1977ABIDJA10721.subject: BIOGRAPHIC DATA ON IVORIAN AMBASSADOR-DESIGNATE TO IRAN, EMMANUEL NOUAMA

segments.text: TO IRAN, EMMANUEL NOUAMA

KOUASSI EMMANUEL ALEXANDRE NOUAMA WAS BORN 24 MARCH 1937 IN GRAND BASSAM, A COASTAL TOWN NEAR ABIDJAN. HE WAS EDUCATED IN THE IVORY COAST AND FRANCE, GRADUATING WITH A DEGREE IN LETTERS FROM THE UNIVERSITY OF POITIERS. FROM 1965 TO 1967, NOUAMA WAS COUNSELLOR OF EMBASSY IN RABAT. FROM 1967 TO 1973, HE WAS COUNSELLOR OF EMBASSY IN WASHINGTON, D.C. IN 1973 HE WAS APPOINTED DIRECTOR OF INTERNATIONAL COOPERATION FOR ECONOMIC, FINANCIAL AND CULTURAL AFFAIRS AT THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS. HE HAS BEEN THE DIRECTOR OF CABINET AT THE MINISTRY SINCE 1974.

AS DIRECTOR OF CABINET, NOUAMA HAS BEEN A PRINCIPAL POINT OF CONTACT IN THE MINISTRY FOR THIS AND OTHER EMBASSIES HERE. HE IS FRIENDLY AND FORTHCOMING, BUT MORE IMPORTANT, DECISIVE AND EFFECTIVE, RARE QUALITIES IN THE IVORIAN FOREIGN OFFICE. HE HAS BEEN CLOSE FRIENDS WITH AMBASSADORS AND OTHER OFFICERS OF THIS EMBASSY AND IS PARTICULARLY WELL-DISPOSED TOWARDS THE U.S. WHILE PLEASED WITH HIS APPOINTMENT TO TEHRAN, HE MADE NO SECRET OF HIS AMBITION TO SUCCEED AMBASSADOR AHOUA IN WASHINGTON. HE SPEAKS FAIR ENGLISH AND ENJOYS USING IT.

NOUAMA AND HIS ATTRATIVE WIFE ARE SOPHISTICATED, ENTERTAINING PEOPLE WHOM WE COMMEND STRONGLY TO EMBASSY TEHRAN. NOUAMA WILL ARRIVE IN DECEMBER OR JANUARY. MADAME NOUAMA AND THEIR TWO CHILDREN WILL REMAIN IN ABIDJAN FOR SEVERAL MONTHS UNTIL HOUSING IS ARRANGED.

1977ALGIER02615.subject: ALGERIAN VIEW OF LIBYAN ROLE IN NORTH AFRICA

segments.text: AS WE HAVE REPORTED PREVIOUSLY, THERE IS A GOOD DEAL OF TALK IN ALGIERS THAT ALGERIANS NOT HAPPY WITH LIBYAN INITIATIVE ON MAGHREB UNITY, AND AT LEAST ONE HIGH GOA OFFICIAL HAS REACTED COOLY TO IDEA IN RECENT CONVERSATION WITH FOREIGN JOURNALISTS.

GENERALLY SPEAKING, OUR IMPRESSION HAS ALWAYS BEEN THAT ALGERIANS WILLING TO GO ALONG WITH QUADHAFI'S UNITY SCHEMES AS LONG AS THESE REMAINED THEORETICAL. THEY SEEM LESS ENTHUSIASTIC, HOWEVER, WHEN IT COMES TO GETTING DOWN TO CASES. AT TIME OF ALGERIAN-LIBYAN RAPPROCHEMENT IN LATE 1975 AND EARLY 1976, FOREIGN MINISTRY OFFICIAL TOOK POSITION IN CONVERSATION WITH US THAT EACH COUNTRY OF REGION MUST ACCORD FIRST PRIORITY TO ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT. ONLY AFTER REASONABLE LEVEL OF DEVELOPMENT ACHIEVED WOULD IT BE POSSIBLE TO THINK OF MAGHREB UNITY, OFFICIAL COMMENTED. SIMILARLY, IN HIS UNGA SPEECH FONMIN BOUTEFLIKA PAID USUAL LIP SERVICE TO MAGHREB UNITY BUT MADE NO MENTION OF QADHAFI'S INITIATIVE.

AT SAME TIME, WE DOUBT THAT ALGERIANS WILL WANT IT TO APPEAR THAT THEY ARE THWARTING QADHAFI'S MOVE. THEY MAY GO ALONG WITH HIS INITIATIVE, PERHAPS EVEN TO POINT OF AGREEING TO ATTEND A MAGHREB SUMMIT, AND WILL TRY TO COUNT ON OTHERS IN REGION TO KEEP QADHAFI'S IDEAS FROM BECOMING TOO SPECIFIC.
GIVEN QADHAFI'S APPARENT INTEREST IN MAURITANIA, DEPT OR EMBASSY TEHRAN MAY WISH TO REPEAT TEHRAN 9069 TO EMBASSY NOUAKCHOTT FOR

1977AMMAN09636.subject: KING HUSSEIN MEETING WITH PRESIDENT CARTER IN TEHRAN

segments.text: REF A) AMMAN 9634, B) STATE 302658

COURT CHIEF SHARAF CALLED SHORTLY AFTER 11:00 A.M. DECEMBER 26 TO TELL ME THAT HE HAS SPOKEN WITH KING WHO HAS EXPRESSED HIS PREFERENCE ON MEETINGS. KING SAID HE WILL OBVIOUSLY WANT A BILATERAL WITH THE SHAH AND WILL WANT A BILATERAL ALSO WITH PRESIDENT CARTER. IF, IN THE COURSE OF HIS DISCUSSIONS IN TEHRAN, A TRILATERAL MEETING SEEMS USEFUL OR REQUIRED, HE WOULD BE VERY MUCH WILLING TO HAVE ONE SET. HIS INCLINATION NOW IS TO LEAVE THE SETTING OF A TRILATERAL MEETING UNTIL DISCUSSIONS TAKE PLACE IN TEHRAN.

SHARAF TOLD ME HE HAD INFORMED IRANIAN AMBASSADOR. SHARAF SAID KING WAS OF COURSE VERY RELAXED, BUT DID NOTE THAT THERE WERE BILATERAL ISSUES AND QUESTIONS WITH IRAN AND THE U.S. WHICH WOULD BEST BE DISCUSSED BETWEEN THE TWO SIDES ALONE. IRANIAN HAS CONFIRMED TO ME THAT HE IS FORWARDING SAME INFORMATION TO TEHRAN, WHICH HE TOLD ME YESTERDAY HAS TAKEN A POSTURE OF WHATEVER HUSSEIN WANTS IS ALRIGHT WITH THE SHAH.

PRESUME THIS WILL OPEN THE WAY TO FIXING SCHEDULE. SHARAF DID NOT SEEM TO THINK THAT TRILATERAL MEETING COULD BE FIXED NOW AND RECOGNIZED THAT FLEXIBILITY IN THE SCHEDULE MIGHT NOT BE AVAILABLE TO RESCHEDULE IT AT A LATER TIME.
RECOMMEND DEPARTMENT REPEAT TEHRAN.

1977ANKARA05167.subject: BAYULKEN APPOINTMENT AS SECRETARY-GENERAL OF PRESIDENCY

segments.text: CONTACTS OVER THE WEEK-END AMONG CENTO SECRETARIAT OFFICIALS INDICATED THAT BAYULKEN PLANS TO STAY ON AS SECRETARY-GENERAL, AT LEAST IN TITLE, UNTIL HE ASSUMES POST AS SECRETARY-GENERAL TO THE PRESIDENCY ON FULL-TIME BASIS SOMETIME IN AUGUST (REFTEL). PRIOR TO HIS ACCEPTING POST AS SECRETARY-GENERAL TO THE PRESIDENCY, BAYULKEN HAD INTENDED TO TAKE LEAVE UNTIL END OF JULY. ALTHOUGH HIS EXACT LEAVE PLANS ARE NOW OPEN TO QUESTION, SECRETARIAT OFFICIALS WERE TOLD ON JULY 8 THAT DEPUTY SECRETARY-GENERAL (POLITICAL AND ADMINISTRATION) SIRDAR HASSAN MAHMUD (PAKISTAN) WOULD BE IN CHARGE OF SECRETARIAT UNTIL BAYULKEN'S RESIGNATION BECOMES EFFECTIVE.
ADDITIONALLY, BAYULKEN'S OFFICE TOLD US JULY 7 THAT NEXT COUNCIL OF DEPUTIES MEETING WOULD BE HELD INN MID-AUGUST; THIS MEETING WILL NOW PROBABLY CONSTITUTE BAYULKEN'S FARWELL TO CENTO.

ON MATTER OF REPLACEMENT FOR BAYULKEN, SECRETARIAT OFFICIALS HAVE INDICATED THAT IRANIANS HAVE ALREADY DESIGNATED, BUT NOT FORMALLY NOMINATED, SUCCESSOR. COMBINED MILITARY PLANNING STAFF SOURCE TOLD US JULY 9 THAT IRANIAN CHOICE IS "YOUNG, UP-AND-COMING" FOREIGN MINISTRY OFFICER. THIS SOURCE DID NOT KNOW HIS NAME EXCEPT THAT IT IS NOT AMBASSADOR HOOSHANG BATMANGHLIDJ WHO HAS BEEN CONNECTED WITH CENTO AFFAIRS FOR MANY YEARS.
ACTION REQUESTED: WE WOULD APPRECIATE ANY INFORMATION EMBASSY TEHRAN MAY HAVE ON POSSIBLE SUCCESSOR TO BAYULKEN.

1977BEIRUT06560.subject: LEBANESE AND PALESTINIAN REACTIONS TO LATEST U.S. STATE- MENTS

segments.text: MENTS

SUMMARY: LEBANESE ARE BEGINNING TO REACT TO STATEMENTS BY PRESIDENT CARTER DISAPPROVING OF PALESTINIAN STATE AND NATIONAL SECURITY ADVISOR BRZEZINSKI RULING OUT PLO AS PART OF PEACE PROCESS. PRESS IS REPORTING PROMINENTLY PRESIDENT'S DECEMBER 28 TELEVISION INTERVIEW AND PRESIDENT SADAT'S CRITICISM. POLITICAL CIRCLES, LEFT AND RIGHT, ARE DEEPLY WORRIED ABOUT CONSEQUENCES FOR LEBANON IF THERE IS NO MIDDLE EAST SOLUTION ACCEPTABLE TO THE PALESTINIANS. MARONITES IN PARTICULAR SEE GRAVE REPERCUSSIONS SOON: BACHIR GEMAYEL IS REPORTED TO BE HOPING FOR ISRAELI HELP TO ESTABLISH A MARONITE REPUBLIC, WITH U.S. ACQUIESCENCE; OTHER MARONITES MAY BE BEGINNING, AT LONG LAST, TO SEEK RAPPROCHEMENT WITH THE MOSLEMS, IN ORDER TO OFFSET BACHIR. END SUMMARY.

IKE. MODERATE PRO-PALESTINIAN ENGLISH-LANGUAGE IKE DECEMBER 29 REPORTED WITHOUT COMMENT WIRE SERVICE REPORTS FROM PARIS THAT NATIONAL SECURITY ADVISOR BRZEZINSKI HAD TOLD PARIS MATCH THAT U.S. HAD DONE EVERYTHING IT COULD TO INDUCE THE PLO TO ADOPT A MORE MODERATE POLICY, TO NO AVIAL, AND QUOTED BRZEZINSKI: "BYEBYE PLO". IKE DECEMBER 30 BANNER IS "SADAT DISAPPOINTED WITH CARTER", WITH SUBHEADING QUOTING SADAT: "HE IS MAKING MY JOB VERY DIFFICULT". STORY IS AP DISPATCH FROM CAIRO. ALSO ON FRONT PAGE IS STORY COMPILED FROM VARIOUS WIRE SERVICES IN WASHINGTON HEADLINED: "CARTER: YES TO BEGIN, NO TO PALESTINE". STORY SAYS PRESIDENT IN HIS TELEVISION INTERVIEW DEC.

28 THOUGHT BEGIN SHOWED A GEAT DEAL OF FLECIBILITY IN HIS PLAN MADE PUBLIC IN THE KNESSET DEC. 28, AND CARRIES EXTRACTS OF TEXT OF INTERVIEW. EDITORIAL IN IKE ARGUES THAT SADAT HAS FAILED, SHOULD ADMIT IT, AND SHOULD RESIGN IF FAILURE HAS DESTROYED HIS CREDIBILITY AS "HELMSMAN" OF ARAB WORLD.

L'ORIENT LE JOUR. INDEPENDENT FRENCH-LANGUAGE DAILY L'ORIENT DECEMBER 29 FRONT PAGES BRZEZINSKI "BYE-BYE PLO" BASED ON AFP FROM PARIS, BUT OTHERWISE SAYS LITTLE ABOUT U.S. ROLE. L'ORIENT DEC. 30, HOWEVER, HEADLINE STORY IS: "SADAT: DECEIVED BY CARTER". STORY, BASED ON UPI AND AFP REPORTS FROM CAIRO OF SADAT'S CBS TELEVISION INTERVIEW, FOCUSSES ON SADAT'S ADJECTIVES. STORY ALSO QUOTES WAFA COMMENTARY OF DECEMBER 29 ATTACKING BRZEZINSKI STATEMENTS TO PARIS MATCH: U.S.

HAS MADE "STRATEGIC DECISION TO OPPOSE THE CREATION OF AN INDEPENDENT PALESTINIAN STATE ON PALESTINIAN SOIL, AND TO BLOCK THE WAY FOR THE PLO, WHICH IS TO BE ISOLATED AND, IF NECESSARY, LIQUIDATED...(THE ISRAELI-AMERICAN POLICY ATTEMPTS) TO POLITICALLY AND ECONOMICALLY SUBJECT THE ARAB WORLD AND MAKE ISRAEL THE GENDARME OF THE MIDDLE EAST". STORY SAYS A U.S.-PLO RUPTURE HAS BEEN PRACTICALLY ASSURED, ALTHOUGH THE PLO REMAINS THE SOLE LEGITIMATE REPRESENTATIVE OF THE PALESTINIANS IN THE VIEW OF THE ARAB STATES.

STORY QUOTES A PLO OFFICIAL: "THE UNITED STATES HAS LOST ALL PRETENSION TO BEING AN HONEST ARBITER OF THE MIDDLE EAST CONFLICT." A WAFA COMMENTARY ALSO STATES THAT IN THE LIGHT OF RECENT U.S. STATEMENTS, "THE PLO AFFIRMS THAT THE BASIS OF ARAB CONFRONTATION ON THE OFFICIAL AND POPULAR LEVELS SHOULD TAKE THE FORM OF A THREAT TO U.S. INTERESTS IN THE REGION."

ARABIC PRESS. COMMENTARY IN ARAB LANGUAGE PRESS IS SO FAR LIMITED. INDEPENDENT AN NAHAR DECEMBER 30 SEEMS DETERMINED TO BE OPTIMISTIC, WITH STORY THAT ISRAEL "MIGHT INSIST ON THE PRESENCE OF ALL PARTIES CONCERNED IN ORDER TO AGREE ON MORE CONCESSIONS. . . ISRAEL ALSO MIGHT DEMAND RECOGNITION BY THE PLO OF THE STATE OF ISRAEL BEFORE MAKING ANY CONCESSIONS, OTHERWISE IT WILL CONTENT ITSELF WITH THE PRESENCE OF EGYPT AND JORDAN. . .IN ADDITION TO THE PRESENCE OF SYRIA AS SUBSTITUTE FOR THE PLO.

THIS POINT MIGHT BE ONE OF THE SUBJECTS TO BE DISCUSSED DURING PRESIDENT CARTER'S TRIP." (COMMENT: AN NAHAR SENIOR EDITOR MICHEL ABU JAWDEH HAS BEEN ENTHUSIASTICALLY SUPPORTIVE OF THE SADAT INITIATIVES, AND BROADLY OPTIMISTIC THAT PEACE IN THE MIDDLE EAST IS IN SIGHT.)

POLITICAL CIRCLES. LEFTISTS CONTINUE TO SUPPORT HOSTILE PALESTINIAN-SYRIAN OUTLOOK. MODERATE MOSLEMS, SOME ORIGINALLY PRIVATELY BUT NOT PUBLICLY SUPPORTIVE OF SADAT INITIATIVES, ARE REFLECTING GROWING CONCERN: ISLAMIC GROUP SPOKESMAN CHAFIC WAZZAN IS SAYING THAT, LIKE THE PALESTINIANS, MOSLEMS SUPPORT THE IDEA OF A PALESTINIAN HOMELAND IN PALESTINE, NOT IN LEBANON. (FOR HIS EFFORTS, SOMEBODY PUT A BOMB IN FRONT OF HIS HOUSE. SECURITY AUTHORITIES SUSPECT THE PALESTINIANS; ONE PALESTINIAN SOURCE SUSPECTS LEBANESE LEFTISTS; AND ONE MARONITE SOURCE WE KNOW SUSPECTS THE SYRIANS.)

AMONG THE MARONITES, U.S. STATEMENTS HAVE HAD SIGNIFICANT IMPACT: BACHIR GEMAYEL, WHO JUST RETURNED FROM THE U.S., IS REPORTEDLY TELLING PEOPLE THAT THERE WILL BE A BIG ISRAELI OPERATION TO DESTROY THE PALESTINIANS IN SOUTH AND THAT THE U.S. WILL GO ALONG WITH IT. OTHER MARONITES FEAR AND SUSPECT THAT HE MAY BE RIGHT, AND THAT HE WANTS TO TAKE OVER A RESULTING "PHALANGIST REPUBLIC". CAMILLE CHAMOUN REPORTEDLY BELIEVES THAT THE SYRIANS WILL SOON HAVE TO LEAVE LEBANON, AND IS SCRAMBLING TO FIND SOME MOSLEM AND DRUZE ALLIES TO OFFSET BACHIR.

ANOTHER RUMOR IS THAT SULEIMAN FRANGIE IS SEEKING TO STRIKE A BARGAIN WITH RACHID KARAME, TO ENCOURAGE THE SYRIANS TO STAY. COMMON THEME AMONG THE MARONITES IS THAT, WHATEVER HAPPENS, THERE WILL BE MOMENTOUS REPERCUSSIONS IN LEBANON.

1977BRUSSE14678.subject: BELGIAN AMBASSADOR MARCEL VAN DE KERCHOVE

segments.text: VAN DE KERCHOVE WAS BORN IN CHERBOURG IN 1924 OF A FRENCH MOTHER AND A BELGIAN FATHER. A DOCTOR IN LAW, HE ENTERED THE DIPLOMATIC SERVICE IN 1951. FOREIGN POSTS AS NOTED REFTEL.

AMBASSADOR VAN DE KERCHOVE IS KNOWN HERE PRINCIPALLY IN THE ROLE OF MFA CHIEF FOR NATO AFFAIRS, A POSITION HELD SINCE 1974. HE SPEAKS FLUENT ENGLISH, FRENCH AND DUTCH, SOME GERMAN AND ARABIC. EMBASSY OFFICERS FOUND HIM A STRONG SUPPORTER OF NATO, BASICALLY PRO-US, BUT NOT BLINDLY SO. HE HAS VISITED THE UNITED STATES ON SEVERAL OCCASIONS.

HE IS MODEST, INTELLIGENT, FRANK AND DIRECT IN PROFESSIONAL CONTACT; ALWAYS CAREFUL TO DISTINGUISH HIS PERSONAL COMMENTS FROM OFFICIAL BELGIAN POSITIONS. HE AND HIS WIFE (LILIANE LABIAU) ARE BOTH GOOD CONVERSATIONALISTS, MIX WELL SOCIALLY, AND HAVE A GOOD SENSE OF HUMOR.
ADDITIONAL MATERIAL POUCHED TODAY, INCLUDING FULL BIO REPORT DATED 12/15/75. OLSEN

SUMMARY. PRESS HIGHLIGHTS CARTER'S CLARIFICATIONS AND WILLINGNESS TO VISIT SADAT. EQUAL TREATMENT GIVEN TO VANCE STATEMENT THAT U.S. DOES NOT SUPPORT BEGIN PLAN. EDITORIALS MORE IN SORROW THAN IN ANGER CRITICIZE CARTER STATEMENTS; ATTACK BEGIN'S ATTITUDE IN NEGOTIATIONS. U.S. CLARIFICATIONS HAVE AMELIORATED ADVERSE EGYPTIAN REACTION. SOME BELIEVE PUBLIC DISAGREEMENT HAS SERVED USEFUL PURPOSE OF REMINDING U.S. THAT SADAT CANNOT BE TAKEN FOR GRANTED. END SUMMARY.

CLARIFICATION. ALL PAPERS DEC 31 HEADLINE PRESIDENT CARTER'S CLARIFICATION ON U.S.-MID EAST POLICY, REITERATING USG PREFERENCE FOR PALESTINIAN ENTITY LINKED TO JORDAN (SADAT'S OWN POSITION). PAPERS NOTE PRESIDENT SAID HE WILL ACCEPT ANY AGREEMENT REACHED BY ISRAEL AND EGYPT AND U.S. HAS NO INTENTION OF IMPOSING SETTLEMENT.

VISIT. PRESS MOOT PRESIDENTIAL VISIT NEXT WEDNESDAY, QUOTING WHITE HOUSE SPOKESMAN AS SAYING FINAL DECISION WILL BE REACHED DEC 31, ON PICKING UP SADAT'S STANDING INVITATION AT THIS TIME. PAPERS REPORT PRESIDENT PREPARED MEET SADAT, IF THIS CONSIDERED DESIRABLE BY BOTH SIDES.

SECRETARY. PRESS PROMINENTLY NOTES SECRETARY'S STATEMENT THAT USG DOES NOT SUPPORT BEGIN PLAN, ALTHOUGH IT "GOOD STARTING POINT". SECRETARY ALSO QUOTED AS HOPING PALESTINIANS WILL JOIN IN NEGOTIATIONS IN FORESEEABLE FUTURE, SINCE THEY SHOULD PLAY ROLE IN DETERMINING SETTLEMENT.

INVITATIONS TO JERUSALEM MEETING. PRESS FRONT PAGES EGYPTIAN (BUT NOT ISRAELI) INVITATIONS TO UNSYG WALDHEIM AND SECRETARY TO PARTICIPATE IN JERUSALEM POLITICAL COMMITTEE DELIBERATIONS. WALDHEIM INVITATION EXTENDED THROUGH EGYPTIAN MISSION TO UN; SECRETARY'S FORWARDED THROUGH EMBASSY CAIRO. SECRETARY'S ACCEPTANCE FEATURED.

EDITORIALS. ALL PAPERS EDITORIALIZE, MORE IN SORROW THAN ANGER, ON PRESIDENT'S EARLIER REMARKS. TYPICAL WAS AHRAM, WHICH SAYS THESE "GIVE RISE TO PERPLEXITY" ON U.S. STAND. PRESIDENT REFERS TO LEGITIMATE RIGHTS OF PALESTINIANS, SAYING THEY SHOULD HAVE HOMELAND OR ENTITY, WHILE SUPPORTING ISRAELI REJECTION INDEPENDENT PALESTINIAN STATE AND DEMAND FOR MILITARY PRESENCE ON WEST BANK. RHETORICALLY, AHRAM QUESTIONS HOW IT POSSIBLE GRANT PALESTINIAN RIGHTS WITHOUT SELF-DETERMINATION, ALSO QUESTIONS POSSIBILITY OF JUST AND DURABLE PEACE WITH CRUX OF PROBLEM UNSOLVED. CONCLUDES CREATION PALESTINIAN STATE ONLY REAL GUARANTEE AGAINST FUTURE WARS, ASKING WHETHER USG WILL SACRIFICE GENUINE PEACE FOR SAKE OF DOMESTIC GAINS.

COMMENTARY. COMMENTATORS DEC 31 HIT BEGIN'S PEACE PLAN HARD. MOST VIRULENT WRITTEN BY MUSTAFA AMIN IN AKHBAR AL-YOM. AMIN, REFERRING TO BEGIN STATEMENT THAT HE ALMOST WALKED OUT OF ISMAILIA TALKS TWICE, SAYS ISRAELI PM LUCKY NONE OF EGYPTIAN NEGOTIATORS SLAPPED HIM IN FACE. CONTINUED, EGYPT NOT NEGOTIATING WITH DELEGATES OF STATE OF ISRAEL BUT "WITH SHYLOCK . . . JEWISH USURER CLAIMING POUND OF FLESH FROM DEBTORS BODY." BEGIN DEPICTED AS PROPERTY USURPER CLAIMING DAMAGES FOR OWN THEFT. "THOSE WHO KNOW HOW CLEVER ISRAELI MERCHANT IS WERE NOT TAKEN ABACK BY BEGIN'S ATTITUDE." HOWEVER, EGYPTIANS SURPRISED BY RECENT DECLARATIONS PRESIDENT CARTER.

PRESIDENT APPEARS TO BE CONTINUING "INTERNATIONAL DANCE, TAKING TWO STEPS FORWARD AND ONE BACK." UNFORTUNATELY RECENT REMARKS INDICATE DANCE HAS CHANGED TO ONE FORWARD AND TWO BACK. 1977GENEVA10087.subject: HUMAN RIGHTS: PRISONER TOTALS, MILITARY COURT

segments.text: RE PARA 5, REF A, MISSOFF HAD OPPORTUNITY DURING NOVEMBER 8 CONVERSATION TO QUERY DIRECTOR OF OPERATIONS, JEAN-PIERRE HOCKE CONCERNING OUTCOME OF MOST RECENT ICRC VISIT TO IRAN.

WHILE OFFERING NO SPECIFICS, HOCKE STATED THAT TEAM HAD COMPLETED ITS MISSION SUCCESSFULLY AND WAS NOW PREPARING ITS REPORT, WHICH WILL BE DELIVERED TO THE SHAH IN THE NEAR FUTURE. HE SAID THAT MISSION MEMBERS HAD BEEN ENCOURAGED BY THE VISIT, FELT THAT IT HAD BEEN CONSTRUCTIVE IN GENERAL AND THAT PROGRESS WAS BEING MADE. HE DID NOTE THAT THERE WAS SOME OBSTRUCTION TO CERTAIN UNSPECIFIED DETAILS DURING THE VISIT ON THE PART OF SAVAK, WHICH COULD BE EXPECTED FROM A SECURITY ORGANIZATION SO LONG ENTRENCHED IN POWER, WHICH WAS NOW GIVING GROUND SLOWLY AND GRUDGINGLY IN THIS AREA.

ICRC IS NOT DISCOURAGED BY THIS HOWEVER, AND FORESEES "SEVERAL MORE VISITS" OF A WEEK TO TEN DAYS EACH, DURING WHICH THEY EXPECT TO MAKE "CONTINUED PROGRESS". FOLLOWING THESE VISITS, ICRC WILL CONDUCT A REVIEW AND ASSESSMENT OF WHERE THEY STAND VIS-A-VIS THE HUMANITARIAN SITUATION IN IRAN.
HOCKE REITERATED THAT THE INTEREST AND BACKING OF THE SHAH IN THIS EFFORT WERE ABSOLUTELY INDISPENSABLE.
RESERVATION MADE HOTEL KOROUSH AUG 24, 25, 26, 27 SINGLE ROOM.

1977ISFAHA00089.subject: STUDENT REACTION IN ISFAHAN; ECHOES OF TEHRAN

segments.text: ON OCTOBER 16, IN MID-MORNING, A GROUP OF APPROXIMATELY 100 MALE STUDENTS FROM THE FACULTIES OF ARTS, SOCIAL SCIENCES, AND SCIENCES BEGAN A DEMONSTRATION DEMANDING A RETURN TO TRADITIONALLY RELIGIOUS VALUES. THEY THREATENED A NUMBER OF FEMALE STUDENTS, TELLING THEM THAT THEY SHOULD NOT GO UNVEILED, SHOULD NOT ASSOCIATE WITH MALE STUDENTS IN CLASSROOMS OR DINING FACILITIES, AND SHOULD NOT BE ATTENDING UNIVERSITY. AT LUNCH TIME, THEY ATTEMPTED TO BLOCK THE ENTRANCE OF FEMALE STUDENTS TO THE SELF-SERVICE CO-ED DINING HALL, BUT WERE PREVENTED FROM DOING SO BY OTHER STUDENTS. THEY THEN INVADED THE BUILDING OF THE FACULTY OF LETTERS, WHERE THEY BEGAN TO BREAK WINDOWS AND DESTROY DOCUMENTS.
OTHER STUDENTS AND CAMPUS SECURITY GUARDS LOCKED THE DOORS OF THE BUILDING AND CALLED THE POLICE, WHO FOUND UP TO 30 STUDENTS STILL TRAPPED IN THE BUILDING WHEN THEY ARRIVED AND ARRESTED THEM.

THIS INCIDENT OCCURRED DURING THE FIRST FESTIVAL OF FOLK ARTS IN ISFAHAN, ATTENDED BY EMPRESS FARAH. APPARENTLY AS A RESULT OF THIS INCIDENT, THE EMPRESS'S ARIPORT DEPARTURE CEREMONY HAS BEEN CANCELLED, A NUMBER OF MAJOR EXHIBITS NEAR THE EMPRESS'S RESIDENCE IN ISFAHAN HAVE BEEN CLOSED DOWN, AND SECURITY AROUND OTHER EXHIBITS AND ALL EVENTS ATTENDED BY THE EMPRESS HAS BECOME EXTREMELY TIGHT--RESULTING PRIMARILY IN A MARKED DECREASE IN IRANIAN ATTENDANCE AT THESE EXHIBITS AND FUNCTIONS. HOWEVER, NO PUBLIC ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING THIS INCIDENT HAS YET BEEN MADE IN ISFAHAN.

COMMENT: THE DEMONSTRATOR'S TARGETS AND TACTICS SEEM ALMOST IDENTICAL TO THOSE OF THE EARLIER TEHRAN DEMONSTRATORS, AND SAVAK IS TRYING TO DETERMINE WHETHER ORGANIZERS CAME FROM TEHRAN OR WHETHER THERE IS A SINGLE ORGANIZATION INVOLVED. IT SEEMS AT LEAST AS LIKELY, HOWEVER, THAT LOCAL STUDENTS WERE MERELY IMITATING WHAT THEY READ IN THE NEWSPAPERS FROM TEHRAN, AS THE SENTIMENTS EXPRESSED ARE NOT UNUSUAL AMONG A CERTAIN CLASS OF TRADITIONAL STUDENTS.

DURING HIS NEARLY FIVE YEARS IN ISLAMABAD, MANOUTCHEHR ZELLI WAS HIGHLY INFLUENTIAL, WIDELY DISLIKED IN THE MFA AND HELPFUL TO OUR EMBASSY AND OUR INTERESTS. THE AMBASSADOR CLOSELY GUARDED THE SHAH'S AND IRAN'S INTERESTS. HE WAS QUICK TO LODGE FORMAL PROTESTS WHEN THE WORDS "ARABIAN GULF" APPEARED IN OBSCURE PAKISTANI PUBLICATIONS. HIS INFLUENCE GREW AS IRAN'S IMPORTANCE, AND FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE, TO PAKISTAN INCREASED. BY THE END OF HIS TOUR, ZELLI HAD IMMEDIATE ACCESS TO ANYONE IN THE GOP UP TO AND INCLUDING PRIME MINISTER BHUTTO.

ZELLI WORE HIS IMPORTANCE EASILY. HE WAS GENERALLY DISLIKED THROUGHOUT THE MFA FOR SOME OF HIS CHARACTERISTICS WHICH PAKISTANIS THINK TYPIFY PERSIANS - ARROGANT, ELITIST, SCORNFUL, SANCTIMONIOUS AND EFFETE. HIS LOYALTY TO THE SHAH WAS EVIDENT AND UNQUESTIONED, AND HIS DETRACTORS IN THE MFA THOUGHT HE ACTED MORE AS A SASSANIAN PROCONSUL THAN A MODERN DAY AMBASSADOR.

ZELLI WAS ALSO OFTEN HELPFUL TO OUR EMBASSY AND SUPPORTIVE OF AMERICAN INTERESTS. HE WILLINGLY SHARED WITH US INFORMATION FROM HIS TALKS WITH BHUTTO, AND, REFLECTING THE SHAH'S VIEW, DID NOT HESITATE TO TELL BHUTTO HE THOUGHT THE ANTI-AMERICAN CAMPAIGN WAS ILL-ADVISED AND COUNTER-PRODUCTIVE.
THE ZELLIS WERE IN GREAT DEMAND IN THE ISLAMABAD SOCIAL CIRCUIT AND SEEMED TO ENJOY ENTERTAINING AND BEING ENTERTAINED.

1977KABUL08902.subject: IRANIAN CONCERN OVER SITUATION IN AFGHANISTAN

segments.text: THE ANSWERS PROVIDED BY CHARGE MIKLOS TO ZELLI (PARAGRAPH 2, REFTEL) ARE ESSENTIALLY CORRECT.

THE AFGHAN AMBASSADOR IN ISLAMABAD IS NUR AHMAD ETEMADI, A FORMER PRIME MINISTER OF AFGHANISTAN DURING THE MONARCHY. ALTHOUGH ETEMADI IS KNOWN TO BE OCCASIONALLY CRITICAL OF HIS KINSMAN, PRESIDENT DAOUD, HE APPEARS TO BE ATRUSTED MEMBER OF THE LATTER'S DIPLOMATIC CORPS (ETEMADI'S LAST ASSIGNMENT WAS MOSCOW) AND CONTINUES TO BE STRONGLY RUMORED AS ONE OF THE VICE PRESIDENTS DAOUD PLANS TO DESIGNATE IN THE NEAR FUTURE. WE HAVE EVEN HEARD ONE RUMOR THAT HE MIGHT REPLACE WAHEED ABDULLAH AS FOREIGN MINISTER. WE CAN ONLY PRESUME THAT HIS IRANIAN COLLEAGUE AT ISLAMABAD EXAGGERATED ETEMADI'S VIEWS.

WHILE AFGHAN AFFAIRS CAN CONCEIVABLY BECOME UNRAVELED VERY QUICKLY AND VIOLENTLY, DAOUD STILL APPEARS TO BE HEALTHY AND FIRMLY IN CHARGE AT THIS TIME. THE POLITICAL AND PUBLIC SAFETY PROBLEMS CITIED BY THE IRANIANS ARE BEING MANAGED BY THE REGIME IN A FASHION THAT EMPHASIZES CALM AND NORMALITY.

ALTHOUGH WE SEE NO VISIBLE EVIDENCE THAT THE AFGHAN GOVERNMENT IS ACTIVELY SEEKING THE KILLERS OF CHIEF PILOT GRAN (A CRIME WHICH WAS NEVER REPORTED IN THE GOVERNMENT-CONTROLLED AFGHAN MEDIA), WE ALSO SEE NO VISIBLE EVIDENCE THAT ANYONE OUTSIDE THE CIRCLES OF GRAN'S OWN FAMILY OR HIS FORMER COLLEAGUES CARES ENOUGH TO PROTEST. THAT IS NOT TO SAY THAT THE GRAN ISSUE MIGHT NOT ARISE SOME DAY AS A SERIOUS PROBLEM FOR THE REGIME.

THE SHORT-LIVED "REVOLT" OF THE FIVE OR SIX CABINET MINISTERS WHO SUBMITTED -- AND THEN WITHDREW -- THEIR RESIGNATIONS HAS NOT PRODUCED ANY DISCERNIBLE RESULTS SINCE DAOUD CONVINCED THE DISSIDENTS TO RETURN TO THEIR OFFICES. INDEED, THERE IS SOME EVIDENCE THAT HE IS NOW UNHURRIEDLY BIDING HIS TIME, PLANNING WAYS TO PRUNE THESE "UNRELIABLE" MINISTERS OUT OF HIS CABINET (PERHAPS EXILING THEM TO AMBASSADORIAL POSTS -- A USUAL AFGHAN PRACTICE).

AS FOR THE ASSASSINATION OF PLANNING MINISTER KHURRAM, THERE HAS BEEN WHAT IS FOR THIS COUNTRY AN UNUSUAL DEGREE OF PUBLICIZED GOVERNMENT ACTION. ON DECEMBER 19, THE GOA IDENTIFIED THE CONFESSED KILLER, ONE MOHAMMAD MARJAN, AND ANNOUNCED THE ARRESTS OF SEVERAL OTHERS WITH WHOM HE HAD ALLEGEDLY PLOTTED (IT IS STILL NOT CLEAR WHETHER THE "PLOTTERS" WERE "LEFTISTS" OR "RIGHTISTS" -OR INDEED WHETHER THESE TERMS HAVE ANY REAL SIGNIFICANCE HERE IN OUR WESTERN SENSE). ALTHOUGH THIS STORY HAS NOT YET UNFOLDED IN ITS ENTIRETY, IT IS CREATING NO DISCERNIBLE SHOCK WAVES IN THE BODY POLITIC EITHER.
IN SHORT, WE REGARD THE KHALATBARY-ZELLI APPROACH AS ANOTHER CASE OF THE FAMILIAR IRANIAN JITTERS.

1977KUWAIT07289.subject: AMIR OF KUWAIT DIES; CROWN PRINCE BECOMES AMIR LIMITED OFFICIAL USE LIMITED OFFICIAL USE

segments.text: AMIR OF KUWAIT, SHAYKH SABAH AL-SALIM AL-SABAH, DIED OF HEART ATTACK ABOUT 0200 LOCAL TIME DEC. 31, 1977 ACCORDING TO OFFICIAL ANNOUNCEMENT MADE HERE AT 0600. HE HAS BEEN SUCCEEDED BY CROWN PRINCE SHAYKH JABER AL-AHMAD AL-JABER AL-SABAH.

THERE IS NO INDICATION OF ANYTHING OTHER THAN A PEACEFUL SUCCESSION. THE COUNCIL OF MINISTERS HAS ORDERED FORTY DAYS OF MOURNING, FIRST THREE DAYS OF WHICH WILL BE OBSERVED BY CLOSURE OF ALL KUWAIT GOVERNMENT OFFICES AND PUBLIC INSTITUTIONS.

BURIAL WILL TAKE PLACE AT 12:00 NOON KUWAIT TIME DEC. 31 IN ACCORDANCE WITH ISLAMIC CUSTOM WHICH DICTATES PROMPT BURIAL. NEW AMIR AND FAMILY MEMBERS WILL RECEIVE CONDOLENCES IMMEDIATELY THEREAFTER AND ON MORNINGS OF NEXT TWO DAYS.
LATE AMIR HAD RULED KUWAIT FOR 12 YEARS, ALTHOUGH IN LAST FEW YEARS, PRESENT AMIR HAD ACTIVELY LED GOVERNMENT. WE WOULD THEREFORE EXPECT NO CHANGE IN GOK POLICY OR PRACTICE.

ACTION REQUESTED: RECOMMEND THAT PRESIDENT SEND MESSAGE OF CONDOLENCE TO AMIR, SHAYKH JABER AL-AHMAD AL-JABER AL-SABAH. AMBASSADOR WILL JOIN DIPLOMATIC CORPS IN PRESENTING CONDOLENCES TO THE NEW AMIR TOMORROW, JAN. 1 AT 0830 HOURS LOCAL. REQUEST THAT PRESIDENT'S CONDOLENCE MESSAGE BE PROVIDED BY COB DEC. 31 SO THAT IT COULD BE PRESENTED PERSONALLY BY AMBASSADOR FOLLOWING MORNING. MAESTRONE NOTE BY OC/T: NOT PASSED PRESIDENT'S PARTY.
WE ARE POUCHING LISBON 7979 AND LISBON 7516 WHICH MAY BE USEFUL IN BRIEFING THE IRANIANS.
IN ADDITION TO REPORTS CITED REF C, WE ARE POUCHING LISBON 7921 ANALYSIS ON MEDEIROS FERREIRA RESIGNATION AS BACKGROUND.

WE HAVE NO OBJECTION TO YOUR USE OF THESE MATERIALS AS BACKGROUND FOR ORAL BRIEFING OF GOI FOREIGN MINISTER ON FERREIRA RESIGNATION AND CURRENT POLITICAL SITUATION. TEXTS, HOWEVER, SHOULD NOT BE SHOWN TO GOI OFFICIALS.

TWENTY DEMONSTRATORS REPRESENTING THE CONFEDERATION OF IRANIAN STUDENTS, LONDON ASSOCIATION (CISNU)' APPEARED AT THE AMERICAN EMBASSY LONDON AT 1010 ON MONDAY, NOVEMBER 14, 1977, TO PROTEST THE VISIT OF THE SHAH OF IRAN TO THE UNITED STATES. THE DEMONSTRATION CONCLUDED AT 1215.

THE DEMONSTRATORS, WHO WERE ALL HOODED, SHOUTED SLOGANS AND CARRIED PLACARDS TO EFFECT: "DOWN WITH SHAH'S REGIME STOOGE OF USA IMPERIALISM", "STOP TORTURING AND MURDERING POLITICAL PRISONERS IN IRAN", "DOWN WITH THE TWO SUPERPOWERS", "US IMPERIALISM OUT OF IRAN", "DEFEND 100,000 POLITICAL PRISONERS IN IRAN", AND "OPPOSE THE SHAH'S VISIT TO THE USA."
POLICE ADVISE THAT CISNU DEMONSTRATIONS WILL ALSO TAKE PLACE AT EMBASSY ON TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 15, AND WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 16.
THERE WAS NO PETITION. UNIFORMED POLICE COVERAGE WAS EXCELLENT.

1977LONDON20881.subject: REPORT ON APPREHENSION OF SUSPECTED HIJACKERS

segments.text: EMBASSY HAS CHECKED WITH APPROPRIATE OFFICIALS, INSOFAR AS THEY ARE AVAILABLE DURING THIS HOLIDAY PERIOD, BUT HAS UNCOVERED NOTHING TO CONFIRM REPORT IN REFTEL.

THERE WAS, HOWEVER, ONE INCIDENT, THE DETAILS OF WHICH WE HAVE NOT YET BEEN ABLE TO CONFIRM, WHICH MAY BE THE BASIS FOR REFTEL SOURCE'S STORY. EMBASSY HAS MADE INQUIRIES AND IF ANY DETAILS DEVELOP WHICH TEND TO CONFIRM REFTEL SOURCE'S STORY, WE WILL INFORM EMBASSY TEHRAN AND DEPARTMENT. BREWSTER NOTE BY OC/T: REFERENCE INCORRECT.

1977NEWDE18690.subject: CONGRESS PARTY TEETERS ON THE BRINK ON NEW YEAR'S EVE

segments.text: ON THE EVE OF THE JANUARY 1-2 "NATIONAL CONVENTION OF CONGRESSMEN" CALLED BY MRS. GANDHI'S SUPPORTERS, THE CONGRESS PARTY REMAINS IN TURMOIL, WITH A FINAL, DEFINITIVE SPLIT INTO TWO SEPARATE PARTIES A GOOD POSSIBILITY. A DE FACTO SPLIT OCCURRED IN THE PARTY'S SENIOR LEADERSHIP IN DECEMBER 27 WHEN SEVEN PRO-INDIRA MEMBERS OF THE 21-MEMBER CONGRES WORKING COMMITTEE (CWC) RESIGNED FROM THE COMMITTEE. (MRS. GANDHI HERSELF HAD RESIDNED FROM THE CWC ON DECEMBER 18.) THE 13 REMAINING MEMBERS ARE IN THE CAMP OF CONGRESS PRESIDENT BRAHMANADA REDDY AND PARLIAMENTARY PARTY LEADER CHAVAN. REDDY HAS NOT YET ACCEPTED THE RESIGNATIONS OF MRS.
GANDHI AND THE SEVEN OTHERS, MOST OF WHOM ARE POLITICAL LIGHTWEIGHTS WITH LITTLE FOLLOWING IN THEIR HOME STATES, PERHAPS IN THE HOPE OF AVOIDING AN OUTRIGHT BREAK.

HOPES FOR A RECONSILIATION BETWEEN THE WARRING FACTIONS SEEM DIM AT THIS POINT. REDDY AND CHAVAN ON DECEMBER 27 STRONGLY CONDEMNED THE "CONVENTION" AS AN "ANTI-PARTY MANEUVER" AND A "CAMOUFLAGE FOR AN ATTEMPT TO SPLIT THE PARTY FOR PERSONAL AND FACTIONAL ENDS." THEY DIRECTLY ACCUSED MRS.

GANDHI OF TRYING TO REASSERT HER DOMINATION OVER THE CONGRESS AND "TO CONVERT IT INTO A CAPTIVE ORGANIZATION." REDDY AND CHAVAN CALLED UPON ALL CONGRESSMEN TO BOYCOTT THE "CONVENTION" SO AS TO PREVENT THE PARTY FROM BECOMING A "PLAYTHING IN THE HANDS OF AN INDIVIDUAL." HINTS FROM LEADERS OF THE REDDY"CHAVAN FACTION THAT THOSE ATTENDING THE JANUARY 1-2 MEETING WOULD FACE DISCIPLINARY ACTION MAY NOW BE IMPACTING ON MANY WAVERING CONGRESSMEN. REPORTS FROMSTATE CAPITALS INCREASINGLY INDICATE THAT MANY CONGRESSMEN WILL NOT ATTEND THE "CONVENTION." EVEN IN MRS.

GANDHI'S HOME STATE OF U.P., LONG CONSIDERED HER ONE SAFE STRONGHOLD, A SIZEABLE CHUNK OF CONGRESS ELDERS HAVE REVOLTED AGAINST THE "CONVENTION" AND HAVE URGED PARTY FIGURES TO BOYCOTT IT. THER ARE ALSO SIGNS THAT THE PRO-INDIRA FACTION ITSELF MAY BE DIVIDING OVER THE IDEA; MRS. GANDHI LOYALIST AND U.P. CONGRESS STRONGMAN KAMALAPATI TRIPATHI RECENTLY SOFT-PEDALED THE "CONVENTION" IDEA, SAYING THAT IT WAS ONLY INTENDED AS A "SEMINAR" TO DISCUSS THE JANATA GOVERNMENT'S FAILURES. HIS "SOFT" APPROACH PRODUCED CRITICISM FROM THE HAWKS IN MRS. BANGHI'S CAMP, WHO SEEM BENT ON OPEN CONFRONTATION WITH THE REDDY/CHAVAN LEADERSHIP.

DESPITE THE LUKEWARM RESPONSE TO THE INVITATIONS, MRS. BANDHI'S LOYALISTS ARE FORGING AHEAD WITH THE "CONVENTION". IN AN OBVIOUS BID TO STEM WEAKENING RESOLVE WITHIN HER FACTION, THE FORMER PMHERSELF ON DECEMBER 30 ATTENDED AND TOOK CHARGE OF THE STERRING COMMITTEE MEETING WHICH IS DRAWING UP PLANS FOR THE SESSION. BY DOING SO, SHE MADE IT CLEAR THA THE IDEA IS HERS AND THAT SHE IS DETERMINED TO SEE IT THROUGH.
AS A TUMULTUOUS 1977 DRAWS TO A CLOSE, THE CONGRESS PARTY WHICH SEEMED SECURITY IN PLACE AT ITS OUTSET IS IN DISARRAY. YET IF 1977 WAS A BAD FOR THE CONGRESS, 178 PROMISES TO BE LITTLE BETTER.

1977NEWDE18696.subject: INDIAN SENSITIVITY ABOUT US COMMENTS ON INDO-SOVIET RELATIONS

segments.text: RELATIONS

YOU SHOULD BE AWARE THAT IN THE LAST TWO DAYS AT LEAST TWO INDIAN PAPERS HAVE REFERRED UNFAVORABLY TO THE PRESIDENT'S COMMENT ON THE GOI'S MOVING AWAY FROM THE SOVIETS AND TOWARD US. THE DECEMBER 30 "TIMES OF INDIA" CITES "COMPETENT CIRCLES" AS SAYING THAT THE REMARK IS NOT TAKEN AS A COMPLIMENT.

THESE "CIRCLES" REPORTEDLY EXPLAIN THAT "THERE IS NO QUESTION OF INDIA MOVING TOWARD ANY COUNTRY, BIG OR SMALL" AND THAT THE DESAI GOVERNMENT "CONTINUES TO VALUE ITS FRIENDSHIP WITH BOTH THE SOVIET UNION AND THE UNITED STATES AND IT IS NOT CONTRADICTORY." (ARTICLE DID NOT MENTION THAT PRESIDENT HAD SAID THAT INDIANS WERE ASSUMING A ROLE OF NEUTRALITY.)

INDIAN EXPRESS PICKED UP SAME THEME THIS MORNING IN AN OTHERWISE FAVORABLE EDITORIAL WELCOMING PRESIDENT'S VISIT. EDIT POINTED OUT THAT PRESIDENT'S REFERENCE TO A PRO-SOVIET TILT IN INDIAN POLICY SHOULD HAVE BEEN AVOIDED AS EMBARRASSING.

AMBASSADOR QUERIED PALKIVALA YESTERDAY ABOUT THE SOURCE OF THE TIMES OF INDIA ITEM. PALKHIVALA SAID THAT HE WAS SURE NEITHER THE FOREIGN MINISTER NOR FOREIGN SECRETARY MEHTA (WHO HAD HIMSELF EXTENSIVELY BRIEFED THE PRESS EARLIER) WOULD HAVE MADE SUCH COMMENTS. PALKIVALA ADDED THAT THERE WERE OTHERS IN THE MINISTRY OF EXTERNAL AFFAIRS WHO MIGHT HAVE, HOWEVER.

1977NICE00422.subject: ASSASSINATION ATTEMPT ON PRINCESS ASHRAF PALAHVI, SISTER OF THE SHAH OF IRAN.

segments.text: SISTER OF THE SHAH OF IRAN.

AS ADDRESSEES AWARE AN ATTEMPT ON THE LIFE OF THE SISTER OF THE SHAH OF IRAN WAS MADE EARLY THE MORNING OF SEPTEMBER 13 (POLICE SOURCES STATED 0327 HOURS). ALTHOUGH PRINCESS ASHRAF WAS NOT INJURED HER TRAVELLING COMPANION MRS. KAN JECH NOURI FOROUGH WAS KILLED AND THE DRIVER OF THE PRINCESS AUTOMOBILE WAS SLIGHTLY WOUNDED (MR. ARUS ETTEMEDIAN). A FOURTH PASSENGER IN THE AUTOMOBILE, MR. M. NODER DIJARCHI WAS NOT INJURED.

THE AUTOMOBILE USED TO CARRY THE ASSASSINS AND WHICH FORCED THE PRINCESS CAR OFF THE ROAD (A PEUGEOT 504) HAS BEEN FOUND AND WAS APPARENTLY STOLEN. THE ATTACKERS FIRED AT LEAST SEVEN SHOTS INTO THE PRINCESS CAR AND THEN DROVE OFF.

THE CONSULATE HAS JUST BEEN INFORMED BY THE POLICE THAT AT THIS POINT NO IDENTIFICATION HAS BEEN MADE AS TO THE GROUP OR INDIVIDUALS WHO MAY HAVE BEEN INVOLVED IN THE ATTACK. WE HAVE BEEN PROMISED INFORMATION WHEN IDENTIFICATION/ARREST IS MADE.
APPRECIATE YOUR COMMENTS. SINCE WE HAVE NO RECORD OF HAVING RECEIVED YOUR A18 OF FEBRUARY 3, 1977, WE WOULD BE GRATEFUL IF YOU COULD TELEGRAPH THE BIO INFO IT CONTAINS.
REF TEHRAN 7693 (NOTAL)

MOST STRIKING ASPECT OF SHAH'S AUGUST 26-30 VISIT TO CZECHOSLOVAKIA WAS THE VAST AMOUNT OF MEDIA ATTENTION TO IT. GIVEN THE HEAVY TRAFFIC OF VIPS THROUGH PRAGUE, IT IS SOMEWHAT SURPRISING TO RECALL HOW FEW HEADS OF STATE COME HERE (AND EVEN FEWER WHO BOTH REIGN AND RULE); THE SHAH IS THE FIRST IN OVER A YEAR. IN CONSEQUENCE, NEWSPAPER AND MAGAZINE READERS AND TV VIEWERS HAVE FOR SEVERAL WEEKS BEEN PROVIDED WITH FAR MORE THAN THEY MAY WANT TO KNOW ABOUT IRAN, PARTICULARLY THE LONG HISTORY OF CZECH-PERSIAN RELATIONS AND THE CURRENT CZECHOSLOVAK-IRANIAN TIES IN ECONOMIC, CULTURAL AND SCIENTIFIC FIELDS.

THE SHAH'S PROGRAM WAS HEAVILY LOADED ON THE CULTURAL/EDUCATIONAL SIDE, WITH BOTH HIMSELF AND THE SHAHBANOU RECEIVING HONORARY DEGREES FROM CHAARLES UNIVERSITY AND TOURING HISTORIC SITES IN PRAGUE AND BRATISLAVA. THE SHAH, NEVERTHELESS, WAS ALSO ABLE TO INDULGE IN ONE OF HIS FAVORITE PASTTIMES-LOOKING AT MILITARY HARDWARE- AS THE GOC SHOWED OFF THE PRODUCTS OF ITS ARMS INDUSTRY (AND PROMPTED CONSIDERABLE SPECULATION HERE OVER POSSIBLE BILATERAL ARMS DEALS).

AT IMPRESSIVE CHARLES UNIVERSITY CEREMONIES GRANTING HONROARY DOCTORATES, THE SHAH DELIVERED A NOTEWORTHY SPEECH ON HUMAN RIGHTS--AS REPORTED TEHRAN 7693. INITIAL PASSAGES OF HIS STATEMENT REFERRED MAINLY TO OBLIGATIONS OF ALL STATES TO RESPECT THE UNIVERSAL DECLARATION OF HUMAN RIGHTS. IN THIS YEAR OF CHARTER 77, WITH ITS ATTENDANT DEBATE OVER RESPECT FOR FUNDAMENTAL FREEDOMS IN CZECHOSLOVAKIA, THE SHAH'S SPEAKING OUT ON HUMAN RIGHTS PROBLEMS IN THE PRESENCE OF PARTY-STATE LEADER HUSAK, THE FACULTY OF CHARLES UNIVERSITY, AND REPRESENTATIVES OF THE LOCAL DIPLOMATIC CORPS WAS A REMARKABLE EVENT.
MOST OF HIS SPEECH STRUCK US AS A STANDARD EXPOSITION, HOWEVER, ON IRAN'S POSITION WITHIN OPEC AND THE SHAH'S CHAMPIONING OF THIRD WORLD ECONOMIC POLICIES TOWARD THE INDUSTRIALIZED WEST.

FINAL COMMUNIQUE WAS ROUTINE WITH MAIN ITEM OF INTEREST BEING REFERENCE TO "CSSR INTEREST IN PURCHASE OF CRUDE OIL AND OTHER IRANIAN PRODUCTS...", SUGGESTING THAT OIL DEAL WHICH HAS BEEN UNDER DISCUSSION FOR SOME TIME HAS NOT YET BEEN COMPLETED. IRANIAN AMBASSADOR TELLS US NO AGREEMENT WAS SIGNED DURING VISIT. COMMUNIQUE ALSO NOTES THAT PRESIDENT HUSAK HAS ACCEPTED INVITATION TO VISIT IRAN AT A TIME TO BE AGREED UPON THROUGH DIPLOMATIC CHANNELS.

COMMENT: FROM THE HUSAK REGIME'S POINT OF VIEW PERHAPS THE MAIN VALUE OF THIS VISIT WAS ITS DEMONSTRATION THAT CZECHOSLOVAKIA CONTINUES TO ENJOY A DEGREE OF INTERNATIONAL LEGITIMACY WITH THE NON-COMMUNIST WORLD DESPITE WIDESPREAD CIRTICISM OVER ITS STANCE ON HUMAN RIGHTS ISSUES. THE ONLY ITEM OF GENUINE SUBSTANCE FOR THESE COUNTRIES TO DISCUSS WAS INCREASED ECONOMIC COOPERATION, WHICH WAS TAKEN CARE OF IN A BRIEF MEETING JUST BEFORE DEPARTURE AND INVOLVED NO ECONOMIC EXPERTS FROM THE IRANIAN SIDE. WE WOULD BE INTERESTED IN ANYTHING TEHRAN MAY LEARN ABOUT THE STATUS OF CZECHOSLOVAK-IRANIAN OIL NEGOTIATIONS FOLLOWING THE SHAH'S RETURN HOME.

1977RABAT05676.subject: REQUEST FOR DEPARTMENT ASSESSMENT OF CURRENT LIBYAN ROLE IN WESTERN NORTH AFRICA

segments.text: LIBYAN ROLE IN WESTERN NORTH AFRICA REF TEHRAN 9069 WE ARE REPEATING RABAT 5046 TO TEHRAN. OUR ANALYSIS IN THAT TELEGRAM STILL APPLIES.

ALTHOUGH AL-HAMDI CONTINUES TO BE FRUSTRATED BY ACTIONS OF RECALCITRANT NORTHERN TRIBAL LEADERS, WE HAVE SEEN NOTHING TO INDICATE THAT OUT OF THIS FRUSTRATION HE IS "TURNING TO THE LEFT". THERE ARE REPORTS THAT AL-HAMDI MAINTAINS HIS CONTACTS WITH LEFTIST ELEMENS IN THE COUNTRY BOTH AS A WAY OF KEEPING TABS ON THEIR ACTIVITIES AS WELL AS PROTECTINT HIS LEFT FLANK. IT IS DOUBLTFUL, HOWEVERN THAT DESPITE HIS TRIBAL DIFFICULTIES HE WOULD GIVE "COMMUNIST ORIENTED INDIVIDUALS AND OR GRUPS GREATER SCOPE AND FREEDOM IN THEIR ACTIVITIES ON THE LOCAL SCENE".

ALL OF AL-HAMDI'S MOVES OVER THE LST THREE YEARS POINT TO A MIDDLE-OFTHE-ROAD, PRAGMATIC POLICY BASED ON CLOSE COOPERATION WITH SAUDI ARABIA AND SUDAN. THE RECENT ASSASSINATION OF LQIMINENT POLITICAL FIGURE AL-HAJRI WITH PROBABLE PDRY INVOLVEMENT HAS FURTHER INCREASED AL-HAMDI'S WARINESS OF TOO CLOSE DEALINGS WITH LEFTISTS WHO, HE KNOWS FULL WELL, REGARD HIM AND HIS REGIME AS BOURGEOIS CLIENTS OF THE SAUDIS.

THE ABOVE DOES NOT MEAN, HOWEVER, THAT THE LEFT, SUCH AS IT IS IN YEMEN, HAS CEASED ITS BEHIND-THE-SCENES MACHINATIONS IN AN EFFORT TO KEEP ITSELF ALIVE AT A TIME WHEN THE COUNTRY IS EXPERIENCING A REAL ECONOMIC BOOM AND WEN FEW YEMENIS ARE BEING ATTRACTED TO THE EXTREMIST SOLUTIONS BEING PROPOSED BY THE LEFT FOR YEMEN'S ECONOMIC AND DEVELOPMENTAL PROBLEMS.

"DEAR MR. PRIME MINISTER: I WISH TO CONGRATULATE YOU ON YOUR APPOINTMENT AS PRIME MINISTER. I RECALL OUR GOOD MEETINGS IN TEHRAN IN MAY AND LATER IN PARIS AND LOOK FORWARD TO FREQUENT OPPORTUNITIES TO MEET AND WORK WITH YOU IN THE FUTURE. OVER THE YEARS, OUR COUNTRIES HAVE ENJOYED THE CLOSEST RELATIONSHIP. I AM SURE THAT DURING YOUR TERM AS PRIME MINISTER, AS DURING THE PERIOD OF SERVICE OF YOUR PREDECESSOR, THIS DEEP FRIENDSHIP WILL CONTINUE TO FLOURISH. AGAIN, PLEASE ACCEPT MY WARM PERSONAL CONGRATULATIONS AND BEST WISHES AS YOU ASSUME THE NEW RESPONSIBILITIES PLACED UPON YOU AT THIS TIME BY HIS IMPERIAL MAJESTY. CORDIALLY, CYRUS VANCE. END .

ON THE BASIS OF CONFIDENTIAL CONSULTATIONS WITH KEY EUROPEAN ALLIES, WE ARE EXPLORING WITH SELECTED AFRICAN AND ARAB STATES WHAT MEASURES MIGHT BE TAKEN TO TRY TO BRING AN END TO THE OGADEN CONFLICT. WHILE RECOGNIZING THAT AT THE PRESENT TIME NEITHER ETHIOPIA NOR SOMALIA HAS SHOWED ANY DISPOTITION TO HALT THE FIGHTING EXCEPT ON TERMS TOTALLY FAVORABLE TO THEM, WE BELIEVE THAT A REAL EFFORT SHOULD BE MADE TO END THE CONFLICT. FOLLOWING THE SOUNDINGS WE WILL COMPARE NOTES WITH OUR ALLIES AND CONSIDER WHAT FURTHER ACTION MIGHT BE APPRIORIATE.

FOR TEHRAN AND ARA ES SALAAM: AT YOUR EARLIEST CONVENIENCE, PREFERABLY WITHIN THE NEXT THREE DAYS YOU SHOULD SEEK AN APPOINTMENT AT THE FOREIGN MINISTER LEVEL AND MAKE THE FOLLOWING POINTS: AS US HAS INDICATED BEFORE, WE CANNOT BUT BE CONCERNED ABOUT THE ONGOING BLODY CONFLICT IN THE OGADEN WHERE NO RESOLUTION APPEARS TO BE IN SIGHT. OUR CONCERN IS SHARED BY SEVERAL OF OUR PRINCIPAL EUROPEAN ALLIES. WE RECOGNIZE THAT THE OGADEN ISSUE IS AN AFRICAN PROBLEM, COMPLICATED IN ITS NATURE AND WITH DEEP ROOTS IN ITS HISTORY. IT IS NOT OUR DESIRE TO INTERFERE, NOR DO WE HAVE ANY PARTICULAR IDEAS TO PROMOTE.

WE WOULD WELCOME YOUR VIEWS ON THIS MATTER AND TO KNOW WHETHER THERE IS ANY ROLE WHICH YOUR GOVERNMENT MIGHT THINK IT WOULD BE HELPFUL FOR THE US, OR EUROPEAN STATES, TO PLAY. FOR EXAMPLE, WOULD THE EFFORTS OF THE OAU COUNTRIES TO ACHIEVE A SOLUTION BE STRENGTHENED BY SOME FORM OF ACTION IN THE UN, PARTICULARLY IN THE CONTEXT OF THE SECURITY COUNCIL WHERE, FOR THE INITIATIVE TO BE EFFECTIVE, WE SHOULD ENGAGE THE SOVIETS IN ADVANCE.

FOR TEHRAN: YOU MAY WISH TO STATE THAT WE HAVE VALUED EARLIER EXCHANGES WITH THEM ON THE HORN. YOU MAY WISH TO REASSURE THEM THAT WE SHARE THEIR INTEREST IN REDUCTION OF SOVIET INFLUENCE IN THE HORN, WHILE REITERATING OUR FIRM POLICY NOT TO IMPLEMENT OUR DECISION TO PROVIDE DEFENSIVE WEAPONS TO SOMALIA AT A TIME WHEN SOMALIA IS PARTICIPATING IN MILITARY ACTION WITHIN THE BOUNDARIES OF A NEIGHBORING COUNTRY. 1977SECTO13036.subject: ISRAELI PROPOSALS FOR AGENDA TO JERUSALEM POLITICAL COMMITTEE MEETING

segments.text: POLITICAL COMMITTEE MEETING REF STATE 311179

AS REPORTED CAIRO 23415, AMBASSADOR ELITS HAS ALREADY PASSED TO EGYPTIAN FOREIGN MINISTER KAMEL DAYAN'S SUGGESTED AGENDA FOR JERUSALEM POLITICAL COMMITTEE MEETING. WE AGEEE WITH RECOMMENDATIONS IN REFTEL THAT BOTH ELITS AND LEWIS INFORM THEIR RESPECTIVE HOST GOVERNMENTS THAT WE WILL DEFER OUR COMMENTS ON PROPOSED AGENDA UNTIL WE HAVE CLEAR PICTURE OF THE VIEWS OF ISRAELIS AND EGYPTIANS, INCLUDING LATTER'S REACTION TO DAYAN'S SUGGESTIONS.

I VISITED ZAHEDAN AND ZABOL MAY 13, 14, AND 15, PRIMARILY TO LOOK INTO THE HELMAND WATERS ISSUE FROM THE LOCAL LEVEL. I TALKED WITH A NUMBER OF PEOPLE IN BOTH PLACES AND MEMCONS OF THE MOST RELEVANT CONVERSATIONS ARE BEING POUCHED. THERE FOLLOWS A COMPENDIUM OF THE INFORMATION OBTAINED.

FIRST, A FEW FACTS CONCERNING THE PHYSICAL SITUATIONIN SISTAN, THE AREA IN IRAN WATERY THE HELMAND: --THE REGION IS DRYING UP. RECENT ARCHEOLOGICAL EXCAVATIONS IN SISTAN INDICATE THAT THE WATER TABLE HAS FALLEN ABOUT 20 METERS IN THE LAST 5,000 YEARS. --ALMOST NONE OF THE WATER WHICH FLOW INTO THE HAMUN (THE SYSTEM OF SHALLOW LAKES WHICH STRADDLES THE IRAN-AFGHAN BORDER THERE) RISES ON THE IRANIAN SIDE. AMBASSADOR DAVOUDI'S STATEMENT (PARA 9 REF A) IS PATENTLY FALSE. --SISTAN IS A RELATIVELY REPEAT RELATIVELY FERTILE AREA IN AN OTHERWISE EXTREMELY ARID REGION.

ON THE AVERAGE, SISTAN GETS ABOUT 30 MILLILITERS OF PRECIPITATION ANNUALLY, AND EVEN WITH IRRIGATION THE AVERAGE YIELD OF WHEAT PER HECTARE IS ONLY 1.5 TONS, SOMEWHAT BELOW THE IRANIAN NATIONAL AVERAGE FOR IRRIGATED WHEAT WHICH ITSELF IS NOT PARTICULARLY HIGH. --THE HELMAND IS SISTAN DIVIDES INTO SEVERAL DISTRIBUTARIES, SOME NATURAL AND OTHERS MAN-MADE.

ONE OF THE LATTER, WHICH LEAVES THE MAIN CHANNEL ABOUT TWO KILOMETERS ABOVE KOHAK AND FLOWS IN A NORTHWESTERLY DIRECTION, FORMS PART OF THE BORDER BETWEEN AFGHANISTAN AND IRAN. --THE DAM AT KOHAK (AND ANOTHER AT ZAHAK ABOUT 15 KILOMETERS DOWNSTREAM) IS IN ACTUALITY A BARRAGE WHICH DIVERTS WATER FROM THE HELMAND'S MAIN DISTRIBUTARY IN IRAN INTO AN IRRIGATION CHANNEL. AS THE BARRAGES HAVE NO STORAGE CAPACITY BEHIND THEM, THEIR VALUE FOR FLOOD CONTROL IS NEGLIGBLE. --THE IRRIGATION CHANNEL CARRYING WATER DIVERTED BY THE BARRAGE AT KOHAK PARALLELS THE DISTRIBUTARY MENTIONED ABOVE WHICH FORMS PART OF THE IRAN-AFGHAN BORDER AND ULTIMATELY DEBOUCHES INTO THE HAMUN.

IT IS THEREFORE EXTREMELY UNLIKELY THAT THE DAMAGE INFLICTED ON 100,000 AFGHAN HECTARES FIFTEEN YEARS AGO BY FLOOD WATERS WAS AS A CONSEQUENCE OF THE BARRAGE AT KOHAK AS CLAIMED BY ABDULLAH (PARA 2 REF A).

THE IRANIANS CURRENTLY HAVE 74 LARGE PUMPS IN OPERATION ON THE HELMAND, MOST OF WHICH ARE DRAWING WATER OUT OF THE SAME DISTRIBUTARY WHICH FORMS PART OF THE IRAN-AFGHAN BORDER. SOURCES ON THE IRANIAN SIDE STATED THE AFGHANS HAVE NONE.

THE ECONOMIC SIGNIFICANCE OF THE HELMAND'S WATERS FOR IRAN DIMINISHES THE FURTHER ONE TRAVELS FROM SISTAN. IN ZAHEDAN, THE PROVINCIAL CAPITAL, THE GOVERNOR GENERAL (HIMSELF AN AGRICULTURAL ENGINEER) TENDED TO TAKE A RELATIVELY RELAXED VIEW. AS FAR AS HE WAS CONCERNED, THE MOST IMPORTANT ISSUE IS STABLILIZATION OF THE WATER SUPPLY. HE THINKS IN TERMS OF THE POTENTIAL FOR AGROBUSINESSES IN SISTAN WHICH WOULD REQUIRE SUBSTANTIAL CAPITAL INVESTMENT. SUCH INVESTMENT CANNOT BE UNDERTAKEN IN A CLIMATE OF UNCERTAINTY.

IN ZABOL, ON THE OTHER HAND, ECONOMIC CONSIDERATIONS EXCLUDE ALL OTHERS. WITHOUT THE HELMAND'S WATER SISTAN HAS NO FUTURE AL ALL. THERE IS UNANIMOUS AGREEMENT THAT IRAN NEEDS ALL THE WATER IT CAN GET AND WIDESPREAD BELIEF THAT 26 METERS PER SECOND IS GROSSLY INADEQUATE. THERE IS A FACTUAL BAISIS FOR THE LATTER, AT LEAST IF SISTAN'S FUTURE IS GAGED IN TERMS OF CURRENT LAND USGAGE AND PRODUCTIVE CAPACITY. AT PRESENT, APPROXIMATELY HALF OF THE REGION'S 200,000 ARABLE HECTARES ARE CULTIVATED DURING A GIVEN YEAR. ALMOST ALL THE LAND IS PLANTED IN CEREALS.

IF IRAN'S SHARE OF THE HELMAND'S WATERS IS LIMITED TO 809,000,000 CUBIC METERS PER YEAR, EVEN IF IT COULD ALL BE USED TO MAXIMUM EFFICIENCY, IT WOULD NOT BE ENOUGH TO IRRIGATE ADEQUATELY 100,000 HECTARES OF WHEAT AND BARLEY.

BUT THERE ARE ALTERNATIVES. CONVERTING THE AREA TO PASTURAGE WOULD REDUCE THE PER HECTAR REQUIREMENT FOR WATER. A CERTAIN AMOUNT OF GRAIN PRODUCTION WOULD BE LOST THEREBY, BUT EVEN NOW SISTAN'S PRODUCTIVE CAPACITY IS ONLY OF LOCAL IMPORTANCE (NO MORE THAN 2.5 PERCENT OF IRAN'S TOTAL WHEAT PRODUCTION COMES FROM THE REGION). MOREOVER, DEMOGRAPHIC TRENDS, IRRESPECTIVE OF THE AVAILABILITY OF WATER, ARE HASTENING THE DAY WHEN A MAJOR SHIFT IN THE CHARACTER OF AGRICULTURE IN SISTAN WILL BECOME INEVITABLE.

EVEN NOW, MIGRATION OF THE REGION'S YOUNG MEN TO OTHER PARTS OF IRAN IN SEARCH OF ECONOMIC OPPORTUNITY AND THE PERSISTENCE OF THE TRADITIONAL FARMING TECHNIQUES HAVE RESULTED IN LESS LAND BEING CULTIVATED THAN COULD BE PUT INTO PRODUCTION GIVEN (FOR THE MOMENT) THE RELATIVE ABUNDANCE OF WATER AVAILABLE. THE AGRICULTURAL OFFICER IN ZABOL BELIEVES THAT THE SCARCITY OF LABOR WILL SOON MAKE A TRANSITION FROM CEREALS TO ANIMAL HUSBANDRY MANDATORY.

POLITICALLY, THE HELMAND'S WATERS HAVE IMPORTANT DOMESTIC AS WELL AS INTERNATIONAL IMPLICATIONS. (AS FAR AS THE LATTER ARE CONCERNED, I FOUND UNIVERSAL CONVICTION AT THE LOCAL LEVEL THAT THE SOVIETS HAVE PUT AFGHANISTAN UP TO CONSTRUCTION OF THE KAMAL KHAN DAM AS A MEANS OF ATTACKING IRAN ON AN EXPOSED FLANK.) OF NECESSITY, TEHRAN MUST BE CONCERNED ABOUT THE ECONOMIC WELL-BEING OF CITIZENS IN ONE OF THE REMOTEST AND POOREST REGIONS OF THE COUNTRY.

THUS, AS SUGGESTED BY AMBASSADOR MAHMUD-GHAZI (PARA 2 REF B), RATIFICATION OF THE HELMAND WATERS TREATY MAY NOT ENTIRELY PACIFY THE GOI SINCE IT WILL DO NOTHING TO RELIEVE (AND MAY EVEN EXACERBATE) LOCAL CONCERNS IN SISTAN.

GHAUS'S HYPOTHESIS (PARA 4 REF C) REGARDING IRANIAN MACHINATIONS HAS A CERTAIN PLAUSIBILITY, ALTHOUGH GIVEN SISTAN'S DECLINING AGRICULTURAL IMPORTANCE AND THE DEMOGRAPHIC PATTERN THERE (IT WOULD APPEAR THAT THE POPULATION HAS ACTUALLY DECLINED ALTHOUGH THE MOST RECENT CENSUS INDICATED A VERY SLIGHT INCREASE OVER THE LAST TWO DECADES), I AM INCLINED TO THINK A VARIANT OF IT MIGHT HAVE GREATER VALIDITY: IRAN NEEDS (AND IS PRESENTLY USING) MORE WATER THAN IT IS ENTITLED TO UNDER THE TERMS OF THE TREATY DURING THE PERIOD OF TIME REQUIRED FOR TRANSITION FROM CEREAL CULTIVATION BY TRADITIONAL METHODS TO SOMETHING ELSE REQUIRING BOTH LESS WATER AND LESS LABOR.

HENCE THE DESIRE TO BUY WATER EXCESS TO AFGHANISTAN'S OWN NEEDS AS REPORTED IN PARA 2 OF REF C. FOR THE SAME REASON, IRAN IS PARTICULARLY UPSET BY THE KAMAL KHAN PROJECT WHICH FROM ITS POINT OF VIEW SMACKS OF A DOG IN THE MANGER.

1977STATE145783.subject: ATHERTON MEETING WITH PDRY UN AMBASSADOR

segments.text: AT OUR INITIATIVE, ASSISTANT SECRETARY ATHERTON MET IN NEW YORK JUNE 22 WITH PDRY PERMANENT REPRESENTATIVE ASHTAL. ATHERTON ASKED ASHTAL TO CONVEY TO HIS GOVERNMENT THAT,IN ACCORDANCE WITH PRESIDENT'S POLICY OF SEEKING TO IMPROVE RELATIONS WHEREVER POSSIBLE, WE WOULD LIKE TO ENTER INTO A HIGH-LEVEL DIALOGUE WITH A VIEW TO IMPROVING RELATIONS WITH SOUTH YEMEN LOOKING TOWARD THE RESTORATION OF DIPLOMATIC RELATIONS. TO THAT END, WE PROPOSED A MEETING OF SENIOR OFFICIALS OF OUR TWO GOVERNMENTS IN ADEN, WASHINGTON, NEW YORK OR WHEREVER THE YEMENIS FOUND CONVENIENT.

ASHTAL NOTED THAT DURING MEETING WITH PDRY FOREIGN MINISTER IN NEW YORK DURING 1975 GENERAL ASSEMBLY, SECRETARY KISSINGER HAD INDICATED HE WOULD SEND REPRESENTATIVE TO ADEN TO DISCUSS RESUMPTION OF RELATIONS. FOR VARIOUS REASONS THIS HAD NOT WORKED OUT, AND ASHTAL SAID HE WELCOMED THIS RENEWED INITIATIVE FOR WHICH HE THOUGHT PRESENT CIRCUMSTANCES WERE AUSPICIOUS. IN RESPONSE TO ASHTAL'S QUESTION ABOUT LEVEL OF U.S. REPRESENTATIVE FOR PROPOSED MEETING, ATHERTON SAID WE HAD NOT DECIDED PRECISELY BUT IT WOULD BE A SENIOR OFFICIAL, POSSIBLY UNDER SECRETARY HABIB WHO HAD RECENTLY VISITED BAGHDAD FOR SIMILAR MISSION.

ASHTAL ASKED ABOUT TIMING AND ATHERTON SAID WHENEVER IT WAS CONVENIENT FOR PDRY BUT FROM OUR POINT OF VIEW, THE SOONER THE BETTER. ASHTAL SAID HE WANTED TO INFORM US THAT THERE WOULD BE OPPORTUNITY FOR HIGH-LEVEL CONTACT THIS FALL SINCE THE CHAIRMAN OF THE PDRY PRESIDENTIAL COUNCIL, SALIM RUBAYYA ALI, WOULD BE COMING TO NEW YORK FOLLOWING A VISIT TO CUBA TO ADDRESS THE UNGA ON SEPTEMBER 29. MEANWHILE, HE WOULD CONVEY OUR SUGGESTION TO ADEN AND WAS CERTAIN HE WOULD RECEIVE AN EARLY REPLY. ASHTAL INDICATED HIS HOPE THAT TODAY'S MEETING WOULD BE KEPT CONFIDENTIAL. ATHERTON SAID THIS WAS OUR INTENTION.
WE ALSO WOULD TRY TO KEEP ANY HIGH-LEVEL MEETING CONFIDENTIAL IF PDRY SO WISHED BUT COULD NOT OF COURSE GUARANTEE IT WOULD NOT COME TO PUBLIC ATTENTION.

IN GENERAL DISCUSSION THAT FOLLOWED, ASHTAL NOTED RECENT PUBLICATION OF DEPARTMENT LETTER TO CONGRESS ON TERRORISM WHICH HAD MENTIONED PDRY AND SAID THIS HAD CREATED A BAD IMPRESSION WITH HIS GOVERNMENT. ATHERTON SAID WE WERE RESPONDING TO A CONGRESSIONAL INQUIRY AND HAD TO PROVIDE FACTUAL INFORMATION AS WE KNEW IT. THIS WAS THE KIND OF THING THAT COULD BE DISCUSSED PRIVATELY BETWEEN US IF WE HAD A BETTER DIALOGUE.

IN RESPONSE TO ATHERTON'S QUERY ABOUT PDRY RELATIONS WITH ITS NEIGHBORS, ASHTAL SAID THERE WERE MUCH IMPROVED AND CITED IN PARTICULAR SAUDI ARABIA, KUWAIT AND NORTH YEMEN. PDRY WANTED TO PURSUE ITS OWN INDEPENDENT NATIONAL POLICY AND TO FOCUS ITS EFFORTS ON INTERNAL ECONOMIC PROBLEMS. ASHTAL SAID HIS GOVERNMENT HOPED U.S. COMPANIES WOULD BECOME INTERESTED IN PDRY; HE ACKNOWLEDGED THAT REESTABLISHMENT OF RELATIONS MIGHT ENCOURAGE SUCH INTEREST. ASHTAL THEN COMMENTED THAT SITUATION "IN OUR AREA" WAS BECOMING EXPLOSIVE. HE MADE PARTICULAR REFERENCE TO HORN OF AFRICA AND SITUATION BETWEEN ETHIOPIA AND SOMALIA. PDRY, HE SAID, HAS GOOD RELATIONS WITH BOTH AND IS TRYING QUIETLY TO BE HELPFUL. ATHERTON SAID U.S.
HOPED REGIONAL PROBLEMS COULD BE RESOLVED BY REGIONAL STATES WITHOUT OUTSIDE POWER SEEKING TO TAKE ADVANTAGE OF SITUATION.

FINALLY, ATHERTON DESCRIBED BRIEFLY OUR MIDDLE EAST PEACE EFFORTS, CITING IN PARTICULAR VICE PRESIDENT MONDALE'S RECENT SAN FRANCISCO SPEECH AND STRESSING THAT WE ARE DETERMINED TO CONTINUE TO WORK FOR JUST MIDDLE EAST

WE UNDERSTAND THE QUESTION OF CONTINGENCY PLANNING WITH RESPECT TO POSSIBLE IRANIAN SUPPORT FOR KINGDOM OF SAUDI ARABIA DID COME UP AT ONE TIME IN CONVERSATION BETWEEN THE SHAH AND DR. KISSINGER. WE UNDERSTAND, FURTHERMORE, THAT THE QUESTION WAS BROUGHT UP BY THE SHAH IN CONTEXT OF HIS CONCERN OVER POSSIBLE RADICAL THREAT TO SAUDI REGIME.

TO DEPARTMENT'S KNOWLEDGE, THIS MATTER HAS NOT COME UP IN DISCUSSIONS BETWEEN USG AND SAUDI OFFICIALS. WE DO NOT FEEL THIS IS APPROPRIATE SUBJECT ON WHICH WE COULD ACT AS INTERMEDIARY BETWEEN IRAN AND SAUDI ARABIA. (IF WE WERE TO DO SO, THERE IS GOOD CHANCE THAT SAG MIGHT MISINTERPRET OUR INTEREST, AND THIS COULD EXACERBATE SUSPICIONS OF SOME WHO TEND TO BELIEVE THAT U.S. HAS CHOSEN IRAN AS ITS MILITARY INSTRUMENT TO MAINTAIN STABILITY THROUGHOUT PERSIAN GULF REGION. IT COULD ALSO BE RESENTED BY SAUDIS AS SUGGESTING WE LACKED CONFIDENCE IN STABILITY OF SAUDI REGIME.)

YOU SHOULD NOT RAISE THIS SUBJECT WITH THE SHAH. IF HE COMES BACK TO IT, YOU SHOULD SAY THAT THE DEPARTMENT HAS CONFIRMED TO YOU THAT THE MATTER CAME UP SOMETIME BACK DURING A DISCUSSION BETWEEN THE SHAH AND DR. KISSINGER, BUT THAT YOU ARE RATHER VAGUE ABOUT THE DETAILS. YOU SHOULD ADD THAT WE HAVE CONCLUDED WE SHOULD NOT ACT AS INTERMEDIARY BETWEEN IRAN AND SAUDI ARABIA ON THIS PARTICULAR ISSUEWHICH IN OUR JUDGMENT COULD BE MISCONSTRUED BY SAUDIS TO DETRIMENT OF OUR COMMON INTEREST IN STRONG U.S.-SAUDI RELATIONS.
WE CONTINUE, HOWEVER, TO ATTACH HIGH IMPORTANCE TO IRANIAN-SAUDI COOPERATION IN PROMOTING THE SECURITY AND STABILITY OF THE PERSIAN GULF REGION.
ANY FUTURE REPORTING ON THIS SENSITIVE SUBJECT SHOULD BE MARKED NODIS CHEROKEE. CHRISTOPHER

1977STATE159404.subject: US-SOVIET TALKS ON INDIAN OCEAN ARMS LIMITATIONS

segments.text: FOLLOWING SUMMARY OF US-SOVIET TALKS ON INDIAN OCEAN ARMS LIMITATIONS IS PROVIDED FOR AMBASSADOR'S USE IN AN ORAL BRIEFING OF THE SHAH. US AND SOVIET SIDES AGREED THAT TALKS SHOULD BE CONFIDENTIAL, BUT US RESERVED RIGHT TO CONSULT WITH ALLIES AND FRIENDS. US HAS NOT YET BRIEFED OTHER LITTORAL STATES (EXCEPT AUSTRALIANS) ON COURSE OF TALKS AND IS PROVIDING THIS INFORMATION TO SHAH ON A CONFIDENTIAL BASIS.

INITIAL ROUND OF TALKS TOOK PLACE JUNE 22-27 IN MOSCOW. TALKS WERE SERIOUS, POSITIVE, AND NON-POLEMICAL. THE TWO SIDES AGREED TO MEET AGAIN IN LATE SEPTEMBER, LEAVING EXACT DATE AND VENUE TO BE DECIDED LATER.

OUR PRIMARY OBJECTIVES IN INITIAL ROUND OF TALKS WERE TO EXPLORE WHETHER THE SOVIETS WERE SERIOUSLY INTERESTED IN SEEKING AN INDIAN OCEAN ARMS LIMITATIONS AGREEMENT, AND TO MAKE CLEAR OUR OWN SERIOUSNESS. OUR CONCLUSION IS THAT THE SOVIETS ARE SERIOUS, BUT THAT THERE ARE MAJOR DIFFERENCES BETWEEN THE SOVIET APPROACH AND OURS, AND THAT LENGTHY NEGOTIATIONS WILL BE REQUIRED BEFORE AN AGREEMENT IS POSSIBLE. BOTH SIDES ACKNOWLEDGED THAT CURRENT US AND SOVIET MILITARY PRESENCE IN INDIAN OCEAN IS NOT AT A HIGH LEVEL AND THAT THERE IS A REAL OPPORTUNITY TO MOVE TOWARDS ARMS CONTROL ARRANGEMENTS WHICH COULD PREVENT THE DEVELOPMENT OF AN ESCALATING ARMS RACE.

US OBJECTIVE IS TO SEEK IN THE FIRST INSTANCE A STABILIZATION OF US AND SOVIET MILITARY ACTIVITY AND PRESENCE. ONCE STABILIZATION IS ACHIEVED WE ARE READY TO CONSIDER MOVING TOWARDS REDUCTIONS IN MILITARY PRESENCE. THE LEVEL OF MILITARY PRESENCE WHICH WOULD BE PERMITTED UNDER A STABILIZATION AGREEMENT, AS WELL AS THE NATURE AND TIMING OF ANY SUBSEQUENT REDUCTIONS ARE MATTERS WHICH MUST BE DETERMINED IN THE COURSE OF FURTHER NEGOTIATIONS.

A COMMON THREAD THROUGHOUT THE SOVIET POSITION WAS THEIR CONCERN THAT THE US IS ENGAGING IN THE BUILDING UP OF AN INFRASTRUCTURE TO SUPPORT STRATEGIC FORCES CAPABLE OF STRIKING THE SOVIET UNION. THEY DIFFERENTIATED BETWEEN THE PRESENCE OF FORCES WHICH THEY CONSIDERED RELATED TO REGIONAL INTERESTS (AND THEY EXPLICITLY RECOGNIZED THE US INTEREST IN ENSURING SECURITY OF SEA LANES FOR COMMERCIAL AND OIL TRAFFIC) AND OTHER FORCES WHICH--THEY ASSERTED-COULD STRIKE THE SOVIET HOMELAND. THEY PRESSED FOR A BAN ON SSBN'S, B-52'S AND AIRCRAFT CARRIERS.

WE REPLIED THAT OUR PRESENCE IN THE INDIAN OCEAN WAS NOT A THREAT TO THE SOVIET UNION; THAT WE WERE NOT PREPARED TO CONSIDER THE BANNING OF SPECIFIC WEAPONS SYSTEMS; BUT THAT GENERAL NAVAL LIMITS WOULD ALSO CONSTRAIN SYSTEMS THE SOVIETS WERE CONCERNED ABOUT.

THE SOVIETS STATED THAT AN AGREEMENT WOULD NEED TO TAKE ACCOUNT OF THE PRESENCE OF THE FORCES AND FACILITIES OF US ALLIES IN THE REGION. THEY ALSO SOUGHT TO TAKE ACCOUNT OF US FORCES IN ADJACENT AREAS, SUCH AS THE PHILIPPINES, WHICH THEY CLAIMED WOULD ALLOW THE US TO SURGE RAPIDLY INTO THE AREA. THE US REJECTED THESE SOVIET POSITIONS. WE SAID THE TALKS ARE BILATERAL AND DO NOT CONCERN THE MILITARY FORCES OF OTHER EXTERNAL STATES WHICH HAVE THEIR OWN INTERESTS TO PROTECT IN THE REGION, OR OF THE LITTORAL STATESAND THAT WE ARE ONLY WILLING TO DISCUSS OUR FORCES PRESENT IN THE INDIAN OCEAN, NOT ADJACENT AREAS.
ON OTHER ISSUES THE SOVIETS WERE SOMEWHAT MORE FLEXIBLE.

WE PROPOSEDADEFINITION OF THE AREA FOR PURPOSES OF NAVAL LIMITS WHICH WOULD INCLUDE ALL OF THE WATERS ENCLOSED BY THE ARC FORMED; ON THE WEST, BY THE EASTERN COAST OF AFRICA; ON THE NORTH, BY THE SOUTHERN COAST OF ASIA; AND, ON THE EAST, BY THE MALAY PENINSULA, THE SOUTHERN SHORE OF INDONESIA, AND THE WESTERN AUSTRALIAN COAST. THERE WAS AGREEMENT TO INCLUDE THE RED SEA AND THE PERSIAN GULF. THE SOVIETS DISAGREED OVER WHERE TO DRAW THE LINE NEAR AUSTRALIA, PUSHING TO INCLUDE MORE OF THE WATERS OFF THE SOUTHERN AND NORTHERN COASTS OF AUSTRALIA.

SHIP DEPLOYMENTS--BOTH SIDES EXPRESSED A WILLINGNESS TO CONSIDER A LIMITATION ON SHIP DEPLOYMENTS MEASURED IN TERMS OF SOME COMBINATION OF SHIP DAYS AND TON DAYS. THERE WAS DISAGREEMENT ON THE TYPES OF SHIPS TO BE INCLUDED AS AUXILIARIES IN ANY LIMITATION AGREEMENT, WITH THE US PRESSING TO INCLUDE ALL SHIPS WHICH SUPPORT A NAVAL PRESENCE, WHILE THE SOVIETS PROPOSED A MORE LIMITED DEFINITION.

SUPPORT FACILITIES. THE SOVIETS INITIALLY PRESSED FOR THE "DISMANTLING" OF DIEGO GARCIA. THEY CLAIMED THAT THE SECURITY OF US TENURE THERE PUTS THIS FACILITY IN A DIFFERENT CATEGORY FROM OTHER FACILITIES IN THE AREA. THE US MADE CLEAR IT WOULD NOT "DISMANTLE" DIEGO GARCIA, AND COUNTERED THAT THE MAIN ISSUE IS NOT WHETHER OR NOT THE US OR THE SOVIET UNION "CONTROL" A BASE IN THE INDIAN OCEAN, BUT RATHER THAT BOTH MAKE USE OF FACILITIES IN THE INDIAN OCEAN TO SUPPORT THEIR MILITARY ACTIVITIES.

WE SAID WE WERE READY TO CONSIDER LIMITATIONS ON THE USE OF DIEGO GARCIA ONLY IN THE CONTEXT OF RESTRICTIONS ON THE USE OF FACILITIES BY BOTH SIDES. THE SOVIETS ADMITTED THAT THEY MAINTAINED A COMMUNICATIONS STATION AND DRY DOCK IN BERBERA, SOMALIA, AND USED SOME OTHER FACILITIES THERE (ALTHOUGH THEY CONTINUED TO CLAIM THAT THESE OTHER FACILITIES ARE UNDER SOMALI, NOT SOVIET CONTROL). THE SOVIETS AT THE END STATED THAT THEY WOULD CONSIDER LIMITATIONS ON THEIR USE OF SOMALI FACILITIES AS PART OF AN AGREEMENT.

IN SUMMARY, SOVIETS LAID OUT MAXIMALIST POSITION WHICH THEY WILL HAVE TO FALL BACK FROM IF THERE IS TO BE PROGRESS. BUT THEY ARE CLEARLY INTERESTED IN REACHING AN AGREEMENT WHICH WOULD MEET SOME OF THEIR SECURITY CONCERNS. THE US MADE CLEAR IT WOULD NOT ACCEPT UNEQUAL RESTRICTIONS NOR ANY LIMITATIONS THAT INFRINGE ON THE INTERESTS OF OUR FRIENDS OR ALLIES. WE WOULD WELCOME IRANIAN COMMENTS ON PARTICULAR ISSUES WHICH RELATE TO THEIR INTERESTS. VANCE

1977STATE168375.subject: LETTER FROM PRESIDENT CARTER TO THE SHAH

segments.text: YOU SHOULD PASS TO THE SHAH FOLLOWING MESSAGE FROM PRESIDENT CARTER DATED JULY 15. SIGNED ORIGINAL WILL BE POUCHED. "YOUR IMPERIAL MAJESTY: "THANK YOU FOR YOUR LETTER OF JUNE 8, 1977, CONCERNING YOUR FUTURE AIRCRAFT NEEDS. I VALUE OUR CORRESPONDENCE, FOR IT IS IMPORTANT THAT WE MAINTAIN OUR CLOSE TIES THROUGH A FULL AND FRANK EXCHANGE ON MATTERS OF MUTUAL CONCERN. A STRONG AND RAPIDLY DEVELOPING IRAN IS IMPORTANT TO AMERICAN NATIONAL INTERESTS. "THERE ARE A NUMBER OF CONSIDERATIONS RAISED BY YOUR REQUEST WHICH I WOULD LIKE TO SHARE WITH YOU.

FIRST, I UNDERSTAND THE PRICING AND DELIVERY CONCERNS WHICH LED YOU TO REQUEST AN ACCELERATION OF THE SCHEDULED DELIVERY RATE OF F-16 AIRCRAFT FROM FOUR PER MONTH TO EIGHT PER MONTH BEGINNING IN 1980. HOWEVER, CONSIDERING OTHER U.S. COMMITMENTS, PRODUCTION CAPACITY FOR THE F-16 DURING THE FIRST SEVERAL YEARS WILL NOT SUSTAIN THIS RATE OF DELIVERY TO IRAN. CONSEQUENTLY, INITIAL DELIVERY DATES OF ADDITIONAL F-16S WOULD NECESSARILY HAVE TO BE POSTPONED BEYOND THE PERIOD YOU HAVE SUGGESTED. "SECOND, I WOULD LIKE TO SHARE WITH YOU MY OWN EVALUATION OF THE BROADER POLICY IMPLICATIONS OF YOUR REQUEST.

I VIEW THE SECURITY RELATIONSHIP WHICH HAS DEVELOPED BETWEEN OUR TWO NATIONS AS AN EXPRESSION OF THE STRONG TIES AND MUTUAL INTERESTS WHICH UNDERLIE THE BASIC POLICIES OF THE UNITED STATES AND IRAN. I STRONGLY SUPPORT THIS RELATIONSHIP AND INTEND, FOR MY PART, TO PRESERVE AND STRENGTHEN IT. SINCE BECOMING PRESIDENT, I HAVE APPROVED THE SALE OF MILITARY EQUIPMENT TO IRAN WHICH, IN TOTAL DOLLAR VOLUME, IS GREATER BY HALF THAN THAT APPROVED FOR ANY OTHER NATION IN THE WORLD. "AT THE SAME TIME, AS YOU ARE AWARE, I HAVE ADOPTED A POLICY OF RESTRAINT IN THE SALE OF U.S.

MILITARY EQUIPMENT ABROAD AS PART OF A BROADER PROGRAM TO REDUCE ARMS BUILDUPS AROUND THE WORLD. I AM FRANKLY CONCERNED THAT THE IMPACT OF ANOTHER MAJOR SALE OF THE MAGNITUDE OF THE 140 F-16S WOULD SERIOUSLY UNDERMINE THOSE EFFORTS AND COULD, IN FACT, BE COUNTERPRODUCTIVE TO THE LONG-TERM RELATIONSHIP WHICH BOTH OF US WISH TO MAINTAIN. SPECIFICALLY, THERE IS THE POSSIBILITY THAT THE ANNOUNCEMENT OF ANOTHER MAJOR SALE NOW, WHEN THE AWACS PROGRAM IS BEING ACTIVELY DEBATED IN THE CONGRESS, COULD JEOPARDIZE BOTH OF THESE PROPOSALS.

FOR THAT REASON, I BELIEVE IT WOULD BE A MISTAKE TO PROCEED WITH A LETTER OF OFFER ON THE 140 AIRCRAFT AT THIS TIME. "IN ADDITION, AS YOU KNOW, IT IS MY INTENTION TO REDUCE THE LEVEL OF ARMS SALES IN SUBSEQUENT YEARS BELOW THE 1977 LEVEL. THIS WILL NECESSARILY REQUIRE CAREFUL MANAGEMENT OF APPROVED SALES IN THE FUTURE.

HOWEVER, IF APPROACHED IN THE SPIRIT OF MUTUAL UNDERSTANDING AND COOPERATION WHICH UNDERLIES THE RELATIONSHIP OF OUR TWO COUNTRIES, I BELIEVE THIS OBJECTIVE CAN BE ACCOMPLISHED IN A MANNER FULLY CONSISTENT WITH IRANIAN SECURITY NEEDS. "IN THE LIGHT OF THESE CONSIDERATIONS, I WISH TO ASSURE YOU THAT YOUR INTEREST IN ACQUIRING ADDITIONAL F-16 FIGHTERS IS VIEWED SYMPATHETICALLY BY THE U.S.

GOVERNMENT, AND I EXPECT TO BE ABLE TO GIVE YOU A MORE SPECIFIC RESPONSE IN ABOUT TWO OR THREE WEEKS. "I ALSO HOPE THAT DURING OUR MEETING THIS FALL WE WILL HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO REVIEW IN GREATER DETAIL THE POLITICAL AND STRATEGIC SITUATION AS IT AFFECTS THE RELATIONS OF OUR TWO COUNTRIES. "MRS. CARTER AND I WERE DELIGHTED TO HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO MEET WITH HER IMPERIAL MAJESTY DURING HER VISIT TO WASHINGTON. THE IRANIAN PEOPLE COULD NOT HAVE A MORE GRACIOUS OR TALENTED REPRESENTATIVE.
MY WIFE AND I REGRET THAT OUR MEETING WITH THE SHAHBANOU HAD TO BE SO BRIEF, AND WE LOOK FORWARD WITH ANTICIPATION TO YOUR VISIT IN NOVEMBER. SINCERELY, JIMMY CARTER." VANCE

1977STATE174254.subject: VIETNAMESE DELEGATION VISITS ETHIOPIA AND ATTACKS U.S. IMPERIALISM

segments.text: U.S. IMPERIALISM

BEGIN UNCLASSIFIED. THREE-MAN VIETNAMESE DEL, LED BY DOAN TRAN CANAH, MEMBER OF FOREIGN RELATIONS BOARD, CENTRAL COMMITTEE OF VIETNAMESE COMMUNIST PARTY AND MEMBER OF VIETNAMESE AFRO-ASIAN PEOPLE'S SOLIDARITY COMMITTEE, PAID OFFICIAL VISIT TO ETHIOPIA, JUNE 29-JULY 6.WHILE HERE DOAN TOOK SEVERAL OPPORTUNITIES TOHPROCLAIM "SOCIALIST" VIETNAM'S SUPPORT FOR "SOCIALIST" ETHIOPIA AND PUBLICLY CASTIGATE U.S. DOAN CLAIMED "MORE THAN 12 MILLION TONS OF POISONOUS EXPLOSIVES RAINED ON VIETNAM FROM WAR MACHINES OF AMERICAN IMPERIALISM, AND VIETNAMESE PEOPLE, WHOSE ONLY SIN WAS TO FOLLOW SOCIALIST PHILOSOPHY, HAD 6,000 TOWNS BOMBED WITH HALF TOTALLY DESTROYED". DOAN SAID, "WE UNDERSTAND INTERNATIONAL IMPERIALISM, AND IN PARTICULAR, U.S.

IMPERIALISM HAS TRIED TO COUNTERATTACK AND FOIL ETHIOPIAN REVOLUTION, BUT U.S. IMPERIALISM HAS BEEN DEFEATED IN LAGOS (SIC), CAMBODIA, VIETNAM, ANGOLA, MOZAMBIQUE AND IS DOOMED TO FAILURE IN ETHIOPIA AS WELL." JULY 7 ETHIOPIAN HERALD REPORTED DOAN'S SPEECH WITH FRONT-PAGE HEADLINES READING "ETHIOPIAN REVOLUTION WEAKENS U.S. IMPERIALISM IN RED SEA AREA". DOAN'S ACTUAL SPEECH COMMENTED ON NATIONAL LIBERATION MOVEMENTS IN AFRICA, ASIA, AND LATIN AMERICA AND SAID THAT "THESE MOVEMENTS CONSTITUTE GREAT FORCE FOR WEAKENING U.S. IMPERIALISM IN MANY PARTS OF THE WORLD."

AS FAREWELL GIFT TO PMAC CHAIRMAN MENGISTU, DOAN PRESENTED GIFT "SYMBOLIZING SOUTH VIETNAMESE FIGHTER KILLING AN AMERICAN GI" AND RING MADE FROM THE METAL OF THE "4,000TH AMERICAN AIRCRAFT SHOT DOWN BY VIETNAMESE FIGHTERS".

WHILE IN ETHIOPIA THE VIETNAMESE WERE BRIEFED BY REPRESENTATIVES FROM VARIOUS MINISTRIES, INCLUDING THOSE OF THE MINISTRY OF URBAN DEVELOPMENT AND HOUSING; MINISTRY OF LABOR AND SOCIAL AFFAIRS; AND MINISTRY OF AGRICULTURE AND SETTLEMENT. DELEGATION ALSO VISITED THE YEKATIT '66 POLITICAL SCHOOL (WHICH PREPARES POLITICAL AGITATORS TO POLITICIZE THE MASSES), THE PROVISIONAL OFFICE FOR MASS ORGANIZATIONAL AFFAIRS, AND REVIEWED UNITS OF THE PEOPLE'S MILITIA. END UNCLASSIFIED.

LATTER CONTINUES TO BE CONCERNED ABOUT THREAT FROM LIYAN-SUPPORTED REBELS IN THE NORTH AND REPEATEDLY CALLS FOR ADDITIONAL EGYPTIAN AND SUDANESE ASSISTANCE. MUGARAK REITERATED GOE HOPE THAT USG WILL ALSO ASSIST CHAD WITH ARMS. I TOLD HIM WE HAVE RECEIVED CHADIAN VP IN WASHINGTON AND ARE CURRENTLY STUDYING MALLOUM'S REQUEST.

I THEN ASKED MUBARAK ABOUT STATUS SUDANESE PRESIDENT NUMAYRI'S MEDIATION EFFORT BETWEEN MALLOUM AND HUSSEIN HABRE. MUBARAK PROVIDED SLIGHTLY DIFFERNT VERSION FROM THAT GIVEN BY FAHMY (REFTEL). MUBARAK RECALLED THAT HE HAD DISCUSSED SUBJECT WITH BOTH NUMAYRI AND MALLOUM DURING HIS TRIP LAST MONTH TO KHARTOUM AND NDJAMENA. ALTHOUGH HE HAD DECLINED TO MEET HABRE IN KHARTOUM, AS NUMAYRI HAD SUGGESTED, HE HAD TAKEN WITH HIM ISURGENT LEADER'S CONDITIONS FOR A RECONCILIATION. THESE HAD TO DO WITH PARTICIPATION IN CHADIAN ARMY, GOVERNMENT, AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF MORE EDUCATIONAL FACILITIES IN MUSLIM AREAS OF EASTERN CHAD. HABRE'S DEMANDS HAD BEEN REASONABLE AND MALLOUM HAD ACCEPTED THEM.
ON HIS RETURN TRIP, HE HAD SO INFORMED NUMAYRI. IT HAD BEEN LEFT THAT NUMAYRI WOULD CONVENE MEETING IN KHARTOUM BETWEEN HABRE AND SPECIAL EMISSARIES SENT BY MALLOUM TO WORK OUT DETAILS.

MUBARAK SAID HE HAD NOT HEARD THAT SUCH MEETING HAS TAKEN PLACE. HE DID NOT KNOW REASON FOR DELAY BUT UNDERTOOK TO INQUIRE. HE EMPHASIZED IMPORTANCE GOE ATTACHES TO A RECONCILIATION BETWEEN MALLOUM AND HABRE AND ITS DETERMINATION TO ENCOURAGE IT. CHASE

YOU MAY ALREADY HAVE BEEN CONTACTED BY YOUR BRITISH COLLEAGUE SUGGESTING A JOINT REQUEST FOR AN APPOINTMENT WITH THE SHAH ON AUGUST 8 OR 9. PURPOSE OF ANGLO-AMERICAN MEETING WILL BE TO RELAY TO SHAH IMPORTANT POLICY DECISIONS RELATING TO THE RHODESIAN SETTLEMENT EFFORT AND TO SEEK HIS ASSISTANCE IN MAKING KNOWN HIS SUPPORT FOR OUR INITIATIVE TO THE SOUTH AFRICANS.

WE ARE STILL ENGAGED IN THE PROCESS OF LENGTHY CONSULTATIONS WITH THE BRITISH IN AN ATTEMPT TO DETERMINE PRECISELY THE SUBSTANCE OF THE SUGGESTED TALKING POINTS FOR THE MEETING. WE WILL PROVIDE YOU WITH FURTHER GUIDANCE BY NIACT IMMEDIATE CABLE AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. HOWEVER, FOR THE TIME BEING, YOU SHOULD COORDINATE AND PURSUE THE APPOINTMENT REQUEST.

OUR UNDERSTANDING WITH BRITISH IS THAT APPROACH TO SHAH WILL BE CONDUCTED IN A JOINT AUDIENCE ATTENDED BY YOU AND THE UK AMBASSADOR. BRITISH EMBASSY, WASHINGTON, AGREES WITH THIS INTERPRETATION AND HAS ASKED LONDON TO CONVEY IT TO THEIR AMBASSADOR IN TEHRAN. FURTHER, US AND UK AGREE THAT IT IS ESSENTIAL THAT THE APPROACH BE MADE TO THE SHAH HIMSELF. SUGGESTED TALKING POINTS FOR THE MEETING WHICH YOU WILL BE ABLE TO COORDINATE WITH YOUR BRITISH COLLEAGUE WILL BE SENT AS SOON AS

WE HAVE AGREED WITH BRITISH THAT UK AMBASSADOR IN TEHRAN SHOULD ARRANGE A JOINT AUDIENCE FOR HIMSELF AND U.S. AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN WITH THE SHAH FOR MONDAY, AUGUST 8. IT IS FURTHER UNDERSTOOD THAT THE BRITISH AMBASSADOR WILL TAKE THE LEAD IN THE CONVERSATION WITH THE SHAH AND THAT AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN WILL SUPPORT AS NECESSARY.

THE BRITISH AMBASSADOR IN TEHRAN HAS BEEN SUPPLIED BY LONDON WITH A STATEMENT OF US-UK PROPOSALS FOR A RHODESIAN SETTLEMENT WHICH WILL FORM THE BASIS OF HIS TALKING POINTS. ORIGINALLY THE UK PROPOSED TO HAVE THE AMBASSADOR HAND THE DOCUMENT ITSELF TO THE SHAH. WE OPPOSE THIS APPROACH AND HAVE MADE OUR POSITION KNOWN TO THE BRITISH. (FYI: THERE ARE STILL A FEW ELEMENTS IN THE PROPOSAL PACKAGE THAT WARRANT FURTHER US-UK CONSULTATION.)

FOREIGN SECRETARY OWEN AND SECRETARY VANCE WILL PRESENT THE SETTLEMENT PLAN TO SOUTH AFRICAN FOREIGN MINISTER BOTHA ON AUGUST 13 IN LONDON. THE FRONT LINE STATES, THE RHODESIAN NATIONALISTS AND THE SMITH REGIME WILL BE GIVEN THE PLAN THE FOLLOWING WEEK DURING A TRIP TO AFRICA BY OWEN WHERE HE WILL BE JOINED BY AMBASSADOR YOUNG. IT WOULD BE HELPFUL IF SECRETARY VANCE AND OWEN COULD IN THEIR CONVERSATION WITH BOTHA SPEAK WITH THE ASSURANCE THAT OUR CLOSEST ALLIES SUPPORT OUR PROPOSALS. FOR THIS REASON WE ARE APPROACHING THE FRENCH, GERMANS, CANADIANS AND IRANIANS.

WE ARE NOT REQUESTING ANY SPECIFIC ACTION ON THE PART OF IRAN PRIOR TO THE BOTHA MEETING. UNDERLYING THEME OF US-UK APPROACH TO SHAH IS OUR DESIRE TO WORK CLOSELY WITH IRANIANS IN PARTNERSHIP FOR REALIZATION OF SHARED OBJECTIVES.

A CENTRAL ELEMENT OF OUR SETTLEMENT EFFORTS IS OUR WILLINGNESS, SHOULD THE SOUTH AFRICANS PROVE UNHELPFUL, TO APPLY ADDITIONAL PRESSURES TO RHODESIA, SOME OF WHICH WOULD IMPINGE UPON SOUTH AFRICA. SOUTH AFRICA'S VIOLATION OF UN SANCTIONS BY SUPPLYING ALL OF RHODESIA'S PETROLEUM NEEDS IS AN OBVIOUS PRESSURE POINT. SOUTH AFRICA IMPORTS ALL BUT A SMALL FRACTION OF ITS OIL; MOST OF IT COMES FROM IRAN. HOWEVER, IN THIS CONVERSATION WITH THE SHAH WE DO NOT WISH TO HIGHLIGHT FUTURE POSSIBLE PUNITIVE ACTION, BUT RATHER TO EMPHASIZE THE FAIRNESS AND FEASIBILITY OF OUR SETTLEMENT PACKAGE.

THE FOLLOWING TALKING POINTS ARE FOR YOUR GUIDANCE AND SHOULD BE COORDINATED WITH THE UK AMBASSADOR'S PRESENTATION. (A) WE HAVE APPRECIATED IRAN'S INTEREST IN A PEACEFUL SETTLEMENT TO THE PROBLEMS OF SOUTHERN AFRICA, PARTICULARLY THAT OF RHODESIA. THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT'S STATEMENT ON SMITH'S ELECTION PLAN (TEHRAN 6489) AND THE CENTRAL BANK'S REMINDER TO IRANIAN BANKS OF RHODESIAN SANCTIONS WERE APPRECIATED. THE BROAD CONGRUENCE OF OUR VIEWS ON MANY AFRICAN MATTERS WAS CLEAR DURING SECRETARY VANCE'S AUDIENCE IN MAY WITH THE SHAH, ESPECIALLY OUR SHARED OPPOSITION TO FOREIGN INTERVENTION ON THE AFRICAN CONTINENT. WE FEEL IT IS IMPORTANT TO KEEP THE SHAH INFORMED OF OUR EFFORTS AND PLANS.

(B) THE US AND THE UK HAVE MADE CONSIDERABLE PROGRESS IN FORMULATING A COMPREHENSIVE PROPOSAL FOR AN INDEPENDENCE CONSTITUTION, ARRANGEMENTS FOR A TRANSITIONAL CARETAKER GOVERNMENT AND AN INTERNATIONAL DEVELOPMENT FUND. WE BELIEVE THAT OUR SETTLEMENT PROPOSALS ARE FAIR TO ALL PARTIES AND CONSTITUTE A SOUND BASIS FOR SETTLEMENT. (C) THE CONSTITUTION OF AN INDEPENDENT ZIMBABWE MUST, TO BE ACCEPTABLE TO INTERNATIONAL OPINION, INCLUDE THE FOLLOWING BASIC ELEMENTS: DEMOCRATIC ELECTIONS BASED ON ONE-MAN, ONE-VOTE, GUARANTEED INDIVIDUAL RIGHTS, AND GUARANTEES OF PENSION AND PROPERTY RIGHTS. WE ARE APPROACHING THE TIME WHEN THE ANGLO-AMERICAN PROPOSALS WILL BE LAID BEFORE THE PRINCIPAL PARTIES AND WORLD OPINION.

THE LATTER CAN BE ACCOMPLISHED MOST SUCCESSFULLY IN A PRESENTATION TO THE UNITED NATIONS. (D) THE UN WILL BE ASKED TO PLAY A MAJOR ROLE IN OVERSEEING A FAIR AND IRREVERSIBLE TRANSITION TO MAJORITY RULE. A UN SPECIAL REPRESENTATIVE AND UN PEACEKEEPING FORCE WILL ASSIST A BRITISH-APPOINTED RESIDENT COMMISSIONER IN THE MAINTENANCE OF LAW AND ORDER AND CONVERSION TO MAJORITY RULE DURING THE TRANSITIONAL PERIOD. (E) WE MUST BE REALISTIC AND ACKNOWLEDGE THAT THERE ARE STILL MAJOR DISAGREEMENTS WHICH DIVIDE SMITH AND THE NATIONALISTS FROM ONE ANOTHER.

HOWEVER, WE BELIEVE THAT BY ENLISTING THE SUPPORT OF THE "FRONT LINE" STATES (TANZANIA, ZAMBIA, BOTSWANA, MOZAMBIQUE AND ANGOLA), WE CAN ENCOURAGE THE NATIONALISTS TO VIEW OUR PROPOSALS SYMPATHETICALLY. (F) WE ASSUME THAT THE SOUTH AFRICANS CAN, IF THEY CHOOSE, CONVINCE SMITH OF THE NEED TO ACQUIESCE IN THE SETTLEMENT, STEP DOWN AND TURN OVER POWER TO A CARETAKER GOVERNMENT. (G) SECRETARY VANCE AND FOREIGN SECRETARY OWEN WILL MEET WITH SOUTH AFRICAN FOREIGN MINISTER BOTHA IN LONDON ON AUGUST 13. AT THAT TIME THE UK-US SETTLEMENT PROPOSALS WILL BE PRESENTED. SOUTH AFRICAN ASSISTANCE IN CONVINCING SMITH TO ACCEPT THEM WILL BE REQUESTED.

IF SOUTH AFRICA IS NOT HELPFUL, THE FRONT LINE STATES AND THE NATIONALISTS WILL DOUBT OUR SINCERITY, DESPAIR OF US-UK EFFORTS, TURN EVEN MORE TO THE SOVIETS AND RESORT TO ALL OUT MILITARY CONFLICT. (H) BOTHA WILL BE TOLD THAT IF THE SETTLEMENT EFFORT IS NOT SUCCESSFUL, THE US AND UK ARE PREPARED TO SEEK EVEN TIGHTER ENFORCEMENT OF UN SANCTIONS AGAINST RHODESIA. SOME OF OUR ACTIONS MIGHT IMPINGE UPON THE ECONOMIC WELLBEING OF SOUTH AFRICA. IN THIS REGARD WE ARE SPECIFICALLY DISMAYED BY SOUTH AFRICA'S CONTINUED SUPPLY OF OIL AND ARMS TO THE RHODESIAN REGIME.

WE HOPE THAT WE WILL RECEIVE THE COOPERATION OF THE SOUTH AFRICANS, THAT THE SETTLEMENT EFFORT WILL BE SUCCESSFUL AND THAT FURTHER SANCTION-RELATED ACTIONS WILL BE UNNECESSARY. (I) WE SHALL REPORT BACK TO THE SHAH THE RESULTS OF THE MEETING WITH BOTHA AND THE SUBSEQUENT PRESENTATIONS OF THE SETTLEMENT PROPOSALS TO THE OTHER PRINCIPAL PARTIES. WE DO NOT REQUEST ANY SPECIFIC IRANIAN ACTION OR STATEMENT ON THIS ISSUE AT THIS TIME.

(IN FACT, WE MUST STRESS THE CONFIDENTIALITY OF THE PRESENTATION TO HIM.) HOWEVER, BOTH FOREIGN SECRETARY OWEN AND SECRETARY VANCE WOULD FIND IT HELPFUL IF IN THEIR CONVERSATION WITH BOTHA THEY COULD EXPRESS THE IDEA THAT OUR CLOSEST FRIENDS,INCLUDING IRAN,SUPPORT OUR PROPOSALS.

1977STATE186569.subject: YOUR MEETING WITH SHAH YOU WILL BE RECEIVING SEPTEL IN RESPONSE TO TEHRAN 7034 WHICH YOU WILL RECOGNIZE AS A LEGALISTIC HOLDING A

segments.text: YOU WILL BE RECEIVING SEPTEL IN RESPONSE TO TEHRAN 7034 WHICH YOU WILL RECOGNIZE AS A LEGALISTIC HOLDING ACTION. POLICY WITH RESPECT TO THE PROBLEM YOU HAVE RAISED IS BEING RESTUDIED AND MATTERS ARE IN A STATE OF UNCERTAINTY. I REGRET THAT WE SIMPLY ARE NOT IN POSITION TO GIVE YOU CLEAR GUIDANCE. IF THE SHAH RAISES THE MATTER, YOU COULD REPLY THAT YOU HAVE ASKED URGENTLY FOR INSTRUCTIONS BUT HAVE NOT YET RECEIVED A DECISION. CHRISTOPHER
IN RESPONSE TO YOUR REQUEST FOR INFORMATION CONCERNING STATE OF PLAY WITH FRENCH ON THIS SUBJECT, WE ARE REPEATING TO YOU TWO CABLES FROM EMBASSY PARIS.

IN ADDITION TO IRAN, US-UK HAS APPROACHED CANADA, FRG, AND FRANCE, THE THREE WESTERN MEMBERS OF THE UNSC. ADDITIONAL APPROACHES ARE CONTEMPLATED TO THE EC-9 MEMBERS, JAPAN, AUSTRALIA, AND NEW ZEALAND.

IN VIEW OF THE AMBASSADOR'S AUG 8 DISCUSSION WITH FON MIN GUIRINGAUD OF THE PROPOSED US-UK APPROACH ON RHODESIA (REF B) , WE WENT ALONG WITH THE BRITISH EMBASSY CLEAR PREFERENCE THAT REF A INSTRUCTION BE CARRIED OUT AT A LOWER LEVEL. CONSEQUENTLY, BRITISH CHARGE JAMES AND, IN ABSENCE DCM, EMBASSY POLITICAL COUNSELOR MADE REQUESTED DEMARCHE TO QUAI DIRECTOR FOR AFRICA GUY GEORGY AUG 9. GUIRINGAUD HAD EMPHASIZED TO THE AMBASSADOR THAT FRANCE CONSIDERS THAT THE UK HAS LEGAL RESPONSIBILITY FOR RHODESIA, THAT THE UK AND THE US SHARE THE PLITICAL RESPONSIBILITY FOR ACHIEVING A SETTLEMENT, BUT THAT FRANCE WANTS TO LEND FULL SUPPORT TO ANGLO-AMERICAN EFFORTS.

GEORGY INDICATED THAT THE OVERALL FRENCH REACTION IS VERY POSITIVE . SPECIFICALLY, UK FOREIGN SECRETARY OWEN TELEPHONED GUIRINGAUD ON MORNING OF AUG 9. GUIRINGAUD ASSURED OWEN FO FRANCE'S "FULL SUPPORT" FOR THE ANGLOAMERICAN PLAN, GEORGY SAID THIS INCLUDES ACTION WITH SOUTH AFRICANS, IN THE UN INCLUDING SANCTIONS AS NECESSARY, AND " IN PRINCIPLE" WITH REGARD TO THE PROPOSED ZIMBABWE FUND. GEORGY EXPRESSED SOME PERSONAL DOUBTS ABOUT EFFECTIVENESS OF SANCTIONS AND SPECIFICALLY RESERVED FRANCE'S POSITION ABOUT FUND DETAILS INCLUDING A CONTRIBUTION.
WE INTEND TO UNDERSCOURE THE MATTER ONCE MORE WITH QUAI DIRECTOR FOR POLITICAL AFFAIRS LABOULAYE. HARTMAN UNQUOTE CHRISTOPHER".

IN CONNECTION WITH THE PROPOSED US-UK APPROACH TO THE FRENCH GOVERNMENT, FOREIGN MINISTER DE GUIRINGAUD IS DEPARTING ON THURSDAY, AUGUST 11, FOR A VISIT TO SEVERAL EAST AFRICAN COUNTRIES. IN A DISCUSSION ON AUGUST 8, HE EMPHASIZED TO ME HIS DESIRE TO SUPPORT ANGLOAMERICAN EFFORTS ON RHODESIA AS WELL AS FRANCE'S INTENTION TO CONTINUE DIRECTLY TO INVOLVE ITSELF ON NAMIBIA. HE GENERALLY WANTS TO PLAY A SUPPORTIVE ROLE IN TRYING TO MOVE THE SOUTH AFRICAN GOVERNMENT AWAY FROM APARTHEID. ACCORDINGLY, THE JOINT DEMARCHE WILL BE MOST WELCOME IF IT CAN BE MADE ON AUGUST 9 AS INDICATED REFTEL. HARTMAN

IN LIGHT OF THE FURTHER INFORMATION RECEIVED FROM YOU, MY EARLIER INSTRUCTIONS ON THIS SUBJECT ARE MODIFIED AS FOLLOWS. IN YOUR NEXT CONVERSATION WITH THESHAH,INFORM HIM THAT THE QUESTION OF PROPOSED ISRAELI-IRANIAN COOPERATION IN ARMS DEVELOPMENT AND PRODUCTION WAS RAISED WITH ME DURING MY RECENT VISIT IN JERUSALEM. ALTHOUGH I TOLD THE ISRAELIS AT THE TIME THAT THE U.S. GOVERNMENT WAS NOT OPPOSED, IN PRINCIPLE, TO JOINT ISRAELI-IRANIAN COOPERATION IN THIS FIELD, I ALSO NOTED THAT WE WOULD OF COURSE NEED TO REVIEW SENSITIVE ITEMS ON A CASE-BY-CASE BASIS. CLEARLY THE PRODUCTION OF SURFACE-TO-SURFACE MISSILES WOULD FALL IN THE LATTER CATEGORY.

I CAN FORESEE POTENTIAL PROBLEMS WITH REGARD TO THE PROPOSED PRODUCTION OF THE TWO TYPES OF MISSILES MENTIONED TO YOU BY THE SHAH, BUT WILL REFRAIN FROM A SPECIFIC RESPONSE PENDING MORE DETAILED INFORMATION ON WHAT ISRAEL AND IRAN HAVE IN MIND.

PLEASE INFORM FINANCE MINISTER ANSARY THAT THE SECRETARY PROPOSES HOLDING MEETING OF U.S.-IRAN JOINT COMMISSION IN NOVEMBER IN WASHINGTON. WE BELIEVE IT WOULD BE DESIRABLE TO HOLD THE MEETING PRIOR TO THE SHAH'S VISIT. WE WOULD APPRECIATE ANSARY'S VIEWS ON DATES SO THAT WE CAN FIRM UP SCHEDULE SOONEST.
WE SHALL BE SENDING YOU A SEPARATE MESSAGE CONCERNING OUR THOUGHTS ON COMMITTEE MEETINGS. VANCE *** Current Handling Restrictions *** n/a *** Current Classification *** CONFIDENTIAL

DEPARTMENT APPRECIATES YOUR EFFORTS IN PRESENTING ANGLO-AMERICAN POSITIONS ON RHODESIA TO HOST GOVERNMENTS. WE REGRET THAT FAST BREAKING EVENTS DURING PAST WEEK HAVE PREVENTED US FROM KEEPING YOU INFORMED. THE FOLLOWING REVIEW OF DEVELOPMENTS IS FOR YOUR BACKGROUND ONLY AT THIS TIME.

THE SECRETARY'S AUGUST 12-13 MEETINGS IN LONDON MOVED US SOMEWHAT CLOSER TO FORMAL PRESENTATION OF THE RHODESIAN SETTLEMENT PROPOSALS. IN A SIX HOUR MEETING WITH SOUTH AFRICAN FOREIGN MINISTER BOTHA THE SECRETARY AND DR. OWEN OUTLINED THE PLAN AND URGED THAT SOUTH AFRICA USE ITS INFLUENCE ON SMITH. BOTHA ARGUED THAT THE PLAN SHOULD NOT BE FORMALLY PRESENTED UNTIL AFTER THE AUGUST 31 RHODESIAN ELECTIONS. THE TWO SECRETARIES REJECTED THIS ARGUMENT, THOUGH, IT NOW APPEARS THAT SNAGS IN THE PROPOSED PRESENTATION TIMETABLE MAKES PRESENTATION PRIOR TO AUGUST 31 UNLIKELY. APART FROM MAKING THE PREDICTABLE SOUTH AFRICAN ARGUMENTS, I.E.

THE PLAN WILL NOT BE ATTRACTIVE ENOUGH TO THE WHITES, BOTHA LISTENED CAREFULLY AND ASKED NUMEROUS SERIOUS QUESTIONS. DURING THE COURSE OF THE MEETING IT WAS MADE CLEAR TO BOTHA THAT SHOULD SOUTH AFRICA NOT PROVE HELPFUL IN CONVINCING SMITH TO ACCEPT THE PROPOSALS, WE WOULD HAVE TO CONSIDER INCREASING PRESSURES ON THE SMITH REGIME WHICH WOULD INEVITABLY AFFECT THE SOUTH AFRICANS. (IN A PRIOR MEETING OWEN AND VANCE DETERMINED THAT THE POSSIBILITY OF A MANDATORY ARMS EMBARGO AGAINST SOUTH AFRICA BASED ON THE PREVIOUS CHAPTER VII FINDING ON THE RHODESIAN SITUATION AS A THREAT TO WORLD PEACE COULD BE PURSUED. OWEN AND VANCE HAD ALSO DISCUSSED POSSIBLE OIL-RELATED PRESSURES.

THE BRITISH HAVE ALREADY APPROACHED BP AND SHELL. THOSE COMPANIES HAVE AGREED TO CONTACT THE SOUTH AFRICANS AND SEEK WAYS OF PREVENTING THEIR OIL FROM BEING TRANSSHIPPED TO RHODESIA. FURTHER MEASURES WERE NOT AGREED UPON.)

THE SECRETARY THEN MET WITH PRESIDENT NYERERE WHO WAS PASSING THROUGH LONDON ON HIS RETURN FROM HIS TRIP TO THE U.S. AND OTHER WESTERN HEMISPHERE STATES. NYERERE RECONFIRMED HIS AGREEMENT WITH PRESIDENT CARTER THAT HE WAS WILLING TO CALL TOGETHER THE OTHER FRONT LINE PRESIDENTS FOR A MEETING AT WHICH OWEN AND AMBASSADOR YOUNG WOULD PRESENT OUR PROPOSALS. NYERERE WAS, HOWEVER, TROUBLED BY WHAT HE INTERPRETED AS DIFFERENCES BETWEEN THE US AND UK VIEWS ON CRUCIAL SECURITY ISSUES DURING THE INTERIM PERIOD AND BEYOND.
(NYERERE WAS GENERALLY MIFFED AT THE BRITISH FOR A VARIETY OF REASONS.) HE WOULD DELAY CALLING THE MEETING UNTIL ANGLO-AMERICAN THINKING ON THIS TOPIC HAD BEEN CLARIFIED FOR HIM.

AFTER THE SECRETARY'S RETURN TO WASHINGTON, ASSISTANT SECRETARY MOOSE AND AF/S DIRECTOR PETTERSON RETURNED TO LONDON FOR FURTHER TALKS WITH THE BRITISH. IN THESE A POSITION RELATING TO LAW AND ORDER WAS WORKED OUT AND PRESENTED ORALLY TO NYERERE ON AUGUST 18 BY THE US AMBASSADOR AND BRITISH HICOM IN DAR ES SALAAM.

THE BASIC PRINCIPLES EMBODIED IN THE AGREED POSITION EMPHASIZE: (1) THE NEED FOR A UN FORCE TO HELP MAINTAIN LAW AND ORDER DURING THE TRANSITIONAL PERIOD, (2) OUR UNDERSTANDING THAT THE REGIME'S FORCES AS PRESENTLY CONSTITUTED WILL BE DEMOBILIZED, AND (3) THAT A NEW ARMY WILL BE CREATED FOR AN INDEPENDENT ZIMBABWE WHICH WILL BE BASED PREDOMINANTLY ON THE PATRIOTIC FRONT FORCES. NYERERE WAS TOLD THAT THE PRECISE DETAILS OF ARRANGEMENTS FOR THE CEASEFIRE AND DEMOBILIZATION OF EXISTING FORCES AS WELL AS THE CREATION OF THE NEW FORCE SHOULD BE THE SUBJECT OF DISCUSSION AMONG THE PARTIES CONCERNED, INCLUDING THE UN.

NYERERE PRONOUNCED HIMSELF SATISFIED WITH OUR CLARIFICATION. HE AGREED TO MOVE AHEAD WITH THE FRONT LINE MEETING. OUR HOPE IS THAT THE MEETING WILL BE HELD IMMEDIATELY AFTER THE TERMINATION OF THE LAGOS ANTI-APARTHEID CONFERENCE (AUGUST 28). THE PROPOSALS WILL ALSO BE FORMALLY PRESENTED TO THE RHODESIAN REGIME, THE NATIONALISTS, AND THE SOUTH AFRICANS. CONSEQUENTLY PUBLIC PRESENTATION OF THE PROPOSALS TO WORLD OPINION VIA THE UNITED NATIONS WHICH HAD ORIGINALLY BEEN PLANNED FOR AUGUST 23 WILL BE DELAYED ACCORDINGLY.

US-UK HAVE BRIEFED UN SECRETARY GENERAL WALDHEIM AND WORLD BANK PRESIDENT MC NAMARA OF OUR PLANS. IT IS OUR HOPE THAT THE WORLD BANK WILL AGREE TO ADMINISTER THE ZIMBABWE DEVELOPMENT FUND WHICH WE VIEW AS AN INTEGRAL ELEMENT OF THE SETTLEMENT PROPOSALS.
WE WILL ENDEAVOR TO KEEP YOU AS INFORMED AS POSSIBLE OF DEVELOPMENTS AS THEY OCCUR. CHRISTOPHER
