1977STATE206851.subject: LETTER FROM PRESIDENT CARTER TO THE SHAH

segments.text: PLEASE PASS FOLLOWING LETTER FROM PRESIDENT CARTER TO SHAH. SIGNED ORIGINAL FOLLOWS BY POUCH. BEGIN TEXT. YOUR IMPERIAL MAJESTY: IN MY JULY 15 RESPONSE TO YOUR REQUEST FOR ADDITIONAL F-16S TO MEET IRAN'S DEFENSE NEEDS, I INDICATED MY HOPE TO BE ABLE TO RESPOND POSITIVELY TO YOU WITHIN SEVERAL WEEKS. EVENTS IN THE CONGRESS, AS YOU ARE WELL AWARE, HAVE RESULTED IN A DELAY OF OUR PLANS CONCERNING AWACS. HOWEVER, IN LIGHT OF ASSURANCES ACCEPTABLE TO THE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN, AND THE U.S. CONGRESS, I AM HOPEFUL THAT THE PROPOSED SALE WILL RECEIVE FAVORABLE CONGRESSIONAL REVIEW IN SEPTEMBER. I APPRECIATE YOUR PATIENCE AND ASSISTANCE IN THIS DIFFICULT MATTER.

I WISH TO ASSURE YOU THAT IT IS IN THE SECURITY INTERESTS OF THE UNITED STATES TO ASSIST IRAN IN THE ACQUISITION OF A RELIABLE AND EFFECTIVE AIR DEFENSE SYSTEM. LET ME ALSO AFFIRM MY EARLIER STATEMENT THAT YOUR INTEREST IN ACQUIRING ADDITIONAL F-16S IS VIEWED SYMPATHETICALLY BY THE U.S. GOVERNMENT. I WOULD PROPOSE THAT WE DISCUSS THIS MATTER DURING OUR MEETING IN NOVEMBER. I LOOK FORWARD WITH PLEASURE TO YOUR VISIT AND TO OUR DISCUSSIONS OF THE MANY IMPORTANT PROBELMS THAT WE SHARE IN COMMON. SINCERELY, JIMMY CARTER. .

IN ADDITION TO MATERIAL PROVIDED IN STATE 210558, YOU MAY PROVIDE SHAH WITH FOLLOWING OBSERVATIONS ON THE SECRETARY'S VISIT TO PEKING.

TALKS WERE WIDE-RANGING AND MARKED BY FRANKNESS AND HEALTHY GIVE-AND-TAKE WHICH BOTH SIDES COMMENTED ON FAVORABLY. ATMOSPHERE, WHICH WAS CORDIAL THROUGHOUT, IMPROVED AS TALKS PROGRESSED. CHINESE CONVEYED IMPRESSION OF SELFCONFIDENCE AND OPTIMISM ABOUT RECENT POLITICAL DEVELOPMENTS IN THEIR COUNTRY.

CHINESE ATTITUDES TOWARD THE SOVIET UNION AT ALL LEVELS WERE CONSISTENT WITH THEIR PUBLIC POSITIONS. CHINESE VIEW THE SOVIETS AS TRYING TO GAIN STRATEGIC SUPREMACY OVER THE US AND AS BENT ON SEEKING WORLD HEGEMONY. THEY ARE DISTRUSTFUL OF AGREEMENTS WITH THE USSR AND BELIEVE THAT ANYTHING THAT SMACKS OF "APPEASEMENT" WILL ONLY ENCOURAGE AGGRESSIVE SOVIET BEHAVIOR. MAIN CHINESE CONCERN OBVIOUSLY WAS THAT WE NOT LET DOWN OUR GUARD OR BECOME BLASE IN LOOKING TO THE FUTURE. THE SECRETARY INTRODUCED THE DISCUSSION OF GLOBAL POLICIES WITH A FORCEFUL STATEMENT OF US DETERMINATION TO MAINTAIN OUR STRENGTH AND MEET THE SOVIET CHALLENGE.

IT WAS CLEAR FROM DISCUSSIONS THAT CHINESE HAVE GREAT RESPECT FOR PRESIDENT TITO AS A LEADER WHO HAS DISPLAYED HARD-HEADED REALISM AND TOUGHNESS IN DEALING WITH THE SOVIET UNION. THIS IS OBVIOUSLY FACTOR OF CONSIDERABLE IMPORTANCE TO PEKING AT THE PRESENT TIME.

DISCUSSIONS OF MIDDLE EAST CENTERED ALMOST EXCLUSIVELY ON THE ARAB-ISRAELI PROBLEM. CHINESE AS USUAL WERE STRONGLY SUPPORTIVE OF ARAB POSITIONS AND EXPRESSED CONCERN THAT US SUPPORT FOR ISRAEL MIGHT CONFLICT WITH OUR EFFORTS TO WORK EFFECTIVELY WITH KEY ARAB STATES SUCH AS EGYPT AND TO PRODUCE PROGRESS TOWARD A COMPREHENSIVE SETTLEMENT. THEY APPEARED WORRIED THAT A CONTINUED STALEMATE IN THE AREA MIGHT WORK TO OUR DISADVANTAGE. CHINESE LISTENED CAREFULLY AS SECRETARY EXPLAINED THE EFFECTIVENESS OF OUR RELATIONS WITH THE ARAB STATES, AND THEY SEEMED SATISFIED THAT IMMEDIATE TRENDS IN THE AREA WERE NOT WORKING TO OUR DETRIMENT.
THERE WAS ONLY BRIEF DISCUSSION OF BILATERAL TRADE MATTERS WHICH DID NOT TOUCH ON CHINESE INTENTIONS WITH RESPECT TO INTERNATIONAL TRADE.

1977STATE213389.subject: PRESIDENT'S LETTER TO CONGRESSMEN ON AWACS

segments.text: FOLLOWING IS TEXT OF LETTER DATED SEPTEMBER 2 SENT BY PRESIDENT CARTER TO ALL MEMBERS OF SFRC AND HIRC AS WELL AS TO SENATOR ROBERT BYRD AND SPEAKER O'NEILL. ATTACHED TO THE PRESIDENT'S LETTER (NOT REPEATED BELOW) WAS THE TEXT OF THE "ASSURANCES" AGREED TO BY THE GOI AND WHICH YOU HAVE PREVIOUSLY SEEN.

BEGIN TEXT: THE ADMINISTRATION WILL RESUBMIT TO THE CONGRESS THE PROPOSAL TO SELL TO IRAN SEVEN AIRBORNE WARNING AND CONTROL SYSTEMS (AWACS) AIRCRAFT IN THE NEAR FUTURE. THIS PROPOSAL IS A MATTER OF HIGH IMPORTANCE TO IRAN AND TO MAJOR AMERICAN INTERESTS IN THE MIDDLE EAST. I SUPPORT IT FULLY. I HOPE THAT YOU WILL JOIN WITH ME IN GIVING IT YOUR OWN SUPPORT. IN MY LETTER OF JULY 28 TO SENATOR HUMPHREY, I WROTE THAT I WAS PREPARED, AS HE HAD REQUESTED ON BEHALF OF HIS SUBCOMMITTEE, TO MAKE CERTAIN ASSURANCES IN CONNECTION WITH THE AWACS SALE. I AM CONFIRMING THOSE ASSURANCES IN THE STATEMENT THAT ACCOMPANIES THIS LETTER.

WE SHARE THE BELIEF THAT IRAN NEEDS AN EFFECTIVE AIR DEFENSE SYSTEM; THESE SEVEN AWACS AIRCRAFT ARE A CENTRAL ELEMENT IN IRAN'S PLANNING. THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT BELIEVES THAT THESE AWACS, IN CONJUNCTION WITH A NUMBER OF GROUND RADARS, WILL HELP PROVIDE THE AIR DEFENSE EARLY WARNING AND DETERRENT CAPABILITY THAT IRAN NEEDS, AND OUR OWN STUDIES SUPPORT THAT CONCLUSION. BY ASSISTING IRAN IN BUILDING ITS DEFENSES, THE UNITED STATES CAN UNDERSCORE ITS INTEREST IN THE STABILITY OF THE PERSIAN GULF, AND THE REST OF THE MIDDLE EAST REGION. THAT REGION, TRAGICALLY, HAS BEEN MARKED BY CENTURIES OF DISTRUST, INSECURITY AND CONFLICT.

BOTH SIDES IN THE ARAB-ISRAEL DISPUTE NOW LOOK TO IRAN WITH RESPECT, AND IRAN HAS WORKED WITH BOTH SIDES TO PROMOTE A JUST AND LASTING PEACE SETTLEMENT. IN PURSUING ITS POLICIES FOR STABILITY AND PROGRESS IN THE REGION AND ELSEWHERE IN THE WORLD, IRAN'S INTERESTS HAVE BEEN LARGELY CONSISTENT WITH OURS. OUR RELATIONSHIP WITH IRAN IS BROAD; IT BOLSTERS SIGNIFICANT U.S. SECURITY INTERESTS AND HELPS TO ASSURE THE UNINTERRUPTED FLOW OF OIL TO AN ENERGY-SHORT WORLD. OUR ENGAGEMENT IN DEVELOPING IRAN'S CIVILIAN ECONOMY IS OF DAILY IMPORTANCE TO OUR OWN MANUFACTURERS AND FARMERS. OUR CLOSE ASSOCIATION WITH IRAN, OVER THREE DECADES, HAS BEEN OF SUBSTANTIAL IMPORTANCE TO THE UNITED STATES.

OUR COOPERATION IN HELPING IRAN MODERNIZE ITS ARMED FORCES IS PART OF THIS RELATIONSHIP. THE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN HAS ADVISED US THAT IT ENDORSES THE ASSURANCES WHICH WE OFFER THE CONGRESS ON AWACS, AND THAT IT WILL ASSIST US TO THE VERY BEST OF ITS ABILITY IN APPLYING RIGID STANDARDS OF PROTECTION FOR THE AWACS AND ITS SUB-SYSTEMS. I NOTE THAT IRAN HAS ALWAYS THOROUGH LY PROTECTED THE MILITARY EQUIPMENT ACQUIRED FROM THE UNITED STATES. BECAUSE OF THE IMPORTANCE OF THIS PROPOSED SALE, IT DESERVES THE CAREFUL CONSIDERATION THAT CONGRESS IS GIVING.
I ASSURE YOU THAT THE ADMINISTRATION WILL CONTINUE TO COOPERATE WITH YOU IN EVERY WAY AS YOU CONDUCT YOUR DELIBERATIONS. .
SPECIFICALLY INSTRUCTED TO BRIEF HIM.

ALLUDING TO ROLLS ROYCE AND HAWKER-SIDLEY INVOLVEMENT IN MIG MAINTENANCE, MOON NOTED THIS HAS BEEN CLOSELY HELD ON BRITISH SIDE. HE HOPED THAT ATHERTON WILL NOT FIND IT NECESSARY TO MENTION ONGOING INVOLVMENT OF THESE TWO BRITISH FIRMS IN MIG MAINTENANCE.
PLEASE ADVISE IF LONDON IS BEING SEPARATELY BRIEFED. EILTS. UNQUOTE VANCE".
MEDIA REPORTS REFERRED TO IN REFTEL (WHICH OUR INFORMATION INDICATES CAME FROM AFP, NOT AP) HAVE SO FAR AS WE CAN TELL GONE UNNOTICED HERE.

IF YOU ARE QUERIED ABOUT THESE REPORTS BY THE SHAH OR ON HIS BEHALF, YOU CAN QUITE HONESTLY SAY THAT NO INFORMATION ABOUT PRESIDENT'S DECISION ON PRM 10 HAS BEEN DISSEMINATED TO THE FIELD, AND SIMPLY UNDERTAKE TO REFER HIS QUERY TO WASHINGTON.

FYI. PRESIDENTIAL DECISION ON PRM 10 IS BEING HELD EXTREMELY CLOSELY. I AM INFORMED, HOWEVER, THAT IRAN IS NOT MENTIONED BY NAME AND THAT WHILE PERSIAN GULF IS REFERRED TO AS AN AREA OF STRATEGIC IMPORTANCE IN DEVELOPING U.S. GLOBAL MILITARY STRATEGY (NOT A PARTICULARLY SURPRISING CONCLUSION), TO SAY THAT IT IS INCLUDED WITHIN THE SCOPE OF U.S. DEFENSE "OBLIGATIONS" WOULD CARRY UNJUSTIFIED IMPLICATIONS IF THIS WERE INTERPRETED TO MEAN THAT WE ENVISAGE ANY OBLIGATIONS GOING BEYOND THOSE CONTAINED IN ALREADY EXISTING U.S.-IRANIAN AGREEMENTS. END FYI.

TEHRAN 8194 RECEIVED AFTER FOREGOING PREPARED. IF YOU ARE QUERIED SPECIFICALLY ABOUT SECRETARY BROWN'S COMMENTS ABOUT DEFENSE OF PERSIAN GULF AREA, YOU SHOULD ALSO UNDERTAKE TO REFER THIS QUERY TO WASHINGTON. HOW WE REPLY WILL CLEARLY REQUIRE CONSIDERABLE COORDINATION HERE AND WILL DEPEND IN PART ON NATURE AND THRUST OF ANY QUESTIONS WHICH YOU RECEIVE FROM IRANIANS.

AMBASSADOR ZAHEDI CALLED ON SECRETARY SEPTEMBER 12 TO INFORM HIM THAT IRANIAN GOVERNMENT IS WILLING TO HAVE MEETING OF JOINT COMMISSION AT ANY TIME US WANTED, AND THAT MEETING SHOULD NOT NECESSARILY BE DEPENDENT UPON THE PROGRESS OF THE NUCLEAR BILATERAL AGREEMENT. IN OTHER WORDS, HE SAID, THE GOI IS COMPLETELY FLEXIBLE. SECRETARY REPLIED THAT HE WOULD STUDY THE MATTER AND GET BACK TO ZAHEDI.

ASSISTANT SECRETARY ATHERTON CALLED ZAHEDI SEPTEMBER 16 TO INFORM HIM THAT, UPON REFLECTION, WE BELIEVED IT WAS PREFERABLE TO DEFER THE MEETING UNTIL THE NUCLEAR BILATERAL AGREEMENT WAS AGREED UPON; OTHERWISE AGENDA WAS VERY SLIM. HE NOTED ALSO, HOWEVER, THAT WE WERE PERFECTLY WILLING HAVE THE MEETING NOVEMBER 8-9IF THE GOI WANTS, BUT THAT ON BALANCE IT MIGHT BE BETTER TO HAVE THE MEETING LATER. ZAHEDI SAID HE AGREED COMPLETELY WITH THIS VIEW, WHICH THE GOI HAD FIRST PUT FORWARD, AND THAT HE WOULD INFORM HIM AND ANSARY.
WE HOPE THAT YOU CAN FOLLOW UP WITH ANSARY NEXT WEEK AND SETTLE THIS MATTER ONCE AND FOR ALL. WOULD ALSO APPRECIATE HIS REACTION TO OUR THOUGHTS ON COMMITTEE

REQUEST YOU NOTIFY LTG (RET.) KHAZAI, DIRECTOR, OFFICE OF NATIONAL PREPAREDNESS AND CIVIL MOBILIZATION, AND APPROPRIATE OFFICIALS IN MINISTRY OF INTERIOR AND STATE CIVIL DEFENSE AUTHORITY THAT, WITH THEIR CONCURRENCE, MG (USAF, RET.) J.H. HERRING AND MR. K. KLEMM PLAN TO RETURN TO TEHRAN IN EARLY OCTOBER.

SINCE NEITHER OF THESE PERSONS HAD PREVIOUSLY PLANNED TO CLOSE OUT HIS ADVISORY ACTIVITIES, WE CONSIDER THEIR RETURN DESIRABLE IN ORDER TO PROVIDE THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT WITH ADDITIONAL ASSISTANCE ON THE FUTURE DEVELOPMENT OF THEIR CIVIL EMERGENCY PREPAREDNESS PROGRAM AND TO LEAD TO THE EARLY WITHDRAWAL OF THE U.S. ADVISORY PERSONNEL. SUMMARY: IN HOUR-LONG BILATERAL WITH KUWAIT FONMIN SABAH AL-AHMAD, ATHERNON REVIEWED CURRENT STATE OF MIDDLE EAST PEACE NEGOTIATIONS. HE FOCUSED PRIMARILY ON CURRENT EFFORTS TO SOLVE PROBLEM OF PALESTINIAN REPRESENTATION AT GENEVA AND NEED FOR FLEXIBILITY BY ALL PARTIES. END SUMMARY.

ATHERTON, ACCOMPANIED BY ARP DEPUTY DIRECTOR COUNTRYMAN AND BEYER OF NEA, HELD ONE-HOUR BILATERAL WITH KUWAITI FOREIGN MINISTER SABAH AL-AHMAD SEPTEMBER 27. KUWAITI AMBASSADOR JAFAAR WAS ALSO PRESENT.

AFTER EXCHANGE OF PLEASANTRIES, ATHERTON NOTED SECRETARY UNABLE TO MEET WITH ALL FOREIGN MINISTERS ATTENDING UNGA BECAUSE OF ALMOST DAILY MEETINGS IN PURSUIT OF MIDDLE EAST PEACE. IN RESPONSE TO SABAH AL-AHMAD, ATHERTON GAVE A GENERAL RUN-DOWN OF STATE OF MIDDLE EAST NEGOTIATIONS, MAKING SAME GENERAL POINTS AS IN US/BAHRAINI BILATERAL (SEPTEL).
FONMIN ALSO RAISED FOLLOWING POINTS TO WHICH ATHERTON RESPONDED

FONMIN ASKED IF WE MIGHT BE ABLE TO GIVE THE PALESTINIANS GUARANTEES IN EXCHANGE FOR THEIR ACCEPTANCE OF RESOLUTION 242. ATHERTON NOTED THAT ALTHOUGH WE CANNOT GUARANTEE ANY OUTCOME AT GENEVA, PLO ACCEPTANCE OF 242 WOULD PERMIT US TO ENTER DIALOGUE WITH IT AND WOULD FACILITATE OUR NEGOTIATING EFFORTS.

FONMIN QUESTIONED HOW THE PLO MIGHT BE PART OF A UNIFIED DELEGATION. ATHERTON SAID THAT IF PLO IS SEPARATELY IDENTIFIED AS PARTICIPATING IN CONFERENCE, THIS WOULD BE IMPOSSIBLE. HE SUGGESTED THAT EVENTUAL FORMULA MIGHT INVOLVE "CONSTRUCTIVE AMBIGUITY" AND NOT SPELL OUT EXPLICITLY FORM OF PALESTINIAN REPRESENTATION IN A WAY WHICH WOULD BE IMPOSSIBLE FOR ONE SIDE OR THE OTHER.

FONMIN NOTED HOW MUCH ARAB POSITION HAD CHANGED SINCE KHARTOUM CONFERENCE WITH ITS FAMOUS THREE "NO'S". NOW ITS ISRAEL WHO IS SAYING NO. ATHERTON ACKNOWLEDGED EVOLUTION OF ARAB POSITION BUT NOTED THERE IS NO WAY WE CAN GET ISRAEL TO GIVE UP ANY OCCUPIED TERRITORIES OUTSIDE OF NEGOTIATING PROCESS. THAT IS WHY THE PRESIDENT, BELIEVING IT IS IN US AND WORLD'S INTEREST TO ACHIEVE A MIDDLE EAST PEACE, ALSO RECOGNIZES A NEED FOR FLEXIBILITY BY BOTH SIDES, PARTICULARLY ON THE KEY QUESTION OF PALESTINIAN REPRESENTATION IF WE ARE TO GET TO GENEVA AND BEGIN NEGOTIATING THE HARD SUBSTANTIVE ISSUES.
ATHERTON NOTED THAT US PUBLIC HAS BAD IMAGE OF PLO, THOUGH MORE POSITIVE ONE OF THE PALESTINIAN CAUSE.

FONMIN ASKED WHAT US MEANT BY A "PALESTINIAN HOMELAND". ATHERTON REPLIED THAT IT WOULD BE A PLACE THE PALESTINIANS CAN CALL HOME. THERE WOULD HAVE TO BE NEGOTIATIONS AS TO WHAT FORM THE HOMELAND WOULD TAKE. WE ARE NOT SAYING IT WOULD BE A STATE, AND WE HAVE IN FACT ALWAYS THOUGHT IT MADE SENSE FOR THE PALESTINIAN ENTITY TO BE LINKED WIH JORDAN. FOREIGN MINISTER SAID US COULD NOT FORCE ACCEPTANCE OF A SPECIFIC FORMULA, AND ATHERTON AGREED.

FONMIN ASKED WHAT US POSITION WOULD BE IF A UNIFIED ARAB DELEGATION WERE POSSIBLE, BUT ISRAEL SAID NOT. ATHERTON REPLIED THAT ISRAEL HAS ACCEPTED PRINCIPLE OF UNIFIED DELEGATION, BUT IT REMAINS TO BE SEEN HOW PALESTINIAN REPRESENTATION WOULD BE WORKED OUT.

ATHERTON THEN ASKED WHAT WOULD BE THE STATUS OF PALESTINIANS IN A COUNTRY LIKE KUWAIT (OR SYRIA OR ELSEWHERE IN THE ARAB WORLD) IF THERE WERE A PALESTINIAN ENTITY. FONMIN REPLIED THAT ONLY ONE PERCENT OF THE PALESTINIANS IN KUWAIT WOULD LEAVE BUT THAT IN NO CASE WOULD THEY BE FORCED OUT. THEY WOULD, HE PRESUMED, HAVE PALESTINIAN PASSPORTS AND ENJOY THE STATUS OF ANY OTHER ARAB. HE AND ATHERTON AGREED THAT THE IMPORTANT THING WAS THAT THE PALESTINIANS NO LONGER CONSIDER THEMSELVES REFUGEES AFTER A SETTLEMENT.

RE SOUTH LEBANON, ATHERTON SAID WE HAD WORKED VERY HARD TO RESTORE CALM. FOREIGN MINISTER ACKNOWLEDGED US EFFORTS AND SAID IT IS IMPORTANT LEBANESE BE ABLE TO REBUILD COUNTRY. KUWAIT DOES NOT MIND SPENDING MONEY TO THIS END AND HAS AGREED TO HELP IN BUILDING LEBANESE ARMY. ATHERTON NOTED THAT THERE IS NOW OPPORTUNITY FOR LEABANESE ARMY TO GO INTO THE SOUTH. US HAS HAD TALKS WITH GENERAL KHOURI AND HAS PLEDGED $25 MILLION FOR ARMY EQUIPMENT THIS FISCAL YEAR. WE WILL GO TO CONGRESS FOR ADDITIONAL FUNDS FOR NEXT YEAR AND ARE ALSO OFFERING ECONOMIC AID.

AFTER NOTING THAT ISRAELIS HAD GOTTEN OUT OF LEBANON, ATHERTON REFERRED TO PROBLEM OF REJECTIONISTS WHO SAY THEY WILL NEVER GET OUT AND ARE THREATENING TO CONTINUE SHOOT ACROSS THE BORDER AT ISRAELI SETTLEMENTS. FONMIN ASSERTED THE PLO WILL "GET THEM OUT" AND HONOR SHTAURA AGREEMENT. NOTING KUWAITI SUCCESS IN COUNSELING MODERATION IN LEBANON, ATHERTON SAID WE ARE ASKING FOR MORE HELP IN THIS IMPORTANT AREA. FONMIN SAID PLO DOES NOT NEED REJECTIONISTS AND IMPLIED KUWAIT WOULD CONTINUE CURRENT MODERATING ROLE IN LEBANON.
FONMIN NOTED THAT US/KUWAIT BILATERAL RELATIONS WERE EXCELLENT, AND HE FELT NO NEED TO DISCUSS THEM IN DETAIL. VANCE CHRISTOPHER

NOTED HE HAD RECENTLY TOLD DIPLOMATIC COLLEAGUE THAT UNFORTUNATELY IT WAS SOMETIMES NECESSARY TO MIX BUSINESS AND POLITICS. HE AND ATHERTON AGREED THAT UNSOLVED MIDDLE EAST PROBLEMS CANNOT HELP BUT HAVE IMPLICATIONS FOR US/ARAB BILATERAL RELATIONS. NOTING IMPORTANCE OF PUBLIC OPINION IN BOTH US AND ARAB COUNTRIES, FONMIN HOPED TO GET MORE CONGRESSMEN TO VISIT THE ARAB WORLD SO THEY WOULD GAIN INSIGHT INTO ARAB POSITIONS.

FONMIN THEN NOTED USEFULNESS OF HIGH-LEVEL CONTACTS BETWEEN OUR TWO COUNTRIES AND HOPED THAT THERE COULD BE AN INCREASE OF US VISITORS TO SUCH PLACES AS BAHRAIN AND THE GULF. ATHERTON CONCURRED AND AGREED TO LOOK INTO THE QUESTION OF SENDING SENIOR US REPRESENTATIVE TO THE GULF.

IN RESPONSE TO A QUESTION FROM ATHERTON, FONMIN SAID HE WAS GENERALLY HAPPY WITH CURRENT STATE OF COOPERATION IN GULF THOUGH IT IS NOT EXACTLY WHAT BAHRAIN WANTS. DUE TO IRAQ, THERE WAS A FAILURE, FOR EXAMPLE, TO REACH A GULF SECURITY AGREEMENT, BUT THIS CAN COME IN THE FUTURE. BAHRAIN HAS GOOD RELATIONS WITH IRAN, SAUDI ARABIA, AND EVEN IRAQ. OMAN IS CALM. SAUDI ARABIA IS EXTENDING ITS INFLUENCE IN AFRICA IN SUCH PLACES AS ZAIRE AND THE HORN OF AFRICA. IF THE MIDDLE EAST PROBLEM IS SOLVED, ARAB MODERATES CAN TURN THEIR ATTENTION TO ASSISTING THESE NEARBY AREAS. VANCE

AS YOU ARE PROBABLY AWARE FROM CONTACTS WITH YOUR BRITISH COLLEAGUE, SEVERAL WEEKS AGO UK APPROACHED US WITH IDEA OF JOINT DEMARCHE TO SHAH ON RHODESIAN QUESTION. CENTRAL PURPOSE OF PROPOSED JOINT APPROACH WOULD HAVE BEEN TO OUTLINE FOR SHAH US-UK THINKING ON MEASURES RELATING TO STOPPING FLOW OF OIL FROM SOUTH AFRICA TO RHODESIA. APPROACH WOULD HAVE NOTED THAT BOTH COUNTRIES STILL IN FORMATIVE STAGES OF PLANNING IN THIS AREA.

MOREOVER,POSSIBLE APPLICATIONS OF SUCH PRESSURE WOULD BE CONSIDERED AS CONTINGENCIES ONLY IF AND WHEN IT BECAME APPARENT THAT MEASURES OF THIS TYPE OR THREATS TO IMPLEMENT THEM WOULD ACHIEVE THE DESIRED RESULT OF SOUTH AFRICAN PRESSURE ON RHODESIA TO COOPERATE IN SETTLEMENT EFFORT. THE SHAH'S ADVICE ON THIS MATTER WOULD HAVE BEEN SOUGHT.

THE ISSUE OF USE OF OIL AS AN INSTRUMENT OF PRESSURE, EVEN IF THIS WERE TO BE BASED ON PRIOR UN SANCTIONS PROHIBITING THE SHIPMENT OF OIL TO RHODESIA, IS EXTREMELY SENSITIVE AND ONE ON WHICH FURTHER SERIOUS STUDY AND CONSIDERATION MUST FOCUS. CONSEQUENTLY, WE HAVE BEEN UNABLE TO RESPOND AFFIRMATIVELY TO THE BRITISH SUGGESTION AT THIS TIME.

IN A RECENT MEETING, THE SHAH ASKED THE BRITISH AMBASSADOR TO PROVIDE HIM ON ANOTHER OCCASSION WITH AN UPDATING OF THE RHODESIAN NEGOTIATIONS. AFTER CONSULTATION WITH DEPT,FCO WILL INSTRUCT THEIR AMBASSADOR TO PROVIDE SUCH A BRIEFING TO THE SHAH, BUT NOT TO RAISE THE TOPIC OF MEASURES RELATING TO STEMMING THE FLOW OF OIL FROM SOUTH AFRICA TO RHODESIA. UK EMBASSY, WASHINGTON HAS AGREED TO ASK FCO TO INSTRUCT AMBASSADOR TO BRIEF YOU AS SOON AFTER HIS CONVERSATION WITH THE SHAH AS IS

IN YOUR CONVERSATION RE BILL BUTLER'S ACTIVITIES SINCE HIS AUDIENCE, YOU SHOULD ASSURE KHALATBARY THAT BUTLER HAS QUIETLY INFORMED ORGANIZATIONSAND INDIVIDUALS PROMINENT IN HUMAN RIGHTS OF STEPS IRAN HAS TAKEN. ( I HAVE RECEIVED FEEDBACK FROM SEVERAL SUCH PEOPLE.) HE HAS BELIEVED THAT THIS IS BEST METHOD AND THE ONE MOST SUITABLE FOR OFFICIAL OF ICJ.

HE ALSO SENT FOLLOWING LETTER TO REPRESENTATIVE FRASER AND IT APPEARS THAT STATE MAY TESTIFY OCTOBER 26: BEGIN TEXT: JOHN INFORMED ME IN THE LAST FEW DAYS OF THE FACT THAT THE SUBCOMMITTEE COULD NOT TAKE TESTIMONY ON RECENT DEVELOPMENTS PERTAINING TO IRAN. I AM PARTICULARLY DISTURBED BECAUSE OF MY FIRM CONVICTION THAT WHEN A COUNTRY HAS RESPONDED IN A MEANINGFUL WAY TO THE WORK OF A NON-GOVERNMENTAL ORGANIZATION, IT IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT TO RECORD THIS RESPONSE, BOTH FOR THE PURPOSE OF PLACING THE MATTER ON A PUBLIC RECORD AND FOR THE PURPOSE OF INSURING COMPLIANCE WITH ANY AGREEMENTS WHICH MIGHT HAVE BEEN MADE.

THE IRANIAN SITUATION IS PARTICULARLY INTERESTING BECAUSE, AS YOU KNOW, RECENTLY HIS IMPERIAL MAJESTY HAS INVITED REPRESENTATIVES OF THE ICRC, AMNESTY INTERNATIONAL AND THE ICJ TO IRAN FOR THE EXPRESS PURPOSE OF REVIEWING THE POSSIBILITY OF AMENDMENTS TO IRANIAN LAW PERTAINING TO THE HUMAN RIGHTS OF IRANIAN CITIZENS. SO FAR WE ARE CONVINCED THAT FOR THE LAST TEN MONTHS THERE HAS BEEN NO EVIDENCE OF TORTURE AND AN INVESTIGATION OF ALL THE IRANIAN PRISONS BY THE ICRC INDICATES THAT THEY ARE HOLDING 3900 PRISONERS FOR ACTS AND EXPRESSIONS RELATING TO POLITICAL MATTERS.

DURING MY AUDIENCE WITH HIS IMPERIAL MAJESTY ON MONDAY, MAY 29, 1977, I DELIVERED TO HIM THE ATTACHED MEMORANDUM BY ME AS CHAIRMAN OF THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE. THE AGREEMENTS MADE BETWEEN US ON THAT DATE HAVE BEEN IMPLEMENTED AS IS INDICATED BY THE COMMUNICATION ADDRESSED TO ME FROM THE IMPERIAL COURT, DATED JULY 4, 1977, A COPY OF WHICH IS ATTACHED HERETO. JUST RECENTLY, AMBASSADOR WILLIAM SULLIVAN, IN A COMMUNICATION ADDRESSED TO ME DATED SEPTEMBER 11, 1977, CONFIRMED THESE DEVELOPMENTS AND REQUESTED ME TO INDICATE TO HIM WHETHER OR NOT WE HAVE FURTHER PLANS TO PURSUE THIS MATTER.

FURTHERMORE, CHARLES NAAS ON THE IRANIAN DESK OF THE STATE DEPARTMENT, HAS INDICATED TO JOHN THAT THE STATE DEPARTMENT WOULD BE WILLING TO TESTIFY TO ITS KNOWLEDGE OF THE FACTS AND DETAILS SUPPORTING THESE DEVELOPMENTS. I UNDERSTAND HOW BUSY YOU MUST BE, BUT I WOULD LIKE TO URGE UPON YOU TO CONSIDER MY REQUEST SINCE RECENT DEVELOPMENTS NOT ONLY IN IRAN, BUT IN THE PHILIPPINES AND OTHER AREAS SHOULD BE MADE PUBLIC IF WE ARE TO PURSUE, DEVELOP AND NURTURE COUNTRIES TO INSTIGATE THE REFORMS WHICH WE ARE ALL URGING IN OUR VARIOUS WAYS. WARMEST PERSONAL REGARDS, .

I NOTE THAT LETTER REFERS TO ICRC FINDING OF 3900 "POLITICAL PRISONERS." RECENTLY KHALATBARY USED TRADITIONAL FIGURE OF 3000 WITH 1000 RELEASED OR TO BE RELEASED SOON; IMPLICATION WAS THAT TOTAL WILL BE AROUND 2000. COULD YOU CLARIFY THESE DISCREPANCIES FOR USE IN TESTIMONY AND IN BRIEFING MATERIALS WE ARE PREPARING?
THIS MESSAGE NEA DISTRIBUTION ONLY. VANCE

1977STATE248900.subject: KURDISH SITUATION IN IRAN AND IRAQ

segments.text: KURDISH LEADER BARZANI CONTINUES TO INSIST--LEAVING ASIDE HIS HOPES THAT THE U.S. MIGHT SUPPORT HIS ASPIRATIONS FOR FULL KURDISH AUTONOMY IN IRAQ--THAT THE U.S. COULD BE MORE HELPFUL THAN IT HAS BEEN IN PURELY HUMANITARIAN AREAS. BARZANI AND HIS ENTOURAGE HERE ARE IN FREQUENT TOUCH WITH MEMBERS OF CONGRESS AND INFLUENTIAL PEOPLE WHO ALSO SENSE THAT THE U.S. COULD DO MORE THAN IT HAS. WE MUST BE IN A POSITION TO RESPOND TO THEIR INQUIRIES AND MESSAGES OF CONCERN WITH FACTUAL, UP-TO-DATE ACCOUNTS OF THE SITUATION AS WE KNOW IT.
WE WOULD THEREFORE BE GRATEFUL IF TEHRAN AND BAGHDAD WOULD SUBMIT REGULARLY REPORTS ON ANY CHANGES IN THE SITUATION WHICH COME TO THEIR ATTENTION, SLUGGING CABLES FOR NEA/ARN, NEA/IRN, AND D/HA.

FOR TEHRAN: BARZANI ALLEGES THAT LIVING CONDITIONS OF MANY OF THE IRAQI KURDS ARE STILL VERY POOR. THOSE WHO HAVE NOT FOUND JOBS DESPERATELY NEED FUNDS, FOOD, MEDICAL HELP, ETC. HE ALLEGES THAT THE KURDISH-IRANIAN JOINT COMMITTEE DEALING WITH THE PROBLEMS OF THE 30,000 OR MORE IRAQI KURDS IS NOT EFFECTIVE. HE ALSO ALLEGES THAT THERE HAVE BEEN MANY CASES OF FAMILY SEPARATION IN WHICH IRANIAN AUTHORITIES HAVE INSISTED THAT A MALE FAMILY HEAD, FOR EXAMPLE, LIVE AND WORK IN ONE CITY WHILE THE REST OF HIS FAMILY LIVES ELSEWHERE.
HE ARGUES THAT THE UNHCR SHOULD ASSIST IN RELIEF ACTIVITIES, BUT IS NOT, AND SHOULD ALSO INTERVENE TO STOP THE PRACTICE OF FAMILY SEPARATION.
PLEASE COMMENT ON THESE ALLEGATIONS AND DESCRIBE WHAT THE UNHCR AND THE IRANIAN RED CRESCENT SOCIETY ARE DOING ON BEHALF OF IRAQI KURDISH WELFARE.

BARZANI TOLD US HE FELT THERE WOULD BE NO PROBLEM IF THE EMBASSY TOOK THE INITIATIVE TO GET IN TOUCH WITH IDRIS BARZANI. WE BELIEVE, HOWEVER, THAT THIS IS A DECISION FOR THE EMBASSY TO MAKE IN THE LIGHT OF IRANIAN SENSITIVITIES.

FOR BAGHDAD: BARZANI ALLEGES THAT AS MANY AS 300,000 KURDS WERE FORCIBLY RESETTLED IN SOUTHEAST IRAQ. HE ACKNOWLEDGES THAT PERHAPS UP TO 30,000 OF THESE PEOPLE HAD BEEN ALLOWED IN RECENT MONTHS TO RETURN TO PREDOMINANTLY KURDISH AREAS, EXCEPT FOR THE BUFFER ZONE ALONG THE IRANIAN BORDER. WHILE THAT STEP APPEARED AS AN ENCOURAGING SIGN THAT THE RESETTLEMENT HAD NOT BEEN WORKING, BARZANI NOW SAYS THAT A NEW REVERSAL OF IRAQI POLICY HAS OCCURRED. THE KURDISH INHABITANTS IN VILLAGES WITHIN A 20 KILOMETER BUFFER ZONE ALONG IRANIAN AND PERHAPS TURKISH BORDER ARE NOW BEING SYSTEMATICALLY UPROOTED AND THEIR HOMES ARE BEING DESTROYED.
HE WAS UNCLEAR AS TO WHERE THERE PEOPLE WERE FLEEING. (THIS IS WIDER THAN EARLIER BUFFER).
WE RECOGNIZE THAT YOU HAVE DIFFICULTY IN OBTAINING INFORMATION ON WHAT IS A SENSITIVE ISSUE IN IRAQ, BUT PLEASE

1977STATE251112.subject: TRAVEL OF MRS. JEAN C. NEWSOM

segments.text: PAN AM'S REVISED SCHEDULE NOW SHOWS FLIGHT 002 ARRIVING TEHRAN 7:00 P.M. NOVEMBER 1, DEPARTING 8:20 P.M. NOVEMBER 2.

DEPARTMENT VIEWS RECENT POLITICAL TREND IN EAST AFRICA AS NOT SO MUCH SHIFT IN CENTER OF GRAVITY AS GENERAL DECLINE IN SIGNIFICANT REGIONAL FOCUS. EAST AFRICAN COMMUNITY HAS COLLAPSED AS EFFECTIVE CENTRALIZING FORCE IN REGION; KENYA'S ATTENTION IS INCREASINGLY FOCUSED NORTHWARD ON THE HORN AND PARTICULARLY THE SOMALI THREAT; AND TANZANIA IS PRINCIPALLY CONCERNED WITH SOUTHERN AFRICA DUE TO ITS ROLE AS KEY MEMBER OF FRONT LINE. IN LATTER CAPACITY, AND PARTICULARLY DUE TO PERSONAL ABILITIES AND INFLUENCE OF NYERERE, TANZANIA HAS ATTAINED INCREASED PROMINENCE ON AFRICAN AND WORLD SCENE INCLUDING VIS-A-VIS WESTERN NATIONS.

AT SAME TIME, KENYATTA IS SHOWING INCREASING SIGNS OF PHYSICAL DECLINE, AND ACTIVITY LEVEL OF KENYA ON REGIONAL AND WORLD STAGE IS NOW SIGNIFICANTLY LESS THAN, FOR EXAMPLE, PERIOD OF CONGO TROUBLES IN MID-SIXTIES. NEVERTHELESS, WE WOULD NOT DRAW CONCLUSION FROM THIS THAT KENYA IS "RUNNING OUT OF STEAM" OR THAT IT WILL NECESSARILY "SINK INTO MORASS" IN NEAR FUTURE AS IRANIANS FEAR. KENYAN ECONOMY HAS WITHSTOOD MULTIPLE SHOCKS OF RECENT YEARS FAR BETTER THAN ANYONE EXPECTED; DOMINANT KENYAN GROUPS REMAIN ENERGETIC AND SELF-CONFIDENT; AND LEADERSHIP POOL IN KENYA IS AS LARGE AS IN ANY AFRICAN COUNTRY EVEN IF IMMEDIATE SUCCESSION TO KENYATTA REMAINS SOMEWHAT CLOUDY.

OVERALL, WHILE WE WOULD NOT DISCOURAGE IRANIANS FROM OPENING A POST IN TANZANIA, PARTICULARLY IF IRAN SEES ROLE FOR ITSELF IN FUTURE DEVELOPMENT OF SOUTHERN AFRICA, WE WOULD CAUTION AGAINST WRITING OFF KENYA OR SEEING LONG-TERM REGIONAL TRENDS IN WHAT MAY ONLY BE TEMPORARY CONSTELLATION OF CIRCUMSTANCES.
EMBASSY MAY DRAW ON ABOVE IN BRIEFING IRANIANS. VANCE

1977STATE252325.subject: NATIONAL DAY MESSAGE TO SHAH FROM PRESIDENT

segments.text: PLEASE DELIVER FOLLOWING MESSAGE TO SHAH FROM PRESIDENT AT APPROPRIATE TIME PRIOR TO OCTOBER 26

BEGIN TEXT: YOUR IMPERIAL MAJESTY: MRS. CARTER JOINS ME IN SENDING OUR WARMEST PERSONAL GREETINGS AND VERY BEST WISHES ON THE OCCASION OF YOUR BIRTHDAY. ON BEHALF OF THE AMERICAN PEOPLE, WE WISH PROGRESS AND PROSPERITY TO THE IRANIAN PEOPLE UNDER YOUR WISE AND ABLE LEADERSHIP. THE CLOSE BONDS BETWEEN OUR TWO COUNTRIES HAVE BEEN FORGED IN OVER THIRTY YEARS OF INTIMATE COOPERATION AND ARE BASED UPON MUTUALITY OF MANY NATIONAL INTERESTS AND OUR SHARED COMMITMENT TO PEACE AND STABILITY IN THE WORLD.
MRS. CARTER AND I WERE DELIGHTED AND HONORED TO MEET THE SHAHBANOU IN JULY AND WE LOOK FORWARD WITH GREAT PLEASURE TO GREETING BOTH OF YOU IN WASHINGTON NEXT MONTH. SINCERELY, JIMMY CARTER. .

1977STATE252921.subject: TERRORISM -- RECOMMENDATIONS TO PRESERVE GSDR COOPERATION

segments.text: THE GOVT OF THE SOMALI DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC ENLISTED IN THE ANTI-TERRORIST RANKS YESTERDAY MORNING, BUT THE QUESTION IS WHETHER WE HAVE AN EAGER RECRUIT OR A RELUCTANT CONSCRIPT. I HAVE NO DOUBT THAT THE ANSWER LIES SOMEWHERE IN BETWEEN, BUT IT BEHOOVES US NOW TO MOVE RAPIDLY TO REINFORCE THE MOTIVATION THAT PROMPTED PRESIDENT SIAD TO MAKE A BASIC DECISION WHEN HE GAVE MINISTER OF STATE WISCHENEWSKI APPROVAL TO LAND THE FEDREP TEAM WHICH TOOK THE AIRCRAFT BY FORCE. SIAD HAS ALREADY HAD SOME SECOND THOUGHTS ABOUT THIS STEP, AN ATTITUDE REFLECTED AT LEAST TO SOME MINOR DEGREE BY SUBORDINATE LEVELS IN THE GSDR.
MOREOVER, THE GSDR HAS A DELICATE PROBLEM IN THE SURVIVING FEMALE HIJACKER. HER DISPOSITION WILL TAX SIAD'S INGENUITY TO A SUBSTANTIAL DEGREE.

WHEN MORE OF THE FACTS ARE KNOWN I BELIEVE WE WILL BE BETTER ABLE TO ANALYZE SAID'S FAVORABLE DECISION TO COOPERATE WITH THE GERMAN EFFORT. TO MY MIND HE REACTED POSITIVELY BECAUSE THE TERRORISTS HAD REJECTED SOMALI OVERTURES AND WISCHENEWSKI WAS ABLE TO OFFER A CONCRETE PLAN TO END THE AFFAIR QUICKLY. I AM LESS SANGUINE THAT THE SOMALI LEADER WOULD HAVE ACQUIESCED HAD WISCHENEWSKI PROPOSED DRAWN OUT NEGOTIATIONS WITH THE HIJACKERS. THE TERRORISTS WERE AN EMBARRASSMENT AND A DISTRACTION TO SIAD, AND HE WANTED THE ISSUE RESOLVED QUICKLY.

SOMALI INFORMATION MINISTER ABDI KASIM SALAD HAS ALREADY DONE A SERVICE IN STRESSING THE SOMALI ROLE IN THE AFFAIR. WITHOUT DISPARAGING THE GERMANS IN ANY WAY, THIS IS APLUS IN THE ANTI-TERRORIST CAUSE. IT MAKES IT MORE DIFFICULT FOR THE GSDR TO AVOID FUTURE OBLIGATIONS. THE EMBASSY MOVED RAPIDLY TO DISAVOW ANY INVOLVEMENT ON MY PART IN THE PLANNING, AN ACCURATE DENIAL, BUT MORE IMPORTANTLY, ANOTHER STEP IN IDENTIFYING THE SOMALIS AS THE PRINCIPAL PARTY.

PRESIDENT CARTER'S PROMPT CONGRATULATORY LETTER TO PRESIDENT SIAD WAS AN EXCELLENT INITIAL STEP IN THE EFFORT TO PRESERVE THE GAINS WE HAVE MADE. THE THOROUGH AND COMPREHENSIVE PRESS GUIDANCE (STATE 250155) IS ANOTHER. I HAVE ALREADY SENT A COPY TO THE MINISTER OF INFORMATION. I AM SEEKING APPOINTMENTS WITH THE MINISTER OF INFORMATION, TRANSPORTATION, THE ACTING MINISTER OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS, AND THE ACTING COMMANDANT OF POLICE TO EXPRESS MY APPRECIATION FOR THEIR CONTRIBUTIONS TO THE HAPPY RESOLUTION OF THE HIJACKING AND SAFE DELIVERANCE OF MRS SANTIAGO AND SON.

I SHOULD DO SO IN ANY CASE, BUT I THINK WE MAY BE ABLE TO STRENGTHEN SOMALI RESOLVE AND THE CONVICTION THAT THEY MADE A CORRECT DECISION IF IN ADDITION TO GRATITUDE I MAY OFFER: --CONTINUED COOPERATION IN EXCHANGING DOCTRINE AND INFORMATION ON TERRORISM AND TERRORIST THREATS. --TRAINING IN ANTI-TERRORIST TACTICS FOR SOMALI POLICE. --SPECIALIZED-EQUIPMENT.

THERE ARE OTHER COURSES THE DEPT MAY ALSO CHOOSE TO PURSUE, E.G.: ENCOURAGING THE SAUIDS AND EGYPTIANS TO APPLAUD THE SUCCESSFUL SOMALI ACTION, BUT I SUGGEST THAT AMBASSADOR YOUNG MAY WISH TO CALL ON THE SOMALI REPRESENTATIVE AT THE UN WITH A MESSAGE OF THANKS AND SOLICIT CONTINUED SUPPORT IN THE DEBATE I UNDERSTAND IS ABOUT TO BEGIN ON HOSTAGES. I SHOULD BE PLEASED TO MAKE A SIMILAR REPRESENTATION HERE. I BELIEVE, HOWEVER, THAT WHATEVER ACTION WE DECIDE TO TAKE SHOULD BE ACCOMPLISHED PROMPTLY. THE SECOND GUESSERS, AND I WONDER IF THE IRAQIS MAY BE THE SEVEREST AND MOST INFLUENTIAL CRITICS, WILL SOON BE MAKING THEIR WEIGHT FELT. LOUGHRAN.
UNQUOTE VANCE".

THE FOLLOWING IS GUIDANCE WHICH YOU MAY PROVIDE TO MINISTER OF COURT HOVEYDA CONCERNING QUESTIONS RAISED BY MUZOREWA'S REQUESTS. WE HAVE CONSULTED WITH UK EMBASSY, WASHINGTON AND, BELIEVE THIS GUIDANCE CONFORMS WITH THAT WHICH FCO WILL SEND UK AMBASSADOR IN TEHRAN.

RECOGNITION: QUESTION OF RECOGNITION OF MUZOREWA'S ORGANIZATION DOES NOT ARISE. US-UK NOTE ITS EXISTENCE AND ARE PLEASED TO DEAL WITH IT. BOTH COUNTRIES, HOWEVER, OBJECT TO GRANTING ANY PARTICULAR NATIONALIST ORGANIZATION OR LEADER EXCLUSIVE RECOGNITION AS THE SOLE VOICE OF THE ZIMBABWE PEOPLE.

TRAINING: WE AGREE THAT MUZOREWA MAY BE ATTEMPTING TO TRAIN A GROUP WHICH WOULD BE LOYAL TO HIM IN THE TO-BE-FORMED ZIMBABWE NATIONAL ARMY. HE HAS MADE APPROACHES TO OTHER GOVERNMENTS FOR MILITARY TRAINING AND TO THE BEST OF OUR KNOWLEDGE HAS NOT RECEIVED ANY ASSISTANCE IN THIS REGARD. MATTER OF TRAINING IS QUESTION FOR IRANIANS TO DECIDE. HOWEVER, WE THINK AT THIS POINT IN NEGOTIATING EFFORT, WHEN WE ARE APPROACHING TALKS WHICH WE HOPE WILL ULTIMATELY LEAD TO A CEASEFIRE AS PART OF A GENERAL MILITARY AND POLITICAL SETTLEMENT, THAT TRAINING OF AN ADDITIONAL MILITARY ELEMENT IS UNNECESSARY.
THERE IS A REAL NEED FOR TRAINED RHODESIAN AFRICANS IN A WIDE VARIETY OF ENDEAVORS AND GOI MIGHT WISH TO EXPLORE POSSIBILITIES OF TECHNICAL TRAINING FOR MUZOREWA'S PEOPLE IN NONMILITARY SPHERE.

MONEY: IN GENERAL, THE EVEN-HANDED, NO FAVORITES APPROACH WHICH APPLIES TO RECOGNIZATION SHOULD, IN OUR VIEW, EXTEND TO IRANIAN FINANCIAL SUPPORT FOR THE NATIONALIST GROUPS. WE UNDERSTAND FROM UK EMBASSY HERE THAT IN INITIAL CONVERSATION UK AMBASSADOR PARSONS TOLD HOVEYDA THAT GOI SHOULD HELP MUZOREWA NO MORE AND NO LESS THAN IT DOES NKOMO. WHILE WE DO NOT OBJECT TO THIS CONCEPT WE PREFER NOT TO PLACE OURSELVES IN POSITION WHERE WE TELL THE GOI HOW THEY SHOULD SPEND THEIR MONEY.

THEREFORE, WE DO NOT THINK IT APPROPRIATE TO IDENTIFY OURSELVES WITH PARSON'S PREVIOUS STATEMENT URGING MUZOREWA/NKOMO EQUALITY IN IRANIAN ASSISTANCE, BUT SUGGEST WE CONFINE OUR REMARKS TO A GENERAL REAFFIRMATION OF THE NEED FOR IMPARTIALITY. VANCE

TEXT OF STATEMENT PREPARED FOR FRASER SUB-COMMITTEE HEARING ON HUMAN RIGHTS IN IRAN GIVEN BELOW. MINOR, ESSENTIALLY NON-SUBSTANTIVE, MODIFICATIONS WERE MADE IN ACTUAL DELIVERY. BILL BUTLER SPOKE FROM NOTES AND WE WILL HAVE TO AWAIT TRANSCRIPT. TEXTS OF PREPARED STATEMENTS BY PROFESSORS RICKS (GEOGETOWN) AND COTTAM BEING POUCHED.

BEGIN TEXT: MR. CHAIRMAN, I WELCOME THE OPPORTUNITY TO APPEAR BEFORE THE SUBCOMMITTEE THIS MORNING. IN HIS TESTIMONY LAST YEAR ASSISTANT SECRETARY ATHERTON SKETCHED OUT THE HISTORICAL, ECONOMIC, CULTURAL AND POLITICAL CONTEXT WITHIN WHICH WE VIEW THE SUBJECT OF HUMAN RIGHTS IN IRAN. I WILL NOT REPEAT THE IMPORTANT POINTS MR. ATHERTON MADE. THEY ARE NOW PART OF THE OFFICIAL RECORD. HOWEVER, MY COMMENTS TODAY SHOULD BE SEEN IN THAT CONTEXT. LEGISLATION.

MILITARY COURT SYSTEM: MR. BUTLER HAS TESTIFIED ABOUT THE IMPORTANT CHANGES MADE IN THE MILITARY COURT SYSTEM WHICH WOULD IMPROVE SUBSTANTIALLY DUE PROCESS PROTECTION OF THE INDIVIDUALS WHO COME INTO THAT SYSTEM BECAUSE OF THEIR INVOLVEMENT, OR SUSPECTED INVOLVEMENT, IN CRIMES AGAINST STATE SECURITY. BRIEFLY, CHANGES IN THE LAW PROVIDE THAT: (1) PERSONS ARRESTED MUST BE ARRAIGNED OR RELEASED WITHIN TWENTY-FOUR HOURS; (2) THE DEFENDANT MAY SELECT A CIVILIAN LAWYER OF HIS OWN CHOICE

THE DEFENSE COUNSEL WILL BE GIVEN ADEQUATE TIME TO PREPARE HIS BRIEF; AND (4) EXCEPT IN UNUSUAL CIRCUMSTANCES, TRIALS WILL BE OPEN TO THE PUBLIC. THE IRANIAN PARLIAMENT APPROVED THE AMENDMENTS IN AUGUST 1977. IMPLEMENTING REGULATIONS HAVE NOW BEEN PREPARED AND THE LAW WILL BECOME EFFECTIVE NOVEMBER 7. THE REVISIONS ARE PARTLY RETROACTIVE IN THE SENSE THAT THEY WILL APPLY TO INDIVIDUALS WHO WERE ARRESTED BUT NOT TRIED BEFORE ENACTMENT OF THE LEGISLATION.
ANTI-DISCRIMINATION LAW: DURING THE SUMMER, A LAW WAS PASSED WHICH PROVIDES PENAL MEASURES -- 6 MONTHS TO A YEAR AND HEAVY FINES -- FOR DISCRIMINATION ON GROUNDS OF RACE, CREED OR SEX.

JUDICIAL REORGANIZATION: FINALLY, A BILL IS PRESENTLY BEFORE THE IRANIAN PARLIAMENT WHICH IS DESIGNED TO STREAMLINE THE CIVILIAN COURT SYSTEM AND IMPROVE THE ADMINISTRATION OF JUSTICE. PRISONERS. A NUMBER OF DEVELOPMENTS CONCERNING PRISONERS SHOULD BE PLACED ON THE RECORD IN THIS STATUS REPORT. LATE LAST YEAR BBC WAS PERMITTED ACCESS TO ONE OF THE PRISONS TO FILM INTERVIEWS WITH SOME SECURITY PRISONERS. AT ABOUT THE SAME TIME, A BELGIAN JOURNALIST OF LE SOIR ASKED TO INTERVIEW BY NAME A NUMBER OF PRISONERS WHOM OPPONENTS OF THE REGIME IN EUROPE HAD CLAIMED WERE CRIPPLED BY TORTURE OR IN FACT EXECUTED.

HE WAS GIVEN ACCESS TO THESE PRISONERS FOR INTERVIEW AND PERMITTED TO PHOTOGRAPH THEM TO ENSURE THEIR IDENTITY. ALL OF THE PRISONERS WERE IN GOOD HEALTH. IN APRIL OF THIS YEAR, A PUBLIC TRIAL WAS HELD FOR A NUMBER OF PRISONERS WHO HAD BEEN ARRESTED IN DECEMBER 1976 FOR COMMUNIST ACTIVITY. THIS WAS THE FIRST PUBLIC TRIAL OF SECURITY PRISONERS IN FIVE YEARS AND THE IRANIAN PRESS GAVE EXTENSIVE COVERAGE TO THE EVENT. A NUMBER OF FOREIGN OBSERVERS, INCLUDING AN AMERICAN, WERE PRESENT.

THE TOTAL NUMBER OF PRISONERS WHO HAD BEEN FOUND GUILTY OF STATE SECURITY CRIMES HAS BEEN SUBSTANTIALLY REDUCED SINCE THE TURN OF THE YEAR BY THE GOVERNMENT'S AMNESTY PROGRAM. AN ADDITIONAL 131 ARE TO BE RELEASED TODAY -- THE BIRTHDAY OF HIS IMPERIAL MAJESTY -- THUS BRINGING THE TOTAL HELD TO AROUND 2,200 -- DOWN FROM THE 3,700 HELD AT ONE POINT IN 1976. INTERNATIONAL OBSERVERS. EARLIER THIS YEAR THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT REQUESTED THE INTERNATIONAL COMMITTEE OF THE RED CROSS TO CARRY OUT A THOROUGH SURVEY OF IRAN'S PENAL INSTITUTIONS AND TO REPORT TO THE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN ON WHAT IMPROVEMENTS SHOULD BE INSTITUTED.

THIS ACTION IS QUITE UNUSUAL AND REPRESENTED, IN PART, THE GOVERNMENT'S DESIRE TO PUT TO REST THE ALLEGATIONS ABOUT PRISON CONDITIONS WHICH HAVE BEEN MADE IN EUROPE AND THE UNITED STATES. SUCH REPORTS ARE, ACCORDING TO ICRC PRACTICE, CONFIDENTIAL AND FOR THE USE ONLY OF THE GOVERNMENT WHICH HAS REQUESTED THE STUDY. THE ICRC JUST RECENTLY COMPLETED A SECOND VISIT TO FOLLOW UP THE EARLIER REPORT. AS YOU KNOW, MR. CHAIRMAN, AMNESTY INTERNATIONAL HAS BEEN AN OUTSPOKEN CRITIC OF HUMAN RIGHTS PRACTICES IN IRAN. THE SHAH OF IRAN MET WITH MARTIN ENNALS, THE PRESIDENT OF THAT ORGANIZATION, TO DISCUSS HUMAN RIGHTS AND THE PERSPECTIVES OF HIS ORGANIZATION.

ONE OF THE MORE SIGNIFICANT OCCURRENCES WAS THE VISIT OF MR. WILLIAM BUTLER TO DISCUSS WITH THE SHAH CERTAIN ASPECTS AFFECTING HUMAN RIGHTS. FINALLY, A NUMBER OF INDIVIDUALS WITH PARTICULAR INTEREST IN HUMAN RIGHTS, INCLUDING AT LEAST FOUR AMERICANS, VISITED IRAN AND MET WITH VARIOUS IRANIAN OFFICIALS. OTHER HUMAN RIGHTS. MR. CHAIRMAN, IN YOUR LETTER TO SECRETARY VANCE REQUESTING THE APPEARANCE OF A DEPARTMENT SPOKESMAN AT THIS HEARING YOU ASKED THAT COMMENT BE GIVEN ON "OTHER INTERNATIONALLY RECOGNIZED HUMAN RIGHTS IN IRAN." A FEW MONTHS AGO, THE SHAH OF IRAN PUBLICLY COMMENTED THAT HE HAD PREVIOUSLY ORDERED THE ENDING OF THE USE OF TORTURE.

WE HAVE HAD NO REPORTS OF THE USE OF INHUMANE TREATMENT AGAINST PRISONERS THIS YEAR. I WILL ADDRESS BRIEFLY YOUR QUESTION ABOUT FREEDOM OF OPINION AND EXPRESSION, INCLUDING FREEDOM OF THE PRESS. FOREIGN NEWSPAPERS AND MAGAZINES CONTAINING CRITICISM OF THE GOI HAVE LONG CIRCULATED FREELY IN IRAN. INCREASING RELAXATION WITH RESPECT TO INTERNAL CRITICISM IS CLEARLY VISIBLE. THE EVIDENCE OF THIS MORE RELAXED ATTITUDE IS BEST EXEMPLIFIED BY TWO OPEN LETTERS, ONE TO THE SHAH, AND THE OTHER TO THE PRIME MINISTER, ARTICULATING LIBERAL ASPIRATIONS. THE LETTER TO THE SHAH WAS SIGNED BY SENIOR MEMBERS OF THE FORMER NATIONAL FRONT.

THE SECOND LETTER, WHICH CALLED FOR INCREASED INTELLECTUAL FREEDOM AND THE REESTABLISHMENT OF THE WRITERS GUILD, WAS ADDRESSED TO THE PRIME MINISTER BY FORTY INTELLECTUALS. IN ADDITION, THREE GOVERNMENT BODIES HAVE BEEN RESURRECTED TO EXAMINE GOVERNMENTAL OPERATIONS -THE IMPERIAL COMMISSION, THE IMPERIAL INSPECTORATE ORGANIZATION, AND THE STUDY GROUP OF IRANIAN PROBLEMS. EACH GROUP HAS BEEN GIVEN A WIDE MANDATE, SOMETIMES OVERLAPPING THAT OF THE OTHER.

THE IMPERIAL COMMISSION IS TO FOCUS ON OVERSEEING ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT, ERADICATING WASTE AND ELIMINATING CORRUPTION; THE IMPERIAL INSPECTORATE ORGANIZATION IS TO MONITOR THE PROGRESS OF THE ADMINISTRATIVE REVOLUTION AND TO CONTINUE UNANNOUNCED SPOT INSPECTIONS OF GOVERNMENT MINISTRIES AND OFFICES; AND, THE STUDY GROUP IS TO DEBATE AND EVALUATE GOVERNMENTAL PROBLEMS AND POLICIES AND TO FORWARD THEIR CRITICISM AND REPORTS TO THE SHAH. THE MEETINGS OF THE IMPERIAL COMMISSION, IN WHICH ATTACKS AGAINST VARIOUS DEFICIENCIES OF THE GOVERNMENT ARE ARTICULATED, ARE REGULARLY TELEVISED. IRAN IS A ONE PARTY STATE. WITHIN THE RASTAKHIZ PARTY THERE IS CONSIDERABLE OPPORTUNITY FOR POLITICAL DEBATE AND CRITICISM OF GOVERNMENTAL PERFORMANCE.

A MAJOR STATED GOAL OF THIS RELATIVELY NEW ORGANIZATION IS TO EXPAND FURTHER SUCH OPPORTUNITIES. LET US TURN BRIEFLY TO ORGANIZED LABOR. THE IRANIAN WORKERS ORGANIZATION REPRESENTS 17 FEDERATIONS WHICH IN TURN ARE COMPOSED OF 750 UNIONS HAVING ABOUT 600,000 MEMBERS. STRIKES ARE ILLEGAL BUT A SUBSTANTIAL NUMBER OF WILDCAT WALKOUTS DO OCCUR. PROGRESS IN THE FIELD OF WOMEN'S RIGHTS CONTINUES, ALTHOUGH NOT WITHOUT THE OPPOSITION OF CONSERVATIVE FORCES. THERE ARE 21 WOMEN OUT OF 268 SEATS IN THE LOWER BODY (THE MAJLES) OF PARLIAMENT AND TWO WOMEN IN THE SENATE WHICH HAS 60 MEMBERS.

THE EMPLOYMENT OF WOMEN IS GROWING, BUT SLOWLY; BY NEXT YEAR IT IS ESTIMATED THAT 14 PERCENT OF WOMEN WILL BE IN THE LABOR FORCE. ALSO, BY NEXT YEAR LITERACY AMONG WOMEN WILL BE IN THE 45-50 PERCENT RANGE. ALTHOUGH YOU DID NOT SPECIFICALLY REQUEST COMMENT ON THIS POINT, I BELIEVE IT IMPORTANT TO NOTE FOR THE RECORD THAT THE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN HAS CONTINUED WITH FULL STEAM THE MAJOR PROGRAMS TO MEET THE SOCIAL AND ECONOMIC NEEDS OF THE PEOPLE.

LIKE EVERY RAPIDLY DEVELOPING NATION, IRAN HAS HAD, AND WILL CONTINUE TO HAVE, DIFFICULT SOCIALECONOMIC PROBLEMS AS ITS TRADITIONAL SOCIETY, WHOSE ECONOMIC INFRA-STRUCTURE WAS VERY LIMITED, MOVES TOWARD A MODERN INDUSTRIAL STATE. THE GOVERNMENT HAS GIVEN A VERY HIGH PRIORITY TO MEETING THE NEEDS OF ITS PEOPLE WITH RESPECT TO HEALTH, EDUCATION, AND THE VARIETY OF SOCIAL SERVICES. LAST YEAR MR. ATHERTON DISCUSSED THE TERRORIST MOVEMENT IN IRAN. THE TERRORIST THREAT CONTINUES AND YOU HAVE SEEN THE PRESS REPORTS OF THE ATTEMPT TO ASSASSINATE PRINCESS ASHRAF, THE SISTER OF THE SHAH, IN FRANCE LAST MONTH.

ENCOUNTERS BETWEEN THE POLICE AND TERRORISTS IN IRAN HAVE RESULTED OVER THE LAST YEAR IN THE DEATH OR CAPTURE OF ABOUT 100 MEMBERS OF THE TERRORIST GROUPS. TWO TERRORISTS WERE EXECUTED AFTER TRIAL. ONE OF THEM WAS CONVICTED OF THE MURDER OF A LOCAL EMPLOYEE OF OUR EMBASSY WHO WAS MISTAKEN FOR A UNITED STATES OFFICIAL WHOM HE RESEMBLED. MR. CHAIRMAN, AS I SAID EARLIER, THESE ACTIONS AND DEVELOPMENTS, TAKEN CUMULATIVELY, REINFORCE THE GRATIFYING TREND WHICH WE NOTED LAST YEAR. WE SHALL WATCH DEVELOPMENTS WITH INTEREST. . VANCE

FOLLOWING IS TEXT OF OCTOBER 12 REUTER ARTICLE BY DAVID REID ANALYZING RESIGNATION OF PORTUGUESE FOREIGN MINISTER.

PORTUGAL'S SOCIALIST CABINET HAS RENEWED ITS BACKING FOR PRIME MINISTER MARIO SOARES AFTER THE SURPRISE RESIGNATION OF FOREIGN MINISTER JOSE MEDEIROS FERREIRA OVER POLICY DIFFERENCES. GOVERNMENT SPOKESMAN MANUEL ALEGRE, IN MAKING THE ANNOUNCEMENT TO REPORTERS LATE LAST NIGHT, DENIED THAT OTHER MINISTERS HAD OFFERED TO RESIGN. THERE HAD BEEN SPECULATION DURING THE DAY THAT AGRICULTURE MINISTER ANTONIO BARRETO AND EDUCATION MINISTER MARIO SOTTOMAYOR CARDIA MIGHT RESIGN IN SYMPATHY.

IN A TELEVISION INTERVIEW, DR. MEDEIROS FERREIRA, 35, WHOSE RESIGNATION WAS ANNOUNCED ON MONDAY, DISCLOSED HE HAD RESIGNED TWICE BEFORE THIS YEAR BUT DR. SOARES HAD PERSUADED HIM TO CONTINUE. ON THE THIRD OCCASION, AFTER HIS RETURN LAST WEEK FROM WHAT HAD BEEN RATED A SUCCESSFUL MISSION TO THE UNITED NATIONS GENERAL ASSEMBLY IN NEW YORK, HIS RESIGNATION WAS ACCEPTED. DR. MEDEIROS FERREIRA DECLINED TO REVEAL THE FACTS BEHIND HIS DECISION TO QUIT, SAYING THIS WAS UP TO THE PRIME MINISTER. BUT INFORMED SOURCES SAID DR. MEDEIROS FERREIRA CONSIDERED HIS ROLE HAD BEEN REDUCED BY THE INVOLVEMENT OF OTHER MINISTERS IN FOREIGN POLICY.

THE SOURCES SAID ONE OF THE MAIN REASONS FOR HIS RESIGNATION WAS THE TIMING OF A DECISION LAST MAY TO ELEVATE DIPLOMATIC RELATIONS WITH ISRAEL TO THE AMBASSADORIAL LEVEL. THE MOVE CAME ON THE EVE OF THE ISRAELI GENERAL ELECTION AND WAS INTERPRETED AS A GESTURE OF GOODWILL BY ONE SOCIALIST GOVERNMENT TO ANOTHER. BUT THE ISRAELI LABOR PARTY OF YITZHAM RABIN WAS DEFEATED, AND MENACHEM BEGIN'S ACCESSION TO POWER LEFT PORTUGAL IN A DELICATE POSITION.

ANOTHER REASON FOR DR. MEDEIROS FERREIRA'S DISCONTENT WAS SAID BY THE SOURCES TO HAVE BEEN THE SUBORDINATION OF A NEW COMMISSION FOR EUROPEAN INTEGRATION--CHARGED WITH NEGOTIATING PORTUGAL'S ENTRY INTO THE COMMON MARKET--TO THE PRIME MINISTER'S OFFICE RATHER THAN TO THE FOREIGN
FOREIGN MINISTER MEDEIROS FERREIRA ANNOUNCED HIS RESIGNATION OCTOBER 10. PM SOARES IS TO TAKE OVER FOREIGN AFFAIRS PORTFOLIO ON INTERIM BASIS.

DESPITE REPORTS FROM PS INSIDERS THAT MEDEIROS FERREIRA WOULD BE REPLACED IN ANTICIPATED CABINET RESHUFFLE IN FALL, HIS RESIGNATION CAME AS SOMEWHAT OF A SURPRISE. STRONG PERFORMANCE AT UNGA LED SOME OBSERVERS TO BELIEVE HIS PROSPECTS IN GOVERNMENT WERE NOT SO DIM AFTER ALL.

WE UNDERSTAND FOREIGN MINISTER'S LETTER OF RESIGNATION WAS SUBMITTED TO PRESIDENT RATHER THAN SOARES AND CONTAINED STRONG CRITICISM OF THOSE ALLEGEDLY UNDERCUTTING FOREIGN MINISTER'S AUTHORITY. PS INTERNATIONAL SECRETARY, RUI MATEUS, NO FRIEND OF MEDEIROS FERREIRA TO BE SURE. TOLD US SOARES WAS FURIOUS.

REGARDLESS OF WHETHER OR NOT THE FOREIGN MINISTER EXPECTED TO BE REPLACED THIS FALL, HIS RESIGNATION, EFFECTIVE OCT 6, CLEARLY COMES AT A DISADVANTAGEOUS POINT FOR SOARES. FURTHERMORE, DEPENDING ON HOW LONG THE PRIME MINISTER ASSUMES THE FOREIGN AFFAIRS PORTFOLIO, MEDIROS FERREIRA'S RESIGNATION MAY AFFECT THE GOP'S ABILITY TO HANDLE A SERIES OF MAJOR FOREIGN POLICY ISSUES, NOT THE LEAST OF WHICH MIGHT BE THE LAJES NEGOTIATIONS.
MEDEIROS FERREIRA'S DEPARTURE IS FOURTH MINISTERIAL-LEVEL RESIGNATION SINCE SOARES GOVERNMENT TOOK OFFICE FIFTEEN MONTHS AGO. FURTHER COMMENT FOLLOWS SEPTEL.

THE FOLLOWING IS INTENDED TO SUPPLEMENT THE EMBASSY'S RECENT REPORTING AND ANALYSIS OF DC INTERNAL POLITICS AS CONTAINED IN ROME'S 14777, 16652 AND 17199 IN RESPONSE TO QUESTIONS RAISED REFTEL.

A RESHUFFLING OF INTERNAL FACTIONAL LINEUPS HAS BEEN UNDERWAY FOR SOME TIME. WHILE IT IS STILL TOO EARLY TO PERCEIVE CLEARLY WHAT THE N EW INTERNAL EQUILIBRIUM WILL BE, AND EVEN LESS HOW IT MIGHT AFFECT DECISIONS AT THE DC CONGRESS (IF INDEED, IT IS HELD ON SCHEDULE), IT IS APPARENT THAT THE OLD 1976 CONGRESS LINEUP HAS FALLEN APART. AT THAT TIME THE PARTY SPLIT ALMOST EVENLY BETWEEN SUPPORTERS OF ZACCAGNINI AND FORLANI. THE ZACCAGNINI SLATE WAS SUPPORTED PRIMARILY BY THE PARTY'S CENTER AND CENTER-LEFT WINGS (FORZE NUOVE, BASE, MOROTEI, DOROTEI BREAKAWAYS SUCH AS RUMOR AND GULLOTTI, WITH THE ARNAUD AUTOMONISTS (FORMER FANFANIANI) TIPPING THE BALANCE.

THE PICCOLI-BISAGLIA DOROTEI, ANDREOTTIANI AND FANFANIANI, THEN REPRESENT ING THE PARTY'S CENTER AND CENTER-RIGHT WINGS, SUPPORTED FORLANI'S CANDIDACY. THE DC SECRETARIAT UNDER ZACCAGNINI REFLECTED THE VICTORY OF THE DC "LEFT"--A CABAL OF FORZE NUOVE, BASE AND MOROTEI (GALLONI, BODRATO, PISANU AND SALVI) TOOK OVER THE DAY-TO-DAY POLITICAL DIRECTION OF THE PARTY. THE MODERATES AND CONSERVATIVES (ANDREOTTIANI, DOROTEI, AND FANFANIANI) RETAINED MUCH OF THE ORGANIZATIONAL CONTROL OF THE PARTY (SIGNORELLO, GASPARI, D'AREZZO).

NO SOONER WERE THE 1976 PARLIAMENTARY ELECTIONS OVER, HOWEVER, THAN THE ZACCAGNINI CONGRESS "MAJORITY" BEGAN TO DISINTEGRATE. AS OFTEN HAPPENS, GALLONI AND BODRATO BECAME MORE AND MORE MEN OF ZACCAGNINI'S SECRETARIAT THAN SURROGATES FOR THE BASE AND FORZE NUOVE LEADERSHIP. THE FIRST DEFECTION WAS THAT OF FORZE NUOVE'S DONAT CATTIN; OVER THE PAST YEAR HE HAS MISSED NO OPPORTUNITY TO CRITICIZE ZACCAGNINI'S FALTERING LEADERSHIP (AS WELL AS THE ANDREOTTI GOVERNMEN T). VIRTUALLY OVERNIGHT, DONAT-CATTIN SHIFTED FROM MAN -OF-THE-LEFT TO HIS PARTY'S MOST ELOQUENT DEFENDER OF FREE ENTERPRISE AND ONE OF ITS MOST ARDENT CRUSADERS AGAINST COMMUNISM.
ALTHOUGH DONAT-CATTIN IS KEEPING HIS OPTIONS OPEN (HE HAS REMAINED ON GOOD TERMS WITH MORO), HE HAS OFTEN ACTED IN CONCERT WITH FANFANI TO HAMSTRING AN ANDREOTTI GOVERNMENT OR MORO PARTY INITIATIVE.

A FAR MORE IMPORTANT SHIFT, THAT OF ANDREOTTI FROM THE CENTER TO HIS PARTY'S LEFT WING, EVOLVED AS A FUNCTION OF THE PRIME MINISTER'S BRIDGING ROLE AS THE LEADER OF A GOVERNMENT DEPENDENT ON THE LEFT PARTIES, THE PCI PARTICULARLY, FOR ABSTENTION SUPPORT. NEVER A MAN OF THE PARTY, THE IMPERATIVES OF THE POSITION AND ANDREOTTI'S PRAGMATIC BENT HAVE FURTHER ISOLATED HIM FROM OTHER PARTY LEADERS. OC OCT. 19, ON THE EVE OF THE DC NATIONAL COUNCIL, THE ANDREOTTIANI ANNOUNCED THEIR FULL SUPPORT FOR ZACCAGNINI.

ANDREOTTI'S MOST SERIOUS RIVAL (NOT SO MUCH FOR THE POSITION OF PRIME MINISTER AS THAT OF PRESIDENT OF THEREPUBLIC) REMAINS ALDO MORO. THE LATTER HAS WORKED QUIETLY AND ALOOFLY DURING THE PAST YEAR TO CONSOLIDATE HIS CONTROL OVERTHE PARTY SINCE HIS ELECTION AS DC PRESIDENT LAST OCTOBE. ALTHOUGH MORO RARELY SHOWS HIS CARDS, HE MAY BE WORKING CLOSELY WITH THE MODERATE DOROTEO LEADER (AND DC CHAMBER WHIP) PICCOLI TO FASHION A NEW CENTRIST ALLIANCE. IF THIS IS INDEED MORO'S STRATEGY, IT WOULD REPRESENT, FOR HIM A SHIFT TO THE RIGHT.

AS THE LARGEST FACTION, THE MODERATE DOROTEI CONTROL ABOUT 25 PERCENT OF THE CONGRESS VOTES. THEIR LAST CONVENTION AT MONTECATINI, OCT. 9-11, WAS IMPORTANT IN THAT IS SIGNALED A RAPPROCHMENT BETWEEN THE TWO RIVAL DOROTEI LEADERS, PICCOLI AND BISAGLIA. SPARING ZACCAGNINI FROM DIRECT ATTACK, THE DOROTEI TARGETED THEIR CRITICISM ON DEPUTY SECRETARY GALLONI FOR WORKING IN "DANGEROUS ISOLATION." THEY RENEWED THEIR CALL FOR A POLITICAL SECRETARIAT THAT, IN EFFECT, WOULD DILUTE GALLONI'S INFLUENCE BY INCLUDING DOROTEI AND OTHER MODERATES. SIGNIFICANTLY, PICCOLI CALLED FOR A "RESHUFFLING OF THE CARDS" TO ESTABLISH "A NEW EQUILIBRIUM" AT THE CENTER UNDER MORO.

SOME OBSERVERS BELIEVE THAT IN CALLING FOR A NEW CENTER MAJORITY, THE DOROTEI SIGNALED THEIR SUPPORT FOR MORO'S REPLACEMENT OF ZACCAGNINI A S PARTY SECRETARY, A MOVE THAT DONAT-CATTIN HAS ALSO PUBLICLY ADVOCATED.

FOR HIS PART, FOREIGN MINISTER FORLANI (A FANFANI MODERATE) HAS ALSO APPARENTLY DECIDED THAT THE MOMENT TO STRIKE HAS COME. ABANDONING HIS NORMALLY CAUTIOUS RESERVE, FORLANI CIRCULATED AN OPEN INVITATION TO HIS "FRIENDS" TO MEET ON OCT. 21 AT THE NATIONAL COUNCIL. ALTHOUGH RATHER LAMELY INSISTING THAT HE DID NOT WISH TO FORM HIS OWN FACTION, FORLANI EVIDENTLY HOPES TO REGAIN A VOICE IN TH E LEADERSHIP OF THE PARTY AND POSSIBLY DISASSOCIATE HIMSELF FURTHER FROM FANFANI. THE LATTER, WHO RETAINS CONSIDERABLE CLOUT DUE TO HIS POWERFUL ORGANIZATIONAL HOLD OVER MANY SECTORS OF THE PARTY, HAS PROGRESSIVELY LOST GROUND AS A NATIONAL LEVEL LEADER.

IN ADDITION TO FANFANI'S OLD-STYLE IMAGE, THERE IS LITTLE ROOM AT THE LEADERSHIP LEVEL FOR A CONSERVATIVE GIVEN THE STRONG CONDITIONING OF ITALIAN POLITICS BY PARTIES OF THE LEFT. THERE IS, HOWEVER, STRONG SUPPORT FOR FANFANI'S ANTI-COMMUNISM IN BOTH THE PARTY AND ELECTORATE.

ALTHOUGH THE FACTIONAL LINEUP WILL CONTINUE TO BE FLUID IN NATURE, VARYING WITH THE ISSUES AND EXTERNAL DEVELOPMENTS, THE CURRENT POSITIONS OF PRINCIPLE DC LEADERS ON THE KEY ISSUE OF THE PARTY'S STANCE TOWARD THE PCI COULD BE DIAGRAMMED AS FOLLOWS: LEFT (MORE OPEN TO PCI CENTER RIGHT(HARDER ON PCI) GALLONI (BASE) ANDREOTTI MORO PICCOLI BISAGLIA FANFANI ZACCAGNINI (DOROTEI)(DOROTEI) DE MITA FORLANI DONAT-CATT IN (BASE) (FORZE-NUO VE) IN CONTRAST TO FANFANI, IT SHOULD BE NOTED THAT DONAT-CATTIN WOULD PROBABLY LEND HIS SUPPORT TO MORO, NOTWITHSTANDING HIS POSITION ON THE RIGHT ON THE PCI ISSUE.

HOW DO THE NEWER DC PARLIAMENTARIANS FIT INTO THIS PICTURE? AS DISCUSSED IN REFTELS, THE GENERATIONAL SOLIDARITY AMONG SUBSTANTIA NUMBERS OF FIRST AND SECOND TERM PARLIAMENTARIANS IS BECOMING AN INCREASINGLY IMPORTANT CONDITIONING FACTOR IN INTERNAL DC GROUPINGS. SMARTING UNDER THE OTEN PRE-EMPTORY AUTHORITY OF ALL THE DC'S TRADITIONAL, FACTIONAL LEADERS (AS CHAMBER WHIP, PICCOLI OFTEN BEARS THE BRUNT OF THE IRE), THE "NEW" PARLIAMENTARIANS WANT A MORE INFLUENTIAL VOICE IN PARTY ORGANIZATION AND DECISIONMAKING. POLITICAL MODERATES FOR THE MOST PART, THEY ARE GENERALLY MORE CONSERVATIVE ON THE PCI ISSUE THAN MANY OF THE PARTY'S LEADERS.

WHILE A MORE FORMAL GROUPING OF NEW PARLIAMENTARIANS MAY BE CONGEALING AROUND THE AGNELLI "HILTONITES," MOST ARE AS YET UNWILLING TO CUT THEIR FORMAL TIES TO THE POWERFUL AND INFLUENTIAL FACTIONS WHICH STILL LARGELY CONTROL ADVANCEMENT AND SURVIVAL IN DC POLITICS. MANY WERE COWERED BY THE FACTIONAL LEADERS' CONVINCING DEMONSTRATION OF THEIR RETRIBUTIVE POWER LAST JULY WHEN EVERY INDEPENDENT RENEWAL CANDIDATE EXCEPT BIANCO WAS DEFEATED FOR ELECTION TO THE DC PARLIAMENTARY GROUP BTX BLOCK VOTING FOR FACTIONAL

1977STATE258712.subject: CURRENT LIBYAN SCENE: QADHAFI MANEUVERS OUT OF ISOLATION SUMMARY. QADHAFI HAS BEEN MANEUVERING VIGOROUSLY AND WITH SOME SUCCESS DURING PAST SEVERAL MONTHS TO END LIB

segments.text: SUMMARY. QADHAFI HAS BEEN MANEUVERING VIGOROUSLY AND WITH SOME SUCCESS DURING PAST SEVERAL MONTHS TO END LIBYA'S ISOLATION IN ARAB WORLD AND MOVE BACK INTO MAINSTREAM OF EVENTS. MAJOR FEATURES OF TREND INCLUDE IMPROVEMENT OF RELATIONS WITH EGYPT, SUDAN, TUNISIA AND GREATER INTEREST IN MAGHREB COUNTRIES. END SUMMARY.

LAST FEW MONTHS HAVE SEEN AN UPBEAT QADHAFI MOVING WITH SKILL AND EFFECTIVENESS TO TAKE LIBYA OUT OF ITS POSITION OF ISOLATION IN THE ARAB WORLD AND PROJECT LIBYAN INFLUENCE MORE DIRECTLY INTO EVENTS OF THE REGION. MAJOR ELEMENT IN CAMPAIGN HAS BEEN SIGNIFICANT, IF PERHAPS TRANSITORY, IMPROVEMENT IN RELATIONS WITH EGYPT SINCE ARMED FORCES OF TWO COUNTRIES CLASHED IN JULY BORDER WAR. CLASH HAD BEEN PRECEDED AND FOLLOWED FOR SOME PERIOD BY BITTER ANTI-SADAT MEDIA CAMPAIGN, ATTACK HAS BEEN DIMINISHING AND HAS NOW CEASED WITH REDUCTION OF BORDER TENSIONS AND EXCHANGE OF PRISONERS.

SINCE END OF CLASH, QADHAFI CONTINUED TO SEND SIGNALS TO SADAT THROUGH VARIOUS THIRD PARTIES OFTEN INCLUDING PLO LEADER YASIR ARAFAT. SADAT'S MOST PROMINENT RESPONSE OCCURRED SOME THREE WEEKS AGO WHEN HE DISPATCHED EGYPTIAN MEDICAL TEAM TO TREAT ONE OF QADHAFI'S AILING SONS.

IN PUBLIC PRONUNCEMENTS QADHAFI HAS CONTINUED TO DEPLORE STRAINED RELATIONS BETWEEN TWO COUNTRIES AND IN OCTOBER 7 SPEECH DRAMATICALLY OFFERED TO PLACE LIBYAN ARMED FORCES AT DISPOSAL OF EGYPT FOR BATTLE AGAINST ZIONISM. DURING SAME PERIOD TWO COUNTRIES AGREED TO REOPEN RESPECTIVE CONSULATES IN ALEXANDRIA AND BENGHAZI, RESUME AIR TRAFFIC AND REVIVE CONFEDERATION CONTACTS. OFFER OF LIBYAN ARMED FORCES FOR EGYPT, THOUGH NOT NEW, HAS NOT BEEN MADE FOR SOME TIME. OF EQUAL INTEREST ARE UNCONFIRMED REPORTS OF QADHAFI'S WILLINGNESS TO TRANSFER BADLY NEEDED ARMS DIRECTLY TO THE EGYPTIAN FORCES.
DURING SAME PERIOD THAW IN RELATIONS WITH SUDAN APPARENTLY OCCURRING. MEDIATION EFFORTS OF SADIQ AL-MAHDI AND AL-HINDI AT QADHAFI'S INITIATIVE MAY BE LEADING TO RESUMPTION OF RELATIONS WITH SUDAN.
ON THE TUNISIAN FRONT INTENSITY OF FAVORABLE TREND OF RELATIONS CONTINUES UNABATED. CONTINUOUS EXCHANGES OF DELEGATIONS GO FORWARD CAPPED RECENTLY BY VISIT OF MADAME BOURGUIBA.

EVIDENCE OF QADHAFI'S RECENTLY ANNOUNCED INTENTION SEVERAL MONTHS AGO OF PAYING MORE ATTENTION TO MAGHREB IS LESS CLEAR. NEVERTHELESS, HE IS APPARENTLY SEEKING TO INSERT HIMSELF IN SAHARA DISPUTE. ACCORDING TO MOROCCAN AMBASSADOR HERE, MOROCCANS ARE WILLING TO LISTEN.

ALSO QADHAFI HAS IMPROVED RELATIONS WITH PLO. YASIR ARAFAT'S FREQUENT VISITS HERE APPARENTLY WERE ALSO CONNECTED WITH RESUMPTION OF LIBYAN SUBSIDIES TO FATAH WHICH HAD BEEN IN ABEYANCE FOR SEVERAL YEARS.

WHILE CHANGING TIDES IN ARAB WORLD ARE CERTAINLY NOT NEW, IT DOES APPEAR THAT QADHAFI IS MOVING WITH SURENESS AND SKILL TO PLACE LIBYA IN A MORE INFLUENTIAL REGIONAL POSITION. PRESUMABLY HE DESIRES APPEAR TO BEST POSSIBLE LIGHT WHEN AND IF ARAB SUMMIT CONFERENCE MATERIALIZES IN TUNIS NEXT MONTH. HE NO DOUBT ALSO WISHES POSITION HIMSELF FOR LARGER LIBYAN ROLE IF MIDDLE EAST PEACE EFFORTS FLOUNDER AS HE BELIEVES THEY WILL. ALSO, IT SEEMS POSSIBLE THAT FRIENDS OF U.S. IN REGION WHO HAD EARLIER ADVOCATED STERNNESS TOWARD LIBYA MAY NOW DESIRE HEDGE THEIR BETS.

1977STATE259459.subject: IBYA'S RENEWED INTEREST IN THE MAGHREB

segments.text: ALGIERS 2615 (NOTAL)

RECENT LIBYAN FOREIGN POLICY INTEREST IN THE MAGHREB APPEARS, FROM DEPARTMENT'S PERSPECTIVE, TO BE MORE A TEMPORARY SHIFT OF EMPHASIS IN THE WAKE OF THE COSTLY JULY BORDER CLASHES WITH EGYPT WHICH WILL PROBABLY NOT DEFLECT THE PRIMARY ATTENTION OF THE LIBYAN LEADERSHIP FROM ITS BASIC FOREIGN POLICY OBJECTIVES; THE PURSUIT OF QADHAFI'S BRAND OF ARAB UNITY, AND THE REJECTION OF ANY ARAB COMPROMISE WITH ISRAEL.

LIBYA'S IMPROVING RELATIONSHIP WITH TUNISIA HAS BENEFITS FOR BOTH PARTIES. TUNISIA'S RAPID RAPPROCHMENT WITH LIBYA SINCE THE SERIOUS DISPUTE THIS PAST SPRING OVER THE DELIMITATION OF THEIR CONTINENTAL SHELF IS PROBABLY BASED ON THE TUNISIAN LEADERSHIP'S HOPES OF SIGNIFICANT ECONOMIC GAIN: FINANCIAL AID, TRADE PREFERENCES, JOINT AGRICULTURAL PROJECTS, AND EMPLOYMENT FOR LARGE NUMBERS OF TUNISIAN LABORERS AND PROFESSIONAL WORKERS. FOR ITS PART, TRIPOLI VIEWS TUNISIAN SKILLED AND UNSKILLED MANPOWER AS A MEANS OF REDUCING ITS DEPENDENCE ON EGYPTIAN LABOR IN THE WAKE OF LIBYAN-EGYPTIAN HOSTILITIES.
CLOSE TUNISIAN-LIBYAN RELATIONS MAY BE DIFFICULT TO SUSTAIN, HOWEVER, GIVEN QADHAFI'S PENCHANT FOR INTERFERING IN TUNISIAN INTERNAL AFFAIRS IN HIS DRIVE FOR TUNISIAN-LIBYAN UNITY ON HIS TERMS.

OTHER ASPECTS OF LIBYA'S "REORIENTATION" TOWARD THE MAGHREB APPEAR LIKELY TO HAVE ONLY A MARGINAL IMPACT ON THE REGION. AS NOTED IN THE ALGIERS REFTEL (ALGIERS 2615), THE ALGERIAN GOVERNMENT IS NO DOUBT UNRECEPTIVE TO CONCRETE LIBYAN UNITY SCHEMES FOR THE MAGHREB. THIS IS ESPECIALLY TRUE SINCE ONE ASPECT OF LIBYA'S POLICY IN THE PAST HAS BEEN TO ENCOURAGE SOME FORM OF FAR-REACHING AUTONOMOUS SAHARAN POLITY COMPRISED OF PORTIONS OF SEVERAL STATES, INCLUDING ALGERIA.

FURTHERMORE, AS NOTED IN THE RABAT REFTEL (RABAT 5046), MOROCCO SEEMS TO CONSIDER THE VARIOUS LIBYAN OVERTURES AS LITTLE MORE THAN A GAME, PARTICULARLY SINCE ANY LIBYAN SPONSORED "SOLUTION" TO THE WESTERN SAHARA PROBLEM WOULD CERTAINLY INVOLVE A DILUTION OF MOROCCAN SOVEREIGNTY, A CONDITION WHICH RABAT FINDS TOTALLY UNACCEPTABLE.
TRIPOLI'S EFFORTS TO IMPROVE RELATIONS WITH TUNISIA, SUDAN, AND MOST RECENTLY, EGYPT PROBABLY REFLECT FOLLOWING CONSIDERATIONS

THE DAMAGE CAUSED TO LIBYA'S LABOR-DEFICIENT ECONOMY BY HOSTILE RELATIONS WITH TUNISIA AND EGYPT, BOTH OF WHICH ARE PRIME SOURCES OF LIBYAN LABOR AND PROFESSIONAL MANPOWER THE ADVERSE DOMESTIC AND EXTERNAL IMPACT OF LIBYA'S ISOLATION IN THE ARAB WORLD; AND
QADHAFI'S BELIEF THAT THE MIDDLE EAST PEACE PROCESS IS DOOMED TO FOUNDER, AND THAT ITS COLLAPSE WILL REAFFIRM THE ARAB WORLD'S NEED FOR QADHAFI-STYLE UNITY AGAINST THE "REAL" ENEMY. VANCE

WE RECEIVED INQUIRY FROM SEN. ALDAI STEVENSON RE ABOVE PRISONERINGASR PRISON. SUBJECT IS HUSBAND OF SUSAN DORSETT MAZAHERI-TEHRANI, CONSTITUENT OF STEVENSON; HAS BEEN IN PRISON SINCE ABOUT JANUARY 1977.
MAZAHERI-TEHRANI NOT ON LIST OF FREED PRISONERS (REFTEL) WOULD APPRECIATE LATEST INFO ON MAZAHERI-TEHRANI FOR REPLY TO SENATOR.
AT YOUR CONVENIENCE, WOULD APPRECIATE LIST OF NAMES OF REMAINING PRISONERS KNOWN TO HAVE US CONNECTION THRU

I WOULD APPRECIATE YOUR HAVING THE FOLLOWING MESSAGE DELIVERED TO AMBASSADOR KAZEMI. AS YOU WILL NOTE, I HOPE KAZEMI WILL BE ABLE TO GO TO GENEVA FOR THE SMALL PRIVATE MEETING MINISTER EVENSEN IS CONVENING ON NOVEMBER 14. I THINK HE IS A PRAGMATIST AND WOULD HAVE A GOOD DEAL TO CONTRIBUTE TO OUR DELIBERATIONS. ANYTHING YOU OR YOUR STAFF COULD REASONABLY DO TO ENCOURAGE HIM TO GO TO GENEVA WOULD BE MOST HELPFUL. WARM REGARD.

BEGIN TEXT DEAR MR. AMBASSADOR: I UNDERSTAND THAT YOU LIKE MYSELF RECEIVED AN INVITATION FROM MINISTER EVENSEN TO ATTEND A SMALL PRIVATE MEETING OF HEADS OF DELEGATION IN GENEVA ON NOVEMBER 14. IN ADVANCE OF THAT MEETING I WOULD LIKE TO SHARE WITH YOU SOME OF OUR THINKING. I HAVE TOLD EVENSEN THAT I WOULD ATTEND WITHOUT PREJUDICE TO THE REVIEW WE ARE NOW CONDUCTING OF OUR LAW OF THE SEA INTERESTS, FOR I CONSIDER THE GENEVA MEETING WILL ENABLE ME TO GAUGE THE DISPOSITION OF SOME OF THE LEADING CONFERENCE PARTICIPANTS TO TRY TO FIND WAYS IN WHICH WE CAN ADVANCE THE WORK OF THE CONFERENCE.

IN CONJUNCTION WITH OUR POLICY REVIEW I HAVE BEEN CONSULTING INFORMALLY WITH A NUMBER OF OUR CONFERENCE COLLEAGUES TO ASCERTAIN THEIR VIEWS ON WAYS IN WHICH THE NEGOTIATIONS MIGHT BE RELAUNCHED ON A FAIR AND REASONABLE BASIS. MY GOVERNMENT ATTACHES GREAT IMPORTANCE TO THE PROPOSITION THAT THE STARTING POINT FOR FURTHER NEGOTIATIONS SHOULD BE NO LESS REASONABLE THAN THE TEXTS WHICH MINISTER EVENSEN SUBMITTED TO CHAIRMAN ENGO. I HAVE THEREFORE BEEN INTERESTED TO FIND OUT TO WHAT EXTENT THIS CONCERN IS SHARED BY OTHER CONFERENCE PARTICIPANTS. REGARDING OUR CONCERNS ABOUT CONFERENCE PROCEDURES, I HAVE BEEN ENCOURAGED BY THE VIEWS I HAVE HEARD EXPRESSED.

THERE SEEMS TO BE A GENERAL FEELING THAT PROCEDURES MUST BE DEVISED TO ENSURE THAT ANY CONSENSUS WHICH EMERGES ON SEABEDS (AND OTHER UNRESOLVED ISSUES) WILL STICK. PRESIDENT AMERASINGHE HAS TOLD ME THAT HE CONTEMPLATES CONDUCTING THE 7TH SESSION OF THE CONFERENCE IN PLENARY SESSION WITH THE COMMITTEE CHAIRMEN SITTING WITH HIM ON THE DIAS. NEGOTIATIONS WOULD BE CONDUCTED IN THE PLENARY AND, TO THE EXTENT NECESSARY, BY WORKING GROUPS FORMED TO DEAL WITH SPECIFIC ISSUES AND CHAIRED BY INDIVIDUALS DESIGNATED BY HIM. THOSE TO WHOM I HAVE SPOKEN SEEM TO THINK THIS IS A CONSTRUCTIVE WAY TO PROCEED.

I WOULD BE MOST INTERESTED IN YOUR REACTION, FOR I CONSIDER THIS A REASONABLE AND USEFUL APPROACH. MANY OF THOSE WITH WHOM I HAVE SPOKEN, INCLUDING PRESIDENT AMERASINGHE, SHARE THE VIEW THAT THE 7TH SESSION MUST BE THE FINAL NEGOTIATING SESSION AND THAT IT SHOULD RESULT IN A DRAFT TREATY. IT IS WIDELY FELT THAT, IF THIS IS TO BE DONE, A GREAT DEAL OF PRELIMINARY WORK MUST BE ACCOMPLISHED DURING THE INTERSESSIONAL PERIOD. THERE IS A RANGE OF ISSUES RELATING TO THE SEABEDS WHICH MUST BE EXAMINED; SOME HAVE NOT YET BEEN ADEQUATELY DISCUSSED, FOR EXAMPLE, FINANCIAL ARRANGEMENTS BETWEEN THE AUTHORITY AND CONTRACTING PARTIES.

PRESIDENT AMERASINGHE WILL SHORTLY ASK EACH DELEGATION TO SEND HIM ITS CRITIQUE OF THE ICNT. A NUMBER OF THE PEOPLE TO WHOM I HAVE SPOKEN THINK THAT THE PRESIDENT MIGHT USE THOSE CRITIQUES TO PREPARE FORMULATIONS WHICH MIGHT BE CONSIDERED AS SUGGESTIONS TO FACILITATE COMPROMISE. THE PRESIDENT SEEMS DISPOSED TO CIRCULATE SUCH FORMULATIONS IN THE INTERESTS OF LAYING A FIRM FOUNDATION FOR WORK AT THE NEXT SESSION. I HAVE ALSO FOUND GENERAL SENTIMENT THAT IF THE NEXT SESSION IS TO MAKE REAL PROGRESS, IT IS IMPERATIVE THAT THESE SUGGESTED FORMULATIONS BE PREPARED PRIOR TO AND DISCUSSED AT AN OPEN-ENDED INTERSESSIONAL MEETING WHICH MIGHT BE HELD EARLY IN 1978.

DO YOU THINK THIS WAY OF PROCEEDING WOULD COMMAND GENERAL SUPPORT? I NOTED ABOVE THAT MY GOVERNMENT BELIEVES THAT THE STARTING POINT FOR FURTHER NEGOTIATIONS SHOULD BE NO LESS REASONABLE THAN THE TEXTS WHICH MINISTER EVENSEN SUBMITTED TO CHAIRMAN ENGO. THE UNITED STATES DID NOT, AS I HAVE MADE CLEAR, REGARD THOSE TEXTS AS SUBSTANTIVELY SATISFACTORY; NOT, I UNDERSTAND, DID THE GROUP OF 77. BUT THE EVENSEN TEXTS DID OFFER REAL PROSPECT OF ENABLING US TO CARRY NEGOTIATIONS FORWARD. GIVEN OUR OWN DIFFICULTIES WITH THE EVENSEN TEXTS, WE COULD NOT THEREFORE CONTEMPLATE NEGOTIATING ON A BASIS SOMEWHERE MIDWAY BETWEEN THE EVENSEN TEXTS AND THE ICNT.

I COULD NOT RECOMMEND TO PRESIDENT CARTER THAT HE SUBMIT TO THE SENATE OF THE UNITED STATES FOR RATIFICATION A PROPOSED TREATY WHICH RESTED SOMEWHERE BETWEEN THOSE TWO DOCUMENTS, NOR WOULD THE SENATE IN ANY CASE GIVE ITS ADVICE AND CONSENT TO SUCH A TREATY. I HOPE THEREFORE THAT YOU WILL APPRECIATE HOW IMPORTANT IT SEEMS TO US TO FIND A SUBSTANTIVE POINT OF DEPARTURE WHICH IS CLOSER TO AN EVENTUAL CONSENSUS THAN THE ONE WHICH WE NOW HAVE IN PROSPECT.

I HOPE THOSE ATTENDING THE GENEVA MEETING WILL SUPPORT AMERASINGHE IN TAKING CHARGE OF THE NEGOTIATIONS, CIRCULATING FORMULATIONS WHICH COULD HELP OVERCOME PROBLEMS IN THE ICNT, AND ORGANIZING WORKING GROUPS DURING THE INTERSESSIONAL PERIOD TO ASSIST IN PREPARING SUCH FORMULATIONS. THE GENEVA MEETING CAN GIVE A NEW IMPULSE TO OUR WORK. YOUR PARTICIPATION WILL BE VERY IMPORTANT. THE READINESS OF OUR COLLEAGUES TO REACH A CONSENSUS ON CONTRUCTIVE STEPS TO GET THE CONFERENCE MOVING WILL BE DIRECTLY RELEVANT TO THE RECOMMENDATIONS I MAKE TO PRESIDENT CARTER ON CONTINUED US PARTICIPATION. I HOPE I WILL HAVE THE PLEASURE OF RENEWING OUR ASSOCIATION IN GENEVA. WITH WARM REGARD. SINCERELY, ELLIOT L.
RICHARDSON. . VANCE

WE REMAIN SOMEWHAT CONFUSED BY SUBJECT REQUEST AND WOULD APPRECIATE FURTHER CLARIFICATION FROM EMBASSY CONCERNING IRANIAN INTEREST IN ASSISTANCE IN FIELD OF CIVIL MOBILIZATION. WE ARE PREPARED, IN THE MEANTIME AND SUBJECT TO AMBASSADOR'S CONCURRENCE, TO ARRANGE ONE OR TWO APPOINTMENTS FOR HIM DURING HIS FORTHCOMING STAY IN WASHINGTON.

REFLETTER STATES IRANIAN CONCERN IS NOT WITH THE AREAS COVERED BY FPA, BUT RATHER WITH THE FIELD OF MOBILIZATION. BOTH DOD AND FPA NOTE THAT THE CONCEPT OF CIVIL MOBILIZATION IS COMPRISED OF EXACTLY THE AREASADDRESSED BY THE FPA EFFORT IN IRAN. THERE IS NO FIELD OF CIVIL "MOBILIZATION" AS DISTINCT FROM THOSE PARTICULAR SUBJECT AREAS. INDUSTRIAL PREPAREDNESS AND MANPOWER EFFORTS USUALLY CARRY THE TITLES INDUSTRIAL MOBILIZATION AND MANPOWER MOBILIZATION, IN FACT, AND MARVIN IS AN EXPERT OF LONG STANDING IN THE FORMER FIELD.

FPA REVEALS THAT THE IRANIANS HAVE BEEN INTERESTED IN MOBILIZATION - PRIMARILY CIVILIAN, BUT AS IT AFFECTS MILITARY CAPABILITIES-FOR TWO OR THREE YEARS. GENERAL BALDWIN ADVISED THEM TO REQUEST ASSISTANCE FROM THE MAAG, WHICH THEY DID. THEY WERE NOT SATISFIED WITH THE STUDY CONDUCTED BY THE MAAG, BUT WERE PLEASED WITH A COUPLE OF PAPERS BALDWIN HAD CONTRIBUTED TO THE EFFORT. THEY ASKED BALDWIN FOR ADDITIONAL ASSISTANCE, BUT HE, AGAIN, REFERRED THEM TO THE MAAG.

DOD'S OFFICE OF PRODUCTION RESOURCES, UNDER THE ASSISTANT SECRETARY OF DEFENSE FOR MANPOWER, RESERVE AFFAIRS, AND LOGISTICS, ADVISES THAT IF IT WERE TO RECEIVE A REQUEST, CHANNELED THROUGH THE MAAG, FOR ASSISTANCE, IT WOULD TURN TO FPA FOR OVERALL GUIDANCE ON ADDRESSING THOSE ASPECTS OF MOBILIZATION THAT ARE PRIMARILY CIVILIAN. USG LEGAL AUTHORITY IN THE AREA RUNS FIRST TO FPA AND THEN TO DOD, COMMERCE, AND OTHER INTERESTED AGECNIES.

BOTH FPA AND DOD ADVISE THAT FORMER FPA HEAD GENERAL BRAY (RET.) IS THE FIRST CHOICE FOR AN ADVISOR TO THE GOI. EVEN HE, HOWEVER, COULD NOT BE EXPECTED TO BE AN EXPERT ON ALL THE CATEGORIES OF CIVILIAN MOBILIZATION. IF THE GOI WANTS EXPERT ADVICE BELOW THE OVERALL PLANNING LEVEL, IT WILL HAVE TO TURN TO PERSONS WITH SPECIFIC CATEGORIES OF TECHNICAL EXPERTISE. GENERAL BRAY LIVES IN THE WASHINGTON, D.C. AREA: WE SHALL ATTEMPT TO SCHEDULE A MEETING FOR THE AMBASSADOR WITH HIM, IF YOU GIVE US THE GO-AHEAD.
GENERAL BALDWIN, WHO IS RETIRED AND LIVES IN WISCONSIN, COULD BE CONTACTED BY PHONE.

TWO OF THE MEN WHO WENT OUT TO MAKE THE INITIAL SURVEY FOR THE FPA, WHICH, APPARENTLY, THE EMBASSY AND THE GOI AGREE WAS A GOOD PRODUCT, LIVE IN THE WASHINGTON AREA. DR. HAAKON LINDJORD AND MR. EDWARD SAUNDERS, JR. ARE BOTH EX-ASSISTANT DIRECTORS OF FPA; WE CAN ATTEMPT TO SCHEDULE MEETINGS WITH ONE OR BOTH OF THEM IF AMBASSADOR WISHES.

WE DO NOT FEEL ADEQUATELY INFORMED RE GOI'S DESIRES TO APPROACH PRIVATE SECTOR INSTITUTIONS SUCH AS RAND CORP. TO PROVIDE A PROSPECTIVE ADVISOR FOR AMBASSADOR TO INTERVIEW. WE MAY BE IN A BETTER POSITION TO DO SO AFTER MEETING(S) WITH PERSON(S) SUCH AS GENERAL BRAY.
PLEASE ADVISE. VANCE

RE PARA 7 REFTEL, WHILE WE ARE AWARE THAT IRAQIS ARE SOURCE OF SOME ARMS (OF UNKNOWN QUANTITY) FOR SOMALIA, WE HAVE NO INFORMATION WHICH WOULD CONFIRM REPORTS OF IRAQI INVOLVEMENT IN OGADEN COMBAT. VANCE
FOR AMBASSADOR

AS YOU WILL RECOGNIZE, OUR EFFORTS IN NEW YORK, ABLY SUPPORTED BY GOI MISSION, TO OBTAIN ACCEPTABLE UN ANTIHIJACKING RESOLUTION HAVE DELAYED OUR RESPONSE TO KHALATBARY'S IDEA OF AN OPEN-ENDED ANTI-TERRORIST DOCUMENT TO BE SIGNED BY LIKE-MINDED GOVERNMENTS IN WHICH TERRORISM WOULD BE DEFINED AS A CRIME, ASYLUM WOULD BE DENIED TO ALL TERRORISTS, AND SIGNATORIES WOULD UNDERTAKE TO REFUSE TO NEGOTIATE WITH TERRORISTS. PLEASE CONVEY OUR REGRETS TO KHALATBARY AND EXPRESS OUR APPRECIATION FOR HIS THOUGHTFUL PROPOSALS WHICH INDEED REFLECT THE NECESSITY TO TAKE ADDITIONAL STEPS TO DEAL WITH THIS INTERNATIONAL PROBLEM.

IN WAKE OF REASONABLY SUCCESSFUL UN OUTCOME (E.G., AVOIDING ANY "NATIONAL LIBERATION" EXCEPTION) WE BELIEVE EFFORTS OF LIKE-MINDED GOVERNMENTS SHOULD BE DIRECTED TO ACHIEVING PRACTICAL RESULTS, NOTABLY WITH RESPECT TO INTERNATIONAL CIVIL AIR SAFETY STANDARDS THROUGH ICAO, AND WE HOPE UN RESOLUTION WILL STIMULATE FURTHER ACCESSIONS TO HAGUE AND MONTREAL CONVENTIONS. IN ADDITION, WE SEE CONTINUING UTILITY OF INFORMAL EXCHANGES AMONG GOVERNMENTS SEEKING COOPERATION AGAINST INTERNATIONAL TERRORISM, E.G., INTELLIGENCE SHARING AND RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT.

IN ADDITION TO EXPRESSING TO KHALATBARY OUR REGRETS RE DELAY IN RESPONSE, YOU SHOULD ALSO NOTE THAT WE IN GENERAL SUPPORT HIS CONCEPT BECAUSE IT WILL FOCUS FURTHER ATTENTION ON THE TERRORIST PROBLEM. AS HE RECOGNIZES, HOWEVER, NEGOTIATING A GENERALIZED SET OF PRINCIPLES WILL BE DIFFICULT AND TIME CONSUMING. IN ANY EVENT, WE WOULD NOT WISH PROPOSED INTERNATIONAL AGREEMENT TO DIVERT ATTENTION AT THIS TIME FROM KIND OF ACTIONS MENTIONED IN PARA TWO. WE WOULD APPRECIATE ANY INFORMATION ON REACTIONS OF OTHER AMBASSADORS WHO HAVE BEEN APPROACHED.

WE ASSUME KHALATBARY WILL ACCOMPANY HIM ON VISIT. SCHEDULE IS CROWDED, BUT, IF YOU BELIEVE IT WOULD BE USEFUL, YOU CAN TELL KHALATBARY THAT WE WILL, IF HE WISHES, SCHEDULE A MEETING AT APPROPRIATE LEVEL IN DEPARTMENT FOR GENERAL DISCUSSION OF SUBJECT. PLEASE
PLEASE BE IN TOUCH IMMEDIATELY WITH HIGHEST APPROPRIATE IRANIAN OFFICIAL TO HAVE THE FOLLOWING MESSAGE PASSED TO THE IRANIAN HEAD OF STATE FROM PRESIDENT CARTER.

BEGIN TEXT. YOUR IMPERIAL MAJESTY: I REGRET TO INFORM YOU THAT THE PRESS OF URGENT BUSINESS IN CONNECTION WITH THE CONGRESSIONAL CONSIDERATION OF MY ADMINISTRATION'S ENERGY PROGRAM OBLIGES ME TO POSTPONE MY VISIT TO YOUR COUNTRY. I ASK YOUR UNDERSTANDING FOR THIS DIFFICULT DECISION. THE CEMENTING OF THE CLOSE TIES BETWEEN OUR TWO COUNTRIES IS OF THE HIGHEST PRIORITY TO ME. HOWEVER, THE EXTREME IMPORTANCE OF THE PROPOSED ENERGY PROGRAM -NOT ONLY TO THE UNITED STATES, BUT INDEED TO ALL ENERGYPRODUCING AND ENERGY-CONSUMING COUNTRIES THROUGHOUT THE WORLD -- NECESSITATES MY STAYING IN WASHINGTON TO ENSURE ITS MANAGEMENT THROUGH THE CONGRESSIONAL PROCESS.

THE ENERGY LEGISLATION WHICH I HAVE PLACED BEFORE THE CONGRESS IS COMPLEX AND INVOLVES INTENSIVE PARLIAMENTARY DEBATE. WE ARE NEARING THE CLOSING STAGES OF THAT DEBATE, WHICH WILL REQUIRE MY PERSONAL INVOLVEMENT. I KNOW THAT MY POSTPONING THE VISIT TO YOUR COUNTRY WILL CAUSE PERSONAL INCONVENIENCE TO YOU AND TO YOUR SENIOR ADVISORS WHO HAVE WORKED TO HARD TO ENSURE THE TRIP'S SUCCESS. I AM, OF COURSE, STILL MOST ANXIOUS TO VISIT WITH YOU AND WILL BE IN TOUCH WITH YOU AS SOON AS I CAN TO TRY TO ARRANGE AN ACCEPTABLE DATE.

segments.text: BROAD LEGISLATION THAT WOULD HAVE PERMITTED ADDITIONAL FOREIGN STUDENTS AT USNA, BEYOND THOSE CURRENTLY AUTHORIZED IN TITLE 10, USC, WAS INTRODUCED IN THE 94TH CONGRESS IN JULY 1975 BUT NOT ACTED UPON. THIS WOULD HAVE PERMITTED QUALIFIED IRANIAN STUDENTS TO COMPETE WITH OTHER FOREIG STUDENTS FOR A LIMITED NUMBER OF SPACES. IT HAS NOT BEEN REINTRODUCED IN THE 95TH CONGRESS.
WE DO NOT BELIEVE THE TIME IS OPPORTUNE TO REOPEN THIS ISSUE OR TO PROPOSE SPECIFIC LEGISLATION TO SEEK ENTRY FOR IRANIANS ONLY. RATIONALE FYI IN PARA FOUR.
YOU MAY ADVISE GOI THAT WE WILL EXPLORE THE POSSIBILITY OF LEGISLATION AT AN OPPORTUNE TIME IN THE FUTURE AND ADVISE ACCORDINGLY.

FYI. NAVY IS PREPARING A LEGISLATIVE PROPOSAL TO PERMIT A LIMITED NUMBER OF SAUDI ARABIAN MIDSHIPMEN TO ATTEND USNA. THIS WOULD PROVIDE FIRST SUCH OPPORTUNITY FOR THE SAUDIS. PROPOSAL HAS STRONG DOD SUPPORT BUT IS BY NO MEANS CERTAIN TO ACHIEVE ENACTMENT. MILITARY JUSTIFICATION, POLITICAL DESIRABILITY, AND DIPLOMATIC SENSITIVITY ON THIS ISSUE, IN CASES OF BOTH IRAN AND SAUDI ARABIA, ARE WELL RECOGNIZED. HOWEVER, CURRENT ATTENDANCE BY IRANIAN MIDSHIPMEN AND UNCERTAIN CONGRESSIONAL RECEPTIVITY TO THE SAUDI PROPOSAL ARGUE AGAINST ACTIVE SPONSORSHIP OF IRANIAN LEGISLATION AT THIS TIME.

IN ADDITION, RECENT ADMISSION OF FEMALE MIDSHIPMEN IMPOSES NEW LIMITATION ON ALL SUCH PROGRAMS DUE TO RESULTING REDUCED NUMBER OF COMBAT ELIGIBLE USNA GRADUATES AVAILABLE TO FILL US OFFICER ACCESSION REQUIREMENTS. ACCORDINGLY, PICTURE IS BLEAK FOR ADDITIONAL IRANIAN ATTENDANCE IN IMMEDIATE FUTURE. WILL KEEP ALL CONCERNED ADVISED OF SIGNIFICANT DEVELOPMENTS ON THIS ISSUE. END FYI.

1977STATE289014.subject: MESSAGE FROM PRESIDENT CARTER TO THE SHAH

segments.text: PLEASE DELIVER FOLLOWING LETTER DATED NOV. 28 FROM PRESIDENT CARTER TO THE SHAH: BEGIN YOUR IMPERIAL MAJESTY: IT WAS A PERSONAL PLEASURE TO WELCOME YOU AND THE SHAHBANOU TO THE WHITE HOUSE. MRS. CARTER AND I HOPE THAT YOU ENJOYED YOUR STAY IN OUR COUNTRY. THANK YOU FOR THE BEAUTIFUL TAPESTRY PORTRAYING GEORGE WASHINGTON. WE WERE INTERESTED TO LEARN THAT THIS BICENTENNIAL GIFT TO THE AMERICAN PEOPLE TOOK TWO YEARS TO WEAVE AND THAT IT CONTAINS 120 TO 160 KNOTS PER SQUARE CENTIMETER. THIS HANGING SPLENDIDLY REFLECTS THE RENOWNED ARTISTIC CRAFTSMANSHIP OF THE WEAVERS OF ISFAHAN AND THE PEOPLE OF IRAN.

I APPRECIATED THE HONOR OF ESTABLISHING A CLOSE AND PERSONAL FRIENDSHIP WITH YOU. THE WISDOM OF YOUR ADVICE AND COUNSEL WILL BE MOST HELPFUL IN THE MONTHS TO COME. OUR DISCUSSIONS REAFFIRMED THE STRONG TIES WHICH OUR TWO COUNTRIES HAVE DEVELOPED OVER THE LAST 30 YEARS. THE RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN IRAN AND THE UNITED STATES PROMISES TO GROW AS WE WORK TOGETHER TO FURTHER OUR COMMON GOALS. YOU WERE INDEED THOUGHTFUL TO FAVOR US WITH THE BEAUTIFUL ORCHIDS AND TO WRITE SUCH A GRACIOUS NOTE UPON DEPARTING OUR COUNTRY. MRS. CARTER AND I LOOK FORWARD TO VISITING IRAN IN THE NEAR FUTURE. SINCERELY, JIMMY CARTER END .
ORIGINAL BEING POUCHED. VANCE

I DEEPLY REGRET THAT I WILL BE UNABLE TO TRAVEL TO TEHRAN TO BRIEF THE SHAH IN THE TIMEFRAME YOU PROPOSE. YOU MAY ASSURE THE COURT THAT ONLY THE MOST PRESSING NEGOTIATIONS HERE IN WASHINGTON PREVENT MY TRAVEL (FYI: US/USSR ARMS TRANSFER RESTRAINT FIRST ROUND).

GIVEN BOTH OUR SCHEDULES, I SUGGEST THAT YOU ATTEMPT TO SCHEDULE THE BRIEFING FOR "SOME TIME IN JANUARY", BUT AVOID FIRM DATES FOR THE PRESENT. I HOPE TO BE ABLE TO FOLLOW THEM WITH THE SHAH'S SALT BRIEFING, AND WILL ADVISE YOU AS SOON AS SCHEDULE FIRMS UP.

I GREATLY APPRECIATE YOUR EFFORTS TO FIND A SPOT ON THE SHAH'S CALENDAR, AND REALIZE IT IS NO SMALL THING TO TURN DOWN DATES OFFERED. YOU MAY WISH TO PASS ON THAT A JANUARY BRIEFING WOULD BE MORE UP-TO-DATE, AS IT WILL ENCOMPASS EVENTS YET TO COME. VANCE

1977STATE295486.subject: AMBASSADOR'S GOALS AND OBJECTIVES IN IRAN

segments.text: THIS TELEGRAM TRANSMITS A STATEMENT OF US FOREIGN POLICY GOALS AND OBJECTIVES IN IRAN. A SEPARATE MESSAGE WILL PROVIDE EXPLANATORY INFORMATION ON THE PURPOSE, IMPLEMENTATION AND REVIEW OF THESE STATEMENTS.
BEGIN TEXT. I. A SUSTAINED POLITICAL/ECONOMIC RELATIONSHIP BUILT UPON TRUST AND CONFIDENCE.
DEVELOP AND MAINTAIN A RELATIONSHIP OF TRUST AND CONFIDENCE WITH THE SHAH.

ASSESS THE RANGE OF EMBASSY CONTACTS IN THE IMPORTANT SEGMENTS OF IRANIAN SOCIETY AND INITIATE STEPS, IF NECESSARY, TO EXPAND RELATIONSHIPS, ALSO TAKING INTO ACCOUNT THE POSSIBLE OPPORTUNITIES PRESENTED BY THE NEW POLITICAL LIBERALIZATION IN IRAN.

WORK AS CLOSELY WITH PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR AND HIS CABINET AS THEY WILL PERMIT ;O ASSIST AND ADVISE THEM IN THETR EFFORTS TO CORRECT THE MOST SERIOUS IMBALANCES WHICH HAVE DEVELOPED IN THE LAST THREE YEARS. II. AN ENHANCED US-IRANIAN RELATIONSHIP IN NON-MILITARY FIELDS.

ENCOURAGE THE CONTINUATION OF A RELIABLE PETROLEUM SUPPLY FOR THE UNITED STATES AND ITS CLOSEST ALLIES AND THE ADOPTION OF A MODERATE PRICING POLICY. EXPLAIN U.S. ENERGY POLICIES AND PROGRAMS, AND THE NEED OF THE WORLD ECONOMY FOR OIL AT BEARABLE PRICES.

FACILITATE AN INCREASE IN THE UNITED STATES' SHARE OF THE MARKET IN IRAN AND BE PREPARED TO USE THE WEIGHT OF THE AMBASSADOR'S OFFICE IN SUPPORT, AT A MINIMUM, OF NONDISCRIMINATORY ACCESS BY AMERICAN FIRMS TO BUSINESS OPPORTUNITIES IN IRAN.
ASSESS HOW WE CAN MAKE THE U.S.-IRAN JOINT COMMISSION MORE EFFECTIVE, INCLUDING HOW TO INVOLVE THE U.S. PRIVATE SECTOR MORE FULLY.

WORK CLOSELY WITH THE SHAH AND DR. ETEMAD OF THE ATOMIC ENERGY ORGANIZATION OF IRAN TO FIND WAYS IN WHICH WE CAN MEET THE PRESIDENT'S NON-PROLIFERATION OBJECTIVES AND REACH A BILATERAL AGREEMENT WITH IRAN.
MAINTAIN U.S. INTELLIGENCE-GATHERING PRIVILEGES IN IRAN.
SUPPORT EFFORTS TO ENGAGE THE GOI MORE FULLY IN THE NARCOTICS PROGRAM FOR AFGHANISTAN.
IMPROVE PROCEDUR"S RELATED TO THE HEAVY DEMAND FOR U.S. COLLEGE EDUCATION BY IRANIAN STUDENTS AND COOPERATE AS APPROPRIATE IN THE DEVELOPMENT OF IRAN'S UNIVERSITY SYSTEM.
CONTINUE TO PRESS IRAN FOR FULL PAYMENT OF THE DELINQUENT SURPLUS PROPERTY DEBT. III. ; CAREFULLY COORDINATED MILITARY RELATIONSHIP INCLUDING THE MILITARY SUPPLY PROGRAM.
OPEN A CAREFUL DIALOGUE WITH THE SHAH ON HIS MILITARY NEEDS WITH THE AIM OF AVERTING UNESSENTIAL MILITARY SALES REQUESTS.
CAREFULLY SUPERVISE EXISTING AND ANTICIPATED FOREIGN MILITARY SALE CASES.

CLOSELY MONITOR ACTIVITIES OF THE REPRESENTATIVES OF U.S. ARMS MANUFACTURERS TO ENSURE THAT THEY ARE OBSERVING THE NEW REGULATIONS ON SALES PROMOTION AND SEEK WAYS TO REDUCE THE NUMBER OF U.S. DEFENSE-RELATED CONTRACTOR PERSONNEL IN IRAN TO THEIR ESSENTIAL NUMBERS.
MONITOR OUR MILITARY SUPPLY RELATIONSHIP TO ENSURE THAT LEGITIMATE IRANIAN DEFENSE NEEDS ARE MET WITHIN THE FRAMEWORK OF CURRENT ARMS TRANSFER GUIDELINES.
MAINTAIN U.S. OVERFLIGHT RIGHTS AND ACCESS TO IRANIAN PORTS FOR NAVAL SHIPS. IV. MAINTENANCE OF IRAN'S BALANCED POSTURE IN REGIONAL AFFAIRS.
ENCOURAGE IRAN'S BALANCED APPROACH TO ARAB-ISRAELI AFFAIRS AND ITS SUPPORT FOR OUR MIDDLE EAST PEACE NEGOTIATIONS.
ENCOURAGE THE MAINTENANCE OF A POSITIVE IRANIAN RELATIONSHIP WITH ISRAEL, INCLUDING AN OIL SUPPLY LINK.
MAINTAIN IRAN'S OPPOSITION TO PAKISTAN REPROCESSING.
SUPPORT SAUDI ARABIA-IRAN COOPERATION CONCERNING PERSIAN GULF SECURITY AND KEEP INFORMED, ALONG WITH IRAN, ON RELEVANT SECURITY DEVELOPMENTS AMONG IRAN'S NEIGHBORS.
ENCOURAGE IRAN TO SUPPORT OUR PRINCIPAL INITIATIVES IN AFRICA.
IMPROVEMENT IN IRAN'S HUMAN RIGHTS PERFORMANCE.

REVIEW WITH THE SHAH AND OTHERS, ON APPROPRIATE OCCASIONS, UNITED STATES HUMAN RIGHTS POLICIES. ENCOURAGE IMPROVEMENTS IN THE HUMAN RIGH;S SITUATION IN IRAN, FOR EXAMPLE, BY NOTING FAVORABLE POSITIVE DEVELOPMENTS AND BY EXPLAINING THE REPERCUSSIONS OF IRAN'S UNFAVORABLE HUMAN RIGHTS IMAGE.

YOU SHOULD APPROACH HOST GOVERNMENT AND ADVISE IT THAT WE HAVE INCONTROVERTIBLE EVIDENCE OF SHARP INCREASE OVER PAST TWO WEEKS IN SOVIET INTERVENTION IN OGADEN DISPUTE THROUGH MASSIVE, CONTINUING SOVIET AIRLIFT OF EQUIPMENT AND PERSONNEL INTO ADDIS ABABA. FACT THAT AN-12 AND AN-22 AIRCRAFT HAVE BEEN DISCHARGING MILITARY EQUIPMENT AT BOLE AIRPORT IS WIDELY KNOWN IN ADDIS. WHILE FLIGHT CLEARANCE REQUESTS HAVE APPARENTLY BEEN LISTING ADEN AS FINAL STOP, IT IS CLEAR THAT THESE FLIGHTS ARE ACTUALLY DESTINED FOR ADDIS ABABA.

INITIAL ROUTE TO ADEN USED BY FLIGHTS WAS OVER PAKISTAN VIA KARACHI. SUBSEQUENT FLIGHTS OVERFLEW IRAN AND UAE. THE MOST RECENT ROUTE USED APPEARS TO BE VIA BAGHDAD AND PRESUMABLY OVERFLIES TURKEY. FYI: MORE DETAILED REPORT FOR YOUR INFORMATION ONLY WILL BE SENT VIA OTHER CHANNELS. END FYI.

SOVIET MILITARY DELIVERIES TO ETHIOPIA HAVE INCLUDED LARGE QUANTITIES OF MODERN WEAPONS SUCH AS ARMOR, ARTILLERY AND HIGHLY SOPHISTICATED AIRCRAFT. NEW SOVIET COMMUNICATIONS FACILITIES HAVE BEEN SET UP NEAR THE ADDIS ABABA GOLF COURSE. THERE HAS BEEN A SIGNIFICANT INCREASE IN THE NUMBER OF SOVIET MILITARY ADVISERS IN ETHIOPIA.

AIM OF AIRLIFT IS UNDOUBTEDLY TO EQUIP ETHIOPIANS TO MOUNT RAPIDLY A COUNTEROFFENSIVE IN THE OGADEN TO BOLSTER THE POSITION OF PRO-SOVIET MENGISTU AND ALSO TO PREVENT CONSOLIDATION OF SOMALI POSITIONS. SOPHISTICATION OF SOME OF THE EQUIPMENT MEANS THAT MONTHS WILL BE REQUIRED BEFORE ETHIOPIANS CAN BE TRAINED TO USE THEM. RECENT INCREASE IN SOVIET AND CUBAN MILITARY PERSONNEL IN ETHIOPIA MAY BE DESIGNED PROVIDE MANPOWER SKILLED IN OPERATION OF SOPHISTICATED EQUIPMENT SO THAT COUNTEROFFENSIVE MAY START BEFORE ETHIOPIANS TRAINED.

SOVIETS MAY ARGUE THAT AIRLIFT IS OF INSIGNIFICANT PROPORTIONS AND IN ANY CASE IS DESIGNED ENABLE ETHIOPIA DEFEND ITS TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY. WHILE US FULLY ENDORSES PRINCIPLE OF TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY, WE CONSIDER SOVIET AIRLIFT AS NOT ONLY SIGNIFICANT BUT AS EGREGIOUS INTERFERENCE BY SUPERPOWER IN AFRICAN DISPUTE WHICH SHOULD BE LEFT TO AFRICANS THEMSELVES TO RESOLVE. SOVIET ACTION SUBVERTS ONGOING EFFORTS BY NIGERIANS AND OTHER AFRICANS TO REACH A NEGOTIATED SOLUTION THROUGH THE OAU.

YOU SHOULD INFORM HOST GOVERNMENT THAT WE CONSIDER FOREGOING CONSIDERATIONS STRONGLY ARGUE THAT THE SOVIET EFFORT SHOULD BE TERMINATED. WE ACCORDINGLY HOPE THAT HOST GOVERNMENT WILL NOT GRANT PERMISSION (OR ANY FURTHER PERMISSION) TO SOVIET AIRCRAFT TO OVERFLY ITS TERRITORY. YOU SHOULD SOLICIT HOST GOVERNMENT'S ADVICE ON METHODS TO STOP AIRLIFT AND/OR MAKE IT PUBLIC KNOWLEDGE (AS IT ALREADY IS IN ADDIS ABABA).

FOR ANKARA: YOU MAY REMIND GOT THAT IT TURNED DOWN US REQUEST TO OVERFLY TURKEY IN 1973 WHEN WE WANTED TO RESUPPLY ISRAEL. OUR INFORMATION ON THE SOVIET AIRLIFT INDICATES THAT DURING THE LAST TWO WEEKS AT LEAST TEN OF THE SOVIET TRANSPORTS INVOLVED IN THE SOVIET AIRLIFT TO ETHIOPIA HAVE TRANSITED TURKISH AIRSPACE BOTH ENROUTE TO AND RETURNING FROM ADEN/ADDIS. MOREOVER, ACCORDING TO OUR INFORMATION, TWO MORE SOVIET TRANSPORTS WILL OVERFLY TURKEY ENROUTE TO ADEN DECEMBER 15.
FOR TEHRAN: WE WOULD HAVE NO OBJECTIONS IF IRAN PER REF. B PLAYED A LEADING ROLE IN FRUSTRATING AIRLIFT EFFORT AND ASSOCIATED OTHER NATIONS WITH ITS COUNTERACTION. CHRISTOPHER UNQUOTE CHRISTOPHER".
