1977STATE301498.subject: BRIEFING ON PRIME MINISTER BEGIN VISIT

segments.text: THE FOLLOWING POINTS CAN BE USED TO BRIEF THE SHAH AND KING HASSAN ON PRIME MINISTER BEGIN'S VISIT TO WASHINGTON. (A) WE HAVE COMPLETED A FULL ROUND OF DISCUSSIONS WITH PRIME MINISTER BEGIN AND I WANT TO PROVIDE THE FOLLOWING REPORT ON WHERE MATTERS NOW STAND. (B) BEGIN BROUGHT WITH HIM TWO PROPOSALS TO DISCUSS WITH THE PRESIDENT, ONE DEALING WITH SINAI AND ONE WITH THE WEST BANK AND GAZA. BEGIN DID NOT ASK FOR OUR ENDORSEMENT OF HIS IDEAS, AND WE DID NOT SEE IT AS PART OF OUR ROLE AS MEDIATOR TO APPROVE OR DISAPPROVE.

WE DID TRY TO MAKE BEGIN SENSITIVE TO ARAB NEEDS AND TO URGE HIM TO BE FLEXIBLE IN HIS FORMULATIONS. (C) ON THE SPECIFIC PROPOSALS ON THE SINAI AND THE WEST BANK AND GAZA, THE PRESIDENT TOOK THE APPROACH OF POINTING OUT WHERE THEY WOULD NOT BE ACCEPTABLE TO ARAB NEGOTIATORS. IN THE SINAI, BEGIN IS CONSIDERING WITHDRAWAL OF ISRAELI FORCES TO THE PRE-1967 INTERNATIONAL BORDER, BUT THERE WILL HAVE TO BE FURTHER DISCUSSION BETWEEN HIM AND PRESIDENT SADAT ON THAT AND A NUMBER OF OTHER MATTERS, INCLUDING THE RELATIONSHIP OF THIS TO THE DECLARATION OF PRINCIPLES.

(D) BEGIN'S PROPOSALS FOR SELF-RULE FOR THE PALESTINIAN ARABS IN THE WEST BANK AND GAZA REPRESENT A SIGNIFICANT STEP FORWARD IN BEGIN'S THINKING, BUT DO NOT YET MEASURE UP TO WHAT ARAB NEGOTIATORS WOULD LIKE. AN IMPORTANT POINT THAT EMERGED FROM OUR DISCUSSIONS, HOWEVER, IS THAT BEGIN'S THINKING IS STILL VERY MUCH IN FLUX. HE IS TALKING ABOUT THE END OF MILITARY GOVERNMENT IN THE WEST BANK AND GAZA AND GOVERNMENT BY A LOCALLY ELECTED COUNCIL WHICH WOULD HAVE RESPONSIBILITY FOR THE NORMAL RANGE OF GOVERNMENTAL ACTIVITIES EXCEPT FOR EXTERNAL SECURITY.

WE SPENT A GOOD DEAL OF TIME WITH BEGIN AND WITH HIS ATTORNEY GENERAL PROBING THE THINKING BEHIND HIS PROPOSALS, AND WE FOUND BEGIN QUITE WILLING TO LISTEN AND TO CONSIDER FURTHER CHANGES TO MEET PROBLEMS ONCE THEY WERE IDENTIFIED FOR HIM. HE MADE IT EXPLICIT THAT THESE ARE PROPOSALS FOR DISCUSSION AND HE IS PREPARED TO ENTERTAIN OTHER SUGGESTIONS. IN OUR DISCUSSIONS, WE OPENED THE WAY FOR FURTHER CONSIDERATION OF JORDAN'S ROLE, OF THE RELATIONSHIP OF THESE PROPOSALS TO THE NEGOTIATING PROCESS, AND OF AN INTERNATIONAL SECURITY PRESENCE.

(E) WE EMPHASIZED THE IMPORTANCE OF PRESENTING HIS PROPOSALS AS A STARTING POINT FOR RESOLVING THE PALESTINIAN QUESTION, NOT AS THE TERMS FOR A FINAL SETTLEMENT. HE INDICATED A WILLINGNESS TO CONSIDER ALTERNATIVES, AND WILL BE ANXIOUS TO HEAR PRESIDENT SADAT'S REACTIONS. (F) BEGIN REMAINS COMMITTED TO THE IDEA OF A COMPREHENSIVE SETTLEMENT, BUT DOES NOT HAVE ANY SPECIFIC PROPOSALS TO OFFER SYRIA AT PRESENT SINCE SYRIA IS NOT ACTIVELY ENGAGED IN THE NEGOTIATIONS. HE DOES, HOWEVER, SAY THAT HE WANTS PEACE WITH ALL HIS NEIGHBORS. WE REITERATED OUR CONTINUED SUPPORT FOR A COMPREHENSIVE AGREEMENT AND A RECONVENING OF THE GENEVA CONFERENCE.

(G) IN SHORT, WE BELIEVE THERE CONTINUES TO BE AN OPPORTUNITY TO MOVE THE NEGOTIATIONS FORWARD. WHILE SOME OF BEGIN'S PROPOSALS ARE STILL EVOLVING, THEY DO OFFER SOMETHING TO SHAPE IN FURTHER DISCUSSIONS.
FOR TEHRAN: WE ARE AWARE OF PROPOSAL THAT ASSAD AND HUSSEIN MEET PRESIDENT CARTER IN TEHRAN. WE WILL BE BACK IN TOUCH AS SOON AS DECISION HAS BEEN MADE, HOPEFULLY EARLY IN THE WEEK.
FOLLOWING, FOR YOUR INFORMATION IS TEXT OF DECEMBER 15 1977 LETTER FROM THE SHAH TO THE SECRETARY, DELIVERED BY AMBASSADOR ZAHEDI.

BEGIN TEXT: DEAR MR. SECRETARY: THANK YOU VERY MUCH FOR YOUR MESSAGE OF DECEMBER 13, 1977 AND FOR LETTING ME HAVE A FIRST HAND ACCOUNT OF YOUR IMPRESSIONS OF YOUR CONTACTS AND TALKS IN YOUR TOUR OF CERTAIN MIDDLE EAST COUNTRIES. I FULLY SHARE YOUR VIEWS AND ENDEAVORS AIMED AT REACHING AN OVER-ALL PEACE SETTLEMENT IN THE AREA. MOREOVER, I BELIEVE THAT THIS IS THE MOST CRUCIAL TIME FOR ISRAEL TO SHOW WISDOM, DECISIVENESS AND COURAGE AS INDEED PRESIDENT SADAT HAS DONE. OBVIOUSLY, I CAN THINK OF MANY FACTORS AND ELEMENTS WHICH WILL TRY TO OPPOSE ALMOST DESPERATELY ANY PEACE IN THE REGION.
I CAN ONLY HOPE THAT THEY WILL NOT SUCCEED IN PREVENTING A JUST SETTLEMENT OF THIS PROBLEM WHICH HAS LASTED SINCE 1947. WITH BEST WISHES, SINCERELY, MOHAMMAD REZA PAHLAVI. . VANCE UNQUOTE VANCE

segments.text: I WANT YOU TO KNOW THAT I THINK HIGHLY OF KAZEMI AND ANTICIPATE THAT HE CAN PLAY A CONSTRUCTIVE ROLE IN THE COMING CRUCIAL MONTHS OF LOS NEGOTIATIONS. COURT CHIEF SHARAF CALLED SHORTLY AFTER 11:00 A.M. DECEMBER 26 TO TELL ME THAT HE HAS SPOKEN WITH KING WHO HAS EXPRESSED HIS PREFERENCE ON MEETINGS. KING SAID HE WILL OBVIOUSLY WANT A BILATERAL WITH THE SHAH AND WILL WANT A BILATERAL ALSO WITH PRESIDENT CARTER. IF, IN THE COURSE OF HIS DISCUSSIONS IN TEHRAN, A TRILATERAL MEETING SEEMS USEFUL OR REQUIRED, HE WOULD BE VERY MUCH WILLING TO HAVE ONE SET. HIS INCLINATION NOW IS TO LEAVE THE SETTING OF A TRILATERAL MEETING UNTIL DISCUSSIONS TAKE PLACE IN TEHRAN.

SHARAF TOLD ME HE HAD INFORMED IRANIAN AMBASSADOR. SHARAF SAID KING WAS OF COURSE VERY RELAXED, BUT DID NOTE THAT THERE WERE BILATERAL ISSUES AND QUESTIONS WITH IRAN AND THE U.S. WHICH WOULD BEST BE DISCUSSED BETWEEN THE TWO SIDES ALONE. IRANIAN HAS CONFIRMED TO ME THAT HE IS FORWARDING SAME INFORMATION TO TEHRAN, WHICH HE TOLD ME YESTERDAY HAS TAKEN A POSTURE OF WHATEVER HUSSEIN WANTS IS ALRIGHT WITH THE SHAH.

PRESUME THIS WILL OPEN THE WAY TO FIXING SCHEDULE. SHARAF DID NOT SEEM TO THINK THAT TRILATERAL MEETING COULD BE FIXED NOW AND RECOGNIZED THAT FLEXIBILITY IN THE SCHEDULE MIGHT NOT BE AVAILABLE TO RESCHEDULE IT AT A LATER TIME.
RECOMMEND DEPARTMENT REPEAT TEHRAN. PICKERING VANCE

UNSUBSTANTIATED INFORMATION HAS BEEN RECEIVED THAT IRANIAN STUDENTS MAY CONDUCT DEMONSTRATIONS AND/OR ATTEMPT A TAKEOVER OF AN IRANIAN OR U.S. INSTALLATION IN EUROPE DURING PRESIDENT CARTER'S VISIT TO TEHRAN. POSTS URGED TO EXERCISE VIGILANCE AND TAKE APPROPRIATE SECURITY PRECAUTIONS DURING THIS TIME PERIOD, PARTICULARLY POSTS WITH SIGNIFICANT IRANIAN POPULATIONS OR POSTS WHICH EXPERIENCED DEMONSTRATIONS DURING THE SHAH'S RECENT VISIT TO THE U.S.
ALL INTELLIGENCE CONTACTS AVAILABLE TO SY/CC HAVE BEEN CHECKED AND THERE IS NO REPEAT NO INTELLIGENCE TO SUBSTANTIATE THIS INFORMATION. CHRISTOPHER

MR. VINCENT PUGLISI OF FAA MET WITH DEPUTY GOVERNOR OF ISTANBUL/AIRPORT SECURITY HALIT BEY ON JUNE 1. THERE HAD BEEN TWO EXPLOSIONS FIFTEEN MINUTES APART. FIRST WAS AT EUROPEAN SIDE OF ISTANBUL RAILROAD STATION. SECOND WAS AT ARRIVAL (LOWER) LEVEL OF YESILKOY AIRPORT TERMINAL. BOTH EXPLOSIONS OCCURRED IN LEFT LUGGAGE STORAGE OFFICES.
EXPLOSION AT AIR TERMINAL OCCURRED NEAR BOTH ARRIVAL AND DEPARTURE GATES.
IMPACT AT AIRPORT LARGE ENOUGH TO SEVERELY DAMAGE FLOOR OF UPPER LEVEL PASSENGER SCREENING DEPARTURE AREA, AS WELL AS UPPER LEVEL DIRECTLY ABOVE LEFT LUGGAGE OFFICE.
LOCAL OFFICIALS ESTIMATE USE OF PLASTIC EXPLOSIVE AND THAT IT PROBABLE A WELL ORGANIZED GROUP WAS INVOLVED AND THE TWO EXPLOSIONS WERE LINKED.

MFA HEAD OF 4TH POLITICAL DIVISION GOODARZI TOLD DCM JUNE 8 THAT MFA HAD A REPORT FROM ITS AMBASSADOR TO YAR THAT PRESIDENT AL-HAMDI IS BECOMING INCREASINGLY TROUBLED AND FRUSTRATED IN ATTEMPTING TO COPE WITH INTERNAL SITUATION. ALLEGEDLY OUT OF THIS FRUSTRATION HE IS TURNING TO THE LEFT AND GIVING COMMUNIST-ORIENTED INDIVIDUALS AND/OR GROUPS GREATER SCOPE AND FREEDOM IN THEIR ACTIVITES ON THE LOCAL SCENE. GOODARZI SAID FOREIGN MINISTER WANTED TO KNOW IF WE HAD HEARD ANYTHING ON THIS SCORE. DCM SAID HE HAD NOTHING RECENTLY ON INTERNAL SITUATION IN YAR BUT WOULD ASK WHETHER DEPARTMENT OR EMBASSY SANA HAD ANYTHING WE COULD PASS ON TO GOI.
PLEASE ADVISE.

FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY CALLED DCM JUNE 9 TO SAY THAT WHEN THE NEW PRC AMBASSADOR PRESENTED HIS CREDENTIALS TO THE SHAH THAT MORNING HE CLAIMED THAT IT WAS HIS AND HIS GOVERNMENTS VIEW THAT THE COUP IN THE SEYCHELLES WAS SOVIET INSPIRED AND BACKED. KHALATBARY SAID THAT, OF COURSE, BLAMING THE SOVIETS FOR ANYTHING THAT THEY DID NOT LIKE WAS PART OF THE STANDARD PRC LINE BUT THOUGHT WE WOULD LIKE TO KNOW THAT IT CAME UP ANYHOW. HE ADDED THAT THE SHAH HAD NOT EXPRESSED ANY OPINION.

IT IS POSSIBLE IN THE CONTEXT OF THE SHAH'S WORRIES ABOUT SOVIETS' MACHINATIONS IN AFRICA AND IN THE INDIAN OCEAN GENERALLY, HE WILL ASK ME ABOUT THIS WHEN I SEE HIM AT THE END OF NEXT WEEK. WOULD APPRECIATE ANY COMMENTS THE DEPARTMENT THINKS I MIGHT USEFULLY MAKE SHOULD THE SUBJECT COME UP.

1977TEHRAN05221.subject: PAKISTAN-IRAN/AFGHAN RELATIONS MFA DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR POLITICAL AFFAIRS (ASIA AND AFRICA) NAYERI CALLED DCM AND REFERRED TO A RECENT STATEME

segments.text: MFA DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR POLITICAL AFFAIRS (ASIA AND AFRICA) NAYERI CALLED DCM AND REFERRED TO A RECENT STATEMENT PRESIDENT DAUD WAS ALLEGED TO HAVE MADE IN AN INTERVIEW WITH THE EDITOR OF "BUSINESS TIMES" OF LONDON ABOUT PAK-AFGHAN RELATIONS AND A COMMENT TO THE EFFECT THAT PAKHTOON AND BALUCHI PROBLEMS MUST BE SETTLED BETWEEN THEM. NAYERI SAID THAT HE WANTED TO REGISTER WITH US, AS IT HAS BEEN REGISTERED IN ISLAMABAD, KABUL AND LONDON, THAT ANY QUESTIONS REGARDING THE BALUCHIS AND BALUCHISTAN WERE MATTERS BETWEEN IRAN AND PAKISTAN. IRAN WOULD NOT COUNTENENCE INTERFERENCE OR GRATUITOUS COMMENT ON THIS SUBJECT BY OTHER PARTIES.

NAYERI SAID THAT HE DID NOT EXPECT US TO DO ANYTHING ABOUT THIS BUT JUST WANTED TO BE CERTAIN THAT WE UNDERSTOOD GOI'S POSITION SHOULD THE QUESTION COME UP AT SOME TIME IN THE FUTURE. COMMENT: THIS IS, OF COURSE, FURTHER EVIDENCE OF IRAN'S ALREADY WELL-KNOWN SENSITIVITY ON ANY QUESTION CONNECTED WITH BALUCHISTAN OR IMPLICATION THAT IS IS A MATTER FOR OUTSIDE INTERVENTION.

1977TEHRAN05223.subject: LETTER TO PRESIDENT REGARDING RELIGIOUS ASSASSINS

segments.text: EMBASSY HAS RECEIVED NOTE ADDRESSED TO AMBASSADOR CONTAINING COPY OF LETTER SUPPOSEDLY SENT DIRECTLY TO PRESIDENT CARTER (COPIES BEING POUCHED NEA/IRN) REGARDING 13 INDIVIDUALS GIVEN DEATH AND PRISON SENTENCES FOR ASSASSINATION OF PROMINENT ISFAHAN AYATOLLAH SHAMSABADI (REFTEL).

LETTER DESCRIBES CONDEMNATION OF "CLERGYMEN" AND IS SIGNED "THE RELIGIOUS COMMUNITY OF ISFAHAN", BUT DOES NOT MENTION ASSASSINATION FOR WHICH GROUP WAS TRIED AND FOUND GUILTY IN CIVIL COURT. ADVANCED DISINGENUITY OF THIS EFFORT BY RELIGIOUS RIGHT WING TO INVOLVE US IN PHONEY HUMAN RIGHTS ISSUE SUGGESTS PERHAPS GROUP'S IRAQI FRIENDS. COPY OF LETTER ALSO SENT TO EMBASSY DAMASCUS AS WELL, WHICH FORWARDED IT TO US.

1977TEHRAN05337.subject: MILITARY COURT REFORM LEGISLATION SUBMITTED TO MAJLES

segments.text: BEGIN UNCLASSIFIED
ON JUNE 14, DEP MIN OF WAR FOR PARLIAMENTARY AFFAIRS LT GEN KATOOZIAN SUBMITTED WIDE-RANGING MILITARY COURT REFORM BILL TO MJLES.

BILL CALLS FOR AMENDMENT OF MILITARY AND JIDICIAL PENAL CODES IN THE CASE OF CIVILIANS CHARGED TO PROVIDE FOR A) COMPLETION OF PRELIMINARY QUESTIONING BY INTERROGATING MAGISTRATE AND CHARGING OR RELEASE WITHIN TWENTYFOUR HOURS PLUS RELATING OF BAIL TO SERIOUSNESS OF CRIME; B) SELECTION OF CIVILIAN LAWYER FROM QUALIFIED MEMBERS OF IRANIAN BAR, AND "TOTAL FREEDOM" IN DEFENSE ARGUMENTS BY BOTH MILITARY AND CIVILIAN LAWYERS; C) OPEN TRIAL BY MILITARY TRIBUNALS EXCEPT WHEN MILITARY PROSECUTOR DECIDES THIS WOULD BE AGAINST "BEST INTERESTS OF STATE OR MORAL STANDARDS", IN WHICH CASE HE WILL SEEK TRIAL CLOSURE AND TRIBUNAL MUST RULE WHETHER TO GRANT IT OR NOT; AND D) PERMITTING DEFENSE SIDE TO REQUEST TRIBUNAL GRANT 15-DAY GRACE PERIOD FOR STUDY OF CHARGES PRIOR TO TRIAL.

EFFECT OF LEGISLATION WOULD BE TO GUARANTEE TO CIVILIANS TRIED FOR NATIONAL SECURITY CRIMES MOST OF BASIC RIGHTS THEY WOULD HAVE UNDER CIVIL TRIAL. BILL CAUSING CONSIDERABLE FAVORABLE COMMENT HERE. WHILE LEGISLATION DOES NOT DIRECTLY ADDRESS QUESTION OF FOREIGN OBSERVERS, INITIAL SOUNDING INDICATE WORING OF BILL'S (ROUGH TRANSLATION BEING POUCHED DEPT) OPENESS PROVISION WOULD ACCOMPLISH THIS AS WELL. PROPOSAL WILL BE STUDIES IN MAJLES JUSTICE COMMITTEE, AND IF APPROVED, PASSED TO SENATE FOR STUDY AND APPROVAL. GOI GOAL IS PASSAGE OF FINAL LEGISLATION BEFORE PARLIAMENTARY RECESS IN EARLY JULY. END UNCLASSIFIED BEGIN CONFIDENTIAL

FIRST READING INDICATES LOCAL LEGAL OFFICIALS BELIEVE GOI IS SERIOUS ON REFORMS. SUBSTANCE OF REFORMS REFLECT MORE FLEXIBLE GOI POSTURE TOWARD ANTI-SECUIRTY CASES AS WELL AS MORE SENSITIVITY TO RIGHTS OF DEFENDANTS. LOCAL HUMAN RIGHTS-MINDED LAWYERS ARE VERY PLEASED INDEED AT THIS MOVE. WELL-PLACED MAJLES SOURCE INFORMED EMBOFF LEGISLATIVE PROCESS LIKELY TO ENCOMPASS ONLY MINOR AMENDMENTS AND UNLESS UNUSUAL (AND UNEXPECTED) SNAG SURFACES, REFORMS SHOULD BE UNDERWAY BY MIDSUMMER.

WE UNDERSTAND BILL HAD APPROVAL OF HIGHEST LEVELS OF GOI, WAS EXTENSIVELY REVIEWED IN PRIMINS OFFICE AND IS POSITIVE GOI ATTEMPT TO MEET CRITICISMS LEVELED AT GOI HANDLING OSECURITY-RELATED CASES OVER PAST TWO YEARS BY NUMBER OF OBSERVERS. IN THIS CONNECTION, DEPT MAY WISH INFORM ICJS WILLIAM BUTLER OF PROPOSED CHANGES, WHICH FOLLOW VERY CLOSELY AND EVEN GO SOMEWHAT BEYOND PROGRAM SHAH OUTLINE TO BUTLER DURING THEIR MAY 30 TALKS.

1977TEHRAN05357.subject: BILATERAL AGREEMENT ON BRIBERY REPORTED SIGNED

segments.text: RECENT AP TICKER ITEM REPORTED JUNE 14 SIGNING OF INFORMATION EXCHANGE AGREEMENT ON BRIBERY CASES BY U.S. DEP ASST ATTNY GEN KEENEY AND IRANIAN MINJUSTICE UNSEC GUITY. JUNE 18 LOCAL PRESS PLAY BASED ON MINJUSTICE REPORT WHICH SAYS AGREEMENT IS TO INVESTIGATE U.S. COMPANIES IN IRAN.
ASSUME AGREEMENT IS STANDARD BILATERAL AS OUTLINED BY AP, BUT WOULD APPRECIATE FULL TEXT OF REPORTED AGREEMENT ASAP, SINCE EMB HAS ALREADY HAD REQUEST FOR COPIES.

IN DISCUSSING HIS "EASTERN PROBLEM" DURING MY JUNE 18 AUDIENCE, THE SHAH EXPRESSED GREAT CONCERN ABOUT THE FUTURE OF PAKISTAN, INDIA, AND AFGHANISTAN. HIS MOST IMMEDIATE WORRY IS PAKISTAN AND HE EXPECTS TO DISCUSS HIS CONCERNS WITH BHUTTO WHEN LATTER VISITS TEHRAN JUNE 21. BUT, IN GENERAL, HE ADDS UP ALL THIS REGION TO A GROWING CAUSE OF TROUBLE FOR IRAN AND, OF COURSE, HE PARLAYS THIS FUTURE TROUBLE INTO THE NEED FOR FURTHER MILITARY EQUIPMENT TO PROTECT HIS EASTERN REGIONS.

HE WAS HARSH IN HIS CONDEMNATION OF BHUTTO. HE SAID THE TINKERING WITH THE ELECTION BY "HIS PEOPLE" WAS NEEDLESS. HE WOULD HAVE WON 70 PER CENT IN AN HONEST ELECTION. HIS INVECTIVE AGAINST THE US WAS RIDICULOUS AND DAMAGING TO THE REGION. HIS DESIRE FOR A REPROCESSING PLANT WAS STUPID; "WHAT WOULD HE DO WITH TWO OR THREE SILLY BOMBS?"

AND YET, HE FELT BHUTTO WAS FAR BETTER THAN THE ALTERNATIVES. IF THE OPPOSITION WINS THE NEXT ELECTION, IT WILL SOON SPLIT UP BETWEEN THOSE WHO WISH TO CARRY PAKISTAN BACK THREE CENTURIES AND THOSE WHO WANT SOCIALISM. THE PROSPECT IS FRAGMENTATION. EVEN IF BHUTTO SHOULD WIN THE NEXT ELECTION, THE RESULTS MAY BE THE SAME BECAUSE FEELINGS ARE SO INFLAMED. HE DOES NOT KNOW WHAT BHUTTO WANTS IN HIS COMING VISIT. (HIS CHILDREN TRANSITED TEHRAN JUNE 17 HEADING WEST.) HE WILL LET ME KNOW IF THE INTERVIEW PRODUCES ANYTHING.

AS FOR INDIA, HE BELIEVES THE CONGRESS PARTY IS DEAD AND THAT MAY BE THE END OF CENTRAL AUTHORITY ("HOW CAN YOU GOVERN A NATION WITH 168 RELIGIONS?"). DESAI IS SOUND AND CONCILIATORY. HE IS WILLING TO DISCUSS THE SHAH'S PROJECT FOR AN INDIAN OCEAN COMMON MARKET (I HAD NEVER HEARD OF THIS ONE BEFORE). HE IS NOT SENILE, BUT HE IS WEAK. HIS JANATA PARTY IS A MISHMASH. BENGAL VOTED COMMUNIST. KERALA HAS ALREADY GONE. THE PROSPECTS FOR INDIA ARE ALSO FRAGMENTATION.

AS FOR AFGHANISTAN, HE IS ANNOYED. HE HAS BEEN OVERLY GENEROUS WITH KABUL. HE HAS GIVEN THEM ALL THEY WANT. BUT THEY RESPOND BY AGITATING THE BALUCHISTAN QUESTION. THIS IS MISCHIEVOUS AND CAN ONLY REFLECT SOVIET INSPIRATION. THE SOVIET HOLD ON KABUL IS INSIDIOUS. DAOUD MAY BE A WILY OLD FOX WHO CAN DEAL WITH MOSCOW BUT HIS SUCCESSORS, PARTICULARLY IN THE ARMY, HAVE ALL BEEN TRAINED IN RUSSIA. THEY WILL BE WILLING DUPES FOR THE RUSSIAN IMPERIAL DRIVE TO THE SEA OF OMAN.

HE MUST MAKE US GRASP THE NATURE OF THE PROBLEM ON IRAN'S EASTERN FRONTIER. THE STRANGULATION OF ALL OIL TO EUROPE AND JAPAN IS POTENTIALLY IN RUSSIA'S REACH. HOW COULD THE US COPE WITH SUCH A THRUST? WE COULD NOT THINK OF SENDING US FORCES TO STOP A DRIVE THROUGH BALUCHISTAN. IRAN MUST HAVE THE CAPABILITY TO PARADROP ONE DIVISION (SIC) INTO THAT AREA AND SUPPORT IT. THIS IS WHY HE NEEDS THE AMST AIRCRAFT TO REPLACE THE C-130. THIS IS WHY HE NEEDS THE NAVAL FORCES HE IS ACQUIRING AND THE AWACS TO CONTROL SUCH OPERATIONS IN THE WILDEST PART OF HIS COUNTRY.
I TOLD THE SHAH THAT I WAS FRANKLY IGNORANT ABOUT THIS WHOLE ARRAY OF PROBLEMS AND THAT HE WOULD HAVE TO EDUCATE ME BEFORE I COULD REACT INTELLIGENTLY TO HIS RECITAL. HE UNDERTOOK GLADLY TO DO SO.
COMMENT: ANY GUIDANCE ON THIS SUBJECT WOULD BE WELCOME.

1977TEHRAN05380.subject: INITIAL MEETING OF US-SOVIET WORKING GROUP IN THE INDIAN OCEAN

segments.text: SULTED AND KEPT INFORMED AT FREQUENT INTERVALS AS WE MOVE ALONG. THIS EXPECTATION ARISES OUT OF CONVERSATIONS THE SHAH HAD WITH SECY VANCE AND CHAIRMAN OF THE JOINT CHIEFS GEN BROWN DURING THEIR RECENT VISITS TO TEHRAN. WE NOTE FROM REFTEL THAT WE HAVE ALREADY CONSULTED WITH AND SOUGHT THE VIEWS OF CERTAIN COUNTRIES INCLUDING INDIA AND NEW ZEALAND, BUT THAT IRAN WAS NOT INCLUDED IN THIS EXERCISE. WE BELIEVE IT IMPORTANT THAT WE FULFILL OUR FAIRLY EXPLICIT COMMITMENT TO THE SHAH AND NOT ON EX POST FACTO BASIS AS REFTEL IMPLIES.

ACCORDINGLY, WOULD APPRECIATE IMMEDIATE AUTHORIZATION TO DISCUSS THE SUBJECT AS OUTLINED IN REFTEL AND ANY ADDITIONAL INFORMATION OR GUIDANCE THAT MAY HAVE BEEN USED IN DISCUSSIONS WITH THE COUNTRIES MENTIONED IN PARA 3 OF REFTEL. WOULD ALSO APPRECIATE BEING KEPT INFORMED OF IMPORTANT DEVELOPMENTS AND/OR DECISIONS THAT MAY ENSUE FROM US-USSR BILATERAL WHICH WE MAY PASS ON TO GOI.

1977TEHRAN05392.subject: IRAN ACCORDS RECOGNITION TO DJIBOUTI BEGIN UNCLASSIFIED

segments.text: BEGIN UNCLASSIFIED

ENGLISH LANGUAGE PRESS JUNE 16 CARRIED MFA ANNOUNCEMENT IRAN WILL BE AMONG FIRST COUNTRIES TO RECOGNIZE DJIBOUTI WHEN IT BECOMES INDEPENDENT JULY 1 AND IRAN WILL OPEN A CONSULAR OFFICE THERE SHORTLY. END UNCLASSIFIED BEGIN LIMITED OFFICIAL USE

MFA SOURCE WAS NOT AUTHORIZED TO ELABORATE ON NEWSPAPER COVERAGE. COMMENT: IT APPEARS CONSULAR OFFICE WILL NOT OPEN UNTIL AFTER JULY 1. IN RESPONSE TO DIRECT QUESTION, MFA SOURCE SAID THAT IRAN HAS "NO REPRESENTATIVES" IN DJIBOUTI NOW. MFA RELUCTANCE TO ELABORATE MAY INDICATE THAT PLANS NOT BEYOND FORMATIVE STAGE. END COMMENT END LIMITED OFFICIAL USE.

DURING JUNE 18 AUDIENCE, SHAH SAID, IN PASSING, THAT THERE WERE ABOUT 5-6,000 COMMUNISTS IN IRAN. HE WAS GIVIING SOME CONSIDERATION TO POSSIBILITY OF MAKING COMMUNIST PARTY LEGAL. HOWEVER, HE DOUBTED THEY WOULD BE WILLING TO PLAY POLITICS BY LOCAL GROUND RULES AND WOULD PROBABLY CONTINUE CLANDESTINE ACTIVITY.

I ASKED WHETHER THE CURRENT CROP OF COMMUNISTS WERE REMNANTS OF THE OLD TUDEH PARTY OR WHETHER THEY WERE NEW RECRUITS. HE SAID THAT THE TUDEH WERE ALL GONE AND THAT THE NEW RECRUITS CAME LARGELY FROM STUDENTS WHO HAD RETURNED FROM EUROPE AND THE US. I SAID I DOUBTED THOSE WHO CAME FROM THE US HAD ANY DEEP ORGANIZATIONAL CONNECTIONS AND WOULD MORE LIKELY BE MARXIST FADDISTS. HE SAID WITH A SMILE THAT MAYBE HALF OF THEM WERE CIA "PENETRATION AGENTS" ANYWAY. I SAID I WOULD FEEL MORE COMFORTABLE IF I THOUGHT THAT WERE TRUE.

THIS LED TO A DISCUSSION OF IRANIAN STUDENTS IN THE US. HE THOUGHT WE HAD ABOUT 15,000 IN AMERICAN INSTITUTIONS. I SAID WE THOUGHT THE NUMBER WAS AT LEAST TWICE THAT, AND THAT MANY WERE IN OBSCURE COLLEGES OF QUESTIONABLE ACADEMIC MERIT. I HOPED WE COULD DO A LITTLE MORE TO PROVIDE COUNSELING FOR POTENTIAL STUDENTS BEFORE THEY LEFT FOR THE US AND SAID THAT WE WOULD BE TALKING WITH HIS MINISTERS ABOUT ARRANGEMENTS TO IMPROVE ON HANDLING OF THEM. THE SHAH AGREED WITHTHIS OBJECTIVE, "ASSUMING, OF COURSE, THAT YOU DO NOT VIOLATE THEIR HUMAN RIGHTS."

COMMENT: MY INITIAL REACTION TO MY FIRST OBSERVATIONS HERE AND IN WASHINGTON IS THAT NEITHER THE US NOR THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT HAS TAKEN ADEQUATE MEASURES TO COPE WITH THE STUDENT PHENOMENON. IT IS MY ESTIMATE THAT IT WILL BE WITH US IN LARGE DIMENSIONS FOR THE NEXT 20 YEARS AND WE NEED TO HAVE SOME MORE IMAGINATIVE APPROACHES TO THE SUBJECT. EMBASSY WILL SHORTLY SUBMIT SOME PROPOSALS.
EMB TEHRAN RECEIVED TODAY COPY OF CABLE FROM HIS EXCELLENCY E FARAHBAKHSHIAN, MINISTER OF ROADS AND TRANSPORTATION, TO SECY. TEXT FOLLOWS.

. HONORABLE CYRUS E VANCE, DEPARTMENT OF STATE, WASHINGTON, DC 20520. DEAR MR SECRETARY: IN REPLY TO YOUR TELEX DATED MAY 28TH 1977 CONCERNING THE AMERICAN FEDERAL HIGHWAYS ADMINISTRATION CONTRACT EXTENSION, REGRET TO ADVISE; AFTER NECESSARY STUDY AND CONSIDERATION BY THIS MINISTRY, IT WAS DECIDED BY THE DEPUTIES' COUNCIL NOT TO RENEW THE CONTRACT FOR TECHNICAL COLLABORATION WITH AMERICAN FEDERAL HIGHWAYS ADMINISTRATION. WE APPRECIATE THE COLLABORATION WHICH RESULTED DURING FULFILLMENT OF CONTRACT. (S) E FARAHBAKHSHIAN, MINISTER OF ROADS AND TRANSPORTATION. UNQUOTE.
ABOVE CABLE IS INTENDED BY MINISTER FARAHBAKHSHIAN AS REPLY TO ADMINISTRATOR COX'S LETTER OF MAY 28 (REFTEL). EMB WOULD APPRECIATE CONFIRMATION FROM DEPT THAT COMMERCIAL CABLE RECEIVED.

MINISTRY OF ROADS AND TRANSPORTATION (MORT) HAS BEEN ENCOUNTERING BUDGETARY DIFFICULTIES FOR SOME TIME. FUNDS ALLOTTED FOR SPECIAL PROJECTS, WHICH INCLUDE FHWA CONTRACT, ARE INSUFFICIENT TO MEET DEMANDS FOR CURRENT IRANIAN FISCAL YEAR. LAST MINUTE ATTEMPTS BY MINISTRY TO OBTAIN APPROVAL FROM PLAN AND BUDGET ORGANIZATION FOR ADDITIONAL FUNDS HAVE BEEN UNSUCCESSFUL. THERE MAY BE SOME DIFFICULTIES IN MINISTRY MEETING FINAL COSTS OF CLOSING OUT FHWA TEAM. UNDER CURRENT BUDGETARY RESTRICTIONS RENEWAL OF FHWA/MORT CONTRACT IS IMPOSSIBLE.
FHWA TEAM WILL DEPART TEHRAN AS SOON AS DETAILS OF DEPARTURE CAN BE ARRANGED.

REFTEL REPORTED THAT GOVERNMENT OF IRAN HAS INTRODUCED LEGISLATION IN PARLIAMENT DESIGNED TO MODIFY AND REFORM SIGNIFICANTLY THE MILITARY AND PENAL CODES IN THE INSTANCE OF CIVILIANS CHARGED BEFORE A MILITARY COURT. THESE AMENDMENTS, IN ENACTED, WILL GO A LONG WAY TO MEET THE DEMANDS OF MANY HUMAN RIGHTS ADVOCATES BOTH WITHIN IRAN AND IN FOREIGN COUNTRIES.

ONE WOULD HAVE EXPECTED THAT THE GOI, CONCERNED ABOUT ITS IMAGE PROBLEM IN THE U.S. AND U.K., WOULD HAVE MADE SOMETHING OF A PUBLICITY SPLASH ON THIS DEVELOPMENT, ESPECIALLY DIRECTED TO FOREIGN WIRE SERVICES. INSTEAD, THE GOI INFORMATION SOURCES GAVE A PERFUNCTORY BRIEFING ONLY TO THE LOCAL PRESS SOURCES, WHICH PLAYED THE STORY IN MODEST TERMS IN THE LOCAL PRESS. A PERFUNCTORY TWO OR THREE PARAGRAPH FILE ITEM WAS ALL THAT IT MERITED ON THE WIRE SERVICES. IT IS DOUBTFUL THAT IT ATTRACTED MUCH ATTENTION IN THE US OR UK.

IN ORDER TO MEASURE GOI SENSITIVITY TO THEIR INDADEQUATE PERFORMANCE, I ASKED MY INFORMATION OFFICER TO MAKE INNOCENT INQUIRY OF THE VICE MINISTER OF INFORMATION ABOUT HIS PLANS FOR HANDLING THE SUBJECT. IT EMERGED FROM THIS CONVERSATION THAT THE VICE MINISTER WAS TOTALLY UNAWARE THAT A DRAFT BILL HAD BEEN SUBMITTED TO THE MAJLES. HE, NATURALLY, HAD NO PLANS FOR PUBLICITY, AND IT IS NOT YET CLEAR WHETHER HE WILL HAVE ANY NOW THAT HE IS AWARE OF THE BILL.

TWO DAYS AFTER THE BILL WAS SUBMITTED, I HAD A VISIT FROM RETIRED AMBASSADOR CHARLES YOST, WHO HAD BEEN IN IRAN FOR AN ASPEN CONFERENCE. HE BEMOANED THE IMAGE WHICH IRAN HAD ABROAD AND ITS DELETERIOUS EFFECTS UPON CONSTRUCTIVE PARTICIPATION IN ASPEN PROJECTS FROM SOME SECTORS OF THE ACADEMIC COMMUNITY. I MENTIONED THE BILL TO HIM AND FOUND THAT HE HAD NEVER HEARD OF IT. HE UNDERTOOK TO INFORM HIMSELF. IT IS POSSIBLE HE MAY WRITE SOMETHING ABOUT IT IN HIS OCCASIONAL PRESS COLUMNS.

THIS EPISODE INDICATES TO ME THAT IRAN WILL CONTINUE TO HAVE A WORSE PUBLIC IMAGE THAN IT DESERVES ON HUMAN RIGHTS UNTIL IT LEARNS TO DO BETTER IN ADVERTISING THE STEPS WHICH IT IS TAKING IN THIS FIELD. THE USG AND OTHERS CANNOT RPT NOT DO THE JOB FOR THEM. ON THE OTHER HAND, WE CAN AND PROBABLY SHOULD PROD THEM TO DO A BETTER JOB.

AMBASSADOR ZAHEDI SEEMS TO HAVE A FLAIR FOR PUBLIC RELATIONS. THE NEW YORK TIMES OP-ED PAGE OWES AMBASSADOR HOVEYDA SOME RETRIBUTION FOR THE PHOTO CARICATURIZATION WHICH ADORNED HIS LETTER ON HUMAN RIGHTS. PERHAPS INNOCENT QUERIES TO BOTH THESE MEN ON THEIR ACTIONS RESPECTING THIS BILL WILL STIMULATE THEM TO CONSIDER SOME EFFECTIVE ACTIONS ON THEIR OWN BEHALF.
I WOULD APPRECIATE DEPARTMENT VIEWS.

IN PURSUIT OF MY INITIAL ROUND OF PROTOCOLARY CALLS ON SENIOR IRANIAN OFFICIALS, I VISITED JUNE 22 WITH SENATE PRESIDENT JAFAR SHARIF-EMAMI. HE IS AN OLD POLITICAL WARHORSE, FORMER PRIME MINISTER, CONFIDANT OF THE SHAH AND EIGHT-TIME SENATE PRESIDENT. HE HAS FOR YEARS ENJOYED A GOOD RELATIONSHIP WITH THIS EMBASSY, HAS ONE DAUGHTER MARRIED TO AN AMERICAN IN TEXAS, AND A SON ABOUT TO ENTER GRADUATE SCHOOL IN THE US. WHILE HE IS BY NO MEANS ONE OF OUR MOST TRUSTED COLLABORATORS, HE HAS A VALUABLE INFLUENCE WHICH WE WISH TO RETAIN AND ELABORATE.

I TALKED WITH SHARIF-EMAMI ABOUT THE PROGRESS OF PARLIAMENTARY ACTION ON THE MILITARY COURT REFORM BILL (REFTELS). HE SAID THE MAJLES HAD ALREADY PASSED THE BILL WITHOUT AMENDMENT AND HAD MOVED IT TO THE SENATE. ALTHOUGH THE SENATE WAS TECHNICALLY ADJOURNED FOR THE SUMMER, IT WOULD RECONVENE ON AN AD HOC BASIS IN THE NEXT FEW WEEKS TO CONSIDER THIS AND OTHER PRIORITY PIECES OF LEGISLATION.

IN THIS CONTEXT, I POINTED OUT THAT THERE WOULD BE CONSIDERABLE FOREIGN INTEREST, ESPECIALLY IN THE US, IN THE PASSAGE OF THIS BILL. I SAID THERE WAS CONSIDERABLE CRITICISM OF THE MANNER IN WHICH JURIDICAL AND DETENTION PROCESSES WERE CARRIED OUT IN THE IRANIAN MILITARY COURT SYSTEM. SHARIF-EMAMI, WHO HAS THE REPUTATION FOR RECOGNIZING A BANDWAGON WHEN IT ROLLS NEAR HIM, AVOWED THAT HE HAD BEEN CONTINUALLY COUNSELLING THE SHAH TO MAKE THESE CHANGES. HE SAID THAT "FORM" WAS VERY IMPORTANT IN CRIMINAL MATTERS. I SAID WE LIKED TO THINK OF IT AS "DUE PROCESS". HE AGREED THAT WAS A GOOD TERM.

I THEN ASKED ABOUT THE HUMAN RIGHTS COMMISSION, WHICH HAD BEEN ESTABLISHED BY THE PARLIAMENT, BUT ABOUT WHICH LITTLE HAD BEEN HEARD. THE SENATE PRESIDENT SAID IT WAS KEPT BUSY BY CONSIDERING AND ANSWERING CORRESPONDENCE FROM SUCH ENTITIES AS SECGEN WALDHEIM AND OTHERS WHO WRITE ON THE SUBJECT. HE THEN LAUNCHED INTO A PAEAN OF PRAISE FOR THE CARTER ADMINISTRATION'S EMPHASIS ON HUMAN RIGHTS. HE SAID THIS POLICY ENHANCED THE US REPUTATION. FRIENDS OF THE US WOULD FIND IT DESIRABLE TO BE RESPONSIVE TO US LEADERSHIP ON THE ISSUE. ONLY THE SOVIETS AND THE COMMUNIST COUNTRIES WOULD BE ISOLATED AND EMBARRASSED.

AFTER THIS SURGE OF EMPATHY, I SAID I THOUGHT THE US SENATE WOULD ENJOY HEARING SHARIF-EMAMI'S VIEWS AND ASKED WHETHER HE HAD ANY REGULAR CORRESPONDENTS IN THAT AUGUST BODY. HE SAID HE HAD A FEW ACQUAINTANCES, BUT NO CORRESPONDENTS. HE LATER SAID (AFTER A FEW MINUTES INTERVAL IN WHICH OTHER MATTERS WERE DISCUSSED) THAT HE WOULD WELCOME THE ESTABLISHMENT OF CORRESPONDENCE WITH THE US SENATE. I SAID I WOULD INVESTIGATE THE POSSIBILITIES.

COMMENT: IT OCCURS TO ME THAT IT MIGHT BE USEFUL FOR VICE PRESIDENT MONDALE, AS SHARIF-EMAMI'S OPPOSITE NUMBER, TO INITIATE A SYSTEM OF CORRESPONDENCE WITH HIM. GIVEN SHARIF-EMAMI'S DIRECT ACCESS TO THE SHAH, THIS WOULD PROVIDE US AN ADDITIONAL CHANNEL FOR GETTING US VIEWS ON HUMAN RIGHTS TO THE DECISION-MAKING LEVEL. IT WOULD ALSO PERMIT CERTAIN LESS FORMALIZED GIVE-AND-TAKE TO OCCUR IN A MANNER WHICH MIGHT PROVIDE MORE LATITUDE THAN PURELY EXECUTIVE BRANCH DIPLOMACY. THE APPROPRIATE OCCASION FOR THE INITIATION OF THIS GAMBIT MIGHT BE THE PASSAGE BY THE PARLIAMENT OF THE MILITARY COURT REFORM BILL.
ACTION REQUESTED: IF THE DEPARTMENT THINKS WELL OF THE PROPOSAL IN PARAGRAPH 6, PLEASE DISCUSS WITH THE VICE PRESIDENT AND ADVISE THIS EMBASSY OF PREFERRED PROCEDURES.

DURING MY COURTESY CALL (REFTEL) ON SENATE PRESIDENT SHARIF-EMAMI, I ASKED HIM A FEW QUESTIONS ABOUT THE PAHLAVI FOUNDATION, OF WHICH HE IS PRESIDENT. SHARIF-EMAMI LAUNCHED INTO LONG RECITAL OF FOUNDATION'S GOOD WORKS AND STRESSED SCHOLARSHIP FUNDS WHICH IT MAKES ACAILABLE TO IRANIAN STUDENTS, ESPECIALLY IN THE US. HE SAID HE WAS CURRENTLY SUPPORTING 700 STUDENTS IN US UNIVERSITIES. (I HAD THOUGHT THE FIGURE WAS HIGHER.)

I ASKED WHETHER HIS MANHATTAN REAL ESTATE VENTURE WOULD EARN INCOME WHICH WOULD PERMIT THE SCHOLARSHIP LOAD TO BE INCREASED. HE SAID HE HAD NOT REALLY DONE THE NUMBERS. HIS BUILDING IS DESIGNED TO BE A PERMANENT ASSET OF THE FOUNDATION IN THE US, AND ALL PROCEEDS FROM ITS OPEATION WILL BE SPENT IN THE US. IT IT WORKS OUT WELL, HE IS CONSIDERING OTHER SUCH INVESTMENTS IN THE UK AND GERMANY.

HE SAID, BY THE WAY, THAT HE HAD BEEN ADVISED THAT A HOTEL WOULD BE MUCH MORE PROFITABLE THAN AN OFFICE BUILDING. THEREFORE, THE PLANS ARE BEING REVISED TO CONVERT THE STRUCTURE TO A HOTEL. WOULD YOU BELIEVE THE SHAHRATON PAHLAZA?

1977TEHRAN05607.subject: RESPONSE TO INDIAN OCEAN AD HOC COMMITTEE

segments.text: WE ARE ASSUMING THAT DEPT INTENDED TO INCLUDE IRAN IN INSTRUCTION TO USUN THAT IT "INFORM ALLIES IN NEW YORK OF THE SUBSTANCE OF THE US RESPONSE PRIOR TO ITS DELIVERY", CONTAINED PARA 3 REF A. IF OUR ASSUMPTION IS NOT CORRECT, WOULD APPRECIATE DEPT AMENDING ITS INSTRUCTION, AND USUN PROVIDING OUR IRANIAN ALLIES IMMEDIATELY-HOPEFULLY PRIOR TO DELIVERY -- SUBSTANCE OF US PROPOSED RESPONSE.

AS NOTED REF B "SHAH HAS AN INTENSE INTEREST IN INDIAN OCEAN AFFAIRS", THEREFORE, BELIEVE IT IN US INTEREST TO TREAT IRAN AS ALLY IN EFFORT TO FOSTER MOST HELPFUL AND SUPPORTIVE IRANIAN ATTITUDE ON ISSUES OF COMMON INTEREST.
WOULD APPRECIATE USUN REPORT ON ANY COMMENT OR REACTION BY IRANIAN UNDEL, AND ANY SUGGESTIONS ABOUT HOW EMB COULD BE HELPFUL HERE.

ALTHOUGH IRANIANS HAVE NOT FOLLOWED UP IN ASKING US ABOUT AFTERMATH OF COUP IN THE SEYCHELLES, POSSIBLY BECAUSE OF ABSENCE OF FONMIN KHALATBARY ON 10 DAY TOUR OF EASTERN EUROPE, WE WOULD LIKE TO VOLUNTEER AN UPDATE READING ON THE SUBJECT DRAWING ON CURRENT FOREIGN RELATIONS ISSUE NO 24. OPPORTUNITY TO DO SO WOULD BE DCM MEETING WITH MFA UNDERSECY NADIM JUNE 28 ON ANOTHER SUBJECT. APPRECIATE AUTHORIZATION BY OPENING OF BUSINESS TEHRAN TIME JUNE 28.
FILE; TELEGRAM TEXT FOR THIS MRN IS UNAVAILABLE

DR FEREIDOUN NASSERI, WHO HAS CHAIRED MANPOWER AND TECHNICAL COOPERATION COMITE FOR THE LAST TWO YEARS, RESIGNED FROM THE MINISTRY OF LABOR AND SOCIAL AFFS FIRST WEEK OF JUNE 1977. MINISTER MANUCHEHR AZMOUN HS APPOINTED FIVE NEW DEPUTY MINISTERS AND DIVISION OF RESPONSIBILITY AMONG THESE FIVE IS SOMEWHAT DIFFERENT FROM PREVIOUS ORGANIZATION OF THE MINISTRY.

EMB UNDERSTANDS NEW DEP MINISTER FOR MANPOWER AND EMPLOYMENT, DR ABBAS SHEIKH, WILL ASSUME NASSERI'S JOINT COMMISSION ROLE. AT PRESENT SHEIKH NOT REPEAT NOT IN TEHRAN. UPON HIS RETURN ECONOMIC COUNSELOR AND USIRJC OFFICER WILL CALL ON SHEIKH AND WILL DISCUSS SUBSTANCE REFTEL AT THAT TIME.

1977TEHRAN05706.subject: 63RD SESSION OF ECOSOC: FULL PLO MEMBERSHIP IN THE ECONOMIC COMMISSION FOR WESTERN ASIA (ECWA)

segments.text: ECONOMIC COMMISSION FOR WESTERN ASIA (ECWA)

DCM RAISED SUBJECT REFTEL#WITH MFA UNDERSECRETARY NADIM JUNE 28 MAKING POINTS OUTLINED PARA 4. NADIM SAID THAT HE APPRECIATED THE LOGIC OF OUR POSITION AND THE IMPLICATIONS PLO MEMBERSHIP IN THE ECWA WOULD HAVE FOR OTHER UN INSTITUTIONS. HE WOULD HAVE TO CHECK, HOWEVER, BEFORE GIVING US OFFICIAL GOI REACTION. URGING GOI SUPPORT IN OPPOSING PLO MEMBERSHIP IN ECWA, DCM EXPRESSED THE HOPE THAT TACTICS AND OBJECTIVES BE COORDINTED THROUGH IRANIAN AMBASSADOR FARTASH AND OUR DELEGATION AT GENEVA.

COMMENT: GIVEN KNOWN GOI ATTITUDE TOWARD PLO, BELIEVE IT LIKELY THAT IT WILL SUPPORT U.S. POSITION IN THIS MATTER. HOWEVER, IT THROWS THE PLO A BONE FROM TIME TO TIME IN THE CONTEXT OF KEEPING ITS CREDENTIALS WITH THE ARABS WELL BURNISHED. WE SHOULD KNOW SHORTLY WHETHER THIS IS JUST SUCH AN OCCASION. SULLIVAN NOTE BY OC/T: REFTEL OMISSION AS RECEIVED

DURING DCM CALL ON MFA UNDERSECRETARY NADIM JUNE 28 ON OTHER MATTERS, LATTER REFERRED TO CURRENT DEBATE IN U.S. OVER MIDDLE EAST SETTLEMENT TERMS (WHICH RECEIVED FRONT PAGE PLAY IN LOCAL PRESS) AND SAID THAT BEGIN'S POSITION WAS TOO MUCH. "ISRAEL CANNOT EXPECT TO GOBBLE UP THE WEST BANK ON THE BASIS OF WHAT IS WRITTEN IN SOME RELIGIOUS BOOK." NADIM WENT ON TO ADD THAT HE AGREED COMPLETELY WITH THE ADMINISTRATION'S STATEMENTS ON THE SUBJECT AND THOUGHT THAT IT WAS A SOUND APPROACH TO A MIDDLE EAST SETTLEMENT.
COMMENT: NADIM'S REMARKS ARE NOT A REFORMULATION BUT REAFFIRMATION OF IRAN'S OFTEN STATED POSITION THAT PATH TO MIDDLE EAST PEACE SHOULD BE IMPLEMENTATION OF UN RESOLUTION 242.

1977TEHRAN05871.subject: U.S.-USSR WORKING GROUP ON THE INDIAN OCEAN

segments.text: WE NOTE U.S.-USSR WORKING GROUP MEETING ON THE INDIAN OCEAN WAS CONCLUDED OVER A WEEK AGO BUT HAVE YET RECEIVED NO INFORMATION REGARDING OUTCOME OTHER THAN CORRECTION OF ERRONEOUS VOA BROADCAST REPORTED STATE 153954. ASSUME IT OUR INTENTION TO INFORM OUR ALLIES AT FAIRLY EARLY DATE OF WHAT TRANSPIRED AND PROGNOSIS FOR POSSIBLE FUTURE MEETINGS AND/OR EXCHANGES. WE WOULD APPRECIATE READOUT AND GUIDANCE ON WHAT WE CAN CONVEY TO GOI WHICH, AS NOTED REFTEL B, HAS A LIVELY INTEREST IN THIS SUBJECT.

VISITING EX-SENATOR EUGENE MCCARTHY, WHO HAD JUST ARRIVED PREVIOUS DAY FROM ISRAEL, TOLD US JULY 2 THAT HE HAD TALKED TO GENERAL YIGAEL YADIN BEFORE HIS DEPARTURE AND THAT HE HAD UNDERSTOOD YADIN WAS ON THE VERGE OF JOINING BEGIN'S COALITION GOVERNMENT. IT WAS NOT CLEAR WHETHER YADIN IS DOING THIS ON A PERSONAL BASIS OR WAS BRINGING HIS PARTY INTO THE COALITION AS WELL BUT HE APPARENTLY EXPECTED TO BE NAMED DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER. 2.THIS MAY BE OLD NEWSTO THE DEPARTMENT AND TEL AVIV BUT IS NOT SOMETHING WE HAVE HEARD HERE.

AMBASSADOR HAS BEEN IN TOUCH WITH COURT MINISTER ALAM MORNING JULY 5 TO EXCHANGE INFORMATION CONCERNING EVENTS IN PAKISTAN. ALAM SAID IRANIAN COMMUNICATIONS WITH THEIR EMBASSY IN ISLAMABAD WERE INTACT AND THEY WERE RECEIVING STEADY FLOW OF REPORTS.

ALAM'S ATTITUDE (AND BY INFERENCE THE SHAH'S) COULD BEST BE DESCRIBED AS THINLY VEILED SATISFACTION. MILITARY TAKEOVER WAS, HE SAID, "ONLY POSSIBLE SOLUTION". HE EXPRESSED PLEASURE THAT BOTH ASGHAR KHAN AND "THAT BUTCHER" TIKKA KHAN HAD BEEN ARRESTED.
IN EXTENSION HIS REMARKS, ALAM SAID HE SUPPOSED THIS WOULD SET PATTERN ALSO FOR TURKEY, WHICH HE DESCRIBED AS "MORE SERIOUS" MATTER THAN SITUATION IN PAKISTAN.

WE WELCOME THE DEPARTMENT'S REAFFIRMATION OF ITS INTENTION TO PURSUE U.S. FOREIGN POLICY OBJECTIVES IN MULTILATERAL FORA AND TO STRENGTHEN THE TEAMWORK BETWEEN THE DEPARTMENT AND THE FIELD FOR THIS PURPOSE. REFTEL A EXPRESSES OUR THOUGHTS ON THIS SUBJECT WHICH WE FIND INCORPORATED IN REFTEL

OF PARTICULAR IMPORTANCE TO OUR EFFECTIVE PRESENTATION OF OUR VIEWS TO OUR HOST COUNTRY IS TIMELINESS, COGENCY AND RIGOROUS LOGIC. ALSO IMPORTANT IS THE COORDINATION OF INITIATIVES BETWEEN THE DEPARTMENT, USUN AND THE EMBASSY TO INSURE CONFORMITY OF POSITION, EMPHASIS AND PRIORITY. SELECTIVITY ALSO BEARS ON OUR EFFECTIVENESS FOR WE CAN EASILY OVERWHELM LESS EXPERT OR WELL-STAFFED MINISTRIES WILL TOO GREAT A VOLUME OF ISSUES OR DETAIL. IN THIS RESPECT IT IS URGED THAT VERY WIDE LATITUDE BE EXTENDED EMBASSIES IN CHOSING ISSUES AS WELL AS LEVELS FOR REPRESENTATION. OBVIOUSLY THERE WILL BE A HARD CORE OF PERHAPS SIX OR SEVEN QUESTIONS TO WHICH WE ATTACH MAJOR IMPORTANCE.

THESE SHOULD BE IDENTIFIED WELL IN ADVANCE OF PROBABLE DISCUSSION IN INTERNATIONAL FORA AND CONVEYED TO EMBASSIES WITH APPROPRIATE REPRESENTATIONAL INSTRUCTIONS. IN OUR EXPERIENCE, LAST MINUTE, BREATHLESS APPEALS ARE NOT ONLY UNSEEMLY BUT FREQUENTLY INEFFECTIVE.

FROM OUR PERSPECTIVE AND KNOWLEDGE OF IRANIAN INTERESTS AND CAPABILITIES REFTEL B SKETCHES OUT A COMPLEX OF ISSUES WHICH MAY WELL BE BEYOND IRAN'S ABILITY TO DIGEST. IF WE PUT EQUAL EMPHASIS ON ALL OF THEM, VARYING FROM THE NORTH/ SOUTH DIALOGUE THROUGH HUMAN RIGHTS TO UN STRUCTURAL CHANGES, WE FEAR WE COULD LOSE IRAN'S ATTENTION AND SUPPORT. WE BELIEVE THIS ILLUSTRATES THE POINT WE ARE MAKING ABOUT THE NEED FOR SELECTIVITY AND PRIORITY RANKING.

WE WISH TO ASSURE THE DEPARTMENT OF OUR BEST EFFORT IN HELPING TO ACHIEVE OUR MULTILATERAL DIPLOMATIC OBJECTIVES AND HOPE THE FOREGOING THOUGHTS ARE FOUND HELPFUL. THE DCM AND I HAVE ASSUMED DIRECT RESPONSIBILITY FOR THIS EFFORT.

THE SHAH ON JULY 2 RECEIVED FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY WHO THEREUPON PRESENTED TO H.I.M. NEWLY-APPOINTED GOI AMBASSADOR TO JAPAN, NASSER MAJD-ARDAKANI, AND NEW GOI AMBASSADOR TO NORTH YEMEN, AMIRUDDIN EFTEKHAR. THESE ARE THE FIRST TWO OF WHAT IS RUMORED TO BE A SERIES OF MFA PERSONNEL CHANGES BOTH HOME AND ABROAD.

MAJD-ARDAKANI, 49, IS A CAREER OFFICIAL WHO JOINED THE GOVERNMENT IN 1949 AND ENTERED DIPLOMATIC SERVICE IN 1955. MAJD HAS A LAW DEGREE FROM UNIVERSITY OF TEHRAN AND IS KNOWN AS A SPECIALIST IN ASIAN AND AFRICAN AFFAIRS. HE HAS SERVED ABROAD AT TUNIS, LONDON AND WASHINGTON AND BEFORE HIS RECENT PROMOTION MADJ WAS SECRETARY-GENERAL OF THE PERSIAN GULF COUNCIL (PGC). HIS APPOINTMENT TO JAPAN APPEARS TO STEM FROM FAMILY CONNECTIONS AS MUCH AS FROM HIS DIPLOMATIC EXPEREINCE. HIS WIFE, THE SISTER OF MFA UNDERSECRETARY NASSIR ASSAR, HAS BEEN LIVING DURING THE PAST YEAR WITH THEIR CHILDREN IN LONDON.

WE UNDERSTAND THAT MADJ DID NOT HAVE A PARTICULARLY SMOOTH WORKING RELATIONSHIP WITH AMBASSADOR ZAHEDI WHILE IN WASHINGTON AS MINISTER-COUNSELOR. WHEN HE RETURNED TO MFA HE WAS WITHOUT AN ONWARD ASSIGNMENT UNTIL TAKING THE RELATIVELY UNIMPORTANT PGC JOB.

WE HAVE FOUND MADJ, WHILE FRIENDLY, TO BE QUITE PROTOCOL-CONSCIOUS AND RATHER INCLINED TO TAKE OFFENSE AT REAL OR IMAGINED SLIGHTS TO HIMSELF OR TO IRAN. HE HAS NOT IMPRESSED EMBOFFS AS BEING PARTICULARLY BRIGHT BUT RATHER TENDS TO FOCUS ON DETAILS WITHOUT MUCH PERSPECTIVE AS TO THEIR IMPACT ON LARGER CONCERNS.

EFTEKHAR, 60, IS ALSO A CAREER DIPLOMAT WITH A LAW DEGREE FROM UNIVERSITY OF TEHRAN. HE HAS SERVED IN VARIOUS MFA DEPARTMENTS: PROTOCOL, WESTERN EUROPEAN AFFAIRS, INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS, AND PASSPORTS. ABROAD HE HAS SERVED AT BAGHDAD AND MADRID. HE SPEAKS ENGLISH AND FRENCH.

IN A RELATED, INFELICITOUS DEVELOPMENT, EFTEKHAR'S PREDECESSOR, AMBASSADOR HASSAN SABETI, 66, DIED JULY 1 OF AN APPARENT HEART ATTACK IN NORTH YEMEN. HE HAD BEEN POSTED TO SANAA FOR OVER THREE YEARS AND WAS SCHEDULED TO RETURN TO TEHRAN WITHIN THE NEXT FEW DAYS.

PROMINENT IRANIAN ATTORNEY MUSA SABI SUBMITTED LETTER TO AMB JULY 2 INDICATING HE IS PROCEEDING TO NEW YORK TO SEE IF PROCEEDINGS AGAINST AFSHAR WHICH WERE DROPPED LAST FALL CAN BE REINSTITUTED. LETTER CONTAINED PARAGRAPH SAYING SHAH HAD BEEN INFORMED OF DISMISSAL OF INDICTMENT AND HAS ORDERED CASE PRESSED. LETTER ASKED AMBASSADOR'S INTERVENTION TO ARRANGE INTRODUCTION TO EITHER SECSTATE OR ATTNY GENERAL.

SABI TOLD ACTING HEAD OF POL SECTION HE HAD BEEN EMPLOYED BY PAHLAVI FOUNDATION AT SHAH'S REQUEST TO PRESS PROSECUTION OF AFSHAR. ORIGINAL CASE WAS DISMISSED, ACCORDING TO US FIRM ROGERS AND WELLS' LETTER TO SABI, BECAUSE AFSHAR SUCCESSFULLY PASSED LIE DETECTOR TEST ON POINTS CONTAINED IN INDICTMENT AFTER CHARGING PROSECUTING ATTORNEY AND JUDGE HAD TAKEN BRIBES TO KEEP CASE OPEN TO "GET" HIM. SABI ALSO SAID HE WILL BE CARRYING FULL POWER OF ATTORNEY FROM DEP CUSTODIAN OF PAHLAVI FOUNDATION TO INSTITUTE CRIMINAL LAWSUIT, DEFEND ALL COUNTER-SUITS, HIRE ATTORNEYS AND MAKE AGREEMENTS WITH US LAW FIRMS.
SABI IS NOT PERMITTED TO SETTLE OR OTHERWISE ABANDON CASE WITHOUT PERSONAL CONSENT OF DEP CUSTODIAN (READ: SHAH).

SABI WAS REFERRED TO NEA/IRN--NAAS FOR DISCUSSION OF PROBLEM AND ARRANGEMENT OF APPROPRIATE CONTACTS. GIVEN DEPTS INVOLVEMENT UNDER FREEDOM-OF -INFORMATION ACT (SEE REFTEL AND PREVIOUS) AND SENSITIVITY OF CASE, BELIEVE LEGAL ADVISOR SHOULD DISCUSS MATTER WITH SABI. SABI IS CLEARLY UNDER ORDERS FROM TOP HERE TO PRESS CASE VIGOROUSLY AND REINSTITUTE CHARGES IF POSSIBLE (ROGER AND WELLS INDICATED TO HIM THAT SINCE CHARGES WERE DISMISSED BEFOR JURY EMPANELED, QUESTION OF DOUBLE JEOPARDY DID NOT ARISE). PROBLEM OF POLITICAL SENSITIVITY COULD BECOME ACUTE IF PROSECUTION PROCEEDS, SINCE AFSHAR WILL MOST CERTAINLY CHARGE SHAH AND GOI ARE OUT TO GET HIM AND TRY TO TURN MATTER INTO POLITICAL RATHER THAN JUDICIAL HEARING.

ON OTHER HAND, IF USG IS TOO DISCOURAGING REGARDING SABI EFFORT, OLDER SUSPICIONS THAT US SOMEHOW "USING" AFSHAR AS ANTI-SHAH STALKING HORSE LIKELY TO RESURFACT AT HIGHEST LEVELS HERE AND SIGNIFICANTLY COMPLICATE POLITICAL CONTEXT OF IRANO-US RELATIONS.
FOR RECORD, EMB POUCHING NEA/IRN COPIES OF MATERIAL SABI TURNED OVER TO EMBOFF. SABI EXPECTS TO ARRIVE IN US JULY 10 AND WILL INITIALLY STAY AT HOTEL PIERRE, NEW YORK.

ON SEVERAL SOCIAL OCCASIONS RECENTLY SOMALIA AMBASSADOR SHARMANI HAS APPROACHED THE DCM PROBING FOR INFORMATION ABOUT U.S. ASSESSMENT OF DEVELOPMENTS IN THE HORN OF AFRICA, U.S. ATTITUDES TOWARD SOMALIA AND PROFESSING SOMALIA INTERESTS IN IMPROVING RELATIONS WITH THE U.S. AND OTHER WESTERN AND ARAB COUNTRIES. THRUST OF SHARMANI'S REMARKS HAS BEEN THAT NOW THAT USSR HAS DECIDED TO HELP ETHIOPIA AND SUPPORT ETHIOPIAN EFFORTS TO HANG ON TO SOMALIA TERRITORY, SOMALIA'S HANDS ARE NO LONGER TIED WITH RESPECT TO DEVELOPING RELATIONS WITH THE WEST.

SHARMANI SAID THAT SOMALIA IS GRATEFUL FOR PAST SOVIET ASSISTANCE, WHICH HAD BEEN FORTHCOMING WITH NO STRINGS ATTACHED, AFTER SOMALIA HAD BEEN TURNED DOWN BY THE WEST AND IT WILL NOT TURN AGAINST THE SOVIET UNION NOW EVEN THOUGH IT WAS HELPING SOMALIA'S ENEMY, ETHIOPIA. NEVERTHELESS SOMALIA WAS NOW EXPLORING OTHER OPTIONS INCLUDING ASSISTANCE FROM U.S., SAUDI ARABIA AND IRAN. HE SAID THAT HE THOUGHT SAUDI ARABIA WILL BE WILLING TO HELP BUT IT MUST UNDERSTAND THAT SOMALIA WAS FIRMLY DEDICATED TO SOCIALIST PRINCIPLES AND COULD NOT BE EXPECTED TO CHANGE ITS IDEOLOGICAL ORIENTATION IN RETURN FOR ASSISTANCE.

SOMALIA THOUGHT THAT THESE PRINCIPLES WERE BEST SUITED TO ITS NEEDS AND WERE ACCEPTED AND SUPPORTED BY ITS PEOPLE. AS FAR AS THE U.S. WQS CONCERNED HE THOUGHT THAT THE NEW ADMINISTRATION BEING UNENCUMBERED WITH LINKS TO ETHIOPIA WAS IN A BETTER POSITION TO EVALUATE THE SITUATION IN THE AREA AND HOPED THAT IT WOULD FIND IT IN ITS BEST INTERESTS TO HELP SOMALIA. HE ALSO EXPRESSED GENERAL OPTIMISM THAT IRAN WOULD BE OF SOME HELP ECONOMICALLY AND MILITARILY BUT MADE NO MENTION OF THE FORTHCOMING IRANIAN MILITARY MISSION VISIT TO SOMALIA.
HE DID ACKNOWLEDGE, HOWEVER, THAT SOMALIA HAD ASKED IRAN FOR "A VERY MODEST AMOUNT" OF SMALL ARMS AND AMMUNITION.

DCM'S RESPONSE HAS BEEN VERY GENERAL, PROFESSING LACKING OF AREA EXPERTISE AND DETAILED KNOWLEDGE OF HORN OF AFRICA AFFAIRS. HE DID SAY, HOWEVER, THAT HE UNDERSTOOD A U.S. ECONOMIC MISSION HAD BEEN DISPATCHED TO SOMALIA TO SEE WHETHER THERE MIGHT BE OPPORTUNITIES FOR US TO DEVELOP A MUTUALLY BENEFICIAL RELATIONSHIP. WHILE HE HAD NO IDEA OF THE POSSIBLE OUTCOME OF THIS OR ANY OTHER INITIATIVE, HE SAID HE THOUGHT WE WELCOMED THE BEGINNING OF A DIALOGUE.

SHARMANI IS A CAREER MILITARY OFFICER WHO CLAIMS LONG MILITARY SERVICE AND A CLOSE RELATIONSHIP WITH PRESIDENT BARRE. HE APPARENTLY HAD SOME MILITARY EDUCATION AND/OR TRAINING IN ITALY AND SPEAKS ITALIAN FLUENTLY. HIS ENGLISH IS ALSO GOOD. HE FORMERLY SERVED AS SOMALIA MILITARY ATTACHE IN CAIRO AND MOSCOW. WHEN ASKED HOW HE CAME TO BE APPOINTED AMBASSADOR, SHARMANI LAUGHED AND SAID THAT PRESIDENT BARRE HAD GOTTEN FED UP WITH CONSERVATIVE CAREER DIPLOMATS WHO SEEMED PRINCIPALLY OCCUPIED WITH PROTOCOLAR NICETIES AND DECIDED TO APPOINT OFFICERS WHO MAY NOT BE SO POLISHED BUT WERE AT LEAST MORE ENERGETIC IN CARRYING OUT SOMALIA'S FOREIGN POLICY OBJECTIVES.

SHARMANI HIMSELF IS HARDLY A DIAMOND IN THE ROUGH AND HAS STRUCK US ON THE FEW OCCASIONS WE HAVE SEEN HIM AS A SMOOTH AND EFFECTIVE ENVOY. SULLIVAN NOTE BY OC/T: DISTRIBUTION COORDINATED WITH MR. GREELEY, S/S-O.

1977TEHRAN06157.subject: US-SOVIET TALKS ON INDIAN OCEAN ARMS LIMITATIONS

segments.text: I GREATLY APPRECIATE PROMPT AND COMPREHENSIVE GUIDANCE WHICH WAS PROVIDED REFTEL FOR MY ORAL BRIEFING OF SHAH ON INDIAN OCEAN AFFAIRS. DURING JULY 12 AUDIENCE, I READ MOST OF TEXT VERBATIM TO SHAH. HE WAS OBVIOUSLY PLEASED NOT ONLY WITH THE FACT OF THE BRIEFING, BUT ALSO ITS SUBSTANCE.

HE SAID HE FELT US POSITION WITH SOVIETS WAS "JUST RIGHT". HE ALSO SAID SOVIET TACTICS, AS DESCRIBED REFTEL, WERE JUST ABOUT WHAT HE HAD EXPECTED. HE WAS INTERESTED TO NOTE, HOWEVER, THAT THEY HAD ADMITTED USE OF FACILITIES IN SOMALIA AND SEEMED WILLING TO INCLUDE THEM IN TALKS.
HE ALSO SAID SOVIET POSITION ABOUT US FRIENDS AND ALLIES WAS A BIT THICK FOR A COUNTRY WHICH HAS DEFENSE AGREEMENTS WITH AT LEAST TWO COUNTRIES (INDIA AND IRAQ) WHICH ARE LITTORAL STATES.
SHAH THEN WENT INTO AN ACCOUNT OF HIS "GRAND DESIGN" FOR INDIAN OCEAN, WHICH WOULD INVOLVE "COMMON MARKET" OF INDIAN OCEAN STATES, SELF-POLICING ARRANGEMENTS BY LITTORAL NAVIES, ETC.

AS FINAL COMMENT, HE SAID THAT US-SOVIET WITHDRAWAL FROM INDIAN OCEAN COULD BE CONSIDERED OUR "IDEAL", BUT HE FELT WE SHOULD HAVE NO ILLUSIONS THAT SOVIETS WOULD EVER AGREE VOLUNTARY TO SUCH WITHDRAWAL.

DURING AUDIENCE WITH SHAH ON OTHER MATTERS JULY 12, I ASKED HOW RECENTLY CONCLUDED IRAN-IRAQ TALKS HAD GONE. SHAH SAID IRAQI DELEGATION HAD BEEN EXTREMELY POLITE AND HAD EXPRESSED ALL RIGHT VOWS OF FRIENDSHIP.

ONLY SIGNIFICANT ELEMENT, IN HIS JUDGMENT, WAS IRAQ REQUEST THAT IRAN REFRAIN FROM CONCLUDING ANY AGREEMENTS ON LIMITS OF OFFSHORE EXPLORATION AREAS WITH OTHER STATES IN PERSIAN GULF. SHAH ASSUMED THIS REQUEST WAS SPECIFICALLY DIRECTED TOWARDS IRANIAN RELATIONS WITH KUWAIT.

HE SAID HIS ASSUMPTION WAS CONFIRMED BY TALK HE HAD WITH KUWAIT AMBASSADOR JULY 11. (AMBASSADOR RETURNED JULY 9 FROM QUICK CONSULTATIONS IN KUWAIT.) AMBASSADOR HAD TOLD SHAH THAT REPORTS OF IRAQ-KUWAIT BORDER AGREEMENT WERE ALL FOR PUBLIC CONSUMPTION. IN ACTUAL PRACTICE, NO AGREEMENT HAD BEEN MADE.
INSTEAD, KUWAITI REPORTED THAT IRAQIS HAD SPENT MOST OF THEIR TIME IN LECTURING KUWAITIS ON VIRTUES OF BA'ATH AND THE GOAL OF ARAB UNITY. (THIS IS, NATURALLY, ANATHEMA TO SHAH.)

SINCE HE WAS DISCUSSING MARITIME BOUNDARIES IN PERSIAN GULF, I ASKED SHAH ABOUT SIGNIFICANCE OF RECENT OMANI DECLARATION OF 200 MILE ECONOMIC ZONE. SHAH SAID THAT WAS STRICTLY FOR OMANI INTEREST "OUTSIDE THE GULF". WITHIN THE GULF, HE HAD AN AGREEMENT WITH OMAN THAT THEIR WATERS WOULD BE DIVIDED AT MID#-) 8,5.

1977TEHRAN06166.subject: MULTILATERAL AFFAIRS: REQUEST FOR MULTILATERAL INFORMATION ON HOST GOVERNMENTS

segments.text: IN RESPONSE TO REQUEST REFTEL, WE BELIEVE THAT INFORMATION PROVIDED TEHRAN 2009 OF 26 FEB 1976 CONTINUES TO REFLECT ACCURATE SUMMARY OF IRANIAN POLICIES ON MULTILATERAL AFFAIRS.
DCM MIKLOS HAS BEEN DESIGNATED MULTILATERAL AFFAIRS OFFICER WITH PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY FOR COORDINATING MULTILATERAL AFFAIRS AT THIS EMBASSY.
IRANIAN PERMANENT DELEGATE TO THE UN AMBASSADOR HOVEYDA WILL HEAD DELEGATION TO THE RESUMED SESSION OF THE 31ST UN GENERAL ASSEMBLY.

IRANIAN FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY ACCOMPANIED BY MFA UNDERSECRETARY NADIM WILL HEAD IRANIAN DELEGATION TO THE 32ND UN GENERAL ASSEMBLY. CURRENT BUT TENTATIVE PLANS ARE FOR KHALATBARY TO ARRIVE IN NEW YORK SEPTEMBER 18 AND TO STAY FOR THREE WEEKS. PRINCESS ASHRAF WILL BE ARRIVING ABOUT OCTOBER 3 TO TAKE OVER LEADERSHIP OF THE DELEGATION UPON KHALATBARY'S DEPARTURE ABOUT THE SAME TIME.
WILL ADVISE FURTHER WHEN MORE PRECISE DETAILS AVAILABLE INCLUDING EXACT MEANS AND TIME OF ARRIVAL AND DEPARTURE.
GOI JULY 11 ANNOUNCED APPOINTMENT OF FEREIDOUNAN ZANFARD AS AMBASSADOR TO PAKISTAN. IN RESPONSE REFTEL, FOLLOWING BIOGRAPHIC BACKGROUND IS PROVIDED.

DR. ZANFARD, 51, IS A CAREER DIPLOMAT WHO GRADUATED FROM UNIVERSITY OF TEHRAN IN POLITICAL SCIENCE. HE ENTERED MFA IN 1948 AND HAS SERVED IN THE FOLLOWING DEPARTMENTS: RECORDS; TREATIES AND LEGAL AFFAIRS; PERSONNEL; ECONOMIC AFFAIRS; INTERNATIONAL COOPERATION DEPT.; AND MIDDLE EAST AND PERSIAN GULF AFFAIRS. ABROAD HE HAS SERVED AT THE IRANIAN MISSION TO THE UNITED NATIONS IN NEW YORK AND WAS IRANIAN AMBASSADOR TO KUWAIT 1971-76. SINCE HIS RETURN FROM KUWAIT HE HAS BEEN HEAD OF THE MFA DIPLOMATIC PLANS AND PROJECTS COUNCIL (SIMILAR TO OUR POLICY/PLANNING STAFF). HE SPEAKS ENGLISH (IN A PRECISE, DELIBERATE MANNER) AND ALSO FRENCH.

THE EMBASSY HAS HAD A GOOD WORKING RELATIONSHIP WITH ZANFARD FOR A NUMBER OF YEARS, GOING BACK TO THE LATE 60S WHEN HE WAS HEAD OF THE MIDDLE EAST AND PERSIAN GULF AFFAIRS DEPARTMENT. HE HAS BEEN GENERALLY WELL INFORMED, THOUGH DISCREET, AND REASONABLY FORTHCOMING IN DISCUSSING GOI POSITIONS. ALTHOUGH HIS PRIMARY AREA OF EXPERTISE HAS BEEN THE PERSIAN BULF, HE HAS BECOME KNOWLEDGEABLE ABOUT WIDER CONCERNS THROUGH HIS POLICY PLANNING EXPERIENCE. HE RECENTLY RECEIVED AN AMERICAN COUNDIL OF YOUNG POLITICAL LEADERS GROUP AND PROVIDED THEM WITH AN IMPRESSIVE TOUR D'HORIZON OF CURRENT IRANIAN FOREIGN POLICY.

EMBASSY CONTACTS HAVE FOUND ZANFARD TO BE INTELLIGENT, WITH A KEEN ANALYTICAL MIND. HE PRESENTS A FAIRLY UNIMPRESSIVE FIRST IMPRESSION SINCE HE IS BASCIALLY A SHY PERSON, WITH A RETIRING DEMEANOR. HE IS REPORTEDLY HELD IN PARTICULARLY HIGH REGARD BY HIS MFA COLLEAGUES.

IN RESPONSE TO OUR QUERY ABOUT IRANIAN THINKING ABOUT WHO MIGHT TAKE CENTO SECGEN BAYULKEN'S PLACE, MFA DIR HOOSHANG BATMANGLIDJ WHO HAS BEEN CONNECTED WITH CENTO AFFAIRS FOR YEARS SAID THAT IRAN THOUGHT IT WAS STILL TURKEY'S TURN AND THAT TURKEY SHOULD, THEREFORE, COME UP WITH A SUITABLE CANDIDATE. WHEN IT WAS MENTIONED THAT WE HAD HEARD THIRD HAND THAT IRAN HAD DESIGNATED A "YOUNG, UP-AND-COMING" MFA OFFICIAL FOR THE POSITION (REF A) BATMAGLIDJ SCOFFED AT THE IDEA SAYING THAT IRAN HAD NO SUCH INTENTION AND FURTHER THAT IT BELIEVED POSITION REQUIRED A SENIOR OFFICIAL OF CONSIDERABLE STATURE, NOTING THAT THE PRESENT INCUMBENT IS A FORMER FONMIN.
HE URGED THAT THE US ENCOURAGE THE TURKS TO COME UP WITH SUCH A CANDIDATE.

INCIDENTALLY, BATMANGLIDJ HAS BEEN TIPPED AS THE NEXT IRANIAN AMB TO TURKEY ALTHOUGH HE HAS NOT BEEN FORMALLY PRESENTED AS SUCH TO THE SHAH--A PROCEDURE WHICH PASSES FOR CONFIRMATION HERE. IF THINGS GO ACCORDING TO PLAN, BATMANGLIDJ EXPECTS TO ARRIVE IN ANKARA TO TAKE UP HIS NEW RESPONSIBILITIES MID TO LATE SEPTEMBER.

RUMORS HAVE BEEN CIRCULATING IN TEHRAN FOR SOME WEEKS REGARDING A NUMBER OF IMMINENT CHANGES OF GOI AMBASSADORS ABROAD. REFTEL NOTED THAT MFA DIRECTOR GERNAL FOR ECONOMIC AFFAIRS HOOSHANG BATMANGHELIDJ IS SCHEDULED TO BE POSTED TO TURKEY WITHIN THE NEXT TWO MONTHS.

ALTHOUGH NO OFFICIAL ANNOUNCEMENTS HAVE BEEN MADE, WE BELIEVE ON THE BASIS OF FAIRLY RELIABLE INFORMATION THAT THESE CHANGES INCLUDE THE FOLLOWING: HORMOZ GHARIB, GRAND MASTER OF CEREMONIES IN THE MINISTRY OF COURT TO BECOME AMBASSADOR TO ITALY; KHOSROW AKMAL, UNDERSECRETARY IN THE COURT MINISTRY AND VICE GRAND MASTER OF CEREMONIES, TO BE AMBASSADOR TO AUSTRALIA; MANUCHEHR AZIMA, CURRENTLY DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR POLITICAL AFFAIRS (EUROPE AND AMERICA), MFA TO BE AMBASSADOR TO SPAIN.

GENERAL FEREIDUN DJAM, PRESENTLY AMBASSADOR TO SPAIN WILL RETURN TO IRAN AND REPORTEDLY WILL BE APPOINTED BY THE SHAH TO THE SENATE. AMBASSADOR AFSHAR IS BEING TRANSFERRED FROM BONN TO TAKE GHARIB'S POSITION IN THE COURT.
BIOGRAPHIC BACKGROUND WILL BE FORWARDED APPROPRIATE POSTS FOLLOWING OFFICIAL ANNOUNCEMENT OF THE ABOVE APPOINTMENTS.

1977TEHRAN06281.subject: AMB ZELLI APPOINTED MFA UNDER SECY

segments.text: THE MINISTRY OF FON AFFS IS IN THE PROCESS OF ROTATING A NUMBER OF CAREER DIPLOMATS AMONG THEM AMB ZELLI, WHO WILL BECOME UNDER SECY FOR POLITICAL AND PARLIAMENTARY AFFS, THE NUMBER TWO POST IN MFA. AMB ZELLI, WHO HAS BEEN POSTED TO PAKISTAN SINCE 1972, IS BEING REPLACED BY FEREIDOUN ZANDFARD (REFTEL).
AMB ZELLI SERVED FROM 1970-72 IN THE SAME POSITION, WHICH AT THAT TIME WAS THE THIRD RANKING JOB IN MFA. THE DEP MINISTER POSITION, THEN HELD BY MINISTER KHALATBARY, HAS SINCE BEEN ABOLISHED.

PREVIOUS BIO REPORTING EHRAN A-156 SEP 14, 1972) PROVIDED HIGHLIGHTS OF ZELLI'S CAREER TO THAT TIME. WE WOULD APPRECIATE ANY ADDITIONAL INFORMATION WHICH EMB ISLAMABAD COULD PROVIDE WITH REGARD TO ZELLI'S TOUR IN PAKISTAN.

FOLLOWING ON THE HEELS OF THE MILITARY COURT REFORM LEGISLATION, (REPORTED REFTEL), THE GOVERNMENT HAS SUBMITTED A BILL TO THE LEGISLATURE WHICH WOULD INTRODUCE PENAL MEASURES FOR DISCRIMINATION ON GROUNDS OF RACE, CREED OR SEX. THE BILL HAS BEEN APPROVED BY THE SENATE AND IN COMMITTEE BY THE MAJLES. IT WILL BECOME LAW WHEN ADOPTED BY THE FULL MAJLES, MOST LIKELY PRIOR TO THE SUMMER RECESS SCHEDULED TO START THE FIRST WEEK OF AUGUST.

ACCORDING TO THE BILL, INDIVIDUALS FOUND GUILTY OF RACIST PROPAGANDA WILL BE CONDEMNED UP TO SIX MONTHS IN PRISON AND FINED FROM 10,000 TO 50,000 FIALS. MORE SEVERE PENALTIES, UP TO ONE YEAR IMPRISONMENT AND 100,000 RIAL FINE, ARE PROPOSED FOR THOSE WHO FORM GROUPS OR PUBLICATIONS WITH THE PURPOSE OF PROMOTING RACIAL HATRED AND DISCRIMINATION.

EDITORIAL COMMENT IN THE JULY 13 ENGLISH-LANGUAGE DAILY KAYHAN INTERNATIONAL ASSERTED THAT, "IRANIANS BY NATURE, AND BECAUSE OF THEIR TRADITIONAL CULTURAL HERITAGE, ARE FREE FROM THE SOCIAL ATTITUDES WHICH BREED BIAS AND PREJUDICE ON GROUNDS OF RACE AND RELIGION". THE NEW REGULATIONS ARE ONLY NECESSARY, ACCORDING TO KAYHAN, BECAUSE IRANIAN SOCIETY "BEING AN OPEN AND FREE SOCIETY IS EXPOSED TO IDEAS AND WAVES OF PROPAGANDA FROM ALL OVER THE WORLD."

COMMENT: THIS LEGISLATION IS ONLY ONE ELEMENT IN A CONTINUING SERIES OF HUMAN RIGHTS MEASURES TAKEN RECENTLY BY THE GOI. ALSO PENDING FINAL MAJLES APPROVAL IS MILITARY COURT REFORM AND LEGISLATION ENTITLING MOTHERS TO WORK PARTTIME FOR THREE MONTHS FOLLOWING THE BIRTH OF A CHILD (WITH A PROPORTIONATE SALARY BUT WITH NO REDUCTION IN THEIR EMPLOYMENT BENEFITS.) ONE KNOWLEDGEABLE MAJLES DEPUTY HAS TOLD EMBOFF THAT THESE MEASURES HAVE WIDE SUPPORT AMONG THE LEGISLATURE AND "WERE A REAFFIRMATION OF THE PERSIAN TRADITION FROM THE TIME OF CYRUS THE GREAT". FACT THAT SHAH IS SEEN AS INSPIRATION BEHIND THESE MEASURES NO DOUBT CONTRIBUTED TO DEPUTY'S EXPRESSION OF ENTHUSIASM.

1977TEHRAN06381.subject: SOMALIA PRESIDENT'S VISIT TO SAUDI ARABIA

segments.text: SOMALIA AMB SHARMANI TOLD DCM EVENING JULY 18 THAT HE HAD JOINED SOMALIA PRES BARRE FOR THE LATTER'S RECENT VISIT TO SAUDI ARABIA. WHEN ASKED HOW THE VISIT HAD GONE SHARMANI REPLIED THAT "IT WAS NOT ONLY USEFUL BUT FRUITFUL". HE WAS DISINCLINED, HOWEVER, TO GO BEYOND THIS GENERAL OBSERVATION. SAUDI ARABIA AMB BAKR WHO WAS PRESENT AT THE CONVERSATION CONFIRMED THAT "SAUDI ARABIA HAD AN OBLIGATION TO HELP ITS BROTHERS" BUT SEEMED LESS INFORMED THAN SHARMANI ABOUT THE SPECIFIC FORM OF ANY SUCH HELP.

WE HAVE NO RECORD OF HAVING RECEIVED THE TEXT OF THE SHAH'S JUNE 8 LETTER TO THE PRESIDENT REFERRED TO IN REFTEL. PLEASE PROVIDE IMMEDIATELY AS IT IS QUITE POSSIBLE THAT THE SHAH WILL WANT TO DISCUSS THE PRESIDENT'S RESPONSE AND I SHOULD KNOW WHAT WAS WRITTEN IN THE FIRST PLACE.
ON REVIEW OF YOUR LETTER TO MILOS OF JUNE 16 IT SEEMS APPARENT THAT YOU INTENDED TO PROVIDE THE JUNE 8 LETTER BUT IT WAS NOT ENCLOSED. INSTEAD YOU PROVIDED TWO COPIES OF JUNE 1 LETTER.

DURING MY INITIAL CALL ON FINANCE MINISTER HUSHANG ANSARY JULY 20, HE INDICATED HIS DESIRE TO ENHANCE STATUS AND FUNCTION OF US-IRAN JOINT COMMISSION. I SAID SECRETARY VANCE HAD TOLD ME HE SHARED THIS INTENTION.

ANSARY SAID THAT, IN PURSUIT OF THIS OBJECTIVE, HE FELT IT WOULD BE USEFUL TO HAVE FULL-DRESS MEETING TO INVOLVE "NEW U.S. ADMINISTRATION" IN JOINT COMMISSION MATTERS. IT HAD BEEN HIS HOPE TO ARRANGE THIS AS AN EARLY ORDER OF BUSINESS "THIS SUMMER". HOWEVER, HE FELT ENERGY SUBCOMMISSION MEETING WOULD NOW TAKE PRIORITY OVER THE FULL, FORMAL SESSION, WHICH COULD PERHAPS BE HELD IN THE FALL.

I SAID I HAD NO PARTICULAR WASHINGTON GUIDANCE ON THIS SUBJECT, BUT WONDERED HOW ANSARY WOULD REACT TO IDEA OF HAVING MEETING IN CONJUNCTION WITH SHAH'S STATE VISIT IN NOVEMBER. ANSARY SAID HE THOUGH THIS WOULD BE GREAT IDEA AND ASKED ME MEET WITH HIM AGAIN ON THIS SUBJECT IN EARLY AUGUST.

I TOOK OCCASION TO POINT OUT SEVERAL PROBLEMS WE HAVE HAD IN HANDLING JOINT COMMISSION MATTERS AND CITED EXAMPLE OF PUBLIC HIGHWAY TEAM AS CASE IN POINT. ANSARY GAVE ME RATHER SWEEPING ASSURANCES THAT HE WOULD STRAIGHTEN OUT THIS "MINOR MATTER". (I HAVE SOME DOUBTS ABOUT HIS AUTHORITY TO DO THIS.)

ACTION REQUESTED: PLEASE ADVISE SOONEST WHAT PLANS DEPARTMENT HAS FOR NEXT USIRJC MEETING AND WHETHER IT IS FEASIBLE TO DISCUSS THIS WITH ANSARY IN TERMS OF WASHINGTON MEETING IN CONJUNCTION WITH NOVEMBER VISIT BY SHAH. MEETING COULD, FOR EXAMPLE, BE HELD A COUPLE OF DAYS BEFORE SHAH'S ARRIVAL AND (ESPECIALLY IF NUCLEAR BILATERAL MATTERS ARE WELL IN TRAIN) PROVIDE SOME SUBSTANCE TO BE ANNOUNCED DURING COURSE OF STATE VISIT. I WILL NEED GUIDANCE ON THIS SUBJECT NO LATER THAN AUGUST 2.
WE HAVE LEARNED FROM IRANIAN ATTORNEY MUSA SABI THAT HE SAW SEVERAL AMERICAN ATTORNEYS WHILE IN NEW YORK LAST WEEK BUT NO FINAL DECISIONS WERE TAKEN IN CASE OF NASSER AFSHAR.

SABI HAD PLANNED TO CALL ON NEA/IRN DIRECTOR NAAS WHILE IN US BUT NEW YORK POWER FAILURE INTERRUPTED HIS TRAVEL SCHEDULE. HE PLANS TO RETURN SHORTLY TO US AND WILL ARRANGE APPOINTMENT WITH DEPARTMENT OFFICIALS AT THAT TIME.
I CONVEYED YOUR CONGRATULATIONS AND REGARDS TO MANOUTCHEHR ZELLI MORNING JULY 21. ZELLI EXPRESSED HIS THANKS AND RECIPROCATED HIS REGARDS AND APPRECIATION.
FYI I FIND ZELLI ESCRUCIATINGLY CAUTIOUS, BUT PERHAPS HE WILL LOOSEN UP OVER TIME.

LOCAL PRESS HAS GIVEN PROMINENT PUBLICITY TO STATEMENT ISSUED JULY 20 BY GOI MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS SPOKESMAN STRONGLY CRITICAL OF IAN SMITH'S CALL FOR NEW ELECTIONS IN RHODESIA. TERMING SUCH ACTION "SUICIDE", THE SPOKESMAN SAID IT WAS "REGRETTABLE" THAT SMITH HAD DECIDED TO PERPETUATE "THE PRESENT ILLEGAL REGIME OF THAT REALM".

FULL STATEMENT FOLLOWS: "IT IS REGRETTABLE THAT THE ILLEGAL RHODESIA GOVERNMENT, WITHOUT TAKING ANY NOTICE OF THE VARIOUS SOLUTIONS PUT FORWARD TO IT FOR THE PEACEFUL TRANSFER OF POWER TO THE BLACK MAJORITY OF THAT TERRITORY, HAS DISSOLVED PARLIAMENT AND DECIDED TO PERPETUATE THE PRESENT ILLEGAL REGIME IN THAT TERRITORY. FOR HIS (SMITH'S) ADOPTION OF THIS POLICY, WHICH IS IN FACT SUICIDE, THERE IS ONLY ONE EXPLANATION: HE HAS LOST HIS FACULTY OF JUDGMENT AND HE IS UNAWARE OF THE IMPORT OF WHAT HE SAYS."

COMMENT: THIS WAS THE FIRST OFFICIAL COMMENT ON THE RHODESIAN ELECTIONS AND WAS UNCHARACTERISTICALLY BLUNT AS COMPARED WITH USUAL GOI FOREIGN RELATIONS PRONOUNCEMENTS. IT WAS DESCRIBED IN PRESS AS A RESPONSE TO A QUESTION PUT BY THE PARS NEWS AGENCY, BUT MORE LIKELY EXPLANATION IS THAT IT WAS A GOVERNMENT INITIATIVE. THIS STATEMENT IS THE LATEST IN WHAT APPEARS TO BE A CURRENT PUBLIC RELATIONS OFFENSIVE AGAINST THE SMITH REGIME. FIVE DAYS AGO LOCAL PRESS CARRIED A "REMINDER" FROM THE CENTRAL BANK OF IRAN THAT COMMERCIAL BANKS ARE NOT ALLOWED TO ISSUE LETTER OF CREDIT FOR TRADE TRANSACTIONS WITH RHODESIA.
THIS WAS CONFIRMATION OF AN EARLIER GOI DECISION TAKEN IN RESPONSE TO UNITED NATIONS SANCTIONS AGAINST RHODESIA. SULLIVAN NOTE BY OC/T: NOT PASSED.

1977TEHRAN06535.subject: GOI'S NEWLY APPOINTED AMBASSADOR TO YEMEN

segments.text: AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN HAD JULY 24 CONVERSATION WITH GOI AMBASSADOR AMIRUDDIN EFTEKHAR, SHORTLY PRIOR TO LATTER'S DEPARTURE FOR HIS NEW POST IN SANA. EFTEKHAR EXPRESSED INTEREST, INTER ALIA, IN GETTING TO KNOW AND IN WORKING WITH AMBASSADOR SCOTES.
REFTEL PROVIDES BRIEF BIOGRAPHIC INFORMATION. WE SHALL BE INTERESTED IN ANY ADDITIONAL INFORMATION WHICH DEVELOPS DURING EFTEKHAR'S TOUR IN SANA.
JUL 16 KAYHAN INTERNATIONAL NEWSPAPER CARRIED SHORT NEWS REPORT SUBJECT "SURPRISE CATCH FOR FISHERMAN".

NAVAL ATTACHE DISCUSSION WITH IMPERIAL IRANIAN NAVY (IIN) REP REVEALED THAT INCIDENT OCCURRED ABOUT 1 JUL 77 APPROX 4 MILES EAST OF JASK WHERE AN IRANIAN FISHERMAN SAW TWO CYLINDRICAL METAL OBJECTS ON THE BEACH. WHEN HE HANDLED ONE IT EXPLODED CAUSING SERIOUS INJIRIES. THE SECOND ITEM WAS DEFUSED BY GENDARMERIE EOD PERSONNEL WHO WERE CALLED TO THE SCENE BY LOCAL POLICE. ACCORDING TO IIN REP TWO MORE OBJECTS WERE FOUND THREE DAYS LATER IN THE SAME AREA. THE THREE UNEXPLODED TUBES WERE TAKEN TO TEHRAN TO BE FURTHER ANALYSED.
TUBES WERE DESCRIBED AS CYLINDRICAL, 23 CM LONG, 4 CM WIDE, MADE OF ALUMINUM, AND CONTAINED CHINESE MARKINGS.
FURTHER INDENTIFICATION WILL BE REPORTED WHEN INFORMATION IS MADE AVAILABLE BY LOCAL AUTHORITIES.

1977TEHRAN06599.subject: VIETNAMESE DELEGATION VISITS ETHIOPIA AND ATTACKS U.S. IMPERIALISM

segments.text: EMBASSY APPRECIATES RECEIPT OF INFORMATION CONTAINED REF B, REPORTING ON VIETNAMESE VISIT TO ETHIOPIA.
