1977TEHRAN06632.subject: 63RD ECOSOC: PLO MEMBERSHIP IN ECWA WE WOULD APPRECIATE REPORT ON ECOSOC CONSIDERATION OF ITEM ON PLO MEMBERSHIP IN ECWA, IN PARTICULAR VOTE AND

segments.text: WE WOULD APPRECIATE REPORT ON ECOSOC CONSIDERATION OF ITEM ON PLO MEMBERSHIP IN ECWA, IN PARTICULAR VOTE AND ANY EXPLANATION OF REPORTED ABSTENTION BY IRANIAN DEL.

A FURTHER DEMONSTRATION OF CURRENT GOI CAMPAIGN TO PERMIT GREATER FREEDOM OF EXPRESSION IS JULY 25 PUBLIC STATEMENT OF HUSHANG ANSARY, MINISTER OF ECONOMICS AND FINANCE AND LEADER OF THE CONSTRUCTIVE WING OF THE RASTAKHIZ PARTY. INTERVIEW RECEIVED WIDESPREAD TEHRAN PRESS COVERAGE WHICH EMPHASIZED ANSARY'S REMARKS ON FREEDOM OF THE PRESS.

ANSARY SAID THAT FREEDOM OF THOUGHT, FREEDOM OF THE PRESS AND ACCESS TO INFORMATION WERE "AMONG THE INDISPUTABLE RIGHTS" OF THE IRANIAN PEOPLE. HE ADDED THAT WITHOUT FREEDOM OF EXPRESSION AND IDEAS, HOW CAN WE EXPECT THOUGHTS TO BLOSSOM AND THE BEST POLICY ALTERNATIVES TO EMERGE?" THE PRESS SHOULD ENJOY COMPLETE FREEDOM TO DISCUSS DOMESTIC AND INTERNATIONAL AFFAIRS AND IT SHOULD PUBLICIZE THE HAZARDS OF EXTRAVAGANCE AND EDUCATED PEOPLE TO BECOME MORE JUDICIOUS IN THEIR EXPENDITURES, ACCORDING TO ANSARY.

IN A RINGING ENDORSEMENT OF A NATIONAL DIALOGUE ANSARY SAID, "PENS SHOULD WRITE AND TONGUES SHOULD SPEAK SO THAT THIS CLASH OF IDEAS SHOULD LIGHT OUR PATH TOWARDS THE IDEAS OF THE REVOLUTION". THESE IDEALS "WHICH RESPOND TO OUR NEEDS OF TODAY AND TOMORROW" INCLUDE THE MONARCHY, THE CONSTITUTION AND THE WHITE REVOLUTION, HE ADDED. ESCHEWING FOREIGN "ISMS" ANSARY SAID NEITHER CAPITALISM NOR COMMUNISM COULD DEAL ADEQUATELY WITH THE PROBLEMSFACING CONTEMPORARY IRAN. SPECIFICALLY, HE SAID THAT THE WESTERN DEMOCRACIES OPERATED THROUGH PRESSURE GROUPS WHICH GIVE RISE TO DANGEROUS ECONOMIC AND SOCIAL PROBLEMS.

SUCH DANGERS WOULD NOT ARISE IN IRAN, ANSARY NOTED, BECAUSE THE INDIGENOUS IRANIAN SYSTEM DID NOT ALLOW FOR THE PRESENCE OF EITHER PRESSURE GROUPS OR INDIVIDUALS WITH VESTED INTERESTS. IN THE LONGER TERM ANSARY OPINED THAT, "GRADUALLY, AS THE PEOPLE'S POLITICAL MATURITY AND FORESIGHT INCREASES, SO ALSO WILL THEIR SCOPE FOR POLITICAL ACTIVITIES". HE SAID THAT CRITICISM WAS AN ESSENTIAL PART OF SOCIAL LIFE IN THE RASTAKHIZ ERA.

TO ENSURE THAT NO MISUNDERSTANDING REGARDING HIS INTERPRETATION OF CRITICISM AROSE HE EXPLAINED, "BY CRITICISM I MEAN THE REGULAR FLOW OF CORRECT INFORMATION THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY WITH THE AIM OF ESTABLISHING DEMOCRATIC VALUES AND POLITICAL LIBERTIES APACE WITH THE DEVELOPMENT OF ECONOMIC DEMOCRACY".

COMMENT: ANSARY'S INTERVIEW CLOSELY FOLLOWS TWO SPEECHES GIVEN WITHIN THE PAST THREE WEEKS BY PRIME MINISTER HOVEYDA IN W HE PROCLAIMED THAT EVERY IRANIAN HAS THE RIGHT TO CRITICIZE AND DIFFER IN ALL NATIONAL AFFAIRS EXCEPT WHERE "THE ESSENCE OF IRAN'S NATIONHOOD IS CONCERNED". THE EXCEPTIONS INCLUDE THE UNTOUCHABLE TRINITY: MONARCH, CONSTITUTION AND WHITE REVOLUTION. ANSARY'S REMARKS DO NOT STRAY FROM HOVEYDA'S EARLIER PRONOUNCEMENTS BUT CONTINUE THE PRESENT CAMPAIGN OF INVITING "CONSTRUCTIVE CRITICISM" WITHIN WELL DEFINED BOUNDARIES. THIS RECENT ACTIVITY BY GOVERNMENT LEADERS IS A REFLECTION OF AN INCREASINGLY TOLERATE OFFICIAL ATTITUDE WHICH HAS DEVELOPED OVER THE PAST TWO YEARS TOWARD CRITICISM OF THE GOVERNMENT.
(REFAIR, POUCHED ADDRESSEE POSTS, PROVIDES MORE COMPLETE ACCOUNT OF CURRENT STIRRINGS OF DISSENT IN IRAN.)
RE EXCHANGE OF LETTERS REFERRED TO PARA 2 REFTEL: POST HAS RECEIVED HUMPHREY LETTER AS USINFO. PRESIDENT CARTER'S LETTER HAS NOT REPEAT NOT BEEN RECEIVED. PLEASE TRANSMIT IMMEDIATELY.

1977TEHRAN06806.subject: CHANGE OF PRIME MINISTERS IM THE MAKING?

segments.text: THE TEHRAN RUMOR MILL, WHICH PERIODICALLY AHS PREDICTED HOVEYDA'S DEPARTURE AS PRIME MINISTER (AFTER NEARLY 13 YEARS ON THE JOB), HAS BEEN WORKING AT A HIGHER PITCH THAN USUAL IN RECENT WEEKS. SEVERAL OF OUR DIPLOMATIC COLLEAGUES, INCLUDING THE BRITISH, FRENCH AND CANADIANS, SAY THEY ARE CONVINCED THAT THIS TIME THE RUMORS RING TRUE.

PREDICTIONS IN THIS AREA ARE CHANCY, AS WE NOTED IN OUR A-116 OF JULY 11, SINCE IN THE FINAL ANALYSIS THE SHAH IS THE ONLY ONE WHO REALLY KNOWS AND HE RARELY TIPS HIS HAND IN ADVANCE. THE MAIN ARGUMENT ADVANCED FOR A CHANGE IS POSSIBLE DESIRE ON THE SHAH'S PART TO CHANGE GOI'S IMAGE AS A WAY OF DEFUSING COMPLAINTS ABOUT SUCH THINGS AS RECURRING SUMMER ELECTRICAL POWER SHORTAGES IN THE CAPITAL AS WELL AS SUGGESTING A MORE TOLERANT NEW ATTITUDE TOWARD PUBLIC COMPLAINTS AND OTHER EXPRESSIONS OF DISSENT.

THE LEADING CANDIDATE FOR MOST OBSERVERS IS MINISTER OF ECONOMIC AFFAIRS AND FINANCE ANSARY, THOUGH A NUMBER OF OTHER MINISTERS AND FORMER PRIME MINISTERS ALSO ARE MENTIONED. SOMEWHAT GREATER PUBLIC EXPOSURE IN THE PRESS FOR ANSARY AND ONE OR TWO OTHERS RECENTLY CIETED AS POSSIBLE STRAW IN THE WIND.

ON THE OTHER HAND, WE ARE AWARE OF NO COMPELLING REASON FOR REPLACEMENT OF HOVEYDA AT THIS TIME. HIS PUBLIC IMAGE HAS NOT DETERIORATED IN ANY SIGNIFICANT WAY. HE HAS RETURNED FROM VACATION IN CORSICA STILL IN APPARENT GOOD HEALTH, AND HE WOULD APPEAR TO ENJOY THE CONFIDENCE OF THE SHAH AS MUCH AS EVER. CHANGES OF OTHER MINISTERS COULD SERVE TO BLUNT CURRENT CRITICISM WITHOUT NECESSARILY CHANGING THE PRIME MINISTER.

WHICH OF THE ABOVE FACTORS PRESENTLY RATES UPPERMOST IN THE MIND OF THE SHAH IS DIFFICULT TO GUESS. WE MAY LEARN MORE AFTER MEETING OF THE RASTAKHIZ PARTY POLITICAL BUREAU CONVENED BY HOVEYDA FOR TOMORROW NIGHT, AUGUST 2.

THE SHAH TOLD ME AUGUST 1 THAT HE HAD JUST RECEIVED A LETTER FROM PRES SADAT EXPLAINING THE BORDER CLASH WITH LIBYA. THE SHAH'S DRY COMMENT WAS THAT SADAT WAS A LITTLE TARDY IN GETTING OUT HIS EXPLANATION. IN HIS VIEW, THE GENERAL WORLD APPRECIATION OF THE FIGHTING WAS THAT EGYPT WAS THE AGGRESSOR. THE SHAH COULD NOT UNDERSTAND WHY SADAT HAD NOT PUBLICIZED LIBYAN ATTACKS WHICH LED UP TO THE EGYPTIAN RAID.

AS FOR THE MILITARY OUTCOME OF THE ACTION, THE SHAH SAID HE WAS DISAPPOINTED. HE HAD PREVIOUSLY COUNSELED SADAT THAT, IF HE WAS GOING TO HAVE A GO AT QADHAFI, HE SHOULD "FINISH HIM OFF". NOW, QADHAFI EMERGES AS A HERO IN LIBYA AND SADAT HAS LOST STATUS WITH HIS OWN MILITARY.

FOR WHAT IT IS WORTH, THE EGYPTIAN EMB LINE ON THE LOCAL COCKTAIL CIRCUIT IS THAT THE SOVIETS PROVOKED THE ACTION BECAUSE THEY SAW A PEACEFUL SETTLEMENT TO THE ARAB-ISRAEL DISPUTE BEGINNING TO CONSOLIDATE AND THEY WISH TO FRUSTRATE SUCH A SETTLEMENT BY DISRUPTING ARAB UNITY.
WE HAVE LEARNED THAT THE GOI PLANS SHORTLY TO ANNOUNCE TWO NEW AMBASSADORIAL APPOINTMENTS.

IRAJ AMINI, PRESENTLY SPECIAL ADVISOR FOR INTERNATIONAL AFFAIRS TO PRINCESS ASHRAF, WILL BE NAMED AMB TO TUNISIA. AMINI, 39, COMES FROM A PROMINENT LANDOWNING IRANIAN FAMILY AND IS INDEPENDENTLY WEALTHY. HIS FATHER, ALI AMINI, WAS PRIMIN DURING THE PERIOD 1961-62. HIS WIFE, VIDA, IS THE DAUGHTER OF A FORMER TEHRAN UNIVERSITY CHANCELLOR. AMINI HAS A DEGREE IN POLITICAL SCIENCE FROM THE UNIV OF WASHINGTON. HE WORKED FOR SEVERAL YEARS FOR IRAN PHILIPS COMPANY, SUBSEQUENTLY PASSED THE IRANIAN MFA ENTRANCE EXAMINATION, AND HAS WORKED INT THE CENTO SECTION OF THE MFA. HE HAS BEEN DETAILED TO THE COURT MINISTRY WHILE WORKIING FOR PRINCESS ASHRAF.

AMINI HAS BEEN A CONTACT OF A SERIES OF EMBOFFS WHO CONSIDERED HIM POLITE, POLISHED AND OUTWARDLY FRIENDLY TO THE US. WITHIN THE PAST TWO YEARS HE EXPRESSED DISAPPOINTMENT AT WHAT HE PERCEIVED AS THE GROWING GAP BETWEEN RICH AND POOR IN IRAN. HE WAS NOT SANGUINE ABOUT THE FUTURE OF IRAN AND FELT FRUSTRATED AT HIS INABILITY TO INFLUENCE GOI DECISIONS.

HOOSHANG AMIR-MOKRI, FIFTYISH, IS SCHEDULED TO BE POSTED AS IRANIAN AMB TO BONN. HE IS CURRENTLY A DIR GEN IN MFA AND SUPERVISES SEVERAL DEPARTMENTS, NOTABLY THE DEPT OF INTERNATIONAL AFFAIRS. A CAREER DIPLOMAT, HE HAS BEEN IN HIS PRESENT POSITION FOR SEVERAL YEARS AND PRIOR TO THAT WAS HEAD OF THE INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS DEPT. HE ALSO SERVED A NUMBER OF YEARS WITH THE IRANIAN DEL TO THE UN IN NEW YORK. EMB CONTACTS HAVE FOUND AMIR-MOKRI FRIENDLY AND KNOWLEDGEABLE. HE LISTENS CAREFULLY, UNDERSTANDS THE POINT QUICKLY AND DOES NOT INDULGE IN PALAVER. HE HAS BEEN GOOD IN GETTING DECISIONS FOR US WITHIN DEADLINES, SOMETIMES IMMEDIATELY MAKING THE DECISION HIMSELF.
IN SUM, HE IS AN EXTREMELY COMPETENT TECHNOCRAT WHO SEEMS DISPOSED TO BE HELPFUL TO AMERICANS WHENEVER HE CAN.

MAJLES AND SENATE HAVE NOW PASSED MILITARY COURT REFORM BILL. IN VIEW OF IMPORTANCE THIS LEGISLATION FOR HUMAN RIGHTS IN IRAN, I SUGGESTED IN REFTEL THAT VICE PRES MONDALE MIGHT BE SOUNDED OUT AS TO HIS DESIRE TO CORRESPOND WITH SHARIF-EMEMI, PRES OF THE IRANIAN SENATE. WOULD APPRECIATE DEPT'S REPLY AS TO WHERE THIS SUGGESTION STANDS. I SHALL BE SEEING SHARIF-EMEMI IN CONNECTION WITH CONSTITUTION DAY CEREMONIES TONIGHT AND TOMORROW AND COULD PASS SOME VERBAL MESSAGE TO HIM AS APPROPRIATE.

1977TEHRAN06938.subject: WORLD CONFERENCE FOR ACTION AGAINST APARTHEID

segments.text: MFA INFORMED EMBOFF AUG 4 THAT GOI WILL BE REPRESENTED AT CONFERENCE BY AMB SHAHROKH FIROOZ, RESIDENT IN LAGOS. SECOND MEMBER OF DEL WILL BE SEIFOLLAH SADEGHI, ACTING HEAD, MFA INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS DEPT.

MFA STILL IN PROCESS OF DRAWING UP SPECIFIC POSITION PAPER FOR CONFERNECE, BUT GENERAL THEME WILL BE CONTINUATIONS OF GOI'S PREVIOUS POSITION ON THIS ISSUE IN GENERAL ASSEMBLY DEBATES. TO ASSIST GOI IN FINAL PREPARATIONS IT WOULD BE HELPFUL TO KNOW IF IT IS ANTICIPATED THAT A PROGRAM OF ACTION WILL BE ADOPTED OR IF ONLY A DECLARATION WILL BE ISSUED AT CONCLUSION OF CONFERENCE.

ACTION REQUESTED: WE WOULD APPRECIATE DEPT'S VIEWS ON QUESTION RAISED PARA 2 ABOVE AND ALSO BACKGROUND ON US POSITION WHEN THIS AVAILABLE. WE COULD DISCUSS THIS SUBJECT FURTHER WITH SADEGHI, IF SUCH ADDITIONAL GUIDANCE IS PROVIDED PRIOR TO AUGUST 10.

DURING THE PAST 2 WEEKS THERE HAS BEEN INCREASED ACTIVITY ON THE PART OF THE RASTAKHIZ PARTY LEADERSHIP BEGINNING WITH CONSTRUCTIVE WING LEADER HUSHANG ANSARY'S PRESS INTERVIEW ON JULY 25 (REFTEL). FOLLOWING THE ANSARY STATEMENT, PROGRESSIVE WING COORDINATOR ABDOLMAJID MAJIDI (WHO IS ALSO MINISTER OF STATE AND DIRECTOR OF THE PLAN AND BUDGET ORGANIZATION) DISCUSSED HIS WING'S PHILOSOPHY IN SEVERAL RECENT INTERVIEWS WITH THE LOCAL PRESS. THAT WING HAS DEVELOPED A 6 POINT "PLATFORM" ENCOMPASSING THE FOLLOWING AREAS: EQUALITY UNDER LAW; PRODUCTIVITY AND EFFICIENCY; DECENTRALIZATION AND PUBLIC PARTICIPATION IN ECONOMIC AND SOCIAL LIFE; ENVIRONMENT: CONCERNS OF YOUTH; AND OIL INCOME SUBSTITUTION.

MAJIDI HAS EMPHASIZED PARTICULARLY THE NEED TO STRENGTHEN PUBLIC PARTICIPATION IN NATIONAL AFFAIRS, NOTING THAT PEOPLE "MUST BE KEPT INFORMED OF REALITIES, AND WE MUST PUT THE FACTS AND FIGURES AT THEIR DISPOSAL". AS DID ANSARY EARLIER, MAJIDI, ON AUG 3, SUPPORTED FREEDOM OF EXPRESSION AS "AN INDISPUTABLE RIGHT OF ALL IRANIANS". HE ADDED THAT "THE GOVERNMENT MUST ALWAYS GUARD AGAINST THE VIOLATION OF THESE PRINCIPLES, DUE TO RED TAPE, BY THE VERY OFFICIALS CHARGED WITH CARRYING THEM OUT."

MAJIDI, ASKED ON SEVERAL OCCASIONS TO CHARACTERIZE THE DIFFERENCES BETWEEN THE PARTY'S TWO WINGS, HAS COMMENTED THAT HIS RESPONSE WOULD HAVE TO AWAIT FORMULATION OF MORE PRECISE CONSTRUCTIVE WING POLICIES. WHEN ASKED AUG 3 IF THE TWO WINGS WOULD BE REPRESENTED BY SEPARATE FACTIONS IN THE MAJLES, PROGRESSIVE COORDINATING COMMITTEE MEMBER DEPUTY HALAKU RAMBOD SAID THAT THE QUESTION WAS INITIALLY CONSIDERED BUT REJECTED SINCE THE TWO WINGS AIM TO REINFORCE PARTY SOLIDARITY AND WOULD NOT, THEREFORE, TAKE SPECIFIC STANDS IN THE MAJLES. FOR HIS PART, ANSARY ON JULY 27 SAID THAT HE FORESAW NO "CONFRONTATION" IN VIEWS BETWEEN THE TWO WINGS.

APART FROM THESE PUBLIC APPEARANCES BY PARTY LEADERS, THERE HAS BEEN INTERNAL DEVELOPMENT WITHIN EACH WING DURING THE PAST FEW WEEKS. THE COORDINATING COMITE OF THE PROGRESSIVE WING HELD ITS FIRST MEETING ON JULY 27 AT WHICH DISCUSSION CENTERED ON A PROGRAM OF ACTION FOR THE WING'S WORKING GROUPS AND PROVINCIAL COMITES AND A PLAN FOR MEETINGS WITH THE PRESS OVER THE NEXT 6 WEEKS. ON THE SAME DAY ANSARY ANNOUNCED THAT THE CONSTRUCTIVE WING WOULD ALSO FORM WORKING GROUPS WHICH WILL EXAMINE IRAN'S POLITICAL, ECONOMIC, SOCIAL, CULTURAL AND INTERNATIONAL POLICIES. PRESUMABLY OUT OF THESE GROUPS WILL EMERGE THE CONSTRUCTIVE WING'S "PLATFORM".

COMMENT: THESE PRONOUNCEMENTS CONTINUE THE CURRENT GOI PUBLIC CAMPAIGN OF SUPPORTING FREEDOM OF EXPRESSION ALBEIT WITHIN THE BOUNDARIES OF "CONSTRUCTIVE CRITICISM". AT THE SAME TIME , THE RASTAKHIZ PARTY APPEARS TO BE ENTERING A NEW PHASE OF INCREASED ORGANIZATIONAL ACTIVITY. IF PRESENT TREND CONTINUES, WE CAN EXPECT GREATER FOCUS ON WING ACTIVITIES AND THE EXPOSITION OF TWO SEPARATE, BUT COMPATIBLE, WING PLATFORMS OR APPROACHES TO SPECIFIC ISSUES. ON THE OTHER HAND, THE WING ORGANIZATIONAL CONCEPT HAS NOT YET RECEIVED SUCH EXTENSIVE PARTY ATTENTION AS TO CATCH THE PUBLIC IMAGINATION.

A REFLECTION OF PUBLIC ATTITUDE WAS RECENT INTERVIEW IN LOCAL PRESS WITH ONE DR SEPEHR ZABIH, IDENTIFIED ONLY AS AN "IRANIAN RESEARCH SCHOLAR AT UC, BERKELEY," WHO STATED: "IT IS NOT CLEAR TO ME WHY THESE TWO WINGS SHOULD BE ACTIVE FOR A WHILE AND THEN LAPSE INTO NON-ACTIVITY. I DO NOT UNDERSTAND THEIR PAST ROLES IN SOCIETY AND I DO NOT KNOW WHAT THEIR ROLES WILL BE IN THE FUTURE." OBVIOUSLY GREATER EFFORTS BY THE PARTY ARE REQUIRED IF RASTAKHIZ PHILOSOPHY IS TO EXTEND BEYOND A VERY LIMITED CIRCLE OF GOVT LEADERS.

BRITISH AMBASSADOR HAS BEEN IN TOUCH BUT IT HIS UNDERSTANDING AND HE BELIEVES UNDERSTANDING IN LONDON THAT HE WOULD SEE SHAH FIRST AND I MIGHT FOLLOW UP IN SEPERATE APPOINTMENT. PLEASE CLARIFY AND ALSO ADVISE WHETHER EFFORT MUST BE WITH THE SHAH WHO I SAW ONLY LAST MONDAY.

PURSUANT TO INSTRUCTIONS REFTEL, I CALLED ON FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY MORNING AUGUST 4 TO PROVIDE HIM LIST OF WEAPONS WHICH SOMALIS ARE SEEKING FROM U.S. AND TO GIVE HIM WASHINGTON EVAULATION OF SAME. KHALATBARY, WHO HAS JUST RETURNED FROM VACATION, THANKED ME AND SAID THERE WAS NOTHING NEW ON IRANIAN SIDE.

I THEN INFORMED HIM OF MY CONVERSATION WITH SHAH AUGUST 1 IN WHICH LATTER TOLD ME HE HAD DECIDED SEND RIFLES. KHALATBARY SAID THIS WAS NEWS TO HIM, BUT ADDED THAT HE HAD NOT YET SEEN SHAH SINCE HIS RETURN FROM LEAVE. HE WOULD GO TO CASPIAN FOR AUDIENCE AUGUST 5 AND RETURN AFTERNOON AUGUST 6. HE EXPECTED TO BE ABLE TO INFORM ME AUGUST 7 WHAT WAS INVOLVED IN THIS TRANSACTION.

SOMALI AMBASSADOR, WHO HAS ATTACHED HIMSELF RATHER CLOSELY TO ME IN RECENT DAYS, CAME TO ME EVENING AUGUST 3 TO COMPLAIN IN RATHER AGITATED ITALIAN THAT IRANIANS HAD LET HIM DOWN AND DECLINED TO PROVIDE ANYTHING. I COUNSELED PATIENCE AND TRUST THAT THE SHAH'S DECISION WILL TRICKLE THROUGH THE BUREAUCRACY IN THE NEXT FEW DAYS.
DEPARTMENT PLEASE REPEAT STATE 182738 TO US.

WE HAVE ESTABLISHED WITH THE COURT AFTER COORDINATION WITH BRITISH HERE THAT REQUEST IS FOR JOINT AUDIENCE WITH THE SHAH. WE ARE TOLD IT IS A BUSY TIME AND IT MAY BE A "COUPLE OF DAYS" BEFORE MEETING OCCUR. NOTWITHSTANDING, TRUST WE WILL RECEIVE IMMEDIATELY AGREED UPON TALKING POINTS SO THAT BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND I CAN COMPARE NOTES WITHIN NEXT 12 HOURS IN CASE AUDIENCE EVENTUATES AUGUST 8 LOCAL TIME.

RUMORED RESIGNATION OF HOVEYDA (REFTEL) TOOK PLACE AUGUST 6. HOVEYDA ANNOUNCED HE WAS RESIGNING TO ACCEPT A NEW APPOINTMENT FROM THE SHAH AND BY NOON AUGUST 7 IT WAS ANNOUNCED HE WOULD REPLACE AILING ASSADOLLAH ALAM AS COURT MINISTER.

SOMEWHAT CONTRARY TO RUMOR MILL, MINISTER OF STATE AND RASTAKHIZ PARTY CHIEF JAMSHID AMOUZEGAR HAS BEEN APPOINTED NEW PRIMIN. HE THUS BECOMES IRAN'S FIRST PRIMIN EDUCATED IN US (CORNELL AND WASHINGTON UNIVERSITIESL. THE SHAH WOULD APPEAR TO HAVE ACCOMPLISHED AT LEAST THREE PURPOSES WITH THIS SWITCH. FIRST, HE HAS FOUND A REPLACEMENT FOR ALAM. SECOND, HE HAS REACTED TO VOCAL CRITICISM ON ELECTRICITY SHORTAGES AND OTHER INTERNAL POPULAR COMPLAINTS THIS SUMMER. THIRD, BY CHOOSING THE HEAD OF RASTAKHIZ PARTY, SHAH HAS REINFORCED HIS OWN PUBLIC UTTERNACES AND THOSE OF SEVERAL MINISTERS, EMPHASIZING KEY ROLE OF PARTY IN IRANIAN DEVELOPMENT.

PUBLIC ANNOUNCEMENT OF NEW CABINET INDICATES MANY MINISTERS REMAIN AS HOLDOVERS, INCLUDING ANSARY FOR ECONOMIC AFFAIRS AND FINANCE, KHALATBARY FOR FOREIGN AFFAIRS, AZIMI FOR WAR, GANJI FOR EDUCATION AND AFKHAMI MINISTER OF STATE FOR WOMEN'S AFFAIRS. THERE ARE SEVERAL TECHNICIANS AMONG NEW APPOINTEES AND THESE INCLUDE AT LEAST TWO AMOUZEGAR ASSISTANTS FROM RASTAKHIZ PARTY AND ELSEWHERE: HOMAYOUN WHO TAKES OVER INFORMATION AND TOURISM AND MANUCHEHR AGAH, MINISTER OF STATE.

RETENTION OF STRONG-WILLED MINISTERS SUCH AS ANSARY WOULD SUGGEST POSSIBILITY OF SOME EARLY STORMS IN THE CABINET SINCE, ON PAST FORM, AMOUZEGAR IS NOT NOTED AS A CONCILIATOR LIKE HOVEYDA. HIS STYLE TENDS MORE TOWARD DOMINATION OF CABINET COLLEAGUES. THIS WOULD BE PARTICULARLY TRUE IF, AS EXPECTED, AMOUZEGAR TAKES PARTICULAR INTEREST IN FINANCIAL-ECONOMIC REFORMS SUCH AS A RENEWED DRIVE AGAINST CORRUPTION, REVISION OF THE TAX STRUCTURE, AND DEVELOPMENT OF CAPITAL MARKETS WITH GREATER GOVERNMENTAL REGULATION.
WE SHALL BE COMMENTING IN GREATER DETAIL WHEN ENTIRE NEW CABINET IS ANNOUNCED.

1977TEHRAN06994.subject: JAMSHID AMOUZEGAR APPOINTED PRIMIN IT HAS JUST BEEN ANNOUNCED THAT JAMSHID AMOUZEGAR HAS BEEN NAMED PRIMIN REPLACING AMIR ABBAS HOVEYDA, WH

segments.text: IT HAS JUST BEEN ANNOUNCED THAT JAMSHID AMOUZEGAR HAS BEEN NAMED PRIMIN REPLACING AMIR ABBAS HOVEYDA, WHO IS MOVING OVER TO MINISTER OF COURT POSITION. YOU MAY RECALL YOUR MEETING AMOUZEGAR AT DCM MIKLOS' RESIDENCE WHEN YOU VISITED HERE IN MAY AND YOUR SUBSEQUENT BREAKFAST WITH HIM IN PARIS, AND HOW FAVORABLY IMPRESSED YOU WERE AT THE TIME. A PERSONAL MESSAGE OF CONGRATULATIONS RECALLING YOUR MEETINGS WOULD, WE BELIEVE, BE WELCOMED AND APPRECIATED. SUGGEST SOMETHING ALONG THE FOLLOWING LINE: DEAR MR PRIME MINISTER: IT IS WITH GREAT PLEASURE THAT I LEARNED OF YOUR APPOINTMENT AS IRAN' PRIME MINISTER.

I RECALL VIVIDLY OUR MEETING TEHRAN IN MAY AND OUR SUBSEQUENT TALKS IN PARIS. YOUR INSIGHTS INTO DOMESTIC AND INTERNATIONAL ISSUES WERE MOST IMPRESSIVE AND DOUBTLESS LED TO HIS IMPERIAL MAJESTY'S DECISION TO SELECT YOU TO SUCCEED YOUR DISTINGUISHED PREDECESSOR AMIR ABBAS HOVEYDA. WE HAVE ENJOYED THE CLOSEST OF RELATIONS WITH YOUR COUNTRY AND WITH YOU PERSONALLY IN YOUR MANY OTHER HIGH GOVERNMENT POSITIONS AND WE LOOK FORWARD TO A CONTINUATION OF THIS RELATIONSHIP WHICH HAS PROVED TO HAVE BEEN OF SUCH BENEFIT TO BOTH OF OUR COUNTRIES.

I WOULD LIKE TO TAKE THIS OCCASION TO WISH YOU PERSONALLY WARMEST CONGRATULATIONS AND SINCEREST BEST WISHES AS YOU ASSUME YOUR NEW RESPONSIBILITIES. CORDIALLY, CYRUS VANCE END . SULLIVAN NOTE BY OC/T: NOT PASSED TO SECRETARY.

THE 71ST ANNIVERSARY OF IRAN'S CONSTITUTIONAL REVOLUTION ON AUGUST 5 WAS THE OCCASION FOR A SPEECH TO THE NATION BY THE SHAH. REFERRING TO IRAN'S RICH CULTURAL HERITAGE AND ANCIENT CIVILIZATION, THE SHAH SAID THAT THE COUNTRY WOULD RETAIN ITS OWN CONCEPT OF DEMOCRACY AS PRACTICED AND WOULD AVOID DISRUPTIVE PRACTICES CREATED BY DEMOCRACY ABROAD. SPECIFICALLY HE SAID: "DEMOCRACY THAT ENTAILS TURMOIL AND BREEDS ANARCHY HAS ADVERSE EFFECTS FOR OTHERS AS WELL AS BEING TOTALLY UNACCEPTABLE TO OURSELVES."

EMPHASIZING THE RIGHTS PRESENTLY AVAILABLE TO IRANIANS, THE SHAH SINGLED OUT THE RASTAKHIZ PARTY AS A FORUM FOR FREE EXPRESSION AND CONSTRUCTIVE CRITICISM. FOR THE FIRST TIME SINCE THE VICTORY OF THE CONSTITUTIONAL REVOLUTION, THE PEOPLE HAVE A CONSTRUCTIVE POLITICAL ORGANIZATION WHICH EMBRACES ALL IRANIANS AND FACILITATES THEIR PARTICIPATION IN NATIONAL AFFAIRS, ACCORDING TO THE SHAH. THROUGH A RASTAKHIZ PARTY DIALOGUE THENATION'S POLITICAL CONSCIOUSNESS IS CONSTANTLY ENRICHED AND STRENGTHENED, HE ADDED.

COMMENT: BY STRESSING TRADITIONAL IRANIAN VALUES AND REJECTING THE "IMPORTATION OF FOREIGN DEMOCRACY" THE SHAH ELABORATED ON A THEME RECENTLY INITIATED BY RASTAKHIZ PARTY CONSTRUCTIVE WING LEADER HUSHANG ANSARY (REFTEL). AN UNDERLYING THEME EMERGING FROM RECENT PRONOUNCEMENT OF GOVERNMENT LEADERS IS THAT POLITICAL DEMOCRACY, AS PRACTICED IN WESTERN INDUSTRIAL COUNTRIES, CANNOT BE STABLE AND LONG LASTING IN IRAN UNLESS BASED UPON STRONG ECONOMIC DEMOCRACY. UNTIL SUCH TIME AS ECONOMIC CONDITIONS BRING ABOUT WHAT THE LEADERSHIP JUDGES TO BE "POLITICAL MATURITY" THE RASTAKHIZ PARTY WILL SERVE AS THE APPROPRIATE INSTRUMENT FOR POLITICAL EXPRESSION.
BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND I HAVE JOINT AUDIENCE WITH SHAH SCHEDULED FOR 1030 AM TUESDAY AUGUST 9 AT RAMSAR ON CASPIAN TO DISCUSS RHODESIA.

I COMPARED TALKING POINTS REF B WITH BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND HIS HEAD OF CHANCERY MORNING AUGUST 8. LONDON HAD NOT YET SENT THEM REVISED TEXT BUT WERE USING EARLIER VERSION PROVIDED BY AF BUREAU PRIOR REVISION BY SECRETARY. AMBASSADOR TELEPHONED LONDON TO ASK FOR LATEST VERSION.

AMBASSADOR ALSO SHOWED ME CABLE FROM SOUTH AFRICA INDICATING THAT SHAH HAD ALREADY TOLD SOUTH AFRICANS HE INTENDED TURN OFF OIL FOR RHODESIA UNLESS SMITH SHAPES UP. THIS SUGGESTS HE IS ALREADY ONE STEP AHEAD OF US.

EXPRESSED APPRECIATION FOR THIS INFORMATION AND SAID THAT THE BASIC THOUGHT HE WISHED TO CONVEY WAS THAT THE GOI WAS IN PRINCIPLE FAVORABLY INCLINED TO HELP CHAD WITH MILITARY EQUIPMENT. THE BALL IS NOW IN OUR COURT.

IN ACCORDANCE WITH INSTRUCTIONS REFTEL, BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND I HAD JOINT AUDIENCE WITH SHAH AT RAMSAR MORNING AUGUST 9 TO DISCUSS RHODESIA. MY BRITISH COLLEAGUE MADE SUCCINCT BUT DETAILED ORAL PRESENTATION OF TALKING POINTS, TO WHICH SHAH LISTENED ATTENTIVELY.

IN REPLY SHAH SAID WE COULD REPORT TO SECRETARIES VANCE AND OWEN THAT HE SUPPORTS THE UK-US PROPOSALS. HE WENT ON TO SAY THAT HE CONSIDERS THIS COURSE OF ACTION THE ONLY POSSIBLE SOLUTION TO THE RHODESIAN PROBLEM. HE SAID HE WOULD BE WILLING, IF THE TWO SECRETARIES THOUGHT IT DESIRABLE, TO MAKE HIS VIEWS KNOWN TO BOTHA THROUGH THE SOUTH AFRICAN REPRESENTATIVE IN TEHRAN.

HE INDICATED THAT PRIME MINISTER VORSTER HAD PROPOSED COMING TO TEHRAN, BUT THE SHAH HAD PUT HIM OFF. IF THE UK AND US THOUGHT IT WOULD HELP FOR HIM TO HAVE A PERSONAL INTERCESSION WITH VORSTER, HE WOULD ALSO BE WILLING TO REACTIVATE THE PROPOSALS FOR THAT VISIT.

SHAH AGREED THAT AN "INTERNAL" SOLUTION, WITH BLACK REPRESENTATIVES OF SMITH'S OWN CHOOSING, WOULD BE DOOMED BEFORE IT BEGAN BECAUSE IT WOULD NEVER BE ACCEPTED BY WORLD OPINION. HE SEEMED TO HAVE SOME DOUBTS ABOUT UK-UK-UN ABILITY TO KEEP THE GUERRILLAS UNDER CONTROL, BUT FELT THE EFFORT HAD TO BE MADE.

IN COMMENTING ON THE POSSIBILITY THAT WORLD-WIDE PRESSURE MIGHT BE REQUIRED TO BRING SOUTH AFRICA INTO LINE, THE SHAH SAID THAT HE FELT IT PARTICULARLY IMPORTANT THAT THE FRENCH (AS ARMS SUPPLIERS) BE BROUGHT ALONG AND THAT SECRETARIES VANCE AND OWEN SHOULD BE ABLE TO TELL BOTHA THAT FRANCE FULLY SUPPORTS THE UK-US EFFORT. THE BRITISH AMBASSADOR ASSURED HIM THAT PARIS WAS ABOARD. (FYI. I HAVE NO RPT NO CABLES INFORMING ME OF STATE OF PLAY WITH FRENCH OR OTHER "CLOSEST FRIENDS" AND WOULD APPRECIATE LEARNING THEIR IDENTITY.)

FINALLY, SHAH RECONFIRMED IRANIAN WILLINGNESS TO CONTRIBUTE TO A UN DEVELOPMENT FUND FOR RHODESIA AND, IF NECESSARY, TO TAKE WHITE REFUGEES INTO IRAN FOR RESETTLEMENT. HE SAID THEY COULD NOT BUY LAND HERE BUT WOULD BE ALLOWED TO LEASE IT FOR "SAY, TWENTY-FIVE YEARS." OTHER SKILLS COULD ALSO BE ACCOMMODATED AS IMMIGRANTS.

BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND I THANKED SHAH FOR HIS SUPPORT AND ASSURED HIM THAT WE WOULD KEEP HIM INFORMED OF OUTCOME AUGUST 12 MEETING. SHAH ALSO EXPRESSED INTEREST IN LEARNING RESULTS OF AUGUST 13 MEETING SCHEDULED WITH NYERERE, AS WELL AS ANY OTHER INDICATIONS OF NYERERE'S VIEWS GLEANED FROM HIS US VISIT.
SUBSTANCE REFTEL PARAS 3 AND 4 CONVEYED TO MEHDI SARRAM, DIRECTOR, NUCLEAR SAFEGUARDS AND PHYSICAL SECURITY, ATOMIC ENERGY ORGANIZATION OF IRAN.
EMB ASSUMES DR ETEMAD, AEOI, PRESIDENT, WILL GIVE HIS PERSONAL COMMENTS ON REF MESSAGE IN WASHINGTON.

1977TEHRAN07074.subject: SHAH'S COMMENTS ON ECONOMIC GROWTH AND PLANNING IN IRAN

segments.text: THE SHAH'S REMARKS TO NEWLY NAMED PRIMIN JAMSHID AMOUZEGAR AND HIS CABINET AT NOWSHAHR ON AUG 7 WERE PRINCIPALLY ON ECONOMIC THEMES AND WITH MAJOR EMPHASIS ON WHAT HE THOUGHT THE GENERAL STRUCTURE OF THE 6TH DEVELOPMENT PLAN (WHICH BEGINS MARCH 21, 1978) OUTHT TO LOOK LIKE. A SUMMARY OF THE MAIN POINTS MADE BY THE SHAH IN HIS ADDRESS FOLLOWS

THE SHAH SAID THAT BEGINNING NOW AND CONTINUING ON INTO THE 6TH PLAN THE NATION'S DEVELOPMENT EFFORT WILL BE AIMED AT "ABSORBABLE" RATES OF GROWTH RATHER THAN THE "UNMATCHED GROWTH RATES" OF THE RECENT PAST. IRAN'S RECENT PERFORMANCE, WHILE "UNMATCHED" IN THE WORLD NEVERTHELESS HAD CAUSED "DISLOCATION AND BACKLASH". HE WENT ON TO SAY THAT A 20 PERCENT GROWTH RATE GOING HAND IN HAND WITH 25 PERCENT INFLATION RATE "WOULD RAVISH MOST OF THE FRUITS OF DEVELOPMENT". A RERUN OF THIS RECENT "UNPARALLELED DEVELOPMENT PERFORMANCE" SHOULD NOT BE EXPECTED, HE SAID.

TURNING TO THE MECHANICS OF ECONOMIC PLANNING, THE SHAH SAID THAT THE PLAN AND BUDGET ORGANIZATION (PBO) HAS ACTED AS A "BRAKE ON PROGRESS" AND WOULD NOT CONTINUE TO OPERATE AS IN THE PAST. THE PBO'S BUDGET SECTION (OR TREASURY) WILL BE TRANSFERRED TO THE MINISTRY OF ECONOMIC AFFAIRS AND FINANCE. HENCEFORTH EACH MINISTRY WILL BE ALLOWED TO DRAW ITS OWN PROJECTS WITHIN THE GUIDELINES OF THE NATION'S DEVELOPMENT STRATEGY. THE NATION'S DEVELOPMENT PHILOSOPHY WILL REMAIN THE SAME AS BEFORE, HE SAID: WITHIN 12 YEARS IRAN WILL BECOME AS DEVELOPED AS WESTERN ERUOPE IS NOW AND WITHIN 25 YEARS IRAN WILL RANK AMONNGTHE 5 MOST ADVANCED COUNTRIES IN THE WORLD.
A GREATER COORDINATION OF DEVELOPMENTAL EFFORT MUST BE OBTAINED TO MAINTAIN EQUITABLE DEVELOPMENT AND AVOIDANCE OF "ADVANCEMENT IN ONE PLACE AND LAGGING PERFORMANCE IN ANOTHER".

THE SHAH CITED IRAN'S CURRENT POWER SHORTAGE, WHICH HAS BEEN MARKED BY DAILY POWER CUTS IN TEHRAN FOR THE LAST SEVERAL WEEKS, AS A COMBINATION OF "BAD LUCK (DROUGHT) AND INCOMPETENCE OF FOREIGN CONTRACTORS AND PERHAPS ALSO LACK OF FORESIGHT, E.G., NO EMERGENCY NETWORK CONNECTING THE SOUTHERN AND NORTHERN GRIDS". IN THE FUTURE, SAID THE SHAH, THE RESOURCES OF THE ARMED FORCES WOULD BE CALLED ON TO DEAL WITH SUCH CONTINGENCIES.

THE NATION'S GROWTH RATE, HE SAID, SHOULD BE KEPT AT A HIGH ENOUGHT RATE TO ABSORB NEW ADDITIONS TO THE LABOR FORCE. HALF OF IRAN'S POPULATION IS UNDER THE AGE OF 15 AND THERE WILL SOON BE A STRONG INFLUX OF YOUNG MEN AND WOMEN INTO THE LABOR FORCE. HE NOTED THAT THE MINISTERIES OF EDUCATION AND SCIENCE AND HIGHER EDUCATION WILL BE MERGED. THE UNIVERSITIES WILL HAVE GREATER AUTONOMY. EDUCATION WILL CONTINUE TO BE FREE AND OF A QUALITY COMPARABLE WITH THE BEST IN THE UNITED STATES AND EUROPE BUT WITHOUT CERTAIN NEGATIVE SOCIAL FEATURES PRESENT IN WESTERN EDUCATION.
TWO NEW PRINCIPALS OF THE SHAH-PEOPLE REVOLUTION ARE NOW BEING PREPARED AND WILL BE ANNOUNCED IN ABOUT 12 DAYS TIME, BRINGING THE TOTAL NUMBER OF PRINCIPALS TO 19.

AT THE CLOSE OF HIS REMARKS THE SHAH REAFFIRMED HIS VIEW THAT PARTICIPATION IN RASTAKHIZ PARTY ACTIVITIES IS POSSIBLE FOR ALL IRANIANS EXCEPT THOSE WHO HAVE "THEIR OWN SPECIAL IDEAS" OR WHO ARE GUIDED FROM ABROAD. SINCE THE GOVT IS ONE OF "NATIONAL UNITY" PARTY WINGS ARE ALLOWED TO ENGAGE IN DEBATE BUT DECISIONS MADE AT THE GOVERNMENTAL LEVEL APPLY EQUALLY, WITHOUT FAVORITISM, TO BOTH WINGS, ACCORDING TO THE SHAH.

REPEATING THEMES ENNUNCIATED 2 DAYS EARLIER ON THE OCCASION OF CONSTITUTION DAY, THE SHAH RECOUNTED ------------------063856 120424Z /12 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 3985 INFO USCINCEUR SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 7074 USCINCEUR FOR POLAD TWENTIETH CENTURY ADVERSITIES FACED BY IRAN, DRAWING FROM THIS RECITAL AN INDICTMENT OF OPPOSITION GROUPS OF THE LEFT AND RIGHT WHICH RECEIVED SUPPORT OF EITHER COMMUNIST OR WESTERN POWERS. THE SHAH CHARGED THAT IRANIAN DISSIDENTS OPERATING ABROAD NOW ARE COMPOSED OF THE SAME TRAITOROUS ELEMENTS OF THE RIGHT AND LEFT THAT OPERATED WITHIN IRAN IN THE PAST.

COMMENT: THE SHAH'S OBSERVATIONS ON THE NEED FOR MORE BALANCED GROWTH AND AT RATES WHICH CAN BE ABSORBED BY THE COUNTRY WITHOUT ATTENDANT DISLOCATIONS (E.G., INFLATION; INFRASTRUCTURE BOTTLENECKS) CAN BE SEEN AS A CONTINUATION ON THEMES WHICH THE MONARCH HAS DWELT UPON OVER THE PAST YEAR. THE PROPOSITION THAT IRAN NEEDS A LOWER, MORE "ABSORBABLE" RATE OF GROWTH HAS LAREADY FOUND RESONANCE IN SOME TENTATIVE THINKING WITHIN THE PBO ON THE 6TH DEVELOPMENT PLAN. ONE DOCUMENT FROM THE PBO (DATED JULY 1976) WHICH THE EMB HAS JUST RECEIVED POSTULATES A GROWTH SCENARIO WITH A 12.8 PERCENT ANNUAL GROWTH RATE.

IT IS NOTEWORTHY, HOWEVER, THAT THE PRINCIPAL AUTHOR OF THIS PAPER TOLD EMBOFFS RECENTLY THAT THE PBO WAS NOW THINKING OF A PER ANNUM GROWTH RATE PROJECTION OF 7.5 PERCENT AND ANNUAL INFLATION AT 12 PERCENT (SEE MEMCON 7/31/77 TO NEA/IRN). THIS OFFICIAL READILY ADMITTED TO DISAGREEMENTS WIT IN THE GOI AS TO WHAT THE 6TH PLAN GROWTH RATE PROJECTION OUGHT TO BE. NOR DID THE SHAH IN HIS REMARKS QUANTIFY WHAT HE THOUGHT AN "ABSORBABLE" RATE OF GROWTH SHOULD BE.

THE PBO PAPER ALSO OPTS FOR A REDUCTION IN 6TH PLAN GROWTH TARGETS (ASSUMING CONTINUING MANPOWER SHORTAGES) RATHER THAN RESORTING TO IMPORTING LABOR WHICH THE PAPER TERMED "AN EXPENSIVE AND EXPEDIENT PANACEA."

WHATEVER FIGURE FINALLY EMERGES AS THE 6TH PLAN GROWTH TARGET IT SEEMS EVIDENT THAT THE ROLE OF THE PBO IN ITS ATTAINMENT WILL BE CONSIDERABLY LESS THAN IN THE LAST FEW YEARS. PBO'S BUDGET OFFICE, THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT BUREAUCRATIC INSTRUMENT WITHIN THE GOVT INSOFAR AS THE ALLOCATION OF NON-DEFENSE PUBLIC SECTOR RESOURCES IS CONCERNED, WILL NOW BE GIVEN TO THE MINISTRY OF ECONOMIC AFFAIRS AND FINANCE. THE PERSONALITY OF THE PLAN ORGANIZATION'S NEW HEAD, MINISTER OF STATE YEGANEH, SEEMS WILL SUITED TO THE ORGANIZATION'S NEW, ESSENTIALLY NON-OPERATIONAL CHARTER. YEGANEH IS A QUIET STUDIOUS TYPE WHO PERHAPS FUNCTIONS BEST IN IVORY-TOWER SITUATIONS.

A CAPABLE FINANCIAL ECONOMIST, YEGANEH IS NOT NORMALLY THOUGHT OF AS AN IDEA MAN OR AS A PARTICULARLY DYNAMIC ADMINISTRATOR. PLAN ORG IN IRAN HAS HAD ITS UPS AND DOWNS OVER THE YEARS AND ONCE AGAIN SEEMS TO BE GOING INTO APRTIAL ECLIPSE.

IT WAS SOMEWHAT SURPRISING GIVEN RECENT HISTORY TO NOTE THE SHAH'S STATEMENT ON THE SEEMINGLY GREATER AUTONOMY WHICH THE SEVERAL MINISTRIES ARE ONCE AGAIN TO ENJOY IN PROJECT DEVELOPMENT. MOST OBSERVERS HERE BELIEVE THAT THE FREE-WHEELING SPENDING BY THE VARIOUS MINISTRIES IN 1974 AND 1975, WITHOUT ANY EFFECTIVE RESTRAINTS IMPOSED BY AN OFTEN CIRCUMVENTED PBO, WAS ONE OF THE MAJOR REASONS FOR THE OVERHEATING OF THE ECONOMY WHICH OCCURED IN THIS PERIOD AND WHICH ULTIMATELY REQUIRED RATHER SEVERE REMEDIAL ACTIONS BY THE GOVT IN MID-1975.

THE GOVERNMENT'S INABILITY TO FINE TUNE THE PLANNING AND DECISION MAKING PROCESS WAS SUBSEQUENTLY SEEN IN PBO'S EMERGENCE SINCE MID-1975 AS THE PRINCIPAL NAY-SAYER IN THE GOVT. DOZENS OF PROJECTS, INCLUDING SOME THE US-IRAN JOINT COMMISSION CONTEXT, WERE ABOLISHED, CUT BACK OR PUT ON THE BACKBURNER BY PBO. MANY PROJECTS LANGUISHED UNFUNDED AND THE POSTPONEMENT OF START-UPS INEVITABLY ENTAILED COST INCREASES LATER ON. PBO CAME TO BE SEEN AS A MAJOR BOTTLENECK BUT IT WAS NATURALLY THOUGHT THAT PBO'S DIRECTOR HAD HIS SOVEREIGN'S CONCURRENCE IN WHAT HE WAS DOING.

DOUBTLESS THE MINISTRY OF ECONOMIC AFFAIRS AND FINANCE HAD A HAND IN THIS THROTTLING DOWN PROCESS BUT PBO GOT MOST OF THE BLAME. THE SHAH IN HIS REMARKS TO THE NEW CABINET CLEARLY FIXED THE BLAME ON PBO AND THE DEPARTURE OF PBO'S FORMER DIRECTOR, ABDOL-MAJID MAJIDI, SEEMS IN RETROSPECT A NATURAL OUTCOME. IT REMAINS TO BE SEEN, OF COURSE, JUST HOW MUCH FREEDOM OF ACTION THE MINISTRIES WILL ONCE AGAIN HAVE AND HOW FLEXIBLE WILL BE THE 6TH PLAN GUIDLINES WITHIN WHICH THEY ARE SUPPOSED TO OPERATE.

1977TEHRAN07083.subject: NEW IRANIAN GOVT: REFURBISHING THE OLD IMAGE

segments.text: SUMMARY: AFTER SEVERAL WEEKS OF WHAT PASSES FOR POLITICAL ACTIVITY IN TEHRAN, AND IN THE WAKE OF A CONSTANT STREAM OF RUMORS CONCERNING POTENTIAL CHANGES ON THE POLITICAL SCENE, THE NEW CABINET ANNOUNCED BY THE SHAH ON AUG 7 COMES AS SOMETHING OF AN ANTI-CLIMAX. THERE HAD BEEN A CONSIDERABLE AIR OF EXPECTANCY IN MANY QUARTERS, GIVING RISE TO UNSUBSTANTIATED AND, IN MANY CASES, UNREALISTIC HOPES THAT THE SHAH WOULD BE WILLING TO BE RESPONSIBE TO VARIOUS POPULAR GRUMBLINGS BY MAKING SOME UNSPECIFIED BUT SIGNIFICANT CHANGES IN THE POLITICAL SYSTEM.

IN THE EVENT, ALTHOUGH THE SHAH'S PUBLIC STATEMENTS SUGGEST THAT HE WOULD LIKE TO GIVE THE IMPRESSION THAT HIS CHANGES ARE MORE SWEEPING, THE SHAH HAS PREDICTABLY SETTLED FOR A RATHER LIMITED CHANGING OF THE GUARD, RETAINING MUCH OF HIS TRADITIONAL SYSTEM OF "CREATIVE TENSION" AMONG HIS APPOINTEES, BUT GENERALLY ENHANCING THE VIGOR AND BRAINPOWER OF THE CABINET LEADERSHIP. END SUMMARY.

CABINET CHANGES IN THE LAST DECADE OR SO UNDER THE SHAH HAVE NOT BEEN NOTABLY MOMENTOUS EVENTS SINCE THE SHAH SETS POLICY IN ITS BROADEST OUTLINE AND MANY OF ITS DETAILS. EVEN WITH IRAN'S FIRST CHANGE OF PRIMINS IN 13 YEARS, ITS DOMESTIC AND INTERNATIONAL POLICIES ARE UNLIKELY TO CHANGE. THE SHAH'S CONSULTATIONS AND INSTRUCTIONS ARE CARRIED ALONG SEVERAL PARALLEL HIERARCHIES IN THE IRANIAN BUREAUCRACY, OF WHICH THE GOVT HEADED BY THE PRIMIN IS ONLY ONE. WITHIN THESE PARAMETERS, HOWEVER, THE STYLE AND TONE OF GOVERNMENTAL ACTIVITIES--AT LEAST DOMESTICALLY--WILL ASSUME THE COLORATION OF A NEW PRIMIN WHO IS EXTREMELY HARD-DRIVING, DEMANDING AND EVEN MORE INTELLIGENT THAN HIS PREDECESSOR.

AS NOTED REFTEL A, A CONVERGENCE OF VARIOUS FACTORS APPEARS TO HAVE LED THE SHAH TO CONCLUDE THAT CHANGES IN THE CABINET WERE NEEDED. CATALYST WAS PROBABLY THE LINGERING ILLNESS OF MINISTER OF COURT ASSADOLLAH ALAM (HE IS REPORTED TO HAVE LEUKEMIA) AND HIS INABILITY TO CARRY FULL BURDEN OF THAT OFFICE, CREATING THE NEED TO FIND A REPLACEMENT. HOVEYDA, WHO WE ARE TOLD WAS TIRING IN HIS 13TH YEAR AS PRIMIN, AND WHO, AMONG MANY RELATIVELY CLOSE TO THE SHAH, IS PROBABLY BEST SUITED TEMPERAMENTALLY TO THE DUTIES OF MINISTER OF COURTS, SEEMED THE NATURAL REPLACEMENT.

ONCE THE SHAH DECIDED TO MAKE THIS CHANGE, OTHER CHANGES AND THE TIMING SEEMED TO FALL INTO PLACE. DOMESTICALLY THERE WAS GROWING CRITICISM OF THE GOVTS PERFORMANCE ON INFLATION, ITS INABILITY TO PROVIDE ADEQUATE HOUSING, RECURRING POWER SHORTAGES, AND GENERAL DISAFFECTION WITH THE OVERALL STATE OF AFFAIRS. THERE WAS ALSO A FEELING THAT THE PRIMIN AND SOME OF HIS CABINET COLLEAGUES HAD BECOME STALE, AND IT WAS TIME TO BRING NEW BLOOD INTO GOVT. CHANGES THAT HAVE TAKEN PLACE DEMONSTRATED ONCE AGAIN THE SHAH'S SKILL IN BALANCING COMPETING PERSONALITIES AND MAINTAINING CONSTRUCTIVE TENSION AMONG THEM.
HE SEIZED THE OCCASION NOT ONLY TO REFURBISH THE GOVTS PUBLIC IMAGE BUT TO SIGNAL SOME SHIFT OF EMPHASIS IN ECONOMIC POLICY (SEPTEL DISCUSSES LATTER POINT IN MORE DETAIL).

OVERALL, THENEW CABINET APPEARS SOMEWHAT STRONGER AND MORE DYNAMIC THAT THE LST. IT REMAINS TO BE SEEN WHETHER AMOUZEGAR CAN MOBILIZE AND DIRECT THE ENERGIES OF HIS TEAM WITH THE SUCCESS ENJOYED BY HIS WILY AND MORE CONCILIATORY PREDECESSOR. IN PARTICULAR, IT WILL BE INTERESTING TO SEE HOW LONG A CLASH CAN BE AVOIDED OVER FINANCE AND ECONOMIC POLICY WITH HUSHANG ANSARY (WHO HAS PRIMINISTERIAL ASPIRATIONS OF HIS OWN). WHILE AMOUZEGAR HAD BEEN GIVEN RELATIVELY FREE HAND IN CHOOSING CABINET COLLEAGUES, ANSARY WAS THE SHAH'S CHOICE TO CONTINUE IN THE KEY POSITION OF FINANCE AND ECONOMIC AFFAIRS.

MOROVER, THE SHAH HAS INDICATED HE IS TRANSFERRING THE ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITY FOR THE BUDGET TO ANSARY'S MINISTRY. ALTHOUGH BOTH MEN ARE INTELLIGENT AND SELF-CONTROLLED AND CAN BE EXPECTED TO REMAIN CONSCIOUS OF THE NEED FOR COOPERATION, THIS CLEARLY PUTS ANSARY IN THE CAT BIRD'S SEAT AS FAR AS NON-MILITARY EXPENDITURES ARE CONCERNED.

IN ADDITION TO AMOUZEGAR AND ANSARY, AMONG 13 MINISTERIAL HOLDOVERS FROM THE PREVIOUS CABINET ARE SUCH PERENNIALS AS KHALATBARY (FORN AFFS), PAHLBOD (CU AFFS), AZIMI (WAR), KIANPOUR (JUSTICE), AND MOINI (BACK TO LABOR AFTER HIS BRIEF STINT AT INTERIOR). SEVERAL MORE RECENTLY APPOINTED MINISTERS HAVE ALSO BEEN CARRIED OVER INTO THE NEW CABINET, NOTABLY AFKHAMI (WOMEN'S AFFS) AND GANJI (WHOSE EDUCATION PORTFOLIO HAS GROWN TO INCLUDE THE FORMER MINISTRY OF SCIENCE AND HIGHER EDUCTION).

MANY OF THE NEWCOMERS TO THE CABINET ARE OF SIMILAR MOLD TO THOSE THEY REPLACED, INTELLIGENT, HARD WORKING, BUT BASICALLY TECHNOCRATS. INCLUDED ALSO ARE TWO MEN OF CONSIDERABLE BUSINESS EXPERIENCE, MOHAMMAD REZA AMIN (INDUSTRIES & MINES) AND KAZEM KHOSROWSHAHI (COMMERCE), ------------------065099 102056Z /14 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 3988 SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 7083 SOME OF THE NEWCOMERS ARE YOUNGER AND RELATIVELY UNKNOWN NATIONALLY. SEVERAL MINISTERS AND ASSISTANTS TO THE PRIMIN HAVE STRONG PERSONAL LOYALTY TO AMOUZEGAR, NOTABLY HOMAYOUN (INFORMATION), KASHEFI (MINISTER OF STATE), AGAH (MINISTER OF STATE), AND FARSHCHI (LIKE HOMAYOUN, RECENTLY FROM THE RASTAKHIZ PARTY).
AMOUZEGAR'S OLD MINISTRY OF INTERIOR GOES TO ASSADOLLAH NASR-ISFAHANI, THE ENERGETIC GOVERNOR GENERAL OF FARS (SHIRAZ) PROVINCE.

ONE OF THE SURPRISES OF THE CABINET CHANGE IS THE APPARENT RETREAT FROM PUBLIC LIFE OF MAJIDI, FORMER HEAD OF THE PLANS AND BUDGET ORGANIZATION. SOME INKLINGS AS TO THE REASON MIGHT BE DRAWN FROM A PASSAGE OF OUTSPOKEN CRITICISM OF THE PLAN AND BUDGET ORGANIZATION IN THE SHAH'S SPEECH ANNOUNCING THE NEW GOVT (SEE SEPTEL). WE ARE TOLD THAT THE SHAH'S IRE STEMS FROM MAJIDI'S INABILITY OR UNWILLINGNESS TO MOVE SOME PROJECTS IN WHICH THE SHAH WAS ESPECIALLY INTERESTED.

IT REMAINS TO BE SEEN WHETHER MAJIDI WILL CONTINUE TO FLAP THE RASTAKHIZ PARTY "WINGS" IN VIEW OF PROBABLE CHANGES AT THE TOP OF THE PARTY LEADERSHIP ACCOMPANYING THE ELECTION OF ANEW CHAIRMAN-- MOHAMADBAHERI, AND OLD WAR HORSE SUPPORTER OF ALAM'S WHO HAS BEEN DEPUTY COURT MINISTER FOR THE PAST 11 YEARS. MAENWHILE, AN EMASCULATED PLAN ORGANIZATION (MINUS THE BUDGET) WILL BE PRESIDED OVER BY THE ABLE BUT RATHER COLORLESS MOHAMMAD YEGANEH, FORMER GOVERNOR OF THE CENTRAL BANK, MINISTER OF STATE WITHOUT PORTFOLIO IN THE LAST GOVT, AND AMOUZEGAR'S LIEUTENANT FOR OPEC AND EAST-WEST QUESTIONS.

STATISTICALLY, THE NEW GOVT CONTINUES A HIGH PERCENTAGE OF AMERICAMN PLQLPID MEMBERS (10 OF THE 23 MINISTERS, INCLUDING AMOUZEGAR, OR 11 OF THE 28 MINISTERS AND PRIME MINISTERIAL ASSISTANTS). MS AFKHAMI, AT 37, REMAINS THE YOUNGEST MINISTER BUT IS CLOSELY FOLLOWED BY TRANSPORTATION MINISTER SALEHI (39) AND HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT MINISTER TOWFIQ (43). TWO MINISTERS ARE IN THEIR 60'S 10 (INCLUDING THE PRIMIN) ARE IN THEIR 50'S, AND 11 IN THEIR 40'S AND 30'S. THESE STATISTICS ARE NOT GREATLY DISSIMILAR TO THE PREVIOUS CABINET'S.

AS FAR AS THE RASTAKHIZ PARTY IS CONCERNED, EMB WILL BE SUBMITTING SEPARATE CABLE GIVING ANALYSIS OF ITS SYAYUS AFTER THE CHANGES. BEFORE BAHERI WAS NAMED AS THE NEW SECY GEN, IT WAS THOUGHT ATHT THE SHAH INTENDED TO DEMONSTRATE THAT THE GOLDEN LADDER TO THE TOP IS VIA THAT POSITION. BAHERI IS A MOST UNLIKELY PRIMIN CANDIDATE, HOWEVER, AND HIS TENUE AS SECY GEN MAY PROVE TO BE BRIEF. INDEED THERE IS SPECULATION THAT AFTER A SUITABLE PERIOD OF PENANCE MAJIDI WILL RESURFACE AS THE HEAD OF THE RASTAKHIZ PARTY.
IN THE MEANTIME HE CAN OCCUPY HIMSELF AS DIRECTOR OF THE EMPRESS'S NEW MUSEUM, A POSITION FROM WHICH HE WAS NOT RELIEVED AND FOR WHICH ONE OBSERVER REMARKED HE NOW HAS PLENTY OF TIME.

1977TEHRAN07097.subject: DUTY FREE PRIVILEGES AND TAX LIABILITIES OF FS NON- DKPLOMATIC PERSONNEL

segments.text: DIPLOMATIC PERSONNEL ARE ISSUED WHITE ID CARD BY THE MFA. NON-DIPLOMATIC PERSONNEL RECEIVED YELLOW CARD. PERSONNEL HOLDING WHITE ID CARD ARE PERMITTED ACCESS TO THE TRANSIT AREA OF AIRPORT; YELLOW CARD HOLDERS ARE NOT PERMITTED ACCESS TO THIS AREA WITHOUT FIRST OBTAINING AIRPORT PASS. AIRPORT PASSES DIFFICULT TO OBTAIN. TELEPHONE CLEARANCE MAY BE GIVEN, BUT NO GUARANTEE THAT POLICEMAN AT AIRPORT WILL HAVE RECEIVED NOTICE. DIFFICULTY ARISES WHEN VISITORS OR NEW EMPLOYEES MUST BE MET AND ASSISTED AT AIRPORT. BURDEN OF MEETING AND ASSISTING OFFICIAL VISITORS OR NEW EMPLOYEES FALLS ON DIPLOMATIC PERSONNEL.

DIPLOMATIC PERSONNEL ARE PERMITTED TO EMPLOY THIRD COUNTRY NATIONALS (TCNS) AS DOMESTICS, BY REGISTERING TCN WITH FOREIGN MINISTRY. TCNS EMPLOYED BY NON-DIPLOMATIC PERSONNEL MUST OBTAIN RESIDENCE AND WORK PERMIT, WHICH DOMESTICS HAVE DIFFICULTY IN OBTAINING. TCH SERVANTS HIRED BY DIPLOMATIC PERSONNEL ARE OFTEN WILLING TO WORK FOR LESS MONEY THAN IRANIAN SERVANTS IN EXCHANGE FOR FOREIGN MINISTRY REGISTRATION WHICH PERMIT TCH TO LEGALLY REMAIN IN IRAN.

IRANIAN CUSTOMS HAS THE LEGAL RIGHT TO INSPECT INCOMING AIR FREIGHT AND PERSONAL HAND LUGGAGE OF NON-DIPLOMATIC PERSONNEL. HOWEVER, EMB AND IRANIAN CUSTOMS HAS INFORMAL AGREEMENT WHEREBY CUSTOMS DOES NOT EXERCISE THIS RIGHT. DIPLOMATIC PERSONNEL ARE FORMALLY EXEMPT FROM CUSTOM'S SEARCH. IF IRANIAN CUSTOMS ELECTED TO EXERCISE LEGAL RIGHT TO SEARCH INCOMING AIR FREIGHT AND BAGGAGE OF NON-DIPLOMATIC PERSONNEL, CUSTOMS DUTIES COULD BE ASSESSED ON GOODS BEING IMPORTED BY NON-DIPLOMATIC PERSONNEL WHO HAVE BEEN IN IRAN OVER 9 MONTHS.

AUTOMOBILES BELONGING TO DIPLOMATIC PERSONNEL BEAR DIPLOMATIC LICENSE PLATES; NON-DIPLOMATIC PERSONNEL ARE ISSUED SERVICE PLATES FOR POVS. ALTHOUGH AUTOMOBILES BEARING DIPLOMATIC PLATES MAY BE ACCORDED MORE RESPECT BY POLICE, THERE IS ESSENTIALLY NO DIFFERENCE BETWEEN PLATES.
DIFFERENCES RELATING TO IMPORTATION OF AUTOMOBILES AND HHE ANSWERED IN TEHRAN 6954.

1977TEHRAN07228.subject: LAW OF THE SEA MILITARY EXEMPTION AND IRAN

segments.text: MFA LEGAL ADVISOR KAZIMI HAS CALLED TO OUR ATTENTION A MEMORANDUM DATED JULY 24 WRITTEN BY ARMISH/MAAG REAR ADMIRAL CONOLLY TO IIN CHIEF HABIBOLLAHI IN WHICH IT WAS STATED THAT KAZIMI HAD TAKEN A POSITION (ON INSTRUCTION) WHICH WAS CONTRARY TO OURS WITH RESPECT TO THE LOS NEGOTIATING TEXT OF ARTICLE 18.ID. THIS MEMORANDUM WAS BASED ON REFTEL WHICH SUGGESTS THAT ADMIRAL CONOLLY TAKE THE SUBJECT UP WITH HIS IRANIAN COUNTERPART. KAZIMI SAID THE MEMORANDUM DOES NOT ACCURATELY PORTRAY HIS OR THE GOI'S POSITION, THAT HE HAS NEVER DISCUSSED THIS PARTICULAR POINT WITH U.S. LOS NEGOTIATORS AND IT HAS NEVER BEEN PART OF HIS INSTRUCTIONS.

FURTHER, HE SAID, HE FAVORED THE CONCEPT OF EXEMPTION OF WARSHIPS OR SHIPS OWNED OR OPERATED BY THE STATE FROM THE COMPULSORY DISPUTE SETTLEMENT PROVISION OF THE DRAFT LOS. HE ALSO FAVORED EXEMPTION OF MARITIME TERRITORY DISPUTES.

QUITE APART FROM THE APPARENT DIFFERENCE ON SUBSTANCE I AM SERIOUSLY DISTURBED THAT THE DIRECTOR OF THE OJCS HAS INSTRUCTED A MEMBER OF MY MISSION TO UNDERTAKE REPRESENTATION TO AN OFFICIAL OF THE GOI ON A MATTER WHICH IS NOT WITHIN HIS MANDATE. THIS ACTION IS A VIOLATION OF MY AUTHORITY AND PRESIDENTIAL DIRECTIVES CONCERNING MY RESPONSIBILITY IN OUR RELATIONS WITH IRAN. IT APPEARS ALSO TO HAVE OCCURED WITHOUT THE KNOWLEDGE OF AMBASSADOR RICHARDSON OR OTHER APPROPRIATE OFFICIALS OF THE DEPARTMENT OF STATE. I WISH TO BE ASSURED THAT THIS WILL NOT RPT NOT HAPPEN AGAIN. SULLIVAN NOTE BY OC/T: NOT PASSED SECDEF.

1977TEHRAN07259.subject: BRIEFING OTHER GOVERNMENTS ON SECRETARY'S MIDDLE EAST TRIP

segments.text: ON MORNING AUGUST 15, I BRIEFED FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY IN DETAIL ON SECRETARY'S MIDDLE EAST TRIP, STRESSING PARTICULARLY US INTENTION TO MAINTAIN MOMENTUM ON PROCESS OF LEADING ANTAGONISTS TO THE TABLE AT GENEVA.

KHALATBARY'S REACTION TO THE VARIOUS POINTS MADE IN REFTEL, PARTICULARLY THOSE DEALING WITH PALESTINIAN REPRESENTATION, WAS THAT HE FORESAW A DIFFICULT CONFRONTATION BETWEEN US AND ISRAEL. HE REPEATED WHAT SHAH HAD TOLD ME ABOUT IRANIAN EFFORTS TO INDUCE ISRAELI "FLEXIBILITY."

AS REGARDS SECRETARY'S INTENTION TO CONTINUE US EFFORT DURING OPENING DAYS OF UNGA SESSION IN NEW YORK, KHALATBARY POINTED OUT THAT HE WILL BE PRESENT IN NEW YORK AT THAT TIME AND WOULD APPRECIATE BEING KEPT ABREAST OF US ACTION.

PASSED INFORMATION STATE REFTEL TO MFA'S SADEGHI AUG 15. HE WAS AWARE OF THESE FACTORS BUT NOTED INFORMATION HE HAS FROM CHAIRMAN OF SPECIAL COMMITTEE ON APARTHEID IS THAT CONFERENCE WILL AIM AT PRODUCING ONLY A DECLARATION AND NO RPT NO PROGRAM OF ACTION. HE HAS ALSO HEARD THAT THERE WOULD BE AN EFFORT TO BASE DECLARATION ON CONSENSUS OF ALL ATTENDING. THIS WOULD BE IRAN'S PREFERENCE TOO. IF EFFORT TO PURSUE CONSENSUS MATERIALIZED THAT WOULD REDUCE CHANCE THAT EXTRANEOUS ISSUES SUCH AS ZIONISM WOULD BE INTRODUCED.

1977TEHRAN07270.subject: BOTHA'S LONDON MEETING WITH SECRETARIES VANCE AND OWEN

segments.text: BRITISH AMB HERE PROVIDED US WITH A COPY OF UK FONOFF REPORT ON FONSECY BOTHA'S MEETING WITH SECYS VANCE AND OWEN IN LONDON AUG 12. ON THE BASIS OF THIS REPORT BRITISH AMB PARSONS BRIEFED FONMIN KHALATBARY AUG 15. KHALATBARY HAD NO SUBSTANTIVE COMMENT OTHER THAN TO RECONFIRM GOI'S SUPPORT OF UK-US PROPOSALS AND ITS WILLINGNESS TO CONTRIBUTE TO A UN DEVELOPMENT FUND FOR RHODESIA. KHALATBARY WILL DOUBTLESS FAITHFULLY RELAY INFORMATION TO THE SHAH AND I DO NOT BELIEVE IT IS NECESSARY FOR ME TO UNDERTAKE A PARALLEL EFFORT.

NEVERTHELESS WOULD APPRECIATE A COPY OF OUR OWN REPORT ON THE BOTHA-VANCE-OWEN MEETING SO THAT I CAN BE ADEQUATELY ARMED TO RESPOND TO ANY QUESTIONS THAT MAY BE ADDRESSED TO ME DIRECTLY ON THE SUBJECT. AS INDICATED REFTEL, WOULD ALSO APPRECIATE LEARNING RESULTS OF AUG 13 MEETING WITH NYERERE AND OTHER INDICATIONS OF NYERERE'S POSITION FOLLOWING HIS US AND UK VISITS.

1977TEHRAN07346.subject: RESIGNATION OF TEHRAN'S MAYOR NIKPAY - ANOTHER INDICATION OF HIGH LEVEL GOI CONCERN SUMMARY: THE INDUCED RESIGNATION OF TEHRAN'S CONTR

segments.text: INDICATION OF HIGH LEVEL GOI CONCERN SUMMARY: THE INDUCED RESIGNATION OF TEHRAN'S CONTROVERSIAL MAYOR UNDER ATTACK FOR SOME OF THE CITY'S ILLS UNDERLINES ROYAL DISPLEASURE AND PROBABLE CONCERN OVER CONTINUING POPULAR COMPLAINTS TRIGGERED BY TEHRAN'S LINGERING ELECTRIC POWER SHORTAGE. END SUMMARY.

TEHRAN'S CONTROVERSIAL MAYOR GHOLAM REZA NIKPAY TENDERED HIS RESIGNATION TO THE CITY COUNCIL AUG 16. THE COUNCIL ACCEPTED IT AND IMMEDIATELY ELECTED JAVAD SHAHRESTANI AS NEW MAYOR. NIKPAY THUS ENDED EIGHT YEARS IN OFFICE, DURING WHICH TEHRAN HAS MORE THAN DOUBLED IN POPULATION AND NIKPAY HIMSELF HAS FREQUENTLY BEEN THE CENTER OF CONTROVERSY.

THE ENERGETIC, VOLUBLE MAYOR WAS REMARKABLY SILENT ON THE REASONS FOR HIS RESIGNATION. WE HAVE REPORTS THAT H AS TELLING THE PRESS HE DID NOT PLAN TO RESIGN ONLY A FEW DAYS AGO. ON AUG. 15, FARSI LANGUAGE PRESS PUBLISHED A DIRECT ATTACK ON NIKPAY BY TAQI MOSSADEQI, CHAIRMAN OF THE NATIONAL IRANIAN GAS COMPANY, WHO BLAMED NIKPAY'S SHORTSIGHTEDNESS FOR GAS LINE SHORTAGES IN THE CITY (AND BY IMPLICATION SOME OF THE TRAFFIC PROBLEMS). THIS SORT OF DIRECT ATTACK IS EXTREMELY RARE IN IRAN'S CAREFULLY MUTED PRESS, AND IT IS EQUALLY UNCHARACTERISTIC OF NIKPAY TO REFRAIN FROM A TELLING RETORT.
WHILE ALL OUR INFORMATION IS NOT YET IN, THESE FACTORS MAKE IT PRETTY CLEAR THAT NIKPAY WAS FORCED TO RESIGN BY DECISION OF THE HIGHEST AUTHORITY (I.E., THE SHAH).

NIKPAY'S RESIGNATION IS SOMEWHAT SIMILAR IN MAY WAYS TO MINISTER MAJIDI'S DEMISE FROM THE CABINET. WE ARE TOLD ON PRETTY GOOD AUTHORITY MAJIDI'S PLAN AND BUDGET ORGANIZATION HAS BEEN BLAMED FOR SHORTSIGHTEDNESS IN REFUSING TO ALLOCATE FUNDS TO ELECTRIC POWER PROJECTS REQUESTED SOME YEARS AGO BY THE ENERGY MINISTER OF THE TIME. COLLATERAL REPORTS WE ARE GETTING INDICATE THAT THE ELECTRICITY DISRUPTIONS ARE WORRYING NOT ONLY POLITICAL AUTHORITIES HERE BUT ALSO THE POLICE/SECURITY APPARATUS WHICH FEARS POSSIBLE REPERCUSSIONS AMONG THE STUDENT POPULATION.

NEW MAYOR SHAHRESTANI SERVED ONE YEAR AS MAYOR IN 19681969 BEFORE BECOMING A PROVINCIAL GOVERNOR AND SUBSEQUENTLY MINISTER IN THE HOVEYDA CABINET. HE ALSO WON A "MAYOR OF THE YEAR" NATIONAL AWARD FOR HIS SERVICE AS MAYOR OF MASHAD JUST PRIOR TO COMING TO TEHRAN. WHILE SHAHRASTANI BRINGS TO HIS NEW JOB OBVIOUS CREDENTIALS AND A GOOD IMAGE IN MUNICIPAL ADMINISTRATION, WE REMEMBER THAT THE MINISTRY OF ROADS UNDER HIS LEADERSHIP WAS NOT A NOTABLY EFFICIENT ORGANIZATION. TOP LEVEL DIRECTION WAS FREQUENTLY LACKING AND PRIORITIES BECAME CONFUSED.

MEANWHILE, NEW ENERGY MINISTER TAVAKOLI HAS ANNOUNCED NEW GOVERNMENT MEASURES TO INCREASE THE NATIONAL ELECTRICITY SUPPLY BUT IS WARNING THAT CONSERVATION OF ELECTRICITY MUST CONTINUE FOR SOME TIME IN VIEW OF THE DANGER OF RECURRING SHORTAGES. IN A REVERSAL OF PREVIOUS POLICY, THE GOI IS ALSO ENCOURAGING THE INSTALLATION AND OPERATION OF PRIVATE ELECTRIC GENERATORS IN FACTORIES AND OTHER LARGE ENTERPRISES.
ALL THIS SUGGESTS CONSIDERABLE HIGH-LEVEL CONCERN HERE WITH THE EFFECTS OF A POWER SHORTAGE WHICH--ACCORDING TO EVIDENCE SLOWLY COMING TO LIGHT--IS LIKELY TO LINGER WITH US FOR QUITE SOME TIME.
REF STATE 194862

AMBASSADOR CALLED ON HOUSHANG ANSARY, MINISTER OF ECONOMIC AFFAIRS AND FINANCE, AUGUST 18. ANSARY WAS UNABLE TO ESTABLISH SPECIFIC DATES FOR MEETING BUT AGREES IN PRINCIPLE TO MEETINGS BETWEEN 6TH AND 12TH OF NOVEMBER. ANSARY WILL INFORM EMBASSY WITHIN A FEW DAYS BEST DATES DURING THAT WEEK FOR MEETING.
EMBASSY WOULD APPRECIATE DEPARTMENT'S THOUGHTS ON AGENDA FOR COMMITTEE MEETINGS SOONEST, SINCE CONSULTATIONS WITH ANSARY'S DEPUTY ON THIS SUBJECT SCHEDULED NEXT WEEK.

FOLLOWING UP LAST NIGHTS CONVERSATION ON IRAN-ISRAEL COPRODUCTION, GENERAL TOUFANIAN ASKED ME TO HIS HOUSE AFTERNOON AUGUST 19. HE SAID HE HAD REPORTED OUR CONVERSATION TO SHAH THIS MORNING, PRIOR SHAH'S AUDIENCE WITH DAYAN.

AFTER AUDIENCE, SHAH TOLD TOUFANIAN THAT DAYAN CLAIMED YOU HAD "BLESSED" ENTIRE TRANSACTION AND THAT HE PERSONALLY HAD TOLD YOU THAT SYSTEM INVOLVED WOULD BE SURFACE-TO-SURFACE MISSILE OF 300 MILE RANGE. HE CLAIMED YOU OFFERED NO OBJECTION.

HOWEVER, IN ORDER TO MEET AMERICAN "PROBLEMS" DAYAN AND HIS WEAPONS EXPERT, DR. ZUSSMAN, WERE PREPARED TO REPLACE THE ELEMENTS OF U.S. ORIGIN WITH PRODUCTS FROM OTHER SOURCES. (THEY ALLEGE THEY HAVE AN INERTIAL GUIDANCE SYSTEM OF FRENCH DESIGN TO REPLACE THE U.S. GYROSCOPE) ZUSSMAN SAID HE COULD ASSURE IRAN OF A WEAPON "WITHOUT A SINGLE SCREW IMPORTED FROM OR LICENSED BY U.S."

TOUFANIAN SAID THAT, EVEN IF NO RPT NO U.S. COMPONENTS OR TECHNOLOGY INVOLVED, SHAH WANTED NIHIL OBSTAT FROM U.S. HE WAS DISTURBED BY APPARENT DISPARITY BETWEEN U.S. AND ISRAELI REPORTS OF YOUR CONVERSATION WITH DAYAN. HE DID NOT WANT TO AGREE TO SOMETHING WITH ISRAEL AND HAVE U.S. RAISE OBJECTIONS LATER.

I REPEATED TO TOUFANIAN THE GUIDANCE YOU HAVE GIVEN ME, BUT POINTED OUT THAT IT WAS BASED ON ASSUMPTION THAT U.S. COMPONENTS WOULD BE INVOLVED. I STRESSED THAT TRANSFER OF SUCH ITEMS REQUIRED ACTION IN ACCORDANCE WITH OUR LAWS. IF THERE WERE NO RPT NO U.S. ELEMENTS, OUR LEGAL AND OFFICIAL POSITION WAS QUITE DIFFERENT. IT WOULD NO LONGER BE A QUESTION OF OBTAINING OUR FORMAL CONSENT, BUT RATHER OUR ADVICE AND OPINION.

I SAID THAT OUR VIEW, AS I UNDERSTOOD IT, WAS THAT WE WOULD HAVE NO OBJECTION TO AN IRAN-ISRAEL CO-PRODUCTION PROJECT WHICH BENEFITED BOTH COUNTRIES AND DID NOT DISTURB THE REGIONAL ARMS BALANCE. I WOULD HAVE TO SEEK YOUR VIEW, HOWEVER, ON THE PARTICULAR MISSILES UNDER DISCUSSION.

I ALSO SUGGESTED TOUFANIAN RELAY TWO OTHER QUESTIONS TO THE SHAH. I RECALLED THAT THE SHAH HAD SAID HE WOULD ENTER THIS VENTURE ONLY IF ISRAEL WAS "FLEXIBLE" ABOUT A MID-EAST SETTLEMENT. DID THE SHAH REGARD CURRENT ISRAELI POLICY AS FLEXIBLE?

SECOND QUESTION WAS WHETHER IRANIANS HAD ANY IMPRESSION ISRAELIS SEEKING TO TIE THEM UP IN ARRANGEMENTS WHICH WOULD PROTECT THEIR PETROLEUM SOURCES WHILE THEY ENGAGED IN PERIOD OF CONFRONTATION WITH U.S. (ZUSSMAN TELEPHONED WHILE I WAS WITH TOUFANIAN SEEKING TO BRING AGREEMENT TO HIS HOUSE FOR SIGNATURE, INDICATING VERY EAGER ATTITUDE).

TOUFANIAN SAID THESE WERE PRECISELY QUESTIONS WHICH WERE TROUBLING SHAH AND HE DID NOT WISH GET OUT OF LINE WITH OUR ACTIONS AND POLICY. HE ASKED IF I COULD HAVE YOUR REACTION SOONEST, SINCE HE HAD TO GIVE A REPLY TO ISRAELI NO LATER THAN AUGUST 21. SHAH IS LEAVING FOR POLAND AUGUST 22. HE ASKED THAT I STAND BY FOR POSSIBLE AUDIENCE WITH SHAH AUGUST 21.
ACTION REQUESTED: IN LIGHT NEW FACTS REPORTED THIS MESSAGE, PLEASE PROVIDE ANSWERS TO QUESTIONS RAISED TO BE IN TEHRAN IF POSSIBLE BY OPENING OF BUSINESS AUGUST 20.

DEPARTMENT MAY IN DUE COURSE NOTICE ITEM ON FRONT PAGE OF KEYHAN INTERNATION AUG 21 QUOTING MFA SPOKESMAN ON GOI POSITION REGARDING JERUSALEM. SPOKESMAN IS QUOTED AS HAVE REASSERTED GOI'S "DEEP CONCERN" OVER PROGRESSIVE JUDAIZATION, AND A DESIRE TO SAVE THE CITY AND PROTECT ITS ISLAMIC ASPECTS. IN POINT OF FACT MFA SPOKESMAN ISSUED NO STATEMENT, HOWEVER, TO MARK ANNIVERSARY OF ISRAELI ANNEXATION OF JERUSALEM, IRANIAN PRESS APPROACHED MFA FOR GUIDANCE. KAYHAN INTERNATIONAL CHOSE TO CARRY A THREE PARAGRAPH STATEMENT WHICH IS AN OLD ITERATION, THOUGH STATEMENT STILL REPRESENTS IRANIAN PUBLIC POLICY.

FARSI PRESS (SEMI-OFFICIAL RASTAKHIZ AND AYANDEGAN) CARRIED SHORTER DESCRIPTIVE ITEMS WHICH NOTED CONSISTENT GOI OPPOSITION TO ISRAELI MEASURES INTENDED TO ALTER COMPOSITION OF JERUSALEM POPULATION, AN ATTTITUDE WHICH IRAN HAS REPEATEDLY VOICED IN INTERNATIONAL ASSEMBLIES AND THROUGH ITS VOTES ON INTERNATIONAL RESOLUTIONS.

COMMENT: MFA SPOKESMAN WAS CAUGHT A BIT FLAT-FOOTED BY PRESS DESIRE TO MARK THIS ANNIVERSARY, THOUGH PUBLIC IRANIAN POLICY REMAINS AS STATED IN ALL THESE ARTICLES. PRIVATE IRANIAN RELATIONSHIP WITH ISRAEL IS, OF COURSE, MORE COMPLICATED, THOUGH AS FAR AS WE KNOW IT DOES NOT RUN CONTRARY TO PUBLIC IRANIAN POSITION ON THE ISSUE OF JERUSALEM.
REF TEHRAN 7399

MINISTER OF ECONOMIC AFFAIRS AND FINANCE ANSARY, AFTER CONSULTATIONS (PRESUMABLY WITH SHAH), TELEPHONED AMBASSADOR AUGUST 21 TO HOLD USIRJC MEETING IN WASHINGTON BETWEEN MONDAY, NOVEMBER 7, AND FRIDAY, NOVEMBER 11. ANSARY SAID GOI VIEWED NUCLEAR ENERGY BILATERAL AS CENTERPIECE OF USIRJC RELATIONSHIP AND FELT NEXT USIRJC MEETING SHOULD BE HELD TO CONSUMMATE AGREEMENT ON THIS SUBJECT.

ACCORDINGLY, ANSARY ASKED WHETHER NECESSARY U.S. LEGISLATION WOULD BE PASSED IN TIME TO MAKE AGREEMENT (AT LEAST IN PRINCIPLE) FEASIBLE BEFORE SHAH'S VISIT. IF SUCH WOULD BE THE CASE, GOI IS PREPARED TO PROCEED WITH USIRJC PRIOR SHAH'S VISIT. IF NOT, GOI WOULD PREFER WAIT UNTIL AGREEMENT REACHED, AND THEN SCHEDULE MEETING.
ACTION REQUESTED: PLEASE PROVIDE BEST ESTIMATE EFFECTIVE DATE OF ENERGY LEGISLATION AND PROSPECTS FOR REACHING AGREEMENT ON BILATERAL PRIOR EARLY NOVEMBER.

1977TEHRAN07495.subject: IRANIAN STATEMENT ON THE WEST BANK

segments.text: IRANIAN PRESS AUG 22 REFERRED TO STATEMENT BY FONMIN SPOKESMAN AUG 21, WHICH "EXPRESSED DEEP REGRET" ON THE DECISION OF THE ISRAELI GOVERNMENT REGARDING NEW SETTLEMENTS ON THE WEST BANK. THE SPOKESMAN WAS QUOTED AS SAYING THESE MEASURES ARE CONTRARY TO INTERNATIONAL LAW AND CONSTITUTE A GREAT OBSTACLE TO FULFILLMENT OF EFFORTS TO ACHIEVE PEACE IN THE REGION.

COMMENT: THIS STATEMENT CAN BE TAKEN AS A STRAIGHTFORWARD EXPRESSION OF GOI POLICY. GOI HAND WAS NOT FORCED AS FAR AS WE CAN SEE BY ANY ARAB PRESSURES ON THIS ISSUE, AND THE EXTENSIVE PLAY IN THE PRESS COULD ONLY REFLECT OFFICIAL ENCOURAGEMENT. STATEMENT MAY HAVE BEEN PARTLY INSPIRED BY THE CONFUSION ATTENDING A PURPORTED MFA SPOKESMAN'S STATEMENT ON JERUSALEM THE DAY BEFORE (SEE REFTEL) BUT IS NOT DIRECTLY CONNECTED WITH IT.
REF SECTO 9010

REFTEL INSTRUCTS ME TO TELL IRANIANS THAT, IN OUR VIEW, LONG-RANGE SURFACE TO SURFACE MISSILE CO-PRODUCTION ARRANGEMENT WITH ISRAEL WOULD BE "UNDESIRABLE". IN ORDER CONVEY THIS MESSAGE TO GENERAL TOUFANIAN, I WILL NEED MORE DETAILED INSTRUCTIONS.

FIRST, I WILL NEED TO KNOW WHETHER "LONG-RANGE" REFERS ONLY TO THE 500-KM MISSILE. IT WILL BE RECALLED THAT THE PACKAGE INVOLVES BOTH A 75-KM RANGE AND A 500-KM RANGE WEAPON. AM I CORRECT IN UNDERSTANDING THAT ONLY THE 500-KM WEAPON IS CONSIDERED "UNDESIRABLE"?

SECOND, I WILL NEED TO KNOW THE GROUNDS ON WHICH WE FIND THE PROPOSAL UNDESIRABLE. IS IT BECUAS WE FEAR THAT KNOWLEDGE OF SUCH A CO-PRODUCTION SCHEME WOULD UPSET POLITCAL BALANCES IN THE MIDDLE EAST? OR IS IT BECAUSE WE CONSIDER THE INTRODUCTION OF SUCH A WEAPON INTO IRAN WOULD UPSET THE MILITARY BALANCE, SPECIFICALLY WITH IRAQ?

THIRD, HOW SHOULD IRAN INTERPRET THE WORD "UNDESIRABLE"? REFTEL POINTS OUT THAT, IN ABSENCE U.S. COMPONENTS, WE HAVE NO LEGAL GROUNDS FOR BLOCKING THE CO-PRODUCTION SCHEME. THE SHAH UNDERSTANDS THIS, BUT WISHES TO KNOW IF WE WILL RAISE "OBJECTIONS." HE OBVIOUSLY HAS IN MIND THE SORTS OF ACTION WE HAVE TAKEN VIS-A-VIS PAKISTAN WITH RESPECT TO ITS REPROCESSING PLANT. I THEREFORE NEED TO KNOW WHETHER OUR POSITION IS MERELY THAT WE WOULD DEPRECATE THE CO-PRODUCTION, OR WHETHER WE SEEK ACTIVELY TO IMPEDE ITS REALIZATION.

ON BALANCE, IT SEEMS TO ME THAT THE MOST FEASIBLE APPROACH WOULD BE FOR ME TO TELL TOUFANIAN THAT WE WILL RAISE NO RPT NO OBJECTION TO THE CO-PRODUCTION OF THE 75-KM MISSLE, WHICH COULD BE DEFINED AS DEFENSIVE WITHIN A NARROW BELT ON IRAN'S FRONTIERS. SUCH A WEAPON WOULD NOT, FOR EXAMPLE, REACH BAGHDAD OR KIRKUK.

ON THE OTHER HAND, I COULD TELL TOUFANIAN THAT WE WOULD ACTIVELY OPPOSE CO-PRODUCTION OF THE 500-KM MISSILE BECAUSE IT WOULD NOT ONLY COVER NEARLY ALL OF IRAQ BUT WOULD ALSO BRING SAUDI ARABIAN OIL FIELDS WITHIN ITS RANGE. I FEEL IT WOULD BE USEFUL IN OUR CONTINUING RELATIONS OF CONFIDENTIALITY WITH IRAN TO BE TOTALLY CANDID ON THIS LATTER POINT.

I REALIZE SECRETARY IS HEAVILY ENGAGED IN CHINA AND HAS PRECIOUS LITTLE TIME FOR EXTRANEOUS MATTERS. HOWEVER, I WILL BE SEEING TOUFANIAN IN CONJUNCTION WITH GENERAL FISH VISIT AUGUST 24 AND WOULD VERY MUCH APPRECIATE ELABORATION ON MY INSTRUCTIONS BEFORE THEN.
DEPT PLEASE REPEAT URGENTLY TO SECRETARY AND AMBASSADOR LEWIS.
TOUFANIAN UNDERTOOK TO RELAY STATEMENT I HAD JUST GIVEN TO SHAH AND ASKED THAT I SEEK AN AUDIENCE EARLY NEXT WEEK, AFTER SHAH'S RETURN.

TOUFANIAN THEN WENT ON TO SAY THAT HE WAS SOMEWHAT PERPLEXED BY SECYS MESSAGE AND COULD ONLY CONCLUDE THAT ISRAELIS HAD NOT LEVELED WITH US. ACCORDING TO HIM, JERICHO MISSILE IS ALREADY DEPLOYED WITH ISRAELI FORCES. HE ESTIMATED THEY MIGHT HAVE "ONLY A COUPLE OF DOZEN," BUT, "GIVEN THE RIGHT WARHEAD, THAT'S ALL THEY NEED."

HE HAD PERSONALLY WITNESSED A TEST-FIRING OF ONE OF THE JERICHOS ON A MEDITERRANEAN RANGE AND COULD VOUCHFOR ITS CHARACTERISTICS AND ACCURACY. SO, HE SAID, COULD THE US NAVY, WHICH WAS AN "UNINVITED WITNESS". HE SAID A HELICOPTER WITH US NAVY MARKINGS WAS CIRCLING THE POINT OF IMPACT DURING THE FIRING AND OBSERVED SPLASHDOWN.

TOUFANIAN THEN WENT ON TO SAY THAT PRIMARY ISRAELI INTEREST IN CO-PRODUCTION SCHEME, IN HIS OPINION, WAS MONEY THEY WOULD EARN FROM THEIR ASSOCIATION IWTH IRAN. ON THE OTHER HAND, PRIMARY IRANIAN INTEREST WAS IN ACQUISITION OF JERICHO, WHICH WAS NEEDED TO MATCH THE IRAQI SCUDS. IRAN HAD VERY LITTLE INTEREST IN THE GABRIEL, EXCEPT FOR THE SEABORNE VIERSION, WHICH WAS STILL IN DEVELOPMENT STAGE.

TOUFANIAN SAID THAT, IF IRANIANS COULD NOT GET THE JERICHO, THEY WOULD BUY AND "IMPROVED SCUD" FROM THE SOVIETS. HE SAID THEY WERE ACCUMULATING LARGE RUBLE BALANCES FROM THEIR GAS SALES TO THE USSR AND ABOUT THE ONLY THING THE SOVIETS HAD TO SELL WERE WEAPONS. HE WOULD FIND THIS A LESS SATISFACTORY ARRANGEMENT THAN THE CO-PRODUCTION SCHEME WITH ISRAEL, BECAUSE FRANKLY HE WAS INTERESTED IN HAVING HIS OWN PRODUCTION FACILITIES IN COUNTRY.

COMMENT: AS WILL BE APPARENT FROM FOREGOING, RATIONALE PRESENTED IN REF A WILL BE INADEQUATE FOR MY DISCUSSIONS WITH SHAH. NOT ONLY WILL I NEED NEW AND REVISED INSTRUCTIONS (INCLUDING WHATEVER MAY BE IMPLICIT IN REF B), BUT I BELIEVE IT WOULD BE HELPFUL TO HAVE ADDITIONAL COMMENTS FROM AMB LEWIS CONCERNING TOUFANIAN'S STATEMENTS ABOUT JERICHO DEPLOYMENT WITH ISRAELI FORCES. FINALLY, IT SEEMS TO ME THAT ANY DEMARCHES I MAKE TO SHAH SHOULD BE MADE IN PARALLEL TO THE ISRAELIS IN ORDER TO AVOID WHIPSAW EFFECTS.
DEPT PLEASE PASS PEKING FOR SECY AND TEL AVIV FOR AMB LEWIS. PLEASE ALSO PROVIDE NEW INSTRUCTIONS FOR AUDIENCE WITH SHAH TO ARRIVE HERE NOT LATER THAN AUG 29.

BEST INFORMATION AVAILABLE TO THIS EMB INDICATES THAT A NUMBER OF TERRORISTS ARRESTED IN RECENT MONTHS HAVE HAD TRAINING IN MAINLAND CHINA. HOWEVER, THIS TRAINING DATES BACKSOME YEARS AND WE HAVE NO INDICATION THAT SUCH TRAINING HAS CONTINUED IN RECENT PAST. IMPLICATION IS THAT CHINESE MAY BE INACTIVE IN THAT ASPECT OF THINGS, BUT IRANIAN OFFICIALS ARE NOT PREPARED TO SAY CHINESE HAVE STOPPED.

NEW HEAD OF EAST ASIA DEPT IN MFA MOTAMEDI, WHO WAS PREVIOUSLY IRANIAN CONSUL GENERAL IN HONG KONG, CONTINUES TO OPERATE UNDER THE ASSUMPTION THAT CHINESE OFFICIAL AND UNOFFICIAL POLICIES CAN AND OFTEN DO DIVERGE. WE WOULD SAY, THEREFORE, THAT ESFANDIARI IS NOT THAT FAR OFF BASE, SINCE HE REFLECTS APPARENT OPINION IN MFA AT LEAST.

AS TO PARA 3 OF REFTEL (PARA 2 APPARENTLY OMITTED) WE SUSPECT ESFANDIARI IS WINGING IT ON HIS OWN. IRAN MAINTAINS FRIENDLY DIPLOMATIC RELATIONS WITH PRC, BUT HAS SHOWN THAT IT UNDERSTANDS COMPLEXITY OF OUR POSITION BETWEEN PEKING AND TAIPIE. BY SAME TOKEN (PARA 4 REFTEL) . IRAN MIGH APPROVE OF US ECONOMIC ASSISTANCE TO VIETNAM BUT SHAH CERTAINLY WOULD NOT WISH IRANIANS TO PREACH TO US ON ANY OF THESE MATTERS WHICH DO NOT DIRECTLY RELATE TO US-IRAN RELATIONSHIP.

ESFANDIARI IS A VETERAN DIPLOMAT WITH APPROXIMATELY 37 YEARS SERVICE. WE HAVE NOTHING TO ADD TO TEHRAN A-18 OF FEB 3, 1977, WHICH WAS SENT TO PEKING. PLEASE ADVISE IF YOU WOULD LIKE US TO REPEAT BIO INFO IN IT TELEGRAPHICALLY.

ACTING CHIEF OF IRANIAN NATIONAL POLICE JA'AFARI TOLD DCM AT A CHANCE MEETING EVENING OF AUG 24 OF HIS GROWING CONCERN ABOUT POSSIBLE CONSEQUENCES OF THE RELEASE OF POLITICAL PRISONERS. HE SAID THAT A NUMBER OF YOUNG TERRORISTS WHO HAD CLOSE TIES WITHSTUDENTS WERE AMONG THEM AND THAT THERE WOULD BE ADDITIONAL RELEASE OF ABOUT 400 ON THE OCCASION OF THE SHAH'S BIRTHDAY OCT 26. THESE RELEASES PUT A POTENT FORCE OF POTENTIAL TROUBLE-MAKERS BACK ON THE STREETS AND JA'AFARI FELT THAT GIVEN THEIR TIES WITH UNIV STUDENTS THERE WAS A PREGNANT POSSIBILITY THAT WHEN THE FALL SCHOOL TERM OPENED SEPT 24 SERIOUS TROUBLE COULD FOLLOW.

INDEED, HE FELT THAT THE UNIV SCENE AND STUDENT ACTIVITY MAY WELL PROVE TO BE THE FIRST MAJOR TEST OF THE AMOUZEGA CABINET HE WAS NOT SANGUINE ABOUT THE OUTCOME BECAUSE HE FELT THAT THE MINISTER OF EDUCATION GANJI WAS NOT WELL QUALIFIED TO DEAL WITH THIS KIND OF TROUBLE. IN JA'AFARI'S OPINION GANJI HELD NEITHER THE KIND OF RESPECT OR THE TRUST OF THE ACADEMIC COMMUNITY OR THE STUDENTS WHICH WAS ESSENTIAL TO NIPPING POTENTIAL DISTRUBANCES IN THE CAMPUS IN THE BUD.

JA'AFARI SAID THAT HE HAD A WELL TRAINED FORCE WHICH AMOUNTED TO ABOUT 2 DIVISIONS PREPARED FOR POSSIBLE TROUBLE. MANY IN THIS FORCE WERE YOUNGER AND BETTER EDUCATED THAN IN THE PAST, HOWEVER, AND HE WAS NOT AT ALL CERTAIN THAT THEY WOULD BE PREPARED TO FIRE ON THE STUDENTS IF THINGS GOT OUT OF HAND. (JA'AFARI IS A FORMER SAVAK COLONEL AND TOUGH LAW AND ORDER MAN). HE FELT THAT IF STUDENT DISTURBANCES COULD BE CONFINED TO THE CAMPUS THE CHANCES OF CONTAINING THE SITUATION WERE REASONABLY GOOD. HE WAS A GREAT LESS SANGUINE ABOUT THE OUTCOME IF THEY BROKE OUT INTO THE STREETS.

COMING FROM SOMEONE WHO IS NORMALLY CONFIDENT AND OPTIMISTIC, JA'AFARI'S FOREBODING SUGGESTS A MORE TROUBLED FUTURE THAN WE HAVE SEEN IN THE RECENT PAST. BY AND LARGE THE UNIV SCENE DURING THE LAST SCHOOL YEAR WAS RELATIVELY QUIESCENT AND LOCAL AUTHORITIES HAVE GROWN MORE SOPHISTICATED IN DEALING WITH THOSE DISTURBANCES THAT HAVE OCCURRED. WHETHER WE WIL WITNESS A RETURN TO VIOLENT CONFRONTATION AND CONCOMITANT OVER-REACTION BY THE POLICE REMAINS TO BE SEEN BUT JA'AFARI'S ANALYSIS DOES NOT PRESENT A HAPPY PROSPECT. AN EARLIER REPORT OF JA-AFARI'S VIES ALONG FOREGOING LINES HAS BEEN SENT IN A SEPARATE CHANNEL.

1977TEHRAN07647.subject: LOS: COMPULSORY DISPUTE SETTLEMENT: MILITARY EXEMPTION AND IRAN

segments.text: EXEMPTION AND IRAN REF STATE 202485
THANKS FOR REFTEL INFORMING ME THAT DECISION TO SEEK MORE INFORMATION ON IRANIAN POSITION RE COMPULSORY DISPUTE SETTLEMENT IN LOS WAS INDEED COORDINATED WITH YOU BEFORE ACTION WAS TAKEN.

I AM STILL CONCERNED, HOWEVER, THAT ADMIRAL MORRIS, OR OTHERS ON YOUR STAFF MAY NOT YET UNDERSTAND THAT THEY CAN NOT RPT NOT INITIATE MESSAGES ON POLICY MATTERS THROUGH NAVY CHANNELS TO INDIVIDUAL NAVY OFFICERS IN THIS MISSION. IT IS NOT A CASE OF "REGRETTING THAT ADMIRAL CONOLLY TOOK UP THE ISSUE WITH HIS IRANIAN COUNTERPART WITHOUT CONSULTING" ME. ADMIRAL CONOLLY SHOULD NEVER HAVE RECEIVED THE MESSAGE AND SHOULD NOT RPT NOT RECEIVE SIMILAR INSTRUCTIONS IN THE FUTURE. MESSAGES ON THIS SUBJECT SHOULD BE SENT TO THE EMBASSY AND WE WILL DECIDE WHO WILL EXECUTE THEM.

IN THIS INSTANCE, AS TEHRAN 7228 POINT OUT, THE MATTER WAS RAISED WITH THE FOREIGN MININSTRY BY MY DCM. WE HAVE WHAT WE REGARD AS ADEQUATE ASSURANCES FROM THE RESPONSIBLE IRANIAN OFFICER THAT "HE FAVORED THE CONCEPT OF EXEMPTION OF WARSHIPS OR SHIPS OWNED OR OPERATED BY THE STATE FROM THE COMPULSORY DISPUTE SETTLEMENT PROVISION OF THE DRAFT AS HE ALSO FAVORED EXEMPTION OF MARITIME TERRITORY DISPUTES".
IF, IN FUTURE DISCUSSIONS WITH IRANIAN DELEGATION, THESE ASSURANCES PROVE INADEQUATE, PLEASE CABLE THE EMBASSY AND WE WILL TAKE APPROPRIATE ACTION.
I WILL ADDRESS THE QUESTION OF IRANIAN ATTITUDES TOWARDS DEEP SEABED ISSUES IN A SEPARATE MESSAGE AFTER FURTHER STUDY OF THE PROBLEMS INVOLVED.

REF A. TEHRAN 7601 B. PEKING 1881 PERTINENT SECTION OF TEHRAN'S A-18 AS FOLLOWS: MAHMUD ESFANDIARI, 61, HAS BEEN NAMED GOI AMBASSADOR TO THE PRC. HE IS A GRADUATE IN POLITICAL SCIENCE FROM THE UNIVERSITY OF BRUSSELS AND HAS A LAW DEGREE FROM THE UNIVERSITY OF LIEGE. A CAREER DIPLOMAT WHO ENTERED THE DIPLOMATIC SERVICE IN 1940, HIS FOREIGN ASSIGNMENTS HAVE INCLUDED STOCKHOLM, BERN, GENEVA, AMBASSADOR TO CANADA (1958-62) AND AMBASSADOR TO SWITZERLAND (1970-73) . WITHIN THE FOREIGN MINISTRY ESFANDIARI HAS SERVED AS HEAD OF THE FOREIGN MINISTERS' SECRETARIAT, CHIEF OF BUDGET AND PERSONNEL DIVISION, UNDERSECRETARY FOR ADMINISTRATIVE AFFAIRS AND UNDERSECRETARY FOR PRESS AND INFORMATION.

HE HAS IMPRESSED THOSE HE HAS MET AS BEING QUIET, EFFICIENT AND PRO-WESTERN. HIS WIFE IS A MEMBER OF THE GHARACOZLOU FAMILY, ONE OF THE MOST PROMINENT TRIBAL FAMILIES IN IRAN. HE SPEAKS FLUENT FRENCH AND GOOD ENGLISH.

1977TEHRAN07696.subject: IRANIAN AND PAKISTANI ATTITUDES TOWARD CENTO

segments.text: REF A. ANKARA 6336, B. TEHRAN 6224 (NOTAL)

AS NOTED IN TEHRAN REFTEL, IRANIANS DESISTED FROM PUTTING UP CANDIDATE FOR THE NEXT CENTO SYG BECAUSE THEY BELIEVE TURKEY'S TURN IS NOT YET COMPLETED. IN OTHER WORDS THEY PREFER TO WAIT AND HAVE THEIR CANDIDATE SERVE A FULL TERM RATHER THAN SIMPLY COMPLETING BAYULKEN'S TERM OF OFFICE. THIS DOES NOT IN ANY WAY SIGNIFY LESS INTEREST IN CENTO.

IN FACT, SHAH IS ON RECORD DESCRIBING CENTO AS "A CLUB" FOR WHICH APPEARANCES COUNT AT LEAST AS MUCH AS UNDERLYING SUBSTANCE. IRANIANS GENERALLY AGREE WITH ESTIMATE THAT PAKISTAN'S FUTURE PARTICIPATION IN CENTO CONTINUES IN DOUBT (AS INDEED IT HAS FOR SOME YEARS). LATEST DEVELOPMENTS IN PAKISTAN SUGGEST BOTH SIDES IN UPCOMING ELECTION CARRY SUBSTANTIAL ANTI-CENTO VIEWS, THOUGH BHUTTO'S ATTITUDE IS, OF COURSE, MORE COMPLICATED THAN PNA'S OUTRIGHT ANNOUNCEMENT THAT PAKISTAN WILL WITHDRAW IF PNA WINS.

AS TO SPECIFIC STEPS TAKEN BY PRESENT PAKISTAN MILITARY GOVERNMENT (ANKARA REFTEL), MFA DEPARTMENT HEAD HERE RAISES THE SPECULATION THAT PAKISTANI RETICENCE MIGHT RPT MIGHT BE LIMITED ONLY TO MILITARY PARTICIPATION IN CENTO ACTIVITIES. WHETHER OR NOT THIS COULD LEAD TO SOME SORT OF MODIFIED PARTICIPATION BY PAKISTAN IN THE MANNER, SAY, OF GREECE IN NATO REMAINS TO BE SEEN.

WHILE IRANIANS HAVE NOT MADE ANY RECENT REPRESENTATIONS TO PAKISTAN RE CENTO, THEY THINK PAKISTANIS ARE WELL AWARE THAT THEIR CONTINUING COOPERATION WITH IRAN AND TURKEY IN THE RCD ORGANIZATION IS CLOSELY RELATED TO EXISTENCE OF THE CENTO ALLIANCE. SHOULD PAKISTAN MOVE TO SEVER ITS TIES WITH CENTO, IRANIANS TELL US FUTURE OF ORGANIZATION WILL TO A LARGE EXTENT DEPEND ON ATTITUDE USG ASSUMES TOWARD ITS CONTINUED EXISTENCE.

1977TEHRAN07698.subject: PARLIAMENT APPROVES AMOUZEGAR CABINET AND ITS PROGRAM

segments.text: SUMMARY. PRIMIN JAMSHI AMOUZEGAR'S CABINET RECEIVED UNANIMOUS VOTES OF CONFIDENCE FROM MAJLES (LOWER HOUSE) AUG 25 AND SENATE (UPPER HOUSE) AUG 27 AFTER UNPRECEDENTED SERIES OF LENGTHY SPEECHES IN PARLIAMENT. MOST DEPUTIES AND SENATORS ACCEPTED AMOUZEGAR'S PROGRAM, BUT MANY STRESSED THAT NEW GOVT MUST IMPLEMENT PAPER PROMISES (OF PREVIOUS GOVTS) AND REALIZE MEASURABLE GOALS. IMPLICIT IN THEIR SPEECHES WAS CRITICISM OF FORMER HOVEYDA GOVTS LACK OF SUCCESS IN HOUSING, AGRICULTURAL, AND EDUCATIONAL SECTORS. END SUMMARY.

LEVEL OF LEGISLATORS' INTEREST IN NEW GOVT WAS HIGH BY IRANIAN STANDARDS. PREVIOUS VOTES OF CONFIDENCE HAVE GENERALLY BEEN PRO FORMA. 25 DEPUTIES AND 8 SENATORS SPOKE FOR TOTAL OF 22 HOURS. THEIR REMARKS RECEIVED EXTENSIVE COVERAGE IN FARSI AND ENGLISH LANGUAGE PRESS. IN CONTRAST TO PAST OCCASIONS, AMOUZEGAR AND HIS CABINET ATTENDED ALL MAJLES AND SENATE SESSIONS.

DEPUTIES AND SENATORS REITERATED FAMILIAR THEMES AS THEY EXHORTED NEW GOVT TO FIND NEW SOLUTIONS FOR HOUSING, AGRICULTURAL, EDUCATIONAL AND BUREAUCRATIC PROBLEMS. THEY ALSO CALLED FOR MORE HONESTY AND OPENNESS IN GOVT, FOR MORE AUSTERITY AND EXEMPLARY BEHAVIOR FROM PUBLIC SERVANTS.

AMOUZEGAR ADDRESSED MAJLES AND SENATE. IN MAJLES AUG 25 HE CALLED FOR RESISTANCE TO "A SPIRIT OF INDOLENCE AND SLOTH" WHICH HAS BEEN CAUSED BY EASY LIFE PAID FOR BY PETROLEUM REVENUES. HE STRONGLY ENDORSED IMPORTANT ROLE OF RASTAKHIZ PARTY IN NATIONAL DIALOGUE BUT POINTED OUT THAT GOVTS COMMITMENT TO SERVE THE PEOPLE MUST BE MATCHED BY PEOPLE'S COMMITMENT TO WORK HARD TO BUILD UP THE COUNTRY. HE SAID HIS GOVT WOULD CONCENTRATE ON HOUSING, EDUCATIONAL AND AGRICULTURAL PROBLEMS AND WOULD REDUCE BUREAUCRACY AND RED TAPE TO A MINIMUM. IN SENATE ON AUG 27 HE EXPANDED ON THEME OF LUKAND OUR CHILDREN WILL HAVE NONE.

WE CANNOT DO WHATEVER WE WISH WITH OUR OIL TO THE DETRIMENT OF FUTURE GENERATIONS... WE MUST HAND OVER A DEVELOPED IRAN TO FUTURE GENERATIONS." AMOUZEGAR ALSO CONDEMNED DISCRIMINATION OF ALL KINDS, WELCOMED GREATER PARTICIPATION OF WOMEN IN NATIONAL ACTIVITY AND CALLED FOR GREATER ROLE OF PRIVATE SECTOR IN IRANIAN DEVELOPMENT.

COMMENT: VIGOROUS PARLIAMENTARY DEBATE ON AMOUZEGAR AND NEW GOVT IS ANOTHER INDICATION OF SHAH'S CONSCIOUS POLICY TO ENCOURAGE MORE CONSTRUCTIVE CRITICISM AND MORE OPEN GOVT. THAT RUMORED THAT AMOUZEGAR HAS BEEN GIVEN 3 TO 4 MONTHS TO
REF ISLAMABAD 8778

SHAH HAS DISCUSSED WITH ME IN A CURSORY WAY HIS MOTIVES IN OFFERING SUPPORT TO BHUTTO. HE SAID THAT HE HAS NO GREAT AFFECTION FOR BHUTTO PERSONALLY AND NO ILLUSIONS THAT BHUTTO CAN BE RESTORED TO HIS FORMER POSITION OF PARAMOUNTCY. ON THE OTHER HAND, HE VIEWS ALL THE ALTERNATIVES MUCH MORE DIMLY.

HE FEELS THAT A PNA VICTORY WOULD PAVE THE WAY TOWARDS "DISINTEGRATION". HE BELIEVES THE CURRENT COALITION IS HELD TOGETHER ONLY BY ITS ANTAGONISM TO BHUTTO. HF THEY WERE TO WIN, HE FEELS THEY WOULD SOON FALL APART AND PRODUCE A NEW NADIR OF CHAOS.

AMONG HIS OTHER CONCERNS ABOUT A PNA VICTORY WOULD BE LHE EFFECT OF THE MOSLEM RELIGIOUS EXTREMISTS UPON IRANIAN MOSLEM GROUPS, WHICH ARE CURRENTLY UNDER EFFECTIVE SECULAR CONTROL. A RETURN TO STRICT ISLAMIC PRACTICES IN NEIGHBORING PAKISTAN COULD LAP OVER INTO THE EASTERN REGIONS OF IRAN.

MANY OF THESE SAME THEMES WERE LABORATED UPON AUGUST 28 IN CALL WHICH UNDER SECRETARY BENSON MADE ON ACTING FOREIGN MINISTER ZELLI, WHO WAS UNTIL RECENTLY IRANIAN AMBASSADOR TO PAKISTAN. ZELLI GAVE IT AS HIS FIRM CONVICTION THAT MLA WOULD CARRY THROUGH ON ITS UNDERTAKING TO HOLD ELECTIONS AND THAT, THEREFORE, ONLY CHOICES WERE BETWEEN BHUTTO AND THE FISSIPAROUS PNA.

INTERESTINGLY ENOUGH, ZELLI TOTALLY DISCOUNTED AMY IMMEDIATE CONCERN ABOUT THE BALUCHI REGION, ON EITHER SIDE OF THE FRONTIER. HE SAID HE THOUGHT THINGS WERE CALM IN THAT REGION AND WOULD REMAIN SO NO MATTER WHAT THE OUTCOME OF THE ELECTIONS. HE SAID IRANIAN CONCERNS ABOUT BALUCHIS WERE IN THE LONGER TERM AND RELATED TO THEIR "UNDERDEVELOPMENT". HE TICKED OFF IRANIAN AID TO VARIOUS PROJECTS ON BOTH SIDES OF THE BORDER DESIGNED TO "MODERNIZE" THE BALUCHIS AND BRING THEM CLOSER INTO HARMONY WITH THE ECONOMY DEVELOPING AROUND THEM.

AS FOR AMBASSADOR HUMMEL'S QUESTION ABOUT ATTEMPTING TO DISSUADE THE SHAH FROM FINAGLING IN THE ELECTION, I AGREE WITH HIS CONCLUSION THAT IT WOULD BE USELESS. HE DOES NOT PERSONALLY SEEM ALL THAT DEDICATED TO HIS SUCCESS. IN DISCUSSING HIS PREDILECTIONS WITH ME HE SHRUGGED HIS SHOULDERS AND SAID HIS SUPPORT WOULD PROBABLY BE OF NO CONSEQUENCE. "AFTER ALL," HE SMILED, "I ALSO PUT UP MONEY TO SUPPORT INDIRA GANDHI."

1977TEHRAN07721.subject: IRANIAN VIEWS ON DEEP SEABED ISSUE

segments.text: PURSUANT TO YOUR CABLE (REFTEL POL COUNS (LAMBRAKIS) DISCUSSED DEEP SEABED WITH CHIEF IRANIAN LOS REP KAZEMI AUG 28. KAZEMI MADE NO SECRET OF HIS "INTELLECTUAL ATTACHMENT" TO THE UNITARY IDEA AS OPPOSED TO THE PARALLES SYSTEM. HE ALLOWED THAT THIS WAS THE LOGICAL WAY PREFERRED BY THE MAJORITY OF MANKING. HE NOTED THAT ANY PROPOSED DEEP SEABED AGENCY WOULD ACTUALLY BE RUN BY AN EXECUTIVE COMITE ON WHICH US, CANADA, AND OTHER WESTERN NATIONS WOULD BE HEAVILY REPRESENTED. EVEN A MAJORITY NOT UNLIKE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEES WHICH RUN OTHER INSTUTIONS SUCH AS THE INTERNATIONAL BANK.

AFTER FURTHER DISCUSSION OF THE ISSUES, KAZEMI FELL BACK ON THE POSITION THAT IRAN'S NATIONAL INTERESTS COULD IN FACT ACCOMMODATE THEMSELVES TO EITHER THE UNITARY OR THE PARALLEL SYSTEMS. POSITION HE WAS ADVOCATING WAS NOT VITAL TO IRAN AND, BY IMPLICATION, COULD CHANGE. HE AS MUCH AS ADMITTED TO POL COUNS THAT POSITIONS HE GENERALLY ESPOUSED IN LOS MEETING HAVE NEVER BEEN STUDIED IN ANY DEPTH BY IRAN'S ULTIMATE POLICY MAKER (THE SHAH), THOUGH GENERAL LINE HE FOLLOWED IN THESE MEETINGS WAS, OF COURSE, APPROVED BY KAZEMI'S SUPERVISORS.

A BASIC POINT KAZEMI WISHED TO MAKE IS THAT THE LOS CONFERENCE HAD NOT YET REACHED A NEGOTIATING STAGE WHERE GOVTS TOOK POSITIONS AND ATTEMPTED TO AGREE ON DEFINITE SETS OF PROPOSALS. EVERYTHING WAS BEING DONE BY CONSENSUS, AND VARIOUS COMPROMISES THAT HAD BEEN PROPOSED WERE DROPPED AT THE FIRST OBJECTION, WITHOUT VOTES BEING TAKEN. IN FACT, HE THOUGHT THE CONFERENCE HAD NOT BEEN WELL PREPARED (IN CONTRAST TO 1958 CONFERENCE WHICH HE RECALLED HAD BEEN). ONCE OPENING REMARKS HAD BEEN MADE IN CARACAS IN 1974, NO FURTHER RECORDS WERE BEING KEPT AND THERE WERE NO DOCUMENTS AS SUCH TO GUIDE THE DISCUSSION.

A GREAT DEAL OF LATITUDE WAS ALLOWED THE PERSONAL OPINION OF DELEGATES, WHICH KAZEMI MADE CLEAR HE DID NOT OBJECT TO. HE THOUGHT IT HAD BEEN USEFULE AND EDUCATIONAL THAT THE ISSUES WERE BEING DISCUSSED IN THIS LESS STRUCTURED WAY BUT ONE COULD NOT REALLY SPEAK ABOUT FORMAL NATIONAL POSITIONS ON QUESTIONS. THE DELS WERE ACTING PARTLY AS INDIVIDUALS, PARTYLY AS INTERNATIONAL LWYERS, AND ONLY PARTLY AS REPS OF THEIR GOVT. ALL THIS SHOULD BE KEPT IN MIND, KAZEMI SAID, WHEN DESCRIBING POSITIONS HE TOOK IN LOS DISCUSSIONS.

COMMENT: IN SHORT, KAZEMI WAS CONFESSING THAT THE VIEWS HE EXPRESSES AT LOS ARE ESSENTIALLY HIS OWN. CONSEQUENTLY, IT MAY BE POSSIBLE TO MODIFY THE VIEWS WHICH HAVE BEEN EXPRESSED BY THE IRANIAN LOS DEL ON DEEP SEABED ISSUES. IF YOU FEEL IT IMPORTANT ENOUGH, AND THE ISSUES ON WHICH IRANIAN SUPPORT IS NEEDED ARE SHARPLY ENOUGH DEFINED, SUCH MODIFICATION MIGHT BE WORTH EXPLORING. WE COULD DO PREPARATORY WORK HERE, BUT, IN FINAL ANALYSIS, A VISIT TO TEHRAN BY LOS EXPERTS FROM YOUR STAFF MAY BE REQUIRED.
SUCH A VISIT WOULD, OF COURSE, BE MORE CERTAIN OF SUCCESS IF US AND SOVIET POSITIONS ON THESE ISSUES WERE KNOWN TO BE IN HARMONY AT THAT TIME.

1977TEHRAN07746.subject: SOME IRANIAN THOUGHTS ON PERSIAN GULF, PLO, ARAB LEAGUE AND IRAQ

segments.text: ARAB LEAGUE AND IRAQ REF BEIRUT 1399 (NOTAL), KUWAIT 4661 (NOTAL)

SUMMARY. IN CONTRAST TO FLURRY OF LOCAL PRESS STORIES DETAILING REAL AND SUPPOSED ATTACKS ON IRAN'S POLICY FROM PLO AND OTHER SOURCES RECENTLY, OUR MFA CONTACTS CALMLY DOWNPLAY POSSIBILITIES OF ANY SUBSTANTIAL THREAT TO IRAN'S INTERESTS IN PERSIAN GULF. BUT THEY ARE WATCHING EVENTS CLOSELY. END SUMMARY.

IN VIEW OF SEVERAL ARTICLES APPEARING OVER PAST WEEK IN IRANIAN PRESS, WE HAVE TAKEN SOUNDINGS AT MFA ON VARIOUS TOPICS INVOLVING PERSIAN GULF, IRAQ AND OTHER SUBJECTS. FIRST PRESS ARTICLE, AUGUST 23, NOTED AN ATTACK ON IRANIAN POLICY IN BEIRUT'S "AL SAWRA," CHARACTERIZED HERE AS A PLO ORGAN.

PAPER WAS REPORTEDLY COMMENTING ON ONE OF PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR'S STATEMENTS (IN CONNECTION WITH FORMATION OF NEW GOVERNMENT) WHICH REPEATED STANDARD IRANIAN LINE IN FAVOR OF COOPERATION AMONG LITTORAL STATES TO PROTECT PERSIAN GULF FROM OUTSIDE INTERFERENCE. "AL SAWRA" REPORTEDLY STATED PURPOSE BEHIND THIS IRANIAN IDEA IS PROTECTING CONTINUED FLOW OF OIL TO THE FACTORIES OF THE IMPERIALISTS, AND ENTAILS CRUSHING THE REVOLUTIONARY MOVEMENTS INSIDE IRAN AND IN THE "ARABIAN GULF" AREA. IRAN'S ASSISTANCE TO SULTAN QABUS IN OMAN WAS CITED, AND ARTICLE CONCLUDED THAT IRANIAN PROPOSAL FOR A COLLECTIVE SECURITY ARRANGEMENT IN PERSIAN GULF IS SUSPICIOUSLY TAILORED TO SERVE IMPERIALIST INTERESTS IN THE REGION.

EXACT REASONS FOR APPARENTLY GRATUITOUS ATTACK ON IRAN AT THIS TIME ARE UNKNOWN TO US OR TO IRANIAN MFA OFFICIALS. LATTER SPECULATE THAT IT IS SOMEHOW CONNECTED WITH EFFORTS TO WELD TOGETHER MAINLINE PLO AND REJECTIONISTS. BELIEF IS EXPRESSED BY THESE MFA OFFICIAL THAT LEFT WING MOVEMENTS IN ARAB WORLD ARE IN PROCESS OF COORDINATING THEIR EFFORTS, AND IRAN HAS BEEN TARGETED ALONG WITH OTHER FRIENDS OF THE US.

THEY ALSO CITE AN ARTICLE IN CAIRO'S AL AHRAM OF AUGUST 26 WHICH REPORTEDLY WE ON SAME THEME, TO WIT THAT IRANIAN SECURITY EFFORTS IN THE GULF ARE RESULT OF DESIRE TO SAFEGUARD US INTERESTS (SINCE US IS ACTING IN AREA THROUGH IRAN AND SAUDI ARABIA). ARTICLE APPARENTLY ALSO ALLEGES IRAN HAS PROMISED US TWENTYBANINE Y MILLION BARRELS OF OIL OVER NEXT TWENTY YEARS. ------------------113236 301357Z /44 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 4318 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY BEIRUT AMEMBASSY CAIRO AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY TEL AVIV SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 7746

MORE GENERALLY, MFA HAS NOTED ARAB LLEAGUE MEETING REPORTEDLY SCHEDULED FOR NEXT MONTH TO DISCUSS RED SEA DEFENSE AND OTHER MATTERS. OFFICIALS SUPPOSE PERSIAN GULF MIGHT ALSO BE DISCUSSED BUT TEND TO DISCOUNT VARIOUS REPORTS TO THE EFFECT THAT SAUDI ARABIA EITHER THROUGH ARAB LEAGUE OR INDEPENDENTLY WOULD BE INTERESTED IN FORGING SOME SORT OF DEFENSIVE ARAB GROUP TO EXCLUSION OF IRAN. THEY DOUBT MUCH WILL BE DONE EVEN IN CONNECTION WITH THE RED SEA, BUT ARE KEEPING THE SITUATION UNDER OBSERVATION.

ANOTHER NEWSPAPER ARTICLE AUGUST 29 CITES BAGHDAD NEWSPAPER, ALSO NAMED AL SAWRA AND IDENTIFIED AS OFFICIAL ORGAN OF IRAQI BA'ATH PARTY, TO EFFECT THAT IRAQI DELEGATION IS ON ITS WAY TO A PRELIMINARY MEETING IN RIYADH IN WHICH PERSIAN GULF STATES ARE TO CONSIDER ESTABLISHING AN OBSERVATORY STATION AND DISCUSS RELATED NAVIGATIONAL MATTERS WITHOUT INCLUDING IRAN. ARTICLE NOTES RECURRING USE OF TERM "ARAB GULF".

BY CONTRAST, APPROPRIATE MFA DEPARTMENT HEAD TELLS US IRAN IS STILLCONSIDERING WHETHER OR NOT TO REACT TO RECENT ESTABLISHMENT OF "ARAB GULF OFFICE" IN IRAQ (BAGHDAD REFTEL). HE NOTES IRAQ ALREADY HAS AN ARAB GULF INSTITUTE IN BASRA, AND IRAN WANTS TO CONSIDER CAREFULLY POSSIBLE REACTION OF IRAQ TO ANY PROTEST IRAN MIGHT LODGE. BY SAME TOKEN, DEPARTMENT HEAD GIVES AS HIS PERSONAL OPINION THAT NEW CHIEF OF IRAQI OFFICE, HASSAN ALI, MIGHT BE ON HIS WAY UP.

OFFICIAL RECALLS MEETING ALI AS DEPUTY HEAD OF IRAQI DELEGATION HERE AND WAS IMPRESSED BY ALI'S PHYSICAL FORCEFULNESS AND GOOD HEALTH, WHICH CONTRASTS WITH IZZAT IBRAHIM'S ILLNESS AND THE GENERALLY AGING, AILING STATE OF SOM MANY TOP LEADERS IN IRAQ. SINCE IRAQ CONTINUES ITS EFFORTS TO OCNCLUDE COOPERATION AGREEMENTS WITH IRAN IN EVERY CONCEIVABLE AREA--THE LAST, A WEEK AGO, WAS ONE FOR EXCHANGE OF MEDICAL INFORMATION--MFA OFFICIALS ARE NOT SURE WHETHER TO INCLUDE IRAQ AMONG CURRENT TROUBLEMAKERS ON PERSIAN FULF ISSUED.
FINALLY, MFA HAS HEARD REPORT OF KUWAITI CROWN PRINCE'S POSSIBLE GULF TOUR (KUWAIT REFTEL) BUT HAS NOTHING TO SUBSTANTIATE IT, OR VARIETY OF RUMORS AS TO ITS PURPOSE.
