1977TEHRAN07754.subject: BAHERI DEBUTS AS RESTAKHIZ SECY GEN

segments.text: BEGIN UNCLAS

RECENT NEWS AND EDITORIAL COVERAGE OF ACTIVITIES OF MOHAMMAD BAHERI ALREADY POINT TO HIS MORE ACTIVE ROLE AS SECY GEN OF RASTAKHIZ PARTY. ON AUG 27 IN HIS FIRST MAJOR PUBLIC STATEMENT AS SYG TO GROUP OF LEGISLATORS AND CABINET AND PARTY MEMBERS, BAHERI ELUCIDATED RPPI GOALS. HE SAID RPPI ENDS ARE ESSENTIALLY POLITICAL, NOT ADMINISTRATIVE. RPPI RESPONSIBILITIES ARE A. TO SERVE AS "ACCURATE, TURSTWORTHY AND SPEEDY INSTRUMENT" FOR CONVEYING PEROPLE'S NEEDS TO SHAH AND B. "TO COMPREHEND THE POLITICAL IMPLICATIONS OF IMPLEMENTING THE PRINCIPLES OF THE REVOLUTION AND OTHER GOVT PROBGRAMS AND TO ACT ON THIS KNOWLEDGE".

PARTY MEMBERSHIP MUST BE INCREASED AND PARTY CHAPTERS MUST SERVE AS CENTERS FOR DISCUSSION OF NATIONAL DEVELOPMENT. IRAN'S MAJOR TASKS ARE TO I INDUSTRIALIZE, TO CREATE NATIONAL TECHNOLOGY, AND TO ERADICATE CORRUPTION AND PROFITEERING. EDITORIAL REACTION AUG 29 PREDICTABLY APPLAUDED BAHERI'S STATEMENTS.
BAHERI'S NEXT STOP TO GATHER SUPPORT WAS TEHRAN BAZAAR WHERE ON AUG 28 HE PLEDGED PARTY CONSIDERATION OF BAZAAR PROBLEMS AND ENDORSED IMPORTANT ROLE FOR TRADE AND OTHER GUILDS.
ON AUG 31 BAHERI ATTENDED MAJLES SESSION AND LATER URGED PROVINCIAL DEPUTIES TO FOSTER PARTY SUPPORT WHEN THEY RETURNED TO THEIR HOMES THIS WEEK. END UNCLAS BEGIN CONFIDENTIAL

COMMENT: RELIABLE SOURCE REPORTS THAT BAHERI IS PRIVATELY SKEPTICAL ABOUT VIABILITY OF RPPI BUT REALIZES THAT SHAH IS DETERMINED TO ESTABLISH SIGNIFICANT POLITICAL PARTY BASE HERE. FOR THAT REASON HE CAN BE EXPECTED TO CAMPAIGN VIGOROUSLY FOR RPPI. HE HAS PREVIOUSLY BEEN CHARACTERIZED AS AMBITIOUS, ARTICULATE, OPPORTUNISTIC AND LOYAL TO SHAH. IF HE IS SUCCESSFUL IN IGNITING FIRS ON BEHALF OF THE PARTY, HE MAY BECOME MORE OF A POWER THAN WE WOULD INITIALLY HAVE EXPECTED.

1977TEHRAN07847.subject: SPECIFIC GOALS AND OBJECTIVES FOR AMB

segments.text: I BELIEVE LIST OF SPECIFIC GOALS AND OBJECTIVES CONTAINED REFTEL IS COMPREHENSIVE, BALANCED AND REALISTIC. I AM GRATEFUL TO BE SPARED FROM SOME OF THE MORE LUDICROUS POTENTIALS OF THIS EXERCISE.

THERE ARE A FEW OTHER AREAS WHICH I FEEL OUGHT TO BE INCLUDED, SINCE THEY SEEM TO OCCUPY A SIGNIFICANT PORTION OF MY TIME AND ATTENTION. I LEAVE IT TO YOU TO PHRASE THEM AS YOU WISH AND TO SPRINKLE THEM WHERE YOU WILL IN YOUR FORMAT.

FIRST IS THE VERY BROAD INTERFACE WHICH US AND IRAN HAVE IN THE EDUCATIONAL AND INTELLECTUAL FIELDS. GIVEN CONTINUING AFFLUENCE IN THIS COUNTRY, THERE WILL BE A SUSTAINED HEAVY DEMAND FOR HIGHER EDUCATION. THIS MEANS A HEAVY FLOW OF IRANIAN STUDENTS TO US FOR NEXT TWENTY YEARS WHILE IRANIAN EDUCATIONAL SYSTEM GETS BUILT UP. IT WILL ALSO PROBABLY MEAN IRANIAN DEMAND FOR ESTABLISHMENT OF MORE USTYPE, US-STAFFED UNIVERSITIES IN IRAN, ALONG LINES OF PAHLAVI AND DAMAVAND. I HAVE ALREADY BEEN HEAVILY ENGAGED IN REVISING WAYS WE COUNSEL, ORIENT AND SCREEN STUDENTS. I AM SURE I AILL BECOME INVOLVED IN ANY PUTATIVE UNIVERSITY TRANSPLANTS.

THE US COMMUNITY HERE IS NEW, AMORPHOUS AND DISCRETE. IT NEEDS LEADERSHIP, COUNSEL, ASSISTANCE AND, IN EXTREMIS, PSYCHIATRIC ATTENTION. TEHRAN IS NOT AN EASY, COMFORTABLE CITY TO LIVE IN, EVEN IF INDIVIDUAL PERSIANS ARE HOSPITABLE. FRUSTRATIONS ABOUND IN ALL QUARTERS -- TRAFFIC, HOUSING, EDUCATION, MEDICAL ATTENTION,ETC. I BELIEVE A LOT OF MY TIME WILL BE SPENT IN GUIDING AND COUNSELING THIS GROWING GROUP OF CLIENTS. THIS WILL INCLUDE CONSTANT ATTENTION TO THE QUESTIONS OF DRUG ABUSE, AND SUPPORT OF LOCAL DEA EFFORTS.

THE IRANIANS WISH TO HAVE "MILITARY STAFF TALKS" WITH US. INSTITUTIONALIZING SUCH TALKS WOULD SMACK TOO MUCH OF THE APPURTENANCES OF AN ALLIANCE AND HAVE UNFORTUNATE REPERCUSSIONS IN ALL AZIMUTHS. HOWEVER, GIVEN THE INCREASING SIZE AND REGIONAL INFLUENCE OF THE IRANIAN MILITARY, WE NEED TO HAVE AD HOC TALKS WITH THEM IN MANY AREAS WHERE OUR MILITARY INTERESTS IMPINGE. ESTABLISHING AND NOURISHING THIS EXERCISE WILL REQUIRE MY ATTENTION. ------------------101401 040925Z /12 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 4362 SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 7847 FOR NEA/IRN NAAS FROM SULLIVAN

OUR CONSULAR SECTION AND MANY SATELLITE ACTIVITIES ARE HOUSED IN A TOTALLY INADEQUATE AND INSECURE BUILDING. THROUGH INGENIOUS PROPOSALS BY OUR ADMINISTRATIVE COUNSELOR, WE ARE GOING TO BE ABLE TO BUILD A NEW OFFICE BUILDING ON THE EMB COMPOUND AT NO REPEAT NO EXPENSE TO USG EXCEPT FOR THE DISPOSAL OF AN UNUSED PATCH OF LAND IN TABRIZ. THE INCOMPETENCE OF FBO HAS ALREADY DELAYED THIS PROJECT BEYOND THE GROUND BREAKING DATE OF SEPTEMBER 1. WE WILL BADLY NEED THIS BUILDING BEFORE THE NEXT VISA RUSH IN THE LATE SPRING OF 1978. PAST EXPERIENCE INDICATES I WILL HAVE TO DO MUCH HEAD-KNOCKING IN WASHINGTON TO MEET THIS GOAL.

IN THE REPORTING PROGRAM, ONE OF MY PRINCIPAL GOALS IS AN ANALYSIS OF "AFTER PETROLEUM, WHAT". I AM NOT SATISFIED THAT IRAN HAS A PLAN TO ACHIEVE AN ADEQUATE SUBSTITUTE CAPACITY TO EARN FOREIGN EXCHANGE AND TO MAINTAIN ITS ECONOMY AT ITS CURRENT AFFLUENT LEVEL ONCE THE OIL DRIES UP. WHILE THIS IS A LONG WAY IN THE FUTURE, A CAREFUL US ANALYSIS OF THIS SITUATION COULD IDENTIFY PROBLEMS WHICH CAN BE TACTFULLY DISCUSSED WITH IRANIAN LEADERS TO SAVE THEM IN SPITE OF THEMSELVES. I WILL GIVE CONSIDERABLE PERSONAL DIRECTION TO THIS STUDY.

IN TOUCHING ON REGIONAL MATTERS, THE ROLE OF IRAN IN THE PERSIAN GULF MAY NEED TO BE SOMEWHAT MORE REFINED. ALSO, IT NEEDS TO BE BORN IN MIND THAT IRAQ, AS WELL AS PAKISTAN, IS DEVELOPING TECHNOLOGY WHICH COULD BE A THREAT TO NON-PROLIFERATION OF WEAPONS-GRADE FISSIONABLE MATERIAL. IN IRAQ'S CASE, IT WOULD BE HIGHLY ENRICHED URANIUM RATHER THAN PLUTONIUM PRODUCT FROM WASTE REPROCESSING.

IN MILITARY MATTERS, I FIND THAT I SPEND QUITE A LOT OF TIME INVOLVED IN DIRECTING AND PRODDING THE CURRENT MILITARY SALES AND ADVISORY PROGRAM HERE. GIVEN THE $15 BILLION LEVEL INVOLVED IN THIS PROGRAM, AND THE VARIOUS SOPHISTICATED SYSTEMS, I AM SURE THIS WILL CONTINUE. I APPRECIATE THE GENERALLY NEGATIVE THRUST OF OUR ARMS TRANSFER POLICY, BUT ALSO EXPECT THAT IRAN, LIKE ISRAEL, WILL BE AN EXCEPTIONAL CASE FOR SOME TIME TO COME. HENCE, MY OBJECTIVES SHOULD REALISTICALLY INCLUDE SUPERVISION OF EXISTING AND ANTICIPATED FMS CASES.

FINALLY, THERE IS THE OBJECTIVE OF SELF-EDUCATION. THIS IS A NEW PART OF THE WORLD TO ME. I AM SPENDING A LOT OF TIME READING ITS HISTORY, LEARNING ITS CULTURE, EXPLORING ITS GEOGRAPHY AND DEMOGRAPHY. I HAVE ALREADY VISITED TABRIZ, MASHED, ISFAHAN, SHIRAZ, QASVIN, AND THE CASPIAN COAST. LATER IN THE YEAR, I WILL VISIT ABADAN, KHORRAMSHAHR, BANDAR ABBAS, BANDAR SHAHPUR, KHARG ISLAND AND OTHER POINTS IN THE PERSIAN GULF. I MAY ALSO ASK DEPT CONCURRENCE IN VISITS TO NEIGHBORING COUNTRIES. I EXPECT TO START LEARING FARSI IN OCTOBER. ALL THIS WILL TAKE TIME AND SHOULD BE CONSIDERED A SPECIFIC OBJECTIVE FOR ANY AMBASSADOR HERE.

1977TEHRAN07869.subject: HOUSING PROBLEMS CAUSE RIOTING BUT QUIET DOWN WHEN SHAH PROMISES FAIR SOLUTION

segments.text: URBAN HOUSING AND LAND SHORTAGE CONTINUES TO BE CENTER OF CONTROVERSY HERE WITH WIDE PRESS COVERAGE OF GOVT DEBATES AND PUBLIC CRITICISM. LAST 10 DAYS HAS SEEN GREATER SQUABBLING THAN USAUAL DESPITE ADOPTION DURING PAST 2 WEEKS TO 2 NEW HOUSING LAWS (REFTELS). ONE LAW PROVIDES MANDATORY LEASING OF HOUSING WHICH LANDLORDS DELIBERATELY KEEP EMPTY AND THE SECOND REVISES THE FORMER TENANCY ACT WHICH FAVORED TENANTS TO THE POINT WHERE LANDLORDS OFTEN FOUND RENTAL PROPERTY AN UNECONOMICAL INVESTMENT.

PRESENTATION BY PRIMIN AMOUZEGAR OF HIS GOVT'S NEW PROGRAM TO THE MAJLES LAST MONTH GAVE RISE TO UNPRECEDENTED DEBATE BY MEMBERS OF PARLIAMENT WHICH REFLECTED GENERAL PUBLIC DISSATISFACTION WITH SHORTAGE AND EXPENSE OF ADEQUATE HOUSING. IN RESPONSE TO THE INCREASING CRITICISM, THE SHAH ON AUG 19 DECLARED PROPER HOUSING AND STABILIZATION OF LAND PRICES AS THE 18TH PRINCIPLE OF IRAN'S WHITE REVOLUTION. BILLS TO IMPLEMENT THIS PRINCIPLE WILL BE PRESENTED BY THE GOVT TO THE MAJLES UPON ITS RETURN FROM SUMMER RECESS ON OCT 5.

LATEST FLARE-UP IN THIS EMONTIONAL ISSUE WAS BROUGHT ABOUT IN LATTER HALF OF AUGUST BY DEMOITION BY MUNICIPALITY POLICE OF ILLEGAL, UNLICENSED CONSTRUCTION OF HOUSES ON LAND OUTSIDE CURRENTLY APPROVED TEHRAN CITY LIMITS. THESE HOUSES WERE BUILT (MAINLY SOUTH AND EAST OF THE CITY) IN AN ATTEMPT TO AVOID TEHRAN'S HIGH PRICES BY SQUATTERS ANE SPECULATORS, DIVERTING SCARCE CONSTRUCTION MATERIALS FROM THOSE WHO HAVE RECEIVED PERMITS FOR BUILDING WITHIN THE CITY LIMITS.

FOR SOME TIME THERE HAVE BEEN RECURRENT REPORTS OF CLASHES BETWEEN THE CITY'S CONSTRUCTION POLICE SQUADS AND OWNERS OF UNLICENSED BUILDINGS, BUT DURING THE PAST TWO WEEKS DISTURBANCES (OFTEN NOT REPORTED IN LOCAL PRESS) HAVE BECOME MORE SERIOUS RESULTING IN SEVERAL RIOTS, ONE OF WHICH REPORTEDLY INVOLVED 5-6,000 PARTICIPANTS IN WHICH AT LEAST ONE POLICE COLONEL (ACCORDING TO EMBASSY'S CONFIDENTIAL REPORTS) WAS FATALLY INJURED. THERE WAS A GOOD DEAL OF DAMAGE TO GOVERNMENT PROPERTY, IN PARTICULAR THE DESTRUCTION OF A PART OF ONE OF TEHRAN'S SATELLITE MUNICIPALITY BUILDINGS AND BURNING OF SOME 22 AUTHOMOBILES BELONGING TO MUNICIPALITY OFFICIALS.

IMMEDIATELY UPON HIS RETURN FROM EASTERN EUROPE AUGUST 31, THE SHAH RECEIVED A SITUATION REPORT FROM PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR AND PUBLICLY ORDERED THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A SPECIAL COMMITTEE COMPOSED OF MINISTER TOUFIQ (HOUSING); AFKHAMI (WOMEN'S AFAIRS); YEGANEH ((0)-, AND BUDGET); AND TEHRAN MAYOR SHAHRESTANI. THIS COMMITTEE IS TO PROPOSE A FAIR NEW HOUSING AND LAND POLICY AND TO REPORT TO THE SHAH WITHIN TEN DAYS. IN THE MEANWHILE THE SHAH AUTHORIZED CONSTRUCTION OF PRIVATELY OWNED HOUSES OUTSIDE TEHRAN'S CITY LIMITS IN AREA SOUTH AND SOUTEAST OF PRESENT BOUNDARIES. TO DISCOURAGE PROFITEERS FROM TAKING ADVANTAGE OF THIS NEW DECREE, ONLY ONE HOUSING PERMIT WILL BE ISSUED TO EACH FAMILY.

THOSE FAMILIES WHICH HAVE BEEN LIVING IN THE AFFECTED AREAS ON OTHER PEOPLE'S LAND AS SQUATTERS WILL BE PROVIDED LAND ON A 99 YEAR LEASE. OTHERS WHO WILL HAVE THEIR PLOTS TAKEN OVER BY STREET OR OTHER PUBLIC FACILITIES WILL BE COMPENSATED WITH AN EQUIVALENT AREA FROM NATIONALIZED LAND ELSEWHERE BUT RETAIN THEIR RIGHT TO A CONSTRUCTION PERMIT. IT IS HOPED THAT BY EXTENDING CITY SERVICES (WATER, ELECTRICITY, GARBAGE COLLECTION) AND RELOCATING SQUATTERS, TO AVOID CREATION OF SLUM CONDITIONS IN T E FRINGE AREAS--A KEY REASON WHY THE MUNICIPAL AUTHORITIES HAVE FORCEFULLY IMPLEMENTED THEIR POLICY OF RAZING ILLEGAL CONSTRUCTION.

COMMENT: ALTHOUGH THESE RECENT PUBLIC DISTURBANCES SEEM TO BE ISOLATED INCIDENTS WITH LIMITED GOALS, THEY ARE THE CULMINATION OF YEARS OF FRUSTRATION ON THE PART OF TEHRAN'S BURGEONING WORKING CLASS WHICH HAS BEEN UNABLE TO FIND SUITABLE HOUSING WITHIN TEHRAN CITY LIMITS. THE SHAH'S ACTION, TAKEN SO QUICKLY AFTER HIS RETURN FROM ABROAD, INDICATES THE HIGH PRIORITY HE PLACES ON THE HOUSING PROBM HIS DECISION SHOULD SERVE TEMPORARILY TO PLACATE AFFECTED FAMILIES WHILE PROVIDING THE GOVERNMENT A PERIOD OF TIME TO FORMULATE MORE LONG-TERM SOLUTIONS.

1977TEHRAN07883.subject: CONVERSATION WITH BANGLADESH AMB TO IRAN

segments.text: BANGLADESH AMB DOHA, WHO SEEMS WELL CONNECTED WITH THE CURRENT MLA LEADERSHIP IN PAKISTAN, HAS SHOWN ME IN GREAT CONFIDENCE A MESSAGE WHICH HE SENT RECENTLY TO DACCA. THE MESSAGE REPORTS ON THE VISIT TO TEHRAN OF A BRIGADIER WHO IS HEAD OF INTELLIGENCE FOR THE MLA. HE ALLEGEDLY CAME HERE TO VISIT WITH THE HEAD OF SAVAK AND THE SENIOR IRANIAN MILITARY INTELLIGENCE OFFICER.

ACCORDING TO DOHA'S REPORT, THE PAKISTANIS WISHED TO ASSURE IRAN ON SEVERAL POINTS OF INTEREST. FIRST, THEY WISHED TO STATE THAT THE MLA WANTED GOOD RELATIONS WITH IRAN. SECOND, THEY SAID THEY WERE PREPARED TO ABANDON THE "CONFRONTATION POLICY" WITH INDIA. THIRD, THEY WISHED TO IMPROVE THEIR RELATIONS WITH THE UNITED STATES. FINALLY, THEY ENCOURAGED IRAN TO MAINTAIN ITS ACTIVE, CLOSE TIES WITH INDIA.

DOHA COMMENTED THAT NONE OF THESE STATEMENTS SOUNDED LIKE THOSE OF A CARETAKER GROUP. HE THEN WENT ON TO OFFER HIS VIEW (PART OF WHICH WAS BASED ON CONVERSATION WITH THE PAK BRIGADIER) THAT THERE WOULD BE NO REPEAT NO GENERAL ELECTIONS IN PAKISTAN NEXT MONTH. HE SAID PAKS WERE STUDYING BANGLADESH EXAMPLE AND WOULD PROBABLY OPT FOR LOCAL ELECTIONS, NOT HIGHER THAN THE COUNCIL LEVEL. HE THOUGHT THEY WOULD PUT OFF GENERAL ELECTIONS INDEFINITELY. HE THOUGHT BHUTTO'S ARREST WOULD MAKE THIS DECISION EASIER.

DOHA THEN WENT ON TO RATTLE OFF A LIST OF NAMES AND PARTY AFFILIATIONS WHICH WERE ALIEN TO MY GRASP OF THE SITUATION IN PAKISTAND AND CONCLUDED THAT A NUMBER OF THESE WOULD BE BROUGHT INTO AN "INTERIM" GOVT TO BE HEADED BY GEN ZIA. HE SAID THE TOUCHSTONE OF THIS AGGREGATION WOULD BE TO BUILD ON THE "NEW BASE" IN PAKISTAN POLITICS, WHICH WOULD BE A COALITION OF THE "MILITARY AND THE MULLAHS". HE DESCRIBED THIS GROUP AS THE SAUDI ARABIAN WING AND FELT THAT ITS ESSENTIAL OPPOSITION WAS THE GROUP WHICH HE CALLED THE LIBYAN WING.

IN DOHA'S VIEW, THE MLA WILL PROBABLY KEEP ITS OPTIONS OPEN UNTIL THE FIRST WEEK IN OCTOBER, AND THEN PROCEED TO MODIFY THEIR PLANS IN THE MANNER SUGGESTED ABOVE. (ZELLI, FORMER IRANIAN AMB TO PAKISTAN, HAS MADE THE SAME OBSERVATION TO ME).
COMMENT: I RELAY ALL THIS FOR WHAT IT MAY BE WORTH VERY LARGELY BECAUSE DOHA IS CONSIDERED BY OTHER OFFICERS IN THE EMB TO BE VERY KNOWLEDGEABLE ABOUT PAKISTAN AND AN INTELLIGENT, ACCURATE REPORTER.
(INFCE) REF A. STATE 210275 B. STATE 184505

THE FOLLOWING THREE CAREER DIPLOMATS HAVE BEEN PRESENTED TO THE SHAH BY FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY, A PROCEDURE WHICH CONFIRMS THEIR LONG-RUMORED (REFTEL) AMBASSADORIAL APPOINTMENTS.

FIRST MENTIONED FIVE MONTHS AGO, KHOSROW AKMAL'S APPOINTMENT AS GOI AMBASSADOR TO AUSTRALIA, WITH ACCREDITION TO NEW ZEALAND, HAS FINALLY BEEN ANNOUNCED OFFICIALLY. AKMAL, 43, MOST RECENTLY HELD THE SENIOR DEPUTY POSITION IN THE MINISTRY OF COURT, UNDER HIS FATHER-IN-LAW HORMOZ GHARIB, FORMER GRAND MASTER OF CEREMONIES WHO HIMSELF WAS RECENTLY APPOINTED AMBASSADOR TO ITALY. AKMAL, WHO HAS A DOCTORATE IN LAW FROM THE UNIVERSITY OF TEHRAN, JOINED THE MFA IN 1958 AND SERVED IN THE PASSPORT, EASTERN EUROPE, AND PROTOCOL DIVISIONS. HE ALSO SERVED ABROAD IN BERN AND WAS COUNSELOR FOR CONSULAR AFFAIRS IN WASHINGTON UNTIL THE ARRIVAL OF AMBASSADOR ZAHEDI WHO HAD HIM TRANSFERRED BACK TO TEHRAN.

FLUENT IN ENGLISH AND FRENCH, AKMAL IS CONSIDERED BY EMBOFFS TO BE STATUS CONSCIOUS AND TO TAKE HIMSELF VERY SERIOUSLY, TENDING TO SPEAK AUTHORITATIVELY EVEN WHEN HE DOES NOT HAVE ALL THE FACTS AT HAND.

HOOSHANG BATMANGLIDJ, 49, NEWLY APPOINTED AMBASSADOR TO TURKEY, WAS BORN IN ANKARA AND IS A GRADUATE IN POLITICAL SCIENCE FROM LONDON UNIVERSITY. HE SPENT ABOUT A YEAR IN BAGHDAD WORKING ON ECONOMIC AFFAIRS OF THE BAGHDAD PACT AND, AFTER THE IRAQI REVOLUTION IN 1958, WENT TO ANKARA WHERE HE WAS A MEMBER OF THE CENTO ECONOMIC DIVISION UNTIL 1963. HE HEADED THE RCD DEPARTMENT IN THE MFA AND WAS MOST RECENTLY DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR ECONOMIC AFFAIRS. HE AND HIS WIFE, TOURAN, SPEAK FLUENT ENGLISH AND EXCELLENT FRENCH. HE IS BRIGHT, WELL INFORMED AND AMBITIOUS AND HAS BEEN A USEFUL CONTACT OVER THE YEARS TO A SERIES OF EMBOFFS.
BATMANGLIDJ (HIS PREFERRED SPELLING) IS THE SUBJECT OF A BIOGRAPHIC REPORT PREPARED IN MAY 1975 BY INR/OIL/B.

MANOUCHEHR AZIMA, 58, AMBASSADOR TO SPAIN, WAS THE DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR EUROPEAN AND AMERICAN POLITICAL AFFAIRS PRIOR TO HIS RECENT APPOINTEMENT. HE HAS A DOCTORATE IN POLITICAL SCIENCE FROM THE UNIVERSITY OF PARTI, HAS SERVED IN MFA FOR 33 YEARS, AND IS CONSIDERED ONE OF IRAN'S MOST SENIOR DIPLOMATS. DURING HIS EARLY DIPLOMATIC CAREER HE SERVED IN THE UNITED STATES BUT HAS SPENT MOST OF HIS SERVICE IN FRANCE, WITH TOURS IN ITALY AND EGYPT. HE WAS MINISTER IN PARIS IN THE MID-60'S AND AMBASSADOR TO GREECE 1966-70. FROM 1971 TO 1974 HE WAS DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR CULTURAL AND SOCIAL AFFAIRS PRIOR TO BEING NAMED TO THE EUROPE/AMERICA POSITION.

KNOWN TO A NUMBER OF EMBOFFS, AZIMA IS NOT CONSIDERED PARTICULARLY EFFECTIVE. HE IS AFFABLE AND PLEASANT BUT NOT A MAN OF DECISION. HIS FRENCH IS VERY FLUENT, HIS ENGLISH RATHER SKETCHY. HIS WIFE, WHO SPEAKS EXCELLENT ENGLISH, IS SOMEWHAT MORE OUTGOING.

TEHRAN RADIO, TELEVISION AND PRESS ARE PROMINENTLY PLAYING AP STORY FROM WASHINGTON WHICH STATES THAT PRESIDENT CARTER HAS DECIDED TO INCLUDE PERSIAN GULF AND SPECIFICALLY IRAN WITHIN SCOPE OF U.S. DEFENSE OBLIGATIONS. STORY, WHICH YOU HAVE DOUBTLESS SEEN, ATTRIBUTES THIS DECISION TO THE CONTENTS OF PRM 10.

I DON'T KNOW WHAT CURRENT WASHINGTON VIEW IS WITH RESPECT TO SHARING TEXTS OF PRMS WITH AMBASSADORS. FROM VARIOUS COLUMNISTS' ARTICLES, PRM 10 SEEMS TO BE ON BEST-SELLER LIST IN GEORGETOWN, JUST AHEAD OF CRASH OF 79.

HOWEVER WASHINGTON WISHES TO HANDLE THIS, I WILL NEED SOME FORM OF OFFICIAL GUIDANCE SOON IN ORDER TO HANDLE INEVITABLE INQUIRY FROM THE SHAH. HE WOULD NATURALLY BE DELIGHTED WITH THIS STORY, IF IT IS TRUE. HIS PROBABLE REACTION WOULD BE TO BEGIN IMMEDIATELY EXPLORING WAYS IN WHICH CONTINGENCY PLANNING FOR THIS DECISION COULD BE IMPLEMENTED.

IF THE STORY IS NOT RPT NOT TRUE I NEED TO BE GIVEN SOME FORMULA BY WHICH I CAN EASE SHAH AWAY FROM ITS EXTENSIVE REPERCUSSIONS BEFORE THE FIGMENTS OF THE REPORT ASSUME REALITY IN THE IRANIAN ESTABLISHMENT. THIS WOULD REQUIRE SOME CAREFUL CONSIDERATION.

IT IS NOT RPT NOT CLEAR TO ME WHAT EFFECT THE STORY IS LIKELY TO HAVE ON THE AWACS CASE. I PRESUME THAT CRITICS OF THE SALE WILL HAVE A NEW ISSUE IN WHICH THEY WILL FLAY THE PRM AS A PLAN TO DEFEND "A BRIDGE TOO FAR". WHETHER THAT WILL BE OFFSET BY THOSE WHO SEE THE PRM AS CONCRETE JUSTIFICATION FOR AWACS IS HARD FOR ME TO JUDGE. IN ANY EVENT, I BELIEVE ADMINISTRATION WITNESSES AND FRIENDLY LEADERSHIP WILL ALSO HAVE TO BE FORTIFIED WITH AN AGREED LINE OF TESTIMONY WHICH ADHERES IN CAREFUL TERMS TO WHATEVER THE FACTS IN THIS CASE MAY BE.
I WILL APPRECIATE EARLY GUIDANCE.
REF A. TEHRAN 7964 B. STATE 210275 C. STATE 184505 SUMMARY: IRAN ACCEPTS U.S. INVITATION TO INFCE ORGANIZING CONFERENCE. END SUMMARY.

PURSUANT TO REFTEL A, EMBOFF CALLED ON DR. CYRUS MANZOOR, DIRECTOR, INTERNATIONAL RELATIONS AND LEGAL AFFAIRS, AEOI. INVITATION FOR IRAN TO ATTEND INFCE ORGANIZING CONFERENCE WAS EXTENDED. TALKING POINTS NOTED REFTEL B WERE DRAWN UPON DURING DISCUSSION.

DR. MANZOOR COMMENTED THAT INFCE HAD BEEN DISCUSSED DURING U.S.-IRAN JOINT ENERGY COMMITTEE MEETING IN WASHDC 8-10 AUGUST. AT THAT TIME, DR. ETEMAD, DIRECTOR, AEOI, HAD INDICATED IRAN'S DESIRE TO PARTICIPATE IN INFCE CONFERENCE. DR. ETEMAD INDICATED THAT IRAN WOULD LIKE TO SUGGEST AGENDA ITEMS IN ADDITION TO THOSE NOTED REFTEL C AS WELL AS COMMENT UPON AGENDA ITEMS ALREADY PROPOSED. DR. MANZOOR SAID THAT AN OFFICIAL ACCEPTANCE OF THE INVITATION TO ATTEND THE CONFERENCE WILL BE SENT TO THE EMBASSY SHORTLY AND WILL INCLUDE SUGGESTIONS AND COMMENTS NOTED ABOVE.

IRAN DELEGATION WILL CONSIST OF TWO AEOI OFFICIALS, PROBABLY SELECTED FROM GROUP WHICH PARTICIPATED IN U.S.-IRAN JOINT ENERGY COMMITTEE MEETING. MR. AKBAR FROM IRANIAN EMEMBASSY IN WASHDC WILL ALSO PARTICIPATE.
DR. MANZOOR EXPRESSED THE HOPE THAT IAEA WILL PARTICIPATE IN CONFERENCE. EMBOFF COMMENTED THAT IAEA PARTICIPATION HAD BEEN SOLICITED.
WILL ADVISE AS SOON AS AEOI DELEGATES ARE NAMED AND WILL FORWARD AEOI COMMENTS AND SUGGESTIONS CONCERNING CONFERENCE AS SOON AS THEY ARE RECEIVED.

PURSUANT TO REFTEL DR. MANZOUR OF AEOI CONTACTED EMBASSY 12 SEPTEMBER AND ASKED IF ANY INFORMATION COULD BE OBTAINED CONCERNING THE LEVEL AT WHICH OTHER COUNTRIES ATTENDING INFCE ORGANIZING CONFERENCE WOULD BE REPRESENTED. REQUEST DEPARTMENT PROVIDE REPRESENTATIVE SAMPLING WHEN INFORMATION IS AVAILABLE.

1977TEHRAN08131.subject: SHAH'S REMARKS ON U.S. -- IRAN RELATIONS

segments.text: AS PART OF LONG KAYHAN INTERVIEW PRINTED SEPTEMBER 13TH, SHAH HAD FOLLOWING REMARKS ON U.S.-- IRAN RELATIONS IN REPLY TO QUESTION ABOUT HIS FORTHCOMING VISIT TO WASHINGTON: "RELATIONS BETWEEN IRAN AND THE UNITED STATES ARE GOOD AND I DON'T THINK THEY COULD BE OTHERWISE. CERTAIN THINGS THAT ARE SAID STEM FROM SPECULATIONS BY SOME OF YOUR JOURNALISTS COLLEAGUES WHO, AT TIMES, INCLINE TOWARDS SENSATIONALISM. "WHENEVER A NEW ADMINISTRATION TAKES OVER THERE ARE THOSE WHO IMAGINE THAT EVERYTHING WILL BE CHANGED. BUT IT IS ONLY INDIVIDUALS WHO CHANGE; THE LONG-TERM INTERESTS OF A NATION CANNOT CHANGE.

WHAT IS IMPORTANT IS THAT EVERYONE SHOULD KNOW THAT IF ANYONE WANTS A THIRD OR FOURTH RATE IRAN WE SHALL NOT TOLERATE THAT. WE SHALL NOT ACCEPT ANYTHING LESS THAN A FIRST CLASS POSITION FOR IRAN. "IF THEY ACCEPT THIS, THEN THEY SHOULD MEET OUR DEMANDS. IF THEY DO NOT ACCEPT THAT...WELL, THEN I WILL SIT DOWN AND MAKE UP MY OWN MIND ABOUT THE BEST MEANS OF SAFEGUARDING MY COUNTRY'S INTERESTS, ALWAYS REMEMBERING THAT IRAN MUST HAVE A FIRST CLASS STATUS."
COMMENT: THERE IS LITTLE DOUBT THAT THE SHAH'S REMARKS ON "FIRST CLASS POSITION" REFER TO IMPORTANT IRANIAN REQUIREMENTS SUCH AS AWACS. REST OF INTERVIEW BEING REPORTED SEPARATELY.

1977TEHRAN08137.subject: TERRORISTS HAVE TEMPORARILY TURNED TO POLITICAL ACTION, SAYS SHAH

segments.text: SAYS SHAH

IN COURSE OF LONG KAYHAN INTERVIEW APPEARING SEPT 13 (BEING REPORTED SEPARATELY), SHAH PUT THE NUMBER OF TERRORISTS LEFT IN IRAN BETWEEN 100 AND 120. HE SAID TERRORISTS HAVE RECEIVED NEW ORDERS FROM ABROAD TO GIVE UP TERRORIST ACTIVITIES FOR THETIME BEING SINCE THIS IS NO LONGER ACCEPTABLE TO WORLD PUBLIC OPINION. THEY AAVE BEEN TOLD TO DIRECT THEIR EFFORTS INSTEAD TO SO CALLED "POLITICAL" ACTIVITY, WHICH CONSISTS OF DISTRIBUTING SECRETLY PRODUCED CIRCULARS TO SPREAD LIES AND RUMORS.

SHAH WENT ON TO DISPARAGE THE TYPE OF "FREEDOM" SUCH PEOPLE SEEK, SUGGESTING THAT THEY DESIRE FREEDOM TO TURN IRAN OVER TO FOREIGN POWERS. HE SAID THAT CONTRARY TO A KAYHAN CARTOONIST'S RECENT CREATION SHOWING A PERSON WITH A PEN WAITING FOR THE GREEN LIGHT, IRANIANS CAN AND DO WRITE WHATEVER THEY LIKE. WHILE MUCH OF WHAT IS WRITTEN IS "IRRESPONSIBLE CHATTER" ABOUT SUBJECTS ON WHICH WRITERS ARE SOMEWHAT IGNORANT, IRAN WELCOMES THIS CHANGE IN TACTICS BY IRAN'S OPPONENTS SINCE THEY CAN ONLY PUT FORWARD A WEAK CASE, WHILE IRAN PROVIDES THE STRONGEST ARGUMENTS AND, FORTUNATELY, THE TRUTH WILL OUT. END UNCLASSIFIED. BEGIN CONFIDENTIAL

COMMENT: WE HAVE NO IDEA WHERE SHAH GOT SUCH LOW FIGURES FOR NUMBER OF TERRORISTS. EMB'S OWN ESTIMATE, WITH ASSISTANCE OF IRANIAN SECURITY SOURCES, IS AT LEAST DOUBLE OR TRIPLE THAT NUMBER. WE ALSO BELIEVE HARD CORE LEADERSHIP OF TERRORISTS IS IRANIAN AND WITHIN THE COUNTRY, NOT FOREIGN, AS SHAH SUGGESTS. SIMILARLY, SUGGESTION THAT TERRORISTS HAVE TURNED TO POLITICAL ACTION RUNS CONTRARY TO OFFICIAL VERSION BEING PUT OUT BY IRANIAN SECURITY ORGANIZATIONS, IN SPITE OF FACT THERE HAVE BEEN NO KNONW TERRORIST INCIDENTS HERE IN RECENT MONTHS.

ATTEMPTED ASSASSINATION OF PRINCESS ASHRAF IN FRANCE SAME DAY INTERVIEW APPEARED HERE IS GRISLY COMMENT ON SHAH'S STATEMENTS. THIS VERSION OF AFFAIRS(INCLUDING ALLEGED FREEDOM OF ALL IN IRAN TO WRITE WHAT THEY LIKE) STRIKES US AS POSSIBLE WINDOWN DRESSING PREPARATORY TO SHAH'S NOVEMBER VISIT TO US. WE ASSUME HE WOULD CHARACTERIZE SOME OF THE OPPOSITION CIRCULARS WHICH HAVE COME TO EMB ATTENTION (SEE, FOR EXAMPLE, TEHRAN 7086) AS PRODUCED BY SUCH TERRORISTS.
REF A. 76 TEHRAN 10830 B. 76 TEHRAN 10842

BEGIN UNCLASSIFIED SUMMARY: IN INTERVIEW WHICH IS BECOMING SOMETHING LIKE AN ANNUAL "STATE OF THE UNION" MESSAGE, SHAH DWELT ON IRAN'S HISTORY TO SHOW HOW IRAN HAS RID ITSELF OF EXTERNAL THREATS AND PAST ECONOMIC DIFFICULTIES UNDER HIS RULE. HE PLAYED DANGERS OF OPPOSITION FROM VARIETIES OF COMMUNISM AND TERRORISTS, THOUGH NOTING THESE EXTERNAL THREATS REMAIN AND ARE AT PRESENT DISGUISING THEMSELVES AS MORE LEGITIMATE POLITICAL OPPOSITION. HE EXHORTED GOVERNMENT, PEOPLE, AND RASTAKHIZ PARTY TO MORE EFFECTIVE EFFORTS IN POLITICAL AS WELL AS ECONOMIC FIELDS (SOME ASPECTS OF WHICH ARE BEING REPORTED SEAPARTELY). WE THINK HE HAS OVERSTATED SOME POINTS (SEE COMMENT AT END). END SUMMARY.

SHAH BEGAN INTERVIEW WITH KAYHAN EDITOR AMIR TAHERI (WHICH APPEARED SEPT 13, ALTHOUGH GRANTED WEEK BEFORE) WITH REFERENCE TO HIS SIMILAR INTERVIEW 11 MONTHS AGO (REFTELS). THIS SUGGESTS HE VIEWS SUCH INTERVIEWS AS HIS FULLLEST ANNUAL REVIEWS OF SITUATION, CLOSEST THING TO "STATE OF THE UNION" MESSAGE.

SHAH EXTENSIVELY REVIEWED IRANIAN HISTORY, REFERRING TO KEY DATES SUCH AS 1907, 1919, 1941, AND 1953, TO SUBSTANTIATE HIS POINT THAT IRAN HAS BEEN THREATENED BY EXTERNAL POWERS. HE SAID COLONIALISTS AT FIRST USED NAKED FORCE TO ACQUIRE RAW MATERIALS AT LOW PRICES AND IMPOSE THEIR OWN GOODS ON CAPTIVE MARKETS AT EXHORBITANT PRICES. AFTER THE RISE OF THE SOVIET UNION AND A NUMBER OF INTERNAL CHANGES IN THE "METROPOLITAN" COUNTRIES THEMSELVES, THEY TRIED TO DEVELOP AN IDEOLOGICAL GUISE FOR THEIR CONTINUED EFORTS. SUDDENLY THEY BECAME LIBERAL, FREEDOM LOVING AND DEFENDERS OF "HUMAN RIGHTS". HOWEVER, INTERVENTION IN THE AFFAIRS OF OTHER COUNTRIES CONTINUED.

THANKS TO HIS EFFORTS, SHAH ASSERTED, IRAN HAS RACHED A STAGE AT WHICH SUCH INTERVENTION CAN NO LONGER TAKE PLACE. THIS IS BECAUSE IRAN VALUES ITS INDEPENDENCE ABOVE EVERYTHING ELSE AND THE SHAHANSHAHI HAS SO MUCH POWER THAT NO ONE WOULD DREAM OF SUCH ACTION. HOWEVER, EVEN SHOULD SUCH EVENTS BE UNLEASED AGAINST IRAN, HE ADDED, RESULTS WOULD BE "NO SIMPLE OR ORDINARY INCIDENT" BUT "COULD CHANGE THE DESTINY OF THE WORLD". SHAH ELABORATED ON ABOVE THEME IN TERMS OF ECONOMIC PROGRESS IN STANDARD OF LIVING OF ALL IRANIANS SINCE KEY TURNING POINT OF AUGUST 1953 (DATE OF SHAH'S RETURN TO POWER).

HE STRESSED HARD AND DEDICATED WORK AND AVOIDANCE OF THE PITFALLS OF WHAT HE TERMED THE "THROW AWAY" CONSUMER SOCIETY WHICH PRODUCES EVERYTHING SIMPLY TO BE DISCARDED. HE THOUGHT IT AMAZING IRAN SHOULD BE SUBJECT TO SO MUCH VARNOMOUS JEALOUSY AND THAT IT SHOULD BE CENSURED FOR ATTEMPTING TO APPROACH EUROPEAN LEVELS IN SUCH THINGS AS MEAT CONSUMPTION, WHEN, FOR EXAMPLE, THE FRENCH AND AMERICANS EAT 87 AND 130 KILOS OF MEAT PER HEAD PER ANNUM RESPECTIVELY, (SHAH'S MORE DETAILED REMARKS ON ECONOMIC MATTERS BEING REPORTED SEPARATELY).

SHAH UPDATED THIS REVIEW OF IRAN'S ALLEGED VICTIMIZATION BY REFRENCE TO A NUMBER OF ARTICLES APPEARING IN EUROPEAN NEWSPAPES WHICH SUGGEST IRAN WILL FALL SHORT OF REACHING EUROPEAN ECONOMIC STANDARDS. THIS WOULD BE TRUE, IF, FOR EXAMPLE, EUROPEANS GANG UP TOGETHER TO SELL IRAN POWER GENERATORS THAT DO NOT WORK. BUT IRAN WILL PUT ITS FOOT DOWN FIRMLY AND DEMAND DEFINITE GUARANTEES THAT PROPER GOODS AND SERVICES BE SOLD TO IT AND SHOP AROUND CHANGING ITS MARKETS, IF NEED BE. ------------------106084 150705Z /14 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 4538 INFO AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MOSCOW USCINCEUR SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 8175

SHAH ALSO HAD A NUMBER OF REMARKS ON OPPOSITION AND TERRORISM, MOST SPECIFIC OF WHICH HAVE BEEN REPORTED SEPARATELY. IN GENERAL HE ASSERTED IRANIAN PEOPLE DO NOT SUPPORT TERRORISM, AS IS SUGGESTED BY THE FACT THAT PEOPLE IN THE STREETS HAVE HELPED WITH THE ARREST OF TERRORIST ELEMENTS. THIS HAS INCLUDED 15 AND 16 YEAR OLD BOYS,. TAXI DRIVERS, AND STREET CLEANERS. BY THE SAME TOKEN, HE SUGGESTED NO NATION HE KNEW OF "TALKS AS FREELY AS OUR ON EVERY SUBJECT AND EVERY INDIVIDUAL". THIS IS AN IRANIAN TRADITION, HE SAID, AND ONLY THOSE WHO HAVE NOTHING USEFUL TO SAY COMPLAIN.

SOME SOCIETIES HAVE ADOPTED A MULTI-PARTY SYSTEM AS A LUXURY, AND ONE CAN SEE WHERE THOSE COUNTRIES ARE HEADING NOW, THE SHAH SAID. IN IRAN, AS LONG AS YOU ACCEPT THE BASIC PRINCIPLES OF THE NATION AND ITS REVOLUTION, YOU CAN CALL YOURSELF WHATEVER YOU LIKE. ANYWAY, HE CONCLUDED, IRAN BY 1990 SHOULD BE DEVELOPED ENOUGH AND MATURE AND EXPERIENCED ENOUGH TO SEE OUT THE BEST WAY FOR ITSELF. WHEN IRANIANS ARE LITERATE AND KNOW HOW TO EXERCISE THEIR RIGHT TO VOTE, THEY WILL INDICATE THEIR REAL WISHES.
SHAH SAID HE WOULD ACCEPT THESE WISHES PROVIDED THEY ARE BASED ON THE LOVE OF IRAN AND THE PEOPLE AND ITS CULTURE, BUT IF ANTI-PATRIOTIC TENDENCIES ARE MANIFESTED HE WOULD REJECT THEM CATEGORICALLY.

IRANIAN STUDENTS ABROAD, THE SHAH ASSERTED, SOMETIMES FALL PREY TO CAREFUL SCHEMES WORKED OUT BY INTERNATIONAL SABOTAGE AND ESPIONAGE ORGANIZATIONS THAT HAVE WELL ESTABLISHED REPUTATIONS FOR BRAINWASHING AND CAN SPOT WEAKNESSES IN INDIVIDUALS. MOST OF IRAN'S OPPONENTS ABROAD ARE TROTSKYITES OR PRO-MOSCOW OR PRO-PEKING COMMUNISTS. A FUNNY THING ABOUT THE COMMUNISTS IS THAT THEY SEEM UNAWARE OF IRAN'S GOOD AND CLOSE RELATIONS WITH THE SOVIET UNION AND CHINA. HOWEVER, IRAN HAS OVERCOME PAST EFFORTS BY "HAMMER AND SICKLE COMMUNISM", "UNION JACK COMMUNISM," "PSEUDO-ISLAMIC COMMUNISM", AND WILL WITHSTAND THE NEW COMMUNISM THAT "IS SEEKING ITS MASTERS ON THE OTHER SIDE OF THE WORLD".

(WE ASSUME THIS IS REFERENCE TO CHINESE COMMUNISM.) AS PART OF THIS BATTLE, SHAH SUGGESTED MORE IRANIANS BE EDUCATED IN IRAN RATHER THAN ABROAD, WHERE THEY ARE EXPOSED NOT ONLY TO POSSIBLE POLITICAL DEVIATION BUT ALSO THE RISK OF DRUG ADDICTION. LARGE SUMS OF MONEY SPENT TO EDUCATE CHILDREN ABROAD COULD AND SHOULD BE SPENT TO IMPROVE EDUCATION IN IRAN.

FINALLY, SHAH ANNOUNCED HIS DESIRE THAT RASTAKHIZ PARTY PRESS ON WITH ITS PLANS TO TRAIN ITS OWN CADRES IN ITS OWN INSTITUTE OF HIGHER LEARNING. THESE SHOULD HAVE A FIRMER BELIEF AND GREATER DISCIPLINE THAN STUDENTS IN OTHER CENTERS OF HIGHER EDUCATION, AND INSTITUTE SHOULD BE PROPERLY FUNDED AND MANAGED. END

COMMENT: SHAH'S EMPHASIS ON PAST FOREIGN INTERVENTION MAY STRIKE MANY OBSERVERS AS EXAGGERATED IN VIEW OF IRAN'S CURRENT MILITARY AND FINANCIAL STRENGTH, BUT IT IS IMPORTANT TO REMEMBER THAT SHAH BELIEVES IN LONG PERSPECTIVES AND HAS NOT RID HIMSELF OF THE SUSPICION THAT FOREIGN INTERVENTION CAN RECUR IN THE FUTURE IF IRAN DROPS ITS GUARD. AT THE SAME TIME, SHAH PROBABLY FINDS IT USEFUL TO REMIND IRANIANS AND OTHERS OF THE BENEFITS HIS RULE HAS CONFEREED. THESE REMARKS, ALONG WITH OTHERS IN THE INTERVIEW, ALSO MAKE A USEFUL BACKDROP FOR THE FORTHCOMING VISIT OF THE SHAH TO THE U.S. , PARTICULARLY AS REGARDS MILITARY PROCUREMENT ORDERS.

1977TEHRAN08176.subject: ECONOMIC THEMES IN SHAH'S INTERVIEW WITH KAYHAN INTERNATION, SEPTEMBER 12, 1977

segments.text: ASPECTS OF THE INTERVIEW ARE REPORTED SEPTEL.

ECONOMIC PLANNING AND THE PRIVATE SECTOR THE SHAH OBSERVED THAT IRAN'S ECONOMIC PLANNING HAD IN SOME CASESBEEN "INCORRECT" IN THE RECENT PAST BUT THAT IT COULD BE SAID THAT SOME OF THE BOTTLENECKS WERE PERHAPS INEVITABLE. NEVERTHELESS, HE SAID, SOME OF THE NATION'S PRIORITIES OUGHT TO HAVE BEEN ALTERED "EVEN WHILE WE PUSHED AHEAD." IN THE END, HE WAS FORCED TO MAKE SOME CHANGES IN THE NATION'S PLANNING MECHANISM. EQUALLY IMPORTANT IS THE NEED TO GIVE INCENTIVES TO THE PRIVATE SECTOR, HE SAID. PRODUCTION IN THE PRIVATE SECTOR OUGHT TO BE EXPANDED AND "PROPER PROFITS" ARE IMPORTANT "PROVIDING THAT THEY (BUSINESSMEN) PAY THEIR TAXES."

COMMENT:THERE IS NOTHING PARTICULARLY NEW IN THE SHAH'S COMMENTS ON ECONOMIC PLANNING. HIS DISSATISFACTION WITH THE PERFORMANCE OF THE PLAN AND BUDGET ORGANIZATION WAS MADE ABUNDANTLY CLEAR IN HIS MESSAGE TO PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR'S NEW CABINET. THE PRIVATE SECTOR WILL WELCOME THE SHAH'S COMMENTS ON INCENTIVES, LACKING IN SPECIFICS THOUGH THEY ARE. IT REMAINS TO BE SEEN, HOWEVER, HOW THE GOVERNMENT WILL ACT UPON THIS MONARCHIAL GUIDANCE, OFFERED FREQUENTLY IN THE PAST, IF INDEED GOVERNMENT ACTS AT ALL.

RISING CONSUMPTION IN IRAN IRAN'S FUTURE GREATNESS AND PROSPERITY AND INDEED SURVIVAL, HE SAID, DEPENDS ON MORE AND BETTER WORK BY ALL OUR PEOPLE. RESPONDING TO THE INTERVIEWER'S OBSERVATION THAT IRAN'S PROBLEMS, AS SEEN IN SOME FOREIGN CAPITALS, STEMS FROM RISING CONSUMPTION AND SPENDING LEVELS, THE SHAH SAID THAT IRAN HAS BECOME THE SUBJECT OF "MUCH VENOMOUS ENVY." IRAN'S RISING STANDARD OF LIVING HAS PRODUCED ENVY ABROAD AND HENT ON TO SAY THAT "CERTAIN PEOPLE ARE DANCING JOYFULLY BECAUSE WE HAVE SUFFERED A POWER SHORTAGE IN RECENT MONTHS". WHY SHOULD NOT THE IRANIAN PEOPLE CONSUME MORE AND HAVE A BETTER LIFE?

WE DO NOT WANT POVERTY AND DEPRIVATION FOR OUR PEOPLE, HE SAID, AND WE CANNOT ACCEPT THE NOTION OF PEOPLE TELLING US THAT WE DO NOT HAVE THE RIGHT TO A PROPER AND HUMANE STANDARD OF LIVING. ON THE OTHER HAND, IRAN MUST REJECT "THIS SO-CALLED CONSUMER SOCIETY WHIIH PRODUCES EVERYTHING SIMPLY TO BE DISCARDED". THE SHAH THOUGHT THE FACT THAT AT LEAST TEN EUROPEAN NEWSPAPERS HAVE COMMENTED THAT NEITHER IRAN OR ANY OTHER THIRD WORLD COUNTRY CAN REACH THE LEVEL OF INDUSTRIALIZATION OF "LITTLE AUSTRIA" MUST BE EITHER "A CENTRALLY CONDUCTED CAMPAIGN OR AN EXAMPLE OF UNUSUAL CONCORD". THEY (FOREIGNERS) CANNOT GO ON SWINDLING US FOREVER.

IRAN WILL INSIST ON DEFINITE GUARANTEES FOR PROPER GOODS AND SERVICES SOLD TO US. COMMENT: THERE HAVE, OF COURSE, BEEN SOME COMMENTARIES IN THE WESTERN PRESS WHICH HAVE RAISED QUESTIONS ABOUT THE WISDOM OF THE PACE OF RECENT ECONOMIC GROWTH IN IRAN. MOST OF THE COMMENTARY WHICH THE EMBASSY HAS SEEN SEEMS TO HAVE BEEN REASONABLY WELL SUPPORTED BY THE FACTS AND NOT REFLECTIVE OF ANY PARTICULARLY ANIMUS TOWARDS IRAN. INDEED, MUCH THE SAME OBSERVATIONS HAVE BEEN MADE IN RECENT MONTHS BY IRANIANS HERE. THIS IS NOT THE FIRST TIME THAT THE SHAH HAS LASHED OUT AT HIS FOREIGN CRITICS NOR WILL IT BE THE LAST.

THE SHAH, OF COURSE, CAN BE THINNED-SKINNED IN REPLYING TO HIS FOREIGN CRITICS BUT WE FIND HIS ASSERTIONS ABOUT A "CENTRALLY CONDUCTED CAMPAIGN" TO DISPARAGE IRAN'S ECONOMIC PERFORMANCE TO BE A BIT EXTREME.

INFLATION: THE SHAH SAID THAT PRICES IN IRAN SHOULD BE ABOUT THE GENERAL LEVEL OF PRICES PREVAILING IN COUNTRIES WITH AN ANNUAL PER CAPITA GNP OF JUST OVER $2,000. HE SAID THE DIFFICULTY WAS, HOWEVER,THAT "SOME PEOPLE" ARE DEMANDING PROFITS UP TO 80 OR 90 PERCENT AND INSISTING UPON PRICE COMPARABILITY WITH WESTERN EUROPE AND YET IGNORE WESTERN EUROPEAN STANDARDS FOR PROFITS, TAXATION, EFFICIENCY AND PRODUCTIVITY.

HE CLEARLY IMPLIED THAT IRANIAN MANUFACTURERS COULD NOT HAVE IT BOTH WAYS, I.E., HIGH PRICES FOR THEIR FINISHED PRODUCTS BUT INDIFFERENT STANDARDS WHEN IT COMES TO EFFICIENCY, PRODUCTIVITY AND PAYMENT OF TAXES. ------------------106069 150702Z /14 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 4540 SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 8176

COMMENT: THE SHAH'S COMMENTS ON INFLATION AND IRANIAN STANDARDS OF PRODUCTION AND EFFICIENCY HAVE BEEN A FAMILIAR THEME IN RECENT MONTHS. THERE SEEMS LITTLE DOUBT BUT THAT DECLINING WORKER PRODUCTIVITY AND ANTI-MODERN BUSINESS PRACTICES HAVE COME TO BE MAJOR PREOCCUPATIONS AS THE SHAH REFLECTS ON IRAN'S ECONOMIC PERFORMANCE AND AND PROSPECTS. THE PROBLEMS HE ALLUDES TO, HOWEVER, ARE DIFFICULT, IF NOT INTRACTABLE, AND READY SOLUTIONS DO NOT SEEM TO BE AT HAND.

HOUSING: COMMENTING ON IRAN'S ACUTE HOUSING PROBLEMS, THE SHAH OFFERED YET ANOTHER THOUGHT AS TO HOW THIS SHORTAGE COULD BE ALLEVIATED. NOTING THAT HE HAD RECENTLY ISSUED EDICTS TO THE GOVERNMENT ON THE SUBJECT OF HOUSING, HE TOLD HIS KAYHAN INTERVIEWER THAT THE GOVERNMENT SHOULD NOT ENTER THE MARKET WITH ITS OWN EXTENSIVE LAND HOLDINGS AND SELL THESE TO BREAK ARTIFICIALLY HIGH PRICES. HE FOUND THE RUN-UP IN LAND PRICES TO BE "NOT NATURAL." HE FOUND THE PHENOMENON OF A WORKER RECEIVING 2,000 RIALS A NIGHT AND MASTER-BUILDERS 5,000 A NIGHT FOR WORKING OUTSIDE TEHRAN CITY LIMITS ON ILLEGAL HOME CONSTRUCTION TO BE "COMPLETELY ASTONISHING."

CORRUPTION: THE SHAH SAID THAT MUCH OF THE TALK OF CORRUPTION AND BRIBERY IS A RESULT OF RUMORS AND "ANTI-IRANIAN PROPAGANDA." THE GOVERNMENT ATTACHES MUCH IMPORTANCE TO HONESTY IN THE ADMINISTRATION AND INSTANCES OF CORRUPTION ARE HANDLED WITH "UTTER RUTHLESSNESS" WHEN SPOTTED. CONCEDING THAT CORRUPTION IS ANY NATION'S WORST ENEMY, HE CITED THE ARMED FORCES AS BEING "ABSOLUTELY TRUSTWORTHY" IN THIS RESPECT. CORRUPTION AT THE HIGHER LEVELS IN THE CIVIL ADMINISTRATION DOES NOT IXIST OR IS MINIMAL. AGAIN, WHENEVER CORRUPTION IS SEEN "WE SHALL ROOT IT OUT WITHOUT MERCY." MOST CORRUPTION OF THE LOWER LEVELS IS SMALL SCALE DISHONESTY, I.E., TIPS.
SOME PEOPLE SEEM TO ENJOY THE GAME OF ACCUSATION AND MUCKRAKING, AND THE AVERAGE IRANIAN SEEMS TO LIKE GOSSIPING ABOUT CORRUPTION, HE SAID.

COMMENT: IT IS TRUE, OF COURSE, THAT THERE HAVE BEEN A FEW HIGHLY PUBLICIZED CASES IN THE LAST TWO OR THREE YEARS OF SWIFT GOVERNMENT ACTION IN WELL-DOCUMENTED INSTANCES OF BRIBERY IN THE NEGOTIATION OF CONTRACTS WITH NIOC, THE IMPERIAL IRANIAN NAVY AND THE CIVIL AIR ORGANIZATION (A BRANCH OF THE MINISTRY OF WAR). THE GUILTY PARTIES WERE FINED AND GIVEN LONG JAIL SENTENCES. CERTAINLY CORRUPTION IN THE ARMED FORCES WAS LESSENED UPON THE DEATH OF GENERAL KHATAMI (HEAD OF THE AIR FORCE) TWO YEARS AGO WHO WAS WIDELY BELIEVED TO HAVE BECOME A MILLIONAIRE SEVERAL TIMES OVER THROUGH RAKE-OFFS ON AIR FORCE CONTRACTS WHICH HE ALONE APPROVED.

NONETHELESS, MOST INFORMED OBSERVERS, WE BELIEVE, WOULD SAY THAT THE ARMED FORCES STILL OFFERS AN ATTRACTIVE TARGET FOR THOSE WHO WOULD OFFER ILLICIT GRATIFICATIONS IN ORDER TO WIN A CONTACT AND THAT CORRUPTION, PROBABLY ON A FAIRLY LARGE SCALE, CAN STILL BE FOUND IN THE ARMED FORCES, IT IS UNCLEAR TO THE EMBASSY JUST HOW GLAGRANT CORRUPTION MUST BECOME BEFORE THE IMPERIAL INSPECTORATE MOVES. WHETHER IT IS CALLED RUMOR MONGERING, MUCK-RAKING OR WHATEVER, THE EMBASSY FINDS A PERVASIVE BELIEF AMONG IRANIANS THAT CORRUPTION CONTINUES TO BE A COMMON OCCURRENCE.
REF STATE 220235

WE ARE PLEASED TO LEARN THAT SECRETARY HAS AGREED TO BILATERAL MEETING IN NEW YORK WITH IRANIAN FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY. WE MAY HAVE SOME DIFFICULTY PASSING THIS WORD TO MINISTER BECAUSE OF RELIGIOUS HOLIDAYS TODAY AND TOMORROW AND BECAUSE WE UNDERSTAND HE WILL BE LEAVING FOR NEW YORK TOMORROW EVENING.

AS PREVIOUSLY REPORTED, MINISTER EXPECTS TO BE IN NEW YORK FROM SEPTEMBER 18. ALTHOUGH HE HAD EARLIER EXPECTED TO LEAVE OCTOBER 4, HE NOW PLANS TO STAY UNTIL OCTOBER 6 IN ORDER BE PRESENT WHEN PRESIDENT CARTER ADDRESSES UNGA.

KHALATBARY HAS INDICATED HE WOULD VERY MUCH LIKE TO MEET WITH SECRETARY PRIOR TO DELIVERING HIS OWN SPEECH IN GENERAL DEBATE. WHILE HE HAD UNDERSTOOD THIS WAS SCHEDULED FOR FIRST DAY OR TWO IN OCTOBER, USUN HAS REPORTED THAT HE IS CURRENTLY SCHEDULED SPEAK SEPTEMBER 27.

SUGGEST EXACT TIMING OF MEETING BE WORKED OUT DIRECTLY BETWEEN USUN AND IRAN PER REP, WITH MAXIMUM EFFORT TO ADHERE MINISTER'S DESIRE HAVE MEETING PRECEDE HIS OWN ADDRESS. DEPT AND USUN SHOULD ALSO BEAR IN MIND KHALATBARY'S DESIRE TO BE KEPT AU COURANT WITH ANY MIDDLE EAST DEVELOPMENTS WHICH RESULT FROM US BILATERALS EITHER IN WASHINGTON OR NEW YORK.

1977TEHRAN08277.subject: ZIA VISIT TO IRAN BEGIN UNCLASSIFIED

segments.text: BEGIN UNCLASSIFIED

SUMMARY: DURING BUSY HOUR VISIT TO TEHRAN SEPT 14, CMLA GEN. ZIA SPOKE WITH SHAH AND GAVE MAJOR NEWSPAPER INTERVIEWS FINALLY PUBLISHED SEPT 18. IN INTERVIEW WITH KAYHAN EDITOR, ZIA STATED FIRMLY THAT HE DOES NOT WISH TO OPERATE NEW GOVERNMENTAL SYSTEM AND, IN "SHERMAN-LIKE" STATEMENT RESPONDED TO A WUESTION: "I AM NOT INTERESTED IN POLITICAL OFFICE AND SHALL NEVER ACCEPT ONE." DISPLAYING ALMOST MYSTICAL FAITH IN ABILITY OF OCT 18 ELECTION TO RESOLVE PAKISTAN'S POLITICAL PROBLEMS, ZIA SAID "DATE OF ELECTIONS SHALL NOT BE ALTERED". ZIA SAID HE WOULD PRESENT "WHITE PAPER, OR BLACK BOOK" TO NEW NATIONAL ASSEMBLY OCT. 28 DETAILING BHUTTO'S MISUSE OF POWER.

WHEN ASKED TO DISCUSS PROSPECTS FOR GOVERNMENT UNDER EITHER BHUTTO OR PNA, ZIA CASTIGATED BOTH, SAYING BHUTTO WAS EXPERIENCED AND SMART, BUT DEVOID OF PRINCIPLES, UNRELIABLE AND CYNICAL. PNA LEADERS CHARACTERIZED AS INEXPERIENCED, UNCERTAIN MEN WHO ARE BASICALLY PROVINCIAL WITH LITTLE OR NO EDUCATION IN WORLD AFFAIRS. ZIA SAID HE EXPECTS TO RETURN TO ARMY POST AFTER ELECTIONS IF NEW GOVERNMENT "WILL ALLOW ME TO KEEP MY ARMY JOB". TENOR OF HIS COMMENTS MAKES US WONDER, HOWEVER, HOW HE CAN AVOID REACHING THE CONCLUSION THAT HE HIMSELF IS THE ONLY TRULY QUALIFIED CANDIDATE TO LEAD THE NATION IN THE FUTURE: END SUMMARY.

DURING BRIEF FOUR-HOUR VISIT SEPT. 14, ZIA HAD LENGTHY MEETING WITH SHAH, ATTENDED CEREMONIAL DINNER, AND GAVE WIDE-RANGING INTERVIEWS TO THREE IRANIAN JOURNALISTS. TWO INTERVIEWS APPEARED IN ENGLISH AND FARSI PRESS SEPT. 18 AND SEEM TO REVEAL MUCH ABOUT ZIA THINKING AS OF SEPT. 14. FOLLOWING ACCOUNT IS BASED ON INTERVIEW WITH KAYHAN EDITOR AMIR TAHERI. SECOND INTERVIEW TAKES SAME LINE.

DESCRIBING HIS RELUCTANCE TO INTERVENE IN POLITICS, ZIA STATES HIS DECISION TO ENTER POLITICAL ARENA MADE ONLY AS A LAST RESORT TO PROTECT EXISTENCE OF ISLAMIC REPUBLIC, AND THEN ONLY WHEN IT WAS "ONLY CHOICE". HE STATED FIRMLY HIS INTENTION TO PROCEED WITH OCT.

18 ELECTIONS AND WITH RESPECT TO HIS OWN FUTURE, SAID: "I MEAN TO GO BACK TO MY ARMY FUNCTIONS AFTER THE ELECTION AND SERVE THE REST OF MY TENURE AS CHIEF OF THE ARMY STAFF PROVIDED THE GOVERNMENT WHICH COMES INTO BEING WILL ALLOW ME TO KEEP MY ARMY JOB." LATER IN INTERVIEW, TAHERI REFERRED TO OTHER GENERALS, INCLUDING SOME IN PAKISTAN, WHO SAID THEY WANTED TO RETURN TO BARRACKS AND THEN HUNG ON. HE ASKED ZIA IF HE COULD MAKE "WHAT THE AMERICANS CALL A SHERMAN DECLARATION?" ZIA REPLIED, " I THINK I HAVE ALREADY MADE MY SHERMAN DECLARATION AND I AM READY TO MAKE IT TEN TIMES OVER.
YOU CANNOT MAKE ME PRESIDENT AND I SHALL NEVER ACCEPT ANY POLITICAL OFFICE. ...NO, I HAVE NO POLITICAL AMBITIONS PERSONALLY. I AM NOT INTERESTED IN POLITICAL OFFICE AND SHALL NEVER ACCEPT ONE."

ZIA CALLED FOR RESTRUCTURING PAKISTAN'S GOVERNMENTAL SYSTEM TO ELIMINATE NEED FOR ARMY TO INTERVENE. IN REPLY TO TAHERI QUESTION WHETHER ZIA WOULD "HAND OVER THE COUNTRY TO ANY TOM, DICK, AND HARRY WHO MIGHT WIN ON A PASSING PROTEST VOTE", ZIA REPLIED MLA WAS CONCERNED WITH THE ENDS, AND WANTS OCTOBER ELECTIONS TO PRODUCE SOME FORM OF STABLE GOVERNMENT THAT HAS A NATIONAL, NOT MERELY PROVINCIAL, NATURE. ZIA SAID MLA DOES NOT RPT NOT INTEND TO MANIPULATE ELECTIONS BUT WILL TRY TO MAKE SURE THAT WHAT EMERGES WILL BE STRONG CENTRALGOVERNMENT. HE SAID HE WOULD PRESENT WHITE PAPER ON BHUTTO'S CRIMES TO NEW NATIONAL ASSEMBLY ON OCT.

28, "EVEN IF MR. BHUTTO IS REELECTED". ZIA NOTED HE HAD PREVIOUSLY RESPECTED BHUTTO BUT HAD CALLED HIM IN TO CRITICIZE HIS RECORD. "I TOLD HIM POINT BLANK THAT I WAS GOING TO UNFOLD HIS SORDID RECORD FOR THE WHOLE WORLD TO SEE." LATER ZIA ADDED, "I TOLD HIM, SIR, YOU HAVE TURNED OUT TO BE A MURDERER, AND EMBEZZLER. YOU POCKETED THE COUNTRY'S MONEY, PART OF WHICH WAS GIVEN BY MUSLIM NATIONS TO HELP PAKISTAN OUT OF ITS ECONOMIC TROUBLES."

WHILE BHUTTO REINCARCERATION AND PROJECTED TRIAL HAVE CHANGED SITUATION, ZIA SAID THAT BHUTTO WAS FREE TO RUN FOR ELECTION "IF HE DOES NOT GET CONVICTED BEFORE OCTOBER 18". ZIA MENTIONED BHUTTO "STOOPED SO LOW AS TO ARRANGE THE MURDER OF A NOBODY--A CERTAIN KASSURI, WHO ESCAPED ASSASSINATION WHILE HIS FATHER DIED BY HIS SIDE".

WITH RESPECT TO HIS PREFERENCES IN THE ELECTION, ZIA SAID "MY PREFERENCES DO NOT MATTER MUCH", AND WENT ON SHARPLY TO CRITICIZE BOTH SIDES. HE DESCRIBED BHUTTO AS "AN EXPERIENCED, HIGHLY EDUCATED, AND EXTREMELY SMART INTELLECTUAL--A POLITICAL PRINCE WITH A GIFT FOR ORATORY ------------------024968 191722Z /50 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA SECSTATE WASHDC 4589 INFO AMCONSUL LAHORE AMCONSUL KARACHI AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY DACCA SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 8277 AND NATURAL TALENTS OF PERSUASION AND MANIPULATION....

WHO WOULD NOT LOOK AN ODDITY IN THE COMPANY OF THE WORLD'S ELITE....A VERITABLE START CAPABLE OF PERFORMING ON THE MOST ILLUSTRIOUS STAGES....BUT THE SAME MAN, BEHIND HIS FASCINATING MASK, IS AN INDIVIDUAL TOTALLY DEVOID OF PRINCIPLES. HE BELIEVES IN NOTHING BUT HIMSELF AND IS PREPARED TO SACRIFICE THE CLOSEST OF HIS KIN....TO REACH THE DIZZY HEIGHTS OF HIS MEGALOMANIA, HE WOULD NOT HESITATE TO TURN CORPSES OF HIS DEAREST FRIENDS INTO A LADDER, DISCARDING IT WITHOUT CEREMONY THE MOMENT HE HAS REACHED THE TOP."

ZIA WAS ONLY SLIGHTLY MORE FLATTERING TO PNA LEADERS, CALLING THEM "INEXPERIENCED POLITICANS, STILL UNCERTAIN ABOUT THE PATH THEY MEAN TO TAKE, BUT NOT YET BLASE ENOUGH TO CONSIDER ACCOUNTABILITY TO THE PEOPLE AS MERELY A RHETORICAL ASIDE?...WE DO NOT KNOW WHETHER THEY CAN RUN THINGS EFFICIENTLY. ...THEY ARE BASICALLY PROVINCIAL WITH SIMPLE TASTES AND LITTLE OR NO EDUCATION IN WORLD AFFAIRS. EACH OF THEM HAS NOTIONS AND IDEAS OF HIS WON." ZIA SAID HE HAD TALKED WITH THE PNA LEADERS AND IMPRESSED UPON THEM THAT "THEY CANNOT FILL STOMACHS WITH THE HOLY BOOK".
IN PROJECTIVE SENTENCE AT END OF THIS COMMENT, ZIA ADDED "WE SHOULD NOT BE AFRAID OF CHANGE SIMPLY BECAUSE THOSE WHO MIGHT ARRIVE HAVE NEVER BEEN THERE BEFORE."

TAHERI'S FINAL QUESTION NOTED PNA HAS BEEN PORTRAYED AS COALITION, SOME OF WHOSE MEMBERS ARE SAID NOT TO HAVE FRIENDLY SENTIMENTS TOWARDS IRAN. ZIA REPLIED, "I DON'T THINK THAT IS TRUE. NO GOVERNMENT IN PAKISTAN COULD WISH FOR OR AFFORD TO HAVE ANYTHING BUT THE CLOSEST OF BROTHERLY RELATIONS WITH IRAN. EVEN IF EVERYTHING CHANGES IN PAKISTAN OUR FRIENDSHIP WITH IRAN AND OUR AFFECTION AND RESPECT FOR HIS IMPERIAL MAJESTY THE SHAHANSHAH AND THE GREAT IRANIAN NATION WOULD REMAIN AS SOLID AS EVER ....I HAVE DISCUSSED THIS WITH THE PNA LEADERS AND HAVE FOUND THEM IN FULL AGREEMENT WITH ME AND AMONG THEMSELVES ON THAT SCORE.
IN THE LAST ELECTION CAMPAIGN THEY HAD LITTLE OPPORTUNITY TO SHOW THEIR FRIENDSHIP FOR IRAN, BUT NOW THEY ARE COMING OUT AND MAKING THE NECESSARY STATEMENTS." END UNCLASSIFIED BEGIN CONFIDENTIAL

ZIA HAD LENGTHY PERSONAL AUDIENCE ALONE WITH SHAH, AND PAK EMBASSY SOURCE HERE REPORTS HE WAS PLEASED WITH OUTCOME BUT GAVE NO DETAILS. LOCAL PRESS PASSED OVER IN SILENCE ZIA VISIT TO SAUDI ARABIA UNTIL MORNING SEPT. 19 WHEN MENTION OF TRIP TO SAUDI ARABIA WAS INCLUDED IN FARSI PRESS STORY ON TRIP.

SEMIOFFICIAL SPECULATION HERE IS THAT ZIA BRIEFED SHAH ON MLA'S INTENTIONS WITH RESPECT TO BHUTTO AND CONTINUING ELECTIONS, AND GOT AT LEAST TACIT ACCEPTANCE OF MLA'S PROJECTED MOVES. MORE ON THE RUMOR SIDE IS TALK HERE THAT ZIA ALSO MAY HAVE PICKED UP SOME FUNDING FROM SAUDIS IN INTERESTS OF CONTINUED STABILITY.

COMMENT: TENOR OF ZIA PRESS INTERVIEWS MARKED BY VIGOROUS RESPONSE COUPLED WITH WHAT SEEMS INCREDIBLE NAIVETE. PERHAPS ZIA IS NOT RPT NOT REALLY SERIOUS ABOUT CONTINUING IN HARNESS AFTER NEW GOVERNMENT CHOSEN, BUT IF HE IS, COMMENTS ON LEADING CONTENDERS FOR POWER SEEM TOO FORTHRIGHT FOR HIS OWN GOOD. ZIA'S REMARKS INDICATE HE HAS NEARLY MYSTICAL BELIEF THAT OCT.

18 ELECTION WILL RESOLVE PROBLEMS OF PAKISTAN'S GOVERNANCE WHILE TAHERI'S QUESTIONS FORESHADOW IRANIAN CONCERN THAT WHATEVER THE OUTCOME, PARTICULARLY IF IT IS A PNA VICTORY, NEITHER PAKISTAN NOR IRAN-PAK RELATIONS ARE OUT OF THE WOODS YET, WE CANNOT HELP WONDERING HOW ZIA CAN AVOID REACHING CONCLUSION IN HIS OWN MIND THAT HE CANNOT LEAVE THE RUNNING OF PAKISTAN TO ANY OF THE LEADERS THAT MIGHT BE ELECTED. DID HE COME TO IRAN TO SUGGEST TO SHAH THAT HE AND THE ARMY WOULD GUARANTEE STABILITY FROM BEHIND THE SCENES EVEN IF THE PNA WON?
MEANWHILE, THE IRANIAN PRESS IS PLAYING PAK SITUATION VERY STRAIGHT, BUT WITH PROMINENT COVERAGE TO EVENTS SUCH AS BHUTTO ARREST AND TENSENESS OVER DEMONSTRATIONS.

IT IS TOO EARLY YET FOR A DEFINITIVE REPLY TO REFTEL A. IRANIANS MAINTAIN EXCELLENT LIAISON WITH THEIR MISSION IN NEW YORK (AND GENEVA) AND ARE WELL AWARE OF USG POSITIONS IN THE GENERAL TERMS LAID OUT BY REFTEL A. THEY THEMSELVES ARE CONSISTENT FROM YEAR TO YEAR IN THE POSITIONS THEY TAKE. THESE POSITIONS USUALLY ACCOMMODATE THEMSELVES TO USG DESIRES, EVEN IN THOSE CASES WHEN THE TACTICAL SITUATION CHANGES AT THE LAST MINUTE FORCING A CHANGE OF STRATEGY IN OUR OWN APPROACH.

EXCEPTIONS ARISE MAINLY ON ISSUES WHICH IRANIANS RECEIVE AS IMPORTANT FOR THEIR IMAGE WITH A LARGE VOTING BLOCK, SPECIFICALLY THE ARABS ON ARAB-ISRAEL QUESTIONS OR THE THIRD WORLD ON LARGER ECONOMIC ISSUES.

IRANIANS BELIEVE STRONGLY IN MODERATION AND REASONABLENESS AND HAVE A GOOD RECORD FOR CONSTRUCTIVE EFFORTS IN PAST UNGAS. WE THEREFORE JUDGE IT SUPERFLUOUS TO REHEARSE WITH THEM THE VIRTUES OF OUR OWN MODERATE POSITIONS ON A WIDE VARIETY OF WHAT THEY WOULD CONSIDER ROUTINE AND RELATIVELY MINOR ISSUES; THEY CAN PREDICTABLY BE COUNTED WITH US, ON THE SIDE OF MODERATION AND REASONABLENESS.

ON THE MORE POLITICALLY CONTROVERSIAL ISSUES (E.G. MIDDLE EAST, CYPRUS) RHODESIA, APARTHEID OR NAMIBIA) THE DECISION ON HOW IRAN VOTES IS MADE BY THE SHAH AND USUALLY AS CLOSE TO THE LAST MOMENT AS POSSIBLE. ON SUCH QUESTIONS THE SHAH AND HIS FOREIGN MINISTER ARE ALREADY WELL AWARE OF OUR GENERAL POSITIONS AND DESIRES AS LAID OUT IN REFTEL A. HOW THEY VOTE WILL DEPEND ON THE SPECIFIC FORM OF ANY RESOLUTION AND THE VTY OF PRESSURES AT THAT MOMENT.

SPECIFICALLY, ON THE MIDDLE EAST AND CYPRUS, IRAN WILL WORK ACTIVELY BEHIND THE SCENES IN COOPERATION WITH THE US AND OTHERS OF LIKE INTERESTS FOR MODERATION IN RESOLUTIONS BEING CONTEMPLATED BY THE PARTIES. ONCE A RESOLUTION HAS BEEN BEEN BROGHT TO A VOTE, HOWEVER, IRAN WILL VOTE ON ARABISRAEL ISSUES ALMOST INVARIABLY WITH THE ARABS.

ON CYPRUS, DECISION WILL BE CLOSRE, AS GOI WEIGHS ITS VOTE-ON A RESPONSE TO ANY SPECIFIC USG APPEAL--AGAINST THE BACKGROUND OF ITS SPECIAL ISLAMIC AND GOOD-NEIGHBORLY TIES TO TURKEY AND ITS CONCERN FOR THIRD WORLD OPINION, GOI ATTITUDE ON AFRICAN ISSUES SUCH AS RHODESIA, APARTHEID, AND NAMIBIA CAN BE EXPECTED TO PARALLEL OUR OWN AS LONG AS OUR ATTITUDES CONTINUE TO PARALLEL THOSE OF THE THIRD WORLD.

MFA INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS DEPARTMENT INFORMS US THAT FINAL TOUCHES ARE STILL BEING PUT ON FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY'S SPEECH, WHICH IS SCHEDULED TO BE DELIVERRED SEPT. 27. WE HAVE APPOINTMENT SEPT. 26 TO REVIEW GOI POSITION ON THE ISSUES IN LIGHT OF TREATMENT THEY WILL RECEIVE IN THAT SPEECH AND PAST RECORD. WE HOPE TO REPORT MORE SPECIFICALLY ON A NUMBER OF THE ROUTINE ISSUES AT THAT TIME BUT WOULD NOT EXPECT TO HAVE DEFINITIVE PREDICTIONS ON THE KEY POLITICAL ISSUES MENTIONED ABOVE. WE SHALL BE HAPPY TO ASSIST DEPT. AND USUN IN FURTHER COORDINATION ON THE LATTER AS THEY TAKE SPECIFIC SHAPE.

1977TEHRAN08449.subject: INTERNATIONAL FUEL CYCLE EVALUATION ORGANIZING CONFERENCE WASHINGTON DC OCT 19-21, 1977

segments.text: EMBOFF CONTACTED MRS FARHOUDI WHO IS ACTING FOR DR CYRUS MANZOUR DIR FOR INTERNATIONAL AND LEGAL AFFS, AEOI, DURING LATTER'S ABSENCE. MRS FARHOUDI SAID THAT DR ETEMAD HAD NOT YET NAMED DELS TO SUBJ CONF. SHE DID NOT EXPECT DELS TO BE NAMED UNTIL FIRST WEEK IN OCTOBER.
WE ARE ADVISING AEOI CONCERNING PARA 2 REF A. INFORMATION.

DURING PERIOD SINCE BRIEF VISIT OF GENERAL ZIA-AL-HUQ TO TEHRAN (SEPTEMBER 14), I HAVE NOTED CONSIDERABLE RETICENCE BY SENIOR IRANIANS IN DISCUSSING PAKISTAN SITUATION. IN CONVERSATION WITH ACTING FOREIGN MINISTER ZELLI, FORMER IRANIAN AMBASSADOR TO PAKISTAN, I EXPRESSED COMMON TEHRAN ASSUMPTION THAT ZIA HAD INFORMED IRANIANS DURING HIS STAY THAT HE INTENDED TO RE-ARREST BHUTTO ON HIS RETURN HOME. ZELLI RATHER GLUMLY STATED THAT ZIA HAD NOT RPT NOT INFORMED THEM OF THIS INTENTION.
SINCE I FOUND THIS STATEMENT RATHER HARD TO BELIEVE, I PUT THE SAME QUESTION TO THE PAKISTAN AMBASSADOR SEPTEMBER 24. THIS BROUGHT FORTH A LONG AND RATHER PROFOUND LAMENT FROM MY PAKISTAN COLLEAGUE.

HE SAID HE HAD BEEN PRIMARILY RESPONSIBLE FOR GETTING GENERAL ZIA TO COME TO TEHRAN. HE HAD PLEADED FOR THE VISIT IN ORDER TO BALANCE ZIA'S VISIT TO JIDDA. HE SAID ZIA HAD AGREED TO COME SOMEWHAT RELUCTANTLY, BUT THAT, WHEN HE DID COME, HE SEEMED TO HAVE GOTTEN ALONG RATHER WELL WITH THE SHAH. THE IRANIANS WERE QUITE CANDID IN MAKING CLEAR THEIR POSITIVE ATTITUDE TOWARDS BHUTTO AND THEIR FEARS OF "DISINTEGRATION" UNDER A PNA REGIME. NEVERTHELESS, THE TALKS HAD GONE WELL.

CONSEQUENTLY, WHEN ZIA RETURNED TO ISLAMABAD AND FORTHWITH ARRESTED BHUTTO, THE PAKISTAN AMBASSADOR FELT THAT HE COMPLETELY UNDID WHATEVER GOOD WILL HE MAY HAVE EARNED HERE. THE AMBASSADOR FEELS RELATIONS ARE CURRENTLY STRAINED AND IS UNHAPPY ABOUT FUTURE PROSPECTS.

COMMENT: AS A CAREER CIVIL SERVANT OF THE OLD SCHOOL, AMBASSADOR AHMED IS QUITE DISTRESSED ABOUT THE CURRENT SITUATION IN HIS COUNTRY. HIS CANDID REMARKS TO ME ON SUBJECT OF IRANIANPAKISTAN RELATIONS SHOULD, OF COURSE, BE CAREFULLY PROTECTED.

1977TEHRAN08479.subject: IRAN RELATIONS WITH AFGHANISTAN AND PAKISTAN

segments.text: SUMMARY. MFA OFFICIAL HAS CONFIRMED OUR EARLIER REPORTS THAT IRANIANS AND AFGHANS HAVE OVERCOME ALL THEIR HELMAND RIVER PROBLEMS, INCLUDING PROPOSED AFGHAN DAM NEAR IRANIAN BORDER. DISCUSSION WITH VISITING KABUL POL COUNS TOUCHED ON A NUMBER OF OTHER SUBJECTS INCLUDING PASHTUNISTAN, BALUCHISTAN, AFGHAN ARMY, AND ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT. END SUMMARY.

DURING CALL ON HIM BY VISITING KABUL POL COUNS FLATIN, MFA DEPARTMENT HEAD SHIVA-RAZAVI CONFIRMED THAT, AS FAR AS IRANIANS ARE CONCERNED, THERE ARE NO MORE PROBLEMS WITH AFGHANISTAN ON HELMAND RIVER WATERS. THIS IS IN LINE WITH EARLIER INFORMATION KABUL AND TEHRAN HAD OBTAINED FOLLOWING NAIM'S MAY 10 VISIT TO THE SHAH (REFTELS).

WHEN FLATIN EXPRESSED USG PLEASURE TO FIND IRAN-AFGHAN RELATIONSHIPS SO MUCH BETTER, SHIVA-RAZAVI COUNTERED BY REFERRING TO KABUL TIMES COVERAGE OF PASHTUNISTAN DAY IN KABUL RECENTLY. HE WAS PARTICULARLY STRUCK BY THE BIG PASHTUNISTAN FLAG FEATURED ON THE FRONT PAGE. ALTHOUGH STILL SKEPTICAL, HE SEEMED TO ACCEPT THE THRUST OF FLATIN'S EXPLANATION THAT FLAG AND OTHER SYMBOLS OF PASHTUNISTAN MEAN LESS TO AFGHAN GOVERNMENT THAN THEY USED TO AND DAUD'S STATEMENTS ARE ALWAYS CAREFULLY GUARDED THESE DAYS AND REFER ONLY TO THE WELL BEING AND FREEDOM OF EXPRESSION OF PUSHTUN AND BALUCHI BROTHERS. THERE IS NO MENTION OF INTEGRATING THESE PEOPLES INTO AFGHANISTAN.
FLATIN NOTED THAT AFGHANS ARE CAREFUL NOT TO OFFEND THE PAKISTANIS THESE DAYS AND INCLUDE PAKISTAN AMONG "FRIENDLY NATIONS".

ON THE RELATED QUESTION OF BALUCHISTAN, SHIVA-RAZAVI BROUGHT OF DAUD'S CELEBRATED REFERENCE TO THE COLONIAL HERITAGE OF THE DURAND LINE ON HIS LAST TRIP TO MOSCOW, BUT HE AGAIN AGREED THAT THE AFGHANS HAVE BEEN VERY CAREFUL IN PUBLIC REFERENCES TO PAKISTAN, PARTICULARLY DURING THE PAKISTANI ELECTIONS. HE AGREED WITH FLATIN THAT THE AFGHANS WOULD LIKE TO TALK TO THE PAKISTANIS ABOUT IMPROVING RELATIONS BUT ARE WAITING UNTIL AFTER THE ELECTIONS SCHEDULED FOR OCTOBER.

SHIVA-RAZAVI REFERRED TO THE SHAH'S WELL-PUBLICIZED POSITION THAT IRAN WILL NOT ACCEPT FURTHER DISINTEGRATION OPAKISTAN. FLATIN SAID THIS SEEMED TO BE SIMILAR TO THE AFGHAN VIEW. FLATIN EMPHASIZED THAT THE AFGHANS ARE VERY NATIONALISTIC AND CAN BEST BE CHARACTERIZED AS NEITHER PROSOVIET NOR PRO-WESTERN BUT JUST PRO-AFGHAN. HE NOTED THAT THE U.S. TRAINS A SELECTED NUMBER OF AFGHAN MILITARY OFFICERS (ABOUT 15 A YEAR). WHILE NUMBERS OF AFGHANS TRAINED IN SOVIET UNION ARE ADMITTEDLY MUCH LARGER, WE FEEL AFGHANS WATCH THIS FACTOR VERY CAREFULLY AND THEIR ARMED FORCES CANNOT BE DESCRIBED AS AGENTS OF THE RUSSIANS.
IN ANY CASE AFGHAN ARMED FORCES ARE MODEST IN NUMBERS AND EQUIPMENT AND HAVE A BIG COUNTRY TO COVER. SHIVA-RAZAVI AGREED, SAYING THEY WERE EVEN UNDER-EQUIPPED.

AT SHIVA-RAZAVI'S REQUEST, FLATIN DESCRIBED THE MAIN AREAS OF U.S. ECONOMIC ASSISTANCE TO AFGHANISTAN TODAY, INCLUDING OUR INTEREST IN SOME SORT OF CROP OR INCOME SUBSTITUTION PROJECT TO REDUCE OPIUM GROWING. HE SEEMED INTERESTED--THOUGH NON-COMMITTAL--IN FLATIN'S SUGGESTION THAT THERE COULD BE GOOD INCOME PRODUCING COMMERCIAL DEVELOPMENT PROJECTS IN AFGHANISTAN, PARTICULARLY IF ACCESS TO IRANIAN PORTS WAS IMPROVED BY ROAD AND RAILROAD BUILDING.

IN RESPONSE TO A QUESTION, SHIVA-RAZAVI SAID HE HAD HEARD TWO FIGURES FOR THE NUMBER OF (MAINLY UNREGISTERED) AFGHAN WORKERS IN IRAN: 500,000 AND ONE MILLION (THE SMALLER FIGURE IS CLOSER TO OUR OWN ESTIMATES). SHIVA-RAZAVI EXPRESSED INTEREST IN FLATIN'S SUGGESTION THAT THE WEST GERMANS, WHO HAVE HAD SO MUCH EXPERIENCE WITH IMPORTING FOREIGN WORKERS, WOULD BE A GOOD SOURCE OF ADVICE AND ASSISTANCE ON REGULARIZING THE AFGHAN WORKER SITUATION.
COMMENT: SHIVA-RAZAVI CAN BE COUNTED ON TO REFLECT OFFICIAL MFA LINE CLOSELY.

1977TEHRAN08530.subject: U.S. - SOVIET WORKING GROUP ON THE INDIAN OCEAN

segments.text: WE NOTE IN SPETEMBER 26 WIRELESS, NEW YORK TIMES STORY THAT U.S. IS ASKING SOVIET UNION TO AGREE TO"STABILIZE" NAVAL ACTIVITIES IN THE INDIAN OCEAN AT ITS PRESENT LEVEL AS A FIRST STEP IN ACHIEVING PRESIDENT CARTER'S GOAL OF DEMILITARIZING THE OCEAN. STORY ALLEGES THAT U.S. DELEGATION HEADED BY PAUL WARNKE WILL BEGIN FOUR DAYS OF TALKS IN U.S. WITH A SOVIET DELEGATION BUT DETAILS ARE NOT AVAILABLE.

AS WE EMPHASIZED IN REFTEL, GOI HAS CONTINUING LIVELY INTEREST IN ANY DEVELOPMENT ON THIS FRONT AND WE BELIEVE IT IMPORTANT THAT IT BE KEPT APPRISED OF UNFOLDING PLANS AND DEVELOPMENTS. APPRECIATE DEPARTMENT'S EARLIER RESPONSE TO REFTEL BUT WIRELESS STORY SUGGESTS THAT INFORMATIONAL PROCESS HAS ONCE AGAIN BROKEN DOWN. PLEASE REPAIR AND KEEP IN

WE NOTE IRANIAN EMB IN BEIRUT IS AGAIN CONCERNED WITH THE ACTIVITIES OF IMAM MOUSSA SADR. IT IS USEFUL TO RECALL THAT IRANIANS WERE TURNED OFF ON SADR SOMETIME AGO. WE HAVE SPECIFIC COLLATERAL REPORT THAT SHAH ORDERED SAVAK CONTACT WITH SADR BROKEN OFF SOMETIME BEFORE OCT 1975, AT LEAST PARTY BECAUSE SPEECHES BY SADR LAUDING LIBYA'S QADHAFI HAD INFURIATED THE SHAH. IT MAY BE THAT SADR HAS TRIED SINCE THEN TO REGAIN GOOD GRACES OF THE IRANIANS, PARTICULARLY IN DAMASCUS WHERE SADR IS SAID TO BE FREQUENT VISITOR, BUT WE WOULD BE SURPRISED IF SADR'S LEFT-WING POPULIST BRAND OF POLITICS WOULD AGAIN APPEAL TO THE IRANIANS.

1977TEHRAN08544.subject: DISSIDENCE: PRISONER RELEASE AND STUDENT RUMBLINGS

segments.text: FOLLOWING SHOULD BE CLOSELY HELD SINCE SEVERAL SOURCES ARE EASILY TRACEABLE TO EMBOFF

WIFE OF ABBAS MILANI, DISSIDENT CONVICTED FOR TERRORIST ACTIVITIES, TOLD EMBOFF PRIVATELY HER HUSBAND AND REST OF "TEHRAN ELEVEN" SENTENCED IN APRIL (REFTEL) HAVE BEEN QUIETLY INFORMED THEY WILL BE FREED IN AMNESTY ON SHAH'S BIRTHDAY, OCT. 26. MILANI TOLD HIS WIFE ALL PRISONERS HAVE BEEN WELL TREATED, INCLUDING RENOVATION AND REPAINTING OF CELLS JUST PRIOR TO INTERNATIONAL RED CROSS VISIT IN LATE SPRING. PRISONERS FIRMLY BELIEVE IMPENDING VISIT OF SHAH TO U.S. COUPLED WITH U.S.

HUMAN RIGHTS POLICY IS IMMEDIATE CAUSE OF THEIR GOOD FORTUNE, AND TWO PRISONERS EXPECT TO WRITE LETTERS TO THIS EFFECT TO EX-FULLBRIGHT PROFESSOR, NOW IN U.S., WHO SERVED HERE "ABOUT TWO YEARS AGO." COMMENT: MOST OBSERVERS EXPECTED EARLY RELEASE OF GROUP, PERHAPS IN TWO OR THREE SHIFTS, SINCE ALL ELEVEN COOPERATED WITH AUTHORITIES. IF GOI'S PRESENT INTENTIONS CARRIED OUT, WHOLE GROUP WILL HAVE SERVED LESS THAN SIX MONTHS SENTENCE.

IN OTHER DISCUSSIONS WITH FACULTY MEMBERS AT SEVERAL UNIVERSITIES, EMB LEARNED APPARENT EXTENT OF ONE ELEMENT IN GOI'S RENEWED CAMPAIGN TO BIND STUDENTS TO REGIME. ON SEPT. 23, FOUR RECENT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY GRADUATES, SPEAKING AT GRADUATION CEREMONIES IN PRESENCE OF SHAH, TOLD SHAH THAT PLOTS TO UNDERMINE REGIME HAD BEEN GOING ON FOR MANY YEARS. AS REPORTED IN LOCAL ENGLISH AND FARSI PRESS, STUDENTS RECOUNTED HOW INCIDENT ON 16TH OF AZAR (DECEMBER 7) 1953 (WHEN THREE STUDENTS WERE KILLED) HAS BEEN BUILT INTO ANNUAL AGITATION DATE. ONE STUDENT SAID PLOTS WERE WORK OF "COLONIAL INTERESTS" WHO WISHED TO KEEP IRAN WEAK.

WHOLE THRUST OF STUDENTS' PITCH WAS PRO-GOI, WHICH LED SOME FACULTY MEMBERS TO RECHECK THEIR STATUS AND DISCOVER THAT NONE OF FOUR HAD BEEN IN DEPARTMENTS CLAIMED. TEHRAN UNIVERSITY STUDENT LEADERS ALSO TOLD ONE LITERATURE PROFESSOR THAT GROUP OF FOUR WAS OBVIOUS PLANT: "IF THESE HAD BEEN REAL STUDENTS, OUR ORGANIZATION WOULD HAVE BEATEN THEM SO BADLY THEY WOULD NOT HAVE BEEN ABLE TO TALK."

THERE HAVE BEEN SEVERAL SIGNS IN RECENT MONTHS THAT GOI IS ATTEMPTING TO INFLUENCE STUDENTS AND COUNTERACT TERRORIST AND OPPOSITIONIST "PROPAGANDA." ABOVE INCIDENT, IF TRUE (AND WE HAVE NO REASON TO DOUBT WORD OF FACULTY MEMBERS INVOLVED), IS EXAMPLE OF OVERZEALOUS ATTENTION TO GOAL ACHIEVEMENT OCCASIONALLY PRACTICED BY GOI BUREAUCRACY IN THIS AND OTHER FIELDS.

IN SIMILAR DISCUSSION WITH NATIONAL UNIVERSITY PROFESSORS, EMBOFF WAS TOLD THAT NEW CHANCELOR QOREISHI JUST NOW DISCOVERING DIMENSIONS OF MESS HE IS INHERITING: OPPOSITIONIST STUDENT GROUPS HAVE THRIVED OVER PAST THREEFOUR MONTHS; SUBSTANTIAL AMOUNT OF FIDDLING WITH FACULTY PAY TAKES PLACE ON ROUTINE BASIS, INCLUDING PAYROLL CERTIFICATION OF NONEXISTENT PROFESSORS AND DOUBLE PAY FOR SOME CLASSES; AND DISCIPLINE HAS SAGGED BADLY. WHILE COMMENTS REFLECT SOME STANDARD ACADEMIC COMPLAINTS, ASSIGNMENT OF PRESTIGIOUS POLITICAL FIGURE SUCH AS QOREISHI, WHO ALSO HAS IMPECCABLE ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS, TO HEAD NATIONAL IS SOME INDICATION THAT GOI AND SHAH HIMSELF ARE AWARE OF PROBLEMS.
NUMBER OF CONTACTS HAVE OPINED THAT NATIONAL MAY BE LEADING LOCUS OF STUDENT DISTURBANCES AS SCHOOL YEAR GETS UNDERWAY OVER NEXT FEW WEEKS, UNLESS QOREISHI CAN GET QUICK HANDLE ON THE SITUATION.

HAD LONG DISCUSSION IN GENEVA ON MACHINERY FOR THE FUTURE. SOME FAVORED UNCTAD AND UNIDA, OTHERS HAD OTHER IDEAS. IRANIANS ARE LOOLING FORWARD TO FURTHER EXCHANGES ON THIS IN NEW YORK. (AS TO SOME IRANIAN ATTITUDES ON ENERGY AND UNCTAD PREPCON ON COTTON, SEE TEHRAN 3371, 4565, AND 5156).
POL COUNS TOOK THIS OCCASION TO CONGRATULATE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT ON ELECTION OF ITS REPRESENTATIVE TO COMMITTEE V, PER REF C.

1977TEHRAN08643.subject: NIE OF 2 AUGUST 1977 ENTITLED "MIDDLE EAST MILITARY BALANCE (1977-82)"

segments.text: MILITARY BALANCE (1977-82)"

IN VIEW INTENSE IRANIAN INTEREST IN MIDDLE EAST EVENTS AND IN VIEW PARALLEL ROLE WHICH IRAN PLAYS WITH U.S. INTERESTS IN THAT REGION, THE STUDY CITED ABOVE WOULD BE OF GREAT INTEREST TO THE SHAH. HOWEVER, THE TEXT OF THE "PRINCIPAL JUDGMENTS" SECTION SEEMS REASONABLE ANODYNE AND COULD BE PASSED WITHOUT COMPROMISING SOURCES.

1977TEHRAN08740.subject: U.S.-SOVIET TALKS ON THE INDIAN OCEAN

segments.text: WE AGAIN FIND OURSELVES UNCERTAIN AS TO WHETHER WE ARE UNINFORMED, ILL-INFORMED OR MISINFORMED ABOUT CURRENT AND PERSPECTIVE U.S.-SOVIET TALKS ON THE INDIAN OCEAN. REFTEL A GIVES US LITTLE BASIS FOR ASSESSING THE ACCURACY OF HENRY BRADSHER'S STORY IN THE WASHINGTON STAR (WHICH WAS CARRIED IN THE WIRELESS FILE OF OCTOBER 3) TO THE EFFECT THAT (A) U.S.

AND THE SOVIET UNION HAVE AGREED TO LIMIT THEIR MILITARY ACTIVITIES IN THE INDIAN OCEAN TO THE PRESENT LEVEL, (B) THAT THE U.S.-SOVIET GOAL IS TO REMOVE ALL MILITARY FORCES OF OUTSIDE POWERS FROM THE INDIAN OCEAN, (C) THAT THE TWO COUNTRIES AGREE THAT THEIR WARSHIPS, SUBMARINES, AND MILITARY PLANES WOULD NOT BE BANNED NOR WOULD NORMAL PEACETIME PORT CALLS, TRAINING CRUISES AND OCEANOGRAPHIC RESEARCH (COMMENT: SEEMINGLY IN CONTRADICTION OF B), (D) ANOTHER MEETING IS EXPECTED TO BE HELD BEFORE THE END OF THE YEAR IN AN UNNAMED, NEUTRAL COUNTRY, AND (E) NAVAL POWERS SUCH AS BRITAIN AND FRANCE WILL BE ASKED TO JOIN IN ANY AGREEMENT REACHED BETWEEN THE U.S.
AND THE SOVIET UNION.

WE WOULD APPRECIATE CLARIFICATION/COMMENT ON THE FOREGOING AND INSTRUCTIONS AS TO WHAT WE CAN CONVEY TO THE GOI ON THIS SUBJECT. IN THE FUTURE WE WOULD HOPE WE WOULD BE AT LEAST AS EQUALLY WELL FAVORED AS THE PUBLIC MEDIA SEEMS TO BE IN BEING KEPT ABREAST OF PROGRESS AND PLANS ON OUR INDIAN OCEAN TALKS.

MINISTER AHMAD-ALI AHMADI INTRODUCED THE FOLLOWING SIX UNDERSECRETARIRS OF MINISTRY OF AGRICULTURE AND RURAL DEVELOPMENT (MARD) TO HIM THE SHAH ON SEPTEMBER 29. THREE MORE UNDERSECRETARIES WILL BE NAMED WHEN REORGANIZATION IS COMPLETED.
TWO FORMER UNDERSECRETARIRS OF MANR WERE RETAINED: HOSSEIN SEPEHRI NOW ENCHARGED WITH PROVINCIAL AFFAIRS AND CHIEF COORDINATOR; AND AMIR-HOSSEIN AMIR-REZVANI, ADMINISTRATIVE AFFAIRS AND FINANCE.
TWO FORMER UNDERSECRETARIES OF THE MCRA CONTINUED IN MARD: ZEINOLABEDIN RAHBARI, LAND AFFAIRS; AND ISMAEL AJAMI, SUPERVISION AND EVALUATION.

TWO NEW UNDERSECRETARIES WERE BROUGHT IN: MORTEZA KAVEH, LIVESTOCK AFFAIRS, FORMERLY HEAD OF RAAZI INSTITUTE; AND MOHSEN KHARAD-PIR, FORESTRY AFFAIRS, FORMERLY GENERAL MANAGER OF GOVERNMENT WOOD PRODUCTS PLANT AT SARI.

TWO NEW DIRECTORS GENERAL WERE ALSO PRESENTED TO THE SHAH: ABDOLLAH JAVAN-SHIR, DIRECTOR GENERAL OF TOWN AND VILLAGE COOPERATIVES; AND MORTEZA HOGHOOGHI-ISFAHANI, DIRECTOR GENERAL OF ORGANIZATION OF PRODUCTION UNITS. BOTH PREVIOUSLY HELD HIGH POSITIONS IN THE MCRA.

1977TEHRAN08885.subject: SHAH'S SPEECH TO OPENING OF PARLIAMENT

segments.text: REF 76 TEHRAN 10099

IN MAJOR DEPARTURE FROM PAST PRACTICE (REFTEL), SHAH SPOKE ONLY SEVEN MINUTES AT 1977 OPENING OF PARLIAMENT. REMARKS CONTAINED NO NEW INITIATIVES, FOCUSED ALMOST ENTIRELY ON DOMESTIC AFFAIRS, AND PRAISED IRAN'S GROWTH. TEXT POUCHED DEPT OCT 6.

SHAH NOTED 20 PERCENT (SIC) GROWTH IN GNP OVER PAST YEAR, CALLED FOR BALANCED DEVELOPMENT IN FORTHCOMING SIXTH PLAN, AND SINGLED OUT AGRICULTURE, NOTING IT "MUST EXPAND SIMULTANEOUSLY WITH INDUSTRY". DIALOG WITH PEOPLE THROUGH RESURGENCE PARTY WAS PRAISED, AND ROLE OF IMPERIAL COMMISSIONS AS WATCHDOG OF DEVELOPMENT PROCESS MENTIONED. INTERNATIONALLY, SHAH POINTED TO TREND OF INCREASING DISORDER AND UNREST, ADDING IRAN WOULD EXERCISE "NECESSARY CARE" IN EQUIPPING ITSELF FOR DEFENSE. CALLED FOR ESTABLISHMENT OF NEW INTERNATIONAL ECONOMIC ORDER TO REMOVE BASIC CAUSES OF UNREST, AND IN PASSING REFERENCE TO SUMMER'S EXTENDED POWER SHORTAGE, LAID BLAME AT FEET OF "FOREIGN ELEMENTS".
REF SECTO 10060
I MET AFTERNOON OCTOBER 9 WITH FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY TO EXPLORE THE POINTS RAISED REFTEL CONCERNING ETHIOPIANSOMALIAN DISPUTE. KHALATBARY WAS POSITIVE AND ARTICULATE IN HIS RESPONSE.

IN SUMMARY, HIS VIEWS ARE AS FOLLWS: (A) OAU IS "IMPOTENT". IF ANY INTERNATIONAL ACTION IS TO BE TAKEN, IT MUST BE IN SECURITY COUNCIL. (B) HE FEELS AN INITIATIVE IN SECURITY COUNCIL WOULD BE "GOOD THING". HE DOES NOT BELIEVE SUCH INITIATIVE WILL PRODUCE AGREED RESOLUTION, BUT IT WILL FOCUS INTERNATIONAL CONCERN ON PROBLEM. (C) HE DOES NOT RPT NOT BELIEVE SOVIETS WILL RESORT TO USE OF VETO, AND DOUBTS THEY WOULD SUCCEED IN PROCEDURAL BLOCK OF SECURITY COUNCIL ACTION. (D) HE BELIEVES INITIATIVE "MUST BE TAKEN BY AN AFRICAN NATION". KENYA WOULD BE THE BEST CANDIDATE BECAUSE IT "FEELS THE DANGER" OF THE CURRENT SITUATION.

(E) A RESOLUTION CALLING FOR RESPECT OF AGREED INTERNATIONAL BOUNDARIES "WOULD NOT BE A BOD THING". SOMALIA SHOULD NOT REJECT SUCH A PROPOSAL, BECAUSE IT PRETENDS TO HAVE NO TROOPS IN OGADEN. (F) MAIN CONSEQUENCE OF TAKING ACTION TO SECURITY COUNCIL MIGHT BE TO FOCUS ATTENTION ON SITUATION AND "PUT A BRAKE" ON ANY "DEFINITIVE ACTION" WHICH MIGHT BE TAKEN BY ANY OF THE PARTIES.

KHALATBARY MADE CLEAR THAT CURRENT CONCERN IS THATETHIOPIA MAY BE ABLE TO LAUNCH A COUNTERATTACK WHICH WOULD NOT ONLY REGAIN OGADEN, BUT ALSO "ANNIHILATE" SOMALIA. HE SAYS SOVIET COUNSELOR IN MOGADISCIO TOLD IRANIAN EMBASSY THAT ETHIOPIA WOULD "TEACH SOMALIA A LESSON".

KHALATBARY INDICATED THAT HE WOULD LIKE TO BE INFORMED OF ANY DECISIONS WE TAKE IN THIS MATTER AND WOULD LIKE TO REMAIN IN CONSULTATION AS DECISIONS DEVELOP. HE EMPHASIZED AGAIN THAT PRINCIAPL IRANIAN CONCERN IS TO PRECLUDE SOVIET HEGEMONY OVER ENTIRE HORN OF AFRICA.

DURING DISCUSSIONS HORN OF AFRICA OCTOBER 9 WITH FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY, HE EXPRESSED IRANIAN CONCERN ABOUT POTENTIAL CONSEQUENCES OF JAL HIJACKING AND RELEASE OF RED ARMY TERRORISTS. HE SAID HE HAD DISCUSSED SUBJECT WITH SHAH AND HAD BEEN AUTHORIZED TO RAISE SOME TENTATIVE IDEAS WITH ME IN ORDER OBTAIN YOUR VIEWS.

THESE IDEAS STEM FROM UN FRUSTRATION OF ORIGINAL WEST GERMAN PROPOSAL FOR AN INTERNATIONAL CONVENTION ON TERRORISM. IRAN ACCEPTS THE FACT THAT, FOR THE CURRENT MOMENT, IT WILL BE IMPOSSIBLE TO SECURE ADEQUATE UNGA SUPPORT TO MAKE SUCH A UN CONVENTION POSSIBLE.

KHALATBARY WOULD LIKE TO EXPLORE, HOWEVER, THE IDEA OF AN AGREEMENT TO BE DISCUSSED AMONG THOSE COUNTRIES FAVORING COOPERATION AGAINST TERRORISM. HE CONCEIVES OF SUCH A DOCUMENT TO BE SIGNED ORIGINALLY AMONG STATES WHICH CAN REACH A CONSENSUS, LEAVING IT OPEN-ENDED FOR FURTHER SIGNATURES LATER AND FOR EVENTUAL ADOPTION AND SANCTION BY THE UN.

IN KHALATBARY'S VIEW, SUCH A DOCUMENT WOULD CONTAIN SEVERAL FEATURES: (A) IT WOULD DEFINE TERRORISM AS A CRIME, RATHER THAN AN ACCEPTABLE POLITICAL ACTION. (B) ALL SIGNATORIES WOULD DENY THE RIGHT OF ASYLUM TO ANY TRRORISTS, NO MATTER WHAT THEIR POLITICAL CAUSE. (C) ALL SIGNATORIES WOULD UNDERTAKE TO REFUSE TO ENTER INTO NEGOTIATIONS WITH, OR MAKE CONCESSIONS TO TERRORISTS.

KHALATBARY ADMITS THAT POINT 4(C) MIGHT PROVE VERY DIFFICULT TO SELL INTERNATIONALLY, BUT SUGGESTS THAT GERMAN AND JAPANESE GOVERNMENTS, IF BOUND INTERNATIONALLY BY SUCH A COMMITMENT, MIGHT BE ABLE TO RESIST DOMESTIC PRESSURES WHICH CONTRIBUTE TO SUCCESS OF TERRORIST MOVEMENTS.

ACTION REQUESTED: KHALATBARY INTENDS DISCUSS THIS PROPOSAL WITH OTHER FRIENDLY GOVERNMENTS, INCLUDING GERMAN AND JAPANESE. BEFORE DOING SO, HE WOULD VALUE YOUR VIEWS ON HIS IDEA, AND WOULD APPRECIATE HAVING THEM SOONEST.

DURING DISCUSSION OF HORN OF AFRICA OCTOBER 9, FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY SAID THAT IRANIAN EMBASSY IN ADDIS ABABA WAS COMPLAINING ABOUT DETERIORATING SECURITY IN CITY. THEY REPORT THAT SEVERAL EMBASSIES HAVE RECENTLY BEEN BURGLARIZED AND THAT ETHIOPIAN GOVERNMENT SAYS IT HAS NO RESOURCES TO IMPROVE SITUATION. ACCORDING IRANIAN EMBASSY, SEVERAL MISSIONS ARE REDUCING STAFF AND SOME ARE CLOSING.

KHALATBARY ASKED FOR U.S. ASSESSMENT OF SECURITY SITUATION IN ADDIS AND WHETHER WE ARE CONTEMPLATING ANY FURTHER REDUCTIONS IN OUR STAFF. I SAID I WOULD HAVE TO INQUIRE SINCE I WAS CURRENTLY UNINFORMED.
ACTION REQUESTED: PLEASE PROVIDE APPROPRIATE INFORMATION FOR REPLY TO FONMIN.

1977TEHRAN08959.subject: VP MUBARAK DELIVERS MESSAGE TO THE SHAH AS PART OF HIS TOUR IN THE AREA, VP MUBARAK MADE QUICK STOPOVER IN TEHRAN OCTOBER 5 AND DELIVERED MESSAGE

segments.text: AS PART OF HIS TOUR IN THE AREA, VP MUBARAK MADE QUICK STOPOVER IN TEHRAN OCTOBER 5 AND DELIVERED MESSAGE FROM PRESIDENT SADAT TO THE SHAH. EGYPTIAN AMBASSADOR SAWFAT DID NOT ACCOMPANY HIM. NEITHER EGYPTIAN AMBASSADOR NOR MFA SOURCES HAVE ANY COMMENT BEYOND OBVIOUS FACT THAT MESSAGE EXPLAINED EGYPTIAN POSITION REGARDING MIDDLE EAST SETTLEMENT EFFORTS.

1977TEHRAN08961.subject: IRANIAN FOREIGN MINISTER'S REMARKS ON MIDEAST, AWACS, PERSIAN GULF BEGIN UNCLASSIFIED

segments.text: AWACS, PERSIAN GULF BEGIN UNCLASSIFIED

UPON HIS RETURN FROM UN, FONMIN KHALATBARY TOLD PRESS IN BRIEF PLANESIDE INTERVIEW THAT IRAN IS WORRIED ABOUT THE DELICATE SITUATION IN THE MIDEAST, PARTICULARLY THE POSSIBILITY OF MORE ARMED CLASHES. IN REPLY TO A QUESTION ON THE SOVIET -U.S. MIDEAST STATEMENT, KHALATBARY SAID: "OBVIOUSLY THE AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE U.S. AND RUSSIA TO END THE MIDEAST PROBLEMS (SIC) IS A VERY POSITIVE STEP. IT HAS CREATED THE HOPE OF SOLVING THE MIDDLE EAST PROBLEM."

NO TRANSCRIPT OF INTERVIEW AVAILABLE, BUT BOTH FOREIGN LANGUAGE AND FARSI/PRESS CARRIED ITEMS FROM IT. OCT 5 IRANIAN NATIONAL RADIO ENGLISH-LANGUAGE BROADCAST HAD ENGLISH EXCERPT IN WHICH KHALATBARY WAS QUOTED AS BACKING "LEGITIMATE NATIONAL RIGHTS OF PALESTINIANS".
COMMENTING ON THE AWACS SALE, KHALATBARY SAID SECRETARY VANCE HAD QUOTED PRESIDENT CARTER AS THOROUGHLY APPROVING THE DEAL, AND ADDED, "I EXPECT IT TO GO THROUGH".

KHALATBARY SAID THE OMANI FOREIGN MINISTER HAD TRIED TO ARRANGE A MEETING OF PERSIAN GULF FOREIGN MINISTERS IN NEW YORK BUT IT WAS POSTPONED BECAUSE OF TIGHT SCHEDULING. END UNCLASSIFIED BEGIN CONFIDENTIAL

COMMENT: MFA HAS CONFIRMED TO US THAT WORDING RE PALESTINIANS IS LONG-STANDING IRANIAN FORMULATION DATING FROM COMMUNIQUE ISSUED AT END OF SADAT VISIT IN JUNE 1976. DIRECTOR GENERAL NAYERI CONFIDED TO DCM THAT, WHILE IRAN HAS TO ASSUME PRO-ARAB COLORATION IN SUCH PUBLIC STATEMENTS, THIS BY NO MEANS CHANGES PRIVATE GOI POSITION--WHICH HAS BEEN CONVEYED TO US BY THE SHAH IN THE PAST--DISAPPROVING OF THE CREATION OF ANY INDEPENDENT PALESTINIAN STATE ON THE WEST BANK AS LIKELY TO BE UNSTABLE AND DANGEROUS TO AREA PEACE.

1977TEHRAN09001.subject: INFCE: US VIEWS ON FINAL COMMUNIQUE OF ORGANIZING CONFERENCE

segments.text: DCM IN MEETING WITH DR. ETEMAD MORNING OF OCTOBER 12 PROVIDED HIM WITH THE TEXT OF OUR PRELIMNARY DRAFT FOR A FINAL COMMUNIQUE OF THE INFCE ORGANIZING CONFERENCE. AFTER READING, ETEMAD REMARKED THAT IT SEEMED SUFFICIENTLY BLAND AND NON-CONTROVERSIAL AND THAT HE HAD "NO TROUBLE" WITH IT.
REF TEHRAN 8938 (RPTD BONN)

FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY INFORMED ME OCTOBER 12 THAT HE HAD CALLED IN GERMAN AMBASSADOR EVENING OCTOBER 11 AND RAISED IDEA OF OPEN-ENDED ANTI-TERRORIST AGREEMENT AS DISCUSSED REFTEL. ACCORDING TO KHALATBARY, GERMAN REACTED POSITIVELY TO CONCEPT, INCLUDING PROVISION WHICH WOULD PROHIBIT SIGNATORIES FROM NEGOTIATIONS WITH TERRORISTS.
COMMENT: I WILL DISCUSS MATTER WITH MY GERMAN COLLEAGUE WHEN NEXT OPPORTUNITY ARISES.

ON OCT 12 PL COUNS BRIEFED MFA DIRECTOR GENERAL (FOR ASIA AND AFRICA) NAYERI ON PROSPECT OF MOVEMENT IN US RELATIONS WITH PDRY PER REFTEL. NAYERI MADE CAREFUL NOTES. HE CONFIRMED THAT IRANIAN GOVERNMENT HAS NO OBJECTIONS AND IN FACT SEES THIS AS STEP IN RIGHT DIRECTION. REFLECTING GOI'S CAUTION ON PDRY, NAYERI GAVE IT AS HIS PERSONAL OPINION THAT PDRY LEADERS ARE SINCERE NEITHER WITH THE SOVIETS NOR WITH THE SAUDIS BUT ARE SIMPLY PLAYING AND THEIR OWN INTERESTS. HE THOUGHT THESE INTERESTS MIGHT BE MORE PERSONAL THAN NATIONAL. HOWEVER, PDRY LEADERS ARE NOT FOOLS.

RECOGNIZING SAUDIS WITH FULL POCKETS AND GREAT HATE FOR COMMUNISM, PDRY LEADERS ARE HAPPY TO TAKE SAUDI HANDOUTS. NEVERTHELESS, HE NOTED REPORTS A FEW MONTHS AGO THAT PDRY AUTHORITIES HAD REMOVED DHOFARI REBELS FROM PROXIMITY TO OMANI FRONTIER AND APPEARED STILL TO BE SEALING THE BORDER AGAINST DHOFARI REBEL OPERATIONS IN OMANI TERRITORY. THUS, HE THOUGH, SOME MOVEMENT WAS POSSIBLE DESPITE CONTRARY SURFACE MANIFESTATIONS SUCH AS PRESIDENT RUBAYA ALI'S SPEECH TO UNGA.

1977TEHRAN09068.subject: PROSPECTS FOR ANOTHER GULF FONMINS CONF IN REPLY TO QUESTION DURING MEETING OCT 12 MFA DIR GEN NAYERI TOLD POLCOUNS THAT THERE HAD BEEN WHAT

segments.text: IN REPLY TO QUESTION DURING MEETING OCT 12 MFA DIR GEN NAYERI TOLD POLCOUNS THAT THERE HAD BEEN WHAT AMOUNTED TO AN INFORMAL RUMP MEETING OF GULF ARAB FONMINS IN NEW YORK AFTER FONMIN KHALATBARY HAD DEPARTED.
