1977TEHRAN09069.subject: REQUEST FOR DEPARTMENT ASSESSMENT OF CURRENT LIBYAN ROLE IN WESTERN NORTH AFRICA

segments.text: LIBYAN ROLE IN WESTERN NORTH AFRICA

DURING MEETING WITH POLCOUNS OCT 12 MFA DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR AFRICA AND ASIA NAYERI ASKED IF WE COULD PROVIDE HIM USG ESTIMATE OF REACTION TO CURRENT LIBYAN DIPLOMACY IN THE MAGHREB AREA. WITHOUT BEING SPECIFIC HE POSITED THAT LIBYANS HAVE TAKEN RENEWED INTEREST IN THE MAGHREB AND HAVE IMPROVED THEIR RELATIONS WITH TUNISIANS. ALGERIANS ARE CERTAINLY NOT HAPPY, HE THOUGH, BUT DID NOT KNOW MORE SPECIFICS OF ANY ALGERIAN REACTION TO THESE EFFORTS.
NAYERI WAS IRANIAN AMBASSADOR IN RABAT UP TO A YEAR AGO. WE WOULD APPRECIATE DEPARTMENT'S CURRENT ASSESSMENT IN RESPONSE TO HIS REQUEST AND WELCOME COMMENTS FROM OTHER ADDRESSEES.
REF ISFAHAN 021 (NOTAL) BEGIN UNCLASSIFIED

PRESS OCT 9 CARRIED STORIES OF DEMONSTRATIONS AT THE SHRINE OF SHAH ABDOL AZIM IN REY BY APPROXIMATELY 120 INDIVIDUALS WHO DISTRIBUTED LEAFLETS AND SHOUTED LOUDLY FOR THE RELEASE OF CONVICTED KILLER MEHDI HASHEMI AND OTHERS IMPLICATED IN KILLING OF AYATOLLAH SHAMSABADI OF ISFAHAN ABOUT A YEAR AGO (REFTEL). HASHEMI AND HIS COHORTS AS WELL AS DEMONSTRATORS ARE FOLLOWERS OF IMAM KHOMENI, NOW RESIDENT IN IRAQ, WHOSE BOOK,"THE IMMORTAL MARTYR" HAS ATTACKED IMAM HOSSEIN, THE THIRD IMAM OF THE MOSLEM SHIA SECT. GROUP CLAIMS RESPONSIBILITY FOR DEMONSTRATION LAST WEEK OUTSIDE ST.
MARIE'S CHURCH NEAR PARIS, AND WAS PRESUMABLY ALSO BEHIND UNSIGNED LETTER CALLING FOR RELEASE OF HASHEMI AND OTHERS SENT TO EMBASSY AND FORWARDED TO NEA/IRN IN EARLY JUNE.
PRESS REPORTS DEMONSTRATORS WERE DISPERSED AFTER FAILING TO ENLIST SUPPORT OF PILGRIMS TO SHRINE. END UNCLASSIFIED BEGIN CONFIDENTIAL

HIGHLY PLACED IRANIAN NATIONAL POLICE (INP) SOURCE TOLD EMBOFF THAT DEMONSTRATIONS TOOK PLACE OCT 5, AND THAT ABOUT 500 PEOPLE WERE INVOLVED. SOURCE CLAIMED WHOLE AFFAIR WAS FOLLOWED BY POLICE MOBILE TEAMS AND NO ONE WAS HELD. INP FEELS EFFORT WAS WORK OF MOSLEM FANATICS NOT RPT NOT CONNECTED TO MUJAHIDDIN TERRORIST GROUP. ANOTHER EMBASSY SOURCE AGREED WITH PRESS ACCOUNTS OF 120 INVOLVED AND ALSO SAID SOME 80 HAD BEEN ARRESTED BUT THEY MAY HAVE BEEN HELD ONLY TEMPORARILY. VARIOUS CLAIMS HAVE BEEN ADVANCED REGARDING SOURCES OF FOREIGN SUPPORT-SAUDI ARABIA AND IRAQ ARE COUNTRIES PRIMARILY NAMED.

THOUGH IRAQI CONNECTION THROUGH IMAM KHOMENI'S GROUP HAS BEEN NOTED BEFORE EMBASSY FINDS POSSIBILITY OF SAUDI CONNECTION SOMEWHAT REMOTE. IT IS CLEAR THAT ALL GOI SERVICES ARE WATCHING STEPPED UP RELIGIOUS DISSIDENT ACTIVITY SUCH AS THIS DEMONSTRATION AND UNIVERSITY ACTIVITY (REPORTED SEPTEL) WITH RENEWED VIGILANCE.

ON OCT 12 POLCOUNS VISITED MFA HEAD OF LEAGAL DEPT KAZEMI, WHO IS CHIEF IRANIAN LOS REP, AND DROPPED OFF COPY OF AMB RICHARDSON'S OCT 4 TESTIMONY. WHEN ASKED HOW HE VIEWED LOS CONF, KAZEMI REPLIED THAT AT LEAST CONF NOW HAS A DOCUMENT IN THE "INFORMAL COMPOSITIE NEGOTIATIONG TEXT" AROUND WHICH DISCUSSION CAN PROCEED. WHILE THIS DOCUMENT DRAFTED BY THE PRESIDENT AND THE "BARONS" OF THE CONFERENCE MIGHTNOT REFLECT THE POSITIONS OF ALL PRESENT, AT LEAST IT SHOULD FOCUS DISCUSSION.

KAZEMI PROMISED TO STUDY AMB RICHARDSON'S TESTIMONY, TOGETHER WITH HIS EARLIER PRESS CONFERENCE (STATE 169685), AND SEE IF HE WISHED TO MAKE ANY FURTHER COMMENTS FOR THE RECORD. FYI: KAZEMI REFUSED TO MAKE ANY COMMENTS ON US POSITION FOR THE RECORD. HE IS KNOWN TO FAVOR VIEW THAT CENTRAL SEABED AUTHORITY SHOULD PRECEDED ANY DEVELOPMENT, RATHER THAN THE OPPOSITE, BUT THAT IS HIS OWN PERSONAL POSITION AND NOT GOI'S. FOR THE MOMENT, HIGHER AUTHORITIES IN GOI HAVE NOT HAD OCCASION TO TAKE A DEFINITIVE STAND ON THE ISSUE. END FYI.

1977TEHRAN09080.subject: VOLATILE SYRIAN AND IRAQI ACTIVITIES IN KUWAIT

segments.text: DURING CONVERSATION WITH POLCOUNS OCT. 12 MFA DIRECTOR GENERAL NAYERI MENTIONED RECENT REPORTS HE HAD BEEN RECEIVING OF GREATER SYRIAN AND IRAQI ACTIVITIES IN KUWAIT WHICH APPARENTLY WERE CAUSING SOME KUWAITI CONCERN. NAYERI FOUND IT DIFFICULT TO BE VERY SPECIFIC BUT SAID HE THOUGHT THIS INVOLVED INCREASED ANTI-IRAQI PROPAGANDA THROUGH PRIVATELY CIRCULATED BULLETINS, ETC., BEING CARRIED OUT ON BEHALF OF SYRIA BY VARIET OF PALESTINIAN AND OTHER ELEMENTS IN KUWAIT. THIS HAD PROVOKED A STRENGTHENING OF IRAQI OFFICIAL OR NONOFFICIAL PRESENCE IN KUWAIT, AND THE KUWAITIS ARE WORRIED.

NAYERI SAID THIS INFORMATION DID NOT COME FROM KUWAITI EMBASSY HERE AND HE HAS NOT SEEN IRAQI AMBASSADOR FOR SOME TIME. WE ASSUME MOST LIKELY SOURCE IS IRANIAN MISSION IN KUWAIT OR PERHAPS SOME IRAQI INTERCEPTS. WELCOME COMMENT FROM DEPARTMENT OR INFO ADDRESSEES.
BEGIN UNCLASSIFIED

SUMMARY: MASKED STUDENTS SUNDAY OCT 9 BROKE WINDOWS AND BURNED A BUS DURING VIOLENT DEMONSTRATIONS INTENDED TO BRING ABOUT SECREGATION OF WOMEN STUDENTS. STUDENTS AND WOMEN'S ORGANIZATIONS HAVE PROTESTED THIS MOVE OF REACTIONARY MOSLEM STUDENTS, SUGGESTED THAT THE DEMONSTRATORS WERE NOT STUDENTS AT ALL, AND CALLED UPON STUDENTS TO RESIST "FORCES OF REACTION AND COUNTERREVOLUTION." END SUMMARY.

FARSI AND FOREIGN LANGUAGE PRESS WEDNESDAY OCT 12 CARRIED STORY OF DEMONSTRATIONS BY SOME 20 MASKED STUDENT EXTREMISTS WHO BROKE WINDOWS, DAMAGED THREE BUSES AND BURNED ANOTHER, AND THREATENED FEMALE STUDENTS WITH BODILY HARM IF THEY TRIED TO EAT AT SELF-SERVICE CAFETERIA IN MEN'S DORMITORY OR TO USE THE MEN'S BUS. LEAFLETS PASSED OUT CALLED UPON FEMALE STUDENTS TO PUT PRESSURE ON UNIVERSITY ADMINISTRATORS TO DEMAND A SEPARATE SELF-SERVIDE RESTAURANT AND A SEPARATE BUS.

FOLLOWING DEMONSTRATIONS, PRESS HAS GIVEN PROMINENCE TO STUDENT UNION AND WOMEN'S ORGANIZATION CRITICIZM OF DEMONSTRATORS AND THEIR MOTIVES. EDITORIAL COMMENT IN BOTH PERSIAN AND ENGLISH PAPERS HAS BEEN CRITICAL OF ATTEMPTS TO "THROW A NATION ON THE MARCH BACK INTO THE MIDDLE AGES". EDITORS, PROFESSORS, AND STUDENTS ALSO ARE DISTURBED THAT EVENTS COULD HAPPEN AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY, WHICH IS NATION'S OLDEST AND ACADEMIC LEADER IN MANY AREAS. PERSIAN "KEYHAN" SAID INCIDENT IS EVIDENCE THAT FORMULATION AND APPLICATION OF STUDENT SELECTION CRITERIA IS INADEQUATE. ONE STUDENT OPINED THAT DEMONSTRATORS WERE NOT REALLY STUDENTS OR THEY WOULD HAVE BEEN RECOGNIZED. END UNCLASSIFIED BEGIN CONFIDENTIAL

EMBOFFS HAVE TALKED TO SEVERAL PROFESSORS AND STUDENTS WITH KNOWLEDGE OF INCIDENTS. BELIEF OF BESTINFORMED IS THAT GROUP REPRESENTS FUNDAMENTALIST MOSLEM STUDENTS WHO "HAVE GONE OVERBOARD THIS TIME". POLICE AND FACULTY MEMBERS FAMILIAR WITH VARIETY OF VERY REACTIONARY MOSLEM GROUPS BELIEVE THIS IS RIGHT-WING FUNDAMENTALIST REACTION TO LOOSENING OF CONTROLS AND INCREASED DISSENT ------------------052040 160825Z /12 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 5006 SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 9082 OF LEFT (SEE REF B).

NEITHER POLICE NOR UNIVERSITY SOURCES BELIEVE DEMONSTRATORS ARE MEMBERS OF ISLAMIC MARXIST TERRORIST GROUP (ISLAMIC MARXISTS OF MUJAHIDDIN VARIETY ESCHEW OPEN CONFRONTATION OF THIS KIND WHICH WOULD MOST CERTAINLY BE WELCOMED BY SECURITY FORCES WHO HAVE TEMPORARILY LOST TRACK OF MUJAHIDDIN). BUT DO NOT RULE OUT POSSIBILITY THERE ARE LINKS. TWO FACULTY MEMBERS BELIEVE DEMONSTRATIONS OCCURRED AT THIS TIME BECAUSE NEW CHANCELLOR MOTAMEDI HAS DISCONTINUED SMALL DEPARTMENTAL LIBRARIES DOTTED AROUND CAMPUS WHICH NEW ADMINISTRATION FEELS HAVE BEEN CENTERS OF STUDENT DISSIDENCE. CLOSING OF LIBRARIES HAS IN EFFECT PUT STUDENTS "OUT IN THE STREETS" AND LED TO RECENT FUNDAMENTALIST RIPOSTE.

UNIVERSITY DEMONSTRATIONS, HOWEVER, ARE OLD HAT IN IRAN. WHAT IS NEW ABOUT THIS ONE IS FUNDAMENTALIST MOSLEM NATURE OF "ATTACKERS", AND PUBLICITY GOI AND PRESS HAVE GIVEN TO INCIDENT. FACULTY AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY BELIEVE INCIDENT WAS TOO LARGE AND OBVIOUS TO BE IGNORED (TRUE), SO PUBLICITY WAS INEVITABLE. MOREOVER, ACADEMICS AND PRESSMEN BELIEVE EVENTS OFFER GOI AND GROUPS SUCH AS STUDENT UNION AND WOMEN'S ORGANIZATION CHANCE TO BE SEEN AS DEFENDERS OF HUMAN RIGHTS. ONE FACULTY MEMBER TOLD EMBOFF SOME SMINISTRY OF EDUCATION OFFICIALS COULD HARDLY BELIEVE THEIR GOOD LUCK THAT FIRST MAJOR STUDENT-AUTHORITY CONFRONTATION WAS OVER CAUSE WHICH IS BOUND TO BE VERY UNPOPULAR WITH MAJORITY OF STUDENTS.

OTHER ACADEMICS NOTE THAT UNIVERSITYASSOCIATED MIDDLE CLASS, BOTH STUDENTS AND YOUNGER FACULTY, HAS NOT REALLY HERETOFORE COME FACE TO FACE WITH IMPLICATIONS OF RELIGIOUS REACTION TO GATHERING MOMENTUM OF MODERNIZATION OVER PAST SEVERAL YEARS. INCIDENT IS SEEN AS GOLDEN OPPORTUNITY FOR GOI TO REMIND THOSE WHO MIGHT BE INCLINED TO VEER LEFT IN THE UNIVERSITY ENVIRONMENT THAT THERE IS PERHAPS A LOT TO LOSE FROM A RELIGIOUS RESURGENCE AND THAT NOT ALL GAINS OF RECENT YEARS ARE NECESSARILY PERMANENT.

EMBASSY COMMENT: WHILE "SHOCK" NOTED PUBLICLY IS NOT AS LARGE AS PRESS REACTION WOULDINDICATE, THERE IS DEFINITELY A FEELING OF UNEASE ABOUT WHAT INCIDENTS PORTEND. WHILE NONE OF OUR IRANIAN SOURCES HAVE SUGGESTED IT WAS A GOVERMENT SET-UP, ONE DID SAY IT WOULD BE INSTRUCTIVE TO FIND OUT WHETHER BURNED BUS WAS AN OLD ONE OR A NEW ONE. (IT APPEARS TO HAVE BEENA RELATIVELY MODERN ONE). EVEN MORE CONVENTIONAL RADICALS DO NOT BELIEVE GOI WOULD HAVE TRIED TO ORCHESTRATE COMPLEX OPERATION LIKE THIS, AND THEY ARE LOOKING OVER THEIR SHOULDERS FOR FURTHER EVIDENCE OF FUNDAMENTALIST ACTIVITY.

GERMAN AMBASSADOR CONFIRMED TO ME OCTOBER 13 (PRIOR TO LATEST LUFTHANSA HIJACKING), THAT HE HAD RECEIVED FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY'S PROPOSALS FOR AN OPEN-ENDED INTERNATIONAL CONVENTION ON TERRORISM. HOWEVER, KHALATBARY HAD NOT BEEN QUITE SO SPECIFIC ABOUT ITS PROVISIONS AS HE HAD WITH ME.
NEVERTHELESS, KHALATBARY HAD STRESSED OBJECTIVE OF PRECLUDING NEGOTIATIONS WITH TERRORISTS AND AMBASSADOR HAS FORWARDED THIS PROPOSAL TO BONN.

IRANIAN DELEGATION WILL BE LED BY GHASSEM ARABIAN, DEPUTY TO AEOI PRESIDENT AND CHIEF OF NUCLEAR FUEL, ENERGY SOURCES, EXPLORATION, AND RECOVERY OFFICE IN AEOI. OTHER DELEGATES ARE MEHDI BALOOCH AND EHSANOLAH ZIAII, BOTH OF THE SAME OFFICE AS ARABIAN.
DR ARABIAN WILL HANDCARRY CREDENTIALS LETTER TO CONFERENCE OFFICER.
MINISTER AHMADI PRESENTED THREE MORE MINISTRY OF AGRICULTURE AND RURAL DEVELOPMENT UNDERSECRETARIES TO THE SHAH ON OCTOBER 13, BRINGING TOTAL NUMBER TO NINE.

ABDOLLAH MANSOUR IS ENCHARGED WITH PARLIAMENTARY AFFAIRS. MANSOUR HOLDS DEGREES FROM UTAH STATE AND COLUMBIA UNIVERSITY. PREVIOUSLY HE WAS BUDGET DIRECTOR OF THE AGRICULTURAL MINISTRY, DEPUTY DIRECTOR OF THE PASTURES DEVELOPMENT FUND, AND VICE PRESIDENT OF THE AGRICULTURAL DEVELOPMENT BANK OF IRAN.

AMIR-HOUSHANG BORHAN IS RESPONSIBLE FOR RESEARCH AND EDUCATIONAL AFFAIRS. BORHAN HOLDS A DOCTORATE IN AGRICULTURAL ENGINEERING FROM A BRITISH UNIVERSITY. FORMERLY HE WAS DIRECTOR OF MINISTRY'S AGRICULTURAL DEVELOPMENT ORGANIZATION, AGRO TECHNIQUE.

FIROUZ MAHDAVI IS UNDERSECRETARY FOR FIELD CROPS AND AGRICULTURAL AFFAIRS. MAHDAVI HOLDS AGRICULTURAL DEGREES FROM VARIOUS AMERICAN AND IRANIAN UNIVERSITIES. MOST RECENTLY HE WAS DEPUTY-DIRECTOR OF AGRICULTURE'S RESEARCH ORGANIZATION AND DIRECTOR GENERAL OF THE SOILS INSTITUTE. HE ALSO HAD BEEN DIRECTOR OF THE SOIL FERTILIZATION PROJECT OF THE KHUZESTAN DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY AND CHIEF ADVISOR TO THE UN ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION PROGRAM.

1977TEHRAN09143.subject: MORE ON TEHRAN UNIV STUDENT DISTRUBANCES

segments.text: BEGIN UNCLASSIFIED
WEEKEND OCT 15-16 SAW REACTION TO OCT 9 FUNDAMENTALIST MOSLEM DISTURBANCES AT TEHRAN UNIV EXPAND TO INCLUDE COMMENTS FROM SHA , IRANIAN WOMEN'S ORGANIZATION AND STUDENTS.

IN REMARKS TO PARLIAMENTARY LEADERS SHAH LASHED OUTT "TRAITOROUS, ANTI-REVOLUTIONARY AND REGRETTABLE INCIDENTS" AND CALLED THEM REACTIONARY ABUSES OF CIVIL LIBERTIES. HE CONTRASTED BEHAVIOR OF DEMONSTRATORS WITH POPULAR PARTICIPATION HE HAD CALLED FOR TO SHAPE IRANIAN REVOLUTION, AND SAID GOAL OF SUCH DEMONSTRATORS WAS TO SET THE COUNTRY BACK "NOT ONLY TO PREREVOLUTIONARY TIMES, BUT ALSO TO CIRCUMSTANCES PREVALENT 1,500 TO 2,000 YEARS AGO". SHAH REFERRED TO EXTERNAL SUPPORT FOR REACTIONARY MEASURES, AND REMARKED, "HOW COORDINATED THESE INTERNAL AND EXTERNAL DEVELOPMENTS ARE*"

SHAH'S COMMENT WAS LEAD STORY IN OCT 17 FARSI AND FOREIGN LANGUAGE PAPERS, WHICH ALSO NOTED FOUR HOUR SIT IN AT TEHRAN UNIV DORMITORIES AT AMIRABAD CAMPUS TO PROTEST DEMONSTRATORS' DESIRE FOR SEGREGATION. DEMONSTRATION WAS ENDED WHEN UNIV AUTHORITIES PLEDGED TO PREVENT FURTHER INCIDENTS SIMILAR TO THOSE REPORTED REFTEL.

OCT 17 MEDIA ALSO REPORTED WOMEN'S ORGANIZATION OF IRAN'S TEHRAN UNIV CHAPTER CALL FOR ALL FEMALE STUDENTS TO RESIST FIERCELY "ANY ATTEMPT BY COUNTERREVOLUTIONARY ELEMENTS TO REVIVE PRACTICES OF THE DARK AGES". IN RESPONSE, UNIV AUTHORITIES PROMISED TO GUARANTEE SAFETY OF ALL STUDENTS, ESPECIALLY WOMEN. END UNCLASSIFIED BEGIN CONFIDENTIAL

ADVERSE REACTION TO EXTREMISTS' ATTEMPTS TO SEGREGATE TEHRAN UNIV ENTIRELY PREDICTABLE. WHAT IS NOTEWORTHY IS THAT GOVT POLICY AND GENUINE FEELINGS OF MAJORITY OF STUDENTS COINCIDE ON THIS ISSUE. NUMBER OF STUDENTS EMBOFF HAVE TALKED TO ON CASUAL BASIS OVER PAST WEEK CONSIDER RELIGIOUS EFFORTS TO "PERSUADE" UNIVERSITIES TO REVERT TO CENTURIES OLD MOSLEM PRACTICES ARE GREATER THREAT TO THEIR WELL BEING THAN SOMETIMES HEAVY HANDED GOVT POLICIES. UNTIL RECENTLY, GOI HAS BEEN THE "HEAVY" ON UNIV SCENE; NOT OTHER CANDIDATES APPEAR TO BE EMERGING.

GENERAL AZHARI HAS ONCE AGAIN ASKED ME WHAT PROGRESS YOU HAVE MADE IN FINDING A CIVIL MOBILIZATION EXPERT TO ACT AS ADVISER TO IRANIAN GOVERNMENT. HE STRESSED NEED FOR THIS TYPE OF ADVICE RATHER THAN "COMMON SENSE" ADVISERS ON CIVIL DEFENSE.
IT MAY BE THAT ONLY EXPERTS IN U.S. STABLE ARE WORLD WAR II VINTAGE. THERE MAY PERHAPS BE PRESTIGIOUS FIGURES FROM THAT ERA STILL EXTANT WHO WOULD BE PREPARED UNDERTAKE THIS PROJECT.
SUGGEST YOU ATTEMPT URGENTLY OBTAIN NAMES OF SOME CANDIDATES WHOM I MIGHT BE ABLE INTERVIEW DURING MY STAY IN WASHINGTON FOR STATE VISIT.

UNDERSECRETARY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS ZELLI CALLED ME FOR FOREIGN MINISTRY AFTERNOON OCTOBER 17 TO DISCUSS IRANIAN PERCEPTIONS OF EAST AFRICA. HE SAID MINISTRY WAS COMING TO CONCLUSION THAT KENYA WAS RUNNING OUT OF STEAM AND THAT TANZANIA MIGHT BE ASSUMING MORE IMPORTANT ROLE.

ZELLI BASED HIS OBSERVATIONS LARGELY ON PERSONALITIES. HE SAID THAT KENYATTA WAS OBVIOUSLY NOT LONG FOR THE SCENE AND THERE APPEARED TO BE NO VIABLE SUCCESSOR. HE WORRIED THAT KENYA MIGHT SINK INTO MORASS OF INTERNAL BICKERING, CORRUPTION, AND CONFUSION.
AT SAME TIME, IRANIANS WERE IMPRESSED WITH NEW STATURE THAT NYERERE SEEMED TO HAVE ACHIEVED, BOTH WITHIN AFRICA AND WITH WEST. IT SEEMED POSSIBLE HE WOULD BECOME THE NEW LEADER OF THE REGION.

ZELLI POINTED OUT THAT IRAN HAD EMBASSY IN NAIROBI BUT NOT REPRESENTATION IN DAR ES SALAAM. FOREIGN MINISTRY WAS PROPOSING IDEA OF OPENING EMBASSY IN DAR ES SALAAM, BUT BEFORE PRESENTING IDEA TO SHAH, WOULD VALUE DEPARTMENT'S ASSESSMENT OF EAST AFRICAN SITUATION.

ACTION REQUESTED: PLEASE PROVIDE COMMENT ON IRANIAN PERCEPTIONS REGARDING SHIFT IN CENTER OF POLITICAL GRAVITY IN EAST AFRICA, AS WELL AS ASSESSMENT OF TANZANIAN PROSPECTS FOR ASSUMING LEADERSHIP ROLE IN THAT REGION.
REF STATE 244292 INTSUM 416 OF OCTOBER 5 WAS RECEIVED IN TEHRAN. THANKS.

SUMMARY: BEGIN CONFIDENTIAL: THE SHAH ANNOUNCED OCTOBER 15 THAT THE SYSTEM OF FIVE YEAR DEVELOPMENT ECONOMIC PLANS AS KNOWN HERETOFORE WILL BE ABOLISHED. SENIOR GOI OFFICIALS CONFIRMED THE SHAH'S NEW DIRECTIVE FOR STUDY AND IDENTIFICATION OF LONG-TERM NATIONAL OBJECTIVES. IT IS NOT YET CLEAR WHETHER OR NOT A NATIONAL OBJECTIVES PLAN DOCUMENT WILL EMERGE OR WHETHER IT WILL GO THE THE PARLIAMENT FOR DEBATE AND ENACTMENT. BEST INFORMATION SUGGESTS THAT THE NEXT ECONOMIC DOCUMENT WILL BE THE 2537 BUDGET, WHICH SHOULD APPEAR IN EARLY 1978.

THE FAILURE TO RECONCILE THE PRESENTLY-IDENTIFIED WIDE GAP BETWEEN AGGREGATE RESOURCE REQUIREMENTS AND LOWER ACTUAL CAPACITIES, AS COULD HAVE OCCURRED IN A SIXTH PLAN PROCESS, DIMINISHES CONSIDERABLY PROSPECTS FOR SHORT-TERM SOLUTIONS TO ECONOMIC IMBALANCES AND UNHEALTHY TRENDS. END SUMMARY.

BEGIN UNCLASSIFIED. THE SHAH, IN AN AUDIENCE OCTOBER 15 WITH PARLIAMENTARY LEADERSHIP, ANNOUNCED THAT THE PAST SYSTEM OF ECONOMIC PLANNING FOR FIVE YEARS WILL BE ABOLISHED AND YEARLY PLANS WILL BE PREPARED INSTEAD. NEWSPAPER ACCOUNTS REPORTED HIS REASONING THAT WHEREAS IN THE PAST SOME PROJECTS HAVE LINGERED AS MUCH AS TEN YEARS EITHER BECAUSE OF NEGLIGENCE OR MISCALCULATION, BY WORKING WITH A YEAR TO YEAR BUDGET OR SPECIAL LEGISLATION THE COUNTRY WILL HAVE A BALANCE SHEET AT THE END OF THE YEAR AND CAN PLAN FOR THE NEXT YEAR WITH A MORE ACCURATE KNOWLEDTE OF THE STATE OF AFFAIRS. END UNCLASSIFIED.

BEGIN CONFIDENTIAL: SOURCES IN THE PLAN AND BUDGET ORGANIZATION (PBO) REPORT THAT NO DISCUSSIONS HAVE OCCURRED ON A CABINET OR INTER-AGENCY BASIS CONCERNING THE SIXTH PLAN SINCE THE GOVERNMENT CHANGED AUGUST 7. WORK ON THE SIXTH PLAN HAD BUILT TO A CLIMAX OVER TWO YEARS BY JULY WHEN AN ENORMOUS GAP DEVELOPED BETWEEN PBO-IDENTIFIED NATIONAL RESOURCES FOR 1978-1983 AND DEVELOPMENT PLANS ADVANCED BY THE MINISTRIES. THE REPORTED CAP BETWEEN RESOURCES AND MINISTERIAL PROJECTS REACHED 200-300 PERCENT. IN THE SUCCEEDING MONTHS, A PRIME REASON FOR THE ABSENCE OF ATTENTION TO THE SIXTH PLAN WAS FOUND IN THE NEW CABINET, WHICH REQUIRED TIME TO IDENTIFY ITS SECOND LEVEL AND LEARN THE JOB.

YET THERE WAS SPECULATION THAT THE PLAN, HERETOFORE EXPECTED IN OCTOBER , MIGHT BE A TEN YEAR PLAN OR THAT THE CURRENT FIFTH PLAN MIGHT BE EXTENDED FOR SEVERAL YEARS IN ORDER TO ACCOMPLISH MORE OF ITS OBJECTIVES.

PBO SOURCES SAY THAT PBO MINISTER YEGANEH IS GIVEN TO DETAIL AND DOES NOT CONVEY CLEARLY A SENSE OF DIRECTION; FURTHER, THE PBO CONTINUES TO FUNCTION UNDER THE STIGMA OF A PERCEIVED DISCREDITING BY THE SHAH. NONE OF THE UNDERSECRETARIES HAS BEEN REMOVED AS YET BUT SOURCES SPEAK OF A CONTINUING UNCERTAINLY OF THEIR POSITION AND PBO'S OVERALL ROLE. FOR EXAMPLE, THE SHAH'S INITIAL INTENT TO TRANSFER THE BUDGET FUNCTION TO MINISTER ANSARY'S PROTFOLIO WAS RESCINDED, BUT NEITHER IS IT CERTAIN TI WILL STAY AT PBO. IN RECENT WEEKS, PBO LEADERSHIP DID LEARN THAT THE NEW THRUST, PRESUMABLY FROM THE SHAH, WAS TO IDENTIFY LONG-TERM "NATIONAL OBJECTIVES" (E.G.

YEAR 2000) AND, HAVING DONE THAT, SECTORAL AND INTRA-SECTORAL GOALS WERE TO BE IDENTIFIED AND PROJECTS SUBJECTED TO PROGRAM EVALUATION REVIEW TECHNIQUE METHODOLOGY. PBO APPARAENTLY WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR THIS.

WHAT EMERGES FROM OUR SENIOR LEVEL PBO AND MINISTRY QUERIES IS THAT DEVELOPMENT PLANNING AS REPRESENTED HERETOFORE IN PARLIAMENTARYAPPROVED FIVE OR SEVEN YEAR AUTHORIZATIONS HAS BEEN ABONDONED. WHETH ER OR NOT THE PBO PRODUCES A DOCUMENT ON ECONOMIC OBJECTIVES AS A GUIDE AND WHETHER THAT DOCUMENT RECEIVES PARLIAMENTARY APPROVAL IS NOT KNOWN AND SOURCES SAY THESE ISSUES ARE NOW UNDER DISCUSSION. IN ANY CASE, NO PLAN SHOULD BE EXPECTED, AS ANTICIPATED, IN OCTOBER NOR IS IT LIKFELY THAT NAY DOCUMENT WILL EMERGE BEFORE THE 2537 BUDGET, WHIC H NORMALLY APPEARS IN JANUARY.

THE SHAH IN HIS OCTOBER 15 AUDIENCE IDENTIFIED AS A REASON FOR REJECTION OF THE TRADITIONAL PLANNING CONCEPT THE INABILITY TO COMPLETE ALL PROJECTS WITHIN A FIVE YEAR SPAN. IT IS THIS, PERHAPS UNNECESSARILY, BUILT-IN FRUSTRATION WHICH IS APPARENTLY SEEN AS THE SOURCE OF OVER-COMMITMENT OF RESOURCES WHICH IS FEEDING INFLATION AND BASIC DISEQUILIBRIUM IN THE ECONOMY.

COMMENT: THE FUTURE ROLE OF CENTRAL PLANNING IS NOT KNOWN. MORAL E IN PBO'S PLANNING BUREAUS IS UNDERSTANDABLY AT A LOW POINT, GIVEN ------------------079322 181135Z /14 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 5084 SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 9221 THE REJECTION OF THE SIXTH PLAN CONCEPT. NONETHELESS, AS AN UNDERSECRETARY IN THE MINISTRY OF ECONOMIC AFFAIRS AND FINANCE CONCEDED, ONLY PBO CAN PROVIDE THE "FRESH LOOK" AT DEVELOPMENT PROGRESS AND RECOMMEND CONTINUATION, STRETCHOUT OR MODIFICATIONS OF INDIVIDUAL PROJECTS IN ORDER TO ACHIEVE BETTER BALANCE WITHIN EXISTING CAPACITIES BECAUSE ONLY PBO HAS THE BROAD VIEW CAPACITY.

BUT PROSPECTS FOR ACHIEVING THIS "FRESH VIEW" IN TIME TO AFFECT THE 2537 BUDGET ARE DIM. THE AMOUZEGAR GOVERNMENT HAS NOT YET HAD TIME TO COME TO GRIPS WITH BASIC PROBLEMS AND THUS IN RECENT MONTHS THE GOVERNMENT CONVEYED A STATE OF PARALYSIS IN ECONOMIC POLICY. BY FAILING TO RESOLVE THE FUNDAMENTAL ISSUE WHICH EMERGED IN JUNE/JULY, I.E. THE TREMENDOUS GAP BETWEEN ASPIRATIONS AND IDENTIFIED RESOURCES, PRESENT IMBALANCES AND TRENDS ARE EFFECTIVELY EXTENDED FOR THE SHORT-RUN.

THE INVOLVEMENT OF THE PLANNING FUNCTION WITH THE BUDGET PROCESS IS ESSENTIAL. BUT WHILE GENERALLY SEEN AS NOW ABSENT IN THE SHORT-RUN, ITS ROLE IN THE MEDIUM TO LONG TERM MAY BE MORE PROMISING. A DISCREDITING OF PLANNING BECAUSE OF PRESENT PROBLEMS MAY INITIALLY HAVE BEEN AA EASY REACTION TO FRUSTRATING ECONOMIC CONDITIONS BUT MAY NOW BE SEEN AS AN UNWISE DISCREDITING OF A CONCEPT--COORDINATED PLANNING--RATHER THAN INSTITUTIONAL FACTORS. THE PRESENT IMBALANCES AND RECENT RECORD OF RESOURCE DISSIPATION RESULTED LARGELY FROM MINISTERIAL CARTE BLANCHE IN THE 1974/75 PERIOD.

PBO'S RECORD IS NOT BLAMELESS IN ITS PROJECT SUPER VISION AND DECISIONS AMONG PROJECTS IN THE SUBSEQUENT PERIOD WHEN ITS POWERS WERE RESTORED OWING TO IRAN'S FINANCIAL CONSTRAINTS BUT THEN ITS TASK WAS DIFFICULT, IF NOT IMPOSSIBLE, GIVEN IRAN'S DECISION MAKING PROCESS AND THE MAGNITUDE OF RESOURCES ALREADY COMMITTED BY CONTRACTS. A POSTPONEMENT OF TOUGH RESOURCE ALLOCATION DECISIONS AND RESORT TO THE BUDGET (NOTABLY A PICEMEAL APPROACH) PROCESS TO ACHIEVE ECONOMIC POLICY AND BALANCED GROWTH AT LEAST IN THE SHORT-RUN IS UNFORTUNATE.

RESPECTIVE MINISTERIAL ASPIRATIONS, WITHIN THE COMPETITIVE POLITICAL AWARDS GAME, WILL CONTINUE TO HAVE REIGN, EXACERBATING THE PRESENT STRUCTURAL DISPARATIES AND RUINOUS TRENDS SUCH AS HIGH INFLATION, SPIRALING WAGES, LAGGING INVESTMENT AND DECLINING PRODUCTIVITY. IN ACTION IN PRESENT ECONOMIC CIRCUMSTANCES IS COSTLY AND EMBASSY AGREES WITH INFORMED CONTACTS THAT IT IS HIGH TIME FOR THE PRIME MINISTER, AND SPECIFICALLY PBO MINISTER YEGANEH, TO ACCEPT THE VARITIES OF CURRENT AND PROSPECTIVE ABSORPTIVE CAPACITIES AND FORCE DICISIONS, HOWEVER DIFFICULT POLITICALLY, FAVORING RESTRAINT AND BALANCE. END COMMENT.

1977TEHRAN09234.subject: TRAVEL OF MRS. JOHN C. NEWSOM

segments.text: REF STATE 249945
WE WILL BE DELIGHTED TO HAVE JEAN WITH US NOVEMBER 1. WILL MEET HER PLANE AND FILL HER WITH FILIPINIANA.

BECAUSE OF LONDON AIRPORT SLOWDOWN, EASTBOUND FLIGHTS ARE OFTEN LATE. WOULD STRONGLY RECOMMEND, IN THE INTERESTS OF A GOOD SLEEP BEFORE RESUMING TRAVEL, THAT JEAN PLAN STAY ONE FULL DAY AND DEPART THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 3, FOR HONG KONG.

MOHAMMAD REZA AHMAD-AKHOUNDI WHO HAD BEEN FOUND GUILTY OF PARTICIPATING IN THE MURDER OF EMBASSY EMPLOYEE HASSAN HOSNAN IN MID-1975 WAS EXECUTED MORNING OF OCT 17. 1977TEHRAN09317.subject: NEW BELGIAN AMBASSADOR IT HAS BEEN ANNOUNCED LOCALLY THAT NEW BELGIAN AMBASSADOR, MARCEL VAN DE KERCKHOVE, WILL BE ARRIVING BEFORE T

segments.text: IT HAS BEEN ANNOUNCED LOCALLY THAT NEW BELGIAN AMBASSADOR, MARCEL VAN DE KERCKHOVE, WILL BE ARRIVING BEFORE THE END OF THE MONTH. HE IS IDENTIFIED AS CURRENTLY WORKING AS DEPUTY SECRETARY GENERAL IN THE MFA IN BRUSSELS. HE WAS BELGIAN AMBASSADOR IN BAGHDAD 1970-74. PRIOR TO THAT HIS POSTS INCLUDED GENEVA, CAIRO, KINSHASA, JIDDA, AND ROME. WOULD APPRECIATE ANY BIOGRAPHIC BACKGROUND FROM ADDRESSEES.

BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND I WERE CALLED IN BY COURT MINISTER HOVEYDA AFTERNOON OCTOBER 20 FOR DISCUSSION ON RHODESIA. HOVEYDA SAID SHAH HAD RECEIVED BISHOP MUZOREWA THAT MORNING AND HAD BEEN GIVEN THREE REQUESTS.

MUZOREWA WANTED (A) "RECOGNITION" OF HIS MOVEMENT, (B) MILITARY TRAINING FOR 43 RPT 43 MEN, AND (C) MONEY. SHAH HAD REPLIED THAT HE WOULD HAVE TO EXAMINE REQUESTS TO SEE IF THEY FELL WITHIN FRAMEWORK OF ANGLO-AMERICAN PROPOSALS.

BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND I BOTH QUESTIONED WHAT WAS MEANT BY "RECOGNITION", SINCE WE ASSUMED THAT MUZOREWA WOULD HAVE TO BE TREATED AS PART OF COMPOSITE AFRICAN GROUP IN FRAMEWORK ANGLO-AMERICAN PLAN. WE WERE ALSO INTRIGUED BY SPECIFIC REQUEST FOR TRAINING OF 43 MEN, AND WONDERED WHY THAT NUMBER WAS USED (HOVEYDA THOUGHT MAYBE THAT WAS ALL THE BISHOP HAD). WE ALL AGREED THAT THE MOST IMPORTANT OF THE THREE REQUESTS WAS FOR MONEY.

IN GENERALLY UNINFORMED CONVERSATION, WE SPECULATED THAT MUZOREWA WAS ATTEMPTING BUILD UP A GROUP WHICH WOULD ENABLE HIM TO HAVE A SHARE IN THE ZIMBABWE ARMY WHEN IT IS TO BE FORMED. WE DOUBTED HE WAS PROPOSING TO DEVELOP A TRULY INDEPENDENT MILITARY FORCE. BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND I AGREED TO QUERY OUR CAPITALS FOR REACTIONS TO PROVIDE THE SHAH.
ACTION REQUESTED: PLEASE CONCERT WITH BRITISH AND PROVIDE JOINT GUIDANCE TO BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND MYSELF SOONEST.

1977TEHRAN09329.subject: ACTIONS TO ENCOURAGE CONTINUED SOMALI OPPOSITION TO TERRORISM

segments.text: FOLLOWING OUR SUGGESTION PER REFTEL COURT ADVISED US THAT SHAH SENT A MESSAGE TO PRESIDENT SIAD BARRE OCTOBER 20 COMMENDING HIM ON HIS COOPERATION IN LUFTHANSA TERRORIST INCIDENT. IT NOT PRESENTLY KNOWN WHETHER THIS MESSAGE WILL BE MADE PUBLIC.

FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY ASKED ME ON OCTOBER 22 WHETHER I COULD GIVE HIM ANY INSIGHTS INTO CURRENT POLITICAL SITUATION IN PORTUGAL. HE SAID HE HAD MET WITH PORTUGUESE FOREIGN MINISTER AT UNGA AND HAD GAINED IMPRESSION LATTER EXPECTED REMAIN IN GOVERNMENT INDEFINITELY. HE WAS THEREFORE SURPRISED BY NEWS OF HIS RECENT RESIGNATION.
ACTION REQUESTED: REQUEST DEPT AND LISBON REPEAT TO TEHRAN COPIES OF ANY MESSAGES OF ANALYSIS WHICH MIGHT BE USEFUL IN BRIEFING IRANIANS.

REF STATE 62422 AFTER EXTENDED CONSULTATION WITH BRITISH, FRENCH, AND FEDREP EMBASSIES HERE, WE WERE CHOSEN TO MAKE PRESENTATION TO GOI ON BERLIN. POL COUNS PASSED COPY OF BRIEFING PAPER TO MFA DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR POLITICAL AFFAIRS (EUROPE AND AMERICA) SEPAHBODI OCT 23. SEPAHBODI WAS GIVEN BACKGROUND OF THE PROJECT, AND IT WAS EXPLAINED TO HIM THAT WE WISHED TO KEEP THE EXERCISE CONFIDENTIAL SO AS NOT TO CREATE THE IMPRESSION THAT THE WESTERN SIDE WAS EMBARKING ON ANY SPECIAL CAMPAIGN AGAINST SOVIET INTERESTS. SEPAHBODI ASSURED US PAPER WOULD BE PASSED TO FOREIGN MINISTER FORTHWITH AND KEPT IN CONFIDENCE.
REF STATE 254586

BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND I HAVE SEPARATELY CONVEYED TO COURT MINISTER HOVEYDA GUIDANCE PROVIDED REFTEL CONCERNING REQUESTS RAISED BY BISHOP MUZOREWA. WE LAID PARTICULAR EMPHASIS UPON DESIRABILITY AVOIDING MILITARY TRAINING OF HIS "FORCES".

HOVEYDA TOLD ME HE WOULD PROPOSE THAT IRANIANS OFFER TO TRAIN MUZOREWA'S PEOPLE IN SOME TECHNICAL COMPETENCE OTHER THAN MILITARY. I HAVE THE IMPRESSION IRAN WOULD BE HAPPY TO HAVE THESE PEOPLE HERE IN ORDER TO GAIN THROUGH THEM A BETTER INSIGHT INTO RHODESIAN FUTURE.

1977TEHRAN09434.subject: HUMAN RIGHTS: PRISONER TOTALS, MILITARY COURT

segments.text: REFORM, RD CROSS VISIT
MORNING OCT. 25 MFA FOURTH POLITICAL (AMERICAN) DEPARTMENT HEAD MOHSEN GOODARZI PROVIDED EMBOFF WITH FOLLOWING INFORMATION IN RESPONSE TO EARLIER QUERIES

POLITICAL PRISONERS: GOODARZI, REFERRING AT ALL TIMES TO "COMMUNISTS AND TERRORISTS, INCLUDING SPIES", SAID IN CALENDAR YEAR 1976 THERE WERE ABOUT 3700 PRISONERS IN JAIL UNDER ANTI-SECURITY LEGISLATION. IN 1976 AND 1977, APPROXIMATELY 1600 PRISONERS WERE PARDONED, OR THEIR TERMS OF CONFINEMENT EXPIRED AND THEY WERE RELEASED. THUS FAR IN CALENDAR YEAR 1977, ABOUT 300 HAVE BEEN ARRESTED OR DETAINED UNDER ANTI-SECURITY LAW. OF THESE, NOT QUITE HALF HAVE HAD THEIR CASES DISPOSED OF, EITHER BY RELEASE OR CONVICTION, OTHER HALF, OR JUST OVER 150, WILL BE TRIED UNDER NEW PROVISIONS OF MILITARY COURT REFORM LEGISLATION.

GOODARZI ADDED THERE WERE ABOUT 2200 PRISONERS REMAINING IN JAIL UNDER PROVISIONS OF ANTISECURITY LEGISLATION. HE SAID THAT GOI WAS UNABLE TO BE MORE SPECIFIC BECAUSE OF CASES UNDERWAY AND RELEASES TAKING PLACE PERIODICALLY. WHEN ASKED IF THESE STATISTICS COULD BE ATTRIBUTED TO GOI, GOODARZE HESITATED, THEN AGREED THAT THEY COULD BE, IF SOME OMNIBUS PHRASE SUCH AS "INFORMATION BASED ON GOI AND OTHER SOURCES...." WERE USED WHICH WOULD PREVENT SPECIFIC IDENTIFICATION OF EXACT FIGURES WITH GOI. (EMBASSY COMMENT: 1600 FIGURE FOR 1976-77 RELEASES PRETTY CLOSE TO INDEPENDENT EMBASSY ESTIMATES OVER PAST YEAR, IF THIS YEAR'S SHAH'S BIRTHDAY GROUP COUNTED IN TOTAL.
GOI FIGURE OF 2200 PROBABLY OUGHT TO BE CONSIDERED AS 2200 PLUS OR MINUS 100.)
GOODARZI SAID TWO TERRORISTS HAVE BEEN EXECUTED AFTER TRIAL BY GOI IN CALENDAR YEAR 1977. HE DID NOT HAVE NAMES. (EMBASSY HAD THOUGHT ONLY ONE HAD BEEN EXECUTED).

MILITARY COURT REFORM: GOODARZI SAID LAW HAD BEEN PASSED AND APPROVED, BUT FINAL IMPLEMENTATION HAD BEEN DELAYED PENDING PREPARATION OF IMPLEMENTING REGULATIONS. NOW READY, REFORM PROVISIONS AND IMPLEMENTING REGULATIONS BECOME EFFECTIVE TOGETHER NOV. 7, 1977. NEW LAW INCLUDES PROVISIONS OUTLINED IN TEHRAN 5337. GOODARZI ADDED THAT ALL CIVIL LAWYERS ELIGIBLE TO PRACTICE LAW IN IRAN WILL ALSO BE ABLE TO PRACTICE BEFORE THE MILITARY COURTS IN ANTI-SECURITY CASES. TWO WEEKS WILL BE PERMITTED FOR DEFENDANT AND DEFENSE COUNSEL TO STUDY PROSECUTION FILE, AND BAIL/BOND WILL BE GRANTED IF COURT APPROVES. GOODARZI SAID COURTS WOULD BE "OPEN TO PUBLIC", UNLESS MAGISTRATE RULES FOR CLOSURE ON PROSECUTION MOTION.
LAW ALSO REQUIRED EXAMINING MAGISTRATE TO DISMISS OR INDICT WITHIN 24 HOURS OF ARREST. WHEN EFFECTIVE, LAW WILL APPLY TO ALL CASES STILL PENDING.

RED CROSS (ICRC) VISIT: GOODARZI CONFIRMED SECOND ICRC VISIT TO IRAN HAD ALREADY TAKEN PLACE AND WAS OVER. HE GAVE NO DETAILS AND WOULD NOT COMMENT FURTHER. GOODARZI NOTED ICRC WOULD BE MAKING REPORT TO GOI AND THAT, FOR THE MOMENT, NO ADDITIONAL VISITS WERE PROJECTED. FOR GENEVA: WOULD APPRECIATE ANY INFO YOU DEVELOP ON ICRC VISIT TO IRAN.

1977TEHRAN09510.subject: COMMENTS ON PROPOSED NOAA DIPLOMATIC NOTE, MEMORANDUM OF AGREEMENT, AND ANNEX TO MEMORANDUM

segments.text: UNITED STATES-IRAN TECHNICAL COOPERATION AGREEMENT ENABLES INDIVIDUAL AGENCIES OF THE RESPECTIVE GOVERNMENTS TO CONCLUDE COOPERATIVE AGREEMENTS WITH ONE ANOTHER. IN LIGHT OF THIS AGREEMENT EMBASSY FEELS IT NOT REPEAT NOT NECESSARY AT THIS TIME TO SEND NOTE TO MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS. SINCE ALL COOPERATIVE AGREEMENTS BETWEEN GOVERNMENT AGENCIES OF UNITED STATES OR IRAN ARE COVERED BY USIRTCA AND PROPOSED NOAA/ MOW COOPERATIVE PROGRAM IS RESULT OF DISCUSSIONS OF SCIENCE, TECHNOLOGY, AND EDUCATION COMMITTEE AT USIRJC MEETING IN AUGUST 1976, EMBASSY FEELS IT IS APPROPRIATE TO CONSIDER NOAA/MOW COOPERATIVE PROJECT AS ONE UNDER AUSPICES OF USIRJC.

EMBASSY FEELS LANGUAGE CONCERNING STATUS, IMPORTATION OF HOUSEHOLD EFFECTS, AND EXEMPTIONS FROM TAXATION IN IRAN SHOULD BE INCORPORATED IN LANGUAGE IN MEMORANDUM OF AGREEMENT. EMBASSY WILL INCLUDE LANGUAGE FROM PARAGRAPH 3 THROUGH 7 AND PARAGRAPH 9 IN MEMORANDUM OF AGREEMENT AND WILL FORWARD REVISED MEMORANDUM OF AGREEMENT VIA POUCH.

GREATLY APPRECIATE PROMPT RESPONSE TO MY REQUEST FOR INFORMATION ABOUT CIRCUMSTANCES SURROUNDING RESIGNATION OF PORTUGUESE FONMIN. DURING MEETING WITH MINISTER KHALTBARY ON OTHER SUBJECTS OCT 29, I DREW ON REF A AND LEFT HIM COPY OF REUTERS ARTICLE (REF B).
IF THERE ARE ADDITIONAL ITEMS WHICH I THINK WILL BE OF INTEREST WHEN POUCHED ANALYSIS (REF C) ARRIVES, I WILL REVERT TO THE SUBJECT ON FUTURE OCCASION.
GREATLY APPRECIATE PROMPT AND HELPFUL GUIDANCE PROVIDED REFTELS. DURING MEETING WITH FONMIN KHALATBARY ON OTHER SUBJECTS OCT 29, I DREW ON REFTELS TO ANSWER HIS QUESTIONS.

IN ESSENCE, I SAID THAT US BELIEVED BOTH NAIROBI AND DAR ES SALAAM WOULD REMAIN IMPORTANT CENTERS IN EAST AFRICA, BUT EACH WITH A SOMEWHAT DIFFERENT FOCUS. I SAID OUR AMB IN DAR HAD INDICATED THAT HE WOULD WELCOME AN IRANIAN COLLEAGUE.

KHALATBARY THANKED ME FOR THE INFORMATION AND SAID HE FELT IRAN WOULD CONTINUE TO MAINTAIN ITS PRESENCE IN NAIROBI, ALTHOUGH HE APPRECIATED VALUE OF TANZANIA, HE WAS NOT SURE SHAH WOULD APPROVE OF OPENING AN EMBASSY THERE BECAUSE SHAH DOES NOT ENTIRELY APPROVE OF NYERERE.

KHALATBARY SAID SHAH'S ATTITUDE GOES BACK TO TIME WHEN ZANZIBAR WAS INCORPORATED AND SHEIKH KARUMI ATTEMPTED FORCE PERSIAN GIRLS IN ZANZIBAR TO MARRY LOCAL HUSBANDS. WHEN IRAN APPEALED TO NYERERE FOR INTERCESSION, LATTER DECLINED TO ACT. THIS ATTITUDE MAY THEREFORE AFFECT IRANIAN DECISIONS AT THIS TIME.

1977TEHRAN09569.subject: , NEW YUGOSLAV AMBASSADOR LOCAL PRESS HAS ANNOUNCED THAT DJURO NINCIC HAS BEEN NAMED YUGOSLAV AMB TO IRAN. UNTIL HIS RECENT ASSIGNMENT

segments.text: LOCAL PRESS HAS ANNOUNCED THAT DJURO NINCIC HAS BEEN NAMED YUGOSLAV AMB TO IRAN. UNTIL HIS RECENT ASSIGNMENT AMB NINCIC WAS REPORTEDLY SERVING IN BELGRADE AS LIAISION OFFICIAL BETWEEN YUGOSLAV FEDERAL SECRETARIAT AND MINISTRY OF FONAFFS. ANY BIO BACKGROUND INFO AVAILABLE TO ADDRESSEES WOULD BE APPRECIATED.
FOLLOWING ARE SALIENT POINTS OF IRANIAN PRESENTATION ON AFGHANISTAN GIVEN TO AMBASSADOR ELIOT DURING HIS CALL ON DR. ABBAS NAYERI, MFA DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR POLITICAL AFFAIRS.

IRAN IS PLEASED THAT PRESIDENT DAOUD'S GOVERNMENT HAS CHOSEN TO DOWN PLAY PUSHTUNISTAN PROBLEM WITH PAKISTAN. NAYERI AGREED THAT PRESENT STATE OF AFFAIRS IS "ABOUT THE BEST WE COULD HOPE FOR". AFGHAN GOVERNMENT WILL NOT BE ABLE TO IGNORE THE ISSUE BUT IRAN IS HOPEFUL THAT AFGHANISTAN WILL NOT EXACERBATE IT EITHER.

IRAN SEES SOME DANGER IN PRESENT INSTABILITY IN PAKISTAN. SHOULD THIS RESULT IN GREATLY WEAKENED CENTRAL GOVERNMENT CONTROL OR EVENTUALLY BREAK UP OF PAKISTAN AND ATTEMPTS BY PUSHTUS TO FORM INDEPENDENT STATE, THEN AFGHAN GOVERNMENT MIGHT BE FORCED BY AFGHANS TO SUPPORT SUCH A MOVE TO SOME DEGREE. AMBASSADOR ELIOT AND NAYERI AGREED BOTH U.S. AND IRAN SHOULD CONTINUE TO COUNSEL RESTRAINT ON THIS ISSUE. IRAN WILL CONTINUE TO SEEK CLOSER TIES WITH AFGHANISTAN IN INTEREST OF EGIONAL STABILITY.

NAYERI SAID IRAN'S TIES WITH AFGHANISTAN WERE ABOUT AS GOOD AS THEY HAVE EVER BEEN. SPRING SETTLEMENT OF HELMAND RIVER WATERS DISAGREEMENT WAS KEY TO EASING AFGHANISTAN'S SUSPICIONS OF IRAN--"WE GAVE THEM EVERYTHING THEY ASKED FOR". QUESTION OF AIR NOT RAISED SPECIFICALLY, BUT NAYERI GAVE IMPRESSION IT WAS GOING AHEAD AS SCHEDULED, (EMBASSY COMMENT: WE WILL BE CHECKING THIS WITH MINISTRY OF ECONOMIC AFFAIRS INTERNATIONAL DIVISION IN COURSE OF NORMAL CONTACTS.) SETTLEMENT OF HELMAND PROBLEM HAS IMPROVED AFGHAN VIEWS OF IRAN, WHICH HAVE ALWAYS CONTAINED SENSITIVITIES ARISING FROM CLOSENESS OF CULTURAL TIES.

IN REVIEW OF AFGHANISTAN'S FUTURE, NAYERI SAID IRANIANS BELIEVE DAOUD WISHES TO CONSTRUCT POLITICAL SYSTEM WITH HIS OWN MEN IN KEY POSITIONS IN NEW PARTY, PARLIAMENT AND GOVERNMENT MINISTRIES. IF THIS CAN BE DONE, THEN THERE IS SOME PROSPECT FOR INSTITUTIONAL STABILITY WHEN DAOUD LEAVES SCENE. NEXT THREE/FOUR YEARS WILL BE CRITICAL FOR INSTITUTIONALIZATION. ON QUESTION OF DAOUD'S SUCCESSOR, GENERAL RASSOULI WAS MENTIONED AS PRESENT LEADING CANDIDATE AND IRANIANS RATE CHANCE OF ROYAL FAMILY COMING BACK AS UNLIKELY.
AMBASSADOR ELIOT INFORMED NAYERI THAT PRESIDENT DAOUD HAS BEEN INVITED TO VISIT THE U.S. NEXT YEAR BUT THAT NO DATES HAVE BEEN SET.
IN ACCORDANCE INSTRUCTION REFTEL, I GAVE SHAH AN ORAL BRIEFING ON "PRINCIPAL JUDGMENTS" OF MIDDLE EAST MILITARY BALANCE ON AFTERNOON OCT 31. AUDIENCE TOOK PLACE ONE HOUR PRIOR ARRIVAL OF SADAT.

SHAH EXPRESSED APPRECIATION FOR BRIEFING, SAID HE CONCURRED IN OUR JUDGMENTS, BUT FELT IT WAS RISKY TO PROJECT ALL THE WAY TO 1982. HIS PRINCIPAL CONCERN IS THAT SADAT MAY COLLAPSE, CURRENT REGIME IN SYRIA MAY BE OVERTHROWN, AND SOVIETS MAY BE REINTRODUCED IN MAJOR WAY.
SHAH ALSO SAID THAT ISRAELI APPRECIATION OF ITS CURRENT MILITARY STRENGTH WOULD PROBABLY MAKE THEM "TOO STUBBORN" TO MAKE ANY REAL CONCESSIONS IN GENEVA.

1977TEHRAN09624.subject: SHAH'S CONCERN RE DEVELOPMENTS IN TWO YEMENS

segments.text: DURING AUDIENCE WITH SHAH ON OTHER SUBJECTS OCTOBER 31, HE TOLD ME HE WAS CONCERNED BY DEVELOPMENTS IN THE TWO YEMENS. HE SAID HE COULDN'T QUITE FIGURE OUT WHAT WAS GOING ON, BUT SENSED SOME DISTRUBING TRENDS.

AS FAR AS SANA WAS CONCERNED, HE WAS NOT SATISFIED WITH THE STORY THAT RELIGIOUS FANATICS HAD ARRANGED THE ASSASSINATIONS BECAUSE THEY WERE SHOCKED BY THE FRENCH CALL GIRLS. THE ARABS ARE USED TO FRENCH CALL GIRLS AND SQUARE THEM WITH THE QORAN BY MAKING THEM CONCUBINES. THERE MUST HAVE BEEN MORE SERIOUS POLITICAL BUSINESS AT THE ROOT OF THE ASSASSINATIONS.

BEYOND THIS, HE WAS CONCERNED WITH WHAT HE HAD BEEN HEARING ABOUT SAUDI ACTIONS CUTTING OFF CONTACT AND ASSISTANCE TO ADEN. HE FELT THAT, IF THE SAUDIS TURNED ADEN LOOSE, THE PDRY WOULD DRIFT BACK TO ITS OLD HABITS AND THE TROUBLES WITH OMAN WOULD ERUPT AGAIN. HE SAID HE HAD INSTRUCTED HIS EMBASSY IN JIDDA TO CONSULT WITH U.S. EMBASSY JIDDA ON THIS SUBJECT.

MFA DEP DIR INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS SADEGHI RESPONDED NOVEMBER 3 TO EMBASSY'S SOLICITATION PER REFTEL PLEDGING IRANIAN SUPPORT FOR US CANDIDATE TO IMCO COUNCIL AND ASSURED THAT INSTRUCTIONS HAVE BEEN GIVEN TO GOI DEL TO LONDON MEETING.

FRENCH CHARGE HERE TOLD AMBASSADOR CATEGORICALLY THAT FRANCE HAD NOT RPT NOT AGREED THAT IRAN COULD REPROCESS SPENT FUEL IN IRAN IF IT SO WISHED CONTRARY TO INFO IN REFTEL. ACCURACY OF THIS STATEMENT SEEMS BORNE OUT BY IRANIAN FAILURE TO PRESS US ON THIS POINT IN JUST CONCLUDED ROUND OF NEGOTIATION ON IRANIAN-U.S. NUCLEAR COOPERATION AGREEMENT. WE BELIVE THAT IF IRAN HAD GOTTEN SUCH A DEAL FROM THE FRENCH IT WOULD HAVE ASKED FOR THE SAME FROM US. FURTHER SHAH HAS TOLD US REPEATEDLY THAT HE DOES NOT WANT TO REPROCESS IN IRAN.

ON OCTOBER 30, THERMAL REFORMING UNIT NUMBER NINE AT ABADAN REFINERY EXPLODED, KILLING FOUR IRANIAN EMPLOYEES OF NIOC AND INJURING ABOUT EIGHTEEN OTHERS. THE UNIT WHICH WAS DESTROYED WAS ONE OF THE OLDEST IN THE REFINERY AND WAS BUILT BEFORE WW II. THE EXPLOSION OCCURRED DURING RECOMMISSIONING AND THE CAUSE IS THOUGHT TO HAVE BEEN A WEAK FLANGE WHICH PERMITTED VAPORT TO LEAK.
INFORMED SOURCES SAY THAT THE EXPLOSION WILL HAVE NO APPRECIABLE IMPACT ON THROUGH-PUT CAPACITY AT ABADAN AND THAT THE REDUCTION OF REFORMING CAPACITY WILL NOT CREATE A SERIOUS PROBLEM.

REF STATE 262839 DCM DELIVERED REFTEL MESSAGE TO DR. KAZEMI MORNING OF NOVEMBER 6. KAZEMI SAID THAT HE WILL ATEND THE LOS MEETING IN GENEVA NOVEMBER 14. IN PASSING HE MADE THE POINT THAT HIS VIEWS ON LOS MATTERS IN THE PAST AND PROBABLY ON THIS OCCASION DO NOT RPT NOT NECESSARILY REPRESENT OFFICIAL GOI POSITIONS WHICH, HE SAID, "SOME TIMES TAKE YEARS TO FORMULAT." NEVERTHELESS, HE EXPRESSED APPRECIATION FOR YOUR FEELING THAT HE MAY BE ABLE TO MAKE A USEFUL CONTRIBUTION TO THE DELIBERATIONS IN GENEVA.
REF STATE 264684

DURING MEETING WITH MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS UNDERSECRETARY ZELLI NOVEMBER 6, I ASKED HIM TO PASS SUBSTANCE OF REFTEL TO MINISTER KHALATBARY. I STRESSED THAT U.S. REMAINED INTERESTED IN HIS PROPOSAL FOR ANTI-TERRORIST CONVENTION, BUT DID NOT WISH DIVERT ATTENTION FROM EFFORT TO STIMULATE ACCESSIONS TO HAGUE AND MONTREAL CONVENTIONS.

ZELLI SAID HE WOULD PASS THIS ON TO KHALATBARY AND GET BACK TO US WITH LATTER'S DESIRES CONCERNING WASHINGTON DISCUSSIONS THIS SUBJECT. HE FELT ONLY CONSTRAINT WOULD BE POSSIBILITY MINISTER MIGHT NOT BE ABLE BREAK AWAY FROM SHAH FOR PRIVATE DISCUSSIONS DURING STATE VISIT.

REF STATE 264503 DURING MEETING WITH MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS UNDERSECRETARY ZELLI ON NOVEMBER 6, I PASSED ON TO MINISTER KHALATBARY FACT THAT WE HAVE NO INFORMATION TO CONFIRM IRAQ COMBAT PRESENCE IN OGADEN.
REF STATE 263036, TEHRAN 9697 I WILL BE DELIGHTED TO TALKWITH MESSRS. BRAY AND LINDJORD WHILE IN WASHINGTON TO ASSIST ME IN DECIDING HOW BEST TO MEET GOI WISH TO HAVE MOBILIZATION ADVISER.

1977TEHRAN09830.subject: LAW OF THE SEA MILITARY EXEMPTION AND IRAN

segments.text: DURING NOV. 6 MEETING DCM HAD WITH MFA LEGAL COUNSEL KAZIMI ON OTHER MATTERS, LATTER REFERRED BACK TO DISCUSSION THEY HAD HAD PREVIOUSLY (REFTEL 1) CONCERNING ALLEGED REMARKS HE HAD MADE CONCERNING LOS NEGOTIATIONS AND MILITARY EXEMPTION FROM COMPULSORY DISPUTE SETTLEMENT. KAZIMI SAID THAT WHEN HE HAD REPORTED THE MATTER TO HIS SUPERIORS THEY HAD BEEN INCLINED TO OVERLOOK PRESSING FOR DETAILS ABOUT WHO ALLEGEDLY SAID WHAT TO WHOM AND WHEN. NOW, HOWEVER, THEY HAVE ASKED SPECIFICALLY WHICH US OFFICIAL SPOKE TO DR. KAZIMI, THE DATE AND THE PLACE. DR.

KAZIMI REITERATED THAT NOT ONLY HAD HE NEVER DISCUSSED THE QUESTION WITH ANYONE IN THE AMERICAN DELEGATION BUT THAT THE REMARKS ATTRIBUTED TO HIM ARE CONTRARY TO HIS VIEWS ON THE SUBJECT. HE SUGGESTED IT MAY HAVE BEEN POSSIBLE THAT OUR DELEGATION CONFUSED HIM WITH THE IRAQI DELEGATE WHO DR. KAZIMI BELIEVED IN FACT ESPOUSED THE POSITION WE HAVE ATTRIBUTED TO DR. KAZIMI.
PLEASE PROVIDE INFORMATION KAZIMI REQUESTED ASAP.
REF A. STATE 260416 AND PREVIOUS, B. TEHRAN 9743 TEHRAN 9431
H PLEASE PASS FOLLOWING MESSAGE TO SENATORS ADLAI STEVENSON AND CHARLES PERCY, AND CONGRESSMAN ABNER MIKVA. ALL HAVE INQUIRED BY LETTER OR CABLE ABOUT STATUS OF SUBJECT PRISONER.

BEGIN : PURSUANT TO YOUR INQUIRY, THE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN HAS INFORMED US THAT MAHMOUD MAZAHERI-TEHRANI WAS ARRESTED IN FEBRUARY 1977 AND CHARGED WITH ANTI-STATE ACTIVITIES. HE WAS TRIED IN MILITARY COURT IN ACCORDANCE WITH IRANIAN LAW, AND SENTENCED TO FOUR YEARS IN PRISON. HIS CASE IS PRESENTLY BEING REVIEWED BY AN APPELLATE COURT. THIS INFORMATION SHOULD SERVE AS OFFICIAL NOTIFICATION OF MR. MAHMOUD MAZAHERI-TEHRANI'S STATUS AND PERMIT MRS. MAZAHERI-TEHRANI TO QUALIFY FOR WELFARE ASSISTANCE IN THE STATE OF ILLINOIS. THE EMBASSY WILL CONTINUE TO FOLLOW THIS MATTER AND WILL ADVISE YOU PROMPTLY OF ANY CHANGE IN MR. MAZAHERI-TEHRANI'S STATUS. SINCERELY, WILLIAM H. SULLIVAN, AMBASSADOR. END .

EMBASSY COMMENT: AS REF B INDICATED, MAZAHERITEHRANI WAS NOT RPT NOT ON SHAH'S BIRTHDAY PARDON LIST OCT 26. EMBASSY IS NOT RPT NOT ABLE TO ESTIMATE HOW LONG APPELLATE PROCEDURE WILL TAKE. THERE IS ALWAYS POSSIBILITY, THOUGH SOMEWHAT REMOTE, AT MAZAHERITEHRANI COULD BE PARDONED WHILE APPEAL STILL IN PROGRESS. EMBASSY WILL CONTINUE TO KEEP ABREAST OF DEVELOPMENTS AND INFORM DEPARTMENT IF SITUATION CHANGES.

1977TEHRAN09851.subject: IRANIAN VIEWS ON CURRENT STATE OF STABILITY IN PEKING

segments.text: UNDERSECRETARY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS ZELLI TOLD ME NOVEMBER 6 THAT THE IRANIAN EMBASSY IN PEKING HAD REPORTED THE APPEARANCE OF WAR POSTERS IN PEKING UNIVERSITY CRITICAL OF THE MAYOR OF PEKING AND OF CH'EN HSI-LIEN. OTHER DIPLOMATIC SOURCES IN PEKING HAVE PRESUMABLY DETECTED THE SAME POSTERS AND HAVE INTERPRETED THIS AS REPRESENTING DISUNITY IN THE CENTRAL COMMITTEE RANKS.

ZELLI SAYS THAT THE PERMANENT COMMITTEE OF THE PEOPLE'S CONGRESS MET UNDER THE CHAIRMANSHIP OF THE MAYOR OF PEKING ON OCTOBER 23 AND 24 AND THAT PROCEEDINGS INCLUDED SPEECHES CRITICAL OF THE ECONOMIC SITUATION WHICH PRESUMABLY REFLECTED UPON THE PARTICULAR COMPETENCE OF TENG HSIAO PING. FROM THIS THE IRANIANS CONCLUDE THAT THE POWER STRUGGLE IS CONTINUING AND THAT THE "GANG OF FOUR" ELEMENT IS ONLY ONE ASPECT OF THE INTERNAL TENSIONS.

ZELLI ASKED FOR U.S. COMMENTS ON THESE REPORTS FROM IRANIAN EMBASSY IN PEKING AND ANY VIEWS WE HAVE ABOUT THE CURRENT STATE OF STABILITY IN THE PEKING LEADERSHIP. HE NOTED IN PASSING, INCIDENTALLY, THAT FOREIGN MINISTER HUANG HUA HAD SPENT 18 HOURS IN TEHRAN EN ROUTE TO THE UNGA AND THAT HE HAD HAD WHAT ZELLI DESCRIBED AS SATISFACTORY TALKS WITH IRANIAN OFFICIALS DURING THAT PERIOD.
ACTION REQUESTED: PLEASE PROVIDE INFORMATION ON WHICH TO BASE RESPONSE TO ZELLI'S REQUEST.

IN COURSE OF COURTESY CALL BY NEWLY ARRIVED ISRAELI MINISTER MOSHE GILBAO ON CHARGE, DISCUSSION TURNED TO RECENT VISIT OF PRES SADAT TO IRAN. ACCORDING TO GILBAO, IT IS ISRAELI VIEW THAT SADAT'S PRIMARY AIM WAS TO BRIEF THE SHAH ON EGYPTIAN REACTION TO US-ISRAELI WORKING PAPER AND PROVIDE THEIR ASSRSSMENT OF PROGRESS BEING MADE TOWARD A GENEVA PEACE CONFERENCE.

ISRAELI MISSION'S IMPRESSION IS THAT ADDITIONAL PURPOSE OF SADAT TRIP WAS TO PRESS SHAH TO MAKE A CASE FOR ARAB SIDE TO PRES CARTER WHEN HE VISITS THE US NEXT WEEK AND TO ENCOURAGE THE PRES TO PURSUE HIS EFFORTS TO RECONVENE THE GENEVA CONFERENCE. GILBAO, NOTING SHAH'S NOVEMBER 4 COMMENTS TO NEWSWEEK'S DE BORCHGRAVE, SAID THAT MOST LIKELY SADAT AND SHAH DISCUSSED ALTERNATIVES, SUCH AS BILATERAL ARRANGEMENTS, IF THE GENEVA CONFERENCE FAILS TO RECONVENE. ISRAELIS BELIEVE THAT SHAH PROBABLY WOULLD NOT HAVE SUGGESTED SUCH A COURSE IN A PUBLIC INTERVIEW UNLESS HE HAD DISCUSSED SUCH AN ALTERNATIVE EARLIER WITH SADAT.
GILBOA ADMITTED THAT THIS WOULD NOT BE A COURSE DISTASTEFUL TO ISRAEL.

ISRAELIS BELIEVE TWO LEADERS ALSO REVIEWED SITUATION IN THE HORN OF AFRICA AND THAT THEY SHARE A CONCERN THAT THE RED SEA COULD BECOME AN "ARAB LAKE" WITH RADICAL ARAB STATES BECOMING CONSOLIDATED ON EACH SIDE OF THE SEA. AS BACKGROUND CONSIDERATION TO ABOVE ISSUES, SADAT ALLEGEDLY REFERRED TO STRAINS WITHIN THE ARAB COMMUNITY, I.E., SYRIAIRAQ AND LYBIA-EGYPT.

1977TEHRAN09936.subject: SAUDI INTERIOR MINISTER--LATEST IN ROUND OF ARAB VISITORS TO IRAN

segments.text: VISITORS TO IRAN

IN WHAT HAS PROVED TO BE AN OVERLAPPING SERIES OF VISITS FROM ARAB LEADERS, THE SAUDI MINISTER OF INTERIOR PRINCE AMIR NAIF BEN ABDUL AZIZ ARRIVED IN TEHRAN ON NOV 3 FOR A FOURDAY OFFICIAL VISIT. THE PRINCE AND HIS PARTY OF 55 WERE THE GUESTS OF GOI INTERIOR MINISTER ASSADOLLAH NASR-ESFAHANI. IRAN WAS FINAL STOP ON 16 DAY TOUR WHICH ALSO INCLUDED IRAQ, JORDAN AND SYRIA.

OFFICIALLY THE PRINCE WAS HERE TO HOLD TALKS WITH HIS COUNTERPART ON STRENGTHENING COOPERATION BETWEEN THE TWO COUNTRIES IN THE FIELD OF SECURITY. IN ADDITION, HOWEVER, HE WAS RECEIVED BY THE SHAH AND PRESENTED WHAT WAS TERMED BY LOCAL PRESS AS "A FRIENDLY MESSAGE" FROM KING KHALID. THE PRINCE DESCRIBED HIS MEETING WITH THE SHAH AS CONFIRMING THE GOOD RELATIONS EXISTING BETWEEN IRAN AND SAUDI ARABIA. ACCORDING TO REPORTS FROM PRESS CONFERENCE GIVEN BY THE PRINCE TO TEHRAN NEWSMEN, OTHER TOPICS DISCUSSED WITH LOCAL OFFICIALS INCLUDED COOPERATION ON EDUCATION AND MEASURES AGAINST SMUGGLING AND DRUG TRAFFICKING.

THE PRINCE STRESSED HIS GOVERNMENT'S WILLINGNESS TO COOPERQTE WITH THE GOI IN FIGHTING TERRORISM AND IN COUNTERING SUBVERSIVE THREATS IN THE PESIAN GULF, PARTICULARLY THE STRAIT OF HORMOZ STRATEGIC AREA.

INTERESTINGLY, ON THE DAY AFTER PRINCE MAIF'S DEPARTURE THE LOCAL PRESS GAVE PROMINENT COVERAGE TO GOI POLICE ACTION WHICH RESULTED IN THE CAPTURE OF TWO MAJOR DRUG SMUGGLING RINGS AND THE SEIZURE OF $50 MILLIORTH OF HEROIN AND HASHISH AND ALSO TO ACTION BY GOI CIVIL AVIATION OFFICIALS TO PLACE ALL IRANIAN AIRPORTS ON "ACTIVE ALERT" AGAINST POSSIBLE TERRORIST ACTIVITY.

COMMENT: GOI MINISTRY OF INTERIOR ASSISTANT SECRETARYLEVEL SOURCE (PROTEXT) CONFIRMED PRESS REPORTS PARA 2 ABOVE. HE SAID VISIT WAS BADICALLY OF GOOD-WILL NATURE WITH SPECIFIC DISCUSSIONS CENTERING ABOUT NARCOTICS SMUGGLING, COUNTERFEITING OF BANK BILLS AND EXTRADITION OF COMMON CRIMINALS. AGREEMENT IN PRINCIPLE WAS REACHED ON THESE POINTS AND LEGAL EXPERTS FROM EACH COUNTRY WILL SHORTLY DRAW UP FORMAL BILATERAL TREATY, ACCORDING TO SOURCE. INFORMAL AGREEMENT DOES NOT SPECIFICALLY PROVIDE FOR COUNTER-TERRORIST MEASURES BUT IT IS ANTICIPATED THAT SUCH PROVISIONS WILL BE INCLUDED LATER IN ANY FORMAL TREATY BETWEEN THE TWO COUNTRIES.
IN RESPONSE TO OUR QUERY, SOURCE WAS UNABLE TO SHED LIGHT ON SPECULATION THAT UPCOMING OPEC MEETING WAS SUBJECT OF DISCUSSION DURING VISIT.

1977TEHRAN09945.subject: REPORTED HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES VOTE ON BRIBERY BILL

segments.text: BRIBERY BILL
