1977TEHRAN09947.subject: IRANIAN REACTION TO AMBASSADOR MEYER'S STATEMENT

segments.text: INTEREST IN AMBASSADOR MEYER'S REMARKS TO SRI SYMPOSIUM ON IRAN-US RELATIONS CONTINUES TO GENERATE GREAT DEAL OF PLAY IN LOCAL PRESS. SUBSEQUENT TO REFTEL A, FORMER PRIME MINISTER ALI AMINI WROTE OCT. 30 OPEN LETTER TO THE PRESS DENYING THAT HE WAS APPOINTED PRIME MINISTER IN 1961 AT USG INSISTENCE.

ON NOV. 1 JOURNALIST ALI SHAABANI, IN A LETTER TO PERSIAN DAILY KAYHAN, REFUTED AMINI'S STATEMENT AND ACCUSED THE FORMER LEADER OF ASSUMING OFFICE AS A RESULT OF U.S. PRESSURE, RABBLE ROUSING, AND FALSE PROMISES OF AN EFFECTIVE REFORM AND DEVELOPMENT PLAN. SHAABANI CHARGED THAT THE AMERICAN EMBASSY LINKS WITH TEACHER STRIKES AND DEMONSTRATIONS IN 1961 CAUSED JAAFAR SHARIF-EMAMI'S RESIGNATION AS PRIME MINISTER.

AN ARTICLE APPEARED IN NOV. 2 ISSUE OF "RANGIN KAMAN", WEEKLY MAGAZINE OF POLITICAL-SOCIAL COMMENTARY, CHRGING THAT AMINI AND HIS FRIENDS ARE TRYING ONCE AGAIN TO PREPARE GROUND FOR HIS ASSUMPTION OF POWER BY STIRRING UP RUMORS ABOUT FEUDS BETWEEN THE GOI AND PRESIDENT CARTER AND THE US CONGRESS, AND EXAGGERATING ANTI-IRAN DEMONSTRATIONS IN AMERICA. 4.IN LIGHT OF THESE CHARGES AND COUNTER-CHARGES WE INQUIRED AT THE COURT MINISTRY IF SOME MESSAGE WAS BEING CONVEYED TO US SINCE THE INITIAL REPORTS OF MEYER'S STATEMENT ORIGINATED FROM THE SEMI-OFFICIAL PARS NEWS AGENCY (PNA).

THE ANSWER WAS "NO MESSAGE INTENDED", COURT OFFICIAL ADDED HALF-JOKINGLY THAT IT WAS MERELY AN EXERCISE IN FREEDOM OF THE PRESS WHICH IS A COURSE WHICH THE US HAS BEEN ENCOURAGING EVERYONE TO OBSERVE. WE WERE INCLINED TO ACCEPT THIS EXPLANATION UNTIL SHAH'S NOV. 4 INTERVIEW WITH DE BORCHGRAVE PUT A DIFFERENT CAST ON THE MATTER. IN RESPONSE TO QUERY RE REPORT GOI RELEASED ALLEGING THAT PRESIDENT KENNEDY PRESSURED THE GOVERNMENT TO APPOINT AMINI AND THAT THE SHAH, WAS, IN EFFECT, SAYING THAT PEOPLE WHO LIVE IN GLASS HOUSES SHOULD NOT THROW STONES, THE SHAH SAID, "IT'S PAST HISTORY BUT CORRECT. YOU ARE ALSO CORRECT IN YOUR ASSUMPTION.
I COULD SAY MUCH MORE BUT I WON'T."

COMMENT: WE ARE SOMEWHAT MYSTIFIED BY IRANIAN PERSISTENCE IN THIS MATTER AND CAN ONLY ASSUME THAT THE SHAH IS TAKING AN OFFENSIVE STANCE PRIOR TO UPCOMING WASHINGTON MEETWITH PRESIDENT CARTER. WE BELIEVE HE IS LASHING OUT NOT SO MUCH AT THE PRESIDENT BUT RATHER AT THE CONGRESS AND US NEWS MEDIA. FOR EXAMPLE, HE HAS BEEN HARPING, FIRST PRIVATELY AND MORE RECENTLY IN PUBLIC, ON OUR 1959 BILATERAL AGREEMENT ON COOPERATION AND THE LACK OF UNDERSTANDING ON THE PART OF CONGRESS AND THE PRESS.

EDITORIAL IN TODAY'S TEHRAN JOURNAL ENTITLED, "AMERICAN COMMITMENT TO AID IRAN UNDENIABLE", SUMS UP CURRENT GOI POLICY AS ONE OF RELIANCE ON THE US IN TIME OF NEED WHILE SIMULTANEOUSLY MAINTAINING GOI SOVEREIGNTY AND INTEGRITY BY BOOSTING ITS MILITARY POWER. IN DE BORCHGRAVE INTERVIEW SHAH REPEATEDLY REFERRED TO HIS UNCERTAINITY REGARDING US COMMITMENTS, CITING "U.S. UNRELIABILITY IN VIETNAM, CAMBODIA, LAOS AND DURING THE INDIA-PAKISTAN WARS". IT APPEARS THAT CONTROVERSY SURROUNDING AWACS SALE TO GOI AND RESULTANT AIRING OF AMERICAN CONCERN RE GOI CAPABILITY AND RELIABILITY INFLICTED A WOUND WHICH HAS YET TO HEAL.
THE GOI HAS ANNOUNCED THE APPOINTMENT OF NEW AMBASSADORS TO THAILAND, SENEGAL AND EAST GERMANY. ALL THREE ARE CAREER DIPLOMATS WITH PREVIOUS SERVICE ABROAD.

FARAJOLLAH BORHANI, AMBASSADOR TO THAILAND, HOLDS A DOCTORATE IN LAW FROM UNIVERSITY OF PARIS. THE 54 YEAR OLD DIPLOMAT BEGAN HIS CAREER IN THE MINISTRY OF EDUCATION LATER TRANSFERRING TO MFA WHERE HE HAS SERVED IN THE ADMINISTRATIVE, WESTERN EUROPEAN AND PRESS AND INFORMATION DEPARTMENTS. HE HAS BEEN POSTED ABROAD IN HAMBURG AND LONDON. HIS LAST POSITION PRIOR TO BEING NAMED AMBASSADOR WAS DIRECTOR OF THE DEPARTMENT OF CULTURAL, TECHNICAL AND SCIENTIFIC RELATIONS IN MFA. BORHANI SPEAKS FRANCH.

NASROLLAH FAHIMI, AMBASSADOR TO SENEGAL, HAS A M.A. IN POLITICAL SCIENCE FROM UNIVERSITY OF TEHRAN. FAHIMI, 55, BEGAN HIS CAREER WITH MFA IN 1945 AND HAS WORKED IN ADMINISTRATIVE, SOUTH ASIA, AND CONSULAR AFFAIRS DEPARTMENTS WITHIN MFA. HE HAS SERVED ABROAD IN GENEVA (1950-55); NEW YORK CONSULATE (1957-58); ROME (VATICAN) (1958) AND WAS CONSUL GENERAL IN MUNICH. IN ADDITION HE WAS A MEMBER OF THE GOI DELEGATION TO THE 13TH UNESCO CONFERENCE IN GENEVA. HIS POST PREVIOUS TO BEING NAMED AMBASSADOR WAS CHIEF OF THE TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE BUREAU, MFA. HE SPEAKS ENGLISH AND FRENCH. FAHIMI'S BROTHER, ASSADOLLAH, HAS BEEN GOI AMBASSADOR TO SWITZERLAND SINCE 1975.
THEY ARE RELATED TO KHALIL FAHIMI, A PROMINENT STATESMAN WHO WAS SEVERAL TIMES PRIME MINISTER UNDER REZA SHAH, THE PRESENT RULER'S FATHER.

AMIR HOSSEIN FARZANEGAN, AMBASSADOR TO GERMAN DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC, HOLDS A M.A. DEGREE IN LAW FROM TEHRAN UNIVERSITY. HE HAS SERVED IN PRAGUE, BUDAPEST AND COPENHAGEN. PRIOR TO HIS RECENT APPOINTMENT AS AMBASSADOR HE WAS HEAD OF THE MINISTERIAL BUREAU, MFA.
WE WOULD APPRECIATE RECEIVING FROM ADDRESSEE POSTS ANY ADDITIONAL BIOGRAPHIC INFORMATION WHICH MAY BECOME AVAILABLE ON THE ABOVE OFFICIALS DURING THEIR CURRENT TOURS ABROAD.

1977TEHRAN09996.subject: US-USSR INDIAN OCEAN TALKS AT A SOCIAL EVENT EVENING OF NOV. 10 SOVIET AMBASSADOR MADE A POINT OF DRAWING ME ASIDE TO INTRODUCE ME TO VIS

segments.text: AT A SOCIAL EVENT EVENING OF NOV. 10 SOVIET AMBASSADOR MADE A POINT OF DRAWING ME ASIDE TO INTRODUCE ME TO VISITING SOVIET AMBASSADOR AT LAR LEV MENDELEVICH, MENDELEVICH IDENTIFIED HIMSELF AS HEAD OF THE USSR DELEGATION TO THE US-USSR INDIAN OCEAN TALKS. HE ASKED ME TO CONVEY TO YOU "OFFICIALLY AND FORMALLY" WORD THAT HE WAS IN TEHRAN TO GET GOI VIEWS ON THE INDIAN OCEAN AS THEY MAY PERTAIN TO THE SUBJECT OF OUR BI-LATERAL DISCUSSIONS. HE WANTED YOU TO KNOW THAT HIS VISIT HERE IS IN NO WAY INTENDED TO PREDJUDICE THE COURSE OF THE DISCUSSIONS.

HE SAID THAT THE US AND THE USSR HAVE AGREED TO CONSULT THEIR FRIENDS FROM TIME TO TIME AND IN THIS CASE "WE BOTH HAVE THE SAME FRIEND" (SIC). COMMENT: I HAVE NO IDEA WHY I WAS PURPOSELY SOUGHT OUT TO CONVEY THE FOREGOING. MENDELEVICH'S VISIT HERE, HOWEVER, MAY BE IN RESPONSE TO A PERCEPTION THAT IRAN LIKES TO BE KEPT CLOSELY INFORMED ABOUT DISCUSSIONS IN WHICH IT HAS A LIVELY INTEREST. HE WILL DOUBTLESS TELL THE GOI THAT THE NEXT SESSION OF OUR TALKS IS SCHEDULED FOR BERN DECEMBER 1. AN ARRANGEMENT OF WHICH I WAS UNAWARE UNTIL MENDELEVICH TOLD ME.

1977TEHRAN10013.subject: OMANI CLAIM TO TERRITORY IN RAS AL KHAIMAH

segments.text: DURING A GENERAL CONVERSATION WITH FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY EVENING OF NOVEMBER 10, I ASKED ABOUT OMANI CLAIMS TO TERRITORY IN RAS AL KHAIMAH AND GOI REACTION IN VIEW OF TIS CLOSE RELATIONS WITH OMAN. KHALATBARY SAID THAT THERE WERE "A LOT OF DIFFERENT BRITISH-DRAWN MAPS DEFINING TERRITORY IN THAT PART OF THE WORLD" AND IT WAS HARD TO KNOW WHICH WAS THE MORE AUTHENTIC. IN ANY EVENT, NOBODY MUCH CARED UNTIL RECENT OIL DRILLINGS IN THE AREA SUGGESTED THE POSSIBILITY OF IMPORTANT PETROLEUM RESERVES.

IRAN HAD NO INTENTION OF GETTING IN THE MIDDLE OF THIS DISPUTE AND THOUGHT IT BEST THAT THE MATTER BE LEFT TO THE ARABS TO SORT OUT AMONGST THEMSELVES. HE DID SAY, HOWEVER, THAT SHAIKH ZAYID WAS HERE RECENTLY HE ASKED FOR THE SHAH'S ADVICE. THE SHAH COUNSELED NEGOTIATION AND UNDERTOOK TO SEND A MESSAGE TO SULTAN QABOOS ASKING HIM TO WITHDRAW THE DEADLINE HE HAD SET FOR RESOLUTION OF THE MATTER AND URGED HIM TO SOLVE THE QUESTION AMICABLY THROUGH NEGOTIATION.

1977TEHRAN10041.subject: IRANIAN PURCHASE OF ADDITIONAL GERMAN POWER REACTORS

segments.text: REACTORS

LOCAL PRESS ANNOUNCED AND EMBASSY SOURCES HAVE CONFIRMED THAT ON 10 NOVEMBER GOI AND FRG SIGNED LETTER OF INTENT FOR PURCHASE OF FOUR 1,200 MW DRY-COOLED, PRESSURIZED WATER REACTORS. GERMAN CONTRACTOR IS KRAFTWERKUNION, AND ESTIMATED COST IS BETWEEN FIVE AND EIGHT BILLION DOLLARS. CONSTRUCTION IS TO BEGIN NEXT YEAR AND INITIAL PLANT COMPLETED IN 1984, WITH OTHER PLANT COMING ON STREAM IN EACH OF THE FOLLOWING THREE YEARS. THE FIRST TWO PLANTS WILL BE LOCATED NEAR ISFAHAN, BUT SITING STUDIES ARE INCOMPLETE.
WHEN THIS NUCLEAR DEAL IS FINALIZED IT WILL BECOME IRAN'S LARGEST SINGLE ORDER FOR PLANT AND EQUIPMENT, AND BRING ITS CONTRACTED NUCLEAR POWER GENERATING CAPACITY UP TO 9,000 MW.

ACCORDING TO LOCAL PRESS REPORTS AEOI PRESIDENT ETEMAD SAID THAT IRANTS 23 ADDITIONAL NUCLEAR REACTORS, AND NEEDS NUCLEAR POWER GENERATING CAPACITY OF 14,000 MW BY THE END OF THE CENTURY. HE ADDED THAT GOI IS CURRENTLY NEGOTIATING WITH "A NUMBER OF COUNTRIES" INCLUDING THE US FOR POWER REACTORS, BUT DECLINED TO GIVE DETAILS. ETEMAD COMMENTED THAT FINANCIAL ASPECT OF THIS NEW KRAFTWERKUNION DEAL NOT YET SOLIDIFIED. ONE LOCAL PAPER REPORTS THAT UNDER TERMS OF THE LETTER OF INTENT A LARGE BUT AS YET UNSPECIFIED PORTION OF FOREIGN EXCHANGE REQUIREMENTS FOR THE DEAL WILL BE EXTENDED BY FRG IN THE FORM OF EXPORT CREDITS.
EMBASSY BELIEVES THAT OIL BARTER WILL PROBABLY PLAY A ROLE IN FINANCIAL ARRANGEMENTS, TOO.

COMMENT: WITHIN LAST COUPLE OF WEEKS GERMAN AMBASSADOR TOLD AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN THAT IT UNLIKELY FRG WOULD COME UP WITH NECESSARY FINANCING SINCE IT IS ALREADY FULLY COMMITTED. OIL BARTER ARRANGEMENT MAY BE IN THE CARDS BUT LARGE SUM INVOLVED MAY MAKE THIS DIFFICULT AS WELL. AS TO NUMBER OF ADDITIONAL REACTORS, IRAN INTENDS TO ACQUIRE BEYOND FOUR UNDER CONTRACT AND FOUR FOR WHICH FRG NOW HAS A LETTER OF INTENT, WE DOUBT THAT FIGURE OF 23 CITED IN PRESS REPORT IS FIRM. ULTIMATE NUMBER WILL OBVIOUSLY DEPEND ON, AMONG OTHER THINGS, OPTIMUM SIZE FOR MARKET REACTOR IS TO SERVE.

IF IRAN PURSUES ITS OVERALL OBJECTIVE OF ACQUIRING BETWEEN 21 TO 23,000 MEGAWATTS OF NUCLEAR GENERATED POWER THERE WILL DOUBTLESS BE ADDITIONAL REACTOR CONTRACTS LET BUT WE BELIEVE NUMBER IS YET TO BE DETERMINED.

1977TEHRAN10064.subject: HUMAN RIGHTS AND DISSIDENTS: ASSORTED ITEMS

segments.text: NUMBER OF EVENTS HAVE TAKEN PLACE IN PAST FEW DAYS WHICH RELATE TO GENERAL IRANIAN HUMAN RIGHTS SITUATION. FOLLOWING IS BRIEF REPORT.

LOCAL PRESS GAVE PROMINENT PLAY TO NOVEMBER TEN SPEECH BY PRINCESS ASHRAF TO THE THIRD COMMITTEE OF THE UNGA. NOTING THAT SOME NATIONS WANTED TO GIVE IRAN LESSONS IN CIVIL AND HUMAN RIGHTS, ASHRAF SAID HUMAN RIGHTS SHOULD BE CONSIDERED IN THE BROADER CONTEXT OF RIGHTS OF NATIONS AND ECONOMIC AND SOCIAL RIGHTS. IRAN CONDEMNED TORTURE AND HAD PROPOSED A JOINT U.N. RESOLUTION WITH SWEDEN AGAINST THIS UNPLEASANT PRACTICE. CASE STUDIES AND EVENTS HAVE REVEALED THAT TORTURE HAS OFTEN BEEN PRACTICED WITHOUT THE AWARENESS OF SENIOR LEVELS OF GOVERNMENT.

(COMMENT: EMBASSY BELIEVES THIS IS THE FIRST TIME ANY SENOR IRANIAN OFFICIAL HAS DIRECTLY SUGGESTED THIS.) ASHRAF SAID POLITICAL AND CIVIL RIGHTS MADE NO SENSE UNLESS DISCUSSED WITHIN THE ECONOMIC, CULTURAL AND SOCIAL CONTEXT OF THE COUNTRY BEING CONSIDERED. SHE SAID AS DIFFERENT COUNTRIES CONTINUE TO PUSH RIVAL INTERPRETATIONS, HUMAN RIGHTS PROMOTION WOULD BECOME A NEW AND CLEVER MEANS OF INTERFERING IN OTHER NATIONS' INTERNAL AFFAIRS. EMBASSY COMMENT: NUMBER OF IRANIAN FIGURES WITH WHOM EMBASSY OFFICERS HAVE TALKED BELIEVE ASHRAF'S SPEECH WAS MEANT TO SET CONTEXT FOR ANY POSSIBLE DISCUSSION OF HUMAN RIGHTS SITUATION WHEN SHAH VISITS WASHINGTON, AND ENSUING MEDIA TREATMENT.

ON SAME DAY, MFA SPOKESMAN PARVIZ ADL SAID ANARCHISTS AND CRIMINALS UNQUOTE WERE CONVERGING ON WASHINGTON TO PREPARE DEMONSTRATIONS AGAINST THE SHAH DURING HIS COMING U.S. VISIT. BOTH FARSI AND ENGLISH PRESS GAVE PROMINENT PLAY ON NOVEMBER TWELVE TO ADL REMARKS WHICH ALSO INCLUDED COMMENT THAT GOI HAD RECEIVED REPORTS ABOUT PREPARATIONS BEING MADE FOR A DIRECTED AND ORCHESTRATED UNQUOTE CAMPAIGN AGAINST IRAN'S INDEPENDENCE AND TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY. ADL WENT ON TO SAY THAT SOME OF THE PAID DEMONSTRATORS UNQUOTE WERE FROM DIFFERENT NATIONALITIES WHO HAD IN THE PAST TRAVELED ON FAKED IRANIAN CITIZENSHIP DOCUMENTS. HE EQUATED THEM WITH THE LUFTHANSA JET HIGHJACKERS WHO HAD FORGED IRANIAN PASSPORTS.

ADL DESCRIBED DEMONSTRATIONS AGAINST THE SHAH (WHO WAS SYMBOL OF IRANIAN NATIONHOOD) AS DIRECT HATRED AGAINST IRAN ITSELF. MOTIVES FOR ATTACKS AGAINST IRAN WERE FEAR OF IRAN'S POWER AND JEALOUSY AT IRAN'S PROGRESS. EMBASSY UNDERSTANDS FROM JOURNALISTIC SOURCES THAT STATEMENT WAS DIRECTED, IF NOT PREPARED, BY COURT MINISTRY.

PERSIAN PRESS MORNING NOVEMBER FOURTEEN SAID STUDENT MEMBERS OF IRANIAN MINORITIES IN U.S.-ASSYRIANS, ARMENIANS AND JEWS--WOULD BE DEMONSTRATING IN SUPPORT OF THE SHAH. ENGLISH PRESS SAID ANTIIRANIAN DEMONSTRATORS WERE CONVERGING ON U.S. FROM EUROPE AND CANADA. EMBASSY COMMENT: PRESS HERE IS MAKING MAJOR EFFORT TO SET STAGE FOR REPORTING OF DEMONSTRATIONS AND COUNTER-DEMONSTRATIONS DURING SHAH'S VISIT.

EMBASSY UNDERSTANDS THAT FIFTY-FOUR JUDGES SIGNED LETTER TO STATE SUPREME COURT PRESIDENT YEGANEH WHICH SAYS COURTS HAVE BEEN DOWNGRADED IN IMPORTANCE. JUDGES CALLED FOR REASSERTION OF JUDICIAL SYSTEM'S JURISDICTION AND ABOLITION OF SPECIAL PROSECUTION AUTHORITIES UNQUOTE AND RETURN OF PROMOTIONS AND ASSIGNMENTS OF JUDGES TO STATE SUPREME COURT. DOCUMENT ALSO CALLS FOR LESS EXECUTIVE INTERFERENCE IN JUDICIAL SYSTEM. WE UNDERSTAND VERY UNOFFICIALLY THAT YEGANEH CALLED JUDGES TOGETHER AND TOLD THEM THAT IRAN'S DEVELOPMENT REQUIRED COURTS TO TAKE A MORE SUBORDINATE ROLE, BUT THIS WOULD EVENTUALLY CHANGE. HE ASKED THE FIFTY-FOUR SIGNERS TO REAFFIRM THEIR LOYALTY TO THE NATION. ALL BUT TWELVE DID SO AND THEN RETURNED TO THEIR DUTIES.

TWELVE WHO REFUSED TO REAFFIRM LOYALTY HAVE BEEN SUSPENDED FROM DUTY AT LEAST TEMPORARILY. THERE HAS BEEN NO REPORTING OF THIS EPISODE IN LOCAL PRESS. WHEN EMBASSY OBTAINS TRANSLATION OF LETTER, WE WILL REPORT FURTHER. EMBASSY COMMENT: ABOVE (FIRST NOTED IN TEHRAN 9692, PARA FOUR) IS FIRST TIME THAT WE KNOW OF WHERE ANY PUNITIVE ACTION HAS BEEN TAKEN AGAINST ANY SIGNERS OF LETTER TO GOI OFFICIALS. IN THIS CASE, HOWEVER, SUSPENSION WAS APPARENTLY FOR REFUSAL TO REAFFIRM LOYALTY RATHER THAN PROTEST ITSELF.

VIEW IMPORTANCE OF QUESTIONS RAISED REFTEL AND EMBASSY'S DESIRE TO COMMENT ON BASIS OF MOST REALISTIC, UP-TO-DATE INFORMATION POSSIBLE, WE HAVE INITIATED DISCREET INQUIRIES WITH GOI AND WILL REPORT BACK ASAP.

1977TEHRAN10078.subject: GDR FOREIGN MINISTER'S VISIT TO IRAN 11/9-13/77

segments.text: GDR FOREIGN MINISTER OSKAR FISCHER PAID FIRST VISIT BY GDR FOREIGN MINISTER TO IRAN SINCE DIPLOMATIC RELATIONS ESTABLISHED IN 1972. WHILE HERE, FISCHER MET SHAH AND HAD DISCUSSIONS WITH FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATABARI. ONLY SUBSTANTIAL PIECE OF BUSINESS THAT WE CAN DISCOVER WAS INVITATION PRESENTED TO SHAH TO VISIT GDR. AT DEPARTURE PRESS CONFERENCE FISCHER SAID SHAH HAD ACCEPTED THE INVITATION TO COME AT SOME FUTURE TIME AS YET UNDETERMINED.

VISIT APPEARS TO HAVE BEEN PURELY CEREMONIAL EFFORT TO STRENGTHEN RELATIONS BETWEEN EAST GERMANY AND IRAN. FISCHER SAID IRANIANS INDICATED A SIMILARITY OF VIEWS BETWEEN THE TWO COUNTRIES ON ALL ISSUES. WHILE NEITHER OUR EAST GERMAN COLLEAGUES NOR FOREIGN MINISTRY SOURCES SEEMED AWARE OF ANY SPECIAL EFFORT TO OPEN UP NEW CHANNELS FOR COOPERATION, FEELING PERSISTS THAT FISHCER MAY HAVE BROACHED POSSIBLE OIL DEAL WITH GOI AT SOME POINT. EAST GERMANS FIRM IN SAYING THAT VISIT WAS PURELY ONE OF FRIENDSHIP AND COOPERATION.

EVENING OF NOVEMBER 14 I HAD AN OPPORTUNITY TO ASK SOVIET AMBASSADOR VINOGRADOV HOW AMBASSADOR MENDELEVICH'S TALKS WITH THE IRANIANS WENT ON THE INDIAN OCEAN. VINOGRADOV TOLD ME THAT MENDELEVICH HAD GIVEN THE IRANIANS A STATUS REPORT ON THE US-USSR TALKS WHICH AS HE DESCRIBED IT WAS VERY MUCH ALONG THE LINES OF THE SAME REPORT WE HAD GIVEN THE GOI ON THE BASIS OF STATE 238371 AND 241701. VINOGRADOV SAID THAT INITIALLY HE HAD SENSED THAT THE IRANIANS WERE WORRIED THAT THE U.S. AND USSR MAY BE WORKING OUT SOME KIND OF ARRANGEMENT BEHIND IRAN'S BACK WHICH COULD PROVE TO BE TO IRAN'S DISADVANTAGE.

HE SAID ALSO THAT THE IRANIANS HAD EXPRESSED SOME IRRITATION AT NOT BEING INCLUDED IN THE TALKS AND/OR NOT BEING KEPT MORE CLOSELY INFORMED. ACCORDING TO VINOGRADOV THE IRANIANS SEEMED MUCH MORE RELAXED AT THE CONCLUSION OF THE SOVIET EXPLANATION AND PLEASED THAT THE SOVIETS HAD TAKEN THE TROUBLE TO SEND THE HEAD OF THEIR DELEGATION TO TEHRAN TO FILL THEM IN ON OUR TALKS. HE SAID THAT MENDELEVICH HAD "DIPLOMATICALLY" MADE THE POINT THAT THE INDIAN OCEAN WAS NOT THE EXCLUSIVE PRESERVE OF THE LITTORAL STATES AND THAT MARITIME POWERS SUCH AS THE U.S.

AND USSR HAD LEGITIMATE RIGHTS IN CRUISING THE AREA MAKING FRIENDLY MILITARY VESSEL PORT CALLS AND OTHERWISE INSURING THAT THE SEA LANES WERE OPEN AND SAFE FOR COMMERCIAL PASSAGE. HE SAID THAT MEDELEVICH WENT ON TO MAKE THE POINT THAT THE U.S. AND THE USSR WERE NOT AT THE STAGE OF CONFRONTATION IN THE INDIAN OCEAN AND THAT THE PRINCIPAL PURPOSE OF THE U.S.-USSR TALKS WAS TO INSURE THAT NEITHER SIDE INCREASED ITS MILITARY PRESENCE IN THE AREA TO A CONFRONTATION LEVEL.

MENDELEVICH ASSURED THE IRANIANS THAT THE US-USSR TALKS IN NO WAY IMPINGED ON IRANIAN INTEREST WHICH HE ACKNOWLEDGED WERE LEGITIMATE--IRAN BEING ONE OF THE INDIAN OCEAN'S LITTORAL STATES--AND SAID THAT THERE WAS NO INTENTION OF A DEAL BEING MADE BEHIND IRAN'S BACK. IN SUM, VINOGRADOV THOUGHT THAT THE TALKS HAD GONE VERY WELL AND THAT THEY HAD BEEN PARTICULARLY USEFUL AND TIMELY IN VIEW OF THE SHAH'S IMMINENT MEETING WITH PRESIDENT CARTER, WHERE THE SUBJECT OF THE INDIAN OCEAN MIGHT COME UP.

EARLIER IN THE DAY I HAD ASKED ACTING FOREIGN MINISTER ZELLI HOW THE MENDELEVICH TALKS HAD GONE. ZELLI EVIDENCED SURPRISE THAT I WAS AWARE OF MENDELEVICH'S VISIT AND SAID THAT HE HAD NOT MENTIONED IT TO ME BECAUSE "YOU HAVE NOT CHOSEN TO TELL US ABOUT THE US-USSR TALKS." HE ADDED THAT HE COULD NOT SAY ANYTHING FURTHER ON THE SUBJECT. I REMONSTRATED THAT HIS WAS NOT TRUE AND THAT WE HAD IN FACT PROVIDED THE SHAH AND THE FOREIGN MINISTER WITH TWO STATUS REPORTS. ZELLI SAID THAT HE WAS NOT AWARE OF THIS.

COMMENT: THIS IS ANOTHER EXAMPLE OF THE LESS THAN PERFECT COMMUNICATION BETWEEN THE COURT AND FOREIGN MINISTER AND INDEED WITHIN THE FOREIGN MINISTRY ITSELF. IT REFLECTS ALSO SUSPICIONS NEVER VERY FAR BELOW THE SURFACE IN IRANIAN MINDS ABOUT GREATER POWER MACHINATIONS TO THE EXTENT THAT WE CAN ALLEVIATE THESE SUSPICIONS BY KEEPING IRAN INFORMED ON MATTERS SUCH AS THIS, SO MUCH THE BETTER. IT WOULD BE APPRECIATED IF THE DEPARTMENT WOULD BEAR THIS IN MIND AS WE MOVE INTO THE NEXT ROUND OF OUR TALKS WITH THE SOVIETS ON THE INDIAN OCEAN.

1977TEHRAN10124.subject: SHAH ORDERS "PROSECUTION" OF FORMER MINISTER OF ENERGY OFFICIALS

segments.text: ENERGY OFFICIALS

BEGIN UNCLASSIFIED: ENGLISH LANGUAGE KAYHAN INTERNATIONAL AND TEHRAN JOURNAL FOR NOVEMBER 13, 1977 CARRIED LENGTHY STORIES ON AN ORDER ISSUED BY THE SHAH CALLING FOR " 049 3:7589," OF FORMER MINISTRY OF ENERGY OFFICIALS FOR THEIR FAILURES WHICH LED TO WIDESPREAD POWER SHORTAGES IN IRAN THIS SUMMER. FOLLOWING A REPORT SUBMITTED BY AN IMPERIAL COMMISSION INSPECTION TEAM ON THE REASONS FOR THE POWER FAILURES, THE SHAH DIRECTED THAT A FORMER ENERGY MINISTER (APPARENTLY IRAJ VAHIDI) THE LATTER'S TECHNICAL AFFAIRS DEPUTY (GHOLAMREZA HAZRATI) AND THE HEAD OF TAVANIR (JALINOUS), AN AUTONOMOUS POWER GENERATING AND TRANSMISSION COMPANY WHOLLY OWNED BY THE GOI, BE BROUGHT TO "TRIAL".

ALTHOUGH THE THREE MEN WERE NOT MENTIONED BY NAME IN THE IMPERIAL COMMISSION'S REPORT, IT IS EXPECTED THAT SUBSEQUENT TESTIMONY BY INSPECTORS BEFORE THE SPECIAL BOARD OF INQUIRY WILL RESULT IN ONE OR MORE OF THE THREE BEING FOUND CULPABLE.

SPECIFICALLY, THE IMPOERIAL COMMISSION FOUND THAT THE POWER SHORTAGE WAS CAUSED BY GOVERNMENTAL INEPTITUDES IN THE FOLLOWING AREAS: (A) LACK OF COOPERATION AND COORDINATION BETWEEN THE MINISTRY OF ENERGY AND ITS AUTONOMOUS DEPENDENCY, TAVANIR; (B) INCOMPETENCE OF THE CONSULTING ENGINEER (UNNAMED); (C) ABSENCE OF A STRONG ENGINEERING CAPACITY WITHIN THE MINISTRY OF ENERGY; (D) REPEATED FAILURES BY CONTRACTORS TO OBTAIN NECESSARY APPROVALS FROM THE MINISTRY OF ECONOMIC AFFAIRS AND FINANCE; (E) FAILURE OF TAVANIR TO INCLUDE PERFORMANCE TIMETABLES IN ITS CONTRACTS; (F) GENERAL INCOMPETENCE AND ABSENCE OF EFFECTIVE DECISION MAKING BOTH IN THE MINISTRY AND IN TAVANIR; AND (G) BAD ORGANIZATION THROUGHOUT THE MINISTRY OF ENERGY AND TAVANIR.

ON THE SAME DAY THAT THE SHAH'S ORDER APPEARED IN THE PRESS, THE DIRECTOR OF THE MONARCH'S SPECIAL BUREAU, MOINIAN, LASHED OUT AT UNNAMED GOVERNMENT EXECUTIVES FOR THEIR "FAILURES, NEGLIGENCE, FLIPPANCY, BUCK-PASSING AND INCOMPETENCE". HE SAID THAT OFFICIALS GUILTY OF "WASTING WEEKS, MONTHS AND EVEN YEARS" WOULD NOT GO SCOT-FREE.

PREDICTABLY, ONE OF THE THREE ACCUSED, AT LEAST, BEGAN LOOKING TO HIS OWN DEFENSES. TEHRAN JOURNAL OF NOVEMBER 14 QUOTES THE FORMER HEAD OF TAVANIR AS SAYING THAT IT WAS ALL THE FAULT OF "WEAK DECISION MAKING" BY EX-MINISTER OF ENERGY VAHIDI. THE FORMER TAVANIR HEAD SAID THAT HE WAS IN CHARGE OF THAT CORPORATION FOR ONLY SIX MONTHS AND CONFIRMED THAT HE HAD SERIOUS DIFFICULTIES WITH HIS DEPUTY, HAZRATI, WHO WRONGLY "INSISTED ON CONTROLLING PROCUREMENT. PROCEDURES." END UNCLASSIFIED.

BEGIN LIMITED OFFICIAL USE. THE EMBASSY UNDERSTANDS THAT THE PROCEDURES TO BE TAKEN AGAINST THE THREE NAMED INDIVIDUALS WILL BE ESSENTIALLY AN ADMINISTRATIVE PROCESS RATHER THAN FORMAL JUDICIAL PROCESS. HOWEVER,THE SPECIAL BOARD OF INQUIRY CAN RECOMMEND TO THE GOVERNMENT THAT A FORMAL PROSECUTION BE LAUNCHED. BEFORE ANY PROSECUTION AGAINST A FORMER MINISTER (OR ACTIVE MINISTER) CAN BEGIN, THE CONCURRENCE OF THE MAJLES MUST BE OBTAINED. THE SHAH'S ACTION IN DIRECTING THIS SPECIAL INQUIRY IS HARDLY SURPRISING GIVEN WIDESPREAD DISSATISFACTION AT THE HIGHEST LEVEL OF THE GOI OVER THIS YEAR'S SEVERE POWER CUTS.

EARLIER THIS YEAR A FRENCH FIRM WHICH SUPPLIED GENERATORS FOR THE REZA SHAH KABIR DAM AND AN AMERICAN CONSULTING ENGINEERING FIRM WERE CRITICIZED BY THE GOI FOR THEIR ALLEGED POOR PERFORMANCE. MOST INFORMED OBSERVERS HERE WERE OF THE VIEW THAT MUCH OF THE FAULT LAY WITHIN THE GOI ITSELF, AND A FEW CYNICS DOUBTED THAT ANY GOI OFFICIAL WOULD EVER BE BROUGHT UP ON CHARGES. THE EMBASSY BELIEVES THAT THE SHAH'S DIRECTIVE IS INDICATIVE OF A GROWING TENDENCY OVER THE PAST FEW MONTHS TO SEARCH OUT MALFEASANCE WITHIN THE GOVERNMENT AND TO HOLD THE MALFACTORS ACCOUNTABLE, SOMETIMES PUBLICLY.

ONE WELL PLACED SOURCE IN THE MINISTRY OF ECONOMIC AFFAIRS AND FINANCE TOLD THE EMBASSY THAT HE HAD THE STRONG IMPRESSION THAT TAVANIR HEAD JALINOUS AND POSSIBLY OTHER IN TAVANIR WERE "CROOKED" BUT THAT MINISTER VAHIDI WAS PROBABLY BLAMELESS. END LIMITED OFFICIAL USE.

1977TEHRAN10184.subject: RECENT STUDENT AND OTHER DISSIDENT ACTIVITIES

segments.text: FOLLOWING INCIDENTS PIECED TOGETHER FROM VARIETY OF SOURCES INCLUDING JOURNALISTS, LOCAL ACADEMICS, EMBASSY'S OWN SY, AND DIPLOMATS WITH SOME PERSONAL KNOWLEDGE OF EVENTS DESCRIBED.

TEHRAN UNIV DISTURBANCES: ON NOV 3 TEHRAN UNIV STUDENTS WERE TOLD TO GATHER FOR A DISCUSSION WITH A DEAN OF THE UNIV (WHICH DEAN NOT SPECIFIED) WHO WOULD DISCUSS THEIR DEMANDS THAT DEPARTMENTAL LIBRARIES BE REOPENED (THEY HAD BEEN CLOSED IN SEPTEMBER BY NEW CHANCELLOR MOTAMEDI, WHO BELIEVED THEY WERE CENTERS OF STUDENT DISSIDENCE). INSTEAD OF DEAN, POLICE SHOWED UP, AND THERE WAS A SCUFFLE WHICH RESULTED IN A FEW INJURIES AND THE TAKING OF 150 STUDENT ID CARDS. SUBSEQUENT WEEK SAW STUDENT BOYCOTT OF CLASSES OVER QUESTION OF RETURNING ID CARDS. UNIV WANTED STUDENTS AND PARENTS TO COME IN TOGETHER TO RETRIEVE CARDS AND GET LECTURE ON PROPER BEHAVIOR.
STUDENTS REFUSED, AND FINALLY ON NOV 13, UNIV ADMINISTRATION PASSED WORD CARDS COULD BE RETRIEVED WITHOUT CONDITIONS. AS OF NOON NOV 15, MANY STUDENTS HAD RETRIEVED CARDS AND BOYCOTT APPEARED OVER.

ARYAMEHR TECHNICAL COLLEGE OUTING EVENING OF NOV 15: BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THOUSAND ARYAMEHR UNIV STUDENTS WHO HAD COME TO COLLEGE TO ATTEND ANTI-SHAH DEMONSTRATIONS COULD NOT GET INTO COLLEGE BECAUSE 8 THOUSAND OTHER STUDENTS WERE ALREADY THERE. THOSE WHO WERE EXCLUDED WENT ON RAMPAGE DOWN EISENHOWER BLVD SHOUTING SLOGANS AND BREAKING WINDOWS IN ABOUT 30 BUILDINGS. POLICE ARE SUPPOSED TO HAVE ARRESTED 40 STUDENTS. SENIOR POLICE COLONEL TOLD A US CONSULAR OFFICER THAT 2 POLICE OFFICERS HAD BEEN SHOT TO DEATH.
ACCORDING TO THE COLONEL, THIS WAS THE FIRST TIME POLICE HAD BEEN KILLED BY GUNFIRE FROM DEMONSTRATORS (AS OPPOSED TO ATTACKS ON ISOLATED MEN OR VEHICLES) AS FAR AS HE KNEW.

LOCAL PRESS MORNING NOV 17 ANNOUNCED SECURITY FORCES HAS ARRESTED 7 PEOPLE NOV 16. ARRESTS OCCURRED WHILE POLICE WERE DISPERSING ABOUT 100 DEMONSTRATORS IN TEHRAN WHO WERE EXPRESSING SOLIDARITY WITH TERRORISTS CONVICTED OF MURDERING AYATOLLAH SHAMSABADI. THESE DEMONSTRATIONS OCCURRED AT THE SHRINE OF HAZRAT ABDOLAZIM. ACCORDING TO PRESS AND PRIVATE SOURCES THERE HAVE BEEN SPORADIC DEMONSTRATIONS BY SMALL GROUPS OF SUPPORTERS OF THOSE WHO KILLED SHAMSABADI IN VARIOUS PARTS OF THE CITY OVER THE PAST 2 DAYS. THESE HAVE MOSTLY CONSISTED OF RANDOM ROCK THROWING AND SHOUTING OF SLOGANS FAVORING THE EXILED AYATOLLAH KHOMENINI.

STRONG RUMOR HAS IT THAT SAVAK RECENTLY ARRANGED KILLING OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI'S SON, WHO WAS LIVING WITH HIM IN IRAQ. STORY WAS SO STRONGLY BELIEVED HERE THAT MIN INFO HOMAYOUN REPORTEDLY ADVISED LOCAL PRESS NOT REPEAT NOT TO REFER TO IT. NEVERTHELESS, KHOMEINI SUPPORTERS HELD "SYMBOLIC" FUNERALS IN ISFAHAN AND QOM. EVENT IN ISFAHAN WAS QUIET AND ORDERLY, BUT POLICE "BASHED A FEW HEADS" IN QOM, ACCORDING TO ONE LOCAL OBSERVER.

EMBASSY COMMENT: IT APPEAR DEMONSTRATIONS NOTED ABOVE WERE ALL TIMED TO COINCIDE WITH SHAH'S US VISIT. ALTHOUGH ONLY ARYAMEHR DEMONSTRATION AND PERHAPS ONE OR TWO OTHER RUMORED MEETINGS AT OTHER SCHOOLS WERE DIRECTLY ANTI-SHAH AND ANTI-VISIT, EMB HAS HEARD OF, BUT NOT SEEN, TEHRAN UNIV STUDENT BROADSIDE LEAFLET CRITICAL OF SHAH'S WASHINGTON TRIP. IF WE ACQUIRE IT, WILL FORWARD TO DEPT.

1977TEHRAN10211.subject: SOME DETAILS ABOUT LETTER OF INTENT FOR IRAN'S PURCHASE OF FOUR GERMAN POWER REACTORS

segments.text: DURING CONVERSATION TODAY WITH GERMAN EMBASSY OFFICERS, EMBOFFS LEARNED THAT LETTER OF INTENT SIGNED 10 NOVEMBER FOR IRANIAN PURCHASE OF FOUR 1,200 MW DRY-COOLED NUCLEAR POWER REACTORS IS FOR MECHANICAL (INCLUDING REACTORS) AND ELECTRICAL COMPONENTS ONLY. CONSTRUCTION WORK WILL BE SUBJECT INTERNATIONAL TENDER FOR BIDS. DRY COOLING COMPONENTS, WHICH ARE CLOSEDSYSTEM 230 METER HIGH TOWERS OF A DESIGN NOT YET COMPLETED, WILL BE OBJECT OF SEPARATE KRAFTWERKUNION (KWU) CONTRACT. FINANCING SPECIFICS NOT COVERED IN LETTER OF INTENT, BUT DEUTSCHEBANK NOW WORKING ON PUTTING TOGETHER A CONSORTIUM THAT WILL NEGOTIATE WITH GOI FOR FINANCING TO COVER MECHANICAL AND ELECTRICAL COMPONENTS COSTS.

KWU WILL RECEIVE CONSULTING FEE FOR DEVELOPING SPECIFICATIONS, ETC. FOR CONSTRUCTION WORK, WHICH WILL BE INTERNATIONAL TENDER. GERMAN EMBOFFS DID NOT KNOW TOTAL VALUE OF FINANCIAL PACKAGE, BUT STATED THAT GOI HAS SO FAR NOT DEMANDED OIL BARTER ALTHOUGH IT IS ON THE RECORD AS SAYING THIS SUBJECT WILL BE RAISED IN FUTURE. CURRENT TIMETABLE CALLS FOR NEGOTIATIONS AND BIDDING TO BE FINISHED WITHIN SIX MONTHS FOR SIGNING OF COMPREHENSIVE CONTRACT.

ABOUT 2,000 GERMAN AND EXPAT TECHNICIANS WILL BE ON SITE, ABOUT THE SAME NUMBER NOW AT BUSHEHR WORKING ON IRAN PLANTS ONE AND TWO, WHERE CONSTRUCTION IS ON SCHEDULE. TWENTY-THREE SITE SURVEYS HAVE BEEN DONE AND AEOI IS CLOSE TO SELECTING THE ISFAHAN SITE FOR WHAT WILL BE IRAN FIVE AND SEVEN. IRAN SIX AND EIGHT WILL BE IN CENTRAL PROVINCE, WITH LOCATION NEAR SAVEH THE LEADING SITE CONTENDER. CONSTRUCTION IS SCHEDULED TO BEGIN NEAR ISFAHAN ON IRAN FIVE LATE IN 1978 OR VERY EARLY IN 1979. WORK ON THE NEXT PLANT IN CENTRAL PROVINCE WILL COMMENCE ONE YEAR LATER, WITH THE OTHERS FOLLOWING AT ONE YEAR INTERVALS.

EACH PLANT IS TO BE COMPLETED IN FIVE YEARS. THE REACTORS FOR THESE FOUR PLANTS WILL BE EXACTLY THE SAME AS THOSE IN IRAN ONE AND TWO, WITH CAPACITY IN EXCESS OF 1,200 MW AND CLOSE TO 1,300 MW. INLAND TRANSPORT OF GERMAN REACTORS WILL BE DIFFICULT, BY RAIL SOME 1,200 KILOMETERS FROM PERSIAN GULF.

LETTER OF INTENT SPECIFIES THAT ONLY INITIAL FUEL LOAD WILL BE PROVIDED (NOT A TEN YEAR SUPPLY AS IS THE CASE WITH IRAN ONE AND TWO). NORMAL NPT AND IAEA PROVISIONS APPLY, AND SHOULD IRAN ABROGATE ITS NPT SAFEGUARDS, AGREEMENT WITH FRG WOULD STILL APPLY AND COULD NOT BE CANCELLED. IRAN MAY STRORE ITS SPENT FUEL OR MAY REPROCESS IN THIRD COUNTRY WITH FRG'S PRIOR APPROVAL.

THERE ARE NOW 25 IRANIAN POST-GRADUATE STUDENTS STUDYING ADVANCED NUCLEAR SCIENCE IN GERMANY FOR TWO YEARS, PLUS 300 OPERATORS OR TECHNICIANS UNDERGOING TWO TO THREE YEAR TRAINING PROGRAMS. FRG IS HAVING SOME PROBLEMS WITH THIS LATTER GROUP WHICH LIKE THAT IN FRANCE IS UNDERQUALIFIED AND LACKING IN MOTIVATION: THE TRAINEES PREFER EUROPEAN AMENITIES TO DILIGENT STUDY. GERMAN EMBASSY SCIATT COMMENTED THAT HE KNEW FRENCH NUCLEAR OFFICIALS ARE WORRIED BECAUSE FIRST GROUP OF SOME 20 POST GRADUATE ADVANCED STUDENTS SOON TO RETURN FROM FRANCE ARE IN FRENCH EYES AT LEAST SUB-STANDARD.
TEHRAN 09684

YOUR ATTENTION IS DIRECTED TO SECTION 22 (COMMENTS) OF REFTEL B WHEREIN ALL SOURCES AVAILABLE DENY ANY KNOWLEDGE OR SUBSTANCE TO REPORTS THAT FOUR ORGANIZATIONS IN IRAN ARE NOW TARGETING AMERICANS AND SENIOR IRANIAN OFFICIALS AND THAT THEREWOULD BE VIOLENT ACTIVITY BY THE END OF NOVEMBER. SOURCE OF THIS INFORMATION, AS INDICATED REFTEL B, APPEARS TO HAVE BEEN AN OVERZEALOUS ACTION BY THE LIAISON OFFICER OF THE OFFICE OF THE COMMANDER, COUNTERINTELLIGENCE COMMAND (CIC), POSSIBLY CONCERNED OVER THE POSSIBILITY OF VIOLENCE DURING THE SHAH'S VISIT TO THE U.S.

ASSESSMENT OF U.S. MISSION RE LOCAL TERRORIST THREAT REMAINS AS INDICATED PARA 1-B OF REFTEL C. WHILE TERRORIST THREAT TO AMERICANS HERE CONTINUES, U.S. MISSION HAS NO RPT NO KNOWLEDGE OF ANY ACTIVITIES OR PLANS OF TERRORIST GROUPS FOR ACTS AGAINST AMERICANS OR SENIOR IRANIAN OFFICIALS.

1977TEHRAN10213.subject: DINNER INVITATION AMBASSADOR ALI-NURI ESFANDIARI (THE TENNIS PLAYER) HAS ASKED ME WHETHER YOU COULD COME TO DINNER EVENING NOV 27.

segments.text: AMBASSADOR ALI-NURI ESFANDIARI (THE TENNIS PLAYER) HAS ASKED ME WHETHER YOU COULD COME TO DINNER EVENING NOV 27. MARIA INCLUDED IF SHE IS BACK. WHAT IS YOUR WISH? AT THIS POINT ONLY OTHER EVENT WE KNOW OF FOR THAT EVENING IS YUGOSLAVIA NATIONAL DAY RECEPTION.

SUMMARY: FIFTY-SIX OPPOSITIONISTS, INCLUDING MANY FIGURES PROMINENT IN PAST DISSIDENT ACTIVITIES, ISSUED LETTER ON EVE OF SHAH'S U.S. VISIT CALLING FOR RETURN TO DEMOCRATIC GOVERNMENT, STRENGTHENING OF JUDICIAL SYSTEM, NEW ELECTIONS FOR ALL MAJOR LEGISLATIVE BODIES, AND ABOLITION OF SECURITY POLICE ORGANIZATIONS. LETTER IS SIMILAR TO, BUT MORE THOROUGH THAN, OTHER EFFORTS OF PAST TWO MONTHS, AND SIGNATORIES REPRESENT MANY OF SAME (EXTREMIST) GROUPS WHICH HAVE ISSUED LETTERS PREVIOUSLY. SOME EMBASSY CONTACTS WHO CANNOT BE CONSIDERED AS UNSYMPATHETIC TO WRITERS' SENTIMENTS NEVERTHELESS TELL US THEY ARE DISAPPOINTED AT LACK OF SUBSTANCE IN THESE GENERALIZED COMPLAINTS. END SUMMARY.

WASHINGTON POST'S BRANIGAN IN NOVEMBER THIRTEEN BYLINE STROY FROM TEHRAN (USINFO NOVEMBER FOURTEEN) MENTIONED LETTER SIGNED BY FIFTY-SIX IRANIANS AND RELEASED ON EVE OF SHAH'S VISIT. IT BEGINS BY NOTING THAT POLITICAL SYSTEM WHICH HAS EVOLVED IN IRAN OVER PAST TWENTY-FOUR YEARS IS NOW FACING A CRISIS WHICH CAN ONLY BE SUCCESSFULLY RESOLVED BY RETURN TO ORIGINAL CONSTITUTIONAL PRINCIPLES OF 1906 CONSTITUTIONAL REVOLUTION. AFTER DETAILING EXECUTIVE EXCESSES IN SOMEWHAT FLORID AND HIGHLY INTELLECTUAL LANGUAGE, AUTHORS CLOSE WITH TEN DEMANDS COMPREHENSIVE IMPLEMENTATION OF PRINCIPLES OF IRANIAN CONSTITUTIONAL LAW RELEASE OF POLITICAL PRISONERS AND RETURN OF EXILES

ABOLITION OF THE SINGLE-PARTY SYSTEM AND FREEDOM OF FORMATION FOR POLITICAL PARTIES, RELIGIOUS ASSOCIATIONS, AND TRADE GUILDS AND UNIONS FREEDOM OF PRESS AND PUBLICATIONS FREEDOM OF OPINION AND EXPRESSION OF THOUGHT
DISSOLUTION OF BOTH HOUSES OF PARLIAMENT AND CITY COUNCILS; AND NEW ELECTIONS BASED OF FULLY FREE, PUBLIC VOTING
REVIVING INDEPENDENCE OF JUDICIARY AND RESTORATION OF GENERAL JURISDICTION OF COURTS CONCURRENT WITH DISSOLUTION OF ALL SPECIAL TRIBUNALS

DISSOLUTION OF ALL ORGANIZATIONS AND AGENCIES WHICH E VIOLATED PEOPLE'S INDIVIDUAL AND SOCIAL LIBERTIES BOTH IN PAST AND AT PRESENT, FREQUENTLY NOT FOREGOING OPEN AND COVERT VIOLENCE IN DOING SO. (COMMENT: KNOWLEDGEABLE IRANIANS UNDERSTAND THIS MEANS SAVAK) PROSECUTION AND PENALTIES FOR ALL VIOLATORS OF PEOPLE'S AND SOCIETY'S BASIC RIGHTS AND INTERESTS
PROMOTION OF CONDITIONS NECESSARY FOR THE IMPLEMENTATION OF HUMAN RIGHTS THROUGH IRAN'S SUBSCRIBING TO THE PROTOCOL APPENDED TO THE INTERNATIONAL TREATY (SIC) OF CIVIL AND POLITICAL RIGHTS.

CONTRARY TO IMPRESSION OF BARANIGAN ARTICLE, LETTER IS NOT REPEAT NOT WORK OF "GROWING MIDDLE-OF-THE-ROAD" DISSENT MOVEMENT, BUT WORK OF ESSENTIALLY SAME GROUPS IN IRANIAN SOCIETY WHICH HAVE BEEN BEHIND ALL LETTERS SURFACING OVER PAST SEVEN MONTHS. PROGRAM IS SIMILAR TO OFFERINGS NOTED IN REF (A), LONG ON GENERALITIES AND VAGUE ON HOW TO ACCOMPLISH THEM. WE UNDERSTAND SAME GROUP, LED BY ALI-ASGHAR HAJ-SEYED-JAVADI, ENG. MEHDI BAZARGAN, AND DR. KARIM SANJABI, HAS DRAFTED MOST DISSIDENT OUTPUT OF PAST MONTHS. AS BRANIGAN NOTES, LETTER WAS GIVEN TO FOREIGN PRESS AND CLEARLY DESIGNED TO PUT PRESSURE ON THE SHAH DURING HIS WASHINGTON VISIT.

WHILE PROPOSALS DO NOT SOUND BAD, THEY HAVE DEFINITE POLLYANNA-ISH RING ABOUT THEM, AND MOST OBSERVERS OF IRANIAN SCENE, WHILE WISHING FOR MORE LIBERALIZATION, WOULD HARDLY AGREE WITH CHARACTERIZATION OF PRESENT-DAY IRAN AS UNQUALIFIED "DICTATORSHIP". GROUP RESPONSIBLE FOR THIS LETTER IS SOLIDLY TO THE LEFT, RADICAL SIDE OF IRANIAN POLITICAL CENTER AND SO RECOGNIZED BY MOST WHO ARE POLITICALLY AWARE, WHETHER THEY AGREE WITH PROPOSALS OR NOT.

TO BEST OF OUR KNOWLEDGE, LETTER HAS BEEN CIRCULATED ONLY PRIVATELY; SEVERAL IRANIANS HEARD OF IT FOR FIRST TIME WHEN PRECIS OF BRANIGAN PIECE APPEARED HERE IN NOVEMBER FOURTEEN INTERNATIONAL HERALD TRIBUNE. MOST INTERESTING SPECULATION, HOWEVER, CENTERS ON WHETHER GOI WILL CRACK DOWN ON SUCH ACTIVITY, OR WHETHER SUCH RELEASES WILL CONTINUE AND, IF SO, WHAT EFFECT THEY WILL EVENTUALLY HAVE. COGENCY, DEPTH, AND ACCURACY OF ANALYSIS WITH RESPECT TO PRESENT CONDITIONS IN IRAN NOT, REPEAT NOT, VERY PROFOUND.

SEVERAL OF OUR CONTACTS (WHO COULD BY NO MEANS BE DESCRIBED AS SYMPATHETIC TO GOI), WHILE PLEASED THAT DISSENT IS EMERGING INTO THE OPEN, ARE DISAPPOINTED AT UNREALISTICALLY SWEEPING DEMANDS AND GRANDIOSE RHETORIC OF ONCE-PROGRESSIVE NATIONAL FRONTERS "WHO NOW SEEM RATHER JADED AND LEFT BEHIND". AND "WHO OUGHT TO BE ABLE TO DO BETTER."

1977TEHRAN10221.subject: COOPERATION IN INTERNAL SECURITY MATTERS BETWEEN IRAN AND UAE

segments.text: POL COUNS CHECKED OUT UAE VISITS WITH MFA DEPARTMENT HEAD DAVOUDI NOVEMBER SEVENTEEN. DAVOUDI SAID HE HAD BEEN PRESENT AT SHEIKH ZAYID'S MEETINGS WITH SHAH AND OTHER IRANIAN OFFICIALS AND COULD ASSURE US THAT MOST OF THE INFORMATION APPEARING IN NEWSPAPER COVERAGE OF THE VISIT WAS PURE FABRICATION. HE NOTED ONE STORY THAT VISIT BY SHEIKH OF RAS AL-KHAIMAH HAD BEEN TO PREPARE ZAYID'S VISIT HERE; DAVOUDI SAID THE TWO VISITS WERE COINCIDENTAL AND HAD NO CONNECTION WITH EACH OTHER.

SITUATION IN THE GULF WAS DISCUSSED GENERALLY, ACCORDING TO DAVOUDI, BUT ALWAYS IN TERMS OF SUPPORT FOR PEACE IN THE GULF, DESIRE TO KEEP STUDYING PROBLEM OF TERRORISM, ETC. IRANIANS COULD DETECT NO CHANGE IN UAEG POSITION REGARDING COLLECTIVE SECURITY OF THE GULF AND, IN FACT, THE MATTER NEVER AROSE IN THOSE TERMS. DAVOUDI KNEW NOTHING ABOUT OREINTATION TOURS BY UAE PERSONNEL TO IRAN AND VICE VERSA (REF A), THOUGH HE DID NOT RULE THIS OUT. HE CHARACTERIZED THE VISIT AS ROUTINE, PERIODIC EXCHANGE WHICH MAINTAINED GENERALLY GOOD RELATIONS BUT DOES NOT REPRESENT ANY SPECIAL NEW POLICY DEPARTURES.
IN REPLY TO QUESTION, DAVOUDI SAID THERE WERE NO CURRENT PLANS FOR ANOTHER MEETING OF GULF STATES TO DISCUSS COLLECTIVE SECURITY.

COMMENT: WHILE DAVOUDI WAS CATEGORIC ABOUT THE MEETINGS HE ATTENDED, THIS DOES NOT RULE OUT BUSINESS BEING CONDUCTED DIRECTLY BETWEEN SHEIKH ZAYID AND THE SHAH OR INDIRECTLY THROUGH OTHERS IN ZAYID'S ENTOURAGE. EMBASSY WILL REPORT FURTHER AS SUCH INFORMATION COMES TO LIGHT. OUR GENERAL IMPRESSION REMAINS THAT IRAN WILL ASSIST UAE OR OTHER GULF STATES IN INTERNAL SECURITY OR SIMILAR AREAS TO THE EXTENT SUCH ASSISTANCE IS SPECIFICALLY REQUESTED (USUALLY IN WRITING), BUT WILL CONTINUE TO BE CAUTIOUS ABOUT APPEARING TO BE FORCING ITS ASSISTANCE OR PRESENCE ON ANY OF THEM.

INCIDENTALLY, DAVOUDI AND OTHER EMBASSY SOURCES INDICATE VISIT OF SAUDI ARABIA'S INTERIOR MINISTER NAIF (TEHRAN 9936--NOTAL) WAS ALSO ROUTINE "GET ACQUAINTED" VISIT AND DID NOT DEAL WITH SUBSTANTIVE SECURITY MATTERS. NAIF DID NOT TALK WITH IRANIAN SECURITY SERVICES, JUST POLICE.

1977TEHRAN10281.subject: GOI REQUEST FOR CLARIFICATION RE POSSIBLE SENATE INVESTIGATION

segments.text: INVESTIGATION

DURING MY MEETING WITH MINISTER OF COURT HOVEYDA NOVEMBER 20 HE MENTIONED A REPORT IN THE WASHINGTON STAR TO THE EFFECT THAT A SUB-COMMITTEE OF THE SENATE FOREIGN RELATIONS COMMITTEE, HEADED BY SENATOR MCGOVERN, IS PREPARING TO UNDERTAKE INVESTIGATION OF THE DEMONSTRATIONS ATTENDING THE SHAH'S VISIT TO WASHINGTON. THE SUB-COMMITTEE APPARENTLY INTENDS TO CONDUCT THIS INVESTIGATION WITH A VIEW IN PARTICULAR TO DETERMINING WHETHER GOI FINANCING WAS INVOLVED IN GETTING PRO-SHAH DEMONSTRATORS TO WASHINGTON, AND WHETHER THERE MIGHT HAVE BEEN VIOLATIONS OF U.S. LAW.
HOVEYDA SAID FINANCING HAD BEEN BY WEALTHY BUSINESSMEN AND OTHER PATRIOTIC INDIVIDUALS, NOT THE GOI. HE NOTED SOME DEMONSTRATORS HAD PAID THEIR OWN WAY.

HOVEYDA ASKED IF WE COULD CLARIFY FOR HIM WHAT LIES BEHIND THIS REPORT. HE ADDED THAT, IFSENATOR MCGOVERN DOES UNDERTAKE SUCH AN INVESTIGATION, GOI WOULD HOPE INVESTIGATION WOULD CONCENTRATE WITH EQUAL VIGOR ON SOURCES OF FINANCING FOR ANTI-SHAH DEMONSTRATORS.
WOULD APPRECIATE ANY CLARIFICATION DEPARTMENT CAN PROVIDE.
REF TEHRAN 10303

SUMMARY. THERE HAS BEEN ONE ADDITIONAL MAJOR POLICE/ STUDENT CONFRONTATION SINCE NOVEMBER TWENTY-ONE, AND FOR THE FIRST TIME, POLICE HAVE BROKEN UP A NON-STUDENT OPPOSITION GROUP. AT LEAST ONE STUDENT HAS REPORDEDLY DIED FROM INJURIES SUSTAINED IN EARLIER POLICE RAID ON TEHRAN UNIVERSITY. UNIVERSITY CHANCELLORS HAVE BEEN CALLED TO TEHRAN TO HEAR GOI'S DECENTRALIZATION PLAN AND DISCUSS STUDENT DEMONSTRATIONS. GOVERNMENT SOURCES DO NOT DENY THESIS THAT RECENT POLICE CRACKDOWNS HAVE BEEN DIRECTED BY HIGHER AUTHORITY. SUCH PROBABILITY IS GETTING INCREASINGLY LIKELY IN OUR VIEW. END SUMMARY.

EVENING OF MONDAY, NOVEMBER 21, MAHMOUD ETEMADZADEH (ALIAS BEHAZIM) SECOND-RANK OPPOSITION FIGURE, WAS SCHDULED TO GIVE TWICE-POSTPONED TALK ON CONCEPT OF FREEDOM TO ARYAMEHR TECHNICAL COLLEGE. ABOUT 1730 LOCAL TIME, A CROWD OF ONE THOUSAND CATHERED TO HEAR THE LECUTRE, ONLY TO FIND POSTER ANNOUNCING THIRD CANCELLATION. GROUP REPORTEDLY MILLED AROUND AND WAS BEGINNING TO DISPERSE, ACCORDING TO TWO EYEWITNESSES (NEWSMEN) AT SCENE, WHEN THREE GREEN BUS/VANS ARRIVED AND GROUP OF YOUNG MEN ARMED WITH BARREL STAVES BEGAN BEATING UP CROWD AND CHASING THEM AWAY.

AFTER ABOUT FIVE MINUTES, RIOT POLICE ARRIVED, AND AT LEAST ONE IRANIAN AND ONE WESTERN JOURNALIST OBSERVED MEN FROM GREEN BUSSES HELPING POLICE ROUND UP ABOUT TWENTY 59 THIRTY STRAGGLERS WHO WERE ARRESTED.

ACCORDING TO WESTERN JOURANLIST WHO HAD BEEN PRESENT AT ONE OF TWO OF PREVIOUS INCIDENTS, THIS WAS FIRST TIME RIOT POLICE HAD NOT BEEN PRESENT AT ARYAMEHR FROM BEGINNING OF ANNOUNCED READING/LECTURE, AND HE THINKS (AS DO NUMBER OF IRANIANS) THAT MEN FROM GREEN BUSSES WERE GOI (READ SAVAK) ORGANIZED TO BREAK UP OPPOSITIONIST GATHERING. JORANOLIST SAYS HE SAW SEVERAL LEFT-WING NATIONAL FRONT INTELLECTUALS PRESENT, AND AMERICAN JOURNSLIST WHO CAME ALONG LATER SAID NUMBER OF STUDENTS FROM OTHER UNIVERSITIES WERE THERE. THOUGH CROWD WAS ONLY ABOUT ONE THOUSAND, IT REPRESENTED MOST TEHRAN UNIVERSITIES AND GROUPS WHICH HAVE BEEN WRITING LETTERS OVER RECENT MONTHS.
NONE OF THE ABOVE HAS APPEARED IN LOCAL PRESS.

COINCIDENTALLY, POLCOUNS BUMPED INTO PROMINENT LAWYER-SIGNER OF AT LEAST ONE OPPOSITION LETTER, WHO OFFERED FOLLOWING SPECIFICS: FIFTY ARYAMEHR TECHNICAL COLLEGE STUDENTS HAVE BEEN INDICTED BY A SINGLE TEHRAN EXAMINING MAGISTRATE, AND THESE INDICTMENTS ARE BEING ALLOWED TO STAND. JUDGES' PROTEST LETTER TO SUPREME COURT CHIEF YEGANEH (TEHRAN 10064) RESULTED IN INDIVIDIDUAL AND GROUP PRESSURE BEING PUT ON JUDGES TO SIGN SUPPLEMENTARY LETTER EXPLAINING THEIR DEMANDS IN MUCH MORE LIMITED TERMS. ABOUT TWELVE REFUSED TO SIGN, AND TWO OF THESE WILL BE MADE EXAMPLES OF-ONE A JUDGE OF TEHRAN'S COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE (ALI GERANMAYEH) AND A TEHRAN ASSISTANT PROSECUTING JUDGE.

FROM TWO DIFFERENT SOURCES WE UNDERSTAND POLICE RAIDED OPEN MEETING OF NATIONAL FRONT SUPPORTERS IN KARAJ EVENING OF NOVEMBER TWENTY-TWO AND BASHED HEADS. PUTTING SEVEN PEOPLE INTO HOSPITAL, INCLUDING AT LEAST ONE OR TWO SIGNERS OF EARLIER LAWYERS' LETTER TO GOI (ONE OF THEM PERHAPS MOSSADEGH GRANDSON HEDYATOLLAH MATIN-DAFTARI). AS FAR AS WE KNOW, THIS REPRESENTS FIRST DIRECT POLICE ACTION AIMED SPECIFICALLY AT OPENLY-ANNOUNCED POLITICAL GROUP MEETING. ------------------117571 270723Z /13 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 5567 INF RUDTC/AMEMBASSY LONDON 4727 SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 10362

SITUATION AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY CONTINUES TO DETERIORATE. APPARENTLY POLICE HAVE CONTINUED TO COME INTO TEHRAN UNIVERSITY CAMPUS EVERY MORNING SINCE MAJOR CONFRONTATION LAST SATURDAY (REFTEL) AND KNOCK A FEW HEADS EACH DAY BEFORE TAKING UP POSITIONS TO MAINTAIN ORDER. STUDENTS WHO ONLY WANT TO STUDY, ALSO, INTIMIDATED BY RATHER INDISCRIMINATE POLICE PROCEDURES. MANY FACULTY ARE HIGHLY AGITATED, AND STUDENTS REPORTEDLY NOW TALK OPENLY OF DOING AWAY WITH THE SHAH. TWO DIFFERENT PROFESSORS HEARD UNIVERSITY CHANCELLOR MOTAMEDI SAY PRIVATELY THAT ONE STUDENT INJURED IN LAST SATURDAY'S DEBACLE HAD DIED, AND TWO MORE WERE IN CRITICAL CONDITION AT LOCAL HOSPITALS.

WESTERN JOURANLISTS WHITELY (BBC) AND BRANIGIN (WASHINGTON POST) (PROTECT BOTH) HAVE HEARD STORY OF ONE DEATH FROM STUDENT SIDE AS WELL. BRITISH EMBASSY HAS HEARD UNCONFIRMED RUMORS OF DEAD RACHING AS HIGH AS FIFTEEN.

BELIEF GROWING HERE THAT GOI HAS AT A MINIMUM APPROVED HARSH POLICE REACTION TO DEMONSTRATORS, IF NOT MOVED TO MORE GENERALIZED INTIMIDATION AGAINST CERTAIN TYPES OF DIDDIDENCE. INTERIOR ASSISTANT SECRETARY DARBANI (PROTDCT), NORAMLLY VERY OPEN, WAS VERY DEFENSIVE IN CONVERSATION WITH EMBOFF AND INDIRECTLY CONFIRMED VIEW THAT POLICE ACTIVITIES HAVE BEEN MORE THAN JUST REACTION TO VIOLENT PROVOCATION.

DARBANI SILENT ON DIRECT QUESTION, BUT POINTED OUT GOI WAS SURE SHAH NOT PLEASED WITH BROUHAHAS DURING WASHINGTON VISIT, AND SAID SENIOR POLICE OFFICIALS, SPECIFICALLY IRANIAN NATIONAL POLICE CHIEF SAMADIANPOUR, HAD INSISTED ON LOCAL CRACKDOWN SO SHAH COULD NOT ACCUSE THEM OF LETTING CONDITIONS DEERIORATE "TO THOSE OF WASHINGTON." (EMBASSY COMMENT: ABOVE MIGHT EXPLAIN INCREASED POLICE HARSHNESS THROUGH SHAH'S RETURN TO TEHRAN EVENING NOVEMBER SEVENTEEN, BUT NOT SUBSEQUENT EVENTS.

HOWEVER, AT LEAST ONE WESTERN JOUANALIST IS FILING STORY NOVEMBRR TWENTY-THREE WHICH WILL INDICATE SHAH MUST HAVE KNOWN ABOUT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY WEEKEND POLICE RAIDS.) WHEN ASKED WHAT NEW PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR'S ROLE HAS BEEN , DARBANI (WHO WAS AMOUZEGAR'S STAFF AIDE AND REMAINS CLOSE CONFIDANT) SAID AMOUZEGAR IS "PEACE-TIME PRIME MINISTER ONLY; WHEN THE WAR (SIC), IT'S UP TO NUMBER ONE." IN ELABORATION, HE SAID SECURITY MATTERS ALMOST TOTALLY BYPASS PRIME MINISTER, WHOC IS MAINTAINING LOW PROFILE ON RECENT EVENTS BECAUSE THERE IS REALLY NOTHING ELSE HE CAN DO.

EMBASSY UNDERSTANDS FROM CONSULATE SHIRAZ THAT PAHLAVI UNIVERSITY ENGINEERING AND ARTS FACULTIES HAVE BEEN ON STRIKE SINCE AFTERNOON NOVEMBER TWENTYTWO. ONE SENIOR PROFESSOR TOLD PRINCIPAL OFFICER THAT THIS WAS FIRST TIME SHIARAZ DEMONSTRATIONS HAVE BEEN LINKED DIRECTLY TO THOSE IN TEHRAN. SOURCE OPINED PAHLAVI UNIVERSITY MIGHT IN THE END LOSE A WHOLE TERM IF IT HAD TO CLOSE.

UNIVERSITY CHANCELLORS HAVE BEEN CALLED TO TEHRAN NOVEMBER TWENTY-THREE FOR MEETING TO HEAR DDUCATION MINISTER GANJI UNVEIL HIS PLAN FOR DECENTRALIZING UNIVERSITY ADMINISTRATION. CHANCELLORS WILL HAVE FULL ADMINISTRATIVE AUTHORITY, INCLUDING BUDGETING, HIRING AND FIRING, AND CONTROL OF STUDENT AFFAIRS, REPORTING DIRECTLY TO MINISTER FOR FIRST TIME. EDUCATION MINISTRY SOURCE SAID IT WAS HOPED THAT RECENT POLICE SEVERITY AT ARYAMEHR AND TEHRAN UNIVERSITIES WOULD "CLEAN OUT" TROUBLESOME ELEMENTS AND MAKE TRANSITION TO NEW POLICE EASIRE. SOURCE INDICATED RECENT STUDENT TROUBLES WOULD ALSO BE MAIN TOPIC OF DISCUSSION, AND AT LEAST TWO CHANCELLORS WILL PUT FORTH LONGER-RANGE IDEAS ON HOW TO REDUCE SALIENCE OF STUDENT DEMONSTRATIONS.

WHEN REF NOTESCONVEYED TO DR ARABIAN (GOI'S DEL TO INFCE) DURING NOV 22 NVISIT ARABIAN STATED HE WOULD HAVE TO DISCUSS ITS CONTENTS WITH HIS COLLEAGUES AND THEREFORE HAD NOT IMMEDIATE COMMENT FOR US TO PASS ON. SAID HE WOULD CONTACT ACTING SCIATT IF HE HAD ANY THOUGHTS TO FORWARD LATER ON, BUT IMPLIED THAT HE WOULD NOT. COMMENT: GIST OF HIS REMARKS WAS THATHE AND AEOI ARENOW FULLY SEIZED WITH OTHER MATTERS AND CAN PUT ONLY VERY LIMITED TIME INTO INFCE DELIBERATIONS.

SUMMARY: SINCE PREVIOUS REPORT, MORE DETAILS ON DEMONSTRATIONS HAVE BECOME AVAILABLE, INCLUDING INFORMATION ON INDIVIDUAL ROLES, LOCAL PRESS PLAY, RUMORS (UNCONFIRMED) OF MORE DEATHS, RELEASE OF SOME DISSIDENTS, AND CLOSURE OR AT LEAST ONE UNIVERSITY. END SUMMARY.

WESTERN-TRAINED OBSERVER GAVE EMBOFFS FOLLOWING RUNDOWN ON WHAT TRANSPIRED ON ROAD BETWEEN TEHRAN AND KARAJ: MEETING OF ABOUT ONE THOUSAND INDIVIDUALS WAS HELD IN GARDEN HOME/WORKSHOP OF HOSSEIN GOLZAR ON TEHRAN-KARAJ ROAD. A MAJORITY OF THOSE ATTENDING WERE EX-NATIONAL FRONTERS, BUT MANY OTHERS, INCLUDING STUDENTS, WERE PRESENT. MEETING WAS BY OPEN INVITATION FROM OWNER OF PROPERTY ON WHICH IT WAS HELD, AND BEGAN ABOUT 1500 LOCAL TIME. ABOUT 1545 A REFORM MULLAH GOT UP TO SPEAK ABOUT 1600 HOURS TEN TO TWELVE TEHRAN CITY BUSSES ARMED WITH STICKS, WHO BROKE THROUGH THE GATE.

THESE MEN FORMED UP IN ROWS THREE TO FIVE FEET APART AND ON SIGNAL MOVED IN, HITTING PEOPLE AT MEETING. ALMOST ALL WERE HIT, ONE HUNDRED OR SO SERIOUSLY, WITH A FEW HOSPITALIZED. ONE LAWYER PRESENT, DARIUSH FAROUHAR, A SIGNER OF SEVERAL OF THE DISSIDENT LETTERS CIRCULATED IN TEHRAN OVER PAST FEW MONTHS, COMPLAINED TO LOCAL GENDARMERIE PRECINCT AND WAS TOLD POLICE WOULD NOT ACT BECAUSE IT WAS "A POLITICAL AFFAIR." FAROUHAR WAS HIT BADLY ABOUT THE HEAD AND BODY, RESULT OF WHICH WAS INJURY IN CONNECTION WITH RECENT REMOVAL OF APPENDIX. HE IS CURRENTLY IN HOSPITAL FOR OPERATION TO GET INJURY REPAIRED.
SOURCE CONFIRMED THAT HEYATOLLAH MATIN-DAFTARI WAS ALSO PRESENT AND HURT (HEAD AND HIP INJURIES) BUT SEEMS OKAY NOW.

LOCAL ENGLISH AND FARSI PRESS CARRIED SMALL ITEM ON ABOVE DISTURBANCE NOVEMBER TWENTY-FOUR DESCRIBING CLASH AS BETWEEN "FACTORY WORKERS" AND "ANTI-NATIONALIST ELEMENTS." LOCAL PRESS DESCRIBED BRAWL WHICH FOLLOWED AS RESULTING FROM "ANTI-NATIONAL" SLOGANS BEING SHOUTED, LINKING DEMONSTRATORS WITH THOSE WHO HAD DISRUPTED ARYAMEHR TECHNICAL COLLEGE AND TEHRAN UNIVERSITY PREVIOUS WEEK (REF B).

LOCAL PRESS TREATMENT OF NOVEMBER TWENTY-FIRST ARYAMEHR INCIDENT (PARA TWO, REF A) APPEARED NOVEMBER TWENTY-SIX, CLAIMING THREE HUNDRED STUDENTS STAGED DEMONSTRATION AGAINST SADAT EVENING NOVEMBER TWENTY. PRESS CLAIMED STUDENTS SHOUTED "DOWN WITH SADAT, LONG LIVE PALESTINE," AND BROKE OUT OF BUILDING TO DISRUPT CLASSES. IRANIAN SOURCE SAYS THERE WAS NO RPT NO ACTIVITY AT ARYAMEHR EVENING NOVEMBER TWENTY, AND ANTISADAT SLOGANS HAVE NOT BEEN FEATURE OF ANY ARYAMEHR DEMONSTRATIONS.

NOVEMBER TWENTY-FOUR, A FLYER APPEARED DOWNTOWN AND AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY CLAIMING SIXTEEN DEATHS AS A RESULT OF RIOTS. EMBOFF SAW, BUT WAS NOT GIVEN, PERSIAN TEXT, WHICH WAS VAGUE, INEXACT AND LACKED DETAIL, PUBLICATION WAS ALMOST SIMULTANEOUS WITH IRANIAN STUDENT CONFEDERATION ANNOUNCEMENT IN PARIS THAT SAME NUMBER HAD BEEN KILLED. BOTH IRANIAN STUDENTS AND TWO JOURNALISTS WHO HAD SEEN FLYER BELIEVE IT IS A PHONEY THOUGH NO ONE DISCOUNTS POSSIBILITY A FEW STUDENTS MAY HAVE DIED.

EMBASSY ------------------119309 280625Z /20 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 5595 INFO AMEMBASSY LONDON SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 10428 IS INCLINED TO BELIEVE ONE STUDENT HAS DIED (REF A) AND THAT HAS NOT BEEN ANNOUNCED. MINISTRY OF INFORMATION STATEMENT, REPORTED BY MEDIA IN ALL LANGUAGES MORNING NOVEMBER TWENTY-SEVEN DENIED "REPORTS FABRICATED BY FOREIGN SUPPORTERS OF SABOTEUR HOOLIGANS," THAT PEOPLE HAD BEEN KILLED DURING RECENT "DISORDERLY BEHAVIOR" AND STATED CATEGORICALLY THAT NOT A SINGLE PERSON HAS BEEN KILLED IN ENCOUNTERS "BETWEEN HOOLIGANS AND OTHER PEOPLE." MIN INFO STATEMENT SAID ENCOUNTERS HAD TAKEN PLACE BETWEEN POLICE AND HOOLIGANS WHO HAD ATTACKED BANKS, SHOPS AND OTHER BUSINESS PREMISES.
STATEMENT NOTED THAT "FOREIGN SUPPORTERS OF THE HOOLIGANS ARE TRYING TO MISLEAD NES MEDIA IN FOREIGN COUNTRIES WHICH ARE NOT FAMILIAR WITH ACTUAL EVENTS HERE."

MEDIA SOURCE HAS TOLD US THAT MAHMOUD ETEMADZADEH AND HIS SON WERE ARRESTED NOVEMBER TWENTY-FOUR ON CHARGES OF PROVOKING DISORDER. ETEMADZADEH WAS SCHEDULED SPEAKER AT ARYAMEHR RALLY THAT WAS CANCELLED NOVEMBER TWENTY-ONE. ENGLISH AND FARSI PRESS ANNOUNCED ISSUANCE OF WARRANTS MORNING NOVEMBER TWENTY-SEVEN.

WE UNDERSTAND UNOFFICIALLY THAT ABOUT TEN TO FIFTEEN STUDENTS ARRESTED AT TIME OF FIRST ARYAMEHR DEMONSTRATIONS (REF B) HAVE BEEN RELEASED OUTRIGHT BY LOCAL MAGISTRATE. LOCAL PRESS HAS CARRIED NOTHING ON THIS, THOUGH EARLIER STORY LAST WEEK DID MENTION ABOUT FORTY STUDENTS BEING CHARGED WITH DISRUPTION.

FACULTY MEMBER HAS INFORMED US THAT NATIONAL UNIVERSITY HAS CLOSED DOWN INDEFINITELY UNTIL PRESENT TROUBLES ARE MORE UNDER CONTROL. SOURCE SAID NEW CHANCELLOR QORESHI VERY CONCERNED AT LACK OF ADMINISTRATIVE CONTROL AND FACULTY COMMUNICATION WITH STUDENTS AND DECIDED BEST COURSE WAS TO SHUT DOWN. NATIONAL WAS VIRTUALLY IDLE ANYWAY, AS BOYCOTT THERE WAS MOST COMPLETE OF SEVERAL STRIKES CURRENTLY IN OPERATION AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY AND OTHER LOCAL SCHOOLS. EVEN TRADITIONALLY QUIET RCD COLLEGE NARROWLY AVERTED SYMPATHETIC BOYCOTT LAST WEEK AND THEN ONLY BECAUSE COLLEGE PRESIDENT HIMSELF TALKED STUDENTS OUT OF IT.

ELSEWHERE AROUND THE COUNTRY, OUR CONSUL IN TABRIZ REPORTS A BRIEF DEMONSTRATION AT AZARBADEGAN UNIVERSITY NOVEMBER FIFTEEN OVER THE LOCAL GRADING SYSTEM. NOVEMBER TWENTY-ONE, A SMALL GATHERING OF STUDENTS NOTED THERE WERE MORE PEOPLE WATCHING MEETING THAN ATTENDING IT.
MIRZAZADEH AND NATEQ CASE (STATE 280793) BING REPORTED SEPTEL.

EMBASSY COMMENT: SITUATION IS STILL FLUID, BUT DISTURBING THEMES EMERGING. FIRST IS FAIRLY WIDE GAP BETWEEN LOCAL PRESS REPORTS, WHICH REFLECT OFFICIAL GOI VIEW, AND VIEWS OF INCIDENTS EMBASSY HAS DEVELOPED FROM TALKING WITH SPECTATORS AND OCCASIONALLY PARTICIPANTS. SECOND IS GROWING APPEARANCE OF ROUGHER POLICE TACTICS WHICH IN ONNE OR TWO CASES APPEARED TO BE OVERREACTION. THIRD IS AMBIGUITY OF MEETINGS INVOLVED. WHILE IT IS CLEAR THAT MEETINGS AND EVENTS OF PAST THREE WEEKS ARE NOT RPT NOT FOREIGN-INSPIRED MACHINATIONS DIRECTED AGAINST GOI (EXPLANATION GOI SEEMS MOVING TOWARD) BEITHER DO THEY SEEM TO BE ORDINARY STUDENT MEETINGS.

MIX OF OPPOSITIONISTS AT UNIVERSITY MEETINGS AND STUDENTS AT KARAJ POLITICCAL MEETING NOVEMBER TWENTY-ONE SUGGESTS AT MINIMUM SOME COORDINATION BETWEEN STUDENTS AND OLD-LINE OPPOSITIONISTS, PERHAPS ACTIVE COLLABORATION. WESTERN JOURNALISTS HERE, WHILE NOT RPT NOT ACCEPTING GOI'S CONSPIRACY THEORY, ARE IMPRESSED WITH ORGANIZATION OF STUDENT GROUPS. LAST DISTURBING NOTE IS VERY REAL POSSIBILITY THAT GOI IN PAST WEEK HAS MADE CONSCIOUS DECISION TO GET INTO THE DEMONSTRATIONS ACT ITSELF, AND THAT "PATRIOTIC FORCES" AT NOVEMBER TWENTY-ONE ARYAMEHR BASH-UP AND FOLLOWING NIGHT AT KARAJ ROAD VIOLENCE WERE GOI-INSTIGATED, IF NOT RECRUITED.
SEEMS TO EMBASSY THAT GOI AT A MINIMUM SIGNALLING THAT LIMITS OF DISSIDENCE IN PRESENT SITUATION HAVE CLEARLY BEEN REACHED AND THAT IT INTENDS TO ASSERT CONTROL.

ONLY IRANIAN INVOLVEMENT IN THIS DISPUTE OF WHICH WE ARE AWARE IS A GENERALIZED PLEA TO OMAN THAT IT NEGOTIATE, APPARENTLY MADE BY IRANIANS AS A RESULT OF REQUEST TO THEM BY UAE'S SHAIKH ZAYID WHEN HE VISITED HERE A COUPLE OF WEEKS AGO. WHEN WE DISCUSSED THIS ISSUE WITH MFA DEPARTMENT HEAD ABOUT A WEEK AGO, HIS ONLY COMMENT WAS THAT THE SULTAN WAS VERY FIRM ON THIS ISSUE. HE CLARIFIED THIS TO MEAN THAT THE SULTAN FELT HE WAS JUSTIFIED IN HIS POSITION AND WOULD NOT BACK DOWN EASILY.
