1977TEHRAN10582.subject: NEW POSITIONS FOR MINISTERS ANSARY, YEGANEH, AND AGAH

segments.text: BEGIN UNCLASSIFIED ON NOV 30, A RELIGIOUS HOLIDAY AND THE EVE OF IRAN'S WEEKEND, RADIO ANNOUNCED THE IMMEDIATE MOVES OF MINISTERS HUSHANG ANSARY FROM MINISTRY OF ECONOMIC AFFAIRS AND FINANCE (MEAF) TO CHAIRMAN AND MANAGING DIRECTOR OF THE NATIONA IRANIAN OIL COMPANY (NIOC); MINISTER OF STATE AND DIRECTOR FOR THE PLANNING AND BUDGET ORGANIZATION (PBO) MOHAMMAD YEGANEH TO MINISTER OF MEAF AND MINISTER OF STATE FOR EXECUTIVE AFFAIRS MANOUCHEHR AGAH AS MINISTER OF PBO. UNDERSECRETARIAL POSITION CHANGES IN THE MINISTRY OF HEALTH AND SOCIAL WELFARE WILL BE REPORTED BY SEPTEL. END UNCLASSIFIED.

BEGIN CONFIDENTIAL. ANSARY'S TRANSFER HAS MANY MEANINGS APART FROM THOSE WHICH MIGHT ULTIMATELY EMERGE. HIS LONG TERM, CAREFUL CONSTRUCTIION OF AN ECONOMIC EMPIRE PROCEEDED WILL UNTIL THE AUG 7 APPOINTMENT OF HIS LONG TIME COMPETITOR JAMSHID AMOUZEGAR AS PRIMIN.SPECULATION HAS BEEN HEAVY SINCE THEN AS TO HIS FUTURE. RUNORS INCLUDED ATTEMPTS BY ANSARY TO RESIGN HIS MINISTRY AND A GENERAL DESPONDENCY SINCE LOSING A SHOT AT THE PRIMIN-ISTERSHIP. HIS MOVE TO THE NIOC, FILLING THE VACANCY CREATED BY DR EGBAL'S RECENT DEATH (TEHRAN 10476), TAKES HIM OUT OF THE CABINET PER SE BUT INTO A SEAT HELD BY EX-PRIM-INISTERS AND AS HEAD OF THE WORLD'S LARGEST CORPORATION.

IT IS NOT CLEAR YET WHETHER ANSARY WILL REPLACE YEGANEH AS IRAN'S OIL SPOKESMAN/DELEGATE TO OPEC. HE HAS NO KNOWN SPECIFIC EXPERIENCE IN OIL MATTERS BUT HAS MUCH EXPERIENCE AS AN APOLOGIST FOR IRAN'S OIL POLICIES. IN ANY CASE, IT WOULD APPEAR DIFFICULT, THOUGH NOT IMPOSSIBLE, FOR ANSARY TO WIELD HIS USUAL INFLUENCE IN THE BROAD SPECTRUM OF ECONOMIC AFFAIRS FROM HISNIOC SEAT, LACKING HIS CABINET BASE AND EASY ACCESS TO THE CENTRAL BANK. HIS PERSONAL PRESTIGE AS THE PRINCIPAL IRANIAN HEAD OF IRAN'S 42 JOINT COMMISSIONS WILL BE LOST, AN EFFECT WHICH THE US WILL FEEL.

THE REASONS FOR YEGANEH'S TRANSFER ARE LESS APPARENT BUT MAY EMERGE AFTER THE LONG WEEKEND. THE MEAF PORTFOLIO MUST BE CONSIDERED A PROMOTION. YET IT WAS GENERALLY CONCEDED BY SOME SENIOR GOI OFFICIALS THAT HHE WAS NOT GRASPING WELL THE ISSUES AND PROBLEMS OF THE PBO AND THE RECENT EVALUATION OF ECONOMIC PLANNING BY THE PRIMINS BROTHER, AMB-AT-LARGE JAHANGIR AMUZEGAG, MAY HAVE AFFECTED THIS DECISION. IT WOULD AT LEAST HELP EXPLAIN DR AGAH'S PROMOTION TO PBO, ONE ADMIRED BY DR AMUZEGAR AND THE PRIMIN. HE IS CONSIDERED ONE OF THE BRIGHTEST IRANIAN ECONOMISTS AND HAS ESTABLISHED A GOOD REPUTATION AMONG ACADEMICS AS WELL AS THE GOVERNMENTAL ECONOMIC TECHNOCRACY.

SINCE A FALLING OUT WITH ANSAR Y, FROM THE DAYS WHEN AS VICE MINISTER FOR ECONOMIC AFFAIRS IN THE OLD MINISTRY OF FINANCE IT WAS MERGED WITH THE MINISTRY OF ECONOMIC AFFAIRS UNDER ANSARY, HE HAS BEEN CLEARLY IDENTIFIED AS A PROTEGE OF AMUZEGAR. HIS ADMINISTRATIVE SKILL AND PERSONAL TACT, COMPLEMENTING ACADEMIC SKILLS AND GOVT EXPERIENCE, BODE WELL FOR THE CURRENTLY FLAGGING PBO AND THE NEED FOR ECONOMIC COORDINATION. EMB WILL PROVIDE ADDITIONAL COMMENT AS INFORMATION EMERGES.

1977TEHRAN10590.subject: HUMAN RIGHTS: DISSENT IN THE PROVINCES; SOME DEMONSTRATORS MAY BE TRIED; TEHRAN UNIVERSITY QUIET

segments.text: DEMONSTRATORS MAY BE TRIED; TEHRAN UNIVERSITY QUIET REF A. TEHRAN 10184 B. TEHRAN 10428

SUMMARY: STUDENT DEMONSTRATIONS HAVE TAKEN PLACE IN SHIRAZ AND ISFAHAN, BUT TABRIZ IS QUIET. TEHRAN COURT ANNOUNCED FORTY-FOUR STUDENT FILES HAVE BEEN FORWARDED FOR INITIAL EXAMINATION TO SEE IF CHARGES WOULD BE PRESSED. MOST UNIVERSITIES REMAIN CLOSED OR OPEN AT HALF SPEED. END SUMMARY.

CONSULATE SHIRAZ REPORTS PAHLAVI UNIVERSITY STUDENTS STAGED DEMONSTRATION NOVEMBER TWENTY-SEVEN IN SUPPORT OF TEHRAN UNIVERSITY STUDENTS WHO WERE ARRESTED. CRITICISM OF SHAH FOR AGREEING TO OIL PRICE FREEZE WAS VOICED. POLICE BROKE UP AFFAIR AND BASHED A FEW HEADS IN PROCESS. STUDENTS HAVE BEEN THNSE AT PAHLAVI UNIVERSITY FOR ABOUT A WEEK, AND THIS IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE THROUGH DECEMBER NINE OF TEN. SENIOR FACULTY MEMBER HAD INDICATED EARLIER TO PRINCIPAL OFFICER THAT DEMONSTRATIONS THIS YEAR MIGHT BE SUFFICIENT TO CLOSE UNIVERSITY FOR YEAR IF THEY CONTINUE, BUT SCHOOL IS STILL FUNCTIONING.

CONSULATE ISFAHAN REPORTS SITUATION THERE HAS HEATED UP SINCE ABORTIVE STUDENT MEETING NOTED REF (B). ON NOVEMBER TWENTY-SEVEN, PEACEFUL DEMONSTRATION AT UNIVERSITY OF ISFAHAN FACULTY OF ARTS AND LETTERS ATTRACTED ATTENTION OF POLICE AND SECURITY FORCES. WHILE THIS WAS IN PROGRESS, OTHER STUDENTS BROKE INTO AND TRASHED TEACHER TRAINING INSTITUTE (TTI) AT OTHER END OF CAMPUS. ALL WINDOWS IN TTI WERE APPARENTLY BROKEN, AND POLICE ARRESTED SOME STUDENTS. LOCAL AUTHORITIES REPORTEDLY IMPRESSED WITH STUDENT COORDINATION OF TWO DEMONSTRATIONS. ON NOVEMBER TWENTY-EIGHT, BETWEEN FOUR AND SEVEN BANKS IN ISFAHAN HAD THEIR WINDOWS BROKEN BY GANGS OF YOUNG MEN.
SECURITY FORCES BRIEFED PRINCIPAL OFFICER AND URGED HIM TO USE ARMORED VEHICLE, TAKE BODYGUARD WITH HIM, AND TRAVEL AS LITTLE AS POSSIBLE OVER NEXT FEW DAYS.

UNIVERSITY OF AZARBADEGAN, ON THE OTHER HAND, HAS BEEN QUIET SINCE DEMONSTRATION NOTED REF (B). TABRIZ CONSUL AND TEHRAN PAO VISITED CAMPUS NOVEMBER TWENTY-NINE, AND FOUND ADMINISTRATORS QUIET AND RELAXED, THOUGH WAITING FOR "OTHER SHOE TO FALL". PAIR WERE TOLD THERE HAD BEEN NO DAMAGE AND NO VIOLENCE THUS FAR, AND POLICE WERE UNDER ORDERS TO "COOL IT" WITH RESPECT TO ANY NECESSARY ACTION. APPARENTLY THERE IS GROUP OF TWENTY WHICH HAS GONE AROUND TO CLASSES AND ANNOUNCED END OF CLASS FOR DAY.

STUDENTS GRUDGINGLY HONOR ANNOUNCEMENT, BUT THERE IS ELEMENT OF COERCION INVOLVED. ------------------008825 301408Z /40 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 5667 INFO AMEMBASSY LONDON SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 10590 BOTH ENGLISH AND PERSIAN PRESS NOVEMBER TWEENTY-NINE ANNOUNCED TEHRAN LOCAL COURT OFFICIALS HAD FORWARDED FORTY-FOUR DOSSIERS TO COURT FOR PRELIMINARY QUESTIONING OF DEFENDANTS TO ESTABLISH WHETHER FURTHER COURT ACTION WAS NECESSARY. BEST INFORMATION WE HAVE IS THAT THESE ARE FILES OF STUDENTS PICKED UP IN FIRST ARYAMEHR TEHCNICAL COLLEGE DISTURBANCE; THEY MAY BE AMONG FIFTY INDICTMENTS MENTIONED TO POL COUNS (TEHRAN 10362). PERSIAN PRESS USED BBC ESTIMATE OF TOTAL TWO HUNDRED FIFTY ARRESTED.

FROM STUDENT/FACULTY SOURCES, SUPPLEMENTED BY OTHERS, IT APPEARS TEHRAN UNIVERSITY IS OPERATING AT A VERY LOW LEVEL, AND SOME CLASSES HAVE BEEN CANCELLED FOR YEAR. UNLESS SPECIAL REGULATIONS ADOPTED, THIS WILL MEAN ALL STUDENTS, INNOCENT AS WELL AS GUILTY, WILL RECEIVE FAILING GRADES, SERIOUSLY CRIPPLING THEIR CHANCES FOR ADMITTANCE TO POST-BA/BS STUDIES. NATIONAL UNIVERSITY HAS REOPENED ON LIMITED BASIS, BUT NUMBER OF COURSES HAVE BEEN ABOLISHED. AT THESE AND OTHER LOCAL UNIVERSITIES, SOME STUDENTS REMAIN OUT ON STRIKE FOR ALL CLASSES, WITH PROFESSORS GIVEN AT LEAST PARTIAL LOCAL OPTION TO FLUNK THOSE WHO FAIL TO MEET ATTENDANCE REQUIREMENTS (WHICH VARY).

ON POSITIVE SIDE, THERE HAVE BEEN NO FURTHER DEMONSTRATIONS TO OUR KNOWLEDGE SINCE NOVEMBER TWENTY-ONE ARYAMEHR DUST-UP, BUT UNIVERSITIES IN COUNTRY ARE AWAITING SIXTEENT OF AZAR (DECEMBER SEVENTH) WHICH HAS TRADITIONALLY INSPIRED STUDENT TROUBLE-MAKING TO COMMENORATE DEATH OF THREE STUDENTS AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY IN 1953.

ON APPARENTLY UNRELATED MATTER, EMBASSY HAS LEARNED THAT BANK EMPLOYEES PLAN STRIKE FOR DECEMBER TEN OVER PAY HIKE AGREEMENT SIGNED ABOUT TWO MONTHS AGO WHICH, ACCORDING TO LOWER-LEVEL CLERKS, HAS NOT BEEN IMPLEMENTED. BANKMEN WERE READYP TO STRIKE NOVEMBER TWENTY-FIRST OR TWENTY-THIRD, BUT, ACCORDING TO OUR SOURCES, POSTPONED IT SO THAT THEIR PROTEST WOULD NOT BE CONFUSED WITH RECENT DEMONSTRATIONS. RADICALS AMONG BANK EMPLOYEES AGREED TO THIS DESPITE THEIR EARLIER DESIRE TO PROMOTE A LINK. SHARP POLICE REACTION TO RECENT DEMONSTRATIONS REPORTEDLY COOLED THEIR ARDOR FOR "UNITED FRONT" WITH OPPOSITIONISTS.

1977TEHRAN10591.subject: NEW MFA DIRECTOR FOR EUROPE AND AMERICA

segments.text: ANNOUNCEMENT HAS BEEN MADE OF HOSSEIN ESHRAGHI'S APPOINTMENT AS DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR POLITICAL AFFAIRS FOR EUROPE AND AMERICA IN MFA. A CAREER DIPLOMAT, AMBASSADOR ESHRAGHI WAS THE SUBJECT OF A DETAILED BIO REPORT TO THE DEPT. (TEHRAN A-172, NOV. 7, 1972) UPON HIS APPOINTMENT AS IRAN'S FIRST AMBASSADOR TO AUSTRALIA.

ESHRAGHI HAS HAD EXTENSIVE EXPERIENCE IN U.S. AFFAIRS HAVING SERVED IN SAN FRANCISCO (TWICE), IN WASHINGTON, AND AS CONSUL GENERAL IN NEW YORK, AND HAS BEEN TWICE HEAD OF THE AMERICAS DEPARTMENT IN MFA. IN 1975, FOLLOWING HIS TOUR IN AUSTRALIA, HE WAS NAMED AMBASSADOR TO MEXICO. HE HAS JUST RETURNED TO IRAN FROM MEXICO; THUS, ANY COMMENTS RE ESHRAGHI'S PERFORMANCE AND ATTITUDES WHICH EMBASSY MEXICO CITY CAN FURNISH WOULD BE APPRECIATED.

1977TEHRAN10604.subject: HUMAN RIGHTS: DISSIDENCE; POSSIBLE LINKS TO TERRORISTS; MORE BACKGROUND ON RECENT DEMONSTRATIONS

segments.text: TERRORISTS; MORE BACKGROUND ON RECENT DEMONSTRATIONS REF TEHRAN 10428

SUMMARY: PRESS HAS REPORTED SOME INCIDENTS OF DISSIDENCE WHICH MAY NOT BE TRUE. LOWER-LEVEL RELIGIOUS FIGURES IN RECENT DEMONSTRATIONS INDICATE POSSIBLE LINKS BETWEEN COMMITTED OPPOSITIONISTS AND WINGS OF MUJAHIDIN AND CHARIK TERRORIST GROUPS. GERMAN EMBASSY REPORTS POLICEMAN ROUGHED UP AND PROFESSOR BEATEN. GOETHE SOCIETY CUTTING ITS CONTACTS WITH OPPOSITIONISTS IN WAKE OF BACKFIRE OVER POETRY READING. END SUMMARY.

BOTH FARSI AND ENGLISH PRESS NOVEMBER TWENTY-NINE CARRIED PARS NEWS AGENCY REPORTS OF DEMONSTRATIONS AND RIOTS IN ISFAHAN AND SHIRAZ. IN SHIRAZ, STORY INDICATED MULLAH TOLD A CONGREGATION OF ABOUT FIVE HUNDRED IN REZA MOSQUE THAT THERE WAS NO FREEDOM OF SPEECH IN IRAN. HE PRAYED FOR IMAM KHOMEINI SEVERAL TIMES AND REPORTEDLY ASKED THE CONGREGATION TO PRAY FOR THE VICTORY OF THE PALESTINIANS. ABOUT TWENTY OF HIS AUDIENCE THEN REPORTEDLY TOOK TO THE STREETS CHANTING PRO-KHOMEINI SLOGANS AND WERE DISPERSED BY POLICE. ABOUT THIRTY PEOPLE ALLEGEDLY DEMONSTRATED IN FRONT OF IRAN AIR OFFICE AND SMASHED WINDOWS WHILE ABOUT TWENTY OTHERS DID THE SAME TO TWO MOVIE HOUSES.
IN ISFAHAN, SEVERAL UNKNOWN PEOPLE REPORTEDLY ATTACKED THE JEWISH SYNAGOGUE AT JUYABAREH AND SET FIRE TO ITS CARPETS WITH GASOLINE.

ACCORDING TO LOCAL MEDIA MAN WHO WAS ON DUTY AT TIME, SAVAK ORDERED ABOVE STORY USED IN ALL NEWSPAPERS, BUT GAVE NO FURTHER DETAILS. PRESS STAFFS AT TWO PAPERS DUBIOUS. ISRAELI DIPLOMAT WAS ABLE TO CONFIRM BURNING OF CARPETS IN ISFAHAN SYNAGOGUE AND SAID GOI HAD APOLOGIZED FOR INCIDENT AND LINKED IT TO PRO-PLO SYMPATHIZERS AMONG FUNDAMENTALIST MOSLEMS. CONSULATE SHIRAZ HAS HEARD NOTHING ABOUT EVENTS REPORTED IN STORY, EVEN AFTER INQUIRY, AND CONSULATE ISFAHAN WAS NOT INFORMED ABOUT SYNAGOGUE INCIDENT DURING BRIEFING NOV 29. AS FAR AS WE KNOW, SYNAGOGUE INCIDENT WAS FIRST ANTI-SEMITIC EFFORT IN CURRENT DISTURBANCES.
IT IS ALSO PSSIBLE THAT EVENTS REPORTED FROM SHIRAZ DID NOT HAPPEN EXACTLY AS DESCRIBED OR WERE SOMEHOW RELATED TO UNIVERSITY EVENTS REPORTED TEHRAN 10590.

IRANIAN NEWSMAN WITH GOOD CONNECTIONS TOLD EMBOFF NOVEMBER TWENTY-NINE THAT HE HAD SPOKEN WITH SOME LOWER-LEVEL RELIGIOUS FIGURES IN WAKE OF NOVEMBER TWENTY-ONE ARYAMEHR INCIDENT AND THEY TOLD HIM THERE WAS DEFINITE CONTACT BETWEEN MUJAHIDIN AND CHARIK TERRORISTS AND DEMONSTRATORS. SOURCE WNET ON TO SAY MUJAHIDIN HAD PLACED SEVERAL VEHICLES LOADED WITH MEN AND WEAPONS AT OUTER FRINGES OF ARYAMEHR COLLEGE WHO WERE READY TO RETURN FIR IF POLICE USED WEAPONS.

SOURCE SAID ONE MULLAH HAD TOLD HIM THAT TERRORISTS WERE NOW GOING TO SKIP DIRECT VIOLENCE UNLESS ATTACKED AND WORK HARDER TO CULTIVATE POLITICAL "GRASS ROOTS" SUPPORT IN WAKE OF WHAT THEY CONSIDER POLARIZING EFFECT OF DEMONSTRATIONS AND POLICE REPRISALS OF PAST TWO WEEKS. MULLAH AND TWO OF HIS FRIENDS ALLEGEDLY CLAIMED GOAL OF ALL OPPOSITIONISTS IN IRAN NOW WAS TO LINE UP BEHIND MODERATE CONSTITUTIONALISTS AND PRESS FOR A WIDER SCOPE FOR POLITICAL ACTIVITY.

SOURCE SAID HE THOUGHT HIS CONTACTS WERE SAYING WHAT THEY BELIVED TO BE TRUE, BUT MIGHT ONLY PARTIALLY REFLECT VIEWS OF TERRORIST LEADER------------------017203 010842Z /14 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 5676 INFO AMEMBASSY LONDON SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 10604 SHIP. SOURCE WAS NOT SURE HOW CLOSE HIS CONTACTS REALLY WERE TO "INNER GROUP" OF TERRORIST MOVEMENT, BUT SAID THIS SUBSTANTIATED RUMBLINGS FROM STUDENTS THAT TERRORISTS WERE BEGINNING TO WANT A PIECE OF THE ACTION.

(EMBASSY COMMENT: WE HAVE NO INDEPENDENT VERFICATION OF ABOVE, AND SOURCE (WHOSE RELATIONSHIP TO SAVAK IS NOT KNOWN) IS NOT ABOVE OCCASIONALLY SLANTING HIS STORIES TO WHAT HE BELIEVES IS LISTENER'S (AND PERHAPS GOI'S) BIAS. HOWEVER, SOMEWHAT SURPRISING LACK OF OVERT TERRORIST ACTIVITY OVER PAST MONTHS, PLUS PRESENCE OF AT LEAST SOME OPPOSITION INDIVIDUALS WITH KNOWN PAST LINKS TO GROUPS WITH TERRORIST CONTACTS AT KARAJ MEETING NOVEMBER TWENTY-TWO, SUGGESTS SOME POSSIBLE TRUTH IN ABOVE.)

IN COURSE OF GENERAL CONVERSATION NOVEMBER TWENTYNINE, GERMAN DCM FILLED IN POL COUNS ON SOME DETAILS RELATING TO STUDENT DEMONSTRATIONS PAST COUPLE OF WEEKS. HE MENTIONED THAT IRANAIN POLICEMAN MAY HAVE DIED OF INJURIES RECEIVED OUTSIDE LUFTHANSA OFFICE WHEN CROWD OF STUDENT DEMONSTRATORS MARCHING DOWN THE STREET RAN ACROSS HIM (ABOUT TEN DAYS AGO). THIS WAS DAY IN WHICH POLICE CHARGED MARCHING DEMONSTRATORS AND BROKE THEM UP WITH CONSIDERABLE INJURIES (TEHRAN 10303). DEMONSTRATORS PREVENTED FIRST AMBULANCE FROM PICKING UP THE INJURED POLICEMAN, WHO WAS WITHOUT WALKIE-TALKIE OR ANY SUPPORT FROM OTHER POLICE, BUT MOB EVENTUALLY MOVED ON.

GERMAN EMBASSY AT FIRST FEARED THIS WAS ATTACK CONNECTED WITH THREATS OF TERRORISTS IN GERMANY, AND CONTACTED IRANIAN AUTHORITIES FOR ADDITIONAL PROTECTION. WHILE PROTECTION ARRIVED ALMOST IMMEDIATELY, GERMANS SOON RELAIZED BLOODYING OF POLICEMAN IN FRONT OF LUFTHANSA WAS COINCIDENTAL. HOWEVER, THEY HAVE BEEN ASSURED THAT POLICEMAN PRESENTLY IN FRONT OF LUFTHANSA OFFICE IS BEING SUPPORTED BY PLAINCLOTHES MEN IN VICINITY. HE HAD NOT HEARD REPORT THAT TWO POLICEMEN HAD BEEN KILLED (TEHRAN 10184 AND 10303).

AS INDICATION OF HIGH EMOTIONS INVOLVED, GERMAN TOLD US OF A 67-YEAR OLD PROFESSOR OF GERMAN LANGUAGE AND LITERATURE AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY WHO HAD POSITIONED HIMSELF BETWEEN GIRL STUDENTS AND POLICE WITH OUTSTRETCHED ARMS TRYING TO PROTECT GIRLS FROM POLICE ONRUSH WHEN THEY WERE BREAKING UP DEMONSTRATION THERE. HE WAS BEATEN DOWN AND IS AT PRESENT IN HOSPITAL WITH BROKEN COLLAR BONE. HE APPARENTLY IS NOT AND NEVER WAS MEMBER OF ANY OPPOSITION GROUP.
GERMAN NOTED THAT POETRY READING AT GOETHE INSTITUTE (TEHRAN 9

HAD AT LEAST TACIT ENDORSEMENT OF THE SHAHBANOU AS A LEGITIMATE CULTURAL ACTIVITY WHEN IT WAS FIRST PROPOSED, AND GERMAN AMBASSADOR AGREED TO IT. NUMBER OF PEOPLE THAT SHOWED UP FOR IT ROSE TO FIFTEEN THOUSAND AT ONE POINT WHICH OVERWHELMED LIMITED AREA OF THE INSTITUTE AND ALARMED GERMAN EMBASSY. GOETHE INSTITUTE DIRECTOR, WHO HAS HAD MANY CONTACTS WITH STUDENT AND OTHER OPPOSITIONISTS IN PAST, HAS INDICATED HE WILL DROP MOST OF THESE CONTACTS NOW SO AS TO AVOID STIGMATIZING THE INSTITUTE.
DECONTROL AFTER THIRTY YEARS.

1977TEHRAN10616.subject: MINISTRY OF HOUSING CHANGES-HOUSING WORKING GROUP

segments.text: SECOND ECHELON CHANGES IN MINISTRY OF HOUSING AND URBAN PLANNING PERSONNEL HAVE RECENTLY BEEN MADE, FOLLOWING CABINET LEVEL CHANGES OF EARLY AUGUST WHEN MINISTER HOMAYOUN HABERI-NASARI WAS SUCCEEDED BY FIROUZ TOWFIK, FORMERLY HEAD OF THE STATISTICS BUREAU OF IRAN AND PLAN & BUDGET ORGANIZATION OFFICIAL (SEE TEHRAN 07043).
MAJOR CHANGE IS DEPARTURE OF ZAVEN SIMONIAN FROM MINISTRY AFTER MORE THAN FIVE YEARS AS UNDERSECRETARY AND LAST TWO YEARS AS SENIOR UNDERSECRETARY.

UNDERSECRETARY LINE UP NOW READS: DR. MANOUCHEHR BEHROUN-UNDERSECRETARY FOR TECHNICAL AFFAIRS MR. IRAJ ETESAM-UNDERSECRETARY FOR URBAN PLANNING & ARCHITECTURE DR. MANOUCHEHR VAHIDI-UNDERSECRETARY FOR PROJECTS

DIRECT GENERAL LEVAL (EQUIVALENT TO ASSISTANT SECRETARY) IS: DR. MOHSEN ASNOASHARI-DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR ADMINISTRATION MR. MOHAMMAD HOSSEIN MAHMOUDI-DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR FINANCIAL AFFAIRS MS. JILA MANSOURI-DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR ORGANIZATION AND EDUCATION MR. JAVD MAJLESI-DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR OFFICE OF HOUSING

QUESTION OF CO-CHAIRMANSHIP OF HOUSING STUDY GROUP WAS RAISED WITH DR. ETESAM, KNOW TO COMMERCIAL SECTION IN HIS PREVIOUS PRIVATE CAPACITY AS PARTNER IN LEADING TEHRAN ARCHITECTURAL/ ENGINEERING CONSULTANCY FIRM, WHO SAID THAT HE WAS NOT AWARE OF JOINT COMMISSION ACTIVITY BUT WOULD RAISE QUESTION WITH NEW MINISTER. ALTHOUGH MR. NASSER-HEJAZI IS TECHNICALLY REPLACING MR. SIMONIAN AND ETESAM IS REPLACING MOHKAMI, IN FACT VARIOUS FUNCTIONS HAVE BEEN REALIGNED AND NEITHER ONE IS A DIRECT SUBSTITUTE FOR SIMONIAN.

EMBASSY PREPARED LETTER TO MINISTER, OUTLINING ACTIVITIES OF THE JOINTSTUDY GROUP AND ASKING FOR THE NAME OF THE NEW CO-CHAIRMAN. 7.SUBSEQUENT TO LETTER,ECON COUNSELOR BROUGHT UP USIRJC DURING CALL ON TOWFIK TO DISCUSS IMPERIAL GUARD PROJECT. IN RESPONSE TO QUESTION, MINISTER SAID HIS THINKING NOW IS TO PLACE CHAIRMANSHIP IN THE HOUSING ORGANIZATION (WHOLLY OWNED OPERATIONAL SUBSIDIARY OF MINISTRY) ALTHOUGH HE COULD NOT GIVE THE NAME OF THE INDIVIDUAL RESPONSIBLE.

COMMENT: MANAGING DIRECTOR AZARPAY CAME TO HOUSING ORGANIZATION LAST APRIL AS PROTEGE OF FORMER MINISTER AND HIS DEPARTURE IS EXPECTED IMMINENTLY, ALTHOUGH IDENTITY OF HIS REPLACEMENT IS NOT KNOWN. PLACING CHAIRMANSHIP IN HOUSING ORGANIZATION HAS VIRTUE OF RESPONSIBILITY IN AN OPERATIONAL RATHER THAN A PLANNING AREA BUT BECAUSE OF NECESSITY OF REFERRING JOINT COMMISSION MATTERS TO CABINET LEVEL OF HOUSING AND OTHER MINISTRIES PUTS ADDITIONAL STEP IN PROCESS.

1977TEHRAN10641.subject: HIGH LEVEL PRC DELEGATION VISITS IRAN

segments.text: ON NOVEMBER 26 TENG YING-CHAO, WIDOW OF CHOU EN-LAI AND VICE CHAIRMAN OF THE STANDING COMMITTEE OF THE NATIONAL CONGRESS OF THE PRC, ARRIVED IN TEHRAN AT THE HEAD OF A HIGH LEVEL DELEGATION WHICH INCLUDES VICE MINISTER OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS HO YING, MFA ACTING DIRECTOR OF THE WEST ASIAN AND NORTH AFRICAN AFFAIRS DEPARTMENT CHOU CHUEH AND MFA DEPUTY DIRECTOR OF THE PROTOCOL DEPARTMENT KAO CHIEN CHUNG. THE DELEGATION IS OFFICIALLY THE GUEST OF PRINCESS FATEMEH, HALF-SISTER OF THE SHAH, AND THEIR VISIT IS IN RESPONSE TO PRINCESS ASHRAF'S 1976 VISIT TO THE PRC. FATEMEH HERSELF VISITED THE PRC IN 1971.

THE VISIT HAS BEEN RECEIVING AN EXTRAORDINARY AMOUNT OF PUBLICITY IN THE LOCAL MEDIA BEGINNING WITH TENG'S AIRPORT ARRIVAL STATEMENT IN WHICH SHE STRESSED THE LONG-STANDING FRIENDSHIP BETWEEN CHINA AND IRAN. THE PRESS HAS PROVIDED DAILY COVERAGE OF THE DELEGATION'S ACTIVITIES WHICH HAVE INCLUDED A TEA RECEPTION BY COURT MINISTER HOVEYDA, A BANQUET BY PRINCESS FATEMEH, A DINNER BY PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR, A LUNCHEON BY PRINCESS ASHRAF AND MEETINGS WITH SENATE PRESIDENT JAAFAR SHARIF-EMAMI AND MAJLIS SPEAKER ABDOLLAH RIAZI. IN ADDITION, TWO MFA REPRESENTATIVES, HO YING AND CHOU CHUEH, CALLED ON FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY.
THAT MEETING WAS CHARACTERIZED BY NCNA AS "CORDIAL AND FRIENDLY"-- THE CONTINUING PUBLIC THEME OF THE VISIT.
DELEGATION WAS GIVEN TOUR OF HISTORIC AND CULTURAL SITES IN ISFAHAN AND SHIRAZ AND IS SCHEDULED TO MEET WITH SHAH TODAY PRIOR TO THEIR DEPARTURE TOMORROW.

THE FRENCH-LANGUAGE DAILY, JOURNAL DE TEHRAN, ON NOV. 28 COMMENTED EDITORIALLY THAT THE TENG VISIT SURPASSED A ROUTINE BILATERAL EXHCANGEOF VISITS, NOTING THAT SHE WAS ACCOMPANIED BY AN IMPORTANT MFA OFFICIAL AND HIS CLOSEST COLLABORATORS. BOTH IN THEIR EDITORIAL AND IN A FEATURE STORY THE JOURNAL REFERRED TO TENG'S ROLE EARLIER THIS YEAR AS "AMBASSADRESS" TO BURMA AND SRI LANKA REPRESENTING "THE CALM AND SECURITY FOUND AGAIN IN CHINA AFTER A LONG PERIOD OF TROUBLES". NOV.

29 ENGLISH-LANGUAGE EDITION OF JOURNAL EDITORIALLY REVIEWED GROWING TRADE TIES BETWEEN THE TWO COUNTRIES AND CONCLUDED THAT, "THERE IS NO DOUBT THAT RELATIONS BETWEEN RIAN AND CHINA WILL BE A MODEL FOR ANY TWO COUNTRIES KEEN ON HAVING THE BEST OF RELATIONS BETWEEN THEM DESPITE DIFFERENT POLITICAL SYSTEMS".

COMMENT: WIDESPREAD PUBLICITY SURROUNDING VISIT GIVES INITIAL IMPRESSION THAT THERE MAY BE LESS TO THIS VISIT THAN MEETS THE EYE. COURT MINISTER HOVEYDA CHARACTERIZED VIST TO DCM AS LARGELY "CEREMONIAL", RECIPROCATING EARLIER HIGH LEVEL GOI VISITS TO CHINA. HOVEYDA SAID TENG DESCRIBED SITUATION IN CHINA AS BETTER NOW THAT "GANG OF FOUR" ARE ON THE SIDELINES AND THAT THERE IS MORE DELGATION OF RESPONSIBILITY THAN BEFORE. TENG REITERATED TO THE COURT MINISTER THE TRADITIONAL PRC CLICHES VIS-A-VIS THE USSR BUT DID NOT HAVE MUCH TO SAY ABOUT THE U.S., HOVEYDA WAS INTERESTED TO NOTE. THE MINISTER SAID THAT IT IS POSSIBLE SOMETHING OF SUBSTANCE MIGHT ARISE FROM THAT MEETING.

WE SUSPECT IT IS UNLIKELY THAT SUCH AN IMPORTANT FIGURE AS HO YING WOULD BE INCLUDED IN THE DELEGATION IF NO ISSUES OF SUBSTANCE WERE TO BE DISCUSSED DURING THE VISIT. WE SHALL FOLLOW UP AND SEE IF THERE IS ANYTHING TO GATHER AFTER THEY HAVE GONE.

1977TEHRAN10686.subject: CANCELLATION OF UAE NATIONAL DAY RECEPTION

segments.text: ON DECEMBER 1, DAY BEFORE UAE NATIONAL DAY RECEPTION, UAE EMBASSY TELEPHONED ALL INVITEES TO SAY RECEPTION CANCELLED. VAGUE REASON GIVEN WAS SOMEONE HAS DIED UNQUOTE. TEHRAN DIPLOMATIC COMMUNITY INCLUDING FELLOW ARABS PUZZLED BY ACTION BUT CAN OFFER NO EXPLANATION BEYOND SPECULATION ALONG LINES OF REFTEL.

IN THE SECOND CABINET RELIGNMENT WITHIN THE PAST WEEK, PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR ANNOUNCED DEC. 3 THE MINISTER OF STATE MAHMUD KASHEFI WILL BECOME MINISTER OF STATE FOR EXECUTIVE AFFAIRS AND MAJLIS DEPUTY HOLAKU RAMBOD WILL BECOME MINISTER OF STATE FOR PARLIAMENTARY AFFAIRS TO REPLACE KASHEFI.

KASHEFI, 54, A CLOSE FRIEND OF THE PRIME MINISTER'S WAS NAMED MINISTER OF STATE FOR PARLIAMENTARY AFFAIRS IN AMOUZEGAR'S ORIGINAL CABINET LAST AUGUST. (BIOGRAPHIC DETAILS WERE PROVIDED REF. B). KASHEFI WILL STEP INTO THE POSITION RECENTLY VACATED BY MANOUCHEHR AGAH WHO WAS PROMOTED LAST WEEK TO MINISTER OF THE PLAN AND BUDGET ORGANIZATION (REF. A).

RAMBOD, 57, MAJLIS DEPUTY FROM TAVALESH, GILAN PROVINCE, HAS SERVED IN PARLIAMENT SINCE 1956. HE IS A 1939 GRADUATE OF TEHRAN MILITARY ACADEMY WHO SUBSEQUENTLY RESIGNED FROM THE ARMY TO WORK ON HIS FAMILY ESTATE IN TAVALESH. RAMBOD WAS THE LEADER OF THE OPPOSITION MARDOM (PEOPLE'S) PARTY IN THE MAJLIS FOR 14 YEARS UNTIL THE PARTY WAS DISSOLVED AFTER THE ESTABLISHMENT OF THE RESURGENCE PARTY IN 1975. RAMBOD WAS THE RECIPIENT OF A USIS INTERNATIONAL VISITOR GRANT IN 1967 AND WAS THE SUBJECT OF AN INR BIOGRAPHIC SUMMARY DATED 28 MARCH 1968. RAMBOD, WHO SPEAKS FAIR ENGLISH, FRENCH AND GERMAN, IS REPUTEDLY A SPELL-BINDING ORATOR WHEN SPEAKING IN FARSI.

DURING HIS YEARS AS A PARLIAMENTARY LEADER OF THE LOYAL OPPOSITION, HE WAS A FREQUENT, WELL-PUBLICIZED CRITIC OF THE GOVERNMENT. AN AVIATION EXPERT, RAMBOD HAS FOR MANY YEARS BEEN THE ALITALIA AGENT IN TEHRAN. AS MINISTER FOR PARLIAMENTARY AFFAIRS RAMBOD WILL ATTEND PARLIAMENTARY SESSIONS AS A REPRESENTATIVE OF THE PRIME MINISTER BUT WILL HAVE TO RESIGN AS AN ELECTED DEPUTY. AS THERE ARE TWO MORE YEARS LEFT IN THE PRESENT PARLIAMENT AND THERE IS NO OTHER DEPUTY FROM RAMBOD'S AREA OF GILAN PROVINCE, AN INTERIM ELECTION WILL BE HELD TO FILL THIS VACANCY.
REF TEHRAN 10735

SUMMARY: GOI IS CONTINUING INDIRECT CAMPAIGN TO PREVENT RENEWAL OF STUDENT DISORDERS USING MORE THREATS FROM SO-CALLED "LOYAL WORKERS," TOGETHER WITH RASTAKHIZ PARTY EXHORTATIONS FOR MORE EFFECTIVE UNVIERSITY ADMINISTRATION AIMED AT ATTRACTING POSITIVE SUPPORT FROM MAIN BODY OF STUDENTS. MEANWHILE, HANCELLOR HAS WARNED THAT ARYAMEHR UNIVERSITY WILL BE SHUT DOWN FOR REMAINDER OF ACADEMIC YEAR IF CLASS ATTENDANCE DOES NOT RISE TO NORMAL IN THREE DAYS (I.E. BY DECEMBER 8). END SUMMARY.

GOVERNMENT ACTIVITIES AGAINST OPPOSITION CONTINUED DECEMBER 5 WITH TWO MEETINGS PRESIDED OVER BY RASTAKHIZ PARTY CHIEF BAHERI, WHICH WERE WELL PUBLICIZED IN BOTH FARSI AND ENGLISH-LANGUAGE PRESS. ONE INVOLVED LARGE NUMBER OF UNIVERSITY STUDENT REPRESENTATIVES AT PRINCE GHOLAM REZA STADIUM. AS CARRIED IN THE PRESS, REMARKS QUOTED FROM SEVERAL STUDENT SPEAKERS FOCUSED ON CRITICISM OF (UNNAMED) GOVERNMENT AND UNIVERSITY AUTHORITIES AS MUCH AS DISRUPTIVE STUDENTS.

FOR EXAMPLE, ONE STUDENT REP ASSERTED THAT RESPECT FOR LAW MEANS "THE PERSON WHO BREAKS THE LAW CANNOT THEN COMPLAIN THAT HE HAS BEEN DEPRIVED OF HIS FREEDOM," WHILE ANOTHER STUDENT SPEAKER POINTED OUT THAT UNIVERSITY AND GOVERNMENT AUTHORITIES SOMETIMES CONTRIBUTE TO CREATION OF SUCH DISRUPTIVE EVENTS THROUGH THEIR INCOMPETENCE AND INDIFFERENCE TO STUDENT PROBLEMS. HE MENTIONED THAT AT STUDENT GATHERING WHEN RASTAKHIZ PARTY WAS FIRST CREATED ALMOST TWO YEARS AGO, PROVINCIAL STUDENTS WERE PROMISED FORTY THOUSAND PRE-FABRICATED HOUSING UNITS TO HELP ALLEVIATE TEHRAN HOUSING SHORTAGE, BUT NONE HAVE MATERIALIZED.

ANOTHER STUDENT CALLED ON PARTY OFFICIALS TO SPONSOR WEEKLY DISCUSSION SESSIONS WITH STUDENTS TO FOCUS ON VARIOUS PROBLEMS SUCH AS SHORTAGE OF PROFESSORS, STUDENT TRANSPORTATION FACILITIES, AND SCARCITY OF RECREATIONAL, WELFARE AND SPORTS FACILITIES IN UNIVERSITIES.

AT SEPARATE MEETING IN ELITE PRIME MINISTRY CLUB, BAHERI AND JAFFARIAN (NORT DEPUTY MANAGING DIRECTOR AND PARS NEWS AGENCY HEAD, SEE REFTEL) LECTURED TEACHERS AND OFFICIAL PARTICIPANTS AT SEMINAR ON STUDENT BEHAVIOR. BAHERI CALLED FOR INCREASED FLOW OF INFORMATION TO COMBAT "FOREIGN INTRIGUE" AT THE UNIVERSITIES, AS WELL AS A STRENGTHENED SENSE OF DUTY AND REFORM OF EXECUTIVE MISTAKES BY OFFICIALS AND ADMINISTRATORS.

JAFFARIAN REVIEWED POST WORLD WAR II DEVELOPMENTS IN IRAN (AS HE DID RECENTLY IN RASTAKHIZ NEWSPAPER, REFTEL), NOTING THAT YOUNG PEOPLE UNDER 25 YEARS OLD TO NOT REMEMBER CIRCUMSTANCES SURROUNDING EMERGENCE OF VARIOUS PARTIES OF THE RIGHT AND LEFT UNDER THE PATRONAGE OF OCCUPYING POWERS IN IRAN DURING WORLD WAR II. TREASON IS TREASON, HE REPORTEDLY SAID, WHETHER COMMITTED BY THE RIGHT OR THE LEFT, AND IT IS NECESSARY TO FOCUS SHARPLY ON THE PATTERN OF FOREIGN INTRIGUE.

ON THE OTHER HAND, THE SHAH-PEOPLE REVOLUTION IS THOROUGH, PROFOUND AND FUNDAMENTAL WITHOUT BEING DISRUPTIVE OR BLOODY. ------------------066389 061340Z /53 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 5754 INFO AMEMBASSY LONDON SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 10777

AS FOLLOW-UPP TO PRESS REPORT (REFTEL), ARYAMEHR UNIVERSITY CHANCELLOR MEHRAN WARNED STUDENTS YESTERDAY THAT UNLESS CLASSES ARE FILLED TO NORMAL CAPACITY WITHIN THREE AYS, THE UNIVERSITIES WILL BE CLOSED FOR THE ENTIRE ACADEMIC YEAR. HE URGED STUDENTS TO HELP ADMINISTRATIVE AUTHORITIES PROTECT EDUCATIONAL DISCIPLINE, AND FIRST STEP IN THIS DIRECTION IS ADEQUATE STUDENT ATTENDANCE IN CLASSES. HOWEVER, "IF SOME STUDENTS WISH TO CREATE DISORDER, THIS IS NOT AN EDUCATIONAL MATTER, AND THEY WILL BE DISMISSED FROM THE UNIVERSITY AND TURNED OVER TO THE APPROPRIATE JUDICIAL AUTHORITES." HE SPOKE TO MEETING WHICH PRESS REPORTED AS BEING ATTENDED BY 700 STUDENTS WHO CALLED ON THEIR CLASSMATES TO RETURN TO CLASSES.

FARSI PRESS ALSO REPORTED RECENT WORKERS' MEETING AT CASPIAN CITY OF RASHT WHICH REPORTEDLY CRITICIZED DISRUPTIVE OPPOSITIONIST ACTIVITIES AND CALLED ON GOVERNMENT TO STOP THEM -- OR PERMIT WORKERS TO PUT A STOP TO THEM THEMSELVES.

COMMENT: OUR PRIVATE SAMPLINGS INDICATE CLASSES AT MOST UNIVERSITIES IN TEHRAN ARE BEING ATTENDED WITH EVEN PARTIAL REGULARITY ONLY AT NIGHT, WHILE MOST STUDENTS AND AUTHORITIES ARE WAITING TO GET PAST DECEMBER 7 ANNIVERSARY BEFORE THEY DRAW CONCLUSIONS AS TO HOW MUCH MORE STUDENT TROUBLE MIGHT BE EXPECTED. APART FROM ONE REPORT OF POSSIBLE SMALLSCALE DISTURBANCE IN TEHRAN YESTERDAY, WHICH WE ARE INVESTIGATING, CITY HAS GENERALLY BEEN QUIET OVER PAST WEEK.

MEANWHILE, GOVERNMENT SEEMS TO BE PULLING OUT ALL STOPS IN PUBLIC RELATIONS CAMPAIGN AIMED, AT LEAST SO FAR, AT TWIN OBJECTIVES OF: (A) WARNING POTENTIAL DEMONSTRATORS THAT THEY MAY INCUR VIOLENT OPPOSITION FROM SO-CALLED "LOYAL WORKERS" WHILE (B) PUBLICIZING COMPLAINTS ABOUT ADMINISTRATIVE INEPTITUDE FROM SOME STUDENT REPRESENTATIVES AND RASTAKHIZ PARTY OFFICIALS. OFFICIALS ARE QUOTED AS ENCOURAGING MORE RESPONSIBLE PERFORMANCE BY BOTH THE UNIVERSITY AUTHORITIES AND THE STUDENTS WHO ARE BEING DUPED BY FOREIGN-ORIGINATED CONSPIRACIES.

WE DOUBT THE AMPAIGN OF PERSUASION HAS HAD MUCH EFFECT YET, BUT IF POTENTIAL DEMONSTRATORS CHOOSE TO IGNORE OPEN HINTS OF STRONG ACTION AGAINST THEM BY SUCH "WORKERS" AND POLICE, WE HAVE NO DOUBT THE AUTHORITIES ARE PREPARED TO REIMPOSE ORDER FORCEFULLY.

1977TEHRAN10814.subject: CONTINUING GOI MEDIA CAMPAIGN AGAINST OPPOSITION

segments.text: OPPOSITION REF A. TEHRAN 10777 B. TEHRAN 10735 SUMMARY: GOI CONTINUES HIGHLY PUBLICIZED CAMPAIGN TO DISSUADE STUDENT PROTESTORS. END SUMMARY.

(BEGIN UNCLASSIFIED) ON EVE OF DEC 7 ANNIVERSARY OF STUDENT DEMONSTRATIONS, IRANIAN TV CARRIED FULL REPORT OF RASTAKHIZ PARTY SYG BAHERI AND OTHERS AT PRIME MINISTRY CLUB SEMINAR LECTURING ACADEMIC AND OFFICIAL PARTICIPANTS ON STUDENT BEHAVIOR (REF A).

PRESS DEC 7 REPORTED BAHERI APPEARANCE AT TEHRAN COLLEGE OF COMPUTER SCIENCE (WHOSE OPERATING LICENSE HAS BEEN REVOKED -- SEE REF A), WHERE HE REPORTEDLY WARNED: "UNLESS YOU ARE PREPARED TO STUDY AND CONSIDER YOUR INTERESTS AND THOSE OF YOUR FAMILIES AND COUNTRY, YOU WILL NOT BE ABLE TO CONTINUE YOUR STUDIES." HE WONDERED WHY SMALL NUMBER OF UNRULY STUDENTS (SEVENTEEN) WERE PERMITTED TO DISRUPT WORK OF ALL OTHERS.

MEANWHILE, (PRO-GOI) STUDENT MEETING AT ARYAMEHR UNIVERSITY (WHICH HAS BEEN THREATENED WITH CLOSURE-REF B), REPORTEDLY PASSED A RESOLUTION CALLING ALL FELLOW STUDENTS TO DEVOTE FULL ATTENTION TO THEIR EDUCATION. RESOLUTION STATED CLASSES ARE BEING CONDUCTED REGULARLY, AND STUDENTS PLEDGED TO TAKE "PREVENTIVE ACTION" AGAINST ANY STUDENTS WHO ATTEMPTED DISRUPTION. FINALLY, RESOLUTION (WHICH WAS PURPORTEDLY ON BEHALF OF "ALL" ENROLLED STUDENTS) STATED THAT, IF DISRUPTIONS CAUSE CLASS RECESSES, "WE HEREBY ANNOUNCE THAT CURRENT ACADEMIC YEAR WILL BE CANCELLED."

ANOTHER ITEM REPORTED THAT SOME FIFTEEN THOUSAND WORKERS IN ISFAHAN HAD COME TOGETHER DECEMBER 6 TO VOICE THEIR OPPOSITION TO "FOREIGN-INSTIGATED AND DISGUSTING ANTI-STATE ACTIVITIES STAGED BY ELEMENTS MASQUERADING AS STUDENTS." PLEDGING ALLEGIANCE TO COUNTRY'S INTEGRITY, INSTITUTION OF MONARCHY, AND LEADERSHIP OF SHAHANSHAH, GROUP REPORTEDLY ASKED RASTAKHIZ PARTY SYG AND GOVERNMENT TO KEEP UNIVERSITY GROUNDS FREE FROM INSTIGATION BY ANARCHISTS, REACTIONARIES AND FOREIGN-INSPIRED ELEMENTS.

PRESS DEC 7 ALSO CARRIED REPORT THAT TEN STUDENTS AT ISFAHAN'S ARYAMEHR TECHNICAL UNIVERSITY WERE ARRESTED DEC 4 ON CHARGES OF DAMAGING UNIVERSITY PROPERTY AFTER THEY HAD PROVOKED INCIDENT IN WHICH THIRTY WINDOWS WERE BROKEN, AND RESISTED AUTHORITIES BY TOSSING STONES AT THEM AND SPRAYING THEM WITH HOT WATER.

PRESS NOTED WITH CONDEMNATORY COMMENT UPI STORY THAT TWENTY-FIVE IRANIAN STUDENTS IN LOS ANGELES WENT ON HUNGER STRIKE MONDAY, DEC 5, TO PROTEST "GENOCIDE IN TEHRAN." STUDENTS REPORTEDLY CITED (EMB COMMENT: WILDLY INFLATED) FIGURES OF SIXTY STUDENTS KILLED IN NOVEMBER RIOTS, WITH HUNDREDS MORE INJURED AND THOUSANDS ARRESTED. (END UNCLASSIFIED)

COMMENT: CONSUL IN ISFAHAN AND EMBOFF WHO HAS BEEN VISITING THERE CONFIRMED THAT INCIDENT OF BROKEN WINDOWS REPORTED ABOVE WAS APPARENTLY WELL ORGANIZED. IRANIAN AUTHORITIES DID NOT MENTION ANY ARRESTS WHEN DESCRIBING THIS INCIDENT TO THEM. CONSUL SIMILARLY NOTED THAT 15,000 WORKDERS SEEMED AN INFLATED FIGURE, BUT ISFAHAN GATHERING DID TAKE PLACE. IT WAS ONE OF AT LEAST FOUR GATHERINGS CALLED BY RASTAKHIZ PARTY TO GATHER WORKERS, STUDENTS, BUSINESSMEN AND TEACHERS FOR PROTEST AT UNIVERSITY DISRUPTIONS. IT WOULD, THEREFORE, APPEAR THAT RASTAKHIZ IS FOLLOWING THROUGH ON BAHERI'S PLEDGE THAT SUCH MEETINGS WILL BE TAKING PLACE AROUND THE COUNTRY (REF A).
FACT THAT ONLY A COUPLE HAVE RECEIVED PUBLICITY SO FAR (IN RASHT AND ISFAHAN) MIGHT SUGGEST INDICATE OTHER MEETINGS HAVE BEEN LESS SUCCESSFUL IN DRAWING SIGNIFICANT TORNOUT.

SEVERAL HUNDRED PARENTS OF STUDENTS HAVE BESIEGED TEHRAN AND ARYAMEHR UNIVERSITIES WITH REQUESTS THAT THREAT TO CLOSE UNIVERSITIES BE RECONSIDERED SO THEIR SONS AND DAUGHTERS CAN COMPLETE THEIR EDUCATIONS.

ACCORDING TO JOURNALIST SOURCE/BOMB THREAT HAS BEEN MADE AT ARYAMEHR UNIVERSITY. PRESS WAS TOLD THIS WAS DUE TO GO OFF LATER (AT 5 PM) TODAY NEAR COLLEGE OF COMPUTER SCIENCES WHICH HAS BEEN SCENE OF CONSIDERABLE TROUBLE.

SOURCE HAS PRIVATELY REPORTED TO EMBASSY THAT WHILE US WRESTLING TEAM WAS HAVING LUCH AT OLYMPIC VILLAGE TODAY SOME 100 OR 150 STUDENT TYPES BROKE IN AND TORE DOWN AN AMERICAN FLAG AND CHANTED ANTI-AMERICAN SLOGANS. AMERICAN ATHLETES WITHDREW INTO THEIR ROOMS WHERE THEY LOCKED THEMSELVES IN, AND STUDENT TYPES LEFT BEFORE ANY POLICE CAME.
APPARENTLY, ONE UNPUBLICIZED DEMAND OUT ON RASTAKHIZ PARTY CHIEF BAHARI BY SOME STUDENTS HAS BEEN RELEASE OF STUDENTS ARRESTED BY POLICE IN PAST COUPLE OF WEEKS.

1977TEHRAN10823.subject: INFCE: TCC CHAIRMANSHIP AND DECEMBER 12 MEETING

segments.text: REF A INFO ABOUT PROPOSAL THAT CHAYES CHAIR DECEMBER 12 TCC MEETING AND REF B VIEWS ABOUT CHAIRMAN'S ROLE CONVEYED IN DETAIL TO AEOI. RESPONSE RECEIVED TODAY IS AS FOLLOWS. : AEOI IN PRINCIPLE AGREES WITH THE VIEWS (CONTAINED IN OUR LETTER) REGARDING THE ROLE OF TCC CHAIRMAN UNQUOTE. FYI: DR. ARABIAN WILL AGAIN PARTICIPATE IN INFCE MEETINGS.

I MET FOR ONE HOUR AND A HALF WITH PRIME MINISTER AMOUZWGAR DECEMBER 7 TO DISCUSS VARIOUS CURRENT MATTERS OF MUTAUAL INTEREST. WE DISCUSSED SUBJECT OF STUDENT UNREST AND GOVERNMENT POLICY TOWARDS DISSENTERS IN SOME DETAIL.

AMOUZEGAR SAID GOI HAD DECIDED TO ESCHEW POLICE MEASURES IN HANDLING DISSENT. HE FELT BEST TACTIC AT UNIVERSITY LEVEL WAS TO MOBILIZE "SILENT MAJORITY" OF STUDENTS AND THEIR PARENTS WHO WISHED CLASSES TO CONTINUE AND TO ENCOURAGE THEM TO RESIST TACTICS OF THOSE FEW STUDENTS WHO SOUGHT, FOR POLITICAL REASONS, TO DISRUPT UNIVERSITY REGIME. RASTAKHIZ PARTY HAD BEEN ASSIGNED TASK OF CARRYING OUT THIS EFFORT.

I ASKED IF THIS MEANT WE WERE GOING TO SEE MUTUAL HEADBASHING SESSION. AMOUZEGAR SAID RASTAKHIZ GROUPS WOULD BE INSTRUCTED TO AVOID PHYSICAL CONFRONTATIONS. HE FELT THEY WOULD BE SO OVERWHELMING IN NUMBERS THAT DISSENTERS WOULD REFRAIN FRM PRECIPITATING SUCH CONFRONTATIONS.

AMOUZEGAR CLAIMED THAT THIS POLICY HAD ALREADY PROVED SUCCESSFUL AND THAT PARENTS HAD BEEN VERY INFLUENTIAL IN PREVENTING CLASS DISRUPTIONS ON DECEMBER 7, WHICH IS TRADITIONAL DAY FOR DISSENTER DEMONSTRATIONS. ACCORDING TO HIM, ONLY ELEMENT OF ANY MAJOR UNIVERSITY TO BE CLOSED THAT DAY WAS ECONOMIC FACULTY OF TEHRAN UNIVERSITY, WHERE FACULTY MEMBERS, RATHER THAN STUDENTS, HAD STAGED WALKOUT. HE SAID ALL CLASSES FUNCTIONED AT ARYAMEHR, WHICH HAD BEEN SCENE OF MAJOR DISRUPTIONS RECENTLY.

PRIME MINISTER WENT ON TO SAY THAT GOVERNMENT PARTICULARLY SOUGHT TO AVOID MAKING ARRESTS, BECAUSE "THESE PEOPLE WANT TO BE ARRESTED." HE SAID THEIR TACTIC WAS TO HAVE SOME OF THEIR MEMBERS ARRESTED, CONVEY THE INFORMATION IMMEDIATELY TO BARAHENI IN NEW YORK, AND HAVE EXAGGERATED REPORTS OF THE ARRESTS CIRCULATED IN THE UNITED STATES. THEN, HE SAID, I WOULD GET A LETTER FROM A CONGRESSMAN AND, IN EFFECT, BECOME AN ADVOCATE FOR THE PERSON ARRESTED.

AMOUZEGAR CLAIMS THAT GOI IS MONITORING CORRESPONDENCE AND TELEPHONE CALLS BETWEEN LOCAL DISSIDENT MOVEMENT AND BARAHENI. THEY ARE CONVINCED THAT LATTER IS CONTROLLING LOCAL OPERATIONS FROM NEW YORK AND SAID THIS WAS PARTICULARLY APPARENT DURING SHAH'S STATE VISIT TO U.S. HE WONDERED IF WE HAD ANY INFORMATION ON WHERE BARAHENI GOT HIS MONEY.

FINALLY, AMOUZEGAR SAID GOI WOULD PERMIT DISSENTING GROUPS TO CONTINUE HAVING PUBLIC MEETINGS, SIGNING LETTERS, AND OTHERWISE REMAINING ACTIVE. HOWEVER, HE SAID RASTAKHIZ WOULD ORGANIZE A COUNTER-ACTION TO EVERY SUCH ACTION AND ATTEMPT TO "DROWN" AND DISCREDIT THE DISSIDENTS IN THE PUBLIC EM.

I SAID I THOUGHT IT WAS IMPORTANT THAT DISSIDENTS CONTINUE TO FEEL THEY HAD SOME MEANS TO GIVE VENT TO THEIR VIEWS. OTHERWISE, THEY WOULD BECOME CONVINCED THERE WAS NO WAY WITHIN THE CURRENT SYSTEM TO ADVOCATE OPPOSITION. THIS, IN TURN, COULD CONVINCE THEM THAT VIOLENCE AND TERRORISM WERE THE ONLY ALTERNATIVES TO THE CURRENT SITUATION. P.M. EMPHATICALLY AGREED.

COMMENT: IT IS CLEAR THAT GOI IS CONTINUING TO FEEL ITS WAY THROUGH THE CIRCUMSTANCES WHICH HAVE RESULTED FROM ITS POLICY OF LIBERALIZING CONDITIONS FOR PUBLIC AIRING OF DISSENT. THE DECISION TO AVOID USE OF MASSIVE POLICE ACTION IS ENCOURAGING, BUT DISSIDENT REACTION TO THE "SILENT MAJORITY" TACTIC IS YET TO BE SEEN. IF THE DISSIDENTS OPT FOR VIOLENT CONFRONTATION, SOME NASTY STREET FIGHTING COULD ERUPT AND THE RASTAKHIZ GROUPS COULD TURN INTO GOON SQUADS. WE WILL CONTINUE TO MONITOR CAREFULLY.
OUR BEST INFORMATION INDICATES THAT DEC. 7 WAS RELATIVELY QUIET IN TEHRAN. BOMB THREAT (SEPTEL) DID NOT MATERIALIZE AND THERE WERE NO MASSIVE STUDENT DEMONSTRATIONS REPORTED.

NUMBER OF PARENTS GATHERED OUTSIDE TEHRAN AND ARYMAEHR UNIVERSITIES REACHED SEVERAL THOUSAND, AND SEVERAL WERE QUOTED IN THE PRESS EXPRESSING DISAPPROVAL OF STUDENT DISRUPTIONS AND HOPE THAT GOVERNMENT WILL INSURE INNOCENT STUDENTS DO NOT HAVE TO PAY PRICE FOR ACTIVITIES OF ONLY A FEW INDIVIDUALS. THIS REFERENCE APPARENTLY APPLIES ALSO TO A NUMBER OF STUDENTS WHO WERE ARRESTED BY POLICE IN DEMONSTRATIONS WHO CLAIM TO HAVE BEEN INNOCENT BYSTANDERS. ACCORDING TO ONE JOURNALISTIC SOURCE, POLICE HAVE RELEASED OR ARE PLANNING THE RELEASE OF ALL BUT SOME FORTY TO FIFTY STUDENTS WHO HAVE PRIOR POLICE RECORDS AS BEING INVOLVED IN DISRUPTIONS.
AMBASSADOR HAD A GOOD TALK WITH PRIME MINISTER ON THIS SUBJECT, BEING REPORTED SEPTEL.

1977TEHRAN10910.subject: AMENDMENTS TO MILITARY COURT LAW IN EFFECT

segments.text: MFA AMERICAN DEPARTMENT HEAD GOODARZI TRANSMITTED OFFICIAL REPLY TO POLCOUNS DEC. 10 THAT AMENDMENTS TO MILITARY COURT LAW ARE IN OPERATION. KAYHAN INTERNATIONAL DEC. 11 AND FARSI PRESS CARRIED ITEM DESCRIBING REGULATIONS WHICH PERTAIN TO CIVILIAN LAWYERS WHO REPRESENT DEFENDANTS AT MILITARY TRIBUNALS UNDER THESE AMENDMENTS. ACCORDING TO THE PRESS, THESE REGULATIONS WERE ANNOUNCED DEC. 10, APPROVED BY THE MINISTRIES OF WAR AND OF JUSTICE.
REGULATIONS AS CARRIED IN THE PRESS ARE
APPLY TO FIRST-CLASS LAWYERS OR ACTIVE OR RETIRED OFFICERS OF THE IMPERIAL ARMY OR STATE GENDARMERIE QUALIFICATIONS FOR SUCH LAWYERS AND OFFICERS ARE

POSSESSION OF A LICENCE TO PRACTICE FROM THE BAR ASSOCIATION, OR A BACHELOR DEGREE IN LAW, OR THE ADVANCED LAW-COURSE CERTIFICATE OF THE IMPERIAL ARMY, OR A SERVICE RECORD OF AT LEAST THREE YEARS IN MILITARY LEGAL CORPS OR PRACTICE RECORD OF AT LEAST FIVE YEARS IN MILITARY TRIBUNALS.
ABSENCE OF A CRIMINAL RECORD.
CLEARANCE FROM PROSECUTION ON ACCOUNT OF CRIMES AND MISDEMEANOURS.
ENDORSEMENT OF THE APPLICANT'S COMPETENCE BY THE AUTHORITIES CONCERNED.
REPRESENTATION POWERS OF THE FEFENCE ATTORNEYS WILL BEGIN IMMEDIATELY AFTER THEIR ACCREDITATION AND CEASE WHEN THE TRIBUNAL DELIVERS ITS VERDICT.
MAXIMUM RATES FOR ATTORNEYS HIRED BY DEFENDANTS ARE 15,000 RIALS IN CRIMINAL CASES AND 5,000 RIALS IN MISDEMEANOUR CASES.
FOR EVERY FREE-CHOICE CASE THE LAWYER REPRESENTS, HE OR SHE MUST ACCPT RESPONSIBILITY TO DEFEND TWO CASES AT THE DIRECTION OF THE TRIBUNAL WITHOUT GETTING ANY PAY.

FAILURE TO ATTEND THE TRIBUNAL SESSION WITHOUT REASONABLE EXCUSE WILL BE CONSIDERED A VIOLATION OF PROCEDURE. PRESENCE AT THESE SESSION WILL HAVE PRIORITY OVER ALL OTHER COMMITMENTS OF THE ATTORNEYS, EVEN WHEN THEY HAVE BEEN OFFICIALLY SUMMONED TO OTHER COURTS AND OFFICES.

COMMENT: WHILE GOODARZI GAVE NO DATE FOR THE AMENDMENTS BEING IN OPERATION, IT SEEMS CLEAR THERE HAVE BEEN NO TRIALS UNDER THEM TO DATE, AND SPECIFIC REGULATIONS INVOLVED IN IMPLEMENTING THEM HAVE JUST OR ARE IN PROCESS OF BEING DRAFTED. WE WOULD NOT BE SURPRISED IF OUR INQUIRY HELPED SPEED THEM UP, THOUGH TIME LAG COULD BE RESULT OF GENERAL BUREAUCRATIC SLOWNESS RATHER THAN ANY CONSCIOUS POLICY DECISION.

AS PER REF A, MISSION COORDINATOR HAS RESERVED ENOUGH SINGLE ROOMS AT HILTON FOR THE WHITE HOUSE PRESS CORPS AND WHITE HOUSE PRESS STAFF. PANAM AND TWA CREWS WILL BE HOUSED AT ARIA SHERATON, TOGETHER WITH THE CREWS OF AIR FORCE ONE AND BACKUP PLANE. THIS HOTEL I ABOUT TWO-THREE MILES FROM HILTON, I.E. 15-20 MINUTES BY CAR.

IMPOSSIBLE TO HOUSE US MEDIA PERSONNEL, NOT ACCOMPANYING PRES, AT HILTON--DESIGNATED PRESS HOTEL--AS PER REF B. NO HOTEL AVAILABLE NEAR HILTON. ATTEMPTS ARE BEING ADE TO GET MORE ROOMS AT ARIA SHERATON. IF SHERATON NOT POSSIBLE, WILL TRY TO RESERVE ROOMS ELSEWHERE, PREFERABLY IN ONE HOTEL, NOT TO STRAIN LOGISTICS. IN ORDER TO DO THIS, WE NEED NAMES OF SUCH MEDIA PERSONNEL, AFFILIATION, ETA AND EDT TEHRAN.
