1977TEHRAN10992.subject: COMMON FUND RES IN UN GENERAL ASSEMBLY

segments.text: CHARGE MET WITH MFA UNDERSECY ZELLI DEC 13 TO DISCUSS SUSPENSION OF UNCTAD COMMON FUND TALKS AND RES ON COMMON FUND NEGOTS TABLED BY GROUP OF 77 FOR CONSIDERATION BY GENERAL ASSEMBLY. WE STRESSED OUR INTEREST IN PREPARING THE GROUND FOR A RESUMPTION OF THE NEGOTS NEXT YEAR, RECOGNIZING THAT IMPORTANT DIFFERENCES BETWEEN GROUP B AND THE GROUP OF 77 REMAIN TO BE BRIDGED.

IN THIS CONNECTION WE SAID THAT WE DID NOT FIND THE RES TABLED BY THE GROUP OF 77 FOR GENERAL ASSEMBLY CONSIDERATION HELPFUL AS PRESENTLY PHRASED SINCE IT, IN OUR VIEW, DID NOT ACCURATELY REFLECT WHAT HAD TRANSPIRED AT GENEVA, OUR ATTITUDE NOR DID IT PROMOTE AN ATMOSPHERE CONDUCIVE TO CONSTRUCTIVE DISCUSSIONS IN THE FUTURE. WE URGED, THEREFORE, THAT GOI SUPPORT EFFORTS TO AVOID A RES OR IF THIS IS NOT POSSIBLE TO TURN A HAND TO DEVELOPING ONE THAT WOULD PROMOTE AN ATMOSPHERE CONDUCIVE TO A USEFUL DIALOGUE.

ZELLI, WHO WAS OBVIOUSLY NOT PARTICULARLY FAMILIAR WITH THE SUBJECT, TOOK COPIOUS NOTES AND PROMISED TO BE BACK TO US. WE LEFT WITH HIM A BOUT DE PAPIER WHICH COVERED THE POINTS MADE IN PARA 3 OF REF B.

1977TEHRAN10993.subject: THE UNIVERSITIES AND OPPOSITION: VIEW FROM ISFAHAN AND SHIRAZ

segments.text: AND SHIRAZ

SUMMAR: RECENT DEMONSTRATIONS AT THE UNIVERSITY OF ISFAHAN, ARYAMEHR TECHNICAL COLLEGE CAMPUS IN ISFAHAN AND PAHLAVI UNIVERSITY IN SHIRAZ HAVE HAD A SOMEWHAT DIFFERENT CAST FROM THOSE IN TEHRAN. UNIVERSITY ADMINISTRATORS BELIEVE THAT DEMONSTRATIONS HAVE BEEN LED BY OUTSIDE AGITATORS. THIS IS NOT WHOLLY TRUE AND ONLY A FEW FACULTY MEMBERS SEEM TO HAVE IN-DEPTH UNDERSTANDING OF WHAT IS HAPPENING. SITUATION IS REMINISCENT OF AMERICAN ACADEMIA PRIOR TO THE 1964 BERKELEY DISORDERS.

STUDENT ATTITUDES IN ISFAHAN AND SHIRAZ ARE MORE DEEPLY AFFECTED BY RELIGIOUS QUESTIONS AND BELIEFS AND NEITHER UNIVERSITIES NOR SECURITY SERVICES SEEM TO HAVE YET HIT UPON EFFECTIVE PROCEDURES FOR HANDLING SITUATIONS IN AN ORDERLY MANNER, BUT OVERT DEMONSTRATIONS HAVE VIRTUALLY STOPPED SINCE DECEMBER 7 (16TH AZAR). END SUMMARY.

FOLLOWING ARE BASED ON CONVERSATIONS WEEK OF DECEMBER 4-7 BETWEEN TEHRAN EMBOFF STEMPEL, CONSULATE PRINCIPAL OFFICERS TOMSETH AND MCGAFFEY, AND SENIOR FACULTY MEMBERS AT THE UNIVERSITIES OF ISFAHAN AND PAHLAVI UNIVERSITY INCLUDING CHANCELLOR AND VICE-CHANCELLOR RESPECTIVELY. IT ALSO INCLUDES RESULTS OF CONVERSATIONS BETWEEN TEHRAN EMBOFF AND RESPECTIVE CONSULS WITH LOCAL SECURITY, UNIVERSITY FACULTY, AND OTHER RELIGIOUS OFFICIALS.

DEMONSTRATIONS AT PAHLAVI IN SHIRAZ HAVE CONTINUED FOR SOME TIME. POLICE HAVE WATCHED DEMONSTRATORS AND RECENT ACTIONS AT PAHLAVI ARE SIMPLY CONTINUATION OF SERIES OF EVENTS. PAHLAVI VICE CHANCELLOR ABOH QASSEN-QAVAMI (WHO HAS BEEN ACTING CHANCELLOR FOR ABOUT TWO MONTHS DUE TO ABSENCE CHANCELLOR MEHR IN U.S.) FIRMLY BELIEVES DEMONSTRATIONS ARE WORK OF OUTSIDE AGITATORS BENT ON MAKING TROUBLE. OTHER FACULTY OBSERVERS BELIVE THAT STUDENT DEMONSTRATIONS ARE SIMPLY A CONTINUATION OF THOSE OCCURING IN PREVIOUS YEARS, BUT NOTE FOR FIRST TIME STUDENTS ARE ACTIVELY EXPRESSING POLITICAL DISCONTENT AND SHOWING WAREMENESS OF EVENTS IN TEHRAN.

ONE SLOGAN BEING SHOUTED AS "DEATH TO THE TRAITOROUS SHAH, PRAISE TO KHOMEINI" (REFERRING TO EXILED AYATOLLAH). STUDENTS WERE AMONG THOSE INVOLVED IN TRASHING OF LOCAL IRANAIR OFFICE AND BREAKING OF WINDOWS AT CINEMA REPORTED IN LOCAL PRESS. AREA OF CINEMA HAS BEEN GATHERING PLACE FOR SOCIAL GROUPS AND SHIRAZIS DO NOT ATTACH AS MUCH IMPORTANCE TO BROKEN MOVIE HOUSE WINDOWS AS DID NATIONAL PRESS.

PAHLAVI UNIVERSITY DEPARTMENT HEAD WHO IS CLOSE TO STUDENTS SAID PAHLAVI STUDENTS WERE DIVIDED INTO THREE BASIC GROUPS--SMALL RADICAL FACTION, MOST OF WHOM ARE ISLAMIC MARXISTS WHO HAVD FORMED SMALL SECRET GROUPS OFF CAMPUS; SMALL APOLITICAL FACTION WHICH CARES LITTLE ABOUT POLITICAL OUTCOMES AND RESULTS, AND VAST MAJORITY OF STUDENTS WHO HAVE COME TO PAHLAVI TO STUDY AND ARE CONCERNED ABOUT THE DISRUPTIONS CAUSED BY DEMONSTRATIONS. THERE ARE A FEW MILITATNT CONSERVATIVES AT PAHLAVI, INCLUDING WOMEN IN CHADORS, BUT FACULTY SOURCES BELIEVE THERE ARE NO MUJAHIDIN TERRORISTS IN THIS GROUP.

PAHLAVI FACULTY MEMBERS ARE AMBIVALENT ABOUT THE DEMONSTRATIONS. FIRST CONCERN IS THAT SUCH ACTIVITIES HINDER THE ACADEMIC COMMUNITY AND COULD LEAD TO CANCELLATION OF COURSES. IN THIS CONNECTION IT IS EXPECTED THAT THE ENGINEERING STUDENTS WILL LOSE THE ENTIRE YEAR AND OTHERS MAY LOSE SEMESTER'S CREDIT. ON THE OTHER HAND, FACULTY LIKE THE IDEA THAT OPPOSITION IS POSSIBLE AND THAT SUCH DEMONSTRATIONS CAN TAKE PLACE. FACULTY AT PAHLAVI (AS WELL AS AT ISFAHAN--SEE BELOW) HAD AN ARGUMENT OVER WHETHER POLICE SHOULD BE BROUGHT ONTO THE CAMPUS.

THE FACULTY FINALLY AGREED TO THIS ABOUT NOVEMBER ------------------027575 131344Z /44 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 5866 INFO AMEMBASSY LONDON SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 10993 NOFORN 20 IN THE INTEREST OF MAINTAINING ORDER. PAHLAVI UNIVERSITY HAS NO INTERNAL POLICE FORCE OF ITS OWN.

AT PAHLAVI DEMONSTRATIONS TO DATE HAVE BEEN HANDLED IN SUCH A WAY THAT THE MAJORITY OF FACULTY AND EDUCATION OFFICIALS BELIEVE STUDENTS DISORDERS WILL TAPER OFF AFTER 16TH OF AZAR (DEC. 7) MANIFESTATIONS.

MANIFESTATIONS OF RELIGIOUS SENTIMENT HAVE APPEARED AT PAHLAVI UNIVERSITY BUT MORE SO AT THE REZA MUSA MOSQUE, WHERE AN IMAM DID GET UP AND PRAISE T J IMAM KHOMEINI AS REPORTED IN THE NATIONAL PRESS. IN ADDITION, A GIRLS SCHOOL ATTACHED TO THE MOSQUE WAS CLOSED WHEN IT WAS DISCOVERED THAT TWO OF THE LEADING FACULTY MEMBERS WERE TEACHING ISLAMIC-MARXIST IDEAS AS WELL AS IDEAS OF IMAM KHOMEINI.

AT ISFAHAN, RELIGIOUS FEELING HAS PLAYED STRONGER ROLE IN MOBILIZING STUDENTS FOR DEMONSTRATIONS, BUT HERE LEADERSHIP EVEN MORE FIRMLY IN HANDS OF A SMALL COTERIE OF MARXIST STUDENTS KNOWN TO SEVERAL PROFESSORS. SOURCES NOTE THAT RELIGIOUS INFLUENCE ENTERS THE EQUATION IN UNUSUAL WAYS AND IS NOT ALWAYS MANIFESTED IN LOGICAL THOUGHT. FACULTY MEMBERS SAY CONTRADICTIONS BETWEEN ISLAM AND MARXISM ARE NOT UNDERSTOOD AT ALL, AND ARE DOWNPLAYED BY MORE SOPHISTICATED ISLAMIC-MARXIST STUDENTS WHO REMAIN IN BACKGROUND AND URGE MORE NAIVE, ENERGETIC STUDENTS FORWARD AS LEADERS OF ACTUAL VIOLENCE.

ISFAHAN UNIVERSITY CHANCELLOR TOUSSI REPEATED FAMILIAR LITANY ABOUT OUTSIDE INTERFERENCE AND SAID UNIVERSITY DID NOT KNOW WHO STUDENTS WERE. HE EXHIBITED ANNOYANCE WITH PROBLEM, AND, LIKE SOME OTHER SENIOR FACULTYADMINSTRATIVE OFFICERS OF BOTH PAHLAVI AND ISFAHAN UNIVERSITIES, SHOWED NO REAL UNDERSTANDING OF OR INTEREST IN DYNAMICS OF STUDENT MOVEMENT. THIS ATTITUDE REMINDED EMBOFF VERY MUCH OF VIEWS OF SENIOR UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA OFFICERS PRIOR TO BEGINNING OF BERKELEY UNREST AND RIOTS IN 1964. OTHERS ON ISFAHAN FACULTY, HOWEVER, ARE MUCH MORE KNOWLEDGEABLE AND NOTED THAT UNIVERSITY DISCIPLINARY COMMITTEE DID IN FACT HAVE NAMES OF 80 INVOLVED IN DEMONSTRATIONS.

HOWEVER, DISAGREEMENT WITHIN FACULTY EXISTS OVER SUITABLE PUNISHMENT TO BE METED OUT. TO DATE, ONLY FIVE HAVE BEEN SUSPENDED FOR ONE SEMESTER AND COMMITTEE CANNOT AGREE ON EVIDENCE OF CONSPIRACY BY 12 OTHERS. AFTER SEVERAL DAYS OF PARTIALLY EFFECTIVE STRIKE, UNIVERSITY REOPENDED AFTERNOON OF DECEMBER 6 AND CLASSES HAVE BEEN MORE OR LESS NORMAL EVER SINCE.

ARYAMEHR TECHNICAL COLLEGE CAMPUS AT ISFAHAN, WHICH HOUSES FRESHMAN CLASS, ALSO HAS SEEN STRIKE ACTION OVER PAST THREE WEEKS, BUT STUDENTS ADAMANT THAT CAUSES ARE NOT POLITICAL, BUT INADEQUATE CONDITION OF CAMPUS--NO HEAT, INADEQUATE RUNNING WATER, ETC. FACULTY FEARFUL THAT, DESPITE AVOWED NON-POLITICAL NATURE OF PROTEST, ANY FUTURE POLICE ACTION IN ISFAHAN COULD EASILY BE EXPANDED TO INCLUDE ARYAMEHR CAMPUS THERE.

CONCLUSIONS: POLICE SEEM TO BE MAINTAINING RELATIVELY RESTRAINED ATTITTUDE IN PROVINCES SIMILAR TO THAT WHICH PREVAILED IN TEHRAN PRIOR TO NOVEMBER 15. ISFAHAN AND PAHLAVI UNIVERSITIES, HOWEVER, LIKE OVERWHELMING MAJORITY OF THEIR COUNTERPARTS IN IRAN, HAVE NOT FOUND SUITABLE YET FULLY EFFECTIVE COMBINATION OF PROCEDURES AND COERCION TO HANDLE DEMONSTRATIONS WITHOUT DISRUPTING UNIVERSITIES. ABILITY OF DISSIDENT STUDENT LEADERS TO WORK BEHIND SCENES AND USE RELIGIOUS FEELING AS ENERGIZING FORCE IS WORTH NOTING, AS IS ORGANIZATIONAL CAPACITY OF ISFAHAN DISSIDENTS. ACCORDING TO SOURCE WHO WAS PRESENT, WINDOWBREAKING DEMONSTRATION AT ISFAHAN (TEHRAN 10814) WAS SO WELL ORGANIZED THAT ALL WINDOWS WERE BROKEN AT ONCE AT STROKE OF 11 A.M.

MEDIA REPORT DECEMBER 13 AND CHECK WITH CONSULS IN SHIRAZ AND ISFAHAN INDICATE QUIET HAS PREVAILED THERE AND ELSEWHERE SINCE DECMBER 7. AT UNIVERSITY OF ISFAHAN, CLASS ATTENDANCE IS RUNNING ABOVE NORMAL, AND STUDENTS ARE APOLOGIZING TO PROFESSORS FOR BEHAVIOUR OF DISRUPTERS. GENERAL ATTITUDE SEEMS TO BE "NOW WE CAN GET ON WITH IT". SEEMS LIKELY THAT PARENTAL PRESSURES (TEHRAN 10827) MAY BE WEIGHING IN WITH STUDENTS, PARTICULARLY AT ISFAHAN UNIVERSITY.

MFA DEPARTMENT HEAD DAVOUDI WHO ACCOMPANIED SHAH ON VISIT TOLD US DEC. 13 THAT MEETINGS AND OTHER ACTIVITIES WERE STRICTLY ROUTINE. ANY SUBSTANTIVE DISCUSSIONS THAT MIGHT HAVE TAKEN PLACE WOULD HAVE BEEN IN A MEETING SHAH AND SULTAN HAD ALONE WITH NO OTHERS PRESENT, AND NO ONE ELSE IS INFORMED. HE AGREED THERE COULD HAVE BEEN DISCUSSION OF OMAN'S CURRENT BOUNDARY DISPUTE WITH UAE AND RASAL-KHAIMAH, AS WELL AS GULF SECURITY.

RE PARA 4 REF. B, DAVOUDI SAID A GENERAL DESIRE HAD BEEN EXPRESSED ON OMANI SIDE FOR COOPERATION IN OIL, MINIERAL DEVELOPMENT AND OTHER ECONOMIC AREAS, BUT THIS WAS LEFT FOR FUTURE CONTACTS. NO IRANIAN ECONOMIC SPECIALIST ACCOMPANIED SHAH ON THE VISIT, AND SUBJECT DID NOT GET ANY SUBSTANTIVE DISCUSSION THAT HE WAS AWARE OF.

INCIDENTALLY, WE NOTED THAT PRESS RELEASES EMANATING FROM OMAN REFERRED TO THE GULF RATHER THAN THE PERSIAN GULF. DAVOUDI SAID THIS MEANT NO CHANGE IN IRAN'S BASIC POLICY ON THE SUBJECT (THOUGH, OF COURSE, IT DOES SHOW A CERTAIN SENSITIVITY TO THE REQUIREMENTS OF OMAN'S IMAGE WITH ITS FELLOW ARAB STATES WHICH IRANIANS HAVE NOT ALWAYS SHOWN IN THE PAST.). MIKLOS *** Current Handling Restrictions *** n/a *** Current Classification *** CONFIDENTIAL

CHARGE DISCUSSED SUBSTANCE OF REFTEL WITH MFA UNDERSECRETARY ZELLI AFTERNOON OF DECEMBER 14 GIVING HIM FULL DETAILS IN PARA 3,4 AND 5. WE ALSO TOLD ZELLI WE HAD NO OBJECTION TO IRAN'S PLAYING LEADING ROLE IN FRUSTRATING AIR LIFT IN ANY WAY IT FOUND FEASIBLE. ZELLI TOOK COPIOUS NOTES AND COMMENTED THAT IN THE CASE OF IRAN WE WERE, OF COURSE, PREACHING TO THE CONVERTED. IN RESPONSE TO HIS QUERY WE GAVE IIM REPRESENTATIVE SAMPLE OF OTHER COUNTRIES WE WERE APPROACHING ALONG THE SAME LINES. HE SAID THAT GOI HAD ALREADY TALKED TO TURKEY ABOUT THIS BUT HAD GOTTEN NO OFFICIAL REACTION.
REQUEST AUTHORIZATION TO PASS ON SUBSTANCE OF ANKARA 9071 AND ANY ADDITIONAL COMMENTS GOT MAY MAKE TO US SUBSEQUENTLY ON THIS SUBJECT.

1977TEHRAN11079.subject: LOS COMPULSORY DISPUTE SETTLEMENT: MILITARY EXEMPTION AND IRAN

segments.text: POLCOUNS LAMBRAKIS ATTEMPTED TO PASS MEASSAGE REFTEL TO MFA LEGAL DEPARTMENT HEAD KAZEMI DEC 13 IN TERMS OF SOMETHING WHICH HAD APPEARED IN US DELEGATION'S NOTES ON MEETING JUNE 27 AND COULD BE PUT BEHIND US NOW THAT WE UNDERSTOOD CORRECT IRANIAN POSITION. KAZEMI PROTESTED THAT, GIVEN SYSTEM PREVAILING IN IRAN, SUCH AN ANSWER WOULD SIMPLY BE ACCEPTED AT FACE VALUE, IE., IF US NOTES CONTAIN SUCH INFORMATION IT MUST BE TRUE. KAZEMI ITERATED THAT REMARKS ATTRIBUTED TO HIM ARE CONTRARY TO HIS VIEWS AND MUST HAVE BEEN CONFUSED WITH THOSE OF IRAQI DELEGATE (TEHRAN 9830).

HE ASSERTED THAT HE DID NOT EVEN ATTEND ANY MEETINGS TO DISCUSS COMPULSORY SETTLEMENT OF DISPUTE. IRANIAN DELEGATE WHO ATTENDED SPOKE IN FRENCH, WHICH MAY HAVE ADDED TO THE CONFUSION. HOWEVER, KAZEMI TOOK FULL RESPONSIBILITY FOR HIS REPRESENTATIVE AND DID NOT FURTHER IDENTIFY HIM.

KAZEMI ASKED THAT WE AGAIN QUERY WASHINGTON IN THE HOPE THAT WASHINGTON MIGHT FIND ITSELF ABLE TO AGREE THAT DELEGATION'S NOTES ON THAT MEETING MAY HAVE BEEN MISTAKEN. THIS WOULD HELP HIM IF IT CAME BACK AS OFFICIAL REPLY FROM US.

COMMENT: KAZEMI IS OBVIOUSLY UNDER PRESSURE FROM HIGHER LEVELS IN HIS MINISTERY AND PERHAPS FROM OTHER MINISTRIES. DESPITE HIS OCCASIONAL CRANKINESS, HE CAN CONTINUE TO BE HELPFUL TO THIS EMBASSY. SINCE IN OUR OPINION THERE HAS ALREADY BEEN TOO MUCH REMASTICATION OF A SINGLE INCIDENT, AND KAZEMI HIMSELF HAS ALREADY LEARNED WHATEVER LESSONS THERE MAY HAVE BEEN TO LEARN FROM IT, REQUEST DEPARTMENT TAKE ANOTHER LOOK AT THE MATTER AND SEE IF US DELEGATION'S NOTES MIGHT HAVE BEEN MISTAKEN ON THIS POINT.
WE WOULD LIKE TO BE ABLE TO PASS SUCH A MESSAGE BACK TO KAZEMI FOR USE WITH HIS SUPERIORS, AND WE FEEL WE HAVE LITTLE TO LOSE BY IT.

1977TEHRAN11087.subject: MGEN MOGHARABI SENTENCED BY GOI MILITARY COURT

segments.text: DEC 15 ISSUE OF FARSI LANGUAGE DAILY RESTAKHIZ CARRIED SHORT ANNOUNCEMENT THAT MAJ GEN AHMED MOGHARABI, A STAFF OFFICER OF THE SUPREME COMMANDER'S STAFF, HAS BEEN SENTENCED TO DEATH BY A MILITARY COURT ON CHARGES OF SPYING. MOGHARABI WILL BE EXPECTED BY FIRING SQUAD IF MILITARY COURT OF APPEALS, WHICH WILL MEET DEC 18, CONFIRMS THE COURT SENTENCE. THE PAPER ALSO ANNOUNCED IN SAME STORY THAT ALI NAGHI RABANI, AN EMPLOYEE OF THE GOI MINISTRY OF EDUCATION, WAS ARRESTED ON SPYING CHARGES AND WILL BE TRIED IN A CIVIL COURT ON DEC 19.

RASTAKHIZ IS THE ONLY TEHRAN PAPER TO CARRY ANNOUNCEMENT OF THESE TWO CASES. THAT PAPER'S BRIEF STORY DID NOT PROVIDE AS COMPLETE A REPORT AS AP ITEM FILED FROM TEHRAN TODAY. RASTAKHIZ DID NOT IDENTIFY MOGHARABI'S POSITION WITHIN THE GOI, NOR MENTION THAT HE WAS CHARGED WITH SPYING FOR THE SOVIET UNION. FYI: AP ITEM INFLATES MOGHARABI'S RESPONSIBILITIES BY IDENTIFYING HIM AS "SECOND IN COMMAND AT IMPERIAL MILITARY HEADQUARTERS." AS NOTED ABOVE, THIS WAS NOT THE CASE.

1977TEHRAN11113.subject: REPLY TO SECRETARY'S BRIEFING ON MIDDLE EAST TRIP

segments.text: COURT MINISTER HOVEYDA TOLD ME DECEMBER 15 THAT THE SHAH'S REPLY TO THIS MESSAGE HAS BEEN SENT VIA AMBASSADOR ZAHEDI.

ON THE BASIS OF REFTEL WE SHARED WITH MFA UNDERSECRETARY ZELLI, TURKISH THINKING ON THE PROBLEM OF SOVIET OVERFLIGHTS AND TURKISH PERCEPTIONS OF DIFFICULTIES THEY CONFRONT IN FRUSTRATING THIS ACTION. ZELLI WAS UNIMPRESSED WITH TURKISH CONCERNS ABOUT THE APPLICATION OF THE MONTREUX CONVENTION AND POSSIBLE SOVIET RETALIATION. HE ASKED THAT WE LET HIM KNOW OF ANY FINAL DECISION THE TURKS MAY MAKE AS TO WHAT COURSE OF ACTION THEY INTEND TO PURSUE. HE DID NOT INDICATE WHETHER WITH GOI WOULD BE TAKING THE MATTER UP AGAIN DIRECTLY WITH THE GOT.

MFA UNDERSECRETARY ZELLI HAS CONFIRMED TO CHARGE THAT IRAN WOULD BE INTERESTED IN PARTICIPATING IN CONTACT GROUP. IT IS, OF COURSE, LIKELY THAT IRAN WOULD WISH TO SELECT WITH CARE THE COUNTRIES IT WOULD BE ASKED TO CONTACT, AND CONSULTATIONS ON THIS POINT WILL EVENTUALLY BE IN ORDER.

EVENING OF DEC 17 FONMIN KHALATBARY TOLD ME THAT IRAN WAS BECOMING INCREASINGLY CONCERNED ABOUT THE SITUATION IN AFGHANISTAN. HE MENTIONED VERY BRIEFLY THE REPORTED RESIGNATION OF 6 MINISTERS (SUBSEQUENTLY WITHDRAWN), THE ASSASSINATION OF THE MINISTER OF PLANNING AND THE HEAD OF AFGHANISTAN PILOT'S ASSOCIATION, AND DAOUD'S ALLEGED DECLINING HEALTH. HE SAID MFA UNDERSECY ZELLI WOULD BE IN TOUCH WITH ME FURTHER ON THIS MATTER.

AS ANTICIPATED ZELLI SUMMONED ME DEC 18 AND TOLD ME THAT HE HAD HAD A REPORT FROM THE IRANIAN AMB IN ISLAMABAD HAD JUST RETURNED FROM A VISIT TO AFGHANISTAN AND EXPRESSED TO THE IRANIAN AMB HIS CONCERN OVER WHAT HE HAD FOUND IN AFGHANISTAN DURING HIS VISIT. THE PICTURE THAT EMERGED WAS ONE OF A GOVT DIVIDED AND WARRING, AN ILL LEADER WHO WAS LOSING CONTROL, AND GROWING LAWLESSNESS AND VIOLENCE THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY. ZELLI WANTED TO KNOW HOW WE SAW THE SITUATION .

I SAID THAT FROM THE REPORTS I HAD SEEN THIS SEEMED TO BE A GROSSLY OVERDRAWN STORY. WHILE IT IS TRUE THAT THERE SEEMED TO HAVE BEEN SOME TURBULENCE IN GOVT RANKS, AS FAR AS I KNEW THINGS HAD NOW SUBSIDED AND DAOUD WAS IN FULL CONTROL. AS TO HIS ILLNESS, WE HAD HEARD THAT HE HAD A TOUCH OF FLU RECENTLY BUT AS FAR AS WE KNEW NOTHING SERIOUS OR LASTING. THE 2 ASSASSINATIONS THAT ZELLI AND THE FONMIN HAD MENTIONED SEEMED TO BE ISOLATED INCIDENTS WHICH DID NOT FIT INTO ANY PERCEPTABLE PATTERN OF GROWING VIOLENCE OR LAWLESSNESS.

I SAID THAT I DID NOT KNOW THE BACKGROUND OR AFFILIATION OF THE AFGHANISTAN AMB IN ISLAMABAD OR WHAT CAUSED HIM TO DRAW SUCH A GLOOMY PICTURE BUT THAT I WOULD SEEK AN UPDATED ASSESSMENT OF HOW WE SAW CURRENT AFGHANISTAN AFFAIRS.
APPRECIATE GUIDANCE.
DRAWING ON REFTEL I BRIEFED FULLY MINISTER OF COURT HOVEYDA MORING OF DEC 19. HOVEYDA PROMISED TO REPORT TO THE SHAH IMMEDIATELY.
I ALSO TOLD HIM THAT WE HOPED TO HAVE SOMETHING ON THE QUESTION OF HUSSEIN AND ASSAD MEETING WITH PRESIDENT EARLY THIS WEEK.

1977TEHRAN11191.subject: MAJ GEN MOGHARABI LOSES APPEALS TRIAL

segments.text: ALL EDITIONS LOCAL NEWSPAPERS DEC 19 CARRIED BANNER HEADLINES AND FRONT PAGE PHOTOS OF MGEN AHMAD MOGHARABI'S MILITARY COURT OF APPEALS TRIAL. AFTER SEVERAL HOURS OF DELIBERATION COURT UPHELD DEC 14 DEATH SENTENCE OF MILITARY COURT ON CHARGES OF SPYING FOR "FOREIGN AGENTS".

IN CONTRAST TO EARLIER PRESS REPORTS (REFTEL, TODAY'S LENGTHY STORIES INCLUDED PHOTOS OF EXTENSIVE CAMERA AND COMMUNICATIONS EQUIPMENT PRESENTED AS PROSECUTION EVIDENCE AND REPORTED PROSECUTION AND DEFENSE ARGUMENTS DURING TRIAL. A NUMBER OF FOREIGN AND LOCAL NEWS REPORTERS WERE PRESENT.

MOGHARABI, 56-YEAR OLD FATHER OF 5 REPORTEDLY ADMITTED DURING TRIAL CLANDESTINE CONTACTS WITH FOREIGN AGENTS (INCLUDING 3 VISITS TO A "FOREGIN EMBASSY"), USE OF INVISIBLE INK AND POSSESSION OF SOPHISTICATED EQUIPMENT. HE CLAIMED, HOWEVER, THAT HE HAD STARTED SPYING ONLY AFTER BEING BLACKMAILED IN CONNECTION WITH CONTACTS WITH A MAJ NIEV IN 1944, AND THAT HE HAD HANDED OVER ONLY "GENERAL INFORMATION" AVAILABLE IN ARMS BROCHURES, VEHICLE MAINTENANCE MANUALS AND OTHER UNCLASSIFIED MATERIAL. MOGHARABI WAS FURTHER REPORTED AS SAYING THAT HE HAD NEVER REVEALED NAMES OF GOI OFFICERS IN SENSITIVE POSITIONS OR OF GOI DECODING AND DECRYPTING SYSTEMS, AND THAT HE NEVER RECEIVED MONEY FOR HIS SERVICES.

PROSECUTION RESPONDED TO ABOVE CLAIMS BY REFERRING TO GOI LEGAL DEFINITION OF "ESPIONAGE" WHICH APPLIES EQUALLY DURING WAR OR PEACETIME AND UNDER WHICH, ACCORDING TO GOI INTELLIGENCE EXPERTS, MATERIAL PROVIDED BY MOGHARABI IS INCLUDED. PROSECUTOR ALSO STATED THAT MOGHARABI'S MODE OF OPERATION, ACCORDING TO EXPERTS, EXHIBITIED EVERY SIGN OF PERSONAL INTEREST RATHER THAN COOPERATION OUT OF RELUCTANT DURESS.
ACCORDING TO THE PRESS, THE SHAH HAS ANNOUNCED HE WILL NOT GRANT EXECUTIVE CLEMENCY.

1977TEHRAN11240.subject: NUCLEAR OFFICIALS FROM IRAN, PAKISTAN, AND TURKEY HOLD RCD MEETING

segments.text: (C) ANKARA 9175

THIRD MEETING OF HEADS OF THE ATOMIC ENERGY ORGANIZATIONS OF THREE MEMBER COUNTRIES OF REGIONAL COOPERATION FOR DEVELOPMENT (RCD) MET IN TEHRAN NOVEMBER 28 AND 29. ACCORDING TO PRESS REPORT, MEETING REVIEWED PROGRESS MADE IN THEIR COOPERATION SINCE LAST SUCH MEETING IN APRIL 1976. IN ADDITION TO ROUTINE MATTERS SUCH AS EXCHANGE OF INFORMATION, EXPERTS AND TRAINEES; JOINT RESEARCH; AND ARRANGING REGIONAL SEMINARS AND WORKSHOPS, MEETING ALSO ADDRESSED MORE SPECIFIC MATTERS THAT HAD BEEN RECOMMENDED FOR ATTENTION AS RESULT OF MEETING EARLIER THIS YEAR OF FUNCTIONAL SPECIALISTS.

THESE SUBJECTS INCLUDED PLANNING OF NUCLEAR POWER PLANTS INCLUDING PREPARATION OF SPECIFICATIONS AND BID DOCUMENTS; APPLICATION OF ISOTOPES IN AGRICULTURE; PRESERVATION OF FOOD BY RADIATION; AND MEDICAL APPLICATION OF RADIATION AND RADIOISOTOPES.

EMBASSY HAS LEARNED FROM TURKISH RCD REP MEHMET EZEN THAT THIS MEETING WAS, AT LEAST IN HIS VIEW, MOST SUCCESSFUL RCD MEETING EVER HELD. TURKISH DELEGATION, HEADED BY MINISTER OF STATE, PROMISED TO SEND AN UNSPECIFIED NUMBER OFU.S. AND GERMAN TRAINED NUCLEAR POWER EXPERTS TO WORK IN IRAN BEGINNING IN JANUARY 1978. IT WAS NOTED THAT TURKEY HAD SOME TEN OR TWELVE SUCH EXPERTS WHOSE SKILLS ARE CURRENTLY NOT BEING UTILIZED IN TURKEY. COMMENT: PRESUMABLY THESE EXPERTS WILL TRAIN IRANIANS IN POWER REACTOR OPERATIONS, IN AN EFFORT TO PREPARE FOR INITIATION OF POWER GENERATING OPERATIONS, HERE IN 1981.
TURKISH RCD REP ALSO COMMENTED THAT PAKISTANI EXPERTS PRESENTED TWO PAPERS (ON PRESERVATION OF FOOD BY RADIATION AND ON MEDICAL APPLICATION OF RADIATION AND RADIOISOTOPES) THAT WERE HIGHLY ACCLAIMED.
IF ANKARA CAN LEARN FURTHER DETAILS ABOUT TURKISH LOAN OF NUCLEAR POWER EXPERTS WE WOULD APPRECIATE IT.

THE SECOND SPY TRIAL WITHIN THE PAST WEEK TOOK PLACE DEC 19 AT WHICH AL NAQI RABBANI QUJDEH, OF THE MINISTRY OF EDUCATION WAS CONDEMNED TO DEATH FOR ESPIONAGE BY THE FIFTH BENCH OF THE MILITARY TRIBUNAL. THE FIVE MILITARY JUDGES UNANIMOUSLY FOUND QUJDEH GUILTY OF HAVING REGULARLY PASSED TO "FOREIGN AGENTS" MATERIAL INJURIOUS TO THE SECURITY OF THE STATE. THE 54-YEAR OLD FORMER DIRGEN OF SCOUTING AFFAIRS AT THE MINISTRY OF EDUCATION WAS REPORTEDLY ARRESTED WHILE ENGAGED IN A CLANDESTINE CONVERSATION WITH A FOREIGNER.

IN CONTRAST TO EARLIER CASE OF MAJ GEN MOGHARABI (REFTELS) CONSIDERABLE BACKGROUND INFORMATION HAS BEEN MADE AVAILABLE TO THE LOCAL PRESS. NEWS ACCOUNTS REVEAL THAT ON MAY 24 GOI INTELLIGENCE AGENTS FOUND QUJDEH CARRYING 500,000 RIALS WHICH HE ALLEGEDLY ADMITTED HE HAD RECEIVED FROM THE FOREIGN AGENT. THE DEFENDANT WAS A MEMBER OF THE TUDEH (COMMUNIST) PARTY DURING WORLD WAR II AT WHICH TIME HE WAS RECRUITED FOR INTELLIGENCE WORK AND WAS SUBSEQUENTLY AN EMPLOYEE AND THEN CHIEF OF THE ARCHIVES OF THE PRIMINS OFFICE FROM 1947 TO EARLY 1954.

THE PROSECUTION CHARGED THAT QUJDEH PROVIDED 14 FOREIGN AGENTS WITH VARIOUS MATERIAL INCLUDING BILATERAL AGREEMENTS SIGNED BY GOI WITH OTHER COUNTRIES, MATERIAL ON IRAN'S BORDER DISPUTES WITH ITS NEIGHBORS, INFORMATION ON SAVAK, MOVEMENTS OF FOREIGN DIPLOMATS, ESCAPE OF TUDEH PRISONERS FROM QASR PR PRISON AND STUDIES OF POSSIBLE DISCONTENT IN THE ARMED FORCES. PUBLICLY THERE HAS BEEN NO IDENTIFICATION OF THE "FOREIGN AGENTS" BUT IT IS COMMON KNOWLEDGE THAT THEY ARE SOVIET AGENTS. IN FACT, WE HAVE BEEN TOLD THAT THE SOVIETS WERE MENTIONED AT THE TRIAL OF MOGHARABI BUT THE PRESS WAS ASKED NOT TO REPORT THIS.
QUJDEH APPEALED THE VERDICT AND THE CASE WILL BE HEARD BY A MILITARY COURT OF APPEALS.
THE FOLLOWING NEW AMBASSADORIAL APPOINTMENTS WERE ANNOUNCED DEC 19 BY THE MINISTRY OF FON AFFS. ALL THE NEWLY APPOINTED OFFICIALS ARE CAREER DIPLOMATS.

BAHMAN AHANIN, THE NEW AMB TO MEXICO, IS A GRADUATE IN LAW FROM TEHRAN UNIV AND HAS A MASTER'S DEGREE IN ADMINISTRATIVE SCIENCE FROM NYU. HE ENTERED THE IRANIAN FOREIGN SERVICE IN 1941 AND HAS SERVED IN THE FOLLOWING POSTS ABROAD: WASHINGTON, UNITED NATIONS, BOMBAY, AND WAS NAMED AMB TO INDONESIA IN 1969. AT HOME HE HAS BEEN IN PROTOCOL, CENTRAL RECORDS AND GOVT HOSPITALITY DEPTS. HIS MOST RECENT MINISTRY POST WAS AS DIRGEN FOR EDUCATION AND SOCIAL AFFAIRS. AHANIN SPEAKS FLUENT ENGLISH. HE APPEARS WILL DISPOSED TOWARD THE US AND HAS BEEN COOPERATIVE WITHIN THE CONTEXT OF THE LIMITED CONTACTS THAT EMBOFFS HAVE HAD WITHIN THE PAST YEAR.

ZIA EDDIN GHAHARY, AMB TO VENEZUELA, PERU, ECUADOR AND TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO (RESIDENT IN CARACAS) HAS A PHD IN POLITICAL SCIENCE FROM THE UNIV OF ROME, AN MA IN POLITICAL SCIENCE AND A BA IN FRENCH FROM TEHRAN UNIV. HE JOINED MFA IN 1951, SERVING IN BRAZIL, NEW YORK, OTTAWA AND BEIRUT. HIS MOST RECENT POST WAS AS HEAD OF THE 8TH POLITICAL DEPT (SYRIA, LEBANON, EGYPT, JORDAN, ISRAEL). GHAHARY IS ONE OF THE MORE EFFECTIVE DEPT HEADS AT THE MFA AND VERY INTERESTED IN SUBSTANTIVE DISCUSSION.

HE VOLUNTEERS INFORMATION TO THE EXTENT HE HAS SOME, THOUGH HE IS NOT IMMUNE FROM THE USUAL IRANIAN MFA AFFLICTION--MAKING AN EFFORT TO APPEAR MOR AUTHORITATIVE IN HIS SUBJECT MATTER THAN IS REALLY THE CASE (SINCE THE MFA IS NOT ALWAYS INFORMED OF THE SHAH'S THINKING). SOMEWHAT GRUFF IN HIS OUTWARD MANNER, HE IS A PROFESSIONAL AND INCIDENTALLY, LIKES TO PLAY BRIDGE. HIS WIFE IS MORE RETICENT ON BRIDGE BUT WILL PLAY IN A FRIENDLY GAME.

NASSEREDDIN MIRFAKHRAI, 51, AMB TO CZECHOSLOVAKIA, GRADUATED FROM TEHRAN UNIV IN 1947 AND ENTERED THE FOREIGN MINISTRY THE FOLLOWING YEAR. HE HAS HAD LONG SERVICE IN THE US--A TOTAL OF 9 YEARS PRIMARILY IN WASHINGTON WITH A 3 MONTH TDY IN SAN FRANCISCO. HE HAS ALSO SPENT 5 YEARS IN LONDON AND WAS MOST RECENTLY DIRGEN OF THE MINISTER' SECRETARIAT, CONCURRENTLY AMB AT LARGE. WITHIN THE MFA MIRFAKHRAI HAS ALSO SERVED IN PROTOCOL, ADMINISTRATION, AND AS HEAD OF DEPT OF EASTERN EUROPEAN AFFAIRS. EMBOFFS HAVE FOUND MIRFAKHRAI TO BE A BASICALLY RETICENT, SOMEWHAT SHY PERSON WHO REQUIRES A LITTLE CULTIVATION.
HE IS FAVORABLY INCLINED TOWARD THE US AND HAS A RELATIVELY GOOD COMMAND OF ENGLISH. HE WAS MARRIED IN 1951 AND HAS TWO CHILDREN.
IRAJ AMINI HAS BEEN OFFICIALLY NAMED AMB OF TUNISIA CONFIRMING INFORMAL INFORMATION LEARNED 5 MONTHS AGO WHICH WAS REPORTED PREVIOUSLY IN TEHRAN 6868 (NOTAL).

CONVEYED SUBSTANCE OF PARA 9 -12 REFTEL TO MINISTER OF COURT HOVEYDA MORNING OF DEC 21 WHO IMMEDIATELY PASSED IT ON TO THE SHAH. SHAH EXPRESSED APPRECIAATION AND ASKED IF IT POSSIBLE TO LET HIM KNOW WHAT REPORTED MEETING OF ISRAELI MINISTER OF DEFENSE WEIZMAN AND EGYPTIAN MINISTER OF WAR GAMASY WAS ALL ABOUT. PLEASE ADVISE.

1977TEHRAN11315.subject: THIRD ROUND OF US - SOVIET TALKS ON INDIAN OCEAN ARMS LIMITATIONS

segments.text: DRAWING FULLY ON REFTEL, DCM BRIEFED MFA UNDERSECY ZELLI DEC 22 ON US-USSR TALKS ON THE INDIAN OCEAN. DCM NOTED THAT WE MAY BE BRIEFING IRANIAN EMB, WASHINGTON, ON THE DAME SUBJECT. ZELLI EXPRESSED APPRECIATION BUT HAD NO SUBSTANTIVE COMMENT. HE DID RAISE THE QUESTION, HOWEVER, OF REPORTS GOI HAD OF "MASSIVE" SOVIET BUILDUP ON SOCOTRA AND ASKED WHAT WE KBW ABOUT THIS. DCM SAID THAT HE COULD NOT RECALL SEEING ANY REPORTS OF SIGNIFICANT SOVIET ACTIVITY ON SOCOTRA BUT WOULD INQUIRE.

ZELLI REPLIED THAT THERE MIGHT BE SOMETHING GOING ON THERE THAT WE WOULD NOT KNOW ABOUT BECAUSE HE HAD HEARD THAT SOCOTRA HAD CLOUD COVER ABOUT EIGHT MONTHS OUT OF THE YEAR AND COULD NOT BE SEEN BY SATELLITE.
APPRECIATE ANY COMMENT AND/OR INFORMATION WE CAN PASS ON IN RESPONSE TO ZELLI'S INQUIRY.

1977TEHRAN11321.subject: GOI VIEW OF SITUATION IN HORN OF AFRICA

segments.text: FONMIN KHALATBARY CALLED ME TO FONMINISTRY MORNING DEC 24 TO DISCUSS SITUATION IN HORN OF AFRICA. HE SAID IRAN WAS PARTICULARLY DISTURBED BY SOVIET AND SATELLITE BUILD-UP IN ETHIOPIA. HIS REPORTS INDICATED THAT SOVIET, EAST GERMAN AND CUBAN PILOTS WERE STREAMING INTO ADDIS AND THAT NEW SOVIET EQUIPMENT WAS BEING READIED FOR SERVICE. HE ANTICIPATED MAJOR ETHIOPIAN OFFENSIVE WHEN RAINY SEASON ENDED, NOT ONLY AGAINST OGADEN AND SOMALIA, BUT POSSIBLY ALSO AGAINST DJIBOUTI. HE ASSUMED THAT MERCENARIES (HE PLACED CUBANS AT 1200) WOULD HANDLE THE SOPHISTICATED EQUIPMENT.

KHALATBARY SAID THAT SOMALIAN PRES SIAD BARRE WOULD ARRIVE IN TEHRAN DEC 27 AND LEAVE DEC 29. SINCE BARRE KNEW THERE WAS LITTLE ASSISTANCE IRAN COULD PROVIDE ON ITS OWN, HE ASSURED PRIMARY PURPOSE OF HIS VISIT TO TEHRAN WAS TO PERSUADE SHAH TO LEAN ON PRES CARTER FOR GREATER ASSISTANCE. HE THEREFORE ASKED THAT I ALERT THE PRES TO PROSPECT THAT SHAH WOULD RAISE HORN OF AFRICA WITH HIM.

KHALATBARY WENT ON TO SAY THAT IRAN ALSO WULD APPRECIATE SOME INDICATION FROM PRES CONCERNING US INTENTIONS WITH RESPECT HORN OF AFRICA. IRAN IS CONVINCED THAT OAU IS UNABLE TO DO ANYTHING IN CURRENT CIRCUMSTANCES AND THAT SOVIETS ARE THE PRINCIPAL ELEMENT WHICH MUST BE DEALT WITH. HE THEREFORE EXPRESSED HOPE THAT PRES WOULD BE ABLE PROVIDE SHAH WITH SOME INSIGHTS INTO US THINKING ABOUT HOW TO DEAL WITH SOVIETS IN THIS REGION.

ANNOUNCEMENT HAS BEEN MADE OF THE GOI'S AGREEMENT TO THE APPOINTMENT OF CHRISTOPHER DAVID BEEBY AS NEW ZEALAND AMBASSADOR TO IRAN. ACCORDING TO PRESS REPORTS BEEBY IS PRESENTLY HEAD OF THE ECONOMIC DIVISION AT THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS, WELLINGTON.
WE UNDERSTAND THE CURRENT AMBASSADOR, BRUCE BROWN, IS DUE TO LEAVE IRAN IN MAY 1978. WE WOULD APPRECIATE ANY BIOGRAPHIC BACKGROUND AVAILABLE TO ADDRESSEES ON AMBASSADOR BEEBY.

DECEMBER 22 PERSIAN AND ENGLISH PRESS REPORTED ATTACKS BY "YOUNG MEN CALLING THEMSELVES STUDENTS" ON FRANKLIN PUBLISHING CO. PRINTING FACILITY, OFFSET PRESS, WHICH IS JOINT US-IRANIAN VENTURE. PRESS REPORTS SAID GROUP DAMAGED SOME EQUIPMENT AND SHOUTED PROVOCATIVE SLOGANS.

SENIOR ACADEMIC ADMINISTRATOR TOLD EMBOFF DEC. 26 THAT ATTACK WAS BY TEHRAN UNIVERSITY STUDENTS, THOUGH SOURCE OF THEIR INSPIRATION WAS "UNCLEAR". AUTHORITIES HAVE REPORTEDLY PINNED INCIDENT DOWN TO STUDENT GROUP AND BELIEVE "SOMEONE" PUT THEM UP TO IT. SOURCE ALSO SAID AT LEAST SOME SLOGANS WERE ANTI-AMERICAN, PROTESTING PRESIDENT CARTER'S VISIT TO IRAN. THIS ACADEMIC WAS VERY HESITANT TO SUGGEST THAT EITHER FOREIGN EMBASSY HAD EGGED STUDENTS ON OR THAT ELEMENTS WITHIN GOI MIGHT HAVE PUT STUDENTS UP TO DEMONSTRATION, BUT CLEARLY BELIEVED THERE WAS SOME SORT OF OUTSIDE INVOLVEMENT AT WORK.

EMBASSY COMMENT: THERE HAS BEEN SURPRISINGLY LITTLE CHATTER ABOUT THIS INCIDENT. THERE IS GENERAL FEELING HERE THAT THERE MAY BE MANIFESTATIONS OF SOME SORT BY STUDENTS BEFORE AND PERHAPS DURING CARTER VISIT AND ATTACK ON OFFSET PRESS SEEMS TO FIT THAT CATEGORY. THERE IS NO INDICATION, HOWEVER, THAT SUCH MANIFESTATIONS, IF THEY TOOK PLACE, WOULD POSE SECURITY THREAT TO PRESIDENTIAL PARTY.

1977TEHRAN11408.subject: COMMENT ON RECENT STUDENT AND DISSIDENT DISTURBANCES

segments.text: REF A. TEHRAN 11098 B. STATE 294128

SUMMARY: RECENT DEMONSTRATIONS BY STUDENTS AND ADULT DISSIDENTS ARE SEPARATE BUT RELATED EFFECTS OF A WELLPUBLICIZED LIBERALIZATION UNDERTAKEN BY THE GOI SINCE LAST SPRING, WHICH IS UNIVERSALLY ATTRIBUTED TO USG PRESSURE. WE SUGGEST THE COMPLEXITIES OF THE PRESENT SITUATION REQUIRE US TO AIM OUR INFLUENCE CAREFULLY. WORKING FOR A DECREASE IN BRUTALITY AND OTHER ABUSES OF THE SECURITY FORCES SHOULD NOT BE CONFUSED WITH SEEKING MORE EXTENSIVE POLITICAL CHANGES. THE DYNAMIC OF ECONOMIC AND SOCIAL CHANGE IN IRAN, WHICH IS FOSTERED BY THE SHAH, IS BOUND TO BRING POLITICAL PARTICIPATION IN DUE COURSE. END SUMMARY.

DISTRUBANCES OVER PAST TWO MONTHS FALL IN TWO GENERAL CATEGORIES: THOSE INVOLVING PRIMARILY STUDENTS AT IRANIAN UNIVERSITIES AND THOSE INVOLVING OPPOSITIONIST DISSIDENT ELEMENTS OF A LEFTIST-NATIONALIST CAST OR WHO ARE RELIGIOUSLY ORIENTED. THE UNIVERSITY DISTRUBANCES HAVE BECOME AN ANNUAL FALL OCCURRENCE IN IAN, -ALTHOUGH THEIR REPRESSION IN THE PERIOD 1972-74 RESULTED IN FEWER SUCH DISTURBANCES IN 1975 AND, PARTICULRLY, 1976. THIS FALL ALL SIGNS INDICATE STUDENTS WERE ENCOURAGED TO DEMONSTRATE BY SHAH'S VISIT TO U.S. AND WELL-ADVERTISED LIBERALIZATION OF LOCAL REGIME CONTROLS WHICH PRECEDED IT. THE LIBERALIZATION IS UNIVERSALLY ATTRIBUTED TO USG PRESSUREES STEMMING FROM THE HUMAN RIGHTS INTEREST OF THE CARTER ADMINISTRATION AND CONGRESS.

CONSIDERABLE EVIDENCE INDICATES THAT OPPOSITION ELEMENTS INCLUDING, PERHAPS, SOME OF THE TERRORIST GROUPS, HAVE ATTEMPTED TO FUEL TRADITIONAL STUDENT ENTHUSIASM WHILE SIMULTANEOUSLY TESTING THE WATERS OF GOVERNMENT TOLERANCE BY OPEN LETTERS AND PETITIONS ALLEGING A VARIETY OF ILLS IN THE CURRENT POLITICAL SYSTEM WHICH CAN ONLY BE CURED BY RADICAL CHANGES TO BRING THE SYSTEM OF INTERNAL POLITICS MORE INTO LINE WITH THEIR INTERPRETATION OF THE IRANIAN CONSTITUTION. IMPLICIT IN ALL, AND EXPLICIT IN SOME, OF THESE MISSIVES HAS BEEN THE DEMAND THAT THE SHAH REIGN AND NOT RULE, EVEN IF HE DOESN'T ABDICATE.
MOST MANIFESTOS HAVE BEEN OF A GENERAL NATURE, THOUGH A FEW HAVE BEEN TAILORED TO SPECIFIC AIMS SUCH AS NATIONALIZATION OF MORE INDUSTRIES.

PARTICULARLY SPECIFIC HAVE BEEN PETITIONS SIGNED BY LAWYERS, AND IN ONE INSTANCE BY JUDGES, ALLEGING SERIOUSLY BEEN CURTAILED OVER THE PAST YEARS AND REQUIRES IMMEDIATE MENDING. THIS WOULD INVOLVE REPEAL OF SEVERAL LEGAL REFORMS (TEHRAN A-75) WHICH HAVE SET UP ALTERNATIVE (SMALL CLAIMS) COURTS AND A GOVERNMENT SCHOOL FOR JUDGES WITH THE AIM OF IMPROVING THE ADMINISTRATION OF JUSTICE. (IN FACT, WE ARE STILL TRYING TO REACH OUR OWN ASSESSMENT AS TO THE DEGREE OF DISINTERESTEDNESS AND JUSTICE IN THE JUDGES' DESIRE TO RETURN TO THE JUDICIAL STATUS QUO ANTE.)

THE JUDGES' LETTER O THE TOP JUDGE IN THE COUNTRY (TEHRAN A-176) WAS MET HEAD ON BY THE GOI WITH A REQUEST THAT THE JUDGES RESCIND THEIR MOST POINTED CRITICISMS AND CONTINUE O FUNCTION WITHIN THE CURRENT SYSTEM WHICH THE GOI CONSIDERED BEST FOR IRN'S PRESENT STAGE OF DEVELOPMENT. A DOZEN JUDGES WHO REFUSED TO GO ALONG HAVE BEEN SUSPENDED FROM THEIR DUTIES, BUT WE ARE NOT AWARE OF ANY FURTHER MEASURES TAKEN AGAINST THEM. APART FROM THIS INSANCE, THERE HAVE BEEN NO MEASURES TAKEN SPECIFICALLY AGAINST PEOPLE WHO HAVE SIGNED THE VARIOUS LETTERS AND PETITIONS TO DATE.
IN FACT, THIS SIGNING CONTINUES, THE LATEST BEING A MESSAGE TO THE PRIME MINISTER SIGNED BY 33 DISSIDENTS (TEHRAN 11098).

THE LACK OF GOVERNMENT REACTION TO THESE PETITIONS OVER THE SUMMER, LEADING INTO THE SHAH'S WASHINGTON VISIT, OBVIOUSLY ENCOURAGED THEIR SIGNERS AND MANY OLD OPPOSITIONISTS WHO SYMPATHIZE WITH THEM TO ATTEMPT TO ORGANIZE FURTHER ACTION. A MEETING TOOK PLACE ON THE ROAD BETWEEN TEHRAN AND KARAJ OF OVER A THOUSAND SUCH PEOPLE ON NOVEMBER TWENTY-TWO UNDER THE GUISE OF A SOCIAL GATHERING ON ONE OF IRAN'S HOLY DAYS. THE MEETING WAS BROKEN UP BY SO-CALLED "WORKERS" WHO WERE ------------------016326 271505Z /44 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 6094 INFO AMEMBASSY LONDON SECTION 2 OF 3 TEHRAN 11408 CLEARLY GOVERNMENT-ORGANIZED AGENTS, VERY THINLY DISGUISED IN THEIR MODUS OPERANDI.

THIS WAS A REPEITION OF AN EARLIER APPEARANCE OF SUCH GOVERNMENT AGENTS WHO BROKE UP A STUDENT DEMONSTRATION ON ARYAMEHR UNIVERSITY GROUNDS JUST PRIOR TO OFFICIAL SECURITY POLICE MOVING IN FOR SOME ARRESTS. A SIMILAR INCIDENT OCCURRED AT LAHEJAN MORE RECENTLY, ON DECEMBER EIGHT (TEHRAN 11098), WHEN A SIMILAR GROUP OF GOVERNMENT-ORGANIZED "FARMERS" BEAT UP A WELL-KNOWN DISSIDENT SPEAKER AT A SMALL COLLEGE ON THE CASPAIN SEA AND INJURED SOME OF HIS FRIENDS.

THE STUDENT DEMONSTRATIONS THEMSELVES HAVE GENERALLY BEEN PUT DOWN BY MORE CONVENTIONAL MEANS USING POLICE TO CONTAIN OR BREAK THEM UP. THIS HAS GENERALLY OCCURRED ON THE MAJOR UNIVERSITY CAMPUSES, THOUGH IN A COUPLE OF INSTANCES THE DEMONSTRATIONS HAD OVERFLOWED INTO TEHRAN'S STREETS BEFORE THEY WER FORCIBLY DISPERSED. UNDER ONE HUNDRED STUDENTS HAVE BEEN CHARGED WITH CRIMINAL OFFENSES, AND THOSE HAVE BEEN IN CIVIL COURTS. MOST OF THE ADDITIONAL TWO TO THREE HUNDRED TAKEN INTO CUSTODY HAVE BEEN RELEASED AFTER IDENTIFICATION. THERE HAVE BEEN NO ARRESTS OF ADULT DISSIDENTS INVOLVED IN THE KARAJ OR LAHEJAN INCIDENTS. A FEW OTHER CASES IN ISFAHAN, SHIRAZ, AND ELSEWHERE HAVE BEEN SIMILARLY DEALT WITH.

MORE OBSCURE AND PUZZLING HAVE BEEN THE CIRCUMSTANCES SURROUNDING DEMONSTRATIONS BY RELIGIOUS PERSONS OR IN THE NAME OF RELIGION. TWO INCIDENTS ARE DOCUMENTED INVOLCING A RELIGIOUS PREACHER CRITICIZING THE PRESENT STATE OF AFFAIRS AND CALLING FOR THE RETURN OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINY, A LEFTIST NATIONALIST LEADER WHO HAS FOR MANY YEARS TAKEN REFUGEE IN IRAQ. OTHER DEMONSTRATIONS HAVE BEEN ALLEGED BY THE PRESS AND GOVERNMENT TO INVOLVE EFFORTS BY RELIGIOUS FANATICS AGAINST THE DESEGREGATION OF WOMEN IN UNIVERSITIES ANDOTHER AGITATION TO REVERSE THE LIBERALIZING REFORMS OF THE SHAH-PEOPLE, OR "WHITE", REVOLUTION.

IN AT LEAST ONE KNOWN INSTANCE THIS SUMMER, A PREACHER SPOKE IN VEILED RELIGIOUS TERMS AGAINST THE HAH'S RULE, DRAWING A WIDE AUDIENCE IN TEHRAN WITHOUT ANY POLICE REACTION. HIS EFFORT TO SPEAK AGAIN FROM THE SAME MOSQUE, HOWEVER, WAS STERNLY MET BY THE POLICE LAST MONTH, AND HE WAS PREVENTED FROM MAKING FURTHER PUBLIC APPEARANCES.

AS THE PRIME MINISTER TOLD THE AMBASADOR RECENTLY (TEHRAN 10827), THE GOI APPEARS TO HAVE EMBARKED ON A TWO-PRONGED PROGRAM. ON ONE HAND, THERE IS A CONCERTED EFFORT TO GET OUT THE "SILENT MAJORITY" WITH THE ASSISTANCE OF THE RASTAKHIZ PARTY MILITANTS, SO THAT GOVERNMENT AND PARTY WORKERS, PROFESSORS, STUDENTS, PARENTS AND OTHER IDENTIFICABLE SGROUPS MAY BE LED INTO POSITIVE DEMONSTRATIONS AND OTHER SHOWS OF LOYALTY TO OVERWHELM THE DISSENTERS AND PERHAPS TAKE AWAY SOME OF THEIR HEADLINE POTENTIAL IN WORLD NEWS MEDIA.
ON THE OTHER HAND, THE GOVERNMENT HAS CLEARLY INSTRUCTED THAT STUDENTS NOT BE PROSECUTED FORMALLY OR BE PUT INTO JAIL IF THAT COURSE IS AT ALL POSSIBLE TO AVOID.

READING BEHIND THIS STATEMENT OF GOI POLICY WE SEE A DILEMMA IN THE MIND OF THE CHIEF POLICYMAKER, THE SHAH. BY RELEASING POLICE GOON SQUADS AGAINST THE DISSIDENTS, AND ON AT LEAST ONE OCCASION AGAINST THE STUDENTS, HE HAS DEMONSTRATED GOOD INTELLIGENCE SOURCES AMONG THE OPPOSITIONISTS AND AN ABILITY TO HURT MANY OF THESE PROPLE PHYSICALLY AD DISSUADE ANY FURTHER ORGANIZATION OR ACTION. BY THE SAME TOKEN, HE KNOWS HE IS ENCOURAGING EXTREMISM AND RUNNING THE RISK OF APPEARING REPRESSIVE AND TYRANNOUS TO THE WORLD MEDIA, IN PARTICULAR TO THE AMERICAN PRESS.

THERE ARE SOME RELATIVE GAINS OVER THE PAST. SECURITY FORCES HAVE NOT ROUNDED UP THOE WHO SIGNED THE VARIOUS LETTERS, AND THIS IS AN IMPROVEMENT ON THE TREATMENT OF SUCH OPPOSITIONISTS IN RECENT YEARS. SIMILARLY, THE PRESS HAS BEEN ALLOWED TO CARRY SOME POLITICAL NEWS AND REPORT DISTURBANCES WICH IT WOULD NOT HAVE BEEN PERMITTED TO MENTION IN PREVIOUS YEARS.

THE RASTAKHIZ PARTY'S EFFORTS TO ORGANIZE POLITICAL PARTICIPATION HAVE INCLUDED IN PRACTICE CONSIDERABLE PUBLICITY FOR A GOOD MANY PROBLEMS AND ABUSES EXISTING IN TODY'S IRAN, AND THE FREQUENT EXHORTATIONS ISSUED FROM THE THRONE INDICATE THAT THE SHAH HIMSELF IS CONCERNED THAT SUCH ABUSES BE CORRECTED AND PROBLEMS SOLVED. ------------------015590 271506Z /43 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 6095 INFO AMEMBASSY LONDON SECTION 3 OF 3 TEHRAN 11408

THERE IS LITTLE DOUBT IN OUR MINDS THAT THE SHAH WOULD PREFER A MORE LIBERALIZED ENVIRONMENT THAN HE HAS PERMITTED TO DATE IF THIS WOULD IMPROVE GOVERNMENT EFFICIENCY AND REDUCE THE CORRUPTION THAT MANY COMPLAIN ABOUT IN THIS SOCIETY WITHOUT ENDANGERING HIS ESSENTIAL POLICY-MAKING PREROGATIVES. BY THE SAME TOKEN, HOWEVER, HE SEES LITTLE TO BE GAINED AND MUCH TO BE LOST BY PERMITTING DESTRUCTIVE CRITICISM, ESPECIALLY WHEN THIS COMES FROM DISCREDITED OPPONENTS OF HIS RULE DATING BACK TO THE 1950'S AND 1960'S. EXACTLY WHAT LIMITED CHANGES HE WOULD PEMIT ARE NOT CLEAR TO US, AND WE SUSPECT ARE STILL NOT CLEAR TO THE SHAH HIMSELF.

IF THE WRITERS OF LETTERS -- WHO ARE WELL-KNOWN TO THE SECURITY FORCES -- WERE TO AGREE ON A SET OF SPECIFIC, LIMITED POLITICAL REFORMS, IT IS CONCEIVABLE TO US THAT THE SHAH WOULD THINK THEM OVER SERIOUSLY AND PERMIT SOME STRAINS OF OPPOSITION TO ESTABLISH THEMSELVES LEGITIMATELY. THIS HAS NOT YET HAPPENED.

BUT THIS IS LIKELY TO BE A PAINFUL PROCESS FOR AN AGING RULER WHO HAS SPENT THE LAST TWENTY TO THIRTY YEARS IN GAINING AND CONSOLIDTING CONTROL OVER HIS COUNTRY'S POLITICAL PROCESSES. HE IS BOUND TO HAVE MANY DOUBTS AS TO WHAT HE IS RISKING BY ALLOWING SUCH OPPOSITION TO SURFACE, EVEN IN A LIMITED WAY. THERE ARE MANY IN THE SECURITY ESTABLISHMENT AND ELSEWHERE WHO COUNSEL GREATER CAUTION AND NO REFORM. UNDER THESE CIRCUMSTANCES, IT WOULD APPEAR LIKELY THAT THE SHAH WILL MOVE ONLY IN CONJUCTION WITH EXTERNAL PRSSURES OR REQUIREMENTS AS HE COMES TO APPRECIATE THEM.

USG STRATEGY MUST, THEREFORE, CONSIDER SEVERAL VERITIES. FIRST, THE SHAH IS WIDELY RECOGNIZED AS PROBABLY THE ONLY VIABLE GOVERNOR OF IRAN TODAY EVEN BY MANY IF HIS OPPONENTS. SECOND, HE IS FIRMLY IN CONTROL, AND NEITHER TERRORIST EXTREMISTS NOR MODERATE DISSIDENTS, NOR INDEED STUDENT DEMONSTRATORS, WILL SHAKE HIS CONTROL. THIRD, THE SHAH'S POLICY IS EMINENTLY PRO-AMERICAN AND IN FAVOR OF AREA STABILITY. THUS HIS OVERTHROW OR DEATH COULD ONLY OCCUR BY UNIQUE ACCIDENT; OUR BEST INTELLIGENCE INDICATES THAT NOT EVEN THE TERORISTS OF LEFT AND RIGHT HAVE SOUGHT IT IN RECENT YEARS.

OUR NEXT QUESTION MUS BE WHERE WE WISH TO PUT OUR EMPHASIS. SHOULD IMPROVEMENT OF HUMAN RIGHTS IN TERMS OF AMERICAN FOREIGN POLICY INVOLVE PRESSING FOR CHANGES IN THE BASIC REGIME -- E.G., BY REINSTITUTING POLICYMAKING AUTHORITY IN PARLIAMENT, RESTRICTING THE POWERS OF THE SHAH AND OF HIS GOVERNMENT, ETC. -- OR SHOULD IT AIM AT IMPROVING TREATMENT OF PRISONERS, BUILDING MORE SAFEGUARDS AGAINST FALSE ARREST AND IMPRISONMENT, WORKING FOR GREATER TOLERANCE FOR PEACEFUL CRITICISM OF GOI PERFORMANCE, IMPROVING JUDICIAL EQUITY, ETC?

IT SEEMS TO US THIS EMBASSY HAS A MANDATE TO WORK FOR THE SECOND SET OF AIMS, NOT THE FIRST, AND WE JUDGE THIS EMPHASIS TO BE WISE, S THE OPTIMUM ACHIEVABLE AT THE PRESENT STAGE OF HISTORY. MOREOVER, IF WE DELIBERATELY PRESS FOR BASIC POLITICAL CHANGES, THIS WILL RAISE IN THE MINDS OF AMANY IRANIANS SPECTRES OF FOREIGN INTERFERENCE IN GOVERNMENT SUCH AS MAKE THE RUSSIANS AND (EVEN TODAY) THE BRITISH DISTRUSTED AND SUSPECT.

THE PEACEFUL REVOLUTION REPRESENTED BY THE SHAH-PEOPLE OR "WHITE" REVOLUTION IS A REAL DEVELOPMENT WHICH HAS PRODUCED GREATER SOCIAL EQUITY AND LESS PRIVILEGE IN WHAT IS STILL AN ESSENTIALLY EASTERN SOCIETY TRYING TO TRANSFORM ITSELF INTO A WESTERN ONE. NONE OF IRAN'S NEIGHBORS, RICH OR POOR, WITH THE EXCEPTION OF ISRAEL AND THE POSSIBLE EXCEPTION OF INDIA, CAN BOAST A FREER OR LESS OPPRESSIVE WAY OF GOVERNMENT. MOREOVER, THE MARCH OF WESTERN ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT, COUPLED WITH VOLUNTARY POPULAR EMULATION OF THINGS WESTERN (MAINLY THE U.S., FRENCH, BRITISH, GERMAN AND ITALIAN) IS PRODUCING ITS OWN CHANGE IN THE VALUE SYSTEM OF A PEOPLE.
THIS IS BOUND OVER A PERIOD OF YEARS TO LEAD TO GREATER POLITICAL PARTICIPATION.

MEANWHILE, IT IS A FACT THAT POLITICAL PARTICIPATION WILL BE LIMITED. OUR WN AIM SHOULD BE TO ONTINUE ENCOURAGING A DECREASE OF HARSHNESS AND OF INEQUITABLE TREATMENT OF POLITICAL OPPOSITION BY THE SECURITY FORCES. THUS, WE WOULD HOPE TO HELP A SPIRIT OF MODERATION REMAIN IN BEING BELOW THE SURFACE-EVEN IF IT REMAINS RELATIVELY INACTIVE -- TO ALLOW FOR ITS RE-EMERGENCE IN FUTURE YEARS.

FOR THOSE YEARS ARE BOUND TO COME, GIVEN THE RATE OF PRO-WESTERN ECONOMIC AND SOCIAL CHANGE WHICH THE SHAH IS FOSTERING, AND HIS CARE TO RESTRAIN THOSE ASPECTS OF ARCH-CONSERVATIVE ISLAMIC INFLUENCE WHICH MIGHT IN OTHER SOCIETIES RETARD OR REVERSE WESTERNIZED ECONOMIC, SOCIAL AND EVENTUALLY POLITICAL LIBERALIZATION.

IRANIAN AMBASSADOR ZAHEDI, WHO IS HERE FOR PRESIDENT'S VISIT, TOLD US THAT HE PLANS TO HAVE A "SMALL" PARTY FOR OFFICIAL PARTY AND ABOUT 24 OTHERS, INCLUDING PRESS AND TV LUMINARIES, AT HIS RSIDENCE AFTER SHAH'S DINNER ENDS AND PRESIDENT RETIRES EVENING DECEMBER 31. HIS RESIDENCE IS ABOUT FIVE MINUTES DISTANCE FROM NIAVARAN PALACE WHSRE OFFICIAL DINNER IS TO TAKE PLACE. HE SAID THAT HE HAD MENTIONED THIS TO THE SECRETARY.

UNTIL ZAHEDI SPRUNG THIS IDEA ON US IT HAD BEEN OUR THOUGHT THAT THOSE IN THE OFFICIAL PARTY BEING PUT UP ON THE EMBASSY COMPOUND WOULD GATHER AT THE AMBASSADOR'S RESIDENCE AFTER THE SHSH'S DINNER TO HAVE A GLASS OF CHAMPAGNE AND SEE IN THE NEW YEAR. WE ARE, OF COURSE, WILLING FOREGO THIS EVENT IF SECRETARY ACCEPTS ZAHEDI OFFER.
LET US KNOW ASAP SO WE CAN PLAN ACCORDINGLY.
GOI LET IT BE KNOWN DEC. 26 VIA RADIO AND PRESS REPORTS THAT MAJOR GENERAL AHMAD MOGHARABI HAD BEEN EXECUTED BY FIRING SQUAD ON DEC. 25.
MOGHARABI WAS CONVICTED ON CHARGES OF SPYING FOR A FOREIGN POWER AND A MILITARY COURT OF APPEALS UPHELD THE DEATH SENTENCE ON DECEMBER 18. (REFTELS)

1977TEHRAN11444.subject: SPECULATION RE ZAHEDI'S AND HOVEYDA'S FUTURE

segments.text: IRAN'S MOST CONSPECIUOUS CURRENT PERSONAL FEUD APPARENTLY ENDED EVENING DECEMBER 27 WHEN COURT MINISTER HOVEYDA AND AMBASSADOR ARDESHIR ZAHEDI LITERALLY KISSED AND MADE UP. OCCASION WAS DINNER HOSTED BY NIOC CHAIRMAN HUSHANG ANSARY TO CELEBRATE ZAHEDI'S FIRST VISIT TO THIS COUNTRY IN MORE THAN SIX YEARS. PRESENT AT THE ELATION WERE PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR AND SEVERAL CABINET MINISTERS AND COURT OFFICIALS.

RUMORS ABOUND IN TEHRAN THAT ZAHEDI IS SCHEDULED TO LEAVE WASHINGTON SOON AND ACCEPT SIGNIFICANT APPOINTMENT IN TEHRAN. SINCE HE HIMSELF HAS OFTEN INDICATED THAT HE IS INTERESTED ONLY IN PRIME MINISTER OR COURT MINISTER POSITIONS, IT IS DIFFICULT TO ASSESS WHAT APPOINTMENT MIGHT BE AVAILABLE TO HIM. BOTH INCUMBENTS SEEM FAIRLY WELL ESTABLISHED IN THEIR CURRENT POSITIONS, ALTHOUGH AMOUZEGAR APPEARS ABOUT TO ESTABLISH A CLEAN SWEEP OF HOVEYDA'S MEN FROM LEADING POSITIONS IN RASTAKHIZ PARTY AND TO BE PERSONALLY RE-INSTALLED IN THE LEADERSHIP OF THAT ORGANIZATION.

MOST LOGICAL SPECULATION, THEREFORE, SEEMS TO CENTER AROUND POSSIBILITY THAT ZAHEDI AND HOVEYDA WOULD SWAP POSITIONS. RUMORS SUGGEST THAT THE SHAH MAY CONSIDER HOVEYDA'S LESS FLAMBOYANT STYLE MORE COMPATIBLE WITH THE CURRENT POLITICAL CLIMATE IN WASHINGTON RATHER THAN ZAHEDI'S SWINGING IMAGE.

NAMED AMB TO IRAN ON JUNE 28, 1972, COTTAFAVI IS A PROFESSIONAL DIPLOMAT WHO BEGAN HIS CAREER IN 1948 AND SERVED IN VARIOUS CAPACITIES IN VIENNA, TEL AVIV, LONDON AND OSLO. IN 1963 HE WAS POSTED TO ROME WHERE HE BECAME DIPLOMATIC ADVISOR TO THE PREMIER FOR SIX YEARS, AND LATER CHEF DE CABINET AT THE FOREIGN MINISTRY FOR THREE YEAR. BORN IN TURIN, MARCH 7, 1917, COTTAFAVI HOLDS AN LL.D. FROM THE UNIV OF ROME.

COTTAFAVI WAS A PRISONER OF WAR IN TEXAS DURING WORLD WAR II. HE APPARENTLY DID NOT FIND THE EXPERIENCE DISPLEASING AND OFTEN PROUDLY REFERS TO HIMSELF AS A "TEXAN". HIS WAR TIME EXPERIENCE BEFORE CAPTURE (PLACE UNKNOWN) WAS WITH THE ELITE ITALIAN SKI CORPS.

COTTAFAVI IS A REAL "OPERATOR" WHO CAN TURN ON CONSIDERABLE CHARM. HE HAS MAINTAINED CLOSE RELATIONS WITH SEVERAL EMB OFFICERS AND MAKES DETERMINED EFFORTS TO "PICK THEIR BRAINS". AN ENERGETIC LADIES' MAN, HE ENJOYS AN ACTIVE SOCIAL LIFE WHERE HE CAN MEET PRETTY WOMEN.

DURING HIS ALMOST 5 YEARS OF SERVICE IN TEHRAN, COTTAFAVI ASSIDUOUSLY AND EFFECTIVELY CULTIVATED A WIDE CIRCLE OF ACQUAINTANCES IN LOCAL GOVT AND SOCIAL CIRCLES. HE APPARENTLY ENJOYED A REASONABLY GOOD RELATIONSHIP WITH THE SHAH AND WAS ABLE TO SEE HIM WITH SOMEWHAT MORE FREQUENCY THAN SOME OF HIS OTHER WEST EUROPEAN COLLEAGUES. COTTAFAVI DEVELOPED A GOOD GRASP OF IRANIAN POWER RELATIONSHIPS ALTHOUGH HIS ASSESSMENT OF INTERNAL POLITICAL DYNAMICS DID NOT SEEM TO BE ESPECIALLY PROFOUND. WE HAVE THE IMPRESSION THAT HE WAS A FAIRLY STERN AND DEMANDING TASKMASTER WITH HIS STAFF.

COTTAFAVI SPEAKS ENGLISH AND FRENCH AND IS AN AVID SKIER. HIS WIFE, GABRIELLE, WAS BORN IN CZECHOSLOVAKIA AND IS A MEMBER OF THE PRINCELY ROHAN FAMILY OF FRANCE. BEFORE HER MARRIAGE MRS COTTAFAVI'S FAMILY EMIGRATED FROM CZECHOSLOVAKIA TO AUSTRIA WHERE SHE BECAME A TRAINED ACCOUNTANT. SHE SPEAKS GERMAN, FRENCH, ENGLISH AND ITALIAN.

1977TEHRAN11459.subject: GREATEER DISTRIBUTION OF COMMENTS ON RECENT DISTURBANCES

segments.text: RECENT DISTURBANCES REF TEHRAN 11408 DEPARTMENT MAY WISH TO GIVE GREATER DISTRIBUTION TO REFTEL WHICH PRESENTS EMBASSY'S ASSESSMENT AND RECOMMENDATIONS IN CONNECTION WITH RECENT STUDENT AND DISSIDENT DISTURBANCES. WE SUGGEST: ABU DHABI, BAGHDAD, DOHA, GENERZA, IDLAMABAD, JIDDA, KABUL, KUWAIT, MANAMA, MOWSOE, NEW DELHI, PARIS, ROME, TEL AVIV.

ON DEC 28, AT APPROX 2040 HOURS LOCAL TIME, AN EXPLOSION (POSSIBLY A SERIES OF SEVERAL EXPLOSION IN QUICK SUCCESSION) OCCURRED IN THE OFFICES OF THE IRAN AMERICA SOCIETY ACADEMIC BUILDING LOCATED AT NO 75 VESALE SHIRAZ IN DOWNTOWN TEHRAN.

EXPLOEION(S) OCCURRED ON GROUND FLOOR IN BATHROOM RESERVED FOR IAS EBECUTIVE. EXTENSIVE DAMAGE OCCURRED THROUGHOUT THE GROUND FLOOR INTERIOR PREMISES. SOME DAMAGE INFLICTED ON GROUND FLOOR CEILING AND UPPER FLOORS (3) OF BUILDING NOT NOW CONSIDERED TO BE STRUCTURALLY SOUND. ALL EXTERNAL WINDOWS AND GRILLEE WERE BLOWN OUT. A LARGE HOLE WAS BLOWN OUT OF THE NORTH EXTERIOR WALL OF THE BUILDING IN THE VICINITY OF THE BATHROOM. EXTENSIVE WINDOW DAMAGE OCCURRED TO BANK OF TEHRAN BUILDING AND TO PRIVATE APARTMENT LOCATED ACROSS ALLEY ON NORTH SIDE OF IAS BUILDING.

ONLY INJURY WAS SLIGHT SUPERFICIAL CUT SUFFERED BY IRANIAN NATIONAL POLICEMAN STATIONED OUTSIDE MAIN IAS ENTRANCE ON WEST SIDE OF BUILDING. ONLY PERSONS PRESENT IN AREA AT TIME OF EXPLOSION WERE INP GUARD AND WATCHMAN/JANITOR LIVING WITH HIS FAMILY IN PENTHOUSE LOCATED ON TOP OF IAS BUILDING.

IAS WAS NOT OPEN TO PUBLIC ON DEC 28. STUDENTS ARE ON VACATION DURING PERIOD DEC 20-JAN 2. AMERICAN OFFICERS WERE ABSENT YESTERDAY. ONLY A SKELETON ADMIN STAFF WAS ON DUTY. DURING AFTERNOON, TWO IAS MAINTENANCE MEN INSTALLED NEW TOILET IN BATHROOM WHERE EXPLOSION OCCURRED. MAINTENANCE MEN DEPARTED PREMISES AT 1500. BUILDING WAS CLOSED AND SECURED BY FSL SECRETARY AT 1705. INTERVIEWS WILL BE CONDUCTED TODAY WITH IAS PERSONNEL PRESENT IN BUILDING YESTERDAY (28TH). ALL OF THESE PERSONNEL HAVE BEEN LOCATED EXCEPT FOR ONE OF MAINTENANCE MEN WHO IS PRESENTLY MISSING UNDER SOMEWHAT UNUSUAL CIRCUMSTANCES.

BOTH POLICE AND RSO OFFICE CONDUCTING INVESTIGATIONS INTO INCIDENT. TO DATE, NO INFORMATION HAS BEEN DEVELOPED RE CAUSE OR MOTIVE OF INCIDENT. RE UPCOMING PRESIDENTIAL VISIT, ALL US MISSION LOCATIONS HAVE BEEN PROVIDED WITH INCREASED INP POLICE PROTECTION AS PRECAUTIONARY MOVE.

RE DEC 28 IAS BOMBING INCIDENT, SAVAK CALLED AN EMERGENCY MEETING EARLY ON THE MORNING OF 29 DECEMBER TO CONVEY A WARNING THAT SAVAK EXPECTS ADDITIONAL TERRORIST INCIDENTS SIMILAR TO THE BOMBING OF THE IAS ACADEMIC CENTER. WHILE SAVAK HAS NO SPECIFIC INFORMATION, THEY ASSESS THE DECEMBER 28 IAS BOMBING AS THE FIRST OF A SERIES OF INCIDENTS WHICH WILL TAKE PLACE IN CONNECTION WITH THE VISIT OF PRESIDENT CARTER. SAVAK HAS ASKED THAT ALL AMERICAN SECURITY ORGANIZATIONS INVOLVED IN THE VISIT AND THE PROTECTION OF AMERICANS IN IRAN BE ALERTED AND THAT EXTRAORDINARY CAUTION BE EXERCISED DURING THE PRESIDENTIAL VISIT.
ALL SECTIONS OF U.S. MISSION HAVE BEEN BRIEFED. ALL CONSULATES HAVE BEEN NOTIFIED. AMERICAN BUSINESS COMMUNITY IS CURRENTLY BEING BRIEFED THROUGH THE PYRAMID COMMUNICATIONS SYSTEM.

POLCOUNS DISCUSSED THIS SUBJECT CAREFULLY (PROTECTING SOURCES) WITH MFA DEPT HEAD DAVOUDI DEC 30. DAVOUDI SAID IRANIANS HAVE NO REASON TO BELIEVE POSSIBILITY OF A COUP IN PDRY IS ANY MORE LIKELY TODAY THAN IT WAS ONE, TWO, OR THREE MONTHS AGO. SAUDIS HAVE NOT APPROACHED IRANIANS AT ALL ON THIS QUESTION OR ANYTHING ELSE RELATED TO PDRY RECENTLY. IRANIAN AMB IN JIDDA HAS BEEN AWAY ON LEAVE PAST TWO WEEKS, AND SAUDI AMB HERE, WHILE ABLE AND COOPERATIVE, IS NOT GENERALLY VERY WELL INFORMED .

DAVOUDI NOTED SAUDI RELATIONSHIP WITH PDRY HAD CHANGED AFTER PDRY ACCUSED SAUDIS OF COMPLICITY IN AL-HAMDI ASSASSINATION. SAUDIS HAVE CUT OFF THEIR AID AND KUWAITIS SAY THEY WILL STOP TOO ONCE PRESENT PROJECT THEY ARE WORKING ON IS COMPLETED.
DAVOUDI OPINED THAT, HAD QUESTION OF COUP BEEN RAISED ABOUT NORTH YEMEN, HE WOULD HAVE ANSWERED DIFFERENTLY. THAT WOULD SEEIM MORE LIKELY POSSIBILITY--THOUGH HE HAD NO SPECIFIC INFORMATION.
DAVOUDI NOTED THAT COOPERATION BETWEEN IRANIAN AND US EMBASSIES IN JIDDA IS "CLOSER THAN BETWEEN ANY OTHER TWO EMBASSIES" AND SUGGESTED CONSULTATIONS ON SUCH QUESTIONS THERE.

COMMENT: FRANKLY WE WOULD BE VERY SURPRISED TO SEE ANY OVERT IRANIAN ASSISTANCE (THROUGH AIR COVER OR OTHERWISE) IN ANY INTERVENTION IN PDRY INTERNAL AFFAIRS, DESPITE FACT IRANIAN PILOT (A CAPTAIN) STILL REMAINS CAPTIVE THERE.

1977TEHRAN11485.subject: RESURGENCE PARTY CONGRESS: CHANGE IN THE OFFING

segments.text: SUMMARY: IN UNEXPECTED MOVE, SHAH HAS INDICATED PRIME MINISTER SHOULD ALSO BE RESURGENCE PARTY (RPPI) SECRETARY GENERAL (SYG). JAN. 4 EXTRAORDINARY CONGRESS EXPECTED TO RATIFY AMOUZEGAR AS SYG, WHEREUPON HE WILL RESTAFF PARTY BUREAUCRACY WITH INDIVIDUALS LOYAL TO HIM. BACKSTAGE POLITICKING ON PROBLEM HAS BROUGHT, THUS FAR, MUTED RIVALRY BETWEEN PRIME MINISTER AND PARTY SYG BAHERI TO LIGHT AND RESULTED IN AT LEAST TEMPORARY AMOUZEGAR CONSOLIDATION OF POWER. FULFILLMENT OF PROMISE FOR AMOUZEGAR WILL DEPEND ON HOW WELL HE CAN MANAGE HIS EXPANDED DOMAIN. END SUMMARY.

MEDIA DEC. 27 CARRIED PROMINENT COVERAGE OF SHAH'S REMARKS TO RPPI EXECUTIVE BOARD THAT PRIME MINISTER SHOULD ALSO HEAD PARTY. REVERSING HIS STATEMENT OF A YEAR EARLIER THAT PARTY SECRETARY GENERAL POST AND THE PRIME MINISTERSHIP WERE BOTH FULL TIME JOBS, SHAH SAID THINGS WERE DIFFERENT IN IRAN NOW. HE IMPLIED THAT ALL NATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS SHOULD COORDINATE THEIR ACTIVITIES THROUGH THE PARTY, WHICH WOULD THEN, UNDER PM'S LEADERSHIP, COORDINATE GOVERNMENT/PARTY ACTIVITIES.

SHAH'S STATEMENT CLIMAXED ABOUT TEN DAYS TO TWO WEEKS OF INCREASINGLY COMPLEX MANEUVERS BEGUN WHEN PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR CALLED FOR AN EXTRAORDINARY CONGRESS OF THE RPPI FORMALLY TO ELECT A SECRETARY GENERAL (SYG) TO REPLACE AMOUZEGAR (BAHERI, THE INCUMBENT, SUCCEEDED TO THE JOB BY VIRTUE OF APPOINTMENT BY PARTY EXECUTIVE BOARD IN AUGUST 1977 WHICH MUST BE RATIFIED BY CONGRESS.). THE CONGRESS WAS FINALLY SET FOR JAN. 4, 1978 AND IN ADDITION TO ELECTING A SYG, WILL AMEND RPPI CONSTITUTION TO MAKE HEADS OF BOTH PARTY WINGS MEMBERS OF THE POLITICAL BUREAY, AND APPROVE A DECLARATION ON COLONIALISM (THE RPPI WILL BE AGAINST IT).

GENERAL EXPECTATION WAS THAT BAHERI WOULD BE FORMALLY RETAINED AS RPPI SYG. EMBASSY HAD LEARNED, HOWEVER, THAT PRINCIPAL, BUT PUBLICLY UNSTATED, REASON AMOUZEGAR CALLED FOR CONGRESS MEETING WAS TO REPLACE BAHERI, WHOM AMOUZEGAR CONSIDERS A LIGHTWEIGHT. AMOUZEGAR WAS ABLE TO DO THIS BECAUSE BAHERI HAS ALSO EARNED EMNITY OF COURT MINISTER HOVEYDA, WHO PUT ASIDE WHATEVER BACKSTAGE DIFFERENCES HE MAY HAVE WITH AMOUZEGAR (AND HE DOES HAVE THEM) TO GET RID OF BAHERI. TWO SOURCES WITH COURT ACCESS BELIEVE NASRATOLLAH MOINIAN, CHIEF OF SHAH'S SPECIAL BUREAU, WAS KEY FIGURE IN URGING RPPI REFORM ON BOTH HOVEYDA AND AMOUZEGAR BASED ON REPORTS FROM HIS OWN INVESTIGATIVE SOURCES.

SOURCE CLOSE TO AMOUZEGAR HAS INDICATED PRIVATELY THAT PRIME MINISTER BECAME CONVINCED EARLY ON THAT BAHERI WAS NOT "PLAYING ON THE TEAM", AND HAS WANTED TO REPLACE HIM WITH SOMEONE MORE PERSONALLY LOYAL. THERE HAVE BEEN ARCANE HINTS IN THE FARSI PRESS THAT THERE MIGHT BE A CHANGE AT THE TOP IN RPPI FOR "ORGANIZATIONAL REASONS", BUT THERE WAS NO PUBLIC SUGGESTION THAT BAHERI WOULD GO UNTIL SHAH'S ANNOUNCEMENT. PRIVATELY, WE UNDERSTAND THAT MOST RECENT POINT OF DIFFERENCE BETWEEN "BAHERI MEN" AND "AMOUZEGAR MEN" HAS BEEN OVER HANDLING PUBLIC EXPRESSIONS OF DISSIDENCE. BAHERI APPEARS TO FAVOR STRONGER MEASURES--MEETING DEMONSTRATIONS WITH COUNTERDEMONSTRATIONS.

AMOUZEGAR, ON THE OTHER HAND, IS REPORTED TO PREFER A MORE SOPHISTICATED, TOLERANT LINE TOWARD DISSENT PLUS USE OF LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICIALS ONLY WHEN VIOLENCE OR SERIOUS THREAT OF VIOLENCE IS PRESENT.

PROBLEM OF POLITICAL ORGANIZATION HAS BEEN COMPLICATED BY FACT EX-PRIME MINISTER, NOW COURT MINISTER, HOVEYDA ------------------033224 291947Z /47 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 6141 SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 11485 NOFORN HAS BEEN QUIETLY KEEPING HIS HAND IN POLITICAL GAME. HOVEYDA HAS PRIVATELY DENIGRATED AMOUZEGAR AND QUIETLY PASSED WORD TO KEY SENIOR WORKING LEVEL OFFICIALS AT MINISTRIES THAT IF THEY WANT TO GET THINGS DONE, THEY SHOULD GO THROUGH HOVEYDA WHO SEES SHAH ONCE A DAY, EVERY DAY.

AMOUZEGAR COULD NOT REALLY MOVE AGAINST BAHERI UNTIL HOVEYDA BECAME CONVINCED THAT BAHERI HAD TO GO, SINCE BAHERI HAD RETURNED ALMOST ALL KEY HOVEYDA LIEUTENANTS FROM 1976 PERIOD TO THEIR SENIOR PARTY JOBS OVER LAST THREE MONTHS.

DIFFICULTY OF HANDLING BOTH PM AND SYG POSTS SIMULTANEOUSLY SUGGESTS AMOUZEGAR WILL BE LOOKING AROUND FOR STRONG FIGURES TO BE HIS PRINCIPAL DEPUTIES. ONE GOOD SOURCE SAYS SENIOR DEPUTY WILL BE HOLAKU RAMBOD, RECENTLY BROUGHT INTO AMOUZEGAR CABINET AS MINISTER OF STATE FOR PARLIAMENTARY AFFAIRS (TEHRAN 10687). HE WAS A CLASSMATE OF THE SHAH'S AT TEHRAN MILITARY ACADEMY, A LEADER OF THE NOW DEFUNCT MARDOM PARTY, AND HAS A DESERVED REPUTATION FOR ORATORY AND INDEPENDENT CRITICISM OF GOVERNMENT. HE WOULD RUN PARTY FROM DEPUTY SYG SLOT. AMOUZEGAR MIGHT ALSO USE ALI FARSHCHI AS SECOND OR THIRD DEPUTY.

FOR REST OF MAJOR JOBS, AMOUZEGAR GROUP HAD MADE IT CLEAR PRIVATELY THAT FIRST TASK OF NEW RPPI LEADERSHIP WILL BE TO INSTALL KEY AMOUZEGAR MEN INTO TOP AND SECOND ECHELON ASSISTANT SECRETARYSHIPS. ONE SOURCE TOLD US THAT "SOME" OFFICIALS OF PREVIOUS REGIME WOULD BE RETAINED, BUT MANY WOULD GO; OTHERS FEEL MOST WILL BE REPLACED.

EMBASSY COMMENT: ASSUMING RPPI CONGRESS RESPECTS SHAH'S WISHES (OF WHICH WE HAVE NO DOUBT), AMOUZEGAR, LIKE HOVEYDA BEFORE HIM, WILL GET HIS CHANCE TO "RIDE THE TIGERS" OF SIMULTANEOUS PARTY LEADERSHIP AND GOVERNMENT PREMIERSHIP. BOTH SHAH AND AMOUZEGAR HAVE CONCLUDED THAT SEPARATION OF TWO JOBS AT THIS STAGE SIMPLY DOESN'T WORK, AND WHEN, AS WE UNDERSTAND, PRIME MINISTER WENT TO SHAH IN EARLY DECEMBER AND ASKED FOR CONTROL OF RPPI BECAUSE TOO MUCH GOVERNMENT BUSINESS WAS GETTING OUT OF HIS HANDS, SHAH READILY AGREED.
FACT THAT THIS WILL BE THIRD MAJOR PERSONNEL SHIFT IN RPPI REACHING DOWN TO DIVISION CHIEFS IN 14 MONTHS MEANS RPPI ORGANIZATIONAL EFFORT WILL AGAIN BE SIGNIFICANTLY IMPAIRED.

ALL THIS SUGGESTS THAT IRANIAN "MAN IN THE STREET" IS CONCLUDING THAT RPPI IS CERTAINLY NOT READY NOW, IF INDEED IT EVER WILL BE, TO PAY SIGNIFICANT INDEPENDENT ROLE IN IRANIAN GOVERNING PROCESS. RESULT, AT LEAST FOR PUBLIC, WILL BE RISE IN GENERAL LEVEL OF CYNICISM. EMBASSY BELIEVES THAT RPPI'S EVENTUAL FATE WILL DEPEND ON HOW WELL AMOUZEGAR AND HIS NEW HAND-PICKED LIEUTENANTS ARE ABLE TO GRASP EFFECTIVE CONTROL OF PARTY MACHINERY AND LINE IT UP TO DO THEIR BIDDING.

IN THAT SENSE, IT IS TOO SOON TO COUNT RPPI OUT OF AN EFFECTIVE POLITICAL ROLE, BUT RESULT OF PRESENT MANEUVER IS TO LEAVE IMPRESSION THAT RPPI IS STILL AS SUBORDINATE TO PERSONAL RIVALRIES AS IT HAS BEEN SINCE EARLY STAGES OF DEVELOPMENT (SEE REF A AND B).

FOR AMOUZEGAR PERSONALLY, DEMISE OF BAHERI MARKS DISAPPEARANCE OR DIMINUTION OF SECOND MAJOR POTENTIAL RIVAL FOR POLITICAL POWER WITHIN A FEW WEEKS. (HUSHANG ANSARY'S MOVE FROM THE CABINET TO NIOC CHAIRMANSHIP WAS FIRST). AMOUZEGAR MUST NOW SHOW THAT HE CAN SUCCESSFULLY RUN EVERYTHING THAT IS NOW PASSING UNDER HIS CONTROL. HOVEYDA SEEMS CONTENT TO LET HIM TRY, AND IN ANY CASE, IS TOO SMART TO MOVE INTO OPEN CONFLICT. FROM TECHNICAL AND ADMINISTRATIVE STANDPOINT, AMOUZEGAR HAS ALWAYS BEEN CONSIDERED ONE OF IRAN'S BEST.

REMAINING QUESTION NOW IS WHETHER HE CAN ADOPT HIS DYNAMIC BUT TRENCHANTLY A CERBIC PERSONALITY WHICH HAS BROUGHT HIM PREVIOUS SUCCESSES AS ADMINISTRATOR TO MORE DEVIOUS REQUIREMENTS OF PERSIAN POLITICAL BROKER'S ROLE. HE APPEARS OFF TO A GOOD START.
PRESIDENT MOHAMMAD SIAD BARRE VISITED TEHRAN DEC 27-29, DURING WHICH HE HELD SEVERAL LONG TALKS WITH THE SHAH AND WAS GUEST OF HONOR AT A STATE BANQUET AT NIAVARAN PALACE.

IN CONTRAST TO MANY OFFICIAL VISITS, EXTENSIVE REPORTS OF THE SUBSTANTIVE DISCUSSIONS HELD BY THE TWO LEADERS APPEARED IN LOCAL PRESS. SIAD BARRE GAVE PRESS CONFERENCE TO LOCAL CORRESPONDENTS DEC 28 IN WHICH HE WAS QUOTED AS SAYING THAT , "IT WAS TIME THE US ENDED ITS POLICY OF 'WAIT AND SEE' OVER THE SITUATION IN THE HORN OF AFRICA AND BECAME INVOLVED BEFORE IT WAS TOO LATE". HE SAID THE INVASION OF SOMALIA BY ETHIOPIA HAD ALREADY BEGUN AND THE US HAD A "MORAL RESPONSIBILITY TO BLUNT THE AGGRESSION". HE REPORTEDLY COMPLAINED THAT WESTERN SUPPORT HAD BEEN CONFINED TO "WORDS AND WORDS".

THE PRESIDENT WAS QUOTED AS SAYING, "WHEN DOES THE US INTEND TO DO SOMETHING? AFTER THE ETHIOPIANS HAVE FINISHED WHAT THEY HAVE BEGUN?" SIAD BARRE NOTED THAT THIS WAS THE ESSENCE OF THE MESSAGE HE HAD LEFT WITH THE SHAH TO BRING TO PRES CARTER'S ATTENTION WHEN HE ARRIVES DEC 31.

IN SUPPORT OF HIS REMARKS REGARDING ETHIOPIAN AGGRESSION, SIAD BARRE REPORTEDLY SAID SOVIET SUPPLIED AIRCRAFT WERE ALREADY BOMBING SOMALIA PROPER. HE ADDED THAT ETHIOPIAN MARKINGS DID NOT CONCEAL THE FACT THAT THEY HAD BEEN RECENTLY BROUGHT INTO ETHIOPIA VIA ADEN. SOMALI INTELLIGENCE HAS REPORTED THAT ETHIOPIA HAS ALSO RECEIVED LARGE NUMBERS OF MIG-23S, 10-12,000 CUBAN TROOPS AND "SCORES OF WARSAW PACT PERSONNEL".: SIAD BARRE CLAIMED HIS GOVT WAS RECEIVING THESE REPORTS FROM A REGULAR STREAM OF REFUGEES AND OGADEN SUCCESSIONIST FIGHTERS.

IN RESPONSE TO A QUERY, SIAD BARRE SAID THAT HE WAS LEAVING IRAN WITH THE EXPECTATION OF INCREASED HELP FROM IRAN. COMMENT: WE HAVE NO INDICATION FROM GOI AT THIS POINT WHETHER SIAD BARRE'S EXPECTATION WILL BE FULFILLED.

RE PARA 3 AND 4 REFTEL, INVESTIGATION CONTINUING RE CAUSE OF MOTIVE OF INCIDENT. THERE WERE APPROXIMATELY 30 IRANIAN EMPLOYEES OF IAS IN THE BUILDING ON 12/28 AT VARIOUS TIMES. NO AMERICANS WERE PRESENT AFTER 1600. ALL THIRTY EMPLOYEES (INCLUDING THE MISSING MAINTENANCE MAN MENTIONED PARA 3 REFTEL) WERE INTERVIEWED IN THE RSO OFFICE ON 12/29. TESTIMONY OF EMPLOYEES WAS CONSISTENT AND TENDS TO SUPPORT CURRENT ASSESSMENT OF LOCAL POLICE THAT BOMB WAS INSERTED THROUGH BATHROOM WINDOWN BY UNKNOWN INDIVIDUAL(S) FROM THE OUTSIDE ALLEY. POLICE ESTIMATE THAT A CHARGE EQUIVALENT TO 2 KILOS OF TNT WAS DETONATED IN THE BUILDING.

MAINTENANCE MEN WORKING IN BATHROOM ON 12/28 RECALL OPENING WINDOW BUT NOT REPEAT NOT SECURING SAME. MAINTENANCE MEN DEPARTED PREMISES AT APPROXIMATELY 1500. IAS ADMIN SECRETARY RECALLS INSPECTING TOILET AT APPROXIMATELY 1700, TESTING TOILET, BUT NOT SECURING WINDOW. NOTHING UNUSUAL WAS NOTED BY SECRETARY AT THIS TIME. NO OTHER PERSONNEL VISITED BATHROOM AREA, ACCORDING TO ADMIN SECRETARY, WHO WAS LAST EMPLOYEE TO DEPART PREMISES, UNTIL SHE DEPARTED PREMISES AT APPROXIMATELY 1745. NOTE: ALTHOUGH OUSIDE BATHROOM WINDOW WAS GRILLED, IF GLASS PORTION OF WINDOW WAS OPEN IT WOULD HAVE BEEN RELATIVELY EASY FOR SOMEONE IN OUTSIDE ALLEY TO INSERT A SMALL PACKAGE(S) THROUGH THE GRILLE INTO THE INTERIOR PREMISES.
ALLEYWAY IS OCCASIONALLY INSPECTED BY POLICE STATIONED ON MAIN STREET IN FRONT OF IAS FACILITY, BUT ALLEYWAY IS NOT UNDER CONTINUAL OBSERVATION.

1977WARSAW09483.subject: PRESIDENT'S VISIT TO POLAND: ATMOSPHERICS AT PUBLIC EVENTS

segments.text: EVENTS

AT THE PUBLIC EVENTS OF PRESIDENT AND MRS. CARTER'S DECEMBER 29-31 VISIT TO POLAND, THE POLISH PUBLIC GREETED THEM WARMLY -- WHEN IT HAD THE CHANCE. A COMBINATION OF RAW WEATHER, THE CHRISTMAS HOLIDAY, FAILURE OF THE POLISH PRESS TO PUBLISH THE TIMETABLE FOR THE DECEMBER 30 TOURS OF THE WARSAW MONUMENTS AND OLD TOWN, AND, ABOVE ALL, STRINGENT EFFORTS AT INSULATION BY THE POLISH SECURITY SERVICES, KEPT THE SIZE OF THE CROWDS CONSIDERABLY BELOW WHAT MIGHT HAVE BEEN THE CASE UNDER OTHER CIRCUMSTANCES. NEVERTHELESS, THERE WAS NO MISTAKING THE FRIENDLY FEELINGS AND PERSONAL REGARD TOWARD THE CARTERS SHOWN BY THE POLES IN THESTREET WHO WERE ON HAND.

CROWD CONTROL AT THE AIRPORT ARRIVAL AND DEPARTURE AND AT THE THREE MONUMENTS WAS EXTREMELY STRICT. PERHAPS 200 POLES WERE BUSSED INTO THE MILITARY AIR TERMINAL FOR THE ARRIVAL AND DEPARTURE CEREMONIEM RELATIVELY FEW -AND THESE OBVIOUSLY PRE-SCREENED -- WERE ALLOWED A CLOSEUP VIEW OF THE CEREMONIES AT THE MONUMENTS. THESE GENERALLY STONY-FACED APPARATCHIKI WERE ARRANGED SO THAT THE ORDINARY SPECTATORS, BEHIND STRONG POLICE CORDONS AND CONSIDERABLY FARTHER AWAY, COULD SEE LITTLE OR NOTHING OF THE WREATHLAYINGS AND ATTENDANT CEREMONIES. EVEN HAD THEIR VIEW BEEN UNOBSTRUCTED, ONLY THOSE WITH THE SHARPEST EYES COULD HAVE PICKED UP ANY DETAILS, SO FAR WERE THEY KEPT FROM THE MONUMENTS THEMSELVES.

A FEW MINOR INCIDENTS TOOK PLACE. APPROXIMATELY A HUNDRED PEOPLE SUCCEEDED IN BREAKING THROUGH THE POLICE LINE ORIGINALLY FORMED ABOUT A THIRD OF A MILE FROM THE TOMB OF THE UNKNOWN SOLDIER, IN AN ATTEMPT TO CATCH A CLOSER GLIMPSE OF THE PRESIDENT. THE POLICE FORMED A NEW LINE WHICH STILL KEPT THESE PEOPLE AT A CONSIDERABLE DISTANCE. ONE YOUNG WOMAN APPARENTLY TRIED TO BREAK THIS LINE. SHE WAS DRAGGED AWAY TO A POLICE JEEP.

THERE WERE CHANTS OF "CARTER, CARTER" AND A CHORUS OF "STO LAT" (THE POLISH EQUIVANT OF "FOR HE'S A JOLLY GOOD FELLOW") OBVIOUSLY DIRECTED AT THE PRESIDENT, FROM THE MIDST OF THE MAIN CROWN BEHIND THE CORDON AT THE TOMB.

AT THE EDGE OF THE SQUARE ON WHICH THE NIKE MONUMENT IS LOCATED, ABOUT FIFTY PEOPLE IN THEIR LATE TEENS OR TWENTIES, STANDING ON AN ACCESS STREET WITH A POOR VIEW OF THE MONUMENT ABOUT 500 YARDS AWAY, TRIED TO MOVE CLOSER. A GROUP OF POLICE LINKED ARMS TO REPSSDHEIR ADVANCE. THE YOUNG PEOPLE REACTED WITH CRIES OF "GESTAPO*" MORE POLICE LEFT THE MAIN CORDON TO PUSH BACK THE CROWD OF YOUTHS, WHICH THEN QUICKLY MELTED AWAY. ON THE OTHER SIDE OF THE SQUARE, CROWDS ALSO STRAINED AT THE POLICE LINE.

AS THE MOTORCADE LEFT FOR THE GHETTO MONUMENT, THESE PEOPLE, WITH CHEERS AND APPLAUSE, GAVE THE CARTERS THEIR FIRST SPONTANEOUS GREETING IN POLAND. THEY FINALLY BROKE THROUGH THE CORDON, BUT ONLY IN TIME TO SEE THE REAR OF THE MOTORCADE SPEEDING OFF.

AT THE GHETTO MONUMENT, SIMILAR CROWD-CONTROL MEASURES KEPT ORDINARY POLES AT A CONSIDERABLE DISTANCE FROM THE CEREMONIES. HOWEVER, AS HIS MOTORCADE WAS LEAVING THE SQUARE, WUE PRESIDENT DIRECTED AN UNSCHEDULED STOP, LEFT THE LIMOUSINE, AND WAS IMMEDIATELY SURROUNDED BY SEVERAL HUNDRED FRIENDLY VARSOVIANS. THIS WAS HIS BEST PERSONAL EXPOSURE TO THE POLISH PUBLIC DURING THE VISIT.

MRS. CARTER WAS WARMLY AND ENTHUSIASTICALLY GREETED BY A MODERATE-SIZE CROWD IN THE OLD TOWN SQUARE. THIS NUMBER INCLUDED A GROUP, WHICH ENCIRCLED MRS. CARTER'S PARTY AND WALKED WITH IT THROUGH THE SQUARE. DESPITE THE EXTREMELY UNFAVORABLE WEATHER CONDITIONS THE CROWD COULD HAVE BEEN SUBSTANTIALLY GREATER. HOWEVER, POLISH SECURITY COMPLETED SEALED OFF THE OLD TOWN AREA APPROXIMATELY 30 MINUTES BEFORE MRS. CARTER'S ARRIVAL AND APPARENTLY ADMITTED ONLY PERSONS LIVING IN THE AREA OR WHO WERE PREVIOUSLY PART OF THEIR PLAN FOR ADMITTANCE.

(THOSE WHO ALREADY WERE IN OLD TOWN SHOPS WERE ALLOWED TO STAY.) IN THE OLD TOWN SQUARE ITSELF, THE CROWD WAS CLOSELY CONTROLLED, AND THE MILITIA RESTRAINED SMALLER CROWDS FROM SPILLING INTO THE SQUARE FROM THE SIDE STREETS. POLISH SECURITY OFFICERS WERE AGGRESSIVE IN KEEPING WELL-WISHERS AWAY FROM THE OFFICIAL PARTY AS IT WALKED THROUGH TL SQUARE.

IN SPITE OF THESE EFFORTS, THE MAJORITY OF THE ONLOOKERS GAVE MRS. CARTER A GENUINELY WARM RECEPTION. THERE WERE NUMEROUS ATTEMPTS BY INDIVIDUAL POLES TO BREAK THROUGH THE SECURITY RING SURROUNDING MRS. CARTER AND TO GREET HER PERSONALLY. SUCH EFFORTS WERE FORCEFULLY DEFLECTED. IN ONE INSTANCE A TEENAGE GIRL TRISA TO GET A CLOSE-UP LOOK AT THE FIRST LADY. POLISH SECURITY PUSHED HER ASIDE WITH SUCH VIGOR THAT IF IT WERE NOT FOR THE DENSITY OF THE CROWD SHE WOULD HAVE FALLEDN TO THE PAVEMENT.

INSTEAD, THE GIRL BOUNCED BACK AND BEGAN HITTING THE SECURITY OFFICER ON THE SHOULDERS WITH HER FISTS WHILE TELLING HIM OF HER DISSATISFACTION IN NO UNCERTAIN TERMS. SHE THEN KEPT HER DISTANCE FOR A FEW MINUTES BUT LATER REJOINED THE CLOSE CIRCLE AROUND RS. CARTER, STILL TRYING FOR A PERSONAL GLIMPSE OF THE FIRST LADY. FINALLY, THE GIRL GAVE UP AND TOOK A POSITION ON THE CURB NEAR WHERE THE MOTORCADE FORMED FOR DEPARTURE. AT THIS POINT, MRS. CARTER BROKE OUT FROM HER SECURITY CIRCLE AND STARTED TO GREET THE CROWD LINING THE SIDEWALK. MUCH TO THE YOUNG GIRL'S SURPRISE AND DELIGHT, MRS.
CARTER CAME UP TO HER, SHOOK HER HAND, AND EXCHANGED A COUPLE OF WORDS.

WE FIND ATTITUDE OF IRANIAN MFA OFFICIAL REPORTED REF A PUZZLING AND REFLECTING WOEFUL LACK OF UNDERSTANDING OF UAE SCENE. OBVIOUSLY IF USG WERE NOT CONCERNED ABOUT INTERNAL POLITICAL AND SECURITY SITUATION IN UAE, DEPARTMENT WOULD NOT HAVE INSTRUCTED EMBASSY TEHRAN TO APPROACH GOI AS IT DID NOR WOULD IT HAVE AUTHORIZED US TO MAKE POINTS CONTAINED REF B TO SHAIKH ZAYID, SHAIKH RASHID, AND OTHER RULERS. THIS WE ARE NOW DOING. WE HOPE AT SAME TIME THAT OTHER GULF FRIENDS OF UAE, NOTABLY IRANIANS AND SAUDIS, WILL BE DOING THE SAME.

WE WOULD REMARK THAT VIEWS EXPRESSED BY SHAH AS WELL AS BY MFA INTERLOCTOR REFLECT VERY MUCH THOSE HELD BY SHAIKH RASHID AND THOSE AROUND HIM IN DUBAI. THIS IS NOT SURPRISING GIVEN LONG AND RELATIVELY CLOSE DUBAI ASSOCIATION WITH IRAN AND IRANIAN BACKGROUNG MANY OF DUBAI'S LEADING MERCHANT FAMILIES. THERE IS, AS WE OURSELVES HAVE HEARD, TENDENCY IN DUBAI TO EXPLAIN AWAY PROBLEMS TROUBLING UAE WITH EXPLANATION THEY ARE ALL DUE TO INFLUENCE ON ZAYID OF VARIOUS FOREIGN ADVISERS AND MOST ESPECIALLY TO THAT OF AHMAD KHALIFAH SUWAIDI WHO HELD FORTH AS "EVIL GENIUS" MANIPULATING ZAYID.

IN PRECISELY SAME WAY ABU DHABIANS HAVE REFERRED TO MAHDI TAJIR AS BEING TROUBLE-MAKER ON DUBAI SIDE. WE UNAWARE OF REASONS WHICH SHAH MAY HAVE FOR SUSPECTING SUWAIDI OF COLLUSION WITH IRAQIS (TO WHAT END?) BUT HAVE A FEELING THESE SUSPICIONS MAY BE BASED AS MUCH IF NOT MORE ON IRANIAN DIPLOMATIC AND INTELLIGENCE REPORTS REFLECTING DUBAINS PREJUDICES AGAINST SUWAIDI THAN ON HARD EVIDENCE OF SUCH COLLUSION.

IT SEEMS TO US THAT IMPORATNT POINT IS NOT WHETHER USG OR IRAN OR SAUDI ARABIA OR EVEN UK IS "RESPONSIBLE" FOR WHAT GOES ON IN LOWER GULF. POINT IS THAT ALL OF US HAVE CLEAR INTEREST IN SEEING UNITY OF UAE PRESERVED AND THIS UNIQUE ARABIAN EXPERIMENT IN FEDERAL GOVERNMENT SUCCEED.

THIS GOAL WILL NOT BE ACHIEVED OR EVEN ADVANCED BY UAE'S FRIENDS AND NEIGHBORS STAKING OUT PARTISAN POSITIONS ON BEHALF OF THIS OR THAT EMIRATE BUT BY MAKING CLEAR TO ALL RULERS WITHIN UAE THAT (A) WE SUPPORT CONTINUED FEDERAL UNITY OF ALL SEVEN EMIRATES, AND (B) WE WOULD NOT SUPPORT OR RECOGNIZE UNILATERAL SECESSION OF ONE OR MORE EMIRATES FROM FEDERATION. (LAST POINT GOES AS MUCH FOR ABU DHABI, WHERE THERE ARE ALSO SOME PAROCHIAL SECESSIONIST TENDENCIES, AS FOR DUBAI.)

POINT SHOULD ALSO BE MADE THAT WITHIN THESE ABOVE PARAMETERS UAE'S FRIENDS AND NEIGHBORS HAVE NO WISH TO INTERFERE IN WHAT ARE OBVIOUSLY DIFFICULT AND COMPLEX CONSTITUTIONAL AND POLITICAL QUESTIONS. RULERS AND PEOPLE OF THE EMIRATES MUST ULTIMATELY WORK THESE OUT FOR THEMSELVES IN MANNER THAT BEST MEETS THEIR TRADITIONS, CURRENT CIRCUMSTANCES, AND ASPIRATIONS FOR THE FUTURE. WE DO NOT SUGGEST THAT EITHER OR BOTH SIDES HAVE ALWAYS ACTED WISELY OR DISINTERESTEDLY IN THE COURSE OF THIS DISPUTE.

HOWEVER, WE BELIEVE IT WOULD BE GROSS OVER-SIMPLIFICATION OF THE PROBLEM TO SEE DISPUTE AS ONE BETWEEN HEROES AND VILLIANS OR TO ASSUME THAT THESE ISSUES HAVE ARISEN MERELY BECAUSE OF "BAD ADVICE" OR THE BANEFUL INFLUENCE OF "CUNNING ADVISERS."

AS AMERICANS SHOULD KNOW WELL FROM THEIR OWN HISTORY, FEDERALISM IS NOT AN EASY FORM OF GOVERNMENT. THERE ARE GENUINE ISSUES HERE THAT GO TO THE HEART OF WHAT THE FEDERAL SYSTEM OF GOVERNMENT IN THE EMIRATES SHOULD BE. HOW LEGITIMATE NEEDS FOR SOME DEGREE OF CENTRAL ORGANIZATION AND CONTROL WILL BE BALANCED AGAINST EQUALLY LEGITIMATE (AND STRONGLY HELD) CONCERNS FOR THE PRESERVATION OF SOME DEGREE OF LOCAL AUTONOMY AND CONTROL OVER POLICIES AND ACTIONS THAT AFFECT THE LIVES AND LIVELIHOODS OF THE UAE'S INHABITANTS ARE FUNDAMENTALLY WHAT THIS INTERNAL DISPUTE IS ALL ABOUT.

THERE ARE NO SIMPLE SOLUTIONS TO SUCH ISSUES(WE ARE STILL FINE-TINKERING WITH OUR OWN FEDERAL SYSTEM) AND THERE MAY NOT BE ALL THAT MUCH THAT OUTSIDERS CAN APPRECIABLY DO AT THIS POINT TO GUIDE OR CONTROL THE EVOLUTION OF THE UAE FEDERAL EXPERIMENT, EXCEPT TO STAND READY TO OFFER SYMPATHY AND TACTFUL ADVICE TO ALL UAE PARTIES SHOULD THEY APPEAR WILLING TO ACCEPT THAT.

IN PARA 3 OF REF A, TEHRAN'S MFA CONTACT TOUCHES ON A VERY VALID CONCERN, NAMELY THE LARGE NUMBERS OF FOREIGN WORKERS IN THE EMIRATES AND THE DEGREE TO WHICH THE ARMED FORCES AND EVEN THE POLICE FORCES ARE RECRUITED FROM AMONG NON-EMIRIANS. THIS IS A MATTER OF CONCERN TO UAE LEADERS THEMSELVES. GIVEN THE SMALL SIEE OF THE UAE POPULATION AND THE DISINCLINATION OF MANY OF ITS NOUVEAUX RICHES NATIVE INHABITANTS TO TAKE UP UNPLEASANT OR FINANCIALLY UNREWARDING OCCUPATIONS LIKE THOSE OF SOLDIER OR POLICEMAN, MUCH LESS CONSTRUCTION WORKERS AND DRILLER, WE SEE NO EARLY SOLUTION TO THIS PROBLEM SHORT OF A DRASTIC TURNDOWN IN THE FEDERATION'S ECONOMY.

ONE ANSWER, WHICH HAS BEEN URGED ON THE UAE SINCE THE INITIAL MILITARY REORGANIZATION PROPOSALS WERE SUBMITTED BY TRIPARTITE SAUDI/ KUWAITI/JORDANIAN SURVEY TEAM IN 1975, WOULD BE TO REDUCE THE SIZE OF THE ARMED FORCES FROM THEIR PRESENT STRENGTH OF OVER 40,000 TO A MORE COMPACT, WELL-TRAINED, AND HIGHLY MOBILE ARMY IN WHICH THE PERCENTAGE OF NATIONALS, AT LEAST IN THE OFFICER CORPS, COULD BE HIGHER THAN IT IS AT PRESENT AND THE NEED FOR LARGE NUMBERS OF FOREIGN ADVISERS, TECHNICANS, ETC., CORRESPONDINGLY REDUCED.

THIS WOULD BE USEFUL ADVICE FOR THIS SMALL COUNTRY'S FRIENDS TO URGE UPON THE UAE LEADERSHIP (ESPECIALLY IN ABU DHABI) BUT IT WOULD NEED TO BE DONE VERY, VERY CAREFULLY SO AS NOT TO AROUSE UAE SUSPICIONS THAT THOSE TENDERING SUCH ADVICE HAVE AS AN ULTERIOR MOTIVE THE WEAKENING THE UAE'S ABILITY TO DEFEND ITS INDEPENDENCE AND TERRITORIAL SOVEREIGNTY FROM ENCROACHMENT BY STRONGER NEIGHBORS.

FACT THAT SIZE OF FORCES IN ABU DHABI HAS BEEN ONE OF ISSUES RAISED BY RASHID IS FURTHER COMPLICATING FACTOR. ------------------028509 111317Z /40 FM AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 7963 AMEMBASSY TEHRAN PRIORITY INFO AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MUSCAT SECTION 2 OF 2 ABU DHABI 1666 EXDIS

THIS LEADS TO THE QUESTION, ALSO REAISED BY THE IRANIAN MFA OFFICIAL, ABOUT WHAT MORE THE USG COULD OR SHOULD DO TO ASSURE THE INTERNAL SECURITY OF THE LOWER GULF STATES. THIS IS A LEGITIMATE QUESTION BUT ONE WHICH THE US CANNOT BE EXPECTED TO ANSWER IN ISOLATION. WE HERE ARE NOT CONVINCED THAT A PROGRAM OR MAJOR ARMS SALES, FOR EXAMPLE, IS THE PRESCRIPTION ALTHOUGH EFFORTS TO IMPROVE THE QUALITY OF UAE ARMED FORCES LEADERSHIP THOUGH TRAINING IN US AND OTHER FRIENDLY MILITARY SCHOOLS MIGHT BE A STEP TOWARD SOLVING SOME OF THE PROBLEMS NOTED IN PARA 5 ABOVE.

WE HEARTILY AGREE WITH EMBASSY TEHRAN'S RECOMMENDATION THIS IS MATTER WHICH MERITS FURTHER STUDY IN WASHINGTON AND OTHER INTERESTED CAPITALS. CONVERSTAIONS REPORTED REF A CONSTITUTE USEFUL FIRST STEP TOWARD CONTINUING DIALOGUE WITH IRANIANS ON THESE AREAS OF CONCERN. WE LOOK FORWARD TO FURTHER SUCH EXCHANGES, NOT ONLY IN TEHRAN BUT IN OTHER CONCERNED CAPITALS ADDRESSED BY REF B.

FOR TEHRAN: RE LAST SENTENCE PARA 4 URTEL, TEHRAN ADDRESSEE NOT ONLY OF ALL ABU DHABI CABLES ON THIS SUBJECT BUT ALSO OF NUMEROUS MEMCONS AND AN AIRGRAM POUCHED JUNE 7. THESE MAY PROVIDE ADDITIONAL INFORMATION ON WHICH TO ENGAGE IRANIANS IN FURTHER DISCUSSION RE UAE SITUATION.
