1978ADDIS00318.subject: OAU PRESS RELEASE ON IRAN AND HORN OF AFRICA

segments.text: BEGIN SUMMARY: EMBASSY BELIEVES THAT OAU JAN 20 PRESS RELEASE OFFFERS US OPPORTUNITY TO REESTABLISH ITS POSITION OF EVENHANDEDNESS VIS-VIS THE OGADEN WAR, WHICH ETHIOPIA SEES US AS HAVING DEPARTED FROM IN RECENT PUBLIC STATEMENTS. END SUMMARY.

OAU HAS CHOSEN IRAN FOR BRUNT OF ITS CRTICISM IN JANUARY 20 PRESS RELEASE. NO INTELLIGENT READER COULD OVERLOOK FACT, HOWEVER, THAT OAU WORDS ARE EQUALLY ADDRESSED TO ALL FOREIGN POWERS WHICH ARE OR MIGHT BE CONTEMPLATING DIRECT INTERVENTION IN WAR ON EITHER SIDE. OAU MSG WAS DIRECTLY INSPIRED BY KENYAN AMBASSADOR WHO WAS ATTEMTPING FIND FORMULA US GOVT OULD ENDORSE. GRANTED CRITICSM OF IRAN IS STRONG, BUT IT DOES REFLECT ATTIUDES OF MANY MODERATE AFRICAN DIPLOMATS HERE.

WE ARE PARTICULARLY STRUCK BY BALANCED LANGUAGE OF FINAL PARAGRAPH. IN ITS REFERENCE TO RESOLVING AFRICAN PROBLEMS IN ACCORDANCE WITH OAU CHARTER PRINCIPLES, THERE IS NO TILT TOWARD ONE OR THE OTHER OF BELLIGERENTS, THEREBY GIVING BOTH TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY AND SELF-DETERMINATION EQUAL WEIGHT IN ANY FUTURE NEGOTIATION OF PEACEFUL SETTLEMENT. STATEMENT ALSO REAFFIRMS OAU'S PARAMOUNT ROLE IN SEEKING SUCH A SETTLEMENT AND WARNS ALL OUTSIDE MEDDLERS TO LEAVE AFRICAN AFFAIRS TO AFRCANS.

IF WE ARE INTERESTED IN PLAYING ROLE IN MEDIATING THIS WAR, AND BRINGING IT TO AN EARLY AND LASTING END, I HOPE WE CAN QUICKLY ENDORSE OAU STATEMENT IN TERMS THAT CAN BE CONVINCINGLY DEMONSTRATED TO BOTH ETHIOPIA AND SOMALIA AS EVIDENCE THAT WE ARE NOT TAKING SIDES AND THAT US INFLUENCE SHOULD NOT BE DISREGARDED, IF BELLIGERENTS MOVE TOWARD NEGOTIATING TABLE IN COMING WEEKS. TO GIVE ENDORSEMENT ATTENTION IT DESERVES, IT WOULD BE PARTICULARLY HELPFUL IF IT COULD BE MADE IN FORM OF STATEMENT BY SECRETARY OR DEPUTY SECRETARY.

IF WE COULD SEE OUR WAY CLEAR TO DO IT, I WOULD FURTHER RECOMMEND THAT WE COUPLE OUR ENDORSEMENT WITH SOME SORT OF PUBLIC RECOGNITION THAT ANY LASTING SETTLEMENT BASED ON TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY NECESSITATES AND PRESUPPOSES WITHDRAWAL OF SOMALI ARMED FORCES FROM OGADEN. WE HOPE SHAH COULD BE MADE TO UNDERSTAND.

IN FIRST MEETING WITH MOFA AMERICAN AFFAIRS DIRECTOR BERHANE DERESSA SINCE HIS RETURN FROM US, EMBOFF WAS TAKEN ABACK BY DEPTH OF FEELING BERHANE SHOWED OVER US ROLE IN HORN, PARTICULARLY SINCE HE IS AS UNDERSTANDING OF US MOTIVES AS ANY OF OUR NORMAL CONTACTS. IN BERHANE'S VIEW, EPMG WAS FAST COMING TO CONVICTION, ON DUAL BASIS OF WHAT PRESIDENT SIAD IN JAN 12 PRESS CONFERENCE AND WHAT US GOVT CHOSE TO LEAVE UNSAID WITH RESPECT TO CONDEMNING SOMALI AGGRESSION AND DEMANDING WITHDRAWAL OF SOMALI TROOPS FROM OGADEN, THAT US WAS BEGINNING TO TILT MORE AND MORE IN SOMALIA'S DIRECTION.

PRESIDENT'S CALL FOR SOMALIS TO INITIATE NEGOTIATIONS WAS GENERALLY INERPRETED AS US SUPPORT FOR CEASEFIRE IN PLACE, WHICH NO ETHIOPIAN WOULD EVER AGREE TO. IN FACT, BERHANE SAID, ONLY CONDITION UNDER WHICH ETHIOPIA WOULD AGREE TO SIT DOWN WITH SOMALIS WAS PRIOR REMOVAL OF ALL SOMALI FORCES FROM OGADEN, WHETHER BY VOLUNTARY ACTION ON THEIR PART OR BY FORCE OF ETHIOPIAN ARMS. RATHER THAN CONCEDE ANYTHING IN ADVANCE IN RETURN FOR FULL WITHDRAWAL, ETHIOPIA WAS PREPARED TO FIGHT AS LONG AS IT TAKES TO ASSURE REALIZATION OF THIS OBJECTIVE.

ANY WOULD-BE FOREIGN MEDIATOR, WELL-MEANING OR OTHERWISE, WHO BELIEVED DIFFERENTLY WAS HEADING DOWN BLIND ALLEY, BERHANE SAID. ------------------102630 211713Z /41 FM AMEMBASSY ADDIS ABABA TO SECSTATE NIACT IMMEDIATE 6994 AMEMBASSY TEHRAN NIACT IMMEDIATE INFO AMEMBASSY BONN IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY JIDDA IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY LONDON IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY MOGADISCIO IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY NAIROBI IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY PARIS IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY ROME IMMEDIATE SECTION 2 OF 2 ADDIS ABABA 0318

BERHANE SAID THAT IF US WAS NOT PREPARED TO CONDEMN SOMALIA AND CALL FOR HER WITHDRAWAL, US WOULD BE WELL ADVISED TO CEASE MAKING PUBLIC STATEMENTS ABOUT HORN ALTOGETHER, SINCE WHAT IT SAID SERVED ONLY TO ALIENATE ETHIOPIA, ENCOURAGE IRAN AND OTHERS TO MAKE UNACCEPTABLE THREATS, AND PROLONG RATHER THAN SHORTEN CONFLICT. BERHANE HAD NO ANSWER TO EMBOFF QUESTION WHY ETHIOPIA DEMANDED THAT US MAKE STATEMENTS CONDEMNATORY OF SOMALIA THAT GO FAR BEYOND ANYTHING OAU HAS SO FAR BEEN PREPARED TO STATE PUBLICLY.

BERHANE INDICATED THAT MEETING IN WASHINGTON OF REPRESENTATIVES OF SAME FIVE POWERS TO WHICH SIAD BARRE HAD ONLY FEW DAYS PREVIOUSLY APPEALED FOR MILITARY ASSISTANCE WAS FURTHER OMINOUS DEVELOPMENT IN ETHIOPIAN EYES. HE WAS NOT IN MOOD TO LISTEN TO COUNTERVAILING ARGUMENTS AND WAS NOT PREPARED TO SAY WHEN FONMIN FELLEKE WOULD RECEIVE ME TO HEAR FULL EXPOSITION OF US POSITION.

PART OF BERHANE'S ANGER NO DOUBT REFLECTED GENERAL ETHIOPIAN TOUCHINESS ABOUT ITS RELATIONSHIP WITH USSR AND CUBA, AND ETHIOPIAN PERCEPTION THAT US CRITICISM OF SOVIETCUBAN ROLE HERE REFLECTS GROWING US TENDENCY TO VIEW SITUATION IN HORN IN EAST-WEST CONFRONTATIONAL TERMS.

WHATEVER THE REASON, ETHIOPIAN DOUBTS ABOUT US GOOD INTENTIONS, AT LEAST AMONG THOSE WHO COUNT IN EPMG, HAVE PROBABLY NEVER BEEN MORE PRONOUNCED AND, AS BERHANE INDICATED, NEITHER FONMIN FELLEKE NOR ANYONE ELSE IN AUTHORITY SEEMS TO BE IN ANY MOOD TO LISTEN TO OUR WORDS UNTIL WE HAVE DEMONSTRATED TO THEM IN SOME PUBLIC FASHION OUR RECOGNITION THAT IT WAS ETHIOPIA WHICH WAS INVADED IN THIS WAR, AND THAT ANY SETTLEMENT OF WAR PRESUPPOSES WITHDRAWAL OF ATTACKERS.

FOR THIS REASON, IT IS NOT AT ALL CERTAIN THAT EPMG WILL BE VERY SATISFIED WITH OAU PRESS RELEASE EITHER. EXCEPT FOR ITS SHARP CRITICISM OF IRAN, STATEMENT IS ONE FROM WHICH SOMALIA CAN DERIVE AT LEAST AS MUCH COMFORT AS ETHIOPIA. STILL, ETHIOPIA KEEPS ACCUSING US OF TRYING TO END RUN OAU, AND SINCE SENTIMENTS OF LAST PARAGRAPH OF OAU RELEASE ARE ONES THAT WE UNQUALIFIEDLY SHARE ANYWAY, WE HOPE OUR RESPONSE CAN BE PROMPT AND AUTHORITATIVE WITH NO DOUBT ABOUT OUR SUPPORT FOR OAU.

1978ADDIS03063.subject: IRANIANS CONSIDERING CLOSING EMBASSY IN ADDIS ABABA

segments.text: APART FROM WELL-KNOWN BILATERAL POLICY DIFFERENCES BETWEEN ETHIOPIA NAD IRAN, WE ARE NOT AWARE OF ANY EXTRAORDINARY HARASSMENT OF IRANIAN DIPLOMATIC PERSONNEL IN ADDIS ABABA. WE WOULD EXPECT ANY SUCH DELIBERATE HARRASSMENT (WHICH THE ETHIOPIANS ARE CERTAINLY CAPABLE OF AS DEMONSTRATED IN THEIR TREATMENT OF SUDANESE AND SOMALI DIPLOMATS IN EARLY 1977) TO BE QUITE OVERT, UNSUBTLE AND ACCOMPANIED BY AN ANTI-IRANIAN PRESS CAMPAIGN.

DIFFICULTIES SUFFERED BY IRANIANS HERE DESCRIBED IN REFTEL ARE TO SOME EXTENT EXPERIENCED BY ALL EMBASSIES. IRANIAN DIFFICULTIES PROBABLY CONSIDERABLY EXACERBATED BY EXTREMELY ABRASIVE BEHAVIOR OF IRANIAN CHARGE TOWARD HIS STAFF AND HIS NEGATIVE ATTITUDE TOWARDS ETHIOPIANS IN GENERAL. EMBASSY AWARE OF HIS TREATMENT OF HIS STAFF BY VIRTUE OF FACT THAT WIFE OF EMBASSY COMMUNICATOR WAS CHARGE'S PERSONAL SECRETARY FOR APPROXIMATELY THREE WEEKS BEFORE SHE QUIT, UNABLE TO TAKE HIS PERSONAL ABUSE AND SHORT TEMPER. IN SHORT, BELIEVE THAT DIFFICULTIES SUFFERED BY IRANIAN CHARGE' HERE ARE PRIMARILY OF HIS OWN MAKING.

WE BELIEVE IT WOULD BE IN IRAN'S OWN INTERESTS AS WELL AS THOSE OF WEST - FOR IRAN TO MAINTAIN A PRESENCE HERE. ANY IRANIAN DECISION TO CLOSE WOULD BE INTERPRETED BY ETHIOPIANS AS FURTHER OVERT HOSTILITY ON PART OF SHAH, AND IT IS ALWAYS MORE DIFFICULT TO REOPEN A MISSION ONCE CLOSED. IRANIAN GOVERNMENT CONSIDERATION TO CLOSING IS MOST LIKELY PROMPTED BY REPORTING OF ITS CHARGE' WHICH WE SUSPECT IS OFTEN SUBSTANTIVELY UNRELIABLE AS WELL. IN OUR OPINION, HE IS NEITHER SERVING HIS OWN COUNTRY OR THE CAUSE OF ITS FRIENDS IN ETHIOPIA. RELATIONS BETWEEN OUR TWO EMBASSIES ARE, NEVERTHELESS, VERY GOOD.

DURING BRIEF DISCUSSION OF IRAN ON NOVEMBER 19, KING HUSSEIN TOLD ME HE HAD SPOKEN TO SHAH EARLIER IN THE DAY. HE WAS VERY WORRIED ABOUT SHAH'S STATE OF MIND AND DESCRIBED HIM ON TELEPHONE AS "TIRED OLD MAN". HUSSEIN SAID HE WOULD TRY TO FIND OPPORTUNITY IN NEXT FEW DAYS FOR QUICK TRIP TO IRAN TO TRY TO BUCK UP SHAH. IN THIS RESPECT, HUSSEIN BELIEVED PRESIDENT CARTER'S RECENT PUBLIC EXPRESSIONS OF SUPPORT FOR THE SHAH WERE EXTREMELY

1978ANKARA05134.subject: NEW TURKISH AMBASSADOR TO IRAN, TURGUT TULUMEN

segments.text: TEHRAN WILL BE THE FIRST AMBASSADORIAL POST FOR TURGUT TULUMEN, AN EXCEPTIONALLY ABLE 49-YEAR-OLD DIPLOMAT WHO FOR THE LAST TWO YEARS HAS HELD ONE OF THE MFA'S HOTTEST JOBS AS DIRGEN FOR CYPRUS/GREECE AFFAIRS. HE HAS TOLD US THAT HE REGARDS THE IMPORVEMENT OF TURKISH/IRANIAN RELATIONS AS A VERY HIGH PRIORITY FOR TURKEY AND THAT HE IS DETERMINED TO DO ALL HE CAN TO BRING ABOUT IMPROVEMENT. HE PLANS TO LEAVE FOR HIS NEW POST IN AUGUST.

TULUMEN'S PERSONAL BACKGROUND IS THE TURKISH EQUIVALENT OF THE US EASTERN ESTABLISHMENT TYPE: BORN IN ISTANBUL, SECONDARY EDUCATION AT GALATASARY LYCEE IN ISTANBUL, AND GRADUATED FROM THE ANKARA UNIVERSITY FACULTY OF POLITICAL SCIENCE. SINCE JOINING THE FOREIGN SERVICE IN 1952, HE HAS GAINED WELL-ROUNDED EXPERIENCE IN ECONOMIC, POLITICAL, PRESS, AND NATO AFFAIRS. HIS OVERSEAS POSTS INCLUDE WASHINGTON, NICOSIA, ATHENS, AND BRUSSELS (NATO). HE HEADED THE TURKISH DEL TO THE PRELIMINARY TALKS ON MBFR IN 1973. HE WAS MFA DEPUTY SPOKESMAN 1974-76.

WHEN HE BECAME CYPRUS/GREECE DIRGEN IN 1976, HE TOLD US WE COULD COUNT ON HIM TO WORK HARD AT REACHING A CYPRUS SETTLEMENT, AND THAT HE WOULD LOOK FOR NEW APPROACHES AND WAYS OF BEING FLEXIBLE. WE BELIEVE THAT WITHIN TURKISH POLITICAL AND POLICY LIMITATIONS, HE HAS MADE GOOD ON THAT PLEDGE. WE HAVE NONETHELESS FOUND HIM A TOUGH BARGAINER WHO CAN BE UNYIELDING UNDER PRESSURE. WHILE HE HAS TAKEN A HARDER LINE ON SOME ISSUES THAN WE THOUGHT TUSTIFIED, HE OBVIOUSLY HAS WORKED HARD ON OTHERS TO DEVELOP A BUREAUCRATIC CONSENSUS SUPPORTING FLEXIBILITY AND COMPROMISE.

MORE THAN MOST OF HIS COLLEAGUES, HE LOOKS FOR CREATIVE SOLUTIONS; AND ON A NUMBER OF OCCASIONS HE AND WE HAVE BEEN ABLE TO KICK EACH OTHER'S IDEAS AROUND AND PRODUCE USEFUL RECOMMENDATIONS FOR HIGHLEVEL ACTION. HE CAN FLARE UP QUICKLY AND IS FRANK IN CRITICIZING US POLICY, BUT THE TONE OF HIS CRITICISM IS USUALLY ONE OF DISAPPOINTMENT, NOT RANCOR, AND HE WILL LISTEN TO REVERSE CRITICISM WITHOUT ANGER. HE CONVERYS THE GOT POSITION ACCURATELY AND APPARENTLY REPORTS OUR POSITION WELL. HE SHOWS A BROAD, COMPLETELY POLICY-ORIENTED OUTLOOK AND AN EXCELLENT KNOWLEDGE OF HOW HIS OWN GOVERNMENT WORKS.

TULUMEN'S PARTY SYMPATHIES ARE NOT CLEAR. IN THE CYPRUS/ GREECE JOB, HE HAS WORKED CLOSELY WITH GOVERNMENTS HEADED BY BOTH MAJOR PARTIES. ALTHOUGH HE DISPLAYS AN AUTOGRAPHED PICTURE OF FORMER PRIMIN DEMIREL IN HIS LIVING ROOM, HE HAS WORKED EXTREMELY WELL WITH PRIMIN ECEVIT, WHO HAS TAKEN A STRONG PERSONAL ROLE IN MAKING POLICY ON THE CYPRUS PROBLEM AND TURKEY'S RELATIONS WITH GREECE.

BOTH TULUMEN AND HIS WIFE HAVE EXCELLENT COMMAND OF ENGLISH. SHE IS AN EXCELLENT HOSTESS AND A WELL-BALANCED PERSON. THEIR ONLY CHILD, A DAUGHTER, 23, IS A TALENTED ARTIST (SHE JUST HAD AN EXHIBIT AT THE TURKISH AMERICAN ASSOCIATION, WHICH WE HELPED ARRANGE) AND IS ABOUT TO BE MARRIED. THE TULUMENS HAVE QUIET TASTES, ENJOY ART AND CLASSICAL MUSIC, ENTERTAIN FAIRLY OFTEN, AND SHARE THE TURKISH LOVE OF CARD-PLAYING.

TULUMEN WILL BRING TO HIS NEW JOB INTELLIGENCE, DRIVE, ARTICULATENESS, POLICY SENSE, AND A KNOWLEDGE OF HOW TO GET THINGS DONE IN ANKARA. PROBABLY HE WILL ALSO BE BLESSED WITH ECEVIT'S BACKING. WE BELIEVE YOU WILL ENJOY KNOWING AND

1978BEIRUT01549.subject: SOVIET AMBASSADOR'S COMMENTS ON CURRENT VIOLENCE ON ISRAELI-PLO FRONT

segments.text: VINOGRADEV'S COMMENT THAT ARAFAT WAS TOTALLY UNAWARE OF ATTACK ON ISRAELI BUS IS NOT WORTH MUCH IN OUR VIEW. ABU JIHAD'S "OCCUPIED TERRITORIES OFFICE" IN FATAH WAS RESPONSIBLE FOR MARCH 11 ATTACK. SUMMARY AND COMMENT. SENATE MAJORITY LEADER BYRD, AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN, DAS CRAWFORD AND MEMBERS OF CODEL PARTY HAD MEETINGS WITH PRIMIN AZHARI AND THE SHAH NOVEMBER 27. SENATOR HAD FIFTEEN MINUTES PRIVATE INTERVIEW WITH SHAH FOLLOWING THE LATTER MEETING. SHAH AND EMPRESS GAVE LUNCHEON FOR SENATOR AND MRS. BYRD, AMBASSADOR AND MRS. SULLIVAN, DAS CRAWFORD AND HOYT PURVIS OF SENATOR'S STAFF.
PRIMIN AZHARI WAS CANDID, CONFIDENT THAT MUHARRAM TENSIONS COULD BE CONTROLLED, AND EMPHATIC ON CONSTITUTIONALITY OF HIS ROLE. THAT CONVERSATION BEING REPORTED SEPARATELY BY EMBASSY TEHRAN.

WITH THE SHAH, SENATOR BYRD EMPHASIZED SUPPORT OF PRESIDENT CARTER, CONGRESS AND AMERICAN PEOPLE. AT SENATOR'S REQUEST, SHAH REVIEWED DISPASSIONATELY AND AT LENGTH THE PROBLEMS HE CONFRONTS, CULMINATING IN RELIGIOUS MONTH OF MUHARRAM, OUTLINING POSSIBLE AVENUES OF ACTION AND THEN RECOUNTING WHY NONE PRESENTED ANY GUARANTEE OF SUCCESSFUL OUTCOME. CONCLUSION OF HIS LISTENERS WAS THAT HE HAS NO REAL ANSWERS AND IS GENERALLY DISPIRITED. THIS IMPRESSION WAS HEIGHTENED BY LUNCHEON DURING WHICH SHAH ALMOST COMPLETELY WITHDREW FROM CONVERSATION, PERHAPS UNDER SEDATION.

MATCHING THE TWO INTERVIEWS, IT COULD BE POSTULATED THAT SHAH IS ORCHESTRATING AN APPROACH TO ANTICIPATED MUHARRAM CRISIS OF (A) CASTING PRIMIN IN THE FOREFRONT, STRONGMAN ROLE OF THE ENFORCER OF ORDER AND THE ONE WHO TAKES MILITARY MEASURES SHOULD THESE PROVE NECESSARY TO CONTROL CROWDS AND (B) DELIBERATELY MOVING HIMSELF INTO THE BACKGROUND IN THE KNOWLEDGE THAT BROAD PUBLIC ANTIPATHY TO HIS ROLE SHARPENS THE SENSE OF CONFRONTATION WITHIN THE NATION, AND PERHAPS HOPING FOR POLITICAL OPENINGS IF MUHARRAM CAN BE WEATHERED. THIS, HOWEVER, IS AT BEST A CHARITABLE HYPOTHESIS. THERE WAS NOTHING IN THE CONVERSATIONS WHICH GAVE ANY PROOF THAT HE IS FOLLOWING A STRATEGY.
AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN'S COMMENTS ARE INVITED. END SUMMARY.

FOLLOWING IS MEMCON OF MEETING WITH SHAH CLEARED BY SENATOR BYRD. NOTES ON MEETING WITH THE SHAH, NOVEMBER 27, L978. SENATOR BYRD OPENED THE MEETING BY ASSURING THE SHAH OF THE STRONG SUPPORT OF THE PRESIDENT OF THE UNITED STATES AND OF HIS OWN SUPPORT FOR THE SHAH'S EFFORTS TO MOVE TOWARD REPRESENTATIVE DEMOCRACY AND TO RESTORE AND MAINTAIN STABILITY, ORDER, AND DOMESTIC TRANQUILITY. WHILE THE UNITED STATES HAD MADE CLEAR IT HAS NO INTENTION OF INTERFERING IN IRAN'S INTERNAL AFFAIRS, THE UNITED STATES WOULD VIEW ANY INTERFERENCE BY ANOTHER COUNTRY AS A MATTER OF UTMOST GRAVITY.

IRAN HAS A VITAL INTERNATIONAL ROLE, AND THE SENATOR EXPRESSED HIS BELIEF THAT CONGRESS AND THE AMERICAN PEOPLE WOULD SUPPORT THE PRESIDENT IN TAKING A STRONG AND DETERMINED STAND AGAINST ANY OUTSIDE INTERFERENCE. THE U.S. WANTS TO CONTINUE TO PURSUE ITS STRONG POLITICAL, ECONOMIC, AND SECURITY RELATIONSHIP WITH IRAN. THE U.S. WANTS TO BE HELPFUL TO IRAN WITHOUT, OF COURSE, INTERFERING IN IRAN'S INTERNAL AFFAIRS. THE SHAH BEGAN BY SAYING THAT HE FOUND THE SENATOR'S COMMENTS TO BE MEANINGFUL AND WAS PLEASED TO HAVE HIM AS A REPRESENTATIVE OF BOTH THE PRESIDENT AND THE LEGISLATIVE BRANCH.

THE SITUATION IN IRAN HAD DEVELOPED WITH SUCH TREMENDOUS SPEED, THE SHAH SAID, THAT HE HAD BEEN TAKEN BY SURPRISE. HE SAID THE COUNTRY SEEMED LIKE A ROCK JUST A YEAR AGO. HE NOTED THAT PRESIDENT CARTER HAD REFERRED TO IRAN LAST YEAR AS AN ISLAND OF STABILITY. THE SHAH ACKNOWLEDGED THAT THERE HAD BEEN MISTAKES ------------------009187 291825Z /42 FM AMEMBASSY CAIRO TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 6683 AMEMBASSY TEHRAN IMMEDIATE SECTION 02 OF 04 CAIRO 25975 EXDIS DISTRIBUTE AS NODIS OVER THE PAST 15 YEARS. HE HAD CONCENTRATED ATTENTION ON ATTEMPTS TO PROGRESS IN CERTAIN MAJOR AREAS AND HAD NOT GIVEN ENOUGH ATTENTION TO PUBLIC OPINION AND PUBLIC INVOLVEMENT.

EFFORTS TO DEVELOP A POLITICAL PARTY SYSTEM HAD BEEN UNSUCCESSFUL. THE BASIS OF POLITICAL ACTIVITY WAS NOT STRENGTHENED; POTENTIAL TALENT REMAINED IDLE. ALL THATREMAINED WAS THE OLD OPPOSITION PEOP. MORE RECENTLY, HE SAID, POLITICAL PRISONERS, INCLUDING THOSE HELD FOR COMMUNIST ACTIVITY HAD BEEN RELEASED. HE SAID ALL POLITICAL PRISONERS HAD NOW BEEN RELEASED ALTHOUGH SOME 'TERRORISTS' REMAINED IMPRISONED. SOME OF THE RELEASED PRISONERS HAVE BECOME ACTIVE ONCE MORE AND THERE ARE WELL ORGANIZED COMMUNIST GROUPS, WORKING DAY AND NIGHT, ACCORDING TO THE SHAH. ANOTHER DEVELOPMENT HAS BEEN THE GREAT INFLUENCE OF THE PRIESTS. THERE HAS BEEN ANTAGONISM TO AUTHORITY.

MANY HAVE NOT REALIZED HOW COUNTER-PRODUCTIVE THIS MAY BE TO THEIR OWN INTERESTS. THE SHAH SAID IT WAS HIS IDEA THAT THE COUNTRY SHOULD FINALLY BECOME A CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCHY. ONLY THEN COULD AUTHORITY BE TRANSFERRED FROM A KING TO HIS HEIR. IRAN IS BECOMING A MUCH MORE SOPHISTICATED COUNTRY. IN 10 YEARS THE POPULATION WILL BE CLOSE TO 50 MILLION, NEARLY ALL OF WHOM WILL BE LITERATE. "WE NEED A MACHINERY FOR DEMOCRACY. I DON'T KNOW IF I CAN DO IT, BUT I WILL TRY," THE SHAH SAID. HE SAID HE WAS CAUGHT IN A SORT OF VICIOUS CYCLE. "SHALL WE ESTABLISH LAW AND ORDER FIRST AND THEN DEMOCRACY?

WHO CAN GUARANTEE THAT IF WE BROUGHT A COLATION TO POWER THEY WOULD NOT YIELD TOO MUCH TO EITHER THE EXTREME LEFT OR EXTREME RIGHT. IF WE CONTINUE CLAMPING DOWN THIS MAY OR MAY NOT END THE DISORDER." THE POLICY THUS FAR HAS BEEN TO TRY AND ESTABLISH LAW AND ORDER. HE EMPHASIZED THE WORD "TRY." HE NOTED THAT THE OIL FIELDS WERE BACK TO ORDER BUT THERE WERE PROBLEMS IN THE MAIN BUILDING OF THE NATIONAL OIL COMPANY. HE SAID THOSE WHO DEMONSTRATED AT THE OIL COMPANY BUILDING WERE MILITARY-LIKE IN THEIR OPERATIONS, RECEIVING ORDERS AND ACTING ACCORDINGLY. HE SAID THERE MIGHT BE TROUBLE WITH ELECTRICAL SERVICE.

THERE ARE NOT ENOUGH SOLDIERS TO COVER EVERYTHING. THE SHAH SAID HE DID NOT WANT TO HAVE "AN ALMOST JUNTA" AND APPLY EMERGENCY RULE AND GET AWAY FROM THE CONSTITUTION. EFFORTS WERE CONTINUING TO MAINTAIN LAW AND ORDER AND TO ESTABLISH CONTACT WITH THE OPPOSITION. HOWEVER, THE OPPOSITION MAY ASK FOR PREROGATIVES AGAINST THE KING. "HOW COULD I ACCEPT THAT? IT WOULD DO HARM TO THE NEXT KING." "IF THE COUNTRY DOESN'T WANT A KING...THAT'S A DIFFERENT PROPOSITION. BUT I DON'T THINK I WOULD BE RENDERING A SERVICE TO AGREE TO ALL THEIR DEMANDS.

THEY ARE SO SHORTSIGHTED THAT THEY DON'T REALIZE THAT A WEAK KING IN THIS COUNTRY MEANS DISINTEGRATION." HE SAID HE DID NOT BELIEVE THE ARMY WOULD FOLLOW ANYONE ELSE. MOST OF THE OPPOSITION, IN THE SHAH'S VIEW, DOES NOT STAND FOR ANYTHING SPECIFIC. "THEY ARE RIDING ON A WAVE OF DISSATISFACTION; MANY OF THEM ARE OUT OF TOUCH WITH REALITY AND DON'T KNOW ABOUT GOVERNING A COUNTRY OF 36 MILLION PEOPLE." HE COMMENTED THAT IT MAY TAKE 10 YEARS TO REMEDY THE DAMAGE THAT HAS RECENTLY BEEN DONE TO THE ECONOMY.

IN CONSIDERING THE VARIOUS POSSIBLE DEVELOPMENTS, THE SHAH SAID HE DID NOT SEE A MILITARY COUP AS A REALISTIC POSSIBILITY. A SITUATION WHERE COMPLETE CHAOS PREVAILED WOULD, HE SAID, BE AN INVITATION TO THE SOVIETS TO TRY TO TAKE ADVANTAGE OF THE SITUATION AND POSSIBLY TAKE CONTROL OF PART OF THE COUNTRY. HE SAID THE TONE OF ------------------009345 291833Z /41 FM AMEMBASSY CAIRO TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 6684 AMEMBASSY TEHRAN IMMEDIATE SECTION 03 OF 04 CAIRO 25975 EXDIS DISTRIBUTE AS NODIS THE SOVIET PRESS TOWARD HIM HAD BEEN BECOMING MORE "INAMICABLE" IN THE LAST TWO TO THREE WEEKS.

IN DISCUSSING THE TWO HOLY MONTHS WHICH WERE FORTHCOMING, THE SHAH SAID THAT HIS ENEMIES WOULD TRY TO EXPLOIT THE SITUATION. THERE WAS LITTLE THAT OTHER NATIONS COULD DO. IT IS, HE SAID, A "DEEP AND INTERNAL MATTER HERE," AND ALL THE BEST STATEMENTS FROM WASHINGTON, LONDON, AND BONN, COULD NOT CHANGE THAT. HE DID, HOWEVER, RAISE THE ISSUE OF BROADCASTS BY THE BRITISH BROADCASTING CORPORATION (BBC), AS HAD THE PRIME MINISTER. THE SHAH SAID THE BBC HAD BROADCAST INCORRECT INFORMATION AND HAD BECOME THE "MOUTHPIECE OF THE OPPOSITION." THE SHAH SAID HE HAD TO BE VERY CAREFUL IN THE MANNER IN WHICH HE DEALS WITH OPPONENTS AND DEMONSTRATORS.

IF THEY ARE ARRESTED, THIS MAY SET OFF A STRIKE IN THE OIL FIELDS AND ARREST THE OIL FLOW.THE WORKERS WOULD NOT RETURN TO THEIR JOBS UNTIL THOSE WHO HAD BEEN ARRESTED WERE RELEASED. COMMENTING ON AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, WHOM HE REFERRED TO AS "THIS FELLOW IN PARIS," THE SHAH SAID HE WAS CONSTANTLY SENDING DIRECTIVES FOR DISOBEDIENCE. ACCORDING TO THE SHAH, HE HAD EVEN SAID THAT PEOPLE MIGHT BE KILLED, BUT THAT THEY WOULD GO TO PARADISE.

THE SHAH THEN ACKNOWLEDGED THAT KHOMEINI HAS "A STRONG FOLLOWING," BUT SAID THAT "SOME PEOPLE ARE SAYING THAT HE'S LOSING A LITTLE GROUND." SENATOR BYRD INQUIRED IF THE GOVERNMENT WAS ADEQUATELY PREPARED TO DEAL WITH EVENTS THAT MIGHT OCCUR DURING THE PERIOD OF MUHARRAM. THE SHAH RESPONDED THAT "THE ANSWER CANNOT BE NO." HE SAID EVERY EFFORT WOULD BE MADE TO AVOID BLOODSHED AND THAT WHERE THERE ARE ADEQUATE NUMBERS OF SOLDIERS, THERE WILL BE ATTEMPTS TO DISPERSE UNRULY CROWDS. PROBLEMS MIGHT OCCUR, HOWEVER, IN CASES WHERE THERE ARE NOT SUFFICIENT NUMBERS OF SOLDIERS.

SENATOR BYRD COMMENTED THAT THE UNITED STATES DID NOT UNDERESTIMATE THE GRAVITY OF THE SITUATION AND THE INTERNATIONAL IMPLICATIONS OF A POSSIBLE DISINTEGRATION WITHIN IRAN. HE SAID HE BELIEVED IT IMPORTANT FOR THE GOVERNMENT TO BE STRONG ENOUGH TO MAINTAIN STABILITY AND ORDER. AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN NOTED THAT UPON THE SENATOR'S DEPARTURE FROM IRAN A PRESS RELEASE WOULD BE ISSUED, SETTING FORTH THE SENATOR'S VIEWS. THE SHAH SAID HE HAD READ COMMENTARY IN MANY WESTERN PAPERS, EVEN IN THE PAKISTANI PRESS, THAT HE SHOULD ABDICATE.

HE SAID THAT ONE OPPOSITION PROPOSAL WAS THAT A ROYAL COUNCIL BE FORMED TO RULE THE COUNTRY UNTIL THE CROWN PRINCE COMES OF AGE AND THE SHAH GETS OUT. HE SAID THIS HAS BEEN REPEATEDLY REFERRED TO IN THE PRESS, AND THAT THERE ARE ALSO REPORTS THAT HE IS "HATED." WHILE HE RECOGNIZES THAT THERE IS STRONG OPPOSITION, HE DOES NOT BELIEVE THIS ACCURATELY REFLECTS THE VIEW OF IRANIANS. SENATOR BYRD SAID THAT HE HAD NOT SEEN CALLS FOR ABDICATION IN THE AMERICAN PRESS AND THAT THE PRESIDENT AND CONGRESS WERE NOT THINKING IN THOSE TERMS.

SENATOR BYRD SAID THE SHAH HAD TO BE JUDICIOUS, BUT ALSO NEEDED TO SHOW CONFIDENCE. BLOODSHED MUST BE AVOIDED, BUT AT THE SAME TIME THE GOVERNMENT MUST BE PREPARED TO DEAL WITH CONTINGENCIES THAT MIGHT ARISE. THE FUTURE OF THE UNITED STATES AND THAT OF IRAN ARE CLOSELY RELATED, AND WE WANT TO PURSUE CLOSE TIES -POLITICALLY, ECONOMICALLY, AND FROM THE STANDPOINT OF SECURITY. WE FULLY RECOGNIZE THE PROBLEMS CONFRONTING THE SHAH AND IRAN, BUT WE HOPE THAT THE SHAH CAN MAINTAIN CONFIDENCE AND BE IN A POSITION TO HELP THE COUNTRY MOVE FORWARD.

THE SHAH ASKED, "HOW DO I KNOW THAT LAW AND ORDER ------------------009420 291834Z /41 FM AMEMBASSY CAIRO TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 6685 AMEMBASSY TEHRAN IMMEDIATE SECTION 04 OF 04 CAIRO 25975 EXDIS DISTRIBUTE AS NODIS CAN BE MAINTAINED IF A COALITION GOVERNMENT CAN BE FORMED?" SENATOR BYRD COMMENTED THAT THE SHAH WAS IN THE BEST POSITION TO MAKE THAT JUDGMENT. HE EMPHASIZED THAT HE WAS NOT ADVOCATING A PARTICULAR COURSE OF ACTION. THAT WAS AN IRANIAN MATTER. BUT WHAT HE WAS SAYING WAS THAT THE LEADERSHIP MUST BE FAIR, FIRM, AND DETERMINED.

THE SENATOR THEN RAISED THE POINT ABOUT THE SHAH'S COMMUNICATION WITH THE PUBLIC AND POSSIBLE USE OF RADIO AND TELEVISION. AT THIS STAGE, AFTER ABOUT ONE HOUR OF DISCUSSION, THE SENATOR HAD A PRIVATE CONVERSATION WITH THE SHAH. SENATOR BYRD INFORMED THE SHAH THAT IN HIS DISCUSSIONS WITH TOP ADMINISTRATION OFFICIALS PRIOR TO HIS DEPARTURE FROM WASHINGTON, THEY HAD BELIEVED IT IMPORTANT FOR THE SHAH TO USE THE MASS MEDIA, PARTICULARLY TELEVISION, TO MAKE HIS CASE TO THE PEOPLE. HOWEVER, SINCE ARRIVAL IN TEHRAN THE SENATOR HAD DECIDED NOT TO MAKE A STRONG RECOMMENDATION.

HE HAD NOTED THAT IRANIAN FRIENDS HADMX HED DIFFERENT REASONS WHY THIS MIGHT NOT BE AN ADVISABLE COURSE* THE JUDGMENT WAS, OF COURSE, FOR THE SHAH TO MAKE. BUT, SENATOR BYRD SAID, IF YOU APPEALED TO PEOPLE ON THE BASIS THAT ORDER AND TRANQUILITY WERE NECESSARY IN ORDER FOR THE COUNTRY TO BE ABLE TO MOVE FORWARD, THIS MIGHT BE EFFECTIVE. THE PEOPLE NEED TO HAVE CONFIDENCE IN THE GOVERNMENT AND THE CONVICTION THAT THE SHAH WILL BE FIRM, FAIR AND DETERMINED -- JUDICIOUS BUT STRONG. IT IS NECESSARY TO BUILD THAT CONFIDENCE IN ORDER TO HAVE THE BASIS FOR TAKING ACTION IN THE FUTURE.

THE SHAH THANKED SENATOR BYRD FOR HIS COMMENTS. HE ASKED THE SENATOR TO TELL THE PRESIDENT TO ASK AMERICANS IN IRAN TO SUPPORT HIM. BY THIS HE SAID HE MEANT THE CENTRAL INTELLIGENCE AGENCY AND OTHER AGENCIES. HIS COMMENT WAS THAT THEY SHOULD SUPPORT HIM "IN WHAT THEY DO AS WELL AS WHAT THEY SAY." EILTS

MFA DEPUTY POLITICAL DIRECTOR PETER DYVIG CONFIRMED TO US NOON RADIO REPORT THAT FOREIGN MINISTER K.B.ANDERSEN LEFT COPENHAGEN TODAY FOR TEHRAN. DYVIG SAID THAT PURPOSE OF THE TWO-DAY VISIT IS TO CLEAR UP THE IMPORT BAN OF DANISH PRODUCTS IMPOSED BY THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT IN RETALIATION FOR DANISH LENIENCY TOWARD IRANIAN DEMONSTRATORS (REFTELS). ACCOMPANYING ANDERSEN ARE HIS PRIVATE SECRETARY, BJARNE BLADBJERG, AND THE HEAD OF THE MFA'S COMMERCIAL DEPARTMENT, ERIK KROG-MEYER.

1978COPENH00067.subject: DANISH ATTITUDES TOWARD FOREIGN MALFEASANCE IN DENMARK

segments.text: (NOTAL) SUMMARY. DANISH GOVERNMENT HANDLING OF THE IRANIAN DEMONSTRATORS WAS CONSISTENT WITH DANISH TRADITIONAL RESPONSE TO SUCH INCIDENTS. THE DANISH CHARACTER IS NON-CONFRONTATIONAL, AND THE GOVERNMENT IS PERHAPS MORE SENSITIVE THAN OTHERS TO CHARGES OF "ANTI-HUMANITARIANISM." PROTESTS IN TWO RECENT CASES INVOLVING THE DEPORTATION OF FOREIGN NATIONALS ARE STILL REVERBERATING. THE DANES--AND PROBABLY THE IRANIAN AMBASSADOR HERE-- WANTED TO AVOID A SIMILAR SITUATION IN THE CASE OF THE IRANIAN DEMONSTRATORS. WHAT REMAINS UNCERTAIN IS HOW THE DANISH GOVERNMENT WOULD REACT IF FACED WITH REAL VIOLENCE OR TERRORISM. END SUMMARY.

DURING A JANUARY 1 CONVERSATION, MFA POLITICAL DIRECTOR OLE BIERRING REITERATED TO POLCOUNCS DENMARK'S POSITION THAT THE IRANIAN AMBASSADOR HAD CONCURRED IN THE NON-PROSECUTION AND DEPORTATION OF IRANIAN DEMONSTRATORS BUT WAS OVERRULED BY TEHRAN. IN VIEW OF REF (A) REPORT AND OUR JUDGMENT OF MFA VERACITY, WE CONCLUDE THAT THIS MUST HAVE BEEN THE CASE. A SEPARATE TELEGRAM OFFERS A GLIMPSE OF THE EXTENT OF DAMAGE TO THE DANISH ECONOMY FROM THE IMPORT BAN. THE PRESENT CABLE TAKES A LOOK AT LARGER DANISH ATTITUDES TOWARD SUCH INCIDENTS.

THE DESIGN ON THE PART OF THE IRANIAN DEMONSTRATORS--ALL FROM OUTSIDE DENMARK--TO STAGE THEIRACT HERE IS PROBABLY AT LEAST PARTLY ATTRIBUTABLE TO THE DANISH IMAGE OF BEING SOFT ON DEMONSTRATORS, DISSIDENTS AND EVEN, PERHAPS, TERRORISTS. THIS IMAGE MAY NOT BE ALTOGETHER WARRANTE, FOR HAPPILY THE DANES HAVE NOT HAD TO DEAL WITH THE KINDS OF VIOLENCE THAT HAVE TAKEN PLACE IN MANY OTHER COUNTRIES IN WESTERN EUROPE.

THERE IS RESPECTABLE EVIDENCE, HOWEVER, THAT SUGGESTS THAT ONE OF THE REASONS FOR THIS ABSENCE OF VIOLENCE IS THAT TERRORISTS USE DENMARK AS A "SAFE HAVEN" WHERE THEY PLAN INCIDENTS ELSEWHERE. AND IT IS CERTAINLY TRUE THAT THE DANISH CHARACTER--TO THE EXTENT THAT A GENERALIZATION IS POSSIBLE--IS NON-CONFRONTATIONAL. FURTHERMORE, THE DANISH GOVERNMENT MAY BE MORE SENSITITIVE TO "ANTI-HUMANITARIAN" ACCUSATIONS THAN SOME OTHER GOVERNMENTS IN WESTERN EUROPE.

A CLAMOR, FOR EXAMPLE, STILL CONTINUES AS THE RESULT OF THE DANISH GOVERNMENT'S DEPORTATION OF "THE MEXICAN" BACK TO HIS OWN COUNTRY (REF C). IN BRIEF, THIS INVOLVED AMEXICAN NATIONAL WHOM THE DANISH GOVERNMENT HAD CONCLUDED WAS CONNECTED WITH TERRORIST ACTIVITY IN SWEDEN. APPARENTLY BECAUSE OF THE SENSITIVITY OF THE INFORMATION HELD BY THE DANES, THE MEXICAN, JAIME OKUSONO MARTINEZ, WAS DEPORTED WITHOUT A FORMAL HEARING. THE LACK OF SUCH A HEARING WAS CRITICIZED BY MANY DANES, NOT JUST THOSE FROM THE LEFT, AND CONSIDERABLE CONSTERNATION WAS RAISED OVER THE PUNISHMENT TO WHICH MARTINEZ MIGHT BE SUBJECTED UPON HIS RETURN TO MEXICO.

A SECOND CASE, WHICH HAS ALSO ATTRACHED ATTENTION AND AS FAR AS WE KNOW REMAINS UNRESOLVED, IS THAT OF A FRENCH NATIONAL IN CUSTODY HERE WHO EXTRADITION HAS BEEN SOUGHT BY THE FRENCH GOVERNMENT. REPORTEDLY, THE CRIME WITH WHICH HE IS CHARGED IN FRANCE MIGHT RESULT IN THE DEATH PENALTY. THE DANES CONTINUE TO REFUSE EXTRADITION PENDING REQUESTED ASSURANCES FROM THE FRENCH THAT SUCH A PENALTY WOULD NOT BE LEVIED.

WITH THESE TWO RECENT CASES, AS WELL AS THE GENERAL DANISH POLITICAL CLIMATE AS BACKGROUND, THE DANISH AUTHORITIES WERE OBVIOUSLY ANXIOUS TO AVOID WHAT COULD HAVE BECOME ANOTHER CAUSE CELEBRE. THE CAUSE OF THE IMPRISONED IRANIAN DEMONSTRATORS WOULD HAVE BEEN TAKEN UP BOTH BY THE USUAL PROTESTORS AS WELL AS THE IRANIA N STUDENTS RESIDENT HERE, MANY OF WHOM ARE ANTI-SHAH. A HARBINGER OF WHAT MIGHT HAVE BEEN IN STORE WAS THE OBVIOUSLY WELL-ORCHESTRATED FLOOD OF TELEGRAMS RECEIVED BY THE DANISH AUTHORITIES IMMEDIATELY AFTER THE ARREST OF THE DEMONSTRATORS.

FINALLY, IT IS UNDERSTANDABLE THAT THE IRANIAN AMBASSADOR HERE MIGHT CONCLUDE WITH OFFICIALS IN THE DANISH FOREIGN MINISTRY THAT THE RESULTS OF A TRIAL, CONVICTION AND SUBSEQUENT INCARCERATION OF THE DEMONSTRATORS COULD HAVE BECOME A RUNNING SORE TO POISON WHAT HAD HERETOFORE BEEN ACCEPTABLE DANISH-IRANIAN RELATIONS.

WHAT REMAINS UNCERTAIN IS HOW THE DANISH GOVERNMENT WOULD REACT IF FACED WITH REAL TERRORISM OR VIOLENCE. THE POLICE HAVE A SPECIALLY-TRAINED ANTI-TERRORIST FORCE READY. BUT A POLITICAL DECISION WILL BE REQUIRED TO EMPLOY IT.

segments.text: DEMONSTRATORS WILL BE ON THE HAMBURG STREETS DECEMBER 16 FOR THE SECOND CONSECUTIVE SATURDAY ACCORDING TO LATEST INFORMATION PROVIDED BY POLICE.

ONE GROUP OF APPROXIMATELY 200-300 KBW (COMMUNIST BUND WEST GERMANY) WILL GATHER AND MARCH AT 1200 LOCAL TIME WITH THE THEME "SUPPORT FOR THE PEOPLE'S FIGHT IN IRAN" AND "AGAINST THE DEMONSTRATION PROHIBITION, CURBS PROHIBITING GATHERINGS".

THE SECOND GROUP, OF APPROXIMATELY 1500 MEMBERS, BELONG TO THE ORGANIZATION "BUNTE LISTE/WEHRT EUCH" (COLORED LIST/ARM YOURSELVES) AND HAVE THE THEME "FOR THE MORAL SUPPORT OF THE DEMOCRATIC OPPOSITION OF IRAN AGAINST THE EXISTING SHAH REGIME". THEIR MARCH BEGINS AT 1330.

THE GROUPS AGAIN WISH TO MARCH IN THE CENTER OF TOWN (POSSIBLY TO DISRUPT HEAVY CHRISTMAS TRAFFIC AND BUSINESS) BUT HAVE BEEN GIVEN ALTERNATIVE ROUTES BY THE POLICE AWAY FROM DOWNTOWN. IT IS NOT KNOWN IF THEY WILL ACCEPT OR ADHERE TO THESE PRESCRIBED ROUTES.
POLICE PRECAUTIONS WILL BE THE SAME AS LAST WEEKEND. US PROPERTY WILL BE GUARDED.

A SOURCE HAS STATED THAT POLICE IN BREMEN AND HANNOVER HAVE BEEN NOTIFIED THERE WILL BE DEMONSTRATIONS HELD IN THOSE CITIES. THIS MAY OCCUR, BUT IT COULD ALSO BE A DECEPTION. 1978ISFAHA00092.subject: ISFAHAN REACTION TO NEW GOVERNEMENT SUMMARY: ISFAHANIS DISMISS THE NEW IRANIAN GOVERNEMENT AS A CARTAKERBODY LEADING TO THE NEXT ELECTIONS ONLY.

segments.text: SUMMARY: ISFAHANIS DISMISS THE NEW IRANIAN GOVERNEMENT AS A CARTAKERBODY LEADING TO THE NEXT ELECTIONS ONLY. HOWEVER, SINCE THEY DOUBT THIS GOVERNMENT HAS ANY INDEPENDENT AUTHORITY, THEY ARE INTERESTED IN ITS ACTIONS AS A GUIDE TO THE SHAH'S THINKING. SO FAR, THEY SEE NO SIGNS OF ANY BASIC CHANGE: THEY BELIEVE THE SHAH IS HOPING TO GET BY WITH PALLIATIVES AND WORDS. THEY DO NOT BELIEVE HE WILL SUCCEED AND ARE WAITING FOR ACTIONS. END SUMMARY.

THE DISMISSAL OF THE AMOUZAGAR GOVERNMENT CAME AS NO SURPRISE TO THE PEOPLE OF ISFAHAN. FOR OVER A MONTH, A MAJOR TOPIC OF CONVERSATION HAD BEEN WHOU WOULD BE NAMED TO REPLACE AMOUZAGAR. THE NAMING OF JAAFAR SHARIF-EMAMI, HOWEVER, WAS SURPRISE AND A DISAPPOINTMENT. MANY POEPLE HAD BEEN EXPECTING THE NEW GOVERNMENT TO INDICATE A REAL DESIRE FOR CHANGE, AND POINT THE WAY TOWARD NEW DIRECTIONS. SHARIF-EMAMI THEY DISMISS AS AN OLD MAN WITH NO STRENGHT, WHOSE MAJOR FUNCTION WILL BE TO FILL THE SEAT UNTIL A REAL GOVERNMENT CAN BE FORMED, PROBABLY FOLLOWING NEXT YEAR'S ELECTIONS.
HIS CABINET ALSO IS LARGELY DISMISSED AS "HOLD-OVERS AND OLD MEN" WHO ARE NOT EXPECTED TO ACCOMPLISH ANYTHING OF SUBSTANCE.

SOME RESPONSE IS POSITIVE. THE MAJOR OF ISFAHAN STATED THAT THIS GOVERNMENT IS A GOOD THING, BECAUSE "IT SHOWS THAT THE SHAH IS NOT GOING TO BE HASTY. HEIS WAITING FOR THE POLITICAL ACTIVITY AND THE ELECTIONS TO SHOW HIM WHAT THE PEOPLE REALLY WANT." OTHERS POINT OUT THAT, "IF THE SHAH WANTS IT, THESE MEN CAN BE USED TO ELIMINATE CORRUPT OFFICIALS WITHOUT CREATING ENEMIES FOR THE NEXT GOVERNMENT." ONE MODERATE MULLAH SAID THAT "SHARIF-EMAMI IS ALMOST A MULLAH HIMSELF. HE WILL CREATE AN ATMOSPHERE WHERE RELIGIOUS MODERATES CAN FIGHT THE EXTREMISTS WITHOUT BEING TAKEN EXTREMISTS THEMSELVES."

MOST OF THE COMMENTS, HOWEVER, ARE NEGATIVE. A LEADING INDUSTRIALIST STATED "SHARIF-EMAMI HAS NO SUPPORT. HE CANNOT ATTACK CORRUPTION; HE CANNOT CHANGE THE DIRECTION OF POLICIES; ALL HE CAN, AND WILL, DO IS ISSUE STATEMENTS, AND HE IS FOOLISH ENOUGH TO BELIEVE HIS STATEMENTS WILL HAVE EFFECT." SOME GO FARTHER. ONE COLLEGE TEACHER IS AFRAID OF EMAMI. "HE WILL WANT TO BE LIKED, AND WILL PLACATE THE MULLAHS BY GIVING THEM EVERYTHING THEY ASK FOR. THEY WILL ONLY ASK FOR MORE, AND WE WILL HAVE CHAOS OR A RELIGIOUS DICTATORSHIP EVEN BEFORE THE ELECTIONS."

MOST PEOPLE ARE JUST IGNORING SHARIF-EMAMI. ANNOUNCEMENTS OF POLITICAL ACTIVITY ARE BEING FOLLOWED CLOSELY. AND THEREIS A GREAT DEAL OF SPECULATION ABOUT THE CHANCES OF DIFFERENT INDIVIDUALS OBTAINING ENOUGH PUBLICH POLITICAL POWER TO BE ABLE TO DEMAND A CHANCE TO FORM THE NEXT GOVERNMENT. GOVERNMENT ACTIONS, SUCH AS CLOSING CASINOS AND REVERTING TO ISLAMIC CALENDAR, ARE SEEN AS SHAH'S ATTEMPTS TO PLACATE RELIGIOUS PARTIES, AND PEOPLE ARE WAITING FOR THE NEXT SHOE TO FALL. THEY DO NOT BELIEVE ANYTHING SO FAR DONE OR PROMISED WILL SUCCEED IN SATISFYING THE RELIGIOUS AND THEREFORE, ACCORDING TO INDIVIDUAL BELIEFS, ARE HOPEFUL OR FEARFUL THAT THE SHAH WILL GO FARTHER.

IN MOSQUES IN ISFAHAN, PREACHERS ARE DECLARING THAT THE SHAH WILL REINSTITUTE THE RELIGIOUS VETO POWER OVER ALL LEGISLATION, POPULAR ELCTION OF THE RELIGIOUS HIERARCHY, AND IMPLEMENTATION OF REGULATIONS REQUIREING FULL OBSERVANCE OF ISLAMIC PREACTICES IN ALL PUBLIC INSTITUTIONS, INCLUDING SCHOOLS AND UNIVERSITIES. THEY POINT TO THE ABOLITION OF THE MINISTRY FOR WOMEN'S ------------------075451 101523Z /46 FM AMCONSUL ISFAHAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 45 INFO AMEMBASSY TEHRAN AMCONSUL SHIRAZ AMCONSUL TABRIZ SECTION 2 OF 2 ISFAHAN 0092 AFFAIRS AS THE FIRST STEP IN RECREATING AN ISLAMIC SOCIETY IN IRAN.

MODERNISTS IN ISFAHAN ARE ALSO POINTING TO THE ELIMINATION OF THE WOMEN'S PORTFOLIO IN FAVOR OF A RELIGIOUS ENDOWMENTS PORTFOLIO, BUT WITH ALARM. THE HEAD OF THE WOMEN'S ORGANIZATION IN ISFAHAN HAS SAID SHE WILL RESIGN "IF THE MULLAHS ATTEMPT TO ROLL BACK ANY PROGRESS WE HAVE MADE." THE CONSULATE HAS RECEIVED OVER TWELVE INQUIRIES FROM PARENTS OF GIRLS AT THE UNIVERSITIES HERE, SAYING THAT IF THE UNIVERSITIES REQUIRE CHADORS AND ISSUE OTHER "ANTI-WOMEN" REGULATIONS, THEY WILL WISH TO TRANSFER THEIR DAUGHTERS TO SCHOOLS IN THE U.S.

GROUP OF FEMALE TEACHERS AT THE UNIVERSITY OF ISFAHAN HAVE SENT A LETTER TO THE CHANCELLOR DECLARING THAT THEY WILL NOT WEAR CHADORS AND REQUESTING HIS ASSURANCES THAT SUCH CHANGES ARE NOT INTENDED. A WIDESPREAD FEAR IS THAT, BY GOING THIS FAR, THE SHAH HAS GIVEN THE RELIGIOUS REACTIONARIES A FEELING OF POWER, AND NOW HE MUST EITHER CONTINUE TO GIVE IN, OR CRACK DOWN ON THEM--AND EITHER MIGHT PROVOKE DISTURBANCES MUCH WORSE THAN IRAN HAS SEEN SO FAR.

ISFAHANIS ARE CONSERVATIVE, AND WHILE THEY TALK A LOT ABOUT THE VARIOUS POLITICAL GROUPS FORMING, THERE HAS BEEN SO FAR NO POLITICAL ACTIVITY OR DECLARATION HERE, EXCEPT THAT THE ONCE-OFFICIAL RESURGENCE PARTY (RPPI) IS REAPIDLY LOSING BOTH STAFF AND ADHERENTS. IT IS WIDELY ASSUMED THAT THE RPPI IS FINISHED AND WILL PROBABLY NOT EVEN CONTEST THE NEXT ELECTIONS.

ISFAHAN REMAINS UNDER MARTIAL LAW, WITH NIGHT-TIME CURFEW AND A BAN ON ALL PUBLIC GATHERINGS. HOWEVER, AUTHORITIES ARE BEING VERY CAREFUL OF INTERFERING WITH ANYTHING WHICH LOOKS POLITICAL. THE NEWSPAPER ANNOUNCEMENT OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI'S RETURN FROM EXILE IN IRAQ (LATER PROVED FALSE) ENGENDERED LARGE GATHERINGS IN MOSQUES AND ON THE MAJOR STREETS WITH NOISY DISCUSSION. TROOPS GRADUALLY DISPERSED THESE GATHERINGS, BUT GENTLY AND WITH NO CONFRONTATIONS--IN SHARP CONTRAST TO THE VIOLENT TACTICS THEY USED TO BREAK UP GATHERINGS SHORTLY AFTER MARTIAL LAW WAS IMPOSED.

THE MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATION REPORTS IT HAS ALREADY RECEIVED A NUMBER OF INQUIRIES ABOUT THE LEGALITY OF HOLDING POLITICAL MEETINGS AND IS CONSIDERING PERMITTING THEM, BUT ONLY INSIDE HALLS WITH LIMITED ATTENDANCE AND TROOPS ON STANBY. THEY ASSUME THAT THE LIFTING OF THE CURFEW WILL ALLOW THE BEGINNING OF ELECTION ACTIVITY AND THAT THERE WILL BE A GREAT DEAL OF IT.

CONCLUSIONS: ISFAHANIS ARE TREATING THE NEW GOVERNMENT AS THE SIGNAL FOR THE BEGINNING OF POLITICAL ACTIVITY LEADING TO ELECTIONS IN THE SPRING. THEY ARE ALTERNATIVELY ENCOURGED OR FEARFUL OVER WHAT BOTH SIDES SEE ASSAN INADEQUATE ATTEMPT TO APPEASE THE RELIGIOUS REACTIONARY FACTION, AND ARE EXCITED ENOUGH TO PARTIALLY DISREGARD MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS. ONCE MARTIAL LAW IS LIFTED OR RELAXED, MAJOR POLITICAL ACTIVITY WILL OCCUR IN ISFAHAN.

EMBASSY TEHRAN COMMENT: MOST TEHRANIS AS WELL AS THIS EMBASSY ARE NOT AS READY TO WRITE OFF THE SHARIF-EMAMI GOVERNMENT AS SOME OF THE CITIZENS OF ISFAHAN ARE. WITH THIS EXCEPTION, MANY OF THE VIEW EXPRESSED IN ISFAHAN ARE ALSO HELD IN TEHRAN AND ELSEWHERE, PARTICULARLYTHE FEELINGS OF CONCERN ON ONE HAND AND HOPE ON THE OTHER ABOUT THE SHAH'S POLICY OF APPEASING THE MULLAHS. ABOVE ANALYSIS WAS COMPLETED SEPT. 3, PRIOR TO IMPOSITION OF MARTIAL LAW IN 12 ADDITIONAL IRANIAN CITIES BESIDES ISFAHAN.

1978ISFAHA00100.subject: FIRE BOMB ATTACK ON AMCIT RESIDENCE, ISFAHAN

segments.text: SUMMARY: SUMMARY IN THE FIRST SUCH INCIDENT REPORTED IN IRAN, A FIRE-BOMB ATTACK WAS MADE ON THE EVENING OF 9/17 ON THE HOME OF AN AMERICAN. WHILE THERE WERE NO INJURIES, THERE IS DISTRUBING EVIDENCE THAT BODILY HARM WAS INTENDED, AND THAT THERE WAS LOCAL ANTI-AMERICAN SUPPORT FOR THE ATTACK. END SUMMARY.

AT 2045 LOCAL 9/17, MR. CHARLES LOIW, MAINTENANCE CHIEF AT A BELL HELICOPTER INTERNATIONAL(BHI) ESTABLISHMENT IN ISFAHAN, HEARD THE SOUND OF HIS FRONT DOOR BEING TRIED. THE DOOR WAS LOCKED, BUT HE WENT TO INVESTIGATE. HE FOUND HIS STAIRWELL AND FRONT DOOR ABLAZE. HE SUCCEEDED IN EXTINGUISHING THE FIRE, AND WENT DOWNSTAIRS TO FIND HIS LANDLORD FIGHTING A FIRE IN HIS (LOW'S AUTO). THAT FIRE WAS ALSO PUT OUT, AND THE CAR WAS PUSHED OUTSIDE TO AVOID THE DANGER OF FURTHER FIRE. THERE WAS A LARGE CROWD GATHERED OUTSIDE, WHO DID NOT OFFER TO ASSIST.

LOW'S WIFE ASSERTS THAT IN THE CROWD SHE SAW A SIGN READING IN POOR ENGLISH"YANKEE GO HOME" PLUS WRITING IN FARSI. MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES, INCLUDING EVENTUALLY THE MARTIAL LAW GOVERNOR, GEN. NAJI, RESPONDED SWIFTLY TO THE CALL, AND ARE INVESTIGATING THOROUGHLY. THEY ARE TAKING THE MATTER SERIOUSLY AND ARE CONSIDERING PLACING MILITARY GUARDS ON AT LEAST SOME BHI RESIDENCES IN THE CITY.

MR. LOW REPORTS THAT HE HAS HAD GOOD RAPPORT WITH HIS NEIGHBORS OVER SEVERAL YEARS. ON 9/17, A NEIGHBOR BOY HAD THROWN ROCKS AT HIS CAR, AND HE HAD SPOKEN STERNLY TO THE BOY'S PARENTS, BUT HE ATTACHES NO SIGNIFICANCE TO THE MATTER. HIS AUTO AND FRONT DOOR ARE INSIDE A LATCHED GATE, BUT HE REPORTS THAT IT IS EASY TO OPEN FROM THE OUTSIDE.

QUESTIONING HAS INDICATED THAT THERE WERE TWO MALE ATTACKERS, WITH THREE DEVICES-TWO STANDARD MOLOTOV COCKTAIL TYPE, ONE PERHAPS A CRUDE (AND UNSUCCESSFUL) ATTEMPT TO CREATE A FRAGMENTATION DEVICE (GAS PLUS GRAVEL). A PRINTED PARTIALLY BURNED NOTICE IN FARSI WAS FOUND AT THE SITE AND TAKEN BY POLICE, BUT NOTHING IS KNOWN YET OF ITS MESSAGE.
BHI HAS NOTIFIED ITS EMPLOYEES OF THE INCIDENT, AND URGED CALM, BUT REPORTS THAT SOME EMPLOYEES ARE ALREADY DEMANDING TO BE SENT HOME. THE AMERICAN COMMUNITY AT LARGE IS DEEPLY DISTURBED.

THE ATTEMPT TO OPEN THE FRONT DOOR, WITH ITS IMPLICATION OF A DESIRE TO THROW A BOMB INSIDE, WITH INJURY OR DEATH A LIKELY RESULT, PLUS THE APPARENT, THOUGH UNCONFIRMED, PRESENCE OF AN ANTI-AMERICAN SIGN TOLERATED BY THE LARGE CROWD, HAS SERIOUS IMPLICATIONS. ALL PREVIOUS FIRE-BOMB ATTACKS HERE HAVE BEEN CAREFULLY DESIGNED TO AVOID DANGER TO PERSONS. THIS IS THE FIRST REPORT OF ANY KIND OF PUBLIC ACCEPTANCE OF ANTI AMERICANISM ASSOCIATED WITH AN ATTACK. ON 8/15 THERE WERE REPORTS OF GENERAL ANTI-FOREIGN PAMPHLETS DISTRIBUTED PRIOR TO A ROCK ATTACK ON APARTMENTS OCCUPIED BY ITALIANS.

THERE HAS BEEN ONE BOMB (AT THIS CONSULATE) ONE FIRE BOMB ATTACK (9/14) ON AN AMERICAN COMPANIES MOTOR POOL, ONE AUTO BURNING, SOME TIRE SLASHINGS (ALL WITHOUT WARNINGS OR SIGNS) AND THERE HAVE BEEN A LARGE NUMBER OF TELEPHONED OR WRITTEN THREATS TO AMERICANS OR AMERICAN PREMISES, BUT NONE OF THESE HAS BEEN FOLLOWED UP BY AN ATTACK. THIS IS THE FIRST TIME THESE ELEMENTS HAVE COME TOGETHER WITH THE ADDED POSSIBILITY OF INTENT TO INJURE OR KILL. AS AMERICANS ARE SCATTERED THROUGHOUT THE CITY AND SUBURBS, THERE IS NO EFFECTIVE WAY TO PROTECT THEM IF ELEMENTS IN THE CITY HAVE DECIDED TO TARGET AMERICANS SPECIFICALLY.

THIS ATTACK AS ALMOST ALL OTHERS, OCCURRED AFTER DARK BUT BEFORE CURFEW WHILE STREETS ARE STILL CROWDED BUT VISIBILITY IS MINIMAL . BUT ANY INCREASE IN CURFEW HOURS HOWEVER WOULD CREATE WIDESPREAD RESENTMENT AND INCREASE THE POSSIBILITY OF ATTACK.

I DO NOT THINK ANTI-AMERICANISM IS WIDESPREAD HERE, BUT IT EXISTS AND IS GAINING ADHERENTS. THEY DO NOT HAVE TO BE NUMEROUS TO BE SUCCESSFUL, AND DO NOT EVEN HAVE TO BE SUCCESSFUL TO FRIGHTEN AMERICANS. IF THE PUBLIC HOLDS ITSELF MERELY NEUTRAL, RATHER THAN ACTIVELY PROTECTING AMERICANS, AS HAS BEEN DONE RECENTLY, THE SITUATION BECOMES DANGEROUS.

1978ISFAHA00110.subject: THE SHAH'S BIRTHDAY IN ISFAHAN: FIRE AND RIOT

segments.text: SUMMARY: THE WEEK PRIOR TO OCT . 26 , THE SHAH'S BIRTHDAY, WAS MARKED IN ISFAHAN BY A RISING TIDE OF DEFIANCE, DEMONSTATIONS, VIOLENCE, ANTI-AMERICAN SENTIMENTS AND INCIDENTS, AND A PERVASIVE FEAR. THESE PEAKED ON THE EVENING OF OCT. 25, AND TRAILED OFF, EXCEPT FOR THE FEAR, BY OCT. 29. LEADERSHIP OF THE PROTEST FELL TO HIGH SCHOOL STUDENTS, WHO EXHIBITED REMARKABLE ORGANIZATION AND DISCIPLINE. CONFRONTATIONS ON OCT. 25 AND 26 RESULTED IN SOME DEATHS, AND FURTHER DEMONSTRATIONS ARE GENERALLY EXPECTED.

SEVERAL WEEKS OF LOW-LEVEL PROTESTS, PRIMARILY ON HIGHSCHOOL GROUNDS CHANGED TO CONFRONTATION AND VIOLENCE ON OCT. 21 WITH THE ARREST OF TWO TEACHERS ALLEGEDLY "RINGLEADERS" OF THE STUDENT DEMONSTRATIONS. ON THE 21ST, THE STUDENTS LEFT THEIR GROUNDS, CHALLENGED MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES, AND WERE BEATEN. THAT NIGHT, THE CAR OF THE POLICE CHIEF OF AN ISFAHAN SUBURB, HOMAYOUNSHAHR, WAS DESTROYED BY A BOMB.

(NO INJURIES) A NUMBER OF SCHOOLS HAD WINDOWS BROKEN, STONES WERE THROWN AT PASSING VEHICLES, AND THE VARIOUS HIGH SCHOOL LEADERS MET AND PREPARED A LIST OF DEMANDS - INCLUDING THE NON-CELEBRATION OF THE SHAH'S BIRTHDAY, REMOVAL OF HIS PICTURE AND ITS REPLACEMENT BY KHOMEINI'S PICTURE, AND THE RELEASE OF THE ARRESTED TEACHERS. THE STUDENTS WITHIN TWO DAYS WERE ORGANIZING MARCHES OF OVER 1000 PERSONS, AND WERE COURTING MARTYRDOM. AUTHORITIES RESPONDED WITH RESTRAINT, BUT STEADILY INCREASING FORCE. ON OCT. 25, A MORNING DEMONSTRATION IN THE BAZAAR RESULTED IN SHOOTING, AND A CLAIM OF DEATHS BY THE STEDENTS. ALL HIGH-SCHOOLS WERE ORDERED CLOSED AND GUARDED BY THE MILITARY.

AFTER A FAIRLY QUIET DAY, A CROWD ASSEMBLED IN THE MAIN SQUARE, IN FRONT OF MARTIAL LAW HEADQUARTERS, TO PROTEST THE PRESUMED DEATHS THAT MORNING. U.S. SECURITY OFFICIALS WHO WITNESSED THE SCENE ESTIMATED THE CROWD AT ITS PEAK AT APPROXIMATELY 7,000. ATTEMPTS BY THE MILITARY TO DISPERSE THE CROWD WITH TEAR-GAS FAILED, AND A CONSIDERABLE QUANTITY OF SMALL-ARMS FIRE WAS HEARD FOR OVER AN HOUR. THE CROWD SCATTERED TO SURROUNDING STREETS, AND SHOOTING WAS HEARD OVER A WIDE AREA. EYEWITNESSES CLAIM TO HAVE SEEN AT LEAST FIVE PERSONS KILLED, AND ONE SOURCE, A SOLDIER, STATED THAT, IN HIS AREA, MORE THAN TWENTY-FIVE PERSONS WERE KILLED.

ON HOSPITAL IN ISFAHAN TREATED BETWEEN FIFTY AND SIXTY PERSONS WITH BULLET WOUNDS, AND OTHER HOSPITALS, DELIBERATELY KEEPING NO RECORDS, STATED ONLY THAT THEY TREATED MANY. AUTHORITIES DENY KNOWLEDGE OF ANY DEATHS, AND STATE THE SOLDIERS WERE INSTRUCTED TO SHOOT TO WOUND, ONLY. ON THURSDAY, THE TOWN SAW NUMEROUS SMALL DEMONSTRATIONS, ESPCIALLY IN THE CONSERVATIVE SECTIONS OF TOWN. A CONSULATE STAFF MEMBER OBSERVED ONE BODY, AND THERE ARE INDICATIONS THAT AT LEAST ANOTHER FIVE WERE KILLED. AUTHORITIES ADMIT USE OF MACHINE GUNS AND, IN ONE CASE, 155MM CANNON, BUT AGAIN STATE NO ONE WAS KILLED- THAT THE FIRING WAS INTO THE AIR.
FRIDAY SAW ONLY A FEW SCATTERED INCIDENTS AND DEMONSTRATIONS, WHILE SATURDAY AND SUNDAY WERE BASICALLY CALM.

DURING THIS PERIOD, DESTRUCTIVE INCIDENTS OCCURRED AT THE SAME TIME AS, BUT SEPARATELY FROM THE MAJOR DEMONSTRATIONS. IN MOST CASES, THESE INCIDENTS WERE THE WORK OF INDIVIDUALS OR SMALL GROUPS. ON OCT. 24, FOUR BANKS WERE BURNED, A BEER DISTRIBUTOR AND A YOUTH HOSTEL WERE DESTROYED ON THE 25TH, ANOTHER BANK AND A CLOSED "AMERICAN" GAMBLING CLUB WERE BURNED ON THE 26TH, AND A RESTAURANT WAS VANDALIZED, AND ON THE 27TH, THE SAME RESTAURANT WAS BOMBED.

EXCEPT FOR THE YOUTH HOTEL, WHICH WAS ATTACKED BY APPROXIMATELY 50-60 YOUNG MEN OUTOF A MOB OF SEVERAL HUNDRED, THE INCIDENTS WERE ALL SNEAK, HIT-AND-RUN EVENTS SIMULTANEOUS TO BUT IN DIFFERENT SECTIONS OF TOWN FROM THE DEMONSTRATIONS. SECURITY AUTHORITIES BELIEVE THEY WERE ALL COMMITTED BY A SINGLE DISTINCT GROUP OF COLLEGE STUDENTS. NEAE-00 EB-08 COME-00 ACDA-12 ( ISO ) W ------------------042974 072229Z /73/45 FM AMCONSUL ISFAHAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 57 INFO AMEMBASSY TEHRAN AMCONSUL SHIRAZ AMCONSUL TABRIZ SECTION 2 OF 2 ISFAHAN 0110

ANTI-AMERICAN INCIDENTS ALSO OCCURRED DISTINCTLY FROM THE MAIN DEMONSTRATIONS. THE U.S. COMMUNITY HAD BEEN TRAUMATIZED BY THE WIDE-SPREAD AND WIDELY-BELIEVED REPORT THAT DISSIDENT GROUPS PLANNED A MASS SLAUGHTER OF AMERICANS TO COMMEMORATE THE SHAH'S BIRTHDAY, AND TENDED TO REACT WITH PANIC TO ACTUAL INCIDENTS. ON THE MINOR INCIDENTS BY INADVERTANTELY STUMBING ON MOBS. THERE WERE NO INJURIES AND NO DAMAGE, BUT THE NEXT DAY THERE WAS ALMOST 60 PERCENT ABSENTEEISM AT THE SCHOOL. ON THE 23RD AND 24TH, THE DUPON JOINT VENTURE, POLYACRYL IRAN, RECEIVED THREATS; A ROCK WAS THROWN INTO AN EMPLOYEES RESIDENCE, AND THE MANAGER RECEIVED A TELEPHONED THREAT ON HIS LIFE.

THE ATTACK ON THE YOUTH HOSTEL, OCCUPIED BY SOME 20 FOREIGNERS, INCLUDING SEVEN AMERICANS, WAS APPARENTLY AN ATTACK ON PROPERTY, AS NO RESIDENTS WERE INJURED, BUT WAS PERCEIVED AS AT ATTEMPT ON THE LIVES OF THE AMERICANS. REPORTEDLY, TWO MEMBERS OF THE MOB WERE SEVERELY INJURED OR KILLED BY TWO FOREIGNERS THERE DURING THE ATTACK. THE ATTACKS ON THE RESTAURANT IS PERCEIVED BY THE U.S. COMMUNITY AS CAUSED BY THE AMERICAN PATRONAGE OF THAT RESTAURANT. AN AMERICAN'S CAR WAS VANDALIZED (TIRES SLASHED/WINDOWS BROKEN), AND THE COMMUNITY REACTION WAS THAT THIS WAS A MERE SUBSTITUTE FOR THE UNAVAILABLE AMERICAN.

ONLY ONE ADDITIONAL AMERICAN FAMILY IS REPORTED LEAVING AFTER THIS WEEKEND, BUT BELL HELICOPTER INTERNATIONAL, THE LARGEST U.S. COMPANY HERE, IS FEARING A CONTINUED OUT-FLOW. TO DATE, THEY HAVE LOST 51 EMPLOYEES AND 96 FAMILIES OF DEPENDENTS, AND IT COULD CLIMB MUCH HIGHER IF THE LEVEL OF FEAR IS NOW SOMEHOW REDUCED.

COMMENT: IT APPEARS THAT THE GROWING SUCCESS AND ORGANIZATION OF THE DEMONSTRATIONS WAS PREDICATED ON CONTINUED RESTRAINT IN THE USE OF FORCE BY THE AUTHORITIES. THE CROWDS FACED NIGHT-STICKS AND TEAR-GAS WITH DEFIANCE AND OFTEN ROCKS, AND IGNORED SHOTS FIRED IN THE AIR. OBSERVERS STATED THAT STUDENT CROWDS ACTED LIKE DISCIPLINED SOLDIERS IN CONFRONTING AUTHORITIES. SHORTLY AFTER THE FIRST CASUALTIES IN THE MAIN SQUARE, HOWEVER, THE DEMONSTRATORS WERE FLEEING IN BLIND PANIC, WHICH APPEARED TO EMBOLDEN THE SOLDIERS. THE AUTHORITIES INSIST ON ONLY ONE DEATH- REPORTEDLY A BOMB-MAKER BLOWN UP IN HIS HOME MAKING A BOMB-BUT THERE IS SUFFICIENT EVIDENCE TO INDICATE DEATHS IN THE 20 TO 30 RANGE.

THE LACK OF ORGANIZED PROTEST ON FRIDAY AND SATURDAY HAS NOW GIVEN WAY TO NEW PEACEFUL STRIKES, WHICH COULD EASILY SPREAD AGAIN TO LARGE PROTESTS, ESPECIALLY AS THE FACTS OF THE DEATHS ARE SHARED AND KNOWN. POLICE AUTHORITIES ARE NERVOUS ABOUT PROBABLE SEVENTH - AND FORTIETH-DAY DEMONSTRATIONS (NOV. 01 AND DEC 4.) ALTHOUGH MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES DISCOUNT THE POSSIBILITY. IT ALSO APPEARS THAT THE MAIN PROTEST WAS BASICALLY PEACEFUL AND ANTI-REGIME, ALTHOUGH SPLINTER GROUPS WERE INVOLVED IN VIOLENCE AND ANTI-AMERICAN ACTIVITIES. THE AMERICAN COMMUNITY, UNFORTUNATELY, FINDS ITSELF UNABLE TO DISTINGUISH BETWEEN DIFFERENT FACTIONS, AND SEES THE ENTIRE IRANIAN POPULATION AS A THREAT.

RUMOR IS BECOMING INCREASINGLY EFFECTIVE AGAINST AMERICANS, AND THE CURRENT OUTFLOW COULD EASILY BECOMEAN UNOFFICIAL EVACUATION. BOTH COMPANY OFFICIALS AND IRANIAN OFFICIALS INCREASINGLY SEE THE MOVEMENT OF THE ENTIRE AMERICAN POPULATION INTO GUARDED "U.S. GHETTOS" AS THE ONLY SOLUTION TO THE DANGER OF RANDOM VIOLENCE. THEY ARE MAKING THIS DETERMINATION, HOWEVER, WITHOUT THE CAPABILITY OF RAPIDLY HOUSING LARGE NUMBERS. THEREFORE, EMPLOYEES IN TOWN ARE MADE TO FEEL THEIR COMPANIES CONSIDER THEM IN DANGER, RESULTING IN EVEN MORE FEAR. THE LEVEL OF FEAR REMAINS HIGH, AND MOST AMERICANS FEEL THREATENED. A SINGLE INCIDENT INVOLVING SERIOUS INJURY OR DEATH FORAN AMERICAN COULD RESULT IN A MASS EXODUS FROM ISFAHAN.
THE CONSULATE, THE SECURITY COMMITTEE, IRANIAN AUTHORITIES, AND THE COMPANIES ARE DOING WHAT IS POSSIBLE TO PREVENT THIS.

1978ISLAMA05019.subject: PRESS REPORTS IRANIAN PRIMIN SAYS NO AID TO PAKISTAN IF BHUTTO EXECUTED

segments.text: BHUTTO EXECUTED

THE PAK URDU PRESS IS CARRYING A BBC STORY WHICH SAYS THAT IRANIAN PRIMIN/FONMIN TOLD AN INTERVIEWER THAT IRAN WILL STOP ALL ASSISTANCE TO PAKISTAN IF THE DEATH SENTENCE AGAINST FORMER PAK PRIMIN BHUTTO IS CARRIED OUT. ACCORDING TO THE STORY, THE SHAH HAS HELD UP ALL DECISIONS ON ASSISTANCE TO PAKISTAN, AND IS "PUTTING PRESSURE" ON THE GOP TO COMMUTE BHUTTO'S SENTENCE.
WE WOULD APPRECIATE EMBASSY TEHRAN'S COMMENT AND A TEXT OF THE INTERVIEW IF AVAILABLE.

1978ISLAMA05100.subject: BBC ACCOUNT OF IRANIAN PM COMMENTS AROUSE RESENTMENT

segments.text: THE ALLEGED REMARKS BY IRANIAN PRIMIN, AS REPORTED ON MAY 19 BY THE BBC, THAT IRAN WOULD CUT OFF ALL ECONOMIC AID TO PAKISTAN IF FORMER PM BHUTTO'S DEATH SENTENCE IS CARRIED OUT HAS EVOKED WIDESPREAD SHOCK AND ANGER HERE. LEADING CONSERVATIVE URDU DAILY NAWA-I-WAQT, IN A STRONGLY-WORDED EDITORIAL, TERMED THE REMARKS "UNBELIEVABLE" AND "CRUDE" AND DEMANDED THAT FOREIGN ADVISER AGHA SHAHI CLARIFY THE NATURE OF HIS RECENT TALKS IN TEHRAN.

SHAHI'S RESPONSE, REPRINTED IN ENGLISH IN THE MAY 22 EDITION OF THE PAPER, WAS THAT HE HAD DISCUSSED MATTERS OF MUTUAL INTEREST WITH THE IRANIANS, INCLUDING AID, BUT THAT BHUTTO'S FATE HAD NOT BEEN RAISED DURING HIS TALKS. HE ALSO INDICATED THAT PAKISTAN'S AMBASSADOR TO IRAN HAD BEEN RECALLED TO ISLAMABAD FOR CONSULTATIONS AND THAT THE GOP HAD ASKED THE IRANIAN EMBASSY FOR A CLARIFICATION OF THE REPORTED INTERVIEW.

CLARIFICATION ACTUALLY CAME ON MAY 21 WHEN THE IRANIAN AMBASSADOR REPORTEDLY CALLED ON FONSEC SHAHNAWAZ -- ON INSTRUCTIONS -- TO CONVEY THE VIEW THAT THE STATEMENT OF THE IRANIAN PRIMIN AS BROADCAST BY THE BBC WAS INCORRECT. ALL PAPERS CARRIED THIS SOMEWHAT STILTED FORMULATION, WITH NO FURTHER AMPLIFICATION ON MAY 22; THE URDU LANGUAGE JANG, FOR ONE, CHARACTERIZED THE CLARIFICATION AS INSUFFICIENT, URGING THE SHAH TO ISSUE A "SATISFACTORY DENIAL." THE ISSUE IS THUS STILL ALIVE HERE, HOWEVER HAPPILY IT MAY BE RESOLVED IN TEHRAN (REFTEL).

COMMENT: THE CLARIFICATION WILL SERVE TO TAKE A LOT OF THE HEAT OUT OF THE ISSUE FOR THE IRANIANS HERE, BUT THE EPISODE -EVEN IF IT IS FULLY EXPLAINED AWAY -- SIMPLY ADDS TO THE RESERVOIR OF SUSPICION AND RESENTMENT WHICH MANY PAKS ALREADY HARBOR ABOUT IRAN AND ITS RULERS. WHATEVER ITS CONSEQUENCES FOR IRAN-PAK RELATIONS, THE INCIDENT WILL GIVE FRESH AMMUNITION TO THE GOP IN ITS LONG BATTLE WITH THE BBC, AND WITH BRITISH NEWS MEDIA IN GENERAL, OVER WHAT THE PAKS REGARD AS ANTI-PAKISTAN BIAS.

MY DEFENSE REPRESENTATIVE HAD A CONVERSATION WITH A PAK JCS STAFF OFFICER MAY 26 WHO HAD ACCOMPANIED JCS CHAIRMAN GENERAL SHARIFF ON HIS RECENT VISIT TO TEHRAN. THE STAFF OFFICER SAID THAT THE SHAH APPEARED "FRIGHTENED AND UPSET" AND "NO LONGER EXUDED CONFIDENCE." THE SHAH WAS DESCRIBED AS BEWILDERED, AND UNABLE TO UNDERSTAND "WHY HIS PEOPLE WERE TURNING AGAINST HIM."
THIS, OF COURSE, MATCHES OBSERVATIONS YOU HAVE MADE AND IT IS OF INTEREST THAT SENIOR PAK MILITARY OFFICERS HAVE COME AWAY WITH SIMILAR IMPRESSIONS AND ARE SPREADING THEM HERE.
REGARDS.

THE GOP, ON JUNE 6, ANNOUNCED ITS AGREMENT TO THE APPOINTMENT OF GEN. NEMATULLAH NASSIRI AS IRANIAN AMBASSADOR TO PAKISTAN. PRESS ARTICLES REPORTING THIS APPOINTMENT ON JUNE 7 NOTE PROMINENTLY THAT GEN. NASSIRI IS CURRENTLY DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER AND CHIEF OF THE STATE NATIONAL SECURITY.
WE UNDERSTAND THAT THE CURRENT IRANIAN AMBASSADOR ZAND FARD, HOPES TO LEAVE ISLAMABAD IN ABOUT TWO WEEKS AND EXPECTS A EUROPEAN ASSIGNMENT.

1978ISLAMA06475.subject: DRA FONMIN BBC INTERVIEW REMARKS RE TREATIES

segments.text: WE NOTE REFTEL REFERENCE TO "BORDER AGREEMENT" BETWEEN AFGHANISTAN AND PAKISTAN TO WHICH -- ACCORDING TO BBC INTERVIEWER WHITELY -- DRA FONMIN AMIN REFERRED IN HIS REMARKS ABOUT DRA REVIEW OF EXISTING TREATIES/AGREEMENTS, ETC. WE KNOW OF NO AGREEMENT, UNLESS DRA HAS FOUND, PERHAPS, A DRAFT OF AN AGREEMENT BEING WORKED UP BY FORMER AFGHAN REGIME AS PART OF ITS TALKS WITH GOP.
FOR KAUIL: DOES REF TO "BORDER AGREEMENT" RING ANY BELL WITH YOU?
FOR TEHRAN: WOULD APPRECIATE WHATEVER ELSE YOU CAN DRAW OUT OF WHITELY ON THIS SUBJECT IN SUBSEQUENT DISCUSSIONS WITH HIM.

FYI: PRESS HERE JULY 2 CARRIED QUOTES FROM RADIO KABUL SAYING AMIN TOLD BBC INTERVIEWER AFGHAN GOVT. NOT BOUND BY ANY AGREEMENTS NEGOTIATED BY PREVIOUS REGIME AND ALLUDING SPECIFICALLY ONLY TO HELMAND RIVER TREATY. ALSO PLAYED UP AFGHAN DESIRE TO SETTLE PUSHTUNISTAN ISSUE WITH PAKISTAN THROUGH NEGOTIATION. JULY 4 PRESS ARTICLE DATELINED PESHAWAR QUOTES RADIO KABUL, HOWEVER, AS HAVING DENIED AMIN MADE ANY SUCH STATEMENTS TO BBC REPORTER.

1978ISLAMA08728.subject: CMLA ANNOUNCES SHORT VISITS TO KABUL AND TEHRAN

segments.text: GOVERNMENT CONTROLLED PAKISTAN TIMES CARRIES SHORT STORY SETPTEMBER 8 REPORTING CMLA GENERAL ZIA'S SEPTEMBER 9 DEPARTURE FOR TEHRAN. THE ARTICLE ALSO ANNOUNCES THAT THE CMLA HAS DECIDED TO STOP EN ROUTE IN KABUL FOR A FOUR-HOUR "UNOFFICIAL" VISIT TO THE AFGHAN CAPITAL.

THE ARTICLE STATES GENERAL ZIA WILL BE ACCOMPANIED BY FINANCE MINISTER GHULAM ISHAQ KHAN, SHIPPING MINISTER MUSTAFA GOKAL, FOREIGN AFFAIRS ADVISOR AGHA SHAHI, FOREIGN SECRETARY SHAHNAWAZ AND THE CMLA'S CHIEF OF STAFF MAJ. GEN. K.M. ARIF.
THE VISIT TO IRAN IS LABELED "A FRIENDLY INFORMAL TWO-DAY VISIT." THE STOP IN KABUL IS SAID TO BE FOR TALKS BETWEEN THE CMLA AND CHAIRMAN OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL, NOOR MOHAMMED TARAKI.

COMMENT THIS OFFICIAL ANNOUNCEMENT IS THE FIRST HINT WE HAVE HAD THAT THE CMLA WAS PLANNING TO STOP IN KABUL. IT COMES AT A PARTICULARLY SENSITIVE TIME IN AFGHAN/PAK RELATIONS AS THE SUSPICIONS ON THE PART OF THE AFGHANS AS TO PAK ACTIVITIES IN SUPPORTING BORDER TROUBLE IN THE NORTH WEST FRONTIER AREA HAVE NOT MEASURABLY ABATED. PAK FOREIGN SECRETARY SHAHNAWAZ HAD PREVIOUSLY ASSURED US OF THE GOP'S INTENTIONS TO PURSUE BETTER RELATIONS (REFTEL), BUT HAD INDICATED THE OPENING TO MORE CORDIALITY WOULD BE A VISIT TO KABUL BY THE GOP MINISTER OF COMMERCE. THE CMLA'S VISIT, THEN, REPRESENTS A QUANTUM LEAP IN THE PROCESS
THE GOP ANNOUNCED OCTOBER 20 THAT ALI ARSHAD, PRESENTLY PAKISTAN'S AMBASSADOR TO AFGHANISTAN, HAS BEEN APPOINTED AMBASSADOR TO IRAN.
BIO DATA IS CONTAINED IN BIO BRIEF CR M 76-13062 OF JULY 21, 1976. OUR FILES SHOW THAT ARSHAD WAS PAK AMBASSADOR TO GHANA BEFORE HIS 1971-1972 STINT AS MFA CHIEF OF PROTOCOL.
EMBASSY KABUL MAY HAVE MORE TO ADD ON ARSHAD'S

1978ISLAMA11698.subject: BALUCHI LEADER BIZENJO VOICES SUPPORT FOR IRANIAN DISSIDENTS

segments.text: IN COMMENT SURE TO BE UNWELCOME IN TEHRAN BUT LIKELY TO BE POPULAR WITH BALUCHIS, MIR GHAUS BIZENJO, AN IMPORTANT BALUCHI LEADER NOW AFFILIATED WITH ALI KHAN'S NATIONAL DEMOCRATIC PARTY (NDP), WAS QUOTED IN THE URDU PRESS 28 NOV. AS SAYING THE IRANIAN PEOPLE WILL CONTINUE TO ENJOY THE BACKING OF THE BALUCHI PEOPLE IN THEIR STRUGGLE. HE DENIED THAT THIS WAS A PARTY POSITION, INDICATING THAT THE NDP DOES NOT BELIEVE IN INTERFERING IN THE INTERNAL AFFAIRS OF IRAN AND AFGHANISTAN.

COMMENT: UNTIL NOW, PAKISTANI POLITICAL LEADERS HAVE BEEN QUITE RESERVED IN THEIR PUBLIC COMMENTS ON THE IRANIAN TURMOIL, BIZENJO, HOWEVER, IS HIGHLY CONTROVERSIAL, A LONER, AND AN ANTI-AUTHORITY FIGURE, WHO FREQUENTLY SPEAKS HIS MIND WITHOUT CONSIDERATION OF THE WIDER EFFECT. WE EXPECT HIS REMARKS, IF ACCURATELY QUOTED--AND THE TEXT IS POORLY REPORTED BY NAWA-I-WAQT'S HYDERABAD CORRESPONDENT-WILL CREATE A BIT OF A HORNET'S NEST ELSEWHERE IN PAKISTAN WHERE THERE IS LITTLE SUPPORT FOR THE ANTISHAH FORCES AND MUCH ANXIETY ABOUT THE FUTURE OF IRAN.

MR. O'GAFFNEY ARRIVED IN ISTANBUL THE EVENING OF DEC. 14. THE CONSULATE ARRANGED HIS HOTEL ACCOMODATIONS IN ISTANBUL AND PERMITTED HIM TO PARK HIS MOTORCYCLE AND TRAILER IN THE COMPOUND. MR. O'GAFFNEY DISCUSSED HIS TRAVEL PLANS WITH A CONSULAR OFFICER ON DEC. 15. THE CONSULAR OFFICER WARNED HIM THAT TRAVEL THROUGH IRAN AT THIS TIME COULD BE VERY DANGEROUS. HE SUGGESTED THAT MR. O'GAFFNEY TAKE AN ALTERNATE ROUTE OR DEFER THE TRIP UNTIL IRAN WAS CALMER. MR. O'GAFFNEY STATED THAT HE WAS AWARE OF THE RISKS BUT THAT HE WISHED TO CONTINUE HIS TRIP THROUGH IRAN.
ICA HELPED MR. O'GAFFNCY TO HOLD A PRESS CONFERENCE IN FRONT OF THE BLUS MOSQUE ON DEC. 15. SEVERAL PAPERS CARRIED STORIES ABOUT HIS TRIP.
MR. O'GAFFNEY LEFT ISTANBUL ABOUT MIDNIGHT DEC. 17 FOR ANKARA.

1978KABUL03282.subject: STATUS OF FOREIGN NATIONALS IN AFGHANISTAN

AMBASSADOR MALIKYAR'S DAUGHTER GULALAI REMAINS IN JAMHURIAT HOSPITAL AND HAS UNDERGONE SURGERY FOR HER WOUNDS. SHE IS REPORTEDLY OUT OF DANGER, BUT THE PROGNOSIS CONCERNING ANY LASTING EFFECTS OF HER WOUNDS IS NOT YET CLEAR. LEILA MALIKYAR WAS AT HOME DURING THE COUP AND IS UNHARMED REPEAT UNHARMED.

IN THE PRESENT ENVIRONMENT, AND FOR THEIR OWN SAFETY, WE ARE EXTREMELY WARYOF APPROACHING ANY AFGHAN, ESPECIALLY ANY WHOSE FAMILIES WERE CLOSELY ASSOCIATED WITH THE FORMER REGIME. THEREFORE, WE ARE RELUCTANT TO BECOME DIRECTLY INVOLVED IN ESTABLISHING COMMUNICATIONS BETWEEN AMBASSADOR MALIKYAR AND HIS DAUGHTERS, ALTHOUGH WE COULD PERHAPS PASS INFORMATION THROUGH INTERMEDIARIES OF THE AMBASSADOR'S CHOICE.

PLEASE ONCE AGAIN CONVEY TO THE AMBASSADOR AND HIS WIFE MY WIFE'S AND MY SINCEREST SYMPATHIES IN THIS PERSONAL TRAGEDY, AND REASSURE HIM THAT WE WILL DO EVERYTHING WE CAN TO ASSIST THEM TO REESTABLISH THEIR LIVES WHEREVER THEY MAY CHOOSE.

1978KABUL04069.subject: AFGHAN REGIME DISPLAYS SENSITIVITY OVER HUMAN RIGHTS CRITICISM

segments.text: SUMMARY: THE NEW AFGHAN REGIME HAS REACTED TESTILY TO INTERNATIONAL CRITICISM OF THE INCLUSION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN AMONG THE POLITICAL PRISONERS IT IS HOLDING. END OF SUMMARY.

ON MAY 17, AN AFGHAN GOVERNMENT SPOKESMAN LASHED OUT AT "SOME FOREIGN REACTIONARY CIRCLES WHO SAVAGELY TRAMPLE HUMAN RIGHTS AND INTEGRITY, ENGAGE IN FAKE AND POISONOUS PROPAGANDA IN AN INTRIGUING MANNER AGAINST THE UNPRECEDENTED LIBERATING REVOLUTION OF THE PEOPLE OF AFGHANISTAN, AND, AMONG OTHER THINGS, SAY THAT THE DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF AFGHANISTAN (DRA) HAS TREATED, OR TREATS, THE WOMEN AND CHILDREN OF THE NADERI DYNASTY (E.EMN THE FORMER ROYAL INEAGE) IN A WAY THAT IS CONTRARY TO HUMAN RIGHTS."

THE STATEMENT ASSERTED THAT "DURING THE GREAT REVOLUTION OF SAUR 7 (APRIL 17), A TOTAL OF FORTY PERSONS WERE KILLED (ON MAY 6, CHAIRMAN NOOR MOHAMMAD TARAKI TOLD THE INTERNATIONAL PRESS THAT 72 OR 73 WERE KILLED), INCLUDING TEN MEMBERS OF THE NADERI DYNASTY, WHO LOST THEIR LIVES AS A RESULT OF THE ORGANIZED AND ANTI-NATIONAL RESISTANCE OF MOHAMMAD DAOUD, WHO . . .

NOT ONLY FIRED ON THE HEROIC OFFICER, WHO, WITH DUE CONSIDERATION TO MILITARY TRADITIONS, COMMUNICATED TO HIM THE MESSAGE OF THE LEADERSHIP OF THE REVOLUTION, BUT ALSO FIRED ON HIS CHILDREN, WHO, IN ORDER TO SURVIVE, BESSECHED HIM TO SURRENDER HIMSELF TO THE REVOLUTIONARIES." (TARAKI TOLD THE AMBASSADOR ON MY 6 THAT THE DAOUD FAMILY, INCLUDING SOME WOMEN, ENGAGED IN A FIERCE SHOOT-OUT WITH ARRESTING TROOPS.)

THE SPOKESMAN ALSO NOTED THAT, " A SMALL NUMBER OF MEMBERS OF THE NADER AND DAOUD FAMILIES AND THEIR SHOE-LICKERS, WHO ARE IMPRISONED IN VIEW OF THEIR PROVOCATIVE AND ANTI-REVOLUTIONARY ACTIVITIES, WILL BE TRIED IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE LAW AT THE REVOLUTIONARY COURT." IN THIS CONNECTION, THE STATMENT ADDED: "A FEW CHILDREN AND WOMEN BELONGING TO THE NAER AND DAOUD FAMILIES ARE UNDER THE PROTECTION OF THE SECURITY FORCES ONLY FOR THE PRESERVATION OF THEIR LIVES WITH DUE CONSIDERATION TO HUMAN INTEGRITY AND HUMAN RIGHTS, WITHOUT INFLICTING UPON THEM THE SLIGHTEST PHYSICAL OR SPIRITUAL DAMAGE, AND APERTINENT DECISION WILL BE ADOPTED REGARDING THEM IN EXPEDIENT CIRCUMSTANCES."

COMMENT: ALTHOUGH WE CANNOT BE CERTAIN WHAT TOUCHED OFF THIS TESTY DRA BLAST, WE ARE AWARE THAT SOME LOCAL ISLAMIC AMBASSADORS (E.G., THE EGYPTIAN, THE SAUDI ARABIAN, AND THE BANGLADESHI) HAVE MADE HUMAN RIGHTS COMMENTS TO HIGH OFFICIALS OF THE NEW REGIME. (IN ONE PARTICULAR CASE OF SUCCESSFUL INTERCESSION FOR A SPECIFIC FAMILY, SAUDI ARABIAN AMBASSADOR SHAIKH ABDULLAH SALEH HABABI REMINDED TARAKI THAT AMONG MUSLIMS, JUSTICE IS IMPORTANT, BUT AN EVEN MORE IMPORTANT CONSIDERATION IS MERCY).

ADDITIONALLY, THE LOCAL DIPLOMATIC WIVES' ASSOCIATION HAS BEEN DISCUSSING A SPECIAL APPROACH TO THE SOLE FEMALE MEMBER OF THE NEW CABINET, DR.ANAHITA RATEBZAD, MINISTER FOR SOCIAL AFFAIRS, ASKING HER TO INTERCEDE IN BEHALF OF THE IMPRISONED WOMEN AND CHILDREN. THE WIVES HAVE NOT YET AGREED ON A COURSE OF ACTION WHICH WOULD GAIN THE APPROVAL OF THEIR HUSBANDS AND GOVERNMENTS. ONE OF THEM, A YUGOSLAV, THOUGHT IT WOULD BE APPROPRIATE TO DISCUSS THE PROPOSAL WITH THE WIFE OF THE SOVIET AMBASSADOR, WHO IS DEAN OF THE DIPLOMATIC CORPS. THAT MAY HAVE BEEN THE CHANNEL THROUGH WHICH THE AFGHANS HEARD ABOUT THIS PROPOSED INTERCESSION.
WHATEVER THE CASE, THE DRA HAS REACTED WITH REMARKABLE SENSITIVITY.

OUR SOURCES, WHO HAVE BEEN RELIABLE SO FAR, INFORM US THAT GULALAI MALIKYAR REMAINS IN JAMHURIAT HOSPITAL, AND THAT SHE IS MAKING SATISFACTORY PROGRESS. AS NOTED EARLIER, LEILA MALIKYAR WAS NOT HARMED DURING THE FIGHTING, AND SHE REMAINS AT HOME. LEILA IS REPORTEDLY CAUTIOUS ABOUT VENTURING OUT OF THE HOUSE AND CONTACTING ANYONE.

DR. MOHAMMAD ANAS IS REPORTEDLY WELL AND LIVING AT THIS HOME. HE HAS BEEN RELIEVED OF HIS POSITION AT THE FORMER MINISTRY OF STATE, BUT WE HAVE HEARD OF NO OTHER ACTIONS HAVING BEEN TAKEN AGAINST HIM. IN THE PRESENT POLITICAL ENVIRONMENT IN THIS COUNTRY, FOR THEIR OWN WELL-BEING, WE ARE EXTREMELY RELUCTANT TO APPROACH ANY AFGHAN, OR TO INITIATE CONTACT WITH THEM IN ANY WAY. DR. ANAS, HOWEVER, IS AN OLD FRIEND OF MANY MISSION OFFICERS, AND WAS A FREQUENT VISITOR TO MANY OF THE ACTIVITIES AT THE AMERICAN CENTER.
THUS, THE OPPORTUNITY MAY ARISE AT SOME POINT TO PASS WORD TO HIM OF THE SENTIMENTS ATTACHED TO THE METRINKO LETTER.

1978KABUL04453.subject: AMBASSADOR MALIKYAR'S DAUGHTER TRANSFERRED FROM HOSPITAL TO PRISON

segments.text: A RELIABLE SOURCE HAS TOLD US THAT GULALAI MALIKYAR HAS BEEN TAKEN FROM JAMHURIAT HOSPITAL TO PUL-I-CHARKI PRISON, JUST OUTSIDE KABUL, WHERE MOST OF THE MOHAMMADZAI DETAINEES ARE BEING HELD. ACCORDING TO THIS SOURCE, GULALAI'S CONDITION HAS IMPROVED TO THE POINT THAT THIS TRANSFER DID NOT PRESENT ANY DANGER TO HER WELL BEING.

1978KABUL04497.subject: DUTCH RELATIONS WITH NEW AFGHAN REGIME

segments.text: THE AFGHAN MINISTRY OF PLANNING HAS RECENTLY TAKEN OVER THE NEW AFGHAN INSURANCE CO. BUILDING PREVIOUSLY OCCUPIED BY, INTER ALIA, THE HONORARY DUTCH CONSUL GENERAL, MR. BOERS, AND BY KLM. THE BUILDING IS ONE OF THE PRIME OFFICE BUILDINGS IN TOWN, AND IS STRATEGICALLY SITUATED BETWEEN THE FOREIGN MINISTRY AND THE PRIME MINISTRY. THUS, IT IS NOT SURPRISING THAT THE REGIME WOULD WANT TO HOUSE ONE OF ITS OWN MINISTRIES IN THAT LOCATION, ALTHOUGH THE AFGHAN BEHAVIOR TOWARD BOERS, WAS, JUDGING FROM HIS ACCOUNT, APPARENTLY UNNECESSARILY BRUSQUE AND OFFICIOUS.
BOERS HAS TOLD US THAT HE INTENDS TO SET UP NEW QUARTERS AT ANOTHER LOCATION IN SHAR-I-NAU WHERE KLM WILL ALSO HAVE ITS HEADQUARTERS.
ALL OF OUR SOURCES SAY THAT NEZAMUDDIN GHAZI HAS SUCCUMBED TO THE WOUNDS HE RECEIVED DURING THE APRIL 27 VIOLENCE AT THE PALACE.
PLEASE CONVEY TO AMBASSADOR MALIKYAR AND MEMBERS OF THE GHAZI FAMILY OUR DEEPEST SYMPATHIES OVER THIS ADDITIONAL PERSONAL TRAGEDY.
FOR NEW DELHI: THIS REGRETTABLE NEWS SHOULD BE CONVEYED TO GHAZI'S SON, MAHMUD GHAZI, WHO, ACCORDING TO THE LAST INFORMATION WE HAD, IS STUDYING IN NEW DELHI.

1978KABUL04906.subject: BROADCASTS REPORTING SHAH'S "DEMISE" WERE, IN FACT, HEARD BY SOME AFGHANS

segments.text: WE AGREE THAT THE WILD RUMORS CIRCULATING HERE TEN DAYS AGO AOUT THE SHAH'S OVERTHROW COULD HAVE STEMMED FROM SOVIET FUN AND GAMES (REFTEL A), ALTHOUGH WE WILL PROBABLY NEVER IDENTIFY THEIR ACTUAL SOURCE TO EVERYONE'S SATISFACTION. NEVERTHELESS, THE RADIO BROADCASTS WHICH WE REPORTED IN REFTEL B, AND WHICH PURPORTED TO EMANATE FROM IRAN, WERE HEARD BY AN FSL MISSION EMPLOYEE WHOSE PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITY IS TO MONITOR LOCAL AND FOREIGN RADIO PROGRAMMING.

AT THE TIME, HE SPECULATED THAT THE "RADIO TEHRAN" BROADCAST COULD HAVE COME FROM SOME SORT OF "MOBILE TRANSMITTER," A THEORY WHICH IS NOT INCOMPATIBLE WITH IRANIAN AMBASSADOR DAVOUDI'S OWN SPECULATION THAT AN AIRPLANE COULD HAVE BEEN THE SOURCE OF THESE EMISSIONS.

1978KABUL07045.subject: ASYLUM REQUEST BY FORMER AFGHAN/POLICE OFFICIAL SAYADI

segments.text: WE HAVE NO INFORMATION REGARDING THE BACKGROUND OF ABDUL GHAFOOR SAYADI. THE IRANIN MEDIA'S DESCRIPTION OF HIS PAST PARTY POSITION (PARA 2 OF REFTEL) IS NOT COMPLETELY CLEAR TO US, BUT WE PRESUME THAT HE MAY HAVE HELD SOME POSITION IN THE PREVIOUS REGIME'S FLEDGLING "PARTY OF THE NATIONAL REVOLUTION" IN KANDAHAR.

ALTHOUGH WE HAVE LITTLE INTEREST IN SAYADI'S PERSONAL STATUS, PER SE, THE MANNER IN WHICH THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT HANDLES THE CASE, AND ESPECIALLY THE MEDIA TREATMENT ACCORDED THE MATTER, COULD CONCEIVABLY PROVIDE SOME CLUES REGARDING FUTURE IRANIAN POSTURES TOWARD THIS REGIME.

1978KABUL07057.subject: DUPREE'S VIEWS ON THE NEW AFGHAN REGIME

segments.text: IN VIEW OF THE FACT THAT DUPREE SPOKE CONFIDENTIALLY TO OUR EMBASSY OFFICERS AS FELLOW AMERICANS AND PERSONAL FRIENDS, I DO NOT THINK WE SHOULD ALLOW HIS PERSONAL VIEWS TO BE PASSED OUTSIDE USG CIRCLES AT THIS TIME. ADDITIONALLY, DUPREE WAS RECALLING A CONVERSATION HE HAD HAD WITH AMIN SEVERAL YEARS AGO, LONG BEFORE THE LATTER ASSUMED HIS CURRENT RESPONSIBILITIES. TAKEN OUT OF ITS TIME CONTEXT, THE "KING-KILLER" PHRASE MIGHT ALARM THE SHAH UNNECESSARILY.

INCIDENTALLY, AMIN HAS STATED TO ME ON TWO RECENT OCCASIONS HIS APPRECIATION FOR IRAN'S FRIENDLY ATTITUDE TOWARD AFGHANISTAN. PERHAPS HE HOPED THAT WE WOULD REPEAT THAT POSITIVE VIEWPOINT TO THE SHAH.

1978KABUL09133.subject: ALI ARSHAD: PAKISTAN'S NEW AMBASSADOR TO TEHRAN

segments.text: PAKISTANI AMBASSADOR ALI ARSHAD HAS APPARENTLY PERFORMED HIS DUTIES ABLY AND WELL DURING HIS SEVERAL YEARS OF SERVICE IN AFGHANISTAN. HE TOOK A LEADING ROLE IN PROMOTING THE BRIEF 197678 RAPPROACHEMENT BETWEEN PAKISTAN AND AFGHANISTAN OVER THE PUSHTUNISTAN ISSUE. AFTER THE AFGHAN REVOLUTION OF APRIL 27 BROUGHT TO POWER A REGIME WITH A MUCH HARDER LINE REGARDING PUSHTUNISTAN, ARSHAD AND HIS STAFF HAVE SOUGHT, WITH SOME SUCCESS, TO KEEP THE DOOR OPEN TO THE POSSIBILITY OF FURTHER DISCUSSIONS, AND TO PRESERVE WHAT REMAINS OF THE PREVIOUS EFFORTS TO REACH AN ACCOMMODATION ON THIS ISSUE.
HIS TRANSFER FROM KABUL TO TEHRAN, ANOTHER CRITICAL DIPLOMATIC POST FOR PAKISTAN, MAY WELL BE A MEASURE OF THE SATISFACTION WITH WHICH ISLAMABAD REGARDS HIS PERFORMANCE.

ON THE NEGATIVE SIDE, ARSHAD APPEARS TO BE, AT BEST, EQUIVOCAL IN HIS ATTITUDE TOWARD THE UNITED STATES. WE OBSERVED THAT HE WAS AN ENTHUSIASTIC SUPPORTER OF FORMER PRIME MINISTER BHUTTO DURING THE LATTER'S ATTACKS ON THE U.S. BEFORE HIS ARREST IN 1977, AND THAT HE REPORTEDLY REPEATED BHUTTO'S ANTI-AMERICAN SLANDERS IN THE LOCAL DIPLOMATIC COMMUNITY. HE HAS NOT BEEN PARTICULARLY FRIENDLY OR FORTHCOMING SINCE BHUTTO'S ARREST EITHER. WE WOULD RECOMMEND THAT HE BE HANDLED WITH CAUTION.
ARSHAD IS AN ENTHUSIASTIC AND TIRELESS BRIDGE PLAYER.

1978KABUL09181.subject: PROPOSED TDY ASSIGNMENT FOR FSO MCNAULL AT ISFAHAN

segments.text: IN VIEW OF THE CIRCUMSTANCES CITED IN REFTEL A, EMBASSY KABUL WOULD BE WILLING TO MAKE FSO-6 MICHAEL E. MCNAULL AVAILABLE FOR ABOUT ONE MONTH OF TDY BACK-UP SERVICE AT CONSULATE ISFAHAN. MCNAULL WAS ORIGINALLY SCHEDULED TO RETURN TO KABUL FROM HIS HARPERS FERRY S/NM SEMINAR ON NOVEMBER 22 (HE PLANS TO DEPART WASHINGTON ON NOVEMBER 20). WHEN MCNAULL RETURNS, WE CAN DISCUSS WITH EMBASSY TEHRAN HIS ETA AT ISFAHAN, WHICH WOULD PRESUMABLY BE RIGHT AFTER THE THANKSGIVING HOLIDAY. (THERE IS KABUL- TOTEHRAN AIRLINE SERVICE EVERY MONDAY, TUESDAY, THURSDAY, FRIDAY AND SUNDAY).

SINCE NARCOTICS OFFICER MCNAULL IS NEEDED URGENTLY AT ISFAHAN, POLITICAL COUNSELOR BRUCE A. FALTIN, THE EMBASSY'S NARCOTICS COORDINATOR, WILL REPRESENT THE EMBASSY AT NEA'S REGIONAL NARCOTICS CONFERENCE AT TUNIS DECEMBER 11-12 (PARAGRAPH 4 OF REFTEL B).
BEFORE THE ARRANGMENTS DISCUSSED ABOVE ARE FINALIZED, WE WOULD APPRECIATE MCNAULL'S BEING CONSULTED FOR HIS VIEWS.

1978KABUL09331.subject: BALUCHI LANGUAGE PROPAGANDA SERVICES IN AFGHANISTAN

segments.text: THE NEW BALUCHI NEWSPAPER REFERRED TO BY IRANIAN MFA DIRECTORGENERAL SANANDAJI (REFTEL A) IS THE PERIODICAL "SOUB," A WORD WHICH TRANSLATES AS "TRIUMPH" IN ENGLISH (REFTEL B).

RADIO AFGHANISTAN INAUGURATED A HALF-HOUR PROGRAM IN THE BALUCHI LANGUAGE SHORTLY AFTER THE REVOLUTION OF APRIL 27. THIS PROGRAM BEGINS EACH EVENING AT EIGHT O'CLOCK. UNDER A CURRENT AGREEMENT WITH PAKISTAN, THE AFGHAN GOVERNMENT HAS BEEN MUTING THE PROPAGANDA CONTENT OF ITS PUSHTU AND BALUCHI SERVICES, BUT, OF COURSE, THE POTENTIAL FOR TROUBLE-MAKING REMAINS.

1978KABUL10093.subject: TRAVEL OF EARNEST V. PAUL O'GAFFNEY

segments.text: 1-RE REFTEL, ONLY TOWN OF VRANG (37 DEGREES NORTH; 72 DEGREES, 20 MINUTES EAST) ON SOVIET SIDE OF AFGHAN BORDER WHICH WE CAN LOCATE IS IN PAMIR MOUNTAINS THE MOST INACCESSABLE PART OF AFGHANISTAN AND TOTALLY IMPASSIBLE DURING THE WINTER AND PROBABLY THE SUMMER AS WELL. WE CAN NOT LOCATE ROSHTKALA ON OUR MAPS.

2- UNLESS O'GAFFNEY ENTERS AFGHANISTAN WHERE THERE IS PAVED HIGHWAY IT IS HIGHLY UNLIKELY THAT HE WILL GET THROUGH AFGHANISTAN ITSELF IN 79 DAYS, BOTH BECAUSE OF ROAD CONDITIONS AND WINTER WEATHER, AND BECAUSE HE WILL MOST LIKELY BE ARRESTED SINCE BADAKHSHAN PROVINCE , WHICH IS APPARENTLY THE PROPOSED POINT OF ENTRY, IS CURRENTLY VERY SENSITIVE FOR SECURITY REASONS.

1978KATHMA02367.subject: DISCUSSION WITH INDIAN FOREIGN SECRETARY JAGAT MEHTA ON AFGHANISTAN DEVELOPMENTS

segments.text: AFGHANISTAN DEVELOPMENTS

I SAW FOREIGN SECRETARY MEHTA LAST EVENING (MAY 2) DURING WHICH WE DISCUSSED AFGHAN COUP AND SOME OF IMPLICATIONS THEREOF AS SEEN BY MEHTA. MEHTA, HAVING JUST RETURNED FROM A MEMORIAL SERVICE FOR A FOREIGN SERVICE COLLEAGUE, WAS TIRED AND DISTRACTED AND WE HAD PLANNED TO MEET FOR 15 MINUTES, BUT TYPICALLY ONCE HE GOT GOING ON SUBJECT OF AFGHANISTAN HE BECAME DISCURSIVE AND WE SPENT ABOUT AN HOUR TOGETHER.

I STARTED BY GIVING HIM SOME OF ATMOSPHERICS OF COUP AND THEN MADE THE POINTS YOU AND I HAD DISCUSSED BEFORE MY DEPARTURE FROM KABUL, NAMELY THAT (A) NEW AFGHAN LEADERSHIP COMPRISED HARD-LINE COMMUNISTS AND NOT RPT NOT "NATIONALISTS". (B) COUP HAD OVERTURNED 100 YEARS OF EFFORT BY BRITISH AND OTHERS TO KEEP AFHANISTAN OUT OF SOVIET ORBIT. NOW THAT IT WAS A COMMUNIST STATE BORDERING ON SOVIET UNION, BREZHNEV DOCTRINE PRESUMABLY CAME INTO PLAY AND IT APPEARED VERY UNLIKELY THAT AFGHANISTAN WOULD BE ABLE TO BREAK AWAY IN FUTURE FROM ITS NEW ALIGNMENT.

(C) THERE WAS ALREADY SOME EVIDENCE THAT NEW LEADERSHIP WOULD REVIVE PUSHTOONISTAN AND BALUCHISTAN ISSUES ONCE NEW GOVERNMENT HAD STABLIZED SITUATION WITHIN COUNTRY. I WENT ON TO SAY THAT ALL OF THIS RAISED IMPORTANT QUESTIONS FOR THE FUTURE ABOUT AREA STABILITY AND ROLE WHICH COUNTRIES OF SOUTH ASIA SHOULD PLAY IN CONTAINING THIS NEW THREAT. ONE OF CRITICAL PROBLEMS IN THIS CONNECTION WAS HOW THESE DEVELOPMENTS WOULD AFFECT PAKISTAN'S SECURITY AND STABILITY, AND INDIAN POLICIES IN AREA AND TOWARDS PAKISTAN.

MEHTA RESPONDED BY SAYING THAT HE AGREED WITH MY CHARACTERIZATION OF NEW AFGHAN LEADERSHIP AS HARDLINE COMMUNIST AND THAT CHANGE OF GOVERNMENT WAS INDEED A MOMENTOUR DEVELOPMENT NOT ONLY BECAUSE IT PLACED AFGHANISTAN UNDER SOVIET CONTROL BUT ALSO BECAUSE OF IMPLICATIONS FOR THE AREA. HE SAID THAT INDIA HAD DECIDED TO RECOGNIZE NEW GOVERNMENT EARLY ON LARGELY BECAUSE OF TRADITIONAL FRIENDSHIP BETWEEN TWO COUNTRIES. AS SOON AS HE HEARD THAT INDIAN AMBASSADOR SINGH HAD BEEN SUMMONED TO MEETING MAY 1 WITH TARAKKI, HE HAD INSTRUCTED SINGH TO INDICATE THAT GOI WAS PREPARED TO RECOGNIZE NEW REGIME.

SINGH HAD REPORTED THAT MEETING HAD BEEN CORDIAL WITH TARAKKI GOING OUT OF HIS WAY TO BE FRIENDLY. MEHTA ADDED THAT IT WAS MUCH TOO EARLY TO COME TO ANY CONCLUSIONS ABOUT HOW AFGHAN-INDIAN RELATIONS MIGHT DEVELOP BUT CONCEIVABLY INDIA COULD PLAY A MODERATING ROLE OR AT LEAST PRESENT NON-COMMUNIST VIEWS INTO AFGHAN DILIBERATIONS. MEHTA WAS CLEARLY UNDER NO ILLUSIONS ABOUT HOW INFLUENTIAL INDIA MIGHT BE IN THE FUTURE AND MERELY POINTED OUT THAT TRADITIONAL INDIAN-AFGHAN FRIENDSHIP MIGHT COME IN USEFUL SOMEDAY.

TURNING TO MY EARLIER COMMENT ABOUT IMPLICATIONS FOR SOUTH ASIA OF AFGHAN COUP, MEHTA LAUNCHED INTO GENERAL COMMENTARY ABOUT RECENT DEVELOPMENTS IN INDIAN FOREIGN POLICY. LOOKING BACK OVER THE LAST TWO YEARS HE FELT THERE WAS SOME GROUND FOR SATISFACTION AND ENCOURAGEMENT IN THAT GOI HAD IMPROVED ITS RELATIONS WITH US WITHOUT LOSING CONFIDENCE OF SOVIETS, WHICH HE NOTED WAS NO MEAN TRICK. FURTHER, FOR A COUNTRY BESET WITH INTERNAL DIFFICULTIES, DOMESTIC ATTITUDES ON FOREIGN POLICY HAD STABILIZED AND BECOME MORE MATURE AND CURRENTLY INDIA'S FOREIGN POLICY CONTRIBUTED TO WHATEVER SENSE OF SELFCONFIDENCE NATION POSSESSED. THIS SALUTORY TREND WAS ALSO EVIDENT IN RELATIONS BETWEEN INDIA AND PAKISTAN.

INDIAN PUBLIC OPINION HAD SWUNG AROUND GRADUALLY TO VIEW THAT THERE WAS NOTHING WRONG IN HAVING GOOD RELATIONS WITH PAKISTAN AND SIMILARLY HE FELT PAKISTANIS WERE GRADUALLY COMING AROUND TO SAME POINT OF VIEW REGARDING INDIA. THERE WERE NUMBER OF ENCOURAGING SIGNS OF THIS NATURE AND IF PAKISTAN COULD ONLY RESOLVE SOME OF ITS DOMESTIC POLITICAL PROBLEMS HE WAS HOPEFUL THAT TREND TOWARDS IMPROVED RELATIONS BETWEEN BOTH COUNTRIES WOULD CONTINUE. ALL OF THIS WAS OF COURSE RELEVANT TO AFGHAN DEVELOPMENTS WHICH GAVE SOME URGENCY TO SOLUTION OF PAKISTAN'S INTERNAL PROBLEMS AND MIGHT IN FACT GENERATE SITUATIONS OR PRESSURES WHICH WOULD RESULT IN NEW LOOK BY PAKISTAN TOWARDS INDIA.

MEHTA STRESSED WHAT HE WAS SAYING WAS HIGHLY SPECULATIVE. SITUATION CREATED BY AFGHAN DEVELOPMENTS WAS VERY COMPLICATED AND PRECIPITOUS CONCLUSIONS OR ACTIONS SHOULD BE AVOIDED. HE EXPRESSED HOPE, HOWEVER, THAT LITTLE BY LITTLE INDIA MIGHT PLAY CONSTRUCTIVE ROLE IN AFGHANISTAN AND EVENTUALLY BE HELPFUL TOWARDS PAKISTAN.
I REPORT THIS FOR WHAT IT IS WORTH. NOT HAVING SEEN TRAFFIC FROM ADDRESSEE POSTS, I DO NOT KNOW HOW MUCH OF THIS IS NEW INFORMATION OR USEFUL. FEEL FREE TO USE AS YOU WISH OR FILE AWAY.

A GROUP OF AGITATORS ENTERED THE OSCO OFFICE AT ABOUT 10 A.M. TEHRAN TIME URGING A GENERAL OSCO STRIKE. FRIGHTENED EXPATRIATES WERE SENT HOME BY MANAGEMENT; THE OFFICE THEN SHUT DOWN AT NOON.

OUR CONSORTIUM CONTACT SAYS EXPATRIATE EMPLOYEES HAVE BEEN COMMUNICATING DIRECTLY WITH THEIR PARENT COMPANIES DEMANDING EVACUATION.
THE PARTICIPANTS MET THROUGH THE MORNING AND CONTINUED DISCUSSIONS AT LUNCH.

OUR CONSORTIUM CONTACT HAS BEEN RATHER INSISTENT IN ASKING ABOUT USG EVACUATION PLANS.
