HERE IS INFORMAL TRANSLATION OF COMPLETE TEXT OF INTERVIEW GIVEN BY IRANIAN TUDEH LEADER ESKANDARI TO JOURNAL "PROBLEMS OF PEACE AND SOCIALISM" NO. 11, 1978. BEGIN TEXT: OUR INTERVIEWS IRAJ ESKANDARI FIRST SECRETARY CC OF THE POPULAR PARTY OF IRAN THE EVENTS IN IRAN, WHERE IN AUGUST-SEPTEMBER 1978, MASS POPULAR UNREST BEGAN WHICH LED TO ESTABLISHMENT OF MARTIAL LAW IN TWELVE CITIES INCLUDING IRAN, INVOKED AN ABUNDANT FLOW OF COMMENTARIES IN THE WHOLE WORLD. IN LETTERS, WHICH HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BY THE EDITORIAL BOARD OF THE JOURNAL "PROBLEMS OF PEACE AND SOCIALISM," READERS ASK TO BE INFORMED AS TO HOW THE IRANIAN COMMUNISTS EVALUATE THE EVENTS WHICH HAVE TAKEN PLACE.
THE EDITORIAL BOARD TRANSMITTED THESE REQUESTS TO COMRADE

ESKANDARI WHO, IN MID-SEPTEMBER, GAVE THE JOURNAL THE FOLLOWING INTERVIEW: QUESTION: HOW DO YOU ASSESS THE GENERAL CHARACTER OF THE MOVEMENT, THE GROWTH OF WHICH AT THE BEGINNING OF LAST SEPTEMBER LED TO AN OPEN CONFRONTATION WITH THE REGIME? ANSWER: IN THE COURSE OF THE LAST SEVERAL MONTHS, THE MOVEMENT AGAINST THE SHAH'S DICTATORSHIP IN IRAN WAS SPREADING AND GATHERING MOMENTUM EXTRAORDINARILY RAPIDLY. IT WAS NOT A SURPRISE FOR OUR PARTY. AS FAR BACK AS 3 YEARS AGO, THE PLENUM OF THE CC OF THE POPULAR PARTY OF IRAN PREDICTED THE INEVITABILITY OF THE RAPID GROWTH OF THE DEMOCRATIC AND NATIONAL MOVEMENT.

THE SYMPTOMS OF THIS WERE APPARENT EVEN THEN: THE STRIKES WERE GETTING LARGER AND MORE FREQUENT, THERE WAS A GROWING DISSATISFACTION AMONG STUDENTS, INTELLECTURALS, NATIONAL BOURGEOISIE. SURELY, NO ONE COULD PREDICT IN ADVANCE WHAT CONCRETE FORM THIS MOVEMENT MAY ASSUME AT THIS OR THAT CONCRETE MOMENT. AND WHILE AT THE PRESENT TIME THE MOVEMENT HAS A CERTAIN RELIGIOUS COLOR, THIS SHOULD NOT BE EXAGGERATED. INDEED, THE SHIITE CLERGY (SEE FOOTNOTE 1) OF IRAN WHO CAME OUT OF THE PETTY AND MIDDLE BOURGEOISIE COULD NOT REMAIN INDIFFERENT TO THE SUFFERINGS OF THE POPULATION: THEY APPEALED AND ARE APPEALING TO THE PEOPLE TO STRUGGLE AGAINST THE DICTATORSHIP.

HOWEVER, IN THE UNITED AND SPONTANEOUS MOVEMENT AGAINST THE REGIME, ARE UNITED ALL THE OPPOSITION ELEMENTS OF THE COUNTRY. WE BELIEVE THAT THE PRESENT MOVEMENT HAS A POPULAR, DEMOCRATIC AND REVOLUTIONARY CHARACTER. IT IS POPULAR BECAUSE THE BROAD MASSES AND, ABOVE ALL, THE WORKING MASSES TAKE PART IN ACTIONS AND DEMONSTRATIONS, ALONG WITH REPRESENTATIVES OF PETTY BOURGEOISIE AND NATIONAL BOURGEOISIE. IT IS DEMOCRATIC, BECAUSE THE MAIN SLOGAN OF THE MOVEMENT IS THE ESTABLISHMENT IN THE COUNTRY OF A DEMOCRATIC ORDER. IT IS REVOLUTIONARY BECAUSE ITS GOAL IS A RADICAL CHANGE OF REGIME, WHICH SHOULD BE BROUGHT TO REALITY BY THE PEOPLE ITSELF.

IT SHOULD BE SAID, THAT THE MOVEMENT HAS NOT BEEN LED BY SOME SORT OF PREVIOUSLY CREATED UNIFIED ORGANIZATION. HOWEVER, POPULAR DISSATISFACTION WAS SO GREAT THAT THE SLOGANS, CALLING FOR STRUGGLE AGAINST THE SHAH'S REGIME, FOUND RESPONSE AMONG THE WIDEST LAYERS OF THE POPULATION, AMONG ALL THOSE WHO STAND FOR DEMOCRACY, AGAINST SOCIAL REPRESSION AND IMPOVERISHMENT, WHICH ARE THE RESULTS OF THE POLICY PURSUED BY THE GOVERNMENT. IT IS KNOWN, THAT THE BILLION DOLLAR REVENUES WHICH IRAN RECEIVES FROM THE EXPORT OF OIL ONLY WIDENED THE ABYSS BETWEEN THE POOR AND THE RICH IN OUR COUNTRY.

RECENT YEARS SAW A QUICKENING PROCESS OF ENRICHMENT OF A SMALL GROUP OF PEOPLE IN POWER WHICH IS CLOSELY CONNECTED WITH IMPERIALIST MONOPOLIES. ON THE OTHER ------------------016110 221835Z /40 FM AMEMBASSY MOSCOW TO AMEMBASSY TEHRAN IMMEDIATE INFO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 9501 UNCLAS SECTION 02 OF 04 MOSCOW 28680 HAND, THERE IS A CONSTANT IMPOVERISHMENT OF THE MASSES, OF THE WORKING PEOPLE, THE GROWING UNEMPLOYMENT AND BANKRUPTCY OF SMALL PEASANT HOLDINGS. WIDELY SPREAD ARE CORRUPTION, ILLEGAL PRACTICES; ABUSE OF POWER AMONG THE RULING CIRCLES ALSO STIRS WIDE-SPREAD BITTER RESENTMENT.

ALL THIS AND MANY OTHER THINGS ACCOUNT FOR THE SCALE OF THE PRESENT UNREST IN WHICH ALL SORTS OF SOCIAL, POLITICAL AND IDEOLOGICAL FORCES AND GROUPINGS ARE TAKING PART. THE SHAH'S ONLY SUPPORT IN THE COUNTRY IS THE ARMY AND POLICE WHICH, AND THIS IS NO SECRET FOR ANYONE, ARE LED BY THE AMERICAN ADVISERS. THEIR TOTAL NUMBER IN THE COUNTRY IS ABOUT FORTY THOUSAND. BY THE WAY, AROUND ONE BILLION DOLLARS ARE SPENT ANNUALLY TO MAINTAIN THEM.

IT WAS THE ARMY AND POLICE WHO PROVOKED BLOODY INCIDENTS, INCLUDING THE TRAGEDY OF SEPTEMBER 8, WHEN, ACCORDING TO THE OFFICIAL REPORTS, AROUND A HUNDRED PERSONS WERE KILLED, AND, ACCORDING TO UNOFFICIAL ACCOUNTS, THE NUMBER OF UNARMED PEACEFUL PEOPLE KILLED WAS TWO TO THREE THOUSAND. EVERYBODY KNOWS THAT THE DEMONSTRATIONS WERE OF PEACEFUL NATURE AND AS FAR AS THE BARRICADES ARE CONCERNED, THEY WERE ERECTED FOR PROTECTION FROM THE ARMY. THERE ARE, HOWEVER, SIGNS WHICH SHOW THAT THE ARMY SUPPORT OF THE REGIME WILL NOT BE ETERNAL. THERE HAVE ALREADY BEEN INSTANCES WHEN OFFICERS AND SOLDIERS REFUSED TO SHOOT AT THE PEOPLE.

QUESTION: IN THE PRESS OF CAPITALIST COUNTRIES, THE PRESENT MOVEMENT AGAINST THE REGIME IN IRAN IS REPRESENTED BASICALLY AS A SHOWDOWN OF FORCES OF REGRESSION AGAINST THE "MODERNISTIC" POLICY PURSUED BY THE SHAH, AS A MOVEMENT IN WHICH THE MOSLEM RELIGIOUS LEADERS DEMAND A RETURN TO "PURE ISLAM" AND COME FORTH AGAINST THE SHAH'S REFORMS WHICH ALLEGEDLY SHOULD TRANSFER THE COUNTRY FROM THE MIDDLE AGES TO "THE MODERN SOCIETY." WHAT DO YOU SAY ABOUT THAT?

ANSWER: AS FAR AS THE RELIGIOUS ASPECT OF THE PRESENT MOVEMENT AGAINST THE REGIME IS CONCERNED, IT SHOULD BE EMPHASIZED THAT THE SHIITE CLERGY CANNOT BE VIEWED AS A FORCE DEMANDING A RETURN TO THE PAST, TO THE MIDDLE AGES. THE POSITION OF THE CLERGY REFLECT, TO A SIGNIFICANT EXTENT, POPULAR FEELINGS. AND THE FACT THAT THE RELIGIOUS MOVEMENT IS NOW PLAYING AN IMPORTANT ROLE IN THE MOBILIZATION OF DEMOCRATIC AND NATIONAL FORCES AGAINST THE DICTATORIAL, ANTI-NATIONAL AND PRO-IMPERIALIST REGIME OF THE SHAH, CAN ONLY BE WELCOMED.

OUR PARTY IS A PEOPLES' PARTY, IT HAS ALWAYS RESPECTED RELIGIOUS BELIEFS WHICH HAVE FIRM ROOTS AMONG THE OVERWHELMING MAJORITY OF THE IRANIAN POPULATION. THE IRANIAN POPULAR PARTY IS A DEMOCRATIC PARTY. IT IS BECAUSE OF THIS WE ARE IN FAVOR OF A UNION WITH ALL DEMOCRATIC FORCES, INCLUDING THE RELIGIOUS ONES. WHEN MOSLEM LEADERS LIKE KHOMEINI TAKE ANTI-IMPERIALIST POSITIONS AND STATE THAT THE REGIME OF THE SHAH IS ANTI-POPULAR AND ANTI-ISLAMIC AND THAT IT SHOULD BE OVERTHROWN, WE CONSIDER THAT THAT IS A POSITIVE STATEMENT. CERTAINLY, IT DOES NOT MEAN THAT WE AGREE WITH THE RELIGIOUS LEADERS ABOUT EVERYTHING, BUT ONE SHOULD BE A REALIST.

IT IS ANOTHER MATTER IF THE MATTER CONCERNED THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A THEOCRATIC STATE. HOWEVER, AS FAR AS WE KNOW, THE IRANIAN RELIGIOUS LEADERS HAVE NEVER CALLED FOR THIS. IF MADARI (ANOTHER PROMINENT RELIGIOUS LEADER OF IRAN) IS IN FAVOR OF A RETURN TO THE 1906 CONSTITUTION, IT SHOULD BE POINTED OUT THAT IT WAS QUITE A DEMOCRATIC CONSTITUTION, INTO WHICH THE SHAH INTRODUCED CHANGES THAT LED TO THE ESTABLISHMENT OF HIS PERSONAL POWER IN THE COUNTRY. FOR THIS REASON A DEMAND FOR RETURN TO THE 1906 CONSTITUTION IS NOT REACTIONARY AT ALL.

IT IS KNOWN THAT IN RECENT YEARS THE SHAH AND HIS GOVERNMENT TRIED TO LAY ALL RESPONSIBILITY FOR THE ANTI-GOVERNMENT DEMONSTRATIONS ON THE SO-CALLED ISLAMIC MARXISTS (SEE FOOTNOTE 2). THEY THEMSELVES INVENTED THIS TERM AS A MEANS TO SPLIT THE ANTI-DICTATORIAL MOVEMENT, IN ORDER TO SIMULTANEOUSLY ATTACK BOTH MARXISM AND RELIGION. THE SHAH, THE GOVERNMENT AND ITS SECRET POLICE SAVAK CONSTANTLY REITERATE: THE RELIGIOUS MOVEMENT AND THE IRANIAN POPULAR PARTY CANNOT COOPERATE WITH EACH OTHER, SINCE MARXISM AND ISLAM ARE INCOMPATIBLE.

IT IS TRUE, THERE IS NO OFFICIAL COOPERATION BETWEEN THEM. ------------------016313 221837Z /40 FM AMEMBASSY MOSCOW TO AMEMBASSY TEHRAN IMMEDIATE INFO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 9502 UNCLAS SECTION 03 OF 04 MOSCOW 28680 WE SIMPLY PARTICIPATE IN THE SAME MOVEMENT AGAINST THE PRESENT REGIME. YET THE ESSENCE OF THIS PROPAGANDA OF THE REGIME IS IN THE FACT THAT IT IS DIRECTED AGAINST US, AGAINST COMMUNISTS AND AGAINST THE POPULAR PARTY. HAD THE PRESENT MOVEMENT AGAINST THE REGIME BEEN PURELY RELIGIOUS, THE SHAH COULD HAVE SATISFIED THE PURELY RELIGIOUS DEMANDS AND IN THAT WAY QUELLED THE WAVE OF POPULAR DISSATISFACTION.

HOWEVER, THE MATTER CONCERNS THE POLITICAL MOVEMENT, POLITICAL DEMANDS PUT FORWARD BY THE WHOLE PEOPLE, AND SPECIFICALLY THE DEMANDS TO ELIMINATE THE DICTATORSHIP AND ESTABLISH A DEMOCRATIC REGIME. QUESTION: WHAT ARE THE OTHER FORCES THAT OPPOSE THE REGIME? ANSWER: ABOVE ALL, IT IS THE NATIONAL FRONT THAT UNITES A NUMBER OF POLITICAL PARTIES WHICH TAKE NATIONALISTIC AND DEMOCRATIC STAND. ITS PARTICIPANTS ARE THE FOLLOWERS OF MOSSADEQH (SEE FOOTNOTE 3).

ALL MEMBERS OF THE NATIONAL FRONT OPPOSE THE SHAH'S DICTATORSHIP AND SUPPORT THE RESTORATION OF CONSTITUTIONAL FREEDOMS AND THE CONVOCATION OF A CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY, ELECTED ON THE BASIS OF UNIVERSAL SUFFRAGE; THEY ARE FOR A DEMOCRATIC GOVERNMENT FORMED AS THE RESULT OF FREE ELECTIONS. THEY DON'T SAY OFFICIALLY THAT THEY ARE AGAINST THE MONARCHY, BUT THEY MAKE THIS KNOWN. THEY SUPPORT THE LIMITATION OF OIL PRODUCTION IN ORDER NOT TO UNREASONABLY WASTE THE NATION'S RESOURCES. IN ITS SOCIAL COMPOSITION, IT IS MAINLY PETI-BOURGEOIS. THE NATIONAL FRONT HAS A SIGNIFICANT INFLUENCE AMONG THE INTELLECTUALS, PARTICULARLY AMONG THE STUDENTS.

BESIDES THIS, THERE IS THE REACTIONARY OPPOSITION TO THE SHAH'S REGIME, WHICH CONSISTS OF PRO-AMERICAN FIGURES. THEY WOULD LIKE TO SETTLE THE CRISIS IN THE COUNTRY IN SUCH A MANNER AS TO NOT ENDANGER THE U.S., GREAT BRITAIN AND THE POSITIONS OF MONOPOLIES OF THESE AND OTHER IMPERIALIST COUNTRIES. THEY TAKE ANTI-SOVIET, ANTI-COMMUNIST POSITIONS. ALI AMINI, THE FORMER PREMIER, WHO ENJOYS U.S. FAVOR, IS A FIGURE THAT CHARACTERIZES THEM. QUESTION: WHAT ARE THE EXTERNAL SUPPORTS OF THE REGIME? ANSWER: ABOVE ALL IT IS U.S. IMPERIALISM. IRAN IS IMPORTANT TO IT AS AN OIL SUPPLIER AND AS A COUNTRY HAVING AN IMPORTANT STRATEGIC POSITION ON THE BORDERS OF THE SOVIET UNION.

IT IS NOT ACCIDENTAL THAT ON THE FOLLOWING DAY AFTER THE BLOODY SLAUGHTER ON SEPTEMBER 8, PRESIDENT CARTER CALLED THE SHAH FROM CAMP DAVID WHERE HE WAS HOLDING TALKS WITH BEGIN AND SADAT TO EXPRESS TO THE SHAH HIS SYMPATHY AND SUPPORT. AT THE SAME TIME THE STATE DEPARTMENT MADE A STATEMENT, MONSTRUOUS IN ITS CYNICISM, THAT THE UNREST IN IRAN "IS BEING SUPPRESSED, IT SEEMS, WITH MODERATION." SO, THE EVENTS IN IRAN HAVE COMPLETELY UNMASKED THE DEMAGOGIC AND FALSE CHARACTER OF THE WIDELY PUBLICIZED APPROACH OF THE CARTER ADMINISTRATION TO "HUMAN RIGHTS." FOR US, FOR THE POPULAR PARTY AND FOR THE NATIONAL FRONT, IT HAD BEEN CLEAR LONG BEFORE.

BUT TODAY EVEN REACTIONARY OPPOSITION MOVEMENTS WHICH COUNTED ON SOME CHANGES IN THE AMERICAN POSITION ARE DISCOURAGED. IT IS CLEAR TO EVERYONE THAT CARTER DOES NOT WANT TO CHANGE ANYTHING IN THE U.S. POSITION WITH RESPECT TO IRAN. HOWEVER, THE UNITED STATES CANNOT BUT SEE THAT DISSATISFACTION WITH THE REGIME HAS ENGULFED ALL THE LAYERS OF THE COUNTRY'S POPULATION. THEY ARE LOOKING FOR SOMETHING THAT COULD CALM DOWN THE DISCONTENT, BUT IN VAIN. THAT'S WHY THEY HAVE TO CONTENT THEMSELVES WITH THE SUPERFICIAL CHANGES CARRIED OUT BY THE PRESENT GOVERNMENT OF SHARIF-IMAMI. UNEQUIVOCAL SUPPORT FOR THE SHAH'S REGIME WAS EXPRESSED BY THE ZIONIST ISRAELI GOVERNMENT.

FINALLY, ANOTHER EXTERNAL SUPPORT FOR THE SHAH'S REGIME IS THE PRESENT LEADERSHIP OF THE PRC. AFTER THE SLAUGHTER OF SEPTEMBER 8, PEKING REITERATED ITS SUPPORT FOR THE SHAH AND QUOTED A SLANDEROUS COMMUNIQUE PUBLISHED IN TEHRAN ABOUT "MANIFESTATIONS FINANCED AND PLANNED FROM ABROAD." BUT EVEN EARLIER ------------------016349 221832Z /40 FM AMEMBASSY MOSCOW TO AMEMBASSY TEHRAN IMMEDIATE INFO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 9503 UNCLAS SECTION 04 OF 04 MOSCOW 28680 HUA KUO-FENG'S VISIT TO TEHRAN AND HIS STATEMENTS THERE CLEARLY SHOWED THERE IS A SHAMELESS AND UNPRINCIPLED COLLUSION BETWEEN THE IMPERIALISTS OF THE USA AND LEADERS OF THE PRC.

THE IMAGE OF THE CHINESE REVOLUTION THAT LONG AGO EMERGED IN THE EYES OF PROGRESSIVE FORCES OF THE WORLD HAS BEEN IRREPAIRABLY DISTORTED. THIS HAS BEEN ACHIEVED BY THE POSITION OF THE CHINESE LEADERS IN AFRICAN AFFAIRS, ITS ATTITUDE TOWARD THE CHILEAN REGIME, ETC. IT IS VERY IMPORTANT NOW THAT OUR PEOPLE UNDERSTAND THE ROLE OF THE PRESENT CHINESE LEADERSHIP. THIS HAS DEALT A CRASHING BLOW TO MAOIST PROPAGANDA IN IRAN, WHICH USED TO BE RATHER ACTIVE, ACCUSING OUR PARTY OF REVISIONISM. NOW EVERYONE SEES WHO TAKES REVISIONIST AND PRO-IMPERIALIST POSITIONS, AND WHO IS FIGHTING FOR THE INTERESTS OF THE IRANIAN PEOPLE. FOOTNOTE 1.

SHIITES - AN ISLAMIC SECT TO WHICH BELONGS ALMOST THE WHOLE POPULATION OF IRAN. ED. NOTE. FOOTNOTE 2. IN IRAN THERE WAS AN ISLAMIC GROUP WHICH CALLED ITSELF THE "POPULAR FIGHTERS" AND WHICH WAS CONNECTED TO THE ULTRA-LEFTIST MOVEMENT "THE URBAN GUERRILLAS." THE SHAH MADE UP THE TERM "ISLAMIC MARXISTS" FOR THEM. THE "POPULAR FIGHTERS" THEMSELVES ALWAYS DENIED THAT THEY WERE MARXISTS, ALTHOUGH THEY ALSO EMPHASIZED THAT THERE WERE POSITIVE THINGS IN MARXISM WITH WHICH THEY WERE IN AGREEMENT. FOOTNOTE 3. MOSSADEQH - THE PRIME MINISTER OF IRAN IN 1951-1953 PROCLAIMED THE NATIONALIZATION OF THE ANGLO-IRANIAN OIL COMPANY.
HE WAS OVERTHROWN AS A RESULT OF A PLOT ORGANIZED WITH THE HELP OF THE CIA. (ED. NOTE). . TOON

1978MOSCOW30836.subject: IRANIAN DIPLOMATS IN MOSCOW DISCUSS IRANIAN SITUATION BEGIN SUMMARY(C): THE IRANIAN AMBASSADOR TOLD

segments.text: SITUATION BEGIN SUMMARY(C): THE IRANIAN AMBASSADOR TOLD AMBASSADOR TOON THAT SOVIETS ARE NOW HEDGING THEIR BETS ON THE SHAH AND THAT SOVIET PRESS HAS RECENTLY BECOME SLIGHTLY MORE ANTI-SHAH. HE NOTED THAT BOTH IRAN AND PAKISTAN ARE CONCERNED ABOUT THE TOUGHER STAND ON THE BALUCHI AND PUSHTU PROBLEMS TAKEN BY THE SOVIET-BACKED TARAKI REGIME. HE WAS REASONABLY CONFIDENT THAT THE SOVIETS ARE NOT PRESSING THE TUDEH TO BE TROUBLESOME. IRANIAN ECONOMIC COUNSELOR, ON OTHER HAND, IN SEPARATE CONVERSATION WITH EMBOFF EXPRESSED VIEW THAT SOVIETS ARE BEHIND TUDEH'S STEPPEDUP EFFORTS TO COORDINATE ITS ACTIONS WITH THE SHAH'S NON-COMMUNIST OPPOSITION IN IRAN.

HE EMPHASIZED HIS BELIEF THAT IRAN CANNOT RELY ON OTHERS TO SOLVE ITS PROBLEMS. END SUMMARY. 1.(C-ENTIRE TEXT) DURING DECEMBER 14 CALL ON AMBASSADOR, IRANIAN AMBASSADOR ARDALAN STATED THAT SOVIETS ARE NOW HEDGING THEIR BETS ON THE SHAH BECAUSE OF DOUBTS OVER HIS SURVIVABILITY. ARDALAN THOUGHT THAT THE SOVIET PRESS IS TAKING A SLIGHTLY MORE ANTI-SHAH LINE. HE SAID THAT NO SOVIET TECHNICIANS HAVE DEPARTED IRAN, ALTHOUGH MANY SOVIET DEPENDENTS HAVE BEEN EVACUATED. IN FACT, WHEN THE TEHRAN AIRPORT WAS CLOSED, THE SOVIETS ASKED FOR AND RECEIVED PERMISSION TO FLY AEROFLOT INTO OTHER AIRPORTS IN IRAN TO EVACUATE SOVIET CITIZENS.

AMBASSADOR ARDALAN REMARKED THAT HE COMPLAINED TO SOVIET DEPUTY FOREIGN MINISTER KOZYREV ABOUT MENGISTU'S ANTI-SHAH STATEMENTS IN MOSCOW (MOSCOW 28684, PARA 9). KOZYREV RESPONDED THAT THE SOVIET POSITION REMAINS CLEAR (I.E., NON-INTERFERENCE), BUT THAT MENGISTU IS INDEPENDENT AND MOSCOW CANNOT CONTROL HIS STATEMENTS.

ON TUDEH-SOVIET LINKS, ARDALAN WAS REASONABLY CONFIDENT THAT THE SOVIETS ARE NOT PRESSING THE TUDEH TO BE TROUBLESOME. HE ADDED THAT, WHILE THE TUDEH IS UNDER SOVIET CONTROL, IT CAN BEHAVE INDEPENDENTLY.

ARDALAN THOUGHT THAT THE IRAQIS ARE WORRIED ABOUT THE IRAN SITUATION, ESPECIALLY THE INCREASED INFLUENCE OF RELIGIOUS EXTREMISTS. HE SAID THAT IRAN AND PAKISTAN ARE CONCERNED ABOUT THE TOUGHER STAND ON THE BALUCHI AND PUSHTU PROBLEMS TAKEN BY THE TARAKI REGIME, BACKED -- ALTHOUGH MAYBE NOT ENCOURAGED -- BY THE SOVIETS.

IN DECEMBER 9 CONVERSATION, IRANIAN EMBASSY ECONOMIC COUNSELOR AHY, IN THE FOURTH YEAR OF AN ASSIGNMENT TO MOSCOW AND APPARENTLY PRO-SHAH, AGREED THAT SOVIET PRESS TREATMENT OF THE SITUATION IN IRAN STILL REMAINS SOMEWHAT CAUTIOUS. HE ACIDLY STATED THAT THE SOVIETS IN PUBLIC AND PRIVATE COMMENT "OFFICIALLY" DO NOT DIRECTLY ATTACK THE SHAH. HE MAINTAINED THAT IN RECENT WEFKS THE TUDEH HAS STEPPED UP ITS ACTIVITIES IN IRAN, INCLUDING EFFORTS TO COORDINATE ITS ACTIONS WITH NON-COMMUNIST OPPOSITION ELEMENTS.

TUDEH'S EFFORTS TO COORDINATE WITH THE OPPOSITION ARE SO FAR TAKING PLACE ONLY IN IRAN.
THE SOVIETS COMPLETELY CONTROL THE TUDEH AND ARE BEHIND THE CHANGE IN THE TUDEH'S STRATEGY INSIDE IRAN.

AHY COMPARED IRAN'S CURRENT POLITY WITH THAT OF DAOUD'S AFGHANISTAN, STATING THAT ONLY THE COMMUNISTS CONSTITUTE A UNIFIED AND DISCIPLINED FORCE AMONG THE OPPOSITION GROUPS. HE STATED THAT, IN HIS OPINION, THE SHAH WILL REMAIN IN POWER, DESPITE HIS PRESENT DIFFICULTIES. HE PREDICTED THAT, IF THE SHAH WERE TO FALL, THE COMMUNISTS WOULD EMERGE AS THE STRONGEST POLITICAL FORCE IN THE COUNTRY WITHIN TWO TO THREE MONTHS, GIVEN THE FISSURES AND ANIMOSITIES WITHIN THE REST OF THE OPPOSITION.

AHY EMPHASIZED HIS BELIEF THAT IRAN HAS TO SOLVE ITS OWN PROBLEMS AND THERE IS LITTLE THE U.S. OR OTHERS CAN DO TO ENSURE CONTIMUING STABILITY INSIDE IRAN. IN THIS CONNECTION, HE SAID THAT, ALTHOUGH HE IS UNAWARE OF THE REASONS BEHIND PRESIDENT CARTER'S PUBLIC STATEMENTS OF SUPPORT FOR THE SHAH, THERE WAS A DANGER THAT THEY COULD BE USED BY THE OPPOSITION TO ALLEGE U.S. CONTROL OF THE SHAH. HE DESCRIBED RECENT REPORTS SUGGESTING A MORE LIBERAL U.S. POLICY WITH REGARD TO CONTACTS WITH THE SHAH'S OPPOSITION AS "STRANGE."

IN RESPONSE TO A QUESTION, AHY STATED THAT THE IRANIANS WERE NOT SURPRISED AND IN FACT HAD EXPECTED THE REPETITION OF THE BREZHNEV WARNING ON IRAN IN THE SOVIET-AFGHAN COMMUNIQUE. HE ADDED THAT THE TREATY AND THE WARNING'S REPETITION WERE BAD FOR IRAN, WHICH MUST FACE SOVIET PRESSURES FROM DIFFERENT DIRECTIONS.

AHY AGREED WITH THE PAKISTANI DIPLOMAT'S OBSERVATION THAT THE SOVIETS ARE CONCERNED THAT MUSLIM CONSERVATIVE INFLUENCE, AS REFLECTED IN ANTI-SHAH TURMOIL, MIGHT SPREAD INTO MUSLIM AREA OF THE USSR; HE REMARKED THAT THIS MAY PROVIDE A BRAKE ON POSSIBLE SOVIET ENTHUSIASM FOR THE OPPOSITION IN IRAN. (COMMENT: NEITHER AHY NOR THE PAKISTANI DIPLOMAT CITED EVIDENCE TO SUPPORT THEIR SPECULATION ON POTENTIAL FOR MUSLIM UNREST IN THE SOVIET UNION. EMBASSY HAS SEEN NOTHING THUS FAR TO SUPPORT SUCH SPECULATION, AND MANY DIPLOMATIC OBSERVERS SHARE OUR ASSESSMENT THAT THIS FACTOR WOULD ONLY MARGINALLY BEAR ON SOVIET POLICY-MAKERS VIS-A-VIS IRAN OVER THE SHORT-TERM.) (C-ENTIRE TEXT) TOON

SULTAN QABOOS RECEIVED ME ALONE FOR 20 MINUTES APRIL 9 AT MUSCAT PALACE. I CONGRATULATED HIM AND HIS GOVERNMENT ON THE IMPRESSIVE PROGRESS I HAVE WITNESSED IN OMAN DURING NEARLY 4 YEARS HERE. THE MILITARY VICTORY IN THE SOUTH AND THE STRIDES UNDER 5YEAR PLAN WERE EVIDENCE OF ADVANCES BOTH IN SECURITY AND DEVELOPMENT. BEYOND THAT, THE GROWING COOPERATION OF VARIOUS GULF STATES IN SECURITY AND, PARTICULARLY, ECONOMIC MATTERS WAS SOMETHING I APPLAUDED BASED ON EARLIER SERVICE IN KUWAIT AND SAUDI ARABIA. I WAS CONFIDENT THIS PROGRESS WOULD CONTINUE. QABOOS THANKED ME AND AGREED GULF COOPERATION IS ESSENTIAL ALTHOUGH UNFORTUNATELY SOME LEADERS WERE SLOW TO THE NEED.

I SPOKE BRIEFLY OF USG DETERMINATION TO CONTINUE STRIVING FOR JUST AND DURABLE ARAB-ISRAELI PEACE, NOTING THAT IN THIS REGARD WE HAVE VALUED SULTAN'S COUNSEL AND MODERATION AND WILL CONTINUE TO DO SO. THIS PROMPTED RESPONSE BY QABOOS ALONG FOLLOWING LINES. ONLY TO YOU, HE REMARKED, AND PERHAPS ONE OR TWO OTHER AMBASSADORS HERE WOULD I SAY THIS. I REALLY THINK THE RABAT SUMMIT WAS UNFORTUNATE. BY VALIDATING PLO AS SOLE SPOKESMAN FOR THE PALESTINIAN PEOPLE, WHICH IN MY OPINION IT IS NOT, THE TASK OF MODERATES SUCH AS JORDAN AND EGYPT IN DEALING WITH THE SITUATION HAS BEEN MADE EXCEEDINGLY DIFFICULT.

THOSE WHO SAY IT IS A TERRORIST ORGANIZATION ARE ESSENTIALLY RIGHT, AND PLO ACTIVITIES IN SEVERAL GULF STATES ARE POTENTIALLY VERY HARMFUL, AS SHAYKH RASHID OF DUBAI RECENTLY TOLD ME. RASHID SPOKE WITH CONCERN OF A RECENT PLO CAMPAIGN IN ABU DHABI USING PAMPHLETS AND PRESSURES. I HOPE, SAID QABOOS, THAT SOMETIME, SOMEHOW, THOSE PALESTINIANS LIVING UNDER ISRAELI OCCUPATION COULD HAVE A CHANCE TO CHOOSE THE LEADERS THEY REALLY WANT TO SPEAK FOR THEM.

BUT IN MEANTIME I FEAR THE PLO, AS IT HAS THE ARMS AND MANY OPERATIVES WHO HAVE MADE IT A CAREER, WILL CONTINUE TO CAUSE TROUBLE JUST WHEN IT CAN BE MOST DISASTROUS TO EFFORTS AND HOPES FOR PEACE. WE WILL NOT ALLOW PLO A FOOTHOLD HERE, HE DECLARED, THOUGH SOME LIP SERVICE WILL HAVE TO BE PAID.

QABOOS TURNED TO PROBLEMS IN THE HORN, EXPRESSING TREPIDATION AT SOMALIA PRESIDENT SIAD BARRE'S "EVERWEAKENING" POSITION AND FEAR THAT DJIBOUTI WOULD BE SWALLOWED UP BY ETHIOPIANS ONCE THEIR SOVIET ARMS ARE FULLY DIGESTED, UNLESS ETHIOPIAN REGIME ENCOUNTERS TOO MANY INTERNAL PROBLEMS. BUT FIRST, HE SAID, IT LOOKS LIKE ETHIOPIA WITH HELP OF CUBANS WILL TRY TO FINISH OFF ERITREAN SEPARATIST GROUPS. SULTAN THEN PREDICTED, SOMEWHAT TO MY SURPRISE, THAT HE THOUGHT SOVIETS MIGHT SEND CUBAN TROOPS HOME FROM ETHIOPIA BEFORE TOO LONG, I.E. WHENEVER ETHIOPIAN ARMY IS FAMILIAR WITH RUSSIAN EQUIPMENT SUPPLIED OVER PAST MONTHS.

HE SPECULATED THAT THEN SOVIETS MIGHT TRY TO GET ETHIOPIANS TO DO THEIR DIRTY WORK IN NEIGHBORING COUNTRIES INCLUDING NORTH YEMEN. I TOLD QABOOS THAT HOWEVER THINGS DEVELOPED HE COULD BE SURE USG IS DEVOTING MUCH TIME AND ATTENTION TO ASSESSING SOVIET ACTIVITIES IN AFRICA AND WOULD WELCOME FURTHER CONSULTATIONS WITH OTHERS CONCERNED, INCLUDING OMAN.

I CONCLUDED BY EXPRESSING DEEP APPRECIATION FOR UNFAILING ASSISTANCE AND FRIENDSHIP OF SULTAN'S GOVERNMENT AND PEOPLE FOR ME AND MY FAMILY SINCE 1974, WHICH HAD ASSISTED MY DUTIES NO END AND MADE THEM A PLEASURE TO PERFORM.

COMMENT. I WAS STRUCK BY SULTAN'S FAILURE TO PURSUE HIS DISCOURSE IN PARA 3 TO WHAT MIGHT HAVE SEEMED LIKELY CONCLUSION THAT OMAN ITSELF IS IN FOR EARLY TROUBLE IN DHOFAR BECAUSE OF PRESSURES FROM PDRY AIDED BY ONE OR ANOTHER OF ITS COMMUNIST ALLIES. FACT HE DID NOT DO SO SEEMS A FURTHER INDICATION (SEE MUSCAT 0417) THAT OMAN DOES NOT SEE THAT HAPPENING IN NEAR FUTURE.

1978MUSCAT00721.subject: ALLEGED RECURRENCE OF FIGHTING IN DHOFAR

segments.text: REF TEHRAN 4500 SUMMARY: APRIL 22 INCIDENT MENTIONED REFTEL WAS SMALL-SCALE CLASH WITHOUT CASUALTIES. EVENTS LIKE THIS HAVE OCCURRED FROM TIME TO TIME IN DHOFAR SINCE THE WAR ENDED. THERE WILL PROBABLY BE ANOTHER ONE AROUND JUNE 9, PFLO'S MAIN ANNIVERSARY AND A NATURAL OCCASION FOR PFLO-INITIATED INCIDENTS. THERE IS NO EVIDENCE VISIBLE FROM HERE THAT ANY SIGNIFICANT STEP-UP IN THE INSURGENCY WILL TAKE PLACE SOON, EVEN THOUGH HANDFUL OFHARDCORE PFLO CADRES REMAIN AT LARGE IN EASTERN DHOFAR MOUNTAINS. HOWEVER, SULTANATE FORCES SEEM UNABLE TO WEED THESE REBELS OUT.
OMANGOV IS WELL AWARE THAT INSURGENCY COULD EVENTUALLY REVIVE, AND OMANIS EXPRESS WORRY ABOUT EXTERNAL DEVELOPMENTS, SUCH AS RECENT EVENTS IN HORN OF AFRICA AND AFGHANISTAN. END SUMMARY.

COL KENNETH DODSON, PRINCIPAL STAFF OFFICER OF SULTAN OF OMAN'S LAND FORCES (SOLF), BRIEFED CHARGE MAY 13 ABOUT APRIL 22 INCIDENT MENTIONED REFTEL. WE TOO HAD SEEN FBIS ITEM GIVING ADEN RADIO'S VERSION OF THIS EVENT, AND MOREOVER HAD HEARD REPORTS THAT PDRY IS BUILDING UP BORDER DEFENSES AROUND HABRUT. WE SOUGHT BRIEFING TO CLARIFY THESE AND OTHER RECENT INDICATIONS THAT THERE MAY BE CAUSE FOR HEIGHTENED WORRY ABOUT OMAN'S SECURITY.

DODSON SHOWED CHARGE SOLF'S STAFF REPORT ON THE APRIL 22 INCIDENT. AT MID-DAY A PLATOON-SIZE PATROL OF SOLF'S SOUTHERN BRIGADE CROSSED WADI SHUFLOON IN EASTERN DHOFAR (ON NORTHERN SIDE OF ESCARPMENT DUE NORTH OF MIRBAT) AND WAS FIRED UPON BY BAND OF PFLO FROM SURROUNDING HILLS. THIS IS THE GERNERAL AREA WHERE 55 OR SO HARD-CORE PFLO CADRES ARE KNOWN TO BE HANGING ON SINCE DEFEAT OF INSURGENCY IN LATE 1975. THE PLATOON FIRED BACK AND, AFTER RECEIVING RADIOED PERMISSION FROM HQ TO USE MORTARS, FIRED BARRAGES AT THE ENEMY HIDING AMONG THE ROCKS. AFTER 20 MINUTES THE PFLO BROKE AND RAN.

SOLF UNITS SPENT THE REST OF THE DAY SEARCHING FOR THEM, WITHOUT SUCCESS. EXAMINATION OF LOCATIONS IN HILLS FROM WHICH PFLO HAD FIRED SUGGESTED THERE HAD BEEN FIVE OF THEM IN ALL. THERE WERE NO KILLED OR WOUNDED ON EITHER SIDE. PLATOON'S EXPENDITURE OF AMMUNITION WAS RATHER LARGE: 1500 ROUNDS OF 7.62. MM CARTRIDGES, 52 ROUNDS OF 81 MM MORTAR SHELLS, ONE 81 MM SMOKE SHELL, AND 16 ROUNDS OF M60 ROCKET GRENADES.

SOLF JUDGED THAT THE REASON FOR THE ATTACK WAS PROBABLY THAT THESE PFLO CADRES HAD SIMPLY WANDERED INTO THE AREA BEARING WEAPONS, HAD SPOTTED THE PATROL AND SEEN THAT IT WAS SMALL, AND HAD SEIZED THE TARGET OF OPPORTUNITY. AS REFTEL NOTES, SUCH INCIDENTS DO OCCUR FROM TIME TO TIME. DODSON SAID THIS WAS THE FIRST CONTACT OF ITS TYPE FOR SEVERAL MONTHS. MINING INCIDENTS ALSO TAKE PLACE OCCASIONALLY.

DODSON PREDICTED THAT ON OR ABOUT JUNE 9, PFLO'S MAJOR ANNIVERSARY, THERE ALMOST CERTAINLY WILL BE A PFLO-INITIATED CONTACT OF SOME KIND. IF THE PATTERN OF THE LAST TWO YEARS HOLDS, THE EVENT WILL BE INHERENTLY INSIGNIFICANT BUT WILL BE PROCLAIMED TO THE WORLD AS A MAJOR "VICTORY" ON ADEN RADIO. THESE ARE MAINLY CREDIBILITY-KEEPING AND MORALE-BUILDING EXERCIESES.

ASKED ABOUT THE ALLEGED PDRY BUILDUP NEAR HABRUT ON THE BORDER, DODSON SEEMED MYSTIFIED AS TO WHAT SUCH REPORTS COULD REFR TO. SOLF WATCHES THE PDRY BORDER ACTIVITIES CLOSELY, AND IT KNOWS OF NOTHING UNUSUAL UNDER WAY AT PRESENT. (COMMENT: DODSON THUS REPEATED EARLIER ASSESSMENT OF ANOTHER SOLF STAFF OFFICER REPORTED MUSCAT 0357 THAT BORDER ACTIVITIES OF PDRY SHOW NO SIGN THAT ANY MAJOR MILITARY MOVE INTO OMAN IS IMMINENT.) ------------------058978 201048Z /10 FM AMEMBASSY MUSCAT TO SECSTATE WASHDC 4348 AMEMBASSY TEHRAN INFO USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY SANA SECTION 2 OF 2 MUSCAT 0721

CHARGE ALSO MENTIONED RECENT OMANGOV DECISION TO SWITCH DIRECTION OF PROJECTED EASTERN DHOFAR OIL PIPELINE FROM SOUTHWARD TO NORTHWARD (SEE MUSCAT 0465 NOTAL), NOTING THERE IS WIDESPREAD SPECULATION LOCALLY THAT DECISION RELATES SOMEHOW TO SECURITY. AGAIN, DODSON EXPRESSED PUZZLEMENT AS TO WHAT BAIS OF THIS CONCERN MIGHT BE. HOWEVER, HE DID REFER TO THE SULTANATE'S "FIRQA" TRIBAL LEVIES OPERATING IN THE DHOFAR MOUNTAINS (MAINLY FORMER PFLO REBELS) AS A WEAK LINK IN DHOFAR'S DEFENSES. THEIR FUNDAMENTAL LOYALTY IS UNCERTAIN. EVEN THOUGH MANY OF THEM MAY KNOW WHERE THE 50-ODD HOLED-UP PFLO CADRES ARE HIDING, THEY DO VERY LITTLE TOHELP THE GOVERNMENT UNCOVER THESE LAST REMAINING ENEMY.

CHARGE POINTED OUT THE RESURRECTED DESIGNATION "PFLOAG" IN THE FBIS ITEM, ASKING IF THERE WERE ANY SIGNIFICANCE IN IT. DODSON KNEW OF NONE, BUT SPECULATED THAT IT COULD SIGNAL A NEW PFLO STRATEGY THT SOLF HAS LONG HALF-EXPECTED, NAMELY A REDUCED EMPHASIS ON ARMED INSURGENCY IN DHOFAR AND A FOCUS ON TERRORISM IN NORTHERN OMAN AND THE COUNTRIES UP THE GULF. COMMENTS

THE ABOVE BRIEFING CONFIRMS PICTURE WE HAVE GOTTEN FROM THE OMANI MILITARY FOR ABOUT TWO YEARS RUNNING. THEME IS THAT PEACE PREVAILS IN DHOFAR MARRED ONLY NW AND THEN BY INCIDENTS LIKE THIS ONE. SUCH EVENTS ARE UNIMPORTANT IN THEMSELVES BUT SERVE AS REMINDER THAT SULTAN'S ENEMY IS STILL THERE.

UNLESS THE REMAINING PFLO CADRES ARE TOTALLY WEEDED OUTAND THAT DOESN'T SEEM TO BE IN THE CARDS - THE DANGER OF AN EVENTUAL REVIVAL OF THE REBELLION IN SOME FORM REMAINS. THE OMANIS ARE WELL AWARE OF THIS. WHETHER OR NOT RENEWED INSURGENCY ACTUALLY OCCURS WILL DEPEND ON A VARIETY OF FACTORS, INCLUDING EXTERNAL ONES BEYOND OMANI CONTROL. RECENT EVENTS IN THE HORN OF AFRICA AND AFGHANISTAN HAVE MADE OMANI POLITICAL LEADERS A BIT JITTERY, OR ATLEAST SO THEY SAY TO ANYBODY WHO WILL LISTEN (SEE MUSCAT A-23 OF 5/10/78).
BUT THE EVIDENCE CLOSE AT HAND, AS SEEN BY THE OMANI MILITARY WATCHING THE BORDER AND THE PFLO IN DHOFAR, FAILS TO SHOW DANGER IN THE IMMEDIATE PERIOD AHEAD.
REF (A) MUSCAT 0844, (B) TEHRAN 5770 REF A'S NOFORN CAPTION WAS PROMPTED BY PARENTHETICAL REFERENCE IN PARA 2. WE SEE NO RPT NO PROBLEM IN YOUR DISCUSSING SUBSTANCE OF REF A WITH IRANIAN OFFICIALS.

1978NDJAME00544.subject: CHADIATS TO SEND DELEGATION TO IRAN SEQUENT TO PRESIDENT MALLOUM FEBRUARY 8 PLEA TO THE DIPLOMATIC CORPS FOR OUTSIDE MILITARY ASSISTANCE F

segments.text: SUBSEQUENT TO PRESIDENT MALLOUM FEBRUARY 8 PLEA TO THE DIPLOMATIC CORPS FOR OUTSIDE MILITARY ASSISTANCE FOR CHAD, HE TOOK ME ASIDE TO TELL ME THAT HE HAD INSTRUCTED HIS AMBASSADOR IN PARIS TO APPROACH THE IRANIAN AMBASSADOR THERE ABOUT SENDING A DELEGATION TO TEHRAN TO DISCUSS THE TRANSFER OF AMERICAN MILITARY EQUIPMENT TO CHAD.

MAHMUD GHAZI IS STAYING WITH MAJOR ABDUL RAHIM WARDAK, ASSISTANT MILITARY ATTACHE, AFGHAN EMBASSY. ADDRESS IS N-24, PANCHSHEELA PARK, EW DELHI, TELEPHONE NUMBER 650936. MAJOR RAHIM SEEMS TO BE "FRIENDLY".

MAHMUD DROPPED OUT OF THE AMERICAN EMBASSY SCHOOL AFTER CHRISTMAS. HE IS IN GOOD HEALTH AND WAS SEEN AT THE SCHOOL LAST WEEK. OUR SCHOOL DIRECTOR TOLD ME THAT MAHMUD IS AT LOOSE ENDS, DOES NOT KNOW WHERE TO TURN AND HAS NO NEWS OF HIS FAILY. I HAVE PUT OUT WORD IN VARIOUS DIRECTIONS THAT I WOULD LIKE TO SEE HIM.
HAMIDOLLAH ENAYAT-SERAJ HAS MOVED OUT OF RESIDENCE AND IS NOW IN ASHOKA HOTEL. I HAVE BEEN IN TOUCH WITH HIM BY PHONE AND MAIL AND EXPECT TO SEE HIM SOON. HIS ONWARD PLANS ARE STILL INDEFINITE.
PLEASE EXTEND MY WARM REGARDS TO AMBASSAODR MALIKYAR.

I SAW MAHMUD GHAZI ON MORNING MAY 19. HIS MOTHER HAD CONTACTED HIM BY PHONE AND SENT HIM ONE-WAY PREPAID TICKET TO GENEVA. SWISS AIR HERE WAS UNWILLING TO ISSUE VISA WITHOUT RETURN TICKET. I HAVE CONTACTED SWISS EMBASSY TO EXPLAIN MAHMUD'S SITUATION, AND HE HAS APPOINTMENT THERE THIS AFTERNOON. SWISS EMBASSY MAY HAVE TO GET APPROVAL FROM BERN TO ISSUE VISA. MAHMUD ALSO HAS TO OBTAIN INDIAN EXIT PERMIT. TENTATIVELY HE HAS RESERVATION ON SWISS AIR MAY 23.

MAHMUD SEEMS IN GOOD SPIRITS, AND SAYS HE HAS ENOUGH MONEY. HE HAS MOVED FROM HOUSE OF MAJOR RAHIM, WHO IS BEING CALLED BACK TO KABUL, AND IS NOW STAYING AT CLARIDGES HOTEL. MAHMUD SAYS HE HAS NOT BEEN CONTACTED BY AMBASSADOR ENAYAT-SERAJ NOR ANY OTHER AFGHAN EMBASSY OFFICIAL, FRIENDLY OR NO.

1978NEWDE08132.subject: POSSIBLE VISIT BY VAJPAYEE TO TEHRAN

segments.text: IN CONNECTION WITH THE RECOMMENDATION MADE IN PARA 7 REFTEL, WHICH WE STRONGLY SECOND, YOU SHOULD KNOW THAT MEA TELLS US THAT THERE IS A GOOD POSSIBILITY THAT FOREIGN MINISTER VAJPAYEE WILL STOP OFF FOR A DAY IN TEHRAN ABOUT MAY 27 EN ROUTE TO THE SSOD. A REPORT OF THIS POSSIBILITY APPEARED IN A TEHRAN DATELINED STORY IN THE "INDIAN EXPRESS" THIS MORNING.

1978NEWDE10379.subject: SOVIET VIEWS ON THE SUBCONTINENT AND BEYOND DURING AN EXTENDED CONVERSATION WITH THE SOVIET AMBASSADOR ON JULY 6 HE MADE A NUMBER OF OBSERVATIONS TH AT MA

segments.text: DURING AN EXTENDED CONVERSATION WITH THE SOVIET AMBASSADOR ON JULY 6 HE MADE A NUMBER OF OBSERVATIONS THAT MAY BE WORTH NOTICE.

HE HOPED OUR GOVERNMENT WOULD CONTINUE TO SEE THE IMPORTANCE OF KEEPING SALT NEGOTIATIONS DE-LINKED FROM OTHER ISSUES SUCH AS THE PROBLEMS IN AFRICA. IN THAT CONNECTION HE SAID THERE HAD BEEN A GREAT ARGUMENT IN MOSCOW ABOUT WHETHER SALT I NEGOTIATIONS SHOULD BE CARRIED ON WHILE WE WERE BOMBING HANOI, BUT FORTUNATELY THOSE IN FAVOR OF DE-LINKAGE PREVAILED OR THERE MIGHT NEVER HAVE BEEN A SALT I AGREEMENT.

HE SAID HIS GOVERNMENT WAS VERY SATISFIED WITH A VERTICAL INDIA TILTED NEITHER TOWARDS US OR TWARD THEM, WHICH HAD BEEN MY DESCRIPTION OF THE GOI'S POLICY OF "GENUINE NONALIGNMENT." HE ADDED THAT THE USSR'S MAJOR INTEREST WAS IN THE STABILITY OF THE AREA.

IN RELATION TO THE SITUATION POSED BY THE NEW GOVERNMENT IN AFGHANISTAN, HE EXPRESSED CONCERN AT THE APPARENT NERVOUSNESS OF PAKISTAN AND IRAN, REITERATED RUSSIA'S INTEREST IN REGTIONAL STABILITY, AND VERY POINTEDLY HOPED THAT WE WOULD NOT DISTURB IT BY INITIATING A PROGRAM OF ARMS SUPPLY FOR PAKISTAN.

THAT LED ME TO RAISE INDIA'S INTEREST IN DPSA'S. VORONTSOV VOLUNTEERED QUITE EMPHATICALLY THAT THE USSR HAD NO INTEREST IN PROVIDING INDIA WITH DPSA'S, ONLY FIGHTERS. HE CHARACTERIZED THE MIG 23 AND MIG 25 AS "INTERCEPTORS," NOT "STRIKE" AIRCRAFT. AS COULD BE EXPECTED, HE THOUGHT THE USA SHOULD LEAN ON THE BRITISH AND FRENCH NOT TO SELL THEIR DPSA'S HERE.

VORONTSOV IS AN AFFABLE, CHARMING, AND OBVIOUSLY VERY BRIGHT FELLOW. I THINK HIS ASSURANCES ABOUT A VERTICAL INDIA, A NON-ALIGNED AFGHANISTAN, AND THE DPSA'S WERE QUITE DELIBERATELY GILDING THE VARIOUS LILIES.

1978NEWDE14538.subject: MEA RESPONSE TO MIDDLE EAST PEACE EFFORT

segments.text: I MET WITH FONSEC MEHTA THIS AFTERNOOM, WENT OVER QUITE THOROUGHLY THE POINTS MADE IN THE GUIDANCE REFTELS, AND LEFT HIM A NON-PAPER ADAPTED FROM THE FIRST OF THOSE TELEGRAMS. HE LISTENED CLOSELY, EXPRESSED APPRECIATION FOR THE BRIEFING, BUT INDICATED THAT GOI WAS UNLIKELY TO GIVE THE CAMP DAVID AGREEMENTS ANY MORE THAN THE VERY LIMITED SUPPORT THAT IT HAD ALREADY (NEW DELHI 14494).

MEHTA SAID THAT THE GOI HAD BEEN UNDER HEAVY PRESSURE FROM OTHER SOURCES TO RENOUNCE THE AGREEMENTS COMPLETELY. IT WOULD NOT DO THAT AND HAD INSTEAD DESCRIBED THE CAMP DAVID AGREEMENTS AS GENUINE EFFORTS TO ADVANCE PEACE. HE INDICATED THAT THE GOI'S SUPPORT WOULD REMAIN AT THAT LEVEL OF HIGH AND VAGUE GENERALITY UNLESS SOME DRAMATIC NEW DEVELOPMENTS COME OUT OF SECRETARY VANCE'S VISITS TO SAUDIA ARABIA, SYRIA, AND JORDAN.

THE EMBASSY HAS FOUND THE DETAILED EMBASSY TEHRAN POLITICAL SECURITY REPORTS MOST USEFUL IN KEEPING IN TOUCH WITH DAY-TO-DAY DEVELOPMENTS ON THE IRANIAN SCENE. IN LIGHT OF THE HIGH INDIAN INTEREST IN IRAN AND OUR ONGOING CONVERSATIONS WITH GOI OFFICIALS ABOUT PROSPECTS THERE (SEE SEPTEL), IT WOULD ALSO BE VERY BENEFICIAL FOR US TO RECEIVE COPIES OF ANY OF THE MORE FAR-REACHING ASSESSMENTS WHICH EMBASSY TEHRAN OR DEPARTMENT OFFICES PREPARE

1978NICOSI03289.subject: MEETING WITH PRC AMBASSADOR TO IRAN

segments.text: CYPRUS IS SITE FOR NUMEROUS COMMUNIST-SPONSORED CONFERENCES, WHICH FREQUENTLY HAVE SOVIET OFFICIAL OR NON- OFFICIAL DELEGATES ATTENDING. HOWEVER, THERE HAVE BEEN NO SOVIET CONFERENCES HERE, AS SUCH, NOR HAVE ANY SENIOR SOVIET OFFICIALS VISITED CYPRUS IN PAST YEAR.

ACCORDING TO PRESS REPORTS HERE, KHOMEINI IS CURRENTLY RESIDING IN SUBURBS OF PARIS, AND HAS TAKEN NO DECISION YET AS TO WHETHER HE WILL STAY HERE OR MOVE TO ANOTHER LOCATION. TWO FRENCH OFFICIALS REPORTEDLY VISITED HIM TO ASK THAT HE ABSTAIN FROM ANY POLITICAL ACTIONS WHILE IN FRANCE. AS A RESULT HE REPORTEDLY CANCELLED A PRESS CONFERENCE HE WAS PLANNING. HE APPEARED BRIEFLY ON FRENCH TV OCTOBER 10, SAYING HE WOULD MAKE NO POLITICAL DECLARATION AT THIS TIME.

NEVERTHELESS, A MEMBER OF HIS ENTOURAGE WAS QUOTED BY AGENCE FRANCE PRESS AS SAYING HE WOULD ACCOMPLISH HIS ISLAMIC MISSION WHATEVER THE PRICE AND WOULD NOT REMAIN SILENT "EVEN IF HE HAS TO GO FROM ONE AIRPORT TO ANOTHER TO MAKE DECLARATIONS."

QUAI IRAN DESK OFFICER CONFIRMED THAT KHOMEINI ARRIVED IN FRANCE WITHOUT ADVANCE CONSULTATIONS WITH FRENCH, SINCE HE TRAVELS AS AN IRANIAN AND DID NOT NEED A VISA. QUAI OFFICIAL SAYS IT IS NORMAL FOR PERSONS IN KHOMEINI'S POSITION TO ABSTAIN FROM POLITICAL ACTIVITY IN FRANCE, BUT NOTED THAT POLITICAL LEADERS IN THIS STATUS HAVE OFTEN ENGAGED IN POLITICAL ACTIVITY IN FRANCE IN THE PAST, PROVIDED SUCH ACTIVITIES WERE CARRIED OUT WITH DISCRETION. HARTMAN

TO OUR KNOWLEDGE, KHOMEINI HAS NOT REPEAT NOT HELD A REAL "INTERVIEW" SINCE HE HAS BEEN IN PARIS. A "COMMUNIQUE" WAS ISSUED ON HIS BEHALF WHEN HE ARRIVED, BUT SINCE THEN HE APPEARS TO HAVE AVOIDED COMMENTS TO THE PRESS AND IS EVIDENTLY TRYING TO RESPECT THE CONDITIONS THE FRENCH HAVE SET FOR HIS STAY HERE (SEE REFTEL B). WE UNDERSTAND, FOR EXAMPLE, THAT HE HAS REFUSED A REQUEST FOR AN INTERVIEW BY PARIS MATCH.

KHOMEINI'S STAY HERE HAS THUS FAR ATTRACTED ONLY MODERATE PRESS ATTENTION. HE HAS MOVED TO A SMALL TOWN ABOUT FORTY KILOMETERS FROM PARIS, AND IS REPORTEDLY RECEIVING NUMEROUS MOSLEM VISITORS THERE. HE WAS SHOWN DOING THIS IN A PHOTO ON THE FRONT PAGE OF THE INTERNATIONAL HERALD TRIBUNE OCT. 12. HOWEVER, HIS ENTOURAGE HAS BEEN QUOTED REPEATEDLY AS SAYING THAT HE WILL NOT MAKE POLITICAL STATEMENTS IN FRANCE, AND WILL LIMIT HIMSELF TO RECEIVING THE FAITHFUL. HIS ENTOURAGE ALSO HAS BEEN REPORTED AS THINKING THAT KHOMEINI WOULD LEAVE FRANCE FOR A MOSLEM COUNTRY SO AS TO BE ABLE TO SPEAK MORE FREELY IN A MORE SYMPATHETIC ENVIRONMENT.

THE COMMUNIQUE WHICH WAS ISSUED ON KHOMEINI'S ARRIVAL HAS NOT BEEN PUBLISHED IN FULL IN THE FRENCH PRESS. THE LARGEST EXTRACTS FROM IT APPEARED IN ARTICLES IN LA LIBERATION OF OCT. 9 AND LE MONDE OF OCT. 10. THE RELEVANT PARTS OF THESE ARTICLES ARE QUOTED BELOW (INFORMAL EMBASSY TRANSLATIONS).

LA LIBERATION ARTICLE: IN A COMMUNIQUE RECEIVED IN PARIS SATURDAY NIGHT THE AYATOLLAH EXPLAINED THE REASONS FOR HIS DEPARTURE FROM NADJAF. THE IRANIAN AUTHORITIES HAD EXPRESSLY INVITED HIM TO ABSTAIN FROM ANY DECLARATIONS OR INTERVIEWS HOSTILE TO THE SHAH. FIFTEEN YEARS AGO KHOMEINI MADE A CALL "TO PURSUE THE FIGHT UP TO THE OVERTHROW OF THE REGIME OF THE PAHLAVIS AND THE INSTALLATION OF AN ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT," AND HE HAD NO INTENTION OF GOING BACK ON HIS DESIRE.

THE CALLS THUS CONTINUED AND TOWARD THE MIDDLE OF THE MONTH OF RAMADAN THE IRAKIAN AUTHORITIES LET HIM KNOW THAT THEY COULD NOT FROM THEN ON "ACCEPT HIS ACTIVITIES BECAUSE OF THEIR RELATIONS WITH THE IRANIAN REGIME." THE AYATOLLAH REPLIED "IF YOU HAVE RESPONSIBILITIES BEFORE THE IRANIAN REGIME, I TOO AM RESPONSIBLE BEFORE ISLAM AND THE IRANIAN PEOPLE AND I MUST ASSUME MY DIVINE AND SPIRITUAL TASK." HIS HOUSE WAS THEN ENCIRCLED BY THE POLICE AND ONLY KHOMEINI'S SON COULD STILL CIRCULATE TO OBTAIN PROVISIONS.

IF I HAD STAYED, ADDS THE AYATOLLAH, "I WOULD HAVE FELT MYSELF GUILTY BEFORE THE IRANIAN PEOPLE AND BEFORE THE MEN AND WOMEN WHO HAVE LOST THEIR YOUNG FOR THE CAUSE OF ISLAM." "HIS EMMINENCE," CONCLUDES THE COMMUNIQUE, "HAS DECIDED TO CONTINUE THE FIGHT FOR THE REALIZATION OF THE ISLAMIC CAUSE UNTIL THE END AND EVERYWHERE." END .

LE MONDE ARTICLE: IN HIS STATEMENT, THE POLITICAL AND SPIRITUAL CHIITE LEADER LISTS THE MAIN OBJECTIVES OF THE STRUGGLE AGAINST THE "IMPERIAL DESPOTISM," CONDEMNING IMPLICITLY THE "AMINI SOLUTION," -- AFTER THE NAME OF PRIME MINISTER ALI AMINI WHO RECENTLY PROPOSED A PLAN AIMED AT SAVING THE MONARCHY OF THE PHALEVIS BY INSURING ONE WAY OR ANOTHER THE TRANSITORY OR DEFINITIVE WITHDRAWAL OF THE SOVEREIGN. "TO AGREE EXPLICITLY WITH THE MAINTAINING OF THE MONARCHY OR TO ACCEPT PROJECTS WHICH WILL SAFEGUARD ITS SURVIVAL ARE EQUAL TO A BETRAYAL OF ISLAM AND OF THE KORAN, OF THE MOSLEMS AND OF IRAN.

IT IS NECESSARY TO REJECT SUCH PLANS AS WELL AS THE INDIVIDUAL WHO FAVORS THEM." THE AYATOLLAH KHOMEINY ------------------018282 131113Z /11 FM AMEMBASSY PARIS TO AMEMBASSY TEHRAN PRIORITY INFO SECSTATE WASHDC 8755 GOES ON TO ASK FOR THE DISMISSAL AND TRIAL OF ALL THE PEOPLE WHO HAD IMPORTANT FUNCTIONS IN THE SERVICE OF THE PAHLEVI DYNASTY. "THERE ARE NO BASIC DIFFERENCES BETWEEN THE PEOPLE WHO FAVOR THE GOVERNMENT AND THOSE WHO, BY OPPORTUNISM AND DUPLICITY, HAVE BECOME OPPONENTS, AND ARE NOISILY TALKING OF FREE ELECTIONS AND THE APPLICATION OF THE CONSTITUTION.

THEIR COMMON OBJECTIVE IS TO PRESERVE THE SHAH AND TO PERPETUATE THE RANSACKING OF OUR WEALTH." THE CHIITE SPIRITUAL LEADER ALSO ASSERTS THAT "THE MOST IMPORTANT OBJECTIVE OF THE IRANIANS IS THE ELIMINATION OF ALL FOREIGN DOMINATION WHATEVER.

ANY POLITICAL REGIME WHICH COMES TO POWER THANKS TO THE INTERVENTION OF FOREIGN POWERS, ESPECIALLY THE U.S., THE USSR AND GREAT BRITAIN, WILL BE AN INSTRUMENT TO MAINMAINTAIN THE NATION IN REGRESSION, DISTRESS, OPPRESSION, RANSACKING AND DESPOTISM." FINALLY, THE AYATOLLAH KHOMEINY EXPOSED "THE DUTIES OF THE STUDENTS AND OF THE PUPILS: TO INCITE THE ARMY TO BREAK THE CHAINS OF DOMINATION AND TO LIBERATE ITSELF FROM THE SHAME OF BEING LED BY FOREIGN COUNSELLORS, TO ENCOURAGE A GENERAL UPHEAVAL AND TO BE VIGILANT REGARDING THE PROVOCATIONS AND THE DIVERSIONS ORGANIZED BY GOVERNMENTAL ELEMENTS WHO WANT TO FRIGHTEN THE POPULATION BY PASSING ON COMMUNIST ORDERS." UNQUOTE.

SUBSEQUENT TO TRANSMITTAL OF SEPTEL REPLYING TO TEHRAN 9906, KHOMEINY HAS ISSUED ANOTHER COMMUNIQUE DATED OCTOBER 12. ACCORDING TO PRESS REPORTS, THE COMMUNIQUE PROCLAIMS OCTOBER 16 A DAY OF NATIONAL MOURNING IN IRAN, AS THE FORTIETH DAY "AFTER THE MASSACRE OF DEMONSTRATORS IN TEHRAN." COMMUNIQUE ALSO ANNOUNCES KHOMEINY'S DECISION TO LEAVE FRANCE FOR A MOSLEM COUNTRY AS SOON AS HE RECEIVED AN INVITATION TO DO SO.

KHOMEINY'S COMMUNIQUE CALLS FOR THE UNITY OF ALL MOSLEM SECTS IN IRAN AND THE PARTICIPATION OF THE MILITARY IN THE FIGHT "UNTIL THE END OF THE DOMINATION BY THE SUPER-POWERS WHICH HAVE STOLEN OUR OIL AND UNTIL THE INDEPENDENCE OF IRAN." IT STRONGLY CRITICIZES PRESIDENT CARTER FOR SUPPORTING THE SHAH.

EXTRACTS FROM THE COMMUNIQUE WHICH HAVE BEEN PUBLISHED HERE FOLLOW (INFORMAL TRANSLATION): "THE FORTIETH DAY AFTER THE MASSACRE OF TEHRAN APPROACHES AND MARTIAL LAW AND THE EVIL IMPERIAL SYSTEM CONTINUE, PUTTING IN DANGER OUR DESTINY TODAY AND OUR FUTURE TOMORROW.

THE SUPERPOWERS WHICH OPPRESS US AND WHICH STEAL OUR RICHES ARE WORKING THROUGH THE SHAH." "WE WILL CONTINUE THE FIGHT AGAINST THE DOMINATION OF THE SUPERPOWERS WHICH STEAL OUR OIL UNTIL IRAN RECOVERS ITS LIBERTY AND ITS INDEPENDENCE." "GREAT PEOPLE OF IRAN; THE HISTORY OF OUR COUNTRY HAS NEVER KNOWN A MOVEMENT OF SUCH SIZE, A MOVEMENT WHICH SEES YOUNG CHILDREN AND OLD MEN, WOMEN WITH THEIR BABES IN ARMS, RUN BEFORE BULLETS TO SAVE THEIR COUNTRY AND ISLAM." "CHILDREN AND OLD MEN, ALL THE PEOPLE CRY OUT 'DOWN WITH THE SHAH' IN SUCH A WAY THAT THE SHAH HAS GONE MAD." "YOUR ROAD IS THE ROAD OF GOD AND YOU ARE AS THE FIGHTERS WHO FIGHT ALONGSIDE THE PROPHET AND THE IMAMS FOR THE LIBERATION OF MANKIND." "UNIFY YOURSELVES, FIRM UP THE FRONT OF ALL THE MOSLEM SECTS AND BRING ABOUT THE PARTICIPATION OF THE MILITARY IN THE MOVEMENT OF UNITY." "TRANSMIT MY WARM GREETINGS TO THE MILITARY AND TELL THEM THAT THOSE WHO ARE KILLED BY THEIR MACHINE GUNS ARE THEIR BROTHERS AND SISTERS, TELL THEM THAT THEY SHOULD NOT KILL TO SATISFY THE CRIMINAL DESIGNS OF THE SHAH."
ICA PARIS SENDING COMPLETE TEXT TELEGRAPHICALLY OF SHAH INTERVIEW.

1978PARIS35309.subject: AYATOLLAH KHOMEINY INTERVIEW WITH AFP FOLLOWING IS TEXT OF AFP ITEM CONTAINING OCTOBER 25 INTERVIEW WITH AYATOLLAH

segments.text: FOLLOWING IS TEXT OF AFP ITEM CONTAINING OCTOBER 25 INTERVIEW WITH AYATOLLAH: BEGIN TEXT: AYATOLLAH KHOMEINY, WHO DIRECTS FROM HIS PARIS EXILE , THE RELIGIOUS OPPOSITION TO THE REGIME OF THE SHAH WEDNESDAY REJECTED ALL POSSIBILITY OF A COMMON STRATEGY WITH THE POLITICAL OPPOSITION FOR THE INSTALLATION OF A TRANSITION GOVERNMENT AS LONG AS THE SOVEREIGN HAS NOT LEFT THE COUNTRY. "REPLYING TO AFP QUESTIONS THE CHIEF IRANIAN SHIITE PRONOUNCED HIMSELF FOR CONTINUATION OF A WAR OF ATTRITION AGAINST IRANIAN GOVERNMENT UNTIL VICTORY. "I HAVE BEEN FROM THE BEGINNING AND REMAIN IRREVOCABLY OPPOSED TO CONCILIATION AND COMPROMISE WHICH CANNOT EITHER GET IRAN OUT OF ITS IMPASSE OR END REPRESSION AND MASSACRES," AFFIRMED AYATOLLAH. "IF THE ENTIRE IRANIAN PUBLIC OPINION RANGES ITSELF WITH THE IDEA THAT THE REGIME MUST GO, THE REGIME WILL BE OBLIGED TO RENOUNCE REPRESSION AND THE HOUR OF THE PEOPLES VICTORY WILL BE HASTENED." AYATOLLAH DECLARED THAT HE DID NOT FEAR A AGGRAVATION OF SOCIAL AND ECONOMIC CHAOS BECAUSE OF THE ABSENCE OF POWER. "A VOID ALREADY EXISTS IN IRAN.
THE ONLY MEANS OF GETTING OUT OF IT IS THE ADVENT OF A REGIME ELECTED BY THE MUSLIM PEOPLE.

THOSE WHO WILL BE SHOWN CAPABLE OF OVERTHROWING THE REGIME WILL ALSO BE CAPEBLE OF RUNNING THE COUNTRY." QUESTIONED ON THE DANGER OF BEING OUTFLANKED BY THE COMMUNIST LEFT, AYATOLLAH EXPRESSED HIS CONVICTION THAT THE YOUNG MALCONTENTS WHO TODAY CLAIM COMMUNISM, WILL TOMORROW RALLY TO THE ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT. "EVEN SUPPOSING THOSE WHO DEMONSTRATE WITH COMMUNIST SLOGANS ARE MARXISTS, THEY DO NOT CONSTITUTE A FORCE IN THE FACE OF THIRTY MILLION PERSIANSWHO ARE IN REVOLT IN THE NAME OF ISLAM. "AFTER THE INSTALLATION OF AN ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT AND THE ENLARGEMENT OF LIBERTIES AND THE CHANCES FOR PROGRESS WHICH WILL ACCOMPANY IT, IT WILL BE POSSIBLE TO DRAW TO ISLAM THOSE WHO SEARCH FOR TRUTH AND JUSTICE." AYATOLLAH REAFFIRMED IN THE CLEAREST TERMS HIS DETERMINATION NOT TO END HIS VOLUNTARY EXILE--WHICH HAS LASTED FIFTEEN YEARS. "AS LONG AS THE SHAH REMAINS IN POWER I WILL NOT RETURN TO IRAN." DOES NOT AYATOLLAH FEAR UPSETTING WESTERN OPINION BY THE ANATHEMAS THAT HE CEASELESSLY LANCES AGAINST THE GREAT POWERS?" I CONDEMN VIOLATIONS OF HUMAN RIGHTS BY THE GREAT POWERS AND NOT THE PEOPLES OF THESE COUNTRIES.

I HAVE THANKED AND CONTINUE TO THANK THE PEOPLES OF THE WEST SHO HAVE SUPPORTED THE REVOLT OF THE IRANIAN PEOPLE." AYATOLLAH REMAINED DISCRETE ON THE SUBJECT OF THE CONSULTATIONS WHICH HE HAS JUST BEGUN WITH REPRESENTATIVES OF THE POLITICAL OPPOSITION IN IRAN. IN THIS REGARD ONE RECALLS THAT HE HAS HAD THREE INTERVIEWS WITH DR. MEHDI BARZAGAN, PRESIDENT OF THE MOVEMENT FOR LIBERTY IN IRAN; THAT HE HAS RECEIVED MR. NASSER MINACHI, ONE OF THE TWO "BOSSES" OF THE TEHRAN BAZAAR; AND THAT HE IS AWAITING THE VISIT OF MR. KARIM SANDJABI, PRESIDENT OF THE NATIONAL FRONT.

AFTER THE COLLECTIVE PRAYER TUESDAY, AYATOLLAH DECLARED THAT HE HAD "BEGUN TO EXPLAIN HIS POSITION TO HIS VISITORS AND THESE HAVE NOT EXPRESSED OPPOSITION TO HIS VIEWS." FINALLY, IN RESPONSE TO A QUESTION ON HIS CONSULTATIONS, HE WAS AT PAINS TO SAY THAT NUMEROUS COMPETENT IRANIANS WHICH THE REGIME OF THE SHAH HAS NEVER CALLED UPON GAVE HIM THE NECESSARY INFORMATION AND SHARED WITH HIM THEIR OPINIONS. .

1978PARIS36316.subject: SETTLEMENT BY AYATOLLAH KHOMEINY FOLLOWING IS COMPLETE TEXT OF AFP ITEM REPORTING AYATOLLAH KHOMEINY INTERVIEW GIVEN TO RADIO LUXEMB

segments.text: FOLLOWING IS COMPLETE TEXT OF AFP ITEM REPORTING AYATOLLAH KHOMEINY INTERVIEW GIVEN TO RADIO LUXEMBOURG: BEGIN TEXT AYATOLLAH KHOMEINY, LEADER OF THE IRANIAN RELIGIOUS OPPOSITION, REFUSES ANY COMPROMISE WITH THE SHAH WHOSE OVERTHROW HE DEMANDS WHILE THREATENING TO UNLEASH CIVIL WAR. "THE SHAH AND HIS DYNASTY MUST LEAVE" HE AFFIRMED. "THE SHAH ASKS FOR A DIALOGUE WITH SEVERAL REPRESENTATIVES OF THE OPPOSITION, BUT IT IS TOO LATE. WE HAVE SAID TO MEMBERS OF THE OPPOSITION SUCH AS MESSRS.

ALI AMINI OR KARIM SANDJABI THAT IF THEY AGREED TO NEGOTIATE WITH THE SHAH THEY WOULD BE BANISHED FROM THE MOVEMENT" ADDED THE AYATOLLAH. "FOR AYATOLLAH KHOMEINY THE COUNTRIES WHICH SUPPORT THE SHAH MUST CEASE DOING SO. "IF THEY DO SO ONE WILL BE ABLE TO FIND A RAPID SOLUTION TO THE PROBLEM. IF NOT A CIVIL WAR WILL BREAK OUT IN IRAN. OUR GOAL IS TO ESTABLISH AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC AFTER HAVING ORGANIZED A REFERENDUM AND RESTORED THE PEOPLES' LIBERTY AND TOTAL INDEPENDENCE OF THE COUNTRY.

IT WILL BE NECESSARY," HE CONCLUDED, "TO RETURN AFFAIRS OF THE COUNTRY TO COMPETENT IRANIAN EXPERTS, REDUCE ARMAMENTS EXPENDITURES, AND REDO THE CONSTITUTION AND LAWS SUPPRESSING THE CLAUSES AND REFORMS BROUGHT BY THE SHAH AND HIS FATHER."

1978PARIS36703.subject: HERALD TRIBUNE AND WASHINGTON POST INTERVIEWS WITH AYATOLLAH KHOMEINY

segments.text: WITH AYATOLLAH KHOMEINY

RON KOVEN, PARIS BUREAU CHIEF OF THE WASHINGTON POST, AND JOE FITCHETT, CHIEF CORRESPONDENT OF THE HERALD TRIBUNE WERE GRANTED AN INTERVIEW WITH AYATOLLAH KHOMEINY NOVEMBER 6--SOON AFTER ANNOUNCEMENT OF MILITARY GOVERNMENT. IN THE FITCHETT ARTICLE FRONT-PAGED IN THE TRIB TODAY (NOVEMBER 7) KHOMEINY IS REPORTED TO HAVE TAKEN A HARD LINE AGAINST THE SHAH, CALLING ON THE MILITARY TO REFUSE TO TAKE ORDERS FROM THE "TRAITOR" SHAH AND WARNING OF ARMED RESISTANCE UNLESS THE CURRENT STRIKES AND PROTEST DEMONSTRATIONS SUCCEED IN ENDING THE MONARCHY. HE WAS OTHERWISE FAIRLY MODERATE IN DESCRIBING THE GOALS OF THE PROPOSED ISLAMIC REPUBLIC AND IN ATTITUDES TOWARDS WESTERN COUNTRIES.
(TEXT OF ARTICLE BEING TELEXED BY ICA TO EMBASSY TEHRAN.)

KOVEN (WHO SAID THAT THE ARTICLE HE SENT TO THE POST IS SIMILAR BUT CONTAINS MORE DIRECT QUOTES) GAVE US SOME BACKGROUND TO THE INTERVIEW. (PLEASE PROTECT.) KOVEN SAID THAT HE AND FITCHETT ARRIVED FOR THE INTERVIEW ABOUT 1100 BUT WHAT WITH GETTING THEIR WRITTEN QUESTIONS TRANSLATED AND WRITTEN RESPONSES BACK THEY DID NOT GET A FACE-TO-FACE INTERVIEW UNTIL ABOUT 1800. THIS DELAY PROVIDED AN OPPORTUNITY TO OBSERVE KHOMEINY AND HIS ENTOURAGE. KOVEN SAID THAT KHOMEINY SEEMED SPRY AND CHIPPER WHEN THEY FIRST ARRIVED BUT BY THE TIME OF SIX O'CLOCK PRAYERS HE APPEARED PALE, TIRED, AND WORN AND THE LITTLE FINGER OF HIS RIGH HAND TREMBLED UNCONTROLLABLY.

NONETHELESS, EVEN TOWARDS THE END OF THE DAY HE SEEMED SHARP AND LUCID. THOUGH HE DEALT THROUGH AIDES AND INTERPRETERS, HE DID NOT GIVE THE IMPRESSION OF BEING MANIPULATED BUT RATHER VERY MUCH IN COMMAND.

KHOMEINY'S AIDES WERE OPENLY CONTEMPTUOUS OF THE OPPOSITION POLITICAL LEADERS WHO COME TO SEE KHOMEINY. KHOMEINY DID NOT WANT TO SEE SANDJABI BUT FINALLY ACQUIESCED. THE FIRST MEETING WAS PRIVATE, THE SECOND "PUBLIC." SANDJABI GOT THE SECOND MEETING BY SAYING HE HAD CHANGED SOME ELEMENTS OF HIS POSITION. IN THE MEETING HE HAD READ OUT THREE POINTS AND KHOMEINY HAD ACKNOWLEDGED THEM. AFTERWARDS HE HAD MADE A UNILATERAL DECLARATION "FROM PONCHATRAIN"--DESIGNED TO ASSOCIATE IT IN THE PUBLIC MIND WITH KHOMEINY--WHICH HAD MADE KHOMEINY FURIOUS ACCORDING TO AN AIDE. AN AIDE DESCRIBED ALL THE STORIES ABOUT POLITICAL LEADERS HAVING "SUMMITS" WITH KHOMEINY AS NONSENSE.
NONE OF THEM REPRESENTS ANYTHING AT ALL IN IRAN AND KHOMEINY HAS NO INTEREST IN MAKING DEALS WITH THEM. BUT EITHER FROM COURTESY OR DISDAIN HE DOES NOT BOTHER TO DISAVOW THEM.

KOVEN SAID KHOMEINY IS LIVING IN A LOWER MIDDLE CLASS NEIGHBORHOOD OF THE PARIS SUBURB PONCHATRAIN. THE HOUSE WHERE HE LIVES WITH HIS FAMILY AND FOUR PERMANENT AIDES IS VERY MODEST. OTHER FOLLOWERS COME OUT FROM PARIS TO BE WITH HIM. THERE IS GENERALLY A PRETTY LARGE CROWD AND KHOMEINY GIVES THE IMPRESSION OF BEING QUITE ACCESSIBLE TO IRANIANS. AN AIDE TOLD KOVEN THAT THEY ARE LOOKING FOR MORE SUITABLE QUARTERS IN NEARBY VERSAILLES, NOT NECESSARILY MORE LUXURIOUS, BUT AT LEAST ADEQUATELY HEATED. THIS WOULD INDICATE THAT KHOMEINY HAS NO INTENTION OF LEAVING FRANCE IN THE NEAR FUTURE.

1978PARIS38987.subject: IRANIAN WALKIN HINTS AT THREAT TO EMBASSY TEHRAN POL COUNSELOR AND SAYS KHOMEINY HAS GIVEN ORDERS FOR BLOOD TO FLOW

segments.text: POL COUNSELOR AND SAYS KHOMEINY HAS GIVEN ORDERS FOR BLOOD TO FLOW

AT 1500 LOCAL EMBASSY OFFICER RECEIVED A YOUNG IRANIAN WHO HAD PREVIOUSLY CALLED FOR URGENT MEETING OUTSIDE OF EMBASSY, BUT SUBSEQUENTLY AGREED TO MEETING AT EMBASSY. IRANIAN, WHO IDENTIFIED HIMSELF ONLY AS AMAR AND REFUSED PROVIDE FURTHER IDENTIFICATION SAID HE IS HEAD OF COMMUNIST ORGANIZATION CALLED "MUJAHIDDIN OF THE IRANIAN PEOPLE." HIS AIM IN COMING TO THE EMBASSY WAS TO SELL INFORMATION ON IRANIAN OPPOSITION MOVEMENTS ABOUT WHICH HE CLAIMS BE FULLY INFORMED. AS INDICATION OF TYPE OF INFORMATION HE HAS AVAILABLE HE SAID THAT EMBASSY TEHRAN POL COUNSELOR LAMBRAKIS SHOULD NOT LET HIS WIFE PLAY TENNIS ANYMORE. HE SAID THAT THROUGH MRS.

LAMBRAKIS, AN ORGANIZATION WAS ABLE TO TRACK DOWN LAMBRAKIS AND INTENDED TO EXECUTE HIM. AMAR CLAIMED CREDIT FOR HAVING STOPPED THIS ACTION SOME TWO MONTHS AGO WHEN HE WAS IN IRAN. HE WOULD NOT FURTHER ELABORATE.

AMAR SAID THAT YESTERDAY, NOVEMBER 27, AYATOLLAH KHOMEINY HAD, BY MEANS OF AN INTERMEDIARY, SENT A MESSAGE TO HIS FOLLOWERS IN IRAN THAT "BLOOD SHOULD FLOW." AMAR SAID THAT KHOMEINY GROUP IS OBTAINING ARMS FROM LIBYA AND SMUGGLING THEM INTO IRAN VIA AFGHANISTAN. HE REFUSED TO ELABORATE FURTHER BUT SAID HE HAS INFORMATION ON QUANTITIES OF ARMS BEING SMUGGLED, THEIR ROUTE INTO IRAN, AND DESTINATIONS.

AMAR SAID THAT A DEMONSTRATION HAD BEEN PLANNED AGAINST AMERICAN EMBASSY PARIS SIMILAR TO THAT STAGED AGAINST CONSULATE GENERAL FRANKFURT BUT THAT "HE HAD MANAGED TO TURN IT OFF FOR THE MOMENT," BECAUSE IT WOULD HAVE WORKED AGAINST THE INTERESTS OF IRANIAN OPPOSITIONISTS IN FRANCE.
AMAR REFUSED TO GIVE EITHER HIS NAME OR NUMBER AT WHICH HE COULD BE REACHED BUT SAID HE WOULD SHORTLY AGAIN BE IN CONTACT WITH THE EMBASSY.

1978PEKING03702.subject: TRAVEL ADVISORY FOR TEHRAN MANY TRAVELLERS IN THE PEOPLE'S REPUBLIC OF CHINA PARTICI- PATING IN TOUR GROUPS ORGANIZED BY IRAN AIR HAVE E

segments.text: MANY TRAVELLERS IN THE PEOPLE'S REPUBLIC OF CHINA PARTICIPATING IN TOUR GROUPS ORGANIZED BY IRAN AIR HAVE EXPRESSED TO USLO APPREHENSION AT CONTINUING THEIR TRIPS WITH IRAN AIR AND CAAC FROM PEKING TO TEHRAN. 1978SANAA00692.subject: FONMIN ON POSSIBILITIES OF SETTLEMENT IN OGADEN

segments.text: SUMMARY: DURING FEB 13 MEETING, FONMIN ABDALLAH AL-ASNAJ OPINED THAT US PROPOSALS FOR PEACEFUL SETTLEMENT IN HORN ARE TOO LATE, WHILE EXPRESSING FEARS THAT SOMALI PRESIDENT SIAD BARRE WILL SOON FALL IN WAKE OF MASSIVE DEFEAT OF SOMALIA BY ETHIOKDZER NEXT 2 TO 3 WEEKS. ASNAJ NOTED THAT "FRIENDS" OF US IN AREA ARE "BITTER" ABOUT SEEMING UNWILLINGNESS OF U.S. TO UNDERSTAND SOVIET MACHINATIONS IN REGION. ASNAJ ALSO INFORMED ME HE IS URGING SAUDI ARABIA TO COORDINATE WITH IRAN TO HELP SOMALI BEFORE FINAL COLLAPSE AND HOPED THAT U.S. WOULD PERMIT SUCH AN EFFORT. END SUMMARY.

AT MY REQUEST, FONMIN AL-ASNAJ RECEIVED ME MORNING FEB 13 TO DISCUSS PROPOSALS MADE IN REFTEL. AFTER MY DETAILED PRESENTATION, ASNAJ REPLIED THAT, WHILE HE FULLY APPRECIATES US EFFORTS TO ACHIEVE A PEACEFUL SETTLEMENT IN HORN OF AFRICA, HE BELIEVES IT IS ALREADY TOO LATE AS BOTH EITHIOPA AND SOMALIA HAVE REJECTED THIS APPROACH.

ASNAJ CONTINUED THAT IT NOW APPEARS SOMALIA WILL BE COMPLETELY DEFEATED BY ETHIOPIA OVER THE NEXT 2 TO 3 WEEKS, FOLOWING WHICH A LEFTIST REGIMW WILL EMERGE TO RETURN TO SOMALIA AND TO THEIR FORMER BASE IN BERBERA. ASNAJ WENT ON TO SAY THAT BASED ON INFORMATION HE HAS RECEIVED FROM HIS EMBASSY IN MOSCOW, FOLLOWING THE OVERTHROW OF SIAD BARRE THE SOVIETS, CUBANS, ADENIS AND ETHIOPIANS WILL THEN PLAN TO TAKE ADVANTAGE OF THIS SETBACK TO MODERATE AND PRO-WESTERN FORCES IN THE HORN OF AFTRICA BY MOVING AGAINST THE PRO-WEST REGIMES IN SUDAN, OMAN AND YEMEN, WITH ULTIMATE OBJECTIVE BEING SAUDI ARABIA AND EGYPT.

ASNAJ OBSERVED THAT FRIENDS OF THE U.S. AND THE WEST IN THE REGION HAVE BECOME VERY DISHEARTENED BY WHAT THEY SEE AS AN UNWILLINGNESS OF THE US AND WEST TO HELP THEN WITHSTAND LEFTIST AND SOVIET UNITION MACHINATIONS. NOTING HIS RECENT RETURN FROM TALKS IN SAUDI ARABIA AND IN THE GULF, ASNAJ SAID THAT MANY HIGH-LEVEL OFFICIALS HE TALKED TO WER "BITTER" ABOUT THE SEEMING INCAPACITY OF U.S. POLICY-MAKERS TO REALIZE WHAT THE SOVIETS ARE UP TO IN THE LOWER RED SEA AREA.

ASNAJ SAID THAT IT IS QUITE OBVIOUS THAT THE SOVIET UNION IS TRYING TO OUTFLANK THE OIL-RICH MIDDLE EAST AFTER HAVING BEEN DEFRATED THERE BY MODERATE ARABS. HE WARNED THAT IF THE US DOES NOT PUT THE CURRENT SITUATION ON THE HORN OF AFRICA IN A LARGER MIDDLE EAST CONTEXT, THE US AND THE WEST WILL SERIOUSLY PAY FOR THIS MISTAKE IN THE FUTURE.

ASNAJ CONCLUDED THAT ON FEB 12 HE HAD SENT A STRONG APPEAL TO SAUDI ARABIA'S PRINCE FAISAL URGING THAT SAUDI ARABIA COORDINATE QUICKLY WITH IRAN TO HELP SOMALIA BEFORE SOMALIA FALLS AS RESULT OF BOTH ETHIOPIA'S OFFENSIVE BUT AS WELL AS INTERNAL LEFTIST PRESSURES. SEVERAL TIME HE EXPRESSED HEOPE THAT THE U.S. WILL ALLOW SAUDI ARABIA TO HELP SOMALIA IN THE SAME WAY THAT MOROCCO AND EGYPT HELPED ZAIRE.

IN THIS CONNECTION, ASNAJ NOTED THAT YEMEN HAS HELPED SOMALIA IN THE PAST WITH SMALL ARMS (1000 RIFLES) BUT IT IS NOT IN A POSITION TO ASSIST IN ANY MEANINGFUL WAY, EXCEPT AS A TRANSIT POINT IF CALLED UPON TO DO SO.

COMMENT: ASNAJ AND OTHERS IN THE YEMENI GOVERNMENT HAVE LONG BEEN EXPRESSING CONCERN ABOUT DEVELOPMENTS IN THE HORN AS THEY BELIEVE, RIGHTLY OR WRONGLY, THAT YEMEN MAY BE NEXT ON THE LIST IF SOVIETS ARE ABLE TO ENTRENCH THEMSELVES ON BOTH SIDES OF THE RED SEA. CERTAINLY IT CAN BE ASSUMED THAT ELEMENTS IN PDRY, WHO HAVE LONG URGING THE EXPORT OF REVOLUTION TO NORTH YEMEN AND ELSEWHERE IN THE PENINSULA, WILL BE EMBOLDENED BY A SUCCESS IN WHICH PDRY WILL HAVE ALSO PLAYED AN IMPORTANT ROLE.

1978SECTO01074.subject: STATUS AND PROSPECTS FOR PEACE NEGOTIATIONS

segments.text: FOLLOWING IS A REPORT ON THE SECRETARY'S THURSDAY MEETINGS IN JERUSALEM FOLLOWING EGYPTIAN DEPARTURE, MEETING WITH SADAT ON FRIDAY, TOGETHER WITH ASSESSMENT OF STATUS, PROSPECTS AND NEXT STEPS IN NEGOTIATION PROCESS. YOU MAY DRAW ON IT AS APPROPRIATE FOR BRIEFING HIGH LEVELS OF HOST GOVERNMENTS.

FOLLOWING DEPARTURE OF EGYPTIAN DELEGATION WEDNESDAY EVENING, SECRETARY MET THURSDAY WITH BEGIN AND DAYAN. THEY MADE SOME FURTHER PROGRESS IN REFINING LANGUAGE OF DECLARATION OF PRINCIPLES AND NARROWING DIFFERENCES ON CRUCIAL PALESTINIAN ASPECTS OF DECLARATION, AND OF COURSE NONE OF THE DRAFTING DONE IN JERUSALEM HAS FORMAL APPROVAL OF EITHER GOVERNMENT.

IN CAIRO ON FRIDAY, SADAT EXPLAINED HIS CUMULATIVE DISILLUSIONMENT WITH ISRAELI APPROACH TO NEGOTIATION AND WITH ISRAELI PUBLIC STATEMENTS OF PRECEDING SEVERAL DAYS. SADAT WAS ESPECIALLY CONCERNED BY ISRAELI CONTINUED INSISTENCE ON RETAINING SETTLEMENTS UNDER ISRAELI PROTECTION IN OCCUPIED TERRITORY BECAUSE HE FEELS THEY PUT IN QUESTION WHETHER ISRAEL'S OFFER TO RETURN TO SINAI TO EGYPTIAN SOVEREIGNTY IS GENUINE. HE REPEATEDLY DECLARED, "THEY CANNOT TREAD ON OTHER PEOPLE'S LAND AND SOVEREIGNTY." HE MADE CLEAR HIS PURPOSE IS STILL COMPREHENSIVE PEACE AGREEMENT. HE IS PREPARED TO CONTINUE WORKING FOR A DECLARATION WHICH WILL GET ISRAELI ADHERENCE TO PRINCIPLES THAT WOULD PERMIT BROADENING OF PEACE NEGOTIATIONS.

WE EXPLAINED PROGRESS MADE WEDNESDAY AND THURSDAY WITH BEGIN AND DAYAN ON DRAFT DECLARATION. SADAT AGREES THERE SHOULD BE A RHETORICAL COOLING-OFF PERIOD, ALTHOUGH HE FEELS NEED TO SET RECORD STRAIGHT AS HE SEES IT IN SPEECH TO NATIONAL ASSEMBLY. HE IS READY TO GO FORWARD WITH SECURITY COMMITTEE MEETING, AND WE ARE URGING ISRAEL TO CONTINUE WITH THE WORK OF THAT COMMITTEE. HE HAS REITERATED THAT DOOR IS STILL OPEN FOR PEACE.

OUR ASSESSMENT IS THAT, WHILE RECENT HIGH LEVEL OF HARSH RHETORIC AND INTERRUPTION OF JERUSALEM TALKS ARE UNFORTUNATE, DAMAGE IS NOT IRREPARABLE. WE BELIEVE PROGRESS CAN BE ACHIEVED IN FURTHER NARROWING GAPS ON DECLARATION LANGUAGE AND THAT MILITARY COMMITTEE COULD BE USEFUL IN GETTING PARTIES BACK INTO CONSTRUCTIVE NEGOTIATING ATMOSPHERE. ATHERTON RETURNING TO JERUSALEM AND WILL REMAIN IN AREA TO ACT AS APPROPRIATE IN HELPING TO KEEP PEACE PROCESS GOING.

WE URGE THAT EVERYONE AVOID FURTHER AGGRAVATING SITUATION AND AVOID LIKEWISE PREMATURE JUDGMENT ON RESULTS OF THIS PHASE OF NEGOTIATIONS. WE WILL CONTINUE TO WORK TOWARD BROADER NEGOTIATIONS AND TOWARD COMPREHENSIVE SETTLEMENT.
FYI. THERE ARE NO REPEAT NO PLANS FOR PRESIDENTIAL LEVEL SUMMIT, CONTRARY TO PRESS REPORTS, NOR SPECIFIC PLANS FOR A RETURN VISIT BY SECRETARY AT THIS TIME. END FYI.

FOR AMBASSADORS WEST AND PICKERING ONLY: YOU MAY TELL FAHD AND HUSSEIN MORE SPECIFICALLY THAT SADAT DID EXPRESS ENCOURAGEMENT AT PROGRESS MADE ON DRAFT DECLARATION IN JERUSALEM AND, WHILE HE STILL WANTED TO TALK FURTHER WITH HIS ADVISORS, HE IS PREPARED TO DISCUSS WITH US CONCRETE WAYS FOR BUILDING ON WORK ALREADY DONE SO AS TO REGAIN MOMENTUM. WE HAVE AGREED THAT WHATEVER IS TO BE DONE NEXT, IT SHOULD BE DONE THROUGH QUIET DIPLOMACY AT FIRST. THAT IS THE REAL REASON ATHERTON IS STAYING IN THE AREA, BUT WE DO NOT WANT TO CALL ATTENTION TO HIS ACTIVITIES.

1978SECTO11026.subject: SECRETARY'S MEETING WITH FOREIGN MINISTER AFSHAR-INTERNAL POLITICS

segments.text: AFSHAR-INTERNAL POLITICS

IN COURSE OF MEETING OCT 3 WITH FONMIN AFSHAR, AFSHAR ASSURED SECRETARY SHAH WAS DETERMINED TO CARRY OUT LIBERALIZATION POLICIES DESPITE "VERY HIGH PRICE". HE DESCRIBED BRIEFLY DETAILS OF GOVERNMENT'S PROGRAMS TO WIN POPULAR SUPPORT, E.G. LIBERALIZATION AND ANTI-CORRUPTION.

AFSHAR ASKED FOR STATE DEPARTMENT ASSESSMENT OF NATURE OF IRANIAN OPPOSITION, SPECIFICALLY WHETHER NATIONAL FRONT, AMINI AND SHARIAT MADARI WERE WORKING TOGETHER; WHETHER THEY HAD CONTACT WITH TUDEH PARTY AND WHETHER THERE WAS JOINT PLANNING BETWEEN IRANIAN OPPOSITION ELEMENTS.

IN REPLY, SAUNDERS ASKED WHETHER GOI FELT THAT LIBERALIZATION PROGRAM COULD SUCCEED IN DRAWING OFF OPPOSITION SUPPORT IN MANNER SIMILAR TO WAY IN WHICH ECONOMIC PROGRAMS AND PROGRESS HAD WEAKENED IRANIAN OPPOSITION SOME TEN YEARS AGO? WAS IT POSSIBLE THAT DEVELOPMENT OF NEW POLITICAL INSTITUTIONS MIGHT DRAW FANGS OF OPPOSITION? AFSHAR REPLIED THERE WAS LITTLE APPRECIATION EITHER IN IRAN OR ABROAD FOR EXTENT OF SIGNIFICANT CONCESSIONS GOI HAD MADE IN PROCESS OF POLITICAL LIBERALIZATION. SOME FRIENDS, HOWEVER, WERE SAYING THAT GOI SHOULD BE MORE GRADUAL IN ITS APPROACH TO REFORMS.

SECRETARY REFERRED TO PRESIDENT'S TELEPHONE CONVERSATION WITH THE SHAH AND PRESIDENT'S WILLINGNESS, IN RESPONSE TO SHAH'S REQUEST, TO ISSUE PUBLIC STATEMENT SUPPORTING SHAH AND HIS LIBERALIZATION PROGRAM. THE PACE OF SHAH'S LIBERALIZATION EFFORTS WOULD DEPEND NECESSARILY ON HIS OWN BEST JUDGMENT OF THE SITUATION, TAKING INTO ACCOUNT THE SEVERAL FACTORS AT WORK.

AFSHAR RAISED SUBJECT OF RUMORS OF US SUPPORT FOR IRANIAN OPPOSITION, SAYING PRESIDENT'S CALL HAD BEEN USEFUL IN CONVINCING IRANIAN PUBLIC OF US ATTITUDE TOWARD REGIME. SECRETARY AND SAUNDERS BOTH POLITELY BUT FIRMLY DISMISSED CANARD OF US ROLE WITH OPPOSITION. AFSHAR COUNTERED THAT SOME PEOPLE BELIEVED THAT US EMBASSY MAINTAINED CONTACTS WITH NATIONAL FRONT AND AMINI AND THEREFORE SUPPORTED OPPOSITION. DEPOFF EXPLAINED THAT AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN HAD INFORMED GOI THAT IN ORDER TO KEEP INFORMED ON COMPLEX IRANIAN POLITICAL DEVELOPMENTS, HIS STAFF WOULD HAVE OCCASIONAL, LOW-LEVEL CONVERSATIONS WITH CERTAIN INDIVIDUALS ASSOCIATED WITH OPPOSITION. THIS DID NOT IMPLY SUPPORT AND WAS CONDUCTED VERY DISCREETLY.

NO ONE FROM EMBASSY TO OUR KNOWLEDGE HAD EVER MET WITH AMINI. AFSHAR SAID HE FULLY UNDERSTOOD PROPER NATURE OF EMBASSY CONTACTS, BUT SUCH MEETINGS MIGHT BE MISUSED BY OPPOSITION TO MISREPRESENT US SUPPORT FOR THEIR OBJECTIVES. SECRETARY SAID IT WAS CLEARLY NOT US POLICY TO SUPPORT SHAH'S OPPOSITION.

REFERRING TO PRESIDENT/SHAH CONVERSATION, SECRETARY ASKED AFSHAR IF THERE WAS ANYTHING FURTHER US COULD DO TO DEMONSTRATE SUPPORT FOR GOI OR TO BE HELPFUL IN DIFFICULT CIRCUMSTANCES. AFSHAR EXPRESSED DEEP APPRECIATION FOR SECRETARY'S INTEREST AND SAID HE WOULD REPORT THIS OFFER TO THE SHAH.

AFSHAR ASKED SECRETARY FOR HIS ASSESSMENT OF SOVIET ROLE IN IRANIAN DISTURBANCES. THE SECRETARY SAID WE HAD LIMITED INFORMATION, BUT DEGREE OF ORGANIZATION IN RECENT IRANIAN DEMONSTRATIONS INDICATED TO US THAT SOME ORGANIZING HAND, POSSIBLY THE SOVIETS, HAD PLAYED A PART. AFSHAR AGREED AND ASKED DID WE THINK THE SOVIETS WISHED TO TOPPLE THE SHAH? WOULD NOT THE SOVIETS FEAR A CONFRONTATION WITH THE US? SECRETARY SAID WE DID NOT KNOW THE SOVIETS' ULTIMATE OBJECTIVE, BUT THEY SHOULD OBVIOUSLY BE CAREFUL OF US REACTION. HE SAID SUBJECT OF IRAN HAD NOT COME UP IN MANY HOURS OF RECENT CONVERSATIONS WITH GROMYKO.
GROMYKO HAD BEEN FRANK, HOWEVER, ABOUT RUSSIAN DESIRE TO MAINTAIN CLOSEST POSSIBLE RELATIONS WITH AFGHANISTAN, SENDING IN ADVISERS AND TECHNICANS TO HELP SHORE UP REGIME.
IN CONCLUSION SECRETARY SAID HE HOPED TO BE ABLE TO VISIT IRAN AND ASKED THAT HIS WARMEST RESPECTS BE CONVEYED TO THE SHAH. AFSHAR URGED SECRETARY TO VISIT, STRESSING HOW HELPFUL IT WOULD BE TO GOI.
SEPTEL REPORTS FOREIGN AFFAIRS PORTION OF DISCUSSION.

1978SECTO13046.subject: SECRETARY'S MESSAGE TO IRANIAN FOREIGN MINISTER

segments.text: PLEASE PASS THE FOLLOWING MESSAGE FROM SECRETARY VANCE TO MINISTER KHALATBARY. BEGIN TEXT EXCELLENCY: IT WAS INDEED A PLEASURE TO SEE YOU AND MRS. KHALATBARY AGAIN DURING PRESIDENT CARTER'S VISIT TO IRAN. YOUR GRACIOUS HOSPITALITY EMPHASIZES THE WARM FEELING THAT EXISTS BETWEEN OUR TWO COUNTRIES. WE LEAVE TEHRAN WITH PLEASANT MEMORIES AND DEEP SATISFACTION WITH THE EXCELLENT STATE OF RELATIONS BETWEEN OUR TWO COUNTRIES. THE DISCUSSIONS HELD BETWEEN HIS IMPERIAL MAJESTY AND THE PRESIDENT HAVE DEMONSTRATED ANEW THAT OUR TRADITIONAL FRIENDSHIP REMAINS STRONG. AS YOU KNOW, PRESIDENT CARTER DEEPLY VALUES HIS IMPERIAL MAJESTY'S VAST KNOWLEDGE AND INSITE ABOUT REGIONAL AS WELL AS WORLD AFFAIRS.

AT A TIME WHEN MIDDLE EAST ISSUES ARE AT A CRUCIAL STAGE, HIS COUNSEL AND COOPERATION ARE OF IMMEASURABLE ASSISTANCE. SIMILARLY, I HAVE ALWAYS REGARDED OUR CONVERSATIONS AS POSITIVE CONTRIBUTIONS TO THE CLOSE AND CORDIAL RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN IRAN AND THE UNITED STATES. I AM CERTAIN THAT OUR TIES WILL BE FURTHER STRENGTHENED IN THE COMING YEARS TO OUR MUTUAL BENEFIT AND IN THE INTERESTS OF WORLD PEACE AND SECURITY. MRS. VANCE JOINS IN MY BEST WISHES TO YOU AND MRS. KHALATBARY FOR A VERY HAPPY AND PROSPEROUS NEW YEAR. SINCERELY, CYRUS VANCE .

FOLLOWING IS THE TEXT OF A LETTER, DATED JANUARY 1, 1978, FROM PRESIDENT CARTER TO THE SHAH, PLEASE DELIVER IT ASAP. BEGIN TEXT: YOUR IMPERIAL MAJESTY: OUR MEETINGS, ALTHOUGH BRIEF, REAFFIRMED THE CLOSE PERSONAL RELATIONSHIP WHICH WE INITIATED IN WASHINGTON, AS WELL AS THE DEEP MUTUALITY OF INTERESTS BETWEEN OUR TWO NATIONS AND THEIR PEOPLE. IT WAS PARTICULARLY GRATIFYING TO ME TO BE ABLE TO REACH AN AGREEMENT IN PRINCIPLE ON NUCLEAR COOPERATION.

NOT ONLY WILL THIS AGREEMENT UNDERLINE AND REINFORCE THE VITAL IMPORTANCE OF OUR SHARED OBJECTIVES IN CONTROLLING THE PROLIFERATION OF NUCLEAR WEAPONS IN THE CAUSE OF WORLD PEACE, BUT IT WILL ALSO OPEN A NEW AND POTENTIALLY FRUITFUL AREA OF COOPERATION BETWEEN OUR TWO NATIONS' IN THE DEVELOPMENT AND PEACEFUL USE OF NUCLEAR ENERGY. OUR DISCUSSIONS OF POLITICAL AND STRATEGIC DEVELOPMENTS IN THE MIDDLE EAST AND AFRICA HAVE OPENED UP NEW AVENUES OF FUTURE COOPERATION WHICH SHOULD DEEPEND AND BROADEN THE CONSULTATION AND COORDINATION OF POLICY-LONG AN ESSENTIAL PART OF U.S-IRANIAN RELATIONS.

SIMILARLY, THE MUTUALITY OF VIEWS WHICH EMERGED IN OUR TALKS WITH REGARD TO NORTH-SOUTH ISSUES WILL PROVIDE AN IMPORTANT FOCUS FOR OUR JOINT EFFORTS IN THIS AREA OVER THE NEXT FEW YEARS. ROSALYNN AND I WOULD BOTH LIKE TO EXPRESS OUR PERSONAL GRATITUDE TO YOU AND THE SHAHBANOU FOR YOUR GRACIOUS HOSPITALITY, AND FOR THE BEAUTIFUL GOLD BOX YOU PRESENTED TO US. YOUR GIFT WILL BE A TREASURED REMEMBRANCE OF OUR VISIT AND FRIENDSHIP. FINALLY, PLEASE ACCEPT MY PERSONAL APPRECIATION FOR THE UNDERSTANDING AND SENSITIVITY WHICH YOU DISPLAYED IN FACILITATING MY MEETING WITH KING HUSSEIN.
THE ADDITION OF THIS IMPORTANT MEETING TO AN ALREADY HECTIC SCHEDULE WAS MADE POSSIBLE ONLY BY YOUR GRACIOUS ASSISTANCE. SINCERELY.
ORIGINAL LETTER BEING POUCHED.

1978SEOUL10392.subject: ROK INQUIRY ABOUT SITUATION IN TEHRAN ROK FOREIGN MINISTRY REPORTS THAT TELEPHONE AND TELETYPE COMMUNICATIONS WITH ROK EMBASSY TEHRAN CUT OFF SIN

segments.text: ROK FOREIGN MINISTRY REPORTS THAT TELEPHONE AND TELETYPE COMMUNICATIONS WITH ROK EMBASSY TEHRAN CUT OFF SINCE EARLY NOVEMBER 20. WOULD APPRECIATE ANY INFORMATION AVAILABLE ON GENERAL SITUATION AND IF POSSIBLE CONCERNING WELFARE OF ROK EMBASSY, OR OTHER KOREANS IN CITY.

SUMMARY: AS CIVIL UNREST IN SOUTHERN IRAN CONTINUES, THERE HAVE BEEN INCREASING INDICATIONS OF UNHAPPINESS WITHIN THE MILITARY. DISSATISFACTION SEEMS TO BE OF TWO BASIC SORTS: ON THE ONE HAND, THE CAREER OFFICER CORPS APPEARS TO BE LOOSING PATIENCE WITH WHAT IT REGARDS AS VACILATION AT THE TOP, AND, ON THE OTHER, LARGELY CONSCRIPT ENLISTED PERSONNEL SEEM TO BE CHAFING UNDER THE REQUIREMENT TO MAINTAIN CIVIL ORDER IN THE FACE OF BROADSPREAD DISCONTENT AMONG PEOPLE FROM BACKGROUNDS SIMILAR TO THEIR OWN. END SUMMARY

THE MOST DRAMATIC EXAMPLE OF DISSENSION WITHIN THE RANKS CAME ON OCTOBER 26 IN JAHROM, ABOUT 180 KILOMETERS FROM SHIRAZ, WHERE A YOUNG DRAFTEE ASSASSINATED THE LOCAL POLICE CHIEF AND SERIOUSLY WOUNDED THE CITY'S MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR. SOURCES IN SHIRAZ HAVE TOLD US THAT THE CIRCUMSTANCES SURROUNDING THE ASSASSINATION INDICATE THAT IT WAS WLLPLANNED AND MAY HAVE INVOLVED THE COOPERATION OF AT LEAST ONE OTHER ENLISTED MAN. ACCORDING TO THESE SOURCES, THE POLICE CHIEF AND MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR CAME OUT OF THE BUILDING WHERE LOCAL OFFICIALS AND DIGNITARIES HAD JUST OBSERVED THE SHAH'S BIRTHDAY AND GOT INTO THE BACK OF A CHAUFEURED MILITARY VEHICLE.

AT THAT POINT, THE DRIVER STOPPED THE MOTOR AND GOT OUT, OSTENSIBLY TO LOOK UNDER THE HOOD. THEREUPON, THE ASSASSIN, CONCEALED ON THE ROOF OF A NEARBY BUILDING WITH A MACHINE-GUN, FIRED A NUMBER OF ROUNDS INTO THE VEHICHLE, KILLING THE POLICE CHIEF INSTANTLY AND SERIOUSLY WOUNDING THE MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR. THIS EVENT FOLLOWED EARLIER REPORTS OF DISSENSION AMONG THE TROOPS STATIONED IN JAHROM WHICH HAS EXPERIENCED A HIGH LEVEL OF UNREST THROUGHOUT MOST OF 1978.

ELSEWHERE, CAREER OFFICERS HAVE BEEN GROWING MORE VOCAL IN THEIR DISAPPROVAL OF THE SHARIF-EMAMI GOVERNMENT'S PERSISTENT DETERMINATION TO CONCILIATE. IN THEIR VIEW, MARTIAL LAW IS LOOSING ITS CREDIBILITY THROUGH THE GOVERNMENT'S REFUSAL TO ENFORCE ITS OWN MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS. THE PROHIBITION AGAINST ASSEMBLAGES OF MORE THAN THREE PEOPLE IS BEING TOTALLY IGNORED, AND THERE HAS BEEN GREAT RELUCTANCE TO RISK CONFRONTATION WITH VIOLATORS OF THAT AND OTHER PROVISIONS OF MARTIAL LAW. THE ULTIMATE RESULT, MANY OFFICERS APPARENTLY FEAR, WILL BE LOSS OF THE ONE ADVANTAGE THAT REMAINS TO THE MILITARY, I.E., THE RESPECT ITS FIREPOWER AFFORDS DESPITE THE OVERWHELMING NUMERICAL SUPERIORITY OF THE AGITATORS.

IF THEIR FEARS ARE REALIZED, THEY ARGUE, FIREBRANDS MIGHT BE TEMPTED TO PROVOKE A CONFRONTATION WHICH COULD PRODUCE SUBSTANTIAL CASUALTIES. THESE OFFICERS SAY THEY WOULD PREFER TO GET TOUGH NOW IN ORDER TO MINIMIZE BLOODSHED.

1978SHIRAZ00164.subject: BACKLASH TO CONTINUED CIVIL UNREST THE CONSULATE HAS GOTTEN A NUMBER OF INDICATIONS IN RECENT DAYS OF AN EMERGENT BACKLASH TO CONTINUED CIVIL UN

segments.text: THE CONSULATE HAS GOTTEN A NUMBER OF INDICATIONS IN RECENT DAYS OF AN EMERGENT BACKLASH TO CONTINUED CIVIL UNREST. WHILE THE OVERWHELMING MAJORITY OF SENTIMENTS SEEMS TO REMAIN ANTI-REGIME, THE SHAH DOES HAVE HIS FANS. THESE APPEAR TO BE GAINING INCREASING SUPPORT FROM A VARIETY OF HERETOFORE APOLITICAL INDIVIDUALS WHO HAVE HAD ENOUGH OF CIVIL UNREST AND/OR FEAR THE CONSEQUENCIES OF ITS CONTINUATION. EXEMPLARY OF THIS PHENOMENON, LATE LAST WEEK A GROUP OF WOMEN IN BLACK VEILS CHANTING, BRING BACK KHOMEINI UNQUOTE, WERE CONFRONTED ON ONE OF SHIRAZ'S STREETS BY ANOTHER GROUP OF WOMEN IN WESTERN DRESS AND WITH UNCOVERED HEADS.
IF KHOMEINI WERE TO RETURN, A MEMBER OF THE LATTER SHOUTED, HE WOULD SOON BE FOLLOWED BY RUSSIAN SOLDIERS WHO WOULD (EXPLETIVE DELETED) VERY WOMAN FOUND WEARING A CHADOR (THE IRANIAN VEIL).

1978SHIRAZ00187.subject: SECURITY AND OPPOSITION ACTIVITIES ON SHIRAZ

segments.text: EVEN WITH THE ONSET OF MOHARRAM, SHIRAZ HAS REMAINED GENERALLY PEACEFUL THROUGH DECEMBER 5. THE REASONS FOR THIS ARE PROBABLY VARIED AND MAY INCLUDE THE PROFESSIONALISM OF THE PRIMARY MILITARY UNIT (THE IMPERIAL IRANIAN GROUND FORCES' 55TH AIRBORNE BRIGADE) RESPONSIBLE FOR MAINTAINING LAW AND ORDER, COLD AND RAINY WEATHER WHICH HAS GRIPPED SHIRAZ, AND SHIRAZI CHARACTER (REPUTED AMONG IRANIANS TO CONTAIN A STRONG ELEMENT OF APATHY). WHETHER THE ACTUAL EXPLANATION FOR THE RELATIVE TRANQUILITY HERE, IT HAS PRODUCED CAUTIOUS OPTIMISM IN SOME QUARTERS THAT SHIRAZ MAY GET THROUGH ASHURA (DECEMBER 11 AND A DAY OF HIGH RELIGIOUS FERVOR) WITHOUT MAJOR INCIDENT.

BECAUSE THE PATTERN OF VIOLENCE THROUGHOUT IRAN HAS TENDED TO BE ONE OF INCREMENTAL INCREASES AND SINCE THE LEVEL OF VIOLENCE IN SHIRAZ ITSELF HAS LAGGED BEHIND MOST OTHER URBAN AREAS, IT DOES INDEED SEEM LIKELY THAT ASHURA WILL NOT BRING GOTTERDAMERUNG HERE. HOWEVER, THERE ARE SEVERAL ASPECTS OF THE LOCAL SITUATION WHICH ARE LESS THAN ENCOURAGING FOR THE LONGER TERM. --FIRST, SHOP CLOSURES HAVE BEEN QUITE EFFECTIVE, INDICATING A HIGH DEGREE OF SUPPORT IN THE COMMERCIAL SECTOR FOR OPPOSITIONIST ACTIVITY.

FURTHER, POWER CUTS AND OTHER ECONOMIC ACTIONS IN THE PUBLIC SECTOR SUGGEST BOTH CONSIDERABLE COORDINATION OF OPPOSITIONIST EFFORTS AND THAT OPPOSITIONIST SENTIMENT IS HARDLY LIMITED TO THE BAZAAR AND THE TRADITIONALIST ELEMENTS OF LOCAL SOCIETY. THIS IS A BROADLY BASED MOVEMENT WITH A SENSE OF PURPOSE. --SECOND, THERE HAS BEEN A GROWING WILLINGNESS TO TEST THE DETERMINATION OF THE GOVERNMENT TO ENFORCE MARTIAL LAW. VIOLATIONS OF THE BAN ON DEMONSTRATIONS HAVE BEEN INCREASING, ALTHOUGH THE DEMONSTRATIONS THEMSELVES HAVE SO FAR BEEN LIMITED IN SCOPE AND HAVE BROKEN UP QUICKLY WHEN CONFRONTED WITH MILITARY FORCE.

HOWEVER, THE CONTINUING ABILITY OF THE MILITARY TO CARRY THE DAY IN SUCH CONFRONTATIONS IS PERHAPS LESS SIGNIFICANT THAN THE APPARENT PERCEPTION OF OPPOSITIONISTS THAT THERE MAY BE RELUCTANCE ON THE PART OF THE GOVERNMENT TO BRING ITS FIRE POWER TO BEAR ON VIOLATIONS OF MARTIAL LAW. THIS, OF COURSE, IS WHAT LED TO MARTIAL LAW'S LOSS OF CREDIBILITY BEFORE NOVEMBER 6. --FINALLY, THERE HAVE BEEN SOME INDICATIONS, AS YET NOT EXTENSIVE, THAT ENLISTED PERSONNEL ARE BEGINNING TO GROW WEARY OF THEIR PEACE KEEPING MISSION. MORALE IN THE 55TH AIRBORNE STILL SEEMS GOOD, BUT SOME OF THE LESS WELL-TRAINED ANCILLARY TROOPS MAY BE CHAFING A BIT.
IF MORALE DOES INDEED BEGIN TO DETERIORATE IN ANY SERIOUS WAY, IT QUITE LIKELY WOULD BE THE PRELUDE TO REAL TROUBLE.

1978SHIRAZ00201.subject: MUSLIM-BAHAI CONFLICT IN SHIRAZ SUMMARY; AN ATTACK ON BAHAIS BY MUSLIM NEIGHBORS IN SHIRAZ DEC 13 DEGENERATED INTO A SHOOT-OUT THAT LEFT A SU

segments.text: SUMMARY; AN ATTACK ON BAHAIS BY MUSLIM NEIGHBORS IN SHIRAZ DEC 13 DEGENERATED INTO A SHOOT-OUT THAT LEFT A SUBSTANTIAL NUMBER DEAD. FOR THE NEXT TWO DAYS THE MUSLIMS ENGAGED IN LOOTING AND BURNING BAHAI PROPERTIES. BY DEC 16 A DEGREE OF CALM HAD RETURNED, AND MANY MUSLIMS WERE FEELING REMORSEFUL FOR THEIR BEHAVIOR. BUT DESPITE APPARENTLY SINCERE EFFORTS BY MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES TO RESTORE ORDER FOLLOWING THE INITIAL SHOOTING INCIDENT WEDNESDAY NIGHT, THE EVENT IN THE MINDS OF MOST IRANIANS IS LIKELY TO BE REMEMBERED AS ONE MORE EXAMPLE OF GOVERNMENT INTRIGUE. END SUMMARY.

ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, DEC 13 A GROUP OF MUSLIMS BEGAN TO BURN THE HOUSES AND SHOPS OF BAHAIS LIVING IN THE VICINITY OF THE POET SAADIS TOMB IN NORTHEAST SHIRAZ. WHAT EXACTLY PROMPTED THIS IS NOT COMPLETELY CLEAR, BUT IT APPEARS THAT MOST OF THE MUSLIMS INVOLVED HAD JUST ATTENDED A GATHERING AT A LOCAL MOSQUE WHERE SPEECHES ATTACKING THE BAHAI COMMUNITY WERE MADE. THE LATTER WERE ACCUSED, INTER ALIA, OF HAVING TURNED MUSLIMS WHO HAD PREVIOUSLY PARTICIPATED IN ANTI-GOVERNMENT ACTIVITIES IN TO MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES.

IN ANY EVENT, A FAMILY MEMBER OF ONE OF THE BAHAI HOMES ATTACKED WAS AN ARMY SARGEANT WHO WAS EITHER ALREADY ON THE SCENE OR ARRIVED SHORTLY AFTER THE BURNING BEGAN WITH A GUN. HE AND TWO RELATIVES, WHO APPARENTLY WERE ALSO ARMED, BEGAN FIRING INTO THE MUSLIM CROWD. THE NUMBER KILLED IS STILL UNCERTAIN--SHIRAZ SECURITY OFFICIALS SAY 10 TO 12, LOCAL HOSPITALS INDICATE AS MANY AS 42--BUT THE SHOOTING ENDED ONLY WITH THE ARRIVAL OF MARTIAL LAW FORCES WHO STORMED THE THREE BAHAIS' HOME, KILLING THEM ALL IN THE PROCESS.

THE NEXT DAY, DEC 14, SMALL GROUPS OF MUSLIMS, MOSTLY TEENAGERS, BEGAN TO ATTACK, LOOT AND SET FIRE TO HOMES AND SHOPS OF PEOPLE ALLEGED TO BE BAHAIS IN THE VICINITY OF SAADI'S TOMB AND NEARBY NEIGHBORHOODS. WHILE MOST OF THE PROPERTIES HIT DID INDEED BELONG TO BAHAIS, IT APPEARS THAT THE OCCASION WAS SEIZED TO SETTLE GRUDGES AGAINST SELECTED MUSLIMS AS WELL. THE PEPSI COLA PLANT, A COMPANY THAT HAS LONG BEEN A FAVORITE TARGET OF ANTI-BAHAI ATTACKS, WAS ALSO BURNED.

MARTIAL LAW FORCES DID WHAT THEY COULD TO BRING THE SITUATION UNDER CONTROL BUT WERE HINDERED BY THE PHYSICAL ENVIRONMENT (CLOSELY PACKED HOUSES WITH NUMBEROUS SIDE STREETS) AND TAUNTS THAT THEY THEMSELVES WERE BAHAIS. THE TROOPS APPEARED TO BE UNDER STRICT ORDERS NOT TO FIRE THEIR WEAPONS EXCEPT INTO THE AIR, AND THEN ONLY IN EXTREMIS. THE POST'S IMPRESSION IS THAT THEY EXERCISED CONSIDERABLE RESTRAINT AND DID A REASONABLY CREDIBLE JOB UNDER EXTREMELY DIFFICULT CONDITIONS.

NIGHTFALL AND CURFEW A FEW HOURS LATER BROUGHT A DEGREE OF CALM TO THE AREA, BUT THE BURNING AND LOOTING RESUMED THE FOLLOWING MORNING. AN ON-THE-SPOT CHECK BY CONSULATE OFFICERS ABOUT MID-DAY REVEALED AN ALMOST CARNIVAL-LIKE ATMOSPHERE IN THE AREA, WITH WHAT WERE CLEARLY FAMILY GROUPS OUT TO WATCH THE YOUNG ARSONISTS BEING CHASED BY THE TROOPS. AT ABOUT THE SAME TIME, A MEMORIAL SERVICE AT A DOWNTOWN MOSQUE FOR SOME OF THOSE KILLED WEDNESDAY NIGHT DEGENERATED INTO AN UGLY DEMONSTRATION ON THE CITY'S MAIN STREET.

WHEN CONSULATE OFFICERS SASSED BY THE AREA, IT APPEARED THAT THE TACTICS OF THE MARTIAL LAW FORCES WERE TO CONTAIN THE MOB RATHER THAN TO BREAK IT UP BY FORCE. SUBSEQUENTLY, TEAR GAS WAS USED TO DISPERSE HARDCORE REMNANTS. ABOUT MID-AFTERNOON THE ARSONISTS AND LOOTERS IN THE NORTHEAST QUARTER OF TOWN LOST THEIR ENTHUSIASM (OR RAN OUT OF KEROSENE) AND BEGAN TO DRIFT AWAY FROM THE AREA. REMARKABLY, THERE APPARENTLY WERE NO FATAL CASUALTIES OR EVEN SERIOUS INJURIES DURING THE TWO DAYS FOLLOWING THE WEDNESDAY NIGHT SHOOT-OUT, THE DAMAGE BEING LIMITED TO THE PROPERTY AND PSYCHOLOGICAL VARIETIES.

BY SATURDAY MORNING, DEC 16, MUCH OF THE MUSLIM COMMUNITY WAS BEGINNING TO FEEL THE EFFECT OF ITS OWN CAPACITY FOR SAVAGERY. ONE OF SHIRAZS MOST INFLUENTIAL MULLAHS, AN OUTSPOKEN OPPONENT OF THE REGIME AND A SELFSTYLED FOLLOWER OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, ISSUED AN ELAMIEH (CIRCULAR) URGING HIS CO-RELIGIONISTS TO RESPECT THE RIGHTS OF BOTH THE IRANIAN MINORITIES AND THE FOREIGN COMMUNITY LIVING IN THEIR MIDST. AND THE PROVINCIAL GOVERNOR GENERAL ORGANIZED THE BUREAUCRACY TO FEED, CLOTHE AND HOUSE THE BAHAIS WHO HAD LOST THEIR HOMES AND POSSESSIONS.

THAT WAS THE GOOD NEWS. THE BAD NEWS WAS THAT THE PERSIAN CONSPIRATORIAL MILL WAS RUNNING FULL SPEED. A ------------------085615 210338Z /62 FM AMCONSUL SHIRAZ TO SECSTATE WASHDC 0109 SECTION 02 OF 02 SHIRAZ 0201 (FM SHIRAZ 0201 VICE TEHRAN 12343) PAHLAVI UNIVERSITY FACULTY TEAM, SELF-APPOINTED TO INVESTIGATE THE INCIDENT, CONCLUDED THAT SAVAK AGENTS PROVOCATEURS HAD BEEN RESPONSIBLE FOR THE WHOLE THING. IT IS DOUBTFUL THAT THE FULL STORY OF WHAT HAPPENED WILL EVER BE KNOWN, BUT THE EVIDENCE THAT IS AVAILABLE HARDLY SUPPORTS SUCH A THESIS.

HOWEVER, IN IRAN FACT AND WHAT IS PERCEIVED AS REALITY ARE OFTEN QUITE DIFFERENT, AND SHIRAZ'S MUSLIM-BAHAI CONFLICT, AS THE ABADAN FIRE A FEW MONTHS AGO, IS LIKELY TO BE REMEMBERED BY MOST IRANIANS AS ONE MORE EXAMPLE OF GOVERNMENT INTRIGUE. SULLIAN

THIS REPORT HAS ALSO BEEN DENIED IN PRESS STORIES BY SOURCES AT MINISTRY OF COURT AND BY AMBASSADOR ZAHEDI. DO YOU HAVE AUTHORITATIVE INFORMATION?

IF IT IS TRUE THAT SHAH WOULD LEAVE THE COUNTRY SO AS TO FACILITATE BAKHTIAR'S JOB OF ESTABLISHING A NEW GOVERNMENT, WE WONDER WHY THE SHAH DID NOT AGREE TO THE SAME CONDITION WITH SADIQI, APPARENTLY A STRONGER CANDIDATE FOR THE PRIME MINISTERSHIP THAN BAKHTIAR. WOULD APPRECIATE YOUR COMMENTS. NEWSOM
