SINCE OUR LAST CORRESPONDENCE, OTHER COMMITMENTS HAVE ARISEN WHICH MAKE A JANUARY BRIEFING MOST DIFFICULT. HOWEVER, I CAN NOW MAKE A FIRM PROPOSAL FOR MID-FEBRUARY FOLLOWING THE FOURTH ROUND OF US-USSR TALKS ON THE INDIAN OCEAN, TENTATIVELY SCHEDULED TO BE HELD IN BERN FEBRUARY 1 THROUGH 10. I COULD ARRANGE TO ARRIVE IN TEHRAN FEBRUARY 11 OR 12, DEPENDING ON AVAILABLE FLIGHTS, AND REMAIN IN TEHRAN FOR TWO DAYS.

I WOULD APPRECIATE YOUR NOT RPT NOT INFORMING THE COURT OF THE POSSIBILITY OF INDIAN OCEAN TALKS AT THIS TIME. HOWEVER, SHOULD THEY BE HELD AS SCHEDULED I ANTICIPATE THE SHAH WILL BE INTERESTED IN A BRIEF ON THAT SUBJECT AS WELL. OUR COMMITMENTS TO THE SHAH ON THAT SCORE ARE FAIRLY CLEAR, BUT I WOULD PREFER TO DEAL WITH THE SPECIFICS OF SUCH A BRIEFING AS THE TIME APPROACHES. CHRISTOPHER

FURTHER TO THE PRESIDENT'S REPORT TO THE SHAH ON HIS MEETINGS WITH KING KHALID AND PRESIDENT SADAT (SECTO 13093), FOLLOWING ARE THOUGHTS YOU MAY PASS TO THE SHAH IN CONNECTION WITH HIS FORTHCOMING VISIT TO EGYPT. THERE IS NOT A GREAT DEAL TO REPORT SINCE MESSAGE ON ASWAN MEETING.

AS THE PRESIDENT TOLD PRESIDENT SADAT DURING THE ASWAN MEETING, THE UNITED STATES PLANS TO PLAY AN ACTIVE ROLE IN THE FORTHCOMING NEGOTIATIONS IN JERUSALEM. WE EXPECT THE MAJOR ISSUES AT JERUSALEM WILL BE THE DECLARATION OF FUNDAMENTAL PRINCIPLES WHICH SHOULD SERVE AS THE BASIS FOR NEGOTIATION OF A COMPREHENSIVE SETTLEMENT, AND PRACTICAL APPROACHES TO THE WEST BANK/GAZA PROBLEM. THE TWO ARE, OF COURSE, INTERRELATED. WE ARE NOW REVIEWING INTENSIVELY OUR STRATEGY FOR THE JERUSALEM TALKS AND EXPECT TO BE IN TOUCH WITH EGYPTIANS AND ISRAELIS SOMETIME NEXT WEEK, PRIOR TO THE OPENING OF THE JERUSALEM MEETING.
YOU MAY ASSURE THE SHAH THAT WE WILL KEEP HIM INFORMED AS OUR THINKING CRYSTALLIZES.

AS FOR SUGGESTIONS ON THE LINE THE SHAH MIGHT TAKE TO ENHANCE THE PROSPECTS FOR SUCCESS OF THE NEGOTIATIONS, WE BELIEVE THE MANIFESTATION OF SUPPORT FOR SADAT'S STAND THAT THE SHAH'S VISIT WILL REPRESENT WILL IN ITSELF BE VERY IMPORTANT. SHAH'S BACKING FOR SADAT, IN PUBLIC STATEMENTS AND IN PRIVATE TALKS WITH SADAT, SHOULD STRENGTHEN SADAT'S POSITION BOTH AT HOME AND IN THE ARAB WORLD AND ADD IMPETUS TO HIS DETERMINATION TO PURSUE THE COURSE TOWARD PEACE. WE ARE SURE SADAT WOULD ALSO BE HEARTENED BY ASSISTANCE THE SHAH COULD GIVE HIM IN DEVELOPING BROADER UNDERSTANDING AND SUPPORT BY OTHER ARABS FOR HIS POLICY OF PEACE.

SHAH WILL NATURALLY FIND SADAT WELL AWARE OF THE PROBLEMS THAT HE AND THE ISRAELIS WILL HAVE TO RESOLVE IN THE JERUSALEM NEGOTIATIONS. THE MOST DIFFICULT ONE WILL BE THE CONCEPT OF SELF-DETERMINATION AND THE FUTURE OF THE WEST BANK AND GAZA. THE ISRAELIS' GREATEST FEAR IS THAT THEIR AGREEMENT TO SELF-DETERMINATION WOULD SET THE STAGE FOR THE ADVENT OF AN INDEPENDENT WEST BANK/GAZA STATE; THIS ACCOUNTS FOR BEGIN'S REFUSAL TO AGREE TO SADAT'S REQUEST FOR USE OF THE PHRASE SELF-DETERMINATION IN PROPOSED DECLARATION OF PRINCIPLES.

FOLLOWING PRESIDENT'S MEETINGS WITH THE SAUDIS AND SADAT, WE BELIEVE IT IS CLEAR NOW TO BOTH THAT WHILE PALESTINIANS MUST PLAY ROLE IN DETERMINING THEIR FUTURE, THIS MUST BE DONE IN SUCH A WAY AS TO ALLAY ISRAELI FEARS THAT RESULT WILL BE RADICAL INDEPENDENT STATE. THIS IS THE CRUCIAL ISSUE AT THIS TIME, AND IF THE JERUSALEM MEETINGS CAN DEAL WITH IT SUCCESSFULLY, A BIG STEP FORWARD WILL HAVE BEEN MADE.
PLEASE TELL THE SHAH THAT WE LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING HIS IMPRESSIONS FOLLOWING HIS TALKS WITH SADAT AND WILL WANT TO KEEP IN CLOSE TOUCH. VANCE UNQUOTE VANCE

IN REPLY TO INVITATION IN REFTEL, PLEASE DELIVER FOLLOWING MESSAGE TO FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY: BEGIN TEXT: YOUR EXCELLENCY: YOU AND YOUR WIFE ARE INDEED THOUGHTFUL AND KIND TO RENEW YOUR INVITATION FOR MY WIFE, OUR DAUGHTER AND ME TO VISIT IRAN. WE WOULD INDEED BE HONORED, AND WOULD VERY MUCH LIKE TO HAVE A CHANCE TO SEE MORE OF YOUR COUNTRY AND LEARN MORE OF ITS REMARKABLE HISTORY. IN VIEW OF OUR CURRENT EFFORTS, SEVERAL KEY ISSUES OF WHICH YOU ARE AWARE, I AM UNABLE AT THIS TIME TO TRY TO SET DATES FOR A RETURN TRIP.

I WILL LOOK FOR AN OPPORTUNITY TO DO SO IN THE FUTURE WHEN WE CAN TAKE ADVANTAGE OF YOUR VERY KIND INVITATION. PLEASE EXTEND TO YOUR CHARMING WIFE SPECIAL GREETINGS AND, ONCE AGAIN, OUR APPRECIATION FOR YOUR WONDERFUL HOSPITALITY. .
PLEASE ARRANGE TO HAVE DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING LETTER FROM ME TO SECRETARY GENERAL WALDHEIM (WALDHEIM ARRIVED IN TEHRAN FROM ANKARA JANUARY 10).

BEGIN TEXT: DEAR KURT: I WANT TO THANK YOU FOR TAKING THE TROUBLE TO TELEPHONE ME THIS MORNING. AS I TOLD YOU I WOULD, I HAVE GIVEN SOME CAREFUL THOUGHT TO OUR CONVERSATION TODAY AS WELL AS TO THE POINTS WHICH YOU MAKE IN YOUR LETTER. I UNDERSTAND FULLY THE CONCERNS YOU EXPRESS, AND I BY NO MEANS WISH TO APPEAR TO BE MINIMIZING THE COMPLEX TASK YOU ARE CONSTANTLY FACED WITH IN MAINTAINING A BROAD CONSENSUS WITHIN THE MEMBERSHIP FOR THE ACTIONS YOU TAKE.

NEVERTHELESS, I AM WRITING TO YOU IN THE HOPE THAT YOU WILL RECONSIDER AND AGREE TO SEND A REPRESENTATIVE TO BE PRESENT AT THE JERUSALEM TALKS. IN THE FIRST PLACE, I CAN UNDERSTAND WHY YOU FEEL IT WOULD NOT BE APPROPRIATE FOR YOU PERSONALLY TO ATTEND THE POLITICAL COMMITTEE MEETING IN JERUSALEM. BOTH PRESIDENT CARTER AND I DO BELIEVE, HOWEVER, THAT IT IS IMPORTANT FOR THE UN TO BE REPRESENTED IN SOME CAPACITY AT THOSE TALKS IN VIEW OF THE INVITATION EXTENDED TO YOU FROM BOTH NEGOTIATING PARTIES.

I BELIEVE A FAILURE TO ATTEND, PARTICULARLY IN LIGHT OF THE UN'S ATTENDANCE AT THE RECENT CAIRO CONFERENCE, WOULD BE INTERPRETED AS A CHANGE IN POLICY AND FOR THIS REASON IN PARTICULAR CONSTITUTE A SET-BACK TO THE NEGOTIATING PROCESS. YOUR DECISION IN THE CASE OF CAIRO WAS WIDELY APPLAUDED; A FAILURE TO ATTEND JERUSALEM WOULD BE HARD TO JUSTIFY PUBLICLY AND WOULD BE INTERPRETED AS A CRITICISM OF THE PROCESS PRESIDENT SADAT HAS INITIATED. AS I INDICATED TO YOU EARLIER IN OUR TELEPHONE CONVERSATION, THE POLITICAL COMMITTEE IS A DIRECT OFF-SPRING OF THE CAIRO CONFERENCE.

ITS RAISON D'ETRE, NO LESS THAN THAT OF THE CONFERENCE ITSELF, IS PREPARATION FOR THE COMPREHENSIVE NEGOTIATIONS THAT WILL ULTIMATELY LEAD TO GENEVA. IN FURTHER CONSIDERING YOUR POSITION, I ALSO URGE THAT YOU REVIEW THE PROPOSITION THAT IT WOULD BE NECESSARY TO SEEK A MANDATE FROM THE SECURITY COUNCIL TO SEND A REPRESENTATIVE TO THE JERUSALEM MEETING. IT WAS NOT NECESSARY PRIOR TO THE CAIRO CONFERENCE, AND SHOULD NOT BE NEEDED TO SEND AN OBSERVOR TO THE JERUSALEM TALKS, GIVEN THEIR ORGANIC RELATIONSHIP TO CAIRO.

I SHOULD THINK THAT EVEN THOSE MEMBERS WHO ARE LESS THAN ENTHUSIASTIC ABOUT THE CAIRO CONVFERENCE WOULD FIND IT INVIDIOUS TO BE TAKING THE PUBLIC POSITION OF ASKING THE SECRETARY GENERAL OF THE UNITED NATIONS TO BOYCOTT TALKS (AND IN FACT THE ONLY NEGOTIATIONS NOW UNDERWAY) WHICH HAVE AS THEIR OBJECTIVE PEACEMAKING IN THE MIDDLE EAST, AND WHICH HAVE RECEIVED SUCH WIDE SUPPORT IN THE WORLD AT LARGE. IF A MEETING WERE CALLED, I KNOW YOU CAN COUNT ON STRONG SUPPORT FROM MOST COUNCIL MEMBERS. I CAN ASSURE YOU THAT YOU COULD CERTAINLY COUNT ON US TO DO THE UTMOST TO RALLY STRONG SUPPORT FOR SUCH A DECISION.

FOR THESE REASONS BOTH THE PRESIDENT AND I HOPE YOU WILL BE ABLE TO RECONSIDER AND SEND A REPRESENTATIVE TO THE JERUSALEM TALKS. NOT TO DO SO, I SINCERELY BELIEVE, WOULD BE SEEN BY SADAT AS A VOTE OF NO CONFIDENCE AND MORE BROADLY, WOULD BE A BLOW TO THE PEACEMAKING PROCESS. I MOST APPRECIATE YOUR INFORMING US ON YOUR TALKS ON THF CYPRUS SITUATION AND AM DELIGHTED TO HEAR YOU DERIVE SOME ENCOURAGEMENT FROM YOUR CONVERSATIONS IN ANKARA. WITH MY WARM REGARDS, SINCERELY, CY. . VANCE

REFERENCE: TEHRAN 0225, TEHRAN 0195, TEHRAN 0190 WHAT FURTHER ACTIONS MIGHT BE TAKEN TOWARD RESOLUTION OF HORN CONFLICT ARE BEING URGENTLY REVIEWED HERE. WE HOPE BE ABLE TO SEND YOU GUIDANCE SOON FOR DISCUSSION

1978STATE008958.subject: MESSAGE FROM THE PRESIDENT TO THE SHAH

segments.text: PLEASE DELIVER FOLLOWING TO THE SHAH

BEGIN TEXT. YOUR IMPERIAL MAJESTY: THANK YOU FOR THE VERY FULL ACCOUNT OF YOUR MEETINGS WITH PRESIDENT SADAT AND THE SAUDI LEADERSHIP. YOUR REPORT OF PRESIDENT SADAT'S VIEWS WILL BE EXTREMELY HELPFUL AS SECRETARY VANCE PREPARES FOR THE FORTHCOMING TALKS IN JERUSALEM. IT IS VERY CLEAR FROM YOUR ACCOUNT TO AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN THAT PRESIDENT SADAT IS NOW FOCUSSING INTENSIVELY ON ARRANGEMENTS AND GUARANTEES THAT WOULD RESPOND TO ISRAEL'S SECURITY CONCERNS WHILE CONTINUING TO PRESS TOWARD AN EQUITABLE TERRITORIAL SOLUTION IN THE SINAI AND ON THE WEST BANK.

THE SECURITY ARRANGEMENTS WHICH HE OUTLINED TO YOU ARE MORE EXPLICIT AND MORE FORTHCOMING THAN ANY PREVIOUS EXPOSITION OF HIS POSITION OF WHICH I AM AWARE. THIS IS VERY WELCOME NEWS. IT WAS PARTICULARLY ENCOURAGING TO HAVE CONFIRMATION OF PRESIDENT SADAT'S CONTINUED FLEXIBILITY WITH REGARD TO A FORMULA ON "SELF-DETERMINATION." THIS WILL OF COURSE BE A KEY ELEMENT OF THE FOREIGN MINISTERS' DISCUSSIONS NEXT WEEK. I WAS ALSO VERY INTERESTED TO LEARN THAT SAUDI THINKING SEEMS TO HAVE EVOLVED CONSIDERABLY SINCE MY VISIT TO RIYADH.

THE FLEXIBILITY WHICH KING KHALID, CROWN PRINCE FAHD AND PRINCE SAUD DEMONSTRATED IN THEIR DISCUSSIONS WITH YOU APPEAR TO CONSTITUTE A SIGNIFICANT SHIFT IN THEIR VIEWS WHICH COULD HAVE A CONSIDERABLE IMPACT IN PLANNING OUR OWN STRATEGY FOR JERUSALEM. I WILL BE PARTICULARLY INTERESTED TO KNOW IF PRINCE SAUD CONFIRMS THESE VIEWS WHEN HE MEETS WITH YOU AND TO LEARN WHAT THE "POINTS OF CLARIFICATION" MAY BE. YOUR IMPRESSIONS ABOUT THE PREOCCUPATION OF EGYPT AND SAUDI ARABIA WITH EVENTS IN THE HORN OF AFRICA ARE IDENTICAL TO MY OWN.

AS A RESULT OF MY TRIP, I AM MORE THAN EVER AWARE OF THE CONCERNS WHICH WE SHARE WITH ALL THE REGIONAL NATIONS ABOUT THE RAPID INCREASE OF SOVIET AND CUBAN MILITARY PRESENCE IN ETHIOPIA AND THE THREAT WHICH THAT REPRESENTS TO STABILITY AND PEACE IN THE AREA. YOUR REPORT ON THE SPECIFIC STEPS WHICH EGYPT, SUDAN AND SAUDI ARABIA ARE TAKING--AND WHICH WE FAVOR--WILL ASSIST US IN OUR OWN POLICY FORMULATION. IN THIS COMPLEX AND DANGEROUS SITUATION, IT IS ESSENTIAL THAT WE ACT IN CLOSE CONSULTATION. I RAISED THIS ISSUE WITH PRESIDENT GISCARD IN PARIS AND URGED HIM TO APPROACH THE SOVIET UNION ABOUT THEIR ACTIVITIES IN THE HORN.

GISCARD AGREES THAT THERE IS ALSO A NEED FOR A PEACE INITIATIVE, AND HE BELIEVES THAT THE MOST APPROPRIATE APPROACH WOULD BE THROUGH THE PERMANENT MEMBERS OF THE UNITED NATIONS SECURITY COUNCIL, POSSIBLY WITH THE ADDITION OF SOME AFRICAN STATES. GISCARD FELT THAT IT WAS ESSENTIAL TO SUPPORT SOMALIA TO SHOW THE SOVIETS THAT THEIR MOVES WERE COSTLY. HE INDICATED THAT THE FRENCH WERE FULLY ENGAGED IN THE PROCESS OF FINDING A PEACEFUL SOLUTION TO THE PROBLEM. AS A RESULT OF MY TALKS, THE UNITED STATES IS NOW CONDUCTING AN INTENSIVE REVIEW OF OUR POLICY IN THE HORN OF AFRICA.

I SHALL REMAIN IN CLOSE CONTACT WITH YOU AS THIS PROCESS PROGRESSES. I DEEPLY APPRECIATE THE EFFORTS YOU ARE MAKING IN THE INTEREST OF PEACE. SECRETARY VANCE AND I WILL KEEP YOU FULLY INFORMED OF THE PROGRESS OF THE JERUSALEM TALKS, AND AS ALWAYS WE SHALL WELCOME YOUR ADVICE AND ASSISTANCE AT EVERY STEP OF THE WAY. SINCERELY, JIMMY CARTER . CHRISTOPHER

THIS CONFIRMS THAT PM DIRECTOR GELB WILL BE ABLE TO BRIEF THE SHAH ON SALT AND INDIAN OCEAN ARMS NEGOTIATIONS WITH THE SOVIETS MONDAY, FEBRUARY 6. IN ADDITION TO SHAH, GELB REQUESTS EMBASSY ARRANGE MEETING WITH TOUFANIAN TO EXCHANGE VIEWS ON US-IRAN SECURITY RELATIONSHIP.

IRAN WILL BE FIRST LEG OF GELB'S TRIP TO TEHRAN, BERN AND BONN. ITINERARY FOR PORTION OF TRIP AFFECTING TEHRAN FOLLOWS (TOMES LOCAL): DEPART WASHINGTON 1700 FEB 2 VIA PA 66 ARRIVE FRANKFURT 0905 FEB 3. DEPART FRANKFURT 1140 FEB 3 VIA PA 2 ARRIVE TEHRAN 1930 FEB 3 (FRIDAY). DEPART TEHRAN 0700 FEB 7 VIA IRAN AIR 715 ARRIVE ZURICH 0930.
GELB WILL BE ACCOMPANIED BY PMAFFOFF MICHAEL ARIETTI.
GELB ACCEPTS AMBASSADOR'S OFFER TO STAY AT RESIDENCE. REQUEST EMBASSY ARRANGE ACCOMMODATIONS FOR MR. ARIETTI.
GELB AND ARIETTI WOULD VERY MUCH LIKE ONE DAY ON SCHEDULE KEPT FREE FOR POSSIBLE VISIT TO ISFAHAN. WOULD APPRECIATE EMBASSY'S SUGGESTIONS AS TO BEST TIMING AND LOGISTICS INVOLVED.

EXCEPT FOR TIMES SET ASIDE FOR BRIEFING THE SHAH AND MEETING WITH TOUFANIAN (IF POSSIBLE) AND DAY-TRIP TO ISFAHAN, GELB INTENDS TO BE AT AMBASSADOR'S DISPOSAL. WOULD APPRECIATE YOUR TENTATIVE SCHEDULE FOR MEETINGS WITH AMBASSADOR AND MISSION PERSONNEL. VISIT PROVIDES OPPORTUNITY FOR GELB TO DISCUSS WITH MISSION BROAD RANGE OF US-IRAN INTERESTS, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO SALT, INDIAN OCEAN, CONVENTIONAL ARMS TRANSFERS (IN GENERAL AND IRAN IN PARTICULAR), NUCLEAR COOPERATION, THE HORN OF AFRICA, PERSIAN GULF SECURITY AND OTHER REGIONAL POL-MIL CONCERNS. SUGGEST GELB BE INCLUDED IN COUNTRY TEAM MEETING (IF NORMALLY SCHEDULED TO COINCIDE WITH ITINERARY) AND FOLLOW UP WITH DISCUSSIONS WITH AMBASSADOR AND MISSION MEMBERS.
HE IS COMPLETELY AMENABLE TO YOUR SUGGESTIONS ON HOW BEST TO ORCHESTRATE.

APPRECIATE YOUR EXPEDITIOUS ASSISTANCE SO FAR. ANTICIPATE YOUR TENTATIVE TEHRAN SCHEDULE AND POSSIBILITY OF MEETING WITH TOUFANIAN, AFTER RECEIPT OF WHICH ITINERARY WILL BE MADE AS FIRM AS POSSIBLE. CHRISTOPHER

DATES MENTIONED IN REFTEL FOR USIRJC MEETINGS HAVE BEEN CONFIRMED WITH ALL RELEVANT USG PARTICIPANTS. ON FEBRUARY 28, SECRETARY WILL CO-CHAIR COMMISSION MEETING IN MORNING, CONDUCT BILATERAL WITH MINISTER YEGANEH, AND HOST LUNCHEON WITH COMMUNIQUE SIGNATURE CEREMONY LATER IN AFTERNOON. WE WILL WORK IN NUCLEAR BILATERAL IF, AS WE HOPE, FINAL AGREEMENT REACHED.

REQUEST EMBASSY FOLLOW UP WITH BREWER AND KAPNICK DURING COUNCIL'S FEBRUARY MEETINGS IN TEHRAN. WE WOULD ALSO LIKE TO HAVE TEXT OF COUNCIL'S FINAL COMMUNIQUE CABLED IF NOT TOO VOLUMINOUS.
WE WILL BE OBTAINING NAMES OF KEY USG PARTICIPANTS AND WOULD APPRECIATE POST DOING LIKEWISE WITH IRANIAN

WE APPRECIATED AMBASSADOR HUMMEL'S SUGGESTION IN REFTEL THAT IT MIGHT BE USEFUL FOR SHAH DURING UPCOMING VISIT TO PAKISTAN TO WEIGH IN AGAIN ON REPROCESSING ISSUE. HOWEVER, IN VIEW OF THE RAPIDLY EVOLVING SITUATION CONCERNING THE REPROCESSING ISSUE WE DO NOT BELIEVE YOU SHOULD MAKE ANY APPROACH TO THE SHAH ON THIS ISSUE AT THIS TIME. VANCE

THE DEPARTMENT HAS NOT COMPLETED ITS ANALYSIS OF IRANIAN REDRAFT OF PROPOSED NUCLEAR COOPERATION AGREEMENT AND ACCOMPANYING NOTE, BUT IT IS CLEAR THAT THE REDRAFT CONTAINS MAJOR SUBSTANTIVE CHANGES, MANY OF WHICH ARE INCONSISTENT WITH CURRENT OR ANTICIPATED US LEGAL REQUIREMENTS OR REPRESENT SIGNIFICANT DEPARTURES FROM CURRENT US POLICY.

THEREFORE FOR THE MOST PART THIS IRANIAN RESPONSE TO US PROPOSALS DOES NOT APPEAR TO CONFORM TO POLICY DECISIONS REACHED BETWEEN THE PRESIDENT AND THE SHAH (FYI: WE UNDERSTAND THAT IN RESPONSE TO PRESIDENT'S COMMENT THAT HE UNDERSTOOD THAT SHAH BELIEVED SOME MINOR DIFFERENCES WOULD NEED TO BE WORKED OUT BEFORE AGREEMENT COULD BE SIGNED, SHAH STATED THAT THE FINAL TEXT "CANNOT BE VERY DIFFERENT" FROM THE PRESENT TEXT SINCE IRAN AGREES WITH ALL THE SUBSTANTIVE PROVISIONS OF THE AGREEMENT AS WRITTEN. END FYI.)

DEPARTMENT IS ENCOURAGED THEREFORE BY MANZOUR'S STATEMENT IN REFTEL C THAT OUTSTANDING QUESTIONS CAN READILY RESOLVED. WE WOULD PROPOSE MEETING IN WASHINGTON BETWEEN MANZOUR AND DEPUTY ASSISTANT SECRETARY NOSENZO IN PERIOD 7 TO 14 FEBRUARY.

DEPARTMENT IS NOW REVIEWING US DRAFT PROPOSALS WITH VIEW TOWARD INCORPORATING AS MUCH AEOI DRAFT LANGUAGE AS POSSIBLE WITHOUT COMPROMISING FUNDAMENTAL US LEGAL AND POLICY REQUIREMENTS. THE TEXT WHICH RESULTS WILL REPRESENT THE MINIMUM US POSITION.

FYI: WE ARE CONCERNED, IN SPITE OF MANZOUR'S OPTIMISM, THAT HIGH LEVEL DEMARCHE MAY BE NECESSARY TO RESTORE THE "AGREEMENT IN PRINCIPLE" REACHED AT THE SUMMIT. DEPARTMENT WOULD VERY MUCH APPRECIATE EMBASSY VIEWS AS TO WHETHER SUCH A DEMARCHE IS WARRANTED AND IF SO HOW SUCH A DEMARCHE CAN BEST BE STRUCTURED TO BE MOST EFFECTIVE. IN PARTICULAR WE WOULD FIND MOST USEFUL EMBASSY ANALYSIS OF WHETHER THERE IS A FUNDAMENTAL MISUNDERSTANDING AT TOP POLICY LEVELS OF GOI OF BASIC US REQUIREMENTS FOR NUCLEAR COOPERATION OR WHETHER AEOI REDRAFT REPRESENTS A "REAR GUARD" ATTEMPT BY MANZOUR TO OBTAIN ADDITIONAL US FLEXIBILITY AT THE MARGINS.
TO ASSIST EMBASSY IN ITS ANALYSIS, BELOW IS A PRELIMINARY AND INCOMPLETE LISTING OF KEY SUBSTANTIVE CHANGES IN AEOI'S REDRAFT. THIS REDRAFT WOULD, INTER ALIA

PERMIT MILITARY (NON-EXPLOSIVE) USES OF SUPPLIED MATERIAL. FOR EXAMPLE, THE METALLURIGICAL PROPERTIES OF URANIUM MAKE ITS USE IN PROJECTILES ATTRACTIVE. THIS AND ANY OTHER MILITARY APPLICATION OF SUPPLIED MATERIAL CONTRAVENES PROVISIONS IN CURRENT AND PENDING LEGISLATION.

REQUIRE THAT ANY BENEFIT IN THE NUCLEAR AREA GIVEN ANY STATE BY THE US ALSO GO TO IRAN (E.G. CONTRACT RELIEF, SPENT FUEL BUY BACK). WE INTERPRET "MOST FAVORED NATION" AS APPLYING ONLY TO BENEFITS "GENERALLY AVAILABLE" TO OTHER STATES.

SUBSTANTIALLY VITIATE USG CAPABILITY, ONCE THE US HAS SUSPENDED ITS SAFEGUARD RIGHTS IN FAVOR OF IAEA SAFEGUARDS, TO DETERMINE THAT IAEA SAFEGUARDS ARE UNSATISFACTORY AND TO REINSTATE ITS OWN SAFEGUARDS.

1978STATE035494.subject: BRIEFING ON SADAT VISIT TO WASHINGTION-SHAH'S MEETING WITH BEGIN

segments.text: IN BRIEFING THE SHAH ON SADAT'S VISIT TO WASHINGTON YOU SHOULD FIRST OF ALL GIVE HIM A COPY OF THE WHITE HOUSE STATEMENT ISSUED FOLLOWING THE PRESIDENT'S FINAL MEETING WITH SADAT FEBRUARY 8. THE STATEMENT SETS OUT OUR BASIC POSITIONS ON ALL MAJOR ASPECTS OF THE MIDDLE EAST NEGOTIATIONS, I.E., THE NEED FOR NORMAL PEACEFUL RELATIONS, A COMPREHENSIVE PEACE, ISRAELI WITHDRAWAL AND THE APPLICABILITY OF RESOLUTION 242 TO ALL FRONTS, RESOLUTION OF THE PALESTINIAN PROBLEM IN ALL ITS ASPECTS (THE STATEMENT REITERATES THE PRESIDENT'S ASWAN LANGUAGE ON THIS POINT) AND VIEW THAT ISRAELI SETTLEMENTS ARE CONTRARY TO INTERNATIONAL LAW AND A CONTINUATION OF SETTLEMENT ACTIVITY INCONSISTENT WITH THE PEACE EFFORT.
WE REGARD THIS STATEMENT AS AN IMPORTANT REAFFIRMATION OF OUR VIEWS; IT PROVIDES GUIDELINES FOR OUR CONTINUING DIPLOMATIC EFFORTS AND SHOULD BE HELPFUL TO SADAT VIS-A-VIS HIS CRITICS.

SADAT ARRIVED IN WASHINGTON CLEARLY DISCOURAGED THAT ISRAEL HAD NOT BEEN MORE RESPONSIVE TO HIS JERUSALEM INITIATIVE. HE WAS PARTICULARLY FRUSTRATED BY THE ISRAELI POSITION ON RETENTION OF SETTLEMENTS IN SINAI AND BY ISRAEL'S UNWILLINGNESS THUS FAR TO AGREE TO MORE FORTHCOMING LANGUAGE ON THE PALESTINIAN ISSUE IN THE PROPOSED DECLARATION OF PRINCIPLES.

WE BELIEVE THAT AS A RESULT OF HIS TALKS WITH PRESIDENT CARTER AND OTHER ADMINISTRATION OFFICIALS, SADAT HAS LEFT WITH RENEWED DETERMINATION TO CONTINUE THE PEACE PROCESS AND WITH REASSURANCE THAT WE UNDERSTAND HIS CONCERNS AND ARE DETERMINED TO REMAIN FULLY AND ACTIVELY ENGAGED IN THE NEGOTIATING EFFORT. THE PRESIDENT SPENT CONSIDERABLE TIME EXPLAINING THE U.S. VIEW OF HOW THE NEGOTIATIONS ARE LIKELY TO EVOLVE. WHILE POINTING OUT THAT IT IS ONLY REALISTIC TO EXPECT THE NEGOTIATING PROCESS TO REQUIRE DETAILED DISCUSSIONS, PRESIDENT ASSURED SADAT THAT WE WOULD RESIST ALLOWING THE NEGOTIATIONS TO BOG DOWN. WE SOUGHT TO IMPRESS UPON SADAT THE NEED FOR CONTINUITY AND PERSEVERENCE.

WE ALSO TRIED TO GET ACROSS TO HIM THAT BEGIN IS DEALING WITH A COMPLEX POLITICAL SITUATION IN ISRAEL, THAT TIME IS NEEDED FOR ISRAELI OPINION TO ADJUST TO THE NEW CIRCUMSTANCES CREATED BY SADAT'S INITIATIVE, AND THAT BEGIN'S SINAI AND WEST BANK/GAZA PLAN REPRESENT EVOLUTION OF ISRAELI THINKING, EVEN THOUGH THEY FALL SHORT OF ARAB REQUIREMENTS.

THE PRESIDENT AND SADAT AGREED THAT, IN CONTINUATION OF THE NEGOTIATING PROCESS, ASSISTANT SECRETARY ATHERTON WOULD RETURN TO THE MIDDLE EAST IN THE NEAR FUTURE TO PURSUE THE WORK ALREADY UNDERWAY ON A DECLARATION OF PRINCIPLES. THEY VIEW SUCH A DECLARATION AS AN IMPORTANT STEP IN ESTABLISHING THE FRAMEWORK FOR A COMPREHENSIVE PEACE IN THE AREA AND AS PROVIDING A BASIS FOR BROADENING PARTICIPATION IN THE NEGOTIATIONS. SADAT CONTINUES TO ATTACH IMPORTANCE TO SEEING JORDAN AND MODERATE PALESTINIANS JOIN THE NEGOTIATING PROCESS AT AN APPROPRIATE TIME. SADAT TOOK THE POSITION THAT A DECLARATION OF PRINCIPLES SHOULD PRECEDE FORMAL RESUMPTION OF WORK IN THE POLITICAL COMMITTEE.

WE DISCUSSED WITH SADAT THE DESIRABILITY OF ATHERTON'S BEGINNING, AT THE SAME TIME HE CONTINUES NEGOTIATIONS ON THE DECLARATION, TO EXPLORE QUIETLY AND INFORMALLY WITH EGYPT, ISRAEL AND JORDAN POSSIBLE GUIDELINES FOR NEGOTIATING INTERIM ARRANGEMENTS FOR THE WEST BANK AND GAZA -- I.E., BEGINNING IN OTHER WORDS TO LOOK BEYOND THE DECLARATION TO WHAT IT MIGHT MEAN IN MORE SPECIFIC TERMS. SADAT AGREED TO CONSIDER THESE IDEAS, AND WE ARE ALSO SEEKING ANY PRELIMINARY REACTION JORDANIANS MAY HAVE.
ISRAELI FOREIGN MINISTER DAYAN WILL BE IN WASHINGTON FOR TALKS ON FEBRUARY 16, AND ATHERTON WILL DEPART FOR THE MIDDLE EAST SHORTLY THEREAFTER.

WITH REGARD TO THE LINE THE SHAH MIGHT PURSUE WITH BEGIN, HIS MAJESTY WILL HAVE GATHERED FROM THE FOREGOING THAT OUR AIM IN THE PERIOD AHEAD WILL BE TO MOVE TOWARD A DECLARATION OF PRINCIPLES ACCEPTABLE TO SADAT AND WHICH WILL SERVE AS A BASIS FOR JORDAN'S JOINING THE NEGOTIATIONS. THIS WILL MEAN AT A MINIMUM A DECLARATION EMPLOYING LANGUAGE ON THE PALESTINIAN PROBLEM ALONG THE LINES OF THE PRESIDENT'S ASWAN STATEMENT.

IT WILL ALSO MEAN MOVING TOWARD AN UNDERSTANDING ON INTERIM ARRANGEMENTS FOR THE WEST BANK AND GAZA GOING BEYOND THE BEGIN PLAN AND BASED ON RECOGNITION THAT THE WITHDRAWAL PROVISIONS OF SECURITY COUNCIL RESOLUTION 242 APPLY TO THE WEST BANK AND GAZA, ASSUMING ARRANGEMENTS CAN BE NEGOTIATED DURING THE INTERIM PERIOD WHICH PROVIDE ADEQUATELY FOR ISRAEL'S SECURITY CONCERNS AND WEST BANK LINKS TO JORDAN. WITH RESPECT TO THE EGYPTIANISRAELI NEGOTIATIONS ON SINAI BEING CONDUCTED BY GAMASY AND WEIZMAN IN THE CAIRO MILITARY COMMITTEE, THE PRINCIPAL ISSUE ON WHICH MOVEMENT WILL BE NEEDED IF PROGRESS IS TO BE MADE IS ISRAELI INSISTENCE ON RETAINING THEIR SETTLEMENTS IN SINAI.

SHAH WILL NO DOUBT HAVE HIS OWN INFORMATION ON BEGIN'S BACKGROUND AND HOW BEST TO DEAL WITH HIM. OUR EXPERIENCE HAS BEEN THAT BEGIN REACTS BEST TO AN APPROACH THAT APPEALS TO HIS SENSE OF HIS HISTORICAL ROLE. HE CAN BE VERY LEGALISTIC WHEN DEALING WITH TEXTS AND CONTENTIOUS IN ARGUMENT, BUT HE IS ACUTELY CONSCIOUS THAT HE HAS COME TO POWER AT A DECISIVE MOMENT AND WANTS TO GO DOWN IN HISTORY AS A MAN WHO MADE THE RIGHT JUDGMENTS AT THE RIGHT TIME.

AT THE SAME TIME, HE IS PULLED IN OTHER DIRECTION BY LIFELONG IDEOLOGICAL COMMITMENT TO ISRAEL'S HISTORICAL RIGHT TO WEST BANK AND GAZA AND BY LOYALTY TO HIS POLITICAL SUPPORTERS WHO ARE ALREADY CHARGING HIM WITH HAVING MADE TOO MANY CONCESSIONS. PERHAPS OUR MAIN TASK WILL BE TO BRING BEGIN TO THE RECOGNITION THAT PEACE WILL REQUIRE FURTHER EVOLUTION OF ISRAELI POSITIONS BUT THAT THIS CAN OCCUR WITHOUT PREJUDICE TO ISRAEL'S SECURITY AND WILL IN FACT BE IN ISRAEL'S LONG-TERM INTEREST. AS A FRIEND AND LEADER OF MAJOR POWER IN THE AREA, THE SHAH IS IN AN EXCELLENT POSITION TO ASSIST BEGIN IN REACHING THESE CONCLUSIONS.
IT GOES WITHOUT SAYING THAT WHATEVER POINTS HIS MAJESTY FEELS HE CAN MAKE TO BEGIN WILL BE MORE EFFECTIVE IF MADE IN HIS OWN NAME AND WITHOUT ANY SUGGESTION OF COORDINATION WITH US. V.VANCE VANCE

1978STATE037063.subject: OUTLINE OF POSSIBLE BASIS FOR SETTLEMENT IN OGADEN

segments.text: OGADEN
ACTION ADDRESSEES SHOULD INSURE THAT HOST GOVERNMENTS ARE AWARE OF SECRETARY'S STATEMENTS ON HORN OF AFRICA CONTAINED IN REPORT OF PRESS CONFERENCE (STATE 36187).

ACTION ADDRESSEES SHOULD ALSO SEEK PROMPTLY TO INFORM HOST GOVERNMENTS OF CURRENT U.S. THINKING ON ELEMENTS WHICH MIGHT PROVIDE A POSSIBLE BASIS FOR A NEGOTIATED SOLUTION. (ELEMENTS A THROUGH C WERE RECENTLY PASSED TO NIGERIAN COMMISSIONER FOR EXTERNAL AFFAIRS GARBA IN FORM OF NONPAPER WHEN GARBA WAS IN ADDIS.)

A BASIS FOR A SETTLEMENT WOULD SEEM TO EXIST IN A COMPROMISE BETWEEN, ON THE ONE HAND, ETHIOPIA'S STATED POLICY PROMISING THE VARIOUS ETHIOPIAN NATIONALITIES THE RIGHT TO SELF-DETERMINATION AND SELF-GOVERNMENT IN AUTONOMOUS REGIONS AND, ON THE OTHER HAND, THE SOMALI GOVERNMENT'S ASSERTION THAT ALL IT SEEKS IS THE SELFDETERMINATION OF THE OGADENI-SOMALI PEOPLE.

NEGOTIATIONS BETWEEN ETHIOPIA AND SOMALIA COULD BE FOCUSED ON THE MODALITIES FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF AN AUTONOMOUS REGIONAL GOVERNMENT OF THE OGADEN RUN BY THE OGADEN SOMALIS; THE NATURE OF THE RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN THE OGADEN REGIONAL GOVERNMENT AND ETHIOPIA, WHICH WOULD RETAIN SOVEREIGNTY OVER THE AREA; THE DEFINITION OF THE AREA TO BE INCLUDED IN SUCH AN AUTONOMOUS REGION; ARRANGEMENTS FOR FREE MOVEMENT OF NOMADIC PEOPLES; AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A DEFINITIVE BORDER TO REPLACE THE PRESENT "PROVISIONAL ADMINISTRATIVE LINE."

PRIOR TO THE INITIATION OF THOSE NEGOTIATIONS, AN UNDERSTANDING COULD BE REACHED BETWEEN ETHIOPIA AND SOMALIA, PERHAPS THROUGH THE EFFORTS OF A MEDIATOR SUCH AS THE OAU, ON THE PRINCIPLES OF THE SETTLEMENT,AND A CEASEFIRE AND WITHDRAWAL OF SOMALIS'S TROOPS THEN COULD BE IMPLEMENTED, UNDER THE SUPERVISION OF A NEUTRAL INTERNATIONAL ENTITY,WHICH WOULD BE TEMPORARILY PRESENT IN THE OGADEN AREA AND ENSURE THE SAFETY AND WELFARE OF ITS INHABITANTS PENDING SUCCESSFUL COMPLETION OF THE NEGOTIATIONS AND ESTABLISHMENT OF A REGIONAL OGADENI GOVERNMENT.
IN CONNECTION WITH THE WITHDRAWAL OF SOMALI FORCES FROM THE OGADEN, SOVIET AND CUBAN FORCES WOULD ALSO WITHDRAW FROM ETHIOPIA.

YOU MAY INFORM HOST GOVERNMENTS THIS REPRESENTS LATEST U.S. THINKING ON CONCEPTS OF SETTLEMENT. WE WOULD BE INTERESTED IN HOST GOVERNMENT REACTIONS TO CONCEPT AND WHETHER THEY CONSIDER IT EQUITABLE AND/OR FEASIBLE. DEPT. WOULD ALSO APPRECIATE HOST GOVERNMENT VIEWS ON PROBABILITY THAT SOMALIA AND ETHIOPIA CAN BE PERSUADED TO ACCEPT THESE PROPOSALS.

FOR CAIRO, KHARTOUM, JIDDA AND TEHRAN: YOU SHOULD FURTHER INFORM HOST GOVERNMENTS THAT, ASSUMING THAT THEY AGREE WITH THE BROAD LINES OF OUR PROPOSED BASIS OF SETTLEMENT, WE BELIEVE IT ESSENTIAL THAT THEY EXERT THEIR INFLUENCE WITH PRESIDENT SIAD BARRE TO INDUCE HIM TO ACCEPT THIS FORMULATION AS BEING IN SOMALIA'S BEST INTEREST, AND PARTICULARLY THAT HE MUST NOW ACCEPT THE INEVITABILITY OF SOMALI WITHDRAWAL FROM OGADEN IN RELATION TO THE OVERALL SETTLEMENT. SIAD BARRE IS AWARE OF THIS PROPOSAL, BUT STILL RESISTS ACCEPTANCE OF LESS THAN HIS MAXIMUM OBJECTIVES. WE BELIEVE HE MUST NOW LOWER HIS SIGHTS TO PRESERVE THE INTEGRITY OF HIS OWN TERRITORY.

YOU SHOULD ALSO INFORM HOST GOVERNMENTS THAT WE ARE CURRENTLY REVIEWING US POSITION ON THE HORN CONFLICT, PARTICULARLY IN RELATION TO THE SITUATION WHICH WOULD PREVAIL IF THE SOMALI BORDER WERE CROSSED BY INVADING FORCES. IN THIS CONNECTION, WE WOULD FIND IT MOST USEFUL TO KNOW IN DETAIL WHAT YOUR HOST GOVERNMENTS HAVE ALREADY DONE AND WHAT THEY PLAN TO DO IN PROVISION OF MILITARY SUPPLIES, AND TECHNICAL PERSONNEL OR MILITARY PERSONNEL TO SOMALIA. (FYI: US HAS NOT RPT NOT DECIDED THAT IT WOULD SUPPLY ARMS OR AUTHORIZE THE TRANSFER OR USE OF US ARMS AND YOU SHOULD AVOID GIVING THE IMPRESSION THAT IT IS LIKELY WE WOULD DO SO.)

FOR LIBREVILLE AND LAGOS: YOU SHOULD FURTHER TELL BONGO AND OBASANJO THAT WE WOULD APPRECIATE THEIR ASSESSMENT OF THE DEGREE TO WHICH THE RECENTLY-CONCLUDED GARBA MISSION TO ADDIS ABABA AND MOGADISCIO HAS ADVANCED THE CAUSE OF A PEACEFUL SETTLEMENT IN THE HORN. WE ARE MOST INTERESTED IN LEARNING WHAT SUCCESS GARBA HAD IN PERSUADING THE COMBATANTS TO NEGOTIATE. WE WOULD NOT WISH TO PROMOTE ANY ACTION WHICH DID NOT SUPPORT THE CENTRAL OAU EFFORT, LED BY NIGERIA. YOU SHOULD SAY THAT WE CONTINUE TO FEEL THAT THE OAU IS THE APPROPRIATE MECHANISM TO BE UTILIZED IN THIS SITUATION.
WE WONDER, HOWEVER, IN VIEW OF THE ESCALATION OF THIS CONFLICT AND ITS GROWING GLOBAL IMPLICATIONS, IF OTHER INTERNATIONAL MECHANISMS MIGHT BE USED TO BUTTRESS THE OAU'S EFFORTS.

FOR NAIROBI: GOK SHOULD BE CAREFULLY BRIEFED ON PROPOSALS. KENYANS SHOULD BE REASSURED, IN LIGHT OF THEIR RECENTLY EXPRESSED CONCERNS, BY SECRETARY'S PUBLIC CALL FOR SOMALI WITHDRAWAL.WHILE DISCUSSION OF "AUTONOMOUS REGIONAL GOVERNMENT" IN PARA 2(B) MAY BE DISTURBING TO KENYANS, YOU CAN LAY GREAT STRESS ON REAFFIRMATION OF ETHIOPIAN SOVEREIGNTY OVER AREA AND SECRETARY'S CALL IN PRESS CONFERENCE FOR "RESPECT BY ALL PARTIES FOR INTERNATIONALLY RECOGNIZED BORDERS", THE LATTER STATEMENT SHOULD BE INTERPRETED AS APPLYING TO KENYA-SOMALI BORDERS AS WELL. IN THIS CONNECTION YOU SHOULD CALL ATTENTION TO THE FACT THAT WE HAVE REPEATEDLY WARNED SOMALIS, BOTH HERE AND IN MOGADISCIO, THAT THEY MUST RESPECT THIS BORDER.

FOR LONDON, BONN, PARIS AND OTTAWA: AS YOU KNOW, YOUR HOST GOVERNMENTS' FOREIGN MINISTERS WILL BE IN NEW YORK OVER THE WEEKEND. THE ISSUE OF THE HORN WILL BE DISCUSSED AT THAT TIME. THE FOREIGN MINISTER OF CANADA WILL OF NECESSITY BE INCLUDED IN THAT DISCUSSION.
FOR CARACAS, BELGRADE AND NEW DELHI: YOU SHOULD LIMIT BRIEFING TO EXPLANATION OF OUR FIVE POINT PROPOSAL WITHOUT DISCUSSING THE BROADER CONCEPT AND OTHER ACTIONS.
FOR MOSCOW: THE PROPOSAL AND OUR VIEW OF SOVIET ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES WILL BE DISCUSSED WITH DOBRYNIN IN WASHINGTON EARLY NEXT WEEK. CHRISTOPHER

1978STATE043325.subject: PLAN OF ACTION FOR HORN OF AFRICA

segments.text: STATE 37063

CONCERNING POINTS RAISED IN REF A CONCERNING DISCREPANCY BETWEEN "ELEMENTS OF DRAFT SC RESOLUTION" AND EARLIER ELEMENTS OF PLAN FOR NEGOTIATED SETTLEMENT (REF D), REF C IS GOVERNING IN ANY DISCUSSION OF SECURITY COUNCIL ASPECTS OF HORN SITUATION. THE ELEMENTS OF A DRAFT RESOLUTION IN REF C WERE GENERALLY AGREED AMONG WESTERN FIVE IN NEW YORK AND REPRESENT OUR VIEW OF WHAT MIGHT BE ATTAINABLE IN SC. IT IS ONLY THE ROUGH OUTLINE OF WHAT A RESOLUTION MIGHT LOOK LIKE AND WE WOULD EXPECT--AND HOPE-THAT IT WOULD BE STRENGTHENED IN NEGOTIATIONS AFTER IT HAS BEEN AGREED TO SEIZE THE COUNCIL OF THE HORN ISSUE.
IRANIAN CONTRIBUTION TO THIS PROCESS WOULD BE WELCOME.

IN ANY EVENT, SECURITY COUNCIL RESOLUTION WOULD BE DESIGNED TO GET NEGOTIATIONS ON A SETTLEMENT GOING, PREFERABLY UNDER OAU AUSPICES. ETHIOPIA WOULD NOT BE LIKELY TO ACCEPT GUIDELINES FOR A SETTLEMENT WHICH IMPLICITLY LIMITED ITS SOVEREIGNTY IN THE OGADEN, BUT IN THE PROCESS OF ACTUAL NEGOTIATIONS IMPLEMENTING GENERAL GUIDELINES WE WOULD HOPE IT WOULD BE POSSIBLE TO REACH AGREEMENT ON NEUTRAL INTERNATIONAL MACHINERY WHICH WOULD HAVE THE EFFECT OF ENSURING AGAINST REPRISALS. FORMAL MANDATE OF SUCH AN ENTITY MAY, HOWEVER, HAVE TO BE LIMITED TO "MONITORING AND REPORTING" ON EVENTS.

PRESUME THAT IRANIANS WOULD AGREE THAT THE BEST HOPE WE HAVE OF DETERRING REPRISALS IS TO GET NEGOTIATIONS STARTED PROMPTLY AND THAT PROSPECTS OF ACHIEVING THIS WOULD BE WORSENED BY SURFACING "GUIDELINES" WHICH WOULD BE UNACCEPTABLE TO ONE OF THE PARTIES. THE APPEARANCE OF EVEN-HANDEDNESS WOULD BE ESPECIALLY IMPORTANT IN THE UN CONTEXT.

WITH REGARD TO REF B, WHILE THE ETHIOPIAN AIR STRIKES AGAINST NORTHERN SOMALI CITIES OBVIOUSLY ARE REGRETTABLE VIOLATIONS OF SOMALIA'S AIRSPACE, WE DO NOT CONSIDER THAT THE PRESENT SCALE OF THESE INTERMITTENT ATTACKS CONSTITUTES AGGRESSION AGAINST SOMALIA. THEY CAN IN FACT BE SEEN AS JUSTIFIABLE RETALIATION AGAINST SOMALI AGGRESSION SUPPORTED FROM THOSE CITIES. THEY DO NOT, IN OUR VIEW, REPRESENT A BREACH OF SOVIET ASSURANCES THAT SOMALIA WOULD NOT BE INVADED ALTHOUGH WE AGREE THAT THEY ARE NOT CONSISTENT WITH THOSE ASSURANCES AND HAVE SO INFORMED THE SOVIETS.

OUR PLAN WOULD STILL BE PURSUED EVEN IF AN INTERNAL COUP IN SOMALIA SHOULD REPLACE SIAD BARRE REGIME WITH A PRO-SOVIET GROUP. OUR GOAL IS TO REACH A MEANINGFUL, ENDURING SETTLEMENT TO ETHIOPIA/SOMALI CONFLICT NO MATTER WHAT COLORATION OF REGIMES ARE. WE DO NOT, BY THE WAY, FORESEE AT THIS TIME THE COLLAPSE OF SIAD BARRE. NOR DO WE BELIEVE A POST-BARRE REGIME, IF IT EMERGED, WOULD NECESSARILY BE PRO-SOVIET. INDEED, TO BE PRO-SOVIET IN SOMALIA AT THIS JUNCTURE IS TO BE ANTI-SOMALI. VANCE
YOU SHOULD TAKE APPROPRIATE OCCASION PRIOR TO BEGIN'S VISIT TO TEHRAN TO BRIEF THE SHAH FURTHER ALONG THE LINES OF THIS MESSAGE.

DAYAN'S BRIEF VISIT TO WASHINGTON PRODUCED NO NEW DEVELOPMENTS OF ANY MOMENT. HE CONTINUES TO BELIEVE EFFORTS SHOULD BE PURSUED TO GET A DECLARATION OF PRINCIPLES AGREED WITH SADAT BUT WAS NOT INTERESTED IN DISCUSSING SPECIFIC LANGUAGE OF DECLARATION WHILE HERE. HE DID ASK OUR HELP IN GETTING FORMAL MEETINGS OF POLITICAL COMMITTEE RESUMED, ON GROUNDS THAT THERE WAS UNDESIRABLE ASYMETTRY IN CONTINUED MEETINGS OF SECURITY COMMITTEE IN CAIRO WHILE POLITICAL COMMITTEE WAS SUSPENDED. WE UNDERTOOK TO RAISE THIS WITH EGYPTIANS BUT INDICATED WE DID NOT THINK HE WOULD BE RESPONSIVE UNTIL A DECLARATION OF PRINCIPLES HAD BEEN AGREED TO.
DAYAN ALSO, PREDICTABLY, EXPRESSED ISRAELI CONCERN OVER AIRCRAFT SALES TO SAUDI ARABIA (VERY LITTLE WAS SAID ABOUT PROPOSED SALE TO EGYPT).

ISRAELIS HAVE EXPRESSED UNHAPPINESS WITH OUR RECENT REFERENCES TO "WITHDRAWAL ON ALL FRONTS" UNDER UN RES. 242. SECRETARY PRESSED DAYAN AS TO ISRAELI ACCEPTANCE THAT 242 DOES REQUIRE WITHDRAWAL ON ALL FRONTS, ASSUMING AGREEMENT CAN BE REACHED ON BORDER ADJUSTMENTS, SECURITY ARRANGEMENTS AND POLITICAL LINKAGE AT WEST BANK TO JORDAN. DAYAN AVOIDED DIRECT ANSWER, SAYING ONLY THAT ISRAELIS HAVE "THEIR OWN PLAN" (I.E., THE "BEGIN PLAN") FOR THE WEST BANK.

FROM OUR RECENT EXCHANGES WITH ISRAELIS, IT IS APPARENT THAT BEGIN IS NOT YET PREPARED TO ACCEPT THE PRINCIPLE OF WITHDRAWAL FROM WEST BANK, UNDERSTANDABLE IN VIEW OF HIS LONG-HELD IDEOLOGICAL COMMITMENTS, BUT OF CRUCIAL IMPORTANCE IF THERE IS TO BE A SUCCESSFUL SOLUTION TO PROBLEM AND ANY PROSPECT OF A PEACE SETTLEMENT. WE BELIEVE THIS WILL BE THE MOST DIFFICULT DECISION FOR ISRAELIS TO FACE IN COMING WEEKS. FYI WE WANT TO BE SURE THAT THIS POINT IS MADE TO SHAH CLEARLY AND WITH EMPHASIS. END FYI.
YOU SHOULD EXPRESS TO SHAH OUR APPRECIATION OF CONTINUED EXCHANGES ON THIS SUBJECT AND SAY WE WILL LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING HIS VIEWS AFTER HIS MEETING WITH BEGIN.

AS IS SO OFTEN THE CASE, NOTHING IS HAPPENING IN THE EYE OF THE HURRICANE. GOVERNMENT HAS NOT ANNOUNCED THE FALL OF FAYA LARGEAU, NOR HAS IT PUBLICLY MENTIONED POSSIBLE MALLOUM-QADHAFI MEETING OR CEASE FIRE. GOVERNMENT AND ARMY APPEAR CALM WITH A BUSINESS AS USUAL UNQUOTE APPROACH, ALTHOUGH RADIO DID CALL FOR ALL DRAFT AGE YOUTHS TO APPEAR AT CITY HALL TOMORROW, FEB. 21.
INFORMAL CONVERSATIONS CONFIRM THAT SOME SORT OF MALLOUM-QADHAFI MEETING IS IN THE WORKS, BUT WHEN AND WHERE ARE STILL UNCLEAR.

ON MILITARY SIDE, COLUMN EVACUATING OUNIANGA KEBIR APPEARS TO STILL BE IN TACT AND MAKING GOOD PROGRESS (NOW SOME 100 KMS SOUTH OF FAYA LARGEAU). TWO SMALL GROUPS OF SURVIVORS FROM FAYA HAVE MADE THEIR WAY TO NDJAMENA, BUT DETAILS OF THE FALL OF FAYA ARE STILL UNKNOWN.

1978STATE048750.subject: SENATE HEARINGS ON G. WILLIAM MILLER

segments.text: LETTERS TO THREE INDIVIDUALS INVITING THEM TO APPEAR BEFORE SENATE COMMITTEE (PRECHT TELCON) HAVE BEEN DELIVERED TO IRANIAN EMBASSY HERE UNDER COVER OF DIPLOMATIC NOTE. FOLLOWING IS TEXT OF LETTER

BEGIN TEXT: PRESIDENT CARTER HAS NOMINATED G. WILLIAM MILLER, CHAIRMAN OF THE BOARD OF TEXTRON, TO BE A MEMBER OF THE BOARD OF GOVERNORS OF THE FEDERAL RESERVE SYSTEM. THE FEDERAL RESERVE IS THIS NATION'S CENTRAL BANK. UNDER THE CONSTITUTION OF THE UNITED STATES, THE U.S. SENATE MUST GIVE ITS ADVICE AND CONSENT TO THE PRESIDENT'S NOMINATION. THIS IS USUALLY REFERRED TO AS THE CONFIRMATION PROCESS. THE BANKING, HOUSING, AND URBAN AFFAIRS COMMITTEE IS THE COMMITTEE OF THE SENATE WHICH HAS JURISDICTION OVER THE NOMINATION AND CONFIRMATION OF G. WILLIAM MILLER. UNDER THE PROCEDURES OF THIS COMMITTEE

WILLIAM MILLER TESTIFIED ON HIS OWN BEHALF ON JANUARY 24, 1978. DURING THE COURSE OF MR. MILLER'S TESTIMONY, A QUESTION WAS RAISED ABOUT A PAYMENT OF $2.9 MILLION BY BELL HELICOPTER, A DIVISON OF TEXTRON, TO AIR TAXI IN CONNECTION WITH THE SALE OF 489 HELICOPTERS TO IRAN DURING THE PERIOD OF 1973-1975. IT WAS ALLEGED THAT GENERAL MOHAMMED KHATAMI HAD AN OWNERSHIP INTEREST IN AIR TAXI. THE COMMITTEE HAS BEEN CONDUCTING AN INVESTIGATION INTO FACTS SURROUNDING BELL'S PAYMENT TO AIR TAXI, INCLUDING WHAT KNOWLEDGE TEXTRON AND BELL HELICOPTER OFFICIALS, INCLUDING G. WILLIAM MILLER, MAY HAVE HAD RESPECTING GENERAL KHATAMI'S OWNERSHIP INTEREST IN AIR TAXI.

IT HAS COME TO THE ATTENTION OF THIS COMMITTEE THAT YOU POSSESS IMPORTANT INFORMATION THAT WOULD BE RELEVANT TO THE COMMITTEE'S INVESTIGATION. BECAUSE OF THE IMPORTANCE OF YOUR TESTIMONY, THIS COMMITTEE REQUESTS YOUR APPEARANCE AT A HEARING TO BE CONDUCTED IN RESPECT TO THESE MATTERS AS IT RELATES TO THE NOMINATION OF G. WILLIAM MILLER DURING THE WEEK OF FEBRUARY 25 THROUGH MARCH 4. THE HEARING WILL BE HELD IN ROOM 5300 OF THE NEW SENATE OFFICE BUILDING IN WASHINGTON, D.C. THE COMMITTEE UNANIMOUSLY AGREED TO MAKE THIS REQUEST FOR YOUR VOLUNTARY APPEARANCE BECAUSE IT FELT THIS TO BE A MATTER INVOLVING THE HIGHEST NATIONAL INTEREST.
THE COMMITTEE WILL PAY YOUR TOURIST AIR FARE AND REASONABLE EXPENSES WHEN YOU APPEAR AND TESTIFY. IN RESPONSE TO THIS REQUEST, I WOULD APPRECIATE YOUR CALLING MR. CHARLES

MARINACCIO, SPECIAL COUNSEL TO THIS COMMITTEE, COLLECT AT 202-224-7391 OR 202-224-1571. I THANK YOU IN ADVANCE FOR YOUR COOPERATION WITH THE WORK OF THIS COMMITTEE OF THE UNITED STATES SENATE. SINCERELY, (SGD) WILLIAM PROXMIRE, CHAIRMAN. . VANCE

1978STATE053176.subject: SECRETARY'S DISCUSSION OF AFRICAN QUESTIONS WITH IRANIAN FINANCE MINISTER

segments.text: IRANIAN FINANCE MINISTER

AT CONCLUSION OF U.S.-IRAN JOINT COMMISSION MEETING FEBRUARY 28, THE SECRETARY HAD A FINAL MEETING WITH FINANCE MINISTER YEGANEH IN WHICH SEVERAL AFRICAN MATTERS WERE DISCUSSED. AMBASSADOR ZAHEDI, AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN AND ACTING ASSISTANT SECRETARY SOBER WERE ALSO PRESENT.

HORN OF AFRICA. THE SECRETARY NOTED THAT WE HAVE SENT A MESSAGE TO PRESIDENT SIAD BARRE TO THE EFFECT THAT HE MUST WITHDRAW FROM THE OGADEN; IT WAS IN HIS INTEREST TO DO SO AND, IF HE DID, SOMALIA'S POSITION WOULD BE DEFENSIBLE BEFORE WORLD OPINION. THE SECRETARY SAID THAT IF SOMALIA WITHDREW ITS TROOPS TO WITHIN ITS OWN BORDERS, THE U.S. WOULD AGREE TO THIRD-COUNTRY TRANSFERS AND WOULD CONSIDER THE SUPPLY OF SOME DEFENSIVE WEAPONS OURSELVES. WE WERE URGING SOMALIA TO USE THE OAU OR UN MECHANISMS TO WORK OUT A SOLUTION.

SECRETARY SAID HE HAD MET THAT MORNING WITH THE KENYAN AMBASSADOR WHO HAD SHOWN THE SECRETARY A MAP ALLEGED TO BE OF SOMALI ORIGIN SHOWING A KENYAN BORDER AREA AS SOMALI TERRITORY. THE KENYANS WERE SENDING A LARGE, VERY HIGHLEVEL DELEGATION LED BY THEIR VICE PRESIDENT, WHICH WAS TO ARRIVE IN WASHINGTON MARCH 1, TO EXPRESS THEIR DEEP CONCERN, TO ASK FOR U.S. EFFORTS TO ENSURE THAT KENYAN TERRITORY WAS NOT INVADED, AND PROBABLY TO ASK FOR U.S. ARMS.
THE SECRETARY SAID IT WAS OUR IMPRESSION THAT, ALTHOUGH KENYA WAS CONCERNED OVER THE SOVIET PRESENCE IN THE REGION, IT WAS EVEN MORE CONCERNED OVER THE SOMALI THREAT TO ITS OWN FRONTIERS.

IN RESPONSE TO QUESTIONS, THE SECRETARY STATED THAT THE SOVIETS HAD ASSURED US THAT THEY AND THE ETHIOPIANS WOULD NOT CROSS THE SOMALI FRONTIER IF SOMALIA WITHDREW ITS TROOPS FROM THE OGADEN. THE ETHIOPIANS HAD MADE A SIMILAR STATEMENT TO OUR OWN EMISSARY. THE CUBANS HAVE GIVEN A SIMILAR ASSURANCE, AND ADDITIONALLY HAVE SENT WORD THAT THEY DO NOT INTEND TO BECOME ENGAGED IN THE FIGHTING IN ERITREA WHERE THE SOVIETS ARE PRESENT.
YEGANEH AND ZAHEDI SAID THAT IRAN'S POLICY WITH RESPECT TO A SOLUTION OF THE OGADEN PROBLEM WAS SIMILAR TO THAT OF THE U.S.

CHAD. ZAHEDI NOTED THAT CHAD HAD BEEN ASKING IRAN FOR HELP, WITH U.S. ENCOURAGEMENT. HE STATED THAT IRAN HAD CONCLUDED THAT IT WAS INADVISABLE TO BECOME INVOLVED IN CHAD AT THIS TIME. THE SECRETARY SAID HE UNDERSTOOD IRAN'S FEELING ON THIS MATTER.

RHODESIA. THE SECRETARY SAID THAT USG VIEWS THE ANGLO-AMERICAN PLAN AS PROVIDING A PROPER SET OF STANDARDS WHICH WOULD LEAD TO ELECTIONS. USG REALIZES THAT WE MUST DEAL WITH REALITIES AND THAT SOME PROGRESS HAS BEEN MADE IN SO-CALLED INTERNAL DISCUSSIONS,WHICH WE HAVE CHARACTERIZED AS A SIGNIFICANT STEP, ALTHOUGH WE BELIEVE IT IS TOO EARLY TO TELL HOW EFFECTIVE THEY WILL BE. THE SECRETARY SAID IT WAS OUR INTENTION TO CONTINUE TO CONSULT WITH THE FRONT-LINE PRESIDENTS. MEANWHILE, THE PATRIOTIC FRONT IS ATTACKING BOTH UK AND U.S., BUT WE WILL REMAIN IN TOUCH WITH THE RHODESIAN LEADERS OUTSIDE RHODESIA AS WELL AS WITH MUZAREWA.

1978STATE055153.subject: SDR PROCLAIMS MOBILIZATION, BUT ALSO READINESS TO MAKE PEACE

segments.text: SALIENT POINTS OF THE SOMALI REVOLUTIONARY SOCIALIST PARTY'S CENTRAL COMMITTEE STATEMENT OF FEB 11 FOLLOW
THE SOVIETS AND CUBANS HAVE TAKEN OVER THE MILITARY OPERATIONS AND CONDUCT MASSACRES OF SOMALI PEOPLE AND AIR RAIDS AGAINST CIVILIAN CENTERS IN THE SDR.
SOVIET ACTIONS FORCE THE GSDR TO REVIEW ITS RELATIONS WITH THE SOVEIT UNION.
IF THE WESTERN POWERS DO NOT ACT TO COUNTER SOVIET VIOLATIONS, THEN WORLD PEACE WILL BE IN DANGER AS A RESULT OF THE INTERNATIONALIZATION OF THE CONFLICT.
THE SDR HAS INCREASED ITS ASSISTNACE TO THE "LIBERATION FORCES" AND DISPATCHED UNITS OF ITS OWN ARMED FORCES TO AID IN THE STRUGGLE.
THE SAME STATEMENT OUTLINES A THREE STEP PEACE PLAN FOR A SETTLEMENT IN THE HORN AS FOLLOWS
A CEASEFIRE SO AS TO STOP THE BLOODSHED. ?. THE WITHDRAWAL OF FOREIGN TROOPS FROM THE REGION AND THE WORKING OUT OF MEANS TO ASCERTAIN THIS.

A CLEAR SOLUTION TO THE PROBLEM OF THE RIGHTS OF THE PEOPLES STRUGGLING FOR SELF-DETERMINATION AND INDEPENDENCE FROM THE ADDIS REGIME, WHICH IS BENT ON THEIR ANNIHILATION WITH THE COLLABORATION OF FOREIGN FORCES. END .
THE STATEMENTTHEN GOES ON TO PROCLIAM THE FOLLOWING ACTIONS
THE INSTITUTION OF A STATE OF EMERGENCY FOR THE DEFENSE OF ITS UNITY AND NATIONAL EXISTANCE.
IN ORDER TO RELIZE THIS OBJECTIVE EVERY SOMALI IS CALLED UPON TO CONSIDER HIMSELF/HERSELF PART OF THIS GENERAL MOBILIZATION AND EFFORTS TOWARDS NATIONAL DEFENSE.
ALL RETIRED AND SECONDED ARMY SERVICE MEN ARE TO REPORT THEMSELVES TO THE DEFENSE MINISTRY.
THE NATIONAL DEFENSE DUTY CALLS FOR THE ENLISTMENT OF VOLUNTEERS, WHO ARE REQUESTED TO REPORT THEMSELVES AT CENTERS ESTABLISHED BY THE DEFENSE MINISTRY FOR THE PURPOSE.
THE WORKERS, CIVIL SERVENTS, ADMINISTRATIVE ORGANS OF THE GOVERNMENT AND THE PUBLIC ARE CALLED UPON TO REDOUBLE THEIR EFFORTS AS THEY HAVE DONE BEFORE WHEN THE NATION WAS CONFORNTED WITH HARD TIMES.

COMMENT: THE PARTY DECLARATION COMES AT THE END OF A WEEK WHEN THE MILITARY INITIATIVE PASSED TO THE ETHIOPIANS AND THEIR SOVIET AND CUBAN ALLIES. WITH THE SOMALI FORCES NOW TRYING TO GAIN TIME FOR A NEGOTIATED SOLUTION, WE ANTICIPATE THE GOVERNMENT WILL UNDERTAKE TO PREPARE THE WAY SOMETHING CONSIDERABLY LESS THAN THE VICTORY THE POPULACE ONCE FELT WAS WITHIN SOMALI GRASP. A BREAK IN DIPLOMATIC RELATIONS WITH THE SOVIETS WAS THEATENED, BUT THIS POTENTIALLY POPULAR STEP WAS DEFERRED, PERHAPS IN THE INTEREST OF A NEGOTIATED SETTLEMENT IN WHICH THE SOVIETS ARE SEEN AS A NECWSSARY IF DISTASTEFUL PARTNER. LOUGHRAN

GEORGE WILL'S COLUMN CARRIED IN TODAY'S PRESS STATES THAT UNITED STATES HAS "APPROACHED IRAN ABOUT STOPPING THE FLOW OF OIL TO ISRAEL UNTIL CONCESSIONS ARE MADE". I HAVE SPOKEN TO WILL, WHO TELLS ME HIS SOURCE WAS IN THE PRESENCE OF A "HIGH AMERICAN OFFICIAL" IN IRAN LAST FALL WHEN SUCH AN APPROACH WAS REPORTEDLY MADE.
I WOULD APPRECIATE YOUR CONTACTING ME BY SECURE TELEPHONE MARCH 13 AT 0745 WASHINGTON TIME TO DISCUSS THIS MATTER.
WARM REGARDS. VANCE

1978STATE077948_2.subject: BRIEFING FOR THE SHAH ON BEGIN VISIT

segments.text: I WANT TO BE SURE THAT THE SHAH HAS A FULL AND ACCURATE PICTURE OF WHERE WE STAND NOW IN THE MIDDLE EAST PEACE NEGOTIATIONS AS RESULT OF THE PRESIDENT'S TALKS WITH BEGIN MARCH 21-22. PLEASE CONVEY TO HIM FOLLOWING REPORT. PLEASE TELL THE SHAH THAT WHILE THE TALKS WITH BEGIN WERE DIFFICULT, WE THINK THEY SERVED THE PURPOSE WE SET FOR THEM AND MARK AN IMPORTANT STEP IN THE PEACE PROCESS. I PARTICULARLY WANT HIM TO KNOW THAT THE USG IS DETERMINED TO PERSEVERE AND TO SUCCEED IN THIS EFFORT, AND THAT OBVIOUSLY WE WILL BE COUNTING ON HELP THAT THE SHAH CAN GIVE US AS WE PROCEED.
WE WILL OF COURSE WELCOME ANY THOUGHTS THE SHAH MAY HAVE.

THE VISIT SHOULD BE VIEWED IN RELATION TO WHERE WE ARE IN THE PEACE PROCESS. FOLLOWING THE INITIAL MOMENTUM GENERATED BY THE JERUSALEM AND ISMAILIA SUMMITS, WHEN THE NEGOTIATIONS BEGAN TO GET DOWN TO THE MOST FUNDAMENTAL ISSUES PROGRESS SLOWED ACCORDINGLY. WE DISCUSSED THESE ISSUES WITH PRESIDENT SADAT IN FEBRUARY AND FOLLOWING FURTHER GROUNDWORK THROUGH ATHERTON'S TALKS IN THE AREA FELT IT WAS IMPORTANT TO DISCUSS THEM ALSO WITH PRIME MINISTER BEGIN.

THE TALKS BETWEEN THE PRESIDENT AND PRIME MINISTER BEGIN DURING THIS VISIT WERE THE MOST PROBING AND DETAILED THEY EVER HAD. PRESIDENT AND PRIME MINISTER MET FOR TWO HOURS MORNING MARCH 21 AND CONTINUED TALKS AT PRIVATE DINNER THAT EVENING AND ON MORNING MARCH 22. SECRETARY PURSUED DISCUSSIONS AT DINNER WITH DAYAN MARCH 21, AND IN MEETINGS AFTERNOONS MARCH 21 AND 22. THROUGHOUT THE VISIT THE PRESIDENT KEPT THE CONVERSATION FOCUSED ON THE CRITICAL ISSUES OF WITHDRAWAL AND THE PALESTINIAN QUESTION AND LEFT BEGIN IN NO DOUBT OF THE CRUCIAL DECISIONS ISRAEL MUST MAKE TO KEEP THE PEACE PROCESS GOING.

BEGIN DID NOT GO BEYOND PRESENT POSITIONS NOR DID WE EXPECT HIM TO DURING THIS VISIT, BUT WE BELIEVE THAT HE WILL GO HOME DEEPLY AWARE THAT THE ISRAELI GOVERNMENT NOW FACES DECISIONS WHICH CANNOT BE AVOIDED. THE PUBLIC HANDLING OF THE TALKS WAS SUCH THAT THE PUBLIC BOTH IN THE U.S. AND IN ISRAEL KNOWS THAT THESE WERE DIFFICULT MEETINGS WHERE THE ISSUES WERE SQUARELY JOINED.

THE PRESIDENT FORCEFULLY STATED THE DEEP AMERICAN INTEREST IN AND COMMITMENT TO ACHIEVING PEACE IN THE MIDDLE EAST. HE EMPHASIZED HIS COMMITMENT TO CONTINUE WORKING WITH THE PARTIES IN EVERY WAY POSSIBLE TO REMOVE OBSTACLES TO PROGRESS IN THE NEGOTIATIONS. THE PRESIDENT STRESSED THE NEED FOR EARLY CONCLUSION OF A MEANINGFUL DECLARATION OF PRINCIPLES WHICH MUST DEAL WITH THE WITHDRAWAL ISSUE AND THE PALESTINIAN QUESTION IN TERMS THAT WILL PROVIDE A CREDIBLE BASIS FOR BROADER NEGOTIATIONS.

CENTRAL FOCUS THROUGHOUT THE TWO DAYS OF CONVERSATION WAS ON THE NECESSITY FOR ISRAEL TO ACCEPT UNEQUIVOCALLY THAT ALL THE PRINCIPLES OF RESOLUTION 242, INCLUDING WITHDRAWAL, APPLY ON ALL FRONTS. THE PRESIDENT MADE CLEAR THAT ACCEPTANCE OF THE PRINCIPLE OF WITHDRAWAL, INCLUDING ON THE WEST BANK AND GAZA, IS ESSENTIAL TO PROGRESS IN THE PEACE NEGOTIATIONS. BEGIN ARGUED THAT NOTHING IN ISRAEL'S PEACE PROPOSALS IS INCONSISTENT WITH 242; THAT EVERYTHING IS NEGOTIABLE; AND THAT THERE SHOULD BE NO PRECONDITIONS FOR NEGOTIATIONS.

WE POINTED OUT THAT THIS ISRAELI POSITION AVOIDS THE BASIC ISSUE OF WHETHER ISRAEL WILL ULTIMATELY WITHDRAW, IN THE CONTEXT OF PEACE COMMITMENTS, SECURITY ARRANGEMENTS AND AGREED BORDERS, AND ALLOW THE PALESTINIANS A REAL VOICE IN DETERMINING THEIR OWN FUTURE. PRESIDENT MADE CLEAR THAT WHILE DISCUSSIONS COULD BE STARTED FROM THE BEGIN SELF-RULE PLAN, WE DO NOT BE STARTED FROM THE BEGIN SELF-RULE PLAN, WE DO NOT CONSIDER THE PLAN, AS IT NOW STANDS, TO OFFER ADEQUATE ARRANGEMENTS FOR THE FUTURE OF THE WEST BANK AND GAZA.

THE PRESIDENT PUT FORWARD A NUMBER OF EXPLORATORY THOUGHTS ON HOW TO BRIDGE THE DIFFERENCES BETWEEN THE PARTIES REGARDING WEST BANK AND GAZA ISSUES AND ALSO REGARDING SINAI. HOWEVER, WE DID NOT, AS SOME PRESS REPORTS ALLEGE, PUT FORWARD A FORMAL U.S. PROPOSAL FOR THE WEST BANK AND GAZA.

THE PRESIDENT REITERATED THE U.S. POSITION REGARDING ISRAELI SETTLEMENTS IN THE OCCUPIED TERRITORIES. IN A SEPARATE MEETING, FOREIGN MINISTER DAYAN TOLD SECRETARY VANCE THAT THERE WILL BE NO NEW SETTLEMENTS IN SINAI WHILE NEGOTIATIONS ARE UNDERWAY AND THAT EACH NEW SETTLEMENT IN THE WEST BANK WILL REQUIRE SPECIFIC CABINET APPROVAL. THE SECRETARY EMPHASIZED THAT WE WOULD VIEW ANY NEW SETTLEMENTS WITH THE UTMOST SERIOUSNESS.

WE BELIEVE THESE MEETINGS WENT FARTHER THAN HAS EVER BEEN POSSIBLE BEFORE TOWARD ENGAGING THE ISRAELIS ON THE REAL ISSUES, AND THAT WE ACCOMPLISHED MOST OF WHAT WE THOUGHT COULD BE ACHIEVED IN THIS SESSION. WHAT IS NEEDED NOW IS TIME FOR THE EFFECTS OF THIS VISIT TO BE DIGESTED IN ISRAEL, FOR BEGIN AND HIS COLLEAGUES TO RETHINK AMONG THEMSELVES THE DIFFICULT DECISIONS AHEAD AND FOR THEM TO WORK THESE DECISIONS THROUGH THE ISRAELI POLITICAL PROCESS. WE ARE SEEING NOW, AS A RESULT OF THE PRESIDENT'S MEETINGS WITH BEGIN, THE SIGNS IN ISRAEL OF A PROFOUND REAPPRAISAL. CLEAR PRESENTATION TO ISRAEL OF THE U.S.

POSITION ON THE KEY ISSUES DURING THE VISIT SHOULD MAKE IT OBVIOUS TO THE ISRAELIS THAT THE U.S. IS DETERMINED TO MOVE THE PEACE NEGOTIATIONS FORWARD. IT IS ESSENTIAL NOW, AS DEBATE INTENSIFIES IN ISRAEL, THAT ALL CONCERNED DO EVERY THING POSSIBLE TO HOLD OUT TO THOSE ISRAELIS LOOKING FOR SERIOUS COMPROMISE THE PROSPECT OF REALISTIC PROGRESS ON GROUNDS THAT PROMISE SECURITY FOR ISRAEL. IT IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT, IN THIS RESPECT, THAT ALL CONCERNED ON THE ARAB SIDE AVOID STATEMENTS OR ACTIONS THAT MIGHT BE UNHELPFUL.

WE DID NOT WANT THIS MEETING TO BE DIVERTED FROM THE CENTRAL ISSUE OF PEACE, AND THEREFORE SOUTHERN LEBANON WAS DISCUSSED ONLY BRIEFLY. THE ISRAELI GOVERNMENT HAD ALREADY AGREED TO COMPLY WITH UN RESOLUTIONS 425 AND 426 AND HAD DECLARED A UNILATERAL CEASEFIRE. PRIME MINISTER BEGIN AND FOREIGN MINISTER DAYAN ASSURED US THAT ISRAEL WILL WITHDRAW FROM LEBANON. WE BELIEVE THAT THE SUCCESSFUL ESTABLISHMENT OF A UN FORCE IN SOUTHERN LEBANON WILL ITSELF SUBSTANTIALLY IMPROVE THE CLIMATE FOR PEACE NEGOTIATIONS. IT IS OUR HOPE THAT THE PLO WILL COOPERATE WITH THE CEASEFIRE AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF LEBANESE GOVERNMENT AUTHORITY THROUGHOUT SOUTH LEBANON.
WE ARE URGING THE ISRAELIS TO TAKE APPROPRIATE STEPS TO ASSURE SIMILAR COOPERATION BY CHRISTIAN MILITIAS IN THE SOUTH.

IT WILL HAVE BEEN NOTED THAT THERE WAS NO PRESS STATEMENT AT THE END OF THE VISIT. WE WERE UNWILLING TO MAKE AN ANODYNE STATEMENT AND CHOSE TO MAKE THE PUBLIC AWARE OF OUR POSITIONS IN OTHER WAYS, NOTABLY THROUGH PRESIDENT'S REMARKS AT THE END OF THE SECOND DAY'S MEETING AND SECRETARY'S PRESS CONFERENCE. FYI: YOU SHOULD POINT OUT THAT MARCH 23 WASHINGTON POST CARRIES FOUR-COLUMN HEADLINE ABOUT "GRIM TALKS" AND "SHARP CONFLICT ON THE ISSUES" AND FEATURED PRESIDENT CARTER'S STATEMENT THAT PEACE STILL SEEMS FAR AWAY. ATHERTON DID BACKGROUNDER IMMEDIATELY AFTER CONCLUSION OF MEETINGS, SENT SEPTEL, WHICH CLEARLY STATED THE U.S. POSITION.

1978STATE089377.subject: CENTO: MESSAGE FROM SECRETARY TO FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY

segments.text: MINISTER KHALATBARY PLEASE DELIVER FOLLOWING MESSAGE TO FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY.

DEAR MR. MINISTER: I HAVE BEEN LOOKING FORWARD TO GREETING YOU IN WASHINGTON ON THE OCCASION OF THE CENTO MINISTERIAL COUNCIL MEETING. I HAVE SEEN THE MEETING AS GIVING US ANOTHER GOOD OCCASION TO DISCUSS BOTH THE CONTINUED IMPORTANCE OF CENTO TO THE SECURITY OF THE CENTO REGION, AND VARIOUS OTHER MATTERS OF INTEREST TO BOTH OUR GOVERNMENTS. I WRITE TO YOU AT THIS MOMENT AS A RESULT OF URGENT REQUIREMENTS WHICH HAVE ARISEN THAT WILL MAKE IT IMPOSSIBLE FOR ME TO BE IN WASHINGTON ON APRIL 19-20, THE DATES SET FOR THE CENTO MEETING.

I WISH TO LAY THE MATTER BEFORE YOU FOR YOUR UNDERSTANDING AND CONSIDERATION, AND SEEK YOUR ASSISTANCE IN RESOLVING THE PROBLEM IN THE BEST INTERESTS OF ALL CONCERNED. AS YOU KNOW, THE UNITED STATES GOVERNMENT HAS BEEN VERY HEAVILY ENGAGED IN RECENT MONTHS, IN THE CLOSEST COLLABORATION WITH THE GOVERNMENT OF THE UNITED KINGDOM, IN SEEKING AN EARLY, EQUITABLE SETTLEMENT REGARDING THE FUTURE OF RHODESIA. IN VERY RECENT DISCUSSIONS IT HAS BEEN AGREED TO CONVENE AN URGENT MEETING OF INTERESTED PARTIES IN AFRICA ON THIS MATTER, AND I WILL THEREFORE BE RETURNING TO AFRICA FOR DISCUSSIONS THAT WILL KEEP ME OCCUPIED THROUGH APRIL 17.

MEANWHILE, MY GOVERNMENT HAS BEEN DISCUSSING WITH THE GOVERNMENT OF THE USSR A NUMBER OF SUBJECTS OF CONSIDERABLE AND URGENT IMPORTANCE. IT HAS BEEN DECIDED THAT I SHOULD GO PERSONALLY TO MOSCOW AT AN EARLY DATE TO CARRY FORWARD THESE DISCUSSIONS. IN THIS CONNECTION, I SHALL HAVE TO ARRIVE IN MOSCOW BY THE EVENING OF APRIL 19. AS YOU CAN SEE FROM THE ABOVE, THE NEED FOR ME TO BE IN AFRICA THROUGH APRIL 17 AND TO BE IN MOSCOW BY LATE ON APRIL 19 WILL PRECLUDE MY BEING IN WASHINGTON ON APRIL 1920 FOR THE CENTO MEETING.

WE ARE, OF COURSE, PREPARED TO GO FORWARD WITH THE CENTO MEETING HERE ON THOSE DATES, AND IN THAT EVENT MY DEPUTY, WARREN CHRISTOPHER, WOULD CHAIR THE U.S. OBSERVER DELEGATION AS WELL AS THE MINISTERIAL CONFERENCE. ON THE OTHER HAND, I HAVE BEEN LOOKING FORWARD TO THE CHANCE TO PARTICIPATE PERSONALLY IN THE CENTO MEETING AND TO MEET WITH THE HEADS OF DELEGATION OF THE OTHER CENTO COUNTRIES.

HAVING THIS IN MIND, I HAVE DISCUSSED WITH THE FOREIGN SECRETARY OF THE UNITED KINGDOM THE POSSIBILITY THAT HIS GOVERNMENT MIGHT BE ABLE TO SERVE AS HOST IN LONDON FOR THE CENTO MINISTERIAL COUNCIL MEETING IN OUR PLACE, SHOULD THAT BE AGREEABLE TO THE REGIONAL MEMBERS. MR. OWEN HAS VERY GRACIOUSLY AGREED, AND I BELIEVE THAT HE WILL BE COMMUNICATING WITH YOU, THE OTHER REGIONAL MEMBERS AND THE SECRETARY GENERAL--TO WHOM I AM ALSO WRITING AT THIS TIME--ON THIS SUBJECT IN THE IMMEDIATE FUTURE.

IF YOU, THE OTHER REGIONAL MEMBERS AND THE SECRETARY GENERAL AGREE THAT OUR NEXT MINISTERIAL COUNCIL MEETING SHOULD BE HELD IN LONDON, I SHOULD LIKE TO INVITE YOU AS WELL AS THE OTHER HEADS OF DELEGATION AND THE SECRETARY GENERAL TO BE MY GUESTS AT DINNER ON APRIL 18 SO THAT WE MAY HAVE AN INFORMAL OCCASION TO DISCUSS MATTERS OF INTEREST TO US ALL. I WOULD BE MOST GRATEFUL IF YOU WOULD LET ME HAVE YOUR VIEWS. IN ANY EVENT, I LOOK FORWARD TO AN EARLY MEETING WITH YOU SO THAT WE CAN DISCUSS THE IMPORTANT MATTERS IN WHICH BOTH OF OUR GOVERNMENTS HAVE A VERY STRONG STAKE.
SINCERELY, CYRUS VANCE END .
REPORT PROMPTLY ANY REACTION TO ABOVE LETTER.
WE SHALL HAVE TO COORDINATE CLOSELY WITH HMG AND YOU SHOULD THEREFORE KEEP YOUR BRITISH COLLEAGUE CURRENTLY INFORMED REGARDING YOUR APPROACH. VANCE

YOU CAN INFORM ZELLI THAT THE LACK OF US REPRESENTATION IN LUANDA SEVERELY RESTRICTS OUR ACCESS TO RELIABLE FIRST-HAND INFORMATION ON SITUATION IN ANGOLA, BUT THAT WE WOULD BE GLAD TO SHARE WITH HIM OUR IMPRESSIONS OF UNITA'S CAPABILITIES AND POTENTIALS.

UNITA APPEARS TO HAVE ABILITY TO DENY TO NETO GOVERNMENT CONTROL OF LARGE RURAL AREAS OF SOUTHERN ANGOLA. IN ADDITION,UNITA CLAIMS TO CONTROL TWO OR THREE OF THE LARGER TOWNS IN THE AREA. MUCH OF THE TERRITORY IN THIS ZONE SEEMS TO BE CONTESTED WITH NEITHER SIDE ABLE TO CLAIM PERMANENT CONTROL.

THE AREA WHERE UNITA IS VERY ACTIVE HAS TRADITIONALLY BEEN THE BREADBASKET OF ANGOLA AND WE UNDERSTAND THAT IN AREAS UNDER CONTROL OF THE LUANDA GOVERNMENT BASIC FOOD ITEMS HAVE HAD TO BE IMPORTED CAUSING A DRAIN ON THE COUNTRY'S ALREADY LIMITED FOREIGN EXCHANGE.FURTHER, IT IS OUR IMPRESSION THAT THE MOST RECENT FAPLA/CUBAN OFFENSIVE IN THAT AREA HAS STALLED. UNITA'S ABILITY TO INFLICT LOSES ON THE GOVERNMENT SIDE AND TO DENY ENDURING CONTROL OF VAST AREAS (PERHAPS UP TO HALF OF ANGOLA) TO THE NETO GOVERNMENT LEAVES LITTLE DOUBT THAT IT HAS A SUBSTANTIAL BASE OF POPULAR SUPPORT.

UNITA'S GUERRILLA CAPACITY TO CHALLENGE AND DAMAGE MPLA/CUBAN FORCES APPEARS TO HAVE GROWN IN RECENT MONTHS BUT, GIVEN LOGISTIC, TRIBAL AND OTHER CONSIDERATIONS, IT IS GENERALLY AGREED THAT NEITHER SIDE WILL BE ABLE TO ASSUME FULL CONTROL OF THE COUNTRY IN THE FORESEEABLE FUTURE.
FYI: WE REALIZE THAT THE FOREGOING IS SKIMPY BUT MOST OF OUR INFORMATION IS DERIVED FROM SENSITIVE INTELLIGENCE SOURCES WHICH IN TURN LIMITS WHAT WE CAN SHARE WITH FOREIGN GOVERNMENTS. END FYI. VANCE

WE ARE IN A CATCH 22 SITUATION WITH REGARD TO ISRAELI WITHDRAWAL FROM SOUTH LEBANON AND UNIFIL DEPLOYMENT. A CREDIBLE, PUBLIC ISRAELI STATEMENT ASSURING FINAL WITHDRAWAL BY AN APRIL DATE IS ESSENTIAL, BOTH TO FORESTALL A SECURITY COUNCIL DEBATE WHICH MIGHT MAKE THINGS WORSE BUT, EVEN MORE IMPORTANT, TO PREVENT POTENTIAL UNRAVELING OF UNIFIL ITSELF. SPECIAL UNGA ON APRIL 20-21 ON FINANCING UNIFIL ALSO THREATENS TO TURN INTO VERY DIFFICULT SESSION IF ISRAELI TIMETABLE FOR WITHDRAWAL IS NOT CLEAR BY THEN; KEY THIRD WORLD NATIONS LIKE INDIA ARE ALREADY SAYING THEY MAY NOT CONTRIBUTE.

ISRAEL WANTS TO MAKE THE FINAL WITHDRAWAL SCHEDULES CONDITIONAL ON ASSURANCES OF AN ADEQUATE UNIFIL DEPLOYMENT, SO THAT NO SIGNIFICANT MILITARY VACUUM IS LEFT BEHIND. ON THE OTHER HAND, PRESENT AND FUTURE TROOP CONTRIBUTORS ARE BECOMING INCREASINGLY RELUCTANT TO PLAY THEIR ROLE BECAUSE THEY DISTRUST ISRAELI INTENTIONS. THUS, THE SITUATION APPEARS: NO ISRAELI WITHDRAWAL STATEMENT; NO NEW TROOP CONTRIBUTIONS. ROUGHLY 2600 TROOPS WILL BE THERE, WITH THE NEPALESE DEPLOYMENT THIS WEEK HENSIVE WITHDRAWAL STATEMENT,WHILE GOING ALL-OUT IN SUPPORT OF THE UN FOR ADDITIONAL TROOP CONTRIBUTORS.

YOU SHOULD THEREFORE GET IN TOUCH AS QUICKLY AS POSSIBLE WITH FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY OR THE SHAH TO EXPLAIN CANDIDLY THE PRESENT DIFFICULT SITUATION IN LEBANON. YOU SHOULD EXPLAIN THAT THE NEED IS FOR ASSURANCES THAT UNIFIL CAN BE FLESHED OUT TO ABOUT 3500 MEN BY A DATE IN APRIL, STILL SHORT OF THE 4000-MAN PROJECTED TOTAL, BUT PROBABLY ADEQUATE TO ASSURE ISRAELI WITHDRAWAL.

SAY THAT WE UNDERSTAND THE UNITED NATIONS HAS ASKED THE IRANIANS TO PROVIDE A NEW BATTALION (OF ABOUT 800 MEN). WE STRONGLY SUPPORT THIS REQUEST. IF THE IRANIANS COULD ASSURE THE UN THAT THEY WOULD SEND A FORCE OF THIS SIZE (OR IDEALLY OFFER AN EVEN MORE SIZEABLE GROUP), WE BELIEVE WE WOULD HAVE A CHANCE OF BREAKING THE PRESENT LOGJAM.

THE IRANIAN TROOPS PRESENTLY IN UNIFIL HAVE PERFORMED EXTREMELY WELL, AS SIILASVUO HAS CONFIDED TO US. IRAN HAS HAD EXPERIENCE IN MOVING TROOPS QUICKLY, AS IN THE DHOFAR REBELLION. ALSO, IRANIAN TROOPS ARE PROBABLY BETTER EQUIPPED AND PREPARED FOR SUCH A MOVE THAN WOULD BE THE CASE FOR CERTAIN OTHER CONTRIBUTORS, WHO MAY EVENTUALLY ARRIVE IN SOUTH LEBANON NEEDING MUCH ADDED EQUIPMENT TO SUPPLEMENT THEIR BASIC SUPPLIES.

IF IRAN WANTED TO MAKE ITS ADDED COMMITMENT CONDITIONAL ON ADVANCE ASSURANCES FROM THE ISRAELIS THAT THEY WOULD DECLARE A FINAL WITHDRAWAL DATE IN APRIL, AFTER AN APRIL ARRIVAL OF THE IRANIAN TROOPS, WE THINK IT WOULD BE POSSIBLE TO OBTAIN SUCH ISRAELI ASSURANCES. WE WOULD CERTAINLY PRESS THE ISRAELIS FIRMLY AND PERSISTENTLY FOR SUCH ASSURANCES. IN FACT, WE WILL CONTINUE TO PRESS THE ISRAELIS FOR A SPECIFIC WITHDRAWAL SCHEDULE, WITH OR WITHOUT AN ADDED IRANIAN TROOP OFFER.

SAY THAT IRAN, IN OFFERING THIS IMPORTANT CONTRIBUTION, WOULD EARN WARM INTERNATIONAL APPLAUSE. THE STEP WOULD ENCOURAGE OTHER TROOP CONTRIBUTORS AND ADD TO UN DETERMINATION TO ASSURE THE SUCCESS OF THE UNIFIL OPERATION.

IN THE ABSENCE OF PROGRESS IN FLESHING OUT UNIFIL AND IN THE ABSENCE OF A CREDIBLE ISRAELI STATEMENT, WHAT PASSES FOR STABILITY IN LEBANON WOULD BE FURTHER THREATENED, AND THE GENERAL MIDDLE EAST SCENE WOULD WITNESS SIGNIFICANT RISES IN TENSIONS.
YOU ARE AUTHORIZED TO DRAW FULLY ON ALL TRAFFIC RELATING TO THE SOUTH LEBANON SITUATION, EXCEPT FOR THE FRENCH COMMENTS THAT THEY MAY HAVE TO CONSIDER WITHDRAW

FOR AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN: WE MUCH APPRECIATE YOUR PROMPT AND SUCCESSFUL DEMARCHE. PLEASE GET THE WORD TO KHALATBARY AND THE SHAH THAT WE ARE EXTREMELY GRATEFUL FOR THIS PROMPT AND POSITIVE RESPONSE ON THEIR PART. WE ARE HOPEFUL THAT THIS GENEROUS IRANIAN GESTURE WILL BREAK THE LOG-JAM.

WHAT WE WILL NEED NOW -- AND WE PRESUME YOU WILL BE RECEIVING THIS IN YOUR APRIL 15 MEETINGS WITH KHALATBARY AND CHIEF OF STAFF AZHARI -- IS AN ASSESSMENT OF HOW QUICKLY AN IRANIAN UNIT COULD BE BROUGHT TO SOUTH LEBANON. CLEARLY, AN IRANIAN UNIT IN PLACE AT THE EARLIEST POSSIBLE MOMENT IN APRIL WOULD PROVIDE VISIBLE AND CONVINCING EVIDENCE THAT UNIFIL WILL BE AT CLOSE TO FULL STRENGTH IN TIME FOR AN ISRAELI WITHDRAWAL BY THE END OF THE MONTH.

FOR USUN:AMBASSADOR LEONARD: YOU SHOULD CONSULT WITH UR'QHART ON THESE LATEST DEVELOPMENTS FROM TEHRAN, EXPLAINING THAT WE PRESSED IRAN TO MAKE A COMMITMENT, JUST AS WE HAD WITH NIGERIA, IN ORDER TO ASSIST THE UN. AS REGARDS THE IRANIAN CONDITION THAT THERE BE AN ISRAELI PUBLIC STATEMENT ASSURING WITHDRAWAL BEFORE THE END OF APRIL, YOU SHOULD POINT OUT THAT WE ALSO SUPPORT THAT TARGET CONCEPT AND HAVE BEEN MAKING THIS CLEAR TO THE ISRAELIS BOTH IN WASHINGTON AND IN ISRAEL. OUR OWN VIEW IS THAT THE UN SHOULD INFORM ISRAEL THAT IRAN IS PREPARED TO MAKE A MAJOR NEW CONTRIBUTION AND THAT THE UN AND U.S.

ARE NOW ATTEMPTING TO DETERMINE HOW QUICKLY AN IRANIAN UNIT COULD BE PUT ON THE GROUND IN SOUTH LEBANON. IT OBVIOUSLY WOULD BE EASIER FOR THE ISRAELIS TO MAKE A COMPREHENSIVE WITHDRAWAL STATEMENT IF THEY WERE ASSURED IN ADVANCE THAT UNIFIL-THROUGH THE INTRODUCTION OF THE IRANIAN CONTINGENT -- WOULD BE UP TO CONSIDERABLE STRENGTH ON AN APRIL DATE. AS SOON AS THE UN OR U.S. HAVE IRANIAN ASSURANCES THAT AN APRIL DEPLOYMENT IS POSSIBLE, THE UN MIGHT RETURN TO THE ISRAELIS AND EXPLAIN THAT AN ADVANCE ISRAELI COMMITMENT TO WITHDRAWAL IN APRIL WILL BE NECESSARY BEFORE THE IRANIANS CAN COMMIT THEIR TROOPS; THE U.S.
WOULD THEN BACK UP THE UN REPRESENTATIONS.

JERUSALEM 1080 JUST RECEIVED IS ENCOURAGING, IN THAT SIILASVUO IS PREPARED TO ASK FOR APRIL 30 WITHDRAWAL IF SENEGALESE CAN BE DEPLOYED EARLY. AN IRANIAN COMMITMENT TO APRIL ARRIVAL WOULD GIVE SIILASVUO ADDED AMMO. ASK URUQHART WHAT THE U.S. MIGHT BEST DO NOW VIS-A-VIS SENEGALESE.

FOR AMBASSADOR LEWIS: PENDING USUN'S CONSULTATIONS WITH URUQHART, WE INTEND TO MENTION TO THE ISRAELIS HERE THAT THE IRANIANS ARE PREPARED IN PRINCIPLE TO MAKE A MAJOR CONTRIBUTION TO UNIFIL AND THAT WE HOPE THEY COULD DO SO BEFORE THE MONTH ENDS. WE WILL BE CONSULTING FURTHER WITH THE ISRAELIS AND THE UN AS MORE INFORMATION IS DEVELOPED IN TEHRAN. WE INTEND TO ADD, HOWEVER, THAT IRAN WILL BE CHAIRMAN OF THE SPECIAL UNGA SESSION ON UNIFIL FINANCING NEXT WEEK. THIS MAKES IT ALL THE MORE IMPORTANT THAT ISRAEL TAKE NOTE THAT IRAN HAS HOPED TO SEE AN ISRAELI STATEMENT ON FINAL WITHDRAWAL.
YOU ARE AUTHORIZED TO MAKE THE SAME POINTS;TO CONDITION GOI TO IRANIAN "CONDITION."
AGAIN FOR AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN: TO SAVE TIME YOU ARE AUTHORIZED TO SEND "EXDIS DISTRIBUTE AS NODIS" MESSAGES LATERALLY TO OTHER POSTS. THE MESSAGES ARE, HOWEVER, HANDLED AS NODIS.

WITH RESPECT TO PARA 6 OF TEHRAN 3513, BASED ON PAST EXPERIENCE WE DO NOT EXPECT THAT USSR WILL CONTRIBUTE FINANCIALLY TO UNIFIL, BUT WE ATTACH GREAT IMPORTANCE TO UNIFIL BEING FINANCED BY REGULAR BUDGET ASSESSMENTS UNDER ARTICLE 17 OF UN CHARTER RELATING TO THE REGULAR BUDGET.

1978STATE111116.subject: EFFECT OF AFGHAN COUP ON NON-ALIGNED MEETING

segments.text: STATE 109324
DCM SHARED APPROPRIATE PORTIONS OF REF A WITH SENIOR GSL FONOFF OFFICIAL. HE EXPRESSED GRATITUDE AND ASKED THAT FOLLOWING REMAIN CLOSELY HELD.

ON 28 APRIL, HE HAD MADE SAME REQUEST (REF C) FOR INFORMATION ABOUT SITUATION IN KABUL TO SOVIET EMBASSY HERE. WITHIN A FEW HOURS SOVIET AMBASSADOR RAFIK NISHANOV HIMSELF CAME TO FOREIGN MINISTRY, DESCRIBED AFGHAN COUP IN PAST TENSE AS SUCCESSFUL, SITUATION RAPIDLY RETURNING TO NORMAL, ETC. NISHANOV ORDINARLY VERY SLOW TO RESPOND TO MFA REQUESTS FOR INFORMATION AND RARELY COMES TO MINISTRY FOR SUCH PURPOSE.

A FEW HOURS LATER, GSL HIGH COMMISSIONER IN NEW DELHI REPORTED TO COLOMBO THAT HE HAD BEEN BRIEFED BY GOI FOREIGN SECRETARY JAGAT MEHTA ON SITUATION IN KABUL. MEHTA'S ACCOUNT COVERED SAME SUBJECTS AS NISHANOV'S IN SAME ORDER, WITH A NUMBER OF SIMILAR PHRASES, CONCLUDING THAT GOI NOT PREPARED TO HOST NON-ALIGNED COORDINATING BUREAU MEETING IF KABUL MAY 6-10 GATHERING CANCELLED.
GSL SENIOR OFFICIAL VOLUNTEERED THAT BASED ON HIS PERVIOUS SERVICE IN MOSCOW, HIS PERSONAL SUSPICIONS OF SOVIETS, AND FOREGOING HE HAD CONCLUDED
IF SOVIETS NOT INVLVED IN AFGHAN COUP, THEY AT LEAST MUST HAVE HAD FOREKNOWLEDGE; THEIR SYSTEM DID NOT ENABLE THEM TO REACT SO "GRACEFULLY" TO SURPRISES IN THIS AREA
THE NISHANOV/MEHTA BRIEFINGS HAD TOO MUCH SIMILARITY TO BE ACCIDENTAL. "OUR INDIAN COURSINS ARE STILL WILLING TO BE HELPFUL TO THEIR SOVIET FRIENDS."

GSL OFFICIAL SAID WITH KABUL INACCESSIBLE, DELHI UNWILLING AND COLOMBO "INAPPROPRIATE", HE EXPECTED NON-ALGINED COORDINATING BUREAU TO MEET IN NEW YORK JUST PRIOR TO SPECIAL SESSION ON DISARMAMENT. WRIGGINS

1978STATE111645.subject: RECOGNITION OF NEW REGIME IN AFGHANISTAN

segments.text: (D) TEHRAN 4114; (E) TEHRAN 4143; (F) ISLAMABAD 4270; (G) KABUL 3446; (H) ISLAMABAD 4318
WE AGREE WITH AMBASSADORS SULLIVAN AND HUMMEL ON DESIRABILITY OF FULL CONSULTATION WITH IRANIANS AND PAKISTANIS ON RECOGNITION ISSUE. HOWEVER, WE DO NOT WANT TO DELAY UNDULY OUR ACTION.

FOR TEHRAN: YOU SHOULD CONSULT FURTHER WITH THE IRANIANS, INDICATING THAT WE ARE RELUCTANT TO DELAY DELIVERY OF OUR NOTE BEYOND MAY 4, OR AT THE LATEST, MAY 5. GIVEN OUR GENERAL POLICY ON RECOGNITION WE SEE NO ADVANTAGE IN OUR DELAYING FURTHER ESPECIALLY IF MOST OTHER COUNTRIES ACCREDITED TO KABUL MOVE PROMPTLY, AS WE ANTICIPATE. WE WOULD, OF COURSE, WELCOME GOI VIEWS. FOR ISLAMABAD: YOU SHOULD SHARE WITH THE PAKISTANIS THE CONTENTS OF THE PROPOSED NOTE (REF B) AND INDICATE THAT WE ARE PROPOSING TO DELIVER IT ON MAY 4 OR AT THE LATEST, MAY 5.

YOU MAY STATE THAT WE ARE CONSULTING WITH THE IRANIANS, AS WELL AS OECD AMBASSADORS ACCREDITED TO KABUL. FOR KABUL: AT MAY 3 MEETING WITH OECD COLLEAGUES, YOU MAY SHARE WITH THEM THE CONTENTS OF YOUR PROPOSED NOTE WHICH HAS BEEN APPROVED BY THE DEPARTMENT. YOU SHOULD INFORM THEM THAT WE ARE CONSULTING THE IRANIANS AND PAKISTANIS, WHO AFTER ALL HAVE THE MOST AT STAKE IN THE NEW SITUATION. WE WOULD APPRECIATE IT IF THE OECD COUNTRIES COULD FIND IT POSSIBLE HOLD UP PRESENTATION OF THEIR NOTES UNTIL MAY 4 OR 5 AT THE LATEST, SO THAT IRAN AND PAKISTAN WILL HAVE SUFFICIENT TIME TO MAKE THEIR VIEWS KNOWN. VANCE

1978STATE119521.subject: SOVIET AND CUBAN PRESENCE IN HORN: AN IRAQI VIEW

segments.text: SUMMARY: FOREIGN MINISTRY OFFICIAL SOUNDS ALARM OVER SOVIET AND CUBAN PRESENCE IN HORN. END SUMMARY

FOREIGN MINISTRY COUNSELOR HADDAWI DREW USINT POLITICAL OFFICER INTO CORNER AT SOCIAL OCCASION FOR A SURPRISINGLY FRANK AIRING OF IRAQI WORRY OVER HORN OF AFRICA. HADDAWI INTRODUCED THE SUBJECT BY ASKING ABOUT USG POLICY TOWARD INDIAN OCEAN. POLOFF BRIEFED HIM ON STATUS OF US-SOVIET NEGOTIATIONS, CONCLUDING WITH CAVEAT THAT CURRENT SOVIET ACTIVITIES IN THE HORN AND ASSOCIATED INCREASE OF THEIR NAVAL FORCES ARE INCONSISTENT WITH THESE TALKS (REF B).

HADDAWI RESPONDED BY EXPRESSING SURPRISE THAT USG WAS ALLOWING SOVIETS AND CUBANS TO INCREASE PRESENCE IN AFRICA, ESPECIALLY IN STRATEGIC AREASOF HORN. HE SUGGESTED USG NO LONGER CARED MUCH ABOUT AFRICA.

AFTER LETTING HADDAWI TAKE CONVERSATIONAL LEAD, POLOFF NOTED USG HAD MADE IT CLEAR THAT SOVIET UNION'S LARGER INTERESTS IN DETENTE COULD NOT BE UNAFFECTED BY LACK OF SOVIET RESTRAINT IN OTHER AREAS. IT WAS NECESSARY, HOWEVER, FOR AFRICAN AND ARAB STATES TO TUE A STAND AGAINST THE ENCROACHMENTS OF SOVIETS AND THEIR CUBAN CLIENTS. IRAQ HAD GOOD RELATIONS WITH SOVIETS AND CUBANS, AND IT WAS NATURAL TO ASK WHY IRAQ DID NOT USE ITS INFLUENCE TO OBTAIN THEIR WITHDRAWAL. WHEREAS SOVIET PRESENCE IN HORN AFFECTED USG INTERESTS INDIRECTLY, IT AFFECTED IRAIS DIRECTLY. IRAQI PRESS, HOWEVER, NEVER EVEN MENTIONED PRESENCE OF SOVIETS AND CUBANS IN ETHIOPIA.

HADDAWI SAID IRAQ HAD TO BE VERY CAREFUL HOW IT HANDLED RELATIONS WITH SOVIETS. PEOPLE IN FOREIGN MINISTRY WERE, HE SAID, VERY CONCERNED ABOUT SOVIETS AND CUBANS IN HORN. WHILE IRAQ HAS BEEN PUBLICLY SILENT, IT HAS MADE ITS VIEWS FELT. OGADEN SITUATION HAD BEEN AMBIGUOUS AND SOMALI ACTIONS UNWISE, BUZ IRAQ KNOWS SOVIETS SEEK PERMANENT PRESENCE ON RED SEA. AT THIS POINT, CONVERSATION BROKE OFF AS OTHER DIPLOMATS JOINED US.

COMMENT: HADDAWI WAS SPEAKING IN HIGHLY INFORMAL MANNER. IF WE HAD RAISED ISSUE OF HORN AS PART OF OUR FORMAL SOUNDINGS ON NONALIGNED ISSUES (REF C), HE WOULD LIKELY HAVE REACTED WITH THE KIND OF GUARDED SUSPICION WHICH HE SHOWED ON THAT OCCASION. NONETHELESS, HADDAWI PROBABLY REFLECTED GENUINE IRAQI CONCERNS ABOUT SOVIET MOTIVES IN THE HORN. WE CONTINUE TO BEWUEVE THAT IRAQ WILL RESIST DISCUSSION OF THIS ISSUE AT FORTHCOMING NONALIGNED CONFEJENCE, WHERE HADDAWI WILL BE NUMBER TWO ON DELEGATION. TACTICAL ALLIANCE WITH CUBA PLAYS TOO GREAT A ROLE IN IRAQI APPROACH TO NAM.

NONETHELESS, IRAQ IS LIKELY TO MOVE IN DIRECTION OF GREATER CRITICISM OF SOVIET AND CUBAN PRESENCE IN HORN. INITIATIVE OF NORMALLY SUPER CAUTIOUS IRAQI DIPLOMAT TO SPEAK SO OPENLY TO AN AMERICAN IS ONE MEASURE OF IRAQI UNHAPPINESS. ERITREA DOES NOT HAVE STATUS OF SACRED CAUSE ACCORDED TO PALESTINE, BUT CUBAN INVOLVEMENT HAS PLAINLY GOT IRAQIS UPSET. PECK

PLEASE DELIVER FOLLOWING MESSAGE TO EMPRESS FROM THE PRESIDENT: YOUR IMPERIAL MAJESTY: THANK YOU FOR YOUR LETTER SUPPORTING THE NOMINATION OF BUCKMINISTER FULLER FOR THE PRESIDENTIAL MEDAL OF FREEDOM. 1978STATE119920.subject: GENERAL ZIA UL-HAQ'S LETTER TO PRESIDENT CARTER ON AFGHAN DEVELOPMENTS

segments.text: I WAS SUMMONED BY THE FOREIGN SECRETARY LAST EVENING TO RECEIVE AND BE ASKED TO TRANSMIT A LETTER FROM CHIEF MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR GENERAL ZIA UL-HAQ TO PRESIDENT CARTER ON THE SITUATION IN AFGHANISTAN, RESPONDING TO SUGGESTION IN REFTEL (A).

SIGNED ORIGINAL OF LETTER BEING TRANSMITTED TO DEPARTMENT (NEA/PAB) IN SEALED ENVELOPE VIA POUCH (REGISTRY NUMBER 3750554) TODAY; FONSEC PROVIDED AMBASSADOR WITH COPY, TEXT OF WHICH FOLLOWS: HIS EXCELLENCY MR. JIMMY CARTER, PRESIDENT OF THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA, WASHINGTON, D.C. DEAR MR. PRESIDENT, YOUR INTEREST IN THE POSSIBLE IMPLICATIONS OF THE RECENT COUP IN AFGHANISTAN AND IN MY PERSONAL ASSESSMENT OF THIS EVENT, HAS BEEN CONVEYED TO ME BY AMBASSADOR HUMMEL. THE CORRECT ASSESSMENT OF THE CHANGE OF REGIME IN KABUL AND OF ITS WIDER RAMIFICATIONS IS, INDEED, ESSENTIAL TO ENABLE US TO DETERMINE OUR RESPONSE TO IT.

YOUR PERSONAL AWARENESS OF THE IMPORTANCE OF THE NEW SITUATION THAT HAS ARISEN, AND YOUR KEENNESS TO HAVE THE RIGHT ANSWERS ARE MOST WELCOME. AS SOON AS THE EVENTS BEGAN TO UNFOLD IN KABUL, WE TOOK THE INITIATIVE TO CONSULT AMBASSADOR HUMMEL AND HAVE REMAINED IN CLOSE TOUCH WITH HIM EVER SINCE. WE HAVE IN THE COURSE OF THESE CONSULTATIONS ALSO BRIEFED HIM IN DETAIL ABOUT THESE DEVELOPMENTS AND OUR PERCEPTION OF THEIR WIDER REPERCUSSIONSIN OUR OWN REGION AND BEYOND. AMBASSADOR HUMMEL, NO DOUBT, HAS COMMUNICATED TO YOU OUR VIEWS WHICH I HOPE HAVE BEEN OF SOME INTEREST.

NEITHER ARE THE FACTS OF THE LATEST TURN OF EVENTS IN AFGHANISTAN OBSCURE NOR IS THEIR INTERPRETATION A DIFFICULT EXERCISE. THE LEFTIST COUP IN KABUL HAS REPLACED A 200-YEAR OLD MONARCHIC TRADITION IN AFGHANISTAN WITH A COMMUNIST-ORIENTED, IF NOT COMMUNIST, GOVERNMENT WHICH WAS IMMEDIATELY RECOGNIZED BY THE SOVIET UNION AND HAS ITS FULL BACKING. INDIA JOINED BULGARIA, THE MOST SUBSERVIENT SOVIET SATELLITE OF EASTERN EUROPE, TO FOLLOW THE SOVIET LEAD WITHOUT ANY HESITATION OR DELAY WHATSOEVER. THE COLLAPSE OF DAOUD'S REGIME, WITH WHICH WE WERE MAKING GOOD PROGRESS TOWARDS A SETTLEMENT OF OUR DIFFERENCES, MAY HAVE BEEN WELCOMED IN NEW DELHI.

INDIA IS ALLIED TO THE SOVIET UNION UNDER THE TREATY OF FRIENDSHIP AND COOPERATION OF 1971 AND ACTS IN TANDEM WITH IT, AT CRITICAL MOMENTS, DESPITE THE ILLUSION OF A SHIFT IN ITS POLICIES. THE FACTS OF HOW THE COUP WAS ENGINEERED ARE NOT IN DISPUTE. SOVIET-TRAINED PILOTS IN SOVIET-SUPPLIED MIG'S AND SOVIET-TRAINED OFFICERS IN SOVIET-SUPPLIED TANKS JOINED TOGETHER TO WIPE OUT PRESIDENT DAOUD AND HIS FAMILY IN A SWIFT AND BLOODY OPERATION, CLOSELY FOLLOWING THE PATTERN OF EVENTS IN ADDIS ABABA NOT LONG AGO. THE AFGHAN POLICE FORCE, WHICH WAS EXCLUSIVELY WEST GERMAN TRAINED, WAS ALSO ELIMINATED.

THE KHALQ PARTY WHICH HAS FORMED THE NEW GOVERNMENT IS COMPOSED OF LEFTISTS KNOWN TO HAVE BEEN CLOSELY ASSOCIATED WITH THE SOVIET UNION AND THE CENTRAL COMMITTEE OF THE SOVIET COMMUNIST PARTY OVER A PERIOD OF MANY YEARS. PRESIDENT TARAKI ALSO SERVED FOR A WHILE IN THE AFGHAN EMBASSY IN WASHINGTON WHERE HIS DENUNCIATION OF THE AFGHAN RULING FAMILY RESULTED IN HIS REMOVAL FROM OFFICE. HE IS NOW NOT ONLY PRESIDENT OF AFGHANISTAN BUT ALSO THE HEAD OF THE KHALQ PARTY WITH WHICH AN EXTREMIST FACTION CALLED PARCHAM MERGED IN OCTOBER 1977.

THE LEADER AND FOUNDER OF THE EXTREMIST PARCHAM FACTION IS NOW THE VICE PRSSIDENT AND DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER IN PRESIDENT TARAKI'S GOVERNMENT. THE OVERWHELMING MAJORITY OF THE REMAINING MEMBERS OF THE GOVERNMENT ARE ALL OF THE SAME HUE. PARAGRAPH 8 OF THE RULING KHALQ PARTY'S MANIFESTO ISSUED IN OCTOBER 1977, SPECIFICALLY MENTIONS THE DURAND LINE, THE RECOGNISED INTERNATIONAL FRONTIER BETWEEN PAKISTAN AND AFGHANISTAN, AS A "COLONIAL IMPOSITION" AND PLEDGES SUPPORT TO THE SO-CALLED "NATIONAL MOVEMENT OF THE PEOPLE OF PAKHTOONISTAN" IN OUR TERRITORY.

IN HIS VERY FIRST PRESS CONFERENCE ONMAY 6, 1978, THE NEW AFGHAN PRESIDENT RAISED THE MATTER OF THE DURAND LINE SAYING, OF COURSE, THAT HE WANTED A PEACEFUL SETTLEMENT OF THIS BORDER ISSUE WITH PAKISTAN. THE ENTIRE FLAVOUR AND RHETORIC OF THE NEW REGIME IN KABUL CONFORM TOCLASSIC COMMUNIST NORMS. THE COUNTRY ITSELF HAS BEEN RE-NAMED THE "DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF AFGHANISTAN" ON FAMILIAR LINES. THE REGIME'SLIP SERVICE TO ISLAMIC VALUES AND NON-ALIGNMENT IS TRANSPARENT ENOUGH. THE NEED FOR SUCH CAMOUFLAGE TO GAIN TIME FOR THE REGIME TO CONSOLIDATE ITS POSITION IS EVIDENT.

IF WE GO ALONG WITH THESE PROFESSIONS IN AN EFFORT TO ENSURE THE CONTINUITY OF THE DIALOGUE WE HAD INITIATED WITH PRESIDENT DAOUD, THIS DOES NOT MEAN THAT WE ARE UNDER ANY ILLUSION OR HAVE BEEN LULLED INTO A FALSE SENSE OF SECURITY BY THE REGIME'S PROTESTATIONS. WE KNOW THAT THE AFGHAN BARRIER HAS BEEN BREACHED AND OUR COUNTRY LIES DIRECTLY IN THE PATH OF THE FLOOD WHICH ROLLED OUT OF CZARIST RUSSIA IN THE LAST CENTURY AND IS NOW FLOWING IN FULL FORCE TOWARDS THE INDIAN OCEAN AND THE PERSIAN GULF.

IT IS THE NATURE OF THE RESPONSE TO THIS SITUATION WHICH IS THE SUBJECT OF CONTROVERSY AMONG OUR FRIENDS AND ALLIES. THIS IS UNFORTUNATE BECAUSE TIME IS RUNNING OUT. NOTHING WILL STOP THE SOVIET UNION FROM PURSUING ITS EXPANISIONIST POLICIES IF EVENTS ENCOURAGE IT TO BELIEVE THAT SMALL COUNTRIES ARE EXPENDABLE IN THE OVERALL CONTEXT OF AMERICA'S GLOBAL STRATEGY. IN OUR ESTIMATION THE ADVENT OF THE LEFTIST REGIME IN KABUL IS AN EVENT OF HISTORIC PROPORTIONS. THE CHANGE IS OF A FUNDAMENTAL NATURE WHICH WILL HAVE A PROFOUND IMPACT ON THE BALACE OF POWER IN OUR REGION AND BEYOND. ITS CONSEQUENCES FOR PAKISTAN ARE INCALCULABLE.

THESE AND RELATED MATTERS ARE RECEIVING OUR URGENT ATTENTION. I AM CONVINCED THAT THESE ARE OF DEEP CONCERN TO YOU ALSO AND HOPE THAT YOU WILL BE ABLE TO SPARE SOME TIME TO GIVE ATTENTION TO THE MEASURES NEEDED TO MEET AN ENTIRELY NEW SITUATION WHICH HAS MATERIALISED EARLIER THAN WE HAD EXPECTED. WE ARE ALSO IN THE PROCESS OF COMPARING NOTES WITH OUR OTHER FRIENDS. MY ADVISOR ON FOREIGN AFFAIRS IS AT PRESENT IN IRAN AND WILL BE MEETING THE SHAHANSHAH. FOR IRAN THE SITUATION COULD BE AS GRAVE AS IT IS FOR US.

IT MAY NOT BE EMPTY RHETORIC TO SAY THAT UNLESS TIMELY ACTION IS TAKEN TO BLOCK THE SOVIET AVALANCE, THE OIL RESOURCES OF THE PERSIAN GULF AND THE ARABIAN PENINSULA MAY BE LOST TO THE WEST WITH CONSEQUENCES THAT NEED NO ELABORATION. I AM UNABLE, MR. PRESIDENT, TO SAY IN GREATER DETAIL WHAT I HAVE TO SAY IN A SHORT LETTER. IT IS NOT POSSIBLE TO CONVEY TO YOU IN THIS COMMUNICATION THE EXACT NATURE OF THE FORCES THAT MAY HAVE BEEN RELEASED BY THE TRANSFORMATION OF THE AFGHAN SCENE.

A FULLER ELABORATION OF THIS THEME, WHICH IS OF VITAL CONCERN TO US AND I HOPE ALSO TO YOU, CAN BETTER BE UNDERTAKEN THROUGH A PERSONAL EXCHANGE OF VIEWS AT A MUTUALLY CONVENIENT TIME. WITH PROFOUND REGARDS, YOURS SINCERELY, GENERAL (M. ZIA-UL-HAQ)
SUGGEST DEPARTMENT CONSIDER REPEATING THIS TEXT TO KABUL, DELHI, ANKARA, LONDON, MOSCOW, AND TEHRAN FOR INFO. HUMMEL

1978STATE119925.subject: DISCUSSION OF AFGHAN SITUATION WITH FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARI

segments.text: REF (B) WHICH WAS PREPARED FOR AMBASSADOR SPIERS FOR USE AT CENTO MEETING PROVIDES OUR CURRENT PRELIMINARY ASSESSMENT OF SITUATION IN AFGHANISTAN AND OUR PRELIMINARY ESTIMATE OF CURRENT SOVIET INTENTIONS. SUGGEST YOU SHARE THESE ASSESSMENTS ORALLY WITH KHALATBARI WHILE STRESSING THAT THEY REPRESENT ONLY OUR PRELIMINARY CONCLUSIONS AND ASSURE HIM THAT WE WISH TO CONTINUE CLOSE CONSULTATIONS AS THE SITUATION EVOLVES.

WITH REGARD TO POINT (C) - ACTIONS TO PREVENT FURTHER SOVIET EXPLOITATION OF SITUATION - WE AGREE WITH POSITION YOU TOOK IN PARAGRAPH 6 OF REF A. YOU MAY FURTHER ADVISE KHALATBARI THAT AT THIS EARLY STAGE WE ARE TRYING TO KEEP OUR OPTIONS OPEN IN AFGHANISTAN AND NOT MAKE ANY PREMATURE DECISIONS OR STATEMENTS WHICH COULD PREJUDICE OUR POSITION EITHER WAY. WE BELIEVE THE WORST THING THAT WE COULD DO AT THE MOMENT IS "TO WRITE OFF AFGHANISTAN". THE NEW LEADERSHIP PROFESSES ITS INTENTION TO REMAIN NONALIGNED AND AT THIS STAGE WE THINK IT IS IN OUR INTEREST TO TAKE THEM AT THEIR WORD.

TO THE EXTENT THAT THERE MAY BE A SIGNIFICANT NATIONALIST COMPONENT IN THE NEW REGIME, WE SHOULD PROVIDE THEM WITH ALTERNATIVES TO EXCLUSIVE RELIANCE ON THE SOVIETS. WE WOULD ALSO HOPE THAT NONE OF US WOULD TAKE ANY ACTIONS WHICH WOULD HAVE THE EFFECT OF PUSHING THE AFGHANS FURTHER INTO THE SOVIET EMBRACE.

REGARDING POINT (D) "ACTIONS US WOULD BE PREPARED TO SUPPORT, BOTH IN PAKISTAN AND AFGHANISTAN" YOU MAY ADVISE KHALATBARI THAT WE HOPE TO CONTINUE OUR CURRENT ACTIVITIES, ASSUMING OF COURSE THAT THE NEW REGIME CREATES CONDITIONS WHICH PERMIT US TO DO SO. WE WILL WANT TO KEEP IN VERY CLOSE CONTACT WITH GOI ON ENTIRE RANGE OF AFGHAN DEVELOPMENTS OVER COMING WEEKS AND MONTHS. ON PAKISTAN YOU TOOK EXACTLY RIGHT POSITION IN PARAGRAPH 7 OF REFTEL (A) AND WE HAVE NOTHING FURTHER TO ADD.

IN DISCUSSING ERITREA WITH MFA OFFICIALS, PER REFTEL, YOU MAY DRAW ON THE FOLLOWING ANALYSIS: THERE ARE A NUMBER OF INDICATIONS WHICH SUGGEST THAT THE ETHIOPIAN ARMY MAY SHORTLY LAUNCH A MAJOR OFFENSIVE IN ERITREA. WE BELIEVE THAT THE MAJOR OBJECTIVES OF SUCH AN OFFENSIVE WOULD BE TO OPEN MAJOR ROADS AND LIFT THE INSURGENT SIEGES OF MAJOR TOWNS BEFORE THE THREE-MONTH RAINY SEASON BEGINS IN MID-JUNE.

CUBAN INTENTIONS REMAIN UNCLEAR. MOST OF THE AVAILABLE INFORMATION SUGGESTS THAT THE CUBANS ARE RELUCTANT TO BECOME INVOLVED IN THE KIND OF DIRECT COMBAT ROLE THAT THEY PLAYED IN ERITREA. INSTEAD, THEY APPEAR TO BE TRYING TO PROMOTE SOME KIND OF NEGOTIATED SETTLEMENT, ALTHOUGH THEIR PROSPECTS FOR SUCCESS IN SUCH AN ENDEAVOR ARE DIM, IN PART BECAUSE MENGISTU SEEMS DETERMINED TO ACHIEVE A MILITARY SOLUTION. IF ETHIOPIAN MILITARY EFFORTS FOUNDER, WE THINK THERE IS A GOOD CHANCE THAT THE CUBANS WOULD EVENTUALLY SEND TROOPS TO RECOUP THE SITUATION, ALTHOUGH SUCH A MOVE MIGHT NOT OCCUR UNTIL AFTER THE RAINY SEASON.

WE EXPECT, HOWEVER, THAT CUBAN ADVISERS WILL ASSIST IN OPERATIONAL AND LOGISTICAL PLANNING FOR THE UPCOMING OFFENSIVE AND THAT CUBAN ADVISERS WOULD ACCOMPANY ETHIOPIAN UNITS INTO COMBAT. ALTHOUGH OUR INFORMATION IS SKETCHY AND OFTEN CONTRADICTORY, THERE COULD BE AS MANY AS 1,200 TO 1,500 CUBAN ADVISERS IN ERITREA PROPER (THE LARGEST SINGLE NUMBER MAY BE IN THE AREA AROUND THE PORT OF ASSAB, WHICH IS NOT THE SCENE OF MAJOR INSURGENCY BUT IS THE PORT OF ENTRY FOR SOVIET MILITARY SHIPMENTS). WE ALSO BELIEVE THERE MAY BE ADDITIONAL CUBAN ADVISERS WITH ETHIOPIAN MILITARY FORCES IN PROVINCES BORDERING ERITREA.
WE HAVE NO HARD EVIDENCE TO DATE THAT CUBAN COMBAT UNITS HAVE MOVED FROM THE OGADEN TO NORTHERN ETHIOPIA OR ERITREA.

ALTHOUGH THE SOVIETS WOULD MUCH PREFER A NEGOTIATED SETTLEMENT IN ERITREA, THEY ARE CONTINUING TO PROVIDE ALL NECESSARY SUPPORT FOR AN ETHIOPIAN MLITARY CAMPAIGN. WE BELIEVE THAT SOVIET ADVISORS WILL PLAY A MAJOR IF NOT CONTROLLING ROLE IN THE PLANNING AND DIRECTION OF ETHIOPIAN MILITARY OPERATIONS. MEANWHILE, THE SOVIET SEALIFT AND AIRLIFT OF MILITARY EQUIPMENT ARE EXPECTED TO CONTINUE AT A RATE ADEQUATE TOMEET ALL REQUIREMENTS GENERATED BY AN ETHIOPIAN OFFENSIVE IN ERITREA. VACE
