A BOUNDARY AGREEMENT WAS SIGNED BY IRAN AND PAKISTAN ON FEBRUARY 6, 1958, REVISING THE ALIGNMENT OF THEIR COMMON BOUNDARY, AND INSTRUMENTS OF RATIFICATION WERE EXCHANGED ON JUNE 6, 1959. COMMISSIONS COMPLETED THE DEMARCATION OF THE BOUNDARY BY PILLARS ON FEBRUARY 27, 1959, TO BE FOLLOWED BY THE PREPARATION OF THE NECESSARY DOCUMENTATION AND MAPS. SEMI-OFFICIAL AND OFFICIAL PUBLICATIONS OF THE GOVERNMENT OF PAKISTAN HAVE ALSO INDICATED THAT A BOUNDARY AGREEMENT WAS TO GO INTO EFFECT ON JULY 25, 1963, TRANSFERRING ABOUT 100 SQUARE MILES OF TERRITORY TO PAKISTAN.

MAPS RECEIVED IN THE DEPARTMENT FROM IRAN AND PAKISTAN SHOWING THE BOUNDARY ARE NOT OF SUFFICIENT SCALE TO DETERMINE WHETHER OR NOT THE NEW BOUNDARY IS BEING USED AND IF THE TERRITORY HAS BEEN TRANSFERRED TO PAKISTAN. IT WOULD BE APPRECIATED IF BOUNDARY MAPS PREPARED BY THE COMMISSIONS OR OTHER DETAILED MAPS SHOWING THE NEW ALIGNMENT AND PILLARS COULD BE FORWARDED TO THE OFFICE OF THE GEOGRAPHER. A DETAILED DESCRIPTION OF THE DEMARCATION OF THE BOUNDARY ALSO WOULD BE HELPFUL.
FROM NEA/IRN

WE HAVE MAY 8 LETTER BELOW FROM SHAH TO PRESIDENT. REPLY NOW BEING DRAFTED. "DEAR MR. PRESIDENT, I SEIZE THIS OPPORTUNITY TO DRAW YOUR ATTENTION TO THE RECENT TRAGIC DEVELOPMENTS IN AFGHANISTAN. I HAD KNOWN ALL ALONG THAT EVENTS IN THAT COUNTRY WOULD FINALLY TAKE SUCH A TURN, BUT THESE OCCURRED FIVE YEARS EARLIER THAN I HAD EXPECTED. ALL OUR PREPARATIONS FOR DEFENCE PURPOSES WERE MADE WITH THIS CONTINGENCY IN MIND, BUT WE WILL NOW HAVE TO CATCH UP WITH EVENTS.

SOME OF THE RESPONSIBILTY FOR ASSURING OUR DEFENCE AND SECURITY REQUIREMENTS WILL REST UPON OURSELVES AND PARTLY ON THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA FOR THE ARMS WE WANT TO BUY. IN ADDITION, THE OIL COMPANIES WITH WHOM WE HAVE AGREEMENTS AND WHO HAVE RECENTLY DECREASED SHARPLY THEIR LIFTING OF IRANIAN OIL WILL ALSO HAVE TO ASSUME A MEASURE OF RESPONSIBILITY IN THIS REGARD BY PURCHASING MORE OIL THUS MAKING INCREASED FUNDS AVAILABLE FOR THE IMPLEMENTATION OF OUR PLANS.

IN THESE ANXIOUS AND TRAGIC TIMES, WE FEEL ENCIRCLED AND, AS I HAD MENTIONED TO YOU BEFORE, MR. PRESIDENT, OUR MAIN SOURCE OF CONCERN IS THE PRESSURE EXERTED FROM CERTAIN QUARTERS TO PUSH FORWARD TOWARDS THE INDIAN OCEAN. IF THIS SHOULD EVER MATERIALIZE, IT COULD DRASTICALLY ALTER THE ENTIRE GEO-POLITICAL SITUATION AND THE PRECARIOUS EQUILIBRIUM IN THIS REGION AND IN THE WORLD AS A WHOLE. FULLY COGNIZANT OF THIS THREAT, I CAN ASSURE YOU, MR. PRESIDENT, THAT WE WILL DO OUR UTMOST TO BRING INDIA AND PAKISTAN TOGETHER AND, I ALSO HOPE THAT THESE COUNTRIES WILL BOTH REALIZE AND BE COMPLETELY ALIVE TO THE DANGER CONFRONTING THEM.

IN OUTLINING THE ABOVE, I HAVE REFERRED TO THE THREAT POSED ON OUR EASTERNFRONTIERS WITHOUT MENTIONING THE DANGER FACING OUR WESTERN FLANKS, INCLUDING THE MENACE TO HASHEMITE JORDAN, SAUDI ARABIA, EGYPT AND THE SUDAN WHERE EVERY EFFORT MUST BE MADE TO MAINTAIN THE PRESENT POLITICAL ORDERS. I WOULD ALSO LIKE TO STRESS THAT MY GOVERNMENT IS GIVING EVERY PRIORITY TO EXPANDING ITS COOPERATION WITH THESE COUNTRIES. GIVEN THE PRESENT SITUATION, I FIRMLY BELIEVE THAT SOME ADDITIONAL MEASURES WILL HAVE TO BE ADOPTED TO SAFEGUARD THE STATUS QUO IN THE FREE COUNTRIES OF THIS REGION.

IN THE CONTEXT, I AM VERY GLAD TO OBSERVE THAT YOU HAVE RECOMMENDED THE LIFTING OF THE EMBARGO ON THE EXPORTATION OF ARMS TO TURKEY AND, I HOPE THAT THIS MEASURE WHICH HAS BEEN APPROVEDBY THE FOREIGN RELATIONS COMMITTEE OF THE HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES WILL BE PASSED BY THE CONGRESS OF THE UNITED STATES. AT THE SAME TIME, I ALSO HOPE THAT THE ISRAELIS WOULD REALIZE THE POTENTIAL DANGER INHERENT IN THE INABILITY TO ACHIEVE PEACE IN THE MIDDLE EAST.

I WANTED TO SHARE THESE THOUGHTS WITH YOU, MR. PRESIDENT IN VIEW OF THE VERY CLOSE COLLABORATION BETWEEN OUR TWO COUNTRIES IN THE MAINTENANCE OF PEACE AND SECURITY IN THIS VITALLY STRATEGIC AREA. I SHOULD BE GRATEFUL IF YOU WOULD GIVE ME YOUR CONSIDERED OPINIONS ON THESE SUBJECTS IN DUE COURSE. WITH KINDEST PERSONAL REGARDS, SINCERELY R. PAHLAVI VANCE

MAY 19 WASHINGTON POST CARRIES JONATHAN RANDAL ARTICLE DATELINED TEHRAN THAT IRAN HAS TOLD PAKISTAN FURTHER ECONOMIC AID DEPENDS ON SPARING BHUTTO'S LIFE. STORY ADDS THAT GOI BELIEVES THAT IF BHUTTO IS EXECUTED, PAKISTAN "COULD BE RIPE FOR SOVIET-SPONSORED DESTABILIZATION". QUOTING "INFORMED GOVERNMENT SOURCES" RANDAL ADDS THAT IRAN WAS READY TO USE "ANY MEANS" TO STOP AFGHAN TROUBLEMAKING IN THE AREA, AND THAT SHAH HAS SAID HE WOULD NOT TOLERATE DISINTEGRATION OF PAKISTAN. REMAINDER OF STORY ECHOES FAMILIAR IRANIAN THEME OF SOVIET PLANS TO ENCIRCLE IRAN AND ENDANGER OIL SUPPLIES FROM THE GULF.

DURING CALL MAY 19 BY IRANIAN EMBASSY POLITICAL COUNSELOR HOMAYUN, PAB OFFICERS ASKED ABOUT ARTICLE AND IRANIAN ATTITUDE TOWARD BHUTTO'S FATE. HOMAYUN SAID IRAN HAD NOT THREATENED TO CUT OFF AID IF BHUTTO WERE EXECUTED, "FOR WE WOULD NOT DO THAT TO OUR FRIENDS". HOWEVER, GOI HAS TOLD PAKISTAN THAT IF BHUTTO SENTENCE CARRIED OUT, IT WOULD BE "A NEW AND VERY DANGEROUS SITUATION". HOMAYUN SAID IRANIAN AMBASSADOR IN ISLAMABAD HAS TOLD GOP THAT IRAN FEELS VERY STRONGLY THAT BHUTTO'S LIFE SHOULD BE SPARED FOR HIS DEATH WOULD CAUSE CONSIDERABLE INTERNAL PROBLEMS FOR PAKISTAN, SOMETHING GOI DOES NOT WANT TO SEE.

COMMENT - HOMAYUN WAS CAREFUL NOT TO SAY IRAN HAS THREATENED PAKISTAN WITH CESSATION OF AID. IT WAS CLEAR, HOWEVER, THAT SHAH WOULD LOOK VERY UNKINDLY ON BHUTTO EXECUTION AND THAT GOI BELIEVES RECENT AFGHAN EVENTS ADD TO ARGUMENTS IN FAVOR OF SPARING HIS LIFE FOR,IN IRANIAN VIEW, HIS DEATH WOULD ONLY SERVE TO FURTHER DESTABILIZE AN

RECENT DISTURBANCES IN TEXAS AND ILLINOIS HAVE INVOLVED SEVERAL HUNDRED IRANIAN STUDENTS WHOSE STATUS IS NOW BEING INVESTIGATED BY INS. THOSE FOUND OUT OF STATUS ARE SUBJECT TO DEPORTATION HEARINGS AND AS A RESULT DEPARTMENT ANTICIPATES RECEIVING INCREASING NUMBER OF ASYLUM REQUESTS VIA INS.
MOST SUCH REQUESTS WILL PROBABLY ATTEMPT TO JUSTIFY CLAIM OF PROBABLE ARREST, DETENTION AND PERSECUTION ON RETURN TO IRAN BECAUSE OF MEMBERSHIP IN IRANIAN STUDENT ASSOCIATION.

PROFILE OF TYPICAL CLAIMANT WOULD BE 25 - 30 YEAR OLD IRANIAN ADMITTED AS STUDENT SEVERAL YEARS AGO WHO MAY OR MAY NOT BE IN STUDENT STATUS AT PRESENT. AS A MEMBER OF ISA HE HAS PARTICIPATED IN ANTI-SHAH DEMONSTRATIONS, CLAIMS THAT SAVAK HAS MEMBERS INFILTRATING MEETINGS AND DEMONSTRATIONS, HAS THEREFORE PROBABLY BEEN IDENTIFIED AND IS KNOWN AS DISSIDENT TO GOI. FAMILY IN IRAN MAY HAVE BEEN QUERIED AS TO WHEN HE WILL RETURN. HE MAY ALSO REFER TO - UNNAMED FRIENDS IN SIMILAR CIRCUMSTANCES WHO DISAPPEARED AFTER RETURNING TO IRAN. IN VIEW OF ALL THIS HE FEELS HE HAS A VALID CLAIM TO REFUGEE STATUS IN THE U.S.

IN ORDER TO ASSIST DEPARTMENT IN EVALUATING REQUESTS AND DEVELOPING BALANCE AND OBJECTIVE JUDGEMENTS, WE WILL APPRECIATE EMBASSY COMMENTS ON WHETHER SUCH STUDENTS ARE LIABLE TO PROSECUTION FOR VIOLATION OF IRANIAN LA' PROHIBITING CRITICISM OF SHAH. IF SO, HAVE SUCH PROSECUTIONS TAKEN PLACE IN PAST AND WHAT WERE SENTENCES? HAVE FAMILIES OF THOSE STUDENTS BEEN HARASSED OR OTHERWISE SUBJECT TO UNWELCOME ATTENTION ON PART OF GOI? WOULD SUCH INDIVIDUALS HAVE A WELL-FOUNDED FEAR OF PERSECUTION FOR REASON OF RACE, RELIGION, NATIONALITY, POLITICAL OPINION, OR MEMBERSHIP OF A PARTICULAR SOCIAL GROUP IN THE EVENT THEY WERE RETURNED TO IRAN? VANCE

FOLLOWING IS TEXT OF LETTER FROM PRESIDENT CARTER TO SHAH IN REPLY TO SHAH'S MAY 8 LETTER. IN DELIVERING LETTER BELOW TO HIM, PRESIDENT HAS ASKED FOLLOWING ORAL MESSAGE BE GIVEN: : AFTER MY TALKS THIS WEEK WITH THE FRENCH, I AM OPTIMISTIC THAT WE WILL BE ABLE TO RESOLVE OUR DIFFERENCES REGARDING PAKISTAN REPROCESSING. END . AS ADDITIONAL TALKING POINT, YOU SHOULD NOTE THAT, WITH THE PROSPECT THIS OBSTACLE WILL BE REMOVED, WE HOPE OUR OPPORTUNITIES TO STRENGTHEN REGIONAL SECURITY WILL BE ENHANCED.

TO THIS END, THE SECRETARY PROPOSES SENDING UNDER SECRETARY NEWSOM TO SOUTH ASIA, INCL;DING TEHRAN, PROBABLY DURING JULY, TO DISCUSS HOW WE CAN FURTHER REGIONAL COOPERATION GENERALLY AND HELP REASSURE PAKISTAN SPECIFICALLY.

BEGIN TEXT: YOUR IMPERIAL MAJESTY: I FULLY SHARE THE CONCERN ABOUT RECENT DEVELOPMENTS IN AFGHANISTAN THAT YOU STATED SO LUCIDLY IN YOUR LETTER OF MAY 8. DOMINATION OF AFGHANISTAN BY THE SOVIET UNION WOULD BE A DEVELOPMENT OF GREAT SERIOUSNESS FOR THE FREE WORLD. IT SHOULD, THEREFORE, BE A MATTER OF HIGH NATIONAL POLICY FOR THOSE OF US WHO SHARE THIS VIEW TO COOPERATE CLOSELY OVER THE COMING WEEKS AND MONTHS. ONE IMPORTANT WAY WE CAN WORK TOGETHER IN THE IMMEDIATE FUTURE IS TO TRY TO HOLD THE AFGHAN LEADERSHIP TO ITS STATED INTENTION TO REMAIN NON-ALIGNED.

IN OUR OWN BILATERAL RELATIONS, WE ARE PREPARED TO MAINTAIN OUR PRESENCE IN AFGHANISTAN AND CONTINUE OUR COOPERATIVE ACTIVITIES THERE. I BELIEVE THAT, TO THE EXTENT WE CAN LIMIT AFGHANISTAN'S DEPENDENCE ON THE SOVIET UNION AND BROADEN ITS TIES ELSEWHERE, WE WILL BE MAKING A USEFUL CONTRIBUTION TO THE GOALS WHICH YOU AND I SHARE. WE MUST RECOGNIZE, HOWEVER, THAT THOSE EFFORTS MAY NOT BE SUCCESSFUL. CONSEQUENTLY, I WILL WANT TO KEEP IN CLOSE PERSONAL CONTACT WITH YOU, AND I HOPE AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN WILL BE ABLE TO EXCHANGE INFORMATION AND REVIEW POLICY CONSIDERATIONS CONTINUOUSLY WITH YOU AND OFFICIALS OF YOUR GOVERNMENT.

YOUR OWN SPECIAL VANTAGE POINT AND DEPTH OF EXPERIENCE IN THAT REGION WILL BE PARTICULARLY VALUABLE IN ASSISTING ME TO EVALUATE THE COURSE OF EVENTS. WE WILL ALSO BE IN CLOSE TOUCH WITH THE GOVERNMENT OF PAKISTAN, WHICH SHARES OUR DEEP CONCERNS ABOUT EVENTS IN AFGHANISTAN AND WHAT THEY MAY PRESAGE FOR THE SECURITY OF THE REGION. WE ARE ACTIVELY CONSIDERING STEPS WE CAN TAKE TO CONTRIBUTE TO PAKISTAN'S STABILITY AND STRENGTH, AND WE WILL CONTINUE TO CONSULT CLOSELY WITH YOU ON THE BEST WAY TO ACHIEVE OUR SHARED GOAL OF A SECURE PAKISTAN IN A PEACEFUL SOUTH ASIA.

WITH REGARD TO THE COUNTRIES ON IRAN'S WESTERN BORDER, I BELIEVE THE ACTIONS THAT THE UNITED STATES HAS TAKEN OR HAS UNDERWAY GO FAR TOWARD STRENGTHENING OUR FRIENDS IN THAT AREA AND ASSURING STABILITY THERE. THE SUPPLY OF ADVANCED FIGHTER AIRCRAFT TO SAUDI ARABIA AND EGYPT WILL BE AN IMPORTANT CONTRIBUTION TO THE DEFENSE OF THOSE COUNTRIES, REINFORCING BOTH THEIR ABILITY AND THEIR RESOLVE TO FACE THREATS FROM RADICAL ELEMENTS. YOUR CLOSE COLLABORATION WITH THEM WILL CONTRIBUTE SIGNIFICANTLY TO THEIR ABILITY TO MAINTAIN THEIR INDEPENDENCE.

WHILE OUR MIDDLE EAST PEACE EFFORT HAS NOT PROGRESSED AS RAPIDLY AS I HAD HOPED, THE UNITED STATES REMAINS COMMITTED TO THE ACHIEVEMENT OF A JUST AND LASTING PEACE BETWEEN ISRAEL AND ITS ARAB NEIGHBORS. WE ARE IN DAILY CONTACT WITH THE PARTIES AND EXPECT TO BE MOVING AHEAD SHORTLY. I PARTICULARLY APPRECIATE YOUR HELPFUL ROLE IN RESPECT TO THE ARAB-ISRAELI NEGOTIATIONS, AND THE CONTRIBUTIONS OF YOUR GOVERNMENT TO THE UNITED NATIONS' PEACEKEEPING FORCE IN SOUTHERN LEBANON.

DESPITE THE DISAPPOINTING SETBACK IN THE SENATE FOREIGN RELATIONS COMMITTEE EARLIER THIS MONTH, I WANT YOU TO KNOW THAT MY ADMINISTRATION REMAINS FULLY COMMITTED TO THE LIFTING OF THE EMBARGO ON ARMS FOR TURKEY. I SHARE YOUR CONCERN REGARDING THE TERMS OF THE ARMS EMBARGO. WE EXPECT THE ISSUE TO COME TO A VOTE ON THE FLOOR OF BOTH HOUSES SOMETIME THIS SUMMER. TURKEY IS FACING A NUMBER OF DIFFICULT PROBLEMS--ECONOMIC, POLITICAL, DIPLOMATIC AND MILITARY--AND HER FRIENDS AND ALLIES SHOULD SPARE NO EFFORT TO MAINTAIN A STRONG AND WESTERN-ORIENTED TURKEY WHICH IS SO IMPORTANT FOR THE SECURITY OF THE REGION. THE U.S.

IS WATCHING CLOSELY THE DEVELOPMENTS IN THE HORN OF AFRICA. WE ARE PREPARED TO CHALLENGE SOVIET AND CUBAN EFFORTS TO GAIN PREDOMINANT INFLUENCE IN THE REGION WITH A COMBINATION OF DIPLOMATIC PRESSURES AND DIRECT U.S. MILITARY AND ECONOMIC ASSISTANCE, AS IN SUDAN AND KENYA. WE CANNOT PROVIDE ASSISTANCE, HOWEVER, IN SITUATIONS IN WHICH WE WOULD BE AIDING A COUNTRY THAT IS SYSTEMATICALLY VIOLATING ANOTHER NATION'S TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY. WE ARE DISTURBED BY RECENT REPORTS REACHING US OF RENEWED ASSISTANCE FROM SOMALIA TO THE INSURGENTS IN THE OGADEN. SUCH ACTIVITY IS CONTRARY TO THE ASSURANCES WE HAVE REQUIRED OF PRESIDENT SIAD THAT HE LIVE AT PEACE WITH HIS NEIGHBORS.

IT GIVES THE SOVIETS AND THE CUBANS AN EXCUSE TO STAY IN ETHIOPIA WITH LARGE CONTINGENTS OF TROOPS. WE WOULD HOPE THAT PRESIDENT SIAD MIGHT REFRAIN FROM ENCOURAGING GUERRILLAS AND TURN HIS COUNTRY TOWARD PEACEFUL DEVELOPMENT. THIS WOULD BE IN THE INTEREST OF CLOSER TIES BETWEEN THE WEST AND SOMALIA, WOULD ENCOURAGE STABILITY IN THE REGION, AND WOULD DEPRIVE THE SOVIETS OF THE OPPORTUNITY TO CONSOLIDATE THEIR POSITION IN THE AREA BY EXPLOITING TENSIONS.

FINALLY, IN OUR DEALINGS WITH THE SOVIET UNION WE WILL CONTINUE TO IMPRESS UPON THE SOVIET LEADERSHIP THE IMPORTANCE FOR UNITED STATES-SOVIET RELATIONS OF SOVIET RESTRAINT IN INTERNATIONAL AFFAIRS AND RESPECT FOR THE INDEPENDENCE OF ALL COUNTRIES. LET ME ASSURE YOU OF THE FIRM UNITED STATES COMMITMENT TO THE DEFENSE OF OUR FRIENDS AND ALLIES ALL OVER THE WORLD FROM AGGRESSION FROM ANY QUARTER. YOUR MAJESTY, I AM ENCOURAGED THAT YOU HAVE WRITTEN TO ME WITH SUCH FRANKNESS. THIS IS PRECISELY THE KIND OF RELATIONSHIP WHICH I HOPED WE WOULD DEVELOP AS A RESULT OF OUR TALKS IN WASHINGTON AND TEHRAN.
WE MUST CONTINUE IN THIS SAME FRANK AND OPEN SPIRIT. SINCERELY, JIMMY CARTER HIS IMPERIAL MAJESTY MOHAMMAD REZA PAHLAVI SHAHANSHAH OF IRAN TEHRAN
WE HAVE REPEATED TO YOU PART III OF EAST-WEST STUDY PREPARED FOR NATO SUMMIT (REF B), WHICH DRAWS UPON AND SUMMARIZES PARTS I-II, AS WELL AS PUBLIC STATEMENT PREPARED BY NATO (REF C).
YOU MAY DRAW ON REF C IN BRIEFING THE SHAH BUT AS SUGGESTED REF A, YOU SHOULD AVOID GIVING ANY IMPRESSION THAT THE STUDY ITSELF COULD BE MADE AVAILABLE TO THE IRANIANS.
YOU MAY WISH TO SHARE WITH THE IRANIANS AT THE SAME TIME THE NATO COMMUNIQUE, LONG TERM DEFENSE PROGRAM (LTDP) AND THE PRESIDENT'S STATEMENT WHICH WE ARE REPEATING TO YOU. VANCE

segments.text: COUNCIL TODAY COMPLETED WORK AD REFERENDUM ON EASTWEST STUDY. DOCUMENT NECESSARILY REPRESENTS COMPROMISE, BUT WE BELIEVE BASIC US DESIDERATA HAVE BEEN MET AND THAT PAPER AS A WHOLE WILL MAKE THE IMPORTANT CONTRIBUTION SOUGHT BY ALLIED LEADERS.

WITH REGARD TO SPECIFIC FINAL ISSUES, FRENCH WERE ADAMANT IN REFUSING TO ACCEPT PHRASES CONCERNING "CLOSE CONSULTATION" BUT DID AGREE TO REFERENCE TO "ALLIED CONSULTATIONS" AND THE OTTAWA DECLARATION. WE IN TURN AGREED TO MODIFY REFERENCES TO CONSULTATIONS IN ECONOMIC AND CSCE PARAGRAPHS AND DID NOT HAVE TO DELETE THEM AS FRENCH HAD URGED. COMMITMENT TO SUCH CONSULTATIONS IS THUS RETAINED IN BOTH THESE PARAGRAPHS AND THROUGH REFERENCE TO OTTAWA DECLARATION.

DOCUMENT WILL BE CONSIDERED FORMALLY APPROVED BY COB MONDAY, MAY 22 UNLESS THERE ARE OBJECTIONS FROM CAPITALS. WE BELIEVE (A) FRENCH HAVE BEEN PUSHED AS FAR AS THEY WILL GO--IT SHOULD BE RECALLED THAT THEY WERE RELUCTANT EVEN TO UNDERTAKE A PART III--, (B) BASIC US INTERESTS ARE PROTECTED, (C) THAT STUDY MEETS THE REQUIREMENTS SET OUT AT LONDON, AND (D) THAT ACCORDINGLY US SHOULD ADOPT IT. 1978STATE145700.subject: NATO SUMMIT -- BRIEFING FOR THE SHAH

segments.text: PER REFTEL, THIS MESSAGE FORWARDS THE TEXT OF A SUMMARY OF THE NATO LONG TERM DEFENSE PROGRAM (LTDP).

BEGIN TEXT: THE LONG-TERM DEFENCE PROGRAMME - A SUMMARY INTRODUCTION AT THE MEETING OF HEADS OF STATE AND GOVERNMENT HELD IN WASHINGTON ON 30TH AND 31ST MAY, THE LEADERS OF STATES PARTICIPATING IN THE INTEGRATED DEFENCE STRUCTURE OF THE ALLIANCE GAVE THEIR ENDORSEMENT TO A WIDE RANGE OF MEASURES AS AN ACTION PROGRAMME DESIGNED TO HELP ADAPT THE DEFENCE POSTURE OF THE ALLIANCE TO THE CHALLE'GES OF THE 1980S. (FOOTNOTE. IN THIS CONNECTION, TURKEY POINTED OUT THE IMPORTANCE TO HER PARTICIPATION OF SUFFICIENT SUPPORT FROM HER ALLIES AS WELL AS OF THE COMPLETE REMOVAL OF EXISTING RESTRICTIONS ON THE PROCUREMENT OF DEFENCE EQUIPMENT.

THIS LONG-TERM DEFENCE PROGRAMME HAS BEEN DEVELOPED, IN RESPONSE TO DIRECTIVES GIVEN AT THE SUMMIT MEETING HELD IN LONDON IN MAY 1977, AS A MEANS OF STRENGTHENING THE ONGOING NATO FORCE PLANNING AND NATIONAL PROGRAMMES IN THE FACE OF THE CHALLENGE TO ALLIANCE SECURITY POSED BY THE CONTINUING MOMENTUM OF THE WARSAW PACT MILITARY BUILD-UP. THE PROGRAMME MARKS A SIGNIFICANT MILESTONE FOR NATO THROUGH ITS PROJECTION OF ALLIANCE DEFENCE PLANNING INTO A LONGER TERM FRAMEWORK AND ITS EMPHASIS ON CO-OPERATIVE EFFORTS TO STRENGTHEN THE DEFENCES OF THE ALLIANCE. THE POLITICAL AND MILITARY BACKGROUND

THE ENHANCEMENT OF NATO'S SECURITY MUST BE ASSURED NOT ONLY BY STRENGTHENING THE ALLIANCE'S DETERRENT AND DEFENCE POSTURE BUT ALSO BY CONTINUED PURSUIT OF DETENTE AND, AS A KEY PART OF THAT PROCESS, EQUITABLE AND MEANINGFUL ARMS CONTROL AND DISARMAMENT AGREEMENTS. HOWEVER TRENDS IN THE MILITARY BALANCE, WHICH IN THE CONVENTIONAL AREA ARE MOVING STRONGLY TO NATO'S DISADVANTAGE, COULD, IF LEFT UNCHECKED, UNDERMINE DETERRENCE AND STABILITY. NATO IS DETERMINED TO MEET THIS CHALLENGE BY MAINTAINING A CREDIBLE DETERRENT AND DEFENCE POSTURE. NATO'S CAPABILITIES WILL CONTINUE TO BE DESIGNED TO SUPPORT THE CONCEPT OF FORWARD DEFENCE BASED ON ADEQUATE CONVENTIONAL, THEATRE NUCLEAR AND STRATEGIC NUCLEAR FORCES THROUGH THE 1980S.

NATO ALSO RECOGNISES THE CHALLENGE TO ITS COLLECTIVE DEFENCE PLANNING ARISING FROM THE FACT THAT MEMBERS OF THE ALLIANCE ARE SOVEREIGN STATES. THEREFORE INCREASED ALLIANCE-WIDE CO-ORDINATION OF NATIONAL PLANNING IS REQUIRED TO STRENGTHEN NATO'S DEFENCE CAPABILITIES BY ACHIEVING A GREATER DEGREE OF CO-OPERATION AND RATIONALIZATION. THE PROGRAMME

THE LONG-TERM DEFENCE PROGRAMME IS DESIGNED TO MEET THESE CHALLENGES. IT PROVIDES FOR FORCE IMPROVEMENTS IN CERTAIN SELECTED AREAS AND FOR A FAR GREATER DEGREE OF ALLIANCE CO-OPERATION, LEADING TO AN INCREASE IN OVERALL DEFENSIVE CAPABILITY FROM THE NATIONAL RESOURCES ALREADY MADE AVAILABLE OR PLANNED FOR THE ALLIANCE. FURTHER IMPROVEMENTS ARE TO BE MADE TO THE READINESS AND COMBAT CAPABILITIES OF NATO'S MILITARY FORCES AND IN THE CAPABILITY TO REINFORCE THOSE FORCES.

THE PROGRAMME RECOMMENDS A SERIES OF DETAILED ACTIONS TO IMPROVE NATO CAPABILITIES IN CERTAIN PRIORITY AREAS: READINESS, REINFORCEMENT; RESERVE MOBILIZATION; MARITIME POSTURE, AIR DEFENCE; COMMUNICATIONS, COMMAND AND CONTROL; ELECTRONIC WARFARE; LOGISTICS; RATIONALIZATION AND THEATRE NUCLEAR FORCES. IN ALL THESE AREAS PARTICULAR EMPHASIS WILL BE PLACED ON CO-OPERATION BETWEEN MEMBER COUNTRIES. THE ACTION AREAS READINESS

THE ABILITY OF WARSAW PACT FORCES TO ATTACK WITH LESS PREPARATION THAN IN THE PAST CHALLENGES NATO FORCES TO BE READY TO RESPOND RAPIDLY WITH THE MAXIMUM POSSIBLE COMBAT CAPABILITY. NATO FORCES THUS REQUIRE IMPROVEMENTS TO A WIDE RANGE OF DEFENCE CAPABILITIES, ESPECIALLY ANTI-ARMOUR UNITS, MODERN AIR-TO-SURFACE WEAPONS AND DEFENCE AGAINST CHEMICAL WARFARE. IN-PLACE FORCES MUST BE READY WITHIN THE MINIMUM WARNING TIME. ARRANGEMENTS FOR MAXIMUM SUPPORT FROM THE CIVIL SECTOR ARE ESSENTIAL. PROGRAMMES INCLUDE INCREASES IN THE NATIONAL HOLDINGS OF TANKS, ANTI-ARMOUR WEAPONS AND MISSILES AND ARMED HELICOPTERS. IT HAS ALSO BEEN AGREED TO PURSUE CO-OPERATIVE OR CO-ORDINATED DEVELOPMENT OF THE NEXT-GENERATION ANTIARMOUR WEAPONS.

A PROGRAMME FOR SUBSTANTIALLY INCREASING NATIONAL HOLDINGS OF MODERN AIR-TO-SURFACE WEAPONS WILL ALSO BE INTRODUCED, ALONG WITH THE PURSUIT OF A COMMON FAMILY OF THESE TYPES OF WEAPONS. PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT AGAINST CHEMICAL WARFARE WILL BE PROVIDED TO MEET NATO STANDARDS. THE ABILITY OF COMBAT FORCES TO UPLOAD AMMUNITION AT SHORT NOTICE WILL BE INCREASED . IN ADDITION, A NUMBER OF NATIONS HAVE AGREED TO INCREASE THE DEGREE OF COMMITMENT OF THEIR FORCES TO NATO, WHICH WILL ENHANCE READINESS IN TIME OF CRISIS. MULTILATERAL DISCUSSIONS TO SHORTEN THE REACTION TIME OF THE 1ST NETHERLANDS CORPS ARE CONTINUING. REINFORCEMENT

THE IMBALANCE OF CONVENTIONAL FORCES IN EUROPE IS SUCH THAT, IN PERIODS OF RISING TENSION OR CRISIS, DETERRENCE COULD BE PUT AT RISK WITHOUT A CAPABILITY FOR RAPID AND EFFECTIVE REINFORCEMENT OF ALLIED COMMAND EUROPE AS A WHOLE. IMPROVEMENTS ARE NOW NECESSARY TO ENHANCE THE ALLIANCE CAPABILITIES FOR RAPID REINFORCEMENT. THIS INVOLVES THE COMMITMENT OF CIVIL AIR, SEA, LAND AND NATIONAL INFRASTRUCTURE RESOURCES TO THE REINFORCEMENT TASK AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF EFFECTIVE ARRANGEMENTS TO CO-ORDINATE THE FLOW OF REINFORCEMENTS. AN ESSENTIAL ELEMENT IS THE USE OF EXISTING EUROPEAN FACILITIES, WITH IMPROVEMENTS WHERE NECESSARY, TO RECEIVE AND MOVE FORWARD EXTERNAL REINFORCEMENTS WITH MINIMUM DELAY.

IN ADDITION MEASURES WILL BE TAKEN TO ACCELERATE THE MOVEMENT OF SIGNIFICANT FIGHTING UNITS TO THE FORWARD AREAS IN THE CRITICAL EARLY PHASE. A MAJOR FEATURE IS THE PREPOSITIONING BY THE UNITED STATES OF THE HEAVY EQUIPMENT FOR THREE ADDITIONAL US DIVISIONS IN THE CENTRAL REGION BY 1982, RECOGNISING THE NEED FOR EUROPEAN ALLIES TO PROVIDE THE NECESSARY SUPPORT AND OTHER FACILITIES. FOR SOME ALLIES MODIFICATIONS TO CIVIL AIRCRAFT ARE PROPOSED TO CARRY EQUIPMENT WHICH CANNOT BE PREPOSITIONED. THE AMPHIBIOUS LIFT FOR THE UNITED KINGDOM/NETHERLANDS MARINE FORCE IS TO BE IMPROVED. RESERVE MOBILIZATION

SINCE RESERVISTS COMPRISE A SIGNIFICANT PROPORTION OF NATO'S TOTAL GROUND FORCES, TIMELY DEPLOYMENT OF RESERVE UNITS IS CRITICAL, ESPECIALLY IN ALLIED COMMAND EUROPE. IT IS THEREFORE NECESSARY TO TAKE ADDITIONAL MEASURES TO ENSURE THAT RESERVISTS AND RESERVE FORMATIONS ARE PROPERLY EQUIPPED, TRAINED AND CAPABLE OF BEING RAPIDLY DEPLOYED TO LOCATIONS WHERE THEY ARE REQUIRED. PROGRAMMES ARE DESIGNED TO BRING NATIONAL RESERVE FORCES UP TO NATO STANDARDS AND TO SEEK TO UPGRADE AND IMPROVE THE OPERATIONAL READINESS OF CERTAIN RESERVE UNITS. IN ADDITION A NUMBER OF EUROPEAN COUNTRIES WILL CONSIDER PROVIDING ADDITIONAL RESERVE BRIGADES OVER THE LONGER TERM.
THIS WOULD INCREASE THE EFFECTIVE USE OF INDIVIDUAL RESERVISTS AND MAKE AVAILABLE ADDITIONAL COMBAT UNITS FOR INITIAL REINFORCEMENT. MARITIME POSTURE

A NUMBER OF MARITIME PROGRAMMES HAVE BEEN AGREED UPON TO PROVIDE FOR GREATLY INCREASED CAPABILITIES IN MARITIME COMMAND, CONTROL AND COMMUNICATIONS AND FOR AIR DEFENCE OF NAVAL UNITS. THE PROGRAMMES ALSO INCLUDE MEASURES TO ACHIEVE IMPROVED ANTI-SUBMARINE CAPABILITIES, BETTER ANTI-MISSILE SURFACE DEFENCE AND GREATER MINE WARFARE CAPABILITIES. CO-OPERATIVE OR CO-ORDINATED DEVELOPMENT OF KEY WEAPON SYSTEMS WILL BE PURSUED. IT HAS BEEN RECOGNISED THAT THE MOST SERIOUS DEFICIENCY LIES IN SHORTAGES IN THE NUMBER OF SHIPS, SUBMARINES AND AIRCRAFT AND THAT SPECIFIC REMEDIES FOR THESE SHORTFALLS SHOULD BE SOUGHT UNDER ESTABLISHED NATO PLANNING PROCEDURES. AIR DEFENCE

AGREEMENT HAS BEEN REACHED ON A BASIC ALLIANCEWIDE CO-OPERATIVE PROGRAMME TO IMPROVE AIR DEFENCE CAPABILITIES RECOGNISING THE NEED FOR SUBSEQUENT DETAILED PLANNING AND REFINEMENT. IT INCLUDES MEASURES DESIGNED TO IMPROVE THE IDENTIFICATION OF HOSTILE AIRCRAFT AND TO ENHANCE THE CONTROL OF NATO'S OWN COMBAT AIRCRAFT. PROVISION IS TO BE MADE FOR IMPROVEMENTS TO FIGHTER AIRCRAFT, ACQUISITION OF IMPROVED SURFACE-TO-AIR WEAPONRY, TO PROVIDE THE ALLIANCE WITH A SIGNIFICANTLY ENHANCED CAPABILITY FOR ENGAGING WARSAW PACT AIRCRAFT PENETRATING AT ALL LEVELS. COMMUNICATIONS, COMMAND AND CONTROL

A NUMBER OF CO-OPERATIVE EFFORTS WERE AGREED WHICH WILL MAKE IMPORTANT CONTRIBUTIONS TO THE OVERALL CAPABILITIES OF THE ALLIANCE FOR COMMUNICATIONS, COMMAND AND CONTROL WHICH ARE ESSENTIAL TO POLITICAL CONSULTATION IN TIMES OF CRISIS AND FOR THE POLITICAL DIRECTION OF FORCES AND WHICH WILL ALSO ACHIEVE A HIGH LEVEL OF INTEROPERABILITY IN THE AREA OF TACTICAL COMMUNICATIONS. THESE INCLUDE THE IMPLEMENTATION OF THE SECOND PHASE OF THE NATO INTEGRATED COMMUNICATIONS SYSTEM AND CO-OPERATION AND CO-ORDINATED EFFORTS IN THE FIELDS OF MARITIME COMMUNICATIONS, TACTICAL TRUNK NETWORK, SINGLE-CHANNEL RADIO ACCESS, NATO/NATIONAL AREA INTERCONNECTION, STRATEGIC AUTOMATIC DATA PROCESSING AND WAR HEADQUARTERS IMPROVEMENTS. ELECTRONIC WARFARE

ALL NATO NATIONS HAVE AGREED THAT URGENT ACTION IS REQUIRED TO COPE WITH THIS IMPORTANT DIMENSION OF MODERN CONFLICT. PROGRAMMES PROVIDE FOR IMPORTANT IMPROVEMENTS IN NATO'S CAPABILITY TO COUNTER THE SOPHISTICATED ELECTRONIC WARFARE THREAT POSED BY THE WARSAW PACT. THEY COVER LAND, AIR AND MARITIME FORCES, TOGETHER WITH IMPROVEMENTS IN NATO'S ORGANIZATION AND PROCEDURES IN THIS FIELD, INCLUDING CLOSER COOPERATION IN RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT. RATIONALIZATION

THE OBJECTIVE IS TO ACHIEVE ECONOMIC SAVINGS AND ENHANCED MILITARY EFFICIENCY THROUGH INCREASED STANDARDIZATION AND INTEROPERABILITY. PROGRAMMES INCLUDE DEVELOPMENT OF NEW PROCEDURES FOR SYSTEMATIC LONGRANGE ARMAMENTS PLANNING, NEW PROCEDURES FOR THE IMPROVED FORMULATION AND UTILIZATION OF STANDARDIZATION AGREEMENTS, AND CONTINUATION OF THE WORK BEING UNDERTAKEN BY THE CONFERENCE OF NATIONAL ARMAMENTS DIRECTORS IN THE FIELD OF INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS. IN THE DEVELOPMENT AND ACQUISITION OF THE EQUIPMENT RECOMMENDED IN THE LONG-TERM DEFENCE PROGRAMME, CO-OPERATIVE PROGRAMMES WILL BE PURSUED TO THE GREATEST EXTENT POSSIBLE.

NATIONS HAVE ALSO ENDORSED THE NEED FOR THE TRANSFER OF TECHNOLOGY BETWEEN MEMBER COUNTRIES WHERE SUCH TRANSFERS CONTRIBUTE TO THE FURTHERANCE OF STANDARDIZATION/INTEROPERABILITY OF NATO DEFENCE EQUIPMENT. LOGISTICS

POLICY AND ORGANIZATIONAL IMPROVEMENTS HAVE BEEN AGREED TO HARMONIZE AND CO-ORDINATE ARRANGEMENTS IN THE REAR AREAS AND THEREBY IMPROVE THE LOGISTIC SUPPORT OF COMBAT FORCES. THE LOGISTICS SUPPORT RESPONSIBILITIES BETWEEN NATO COMMANDERS AND MEMBER NATIONS WILL BE MORE CLEARLY DEFINED, AND IMPROVED LOGISTICS STRUCTURES PROVIDED WITHIN NATO MILITARY COMMANDS. A LOGISTICS MATTER PLANNING SYSTEM IS TO BE DEVELOPED TO PROVIDE FOR BETTER PLANNING AND MANAGEMENT OF NATO LOGISTICS FUNCTIONS. THERE ARE ALSO TO BE INCREASED WAR RESERVE STOCKS AND WAYS ARE BEING SOUGHT TO IMPROVE FLEXIBILITY IN THE USE OF AMMUNITION STOCKS IN WAR AND TO BUILD UP STOCKS OF PRIMARY FUELS WITH IMPROVED STORAGE FACILITIES. THEATRE NUCLEAR MODERNIZATION
MEASURES ARE BEING DEVELOPED TO ENSURE THAT NATO'S THEATRE NUCLEAR FORCES CONTINUE TO PLAY THEIR ESSENTIAL ROLE IN NATO'S DETERRENCE AND DEFENCE POSTURE. IMPLEMENTATION

THERE IS TO BE A VIGOROUS AND SUSTAINED FOLLOWTHROUGH ON THE DETAILS OF THESE RECOMMENDATIONS. TO THIS END HEADS OF STATE AND GOVERNMENT HAVE PLEDGED THEIR FULL SUPPORT FOR THE INTENSIVE CIVIL AND MILITARY PLANNING AND DEVELOPMENT EFFORTS NEEDED AT NATIONAL AND NATO LEVEL. ARRANGEMENTS WILL BE MADE FOR ENSURING AN EFFECTIVE FOLLOW-THROUGH FOR THE MEASURES APPROVED UNDER THE LONG-TERM DEFENCE PROGRAMME, INCLUDING A STUDY ON STRENGTHENING OF INTERNATIONAL MACHINERY. THERE WILL BE FURTHER ACTION ON RELATED LOW COST/NO COST RECOMMENDATIONS AND PROVISION FOR PERIODIC MONITORING AND REVIEW OF PROGRESS. .

1978STATE180204.subject: KDP REP COMMENTS ON REPORTED CLASH BETWEEN KDP- TALBANT FORCES

segments.text: TALBANT FORCES

DURING VISIT JULY 12 TO NEA/ARN, LOCAL KDP REP VOLUNTEERED FOLLOWING INFORMATION ON EARLIER REPORTS OF MAJOR BATTLE BETWEEN KDP AND TALABANI FORCES. ACCORDING TO KDP REP, TALABANI MET WITH SADDAM HUSSEIN AND AGREED TO CRUSH THE PESH MERGA IN EXCHANGE FOR TITULAR LEADERSHIP IN THE AUTONOMOUS REGION AFTER COMPLETING THE JOB. ALLEGEDLY, TALABANI THEN TOOK HIS 700 (SIC) TROOPS INTO IRAN, CIRCLED INTO TURKEY, AND RE-ENTERED IRAQ TO FORM THE NORTHERN HALF OF A PINCER MOVEMENT, BUTRESSED BY TWO, RECENTLY MOBILIZED DIVISIONS OF IRAQ REGULARS FROM THE SOUTH.

TURKISH KURDS WERE SAID TO HAVE ALERTED KDP FORCES OF IMPENDING ENCIRCLEMENT, WHICH ENABLED KDP TROOPS TO MEET AND DEFEAT TALABANI FORCES. KDP REP ALLEGED THAT ACTION TOOK PLACE IN A LONG NARROW VALLEY WHICH STRADDLES THE TURKISH-IRAQI BORDER. ACCORDING TO KDP REP, 120 DIED AND 200 WERE TAKEN PRISONER BY PESH MERGA.

SUBSEQUENT TO THE BATTLE, TALABANI REPRESENTATIVES ALLEGEDLY WENT TO LONDON TO BARTER WITH LOCAL KDP REPS FOR LIVES OF PRISONERS, ALLEGEDLY OFFERING TO TERMINATE OVERTURES FOR SUPPORT TO FOREIGN GOVERNMENTS IN EXCHANGE FOR THE THE PRISONERS. ENVOYS APPARENTLY FAILED TO ELICIT KDP LONDON'S INTEREST IN THE DEAL, AND IT SEEMS APPARENT THAT 200 PRISONERS WILL NOT BE RELEASED. IN RECOUNTING THIS EVENT, KDP REP STATED IT WAS OBVIOUS IRAN HAS COOPERATED WITH IRAQ BY ALLOWING TALABANI TO MOVE TROOPS ACROSS THE BORDER.

EARLIER SYRIAN SUPPORT FOR TALABANI IS A KNOWN FACT, ACCORDING TO KDP REP, WHO ALSO PREDICTED THAT TALABANI WILL NOT BE ABLE TO CONTINUE AN EFFECTIVE CAMPAIGN, SINCE JUNE BATTLE LEFT HIM WITH ONLY 200 EFFECTIVES.

ALTHOUGH KDP REP MADE FORCEFUL PRESENTATION RECOUNTING DETAILS OF THE CLASH, HIS ALLEGATIONS OF A DEAL WITH THE IRAQI GOVERNMENT, AS WELL AS HIS PROGNOSIS FOR TALABANI'S FUTURE APPEAR TO BE LESS THAN OBJECTIVE. WE WOULD BE INTERESTED IN ANY ADDITIONAL INFORMATION ADDEES TURN UP

YOU CAN INFORM MFA THAT WE BELIEVE SERIOUS EFFORTS ARE UNDER WAY TO FIND A RESOLUTION OF THE PRESENT PROBLEM. AS MFA KNOWS, WE CONTINUE TO BE IN CLOSE AND REGULAR TOUCH WITH ALL CONCERNED QUARTERS, URGING RESTRAINT AND PATIENCE. CHAMOUN HAS BEEN ISSUING SOME STRONG STATEMENTS INDICATING THERE WILL BE NO COMPROMISE WITH THE SYRIANS. HE AND OTHER CHRISTIAN RIGHTISTS APPEAR DETERMINED THAT SYRIAN FORCES WITHDRAW COMPLETELY FROM LEBANON.

AS FOR CHAMOUN'S CLAIMS THAT SYRIA WANTS TO ANNEX LEBANON, YOU SHOULD CAREFULLY POINT OUT THAT WE HAVE BEEN TRYING ALSO TO ASCERTAIN SYRIAN OBJECTIVES. WE DOUBT STRONGLY THAT THEY HOPE TO ANNEX LEBANON OR PART OF THE COUNTRY. SYRIAN LEADERS INSIST TO US AND OTHERS THAT THEY ARE SIMPLY CARRYING OUT THEIR PEACE-KEEPING ROLE IN TRYING TO PRESERVE SECURITY AND LAW AND ORDER ON BEHALF OF THE SARKIS GOVERNMENT. THEY WANT TO END "ARMED MANIFESTATIONS" ON ALL SIDES.

WE BELIEVE THE SYRIANS WOULD LIKE TO LIMIT THE POWER OF THE CHRISTIAN RIGHTISTS AND THEIR MILITIAS BUT PROBABLY RECOGNIZE BY NOW THAT INTERNATIONAL OPINION AND OTHER FACTORS WOULD NOT ALLOW THEM TO GO TO THE MILITARY LENGTHS SUCH AN OBJECTIVE WOULD REQUIRE. THEY HAVE TOLD US THEY ARE NOT SEEKING MILITIA DISARMAMENT, AND SARKIS HIMSELF HAS MADE CLEAR PUBLICLY THAT SUCH DISARMAMENT IS PROBABLY NOT REALISTIC AT THIS TIME.

LEBANESE GOVERNMENT LEADERS SAY TO US THAT THE SYRIANS DO NOT WANT TO CRUSH THE LEBANESE MILITIAS BUT THAT THEY DO WANT TO SEE AN END TO THEIR PROVOCATIONS AGAINST SYRIAN SOLDIERS, AND A CHANGE IN THE POLICIES OF THE CHRISTIAN RIGHTIST LEADERS FROM ONE OF OBSTRUCTIONISM TO SUPPORT FOR SARKIS.

AS FOR THE MURDER OF TONY FRANGIE, WE BELIEVE THAT THIS WAS ONE MORE EPISODE IN THE RECENT STRUGGLE BETWEEN FRANGIE AND THE PHALANGE FOR CONTROL OF TRADITIONALLY FEUDAL NORTH LEBANON. FRANGIE HAS TRADITIONALLY BEEN CLOSE TO SYRIAN LEADERS. WHAT THE MFA FELT WAS A GROWING RAPPROCHEMENT BETWEEN FRANGIE AND SYRIA WAS REALLY AN OUTGROWTH OF FRANGIE'S STRONG OPPOSITION TO PHALANGE EFFORTS TO CONTROL HIS FEUDAL DISTRICT, AND A TURNING AWAY FROM THE ANTI-SYRIAN POSITION OF THE LEBANESE CHRISTIAN FRONT.
THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE MURDER OF TONY FRANGIE MAY HAVE HAD IN MIND DEALING A SIDE BLOW AT SYRIA, BUT THIS PROBABLY WAS NOT THEIR PRINCIPAL AIM.

OUR VIEW IS THAT IRANIANS COULD CONTINUE TO PLAY A HELPFUL ROLE BY STRONGLY COUNSELING RESTRAINT ON THEIR CHRISTIAN CONTACTS, MEANING AN END TO MILITARY PROVOCATIONS. ON THE WHOLE, SYRIANS ARE BEHAVING WITH RESTRAINT. THIS COULD CHANGE IF THE CHRISTIANS MOUNT A MAJOR MILITARY CHALLENGE. THANK THE IRANIANS FOR THEIR PREVIOUS HELPFUL EFFORTS (PARA 2 REFTEL). CHRISTOPHER

AS PROMISED, WE HAVE CHECKED ON TIMING FOR CONGRESSIONAL CONSIDERATION OF INITIALED U.S.-IRAN AGREEMENT FOR PEACEFUL NUCLEAR COOPERATION. ACCORDING TO SENATE PARLIAMENTARIAN'S OFFICE, IF AGREEMENT SUBMITTED BY JULY 22, THERE WOULD BE ADEQUATE TIME FOR 60 DAY PERIOD OF CONTINUOUS SESSION TO ELAPSE BEFORE OCTOBER 7, WHEN BYRD HAS ANNOUNCED CONGRESS WILL ADJOURN SINE DIE. THERE IS NO WAY TO TELL NOW WHETHER CONGRESS WILL MEET ITS OCTOBER 7 DEADLINE OR WILL INSTEAD EITHER ADJOURN A WEEK OR SO LATER OR COME BACK AFTER NOVEMBER 7 ELECTIONS. IF THEY DO NOT MEET OCTOBER 7 DEADLINE, OBVIOUSLY WE HAVE MORE TIME THIS SESSION.

FURTHER, ACCORDING TO SENATE PARLIAMENTARIAN'S OFFICE, COUNTING OF 60 DAYS DOES NOT RPT NOT START FROM BEGINNING WHEN NEW CONGRESS COMESBACK JANUARY 3. RATHER, ONLY DAYS NOT ELAPSED PRIOR TO ADJOURMENTWOULDREMAIN FOR NEW CONGRESS.

DESPITE URGENT CLEARANCE WORK, WE WILL UNFORTUNATELY NOT BE IN A POSITION TO SUBMIT PACKAGE TO PRESIDENT PRIOR TO JULY 22, LET ALONE HAVE RECEIVED AUTHORITY TO SIGN, AND AFTER SIGNING HAVE HAD TIME TO SUBMIT TO CONGRESS. WE ARE NONETHELESS WORKING URGENTLY SO THAT IF CONGRESS' OCTOBER 7 DEADLINE SLIPS, WE WILL HAVE CHANCE OF AGREEMENT COMING INTO FORCE THIS SESSION.

IN REPORTING THIS SITUATION TO IRANIANS, YOU MAY MENTION TO MANSOOR OR TABARI AS AN ASIDE THAT WE HAVE DISCOVERED TWO TYPOGRAPHICAL ERRORS IN TEXT. ON PAGE 8 OF AGREEMENT, LINE 2, LETTER "O" IS MISSING FROM WORD "PURPOSES". ON PAGE 4 OF NOTE, LINE 12, FIRST WORD SHOULD BE "AS" AND NOT "WAS".

1978STATE183940.subject: IRANIAN/FRG PUBLIC STATEMENTS ON NUCLEAR ISSUES

segments.text: ACDA IS IN THE PROCESS OF PREPARING UNCLASSIFIED NUCLEAR PROLIFERATION ASSESSMENT STATEMENT REQUIRED BY CONGRESS IN CONNECTION WITH THE US-IRANIAN AGREEMENT FOR COOPERATION. WE HAVE BEEN UNABLE TO FIND THE EXACT TEXT OF CERTAIN IRANIAN AND FRG STATEMENTS ON MATTERS RELATING TO THE AGREEMENT WHICH WE WOULD LIKE TO HAVE FOR BACKGROUND.

FOR EMBASSY TEHRAN: PLEASE CABLE ASAP FOLLOWING INFORMATION: (A) EXACT TEXT AND CONTEXT OF STATEMENTS MADE BY SHAH THAT ACQUISITION OF NUCLEAR WEAPONS BY ALL OTHER MAJOR STATES IN THE AREA WOULD MAKE IT NECESSARY FOR IRAN TO REVIEW ITS SITUATION VIS-A-VIS NUCLEAR WEAPONS. WE BELIEVE SUCH A STATEMENT MAY HAVE BEEN MADE IN THE CONTEXT OF THE SHAH'S SUPPORT FOR A MIDDLE EAST NUCLEAR-WEAPONFREE ZONE. (B) TEXT OR COMMUNIQUE OF ETEMAD'S COMMENTS ON DOMESTIC FUEL REPROCESSING PLANS AT FEBRUARY 1977 PRESS CONFERENCE REPORTED IN REFTEL.

FOR TEHRAN AND BONN: PLEASE PROVIDE TEXT OF ANY PUBLIC STATEMENTS ON SCOPE OF FRG/IRAN NUCLEAR AGREEMENT, SIGNED JULY 3, 1978, ESPECIALLY WITH REGARD TO POSSIBLE COOPERATION IN THE FIELD OF REPROCESSING AND TIMING OF

DEPARTMENT EXPRESSES APPRECIATION FOR POUCHING OF 20 MAPS AND BOOKLET ON IRAN-PAKISTAN BOUNDARY. MAPS ARE STAMPED SECRET AND CLARIFICATION IS NEEDED AS TO WHETHER OR NOT THEY RETAIN THEIR ORIGINAL CLASSIFICATION OR IF THEY ARE ACTUALLY UNCLASSIFIED.

SENATE PARLIAMENTARIAN'S OFFICE HAS NOW CHANGED VIEW ON WHETHER COUNTING OF 60 DAY PERIOD OF CONTINUOUS SESSION BEGINS ANEW AFTER CONGRESS ADJOURNS SINE DIE. THEY NOW MAINTAIN THAT COUNT STARTS ANEW EACH CONGRESS. SENATE STAFFERS STRONGLY MAINTAIN SAME VIEW AND CITE SENATE REPORT (PAGE 20) WHICH SAYS: "IN CALCULATING A PERIOD OF DAYS OF CONTINUOUS SESSION, THOSE DAYS WHEN EITHER HOUSE IS IN RECESS FOR MORE THAN THREE DAYS ARE NOT COUNTED, AND ANY PERIOD WHICH DOES NOT EXPIRE PRIOR TO SINE DIE ADJOURNMENT MUST BEGIN ANEW AT THE BEGINNING OF THE NEXT CONGRESS." HOUSE PARLIAMENTARIAN'S OFFICE SHARES VIEW THAT COUNTING BEGINS ANEW EACH CONGRESS.
THUS, IF 60 DAYS OF CONTINUOUS SESSION DOES NOT ELAPSE DURING CURRENT SESSION, COUNTING WOULD BEGIN ANEW IN JANUARY WHEN 96TH CONGRESS CONVENES.

FEDERAL JUDGE ON JULY 20 OVERTURNED RULING OF LUBBOCK AUTHORITIES THAT WOULD HAVE RESTRICTED ROUTE OF MARCH OF IRANIAN STUDENTS TO DOWNDOWN AREA. AUTHORITIES WERE OBLIGED TO ISSUE PERMIT FOR ROUTE THAT PASSED HOME PURCHASED BY COL. OVESSI. ON JULY 21, ESTIMATED 450 STUDENTS TOOK PART IN MARCH, PAUSING IN FRONT OF HOME TO CHANT SLOGANS. OTHERWISE DEMONSTRATION PASSED WITHOUT INCIDENT. SPECIAL POLICE PROTECTION WAS ON HAND AT HOME.

COINCIDENTLY, JULY 21 WAS DAY OVESSI HAD PLANNED TO MOVE INTO HOME WITH SMALL HOUSE WARMING PARTY PLANNED FOR THAT EVENING. HE WAS DISSUADED BY LUBBOCK SECURITY ESCORT. CROWN PRINCE AND OVESSI ARE TRAVELING THIS WEEKEND.

WE HAVE BEEN IN CONTACT WITH LUBBOCK MAYOR AND HIS STAFF WHO ARE MOST COOPERATIVE. STUDENTS HAVE REQUESTED PARADE PERMIT FOR AUGUST 18/19, ALTHOUGH THERE ARE REPORTS THAT DEMONSTRATIONS WILL OCCUR WEEKLY DURING CROWN PRINCE-S STAY AT REESE AFB.

MEANWHILE, IT SEEMS PROBABLE THAT PERMIT WILL BE ISSUED HERE FOR IRANIAN STUDENTS TO DEMONSTRATE IN LAFAYETTE PARK AND NEAR IRANIAN EMBASSY ON JULY 25. ROYAL CHILDREN TENTATIVELY SLATED TO DEPART U.S. BEFORE THAT DATE; THERE APPEARS TO BE NO LINKAGE OF DEMONSTRATION TO THEIR PRESENCE.
PERMISSION GRANTED FOR MRS. CHERYL NAY TO ACCEPT EMPLOYMENT UNDER TERMS SPECIFIED BY DEPT. IN SIMILAR CASES IN THE PAST.
PLENARY JULY 12 AFTERNOON HEARD SPEECHS BY AUSTRIA, IRAN, AFGHANISTAN, ILO, UNIDO AND ICC.

THE AUSTRIAN REP OUTLINED THE DILEMMA DEVELOPED COUNTRIES COUNTRIES NOW FACE, WHICH HE CHARACTERIZED AS HAVING TO TAKE BOLD DECISIONS VIS-A-VIS THE WORLD ECONOMIC SITUATION WHILE AT THE SAME TIME BEING RELUCTANT TO UNDERTAKE NEW TASKS IN VIEW OF INTERNAL ECONOMIC DIFFICULTIES. HE NOTED THE U.N. HAS A SPECIAL ROLE OF LEADERSHIP IN THESE TIMES AND THAT THE COW PRESENTS AN OPPORTUNITY FOR THE U.N. TO DEVELOP SUCH LEADERSHIP. AUSTRIA WELCOMED THE ESTABLISHMENT OF THE COW WHICH SHOULD UNDERTAKE AN INTERDISCIPLINARY, INTEGRATED REVIEW OF THE WORLD'S ECONOMIC PROBLEMS.

THE FAILURE OF THE FIRST SESSION OF THE COW COULD BE ATTRIBUTED TO INADEQUATE PREPARATIONS AND CONSULTATIONS BEFORE IT MET WHICH RESULTED IN DIFFERING EXPECTATIONS FROM DIFFERING GROUPS OF COUNTRIES. IT WAS, TO HIS MIND, IMMATERIAL WHETHER THE COW ISSUED DECISIONS, CONCLUDING REPORTS, ETC., WHAT WAS IMPORTANT MUST BE THAT THE COW HAVE MEANINGFUL DISCUSSIONS IN SELECT AREAS WHERE THERE IS ADVANCED EVIDENCE OF THE CONVERGENCE OF VIEWS ARE POSSIBLE - IT MUST WORK TO EXPAND THESE AREAS OF CONVERGENCE INTO BROADER AREAS OF AGREEMENT. HE OUTLINED THE SALIENT PROBLEMS OF THE WORLD'S ECONOMY AS INCREASING PROTECTIONISM.

HE EXPRESSED THE HOPE FOR A BREAKTHROUGH ON THE COMMON FUND NEGOTIATIONS, AND THE NEED TO DEAL WITH ENERGY PROBLEMS (WELCOMING THE CONVENING OF A CONFERENCE ON ENERGY). AUSTRIA ALSO WELCOMED THE OUTCOME OF THE SSOD, STATING THE FOLLOW-UP TO THE CONFERENCE SHOULD BE VIGOROUS TO ENABLE THE UNDERTAKING OF MASSIVE TRANSFERS OF RESOURCES FROM DC TO LDC UNDER "MUTUALLY ADVANTAGEOUS CONDITIONS".

ILO DIRECTOR GENERAL BLANCHARD REGRETTED THE WITHDRAWAL OF THE U.S. FROM ILO AND THE ABSENCE OF ALOOFNESSON THE PART OF OTHER COUNTRIES WHICH HAS FOLLOWED. FINANCIAL DIFFICULTIES BECAUSE OF U.S. WITHDRAWAL HAVE RECESSITATED DEFERRAL OR CUTTING BACK OF MANY PROGRAMS. HE ALSO EXPRESSED HOPE THAT THE ORGANIZATION'S UNIVERSALITY WILL BE RESTORED. ILO HAD TAKEN IMPORTANT ACTIONS WITH RESPECT TO SITUATION IN SOUTHERN AFRICA BY ADMITTING NAMIBIA, HOLDING TWO SPECIAL PLENARY SITTINGS ON APARTHEID, AND INCREASING ASSISTANCE TO NATIONAL . LIBERATION MOVEMENTS. REMAINDER OF HIS SPEECH WAS DEVOTED TO BASIC HUMAN NEEDS CONCEPT. IT IS NOT AN ALTERNATIVE TO THE STRATEGY OF INDUSTRIALIZATION BUT RATHER ADDS A NEW VARIABLE TO IT.
IT IS AN INSTRUMENT TO CREATE ECONOMIC INFRASTRUCTURES AND HENCE EMPLOYMENT. THE SPEECH WAS WELL RECEIVED AND PRESIDENT OF ECOSOC ON BEHALF OF THE COUNCIL GAVE AN APPRECIATIVE STATEMENT AFTER IT.

AMB. FARTASH OF IRAN SPOKE AND CRITICIZED THE COMMITTEE OF THE WHOLE FOR ITS INCONCLUSIVE DISCUSSIONS. IT IS NOT A NEGOTIATING FORUM. INSTEAD COW MUST NOW IDENTIFY THOSE MEASURES OF IDS AND 6TH AND 7TH SPECIAL SESSIONS WHICH ARE YET TO BE IMPLEMENTED AND SHOULD MAKE APPRORIATE RECOMMENDATIONS. FIRST SESSION FAILED AS A RESULT OF DIFFERENCES REGARDING INTERPRETATION OF ITS MANDATE. THIS MUST BE AVOIDED AT NEXT SESSION.
UNIDO DIRECTOR GENERAL KLAUS SPOKE BRIEFLY ON IMPORTANCE OF ENERGY AND CONSERVATION AND PRICING POLICIES TO DEVELOPMENT.

AFGHANISTAN SPEAKER CITED SOME PROGRESS IN WORLD ECONOMIC SITUATION IN 1977 BUT REITERATED THAT NO MAJOR STEPS TOWARDS RECTIFYING GLOBAL IMBALANCE HAD OCCURED. THIS IMBALANCE COULD GENERALLY BE ASCRIBED TO OLD IMPERIALIST WORLD ORDER. FINALLY, LANDLOCKED AND LEAST DEVELOPED COUNTRIES NEEDED PARTICULAR HELP IN FORM OF CONTRIBUTIONS TO SPECIAL FUND, AND IN GRANTING OF RIGHT OF FREE ACCESS TO THE SEA.
INTERNATIONAL CHAMBER OF COMMERCE GAVE USUAL STATEMENT ON IMPORTANCE OF PRIVATE INDUSTRY TO DEVELOPMENT PROCESS. VANDEN HEUVEL UNQUOTE VANCE

1978STATE187844.subject: NAMIBIA/ SAG REJECTS WALVIS BAY RESOLUTION - VORSTER LETTER

segments.text: VORSTER LETTER THE FOLLOWING IS THE TEXT OF PRIME MINISTER VORSTER'S LETTER OF JULY 23 ADDRESSED TO THE FIVE HEADS OF GOVERNMENT AND GIVEN TO THE PRETORIA FIVE BY FOREIGN MINISTER BOTHA THIS EVENING, JULY 23 (SEPTEL). THE LETTER ACKNOWLEDGES RECEIPT OF THE LETTERS OF THE FIVE HEADS OF GOVERNMENT TO VORSTER ON JULY 17 AND IS DEVOTED TO THE WALVIS BAY DRAFT RESOLUTION WHICH WAS GIVEN TO THE SOUTH AFRICAN CHARGE EKSTEEN IN NEW YORK ON JULY 22 AND WHICH VORSTER'S LETTER CATEGORICALLY REJECTS AS A BREACH OF PREVIOUS AGREEMENT AND UNACCEPTABLE. BEGIN TEXT I WISH TO ACKNOWLEDGE RECEIPT OF YOUR LETTER DATED 17 JULY 1978.

HAVING NOTED WITH SERIOUS CONCERN THE CONTENTS OF THE MESSAGE CONVEYED TO MY FOREIGN MINISTER BY THE AMBASSADORS OF THE FIVE ON 15 JULY 1978, I WAS HEARTENED TO RECEIVED YOUR LETTER, WHICH MORE ACCURATELY REFLECTS THE UNDERSTANDING AT WHICH THE SOUTH AFRICAN GOVERNMENT AND THE GOVERNMENTS OF THE FIVE HAD ARRIVED. AS YOU RIGHTLY POINT OUT, THIS UNDERSTANDING WAS, IN THE WORDS OF CANADIAN FOREIGN MINISTER JAMIESON IN THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY ON 25 APRIL 1978, THAT "ALL ASPECTS OF THE QUESTION OF WALVIS BAY MUST BE SUBJECT TO DISCUSSION BETWEEN THE SOUTH AFRICAN GOVERNMENT AND THE ELECTED GOVERNMENT OF NAMIBIA".
YOU GO ON TO STATE THAT YOUR GOVERNMNT CONTINUES TO MAINTAIN THIS VIEW AND HAS RESISTED ALL PRESSURES TO INCLUDE THE QUESTION OF WALVIS BAY AS PART OF THE PROPOSAL.

THROUGHOUT THE MONTHS OF DISCUSSION PRECEDING ACCEPTANCE OF YOUR PROPOSAL I MADE IT CLEAR TO YOUR REPRESENTATIVES THAT I WAS NOT PREPARED TO CONTINUE WITH NEGOTIATIONS FOR A SETTLEMENT OF THE SOUTH WEST AFRICA QUESTION IF THE ISSUE OF WALVIS BAY WERE TO BE INTRODUCED INTO THE NEGOTIATIONS OR IN ANY SETTLEMENT PROPOSAL. YOUR REPRESENTATIVES ACKNOWLEDGED ON MORE THAN ONE OCCASION IN MY PRESENCE THAT THEY ACCEPTED THIS BASIS FOR OUR NEGOTIATIONS. INDEED, DURING THE DISCUSSIONS IN CAPE TOWN IN JUNE 1977 YOUR REPRESENTATIVES CATEGORICALLY AGREED THAT THEY WOULD NOT WISH TO ADDRESS THE SUBSTANCE OF THE QUESTION OF WALVIS BAY.

THEY ACKNOWLEDGED THAT WALVIS BAY WAS NOT PART AND PARCEL OF SOUTH WEST AFRICA, ALLUDING MERELY TO THE POSSIBILITY THAT A CONTROVERSY MIGHT ARISE ABOUT THE ISSUE AT SOME FUTURE STAGE. THEY ACKNOWLEDGED THAT THEY WERE NOT ARGUING AT ALL ABOUT THE POLITICAL AND LEGAL SITUATION IN RESPECT OF WALVIS BAY. YOUR REPRESENTATIVES ACKNOWLEDGED THAT THEY DID NOT DENY THE RIGHTS OF SOUTH AFRICA FROM A LEGAL POINT OF VIEW. I ASKED YOUR REPRESENTATIVES WHETHER THEY MEANT THAT EITHER THE UNITED NATIONS OR THEY THEMSELVES OR ANYBODY ELSE WOULD LAY CLAIM TO WALVIS BAY AS NOT BEING PART OF THE REPUBLIC OF SOUTH AFRICA.

THEY REPLIED IN THE NEGATIVE AND STATED THAT THEY WERE NOT ADDRESSING THE MERITS OF THE CASE. ON THIS, AND ON VARIOUS OTHER OCCASIONS, I ALSO INFORMED YOUR REPRESENTATIVES THAT ANY DISCUSSION OF WALVIS BAY WOULD LEAD TO THE IMMEDIATE TERMINATION OF THE NEGOTIATIONS.

THERE CAN THUS BE NO DOUBT THAT WE AGREED, AND THAT WE CLEARLY AND UNAMBIGUOUSLY AGREED, THAT YOU WOULD TAKE NO STAND ONE WAY OR THE OTHER ON THE ISSUE OF WALVIS BAY. IN THIS CONNECTION, YOU WILL RECALL THAT AT THE TIME OF THE NEW YORK TALKS YOU PROPOSED TO DISPOSE OF THE QUESTION OF WALVIS BAY IN A PARAGRAPH WHICH STATED THAT ACCEPTANCE OF THE PROPOSAL WOULD IN NO WAY PREJUDICE THE TERRITORIAL CLAIMS OF ANY PARTY. HOWEVER, AT THE INSISTENCE OF SOUTH AFRICA IT WAS AGREED TO DELETE EVEN THIS IMPLIED REFERENCE TO THE ISSUE OF WALVIS BAY.

FURTHERMORE, IN ITS RESPONSE TO THE FIVE'S MESAGE OF 22 JUNE 1978 THE SOUTH AFRICAN GOVERNMENT AGAIN DEALT IN SOME DETAIL WITH THE ISSUE OF WALVIS BAY. IT SAID INTER ALIA: "IN REGARD TO WALVIS BAY THE SOUTH AFRICAN GOVERNMENT WISHES TO REMIND THE FIVE GOVERNMENTS THAT IN THE COURSE OF THE EARLIER DISCUSSIONS THE FIVE HAD AGREED THAT THE ISSUE OF WALVIS BAY WOULD NOT FORM PART OF THEIR PROPOSAL, BEING A MATTER WHICH COULD FORM THE SUBJECT OF DISCUSSION ON A VOLUNTARY BASIS BETWEEN SOUTH AFRICA AND THE NEW GOVERNMENT OF SOUTH WEST AFRICA.

AFTER EXTENSIVE CONSULTATION THEY PRESENTED THE SOUTH AFRICAN GOVERNMENT WITH THE TEXT OF A STATEMENT WHICH THEY WOULD MAKE IN THE SECURITY COUNCIL IF THE NEED AROSE. THE TEXT READ AS FOLLOWS: 'THE FIVE NOTED CONFLICTING POSITIONS ON WALVIS BAY. WE ALSO NOTED THAT THE STRENGTH OF FORCES WOULD NOT BE INCREASED. ALSO THE FIVE CONSIDER THAT ALL ASPECTS OF THE QUESTION OF WALVIS BAY SHOULD BE SUBJECT TO DISCUSSION BETWEEN THE SOUTH AFRICAN GOVERNMENT AND THE FUTURE GOVERNMENT OF NAMIBIA. DURING THE TRANSITIONAL PROCESS TH FIVE WOULD EXPECT THAT PROVISIONS WOULD BE MADE TO ALLOW NAMIBIANS OF WALVIS BAY TO PARTICIPATE IN THE POLITICAL PROCESS DESCRIBED IN THE PROPOSAL.'.

THE SOUTH AFRICAN GOVERNMENT POINTED OUT THAT ONLY THE FOLLOWING SENTENCE WAS MATERIAL, I.E. 'THE FIVE CONSIDER THAT ALL ASPECTS OF THE QUESTION OF WALVIS BAY SHOULD BE SUBJECT TO DISCUSSION BETWEEN THE SOUTH AFRICAN GOVERNMENT AND THE FUTURE GOVERNMENT OF NAMIBIA'. THE FIVE, HOWEVER, INDICATED THAT THEY MIGHT HAVE TO USE THE WHOLE STATEMENT IF THIS BECAME NECESSARY. THE SOUTH AFRICAN GOVERNMENT EMPHASIZED THAT THE UNDERSTANDING IN REGARD TO THE HANDLING OF THE WALVIS BAY QUESTION WHICH HAD BEEN REACHED IN GOOD FAITH PLAYED A VERY IMPORTANT PART IN THE SOUTH AFRICAN GOVERNMENT'S ACCEPTANCE OF THE PROPOSAL OF THE FIVE.

INDEED, THE SOUTH AFRICAN PRIME MINISTER INDICATED UNEQUIVOCALLY AT THE TIME THAT IF THERE WERE ANY ATTEMPT TO INTRODUCE THE WALVIS BAY ISSUE INTO THE PROPOSAL, OR TO TRY TO PREJUDGE ANY FUTURE DISCUSSIONS, HE WOULD HAVE HAD TO TERMINATE THE NEGOTIATIONS FORTHWITH. THE FIVE HAD REPEATEDLY ACKNOWLEDGED THAT THEY WERE AWARE OF THIS BASIC POSITION OF THE SOUTH AFRICAN GOVERNMENT.

THE SOUTH AFRICAN GOVERNMENT CONTINUES TO REGARD THE UNDERSTANDING ON WALVIS BAY AS AN IMPORTANT AND MATERIAL PART OF THE PROPOSAL AS A WHOLE, AND ASSUMES THAT THE FIVE WILL HANDLE THIS ISSUE IN THE SECURITY COUNCIL IN THE WAY THEY INDICATED TO US BEFORE OUR ACCEPTANCE OF THEIR PROPOSAL.".

I WOULD ALSO LIKE TO DRAW YOUR ATTENTION TO A COMMUNICATION ADDRESSED TO THE SECRETARY GENERAL ON 2 MAY 1978 BY MY FOREIGN MINISTER. IN REGARD TO THE GEOGRAPHIC EXTENT AND LEGAL POSITION OF SOUTH WEST AFRICA HE POINTED OUT: "FOR OVER THIRTY YEARS THE UNITED NATIONS HAS CONCERNED ITSELF WITH THE QUESTION OF SOUTH WEST AFRICA, A TERRITORY WHOSE GEOGRAPHIC EXTENT HAS THROUGH THE YEARS BEEN CLEARLY DEFINED, ALSO IN DOCUMENTS OF THE LEAGUE OF NATIONS AND THE UNITED NATIONS ITSELF. BASED ON TREATIES WHICH ALSO DEFINE THE BORDERS OF OTHER COUNTRIES IN THE REGION THE TERRITORY'S BOUNDARIES HAVE BEEN INTERNATIONALLY RECOGNISED FOR ALMOST A HUNDRED YEARS.

FURTHERMORE, MOST AFRO-ASIAN AND LATIN AMERICAN COUNTRIES HAVE ACCEPTED THAT COLONIAL BOUNDARIES MUST, UNDER INTERNATIONAL LAW, CONTINUE TO BE THE BOUNDARIES AFTER INDEPENDENCE. MOREOVER, ARTICLE 11 OF THE MANIFESTO ON SOUTHERN AFRICA APPROVED BY THE CONFERENCE OF EAST AND CENTRAL AFRICAN STATES AT LUSAKA, ZAMBIA, ON 16 APRIL 1969 AND ADOPTED BY THE ASSEMBLY OF HEADS OF STATE AND GOVERNMENT AT ADDIS ABABA, 6-10 SEPTEMBER 1969, STATES IN PART: 'AS FAR AS WE ARE CONCERNED THE PRESENT BOUNDARIES OF THE STATES OF SOUTHERN AFRICA ARE THE BOUNDARIES OF WHAT WILL BE FREE AND INDEPENDENT AFRICAN STATES.'.

THIS MANIFESTO WAS WELCOMED BY THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY ITSELF AS RESOLUTION 2505 (XXIV) ON 20 NOVEMBER 1969. NO ENTITY CAN CLAIM THE RIGHT TO ADD TO OR TO DIMINISH THE AREA OF THE FORMER MANDATED TERRITORY OF SOUTH WEST AFRICA. UNDER INTERNATIONAL LAW SOUTH AFRICA HAS SOVEREIGNTY OVER WALVIS BAY. WHATEVER ARRANGEMENT MIGHT BE REACHED BETWEEN SOUTH AFRICA AND A DULY ELECTED GOVERNMENT OF AN INDEPENDENT SOUTH WEST AFRICA, IS A MATTER FOR THESE TWO GOVERNMENTS.".

I INTERPRETED YOUR LETTER OF 17 JULY 1978 AS EXACTLY REFLECTING THIS UNDERSTANDING. IT WAS, THEREFORE, WITH A PROFOUND SENSE OF SHOCK AND AMAZEMENT THAT I LEARNT OF THE INTENTION TO INTRODUCE A RESOLUTION IN THE SECURITY COUNCIL SUPPORTED BY THE FIVE WHICH COMPLETELY NEGATES THIS UNDERSTANDING. MY FIRST REACTION WAS THAT IT COULD NOT POSSIBLY BE TRUE. I STILL BELIEVE THAT IT CANNOT BE TRUE, A BELIEF WHICH IS STRENGTHENED BY THE FACT THAT THE FIVE DID NOT VOTE FOR RESOLUTION 32/9D DECLARING THAT WALVIS BAY IS AN INTEGRAL PART OF SOUTH WEST AFRICA. THE DRAFT RESOLUTION APPARENTLY READS AS FOLLOWS: "RECALLING ITS RESOLUTIONS 385 (1976) AND ....

(1978); REAFFIRMING IN PARTICULAR THE PROVISIONS OF SECURITY COUNCIL RESOLUTION 385 (1976) RELATING TO THE TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY AND UNITY OF NAMIBIA; TAKING NOTE OF OPERATIVE PARAGRAPH 7 OF GENERAL ASSEMBLY RESOLUTION 32/9D WHICH DECLARED THAT WALVIS BAY IS AN INTEGRAL PART OF NAMIBIA
DECLARES THAT THE TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY AND UNITY OF NAMIBIA MUST BE ASSURED THROUGH THE REINTEGRATION OF WALVIS BAY WITHIN ITS TERRITORY
DECIDES TO LEND ITS FULL SUPPORT TO THE INITIATION OF STEPS NECESSARY TO ENSURE EARLY REINTEGRATION OF WALVIS BAY INTO NAMIBIA
DECLARES THAT, PENDING THE ATTAINMENT OF THIS OBJECTIVE, SOUTH AFRICA MUST NOT USE WALVIS BAY IN ANY MANNER PREJUDICIAL TO THE INDEPENDENCE OF NAMIBIA OR THE VIABILITY OF ITS ECONOMY
DECIDES TO REMAIN SEIZED OF THE MATTER UNTIL WALVIS BAY IS FULLY REINTEGRATED INTO NAMIBIA.".

IN DELICATELY BALANCED NEGOTIATIONS OF THE NATURE WE HAVE CONDUCTED WITH YOUR REPRESENTATIVES THE SINGLE FUNDAMENTAL ESSENTIAL TO THE SUCCESS OF THE EFFORT IS GOOD FAITH AND INTEGRITY. IN REGARD TO WALVIS BAY WE ARE CONFRONTED BY A BLATANT REJECTION OF A VITAL PART OF AN AGREEMENT ENTERED INTO IN GOOD FAITH. WALVIS BAY IS UNCHALLENGEABLY PART OF THE TERRITORY OF THE SOVEREIGN STATE OF SOUTH AFRICA. THIS HAS NEVER BEEN SERIOUSLY CHALLENGED BY ANY STATE WITH A LEGAL TRADITION, LEAST OF ALL YOUR OWN. YOUR REPRESENTATIVES HAVE REPEATEDLY AND CONSISTENTLY AGREED THAT WALVIS BAY WOULD BE EXCLUDED FROM THE AMBIT OF THE NEGOTIATIONS AND THE SETTLEMENT PROPOSAL.

IT WAS ON THIS CLEAR UNDERSTANDING THAT SOUTH AFRICA COOPERATED WITH THE FIVE WHICH LENT THEIR GOOD OFFICES TO THE PARTIES TO THE SOUTH WEST AFRICA ISSUE. IT WAS ON THE STRENGTH OF YOUR ASSURANCES THAT MY GOVERNMENT ACCEPTED YOUR PROPOSAL. WHERE DOES THE WORLD STAND IF NO RELIANCE CAN BE PLACED ON THE WORD OF LEADING WESTERN POWERS? HOW RELIABLE ARE ALL THE TREATIES, COMMITMENTS AND AGREEMENTS OF THESE POWERS IF THIS IS TO SERVE AS AN EXAMPLE?

IF THE ABOVE DRAFT RESOLUTION IS, IN FACT, TO BE INTRODUCED AND TO RECEIVE THE SUPPORT OF THE FIVE, IT WOULD MAKE A MOCKERY OF ALL THE DISCUSSION WE HAVE HAD SO FAR. SEEN IN THE CONTEXT OF THE PROPOSAL AS A WHOLE, THE DRAFT RESOLUTION CONSTITUTES AN OBVIOUS ATTEMPT TO CIRCUMVENT THE PROPOSAL ITSELF. CONSEQUENTLY YOUR SUPPORT FOR THE DRAFT RESOLUTION MUST RAISE GRAVE DOUBTS AS TO THE SPIRIT AND MANNER IN WHICH THE FIVE WOULD STAND BEHIND THE PROPOSAL. IT WOULD SO DESTROY CONFIDENCE THAT IT WOULD BECOME IMPOSSIBLE TO COOPERATE WITH THE FIVE IN IMPLEMENTING THEIR PROPOSAL.

ON THE OTHER HAND THE SOUTH AFRICAN GOVERNMENT FOR ITS PART STANDS BY THE PROPOSAL, AS WELL AS ITS UNDERTAKINGS, INCLUDING THOSE IN REGARD TO WALVIS BAY. THE SOUTH AFRICAN GOVERNMENT REMAINS IRREVOCABLY COMMITTED TO A PEACEFUL SOLUTION FOR SOUTH WEST AFRICA. IT WOULD, ACCORDINGLY, HAVE NO OBJECTION TO A RESOLUTION OF THE SECURITY COUNCIL WHICH REFLECTS THE POSITION UPON WHICH WE STAND AGREED IN REGARD TO WALVIS BAY. INDEED, IF THE DRAFT RESOLUTION REFLECTED THE CONTENTS OF YOUR LETTER OF 17 JULY 1978, MY GOVERNMENT WOULD NOT OBJECT TO IT.

HOWEVER, WE CATEGORICALLY REJECT ANY RESOLUTION, SUCH AS THE ONE QUOTED ABOVE, WHICH SEEKS TO PREJUDGE THE ISSUE OF WALVIS BAY AND WHICH UNQUESTIONABLY AMOUNTS TO A SUBSTANTIAL AMENDMENT OF THE WHOLE BASIS ON WHICH MY GOVERNMENT AGREED TO THE PROPOSAL, A FACT KNOWN TO YOU AND ACCEPTED BY YOU.

WE FULLY AGREE THAT THE TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY OF SOUTH WEST AFRICA MUST BE PRESERVED, BUT IN EXACTLY THE SAME WAY AS MUST THAT OF THE REPUBLIC OF SOUTH AFRICA. IF ANY ATTEMPT IS MADE TO MODIFY THE EXISTING SITUATION WORLD-WIDE RELATING TO ENCLAVES OR ISLANDS IN THE IMMEDIATE VICINITY OF THE MAINLAND IN SUCH A WAY THAT THEY ARE REQUIRED TO FORM PART OF THE CONTIGUOUS OR MAINLAND TERRITORY CONCERNED, THEN ALL SUCH ASES MUST BE REVIEW SIMULTANEOUSLY ON A GLOBAL BASIS AND BE DEALT WITH IN THE SAME MANNER.

IF, THEREFORE, THIS IS THE INTENTION, AND THE RESPONSIBLE POWERS ARE WILLING TO SUBMIT TO A NEW ARRANGEMENT THE CASES, FOR EXAMPLE, OF GIBRALTAR, CABINDA, HONG KONG, NORTHERN IRELAND, BERLIN, BELIZE, PANAMA CANAL, GUANTANAMO BAY AND MACAO, TO MENTION ONLY SOME, THEN WE FOR OUR PART WOULD ALSO BE PREPARED TO HAVE THE CASE OF WALVIS BAY EXAMINED ON THE SAME BASIS. . EDMONDSON

WE WOULD LIKE TO INCLUDE IN PACKAGE WE SUBMIT TO PRESIDENT FOR APPROVAL, IRANIAN RESPONSE TO US NOTE, SINCE EXCHANGE OF NOTES TOGETHER WILL CONSTITUTE INTEGRAL PART OF AGREEMENT. WE SUGGEST THAT THE IRANIAN RESPONSE US NOTE, WITH ADDITION OF OPENING AND CLOSING PARAGRAPHS, AS FOLLOWS: BEGIN TEXT. I HAVE THE HONOR TO REFER TO YOUR NOTE DATED TODAY REGARDING THE PROPOSED AGREEMENT FOR COOPERATION BETWEEN THE GOVERNMENT OF THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA AND THE IMPERIAL GOVERNMENT OF IRAN CONCERNING PEACEFUL USES OF NUCLEAR ENERGY, WHICH READS AS FOLLOWS: (TEXT OF US NOTE).

I HAVE THE HONOR TO CONFIRM THAT THE IMPERIAL GOVERNMENT OF IRAN SHARES THE ABOVE UNDERSTANDINGS AND THAT THIS EXCHANGE OF NOTES SHALL CONSTITUTE THE FORMAL RECORD OF THESE MUTUAL UNDERSTANDINGS AND SHALL BE AN INTEGRAL PART OF THE AGREEMENT. .
WE REQUEST YOU CHECK ABOVE TEXT OUT WITH MANZOOR AND CABLE US OKAY OR ANY PROPOSED MODIFICATIONS ASAP.

WE ARE ANXIOUS TO RECEIVE FARSI TEXT (PARA 4-5 OF REFTEL) AT EARLIEST TIME SO THAT WE CAN COMMENCE LANGUAGE COMPARISON. WE INTEND TO UNDERTAKE THIS STEP SEPARATE FROM AND SIMULTANEOUS TO PROCESS OF APPROVING SUBSTANCE

CONGRESSMAN STARK OF CALIFORNIA RECENTLY INTRODUCED AN AMENDMENT TO THE ARMS EXPORT CONTROL ACT. TEXT FOLLOWS. : (A) NO DEFENSE ARTICLES SOLD OR LICENSED FOR EXPORT TO THE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN UNDER THE ARMS EXPORT CONTROL ACT AFTER THE DATE OF ENACTMENT OF THIS ACT MAY BE USED IN THE PERFORMANCE OF ANY DOMESTIC SURVEILLANCE OR POLICE OR OTHER LAW ENFORCEMENT FUNCTION OR IN ANY ACTIVITY CARRIED OUT FOR INTERNAL SECURITY PURPOSES WHICH INVOLVES THE VIOLATION OF INTERNATIONALLY RECOGNIZED HUMAN RIGHTS OR THE SUPPRESSION OF POLITICAL EXPRESSION.

(B) WHENEVER A SALES AGREEMENT IS ENTERED INTO OR AN EXPORT LICENSE IS ISSUED UNDER THE ARMS EXPORT CONTROL ACT INVOLVING THE SALE TO THE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN OF ANY DEFENSE ARTICLES WHICH COULD BE USED FOR INTERNAL SECURITY PURPOSES, THE PRESIDENT SHALL SUBMIT A REPORT TO THE CONGRESS WHICH DESCRIBES
THE DEFENSE ARTICLES TO BE SOLD OR LICENSED, INCLUDING THE QUANTITY AND VALUE OF SUCH ARTICLES THE INTENDED RECIPIENT AND THE INTENDED USERS OF THE DEFENSE ARTICLES; AND

THE ASSURANCES PROVIDED BY THE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN THAT THE DEFENSE ARTICLES WILL NOT BE USED FOR DOMESTIC SURVEILLANCE OR POLICE OR OTHER LAW ENFORCEMENT PURPOSES, WILL NOT BE USED TO VIOLATE INTERNALLY RECOGNIZED HUMAN RIGHTS, AND WILL NOT BE USED TO SUPPRESS POLITICAL EXPRESSION. (C) THE PRESIDENT SHALL PROMPTYLY REPORT TO THE CONGRESS ANY INFORMATION OBTAINED BY THE EXECUTIVE BRANCH WHICH INDICATES THAT THE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN MAY HAVE USED DEFENSE ARTICLES SOLD OR LICENSED UNDER THE ARMS EXPORT CONTROL ACT CONTRARY TO THE ASSURANCES DESCRIBED IN THE REPORT SUBMITTED PURSUANT TO SUBSECTION (B) WITH RESPECT TO THOSE ARTICLES. 1978STATE192281.subject: IRANIAN HUMAN RIGHTS ORGANIZATION AFILLIATES WITH INTERNATIONAL LEAGUE

segments.text: INTERNATIONAL LEAGUE
THE INTERNATIONAL LEAGUE FOR HUMAN RIGHTS, HEADQUATERED IN NEW YORK, HAS ISSUED THE FOLLOWING PRESS RELEASE, DATED JULY 18, 1978

THE INTERNATIONAL LEAGUE FOR HUMAN RIGHTS TODAY (JULY 18, 1978) ANNOUNCED THAT THE IRANIAN SOCIETY FOR THE DEFENSE OF FREEDOM AND HUMAN RIGHTS, FORMED IN LATE 1977 TO PROMOTE CIVIL AND POLITICAL RIGHTS IN IRAN, JOINS NEARLY FORTY GROUPS IN COUNTRIES AROUND THE WORLD AS A LEAGUEAFFILIATED ORGANIZATION. IN ANNOUNCING THE ACTION TAKEN BY THE LEAGUE BOARD ON JUNE 16, 1978, JOSE A.

CABRANES, LEAGUE VICE-PRESIDENT, EXPRESSED THE BOARD'S HOPE THAT "THE LEAGUE AND THE IRANIAN SOCIETY WILL COOPERATE CLOSELY IN WORKING TO PROMOTE HUMAN RIGHTS IN IRAN GUARANTEED BY THE IRANIAN CONSTITUTION AND INTERNATIONAL AGREEMENTS." "OUR HOPE IS THAT AN AFFILIATION WITH THE LEAGUE WILL AFFORD SOME MEASURE OF INTERNATIONAL RECOGNITION AND PROTECTION TO SOCIETY MEMBERS," CABRANES ADDED. IN APRIL 1978, THE HOMES OF THREE MEMBERS OF THE SOCIETY WERE BOMBED, INCLUDING THE HOME OF MR. MEHDI BAZARGAN, A CO-FOUNDER OF THE SOCIETY. A NON-POLITICAL GROUP, THE SOCIETY WAS FORMED BY THIRTY IRANIANS PROMINENT IN ARTISTIC, LEGAL, CULTURAL, AND JOURNALISTIC ENDEAVORS.

IN RECENT MONTHS THE SOCIETY HAS CONDEMNED VIOLATIONS OF RIGHTS IN IRAN. IN A JUNE 28 LETTER TO IRANIAN PRIME MINISTER J. AMOUZEGAR, THE SOCIETY PROTESTED THE "EXTREME VIOLENCE AND CRUELTY" USED BY MILITARY AND POLICE FORCES IN STOPPING A PEACEFUL DEMONSTRATION IN THE CITY OF BABOSAR. THE SOCIETY CONDEMNS "EVERY TYPE OF TRANSGRESSION OF UNIVERSAL RIGHTS AND THE VIOLATION OF INDIVIDUAL RIGHTS," AND, ACCORDING TO THE SOCIETY CHARTER, "WITH ALL THE POWER AND POSSIBILITIES AT OUR DISPOSAL WE WILL STAND TO DEFEND THE INDIVIDUALS, SOCIETIES, AND GROUPS WHOSE HUMAN RIGHTS ARE SUBJECT TO OPPRESSION AND AGRESSION.
THE INTERNATIONAL LEAGUE FOR HUMAN RIGHTS, FOUNDED IN 1942, IS AN INTERNATIONAL NONGOVERNMENTAL ORGANIZATION WHICH SEEKS TO PROMOTE HUMAN RIGHTS WORLDWIDE. END VANCE

ON FRIDAY, JULY 28, EMBOFF MET WITH ANDRE JACOMET TO REVIEW CURRENT STATUS OF THIS SUBJECT. JACOMET SAID THAT A LETTER FROM ZIA TO GISCARD HAD BEEN RECEIVED WHICH WAS LONG, CAREFULLY WRITTEN, OBVIOUSLY PREPARED FOR POTENTIAL RELEASE AND ALLUDED TO THREATS. THE LETTER INSISTED ON A CHANGE IN THE FRENCH DECISION TO CANCEL THE PLANT AS THE FRENCH DECISION TO CANCEL THE PLANT WOULD HAVE A GREAT IMPACT IN PAKISTAN; THE LETTER DID NOT SAY SPECIFICALLY WHAT WOULD HAPPEN IF THE FRENCH DECISION WAS NOT CHANGED.

JACOMET SAID THAT HE HAD PRESENTED HIS RECOMMENDATIONS THROUGH HIS MINISTER TO PRESIDENT GISCARD WHICH WERE ALONG THE FOLLOWING LINES. THE US (NEWSOM) HAS STATED WHAT IT COULD DO TO ASSIST PAKISTAN IN THE FUTURE ONCE THE REPROCESSING PLANT IS OUT OF THE WAY. OTHER COUNTRIES HAVE ALSO INDICATED THAT THEY ARE IN A POSITION TO ASSIST PAKISTAN. JACOMET HAS TOLD THE GOP THAT FRANCE WOULD CANCEL THE CONTRACT BUT HE DID NOT GO INTO MUCH DETAIL ON WHAT FRANCE COULD DO IN COOPERATING WITH PAKISTAN ONCE THE CONTRACT WAS CANCELLED.

THUS, JACOMET PROPOSES AN ENVOY OF PRESIDENT GISCARD SHOULD BE SENT TO ISLAMABAD TO TALK ABOUT THE FUTURE, INCLUDING THE OPPORTUNITIES FOR FRANCE TO ASSIST PAKISTAN IN ITS ECONOMIC AND MILITARY DEVELOPMENT. JACOMET HOPED THAT PRESIDENT GISCARD WOULD MAKE HIS DECISION VERY SOON AS JACOMET FEARS THAT THE GOP WILL MAKE PUBLIC ZIA'S LETTER AND THE FRENCH WOULD BE ILL-PREPARED TO RESPOND IMMEDIATELY. JACOMET NOTED THAT THE FRENCH AMBASSADOR IN ISLAMABAD HAD ADVISED THAT HE FOUND IT VERY DIFFICULT TO IMAGINE THAT ZIA WOULD BE SILENT ON THIS MATTER FOR ANY LENGTH OF TIME.

YOUR IMPERIAL MAJESTY: I HAVE APPRECIATED THE CONVERSATIONS AND CORRESPONDENCE WE HAVE HAD IN THE PAST ON MATTERS OF HIGH CONCERN TO OUR TWO COUNTRIES. I KNOW HOW SERIOUSLY YOU REGARD THE NEED FOR REAL PROGRESS TOWARDS A LASTING SETTLEMENT OF THE ARABISRAEL CONFLICT AND I WISH TO SHARE WITH YOU SOME THOUGHTS ON THE FORTHCOMING MIDDLE EAST MEETING AT CAMP DAVID. WE ARE GRATIFIED THAT PRIME MINISTER BEGIN AND PRESIDENT SADAT HAVE BOTH RESPONDED POSITIVELY TO THE INVITATION TO MEET WITH ME NEXT MONTH IN A MAJOR NEW EFFORT TO ESTABLISH A FRAMEWORK FOR A MIDDLE EAST PEACE SETTLEMENT.

WE HAVE PURPOSELY NOT SET A FIXED DURATION FOR THE TALKS, SCHEDULED TO BEGIN ON SEPTEMBER 6, SO AS TO BE ABLE TO ALLOW AS MUCH TIME AS IS NEEDED FOR OUR EFFORTS TO SUCCEED. THIS IS AN ENCOURAGING INDICATION OF THE SERIOUSNESS WITH WHICH ALL PARTIES ARE APPROACHING THIS MEETING. I EXTENDED THIS INVITATION BECAUSE I BELIEVE WE HAVE REACHED A CRUCIAL POINT IN THE SEARCH FOR PEACE IN THE MIDDLE EAST. NINE MONTHS HAVE PASSED SINCE PRESIDENT SADAT AND PRIME MINISTER BEGIN OPENED SIGNIFICANT NEW POSSIBILITIES FOR NEGOTIATING WITH THE HISTORIC MEETINGS IN JERUSALEM AND IN ISMAILIA.

THE SIDES HAVE MADE PROGRESS TOWARD RESOLVING SOME OF THE ISSUES THAT DIVIDE THEM AT THIS TIME, BUT RECENTLY, AS YOU ARE AWARE, AN IMPASSE WAS THREATENED. I AM CONVINCED THAT WE CANNOT AFFORD AN IMPASSE, SINCE THE POSITIONS WOULD THEN HARDEN AND THE ATMOSPHERE DETERIORATE TO THE POINT WHERE THE PRESENT OPPORTUNITY FOR PEACE COULD WELL BECOME ANOTHER OF THE LOST OPPORTUNITIES THAT HAVE MARKED THE HISTORY OF THIS TRAGIC CONFLICT.

THE OBJECTIVE AT THE CAMP DAVID MEETING WILL REMAIN AS IT HAS BEEN DEFINED BY THE TWO SIDES THEMSELVES IN NEGOTIATIONS THIS YEAR: TO MAKE PROGRESS TOWARD AGREEMENT ON A FRAMEWORK, BASED ON SECURITY COUNCIL RESOLUTION 242, THAT WOULD ALLOW STEADY PROGRESS TOWARD AGREEMENT ON SPECIFIC ISSUES, WITHIN THE CONTEXT OF THE AGREED GOAL OF A STABLE, JUST AND COMPREHENSIVE PEACE. SUCH AN AGREED FRAMEWORK MIGHT HELP TO BRING OTHER PARTIES TO THE CONFLICT INTO THE PEACE NEGOTIATIONS.

OUR EXPERIENCE IN ATTEMPTING TO FACILITATE AND PROMOTE NEGOTIATIONS THIS PAST YEAR HAS DEMONSTRATED THAT IT IS IMPOSSIBLE TO CARRY NEGOTIATIONS BEYOND A CERTAIN POINT ON THE CRUCIAL ISSUES UNLESS THE HEADS OF GOVERNMENT THEMSELVES CAN BE ENGAGED IN A DIRECT EXCHANGE. THIS WAS ONE OF THE CONSIDERATIONS THAT LED ME TO THE DECISION TO EXTEND INVITATIONS TO THE TWO LEADERS TO MEET WITH ME AT CAMP DAVID. OUR OBJECTIVE WILL BE TO ACHIEVE AGREEMENTS AT THE POLITICAL LEVEL WHICH CAN PROVIDE GUIDANCE FOR THE NEGOTIATORS ON THE KEY ISSUES.

I PLAN TO DO EVERYTHING WITHIN MY POWER TO HELP PRESIDENT SADAT AND PRIME MINISTER BEGIN ACHIEVE THE PROGRESS FOR WHICH WE ARE ALL SEARCHING. AS WE MOVE INTO THIS CRUCIAL NEW PHASE OF MIDDLE EAST NEGOTIATIONS I WANTED TO SHARE WITH YOU MY REASONS FOR TAKING THIS STEP AND THOUGHTS ABOUT WHAT WE HOPE TO ACCOMPLISH. I KNOW YOU WILL AGREE WITH MY SENSE OF THE IMPORTANCE OF THESE TALKS, WHICH HOLD THE PROSPECT OF A MAJOR STEP FORWARD, DESPITE THE REAL DIFFICULTIES. I HOPE THAT I CAN COUNT ON YOU FOR UNDERSTANDING AND FULL SUPPORT IN THE TASK ON WHICH WE ARE EMBARKING.

YOU HAVE MET RECENTLY WITH SOME OF THE PARTICIPANTS AND KEY OBSERVERS OF THE NEGOTIATIONS AND I WOULD VALUE YOUR IMPRESSIONS. IRAN'S SUPPORT FOR THE PEACE PROCESS HAS BEEN EXTREMELY VALUABLE AND WE LOOK FORWARD TO CONTINUING COOPERATION IN THE INTEREST OF WORLD PEACE. WITH MY BEST WISHES, SINCERELY

DEPARTMENT BELIEVES THAT IT WOULD BE USEFUL FOR US-UK TO APPROACH SHAH AND REQUEST THAT HE URGE BISHOP MUZOREWA TO GIVE SERIOUS CONSIDERATION TO ATTENDANCE AT AN ALLPARTIES MEETING. IN JULY 9 CONVERSATION SHAH EXPRESSED KEEN INTEREST IN RHODESIAN DEVELOPMENTS TO UNDER SECRETARY NEWSOM AND SAID THAT HE HAD GIVEN LIMITED FINANCIAL SUPPORT TO MUZOREWA AND SITHOLE. OUR UNDERSTANDING IS THAT THE SHAH WOULD WELCOME OUR REQUESTS FOR COOPERATION IN OUR SOUTHERN AFRICAN NEGOTIATING EFFORTS.

ACCORDINGLY, EMBASSY, LONDON IS ASKED TO DISCUSS ON PRIORITY BASIS WITH FCO POSSIBILITY OF A JOINT APPROACH BY US-UK AMBASSADORS TO THE SHAH, OR HIS PRINCIPAL ADVISORS, IN WHICH THE FOLLOWING POINTS WOULD BE MADE

THE SITUATION IN RHODESIA IS DETERIORATING. THE SALISBURY AGREEMENT HAS NOT GAINED THE WIDESPREAD AFRICAN BACKING THAT ITS SUPPORTERS HAD HOPED FOR. THE AMNESTY PROGRAM HAS MET WITH ONLY LIMITED SUCCESS. THE MAJORITY OF THE GUERRILLA FORCES CLEARLY LACK SUFFICIENT CONFIDENCE IN THE EXECUTIVE COUNCIL TO WARRANT GIVING UP THEIR ARMS.

GIVEN THESE CONDITIONS, WE MAY BE APPROACHING A SITUATION OF NO-RETURN. THE INTERNAL PARTIES MAY MOVE FORWARD WITH THEIR PLANS FOR ELECTIONS AND THE INSTALLATION OF A NOMINALLY MAJORITY-RULED GOVERNMENT, WHICH MIGHT PROVE INCAPABLE OF PACIFYING THE COUNTRY OR BOLSTERING THE ECONOMY. THE GUERRILLA LEADERSHIP WOULD PROBABLY STEP UP THE FIGHTING, CONVINCED OF ITS ULTIMATE VICTORY. THE RESULT MIGHT BE A BLACK VS. BLACK CIVIL WAR, WITH GREATER INSTABILITY IN SOUTHERN AFRICA AS A WHOLE, AND FURTHER OPPORTUNITY FOR SOVIET AND CUBAN INTERVENTION.

US-UK BELIEVE THAT IT IS ABSOLUTELY NECESSARY TO BRING THE PARTIES TOGETHER FOR AN ATTEMPT AT NEGOTIATIONS. FOR SEVERAL MONTHS WE HAVE SUGGESTED AN ALL-PARTIES CONFERENCE AS THE BEST MEANS OF FOSTERING THE TYPE OF DIFFICULT NEGOTIATIONS WE HAVE IN MIND.

AT DAR ES SALAAM IN APRIL THE PATRIOTIC FRONT AGREED TO ATTEND SUCH A MEETING. THE MEMBERS OF THE SALISBURY GROUP WERE INITIALLY NEGATIVE. HOWEVER, AS THEY HAVE MORE REALISTICALLY APPRAISED THEIR SITUATION THEY HAVE BECOME LESS OPPOSED. WE ARE NOW SUGGESTING A PRIVATE MEETING OF ONLY THE PRINCIPALS WITH ONE OR TWO AIDES IN A SECLUDED ENVIRONMENT. THE MEETING WOULD BE CHAIRED BY DR. OWEN AND SECRETARY VANCE. SMITH IS WILLING TO ATTEND, AND WE THINK SITHOLE AND CHIEF CHIRAU WOULD GO ALONG AS WELL.

THE PRINCIPAL OPPONENT OF THE ALL-PARTIES MEETING IS BISHOP MUZOREWA. DESPITE SIGNIFICANT SUPPORT FOR SUCH A MEETING AMONG SOME WITHIN HIS OWN PARTY, HE REMAINS GENERALLY NEGATIVE TOWARD THE IDEA. MUZOREWA IS APPARENTLY FEARFUL THAT AN ARRANGEMENT WHICH WOULD BRING THE PATRIOTIC FRONT INTO A SETTLEMENT WOULD FURTHER ERODE HIS POPULAR SUPPORT AND MAKE IT IMPOSSIBLE FOR HIM TO ATTAIN THE POLITICAL POWER HE NOW SEES WITHIN HIS GRASP.

WE HAVE TOLD THE BISHOP THAT HE HAS NOTHING TO LOSE BY ATTENDING AN ALL-PARTIES MEETING, AND THAT IN DOING SO HE WOULD DEMONSTRATE THAT HE IS PREPARED TO LEAVE NO STONE UNTURNED IN HIS SEARCH FOR PEACE. FURTHER, WE HAVE MADE IT CLEAR THAT HE CAN ATTEND WITHOUT PRECONDITIONS. WE ASSUME THAT EACH OF THE PARTIES WILL COME TO THE CONFERENCE TABLE SUPPORTING THEIR OWN PROPOSALS FOR A SETTLEMENT, WHICH, IN HIS CASE WILL BE THE SALISBURY AGREEMENT. WE BELIEVE THAT IT WILL BE NECESSARY FOR ALL OF THE PARTIES TO COMPROMISE. WE SHALL ACCEPT ANY SETTLEMENT, CONSISTENT WITH OUR OWN PRINCIPLES, WHICH IS SATISFACTORY TO THE PARTIES THEMSELVES.

WE BELIEVE THAT A MESSAGE FROM THE SHAH TO THE BISHOP, URGING HIS PARTICIPATION IN AN ALL-PARTIES MEETING MIGHT BE INSTRUMENTAL IN CONVINCING MUZOREWA THAT FURTHER NEGOTIATIONS WITH THE PATRIOTIC FRONT AT AN ALLPARTIES MEETING WOULD BE WORTHWHILE.

1978STATE220088.subject: CONGRESSIONAL INQUIRY: ISFAHAN AND SHIRAZ DEMONSTRATIONS

segments.text: DEMONSTRATIONS
PLEASE PROVIDE A REPORT IN RESPONSE TO THE FOLLOWING LETTER (8/22) RECEIVED FROM CONGRESSMAN FRASER.

I HAVE RECENTLY RECEIVED A REPORT CONCERNING GOVERNMENT ACTION DURING A DEMONSTRATION IN THE IRANIAN CITY OF ISFAHAN ON AUGUST 13. I UNDERSTAND THAT FOUR PERSONS WERE KILLED AND ANOTHER 60 INJURED, AND THAT MARTIAL LAW AND AN EIGHT-HOUR CURFEW HAVE BEEN IMPOSED ON THE CITY FOR ONE MONTH. IT IS REPORTED THAT ON AUGUST 12 IN THE CITY OF SHIRAZ THE POLICE ATTACKED A PEACEFUL ASSEMBLY LEAVING THREE PERSONS DEAD AND HUNDREDS WOUNDED AND ARRESTED, AND THAT ABOUT 400 PERSONS WERE TAKEN TO HOSPITALS IN SHIRAZ IN CRITICAL CONDITION AND WERE REFUSED TREATMENT. FURTHERMORE, THE GOVERNMENT HAS TURNED AWAY EVERY POSSIBLE BLOOD DONOR FOR THOSE REQUIRING TRANSFUSIONS.

I WOULD APPRECIATE IF YOU COULD ASK OUR EMBASSY IN TEHRAN FOR A REPORT ON THESE OCCURRENCES. I WOULD ALSO LIKE TO KNOW WHAT ACTIONS THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT AND THE IRANIAN RED CROSS HAVE TAKEN TO HELP THESE PEOPLE REQUIRING MEDICAL TREATMENT. END .

REFTEL WELL RECEIVED HERE, BUT OWING TO ABSENCES FROM WASHINGTON WE WILL BE UNABLE TO SEND YOU A REPLY IN TIME FOR AUGUST 31 MEETING. WE WILL DO OUR BEST TO GET SOMETHING TO YOU AS SOON AS POSSIBLE THEREAFTER. FURTHER SUGGESTIONS WITH REGARD TO YOUR MEETING WITH HOUEYDA WILL BE FORTH
FROM NEA/IRN. FRIGATE CASE WAS SENT TO CONGRESS FOR 20 DAY REVIEW ON JULY 27 AND FOR 30 DAY NOTIFICATION ON AUGUST 21. NOTIFICATION ACTION ENDS SEPTEMBER 20.

WE SHARE FULLY YOUR ASSESSMENT THAT POLITICAL DEVELOPMENT IN IRAN HAS REACHED A CRITICAL TURNING POINT. IT SEEMS CLEAR THAT PROLONGATION OF SERIOUS URBAN VIOLENCE IS BECOMING INTOLERABLE FOR ALL SEGMENTS OF IRANIAN SOCIETY. THE COUNTRY FACES CHOICE BETWEEN FURTHER LIBERALIZATION LEADING TO FREE PARLIAMENTARY ELECTIONS NEXT YEAR OR HARSH CRACKDOWN ON FULL SPECTRUM OF POLITICAL DISSIDENTS. IT IS DOUBTFUL THAT LATTER COURSE, WHICH COULD CALL IN QUESTION LOYALTY OF ARMY AND SECURITY ELEMENTS, WOULD SUCCEED FOR MORE THAN VERY LIMITED PERIOD. THUS, OUR STRONG PREFERENCE FOR LIBERALIZATION PROGRAM IS, IN ADDITION, ONLY REAL ALTERNATIVE FOR GOI AT THIS JUNCTURE.

WE ALSO AGREE COMPLETELY WITH YOUR VIEW THAT USG SHOULD USE ITS INFLUENCE IN APPROPRIATE WAYS TO PROMOTE LIBERALIZATION PROCESS. YOU HAVE HANDLED THIS SUBJECT IN EXACTLY THE RIGHT WAY IN YOUR TALKS WITH SHAH AND HIS ADVISERS. WE WILL BE SEEKING OTHER OPPORTUNITIES AND MEANS OF GETTING OUR MESSAGE ACROSS.

AGAINST THIS BACKGROUND, WE HAVE FOLLOWING SUGGESTIONS FOR YOUR MEETING WITH HOVEYDA: --INFORM HIM THAT BECAUSE OF IRAN'S VITAL IMPORTANCE FOR THE US, EVENTS ARE BEING WATCHED WITH INTENSE INTEREST AND GENUINE SYMPATHY FOR PROBLEMS WHICH GOI FACES. WE KNOW THAT PRESIDENT, BECAUSE OF PERSONAL RELATIONSHIP HE HAS ESTABLISHED WITH THE SHAH, WILL READ WITH KEEN INTEREST YOUR REPORTS, PARTICULARLY THOSE TRANSMITTING THE SHAH'S VIEWS. --IN EXPRESSING SUPPORT FOR LIBERALIZATION PROGRAM, YOU MIGHT ATTEMPT TO DRAW OUT HOVEYDA -- THE OLD POLITICAL PRO -- ON STATE OF PLANNING FOR BROAD PARTICIPATION IN MAJLIS ELECTIONS.

BELIEVE YOU CAN EFFECTIVELY SHOW OUR SUPPORT FOR LIBERALIZATION BY ADDING TO GENERALIZED USG ENDORSEMENT OF PROGRAM A DISPLAY OF INTEREST IN CONCRETE MEASURES BEING PLANNED. --WE BELIEVE YOU HAVE TAKEN CORRECT APPROACH ON CANARD THAT US IS BACKING SHAH'S OPPONENTS. WE SHOULD CONTINUE TO FACE THIS ASSERTION HEAD ON AND PRESS THOSE WHO RETAIL IT TO GIVE US A BILL OF PARTICULARS THAT WE CAN DEAL WITH. IF REFERENCE IS MADE TO ADMINISTRATION'S HUMAN RIGHTS AND ARMS TRANSFER POLICIES, WE SHOULD PATIENTLY EXPLAIN THESE ARE GLOBAL POLICIES AND IRAN IS NOT BEING SINGLED OUT FOR SPECIAL ATTENTION.

OUR PRESENT INCLINATION IS THAT THIS ISSUE IS BEST HANDLED BY YOU AND THAT WE SHOULD NOT ENGAGE THE PRESIDENT, THEREBY GIVING CHARGE GREATER STATURE THAN IT DESERVES. WE BELIEVE THAT HOVEYDA, WHO IS BOTH POLITICALLY SAVVY AND WILL BE FRANK, WILL BE YOUR MOST USEFUL INTERLOCUTOR ON THIS SUBJECT.
WE LOOK FORWARD TO YOUR REPORT OF CONVERSATION AND ANY ADDITIONAL VIEWS YOU MAY HAVE ON TACTICS. WARM REGARDS, DAVE. CHRISTOPHER

WHAT DO YOU HAVE ON THE SITUATION IN IRAN? IT SEEMS TO BE GETTING RATHER SERIOUS, AND THERE ARE REPORTS OF ABOUT 250 PEOPLE BEING KILLED.

LET ME NOTE FIRST THAT THE SAME CURFEW LAWS THAT APPLY TO IRANIAN CITIZENS APPLY TO OUR PEOPLE AS WELL, WHICH AFFECTS OUR ABILITY TO HAVE TOO MUCH INDEPENDENT INFORMATION. WE HAVE, THEREFORE, ONLY FRAGMENTARY AND INCOMPLETE REPORTS AND CANNOT JUDGE THE SCOPE OR THE MAGNITUDE OF THE DISORDERS. I'M JUST NOT GOING TO BE IN ANY POSITION TO COMMENT OR VERIFY PRESS REPORTS ABOUT IT. WE, OF COURSE, HOPE FOR THE QUICKEST POSSIBLE RESTORATION OF ORDER. THE MARTIAL LAW WHICH PERTAINS ALSO INCLUDES THE CURFEW THAT I MENTIONED, WHICH IS FROM 9 PM TO 5 AM. WE DON"T HAVE ANY REPORTS OF INJURIES TO AMERICANS.

THE THE EMBASSY IS ADVISING CITIZENS TO ACT PRUDENTLY AND TAKE THE NECESSARY PRECAUTIONS THAT THE SITUATION CALLS FOR, INCLUDING AVOIDING CROWDS AND STAYIN AWAY FROM POTENTIALLY TROUBLESOME AREAS. THE AIRPORT IS OPEN, BUT WITH THE CURFEW, ANYONE ARRIVING AFTER 9 PM WILL HAVE TO REMAIN AT THE AIRPORT UNTIL 5 AM THE NEXT MORNING.
HODDING, ARE YOU SAYING THAT AMERICAN DIPLOMATS ARE SUBJECT TO THE CURFEW ALSO?

I'M SAYING THAT ALL PEOPLE IN THAT TERRITORY ARE SUBJECT TO THE CURFEW, AND THAT DOESN'T MEAN THAT YOU CAN'T UNDOUBTEDLY GO TO AN OFFICIAL MEETING WITH SOME KIND OF ESCORT. I'M JUST TALKING ABOUT THE ABILITY TO ROAM THE STREETS IS LIMITED, AS IT IS FOR EVERYBODY.
IS THE UNITED STATES TAKING ANY ACTIONS, DUSTING OFF ANY CONTINGENCY PLANS, IN VIEW OF THE FACT THAT THERE ARE SO MANY AMERICANS THERE AND SO MUCH AMERICAN INVESTMENT AND THAT KIND OF THING?
I DO NOT KNOW OF ANY AND I DO NOT KNOWOF SUCH. YOU KNOW, THERE ARE ALWAYS CONTINGENCY PLANS IN ANY COUNTRY, BUT I KNOW OF NOTHING BEING "DUSTED OFF", AS YOU REFER TO IT.
DO YOU HAVE ANY MATERIAL ON THE SITUATION AS IT IS NOW? ARE YOU CONCERNED? IT IS MORE SERIOUS THAN IN THE PAST?

I THINK I HAVE TO REFER BACK TO WHAT I SAID, WHICH IS: WE SIMPLY ARE NOT IN MUCH OF A POSITION TO JUDGE THE SCOPE OR MAGNITUDE OF THE DISORDERS. WHEN THAT CHANGES I'LL TRY TO BE MORE HELPFUL TO YOU, BUT I DON'T HAVE ANYTHING IN THE WAY OF AN ASSESSMENT THAT

1978STATE228912.subject: THE POLITICAL SITUATION AND THE TITF

segments.text: STATE AND COMMERCE HAVE RECEIVED NUMEROUS CALLS DURING PAST TWO DAYS CONCERNING IMPACT OF POLITICAL SITUATION ON GENERAL BUSINESS CLIMATE. MOST FREQUENT QUESTION CONCERNS WHETHER CURFEW AND MARTIAL LAW WILL CAUSE CANCELLATION OF TEHRAN INTERNATIONAL TRADE FAIR (TITF). EXHIBITORS ARE WORRIED THAT DEMONSTRATION ACTIVITIES MAY EXTEND TO FAIR GROUNDS AND HOTEL AREAS.

IT WOULD BE HELPFUL FOR USDOC AND DEPARTMENT TO HAVE EMBASSY ASSESSMENT IN FORM OF UNCLASSIFIED HAND OUT WE COULD USE TO ALLAY CONCERNS ON PART OF BUSINESS EXECUTIVES AND EXHIBITORS. WOULD APPRECIATE ALSO YOUR VIEWS ON WHETHER BUSINESS TRIPS DURING THIS PERIOD CAN BE

ACCORDING TO PRESS REPORTS, BISHOP MUZOREWA IS PLANNING TRIP TO TEHRAN FROM LONDON THIS WEEKEND. DEPARTMENT WOULD BE INTERESTED IN ANY INFORMATION YOU CAN GET FROM GOI OFFICIALS ABOUT PURPOSE OF VISIT AND MUZOREWA'S FUTURE PLANS.
EMBASSY SHOULD NOT REQUEST MEETING WITH MUZOREWA, BUT SHOULD NOT REFUSE MEETING IF HE REQUESTS ONE.

SHARPLY DISQUIETING DEVELOPMENTS IN IRAN OVER PAST 48 HOURS WERE REVIEWED HERE AFTERNOON SEPTEMBER 8. IT WAS DECIDED THAT SITUATION CALLS FOR EARLIEST POSSIBLE PRIVATE EXPRESSION TO THE SHAH OF CONCERN, SUPPORT AND INTEREST IN HIS VIEWS ON HOW THESE DEVELOPMENTS CAN BEST BE HANDLED. WE CONSIDERED THAT IN THE ABSENCE OF SUCH EXPRESSION OF SUPPORT SHAH MIGHT COME TO FEEL EVEN MORE DEPRESSED AND SUSPICIOUS OF MOTIVES OF U.S. AS WELL AS OTHERS. IN THE CIRCUMSTANCES IT WAS DECIDED TO SEND AN APPROPRIATE ORAL MESSAGE TO THE SHAH FROM THE PRESIDENT TO BE DELIVERED BY AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN. TEXT IS CONTAINED IN FINAL PARAS.

IT WAS ALSO AGREED THAT THE GOVERNMENTS OF SAUDI ARABIA AND JORDAN SHOULD BE INFORMED OF OUR CONCERN, SUPPORT AND INTENDED MESSAGE TO REASSURE THEM THAT WE ARE NOT PASSIVE ABOUT THE SITUATION IN IRAN AND FULLY SHARE THE APPREHENSION WHICH THEY MUST FEEL. JIDDA AND AMMAN MAY CONVEY THIS AS APPROPRIATE. EGYPTIAN AND ISRAELI LEADERS AT CAMP DAVID WILL BE INFORMED. WE UNDERSTAND THAT SADAT HAS ALREADY SPOKEN WITH THE SHAH BY TELEPHONE.

FYI: WE HAVE INFORMED IRANIAN EMBASSY HERE THAT A LARGE PENDING ORDER FOR TEAR GAS HAS BEEN APPROVED FOR EXPORT. WE ARE ADVISING KEY CONGRESSIONAL LEADERS OF OUR ANALYSIS OF THE SITUATION IN IRAN AS BEING QUITE SERIOUS AND OUR IMMEDIATE INTENTIONS REGARDING U.S. RESPONSE. END FYI.

WE WOULD APPRECIATE RECEIVING SAUDI AND JORDANIAN COMMENTS ON THEIR VIEWS OF THE SITUATION IN IRAN, INTENDED COURSES OF ACTION, IF ANY, AND REACTIONS TO OUR INITIAL COURSE OF ACTION. THOSE GOVERNMENTS MAY WISH CONSIDER PARALLEL MESSAGES OF SUPPORT TO THE SHAH.
FOR LONDON: IN RESPONSE TO INQUIRY BY BRITISH EMBASSY (SQUIRES/MUIR), WE CONVEYED THE FOREGOING. IT MAY ALSO BE USED BY YOU AS APPROPRIATE.
FOLLOWING IS TEXT OF PRESIDENTIAL ORAL MESSAGE WHICH AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN SHOULD DELIVER SOONEST TO THE SHAH.

RECENT EVENTS IN IRAN ARE A MATTER OF SERIOUS CONCERN TO ALL OF IRAN'S FRIENDS IN THE U.S. WE ARE DEEPLY SADDENED AT THE LOSS OF LIFE. WE FULLY APPRECIATE THE SERIOUS DIFFICULTIES THAT THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT CONFRONTS AS IT SEEKS TO PURSUE ITS ANNOUNCED AND COMMENDABLE PROGRAM OF POLITICAL LIBERALIZATION.

WE HAVE GREAT CONFIDENCE IN THE SHAH'S ABILITY TO DEAL EFFECTIVELY WITH THE PRESENT SITUATION. WE ARE CONFIDENT THAT HIS LONG EXPERIENCE AND INTENSE DESIRE TO ADVANCE THE WELL-BEING OF HIS PEOPLE WILL GUIDE HIM IN HIS HANDLING OF THE PRESENT DIFFICULTIES. --WOULD APPRECIATE SHAH S EVALUATION OF THE PRESENT - SITUATION.END .
PLEASE TELL THE SHAH THE PRESIDENT WILL TELEPHONE HIM AT 0800 WASHINGTON TIME SUNDAY SEPTEMBER 10.
WE DO NOT PLAN AT THIS STAGE TO MAKE PUBLIC STATEMENT BUT MAY CONSIDER THIS AS A LATER OPTION. CHRISTOPHER

THE WHITE HOUSE SUNDAY AT 4 P.M. LOCAL TIME RELEASED THE FOLLOWING STATEMENT: . THE PRESIDENT CALLED THE SHAH OF IRAN THIS MORNING AND DISCUSSED THE PRESENT SITUATION IN IRAN. THE PRESIDENT REAFFIRMED THE CLOSE AND FRIENDLY RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN IRAN AND THE UNITED STATES AND THE IMPORTANCE OF IRAN'S CONTINUED ALLIANCE WITH THE WEST. (NEW PARAGRAPH) THE PRESIDENT EXPRESSED HIS DEEP REGRET OVER THE LOSS OF LIFE AND HIS HOPE THAT THE VIOLENCE WOULD SOON BE ENDED. HE FURTHER EXPRESSED THE HOPE THAT THE MOVEMENT TOWARD POLITICAL LIBERALIZATION WOULD CONTINUE. UNQUOTE.

FYI, ON BACKGROUND WE ARE TELLING THE PRESS THAT THE PRESIDENT CALLED THE SHAH FROM CAMP DAVID BEFORE DEPARTING FOR GETTYSBURG FOR A SIGHTSEEING TRIP WITH PRIME MINISTER BEGIN AND PRESIDENT SADAT SUNDAY MORNING, AND THAT THE TELEPHONE CALL LASTED 10-15 MINUTES.
ADDRESSEES MAY USE THE FOREGOING AS APPROPRIATE IN CONTACTS WITH GOVERNMENT AND PRESS. CHRISTOPHER
