1978STATE246627.subject: RECENT OPPOSITION EFFORTS IN HUMAN RIGHTS FIELD

segments.text: PASSED GIST OF REFTEL TO BILL BUTLER. HE ASKS THAT YOU CONVEY TO MATIN-DAFTARY INVITATION FOR HIM AND HIS WIFE (IF TRAVELING) TO STAY WITH BUTLER WHILE IN NEW YORK. BUTLER OFFICE TELEPHONE: 212-755-2040.

DURING COURSE OF CONVERSATION, BUTLER MENTIONED VAFARI, LONG-TIME PRIVATE SECRETARY TO MINISTERS OF JUSTICE, AS RIGHT-THINKING CIVIL SERVANT IN KEY POSITION. VAFARI, BUTLER THOUGHT, WOULD BE EXCELLENT EMBASSY CONTACT FOR

PLEASE DELIVER FOLLOWING PRESIDENTIAL LETTER TO THE SHAH: BEGIN TEXT: "YOUR IMPERIAL MAJESTY: I AM VERY PLEASED THAT YOU WERE ABLE TO MEET ON MONDAY WITH AMBASSADOR ATHERTON FOR A DISCUSSION OF THE CAMP DAVID AGREEMENTS. AS YOU KNOW, I VALUE YOUR VIEWS AND HAVE READ WITH GREAT INTEREST AMBASSADOR ATHERTON'S REPORT OF HIS CONVERSATION WITH YOU. I ESPECIALLY APPRECIATE YOUR GOOD WISHES AND EXPRESSION OF SUPPORT FOR OUR EFFORTS TOWARDS PEACE. I WOULD LIKE TO ADD A FEW WORDS OF MY OWN TO WHAT AMBASSADOR ATHERTON HAS SAID.

AS YOU ARE AWARE FROM YOUR READING OF THE FRAMEWORK AGREEMENTS, THEY DO NOT PRETEND TO SOLVE ALL THE PROBLEMS CREATED BY THIRTY YEARS OF CONFLICT BETWEEN ISRAEL AND ITS ARAB NEIGHBORS. OBVIOUSLY, THE PROBLEMS ATTENDANT UPON THE ARAB-ISRAEL CONFLICT ARE FAR TOO DIFFICULT AND COMPLEX TO BE COMPLETELY RESOLVED IN A FEW DAYS OR EVEN A FEW WEEKS. I DO BELIEVE, HOWEVER, THAT THE AGREEMENTS OFFER THE ARAB SIDE THE OPPORTUNITY, THROUGH PARTICIPATION IN A PROCESS IN WHICH THE UNITED STATES WILL REMAIN ACTIVELY ENGAGED, TO ACHIEVE THEIR LONG CHERISHED LEGITIMATE OBJECTIVES.

AT THE SAME TIME THE AGREEMENTS ALSO OFFER ISRAEL THE FULLEST GUARANTEES FOR ITS SECURITY AND THE OPPORTUNITY TO ACHIEVE THE PEACE WITH AND ACCEPTANCE BY ITS ARAB NEIGHBORS THAT HAVE SO LONG BEEN ISRAEL'S GOAL. THE FRAMEWORK AGREEMENTS ARE PRECISELY WHAT THEIR NAME IMPLIES, FRAMEWORKS WITHIN WHICH THE PARTIES CAN WORK TO REACH A JUST, LASTING AND COMPREHENSIVE PEACE. LET ME MAKE CLEAR THAT THE CAMP DAVID AGREEMENTS ARE ONLY A BEGINNING, ALTHOUGH A VERY GOOD ONE I THINK. THE UNITED STATES IS COMMITTED TO REMAIN FULLY ENGAGED AND TO PURSUE ITS EFFORTS UNTIL THE WORK BEGUN AT CAMP DAVID IS CARRIED THROUGH TO ITS CONCLUSION.

IT IS DISTURBING THAT ELEMENTS IN THE REGION HAVE JOINED WITH THE SOVIETS TO OPPOSE THE AGREEMENTS. WE BELIEVE WE MUST STAND FIRM WITH THOSE IN THE REGION WHO ARE PREPARED TO SEIZE THE PRESENT OPPORTUNITY AS THE ONLY REALISTIC WAY TO MOVE TOWARD PEACE. I UNDERSTAND AND FULLY APPRECIATE THE CONCERN THAT YOU EXPRESSED TO AMBASSADOR ATHERTON REGARDING THE DIFFICULT DECISIONS FACING OUR FRIEND KING HUSSEIN. I AM AWARE OF THE QUESTIONS THAT KING HUSSEIN HAS ASKED ABOUT THE CAMP DAVID AGREEMENTS, AND I WELL KNOW THE DIFFICULTIES AND DANGERS THAT A DECISION BY HIM TO JOIN THE NEGOTIATIONS WOULD INVOLVE.

AGAINST THESE, HE MUST WEIGH THE DANGEROUS CONSEQUENCES FOR JORDAN AND ALL OF US IF WE LOSE THE BEST OPPORTUNITY FOR PEACE THAT THE MIDDLE EAST HAS KNOWN, ONE THAT WILL NOT SOON COME AGAIN. IT IS MY PROFOUND HOPE THAT AFTER DUE REFLECTION KING HUSSEIN WILL AGREE TO JOIN THE NEGOTIATIONS FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A WEST BANK/GAZA INTERIM REGIME. I AM CONFIDENT THAT THIS DECISION WILL BE THE RIGHT ONE FOR HIM, FOR THE PEOPLE OF JORDAN, AND FOR THE PALESTINIANS AND ARABS EVERYWHERE. IF HE DOES AGREE TO JOIN HE CAN COUNT ON MY COMMITMENT TO REMAIN AT HIS SIDE UNTIL ALL THE ISSUES ARE SATISFACTORILY RESOLVED.

I KNOW THAT KING HUSSEIN WILL BE WEIGHING THIS MATTER VERY CAREFULLY IN THE DAYS AHEAD AND PERHAPS TAKING COUNSEL WITH HIS FRIENDS. I WOULD DEEPLY APPRECIATE ANY SUPPORT AND ENCOURAGEMENT YOU MIGHT FEEL YOU COULD GIVE HIM TOWARD JOINING THE NEGOTIATIONS. I AM PERSUADED THAT THIS IS THE RIGHT COURSE, THE ONLY ONE THAT CAN BRING BENEFIT TO JORDAN AND TO ALL THE PEOPLES OF THE MIDDLE EAST. SUCH SUPPORT AS YOU MAY FEEL YOU CAN PRIVATELY LEND WITH OTHERS WILL ALSO BE HELPFUL TO OUR SHARED OBJECTIVE OF PEACE.

AS YOU AND I HAVE DISCUSSED IN THE PAST, IRAN AND THE UNITED STATES MUST REMAIN ACTIVELY INVOLVED IN THE SEARCH FOR THE RESOLUTION OF THE MIDDLE EAST CONFLICT WHICH ULTIMATELY HAS A CRITICAL BEARING ON THE STABILITY OF THE REGION AND THE VITAL INTERESTS OF OUR TWO COUNTRIES. THE INTERNAL DIFFICULTIES THAT IRAN IS CONFRONTING REMAIN VERY MUCH IN MY MIND AND I AM PLEASED THAT THE SITUATION APPEARS FURTHER IMPROVED SINCE OUR TELEPHONE CONVERSATION. I SHALL CONTINUE TO FOLLOW WITH INTEREST AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN'S REPORTS OF HIS CONVERSATIONS WITH YOU AND THE PROGRESS IN THE PROGRAMS YOU HAVE SET FORTH. YOU KNOW YOU HAVE MY SUPPORT FOR THESE EFFORTS.
SINCERELY, JIMMY CARTER. ." THERE WILL BE NO SIGNED COPY OF THE LETTER. CHRISTOPHER

1978STATE248420.subject: PROPOSED VISIT OF CONGRESSMAN STEPHEN J. SOLARZ

segments.text: CONGRESSMAN SOLARZ IS PLANNING A TWO-DAY VISIT TO TEHRAN NEXT MONTH, ARRIVING LATE AFTERNOON OCTOBER 15 AND DEPARTING EVENING OCTOBER 17. PRECISE SCHEDULING WILL FOLLOW. CONGRESSMAN WISHES TO LOOK INTO THREE ISSUES

NATURE AND EXTENT OF IRANIAN OPPOSITION AND ITS IMPACT ON IRANIAN INTERNAL STABILITY; (2) IRANIAN MILITARY DEVELOPMENT PLANNING WITH FOCUS ON FUTURE PROCUREMENT OF MAJOR ITEMS FROM THE U.S.; AND (3) QUESTION OF OIL PRICES AND RELATED ENERGY MATTERS. HE WISHES TO GIVE HEAVY EMPHASIS TO FIRST QUESTION.

CONGRESSMAN HAS ASKED FOR PRELIMINARY SUGGESTION DATE AMBASSADOR ZAHEDI WHO PROMISED AN AUDIENCE WITH THE SHAH WOULD BE POSSIBLE. CAN YOU CONFIRM? IN ADDITION, HE PARTICULARLY WOULD LIKE TO MEET WITH SECULAR AND RELIGIOUS OPPOSITION LEADERS (E.G., MINACHI OR ONE OF HIS GROUP OR A MAJLIS MEMBER AND POSSIBLY SHARIAT MADARI OR OTHER PROMINENT RELIGIOUS LEADER). HE HOPES ALSO TO TALK WITH INFORMED IRANIAN OBSERVERS (E.G.

CYRUS GHANI, SHAUL BAKKASH, SAYEED HOSSEIN NASR), PERSONS WHO CAN EXPLAIN GOVERNMENT POLICIES EFFECTIVELY (E.G., HOVEYDA OR AMIR TAHERI -- BOTH OF WHOM SOLARZ MET ON LAST TRIP, -- OR GANGI) AND POSSIBLY ONE PERSON WITH A GOOD FEEL FOR THE ECONOMIC SITUATION (MEHRAN, OR POSSIBLY YEGANEH). HE WOULD ALSO LIKE TO MEET WITH ASTUTE FOREIGN DIPLOMATS, ESPECIALLY AMBASSADOR PARSONS, AND OTHER PERCEPTIVE INDIVIDUALS, E.G., CATHERINE BATESON.
ON MILITARY MATTERS PROBABLY GEN. TOUFANIAN OR IN HIS ABSENCE, MASUMI OR ARDALAN, WOULD BE HIS BEST INTERLOCUTER. ON OIL QUESTIONS, CONGRESSMAN HAD NO SUGGESTIONS, NOR DO WE.
IF EMBASSY DOES NOT FEEL THAT IT CAN APPROPRIATELY ARRANGE APPOINTMENTS WITH RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP, PLEASE LET US KNOW AND WE WILL EXPLORE ALTERNATIVE APPROACHES HERE.

CONGRESSMAN WISHES TO MAKE USE OF EVERY AVAILABLE MOMENT, I.E. WITH WORKING BREAKFASTS, LUNCHES, ETC. HE HOPES EMBASSY CAN PROVIDE BRIEFING SHORTLY AFTER ARRIVAL. (HE WILL BE COMING DIRECT FROM US. ) AID STEPHEN SHOLLOM WILL ACCOMPANY.
FOR TEL AVIV: SOLARZ WILL BE VISITING ISRAEL AFTER HIS STOP IN IRAN AND WOULD LIKE TO MEET WITH FORMER UNOFFICIAL AMBASSADOR TO IRAN URI LUBRANI. WILL HE BE AVAILABLE IN ISRAEL OCTOBER 31-NOVEMBER 5?
WE HAVE REVIEWED PROPOSALS CONTAINED REF (A). WITH EXCEPTION OF ONE POINT (DISCUSSED BELOW), WE AGREE TO RECOMMENDATIONS IN REF (A).

WE CONTINUE TO HAVE DIFFICULTY WITH MATTER RAISED PARA 14 OF REF (B). DESPITE EXPLANATION PARA 14 OF REF (A), WE STILL BELIEVE WORDS "NUCLEAR ARMS" UNNECESSARY IN PERSIAN TEXT. WE NOTE THAT "NON-PROLIFERATION" IS REFERRED TO SEVERAL TIMES IN NOTE WITHOUT BEING MODIFIED BY WORDS "NUCLEAR ARMS" OR SIMILAR CONCEPT. SEE PAGE ONE OF NOTE, PARA 3, LINE 4; PAGE TWO OF NOTE, PARA ONE, LINES 6 AND

THUS, WE WOULD PREFER DELETION OF WORDS "NUCLEAR ARMS". KEY REASON IS FYI IN PARA 14 OF REF (B). IF, NEVERTHELESS, IRANIANS NOT PREPARED TO AGREE TO OUR REQUEST, WE SUGGEST FOLLOWING ALTERNATIVE PERSIAN WORDING: "GHOSTARESHE MAVADDE GHABELE ENFEJARE HASTEI". LITERALLY, THIS PERSIAN TEXT TRANSLATES "DISSEMINATION OF NUCLEAR EXPLOSIVES."

1978STATE249772.subject: VISIT BY GAO TEAM ON FMS PROGRAM

segments.text: MADRID 11015 (NOTAL)

"CASE STUDIES OF MAJOR ARMS SALES" AND "CONTROLS EXERCISED OVER COMMERCIAL ARMS AND MUNITIONS SALES TO FOREIGN BUYERS" ARE THE SAME GAO REVIEW. ONLY ONE GAO TEAM WILL VISIT TEHRAN ON SUBJECT OF US ARMS SALES.

FOCUS OF REVIEW IS AN ASSESSMENT OF THE ADMINISTRATION'S POLICY OF RESTRAINING ARMS TRANSFERS. THE REVIEW IS A CONGRESSIONAL REQUEST BY HOUSE INTERNATIONAL RELATIONS AND SENATE FOREIGN RELATIONS COMMITTEES. THE GAO HAS BEEN SPECIFICALLY REQUESTED TO INCLUDE CASE STUDIES OF RECENT SALES.
CASES SELECTED FOR IRAN ARE "ARMAMENT SUITES" FOR 12 EUROPEAN-BUILD FRIGATES AND AWACS. IN ADDITION, THE GAO WILL EXAMINE THE ADMINISTRATION'S TURNDOWNS, INCLUDING TURNDOWN OF SALE OF F-4G'S.

CASEWORK WILL EMPHASIZE PLAYERS AND ROLES IN THE DECISION MAKING PROCESS LEADING UP TO A SALE AND THE POLICY ISSUES RAISED AS SALE IS CONSIDERED. CASEWORK IN-COUNTRY WILL CONCENTRATE ON EMBASSY/MAAG INVOLVEMENT IN EVENTS LEADING UP TO FORMAL REQUEST FOR LETTER OF OFFER. OBJECTIVE IS TO GAIN COMPLETE UNDERSTANDING OF ARMS SALES PROCESS AND HOW THAT PROCESS IS CHANGING WITH THE CARTER ADMINISTRATION.

SECOND AREA OF INTEREST IS ROLE OF EMBASSY/MAAG IN SECURITY ASSISTANCE PLANNING; THAT IS ANTICIPATING IRANIAN SALES REQUESTS AND MORE RECENTLY OBTAINING, ANALYZING, AND RESPONDING TO THE IRANIAN LONG-TERM REQUEST LIST.

THE THIRD AREA IS THE IMPACT, PROBLEMS, AND SUCCESSES IN IMPLEMENTING A RESTRAINT POLICY. THE GAO HAS BEEN TOLD THAT IRAN IS CONSIDERED TO BE THE "TEST CASE" FOR THE VIABILITY OF THE PRESIDENT'S POLICY. ISSUES TO BE ADDRESSED INCLUDE MAJOR CONSTRAINTS IN IMPLEMENTING POLICY IN IRAN EFFECTIVENESS OF CEILING IN PRODUCING RESTRAINT AND POSSIBLE ALTERNATIVES

CAN RESTRAINT BE BILATERAL; THAT IS, HAVE SALES EFFORTS BY OTHER COUNTRIES INCREASED IN IRAN IMPACT OF RESTRAINT ON OUR RELATIONS WITH IRAN EFFORTS TO CONTROL CONTRACTOR ACTIVITIES THAT MIGHT GENERATE IRANIAN INTEREST IN ARMS MEASURING THE SUCCESS OF RESTRAINT IN IRAN RESULTS OF RESTRAINT ON MAAG RELATIONS WITH IRANIAN MILITARY EXTENT OF MAAG INVOLVEMENT IN IRANIAN MILITARY PLANNING AND SYSTEMS ACQUISITION; AND DOES PL 92-95 HAVE A NEGATIVE IMPACT ON PLANNING ROLE (LOOKING AHEAD).

TEAM IS NOT ANTICIPATING WORK OUTSIDE OF TEHRAN UNLESS SUGGESTED BY MAAG. PRINCIPAL CONTACTS WILL BE EMBASSY POLITICAL/MILITARY AFFAIRS OFFICERS AND MAAG PERSONNEL (SPECIFICALLY THOSE INVOLVED IN NAVY WEAPONS SUITES CASE, THOSE FAMILIAR WITH BACKGROUND OF AWACS SALE, AND THOSE INVOLVED IN PLANNING SYSTEMS ACQUISITIONS ACTIVITIES. GAO TEAM WILL STAY ONLY AS LONG AS NECESSARY TO SATISFY REVIEW OBJECTIVES. GAO TEAM WOULD APPRECIATE OFFICE WITH 3 DESKS IF EASILY AVAILAB6E.OTHER ADMINISTRATIVE NEEDS WILL BE KEPT TO MINIMUM.
FOR MADRID AND JIDDA
GENERAL APPROACH AND QUESTIONS TO BE PURSUED BY GAO TEAM IN SPAIN AND SAUDI ARABIA ARE AS DESCRIBED SUPRA.
A. CASES FOR SPAIN ARE MK-13 GUIDED MISSILE LAUNCHER AND 64 SEASPARROW MISSILES.
B. CASES FOR SAUDI ARABIA ARE F-15 AND SANG MODERNIZATION FOLLOW-ON.
AGAIN, GAO TEAMS WILL STAY ONLY AS LONG AS NECESSARY TO SATISFY REVIEW OBJECTIVES.
GAO TEAM MEMBERS TRAVELING ON OFFICIAL PASSPORTS AND HAVE OBTAINED SPANISH VISAS. FRANKFURT EUROEPEAN REGIONAL OFFICE WILL TELEGRAPH FLIGHT INFORMATION AND SECURITY CLEARANCE DATA ON ITS STAFF. VANCE
WOULD APPRECIATE EMBASSY COMMENTS AND ANY ADDITIONAL INFORMATION BEARING ON SUBSTANCE OF REFERENCED REPORT. CHRISTOPHER

AHI IS MIT PHD (POLITICAL SCIENCE), FORMERLY WITH ISS, NOW ASSISTANT MANAGER OF BANK OMRAN. A RELATIVE OF DR.RAM, AHI COMBINES EXCELLENT ACCESS WITH KEEN INTELLIGENCE AND HAS INTERESTED HIMSELF IN POOR UNDERSTANDING OF USG POLICIES WITHIN UPPER ECHELONS OF GOI AND IDENTIFIED PROBLEM AS "COMMUNICATIONS GAP" BETWEEN ELEMENTS OF GOI AND USG AGENCIES. HE SAYS HE HAS ARGUED WITH IRANIAN ELITE THAT, CONTRARY TO PAST TWO ADMINISTRATIONS, USG POLICIES ARE NOW PRODUCT OF CAREFUL BUREAUCRATIC STUDY AND CONFLICTS BETWEEN OFFICES AND AGENCIES. THIS MEANS DELAYS AND SOMETIMES DECISIONS THAT ARE NOT AS CLEAR-CUT FOR IRAN AS IN THE PAST.

HE WAS TOLD BY "HIGHEST LEVEL" OF GOI TO INVESTIGATE HIS THESIS AND HAS SEEN NUMBER OF OFFICERS IN (MAINLY WORKING LEVEL) AND OUTSIDE OF USG. HE WILL REPORT TO GOI THIS WEEK AND WILL SEEK MEETING WITH AMBASSADOR OR DCM.

BEFORE DEPARTURE, AHI SAID HE WOULD RECOMMEND CREATION OF "AN IRANIAN NSC" WHICH WOULD HAVE PRIMARY PURPOSE OF FACILITATING "INFORMAL COMMUNICATIONS" WITH KEY GROUPS IN EXECUTIVE BRANCH AND CONGRESS. TOLD HIM THAT WE AGREED BETTER UNDERSTANDING ON IRANIAN SIDE WAS NEEDED AND THAT COMMUNICATIONS A PERENNIAL PROBLEM. WE WOULD WELCOME IMPROVEMENTS, BUT EMPHASIZED THAT USG WOULD TAKE NO POSITION IN SUPPORT OF HIS RECOMMENDATION; GOI WOULD HAVE TO DECIDE FOR ITSELF HOW IT WISHED TO ORGANIZE FOR DEALING WITH USG. FURTHER, UNDER NO CIRCUMSTANCES WOULD WE WANT OLD OR NEW ELEMENTS OF GOI TO DEPART FROM ESTABLISHED CHANNELS FOR COMMUNICATIONS.

IT WAS UNREALISTIC TO THINK WE WOULD ALLOW AMBASSADOR TO BE BYPASSED IN AGENCY-TOAGENCY EXCHANGES. HE GOT THE MESSAGE. AHI IS ALSO QUITE REALISTIC ABOUT CAPABILITIES OF IRANIAN EMBASSY IN DEALING WITH EXECUTIVE AND THE HILL.
PLEASE DO NOT BE PUT OFF BY FOREGOING. BELIEVE AHI IS EXCEPTIONAL CONTACT WHO CAN BE VERY USEFUL TO EMBASSY AND HOPE YOU WILL SEE HIM. FOR EXAMPLE.....

DISCUSSED WITH AHI CONGRESSMAN SOLARZ'S INTEREST IN MEETING WITH RELIGIOUS OPPOSITION. AHI VOLUNTEERED FOLLOWING ARRANGEMENT WHICH HE WILL RAISE WITH YOU. HE WILL ASK MAJID TEHRANIAN, HARVARD GRADUATE WHO HEADS IRAN COMMUNICATIONS AND DEVELOPMENT INSTITUTE (ICDI), TO INVITE SOLARZ AND CERTAIN LAY RELIGIOUS LEADERS FOR TEA, POSSIBLY FOLLOWING A TALK BY SOLARZ. (WE TOLD AHI WE DOUBTED SOLARZ WOULD WANT TO LECTURE, BUT HAVE NOT BEEN ABLE TO REACH HIM.) ,CDI IS APPARENTLY NIRT-SUPPORTED AND, HENCE, MEETING COULD NOT BE OPPOSED BY GOI. TEHRANIAN, AHI SAYS, HAS MAINTAINED ACTIVE CONTACTS WITH RANGE OF OPPOSITION FIGURES, INCLUDING RELIGIOUS TYPES.
UNLESS I HEAR DIFFERENTLY FROM YOU TOMORROW, I WILL TRY TO PERSUADE SOLARZ TO ACCEPT THIS PROCEDURE FOR ENCOUNTER

SPOKE TO NORVIL JONES AND CONVEYED GIST OF REFTEL. HE AND SFRC STAFF WILL PUSH FOR DELAY OF AT LEAST 7-10 DAYS ON CHURCH LETTER. DON'T KNOW WHAT POSITION CHURCH WILL TAKE. URGENCY OF LETTER IS ASSOCIATED WITH FEAR IN SOME CONGRESSIONAL CIRCLES THAT DEPSEC DUNCAN WILL CONVEY POSITIVE F-14 DECISION TO GOI. PROPOSED LETTER ASKS THAT CONGRESS BE CONSULTED ALONG SAME LINES AS MIDEAST AIRCRAFT PACKAGE PRIOR TO FINAL DECISION.
MRS. BENSON IS APPEARING BEFORE HIRC GROUP ON WEDNESDAY AFTERNOON FOR DISCUSSION OF ARMS SALES THAT WILL PREDICTABLY GIVE AMPLE ATTENTION TO IRAN AND THE LONG-TERM LIST.

BELIEVE IN ADDITION TO EXCELLENT LINE YOU PROPOSE TO TAKE WITH TOUFANIAN RE MAJOR PROJECT COSTS, YOU COULD APPROPRIATELY ADD THAT STRONG SUPPORT IRAN NOW ENJOYS IN CONGRESS COULD BE ADVERSELY AFFECTED BY DEBATE OVER MAJOR ARMS SALE NEXT SESSION SUCH AS F-14. IN ANY EVENT, THERE IS UNIVERSAL PREFERENCE HERE THAT F-14 ISSUE BE CAREFULLY ADDRESSED BY GOI AGAINST BACKGROUND OF GOI RECONSIDERATION OF PRIORITIES RATHER THAN AS POLITICAL QUESTION BETWEEN

WE SUPPORT LINE YOU HAVE TAKEN WITH PRIME MINISTER AS MOST REASONABLE COURSE IN THESE DIFFICULT CIRCUMSTANCES. WE CLEARLY DO NOT WISH TO INJECT SOVIETS INTO IRANIAN INTERNAL AFFAIRS. NOR DO WE THINK WE AND BRITISH SHOULD BECOME DEEPLY INVOLVED IN QUESTIONS WHICH ARE BASICALLY IRAN'S TO DECIDE. THEREFORE, BELIEVE YOU SHOULD LIMIT YOUR POSITION IN TALKS WITH SHARIF-EMAMI, OCTOBER 4, TO SUGGESTION THAT IT SEEMS BEST FROM ALL POINTS OF VIEW THAT KHOMEINI REMAIN IN IRAQ.
DO NOT BELIEVE AT THIS STAGE WE SHOULD SUGGEST TURKEY AS A SECONDARY PLACE OF EXILE, ALTHOUGH WE MAY WISH TO RECONSIDER THIS WHEN WE HAVE A READING OF IRAQI REACTION TO IRANIAN EMISSARY.

IN YOUR CONVERSATION WITH SHARIF-EMAMI YOU MIGHT ASK HIM IF IRAN CONSIDERS ITS OWN INFLUENCE WITH IRAQ TO BE INSUFFICIENT, WHETHER IRANIANS HAD CONSIDERED ASKING SAUDIS AND POSSIBLY ALGERIANS TO INTERVENE WITH IRAQ IN FAVOR OF SOME ARRANGEMENT WHICH WOULD KEEP KHOMEINI AT NAJAF.

IN ADDITION, YOU MIGHT WISH TO MAKE POINT WITH SHARIF-EMAMI THAT PRESENT OUTBREAK OF DISTURBANCES IN IRAN STEMS FROM EFFORTS TO PUT CLAMP ON KHOMEINI. IT WOULD SEEM IN IRAN'S INTEREST TO AVOID SITUATION IN WHICH KHOMEINI WAS FORCIBLY DETAINED AGAINST HIS WILL IN IRAQ. BETTER ALTERNATIVE MIGHT BE FOR KHOMEINI NOT TO HAVE OTHER PLACE OF REFUGE AND TO BE REQUIRED TO REMAIN IN IRAQ BECAUSE OF LACK OF ALTERNATIVES.

FINALLY, WE UNDERSTAND BRITISH MAY SUGGEST THAT IRANIANS BEGIN TO MOVE QUICKLY TO MEET DEMANDS OF RELIGIOUS LEADERS, PARTICULARLY MODERATE SHARIAT MADARI. BRITISH ALSO WOULD LIKE IRANIANS TO ALLOW SOME CREDIT TO GO TO MODERATE LEADERSHIP AS WAY OF DRAWING FROM KHOMEINI. WE DO NOT HAVE SUFFICIENT APPRECIATION HERE FOR TACTICAL SITUATION IN IRAN AND ARE NOT AT ALL CERTAIN THIS TACTIC WOULD WORK. THEREFORE, WE ARE RELUCTANT TO SUGGEST THAT YOU PUT FORWARD THIS IDEA. WE LEAVE HANDLING OF THIS ASPECT TO YOUR DISCRETION.

FOR LONDON: PLEASE SHARE FOREGOING WITH IVOR LUCAS, HEAD OF ME DEPARTMENT, FCO, ON URGENT BASIS. WE ARE COORDINATING WITH BRITISH EMBASSY HERE, WHICH WE UNDERSTAND MAY BE SENDING CABLE OF INSTRUCTIONS TO TEHRAN. CHRISTOPHER

1978STATE253966.subject: HAMILTON SUBCOMMITTEE HEARING ON ARMS TRANSFERS

segments.text: MRS. BENSON AND GENERAL GRAVES APPEARED FOR ALMOST THREE HOURS, OCTOBER 5, FOR REVIEW OF ADMINISTRATION'S ARMS TRANFER POLICY AND SPECIFIC SALES. IRAN RECEIVED CONSIDERABLE ATTENTION FROM EACH OF THE MEMBERS WHO HAD QUESTIONS AS SUMMARIZED BELOW

CONGRESSMAN FINLEY DEVOTED ALMOST HIS ENTIRE TIME TO INQUIRY INTO FRIGATE SALE AND CRITICAL IMPLICATIONS FOR CEILING CONCEPT. --CONGRESSMAN SOLARZ EXPRESSED DOUBT ABOUT IRAN'S POLITICAL STABILITY AS IT RELATED TO POSSIBLE ACQUISITION OF SOPHISTICATED WEAPONRY. CONGRESSMAN STUDDS WAS CRITICAL OF DEPARTMENT FOR NOT HAVING DEPLORED DEATHS WHICH OCCURREDWITH IMPOSITION OF MARTIAL LAW. HE STRONGLY CRITICIZED ADMINISTRATION'S APPARENT CONTINUING WILLINGNESS TOSELL SOPHISTICATED ARMS TO IRAN UNDER PRESENT CIRCUMSTANCES.

1978STATE254667.subject: UNDERSTANDING ON REPROCESSING APPROVALS UNDER THE US-IRAN PEACEFUL NUCLEAR COOPERATION AGREEMENT

segments.text: DISCRIMINATORY TREATMENT IN THE ACCOMPANYING EXCHANGE OF NOTES AND, PARTICULARLY, ON HOW THIS MIGHT RELATE TO REPROCESSING REQUESTS WHICH THE US MAY HAVE TO APPROVE BECAUSE OF SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES AS OUR EFFORTS IN INFCE AND ELSEWHERE PROCEED TOWARD DEVELOPMENT OF MORE PROLIFERATION-RESISTANT ALTERNATIVES TO REPROCESSING. THIS CONCERN HAS HELD UP OUR INTERNAL REVIEW OF THE SUBJECT AGREEMENT WHICH, AS EMBASSY KNOWS, HAS NOT YET BEEN FORWARDED FOR THE PRESIDENT'S CONSIDERATION.

THIS MATTER HAS COME TO A HEAD IN OUR RECENT REVIEW OF TWO REQUESTS FROM JAPANESE UTILITIES TO TRANSFER USORIGIN SPENT FUEL FROM JAPAN TO THE UK AND FRANCE FOR REPROCESSING. BOTH OF THESE CASES INVOLVE REPROCESSING CONTRACTS WHICH WERE ENTERED INTO BEFORE THE CHANGE IN US POLICY ON REPROCESSING AS ENUNCIATED IN APRIL 1977. THE THREE OTHER RETRANSFER FOR REPROCESSING REQUESTS WHICH HAVE BEEN APPROVED SINCE APRIL 1977 ALSO INVOLVED CONTRACTS PREDATING OUR POLICY.

FYI. PRESIDENTIAL GUIDANCE FOR HANDLING RETRANSFER FOR REPROCESSING REQUESTS DURING THE PERIOD OF INFCE ALLOWS FOR CASE-BY-CASE APPROVALS (A) WHEN THERE IS A CLEAR SHOWING OF NEED (THAT IS, SPENT FUEL CONGESTION) IF THE REQUESTING COUNTRY HAS MADE APPROPRIATE EFFORTS TO EXPAND ITS SPENT FUEL STORAGE CAPACITY, OR (B) WHEN THE REQUEST INVOLVES A CONTRACT PREDATING 1977 IF THE REQUESTING COUNTRY IS ACTIVELY COOPERATING IN EXPLORING MORE PROLIFERATION-RESISTANT METHODS OF SPENT FUEL DISPOSITION AND APPROVAL WOULD DIRECTLY FURTHER MAJOR NON-PROLIFERATION OBJECTIVES. ANY OTHER CASES WOULD BE REFERRED TO THE PRESIDENT.

AS NOTED, THIS IS AN INTERIM MEASURE DURING THE PERIOD OF INFCE OR UNTIL APPROPRIATE NATIONAL OR INTERNATIONAL SPENT FUEL FACILITIES ARE CREATED. MOREOVER, UNDER THIS GUIDANCE, WE WILL CONTINUE TO GIVE PRIMACY TO THE SPENT FUEL CONGESTION TEST IN EVALUATING REQUESTS.

FOUR COUNTRIES HAVE REPROCESSING CONTRACTS WITH THE UK OR FRANCE WHICH PREDATE OUR POLICY: JAPAN, SWEDEN, SWITZERLAND, AND SPAIN. THESE CONTRACTS COVER ABOUT 2,000 TONS OF UNSHIPPED SPENT FUEL, MOST OF WHICH IS JAPANESE. SWITZERLAND AND SPAIN ARE EXPANDING THEIR SPENT FUEL STORAGE CAPACITIES, LARGELY AT OUR URGING IN PREVIOUS APPROVALS, AND THIS SHOULD LIMIT THE NEED FOR RETRANSFERS DURING INFCE. ALSO, IT APPEARS THAT MOST OF THE MATERIAL COVERED BY SPAIN'S CONTRACTS WAS SHIPPED PRIOR TO OUR POLICY. END FYI

BECAUSE THE TWO JAPANESE REQUESTS RECENTLY REVIEWED INVOLVE CONTRACTS FOR REPROCESSING SIGNED PRIOR TO 1977, IT IS OUR VIEW THAT SUCH APPROVALS DO NOT CONSTITUTE A PRECEDENT UNDER THE "COMPARABLE NEEDS" CLAUSE OF THE PROPOSED US-IRAN PEACEFUL NUCLEAR COOPERATION AGREEMENT AND, THUS, WOULD NOT TRIGGER AN IRANIAN RIGHT TO APPROVALS WHEN THAT AGREEMENT CAME INTO FORCE. THE PRESIDENT HAS DIRECTED THAT THIS VIEW BE CONFIRMED IN AN EXCHANGE OF NOTES WITH THE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN. PARA 7 CONTAINS A PROPOSED NOTE TO BE PROVIDED TO APPROPRIATE GOI OFFICIALS.

FYI. WE RECOGNIZE THAT OUR NEGOTIATIONS WITH IRAN IN THIS AREA HIGHLIGHTED OUR NEED TO BE ABLE TO ACT ON SPECIAL CASES WITHOUT AUTOMATICALLY TRIGGERING THE NONDISCRIMINATORY PROVISIONS OF THE US-IRAN AGREEMENT, BUT DID NOT SPECIFICALLY DEFINE PRE-APRIL 1977 REPROCESSING CONTRACTS OR COMMITMENTS AS A CRITERION. SUCH CONTRACTS OR COMMITMENTS CAN, HOWEVER, GIVE RISE TO THE VERY KINDS OF SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WE DISCUSSED WITH IRAN, AS EVIDENCED BY OUR DISCUSSIONS OF TOKAIMURA.

(AS YOU WILL RECALL, FORMER PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR ACKNOWLEDGED THAT THE JAPANESE CASE WAS A SPECIAL SITUATION AND DID NOT CONSTITUTE A PRECEDENT--REFERENCE TEHRAN 8872.) WE ALSO RECOGNIZE THAT THE UNDERSTANDING MAY CAUSE SOME CONCERN IN IRAN, EVEN THOUGH WE BELIEVE IT IS FULLY CONSISTENT WITH THE INTENT OF THE NEGOTIATORS IN FORMULATING THE NONDISCRIMINATORY TREATMENT PROVISIONS IN THE PROPOSED AGREEMENT. MOREOVER, THIS UNDERSTANDING IS AN ESSENTIAL ELEMENT IN APPROVAL OF THE AGREEMENT HERE. THEREFORE, WE WOULD APPRECIATE RESPONSE AS EARLY AS POSSIBLE. IF YOU NEED ANY FURTHER INFORMATION ABOUT DEMARCHE, PLEASE CABLE US BEFORE PROCEEDING. END FYI

PROPOSED NOTE TO GOI FOLLOWS: BEGIN - THE AMBASSADOR OF THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA PRESENTS HIS COMPLIMENTS TO THE IMPERIAL GOVERNMENT OF IRAN AND IS PLEASED TO REFER TO THE PROPOSED AGREEMENT FOR PEACEFUL NUCLEAR COOPERATION BETWEEN THE GOVERNMENT OF THE UNITED STATES AND THE IMPERIAL GOVERNMENT OF IRAN AS INITIALED BY REPRESENTATIVES OF THE TWO GOVERNMENTS ON JULY 11, 1978. IN THIS REGARD, THE GOVERNMENT OF THE UNITED STATES WISHES SPECIFICALLY TO REFER TO THOSE PROVISIONS OF THE PROPOSED AGREEMENT DESIGNED TO ENSURE THAT IT WOULD BE IMPLEMENTED IN A MANNER THAT WOULD NOT DISCRIMINATE AGAINST IRAN'S NUCLEAR ENERGY DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM.
THESE PROVISIONS, AS SET FORTH IN THE PROPOSED EXCHANGE OF NOTES WHICH WILL BE AN INTEGRAL PART OF THE AGREEMENT, ARE IN RELEVANT PART AS FOLLOWS

"RECOGNIZING IRAN'S LEADERSHIP ROLE IN THE FIELD OF NON-PROLIFERATION, THE UNITED STATES INTENDS TO IMPLEMENT THE AGREEMENT IN A WAY THAT ASSURES THAT IRAN AS A MOST FAVORED NATION ENJOYS,INTER ALIA, THE SAME BENEFITS AND OPPORTUNITIES AND FREEDOMS OF ACTION AS MAY BE AVAILABLE TO ANY OTHER PARTY WITH WHICH THE UNITED STATES COOPERATES."

"NOTWITHSTANDING THE PREVIOUS PARAGRAPHS, WHEN THE NEED ARISES FOR IRAN TO ARRANGE FOR DISPOSITION OF ITS SPENT FUEL, IF THE UNITED STATES HAS, SUBSEQUENT TO THE DATE OF ENTRY INTO FORCE OF THIS AGREEMENT, APPROVED THE REPROCESSING OF ANY OTHER COOPERATING STATE'S SPENT FUEL TO ACCOMMODATE THAT STATE'S FUEL CYCLE MANAGEMENT, THE UNITED STATES WOULD APPROVE REPROCESSING OF IRANIAN SPENT FUEL TO MEET COMPARABLE IRANIAN NEEDS, IN THE UNITED KINGDOM, FRANCE, OR OTHER MUTUALLY AGREED STATES UNDER ARRANGEMENTS WHICH PROVIDE IRAN WITH BENEFITS COMPARABLE TO THOSE PROVIDED TO SUCH OTHER STATE AND UNDER TERMS AND CONDITIONS NO LESS FAVORABLE THAN THOSE APPLICABLE TO SUCH OTHER STATE." AS REFLECTED IN THESE PROVISIONS, THE GOVERNMENT OF THE UNITED STATES RECOGNIZES IRAN'S INTEREST IN NONDISCRIMINATORY TREATMENT FOR ITS NUCLEAR ENERGY DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM AND FULLY INTENDS TO IMPLEMENT THE AGREEMENT ACCORDINGLY.

AT THE SAME TIME, THE GOVERNMENT OF THE UNITED STATES NOTES THAT, DURING NEGOTIATION OF THE PROPOSED AGREEMENT, IT WAS RECOGNIZED THAT THE UNITED STATES COULD BE CONFRONTED WITH THE NEED TO APPROVE REQUESTS FOR REPROCESSING INVOLVING SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES. THE GOVERNMENT OF THE UNITED STATES WISHES TO TAKE THIS OPPORTUNITY TO INFORM THE IMPERIAL GOVERNMENT OF IRAN THAT SUCH SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES DERIVE FROM OTHER COUNTRIES' COMMITMENTS ENTERED INTO PRIOR TO THE CHANGE IN UNITED STATES POLICY ON THIS MATTER AS RELATED IN PRESIDENT CARTER'S STATEMENT OF NON-PROLIFERATION POLICY IN APRIL 1977.

THIS WOULD INCLUDE CASES SUCH AS THOSE ASSOCIATED WITH THE TOKAIMURA REPROCESSING FACILITY AND RETRANSFERS OF SPENT FUEL FOR REPROCESSING UNDER CONTRACTS CONCLUDED BEFORE 1977. BASED ON THIS AND THE DISCUSSIONS DURING NEGOTIATION OF THE REFERENCED PROVISIONS, THE GOVERNMENT OF THE UNITED STATES UNDERSTANDS THAT UNITED STATES APPROVAL OF REPROCESSING REQUESTS UNDER SUCH CIRCUMSTANCES -- THAT IS, INVOLVING COMMITMENTS BY OTHER GOVERNMENTS WHICH WERE ENTERED INTO PRIOR TO APRIL 1977 AND WHICH, THEREFORE, ARE NOT COMPARABLE TO FUTURE ARRANGEMENTS-- WOULD NOT CONSTITUTE A PRECEDENT FOR APPROVAL BY THE GOVERNMENT OF THE UNITED STATES OF FUTURE REQUESTS BY THE IMPERIAL GOVERNMENT OF IRAN FOR REPROCESSING.

THE GOVERNMENT OF THE UNITED STATES WISHES TO ASSURE THE IMPERIAL GOVERNMENT OF IRAN THAT THIS UNDERSTANDING IS WITHOUT PREJUDICE TO CONSIDERATION BY THE GOVERNMENT OF THE UNITED STATES OF ANY SUCH REQUEST BY THE IMPERIAL GOVERNMENT OF IRAN ON ITS MERITS. THE GOVERNMENT OF THE UNITED STATES WOULD APPRECIATE CONFIRMATION BY THE IMPERIAL GOVERNMENT OF IRAN THAT IT SHARES THE UNDERSTANDING SET FORTH IN THIS NOTE.

WE PROPOSE FOLLOWING REPLY TO EMBASSY: : THE DEPARTMENT OF STATE, THE DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE AND THE FEDERAL BUREAU OF INVESTIGATION DID NOT OFFICIALLY TRANSMIT TO THE NEW YORK MAGAZINE ANY INFORMATION WHICH WAS CONTAINED IN THE ARTICLE ON IRAN WHICH APPEARED IN THE ISSUE OF SEPTEMBER 18, 1978.

FURTHER, THE DEPARTMENT OF STATE HAS INVESTIGATED THIS MATTER IN WASHINGTON AND TEHRAN AND IS UNABLE TO IDENTIFY ANY OFFICER OF THE DEPARTMENT OF STATE, DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE, OR FEDERAL BUREAU OF INVESTIGATION WHO PROVIDED ANY INFORMATION AS ASSERTED IN THE FOLLOWING PARAGRAPH TAKEN FROM THE ARTICLE IN QUESTION: : THROUGH VARIOUS SOURCES AN INSIDE VIEW OF SAVAK'S SPY APPARATUS IN THE UNITED STATES HAS BEEN OBTAINED. THIS INFORMATION HAS BEEN CHECKED WITH FORMER SAVAKS, WELL-PLACED WESTERN JOURNALISTS, SENATE FOREIGN RELATIONS COMMITTE STAFFERS, AND STATE DEPARTMENT AND FBI SOURCES. NOTHING HAS BEEN INCLUDED FOR WHICH CROSS-CONFIRMATION WAS NOT OBTAINED. END .

WE ARE SURVEYING STATE, JUSTICE AND FBI AND WOULD APPRECIATE YOUR DOING SAME WITH RESPECT TO PERSONNEL AT EMBASSY AND CONSULATES. IF ANY PERSONNEL PROVIDED INFORMATION DIRECTLY OR INDIRECTLY TO NEW YORK MAGAZINE OR AUTHOR OF ARTICLE, PLEASE PROVIDE A STATEMENT DESCRIBING HIS CONTACT. WE WOULD LIKE TO REPLY TO IRANIAN EMBASSY IN TWO WEEKS. VANCE
DEPTOFF HAD 45-MINUTES TELEPHON- CONVERSATION WITH MATIN-DAFTARY WHO WAS UNABLE TO VISIT WASHINGTON. HIGHLIGHTS OF HIS REMARKS FOLLOW

GOI'S BASIC PROBLEM IS THAT IT IS NOT "HONEST" WITH PEOPLE. IT TALKS LIBERALIZATION, BUT PRESENTS BILLS TO MAJLES ON ELECTIONS, PRESS, ASSEMBLY, UNIVERSITIES WHICH ARE QUITE RESTRICTIVE, IN SOME CASE MORE SO THAN PRESENT PRACTICES. UNIVERSITY PROFESSORS, FOR EXAMPLE, HAVE BEEN STRUGGLING FOR YEARS FOR INDEPENDENT MANAGEMENT. UNDER PROPOSED LAW, FREEDOMS THAT SOME UNIVERSITIES NOW HAVE 'OULD BE NULLIFIED BY CREATION OF BOARD THAT EVEN ORDINARY LAYMEN CAN SEE WOULD BE CONTROLLED BY GOI.
GOVERNMENT WAS TRYING WITH NEW LEGISLATION TO ENACT SERIES OF TOUGH LAWS SO THAT WHEN MARTIAL LAW EVENTUALLY LIFTED REGIME WILL, IN FACT, HAVE MEANS OF MAINTAINING TIGHT CONTROLS.
WHEN ASKED WHAT GOI SHOULD DO TO EFFECT NATIONAL RECONCILIATION, MATIN-DAFTARY LISTED FOLLOWING

GENERAL AMNESTY FOR POLITICAL PRISONERS WHICH HE ESTIMATED AT NOT LESS THAN 10,000 PERSONS. GENUINE CRIMINALS SHOULD OF COURSE BE CONFINED, BUT OPPOSITIONISTS, EVEN THOSE WHO HAD ENGAGED IN VIOLENCE AGAINST GOI, SHOULD BE RELEASED. VIOLENCE WAS EXCUSABLE UNDER CONDITIONS RESEMBLING WAR BETWEEN GOI AND PEOPLE.
MEANINGFUL AND MUCH MORE EXTENSIVE CAMPAIGN ON CORRUPTION.
SOCIAL JUSTICE--NARROWING GAP BETWEEN RICH AND POOR AND COMBATTING MAFIA-LIKE GROUPS THAT HAD SPRUNG UP.

PUNISHMENT FOR THOSE OFFICIALS GUILTY OF CRIMES AGAINST POPULATION, I.E., RANDOM KILLING OF DEMONSTRATORS OR KILLING OF PERSONS SEEKING REFUGE IN HOMES OF CLERGY IN QOM AND ISFAHAN. (HE DESCRIBED TORTURE OF THREE YOUTHS IN POLICE VEHICLE DURING DAYLIGHT IN MASHAD BEFORE NUMEROUS WITNESSES WHO SUPPORTED BAR ASSOCIATION COMPLAINT TO LOCAL AUTHORITIES. COMPLAINT FILED IN SEPTEMBER, BUT NO RESPONSE HAD COME FROM GOI. CONSEQUENTLY, POLICE COLONEL WHO DIRECTED BRUTAL TREATMENT WAS MURDERED IN MASHAD FEW DAYS AGO.)

MATIN-DAFTARY REJECTED COMPLETELY THESIS THAT TEHRAN DEMONSTRATIONS JUST PRIOR TO MARTIAL LAW WERE PERHAPS ORGANIZED BY OUTSIDE POWERS. PEOPLE, HE SAID, HAD LEARNED FROM EXPERIENCE HOW TO CONDUCT THEMSELVES, RECALLING THAT IN 1952 POLICE HAD DISINTEGRATED AND FOR THREE DAYS PEOPLE OF TEHRAN HAD DIRECTED TRAFFIC AND MAINTAINED ORDER. DID ANYONE SERIOUSLY THINK THAT FOREIGN AGENTS COULD CONTROL OR DIRECT IRANIANS AT THIS STAGE IN THEIR REVOLT AGAINST GOI?

ASKED WHETHER IN FACT PRESS HAD NOT BECOME MUCH MORE FREE THAN IN RECENT YEARS, MATIN-DAFTARY SAID GOI CENSORSHIP NOW MORE SOPHISTICATED. TRUE, PRESS REPORTED ON NATIONAL FRONT, BUT ONLY WHAT GOI WISHED PUBLIC TO READ. PRESS WOULD SOMETIMES PRINT NATIONAL FRONT RELEASES SIX MONTHS LATE IN DIFFERENT CONTEXT; PR-SS WOULD NOT ALLOW NATIONAL FRONT TO HAVE PRINTED WHAT OPPOSITION WISHED. TIME ON RADIO/TV WERE DENIED NATIONAL FRONT. CLEARLY, THERE COULD BE NO FREE ELECTIONS IF OPPOSITION DID NOT ENJOY ACCESS TO MEDIA EQUAL TO GOI.

DEPTOFF CITED CRITICISM OF SAVAK BY SENATOR JALALINAINI AS EXAMPLE OF GREATER FREEDOM OF EXPRESSION. MATIN-DAFTARY REPLIED NAINI WAS THROWN OUT OF BAR ASSOCIATIO; OFFICE PRECISELY BECAUSE HE CLOSELY FOLLOWED GOI DIRECTIONS. HE HAD NOW BEEN INSTRUCTED TO ATTACK SAVAK IN ORDER TO BUILD HIMSELF UP SO THAT GOI WOULD HAVE ACCEPTABLE CANDIDATES TO STAND FOR ELECTION. REGIME WAS CONSTRUCTING "CHARACTERS OR PLAYERS" FOR ELECTION IT WILL STAGE MANAGE.

ASKED ABOUT SITUATION IN COURTS, HE SAID ABILITY OF LAWYERS TO DEFEND POLITICAL OFFENDERS STILL "NOT FREE, NOT EASY." SPECIAL RULES WERE IMPOSED BY JUDGES TO PREVENT LALYERS FROM SERVING AND CLIENTS WERE INTIMIDATED NOT TO REQUEST LAWYERS.

ASKED WHETHER GOI ARMS PURCHASES REPRESENTED ISSUE WITH OPPOSITION, HE SAID SUBJECT NOT REALLY DISCUSSED IN DETAIL. PRINCIPLE APPLIED THAT GOVERNMENT'S MAJOR EXPENDITURES SHOULD BE DEBATED AND DECIDED BY MAJLES IN CONSTITUTIONAL MANNER. INFORMATION WAS KEPT FROM PUBLIC, WHICH OF COURSE WANTED TO SEE IRAN STRONG; HOWEVER, BECAUSE THERE WERE NO CONSULTATIONS MANY PEOPLE THOUGHT GOVERNMENT WAS WASTING IRAN'S WEALTH ON EXPENSIVE PURCHASES.

BEST ESTIMATE WAS SOME 3000 PERSONS HAD BEEN KILLED BY MARTIAL LAW TROOPS THROUGHOUT TEHRAN ON SEPTEMBER 8. HE DISPUTED GOI RELEASE OF 333 POLITICAL PRISONERS, SAYING NOTHING WAS KNOWN OF ANY OF THEM.
EMBASSY MAY WISH TO COMMENT. VANCE

FOLLOWING IS TEXT OF LETTER DATED OCTOBER 3 DELIVERED TO WHITE HOUSE BY AMBASSADOR ZAHEDI: : DEAR MR. PRESIDENT, I THANK YOU FOR YOUR MESSAGE OF 29TH SEPTEMBER, 1978. IT WAS A PLEASURE FOR ME TO MEET AMBASSADOR ATHERTON WHO GAVE ME A DETAILED REPORT ON THE LATEST DEVELOPMENTS FOLLOWING THE CAMP DAVID AGREEMENTS. ONCE AGAIN, I WISH TO EXPRESS MY DEEP APPRECIATION AND ADMIRATION TO YOU, MR. PRESIDENT, FOR YOUR HIGHLY LAUDABLE AND VALUABLE EFFORTS AIMED AT ESTABLISHING A JUST AND LASTING PEACE IN THE MIDDLE EAST.

IN KEEPING WITH THE PROPOSAL WHICH YOU HAVE MADE WITH REGARD TO HIS MAJESTY KING HUSSEIN OF HASHEMITE JORDAN, I INTEND TO DESPATCH A SPECIAL ENVOY TO AMMAN TO DISCUSS THE VARIOUS ASPECTS OF THE QUESTION WITH HIM. I WILL BE VERY GLAD TO INFORM YOU OF THE OUTCOME OF THIS MEETING AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. IT GIVES ME GREAT SATISFACTION TO WITNESS THE CLOSE COOPERATION BETWEEN THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA AND IRAN IN OUR QUEST FOR PEACE AND IN DEFENDING THE VITAL INTERESTS WHICH WE BOTH SHARE. WITH KINDEST REGARDS, SINCERELY, MOHAMMAD REZA PAHLAVI. END . VANCE

FOLLOWING PARAGRAPHS ARE THOUGHTS OF SOME OF US AT STAFF LEVEL. EMPHASIZE THAT THEY ARE UNCLEARED AND HAVE NO STANDING WHATSOEVER. BELIEVING TIME HAS COME FOR USG TO INTENSIFY ITS EFFORTS TO ASSIST GOI IN COHERENT MANNER, WE WOULD LIKE YOUR VIEWS BEFORE MAKING ANY MOVES. IDEALLY, WE WOULD LIKE TO APPROACH PROBLEM THROUGH COMPREHENSIVE POLICY DOCUMENT AND MAY MOVE IN THAT DIRECTION; FRANKLY, HOWEVER, WE FEAR LEAKS.

WE ARE DEEPLY DISTURBED BY ARRAY OF DIFFICULTIES FACING GOI AND TENDENCY OF EVENTS TO STAY AHEAD OF ITS EFFORTS TO OVERCOME WIDESPREAD PUBLIC DISTRUST AND HOSTILITY. WE ARE NOT IMPRESSED BY CABINET'S HANDLING OF CURRENT PROBLEMS, NOR BY ANALYSIS PUT FORWARD BY HOVEYDA AND ANSARY. IT SEEMS TO US THAT IF REGIME IS TO HALT RAPID EROSION OF ITS REMAINING SUPPORT, IT MUST MAKE RADICAL CHANGES IN ITS APPROACH. PROBABLE EVENTUAL ALTERNATIVE APPEARS TO BE ASSERTION OF INCREASED AUTHORITY BY MILITARY WHICH WOULD PROBABLY NOT HAVE SUPPORT FOR GOVERNING EFFECTIVELY FOR SUSTAINED PERIOD.

IN OUR JUDGMENT, IT IS IMPERATIVE THAT GOI INTRODUCE NEW FACES IN GOVERNMENT. IT IS NOT ENOUGH TO PUNISH SOME WRONG-DOERS FROM PAST. SHAH MUST BRING IN MEN WHO ARE NOT TAINTED BY ASSOCIATION WITH HIS REGIME, BUT WHOSE REPUTATIONS FOR INDEPENDENCE OF MIND, HONESTY AND ABILITY CAN BEGIN TO REVERSE PUBLIC ATTITUDES. PRESENT CABINET HAS STRONG ODOR OF THE PAST AND, IN ADDITION, MAY HAVE BEEN FURTHER DISCREDITED BY ACTIONS (MARTIAL LAW) SINCE IT TOOK OFFICE.

IS IT NOT POSSIBLE FOR GOI TO SWALLOW HARD AND APPOINT A JUSTICE MINISTER WHO COMES FROM RANKS OF REFORMED BAR ASSOCIATION, OR A HIGHER EDUCATION MINISTER WHO IS ACCEPTABLE TO LARGE PART OF UNIVERSITY STAFFS, A COMMERCE MINISTER WHO IS RESPECTED BY BAZAARIS, A MINISTER OF INFORMATION ACCEPTABLE TO JOURNALISTS?

NOT ALL SUCH CHANGES NEED, OR PROBABLY SHOULD, BE MADE AT ONCE. BUT INTRODUCTION IN CABINET OF ONE OR TWO COMPLETELY NEW ELEMENTS COULD PROVIDE A TESTING FOR BOTH SIDES--FOR GOI TO SEE WHETHER POLITICAL SITUATION IS IMPROVED THEREBY AND FOR OPPOSITION TO SEE WHETHER GOI IS SINCERE. IF GOI AMENABLE TO SUCH A NEW APPROACH, IT MIGHT BE KICKED OFF BY NO-HOLDS-BARRED ROUND TABLE CONFERENCE (PROBABLY PRIVATE) WITH OPPOSITION IN WHICH THEY COULD VOICE THEIR DEMANDS AND GOI COULD RESPOND. INTENTION WOULD BE TO ENGAGE OPPOSITION IN POLITICAL PROCESS IN POSITIVE AND MEANINGFUL WAY, DRAWING LEADERSHIP AWAY FROM STERILE PROTESTS.

WE WOULD APPRECIATE YOUR THOUGHTS. IF YOU AGREE THAT TIME HAS COME FOR SUCH BOLDER MOVES, DO YOU BELIEVE YOU COULD APPROPRIATELY AND SUCCESSFULLY ADVANCE THIS LINE OF ARGUMENT (OF COURSE, WITHOUT SUGGESTING SPECIFIC INDIVIDUALS) WITH THE SHAH? WE HAVE RESERVATIONS ABOUT GETTING THIS DEEPLY INVOLVED IN IRANIAN POLITICS WITH THE SUBSTANTIAL RISK THAT ENTAILS--BUT THE RISKS INHERENT IN FURTHER DRIFT ARE ALSO GREAT.

ADDITIONALLY, WE WONDER IF WE SHOULD SUGGEST TO GOI A BROAD PROGRAM OF TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE TO HELP IT RAPIDLY TO SET REFORM MEASURES IN MOTION (E.G. HOUSING, RURAL ELECTRIFICATION, HEALTH)? OUR FIRST CHOICE WOULD BE FOR WORLD BANK OR OTHER INTERNATIONAL INSTITUTION TO SUPPLY TALENT, BUT WE COULD MOBILIZE JOINT COMMISSION FOR USG OR PRIVATE SOURCES OF EXPERTISE. AGAIN, WE WOULD WELCOME YOUR THOUGHTS.

WE ARE CONSIDERING RECOMMENDING THAT THE SECRETARY (AND PERHAPS OTHERS LATER) TELEPHONE THE SHAH TO RESTATE OUR SUPPORT. WE ARE EXAMINING PARALLEL EFFORT ON HILL, BUT IT MAY BE HARD TO MOBILIZE CONGRESSIONAL ENERGIES WHICH ARE FOCUSED ON ELECTIONS. BEFORE PROCEEDING DOWN THIS PATH, WE SHALL AWAIT YOUR VIEWS, PERHAPS AFTER FORTHCOMING AUDIENCE.

WE WERE ESPECIALLY INTERESTED IN TEHRAN 9571 REPORTING BRITISH CONSULTATIONS WITH GOI TO ASSIST A MORE EFFECTIVE CROWD CONTROL PROGRAM. AS YOU ARE AWARE, WE ARE NOW REGULARLY APPROVING ALL NON-LETHAL PURCHASES OF POLICE EQUIPMENT BY GOI. WOULD APPRECIATE YOUR THOUGHTS ON ADDITIONAL STEPS WE MIGHT TAKE. BELIEVE BRITISH ARE BEST ABLE TO TAKE LEAD, BUT PERHAPS WE COULD BACK THEM UP WITH SIMILAR ADVICE/ASSISTANCE TO IRANIANS.

GOI DECISION TO BACK AWAY FROM MAJOR ARMS PURCHASES THIS YEAR WILL SUBSTANTIALLY REDUCE CHANCES OF CORROSIVE DEBATE IN CONGRESS AND THE PRESS. WE WONDER IF THE SHAH WOULD NOT BE WISE TO TAKE A LITTLE CREDIT AT HOME AND ABROAD BY A PUBLIC ANNOUNCEMENT OF HIS DECISIONS. AT SAME TIME, BELIEVE IT IMPORTANT WE SEEK TO RETAIN GOOD WILL OF IRANIAN MILITARY BY DISPLAY OF INCREASED READINESS AT ALL LEVELS TO PROVIDE SUPPORT FOR ONGOING PROGRAMS. WOULD IT BE USEFUL TO SUGGEST ADDITIONAL HIGHLEVEL VISITORS, E.G. FROM AMONG JCS?

WE WOULD PROPOSE THAT MESSRS. BLUMENTHAL AND COOPER NOT PRESS HARD ON THE IRANIANS ON OIL PRICES-A POSTURE THAT IS NOT LIKELY TO PRODUCE POSITIVE RESULTS AND COULD CONVINCE THE GOI WE WERE ANTAGONISTIC TOWARDS IT. WE FEAR THAT OUR CHANCES OF SUCCESS IN MODERATING U.S. POLICY ON OIL WITH RESPECT TO IRAN ARE NOT LARGE. WOULD WELCOME YOUR VIEWS. VANCE

1978STATE257852.subject: ERA DECISION ON PAC-INDO LNG PROJECT

segments.text: PER REFTEL, DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY'S ENERGY REGULATORY ADMINISTRATION (ERA) RECENTLY ISSUED AN OPINION APPROVING THE PRICE ESCALATOR AND CURRENCY EXCHANGE ADJUSTOR PROVISIONS FOR THE PAC-INDO PROJECT WHICH WOULD IMPORT LNG FROM INDONESIA INTO CALIFORNIA. WE WOULD CAUTION POSTS IN COUNTRIES WHERE THERE ARE LNG PROJECTS PENDING OR PROPOSED TO BE VERY CAREFUL IN DRAWING PARALLELS ABOUT THE PROSPECTS OF LOCAL LNG PROJECTS ON THE BASIS OF THIS OPINION. THE OPINION AS WRITTEN MAY BE OF LITTLE RELEVANCE AS A PRECEDENT IN OTHER LNG IMPORT CASES. COMMENTS IN THIS MESSAGE ARE PROVIDED WITHOUT ERA CLEARANCE FOR BACKGROUND PURPOSES AND SHOULD NOT BE COMMUNICATED TO HOST GOVERNMENTS OR LOCAL BUSINESSMEN.

EMPHASIS IN PARA 3 OF REFTEL ON THE "MATERIAL FACTS" OF THIS "PARTICULAR PROJECT" INDICATES THAT THIS OPINION SHOULD NOT BE INTERPRETED AS A PRECEDENT FOR OTHER PROJECTS. THE SPECIAL CONSIDERATIONS INCLUDE CALIFORNIA'S UNIQUE ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENT FOR NATURAL GAS; THE INVERTED BLOCK RATE STRUCTURE USED FOR PRICING GAS IN CALIFORNIA WHICH MEETS SOME OF THE GOALS OF INCREMENTAL COST PRICING; AND PLANS BY THE SAME COMPANIES INVOLVED IN THE PAC-INDO PROJECT TO BRING CURRENTLY EXPORTED ALASKAN LNG INTO THE STATE THROUGH JOINT RECEIVING/ REGASSIFICATION FACILITIES.

THE LOW PRIORITY ASSIGNED TO IMPORTED LNG IN THE RANKING IN PARA 4 OF REFTEL WAS NOT TECHNICALLY REQUIRED AS A PART OF THE OPINION, AND IT IS OUR BELIEF THAT IT WAS INCLUDED PRIMARILY FOR THE BENEFIT OF OTHER APPLICANTS AND POTENTIAL LNG EXPORTERS. THE RANKING IN PARA 4 PARALLELS CLOSELY STATEMENTS MADE BY HIGH LEVEL DOE OFFICIALS IN RECENT DISCUSSIONS OF LNG PROJECTS.

THE CAREFULLY CHOSEN LANGUAGE IN PARA 2 OF REFTEL THAT THE PRICE ESCALATOR FORMULA "SATIFIED SOME CONCERNS" AND "PROVIDES SOME PROTECTION" (EMPHASIS ON SOME) WAS UNDOUBTEDLY INTENDED TO INDICATE THAT THERE REMAINS SUBSTANTIAL ERA RESISTENCE TO ANY LINK THROUGH ESCALATORS WITH OPEC CONTROLLED OIL PRICES, EVEN WITH THE 15 PERCENT MAXIMUM ANNUAL INCREASE CAP. 1978STATE259458.subject: THE BHUTTO CASE AND REGIONAL SECURITY

segments.text: WE HAVE NO QUARREL WITH THE OVERALL THRUST OF REFTEL. IT IS ON TARGET, AND WE LOOK FORWARD TO AN ELUCIDATION OF SAUDI VIEWS WHICH ARE, AS DEPARTMENT KNOWS, VERY INFLUENTIAL HERE IN PAKISTAN.

WE DO, HOWEVER, WISH TO DIFFER WITH THE ESTIMATE IN REFTEL ABOUT THE DEGREE OF DISORDER, ETC. EXPECTED IF THE SUPREME COURT UPHOLDS AND THE GOVERNMENT CARRIES OUT THE BHUTTO DEATH SENTENCE FOR MURDER/CONSPIRACY.

WE HAVE ALREADY SEEN SOME OF THE WUTIVITY BHUTTO'S PARTYMENT HAVE ATTEMPTED IN ORDER TO DRAW ATTENTION TO THE CASE AS IT WINDS DOWN TO A VERDICT. WE WOULD EXPECT A SPASM OF STREET VIOLENCE AND BLOODSHED SHOULD THE SENTENCE ACTUALLY BE CARRIED OUT. BHUTTO STILL IS INDISPUTABLY THE MOST POPULAR FIGURE IN THE LAND; IT SHOULD NOT BE FORGOTTEN, HOWEVER, THAT HE IS ALSO PROBABLY THE MOST DESPISED AND HATED FIGURE IN THE LAND BY THOSE WHO DO NOT LOVE HIM. THERE IS VIRTUALLY NO NEUTRAL GROUND AMONG PAKISTANIS AT LARGE.

OTHER CONSIDERATIONS APART AND PURELY AS A MATTER OF LAW AND ORDER, WE BELIEVE THE GOP HAS DEMONSTRATED ITHKOMMANDS ENOUGH STRENGTH ON ITS OWN AND SUPPORT OF MOST OTHER POLITICAL ELEMENTS IN THE COUNTRY TO DEAL WITH THIS PERIOD WITHOUT LOSING CONTROL. IF BHUTTO IS EXECUTED IN ACCORDANCE WITH A SUPREME COURT JUDBEMENT, THERE WOULD DOUBTLESS BE MORE VIOLENT DISORDERS THAN IF HIS SENTENCE IS REDUCED TO IMPRISOMENT -- BUT THE MAJOR DISORDERS WOULD BE LIMITED IN TIME, PERHAPS A FEW WEEKS.

ON THE OTHER HAND, IF THE SENTENCE IS REDUCED TO IMPRISONMENT, THEN THE INITIAL DISORDERS WOULD PROBABLY BE LESS SHARP BUT WOULD PROBABLY RECUR REPEATEDLY, AND MIGHT LATER CULMINATE IN AN EVEN MORE OMINOUS PERIOD OF VIOLENCE IF BHUTTO AND HIS FOLLOWERS ATTEMPT TO RETURN HIM TO POWER BY FORCE.

THESE REGRETTABLY, ARE THE HARSH DOMESTIC RPT DOMESTIC CONSIDERATIONS THAT PROBABLY WEIGH HEAVILY WITH GOP DECISION-MAKERS. HOPEFULLY COUNTERVAILING INTERNATIONAL FACTORS -- PRESSURES FOR CLEMENCY FROM MANY COUNTRIES INCLUDING THE USG -- WILL BE SEEN BY THE GOP TO BE PARAMOUNT.

WE DO NOT WISH TO MINIMIZE THE DIFFICULT TIMES AHEAD AS PAKISTAN CONTINUES ITS SEARCH FOR LASTING POLITICAL INSTITUTIONS; NOT DO WE WISH TO DISLUTE FOUR STRONG BELIEF THAT FOR MANY REASONS FORMER PRIME MINISTER AND PRESIDENTS SHOULD NOT BE EXECUTED REGARDLESS OFWHETHER ADEQUATE COURT PROCEDURES PRECEDE THE EXECUTIONS, WE DO, HOWEVER, WANT TO QUESTION THE JUDGEMENT THAT THE PRESENT GOVERNMENT AND THE PRESENT POLITICAL SITUATION HERE CANNOT SURVIVE IF BHUTTO IS EXECUTED. HUMMEL UNQUOTE
WOULD APPRECIATE YOUR VIEWS ON TIMING AND HANDLING OF NUCLEAR AGREEMENT, ASSUMING WE ARE ABLE TO GET PAST HURDLES BEFORE US.

AS YOU KNOW, TWO BALLS ARE IN TEHRAN'S COURT -REMAINING TRANSLATION ITEM AND EXCHANGE OF NOTES ON JAPAN. AGREEMENT ITSELF IS STILL LODGED ON SECRETARY SCHLESINGER'S DESK. MR. NYE SPOKE TO HIM RECENTLY ON TWO POINTS OF CONCERN, MFN AND IMPLICATIONS OF RECENT HIGHLY CLASSIFIED REPORTING. NYE ARGUED WE SHOULD PROCEED. SCHLESINGER AGREED TO TAKE DECISION BEFORE LEAVING FOR CHINA ABOUT OCTOBER 21.

IF HIS POSITION IS POSITIVE, WE MAY, OF COURSE, THEN FACE A HURDLE AT THE WHITE HOUSE, BUT THERE ARE NO REPEAT NO SIGNS OF THAT AT THIS TIME. SIMILARLY, SOME IN THIS BUILDING (S/P) MAY RAISE QUESTION WHETHER WE SHOULD ADVISE SECRETARY TO SEND AGREEMENT TO THE PRESIDENT NOW.

AGAINST THIS BACKGROUND, WOULD APPRECIATE YOUR ASSESSMENT OF POLITICAL UTILITY OF SIGNING AGREEMENT SOME TIME BEFORE IT CAN BE SUBMITTED TO CONGRESS IN JANUARY OR FEBRUARY. FROM THIS DISTANCE, I WONDER, WITH IRAN SO DISTRACTED WITH PRESENT TURMOIL, WHETHER ANNOUNCEMENT AT THIS MOMENT (OR SIMILAR MOMENT IN THE FUTURE) WOULD HAVE EFFECTIVE IMPACT? SECONDLY, WITH IRANIAN DECISIONS ON NUCLEAR PLANTS IN APPARENT STATE OF FLUX (IF DEFINITE DECISION AGAINST MORE PLANTS HAS NOT, IN FACT, BEEN TAKEN), WOULD IT NOW SEEM WE WERE TRYING TO MUSCLE GOI INTO HOLDING PLANTS FOR US FIRMS?

MY INCLINATION, SINCE CONGRESSIONAL NOTIFICATION IS FORECLOSED, WOULD BE TO WAIT UNTIL DEGREE OF CALM IS ESTABLISHED IN TEHRAN AND PICK CAREFULLY MOMENT OF SIGNING TO ACHIEVE MAXIMUM EFFECT AS GESTURE OF POLITI

SENIOR REPRESENTATIVES OF BOY SCOUTS OF AMERICA (BSA) MET ON OCTOBER 16 WITH SY AND NEA/IRN TO REVIEW PROSPECTS FOR JAMBOREE AT NISHAPUR, JULY 1979. PRESENT PLANS ARE THAT ABOUT 2500 AMERICAN SCOUTS WOULD ATTEND, ALTHOUGH OWING TO HIGH EXPENSE AND UNCERTAIN CONDITIONS IN IRAN, ONLY ABOUT ONE-HALF THAT NUMBER HAVE NOW SIGNED UP AND BSA IS NOT SURE THEY WILL REACH ORIGINAL TARGET.

BSA COUNCIL MEETS ON OCTOBER 19 TO ADDRESS QUESTION OF US PARTICIPATION IN JAMBOREE. IF US DECIDES NOT TO PARTICIPATE, PROSPECT IS THAT JAMBOREE WILL NOT TAKE PLACE. BSA IS VERY WORRIED ABOUT IRANIAN INTERNAL CONDITIONS AT THE TIME OF JAMBOREE, AND, TO SOMEWHAT LESSER EXTENT, ABOUT CRITICISM FROM HUMAN RIGHTS GROUPS AND PROBLEM OF AIR CHARTER ARRANGEMENTS (DCM NAAS IS FAMILIAR). BSA MUST MAKE COMMITMENTS FOR TRAVEL ARRANGEMENTS WITHIN A MATTER OF FEW WEEKS AND IF JAMBOREE IS SUBSEQUENTLY CANCELLED, COULD STAND TO LOSE UPWARDS OF DOLLARS 200 THOUSAND. BSA HAS NOT BEEN ABLE TO OBTAIN CANCELLATION INSURANCE FROM ANY INTERNATIONAL FIRM.

IN RESPONSE TO QUESTIONS DEPOFF SUMMARIZED CURRENT POLITICAL SITUATION IN IRAN AND MAJOR EVENTS WHICH LIE AHEAD, I.E. MOHARRAM, END OF MARTIAL LAW, AND ELECTIONS. HE GAVE OPINION THAT AMERICAN SCOUTS WOULD NOT FACE DANGEROUS SECURITY SITUATION IN IRAN, THAT OPPOSITION ELEMENTS, EVEN TERRORISTS, HAD NOT TARGETED SUCH SENSITIVE GROUPS AS AMERICAN BOY SCOUTS. FURTHER, IRANIAN GOVERNMENT WOULD CERTAINLY MAKE EVERY EFFORT TO PROVIDE IRONCLAD EFFICIENT ARRANGEMENTS. NEVERTHELESS, DEPARTMENT OBVIOUSLY COULD NOT GIVE 100 PERCENT GUARANTEE THAT GOI WOULD NOT LATER CANCEL JAMBOREE OR THAT IT WOULD TAKE PLACE WITHOUT PROBLEMS. WE DID NOT THINK THAT JAMBOREE WAS IN SAME CATEGORY AS SHIRAZ'S ART FESTIVAL.

AT END OF MEETING, BSA REPS REMAINED CONCERNED AND WE AGREED TO SEEK EMBASSY ASSESSMENT AND POSSIBLE RECOMMENDATIONS AS TO WHETHER BSA SHOULD PROCEED. WE ALSO SUGGESTED THAT EMBASSY MIGHT WISH TO SOUND OUT DR. HOSSEIN BANAI, WHO IS RUNNING JAMBOREE FOR GOI, FOR HIS VIEWS. BSA REPS TOLD US THAT THEY WERE SERIOUSLY CONSIDERING THAT US RECOMMEND TO INTERNATIONAL SCOUT COUNCIL THAT A PRIVATE EMISSARY BE SENT TO GOI TO SUGGEST POSTPONEMENT OF JAMBOREE UNTIL 1983. THIS WOULD ENABLE GOI TO TAKE INITIATIVE TO POSTPONE CONFERENCE AND AVOID A LOSS OF FACE. JAMBOREE COULD BE HELD IN SWEDEN NEXT YEAR.

UNDER THESE CIRCUMSTANCES, IT MIGHT NOT BE ADVISABLE FOR EMBASSY TO APPROACH BANAI, W;HO MIGHT LATER BELIEVE THAT US WAS BEHIND PRESSURE TO POSTPONE IRANIAN GATHERING. WE PROMISED BSA REPS FURTHER REPLY BY NOON, OCTOBER 18. REGRET LIMITED TIME FOR CONSIDERATION OF THIS QUESTION, BUT WE ARE OBLIGED TO ADVISE BSA BEFORE COUNCIL MEETS ON OCTOBER 19. CHRISTOPHER

1978STATE263767.subject: VISIT TO COUNCIL OF EUROPE : PRESS SESSION

segments.text: ON OCTOBER 11, ASSISTANT SECRETARY DERIAN VISITED THE COUNCIL OF EUROPE AND ITS HUMAN RIGHTS COMPONENT OPERATIONS IN STRASBOURG. THE VERY FRUITFUL SESSIONS AND RECEPTIVE ATMOSPHERE WILL BE REPORTED ON IN DETAIL FROM WASHINGTON. AFTER THE AFTERNOON SESSIONS ASST.SEC. DERIAN MET WITH LOCAL CORRESPONDENTS OF THE EUROPEAN PRESS AT CONGEN'S HOME. THERE FOLLOWS A BRIEF RESUME OF THE QUESTIONS AND ANSWERS AT THAT MEETING.

A REP FROM THE WEST GERMAN PRESS (DPA) INQUIRED ABOUT THE GENERAL ITINERARY AND NATURE OF ASST.SEC. DERIAN'S TRIP, WITH PARTICULAR EMPHASIS ON THE BERLIN STOP, AS MIGHT BE EXPECTED. MS. DERIAN REITERATED THAT THE MEETING WITH THE OFFICIALS OF THE GDR WAS HELPFUL AND "FRANK". A LIST OF THE OFFICIALS WHOM SHE MET IN THE GDR WAS PROVIDED, AND THE JOURNALIST DID NOT PRESS HIS INQUIRY ANY FURTHER.

A REPRESENTATIVE OF THE CYPRIOT PRESS ASKED ABOUT THE HUMAN RIGHTS SITUATION IN THAT NATION. ASST. SEC. DERIAN OPINED THAT MANY OFFICIALS OF THE USG HAD ALREADY COMMENTED FULSOMELY ON THAT SITUATION, AND SHE DID NOT FEEL IT WAS USEFUL FOR HER TO COMMENT. THE REP FROM THE TURKISH PRESS DID NOT ASK ANY QUESTION ON CYPRUS.

AN ITALIAN JOURNALIST WHO WAS COVERING THE DELIBERATIONS OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT CURRENTLY IN SESSION ASKED ABOUT A VARIETY OF ISSUES RELATED TO USG HUMAN RIGHTS POLICY AND ALSO OF CONCERN TO THE CURRENT EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT SESSION. HE BEGAN BY ASKING WHAT THE U.S. POSITION WAS ON HUMAN RIGHTS IN NICARAGUA IN LIGHT OF PAST U.S. ECONOMIC SUPPORT OF THE SOMOZA REGIME. ASST.SEC. DERIAN EXPRESSED THE U.S.'S GRAVE CONCERN OVER RECENT DEVELOPMENTS IN NICARAGUA AND OUR HOPE THAT THE PRESENT GOVT WILL BE SCRUPULOUS IN ITS ATTENTION TO HUMAN RIGHTS DURING THE CURRENT CRISIS.

THE JOURNALIST PRESSED ON IN HIS QUESTIONING ABOUT APPARENT CONTRADICTIONS BETWEEN OUR COMMITMENT TO HUMAN RIGHTS AND OUR SUPPORT OF SOMOZA. ASST.SEC. DERIAN USED THE OPPORTUNITY TO EXPLAIN THE GENERAL COMMITMENT TO HUMAN RIGHTS IMPROVEMENTS IN ALL COUNTRIES AND THE EVOLUTION OF USING BOTH LEGISLATIVELY MANDATED AND DISCRETIONARYMOVES TO INDUCE OTHER NATIONS TO IMPROVE THEIR TREATMENT OF THEIR CITIZENS. SHE ALSO REVIEWED OUR EFFORTS IN THE OAS AND WITH OTHER LATIN NATIONS TO STOP THE BLOODSHED IN NICARAGUA DURING THE RECENT CRISIS. OUR COMMITMENT, MS. DERIAN ADDED, IS TO CONTRIBUTE TO THE GENERAL WELFARE OF THE NICARAGUAN PEOPLE BY ENCOURAGING A DIALOGUE BETWEEN THE GOVT AND THE OPPOSITION.

IN RESPONSE TO THE QUESTION OF WHY WE HAD NOT DONE "MORE". MS. DERIAN EXPLAINED THAT WE CHOSE THE METHOD WE THOUGHT BEST FROM OUR PERSPECTIVE AND CAUTIONED THAT AS WE ARE NOW IN A MEDIATION ROLE, OUR PUBLIC REMARKS COULD NOT GO INTO DETAIL ON THIS ISSUE.

THE SAME JOURNALIST STATED THAT THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AGENDA FOR OCT. 11 ALSO INCLUDED AN ITEM ON IRAN: THUS, HE INQUIRED AS TO CURRENT U.S. HUMAN RIGHTS POLICY TOWARD IRAN. ASST. SEC. DERIAN ANSWERED THAT THERE IS NO QUESTION THAT THERE HAVE BEEN SERIOUS HUMAN RIGHTS PROBLEMS IN IRAN. HOWEVER, THE GEOGRAPHIC INTEGRITY OF THE NATION OF IRAN IS OF GREAT IMPORTANCE TO THE U.S., THE REGION AND TO WORLD PEACE. THEREFORE, THE U.S. CONTINUES ARMS SALES AND OTHER BILATERAL COOPERATION WITH THE CURRENT GOVT OF IRAN, BUT MS. DERIAN POINTED OUT THAT THESE RELATIONS DO NOT MEAN THAT WE MUST BE SILENT ON IRAN.

IN FACT, SHE CONFIRMED THAT WE HAVE CARRIED ON A CONTINUOUS DIALOGUE WITH THE GOI ON THE QUESTION OF HUMAN RIGHTS IN THAT COUNTRY. WE BELIEVE, SHE ADDED, THAT THERE HAS BEEN A POSITIVE TREND FOR IMPROVEMENT IN HUMAN RIGHTS IN THAT COUNTRY. IN RESPONSE TO FURTHER QUESTIONING, DERIAN POINTED OUT THAT THE SHAH MADE A COMMITMENT THAT NO TORTURE WOULD OCCUR, AND, IN FACT, OUR SOURCES OF INFO SHOW A DRAMATIC DROP IN THE REPORTS OF TORTURE IN IRAN. SHE ALSO CITED THE RECENT ICJ VISIT AND POINTED OUT THAT THE USG HAS BEEN VERY CAREFUL ABOUT LISTENING TO ALL SIDES IN ISSUES OF HUMAN RIGHTS VIOLATIONS.

IN RESPONSE TO A QUESTION ABOUT THE ERA AND RIGHTS OF WOMEN IN THE U.S., ASST. SEC. DERIAN POINTED OUT THE POLLS INDICATE THAT THE MAJORITY OF AMERICANS FAVOR THE ERA BUT IN A DEMOCRACY IT TAKES TIME TO CONVINCE EVERYBODY AND TO SURMOUNT THE OBSTACLES TO SUCH LEGISLATION. SHE WENT ON TO EXPLAIN THE EXISTENCE OF LEGISLATION WHICH ALREADY AIDS WOMEN TO ACHIEVE PROTECTION UNDER THE LAW AND THE ROLE THE ERA WILL HAVE IN CONSOLIDATING THAT LEGISLATION TO GIVE WOMEN AN OVERALL PROTECTIVE UMBRELLA.

ON THE FUTURE OF THE OAS AMERICAN HUMAN RIGHTS CONVENTION, DERIAN EXPLAINED THAT THIS IS A PRIORITY FOR THE CARTER ADMINISTRATION. SHE EXPLAINED THAT THE RATIFICATION PROCESS HAS NOT MOVED FASTER BECAUSE OF A VARIETY OF CRISIS LEGISLATION THAT HAS PREEMPTED THE ADMINISTRATION'S EFFORTS ON CAPITOL HILL. SHE STATED THAT SHE HOPED THE CONVENTION WOULD BE HIGH ON THE AGENDA OF THE CONGRESS IN JANUARY. SHE CONFIRMED THAT THE U.S., UPON RATIFICATION OF THE CONVENTION, WOULD ACCEPT THE JURISDICTION OF THE INTER-AMERICAN CONVENTION EXCEPT FOR THE RESERVATIONS WE MUST APPLY BECAUSE OF OUR OWN CONSTITUTION.

IN ONE FINAL QUESTION ABOUT IRAN, THE ITALIAN JOURNALIST ASKED IF CURRENT DEVELOPMENTS (MARTIAL LAW) IN IRAN DID NOT SEEM TO CONTRADICT DERIAN'S STATEMENT ABOUT A FAVORABLE TREND IN HUMAN RIGHTS IN IRAN. IN RESPONSE ASST.SEC. DERIAN CAUTIONED AGAINST JUDGING THE FUTURE TREND IN THE MIDDLE OF A CRISIS. SHE POINTED OUT HOW DIFFICULT IT IS TO RECEIVE ENOUGH INFORMATION DURING A PERIOD OF SUCH TURBULENCE AND SAID AN ANALYSIS OF THE HUMAN RIGHTS SITUATION COULD ONLY BE MADE WHEN THE SITUATION HAD SETTLED DOWN SOMEWHAT.

IN CONVERSATION TODAY WITH A SECURITY REPRESENTATIVE OF DUPONT INTERNATIONAL, TWO ITEMS WERE BROUGHT UP THAT NEITHER NEA/IRN NOR SY WERE AWARE OF, IF IN FACT THE INFORMATION IS VALID. IN CONNECTION WITH THE SHAH'S BIRTHDAY ON OCTOBER 26TH, DUPONT REPRESENTATIVES IN IRAN REPORTED THAT POSTERS HAVE BEEN PUT UP THAT STATE SOMETHING TO THE EFFECT: "GIVE THE SHAH A DEAD AMERICAN FOR HIS BIRTHDAY." WERE THIS ACCURATE, THIS WOULD APPEAR TO BE THE FIRST DIRECT REFERENCE TO THE POSSIBLE KILLING OF AMERICANS.

ALSO REPORTED WAS THAT 12 BELL HELICOPTER FAMILIES HAVE DEPARTED OR ARE IN THE PROCESS OF DEPARTING ISFAHAN. IN LIGHT OF THE BOMBING OF THE BELL HELICOPTER BUS, THIS INFORMATION WOULD SEEM PLAUSIBLE BUT WOULD ALSO REFLECT THE FIRST MINI-EVACUATION OF AMERICANS FROM IRAN WITH OR WITHOUT YOUR CONSENT.

M/CT, NEA/IRN, AND SY/CC/TAG WOULD APPRECIATE YOUR COMMENTS SOONEST, BECAUSE IF THESE ARE JUST MORE OF THE RAMPANT RUMOR VARIETY, WE WOULD LIKE TO DISPEL THEM HERE IN THE STATES AS QUICKLY AS POSSIBLE. NEWSOM
PLEASE DELIVER FOLLOWING MESSAGE TO THE SHAH FROM THE PRESIDENT ON APPROPRIATE OCCASION PRIOR TO OCTOBER 26

BEGIN TEXT: "YOUR IMPERIAL MAJESTY: ROSALYN AND I EXTEND TO YOU OUR MOST CORDIAL GREETINGS AND BEST WISHES ON THE OCCASION OF YOUR BIRTHDAY. AS I HAVE TOLD YOU BEFORE, IRAN HAS OFTEN BEEN IN OUR THOUGHTS THESE PAST MONTHS. I KNOW THAT THE RECENT DISTURBANCES HAVE BEEN A GREAT PREOCCUPATION FOR YOU. BUT, I ALSO KNOW THAT YOU CAN REFLECT WITH PRIDE AND SATISFACTION ON WHAT YOU HAVE DONE OVER THE PAST 37 YEARS TO MOVE YOUR COUNTRY FORWARD. THE PRESENT PERIOD OF DIFFICULT TRANSITION WILL NOT LAST FOREVER, AND IRAN WILL EMERGE A STRONGER NATION BECAUSE OF THE PROGRESSIVE POLITICAL PROGRAM YOU HAVE SET IN MOTION.

LET ME REAFFIRM THAT THE UNITED STATES VALUES OUR STRONG AND ENDURING TIES WITH IRAN, AND THAT WE PLACE HIGH IMPORTANCE ON OUR CLOSE RELATIONSHIP. WORKING TOGETHER, OUR NATIONS HAVE MUCH TO CONTRIBUTE IN ASSURING PEACE AND PROMOTING GREATER PROSPERITY IN THE WORLD. SINCERELY, JIMMY CARTER." .
THERE ARE NO PLANS TO RELEASE TEXT. CHRISTOPHER

1978STATE270778.subject: IRAN SEVERS MILITARY TIES WITH ISRAEL

segments.text: REFERENCE: TEHRAN 10375

IT IS NOT CLEAR HOW SEVERANCE OF MILITARY CONTRACTS WITH ISRAEL WILL MOLLIFY ISLAMIC EXTREMISTS UNLESS GOI IS WILLING TO MAKE PUBLIC ITS ACTION. IS THERE ANY INDICATION THAT THIS IS IRANIAN INTENTION? HAS THERE BEEN ANY SUGGESTION THAT IRAN MAY CONTEMPLATE FURTHER MOVES AGAINST ISRAEL, E.G. AFFECTING DIPLOMATIC REPRESENTATION IN TEHRAN OR OIL SUPPLY? VANCE

DOE HAS CLEARED THE PROPOSED SUBJECT AGREEMENT AND WE ARE NOW IN A POSITION TO SEEK PRESIDENTIAL APPROVAL UPON RECEIPT OF CONFIRMATION OF UNDERSTANDING SET FORTH IN REFTEL (B). TIMING OF SIGNING OF AN AGREEMENT IS NOT YET DETERMINED. WE AGREE WITH EMBASSY VIEW (REFTEL A) THAT TIMING CAN AND SHOULD TAKE ACCOUNT OF IRANIAN SITUATION AND OTHER FACTORS.

THIS DOES NOT REPEAT NOT, HOWEVER, OBVIATE NEED TO SEEK UNDERSTANDING SET FORTH IN REFTEL (B) WHICH WAS AN ESSENTIAL ELEMENT OF THE PRESIDENT'S DECISION ON THE CRITERIA FOR DEALING WITH CASES INVOLVING CONTRACTS PREDATING OUR POLICY ON REPROCESSING (SUCH AS KANSAI AND TEPCO), AT LEAST DURING THE PERIOD OF INFCE OR UNTIL APPROPRIATE NATIONAL OR INTERNATIONAL SPENT FUEL FACILITIES ARE CREATED. IN THIS REGARD, DELAY IN SIGNING THE AGREEMENT WILL NOT MAKE THE NEED FOR CONFIRMATION OF OUR UNDERTAKING ACADEMIC. THE PRESIDENT'S DIRECTIVE WAS NOT TO SEEK AN UNDERSTANDING ON TWO PARTICULAR CASES BUT RATHER ON THE PRE-EXISTING CONTRACTS AS OUTLINED REFTEL (B).
THUS, EMBASSY SHOULD PROMPTLY TAKE STEPS TO IMPLEMENT INSTRUCTIONS PER REFTEL. AS NOTED IN REFTEL, IF EMBASSY NEEDS ANY FURTHER INFORMATION ABOUT DEMARCHE, PLEASE CABLE US.

WE SHOULD MAKE CLEAR TO THE GOI THAT WE ARE NOT SEEKING AN AMENDMENT TO THE AGREEMENT AS SUCH AND THAT CONFIRMATION OF OUR UNDERSTANDING MAY BE ACCOMPLISHED BY A BRIEF NOTE SAYING ONLY THAT THE GOI WISHES TO CONFIRM THAT IT SHARES THIS UNDERSTANDING. WHILE THIS WOULD NOT BE A FORMAL PART OF THE AGREEMENT, IT WOULD BE BROUGHT OUT IN CONGRESSIONAL HEARINGS AS WE EXPECT CONGRESSIONAL INTEREST TO FOCUS PARTICULARLY ON THE MEANING AND IMPLICATIONS OF THE NON-DISCRIMINATORY TREATMENT PROVISIONS. OF COURSE, CONGRESSIONAL CONSIDERATION WOULD NOT OCCUR UNTIL AFTER THE AGREEMENT HAD BEEN SIGNED BY THE USG AND GOI.

FOLLOWING IS EXACT TEXT OF ADMIRAL TURNER'S COMMENTS ON IRAN: QUESTION: THERE'S A GOOD DEAL OF NEWS COMING INTO THIS COUNTRY FROM IRAN, WHICH IS ONE OF OUR MAJOR OIL SUPPLIERS, A GOOD DEAL OF TROUBLE HAS BEEN HAPPENING, AND A GOOD DEAL OF CONFLICT. THE QUESTION, I SUPPOSE THE FIRST QUESTION TO ASK IS WHETHER THE CIA DETECTS ANY SOVIET INFLUENCE BEHIND THESE, ANY SOVIET MOVEMENT TO MOVE IN AND TAKE ADVANTAGE OF THESE, ANYTHING OF THAT SORT? DIRECTOR TURNER: WELL, I THINK THE POSITION THE SHAH OF IRAN IS IN TODAY IS A VERY DIFFICULT ONE.

HE'S BEEN TRYING GENUINELY TO LIBERALIZE, TO MODERNIZE HIS COUNTRY OVER QUITE A PERIOD OF TIME NOW. IN RECENT MONTHS HE'S MET CONSIDERABLE RESISTANCE FROM THE CONSERVATIVE, RIGHTWING ELEMENTS OF HIS OWN COUNTRY. AS A RESULT, HOWEVER, THE LEFT WING'S SMALL NUCLEUS OF COMMUNISTS HAS TRIED TO TAKE ADVANTAGE OF THIS AND TO USE THE DISTURBANCES FROM THE RIGHT FOR THEIR OWN PARTICULAR ADVANTAGE. BUT I THINK IT'S AN OPPORTUNISM TAKING ADVANTAGE OF A GENUINE DISSENT WITHIN THE COUNTRY AT THE DIRECTION THE SHAH IS GOING. BUT I'M....

QUESTION: SPECIFICALLY, DO YOU SEE ANY SOVIET, NEW SOVIET MONEY, NEW SOVIET AGENTS MOVING IN TO EXPAND AND USE THIS BRIDGEHEAD? DIRECTOR TURNER: NO, I HAVEN'T SEEN THAT. AND I'M PLEASED THAT THE SHAH IS CONTINUING WITH HIS LIBERALIZATION EFFORTS. AND AS YOU KNOW, THE BIG EVENT WILL BE NEXT JUNE WHEN HE'S PROMISED -- AND HE'S STICKING TO HIS PROMISE OF FREE ELECTIONS FOR HIS PARLIAMENT. IT'S A VERY IMPORTANT MOMENT FOR HIM AND FOR US.

IN RECENT DINNER CONVERSATION WITH DRAPER, GENERAL BARZANI AGAIN BROACHED DIFFICULTIES IDRIS BARZANI IS ENCOUNTERING IN ATTEMPTING TO OBTAIN AN IRANIAN PASSPORT AND PERMISSION TO VISIT HIS FATHER. IT IS OUR IMPRESSION THAT BARZANI IS NOT IN THE BEST OF HEALTH AND HE WOULD VERY MUCH LIKE TO SEE HIS SON AGAIN.

ON HUMANITARIAN GROUNDS, WE WONDER IF YOU COULD APPROACH THE GOVERNMENT AND INQUIRE ABOUT IDRIS' PASSPORT AND THE POSSIBILITY OF HIS VISITING THE US. IT WOULD BE HELPFUL IF YOU COULD ASCERTAIN WHAT OBJECTIONS THE IRANIANS HAVE, IF THIS IS, IN FACT, THE CASE. WE WOULD ANTICIPATE THAT IDRIS WOULD SPEND CLOSE TO A MONTH HERE AND THEN RETURN TO

SOVIET EMBASSY THIRD SECRETARY MAGOMED M. OSMANOV CALLED OCTOBER 26, AT HIS REQUEST, ON NEA/IRN OFFICER TO DISCUSS SITUATION IN IRAN AND U.S.-IRANIAN RELATIONS. MR. OSMANOV CLAIMED TO BE CHARGED WITH FOLLOWING DEVELOPMENTS IN THE MIDDLE AND NEAR EAST FOR THE EMBASSY.
OSMANOV WAS PRIMARILY INTERESTED IN TWO SUBJECTS

WHAT U.S. WAS DOING TO SUPPORT THE SHAH, AND B) OUTLOOK FOR IRANIAN ARMS PURCHASES. DEPTOFF, DRAWING ON PRESIDENT'S CALL TO THE SHAH AND REMARKS CONCERNING IRAN AT RECENT PRESS CONFERENCE, EXPLAINED U.S. POLICY EMPHASIZING IMPORTANCE OF IRAN, SUPPORT FOR SHAH AND LIBERALIZATION PROGRAM, AND HOPES FOR SUCCESS IN ENDING PRESENT DIFFICULTIES WHICH ARE PRIMARILY INTERNAL IRANIAN AFFAIR. ON QUESTION OF ARMS PURCHASES, DEPTOFF POINTED OUT THAT DEFENSE WAS ALSO QUESTION OF ECONOMIC WELL BEING AND SOCIAL STABILITY AND THAT POSSIBLE SLOW-DOWN IN IRANIAN ARMS PURCHASES WOULD STILL LEAVE IRAN STRONG MILITARILY.

OSMANOV SAID USSR VERY CONCERNED AND LAST THING IT WANTED WAS AN UNSTABLE NEIGHBOR ON ITS SOUTHERN BORDER. HE EMPHASIZED THE VALUE THE SOVIET UNION PLACED ON GOOD RELATIONS IT HAD DEVELOPED OVER THE YEARS WITH IRAN, PARTICULARLY WITH THE SHAH. HE LEFT STRONG IMPRESSION THAT, AT LEAST IN HIS VIEW, THE U.S. WAS NOT DOING ENOUGH TO HELP THE SHAH. HE SPECIFICALLY SAID THAT HE WOULD HAVE EXPECTED THE U.S. TO SHOW ITS SUPPORT IN CONCRETE TERMS, SUCH AS PROVIDING ECONOMIC ASSISTANCE OR BUYING MORE IRANIAN OIL. WHEN DEPTOFF POINTED OUT THAT PRESENT DIFFICULTIES WERE LARGELY INTERNAL MATTERS, OSMANOV STUCK TO HIS GUNS AND REITERATED POINT ABOUT SHAH'S NEED

TRANSMITTED HEREWITH IS PORTION OF TEXT OF MEMO WE ARE SENDING TO THE SECRETARY FOR HIS MEETING AT BREAKFAST TOMORROW WITH THE PRESIDENT AND DR. BZREZINSKI. WE WERE ASKED TO PRESENT SUMMARY STATUS REPORT OF SITUATION IN IRAN AND U.S. ACTIONS TO DATE, PLUS POSSIBLE INITIATIVES WE COULD TAKE IN THE NEAR TERM. REGRET THAT THERE IS NOT MORE TIME TO HANDLE THIS MATTER, BUT BELIEVE IT WOULD BE MOST USEFUL IF YOU COULD SUBMIT YOUR VIEWS DIRECTLY TO THE SECRETARY AND DR. BZREZINSKI TO ARRIVE HERE BEFORE 7 A.M. OUR TIME.

BEGIN TEXT: POSSIBLE COURSES OF FUTURE ACTION THE SHAH HAS SEVERE LONG TERM PROBLEMS, BUT ALSO URGENT NEED TO ESTABLISH EFFECTIVE GOVERNMENT WITHIN A FEW WEEKS. THE ABSOLUTE PREREQUISITE IS TO RESTORE A MEASURE OF PUBLIC CREDIBILITY. THE CHANCE OF OBTAINING EVEN TACIT SUPPORT THROUGH QUIET NEGOTIATIONS WITH THE MODERATE OPPOSITIONISTS, HOWEVER, SEEMS SLIM. THE GOI TRIED QUIET NEGOTIATIONS WITH THE RELIGIOUS MODERATES LAST SUMMER AND FAILED. IF THE SITUATION CONTINUES TO DETERIORATE, THE MILITARY WILL ALMOST CERTAINLY INTERVENE. THE MILITARY WOULD DEAL HARSHLY WITH THE OPPOSITION, MAKING MANY ARRESTS, CLAMPING DOWN ON THE PRESS AND SUPPRESSING STREET DEMONSTRATIONS.

THE COUNTER REACTION FROM THE MASSES WOULD BE EQUALLY HARSH, THOUGH POSSIBLY SOMEWHAT DELAYED. THE LOYALTY OF JUNIOR MILITARY PERSONNEL COULD NOT BE ASSURED UNDER THESE CONDITIONS. THE MILITARY HAS NO TALENT FOR MANAGING SUCH COMPLEX ENTERPRISES AS THE OIL INDUSTRY AND WE KNOW OF NO MILITARY LEADER WITH POPULAR APPEAL. PLAINLY, THIS ADMINISTRATION WOULD FIND IT DIFFICULT INDEED TO SUPPORT A MILITARY REGIME IN IRAN. THUS, IN OUR OPINION, U.S. POLICY SHOULD HAVE THREE MAIN THRUSTS
FIRM SUPPORT FOR THE SHAH AS THE KEY ELEMENT CAPABLE OF LEADING IRAN THROUGH A TRANSITION TO A MORE BROADLY BASED AND STABLE GOVERNMENT.
INCREASINGLY STRONG SUPPORT FOR THE SHAH'S LIBERALIZATION EFFORTS, INCLUDING A MORE ACTIVE ADVISORY ROLE WITH THE SHAH AND OFFERS OF ASSISTANCE TO THE GOI.
STEADFAST OPPOSITION TO A MILITARY REGIME. TO ELABORATE ON THESE PRINCIPLES, HERE ARE SOME OF THE INITIATIVES UNDER WAY OR ON WHICH WE WOULD LIKE YOUR GUIDANCE

SUBJECT TO YOUR VIEWS, WE BELIEVE WE SHOULD ASK AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN TO PROVIDE OUR ADVICE TO THE SHAH AND HIS CLOSE ASSOCIATES WITH GREATER SPECIFICITY THAN IN THE PAST. ALTHOUGH WE DO NOT THINK WE SHOULD ADVOCATE A FORMAL COALITION GOVERNMENT OR GO SO FAR AS TO DESIGNATE INDIVIDUALS, WE BELIEVE WE SHOULD (1) URGE THE SHAH TO CREATE A PUBLIC DIALOGUE BETWEEN HIS SUPPORTERS AND THE OPPOSITION AND (2) INCLUDE RESPONSIBLE MEMBERS OF THE OPPOSITION IN SOME CABINET POSITIONS. THE GOI ALLOWS, EVEN ENCOURAGES, CRITICISM IN THE PARLIAMENT, BUT THAT BODY DOES NOT INCLUDE THE ACTIVE OPPOSITION AND IS PROBABLY NOT DEEMED INDEPENDENT BY THE PUBLIC.

IT SEEMS ESSENTIAL TO ENGAGE THE OPPOSITION IN A CONSTRUCTIVE AND PEACEFUL POLITICAL PROCESS, FORCING THE CRITICS TO SHARE IN THE HARD DECISIONS LIKE STRIKE SETTLEMENTS AND UNIVERSITY MANAGEMENT. BRINGING REPUTABLE OPPOSITION MEMBERS INTO THE GOVERNMENT COULD ALSO HAVE THE PSYCHOLOGICAL EFFECT OF CONVINCING SOME OF THE PUBLIC THAT THE GOVERNMENT COULD BE TRUSTED AND HAD TRULY TURNED AROUND IN ITS ATTITUDE. ON THE OTHER HAND, IT COULD ALSO LEAD THE OPPOSITION TO STEP UP ITS DEMANDS, VIEWING THE GOVERNMENT'S ACTIONS AS A SIGN OF WEAKNESS.

UNDER SECRETARY COOPER WILL SUGGEST WORLD BANK OR U.S. JOINT COMMISSION ADVICE AND ASSISTANCE (ON A REIMBURSED BASIS) TO HELP THE GOI WITH ITS ECONOMIC PLANNING AND THE RAPID IMPLEMENTATION OF PROJECTS WITH HIGH POLITICAL IMPACT. IF YOU APPROVE, WE COULD FOLLOW UP STRONGLY ANY SIGNS OF IRANIAN INTEREST.

WE MIGHT ASK DOD TO SEND TEAMS OF MANAGEMENT EXPERTS TO IRAN TO REVIEW MAJOR DEFENSE PROGRAMS WITH A VIEW TO CUTTING BACK COSTS AND REDUCING STAFFING, I.E. REDUCING PROGRAMS TO A MORE AUSTERE LEVEL COMPATIBLE WITH IRAN'S DIFFICULT CIRCUMSTANCES.

WE COULD FORMALIZE OR MAKE MORE REGULAR OUR CONSULTATIONS ON IRAN WITH THE BRITISH, FRENCH, GERMANS AND POSSIBLY ISRAELIS AND SAUDIS. FOUR POSSIBLE ACTIONS OPEN TO US WHICH ARE NOT RECOMMENDED FOR CONSIDERATION AT THIS TIME ARE

ASK THE PRESIDENT TO MAKE ANOTHER STATEMENT OF U.S. SUPPORT FOR THE SHAH AT HIS OCTOBER 31 PRESS CONFERENCE. WE DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS STEP BECAUSE THE PRESIDENT'S BIRTHDAY MESSAGE WILL JUST HAVE APPEARED IN THE IRANIAN PRESS. ALSO, THE PRESIDENT WILL HAVE A PHOTO SESSION WITH THE CROWN PRINCE ON THE SAME DAY AND THAT WILL PROVIDE EVIDENCE OF AMERICAN SUPPORT. WE WOULD PREFER TO HOLD THE OPTION OF A FURTHER PRESIDENTIAL STATEMENT UNTIL LATER.

AN APPEAL TO ALL SIDES TO CEASE THE VIOLENT CONFRONTATION AND MOVE TOWARDS PEACEFUL DISCUSSIONS OF DISPUTES WITHOUT PRECONDITIONS. SUCH A MOVE WOULD BE SEEN BY THE SHAH AS DIMINISHING OUR SUPPORT FOR HIM AND WOULD UNDERCUT OUR OTHER EFFORTS.
AGREE TO CONTACTS WITH THE EXTREME OPPOSITION ELEMENTS ASSOCIATED WITH AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI. THAT MOVE WOULD BE CLEARLY MISUNDERSTOOD BY THE IRANIANS AS A SHIFT IN THE U.S. POSITION.

SEND A SPECIAL ENVOY TO THE SHAH AS A DRAMATIC EXPRESSION OF U.S. SUPPORT FOR THE SHAH. WE DO NOT BELIEVE THIS STEP IS WARRANTED, BUT MAY WISH TO RESERVE IT FOR LATER. - FIRST, WE SHOULD RECOGNIZE THAT OUR ABILITY TO INFLUENCE THE COURSE OF IRANIAN POLITICS IS LIMITED AND THAT IRANIAN EVENTS HAVE THEIR OWN LOGIC AND MOMENTUM. THERE IS A VERY GOOD CHANCE THAT THE SHAH'S FORTUNES WILL CONTINUE TO ERODE AND THERE IS EVEN A POSSIBILITY THAT OUR ACTIONS COULD CONTRIBUTE TO THAT PROCESS. BUT THE GREATEST RISK, IN OUR VIEW, IS TO DO NOTHING.

SECOND, WE ARE CONCERNED FOR THE SAFETY OF THE 41,000 AMERICANS RESIDENT IN IRAN. WE ARE WATCHING THAT SITUATION CLOSELY, BUT DO NOT BELIEVE THE SITUATION REQUIRES ANY EMERGENCY MEASURES AT THIS TIME. .
PLEASE DO NOT FEEL CONSTRAINED TO MAKE YOUR COMMENTS IN FORM OF COMMENTARY ON OUR TEXT. IT MIGHT BE PREFERABLE TO SUBMIT YOUR VIEWS WITHOUT REFERENCE TO OUR PAPER. VANCE

WE ARE BEGINNING TO HEAR INFLUENTIAL, OUTSIDE VOICES HERE ASSERT THAT SHAH'S POLICY OF POLITICAL CONCESSIONS HAS PROVEN MISTAKEN AND THAT HE SHOULD TURN TO PROGRAM OF CRACKING DOWN ON DISSIDENTS. BELIEVE IT WOULD BE TIMELY AND USEFUL IF, WITHOUT REFERRING TO THIS MESSAGE, YOU COULD GIVE US YOUR BEST ASSESSMENT OF CONSEQUENCES/ OUTCOME IN SHORT AND LONG TERM OF A POLICY OF SEEKING TO RESTORE ORDER BY USING FORCE TO RETURN STRIKERS TO JOBS AND TO KEEP DEMONSTRATORS OFF THE STREETS. PRESUMABLY ASSOCIATED WITH SUCH A POLICY WOULD BE A CLAMP DOWN ON THE PRESS AND UNIVERSITIES AND ARRESTS OF LARGE NUMBERS OF SECULAR AND RELIGIOUS OPPOSITIONISTS.

(WE HEAR THAT SECURITY AGENCIES BELIEVE OPPOSITION CAN BE QUELLED BY ONLY 400 KEY ARRESTS.) PLEASE INCLUDE IN ANALYSIS YOUR ESTIMATE OF LOYALTY OF ARMY AND OTHER SECURITY FORCES UNDER CONDITIONS OF TIGHT CONTROLS OVER EXTENDED PERIOD AND PROBABLE REACTION OF GROUPS WITHIN IRANIAN BODY POLITIC. YOU MIGHT ALSO CONSIDER PUBLIC REACTION IF ELECTIONS WERE TO BE POSTPONED.
REALIZE THAT YOU HAVE GIVEN US YOUR VIEWS AND ANSWERS TO THESE QUESTIONS IN VARIOUS CABLES, BUT BELIEVE BRINGING IT ALL TOGETHER IN ONE NORMAL DISTRIBUTION EXDIS MESSAGE COULD BE QUITE HELPFUL.
FOLLOWING IS REPORT OF RECENT, HOUR-LONG CONVERSATION BETWEEN KHOMEINI AND IRANIAN VISITOR WHO HAD LAST KNOWN HIM IN 1963. REPORT PROVIDED TO DEPTOFF BY RELIABLE INTERMEDIARY.

VISITOR FOUND KHOMEINI SUPREMELY CONFIDENT THAT IN DUE TIME HE WOULD SUCCEED IN HIS SINGLE-MINDED MISSION OF BRINGING DOWN PAHLAVI DYNESTY. KHOMEINI REJECTED ANY COMPROMISE POSITION AND SPECIFICALLY EXCLUDED ALI AMINI AS "INDEPENDENT" PRIME MINISTER UNDER A CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCHY OR SOME SIMILAR ARRANGEMENT. AMINI, IN KHOMEINI'S VIEW, IS COMPROMISED THROUGH PAST ASSOCIATION WITH SHAH AND SHAH'S FATHER.

WHEN VISITOR WARNED THAT UNLESS TURMOIL WAS HALTED, COMPLETE CHAOS OR ARMY CONTROL LAY AHEAD, KHOMEINI SEEMED UNPERTURBED. SIMILARLY, WHEN VISITOR POINTED TO ECONOMIC HAVOC THAT COULD RESULT FROM CONTINUING STRIKES, KHOMEINI REFUSED TO BE MOVED. HE ASSERTED THAT VISITOR SIMPLY DID NOT UNDERSTAND NATURE OF POLITICAL REVOLT AGAINST THE SHAH THAT WAS OCCURRING IN IRAN. KHOMEINI DID NOT FEAR ANY OF THESE DANGERS BECAUSE HE WAS SURE THAT THEY WERE STEPS EN ROUTE TO AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC.

IN THE PROCESS THAT LIES AHEAD, KHOMEINI SEEMS TO SEE HIMSELF AS A SORT OF ARBITER RATHER THAN AN INITIATOR, APPROVING OR DISAPPROVING THIS OR THAT PROPOSAL. IN THIS FRAMEWORK HE WAS PREPARED TO LISTEN TO WHAT BARZARGAN AND SANJABI HAD TO SAY, BUT ONLY TO ACCEPT THOSE IDEAS WHICH WERE CONGRUENT WITH HIS ULTIMATE GOAL.

KHOMEINI APPEARED VERY INNOCENT OR SIMPLISTIC IN HIS UNDERSTANDING OF THE WESTERN POWERS AND WAS HEAVILY INFLUENCED BY MEMBERS OF HIS CIRCLE WHO ARE EXTREMELY ANTI-WESTERN. HE VIEWED THE WEST AS HIGHLY PERNICIOUS AND BELIEVED THAT ALL ARAB STATES WERE UNDER WESTERN INFLUENCE. HE WAS ESPECIALLY DISAPPOINTED IN IRAQ WHICH HE HAD THOUGHT AN INDEPENDENT COUNTRY. KUWAIT WAS PLACED IN THE SAME CATEGORY FOR HAVING REFUSED HIM PERMISSION TO ENTER.

1978STATE275461.subject: ISRAELI POSITION ON "THICKENING" OF WEST BANK SECRET SECRET

segments.text: EAST JERUSALEM

AS PART OF THE ISRAELI CABINET DECISION WITH REGARD TO THE DRAFT EGYPTIAN/ISRAELI PEACE TREATY, BEGIN ANNOUNCED THAT ISRAEL WOULD BE MOVING FORWARD TO "THICKEN" ISRAELI SETTLEMENTS IN THE WEST BANK RIGHT AWAY. WHILE DAYAN HAS INDICATED THIS PROCESS OF "THICKENING" WOULD BE GRADUAL AND UNDRAMATIC AND ONLY INVOLVE A FEW HUNDRED PERSONS, OTHER AUTHORITATIVE ISRAELIS HAVE TOLD US THAT THEY INTEND TO PUT AN ADDITIONAL 500 FAMILIES INTO THE SETTLEMENTS.

WITH SOME DIFFICULTY WE HAVE BEEN ABLE TO PERSUADE THE EGYPTIANS NOT TO RECALL THEIR DELEGATION HEADS FOR CONSULTATION IN LIGHT OF THIS DEVELOPMENT, BUT THE ISRAELI DECISION IS NOT ONLY INCONSISTENT WITH THE SPIRIT OF THE DISCUSSIONS AT CAMP DAVID, BUT IT ALSO PROMISES TO UNDERMINE FURTHER THE INTEREST AND SUPPORT WE HAVE BEEN TRYING TO BUILD WITHIN THE ARAB WORLD AND WITH THE PALESTINIANS FOR THE CAMP DAVID FRAMEWORK APPROACH TO THE WEST BANK AND GAZA ISSUE.

IN ADDITION, THE ISRAELI PRESS HAS REPORTED THAT BEGIN HIMSELF IS CONSIDERING MOVING THE OFFICES OF THE PRIME MINISTRY AND FOREIGN MINISTRY TO EAST JERUSALEM. WHILE WE HAVE BEEN TOLD THAT THIS MOVE WILL NOT BE DECIDED IN THE IMMEDIATE FUTURE, AND IS CURRENTLY ON "ICE", ISRAELI PUBLIC INTEREST IN SUCH A MOVE HAS ALREADY BEGUN TO BUILD MOMENTUM.

ACTION ADDRESSEES SHOULD GET IN TOUCH SOONEST WITH HIGHEST APPROPRIATE OFFICIAL IN HOST GOVERNMENT TO MAKE FOLLOWING CORE TALKING POINTS, TAILORED TO LOCAL CONDITIONS, IN YOUR PRESENTATION (WE HAVE BEEN IN TOUCH FROM WASHINGTON WITH DUTCH, DANES, AND BRITISH)

THE SECRETARY HAS ASKED THAT I CONVEY TO YOU ON HIS BEHALF OUR DEEP CONCERN OVER THE RECENT ISRAELI DECISION TO "THICKEN" ISRAELI SETTLEMENTS IN THE WEST BANK AND PRESS REPORTS ISRAEL IS CONSIDERING MOVING CERTAIN OFFICES TO EAST JERUSALEM, EVEN WHILE NEGOTIATIONS ARE PROCEEDING IN WASHINGTON ON BOTH ISRAELI/EGYPTIAN PEACE TREATY AND ON SPECIFIC WAYS TO APPROACH THE WEST BANK/GAZA ISSUE IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE CAMP DAVID FRAMEWORK AGREEMENTS.
EGYPT WANTS TO CONTINUE AND CONCLUDE THE NEGOTIATIONS.

IT NEEDS TO DO SO IN A WAY THAT COUNTERACTS THE CHARGE SADAT IS ABANDONING THE OTHER ARABS AND THAT MAKES CREDIBLE HIS STATEMENTS THAT HE IS COMMITTED TO THE CAMP DAVID FRAMEWORK IN ITS ENTIRETY INCLUDING WEST BANK/GAZA NEGOTIATIONS WITH PALESTINIAN PARTICIPATION.

THE ISRAELI ANNOUNCEMENT ON SETTLEMENTS AND CONTINUING PUBLIC STATEMENTS ARE INTERPRETED BY THE ARABS AS EVIDENCE THAT ISRAEL IS CONSOLIDATING ITS POSITION IN THE WEST BANK AND GAZA AND FURTHER PREJUDING THOSE NEGOTIATIONS.

SADAT IS EMBARRASSED POLITICALLY AT HOME AND IN THE ARAB WORLD. THE ISRAELI DECISION GIVES ADDED AMMUNITION TO SADAT'S CRITICS AT THE BAGHDAD SUMMIT AND UNDERCUTS THOSE WHO WOULD LIKE TO PROTECT HIM AT THAT MEETING.
THE ARAB WORLD IS ASKING HOW EGYPT CAN DO BUSINESS AS USUAL IN THE WASHINGTON NEGOTIATIONS UNDER THESE CIRCUMSTANCES.

EGYPT IS NOT RECALLING ITS DELEGATION HEADS FOR CONSULTATION, BUT NO NEGOTIATING MEETINGS ARE POSSIBLE FOR NOW. THE ISRAELI DECISION HAS THUS JEOPARDIZED THE WASHINGTON NEGOTIATIONS WHICH WERE MAKING GOOD PROGRESS UNTIL THE SETTLEMENT DECISION WAS ANNOUNCED.
POTENTIALLY EVEN MORE DAMAGING ARE REPORTS THAT ISRAEL IS CONSIDERING MOVING THE PRIME MINISTRY AND FOREIGN MINISTRY TO EAST JERUSALEM.
IF CARRIED OUT, THIS WOULD SERIOUSLY JEOPARDIZE THE NEGOTIATING PROCESS STEMMING FROM CAMP DAVID.
MOREOVER, IT WOULD BE UNIVERSALLY CONDEMNED IN THE WORLD. IT IS DOUBTFUL THAT ANY GOVERNMENT WOULD ACCEPT THIS MOVE AND DO BUSINESS WITH ISRAEL IN EAST JERUSALEM.

ASSUMING YOU SHARE OUR CONCERNS OVER IMPLICATIONS OF ISRAELI MOVES, SECRETARY WOULD VERY MUCH APPRECIATE YOUR GOVERNMENT GETTING IN TOUCH WITH THE ISRAELIS (THROUGH APPROPRIATE CHANNEL) TO COMMUNICATE YOUR OWN PERSONAL CONCERN AND THAT OF YOUR GOVERNMENT AND TO URGE THAT ISRAEL TAKE STEPS TO LIMIT THE DAMAGE ALREADY MADE, FOR EXAMPLE, BY AGREEING TO DELAY OR DECELERATE THE "THICKENING" PROCESS AND TO MAKE IRREVOCABLY CLEAR THAT NO DECISION TO MOVE OFFICES TO EAST JERUSALEM WILL BE TAKEN.
TEHRAN: PLEASE REPORT IMMEDIATELY IF YOU BELIEVE THE SHAH, OR OTHER IRANIAN OFFICIALS YOU MIGHT APPROACH, WOULD HAVE DIFFICULTY WITH OUR REQUEST.
BUCHAREST: REQUEST CHARGE CONVEY THIS MESSAGE DIRECTLY TO FOREIGN MINISTER ANDREI OR, IF UNAVAILABLE, TO PUNGAN OR OTHER APPROPRIATE INTERMEDIARY. VANCE UNQUOTE VANCE

PLEASE PASS THE FOLLOWING MESSAGE ON IRAN FROM THE SECRETARY TO FOREIGN MINISTER GENSCHER: BEGIN : DEAR HANS-DIETRICH: KNOWING YOUR DEEP CONCERN ABOUT RECENT EVENTS IN IRAN, WHAT THEY PRESAGE FOR THE AREA, AND HOW WESTERN INTERESTS WILL BE AFFECTED, I WANT TO SHARE WITH YOU DIRECTLY AND IN YOUR EC COUNCIL PRESIDENCY CAPACITY OUR ASSESSMENT OF THE PRESENT SITUATION. OUR INITIAL REPORTS INDICATE THAT THE INSTALLATION OF A MILITARY GOVERNMENT HAS BROUGHT CALM TO MUCH OF THE COUNTRY. THE DESTRUCTIVE MOB ACTIONS WHICH SWEPT TEHRAN DURING THE PAST TWO DAYS HAVE ENDED FOR THE TIME BEING AND THE MILITARY SEEMS TO HAVE EFFECTIVE CONTROL OVER THE CITY.

REPORTS WE RECEIVE FROM OUR CONSULATES OUTSIDE TEHRAN STATE THAT THE OTHER URBAN CENTERS ARE, WITH A FEW EXCEPTIONS, GENERALLY QUIET. THERE HAVE BEEN SERIOUS DISTURBANCES IN TABRIZ, IT SEEMS. WE UNDERSTAND WHY THE SHAH CHOSE TO MOVE TO INSTALL A MILITARY GOVERNMENT, AND WE HAVE TOLD HIM THAT WE FULLY SUPPORT HIS ACTIONS. IT HAD BECOME CLEAR THAT THE SHARIF-EMAMI CABINET COULD NOT MAINTAIN ORDER. A NONPOLITICAL NEUTRAL FIGURE WHO COMMANDED THE RESPECT AND POPULAR FOLLOWING NECESSARY TO LEAD THE COUNTRY BACK TO STABILITY DID NOT SEEM TO BE PRESENT.

THE SHAH ACTIVELY EXPLORED A NUMBER OF POSSIBILITIES FOR CIVILIAN GOVERNMENT, INCLUDING THE PARTICIPATION OF VARIOUS OPPOSITION ELEMENTS, SPECIFICALLY THE NATIONAL FRONT LEADERSHIP. THE OPPOSITION, HEAVILY INFLUENCED BY THE INTRANSIGENCE AND EXTREME POSITIONS OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, REFUSED TO PARTICIPATE. DIRECT AND IMMEDIATE ACTION WAS NECESSARY TO COMBAT THE GROWING CHAOS, AND WE BELIEVE THE SHAH TOOK THE ONLY ACTION AVAILABLE TO HIM. THE SHAH REALIZES, HOWEVER, THAT ALTHOUGH HE HAS SOME BREATHING ROOM, HE STILL FACES GRAVE PROBLEMS IN RESTORING STABILITY TO IRAN. WE CONTINUE TO BELIEVE THAT, WITH THE POLITICAL SHREWDNESS HE HAS SHOWN IN THE PAST, HE RETAINS THE CAPABILITY TO LEAD THE COUNTRY TO ELECTIONS.

WE BELIEVE IT IS ESSENTIAL THAT HE REMAIN IN CONTROL. WE HAVE REASSURED HIM OF OUR STRONG SUPPORT AND HAVE HIGHLIGHTED THE FACT THAT, ONCE ORDER IS RESTORED, IT IS VITAL THAT THE LIBERALIZATION PROCESS CONTINUE AND FREE ELECTIONS BE HELD. POSSIBLE SOVIET ACTIVITIES AFFECTING IRAN ARE OF DIRECT INTEREST TO US. I WANT YOU TO KNOW THAT WE HAVE SEEN NO CONCRETE EVIDENCE THUS FAR THAT THE SOVIETS ARE TAKING ANY STEPS TO AGGRAVATE THE SITUATION. A NUMBER OF SOVIET AMBASSADORS, INCLUDING DOBRYNIN HERE, HAVE TAKEN THE POSITION THAT THEY WANT TO SEE THE SHAH REMAIN BUT WERE CONCERNED ABOUT POSSIBLE ANARCHY SO CLOSE TO THEIR BORDERS.

WE WILL, OF COURSE, WATCH CLOSELY FOR ANY CHANGES IN SOVIET POLICY OR ACTIONS. ALTHOUGH I KNOW THAT OUR EMBASSIES ARE IN CLOSE TOUCH, I WANT TO MENTION OUR ACTIONS AFFECTING THE AMERICAN COMMUNITY IN IRAN. TO THE BEST OF OUR KNOWLEDGE, ALL AMERICANS IN THE COUNTRY ARE SAFE. ALTHOUGH UNDERSTANDABLY NERVOUS, AMERICANS REMAIN CALM AND WE BELIEVE MOST RETURNED TO WORK ON NOVEMBER 7. THERE HAVE BEEN ONLY SCATTERED INSTANCES OF OUR CITIZENS CHOOSING TO LEAVE AT THIS TIME. WE HAVE COUNSELED CAUTION AND PRUDENCE, BUT HAVE NOT SET IN MOTION ANY PLANS TO EVACUATE OUR LARGE COMMUNITY. WE HAVE, HOWEVER, RECOMMENDED AGAINST NONESSENTIAL TRAVEL BY AMERICANS TO IRAN.

ALTHOUGH IRAN CONTINUES TO EXPORT OIL, THE AMOUNT, AS YOU KNOW, HAS BEEN GREATLY REDUCED OVER THE PAST WEEK. IF PROLONGED, THIS COULD ADVERSELY EFFECT OUR ECONOMY AND THOSE OF OUR FRIENDS IN WESTERN EUROPE, JAPAN AND ISRAEL. WE WILL CONTINUE TO MONITOR THE OIL QUESTION VERY CAREFULLY AND OUR STAFFS SHOULD STAY IN CLOSE TOUCH ON THIS ISSUE. ALTHOUGH THE SITUATION IS VERY WORRISOME, WE REMAIN CONFIDENT THAT THE SHAH WILL SUCCEED IN HIS EFFORTS TO ACHIEVE STABILITY, REESTABLISH CIVILIAN GOVERNMENT AND HOLD FREE ELECTIONS. I WOULD APPRECIATE YOUR OWN ASSESSMENT OF RECENT EVENTS AND WHERE THEY MAY LEAD. WITH WARM REGARDS, SINCERELY, CYRUS VANCE

WE WOULD APPRECIATE BY END OF THIS WEEK EMBASSY'S PRELIMINARY ASSESSMENT OF PERFORMANCE AND PROSPECTS OF MILITARY GOVERNMENT. WE WOULD LIKE EMBASSY'S VIEWS ON FOLLOWING ASPECTS: (A) LAW AND ORDER. ALTHOUGH REPORTING CABLES INDICATE THAT SECURITY CONDITIONS IN TEHRAN HAVE SUBSTANTIALLY IMPROVED, LEVEL OF VIOLENCE OUTSIDE THE CAPITAL SEEMS ROUGHLY EQUAL TO THAT PRIOR TO APPOINTMENT OF MILITARY GOVERNMENT. KERMANSHAH AND CASPIAN TOWNS, OR ARE TROOPS INEFFECTIVE IN COPING WITH PROBLEMS? IS MILITARY MOVING IN STAGES TO PACIFY TEHRAN FIRST AND OTHER CENTERS LATER? (B) STRIKES. HOW DOES EMBASSY EVALUATE PERFORMANCE OF MILITARY OFFICIALS IN PERSUADING WORKERS TO RETURN TO THEIR JOBS. WE WOULD APPRECIATE A BRIEF SURVEY OF GOVERNMENT'S SUCCESSES AND FAILURES WHERE AUTHORITIES HAVE APPLIED THEMSELVES IN A SERIOUS EFFORT TO END STRIKES. ARE SOME SECTORS BEING IGNORED WHILE GOVERNMENT CONCENTRATES ON OIL, IRAN AIR, AND OTHER KEY AGENCIES OR INDUSTRIES? (C) CIVIL SERVICE. WE HAVE NOTED APPARENT RELUCTANCE OF QUALIFIED IRANIANS OF HIGH REPUTE TO SUPPORT MILITARY GOVERNMENT BY TAKING MINISTERIAL POSITIONS.

MEHRAN APPEARS A RARE EXCEPTION AMONG RATHER COLORLESS CIVILIAN APPOINTEES. IS THIS GENERALIZATION ACCURATE? WHAT INDICATIONS DOES EMBASSY HAVE OF WILLINGNESS OF KEY CIVIL SERVANTS TO COOPERATE WITH MILITARY MINISTERS? HAS FUNCTIONING OF MINISTRIES IMPROVED? (D) PUBLIC PERCEPTIONS. WHAT HAS BEEN REACTION OF INDEPENDENT-MINDED PERSONS OF INFLUENCE TO INSTALLATION OF A MILITARY GOVERNMENT? IN TERMS OF MODERATE OPPOSITION REACTION, DOES EMBASSY BELIEVE THAT MILITARY REGIME WILL FACILITATE OR MAKE MORE DIFFICULT EVENTUAL FORMATION OF A CIVILIAN GOVERNMENT WITH BROAD POPULAR APPEAL? (E) IMPLICATIONS FOR THE U.S. HOW HAS INSTALLATION OF A MILITARY GOVERNMENT AFFECTED THE U.S. POSITION IN IRAN?
