IN OUR RUSH YESTERDAY TO PREPARE MEMORANDA, WE WERE UNABLE TO FILL YOU IN ON THE REASON FOR OUR INQUIRY REGARDING POSSIBLE EARLY ELECTIONS. KING HASSAN SUGGESTED TO THE PRESIDENT THAT THE SHAH SHOULD OPT FOR ELECTIONS WITHIN A VERY SHORT TIME AND THAT MOROCCO WOULD UNDERTAKE TO MANAGE AND OVERSEE THE ELECTION PROCESS FOR HIM. HASSAN WANTED U.S. ENDORSEMENT TO PUT FORWARD HIS PROPOSAL TO ZAHEDI TODAY OR TOMORROW. WE ARE DISCOURAGING THE KING FROM PURSUING THIS IDEA ALTHOUGH NOTING THAT THE CONCEPT OF EARLY ELECTIONS IS AN INTERESTING ONE THAT WE MAY WISH TO CONSIDER FURTHER.

WEDNESDAY NIGHT IN HIS FOLLOW-UP MEETING WITH KING HASSAN, THE SECRETARY SAID WE HAD STUDIED HIS SUGGESTION AND FOUND VERY INTERESTING THE IDEA OF EARLIER ELECTIONS. HOWEVER, HE SAID THE CONCERN WE HAVE IS AT WHAT SPEED THE SHAH COULD PROCEED TO ELECTIONS WITH THE GREATEST CHANCE OF A MODERATE OUTCOME. IF ELECTIONS WERE SET TOO SOON, IT MIGHT BE IMPOSSIBLE FOR HIM TO PREPARE SUPPORTIVE FORCES ADEQUATELY. HASSAN SAID HE HONESTLY COULD NOT GIVE A VIEW ON WHAT WOULD BE AN OPTIMAL TIME FOR THE ELECTIONS. THE MAIN PURPOSE OF AN EARLY ELECTION WOULD BE TO DE-FUSE THE CURRENT TIMEBOMB.

THE KING PLANNED TO SEE ZAHEDI THRUSDAY AFTERNOON AND SAID HE WOULD BE "SENDING HIM TO TEHRAN" WITH A MESSAGE. THAT IS ALL WE KNOW TO DATE. YOU WILL SEE FROM THE ABOVE THAT ANY PROPOSAL WHICH HASSAN MAY PUT TO ZAHEDI IS ON HIS OWN. IF THE SUBJECT IS RAISED WITH YOU YOU CAN ASSUME THAT THE U.S. LISTENED TO HASSAN BUT DID NOT IN ANY WAY GIVE BACKING TO THE KING'S

1978STATE295947.subject: BREZHNEV LETTER FOLLOWING PRESS GUIDANCE WAS PREPARED NOVEMBER 19. IT HAS NOT BEEN USED AT NOON BRIEFINGS. POST MAY USE AS

segments.text: FOLLOWING PRESS GUIDANCE WAS PREPARED NOVEMBER 19. IT HAS NOT BEEN USED AT NOON BRIEFINGS. POST MAY USE AS APPROPRIATE.
DOES THE U.S. HAVE A CONTINGENCY PLAN IN CASE THE SHAH'S GOVERNMENT SHOULD FALL?

EVERY AMERICAN EMBASSY HAS A CONTINGENCY PLAN TO PROTECT AMERICANS IN THE EVENT OF SERIOUS DISTURBANCES OVERSEAS. SUCH A PLAN EXISTS IN TEHRAN AS IN EVERY OTHER FOREIGN CAPITAL. WE HAVE TAKEN NO STEPS TO IMPLEMENT THE PLAN IN IRAN.
BUT DOES THE U.S. HAVE A CONTINGENCY PLAN TO ASSURE THAT THE SHAH REMAINS IN POWER?

AS THE PRESIDENT HAS STATED WE HAVE NO INTENTION OF INTERFERING IN THE INTERNAL AFFAIRS OF ANY FOREIGN COUNTRY. WE NOTE THAT THE SHAH HAS RECENTLY SAID IN A PRESS INTERVIEW THAT HE WOULD NOT WISH FRIENDLY FOREIGN GOVERNMENTS TO INTERVENE ON HIS BEHALF.
WHAT DO WE KNOW OF SOVIET INVOLVEMENT IN IRAN?

THE PRESIDENT ADDRESSED THAT QUESTION ON NOVEMBER 13. HE SAID: "WE DON'T HAVE ANY EVIDENCE THAT THE SOVIETS, FOR INSTANCE, ARE TRYING TO DISRUPT THE EXISTING GOVERNMENT STRUCTURE IN IRAN NOR THAT THEY ARE A SOURCE OF VIOLENCE IN IRAN. I THINK THEY RECOGNIZE--THEY HAVE A VERY LONG MUTUAL BORDER WITH IRAN AND A STABLE GOVERNMENT THERE NO MATTER WHO ITS LEADERS MIGHT BE IS VALUABLE TO THEM. THIS MIGHT CHANGE. IF IT BECOMES OBVIOUS THAT THE SHAH IS VERY VULNERABLE AND THAT OTHER FORCES MIGHT COME INTO POWER, THE SOVIETS MIGHT CHANGE THEIR OBVIOUS POSTURE. BUT THAT IS THE OBSERVATION THAT WE HAVE NOW."
THE STATEMENT DOES NOT MENTION U.S. SUPPORT FOR LIBERALIZATION IN IRAN. INSTEAD IT ENDORSES THE SHAH'S EFFORT TO RESTORE DOMESTIC TRANQUILITY. DOES THIS INDICATE A SHIFT IN U.S. POLICY?

OUR SUPPORT FOR THE SHAH'S EFFORTS TO LIBERALIZE THE IRANIAN POLITICAL SYSTEM IS WELL KNOWN. THIS POSITION HAS BEEN STATED ON NUMEROUS OCCASIONS BY THE PRESIDENT AND SECRETARY VANCE. THE SECRETARY'S STATEMENT OF NOVEMBER 19 REPRESENTS NO CHANGE IN THE U.S. POSITION.
WAS THE U.S. STATEMENT ON IRAN MADE IN RESPONSE TO THE BREZHNEV STATEMENT?
YES.
WAS THE HOTLINE USED OR HAS THE PRESIDENT OTHERWISE BEEN IN TOUCH WITH BREZHNEV ABOUT IRAN?
NO COMMENT ON PRESIDENTIAL COMMUNICATIONS.
WHY DID BREZHNEV MAKE HIS STATEMENT AT THIS TIME?
WE ARE NOT IN A POSITION TO COMMENT ON SOVIET ACTIONS.
WHAT ACTIONS DOES THE U.S. CONTEMPLATE TO "PRESERVE AND PURSUE" ITS INTERESTS IN IRAN?

THE STATEMENT MAKES CLEAR THAT WE CONSIDER IRAN'S DIFFICULTIES STRICTLY AN INTERNAL MATTER. WITHOUT INTERFERING IN ANY WAY IN IRAN'S DOMESTIC AFFAIRS, WE WILL CONTINUE TO MAINTAIN AND PROMOTE OUR COOPERATION WITH IRAN ACROSS A BROAD RANGE OF SHARED INTERESTS. THESE INTERESTS TOUCH ON OFFICIAL PROGRAMS OF COOPERATION AS IN POLITICAL AND DEFENSE MATTERS AS WELL AS ON THE LARGE NUMBER OF PROJECTS WHICH PRIVATE AMERICANS ARE WORKING ON WITH IRANIANS. CHRISTOPHER

FOLLOWING IS A TRANSCRIPT OF QUESTIONS ON IRAN AT NOON PRESS BRIEFING, NOVEMBER 28: Q: COULD YOU TELL US SOMETHING ABOUT THIS REPORT THAT THE UNITED STATES HAS HAD CONTACTS WITH PEOPLE OPPOSING THE SHAH IN IRAN? A: THAT IS CORRECT. Q: IT IS CORRECT? CAN YOU GIVE US SOMETHING ABOUT WHAT THESE CONTACTS ENTAILED AND WHO YOU HAVE BEEN TALKING TO? A: NO. BUT THEY HAVE BEEN GOING ON FOR SOME TIME. THAT IS CLEARLY NOT UNUSUAL. Q: THAT IS NOT UNUSUAL? A: NO. BUT I CAN CONFIRM IT. Q: COULD YOU DEFINE "SOMETIME?" ARE YOU TALKING ABOUT MONTHS, YEARS, WHAT?
A: FOR SOME MONTHS, AT ANY RATE, THAT I AM AWARE OF.

FYI: FOLLOWING IS CONTINGENCY PRESS GUIDANCE PREPARED BUT NOT USED. Q: IS IT TRUE THAT EMBASSY TEHRAN HAS RECENTLY ESTABLISHED CONTACT WITH THE OPPOSITION IN RESPONSE TO THE CRITICISM OF OUR INTELLIGENCE WORK IN TEHRAN? A: NO, THIS IS NOT A RECENT DEVELOPMENT. OUR EMBASSY HAS HAD INFORMAL CONTACTS WITH THE OPPOSITION FOR SOME TIME PRIOR TO THE CURRENT DIFFICULTIES, AS PART OF THE NORMAL POLITICAL WORK OF ANY EMBASSY. OBVIOUSLY, THESE CONTACTS INTENSIFIED AS THE POLITICAL TROUBLESIN IRAN INCREASED EARLIER IN THE YEAR. WE HAVE HAD AND CONTINUE TO HAVE, CONTACTS WITH A VARIETY OF OPPOSITION FIGURES.

WE HAVE MADE NO EFFORT TO HIDE THESE FROM THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT, WHICH IS WELL AWARE OF THESE CONTACTS. ON BACKGROUND: THE COUNTRY DIRECTOR FOR IRAN, HENRY PRECHT, OUTLINED EMBASSY CONTACT WITH THE OPPOSITION ON THE MACNEIL-LEHRER TELEVISION PROGRAM ON NOVEMBER 3. Q: IS IT TRUE THAT EMBASSY TEHRAN HAS SUPPRESSED REPORTING THAT IT HAS DEEMED CONTRARY TO THE THRUST OF AMERICAN POLICY? A: EMBASSY REPORTING HAS BEEN FULLY DESCRIPTIVE OF EVENTS AND TRENDS IN IRAN. WE ARE AWARE OF NO GAPS IN THE EMBASSY'S COVERAGE. WE HAVE FULL CONFIDENCE IN OUR AMBASSADOR. Q: WHAT IS THE SITUATION IN IRAN?

A: WE DO NOT YET HAVE A REPORT FROM OUR EMBASSY, BUT WE UNDERSTAND THAT YESTERDAY WAS RELATIVELY CALM WITH SOME DISTURBANCES IN ISRAHAN IN THE AFTERMATH OF THE NATIONWIDE GENERAL STRIKE. Q: WHAT DO YOU HAVE TO SAY ABOUT REPORTS THAT THE SHAH FEELS U.S. SUPPORT FOR HIM IS WEAK? A: WE HAVE HAD MANY FRANK CONVERSATIONS WITH THE SHAH ABOUT U.S. POLICY ON IRAN, AND HE HAS NOT EXPRESSED ANY CONCERN ABOUT THAT POLICY. Q: HAVE YOU ANY INDICATIONS OF THE TRUTH OF PRESS REPORTS THAT AMERICANS IN OIL COMPANY ACTIVITIES IN IRAN HAVE BEEN INVOLVED IN THE DISTURBANCES THERE? A: NO.
WE HAVE NO EVIDENCE THAT AMERICANS ARE INOLVED IN PROMOTING THE DISTURBANCES IN IRAN. VANCE

CHAIRMAN MOORE AND OTHERS WONDERED ABOUT WHETHER THEY SHOULD PROCEED WITH ADDITIONAL APPLICATIONS SUCH AS THOSE FOR STEEL MILLS. WE ADVISED THEM THAT IT WAS DIFFICULT TO PREDICT HOW PROJECTS MIGHT FARE IN ANY ECONOMIC REEVALUATION. IN GENERAL WE ATTEMPTED TO REASSURE THEM THAT GOI WOULD CONTINUE TO REQUIRE SUPPLIERS CREDITS FOR PROJECT FINANCING. SOME DELAYS IN DEALING WITH IRANIANS WOULD BE INEVITABLE, PARTICULARLY IN WEEKS AHEAD.

HOWEVER, WE POINTED OUT ANY DENIAL OR CANCELLATION WOULD CREATE STRONG NEGATIVE SIGNAL NOT COMPATIBLE TO BANK'S LONGER TERM INTERESTS IN IRAN. THEY AGREED AND FELT BEST COURSE WOULD BE TO TEMPORIZE. WITH REGARD TO PRIVATE SECTOR PARTICIPATION, THERE WAS LESS CERTAINTY. BANK WILL PROBABLY SEEK EMBASSY'S VIEWS ON CASE BY CASE BASIS.
WE ALSO DISCUSSED POSSIBLE TRIP OF CHAIRMAN MOORE. FEELING WAS THAT IT WOULD BE BETTER TO POSTPONE VISIT FROM JANUARY TO PERHAPS LATER IN THE YEAR.

WE DID NOT PULL ANY PUNCHES IN DESCRIBING VERY SAD CONDITION OF THE IRANIAN POLITICAL AND ECONOMIC SCENE. OUR PRESENTATION WAS NOT SUBSTANTIALLY DIFFERENT IN TENOR FROM DESCRIPTIVE REPORTS PUBLISHED FOLLOWING DAY IN NY TIMES AND TIME MAGAZINE. VANCE

EMBASSY TEHRAN HAS POUCHED TO THE DEPARTMENT THE FOLLOWING DESCRIPTION AND ANALYSIS OF THE FOREIGN POLICY ORIENTATION OF OPPOSITION ELEMENTS IN IRAN. THIS IS A SUBJECT OF POTENTIALLY HIGH IMPORTANCE AND WE WOULD APPRECIATE YOUR SHARING THE GIST OF THIS MESSAGE WITH KNOWLEDGEABLE OFFICIALS INHMG, BEARING IN MIND SENSITIVITY OF THIS MATERIAL. PLEASE REPORT ASAP.

BEGIN TEXT: SUMMARY: EXTRAPOLATING FROM AN ADMITTEDLY THIN DATA BASE OF KHOMEINI SPEECHES, OPPOSITION TRACTS, AND PRIVATE OPPOSITION COMMENTS, WE BELIEVE A NUMBER OF CHANGES WOULD TAKE PLACE IN SHORT-TERM IRANIAN FOREIGN POLICY IF THE OPPOSITION SUCCEEDED IN OUSTING THE SHAH. THESE WOULD PROJECT MILITANT NATIONALISM, ISLAM AND (PROBABLY) SOCIALISM, WITH ASSERTIONS OF NON-ALIGNMENT, NON-INTERVENTIONISM, AND ANTIWESTERN RHETORIC. TIES WITH ISRAEL AND SOUTH AFRICA WOULD BE CUT. U.S. CONTRACTS AND PRESENCE WOULD BE REDUCED. INTELLIGENCE COOPERATION WOULD SUFFER. A DEGREE OF ADVENTURISM IN SUPPORT OF MOSLEM OPPOSITION IN AFGHANISTAN MIGHT BE SANCTIONED. GREATER OIL PRICE HIKES WOULD BE PURSUED.

HOWEVER, IN THE ABSENCE OF A COMMUNIST SEIZURE OF POWER (WHICH WE CONSIDER UNLIKELY) THE DOMINANCE OF THE MILITARY AND NATIONALIST CONSERVATIVE ELEMENTS WOULD IN ALL LIKELIHOOD ENSURE AN EVENTUAL RETURN TO THE ESSENTIALS OF IRANIAN NATIONAL SURVIVAL -- A DENIAL OF TERRITORY AND INFLUENCE TO THE SOVIETS, PROTECTION OF OIL RESOURCES AGAINST ALL COMERS, AND DESIRE FOR ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT WITH FOREIGN ASSISTANCE. NEVERTHELESS, THE DEGREE TO WHICH NEAR-TERM CONFUSION MIGHT AFFECT THE LONG-TERM LOGIC OF IRANIAN POLICY IS HARD TO PREDICE WITH ACCURACY AT PRESENT. END SUMMARY. FOREIGN POLICY HAS NOT APPEARED AS AN AREA OF IMPORTANT CONTROVERSY IN THE OPPOSITION'S DRIVE AGAINST THE SHAH.

SUCH ASPECTS WHICH HAVE CREPT INTO PUBLIC DISCUSSION HAVE GENERALLY BEEN LIMITED TO STATEMENTS AGAINST U.S. OR BRITISH "COLONIALISM" AS WELL AS OCCASIONAL ANTI-COMMUNIST OR ANTI-SOVIET BLASTS. ISRAEL HAS BEEN CASTIGATED PROBABLY EVEN MORE THAN THE U.S. DUE TO LATENT ANTI-SEMITISM IN OPPOSITION MOBS, DESPITE REASSURANCES OF TOLERANCE FROM TOP OPPOSITION RELIGIOUS LEADERS. AS WE HYPOTHETICALLY ASSESS THE NATURE OF ANY SUCCESSOR REGIME TO THE SHAH'S, THEREFORE, WE MUST ATTEMPT TO ESTIMATE PROBABLE DIRECTIONS OF FOREIGN POLICY EVEN IN THE ABSENCE OF FIRM EVIDENCE. ONE COMPLICATION IS THE NATURE OF ANY SUCH REGIME ITSELF.

MILITARY DICTATORS OF THE RIGHT ARE LIKELY TO MAKE THE LEAST NUMBER OF CHANGES IN IRAN'S FOREIGN POLICY. A REGIME DOMINATED BY AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI AND TOP RELIGIOUS LEADERS WOULD MAKE SOMEWHAT DIFFERENT CHANGES THAN A REGIME DOMINATED BY LEFT-LEANING LEADERS OF THE OPPOSITION NATIONAL FRONT OR -- A SLIGHT POSSIBILITY ONLY -- A COMMUNIST DOMINATED GOVERNMENT. IN ESTIMATING POSSIBLE CHANGES, THEREFORE, WE ASSUME AS MOST LIKELY SOME COMBINATION OF MILITARY RULE WITH THE SUPPORT OF TOP RELIGIOUS LEADERS AND NATIONAL FRONT POLITICIANS.

THE COMMON DENOMINATORS OF SUCH A REGIME WOULD BE PROUD NATIONALISM AND AN EFFORT TO DIFFERENTIATE FROM THE SHAH'S REGIME IN TONE AND APPEARANCE EVEN WHEN THIS MIGHT NOT BE POSSIBLE IN SUBSTANCE. THE USG IS FREQUENTLY ACCUSED BY THE OPPOSITION AS HAVING INSTALLED THE SHAH AND KEEPING HIM IN POWER. ISRAEL IS SOMETIMES DEPICTED AS A JUNIOR PARTNER OF THE U.S., SOMETIMES AS AN ENEMY OF ISLAM AND PART OF A WORLD-WIDE ZIONIST CONSPIRACY. MANY OF THE MORE MODERATE OPPOSITION LEADERS HAVE ASSURED EMBASSY OFFICERS IN PROVATE THAT THEY HAVE NO BASIC QUARREL WITH THE USG AND ONLY REQUEST THAT THE USG STOP SUPPORTING THE SHAH.

MANY HAVE EMPHASIZED THE ESSENTIAL NEED IRAN HAS FOR A LARGE PROTECTOR SUCH AS THE U.S. AGAINST THE PERENNIAL SOVIET ENEMY ON ITS BORDERS. INDEED, SOME OF THESE MODERATES PREDICATE THEIR DRIVE TO RID IRAN OF THE SHAH AT THIS TIME IN TERMS OF THIS BEING A RELATIVELY SAFE TIME BECAUSE THEY SEE COMMUNIST INFLUENCE IN IRAN AS MINOR OR NEGLIGIBLE. THE CONCERN THEY EXPRESS TO THE EMBASSY IS THAT THE USG MIGHT SUPPORT THE SHAH'S "BANKRUPT REGIME" IN POWER WITH THE ASSISTANCE OF A REPRESSIVE MILITARY FOR A LONG PERIOD OF TIME, THUS DRIVING MORE PEOPLE INTO THE COMMUNIST CAMP OUT OF DESPERATION.

VERY FEW OF THESE LEADERS REALLY WORRY HARD ABOUT THAT POSSIBILITY, HOWEVER, AS THEY ARE CONFIDENT AT PRESENT THAT THE SHAH CANNOT LAST MUCH LONGER. A RELATIVELY NEW PHENOMENON SINCE AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI'S ARRIVAL IN PARIS HAS BEEN HIS PROPENSITY TO HINT AT FOREIGN POLICY CHANGES MORE AND MORE OFTEN IN HIS PUBLIC INTERVIEWS. THESE ARE GENERALLY CRYPTIC REFERENCES TO BE INFERRED FROM HIS ATTACKS ON THE LARGE AMERICAN PRESENCE IN IRAN AND HIS EMPHASIS ON INDEPENDENT IRANIAN NATIONALISM STRUGGLING AGAINST THE ATTEMPTS OF POWERS SUCH AS THE U.S., THE SOVIET UNION, BRITAIN, AND EVEN MAINLAND CHINA TO CONTROL IRAN'S AFFAIRS.

MANY OF KHOMEINI'S STATEMENTS ARE WEAK IN LOGIC BUT STRONG IN EMOTION -- SUCH AS HIS ACCUSATION THAT "PAHLAVI" HAS BEEN "GIVING AWAY" IRAN'S OIL TO WESTERN EXPLOITERS (A THEME REMINICIENT OF MOSSADEQ 25 YEARS AGO -- WHEN IT WAS PERHAPS MORE JUSTIFIED). KHOMEINI'S UTTERANCES OF THE PAST TWO YEARS, MANY OF WHICH WERE HEARD HERE ON TAPE, ARE REPLETE WITH HIGHLY EMOTIONAL, QADDAFI-LIKE ATTACKS ON THE WEST.

IN A RECENT INTERVIEW WITH THE FRENCH LEFTIST PAPER "LIBERATION" KHOMEINI HAS BECOME EVEN MORE SPECIFIC, SAYING "ALL THE CONTRACTS AND AGREEMENTS MADE WITH FOREIGNERS AGAINST THE INTERESTS OF THE NATION WILL BE CANCELLED." THUS LIKELY CHANGES WE SEE IF SUCH A SITUATION AROSE WOULD INCLUDE THE FOLLOWING

A DEMAND FOR DEPARTURE OF MOST FOREIGN RESIDENT WORKERS, PARTICULARLY THE AMERICANS. THIS MAY OR MAY NOT INCLUDE EQUAL EMPHASIS ON THE SOVIETS, DEPENDING ON THE NATURE OF THE NEW GOVERNMENT. --ASSOCIATED WITH THIS DEMAND WOULD BE A CUT IN THE MILITARY BUDGET FOR NEW ARMAMENTS AND CONSEQUENTLY IN THE NUMBER OF (MAINLY AMERICAN) ADVISERS AND TECHNICIANS. THIS DEMAND MIGHT BE MITIGATED SOMEWHAT IF THE MILITARY MAINTAINED AN IMPORTANT VOICE IN THE SUCCESSOR GOVERNMENT. --LOUD ANNOUNCEMENTS OF THE NATIONALIST, NON-ALIGNED CHARACTER OF THE NEW IRAN. THIS WOULD BE REFLECTED IN LESS FRIENDLY RHETORIC TOWARD THE U.S.
AND THE WEST AND PERHAPS MORE FRIENDLY RHETORIC TOWARD THE SOVIET UNION (DEPENDING ON THE STRENGTH OF LEFTIST INFLUENCES IN THE GOVERNMENT).

PUBLIC ANNOUNCEMENT OF NON-INTERVENTION IN THE AFFAIRS OF OTHERS, EXPLICITLY OR TACITLY INCLUDING THE AREAS OF THE PERSIAN GULF, INDIAN SUBCONTINENT, AND HORN OF AFRICA. IRANIAN TROOPS IN OMAN WOULD BE RECALLED AND A "MORE CORRECT" ATTITUDE DECREED TOWARD ALL NEIGHBORS. THIS FACTOR WOULD BE PERHAPS DIMINISHED IN A GOVERNMENT DOMINATED BY RELIGIOUS AND MILITARY INFLUENCES AS REGARDS AFGHANISTAN, WHERE CLANDESTINE SUPPORT FOR ISLAMIC OPPOSITION MOVEMENTS MIGHT BE SANCTIONED.

A REVERSAL OF POLICY TOWARD ISRAEL WHICH WOULD PROBABLY INCLUDE STOPPING OF OIL SHIPMENTS AND CANCELLATION OF ALMOST ALL JOINT COOPERATION PROJECTS IN AGRICULTURE AND ELSEWHERE. THE EFFECTS OF THIS POLICY WOULD PROBABLY BE LIMITED INSOFAR AS ARABS ARE NOT GREAT FAVORITES IN IRAN DESPITE THE GENERAL AURA OF PRO-ARAB SENTIMENT BEING EXUDED BY KHOMEINI IN PARIS. RUPTURE OF TIES WITH ISRAEL WOULD PROBABLY BRING SIMILAR RUPTURE OF LESSER TIES WITH SOUTH AFRICA, MAINLY THE SUPPLY OF OIL.
A PUSH TO INCREASE OIL PRICES TO THE MAXIMUM.

SIGNIFICANT DECLINE IN INTELLIGENCE COOPERATION WITH THE U.S. AND OTHER WESTERN NATIONS. IF LEFTISTS PREDOMINATED IN THE GOVERNMENT WE MIGHT SEE THE SOVIET UNION MAKE A STRONG EFFORT TO APPLY GREATER "NEUTRALITY" TO IRAN'S POLICY.

MORE EMPHASIS ON SOLIDARITY WITH THE WORLD'S SOCIALIST MOVEMENT (PARTICULARLY IF LEFTISTS WERE PROMINENT IN GOVERNMENT) AND A GREATER EFFORT TO FAVOR WESTERN EUROPEAN COUNTRIES SUCH AS FRANCE OVER THE U.S. OR BRITAIN IN TRADE AND ARMAMENT PURCHASES.

DOMESTIC CONSIDERATIONS WOULD OBVIOUSLY BE DICTATING FOREIGN POLICY ALMOST ENTIRELY, AND THERE WOULD BE LITTLE LEFT OF THE BROAD APPROACH TO IRANIAN NATIONAL SECURITY TAKEN BY THE SHAH IN RECENT YEARS. STUDENTS AND OTHER MILITANTS RETURNING IN LARGE NUMBERS FROM THE U.S., WESTERN AND EASTERN EUROPEAN COUNTRIES WOULD UNDOUBTEDLY EXERT A CONSIDERABLE INFLUENCE IN THESE CHANGES. REORIENTATION OF DOMESTIC SPENDING TOWARD AGRICULTURE, HOUSING, MOSQUES, ETC. WOULD GREATLY CUT DOWN THE NEED FOR FOREIGN TECHNICIANS AND SUSPEND OR END MOST FOREIGN TECHNICAL COOPERATION. NEVERTHELESS, WE BELIEVE NO SUCCESSOR GOVERNMENT COULD LONG DENY OBVIOUS REALITIES. THUS CONTINUITY IN IRANIAN FOREIGN POLICY WOULD BE EXPRESSED IN SEVERAL IMPORTANT RESPECTS
DENIAL OF IRANIAN TERRITORY TO THE SOVIETS AND AN EFFORT TO LIMIT SOVIET INFLUENCE IN IRAN.

READINESS TO PROTECT OIL RESOURCES AGAINST ALL COMERS, TO INCLUDE SOME PROTECTION OF THE SEA LANES IMMEDIATELY ADJOINING IRANIAN TERRITORY, THOUGH IN A LESS AGGRESSIVE FASHION THAN INDICATED BY THE PUBLIC PRONOUNCEMENTS OF THE SHAH.

A DESIRE FOR FOREIGN HELP TO BUCK UP AN ECONOMY WHICH WILL HAVE RECEIVED MANY BLOWS AND WILL IN ALL PROBABILITY BE FOUNDERING IN THE ABSENCE OF INVESTOR CONFIDENCE AND WITH LARGE SCALE FLIGHT OF CAPITAL. SUCH HELP WOULD UNDOUBTEDLY BE SLOW IN COMING GIVEN THE EMPHASIS ANY SUCCESSOR GOVERNMENT WOULD PUT ON "NO STRINGS ATTACHED." THESE FACTORS OF CONTINUITY WOULD IN THE LONG RUN LIKELY ENSURE THE PRESERVATION OF WHAT THE U.S. AND THE WEST CONSIDER THEIR MINIMAL ESSENTIAL INTERESTS IN IRAN, NAMELY ITS TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY, NON-COMMUNIST GOVERNMENT, AND CONTINUING EXPORT OF OIL TO THE WEST.

THE CHANGES PROBABLE IN THE NEAR TERM, HOWEVER, COULD WORK A CONSIDERABLE DEGREE OF TEMPORARY DISRUPTION WHICH WOULD CONFUSE AND WEAKEN NOT ONLY THE NEW IRANIAN GOVERNMENT BUT ALSO ITS ERSTWHILE SUPPORTERS IN THE WEST. WE ASSUME THE SOVIET UNION WOULD NOT TAKE AGGRESSIVE ACTIONS. HOWEVER, THE EXACT EFFECTS OF NEAR TERM CHANGES ON THE LONG TERM PROSPECTS CANNOT BE PREDICTED IN GREATER DETAIL AT THIS

1978STATE306445.subject: REDUCTION IN SIZE OF AMERICAN COMMUNITY IN IRAN

segments.text: SECRETARY APPRECIATES YOUR LUCID ANALYSIS OF THE AGONIZING DECISION ON WHETHER TO ENCOURAGE DEPENDENTS TO LEAVE IRAN. HE APPRECIATES THE WEIGHT OF YOUR ARGUMENT AND WILL BE CONSIDERING IT FURTHER.

MEANWHILE, WE ARE WONDERING WHETHER THERE IS ANY WAY TO PROVIDE ADDITIONAL SECURITY TO PEOPLE WITHIN THE GENERAL AREAS WHERE THEY NOW LIVE BY MAKING IT POSSIBLE FOR THOSE WHO MAY LIVE IN ISOLATED LOCATIONS TO MOVE TEMPORARILY INTO MORE PROTECTED AREAS. FOR INSTANCE, IF IT APPEARS THAT VIOLENCE IS GOING TO BE DIRECTED AT AMERICAN HOMES, IS THERE SOME WAY TO CONGREGATE PEOPLE IN CERTAIN AREAS WHERE THE MILITARY MIGHT PROVIDE CONCENTRATED PROTECTION? OR, IF THAT IS NOT FEASIBLE, HOW EFFECTIVE WOULD IT BE TO GET THE IRANIANS TO INCREASE THEIR PATROLS IN AREAS WHERE AMERICANS ARE CONCENTRATED? VANCE

SEC ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING MCDONNEL-DOUGLAS NOW SCHEDULED TO TAKE PLACE DECEMBER 14.
INFORMATION COVERING OTHER ASPECTS OF REFTEL WILL BE

IN ORDER TO GIVE OUR OFFICIAL DEPENDENTS THE SAME OPTION THAT IS AVAILABLE TO DEPENDENTS OF OTHER AMERICAN EMPLOYEES IN IRAN, THOSE OFFICIAL DEPENDENTS WHO WISH TO LEAVE IRAN TEMPORARILY MAY DO SO. APPROPRIATE FUNDING CITATION WILL BE PROVIDED SEPTEL.

BEFORE YOU INFORM YOUR STAFF, PLEASE ADVISE THE PRIME MINISTER IN A LOW KEY FASHION OF OUR DECISION. YOU SHOULD EMPHASIZE THAT WE ARE NOT WITHDRAWING OUR STAFF AND THAT WE HAVE EVERY INTENTION OF CONTINUING TO SUPPORT THE GOI THROUGH OUR MILITARY AND CIVILIAN PROGRAMS IN IRAN. FINALLY, WE ARE NOT CHANGING OUR GUIDANCE TO AMERICANS RESIDENT IN IRAN, BUT IT IS PROBABLE THAT INCREASED NUMBERS OF PRIVATE DEPENDENTS WILL SEEK TO EXERCISE THIS OPTION NOW THAT WE ARE OFFERING IT TO OUR STAFF.
WE ARE UNCLEAR AS TO HOW MANY DEPENDENTS MIGHT WISH TO LEAVE. OUR THOUGHT IS THAT PERHAPS VERY FEW WOULD WISH TO DO SO. IN ANY EVENT, WE SUGGEST YOU ESTABLISH CONTACT WITH

H. ROSS PEROT, PRESIDENT OF ELECTRONIC DATA SYSTEMS, DALLAS, TELEPHONED HA DEPT. ASST. SEC. FRANK SIEVERTS DEC. 5 TO EXPRESS HIS SERIOUS CONCERN ABOUT THE SAFETY OF SOME EDS STAFF AND OFFICERS IN FACE OF IMPLIED THREATS RESULTING FROM EDS EFFORTS IN RECENT DAYS TO OBTAIN PAYMENT FOR SOME $8.5 MILLION ARREARAGES FROM GOI AND BANK OF OMRAN. ACCORDING TO PEROT, EDS OPERATES MAJOR DATA CENTER FOR MINISTRY OF HEALTH AND WELFARE, AND COMPUTERS FOR THE BANK, BUT HAS NOT BEEN PAID SINCE JUNE.

SEVERAL OF HIS TOP AIDES IN IRAN DISCUSSED THIS WITH RESPONSIBLE IRANIANS IN RECENT DAYS, AFTER WHICH AN EFFORT WAS MADE TO PICK UP THE PASSPORTS OF SOME OF THE CONCERNED OFFICERS. HE REPORTS THE PASSPORTS HAVE BEEN GIVEN TO LEW GOELZ OF THE EMBASSY FOR SAFEKEEPING, BUT THAT HIS CONCERN FOR THE SAFETY OF HIS EMPLOYEES AND THEIR DEPENDENTS IS SERIOUS.

PEROT SAYS EDS HAS 360 AMERICAN EMPLOYEES AND DEPENDENTS IN IRAN, AND HE IS NOT AT THE MOMENT RAISING CONCERN ABOUT ALL OF THEM, BUT ABOUT TWO FAMILIES IN PARTICULAR: PAUL CHIAPPARONE AND WILLIAM D. GAYLORD. THE FORMER FAMILY HAS PAPERS IN ORDER FOR DEPARTURE, BUT THE GAYLORDS NEED HELP IN SECURING DEPARTURE DOCUMENTS. HE ASKS IF THESE TWO FAMILIES COULD RECEIVE EMBASSY HELP IN PROVIDING FOR THEIR SAFETY, BY SAFE HAVEN IN THE EMBASSY IF NECESSARY. A THIRD OFFICER INVOLVED IS PAUL BUCHER, WHOSE FAMILY IS NOT WITH HIM.
PEROT HAS ASKED HIS TOP MAN IN IRAN, MR. BILL GAYDEN, PRESIDENT OF EDS INTERNATIONAL, TO SEE AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN TO DISCUSS THIS SITUATION.
HE NOTES THAT THE AFFECTED STAFF ARE THE ONES WHO SIGNED INVOICES OR RECEIPTS FOR WHICH PAYMENT HAS NOT BEEN RECEIVED. HE SAYS THERE HAVE BEEN NO ALLEGATIONS OF INADEQUATE PERFORMANCE OR IMPROPRIETY.

PEROT SAYS HE RECOGNIZES THE BROADER IMPLICATIONS OF THE CURRENT SITUATION AND HAS NO DESIRE TO PULL HIS PROGRAM OUT OF IRAN, WHICH HE SAYS WOULD HAVE CRIPPLING EFFECTS ON THE MINISTRY AND THE BANK. HE DOES HOWEVER WANT TO BE PAID, AND HE IS CONCERNED ABOUT APPARENT THREATS TO

IN RESPONSE TO REFTEL, WE WANT YOU TO KNOW THAT THE STATE DEPARTMENT SPOKESMAN TODAY IS ISSUING THE FOLLOWING STATEMENT: "THE PRESIDENT'S COMMENTS AT HIS BREAKFAST MEETING WITH REPORTERS YESTERDAY DO NOT INDICATE ANY CHANGE IN U.S. POLICY TOWARDS IRAN AND OUR SUPPORT FOR THE SHAH. AS STATED BEFORE BY THE PRESIDENT, THE U.S. HAS NO INTENTION OF INTERVENING IN IRANIAN AFFAIRS AND EXPECTS ALL OTHER COUNTRIES TO ABSTAIN FROM ANY INTERFERENCE."

IN ADDITION, THE SECRETARY WANTS YOU TO KNOW THAT HE HAS ASKED DR. BRZEZINSKI TO CALL AMBASSADOR ZAHEDI ON HIS BEHALF TO MAKE HIM AWARE OF THIS STATEMENT AND TO EMPHASIZE THAT THERE HAS BEEN NO CHANGE IN AMERICAN POLICY.

THE STATEMENT IS BEING ISSUED AT THE DEPARTMENT'S NOON BRIEFING. THE WHITE HOUSE IS TELLING REPORTERS ON BACKGROUND THAT THE PRESIDENT REQUESTED THE DEPARTMENT TO ISSUE THIS POLICY STATEMENT BECAUSE OF HIS CONCERN AT THE TWIST CONTAINED IN PRESS REPORTS OF HIS BREAKFAST REMARKS DECEMBER 7 TO REPORTERS. WHITE HOUSE IS NOT HAVING A DAILY BRIEFING TODAY. DEPARTMENT SPOKESMAN WILL CONFIRM IN ANSWER TO QUESTIONS AT BRIEFING THAT POLICY STATEMENT HAS BEEN ISSUED ON BEHALF OF THE PRESIDENT. VANCE

1978STATE310406.subject: MESSAGE ON IRAN AND THE SECURITY OF THE GULF

segments.text: PLEASE REITERATE TO CROWN PRINCE FAHD THAT WE ARE FOLLOWING THE SITUATION IN IRAN WITH THE GREATEST CONCERN AND THE FULLEST POSSIBLE APPRECIATION OF THE IMPLICATIONS OF THE SITUATION FOR THE VITAL INTERESTS OF OURSELVES AND OUR FRIENDS. WE WANT HIM TO KNOW THAT WE ARE EXAMINING CAREFULLY AND URGENTLY THE PRESENT SITUATION AND ARE PREPARED TO DISCUSS IT WITH THE GOVERNMENT OF SAUDI ARABIA AT ANY TIME. WE HOPE HE WILL FEEL FREE TO COMMUNICATE WITH US AT ANY TIME ABOUT HIS OWN PERCEPTIONS OF THE SITUATION.

YOU SHOULD ALSO GIVE FAHD FOLLOWING TEXT OF STATEMENT ISSUED ON BEHALF OF THE PRESIDENT AT NOON BRIEFING DECEMBER 8. : THE PRESIDENT'S COMMENTS AT HIS BREAKFAST MEETING WITH REPORTERS YESTERDAY DO NOT INDICATE ANY CHANGE IN U.S. POLICY TOWARDS IRAN AND OUR SUPPORT FOR THE SHAH. AS STATED BEFORE BY THE PRESIDENT, THE U.S. HAS NO INTENTION OF INTERVENING IN IRANIAN AFFAIRS AND EXPECTS ALL OTHER COUNTRIES TO ABSTAIN FROM ANY INTERFERENCE. END . THIS STATEMENT WAS MADE BECAUSE OF MISINTERPRETATION IN THE PRESS OF THE PRESIDENT'S REMARKS THE PREVIOUS DAY.

YOU SHOULD ASSURE THAT FAHD UNDERSTANDS THAT WE BELIEVE THE SHAH CONTINUES TO PLAY AN IMPORTANT ROLE IN IRAN IN ASSURING STABILITY. AS COMMANDER-IN-CHIEF, HE IS UNIQUELY ABLE TO PROVIDE THE LEADERSHIP AND RALLYING POINT FOR THE ARMED FORCES.

PLEASE ASK FAHD IF THE SAUDIS HAVE THEMSELVES CONSIDERED MEASURES THAT MIGHT BE USEFUL TO ASSIST IRAN AT THIS TIME, E.G., A MESSAGE OF SUPPORT OR AN EMISSARY TO TEHRAN. SAY THAT THE PRESIDENT AND SECRETARY WOULD WELCOME ANY POSITIVE STEP THE SAUDIS MIGHT DECIDE WOULD BE USEFUL TO TAKE. NEWSOM

DURING PAST SEVERAL DAYS DEPTOFF HAS REVIEWED IRANIAN SITUATION WITH INDIAN, PAKISTANI AND TURKISH EMBOFFS. EACH OF THEM WAS EXTREMELY PESSIMISTIC ABOUT SHAH'S SURVIVAL CHANCES. PAKISTANI SAID THAT SENIOR LEVELS IN HIS FOREIGN MINISTRY HAD BEEN CONVINCED FOR 3-4 MONTHS THAT SHAH'S DAYS WERE NUMBERED. ALTHOUGH NONE OF THE OFFICERS INDICATED HE WAS EXPRESSING AN OFFICIAL POSITION, EACH WAS CONVINCED THAT REMOVAL OF THE SHAH WOULD BE FOLLOWED SOONER OR LATER BY A LEFT-ORIENTED GOVERNMENT. NONE OF THE OFFICERS SUGGESTED THEIR GOVERNMENTS HAD ANY INDICATION THAT THE SOVIETS OR THEIR FRIENDS WERE MEDDLING IN IRAN.

NONE OF THE VISITORS HAD ANYTHING TO CONTRIBUTE ON TUDEH PARTY OR OTHER COMMUNIST ACTIVITY IN IRAN. DEPTOFF ASKED EACH OF THEM IF HE COULD SHARE WITH US ANY INFORMATION THAT WAS DEVELOPED ON THESE SUBJECTS.

DURING THESE CONVERSATIONS, DEPTOFF TRIED DELICATELY TO SOUND OUT VISITORS AS TO WHETHER THEIR GOVERNMENTS MIGHT BE INTERESTED IN PASSING A PRIVATE OR PUBLIC MESSAGE OF SUPPORT TO THE SHAH. THERE WAS NO ENCOURAGEMENT ON THIS POINT FROM ANY OF THE EMBOFFS. IN GENERAL, THEY CONVEYED THE VIEW THAT WHAT THEIR GOVERNMENTS SAID TO THE SHAH WOULD HAVE LITTLE IMPACT ON THE WAY HE ADDRESSED IRAN'S CRISIS.

IN ADDITION, DEPTOFF ASKED TURK DCM TO ASK HIS GOVERNMENT IF IT WOULD MONITOR INDICATIONS OF OPINION IN AZERBAIJAN AND KURDISH AREAS THAT SUGGESTED A GROWTH IN AUTONOMOUS SENTIMENTS. HE AGREED TO DO SO.
WE HAVE SEVERAL QUESTIONS ABOUT CONVERSATION REPORTED REFTEL.
WILL THE CDHRF REPRESENT OTHER OPPOSITION GROUPS IN COALITION DISCUSSIONS WITH THE GOVERNMENT OR IN CONTACTS WITH THE BRITISH AND AMERICANS? (PAR 3 REFTEL).
IF THE SHAH IS TO AGREE TO A REGENCY COUNCIL AND THEN DEPART IRAN IS HE TO BE ALLOWED FIRST TO PICK THE MEMBERS OF THE REGENCY COUNCIL? (PARA 4).
IS HE ALSO TO BE ALLOWED TO PICK THE NEW CABINET? (PARA 4).

DOES THE CDHRF EXPECT THE US AND UK AMBASSADORS TO PRESENT THE LISTS OF THE CABINET AND REGENCY COUNCIL TO THE SHAH FOR HIS SELECTION? ARE THE AMBASSADORS EXPECTED TO ENDORSE THE LIST AND URGE THE SHAH TO ACCEPT IT? (PARA 4).

WHO IN THE EMBASSY'S JUDGMENT WAS PRIMARILY RESPONSIBLE FOR NEGOTIATING THE PEACEFUL MARCH OF DECEMBER 9 (REFTEL REFERS TO ALI AMINI; OTHER REPORTS HAVE MENTIONED SANJABI. AND ZAHEDI HAS TAKEN CREDIT.) CHRISTOPHER
FOLLOWING QUESTIONS ON IRAN AND OPEC OIL PRICES AND PRESIDENT'S ANSWERS, GIVEN AT DECEMBER 12 PRESS CONFERENCE, ARE PROVIDED FOR YOUR INFORMATION

QUESTION: MR. PRESIDENT, WHAT WILL BE THE DOMESTIC AND INTERNATIONAL EFFECT IF THE SHAH FAILS TO MAINTAIN POWER IN IRAN? THE PRESIDENT: I FULLY EXPECT THE SHAH TO MAINTAIN POWER IN IRAN AND FOR THE PRESENT PROBLEMS IN IRAN TO BE RESOLVED, ALTHOUGH THERE HAVE BEEN CERTAINLY DEPLORABLE INSTANCES OF BLOODSHED WHICH WE WOULD CERTAINLY WANT TO AVOID, OR SEE AVOIDED. I THINK THE PREDICTIONS OF DOOM AND DISASTER THAT CAME FROM SOME SOURCES HAVE CERTAINLY NOT BEEN REALIZED AT ALL. THE SHAH HAS OUR SUPPORT AND HE ALSO HAS OUR CONFIDENCE.

WE HAVE NO INTENTION OF INTERFERING IN THE INTERNAL AFFAIRS OF IRAN AND WE HAVE NO INTENTION OF PERMITTING OTHERS TO INTERFERE IN THE INTERNAL AFFAIRS OF IRAN. THE DIFFICULT SITUATION THERE HAS BEEN EXACERBATED BY UNCONTROLLED STATEMENTS MADE FROM FOREIGN NATIONS THAT ENCOURAGE BLOOD BATHS AND VIOLENCE. THIS IS SOMETHING THAT REALLY IS DEPLORABLE AND I WOULD HOPE WOULD CEASE AFTER THIS HOLY SEASON PASSES. I THINK IT IS GOOD TO POINT OUT THAT THE IRANIAN PEOPLE FOR 2500 YEARS, PERHAPS AS LONG AS ALMOST ANY NATION ON EARTH, HAVE HAD THE ABILITY FOR STABLE, SELF-GOVERNMENT.

THERE HAVE BEEN CHANGES IN THE GOVERNMENT, YES, SOMETIMES VIOLENCE, BUT THEY HAVE A HISTORY OF AN ABILITY TO GOVERN THEMSELVES AND BECAUSE OF THAT AND OTHER FACTORS WHICH I HAVE JUST DESCRIBED, I THINK THE SITUATION IN IRAN WILL BE RESOLVED SUCCESSFULLY.

QUESTION: MR. PRESIDENT, TO WHAT EXTENT ARE YOU CONCERNED OVER THE PROSPECT OF THE OPEC NATIONS RAISING THE PRICE OF OIL THIS WEEKEND -- REPORTS ARE IT WILL BE IN THE NEIGHBORHOOD OF 5 PERCENT -- THE IMPACTS IT WILL HAVE ON INFLATION, AND DO YOU CONTEMPLATE ANY FUTURE ACTIONS TO CURB IMPORTS? THE PRESIDENT: MOST OF OUR PROBLEMS WITH THE ADVERSE TRADE BALANCES CAN BE ATTRIBUTED TO OIL IMPORTS, ALTHOUGH WE HAVE OTHER PROBLEMS AS WELL. I CERTAINLY HOPE THAT THE OPEC NATIONS WILL DECIDE NOT TO RAISE THE PRICE OF OIL. IF THEY DO, I HOPE IT WOULD BE MINIMAL.

WE HAVE TRIED TO CONVINCE THEM THAT THIS IS IN THE BEST INTERESTS OF THE WORLD ECONOMY AND ALSO IN THE BEST INTERESTS OF THE OPEC NATIONS THEMSELVES, TO HAVE A STABLE WORLD ECONOMY WITH MINIMUM INFLATION IN THE FUTURE. WE ARE TRYING TO SET A GOOD EXAMPLE IN OUR OWN NATION, BOTH IN CONTROLLING INFLATION AND ALSO IN STABILIZING THE VALUE OF THE DOLLAR ON WHICH THE PRICE OF OIL IS BASED. THE COUNTRIES IN THE OPEC NATIONS HAVE SUFFERED SOMEWHAT, BECAUSE FOR A TIME THE DOLLAR VALUE WAS GOING DOWN VERY RAPIDLY. IT HAS RECOVERED SINCE THE FIRST OF NOVEMBER.

SO I WOULD HOPE, FIRST OF ALL, TO REPEAT MYSELF, THAT THERE WILL BE NO INCREASE IN THE PRICE OF OIL. IF THEY MUST INCREASE THE PRICE OF OIL, I THINK IT OUGHT TO BE MINIMAL FOR THEIR OWN BENEFIT AND FOR THE BENEFIT OF THE

1978STATE313198.subject: NEA PRESS BRIEFING FOR YOUR INFORMATION, FOLLOWING ARE GUIDANCES PROVIDED TO DEPARTMENT SPOKESMAN DECEMBER 12 WHICH NOT USED IN

segments.text: FOR YOUR INFORMATION, FOLLOWING ARE GUIDANCES PROVIDED TO DEPARTMENT SPOKESMAN DECEMBER 12 WHICH NOT USED IN NOON BRIEFING AS QUESTIONS NOT RAISED: IRANIAN SITUATION REPORT WHAT IS THE SITUATION IN IRAN?

TEHRAN WAS APPARENTLY QUIET FOR THE THIRD DAY. THERE WERE NO MAJOR DEMONSTRATIONS TODAY. ISFAHAN WAS THE SCENE OF SERIOUS VIOLENCE YESTERDAY WITH EXPLOSIONS, FIRES, AND CONSIDERABLE SHOOTING REPORTED. TODAY THE CALM SEEMS TO HAVE RETURNED TO ISFAHAN. WE UNDERSTAND THE SECURITY FORCES ARE PRESENT IN LARGE NUMBERS TO PREVENT VIOLENCE. NO AMERICANS HAVE BEEN INJURED IN IRAN.
WERE HELICOPTERS USED TO FIRE ON DEMONSTRATORS IN ISFAHAN?
OUR EMBASSY HAS STATED THEY CANNOT CONFIRM THE PRESS REPOSTS. MOVEMENTS OF AMERICANS WHAT IS THE SITUATION ON AMERICANS LEAVING IRAN?
TEHRAN AIRPORT IS NOW OPEN AND NORMAL AIRLINE SERVICE IS RESUMING. WE DO NOT HAVE THE IMPRESSION THAT THERE IS A HEAVY DEMAND FOR AMERICANS WISHING TO LEAVE IRAN. BAD BEHAVIOR OF AMERICANS
DOES THE DEPARTMENT HAVE ANY COMMENT ON THE UNATTRACTIVE BEHAVIOR OF AMERICANS IN IRAN REPORTED IN THE PRESS TODAY?

WE, OF COURSE, EXPECT ALL AMERICANS OVERSEAS TO RESPECT LOCAL LAWS AND CUSTOMS AND TO CONDUCT THEMSELVES PROPERLY. THE DEPARTMENT AND THE EMBASSY HAS PROVIDED BRIEFINGS TO COMPANIES AND GROUPS ON LIFE IN IRAN SINCE AMERICANS BEGAN TO MOVE THERE IN LARGE NUMBERS OVER THE PAST SIX-EIGHT YEARS. SENSITIVE MILITARY EQUIPMENT (IF ASKED)
IS THE U.S. CONCERNED ABOUT THE SECURITY OF SENSITIVE U.S. MILITARY EQUIPMENT THAT WE HAVE SOLD TO IRAN, E.G. THE F-14 AND PHOENIX MISSILE?

WE BELIEVE THAT THE IRANIAN SECURITY FORCES ARE CAPABLE OF MAINTAINING THE SECURITY OF THESE SENSITIVE SYSTEMS. WE HAVE NO REASON TO BELIEVE THAT THIS PROTECTION WILL BE WEAKENED IN THE FUTURE. NATURALLY, WE ARE KEEPING THE SITUATION UNDER CLOSE REVIEW.
ARE THERE CONTINGENCY PLANS TO PROTECT U.S. MILITARY EQUIPMENT IN IRAN?
WE NEVER DISCUSS CONTINGENCY PLANS. AMNESTY INTERNATIONAL ON TORTURE (IF ASKED)

WHAT COMMENT DOES THE DEPARTMENT HAVE ON THE AMNESTY INTERNATIONAL CHARGE THAT TORTURE IS CONTINUING IN IRAN AND THAT SPECIFICALLY SOME OF THE DEMONSTRATORS IN THE RECENT DISTURBANCES HAVE BEEN TORTURED?

THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT HAS STATED THAT TORTURE WAS OFFICIALLY BANNED IN IRAN SOME TWO YEARS AGO. WE IN THE DEPARTMENT OF STATE HAVE NOT RECEIVED ANY INFORMATION FROM OUR EMBASSY TO CONTRADICT THAT STATEMENT. WE RECOGNIZE THAT IN THE CONDITIONS OF TURMOIL THAT PREVAIL, THERE MAY HAVE BEEN INSTANCES OF HARSH POLICE REACTION AND TREATMENT. THIS IS REGRETTABLE, BUT WE DO NOT BELIEVE THAT PRACTICES OF THIS KIND ARE OFFICIALLY CONDONED.
IS THE DEPARTMENT OR OUR EMBASSY IN IRAN LOOKING INTO THESE ALLEGATIONS?

WE HAVE NOT SEEN THE TEXT OF THE AMNESTY INTERNATIONAL REPORT YET. WE WILL, OF COURSE, STUDY IT CAREFULLY WHEN WE DO. WHEREVER HUMAN RIGHTS ISSUES ARISE, OUR EMBASSIES ARE UNDER STANDING INSTRUCTIONS TO ADDRESS THEM. THIS IS TRUE IN IRAN AS ELSEWHERE. HUSSEIN-KHOMEINI MEETING
DOES THE DEPARTMENT HAVE ANYTHING ON THE REPORTS THAT HUSSEIN IS SEEKING A MEETING WITH KHOMEINI TO TRY TO MEDIATE BETWEEN SHAH AND OPPOSITION?
WE HAVE SEEN THE PRESS REPORTS, BUT HAVE NOTHING TO SAY ABOUT THEM.

1978STATE313310.subject: REGENCY COUNCIL COULD YOU PLEASE GIVE US BY OPENING OF BUSINESS WASHINGTON TIME TOMORROW A STATEMENT OF THE BASIS IN IRANIAN

segments.text: COULD YOU PLEASE GIVE US BY OPENING OF BUSINESS WASHINGTON TIME TOMORROW A STATEMENT OF THE BASIS IN IRANIAN LAW FOR THE IDEA OF THE REGENCY COUNCIL. WE SEE NO REFERENCE TO A REGENCY COUNCIL IN THE CONSTITUTION OF 1906 OR THE SUPPLEMENTARY LAW OF 1907. PERHAPS WE DO NOT HAVE A VERSION THAT REFLECTS RECENT AMENDMENTS. IN ANY EVENT, COULD YOU TELL US WHAT IRANIAN LAW PRESCRIBES WITH RESPECT TO A REGENT AND A REGENCY COUNCIL. CHRISTOPHER

1978STATE314577.subject: PRESS GUIDANCES FOLLOWING, FOR YOUR INFORMATION, ARE GUIDANCES PREPARED DECEMBER 13 FOR DEPARTMENT SPOKESMAN BUT NOT USED

segments.text: FOLLOWING, FOR YOUR INFORMATION, ARE GUIDANCES PREPARED DECEMBER 13 FOR DEPARTMENT SPOKESMAN BUT NOT USED AT NOON BRIEFING IRAN SITREP WHAT IS THE SITUATION ON IRAN TODAY? WHAT HAPPENED IN ISFAHAN YESTERDAY?

CONDITIONS IN TEHRAN AND OTHER CITIES ARE REPORTED TO BE CALM TODAY. --SOME OF THE PRESS REPORTS ON WHAT HAPPENED IN ISFAHAN YESTERDAY ARE CONSIDERED EXAGGERATED BY OUR CONSULATE THERE. WE HAVE NO CONFIRMED REPORTS OF DEATHS IN ISFAHAN YESTERDAY.
IRAN: DEPARTURE OF AMERICANS WHAT IS THE SITUATION AS REGARDS DEPARTURE OF AMERICANS FROM IRAN?

WE HAVE NO FIGURES ON DEPARTURES OF AMERICANS FROM IRAN YESTERDAY OR TODAY. WE HAVE NO INDICATION THAT ANYONE WISHING TO LEAVE IS UNABLE TO DO SO. NOTE: INTERNATIONAL FLIGHTS IN AND OUT OF IRAN RESUMED YESTERDAY WITH THE REOPENING OF TEHRAN'S AIRPORT.
IRAN: OIL PRODUCTION
WHAT IS THE PRESENT OIL PRODUCTION? IS IT TRUE THAT IRAN IS SEEKING KEROSENE FROM OTHER GULF COUNTRIES TO MEET LOCAL NEEDS?

OIL PRODUCTION IS ESTIMATED AT ABOUT 1.3 MILLION BARRELS A DAY AT THIS TIME. ABOUT HALF OF THAT AMOUNT IS USED WITHIN IRAN. --WE KNOW THERE ARE SHORTAGES OF KEROSENE IN IRAN AND IT WOULD THEREFORE NOT BE SURPRISING IF THE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN TRIED TO MEET THIS NEED FROM OTHER SOURCES.
US REPRESENTATIONS TO FRANCE ABOUT KHOMEINI
HAS THE U.S. TALKED EITHER FORMALLY OR INFORMALLY TO THE FRENCH ABOUT KHOMEINI ISSUING STATEMENTS FROM FRANCE?
THIS CONCERNS THE QUESTION OF DIPLOMATIC COMMUNICATIONS AND I HAVE NO COMMENT ON IT.
REFERENCES: A) TEHRAN 12025 B) STATE 308108

ROSS PEROT TELEPHONED SIEVERTS DECEMBER 13 TO CONVEY HIS CONTINUED URGENT CONCERN ABOUT THE SAFETY OF CHIAPPARONE AND GAYLORD. HE IS DISTRESSED AT EMBASSY'S RETENTION OF THEIR PASSPORTS, WHICH HE ASKS BE RETURNED TO THE TWO MEN. HE ALSO WOULD LIKE THE EMBASSY TO ASSIST THEM IF NECESSARY TO LEAVE THE COUNTRY.

PEROT NOTES THAT NO ONE HAS INDICATED WHO OR WHICH OFFICE IN IRAN WANTS TO INTERVIEW THE TWO MEN, OR WHEN. HE GIVES HIS PERSONAL UNDERSTANDING THAT THE MEN RETURN TO IRAN TO BE INTERVIEWED IF THAT PROVES NECESSARY IN THE FUTURE.

PEROT ALSO NOTES THAT THE TWO MEN ARE MANAGING ENGINEERS WHO HAVE BEEN IN IRAN A RELATIVELY SHORT TIME. THEY DID NOT PARTICIPATE IN NEGOTIATING THE EDS CONTRACTS, WHICH PEROT EMPHASIZES WERE APPROVED AT ALL LEVELS OF THE GOI.

PEROT SAYS THE TWO MEN ARE REMAINING IN THEIR HOMES AND ARE "SCARED TO DEATH" ON THE CURRENT TROUBLED SITUATION. HE CONSIDERS IS ESSENTIAL TO ENABLE THEM TO LEAVE IRAN AS SOON AS POSSIBLE, AND HOPES THE EMBASSY AT LEAST WILL NOT PREVENT THIS, WHICH HE INDICATES IS THE OBVIOUS EFFECT OF THE EMBASSY RETAINING THE PASSPORTS. HE HOPES AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN WILL REVIEW THE SITUATION AGAIN AND SEE WHAT CAN BE DONE. CHRISTOPHER
EMBASSY EFFORTS ON BEHALF EDS OFFICIALS GREATLY APPRECIATED.

OFFICES OF SENATORS KENNEDY AND MATHIAS HAVE MADE INQUIRIES OVER PAST COUPLE OF DAYS ABOUT GAYLORD'S SITUATION. INQUIRY TO KENNEDY MADE BY TED REARDON WHO WE UNDERSTAND IS RELATIVE BY MARRIAGE OF GAYLORD'S.

WE HAVE SHARED WITH THEM INFORMATION CONTAINED TEHRAN 12025 AND REFTEL, ASSURING THEM THAT EMBASSY IS DOING EVERYTHING POSSIBLE ON GAYLORD'S BEHALF. BOTH OFFICES ARE SO ADVISING THOSE WHO HAVE MADE INQUIRIES ABOUT GAYLORD, AND REQUESTED THAT WE PASS ALONG ANY FURTHER INFORMATION YOU MAY BE ABLE TO OBTAIN. CHRISTOPHER
IN A DECEMBER 13 PRESS CONFERENCE IN WASHINGTON, DR.

IBRAHIM YAZDI, A CLOSE ASSOCIATE OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, REITERATED THAT: --IRAN WILL BE A NON-ALIGNED COUNTRY IF AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC IS INSTALLED. --RELIGIOUS OPPOSITION FIGURES HAVE NOT DISCUSSED IRAN'S FUTURE WITH US OFFICIALS AND WOULD ONLY DO SO UNDER THE PROPER CIRCUMSTANCES. --THE AMERICAN MILITARY PRESENCE IN IRAN IS HARMFUL AND UNNECESSARY. --FOREIGN CONTRACTS WOULD BE REVIEWED BY AN ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT AND CANCELLED IF THEY DO NOT BENEFIT IRAN. --IRAN WOULD DISCONTINUE SELLING OIL TO ISRAEL IF THE PALESTINIAN ISSUE IS NOT RESOLVED. --THE OPPOSITION WILL RESORT TO "ARMED STRUGGLE" IF PEACEFUL STRIKES AND DEMONSTRATIONS ARE NOT SUCCESSFUL. --MARXISTS WOULD NOT PARTICIPATE IN AN ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT BUT WOULD BE FREE TO EXPRESS AN OPINION. --RELIGIOUS MINORITIES WOULD BE FREE TO OBSERVE RELIGIOUS RIGHTS AND PRACTICES IN AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. --AN ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT WOULD TRY THE SHAH FOR HIS CRIMES, AND IF HE IS FOUND GUILTY, WOULD SENTENCE HIM TO LIFE IMPRISONMENT.

COMMENT: THE PRESS CONFERENCE HAS NOT BEEN REPORTED IN THE U.S. MEDIA ALTHOUGH ABOUT TEN U.S. JOURNALISTS COVERED IT. ICA TRANSMITTED BY WIRELILE ON 12/13/78 800-WORD STORY RE PRESS CONFERENCE. CHRISTOPHER UNQUOTE VANCE NOTE: ORIGINAL DIST: EUR,NEA/ISO,POLI,SAA,SES,DOE,SOE,EB,COME,TRSE
WOULD APPRECIATE REPLIES TO REFTELS. IN ADDRESSING REF (B) PLEASE ALSO GIVE US YOUR READING OF EXTENT TO WHICH SHAH HAS BEEN CALLING THE SHOTS SINCE EVENTS OF NOVEMBER 4 AND 5. CHRISTOPHER
FOLLOWING FOR YOUR INFORMATION ARE PRESS GUIDANCES PREPARED FOR DEPARTMENT SPOKESMAN DECEMBER 14 WHICH NOT USED AT NOON BRIEFING
WHAT IS OUR REACTION TO AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI'S STATEMENT THREATENING TO CUT OFF OIL SHIPMENTS TO THE UNITED STATES AND ISRAEL?
WE HAVE NOTED THOSE STATEMENTS.
DO WE HAVE ANYTHING ON THE PRESS REPORT THAT F-5 AIRCRAFT HAVE BEEN SABOTAGED IN IRAN? DO WE HAVE ANYTHING ON REPORTS OF A MUTINY IN THE IRANIAN ARMY?
I HAVE NOTHING FOR YOU ON EITHER OF THOSE STORIES.
HAS THE U.S. DRAWN UP A LIST OF IRANIAN GENERALS WHOM WE BELIEVE WOULD BE ACCEPTABLE TO THE SHAH AND THE OPPOSITION?
NO.
HAVE WE UPDATED OUR PLANS TO REMOVE SENSITIVE EQUIPMENT FROM IRAN? HAVE WE STARTED REMOVING SOME OF IT?

WE BELIEVE THAT THE IRANIAN MILITARY IS FULLY COMPETENT TO PROVIDE FOR THE SECURITY OF U.S.-ORIGIN MILITARY EQUIPMENT. WE HAVE NO REASON TO BELIEVE THIS WILL NOT CONTINUE TO BE THE CASE IN THE FUTURE. OBVIOUSLY, WE ARE WATCHING THE SITUATION VERY CLOSELY.
DID THE EMBASSY WORK WITH THE OPPOSITION OR THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT TO HELP ASSURE THAT THE RECENT DEMONSTRATIONS WOULD BE PEACEFUL?
I AM NOT GOING INTO OUR DIPLOMATIC EXCHANGES WITH IRAN.
ARE WE MAINTAINING CONTACT REGULARLY WITH THE SHAH AND THE OPPOSITION LEADERS?
THE AMBASSADOR PERIODICALLY TALKS TO THE SHAH. THE EMBASSY HAS CONTACT WITH MEMBERS OF THE OPPOSITION IN ORDER TO FOLLOW EVENTS IN IRAN.
WHAT IS THE SITUATION TODAY IN IRAN?
OUR REPORTS ARE NOT SUBSTANTIALLY DIFFERENT FROM THE PRESS STORIES.
THE EMBASSY REPORTS THE COUNTRY IS QUIET, WITH PRO-SHAH DEMONSTRATIONS OCCURRING IN SOME CITIES.
WHAT ABOUT AMERICANS IN IRAN?
THERE HAVE BEEN NO REPORTS OF VIOLENT INCIDENTS INVOLVING AMERICANS. SOME AMERICANS ARE STILL LEAVING THE COUNTRY, BUT WE BELIEVE THE GREAT NUMBER OF THOSE WHO WISHED TO DEPART DID SO BEFORE ASHURA.

YOUR REPORTS AND PRESS STORIES SUGGEST THAT PRO-SHAH DEMONSTRATIONS OCCURRING IN ISFAHAN AND ELSEWHERE MAY BE OFFICIAL INSPIRED OR, AT A MINIMUM, TOLERATED. WE ARE PARTICULARLY CONCERNED BY RECENT VIOLENCE IN SHIRAZ THAT HAS TAKEN AN ANTI-BAHAI AND, WE HEAR, ANTI-JEWISH TURN. GOI SECURITY OFFICERS HAVE ADVISED ONE U.S. FIRM TO KEEP ITS PERSONNEL AWAY FROM THESE TROUBLES WHICH ARE DESCRIBED AS QUITE DANGEROUS.

WE ARE AWARE FROM PREVIOUS EVIDENCE OF AMB. ZAHEDI'S EFFORTS TO STIMULATE PRO-SHAH VIOLENCE. WE WOULD APPRECIATE YOUR ASSESSMENT OF RECENT PRO-SHAH DEMONSTRATIONS, INCLUDING BEST INFORMATION YOU HAVE AS TO WHETHER THEY ARE SUPPORTED BY GOI, ZAHEDI'S ROLE, WHETHER PRO-SHAH GROUPS ARE INVOLVED IN ATTACKS ON MINORITIES AND POTENTIAL FOR THIS VIOLENCE BREEDING SERIOUS TROUBLE WITH OPPOSITION AND BLOCKING EFFORTS TO REACH POLITICAL ACCOMODATION. CHRISTOPHER

1978STATE316580.subject: APPROACH TO USG BY NATIONAL FRONT

segments.text: MORTEZA BAZARGAN, NEPHEW OF MEHDI BAZARGAN, CALLED ON DEPOFF ON DECEMBER 15 TO DESCRIBE NATIONAL FRONT PLAN FOR SUCCESSOR GOVERNMENT. HE SAID NATIONAL FRONT LEADERSHIP WAS CONCERNED THAT U.S. FEARED THE UNKNOWN FUTURE SHOULD THE SHAH LEAVE THE SCENE. HE WANTED TO REASSURE USG THAT A GOVERNMENT RUN BY NATIONAL FRONT WOULD BE FRIENDLY TO U.S. HE SAID PLAN DESCRIBED BELOW HAD BLESSING OF SANJABI AND KHOMEINI, ALTHOUGH HE WAS FUZZY ON DEGREE OF ACCEPTANCE BY BOTH LEADERS.
NEITHER KHOMEINI NOR ANY OTHER MULLAH WOULD TAKE POSITION OF MINISTER IN A FUTURE CABINET. RELIGIOUS FIGURES MIGHT BECOME GOVERNORS OF MASHAD OR GOM AND THEY MIGHT RUN FOR MAJLIS.

THE OPPOSITION WOULD ASK THE SHAH TO APPROVE A "REGENCY COUNCIL" WHICH WOULD EXERCISE THE SHAH'S CONSTITUTIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES AFTER HE LEFT IRAN. THE COUNCIL WOULD BE COMPOSED OF 3 MEN: SANJABI, ABDOLLAH ENTEZAM AND MANOUCHER SALOUR (DIRECTOR OF PAHLAVI FOUNDATION CEMENT FACTORIES, VERY RELIGIOUS AND ACCEPTABLE TO THE SHAH AND HIS OPPOSITION).

THE COUNCIL WOULD NAME A NEW CABINET WHICH WOULD BE HEADED BY MEHDI BAZARGAN. FREE ELECTIONS WOULD BE CALLED AT AN EARLY DATE FOR THE TWO HOUSES OF PARLIAMENT AND A THIRD BODY, A CONSTITUTIONAL ASSEMBLY WHICH WOULD REVISE THE CONSTITUTION. BAZARGAN SAID THAT IRAN, UNDER THE NATIONAL FRONT, WOULD SEEK BEST POSSIBLE RELATIONS WITH THE WEST AND WOULD EVEN CONTINUE TO SUPPLY OIL TO ISRAEL. KHOMEINI WOULD NOT LIKE IT, BUT HE WOULD BE OBLIGED TO ACCEPT THAT POSITION.
IF THE CONSTITUTIONAL ASSEMBLY VOTED TO KEEP THE MONARCHY, CROWN PRINCE REZA WOULD BE INVITED TO RETURN TO IRAN. IF A REPUBLIC WERE SELECTED, THERE WOULD BE AN ELECTION FOR PRESIDENT.
THE NATIONAL FRONT HAD CONSIDERED OTHER FIGURES FOR THE COUNCIL, INCLUDING GENERAL DJAM, AMINI, SORURI, BUT THEY HAD NOT BEEN SELECTED. THE HUMAN RIGHTS COMMITTEE HAD BEEN INFORMED.

THE NEW GOVERNMENT WOULD BE ANTI-COMMUNIST, WOULD END MARTIAL LAW, PERMIT FREEDOM OF THE PRESS, BUT PROBABLY NOT PERMIT STRIKES FOR ABOUT A YEAR. SAVAK WOULD LOSE ITS AUTHORITY. PROBABLY 10-15 SENIOR MILITARY OFFICERS WOULD LEAVE WITH THE SHAH. MOST OF THE PURGED OFFICERS WOULD BE GROUND FORCE. THE OPPOSITION HAD ALREADY SELECTED MILITARY LEADERS WHICH COULD ASSURE THE LOYALTY OF THE ARMY AND NO SERIOUS PROBLEM WAS ANTICIPATED. A NUMBER OF OFFICERS HAD CALLED RECENTLY ON SHARIAT-MADARI AND SEPARATELY ON THE NATIONAL FRONT.

DEPTOFF ASKED WHAT THE U.S. SHOULD DO? BAZARGAN SAID THAT IF THE U.S. ENDED ITS SUPPORT FOR THE SHAH, HE AND HIS MILITARY OFFICERS WOULD LEAVE THE COUNTRY IMMEDIATELY. HE HOPED THE U.S. WOULD PRESENT THE OPPOSITION'S PLAN TO THE SHAH SO THAT FURTHER BLOODSHED AND ECONOMIC DISRUPTION COULD BE AVOIDED.

DEPTOFF ASKED IF THE OPPOSITION HAD NOT THEMSELVES CONVEYED THE PLAN TO THE SHAH? BAZARGAN SAID THE SHAH HAD SENT BEHBAHANI (MANAGER OF PAHLAVI FINANCES), TO OFFER PRIME MINISTERSHIP TO MEDHI BAZARGAN. LATTER HAD REFUSED BUT HAD NOT, IN TURN, GIVEN SHAH OPPOSITION'S SCHEME.

VISITOR EMPHASIZED THAT A COALITION GOVERNMENT WITH THE SHAH REMAINING ON THE SCENE WAS NOT POSSIBLE IN TODAY'S IRAN. HE HOPED U.S. WOULD SUPPORT PLAN HE HAD UTILIZED, RECOGNIZING THAT IRAN WOULD BE VERY FRIENDLY TOWARDS U.S. BECAUSE IRAN NEEDED U.S. FOOD, SPARE PARTS, SERVICES AND TECHNOLOGY TO PURSUE ITS DEVELOPMENT.

DEPTOFF THANKED BAZARGAN FOR HIS PRESENTATION AND SAID HE WOULD REPORT IT TO INTERESTED OFFICIALS. HE SUGGESTED THAT BAZARGAN ESTABLISH CONTACT WITH POL-CONS LAMBRAKIS WHEN HE RETURNED TO TEHRAN. CHRISTOPHER

1978STATE316928.subject: MESSAGE FROM SENATOR PERCY TO AMBASSADOR ZAHEDI PLEASE TRANSMIT FOLLOWING MESSAGE FROM SENATOR PERCY TO AMBASSADOR ZAHEDI

segments.text: PLEASE TRANSMIT FOLLOWING MESSAGE FROM SENATOR PERCY TO AMBASSADOR ZAHEDI: BEGIN TEXT: DEAR ARDESHIR: OUR THOUGHTS ARE WITH YOU AND HIS MAJESTY IN THESE TRYING TIMES. YOU HAVE SEEN GREAT STRESS AT TIMES IN THE UNITED STATES AND THOSE PROBLEMS WERE OVERCOME. I AM CONFIDENT THAT YOU WILL ALSO OVERCOME YOUR PRESENT PROBLEMS. YOUR MANY FRIENDS IN CONGRESS JOIN IN SENDING YOU OUR FONDEST WISHES. SENATOR CHUCK PERCY. . VANCE

WE WOULD APPRECIATE LIST OF NAMES PUBLISHED BY CBI EMPLOYEES ASSOCIATION OF SENIOR OFFICIALS WHO HAVE RECEIVED FOREIGN SCHOLARSHIPS FROM PAHLAVI FOUNDATION. WE ASSUME THIS LIST WILL TAKE ITS PLACE ALONGSIDE LIST OF IRANIANS WHO SHIPPED LARGE AMOUNTS OF RIALS OUT OF THE COUNTRY. IT IS OUR IMPRESSION FROM TALKING TO VISITING AND RESIDENT IRANIANS THAT ACCURACY OF LATTER LIST IS BROADLY ACCEPTED.

IRANIAN EMBASSY (PROTECT ABSOLUTELY) HAS SPECULATED WHETHER AMBASSADOR ZAHEDI WILL BE ABLE TO RETURN TO THE U.S. SOON. THEY NOTE THAT SPECIAL PROSECUTOR HAS SAID THAT THOSE NAMED ON CBI LIST ARE NOT TO LEAVE IRAN. VANCE
FOLLOWING, FOR YOUR INFORMATION, IS PRESS GUIDANCE PREPARED FOR DEPARTMENT SPOKESMAN DECEMBER 19, WHICH, AS OCCASION DID NOT ARISE, WAS NOT USED IN NOON BRIEFING.
WHAT IS OUR REACTION TO REPORTS THAT THE SHAH IS PREPARED TO ACCEPT A MAJOR REDUCTION IN HIS POWERS?
I THIN. IT HAS BEEN CLEAR FOR SOME TIME THAT THE SHAH WAS WILLING TO SHARE AUTHORITY WITH OTHER INSTITUTIONS IN THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT.

CHARGE' SHERMAN MET MOFA MIDDLE EASTERN AND AFRICAN AFFAIRS BUREAU DIRGEN CHIBA DECEMBER 18 AND CONVEYED POINTS CONTAINED IN REF A. CHARGE' REITERATED FIRM USG SUPPORT FOR SHAH, THANKED CHIBA FOR CLOSE COOPERATION DURING IRANIAN CRISIS, AND SUGGESTED FURTHER EXCHANGES OF INFORMATION, ESPECIALLY CONCERNING ECONOMIC SITUATION AND OIL PRODUCTION.

IN RESPONSE, CHIBA SAID DEPARTMENT AND TEHRAN SITREPS AND REPORTS, PROVIDED ALMOST DAILY BY EMBASSY TOKYO, WERE VERY USEFUL IN MOFA PLANNING. HE NOTED THAT MOFA HAD INSTRUCTED JAPANESE EMBASSY TEHRAN TO AVOID AGGRESSIVE INTELLIGENCE COLLECTION DURING CRISIS PERIOD, INSTEAD RELYING ON CONSULTATION WITH US. GIVEN THIS SITUATION, CHIBA HOPED WE WOULD CONTINUE TO PROVIDE MOFA WITH FRESH ANALYSIS, ESPECIALLY CONCERNING VARIOUS POLITICAL FACTIONS AND THEIR INTENTIONS.

TURNING TO ECONOMICS, CHIBA REMARKED THAT, WHILE MOST MAJOR JAPANESE PROJECTS IN IRAN--SUCH AS MITSUI OIL REFINERY AT BANDARESHAHPUR--WOULD REACH COMPLETION DESPITE CRISIS, SOME LESSER VENTURES--SUCH AS LNG DEVELOPMENT-MIGHT FACE DEFERRAL. NOTING ANXIETY OF JAPANESE FIRMS ABOUT SECURITY OF INVESTMENTS IN IRAN, CHIBA SAID MITSUI, FOR ONE, HAD BEEN ACTIVELY SEEKING GOJ GUARANTEES FOR IRANIAN PROJECTS.
CHIBA SAID THAT GOJ EXPERTS BELIEVED PROLONGED REDUCTION OF IRANIAN OIL PRODUCTION BY ONE-THIRD WOULD NOT BE SERIOUS, BUT THAT REDUCTION BY HALF WOULD BE "UNMANAGEABLE" FOR OIL-CONSUMING STATES.
COMMENT: CHIBA'S REQUEST UNDERSCORED MOFA DESIRE, AS NOTED REFS B AND C, FOR ANY CURRENT ASSESSMENTS DEPARTMENT AND INTELLIGENCE COMMUNITY ARE ABLE TO PROVIDE. SHERMAN
(S) ENTIRE TEXT.

CHARGE WILL PLAN TO MEET WITH MIDDLE EAST AND AFRICA BUREAU DIRECTOR GENERAL CHIBA DECEMBER 18 TO EXCHANGE VIEWS ON IRANIAN CRISIS, MAKING POINTS PARA 2 REF A) CONCERNING OUR CONTINUING SUPPORT FOR SHAH AND ASKING GOJ VIEWS ON QUESTIONS RAISED IN PARA 3.

GOJ FULLY SHARES OUR DESIRE TO KEEP IN CLOSEST POSSIBLE TOUCH ON THESE CRUCIAL ISSUES, AND AS DEPARTMENT IS AWARE, EMBASSY HAS MAINTAINED ALMOST DAILY DIALOGUE WITH MOFA ON CRISIS, PASSING DEPARTMENT AND TEHRAN POLITICAL SITREPS AND REPORTS ON SITUATION IN OIL SECTOR, AND EXCHANGING VIEWS ON INFORMAL BASIS. WE WOULD ALSO CALL ATTENTION TO GOJ ANALYSIS TRANSMITTED REF. B, WHICH REPRESENTED FRANK GOJ ASSESSMENT AS OF LAST WEEK CONCERNING POSSIBLE OUTCOMES OF CRISIS. AS NOTED REF B., MOFA WOULD APPRECIATE ANY DEPARTMENT REACTION TO THAT ASSESSMENT, AS WELL AS ANY ANALYSES DEPARTMENT AND INTELLIGENCE COMMUNITY MAY HAVE AT HAND. SHERMAN

(S-ENTIRE TEXT) BEGIN SUMMARY: THE FRG HAS WELCOMED OUR PROPOSAL TO BEGIN QUIET CONSULTATIONS ON IRAN. WE BELIEVE THAT WE COULD COMMENCE THESE TALKS QUICKLY, BUT BEFORE DOING SO WE SHOULD HAVE A FULLER READOUT OF WASHINGTON'S VIEWS ON THE CURRENT SITUATION AND WHAT THE FUTURE MAY HOLD. END SUMMARY.

THE AMBASSADOR MADE USE OF AN ALREADY SCHEDULED APPOINTMENT WITH FOREIGN MINISTER GENSCHER ON DECEMBER 18 TO MAKE THE PRESENTATION ALONG THE LINES OF REF. GENSCHER WELCOMED OUR PROPOSAL AND DESIGNATED ASSISTANT SECRETARY ANDREAS MEYER-LANDRUT, DIRECTOR OF THE FOREIGN MINISTRY'S THIRD POLITICAL DIVISION, AS THE FRG CONTACT POINT FOR THESE CONSULTATIONS. GENSCHER FULLY SHARED OUR VIEW OF THE NEED TO KEEP THESE TALKS UNDER CLOSE WRAPS.

REFLECTIVE OF A DEEPLY HELD FRG CONCERN, GENSCHER'S FIRST QUESTION AFTER HEARING THE AMBASSADOR'S PRESENTATION WAS WHETHER THE USG PLANNED TO CONTINUE MOVING ITS PERSONNEL OUT OF IRAN. THE AMBASSADOR REPLIED THAT, SO FAR, SOME DEPENDENTS HAVE LEFT ON A VOLUNTARY BASIS, AND THAT NO LARGE-SCALE MOVE OF USG PERSONNEL IS UNDERWAY.

GENSCHER SEEMED RELIEVED TO HEAR THIS, BECAUSE HE FEARED THAT A MASSIVE EVACUATION WOULD BE SEEN AS A LACK OF WESTERN CONFIDENCE IN THE GOI. HE NOTED THAT THERE ARE MANY GERMANS IN THE COUNTRY, AND THAT THE FRG HAS TAKEN STEPS TO LAUNCH AN EVACUATION ON SHORT NOTICE BUT HAS NOT YET FLOWN ANY PERSONNEL OUT.

GENSCHER NEXT SPOKE OF THE COMMON WESTERN INTEREST IN HELPING IRAN RETURN TO A CONDITION OF INTERNAL STABILITY AND MAINTAIN ITS TRADITIONAL ORIENTATION OVER THE MIDDLE- AND LONG-TERM. HE HAD NO DOUBT THAT THE PRESENT GOVERNMENT WAS DETERMINED TO HOLD TO IRAN'S TRADITIONAL FOREIGN POLICY ORIENTATION, AND HE SAW NO REASON FOR UNEASE ON THAT SCORE. THE QUESTION WAS WHETHER THE REGIME WOULD PERCEIVE THE SHAH AS AN ASSET OR A BURDEN IN REACHING ITS GOALS. GENSCHER THOUGHT THAT CURRENT GOI POWER HOLDERS HAD NOT YET MADE UP THEIR MINDS ON THAT POINT.

IN REPLY TO THE AMBASSADOR'S COMMENT ON THE SHAH'S EFFORT TO BRING OPPOSITION POLITICANS INTO A COALITION GOVERNMENT, GENSCHER NOTED THAT THE PRESENT MILITARY REGIME DOES NOT DERIVE ITS AUTHORITY DE FACTO FROM THE SHAH, BUT RATHER FROM THE UNITY OF THE ARMY WHICH HAS HELD UP WELL. HE SAW THE DANGER OF DEMORALIZATION IN THE RANKS, HOWEVER, AND HE THOUGHT THAT IN THIS CONNECTION MUCH WOULD BE DECIDED IN THE NEXT FEW DAYS.

THE POSITION OF THE USSR PLAYED A PROMINENT PART IN THE DISCUSSION. GENSCHER OBSERVED THAT MOSCOW APPEARS TO BE PLAYING A WAITING GAME, AND HAS PREPARED ITSELF FOR AN EVENTUAL CHANGE OF REGIME IN IRAN. HE AGREED FULLY WITH THE AMBASSADOR'S COMMENT THAT THE SOVIETS HAVE MANY CONSIDERATIONS IN FORMULATING THEIR POLICY TOWARD IRAN. HE SAID THEY MIGHT WELCOME A CHANGE, BUT THEY WOULD NOT WANT AN UNSTABLE SITUATION IN IRAN, AND CERTAINLY NOT A SITUATION WITH POWERFUL RELIGIOUS OVERTONES THAT MIGHT STRIKE SYMPATHETIC CHORDS IN ISLAMIC MINORITIES IN THE USSR.

GENSCHER COMMENTED WRYLY THAT, EVEN 60 YEARS AFTER THE OCTOBER REVOLUTION, ISLAM REMAINS A POWERFUL LATENT FORCE IN THOSE AREAS. NOTING THAT DELIVERIES OF IRANIAN GAS TO THE USSR HAVE LAGGED RECENTLY, HE DID NOT RULE OUT ALTOGETHER THE POSSIBILITY THAT THE SOVIETS, AFTER WEIGHING ALL FACTORS, MIGHT OPT TO CHANGE THEIR POSITION ON IRAN, PERHAPS IN PART TO OFFSET PROBLEMS THEY ARE HAVING WITH THE CHINESE.

SUMMING UP THE FRG POSITION, GENSCHER SAID THAT BONN WILL DO NOTHING WHICH CONTRIBUTES TO INSTABILITY IN IRAN OR SENDS OUT "NEGATIVE SIGNALS" TOWARD THAT COUNTRY. HE SAID THAT THE FRG WILL MAKE EVERY EFFORT TO HELP KEEP IRAN ON ITS TRADITIONAL FOREIGN-POLICY COURSE, AND TO SUPPORT INDIGENOUS GROUPS WHICH"NOT ONLY PROMISE BUT GUARANTEE" THAT COURSE. HE IMPLIED THAT CLOSE CONSULTATIONS WITH THE USG SHOULD PROCEED ON THAT BASIS.

COMMENT. GENSCHER HAD CLEARLY DONE HIS HOMEWORK ON IRAN. HIS COMMENTS INDICATE THAT FRG THINKING ON FUTURE OPTIONS HAS CONTINUED. NOW THAT WE HAVE A FORMAL CONTACT POINT, WE BELIEVE THAT WE COULD MOVE QUICKLY TO BEGIN BILATERAL CONSULTATIONS. IT WOULD HELP TO HAVE A FULLER READING ON WASHINGTON VIEWS RE THE CURRENT SITUATION AND FUTURE PROSPECTS IN IRAN, PARTICULARLY AS THEY BEAR ON GENSCHER'S CONCERNS, BEFORE GOING INTO SUCH A MEETING. PLEASE ADVISE. END COMMENT. STOESSEL

1978STATE323593.subject: PRESS GUIDANCE FOLLOWING PRESS GUIDANCE FOR USE TODAY: Q. WHAT DO YOU HAVE ON THE ASSASSINATION OF PAUL

segments.text: FOLLOWING PRESS GUIDANCE FOR USE TODAY WHAT DO YOU HAVE ON THE ASSASSINATION OF PAUL GRIM?

MR. GRIM, AN OFFICIAL OF THE OIL SERVICE COMPANY, WAS SHOT BY TERRORISTS WHILE DRIVING TO WORK NEAR AHWAZ THIS MORNING. AN IRANIAN EMPLOYEE OF THE OIL SERVICE COMPANY WAS REPORTEDLY KILLED IN A SEPARATE INCIDENT NEAR AHWAZ. WE DO NOT HAVE ANY INFORMATION ON THE PARTIES RESPONSIBLE FOR THE KILLINGS.
WHAT ABOUT THE SAFETY OF AMERICANS IN AHWAZ?

THE AMERICAN COMMUNITY UNDERSTANDABLY IS QUITE UPSET AND TENSE. THE IRANIAN SECURITY AUTHORITIES HAVE INCREASED THEIR PROTECTION OF AMERICANS AND OTHER FOREIGNERS IN THE AREA. OUR CONSUL IN SHIRAZ IS IN TOUCH WITH THE AHWAZ AUTHORITIES. THE EMBASSY IS SENDING A CONSULAR OFFICER TO THE CITY AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.
IS THE EMBASSY CHANGING ITS GUIDANCE FOR AMERICANS IN IRAN?

AS WE HAVE STATED IN THE PAST, THE EMBASSY IS KEEPING THE QUESTION OF THE SAFETY OF AMERICANS UNDER CONTINUING REVIEW. IN REACHING ITS ASSESSMENTS IT IS IN TOUCH WITH MEMBERS OF THE AMERICAN COMMUNITY. THE EMBASSY HAS NOT REVISED ITS ADVICE TO AMERICANS, I.E., TO BE PRUDENT AND CAUTIOUS IN THEIR ACTIVITIES IN IRAN DURING THIS PERIOD OF TENSION.
WHAT IS THE SITUATION ELSEWHERE IN IRAN?

THERE WERE DEMONSTRATIONS OF STUDENTS TODAY WITH THE SCHEDULED REOPENING OF THE HIGH SCHOOLS. WE DO NOT HAVE ANY INFORMATION INDICATING THAT VIOLENCE WAS ASSOCIATED WITH THESE DEMONSTRATIONS. TEHRAN, ISFAHAN AND OTHER PROVINCIAL CITIES ARE REPORTED GENERALLY QUIET, ALTHOUGH MANY SHOPS REMAIN CLOSED. COOPER

FOLLOWING IS TEXT OF CABLE CONSORTIUM IS SENDING TO OSCO HEADQUARTERS IN TEHRAN AND AHWAZ REGARDING MOVEMENT OF EMPLOYEES: : THIS IS TO ADVISE YOU AND YOUR PEOPLE THAT WE ARE VERY CONCERNED ABOUT THE SITUATION AND HAVE FULL SYMPATHY WITH YOUR POSITION. WE ARE MOBILIZED HERE IN LONDON AND ARE PREPARED TO HELP YOU IN ANY WAY WE CAN. AS A START WE AUTHORIZE YOU TO EVACUATE THE DEPENDENTS OF THOSE WHO WISH TO LEAVE IRAN. WE ARE ARRANGING SPECIAL AIR TRANSPORT ON AN URGENT BASIS. OUT OF POCKET COSTS OF THOSE DEPENDENTS INVOLVED WILL BE MET FOR THE FIRST TWO WEEKS AFTER LEAVING IRAN.

DURING THAT TIME WE WILL DEVELOP A POLICY FOR THE LONGER TERM. PLEASE ASSURE YOUR PEOPLE THAT ANY SUCH POLICY WILL BE REASONABLE AND HELPFUL. DEPENDENTS WHO WISH TO MAY RETURN TO THEIR POINT OF ORIGIN. WE SUGGEST THAT OTHERS COME TO LONDON WHERE WE WILL PROVIDE HOTEL ACCOMMODATIONS. WE WILL NEED TO KNOW DETAILS AS SOON AS POSSIBLE IN ORDER TO MAKE HOTEL RESERVATIONS AND/OR OTHER BOOKINGS AND SET UP RECEPTION FACILITIES, ETC. TELL YOUR PEOPLE THAT WE WILL GIVE ALL ASSISTANCE, IN PARTICULAR ENROUTE TO THEIR DESTINATION. WE AGREE WITH YOUR RECOMMENDATIONS THAT ALL PARTIES SHOULD STAY IN SECURE AREAS UNTIL SECURITY IS ASSURED.

WE ARE CONSIDERING OTHER MEASURES AND ARE IN TOUCH WITH GEORGE LINK WHO IS ON HIS WAY TO LONDON TO CONSULT WITH US. HE WILL PROBABLY RETURN TO IRAN SHORTLY. IN ADDITION, ANY EMPLOYEE WHO ASKS TO LEAVE WITH THEIR DEPENDENTS MAY DO SO ON THE SAME BASIS AS ABOVE. DEPENDING ON CIRCUMSTANCES WE HOPE THE MAJORITY WILL NOT LEAVE WITHOUT DUE CONSIDERATION OF ALL FACTORS, PARTICULARLY BECAUSE IT WILL NOT BE EASY TO PUT A LARGE NUMBER OF PLANES INTO IRAN AT SHORT NOTICE. THIS POLICY APPLIES FOR TEHRAN AS WELL.

WE URGE YOU TO USE COMMERCIAL AIRLINES TO THE EXTENT POSSIBLE IN ORDER TO REDUCE THE NUMBER AND THE NEED FOR SPECIAL CHARTERS. AGAIN WE WILL NEED TO KNOW THE DETAILS OF FLIGHTS, ETC. AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. UNQUOTE.

1978STATE323965.subject: ATTITUDES AND TROUBLES IN THE IRANIAN MILITARY

segments.text: NEA/IRN IS PROUD TO SEE ONE OF ITS OWN MAKING GOOD. REFTEL IS AN EXCELLENT CABLE. WE ARE REPEATING IT

WE WOULD LIKE BY DECEMBER 28 YOUR PRELIMINARY RECOMMENDATION, TAKING INTO ACCOUNT RECENT DEVELOPMENTS, REGARDING RETURN OF OFFICIAL DEPENDENTS TO IRAN. DECISIONS ON DEPENDENT MOVEMENTS WILL SUBSEQUENTLY BE MADE BY STATE AND DOD.

WE WILL WANT YOUR VIEWS AS TO WHETHER CONDITIONS IN IRAN WILL PERMIT US TO TERMINATE PRESENT ARRANGEMENT ON A SPECIFIED DATE IN THE NEAR FUTURE, WHETHER WE SHOULD CONTINUE CURRENT POLICY ON DEPENDENTS PENDING A FURTHER REVIEW, OR WHETHER WE MIGHT ALLOW VOLUNTARY RETURN OF SOME DEPENDENTS NOW WITHOUT ALTERING THE STATUS OF THOSE WHO WISH TO REMAIN OUTSIDE IRAN. IN CONSIDERING THIS QUESTION YOU MAY WISH TO EXAMINE WHETHER A SELECTIVE RETURN IS DESIRABLE AND APPROPRIATE. FOR EXAMPLE, THOSE PERSONS WHO LIVE IN AREAS WHICH POSE A GREATER SECURITY THREAT COULD HAVE THEIR TRAVEL DEFERRED.

OTHERS, WITH SCHOOL CHILDREN OR EMPLOYMENT (ESPECIALLY PIT POSITIONS), MIGHT BE GIVEN PRIORITY FOR RETURN. FURTHER, YOU WILL WISH TO EVALUATE THE LONGER TERM SECURITY/PSYCHOLOGICAL SITUATION IN TERMS OF WHETHER WE SHOULD ADVISE DEPENDENTS WITH SCHOOL-AGE CHILDREN TO ESTABLISH THEMSELVES IN THE U.S. FOR THE BALANCE OF THE SCHOOL YEAR -- UNLESS CONDITIONS IN IRAN RADICALLY IMPROVE IN THE INTERIM.

AS THE DECISION WE REACH ON THIS QUESTION WILL HAVE IMPLICATIONS FOR PRIVATE AMERICANS IN IRAN, WE SUGGEST YOU TAKE QUIET SOUNDINGS IN THE COMMUNITY, IN ADDITION TO THE OFFICIAL FAMILY, IN PREPARING YOUR RECOMMENDATION.

IF YOU DECIDE THAT WE ARE NOT NOW ABLE TO REACH DEFINITE JUDGMENTS ON THIS QUESTION, PLEASE GIVE A DATE ON WHICH YOU WILL MAKE THE NEXT REVIEW. WE WILL WANT TO GIVE EMPLOYEES AND DEPENDENTS A SENSE OF HOW WE ARE APPROACHING THIS PROBLEM AND A SCHEME OF PERIODIC REVIEWS ON SET DATES.

1978STATE324050.subject: SHUT DOWN OF OSCO ACTIVITIES IOP REPRESENTATIVES ARE MEETING IN LONDON TO DISCUSS FUTURE OPERATIONS IN IRAN. OSCO MANAGING DIRECTOR LINK I

segments.text: IOP REPRESENTATIVES ARE MEETING IN LONDON TO DISCUSS FUTURE OPERATIONS IN IRAN. OSCO MANAGING DIRECTOR LINK IS PRESENT FOR THESE DISCUSSIONS. ACCORDING TO OUR COMPANY SOURCES HERE, CONSORTIUM IS GIVING SERIOUS THOUGHT TO SHUT-DOWN OF ALL ACTIVITIES IN IRAN. THIS WOULD MEAN REMOVAL OF ALL EXPATRIATE WORKFORCE UNTIL GOI CAN GUARANTEE SAFETY OF THE OIL FIELDS. PREVAILING VIEW IS THAT OSCO PERSONNEL ARE NOW IN AN "OIL OR LIVES" SITUATION.

(APPARENTLY SPECIFIC DEATH THREATS HAVE BEEN RECEIVED IN AFTERMATH OF THE GRIMM ASSASSINATION.) IF DECISION IS MADE FOR TOTAL PULLOUT, OSCO WOULD FORMALLY NOTIFY GOI (PERHAPS PRIME MINISTER), ADVISING THAT DECISION WAS A TEMPORARY ONE AND WOULD BE REVIEWED AS SOON AS SECURITY CONDITIONS SHOWED IMPROVEMENT.

WE RECEIVED RESULTS OF MEETING AFTER FOREGOING PARAGRAPH DRAFTED. COMPANIES HAVE DECIDED THEY WILL ENCOURAGE ALL DEPENDENTS TO LEAVE AND WILL NOT DISCOURAGE EMPLOYEES WHO WISH TO DO SO.OSCO'S IRANIAN STAFF WILL BE TOLD THEY MAY TAKE ANNUAL LEAVE IF THEY WISH. COMPANIES WANT TO MAINTAIN OSCO FUNCTIONS, BUT SAFETY OF EMPLOYEES IS OF OVERRIDING IMPORTANCE. A DELEGATION OF SENIOR OFFICIALS OF COMPANIES (POSSIBLY INCLUDING BP CHAIRMAN) WILL VISIT TEHRAN SOONEST TO SEE NEW NIOC CHAIRMAN, PM AND POSSIBLY THE SHAH. BURDEN OF MESSAGE WILL BE THAT COMPANIES ARE TERRIBLY CONCERNED ABOUT SECURITY CONDITIONS. UNLESS COMPANIES CAN BE SATISFIED ON SAFETY THEY WILL BE FORCED TO PULL OUT ALL EMPLOYEES.

IN EFFECT, UNTIL VISIT CAN BE ARRANGED, COMPANIES ARE GIVING GOI ANOTHER FEW DAYS IN HOPE SECURITY SITUATION WILL IMPROVE. HOPEFUL SIGN IS THAT OF 100 SCHEDULED ONLY 44 PERSONS SHOWED UP TO LEAVE ON CHARTERED PLANE TODAY.

COMPANY REP TOLD US IRANIAN SECURITY OFFICIALS ARE CLEARLY SEEKING TO GIVE FULL COOPERATION, BUT DOUBT REMAINS WHETHER SECURITY OF EXPATRIATE STAFF CAN ACTUALLY BE ASSURED. REP SAID PRODUCTION IS DETERIORATING. THERE IS AN INCREASE IN NUMBER OF MEN ON STRIKE, NO GAS PRODUCTION AND A FURTHER DROP IN OIL OUTPUT (POSSIBLY TO TWO MILLION BARRELS TOMORROW) IS FORESEEN.

1978STATE325479.subject: ALLEGED THREATS AGAINST AMERICAN LIVES IN IRAN

segments.text: MR. JACK J. WARMBRAND, ACCOMPANIED BY HIS ATTORNEY, JOEL SCHWEIDEL, MET WITH AMBASSADOR PETREE AND MISSOFF ON DEC. 26, 1978 TO PROVIDE THEM WITH INFORMATION ON PLANS BY CERTAIN RADICAL FACTIONS TO CARRY OUT ATTACKS ON AMERICANS IN IRAN ON NEW YEAR'S EVE. WARMBRAND AND SCHWEIDEL SAID THAT THE ONLY REASON FOR BRINGING THEIR INFORMATION TO OUR ATTENTION WAS CONCERN THAT AMERICAN LIVES ARE IN JEOPARDY.

WARMBRAND SAID THAT HE HAD BEEN TRYING UNSUCCESSFULLY TO CONVEY THIS INFORMATION TO THE USG FOR SEVERAL WEEKS THROUGH SENATOR MOYNIHAN'S OFFICE AND THROUGH THE TREASURY DEPARTMENT, BUT THAT HIS MEETING AT USUN WAS THE FIRST RESPONSE TO HIS EFFORTS TO OBTAIN APPOINTMENTS WITH US OFFICIALS.

WARMBRAND DESCRIBED HIMSELF AS A CLOSE FRIEND OF KHAIBAR KHAN, TITULAR HEAD OF THE BAKHTIARI TRIBES OF SOUTHERN IRAN AND PRESENTLY A POLITICAL EXILE RESIDING IN LAS VEGAS. HE CHARACTERIZED KHAIBAR KHAN AS AN INDIVIDUAL WHO HAD BEEN VERY CLOSE TO THE SHAH UNTIL ABOUT 15 YEARS AGO WHEN HE DISCOVERED AND REVEALED VARIOUS ACTS OF FOREIGN AID CORRUPTION COMMITTED BY THE SHAH (INCLUDING HIS TESTIMONY BEFORE THE MCCLELLAN COMMITTEE IN 1965), WHICH PUT AN ABRUPT END TO THEIR FRIENDSHIP.

HE FURTHER CHARACTERIZED KHAIBAR KHAN AS PRO-WESTERN, AND SAID THAT HE HAD BEEN BROUGHT BACK TO IRAN FROM ENGLAND BY THE BRITISH DURING WORLD WAR II TO ASSIST THE WEST IN OPERATING OIL FIELDS AND THAT HE SUBSEQUENTLY WAS RESPONSIBLE FOR SAVING HUNDREDS OF AMERICAN LIVES DURING THE UPRISINGS OF 1953. KHAIBIR KHAN, HE SAID, IS OPPOSED TO THE MORE RADICAL ELEMENTS WHICH ARE PRESENTLY TRYING TO TAKE OVER IRAN AND TURN IT AGAINST THE WEST.

WARMBRAND THEN SAID THAT KHAIBIR KHAN HAS ASKED HIM TO PASS ON TO RESPONSIBLE U.S. OFFICIALS THE FOLLOWING: PLANS HAVE BEEN MADE TO KILL AND INJURE AMERICANS IN IRAN ON NEW YEAR'S EVE BY PLANTING BOMBS AT VARIOUS PARTIES TO BE HELD AT THE AMERICAN EMBASSY IN TEHRAN AS WELL AS AT MILITARY AND CIVILIAN CLUBS IN ISFAHAN, ABADAN AND AHWAZ. THE SERVANTS AND STAFF ARE GOING TO BE BRINGING PIECES OF THESE BOMBS ONTO THE PREMISES AS THEY GET READY FOR THESE PARTIES. KHAIBIR KHAN, WARMBRAND SAID, IS PREPARED TO PROVIDE DETAILED INFORMATION AS TO THE TIME AND LOCATION OF THESE PLANNED ATTACKS IF A RESPONSIBLE U.S.
OFFICIAL WILL MEET WITH HIM IN LAS VEGAS IN WARMBRAND 'S PRESENCE. THE ONLY THING HE WILL NOT REVEAL IS THE NAMES OF HIS SOURCES.

THE OVERALL PURPOSE OF THESE ATTACKS, HE WENT ON, IS TO SHOW THAT THE GOI CANNOT PROTECT AMERICANS, AND TO CAUSE GREATER DISSENSION AND TENSION IN US/IRAN RELATIONS. WARMBRAND WENT ON TO SAY THAT THE KILLING OF PAUL GRIM WAS PART OF THIS OVERALL PLAN TO KILL PROMINENT AMERICANS IN IRAN. HE IMPLIED, BUT DID NOT SAY, THAT KHAIBIR KHAN HAD ADVANCE KNOWLEDGE OF PLANS TO KILL GRIM.

PETREE EXPRESSED APPRECIATION FOR WARMBRAND'S INITIATIVE IN COMING TO THE MISSION TO TELL US OF HIS CONCERNS. HE ASSURED HIM THAT WE WOULD PASS HIS REPORT ON PROMPTLY TO THE DEPARTMENT (HIRSCH/MARTIN TELCON DEC 26). WARMBRAND ALSO GAVE US A COPY OF A LETTER HE WROTE TO PRESIDENT CARTER ON NOV 20, 1978 SEEKING TO HIGH-LIGHT THE DANGER TO AMERICAN LIVES AND AN ARTICLE IN THE NATION MAGAZINE ENTITLED "THE BILLION DOLLAR MYSTERY" BY FRED J. COOK (DATED APRIL 12, 1965) WHICH DESCRIBES IN DETAIL THE HISTORY OF RELATIONS BETWEEN THE SHAH AND KHAIBIR KHAN. COPY OF THE LETTER HAS BEEN DATAFAXED TO (NEA/IRN/MARTIN).
WARMBRAND CAN BE CONTACTED THROUGH HIS ATTORNEY JOEL SCHWEIDEL AT 212-661-4480 OR AT HIS RESIDENCE 212-889-7161. YOUNG

1978STATE327044.subject: SITUATION IN IRAN (S - ENTIRE TEXT) SUMMARY: HMG REMAINS FIRM IN SUPPORT OF SHAH, BUT FCO BELIEVES UK AND US CAN HE

segments.text: (S - ENTIRE TEXT) SUMMARY: HMG REMAINS FIRM IN SUPPORT OF SHAH, BUT FCO BELIEVES UK AND US CAN HELP HIM BEST BY NOT GETTING INVOLVED. IRANIANS MUST SORT OUT DIFFICULTIES THEMSELVES. A MILITARY CRACKDOWN WILL NOT WORK AND A CIVILIAN GOVERNMENT WILL BE UNWORKABLE AS LONG AS THE SHAH INSISTS ON REMAINING COMMANDER-INCHIEF. DWINDLING OIL SUPPLIES MAKE CRUNCH IMMINENT, BUT NO PRO-SHAH BACKLASH IS EXPECTED.

FCO MIDDLE EAST DEPARTMENT HEAD LUCAS GAVE US DEC 29 FOLLOWING UPDATE ON AMBASSADOR PARSONS' THINKING: ZAHEDI HAS BEEN VERY ACTIVE AND MAY BE TRYING TO ARRANGE, PERHAPS AS EARLY AS SATURDAY' DEC 30, THE APPOINTMENT OF A NEW PRIME MINISTER (PARSONS THINKS THIS MIGHT BE GENERAL DJAM) AT THE HEAD OF A TOUGHER GOVERNMENT. THE NEW ARRANGEMENT WOULD RETAIN A DISTINCTION BETWEEN THE MILITARY AND CIVILIAN SECTORS. PARSONS SPECULATES THIS PLAN MIGHT INCLUDE A "TEMPORARY WITHDRAWAL" BY THE SHAH BUT WITHIN IRAN. SUCH A SCHEME, PARSONS THINKS, IS UNLIKELY TO BRING EVEN A TEMPORARY IMPROVEMENT IN THE SITUATION.

LUCAS STRONGLY BELIEVES THAT A TOUGHER GOVERNMENT POSTURE, I.E. A MILITARY CRACKDOWN, HAS NO CHANCE OF IMPROVING MATTERS. THE SCALE AND QUALITY OF DISSIDENCE ARE SUCH THAT MILITARY METHODS SIMPLY WILL NOT WORK. FURTHER. THE USG IS LIKELY TO BE BLAMED FOR ANY SUCH CHANGE -- THE WIDELY PUBLICIZED PHONE CALL BY DR. BRZEZINSKI MIGHT EVEN GIVE RISE TO A BELIEF THAT THE SHAH WAS ACTING AT THE BEHEST OF THE USG. AS FOR THE CHANCES OF A CIVILIAN GOVERNMENT. HAT TOO WILL NOT WORK UNLESS THE SHAH IS PREPARED TO GIVE UP HIS COMMANDER-INCHIEF POSITION (I.E.

THE SHAH'S CREDIBILITY IS DESTROYED AND OPPOSITIONISTS ASSUME HE WILL HAVE HIS REVENGE IF HE STAYS ON AS COMMANDER-IN-CHIEF). SO FAR' HERE IS NO INDICATION THAT THE SHAH WILL CONSIDER GIVING UP HIS MILITARY POSITION.

IN LUCAS' VIEW, HOWEVER, WE SHOULD NOT THINK SIMPLY IN TERMS OF THE SHAH HAVING TWO OPTIONS -- A STRONG CIVILIAN OR MILITARY GOVERNMENT. LUCAS BELIEVES, AS DO MANY EXPERTS ON IRAN IN LONDON, THAT THE IRANIANS MUST SOLVE THEIR OWN PROBLEMS. AN IMPORTANT QUESTION FOR US MAY BE WHAT OUR RESPONSE SHOULD BE IF WE AND KEY IRANIANS SHOULD CONCLUDE THE SHAH MUST GO. PRESUMABLY, NO IRANIAN WILL HAVE THE COURAGE TO TELL HIM AND WE WILL BE ASKED TO PERFORM THIS FUNCTION. IN THIS EVENT, THE FCO BELIEVES AT PRESENT THAT WE SHOULD NOT CARRY SUCH A MESSAGE.
THE SUDDEN DISLOCATION OF THE SHAH'S EXIT WOULD MAKE MATTERS WORSE.

LUCAS REITERATED HMG'S SUPPORT FOR THE SHAW AND NOTED DR. OWEN'S DETERMINATION THAT THERE BE NO HINT THAT THIS SUPPORT IS SLIPPING IN ANY WAY. LUCAS ADDED THE PERSONAL COMMENT THAT IT IS BECOMING HARD TO IMAGINE A WORSE ECONOMIC SITUATION THAN THE PRESENT ONE, WHICH IS OMINOUS FOR THE US, FOR EUROPE AND FOR THE IRANIANS THEMSELVES. WITH DOMESTIC OIL SUPPLIES DWINDLING TO A TRICKLE, A CRUNCH IS CLEARLY IMMINENT AND THE ECONOMY MAY BECOME THE DETERMINING FACTOR. THERE IS NO EVIDENCE OF A PRO-SHAH BACKLASH DEVELOPING.

EMBOFF ASKED FOR FCO VIEW OF WHAT, IF ANYTHING, WE SHOULD DO NOW. THE ANSWER WAS UNEQUIVOCAL: UK AND US SHOULD DO NOTHING. WE MUST NOT GET INVOLVED AND WE MUST ESPECIALLY NOT TELL THE SHAH TO CRACK DOWN IN EVEN TOUGHER FASHION. SUCH ADVICE COULD BE FATAL FOR HIM AND FOR US.

LUCAS OBSERVED THAT THE DISSIDENT ELEMENTS SEEM TO HAVE NO LACK OF MONEY. QUOTING AN IRANIAN RESIDENT IN LONDON WHO HAS JUST RETURNED FROM TEHRAN. LUCAS SAID THERE IS MUCH SPECULATION BUT LITTLE KNOWLEDGE ABOUT WHERE THIS MONEY IS COMING FROM. THERE ARE BELIEVED TO BE CLOSE LINKS BETWEEN THE BAZAARS AND THE MOSQUES AND IT IS CONCEIVABLE THAT OUTSIDE MONEY IS BEING FUNNELED IN AS WELL. QADHAFI MIGHT BE A DONOR. THE BRITISH HAVE NO EVIDENCE OF SOVIET FINANCING.

AS THE FCO PERMANENT UNDER SECRETARY HAD DONE LAST WEEK. LUCAS ASKED FOR INFORMATION ON THE BALL REPORT. HE MADE IT CLEAR THAT THE FCO HOPES WE WILL SHARE OUR VIEWS WITH THE BRITISH AS WE ARE ASKING THEM TO DO WITH US. BREWSTER

1978STATE328083.subject: DISCUSSION WITH SOVIET OFFICIAL ON IRAN

segments.text: SOVIET EMBASSY THIRD SECRETARY MAGOMED OSMANOV CAME IN DEC. 29 AT HIS REQUEST TO DISCUSS THE SITUATION IN IRAN WITH DEPTOFF IN NEA/IRN. OSMANOV WAS FISHING FOR INFORMATION ON DEVELOPMENTS IN IRAN, PARTICULARLY OUTLOOK FOR SHAH, AND U.S. "CONTINGENCY" PLANS. (DURING PREVIOUS DISCUSSIONS OSMANOV LAMENTED SOVIET LACK OF INFORMATION ON IRAN AND INABILITY TO INFLUENCE EVENTS.)

AFTER AN INITIAL DISCUSSION OF CURRENT EFFORTS BY SADEQI AND BAKHTIAR TO FORM A CIVILIAN GOVERNMENT, AND CURRENT ECONOMIC CRUNCH, OSMANOV STATED THAT ALL THE USSR WANTED WAS TO HAVE CALM AND STABILITY IN IRAN. DEPTOFF REPLIED THAT RECENT SOVIET PRESS STORIES SEEMED TO BELIE THIS AND TOLD OSMANOV IN STRONG TERMS THAT THESE STORIES AND THEIR ATTACKS ON THE US ROLE IN IRAN WERE, AS THE SOVIETS WELL KNEW, MOST UNHELPFUL IN THIS DIFFICULT SITUATION.

OSMANOV MAINTAINED THAT SOVIET PRESS ACCOUNTS WERE PURELY FACTUAL ABOUT EVENTS IN IRAN AND ADDED THAT ONLY PRAVDA SHOULD BE TAKEN SERIOUSLY, OTHER MEDIA BEING MORE "FREE." DEPTOFF SUGGESTED SOVIET EMBASSY SUFFERED FROM LACK OF INFORMATION ABOUT WHAT HAD APPEARED IN SOVIET PRESS AND TASS STORIES AND OFFERED TO PROVIDE COPIES. OSMANOV SAID THAT HE HAD TAKEN NOTE OF US VIEWS ABOUT SOVIET PRESS STORIES AND WOULD REPORT SAME.

OSMANOV BROUGHT UP PRESS STORIES ABOUT US SHIP MOVEMENTS. DEPTOFF REJOINED THAT USSR SHOULD NOT DRAW ITS CONCLUSIONS FROM US PRESS SOURCES, WHICH WERE NONGOVERNMENTAL, BUT RATHER SEEK ITS INFORMATION FROM OFFICIAL SOURCES. DEPTOFF THEN PROCEEDED TO OUTLINE TO OSMANOV THE HISTORY AND COMPOSITION OF MIDEASTFOR AND TO DESCRIBE THE MIDLINK EXERCISE, NOTING THE FACT THAT SOME OF THE SHIPS THAT PARTICIPATED IN THAT EXERCISE HAD TEMPORARILY REMAINED IN THE ARABIAN SEA AREA, BUT OUTSIDE THE PERSIAN GULF. DEPTOFF POINTED OUT THAT US SHIPS MOVED IN AND OUT OF THE INDIAN OCEAN, BUT DID NOT GO INTO QUESTION OF CARRIER FORCE.
IN REPLY TO A QUESTION, DEPTOFF TOLD OSMANOV THAT SHIPS WERE NOT INTENDED FOR EVACUATION PURPOSES.
OSMANOV RAISED MATTER OF "CONTINGENCY" PLANS AND WAS TOLD THAT PRESS REPORTS ABOUT THIS MEANT THE CONTINGENCY EVACUATION PLAN THAT WE HAVE FOR IRAN, AS FOR ALL OTHER COUNTRIES AT ALL TIMES.

REGARDING QUESTION OF US INTERFERENCE IN IRAN, DEPTOFF REITERATED POSITION HE HAD PREVIOUSLY TAKEN WITH OSMANOV THAT THE US WAS NOT INTERFERING, WAS NOT TRYING TO AFFECT ANY PARTICULAR SOLUTION, THAT IT WAS UP TO IRANIANS THEMSELVES TO FIND ANSWER TO PROBLEMS. OSMANOV INSISTED THAT SOVIETS WERE NOT INTERFERING, BUT THAT THEY WERE CONCERNED BECAUSE THEY HAD HAD GOOD RELATIONS WITH SHAH. HE WAS KNOWN QUANTITY AND UNCERTAINTIES ABOUT WHAT MIGHT REPLACE HIM MADE SITUATION VERY UNCOMFORTABLE FOR THEM. RUSSIAN REPEATED THE CALM AND STABILITY THEME.

DEPTOFF BROUGHT UP POINT THAT REPORTEDLY MANY OF THE STUDENTS WHO HAD RETURNED TO IRAN FROM EUROPE AND THE US AND WERE NOW ACTIVE IN VIOLENCE WERE MEMBERS OF COMMUNIST ORGANIZATIONS OF VARIOUS KINDS. DEPTOFF ALSO MENTIONED REPORTS OF SOVIET OVERFLIGHTS OF IRAN. OSMANOV SAID THAT AFTER HE READ ABOUT THESE IN THE NEWSPAPERS, HE HAD SPECIFICALLY CHECKED WITH HIS MINISTER-COUNSELOR WHO HAD TOLD HIM REPORTS WERE NOT TRUE. DEPTOFF TOLD OSMANOV THAT THERE AGAIN APPEARED TO BE A LACK OF INFORMATION AT THE SOVIET EMBASSY; IT WAS A WELL KNOWN FACT THAT THERE HAD BEEN DEEP PENETRATIONS BY SOVIET AIRCRAFT.
OSMANOV SAID HE COULD NOT UNDERSTAND WHAT PURPOSE THEY WOULD HAVE, AND DEPTOFF AGREED THAT THEY DID SEEM MYSTERIOUS.

OSMANOV BROUGHT UP BREZHNEV NOVEMBER 19 STATEMENT ON INTERFERENCE BY US AND SAID BREZHNEV WOULD NOT HAVE MADE THE STATEMENT WITHOUT REASON. DEPTOFF SUGGESTED THAT IF SOVIETS HAD CONCERNS, FEARS, OR WORRIES ABOUT US ROLE IN IRAN, THEY SHOULD RAISE THESE WITH THE USG SO THAT THEY COULD BE DISCUSSED AND DISPELLED, RATHER THAN RESORT TO UNFOUNDED STATEMENTS.

OSMANOV ENDED BY RESTATING SOVIET CONCERNS ABOUT DEVELOPMENTS IN IRAN AND THE BLEAK OUTLOOK FOR THE SHAH. HE SPECIFICALLY MENTIONED THEIR WORRIES ABOUT A POSSIBLE EXTREME RELIGIOUS GOVERNMENT, A HARD-LINE MILITARY GOVERNMENT, OR CHAOS. HE AS MUCH AS ADMITTED THAT THE SOVIETS WERE TRYING TO HAVE THEIR CAKE AND EAT IT TOO -NO ATTACKS ON THE SHAH, VERBAL SUPPORT FOR THE OPPOSITION.

PAN AM INFORMS US THAT CIVIL AIR AUTHORITIES AT MEHRABAD HAVE STATED THAT NO AMERICAN OR ISRAELI AIRCRAFT WILL BE ALLOWED TO LAND IN OR OVERFLY IRAN. IF ANY AMERICAN AIRCRAFT COMES TO IRAN, CIVIL AIR AUTHORITIES CANNOT GUARANTEE THEIR SAFETY. PAN AM IS CONSULTING ITS UNDERWRITERS AND CONSIDERING WHETHER TO PULL OUT OF IRAN.

SECRETARY ASKS THAT YOU URGENTLY CONTACT GOI TO OBTAIN ASSURANCES THAT MEHRABAD AIRPORT WILL BE AVAILABLE FOR USE BY AMERICAN CARRIERS. GOI SHOULD UNDERSTAND UTMOST GRAVITY OF THIS SITUATION. PLEASE LET US KNOW AT ONCE IF GOI IS UNABLE TO PROVIDE SECURITY AND AIR TRAFFIC SERVICES AT MEHRABAD.
COMMUNICATE WITH US BY TELEPHONE THROUGH OPERATIONS CENTER. ADVISE US ALSO ABOUT POSSIBILITIES OF USE AND SECURITY SITUATIONS AT OTHER NEAREST AIRPORTS. NEWSOM

FOLLOWING RECEIVED FROM EXXON: 96 OSCO PEOPLE LEFT YESTERDAY, 350-400 ARE EXPECTED TO LEAVE TODAY. PEOPLE ARE BEING FERRIED TO ABADAN FROM AHWAZ ON AN F-27, DEPARTURES ARE OUT OF ABADAN INTO BAHRAIN AND THEN ON TO ATHENS. OSCO PEOPLE ARE STILL FIGURING THAT ABOUT 1,000 PEOPLE WILL LEAVE IN THE COURSE OF THE NEXT THREE DAYS. FLIGHT CLEARANCE PROBLEMS HAVE APPARENTLY BEEN SOLVED; THERE ARE PROBLEMS WITH IMMIGRATION CLEARANCES AND PAPERS NOT BEING IN ORDER. APPARENTLY MOST OF THESE HAVE BEEN SOLVED AFTER THE USUAL ARGUMENTS WITH IRANIAN OFFICIALS.

THERE IS GENERAL SHOOTING IN AHWAZ, MILITARY PROTECTION FOR OFFICES HAS BEEN WITHDRAWN, BUT APPARENTLY SOME SECURITY FORCES REMAIN IN THE OIL FIELDS. MILITARY PROTECTION FOR MR. EVANS HAS BEEN WITHDRAWN, A CONDITION SET FORTH BY THE STRIKERS. EVANS IS NOT PARTICULARLY UPSET BY THIS SINCE HE DID NOT FEEL WELL PROTECTED ANYWAY.

NATIONAL FRONT PEOPLE ARE IN AHWAZ, AND HAVE, IN ESSENCE TAKEN OVER THE OIL FIELDS. PROVIDED THEIR POSITION IS NOT DISPUTED BY GOI FORCES, OSCO PEOPLE DO NOT FEEL THREATENED. 50 TO 100 PEOPLE WILL REMAIN IN IRAN ON A VOLUNTARY BASIS. EXACTLY WHERE THEY WILL STAY HAS NOT YET BEEN DECIDED. AHWAZ IS DEEMED TOO DANGEROUS. KHARG IS BEING SERIOUSLY CONSIDERED.
GRUMMAN OFFICIAL INFORMED DEPARTMENT THAT HIS FIRM HAS NO PLANS TO MOVE PEOPLE OUT OF ISFAHAN AT THE MOMENT. CITY IS REPORTED VERY QUIET. NEWSOM

SUMMARY. ON 14 JANUARY A STUDENT DEMONSTRATION AT TABRIZ'S AZARABADEGAN UNIVERSITY RESULTED IN DAMAGE TO BUILDINGS AND VEHICLES ON THE CAMPUS, AND THE TABRIZ BAZAAR WAS CLOSED BECAUSE OF ANTI-GOVERNMENT PROTESTS THERE THE SAME DAY. IN ANSWER TO THE ABOVE INCIDENTS, A MASSIVE PRO-GOVERNMENT RALLY WAS HELD IN TABRIZ ON 17 JANUARY. END SUMMARY.

ON JAN 14 DURING THE END-OF-SEMESTER EXAM PERIOD, AZARABADEGAN UNIVERSITY SAW ANOTHER OF ITS RECENTLY SPORADIC PROTEST DEMONSTRATIONS. ALLEGEDLY IN SUPPORT OF PREVIOUS DEMONSTRATIONS IN THE RELIGIOUS CENTER OF QOM AND THE TEHRAN BAZAAR, THE TABRIZ CAMPUS ACTIVITY RESULTED IN DAMAGE TO SEVERAL UNIVERSITY BUILDINGS AND ALSO TO VEHICLES PARKED ON THE CAMPUS. ONEWITNESS CLAIMED THAT APPROXIMATELY FIFTY STUDENTS TOOK PART IN THE PROTEST, AND THAT TWICE THAT NUMBER OF POLICE WERE PRESENT TO STOP THE ACTIVITY.

ON THE SAME DAY, AND AGAIN ALLEGEDLY IN PROTEST OF THE GOVERNMENT'S ACTION IN QOM, A DEMONSTRATION AND FIGHTING BROKE OUT IN THE CENTER OF TABRIZ'S ULTRACONSERVATIVE BAZAAR AREA. THE BAZAAR WAS ORDERED CLOSED FOR THE DAY, AND SOME SHOPS HAVE REMAINED SHUT. SPECIFIC TARGETS OF THE BAZAAR DEMONSTRATORS WERE LOCAL BRANCHES OF THE SADERAT BANK AND THE COMMERCIAL (BAZARGAN) BANK, BOTH OF WHICH ARE POPULARLY RUMORED TO BE CONTROLLED BY ADHERENTS OF THE BAHAI FAITH.

JAN 17 SAW THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT'S RESPONSE TO THE ABOVE INCIDENTS WITH A MASSIVE RALLY TO SHOW TABRIZ'S SUPPORT FOR THE REGIME. ALL SCHOOLS, GOVERNMENT OFFICES AND STATE FACTORIES IN THE AREA WERE ORDERED SHUT, AND THE STUDENTS, TEACHERS, GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES AND FACTORY WORKERS WERE COMMANDED TO GATHER TOGETHER IN FRONT OF THE PROVINCIAL GOVERNOR'S OFFICE BUILDING. SPEECHES WERE MADE BY REPRESENTATIVES OF DIFFERENT PROFESSIONAL AND WORKERS' GROUPS (INCLUDING THE CLERGY) TO A CROWD OFFICIALLY ESTIMATED AT FIFTY THOUSAND, A NOT UNLIKELY FIGURE GIVEN THE STUDENT WORKER POPULATION ORDERED TO ATTEND.

1978TABRIZ00020.subject: TABRIZ RIOTS: POLICE OFFICIALS GET AXE TABRIZ NEWS MEDIA ANNOUNCED FEBRUARY 28 THAT DIRECTOR OF THE POLICE FOR EAST AZERBAIJAN PROVINCE HAS BEEN REM OV

segments.text: TABRIZ NEWS MEDIA ANNOUNCED FEBRUARY 28 THAT DIRECTOR OF THE POLICE FOR EAST AZERBAIJAN PROVINCE HAS BEEN REMOVED FROM OFFICE AND IS NOW AWAITING A DECISION BY THE IMPERIAL INVESTIGATING COMMISSION FOR FURTHER POSSIBLE PUNISHMENT. THE DIRECTOR OF "CIVIL" POLICE INTELLIGENCE OF THE EAST AZERBAIJAN AND THE POLICE MAJOR IN CHARGE OF THE 6TH PRECINCT HAVE ALSO BEEN REMOVED FROM TABRIZ, THE FORMER BEING SEPARATED FROM THE SERVICE AND THE LATTER OFFICIALLY REPRIMANDED AND TRANSFERRED TO ANOTHER POST. OTHER TRANSFERS ARE EXPECTED IN VIEW OF PUBLIC STATEMENTS BY THE SHAH THAT OFFICIALS FOUND GUILTY OF NEGLIGENCE WHICH ENABLED THE TABRIZ VIOLENCE TO OCCUR MUST BE PUNISHED.
TEHRAN NEWS REPORTS TABRIZ MAYOR ALSO SACKED.

1978TEHRAN00051.subject: IRAN STOPS DANISH IMPORTS IN RETALIATION FOR DANISH LENIENCY TOWARD IRANIAN DEMONSTRATORS

segments.text: THE IMPORT BANS AGAINST DANISH AND ITALIAN IMPORTS HAVE BEEN IN EFFECT FOR APPROXIMATELY ONE WEEK AND HAVE TAKEN THE FORM OF AN ORDER FROM THE CENTRAL BANK OF IRAN TO THE COMMERCIAL BANKS NOT TO ISSUE LETTER OF CREDIT FOR IMPORTS FROM ITALY OR DENMARK. TRADE AND OTHER SOURCES BELIEVE BOTH BOYCOTTS WILL BE OF A TEMPORARY NATURE. WELL-PLACED SOURCE IN IRANIAN CHAMBER OF COMMERCE, WHICH ANNOUNCED BAN, THOUGHT BOYCOTTS WOULD LAST 3-4 WEEKS BUT PROBABLY WOULD REQUIRE ITALIAN AND DANISH REPS VISIT TO TEHRAN TO DISCUSS MATTER.
END THE BANS APPARENTLY STEMMED FROM SHAH'S REACTION TO REPORTS FROM THE FOREIGN MINISTRY ON DANISH AND ITALIAN GOVERNMENT HANDLING OF RECENT DEMONSTRATIONS.

CONVERSATION BETWEEN DEPUTY CHIEF OF MISSION AND DANISH AMBASSADOR MUNK HERE CONFIRMS ACCOUNT IN REFTEL. ACCORDING TO MUNK, BEGINNING MID-DECEMBER HE RECEIVED REPORTS THAT BANKS WERE REFUSING TO OPEN LETTERS OF CREDIT FOR DANISH PRODUCTS. SUBSEQUENTLY HE WAS SUMMONED TO SEE FOREIGN MINISTER WHO NDICATED ACTION ON IMPORTS WAS IN RESPONSE TO UNSATISFACTORY DANISH GOVERNMENT HANDLING OF IRANIAN DEMONSTRATORS. MUNK REMONSTRATED THAT IRANIAN AMBASSADOR IN COPENHAGEN HAD BEEN IN FULL AGREEMENT WITH TREATMENT OF DEMONSTRATORS, (I.E., EXPULSION, WITHOUT PROSECUTION) AND EXPRESSED PERPLEXITY AT THE IRANIAN ACTION.

FOREIGN MINISTER APPEARED UNAWARE OF IRANIAN AMBASSADOR'S CONCURRENCE IN LENIENT TREATMENT AND EVIDENCED SOME DISCOMFITURE, NOTING THAT PERHAPS THE PUNISHMENT MIGHT BE A BIT TOO SEVERE. HE DID NOT, HOWEVER, OFFER TO TAKE AMELIORATIVE ACTION. FROM TENOR OF REMARKS OF A GOI OFFICIAL WITH WHOM WE SPOKE, FACT THAT IRANIAN AMBASSADOR IN COPENHAGEN CONCURRED IN FINAL DANISH DECISION NOT TO PROSECUTE SEEMS TO BE GETTING AROUND TOWN.

AMBASSADOR MUNK THEREAFTER QUERIED COURT MINISTER REGARDING MATTER BUT RECEIVED NO ENCOURAGEMENT.
