HE ALSO DISCUSSED SUBJECT WITH EEC COLLEAGUES WHO HAD LITTLE TO OFFER IN THE WAY POSSIBLE COUNTERMEASURES OR LEVERAGE AND RECALLED SIMILAR 1974 FIVE MONTH BOYCOTT OF DUTCH IMPORTS IMPOSED BY GOI FOR SAME REASON, I.E. INVASION OF IRANIAN DIPLOMATIC PREMISES BY DEMONSTRATORS AND "PERMISSIVE TREATMENT" (AS GOI SEES IT) BY HOST GOVERNMENT.

COMMENT: EMBASSY WOULD OPINE THAT BANS WILL PROBABLY LAST MONTH OR SO AND THEN QUIETLY DROPPED PROVIDED DANISH AND ITALIAN GOVERNMENTS GIVE SOME SORT OF ASSURANCES RE AVOIDING REPETITION OF EVENTS. MEANWHILE, IRANIAN FIRMS TRADING WITH DANISH AND ITALIAN SUPPLIERS ARE MUCH PUT OUT AND HAVE BEEN IMPORTUNING IRANIAN CHAMBER OF COMMERCE, VIRTUALLY AN OFFICIAL GOI BODY, FOR RELIEF, TO NO AVAIL. FINALLY, IRANIAN AMBASSADOR TO DENMARK, A WELL-KNOWN IRANIAN FEMINIST AND PROBABLE CLOSET HUMANITARIAN, HAS UNQUESTIONABLY BLOTTED HER COPYBOOK WITH HER SUPERIORS HERE.

PRESS JANUARY TWO REPORTED SHAH'S REMARKS ON SOMALIA WHICH WERE GIVEN TO LOCAL PRESS AND TV REPRESENTATIVES IN TERMS OF A WARNING THAT IRAN "WILL NOT WATCH IDLY AS ETHIOPIA ATTACKS THE RECOGNIZED BORDERS OF SOMALIA." THE BASIC TASK, SHAH IS DESCRIBED AS SAYING, IS TO CREATE DIRECT CONTACTS BETWEEN SOMALIA AND ETHIOPIA SO THAT PEACE TALKS CAN BE STARTED.

SECONDLY, "WE MUST MAKE ETHIOPIA UNDERSTAND THAT SO FAR WE HAVE NOT TAKEN ANY ACTION AGAINST IT. ON THE CONTRARY, WE HAVE TRIED FOR A PEACEFUL SOLUTION TO THE DIFFICULTIES. AT THE SAME TIME WE MUST ALSO MENTION TO ETHIOPIA THAT IF IT IS THINKING OF INVADING THE RECOGNIZED BORDERS OF SOMALIA, THIS IS NOT SOMETHING WHICH IRAN WOULD IGNORE."
SHAH IS REPORTED TO HAVE CONFIRMED TO THE PRESS THAT SITUATION IN THE HORN OF AFRICA HAD COME UNDER EXTENSIVE REVIEW IN HIS TALKS WITH PRESIDENT CARTER.

SUMMARY: SEVERAL DEMONSTRATIONS, TWO BOMBINGS (ONE NOT YET CONFIRMED) AND VANDALISM AT FOUNDATION OFFICE MARKED PERIOD IMMEDIATELY SURROUNDING PRESIDENT CARTER'S DEC. 31-JAN 1 VISIT TO TEHRAN. RUMORS ABOUND AS TO WHO WAS INVOLVED AND FACTS ARE FEW. END SUMMARY.

POTENTIALLY MOST DANGEROUS INCIDENT WAS DEC. 28 BOMBING OF IRAN-AMERICAN SOCIETY STUDENT CENTER TWO BLOCKS FROM TEHRAN UNIVERSITY CAMPUS. INCIDENT (REPORTED REFTEL) OCCURRED IN EVENING AFTER CENTER WAS EMPTY. GUARD WAS INJURED AND DAMAGE TO FIRST FLOOR WAS EXTENSIVE, BUT IAS HOPES TO HAVE CENTER BACK IN OPERATION EARLY THIS WEEK SINCE CLASSROOM SPACES WERE NOT SUBSTANTIALLY DAMAGED.

EMBASSY HAS HEARD THAT PLAN AND BUDGET ORGANIZATION HAD ONE FLOOR SEVERELY DAMAGED BY BOMB APPARENTLY SIMILAR TO THAT WHICH DAMAGED IAS CENTER. INCIDENT, WHICH REPORTEDLY HAPPENED EVENING OF DEC. 31, HAS NOT BEEN MADE PUBLIC.

PRIOR TO 1145 HOURS ON DEC. 31, A GROUP OF YOUNG MEN AND WOMEN DRIFTED INTO THE OFFICES OF AMERICAN MIDEAST EDUCATIONAL AND TRAINING SERVICES (AMIDEAST), CURRENTLY THE NAME OF THE FORMER AMERICAN FRIENDS OF THE MIDDLE EAST. AT ABOUT 1145 HOURS, ONE YOUTH PULLED A MASK OVER HIS HEAD, GAVE SHORT SPEECH ON DICTATORIAL REGIMES IN IRAN AND THE US, AND LED REST OF THE GROUP IN OBVIOUSLY PREORGANIZED EFFORT TO VANDALIZE OFFICES AND PAINT SLOGANS ON WALL. NO MIDEAST EMPLOYEES WERE HURT, THOUGH ALL WERE PRESENT.

THEY DID NOT RECOGNIZE ANY OF THE YOUTHS PRESENT AS ANY OF THE STUDENTS WHO NORMALLY FREQUENT THIS NONPROFIT CENTER FOR INFORMATION ON US EDUCATION. THIS IS THE FIRST KNOWN INCIDENT AT AMIDEAST OFFICES, AND POST RSO HAS AGREED TO ADVISE AMIDEAST ON PRECAUTIONS AGAINST FUTURE PROBLEMS.

ABOUT 1000 HOURS DEC. 31, A GROUP OF ABOUT 200 PEOPLE GATHERED ONE AND A HALF BLOCKS SOUTH OF THE EMBASSY ON ROOSEVELT AND BEGAN TO MARCH TOWARD THE EMBASSY WHEN THEY WERE DISPERSED BY POLICE. JAN. 1 TEHRAN FARSI AND ENGLISH PRESS BASED ON SEMI-OFFICIAL PARS NEWS AGENCY STORY, INDICATED DEMONSTRATORS REACHED EMBASSY, BUT OBSERVATION BY EMBASSY SY DID NOT SUPPORT THIS. LATER, IN EARLY AFTERNOON, GROUP OF ABOUT 40 YOUTHS BEGAN TO GATHER IN FRONT OF IRAN AMERICAN AGRICULTURAL ORGANIZATION, APPARENTLY WITH INTENT OF THROWING ROCKS AND BREAKING WINDOWS. POLICE CHASED GROUP OFF BEFORE DEMONSTRATION OCCURRED.
PARS NEWS AGENCY ALSO REPORTED IN JAN. 1 DISPATCH AT LEAST TWO OTHER DEC. 31 DEMONSTRATIONS WHERE ANTIAMERICAN SLOGANS WERE SHOUTED, BUT EMBASSY HAS NO OTHER CONFIRMATION.

INTERESTING BYPLAY OCCURRED REGARDING AMIDEAST INCIDENT WHEN ALL THREE FOREIGN CORRESPONDENTS HERE WERE TELEPHONED BY GROUP ALLEGEDLY RESPONSIBLE FOR RAID AND INFORMED OF DETAILS. THIS LED MORE SUSPICIOUS AMONG THEM TO OPINE THAT PERHAPS GOI MAY HAVE HAD NO OTHER EVIDENCE TO SUPPORT THIS VIEW, MODUS OPERANDI OF GROUP WHICH INVADED AMIDEAST SUGGESTS STANDARD STUDENT TACTICS RATHER THAN PARA-MILITARY APPROACH WHICH HAS CHARATERIZED SUSPECTED GOI-INSTIGATED INCIDENTS.

ONLY MAJOR DISSIDENT PUBLIC EFFORT HAS BEEN BROADSIDE FROM "ALLIANCE OF NATIONAL FRONT", WHICH CRITIZES CARTER VISIT IN VERY ABUSIVE TERMS AND PAINTS US AS IN LEAGUE WITH ZIONISTS IN MIDEAST. TENOR OF ITEM MAKES IT VERY SUSPICIOUS, AND SOME OF LANGUAGE (INCLUDING REFERENCE TO "KILLER-NEUTRON BOM" COULD ALMOST BE LIFTED FROM SOVIET AND RADICAL PALESTINIAN OFFERINGS. PIECE DOES NOT RPT NOT APPEAR TO BE WORK OF DISSIDENT GROUPS WITH WHICH EMBASSY AND LOCAL FOREIGN JOURNALISTS ARE FAMILIAR AND IS TOO ABUSIVE, POLITICAL AND IDEOLOGICAL TO HAVE BEEN GOI PLANT.
IT MIGHT BE NICE BIT OF DISSIMULATION BY A COMMUNIST EMBASSY OR MORE PROBABLY A FIRST-TIME OFFERING BY NEW MARXIST GROUP WHICH HAS NOT PREVIOUSLY BEEN ACTIVE IN BROADSIDE PARADE.

EMBASSY COMMENT: RUN OF INDIDENTS WAS ABOUT WHAT WE HAD BEEN LED TO EXPECT. ORIGINS OF BOMBINGS AND AMIDEAST INVASION REMAIN MYSTERIES. SPECULATION ON POSSIBLE GOI BACKING FOR SOME INCIDENTS EXISTS. WHILE IS IMPOSSIBLE TO RULE THIS OUT, GOI'S WHOLE ATTITUDE TOWARD CARTER VISIT SUGGESTS THAT THIS IS NOT THE CASE. MORE SUBSTANTIVE FACTS WHICH WOULD ALLOW MORE DEFINITE CONCLUSIONS TO BE DRAWN AS TO ORIGINS OF DEMONSTRATORS IN ALL INCIDENTS ARE SIMPLY NOT AVAILABLE.

1978TEHRAN00110.subject: TURKISH AMBASSADOR'S CONCERNS RE U.S. "DOWNGRADING OF CENTO"

segments.text: OF CENTO"

ON JANUARY 1, AFTER DEPARTURE OF PRESIDENT CARTER, TURKISH AMBASSADOR GUMRUKCUOGLU APPROACHED ME AND SAID HE WOULD LIKE OPPORTUNITY TO DISCUSS PRESIDENT'S VISIT HERE. ACCORDINGLY, I MET WITH HIM MORNING JANUARY 3 AND GAVE HIM GENERALIZED BRIEFING ON RESULTS OF MEETINGS BETWEEN PRESIDENT AND SHAH.

IT DEVELOPED, HOWEVER, THAT GUMRUKCUOGLU WAS ONLY MARGINALLY INTERESTED IN THOSE DISCUSSIONS. BURDEN OF HIS CONCERN WAS IMPRESSION THAT UNITED STATES, BY STRESSING ITS SPECIAL RELATIONSHIPS WITH IRAN, WAS DOWNGRADING CENTO AND, MORE PARTICULARLY, ITS PRESENT AND FUTURE RELATIONSHIPS WITH TURKEY. HE STRESSED THAT PRESIDENT'S CHARACTERIZATION OF IRAN AS AN "ISLAND" OF STABILITY OF PROGRESS SUGGESTED THE CONCLUSION THAT ALL OTHER COUNTRIES IN THE REGION-INCLUDING TURKEY--WERE IN A STATE OF HOPELESS TURMOIL.

HIS CONCERNS IN THIS MATTER WERE MAGNIFIED BY AN EDITORIAL APPEARING IN JANUARY 3 EDITION OF FRENCH-LANGUAGE JOURNAL DE TEHRAN WHICH STATED, "TO CITE ONLY THIS REGION, IRAN REMAINS THE ONLY COUNTRY ON WHICH THE UNITED STATES CAN COUNT TO SAFEGUARD THE PEACE, THIS THIS CONTEXT, ONE CAN THINK OF THE CENTO PACT AND OF THE OTHER TWO MEMBERS IN THE GRIP OF THE MOST SEVERE POLITICAL AND ECONOMIC DEFFICULTIES." GUMRUKCUOGLU SAID HE ASSUMED THE WRITER OF THAT EDITORIAL HAD RECEIVED SOME OFFICIAL GUIDANCE.

I TOLD THE AMBASSADOR THAT I FELT THE EDITORIAL WAS CONSIDRABLY MORE EXPANSIVE THAN THE SENSE OF THE DISCUSSIONS BETWEEN THE CHIEFS OF STATE AND THAT THERE HAD BEEN NO RPT NO DEROGATION FROM CENTO AND CERTAINLY NO RPT NO LIGHT DISMISSAL OF TURKEY AS THE JOURNAL SUGGESTS. I TOLD HIM THAT, IN FACT, DURING THE EARLIER DISCUSSIONS BETWEEN THE PRESIDENT AND THE SHAH IN WASHINGTON, THERE HAD BEEN AN EXCHANGE IN WHICH BOTH HAD STRESSED THE KEY IMPORTANCE OF TURKEY AND THE NEED TO RESTORE U.S.-TURKISH RELATIONS TO THEIR PROPER LEVEL.

AS FOR THE PRESIDENT'S USE OF THE WORD "ISLAND", THAT DID NOT SUGGEST A SURROUNDING SEA OF CHAOS. IN FACT, I THOUGHT WE COULD CONSTRUCT A CONCEPT OF OTHER SUCH "ISLANDS", TO INCLUDE TURKEY, AND FOR THAT MATTER, GREECE, IN AN "ARCHIPELAGO" WHICH WE WOULD HOPE IN THE FUTURE TO SEE DEVELOP INTO A "PENINSULA". HAVING MILKED THAT LITERARY ALLUSION FOR MORE THAN IT WAS WORTH, I THEN TURNED TO THE SITUATION IN TURKEY AND ITS IMPLICATIONS FOR CYPRUS AND NATO.

GUMRUKCUOGLU WARMED TO THAT SUBJECT AND GAVE ME A MOST OPTIMISTIC FORECAST FOR THE NEW TURKISH GOVERNMENT, CLAIMING THAT ECEVIT WOULD BE FAR MORE ABLE THAN DEMIREL TO LAUNCH A NEGOTIATION WITH CARAMANLIS ON CYPRUS AND OTHERWISE FORETELLING GREAT PROGRESS FOR US-TURKISH RELATIONS.

IN CONCLUDING OUR CONVERSATION, I ASSURED GUMRUKCUOGLU THAT I WOULD REPORT HIS CONCERNS TO WASHINGTON, WHERE I FELT SURE THEY WOULD BE UNDERSTOOD. SULLIVAN ------------------105078 021507Z /45 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 57 INFO AMEMBASSY TEHRAN AMCONSUL SHIRAZ AMCONSUL TABRIZ SECTION 2 OF 2 ISFAHAN 0110

ANTI-AMERICAN INCIDENTS ALSO OCCURRED DISTINCTLY FROM THE MAIN DEMONSTRATIONS. THE U.S. COMMUNITY HAD BEEN TRAUMATIZED BY THE WIDE-SPREAD AND WIDELY-BELIEVED REPORT THAT DISSIDENT GROUPS PLANNED A MASS SLAUGHTER OF AMERICANS TO COMMEMORATE THE SHAH'S BIRTHDAY, AND TENDED TO REACT WITH PANIC TO ACTUAL INCIDENTS. ON THE MINOR INCIDENTS BY INADVERTANTELY STUMBING ON MOBS. THERE WERE NO INJURIES AND NO DAMAGE, BUT THE NEXT DAY THERE WAS ALMOST 60 PERCENT ABSENTEEISM AT THE SCHOOL. ON THE 23RD AND 24TH, THE DUPON JOINT VENTURE, POLYACRYL IRAN, RECEIVED THREATS; A ROCK WAS THROWN INTO AN EMPLOYEES RESIDENCE, AND THE MANAGER RECEIVED A TELEPHONED THREAT ON HIS LIFE.

THE ATTACK ON THE YOUTH HOSTEL, OCCUPIED BY SOME 20 FOREIGNERS, INCLUDING SEVEN AMERICANS, WAS APPARENTLY AN ATTACK ON PROPERTY, AS NO RESIDENTS WERE INJURED, BUT WAS PERCEIVED AS AT ATTEMPT ON THE LIVES OF THE AMERICANS. REPORTEDLY, TWO MEMBERS OF THE MOB WERE SEVERELY INJURED OR KILLED BY TWO FOREIGNERS THERE DURING THE ATTACK. THE ATTACKS ON THE RESTAURANT IS PERCEIVED BY THE U.S. COMMUNITY AS CAUSED BY THE AMERICAN PATRONAGE OF THAT RESTAURANT. AN AMERICAN'S CAR WAS VANDALIZED (TIRES SLASHED/WINDOWS BROKEN), AND THE COMMUNITY REACTION WAS THAT THIS WAS A MERE SUBSTITUTE FOR THE UNAVAILABLE AMERICAN.

ONLY ONE ADDITIONAL AMERICAN FAMILY IS REPORTED LEAVING AFTER THIS WEEKEND, BUT BELL HELICOPTER INTERNATIONAL, THE LARGEST U.S. COMPANY HERE, IS FEARING A CONTINUED OUT-FLOW. TO DATE, THEY HAVE LOST 51 EMPLOYEES AND 96 FAMILIES OF DEPENDENTS, AND IT COULD CLIMB MUCH HIGHER IF THE LEVEL OF FEAR IS NOW SOMEHOW REDUCED.

COMMENT: IT APPEARS THAT THE GROWING SUCCESS AND ORGANIZATION OF THE DEMONSTRATIONS WAS PREDICATED ON CONTINUED RESTRAINT IN THE USE OF FORCE BY THE AUTHORITIES. THE CROWDS FACED NIGHT-STICKS AND TEAR-GAS WITH DEFIANCE AND OFTEN ROCKS, AND IGNORED SHOTS FIRED IN THE AIR. OBSERVERS STATED THAT STUDENT CROWDS ACTED LIKE DISCIPLINED SOLDIERS IN CONFRONTING AUTHORITIES. SHORTLY AFTER THE FIRST CASUALTIES IN THE MAIN SQUARE, HOWEVER, THE DEMONSTRATORS WERE FLEEING IN BLIND PANIC, WHICH APPEARED TO EMBOLDEN THE SOLDIERS. THE AUTHORITIES INSIST ON ONLY ONE DEATH- REPORTEDLY A BOMB-MAKER BLOWN UP IN HIS HOME MAKING A BOMB-BUT THERE IS SUFFICIENT EVIDENCE TO INDICATE DEATHS IN THE 20 TO 30 RANGE.

THE LACK OF ORGANIZED PROTEST ON FRIDAY AND SATURDAY HAS NOW GIVEN WAY TO NEW PEACEFUL STRIKES, WHICH COULD EASILY SPREAD AGAIN TO LARGE PROTESTS, ESPECIALLY AS THE FACTS OF THE DEATHS ARE SHARED AND KNOWN. POLICE AUTHORITIES ARE NERVOUS ABOUT PROBABLE SEVENTH - AND FORTIETH-DAY DEMONSTRATIONS (NOV. 01 AND DEC 4.) ALTHOUGH MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES DISCOUNT THE POSSIBILITY. IT ALSO APPEARS THAT THE MAIN PROTEST WAS BASICALLY PEACEFUL AND ANTI-REGIME, ALTHOUGH SPLINTER GROUPS WERE INVOLVED IN VIOLENCE AND ANTI-AMERICAN ACTIVITIES. THE AMERICAN COMMUNITY, UNFORTUNATELY, FINDS ITSELF UNABLE TO DISTINGUISH BETWEEN DIFFERENT FACTIONS, AND SEES THE ENTIRE IRANIAN POPULATION AS A THREAT.

RUMOR IS BECOMING INCREASINGLY EFFECTIVE AGAINST AMERICANS, AND THE CURRENT OUTFLOW COULD EASILY BECOMEAN UNOFFICIAL EVACUATION. BOTH COMPANY OFFICIALS AND IRANIAN OFFICIALS INCREASINGLY SEE THE MOVEMENT OF THE ENTIRE AMERICAN POPULATION INTO GUARDED "U.S. GHETTOS" AS THE ONLY SOLUTION TO THE DANGER OF RANDOM VIOLENCE. THEY ARE MAKING THIS DETERMINATION, HOWEVER, WITHOUT THE CAPABILITY OF RAPIDLY HOUSING LARGE NUMBERS. THEREFORE, EMPLOYEES IN TOWN ARE MADE TO FEEL THEIR COMPANIES CONSIDER THEM IN DANGER, RESULTING IN EVEN MORE FEAR. THE LEVEL OF FEAR REMAINS HIGH, AND MOST AMERICANS FEEL THREATENED. A SINGLE INCIDENT INVOLVING SERIOUS INJURY OR DEATH FORAN AMERICAN COULD RESULT IN A MASS EXODUS FROM ISFAHAN.
THE CONSULATE, THE SECURITY COMMITTEE, IRANIAN AUTHORITIES, AND THE COMPANIES ARE DOING WHAT IS POSSIBLE TO PREVENT THIS.

1978TEHRAN00144.subject: FOLLOW-UP ON SUBJECTS DISCUSSED BY PRES AND SHAH

segments.text: COURT MINISTER HOVEYDA CALLED ME AFTERNOON JAN 4 AT SHAH'S REQUEST TO FOLLOW UP SUBJECTS DISCUSSED DURING PRESIDENTIAL VISIT. HE REFERRED TO SHAH'S OFFER TO VISIT CAIRO AND RIYADH IN FURTHERANCE OF MIDDLE EAST PEACE NEGOTITATIONS.

HOVEYDA ASKED ME TO INFORM YOU THAT SHAH HAD ALREADY CONVEYED OFFER TO VISIT CAIRO THROUGH SPECIAL EMISSARY WHOM SADAT HAS SENT TO TEHRAN FOR BRIEFING ON PRESIDENT'S VISIT. AS SOON AS HE RECEIVES INDICATION OF SADAT'S PREFERENCE ON TIMING, HE WILL WORK OUT SCHEDULE WITH SAUDI ARABIANS.

IN VIEW OF POSSIBLITY THAT SADAT MAY OPT FOR EARLY MEETING, HOVEYDA ASKED ME TO REMIND YOU OF PRESIDENT' OFFER TO SEND SHAH MESSAGE REPORTING HIS MEETINGS WITH KHALED AND SADAT AS WELL AS HIS SUGGESTIONS ON LINE WHICH SHAH MIGHT TAKE TO ENHANCE PROSPECTS FOR SUCCESS OF CURRENT NEGOTIATIONS.

HOVEYDA ALSO MENTIONED INTERESTS WHICH IRAN SHARES WITH EGYPT AND SAUDI ARABIA ON HORN OF AFRICA. HE REALIZED IT MIGHT BE PREMATURE FOR YOU TO HAVE ANY CONSIDERED PLAN TO ACTION ON ETHIOPIA-SOMALIA CEASE-FIRE EFFORT, BUT ASKED FOR ANY GUIDANCE YOU MIGHT FIND HELPFUL AS RESULT OF YOUR DISCUSSIONS IN RIYADH AND ASWAN.

WE HAVE DETERMINED THAT THE SHAH WILL BE IN TOWN AND PROBABLY AVAILABLE BETWEEN NOW AND JAN 21. HE WILL BE UNAVAILABLE FROM JAN 21 TO FEB 1 AND BACK AGAIN FROM FEB 2 TO FEB 10. HOPE THIS GIVES YOU ENOUGH LATITUDE IN PLANNING YOUR VISIT TO TEHRAN TO BRIEF THE SHAH ON SALT AS DISCUSSED EARLIER. PLEASE ADVISE.

SUMMARY: AS CIVIL UNREST IN SOUTHERN IRAN CONTINUES, THERE HAVE BEEN INCREASING INDICATIONS OF UNHAPPINESS WITHIN THE MILITARY. DISSATISFACTION SEEMS TO BE OF TWO BASIC SORTS: ON THE ONE HAND, THE CAREER OFFICER CORPS APPEARS TO BE LOOSING PATIENCE WITH WHAT IT REGARDS AS VACILATION AT THE TOP, AND, ON THE OTHER, LARGELY CONSCRIPT ENLISTED PERSONNEL SEEM TO BE CHAFING UNDER THE REQUIREMENT TO MAINTAIN CIVIL ORDER IN THE FACE OF BROADSPREAD DISCONTENT AMONG PEOPLE FROM BACKGROUNDS SIMILAR TO THEIR OWN. END SUMMARY

THE MOST DRAMATIC EXAMPLE OF DISSENSION WITHIN THE RANKS CAME ON OCTOBER 26 IN JAHROM, ABOUT 180 KILOMETERS FROM SHIRAZ, WHERE A YOUNG DRAFTEE ASSASSINATED THE LOCAL POLICE CHIEF AND SERIOUSLY WOUNDED THE CITY'S MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR. SOURCES IN SHIRAZ HAVE TOLD US THAT THE CIRCUMSTANCES SURROUNDING THE ASSASSINATION INDICATE THAT IT WAS WELLPLANNED AND MAY HAVE INVOLVED THE COOPERATION OF AT LEAST ONE OTHER ENLISTED MAN. ACCORDING TO THESE SOURCES, THE POLICE CHIEF AND MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR CAME OUT OF THE BUILDING WHERE LOCAL OFFICIALS AND DIGNITARIES HAD JUST OBSERVED THE SHAH'S BIRTHDAY AND GOT INTO THE BACK OF A CHAUFEURED MILITARY VEHICLE.

AT THAT POINT, THE DRIVER STOPPED THE MOTOR AND GOT OUT, OSTENSIBLY TO LOOK UNDER THE HOOD. THEREUPON, THE ASSASSIN, CONCEALED ON THE ROOF OF A NEARBY BUILDING WITH A MACHINE-GUN, FIRED A NUMBER OF ROUNDS INTO THE VEHICHLE, KILLING THE POLICE CHIEF INSTANTLY AND SERIOUSLY WOUNDING THE MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR. THIS EVENT FOLLOWED EARLIER REPORTS OF DISSENSION AMONG THE TROOPS STATIONED IN JAHROM WHICH HAS EXPERIENCED A HIGH LEVEL OF UNREST THROUGHOUT MOST OF 1978.

ELSEWHERE, CAREER OFFICERS HAVE BEEN GROWING MORE VOCAL IN THEIR DISAPPROVAL OF THE SHARIF-EMAMI GOVERNMENT'S PERSISTENT DETERMINATION TO CONCILIATE. IN THEIR VIEW, MARTIAL LAW IS LOOSING ITS CREDIBILITY THROUGH THE GOVERNMENT'S REFUSAL TO ENFORCE ITS OWN MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS. THE PROHIBITION AGAINST ASSEMBLAGES OF MORE THAN THREE PEOPLE IS BEING TOTALLY IGNORED, AND THERE HAS BEEN GREAT RELUCTANCE TO RISK CONFRONTATION WITH VIOLATORS OF THAT AND OTHER PROVISIONS OF MARTIAL LAW. THE ULTIMATE RESULT, MANY OFFICERS APPARENTLY FEAR, WILL BE LOSS OF THE ONE ADVANTAGE THAT REMAINS TO THE MILITARY, I.E., THE RESPECT ITS FIREPOWER AFFORDS DESPITE THE OVERWHELMING NUMERICAL SUPERIORITY OF THE AGITATORS.

IF THEIR FEARS ARE REALIZED, THEY ARGUE, FIREBRANDS MIGHT BE TEMPTED TO PROVOKE A CONFRONTATION WHICH COULD PRODUCE SUBSTANTIAL CASUALTIES. THESE OFFICERS SAY THEY WOULD PREFER TO GET TOUGH NOW IN ORDER TO MINIMIZE BLOODSHED.

1978TEHRAN00183.subject: LOS:COMPULSORY DISPUTE SETTLEMENT: MILTARY EXEMPTION AND IRAN

segments.text: THE WORDING YOU SUGGESTED IN PARA TWO REFTEL WAS EMINENTLY ACCEPTABLE TO KAZEMI AND IS BEING GIVEN TO HIM IN A LETTER FROM POLCOUNS. THANK YOU AND WARM REGARDS.

MFA OFFICIALS PREPARING SYG WALHEIM VISIT HERE DESCRIBED IT ON DECEMBER 30 AS ROUTINE. THEY SAID VISIT, WHICH HAS JUST BEEN ANNOUNCED PUBLICLY FOR JANUARY 10-14, HAS BEEN PLANNED FOR SOME TIME AND THERE IS NO SPECIFIC AGENDA BEYOND THE OBVIOUS FACT THAT THERE WILL BE GENERAL TOUR D'HORIZON WITH THE SHAH AND OTHER OFFICIALS THAT WALDHEIM MEETS. THEY EXPECTED THE MIDDLE EAST WOULD FIGURE AMONG ISSUES DISCUSSED BUT HAD HEARD NOTHING SPECIFIC ABOUT OTHER ISSUES THAT MIGHT BE BROUGHT UP.

1978TEHRAN00187.subject: IRANIAN CADIDATE FOR UN HUMAN RIGHTS COMMISSION

segments.text: EMBASSY HAS RECEIVED MFA NOTE DATED DECEMBER 24 WHICH ANNOUNCES NOMINATION OF MINISTER OF EDUCATION MANUCHEHR GANJI FOR REELECTION TO MEMBERSHIP OF THE SUB-COMMITTEE ON ENDING RACIAL DISCRIMINATION AND PROTECTION OF MINORITIES AT ELECTIONS WHICH ARE TAKING PLACE DURING THE 34TH SESSION OF THE UN HUMAN RIGHTS COMMISSION. IN VIEW OF THE FRIENDLY RELATIONS EXISTING BETWEEN THE U.S. AND IRAN, THE NOTE REQUESTS USG SUPPORT OF MINISTER GANJI'S CANDACY.

THIS EMBASSY VIGOROUSLY SECONDS GANJI'S NOMINATION. THIS IS A POSITION OF SOME INTEREST TO THE GOI, AND GANJI IS UNDOUBTEDLY IRAN'S BEST CANDIDATE AT PRESENT. HIS CURRICULUM VITAE, AS ENCLOSED IN THE NOTE, IS BEING POUCHED TO THE DEPARTMENT (NEA/IRN), BUT FULL BIOGRAPHIC INFORMATION ON MINISTER GANJI IS ALREADY AVAILABLE IN WASHINGTON.

FOLLOWING DANISH FOREIGN MINISTER'S VISIT HERE, DCM ASKED DANISH AMBASSADOR MUNK WHETHER IT HAD BEEN SUCCESSFUL. MUNK, OBVIOUSLY PLEASED AND RELIEVED, SAID THAT THINGS HAD GONE VERY WELL. WHILE BEGINNING OF FOREIGN MINISTER'S AUDIENCE WITH THE SHAH WAS A BIT COOL, THE ATMOSPHERE BEGAN TO WARM UP AS THINGS WENT ALONG AND CONTINUED TO IMPROVE THROUGH A WORKING LUNCHEON WITH IRANIAN FOREIGN MINISTER AND MEETING WITH PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR. MUNK SAID THAT HE HAD FELT ALL ALONG THAT IRANIAN-DANISH RELATIONS WERE ON FIRM GROUND AND THAT THE DIFFERENCES THAT HAD DEVELOPED WERE BETWEEN FRIENDS.

WHILE HE DID NOT SAY THE EMBARGO HAD BEEN LIFTED, HE APPARENTLY BELIEVES IT WILL BE AND, AS HE PUT IT, "ALL DIFFERENCES HAVE BEEN COMPOSED." MUNK ADDED PARENTHETICALLY THAT THE FOREIGN MINISTER HAD NOT RETREATED FROM HIS POSITION THAT THE DANES HAD HANDLED THE IRANIAN STUDENT MATTER PRUDENTLY AND IN THE LONG TERM INTERESTS OF BOTH COUNTRIES. THE FOREIGN MINISTER HAD MADE NO APOLOGIES FOR DANISH ACTIONS AND NO CONCESSION TO THE IRANIAN POSITION THAT THE STUDENTS SHOULD HAVE BEEN DEALT WITH MORE HARSHLY.
THE FOREIGN MINISTER'S JOURNEY HERE SEEMS TO HAVE SATISFIED IRAN'S INJURED AMOUR PROPRE AND GIVEN IRAN AN OPPORTUNITY TO BACK OFF FROM WHAT WAS ESSENTIALLY A WEAK WICKET.

1978TEHRAN00190.subject: INDICATION THAT ETHIOPIA WOULD BE PREPARED TO ENGAGE IN NEGOTIATIONS WITH SOMALIA SUMMARY: ETHIOPIA HAS RESPONDED TO REMARKS BY SHAH

segments.text: IN NEGOTIATIONS WITH SOMALIA SUMMARY: ETHIOPIA HAS RESPONDED TO REMARKS BY SHAH DURING PRES CARTER'S VISIT CONCERNING THE HORN OF AFRICA. ETHIOPIAN FONMIN SUMMONED IRANIAN CHARGE EVENING JAN 2 AND INDICATED THAT ETHIOPIA WOULD BE PREPARED ENGAGE IN NEGOTIATIONS WITH SOMALIA. IRANIAN FONMIN SEEMS ENCOURAGED BY THIS DEVELOPMENT. HOWEVER, PRECONDITIONS ATTACHED TO SUCH NEGOTIATIONS BY ETHIOPIA APPEAR UNACCEPTABLE TO SOMALIA. THESE PRECONDITIONS WOULD REQUIRE WITHDRAWAL OF SOMALI FORCES FROM OGADEN AND SOMALI RECOGNITION OF INTERNATIONAL BOUNDARIES. I WILL DISUCSS MATTER FURTHER WITH SHAH EVENING JAN 5. END SUMMARY.

UNDERSECY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS ZELLI CALLED ME TO MINISTRY MORNING JAN 5 TO DISCUSS "URGENT DEVELOPMENT". IN OUR TALK WE WERE JOINED BRIEFLY BY FONMIN KHALATBARY, WHO HAD TO LEAVE FOR AUDIENCE WITH SHAH. BOTH ZELLI AND KHALATBARY SEEMED QUITE EXCITED BY MESSAGE WHICH THEY HAD RECEIVED FROM ADDIS ABABA REPORTING CONVERSATION BETWEEN ETHIOPIAN FOREIGN MINISTER AND IRANIAN CHARGE, WHO HAD BEEN SUMMONED TO FOREIGN OFFICE IN ADDIS ABABA EVENING JAN 2.

ACCORDING ZELLI, FONMIN TOLD IRANIAN CHARGE HE WAS REACTING TO WIRE SERVICE REPORTS OF STATEMENT ATTRIBUTED TO SHAH AFTER HIS MEETINGS WITH PRES CARTER. IN RESPONSE TO THE SHAH'S STATEMENT, THE ETHIOPIAN FONMIN MADE THE FOLLOWING TEN POINTS
SOMALIA WAS THE AGGRESSOR, IT WAS STILL BOMBING ETHIOPIAN CITIES, AND ITS TROOPS HAD BEEN FIVE MONTHS IN ETHIOPIAN TERRITORY.

ETHIOPIA HAS NO INTENTION OF TRANSGRESSING INTO SOMALIA AND NO CLAIM AGAINST SOMALI TERRITORY. THE REMEDY FOR THE PRESENT SITUATION IS FOR SOMALIA TROOPS TO WITHDRAW AND TO RECOGNIZE ETHIOPIA'S PROPER FRONTIERS. ETHIOPIA HAS A LEGAL RIGHT TO PUSH BACK SOMALI INVADERS. ETHIOPIA WANTS COUNTRIES LIKE IRAN TO EXERT THEIR INFLUENCE TO HAVE SOMALIA WITHDRAW ITS TROOPS. (C) WHOEVER SUPPLIES ARMS TO SOMALIA ASSISTS SOMALIAN AGGRESSION. (D) ETHIOPIA IS GRATEFUL FOR THE SHAH'S CONCERN AND READY TO PARTICIPATE IN "ANY SORT OF DISCUSSIONS". HOWEVER, BEFORE THIS COULD TAKE PLACE SOMALIA MUST WITHDRAW, RECOGNIZE ETHIOPIA'S INTERNATIONAL FRONTIERS, AND RESPECT THE PROVISIONS OF THE OAU CHARTER.

(E) ETHIOPIA IS DETERMINED TO FIGHT TO THE LASTMANTO PRESERVE ITS INDEPENDENCE, TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY, AND UNITY. (F) ETHIOPIA HAS NO EXPANSIONIST AMBITIONS AGAINST ANY OF ITS NEIGHBORS. (G) ETHIOPIA HAS PROPOSED A CONFEDERATION WITH SOMALIA WHICH THE LATTER HAS NOT ACCEPTED. SUCH A CONFDERATION WOULD PERMIT THE MUTUAL EXPLOITATION OF COMMON ECONOMIC RESOURCES. (H) SOMALIA HAS PREPARED FOR SEVENTEEN YEARS TO GO TO WAR AGAINST ITS NEIGHBORS. ITS CONSTITUTION AND ITS FLAG TESTIFY TO ITS EXPANSIONIST INTENTIONS.

SOMALIA HAS ALSO ------------------094584 081119Z /12 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 6260 SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 0190 FOR THE SECRETARY FROM SULLIVAN SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 0190 FOR THE SECRETARY FROM SULLIVAN ATTACKED KENYA WHICH RAISED THE ISSUE IN LIBREVILLE. SOMALIA IS ALSO ENGAGED IN THE DESTRUCTION OF DJIBOUTI. (I) NONE OF THE COUNTRIES OF THE OAU CONDONES OR SUPPORTS THE POLICIES OF SOMALIA. (J) IN THE OAU COMMITTEE FOR MEDIATION, ETHIOPIA MAINTAINED ITS PRESENCE BUT SOMALIA WALKED OUT.

ZELLI SAID THAT, IN ORDER TO KEEP THE DIALOGUE WITH THE ETHIOPIANS GOING, HE HAD SENT THE EXACT TEXT OF THE STATEMENT MADE BY THE SHAH ON JANUARY 1. HE QUOTED IT TO ME AS FOLLOWS: "OUR ENDEAVOR IS THAT THE GOVERNMENTS OF SOMALIA AND ETHIOPIA SHOULD TRY TO ESTABLISH PEACE BY DIRECT CONTACT AND THROUGH PEACEFUL SOLUTION OF THEIR DIFFERENCES. JUST AS WE HAVE TRIED IN THE PAST, WE STILL ARE TRYING TO DO WHATEVER IS NECESSARY IN THIS RESPECT.

ETHIOPIA SHOULD REALIZE THAT UP TO NOW WE HAVE NOT DONE ANYTHING AGAINST THEM, AND, TO THE CONTRARY, WE HAVE TRIED THAT THE DIFFERENCES BETWEEN SOMALIA AND ETHIOPIA SHOULD BE SOLVED BY PEACEFUL MEANS. AT THESAME TIME WE MUST DRAW THE ATTENTION OF ETHIOPIA TO THE FACT THAT, SHOULD THEY ENVISAGE TRANSGRESSING BEYOND THE INTERNATIONALLY RECOGNIZED BOUNDARIES OF SOMALIA, THUS ENDANGERING THE TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY OF THAT COUNTRY, AND SHOULD SOMALIA REQUEST OUR ASSISTANCE, AS WE HAVE ASSUMED IN THE CASE OF OMAN AND WITH REGARD TO THE REGIONAL COUNTRIES, THEN IT IS A MATTER OVER WHICH IRAN COULD NOT REMAIN INDIFFERENT."

ZELLI ASKED MY REACTION TO THIS INTERCHANGE. I TOLD ZELLI THAT, ALTHOUGH IT WAS ENCOURAGING THAT THE ETHIOPIANS HAD APPROACHED IRAN IN A SERIOUS VEIN, IT SEEMED TO ME THAT THE PRECONDITIONS ESTABLISHED FOR DISCUSSIONS WITH SOMALIA WOULD BE PRETTY DIFFICULT FOR THE SOMALIANS TO ACCEPT. I POINTED OUT THAT SOMALIA COULD CONTINUE ITS SOPHISTRY ABOUT NOT HAVING ANY TROOPS IN THE OGADEN AND THEREFORE MIGHT BE ABLE TO SAY THAT IT WAS COMPLYING WITH THE CONDITIONS CONCERNING WITHDRAWAL OF SOMALI FORCES. ON THE OTHER HAND, THE CONDITIONS OF ACCEPTING THE CURRENT INTERNATIONAL BOUNDARY OF ETHIOPIA ENCOMPASSING OGADEN WAS WHAT THE DISPUTE WAS ALL ABOUT.
THEREFORE IT SEEMED RATHER UNLIKELY THAT THE ETHIOPIAN PROPOSAL WOULD GET VERY AT.

ZELLI ACKNOWLEDGED THIS BUT SAID THAT THE IRANIANS HAD NEVERTHELESS SENT A MESSAGE TO SIAD BARRE IN MOGADISCIO ENCOURINGING HIM TO UNDERTAKE "AN OFFENSIVE FOR PEACE" WITH A PUBLIC STATEMENT TO THE EFFECT THAT HE WAS PREPARED TO MEET WITH THE ETHIOPIANS TO DISCUSS A CEASE-FIRE AND A RESOLUTION OF THE CONFRONTATION WITH ETHIOPIA. ZELLI SAID THAT, IF A MOMENTUM COULD BE BEGUN IN THIS MATTER HE THOUGHT IT MIGHT BE POSSIBLE TO BRING THE OAU INTO THE EQUATION. IF THE OAU COULD SET UP A "CEASEFIRE COMMISSION" THIS MIGHT SET THE TERMS OF REFERENCE FOR BOTH THE ANTAGONISTS.

I POINTED OUT TO ZELLI THAT I EXPECTED TO HEAR FROM YOU CONCERNING YOUR IDEAS FOR ACTION WITH RESPECT TO THE HORN OF AFRICA SUBSEQUENT TO YOUR VARIOUS CONVERSATIONS IN SAUDI ARABIA, EGYPT, AND PARIS. I EXPRESSED THE HOPE THAT IRAN WOULD NOT PLUNGE TOO FAR AHEAD ON THIS PARTICULAR ENTERPRISE UNTIL YOU HAD BEEN ABLE TO SUGGEST A MORE CONCERTED FORM OF ACTION. ZELLI SAID THAT IRAN WOULD, OF COURSE, CONCERT ITS ACTIONS WITH THE UNITED STATES AND WAS EAGERLY AWAITING YOUR SUGGESTIONS.

COMMENT: I HAVE AN AUDIENCE WITH THE SHAH THIS EVENING AND WILL ATTEMPT TO SLOW DOWN THE PACE OF IRANIAN ACTIONS UNTIL YOU CAN PROVIDE MORE DETAILED GUIDANCE CONCERNING YOUR OWN VIEWS AND THE VIEWS OF YOUR VARIOUS INTERLOCUTORS. MY GUESS IS THAT THE SHAH WILL BE SOMEWHAT MORE SKEPTICAL ABOUT THE ETHIOPIAN DEMARCHE THAN HIS ACOLYTES IN THE FOREIGN MINISTRY.

1978TEHRAN00195.subject: INDICATION THAT ETHIOPIA WOULD BE PREPARED TO ENGAGE IN NEGOTIATIONS WITH SOMALIA

segments.text: I MET WITH SHAH EVENING JANUARY 5 TO DISCUSS INITIATIVE WHICH HE HAS TAKEN IN HORN OF AFRICA. HE SHARED MY SKEPTICIISM ABOUT THE VIABILITY OF THE PROPOSALS MADE BY THE ETHIOPIANS, BUT FELT IT WAS WISE TO SEIZE ANY OPPORTUNITY TO BRING ETHIOPIA AND SOMALIA INTO NEGOTIATIONS.

I RECALLED THE DISCUSSIONS HE HAD HELD WITH THE PRESIDENT ON THIS SUBJECT AND SAID I HAD NOT YET RECEIVED ANY GUIDANCE OR SUGGESTIONS FROM YOU FOLLOWING ON YOUR DISCUSSIONS OF THIS SUBJECT ELSEWHERE. THEREFORE, I DID NOT KNOW WHAT OTHER INITIATIVES U.S. MIGHT BE CONTEMPLATING.

SHAH SAID HE DID NOT RPT NOT INTEND PURSUE CURRENT DEMARCHES ANY FURTHER AT THIS TIME. HE WOULD LOOK TO WASHINGTON FOR SOME GUIDANCE ABOUT MANNER IN WHICH OTHER COUNTRIES PARTICULARLY IMPORTANT AFRICAN COUNTRIES SUCH AS NIGERIA, WOULD BE BROUGHT INTO THE ACT.
SHAH TOLD ME EVENING JANUARY 5 THAT HE HAD BEEN VISITED THAT SAME MORNING BY SOVIET AMBASSADOR VINOGRADOV, WHO HAD CONVEYED WARMEST NEW YEAR'S GREETINGS FROM THE SOVIET LEADERSHIP.

IN ADDITION TO THE GREETINGS, THERE WAS A MESSAGE FROM BREZHNEV URGING THE SHAH TO "ADD HIS VOICE" TO THE "OUTCRY" AGAINST THE NEUTRON BOMB. THE SOVIETS SAID THAT ITS INTRODUCTION INTO WESTERN EUROPE WOULD BE "DESTABILIZING".

THE SHAH SAID HE HAD TOLD VINOGRADOV THAT HE WOULD STUDY THE QUESTION, BUT THAT HE THOUGHT THE MATTER WAS SOMETHING BETWEEN THE SOVIETS AND THE NATO COUNTRIES, IN WHICH IRAN HAD NO VOICE. THE SOVIET AMBASSADOR ANSWERED THIS COMMENT WITH A "VERY FLATTERING" REFERENCE TO THE SHAH'S GREAT INFLUENCE AND AUTHORITY THROUGHOUT THE WORLD.

IN DISCUSSING THIS SUBJECT, I MENTIONED PRESIDENT CARTER'S STATEMENT IN WARSAW, WHICH DREW A DISTINCTION BETWEEN STRATEGIC AND TACTICAL WEAPONS. I SAID THE PRESIDENT HAD INDICATED THAT, ONCE AGREEMENT HAD BEEN REACHED ON SALT, WE WOULD BE PREPARED TO DISCUSS TACTICAL WEAPONS, SUCH AS THE NEUTRON BOMB AND SOVIET IBRM'S IN EASTERN EUROPE.

1978TEHRAN00205.subject: IRAN'S RESURGENCE PARTY PICKS NEW LEADER, ATTACKS COLONIALISTS WHO TRY TO SUBVERT STUDENTS

segments.text: SUMMARY: IRAN'S RESURGENCY PARTY (RPPI) HAS CHOSEN PRIME MINISTER JAMSHID AMOUZEGAR TO BE ITS SECRETARY GENERAL. LEADERS OF THE PARTY'S TWO WINGS HAVE BEEN MADE AUTOMATICALLY MEMBERS OF POLITICAL BUREAU. PARTY HAS ATTACKED BOTH "RED AND BLACK" COLONIALISTS WHO TRY TO SUBVERT STUDENTS AND THUS DESTROY IRAN'S NATIONAL INDEPENDENCE. SHAH AND PARTY LEADERS CALL FOR GREATER PUBLIC PARTICIPATION. OTHER PERSONNEL CHANGES EXPECTED MOMENTARILY. END SUMMARY.

IRAN'S SINGLE LEGAL POLITICAL PARTY, THE RESURGENCE PARTY OF THE PEOPLE OF IRAN (RPPI), AT ITS JAN. 4 EXTRAORDINARY CONGRESS SELECTED JAMSHID AMOUZEGAR, CURRENTLY PRIME MINISTER, TO SERVE CONCURRENTLY AS RPPI SECRETARY GENERAL (SYG). THIS MOVE, FORESHADOWED EARLIER BY SHAH'S STATEMENT THAT BOTH JOBS COULD NOW BE HELD BY ONE MAN (REFTEL), CLIMAXED NEARLY A MONTH OF POLITICAL MANEUVERING AND CONSOLIDATES AMOUZEGAR'S INTERNAL POLITICAL POSITION.

CONGRESS ALSO AMENDED RPPI CHARTER TO PROVIDE AUTOMATIC POLITICAL BUREAU MEMBERSHIP FOR HEADS OF RPPI'S TWO WINGS, ABDOL MAJIDI (PROGRESSIVE) AND HUSHANG ANSARY (CONSTRUCTIVE), THOUGH ANSARY WAS ALREADY A MEMBER BY VIRTURE OF HIS PRIOR APPOINTMENT TO POLITICAL BUREAU.

TWO MAJOR THEMES (EMERGED FROM ONE-DAY CONGRESS: NEED TO FIGHT AND ROOT OUT ALL VESTIGES OF COLONIALISM FROM IRAN, WHETHER "RED OR BLACK", COLONIALISM OR NEOCOLONIALISM; AND STRESS ON NECESSITY FOR POPULAR PARTICIPATION IN PARTY AND INCREASED POLITICAL EDUCTION.

THOUGH PARTICIPATION AND EDUCATION WERE MAIN THEME OF SHAH'S EXHORTATION TO CONGRESS READ BY COURT MINISTER HOVEYDA, MAIN EMPHASIS OF OTHER TALKS WAS PLACED ON ALERTING STUDENTS TO, AND PROTECTING THEM FROM, MACHINATIONS OF "FOREIGN AGENTS". AMOUZEGAR, WING CHIEFS ANSARY AND MAJIDI, AND SEVERAL OTHER SPEAKERS, HIT HARD AT "RED AND BLACK" COLONIALISM AND REACTION WITHOUT NAMING EITHER COUNTRIES OR FACTIONS (EMBASSY COMMENT: QUESTION OF WHO BLACK REACTIONARIES ARE SUPPOSED TO BE IS INTERESTING.

PHRASE AS USED BY ALL SPEAKERS LENDS ITSELF TO EAST-WEST INTERPRETATION, BUT SEVERAL SOPHISTICATED OBSERVERS OF IRANIAN SCENE AND WE OURSELVES BELIEVE "BLACK" IN THIS CONTEXT KEPT DELIBERATELY VAGUE TO CONDEMN ISLAMIC REACTIONARIES WITHOUT APPEARING TO DO SO OVERTLY AND EXPLICITYLY.)

AMOUZEGAR STRESSED "RADICAL" APPROACH TAKEN BY ENEMIES OF REGIME, WHOM HE LINKED TO THOSE FORCES AND COUNTRIES WHO WERE JEALOUS OF IRAN (A COMMON AMOUZEGAR LINE, BUT NOT UNTIL NOW THE PRINCIPAL THEME OF A MAJOR ADDRESS.). HE CALLED FOR GREATER STUDENT AWARENESS OF THREATS TO THEMSELVES AND TO NATION. IN UNUSUAL DEPARTURE, AMOUZEGAR ALSO HELD UP CYRUS' PROCLAMATION ON HUMAN RIGHTS, THE IRANIAN CONSTITUTION, AND THE SHAHPEOPLE REVOLUTION'S 19 POINTS AS THREE MOST SIGNIFICANT DOCUMENTS IN IRANIAN HISTORY.

(WHILE HE RETURNED TO TRADITIONAL "HOLY TRINITY" OF SHAH, CONSTITUTION, AND SHAH-PEOPLE REVOLUTION, AND RPPI REAFFIRMED THESE THREE AS PILLARS OF IRANIAN POLITICAL SYSTEM, HIS USE OF "THREE DOCUMENTS" AND INTRODUCTION OF HUMAN RIGHTS AS SUBSIDIARY THEME IN SPEECH IS NEW PUBLIC TACK.) ------------------094434 080932Z /14 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 6254 INFO AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY BONN AMEMBASSY PARIS AMEMBASSY THE HAGUE AMEMBASSY COPENHAGEN AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY DOHA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY MUSCAT

STRESS ON HUMAN RIGHTS, PARTICIPATION, AND EDUCATION LED TO ANSARY EXPRESSION OF HOPE THAT CONGRESS WOULD MARK "GENUINELY NEW BEGINNING" OF DIALOG AND ENCOURAGEMENT OF DIFFERENT POINTS OF VIEW. BOTH HE AND MINISTER OF INFORMATION HOMAYOUN WARNED EXPRESSELY THAT ENEMIES OF IRAN WERE TRYING TO POLLUTE THIS NEW POLITICAL ATMOSPHERE BY SOMENTING DISTURBANCES AND VIOLENCE. ANSARY CALLED FOR "PLURALITY OF VIEWS AND TASTES AND NOT A DIVISION OF THE PEOPLE ON A CONTEXT OF ENMITY". HOMAYOUN WARNED IN TURN OF TWIN DANGERS FROM OPPOSITE POLES-DANGER OF CONFORMITY AND STAGNATION OF THOUGHTS ON ONE HAND AND DANGER OF FRICTION AND FACTION ON THE OTHER. FULLER ACCOUNTS OF SPEECHES BEING POUCHED DEPT.

EMBASSY WILL BE REPORTING MORE FULLY ON MEANING OF RPPI CHANGE IN CONTEXT OF AMOUZEGAR GOVERNMENT'S EVOLUTION SINCE AUG. 1977, BUT A FEW PRELIMINARY OBSERVATIONS ARE IN ORDER: A) WHETHER SITUATION EVOLVES IN DIRECTION RHETORIC POINTS OR NOT WILL DEPEND ON FUTURE EXPERIENCE WHICH WILL BE ONLY WAY TO GAUGE IMPACT OF CONGRESS ON DAY-TO-DAY POLITICS OF COUNTRY IN WHICH ALL MAJOR AND MANY MINOR DECISIONS ARE MADE AT TOP.

NON-STUDENT INTERNAL DISSIDENTS WERE NOT DIRECTLY ATTACKED IN RPPI CONGRESS RHETORIC. SEVERAL OF OUR CONTACTS ON AT LEAST A "FIRST LOOK" BASIS ARE ENCOURAGED BY THIS DEVELOPMENT, WHICH APPEARS TO LEAVE ROOM FOR DISSIDENTS TO OPERATE, AND HOLDS OPEN AT LEAST THEORETICAL POSSIBILITY FOR THEM TO JOIN GROWING PARTY "DIALOG" (CARROT) WHILE ON OTHER HAND ATTRIBUTING MOST, IF NOT ALL, EXTRA-PARTY CRITICISM TO FOREIGN ELEMENTS (STICK). (C) ALTHOUGH NO OTHER NEW LEADERSHIP POSITIONS WERE FILLED BY CONGRESS, VIRTUALLY UNANIMOUS EXPECTATION IS THAT AMOUZEGAR WILL MAKE MAJOR CHANGES SOON AT CENTRAL RPPI HEADQUARTERS, THOUGH PROBABLY NOT AT THE PROVINCIAL SECRETARY LEVEL.

KEY POSITION WILL BE SENIOR DEPUTY SECRETARY GENERAL, WHO WILL IN FACT RUN PARTY. LEADING CANDIDATES ON RUMOR MARKET ARE MINISTER OF STATE HOLAKU RAMBOD, LABOR MINISTER MOINI AND KEY AMOUZEGAR CONFIDANTE AMIN ALIMARD.

IN SUM, RPPI LEADERS HAVE SAID MOST OF THE RIGHT THINGS AND RPPI HAS BEEN FORMALLY RETIED TO GOVERNMENTAL SYSTEM WITH AMOUZEGAR'S ACCESSION TO SYG. TIME WILL DETERMINE IMPACT. RPPI LINKAGE OF STUDENT DISSIDENCE BOTH ABROAD AND AT HOME WITH REGIME'S ENEMIES IS LIKELY TO BE CONTINUING GOI THEME AS WELL.

1978TEHRAN00207.subject: CHINESE AMBASSADOR'S REACTION TO SUMMARY OF RESULTS PRESIDENT' CARTER'S VISIT TO IRAN

segments.text: PRESIDENT' CARTER'S VISIT TO IRAN

DURING COURSE OF DINNER AT PAKISTAN EMBASSY JANUARY 1, I GAVE CHINESE AMBASSADOR GENERALIZED SUMMARY OF RESULTS PRESIDENT CARTER'S VISIT TO IRAN. HE EXPRESSED SATISFACTION THAT VISIT HAD GONE WELL AND THAT U.S.-IRANIAN BILATERAL TIES WERE STRENGTHENED.

HIS PRIMARY REACTION WAS IN CONTEXT OF U.S.-IRANIAN EXPRESSIONS OF CONCERN RE HORN OF AFRICA. HE SAID HIS GOVERNMENT FELT SOVIETS WERE ENGAGED IN MAJOR ADVENTURE IN ETHIOPIA AND THAT THEIR AMBITIONS WITH RESPECT TO AFRICA WERE NOT RPT LIMITED TO REGION OF THE HORN. HE EXPRESSED HOPE U.S. WOULD FIND WAY TO STOP SOVIET ACTIVITIES THERE.
CONVERSATION TURNED TO RECENT EVENTS IN INDICHINA. WHILE I REFRAINED FROM SAYING "WE TOLD YOU SO," I DID DILATE ON LAO DONG PARTY AMBITIONS TO CONTROL ALL OF THE OLD FRENCH INDOCHINA REGION.
CHINESE AMBASSADOR SAID HE WES SURE SOVIETS HOPED TO ESTABLISH SATELLITE AREA ON CHINA'S SOUTHERN FLANK AND THAT "IT WOULD BE LOGICAL" FOR CHINA TO OPPOSE SUCH AN EFFORT.

1978TEHRAN00221.subject: NEW ITALIAN AMBASSADOR TO IRAN LOCAL PRESS REPORTS THAT GIULIO TAMANINI, NEWLY APPOINTED ITALIAN AMBASSADOR TO IRAN, WILL ARRIVE TEHRAN TON

segments.text: LOCAL PRESS REPORTS THAT GIULIO TAMANINI, NEWLY APPOINTED ITALIAN AMBASSADOR TO IRAN, WILL ARRIVE TEHRAN TONIGHT. WE UNDERSTAND TAMANINI HAS BEEN SERVING MOST RECENTLY AS COUNSELOR OF EMBASSY IN WASHINGTON. ANY BIOGRAPHIC INFORMATION AVAILABLE TO ADDRESSES WOULD BE APPRECIATED.

ON JANUARY 7, FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY CALLED ME ONCE AGAIN TO THE MINISTRY TO DISCUSS HORN OF AFRICA. HE SAID THAT, RESPONSIVE TO MESSAGE WHICH SAHAH HAD SENT SIAD BARRE (REFTEL) URGING "PEACE OFFENSIVE", LATTER HAD AGREED MAKE PUBLIC STATEMENT CALLING FOR NEGOTIATIONS WITH ETHIOPIA.

SIAD BARRE HAD REPORTEDLY TOLD IRANIAN AMBASSADOR JANUARY 6 THAT HE WOULD STATE: (A) OGADEN IS AN INTERNAL PROBLEM FOR ETHIOPIA, WHICH SHOULD OPEN DISCUSSIONS WITH LIBERATION FRONT; (B) THAT ISSUE SHOULD BE EASY TO SOLVE IF THERE IS PARTICIPATION OF OTHER AFRICAN STATES; (C) SOMALIA WOULD BE PREPARED PARTICIPATE IN SUCH DISCUSSIONS BETWEEN ETHIOPIA AND LIBERATION FRONT; (D) SOMALIA WOULD ALSO BE PREPARED NEGOTIATE DIRECTLY WITH ETHIOPIA ON MATTERS OF MUTUAL CONCERN.

MORNING PRESS JANUARY 8 CARRIES REPORTS OF STATEMENT MORE OR LESS ALONG FOREGOING LINES ATTRIBUTABLE TO SIAD BARRE. THIS WOULD APPEAR TO CONSTITUTE MORE PROPAGANDA THAN SUBSTANCE, BUT IT IS, OF COURSE, SHAH'S VIEW THAT WE SHOULD "SEIZE" ANY OPPORTUNITIES, HOWEVER, INSUBSTANTIAL, TO PROD TWO PARTIES TOWARDS NEGOTIATION.
ACTION REQUESTED: I WOULD APPRECIATE WHATEVER GUIDANCE DEPT PROPOSES TO FULFILL UNDERTAKING TO IRANIANS RESULTING FROM PRESIDENT'S DISCUSSIONS WITH SHAH.

WE WERE INTERESTED TO SEE FOREIGN MINISTER ASNAJ SUGGESTING THAT THE SAUDIS CONCLUDED THERE IS NO REAL DIFFERENCE BETWEEN SALIM RUYABI ALI AND ABD AL-FATTAH ISMAIL,AND THAT PDRY REGIME HAS BEEN USING THIS ALLEGED RIFT AS A WAY OF EXTRACTING MORE ASSISTANCE OUT OF SAUDIS AND OTHER ARAB MODERATE STATES. THIS IS EXACTLY THE LINE SUGGESTED TO US ON SEVERAL OCCASIONS BY MFA FIRST POLITICAL DEPARTMENT HEAD DAVOUDI, ALTHOUGH DAVOUDI HAS PUT IT IN FORM OF RHETORICAL QUERY RATHER THAN A DEFINITIVE STATEMENT.

WE USG, BASING OURSELVES PERHAPS A GOOD DEAL ON BRITISH ESTIMATES, HAVE FOR A NUMBER OF YEARS ASSUMED AN ACTIVE RIVALRY BETWEEN THE TWO MEN, AND THIS HAS BECOME ENTRENCHED IN ALL ESTIMATES AND BRIEFINGS ON THE SITUATION. QUESTION ARISES WHETHER SUCH RIVALRY CAN BE ACTIVE OVER SUCH A LONG PERIOD OF TIME AT THE VERY TOP OF A GOVERNMENT'S AFFAIRS AND STILL REMAIN IN BALANCE, AS WOULD APPEAR TO BE THE CASE IN PDRY. MAYBE THE WHOLE CONCEPT REQUIRES REEXAMINATION.
WE WOULD APPRECIATE ANY COMMENTS ON THIS POINT THAT WE MIGHT PASS TO THE IRANIANS.

1978TEHRAN00281.subject: IRANIAN FOREIGN MINISTER'S MESSAGE TO SECRETARY VANCE

segments.text: EMBASSY HAS RECEIVED FOLLOWING MESSAGE FROM FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY FOR TRANSMITTAL TO SECRETARY VANCE: BEGIN TEXT. EXCELLENCY: I HAVE RECEIVED YOUR EXCELLENCY'S LETTER OF JANUARY 1, 1978 WHICH WAS FORWARDED TO ME BY HIS EXCELLENCY MR. WILLIAM SULLIVAN WITH PLEASURE, AND I WOULD LIKE TO TAKE THIS OPPORTUNITY TO CONVEY MY DEEP APPRECIATION FOR THE VERY KIND SENTIMENTS WHICH YOU HAVE EXPRESSED TOWARDS MY AUGUST SOVEREIGN AND MYSELF. (PARA) IT WAS INDEED A GREAT PLEASURE FOR ME TO HAVE WELCOMED YOUR EXCELLENCY TO TEHRAN DURING PRESIDENT CARTER'S VISIT, AND TO HAVE HAD THE OPPORTUNITY TO EXCHANGE VIEWS WITH YOU ON MATTERS OF MUTUAL INTEREST AND CONCERN TO US BOTH.

(PARA) IT IS A SOURCE OF PROFOUND SATISFACTION FOR ME TO OBSERVE THE SPIRIT OF UNDERSTANDING AND HARMONY WHICH PREVAILS IN OUR RELATIONS. I SHARE YOUR EXCELLENCY'S BELIEF THAT PRESIDENT CARTER'S VISIT TO IRAN HAS EMPHASIZED THE EXCELLENT RELATIONS EXISTING BETWEEN OUR TWO COUNTRIES AND HAS NO DOUBT PLAYED AN IMPORTANT ROLE IN THE YET FURTHER STRENGTHENING OF THESE RELATIONS. (PARA) MAY I AVAIL MYSELF OF THIS OPPORTUNITY TO RENEW THE INVITATION WHICH I EXTENDED TO YOUR EXCELLENCY AND SAY HOW VERY MUCH MRS. KHALATBARY AND MYSELF LOOK FORWARD TO THE PLEASURE OF WELCOMING MRS. VANCE, YOUR EXCELLENCY, AND YOUR CHARMING DAUGHTER TO TEHRAN.

I WOULD BE GRATEFUL IF YOU COULD SUGGEST SEVERAL DATES IN ACCORDANCE WITH YOUR SCHEDULE OF ENGAGEMENTS SO THAT A SUITABLE DATE FOR YOUR VISIT TO TEHRAN MAY BE DETERMINED TO OUR MUTUAL CONVENIENCE. WITH WARM PERSONAL REGARDS, ABBAS ALI KHALATBARY. END OF TEXT.
ORIGINAL BEING POUCHED.

1978TEHRAN00349.subject: TEXT OF MESSAGE FROM SECY GEN WALDHEIM TO SECY VANCE

segments.text: SECGEN WALDHEIM, WHO CURRENTLY VISITING TEHRAN, HAS ASKED ME TO TRANSMIT TEXT OF MESSAGE TO YOU. HE SAID HE READ IT TO YOU OVER THE TELEPHONE JAN 10 AND THAT YOU HAD ASKED TO RECEIVE CONFIRMATION COPY. HE ALSO INDICATED THAT HE IS EXPECTING REPLY FROM YOU IN COURSE OF TODAY.

TEXT FOLLOWS: THE SECRETARY GENERAL IS CONTINUING TO FOLLOW WITH THE CLOSEST INTEREST CURRENT EFFORTS TO ACHIEVE PROGRESS TOWARD A SOLUTION IN THE MIDDLE EAST. (PARA) IT WILL BE RECALLED THAT THE SEC. GEN. DESIGNATED LT. GEN. SIILASVUO, CHIEF COORDINATOR OF UN PEACE-KEEPING OPERATIONS IN THE MIDDLE EAST, TO BE PRESENT AT THE CAIRO PLENARY MEETING IN PREPARATION FOR THE GENEVA CONFERENCE SO AS TO KEEP HIM INFORMED OF CURRENT DEVELOPMENTS IN MIDDLE EAST NEGOTIATIONS. (PARA) THE CAIRO CONFERENCE HAS NOW SPLIT UP INTO TWO WORKING COMMITTEES.

THE SECRETARY-GENERAL BELIEVES THAT AT THIS STAGE IT WOULD NOT BE APPROPRIATE FOR HIM TO TAKE PART, OR BE REPRESENTED, IN THE WORK OF THESE COMMITTEES. (PARA) HOWEVER, THE PARTIES HAVE INDICATED TO HIM THEIR INTENTION TO KEEP HIM INFORMED OF THE PROCEEDINGS OF THE POLITICAL COMMITTEE THROUGH GEN. SIILASVUO, WHOSE HEADQUARTERS IS IN GOVERNMENT HOUSE, JERUSALEM. IF MATTERS PERTAINING DIRECTLY TO THE UNITED NATIONS ARE DISCUSSED, GEN. SIILASVUO WOULD ALSO BE AVAILABLE TO TRANSMIT THE NECESSARY INFORMATION TO THE SECRETARY GENERAL IN ORDER THAT HE MAY KEEP THE APPROPRIATE ORGANS OF THE UN INFORMED AS NECESSARY. END OF TEXT.

1978TEHRAN00364.subject: SHAH DISCUSSES HORN OF AFRICA IN ASWAN AND RIYADH

segments.text: UPON HIS RETURN FROM VISITS TO ASWAN AND RIYADH, SHAH TOLD ME HE HAD DISCUSSED HORN OF AFRICA IN BOTH PLACES. HE SAID HE FOUND BOTH EGYPTIAN AND SAUDIS GRAVELY CONCERNED BY SOVIEIT ACTIVITY THERE, AND CONSIDERED SAUDIS "PETRIFIED" BY PROSPECT OF SOVIET PRESENCE ACROSS RED SEA.

SADAT TOLD HIM THAT NUMEIRY HAD UNDERTAKEN TO SEND SUDANESE BRIGADE TO BERBERA. TROOPS WOULD BE PICKED UP BY EGYPTIAN SHIPS AND ENTIRE EXPEDITION WOULD BE FUNDED BY SAUDIS. SADAT ALSO SAID THAT EGYPT WOULD SEND CREWS TO SOMALIA TO MAN SAM II MISSILE SITES, WHICH SOMALIS WERE UNABLE TO HANDLE.

SHAH GOT IMPRESSION THAT SADAT IS VERY PREOCCUPIED WITH IDEA THAT SOVIETS ARE SEEKING TO RETALIATE AGAINST HIM BY SEIZING CONTROL OF TERRIROTY OF VITAL INTEREST TO EGYPT. HE MUSED ON THOUGH THAT SADAT MIGHT HAVE BEEN IMPELLED TO HIS DRAMATIC OVERTURES IN THE MIDDLE EAST AND HIS GENEROUS OFFERS TO ISRAEL BECAUSE HE WISHES TO TIDY UP HIS EASTERN FRONT IN ORDER TO CONCENTRATE ON MORE PERNICIOUS DANGERS ELSEWHERE. SULLIVAN NOTE BY OC/T: NOT PASSED USCINCEUR.

1978TEHRAN00366.subject: FURTHER IRANIAN STATEMENT ON SOMALI-ETHIOPIAN DISPUTE AT IMPROMPTU PRESS CONFERENCE WHILE HE WAS WAITING TO MEET SYG WALDHEIM AT AIRPORT JANUARY 10, FOREIGN MINIST

segments.text: AT IMPROMPTU PRESS CONFERENCE WHILE HE WAS WAITING TO MEET SYG WALDHEIM AT AIRPORT JANUARY 10, FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY RESPONDED TO A QUESTION ON THE HORN OF AFRICA BY SAYING THAT, FOLLOWING THE RECENT MEETING BETWEEN THE SHAH AND PRESIDENT SIAD BARRE IN TEHRAN, THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT HAS URGED THE TWO PARTIES TO RESOLVE THEIR DISPUTE BY DIRECT BILATERAL NEGOTIATIONS.

WE NOTE WITH APPRECIATION DEPT'S RECOGNITION THAT STATEMENTS OF GOALS AND OBJECTIVES SHOULD NOT BE VIEWED AS FIXED OR IMMUTABLE. WE HAVE EXAMINED WITH CARE THOSE SET FORTH IN REF B. IN LARGE MEASURE WE BELIEVE THEY ARE REALISTICALLY ACHIEVABLE AND ADDRESS OUR CENTRAL CONCERNS AND INTERESTS IN IRAN. WE HAVE, HOWEVER, MODIFIED AND EXTENDED THIS STATEMENT TO TAKE INTO ACCOUNT RECENT DEVELOPMENTS AND SLIGHTLY ALTERED PERCEPTIONS OF WHAT OUR CURRENT GOALS AND OBJECTIVES OUGHT TO BE. THERE FOLLOWS A FULL RESTATEMENT IN THE FORMAT USED IN REFTEL B.

BEGIN TEXT. I. AS SUSTAINED POLITICAL/ECONOMIC RELATIONSHIP BUILT UPON TRUST, CONFIDENCE, AND MUTUAL RESPECT. --MAINTAIN AND REINFORCE THE RELATIONSHIP OF TRUST AND CONFIDENCE ESTABLISHED WITH THE SHAH. --ASSESS THE RANGE OF EMB CONTACTS IN THE IMPORTANT SEGMENTS OF IRANIAN SOCIETY AND INITIATE STEPS TO EXPAND RELATIONS HIPS TO T HE EXTENT POSSIBLE WITH THOSE FORCES AND GROUPS WHICH ARE EVOLVING INTO IMPORTANT CENTERS OF INFLUENCE AS IRAN MODERNIZES.

THIS SHOULD TAKE INTO ACCOUNT OPPORTUNITIES PRESENTED BY RECENT EASING OF SOME GOVT STRICTURES ON POLITICAL ACTIVITY, RECOGNIZING THAT SOME RISKES MAY BE INVOLVED IN CERTAIN CASES REQUIRING THAT WE PROCEED SELECTIVELY AND PRUDENTLY. --ENCOURAGE PRIMIN AMOUZEGAR AND HIS CABINET TO REFLECT ON IGNFJS LONG-TERM ECONOMIC GOALS AND TO PLAN A SPECIFIC AND INTEGRATED PROGRAM OF INITIATIVES DESIGNED TO MAINTAIN ECONOMIC MOMENTUM AS OIL REVENUES INEVITABLY DIMINISH. IN THIS RESPECT ENCOURAGE AND SUPPORT IRANIAN INITIATIVES TO SEEK OUTSIDE EXPERT ASSISTANCE AND ADVICE FROM THE IBRD AND OTHER APPROPRIATE SOURCES.

ENGAGE FULL RANGE OF USIS CAPABILITIES IN KEEPING IRANIAN DECISIONMAKERS AND OPINION MOLDERS INFORMED OF US POLICIES AND ATTITUDES AFFECTING IRANIAN INTERESTS AND IRANIAN-US RELATIONS. II. AN ENHANCED US-IRANIAN RELATIONSHIP IN NON-MILITARY FIELDS. --ENCOURAGE THE CONTINUATION OF A RELIABLE PETROLEUM SUPPLY FOR THE UNITED STATES AND ITS CLOSEST ALLIES AND THE ADOPTION OF A MODERATE PRICING POLICY.

EXPLAIN US ENERGY POLICIES AND PROGRAMS, AND THE NEED OF THE WORLD ECONOMY FOR OIL AT BEARABLE PRICES. --FACILITATE AN INCREASE IN THE UNITED STATES' SHARE OF THE MARKET IN IRAN AND BE PREPARED TO USE THE WEIGHT OF THE AMBASSADOR'S OFFICE IN SUPPORT, AT A MINIMUM, OF NONDISCRIMINATORY ACCESS BY AMERICAN FIRMS TO BUSINESS OPPORTUNITIES IN IRAN.
ASSESS HOW WE CAN MAKE THE US-IRAN JOIN COMMISSION MORE EFFECTIVE, INCLUDING HOW TO INVLIVE THE US PRIVAT SECTOR MORE FULLY.

PURSUE WITH DR ETEMAD AND HIS ATOMIC ENERGY ORGANIZATION ASSOCIATED FORMULATION OF FINAL TEXT OF US-IRANIAN NUCLEAR COOPERATIN AGREEMENT WHICH MEETS PRESIDENT'S NONPROLIFERATION OBJECTIVES. ------------------116500 111237Z /10 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 6346 SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 0367 --MAINTAIN US INTELLIGENCE-GATHERING PRIVILEGES IN IRAN, AND CONTINUE TO PROVIDE QUID PRO QUO LIAISON SUPPORT IN RESPONSE TO THESE PRIVILEGES. CAREFULLY WEIGH ANY PROPOSALS FOR ADDITIONAL PRIVILEGES TO ENSURE THEY DO NOT ENDAGNER EXISTING ASSETS. --SEEK TO ENGAGE IRAN MORE FULLY IN REGIONAL NARCOTICS EFFORTS AIMED AT REDUCING NARCOTICS PRODUCTION IN AFGHANISTAN AND PAKISTAN AND REDUCING ILLICIT NARCOTICS TRAFFIC INTO AND THROUGH IRAN.
WORK WITH GOI MINISTRY OF EDUCATION TO IMPROVE PROCEDURES IN THE EVALUATION AND PROCESSING OF IRANIANS SEEKING AN EDUCATION IN THE US.
EXPAND OPPORTUNITIES FOR IRANIAN STUDENTS PLANNING TO STUDY IN THE US TO RECEIVE APPROPRIATE ORIENTATION, COUNSELLING, AND ENGLISH INSTRUCTION PRIOR TO THEIR DEPARTURE.
CONTINUE TO PRESS IRAN FOR FULL PAYMENT OF THE DELINQUENT SURPLUS PROPERTY DEBT. III.

CAREFULLY COORDINATED MILITARY RELATIONSHIP INCLUDING THE MILITARY SUPPLY PROGRA. --MAINTAIN A CONTINUING DIALOGUE WITH THE SHAH AND HIS PRINCIPAL MILITARY ADVISORS ON HIS MILITARY NEEDS WITH THE AIM OF AVERTING NONESSENTIAL MILITARY SALES REQUESTS. --CAREFULLY SUPERVISE EXISTING AND ANTICIPATED FOREIGN MILITARY SALE CASES. --CLOSELY MONITOR ACTIVITIES OF THE REPS OF US ARMS MANUFACTURERS TO ENSURE THAT THEY ARE OBSERVING THE NEW REGULATIONS ON SALES PROMOTION AND SEEK WAYS TO REDUCE NUMBER OF US DEFENSERELATED CONTRACTOR PERSONNEL IN IRAN TO THEIR ESSENTIAL NUMBERS. --MONITOR OUR MILITARY SUPPLY RELATIONSHIP TO ENSURE THAT LEGITIMATE IRANIAN DEFENSE NEEDS ARE MET WITHIN THE FRAMEWORK OF CURRENT ARMS TRANSFER GUIDELINES.

REEXAMINE US-IRAN MILITARY COOPERATION RELATIONSHIP TO ENSURE THAT IT IS CONSISTENT WITH PUBLIC LAW 95-92. --ENCOURAGE GOI TO ACCEPT INCREASED RESPONSIBILITY FOR DEVELOPMENT OF IMPROVED MILITARY MANAGEMENT, PLANNING, AND INTERNAL STAFFING TECHNIQUES WITH THE ULTIMATE OBJECTIVE OF ELIMINATING DEPENDENCE ON US MILITARY ADVICE AND ASSISTANCE. --MAINTAIN US OVERFLIGHT RIGHTS AND ACCESS TO IRANIAN PORTS FOR NAVAL SHIPS. IV.

MAINTENANCE OF IRAN'S BALANCED POSTURE IN REGIONAL AFFAIRS. --ENCOURAGE THE CONTINUATION OF IRAN'S BALANCED APPROACH TO ARAB-ISRAELI AFFAIRS AND ITS SUPPORT FOR OUR MIDDLE EAST PEACE NEGOTIATIONS. --ENCOURAGE THE MAINTENANCE OF A POSITIVE IRANIAN RELATIONSHIP WITH ISRAEL, INCLUDING AN OIL SUPPLY LINK. --MAINTAIN IRAN'S OPPOSITION TO PAKISTAN REPROCESSING. --SUPPORT IRAN'S COOPERATION WITH SAUDI ARABIA, IMAN, AND OTHER ARABIAN PENINSULA STATES ON PERSIAN GULF SECURITY, KEEPING INFORMED ON RELEVANT SECUIRTY DEVELOPMENTS IN IRAQ AND IRAN'S OTHER REGIONAL NEIGHBORS. --ENCOURAGE A CONTINUATION OF RESPONSIBLE IRANIAN COOPERATION WITH AFGHANISTAN, PAKISTAN, AND INDIA IN BOTH POLITICAL AND ECONOMIC SPHERES. --ENCOURAGE IRANIAN SUPPORT OF OUR PRINCIPLE POLICIES IN AFRICA.

IMPROVEMENT IN IRANJS HUMAN RIGHTS PERFORMANCE. --REVIEW WITH THE SHAH AND OTHER ESPONSIBLE OFFICIALS, ON APPROPRIATE OCCASION, US HUMAN RIGHTS POLICIES, FOCUSING ON IMPROVEMENT IN HUMAN RIGHTS (WHICH IS ATTAINABLE) AS OPPOSED TO PUSHING FOR CHANGES IN THE POLITICAL SYSTEM (WHICH MAY SMACK OF FOREIGN INTERFERENCE AND BE COUNTER PRODUCTIVE), NOTING THE IMPACT AN UNFAVORABLE IRANIAN PUBLIC IMAGE ON THIS ISSUE MIGHT HAVE ON IRAN'S INTERNATIONAL POSTURE IN THE US AND ELSEWHERE.

DCM DELIVERED YOUR REF MESSAGE TO SECGEN WALDHEIM EVENING OF JAN 11. IT WAS A CROWDED SOCIAL OCCASION WHICH INHIBITED CONVERSATION. NEVERTHELESS, AFTER READING YOUR LETTER WALDHEIM COMMENTED THAT HE CERTAINLY DID NOT WANT TO DO ANYTHING TO FRUSTRATE MIDEAST PEACE EFFORTS. HE STILL SEEMED TO HAVE A PROBLEM, HOWEVER, WITH THE CONCEPT OF HAVING A UN REP AT THE JERUSALEM MEETING WITHOUT A MANDATE FROM THE UN SECURITY COUNCIL. DCM URGED THE VIEW SET FORTH IN YOUR LETTER THAT THIS NOT NECESSARY AND THAT JERUSALEM MEETING BE VIEWED AS BEING A CONTINUUM OF EFFORTS BUILDING TOWARD A COMPREHENSIVE PEACE SETTLEMENT.
WALDHEIM SEEMED UNCONVINCED BUT SAID HE WOULD CONSIDER THE MATTER AND BE IN TOUCH FURTHER.
SUGGEST DEPARTMENT PASS TO: USMISSION USUN NEW YORK.

1978TEHRAN00388.subject: GOI SPOKESMAN COMMENTS ON FOREIGN ISSUES

segments.text: MINISTER OF INFORMATION AND TOURISM DARIUSH HOMAYOUN HELD A PRESS CONFERENCE ON JAN. 10 FOR FOREIGN CORRESPONDENTS RESIDING IN IRAN. HIGHLIGHTS OF THE INTERVIEW WERE REPRIENTED IN THE FRENCH LANGUAGE JOURNAL DE TEHRAN ARE NOTED BELOW.

ON PERSIAN GULF SECURITY, HOMAYOUN SAID THAT "THE POLICY OF THE GOI IS CLEAR...WE HAVE ALWAYS BEEN IN FAVOR OF A POLICY OF COOPERATION WITH ALL THE RIPARIAN STATES, BECAUSE ACCORDING TO IRAN, PEACE, SECURITY AND STABILITY IN THAT VITAL ZONE IS THE RESPONSIBILITY OF ALL THE LITTORAL STATES. AT THE SAME TIME, IRAN IS IN FAVOR OF TOTAL FREEDOM OF NAVIGATION IN THE PERSIAN GULF. IRAN WILL, IN CONSEQUENCE, FOLLOW UP ALL EFFORTS OF LITTORAL STATES TO ARRIVE AT THIS OBJECTIVE IN THE REGION." IN RESPONSE TO ANOTHER QUESTION OF GULF SECURITY, THE MINISTER STATED: "THE GOI HAS NOT PROPOSED A CONCRETE FORMULA.
WE HAVE ONLY INDICATED OUR SUPPORT IN GENERAL TERMS WITH ANY ACCEPTABLE FORM OF COOPERATION, ON THE BASIS OF A COLLECTIVE UNDERSTANDING WITH THE OTHER LITTORAL STATES."
CONCERNING THE INDIAN OCEAN, HOMAYOUN REPEATED THE WELL KNOWN POSITION "THAT MAINTENANCE OF AN INDIAN OCEAN ZONE OF PEACE CAN ONLY BE REALIZED BY THE LITTORAL STATES WITHOUT EXTERNAL INTERFERENCE".

WHEN ASKED FOR A COMMENT ON THE MIDDLE EAST CONFLICT, THE MINISTER SAID, "THE POSITION OF IRAN IN THE MIDDLE EAST SITUATION IS WELL KNOWN. WE ARE IN FAVOR OF THE APPLICATION OF INSC RES. 242 AND 388. AT THE SAME TIME, WE WILL LEND SUPPORT TO ALL POSITIVE INITIATIVES WHICH CAN LEAD TO THE RESUMPTION OF THE GENEVA CONFERENCE."

ONE QUESTION DEALT WITH HUMAN RIGHTS, SPECIFICALLY THE IRC AND AMNESTY INTERNATIONAL. HOMAYOUN RESPONDED THAT "THE GOI HAS BEEN THE ONLY GOVERNMENT WHICH HAS AUTHORIZED REPRESENTATIVES OF THE IRC TO VISIT IRANIAN PRISONS. THEIR RECOMMENDATIONS ON THE IMPROVEMENT OF PRISON CONDITIONS HAVE BEEN APPROVED BY THE PARLIAMENT AND PUBLISHED IN THE PRESS."

COMMENT: HOYAYOUN'S PRESS CONFERENCE DID NOT BREAK NEW GROUND BUT SERVED RATHER AS A FORUM FOR REITERATION OF WELL KNOWN GOI POLICIES. THIS IS THE LATEST IN A RECENT SERIES OF PUBLIC INTERVIEWS GRANTED BY THE MINISTER.

IN MOST SERIOUS INCIDENT OF THIS SORT FOR YEARS, 5 DEMONSTRATORS WERE SHOT DEAD AND 9 INJURED WHEN POLICE OPENED FIR ON A CROWD ATTEMPTING OF OCCUPY A POLICE STATION IN THE HIGHLY RELIGIOUS CITY OF QOM JAN 9. A POLICE OFFICE AND 3 POLICEMEN WERE INJURED BY THE DEMONSTRATORS AND ONE 13 YEAR BOY WAS TRAMPLED TO DEATH IN THE STAMPEDE THAT FOLLOWED THE SHOOTING.

INCIDENT OCCURRED ON ANNIVERSARY OF LAND REFORM LEGISLATION PASSED IN 1963. IT FOLLOWED A MUCH MILDER PROTEST BY STUDENTS OF RELIGION SHOULTING ANIT-NATIONAL SLOGANS ON JAN 7 THE 42ND ANNIVERSARY OF REZA SHAH'S DEGREE ABOLISHING THE VEIL FOR WOMEN.

ON THE 9TH A MOB OF PROTESTORS ARMED WITH STONES, IRON BARS, AND WOODEN STAVES REPORTEDLY RAMPAGED THROUGH THE STREETS SMASHING WINDOWS OF SHOPS AND DESTROYING PREMISES OF REASTAKHIZ PARTY HEADQUARTERS. THEY THEN TRIED TO TAKE OVER A POLICE STATION, DAMAGING POLICE VEHICLES OUTSIDE. POLICE WARNINGS AND WARNING SHOTS INTO THE AIR WENT UNHEEDED, AND POLICE THEN FIRED INTO THE CROWD.

INFORMATIN ON THIS INCIDENT WAS RELEASED TO THE PRESS BY PARS NEWS AGENCY AFTERNOON JAN 10. SAME INFORMATION WAS GIVEN TO DCM BY COURT MINISTER HOVEYDA AT SHAH'S DINNER THAT EVENING FOR VISITING CODE.

COMMENT: DEMONSTRATIONS ARE BEING ASCRIBED BY POLICE AUTHORITIES--ACCURATELY WE BELIEVE--TO CONSERVATIVE RELIGIOUS OPPOSITION ELEMENTS (THOUGH NOT SPECIFICALLY TO FOLLOWERS OF KHOMEINY OR TO ISLAMIC MARXISTS AS SUCH). THIS IS FIRST TIME IN MANY YEARS, IN OUR RECOLLECTIN, THAT POLICE HAVE KILLED SEVERAL DEMONSTRATORS BY FIRING INTO A CROWD. SEVERITY OF THIS INCIDENT WOULD APPEAR TO ARGUE AGAINST THOSE AMONG THE JOURNALISTS AND OTHER OBSERVERS HERE WHO HAVE SUSPECTED MANY RECENT INCIDENTS WERE COOKED UP BY IRANIAN SECURITY FORCES TO IMPRESS THE SHAH AND/OR USG.

BY THE SAME TOKEN, IT IS POSSIBLE TO CONCLUDE THAT RELATIVE POLICE LENIENCY, AS FOR EXAMPLE IN LACK OF EFFECTIVE REACTION TO STUDENT DEMONSTRATION JAN 7, ENCOURAGED MORE VIOLENT DEMONSTRATION WHICH NECESSITATED VIOLENT REPRESSION TO PUT DOWN. AT LEAST IT IS CONCEIVABLE THAT THE MANY PROPONENTS OF THE MAILED FIST IN GOI ESTABLISHMENT MIGHT SO ARGUE TO THE SHAH AND PRIMIN AMOUZEGAR IN EFFORT TO REVERSE RELATIVE LIBERALIZATION OF RECENT MONTHS.

1978TEHRAN00390.subject: THREAT LETTER RECEIVED BY GRUMMAN IRAN LIMITED

segments.text: ON THE EVENING OF JANUARY 8, LOCAL OFFICES OF THE GRUMMAN CORP. RECEIVED A THREAT LETTER SIGNED BY THE IRAN REVOLUTIONARY MOVEMENT. ACCORDING TO RECIPIENT, LETTERHEAD LOGO ON THREAT WAS SIMILAR TO THAT BELONGING TO THE MUJAHIDIN-E-KHALQ, WHO HAVE BEEN RESPONSIBLE FOR PREVIOUS ATTACKS ON AMERICANS. LETTER WAS ADDRESSED TO "THE COMPANY THAT MAKES THE F-14 AND F-16." LETTER CONTAINED PHRASES CRITICIZING GOI ON PURCHASING F-14 AND F-16 AIRCRAFT WITH GOI NATURAL RESOURCES (OIL) WHICH COULD BE BETTER UTILIZED IN PROVIDING MORE DOCTORS AND MEDICINES TO IRANIAN PEOPLE. LETTER CALIMED RESPONSIBILITY FOR RECENT EXPLOSION AT IAS ACADEMIC CENTER AND THREATENED FUTURE SUCH ACTS.
LETTER STATED THAT THE F-14 AND F-16 PROJECTS WOULD BE "DESTROYED."

ALTHOUGH LETTER WAS RECEIVED AT GRUMMAN OFFICES AND GRUMMAN IS THE LOCAL COMPANY PUBLICLY IDENTIFIED WITH F-14 PROGRAM, RSO CONTACTED GENERAL DYNAMICS COMPANY (F-16 PROGRAM) TO NOTIFY THEM OF CONTENTS OF GRUMMAN THREAT LETTER AND TO ADVISE THEM TO BE ALERT FOR ANY SUSPICIOUS CIRCUMSTANCES INVOLVING THEIR PERSONNEL OR OFFICES. RSO IS IN PROCESS OF CONTACTING ALL F-14 SUBCONTRACTORS TO ADVISE THEM SIMILARLY.

AT GRUMMAN AND SAVAK REQUEST, RSO WILL CONDUCT INFORMAL PHYSICAL SECURITY SURVEY OF GRUMMAN OFFICES TOMORROW TO ADVISE THEM RE POSSIBLE INCREASED PHYSICAL SECURITY PREACUATIONS TO BE TAKEN. NONE OF THE OFFICES OF THE U.S. MISSION OR VARIOUS INTELLIGENCE AGENCIES WITHIN GOI HAVE ANY FURTHER INFORMATION AT PRESENT TIME PERTAINING TO THREAT LETTER. GOI IS ARRANGING TO PLACE UNOFORMED POLICE IN FRONT OF GRUMMAN OFFICES AND PLAINCLOTHES POLICE AROUND GRUMMAN RESIDENCES FOR AN INDEFINITE PERIOD PENDING FURTHER INVESTIGATION OF THIS PARTICULAR THREAT.

ORIGINAL OF LETTER WAS SHEDDED BY RECIPIENT WHO DID NOT WANT GET INVOLVED. HE LATER THOUGHT BETTER OF THIS AND HAS PROVIDED SHEDDED LETTER WHICH WE RECONSTRUCTING. WHEN THIS DONE WE SHOULD BE ABLE ESTABLISH DEFINITELY WHETHER IT MUJAHIDIN OR OTHER GROUP. WILL ADVISE AND POUCH FULL TEXT.

1978TEHRAN00409.subject: SHAH'S PLAN TO TALK WITH THE ISRAELIS

segments.text: DURING MY CONVERSATION WITH THE SHAH EVENING JAN 10, I MADE RECOMMENDATION CONTAINED REFTEL, AND POINTED OUT THAT MEETINGS HAD BEEN POSTPONED UNTIL JAN 16. SHAH SAID HE WOULD GET WORD TO ISRAELIS SOMEHOW BEFORE THAT TIME.

YOU AND SECY WILL BE AMUSED TO KNOW THAT, IN CONVERSATION WITH SENATORS, SHAH SUGGESTED TO RIBICOFF THAT HE GET PARALLEL WORD TO US JEWISH COMMUNITY. SENATOR HOLLINGS SUGGESTED RIBICOFF BRING GROUP OF COMMUNITY LEADERS TO TEHRAN TO MEET WITH SHAH. RIBICOFF DEMURRED ("FIFTEEN JEWISH EGOS IN ONE ROOM?") AND SUGGESTED SHAH SPEAK TO DAYAN.
IN SHORT, WE BEAT THE JEWISH ANGLE FOR ALL IT WAS WORTH. GOOD LUCK IN JERUSALEM.
REF AM DAR ES SALAAM 105, B. TEHRAN 0053, C. TEHRAN 0195 TEHRAN 0366

AS REF B (BEING REPEATED DAR ES SALAAM) INDICATES, SHAH WARNED ETHIOPIA SPECIFICALLY AGAINST ATTACKING THE "RECOGNIZED BORDERS" OF SOMALIA. THRUST OF SHAH'S POLICY IS TO BRING BOTH ETHIOPIA AND SOMALIA TO REALIZATION THAT THEIR BEST COURSE IS TO SETTLE THEIR DISPUTE BETWEEN THEMSELVES RATHER THAN RUNNING ADDITIONAL RISKS A PROLONGED CONFLICT WOULD BRING. FONMIN KHALATBARY'S STATEMENT (REF D) IS IN THE SAME VEIN.

FYI/ SHAH HAS NO PLANS (EVEN OF A CONTINGENCY NATURE) FOR DIRECT INTERVENTION ON THE HORN. HE HAS TOLD AMB THAT HE INFORMED SIAD BARRE AND SADAT THE HE COULD NOT PLANS TO PROVIDE SOMALIS HEAVY MILITARY EQUIPMENT SINCE HE AGREES WITH US VIEWS ON SANCTITY OF BORDER. THEREFORE, HIS WORDS, WHICH WERE AN IMPROMPTU RESPONSE TO A RADIO INTERVIEW AT THE AIRPORT, SHOULD NOT BE OVERINTERPRETED. THEY WERE MERELY INTENDED TO INSERT AN ADDITIONAL ELEMENT OF UNCERTAINTY IN ETHIOPIAN CALCULATHIONS AS AN "ENCOURAGEMENT" TO NEGOTIATE.

UPON CHECKING WITH THE COURT THIS MORNING WE HAVE BEEN ADVISED THAT THE SHAH'S SCHEDULE FOR FEB 4 AND 5 IS FULL, CONTRARY TO INFORMATION CONTAINED TEHRAN 0161. THEREFORE, IT WILL NOT BE POSSIBLE FOR YOU TO BRIEF SHAH ON EITHER FEB 4 OR 5. HOWEVER, AS OF THIS MORNING SHAH'S SCHEDULE COULD ACCOMMODATE A BRIEFING FROM YOU FEB 6. IF THIS IS FEASIBLE IN TERMS OF YOUR SCHEDULE FOR NEXT ROUND OF INDIAN OCEAN TALKS.

IF YOU CAN CONFIRM TO US THAT IT WOULD BE POSSIBLE FOR YOU TO BRIEF THE SHAH FEB 6 WE WILL IMMEDIATELY GET IN TOUCH WITH THE COURT TO MAKE FIRM APPOINTMENT. IN THAT EVENT YOU COULD ARRIVE TEHRAN ON PANAM 2 EVENING OF FEB 5.
AMB INVITES YOU TO STAY AT RESIDENCE.
HOPE IT WILL BE POSSIBLE, IN TERMS OF YOUR SCHEDULE, TO PROVIDE BRIEFING FOR SHAH FEB 6.

1978TEHRAN00425.subject: THREAT LETTER RECEIVED BY GRUMMAN IRAN LIMITED

segments.text: LOGO PORTION OF THREAT LETTER WAS RECONSTRUCTED TODAY. LOGO WAS THAT OF CHARIKHA-YE-FEDAI-YE-KHALQ (THE PEOPLES SACRIFICE GUERILLAS).

COMMENT: THIS FIRST TIME IN RECENT MEMORY CHARIKS HAVE DIRECTLY THREATENED AMERICANS IN IRAN. WHILE THEY HAVE COLLABORATED IN PAST WITH MJUAHIDIN-E-KHALQ (THE PEROPLES STRUGGLERS, THE GROUP RESPONSIBLE FOR PREVIOUS ATTACKS ON AMERICANS), THOSE COLLABORATIONS HAVE NOT BEEN DIRECTED AGAINST AMERICANS.

1978TEHRAN00442.subject: WALDHEIM REPLY TO SECRETARY AND UN SPOKESMAN STATEMENT

segments.text: ON EVENING JAN 13, WALDHEIM GAVE ME LETTER TO YOU, TOGETHER WITH TEXT OF ANNOUNCEMENT HE WILL MAKE IN JERUSALEM MEETING. HE SAID THAT ANNOUNCEMENT WILL BE PUT OUT ABOUT 3:30 PM NEW YORK TIME JAN 13.

IN HANDING ME LETTER, WALDHEIM SAID IT WAS MAXIMUM HE COULD DO. HE STRESSED THAT GEN SIILASVUO WILL BE IN THE CONFERENCE ROOM AS AN OBSERVER, BUT THAT HE WOULD NOT SIT AT TABLE OR MAKE ANY INTERVENTIONS. WALDHEIM ASKED FOR U.S. ASSISTANCE IN HAVING ISRAELIS PROVIDE APPROPRIATE SEATING FOR HIM TO ACT AS AN OBSERVER.

WALDHEIM ALSO APOLOGIZED FOR SHORTNESS OF TIME INVOLVED IN PUBLICATION OF STAMENT. HE SAID HE HAD INTENDED TO PUT IT OUT TOMORROW, BUT WAS REMINDED THAT TOMORROW IS JEWISH SABBATH. HE SAID THAT BILL BUFFUM IN NEW YORK WAS COMPLETELY AU COURANT AND COULD ANSWER ANY QUESTIONS.

TEXT OF LETTER FOLLOWS: DEAR CY, THANK YOU FOR YOUR LETTER OF 10 JANUARY. I APPRECIATE THE THOUGHT YOU HAVE GIVEN TO THE PROBLEM OF UN PARTICIPATION IN THE JERUSALEM MEETING OF THE POLITICAL COMMITTEE AND FOR YOUR UNDERSTANDING OF THE INEVITABLY VERY DELICATE POSITION OF THE SECRETARYGENERAL IN THIS MATTER. IN ORDER TO BE SURE THAT WE UNDERSTAND EACH OTHER FULLY, I FEEL THAT I SHOULD RESPOND TO THE VARIOUS POINTS YOU HAVE MADE. I THINK WE AGREE THAT MY PRESENCE IN JERUSALEM WOULD NOT BE APPROPRIATE.

I HAVE NO MANDATE TO PARTICIPATE IN SUCH A MEETING, AND IN ANY CASE I DO NOT SEE WHAT ROLE I COULD, OR SHOULD, PLAY IN IT AT THE PRESENT STAGE. AS FAR AS SOME OTHER FORM OF REPRESENTATION IS CONCERNED, I FULLY RECOGNIZE THAT A COMPLETELY NEGATIVE RESPONSE TO THE INVITATION WOULD BE MISUNDERSTOOD AND MIGHT ALSO POSSIBLY CONSTITUTE A SETBACK TO THE NEGOTIATING PROCESS. CERTAINLY MY DIFFICULTIES ABOUT THE RESPONSE TO THIS INVITATION ARE IN NO SENSE A CRITICISM OF PRESIDENT SADAT'S INITIATIVE, WHICH, AS YOU MAY KNOW, I HAVE FREQUENTLY AND PUBLICLY PRAISED.

THEY SPRING RATHER FROM THE NATURE AND AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARYGENERALSHIP AND THE HEATED CONTROVERSY WHICH HAS ARISEN OVER THE MOST RECENT DEVELOPMENTS IN THE MIDDLE EAST. THE SECRETARY-GENERAL CANNOT IGNORE THE POINT OF VIEW OF AN IMPORTANT SEGMENT OF THE MEMBERSHIP ON AN IMPORTANT POLITICAL QUESTION - A GROUP WHICH INCLUDES IN THIS CASE ONE OF THE TWO CO-CHAIRMEN OF THE GENEVA CONFERENCE. NOR IS IT PRODUCTIVE FOR HIM TO TAKE INDEPENDENT ACTIONS ON A MATTER BEFORE THE SECURITY COUNCIL WITHOUT HAVING AN ADEQUATE MANDATE. IF HE DOES THIS, HE IS LIKELY TO BE CHALLENGED AND TO FIND HIMSELF ON VERY WEAK CONSITUTIONAL GROUND.

MOREOVER THE RESULTING CONTROVERSY, AS WE KNOW FROM BITTER EXPERIENCE, TENDS SERIOUSLY TO COMPLICATE EFFORTS TO SOLVE THE PROBLEM AT HAND. I SENT GENERAL SIILASVUO TO CAIRO IN THE FULL KNOWLEDGE THAT MY DECISION WOULD BE CRITICISED IN SOME QUARTERS, AS INDEED IT WAS. I FELT JUSTIFIED IN DOING THIS BECAUSE ALL THE PARTIES AND THE TWO CO-CHAIRMEN HAD BEEN INVITED TO THE CAIRO CONFERENCE AND BECAUSE IT WAS A PLENARY MEETING SPECIFICALLY CALLED TO DISCUSS THE PROCEDURE FOR PREPARING THE GENEVA CONFERENCE. THE POLITICAL COMMITTEE IS ONE OF TWO SUBSTANTIVE WORKING GROUPS SET UP FOR THE PURPOSE OF SUBSTANTIVE NEGOTIATIONS BETWEEN TWO OF THE PARTIES.

AS SUCH, IT HAS BEEN STRONGLY CRITICISED BY SOME OF THE OTHER PARTIES TO THE MIDDLE EAST PROBLEM. IN ANY CASE AND IN ANY CIRCUMSTANCES THE SECRETARY-GENERAL IS NOT IN A POSITION TO PLAY AN ACTIVE ROLE IN SUCH SUBSTANTIVE NEGOTIATIONS WITHOUT A SPECIFIC MANDATE FROM THE SECURITY COUNCIL. FOR REASONS I HAVE STATED BEFORE, AND WITH WHICH I BELIEVE YOU AGREE, I DO NOT THINK IT WOULD BE HELPFUL FOR ME TO SEEK SUCH A MANDATE IN THE PRESENT CIRCUMSTANEEK A SOLUTION WHICH WILL BOTH MEET YOUR PREOCCUPATIONS AND ALSO, I HOPE, AVOID A PUBLIC CHALLENGE IN THE SECURITY COUNCIL.

WHILE IT IS CERTAINLY TRUE AS YOU SAY, THAT THE PRESENT TALKS HAVE RECEIVED WIDE SUPPORT IN THE WORLD AT LARGE, THAT SUPPORT IS NOT UNANIMOUS, AND AMONG THE OPPOSITION THERE ARE GOVERNMENTS WHOSE VIEWS I, AS SECRETARY-GENERAL OF THE UN, CANNOT IGNORE. ------------------007751 131700Z /43 S FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 6384 AMEMBASSY TEL AVIV NIACT IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY CAIRO NIACT IMMEDIATE USMISSION USUN NEW YORK NIACT IMMEDIATE SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 0442 EXDIS FOR THE SECRETARY FROM SULLIVAN HOWEVER, I AM ANXIOUS TO FIND A SOLUTION TO THE PROBLEM WHICH WILL ASSIST THE PEACE-MAKING PROCESS AND DEMONSTRATE CONFIDENCE IN PRESIDENT SADAT'S COURAGEOUS INITIATIVE.

NATURALLY, I AM ALSO ANXIOUS TO TAKE FULL ACCOUNT OF PRESIDENT CARTER'S AND YOUR VIEWS IN THIS MATTER. I HAVE THEREFORE REVISED ONCE AGAIN THE STATEMENT WHICH I PROPOSE TO MAKE ON THIS MATTER AND I ATTACH A COPY TO THIS LETTER. AS YOU WILL SEE, THIS BROADENS THE ROLE OF GENERAL SIILASVUO, AND I PROPOSE TO INSTRUCT HIM TO BE PRESENT AT MEETINGS OF THE COMMITTEE, ALTHOUGH HE WILL NOT BE A PARTICIPANT AT THE TABLE, BUT WILL FOLLOW THE PROCEEDINGS AS AN OBSERVER. I HOPE THAT YOU WILL UNDERSTAND THAT THIS IS AS FAR AS I CAN POSSIBLY GO.

IN FACT, I HAVE NO DOUBT THAT THESE ARRANGEMENTS WILL BE EVEN MORE STRONGLY ATTACKED BY THOSE WHO HAVE ALREADY OPPOSED THE PRESENCE OF A UN REPRESENTATIVE IN CAIRO. I WOULD BE MOST GRATEFUL IF YOU WOULD DO YOUR BEST TO ENSURE THE UNDERSTANDING AND CO-OPERATION OF THE OTHER MEMBERS OF THE POLITICAL COMMITTEE IN GIVING EFFECT TO THIS ARRANGEMENT. WITH WARM REGARDS, (SIGNED) KURT WALDHEIM UNQUOTE.

TEXT OF STATEMENT FOLLOWS: STATEMENT BY UN SPOKESMAN THE SECRETARY GENERAL IS CONTINUING TO FOLLOW WITH THE CLOSEST INTEREST CURRENT EFFORTS TO ACHIEVE PROGRESS TOWARD A SOLUTION IN THE MIDDLE EAST. IT WILL BE RECALLED THAT THE SECRETARY-GENERAL DESIGNATED LT. GEN. SIILASVUO, CHIEF CO-ORDINATOR OF U.N. PEACE-KEEPING OPERATIONS IN THE MIDDLE EAST, TO BE PRESENT AT THE CAIRO PLENARY MEETING IN PREPARATION FOR THE GENEVA CONFERENCE SO AS TO KEEP HIM INFORMED OF CURRENT DEVELOPMENTS IN MIDDLE EAST NEGOTIATIONS. THE CAIRO CONFERENCE HAS NOW SPLIT UP INTO TWO WORKING COMMITTEES, ONE IN JERUSALEM AND ONE IN CAIRO.

THE SECRETARY-GENERAL HAS BEEN INVITED EITHER TO ATTEND OR TO SD REPRESENTATIVE TO THE POLITICAL COMMITTEE IN JERUSALEM. THE SECRETARY-GENERAL WILL NOT HIMSELF BE PRESENT AT THIS MEETING. TAKING INTO ACCOUNT THESE NEW WORKING ARRNGEMENTS AND HAVING IN MIND THE EXISTING INVOLVEMENT OF THE UNITED NATIONS IN PEACE-KEEPING IN THE MIDDLE EAST, THE SECRETARY-GENERAL WILL INSTRUCT GENERAL SIILASVUO, WHOSE HEADQUARTERS IS IN GOVERNMENT HOUSE, JERUSALEM, TO FOLLOW THE PROCEEDINGS OF THE POLITICAL COMMITTEE. FOR THIS PURPOSE GENERAL SIILASVUO WILL BE INSTRUCTED TO RECEIVE INFORMATION FROM THE PARTIES CONCERNING THE NEGOTIATIONS, AND PARTICULARLY WITH REGARD TO ANY MATTERS DIRECTLY AFFECTING THE UNITED NATIONS.
HE WILL BE INSTRUCTED TO TRANSMIT RELEVANT INFORMATION TO THE SECRETARY-GENERAL SO THAT HE IN TURN MAY KEEP THE COMPETENT ORGANS OF THE UNITED NATIONS INFORMED AS APPROPRIATE. UNQUOTE.
WALDHEIM PARTY LEAVES TOMORROW MORNING FOR CYPRUS.

1978TEHRAN00448.subject: YOUR JERUSALEM MEETING WITH CODEL ZABLCKI, JAN 16

segments.text: YOU WILL BE MEETING WITH A DEL WHICH WILL HAVE BEEN FULLY EXPOSED TO THE MIDDLE EAST SCENE; A DEL WHICH TO A SIGNIFICANT DEGREE HAS BEEN A PARTICIPANT IN THE POLITICAL MANEUVERING IN THE AREA FOLLOWING THE SADAT VISIT. THIS GROUP HAD HEARD PRACTICALLY THE FULL SPECTRUM, FROM SYRIAN FONMIN KADDAM TO KING HUSSEIN, SADAT, CROWN PRINCE FAHD, AND PRIMIN BEGIN (WHO THE GROUP WILL MEET ON SUNDAY). THEY WILL WANT TO SHARE THEIR PERCEPTIONS. A STRONG CONSENSUS HAS DEVELOPED ON THIS TRIP THAT TURNING BACK FROM JERUSALEM--TO QYOTE YOUR L.A. SPEECH WHICH MOST MEMBER HAVE READ--WOULD LEAD TO A RADICALIZATION OF THE ARAB WORLD AND INEVITABLY TO WAR.

MEMBERS ARE ANXIOUS TO HEAR YOUR VIEWS OF THE SITUATION AND TO GAIN A BETTER UNDERSTANDING OF THE TACTICS THE US WILL EMPLOY TO ACHIEVE A POSITIVE RESULT. CLEM ZABLOCKI AND BILL BROOMFIELD HAVE QUOTED THE PRESIDENT'S ASWAN PRINCIPLES AT EVERY OPPORTUNITY AND HAVE BEEN VERY SUPPORTIVE THROUGHOUT.

THE DEL HAS HEARD THE ARAB PLEA FOR U.S. ACCEPTANCE OF THE PALESTINIAN RIGHT OF SELF-DETERMINATION. MOST SEEM TO UNDERSTAND THAT THE PRESIDENT'S STATEMENT THAT PALESTINIANS SHOULD "PARTICPATE IN THE DETERMINATION OF THEIR OWN FUTURE" IS A STEP TOWARD COMPROMISE ON THE DIFFICULT ISSUE. THERE MAY, HOWEVER, BE SOME LINGERING CONFUSION OVER WHAT SADAT NEEDS AND WHAT HE IS NEGOTIATING. AN EXPLANATION OF HIS AND OUR GOALS IN NEGOTIATING A STATEMENT OF PRINCIPLES AND THE PROBABLE NEED FOR AMBIGUITY IN SUCH A STATEMENT WOULD--ENHANCE APPRECIATION FOR THE PROCESS.

WITH 2 POSSIBLE EXCEPTIONS, THE GROUP SEEMS PREPARED TO EXPRESS CONCERN AND DISAPPOINTMENT TO THE ISRAELI GOVT OVER WHAT THEY PERCEIVE TO BE INTRANSIGENCE AND A FAILURE TO MATCH SADAT'S INITIATIVE. SOME EVEN ENCOURAGED THE SHAH TO USE HIS INFLUENCE TO ACHIEVE A CHANGE IN ISRAELI ATTITUDES. ZABLOCKI, IN PARTICULAR, WILL WANT YOUR ADVICE ON HOW HARD HE SHOULD PUSH PUBLICLY. YOU MAY WISH TO SPEAK TO HIM PRIVATELY, EITHER JUST BEFORE OR AFTER THE MEETING WITH THE FULL DEL.

YOU MAY ALSO WISH TO SPEAK PRIVATELY TO JACK BINGHAM AND DANTE FASCELL WHOSE CREDENTIALS ARE SUCH THAT THEY MIGHT HAVE AN IMPACT ON ISRAELI THINKING. BINGHAM, WHOSE COMMENTS HAVE BEEN SUPPORTIVE OF ISRAEL THROUGHOUT, INDICATED IN OUR MEETING WITH KING HUSSEIN THAT HE FELT THE ISRAELI RESPONSE (TO SADAT) HAS BEEN TO NEGATIVE AND THIS WORRIES ME UNQUOTE.

THREE FACTORS ARE IMPORTANT TO THESE MEMBERS AND SHOULD BE EMPHASIZED: (1) THE SOVIET UNION IS NOT NOW PART OF THE PEACE PROCESS BUT STANDS TO GAIN IF SADAT FAILS; (2) THE PLO, POLITICALLY UNPOPULAR IN THE U.S., IS LIKEWISE NOT INVOLVED (PAUL FINDLEY, WHO ALONG WITH HELEN MEYNER AND LARRY WINN MET WITH ARAFAT IN DAMASCUS, IS PRACTICALLY ALONE IN THE FEELING THEY SHOULD BE INVOLVED; AND

BY PREFERENCE THE U.S. DOES NOT SUPPORT THE CREATION OF AN INDEPENDENT PALESTINAIN STATE. ON THE LAST POINT, THE GROUP HAS HEARD, SOME EVIDENCE THAT THE PALESTINAINS WOULD CHOOSE A LINKAGE WITH JORDAN AND THE SHAH MADE CLEAR HIS PREFERENCE FOR SUCH AN ARRANGEMENT.

THE CODEL GAINED A BETTER APPRECIATION FOR SAUDI ARABIA'S ROLE IN THE MIDDLE EAST PEACE EQUATION AND IN CONTROLLING WORLD OIL PRICES AND SUPPLY. EVEN THOSE MOST STRONGLY OPPOSED TO A POSSIBLE F-15 SALE CAME AWAY WITH SHAKEN CONVICTIONS. ONE OPPONENT SAID TO ME PRIVATELY: THE CROWN PRINCE ASKED THE $64 QUESTION ON THE F-15: "ARE YOU OUR FRIENDS OR NOT?" UNQUOTE. A STRONG CONSENSUS IN FAVOR OF THE SALE WAS EVIDENT.

IN SUM, THIS CODEL, ONE OF THE LARGEST TO TRAVEL TO THE MIDDLE EAST, COULD HAVE GREAT IMPACT ON CONGRESSIONAL AND PUBLIC OPINION ON KEY ISSUES. THEY HAVE BEEN EXTREMELY HARD WORKING AND HAVE CONTRIBUTED GREATLY TO WHAT WE ARE TRYING TO ACCOMPLISH IN THIS AREA AND TO A BETTER UNDERSTANDING BY FOREIGN GOVTS OF U.S. CONGRESS. YOUR COMPLIMENTS FOR THEIR EFFORTS WOULD BE MOST APPRECIATED.

AS A REMINDER, FOLLOWING ARE MEMBERS AND STAFF WITH WHOM YOU WILL BE MEETING: DEMOCRATS: CLEMENT ZABLOCKI, DANTE FASCELL, JONATHAN BINGHAM, LEO RYAN, HELEN MEYNER, DON PEASE, JOHN CAVANAUGH, CHRIS DODD; REPUBLICANS: BILL BROOMFIELD, PAUL FINDLEY, LARRY WINN, SHIRLEY PETTIS, BEN GILMAN, HERB BURKE, DEL CLAWSON; STAFF: JACK BRADY, GEORGE BERDES, EVERETT BIERMAN, IVO SPALATIN, HELEN MATTAS, KEN HARDING (SERGEANT AT ARMS)
