1978TEHRAN00459.subject: SYG WALDHEIM COMMENTS ON MIDDLE EAST AND CYPRUS

segments.text: SYG WALDHEIM IS CURRENTLY ON A FOUR DAY OFFICIAL VISIT TO IRAN.
HE HELD A PRESS CONFERENCE ON ARRIVAL JAN. 10 HIGHLIGHTS OF WHICH WERE PUBLISHED IN FRENCH-LANGUAGE JOURNAL DE TEHRAN. HE WAS ASKED SPECIFICALLY ABOUT THE MIDDLE EAST AND CYPRUS.

WITH REGARD TO A SOLUTION TO THE MIDDLE EAST CRISIS, WALDHEIM WAS QUOTED AS SAYING: "A GLOBAL SOLUTION IN THE MIDDLE EAST ENTAILS A LONG PROCESS. I DO NOT EXPECT IT TO HAPPEN SOON. THERE IS NO DOUBT, HOWEVER, THAT THE PEACE INITIATIVE OF PRESIDENT SADAT AND HIS VISIT TO JERUSALEM CONSTITUTE AN IMPORTANT HISTORIC EVENT. NOW, WE MUST SEE IF THE FOLLOW UP TO THAT INITIATIVE WILL LEAD TO A SOLUTION. IT IS DIFFICULT TO FORECAST IN THIS AREA, BUT ANY FORECAST MUST TAKE INTO ACCOUNT UN RES. 242 AND 338 AND OTHER DECISIONS OF THE UN. THE PALESTINIAN QUESTION IS THE MOST DIFFICULT PRINCIPLE TO BE RESOLVED.

IF A LOGICAL SOLUTION TO THAT DIFFICULTY IS NOT FOUND, I DO NOT BELIEVE THAT IT WILL BE POSSIBLE TO RESOLVE THE CRISIS." WITH REGARD TO THE GENEVA CONFERENCE, WALDHEIM REPORTEDLY SAID, "UNDER PRESENT CONDITIONS, IT IS NOT POSSIBLE TO RECONVENE. HOWEVER, I HOPE THAT PRESENT EFFORTS WILL LEAD TO THE RESUMPTION OF THAT CONFERENCE. WE ARE NOW FACED WITH THE QUESTION OF THE CREATION OF A PALESTINIAN STATE. VIEWS DIFFER ON THIS PROPOSAL. EVIDENTLY A NUMBER OF DIFFICULTIES EXIST WHICH MUST BE RESOLVED AND THAT WILL TAKE TIME."

IN RESPONSE TO A QUESTION ON CYPRUS, WALHEIM EXPRESSED THE HOPE THAT "THE TWO COMMUNITIES, GREEK AND TURKISH, WILL BEGIN NEGOTIATING NOT LATER THAN FEBRUARY OR THE BEGINNING OF MARCH." WALDHEIM ADDED THAT HE "HAD BEEN ASSURED BY THE TURKISH PRIME MINISTER THAT THE TURKS WILL SUBMIT NEW PROPOSALS FOR THESE NEGOTIATIONS. HE HAS ADDED THAT HE WILL PUBLISH THE PROPOSALS SO THAT THE TWO COMMUNITIES CAN BE AWARE OF THEM."
AVAILABLE BIOGRAPHIC BACKGROUND ON NEWLY APPOINTED GOI AMBASSADOR NASROLLAH FAHIMI WAS SENT DAKAR VIA 77 TEHRAN 9984 ON NOVEMBER 10. PLEASE ADVISE IF MESSAGE NOT RECEIVED.

1978TEHRAN00535.subject: JAPANESE FOMIN SONODA'S VISIT TO IRAN

segments.text: JAPANESE FOMIN SUNAO SONODA'S ONE-DAY VISIT TO IRAN WAS ACCORDED THE TREATMENT EXPECTED OF AN "UNOFFICIAL" VISIT. CONTACTS WERE LIMITED AND PRESS COVERAGE WAS MODERATE. THE REASON GIVEN BY THE JAPANESE EMBASSY FOR THE "UNOFFICIAL" CHARACTER OF THE VISIT WAS THE CONFLICT HERE WITH THE PREVIOUSLY SCHEDULED VISIT OF NIGERIA'S SECOND-IN-COMMAND BRIGADIER SHEHU MUSA YAR'ADUA. JAPANESE CONTACTS SAID THAT FOMIN KHALATBARI'S LUNCHEON FOR SONODA CONSTITUTED THE ONLY OFFICIAL CONTACT WITH GOI AT CABINET LEVEL. DISCUSSIONS WITH KHALATBARI WERE DESCRIBED AS GENERAL IN NATURE.

SONODA, ON A TELEVISED PRESS CONFERENCE, SAID DISCUSSIONS INCLUDED NORTH-SOUTH DIALOGUE, HORN OF AFRICA, NEW ECONOMIC ORDER, MIDDLE EAST CONFLICT, CYPRUS AND THE WORLD ECONOMIC SITUATION. JAPANESE EMBASSY OFFICIAL SAID KHALATBARI WAS INTERESTED PARTICULARLY IN SONODA'S BRIEFING OF HIS RECENT TALKS IN MOSCOW CONCERNING SOVIET OCCUPIED JAPANESE ISLANDS. WHILE THANKING IRAN FOR ITS INITIAITIVE ON OPEC'S OIL PRICE FREEZE, SONODA DID NOT OTHERWISE DISCUSS OIL.
JAPANESE EMBASSY OFFICIALS ARE NOW PREPARING FOR SONODA'S EIGHT HOUR TRANSIT HERE ON JANUARY 19 AND ARE HOPEFUL ADDITIONAL HIGH-LEVEL CONTACTS MAY OCCUR.

1978TEHRAN00536.subject: APPEALS COURT UPHOLDS DEATH PENALTY FOR CIVILIAN SPY

segments.text: A MILITARY COURT OF APPEALS ON JAN 15 UPHELD THE DEATH SENTENCE OF ALI NAQI RABBANI QUJDEH, 56, A FORMER EMPLOYEE IN THE GOI MINISTRY OF EDUCATION. THE 5 MILITARY JUDGES UNANIMOUSLY CONFIRMED THE DEC 19 MILITARY TRIBUNAL RULING THE GUQDEH WAS A SPY FOR THE SOVIET UNION FOR MORE THAN THIRTY YEARS AND RECEIVED CASH, GIFTS AND OTHER FAVORS FOR HIS SERVICES ON A REGULAR BASIS.

DURING APPEALS TRIAL QUJDEH REPORTEDLY CONFESSED TO HAVING MAINTAINED CONTACT WITH SOVIET INTELLIGENCE AGENTS, AND TO HAVING PASSED INFORMATION TO THEM, HE HAS APPEALED TO THE SHAH FOR IMPERIAL CLEMENCY.

COMMENT: THIS IS THE SECOND SPY TRIAL WITHIN THE PAST MONTH AND WAS WIDELY REPORTED TODAY IN LOCAL MEDIA. IN CONTRAST WITH PREVIOUS PUBLISHED REPORTS ON QUJDEH CASE WHICH REFERRED VAGUELY TO "FOREGIN AGENTS" AND - "FOREGIN POWER", LATEST STORIES EXPLICITLY REFER TO "MOSCOW PAID SPY" AND "SOVIET INTELLIGENCE AGENTS"--A DELIBERATE CHANGE OF POLICY BY THE GOVT. FARSI PRESS HEADLINED QUJDEH AS "SOVIET SPY" AND WITHIN TEXT OF STORIES IDENTIFIED FOR FIRST TIME PREVIOUS SPY, GEN MOGHARABI, AS SOVIET AGENT. THERE IS NOTEXPECTATION THAT THE SHAH WILL GRANT CLEMENCY IN THIS CASE. ACCORDING TO IRANIAN LAW SENTENCE, UNLESS COMMUTED, MUST BE CARRIED OUT WITHIN 10 DAYS OF DECISION.

1978TEHRAN00569.subject: MULTILATERAL AFFAIRS CALENDAR, JANUARY THROUGH JUNE 1978

segments.text: REFAIR DOES NOT LIST CENTO MINISTERIAL MEETING ON MULTILATERAL AFFAIRS CALENDAR, WHICH WE UNDERSTAND IS SCHEDULED TO TAKE PLACE APRIL 18-20 IN WASHINGTON. PLEASE ADVISE.
I WAS DELIGHTED TO RECEIVE REFTEL CONFIRMING YOUR AVAILABILITY TO BRIEF THE SHAH ON SALT FEBRUARY 6. AUDIENCE HAS BEEN SET FOR 1130 THAT DAY.
BOB MARTIN, OUR POL-MIL COUNSELOR, WILL MEET YOU UPON ARRIVAL. ARIETTI ALSO INVITED TO STAY AT RESIDENCE.

BEST TIME FOR A TRIP TO ISFAHAN WOULD BE FEBRUARY 4. THERE IS AN EARLY MORNING FLIGHT (IRAN AIR 274) WHICH DEPARTS TEHRAN AT 0715 AND ARRIVES ISFAHAN AT 0755. IT IS THEN POSSIBLE TO RETURN FROM ISFAHAN EARLY THAT EVENING ON FLIGHT IRAN AIR 210, WHICH DEPARTS ISFAHAN AT 1900 AND ARRIVES AT TEHRAN AT 1940. IT IS NOT CONVENIENT TO CONSIDER STAYING OVERNIGHT IN ISFAHAN BECAUSE THE FIRST DEPARTING FLIGHT FOR TEHRAN FEBRUARY 5 IS NOT UNTIL 1035. WE UNDERSTAND YOU CAN GET TICKETS FOR ISFAHAN TRIP IN WASHINGTON, BUT WOULD BE GLAD PURCHASE THEM HERE IF YOU WISH.

SUNDAY, FEBRUARY 5 THERE IS A 0900 STAFF MEETING, AFTER WHICH I WOULD LIKE TO HAVE A SESSION WITH YOU WITH THE DCM, THE CHIEF, ARMISH/ MAAG AND POL-MIL COUNS FOR PERHAPS AN HOUR. FOLLOWING THAT CARMISH (MGEN GAST) AND POL-MIL COUNS WOULD GO WITH YOU TO ARMISH/MAAG FOR SOME MORE SPECIFIC BRIEFINGS/ DISCUSSION OF THE SECURITY ASSISTANCE PROGRAM. AFTER AN INFORMAL NO HOST LUNCH AT THE OFFICERS CLUB I WOULD REJOIN YOU FOR A 1400 MEETING WITH GENERAL TOUFANIAN.

OTHER MEETINGS WITH MISSION PERSONNEL CAN BE FITTED IN AROUND FIRM APPOINTMENTS NOTED ABOVE DURING REMAINDER OF YOUR TIME IN TEHRAN. I PLAN A SMALL DINNER FEBRUARY 6 (RATHER THAN LARGER RECEPTION) BECAUSE IT IS EASIER IN TERMS OF INFORMAL DISCUSSION. DCM WILL DO THE SAME FEBRUARY 5; UNFORTUNATELY I HAVE ANOTHER ENGAGEMENT THAT EVENING.
LOOK FORWARD TO SEEING YOU EARLY IN FEBRUARY.

1978TEHRAN00603.subject: RESURGENCE PARTY PICKS FOUR NEW SENIOR OFFICIALS

segments.text: SUMMARY: RESURGENCE PARTY (RPPI) SECGEN (SYG) AMOUZEGAR HAS SELECTED 4 EXPERIENCED PARTY OFFICIALS TO BE HIS SENIOR DEP SECYS GEN AND PARTY TREASURER. SHAH ENCOURAGED RPPI TO COMPLETE ITS ORGANIZATIONAL TASKS AND STIMULATE DEBATE BETWEEN THE PARTY WINGS. END SUMMARY.

ON JAN 16, PRIMIN AND RPPI SYG AMOUZEGAR PRESENTED HIS 3 SENIOR DEPUTIES AND NEW PARTY TREASURER TO THE SHAH, THUS CONFIRMING THEM. CHOSEN WERE MAHMUD JAAFARIAN, IN CHARGE OF PUBLIC EDUCATION, PUBLICATIOONS, AND PUBLIC RELATIONS (INCLUDING PRESS DISSEMINATION),; MOHAMMAD REZA AMELI-TEHRANI, IN CHARGE OF PARTY/GOVT RELATIONS; MOHAMMAD HOSSEIN MOUSAVI, IN CHARGE OF ORGANIZATIONAL AFFAIRS; AND ALI FARSHCHI, TREASURER AND RESPONSIBLE FOR FINANCIAL AND ADMINISTRATIVE MATTERS.

CONSISTENT WTIH PREVIOULS PRACTIVE FOR MOST RPPI OFFICIALS BELOW THE SYG, EACH INDIVIDUAL WILL KEEP HIS PREVIOUS PORTFOLIOS AS WELL. JAAFARIAN REMAINS DEP MANAGING DIR OF NATIONAL IRANIAN RADIO AND TELEVISION (NIRT) AND ACTINGDIRGEN OF PARS NEWS AGENCY. FARSHCHI WILL CONTINUE AS ASSISTANT TO THE PRIMIN AND PRES OF THE ENDOWMENTS ORGANIZATION. MOUSAVI AND AMELI-TEHRANI REMAIN MAJLES DEPUTIES, AND AMELI-TEHRANI ALSO RETAINS HIS POSITION AS RPPI PARTY CHIEF FOR THE CENTRAL PROVINCE (TEHRAN).

IN SELECTING HIS 4 SENIOR COLLEAGUES, AMOUZEGAR APPEAR TO HAVE OPTED FOR PLAN SPLITTING UP THE POWER OF THE SENIOR DEP SECGEN POSITION. SOURCE CLOSE TO HIM BELIEVES AMOUZEGAR HAVING PICKED 4 EXPERIENCED HANDS (SEE BIOS BELOW), INTENDS TO LET THEM RUN THINGS TOGETHER SUBJECT TO HIS OWN GENERAL SUPERVISION RATHER THAN PICK A SINGLE CHIEF OF STAFF. EMB'S INITIAL IMPRESSION IS THAT QUALITY OF GROUP IS GOOD, ESPECIALLY FARSHCHI AND AMELI-TEHRANI SELECTIONS, WHICH BRING BACK KEY MEMBERS OF AMOUZEGAR'S ORIGINAL TEAM AT RPPI CENTRAL HQS. BIO DATA FOLLOWS ON AMELI-TEHRANI, JAAFARIAN, AND MOUSAVI (FARSHCHI WAS COVERED IN REF C).

MAHMUD JAAFARIAN WAS BORN IN 1925 AND HOLDS A HD IN SOCIOLOGY FROM THE SORBONNE. HE BEGAN HIS CAREER WITH EBRAT"MAGAZINE AND JOINED NIRT AT ITS INCEPTION, BECOMING A DEP DIR IN 1969 AND LATER DEP MANAGING DIR. HE BECAME ACTING DIRGEN OF PARS NEWS AGENCY IN NOVEMBER 1976. HE HAS BEEN A MEMBER OF THE RPPI COMMITTEE ON POLITICAL EDUCATION AND THE NATIONAL PROBLEMS COMMITTEE OF THE CONFERENCE FOR EDUCATIONAL APPRAISAL. HE IS CONSIDERED AN EXPERT IN ARAB AND PERSIAN GULF PROBLEMS, AND IS THE EDITORIAL WRITER FOR THE WEEKLY "TAMASHA". HE SPEAKS FRENCH, ENGLISH AND ARABIC IN ADDITION TO HIS NATIVE PERSIAN AND HAS WRITTEN AND BROADCAST EXTENSIVELY.
MUCH OF THIS MATERIAL HAS BEEN DIRECTLY ANTI-COMMUNIST. HE IS MARRIED.

DR MOHAMMAD-HOSSEIN MOUSAVI WAS BORN IN TABRIZ IN 1919. HE HAS BA AND MA DEGREES FROM TEHRAN UNIV AND A DOCTORATE IN LAW FROM PARIS. HIS CAREER HAS BEEN IN LAW WHERE HE HAS BEEN A REGULAR ATTORNEY, PUBLIC PROSECUTOR, COURT ADVISER AND JUDGE. HE IS VICE PRES OF THE IRANIAN COURT LAWYER'S INSTITUTE. AS A MEMBER OF THE OPPOSITION MARDOM PARTY, HE WAS ELECTED TO THE 1971 MAJLES AND REELECTED IN 1975, THIS TIME AS AN RPPI CANDIDATE. HE HAS TRAVELED IN EUROPE AND SPEAKS ENGLISH AND FRENCH.

DR MOHAMMAD REZA AMELI-TEHRANI WAS BORN IN 1927 IN TEHRAN. HE RECEIVED HIS MEDICAL DOCTORATE FROM TEHRAN UNIV IN 1953 AND HAS BEEN AN ASSOCIATE PROFESSOR AT THE UNIVERSITY'S MEDICAL SCHOOL SINCE 1962. HE WAS A FOUNDER OF THE PAN IRANIST PARTY IN 1947 AND EVENTUALLY BECAME DEPUTY LEADER. HE WAS A MAJLES DEPUTY FROM 1967 TO 1971, THEN DIR OF THE MINISTRY OF INFORMATION'S HIGH SCHOOL OF TOURISM SERVICES. ELECTED AGAIN TO THE MAJLES IN 1975 AS AN RPPI CANDIDATE, HE BECAME INTERESTED IN PARTY AFFAIRS AND WAS NAMED RPPI SECGEN FOR CENTRAL (TEHRAN) PROVINCE IN LATE 1976, A POSITION HE STILL RETAINS.
HE HAS WRITTEN SEVERAL POLITICAL ARTICLES AND EDUCATIONAL BOOKS. HE SPEAKS ENGLISH; HIS MARITAL STATUS IS NOT KNOWN.

DURING PRESENTATION OF DEPUTIES, SHAH URGED MOUSAVI TO GET BUSY AND COMPLETE ELECTION OF RPPI COUNCILS SO THAT PARTY COULD MOVE FORWARD. SHAH ALSO CALLED ON PARTY WINGS TO BEGIN PUBLIC DISCUSSIONS OF THEIR POSITIONS SO THAT VOTERS WILL KNOW WHAT THEY ARE VOTING FOR IN FUTURE ELECTIONS.

WE HAVE DETERMINED THAT THE SHAH WILL BE IN TOWN AND PROBABLY AVAILABLE BETWEEN NOW AND JAN 21. HE WILL BE UNAVAILABLE FROM JAN 21 TO FEB 1 AND BACK AGAIN FROM FEB 2 TO FEB 10. HOPE THIS GIVES YOU ENOUGH LATITUDE IN PLANNING YOUR VISIT TO TEHRAN TO BRIEF THE SHAH ON SALT AS DISCUSSED EARLIER. PLEASE ADVISE.

1978TEHRAN00623.subject: NIGERIAN PRIME MINISTER'S DISCUSSION WITH FOREIGN MINISTER ON HORN OF AFRICA

segments.text: MINISTER ON HORN OF AFRICA

IRANIAN FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY TOLD ME MORNING JANUARY 18 THAT GOI WAS DISAPPOINTED BY ITS TALKS WITH VISITING NIGERIAN PRIME MINISTER BRIGADIER SHEHU MUSA YAR' ADUA ON SUBJECTS AFFECTING HORN OF AFRICA. HE SAID NIGERIAN KEPT SUGGESTING THAT IRAN INITIATE ACTION TO MEDIATE ETHIOPIAN-SOMALIAN DISPUTE.

ACCORDING KHALATBARY, SHAH FINALLY TOLD HIS VISITOR RATHER POINTEDLY THAT IRAN EXPECTED AFRICAN STATES, PARTICULARLY NIGERIA, TO TAKE THE LEAD IN ATTEMPTING TO PRODUCE NEGOTIATIONS IN THE HORN. YAR' ADUA'S REPLY WAS REPORTEDLY MOST EVASIVE.

1978TEHRAN00628.subject: GOI PROTEST TO SOMALIAN AMB FOR ABUSING IRANIAN HOSPITALITY

segments.text: HOSPITALITY

SOMALIAN AMB TO IRAN GAVE A PRESS CONFERENCE IN TEHRAN JAN 17, APPARENTLY TIMED TO COINCIDE WITH SIAD BARRE'S RECENT DEMARCHE IN MOGADISCIO. IN SUBSEQUENT TELEVISON INTERVIEW, AMB ATTACKED SOVIETS AND CUBANS AS MEMBERS -UNHOLY ALLIANCE" WITH ETHIOPIANS.

IRANIAN FONMIN KHALATBARY TOLD ME MORNING JA 18 THAT GOI WILL PROTEST TO SOMALIAN FOR ABUSING IRANIAN HOSPITALITY BY SUING LOCAL TELEVISION TO ATTACK A NATION WITH WHICH IRAN MAINTAINS FRIENDLY RELATIONS (I.E. THE SOVIETS). HE ASSUMES MOSCOW WILL ALSO PROTEST TO GOI.

SUMMARY: FURTHER REPORTS INDICATE RIOTING SAT, JAN 14 IN SYMPATHY WITH THOSE KILLED AT QOM JAN 9 WAS WIDESPREAD IN TEHRAN, TABRIZ, ISFAHAN AND ELSEWHERE. LARGE PRO-GOVERNMENT DEMONSTRATION OCCURRED IN TABRIZ. THUS FAR, THERE HAS BEEN NO EXPLICIT ANTIAMERICANISM. END SUMMARY.

IN ADDITION TO INCIDENTS MENTIONED REFTEL, SAT, JAN 14 SAW WIDESPREAD VIOLENT RIOTS AT THE UNIV OF AZERBADIGN (TABRIZ) AND MARMAK COLLEGE, ARYAMEHR TECHNICAL COLLEGE, AND TEHRAN UNIV (ALL IN TEHRAN). PATTERN WAS SAME IN ALL CASES--STUDENTS BROKE INTO UNIV BUILDINGS WITH INTENT TO DO SEVERE DAMAGE AND WERE REPULSED BY POLICE, WITH SOME ARRESTS MADE IN EACH CASE.

AT TEHRAN, POLICE WERE PRESENT FROM BEGINNING, AND FACULTY SOURCE WHO OBSERVED RIOT SAID IT WAS CLASSIC CONFRONTATION--STUDENTS CLEARLY BENTON VIOLENCE, POLICE RESISTING AND BREAKING UP DEMONSTRATION. ANOTHER ACADEMIC SOURCE INDICATED DEMONSTRATIONS AT TEHRAN WERE WIDESPREAD AND INCLUDED VIRTUALLY ALL FACULTIES, INCLUDING ARTS AND LETTERS WHICH IS NOT USUALLY SUBJECT TO RIOTING. THIS SOURCE THOUGHT POLICE BEHAVIOR WAS PROFESSIONAL, AND STUDENTS WERE BENT ON DESTRUCTION FROM START.
POLICE WERE ALSO READY AT ARYAMEHR WHERE TEHRAN UNIV SCENARIO REPEATED ITSELF. STUDENTS INFLICTED EXTENSIVE DAMAGE AND WERE DISPERSED BY POLICE WITH SOME ARRESTS.

AT NARMAK, ABOUT 600 STUDENTS BEGAN DEMONSTRATIONS WITH NO OUTSIDE POLICE INITIALLY PRESENT. LOCAL CAMPUS GUARDS WERE UNABLE TO CONTROL MOB, WHICH BROKE INTO CHANCELLOR'S OFFICE (HE WAS OUT OF COUNTRY) AND VIRTUALLY DESTROYED ADMINISTRATION BUILDING. SENIOR UNIV OFFICIAL INDICATED OVER 70 PERCENT F WINDOWS ON CAMPUS WERE BROKEN, AND THERE WERE SEVERAL STUDENTS INJURED IN SCUFFLING BEFORE POLICE ARRIVED AND BROKE UP FESTIVITIES. ACCORDING TO THIS SOURCE, GOI WILL BE TRYING ALL ARRESTED STUDENTS IN CIVIL COURTS AND DESTRUCTION OF PROPERTY AND OTHER CHARGES SUCH AS COMMITTING BODILY INJURY, IF APPLICABLE.
CONSULATE ISFAHAN NOTES BAZAAR REMAINED CLOSED THROUGH JAN 17, BUT OTHER SHOPS BEGAN REOPENING DURING JAN 17.

ONLY COUNTER-DEMONSTRATION WE AWAREOF RELATED TO THESE EVENTS WAS "SPONTANEOUS" OUTPOURING OF SEVERAL THOUSAND PEOPLE IN TABRIZ TO PROTEST RIOTS AGAINST GOVT. MEETING FOLLOWED RIIOT AT AZARBADIGAN UNIV ON JAN 14 WHICH DID SIGNIFICANT DAMAGE TO UNIV BUILDINGS. PRESS JAN 18 SAID 50,000 PEOPLE ATTENDED PROGOVT DEMONSTRATION, WHICH FEATURED SPEAKERS ATTACKING EFFORTS TO PREY ON ENEMIES OF IRAN. MESSGE DELIVERED TO MEETING BY TABRIZ RELIGIOUS LEADER'S REP BLASTED "INTERNATIONAL CHAIN OF AGITATORS WHO ARE IN THE SERVICE OF COLONIAL INTERESTS", WHO WILL "DO ANYTHING, ESPECIALLY BY DONNING THE CLOAK OF RELIGION, TO ACHIEVE THEIR UNHOLY ENDS".
CONSULATE TABRIZ SAYS GOI CLEARLY ORGANIZED EVENT, TO POINT OF PROVIDING UNIFORM PLACARDS AND PICTURES OF SHAH.
THUS FAR, WE UNAWARE OF ANYSPECIFICALLY ANTI-AMERICAN INCIDENTS RELATED TO QOM EVENTS AND RELATED MANIFESTATIONS.

1978TEHRAN00666.subject: IMPERIAL COMMISSION MEETING PUBLICIZES CRITICISM OF GOI PROJECTS

segments.text: OF GOI PROJECTS

THE NINTH GENERAL MEETING OF THE IMPERIAL COMMISSION WAS OPENED JAN. 17 UNDER THE CHAIRMANSHIP OF NOSRATOLLAH MOINIAN, CHIEF OF THE SHAH'S SECRETARIAT. SESSION WAS ATTENDED BY PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR AND OTHER CABINET MEMEBERS. MOINIAN, IN HIS OPENING REMARKS, STRESSED "THOSE WHO ACT AGAINST THE GLORY OF IRAN WILL SUFFER". REMINDING HIS AUDIENCE, "IT IS NOT LONG SINCE THE OCCUPATION OF IRAN AND THE START OF THE DARK YEARS WHEN THE MIGHTY SAT IN THEIR CAPITALS DECIDING THE FUTURE OF THIS ANCIENT LAND.

ONLY ONE PERSON STOOD AGAINST THEM." REFERRING TO SPATE OF RECENT HIGHLEVEL VISITS TO IRAN, MOINIAN SAID, "EVEN THE BIGGEST LEADERS OF THE WORLD COME TO IRAN SAYING THAT THEY HAVE COME TO LEARN FROM THE SHAHANSHAH, TO CONSULT HIM, AND TO SEEK HIS GUIDANCE."
A CONDENSED 70 PAGE REPORT ON THE FINDING OF THE IMPERIAL COMMISSION COMMITTEES WAS PRESENTED. ACCORDING TO MOINIAN, THREE LESSONS HAVE BEEN DRAWN FROM THE STUDY

THE NEW GENERATION MUST BE ALERT TO PREVENT WASTE AND INEFFICIENCY AND THERE IS NO ROOM FOR IRRESPONSIBLE BEHAVIOR IF PRINCIPLES OF THE REVOLUTION ARE TO BE ACHIEVED; 2) PROJECTS MUST BE RAISED ON A LOGICIAL ASSESSMENT OF FINANCIAL, MANPOWER AND OTHER RESOURCES; 3) GOI PLANNING AUTHORITIES MUST CONSTANTLY SUPERVISE AND FOLLOW UP EACH PROJECT TO AVOID "IRREPARABLE LOSSES".

SPECIFIC CRITICISM WAS LEVELED BY THE COMMISSION IN KEY AREAS, SUCH AS MEDICAL CARE, IN A REPORT PREPARED BY THE MEDICAL AND SOCIAL INSURANCE COMMITTEE WHICH REVEALED MALPRACTICE, INEFFICIENCY AND MISMANAGEMENT AT VARIOUS HOSPITALS. THE COMMISSION EDUCATION COMMITTEE REPORTED ON SEVERAL INSTANCES OF MISMANAGEMENT IN RURAL SCHOOL CONSTRUCTION BUT ALSO NOTED THAT AN UNANNOUNCED INSPECTION HAD FOUND THE EDUCATION CORPS FOR GIRLS TRAINING CENTER HAD THE HIGHEST STANDARD OF CLEANLINESS. THE COMMISSION'S POWER COMMITTE INSPECTED A NUMBER OF POWER STATIONS AND RELATED PROJECTS AND REVEALED DELAYS IN COMPLETION OF THE STATIONS IN QOM AND SHAHABAD. OTHERS, HOWEVER, HAD BEEN COMPLETED ON SCHEDULE.

THE COMMISSION ALSO COMMENTED ON COOPERATIVE ORGANIZATIONS, SUGGESTING THAT INCREASED CREDIT BE EXTENDED TO COOPERATIVES AND THAT RURAL COOPERATIVE RETAIL SHOPS BE EXPANDED. CONSIDERABLE ATTENTION WAS FOCUSED ON THE PORTS AND SHIPPING ORGANIZATION WHICH WAS HELD RESPONSIBLE FOR "UNREASONABLE DELAYS" LEADING TO INEFFICIENT IMPLEMENTATION OF THE BANDAR SHAHPOUR DEVELOPMENT PLAN AND CONGESTION AT THAT PORT. REPRESENTATIVES FROM THE VARIOUS ORGANIZATION SUBJECT TO CRITICISM WERE PRESENT AND GIVEN AN OPPORTUNITY TO RESPOND TO THE COMMISSION'S FINDINGS. THE MEETING WAS TELEVISED AND RECEIVED WIDESPREAD PRESS COVERAGE.

PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR, COMMENTING ON THE COMMISSION REPORTS, PLEDGED THAT THE GOVERNMENT WOULD FOCUS INCREASED ATTENTION ON DEVELOPMENT OF PROVINCIAL TOWNS. HE REPORTEDLY POINTED OUT THAT SOME OF THE SHORTCOMING REVEALED BY THE COMMISSION WERE PERHAPS THE RESULTS OF NON-COMPETITIVE FIRMS IN THE PRIVATE SECTOR. HE SAID THAT THE HIGH COST OF IRANIAN PRODUCTS MUST BE INVESTIGATED AND HINTED THAT SOME IRANIAN INDUSTRIALISTS AHD INDULGED IN LAND SPECULATION WITH MONEY AND CREDITS OBTAINED FROM BANKS AND LOANS RATHER THAN INVESTING THEM IN THEIR BUSINESS FIRMS.

COMMENT: IT WAS INTERESTING THAT MOINIAN WRAPPED HIS INTRODUCTORY REMARKS IN SAME PATRIOTIC THEME RESERVED IN PAST FOR SUCH EVENTS AS THE ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION OF THE WITHDRAWAL OF FOREIGN TROOPS FROM AZERBIJAN BUT WHICH IS CURRENTLY BEING INSERTED WITH INCREASING FREQUENCY IN OTHER MAJOR GOI PRONOUNCEMENTS SUCH AS AT RECENT RASTAKIZ PARTY CONGRESS. LATEST MEETING OF THE COMMISSION CONTINUES PRACTICE OF SUMMER SESSIONS WHICH ENCOURAGED "CONSTRUCTIVE CRITICISM" AND PUBLICIZED SHORTCOMING OF GOI PROGRAMS.

1978TEHRAN00688.subject: TANGOV QUESTIONS ON IRAN'S SOMALIA POLICY

segments.text: ON JANUARY 18 DCM ASKED MFA DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR ASIA AND AFRICA NAYERI IF GOI HAD MADE ANY STATEMENTS CONCERNING THE TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY OF ETHIOPIA TO COMPLEMENT THE SHAH'S AND FOREIGN MINISTER'S STATEMENTS REGARDING THE TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY OF SOMALIA. NAYERI SAID THERE HAVE BEEN NO EXPLICIT STATEMENT TO THAT EFFECT, BUT IMPLICIT IN THE GOI STATEMENTS ON SOMALIA WAS THE OBVERSE, I.E., THAT IRAN RESPECTS THE CONCEPT OF THE INVIOLABILTY OF INTERNATIONAL FRONTIERS WITH RESPECT TO ETHIOPIA AS TO OTHER COUNTRIES.

1978TEHRAN00693.subject: IRANIAN PREPARATIONS FOR THE IMCO PLENIPOTENTIARY CONFERENCE TO BE HELD IN LONDON FEBRUARY 6-17, 1978

segments.text: INFO REQUESTED PARA FOUR REF: IRAN WILL PARTICIPATE IN THE FEBRUARY PLENIPOTENTIARY CONFERENCE, SENDING ONE OFFICIAL FROM NATIONAL IRANIAN OIL COMPANY AND ONE FROM PORTS AND SHIPPING ORGANIZATION (NAMES SO FAR UNKNOWN TO MFA.). AS FAR AS LEGAL AFFAIRS DEPARTMENT OF MFA HAS BEEN ABLE TO DETERMINE, THERE IS NO IRANIAN OPPOSITION TO THE U.S. PROPOSALS THAT WILL BE PRESENTED AT PLENIPOTENTIAY CONFERENCE AND NO FURTHER INFORMATION IS NEEDED.
IRAN WILL ALSO SEND DELEGATE TO IMCO MEETING SCHEDULED FOR APRIL 17, 1978. AND FOR THE RECORD, MFA CLAIMS THAT IRAN WAS INDEED REPRESENTED AT JOINT MSC/MEPC MEETING LAST APRIL.

DURING JAN 18, 1978 MEETING WITH EMB CIVAIR OFFICER, IRANIAN AIRPORT SENIIOR SECURITY OFFICIAL, GEN SLAEHIYEH CONFIRMED THAT THE PROCEDURES OUTLINED PARA ONE, REFTEL ARE THE OFFICIAL GOVT POSITIONS IN CASE OF A HIJACKING.

GEN SALEHIYEH ALSO STATED THAT SINCE THE TIME OF THE LUFTHANSA THREAT SPECIAL IRANIAN TROOPS WITH COUNTER HIJACING AND TERRORIST TRAINING HAVE BEEN POSTED TO ALL MAJOR IRANIAN AIRPORTS AND THESE TROOPS ARE ON 24 HOUR DUTY.

IMF SECOND AMENDMENT TO THE ARTICLES OF AGREEMENT AND QUOTA INCREASE: THE IRANIAN MAJLIS AND SENATE HAVE APPROVED BOTH ACTIONS AND THE SHAH'S SIGNATURE IS EXPECTED SHORTLY. IRAN'S IMF QUOTA WILL INCREASE FROM SDR 192 MILLION TO 660 MILLION. THE MECHANICS FOR THE INCREASE INVLOVE THE MINISTRY OF ECONOMICS AND FINANCE PROVIDING A PROMISORY NOTE TO THE CENTRAL BANK OF IRAN (CBI), WHICH IN TURN WILL PROVIDE THE INCREASE IN RIALS.

WITTEVEEN FACILITY: CBI DIRECTOR FOR INTERNATIONAL RELATIONS AND STUDIES MANAVI-RAD SAYS THAT AUTHORIZATION FOR IRAN'S SDR 685 MILLION PARTICIPATION IN THE FACILITY IS BOGGED DOWN IN A CABINET DISPUTE OVER IRAN'S IMF QUOTA. AS DEPARTMENT AND US EXEC. DIR. AWARE, IRAN STRONGLY DESIRES A LARGER QUOTA AND VOTE IN IMF. WHILE FRICTION WITH IMF OVER THIS HAS AFFECTED THE WITTENEEN CONTRIBUTION, MANAVI-RAD EXPECTS IT TO BE OVERCOME AND THE NECESSARY AUTHORIZATION OBTAINED FROM PARLIAMENT AND THE SENATE EARLY IN THE NEXT IRANIAN YEAR,WHICH BEGINS MARCH 21.
CBI VICE GOVERNOR SHIRAZI SAID THAT THIS CONTRIBUTION WILL BE FROM THE CBI'S OWN PORTFOLIO, AS WAS ABOUT HALF OF IRAN'S PARTICIPATION IN THE FUND'S OIL FACILITIES.

MFA CENTO AFFAIRS DEPT HEAD PANAHI NOTES FEB 24 CENTO ANNIVERSARY TRADITIONALLY IS OCCASION FOR MESSAGES FROM MEMBER COUNTRY FONMINS TO CENTO SYG. WHILE IT IS POSSIBLE NEW SYG WILL BE APPOINTED BEFORE THEN, GOI WOULD LIKE TO COORDINATE ON PROCEDURE WE SHOULD FOLLOW IN ABSENCE OF SYG. HE NOTES MESSAGE IS USUALLY DELIVERED PHYSICALLY IN THE FORM OF A SIGNED LETTER AND, THEREFORE, REQUIRES CONSIDERABLE LEAD TIME. HE HAS ALREADY APPROACHED BRITISH WHO ARE QUERYING FCO. PLEASE ADVISE.

PANAHI ALSO INFORMS US ECONOMIC COMITE MEETING IS BEING PUSHED BACK BY ONE WEEK TO MARCH 6-8 DUE TO VERY COLD WEATHER IN TABRIZ AND OTHER ADMINISTRATIVE REASONS. IT WILL PROBABLY BE HELD IN TABRIZ CITY HALL.
REF STATE 12946

WIRELESS FILE TEXT OF AMBASSADOR RICHARDSON'S JAN 18 ADDRESS TO SEAPOWER SYMPOSIUM PASSED TO DR. KAZEMI, HEAD, LEGAL DEPARTMENT, MFA. KAZEMI COMMENTED TO EMBOFF THAT SPEECH REFLECTED "BETTER MOOD THAN PREVIOUSLY", ADDING THAT HE RECENTLY HAD OPPORTUNITY TO MEET WITH DEPUTY SPECIAL REPRESENTATIVE ALDRICH IN QATAR WHERE THEY HAD FULL DISCUSSION OF RICHARDSON SPEECH.
KAZEMI IS PLANNING TO ATTEND LOS INTERSESSIONAL MEETING BEGINNING FEB 6 IN NEW YORK.

IN RESPONSE TO RECENT DISTURBANCES PROTESTING IRANIAN WOMEN'S EMANCIPATION (REFTEL, THE WOMEN'S ORGANIZATION OF IRAN (WOI) COORDINATED A NUMBER OF NON-VIOLENT COUNTERDEMONSTRATIONS ON JAN 22. NEWS STORIES PROMINENTLY FEATURED IN ALL PAPERS REPORT MASS RALLIES IN OVER 400 CITIES AND TOWNS THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY IN WHICH "TENS OF THOUSANDS" OF WOMEN PARTICIPATED. IN ADDITION, GOVT MINISTRIES (INCLUDING MFA), PRIVATE COMPANIES AND THE WOI ITSELF STAGED MEETINGS IN TEHRAN.

AT A GATHERING OF GOI EMPLOYEES AT THE PRIMINS OFFICE, MIN OF STATE FOR WOMEN'S AFFAIRS AND WOI SECGEN MAHNAZ AFKHAMI TOLD THE ASSEMBLED WOMEN THAT MEETINGS ON JAN 22 WERE HELD TO DISPLAY WOMEN'S UNITED RANKS IN OPPOSITION TO "TREASONOUS CONSPIRACIES". AFKHAMI, ON BEHALF OF IRANIAN WOMEN, FORWARDED A TELEGRAM TO THE SHAH ASSERTING THAT WOMEN HAD DECLARED WAR ON "AGENTS OF FOREIGNERS AND REACTIONARIES WHO WANT WOMEN TO RETURN TO THE INFERNAL PERIOD OF THE PAST". ALONG WITH THESE SENTIMENTS, RITUALISTIC SUPPORTIVE STATEMENTS APPEARED AFFIRMING IRANIAN WOMEN'S FAITH IN THE THREE PRINCIPLES OF THE RASTAKHIZ PARTY-MONARCHY, CONSTITUTION AND THE WHITE REVOLUTION.

COMMENT: THEME OF MEETINGS ECHO VIEWS RECENTLY EXPRESSED TO EMBOFF BY WOI DEP DIR EZZAT AGHEVLI THAT "FOREIGN ELEMENTS", ARE BEHIND ANTI-WOMEN'S RIGHTS PROTESTORS. LOWER RANKING WOI OFFICIAL CONFIRMED JAN 23 THAT ORGANIZATION HAS BEEN BUSY ORGANIZING NOT ONLY JAN 22 TURNOUT, BUT ALSO MASS PARTICIPATION BY WOMEN IN THE UPCOMING RALLIES CELEBRATING 6TH OF BAHMAN (ANNIVERSARY OF THE WHITE REVOLUTION, JAN 26) AND ON 8TH OF ESGAND (IRANIAN WOMEN'S RIGHTS DAY, FEB 27).

1978TEHRAN00811.subject: JAPANESE FONMIN SONODA'S VISIT TO IRAN

segments.text: AS ANTICIPATED IN REFTELS, JAPANESE FONMIN SONODA STOPPED AT TEHRAN FOR SOME 7 HOURS JAN 19 IN TRANSIT TO JAPAN FROM HIS MIDDLE EAST TOUR. A 1 HOUR MEETING WITH PRIMIN AMOUZEGAR WAS CHARACTERIZED BY A JAPANESE EMBOFF AS A COURTESY CALL. THE PRIMIN EXPRESSED HOPE THAT THE ALREADY GOOD ECONOMIC COOPERATION BETWEEN IRAN AND JAPAN WOULD EXTEND TO A WIDER RANGE OF ACTIVITIES, INCLUDING CULTURAL EXCHANGES. HE ALSO WELCOMED THE PROSPECT OF JAPANESE PRIMIN FUKUDA'S VISIT, WHICH ACCORDING TO OUR CONTACT IS SPECULATED TO OCCUR IN MAY, WHEN THE CURRENT SESSION OF THE DIET RECESSE.
THE BALANCE OF SONODA'S TIME HERE WAS DEVOTED TO SEEING THE CROWN JEWELS, SHOPPING, AND REST.

REF STATE 4585 INSTRUCTIONS BEEN RECEIVED BY JAPANESE (JANUARY 22) AND DUTCH (JANUARY 24) HERE. THEY ARE WILLING TO PLAY ANY WAY WE WANT IN APPROACH TO GOI, BUT WE ARE AWAITING RECEIPT OF INSTRUCTIONS BY GERMANS BEFORE WE PROCEED.

1978TEHRAN00961.subject: RELIGION AND POLITICS: QOM AND ITS AFTERMATH

segments.text: REF A. TEHRAN 0548 B. TEHRAN 0389 C. TEHRAN 0665

77 TEHRAN A-124 SUMMARY: RELIGIOUS DISTURBANCES WIDESPREAD OVER WEEKEND JAN 14-15. AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI'S INTERVIEW WITH THREE FOREIGN CORRESPONDENTS WAS OPEN (AND UNPRECEDENTED) PUBLIC REFUTATION OF GOVERNMENT STATEMENTS. AS RESULT OF QOM INCIDENT ORGANIZED MOSLEM ESTABLISHMENT POTENTIALLY IN STRONGEST POSITION SINCE 1963 VIS-A-VIS GOI. MOSLEMS FAR FROM WHOLLY UNIFIED, BUT GOI IS DEMONSTRATING CONSIDERABLE UNCERTAINTY IN FACING UP TO THE CHALLENGE. END SUMMARY.

FOLLOWING DESCRIPTION OF EVENTS WERE GLEANED FROM IRANIAN CONTACTS CLOSE TO RELIGIOUS LEADERS AND TWO OF THREE FOREIGN JOURNALISTS WHO INTERVIEWED AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI AND OTHER RELIGIOUS LEADERS. EMBASSY ASSESSMENT OF SIGNIFICANCE OF QOM EVENTS AND AFTERMATH GIVEN IN PARAS SIX THRU NINE.

AS FULL REPORTS COME IN, IT APPEARS WEEKEND JAN 1415 SAW MAJOR RELIGIOUS DEMONSTRATIONS IN MASHAD, ABADAN, AHWAZ, DEZFUL, HORRAMSHAR, SHUSTAR, ZANJAN AND PERHAPS OTHER CITIES. AHWAZ BAZAAR WAS CLOSED FOR TWO DAYS AND 50 CITIZENS WERE REPORTED "EXILED" TO FORCED RESIDENCE IN QOM AS A RESULT OF THEIR PARTICIPATION IN DEMONSTRATIONS. UNCONFIRMED RUMORS INDICATE SEVERAL PEOPLE WERE KILLED IN ABADAN RIOT AND NUMBER OF INDIVIDUALS INJURED AT OTHER LOCATIONS. UNCONFIRMED RUMOR IN TEHRAN INDICATES THREE PEOPLE DIED AS RESULT OF INJURIES SUSTAINED AT ARYAMEHR TECHNICAL COLLEGE RIOT JAN 11 AND 12.
MANY IRANIANS APPEAR TO HAVE CEASED TO BELIEVE NEWSPAPER REPORTS OF RELIGIOUS INCIDENTS AND REGARD COUNTER-DEMONSTRATIONS (REPORTED REF A AND C) AS GOVERNMENT INSPIRED.

JOURNALISTS WHO INTERVIEWED AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI IMPRESSED WITH HIS SINCERITY. AYATOLLAH WAS UNWILLING TO BE INTERVIEWED FOR PUBLICATION BUT WAS FINALLY CONVINCED HIS STATEMENTS WOULD BE MUCH LESS MEANINGFUL IF HIS NAME WERE NOT ATTACHED TO THEM. SHARIATMADARI CONTINUALLY STRESSED DESIRE NOT TO ENTER INTO CONFLICT WITH CIVIL AUTHORITES. HE SAID HE HAD NOT ORDERED BAZAARS IN COUNTRY TO CLOSE DOWN AND HAD ENCOURAGED RELIGIOUS LEADERS IN EACH TOWN TO MAKE THEIR OWN DECISION REGARDING MEMORIAL SERVICES FOR THOSE KILLED IN QOM. NEVERTHELESS, SHARIATMADARI'S STATEMENTS IN BRANIGIN WASHPOST STORIES (JAN 20, USINFO) WERE A DIRECT CHALLENGE TO GOVERNMENT'S VERSION OF EVIDENCE SURROUNDING KILLINGS AT QOM.

AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI WAS TREATED WITH OBVIOUS RESPECT BY OTHER LEADERS OF QOM THEOLOGICAL INSTITUTE WHO WERE PRESENT DURING INTERVIEW. RELIGIOUS LEADERS AGREED POLICE HAD OVERREACTED AND INSISTED SHOOTINGS WERE UNPROVOKED. AYATOLLAH ASKED QUESTION (NOT REPORTED BY NEWSMEN) WHY POLICE HAD NOT USED TEAR GAS OR FIRE HOSES? SHARIATMADARI AND HIS COLLEAGUES SAID ORIGINAL CROWD HAD BEEN AROUND 5000. HE SAID SOME 30 INDIVIDUALS WERE KILLED WHEN SHOOTING STARTED--MORE DIED LATER BRINGING TOTAL AROUND 70. (COMMENT: EMBASSY HAS RECEIVED REPORT THAT PARS NEWS AGENCY, AFTER FIRST REPORTS, CAME UP WITH FIGURE OF 76 KILLED BUT WAS ORDERED BY GOI NOT TO USE THIS FIGURE.

MORE ACCURATE FIGURE IN OUR JUDGEMENT IS REPORT FROM OPPOSITION INFORMANT WHO CLAIMS THAT 14 DEATH CERTIFICATES WERE KNOWN TO HAVE BEEN SIGNED (SEP MEMCON). THE LATTER TRACKS WITH OTHER RELIABLE REPORTS EMBASSY HAS RECEIVED.)

IN DISCUSSIONS WITH REPORTERS, SHARIATMADARI INDICATED RELIGIOUS COLLEGE AND MOSQUE AT AHWAZ HAD BEEN CLOSED FIVE DAYS BECAUSE RELIGIOUS LEADERS THERE HAD BEEN IN FOREFRONT OF DEMONSTRATORS. SHARIATMADARI AND HIS COLLEAGUES LEFT DEFINITE IMPRESSION WITH JOURNALISTS THAT THEY HAD CONTACTS IN MOST MAJOR AND MANY MINOR IRANIAN CITIES. TWO MULLAHS WHO HAD RECENTLY RETURNED FROM KHUZISTAN PROVINCE TOLD OF THEIR ORGANIZATIONAL EFFORTS THERE. JOURNALIST' IMPRESSION WAS THAT ------------------041246 270136Z /14 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 6627 INFO AMEMBASSY LONDON SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 0961 NOFORN SHARIATMADARI WAS EMERGING AS FOREMOST LEADER OF MOSLEM REACTION TO GOVERNMENT.

OTHER EMBASSY SOURCES DESCRIBE HIM AS ONE OF EIGHT LEADING IRANIAN AYATOLLAHS AND POSSIBLY THE MOST EMINENT ONE, AFTER JAILING OF AYATOLLAH TALEQUANI AND BANISHMENT TO PROVINCES OF SEVERAL OTHERS LAST FALL. ONE SOURCE NOTED THERE WAS NOW NO RPT NO AYATOLLAH IN MASHAD, ONE OF IRN'S THREE MOST RELIGIOUS CITIES. ACCORDING TO EMBASSY FILES, AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI HAD BEEN KNOWN IN EARLIER YEARS AS PROGRESSIVE THINKER (IN MOSLEM CONTEXT), ONE WHO HAD SERIOUSLY STUDIED ISLAMIC REFORMERS OF LATE 19TH AND EARLY 20TH CENTURY. JOURANLISTS WERE INTRODUCED TO AYATOLLAH BY SENIOR FIGURE IN TEHRAN'S "HOSSEYNIYEH ERSHAD" RELIGIOUS CENTER WHICH MAINTAINS CONTACTS WITH SHARIATMADARI AND OTHER AYATOLLAHS.

EMBASSY ANLAYSIS: FROM POLITICAL STANDPOINT, MOST INTERESTING ELEMENT OF SHARIATMADARI'S PRONOUNCEMENTS WAS STATEMENT THAT WEARING OF VEIL WAS UP TO INDIVIDUAL WOMAN AND THAT ISLAM WAS NOT AGAINST LAND REFORM BUT MERELY AGAINST WAY GOVERNMENT HAD CARRIED OUT CERTAIN ELEMENTS OF SHAH-PEOPLE REVOLUTION. TWO LOCAL CONTACTS WHO ARE FAMILIAR WITH RELIGIOUS CURRENTS HERE BELIEVE IF SHARIATMADARI CAN MAKE THIS POSITION MAIN THESIS OF ISLAMIC OPPOSITIONISTS (MANY OF WHOM ARE MUCH MORE REACTIONARY THAN THIS) HE WILL HAVE TURNED MOVEMENT IN DIRECTION WHICH MIGHT COMMEND IT TO THOSE WHO HAVE THUS FAR BEEN ALIENATED FROM OPPSITION POLITICS BUT WHO ARE ALSO NOT INTERESTED IN RELIGIOUS FUNDAMENTALISM--MEMBERS OF IRAN'S EMERGING MIDDLE CLASS.

IN COMING MONTHS EMBASSY WILL BE ATTEMPTING TO WORK AT INHERENTLY DIFFICULT TASK OF LEARNING MORE ABOUT RELIGIOUS ELEMENTS OF OPPOSITIONIST MOVEMENT, INCLUDING DOCTRINES WHICH ARE CURRENTLY BEING ESPOUSED BY BOTH PROGRESSIVES AND REACTIONARIES. WHAT QOM INCIDENT AND ITS AFTERMATH HAS DONE, HOWEVER, IS TO ELEVATE RELIGIOUS OPPOSITION TO MORE VISIBLE, SIGNIFICANT POSITION AMONG THOSE WHO HAVE THUS FAR TAKEN ADVANTAGE OF NEW LIBERALIZATION. ORGANIZATIONAL ACCOMPLISHMENTS OF AYATOLLAHS AND MULLAHS IN RESPONSE TO QOM EVENTS SEEM IMPRESSIVE, THOUGH THEY WOULD PROBABLY FIND IT DIFFICULT TO GENERATE ADDITIONAL DEMONSTRATIONS IMMEDIATELY FOR PURELY POLITICAL PURPOSES IN ABSENCE OF ADDITIONAL CRYSTALLIZING INCIDENTS.

(QOM DEMONSTRATION WAS TOUCHED OFF BY ARTICLE IN DAILY NEWSPAPER ETELAAT WHICH SEVERELY ATTACKED EXILED RELIGIOUS LEADER KHOMEINI.) FOR EXAMPLE IT IS DOUBTFUL THAT RELIGIOUS FACTIONS COULD BE MOBILIZED IN NEAR FUTURE TO SUPPORT ANY LEGISLATION IN PARLIAMENT OR TO DEMONSTRATE IN FAVOR OF CONSTITUTIONAL REFORM. POTENTIAL BLEND OF RELIGIOUS FERVOR WITH THE POLITICAL, HOWEVER, HAS KEPT GOI, AND SHAH, ALERT TO DANGERS OF RELIGIOUS INVOLVEMENT IN POLITICS.

INITIAL SOUNDINGS INDICATE THAT GOI HAS NOT RPT NOT BEEN ABLE TO MOBILIZE MIDDLE CLASS AROUND SLOGANS DEPICTING RELIGIOUS DEMONSTRATORS AT QOM AS HOPELESS REACTIONARIES. "WORKERS AND PEASANTS" PLUS BUSINESSMEN, GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES, STUDENTS AND SOME INTELLECTUALS HAVE TURNED OUT DUTIFULLY FOR GOVERNMENT DEMONSTRATIONS, BUT THIS HAS NOT BOUND MIDDLE CLASS MORE CLOSELY TO GOVERNMENT. POTENTIAL DANGER, OF COURSE, IS THAT GOI MIGHT LOSE CONTROL OVER LRELIGIOUS ELEMENTS, LEADING TO THE INHERENTLY MORE DANGEROUS CONFRONTATION OF SECULAR MODERNIZERS AGAINST FUNDAMENTALIST RELIGIOUS LEADERS WHICH HAS BEEN AVOIDED FOR SOME 15 YEARS.

THUS FAR, AMERICANS AND OTHER FOREIGNERS HAVE NOT RPT NOT BEEN INCLUDED EVEN INDIRECTLY IN ATTACKS ON GOI. GIVEN DEEP XENOPHOBIC STREAK IN FUNDAMENTALIST MOSLEMS, HOWEVER, IT IS DIFFICULT TO SEE HOW THIS CONDITION CAN HOLD UNLESS PROGRESSIVE AYATOLLAHS ARE ABLE TO IMPOSE MORE STRICT DISCIPLINE ON THEIR FOLLOWERS THAN SEEMS POSSIBLE FROM PAST EXPERIENCE, PARTICULARLY IF ISLAMIC MARXISTS MUDDY THE WATERS.

1978TEHRAN00962.subject: EFFORT TO OPEN CHANNEL OF COMMUNICATION TO MENGISTU

segments.text: REF A. STATE 20233 B. STATE 18370

I GREATLY APPRECIATE BEING KEP INFORMED OF OUR ACTIONS CONCERNING THE HORN OF AFRICA SO THAT I CAN BE RESPONSIVE TO THE CONTINUING IRANIAN INTEREST IN THAT REGION. AT THE CURRENT MOMENT, THERE IS SOME SENSITIVITY HERE ON THE SUBJECT BECAUSE OF THE SHARP, PERSONALIZED REACTION FROM ADDIS ABABA TO THE SHAH'S RATHER CASUAL PUBLIC STATEMENT MADE AFTER THE PRESIDENT'S VISIT HERE.

AFTER DELIBERATE CONSIDERATION, I HAVE DECIDED NOT RPT NOT TO INFORM THE SHAH AT THIS TIME OF OUR EFFORT TO OPEN A CHANNEL OF COMMUNICATION TO MENGISTU. IN THE FIRST PLACE, THE MESSAGE IS RATHER CRYPTIC. WE ALREADY HAVE EMBASSIES FUNCTIONING IN BOTH CAPITALS AND I WOULD BE HARD PRESSED TO EXPLAIN TO THE SHAH WHAT FURTHER ACTION THE MESSAGE IMPLIES. IN THE SECOND PLACE, OUR PURPOSE IN THIS EFFORT IS UNCLEAR AND WOULD, PERHAPS, CAUSE THE SHAH MORE CONCERN THAN IT WOULD GIVE HIM SATISFACTION.

I HAVE SIMILARLY REFRAINED FROM BRIEFING THE SHAH ON THE REPORT (REF B) OF THE FIVE-POWER MEETING IN WASHINGTON BECUASE IT DID NOT SEEM TO ME THAT THE LINES OF DIRECTION FOR SUBSEQUENT ACTION WERE ADEQUATELY CLEAR. THE VARIOUS BILATERAL APPROACHES DO NOT APPEAR TO REPRESENT TECTICAL CONSENSUS.

IN SHORT, I FEEL IT WOULD BE MORE USEFUL TO BRIEF THE SHAH WHEN I CAN PRESENT HIM WITH SOME CLEAR CONCEPTUAL VIEW OF OUR INTENTIONS NOT ONLY WITH RESPECT TO THE INITIATION OF NEGOTIATIONS, BUT ALSO WITH RESPECT TO THEIR EVENTUAL OUTCOME, BOTH IN TERMS OF A CONTEMPLATED STATUS FOR THE OGADEN AND THE ELIMINATION OF EXTRA-CONTINENTAL MILITARY PRESENCE IN ETHIOPIA.

REF TEHRAN 251 (NOTAL, SANA 182 (NOTAL SUMMARY: INFORMATION IN SANA'S REFTEL APPEARS TO SUBSTANTIATE CONTINUING IRANIAN DISTRUST OF PDRY LEADERSHIP. WHILE IRANIAN PERCEPTION AS GIVEN TO US SEEMS ESPECIALLY HARD ONE, WE WONDER WHETHER--FAILING ANY DRAMATIC NEW WESTERN INITIATIVE TO DISLODGE SOVIET INFLUENCE--THIS HARD LINE NEGATIVE READING OF PDRY LEADERSHIP IS NOT INDEED THE RIGHT OPERATIONAL ONE. END SUMMARY.

APPRECIATE SANA'S COMMENT ON QUESTION WE RAISED IN TEHRAN REFTEL. IN PARTICULAR, WE WERE IMPRESSED BY JUDGMENT REGARDING SSALIM RUBAYI ALI AND ABD AL-FATTAH ISMAIL THAT "EACH SEEMS TO FEEL STRONGLY THAT HE NEEDS THE OTHER IN ORDER TO SURVIVE," AS WELL AS CONSENSUS AMONG INFORMED OBSERVERS IN YEMEN THAT "SALIM COULD SACK ABD AL-FATTAH ANY TIME HE WANTS." THESE POINT TO A STRONG BOND AT LEAST OF NECESSITY BETWEEN THE TWO MEN AND PUTS THEIR RIVALRY MORE IN TERMS OF POLICY (AS NOTED PARA 4 SANA REFTEL) THAN OF DYNAMICS.

IF DYNAMIC TENSION EXISTS TO THAT EXTENT BETWEEN THE TWO MEN, COULD THE RELATIONSHIP NOT BE DESCRIBED MORE ACCURATELY AS A PARTNERSHIP RATHER THAN A RIVALRY? THE FURTHER QUESTION THEN ARISES AS TO HOW FAR THE "SENIOR PARTNER", SALIM RUBAYI ALI, COULD CHANGE THE DIRECTION OF FUNADMENTAL POLICY WITHOUT THE OTHER'S CONSENT.

POLCOUNS TRIED OUT SOME OF THESE IDEAS WITH DAVOUDI, HEAD OF MFA FIRST POLITICAL DEPARTMENT (WHICH HANDLES IRAQ AND THE PENINSULA COUNTRIES). DAVOUDI'S REACTION WAS TO ITERATE HIS BELIEF THAT, SINCE THE TWO MEN NEED EACH OTHER, THEIR RIVALRY IS MORE APPAENT THAN REAL. ALL LEADERS HAVE SOME DIFFERENCES AND RIVALRIES, BUT SALIM RUBAYI ALI IS NOT ABOVE PLAYING UP HIS DIFFERENCES WITH ABD AL-FATTAH ISMAIL IN ORDER TO HOODWINK POTENTIAL DONORS SUCH AS THE SAUDIS.

IN THE FINAL ANALYSIS BOTH MEN ARE DEDICATED TO CONTINUATION OF THE PRESENT RADICAL REGIME IN PDRY (WHETHER THIS BE CHARACTERIZED AS MARXIST OR OTHERWISE) AND (BECAUSE THEY NEED EACH OTHER) SALIM RUBAYI ALI CANNOT BE BOUGHT OFF INTO A CHANGE OF BASIC ORIENTATION.

FRANKLY, WE SUSPECT DAVOUDI'S IDEAD COME TO A CONSIDERABLE DEGREE FROM IRANIAN REPRESENTATIVES IN JIDDA, WHO ARE REGARDED HERE AS THE EXPERTS IN THEFIELD ON PDRY AFFAIRS. IT WOULD BE INTERESTING TO KNOW TO WHAT EXTENT THOSE REPRESENTATIVES MIGHT BE INFLUENCED BY SOME HARD LINE SAUDI CONTACTS.

IN RIEW OF THE ANALYSIS PRESENTED IN SANA'S CABLE, HOWEVER, ONE WONDERS WHETHER ANY DEGREE OF SAUDI SKILL IS LIKELY TO MOVE PDRY POLICY IN A SIGNIFICANTLY NEW DIRECTION AS LONG AS THERE HAS BEEN NO DRAMATIC PDRY BREAK WITH THE SOVIET UNION AND SALIM RUBAYI ALI'S NEED FOR ABD AL-FATTAH ISMAIL PREVENTS HIM FROM EITHER IMPOSING HIS WILL OR GETTING RID OF HIM. IT WOULD PROBABLY TAKE SOME PRETTY DRAMATIC WESTERN INITIATIVES TO GET THE CONSENT OF AN IDEOLOGIST SUCH AS ABD AL-FATTAH ISMAIL TO A RE-ORIENTATION OF POLICY AWAY FROM THE SOVIET UNION, AND ONE WONDERS HOW LONG SUCH A CHANGE WOULD LAST.
THIS WOULD APPEAR TO BE A MAJOR TASK REQUIRING MAJOR EFFORTS BY OTHERS BESIDES THE SAUDIS, AND PERHAPS MORE CONVINCING EVIDENCE THAN HAS SO FAR BEEN PRESENTED THAT THE GAME WOULD BE WORTH THE CANDLE.

1978TEHRAN00974.subject: SHAH PUBLISHES GUIDELINES FOR THE SHAH-PEOPLE REVOLUTION

segments.text: THE SHAH'S NEW BOOK, TOWARD THE GREAT CIVILIZATION, WAS RELEASED TO THE PUBLIC JANUARY 25, COINCIDING WITH THE FIFTEENTH ANNIVERSARY OF THE SHAH-PEOPLE REVOLUTION, GLOWING REVIEWS APPEARED ON FRONT PAGE OF ALL NEWSPAPERS JANUARY 26 AND TEXT OF PREFACE AND CONCLUDING, "MESSAGE TO THE IRANIAN PEOPLE", WERE REPRINTED IN ENGLIHS-LANGUAGE TEHRAN JOURNAL. (THAT PAPER ANNOUNCED IT WILL PUBLISH A SERIALIZED, UNOFFICIAL, ABRIDGED TRANSLATION OF THE 320 PAGE WORK. ARTICLES WILL BE POUCHED TO NEA/IRN AS THEY APPEAR. MINISTRY OF INFORMATION HAS INFORMED US THAT OFFICIAL TRANSLATION IS IN PREPARATION AND WILL APPEAR IN ABOUT THREE MONTHS.)

IN PREFACE SHAH STATES THAT THIS BOOK, HIS THIRD, FOLLOWS ON "MISSION FOR MY COUNTRY" (1962) WHICH WAS HISTORICAL IN NATURE AND "THE WHITE REVOLUTION" (1967) WHICH DISCUSSED THENCURRENT PROBLEMS FACING THE COUNTRY. HIS LATEST BEST-SELLER CONCERNS THE FUTURE, AND IS CONSIDERED BY THE SHAH "PART OF MY NATIONAL DUTY." WITHIN TEXT SHAH HAS PROCLAIMED CATCHY SLOGAN, "WORK, WORK, MORE WORK," A THEME HIGHLIGHTED IN NEWS HEADLINES TODAY AND INCREASINGLY STRESSED BY GOI LEADERS IN RECENT SPEECHES. SO FAR, HOWEVER, THERE IS NO INDICATION WORK ETHIC EXHORTATIONS HAVE CAUGHT IMAGINATION OF POPULACE.

IN CONCLUDING SECTION, SHAH PROVIES SELF-PERCEPTION OF HIS PRESENT POSITION WITHIN IRANIAN SOCIETY: "MY POWER ALSO, BOTH UNDER LAW AND DUE TO THE SPECIAL SPIRITUAL LINK THAT I HAVE WITH MY PEOPLE, IS AT ITS HIGHEST PEAK. ON THE OTHER HAND THIS ENTAILS FOR ME ROUND-THE-CLOCK BACK-BREAKING WORK, CONSTANT AND CONCERTED EFFORTS, INTERNATIONAL TENSIONS AND PERMANENT CONFRONTATIONS WITH PROVOCATIONS, PLOTS AND ENMITIES WHICH WOULD, MOST PROBABLY, HAVE NOT COME TO THE FURFACE OTHERWISE."

TOUCHING ON A SENSITIVE CONTEMPORARY ISSUE, THE SHAH, IN A "FITTING FINALE" TO THE CHAPTER DEALING WITH EDUCATIONAL AND CULTURAL DEVELOPMENT, STRESSES THE NEED FOR REINFOCING RELIGIOUS FAITH. HE MAKES A CLEAR DISTINCTION, HOWEVER, BETWEEN "REAL FAITH" AND "MISINTERPRETATIONS WHICH TAKE PLACE IN "THIS FIELD," NOTING THAT "THE REAL MEANING OF ISLAM IS NOT COMPATIBLE WITH BIASED INTERPRETATIONS OR THOSE DESIGNED TO MISLEAD PEOPLE AND BRACKET PROMOTE END BRACKET REACTIONARY ENDS."

COMMENT: MEANINGFUL ASSESSMENT OF SHAH'S LATEST PRONOUNCEMENT MUST AWAIT READING OF FULL TEXT. BOOK HAS BEEN CONSCIOUSLY PREPARED AS GUIDELINE FOR NATION'S FUTURE AND AS SUCH WILL BE FOCAL POINT FOR GOI LEADERSHIP AND REQUIRED READING (WORK, WORK, MORE WORK) FOR THOSE FOLLOWING DEVELOPMENTS IN IRAN.

1978TEHRAN00998.subject: DENIAL OF IRANIAN INVOLVEMENT IN OMAN-RAS AL KHAIMA DISPUTE

segments.text: ON JANUARY 29 POLCOUNS CHECKED WITH MFA DEPARTMENT HEAD DAVOUDI ASKING IN A GENERAL WAY IF OMAN-RAS AL KHAIMA DISPUTE WAS IN ANY WAY INVOLVING IRAN. DAVOUDI WAS CATEGORIC IN SAYING IT WAS NOT. HE SAID IRAN IS A BYSTANDER SO FAR.
DAVOUDI ALSO SAID AREA OF DISPUTE DID NOT APPROACH IRANIAN WATERS OR THOSE OF ABU MUSA AND TUNB ISLANDS.

POLCOUNS ALSO ASKED HEAD OF MFA LEGAL DEPARTMENT KAZEMI WITH WHAT COUNTRIES IRAN HAS CONTINENTAL SHELF MEDIAN LINE AGREEMENTS. FOR THE RECORD, KAZEMI SAID AGREEMENTS EXIST WITH SAUDI ARABIA, BAHRAIN, QATAR AND OMAN. AGREEMENTS HAVE BEEN INITIALED BUT ARE NOT IN FORCE WITH ABU DHABI AND DUBAI. IN ABU DHABI CASE BOTH SIDES ARE AWAITING OUTCOME OF ITS BOUNDARY DISPUTE WITH SAUDI ARABIA. THERE IS NO AGREEMENT WITH RAS AL KHAIMA, BUT KAZEMI WAS UNAWARE OF ANY CURRENT DISPUTE INVOLVING THAT EMIRATE. AS A GENERAL RULE, HE ADDED, MEDIAN LINE WITH ALL THESE COUNTRIES HAS BEEN DRAWN IN REGARD TO THE MAIN SHORELINE, NOT TAKING ACCOUNT OF ISLANDS.

IN VIEW OF THE ABOVE, WE WOULD BE VERY SURPRISED THAT IRANIANS WOULD HAVE EXPRESSED AN INTEREST IN WATERS AFFECTED BY OMAN-RAS AL KHAIMA DISPUTE, AND WE DO NOT SEE WHAT IRANIANS WOULD HOPE TO GAIN BY TRYING TO HIDE THEIR INVOLVEMENT IF THEY HAD. THEY ARE AWARE OF THE WAY INFORMATION RUNS LOOSE IN THIS PART OF THE WORLD AND THE PROBABILITY A CLAIM IN THE FORM OF A WRITTEN NOTE WOULD NOT REMAIN SECRET VERY LONG.

1978TEHRAN01020.subject: PROPOSED VISIT TO TEHRAN BY BEGIN

segments.text: DURING COURSE OF CONVERSATIONS ON OTHER SUBJECTS WITH SHAH MORNING JANUARY 29, HE TOLD ME THAT HE HAD FINALLY RECEIVED ISRAELI REACTION TO HIS DEMARCHE MADE JUST BEFORE JERUSALEM TALKS BROKE UP. REACTION CAME IN FORM OF PROPOSAL THAT BEGIN SHOULD COME TO TEHRAN TO EXPLAIN ISRAELI POSITION.

SHAH SAID HE HAS AGREED IN PRINCIPLE TO IDEA THAT BEGIN SHOULD COME HERE, BUT HAS STRESSED IMPORTANCE OF PRECISE AGREEMENT WITH ISRAELIS ON MANNER IN WHICH VISIT SHOULD BE HANDLED. HE SAID THAT, IF BEGIN MERELY WISHES TO PUT FORTH ARGUMENTS INFAVOR OF HIS PEACE PLAN, VISIT WILL HAVE TO BE CLANDESTINE AND DENIABLE. IF, ON OTHER HAND, BEGIN IS PREPARED TO ACCEPT PREMISES OF SHAH'S DEMARCHE, SHAH WOULD BE HAPPY TO HAVE VISIT MADE PUBLIC AND LET BEGIN ANNOUNCE HIS FLEXIBILITY FROM TEHRAN.

ALTHOUGH I DID NOT PRESS SHAH ON EXACT TERMS OF HIS DEMARCHE, IT IS CLEAR FROM EARLIER CONVERSATIONS I HAVE HAD WITH HIM THAT HE HAS ASKED BEGIN TO SACRIFICE THE "ILLEGAL" SETTLEMENTS BOTH IN SINAI AND ON WEST BANK IN ORDER TO REALIZE THE LARGER DIMENSIONS OF SADAT'S PROPOSALS, WHICH THE SHAH REGARDS AS MOST GENEROUS. HE OBVIOUSLY HAS NO RPT NO ILLUSIONS THAT BEGIN WILL ACCEPT THESE PREMISES OUT OF HAND.

SHAH SAID HIS ASSUMPTION WAS THAT BEGIN WOULD PROBABLY COME HERE SHORTLY AFTER SHAH RETURNS FROM HIS VISITS TO INDIA AND PAKISTAN (EVENING FEBRUARY 5). HE NOTED THAT SADAT WOULD BE ENGAGED IN WASHINGTON TALKS FEBRUARY 4 AND 5. HE SAID HE HOPED HE WOULD HAVE RESULTS OF THOSE TALKS IN HAND BEFORE HE MEETS WITH BEGIN. AGAIN HE CONFIRMED THAT HE WAS PREPARED TO BE HELPFUL WITH BEGIN IN ANY WAY WE CONSIDERED CONSTRUCTIVE.

ACTION REQUESTED: PLEASE PROVIDE ME WITH IMMEDIATE READ-OUT FROM SADAT TALKS FOR USE WITH SHAH. I HAVE AUDIENCE WITH HIM MONDAY, FEBRUARY 6, IN ORDER BRING LES GELB FOR SALT BRIEFING AND COULD MOST EFFECTIVELY USE THE SADAT INFORMATION AT THAT TIME, TOGETHER WITH ANY PARTICULAR POINTS YOU WISH HIM TO MAKE TO BEGIN.
REQUEST DEPARTMENT PASS THIS MESSAGE TO AMEMBASSY CAIRO AND AMEMBASSY TEL AVIV.

FROM TIME TO TIME WE HAVE REPORTED "FOR WHAT IT'S WORTH" VIEWS OF LEBANESE AMB AL-KHALIL WHO IS, AS DEPT AND BEIRUT AWARE, A MEMBER OF THE PROMINENT SOUTH LEBANESE SHIA POLITICAL FAMILY KHALIL. THIS IS ANOTHER IN THIS SERIES. IN SOMEWHAT RAMBLING DISCOURSE WITH DCM JAN 28, AL-KHALIL MADE THE FOLLOWING STATEMENTS/CLAIMS

ISRAELIS HAVE NEVER TAKEN MEANINGFUL ACTION AGAINST PLO STRONGHOLDS IN SOUTH LEBANON AND HAVE REFUSED TO COOPERATE WITH SHIAS IN DEALING WITH PALESTINIANS IN THE AREA. ISRAELI ASSISTANCE TO CHRISTIANS HAS BEEN MINIMAL AND RECENTLY CEASED ALTOGETHER. EVEN THOUGH ISRAELIS HAVE CAPABILITY TO INTERCEPT MASSIVE SHIPMENTS OF MILITARY EQUIPMENT AND MATERIEL TO PALESTINIANS THROUGH PORT OF TYRE, AND INDEED EVEN PROMISED TO DO SO, THEY HAVE DONE NOTHING. ISRAELI EXCUSE, HE SAID, IS THAT SHIPS FROM NORTH TO TYPRE HUG THE COASTLINE MAKING IT IMPOSSIBLE BY ISRAELIS TO INTERCEPT.

CONCLUSION IS THAT ISRAELIS NEITHER UNEASY OR PARTICULARLY UNHAPPY ABOUT PLO PRESENCE IN SOUTH LEBANON AND WOULD JUST AS SOON HAVE THEM THERE AS MOVED TO THE WEST BANK. THIS OF COURSE MEANS THAT SOUTH LEBANON WILL CONTINUE TO BE AN AREA OF TURBULENCE AND IT WILL SLOW IF NOT PREVENT RESTORATION OF LEBANON'S NATIONAL INTEGRITY.

STORY THAT SYRIA IS DISCOMFORTED BY ITS ALLEGED NEED TO REMAIN IN LEBANON IS A CANARD. SYRIA WANTS TO CONTINUE ITS PRESENCE IN LEBANON IN ORDER TO MAINTAIN ITS ABILITY TO INFLUENCE THE COURSE OF LEBANESE AFFAIRS. IT ALSO FINDS IT CONVENIENT MEANS OF DISTRCATING SYRIAN PUBLIC ATTENTION AWAY FROM INTERNAL SYRIAN PROBLEMS. COST OF MAINTAINING TROOPS IN LEBANON AND THEIR ALLEGED CORRUPTION THROUGH EXPOSURE TO BEIRUT'S BRIGHT LIGHTS IS SMALL PRICE TO PAY FOR THESE ADVANTAGES.

CONTRARY TO SOME REPORTS IN ARAB WORLD, IRAQI TROOPS ARE IN FACT IN SOUTH LEBANON WORKING CLOSELY WITH THE PLO. THEY HAVE BEEN INFILTRATED IN CIVILIAN GARB WITH SYRIAN KNOWLEDGE AND ACQUIESCENCE. AL-KHALIL SAID THAT HE KNOWS THIS TO BE A FACT BECAUSE OF REPORTS HE HAS RECEIVED FROM PEOPLE CLOSE TO HIS FAMILY WHO ARE EASILY ABLE TO IDENTIFY IRAQIS WHO DEAL WITH LOCAL INHABITANTS IN THE MARKET PLACE AND IN OTHER MATTERS OF DAILY ROUTINE.
SYRIA GOT PALESTINIANS TO GO ALONG WITH THE SHTAURA AGREEMENT BECAUSE IT HAD ASSURED THEM IN ADVANCE THAT IT WOULD NEVER BE IMPLEMENTED.

AL-KHALIL REITERATED THEME THAT HE HAS ADVANCED FOR LAST 2 YEARS THAT SHIA OF SOUTH LEBANON SHOULD BE GIVEN MILITARY MEANS TO DEAL WITH PALESTINIANS IN SOUTH LEBANON. HE SAID SHIA HAD A CAUSE BECAUSE OF TREATMENT THEY HAD RECEIVED AT PALESTINIAN HANDS AND HE EXPRESSED GREAT CONFIDENCE THAT PALESTINIANS COULD BE CRUSHED. THIS, IN HIS VIEW, WOULD HAVE BENEFICIAL EFFECTS IN DEALING WITH LARGER PALESTINIAN PROBLEM AND CURRENT MIDEAST PEACE EFFORTS.

NOTWITHSTANDING HIS PESSIMISM OVER SITUATION IN SOUTH LEBANON, AL-KHALIL THOUGHT THAT PRES SADAT'S PEACE EFFORTS HAVE SOME PROSPECT OF SUCCEEDING PROVIDED OF COURSE US MAKES ISRAEL UNDERSTAND IT MUST MEET THE TERMS OF UN RESES 242 AND 338 AND "ACCEPT LEGITIMATE RIGHTS OF PALESTINIAN PEOPLE".

ASSUME SUBJECT IS NUCLEAR ENERGY LEGISLATION PACKAGE RELEVANT TO US-IRAN NUCLEAR COOPERATION AGREEMENT, AND THAT "NON-PROLIFERATION" LABEL IN REFTEL IS SHORT FORM WAY OF DESCRIBING IT. IF THAT NOT THE CASE, WOULD APPRECIATE BRIEF DESCRIPTION OF S.897.

JAN 26 15TH ANNIVERSARY OF SHAH-PEOPLE REVOLUTION (6TH OF BAHMAN) WAS CELEBRATED IN SURPRISINGLY PACIFIC AND WIDESPREAD FASHION AND OPPOSITION DISTURBANCES WHICH SOME PROJECTED FAILED TO MATERIALIZE.

SEVERAL MILLION PEOPLE MARCHED PAST PICTURES OF SHAH IN TEHRAN AND VARIOUS CITIES TO CELEBRATE "WHITE REVOLUTION". DESPITE DRIZZLE IN TEHRAN, SOME 300,000 TURNED OUT ON WELLORGANIZED "HOLIDAY", AIDED BY GOVT-ORGANIZED TRANSPORTATON. TEHRAN OBSERVERS AND REPORTS FROM MAIN PROVINCIAL TOWNS INDICATE CEREMONIES PASSED WITHOUT INCIDENT: NUMBERS OF PEOPLE INVOLVED SEEMED SLIGHTLY GREATER THAN LAST YEAR. THOUGH SECURITY POLICE HAD EXPECTED SOME OPPOSITION MANIFESTATIONS, ONLY SIGN OF ANTI-GOVT FEELING WERE A FEW SIGNS MAKING OBLIQUE REFERENCES TO RETURN TO "CONSTITUTIONAL" RULE, PRESUMABLY REFERRING TO OPPOSITIONIST DEMANDS THAT SHAH RETURN TO LETTER OF 1906 CONSTITUTION.

MEDIA PLAYED EVENT STRAIGHT, WITH EMPHASIS ON NUMBER OF WOMEN MARCHING AND FACT THAT ALL GROUPS IN SOCIETY WERE REPRESENTED. TONE WAS ONE OF SATISFACTION AT ACCOMPLISHMENTS OF PAST DECADE AND A HALF AND RHETORIC (BRIEF) WAS VITAGE BOILERPLATE, PRESUMABLY TO AVOID TAKING LUSTRE OF RELEASE OF SHAH'S NEW BOOK AND ANNIVERSARY MESSAGE: WORK, WORK, AND MORE WORK (REFTEL).
REF STATE 22371

WHILE YOU ARE OBVIOUSLY BETTER PLACED THAN WE TO JUDGE WHETHER IRANIAN REDRAFT OF PROPOSED NUCLEAR COOPERATION AGREEMENT MEETS CURRENT OR ANTICIPATED US LEGAL REQUIREMENTS, WE ARE CONCERNED THAT THERE BE NO DEVIATION ON EITHER SIDE FROM WHAT WAS AGREED AND UNDERSTOOD BETWEEN THE TWO CHIEFS OF STATE. MORE SPECIFICALLY, THE SHAH WAS TOLD BY THE PRESIDENT AND BY SECRETARY VANCE THAT IRAN WOULD BE ACCORDED MOST FAVORED NATION STATUS IN OUR AGREEMENT. THIS COMMITMENT, TO OUR KNOWLEDGE, WAS NOT QUALIFIED NOR WAS IT INDICATED THAT IT WOULD BE SUBJECT TO SELECTIVE INTERPRETATION.
REFTEL PARAS 5B AND 5E SUGGEST THAT WE MAY BE TAKING A POSITION CONTRARY TO WHAT THE SHAH UNDERSTOOD.

WE SHARE YOUR VIEW THAT THE AEOI MAY BE ATTEMPTING TO OBTAIN ADDITIONAL US FLEXIBILITY AT THE MARGINS, AND IN THE CASE OF SEPARATED PLUTONIUM MAY BE SEEKING AN ARRANGEMENT THAT GOES BEYOND THE "AGREEMENT IN PRINCIPLE" REACHED AT THE SUMMIT. BEFORE WE CONSIDER ANOTHER HIGH LEVEL DEMARCHE, HOWEVER, WE WOULD WANT TO BE SURE IN VERY SPECIFIC CONCRETE TERMS HOW AND IN WHAT WAY IRANIAN POSITION DIFFERS FROM THE "AGREEMENT IN PRINCIPLE." PRESUMABLY YOU WILL WISH TO DEFER FORMULATING YOUR RESPONSE WHICH COULD BECOME THE SUBSTANCE OF ANY SUCH DEMARCHE UNTIL YOU HAVE HAD AN OPPORTUNITY TO REVIEW THE QUESTION WITH MANZOUR.

HE HAS TOLD US THAT HE CAN ARRIVE IN WASHINGTON FEBRUARY 15 AND SPEND AT LEAST THE 16TH AND 17TH GOING OVER THESE AND ANY OTHER QUESTIONS WITH YOU. WE HAVE NOT REPEAT NOT DISCUSSED ANY OF THE POINTS RAISED IN PARA 5 OF REFTEL WITH HIM.

PLEASE ADVISE WHETHER THE TIME HE SUGGESTS IS ACCEPTABLE TO YOU AND WHETHER ON THE BASIS OF FURTHER ANALYSIS OF THE IRANIAN REDRAFT AND OUR FOREGOING COMMENTS YOU WISH US TO DISCUSS ANY PARTICULAR POINTS WITH HIM PRIOR TO YOUR MEETING.

THE MILITARY PROSECUTOR'S OFFICE ANNOUNCED ON JANUARY 29 THAT THE SHAH HAS "ISSUED ORDERS FOR THE POSTPONEMENT OF THE EXECUTION" OF CONVICTED SOVIET SPY ALI NAQI RABBANI QUJDEH. ANNOUNCEMENT, CARRIED ON FRONT PAGES OF LOCAL PRESS, DID NOT PROVIDE REASON FOR POSTPONENENT OR REVEAL IF DELAY AMOUNTS IN FACT TO COMMUTATION OF SENTENCE. QUJDEH'S DEATH SENTENCE WAS UPHELD BY MILITARY COURT OF APPEALS ON JAN 15. UNDER IRANIAN LAW, UNLESS COMMUTED BY THE SHAH, SENTENCE SHOULD HAVE BEEN CARRIED OUT WITHIN TEN DAYS OF DECISION; JANUARY 25 PASSED, HOWEVER, WITHOUT ANNOUNCEMENT OF QUJDEH'S FATE.

COMMENT: THIS ACTION BY SHAH IS SOMEWHAT UNEXPECTED GIVEN SWIFT EXECUTION OF MAJOR GENERAL MOGHARABI IN EARLIER SOVIET SPY CASE. ALTHOUGH OUR INFORMATION IN THIS INSTANCE IS LIMITED, WE BELIEVE THAT TWO INTERPRETTATIONS ARE POSSIBLE. PERHAPS QUJDEH HAS BEEN REWARDED FOR COOPERATION WITH GOI AUTHORITIES (JOURNAL DE TEHRAN ARTICLE TODAY STATES THAT QUJDEH HAS ADMITTED THE SPY CHARGES AND HAS REVEALED THE NAMES OF FOURTEEN FOREIGNERS TO WHOM HE GAVE DOCUMENTATION). ALTERNATIVELY (OR IN ADDITION), THE SHAH PLANS EVENTUALLY TO COMMUTE THE SENTENCE AND PRESENT A COMPASSIONATE PUBLIC IMAGE ABROAD IN ATTEMPT TO COUNTER CRITICISM IN FIELD OF HUMAN RIGHTS.

1978TEHRAN01059.subject: FRENCH INTEREST IN US-IRAN NUCLEAR REACTOR AGREEMENT

segments.text: REF A. 77 PARIS 31778 B. 77 TEHRAN 9756 C. PARIS 2536
IN CONNECTION WITH ANY INFORMATION WE MIGHT PASS TO FRENCH ON U.S.-IRAN NUCLEAR REACTOR AGREEMENT, REQUEST LOUET BE ASKED AGAIN TO CLARIFY ONE KEY POINT IN FRENCH-IRAN AGREEMENT.
ADDRESSEES WILL RECALL THAT OOUET TOLD EMBASSY PARIS "IRAN HAS THE UNILATERAL RIGHT TO REPROCESS IN IRAN" (PARA 3 REFTEL A). FRENCH CHARGE HERE TOLD AMBASSADOR JUST THE OPPOSITE (REFTEL B).

1978TEHRAN01070.subject: PROPOSED PUBLIC AFFAIRS ENGAGEMENTS FOR AMB SULLIVAN

segments.text: GREATLY APPRECIATE PROPOSED ARRANGEMENTS FOR MY PARTICIPATION IN PUBLIC AFFAIRS EVENTS IN EARLY MARCH. GENERAL SCHEDULE AS OUTLINED APPEARS SATISFACTORY. DETAILED COMMENTS FOLLOW.

DO NOT REPEAT NOT CONSIDER IT PRUDENT TO ACCEPT MARIN COUNTRY WORLD AFFAIRS COUNCIL ENGAGEMENT EVENING MARCH 1. THERE WILL INEVITABLY BE LOOSE ENDS RESULTING FROM US-IRAN JOINT COMMISSION MEETING WHICH WILL ENCUMBER ME IN WASHINGTON MOST OF MARCH 1. THEREFORE, I BELIEVE EARLIEST UNDERTAKING SHOULD BE SAN FRANCISCO MARCH 2. THEREE EVENTS PROPOSED THAT DAY APPEAR SATISFACTORY.

PROGRAMS FOR LOS ANGELES MARCH 3 AND FORHOUSTON MARCH 6 ARE SATISFACTORY. PRESS CONFERENCE AT HOTEL WULD APPEAR MORE FEASIBLE DURING WORKDAY MONDAY, MARCH 6 RATHER THAN UPON MY ARRIVAL EVENING SUNDAY, MARCH 5. I HAVE NO BURNING DESIRE FOR LUNCHEON WITH IRANIAN CONSUL GENERAL, AND WOULD PREFER AVOID FORMAL LUNCH ARRANGEMENT.
ADDITIONAL MEDIA ARRANGEMENTS, SUCH AS EDITORIAL BACKGROUNDERS, ARE ACCEPTABLE, BUT CARE SOULD BE TAKEN TO AVOID OVERLY CONGESTED SCHEDULE, AS WELL AS OVER-EXPOSURE.

TRAVEL SXHEDULE GENERALLY ACCEPTABLE. MARCH 1 FROM WASHINGTON TO SAN FRANCISCO SHOULD BE EVENING FLIGHT (CLUSTER OF PLANES LEAVE IN 5 TO 5:45 PM TIME FRAME). IN VIEW EVENING ENGAGEMENT SAN FRANCISCO MARCH 2, THERE IS QUESTION WHETHER EVENING FLIGTH TO LOS ANGELES IS FEASIBLE. EITHER LATE NIGHT OR EARLY MORNING FLIGHT SEEMS INDICATED. LOS ANGELES-HOUSTON AND HOUSTON-WASHINGTON TIMES SEEM SATISFACTORY.

AS FAR AS HOTELS AND GROUND TRANSPORTATIN ARE CONCERNED, THEY WOULD APPEAR TO DEPEND TO SOME EXTENT ON ARRANGEMENTS WITH SPONSORS. IF I AM TO BE MET BY SPONSORS WITH VEHICLES AT ALL PORTS OF CALL, THIS WOULD MAKE LIFE EASIER. IF SPONSORS ARE PICKING UP HOTEL TABS, I LEAVE CHOICES TO THEM. IN SAN FRANCISCO, I NORMALLY USE THE DOWNTOWN OR THE AIRPORT HYATT. IN LOS ANGELES, I USUALLY USE THE CENTRURY PLAZA. IN HOUSTON, I WILL TAKE THE CUT-RATE SUITE IF SPONSORS PREFER. OTHERWISE, I CAN USUALLY FIT INTO NORMAL HOTEL ROOM.

GIVEN INEVITABLE IRANIAN STUDENT REACTION TO EVENTS INVOLVING ESTABLISHMENT ASSOCIATIONS WITH IRAN, I TRUST SY AND SPONSORS ARE ALERTED TO POSSIBLE DEMONSTRATIONS, DISRUPTIONS, ETC. THEY USUALLY GET MOST OF THE TV COVERAGE.
MINISTER YEGANEH WOULD BE DELIGHTED TO MEET WITH SECRETARY BLUMENTHAL AND UNDER SECRETARY COOPER. SUGGEST APPOINTMENTS FOR MORNING OF FEBRUARY 27, AS HE ALREADY HAS ENGAGEMENTS FOR AFTERNOON.

ENGLISH-LANGUAGE AND FARSI PRESS ON JAN. 31 PROMINENTLY FEATURED WARNING BY IRANIAN AMBASSADOR TO KENYA THAT GOI COULD NOT REMAIN INDIFFERENT IF SOMALIA WERE "ATTACKED AND INVADED WITHIN ITS INTERNATIONALLY RECOGNIZED BORDERS". ACCORDING TO THE PRESS, AMBASSADOR SAID IRAN WAS TRYING TO HELP BUILD UP MOMENTUM FOR A PEACEFUL SOLUTION OF THE DISPUTE.

COMMENT: GOI FOREIGN MINISTER AT LUNCH FOR FOREIGN CORRESPONDENTS JAN. 28 CAUTIONED GROUP RE SHAH'S STATEMENT ON INVIOLABILITY OF SOMALIAN BORDERS (REF A) SAYING THAT SHAH DID NOT MEAN IRAN WOULD SEND TROOPS TO THE AREA. AS WE MENTIONED IN OUR REFTEL B, FOREIGN MINISTER DID NOT EXPLICITLY RULE OUT OTHER FORMS OF ASSISTANCE WHICH, HE SAID, IS AT PRESENT CONFINED TO HUMANITARIAN AID THROUGH IRANIAN RED CROSS AFFILIATE.

INCIDENTALLY, MFA CHIEF SPOKESMAN ADL TOLD POLCOUNS JAN. 31 THAT REPORTERS ARE PESTERING HIM TO GET MORE EXACT DEFINITION OF WHAT WOULD CONSITUTE ETHIOPIAN ATTACK ACROSS INTERNATIONAL BORDER, E.G. WOULD THIS INCLUDE AIR RAIDS? POLCOUNS RECOMMENDED HE BORROW A PAGE FROM OUR OWN STATE DEPT PRACTICE AND SIMPLY REFUSE COMMENT ON HYPOTHETICAL QUESTIONS....STILL, THIS MIGHT EXPLAIN LATEST PHRASING OF IRANIAN WARNING (ABOVE) WHICH NOW READS "ATTACKED AND INVADED" RATHER THAN JUST "ATTACKED."

FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY PRESENTED THE FOLLOWING THREE NEWLY APPOINTED AMBASSADORS TO THE SHAH DURING AN AUDIENCE JANUARY 26. SUCH A PRESENTATION CEREMONY SERVES AS COMFIRMATION OF THE THREE CAREER DIPLOMATS IN THEIR NEW RESPONSIBILITIES.

BAHRAM BAHRAMI, 53, NEWLY APPOINTED AMBASSADOR TO FRANCE, GRADUATED FROM TEHRAN UNIVERSITY IN POLITICAL AND SOCIAL SCIENCE AND SOCIOLOGY. HE JOINED THE GOVERNMENT IN 1946 IN WHAT WAS THEN THE MINISTRY OF ART AND INDUSTRY, TRANSFERRING TO MFA IN 1953. IN LATTER DEPARTMENT HE HAS SERVED AS STAFF AIDE TO THE DEPUTY FOREIGN MINISTER AND FOREIGN MINISTER; CHIEF OF THE CULTURAL RELATIONS DEPARTMENT; DIRECTOR GENERAL OF THE SECRETARIAT; CHIEF OF PROTOCOL; AND UNDERSECRETARY FOR FINANCIAL AND ADMINISTRATIVE AFFAIRS. ABROAD HE HAS SERVED IN LONDON, BERN AND HAS RECENTLY RETURNED FROM TWO YEARS SERVICE AS AMBASSADOR TO EGYPT. HE SPEAKS FRENCH AND ENGLISH.
ACCORDING TO A LOCAL ROMANIAN DIPLOMAT, BAHRAMI'S WIFE IS OF TURKISH STOCK, BORN IN ROMANIA, AND SPEAKS FLUENT ROMANIAN.

MOHAMMAD ALI MOSHIRI-HAMEDANI, 56, ASSIGNED AS AMBASSADOR TO ROMANIA, HAS A POST GRADUATE DEGREE IN POLITICAL SCIENCE FROM TEHRAN UNIVERSITY. MOSHIRI HAS HAD AN EXTENSIVE OVERSEAS CAREER, SERVING IN WASHINGTON (1955-57); BRUSSELS (FOUR YEARS); NEW DEHLI (ONE YEAR; ROME (ONE AND HAF YEARS); ISLAMABAD (MINISTER, THREE AND HALF YEARS); AND QUETTA, PAKISTAN (CONSUL GENERAL, ONE AND HALF YEARS). HE RETURNED TO TEHRAN IN 1975 TO ASSUME DUTY AS HEAD OF THE EASTERN EUROPEAN DEPARTMENT, MFA. IN 1975 HE ALSO SERVED BRIEFLY AS OIC OF ICCS AFFAIRS AND ACTING CHIEF OF THE CULTURAL RELATIONS DIVISION.

HE CONSIDERS HIMSELF AN EXPERT ON THE HISTORY AND CULTURE OF PAKISTAN AND IS CONSIDERED A PAKOPHILE. EMBOFFS HAVE FOUND MOSHIRI A FREIENDLY, RATHER COURTLY CONTACT WHO IS MORE RESPONSIVE TO OUR REQUESTS THAN IS NORAMALLY THE CASE WITH MFA PERSONNEL BELOW THE MINISTERIAL LEVEL. A THOUGHTFUL, STUDIOUS MAN, HE IS INTERESTED IN "EXCHANGING" INFORMATION WITH AMERICANS, EVEN IF THE "EXCHANGE IS OFTEN ONE-SIDED DUE TO THE SHORTAGE OF INFORMATION AVAILABLE TO IRANIAN DIPLOMATS IN GENERAL. HE IS MARRIED AND SPEAKS FLUENT BUT ACCENTED ENGLISH, EXCELLENT FRENCH.
MOSHIRI ACCOMPANIED THE SHAH AND EMPRESS ON THEIR OFFICIAL VISITS TO POLAND AND CZECHOSLOVAKIA IN AUGUST 1977, AND HAS VISITED ROMANIA ACCOMPANYING FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY RECENTLY.

ABBAS NAYYERI, 52, APPOINTED AMBASSADOR TO EGYPT, HAS A DEGREE IN JUDICIAL LAW FROM TEHRAN UNIVERSITY AND A PH.D. IN INTERNATIONAL LAW FROM THE UNIVERSITY OF PARIS (1957). HE JOINED THE MAF IN 1947 SERVING INITIALLY IN THE ARCHIVES DEPARTMENT, MOVING TO PROTOCOL IN 1948. LATER ASSIGNMENTS INCLUDE: INTERNATIONAL RELATIONS, 1953; HEAD, DEPARTMENT OF ECONOMIC AFFAIRS, 1957-61; ACTING DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR ECONOMICS AND INTERNATIONAL AFFAIRS, 1971. OVERSEAS HE HAS SERVED AT BRUSSELS (1952-1957); COUNSELOR AND MINISTER, LONDON (1962-67); AMBASSADOR TO MOROCCO (1972-76). HE HAS MOST RECENTLY BEEN DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR ASIAN AND AFRICAN POLITICAL AFFAIRS. HE WAS MARRIED IN 1957 AND SPEAKS ENGLISH AND FRENCH.

RANK CONSCIOUS, NAYYERI PREFERS TO TALK TO OFFICIALS BELOW THE RANK OF AMBASSADOR AT SOCIAL FUNCTIONS RATHER THAN RECEIVING THEM FORMALLY IN HIS OFFICE. THE AMBASSADOR AND DCM HAVE GENERALLY FOUND HIM HELPFUL AND QUITE WELL-INFORMED. LOWER-RANKING EMBASSY OFFICERS HAVE ALSO FOUND HIM CORDIAL AND WILLING TO BE HELPFUL, BUT HAVE ON OCCASION BEEN MISLED BY INACCURATE OR EXAGGERATED INFORMMATION FROM HIM.
REF STATE 11044, TEHRAN 1051

JOINT PRESENTATION WAS MADE BY POLCOUNS TOGETHER WITH FORST COUSELORS OF GERMAN, DUTCH AND JAPANESE EMBASSIES TO MFA DIRECTOR GENERRL FOR INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATION AFFAIRS SADIGH-ESFANDIARI FEBRUARY 1. EACH REPRESENTATIVE MADE SOME POINTS FROM HIS OWN SET OF INSTRUCTIONS INDICATING HIS GOVERNMENT'S STRONG INTEREST IN PUSHING ALONG WITH ENLARGEMENT OF CONTACT GROUP FOR THE IMMEDIATE PURPOSE OF GETTING ALL NATIONS TO ADHERE TO THE ANTI-HIJACKING CONVENTIONS. SADIGHESFANDIARI INDICATED HE WOULD REPORT DEMARCHE, ALONG WITH TALKING POINTS PROVIDED BY THE DEPARTMENT (REFTEL) WHICH WE LEFT WITH HIM.
ON PERSONAL BASIS HIS PRELIMINARY REACTION WAS THAT HIS GOVERNMENT WELCOMES THIS MOVE AND, IN KEEPING WITH PAST GOI POLICY, WOULD EXPECT TO ACCEPT THE INVITATION. HE WILL GIVE A FORMAL REACTION SOON.

MANZOUR WILL ARRIVE VIENNA NOON FEBRUARY 19 AND CAN MEET WITH YOU THAT AFTERNOON AND FOLLOWING DAY. HE UNDERSTANDS IAEA MEETING NOT SCHEDULED TO OPEN UNTIL OF FEB 21 SO YOU SHOULD HAVE SUFFICIENT TIME BEFORE HAND.

SINCE I WILL NOT BE ABLE TO MEET WITH YOU PRIOR TO THE BEGINNING OF TUESDAY'S PLENARY SESSION AND THE QUESTION OF WORKING GROUPS MAY ARISE DURING THAT MEETING, I OFFER THE FOLLOWING AS MY PERSONNEL SUGGESTIONS ON THE NUMBER AND COMPOSITION OF WORKING GROUPS DURING THIS ROUND. DUE TO THE NEED FOR INTERPRETERS NO MORE THAN TWO GROUPS COULD MEET AT THE SAME TIME.

MEETINGS OF A US-SOVIET DRAFTING GOUP COULD TAKE PLACE EVERY ALTERNATE DAY AND WOULD BEGIN THE PROCESS OF AGREEING ON A JOINT DRAFT TEXT WITH BRACKETED LANGUAGE WHERE NECESSARY. I SUGGEST THE US SIDE BE HEADED BY JOHN NEWHOUSE AND ALSO INCLUDE GORMAN, ARIETTI, KINNEY, AND MCCALL.

I SEE OUR EFFORT TO GET SOVIET AGREEMENT ON THE DEFINITION OF A ROUTINE PORT CALL AS A MAJOR US GOAL DURING THE ROUND. AFTER WE HAVE MADE OUR PRESENTATION ON A DEFINITION OF A ROUTINE PORT CALL DURING A PLENARY SESSION, THE US SHOULD SUGGEST AN EXPERTS GROUP TO REACH AGREEMENT ON THIS POINT. I SUGGEST THE GOUP BEHEADED BY LYNN DAVIS (WITH SICK AS ALTERNATE HEAD) AND ALSO INCLUDE HIBBITS, KINNEY, ARIETTI, AND TWOMBLY.

ANOTHER EXPERTS GROUP WOULD CONSIDER ISSUES RELATED TO NAVAL FORCES SUCH AS THE DEFINITION OF TRANSIT, AUXILIARY SHIPS, AND PROCEDURES FOR INVOKING A FORCE MAJEURE EXCEPTION. I SUGGEST THAT THIS GROUP BE HEADED BY ADMIRAL BAYNE AND ALSO INCLUDE PAKRADOONI, TWOMBLY, MCNAMARA, AND HIBBITS.

THE SOVIETS MAY ALSO PROPOSE AN EXPERTS GROUP ON THE DEFINITION OF THE AREA. HOWEVER, SINCE THE US POSITION IS BASED ON POLITICAL NOT TECHNICAL CONSIDERATIONS, I DO NOT BELIEVE THIS WOULD BE USEFUL. REGARDS, GELB.

1978TEHRAN01267.subject: KURDS: BARZANI FORCES FEELING THE SQUEEZE

segments.text: REF TEHRAN 1222 SUMMARY: KURDISH DEMOCRATIC PARTY (KDP) REPRESENTATIVE ALISULAIMAN BRIEFED EMBOFF ON KURDISH REBEL SITUATION IN IRAQ, WHICH IS WORSENING FOR KDP FORCES, HE SUGGESTED TALABANI GROUP HAS MADE, OR IS IN PROVESS OF MAKING, DEAL WITH IRAQI GOVERNMENT TO DESTROY BARZANI FORCES. SOURCE SAID SYRIANS ARE AIDING TALABANI FORCES WITH SUBSTANTIAL WEAPONS DELIVERIES AND APPEALED OBLIQUELY FOR U.S. HELP, NOTING BARZANI HAD RECEIVED SAUDI HELP IN PAST AND MIGHT BE ASKING FOR MORE. AS AND IF KDP SITUATION GETS WORSE, WE MAY EXPECT MORE PLEAS FOR SUPPORT, BOTH IN TEHRAN AND WASHINGTON. END SUMMARY.

AT HIS OWN REQUEST KDP REP ALI-SULAIMAN CALLED ON POLOFF STEMPEL TO MAKE PLEA FOR CONTINUED U.S. REFUGEE PROGRAM FOR KURDS (SEE REFTEL). HE ALSO MADE POINT OF EXPLAINING CURRENT KDP "SITUATION" AS SEEN BY IDRIS BARZANI AND OTHER KDP LEADERS HERE

ALI-SULAIMAN SAID TALABANI GROUP WAS NOW VERY ACTIVE MILITARILY WITHIN IRAQ AND HAD EVEN BEEN ATTACKING AND CAPTURING ISOLATED KDP GROUPS. SITUATION WAS BAD, BECAUSE GOI STILL ADAMANT ABOUT NOT LETTING KURDS CROSS BORDER FROM IRAN TO HELP THEIR BRETHREN. MOREOVER, GOI CONTINUES TO INSIST THAT ISRIS BARZANI MINIMIZE HIS CROSSBORDER CONTACTS.

KDP REP WENT ON TO SAY THAT BARZANI GROUP HAS EVIDENCE TALABANI AND MAHMOUD ALI OSMAN AND ALI ASCARI HAVE MADE A DEAL AMONG THEMSELVES TO WORK OUT A PARTIAL SETTLEMENT WITH IRAQI GOVERNMENT AT BARZANI'S EXPENSE TO GIVE THEMSELVES FULL CONTROL OF KURDISH REBEL MOVEMENT. KDP IS UPSET BY THIS, BECAUSE SYRIANS AND "PROBABLY" SOVIETS ARE GIVING SUBSTANTIAL WEAPONS HELP TO TALABANI. WHEN QUERIED WHAT KIND, ALI-SULAIMAN REPLIED SMALL ARMS AND MORTARS FOR CERTAIN, PERHAPS HEAVIER ARTILLERY ITEMS AS WELL. HE SAID KDP TRYING TO CONVINCE IRANIANS THAT TALABANI SEEKING DOMINATION OF KURDISH REBEL MOVEMENT WITH EYE TO FOMENTING TROUBLE IN IRAN LATER.
EMBASSY COMMENT: WE HAVE NO WAY OF CONFIRMING ABOVE, BUT SUGGESTION OF HOSTILE SQUEEZE PLAY ON BARZANI FORCES WELL WITHIN REALM OF POSSIBILITY AND IS CONSISTENT WITH PREVIOUS INTRAJURDISH BICKERING.

ALI-SULAIMAN IN PASSING COMMENT ON REFUGEE QUESTION SAID THAT GENRAL BARZANI HAD GOTTEN "ABOUT A MILLION" DOLLARS FROM SAUDIS ON A ONE-SHOT DEAL IN 1974 AND WAS GIVING SERIOUS CONSIDERATION TO ASKING THEM FOR SECOND TRANSFUSION WITH PART OF MONEY TO GO FOR HELPING REFUGEES GET RESETTLED AND REST TO SUPPORT KDP MOVEMENT, WHICH SAGGING A BIT UNDER NEW IRANIAN STRICTURES AND BATTLEFIELD REVERSES IN IRAQ.

ALI-SULAIMAN CLOSED HIS REVIEW OF KURDISH POSITION WITH COMMENT HE HAD BEEN ASKED TO RELAY TO US BY IDRIS BARZANI: "IF THERE IS ANY POSSIBILITY FOR CHANGING THE SITUATION IN IRAQ, NOW IS THE TIME TO ACT". EMBOFF INDICATED U.S. POLICY TOWARD KURDS WAS RESTRICTED TO HELPING WITH REFUGEE SITUATION AND WOULD PROBABLY CONTINUE THAT WAY, BUT SAID STATEMENT WOULD BE REPORTED. CONTINUING AS IF HE HAD NOT HEARD, ALI-SULAIMAN SAID KDP COULD USE SOME HELP, "SINCE LEFTISTS SEEM TO BE GETTING PLENTY OF SUPPORT FROM THE SOVIET UNION".

THOUGH EMBOFF GAVE NO ENCOURAGEMENT TO KDP REP'S ENTREATIES, PRESENT SITUATION OF BARZANI FORCES, PLUS HISTORIC U.S. SYMPATHY FOR KURDS ESPECIALLY IN 1973-75 PERIOD, SUGGEST THAT KDP MAY STEP UP APPROACH TO USG IN VARIETY OF WAYS, PARTICULARLY IF GROUP'S FORTUNES WITHIN IRAQ TAKE DEFINITE TURN FOR THE WORSE. ALISULAIMAN HINTED AT SAME THING WHEN HE REFERRED ON TWO OCCASIONS TO GROWING KDP EFFORTS IN U.S., PARTICULARLY WITH CONGRESS.

1978TEHRAN01277.subject: ADDOU CALL ON THE DEPUTY SECRETARY

segments.text: REF STATE 30677

WELCOME CLEAR OUTLINE OF CONCEPTS WHICH MIGHT BE AGREED ON EVEN BEFORE ACTUAL SOMALI-ETHIOPIAN NEGOTIATIONS AS STATED BY DEPUTY SECRETARY IN REFTEL PARA 6 AND AGAIN SUMMARIZED PARA 9 REFTEL. KNOW GOI WILL ALSO BE INTERESTED AND REQUEST WE BE AUTHORIZED TO BRIEF THEM ON OUR POSITION.

IF DEPARTMENT AUTHORIZES US TO BRIEF THEM, WOULD APPRECIATE SHORT EXPLANATION OF WHAT IS INVOLVED IN CONCEPT OF NEGOTIATING "A DEFINITIVE BORDER BETWEEN ETHIOPIA AND SOMALIA TO REPLACE PRESENT PROVISIONAL ADMINISTRATIVE LINE." SULLIVAN *** Current Handling Restrictions *** n/a *** Current Classification *** CONFIDENTIAL

SHAH TOLD ME FEBRUARY 6 THAT BEGIN VISIT TO TEHRAN WAS NOW SCHEDULED TO TAKE PLACE EARLY NEXT WEEK. HE SAID HE HOPED TO HAVE REPORTS OF SADAT VISIT TO WASHINGTON BEFORE THAT. HE ADDED THAT HE TRUSTED IT WOULD BE "GOOD NEWS".
THIS INDICATES THAT READOUT ON SADAT VISIT PLUS U.S. SUGGESTIONS FOR IRANIAN DISCUSSIONS WITH BEGIN SHOULD ARRIVE TEHRAN NO LATER THAN THIS WEEKEND IF I AM TO ARRANGE AUDIENCE PRIOR BEGIN VISIT.

1978TEHRAN01354.subject: YEGANEH BILATERALS WITH VANCE, BLUMENTHAL, AND COOPER

segments.text: FOR YEGANEH'S BILATERAL WITH SECY, AMB SUGGESTS FOLLOWING 3 TOPICS: A. NORTHSOUTH DIALOGUE, B. IRAN'S OIL PRICE POLICY AFTER 1978, AND C. A BRIEF MENTION BY SECY OF FORD'S MANUFACTURING PROPOSAL FOR IRAN. FYI: WE UNDERSTAND THAT FORD WILL SEEK APPOINTMENT WITH YEGANEH IN WASHINGTON, POSSIBLY FEBRUARY 27, TO MAKE PRESENTATION OF ITS JOINT VENTURE PROPOSAL.

FOR BLUMENTHAL---YEGANEH BILATERAL WE SUGGEST: A. THE DOLLAR IN WORLD TRADE AND FINANCING, B. RECENT US TAX RULINGS AFFECTING AMERICAN CITIZENS AND COMPANIES DOING BUSINESS IN IRAN, AND C. WITTEVEEN FACILITY.

AS IRANIANS HAVE ASKED WHAT TO EXPECT IN YEGANEH'S BILATERALS WITH VANCE, BLUMENTHAL AND COOPER, WE WOULD APPRECIATE GUIDANCE AS TO SUBJECTS THAT MAY COME UP. EMB WILL CONTINUE TO EXPLORE POSSIBLE DISCUSSION TOPICS WITH GOI AND WILL KEEP YOU INFORMED.
RE PARA 2 REFTEL, SUGGEST THAT YOU NOT REPEAT NOT ALERT MC NAMARA TO POSSIBLE MEETING WITH YEGANEH ON WORLD BANK STUDY IDEA. WE MAY HAVE FURTHER THOUGHTS ON THIS WITHIN A FEW DAYS.
FYI: REGARDING MEETINGS FEB 27, YEGANEH'S OFFICE ADVISES THAT IRANIAN EMB IN WASHINGTON IS COORDINATING HIS SCHEDULE, THUS ALL APPOINTMENTS SHOULD BE CONFIRMED THROUGH AMB ZAHEDI'S OFFICE.

EMBOFF SPOKE WITH VICE MIN, MINISTRY ECONOMIC AFFAIRS AND FINANCE, JAVAD VAFA, FEB 6 CONCERNING GOI PLANS CONCERNING REPRESENTATION AT FIRST MEETING OF UN OVERVIEW COMMITTEE FEB 13-17. ALTHOUGH IRAN'S REP AT PARIS CIEC MEETINGS WAS MEAF MIN YEGANEH, VICE MIN VAFA WAS UNAWARE OF UPCOMING FIRST MEETING OF OVERVIEW COMMITTEE. EMBOFF, DRAWING UPON REFTEL A, BRIEFED HIM ON PURPOSE OF OVERVIEW COMMITTE AND GAVE HIM A MEMORANDUM ON THE SUBJECT. VAFA SAID HE WOULD LOOK INTO MATTER OF GOI'S REPRESENTATION AT FIRST MEETING AND COMMUNICATE FURTHER WITH EMB.

MINISTRY FOREIGN AFFAIRS OFFICER CHARGED WITH IO MATTERS, EHSASSI, WAS MORE FAMILIAR WITH UN OVERVIEW COMMITTEE. HE SAID THAT QUESTIN OF WHETHER GOI WOULD SEND SOMEONE FROM TEHRAN OR OTHERWISE BE REPRESENTED BY IRAN'S MISSION AT UN WAS UNDER STUDY. MFA, AT LEAST AT HIS LEVEL, SEEMS TO FAVOR OVERVIEW COMMITTEE FIRST MEETING BEING COVERED BY IRANIAN MISSION IN NEW YORK. IF GOI IN THE END SENDS SOMEONE FROM TEHRAN, OFFICIAL MOST PROBABLY WULD BE FROM MEAF.
DEPT AND USUN WILL BE ADVISED WHEN EMB HAS FURTHER DETAILS ON THE MATTER.

1978TEHRAN01499.subject: SOVIET POLICY IN THE HORN: A FRENCH VIEW

segments.text: ON FEBRUARY 9 FRENCH EMBASSY ASSISTANT MILITARY ATTACHE, WHO IS A PERSONAL FRIEND OF POLCOUNS, PRODUCED A VIEW OF SOVIET POLICY IN THE HORN WHICH HAS SOME STRIKING SIMILARITIES TO THAT OF MFA SECRETARY GENERAL SOUTOU (REFTEL). IN PARTICULAR, HE NOTED SOVIETS COMPLETELY REORGANIZED SOMALI INTELLIGENCESECURITY APPARATUS A FEW YEARS BACK AND ARE BOUND TO HAVE MANY ASSETS IN PLACE TODAY, ONLY A FEW MONTHS AFTER SOMALI BREAK WITH THE SOVIETS. MOST LIKELY SOVIET OBJECTIVE, THEREFORE, IS NOT TAKEOVER OF SOMALIA BY ETHIOPIA, BUT RATHER REPLACEMENT OF SIAD BARRE BY SOMEONE PREPARED TO SEE RETURN OF THE SOVIETS TO SOMALIA. THEN SOVIETS WILL HAVE GAINED ETHIOPIA WHILE RETAINING SOMALIA.

SINCE SOVIETS ARE ON THE SIDE OF INTERNATIONAL VIRTUE IN ETHIOPIA (I.E., ON THE RIGHT SIDE OF INTERNATIONALLY RECOGNIZED BOUNDARIES) ATTACHE DID NOT SEE WHAT FREE WORLD COULD DO EFFECTIVELY TO ASSIST SOMALIS IN THE OGADEN. MOST IMPORTANT TASK, IN HIS OPINION, IS TO REPLACE FORMER SOVIET ADVISORS WITH ACCEPTABLE PRO-WESTERN ONES IN THE SOMALIAN ESTABLISHMENT. HE SUGGESTED EGYPTIANS OR OTHERS OF SIMILAR AVAILABILITY AND VIEWS AND THOUGHT THIS A TASK WORTHY OF IMMEDIATE USG AND FREE WORLD ATTENTION.

ATTACHE ALSO WORRIED ABOUT QUESTION OF WHO PROTECTS THE HEAD OF STATE. HE NOTED THIS WOULD APPEAR TO BE HIGH PRIORITY IN SOVIET METHOD OF OPERATION WITH, FOR EXAMPLE, CUBANS PROTECTING SEKOU TOURE IN GUINEA WHILE GUINEANS PROTECT CASTRO IN CUBA. POLCOUNS ALLOWED THAT HE HAD NEVER HEARD OF THIS LAST ARRANGEMENT.
COMMENT: AT LEAST SOME OF SOUTOU'S VIEWS WOULD SEEM TO BE SHARED QUITE FAR DOWN THE LADDER OF THE FRENCH OVERSEAS ESTABLISHMENT.

1978TEHRAN01547.subject: IRAN PRESS REPORTS KURDS EXECUTED IN IRAQ

segments.text: KEYHAN CARRIED FOLLOWING STORY IN FEB 12 FARSI EDITON UNDER HEADLINE "FIVE MEMBERS OF IRAQI KURDISH MOVEMENT EXECUTED: 90 OPPOSITION KURDS IN IRAQ DETAINED". (INFORMAL ENGLISH TRANSLATION BY EMB).

"LONDON REUTER-KURDISH NATIONALISTS PUBLISHED YESTERDAY A LIST OF 90 OF THEIR SUPPORTERS WHO HAVE BEEN JAILED OR DETAINED BY THE IRAQI AUTHORITIES ACCORDING TO THESE SOURCES, AND DECLARED THAT 5 ACTIVISTIS OF THE KURDISH MOVEMENT HAVE BEEN EXECUTED".

"THE KURDISH DEMOCRATIC PARTY ANNOUNCED IN A DECLARATION PUBLISHED IN LONDON THAT "THE REASONS THAT HAVE LED THE AUTHORITIES TO ENFORCE SUCH HARSH SENTENCES ARE EITHER THESE PERSONS JOINING THE OPPOSITION POLITICAL PARTY, I.E. THE KURDISH DEMOCRATIC PARTY, OR THEIR RELATIONSHIP WITH PERSONS WHO HAVE JOINED KURDISH PARTISAN RANKS". THE LIST OF 90 NAMES INCLUDES A NUMBER OF STUDENTS, TEACHERS, WORKERS, WOMEN AND CPLDREN".
" THE REBELLION OF IRAQI KURDS UNDER THE LEADERSHIP OF MULLA MUSTAFA BARZANI WAS CRUSHED IN 1975, BUT SCATTERED GUERRILLA ACTIVITIES HAVE CONTINUED.Z
"THE IRAQI EMB IN LONDON ANNOUNCED THAT IT HAS NOT SEEN THE DECLARATION AND HAS NO COMMENT ON IT.
EMB COMMENT: ITEM WAS CARRIED IN FEB 13 FRENCH JOURNAL DE TEHRAN BUT NOT IN ENGLISH PAPERS. THIS IS FIRST COVERAGE OF INCIDENTS OF THIS TYPE THAT HAS COME TOOUR ATTENTION IN ABOUT 2 YEARS.

MFA INFORMS US IT IS SENDING AN INSTRUCTION TO ITS MISSION IN NEW YORK TODAY, FEBRUARY 13, INFORMING IT OF THE FOURCOUNTRY APPROACH AND OF GOI ACCEPTANCE. IT INSTRUCTS IRANIAN MISSION (A) TO APPOINT A REPRESENTATIVE TO ACT AS LIAISON WITH THE CONTACT GROUP AND (B) COOPERATE TO THE UTMOST IN THE CONTACT GROUP'S EFFORTS.
WE HAVE INFORMED THE GERMAN, JAPANESE AND DUTCH EMBASSIES.

1978TEHRAN01608.subject: BRIEFING ON SADAT'S VISIT TO WASHINGTON-SHAH'S MEETING WITH BEGIN

segments.text: IN LENGTHY AUDIENCE WITH SHAH MORNING FEB 14, I BRIEFED HIM ON SADAT'S VISIT TO WASHINGTON AND DREW UPON REFTEL TO PREP HIM FOR HIS MEETING WITH BEGIN. SHAH TOLD ME BEGIN HAS ASKED TO DELAY HIS VISIT SEVEN DAYS AND WILL THEREFORE NOT ARRIVE UNTIL NEXT WEEK.
UPON COMPLETION OF MY BRIEFING ON SADAT VISIT, SHAH EXPRESSED SATISFACTION THAT US HAD CONVINCED HIM TO PERSEVERE AND BELIEF THAT SCENARIO WE HAD AGREED FOR DELIBERATE NEGOTIATIONG PROCESS WAS SOUND.
AS FOR BEGIN, SHAH SAID HE HAD INFORMED LOCAL ISRAELI REP THAT BEGIN WAS JAOPARDIZING PEAKE OF ENTIRE AREA BY HIS INSISTENCE UPON THE ILLEGAL SETTLEMENTS WHICH HE PERMITTING IN OCCUPIED TERRITORY.

IN DISCUSSING BEGIN'S DOMESTIC POLITICAL PROBLEMS, SHAH ACKNOWLEDGED THEY WERE REAL, BUT SAID WE COULD, IN RELATIVE TERMS, CONTEMPLATE THE COLLAPSE OF BEGIN'S COALITION WITH SOME EQUANIMITY. ON THE OTHER HAND, SADAT WAS "INDISPENSABLE". IF HE WERE TO COLLAPSE, A NEW EGYPTIAN GOVT WOULD BRING A TOTALLY DIFFERENT OUTLOOK TO PEACE IN THE AREA. HE SAID HE WOULD TRY TO CONVINCE BEGIN THAT ISRAEL MUST NOT PERMIT SADAT TO PERISH.

THE SHAH NOTED WITH SOME AMUSEMENT THE ASPERITY WHICH MARKED BEGIN AFD DAYAN'S COMMENTS ABOUT THE VANCE PRESS CONFERENCE. HE FELT THOSE COMMENTS WOULD BE COUNTER-PRODUCTIVE IN THE UNITED STATES AFD THAT THE CONGRESS WOULD BACK THE PRES IN A STIFF CONFRONTATION WITH BEGIN AT THIS STAGE "PERHAPS FOR THE FIRST TIME"".
FINALLY, THE SHAH UNDERTOOK TO INFORM US IMMEDIATELY OF THE RESULTS OF HIS MEETING WITH BEGIN. A7. THE DEPT IS REQUESTED TO PASS THIS MESSAGE TO CAIRO AND TEL AVIV.

1978TEHRAN01614.subject: PLAN OF ACTION FOR HORN OF AFRICA

segments.text: REF STATE 037063

DURING COURSE OF AUDIENCE WITH THE SHAH ON OTHER MATTERS MORNING FEB 14, I OUTLINED PLAN OF ACTION FOR HORN OF AFRICA CONTAINED REFTEL. I SAID I HAD ALSO DISCUSSED SUBJECT BRIEFLY WITH FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY AND, WHILE I DID NOT EXPECT IMMEDIATE REACTION, I WOULD HOPE TO HAVE CONSIDERED IRANIAN VIEWS IN NEAR FUTURE.

SHAH SAID HE WOULD GIVE ME ONE OR TWO IMMEDIATE COMMENTS, BUT THAT I COULD GET MORE DETAILED VIEWS FROM KHALATBARY. HE SAID HE AGREED IN PRINCIPLE WITH U.S. OUTLINE AND BELIEVES IT WOULD BE MISTAKE FOR U.S. TO BECOME MILITARILY ASSOCIATED DIRECTLY WITH SOMALIA.

HOWEVER, HE HAS DOUBTS U.S. PLAN WILL GET OFF THE GROUND. IN THE FIRST PLACE, HE EXPECTS "WE WILL GET A NYET" FROM THE SOVIETS. SECONDLY, HE THINKS THE MILITARY ACTION IN THE OGADEN MAY DEVELOP SO SWIFTLY THAT QUESTIONS OF SOMALIA WITHDRAWAL AND AN INTERNATIONAL FORCE MAY PROVE TO BE ACADEMIC.

HE BELIEVES THE TWO MOST IMPORTANT OBJECTIVES IN THE SHORT TUN MUST BE TO ASSURE THAT THE MILITARY DRIVE STOPS AT THE SOMALI BORDER AND THAT THE SOMALI STATE REMAINS INTACT. HE FEARS THAT, IN THE WAKE OF A SOMALI MILITARY DEFEST, SIAD BARRE WILL BE OVERTURNED BY A COUP WHICH WILL BE LED BY PROSOVIET SOMALI OFFICERS. THE SOVIETS WOULD THEN HAVE BOTH ETHIOPIA AND SOMALIA.

THE SHAH SAID HE BELIEVED EGYPT, SUDAN AND SAUDI ARABIA HAD THE PARAMOUNT INTEREST AND THEREFORE PRIME RESPONSIBILITY FOR ASSURING THE INTEGRITY OF SOMALIA. HE WAS DISTURBED THAT THE MILITARY PLANS SADAT HAD DISCUSSED WITH HIM AT ASWAN HAD FAILED TO DEVELOP. UNDER THOSE PLANS, SUDAN WOULD INSTALL TROOPS AT BERBERA AND EGYPT WOULD SEND SAM CREWS TO HARGEISA AND BERBERA. THE SAUDIS WOULD FUND BOTH EFFORTS.

IN ORDER TO PROD THIS ACTION, THE SHAH SAID HE HAD SENT UNDERSECRETARY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS ZELLI TO RIYADH THIS PAST WEEKEND TO CONSULT THE SAUDIS. THE SAUDIS SAID THEY HAD ALREADY PAID OUT DOLLARS 180 MILLION AND WERE PREPARED TO SEND MORE. THE PROBLEM SEEMED TO BE MILITARY DISAGREEMENTS BETWEEN EGYPT AND SUDAN, ON THE ONE HAND, AND SOMALIA ON THE OTHER. HE EVEN SENSED THERE MIGHT BE SOME EGYPT-SUDAN FRICTION IN THE WAKE OF THE SUDAN-LIBYAN RECONCILIATION.

AS FOR HIS OWN INTENTIONS, THE SHAH SAID HE HAD TOLD THE SAUDIS THAT, IF THEY WISH TO SEND TROOPS AND EQUIPMENT TO SOMALIA, HE WOULD REPLACE THEM MAN FOR MAN, WEAPON FOR WEAPON, INSIDE SAUDI ARABIA, FOR EXAMPLE, ON THE YEMEN FRONT. HE ADDED WRYLY THAT THE SAUDIS DID NOT REACT TO THIS SUGGESTION.

COMMENT: ALTHOUGH I EXPECT A MORE FORMAL REACTION IN THE NEXT FEW DAYS, I BELIEVE DEPT CAN CONSIDER IRANIANS AGREE IN PRINCIPLE WITH PLAN CONTAINED REFTEL, BUT DO NOT CONSIDER IT VERY REALISTIC IN CURRENT CIRCUMSTANCES. THEY HAVE NOTHING BETTER TO PROPOSE FROM THEIR OWN STUDIES, AND WILL GIVE WHATEVER MORAL AND POLITICAL SUPPORT WE WISH FROM THEM. WHEN I HAVE THEIR MORE FORMAL VIEWS, I WILL ASK THEM TO JOIN IN THE EFFORT TO PERSUADE SIAD BARRE TO WITHDRAW HIS FORCES FROM THE OGADEN, IF INDEED, THERE ARE ANY LEFT THERE BY THEN.

BACKGROUND. GOI WILL NOT ALLOW MISSION DEPENDENTS WHO HOLD DIPLOMATIC OR OFFICIAL PASSPORTS TO WORK ON LOCAL ECONOMY, EXCEPT IN CERTAIN AMERICAN CURRICULUM SCHOOLS. JOBS ARE AVAILABLE IN NEARLY ALL PROFESSIONAL CATEGORIES AND U.S. TOURIST PASSPORT HOLDERS HAVE NO PROBLEMS IN OBTAINING WORK PERMITS, RESIDENCE PERMITS AND ESTABLISHING THEMSELVES AS TAX-PAYING FOREIGN EMPLOYEES. MISSION POLICY IS THAT UNLESS MFA STATES "NO OBJECTION" TO A SPECIFIC DEPENDENT'S APPLICATION FOR A SPECIFIC JOB, THE DEPENDENT MAY NOT ACCEPT EMPLOYMENT. MFA HAS NOT RESPONDED TO "NO OBJECTION" REQUEST FOR OTHER THAN TEACHERS IN MORE THAN TWO YEARS AND CHIEF OF PROTOCOL HAS INDICATED INFORMALLY THAT HIS OFFICE WILL CONTINUE TO IGNORE SUCH REQUESTS.
PROBLEM AS HE SEES IT IS DEPENDENT CARRYING THE PRINCIPAL'S CIVIL LAW AND TAX IMMUNITIES INTO NORMAL COMMERCIAL ACTIVITIES.

PRESENT SITUATION. MISSION HAS 20-30 DEPENDENTS, PRIMARILY SPOUSES, WHO WISH THEIR IMMUNITY WAIVED AND TO ADJUST STATUS IN COUNTRY OR DEPART IRAN AND RETURN ON TOURIST PASSPORTS. WAIVER APPLICANTS INCLUDE AN ATTORNEY, A CHIMICAL ENGINEER, TWO ELECTRONICS ENGINEERS, A PERSONNEL SPECIALIST AND A FINANCIAL MANAGER, EACH OF WHOM HAS EMPLOYMENT OFFERS.

1978TEHRAN01691.subject: NEW APPOINTMENTS ANNOUNCED TO CENTRAL BANK, BANK MELLI AND NIOC

segments.text: NIOC

BEGIN UNCLASSIFIED: THE SHAH ON FEB 15, RECEIVED IN SEPARATE AUDIENCES PRIMIN AMOUZEGAR AND NIOC CHAIRMAN AND MANAGING DIR ANSARY WHO RESPECTIVELY INTRODUCED: -. YUSSEF KHOSHKISH AS THE NEW GOVERNOR OF THE CENTRAL BANK OF IRAN (CBI) AND JALIL SHORAKA, FORMERLY DEPUTY MIN OF THE MINISTRY OF ECONOMIC AFFAIRS AND FINANCE (MEAF) AS KHOSHKISH'S SUCCESSOR TO THE PRESIDENCY OF BANK MELLI; AND B.

HASSAN-ALI MEHRAN, FORMERLY CBI GOVERNOR, AND FOROKH NAJMABADI, FORMERLY MANAGING DIR OF THE NATIONAL IRANIAN STEEL INDUSTRIES CORP (NISIC) AND CHAIRMAN OF IRAN COPPER INDUSTRIES AND UNTIL AUG 7, 77 MIN OF INDUSTRY AND MINES, AS DEPUTY CHAIRMAN TO ANSARY AND MANAGING DIR AT THE NIOC FOR ECONOMIC AND COMMERCIAL AFFAIRS AND FOR TECHNICAL AFFAIRS RESPECTIVELY. REPLACEMENTS FOR SHORAKA AND NAJMABADI WERE NOT NAMED.

PRESS REPORTS CONVEYED THE SHAH'S EXPECTATIONS THAT THE NIOC SHOULD "UTILIZE ITS VAST RESOURCES AND CAPABILITIES TO BECOME THE WORLD'S BIGGEST COMPANY IN EVERY ASPECT."
