ANSARY REPORTEDLY TOLD THE SHAH THAT HE HAS ISSUED INSTRUCTIONS CONCERNING NIOC'S NEW ACTIVITIES IN TAPPING NON TRADITIONAL SOURCES OF ENERGY, ESPECIALLY SOLAR, AS WELL AS NEW EXPLORATION PROGRAMS FOR OIL AND GAS. IN THE AUDIENCE WITH THE NEW BANKERS THAT SHAH REPORTEDLY INSTRUCTED A CAREFUL AND METICULOUS APPLICATION OF THE COUNTRY'S MONETARY POLICY AND THE DIRECTION OF BANK CREDITS TO PRODUCTIVE, RATHER THAN SPECULATIVE AND CONSUMPTIVE PURPOSES. END UNCLASSIFIED.

BEGIN CONFIDENTIAL: THESE APPOINTMENTS CARRY AN UNUSUALLY HIGH ELEMENT OF SURPRISE AND POTENTIAL CHANGE. A. SHORAKA, 47, AN ACCOUNTANT BY TRAINING AND WITH EXPERIENCE IN THE MEAF, THE CBI (AS DEPUTY), AND THE EXPORT PROMOTION CENTER, TAKES RELATIVE YOUTH, A "MERCHANT'S MENTALITY" AND EXPERIENCE INTO THE COUNTRY' S LARGEST AND COMPLETELY GOI OWNED COMMERCIAL BANK. THIS REPRESENTS A CLEAR PROMOTION FOR SHORAKA BUT DIMINISHES HIS POLICY IMPACT. HIS FLEXIBLE, PRAGMATIC APPROACHES WILL CONTRAST SHARPLY WITH HIS PREDECESSOR KHOSHKISH. AS DEPUTY OF MEAF, SHORAKA WAS HEAVILY INVOLVED IN THE USIRJC AS WELL AS OTHER BILATERAL ECONOMIC POLICY ISSUES AND GENERALLY RESPONSIVE TO US INTERESTS. B.

KHOSHKISHS APPOINTMENT AS CBI GOVERNOR IS CHARACTERIZED AS EITHER A LATERAL MOVE OR SLIGHT PROMOTION AND ALSO A COMPLETE SURPRISE, INITIAL REACTIONS BY CBI OFFICERS AND BANKERS IS SOMEWHAT NEGATIVE. KHOSHKISH, 72, ELDER STATESMAN OF THE BANKING COMMUNITY, PRES OF BANK MELLI FOR 16 YEARS AND CHAIRMAN OF THE BOARD OF THE BANKERS ASSN IS VIEWED AS TOO TRADITIONAL AND INFLEXIBLE FOR THE CBI POST. QUICKLY CONCEDING HIS BANKING EXPERTISE, BANKERS NOENTHELESS VIEW HIS INSIDE KNOWLEDGE OF THE BANKING SYSTEM WITH CONCERN, SOME SEEING IN IT A PRO STATUS QUO TENDECY. ONE SENIOR BANKER VOICED A CONCERN HEARD FROM SEVERAL OFFICIAL CONTACTS AND SHARED BY EMB, I.E.

THAT KHOSHKISH LACKS THE POISE AND "PR"CAPABILITIES NEEDED IN THE GOVERNOR'S JOB, ESPECIALLY AS IT CONCERNS INTERNATIONAL FINANCIAL ORGANIZATIONS SUCH AS THE IMF. A US BANKER RECOUNTED KHOSHKISH'S LOST BATTLE WITH THE CBI TO ------------------089787 180820Z /11 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 7009 SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 1691 LIMIT GOI GUARANTEED LOANS TO IRANIAN LEGAL JURISDICTION AND FEARS A LESS FLEXIBLE AND SOPHISTICATED CBI UNDER HIM. C. THE APPOINTMENTS OF MEHRAN (40) AND NAJMABADI (47) AS DEPUTIES TO ANSARY REPRESENT THE ONLY EXPLICIT FUNCTIONAL CHANGES IN THE FEB 15 ANNOUNCEMENTS.

THESE POSTIONS ARE NEW ONES ALTHOUGH IN THE CASE OF MEHRAN HE WILL BE AN "ACTING DEPUTY" UNTIL THE NIOC CHARTER IS AMENDED TO PERMIT A NON "OIL MAN" IN THAT POST. FORMER DEPUTIES DR REZA FALLAH AND AGHAKHAN BAKHTIAR ARE NOW ADVISORS TO THE CHAIRMAN WITH NO CHANGE IN RESPONSIBILITIES. ANSARY'S COMMENTS CONCERNING NEW ACTIVITIES FOR THE NIOC ARE CONSISTENT WITH RECENT REPORTS OF NIOC PLANS TO DIVERSIFY INTO NON TRADIONAL ENERGY AREAS AS WELL AS MINING. POLITICALLY, THE MOVE IS INTERPRETED BY A NUMBER OF CONTACTS AS A REGROUPING BY ANSARY OF HIS INTIMATES.

NAJMABADI SERVED AS ANSARY'S DEPUTY IN THE OLD MIN OF ECONOMY AND REPORTEDLY OWED HIS MINISTERIAL APPOINTMENT TO IM. MEHRAN'S PROTEGE RELATIONSHIP TO ANSARY IS WELL KNOWN, BUT THIS MOVE BELIES REPORTS OF A RECENT COOLING IN THE RELATIONSHIP. ANSARY AND NAJMABADI LOST MINISTERIAL PORTFOLIOS IN NOVEMBER AND AUGUST OF 1977 AND MEHRAN'S ASSIGNMENT IS A CLEAR DEMOTION ALTHOUGH IN THE LONG TERM MAY AUGUR WELL SINCE, INTER ALIA, THERE IS A CLEAR NEED FOR FINANCIAL MANGEMENT TALENT AT NIOC.

THE EMB FINDS SOME VALIDITY IN THE JUDGEMENT BY SEVERAL RESPECTED IRANIANS THAT ANSARY IS BUILDING HIS "SHADOW CABINET" WHILE IN THE PROCESS MAKING A DETERMINED EFFORT TO INVIGORATE THE PRESTIGIOUS THOUGH PONDEROUS NIOC INTO A DYNAMIC DEVELOPMENT ORIENTED ORGANIZATION.

THE VACANCIES CREATED BY THESE MOVES AS WELL AS THE POTENTIAL FOR SECOND-LEVEL MOVES AT THE CBI AND MEAF HAVE THE BUREAUCRACY WAITING FOR THE OTHER "SHOE TO FALL". IN THE MEAF, NOT ONLY IS THE DEPUTY MIN VACANCY IMPORTANT, BUT THE POSITIONS OF UNDERSECRETARIES DR AHMAD KOOROS (FOR ECONOMICS) AND DR JAMSHI ASHRAFI (FOR INTERNATIONAL INVESTMENT AND CREDITS) ARE CONSIDERED SHAKY. NO CHANGES ARE ANTICIPATED UNTIL MINISTER YEGANEH RETURNS FROM KUWAIT. CHANGES AT THE CBI ARE, PERHAPS, LESS LIKELY, ALTHOUGH VICE GOVERNOR FOR RESEARCH DR BAHMAN HOMAYOUN HAS JUST COMPLETED 30 YEARS AND IS RECEPTIVE TO RETIREMENT OR ANOTHER JOB.
NISIC HAS SUFFERED THE LOSS OF ITS CHAIRMAN/MANAGING DIR TWICE IN 6 MONTHS, WITH REZA AMIN'S APPOINTMENT AS MIN OF INDUSTRY AND MINES IN AUGUST 77 AND NOW NAJMABADI'S MOVE.

YOUR PRUDENCE IS APPRECIATED. IT SEEMS TO US THAT THE DRAFT RESPONSE CONTAINED PARA THREE OF REFTEL COULD BE SLIGHTLY REWORDED AND STILL MAKE THE SUBSTANTIVE POINTS COVERED IN YOUR DRAFT. OUR EFFORT IN THAT DIRECTION IS IN PARAS TWO THROUGH SIX BELOW.

TEX OF SUGGESTED REPLY. : DEAR MR. HAMILTON: THE SECRETARY HAS ASKED ME TO REPLY TO YOUR FEBRUARY 2 LETTER REGARDING THE JACK ANDERSON COLUMN OF THAT DATE. THIS RESPONSE HAS BEEN COORDINATED WITH THE DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE AND THE CENTRAL INTELLIGENCE AGENCY AS YOU REQUESTED.

THE PORTION OF THE ANDERSON COLUMN WHICH YOU HIGHLIGHTED MAKES THREE ASSERTIONS, NAMELY: --AN IRANIAN INTELLIGENCE OFFICER; --PROVIDED AWACS SECRETS TO THE SOVIETS; AND --WAS SUBSEQUENTLY EXECUTED. THE FIRST TWO ASSERTIONS ARE NOT TRUE; THE THIRD IS ACCURATE.

MAJOR GENERAL MOGHAREBI, THE IRANIAN MILITARY OFFICER WHO WAS EXECUTED THE END OF LAST YEAR FOR SPYING FOR THE SOVIET UNION, WAS NOT AN INTELLIGENCE OFFICER. MOGHAREBI WAS DEPUTY CHIEF OF J-5 (PLANS, PROGRAMS AND BUDGET) OF THE SUPREME COMMANDER'S STAFF. THE SUPREME COMMANDER'S STAFF IS NOT INVOLVED IN IRANIAN ARMS PROCUREMENT. THEREFORE, MOGHAREBI WOULD NOT HAVE HAD ACCESS AS A RESULT OF HIS DUTIES TO ARMS PROCUREMENT INFORMATION.

WITH RESPECT TO AWACS IN PARTICULAR, THE LETTERS OF OFFER CONTAINING DETAILED INFORMATION WERE NOT PROVIDED TO THE IRANIAN VMOW (THE ORGANIZATION CHARGED WITH PROCUREMENT) UNTIL AFTER CONSIDERATION OF THE PROPOSED SALE BY CONGRESS HAD BEEN COMPLETED IN EARLY OCTOBER 1977. BY THAT TIME, MAJOR GENERAL MOGHAREBI HAD BEEN ARRESTED. THE FIRST AWACS WILL NOT BE DELIVERED TO IRAN UNTIL 1980.

YOUR FEBRUARY 2 LETTER OONTAINS A SECOND, MORE GENERAL QUESTION: PRECISELY WHAT SECRETS ON WHAT SYSTEMS MAY HAVE BEEN GIVEN TO THE SOVIETS. END . THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT KEPT US INFORMED OF THE ARREST, TRIAL AND CONVICTION OF MOGHAREBI, AND HAS COOPERATED WITH US IN TRYING TO ASSESS WHETHER HE COMPROMISED ANY SENSITIVE US DATA. THE DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE IS CURRENTLY CARRYING OUT A STUDY TO ASSESS WHAT IF ANY, COMPROMISE OF SENSITIVE TECHNICAL DATA MAY HAVE OCCURRED. THIS CAREFUL AND DETAILED REVIEW WILL NOT BE COMPLETED FOR SEVERAL MORE MONTHS.
PLEASE LET US KNOW IF YOU WISH US TO BE IN FURTHER TOUCH WITH YOU WHEN THE REVIEW IS COMPLETED. SINCERELY, DOUGLAS J. BENNETT. .

1978TEHRAN01708.subject: PLAN OF ACTION FOR HORN OF AFRICA

segments.text: STATE 42000

MIN OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS KHALATBARY TELEPHONED ME EVENING FEB 16 TO SAY THAT MINISTRY, IN STUDYING US PLAN FOR HORN OF AFRICA, FELT NEED FOR AUTHORITATIVE ANSWERS TO TWO QUESTIONS. HE HOPED WASHINGTON COULD SUPPLY THESE ANSWERS SOONEST SO THAT HE COULD GIVE ME FORMAL IRANIAN REACTION TO OUR POPOSALS AT EARLIEST TIME.

FIRST QUEATION WAS WHETHER US, IN DEFINING POSSIBLE ETHIOPIAN VIOLATION OF SOMALI FRONTIER, WOULD CONSIDER AN ACTION ACROSS THE FRONTIER AS AGGRESSION AGAINST SOMALIA. HE ASKED WHETHER WE FELT CURRENTLY REPORTED BOMBING OF HARGEISA AND BEIBERA AS CONSISTENT WITH SOVIET ASSURANCES THAT ETHIOPIAN FORCES WOULD REFRAIN FROM VIOLATING THE FRONTIER.

SECOND QUESTION WAS WHETHER OUR PLAN WOULD STILL BE PURSUED IF AN INTERNAL COUP IN SOMALIA SHOULD REPLACE CURRENT REGIME WITH PRO-SOVIET GROUP. WOULD WE STILL, FOR EXAMPLE, SEEK TO HAVE A DEFINITIVE FRONTIER LINE DRAWN BETWEEN ETHIOPIA AND SOMALIA.

I WOULD LIKE TO HAVE ANSWERS SOONEST IN ORDER TO SEEK APPOINTMENT WITH KHALATBARY AT LATEST ON SUNDAY FEB 19. AT THAT TIME, I WOULD ALSO RAISE WITH HIM POINTS CONTAINED REFTELS C AND D CONCERNING SOMALI WITHDRAWAL FROM OGADEN AND INITIATIVE WITH UN SECURITY COUNCIL.
BRITISH EMB INFORMED US FEB 16 THAT THEY HAD RECEIVED INSTRUCTIONS CONCERNING UNSC DEMARCHE. I WOULD EXPECT THEM TO TAKE ACTION NO LATER THAN SUNDAY ON THEIR INSTRUCTIONS.

1978TEHRAN01709.subject: SECURITY COUNCIL ACTION ON THE HORN

segments.text: IN READING TEXT OF "ELEMENTS" TO BE PROPOSED IN DRAFT RES TO BE PLACED BEFORE UNSC, I NOTE THAT IT DOES NOT REPEAT NOT CONTAIN REFERENCE TO "A NEUTRAL INTERNATIONAL ENTITY" TO "ENSURE SAFETY AND WELFARE OF INHABITANTS" WHICH WAS ONE OF KEY ELEMENTS IN FOUR POINT PLAN WHICH WE PRESENTED TO GOI FOR ITS ENDORSEMENT.

THE REFERENCE IN PARA 3 OF THE"ELEMENTS" TO "MACHINERY (E.G. ESTABLISHMENT OF OBSERVATION TEAMS)" FALLS FAR SHORT OF THE PROPOSAL IN OUR PLAN, IN THAT ITS ONLNCTION WOULD BE "TO MONOTOR" AND "TO REPORT".

IRANIANS WILL IMMEDIATELY SPOT THIS DISCREPANCY AND WILL WISH TO KNOW WHICH PROPOSAL IS CONTROLLING. PLEASE ADVISE IMMEDIATELY WHETHER WE SHOULD TELL GOI THAT WE HAVE DROPPED OUR PLAN FOR OUR ENTITY TO PROTECT OGADENI AGAINST ETHIOPIAN REPRISALS OR WHETHER WE ARE STILL SEEKING TO HAVE SUCH AN ENTITY ESTABLISHED, EITHER WITHIN THE FRAMEWORK OF A UNSC RES OR THROUGH SOME OTHER MEANS.
THE ANSWER TO THIS QUESTION MAY BE SIGNIFICANT IN DETERMINING WHETHER THE IRANIANS (AND I SUSPECT SEVERAL OTHER GOVTS) WILL ENDORSE OUR PLAN.

1978TEHRAN01710.subject: RIOTS IN TABRIZ, ELSEWHERE OVER 40TH DAY ANNIVERSARY OF QOM KILLINGS SUMMARY: ON SATURDAY FEB. 18, RIOTING OCCURRED IN

segments.text: OF QOM KILLINGS SUMMARY: ON SATURDAY FEB. 18, RIOTING OCCURRED IN TABRIZ MARKING 40TH DAY OF MOURNING FOR THOSE KILLED IN QOM DISTURBANCES JAN 9. GUNFIRE HAS BEEN WIDESPREAD IN THE CITY AND TROOPS ARE ON ALERT. IRAN-AMERICAN SOCIETY (IAS) BINATIONAL CENTER HAD ALL WINDOWS BROKEN, BUT EXCEPT FOR THIS INCIDENT RIOTS HAVE NOT REPEAT NOT TAKEN ANTIU.S. TURN, AND CONSULATE TABRIZ REPORTS ALL AMERICANS ARE SAFE AS OF 5 P.M. LOCAL TIME FEB 18. SHIRAZ SAW MINOR DISTURBANCES. END SUMMARY

IN WAKE OF ORDER TO CLOSE TABRIZ BAZAAR GIVEN BY LOCAL RELIGIOUS LEADERS TO COMMEMORATE 40TH DAY AFTER QOM INCIDENTS OF JAN 9, TABRIZ CONSULATE REPORTS MASSIVE CROWDS NUMBERING IIN THOUSANDS TOOK TO STREETS WITH ROCKS AND PERHAPS OTHER WEAPONS. DISTURBANCES BEGAN EARLY IN MORNING, AND BY 9:30 OR 10:00 A.M. FIRING, INCLUDING MACHINE GUN BURSTS, WAS HEARD THROUGHOUT CITY. ARMY TROOPS WERE DEPLOYED. HEAVY MORNING FIRING HAD GIVEN WAY TO RANDOM SHOOTING BY AFTERNOON, INCLUDING REPORTED SNIPER FIRE FROM UNIVERSITY AREA OF CITY. TABRIZ UNDER CURFEW EVENING FEB 18.

AT ABOUT 2:30 P.M., IAS BINATIONAL CENTER WAS ATTACKED AND ALL WINDOWS WERE BROKEN. NO ONE WAS IN BUILDING AT TIME, AND CROWD DID NOT ENTER. ELSEWHERE IN TABRIZ, EYEWITNESSES HAVE REPORTED SUBSTANTIAL BREAKAGE OF WINDOWS AND MANY BUILDINGS WERE SEEN BURNING DURING DAY. SEVERAL BANKS WERE APPARENTLY GUTTED, INCLUDING BANK SEPAH AND BANK SADERAT. INTERNATIONAL HOTEL HAD ALL ITS WINDOWS SMASHED AND SOME FOREIGN (NOT REPEAT NOT AMERICAN) TOURISTS WERE REPORTEDLY ROUGHED UP. U.S. TAFT TEAMS REPORT IRANIAN ARMY HAS BEEN PUT ON ALERT. TAFT TEAMS ARE NOT REPEAT NOT LEAVING BASES FOR TIME BEING. CONSULATE TABRIZ HAS CAUTIONED AMERICANS TO REMAIN AT HOME.
CONSULATE ITSELF HAS BEEN UNDER REINFORCED POLICE PROTECTION SINCE A.M. FEB 18, IN ADDITION TO NORMAL POLICE GUARD.

EYEWITNESS REPORTS AT LEASE ONE IRANIAN WOMAN IN TABRIZ WAS DRAGGED FROM HER CAR AND BEATEN BECAUSE SHE WAS NOT RPT NOT WEARING CHADOURX (LONG ISLAMIC VIEL-ROBE). CONSULATE TABRIZ BELIEVES THERE HAVE BEEN CASUALTIES, BS NOT PREPARED TO SAY HOW MANY AT THIS POINT. RUMORS ARE BEGINNING TO BOUNCE ABOUT, BUT HARD FACTS NOT NOW AVAILABLE.

TEHRAN AND ISFAHAN WERE QUIET, WITH NO INCIDENTS REPORTED. IN SHIRAZ, BAZAAR WAS CLOSED MORNING FEB. 18, AND POLICE BROKE UP DEMONSTRATION WITH CLUBS, ACCORDING TO CONSULATE SHIRAZ. THERE WERE ALSO RUMORS OF TROUBLE AT SHIRAZ' PAHLAVI UNIVERSITY, BUT CONSUL HAS NOT YET BEEN ABLE TO CONFIRM THIS.

IRANIAN POLICE TELL SY AND OSI PRIVATELY THAT DISTURBANCES ALSO OCCURRED AT QOM AND ABIDAN FEB. 18, BUT DID NOT PROVIDE DETAILS. NATIONAL IRANIAN RADIO AND TELEVISION (NIRT) BROKE STORY FIRST ON 5 P.M. NEWS SHOW, SAYING "COMMUNISTS AND ISLAMIC-MARXISTS" HAD RIOTED IN TABRIZ AND THAT THERE HAD BEEN PROPERTY DAMAGE.

EMBASSY COMMENT: DIMENSIONS OF DISTURBANCE AT TABRIZ CLEARLY CITY-WIDE AND ATTESTED TO BY NUMBER OF DIFFERENT SOURCES. LEVEL OF VIOLENCE SURPRISING, AND THOUGH IT IS NOT RPT NOT YET KNOWN WHETHER MOBS WERE ARMED BEYOND NORMAL (FOR IRAN) STICKS AND STONES, INTENSITY AND DURATION OF FIRING SUGGEST MORE THAN USUAL OPPOSITIONIST ACTIVITY . REASONS FOR THIS AND SCALE AND SPREAD OF RELATED ACTIVITY ELSEWHERE IN IRAN WILL BE EXPLORED IN DAYS TO COME.
REF NAIROBI 0379

FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATABRY ON FEBRUARY 18 ANNOUNCED THAT THE GOI HAS DECIDED TO SEVER ITS DIPLOMATIC RELATIONS WITH KANYA IN RESPONSE TO KENYA'S "UNWARRANTED" CRITICISM OF IRANIAN POLICY IN THE OGADEN CONFLICT. SPEAKING TO LOCAL AND FOREIGN REPORTERS, KHALATBARY WAS REPORTED IN FRENCH-LANGUAGE JOURNAL DE TEHRAN AS SAYING THAT THE KENYAN PRESS HAD BEEN "VIRULENTLY REPROACHING" IRAN AND CRITICIZING THE GOI SINCE THE SHAH'S NEW YEAR'S DAY STATEMENT.

THE FOREIGN MINISTER, IN A SHARP ATTACK ON HIS KENYAN COUNTERPART, ADDED THAT THE GOI HAD ASKED THE KENYAN GOVERNMENT TO CLARIFY IRAN'S TRUE ROLE TO THE KENYAN PEOPLE BUT "WE HAVE SEEN WITH SURPRISE AND REGRET THAT THE KENYAN MINISTER OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS HAS ECHOED THE SWAHILI PRESS AND HAS REPEATED ALLEGATIONS ALREADY MADE TOWARD OUR COUNTRY. THE MINISTER HAS CLAIMED THAT IRAN IS NOT AN AFRICAN STATE AND HAS NO RIGHT TO INTERFERE IN AFRICAN AFFAIRS. SURELY THE FOREIGN MINISTER MUST KNOW THAT A NUMBER OF 'FOREIGNERS' ARE ON AFRICAN SOIL AND THAT CUBANS AND OTHER FOREIGNERS ARE IN ACTUAL FACT PARTICIPATING IN THE FIGHTING.

APPARENTLY THE MINISTER IS IGNORANT OF ONE OF THE FUNDAMENTAL PRINCIPLES OF THE UN. ALL MEMBER STATES OF THE UN HAVE THE DUTY AND RIGHT TO EXPRESS THEIR CONCERN WHEN PEACE IS THREATENED IN ANY REGION AND TO DO ALL POSSIBLE TO MAINTAIN PEACE. IRAN, AS AN ACTIVE AND INITIAL MEMBER OF THAT ORGANIZATION, THUS HAS THE RIGHT AND DUTY TO BE CONCERNED ABOUT THE FUTURE OF PEACE WHEN IT IS THREATENED IN AFRICA. WE HAVE THE RIGHT TO SPEAK FRANKLY: IRAN CANNOT REMAIN INDIFFERENT IF THE INTERNATIONALLY RECOGNIZEDBORDERS OF SOMALIA ARE THREATENED."

IN RESPONSE TO A QUESTION RE FUTURE GOI ACTION, KHALATBARY ANSWERED," THE IRANIAN DECISION WILL NOT BE REVEALED BEFORE AGGRESSION OCCURS." IN REJECTING KENYAN REPORTS OF IRANIAN INVOLVEMENT IN THE OGADEN, KHALATBARY REITEREATED THAT GOI SUPPORT TO SOMALIA HAS CONSISTED ONLY OF MEDICAL SUPPLIES, DELIVERED BY THE GOI RED CROSS AFFILIATE.

COMMENT: DRAMATIC DIPLOMATIC BREAK (MOST RECENT SIMILAR ACTION WAS BREAK WITH CUBA IN 1976) EXEMPLIFIES GOI'S SENSITIVITY TO KENYAN CRITICISM OF SHAH'S PRONOUNCEMENT. AS EMPHASIZED IN REFTEL, GOK HAS EXHIBITED HIGH EMOTIONAL LEVEL ON ISSUE OF SOMALIAN THREAT AND HAS STEPPED UP WAR OF WORDS WITH IAN. AMBASSADOR TAVAKOLI, IRAN'S ENVOY FOR PAST YEAR, HAS OBVIOUSLY BEEN UNABLE TO SMOOTH TROUBLED WATERS OR PUT DISPUTE INTO PROPER PERSPECTIVE AND HAS BEEN RECALLED BY GOI. BIRITH EMBOFFS IN TEHRAN INFORM US GOI HAS ASKED HMG TO REPRESENT IRANIAN INTERESTS IN KENYA BUT REPORT NO DECISION TAKEN AS YET IN LONDON.
POLCOUNS HAS APPOINTMENT AT MFA FEBRUARY 21 TO SEE WHAT BACKGROUND IRANIANS PROVIDE IN ADDITION TO KHALATBARY'S LENGTHY STATEMENT.

1978TEHRAN01762.subject: RIOTS IN TABRIZ, ELSEWHERE OVER 40 DAY ANNIVERSARY OF QOM KILLINGS

segments.text: SUMMARY: MORNING AFTER SURVEY SHOWS DAMAGE FROM FEB 18 TABRIZ RIOTS WAS WIDESPREAD N TABRIZ. VIRTUALLY ALL BANKS VANDALIZED, MANY STORES GUTTED AND SUBSTANTIAL NUMBER OF PUBLIC OFFICES DESTROYED. ARMY WAS CALLED IN MORNING FEB 18 AND REMAINS IN CONTROL OF CITY. BAZAAR AND ALL SHOPS EXCEPT FOOD STORES CLOSED. GOI VERY TIGHT LIPPED ABOUT EVENTS,, WHICHMEDIA TREATED FEB 19 AS MERELY LARGE BAZAAR RIOT. SOUNDINGS BY CONSULATE TABRIZ INDICATE CROWDS HAD SOME WEAPONS AND THERE WERE CASUALTIES, BUT NO ONE IS SAYING HOW MANY. FURTHER REPORTS CONFIRM REFTEL'S DESCRIPTION OF EVENTS IN SHIRAZ, ISFAHAN. BAZAARS CLOSED IN TEHRAN AND ISFAHAN, OPEN IN SHIRAZ.
TABRIZ EVENTS VERY TENTATIVELY BEING LAID TO SURPRISINGLY WELL ORGANIZED MOSLEM FANATICS. END SUMMARY.

US CONSUL METRINKO TOURED MAIN AREAS OF TABRIZ--ARMY HAS SEALED OFF MORE CONSERVATIVE AREAS FOR TIME BEING--AND REPORTS EXTENSIVE DAMAGE. THREE MEDIUM SIZED POLICE STATION TOTALLY DESTROYED, MANY MUNICIPAL BUILDING HIT, VIRTUALLY ALL BANKS BROKEN INTO, AND TEN OF 30 GUTTED. IAS BINATIONAL CENTER WAS ONLY BUILDING HIT ON ITS STREET. THIS PLUS PATTERNS OF SHOP DESTRUCTION AND BREAK INS SUGGEST TO IRANIANS IN TABRIZ AND TO OUR CONSUL THAT RIOTS WERE BETTER ORGANIZED THAN ORIGINALLY THOUGHT POSSIBLE. ALL HOTELS HAVE GROUND FLOOR WINDOWS OUT, AND 20-30 SHOPS NEAREST CENTER OF TOWN WERE GUTTED AFTER EXTENSIVE GUNFIGHT WHICH CENTERED ON MUNCIPALITY BUILDING.

ARMY REMAINS IN CONTROL OF TOWN; POLICE WERTLOADUALLY RETIRED FROM CITY AS ARMY TOOK OVER DURING LATE MORNING FEB 18, AND ONLY A FEW POLICEMEN ARE BEING SEEN ON STREETS FEB CONSUL SAYS NUMBER OF UNVERIFIABLE STORIES INDICATE ELEMENTS IN CROWDS HAD WEAPONS.

GOI OFFICIALS ARE VERY RETICENT TO TALK ABOUT EVENTS. ENGLISH AND FARSI PRESS USED PARS NEWS AGENCY INFO WHICH CHARACTERIZED MOB AS "GROUPS OF HOOLIGANS" WITH SOME SELFPROCLAIMED "ISLAMIC-MARXISTS AMONG THEM, WHO DESTROYED PROPERTY. ------------------101198 191351Z /43 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 7047 USIA WASHDC IMMEDIATE DEFENSE INTELLIGENCE AGENCY WASHDC IMMEDIATE CENTRAL INTELLIGENCE AGENCY WASHDC IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY BAGHDAD USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 1762 LOCAL PRESS PLAY INCLUDED COMMENT: "CERTAINLY FOREIGN ELEMENTS WERE BEHIND THE INCIDENT, "BUT NO DETAILS WERE GIVEN.
GENERAL BELIEF IN TABRIZ IS THAT THERE WERE CASUALTIES, AND UNCONFIRMED REPORT TO CONSUL INDICATED BODIES WERE BEING BURIED IN TABRIZ CEMETERY FEB 19.

EVEN THOUGH GOI IS NOT COMMENTING, EVIDENCE SO FAR SUGGESTS THAT TABRIZ VIOLENCE IS WORK OF FANATICAL MOSLEMS. WE AND BRITISH BELIEVE THERE WAS PROBABLY NO DIRECT FOREIGN INVOLVEMENT, BUT WOULD NOT RULE OUT POSSIBILITY THAT ALL OR PART OF RIOT LEADERSHIP IN TABRIZ HAD RECEIVED TRAINING ABROAD.

IN TEHRAN, BAZAAR WAS CLOSED OFFICIALLY, PRESUMABLY TO PREVENT SYMPATHETIC ECHOES F TABRIZ. TEHRAN BAZAAR REMAINED OPEN FEB 18, BUT SITUATION AS DESCRIBED BY OBSERVER WAS TENSE, WITH SUBSTANTIAL POLICE PRESENCE.

SHIRAZ CONSUL TOMSETH CONFIRMED THAT THERE WAS SUBSTANTIAL DEMONSTRATION AT PAHLAVI UNIVERSITY ARTS AND SCIENCE FACULTY FEB 18, WITH SHOULTS OF "LONG LIVE KHOMEINI AND "WE DON'T WANT THE SHAH". RUMOR HAS IT THAT ONE STUDENT WAS SHOT, AND RELIABLE EYEWITNESS SAW BLOOD ON FLOOR OF BUILDING AFTER POLICE MOVED IN WITH CLUBS TO BREAK UP DEMONSTRATION. SHIRAZ BAZAAR WAS OPEN FEB 10, AND DESPITE RUMORS, CONSUL COULD FIND NO EVIDENCE OF OTHER DISTURBANCES. SHOOTING OCCURRED AT BAZAAR FEB 18, BUT NO HARD FACTS AVAILABLE EITHER WAY, AND REFTEL REPORT BELIEVED ESSENTIALLY CORRECT.

IN ISFAHAN, CIRCULARS WENT OUT FEB 17 CALLING FOR MOURNING FEB 18, AND POLICE ON STREETS THERE REINFORCED. CIRCULARS WERE PRE PRINTED WITH AT LEAST FIVE NAMES OF QOM DEAD. CONSUL MC GAFFEY IS ATTEMPTING TO OBTAIN NAMES USED. BAZAAR WAS CLOSED FEB 18, BUT SOME SHOPS REOPENED FEB 19. CONSUL INDI CATES THERE WERE AND ARE NO INDICATORS OF FURTHER TROUBLE SUCH AS PRECEDE MAJOR DISTURBANCES, AND CITY REMAINS CALM, THOUGH SEVERAL PRIVATE STORES WERE CLOSED FEB 18.
BRITISH COLLEAGUE HAS HEARDTHAT THERE WILL BE A CITY WIDE INDUSTRIAL STRIKE IN SAVEH FEB 19, IN SYMPATHY WITH QOM DEAD, BUT FURTHER INFO LACKING.

EMB COMMENT: IT IS STILL TOO EARLY, ESPECIALLY IN VIEW OF GOI RETICENCE TO DISCUSS MATTERS AND OFFICIAL INSISTENCE THAT TABRIZ EVENTS WERE MERELY LARGE BAZAAR RIOT, TO GIVE DEFINITIVE ANALYSIS OF EVENTS. WE DO NOT REPEAT NOT KNOW IF LEFTIST ELEMENTS WERE INVOLVED IN VIOLENCE OR WHETHER ENTIRE AFFAIR WAS REACTIONARY MOSLEM SHOW. EXTENT OF CASUALTIES ALSO UNCLEAR, HOWEVER, TABRIZ BROUHAHA WAS NO MERE BAZAAR RIOT, AND NECESSITY OF CALLING IOOPS HAS UNDOUBTEDLY CAUSED GOI TO BEGIN CONSIDERING IMPLICATION OF EVENTS. INFO CONSUL METRINKO HAS PIECED TOGETHER SUGGESTS AT FIRST CUT THAT MOB WAS WELL ORGANIZED AND DESTRUCTION WAS NOT RANDOM, BUT WELL PLANNED.
OF COURSE, VERY FACT THINGS GOT TO THE RIOT STAGE SUGGESTS CONTINUING GOI RELUCTANCE AT THE HIGHEST LEVELS TO CRACK DOWN HARD ON RELIGIOUS MILITANTS.

1978TEHRAN01763.subject: CONVERSATION OF IRANIAN AMBASSADOR IN CAIRO WITH PRESIDENT SADAT

segments.text: PRESIDENT SADAT

FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY READ ME A CABLE HE HAD RECEIVED FROM IRANIAN AMBASSADOR IN CAIRO FEBRUARY 19 REPORTING CONVERSATION AMBASSADOR HAD WITH PRESIDENT SADAT. LATTER PLEADED WITH IRAN FOR MILITARY EQUIPMENT FOR SOMALIA. HE SAID EGYPT WAS SENDING ALL IT COULD, BUT HAD DIFFICULTIES. HE CITED KENYAN INTERCEPT OF EGYPTIAN PLANE AND "OBSTACLES" SOVIETS WERE PLACING IN WAY OF SEABORNE SHIPMENTS.
KHALATBARY EXPRESSED PUZZLEMENT ABOUT SADAT'S REFERENCE TO SOVIET "OBSTACLES". HE ASKED IF WE COULD CLARIFY WHETHER SOVIET WARSHIPS WERE ACTUALLY IMPEDING EGYPTIAN SHIPMENTS.
ACTION REQUESTED: PLEASE PROVIDE CLARIFICATION SOONEST.

1978TEHRAN01764.subject: PLAN OF ACTION FOR HORN OF AFRICA

segments.text: I CALLED ON MINISTER OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS KHALATBARY EVENING FEBRUARY 19 TO PROVIDE HIM CLARIFICATIONS CONCERNING U.S. POLICY ON HORN OF AFRICA CONTAINED REFTEL. HE EXPRESSED APPRECIATION FOR PROMPT WASHINGTON REPLY AND SAID HE WOULD INFORM SHAH IMMEDIATELY. HE WAS REASSURED BY U.S. ASSESSMENT THAT SIAD BARRE OVERTHROW BY PRO-SOVIET REGIME WAS UNLIKELY. HE SAID CONCERN ABOUT VIOLATION OF BORDER STEMMED FROM SHAH'S PUBLIC STATEMENT THAT IRAN COULD NOT REMAIN "INDIFFERENT" TO BORDER VIOLATION. HE SEEMED RELIEVED THAT WE DID NOT CONSIDER BOMBING OF HARGEISA AS AGGRESSION.

KHALATBARY SAID THAT HE EXPECTED HAVE FORMAL (AND FAVORABLE) REACTION TO OUR PLAN OF ACTION AS SOON AS HE COULD CONSULT SHAH FEBRUARY 20. IN MEANTIME, SHAH HAD ALREADY FULLY ENDORSED NEED FOR SIAD BARRE TO DECLARE HIS WILLINGNESS TO WITHDRAW FROM OGADEN IN ORDER TO START NEGOTIATING PROCESS. CONSEQUENTLY, HE HAD ALREADY INSTRUCTED IRANIAN AMBASSADOR IN MOGADISCIO TO MAKE DEMARCHE ALONG THOSE LINES TO SOMALI GOVERNMENT.

I ALSO TOOK OCCASION TO INFORM KHALATBARY OF U.S. VIEWS ON UNSC INITIATIVE. HE HAD ALREADY BEEN INFORMED IN GENERAL TERMS BY UK AMBASSADOR. AGAIN, KHALATBARY HAD NO STRONG REACTION, BUT HOPED NIGERIA COULD BE PERSUADED TO TAKE THE INITIATIVE. HE FELT IT WOULD BE DIFFICULT TO GET AN EFFECTIVE RESOLUTION UNDER A SOVIET CHAIRMAN.

SUMMARY: MEDIA COVERAGE HAS EXPANDED. GOI SAYS 6 WERE KILLED, 125 WOUNDED IN TABRIZ VIOLENCE AND MOBS WERE WELL ORGANIZED. TABRIZ AUTHORITIES HAVE RECEIVED A MESSAGE TO RELEASE PRISONERS OR THERE WILL BE MORE TROUBLE. GOI MINISTER OF STATE FOR PARLIAMENTARY AFFAIRS RAMBOD TOLD MAJLES THAT RINGLEADERS HAVE BEEN IDENTIFIED AS "KNOWN COMMUNISTS". SENATORS CALL FOR TOUGHER ACTION AGAINST RIOTERS. IMPERIAL INVESTIGATION OF TABRIZ SITUATION HAS BEGUN. SCATTERED INCIDENTS CCCURRED ELSEWHERE IN IRAN MOST RECENTLY AT QOM. TEHRAN UNIVERSITIES EXPERIENCE MINOR DISTURBANCES FEB 20, AND INTERNATIONAL SCHOOL WALL IN TEHRAN PAINTED WITH SLOGANS. END SUMMARY.

FEB 20 AND 21 PRESS IN TEHRAN CARRIED MAJOR STORIES ON TABRIZ RIOTS. ENGLISH LANGUAGE KEYHAN FEATURED PICTURE SPREAD WHICH PRETTY MUCH CONFIRMS DESTRUCTION REPORTED REFTELS. GOI HAS STATED THERE WERE SIX KILLED AND 125 INJURED. RUMOR HAS IT THAT MANY MORE DIED AND OTHERS WERE INJURED, BUT SOLID INFO NOT AVAILABLE. AFTER THOROUGH TOUR OF TABRIZ FEB 20, CONSUL METRINKO HAS INDICATED THAT DESTRUCTION OF COMMERCIAL DISTRICT WAS MORE WIDESPREAD THAN HE THOUGHT, EXTENDING ALONG THE MAIN AXIS OF THE CITY, AN AREA OF ABOUT EIGHT MILES BY FOUR MILES.
PERSIAN PRESS STRESSED BAD ECONOMIC IMPACT WHICH WIDESPREAD DESTRUCTION OF BANK AND COMMERCIAL RECORDS WILL HAVE ON CITY AND REGION.

PRESS FEB 21 ANNOUNCED FORMATION OF IMPERIAL COMMMISSIIN OF INQUIRY TO INVESTIGATE EVENTS AT TABRIZ, AND US CONSUL THERE REPORTS COMMISSION IN PLACE AND WORKING FEB 21. NAMES OF GROUP NOT YET KNOWN. ACCORDING TO CONSUL, UNOFFICIAL STORY GOING AROUND WELL PLACED CIRCLES IS THAT TABRIZ AUTHORITIES HAVE RECEIVED FOUR SEPARATE "MESSAGES" TO RELEASE ALL PRISONERS HELD OR CITY WILL EXPLODE AGAIN. GOI REMAINS TIGHT LIPPED ABOUT NUMBERS TAKEN INTO CUSTODY, AND CONSUL WAS TOLD PROVINCIAL GOVERNOR OR HIS DEPUTY SHOULD HENCEFORTH BE HIS BASIC CONTACTS ON MATTERS RELATED TO DEMONSTRATIONS/RIOTS.

PARLIAMENTARY DISCUSSION OF TABRIZ RIOT IN TEHRAN CENTERED AROUND MINISTER OF STATE HOLAKU RAMBOD'S REPORT TO MAJLES ON INCIDENT, INCLUDING STATEMENT (UNSUPPORTED BY FURTHER EVIDENCE) THAT RINGLEADERS OF THE PLOT HAVE BEEN IDENTIFIED AS "KNOWN COMMUNISTS". HE WENT ON TO SAY THAT "THOSE WHO DID SUCH DESTRUCTION WERE NOT IRANIAN". THE GOI GOI WOULD DEAL WITH THIS LAWLESS VIOLENCE WITHIN THE FRAMEWORK OF ITS LEGAL DUTIES AND POWERS, HE CONCLUDED. RAMBOD WAS REPLYING TO COMMENTS BY MANY MAJLES DEPUTIES AND SEVERAL SENATORS DEPLORING VIOLENCE. TEHRAN SENATOR ALI REZA'I, JOINED BY OTHERS, CRITICIZED THE GOI'S LACK OF FOREKNOWLEDGE OF EVENTS AND CALLED FOR STERNER MEASURES AGAINST "HOOLIGANS".

HE CRITICIZED LENIENCY SHOWN BY COURT IN RECENT CASES WHERE STUDENTS WERE MERELY FINED FOR BREACHES OF PEACE. (COINCIDENTALLY, PRESS FEB 21 ANNOUNCED TEN STUDENTS HAD BEEN CONVICTED AND FINED 30,000 RIALS EACH (DOLS 440) FOR TEIR PART IN DEC 21 1977 DISTURBANCES IN TEHRAN).

QUIET HAS REIGNED IN OTHER MAJOR CITIES, EXCEPT IN QOM, WHERE FEB 21 PRESS REPORTS A MOB "CHANTING ANTI-NATIONAL SLOGANS". ATTACKED A HOSPITAL. NO MOTIVE WAS GIVEN. SOTRIES CONTINUE THAT THERE WAS EXTENSIVE TROUBLE IN QOM ON FEB 19,BUT DETAILS ARE VAGUE, AND RUMORED EVENTS THERE MAY NOT HAVE VEEN VERY SERIOUS, IF IN FACT THEY TOOK PLACE AT ALL.

CONSULATE ISFAHAN HAS LEARNED THAT THERE WAS A SMALL ------------------106613 211425Z /45 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 7079 USIA WASHDC DEFENSE INTELLIGENCE AGENCY WASHDC CENTRAL INTELLIGENCE AGENCY WASHDC INFO AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 1814 DEMONSTRATION AT ISFAHAN UNIVERSITY FEB 18, BUT IT PASSED WITHOUT INCIDENT, AND THE ISFAHAN BAZAAR REMAINS RELAXED AND IS NOW TWO-THIRDS OPEN. MINOR CONCERN AROSE FEB 21 WHEN GROUP OF ARMED YOUNG MEN IN GENDARMERIE KHAKI WERE SEEN AROUND CENTRAL POLICE STATION, BUT CITY SECURITY CHIEF INFORMED CONSUL MCGAFFEY THAT THIS WAS ROUTINE GUARD DUTY TRAINING.

SHIRAZ CONSULATE REPORTS CITY HAS EMAINED QUIET, AND RUMORED SHOOTING (REPORTED REF B) WAS NOT FATAL; BLOOD AT UNIVERSITY WAS SPILLED BY VIGOROUS HEAD-BASHING AND WAS SWIFTLY CLEANED OFF. BAZAAR IS QUIET AND OPEN.

IN TEHRAN, EB 20 SAW MINOR DEMONSTRATIONS AT TEHRAN AND NATIONAL UNIVERSITIES, ONLY NOTEWORTHY ELEMENT OF WHICH WAS THEIR SIMULTANEOUS 10 A.M. STARTING TIME, WHICH MOVED ONE PROGESSOR TO COMMENT THAT THE AGITATORS WERE SIMPLY TESTING OUT THEIR ABILITY TO COORDINATE THINGS. AT ABOUT SAME LEVEL WAS DEMONSTRATION AT TEHRAN TECHNICAL COLLEGE, WHERE AUTHORITIES CLOSED GATES, RELEASING ONLY FACULTY UNTIL APPARENTLY ROUTINE CHECK OF STUDENT ID CARDDS WAS COMPLETE. TEHRAN BAZAAR IS OPEN AND RELATIVELY RELAXED. REINFORMCED POLICE PRESENCE IN BAZAAR FEB 18-19 HAS BEEN WITHDRAWN.

APART FROM ATTACK ON TABRIZ IAS FEB 18, ONLY OTHER INCIDENT WITH ANTI-AMERICAN OVERTONES OCCURRED IN TEHRAN EVENING OF FEB 19 WHEN INDIVIDUAL OR GROUP PAINTED "DOWN WITH THE SHAH," AND "GO HOME AMERICANS" IN PERSIAN ON THREE OF FOUR EXTERIOR WALLS OF COMMUNITY SCHOOL COMPOUND. SCHOOL, WHICH IS TRULY INTERNATIONAL SCHOOL FROM GRADES 1-12, BUT WITH MAJORITY U.S. STAFFING, IS SET IN OLDER SECTION OF CITY. SCHOOL OFFICIALS REPORTED MATTER TO POLICE, WHO HELPED SCHOOL PAINT WALLS OVER AND HAVE STATIONED EXTRA POLICEMEN IN AREA FOR NEXT FEW DAYS.
THERE HAVE BEEN NO SUBSEQUENT INCIDENTS, AND SCHOOL PRINCIPAL SAYS COMMUNITY RELATIONS WITH SOME 60 OF HIS STAFF WHO LIVE IN VICINITY HAVE BEEN UNIFORMLY GOOD FOR YEARS.

COMMENT: GOI STILL ASSESSING SITUATION AND PLAYING INFORMATIONAL CARDS CLOSE TO VEST. SPECULATION IN TEHRAN, IN WAKE OF REVELATIONS OF DAMAGE AND ORGANIZATION OF MOB, HAS TENDED TO SUPPORT THEORY OF SOME KIND OF EXTERNAL INVOLVEMENT, BUT NO EVIDENCE OF THIS HAS BEEN PUT FORWARD YET. ONE IRANIAN CLOSE TO ESTABLISHMENT RELIGIOUS SOURCES SAYS TABRIZIS ARE MORE DEEPLY COMMITTED TO THEIR RELIGIOUS BELIEFS AND, WHILE PERHAPS NOT AS FANATICAL AS MOSLEMS IN QOM, WOULD BE "MORE LIKELY TO RAISE HELL THAN THEIR WARM WEATHER COUNTERPARTS TO THE SOUTH." IF CONVINCED IT WAS THE THING TO DO.

PARLIAMENTARY CALL FOR TOUGHER ACTION BY GOI IS ENTIRELY PREDICTABLE, AND ONE IMPORTANT RESULT OF RECENT VIOLENCE HAS BEEN TO MAKE MIDDLE-STRATA IRANIANS RETHINK EFFECTS OF OPPOSITIONISM ON SOCIETY. SOME PROFESSORS AND BUSINESSMEN OF OUR ACQUAINTANCE FEEL THINGS REACHED POINT AT TABRIZ WHERE THEIR OWN IMPORTANT VALUES ARE BEGINNING TO BE THREATENED. MANY WHO HAVE THUS FAR TACITLY SUPPORTED MODERATE OPPOSITIONIST HECKLING OF GOI MAY BE HAVING SECOND THOUGHTS.

1978TEHRAN01849.subject: BREAK OF GOI RELATIONS WITH KENYA

segments.text: REF TEHRAN 1760

ON FEB 21 MFA DEPARTMENT HEAD GAVE POLCOUNS ADDITIONAL BACKGROUND ON BREAK OF RELATIONS WITH KENYA. THIS DID NOT AMOUNT TO A GREAT DEAL MORE THAN APPEARED IN FOREIGN MINISTER'S STATEMENT TO THE PRESS (REFTEL). IRANIANS HAVE BEEN DISTURBED BY ALLEGATIONS APPEARING IN KENYAN PRESS WHICH ACCUSED IRAN OF INTERVENTION IN AFRICAN AFFAIRS. IRANIANS HAVE ARGUED THAT MUCH MORE GROSS MILITARY INTERVENTION BY SOVIETS AND FARAWAY CUBANS ON ETHIOPIA'S SIDE OUGHT TO GET AT LEAST AS MUCH ATTENTION FROM KENYA AS DID THE QUALIFIED AND GUARDED STATEMENT BY THE SHAH THAT IRAN WOULD NOT STAND IDLY BY IF ETHIOPIA CROSSED INTERNATIONALLY RECOGNIZED BOUNDARY INTO SOMALIA.
SHAH'S POSITION IS AFTER ALL IN KEEPING WITH U.N. CHARTER.

IRANIANS HAVE BEEN USING THIS ARGUMENT FOR SOME TIME IN KENYA AND WERE UNTIL RECENTLY UNDER THE IMPRESSION THAT ACCUSATIONS AGAINST THEM DID NOT HAVE GOK SUPPORT. HOWEVER, IRANIAN AMBASSADOR WAS SURPRISED AND SADDENED TO DISCOVER KENYAN FOREIGN MINISTER MARKING THE SAME ACCUSATIONS AND REFUSING TO RECOGNIZE ANY VIRTUE IN IRANIAN COUNTER-ARGUMENT. IN THAT CIRCUMSTANCE, IRAN FELT IT COULD NOT CONTINUE DIRECT DIPLOMATIC RELATIONS WITH A GOVERNMENT WHICH IS ACCUSING IT UNJUSTLY AND IN A DISCRIMINATORY MANNER.

DEPARTMENT HEAD WONDERED ALOUD WHAT COULD HAVE MADE KENYANS BEHAVE THAT WAY. POLCOUNS NOTED VERY STRONG KENYAN FEARS OF SOMALI IRREDENTISM AND SAID HE WAS UNAWARE OF ANY OTHER FACTOR. IN REPLY TO QUESTION, DEPARTMENT HEAD SAID KENYAN GOVERNMENT HAD NOT REACTED IN ANY OFFICIAL MANNER TO THE ANNOUNCEMENT OF THE BREAK, AND AMBASSADOR TAVAKOLI IS WINDING UP HIS AFFAIRS. DEPARTMENT HEAD THOUGHT IT UNLIKELY DECISION WOULD BE RESERVED IN NEAR FUTURE.

COMMENT: SOMETHING OF A TEMPEST IN A TEAPOT PERHAPS, BUT THE SHAH IS VERY SENSITIVE TO ASPERSIONS BEING CAST ON IRAN'S GOOD NAME AND HIS OWN PRESTIGE. IN ABSENCE OF ANY CONCILIATORY GESTURE FROM KENYANS, WE AGREE WITH COMMENT IN NAIROBI'S 2693 (JUST RECEIVED) THAT THERE SEEMS LITTLE CHANCE OF PATCHING THINGS UP AS LONG AS THE HORN CONFLICT IS NOT SETTLED.

1978TEHRAN01851.subject: MFA ANNOUNCES FOUR NEW DIRECTORS GENERAL

segments.text: A NUMBER OF LONG-EXPECTED SHIFTS WITHIN THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS HAVE BEEN ANNOUNCED DURING THE PAST WEEK. ALL OF THE NEW APPOINTEES ARE CAREER DIPLOMATS.

SOLTAN HOSSEIN SANANDAJI, 59, HAS BEEN NAMED DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR POLITICAL AFFAIRS (ASIA, AFRICA AND THE PACIFIC). ANBASSADOR SANANDAJI HELD THIS POSITION BEFORE IN THE PERIOD 1971-74, PRIOR TO BEING NAMED AMBASSADOR TO POLAND. HE HAS MOST RECENTLY SERVED AS AMBASSADOR TO TUNISIA (1976-77). SANANDAJI, A MAN OF STRONG VIEWS AND (REPORTEDLY) MAN PREJUDICES (ANTI-UK, ANTI-ARAB, ANTI-INDIAN) HAS BEEN THE SUBJECT OF A NUMBER OF EARLIER BIOGRAPHIC REPORTS (TEHRAN A012, JAN. 22, 1974; TEHRAN A138, JULY 22, 1976.) LISTING IN IRAN'S WHO'S WHO CAN BE FOUND UNDER NAME VAKILI-SANANDAJI. IN LIGHT AMBASSADR SANANDAJI'S SENSITIVE MFA POST WE WOULD APPRECIATE EMBASSY TUNIS' VIEWS ON HIS PERFORMANCE IN TUNISIA.

MANUCHEHR SEPAHBODI, 55, NEW DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR ECONOMIC AFFAIRS, HAS A DEGREE IN POLITICAL SCIENCE FROM TEHRAN UNIVERSITY. HE JOINED THE GOVERNEMENT IN 1945 WORKING FIRST IN THE DEPARTMENT OF TRADES AND ARTS AND LATER IN THE MINISTRY OF NATIONAL ECONOMICS. AFTER JOINING MFA IN THE EARLY 1950S HE SERVED IN PROTOCOL, ECONOMIC AFFAIRS AND WAS HEAD OF THE DEPT OF PERSIAN GULF AFFAIRS. ABROAD HE HAS SERVED IN COLOGNE, BASRA, KARACHI AND HAS RECENTLY RETURNED FROM SIX YEARS AS IRANIAN AMBASSADOR TO BAHRAIN. HE SPEAKS ENGLISH. (SEE 76 MANAMA 1972 FOR ASSESSMENT OF SEPAHBODI'S TENURE.)

IRAJ PEZECHKZAD (PREFERRED SPELLING), 50, A WELL KNOWN AUTHOR AS WELL AS DIPLOMAT, HAS BEEN APPOINTED DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR SOCIAL AND CULTURAL RELATIONS. HE HAS A DEGREE IN LAW AND POLITICAL SCIENCE FROM DIJON UNIVERSITY, FRANCE. JOINING THE GOI IN 1953, HE SERVED AS JUDGE IN THE MINISTRY OF JUSTICE FOR FIVE YEARS. SINCE JOINING THE MFA IN 1957 HE HAS BEEN POSTED IN VIENNA (1960); PRAGUE (1936); GENEVA (1966); AND WAS CHARGE IN ALGERIA (1973). AT HOME HE HAS SERVED IN THE DEPT OF INFORMATION AND PRESS, THE DEPT OF STUDIES AND RESEARCH, AND WAS FOR FOUR YEARS HEAD OF THE WESTERN EUROPEAN DEPARTMENT.

HE SPEAKS FRENCH AND HAS PUBLISHED SEVERAL ARTICLES, NOVELS, AND PLAYS. PEZECHKZAD WROTE THE SCRIPT OF "DEAR UNCLE NAPOLEON," ONE OF THE MOST POPULAR FARSI TELEVISION SERIALS TO BE SHOWN BY NIRTV, AND PRESENTLY BEING RERUN NATIONALLY.

MOHSEN GOODARZI, 54, HAS BEEN PROMOTED TO THE POST OF DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR THE MINISTER'S SECRETARIAT AND CONCURRENTLY CHEF DE CABINET WITH THE PERSONAL RANK OF AMBASSADOR. UNTIL HIS APPOINTMENT HE WAS HEAD OF THE AMERICAS DEPT AND WAS ONE OF THE EMBASSY'S MOST EFFECTIVE CONTACTS AT MFA. (FULL BIOGRAPHIC MATERIAL SUBMITTED PREVIOUSLY TO INR.) REPLACING GOODARZI IN THE FOURTH POLITICAL DEPT IS HIS COUSIN, SAEED GOUDARZNIA, ALSO A CAREER DIPLOMAT. GOUDARZNIA, 53, HAS SERVED TWO TOURS IN THE U.S.: 1964-68 AT THE IRAIAN UN MISSION IN NEW YORK AND 1968-72 AS DEPTUY PRINCIPAL OFFICER IN SAN FRANCISCO.

FOLLOWING HIS CALIFORNIA ASSIGNMENT COUDARZNIA WAS CHIEF OF THE CONSULAR SECTION IN LONDON FOR THREE YEARS AND HAS SPENT THE PAST TWO YEARS AS CONSUL IN BAKU, USSR. (ADDITIONAL BACKGROUND PROVIDED INR IN EMBASSY TEHRAN MEMO OF FEB 8, 1978).

REGARDING PRESS REPORTS THAT ABDUL WALI KHAN IS LIKELY TO VISIT TEHRAN ON HIS WAY TO LONDON (REFTEL), MFA DEPARTMENT HEAD TOLD POLCOUNS FEB 21 THAT HE THOUGHT REPORT WAS TRUE AND HAD HIMSELF "READ IN THE NEWSPAPERS" THAT WALI KHAN HAD EXPLAINED THIS VISIT AS BEING AT THE INVITATION OF THE SHAH. HE SAID WALI KHAN HAD APPARENTLY REFERRED TO SHAH'S BRIEF STOPOVER IN PAKISTAN ON HIS WAY BACK FROM INDIA DURING WHICH SHAH MET WITH A NUMBER OF PAKISTANI LEADERS AND REPORTEDLY INVITED THEM ALL TO VISIT IRAN.
ARRANGEMENTS FOR SUCH A VISIT ARE NOT LIKELY TO BE MADE BY MFA.

1978TEHRAN01875.subject: E AND E PLAN - MILITARY ANNEX

segments.text: MILITARY ANNEXES HAVE NOW BEEN TRANSMITTED TO STUTTGART (ELG), USCINCEUR AND DEPARTMENT. WOULD APPRECIATE THEIR EARLY REVIEW AND ADVICE PROVIDED EMBASSY OF ANY CHANGES DESIRED.

REVISED E AND E PLAN FOR IRAN REPEAT IRAN IS BEING TRANSMITTED DEPARTMENT WITH COPIES STUTTGART (ELG) AND USCINCEUR BY NEXT AVAILABLE AIR POUCHES. AS EXPLAINED TO EUCOM TEAM, EMBASSY HAS DECIDED ON ONE MASTER PLAN FOR THE ENTIRE COUNTRY RATHER THAN INDIVIDUAL PLANS FOR FOUR CONSULAR DISTRICTS. WE WILL BE REFINING THE PLAN CONTINUOUSLY IN THE COMING WEEKS AND PARTICULARLY WITH REGARD TO THE PORTIONS OF THE COUNTRY-WIDE PLAN THAT PERTAIN TO THE CONSULAR DISTRICTS OF ISFAHAN, SHIRAZ AND TABRIZ.

SPECIAL TEAMS ARE BEING DISPATCHED TO THESE OTHER AREAS TO ASSIST LOCAL CONSULATE AND MILITARY PERSONNEL WITH THEIR E AND E PLANING AND IN DETERMINING WHAT MODIFICATIONS SHOULD BE MADE TO THE COUNTRY-WIDE E AND E PLAN. THIS EFFORT IS BEING GIVEN ABSOLUTE TOP PRIORITY WITH SPECIAL TASK FORCES DEVOTING 100 PERCENT OF THEIR TIME AT BOTH THE EMBASSY AND ARMISH/MAAG. WE BELIEVE THAT ANY SIGNIFICANT MODIFICATIONS TO THE E AND E COUNTRY WIDE PLAN THAT PERTAIN TO SHIRAZ, ISFAHAN AND TABRIZ WILL BE COMPLETED WITHIN 10 DAYS, BUT THERE UNDOUBTEDLY WILL BE, AS PREVIOUSLY INDICATED, A CONTINUOUS REVISION THROUGHOUT THE COMING WEEKS.

SUMMARY: GOI HAS STATED ABOUT 250 WERE ARRESTED ON CHARGES OF VIOLENCE AND SABATOGE DURING FEB. 18 TABRIZ RIOHS. CURRENT INTENTION IS TO TRY ALL IN CIVIL, NOT MILITARY COURTS. DEATH TOLL UPPED TO NINE OFFICIALLY, BUT INFORMAL ESTIMATES RUN AS HIGH AS 200. EXISTENCE OF DUPLICATE RECORDS WILL EASE ECONOMIC HARDSHIP. CONSULATE TABRIZ FINDS GOI WAS BADLY UNDERPREPARED TO HANDLE TABRIZ VIOLENCE, WHICH WAS DEFINITELY WELL-ORGANIZED AND PLANNED, DOWN TO ASSEMBLY OF WEAPONS AND FIREBOMBS. MOBS WERE MOSTLY UNEMPLOYED YOUTH, WHICH COULD INDICATE FUTURE PROBLEMS. AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI HAS CONDEMNED VIOLENCE, BUT DEFENDS RIGHT TO DEMONSTRATE. NEW INFORMATION INDICATES PEACEFUL DEMONSTRATIONS TOOK PLACE FEB.

18 IN AHWAZ AND MASHAD, IN ADDITION TO OTHERS REPORTED REFTELS A AND B. SOME UNIVERSITIES WILL REMAIN CLOSED BEYOND NORMAL OPENING DATES, AND NATIONAL UNIVERSITY IN TEHRAN HAD BRIEF FLURY OF AGITATION FEB. 21. OPPOSITIONISTS IN TEHRAN SURPRISED BY TABRIZ VIOLENCE AND UNCERTAIN HOW THEY WILL HANDLE PRESENT EVENTS. END SUMMARY.

FEB. 22 PRESS REPORTING OF TABRIZ SITUATION NOTES TABRIZ JUSTICE MINISTRY SOURCE SAID MORE THAN 250 PEOPLE HAVE BEEN ARAYSTED, MANY OF WHOM ARE "PROFESSIONAL AGITATORS" BEING SOUGHT IN OTHER PROVINCIAL CITIES BY POLICE. ACCUSED ARE BEING QUESTIONED BY TEAM OF CIVIL MAGISTRAT CES WHO REFUSE COMMENT ON COURSE OF INTERROGATIONS. ACCORDING TO FARSI PRESS, ACCUSED WILL ALL BE TRIED IN CIVIL COURTS.

PRESS MORNING FEB. 22 PUT DEATH TOLL AT NINE WITH DEATH OF THREE OTHERS, BUT CONSUL METRINKO IN TABRIZ SAYS DEAD ALMOST CERTAINLY GREATER THAN THAT, NOTING 200 AS UPPER LIMIT CURRENTLY BEING DISCUSSED. ONE FOREIGN OBSERVER VIEWED SEVEN SMALL PICKUP TRUCKS LOADED WITH BODIES IN THE BAZAAR, WHICH WOULD SUGGEST SOMEWHERE AROUND 80-100 DEAD AT THAT LOCATION. NUMBER OF WOUNDED CERTAINLY HIGHER THAN OFFICIAL GOI ESTIMATE OF 125; ONE HOSPITAL ALONE TREATED MORE THAN 150. FULL DESCRIPTION OF EVENTS BEING POUCHED FEB. 23 (REF C). ONE CORRECTION TO EARLIER DESCRIPTION CONTAINED REF B SHOULD BE NOTED: ARMY DID NOT ARRIVE UNTIL LATE MORNING/EARLY AFTERNOON FEB.
18, AFTER POLICE HAD LOST CONTROL INITIALLY. ARMY UNITS CAME FROM MARAND (45 MINUTES AWAY) AND MARAGHE (TWO HOURS AWAY).

CONSUL METRINKO ALSO FOUND MUNICIPAL GOVERNMENT WAS NOT RPT NOT PREPARED FOR RIOT, AND SUGGESTS THAT THERE WILL BE SOME TIGHTENING UP IN CIVIL ADMINISTRATION AND LAW ENFORCEMENT IN THE REGION. AFTER DISCUSSIONS WITH OBSERVERS, CONSUL BELIEVES BULK OF RIOTERS WERE YOUNG MEN, MOSTLY UNEMPLOYED, AND THAT GOVERNMENT DESCRIPTION OF GROUP AS "ISLAMIC MARXISTS" HAS NO MEANING IN TERMS OF WHAT HAPPENDED. MOB CAME FROM LOWEST STRATA OF SOCIETY WHICH HAS TRADITIONALLY BEEN MOST VOLATILE GROUP IN PERVASIVELY GRIM RELIGIOUS ENVIRONMENT OF IRANIAN LOWER CLASS.

RELIGIOUS BELIEFS ARE DEEP (REF A), AND MANY OF GROUP BELIEVED THEY WERE PERFORMING HOLY DUTY BY MOURNING DEATH OF QOM "MARTYRS." CONSUL CONCLUDES TABRIZ INCIDENT HAS OPENED GATES FOR RELIGIOUS AND SOCIAL FORCES THAT WILL NOT RPT NOT BE EASILY PLACATED. EMBASSY BELIEVES SITUATION NOT THAT DIFFICULT--GOI HAS UNTIL NOW REFRAINED FROM USING FULL RANGE OF SOCIAL CONTROLS, AND OBSERVERS IN TEHRAN BELIEVE STATEMENTS TO DATE DO NOT SUGGEST BACKING DOWN FROM BASICALLY MORE LIBERAL STANCE.

GOI'S INITIAL VIEW SEEMS TO BE THAT TABRIZ WAS REGRETTABLE EXCEPTION TO PEACEFUL DEMONSTRATIONS ELSEWHERE (SEE BELOW) AND THAT FOREIGN ELEMENTS AND INEPT POLICE ACTIVITY WERE TO BLAME FOR MATTERS GETTING OUT OF HAND. ------------------011349 240504Z /21 R 230534Z FEB 78 ZDK FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 7114 USIA WASHDC DEFENSE INTELLIGENCE AGENCY WASHDC CENTRAL INTELLIGENCE AGENCY WASHDC INFO AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 01879

MOB ORGANIZATION WAS EXCELLENT, AS SHOWN BY FACT GROUP WAS ABLE TO SPLIT UP AND TARGET SPECIFIC TYPES OF BUILDINGS-PUBLIC OFFICES, BANKS, MOVIES, SOCIAL CLUBS--WHICH REPRESENTED SECULAR SOCIETY AS WELL AS PLACES WHERE WOMEN "EXPOSE" THEMSELVES (A FUNDAMENTALIST MOSLEM NO-NO). FACT GROUP HAD GATHERED WEAPONS AND PREPARED BOMBS SUGGESTS PLANNING ABOVE AND BEYOND PREVIOUS INCIDENTS OVER PAST FOUR MONTHS. SUCH ORGANIZATION IS PROBABLY BASIC REASON WHY GENERAL VIEW IS THAT RIOTERS HAD SOME SORT OF LEADERSHIP, PERHAPS EVEN FOREIGN HELP.

OTHER SOURCES GIVE US POSITIVE CONFIRMATION THAT FEB. 18 DEMONSTRATIONS IN QOM, AHWAZ, AND MASHAD WERE PEACEFUL, THOUGH POLICE MAINTAINED HELICOPTER SURVEILLANCE OVER QOM GROUP. FEB. 22 PRESS REPORTED MINOR DUSTUP FEB. 21 AT TEHRAN'S NATIONAL UNIVERSITY, WHERE GROUP OF AGITATORS WOUNDED TWO CAMPUS GUARDS, DESTROYED AN INFORMATION KIOSK, AND BROKE WINDOWS BEFORE BEING DISPERSED BY POLICE.

PRESS ALSO REPORTS OTHER UNIVERSITIES ARE NOT OPEN AROUND COUNTRY, BUT WE BELIEVE THIS IS MERELY END OF NORMAL EXAM PERIOD. AZARBADIGAN UNIVERSITY IN TABRIZ, HOWEVER, WILL NOT OPEN FOR SECOND TERM UNTIL FEB. 26, A WEEK BEYOND THE NORMAL OPENING DATE.

WESTERN JOURNALIST WHO HAS TALKED WITH UNION OF NATIONAL FRONT FORCES REPRESENTATIVES FOUND THESE OPPOSITIONISTS AS SURPRISED AS EVERYONE ELSE ABOUT VIOLENCE IN TABRIZ AND AT A LOSS TO EXPLAIN THEM EXCEPT IN TERMS OF REPRESSED PEOPLES TAKING UP CUDGELS OF FREEDOM AND SIMILAR BOILERPLATE. SOURCE SAID GROUP PLANS STATEMENT BUT NOT SURE WHAT IT WILL BE, AND MAY WANT TO WALK SOFTLY UNTIL IT FEELS IT HAS BETTER INFO. GROUP HAD SUPPORTED AYATOLLAHS' PRE-FEB. 18 CALL FOR PEACEFUL DEMONSTRATIONS TO MOURN QOM "MARTYRS," AND TENDS TO DISBELIEVE STORIES OF "FOREIGN INTERVENTION."

EMBASSY COMMENT: UNFOLDING INVESTIGATION OF EVENT NOT FINISHED YET, BUT INITIAL READING OF GOI REACTION IS SURPRISING AND SOMEWHAT CHEERING. GOI HAS NOT GONE INTO REPRESSIVE MODE, IMMEDIATELY TIGHTENING UP SECURITY, AS MANY FEARED. IT WOULD SEEM THAT GOI AUTHORITIES ARE REALLY REASSESSING HOW TABRIZ EVENTS WILL AFFECT LIBERALIZATION POLICY. FACT THAT RIOTERS ARE BEING QUESTIONED BY CIVIL MAGISTRATES AND THUS FAR APPEAR TO BE HEADED FOR CIVIL COURTS IS POSITIVE SIGN, BUT MAY JUST BE INDICATION THAT HARD LINE REACTION HAS NOT YET GATHERED STEAM. THRONE HAS BEEN NOTABLY SILENT ON EVENTS, PREFERRING TO LET OTHERS (CABINET, SENATORS) SPEAK OUT FOR NOW.

AS YOU WILL SEE FROM REFTEL, FORMULATION AND APPLICATION OF MOST FAVORED NATION (MFN) LANGUAGE APPEARS TO BE ONLY UNRESOLVED OBSTACLE TO SUCCESSFUL CONCLUSION OF OUR NUCLEAR COOPERATION AGREEMENT WITH IRAN. SOMEWHAT TO MY SURPRISE, MANZOUR HAS SUGGESTED LANGUAGE (PARA 7, REFTEL) WHICH INDICATES A GOI WILLINGNESS TO ACCEPT A LIMITED APPLICATION OF THE MFN CONCEPT. ASSUME HE WOULD NOT HAVE DONE SO WITHOUT EXPLICIT AUTHORITY FROM HIGHER UP. BALANCE OF MESSAGE, HOWEVER, IMPLIES THAT WE STILL HAVE A PROBLEM EVEN WITH THIS COMPROMISE PROPOSAL, BUT IT UNCLEAR PRECISELY WHAT IT IS.

IF WE ANTICIPATE THE POSSIBILITY OF ARRANGEMENTS WITH OTHER COUNTRIES WHICH WE WOULD BE UNWILLING TO EXTEND TO IRAN HIDING BEHIND OUR FORMULATION OF "UNDER COMPARABLE CIRCUMSTANCES" (PARA 2, REFTEL), THEN IT SEEMS THAT WE ARE NOT MEETING THE PRESIDENT'S COMMITMENT TO THE SHAH. IF THIS IS OUR INTENTION I FIND IT DIFFICULT TO DISCERN WHAT WE THINK OUR PROBLEM IS WITH IRANIAN FORMULATION AS AMENDED BY MANZOUR. I HAVE NO USEFUL INSIGHTS AS TO WHAT WE MAY BELIEVE TO BE A DILEMMA OR HOW IT MIGHT BE DEALT WITH BUT HOPE YOU CAN OVERSEE ITS RESOLUTION WHILE YOU ARE IN WASHINGTON.

FROM WHAT WE HAVE BEEN TOLD PREVIOUSLY, AND WHAT JAMSHID AMOUZEGAR MENTIONED IN PASSING TO ME YESTERDAY ABOUT IRAN'S NUCLEAR ENERGY DEVELOPMENT STRATEGY, I SENSE THAT WHAT GOI WANTS IS A CLEAR SHOT AT GOING FOR FAST BREEDER REACTORS IF NOTHING ELSE TURNS UP BY 1985. SINCE THIS PRESUMABLY DOES VIOLENCE TO OUR STRATEGY OF LIMITING DANGERS OF PROLIFERATION, THERIN MAY LIE THE DILEMMA.

THE PROCEDURES MANZOUR SUGGESTS, ASSUMING WE ARE ABLE TO GET PAST THE MFN HURDLE, SUGGESTS THAT THERE IS NO REPEAT NO POSSIBILITY OF OUR BEING ABLE TO SIGN AN AGREEMENT ON FEB 28. I AM RELUCTANT TO EXPLORE POSSIBLE SHORTCUTS HOWEVER UNTIL WE HAVE A BETTER PICTURE OF WHETHER IT IS WORTH THE EFFORT.
FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY SUMMONED ME AFTERNOON OF FEBRUARY 25 AND EMPHASIZING MATTER WAS "TOP SECRET" ASKED THAT FOLLOWING MESSAGE BE PASSED TO THE PRESIDENT FROM THE SHAH.

I MET WITH MR. BEGIN ON THE 23 OF FEBRUARY. HE EXPLAINED TO ME THE KNOWN ISRAELI POSITION AND ALL THAT CONSTITUTES A MENACING SITUATION TO HIS COUNTRY WHICH HAS TO FACE 11,000 TANKS, MORE THAN 2000 WAR PLANES, SEVERAL THOUSAND ARTILLERY GUNS AND ABOUT 10,000 APC'S FROM POTENTIAL ENEMIES. MR. BEGIN EXPLAINED THE ISRAELI PLAN FOR THE WEST BANK CONSISTING OF MAJOR RECTIFICATIONS (FOR HIM) OF THE PRESENT BORDER AND ALSO HIS IDEAS ABOUT THE SINAI. ALTHOUGH HE DID NOT MENTION SPECIFICALLY SETTLEMENTS IN THE SINAI.

HE ALSO EXPLAINED HIS GREAT CONCERN AND WORRY ABOUT SAUDI ARABIA GETTING F-15'S AS WELL AS ALL THE DIFFICULTIES HE HAS TO FACE FROM HIS OPPOSITION IN ISRAEL. I STATED THAT IN MAY OPINION IT IS IN THE INTEREST OF ALL AND ESPECIALLY IN THE INTEREST OF ISRAEL TO MAKE PEACE WITH EGYPT AND ESPECIALLY BECAUSE PRESIDENT SADAT IS SO REASONABLE. I EVEN TOLD HIM THAT I DID NOT KNOW IF I WAS IN PRESIDENT SADAT'S POSITION WHETHER I WOULD GO AS FAR AS HE HAS GONE, NOTING THAT SADAT EVEN WANTED TO HAVE JOINT VENTURES WITH ISRAEL IN THE SINAI AND ELSEWHERE.

THE SECURITY OF ISRAEL DEMANDS THAT IT SHOULD HAVE SECURE BORDERS AND NOT HAVE TO WORRY, AT LEAST ON HER WESTERN FRONT. IF ISRAEL COULD MAKE PEACE WITH EGYPT THE SAUDIS COULD NOT ADOPT ANY POSITION OTHER THAN THAT OF THE EGYPTIANS. MY VIEW IS THAT THE WEST BANK OF JORDAN SHOULD HAVE MINOR ADJUSTMENTS, THAT THE WESTERN BANK SHOULD BE DEMILITARIZED AND GIVEN TO JORDAN WHO WOULD KNOW WHAT TO DO WITH THE PALISTANIANS WITHIN THE KINGDOM OF JORDAN. THIS WOULD PERMIT JORDAN TO NEGOTIATE PEACE AT THE SAME TIME AS EGYPT.

I ALSO SAID THAT I BELIEVE PRESIDENT SADAT WANTED PEACE AND THAT HE HAD NO AMBITIONS TOWARD THE EAST AND THAT HIS MAIN PROBLEMS WERE WITHIN EGYPT AND IN AFRICA. FOR EGYPT, JORDAN AND SAUDI ARABIA THE DREADFUL ALTERNATIVE TO MAKING PEACE IS THAT HE WOULD JOIN THE REJECTION FRONT WITH ALL THE CONSEQUENCES. I DID REPEAT THAT I CONSIDER THE CREATION OF AN INDEDENDENT STATE OF PALESTINE AS A VERY DANGEROUS THING. FOR ALL OF THESE REASONS I SUGGESTED THAT THE OPPOSITION IN ISRAEL SHOULD USE THEIR HEADS MORE RATHER THAN TO FOLLOW THEIR HEARTS AND SENTIMENTS. - UNQUOTE

I ASKED HOW THE SHAH HAD FOUND BEGIN. KHALATBARY SAID THAT CONSIDERING BEGIN'S OPPOSITION IN ISRAEL AND HIS PREVIOUS EXPERIENCE AND ATTITUDE THE SHAH HAD NOT FOUND HIM AS UNREASONABLE MAN. HE HAD LISTENED TO WHAT THE SHAH HAD TO SAY AND STATED HIS OWN POSITION CALMLY AND UNEMOTIONALLY.

1978TEHRAN01932.subject: TABRIZ RIOTS: CURRENT DEVELOPMENTS AND SOME RANDOM THOUGHTS

segments.text: SUMMARY. GOI REAFFIRMS FIGURE OF 9 DEAD IN RITOS BUT MOST KNOWLEDGEABLE SOURCES PLACE NUMBER SOMEWHERE BETWEEN 100 AND

LOCAL PRESS CARRIES FIGURE OF BETWEEN 260 AND 450 ARRESTED AND NOTES MOST ARE MALES BETWEEN 15 AND 30 YEARS OLD. CONFIDENTIAL PARLIAMENTARY SOURCE INDICATES GOI NOW BELIEVES JUST OVER 6000 WERE INVOLVED IN DEMONSTRATIONS AND THAT MOBS WERE ORGANIZED SEPARATELY AT 4 TO 6 LOCATIONS. HIGH POWERED MILITARY COMMITTEE SENT TO TABRIZ FOR INVESTIGATION, AND IMPERIAL INVESTIGATING TEAM INCLUDES PARLIAMENTARIANS, BUT NAMES NOT BEING ANNOUNCED. MILITARY REMAIN IN CONTROL OF TABRIZ, BUT POLICE ARE RESUMING FUNCTIONS. HOUSE TO HOUSE SEARCHES GOING ON FOR KNOWN RITOERS: ONE POLICEMAN ARRESTED FOR LOOTING RESURGENCE PARTY HQS. EXPECTED STORIES OF POLICE PROVOCATION FINALLY BEGINNING TO SURFACE, BUT SEEM UNLIKELY.

SOME LOCAL JOURNALISTS HAVE CONNECTED WHAT THEY SEE AS RENEWED SOVIET INTEREST IN RELIGIOUS MATTERS OVER PAST 6 MONTHS WITH POSSIBLE CLANDESTINE ROLE IN TABRIZ AFFAIR, BUT THERE IS NO RPT NO EVIDENCE TO SUPPORT SUCH LINKAGE, THOUGH SOVIETS HAVE SHOWN GREATER INTEREST IN RELIGIOUS AFFAIRS OVER PAST FEW MONTHS. OVERWHELMING VIEW OF UNINVOLVED OBSERVERS IS THAT RELIGIOUS FUNDAMENTALISM FUELED BY DISSATISFACTION WITH PACE OF MODERN LIFE WAS SUFFICIENT CAUSE. END SUMMARY.

MININFO HOMAYOUN REITERATED FOR PRESS FEB 23 GOI FIGURE OF 9 DEAD AT TABRIZ, BUT VIRTUALLY NO OTHERS TAKE THIS SERIOUSLY. CONSULATE TABRIZ ESTIMATES GIVEN IN REF A, AND LOCAL JOURNALIST WITH EXCELLENT CONTACTS SAID HIS BEST GUESS WAS 180 DEAD, THOUGH OTHER (NATIONAL FRONT OPPOSITIONIST) ESTIMATES RANGED AS HIGH AS 300. INJURED CLEARLY EXCEEDED OFFICIAL FIGURES OF 125, BUT MANY RECEIVED ONLY MINOR BRUISES.

ESTIMATES OF THOSE ARRESTED RANGE FROM KEHYAN'S 262 TO ETELLA'AT'S 450. PARLIAMENTARY SOURCE TOLD POLOFF EVENING FEB 23 THAT PRIVATE GOI REPORT TO SELECTED MAJLES MEMBERS INDICATED JUST OVER 6000 WERE ACTIVELY INVOLVED IN RIOTING. REPORT ALSO INDICATED MOB WAS ORGANIZED AT 4 TO 6 LOCATIONS WITH SOME OF THESE GROUPS SPLITTING UP LATER. RUMOR THAT TABRIZ MOSQUES WERE CLOSED BY GOI PRIOR TO RIOTS NOW CIRCULATIONG IN TEHRAN, BUT WITHOUT FOUNDATION. MAIN MOSQUE IN TABRIZ MAY HAVE HAD RESTRICTED ACCESS IN LATER STAGES OF GATHERING, BUT EYEWITNESSES SAW MOBS SPILL OUT OF ALL MAJOR MOSQUES EN ROUTE TO CONFRONTATION.

PRESS FEB 23 ANNOUNCED HIGH POWERED MILITARY COMMITTEE OF 15 HAD ARRIVED IN TABRIZ HEADED BY FOLLOWING KEY GENERALS: GENERAL JAFAR SHAFAGHAT, VICE CHIEF OF SUPREMEM COMMANDER'S STAFF (SCS) (REPORTEDLY AN AZARBAIJANI PLACE IN CHARGE OF THE MISSION TO MAKE CERTAIN THE SHAH GETS TRUE STORY); LT GEN NASER FIROOZMAND, CHIEF, MILITARY SPECIAL INSPECTION, SCS; MAJOR GENERAL MOHAMMAD RAHIMI, VICE DEPUTY FOR OPERATIONS AND INTELLIGENCE COMMANDER FOR IRANIAN GROUND FORCES, AND RETIRED MAJOR GENERAL HBIB BEYTOLLAHI, FORMERLY IN INTELLIGENCE OPERATIONS (J-2) FOR SCS. OTHER TEAMS ON SCENE INCLUDE MAGISTRATES (REF A) AND IMPERIAL INSPECTION TEAM OF CIVILIANS WHICH INCLUDES SOME PARLIAMENTARIANS WHOSE NAMES HAVE NOT BEEN RELEASED.

CONSULATE TABRIZ REPORTS MILITARY ARE STILL IN CONTROL OF CITY, BUT POLICE ARE RESUMING FUNCTIONS. HOUSE-TO-HOUSE SEARCHES ARE GOING ON FOR KNOWN AND SUSPECTED RIOT PARTICIPANTS. CONSUL REPORTS ONE OF HIS ECECURITY ESCORTS WAS ARRESTED FOR LOOTING WHEN SEARCH TEAM DISCOVERED MATERIAL FROM GUTTED RESURGENCE PARTY HQS IN HIS HOME DURING SEARCH. MILITARY FORCES NOW PRESENT IN TABRIZ ARE MAINLY KURDISH TROOPS FROM KERMANSHAH WHO DO NOT SPEAK TURKISH AND WHO, ACCORDING TO CONSUL METRINKO, BELIEVE THEY ARE PROTECTING TABRIZ AGAINST COMMUNISTS.

RANDOM STORIES OF POLICE PROVOCATION AT TABRIZ ARE BEGINNING TO SURFACE IN TEHRAN, BUT AS NEAR AS WE CAN DETERMINE, THESE HAVE NO BASIS IN FACT. CONSULATE TABRIZ NOTES ALL POLICE IN CITY ARE NATIVES OF REGION AND WOULD NOT WANT TO ENGAGE IN VIOLENCE, PARTICULARLY AGAINST TOUGH TURKISHSPEAKING MOB. ONE REASON ADVANCED HERE FOR INADEQUATE GOI PREPARATION FOR EVENTS WAS ABSENCE OF PROVINCIAL GOVERNOR AZMUDEH ON TOUR OF PROVINCE FOR 4 DAYS PRECEDING FEB 18.

ONE LOCAL AND ANOTHER FOREGIN JOURNALISTHERE HAVE BOTH NOTED OVER PAST 6 MONTHS INCREASING INTEREST OF SOVIET DIPLOMATIC PERSONNEL IN RELIGIOUS MATTERS (EMB COMMENT: THIS WOULD HARDLY BE SURPRISING FOR ANY ASTUTE OBSERVER) AND HAVE CONNECTED SOVIET'S INTEREST WITH POSSIBLE INVOLVEMENT IN TABRIZ AFFAIR AT CLANDESTINE LEVEL OR THROUGH LIBYAN SURROGATES. EMB HAS NO RPT NO EVIDENCE TO SUPPORT THIS VIEW, AND ALL INFO WE HAVE POINTS TO TABRIZ FRACAS AS MANIFESTATION OF RELIGIOUS FEELING.

WE WOULD NOT RULE OUT POSSIBLE MOB LEADERSHIP BY A FEW WHO HAD RECEIVED SOME TRAINING ABROAD, BUT UNLESS WE SEE MORE CONCLUSIVE EVIDENCE THAN HAS SURFACED SO FAR (MOSTLY UNSUPPORTED GOI STATEMENTS), WE WOULD SHARE VIEW OF VAST MAJORITY OF UNINVOLVED OBSERVERS WHO FEEL SIZE OF TABRIZ DISTURBANCES MOSTLY DUE TO ROUGH TURKISH PEASANTRY GETTING WORKE UP ON RELIGIOUS GROUNDS AND TAKING OUT ITS DISSATISFACTION WITH COURSE OF CHANGE IN MODERN LIFE ON SYMBOLS AND PRESENCE OF THAT LIFE IN TABRIZ. AT THE SAME TIME, EVIDENCE IS FAR FROM IN YET ON WHAT KIND OF PEOPLE MIGHT HAVE BEEN THE INSTIGATORS AND COORDINATORS BEHIND THE PEASANT RELIGIOUS FURY.
BOMB THREAT TO CONSULATE SHIRAZ BEING REPORTED SEPTEL.

1978TEHRAN02001.subject: GAO REVIEW: "EFFECTIVENESS OF COUNTER- TERRORISM MEASURES"

segments.text: POST CONCURS WITH PROPOSED VISIT GAO TEAM.
GOI HAS BEEN EXTRAORDINARILY RESPONSIVE TO OUR REQUESTS FOR SECURITY ASSISTANCE AND WE WILL WANT TO CONSIDER WITH CARE WHO THE GAO TEAM CONTACTS AND WHAT SHOULD BE DISCUSSED.
PLEASE ADVISE ACTUAL ITINERARY.

1978TEHRAN02036.subject: IRAN AIR TAXI AND THE G. WILLIAM MILLER CONFIRMATION HEARING

segments.text: HEARING

VICE MINISTER OF WAR GENERAL TOUFANIAN SUMMONED ME TO HIS OFFICE FEBRUARY 27 TO EXPRESS RISING INDIGANTION OVER PRESS STORIES AND OTHER REPORTS HE HAS BEEN GETTING ABOUT QUESTIONS BEING RAISED IN THE CONGRESS IN THE COURSE OF WILLIAM MILLER'S CONFIRMATION HEARINGS AS CHIARMAN OF THE FEDERAL RESERVE BOARD. TOUFANIAN SAID THAT HE WOULD LIKE TO MAKE SEVERAL POINTS WITH ME WHICH HE HOPED COULD ALSO BE MADE WITH THE CONGRESS.

IT SHOULD BE CLEARLY UNDERSTOOD THAT THE SHAH MAKES MAJOR MILITARY PROCUREMENT DECISIONS. HE DOES THIS ON THE BASIS OF THE BEST INFORMATION AVAILABLE AND IT IS WELLKNOWN THAT HE IS AN EXPERT IN THIS FIELD. IN THE CASE OF THE BELL HELICOPTER SALE TO IRAN, FOR EXAMPLE, HE SAID THAT THE SHAH PERSONALLY HEARD SALES AND TECHNICAL PRESENTATIONS FROM SEVERAL U.S. AND WESTERN HELICOPTER MANUFACTURERS. IN PARTICULAR HE EXAMINED WITH GREAT CARE AND IN DETAIL THE MERITS OF BELL AND SIKORSKY HELICOPTERS. HE CONCLUDED THAT BELL HAD THE BEST TO OFFER FOR IRAN'S MONEY AND WAS SUITED TO IRAN'S STRATEGIC NEEDS.
ALLEGATIONS OR INNUENDOS SUGGESTING THAT THIS DECISION WAS BASED ON NON-TECHNICAL AND/OR NON-STRATEGIC CONSIDERATIONS WAS INCORRECT, OFFENSIVE AND INSULTING.

GENERAL KHATAMI WAS INDEED A FOUNDING MEMBER OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF IRAN AIR TAXI AND THIS IS A MATTER OF PUBLIC RECORD. THERE HAS NEVER BEEN ANYTHING SECRETIVE ABOUT KHATAMI'S PAST CONNECTION WITH AIR TAXI. HIS TIES WITH THAT COMPANY, HOWEVER, WERE TERMINATED AROUND 1967. TOUFANIAN SHOWED ME A NOTARIZED STATEMENT DATED MAY 10, 1973 LISTING THE NAMES OF THE THREE SHARE HOLDERS OF AIR TAXI. KHATAMI'S NAME WAS NOT AMONG THEM. TOUFANIAN WENT ON TO MAKE THE POINT THAT EVEN IF KHATAMI HAD BEEN AN OFFICIAL AND SHARE HOLDER OF AIR TAXI UP UNTIL THE TIME OF HIS DEATH IN 1975 THERE WAS NOTHING ILLEGAL ABOUT THIS.

TO THIS VERY DAY IRANIAN OFFICIALS ARE NOT PRECLUDED BY LAW FROM HAVING OUTSIDE PRIVATE INTERESTS ANY MORE THAN U.S. SENATORS ARE. THE PAYMENT OF THE DOLS 2.9 MILLION FEE TO AIR TAXI WAS A NORMAL DISCHARGE OF A COMMERCIAL OBLIGATION TO A COMPANY WHICH BELL HELICOPTER HAD HAD AN ASSOCIATION FOR THE PREVIOUS 15 YEARS. THIS PAYMENT IN LARGE MEASURE REPRESENTED COMPENSATION FOR EXPENSES AND SERVICES AIR TAXI HAD UNDERTAKEN ON BELL HELICOPTERS BEHALF AND WAS THE CONSEQUENCE OF AN ENTIRELY CORRECT AND RESPECTABLE, PRINCIPAL-AGENT RELATIONSHIP.

TOUFANIAN SAID THAT AIR TAXI HAD BEEN EASED OUT OF THE BELL HELICOPTER SALES PICTURE BECAUSE IT HAD INITIALLY INDICATED ITS TERMS FOR THE SALE WAS TEN PERCENT FOR HELICOPTERS AND 25 PERCENT FOR SPARES. THESE FEES ON A POTENTIAL SALE OF DOLS ONE BILLION WERE DEEMED OUTRAGEOUS. SUBSEQUENT CONTRACTUAL RENEGOTIATIONS BROUGHT THE AGENT'S FEE DOWN TO ONE-HALF OF ONE PERCENT AND FINALLY AIR TAXI WAS ELIMINATED ALTOGETHER.

TOUFANIAN EXPRESSED DISTRESS OVER THE DECEASED GENERAL KHATAMI'S GOOD NAME BEING IMPUGNED AND PUZZLEMENT OVER THE MOTIVES OF THOSE WHO SEEMED TO BE INCLINED TO INTERPRET A STRAIGHT FORWARD, ABOE-THE-BOARD TRANSACTION AS SOMETHING SINISTER, SHADY AND ILLEGAL.

COMMENT: TOUFANIAN DID NOT STRIKE ME AS PROTESTING TOO MUCH. ON THE CONTRARY HE SEEMED TO BE GENUINELY DISTRESSED THAT THIS AFFAIR WAS BEING MISINTERPRETED TO THE POSSIBLE DISCREDIT OF HONORABLE PEOPLE IN BOTH COUNTRIES. HE WAS OPEN AND FORTHCOMING IN OFFERING WHAT DOCUMENTATION WAS AVAILABLE TO HIM IN SUPPORTING THE FOREGOING STATEMENTS AND COMMENTS. A SEPARATE MESSAGE REPORTS OUR INDEPENDENT FINDINGS OF WHAT THE PUBLIC RECORD REVEALS WHICH APPEARS TO CORROBORATE WITH WHAT GENERAL TOUFANIAN TOLD ME. FURTHER IT IS AN INDISPUTABLE FACT THAT IT IS NOT RPT NOT ILLEGAL FOR GOI OFFICIALS TO HAVE PRIVATE INTERESTS EVEN THOUGH THERE MAY BE AN APPERANCE OF A CONFLICT OF INTEREST.
THERE IS LEGISLATION IN THE WORKS TO LIMIT AND DEFINE WHAT PUBLIC OFFICIALS CAN DO IN THIS RESPECT BUT IT HAS NOT YET PASSED INTO LAW.

1978TEHRAN02038.subject: U.S. POLICY DECISIONS ON HORN OF AFRICA

segments.text: I MET WITH ACTING FOREIGN MINISTER ZELLI AFTERNOOON OF FEBURARY 26 AND CONVEYED TO HIM THE FIRST THREE POINTS MADE IN PARA TWO OF REFTEL. ZELLI COMMENTED THAT HE DID NOT SEE ANYTHING NEW IN THE FIRST TWO POINTS AND EVIDENCED LITTLE INTEREST OVER THE THIRD POINT. WE THEN DISCUSSED THE SITUATION IN THE HORN OF AFRICA TOUCHING ON SUCH QUESTIONS AS SOVIET AND CUBAN INVOLVEMENT, THEIR ULTIMATE OBJECTIVES AND SIAD BAARE'S RECENT RESPONSE TO A CALL FOR A WITHDRAWAL OF SOMALI FORCES FROM THE OGADEN.

ZELLI THEN ASKED WHETHER WE TRUSTED SOVIET AND ETHIOPIAN ASSURANCES THAT THERE WAS NO INTENTION TO INVADE SOMALIA PROPER AND WHAT WOULD WE DO IF THEY DID NOT HOLD TO THEIR PROMISE. UNDER THE CIRCUMSTANCES I FELT IT APPROPRIATE TO MOVE TO POINT FOUR OF PARA TWO. ON HEARING WHAT WE MAY BE PREPARED TO DO IN THE EVENT OF AN INVASION OF SOMALIA, ZELLI BRIGHTENED PERCEPTIBLY. HE SAID "NOW THAT HAS REAL SUBSTANCE" AND TOOK VERY CAREFUL NOTE OF WHAT I TOLD HIM.

COMMENT: THIS WILL DOUBTLESS BE REPORTED TO THE SHAH. HOW IT WILL BE FACTORED INTO IRAN'S CALCULATION OF WHAT IT MIGHT DO IN THE EVENT SOMALIA IS INVADED I DO NOT KNOW. THERE IS NO DOUBT, HOWEVER, THAT IRAN IS DEEPLY CONCERNED ABOUT DEVELOPMENTS IN THE HORN OF AFRICA AND THAT IT HAS BEEN CONSULTING CLOSELY WITH SAUDI ARABIA ON POSSIBLE CONTINGENCIES (TEHRAN 01614).
DEPARTMENT MAY WISH TO PASS TO EMBASSIES CAIRO, JIDDA, ADDIS ABABA AND MOGADISCIO.

EMOFF, ACCOMPANIED BY E/C SECTION FSL, VISITED OFFICE OF REGISTRAR OF COMPANIES, MINISTRY OF JUSTICE, TEHRAN, ON FEBRUARY 26 AND EXAMINED THE REGISTRY OF COMPANIES BOOK. BOOK IN QUESTION CONTAINS VARIOUS DATA ON ALL REGISTERED IRANIAN COMPANIES, E.G., NAMES OF COMPANY OFFICERS/DIRECTORS, CAPITALIZATION, PURPOSE FOR WHICH COMPANY FORMED, TYPE OF COMPANY (PUBLIC OR PRIVATE), DIVIDEND DECLARATION RECORD, REELECTION OF SHAREHOLDERS. ENTRY FOR APRIL 20, 1957, IS FOR AIR TAXI COMPANY AND GIVES ROUTINE INFORMATION ON COMPANY, INCLUDING LISTING OF FOLLOWING FOUR INDIVIDUALS AS MEMBERS OF BOARD OF DIRECTORS AT TIME OF REGISTRATION AHMAD SHAFIGH, 2) MOHAMMAD AMIR KHATAMI, 3) NADER JAHANBANI

AMIR HOSSEIN AZAM ZANGANEH. EMBASSY BELIEVES REGISTRY OF COMPANIES BOOK IS A REASONABLY ACCURATE COMPENDIUM OF INFORMATION ON MOST IRANIAN COMPANIES BUT WOULD POINT OUT THAT ADDITIONS AND AMENDMENTS TO COMPANY RECORDS ARE FREQUENTLY RECORDED IN VARIOUS FILE FOLDERS MAINTAINED IN REGISTRY OFFICE.
OFFICE OF REGISTRAR OF COMPANIES, MINISTRY OF JUSTICE, IS PUBLIC OFFICE AND ANYONE HAVING LEGITIMATE INTEREST IN HAVING COMPANY DATA CAN CONSULT REGISTRY BOOK.

EXISTENCE OF OFFICE OF REGISTRAR OF COMPANIES AND KIND OF INFORMATION MAINTAINED THERE IS WELL KNOWN IN IRANIAN RPT IRANIAN BUSINESS COMMUNITY. EMBASSY BELIEVES THAT EXISTENCE THIS OFFICE LESS WELL KNOWN TO FOREIGN NATIONAL HEADS OF FOREIGN COMPANIES HERE ALTHOUGH IRANIAN AUDITING, ACCOUNTING, AND LEGAL STAFFS OF SUCH COMPANIES WOULD CERTAINLY BE AWARE OF REGISTRY OFFICE. WHILE IT IS DIFFICULT TO MAKE A GENERALIZED STATEMENT AS TO HOW WELL KNOWN THE REGISTRY OFFICE IS IN EXPATRIATE BUSINESS COMMUNITY HERE. EMBASSY INCLINED TO BELIEVE THAT ANY LARGE U.S. CORPORATION CONTEMPLATING A MAJOR BUSINESS UNDERTAKING IN IRAN WOULD MORE LIKELY CONSULT WITH OTHER SOURCES RATHER THAN GO DIRECTLY TO REGISTRY OFFICE, E.G.
EMBASSY, (FOR WTDR), CORPORATION'S OWN IRANIAN LAWYERS, IRANIAN BANK.

1978TEHRAN02101.subject: US POLICY DECISIONS ON HORN OF AFRICA

segments.text: NO, THERE WAS NO MISUNDERSTANDING OF IMPORT OF PARA 2D OF STATE 49635 ON MY PART OR I BELIEVE ON ZELLI'S. IN FACT TO MAKE CERTAIN THAT THERE WAS ABSOLUTELY NO MISUNDERSTANDING I READ HIM THAT PARTICULAR PARAGRAPH WORD FOR WORD.

INCIDENTALLY, THE IRANIANS, AND POSSIBLY OTHERS, DO NOT TAKE KINDLY TO OUR INDICATING THAT "WE HAVE NO OBJECTION TO THEIR SUPPLY OF NONE-US-ORIGIN WEAPONS TO SOMALIA" OR ANYWHERE ELSE FOR THAT MATTER. IT IS NO SO MUCH THE SUBSTANCE OF THE MATTER BUT THE SUGGESTION THAT WE SOMEHOW HAVE A RIGHT TO TELL THEM WHAT THEY CAN DO. WE MIGHT EXAMINE A LITTLE MORE CAREFULLY HOW WE PHRASE OUR POSITION ON SUCH QUESTIONS GIVEN THE SENSITIVITIES OF OUR FRIENDS HERE TO ANY APPEARANCE OF U.S. TUTELAGE.

1978TEHRAN02121.subject: TABRIZ RIOTS: BERSERK SOLDIER SHOOTS FOUR TABRIZ CONSUL METRINKO INFORMED EMBASSY PRECEINCT GOVERNMENT HEAD CONFIRMED STORY THAT ON FEB 28 ARMY INLI STED

segments.text: TABRIZ CONSUL METRINKO INFORMED EMBASSY PRECEINCT GOVERNMENT HEAD CONFIRMED STORY THAT ON FEB 28 ARMY INLISTED MAN (WHO IS NATIVE OF TEHRAN) WENT BERSERK AND SHOT HIS COMMANDING OFFICER AND ONE OTHER SOLDIER. SOLDIER THEN WENT TO UNIVERSITY OF AZARBADEGAN WHERE HE KILLED THE POLICE MAJOR IN CHARGE OF PRECINCT AND SHOT TWO OTHER POLICEMEN, ONE OF WHOM SUBSEQUENTLY DIED. SOLDIER TAKEN INTO CUSTODY. PROVINCE SECURITY FORCES DO NOT RPT NOT BELIEVE EVENT WAS RELATED TO RECENT TABRIZ RIOTS BUT SOLDIER WAS OBVIOUSLY MEMBER OF ARMY UNIT CURRENTLY STATIONED IN TABRIZ AS BACKUP TO SECURITY FORCES.

PRESS MARCH 2 GAVE ROUND UP OF THOSE ARRESTED AND STILL FACING CHARGES AND SAID THAT 18 PEOPLE HAD BEEN DETAINED OVER PAST TWO DAYS FOR DISTRIBUTING SUBVERSIVE MARXIST LEAFLETS (ILLEGAL UNDER IRANIAN LAW) AND SHOUTING SUBVERSIVE SLOGANS. FIVE WERE ARRESTED FEB 28, 13 MORE MARCH 1. BOTH GROUPS INCLUDED GIRLS, BUT NO NAMES ARE GIVEN.

FOUR TEHRAN POLYTECHNIC STUDENTS WILL BE TRIED BEFORE LOCAL MAGISTRATE ON CHARGES OF CREATING CAMPUS UNREST, BREAKING WINDOWS AND SETTING BUILDINGS ON FIRE. THE FOUR-MASOUD SALIMI, HADI MOUSAVI, NASSAR RAVANI, AND FARID SHAHPOUR WERE ARRESTED LAST WEEK IN WAKE OF FEB 20 EVENTS AT SEVERAL UNIVERSITIES (REFTEL).

NINE COLLEGE STUDENTS FROM TEHRAN UNIVERSITY'S FACULTY OF POLITICAL SCIENCE AND COMPUTERS AND 26 FROM THE INDEPENDENT COLLEGE OF POLITICAL AND SOCIAL SCIENCE (TEHRAN) WILL ALSO BE GOING TO TRIAL IN CIVIL COURT ON SIMILAR DISORDER CHARGES (NAMES BEING POUCHED).
MINISTRY OF JUSTICE EXAMINER TOLD PRESS THAT, BEYOND THESE, 40 STUDENTS REMAIN IN CUSTODY AS RESULT OF VIOLENCE OVER PAST TWO MONTHS.

EMBASSY COMMENT: WILL BE INTERESTING TO SEE IF THOSE PICKED UP FOR DISTRIBUTIONG "MARXIST" LITERATURE ARE FINALLY PROSECUTED AND ON WHAT GROUNDS IN WHICH COURT. THUS FAR ALL STUDENTS PICKED UP HAVE BEEN TRIED ON DISORDER-RELATED CHARGES; ARRESTS FOR PASSING SUBVERSIVE LITERATURE HAVE ALSO BEEN HANDLED IN CIVILIAN CHANNELS, AN IMPROVEMENT OVER PRE-APRIL 1977 PRACTICE.

1978TEHRAN02178.subject: TABRIZ RIOTS: GOI PERSONNEL CHANGES AND SOME ADDITIONAL OBSERVATIONS

segments.text: SUMMARY: AZMOUDEH OUT AS EAST AZARBAIJAN PROVINCIAL GOVERNOR; EX-PROVINCIAL POLICE CHIEF BRIGADIER GEN. HOUSHMAND REAPPOINTED POLICE COMMANDER IN PROVINCE. REVIEW OF RIOT ACTIVITIES INDICATES DISTINCTLY GREATER ANTI-GOI ACTIVITY AT TABRIZ THAN IN PREVIOUS RELIGIOUS DEMONSTRATIONS. THOUGH RELIGIOUS LEADERS DEPLORE VIOLENCE, RUMORS CONTINUE TO ABOUND. ROUNDUP OF SUSPECTED RIOT LEADERS CONTINUING, BUT 110 NOW OUT ON BAIL AFTER QUESTIONING. OPPOSITIONISTS STILL UNSURE HOW TO PLAY TABRIZ EVENTS. END SUMMARY.

MORNING PRESS MARCH 2 ANNOUNCED EAST AZARBAIJAN PROVINCIAL GOVERNOR ESKANDAR AZMOUDEH WOULD NOT BE RETURNING TO HIS JOB AFTER HIS MEETING WTIWH GOI OFFICIALS IN TEHRAN. THIS IS FURTHER CONFIRMATION OF REFTELS THAT LARGE-SCALE CHANGES ARE IN ORDER FOR TABRIZ. (NOTE: REF B INCORRECTLY ANNOUNCED TABRIZ MAYOR HAD BEEN SACKED. HE REMAINS IN OFFICE FOR NOW. ERROR WAS DUE TO MIXUP IN LOCANEWSROOM.) PRESS ALSO ANNOUNCED APPOINTMENT OF BRIGADIER GEN. HOUSHMAND AS NEW EAST AZARBAIJAN CHIEF OF POLICE; HE WAS FORMERLY IN SAME POSITION AND IS ONE OF BEST IRANIAN NATIONAL POLICE OFFICERS AT HIS GRADE, ACCORDING TO TEHRAN POLICE SOURCE.

REVIEW OF RIOT ACTIVITIES FROM TEN DAYS' PERSPECTIVE AND ADDITIONAL INFORMATION SUGGESTS TABRIZ EVENTS HAD DISTICTLY ANTI-GOVERNMENT CAST. COMMERCIAL SURCES TOLD ECONOFF THAT BANK OMRAN BRANCHES PARTICULARLY HARD HIT--THIS BANK IS KNOWN AS MAIN RESPOSITORY OF PAHLAVI FOUNDATION FUNDS--AND FOR FIRST TIME IN RELIGIOUSLYORIENTED DEMONSTRATION, LEAFLETS, DIRECTLY ATTACKING SHAH WERE PASSED OUT. SHOPS WHICH WERE HIT, IN ADDITION TO THOSE CITED EARLIER, INCLUDED THOSE OPEN IN DEFIANCE OF CLOSE ORDER GIVEN BY AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI OF QOM, AND THOSE WITH SHAH/SHABANOU, OR OTHER ROYAL FAMILY REFERENCE IN THEIR NAMES. ATTACKS ON MUNICIPAL BUILDINGS PARTICULARLY VICIOUS.

RUMORS CONTINUE TO CIRCULATE THAT MAIN CAUSE OF RIOT WAS CLOSURE OF MOSQUES BY PROVINCE GOVERNOR DESPITE TEHRAN "SUGGESTION" THAT THIS NOT BE DONE, AND FURTHER STORY STILL MAKING ROUNDS THAT POLICE CHIEF OF 6TH DISTRICT (WHO WAS RELIEVED) STARTED MOB ON ITS WAY BY SHOOTING EITHER AN OLD MAN OR A STUDENT (TAKE YOUR CHOICE) DEAD ON THE STREET. (EMBASSY COMMENT: UPDATED INFO CONFIRMS CLOSING OF MANY MOSQUES, BUT STORY ON POLICE CHIEF REMAINS IN THE RUMOR CORRAL AS UNLIKELY.)

PRESS REPORTS ADDITIONAL 13 PERSONS ARRESTED MARCH 1 (NO NAMES GIVEN), INCLUDING SOME PROMINENT TABRIZ MERCHANTS (PRESUMABLY BAZAAREES). PUBLIC PROSECUTOR IN TABRIZ HAD ANNOUNCED THAT 100 INDIVIDUALS HAVE BEEN RELEASED ON BAIL OUT OF TOTAL 627 ARRESTED. JUDICIAL PROCEEDINGS REMAIN IN HANDS OF MINISTRY OF JUSTICE; TO EMBASSY'S KNOWLEDGE NO ONE YET HAS BEEN HANDED OVER TO MILITARY COURT SYSTEM.

EMBASSY SOURCE WITH GOOD RELIGIOUS OPPOSITIONIST CONTACTS IN TEHRAN REPORTS THIS GROUP WAS DISMAYED ABOUT TABRIZ VIOLENCE, UNSURE WHETHER AND HOW DEEPLY THEIR OWN PEOPLE WERE INVOLVED AND SUSPICIOUS OF WHETHER OTHERS MAY HAVE INFILTRATED MOB AND TURNED IT VIOLENT. FACT THAT MOB STRUCK IN TWO WAVES AND THAT AT LEAST ONE BANK (IRANOBIRITSH) WAS HIT AT 7 A.M. , WELL BEFORE RIOTING STARTED, HAS SUGGESTED TO SOME OPPOSITIONISTS THAT THEY WERE USED BY OTHERS, BUT NONE ARE YET WILLING TO SAY WHO "OTHERS" MIGHT BE.

EMBASSY COMMENT: BOTH GOI AND ITS CRITICS ARE CLEARLY REASSESSING TABRIZ EVENTS IN TERMS OF THEIR OWN LONGER TERM STRATEGIES, AND NEITHER APPEARS HAPPY ABOUT TURN OF EVENTS. ASIDE FROM PRIVATE COMMENTS, EVERYONE SEEMS TO BE WAITING FOR PROMISED GOI INVESTIGATION REPORT ON TABRIZ EVENTS BEFOE BRINGING FORTH FULLER ANALYSIS. UNLESS ADDITIONAL INFO MARKEDLY CHANGES SITUATION OR PERCEPTIONS OF SAME, EMBASSY WILL DO THE SAME.
CONSULATE TABRIZ AIRGRAM A-05 BEING POUCHED MARCH 3 GIVES UPDATE ON MANY DETAILS AND CONSULATE'S INTERIM VIEW OF EVENTS.

SUMMARY: CHANGES CONTINUE IN EAST AZARBAIJAN PROVINCIAL ADMINISTRATION. MORE ARRESTED AND RELEASED IN TABRIZ. ADDITIONAL POLICE ARRIVE IN TABRIZ. IN TEHRAN, SOME RELEASED ON PASSING SUBVERSIVE LITERATURE CHARGES, OTHERS CHARGED. LITERATURE BEING PASSED NOT LIBERAL OPPOSITIONIST CIRCULARS, BUT ANTI-SHAH CALLS TO RIOT. END SUMMARY.

PESS MARCH 5, REPORTS ARREST OF 15 ADDITIONAL SUSPECTS IN TABRIZ BRINGING TOTAL ARRESTED TO 641, OF WHICH 110 ALREADY RELEASED AND 25 MORE SLATED FOR DISCHARGE ACCORDING TO TABRIZ COURT EXAMINER. MEDIA ALSO ANNOUNCE THAT DEATH TOLL HAS RISEN TO 12 AS RESULT OF RECENT DEATH OF STUDENT FROM INJURIES.

NEW EAST AZARBAIJAN GOVERNOR GENERAL APPOINTMENT BEING REPORTED SEPTEL. TWO NEW POLICE APPOINTMENTS HAVE ALOS BEEN ANNOUNCED. FORMER TEHRAN TRAFFIC POLICE CHIEF BRIG GEN. PARVIZ AFSARI HAS BEEN SENT TO HEAD WEST AZARBAIJAN POLICE AND COLONEL QORBAN ALI TORABI WILL BE NEW DEPUTY POLICE CHIEF FOR EAST AZARBAIJAN CENTRAL POLICE. RUMORS OUT OF COMMITTEE INVESTIGATING NEGLIGENCE CHARGES AGAINST FORMER EASTAZARBAIJAN CHIEF SUGGEST HE WILL BE EXPELLED FROM FORCE OR DEMOTED.

SMALL ITEM IN PRESS MARCH 5 NOTED 400 ADDITIONAL POLICE HAVE BEEN SENT TO TABRIZ, US SOURCE IN TEHRAN SAYS 27 BUS LOADS OF IRANIAN ARM SPECIAL FORCES LEFT TEHRAN FOR TABRIZ ABOUT FEB. 27. TWO STORIES PROBABLY REFERRING TO SAME GROUP. CONSULATE TABRIZ REPORTS ARMY HAS BEEN LESS OBVIOUS OVER PAST FEW DAYS, AND SEEMS TO BE FADING DISCREETLY INTO BACKGROUND.

IN TEHRAN, PROSECUTOR'S OFFICE ANNOUNCED RELEASE OF EIGHT OF 13 INDIVIDUALS ARRESTED (REF A) LATE LAST WEEK FOR PASSING SUBVERSIVE LITERATURE FOR LACK OF EVIDENCE. REMAINING FIVE WILL BE INDICTED ALONG WITH FIVE CHARGED EARLIER (REF A). SENIOR UNIVERSITY OFFICIAL TOLD POLCOUNS THAT THOSE ARRESTED WERE PASSING OUT CALLS TO FURTHER RIOTS WITH STRONG ANTI-SHAH TONE. SOURCE CHARACTERIZED THEM AS DEFINITELY NOT MODERATE OPPOSITIONIST CIRCULARS "WE HAVE COME TO EXPTECT", BUT DEFINITE HARDLINE EFFORT. SAME SOURCE NOTED SHAH HAD TOLD UNIVERSITY LEADERS THAT THERE WOULD BE NO MORE ARRESTS OF STUDENTS -UNIVERSITIES MUST ADMINISTRATIVELY DISCIPLINE THEIR OWN. UNCLEAR AS TO WHETHER THIS MEANT STUDENS ON UNIVERSITY CAMPUSES OR STUDENTS ANYWHERE.
EMBASSY SUSPECTS GOI POLICE/SECURITY FORCES GIVEN ORDERS NOT TO GO ON CAMPUSES, BUT THAT STUDENTS ELSEWHERE WILL BE TREATED SAME AS ANY OTHER DEMONSTRATORS.

ANTICIPATED FULL REPORT ON RIOTS (REF B) NOT YET RELEASED, BUT WE UNDERSTAND INVESTIGATING COMMITTEE LAID VIRTUALLY ENTIRE BLAME ON PROVINCIAL AUTHORITIES PRIVATE SOURCES TELL US THIS HAS INCREASED PRIME MINISTER'S SUSPICION THAT SECURITY SERVICES ARE HOSTILE TO HIM, SINCE DEPOSED GOVERNOR WAS HIS UNCLE ON MOTHER'S SIDE.

1978TEHRAN02243.subject: FIVE NEW PROVINCIAL GOVERNORS NAMED: ADMINISTRATION TO TIGHTEN UP

segments.text: SUMMARY: FIVE NEW PROVINCIAL GOVERNORS APPOINTED MARCH 2, INCLUDING NEW GOVERNOR FOR EAST AZARBAIJAN (TABRIZ) PROVINCE, SHAH CHARGED THEM WITH IMPROVING PROVINCIAL ADMINISTRATION. CENTRAL PROVINCE CAPITAL MOVED FROM TEHRAN TO ARAK. REPORTEDLY GROUP WAS PICKED FOR ITS ADMINISTRATIVE ABILITIES TO EASE DIFFICULT SITUATIONS WHICH HAD DEVELOPED. END SUMMARY.

MARCH 2, SHAH ANNOUNCED NAMES OF 5 NEW PROVINCIAL GOVERNORS. MOST IMPORTANT WAS MOVE OF GEN JAAFAR SHAFAQAT FROM VICE CHIEF OF SUPREME COMMANDER' STAFF TO GOVERNORSHIP OF EAST ARZARBAIJAN PROVINCE. SHAFAQAT, WHO WAS SHAH'S MILITARY ADJUTANT GEN AND WHO HEADED IMPERIAL MILITARY INSPECTION OF TABRIZ RITOS (REF A), WAS APPOINTED BECAUSE HE IS A TABRIZI WHO KNOWS AREA WELL AND HAS "ABSOLUTE" CONFIDENCE OF SHAH, ACCORDING TO INTERIOR MINISTRY SOURCES. (THUS ENDING SPECULATION THAT NO MORE AZARBAIJANIS WOULD BE GIVEN PROVINCIAL POSTS.) SHAFAQAT TOLD PRESS MARCH 4 HE HAD RECEIVED ROYAL INSTRUCTIONS TO REMEDY CERTAIN "DEFECTS AND DISCRIMINATIONS".

SHAFAQAT IS 62, AND HAS HAD IMPRESSIVE CAREER AS COMMANDER OF IMPERIAL GUARD, CHIEF OF STAFF OF GROUND FORCES AND SECOND ARMY COMMANDER. HE WAS EDUCATED IN LAW AND HAS A LAW DEGREE FROM THE UNIV OF PARIS.

REZA SADAQIANI, FORMER MIN OF RURAL COOPERATIVES (QOURAUUL AND FOR PAST YEAR GOVERNOR OF LURISTAN, HAS BEEN SHIFTED TO CENTRAL PROVINCE, REPORTEDLY TO MAKE SURE SHIFT OF PROVINCIAL CAPITAL TO ARAK GOES SMOOTHLY AND CENTRAL PROVINCE DECENTRALIZATIN SCHEME, WHICH WILL BE IMPLEMENTED CONCURRENTLY, GETS OFF TO GOOD START. REPLACING HIM IN LURISTAN WILL BE EQBAL EQBAL, A 49 YEAR OLD ENGINEER WHO HAS BEEN A DIRGEN IN THE INTERIOR MINISTRY AND PREVIOUSLY HEAD OF THE TEHRAN OFFICE OF UNESCO.

GOING TO ZANJAN WILL BEHUSHANG AMIR BEHZADI, AGE 45, WHO PLEDGED "HIGHEST DEGREE OF FREEDOM" FOR ZANJAN RESIDENTS. EMB UNDERSTANDS PREVIOUS GOVERNOR GENERL FOUGHT CONSTANTLY WITH HIS STAFF AND WHOLE PROVINCE HAS BEEN UNSETTLED FOR SEVERAL MONTHS. LOCAL INTERIOR MINISTRY OFFICIALS FEEL BEHZADI IS MAN TO STRAIGNTEN OUT MESS. BEHZADI STUDIED POLITICAL SCIENCE AT TEHRAN UNIV AND HAS HAD EXTENSIVE EXPERIENCE IN PROVINCIAL POSTS WITH INTERIOR MINISTRY, INCLUDING SPOT AS DEPUTY TO GOVERNOR GENERAL OF KERMAN AND SEVERAL POSTS AS DISTRICT GOVERNOR.

REMAINING NEWCOMER IS HASSAN ESLAMI, 44, WHO WILL BE GOING TO SISTAN AND BALUCHISTAN, SENSITIVE PROVINCE ON IRAN'S BORDER WITH PAKISTAN. BORN IN ZANJAN, HE IS A CAREER INTERIOR MINISTRY OFFICAL WHO HAS BEEN A DIRGEN IN THE INTERIOR MINISTRY AND HELD SEVERAL DISTRICT GOVERNORSHIPS AS WELL AS SERVING AS ASST TO THE GOVERNOR GENRAL OF ISFAHAN. HE, TOO, WAS PICKED TO REMEDY WHAT SOURCE CALLS DEFECTS RELATING TO BUREAUCRATIC INEFFICIENCY.

EMB COMMENT: SOURCES TELL US GROUP, WHICH EXCEPT FOR SPECIAL CASES OF SHAFAQAT AND SADAQIANI, IS SIGNIFICANTLY YOUNGER THAN AVERAGE, WERE PICKED FOR THEIR ADMINISTRATIVE SKILLS AND ABILITY TO MAKE GOVERNMENTAL MACHINERY WORK. SHAH CHARGED NEW GOVERNORS WITH WEEDING OUT DISCRIMINATION, RED TAPE AND OTHER PRACTICES WHICH FOSTER DISCONTENT AND MISTRUST. ACCORDING TO UR SOURCES, SHAFAQAT CLEARLY HAS IMPERIAL MANDATE TO SHAKE UP EAST ARARBAIJAN ADMINISTRATION, WHICH HAD GROWN SLACK UNDER 4 YEAR TENURE OF AZMOUDEH, WHO COINCIDENTALLY HAPPENS TO BE AN UNCLE TO CURRENT PRIMIN AMOUZEGAR. CONSULATE TABRIZ REPORTS WHOLESALE SHAKEUP IN PROVINCIAL ADMIN IS ALREADY UNDERWAY AS OF 4-5 MARCH.
LARGE MAJORITY OF CONSULATE'S OLD CONTACTS ARE NO LONGER IN PLACE, BUT WHETHER THIS IS TEMPORARY MEASURE PENDING REVIEW OR PERMANENT REMOVAL IS NOT YET CERTAIN.

1978TEHRAN02246.subject: IRANIANS REDUCE THEIR REPRESENTATION IN EAST GERMANY

segments.text: ON FRIDAY, MARCH 3, MFA REDUCED DIPLOMATIC REPRESENTATION IN EAST BERLIN BY RECALLING ITS AMBASSADOR AND THE REST OF THE EMBASSY STAFF AND LEAVING THE EMBASSY IN THE CARE OF A THIRD SECRETARY, WHO IS TO SERVE AS "CHARGE DES AFFAIRES" (NOT CHARGE D'AFFAIRES) AS AN ADMINISTRATIVE CARETAKER MFA EXPLAINED IN A RELEASE TO THE PRESS NEXT DAY THAT THIS MEASURE HAD BEEN TAKEN BECAUSE THE EAST GERMAN GOVERNMENT HAD NOT PROVIDED APPROPRIATE PROTECTION AGAINST THE VANDALS WHO HAD DAMAGED THE EMBASSY BUILDING IN AN ANTI-IRANIAN DEMONSTRATION A FEW DAYS BEFORE AND LOCKED UP IRANIAN DIPLOMATS.

EVEN MORE IMPORTANT, EAST GERMAN EXPULSION OF THE 30 OR SO CULPRITS INVOLVED WAS SEEN AS EVADING ITS OBLIGATION TO BRING THEM TO JUSTICE AND ENCOURAGING FURTHER ATTACKS OF THIS SORT ON THE IRANIAN EMBASSY.

MFA DIRECTOR GENERAL ESHRAGHI CONFIRMED THE SERIES OF EVENTS TO POLCOUNS MARCH 5. HE SAID EAST GERMAN AMBASSADOR HAD BEEN IN TO SEE HIM MARCH 4 AND EXPRESSEEREGRET FOR WHAT HAD BEEN DONE, GIVING WHAT IRANIANS CONSIDER A LAME EXPLANATION FOR IT ALL. IRANIANS ARE ESPECIALLY OUTRAGED, HE SAID, BY THE DEPORTATION WITHOUT LEGAL PUNISHMENT WHICH IRANIANS DO NOT CONSIDER NORMAL OR APPROPRIATE. IN REPLY TO OUR QUESTION HE SAID THE WHOLE RANGE OF RELATIONSHIPS WITH EAST GERMANY IS CURRENTLY UNDER REVIEW AND, WHILE NO MOVES HAVE SO FAR BEEN TAKEN IN THE COMMERCIAL AREA, HE CERTAINLY WOULD EXPECT NO RPT NO EXPANSION OF COMMERCIAL RELATIONSHIPS UNDER THESE CONDITIONS.

ESHRAGHI NOTED THAT EAST GERMAN MISSION REMAINS AS IT WAS, AND HE DOUBTED THEY WOULD RECIPROCATE BY REDUCING IN ANY WAY. IN REPLY TO OUR QUESTION, HE SAID GOI HAS MADE NO SPECIALS REQUIREMENTS OF THE EAST GERMANS BUT IS WAITING TO SEE IF THEY COME UP WITH ANY SUGGESTIONS FOR IMPROVING THE SITUATION.

IN REPLY TO ANOTHER QUESTION, HE SAID HE DID NOT KNOW EXACTLY WHY GOI CHOSE THIS PARTICULAR RESPONSE IN EAST GERMANY'S CASE AS OPPOSED TO LESS OFFICIAL COMMERCIAL SANTIONS IN CASES OF DANISH AND ITALIAN CASES RECENTLY, BUT OF COURSE EAST GERMAN AUTHORITIES ARE EXPECTED TO BE IN MORE CONTROL OF THE SITUATION AND PERHAPS IRAN IS GETTING A LITTLE TIRED OF THE REPETITION OF SUCH INSTANCES.

COMMENT: IRANIAN REACTION IN THIS CASE AS IN OTHERS RECENTLY (BREAK IN RELATIONS WITH KENYA, AS WELL AS DANISH AND ITALIAN CASES MENTIONED ABOVE AND A CERTAIN DEGREE OF PRESSURE APPLIED TO BRITISH GOVERNMENT IN CONNECTION WITH BBC COVERAGE) STRIKES US--AS IT WILL OTHERS--AS PRETTY TOUCHY. UP TO NOW, IRANIANS HAVE TALKED TOUGH BUT CLIMBED DOWN RATHER QUICKLY ONCE CONCILIATORY EXPLANATIONS WERE OFFERED. IF THEY VALUE EAST GERMAN RELATIONSHIP AS MUCH AS THEY HAVE APPEARED TO UP TO NOW, WE MIGHT EXPECT SIMILAR PATTERN.

HOWEVER, THE SHAH IS FACED BY PROBLEM OF CONTINUING INVASIONS OR IRANIAN EMBASSIES AND CONSULATES IN ONE COUNTRY AFTER ANOTHER AND UNDOUBTEDLY IS SEEKING ONE OR TWO GOOD OPPORTUNITIES TO SET AN EXAMPLE THAT WILL DETER OTHER GOVERNMENTS FROM BEING SO PERMISSIVE. HE MIGHT JUST PICK EAST GERMANY AS SUCH A CASE.

1978TEHRAN02251.subject: IRANIAN CRUDE EXPORTS TO SOUTH AFRICA

segments.text: A-23 (NOTAL)

INFORMATION PROVIDED BY IRANIAN COST REP REGARDING BREAKDOWN OF IRANIAN CRUDE OIL EXPORTS TO SOUTH AFRICA GENERALLY ACCORDS WITH THE DATA OBTAINED BY THIS EMBASSY. ACCORDING TO OUR SOURCES, BOTH WITHIN AND OUTSIDE NIOC, THE SOURCE AND QUANTITIES OF CRUDE OIL EXPORTS TO SOUTH AFRICA IN 1977 WERE AS FOLLOWS: CONSORTIUM TRADING COMPANIES (I.E. ESFANDIARY'S MULTINATIONAL CORPORATIONS): 240 MBPD; AND NIOC (FROM ITS SHARE OF IPAC PRODUCTION AND "STATED QUANTITY" OIL FROM THE KHUZESTAN FIELDS: 40 MBPD.
SOUTH AFRICA WAS IRAN'S SEVENTH LARGEST CRUDE OIL MARKET IN 1977 AND ACCOUNTED FOR ALMOST SIX PERCENT OF TOTALIRANIAN CRUDE EXPORTS.
NIOC ATTEMPTS TO PREVENT LEAKS OF INFORMATION ON ITS DIRECT EXPORT PROGRAM, AND THE SPECIFIC FIGURES PROVIDED ABOVE SHOULD BE USED WITH DISCRETION.

1978TEHRAN02293.subject: IRAN SUSPENDS TRADE WITH EAST GERMANY

segments.text: BEGIN UNCALSSIFIED: IN THE WAKE OF IRAN'S REDUCTION OF DIPLOMATIC REPRESENTATION IN EAST BERLIN, REPORTED IN REFTEL, THE MARCH 6 PRESS ANNOUNCED THAT THE IRANIAN BUSINESS COMMUNITY, IN A MEETING AT THE IRAN CHAMBER OF COMMERCE, INDUSTRY AND MINES, DECIDED MARCH 5 TO STOP ALL BUSINESS RELATIONS WITH EAST GERMANY. THESE BUSINESSMEN REPORTEDLY CALLED ON THEIR BANKS TO STOP OPENING LETTERS OF CREDIT AND REGISTERING IMPORT ORDERS WITH EAST GERMAN SUPPLIERS. FURTHER, BUSINESS CONTACTS AT THE PUBLIC SECTOR LEVEL HAD ALSO STOPPED AND JOINT VENTURES IN CONSTRUCTION AND OTHER FIELDS WOULD NOW BE REGARDED NULL AND VOID.

BEGIN CONFIDENTIAL: THIS DISSEMBLING TACTIC WAS ALSO EMPLOYED IN THE SUSPENSION OF TRADE IN LATE 1977 WITH DENMARK AND ITALY, ALSO FOR THE REASON OF DISPLEASURE OVER HANDLING OF DEMONSTRATIONS AGAINST IRANIAN EMBASSIES. IN FACT, THE INSTRUCTION TO TERMINATE ANY TRADE DOCUMENTATION INVOLVING EAST GERMANY WAS TELEPHONED TO THE BANKS BY THE EXCHANGE CONTROL DEPARTMENT OF THE CENTRAL BANK OF IRAN, AS ADMITTED BY THE POLITICAL INNOCENT OF THE BANK WHO MADE THE CALLS.

EMBASSY HAS HEARD NUMBER OF RUMORS OF POSSIBLE DEMONSTRATIONS IN TEHRAN AND SHIRAZ MARCH 11. TEHRAN RUMORS APPEAR TO BE JUST THAT, SINCE OUR BEST SOURCES INDICATE NOTHING IS PLANNED HERE BEFORE MARCH 30, WHEN BOTH STUDENTS AND BAZAAR TYPES CURRENTLY PROJECTING "COMMEMORATIVE" MEETINGS FOR THOSE KILLED AT TABRIZ.

CONSULATE SHIRAZ, HOWEVER, REPORTS FROM BOTH UNOFFICIAL AND GOVERNMENT SOURCES THAT PAHLAVI UNIVERSITY STUDENTS ARE PLANNING DEMONSTRATION MARCH 11 TO PROTEST GOI SUPPORT FOR OIL PRICE FREEZE (A PRETTY INTELLECTUAL PRETEXT*). IN EMBASSY'S ESTIMATION, IT APPEARS THAT MOST LIKELY DEMONSTRATION ACTIVITY THIS WEEK, IF ANY, WILL BE IN SHIRAZ BUT, GIVEN UNEASE AND RUMORS, LITTLE WOULD SURPRISE US.

INTERVIEW SUMMARY: SHAH'S RECENT INTERVIEW WITH WASHPOST'S JONATHAN RANDAL AND AMIR TAHERI ANALYSIS PUBLISHED TEHRAN GIVE GOOD INSIGHT INTO SHAH'S VIEWS ON CONTINUED LIBERALIZATION (REF A), WHICH ARE SHARED MORE OR LESS ENTHUSIASTICALLY BY MOST HIGH ECHELON IRANIAN ELITE. TRANSCRIPT OF INTERVIEW (STORY CARRIED REF B) AND TEXT OF ARTICLE BEING POUCHED DEPARTMENT.
