SHAH WANTS CONTINUED LIBERALIZATION AND IS PREPARED TO LIVE WITH SOME VIOLENCE WHILE SIMULTANEOUSLY PUTTING HEAT ON LOCAL ADMINISTRATORS TO HANDLE AFFAIRS WITH INTELLIGENCE AND DISCRETION TO MINIMIZE ADVERSE EFFECTS OF OPPOSITIONIST ACTIVITIES.

TAKEN IN CONTEXT DOMESTIC DEVELOPMENTS IN IRAN OVER PAST EIGHT MONTHS, THIS GIVES VERY DIFFERENT PICTURE OF SHAH AND IRANIAN MODERNIZATION THAN UNEDUCATED BUT WIDESPREAD VIEW OF SHAH AS MEGALOMANIAC BENT ON REPRESSING HIS PEOPLE AND GATHERING ARMS FOR CONQUEST, A VIEW WHICH IRANIAN OPPOSITIONIST GROUPS HAVE BEEN PROPAGATING FOR SOME TIME IN U.S. AND WESTERN EUROPE. FOR PURPOSE OF ENCOURAGING FURTHER HUMAN RIGHTS ADVANCES IN IRAN EMBASSY BELIEVES IT WOULD BE USEFUL IF USG AND OTHERS PLAYED ON THEMES DEVELOPED BY SHAH IN APPROACH TO HUMAN RIGHTS RATHER THAN WHAT IRANIANS REFER TO AS WESTERN OBSESSION WITH CIVIL RIGHTS LEGALISMS. END SUMMARY.

SHAH-RANDAL INTERVIEW TOOK LINE THAT, DESPITE ACTIVITY OF DISSIDENTS, LIBERALIZATION WILL CONTINUE. SHAH DISPARAGED OPPOSITION TRYING TO TEACH HIM HUMAN RIGHTS WHEN THEY WERE "THE MOST INTRACTABLE PERSONS WHO DID NOT LIVE ONE DAY WITHOUT MARTIAL LAW...", WHILE THEY WERE IN POWER (REFERRING TO MOSSADEQ PERIOD). HE MADE POINT PUBLICLY FOR FIRST TIME THAT NOT ALL RELIGIOUS LEADERS BELONG IN CATEGORY OF "BLACK REACTIONARIES", AND ACKNOWLEDGED TABRIZ RIOTS FEB 18 WERE SUBSTANTIALLY DUE TO BAD MANAGEMENT BY OFFICIALS. HE NOTED GUILTY OFFICIALS WERE BEING PUNISHED AND EVEN, IN RELAXED JIBE ON THIS SUBJECT, ACKNOWLEDGED SAVAK NEGLIGENCE--"NOW WE HEAR THAT FOR THREE-FOUR DAYS THEY (DEMONSTRATORS) WERE PREPARING ALL THOSE STICKS...

YOU CAN'T TO THAT IN ONE HOUR. AND THAT'S WHY PEOPLE ARE LOSING THEIR RANKS (POSITIONS) BECUSE WE NEVER GOT ONE SERIOUS REPORT ABOUT THE POSSIBILITY OF ANY INCIDENTS THERE. AND YOU ARE CALLING OUR SAVAK MORE EFFICIENT OR WORSE THAN THE KGB, THAT THEY HAVE SPIES EVERYWHERE. WELL, (CHUCKLE) IN THE CASE OF TABRIZ THAT WAS NOT TRUE." INTERESTINGLY, WHEN SHAH WAS INVITED BY RANDAL TO RELATE QOM AND TABRIZ DISTURBANCES TO PRESIDENT CARTER'S ESPOUSAL OF HUMAN RIGHTS, SHAH CHIDED RANDAL NOTING LIBERALIZATION BEGAN WELL BEFORE CARTER ELECTION.

HE LINKED DISTURBANCES DIRECTLY TO LIBERALIZATION PROGRAM, AND SAID THIS WAS PRICE IRAN HAD TO PAY BECAUSE OF RIGHT AND LEFT INTEREST IN FOMENTING TROUBLE. HE DID NOT LEAN ON "FOREIGN INVOLVEMENT" THEME. WHILE DEPRECIATING VIEWS, OF OPPOSITIONISTS, SHAH NEVERTHELESS TOLD RANDAL THAT "ANY SUGGESTION THAT COULD BE POSITIVE FOR THE COUNTRY WILL BE RECEIVED WHOLEHEARTEDLY--WHY NOT?". SEEMS CLEAR THAT SHAH HAD THOUGHT OUT ANSWERS TO RANDAL QUESTIONS ON LIBERALIZATION AND HAS NOW TWICE GONE ON RECORD AS READY TO STICK TO HIS GAME PLAN FOR IMMEDIATE AND MEDIUM TERM FUTURE.

SHAH LISTED POLITICAL AIMS AS GUARANTEEING FREEDOM, PUTTING POWER INTO HANDS OF PEOPLE AS MUCH AS POSSIBLE THROUGH DECENTRALIZATION OF ADMINISTRATION TO VILLAGE AND PROVINCIAL COUNCILS AND PROVINCIAL AND DISTRICT GOVERNORS. SHAH CONTINUED THAT LIBERALIZATION DID NOT MEAN HE WOULD NOT DEFEND COUNTRY BUT BASIS OF STATE AND SOCIETY STRONG ENOUGH TO ALLOW "AT LEAST THIS LIMIT AND EVEN MORE".

TAHERI ARTICLE, WHICH WE UNDERSTAND WAS INSPIRED IF NOT PARTIALLY WRITTEN BY COURT MINISTRY SOURCES, EXPANDS ON DOMESTIC THEME IN SHAH'S REMARKS AND GIVES RATIONALE FOR SHAH'S APPROACH TO DOMESTIC POLITICAL AFFAIRS.

PIECE MAKES FOLLOWING BASIC POINTS: A) WHILE IRAN HAD WIDE GULF BETWEEN RICH AND POOR, POLITICAL DEMOCRATIZATION WAS NOT POSSIBLE: B) REMARKABLE PROGRESS OF PAST 15 YEARS HAS NOW BROUGHT IRAN TO POINT WHERE IT CAN RECONSTRUCT ITS POLITICAL LIFE ACROSS A SPECTRUM IN WHICH EXTREMES "CANNOT BUT BE CONFINED TO SMALL SECTIONS OF SOCIETY"; C) SHAH, IN NEW BOOK "TOWARDS THE GREAT CIVILIZATION", HAS SAID POLITICAL LIFE MUST BE BROUGHT INTO LINE WITH ECONOMIC/SOCIAL ADVANCES AND DANGERS THAT DO EXIST FROM EXTREMES SHOULD NOT BE OVERESTIMATED: D) SHAH-PEOPLE REVOLUTION WIDELY ACCEPTED AND NOW IT IS POSSIBLE TO RECRUIT POLITICAL ORGANIZERS FROM BEYOND NARROW LIMITS OF THOSE TRAINED IN EXTREMIST TRADITIONS (EX-TUDEH MEMBERS) OR TECHNOCRATS WHO FEARED POLITICS: AND D) PROVESS OF LIBERALIZATION BEGAIN TWO YEARS ------------------083841 120831Z /13 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 7357 INFO AMEMBASSY LONDON SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 02464 AGO WITH EASING OF CENSORSHIP AND HAS CONTINUED WITH AMNESTIES FOR PRISONERS, REVISION OF MILITARY TRIBUNAL LAW, RED CROSS REVIEW OF PRISONS AND CREATION OF RESURGENCE PARTY.

FINAL THRUST OF ARTICLE IS THAT "BOTH ADMINISTRATION AND ITS CRITICS HAVE TO SEEK GENUINE PUBLIC SUPPORT FOR THEIR IDEAS. THEY CAN NO LONGER EXPECT THE MONARCHY TO DO ALL THEIR POLITICAL WORK FOR THEM."

ABOVE IS, OF COURSE, PATTERN OF INENT AS MUCH AS ACTUAL DESCRIPTION OF SITUATION. EMBASSY BELIEVES RIGHT AND LEFT ARE NOT AS WEAK AS TAHERI STATES THEY ARE, AND IRAN MAY NOT YET QUITE BE TO POINT WHERE MIDDLE CLASS MODERATES CAN ASSUME GREATER ROLE WITH EASE. PROBLEM OF CONTROLLING DEMONSTRATIONS WILL REQUIRE OFFICIALS TO EXERCISE JUDGEMENT AND ACCEPT RESPONSIBILITY, ELEMENTS WHICH HAVE NOT HERETOFORE BEEN REQUIRED OF THEM IN IRANIAN POLITICAL SYSTEM. POLITICAL FOCUS OF PAST 30 YEARS ON CENTER SUGGESTS TO US AND TO MANY KNOWLEDGEABLE IRANIAN OBSERVERS THAT DECENTRALIZATION WILL BE A LONG-TIME PROCESS, BUT AT LEAST IT IS MODESTLY UNDERWAY.

MOST OF THOSE IN GOVERNMENT OR IN PRIVATE SECTOR WITH WHOM WE HAVE TALKED HAVE WELCOMED SHAH/GOI DECISION TO GO AHEAD WITH LIBERALIZATION DESPITE PRIVATE CYCICISM ABOUT DEGREE OF FREEDOM WHICH WILL BE POSSIBLE. THIS CONTRASTS RATHER STARKLY WITH STEREOTYPE "STREET" VIEW OF SHAH AS BRUTAL TYRANT BENT ON OPPRESSING PEOPLE AND GATHERING ARMS FOR CONQUEST, WHICH HIS OPPONENTS HAVE BEEN ASSIDUOUSLY PROPAGATING OVER PAST SIX YEARS.

BELIEVE SHAH'S PUBLIC STATEMENT OF POSITIONS HERE OFFERS USEFUL CHANCE FOR USG AND OTHERS TO TAILOR FURTHER APPROACHES ON HUMAN RIGHTS TO IRANIAN "HOMEGROWN"THEMES RATHER THAN WHAT IRANIANS REFER TO AS WESTERN LEGALISMS. FOR INSTANCE, IMPROVEMENTS IN IRANIAN JUDICIAL SYSTEM COULD BE ADVANCED IN TERMS OF BUILDING FUTURE POLITICAL PARTICIPATION TO MATCH IRAN'S ECONOMIC AND SOCIAL PROGRESS.

POINT S THAT CAREFUL READING OF SHAH'S VIEWS AS EXPRESSED IN ANDAL INTERVIEW AND TAHERI ARTICLE SHOULD SUGGEST, NOT ONLY TO DEPT BUT TO ORGANIZATIONS AS DIVERSE AS AMNESTY INTERNATIONAL AND INTERNATIONAL COMMISSION OF JURISTS, OPENINGS THROUGH WHICH TO BRING THEIR CONCERNS TO IANIAN ATTENTION IN WAYS WHICH SUPPORT WHAT GOI IS TRYING TO DO WHILE MINIMIZING XENOPHOBIC REACTION.

FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY TELEPHONED ME MORNING MARCH 12 TO REPORT THAT HE HAD BEEN IN CONTACTWITH SHAH (WHO IS STILL IN SOUTHERN IRAN) CONCERNING DEVELOPMENTS IN HORN OF AFRICA. HE SAID SHAD HAD AUTHORIZED ISSUANCE OF PUBLIC STATEMENT WHICH WOULD WELCOME SIAD BARRE'S DECISION AND CHARACTERIZE IT AS A "POSITIVE AND USEFUL STEP".
STATEMENT WOULD ALSO CALL FOR A CONFERENCE TO BE HELD EITHER UNDER AUSPICES OF OAU OR UN TO DISCUSS A SOLUTION TO THE PROBLEM, WHICH WOULD INCLUDE WITHDRAWAL OF FOREIGN TROOPS FROM EHTIOPIA.

KHALATBARY ALSO SAID SHAH WISHED ME TO BE INFORMED THAT, IMMEDIATELY BEFORE HIS DEPARTURE FOR SOUTHERN IRAN ON MARCH 19, HE HAD RECEIVED SOVIET AMBASSADOR, WHO HAD ASKED FOR AUDIENCE TO DISCUSS SITUATION IN HORN OF AFRICA. ACCORDING TO SHAH, SOVIETS ARE PROPOSING THE CONVENING OF A CONFERENCE UNDER AUSPICES OF OAU TO DISCUSS "SOLUTION TO PROBLEM". KHALATBARY SAID HE DID NOT HAVE FURTHER DETAILS OF SOVIET AMBASSADOR'S DISCUSSION WITH SHAH.

ON MY RETURN TO TEHRAN I NOTED THAT THE SHAH'S MESSAGE TO THE PRES REPORTING ON HIS CONVERSATION WITH BEGIN IN TEHRAN ON FEB 23 HAS NOT BEEN ACKNOWLEDGED, AT LEAST THROUGH EMB CHANNELS. IF WE HAVE NOT DONE SO I THINK WE SHOULD. I HOPE ALSO THAT WE WILL PROVIDE THE SHAH WITH AN ACCOUNT OF THE PRESIDENT'S FORTHCOMING MEETING WITH BEGIN AS I ASSUME WE WANT TO KEEP THE SHAH AN ACTIVE AND INTERESTED COLLABORATOR IN THE PEACE PROCESS. THIS WOULD BEST BE IN THE FORM OF A MESSAGE FROM THE PRESIDENT TO THE SHAH.

1978TEHRAN02563.subject: EDITORIAL SUPPORT FOR SOMALIAN DECISION TO WITHDRAW

segments.text: IN WHAT APPEARS TO BE OFFICIALLY-INSPIRED EDITORIAL, MARCH 13 ENGLISH-LANGUAGE DAILY "TEHRAN JOURNAL" CHARACTERIZED SOMALIAN DECISION TO WITHDRAW ITS REGULAR FORCES FROM OGADEN AS EXTREMELY COURAGEOUS ACT UNQUOTE. LEADING PARAGRAPH CONCLUDES THAT PRES SIAD BARRE HAS SHOWN CLEARLY THAT THE SOMALIS ARE FIMLY COMMITTED TO PEACE ON THE HORN OF AFRICA UNQUOTE. WHILE ADMITTING THE OPTIONS OPEN TO THE SOMALIS WERE LIMITED, THE EDITORIAL NOTES THAT SIAD BARRE'S DECISION COULD NOT HAVE BEEN EASY UNQUOTE.

SECOND HALF OF LONG EDITORIAL FOCUSES ON US POLICY IN AREA, SAYING THAT AMERICAN POLICY ON THE OGADEN CONFLICT HAS NOT BEEN VERY POSITIVE. THE US HAS REFUSED SOMALI APPEALS FOR ARMS. IN FACT THE US ADMINISTRATION HAS NOT LIVED UP TO EXPECTATIONS IN REGARD TO THE HORN OF AFRICA. LEADERS OF THE LIBERATION MOVEMENTS IN THE OGADEN HAVE ASKED WITH SOME VENOM WHETHER THE CARTER ADMINISTRATION'S HUMAN RIGHTS POLICY APPLIES ONLY TO DISSENTERS IN RUSSIAN JAILS AND NOT TO THE OPPRESSED AND COLONIZED PEOPLES IN THE OGADEN UNQUOTE.

ALLOWING THAT THERE ARE SIGNS OF IMPROVED US ATTITUDE UNQUOTE, THE 'JOURNAL" SUGGESTS THAT AMERICA MAY HAVE TO ACT MORE DECISIVELY AND RELATIVELY QUICKLY TO PREVENT A RETURN OF SOVIET INFLUENCE IN SOMALIA IN PARTICULAR AND AFRICA IN GENERAL UNQUOTE. EDITORIAL CONCLUDES WITH THOUGHT THAT HAVING ENCOURAGED THE SOMALIS TO PULL OUT, SURELY THE CARTER ADMINISTRATION HAS A RESPONSIBILITY TO IMPOSE EVEN STRONGER DIPLOMATIC PRESSURE ON THE SOVIET UNION, ETHIOPIA AND CUBA TO END THE FIGHTING UNQUOTE.
COMMENT: THIS EDITORIAL, TOGETHER WITH GOI OFFICIAL STATEMENT, MARCH 12 (REPORTED SEPTEL), PROVIDES MOST RECENT REACTION OF GOI TO HORN OF AFRICA CONFLICT.

UK EMB IS AWARE OF POSSIBILITY THAT KENYAN MISSION MAY VISIT TEHRAN IN NEAR FUTURE AND IS PREPARED TO MAKE ARRANGEMENTS FOR SUCH A VISIT AS REQUESTED. FOR THE MOMENT, HOWEVER, IT HAS HEARD NOTHING MORE ABOUT A VISIT AND NOTES THAT MOI DEL HAS RETURNED TO NAIROBI AFTER A STOPOVER IN BONN.

WE NOTE FONMIN KHALATBARY DURING MEETING WITH PRESS MARCH 13 (TEHRAN 2592) TOLD REPORTERS THAT BRITISH ARE REPRESENTING IRAN'S INTERESTS IN KENYA. THIS IS TRUE IN A GENERAL WAY, ACCORDING TO UK EMB, BUT EXACT STATUS OF LAST REMAINING IRANIAN IS NOT COMPLETELY CLEAR. APPARENTLY IRANIANS HAVE CLOSED DOWN THEIR OWN BUILDING, BUT QUESTION REMAINS WHETHER LAST OFFICIAL WIL HAVE STATUS AS HEAD OF IRANIAN INTEREST SECTION WITHIN BRITISH EMB OR CONTINUE IN SOME INDEPENDENT FASHION. BRITISH THINK 3 COUNTRIES ARE TRYING TO WORK THIS OUT, THOUGH LOCUS OF DISCUSSIONS DOES NOT SEEM TO BE TEHRAN.

1978TEHRAN02691.subject: SOVIET AMBASSADOR'S COMMENTS RE CURRENT VIOLENCE ON ISRAELI-PLO FRONT

segments.text: ISRAELI-PLO FRONT

SOVIET AMBASSADOR VINOGRADOV (WHO CO-CHAIRED LAST GENEVA MEETING ON MIDDLE EAST) SPOKE TO ME AT SOME LENGTH MARCH 18 ABOUT CURRENT VIOLENCE ON ISRAEL-PLO FRONT. WHILE HE WAS PREDICTABLY AND PIOUSLY OUTRAGED BY THE ISRAELI ACTION IN SOUTH LEBANON, I FOUND HIM SURPRISINGLY SENSITIVE ON THE SUBJECT OF THE PLO TERRORIST ATTACK IN ISRAEL. HE ADMITTED THAT THE SOVIETS WERE EMBARRASSED BY THE FACT THIS ATTACK TOOK PLACE IMMEDIATELY AFTER ARAFAT'S VISIT TO MOSCOW.

FOR WHAT IT MAY BE WORTH, VINOGRADOV SAID THAT HE FELT ARAFAT WAS TOTALLY UNAWARE OF THE ATTACK, WHICH HE BELIEVED WAS CARRIED OUT BY PLO LEFT-WING EXTREMISTS. HOWEVER, HE ALSO FELT ARAFAT HAD TO TAKE RESPONSIBILITY FOR THE ACTION IN ORDER TO PRESERVE HIS POSITION WITHIN THE PLO.

VINOGRADOV FURTHER STATED THAT SOVIETS BELIEVE ARAFAT HAS "MATURED" SIGNIFICANTLY IN RECENT TIMES. HE SAID SOVIETS HAVE BEEN WORKING WITH HIM TO ADVANCE THIS "MATURING" PROCESS. AT THE SAME TIME, SOVIETS FELT ARAFAT HAD SERIOUS PROBLEMS IN MAINTAINING HIS POSITION OF PRIMACY WITHIN THE PLO.

THIS OBSERVATION LED TO A DISQUISITION ON THE HISTORY OF THE SOVIET REVOLUTION, IN WHICH, ACCORDING TO VINOGRADOV, THE MOST VIOLENT AND BLOODY CLASHES CAME AFTER THE BOLSHEVIST VICTORY, AND WERE FOUGHT AGAINST LEFT-WING EXTREMISTS. THE AMBASSADOR PREDICTED THAT THE PALESTIANIANS WOULD CONTINUE TO HAVE SEVERE INTERNAL PROBLEMS AND EVENTUALLY WOULD HAVE TO BRING THEIR LEFT-WING EXTREMISTS UNDER CONTROL.

1978TEHRAN02724.subject: SHAH CONDEMNS ISRAELI ACTION IN LEBANON

segments.text: IN RESPONSE TO PRESS QUERY, SHAH CONDEMNED ISRAEL'S ATTACK ON PALESTIANIAN TARGETS IN SOUTHERN LEBANON SAYING, "WE LIKE OTHER NATIONS, CONDEMN AGGRESSION. THIS (ISRAELI ACTION) IS OF COURSE SHEER BULLYING AND IT SHOWS ONCE AGAIN WHAT INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS ARE REALLY WORTH." SHAH ADDED, "OF COURSE, I AM TALKING ABOUT THE WEAKNESS OF THE UNITED NATIONS.".

SHAH'S REMARKS CAME AT AIRPORT PRESS CONFERENCE IN ABADAN ON MARCH 18 AT CONCLUSION OF HIS TOUR OF KHUZESTAN PROVINCE. IN WIDE-RANGING INTERVIEW SHAH TOUCHED ON A NUMBER OF ISSUES INCLUDING GOI OIL POLICY AND INTERNAL DISSIDENCE WHICH ARE BEING REPORTED BY SEPTELS.

GOI-FRENCH RELATIONS: THE SHAH SAID HE COULD SEE NO REASON WHY RELATIONS BETWEEN THE TWO COUNTRIES SHOULD BE AFFECTED BY A POSSIBLE CHANGE OF GOVERNMENT. "WE STAND WHERE WE ARE. WE SHOULD WAIT AND SEE WHAT THE FRENCH SIDE DOES (IN THE EVENT PRESENT GOVERNMENT IS DEFEATED). AS A MATTER OF PRINCIPLE, FRENCH DOMESTIC POLITICS SHOULD LEAVE RELATIONS BETWEEN TEHRAN AND PARIS UNAFFECTED. BUT IF THEY WANT TO PUSH A SPECIAL POLICY, THEN IT WILL BE A DIFFERENCE STORY.", THE SHAH COMMENTED.

NAVAL PROCUREMENT: SHAH SAID GOI ORDERS FOR WEST GERMAN SUBMARINES AND WARSHIPS ARE NOT CONNECTED WITH IRAN'S PERSIAN GULF STRATEGY AS CLAIMED BY THE WESTERN PRESS. SINCE THE PERSIAN GULF IS BOTH NARROW AND SHALLOW, AND THUS IN SHAH'S WORDS, "UNSUITABLE FOR SUBMARINES", THESE PEPARATIONS ARE FOR "IRANIAN ENTRY INTO THE INDIAN OCEAN".

COMMENT: MFA SPOKESMAN TOLD EMBOFF THAT NO FURTHER GOI STATEMENT IS EXPECTED AT THIS TIME ON RECENT ISRAELI ACTION IN LEBANON SINCE SHAH HASGIVEN OFFICIAL GOI REACTION. FARSI KEYHAN MARCH 18 CARRIED ITEM IN POLITICAL COLUMN WHICH NOTED IRAN WAS ALWAYS CONCERNED WITH ATTACKS ON OTHER COUNTRIES ESPECIALLY SINCE GOI HAS TROOPS WITH U.N. PEACEKEEPING FORCE IN GOLAN.

1978TEHRAN02765.subject: POLITICAL DEVELOPMENTS: SHAH CONDEMNS SUBVERSION; MORE PRISONERS BEING RELEASED; PARLIAMENT DEFEATS CENSURE MOTION ON GOI HANDLING OF TABRIZ

segments.text: SUMMARY: SHAH CASTIGATES THOSE WHO USE LIBERTY FOR TREASON. COMBINED AMNESTIES TO RELEASE AN ADDITIONAL 1203 PRISONERS, 40 OF WHOM ARE ANTI-STATE SECURITY PRISONERS. PARLIAMENT DEFEATS CENSURE MOTION FOR HANDLING OF TABRIZ RIOTS. JUDICIAL AUTHORITIES ANNOUNCE 400 REMAIN UNDER ARREST IN TABRIZ WITH 300 RELEASED. RUMORS STILL ABOUND, BUT COUNTRY QUIET. END SUMMARY.

IN SPEECH MARCH 18 AT ABADAN, SHAH INTER ALIS CONDEMNED THOSE WHO CROSSED THE BORDER BETWEEN LIBERTY AND TREASON TO WORK FOR ADVANTAGE OF A FOREIGN POWER. HE REITERATED THEME THAT DETAILS, BUT NOT FUNDAMENTALS, OF SHAH-PEOPLE REVOLUTION ARE OPEN FOR NEGOTIATION AND DISCUSSION. HE RENEWED EARLIER PLEDGE TO CONTINUE EXTENSION OF FREEDOM DESPITE ACTIVITIES OF "REDS AND REACTIONARIES" AND EXPRESSED HOPE THAT THOSE CREATING UNREST WOULD ONE DAY "SEE THE LIGHT".

IN TWO AMNESTIES ANNOUNCED PAST TWO DAYS, IN ADDITION TO THAT NOTED REF A, GOI WILL RELEASE 385 PRISONERS WHO WERE TRIED IN MILITARY COURTS, INCLUDING 40 ANTI-STATE SECURITY PRISONERS (NAMES BEING POUCHED DEPT AND LONDON). AN ADDITIONAL 818 PRISONERS TRIED IN CIVILIAN COURTS WILL BE RELEASED AND ANOTHER 1300 INMATES WILL HAVE THEIR SENTENCES REDUCED IN ACCORDANCE WITH PROGRAM NOTED REF A. IN RELATED ACTIVITIES, MINISTRY OF JUSTICE SAID 31 STUDENTS ARRESTED IN RECENT ROUNDUP FOR PASSING PROPAGANDA (REF B) WILL BE TRIED SOON, 22 IN CIVILIAN COURTS ON DISORDERLY CONDUCT CHARGES AND NINE IN "OTHER" COURTS (PRESUMABLY MILITARY TRIBUNALS) FOR PASSING SUBVERSIVE PROPAGANDA.

MINJUSTICE ALSO ANNOUNCED FREEING OF ONE STUDENT FROM EARLIER EPISODE AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY AND HEAD OF TEHRAN COURTS HOSSEIN MORTAZAVI ANNOUNCED THAT DESPITE PUBLIC PRESSURES FOR "UNLAWFUL" ACTION, COURT TRIAL OF TWO RECENT KIDNAP-MURDERERS WOULD FOLLOW DUE PROCESS OF LAW. STATEMENT WAS IN RESPONSE TO PARLIAMENTARY AND OTHER CALLS FOR EXTRA-SPEEDY JUSTICE FOR TWO KILLERS.

MARCH 16 TABRIZ MAJLES MEMBER AHMAD BANI-AHMAD SUBMITTED CENSURE MOTION AGAINST GOVERNMENT FOR POOR HANDLING OF TABRIZ RIOTS. AFTER HEARING ARGUMENTS FROM BANI-AHMAD, ONE OTHER DEPUTY AND COUNTER-SIDXUSSION FROM MININTERIOR NASR-ISFAHANI, INTERSPERSED WITH VIOLENT ARGUMENTS, MAJLES OVERWHELMINGLY VOTED CONFIDENCE IN GOI. THIS IS FIRST CENSURE MOTION SINCE AT LEAST EARLY SIXTIES. IN MEMORY OF MAJLES OBSERVERS AND SIGNIFICANT FACT WAS THAT IT WENT FORWARD AT ALL. MAJLES CLEARLY UNEASY ABOUT SCENARIO AND NON-ROLL CALL VOTE UNDOUBTEDLY DID NOT REFLECT TRUE FEELINGS OF SOME DEPUTIES, WHO LINED UP WITH SOLID MAJORITY AFTER BLOWING OFF STEAM. PRESS CARRIED MINOR MENTION OF MITION.

TABRIZ JUDICIAL AUTHORITIES HAVE ANNOUNCED THAT 400 OF ABOUT 700 ULTIMATELY ARRESTED REMAIN IN JAIL FOR THEIR PART IN FEB 18 RIOTS. TRIALS ARE NOT EXPECTED TO BE SUBSTANTIALLY UNDERWAY FOR FOUR MONTHS, ACCORDING TO LOCAL PRESS, BUT MINJUSTICE SOURCE SAID GOI IS EXPECTING TO SPEED THIS UPP.

MARCH 19 TEHRAN JOURNAL CARRIED FULL COLUMN EDITORIAL ON NEED TO COMBAT VICIOUS RUMORS. EDITORIAL NOTED WITH APPROVAL GOI WAS TAKING ALL PRECAUTIONS, BUT SAID RUMORS WERE SO FAR BASELESS, AND THAT EVEN IF THERE WERE ATTEMPTS TO DISRUPT, NATION WOULD GO FORWARD WITH DEVELOPMENT. AS IRAN HEADS INTO TRADITIONAL NEW YEAR'S HOLIDAY BEGINNING MARCH 21, MOST ACTIVITY, INCLUDING DEMONSTRATIONS, EXPECTED TO SLOW DOWN DRAMATICALLY THOUGH WE UNDERSTAND COMMEMORATIVE SERVICES FOR "VICTIMS" OF TABRIZ RIOTS ARE STILL PLANNED FOR MARCH 30 IN MANY MOSQUES.

GOI HAS ANNOUNCED THE APPOINTMENT OF ALI KHERADMEH, A CAREER DIPLOMAT, AS AMBASSADOR TO NORWAY. BORN IN 1921 KHERADMEH HAS A PHD IN POLITICAL SCIENCE FROM THE UNIVERSITY OF TEHRAN AND DID POST GRADUATE WORK IN "PUBLIC ADMINISTRATION AND LAW ENFORCEMENT" AT NEW YORK UNIVERSITY AND THE INSTITUTDES HAUTES ETDUES INTERNATIONALES AT GENEVA. PRIOR TO JOINING MFA, HE WORKED IN THE ANGLO-IRANIAN OIL CO., THE NATIONAL BANK OF IRAN AND WAS AN OFFICER IN THE IRANIAN ARMY AND POLICE. HE SERVED FOR FOUR YEARS IN THE 1950S WITH THE POINT IV PROGRAM IN TEHRAN.

AMBASSADOR KHERADMEH JOINED MFA IN 1955 AND WAS POSTED FIRST TO COPENHAGEN. DURING THAT ASSIGNMENT HE SERVED THE FIRST OF THREE TDY ASSIGNMENTS TO THE IRANIAN MISSION TO THE UN IN NEW YORK. IN THE MID-60S HE SERVED AS DEPUTY IN THE MFA AMERICAS DIVISION, FOLLOWING WHICH HE WAS POSTED TO POSCOW FOR TWO TO THREE YEARS. IN 1970 KHERADMEH RETURNED AS DEPUTY IN THE OFFICE OF INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS, MFA, DURING WHICH HE SERVED ON DELEGATIONS TO UN MEETINGS IN GENEVA AND NEW YORK. IN THE EARLY 1970S HE SERVED AS MINISTER IN CAIRO AND IN 1973 WAS POSTED TO SAN FRANCISCO AS CONSUL GENERAL.
IN 1975 HE RETURNED TO TEHRAN TO BECOME HEAD OF THE AFRICA DIVISION FOR A BRIEF PERIOD PRIOR TO BEING NAMED AMBASSADOR TO OMAN IN DECEMBER 1975. KHERADMEH REMAINED AT THAT POST UNTIL RECENTLY.

KHERADMEH, WHO HAS BEEN AN EMBASSY CONTACT FOR OVER TWENTY YEARS, IS FRIENDLY AND APPROACHABLE BUT HAS NOT BEEN PARTICULARLY FORTHCOMING OR IMPRESSIVE, BEING CHARACTERIZED BY ONE OFFICER AS A LIGHTWEIGHT "DANDY". HE SPEAKS EXCELLENT ENGLISH AND FRENCH. DURING HIS TOUR IN MUSCAT HIS WIFE AND TWO SONS, NOW AGED 20 AND 18 RESIDED IN TEHRAN TO COMPLETE THEIR SCHOOLING.

FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY TOOK ME ASIDE THIS MORNING PRIOR TO NOW RUZ SALAAM TO TELL ME THAT SHAH HAD JUST DECIDED TO ACCEDE TO WALDHEIM REQUEST TO DEPLOY IRANIAN PEACEKEEPING CONTINGENT FROM GOLAN HEIGHTS TO SOUTH LEBANON. HE SAID SHAH HAD AGREED RELUCTANTLY AND ONLY AFTER UNSYG HAD ASSURED HIM THIS WOULD BE TEMPORARY MEASURE, AFTER WHICH OTHER CONTINGENTS WOULD REPLACE IRANIANS IN SOUTH LEBANON.

I TOOK OCCASION TO PROVIDE KHALATBARY WITH REPLIES TO QUESTIONS HE HAD EARLIER ASKED ABOUT SOVIET ATTITUDE TOWARDS PEACEKEEPING FORCE AND ABOUT METHOD OF FINANCING TO BE USED. HE REITERATED STATEMENT THAT IRAN WOULD NOT RPT NOT ASK FOR COMPENSATION FOR ITS FORCES. HE ALSO ASSURED SOVIETS WOULD REFUSE TO PAY THEIR SHARE OF ARTICLE 17 EXPENSES.
KHALATBARY, IN TELLING ME OF SHAH'S DECISION, POINTED OUT THAT CONTINGENT TO BE REDEPLOYED CONSTITUTED ENTIRE IRANIAN FORCE CURRENTLY IN GOLAN.

1978TEHRAN02807.subject: DIFFICULTIES EAST GERMANS HAVE BEEN EXPERIENCING WITH IRAN

segments.text: DIFFICULTIES WHICH EAST GERMANS HAVE BEEN EXPERIENCING WITH IRAN (REFTEL) ARE BECOMING MORE COMPLEX AND ARE BEING SUBTLY EXPLOITED BY WEST GERMANS. NOT ONLY HAVE EAST GERMAN TRADE RELATIONS BEEN AFFECTED, BUT ALSO A NUMBER OF POLITICAL AND CULTURAL EVENTS AS WELL.

PRINCIPAL AMONG THESE HAS BEEN STATE VISIT TO EAST GERMANY PLANNED BY SHAH FOR SEPTEMBER OF THIS YEAR. AS OF NOW, VISIT HAS BEEN CANCELLED, ALTHOUGH THERE IS OBVIOUSLY TIME TO REINSTATE IT SHOULD EAST GERMAN-IRAN RELATIONS BE REPAIRED BY THAT TIME.

IN MEANTIME, WEST GERMANS ARE MOVING WITH ILL-CONCEALED GLEE TO ENHANCE THEIR ALREADY CLOSE RELATIONS WITH IRAN. GERMAN AMBASSADOR TELLS ME IN CONFIDENCE THAT HE HAS JUST ARRANGED FOR A STATE VISIT TO IRAN LATER THIS SPRING BY FRG PRESIDENT WALTHER SCHEEL AND HIS WIFE. FROM THE IRANIAN POINT OF VIEW, THIS SORT OF EVENT IS OBVIOUSLY DESIGNED TO PUT PRESSURE ON EAST GERMANS TO BE MORE FORTHCOMING IN ACTIONS AND ASSURANCES DESIGNED TO PREVENT FUTURE PROPAGANDA ACTIVITIES IN EAST GERMANY BY IRANIAN DISSIDENT ACTIVISTS.

1978TEHRAN02914.subject: BRIEFING FOR SHAH ON HORN OF AFRICA

segments.text: WHEN EMBASSY CALLED IMPERIAL COURT TO OFFER BRIEFING FOR SHAH CONTAINED REF (A), CALL WAS VERY RAPIDLY RETURNED INVITING ME TO FLY TO KISH ISLAND TOMORROW MARCH 28, FOR AUDIENCE WITH SHAH. KING HUSSEIN IS ALSO THERE, BUT IT IS NOT INDICATED WHETHER I WILL SEE HIM.)

SINCE I HAVE NOT HAD AUDIENCE SINCE BEFORE MY RECENT TRIP TO WASHINGTON, SHAH WILL DOUBTLESS WISH TO TOUR HORIZON GENERALLY, AND WILL SPECIFICALLY WISH SOME READING ON HORN OF AFRICA. I NOTE FROM REF (B) THAT BRIEFING ON MOOSE VISIT IS DUE SHORTLY. IF AT ALL POSSIBLE TO GET THIS TO ME BEFORE 0800 TEHRAN LOCAL TIME (NOW 10 HOURS AHEAD OF WASHINGTON) THIS WOULD BE VALUABLE OPPORTUNITY TO REPORT OUR VIEWS ON PROGRESS THERE.

IN MAKING THIS SUGGESTION, I DO NOT RPT NOT WISH SUGGEST THAT IRAN IS CANDIDATE FOR THE SORT OF ROLE WHICH WE APPEAR TO BE EXPECTING OF SAUDI ARABIA BUT IT WILL BE A FACTOR IN IRAN'S MODEST AID PROGRAM FOR SOMALIA TO KNOW OUR OWN INTENTIONS IN THIS REGARD AND WHAT SAUDIS ARE PREPARED TO DO. IT WOULD ALSO BE HELPFUL TO BE ABLE PRESENT OUR VIEWS ABOUT UNSC ACTION IN EVENT LAGOS MEETING ABORTS OR DEADLOCKS.
77 TEHRAN 10362, E. TEHRAN 10428

INFORMED MFA FOURTH POLITICAL DIVISION DEPUTY HEAD MOKALLA OF CONTENTS REF A. MOKALLA OBVIOUSLY SURPRISED AT ZAHEDI LETTER AND PROMISED TO REDOUBLE EFFORTS TO GET OFFICIAL REPLY TO EMBASSY'S EARLIER INQUIRY REGARDING MAZAHERI-TEHRANI'S ELIGIBILITY TO LEAVE COUNTRY (REF B). COMMENT: ZAHEDI'S LETTER CERTAINLY GIVES LEVERAGE FOR PRESSURE ON GOI IF APPROPRIATE DOCUMENTS FOR DEPARTURE ARE NOT RPT NOT FORTHCOMING. WE HOPE DEPARTMENT IS PREPARING FAVORABLE REPLY TO DOCUMENT WAIVER QUESTION POSED FINAL PARA REF B.

WITH REGARD TO NAMES MENTIONED REF C, IT WOULD APPEAR THAT PROMINENT RIGHTS ACTIVIST HAS BEEN CONTACTED BY UNION OF NATIONAL FRONT (UNF) SUPPORTER REGARDING SOME OF THEIR PET CSASES. TRUST NEA/IRN HAS RUN ALL THOSE NAMED THROUGH INR'S BIO COMPUTERS. WE ARE CHECKING MORE DEEPLY, BUT HERE IS INTERIM REPORT

BEHAZIN IS SYNONYM FOR ENG. ETEMADZADEH, WHOSE ARREST FOR PROVOKING PUBLIC DISORDER WAS REPORTED REFS D AND E. HE WAS ARRESTED NOV 24 AND SUBSEQUENTLY TRIED IN PUBLIC COURT AND SENTENCED TO SHORT JAIL TERM AND FINE.

SAID SHAMS AL-AHMAD IS SUBJECT OF FLYER WHICH EMBASSY HOPES TO OBTAIN SHORTLY. WE DO NOT YET HAVE DEFINITIVE DATE OF HIS ARREST, BUT IT APPEARS TO HAVE BEEN AT LEAST ONE OR TWO YEARS AGO, PERHAPS EVEN EARLIER. ACCORDING TO DISSIDENT SOURCE, GOI ALSO APPARENTLY CONFISCATED ENTIRE BOOK (PUBLICATION) RUN REFERRED TO IN REF C.
INITIAL CHECKS ON HASSAN AHSAM AND MUHAMMED REZA ZAMINI TURNED UP NOTHING.
FOUR TERRORISTS MENTIONED PARA FOUR REF C NOT KNOWN TO US IN TERMS OF RECENT DISTURBANCES. FROM LENGTH OF SENTENCES, WE SUSPECT THESE MAY HAVE BEEN CAUGHT AND TRIED SOME TIME AGO.

TRACING AL-AHMAD AND BEHAZIN LEADS US BACK TO THE UNF CONSTELLATION, AND WE SUSPECT THAT WHEN WE TURN UP INFO ON OTHERS, THEY WILL BE FOUND TO HAVE UNF CONNECTIONS, TOO. IT IS ALWAYS USEFUL FOR US TO HAVE INFORMATION AND OUR INITIAL FINDINGS CAN BE PASSED ON, IN CONFIDENCE, TO SOURCE. U.S. RIGHTS ACTIVIST SHOULD BE CAUTIONED THAT NOT RPT NOT ALL MATERIAL HE IS GETTING FROM HIS APPARENT SOURCES IS LIKELY TO BE VALID OR WITHOUT ACCOMPANYING AXE TO GRIND.

1978TEHRAN02926.subject: LOW-LEVEL DEMONSTRATIONS: TERRORIST SHOT SUMMARY: THERE HAVE BEEN RUMORS OF DEMONSTRATIONS IN QOM AND JAHROM OVER IRANIAN NEW YEAR'S PERIOD. NUMBER OF P

segments.text: SUMMARY: THERE HAVE BEEN RUMORS OF DEMONSTRATIONS IN QOM AND JAHROM OVER IRANIAN NEW YEAR'S PERIOD. NUMBER OF PRISONERS MAY BE ENGAGING IN HUNGAR STRIKE AT QASR PRISON. ONE TERRORIST KILLED IN ISFAHAN. END SUMMARY.

WE CONTINUE TO HEAR STORIES OF MODEST DEMONSTRATIONS IN QOM OVER PAST WEEK, BUT THERE HAVE BEEN NO MEDIA STORIES ON SUBJECT AND NO RPT NO OTHER SUBSTANTIATING INFORMATION. SOURCE WHO HAS GOOD FRIEND IN QOM SAID TWO BRANCHES OF BANK MELLI WERE VANDALIZED ABOUT MARCH 19-20. IN APPROXIMATELY SAME TIME FRAME, A MULLAH IN JAHROM, SECOND LARGEST CITY IN FARS PROVINCE REPORTEDLY GAVENAN ANTI-GOVERNMENT SPEECH AT FUNERAL OF MULLAH WHO HAD DIED. ACCORDING TO SOURCE, MULLAH WHO GAVE TALK RETURNED HOME TO FIND HIS HOUSE SURROUNDED BY POLICE. SOURCE DID NOT KNOW IF MULLAH WAS ARRESTED OR NOT.

AT QASR PRISON NEAR KARAJ, SEVERAL ANTI-STATE SECURITY PRISONERS HAVE APPAENTLY BEEN ON HUNGER STRIKE SINCE MARCH 12. IN ANOTHER SECTION OF PRISON ON MARCH 15, U.S. CONSUL WHO VISITED AMCIT PRISONER SAW NOTHING. COLONEL IN CHARGE OF PRISON DID NOT MENTION STRIKE TO CONSUL AND APPEARED VERY RELAXED. (EMBASSY FOUND ABOUT ALLEGED "STRIKE" AFTER CONSUL'S VISIT.). ACCORDING TO FOREIGN JOURANLIST EYEWITNESS, THERE WERE MILD DEMONSTRATIONS OF UP TO 100 WOMEN ON MARCH 19 AND 20 NEAR PRISON, BUT NO VIOLENCE. POLICE WERE PRESENT TO KEEP ORDER.

UNION OF NATIONAL FRONT (UNF) SOURCE TOLD ANOTHER FOREIGN JOURANLIST THAT HIS GROUP HAD SENT PROTEST TELEGRAM REGARDING HUNGER STRIKE TO PRIME MINISTER ON MARCH 18, BUT THERE HAD BEEN NO RESPONSE BY MARCH 26. UNF SOURCE SAID PRISONERS STAGING HUNGER STRIKE TO HIGHLIGHT FACT THEY WERE NOT PARDONED ALONG WITH MANY OF THEIR BRETHEREN IN SUBSTANTIAL NEW YEAR'S RELEASES. (EMBASSY COMMENT: APPEARS SOME PRISONERS MAY BE FASTING. WHETHER THIS IS IN FACT CASE OR NOT, UNF COMMITTEE ON DEFENSE OF HUMAN RIGHTS IS CLEARLY COORDINATING ACTIVITY BY PRISONERS' FAMILIES TO PRESSURE GOI FOR THEIR RELEASE.)

PRESS MARCH 26 REPORTED TERRORIST WHO CALLED HIMSELF FARAMARZI WAS KILLED IN SHOOTOUT AT ISFAHAN BUS STATION WHEN POLICE STARTED TO EXAMINE TWO CRATES AND OWNER OPENED FIRE ON POLICE. CARATES SUBSEQUENTLY FOUND TO CONTAIN "SUBVERSIVE LITERATURE" (NOT FURTHER IDENTIFIED) A PORTABLE PRINTING PRESS, SOME AMMUNITION AND A GRENADE.

1978TEHRAN02936.subject: POSSIBLE COOPERATION BETWEEN EPA AND IRANIAN PLAN AND BUDGET ORGANIZATION PLAN AND BUDGET ORGANIZATION (PBO) PLANS TO SET UP

segments.text: PLAN AND BUDGET ORGANIZATION PLAN AND BUDGET ORGANIZATION (PBO) PLANS TO SET UP DATA BANK WITH INFORMATION ON WATER RESOURCES QUALITY. DATA BANK WOULD UTILIZE SATELLITE INFORMATION, AERIAL PHOTOGRAPHY AND GROUND PHOTOGRAPHY.
