PLEASE RESPOND BY IMMEDIATE CABLE PRIOR TO CLOSE OF BUSINESS MARCH 29.

1978TEHRAN02955.subject: REPRESENTATION AT MAY UN OVERVIEW MEETING

segments.text: EMBOFF, DRAWING ON REF B, RAISED ISSUE OF GOI REPRESENTATION AT MAY UN OVERVIEW MEETING WITH JAVAD VAFA, VICE MINISTER FOR INTERNATIONAL AFFAIRS, MINISTRY OF ECONOMIC AFFAIRS AND FINANCE. VAFA SAID GOI HAD DECIDED THAT ITS PARTICIPATION WOULD BE LED BY ITS PERMANENT REPRESENTATIVE TO UN, AMBASSADOR FEREIDUN HOVEYDA, WITH SPECIAL ASSISTANCE BY DR. JAHANGIR AMUZEGAR, HEAD OF IRAN'S ECONOMIC MISSION TO THE U.S., IRAN'S EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR OF THE IBRD AND BROTHER OF THE PRIME MINISTER. THIS DECISION WOULD SEEM CONSISTENT WITH VIEW GIVEN US BY MFA EARLY FEBRUARY (REF A), I.E. THAT THE MEETINGS WOULD BE COVERED BY GOI'S UN MISSION.

1978TEHRAN02957.subject: APPOINTMENT OF AMIR SHILATI-FARD AS MFA UNDERSECRETARY

segments.text: AMIR SHILATI-FARD, A CAREER DIPLOMAT, HAS BEEN APPOINTED UNDERSECRETARY FOR PARLIAMENTARY AFFAIRS IN THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS. HE JOINED MFA IN 1953 AND WAS APPOINTED AMBASSADOR TO TURKEY IN 1969 AND AMBASSADOR TO FRANCE IN 1973. AMBASSADOR SHILATI-FARD, WHO RECENTLY RETURNED FROM PARIS, WAS THE SUBJECT OF A FULL BIOGRAPHIC REPORT SUBMITTED EARLIER (TEHRAN A143, SEPTEMBER 5,1973).

SHILATI-FARD BECOMES THE FIFTH UNDERSECRETARY WITHIN MFA. ACCORDING TO MFA SOURCE, FOR THE PAST SEVERAL YEARS THE UNDERSECRETARY FOR POLITICAL AFFAIRS HAS ALSO HAD RESPONSIBILITY FOR PARLIAMENTARY AFFAIRS "DUE TO LACK OF SENIOR MFA PERSONNEL". TRADITIONALLY THE TWO JOBS HAVE BEEN SEPARATE.

1978TEHRAN02991.subject: DISCUSSION WITH SHAH ON SITUATION IN SOUTH LEBANON

segments.text: DURING AUDIENCE WITH SHAH ON OTHER MATTERS MORNING MARCH 28, WE BRIEFLY DISCUSSED SITUATION IN SOUTH LEBANON. SHAH SAID HE HAD BEEN RELUCTANT USE IRANIAN TROOPS IN ANYTHING BUT INTERIM MODE BECAUSE HE FEELS UNIFIL TASK MAY BE IMPOSSIBLE TO ACCOMPLISH. HIS GREATEST CONCERN IS THAT THERE WILL BE NO RPT NO LEBANESE FORCES CAPABLE OF TAKING OVER RESPONSIBILITY AND ASSURING LEBANESE SOVEREIGNTY IN THE REGION.

HE SAID LEBANON CAN HARDLY BE CALLED A STATE ANY MORE, AND IT CERTAINLY CANNOT BE SAID TO HAVE AN ARMY. THEREFORE SARKIS HAS A REAL PROBLEM IN TRYING TO MUSTER LEBANESE TROOPS FOR DUTY IN THE SOUTH. IF HE SENDS CHRISTIANS, THEY WILL BE RESENTED AND RESISTED. IF HE SENDS MUSLIMS, THEY WILL BE ANTI-ISRAEL AND POSSIBLY SYMPATHETIC WITH PLO. IF HE SENDS A MIXED FORCE, HE WILL HAVE MAJOR PROBLEMS OF DISCIPLINE.

SHAH'S CONCLUSION IS THAT UNIFIL WILL HAVE TO STAY FOR A LONG TIME AND THAT IT WILL NEVER HAVE THE STRENGTH TO DOMINATE THE PALESTINE UNITS IN THE AREA. IF THESE IN TURN HAVE BEEN SIGNIFICANTLY AUGMENTED BY IRAQIS, HE PREDICTS A HOST OF TROUBLES FOR THE ENTERPRISE.

1978TEHRAN02992.subject: CIVIL DISORDERS: RUMORS, THREATS FLY AGAIN;

segments.text: SUMMARY: AMERICAN COMMUNITY CHURCH RECEIVED BOMB THREAT EARLY AFTERNOON MARCH 27 BUT NO BOMB FOUND. ASSYRIAN CHURCH AND ARMENIAN NEWSPAPER HAVE RECEIVED ANONYMOUS TELEPHONE CALLS PAST FEW DAYS SAYING EASTER IS "GOOD TIME TO KILL CHRISTIANS". ONE CALL MENTIONED APRIL 1 AS POSSIBLE DATE FOR ACTION. HOWEVER, MOSLEM RELIGIOUS LEADER HERE CALLED FOR QUIET. TERRORIST MENTIONED REFTEL IDENTIFIED BUT HAD NO PREVIOUS POLITICAL RECORD. ENDSUMMARY.

ABOUT 1330 HOURS MARCH 27, PASTOR AMERICAN COMMUNITY CHURCH RECEIVED CALL FOR "AMERICAN MILITARY CHURCH"; WHEN HE TRIED TO EXPLAIN CHURCH WAS COMMUNITY AFFAIR, CALLER BROKE INTO TO THERE WAS BOMB IN BUILDING. AREA WAS CLEARED, AND SEARCH REVEALED NO BOMB. CHURCH AND OFFICES ARE BEING CLOSED FOR TWO DAYS AS PRECAUTIONARY MEASURE.

ABOUT THREE DAYS AGO, ST. THOMAS ASSYRIAN CHRISTIAN CHURCH IN TEHRAN WITH CONGREGATION OF ABOUT 2,000 EMEMBERS RECEIVED TELEPHONE CALL WHICH SAID EASTER WAS "GOOD TIME TO KILL CHRISTIANS". ASSYRIAN MINORITY MAJLES DEPUTY REPORTEDLY SAW SHAH ON MATTER AND WAS GIVEN REASSURANCES CHRISTIANS WOULD BE PROTECTED. THUS FAR, THERE HAVE BEEN NO INCIDENTS.

CHRISTIAN ARMENIAN NEWSPAPER ALIK RECEIVED TWO ANONYMOUS CALLS IN SAME VEIN AS ASSYRIAN CHURCH, BUT SECOND ONE MENTIONED POSSIBILITY OF ACTION AGAINST CHRISTAINS ON APRIL FIRST WHICH WAS SAID TO BE SOME KIND OF MARTYRS ANNIVERSARY. (COMMENT: CHECK OF OUR CALENDARS SHOWS NO RELIGIOUS OR TERRORIST ANNIVERSARY THAT WOULD FIT BILL). NOTHING HAS YET HAPPENED.

EMBASSY COMMENT: WHILE THERE HAVE BEEN NO INCIDENTS, AND SITUATION FITS PATTERN OF RUMOR MILL TWO WEEKS AGO, WE ARE MAINTAINING CAREFUL WATCH ON SITUATION, ESPECIALLY IN VIEW OF GENERAL EXPECTATION THAT "SOMETHING" WILL TAKE PLACE OVER MARCH 30-APRIL 2 PERIOD. BEST CONTACTS WE HAVE IN RELIGIOUS COMMUNITY INDICATE MARCH 30 (40-DAY ANNIVERSARY AFTER TABRIZ RIOTS) WILL BE QUIET OCCASION. SENIOR MOSLEM LEADER AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI HAS CALLED FOR CLOSING OF SHOPS BUT FOR FAITHFUL TO REMAIN AT HOME TO AVOID PROVOKING OUTBURSTS. FOREING JOURNALIST SAYS WHOLE RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP WANTS TO "KEEP LID ON" THIS TIME AND ARE MAKING MORE PREPARATIONS THAN BEFORE TO POLICE THEIR OWN GROUPS.

TERRORIST REPORTED KILLED IN ISFAHAN (REF A) IDENTIFIED AS ALI MIRABIAN, EX-MINISTRY OF EDUCATION OFFICIAL, REPORTEDLY DISMISSED BECAUSE OF ABSENTEEISM, EMBEZZLEMENT AND OTHER MISCONDUCT. WE HAVE NO INFORMATION THAT HE HAD BEEN PREVIOUSLY ACTIVE POLITICALLY.

1978TEHRAN03023.subject: CANADIAN CANDIDATE FOR IAEA DEPUTY DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR SAFEGUARDS

segments.text: WE APPROACHED VICE PRESIDENT FOR INTERNATIONAL RELATIONS OF ATOMIC ENERGY ORGANIZATION OF IRAN (AEOI), CYRUS MANZOUR, TO EXPRESS OUR SUPPORT FOR DR. PRINCE'S CANDIDACY. MANZOUR STATED THAT HIS GOVERNMENT UNDERSTANDS THAT ADDITIONAL (TO THOSE CITED REF) CANDIDATES MAY BE ENTERING THE COMPETITION; THEREFORE GOI IS WITHOLDING SUPPORT FOR ANY ONE UNTIL ALL ARE IDENTIFIED.
HAVE COORDINATED OUR ACTIVITIES ON BEHALF DR. PRINCE WITH CANADIAN EMBASSY.

1978TEHRAN03025.subject: HUMAN RIGHTS INQUIRIES: SAID SHAMS AL-AHMAD

segments.text: THIS UPDATES AND CLARIFIES INFO REGARDING AL-AHMAD WHICH REF B SUPPLIED IN REPLY TO REF A.

ACCORDING TO SOURCE WHO HAS SEEN FLYER AND HAS TALKED TO TWO DISSIDENTS WHO KNOW SUBJECT WELL, FOLLOWING IS ACCOUNT OF EVENTS SURROUNDING PUBLICATION OF BOOK WHOSE TITLE GIVEN HERE IN ENGLISH AS "THE WESTERN DISEASE".

AL-AHMAD HAS BEEN IN AND OUT OF TROUBLE WITH IRANIAN AUTHORITIES SINCE TIME OF MOSSADEQ AND IS CONSIDERED SOLIDLYLEFT-WING LITERARY FIGURE. ABOUT A MONTH AGO, HE WAS PREPARIN TO PUBLISH BOOK ON PROBLEMS OF WESTERNIZATION. AL-AHMAD DECIDED TO SHORT-CUT NORMAL PUBLICATION PROCEDURES AND FORGED CENSOR'S STAMP OF APPROVAL (WHICH REQUIRED HERE AND NORMALLY ROUTINE MATTER EXCEPT FOR SPECIFICALLY POLITICAL OR POLITICO-RELISIOUS WORKS. WHEN GOI PRESUMABLY THROUGH PRINTER) DISCOVERED FORGERY, AL-AHMAD WAS ARRESTED AND ENTIRE PUBLICATION RUN WAS CONFISCATED (AND POSSIBLY DESTROYED) BECAUSE REQUISITE APPROVAL STAMP HAD BEEN FORGED.

SOURCE WHO REPORTED THIS INTIMATED THAT, WHILE CENSORSHIP PERHAPS NOT LEGAL IN U.S., AL-AHMAD APPEARS TO HAVE CLEARLY BROKEN FORGERY LAW AND, GIVEN CIRCUMSTANCES, THIS MIGHT NOT RPT NOT BE BEST POSSIBLE CASE ON WHICH TO CRITICIZE CENSORSHIP.

1978TEHRAN03026.subject: TERRORIST THREAT LETTER DIRECTED AGAINST AMERICANS IN KABUL

segments.text: ASIDE FROM WRY AND REGRETFUL "WELCOME TO THE CLUB" TEHRAN CAN ADD LITTLE HARD DATA ON THREAT TO USIS LIBRARY KABUL (REFS A AND B). EXCELLENT DEPARTMENTAL BACKGROUNDER (REF C) GIVES BASICS ON CHARIKS.

OUR FIRST REACTION AFTER READING LETTER (REF B) IS THAT THERE IS AT MOST A MARGINAL CONNECTION BETWEEN KABUL EFFORT AND IRANIAN CHARIKS. THOUGH CHARIKS HERE HAVE COME OUT IN SUPPORT OF PLO OBJECTIVES ON SPORADIC OCCASIONS SINCE 1972, THE FEW DOCUMENTS WE HAVE SEEN HAVE BEEN MUCH MORE CONCERNED WITH DOMESTIC IRANIAN MATTERS. NOTHING ALONG LINES OF KABUL LETTER HAS SURFACED HERE, THOUGH CHARIKS DID CIRCULATE LETTER IN JANUARY 1978 CLAIMING RESPONSIBILITY FOR BOMB BLAST WHICH DAMAGED IRAN-AMERICAN SOCIETY STUDENT CENTER ON DEC 28, THREE DAYS BEFORE PRESIDENT CARTER'S END-OFYEAR VISIT TO TEHRAN.

THEIR SUBSEQUENT PROPAGANDA HERE HAS HAD SOMEWHAT MORE ANTI-AMERICAN TINGE THAN FORMERLY BUT WITH NO MENTIONS OF CHINESE OR MAO TSE-TUNG. IF KABUL GROUP WERE REALLY IRANIANS, WE WOULD HAVE EXPECTED ANY DOCUMENT THEY ISSUED TO TAKE EXTENSIVE SWATS AT SHAH. WHILE "ARMED ATTACK" SMACKS OF THE CHARIKS, THAT PHRASE IS HARDLY ORIGINAL. MOREOVER, COMMON PRACTICE OF IRANIAN TERRORIST GROUPS IS TO CLAIM CREDIT FOR AND EXPLAIN A TERRORIST ACT AFTER THE FACT. WE KNOW OF NO INSTANCES WHERE VICTIMS WERE WARNED IN ADVANCE.

EMBASSY IS CHECKING OUT POSSIBLE CHARIK CAPABILITIES IN AFGHANISTAN WITH LOCAL AUTHORITIES, BUT THEIR INITIAL REACTION IS SIMILAR--IRANIAN CHARIKS HAVE INSUFFICIENT ORGANIZATIONAL CAPABILITY OR DESIRE FOR TYPE OF FOREIGN PROJECTION DESCRIBED REF A. IN THIS CONNECTION, WOULD APPRECIATE KABUL POUCHING FARSI COPY OF NOTE FOR EXAMINATION HERE.

AS INITIAL VIEW, WE TEND TO THINK USE OF CHARIK SIGNATURE MAY HAVE RESULTED FROM CLOSE CONNECTION OF OTHERS (PROBABLY PALESINIANS) WITH GOOD IRANIAN FRIEND, PERHAPS SYMPATHETIC TO CAHRIK CAUSE, WHO MAY HAVE HELPED DRAFT LETTER SENT TO USIS.

1978TEHRAN03034.subject: SECOND BOMB THREAT AT COMMUNITY CHURCH, OTHER CIVIL ATTACKS

segments.text: SUMMARY: ARMY CHAPLAIN'S OFFICE AT COMMUNITY CHURCH RECEIVED SECOND BOMB THREAT BY SAME INDIVIDUAL MARCH 29, OTHER SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY OCCURRED. NO BOMB FOUND, GUARDS TO BE PLACED ON CHURCH. PRESS MARCH 29 REPORTS SEVERAL INCIDENTS OF ATTACKS ON BANKS, OFTEN WITH BOTTLES FILLED WITH GASOLINE OR OTHER INFLAMMABLE CHEMICALS. TWO CITY BUILDINGS, ONE BANK ATTACKED IN ISFAHAN MARCH 29. ATTACKS APPEAR TO BE RANDOM INCIDENTS BY LIKE-MINDED FANATICS. END SUMMARY.

ARMY CHAPLAIN'S OFFICE, WHICH RECEIVED FIRST BOMB THREAT CALL REFTEL), GOT SECOND CALL ABOUT 1100 HOURS MARCH 29 WARNING THAT "YESTERDAY WAS KIDDING, TODAY IS THE REAL THING." CALLER CONVINCED LISTENER THAT HE HAD WITNESSED EPISODE REPORTED REFTEL AND SAID IRAN WOULD NOT BE GREAT UNTIL IT GOT RID OF ALL CHRISTIANS, ESPECIALLY THE ARMY CHAPLAIN. WHEN TOLD THERE WERE CHILDREN IN AREA, CALLER REPLIED "THEY DON'T COUNT; THEY'RE ONLY MILITARY CHILDREN." CALLER DESCRIBED HIMSELF AS A CONCERNED IRANIAN. SEARCH REVEALED NO BOMB, BUT LATER IN AFTERNOON AT LEAST TWO SUSPICIOUS CHARACTERS WERE SEEN IN VICINITY OF CHURCH.

ONE WAS CHASED THROUGH BACK CORNER OF LOT AND OBSERVED TO HAVE SMALL OBJECT, PERHAPS PISTOL, IN HAND. ARMISH-MAAG CHIEF HAS ASKED FOR MILITARY GUARD, AND TWO IRANIAN MILITARY ARE BEING STATIONED AT CHURCH FOR NEXT TWO WEEKS.

PARS NEWS AGENCY (PANA) REPORTED MORNING MARCH 29 THAT ON MARCH 27 AND28BANKS AND OTHER OFFICES WERE ATTACKED IN VARIOUS IRANIAN CITIES. MARCH 27, IN QAZVIN TWO SADERAT BANK BRANCHES WERE ATTACKED BY GROUPS WITH FIRE BOMBS WHO BROKE NUMEROUS WINDOWS. NO CASUALTIES BUT MODERATE DAMAGE. IN BABOL, ABOUT 50 MASKED INDIVIDUALS REPORTEDLY ATTACKED BAZARGANI AND SADERAT BANK BRANCH OFFICES AND KNOCKED RESURGENCE PARTY SIGN OFF PARTY'S OFFICE BUILDING BEFORE BEING DISPERSED BY THE POLICE. SIX WERE ARRESTED.

PANA ALSO REPORTED AN UNIDENTIFIED GROUP SMASHED A SADERAT BANK BRANCH WINDOW AND LEFT BEHIND A BOTTLE OF INFLAMMABLE CHEMICALS. IN KASHAN THREE UNIDENTIFIED PERSONS THREW A CAN OF GASOLINE AT THE BITA CINEMA HALL WHERE THE MAIN ENTRANCE CAUGHT FIRE BEFORE BEING QUICKLY PUT OUT.

CONSULATE ISFAHAN CONFIRMED RADIO REPORTS THAT TWO BRANCHES OF THE MUNICIPAL BUILDINGS WERE ATTACKED BY SOME GAS-FILLED BOTTLES WITH LITTLE DAMAGE AND NO CASUALTIES. A BANK SADERAT BRANCH WAS ALSO FIREBOMBED.

EMBASSY COMMENT: THROUGH MARCH 29, RELIGIOUS AUTHORITIES HAVE CONTINUED TO URGE CALM AND NON-PROVOCATIVE STANCE ON THEIR FOLLOWERS. GENERAL BELIEF IS THAT ATTACKS NOTED ABOVE ARE WORK OF SMALL GROUPS OF PROBABLY FANATIC ISLAMIC FUNDAMENTALISTS "MARCHING TO A DIFFERENT DRUM" WHO ARE PROBABLY NOT RPT NOT RESPONSIVE TO STANDARD RELIGIOUS CONTROL BY LEADERS.

1978TEHRAN03067.subject: ATTENDANCE AT SPECIAL SESSION ON DISARMAMENT

segments.text: UK HEAD OF CHANCERY HAS TOLD POL-MIL COUNS THAT DURING RECENT SEVERAL DAY VISIT TO IRAN OF UK DEFMIN FRED MULLEY SHAH ASKED MULLY IF HE (HIM) SHOULD ATTEND THE SPECIAL SESSION ON DISARMAMENT (SSOD). THERE APPARENTLY WAS NO DISCUSSION OF QUESTION, WHICH SEEMED TO TAKE MULLEY QUITE BY SURPRISE. HEAD OF CHANCERY SAID SHAH WAS BEING AROSE IN WAY THAT LED UK EMBASSY TO ASSUME SHAH WAS BEING PRESSED TO ATTEND SSOD. CARRYING PROCESS ONE STEP FURTHER, BRITS ASSUMED THAT IF SHAH HAD BEEN PRESSED US WOULD BE LIKELY SOURCE OF PRESSURE.

POL-MIL COUNS SAID THIS EMBASSY HAD NO INSTRUCTIONS ON SSOD, AND HAD NOT DISCUSSED SPECIAL SESSION WITH GOI. COMMENT: SHAH DID NOT RAISE QUESTION WITH AMBASSADOR DURING AUDIENCE TWO DAY FOLLOWING MULLEY, AND WE SURPRISED TO HEAR THAT SHAH PUT QUESTION TO MULLEY. END COMMENT.
WITH RESPECT TO HMG PRESENTATION AT SSOD, UK EMBASSY HERE HAD BEEN ASSUMING THAT FONSEC OWEN WOULD ATTEND, BUT NOW UNDERSTANDS THAT PRIMIN CALLAGHAN PLANS TO GO.
WOULD APPRECIATE ANY GUIDANCE IN CASE QUESTION IS RAISED WITH AMBASSADOR.

1978TEHRAN03074.subject: MINISTRY OF ENERGY TO TAKE OVER NUCLEAR POWER OPERATIONS

segments.text: OPERATIONS

FARSI PRESS ON 29 MARCH NOTED AND EMBASSY HAS CONFIRMED THAT MINISTRY OF ENERGY HAS BEEN GIVEN NEW RESPONSIBILITIES FOR NUCLEAR POWER OPERATIONS, TO INCLUDE NEGOTIATING CONTRACTS AND AGREEMENTS, CONSTRUCTION, AND OPEATION.

COMMENT: THIS TAKEOVER OF NUCLEAR POWER ACTIVITITES IS A BLOW TO ATOMIC ENERGY ORGANIZATION OF IRAN (AEOI), WHICH IS REPORTEDLY SUFFERING MORALE AND PERSONNEL PROBLEMS AS A RESULT OF BOTH THIS LOSS OF NUCLEAR POWER OPERATIONS AND ITS RECENT REORGANIZATION. FUNCITIONAL AND ORGANIZATIONAL RAMIFICATIONS REMAIN TO BE SEEN, BUT AEOI WILL CERTAINLY SUFFER FROM LOSS OF ITS PRESTIGIOUS, BIG BUDGET ACTIVITIES. IN THE LARGER VIEW, HOWEVER, IT SEEMS SENSIBLE THAT MINISTRY OF ENERGY CONTROL ALL ELECTRIC (RATHER THAN ONLY CONVENTIONAL) POWER ACTIVITIES.

1978TEHRAN03100.subject: DISCUSSION WITH SHAH ON PALESTINE ISSUE IN WEST BANK

segments.text: WHEN I SAW THE SHAH MARCH 28, HE ONCE AGAIN RAISED WITH ME HIS FAVORITE FORMULA FOR HANDLING THE PALESTINE ISSUE IN THE WEST BANK, THAT FORMULA, YOU WILL RECALL, IS TO INTERPRET RESOLUTION 242 AS REQUIRING ISRAEL TO HAND BACK THE WEST BANK (WITH TERRITORIAL ADJUSTMENTS TO BE AGREED) TO JORDAN, FROM WHICH IT WAS TAKEN BY SIRAELI MILITARY ACTION. UNDER THIS FORMULA, ISRAEL WOULD NOT RPT NOT BE REQUIRED TO MAKE ANY DECISIONS ABOUT A REFERENDUM OR OTHER ACT OF "SELF-DETERMINATION" BY THE PALESTINIANS. SUCH MATTERS WOULD BECOME THE RESPONSIBILITY OF JORDAN TO MAKE AFTER THE TERRITORY IS HANDED BACK.

THE SHAH, WHO HAD KING HUSSEIN AS HIS GUEST ON KISH ISLAND DURING THIS CONVERSATION, SAID HE WAS CONFIDENT HUSSEIN WAS PREPARED TO ASSUME THE RESPONSIBILITY FOR HANDLING THE PALESTINIAN ISSUE AND COULD BE COUNTED ON TO RESIST THE IDEA OF AN INDEPENDENT PALESTINIAN STATE. THE SHAH HAS PREVIOUSLY TOLD ME THAT SADAT WOULD ALSO ACCEPT THIS FORMULA FOR THE WEST BANK.

THIS IS ABOUT THE FOURTH TIME THE SHAH HAS MADE THIS PROPOSAL TO US AND WE HAVE NEVER YET GIVEN HIM A RESPONSE. YOU WILL RECALLL THAT HE OUTLINED THESE IDEAS TO THE SECRETARY IN WASHINGTON LAST NOVEMBER AND AGAIN TO THE PRESIDENT IN TEHRAN ON DECEMBER 31. HE OBVIOUSLY BELIEVES THAT THEY HAVE MERIT AND THAT WE HAVE NOT YET EXPLAINED WHY WE DECLINE TO ESPOUSE THEM IN THE PEACE-MAKING PROCESS.

I AM NOT ADEQUATELY ACQUAINTED WITH THE NUANCES OF THE PALESTINIAN ISSUE AND OF THE NEGOTIATIONS TO KNOW WHY THE SHAH'S FORMULA HAS NEVER BEEN TRIED. ON THE FACE OF IT, THE IDEAS WOULD SEEM TO OFFER A WAY TO GET ISRAEL OFF THE PALESTINE HOOK, EVEN IF IT DOES IMPOSE A CONSIDERABLE BURDEN ON HUSSEIN TO FACE ARAB PRESSURES ABOUT PALESTINE SELFDETERMINATION AS WELL AS TERRITORIAL CONCESSIONS ON THE WEST BANK. HOWEVER, IF HUSSEIN REALLY IS PREPARED TO SHOULDER THESE BURDENS, HE WOULD SEEM A RELIABLE PARTY TO THE PEACE PROCESS.

ACTION REQUESTED: I WOULD LIKE TO HAVE AN AUTHORITATIVE U.S. REACTION TO THE SHAH'S PROPOSALS. IF WE FEEL THEY ARE NON-STARTERS, I WOULD APPRECIATE HAVING THE FULL RATIONALE SO THAT I CAN EXPOUND IT TO HIM THE NEXT TIME HE RAISES THEM. IF, ON THE OTHER HAND, YOU FEEL THEY HAVE MERIT AND ARE PREPARED TO TRY THEM, I WOULD APPRECIATE BEING ABLE TO LET HIM KNOW IN ADVANCE.

AS A POINT OF FACT CHARIK ORGANIZATION HAS NOT BEEN RESPONSIBLE FOR ASSASSINATIONS OF AMERICANS UP TO NOW, JUST FOR ONE BOMBING AND SOME VERY GENERALIZED THREATS (TEHRAN REFTEL). THEIR ASSASSINATIONS SO FAR CONFINED TO IRANIAN OFFICIALS AND BUSINESSMEN. ASSASSINATION OF AMERICANS TO DATE HAS BEEN WORK OF OTHER TERRORIST GROUP, THE MUJAHIDIN-E-KHALQ OR "PEOPLES STRUGGLERS."
WHILE THIS IS IMPORTANT FOR KABUL TI KNOW, LEAVE IT TO YOU WHETHER OR NOT TO CHANGE PRESENTATION ALREADY GIVEN TO MINISTER OF INTERIOR (KABUL REFTEL).

ABSENCE OF CHARIK ATTACKS ON AMERICANS IN THE PAST MIGHT CONCEIVABLY BE ANOTHER SMALL PIECE OF EVIDENCE TENDING TO SUGGEST WRITERS OF LETTER ARE NOT CONNECTED WITH IRANIAN CHARIKS--BUT IN VIEW OF POSSIBLE CHANGE IN FUTURE CHARIK BEHAVIOR THAT WOULD BE THIN STRAW ON WHICH TO LEAN.

HEAD OF MFA AFRICA DEPARTMENT TOLD POLCOUNS MARCH 30 THAT BELGIAN AMBASSADOR HAD BEEN IN TO SEE HIM A FEW DAYS AGO TO INFORM GOI OF "MOBUTU PLAN" FOR INTERNAL REFORM AND ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT OF ZAIRE. BELGIAN TOLD HIM INVITATION FOR GOI TO PARTICIPATE, ALONG WITH SUCH OTHERS AS SAUDI ARABIA, AND PROBABLY FRANCE, ITALY, GERMANY, WILL BE FORTHCOMING ONCE INITIAL PLANNING HAS BEEN CUT DOWN AND MADE MORE PRACTICAL BY GROUP CURRENTLY WORKING ON IT IN BRUSSELS. BELGIANS ARE CHAIRING THE EFFORT AND FURTHER CONTACT CAN BE EXPECTED AFTER A COUPLE MORE WEEKS.

DEPARTMENT HEAD SAID GOI IS VERY INTERESTED IN ZAIRE'S FUTURE AND WILL SEE WHAT IT CAN DO TO ASSIST ONCE SPECIFIC NEEDS ARE CLEAR, AS WELL AS PLANS OF OTHER POTENTIAL DONORS. HOWEVER, DEPARTMENT HEAD TOLD US (THOUGH APPARENTLY NOT THE BELGIAN), IRAN IS IN NO POSITION TO ASSIST FINANCIALLY AT PRESENT. HE DID NOT RULE OUT FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE AFTER A YEAR OR TWO. HE UNDERSTOOD IMMEDIATE FINANCIAL NEEDS OF ZAIRE ARE BEING STUDIED AT PRESENT BY IMF TEAM IN KINSHASA.
DEPARTMENT HEAD REFERRED IN PASSING TO RECENT ATTEMPTED COUP D'ETAT IN ZAIRE, APPARENTLY INSTIGATED BY LIBYANS, BUT SURPRISINGLY SEEMING TO INVOLVE A BELGIAN DIPLOMAT IN KINSHASA.
ACTION REQUESTED: IN VIEW OF AWAKENING GOI INTEREST IN ZAIRE, REQUEST DEPARTMENT KEEP US CURRENTLY INFORMED OF POLITICAL AND ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENTS THERE.

SUMMARY: ON 40TH DAY ANNIVERSARY OF TABRIZ RIOTS, TEHRAN VERY QUIET, AND ONLY MINOR DISTURBANCES REPORTED IN A FEW OTHER IRANIAN CITIES. PRESS HAS CRITICIZED "HOOLIGANS" WHO OPERATE OUTSIDE LAW. END SUMMARY.

DESPITE A FEW PREDICTIONS OF DEMONSTRATIONS, TEHRAN HAS EXPERIENCED ONE OF ITS QUIETEST DAYS. FOLLOWING EXHORTATIONS FROM RELIGIOUS LEADERS, TEHRAN BAZAAR SHOPS DID NOT OPEN TODAY, BUT AS OF 1300, THERE HAVE BEEN NO PUBLIC MANIFESTATIONS OF DISORDER. SOME OTHER MERCHANTS IN OTHER PARTS OF CITY CLOSED STORES, MANY OF THEM RELIGIOUS MINORITY SHOPOWNERS BEING PRUDENT IN FACE OF VARIOUS RUMORED THREATS (REF A).
COMMUNITY CHURCH HAS EXPERIENCED NO RPT NO MORE THREATS OR INCIDENTS SINCE POLICE GUARDS WERE PLACED AROUND PREMISES EVENING OF MARCH 29 (REF B).

IN OTHER CITIES, PRESS MARCH 30 REPORTED WINDOWSMASHING OF RESURGENCE PARTY HEADQUARTERS IN ABADAN TUESDAY AND NOTED ISFAHAN INCIDENTS REPORTED REFTEL. FIRE OF UNIDENTIFIED ORIGIN IN BABOL NIGHT MARCH 28, WHICH DESTROYED NUMBER OF SHOPS BEFORE BEING EXTINGUISHED. TO DATE THERE IS NO EVIDENCE OF DELIBERATE ARSON BUT NATURAL SUSPICIONS PERSIST. LOCAL RADIO AT 1400 REPORTED ADDITIONAL INCIDENTS AGAINST BANKS MARCH 29 IN YAZD, ZAHEDAN AND MASHAD. OUR SHIRAZ CONSULATE REPORTS ALL QUIET THERE, EXCEPT FOR SMALL DISTURBANCES IN BAZAAR WHICH BEGAN ABOUT NOON MARCH 30 AND POLICE HAVE UNDER CONTROL.

MEDIA SAID ISFAHAN SAW ATTACKS AGAINST BANK AND POLICE CAR MARCH 29, NOTHING SO FAR MARCH 30; CONSULATE SAYS POLICE CHASED OFF ATTACKERS BY FIRING INTO CAR. THERE HAVE BEEN NO ARRESTS. TABRIZ TOTALLY QUIET. IN ONLY CASE WHERE ARRESTS REPORTED, COLLEGE STUDENTS FROM COLLEGE OF ARTS IN AHWAZ REPORTEDLY WENT TO DEZFUL, 100 KILOMETERS AWAY, AND ATTACKED BANKS; FIVE STUDENTS WERE SUBSEQUENTLY ARRESTED.

AT QAZVIN, 2A.M. MARCH 30, POLICE ATTEMPTED TO ARREST TWO INDIVIDUALS DRIVING A PEYKAN FOR PASSING OUT "LEFTIST LITERATURE". OCCUPANTS OF CAR OPENED FIRE, AND ONE WAS KILLED BY POLICE WHILE OTHER ESCAPED. POLICE FOUND NUMBER OF INCRIMINATING ITEMS IN CAR INCLUDING LITERATURE, WEAPONS AND FORGED IDENTIFICATION CARDS.

KEYHAN ENGLISH EDITION CARRIED EDITORIAL MARCH 30 REITERATING THEME THAT IRAN'S NATIONAL SOLIDATITY WILL DEFEAT THE "UNHOLY ALLIANCE" FOR LEFT AND RIGHT FORCES. IT POINTED OUT HOOLIGANS ARE RESORTING TO ILLEGAL AND DESTRUCTIVE ACTS AND ASSERTED IT IS A CRIME FOR THOSE WHO TAKE TO THE STREETS TO DENY PURSUIT OF LIFE WITHIN LAW TO OTHERS. TEHRAN JOURNAL SMAE DAY NOTED NEW EAST AZARBAIJAN GOVERNOR SHAFAQAT HAD CALLED FOR IMPROVEMENT OF TABRIZ ENVIRONMENT BY CREATION OF CITY'S FIRST SEWAGE SYSTEM. EDITORIAL, IN FLIGHT OF RHETORIC, SPOKE OF SPING WINDS OF CHANGE ACROSS IRAN AND CALLED ON OTHER CITIES TO GET MOVING ON DEVELOPMENT AND REFORM PROGRAMS.

WE UNDERSTAND LOCAL AUTHORITIES IN QOM EXPECT SOME DEMONSTRATIONS THERE AFTERNOON MARCH 30. QOM HAS BEEN CENTER OF RUMORED DEMONSTRATIONS FOR OVER SIX WEEKS; HOWEVER, THOSE FEW WHICH HAVE ACTUALLY OCCURRED SINCE JAN. 9 RIOTS HAVE BEEN IN VERY LOW KEY AND EXPEDITIOUSLY HANDLED BY POLICE.

1978TEHRAN03141.subject: BOMB THREATS AT SHIRAZ CONSULATE AND OTHER AREAS RELATED TO AMERICAN COMMUNITY

segments.text: PRINOFF HOUSED IN RESIDENCE IMMEDIATELY BELOW SHIRAZ CONSULATE RECEIVED PHONE CALL BOMB THREAT AT 1800 HOURS LOCAL TIME ON SATURDAY APRIL 1. CALLER SPOKE INITIALLY IN BROKEN ENGLISH, THEN IN FARSI, AND AFTER SOME INITIAL INNOCUOUS REMARKS, USED TERM "BOMB" TO INTERRUPT PRINOFF. CALLER THEN PROCEEDED TO RAMBLE ON IN OBVIOUSLY UNREHEARSED AND OFTEN INCOHERENT TERMS AGAINST US PRESENCE IN IRAN, SAYING AGAIN AND AGAIN THAT AMERICANS SHOULD "LEAVE". PRINOFF INITIALLY ATTEMPTED TO DRAW OUT CONVERSATION RE CALLER'S COMMENTS ABOUT AMERICANS. TELEPHONE CALL WAS TERMINATED BEFORE CONVERSATION COULD BE DIRECTED BACK TO CALLER'S INITIAL REFERENCE TO "BOMB". 2.SHIRAZ CONSULATE AND PRINOFFS RESIDENCE WERE SEARCHED WITH NEGATIVE RESULTS.

APPROPRIATE GOI AUTHORITIES WERE NOTIFIED. FYI, CONSULATE WAS CLOSED ON BOTH MARCH 31 AND APRIL 1 AND HAD NOT BEEN OPEN TO PUBLIC SINCE MARCH 30. IN VIEW OF LACK OF PUBLIC ACCESS A AND CONTINUAL GOI POLICE COVERAGE ON PREMISES, PROBABILITY OF A BOMB BEING PLACED ON PREMISES WAS SMALL.

ON FRIDAY, MARCH 31, AT APPROX 1500 HOURS LOCAL TIME, A BOMB THREAT IN FARSI WAS CALLED IN TO VICTORIA HOTEL IN TEHRAN. CALL WAS BRIEF AND STATED SIMPLY THAT THERE WAS A "BOMB IN THE HOTEL". SUBSEQUENT SEARCH WAS NEGATIVE. OF POSSIBLE INTEREST IS FACT THAT VICTORIA HOTEL IS UTILIZED ALMOST EXCLUSIVELY TO HOUSE AMERICAN PERSONNEL OF GRUMMAN CORP. CALLER MADE NO MENTION OF AMERICANS OR GRUMMAN CORP. AT TIME OF RECEIPT OF TERRORIST THREAT LETTER BY GRUMMAN CORP OFFICE IN TEHRAN IN JANUARY (REFER TEHRAN 0390, TEHRAN 0425), RSO COORDINATED WITH GOI TO ARRANGE PLAINCLOTHED POLICE COVERAGE IN AREA OF VICTORIA HOTEL.
GRUMMAN IS REQUESTING, WITH RSO ASSISTANCE, ADDITIONAL POLICE COVERAGE OF VICTORIA HOTEL AT PRESENT TIME.

NO FURTHER INCIDENTS OR THREATS (REFER TEHRAN 2992, TEHRAN 3034) HAVE BEEN RECEIVED AT TEHRAN COMMUNITY CHURCH SINCE POLICE GUARDS WERE PLACED AROUND PREMISES EVENING OF MARCH 29. SULLIVA N NOTE BY OC/T: TELEGRAM DELAYED IN TRANSMISSION.

1978TEHRAN03146.subject: LOW LEVEL VIOLENCE OVER HOLIDAY WEEKEND

segments.text: SUMMARY: OVER WEEKEND, LOW-LEVEL VIOLENCE OCCURED IN ABOUT 15 IRANIAN CITIES ACCORDING TO LOCAL PRESS SOURCES. BOMB THREATS (BEING REPORTED SEPTEL) MADE TO ONE TRAN HOTEL WHERE GRUMMAN EMPLOYEES STAY, ONE ISFAHAN HOTEL AND AMCONSULATE SHIRAZ. NO BOMBS FOUND. TWO RIOTERS WERE KILLED IN YAZD AND ONE TERRORIST DIED IN QAZVIN SHOOTOUT (PREVIOUSLY REPORTED REFTEL). SEVERAL INDIVIDUALS ARRESTED FOR ALLEGEDLY DISTRIBUTING ANTI-STATE PROPAGANDA. INCIDENTS NOT RPT NOT BELIEVED PART OF OVERALL PLAN BUT RESULT OF NUMEROUS SMALL GROUPS DECIDING TO TAKE MATTERS INTO THEIR OWN HANDS. MANY BECOMING MORE CONCERNED AS VIOLENCE CONTINUES, BUT THEIR REACTIONS VARY. END SUMMARY.

PRESS APRIL 1 AND APRIL 3 REPORT SERIES OF INCIDENTS INVOLVING LOW-LEVEL VIOLENCE--BREAKING BANK WINDOWS, ATTACKS ON GOVERNMENT BUILDINGS, ATTEMPTS TO START FIRES--IN FIFTEEN IRANIAN CITIES. PRESS CHARACTERIZES SERIES OF EVENTS AN "OUTBURST OF VIOLENCE", BUT OVERWHELMING MAJORITY OF INCIDENTS INVOLVED VERY SMALL GROUPS ON HIT-AND-RUN BASIS. (FULL ACCOUNT BEING POUCHED.) MAJOR EXCEPTION WAS YAZD WHERE TWO RIOTERS WERE KILLED WHEN POLICE OPENED FIRE ON CROWD TRYING TO BURN BANKS. POLICE FIRED AFTER TRYING TO BRING SCENE UNDER CONTROL WITH FIRE HOSES AND TEAR GAS, ACCORDING TO PARS NEWS AGENCY.

SECOND EXCEPTION WAS MASHAD, WHERE 40 PEOPLE WERE ATTACKING BANKS AND PUBLIC BUILDINGS WHEN POLICE WADED IN, ARRESTED SIX AND DISPERSED THE REST. ONLY OTHER LARGESCALSE ACTION WAS AT MIANEH, WHERE 80 MASKED DEMONSTRATORS ATTACKED THE RAILWAY STATION FRIDAY MARCH 31 AND TRIED TO HALT A TRAIN WITH STICKS AND ROCKS. THERE WAS DAMAGE BUT NO CASUALTIES.

OTHER ATTACKS OCCURED AGAINST WOMEN'S ORGANIZATION BUILDINGS, GOVERNMENT OFFICES, BANKS AND MOVIE HOUSES IN NUMBER OF CITIES, INCLUDING ABADAN, AHWAZ, ISFAHAN, TEHRAN AND QOM. TEHRAN ACTIVITY WAS CONFINED TO MARCH 30-31, LOCATED MOSTLY IN SOUTH OF CITY. BY APRIL 2 SOUTH TEHRAN HAD RETURNED TO NORMAL FOR FINAL NEW YEAR'S HOLIDAY, SIEZDAH BEDAR. SHIRAZ, EXCEPT FOR INCIDENT REPORTED REFTEL, AND TABRIZ WERE QUIET. ------------------085213 032334Z /62 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 7664 INFO USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY LONDON SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 3146

MARCH 30 AND 31 SAW BOMB THREATS AGAINST HOTEL IN TEHRAN WHICH HOUSES GRUMMAN EMPLOYEES AND LARGE ISFAHAN HOTEL. ON APRIL 1, AMCONSULATE SHIRAZ RECEIVED PHONE CALL IN EARLY EVENING WITH BOMB THREAT. IN ALL CASES, SEARCH WAS MADE, NO BOMBS WERE FOUND.

IRANIAN SECURITY AGENTS CARRIED OUT RAIDS IN TABRIZ MARCH 29, WHICH NETTED EIGHT PEOPLE ACCUSED OF DISTRIBUTING SUBVERSIVE LITERATURE AND TWO OTHERS--MIRALI COLAMI SAPIDANI AND BAIRAM GURZAH--ON CHARGES OF SELLING CASSETTES CONTAINING SUBVERSIVE PROPAGANDA. CASSETTES REPORTEDLY CAME FROM QOM, ACCORDING TO SAPIDANI AND GURZAH. POLICE, NOT SECURITY SERVICE, ALSO ARRESTED THREE INDIVIDUALS IN ABADAN AND FOUR STUDENTS IN TEHRAN FOR DISTRIBUTING ANTI-STATE LEAFLETS.

WE UNDERSTAND FROM RELIABLE FOREIGN REPORTER WHO WAS PRESENT THAT SENIOR TEHRAN MULLAH GAVE TWO-HOUR SERMON MARCH 30 IN TEHRAN'S BAZAAR MOSQUE. SPEECH WAS DISTINCTLY ANTI-GOVERNMENT THOUGH SHAH NOT MENTIONED. USE OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI'S NAME BROUGHT LOUD CHEERS, HOWEVER, AS DID MENTION OF LOCAL RELIGIOUS LEADERS BY NAME. SITUATION WAS PEACEFUL THOUGH POLICE WERE PRESENT.

FULL ANALYSIS WOULD BE PREMATURE, BUT INITIAL ACCOUNTS SUGGEST EVENTS WERE NOT CENTRALLY DIRECTED (SENIOR RELIGIOUS LEADERS HAD CALLED FOR QUIET OBSERVANCE OF 40TH DAY COMMEMORATION OF TABRIZ RIOTS AT HOM) BUT WORK OF SMALLER GROUPS WHO DECIDED TO ACT ON THEIR OWN. AMATEURISH ORGANIZATION OF SEVERAL EVENTS AND CONCURRENT ARRESTS OF "SUBVERSIVE" GROUPS SUGGESTS MANY FOLK DECIDED TO GET INTO ACT. TWO VETERAN IRANIAN OBSERVERS OF DISSIDENT SCENE EXPRESSED SURPRISE AND DISMAY AT RESULTS OF WHAT ONE DESCRIBED AS SHAH'S "LET A HUNDRED FLOWERS BLOOM" CAMPAIGN AND OFFERED SAD REGRET THAT "SO MANY BLOSSOMS WERE COMING UP STINKWEED".

ON OTHER HAND, NUMBER OF IRANIANS WHO MIGHT BE DESCRIBED AS PART OF "ESTABLISHMENT" BECOMING PESSIMISTICALLY CONCERNED THAT SHAH'S LIBERALIZATION COMING TO MEAN TACIT PERMISSION FOR VIOLENCE. OVER NEXT FEW WEEKS, THERE IS LIKELY TO BE SERIOUS PUBLIC AND PRIVATE REVIEW OF EVENTS OF RECENT PAST AND MUTED DEBATE OF WHERE IRAN SHOULD GO FROM HERE. AS OF NOW, IRANIAN OPINION IS SPLIT ON QUESTION OF ACCEPTING STATE OF AFFAIRS WHICH CONTINUES TO PRODUCE VIOLENT DISSIDENCE.
DESPITE ADDITIONAL BOMB THREATS, IT DOES NOT RPT NOT APPEAR THAT DISSIDENT MOVEMENT IS TURNING TOWARD SHARPLY INCREASED XENOPHOBIA.

DCM AND ACTING SCIENCE ATTACHE DISCUSSED WITH AEOI MANZOUR IMPENDING SHIFT OF SOME CURRENT AEOI RESPONSIBILITIES TO THE MINISTRY OF ENERGY AND WHAT WOULD CONTINUE TO BE THE PRESERVE OF THE AEOI. AS MANZOUR EXPLAINED IT, LAST SUMMER'S ENERGY CRISIS GRAPHICALLY DEMONSTRATED SHORTCOMINGS IN COORDINATION AND MANAGEMENT OF IRAN'S ENERGY DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM. PROPOSED CHANGES ARE INTENDED TO RECTIFY THESE SHORTCOMINGS. SPECIFICALLY, MINISTRY OF ENERGY WILL BE TAKING ON THE RESPONSIBILITY OF BUILDING AND OPERATING NUCLEAR ENERGY PLANTS AND INSURING THAT THEY ARE FULLY INTEGRATED WITH OTHER NATIONAL ENERGY FACILITIES.

IT HAS YET TO BE DETERMINED, HOWEVER, WHEN THIS TRANSFER WILL OCCUR, BUT IT WILL PROBABLY BE OVER A PHASED PERIOD DETERMINED BY, AMONG OTHER THINGS, THE ABILITY OF MINISTRY OF ENERGY TO RECRUIT AND TRAIN MANPOWER FOR THIS PURPOSE. WE WILL REPORT FURTHER AS THIS MATTER EVOLVES. WM MANZOUR ASSURED US THAT THIS PROPOSED TRANSFER OF RESPONSIBILITY WOULD IN NO WAY LESSEN OR INFLUENCE THE MANY OTHER RESPONSIBILITIES THE AEOI WILL CONTINUE TO BE CHARGED WITH. SPECIFICALLY THIS INCLUDED THE NEGOTIATION OF THE US-IRAN BILATERAL COOPERATION AGREEMENT.

IN THIS CONNECTION, MANZOUR SPECULATED THAT THE US-IRAN BILATERAL WILL PROBABLY BE THE LAST TO BENEGOTIATED, IRAN HAVING ALREADY REACHED BILATERAL AGREEMENT WITH THE TWO OTHER MAJOR NUCLEAR VENDORS-GERMANY AND FRANCE--WHO HAVE THE KIND OF TECHNOLOGY IRAN IS MOST INTERESTED IN. MANZOUR SAID THAT HE WAS AWAITING EAGERLY WORD FROM US AS TO THE OUTCOME OF WASHINGTON'S CONSIDERATION OF WHAT HAD BEEN DISCUSSED BETWEEN US IN VIENNA. ON HIS PART HE HAD UNDERTAKEN TO REVIEW MATTER WITH APPROPRIATE AUTHORITIES HERE.

IT WAS HIS BELIEF THAT PROVIDED--AND HE EMPHASIZED PROVIDED--WE INCLUDED THE VITALLY IMPORTANT MOST FAVORED NATION CLAUSE IN OUR PROPOSAL WE COULD PROBABLY WRAP UP FINAL AGREEMENT IN ONE-HALF DAY OF FINAL NEGOTIATION.

URGE THAT DEPT PRESS ON WITH THE CLEARANCES AND DESPATCH TO US OF ANY FURTHER INSTRUCTIONS. WE ARE STILL DEALING WITH THE SAME PLAYERS AND ATTITUDES THAT WE HAVE HAD ALL ALONG INSOFAR AS OUR BILATERAL IS CONCERNED.

DURING RECENT VISIT OF TEHRAN POLCOUNS TO JIDDA, MFA DIRECTOR FOR ASIA AND AFRICA SARRAJ TOLD HIM, AND JIDDA EMBOFF, THAT SULTAN QABOOS HAD INTRUSTED THE SOLUTION OF THE PROBLEM TO SHEIKH ZAYID. SARRAJ WENT ON TO SAY THAT SAUDI ARABIANS HAVE BEEN VERY ACTIVE IN TRYING TO ASSIST A SOLUTION.
OUR IRANIAN MFA INTEUTEURS HERE AGREE WITH GENERAL CONCLUSIONS THAT ABSENCE OF A COMMERCIALLY MARKETABLE OIL FIND IN DISPUTED TERRITORY HAS PROBABLY LED EVERYONE TO RELAX SOMEWHAT ON THIS ISSUE.

MOSTAFA ELM-MOTLAQ, UNTIL RECENTLY GOI AMBASSADOR TO THE SUDAN, HAS BEEN ARRESTED IN TEHRAN ON CHARGES OF EMBEZZLING MORE THAN 9.8 MILLION RIALS (US DOLS140,000). ACCORDING TO THE CIVIL SERVICE TRIBUNAL PROSECUTOR, ELM-MOTLAQ WAS APPREHENDED JUST BEFORE A PLANNED DEPARTURE FOR LONDON, HAVING LIQUIDATED HIS IRANIAN PROPERTY.

CHARGES AGAINST THE AMBASSADOR INCLUDE, INTER ALIA, TRANSFERRING EMBASSY FUNDS TO THE PRIVATE ACCOUNT OF EMBASSY SECOND SECRETARY NAYEBOSSADRI (WHO HAS BEEN RECALLED TO TEHRAN FOR QUESTIONING); CONSPIRACY WITH THE EMBASSY'S SUDANESE LANDLORD; RETAINING PROCEEDS FROM THE SALE OF THE EMBASSY'S MERCEDES; BUYING FURNITURE FOR HIS OWN LONDON APARTMENT WITH OFFICIAL FUNDS; AND MISAPPROPRIATING LOCALEMPLOYEE OVERTIME PAY. ACCORDING TO PRESS REPORTS ELM-MOTLAQ HAS RETURNED MORE THAN DOLS 25,000 BUT THE GOVERNMENT IS CLAIMING FULL COMPENSATION INCLUDING A FINE OF TWICE THE AMOUNT EMBEZZLED.

BIO NOTE: ELM-MOTLAQ, 60, WAS BORN IN ISFAHAN AND RECEIVED AN UNDERGRADUATE DEGREE FROM THE FORMER BRITISH COLLEGE THERE IN 1939. HE WORKED FOR TEN YEARS AS A BUSINESSMAN IN ISFAHAN AND TEHRAN, LEAVING FOR LONDON IN 1947. DURING PERIODS 1953-55 AND 1956-58 HE WAS A STUDENT AT SYRACUSE UNIVERSITY, RECEIVING A M.A. AND PHD. FOLLOWING HIS RETURN TO IRAN HE JOINED THE PLAN ORGANIZATION, FIRST AS HEAD OF THE INDUSTRIAL PLANNING DIVISION AND IN 1962, BECOMING DIRECTOR OF THE PLANNING AND ECONOMIC DIVISION; AT THE SAME TIME HE WORKED AS ECONOMIC EDITOR FOR THE NEWSPAPER ETTELA'AT.

AFTER A TOUR WITH THE ECONOMIC DIVISION OF CENTORSECRETARIAT HE WAS POSTED TO LONDON AS COUNSELOR FOR ECONOMIC AFFAIRS. IN 1972 HE BECAME DIRECTOR OF THE DEPARTMENT OF INTERNATIONAL ECONOMIC AFFAIRS, MFA. AMONG THE MANY BOOKS ELM-MOTLAQ HAS TRANSLATED FROM ENGLISH INTO FARSI IS "PRINCIPLES OF MANAGEMENT". COMMENT: THIS IS FIRST WE HAVE HEARD OF THE AMBASSADOR'S PECUNIARY PECCADILLOS AND WOULD WELCOME EMBASSY KHARTOUM'S REACTION.

1978TEHRAN03182.subject: SPECIAL EMISSARY TO SOMALIA AND PROSPECTS FOR ERITREA

segments.text: DURING MEETING APRIL 3 AMBASSADOR BRIEFED MFA UNDERSECRETARY ZELLI ON THE MISSIONOF U.S. EMISSARY TO SOMALIA MOOSE ACCORDING TO PARAGRAPHS 1 A-H OF REF A. ZELLI SAID HE WAS INTERESTED TO KNOW THAT PROVISION OF DEFENSE REQUIPMENT CONTINUES UNDER ACTIVE REVIEW IN USG. HE NOTED USEFUL PUBLIC STATEMENTS BY SIAD BARRE, BUT THOUGHT ETHIOPIANS KEPT RAISING THE ANTE, MOST RECENTLY DEMANDING WAR REPARATIONS AS WELL. THIS WOULD MAKE IT IMPOSSIBLE FOR SIAD BARRE TO MEET THE CONDITIONS POR ALKS IN NIGERIA AS PROPOSED.

ZELLI SAID THE CURRENT TATUS QUO IN THE OGADEN IS ALL RIGHT FROM GOI POINT OF VIEW, AS LONG AS THE ETHIOPIANS DO NOT CROSS THE BORDER. HE THOUGHT A SWITCH OF ETHIIPOPIAN EFFORTS TO ERITREA WOULD PRESENT MANY MORE PROBLEMS FOR THE ETHIOPIANS AND THEIR BACKERS. FOR ONE THING, HE DID NOT SEE HOW "SOME PEOPLE," WHO HAVE BEEN SUPPORTING MARXIST SEPARATIST ERITREAN LIBERATION MOVEMENTS COULD NOW SWITCH SIDES SO EASILY. REAL GUERRILLA WARFARE WOULD DEVELOP, HE THOUGHT, IF CUBAN COMMIT FORCES IN SUPPORT OF ETHIOPIA IN ERITREA.

ON THE OTHER HAND, ZELLI OPINED THAT IF ETHIOPIANS DID NOT GET CONTROL OF ERITREA, AND SOVIETS REMAINED OUT OF SOMALIA, THAT WOULD PRESENT A TOLERABLE SITUATION SINCE SOVIETS WOULD BE DENIED SECURE ACCESS TO THE SEA. IN THIS REGARD, AMBASSADOR FOUND ZELLI'S PRESENTATION FAR LESS GLOOMY ON THE HORN THAN HAS BEEN GOI'S WONT RECENTLY.

THIS TRACKS WELL WITH CONVERSATION POLCOUNS HAD A FEW DAYS AGO WITH MFA AFRICA DEPARTMENT HEAD. LATTER SAID GOI IS MORE RELAXED ABOUT PROSPECTS FOR ERITREA THAN IT WAS ON SOMALIA, SINCE ERITREA IS GEOGRAPHICALLY MORE A CONCERN FOR THE ARAB COUNTRIES THAN FOR THE INDIAN OCEAN COUNTRIES. THEREFORE, MFA IS HOLDING A WATCHING BRIEF ONLY ON ERITREA.

COINCIDENTALLY, DURING HIS RECENT ORIENTATION TRIP TO JIDDA, POLCOUNS WAS TOLD BY SAUDI MFA DIRECTOR FOR AFRICA AND ASIA SARRAJ THAT SAUDIS ARE WATCHING ERITREAN SITUATION VERY CAREFULLY. AS ETHIOPIANS SWITCH THEIR ATTENTION TO ERITREA, MAINTENANCE OF SUPPLY LIFELINE TO SUDAN BECOMES ALL-IMPORTANT FOR ERITREANS. SARRAJ SAID THAT WAS THE REASON ELF AND EPLF LEADERS HAD AGREED TO ANNOUNCEMENT OF UNITY AT NUMARYI'S URGIN (JIDDA 1847). HOWEVER, SARRAJ SAID HE KNEW THE TWO ERITREAN LEADERS CONCERNED WELL AND WAS SURE THEY COULD NEVER COOPERATE ON A PERMANENT BASIS. EPLF IS MUCH TOO RADICAL IN ANY CASE. MOREOVER, BOTH LEADERS ARE PRIMARILY MILITARY MEN WHO SEEK A MILITARY SOLUTION.

SAUDIS ARE INTERESTED IN EXPLORING POLITICAL SOLUTION THROUGH REFERRAL OF THE ERITREAN ISSUE TO THE UN, IN VIEW OF UN RESPONSIBILITY FOR PUTTING ERITREA UNDER ETHIOPIAN CONTROL BACK IN 1950. CONTRARY TO WHAT WE HAD HEARD ABOUT OAU ATTITUDES, SARRAJ EXPRESSED OPTIMISM THAT ERITREANS WOULD GET OOOD RESULTS FROM THE UN IF THEY PUT THEIR CASE THERE. THEREFORE, HE INDICATED, SAUDIS ARE PRESENTLY SUPPORTING THIRD GROUP (PLF) UNDER OSMAN, WHO UNDERSTANDS POLITICAL APPROACH TO THE PROBLEM BETTER THAN THE OTHER LEADERS.

MEANWHILE FORMER IRANIAN AMBASSADOR IN KHARTOUM ELM-MOTLAO HAS BEEN ARRESTED HERE FOR LARGE-SCALE EMBEZZLEMENT OF EMBASSY FUNDS (TEHRAN SEPTEL). DEPUTY HEAD OF SOUTH ASIAN DEPARTMENT HERE IS PREPARING TO GO TO KHARTOUM AND STAND IN AS CHARGE FOR A MONTH OR TWO UNTIL NEW AMBASSADOR CAN BE APPOINTED.

1978TEHRAN03183.subject: COUNTRY PLAN INSTRUCTIONS: BILATERAL COMMUNICATIONS RELATIONSHIP

segments.text: SINCE THE BEGINNING OF THIS CENTURY, IRAN AND THE UNITED STATES DEVELOPED WHAT EACH CONSIDERED TO BE A SPECIAL RELATIONSHIP, CULMINATING IMMEDIATELY AFTER WORLD WAR II WITH A MAJOR COMMITMENT BY THE USG TO IRAN'S TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY. IN RECENT YEARS, ALONG WITH THE EXCEPTIONAL GROWTH IN IRAN'S REGIONAL IMPORTANCE, A CONGRUENCE OF MANY OF IRAN'S NATIONAL GOALS WITH THOSE OF THE UNITED STATES HAS OCCURRED.

OVERALL U.S. MISSION GOALS IN IRAN STRESS (1) THE IMPORTANCE OF A CLOSE POLITICAL/ECONOMIC RELATIONSHIP BASED ON TRUST, CONFIDENCE AND MUTUAL RESPECT, (2) AN ENHANCED RELATIONSHIP IN NON-MILITARY FIELDS, (3) A CONTINUING ROLE IN THE MODERNIZATION OF IRAN'S SECURITY FORCES, (4) A BALANCED IRAN POSTURE IN REGIONAL AFFAIRS, (5) AND A CLOSER IDENTITY OF VIEWS ON HUMAN RIGHTS. EFFECTIVE BILATERAL COMMUNICATION IS IMPORTANT TO THE ACHIEVEMENT OF ALL OF THESE GOALS, BUT NUMBERS 1, 2, AND 5 WILL PARTICULARLY ENGAGE ICA IN IRAN.

AT POLITICAL ELITE LEVELS, U.S.-IRAN COMMUNICATION IS EASED BY THE FACT THAT MANY SUCH IRANIANS ARE LINGUISTICALLY SKILLED, WIDELY TRAVELLED AND HIGHLY EDUCATED (MOSTLY IN THE U.S.). SOURCES OF INFORMATION ABOUT THE UNITED STATES, MOREOVER, ARE READILY AVAILABLE THROUGH LOCAL MEDIA AND OTHER OUTLETS, NONE OF WHICH SYSTEMATICALLY DISTORTS OR DISPARAGES THE U.S. AND ITS POLICIES. THE ENGLISH LANGUAGE RADIO AND TV ARE VEHICLES FOR USUALLY BENIGN AMERICANA AND ARE AUDITED BY INTERESTED IRANIANS WHOSE TOLERANCE OF CULTURAL IMPORTS REMAINS RELATIVELY HIGH. FACE TO FACE CONTACT WITH AUTHORITATIVE AND KNOWLEDGEABLE AMERICANS IN SPHERES RELEVANT TO MISSION GOALS IS FREQUENT UNDER BOTH USG AND OTHER AUSPICES.

IRAN'S ELITE STRATUM, HOWEVER, INCLUDES SIGNIFICANT NUMBERS WHOSE KNOWLEDGE OF ENGLISH IS RUDIMENTARY. MOREOVER DIALOGUE BETWEEN AMERICANS AND OTHER LESS COSMOPOLITAN INFLUENTIALS IS LIMITED FOR BOTH LANGUAGE AND CULTURAL REASONS: ITS ABSENCE COULD PROVE AN ADVERSE FACTOR SHOULD PRESENT UNSETTLED CONDITIONS WORSEN. THE DILEMMA FOR ICA IS HOW AND WHETHER IT CAN COMMUNICATE PURPOSEFULLY WITH AN INCREASINGLY IMPORTANT AUDIENCE UNIVERSE TRADITIONALLY REMOVED FROM USIS ACTIVITY. MEDIUM WAVE AND SHORTWAVE FARSI LANGUAGE BROADCASTS FROM ABROAD ATTRACT THE POLITICALLY CURIOUS AT ALL SOCIAL LEVELS. ICA IS GIVING ATTENTION TO THIS MATTER.

THE 60,000 IRANIANS STUDYING AT ALL LEVELS IN THE UNITED STATES CONSTITUTE BOTH A COMMUNICATION ASSET AND LIABILITY. ON THE POSITIVE SIDE, THE CADRE OF PROFESSIONALS IN IRAN CONVERSANT WITH AND SYMPATHETIC TO THE U.S. AND ITS WAYS INCREASES GEOMETRICALLY AT THE END OF EACH ACADEMIC YEAR. YET THERE REMAIN IRANIAN STUDENT GHETTOS IN THE U.S. PEOPLED BY THE UNQUALIFIED IN TERMS OF LANGUAGE ABILITY AND CULTURAL RAPPORT. SUPPORTED BY AMERICAN DISSIDENTS, THEY BECOME SPAWNING GROUNDS FOR ANTI-REGIME POLITICAL ACTIVISM--DISINFORMATION TO DISCREDIT THE US/IRAN RELATIONSHIP--RATHER THAN ACADEMIC ACHIEVEMENT. THE U.S. PRESENCE IN IRAN IS ALSO MIXED IN TERMS OF BENEFIT.

THERE ARE SOME 50 FORMAL UNIVERSITY AFFILIATIONS BETWEEN IRAN AND THE U.S., ABOUT 250 AMERICAN EDUCATORS ON THE FACULTIES OF IRAN'S MAJOR UNIVERSITIES AND SCORES MORE IN THEIR TRAINING INSTITUTIONS. THE TOTAL RESIDENT AMERICAN PRESENCE IN IRAN APPROACHES 40,000, MAINLY BUSINESS PEOPLE BUT INCLUDING SIGNIFICANT NUMBERS OF BLUE COLLAR CONTRACT ------------------098959 041056Z /11 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO USICA WASHDC PRIORITY INFO SECSTATE WASHDC 7688 UNCLAS SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 03183 USICA PERSONNEL. WHILE TENSIONS ARE INEVITABLE GIVEN CULTURAL ADJUSTMENT PROBLEMS, THE SITUATION HAS BEEN MORE THAN MANAGEABLE.

CULTURAL ADJUSTMENT AND PERSONAL SECURITY PROBLEMS MAY INCREASE, HOWEVER WITH THE ANTICIPATED INFLUX OF ADDITIONAL AMERICANS AND A WORSENING OF THE ENVIRONMENT WHICH IN TEHRAN INCLUDES CHAOTIC TRAFFIC, POLLUTION, SOCIAL SERVICE LACKS, AND INCREASED EXTREMIST ACTIVITY. IN LINE WITH MISSION GOALS, ICA IS ADDRESSING CERTAIN OF THE ABOVE PROBLEMS THROUGH COUNSELING, ENGLISH TEACHING, AND ORIENTATION PROGRAMS FOR IRANIAN STUDENTS. UNDER ICA'S NEW MUTUALITY MANDATE PROGRAMS WILL BE DEVELOPED TO FOSTER MORE ACCURATE UNDERSTANDING AMONG AMERICANS HERE AND IN THE U.S. OF MODERN IRAN.

ANOTHER SOURCE OF UNDERLYING TENSION IN THE COMMUNICATIONS RELATIONSHIP, NOT SUSCEPTIBLE TO ICA TREATMENT, IS WHAT ONE AMERICAN ACADEMIC HAS DESCRIBED AS A PERCEPTIBLE DISCONTENT AMONG MIDDLE CLASS PROFESSIONALS WITH THE PARTRIMONIAL BASIS OF POLITICS IN IRAN UNQUOTE. THIS HAS PROMPTED MANY THOUGHTFUL IRANIANS TO ASPIRE TO PERMANENT RESIDENCY IN THE U.S. ESCAPE VALVES FOR DISCONTENT ARE IN EVIDENCE, HOWEVER. MEDIA RESTAINTS HAVE BEEN EASED. DESPITE DISORDERS, THE SHAH HAS MADE CLEAR HE WILL NOT REVERSE LIBERALIZATION MEASURES. IRAN'S ENFORCED EVOLUTION TOWARDS GREATER DECENTRALIZATION OF THE DECISIONMAKING PROCESS SHOULD BE AMELIORATIVE. AS IRAN MODRNIZES, NEW FORCES AND GROUPS ARE EVOLVING INTO IMPORTANT CENTERS OF INFLUENCE.
A MISSION GOAL TO ASSESS THIS PHENOMENON WILL DIRECTLY ENGAGE ICA IN DETERMINING THE UTILITY OF ITS EXISTING MIX OF PRODUCTS, PROGRAMS, AND RANGE OF CONTACTS.

MILITARY MODERNIZATION, IMPLEMENTATION OF ECONOMIC PLANS, OIL PRICE DECISION TAKING, AND REGIONAL AND INTERNAL SECURITY CONCERNS ARE PREOCCUPATIONS WHICH SUBSTANTIVELY INVOLVE A VERY LIMITED IRANIAN POLITICAL ELITE WHO HAVE DIRECT ACCESS TO AUTHORITATIVE U.S. PERSONALITIES AND INFORMATION. SUCH ACCESS, HOWEVER, DOES NOT EASILY PERSUADE IRAN'S INNER CIRCLE, AND HENCE A WIDER STRATUM OF INFLUENTIALS, AS TO THE VALIDITY OF U.S. POLICIES. THE USG SYSTEM OF CHECKS AND BALANCES, ADMIRED IN THEORY, BLURS THE U.S. IMAGE AS A RELIABLE ALLY IN MEETING PRESSING INTERNATIONAL AND DOMESTIC ISSUES (E.G, HORN OF AFRICA, ARMS SALES, ENERGY LEGISLATION).

IRANIANS ARE ENCOURAGE TO BELIEVE THE CARTER ADMINISTRATION'S EMPHASIS ON HUMAN RIGHTS IS MISPLACED GIVEN THE PRIMACY THE SHAH ASSIGNS TO MEETING HUMAN NEEDS. CERTAIN NORTH/ SOUTH ECONOMIC ISSUES ARE VIEWED DISSIMILARLY WITH IRAN UNCRITICALLY SUBSCRIBING TO THE WORLD ECONOMIC ORDER CONCEPT. ICA WILL FOSO-WAY DIALOGUE ON THIS CLUSTER OF TOPICL ISSUES THROUGH SPEAKER PROGRAMS, EXCHANGE PROJECTS AND INFORMATION PLACEMENT.

THERE ARE IMPORTANT SUBJECT AREAS WHERE ICA-SUPPORTED U.S.-IRANIAN COMMUNICATION OVER THE LONGER TERM CAN ENHANCE THE BASIC RELATIONSHIP PER MISSION GOALS 1, AND 2. THESE ARE FIELDS WHERE THE U.S. EXPERIENCE AND TENDENCIES ARE RLEVANT TO BOTH COUNTRY'S INTERESTS AND NEEDS. THEY INCLUDE, IN PRIORITY ORDER, CHALLENGES CONFRONTING BOTH COUNTRIES IN THE FIELDS OF EDUCATION, ENERGY, AND URBAN AFFAIRS; ISSUES INVOLVED IN THE FREE FLOW OF INFORMATION; IRANIAN INTEREST IN AMERICAN STUDIES/ENGLISH PROFICIENCY; INCREASED AWARENESS OF IRAN BY U.S. MEDIA AND SCHOLARS; AND MUTUAL RECEPTIVITY TO ACHIEVEMENTS IN THE FINE ARTS. BNC'S IN TEHRAN AND THE PROVINCES WILL BE THE FOCAL POINTS FOR MUCH OF ICA PROGRAMMING IN THESE AREAS.

1978TEHRAN03200.subject: DISCUSSION OF CURRENT SITUATION IN ANGOLA WITH ACTING FOREIGN MINISTER ZELLI

segments.text: ACTING FOREIGN MINISTER ZELLI

ACTING MINSTERZELLI CALLED ME TO FOREIGN MINISTRY APRIL 3 TO DISCUSS CURRENT SITUATION IN ANGOLA. ACCORDING ZELLI, IRANIANS HVE BEEN INFORMED THAT UNITA CONTROLS LARGE PORTIONS OF ANGOLA AND HAS POTENTIAL TO SEIZE GREATER AREAS, INCLUDING CITIES.

THIS INFORMATIONS ALSO CLAIMS THAT ANGOLAN PEOPLE BITTERLY RESENT CUBANS AND HAVE INFLICTED HEAVY CASUALTIES ON THEIR FORCES. SITUATION HS ALLEGEDLY ALARMED SOVIETS, WHO ARE SEEKING TO NEGOTIATE POLITICAL COMPROMISE WITH UNITA. LATTER, HOWEVER, INSISTS THAT PRIOR CONDITION TO ANY COMPROMISE MUST BE TOTAL EJECTION OF CUBANS.
UNITA FURTHER CLAIMS THAT, IF IT HAD ADEQUATE FINANCIAL RESOURCES, IT COULD CAPITALIZE ON POPULAR REACTION AGAINST CURRENT SITUATION IN ORDER TO ACHIEVE POLITICAL DOMINANCE IN ANGOLA.

ZELLI SSAID IRAN HAD ONLY LIMITED INFORMATION ABOUT ANGOLA AND HAD INADEQUATE MEANS TO CHECK VALIDITY OF UNITY CLAIMS. HE WOULD THEREFORE GREATLY APPRECIATE U.S. READING OF SITUATION AND WOULD ESPECIALLY LIKE WASHINGTON'S EVALUATION OF UNITA POTENTIAL. HE WISHED KNOW WHETHER WE THOUGH IT HAD ONLY "NUISANCE VALUE" OR WHETHER IT MIGHT INDEED HAVE FUTURE GOVERNING ROLE IN ANGOLA.

I ASKED ZELLI WHETHER THIS INQUIRY MEANT THAT UNITA WAS ACTUALLY SOLICITING IRANIAN FINANCIAL SUPPORT. HE REPLIED AFFIRMATIVELY. I THEN RATHER MALICIOUSLY MENTIONED RECENT LONDON OBSERVER REPORT WHICH ALLEGED THAT FRANCE, SAUDI ARABIA, IRAN, MOROCCO AND ONE OTHER ARAB STATE WERE ALREADY CONTRIBUTING FUNDS TO UNITA. ZELLI MADE A FLUSTERED NONCOMMITTAL DENIAL. WITHOUT PUSHING THE MATTER FURTHER, I SAID I WOULD SEEK WASHINGTON GUIDANCE.

COMMENT: WITH LONDON OBSERVER'S EXPOSURE OF UNITA FUND, IRAN MAY BE RECONSIDERING ITS POSITION, AND MAY BE SEEKING INDEPENDENT ASSESSMENT ON ANGOLAN SITUATION. IT IS PROBABLY THAT THEY HAVE RELIED HEAVILY IN PAST ON FRENCH INFORMATION. ALTERNATIVELY, THIS INQUIRY MAY MERELY BE A RATHER CLUMSY WAY OF COMING CLEAN ON UNITA FUND, WHICH, IN THE PAST, HAS BEEN DEVELOPED WITHOUT CONSULTATION WITH U.S.
ACTION REQUESTED: PLEASE PROVIDE SOONEST BEST U.S. ASSESSMENT OF UNITA CAPABILITIES AND POTENTIALS.

SUMMARY: SMALL INCIDENTS OF VIOLENCE CONTINUE. ONE ADDITIONAL PROTESTOR DIED FROM INJURIES IN AHWAZ. MORE ARRESTED FOR ALLEGEDLY PLANNING TO DISTRIBUTE SUBVERSIVE LITERATURE CASSETTES. RESURGENCE PARTY WING LEADER HAS CRITICIZED VIOLENT PROTEST, CALLED FOR COMMITTEES TO STUDY WAYS TO HANDLE PROBELM. END SUMMARY.

PRESS APRIL 4 REPORTS CONTINUING INCIDENTS OF ATTACKS ON BANKS, GOVT OFFICES, PARTY HQS, ETC. IN ABOUT A DOZEN PROVINCIAL TOWNS. SECURITY AND POLICE FORCES REMAIN ON ALERT, AND MOST INCIDENTS HAVE BEEN HALTED BEFORE SEVERE DAMAGE WAS DONE. POLICE REPORT TOTAL OF 43 INDIVIDUALS HAVE BEEN ARRESTED AS RESULT OF DISTURBANCE OF LAST FEW DAYS. ONE AHWAZ RIOTER DIED IN HOSPITAL OF WOUNDS RECEIVED IN WEEKEND DISTURBANCES WHICH POLICE HAD TO BREAK UP.
IN ARAK, POLICE WARNED DRIVERS OF GOVT VEHICLES TO CHECK THEIR CARS BEFORE ENTERING IN CASE EXPLOSIVES HAVE BEEN PLANTED. THERE HAVE BEEN SEVERAL CASES OF ATTEMPTED FIRE BOMBING OF VEHICLES.

POLICE ARRESTED 4 STUDENTS AND A TEACHER APRIL 1 IN TEHRAN FOR ALLEGEDLY PLANNING TO DISTRIBUTE SUBVERSIVE CASSETTES AND PRINTED MATTER. 5 WERE HELD IN CUSTODY FOR INVESTIGATION.IN ADDITION TO THOSE REFTEL REPORTED ARRESTED IN TABRIZ FOR SAME OFFENSE, SECURITY AGENTS REPORTEDLY ARRESTED 2 MORE MEN FOR SELLING CASSETTES CONTAINING "SUBVERSIVE PROPAGANDA". EMB HAS LEARNED PRIVATELY THAT THESE CASSETTES MOST PROBABLY ARE THOSE MADE OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI'S SPEECHES AT SMALL MEETINGS IN IRAQ, THEN SMUGGLED ACROSS THE BORDER. EMB SHORTLY HOPES TO HAVE AT LEAST PRECIS OF 4 MAJOR CASSETTES NOW BEING DISTRIBUTED IN TEHRAN.
MAIN THRUST OF CASSETTES AS REPORTED TO US IS ATTACK AGAINST GOI FOR DISOBEYING "LAWS OF ISLAM" AND CALL FOR RETURN TO "CONSTITUTIONAL GOVERNMENT", WITH REVIVED ROLE FOR RELIGIOUS OFFICIALS IN GOVT.

IN STATEMENT FIRST RELEASED IN PERSIAN APRIL 2, RESURGENCE PARTY PROGRESSIVE WING LEADER ABDOL MAJID MAJIDI CRITICIZED THOSE WHO HAVE FAILED TO MAKE RESPONSIBLE USE OF THE NEW OPEN POLITICAL ATMOSPHERE. ATTACKING THOSE WHO CONCEAL THEIR IDEAS AND WHISPER NEGATIVE COMMENTS HERE AND THERE, HE CHALLENGED THEM TO COME OUT INTO THE OPEN. MAJIDI ALSO SUGGESTED A "COMPREHENSIVE PLAN TO FIGHT SUBVERSIVE ELEMENTS" WHICH WOULD BEGIN WITH FORMATION OF A RESURGENCE PARTY COMMITTEE TO DEVELOP WAYS OF CURBING THE VIOLENCE NOW OCCURRING IN IRAN. TEHRAN JOURNAL AND ETTELA'AT COMMENTED GUARDEDLY ON MAJIDI'S PROPOSAL EDITORIALLY APRIL 4, SUGGESTING HIS WORDS NEEDED TO BE TRANSLATED INTO ACTION.

EDITORIAL CALLED FOR BALANCED APPROACH TO PROBEM--EXAMINING TROUBLES FOR POSSIBLY GENUINE GRIEVANCES REQUIRING REMEDIAL ACTION AMONG THE PEROPLE, AS WELL AS WORKING TO ROOT OUT ANY NEFARIOUS FOREIGN INFLUENCES THAT MIGHT EXIST AND CONTROLLING THOSE WHO ARE UNBALANCED ENOUGHT TO SEEK THEIR THRILLS THROUGH DESTRUCTIVE IMPULSES. EDITORIAL CLOSED WITH HOPE THAT "A VIOLENT BACKLASH WILL NOT BE SEEN AS PREFERABLE TO LONGER-TERM PROBING AND EDUCATION".
THERE HAVE BEEN NO FURTHER INCIDENTS INVOLVING FOREIGNERS SINCE THOSE REPORTED REFTEL AND EARLIER.
LONDON 5031 (ALL NOTAL)

DURING RECENT ORIENTATION VISIT TO SAUDI ARABIA AND OMAN POLCOUNS HAD OCCASION TO DISCUSS PDRY IN LIGHT OF EXPRESSIONS OF SERIOUS CONCERN IN FEBRUARY BY FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY TO THE AMBASSADOR HERE (TEHRAN REFTELS) AND ECHOES FROM IRANIAN MILITARY ATTACHE IN JIDDA (JIDDA REFTEL). IRANIAN AMBASSADOR RAED IN JIDDA, WHO IS AN OLD SAUDI HAND AND SOURCE OF MOST MFA THINKING ON SAUDI ARABIA, SAID HE HAD BEEN TOLD BY SAUDI FOREIGN MINISTER PRINCE SAUD ABOUT A MONTH OR SO AGO THAT PDRY AND IRAQ WERE GETTING MORE AGRESSIVE IN THE AREA.
RAED PROVIDED NOTHING MORE SPECIFIC ON WHAT IRAQIS MIGHT BE DOING, BUT NOTED PDRY IS INCREASING ITS ARMY TO 40,000, ADDIGN SOME 18,000 WHO WOULD BE "COMMANDOS."

AT THE SAME TIME, SAUD TOLD THE IRANIAN AMBASSADOR THAT, IN LINE WITH CUTOFF OF SAUDI FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE TO PDRY, SAUDI TROOPS HAVE BEEN PULLED BACK AND ARE NO LONGER INTERPOSED BETWEEN SOUTH YEMEN EXILES AND PDRY TROOPS AT SAUDI-PDRY BORDER. THEREFORE, EXILES ARE ABLE TO CARRY OUT RAIDS ACROSS THE BORDER, AND THESE ARE SOMETIMES RECIPROCATED BY PDRY TROOPS. (COMMENT: AMBASSADOR DID NOT SEEM DISPOSED TO DRAW POSSIBLY OBVIOUS CONCLUSION THAT PDRY MILITARY BUILDUP MAY BE DEFENSIVE IN NATURE INTENDED TO PREVENT RETURN OF SOUTH YEMENI EXILES FROM SAUDI TERRITORY TO SOUTH YEMEN.)

SOMEWHAT INCONSISTENTLY, SAUDI MFA DIRECTOR FOR ASIA AND AFRICA IN LATER DISCUSSION SAME DAY WAS RELAXED ON WHOLE QUESTION OF PDRY AND DID NOT APPEAR TO HAVE HEARD OF ANY NEW IRAQI EFFORTS IN THE AREA. PERHAPS HE WAS BEING CAUTIOUS OR WAS UNINFORMED, BUT THIS CALM WAS OUT OF KEEPING WITH HIS EXPRESSION OF SERIOUS CONCERN OVER SITUATION IN THE HORN OF AFRICA.

BRIEFINGS FROM CHIEF OF STAFF AND OTHER BRITISH OFFICERS SERVING WITH SULTAN'S ARMED FORCES IN OMAN BROUGHT HOME THE BASIC HOSTILITY OF TERRAIN AND WEATHER CONDITIONS IN THE DHOFAR. BRITISH OFFICERS OPINED ANY MOVEMENT OF SIGNIFICANT NUMBER OF TROOPS ACROSS PDRY BORDERS INTO DHOFAR WOULD BE A MJOR ENTERPRISE WITH GIGANTIC LOGISTIC PROBLEMS AS THE TROOPS GOT FURTHER AND FURTHER FROM THEIR BASES IN PDRY, ESPECIALLY IF OMANIS CONTINUE TO CONTROL THE AIR. THEREFORE OFFICERS TNEDED TO DISCOUNT POSSIBILITY OF CROSS-BORDER OPERATIONS BY CUBANS, IRAQIS, OR ANY OTHER TROOPS IN SIGNIFICANT NUMBERS, THOUGH THEY WERE PREPARED TO ACCEPT POSSIBILITY OF A REOPENING OF THE DHOFAR INSURRECTION BY PDRY-TRAINED LOCAL CADRES.

THROUGHOUT ALL THESE CONVERSATIONS REFERENCE WAS MADE IN A GENERAL WAY TO THE PROBABLE STRENGTHENING OF SOVIET INFLUENCE IN PDRY AND THE WEAKENING OF PRESIDENT SALIM RUBAY'I-ALI'S POSITION BY PRO-SOVIET SUPPORTERS OF ABDUL FATAH ISMA'IL. IRANIAN AMBASSADOR EVEN SUGGESTED SAUDIS EXPECT SALIM RUBAY'IALI'S OUSTER IN PARTY ELECTIONS SCHEDULED FOR THIS JUNE.

UPON RETURNING TO TEHRAN, POLCOUNS GOT THE SAME GENERAL KIND OF CONCERN EXPRESSED BY MFA DEPARTMENT HEAD FOR THE AREA, WHO ONCE SERVED AS AMBASSADOR RAED'S DEPUTY IN JIDDA. NO FURTHER DETAILS WERE PROVIDED, HOWEVER, AND OUR IMPRESSION WAS ONCE AGAIN OF RUMORS AND EXAGGERATED REPORTS WHICH SO OFTEN FLOOD THIS PART OF THE WORLD. THIS IMPRESSION IS HEIGHTENED BY FACT NEITHER FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY NOR HIS CHIEF DEPUTY HAVE RAISED THESE ISSUES AGAIN WITH THE AMBASSADOR IN RECENT WEEKS. 7 . COMMENT: OUR GENERAL IMPRESSION IS OF NEW CONCERN AMONG CONSERVATIVE GOVERNMENTS IN THIS AREA SUCH AS THE IRANIANS, SAUDIS AND PERHAPS THE OMANIS.

BUT NOBODY HAS ANY NEW FACTS, AND SPECULATION OFTEN RUNS IN MUTUALLY CONTRADICTORY DIRECTIONS. IT WOULD APPEAR THAT SOME OF THESE REPORTS HAVE BEEN FEEDING ON EACH OTHER, WITH EVEN BRITISH SOURCES IN ADEN AND ELSEWHERE NO BETTER OFF THAN WE ARE IN FATHOMING PROSPECTS FOR NEW PDRY OR IRAQI AGRESSIVENESS IN THE AREA.
ADDRESSEES' COMMENTS ARE INVITED.
DECONTROL 1-1-1990.
SUMMARY: SPORADIC INCIDENTS OF VIOLENCE CONTINUE. FOREIGN MINISTRY CREATES COMMITTEE TO NULLIFY "SUBVERSIVE PROPAGANDA". ABOUT 43 TOWNS AND VILLAGES HAVE REPORTED INCIDENTS THUS FAR. END SUMMARY.

MEDIA APRIL 5 REPORTED A FEW SPORADIC INCIDENTS OF CONTINUED VIOLENCE, BUT LEVEL OF ACTIVITY IS CLEARLY DYING DOWN. IN NEWLY REPORTED INCIDENTS, A TOWN GOVERNOR'S CAR WAS SET AFAIRE IN DARRESHAHR AND A PHYSICAL CULTURE ORGANIZATION IN SIRJAN WAS BURNED.

ON APRIL 4 FOREIGN MINISTRY SPOKESMAN PARVIZ ADL ANNOUNCED FORMATION OF A COMMITTEE OF GUIDANCE AND INFORMATION WITHIN THE MINISTRY TO USE OFFICIAL AND UNQUESTIONABLE INFORMATION TO UNCOVER LIES BEING SPREAD BY INTERNATIONAL CONSPIRATORS. ADL SAD THE COMMITTEE WOULD OPERATE WITHIN THE FRAMEWORK OF THE RESURGENCE PARTY CHAPTER IN THE MINISTRY. THE COMMITTEE'S MAIN EMPHASIS APPEARS TO BE ON INFORMING IRANIAN DIPLOMATIC MISSIONS OF THE TRUE SITUATION IN IRAN. ADL DEFENDED THE CLERGY AS "ONE OF THE STRONGEST BASTIONS OF FAITH, MORALITY AND PATRIOTISM" IN IRAN. HE SAID THE CLERGY WERE SOMETIMES GIVEN FALSE INFORMATION AND THE MINISTRY DID NOT WISH THEM TO BE MISINFORMED.
THE COMMITTEE WILL ALSO USE ITS INFORMATION TO INFORM IRANIAN CITIZENS AT HOME OF ACTIVITIES DIRECTED AGAINST THE NATIONAL INTEREST.

A REVIEW OF VARIOUS INCIDENTS REPORTED OVER THE PAST FOUR DAYS SUGGESTS THERE HAVE BEEN ABOUT 43 TOWNS AND VILLAGES INVOLVED IN SOME SORT OF DISTURBANCES. TO DATE THERE HAS BEEN NO INDICATION OF A CONSPIRACY TO PROMOTE THESE ACTIVITES BUT RUMORS ARE AGAIN BEGINNING TO SURFACE THAT THERE HAS BEEN "FOREIGN"--PROBABLY RUSSIAN-INSPIRATION BEHIND SOME OF THE ACTIVITIES. ONE STORY HEARD BY AN EMBASSY OFFICER EVEN SUGGESTED THAT AMERICAN INTERNATIONAL CORPORATIONS WERE TRYING TO MUDDY IRAN'S WATERS...

1978TEHRAN03245.subject: IRANIAN JUDICIAL SYSTEM AND THE NEW LIBERALIZATION SUMMARY: IN LENGTHY DISCUSSION WITH SENIOR JUDICIAL OFFICIAL, EMBOFF LEARNED THAT MINISTRY OF JUS TICE IS QUITE P

segments.text: SUMMARY: IN LENGTHY DISCUSSION WITH SENIOR JUDICIAL OFFICIAL, EMBOFF LEARNED THAT MINISTRY OF JUSTICE IS QUITE PLEASED WITH ITS NEW AND EXPANDED ROLE IN DEALING WITH DISSENTERS. ACCORDING TO SOURCE, ALL THE REST OF TABRIZ DEMONSTRATORS ARE CURRENTLY SCHEDULED FOR CIVILIAN COURT TRIAL. END SUMMARY.

SENIORJUDICIAL OFFICIAL IN MINISTRY OF JUSTICE OUTLINED TO EMBOFF APRIL 4 HIS MINISTRY'S PLEASURE AT THE DIRECTION IRAN'S NEW LIBERALIZATION HAS TAKEN WITH RESPECT TO THE COURTS. THE CURRENT TRIAL OF 16 UNIVERSITY OF TEHRAN POLITICAL SCIENCE STUDENTS HAS BEEN A REAL EYE OPENER TO BOTH PROSECUTORS AND JUDGES. THE STUDENTS WHO ARE REPRESENTED BY 42 LAWYERS HAVE COME TO ACCEPT THE COURT'S AUTHORITY AND, ACCORDING TO A SENIOR JUDGE ON THE CASE, "SEEMED TO HAVE LEARNED SOMETHING ABOUT PROPER BEHAVIOR".

MINJUSTICE SOURCE ALSO SAID ALL TRIALS OF THOSE ARRESTED FOR DISTURBANCES HAVE BEEN AND WILL BE OPEN TO THE PUBLIC. IT HAS BEEN CLEAR FROM REACTION OF DEFENDANTS THAT TRIAL IN CIVILIAN COURTS IS MUCH MORE LIKELY TO TURN THEM INTO USEFUL CITIZENS THAN INCARCERATION AND TRIAL IN MILITARY COURT. IN SHORT, THERE IS LITTLE BACKLASH FROM CIVILIAN COURT TRIALS THAT WOULD TURN STUDENTS INTO "LIFE-LONG TERRORISTS".

MINISTRY SOURCE INDICATED THAT OF THOSE BROUGHT TO TRIAL ABOUT A THIRD HAVE BEEN ACQUITED AND MANY OF REST HAVE RECEIVED SUSPENDED SENTENCES. ONLY THOSE WHO HAD PAST RECORD OF TERRORISM OR CIVIL DISTURBANCE ACTIVITIES WERE AT PRESENT GETTING JAIL SENTENCES.

THIS REINVIGORATED ROLE FOR THE MINISTRY OF JUSTICE HAS PUT SOME PRESSURE ON ALREADY INADEQUATE STAFFING. TO BEGIN ALLEVIATING THIS PROBLEM, MINISTRY HOPES TO OPEN ITS POST GRADUATE COLLEGE OF LAW STUDIES IN ISFAHAN SOMETIME DURING THE CURRENT YEAR.

EMBASSY COMMENT: SOURCE'S REACTION TO EVENTS OF PAST 3-4 MONTHS CONFIRMS VIEWS WE HAVE HEARD FROM LOW LEVEL JUDICIAL OFFICIALS THAT LEGAL OFFICIALS ARE VERY PLEASED WITH REINVIGORATED ROLE OF CIVILIAN COURTS. WE WOULD HOPE THOSE ORGANIZATIONS INTERESTED IN ROLE OF LAW AND HUMAN RIGHTS WILL BE FINDING THIS OUT FOR THEMSELVES OVER COMING MONTHS.
MINJUSTICE SOURCE ALSO SAID THAT CASE AGAINST ARTIST ASHUR BANIPAL BABILA (TEHRAN 3027) HAD BEEN DROPPED.

1978TEHRAN03302.subject: EAST AND WEST GERMANS TO VISIT IRAN

segments.text: PRESS APRIL 6 ANNOUNCED GOODWILL VISIT HERE OF FEDROP PRESIDENT SCHEEL FOR THREE DAYS BEGINNING APRIL 21 FOR PURPOSE OF DISCUSSING BILATERAL ECONOMIC RELATIONS. SAME DAY PRESS NOTED GDR FOREIGN MINISTER FISCHER WILL BE COMING APRIL 12 FOR AN EXCHANGE OF VIEWS WITH IRANIAN AUTHORITIES. LATTER IS VISIT TO CANOSSA BY FOREIGN MINISTER WHICH HAS BECOME STANDARD IRANIAN EXPECTATION IN THE CASE OF EUROPEAN GOVERNMENTS ACCUSED OF LAXITY IN PERMITTING OUTRAGES AGAINST IRANIAN DIPLOMATIC MISSIONS THERE. EAST GERMAN AMBASSADOR TOLD DCM HE HOPES TO SET RELATIONSHIP BACK ON THE RIGHT TRACK WITH THIS VISIT. MEANWHILE, WEST GERMAN ECONOMIC RELATIONSHIPS WITH IRAN HAVE CONTINUED TO BOOM.

PRESS APRIL 6 HEADLINED ARREST EVENING MARCH 27 OF RETIRED BRIGADIER GENERAL ALI AKBAR DARAKSHANI IMMEDIATELY FOLLOWING CONTACT WITH A RUSSIAN EMPLOYEE OF THE IRANO-SOVIET TRANSPORT COMPANY, IDENTIFIED AS ALMAN SHAMIROV IBRAHIMOGLI. THE GENERAL, WHO WAS 82, APPARENTLY SUFFERED A HEART SEIZURE AT THE MOMENT OF HIS ARREST AND DIED IN THE HOSPITAL OF CORONARY FAILURE.

THE GENERAL WAS FORMERLY COMMANDER OF IRANIAN FORCES IN AZARBAIJAN DURING AND AFTER WORLD WAR II, AND COLLABORATED WITH THE SEPARATIS MOVEMENT ESTABLISHED WITH SOVIET ASSISTANCE THERE. HE WAS SENTENCED TO LIFE IMPRISONMENT BY A MILITARY COURT IN 1946 BUT PARDONED TWO YEARS LATER ON IMPERIAL ORDERS AND RELEASED.

THE PRESS IDENTIFIES A FIAT CAR BEARING TEHRAN LICENSE PLATE 32339 WITH TWO "EMPLOYEES OF THE SOVIET EMBASSY" IN IT IN ADDITION TO IBRAHIMOGL AS THE VEHICLE WHICH MADE A RENDEZVOUS WITH DARAKHSHANI. IBRAHIMOGLI WAS THEN SEEN GETTING OUT OF THE CAR AND HANDING DARAKHSHANI A PARCEL. THE IRANIAN SECURITY AGENTS WHO HAD BEEN FOLLOWING DARAKHSHANI CONTINUED BEHIND HIM TO HIS NEARBY HOUSE AND ARRESTED HIM. NO FURTHER INFORMATION IS PROVIDED ON THE SOVIET CITIZENS INVOLVED.

COMMENT: WITH HIS RECORD, IT IS MOST UNLIKELY THAT DARAKHSHANI HAD ACCESS TO MATERIALS WORTH MUCH SOVIET GOLD (APARTFROM A PENSION), EVEN BY EXERCISING THE USUAL FAMILY AND OTHER CONNECTIONS. THE FRONT-PAGE HEADLINE TREATMENT SPECIFYING SOVIET INVOLVEMENT AND NAMING NAMES SO SOON AFTER THE INCIDENT SUGGESTS GOI AUTHORITIES PLACE LESS SECURITY THAN PUBLICRELATIONS VALUE IN THIS CASE. SUCH TREATMENT IS MOST LIKELY INTENDED TO REINFORCE THE OFFICIALLY INSPIRED SUGGESTIONS MAKING THE ROUNDS HERE THAT MANY IRANIAN DISSIDENTS ARE PLAYING INTO THE HANDS OF INTERESTED FOREIGN POWERS, IF NOT ACTUALLY WORKING UNDER THEIR ORDERS.

1978TEHRAN03325.subject: RELEASED PRISONERS FREE TO LEAVE IRAN

segments.text: MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS AMERICAN DEPARTMENT DEPUTY CHIEF MIKALA HAS CONFIRMED TO EMBASSY THAT THERE ARE NO LEGAL IMPEDIMENTS TO MAHMOUD MAZAHERI-TEHRANI OBTAINING GOI PASSPORT AND EXIT VISA. WHEN ASKED IF THIS APPLIED TO ALL PRISONERS RELEASED IN AMNESTIES, MOKALA REPLIED YES.
AS OF APRIL 9, MAZAHERI-TEHRANI HAD NOT RPT NOT APPROACHED CONSULATE.

1978TEHRAN03348.subject: CENTO SECRETARY GENERAL'S VISIT TO TEHRAN

segments.text: CENTO SECGEN GURUN CURRENTLY VISITING TEHRAN ON ORIENTATION TOUR. IRANIAN FONMIN KHALATBARY HELD WORKING LUNCH FOR HIM AND CENTO AMBASSADORS APRIL 9.

DURING THIS SESSION, IT EMERGED THAT ALL HANDS WERE SATISFIED WITH ADJUSTMENTS WHICH HAVE BEEN MADE TO SCHEDULE FOR MINISTERIAL MEETING. BRITISH AMBASSADOR, THEREFORE, AGREED SEND MESSAGE TO LONDON URGING OWEN TO TRANSMIT FORMAL INVIATIONS FOR MEETING IN LONDON SOONEST.

AFTER LUNCH, GURUN ASKED ME TO SEND MESSAGE TO DEPARTMENT PUTTING FORTH HIS "PERSONAL VIEW" THAT IT WOULD BE A NICE GESTURE FOR SECRETARY VANCE TO OFFER TO HAVE NEXT MEETING (1979) IN WASHINGTON. THIS WOULD BRING TURKEY INTO ROTATION AS HOST FOR 1980 MEETING, WHICH WOULD COINCIDE WITH 25TH ANNIVERSARY OF CENTO, AN EVENT WHICH GURUN WOULD LIKE TO SEE TAKE PLACE IN ANKARA.

ACTION REQUESTED: SUGGEST SECRETARY BE ALERTED TO ADDRESS THIS QUESTION IN LONDON MEETING, AND, IF HE AGREES WITH GURUN SUGGESTION, TO TAKE INITIATIVE IN VOLUNTEERING WASHINGTON SITE FOR 1979 SESSIONS.

1978TEHRAN03353.subject: RENEWED AND MORE COMPLEX VIOLENCE; HINT OF OFFICIAL REACTION

segments.text: SUMMARY. THREE BOMBS PLANTED AT TEHRAN HOMES OF LEADING DISSIDENTS EARLY APRIL 9. STUDENT RIOT IN ISFAHAN OF MAJOR PROPORTIONS. RESURGENCE PARTY WING LEADER CALLS ON PARTY TO USE FORCE AGAINST "SABOTEURS OF PUBLIC ORDER" IF NECESSARY. CIVIL RESISTANCE CORPS MEMBERS PLEDGE READINESS TO STOP HOOLIGNAISM. OPPOSITION ACTIVITIES CONTINUE, AND STAGE APPARENTLY BEING SET FOR STRONGER GOVERNMENT ACTION. EMD SUMMARY.

FROM SEVERAL SOURCES EMBASSY HAS LEARNED THAT THREE BOMBS WENT OFF NEAR HOME WALLS OF THREE PROMINENT DISSIDENT FIGURES IN THE VERY EARLY HOURS OF APRIL 9. AMCIT EYEWITNESS SAW BOMB DAMAGE FRONT WALL OF HOME OF KARIM SANJABI IN NIAVARAN. OTHER SOURCES SAID BOMBS ALSO EXPLODED AT HOMES OF ENG. MEHDI BAZARGANEH AND ENG. REZA MOQHADDAM, BOTH OLD-TIME DISSIDENT FIGURES WHO HAVE BEEN INVOLVED WITH VARIOUS FACTIONS OF UNION OF NATIONAL FRONT (UNF). NO ONE WAS HURT, BUT DAMAGE WAS EVIDENT.

AS USUAL, TWO STORIES SERIOUSLY MAKING ROUNDS: MOST CREDIBLE (GIVEN VICTIMS) WAS THAT PRO-GOVERNMENT GROUPS, EITHER FORMALLY ORGANIZED OR NOT, PLANTED EXPLOSIVES TO WARN OPPOSITIONISTS THAT RECENT VIOLENCE (REFTELS) HAD GONE ABOUT AS FAR AS IT COULD WITHOUT SOME FORM OF RETALIATION. SECOND STORY SAYS EXPLOSIVES WERE WORK OF MORE EXTREMIST DISSIDENTS DISPLEASED WITH RELATIVELY MODERATE STANCE OF INDIVIDUALS TARGETTED. FIRST SEEMS MORE LIKELY TO US AT MOMENT, BUT THERE IS AS YET NO RPT NO HARD EVIDENCE EITHER WAY.

MORNING APRIL 9, SUBSTANTIAL STUDENT MARCH BEGAN AT UNIVERSITY OF ISFAHAN WITH UP TO 500 STUDENTS. CONSULATE ISFAHAN REPORTS ONE EYEWITNESS NEAR START OF MARCH HEARD YOUTHS SINGING AND GENERALLY CHEERFUL. GROUP, OR PART OF IT, LATER BROKE ALL WINDOWS AT PEPSI BOTTLING PLANT (BAHAI-OWNED) SEVERAL BLOCKS FURTHER DOWN MAIN STREET OF MARCH. POLICE EVENTUALLY FIRED IN AIR TO DISPERSE GROUP OF 40 OR 50 AT PLANT AND ARRESTED SEVERAL. CONSULTATE ISFAHAN REPORTS SMALL GROUPS SCURRYING IN AND OUT OF KUCHES (SMALL STREETS) HAVE CONTINUED TO BREAK WINDOWS WELL INTO AFTERNOON.
ALTHOUGH INCIDENTS TAKING PLACE AREA WHERE MANY AMERICANS LIVE, NO RPT NO AMERICANS HAVE BEEN REPORTED HURT AND VIOLENCE DOES NOT RPT NOT SEEM DIRECTED AT FOREIGNERS.

ABOVE TWO INCIDENTS OCCURRED JUST DAYS AFTER RESURGENCE PARTY PROGRESSIVE WING LEADER MAJIDI CALLED ON APRIL 6 FOR RESURGENCE PARTY "ACTION COMMITTEES" TO USE FORCE AGAINST SABOTEURS AND ACT IN COORDINATION WITH LOCAL AUTHORITIES TO THWART RIOTS AND "IF NECESSARY, LAUNCH COUNTER STRIKES". GROUP IS EXPECTED TO REPORT ON INADEQUATE PERFORMANCE OF LAW OFFICIALS AS WELL AS UNJUST ACTIONS BY PUBLIC OFFICIALS WHICH CAUSE DISCONTENT.

PERHAPS AS OMINOUS FROM HUMAN RIGHTS VIEWPOINT IS PARS NEWS AGENCY REPORT APRIL 9 THAT EMBERS OF THE CIVIL DEFENSE ORGANIZATION, THE CIVIL RESISTANCE CORPS, HAVE ANNOUNCED THEIR READINESS "TO STOP VIOLENCE AND SABOTAGE" PERPETRATED BY GROUPS OF "MASKED HOOLIGANS". COMMUNIQUE PUT OUT BY RESISTANCE CORPS SAID VIOLENT DEMONSTRATORS HAVE BEEN MISUSING FREEDOM. EXPERIENCED HANDS REMEMBER STREET MOBS OF MOSSADEQ'S TIMES AND MOB AND COUNTER-MOB ACTIVITIES OF 1962 NATIONAL FRONT RIOTS AND WONDER WHETHER STAGE IS BEING SET FOR NEW CONFRONTATION BETWEEN GOI AND OPPOSITION ALONG SAME OLD SHOPWORN LINES OF PREVIOUS ENCOUNTERS, WITH CIVIL RESISTANCE GROUPS AS GOI ACTION ARM.

EMBASSY WILL HAVE MORE COMMENT WHEN FACTS AND INTENTIONS ARE CLEARER, BUT WOULD OFFER TWO CAUTIONARY POINTS AT THIS STAGE: A) DESPITE INCREASING DEBATE ON DISSIDENT ACTIONS AND APPROPRIATE GOI RESPONSE, SECURITY SITUATION REMAINS UNDER CONTROL, AND B) DESPITE NUMBER AND RANGE OF INCIDENTS TO DATE, WE HAVE NO EVIDENCE THAT MAJOR DISSIDENT LEADERSHIP GROUPS--NATIONAL FRONTERS, RELIGIOUS LEADERS, ETC.--ARE SEEKING FULL DRESS CONFRONTATION WITH GOI.

1978TEHRAN03354.subject: BRITISH APPROACH TO SHAH ON NAMIBIA

segments.text: TAKING ADVANTAGE OF AUDIENCE WITH SHAH SCHEDULED FOR APRIL 8, BRITISH AMBASSADOR PARSONS MADE APPROACH MENTIONED REFTELS. BRITISH BRIEFED US ON IT APRIL 9.

PARSONS TOOK LINE THAT SHAHSHOULD URGE SOUTH AFRICANS TO BE REASONABLE WHEN FIVE POWER PROPOALS (OF WHICH HE GAVE THE SHAH A COPY) IS PUT TO THEM SO AS TO AVOID SITUATION DETERIORATING TO POINT THAT SOME SORT OF SANCTIONS RESOLUTION AGAINST NAMIBIA REGIME MIGHT BECOME ONLY ALTERNATIVE. SHAH IMMEDIATELY GRASPED THE POINT. HE SAID HE WOULD CONSULT WITH SOUTH AFRICAN REP (CONSUL GENERAL) HERE AS TO BEST METHOD HE SHOULD USE, EITHER A PERSONAL MESSAGE FROM HIMSELF, OR A SOUTH AFRICAN ENVOY BEING SENT TO TEHRAN TO DISCUSS THE MATTER.
SHAH NOTED THAT FONMIN BOTHA HAS EXPRESSED AN INTEREST IN VISITING IRAN, BUT SINCE THERE ARE NO IMMEDIATE PLANS FOR SUCH A VISIT HE AGREED WITH PARSONS' SUGGESTION THAT A FASTER METHOD BE USED.

SHAH INDICATED HE WOULD USE TWO RELATED LINES OF ARGUMENT WITH SOUTH AFRICANS. HE WOULD URGE THAT IN VIEW OF THEIR APPARENT PREPARATIONS TO LEAVE NAMIBIA THEY DO SO GRACEFULLY AND IN A MANNER TO GAIN CREDIT RATHER THAN HAVING TO BE PUSHED OUT. HE WOULD ALSO URGE THAT SOUTH AFRICANS DEMONSTRATE COOPERATIVENESS, SO THAT THEY WILL NOT BE BLAMED SHOULD PROPOSAL FAIL.

SHAH INQUIRED ABOUT THE STATUS OF WALVIS BAY AND WAS TOLD THIS STILL REMAINED TO BE SETTLED. THERE WAS A GENERALIZED HISTORIAL DISCUSSION OF ENCLAVES SUCH AS HONG KONG, TANGIER, AND PONDICHERRY WITH BOTH MEN APPEARING TO CONCLUDE THAT, WHILE ENCLAVES WERE A BIG THING IN THE PAST, IN THIS DAY AND AGE AN ENCLAVE SUCH AS WALVIS BAY WOULD PROBABLY END UP BEING INTEGRATED INTO NAMIBIA.

IN THE ABSENCE OF SPECIFIC INSTRUCTIONS, I DID NOT RAISE THIS SUBJECT WHEN I SAW THE SHAH APRIL 9 ON OTHER BUSINESS. POINTS SEEM TO HAVE BEEN ADEQUATELY MADE BY BRITISH, HOWEVER, AND THERE WOULD APPEAR NO NEED FOR US TO FOLLOW UP AT THIS TIME. SULLIVAN

1978TEHRAN03406.subject: GOI SPONSORS LARGE RALLY IN TABRIZ

segments.text: THE GOI-SPONSORED RASTIKHIZ PARTY ORGANIZED A PRO-GOVERNMENT MEETING APRIL 9 IN TABRIZ IN RESPONSE TO LARGE SCALE RIOTING WHICH TOOK PLACE IN THAT CITY ON FEBRUARY 18 (REFTEL A). ACCORDING TO NEWS REPORTS MORE THAN 300,000 ATTENDED RALLY, WHICH WAS TELEVISED NATIONALLY, INCLUDING PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR, CABINET MINISTERS AND RPPI PARTY LEADERS. CONSULATE TABRIZ REPORTS ENTIRE CITY, INCLUDING BAZAAR, CLOSED FOR RALLY WITH PARTICIPANTS FROM SURROUNDING AREAS BEING PROVIDED TRANSPORTATION TO TABRIZ. NO TROUBLE REPORTED.

UNDERLYING THEME OF THIRY MINUTE ADDRESS BY AMOUZEGAR PLACED BLAME FOR RECENT CIVIL DISTURBANCES IN IRAN ON FOREIGN POWERS, PROMISING THAT "THE GOVERNMENT WILL COMBAT ANY INTRIGUES EMANATING FROM LEFTISTS FOR RIGHTISTS AND WILL TAKE APPROPRIATE ACTION AGAINST THE INSTIGATORS OF THE FEBRUARY RIOTS". OBLIQUELY REFERRING TO CONSERVATIVE FORCES BEHIND RECENT PROTEST INCIDENTS, THE PRIME MINISTER CHARGED THAT, "THESE ELEMENTS' ACTIONS DO NOT ACCORD WITH THE TEACHINGS OF ISLAM. WHAT IS CRYSTAL CLEAR, HOWEVER, IS THAT THE PROVISIONS OF THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION ARE INSPIRED BY ISLAMIC TEACHINGS.".

AMOUZEGAR'S SPEECH WAS INTERRUPTED FREQUENTLY BY CRIES "LONG LIVE THE SHAH" FROM THE CROWD, AND HE WAS CHEERED LOUDEST WHEN HE DECLARED THAT AZARBAIJAN WOULD NEVER AGAIN REPEAT ITS 1946 SECESSION FROM IRAN.
SEVEN POINT "RESOLUTION" IN SUPPORT OF SHAH-PEOPLE REVOLUTION AND CONDEMNING "EVERY PLOT, EVERY DESIGN INSTIGATED BY THE COLONIALISTS AND THEIR HIRED AGENTS" WAS GIVEN STANDING OVATION BY CROWD.

COMMENT: RALLY HAS LONG BEEN IN PREPARATION, ORIGINALLY BEING SCHEDULED FOR SHORTLY AFTER FEBRUARY RIOTS IN TABRIZ. GOI-INSPIRED MEDIA PRUBLICITY DURING WEEK PRIOR TO RALLY HAS EXHIBITED STRONGER-THAN-USUAL ANTI-SOVIET THEME WITH ANNOUNCEMENT OF ARREST OF BG DARAKSHANI (REFTEL B) AND FRONT PAGE TREATMENT OF MEMOIRS OF MG AHMAD ZANGANEH WHO HAS WRITTEN THAT THE SOVIETS ATTEMPTED TO FORCE HIM TO SURRENDER THE AZARBAIJAN CITY OF REZAIEH TO REBEL FORCES IN 1946. THESE MEDIA EVENTS, PLUS PRIME MINISTER'S "FOREIGN POWERS" REFERENCES, MAY BE GOI LEADERSHIP'S NOT SO SUBTLE REACTION TO RECENT SOVIET PROPAGANDA TREATMENT OF IRAN (REFTEL AND SEPTEL).
WE EXPECT FURTHER COMMENT ONCE OUR CONSUL IN TABRIZ HAS HAD NECESSARY CONSULTATIONS WITH LOCAL SOURCES.

1978TEHRAN03433.subject: REQUEST FOR INFORMATION ON PALESTINIAN REPRESENTATION ABROAD

segments.text: THERE IS NO PLO REPRESENTATION IN IRAN--DESPITE SEVERAL REQUESTS BY PLO IN THE PAST TO ESTABLISH ONE.
ANNOUNCEMENT HAS BEEN MADE BY THE GOI OF THE NOMINATION OF VISHNU KALINDAS AHUJA AS AMB OF INDIA TO IRAN. THE NEW AMB HAS REPORTEDLY SERVED AS CONSUL GENERAL IN NEW YORK AND AS AMB TO RUMANIA.
ANY BIO BACKGROUND INFO AVAILABLE WOULD BE APPRECIATED.

1978TEHRAN03452.subject: FURTHER ON PRO-GOVERNMENT RALLY IN TABRIZ

segments.text: CONSULATE TABRIZ HAS PICKED UP FURTHER ATMOSPHERICS SURROUNDING APRIL 9 PRO-GOVERNMENT RALLY HELD IN THAT CITY. CROWD, WHICH WAS INDEED VAST NUMBERING SEVERAL HUNDRED THOUSAND, INCLUDED A NUMBER OF INVOLUNTARY PARTICIPANTS. APPARENTLY MANY GOVERNEMENT EMPLOYEES IN SURROUNDING AREAS WERE TOLD TO ATTEND OR RISK THEIR JOB RETENTION. ALL SCHOOLS WERE CLOSED, AND SOME CHILDREN AT LEAST ADVISED TO ATTEND OR FACE FAILURE FOR SCHOOL TERM.

THERE WAS SCATTERED VIOLENCE AT LOCAL UNIVERSITY DURING RALLY WHEN STUDENTS MOUNTED ANTI-GOVERNMENT DEMONSTRATION. IN ANOTHER INCIDENT, UNKNOWN ASSAILANTS SMASHED CARS NEAR THE BAZAAR, SHOUTING "BRING BACK KHOMEINI". ACCORDING TO LOCAL EYE WITNESS INCIDENTS WERE BRIEF AND DID NOT SPREAD BEYOND LOCALIZED AREAS.

MEANWHILE, THE PRESS REPORTED TODAY FURTHER DETAILS OF PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR'S SPEECH (REPORTED REFTEL) IN WHICH HE MADE SWEEPING PROMISES OF GOVERNMENT AID FOR RURAL AREAS OF AZERBAIJAN. IN RESPONSE TO THE RECENT TABRIZ DEMONSTRATION AND TO COMPLAINTS FROM LOCAL FARMERS, AMOUZEGAR WAS REPORTED TO HAVE PROMISED GREATER MANPOWER IN THE AGRICULTURAL SECTOR; A STUDY OF AGRICULTURAL PRICES; AGRICULTURAL LOANS TO FARMERS AT EASY TERMS AND WITH A MINIMUM OF RED TAPE; FORMATION OF A FARMERS UNION IN TABRIZ; NEW STORAGE FACILITIES FOR FARM PRODUCE; 5,000 NEW UNITS OF WORKERS' HOUSING; AND A SUBSTANTIAL GOVERNMENT CONTRIBUTION TO A NEW SEWAGE SYSTEM FOR THE CITY OF TABRIZ.

COMMENT: THE PRIME MINISTER TOOK OFFICE LAST AUGUST PROMISING THE COUNTRY THAT GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS WOULD NO LONGER MAKE PROMISES OF FUTURE PROGRAMS. AFTER MAINTAINING A LOW PUBLIC PROFILE FOR SOME MONTHS, AMOUZEGAR HAS RATHER SPECTACULARLY BROKEN HIS PROMISE. IT REMAINS TO BE SEEN IF OTHER AREAS OF IRAN WILL LEARN FROM THE TABRIZ EXPERIENCE AND SEEK TO GAIN THE ATTENTION OF THE GOVERNMENT BY SOME DRAMATIC GESTURE, THEREBY REAPING GOVERNMENT BENEFITS.

WITH RESPECT FINANCING, KHALATBARY ASKED FOR U.S. ASSESSMENT OF POSITION WHICH SOVIET BLOC CAN BE EXPECTED TO TAKE RE APPLICABILITY OF ARTICLE 17. HE NOTED THAT SOVIETS, IN SECURITY COUNCIL, HAD EXPRESSED NEGATIVE VIES ON THIS SUBJECT. HE THOUGHT THEIR ABSTENTION IN UNSC VOTE ON RES 425 OFFERED SOME AMBIGUITY, HOWEVER. HE HOPED SECRETARY VANCE WOULD ADDRESS QUESTION IN MOSCOW, SINCE HE FELT A SOVIET REFUSAL TO BE ASSESSED FOR UNIFIL WOULD BE NOT ONLY UNFAIR, BUT WRONG.

ACTION REQUESTED: PLEASE PROVIDE PRIOR APRIL 15 BEST U.S. ASSESSMENT OF SOVIET POSITION ON FINANCING IF UNSC DOES NOT RPT NOT CONDEMN ISRAEL AND IF DATE CERTAIN IN APRIL FOR WITHDRAWAL HAS BEEN ANNOUNCED FROM JERUSALEM.
SUGGEST DEPARTMENT PASS TO BEIRUT, JERUSALEM AND TEL AVIV.

SUBJECT OF ATTENDANCE BY CHIEFS OF STATE AT SPECIAL UNGA SESSION ON DISARMAMENT HAS ONCE AGAIN BEEN RAISED BY GOI. FONMIN KHALATBARY SAID HE HAD HEARD RUMOR THAT SECY VANCE, ON HIS VISIT TO MOSCOW, WOULD INVITE BREZHNEV TO ATTEND UNGA.

KHALATBARY WENT ON TO SAY THAT TITO HAD ALREADY ANNOUNED HE WOULD ATTEND AND THAT GISCARD WAS ALSO PLANNING TO BE THERE. HE FELT SURE THAT, IF GISCARD WENT, OTHER NATO CHIEFS WHO WOULD BE AT WASHINGTON NATO MEETING WOULD ALSO WISH TO GO. HE THOUGHT THIS PARTICULARLY SURE FOR SCHMIDT.

DRAWING ON REF B, I SAID US WAS NOT RPT NOT ENCOURAGING ATTENDANCE BY CHIEFS OF STATE AND THAT I HAD NO INFO TO CONFIRM ATTENDANCE AT SESSION BY THOSE LISTED PARA 2. AS FAR AS BREZHNEV CONCERNED, I POINTED OUT THAT SHEVCHENKO AFFAIR WOULD ADD A NEW COMPLICATION TO THAT PROSPECT.
THERE WAS NO RPT NO MENTION OF POSSIBILITY THAT SHAH MIGHT BE PLANNING TO ATTEND.
ACTION REQUESTED: PLEASE PROVIDE ME SOONEST WITH BEST INFO AVAILABLE ON ATTENDANCE AT SESSION BY CIEFS OF STATE OR CHIEFS F GOVT, AND PARTICULARLY WHETHER PRES CARTER PLANS ATTEND.

1978TEHRAN03531.subject: CUBANS AND SOVIETS IN ERITREA MFA TELLS US ITS EMB IN ADDIS ABABA PUTS CURRENT COUNT OF CUBANS IN ERITREA AT 1800. ALSO REPORTS ABOUT 1000

segments.text: MFA TELLS US ITS EMB IN ADDIS ABABA PUTS CURRENT COUNT OF CUBANS IN ERITREA AT 1800. ALSO REPORTS ABOUT 1000 EXPERTS FROM SOVIET UNION AND 1000 FROM VARIOUS OTHER COUNTRIES ASSISTING ETHIOPIANS IN ERITREA. THERE IS NO EXACT INDICATION AS TO ROLE BEING PLAYED BY CUBANS OR OTHERS. MFA WOULD APPRECIATE WHATEVER INFO WE HAVE ON NUMBERS AND ROLE PLAYED PARTICULARLY BY CUBANS.

1978TEHRAN03532.subject: CIVIL SITUATION: BOMBING OF DISSIDENT HOMES; ARTIST ARRESTED

segments.text: TEHRAN 3245 SUMMARY: BOMBINGS REPORTED REF A CREDITED TO "UNDERGROUND COMMITTEE FOR VENGEANCE." PROMINENT DISSIDENT DENTIST KIDNAPPED AND BEATEN. RANDOM ACTS OF VIOLENCE APPEAR TO BE EASING, BUT DISSIDENTS CONCERNED BY GOI ACTIONS. ARTIST BABILA FINALLY ARRESTED APRIL 10. END SUMMARY.

EMBASSY HAS LEARNED THAT LEAFLETS IN PERSIAN WERE DISTRIBUTED AT BOMBINGS OF HOMES OF THREE PROMINENT DISSIDENTS REPORT REF A. FLYERS CONTAINED MESSAGE THAT THESE BOMGINS ARE "WARNING TO OPPOSITIONAISTS TO STOP VIOLENT ACTIVITIES". LEAFLETS WERE SIGNED "UNDERGROUND COMMITTEE FOR VENGEANCE"., UNHEARD OF UNTIL THIS INCIDENT. JOURNALISTS WHO HAVE SEEN THESE LEAFLETS DESCRIBE THEM AS SIMILAR IN TONE TO OTHER ANTI-DISSIDENT TRACTS DISTRIBUTED WEEKS EARLIER AND ATTRIBUTE BOMBINGS TO GROUPS OF THUGS, PROBABLY WITH LINKS TO EITHER RESURGENCE PARTY OR TO SECURITY FORCES. THERE IS NO RPT NO HARD EVIDENCE TO THIS EFFECT.
HOWEVER, FACT PRESS HAS NOT MENTIONED THESE BOMBINGS AND GOI HAS BEEN SILENT ON MATTER DOES SUGGEST POSSIBILITY OF SOME SORT OF OFFICIAL OR UNOFFICIAL INVOLVEMENT.

DISSIDENT SOURCE HAS TOLD US OF FOURTH BOMBING SAME NIGHT AT HOME OF MAHMOUD MANIAN, PROMINENT BAZAAR MERCHANT ASSOCIATED WITH A RELIGIOUS (ALI SHARIATI) MOVEMENT. SAME LEAFLET LEFT HERE. ACCORINDG TO SAME SOURCE, VICTIMS HAVE BEEN RECEIVING SERIES OF TELEPHONE CALLS THREATENING FURTHER VIOLENCE IF THEY DO NOT CHANGE THEIR WAYS. VICTIMS BLAME GOVERNMENT, SPECIFICALLY RESURGENCE PARTY PROGRESSIVE WING LEADER MAJIDI.

ON SAME NIGHT, APRIL 9, PROMINENT OPPOSITION DENTIST HABIBOLAH PEYMAN WAS TAKEN FROM HIS HOME BY THREE OR FOUR UNIDENTIFIED MEN AND DRIVEN OUT OF TEHRAN ON KARAJ ROAD, WHERE HE WAS BEATEN AND LEFT SEMI-CONSCIOUS BY ROADSIDE. PEYMAN HITCHHIKED TO HOME OF FRIEND IN DISSIDENT MOVEMENT. HE TOLD SOURCE HE COULD NOT IDENTIFY HIS ATTEACKERS, BUT THOUGH THEY WERE YOUNG GOONS, PERHAPS UNEMPLOYED, PERHAPS ON "CONTRACT" TO SOME PRO-GOVERNEMENT ------------------121223 131336Z /46 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 7833 INFO CINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY LONDON SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 3532 GROUP.
HE LATER APPEARED, SHOWING HIS BRUISES, WITH HIS LAWYER, BEFORE CIVILIAN COURT EXAMINING MAGISTRATE TO REPORT AND COMPLAIN ABOUT THE INCIDENT.

ALTHOUGH PROGRESSIVE WING LEADER MAJIDI HAS SAID HE WAS MISQUOTED IN REPORTS OF HIS STATEMENT THATRESURGENCE PARTY ACTION COMMITTEES WOULD USE FORCE AGAINST SABOTEAURS (HELATER CLAIMED ONLY "POLITICAL ACTION" WAS MEANT), GOI HAS NOT RPT NOT COME OUT WITH ANY OTHER STATEMENT CONDEMNING VIOLENCE AGAINST OPPOSITIONISTS AND HIS TRIED TO IGNORE MATTER, ALSO SUGGESTING THAT PRESS DO SO. ALL THIS LEADS MANY TO WONDER IF THOSE WHO SUPPORT GOI ARE ATTEMPTING TO LIMIT SCOPE OF DISSIDENT ACTION BY CRUDE TACTICE OF SHOWING THAT VIOLENCE BEGETS VIOLENCE.

ACTUALLY, OVER PAST THREE DAYS, REPORTED INCIDENTS OF VIOLENCE HAVE TAPERED OFF. GOVERNMENT AND RESURGENCE PARTY SOURCES HAVE REPORTED FLOODS OF LETTERS AND TELEGRAMS URGING MORE PRO-GOI ACTIVITY AGAINST TROUBLEMAKERS. PARTY IS CONSEQUENTLY HOLDING MEETINGS OF CONCERNED PERSONS IN MANY PARTS OF THE COUNTRY. THERE HAVE ALOS BEEN ARTICLES IN THE PRESS SUGGESTING THAT MORE DEBATE AND PUBLIC EXPOSURE WILL DISCREDIT THE TROUBLEMAKERS FROM LEFT AND RIGHT.

INCIDENTALLY, ASHUR BABILA WAS FINALLY ARRESTED APRIL 10 FOR FAILING TO SHOW UP IN COURT TO DEFEND HIMSELF OF CHARGES OF CORRUPTING PUBLIC MORALS (REF C). DESPITE JUSTICE OFFICIAL'S STATEMENT TO US THAT CASE WOULD PROBABLY BE DROPPED (REF D), PROSECUTOR SERVED WARRANT APRIL 10, AND BABILA WAS RELEASED ON BAIL UNTIL TRIAL. UNOFFICIAL SOURCE SAID THERE IS REAL CONFLICT WITHIN JUDICIARY ON THIS ONE--PRESSURE ON PROSECUTOR'S OFFICE FROM CONSERVATIVES TO "MAKE AN EXAMPLE OF BABILA" AND COUNTERPRESSURE FROM JUDICIARY TO EFFECT THAT GOVERNMENT OUGHT TO BE ABOVE THIS KIND OF HARASSMENT.
REMAINS TO BE SEEN WHETHER CASE WILL ACUTALLY COME TO FAIRLY NOISY PUBLIC TRIAL OR WHEHTER DISCREET BUT STRENUOUS BACKSTAGE MANEUVERING WILL RESULT IN CASE FINALLY BEING DROPPED OR SETTLED QUIETLY.
FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY HAS JUST TELEPHONED ME TO SAY THAT, AFTER DISCUSSING MY DEMARCHE ABOUT ADDITIONAL IRANIAN TROOPS FOR UNIFIL WITH SHAH, HE HAS HE HAS RECEIVED NEW INSTRUCTIONS.

INSTEAD OF AWAITING RETURN OF GENERAL AZHARI TO REFINE DETAILS OF TROOP DEPLOYMENT, SHAH HAS INSTRUCTED KHALATBARY TO INFORM UNSYG THAT IRAN IS PREPARED TO AGREE WITH HIS REQUEST FOR ADDITONAL TROOPS. HOWEVER, BEFORE COMMITTING THESE TROOPS TO LEBANON, IRAN WISHES GOVERNMENT OF ISRAEL TO MAKE PUBLIC STATEMENT ANNOUNCING THAT ALL ISRAELI FORCES WILL BE WITHDRAWN FROM LEBANON PRIOR TO END OF APRIL.

IRANIAN DELEGATION IN NEW YORK IS BEING TOLD TO DISCUSS THIS WITH URQUHART SOONEST IN ORDER TO GIVE WALDHEIM ADDITIONAL LEVERAGE FOR HIS AND SILASVUO'S DEALINGS WITH WEIZMAN. IRANIANS DO NOT RPT NOT INTEND TO DISCUSS DIRECTLY WITH ISRAEL NOR TO MAKE ANY PUBLIC ANNOUNCEMENT BECAUSE THEY DO NOT WISH TO CROSS WIRES WITH US AND UNSYG EFFORTS AT THIS TIME.
REF/ STATE 95865

GENERAL AZHARI INFORMED ME EVENING APRIL 15 THAT ONCE HE IS GIVEN GREEN LIGHT, HE COULD DEPLOY ADDITIONAL IRANIAN BATTALION TO UNIFIL IN FORTH-EIGHT HOURS. THUS, IRANAISN COULD BE IN LEBANON WELL BEFORE END OF APRIL IF ISRAEL AGREES TO STATEMENT ON WITHDRAWAL IN NEXT FEW DAYS. (MY OWN MILITARY ADVISERS SUGGEST THAT IT WOULD BE PRUDENT TO ALLOW SOME SLIPPAGE IN THIS ESTIMATE. UNLESS BATTALION IS ALREADY POSITIONED WITH ITS EQUIPMENT AT PORT OF EMBARKATION, THEY FEEL THREE TO FOUR DAYS IS A MORE REALISTIC ESTIMATE.)

NEWS OF THE ADDITIONAL IRANIAN TROOP OFFER, TOGETHER WITH THE CONDITIONS UNDER WHICH IT IS BEING OFFERED, IS FRONT PAGE NEWS IN TEHRAN PRESS MORNING APRIL 16. STORY IS REPORTED BOTH FROM NEW YORK AND TEHRAN SOURCES. ASSUME THIS PUBLICITY MAY MAKE IT MORE DIFFICULT FOR ISRAELIS TO MAKE PUBLIC ANNOUNCEMENT AT THIS TIME.

KHALATBARY LEAVES APRIL 17 FOR LONDON WHERE HE WILL MEET SECRETARY DURING CENTO MINISTERIAL. IRANIAN UN PERM REP HOVEYDA, WHO HAS BEEN IN IRAN BRIEFLY, IS RETURNING TO NEW YORK TODAY. DISCUSSIONS CONCERNING SPECIAL SESSION FOR FINANCING UNIFIL CAN BE CONCENTRATED WITH THESE TWO OFFICIALS.

1978TEHRAN03627.subject: NEW SWEDISH AMBASSADOR ACCREDITED TO GOI

segments.text: ANNOUNCEMENT HAS BEEN MADE OF THE APPOINTMENT OF KAJ SUNDBERG AS SWEDISH AMBASSADOR TO IRAN. THE NEW SWEDISH ENVOY WAS UNTIL RECENTLY DEPUTY HEAD OF HIS COUNTRY'S PERMANENNT MISSION TO THE UN IN NEW YORK.

SWEDISH EMBASSY SOURCE HERE ADVISES THAT AMBASSADR SUNDBERG WILL ARRIVE TEHRAN IN THE FALL AT WHICH TIME PRESENT AMBASSADOR, BENGT ODHNER, WILL RETURN TO STOCKHOLM TO BECOME MEMBER OF MFA "COMMERCIAL AGREEMENTS NEGOTIATING TEAM".
