AMBASSADOR ODHNER HAS SERVED MOST RECENTLY IN IRAN SINCE DEC. 1973. BUT WAS PREVIOUSLY IN TEHRAN AS SWEDISH HEAD OF MISSION (SWEDEN ESTABLISHED A RESIDENT AMBASSADOR ONLY IN 1957.). A TALL, DARK, TACITURN BACHELOR, ODHNER HAS HAD EXTENSIVE EXPERIENCE IN THE REGION. WE HAVE HAD LIMITED SUBSTANTIVE DISCUSSIONS WITH ODHNER, BUT HE HAS BEEN EFFECTIVE IN STEADILY INCREASING SWEDEN'S BILATERAL TRADE WITH IRAN DURING HIS TENURE.
ANY BIOGRAPHIC INFORMATION AVAILABLE ON AMBASSADOR SUNDBERG WOULD BE APPRECIATED.

LEBANESE AMBASSADOR AL-KHALIL TOLD US EVENING OF APRIL 17 THAT HE HAD JUST HEARD THROUGH FAMILY SOURCES IN LEBANON THAT IDF OFFICERS HAD ROUNDED UP VILLAGE LEADERS IN THE TYRE AREA AND DEMANDED THAT THEY SIGN A STATEMENT REQUESTING ISRAELI PROTECTION. LEADERS DEMURRED AND ISRAELIS GAVE THEM TEN DAYS (FROM APRIL 16) TO RESPOND OR BEAR THE CONSEQUENCES. AL-KHALIL SAW THIS AS BLATANT EXAMPLE OF ISRAELIS SEEKING AN EXCUSE TO PROLONG THEIR STAY IN THE AREA.

AS THE DEPARTMENT KNOWS, TYRE IS AL-KHALIL FAMILY TURF. WHETHER FACTS OF THE STORY HE TOLD US ARE ACCURATE WE DO NOT KNOW, BUT WE BELIEVE THAT HE WAS FAITHFULLY REPORTING WHAT HE HAD HEARD FROM HIS SOURCES.

1978TEHRAN03699.subject: NEGOTIATION OF AGREEMENTS FOR PEACEFUL NUCLEAR COOPERATION--COMPARISON BETWEEN MODEL AND US-GOI VERSION

segments.text: EMBASSY HAS REVIEWED SUBJECT MODEL AGREEMENT FOR COMPARISON WITH MARK-UP OF US-GOI VERSION, PREPARED IN VIENNA WHEN DEPUTY ASSISTANT SECRETARY NOSENZO LAST MET WITH MANZOOR OF AEOI. COMMENTS WHICH FOLLOW ARE PROVIDED TO HELP DEPARTMENT IN PREPARATION OF ARTICLE BY ARTICLE COMMENTARY (SEE REFTEL PARA 3 SECTION 1), WHICH MAY PROVE USEFUL AS BACKGROUND TO CONTINUING NEGOTIATIONS WITH GOI.

COMPARATIVE COMMENTS FOLLOW: (A) INTRODUCTORY LANGUAGE OF THE US-GOI VERSION STRESSES FURTHERANCE OF NPT OBJECTIVES. DRAFT MODEL STRESSES, PER SE, PREVENTING THE PROLIFERATION OF NUCLEAR EXPLOSIVE DEVICES. (B) ARTICLE 4 (TRANSFER OF EQUIPMENT AND MATERIAL). PARA 2 OF THE US-GOI VERSION GOES BEYOND THE MODEL TO ASSURE THE GOI THE OPPORTUNITY TO RECEIVE THAT PORTION OF SEPARATIVE WORK OUTPUT (AS A MINIMUM) TO WHICH THEY ARE ENTITLED AS CONSEQUENCE OF A GOI INVESTMENT IN ANY URANIUM ENRICHMENT FACILITY IN THE UNITED STATES. PARA 7 OF THE US-GOI VERSION GOES BEYOND THE MODEL BY STATING THAT THE U.S.

SHALL ENDEAVOR TO ASSURE THAT IRAN DERIVES THE FULL BENEFIT OR MULTILATERAL FUEL ASSURANCES THAT MAY EVOLVE DURING THE PERIOD OF THIS AGREEMENT UNQUOTE. (C) ARTICLE 9 (SAFEGUARDS). PARA 1 OF THE US-GOI VERSION PROVIDES THE RIGHT TO THE U.S. TO REVIEW THE DESIGN OF ANY REACTOR, AND OTHER EQUIPMENT WHICH ARE TO BE TRANSFERRED PURSUANT TO THIS AGREEMENT TO IRAN OR OF ANY FACILITY RPT OF ANY FACILITY, ETC. THE MODEL AGREEMENT DOES NOT SPECIFY THIS U.S. RIGHT. PARAS 4 AND 5 OF THE US-GOI VERSION HAVE THE FOLLOWING LANGUAGE WHICH IS ADDITIONAL TO THAT IN THE MODEL AGREEMENT.

THE AGREEMENT BETWEEN IRAN AND THE IAEA PURSUANT TO ARTICLE III(4) OF NPT SATISFIES THIS REQUIREMENT UNQUOTE. PARA 7 OF THE U.W-GOI VERSION APPEARS TO BE NARROWER IN ITS INTENT THAN SAME PARA OF MODEL. LATTER REFERS TO SAFEGUARDS REQUIRED BY THE AGREEMENT; US-GOI VERSION REFERS TO MEASURES TO MAINTAIN AND FACILITATE APPLICATION OF SAFEGUARDS PROVIDED FOR UNDER THIS ARTICLE. (D) ARTICLE 11 (CESSATION OF COOPERATION). THE MODEL AGREEMENT GIVES THE U.S. BROADER RIGHTS FOR CESSATION OF COOPERATION THAN DOES THE US-GOI VERISION. (E) ARTICLE 13 (CONSULTATIONS). THE MODEL AGREEMENT IS MORE EXPLICIT RE COOPERATION IN THE PROTECTION OF THE INTERNATIONAL ENVIRONMENT.

THE US-GOI VERSION REFERS TO DEVELOPMENT OF FURTHER COOPERATION IN THIS AREA. (F) ARTICLE 14 (FINAL PROVISION). PARA 1 OF THE MODEL HAS THE LINE MISSING (SEE REFTEL) WHICH IDENTIFIES THE INITIAL PERIOD DURING WHICH THE AGREEMENT SHALL REMAIN IN FORCE. THE US-GOI VERSION SPECIFIES THE INITIAL PERIOD OF FIFTEEN YEARS.

SUMMARY: CALLS FOR CITIZENS TO MOBILIZE AGAINST PRESENT LOWLEVEL VIOLENCE IN IRAN (REFTEL) HAVE SO FAR RESULTED IN LIMITED POLITICAL ACTION UNDER RESURGENCE PARTY AEGIS, INCLUDING PRO-GOVERNMENT SPEECHES AND DEMONSTRATIONS IN MANY CITIES, AND EMERGENCE OF A RESISTANCE CORPS OR MOVEMENT WHICH MADE ITS APPEARANCE WHEN IT ACTIVIISTS INFILTRATED ANTIGOVERNMENT MOBS IN THREE PROVINCIAL CITIES, IDENTIFIED RING LEADERS AND HELD THEM UNTIL POLICE COULD ARRIVE TO MAKE FORMAL ARRESTS. DESPITE SPECULATION, THERE IS NO EVIDENCE AS YET THAT GOVERNMENT IS DEFINITIVELY FALLING BACK ON CREATION OF SUCH VIGILANTE "POPULAR MILITIA".
RATHER, WE BELIEVE, THIS REPRESENTS ONE OF SEVERAL INSTRUMENTS GOI IS TESTING, BOTH TO WARN OFF POTENTIAL DISSIDENTS AND TO SEE WHAT METHODS WORK BEST AS DISSIDENT TACTICS EVOLVE. END SUMMARY.

RECENT INDICATIONS THAT THE RESURGENCE PARTY WILL ORGANIZE PRO-GOVERNMENT DEMONSTRATIONS AND THE RESISTANCE CORPS WILL HELP LOCAL LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS IDENTIFY VIOLENT DEMONSTRATORS AND CONFRONT THEM SUGGEST THE GOI WISHES TO BRING MORE PRO-GOI CITIZENS INTO PLAY AGAINST THE WAVE OF HIT-AND-RUN VIOLENCE THAT HAS STRUCK OVER 53 CITIES AND TOWNS (OUR LATEST COUNT) BEORE EASING OFF IN PAST WEEK.

ACCORDING TO PRESS REPORTS, RESISTANCE CORPS ACITVISITS INFILTRATED DEMONSTRATORS APRIL 13-15 AND IDENTIFIED AND HANDED OVER TO POLICE 12 SUSPECTED RIOTERS. THESE ACTIONS TOOK PLACE IN ISFAHAN, QOM, AND ZANJAN. PRESS ACCOUNTS BEING POUCHED NEA INCLUDE NAMES OF DEMONSTRATORS TURNED OVER TO LOCAL POLICE. OFFICIAL SOURCE IN JUSTICE MINISTRY HAS INFORMED US THAT RESISTANCE CORPSMEN HAVE NO POWERS OF ARREST. BUT CAN "HOLD DOWN" RIOTER UNTIL POLICE CAN BE SUMMONED TO TAKE INDIVIDUAL INTO CUSTODY.

GOI HAS REMAINED AMBIVALENTLY SILENT ON QUESTION OF OFFICIALLY SANCTIONED CITIZEN VIOLENCE, AND MEDIA PLAY HAS SUGGESTED THAT GOVERNMENT IS NOT REALLY OPPOSED TO "CITIZEN ACTION" AGAINST DEMONSTRATORS AT LEAST IN CERTAIN CIRCUMSTANCES. SOURCES CLOSE TO POLICE SAY THIS LINE HAS REASSURED POLICE A BIT THAT THEY WILL NOT BE OUT ON FIRING LINE ALONE. SCOPE OF RANDOM VIOLENCE OF PAST FEW WEEKS HAS SURPRISED GOI AND OPPOSITIONIST LEADERS ALIKE, AND BOTH SIDES ARE CLEARLY CONTEMPLATING WHAT HAPPENS NEXT.

IN THIS CONTEXT, EMERGENCE OF RESISTANCE CORPS IS INTERESTING. CORPS WAS ESTABLISHED IN JUNE, 1977 AS CIVIL FORCE WHICH WOULD RESIST GUERRILLASTYLE IF IRAN IS OCCUPIED IN TIME OF WAR. CORPS, WHICH IS OFTEN CONFUSED WITH CIVIL DEFENSE ORGANIZATION FROM WHICH IT GREW AND WAS SEPARATED IN 1977, WAS BASED ON IDEA SHAH FIRST ESPOUSED IN 1972-3. COMMANDER OF CORPS IS DEPUTY COMMANDER OF IRAN'S GENDARMERIE, GENERAL MOHAMMAD MOMENI. LEADERSHIP COMES FROM GENDARMERIE, WHICH HAS EXECUTIVE RESPONSIBILITY FOR ORGANIZATION. MEMBERS OF CORPS INCLUDE MANY CIVIL SERVANTS, RESURGENCE PARTY MEMBERS WHO HAVE BEEN INTERESTED AND PRIVATE CITIZENS (PARTICULARLY IN RURAL AREAS).
FROM DISCUSSIONS WITH LOCAL MEMBERS OF CORPS, IT IS CLEAR THAT UNITS ARE WELL CONTROLLED BY GENDARMERIE AND COULD NOT HAVE EMBARKED ON PUBLIC ORDER ACTIVITIES WITHOUT OFFICIAL APPROVAL.

IT WOULD APPEAR THERE IS A DIFFERENCE BETWEEN NOMINAL MEMBERS WHO JOINED BECAUSE SOMEONE IN AUTHORITY SUGGESTED THEY SHOULD AND ACTIVISTS. IT IS DIFFICULT TO ESTIMATE NUMBER OF ACTIVIST MEMBERS OF RESISTANCE CORP, ------------------073870 190725Z /14 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 7908 AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY LONDON USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 3700 BUT IT WOULD APPEAR AS OF NOW TO BE VERY TINY PERCENTAGE OF 500,000 PROJECTED MEMBERSHIP FIGURE GIVEN US BY ONE SOURCE. ORGANIZATION HAS BEEN LARGELY MORIBUND, AND EVEN FEW MEMBERS WE HAVE TALKED TO WHO CAN PRODUCE MEMBERSHIP CARDS KNOW NOTHING OF PRESENT ACTIVITIES.

SOME OF OUR MORE KNOWLEDGEABLE IRANIAN SOURCES HAVE SPECULATED THAT THIS MAY BE GOI'S WAY OF BRINGING SAVAK AND OTHER OFFICIAL GOI LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS INTO DEMONSTRATION CONTROL PROCESS BY BACK DOOR. WE HAVE NO HARD EVIDENCE EITHER WAY, BUT FACT THAT RESISTANCE CORP WAS BESIEGED BY "OFFERS"TO HELP PROTECT THE FATHERLAND AND JUST DAYS LATER PRODUCED FIRST SUCCESSFUL FORAYS IN THREE DIFFERENT CITIES SUGGESTS SOMEONE WAS STEPPING A GOOD DEAL MORE SPRIGHTLY THAN USUAL, PRESUMABLY WITH ORGANIZED GOI ASSISTANCE.

RESURGENCE PARTY ACTIVITY CONTINUES, BUT IT APPEARS TO HAVE TURNED AWAY FROM FORCEFUL PHYSICAL ACTION AGAINST DEMONSTRATORS THAT PROGRESSIVE WING LEADER MAJIDI FLIRTED WITH BRIEFLY (REFTELS). NEITHER GOI NOR PARTY LEADERS HAVE SPECIFICALLY EXCLUDED FORCEFUL RESPONSE FROM THE PARTY MANDATE, HOWEVER, LATEST ENTRY INTO THE CONTEST TO SAFEGUARD THE NATION IS THE CONSERVATIVE WING, UNDER HUSHANG ANSARY, WHICH ON APRIL 17 SAID IT WAS DISPATCHING 250 REPRESENTATIVES OF THE WING TO VARIOUS CITIES AND TOWNS THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY TO BOOST PARTY ORGANIZATION AND ENCOURAGE PEOPLE TO WORK ACTIVELY INTHE PARTY TO HELP PROTECT THE NATION.

PERSIAN MEDIA ON APRIL 18 REPORTED PARTY RALLIES APRIL 13-15 IN SEVERAL IRANIAN CITIES, INCLUDING DAMAVAND, KARAJ, SHAHI, MAHALOT, SHAHRUD AND SHAHRIAT OVER PAST WEEKEND. THESE WERE LED BY RESURGENCE PARTY ACTION COMMITTEES, SIMILAR TO THOSE SET UP EARLIER IN REZAIYEH, KERMANSHAH, PIRANSHAR, AND OTHER CITIES. DEMONSTRATIONS WERE PEACEFUL AND PARTY LEADERS SPOKE ON NEED TO ELIMINATE VIOLENCE FROM POLITICS.

(COMMENT: GOI AND PARTY ACTIVITY TO DATE CAN BE BOILED DOWN TO CONTINUING EFFORTS BY THE SHAH AND HIS ADVISERS TO TEST A VARIETY OF METHODS FOR CONTROLLING AND DISSUADING INTERNAL DISSIDENTS. THESE HAVE INCLUDED PRO-GOI SPEECHES AND DEMONSTRATIONS AS WELL AS ENCOURAGEMENT TO "RESISTANCE CORPS" PARA-MILITARY WHO MIGHT MOBILIZE MUSCLE AND ACT MORE DIRECTLY IN THESTREETS AGAINST THE DISSIDENTS. WE GUESS SUCH TESTING WILL CONTINUE UNTIL THE SHAH FEELS HE HAS A PRETTY GOOD IDEA OF (A) ENTIRE RANGE OF TACTICS TO WHICH OPPOSITION WILL RESORT, (B) RELATIVE SUCCESS AND POLITICAL COST OF EACH OF THE MEANS USED TO COMBAT THEM, AND (C) FOREIGN PRESS REACTION.
AVAILABLE BIOGRAPHIC BAEKGROUND MATERIAL SENT SANA JULY 1977, AT THE TIME OF AMIRUDDIN EFTEKHAR'S APPOINTMENT AS AMBASSADOR TO NORTH YEMEN, FOLLOWS

EFTEKHAR, 60, IS A CAREER DIPLOMAT WITH A LAW DEGREE FROM UNIVERSITY OF TEHRAN. HE HAS SERVED IN VARIOUS MFA DEPARTMENT: PROTOCOL, WESTERN EUROPEAN AFFAIRS, INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS AND PASSPORTS. ABROAD HE HAS BEEN POSTED TO BAGHDAD AND MADRID. HE SPEAKS ENGLISH AND FRENCH.
WE WOULD APPRECIATE ANY ADDITIONAL INFORMATION WHICH MIGHT DEVELOP DURING EFTEKHAR'S TOUR IN SANA AND DJIBOUTI.

FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY WILL ATTEND AND PROBABLY BE THE HIGHEST IRANIAN OFFICIAL AT THE SPECIAL SESSION. HIS DATES HAVE NOT YET BEEN FIXED, THOUGH HIS OFFICE BELIEVES HE MAY NOT ARRIVE FOR THE OPENING OF THE SESSION, BUT A BIT LATER IN EARLY JUNE. WE EXPECT TO HAVE MORE EXACT READ OUT WHEN HE RETURNS TO IRAN OVER THE WEEKEND AND WILL SUPPLEMENT THIS INFORMATION.

SUMMARY: PRISON HUNGER STRIKE APPEARS OVER. SOME PRISONER DEMANDS REPORTEDLY MET. PRECISE FACTS AND FIGURES STILL HAZY. SETTLEMENT MAY HAVE BEEN TIED TO PROJECTED INTERNATIONAL RED CROSS (ICRC) VISIT. END SUMMARY.

VERY WELL-CONNECTED FOREIGN JOURNALIST INFORMED EMBOFF THAT GOOD CONTACTS ON OPPOSITIONIST COMMITTEE FOR THE DEFENSE OF PRISONERS LEARNED THAT THE QASR PRISON HUNGER STRIKE WAS OVER ON APRIL 10. ACCORDING TO OPPOSITIONIST SOURCES, INMATES "WON" FOLLOWING CONCESSIONS: A) RIGHT TO RECEIVEDLOCAL BOOKS AND MAGAZINES UNCENSORED; B) ABILITY TO PURCHASE FOOD OUTSIDE PRISON IF DESIRED; C) PERMISSION TO HAVE NEEDLES TO MEND CLOTHES; ANA D) WIDER SPACING IN METAL GRILL THAT SEPARATES PRISONERS FROM THEIR FAMILIES DURING VISITING HOURS.

JOURNALIST HAD CHECKED SEVERAL OTHER SOURCES ON QUESTION OF NUMBERS INVOLVED AND CONDITION OF PRISONERS AND NOTED FACTS IN THIS AREA VERY UNCERTAIN (AND JOURNALIST WOULD USE THEM ONLY IN VERY GENERAL WAY IN NEWS STORY). OPPOSITIONISTS CLAIM 400-500 PRISONERS WERE INVOLVED, BUT JOURNALIST DOES NOT BELIEVE THIS, PREFERRING TO GO WITH FIGURE CLOSER TO 200 PLUS OR MINUS 30. PROBLEM IS THAT NOT ALL PRISONERS WERE ON HUNGER STRIKE AT ALL TIMES-SOME PARTICIPATED ONLY SPORADICALLY, OTHERS ATE SMUGGLED FOOD TO KEEP UP MINIMUM STRENGTH.
ACCORDING TO OPPOSITIONISTS, 100 PRISONERS WENT TO HOSPITAL AFTER HUNGER STRIKE, BUT CHECK WITH OTHER SOURCES INDICATES THAT ONLY SMALL MINORITY REMAINED THERE BEYOND INITIAL HEALTH CHECK.

MOST INTERESTING FEATURE OF STRIKE TTLEMENT IS FACT THAT GOI REPORTEDLY EXPECTED VISIT OF ICRC TEAM WEEK OF APRIL 10-17, AND PRESSURE OF IMPENDING VISIT MAY HAVE HELPED PUSH TO SETTLEMENT. EMBASSY HAS NOT HEARD FROM OTHER SOURCES THAT ICRC TEAM ACTUALLY ARRIVED. SEVERAL JOURNALISTS ALSO UNABLE TO CONFIRM THIS. GOI HAS PLAYED PAST ICRC VISITS VERY CLOSE, AND EMBASSY DOES NOT WISH TO ASK GOI DIRECTLY IN ABSENCE OF PUBLISHED PEG ON WHICH TO HANG QUESTION. NEVERTHELESS, TIMING OF PROJECTED VISIT DOES SQUARE WITH WHAT WE HAVE HEARD OF OTHER GOI ACTIVITY, INCLUDING NEW YEAR'S PARDONS, ESTABLISHMENT OF MORE FLEXIBLE VISITING HOURS, ETC.
FOR GENEVA: WOULD APPRECIATE ANY INFO ON ICRC VISIT.
AS BACKGROUNDER TO ON-GOING LOS MEETING AND MARINE ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION CONFERENCE IN KUWAIT, KAYHAN INTERNATIONAL ON SPRIL 18 PUBLISHED ARTICLE BY STAFF CORRESPONDENT SHAHIN MOSSAVAR-RAHMANI.

ARTICLE, BEING POUCHED D/LOS AND LOS-GENEVA, REVIEWS GOI POSITION ON TERRITORIAL WATERS NOTING THAT BILATERAL AGREEMENTS ARE IN FORCE BETWEEN IRAN AND HER NEIGHBORS IN CASPAIN SEA, PERSIAN GULF, AND SEA OF OMAN REGIONS. THUS, "FINAL OUTCOME ON MANY SEA LAW ISSUES MAY NOT AFFECT IRAN SIGNIFICANTLY" ACCORDING TO MOSSAVAR-RAHMANI.

IN THE SAME WAY, EXPLORATION AND EXPLOITZTION OF NATURAL RESOURCES AND FISHING IN AREA BEYOND TERRITORIAL LIMIT (IN IRAN'S CASE, 12 N.M.) AND WITHIN CONTINENTAL SHELF IS BEING SHARED BY IRAN AND HER NEIGHBORS BY DRAWING " A MEDIAN LINE, EVERY POINT ON WHICH IS EQUIDISTANT FROM THE NEAREST POINT ON THE COASTLINE OF BOTH STATES" AND IS NOT DEPENDENT ON A FINAL LOS TREATY. THIS "MEDIAN LINE" FORMULA ALSO APPLIES TO THE SEA OF OMAN WHERE, UNLIKE THE PERSIAN GULF, THE CONTINENTAL SHELF DROPS OFF SHARPLY (FYI: MFA SOURCE, CONFIRMED THAT SUCH BILATERAL AGREEMENTS HAVE NOT AS YET BEEN CONCLUDED WITH ALL LITTORAL STATES.).

WITH REGARD TO RIGHTS OF PASSAGE, THE ARTICLE STATES, "IRAN HAS ALSO SUPPORTED THE ISSUE OF FREE PASSAGE OF SHIPS ON ROUTES THAT FALL WITHIN A COUNTRY'S TERRITORIAL LIMIT. THE SO-CALLED LAW OF FREE PASSAGE APPROVED IN 1958 STATES THAT SHIPS OF ALL NATIONS MAY ENJOY THE RIGHT OF FREE PASSAGE THROUGH EACH OTHERS' TERRITORIAL WATERS AS LONG AS IT IS NOT 'PREJUDICIAL TO THE PEACE, GOOD ORDER OR SECURITY' OF THE COASTAL STATE, AND CONFORMS WITH OTHER ARTICLES OF INTERNATIONAL LAW. THE STRAITS OF HORMOZ, WHICH LIE WITHIN IRAN'S JURISDICTION, IS AN EXAMPLE OF THE LAW OF FREE PASSAGE IN ACTION."

COMMENT: RE FINAL SENTENCE ABOVE, GOI OF COURSE SHARES STRAITS OF HORMOZ WITH OMAN, AND IT WOULD THEREFORE BE MORE PRECISE TO STATE THAT THE STRAITS LIE "PARTIALLY WITHIN IRAN'S JURISDICTION". LATEST INFORMATION AVAILABLE HERE (77 MUSCAT 647) INDICATES THAT OMANGOV DOES NOT FAVOR "TRANSIT PASSAGE" FORMULATION IN STRAITS. PRIME GOI EXPERT, EZEDDINE KAZEMI, IS PRSENTLY IN GENEVA AND HENCE IS UNAVAILABLE TO US FOR AUTHORITATIVE COMMENT ON SIGNIFICANE OF ABOVE STATEMENT ON "FREE PASSAGE" VIS-AVIS "TRANSIT PASSAGE".

A SOVIET EMPLOYEE OF THE IRANO-SOVIET TRANSPORT COMPANY, WHO WAS APPREHENDED MARCH 27 DURING THE ARREST OF BRIG. GEN. (RET.) ALI AKBAR DARAKHSHANI (REFTEL), LEFT TEHRAN TIWHT HIS WIFE AND CHILDREN FOR THE SOVIET UNION APRIL 20. ALMAN SHAMIROV EBRAHIMOGHLI, 42, WAS ORDERED TO LEAVE IRAN BECAUSE OF HIS "ESPIONAGE ACTIVITIES", WHICH INCLUDED PAYMENT OF 28,000 RIALS ($400) TO DARAKHSHANI, ACCORDING TO LOCAL PRESS REPORTS.

COMMENT: ACCORDING TO PRESS REPORTS AT THE TIME, TWO "EMPLOYEES OF THE SOVIET EMBASSY" IN ADDITION TO EBRAHIMOGHLI WERE IN THE VEHICLE WHICH MADE A RENDEZVOUS WITH DARAKHSHANI LAST MONTH. THESE OTHER TWO SOVIETS HAVE NEVER BEEN PUBLICLY IDENTIFIED NOR TO OUR KNOWLEDGE HAS ACTION BEEN TAKEN AGAINST THEM BY THE GOI.

1978TEHRAN03869.subject: BILATERAL COOPERATION ON PEACEFUL USES OF NUCLEAR ENERGY

segments.text: ENERGY

YOU WILL RECALL THAT WHEN I SAW YOU IN WASHINGTON TWO MONTHS AGO, I EXPRESSED CONCERN THAT THE BUREAUCRACY WAS DELAYING IMPLEMENTATION OF THE "MOST FAVORED NATION" TREATMENT WHICH THE PRESIDENT HAD OFFERED THE SHAH IN THE FIELD OF BILATERAL COOPERATION ON THE PEACEFUL USES OF NUCLEAR ENERGY. DUE TO YOUR INTERCESSION, A FORMULA WAS WORKED OUT AND SENT TO THE WHITE HOUSE IN LATE MARCH FOR THE PRESIDENT'S APPROVAL.

ONE MONTH LATER AND DESPITE A PERSONAL MESSAGE WHICH I SENT TO ZBIG, WE HAVE YET TO RECEIVE AUTHORIZATION TO PROPOSE THIS FORMULA TO THE IRANIANS. THE NET RESULT IS THAT OUR NEGOTIATION OF THE BILATERAL AGREEMENT HAS BEEN STALLED FOR NEARLY THREE MONTHS. THE IRANIANS ARE BECOMING QUITE SUSPICIOUS OF OUR MOTIVES. THE SHAH HAS RECENTLY REMINDED ME THAT HE IS WAITING FOR A WASHINGTON MOVE.

THE GRAPEVINE INFORMATION WHICH I GET IS THAT SOME OF THE EARLIER OPPONENTS OF THE PRESIDENT'S "MOST FAVORED NATION" UNDERTAKING HAVE SUCCEEDED IN DELAYING THE PAPERS FROM REACHING THE PRESIDENT'S DESK. I THEREFORE REGRET THAT I FEEL I HAVE TO ASK YOU ONCE AGAIN TO INTERECEDE PERSONALLY TO GET ME THE AUTHORIZATION WE NEED FOR FURTHER DISCUSSIONS WITH THE IRANIANS.

1978TEHRAN03889.subject: GIFT OF JEWELRY FROM IRANIAN OFFICIAL

segments.text: ON DECEMBER 15, 1977, I SENT THROUGH THE CLASSIFIED AIR POUCH A SET OF JEWELRY WHICH MY WIFE HAD RECEIVED FROM THE TRUSTEE OF THE SHRINE OF IMAM REZA AND WHICH THE TRUSTEE REFUSED TO TAKE BACK. IN THE LETTER ACCOMPANYING THE JEWELRY, I ASKED THAT PROTOCOL ACCEPT CUSTODY OF THE JEWELS AND ALSO MADE CERTAIN SUGGESTIONS CONCERNING THEIR DISPOSITION. I FURTHERMORE REQUESTED A RECEIPT.
SINCE I HAVE HEARD NOTHING IN RESPONSE, I WOULD LIKE A MESSAGE ASSURING ME THAT THE JEWELS HAVE BEEN RECEIVED. I WOULD ALSO LIKE A RECEIPT AND AN ANSWER TO MY SUGGESTIONS ON DISPOSITION.

1978TEHRAN03892.subject: GOI DISCOURAGEMENT OF DISSIDENT POLITICAL ACTION

segments.text: I AM BECOMING INCREASINGLY CONCERNED BY THE EVIDENCE THAT IRANIAN AUTHORITIES HAVE DECIDED TO RESORT TO HEAVY-HANDED MEANS TO DISCOURAGE DISSIDENT POLITICAL ACTION. REF A IS THE LATEST CASE IN POINT.

THESE ACTIONS ARE BEING TAKEN DESPITE THE SHAH'S REITERATED ASSURANCES TO ME AND OTHERS THAT HE CONTINUES TO PURSUE A POLICY OF "LIBERALIZATION" AND DESPITE PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR'S ASSURANCES (REF B) THAT THE GOVERNMENT AND THE RASTAKHIZ PARTY WOULD NOT RESORT TO BROWNSHIRT TACITCS IN THEIR "SILEN MAJORITY" RESISTENCE TO DISSIDENT VIOLENCE.

I HAVE SPOKEN ABOUT MY CONCERNS TO TWO CABINET MINISTERS AND FOUND THEM BOTH PRIVATELY SYMPATHETIC. IT IS MY INTENTION TO MAKE A MORE FORMAL REPRESENTATION TO AMOUZEGAR, SINCE THE SO-CALLED "RESISTENCE CORPS" IS NOMINALLY UNDER HIS CONTROL. I INTEND ALSO TO REMIND HIM OF HIS EARLIER ASSURANCES TO ME ABOUT NON-VIOLENCE.

I SAW AMOUZEGAR BRIEFLY AT THE AIRPORT YESTERDAY AFTER HIS RETURN FROM THE UNITED STATES. HE TOLD ME THAT, WHILE IN WASHINGTON, HE HAD MET A NUMBER OF OFFICIALS, ESPECIALLY FROM THE CONGRESS, BUT ALSO FROM THE DEPARTMENT. IN PARTICULAR, HE MENTIONED ATHERTON.

IN A MESSAGE WHICH I SENT THROUGH ANOTHER CHANNEL, I RECOMMENDED THAT A SENIOR DEPARTMENT OFFICIAL RAISE OUR CONCERN WITH HIM DURING HIS RECENT STAY IN WASHINGTON. BEFORE I MEET WITH HIM AGAIN I WOULD LIKE TO KNOW WHETHER THIS WAS DONE AND, IF SO, WHETHER THERE WAS ANYTHING IN THAT CONVERSATION ON WHICH I CAN BUILD IN MY TALK WITH HIM.

WE WERE AMUSED TO NOTE HOW MUCH SAUDI MFA OFFICIAL AHMAD SIRAJ'S VIEWS ON IRAN ARE THE MIRROR IMAGE OF MANY IRANIAN VIEWS ON SAUDI ARABIA. IRANIANS SEE THE RELATIVE ABSENCE OF SOCIAL MODERNIZAON IN SAUDI ARABIA AS TROUBLE FOR THE FUTURE AND A CHALLENGE TO THE CONTINUED HEGEMONY OF THE ROYAL FAMILY. MANY IRANIANS SEE THEIR OWN PROBLEMS AND TROUBLES AS GROWING PAINS IN TRANSITION TO WHAT THEY HOPE WILL BE A STRONGER SOCIETY. THEIR VIEWS ARE, OF COURSE, COLORED BY A REJECTION FOR THE MOST PART OF RELIGIOUS INFLUENCE IN THE DAILY AFFAIRS OF BUSINESS OR THE STATE, WITH THE SOMEWHAT SPECIAL VIEW OF SAUDI ARABIA THAT PRODUCES.

MANY OF SIRAJ'S CRITICISMS ARE WELL TAKEN. THE SHAH, IS, TRYING TO SET THE STAGE FOR HIS SUCCESSOR AND CONTINUE TO BALANCE, CONCILIATE, CAJOLE, COOPT, AND, AS NECESSARY, PRESSURE THE DIVERGENT ELEMENTS OF THIS VERY COMPLEX COUNTRY SO THAT STABILITY CAN ACCOMPANY WRENCHING SOCIAL AND ECONOMIC CHANGE. THERE ARE MANY UNCERTAINTIES FOR THE FUTURE, BUT IT WOULD APPEAR TO US ANY DISINTEGRATION OF IRAN INTO "CONGERIES OF SMALL STATES" WOULD BE A HIGHLY UNLIKELY EVENTUALITY. ON THAT POINT, AT LEAST, SIRAJ MIGHT BE REASSURED. IRAN AS A NATIONAL ENTITY WILL ALMOST CERTAINLY ROCK ALONG IN BETTER TIMES AND WORSE.
WE HAVE INCLUDED JIDDA AS AN ADDRESSEE ON A COMPANION CABLE IN WHICH WE COMMENT ON SOME BRITISH VIEWS OF IRAN. JIDDA MAY WISH TO DRAW ON IT IN FUTURE CONVERSATION WITH SIRAJ.

1978TEHRAN03897.subject: BRITISH VIEW OF SITUATION IN IRAN

segments.text: WE WERE INTERESTED BY ACCOUNT OF ASSISTANT SECRETARY SAUNDERS' DISCUSSIONS WITH FCO ASSISTANT UNDER SECRETARY WEIR AND DEPARTMENT HEAD LUCAS ON APRIL 18 REGARDING THE SITUATION IN IRAN. WE SHARE MOST OF THE PERCEPTIONS MENTIONED BY THE FCO OFFICIALS, BUT WOULD DIVERGE FROM THE OVER-ALL TONE COMMUNICATED PERHAPS AS A RESULT OF COMPRESSION IN RELATIVELY SHORT CONVERSATIONS.

THE SHAH HAS REMARKED TO AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN AND ALSO PUBLICLY REGARDING HIS DETERMINATION TO PROCEED WITH HIS INTERNAL LIBERALIZATION PROGRAM. AS NOTED BY THE BRITISH THIS PRESENTS A NUMBER OF DIFFICULTIES AND DILEMMAS. WE HESITATE TO DRAW THE CONCLUSION THAT THE SHAH "HAS BEEN UNWILLING TO INTRODUCE GENUINE POLITICAL INSTITUTIONS" SINCE WHAT IS "GENUINE" IN A PERSIAN CONTEXT WOULD BE DIFFICULT TO IDENTIFY. IT IS HARD TO RECALL A PERIOD OF MODERN IRANIAN HISTORY WHEN SUCH POLITICAL INSTITUTIONS EXISTED AND WERE EFFECTIVE.

THE SHAH'S PROBLEM APPEARS TO US RATHER ONE OF PUSHING THE PROCESS OF CREATION OF MODERN INSTITUTIONS, WHILE PROTECTING HIS FLANKS FROM EXTREMISTS OF LEFT AND RIGHT AND MAINTAINING A VIABLE RELATIONSHIP WITH THE CONSERVATIVE RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP WHICH HAS GREAT INFLUENCE WITH HIS PEOPLE. THERE IS AN ELEMENT OF "ACCIDENT" IN SOME OF THE COOPERATION CURRENTLY EXISITING BETWEEN RELIGIOUS AND OTHER (INTELLECTUAL LEFT WING) DISSIDENTS, BUT ACCIDENT IS HARDLY THE KEY ELEMENT.

RATHER, WHAT WE ARE BEGINNING TO ANALYSE AS A BREAKDOWN OF COMMUNICATIONS BETWEEN THE MODERNIZING ESTABLISHMENT AROUND THE SHAH AND THE RELIGIOUS CONSERVATIVES COULD LEAD TO SERIOUS INTERNAL INSTABILITY WHICH THE CONSERVATIVE MONARCHY WOULD CONSCIOUSLY SEEK TO CAPITALIZE ON. AS THE BRITISH SUGGEST, A GOOD DEAL OF THIS IS OF THE SHAH'S OWN MAKING, IF ONLY BECAUSE THE SERIOUS RELIGIOUS OUTBREAK AT GHOM IN JANUARY APPEARS TO HAVE BEEN TRIGGERED BY AN AWKWARD AND PERHAPS ILL-CONSIDERED NEWSPAPER ATTACHK ON A RIGHT WING RELIGIOUS OPPONENET (AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI) IN THE PROCESS OF SEEKING TO INVOLVE THE POPULACE IN MORE POLITICAL ACTIVITY AND DIALOGUE.

WHILE WE AGREE WITH THE BRITISH EMBASSY HERE AND THE FCO THAT THERE IS AN ECONOMIC DIMENSION TO THE DISSATISFACTION AT PRESENT, THE ROOTS OF DISSIDENCE DATE BACK MANY YEARS DERIVING FROM PAST POLITICAL ALIGNMENTS AND BATTLES, AND WE DOUBT THE BRITISH ANY MORE THAN WE WOULD EXPECT THE CURETO LIE IN ECONOMIC IMPROVEMENTS. THE SHAH'S TECHNIQUE OF CONTROLLING THE ARMY, SECURITY FORCES, MINISTRIES, AND OTHER POTENTIAL CHALLENGERS TO HIS MONARCHY INDEED RESEMBLES PARALLEL PILLARS MORE THAN A PYRAMID, BU T IT HAS WORKED PRETTY WELL FOR HIM, PARTICULARLY WHEN COMPARED WITH WHAT HAS HAPPENED IN MANY SURROUNDING COUNTRIES.

WHILE THE DISTURBANCES IN IRAN ARE INDEED THE WORST FOR 15 OR SO YEARS (SINCE 1962-63), THE SHAH'S METHOD OF REACTING TO THEM IS QUITE COMPLEX. EMBASSY HAS IN PREPARATION, AND WILL SOON BE SENDING, A LONGER PIECE ANALYZING SOME OF THE KEY DEVELOPMENTS IN IRAN OVER THE PAST YEAR, OUR VIEW OF THE SHAH'S AIMS AND POLICIES, AND ESTIMATES AS TO WHERE THEY MAY BE LEADING.

1978TEHRAN03917.subject: NORTH KOREA NAMES NEW AMBASSADOR TO GOI

segments.text: LOCAL PRESS HASKED UP AP REPORT THAT CHA BYONG OK HAS BEEN NAMED NORTH KOREIAN AMBASSADOR TO IRAN. ANY BIOGRAPHIC BACKROUND AVAILABLE TO ADDRESSEES WOULD BE APPRECIATED.

NORTH KOREA'S FIRST ENVOY TO IRAN, AMBASSADOR LY YUN HO, ARRIVED IN MARCH 1974. GOI DEPARTURE FORMALITIES INCLUDED CEREMONY WHERE COURT MINISTER HOVEYDA, ON ORDERS OF THE SHAH, CONFERRED A HOMAYOUN MEDAL FIRST CLASS ON AMBASSADOR LY. A FEW DAYS LATER, MFA PARLIAMENTARY UNDERSECRETARY SHILATI-FARD GAVE A FAREWELL LUNCH FOR LY AT WHCIH HE REPOREDLY SAID THAT THE GOI ESTIBLISHED RELATIONS WITH THE DPRK FIVE YEARS AGO "IN PURSUANCE OF OUR INDEPENDENT NATIONAL POLICY", ADDING THAT AMBASSADOR LY "HAS BEEN CROWNED WITH SUCCESS IN THIS MISSION".

COMMENT: WHILE LY RECEIVED STANDARD TREATMENT FOR DEPARTING AMBASSADORS, THIS IS MOST WIDESPREAD PUBLICITY GIVEN GOI RELATIONS WITH NORTH KOREA SINCE LAST YEAR'S BILATERAL TRADE PROTOCOL SIGNED IN PYONGYANG. DPRK DIPLOMATIC MISSION IS BARELY VISIBLE ON LOCAL SCENE: THEY HAVE FOUR DIPLOMATS ACCREDITED TO GOI, LESS THAN A FOURTH OF THE HIGHLY ACTIVE SOUTH KOREAN CONTINGENT.

1978TEHRAN03955.subject: PARLIAMENT QUERIES GOVERNMENT ON BOMBING OF DISSIDENT LAWYERS

segments.text: SUMMARY. MAJLES DEPUTY CALLS ON GOI TO DESCRIBE ITS CONDUCT IN HANDLING OF BOMB CASES. END SUMMARY.

PRESS APRIL 26 REPORTS TABRIZ MAJLES DEPUTY MOHSEN PEZESHKPOUR DEMANDED IN PARLIAMENT APRIL 25 THAT GOI EXPLAIN WHAT ACTION HAS BEEN TAKEN FOLLOWING TWO BOMB EXPLOSIONS IN LEGAL OFFICES LAST WEDNESDAY (REF A). PEZESHKPOUR TABLED SERIES OF QUESTIONS ABOUT BOMB BLASTS INSISTING "AUTHORITIES ARE NOT ONLY RESPONSIBLE FOR THE SAFETY OF PEOPLE'S LIVES AND PROPERTY BUT FOR THEIR DIGNITY AND FREEDOM.". HE ASKED WHETHER GOVERNMENT HAS TAKEN ANY ACTION TO DISCOVER DIRUPTIVE ELEMENTS BEHIND THE "UNDERGROUND COMMITTEE FOR REVENGE". PEZESHKPOUR ALSO WANTS GOI TO INDICATE WHAT COMMITMENTS AUTHORITIES HAVE MADE TO PREVENT OTHER ILLEGAL AND UNDESIRABLE THREATS TO GENERAL SECURITY.

PEZESHKPOUR IS DEPUTY WHO TABLED MOTION AGAINST GOVERNMENT INTABRIZ RIOTS (REF B), AND EMBASSY HAS LEARNED THAT AT STORMY AND INFORMAL SESSION OF FEW MAJLES DEPUTIES WITH PRIME MINISTER DURING PAST WEEK, PEZESHKPOUR'S QUESTIONS SO IRRITATED PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR THAT HE THREATENED TO HAVE HIM REMOVED FROM THE RESURGENCE PARTY TICKET FOR NEXT YEAR'S PARLIAMENTARY ELECTIONS.

PRESS CARRIED ORIGINAL PEZESHKPOUR CENSURE MOTION AND TEHRAN JOURNAL MADE STORY OF INQUIRY ITS DOMESTIC (THIRD-PAGE) LEAD. PRESS IN PAST FEW WEEKS HAS BEEN MORE WILLING ON SEVERAL OCCASIONS TO AT LEAST CONFIRM OTHERS' RAISING OF EMBARRASSING MATTERS.

TEHRAN JOURNAL APRIL 26 PUBLISHED COLUMN-LENGTH EDITORIAL ON QUESTION OF FREE EXPRESSION WHICH CRITICIZES WESTERN PRESS FOR "BLOWING UP INCIDENTS OUT OF PROPORTION". EDITORIAL NOTED "THE FLINE DIVIDING CONSTRUCTIVE EXPRESSION OF OPINION ON MATTERS OF NATIONAL EMPORTANCE AND NEGATIVE ATTITUDE, IGNORING THE MOST SHINING ACHIEVEMENTS OF THE PAST FEW YEARS, IS INDEED VERY THIN.". EDITORIAL GOES ON TO SUGGEST THAT IN DEVELOPING COUNTRY, DEMONSTRATIONS, SOMETIMES VIOLENT, ARE UNDERSTANABLE. TEXT BEING POUCHED DEPARTMENT.

1978TEHRAN03957.subject: KABUL'S INITIAL ANALYSIS OF THE KHAIBAR KILLING

segments.text: ON APRIL 26, WE BRIEFED MFA DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR ASIA AND AFRICA SANANDAJI ON ANALYSIS CONTAINED REFTEL. HE WAS VERY INTERESTED AND REMARKED THAT WAHEED ABDULLAH HAD TOLD IRANIAN AMBASSADOR DAVOUDI THAT GOA PERMITTED DEMONSTRATION TO TAKE PLACE SO THAT IT COULD IDENTIFY MEMBERS OF COMMUNIST GROUP WHEN THEY CAME INTO THE OPEN (PER PARA 4 REFTEL).

SANANDAJI WAS AMUSED BY QUOTATION ATTRIBUTED TO DAVOUDI TO THE EFFECT THAT POSSIBLE MOTIVE MIGHT HAVE BEEN DAOUD'S DESIRE TO "SEND A MESSAGE TO YOUR BOSS AND OURS." HE SAID HE WOULD ASK DAVOUDI WHO IS HERE ON CONSULTATION ABOUT IT. HE ALSO FOUND LAST PARAGRAPH REFTEL SIGNIFICANT SINCE IT CONTENDS TO CONFIRM IRANIAN BELIEF THAT SITUATION IS VERY DANGEROUS IN AFGHANISTAN DUE TO IMPORTANCE OF COMMUNISTS BEHIND THE SCENES. THIS IS SOMETHING WHICH IRANIANS WILL BE INVESTIGATING CLOSE-UP DURING SHAH'S VISIT IN LATE MAY.

1978TEHRAN03958.subject: OMAN - RAS AL KHAIMAH BORDER DISPUTE

segments.text: DURING MEETING APRIL 26 WITH VISITING AMBASSADOR WOLLE AND POLCOUNS, MFA DIRECTOR GENERAL SANANDAJI SHOWED INTEREST IN OUR PERCEPTION OF OMAN - RAS AL KHAIMAH BORDER DISPUTE. WHEN WOLLE HAD BRIEFED HIM ON OUR ATEST VIEWS, INVOLVING SHEIKH ZAYID AS THE MIDDLE MAN, SANANDAJI SAID HE HAD HEARD THAT SHEIKH RASHID HAD COME UP WITH A COMPROMISE PROPOSAL WHICH WOULD AWARED OFF-SHORE RIGHTS IN DISPUTED ZONE TO OAN IN RETURN FOR OMANI RECOGNITION OF RAS AL KHAIMAH SOVEREIGNTY OVER LAND PORTION.
SANANDAJI SAID HE HAD HEARD OMANIS TOOK BADLY TO THIS PROPOSAL (IT WAS NOT CLEAR, BUT IMPLIED, THAT RASHID MAY HAVE PUT THIS PROPOSAL TO OMANIS DURING HIS RECENT VISIT THERE.)

AT DINNER APRIL 29, GEORGE BUSH GAVE ME THE FOLLOWING COMMENTS ABOUT HIS AUDIENCE WITH THE SHAH EARLIER THAT DAY. HE SAID THE SHAH IS VERY CONCERNED ABOUT DEVELOPMENTS IN AFGHANISTAN AND CONSIDERED THE COUP ONE MORE EXAMPLE OF THE SOVIET GRAND DESIGN. HE HAD WARNED PRESIDENTS NIXON, FORD AND CARTER ABOUT AFGHANISTAN; NOW HE SEES THE COUP AS FURTHER PROOF OF A COMMUNIST DRIVE TO ENCIRCLE IRAN. HE HAS BECOME UNSURE OF PAKISTAN NOW.

AT THE SAME TIME THE SHAH TOLD BUSH OF HIS CONCERN ABOUT THE PERSIAN GULF STATES, WHICH HE SAID WERE "RUN BY A BUNCH OF BEDOUINS" WHO HAVE NO PLAN. THEY ARE NO MATCH FOR THE FORCES DETERMINED TO OVERTHROW THEM. HE MENTIONED IRAQ AND SYRIA AS REAL MENACES.

AT THE SAME DINNER SAVAK CHIEF GENERAL NASSIRI SAID HIS INFORMATION INDICATED ISOLATED CENTERS OF MILITARY RESISTANCE TO THE COUP GROUP CONTINUED, PARTICULARLY IN HERAT; IN KANDAHAR, WHERE AIR FORCE ELEMENTS INCLUDING SEVERAL MIG-EQUIPPED UNITS WERE STILL HOLDING OUT; AND IN BAGRAM AIR FORCE BASE, ABOUT TWENTY MILES NORTH OF KABUL. HE SAID A FORCE OF PARATROOPS FROM KANDAHAR HAD, ACCORDING TO REPORTS, TAKEN POSITIONS IN THE PRESIDENTIAL PALACE BUT ALL WERE KILLED. MOST OF THE AIR ATTACKES ON GOVERNMENT BUILDINGS IN KABUL WERE BY SU-7 AIRCRAFT.

NASSIRI ALSO TOLD ME THAT AS OF THAT TIME HE HAD NO INFORMATION TO CONFIRM THE DEATHS OF FORMER PRESIDENT DAOUD AND HIS BROTHER, NAIM, AND THAT HE HAD HEARD DAOUD'S WIFE AND SON HAD TAKEN REFUGE IN THE FRENCH EMBASSY.
WE ARE CONTINUING TO EXCHANGE INFORMATION WITH THE GOI ON THE BASIS OF KABUL REPORTS.

1978TEHRAN04110.subject: EMBASSY CONTACT WITH LEADERS OF ISLAMIC COMMUNITY

segments.text: SINCE CIVIL DISTURBANCES IN QOM AND TABRIZ, I HAVE ASKED EMBASSY POLITICAL OFFICERS TO ESTABLISH CONTACT WITH LEADERS OF THE ISLAMIC COMMUNITY IN ORDER TO ACHIEVE A BETTER COMPREHENSION OF THOSE ISSUES WHICH ARE AGITATING THE MULLAHS. AS THESE CONTACTS HAVE DEVELOPED, THE ISLAMIC LEADERS HAVE INDICATED A BASIC LOYALTY TO AND RESPECT FOR THE SHAH, BUT HAVE SAID THAT THEIR ACCESS TO HIM HAS BEEN BLOCKED BY HIS ACOLYTES.

THESE SAME LEADERS HAVE ALSO INDICATED A DESIRE TO MEET WITH ME PERSONALLY AND TO ARRANGE OTHER MEETINGS BETWEEN ME AND SOME OF THE MORE PRESTIGIOUS AYATOLLAHS FROM QOM. I HAVE SENT WORD THAT I DO NOT INTEND TO MAKE A PILGRIMAGE TO QOM BUT WOULD BE PREPARED MEET WITH ISLAMIC LEADERSHIP ON NEUTRAL GROUND (PROBABLY IN POLITICAL COUNSELOR'S HOME).

IN ORDER TO ANTICIPATE AND ALLAY SOME SUSPICAIONS, I DECIDED, IN COURSE OF A CONVERSATION ON OTHER MATTERS (REPORTED SEPTEL) TO INFORM HUSHANG ANSARY OF THE ISLAMIC LEADER'S DESIRE TO MEET WITH ME AND OF MY INTENTION TO SEE THEM. AT THE TIME OF OUR CONVERSATION, ANSARY MADE NO PARTICULAR COMMENT. HOWEVER, THE NEXT MORNING HE TELPHONED ME TO ADVISE ME, "AS A FRIEND", THAT HE TOUGHT MEETINGS WITH "THOSE PEOPLE" WOULD NOT SIT WELL WITH THE SHAH.

I THANKED ANSARY FOR HIS ADVICE BUT TOLD HIM I DID NOT INTEND TO BE EXPLOITED BY THE ISLAMIC LEADERS. I SAID I FELT A GENUINE NEED TO LEARN MORE ABOUT THEIR ATTITUDES AND THEREFORE INTENDED TO MEET WITH THEM DISCREETLY. I SAID I WOULD HAVE NO OBJECTION IF HE WISHED TO CONVEY ALL THAT TO THE SHAH. ANSARY SEEMED RELIEVED WHEN I SUGGESTED HE INFORM THE SHAH. THIS PRESUMABLY PASSES THE BUCK ELSEWHERE AND HE HAS EXPIATED HIS LOYALTY BY HIS "PERSONAL ADVICE" TO ME.

1978TEHRAN04114.subject: RECOGNITION OF NEW REGIME IN AFGHANISTAN

segments.text: WE HAVE BEEN IN TOUCH WITH IRANIAN MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS CONCERNING PROBLEM OF RECOGNIZING NEW REGIME IN AFGHANISTAN. ACTING FOREGIN MINISTER ZELLI TOLD ME AFTERNOON MAY 1 THAT, SINCE FOREIGN MINISTER HAS NOT YET RETURNED FROM RABAT AND SINCE SHAH OBSERVING MILITARY MANEUVERS IN SOUTH, HE DID NOT EXPECT HAVE GUIDANCE UNTIL MAY 2. HOWEVER, COURT MINISTER WOULD SEE SHAH IN SHIRAZ EVENING MAY 1 AND MIGHT HAVE SOMETHING FURTHER AT THAT TIME.

IN MEANTIME, WE HAVE PROVIDED ZELLI WITH SUMMARY OF CRITERIA USED IN OUR RECOGNITION PRACTICE AND STRESSED LACK OF POLITICAL CONTENT IN OUR POLICY. ZELLI EXPRESSED HOPE U.S. WOULD "COORDINATE" ITS RECOGNITION ACTION WITH IRAN AND PAKISTAN.

I HAVE JUST SEEN REF B WHICH INDICATES THAT AMB ELIOT HAS DISCUSSED RECOGNITION WITH OECD REPS IN KABUL BUT NOT RPT NOT WITH REPS OF IRAN AND PAKISTAN. WHILE I AGREE WITH VALIDITY OF CONCERTING OUR ACTION WITH OECD NATIONS, IT SEEMS TO ME THAT IRAN AND PAKISTAN ARE THE NATIONS MOST LIKELY TO BE SENSITIVE TO "UNSEEMLY HASTE" ON OUR PART.

OUR OWN READINGOF IRANIAN INTENTIONS SUGGESTS THEY WILL PROBABLY AGREE TO RECOGNITION OF THE NEW REGIME WITHOUT INTERPOSITION OF POLITICAL CONDITIONS. HOWEVER, BECAUSE OF CIRCUMSTANCES DESCRIBED IN FIRST PARAGRAPH THIS MESSAGE, IT IS DBOUBTFUL THEY WILL BE PREPARED TO ACT BY MAY 3, WHEN THE OECD REPS IN KABUL HAVE SCHEDULED THEIR NEXT MEETING ON THIS SUBJECT.

I APPRECIATE THE ADMINISTRATIVE AND OTHER PROBLEMS WHICH THE OECD REPS ANTICIPATE IF THEIR POSITIVE ACTION IS UNDULY DELAYED. HOWEVER, IT SEEMS PROBABLE THEY WILL ENCOUNTER MOST OF THOSE PROBLEMS NO MATTER HOW SOON THEY ACT AND IT IS DOUBTFUL THE NEW REGIME EXPECTS RECOGNIZTION BY SUCH AN EARLY DATE AS MAY 4.

I THEREFORE STRONGLY RECOMMEND THAT DEPT DELAY ACTION ON RECOGNITION OF NEW REGIME UNTIL AMB HUMMEL AND I CAN HAVE A DECENT INTERVAL FOR SUBSTANTIVE CONSULTATIONS WITH THE IRANIANS AND THE PAKISTANIS. IF EITHER OR BOTH OF THESE GOVERNMENTS DECIDE TO RESORT TO UNCONSCIONABLE DILATORY POLICIES, WE COULD, IN THAT UNLIKELY EVENT, BREAK RANKS WITH THEM AND ACT FIRST. IT ALSO SEEMS TO ME THAT THE OECD REPS, MOST OF WHOM HAVE PRECIOUS LITTLE INTERESTS TO DEFEND IN AFGHANISTAN, COULD AFFORD A REASONABLE DELAY.
EVEN IF SOME OF THEM MIGHT WISH TO ACT MORE PRECIPITOUSLY, I FEEL WE CAN AFFORD TO LET THEM GO AHEAD WITHOUT US AND RISK NO GREAT LOSS OF PRINCIPLE.

IN SHORT, IT SEEMS CLEAR THAT ALL OF US (WITH POSSIBLE EXCEPTION OF PEKING) ARE GOING ATO RECOGNIZE THE NEW REGIME IN THE NEAR FUTURE ANYWAY. WE HAVE FAR MORE TO GAIN BY MAKING A DELIBERATE AND SERIOUS EFFORT TO CONSULT WITH IRAN AND PAKISTAN THAN WE HAVE TO LOSE IF THIS ACTION CAUSES US A FEW DAYS' DELAY IN THE DELIVERY OF OUR DIPLOMATIC NOTE. CONSEQUENTLY, IF THE DEPT APPROVES THE TEXT OF KABUL'S DRAFT NOTE, I WOULD LIKE AUTHORIZATION TO DISCUSS IT WITH THE IRANIAN OFFICIALS (WHILE AMB HUMMEL DISCUSSES IT IN ISLAMABAD) WITHOUT RPT WITHOUT THE DEADLINE OF A SPECIFIC DATE SCHEDULED FOR ITS DELIVERY.
WE COULD INDICATE THAT WE WOULD BE PREPARED TO DELIVER IT SOONEST IF IRAN AND PAKISTAN CONCUR.

IN COURSE OF GENERAL RASTIKHIZ PARTY CAMPAIGN AGAINST DISSIDENTS, PARTY WING LEADER HUSHANG ANSARY HAS BEEN TRAVELING IN SOUTHERN IRAN TO RALLY LOCAL PARTY LEADERS IN SUPPORT OF THE GOVERNMENT. HE RETURNED TO TEHRAN OVER THE WEEKEND. I SAW HIM EVENING APRIL 30 AND DISCUSSED WITH HIM THE GENERAL TENOR OF HIS TOUR.

ANSARY SAID THAT, WHEN HE ARRIVED IN ISFAHAN, THE LOCAL LEADERSHIP HAD ASSEMBLED ABOUT ONE THOUSAND CADRE TO MEET WITH HIM. SINCE HE HAD EXPECTED A LEADERSHIP GROUP OF ABOUT FIFTY, THIS GATHERING HAD RATHER TAKEN HIM ABACK. HE SAID HE FOUND THE PARTY CADRE INTENT UPON PHYSICAL ACTION TO DISCOURAGE THE DISSIDENTS AND IT TOOK HIM NEARLY FIVE HOURS TO CONVICE THEM THAT DISCUSSION AND PERSUASION WERE MORE EFFECTIVE FORMS OF ACTION THAN DEMONSTRATIONS AND CONFRONTATIONS.

ANSARY BLAMED THE FEISTY MOOD OF THE PARTY FAITHFUL ON THE STATEMENT WHICH HAD BEEN MADE BY RIVAL WING LEADER MADJIDI IN WHICH THE LATTER HAD CALLED FOR MORE DIRECT PHYSICAL ACTION AGAINST DISSIDENTS. ANSARY REPEATED HIS PREVIOUSLY STATED THEMES THAT ARRESTS AND CROWD CONTROL WERE THE FUNCTION OF THE POLICE. THE PARTY SHOULD SEEK TO USE ITS POWERS TO PERSUADE DISSIDENTS AGAINST DEMONSTATIONS AND VIOLENCE.

I THEN LAUNCHED INTO THE DISCOURSE IF HAVE ALSO DELIVERED TO SEVERAL OTHER INFLUENTIAL IRANIANS RECENTLY ABOUT THE NAGATIVE CONSEQUENCES OF THE HEAVY-HANDED ACTION WHICH "UNKNOW GROUPS" HAVE TAKEN AGAINST SOME OF THE OLD NATIONAL FRONT POLITICIANS AND AGAINST STUDENT GROUPS. WHILE DISCLAIMING ANY KNOWLEDGE OF WHOSE THESE GROUPS WERE, ANSARY REACTED SOMEWHAT DEFENSIVELY, SAYING THAT THESE WERE INTERNAL IRANIAN MATTERS WHICH SHOULD BE LEFT TO IRANIAN AUTHORITIES TO HANDLE. HE SUBSEQUENTLY RELAXED HIS DEFENSES SOMEWHAT TO SAY THAT THESE ACTIONS WERE CONTRARY TO HIS GENERAL PRINCIPLES AND HE WAS TRYING TO AVERT THEM.

COMMENT: WHILE MOST OF THE WESTERNIZED IRANAIN LEADERS ARE EMBARRASSED BY THE RECENT BOMBINGS AND BEATINGS DIRECTED AGAINST DISSIDENTS, THEY SEEM TO ASSUME THAT THESE ACTIONS HAVE OFFICIAL SANCTION AND ARE THEREFORE RELUCTANT TO DO MORE THAN EXPRESS THEIR PRIVATE CLUCKING SYMPATHY.
MFA INFORMS US IRANIAN SIDE OF BORDER WITH AFGHANISTAN IS STILL OPEN AS USUAL. AFGHAN SIDE APPEARS TO BE SHOWING MORE RESTRAINT THAN PRIOR TO COUP, WITH ONLY A FEW PEOPLE CROSSING.

1978TEHRAN04122.subject: FURTHER PRESS REACTION TO AFGHAN COUP

segments.text: LOCAL PRESS CONTINUED BANNER HEADLINES MAY FIRST WITH AFGHAN LEADERSHIP BEING CLEARLY IDENTIFIED--I.E. "KABUL'S COMMUNIST LEADER", "COMMUNIST NAMED AFGHAN PRESIDENT"-AS CONFIRMING "WORST FEARS OF THE WEST". LENGTHY STORIES IN FOREIGN LANGUAGE AND PERSIAN PRESS TAKEN FROM VAIOUS NES SERVICES. "JOUNAL DE TEHRAN" MAY FIRST REPRINTS APRIL 29 EDITORIAL FROM PARTY DAILY "RASTAKHIZ" WHICH OPINED THAT DAOUD WAS HIMSELF THE VICTIM OF INSECURITY WHICH HE BROUGHT ABOUT BY HIS COUP D'ETAT AGAINST THE FORMER KING.

EDITORIAL ALLEGES THAT EX-KING WAS PROCEEDING TO MAKE STRUCTURAL REFORMS PRIOR TO HIS OVERTHROW BY DAOUD WHO WAS DEPENDENT ON CONSERVATIVE INFLUENTIAL ELEMENTS, INCLUDING THE TRIBES, WHO WERE AN OBSTACLE AGAINST REFORM, PARTICULARLY IN THE AGRARIAN SECTOR. IN ADDITION, ACCORDING TO "RASTAKHIZ," DAOUD DID NOT HAVE THE RESPECT AND POLITICAL INFLUENCE OF THE EX-KING WITH THE AFGHAN PEOPLE.

WELL-CONNECTED JOURNALIST AMIR TAHERI AHD LONG PIECE IN PERSIAN LANGUAGE "KAYHAN" APRIL 30, ENTITLED: "WILL AFGHANISTAN BECOME A SOVIET SATELLITE?" CONSIDERING THE STRONG NATIONALIST FEELINGS IN AFGHANISTAN." REGARDING FUTURE SOVIET ACTION, TAHERI SPECULATES THAT DIRECT INTERFERENCE WOULD LIKELY DRAW STRONG REACTION FROM CHINA AND PAKISTAN. TAHERI NOTES THAT THE U.S.

CONGRESS WITH ITS GREATER VOICE IN FOREIGN POLICY (THAN IN 1950'S AND 1960'S) LEAVES THE WHITE HOUSE WITH "LITTLE AUTHORITY TO RESORT TO QUICK ACTION IN SUCH CASES, WHETHER OPENLY OR SECRETLY, AS TESTED IN ANGOLA AND THE HORN OF AFRICA." ON THE OTHER HAND, TAHERI INTERESTINGLY SPECULATES THAT PEOPLE LIVING IN SOVIET CENTRAL ASIA ARE ETHNICALLY SIMILARY TO AFGHANIS AND INFILTRATION BY SOVIETS WOULD "HARDLY SEEM DIFFICULT", PRECLUDING THE NECESSITY FOR INDIRECT FORCES SUCH AS "CUBAN VOLUNTEERS," A GROWING CONCERN HERE.
COMMENT: FOLLOWING SEVERAL DAYS OF "WAIT AND SEE" ATTITUDE TOWARD DEVELOPMENTS, THE IRANIAN PRESS TODAY HAS MINCED NO WORDS IN LABELLING THE NEW REGIME BOTH COMMUNIST AND PRO-SOVIET.

I MET WITH ACTING FOREIGN MINISTER ZELLI AT NOON MAY 2 TO REVIEW SITUATION ON RECOGNIZING NEW AFGHANISTAN REGIME. I GAVE HIM TEXT OF NOTE PROPOSED IN REF C, POINTING OUT THAT IT WAS AMB ELIOT'S SUGGESTION WHICH HAD NOT YET BEEN APPROVED BY WASHINGTON.
I SAID THAT DEPARTMENT HAD INDICATED IT WAS INCLINED TO GO ALONG WITH ELIOT'S PROPOSAL AND WOULD LIKE VIEWS OF GOVERNMENTS OF IRAN AND PAKISTAN. I DID NOT RPT NOT MENTION TIMETABLE CONTAINED REF C.

ZELLI, WITH HIS USUAL CAUTION, SAID HE HAD NO RPT NO FORMAL IRANIAN REACTION AT THIS TIME. HE HAD DISCUSSED MATTER BY PHONE WITH COURT MINISTER HOVEYDA, WHO IS IN SHIRAZ WITH THE SHAH. HOEVYDA SAID SHAH HAD DECIDED TO DELAY DECISION UNTIL HE COULD TALK WITH FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY, WHO ARRIVED IN TEHRAN LAST NIGHT AND LEFT THIS MORNING FOR SHIRAZ IN COMPANY OF VISITING ITALIAN FOREIGN MINISTER. ZELLI THEREFORE HOPED TO HAVE FURTHER GUIDANCE LATER TODAY.

IN GIVING HIS PERSONAL ASSESSMENT OF SITUATION, ZELLI SAID HE FELT NEW REGIME WAS CURRENTLY IN EFFECTIVE CONTROL OF COUNTRY. HE REGARDED ITS ORIENTATION AS TOTALLY PRO-SOVIET AND EXPECTED A GENERAL DETERIORIATION OF AFGHAN RELATIONS WITH IRAN. IN RECONSTRUCTING EVENTS, HE FELT BLAME FOR CURRENT TRAGEDY HAD TO BE PLACED ON DAOUD, WHO HAD FAILED TO DELIVER ON THE PROMISES OF HIS OWN REVOLUTION, AND WHO THEREFORE HAD CREATED THE DISSATISFACTION WHICH THE COMMUNISTS HAD EXPLOITED. IN THE LONG RUN, HOWEVER, ZELLI WONDERED WHETHER THIS "HANDFUL OF COMMUNISTS IN KABUL" COULD SUCCEED IN CONTROLLING THE CONSERVATIVE, RELIGIOUS TRIBAL PEOPLE.
HE THOUGHT THEY WOULD HAVE TO BE VERY CAREFUL AND VERY CLEVER IF THEY ARE TO SUCCEED.

COMMENT: I ASSUME WE WILL HAVE POSITIVE IRANIAN VIEW ON RECOGNITION WITHIN THE NEXT DAY OR SO. HOWEVER, IT MAY NOT COME IN TIME FOR MAY 3 MEETING SCHEDULED IN KABUL OR FOR MAY 4 DELIVERY OF OUR NOTE. I THEREFORE CONTINUE TO RECOMMEND THAT WE DELAY OUR TIMETABLE BRIEFLY UNTIL THE IRANIANS GET THEIR ACT TOGETHER. IT WOULD SEEM MOST INAPPROPRIATE, NOW THAT WE HAVE CONSULTED THEM IN ACCORDANCE REF A, FOR US TO MOVE AHEAD BEFORE WE HAVE THEIR REACTION.

1978TEHRAN04152.subject: GOI CONCERN OVER FOREIGN INFLUENCE IN DOMESTIC AFFAIRS

segments.text: SUMMARY: IRANIAN GOVERNEMENT SPOKESMEN MOST NOTABLY AND RECENTLY PRIME MINISTER HAVE REEMPHASIZED THEME OF UNSAVORY FOREIGN INFLUENCE FIRST HEARD IMMEDIATELY FOLLOWING FEB18 TABRIZ RIOTS. CURRENT STATEMENTS STRESS DANGER OF IDEOLOGICAL "IMPERIALISM" FOR IRAN AND CONTAIN DEFINITE ANTI-WEST AS WELL AS ANIT-COMMUNIST TINGE. EMBASSY SPECULATES GOI MAY BE RETURNING TO FOREIGN DANGERS THEME AT LEAST PARTLY AS A WAY OF FINESSING EMERGENT TENSIONS OF AND PROBLEMS WITH DOMESTIC LIBERALIZATION BY LAYING BLAME TO EXTERNAL INFLUENCES, NOT GOI'S WON ACTIONS. END SUMMARY.

OVER PAST TWO WEEKS SENIOR RESURGENCE PARTY FUNCTIONARIES HAVE RETURNED TO THEME OF DANGERS POSED TO IRAN BY "RED AND BLACK" IMPERIALISM. SHAH REFERRED TO THIS IN IMMEDIATE POST-TABRIZ RIOT PERIOD (REF A), FOLLOWING WHICH EMPHASIS WAS PLACED ON PROVINCIAL GOVERNEMENT'S ADMINISTRATIVE FAILINGS FOR SHORT TIME. SHARPTEST USE OF THIS TECHNIQUE HAS BEEN BY RESURGENCE PARTY DEPUTY SECRETARY GENERAL REZA AMELI ON SEVERAL OCCASIONS IN PROVINCIAL SPEECHES.

MOST AUTHORITATIVE STATEMENT OF THIS VIEW WAS DELIVERED BY PRIME MINISTER ON APRIL 30 TO GRADUATES OF AIR FORCE COMMAND AND STAFF COLLEGE IN TEHRAN. (MOST COMPREHENSIVE AND BEST NEWS COVERAGE BEING POUCHED DEPT.) AFTER LISTING "HIGHLIGHTS" OF SHAH'S GUIDELINES FOR CONTEMPORARY MAN "TO LIVE WITH DIGNITY AND FREEDOM AT THE INTERNATIONAL AND NATIONAL LEVELS," PRIME MINISTER PAINTED TWO CONTRASTING FORMS OF NEOCOLONIALISM.

FIRST IS THAT PRACTICED BY WESTERN SOCIETIES STEMMING FROM THEIR SYSTEM OF "EXPLOITATION OF ONE INDIVIDUAL BY ANOTHER". THESE SOCIETIES STILL SUFFER FROM RACIAL DISCRIMINATION AND CONTAIN LARGE CAPITALIST CONSPIRACIES ON AN INTERNATIONAL SCALE WHICH DOMINATE OTHER NATIONS' WEALTH, DEPRIVING THIRD WORLD NATIONS OF "REQUIREMENTS OF LIFE" BUT LEAVING THEM DEPENDENT ON ADVANCED NATIONS FOR SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGYM "THESE INEQUITIES CAUSE CORRUPTION, SABOTAGE, TERRORISM AND PLOTS TO DISRUPT AND CAUSE ANXIETY IN SOCIETIES."

SECOND FORM OF IMPERIALISM IS THAT OF NEW CLASS OF EXPLOITERS WHO CRITICIZE WESTERN INEQUITIES BUT HAVE ESTABLISHED SOCIETIES WHERE "INDIVIDUALS ARE DEPRIVED OF THEIR MOST BASIC FREEDOMS AND ARE BROUGHT UP WITH A SENSE OF HATE AGAINST THE WORLD. THESE ARE TOTALITARIAN SYSTEMS USING THE NAME OF FREEDOM IN AN EFFORT TO DOMINATE THE WORLD." THEY FOSTER "EVERY TYPE OF AGITATION, REBELLION AND TERRORISM", CREATING ANTAGONISTIC OPPOSING GROUPS TO DIVIDE PEOPLE, INSPIRING "RELIGIOUS AND SECTARIAN DIFFERENCES AIRMED AT DAMAGING NATIONAL UNITY".

PRIME MINISTER CONCLUDES THAT IN CONTEMPORARY WORLD, THOSE SEEKING DOMINATION, "WHETHER THEY BE FROM EAST OR WEST, RED OR BLACK", WANT TO CONTROL OTHER COUNTRIES, SECURITY SO THEY CAN DESTROY A COUNTRY WHENEVER THEY WISH.

EMBASSY COMMENT: GOI MAY BE RETURNING TO FOREIGN DANGER THEME BECAUSE IT IS EASIER (AND TRADITIONALLY PERSIAN) TO ASCRIBE PROBLEMS TO EVIL FOREIGN INFLUENCE THAN TO DEAL HEAD-ON WITH DOMESTIC CAUSES. WHILE IRANIANS FEAR SOVIET SUBVERSION, FROM AN EMOTIONAL AND HITORICAL POINT OF VIEW THEY CAN ASO GET WORKED UP AGAINST WESTERN IDEAS (AND OIL COMPANIES).

1978TEHRAN04157.subject: CONTACTS WITH LEADERS OF ISLAMIC COMMUNITY

segments.text: REFTEL REPORTED THE NERVOUSNESS DISPLAYED BY HUSHANG ANSARY WHEN I INFORMED HIM I EXPECTED TO MEET WITH SOME ISLAMIC LEADERS. I WAS AMUSED MAY 2 TO RECEIVE ANOTHER CALL FROM ANSARY SAYING THAT HE HAD INFORMED THE SHAH ABOUT OUR CONVERSATION.

ANSARY SAID SHAH "OF COURSE" WOULD HAVE NO RPT NO OBJECTION IF I MET WITH ISLAMIC PERSONALITIES. SHAH THEN REPORTEDLY WENT ON TO SAY THAT HE WAS FULLY CONFIDENT I WOULD NOT USE THESE CONTACTS THE WAY THE BRITISH HAD IN 1907. I TOLD ANSARY I HAD SPENT THIRTY YEARS LEARNING HOW TO AVOID BEING COMPROMISED.
NOT A SPARROW FALLS....*
AS NOTED OUR REFTEL, WE QUOTED LOCAL PRESS COMMENTARY WHICH WE WILL ATTEMPT TO CLARIFY WITH MFA'S KAZEMI WHEN HE RETURNS FROM GENEVA LATER THIS MONTH.

1978TEHRAN04167.subject: RECOGNITION OF NEW REGIME IN AFGHANISTAN

segments.text: INCLUDING OUR GENERAL POLICY ON RECOGNITION, AND FOUND THAT HE WAS FULLY BRIEFED.

I THEN TOLD HIM (A) THAT DEPARTMENT HAD APPROVED TEXT OF PROPOSED NOTE WHICH I HAD GIVEN ZELLI YESTERDAY AND (B) THAT WE WISHED TO DELIVER THAT NOTE MAY 4 OR MAY 5. I REITERATED OUR REQUEST FOR IRAN'S VIEWS.

KHALATBARY THANKED ME FOR MY INFORMATION. HE THEN ASKED WHETHER WE HAD HEARD FROM PAKISTAN. IT WAS CLEAR FROM THE TENOR OF THE QUESTION THAT SHANAWAZ HAD APPROACHED GOI ON "COORDINATION" PROPOSAL CITED REF B.) I CONFIRMED SUBSTANCE OF REF B, BUT SAID WASHINGTON HAD INDICATED THAT WE WISHED MOVE MAY 4 OR MAY 5.
KHALATBARY SAID HE WOULD CONVEY MY LATEST INFORMATION DIRECTLY TO THE SHAH (WHO IS MOVING THIS MORNING FROM SHIRAZ TO KISH ISLAND) AND WOULD BE BACK TO ME WHEN HE HAD AN OFFICIAL POSITION.
IF YOU PASS INFO CONTAINED REFTEL TO AMBASSADOR MALIKYAN, PLEASE ALSO CONVEY CONDOLENCES FROM MARIE AND ME AND FROM RHODA AND JACK MIKLOS ON HIS FAMILY'S TRAGEDY.

1978TEHRAN04213.subject: INDIAN ASSESSMENT OF SITUATION IN AFGHANISTAN

segments.text: INDIAN CHARGE SAHDEV CAME TO SEE POLCOUNS MORNING MAY 3 ON WHAT WAS ESSENTIALLY A FISHING EXPEDITION. HE HAS HAD NOT EVEN A PRELIMINARY ASSESSMENT OF SITUATION IN AFGHANISTAN FROM NEW DELHI, ALTHOUGH SUCH AN ASSESSMENT IS USUAL. HE EXPLAINED INDIAN RECOGNITION IN TERMS OF NORMAL INDIAN PROCEDURE (REF B) THOUGH EXPRESSING REGRET IT WAS LUMPED IN THE COMPANY IT WAS.

HE WAS INTERESTED IN IRANIAN REACTIONS SINCE HIS EMBASSY HAS HAD NO SUBSTANTIVE CONTACTS WITH MFA FOLLOWING THE COUP. POLCOUNS EXPLAINED IRANIAN MFA VIEWS ARE VERY TENTATIVE IN ABSENCE OF DEFINITIVE INSTRUCTIONS FROM THE SHAH BUT HE SUGGESTED PROBABILITY THAT IRAN WILL BE WATCHING INDIAN REACTION CAREFULLY IN THE IMMEDIATE FUTURE AND MIGHT EVENTUALLY SEEK INDIAN COOPERATION IN ACTIVELY DISCOURAGING ANY AGGRESSIVE AFGHAN MOVES TOWARD PAKISTAN. SAHDEV READILY AGREED, THOUGH NOTING THAT ANY INDIAN ACTIVITY CONCERNING PAKISTAN WOULD BE SUSPECT IN PAKISTANI EYES, EVEN IF ITS AIM WAS TO DISCOURAGE AGGRESSIVE INTENTIONS ON AFGHAN SIDE.

IN THIS SENSE, HE THOUGHT HIS GOVERNMENT WOULD BE ON THE HORNS OF A DILEMMA, DAMED IF IT DID AND DAMNED IF IT DIDN'T, IN PAKISTANI EYES. HE VOLUNTEERED THAT SHAH MUST BE FEELING SURROUNDED NOW THAT AFGHANISTAN APPEARS TO HAVE GONE OVER TO THE SOVIET-IRAQI SIDE.

SAHDEV SAID INDIANS HAD "KNOWN ABOUT" THE "GROUP" OF OFFICERS FOR SOME TIME BUT HAD NOT EXPECTED, ANYMORE THAN ANYONE ELSE, THAT THEY WOULD ACT SO SOON. HE SUPPOSED DAOUD'S ARREST OF THE COMMUNIST LEADERS PERCIPITATED THEIR MOVE. HE HAD NOTHING TO OFFER RE POSSIBLE SOVIET COLLUSION. HE WAS ALSO VAGUE WHEN POLCOUNS PROBED AS TO EXACTLY IN WHAT WAY INDIANS "KNEW" OF THIS "GROUP".

SAHDEV ASSERTED THAT CONTINUED INTEGRITY OF PAKISTAN IS HIGHLY DESIRABLE FROM INDIAN POINT OF VIEW AS WELL AS IRANIAN. INDIA WOULD HAVE LITTLE TO GAIN AND PERHAPS MUCH TO LOSE THROUGH AREA INSTABILITY AS A RESULT OF PAKISTAN BREAKUP. BESIDES, WHAT WOULD BE THE ADVANTAGE OF ABSORBING MORE MINORITY, PROBABLY HOSTILE, POPULATIONS? (WE ASSUME THIS IS A POINT INDIANS REGULARLY MAKE TO IRANIANS.)
COMMENT: MAIN REASON WE REPORT THIS CONVERSATION IS TO ESTABLISH THAT INDIAN MFA HAS APPARENTLY NOT YET SENT ITS USUAL PRELIMINARY GUIDANCE TO ITS EMBASSIES.

I TELEPHONED KHALATBARY MORNING MAY 4 TO GIVE HIM GIST OF REFTEL AND TO SAY THAT WE NOW PLANNED TO DELIVER OUR NOTE IN KABUL ON MAY 6. I POINTED OUT THAT WE HAVE BEEN WAITING FOUR DAYS FOR GOI VIEWS AND ASKED WHETHER KHALATBARY HAD ANY REACTION TO CONVERY.
WITH SOME EMBARRASSMENT, KHALATBARY SAID HE WAS STILL WITHOUT GUIDANCE. HE UNDERTOOK, HOWEVER, TO "TAKE CONTACT" WITH SHAH, WHO IS STILL AT KISH, AND GIVE ME AN ANSER EARLY THIS AFTERNOON.

AT 1300, HE TELEPHONED TO SAY THAT IRAN WILL ALSO INSTRUCT ITS EMBASSY IN KABUL TO DELIVER ITS RECOGNITION NOTE ON SATURDAY, MAY 6. I SAID THAT PAKISTAN HAD AGREED TO DO THE SAME AND THAT IT THUS APPEARED THERE WOULD BE A FAIRLY SOLID PHALANX ON THAT DAY. KHALATBARY SAID HE THOUGHT THAT FACT WOULD HAVE A CERTAIN SIGNIFICANCE.
I APPREICATE FORBEARANCE OF DEPARTMENT AND KABUL IN THIS MINOR DELAY, WHICH HAS PERMITTED SENSE OF CONSULTATION WITH THE IRANIANS AT A RATHER PAINFUL JUNCTURE OF THEIR DIPLOMACY.

1978TEHRAN04256.subject: IRANIAN ATTITUDE TOWARD NEW AFGHAN GOVERNEMENT

segments.text: SEVERAL EDITORIALS IN TEHRAN PRESS REFER TO STATEMENT MADE TO MAJLES (PARLIAMENT) BY MINSTATE FOR PARLIAMENTARY AFFAIRS RAMBOD MAY 2 TO THE EFFECT THAT GOI POLICY REMAINS, AS ALWAYS, TO REFREAIN FROM INTERFERENCE IN THE INTERNAL AFFAIRS OF OTHER COUNTRIES AND TO SEEK MUTAULLY BENEFICIAL TIES WITH ALL ITS NEIGHBORS.

STATEMENT WENT ON TO SAY THAT AFGHANISTAN NO LESS THAN IRAN HAS AN INTEREST IN THE STABILITY AND ORDERLY DEVELOPMENT OF THIS REGION, ALONG WHICH THE TWO COUNTRIES SHARE A LONG BORDER. BESIDES, THE TWO COUNTRIES ARE LINKED BY SHARED HISTORY, RELIGION, CULTURE, AND LANGUAGE, AND THESE CONSIDERATIONS HAVE ALWAYS ACTIVATED IRANIANS TO TAKE SATISFACATION IN A PROSPEROUS, STRONG, AND INDEDPENDENT AFGHANISTAN.
THE STATEMENT AND EDITORIALS NOTED THAT IRAN WILL BE WATCHING DEVELOPMENTS CAREFULLY WITH THESE PRINCIPLES IN MIND.

THE EDITORIALS WOULD HARDLY HAVE GIVEN SUCH WIDE PLAY TO RAMBOD'S WORDS WITHOUT OFFICIAL SANCTION. THEY CAN BE TAKEN REASONABLY AUTHORITATIVE INDICATIONS OF GOI PUBLIC POLICY AND GOI HOPES FROM THE NEW AFGHAN GOVERNEMENT. FOR THE TIME BEING.

TEHRAN 4120 SUMMARY: BUTLER HAD POSITIVE VISIT WITH SHAH AND MET REPRESENTATIVES OF MAJOR IRANIAN GROUPS CONVERNED WITH HUMAN RIGHTS METIONED IN REF A. HE TOLD SHAH THAT CONTINUATION OF VIOLENCE AGAINST DISSIDENTS BY "UNIDENTIFIED HOODLUMS" WOULD ENDANGER INTERNATIONAL COMMISSION OF JURISTS'S (ICJ) DIALOG WITH IRAN. BUTLER SPECIFICALLY URGED EMBASSY TO HELP OUT IRANIAN GROUPS STRIVING FOR GREATER PUBLIC ROLE AND INDICATED INTENT TO STIMULATE BAR ASSOCIATION INTEREST IN BEATINGS AND BOMBING OF LAWYERS. END SUMMARY.

BUTLER VISIT USEFUL AND MORE POSITIVE THAN EITHER BUTLER OR EMBASSY HAD EXPECTED. ALTHOUGH SCHEDULE CHANGED AS RESULT OF SHAH'S TRIP TO SOUTHERN IRAN, BUTLER MET WITH SHAH IN SHIRAZ AND WAS ABLE TO SEE ALL THREE FOREIGN JOURNALISTS WHO HAVE REGULARLY COVERED IRAN. UPON HIS RETURN TO TEHRAN, HE SAW REPRESENTATIVES OF IRANIAN LAWYER'S ASSOCIATION, IRANIAN WRITER'S ASSOCIATION, AND SEVERAL LAWYERS WHO HAVE BEEN BEATEN OR WHOSE HOUSES HAVE BEEN BOMBED RECENTLY.

CENTERPIECE OF VISIT WAS BUTLER'S LENGTHY DISCUSSION OF HIS MEMORANDUM WITH SHAH MAY 2. FOLLOWING REPORT OF MEETING IS BASED ON BUTLER PRESENTATION TO AMBASSADOR AND EMBOFFS MORNING MAY 3. BUTLER NOTED MEETING BEGAN ON POSITIVE NOTE AND STAYED THERE. COURT MINISTER HOVEYDA WAS PRESENT AND TOOK EXTENSIVE NOTES. BUTLER DESCRIBED DISCUSSION UNDER SEVERAL MAJOR HEADINGS

CIVILIAN JURISDICTION --SHAH INDICATED HE INTENDED TO CONTINUE REFERRING DISSIDENCE CASES TO CIVILIAN COURTS, EXCEPT IN CASES OF DIRECT THREAT TO SAFEY OF STATE. BUTLER CONGRATULATED HIM ON THIS CHANGE IN IRANIAN POLICY AND URGED SHAH TO KEEP IT UP. BUTLER BROUGHT UP PROBLEM OF SPECIAL COURT OF CASSATION TO TRY STATE SECURITY CASES (RECOMMENDATION MADE BY BUTLER IN 1977 WHICH WOULD BE A COURT WITH COMZINED MILITARY AND CVIILIAN JUDGES (ALONG FRENCH LINE). SHAH SQAID HE STILL HAD RESERVATIONS ABOUT THIS AND SINCE VIRTUALLY ALL PRISONERS WERE NOW GOING BEFORE CIVILIAN COURTS, HE WAS NOT READY TO CHANGE.

RIGHT TO COUNSEL: MILITARY COURTS--BUTLER BROUGHT UP THE NEED FOR LAWYERS TO BE APPROVED BY MILITARY AUTHORITIES BEFORE APPEARING IN MILITARY COURT. SHAH SAID HE WAS UNAWARE OF THIS AND ORDERED COURT MINISTER HOVEYDA TO ELIMINATE IT. SIMILARLY, REGARDING REQUIREMENT FOR LAWYERS PRACTICING BEFORE MILITARY COURT TO TAKE TWO FREE CASES FOR EACH FEE CASE, SHAH "WAS SHOCKED" (IN BUTLER'S WORDS), AND ORDERED HOVEYDA TO CORRECT IT IMMEDIATELY. (EMBASSY COMMENT: SHAH'S PROTESTATIONS OF IGNORANCE SOMETHING LESS THAN CONVINCING. CORRECTION OF SITUATION IS LIKELY TO REQUIRE ADDITIONAL LEGISLATION IN PARLIAMENT. IT IS NOTEWORTHY, HOWEVER, THAT SHAH READILY ACCEPTED BUTLER SUGGESTIONS.

THIS TENDS TO CONFIRM STORIES EMBASSY HAS HEARD THAT JUDICIAL REFORM COMMISSIONS HAVE BEEN MAKING RECOMMENDATIONS FOR LIBERALIZATION.) WITH RESPECT TO LIMITATION OF NUMBERS OF LAWYERS IN MILITARY COURT CASES, SHAH INDICATED DESIRE TO KEEP SOME SORT OF LIMIT TO PREVENT IRRELEVENT FILIBUSTERING. HE THOUGHT EACH DEFENDANT SHOULD BE LIMITED TO JUST ONE LAWYERWN BUT NOT TO LESS THAN THAT.

SAVAK-SHAH SAID, FOR INTERNAL REASONS, HE DOES NOT WANT TO "DISTURB" PRESENT NATIONAL SECURITY LAW BY TRYING TO AMEND IT. WITH RESPECT TO PROBLEM OF SAVAK OFFICERS SERVING AS EXAMINING MAGISTRATES, HOWEVER, SHAH WAS READY TO GIVE ASSURANCES THAT ANY SAVAK CASE WILL GO BEFORE A MALISTRATIE WHO IS NOT RPT NOT A SAVAK OFFICER WITHIN 48 HOURS. SHAH DIRECTED HOVEYDA TO SEND BUTLER A LETTER CONFIRMING THIS.

IN RESPONSE TO EMBOFF QUESTION AS TO WHETHER THIS 48-HOUR PERIOD BEGAN WITH INITIAL ARREST OR AT SOME SUBSEQUENT TIME IN INVESTIGATION, BUTLER SAID THERE WAS STILL SOME AMBIGUITY ON THIS POINT, WHICH HE HOPED GOI WOULD MOVE TO CLEAR UP. ------------------031517 060340Z /73 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 8149 INFO AMEMBASSY LONDON SECTION 2 OF 3 TEHRAN 4257 LIMDIS

RIGHT TO COUNSEL: MAGISTRATE TAGE-SHAH AND BUTLER DISCUSSED ARRESTEES NOT HAVING COUNSEL AT STAGE OF INITIAL INTERROGATION AND APPEARANCE BEFORE "JUGE D'INSTRUCTION". HOVEYDA SAID CHANGE WAS UNDER CONSIDERATION, BUT THERE WERE PROBLEMS IN GETTING LAWYERS INVOLVED AT THE VERY BEGINNING WHEN IT WAS NOT CLEAR THAT THERE WAS A CASE OR NOT. BUTLER PRESSED, AND SHAH SAID MATTER WAS BEING STUDIED BY JUDICIAL COMMITTEE, AND HE WOULD LOOK INTO IT PERSONALLY. BUTLER HAD IMPRESSION HAH WAS FAVORABLY DISPOSED TO DOING SOMETHING BUT WANTED IT WORKED OUT BY JUDICIEARY FIRST.

AMNESTY FOR POLITICAL PRISONERS--SHAH SAID THERE REMAINED ABOUT 2,000 PRISONERS IN JAIL FOR CRIMES WHICH WERE POLITICALLY RELATED IN SOME WAY (AS OPPOSED TO ABOUT 3,000 AT LAST BUTLER VISIT) . SHAH STATED HE PLANNED TO USE NEW AMNESTY LAW OF FEBRUARY 1978 TO RELEASE OTHERS AND PROMISED BUTLER A LIST OF AMNESTY CASES.

HARASSMENT OF LAWYERS-BUTLER SAID HE HAD HEARD LAWYERS WHO SIGNED PETITION FOR INDEDENDENT JUDICIARY IN FALL OF 1977 HAD BEEN DENIED GOVERNEMENT WORK. HOVEYDA INTERJECTED THAT HE HAD "'JUST THAT MORNING" CHECKED ON THI AND IT WAS NOT TRUE. BUTLER RESPECTFULLY DISAGREED AND SUGGESTED COURT MINISTER CHECK SOME MORE. SHAH THEN ASKED, "DON'T WE HAVE THE RIGHT TO HIRE OUR FRIENDS?" BUT BUTLER REPLIED YES, IF FUNCTION REQUIRES ALLEGIANCE OF LAWYER CONCERNED, BUT IF IT IS QUESTION OF ROUTINE LEGAL JOBS, THIS BAN SMACKS OF INTIMIDATION AND WOULD CAUSE PROBLEMS.

(AMBASSADOR NOTED THAT SHAH HAD TOLD HIM PEOPLE COULD DISAGREE BUT COULD NOT ATTACK BASIC INSTITUTIONS OF REGIME-MONARCH, CONSTITUTION AND SHAHPEOPLE REVOLUTION. AMBASSADOR SUGGESTING BUTLER MIGHT AT SOME TIME MAKE PKOINT THATTHESE LAWYERS AREN'T REALLY ATTACKING THE MONARCHY, THEY JUST WANT A PIECE OF THE ACTION.)

POLITICAL HARASSMENT--BUTLER OPENED BY COMMENTING THAT IRAN HAD MADE SOME TREMENDOUS ACCOMPLISHMENTS IN PAST 15 MONTHS WHICH WERE GOOD FOR THE COUNTRY'S PRESTIGE AND IMAGE ABROAD. THESE WERE SERIOUSLY ENDANGERED BY EXTRA-LEGAL VIOLENCE AGAINST VARIOUS DISSIDENTS BY UNIDENTIFIED INDIVIDUALS. WHATEVER GOI'S STORY, WORLD WOULD SIMPLY NOT RPT NOT BELIEVE THESE ATTACKS WERE NOT GOI INSPIRED. PROBLEM OF CIVILIAN ARRESTS BY RESISTANCE CORPS WAS PART OF THIS PROBLEM. SHAH ASKED WHETHER COMMUNITY MEMBERS SHOULD NOT HAVE RIGHT TO MAKE ARRESTS.

BUTLER REPLIED CITIZEN ARREST CONCEPT WELL KNOWN IN ANGLO-SAXON LAW, TOO, BUT WHEN 12 ARMY TRUCKLOADS OF "CITIZENS" SHOWED UP WITH CLUBS AND WEAPONS, THIS WAS STRETCHING CREDIBILITY OF IDEA A BIT FAR. BUTLER CONTINUED THAT I BEATINGS AND OTHER QUASI-VIOLENT INTIMIDATION GO ON MUCH LONGER, THEN DIALOG BETWEEN IRAN AND ICJ WOULD BE ENDANGERED AND ICJ MIGHT BE FORCED TO RESORT OTHER MEASURES. THERE FOLLOWED DISCUSSION OF PROBLEMS ATTNDANT TO SITUATION WHERE EXTRA-LEGAL FORCES TAKE ADMINISTRATION OF JUSTICE INTO THEIR OWN HANDS, AND BUTLER HAD IMPRESSION HE GOT SHAH TO RELAIZE IMPORTANCE OF PROBLEM.

SHAH FINALLY MADE STATEMENT THAT LAW MUST BE EXERCISED EQUALLY, OFTEN RAISING, PERHAPS RHETORICALLY, QUESTION WHY GOI COULDN'T DO THIS KIND OF THING IF DISSIDENTS AND RELIGIOUS GROUPS DID. BUTLER WENT OVER DIFFERENCES. SHAH ALSO EXPRESSED HIS CONCERN FOR NATIONAL SECURITY, NOTING HE WAS DETERMINED THAT WHAT HAPPENED IN AFGHANISTAN WOULD NOT HAPPEN IN IRAN. (AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN NOTED SHAH WOULD PROBABLY BE MORE CONCERNED ABOUT THIS TYPE OF SUBVERSION THAN HE HAD BEEN AS RESULT OF AFGHANISTAN EVENTS AND ADVISED ICJ TO TAKE THIS INTO ACCOUNT WHEN DEALING WITH SHAH.)

ON RELIGIOUS ISSUE, BUTLER SAID HE FOUND SHAH UP IN ARMS. SHAH WENT ON TAT LONG, EMOTIONAL LENGTH ON FACT HE COULD NOT EVEN HAVE HIMSELF PHOTOGRAPHED PLAYING WITH HIS DOGS (AN UNCLEAN ANIMAL TO GOOD MOSLEMS), GIRLS HAVE BEEN BEATEN UP FOR APPEARING IN SWIMMING POOLS IN BIKINIS, ETC. HE FOUND SHAH VERY UNCOMPROMISING. SHAH OFFERED OPINION THAT RELIGIOUS OPPOSITION REPRESENTS LESS THAN THE MAJORITY OF MOSLEMS AND SPOKE FEELINGLY OF "FANATICS OF RIGHT AND LEFT" WHO OFTEN WORK TOGETHER, SOMETIMES STARTING AS ONE AND BECOMING THE OTHER. ------------------031369 060340Z /73 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 8150 INFO AMEMBASSY LONDON SECTION 3 OF 3 TEHRAN 4257 LIMDIS
AT CLOSE OF MEETING SHAH COMPLIMENTED BUTLER ON HIS PRESENTATION AND URGED ICJ TO KEEP IN TOUCH THROUGH IRANIAN AMBASSADORS IN NEW YORK AND WASHINGTON.

WHILE IN SHIRAZ, BUTLER EXCHANGED VIEWS AND INFORMATION WITH BRITISH JOURNALISTS LIZ THURGOOD (THE GUARDIAN) AND ANDREW WHITLEY (BBC). ALTHOUGH HE ENJOYED DISCUSSIONS, BUTLER FOUND PAIR VERY HOSTILE TO GOI AND NOTED THEY DEPRECIATED U.S. EMBASSY ROLE IN HUMAN RIGHTS AND DID NOT APPEAR TO UNDERSTAND "REAL WORLD" DYNAMICS OF U.S. ADMINISTRATION'S HUMAN RIGHTS POLICY, WHICH HE THEN ATTEMPTED TO EXPLAIN TO THEM. (EMBOFFS AWARE OF THURGOOD BIAS, BUT FEEL BUTLER MAY BE JUDGING WHITLEY ON BASIS OF STRONG THURGOOD VIEWS, SINCE HE SAW THEM TOGETHER.) UPON RETURN TO TEHRAN, BUTLER MET WITH BILL BRANIGIN (WASHINGTON POST) MORNING MAY 3 AND WITH OTHERS NOTED PARA 1.
(FYI: BRANIGIN AND THRUGOOD LEAVE IRAN PERMANENTLY FOR NEW ASSIGNMENTS NEXT WEEK)

JUST BEFORE LEAVING, BUTLER TELEPHONE EMBOFF ON TWO ADMINISTRATIVE MATTERS AND REPEATED FOR EMBOFF (AND PERHAPS FOR BENEFIT OF "UNSCHEDULED" IRANIAN LISTENERS). SOME POINTS MADE IN TALKS WITH AMB. AND EMBOFFS: ICJ IS SERIOUSLY CONCERNED WITH EXTRA-LEGAL ACTIVITIES AGAINST DISSIDENTS AND THIS COULD JEOPARDIZE ICJ-IRAN DIALOG TO POINT ICJ WOULD FEEL CONSTRAINED TO GO INTO PUBLIC CRITICISM "IF THE BEATINGS DON'T STOP, AND SOON." BUTLER OFFERED VIEW THAT DISSIDENT EX-NATIONAL FRONT LAWYERS SEEMED TO BE INTERESTED IN PRINCIPLES OF ICJ AND "WERE NOT POLITICAL", APPEARING TO POSE NO THREAT TO MONARCHY.

BUTLER NOTED HE WAS CONSIDERED CHARTERING IRANIAN LAWYER'S ASSOCIATION AS ICJ CHAPTER, DISENFRANCHISING IN THE PROCESS PRESENT QUIESCNET ICJ CHAPTER HERE. WITH RESPECT TO THIS TYPE OF DISSIDENT, BUTLER TOLD EMBOFF IT WAS EMBASSY'S "AFFIRMATIVE DUTY TO HELP THESE PEOPLE OUT". EMBOFF NOTED WE WOULD REMAIN IN CONTACT, AND BUTLER SAID MORE THAN THAT WAS NEEDED. EMBOFF NOTED HIS VIEW.

EMBASSY COMMENT: WE HAD DISCUSSED PRIVATELY WITH BUTLER FACT THAT OUR LOW PROFILE PRECLUDES DISCUSSION WITH PRESS AND OTHERS OF WHAT EMB IF DOING PRIVATELY. WE HAVE NO SERIOUS PROBLEM WITH PRESS AND OTHERS PRODDING US FOR APPARENT LACK OF BULIC ROLE, AND UNDERSTAND BUTLER MAY HAVE BEEN SPEAKING FOR WIDER AUDIENCE IN THIS CASE. HOWEVER, EMBOFFS WARNED BUTLER FOR THE RCORD THAT WE A(AND HE) COULD NOT BE SURE LAWYERS' GROUP WOULD NOT EXPAND INTO POLITICAL ACTIVITY WIDER THAN PRESDENT DESIRE FOR LEGAL REMEDIIES AND ICJ MIGHT THEN BE COMPROMISED. DEPARTMENT MAY WISH TO MAKE SURE BUTLER HAS FULL UNDERSTANDING OF HOW WE ARE PLAYING OFFICIAL U.S.

CARDS HERE AND WHY WE WOULD BE RELUCTANT TO MOVE FURTHER OUT AHEAD PUBLICLY. ICJ'S OWN SUCCESSES SHOW VALUE OF DISCREET CONTACT. AS NEA/IRN IS AWARE, UNION OF NATIONAL FRONT LAWYERS ARE VERY POLITICAL AND INCLUDE AT LEAST SOME OF KEY LEADERSHIP OF GROUP. WHILE WE WOULD HAVE NO REAL OBJECTION TO ICJ CHARTERING THIS GROUP (THOUGH AS BUTLER HIMSELF POINTED OUT, THIS WOULD INVOLVE DISENFRANCHISING MORIBUND ICJ CHAPTER HERE HEADED BY ELDERLY LAWYER NAMED KAZEMI) WE FEEL HE SHOULD WAIT UNTIL NEW GROUP APPLIES AND (PRESUMABLY) IS OFFICIALLY REGISTERED WITH GOI BEFORE DOING SO.

SHOULD ICJ FAIL TO DO THIS, IT WOULD LEAVE ITSELF UPEN TO CHARGE IT WAS SUPPORTING "ANTI-STATE" BEHAVIOR AND PROBABLY WORK ITSELF BACK INTO POSITION SIMILAR TO AMNESTY INTERNATIONAL, FROM WHICH IT WOULD BE MUCH LESS USEFUL TO ITSELF AND TO USE.

BUTLER ALSO TOLD EMBASSY PRIVATELY HE HAD AFFIDAVIT FROM LAWYER LAHIJI REGARDING BEATING HE SUFFERED (REF C). BUTLER PLANNING TO STIMULATE SOME INTEREST IN THIS WITHIN AMERICAN AND BRITISH BAR ASSOCIATIONS AND ELSEWHERE AS MEANS OF KEEPING PRESSURE ON GOI AND SHAH.

AFGHANISTAN AMBASSADOR AND MRS. MALIKYAR RETURNED TO TEHRAN YESTERDAY FROM THE UNITED STATES WHERE HE WAS UNDERGOING MEDICAL TREATMENT AT THE TIME OF THE KABUL CORP. THE AMBASSADOR CAME TO SEE ME MORNING MAY 5 FOR LONG, EMOTIONAL DISCUSSION OF HIS CURRENT CIRCUMSTANCES.

HE HAS RECEIVED A MESSAGE FROM THE NEW REGIME INFORMING HIM THAT HE HAS BEEN RELIEVED OF HIS FUNCTIONS. THE REGIME HAS DESIGNATED HIS FIRST SECRETARY TO TAKE CHARGE OF THE EMBASSY, BY PASSING THE MINISTER-COUNSELOR WHO SHOULD HAVE BEEN CHARGE'. MALIKYAR SAYS THAT THE AFGHAN AMBASSADORS IN BELGRADE, CAIRO, ISLAMABAD, LONDON AND NEW DELHI HAVE SIMILARLY BEEN RELIEVED. THERE MAY ALSO BE OTHERS OF WHICH HE IS NOT AWARE.

MALIKYAR'S FIRST PRIORITY IS TO TRY TO GET HIS TWO DAUGHTERS OUT OF KABUL. HE IS, OF COURSE, ANXIOUS FOR WORD OF THE ONE WHO WAS REPORTED SERIOUSLY WOUNDED. I TOLD HIM I WAS SURE OUR EMBASSY IN KABUL WOULD BE HELPFUL IN ATTEMPTING TO ESTABLISH COMMUNICATIONS BETWEEN HIM AND HIS DAUGHTERS.

MALIKYAR FEELS HIS BEST LEVERAGE IN SECURING RELEASE OF HIS DAUGHTERS LIES IN FACT THAT HE HAS CONTROL OF THE CHECKBOOK WITH ACCESS TO THE EMBASSY'S BANK ACCOUNT HERE IN TEHRAN. THIS ACCOUNT CONTAINS ABOUT TWO AND ONE HALF MILLION DOLLARS REALIZED FROM THE SALE OF FORMER EMBASSY PROPERTY HERE. HE WILL TRY TO BARGAIN THE RETURN OF THIS CHECKBOOK AGAINST THE RELEASE OF HIS DAUGHTERS. HE WOULD ALSO LIKE TO USE IT FOR LEVERAGE IN ASSURING THE INTEGRITY OF HIS PROPERTY IN AFGHANISTAN, BUT HE IS LESS SANGUINE ABOUT HIS SUCCESS IN THAT PROSPECT.

ONCE HE GETS HIS DAUGHTERS OUT, MALIKYAR WILL TRY TO ASSEMBLE HIS FAMILY AND REARRANGE HIS LIFE. ALTHOUGH HE WILL STAY TEMPORARILY IN TEHRAN, HE FEELS IT WILL PROVE TOO EXPENSIVE AND HIS PREFERENCE IS TO GO TO THE UNITED STATES. HE HAS ONE SON AND A DAUGHTER-IN-LAW IN LOS ANGELES.THERE ARE ALSO TWO DAUGHTERS AND A SON, TOGETHER WITH HIS WIFE, HERE IN TEHRAN, PLUS ONE SON IN VIENNA.

MALIKYAR INTENDS TO DISCUSS ALL THIS WITH IRANIAN OFFICIALS AND SEEK THEIR SYMPATHETIC TREATMENT OF HIS FAMILY. I TOLD HIM I WOULD ALSO PUT IN A GOOD WORD, BUT THAT I WAS SURE THE IRANIANS WOULD TAKE GOOD CARE OF HIM WHILE HE IS HERE.

ACTION REQUESTED: I AVOIDED GIVING MALIKYAR ANY VIEWS ON HIS PROSPECTS FOR SETTLEMENT IN THE UNITED STATES. HE DID NOT GIVE ME DETAILS OF HIS FINANCIAL CONDITION EXCEPT TO SAY THAT HIS PROPERTY IN KABUL WOULD ENABLE HIM TO LIVE COMFORTABLY IF HE COULD USE OR CONVERT IT. HIS CHILDREN ARE ALL AMERICAN EDUCATED AND AT LEAST TWO OF THEM ARE EMPLOYED BY THE UNITED NATIONS. PLEASE PROVIDE APPROPRIATE GUIDANCE FOR ME TO USE WITH MALIKYAR IS DISCUSSING HIS DESIRE TO SETTLE IN THE UNITED STATES.

1978TEHRAN04278.subject: VISIT OF PAKISTANI FOREIGN ADVISOR AGHA SHAHI TO TEHRAN

segments.text: UNDERSECRETARY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS ZELLI INFORMED ME MAY 6 THAT PAKISTAN FOREIGN ADVISOR AGHA SHAHI WILL ARRIVE IN TEHRAN MAY 7 FOR TWO DAY VISIT. TRIP WAS ARRANGED URGENTLY AT PAKISTANI REQUEST FOR CONSULTATIONS ABOUT AFGHANISTAN. EFFORT IS BEING MADE TO INCLUDE TURKS IN CONSULTATIONS, BUT IT IS NOT CERTAIN THEY WILL ATTEND.

IRANIANS ARE TAKING LINE THAT THEY WISH GIVE NEW KABUL REGIME CHANCE TO PROVE ITS NATIONAL INDEPENDENCE. IN ADDITION TO CONTINUING DIPLOMATIC RELATIONS, THEY ALSO, FOR TIME BEING, ARE PREPARED TO CONTINUE THEIR ECONOMIC ASSISTANCE PROJECTS. THE REPORT PAKISTANIS AS "VERY AGITATED" ABOUT EVENTS.

1978TEHRAN04306.subject: COMMENTARY ON GOI RECOGNITION OF AFGHAN GOVT

segments.text: LOCAL PRESS MAY 7 CARRIED BRIEF LOW-KEY FRONT PAGE ARTICLES COVERING MFA SPOKESMAN'S MAY 6 ANNOUNCEMENT THAT IRAN "AT THE REQUEST OF THE GOA INFORMED THAT GOVERNMENT THAT PAST RELATIONS WILL CONTINUE". GOI AMBASSADOR DAVOUDI, ON LEAVE IN TEHRAN, WILL LEAVE SOON FOR KABUL.
TEHRAN JOURNAL PRINTED EDITORIAL MAY 7 ENTITLED "RECOGNITION", EXCERPTS OF WHICH APPEAR BELOW

"IT IS CERTAINLY NO SURPRISE. IRANIAN RECOGNITION OF AFGHANISTAN WAS EXPECTED. THE FACT IS THAT AFGHANISTAN IS THERE--A NEIGHBOR JUST ACROSS THE EASTERN BORDER. AS ONE LADING DIPLOMAT IN THIS COUNTRY PUT IT, 'WE CANNOT CHOOSE THE REGIMES OF OUR NEIGHBORS, BUT WE HAVE TO LIVE WITH THEM.'."

"SUCH OTHER NATIONS AT THE USSR, INDIA, VIETNAM, CUBA, TURKEY, PAKISTAN, MONGOLIA AND EASTERN BLOC COUNTRIES WERE QUICK TO RECOGNIZE THE RULING REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL. IRAN REMAINED QUIET A LITTLE LONGER, AWAITING SOME CONCRETE POLICY STATEMENT FROM KABUL AND ALLOWING THE DUST TO SETTLE AFTER THE BLOODY COUP. AND FRIDAY BROUGHT A STRONG DENIAL FROM TARAKI THAT THE AFGHAN GOVERNMENT IS A PRO-MOSCOW COMMUNIST REGIME."

"BUT THE KEY REASON FOR IRANIAN RECOGNITION IS SURELY THAT SUCH A STEP FOLLOWS NATURALLY FROM IRAN'S FOREIGN POLICY. THIS NATION HAS CONSISTENTLY ARGUED THAT INTERNATIONAL RELATIONS MUST BE BASED ON NON-INTERFERENCE IN OTHER COUNTRIES' AFFAIRS AND RECOGNITION OF THEIR NATIONAL SOVEREIGNTY. HIGH IRANIAN OFFICIALS HAVE REPEATEDLY STRESSED THAT IRAN SEEKS FRIENDLY AND PRODUCTIVE RELATIONS WITH ALL NATIONS, IRRESPECTIVE OF THEIR FORMS OF GOVERNMENT, PROVIDED THEY DO NOT VIOLATE OTHER NATIONS' RIGHTS TO SELF-RULE.

ALLY THIS TO THE LONG-STANDING HISTORICAL TIES BETWEEN IRAN AND AFGHANISTAN, THE LINKS BETWEEN THEIR RESPECTIVE CITIZENS WITHIN THE BROTHERHOOD OF ISLAM AND THE PROMINENT ROLE IRAN CONTINUES TO PLAY IN FOSTERING REGIONAL HARMONY AND COOPERATION."

"AMID WESTERN NEWS MEDIA REPORTS OF COMMUNIST OR PRO-MOSCOW INFLUENCE ON THE NEW KABUL REGIME, THERE IS A CLEAR NEED TO WAIT AND SEE RATHER THAN ASSESS THE TRUE COLORS OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL TOO SOON. TIME ALONE WILL REVEAL THE DIFFERENCES, IF ANY, BETWEEN THE INTERNATIONAL APPROACHES OF DAOUD AND THOSE OF TARAKI. BUT WHATEVER THE OUTCOME, IRAN WILL NO DOUBT CONTINUE TO STRIVE FOR MUTUALLY BENEFICIAL TIES WITH THE PEOPLE OF AFGHANISTAN, WHO REMAIN, HOWEVER THEY ARE RULED, OUR NIGHBORS."

1978TEHRAN04308.subject: IRANIAN PRESS SUPPORTS RULE OF LAW

segments.text: SUMMARY: IRANIAN PRESS OVER PAST TWO DAYS HAS SUPPORTED MAJLES DEPUTY'S CALL FOR INVESTIGATION INTO BOMBINGS OF DISSIDENT HOMES (REF A). THEME IS RULE OF LAW MUST PREVAIL. FACT ARTICLES APPEARED MAY PORTEND BEGINNING OF SHIFT IN GOI ATTITUDE TOWARD EXTRA-LEGAL VIOLENCE. END SUMMARY. BEGIN UNCLASSIFIED

BOTH ENGLISH AND FARSI PRESS PUBLISHED EDITORIALS MAY 6-7 COMMENTING ON RECENT SPATE OF VIOLENT ACTIVITIES AND THEIR ORIGINS. TEHRAN JOURNAL MAY 6 COMMENDED MAJLES DEPUTY PEZESHKPOUR'S CALL FOR GOI ACCOUNTING OF ITS ACTIVITIES IN RELATION TO BOMBING OF TWO DISSIDENT LAWYERS' OFFICES. EDITORIAL NOTED JUSTICE MINISTER KIANPOUR HAD REPLIED IN PARLIAMENT MAY 4: "THE MINISTER PLEDGED CONTINUED GOVERNMENT VIGILANCE AND ACTION BASED STRICTLY ON LAWS DESIGNED TO PROTECT SOCIETY FROM CORRUPTION, CONSPIRACIES AND ALL OTHER TYPES OF VIOLENCE. SUCH ATTACKS ARE NOT ACCEPTED AS PART OF THE INDIVIDUAL RIGHTS GUARANTEED IN IRAN AS MUTUAL RESPECT FOR EACH OTHER'S RIGHTS IS A NECESSITY, HE ARGUED.
KEYANPOUR EXPOUNDED AT LENGTH ON THE GOVERNMENT'S CONDEMNATION OF SUCH TERROR TACTICS."

KAYHAN INTERNATIONAL ALSO NOTED KIANPOUR'S COMMITMENT "BOTH TO PROTECT THE CONSTITUTIONAL RIGHTS AND LIBERTIES OF ALL IRANIANS AND TO ACT WITH DETERMINATION AGAINST THOSE WHO WOULD ENGAGE IN VIOLENCE TO ACHIEVE THEIR ENDS...". EDITORIAL SAID "KIANPOUR RIGHTLY EMPHASIZED THE UNACCEPTABILITY OF UNLAWFUL ACTS IN PURSUIT OF POLITICAL ENDS.

IRANIANS WILL NOT SUFFER INDIVIDUALS WHO GO AROUND PLACING BOMBS IN PEOPLE'S HOMES AND OFFICES; IN THE SAME WAY THEY WILL NOT SUFFER THOSE WHO RESORT TO MOB VIOLENCE, WHO DESTROY PRIVATE AND PUBLIC PROPTERTY, AND WHO FORCIBLY DISRUPT CENTERS OF EDUCATION AND LEARNING, WHO PURSUE THE POLITICS OF THE STREET RATHER THAN THE POLITICS OF PARLIAMENT." IT CLOSED WITH FOLLOWING: "IRANIANS SHOULD STAND TOGETHER IN THE FIRM DETERMINATION THAT, DURING THIS PERIOD OF LIBERALIZATION, THE RULE OF LAW SHALLPREVAIL.

AT THE SAME TIME, IT WILL BE THE TASK OF PARLIAMENT AND THE RASTAKHIZ PARTY TO ENSURE THAT POLITICAL ACTIVITY IS CHANNELLED INTO INSTITUTIONAL FORUMS FOR ORDERLY AND RATIONAL PUBLIC DIALOGUE AND DEBATE." END UNCLASSIFIED BEGIN CONFIDENTIAL

WHILE WORDS ARE PERHAPS CLOSER TO ASPIRATIONS OF MIDDLE CLASS THAT REFLECTION OF IMMEDIATE REALITY, FACT THAT PRESS PUBLISHED THEM IS SIGNIFICANT. THERE HAS BEEN CONSIDERABLE PRIVATE DISCUSSION AT ALL LEVELS OF IRANIAN SOCIETY ON PROBLEM OF VIOLENCE AND POSSIBLE GOVERNMENT COMPLICITY. IN VIEW OF THIS, GOI MAY BE BENDING A BIT TO PUBLIC SENTIMENT AND PREPARING TO MOVE DISCREETLY TOWARD LAW AND ORDER POSTURE.

ACCORDING TO ONE IRANIAN PRESSMAN, WHO WAS FRANKLY SURPRISED HIS PAPER WOULD RUN SUCH AN ARTICLE IN VIEW OF GOI AND RESURGENCE PARTY ATTITUDES (REF B) OVER PAST FEW WEEKS, INCONCISTENCY OF GOI CALLING FOR PEACEFUL BEHAVIOR AND THEN APPARENTLY EITHER CONDONING VIOLENCE OR BEING INCAPABLE OF FINDING OUT WHO WAS DOING IT HAS CAUSED SOME RESTIVENESS AMONG POLICE WHO FEEL THEY ARE BEING SET UP FOR A BUM RAP BY WHAT APPEARS TO THEM AS GOI'S JANUS-LIKE ATTITUDE TOWARD VIOLENCE.

1978TEHRAN04327.subject: CENTO SEMIANR ON UTILIZATION OF WIND ENERGY

segments.text: CENTO SCIENTIFIC SECRETARIAT WOULD LIKE TO KNOW ASAP DATES OF HUGHES TRAVEL PER REFA, SUGGESTING THAT HUGHES ARRIVE ANKARA ON 1 JUNE, SPEND ONE WEEK THERE, THEN PROCEED TO IRAN FOR ONE WEEK, FOLLOWED BY ONE WEEK IN PAKISTAN. IF THIS ACCEPTABLE, SECRETARIAT WILL REQUEST APPOINTMENTS BEGINNING IN TURKEY ON 2 JUNE. PLEASE ADVISE.
IS SECRETARIAT ASSUMPTION THAT USG WILL FUND HUGHES TRIP CORRECT?

WHILE WAITING IN ANTE-CHAMBER FOR AUDIENCE WITH SHAH ON MORNING MAY 8, I WAS APPROACHED BY GRAND MASTER OF CEREMONIES ASLAN AFSHAR, WHO SAID HE HAD JUST HAD LONG TALK WITH FORMER AFGHAN AMBASSADOR MALEKYAR. AFSHAR SUGGESTED I MAKE "HUMANITARIAN" MENTION OF MALEKYAR'S PROBLEM WHEN I SAW THE SHAH.

OPPORTUNITY AROSE IN COURSE OF AUDIENCE FOR ME TO TELL SHAH OF MALEKYAR'S DISPOSSESSION FROM EMBASSY AND HIS NEED FOR TEMPORARY ACCOMMODATION. I SAID MALEKYAR HAD TOLD ME HE WANTED REMAIN TEHRAN UNTIL HE COULD GET HIS TWO DAUGHTERS OUT OF KABUL.

SHAH IMMEDIATELY SAID HE WOULD TAKE CARE OF PROBLEM. HE HAS ASKED COURT MINISTER HOVEYDA TO PUT MALEKYAR FAMILY IN FLAT, PROVIDE THEM PROTECTION AND SEE THAT THEY ARE TAKEN CARE OF PENDING THEIR RELOCATION.

I HAVE ALSO LEARNED FROM KUWAIT AMBASSADOR (WHO IS MEMBER OF KUWAITI RULING FAMILY) THAT HIS FAMILY IS ALSO PREPARED TO HELP MALEKYARS. I BELIEVE THEREFORE THAT THEIR IMMEDIATE SITUATION IS STABILIZED.

WHEN I TOOK SECRETARY OF THE ARMY ALEXANDER TO CALL ON THE SHAH MORNING OF MAY 8, I FOUND HIM TIRED AND DEPRESSED, ALMOST LISTLESS. THIS IS THE FIRST TIME I HAVE SEEN HIM SINCE THE EVENTS IN AFGHANISTAN AND THAT SITUATION, ESPECIALLY THE LOSS OF LIFE AMONG THE MOHAMADZAI FAMILY, MAY HAVE BEEN THE CAUSE OF HIS DEPRESSION. ALTERNATIVELY, IT COULD MERELY HAVE BEEN THE FACT THAT HE IS RECOVERING FROM A COLD AND HAD A LAME LEG WHICH SEEMS TO HAVE RESULTED FROM A WATER-SKIING MISHAP.

THE SHAH DID NOT DWELL ON THE EVENTS IN AFGHANISTAN AS MUCH AS I HAD EXPECTED, MERELY CONFINING HIMSELF TO THE STATEMENT THAT THE COUP HAD COME "FIVE YEARS" EARLIER THAN HE EXPECTED, BECAUSE HE HAD THOUGHT THE COMMUNISTS WOULD WAIT UNTIL DAOUD HAD PASSED PEACEFULLY FROM THE SCENE. HE EXPRESSED CONCERN ABOUT MOSCOW'S INTENTIONS IN THE REGION. THE FOCUS OF HIS CONCERN IS THE PUSHTOON-BALUCHISTAN REGION OF WESTERN PAKISTAN. HE FEELS THE ECONOMIC AND POLITICAL DISARRAY IN PAKISTAN IS VERY TEMPTING TO THE SOVIETS AND THAT THEY MAY MOVE RAPIDLY TO EXPLOIT IT.

HE SAID HE WOULD MEET AGHA SHAHI THAT SAME AFTERNOON. HE WAS SURE HE WOULD BE ASKED FOR "MORE LOANS". HE SAID IT WAS OBVIOUS PAKISTAN NEEDED HELP BUT ADMITTED CANDIDLY THAT HE WAS "HESITATING" BECAUSE HE DIDN'T LIKE "CERTAIN THINGS THEY ARE DOING". I EAID OUR ABILITY TO HELP WAS HANDICAPPED BY PAKISTANI INSISTENCE ON THEIR REPROCESSING PLANT. HE GAVE HIS USUAL DISSERTATION ON THE STUPIDITY OF THIS PLANT.

HE THEN TURNED TO THE DOMESTIC SITUATION IN IRAN AND ADMITTED THAT HE WAS DISCOURAGED AND FRUSTRATED. HE FELT THE ISLAMIC LEADERS WERE PLAYING INTO THE HANDS OF THE COMMUNISTS. HE COULD NOT UNDERSTAND WHY THERE WERE YOUNG, EDUCATED PEOPLE WHO SEEMED TO PREFER THE COMMUNIST SYSTEM TO THE CURRENT SYSTEM IN IRAN. HE SAID "EITHER WE ARE DOING SOMETHING WRONG, OR ELSE THEY ARE ALL CRAZY. BUT THERE ARE SO MANY OF THEM. CAN SO MANY ALL BE CRAZY?"

COMMENT: THIS IS THE FIRST TIME I HAVE HEARD SHAH EXPRESS THE VIEW THAT THERE MAY BE SOMETHING FUNDAMENTALLY WRONG WITH HIS SYSTEM AND HIS "GAME PLAN". HE USUALLY HAS A FEISTY ASSURANCE THAT HIS SYSTEM WILL PROVE RIGTT AND THAT THE "HANDFUL" OF OPPOSITIONISTS WILL BE REJECTED BY "THE PEOPLE". THE PAST FEW DAYS WHICH HE HAS SPENT IN SOME SOLITUDE AT KISH RECOVERING FROM A COLD AND THE EVENTS IN AFGHANISTAN AS WELL AS THE CONTINUING MINOR DISTURBANCES THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY AND ESPECIALLY ON THE CAMPUSES SEEM TO HAVE SOBERED HIM AND GIVEN HIM SOME LHILOSOPHICAL UNCERTAINTIES.
THIS MAY BE ONLY A MOMENTARY LAPSE FROM HIS USUAL SELF-CONFIDENCE, BUT IT WAS CONSPICIOUS ENOUGHT TO BE WORTH NOTING.

1978TEHRAN04356.subject: DISCUSSION OF SITUATION IN AFGHANISTAN WITH FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY

segments.text: MINISTER KHALATBARY

FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY ASKED ME TO COME TO HIS OFFICE AFTERNOON MAY 8 TO DISCUSS SITUATION IN AFGHANISTAN. HE SAID HE HAD COMPLETED DISCUSSIONS WITH PAKISTANI FOREIGN ADVISER AGHA SHAHI AND WISHED TO CONVEY GIST OF THEIR JOINT CONCERN TO WASHINGTON.

IN DOING SO, HE HARKED BACK TO CENTO MINISTERIAL MEETING IN LONDON LAST MONTH AND TO COMPLIMENTARY STATEMENTS WHICH HE AND AGHA SHAHI TAD MADE ON THAT OCCASION. HE SAID THAT NEED FOR CENTO POLITICAL GUIDANCE IN LIGHT OF CURRENT AFGHANISTAN DEVELOPMENTS HAD BECOME MORE ACUTE. IRAN AND PAKISTAN NEEDED TO KNOW U.S. AND U.K. VIEWS CONCERNING SITUATION NOW FACING THOSE TWO COUNTRIES. (I ASSUME KHALATBARY ALSO HAS CONVOKED BRITISH AMBASSADOR, BUT HAVE NOT YET HAD CHANCE TO CHECK THIS POINT).

IRAN AND PAKISTAN BELIEVE THAT, IF SOVIETS FEEL THEY CAN MOVE AHEAD WITHOUT RESISTANCE, THEY WILL PUSH RAPIDLY TO EXPLOIT POSSIBILITIES FOR SUBVERSION IN BALUCHISTAN AND PASHTOONISTAN. ACCORDING TO KHALATBARY, AGHA SHAHI FEELS THAT BALUCHIS ARE THE MORE VULNERABLE OF THE TWO AND THE FIRST LIKELY SOVIET TARGET. THEY FEEL THAT "IF WE ARE MERELY TO BE SPECTATORS OF THESE EVENTS", SOVIETS WILL BE ENCOURAGED TO ACT.

ACCORDINGLY, KHALATBARY ASKED IF I COULD OBTAIN A STATEMENT FROM WASHINGTON GIVING (A) U.S. VIEW OF SITUATION RESULTING FROM EVENTS IN AFGHANISTAN, (B) U.S. ESTIMATE OF CURRENT SOVIET INTENTIONS, (C) WHAT ACTIONS MIGHT BE FEASIBLE TO PREVENT FURTHER SOVIET EXPLOITATION OF SITUATION, AND (D) WHAT ACTIONS U.S. WOULD BE PREPARED TO SUPPORT, BOTH IN PAKISTAN AND IN AFGHANISTAN.

I GAVE KHALATBARY A BRIEF SUMMARY OF AMBASSADOR ELIOT'S FIRST ENCOUNTERS WITH THE NEW REGIME IN KABUL. I ASKED WHETHER IRANIANS FELT NEW GOVERNMENT WAS FIRMLY IN CONTROL AND WHETHER THEY EXPECTED ANY RESISTANCE. KHALATBARY SAID HE SAW NO SIGNS OF RESISTANCE AND DOUBTED ANY COULD BE EFFECTIVE.

I THEN SAID THAT WE INTENDED, AT LEAST FOR THE TIME BEING, TO CONTINUE ALL OUR ASSISTANCE PROGRAMS IN AFGHANISTAN IN ORDER TO TEST WHAT THE NEW REGIME'S REACTION WILL BE TO THEM. IT WAS, OF COURSE, TOO EARLY TO MAKE ANY JUDGEMENTS ON THIS SCORE.

AS FAR AS ASSISTANCE TO PAKISTAN IS CONCERNED, I POINTED OUT AGAIN THAT WE COULD DO NOTHING, EITHER IN THE MILITARY OR ECONOMIC FIELDS, IF THE PAKISTANI INSIST UPON ACQUIRING THEIR REPROCESSING PLANT. I SUGGESTED IRAN MAKE THIS POINT CLEARLY AND BLUNTLY TO THEIR PAKISTANI FRIENDS. KHALATBARY SAID HE WOULD CONTINUE TO DO SO.

KHALATBARY LEAVES WITH THE SHAH ON FRIDAY, MAY 12, FOR VISITS TO BULGARIA AND HUNGARY. HE SAID HE WOULD APPRECIATE VERY MUCH IF WE COULD GET HIM SOME REPLY ABOUT OUR VIEWS BEFORE THEY MAKE THESE EASTERN EUROPEAN VISITS WHERE THEY FEEL THEIR STATEMENTS WILL BE VERY CLOSELY MONITORED BY THE SOVIETS. I SAID I WOULD TRY, BUT FELT WASHINGTON WAS STILL TRYING TO DIGEST WHAT HAD HAPPENED AND MIGHT NOT HAVE WELLCONSIDERED VIEWS AT THIS EARLY DATE.

ACTION REQUESTED: PLEASE SEND ME SOME VIEWS, HOWEVER PRELIMINARY, BY OPENING OF BUSINESS THURSDAY, MAY 11. IN VIEW OF CENTO CONTEXT, IT MAY BE NECESSARY COORDINATE THESE WITH U.K. ANY COMFORTING THOUGHT THAT CAN BE IMPARTED TO THE SHAH BEFORE HIS BALKAN TRIP WILL BE HELPFUL IN ENCOURAGING HIM TO MAINTAIN A MORE RESILIENT ATTITUDE IN DEALING WITH THE BARBARIANS.

SUMMARY: NUMBER OF VIOLENT INCIDENTS INCREASES SLIGHTLY. TEHRAN UNIVERSITY DEAN ATTACHED, BADLY INJURED. RELIGIOUS LEADERS AIM FOR QUIET CEREMONIES ON MAY 9. TEHRAN AND OTHER CITIES GENERALLLY QUIET AS OF NOON MAY 9 AFTER INCIDENTS MAY 8. END SUMMARY.

PRESS MORNING MAY 9 REPORTS SEVERAL VIOLENT INCIDENTS MAY 8 IN TEHRAN AND OTHER CITIES-ISFAHAN, TABRIZ, KASHAN, KERMAN, AND ARSANJAN. IN TEHRAN, EVENING MAY 8 A GROUP OF YOUTHS ATTACKED A BANK OF TEHRAN BRANCH IN ABBASSABAD AND BROKE ALL FRONTAL GLASS IN A MAJOR MOVE HOUSE TWO BLOCKS FROM THE IRANAMERICA SOCIETY. RIOTERS REPORTEDLY ATTACKED THREE BANKS IN IN KASHAN AND ONE IN ARSANJAN.

IN ISFAHAN, CONSUL MCGAFFEY REPORTED EVENING MAY 8 LARGE GROUP STAGED PEACEFUL DIVERSION AT CITY HALL WHILE ORGANIZED GROUP OF 20 TO 40 FIREBOMBED LIQUOR STORE AND NEARBY MOVIE.
