FIREBOMBING WATCHED BY AMCIT WITNESS, WHO SAW ELEVEN FIRE BOMBS THROWN, ALL OF WWHICH EXPLODED. ISFAHAN OPEN FOR BUSINESS NORMALLY MAY 9.

CONSUL METRINKO REPORTS THAT THERE WERE SUBSTANTIAL RIOTS WITH SHOOTING AT AZARBADEGAN UNIVERSITY IN TABRIZ EVENING MAY 8. GUNFIRE WAS HEARD AND WITNESSES REPORTED MANY WOUNDED. GROUP OF STUDENTS TRIED TO BURN THREE CARS, ONE OF WHICH EXPLODED AND CAUSED SUBSTANTIAL INJURIES. MORNING MAY 9, TABRIZ MERCHANTS OPENED FOR BUSINESS, THEN ABOUT 0900 QUICKLY SHUT DOWN. CONSUL SAYS 95 PER CENT OF BUSINESSES CLOSED AND JOINT POLICE/ARMY PATROLS AT ALL MAJOR AND MANY MINOR INTERSECTIONS. AS OF 1400 LOCAL TIME, MAY 9, THERE HAD BEEN NO FURTHER VIOLENCE.

ON UNIVERSITY SCENE, TEHRAN DEMONSTRATIONS TOOK UGLY TURN MAY 8 WHEN UNIDENTIFIED ASSAILANTS ATTACKED AND SEVERALY IJURED LITERATURE FACULTY DEAN EZZATOLLAH NEGAHBAN, ONE OF IRAN'S FOREMOST ARCHAEOLOGISTS. SOURCES TELL US NEGAHBAN RECEIVED STAB WOUNDS WHICH MAY HAVE CUT SOME TENDONS IN HIS RIGHT ARM. HE REMAINS IN HOSPITAL. ACCORDING TO PRESS, HE HAD BEEN THREATENED EARLIER AND HIS OFFICE SET ON FIRE BUT PERSISTED IN COMING TO WORK. PRESS REPORTS KERMAN UNIVERSITY IS NOT ONLY CLOSED AS NOTED PER REFTEL, BUT 14 STUDENTS WERE ARRESTED AFTER STUDENT WAS INJURED BY A GROUP OF YOUTHS.
PRESS ALSO REPORTED STUDENT WAS INJURED AT KARAJ COLLEGE AFTER ALLEGEDLY RESISTING ENTREATIES OF THIS CLASSMATES TO JOIN CLASS BOYCOTT.

IN PRIVATE DISCUSSIONS WITH IRANIAN WHO SAW AYATOLLAH SHIRATMADARI IN QOM LAST WEEK, EMBOFFS LEARNED THAT RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP HAD TOYED WITH IDEA OF SEEKING SHUTDOWN OF ALL BUSINESSES MAY 9 BUT EVENUALLY OPTED FOR COMMEMORATIVE SERVICES ON GROUNDS THEY LESS LIKELY TO LEAD TO VIOLENCE. WHILE SOURCE WAS PRESENT, SEVERAL RELIGIOUS LEADERS IN VARIOUS CITIES CALLED SHARIATMADARI SEEKING HIS ADVICE ON WHAT TO DO, AND HE ADVISED THEM TO HOLD COMMEMORATIVE SERVICES RATHER THAN ENGAGE IN MARCHES OR OTHER ACTIVITIES.

TEHRAN AND OTHER CITIES APPEAR QUIET SO FAR, MAY 9, BUT THERE IS REINFORCED POLICE PRESENCE IN MOST PLACES. TEHRAN BAZAAR IS VIRTUALLY CLOSED AND MASHAD BAZAAR IS CLOSED. TEHRAN POLICE HAVE BEEN USING HELICOPTERS TO KEEP AND EYE ON CITY SINCE MID-MORNING.

GOI SPOKESMAN HOMAYOUN, IN PRESS BEIEFING FOLLOWING CABINET SESSION MAY 8, SAID THAT PRESERVATION OF AFGHANISTAN'S INDEPENDENCE AND THE GROWING PROSPERITY OF ITS PEOPLE WERE STILL THE TWO MAIN PRINCIPLES OF IRAN'S POLICY TOWARD THAT COUNTRY. HE ADDED THAT THE FUTURE COURSE OF BILATERAL RELATIONS WOULD DEPEND ON SUBSEQUENT DEVELOPMENTS, I.E., "THE NEW AFGHAN GOVERNMENT HAS BEEN IN POWER FOR ONLY A SHORT TIME AND NATUALLY HAS BEEN BUSY ATTENDING TO ITS INTERNAL AFFAIRS. IT IS THEREFORE TOO EARLY TO TALK ABOUT IRANO-AFGHAN RELATIONS AT THIS STAGE."

FRENCH LANGUAGE DAILY, JOURNAL DE TEHRAN, CARRIED EDITORIAL MAY 9 ON THE FUTURE RELATIONS OF AFGHANISTAN AND PAKISTAN. WITH THE VISIT OF PAK FOREIGN ADVISER AGHA SHAHI AS BACKGROUND THE EDITORIAL CONTRASTS THE RELATIONS OF IRAN AND PAKISTAN WITH THE NEW AFGHAN GOVERNMENT, NOTING IT IS A "DEMOSCRATIC REPUBLIC" AND NOT "SOCIALIST PEOPLES", BUT NEVERTHELESS BY THE VERY FACT THE NEW AFGHAN LEADERSHIP BELONGS TO COMMUNIST ORGANIZATIONS, WHATEVER THEIR OFFICIAL APPLELLATION, AMOUNTS TO A REAL CHANGE OF REGIME MUCH GREATER THAN THAT IN 1973. OTHER EXCERPTS FROM LENGTHY EDITORIAL FOLLOW
" THE NEW REGIME HAS SPREAD SLOGANS RESPECTING THE PRINCIPLES OF ISLAM WHICH ARE MEANT TO WIN THE ALLIANCE OF THE PROFOUNDLY RELIGIOUS AFGHAN POPULATION AS WELL AS EXTINGUISH FEARS OF ITS NEIGHBORS."

"IN PEACEFUL TIMES IRAN IS LESS MENACED THAN PAKISTAN BECAUSE THERE ARE NO TERRITORIAL DISPUTES BETWEEN OUR COUNTRY AND AFGHANISTAN. THE DOMESTIC SITUATION IN IRAN IS SUCH THAT TROUBLES, EVEN OVER THE FRONTIER, WILL HAVE NO EFFECT ON THE POLITICAL STABILITY OF OUR COUNTRY."

"IT IS OTHERWISE IN RELATIONS BETWEEN AFGHANISTAN AND PAKISTAN. THEY POSE THE THORNY QUESTION OF THE FUTURE OF PUSTUNISTAN. HOWEVER, AS MOHAMMAD DAOUD APPEARS TO HAVE PROMISED ISLAMABAD, DISSENSION BETWEEN THE TWO COUNTRIES CAN BE MUTED. IT IS STILL TOO EARLY TO JUDGE THE ATTITUDE OF THE NEW AFGHAN LEADERS, BUT SHOULD DIFFICULTIES BREAK OUT BETWEEN ISLAMABAD AND KABUL FOR OTHER REASONS, THE AFGHAN GOVERNMENT WILL NOT FAIL TO USE THE PUSHTUNISTAN TRUP CARD TO PROVOKE TROUBLE IN PAKISTAN WHOSE POLITICAL STABILITY, WH THE BHUTTO AFFAIR SO MISHANDLED, IS PRECARIOUS."

"BEFORE BHUTTO VARIOUS PAK GOVERNMENTS HAD TRIED BY FORCE OF ARMS TO BRING THE POPULATION OF THOSE REGIONS TO HEEL. THE RESULT HAS ONLY BEEN TO CREATE TENACIOUS HATRED OF THE CENTRAL GOVERNMENT. HOWEVER, IF KABUL HOLDS A TRUP IN FUTURE NEGOTIATIONS WITH PAKISTAN, PAKISTAN ON ITS SIDE, BY PROHIBITING AFGHAN IMPORTS AND EXPORTS ACROSS ITS TERRITORY, CAN PROVOKE THE MOST SERIOUS ECONOMIC DIFFICULTIES FOR ITS AFGHAN NEIGHBOR."

COMMENT: ABOVE EDITORIAL ANALYSIS CONTAINS GENEROUS MEASURES OF CAUTION, PROFESSED SELF-CONFIDENCE AND PERHAPS SOME WISHFUL THINKING. THE EMPHASIS ON BHUTTO'S ACCOMPLISHMENTS IS ANOTHER INDICATION THAT GOI IS KEEPING UP ITS PRESSURE ON GOP AGAINST HIS EXECUTION. INTERESTINGLY, REFTEL INDICATES THAT PAKS BELIEVE BALUCHIS, RATHER THAN PUSHTUS, ARE THE AFGHANS' PRIME TARGET OF OPPORTUNITY. SINCE BALUCHIS ALSO LIVE IN IRAN, THAT MAY SIMPLY BE A PLOY TO HELP CONCENTRATE IRAN'S ATTENTION ON THE PROBLEM.

LOCAL PRESS HAS REPRINTED EXCERPTS FROM INTERVIEW ORIGINALLY APPEARING IN DUTCH MAGAZINE "ELSEVIERS". MUCH OF ARTICLE SEEMS TO BE REITERATION OF THE HARD-WORKING EMPRESS'S BUSY DAILY ROUTINE. EXCERPTS STRESS HER COMMITMENT TO EDUCATION AND CULTURAL ASPECTS OF IRANIAN LIFE AND PROVIDE AN UP-DATE ON HER REACTION TO CURRENT FERMENT TAKING PLACE WITHIN CERTAIN SEGMENTS OF IRANIAN POPULATION.

REFLECTING A WIDESPREAD CONCERN OF INTELLECTUALS AND CONSERVATIVE CLERGY WITH CULTURAL CHANGES TAKING PLACE IN IRAN THE EMPRESS EMPHASIZED THAT MATERIAL POSSESSIONS ALONE CANNOT ENSURE HAPPINESS. CONTRASTING THE RURAL PEASANTRY AS "LIVING A RICH, HUMAN LIFE" WITH THOSE IN URBAN CENTERS" "WHO HAVE BECOME RICH AND SPEND A GREAT DEAL" SHE WARNED THAT THE LATTER "MAY NO BE ABLE TO DIGEST THESE RAPID CHANGES".

EMPRESS IS QUOTED AS ATTACKING "BUREAUCRATIC-MINDED AND CONSERVATIVE ACADEMICS" WHO IMPLEMENT "EXTREMELY STRICT AND BUREAUCRATIC ADMINISTRATIVE REGULATIONS AT OUR UNIVERSITIES". SHE STRESSED THAT THESE ACADEMICS MUST BECOME MORE RESPONSIVE AND "MORE FREEDOM" MUST BE GIVEN TO THE UNIVERSITIES. REFERRING TO THE FACT THAT MANY IRANIANS WHO STUDY ABORAD DO NOT RETURN HOME, THE EMPRESS NOTED THAT THE GOVERNMENT WOULD LIKE TO HAVE BEEN ABLE TO PROVIDE UNIVERSITY TRAINING FOR THE 50,000 STUDENTS STUDYING ABROAD.

COMMENT: PORTION OF INTERVIEW WHICH APPEARED HERE IS REAFFIRMATION OF EMPRESS'S WELL KNOWN VIEWS--WHICH ARE THOUGHT TO BE SOMEWHAT MORE LIBERAL THAN THOSE OF THE SHAH. THESE PUBLIC STATEMENTS TO VARIOUS CORRESPONDENTS HAVE BEEN EFFECTIVE IN PROJECTING A SOMEWHAT INDEPENDENT STANCE BY THE EMPRESS AND IN BURNISHING HER IMAGE AS A HARDWORKING, CONCERNED, "MODERN" MEMBER OF THE ROYAL FAMILY. THEY PROJECT CONCERN ON THE PART OF THE ROYAL FAMILY FOR THE HUMAN PROBLEMS THAT RESULT FROM IRAN'S RAPID, OFTEN HECTIC AND FRUSTRATING PACE OF ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AND SOCIAL CHANGE.

AT 1210 HOURS LOCAL TIME ON TUESDAY, MAY 9, A TELEPHONE BOMB THREAT WAS RECEIVED BY A LOCAL EMPLOYEE AT THE IRAN AMERICA SOCIETY FACILITY IN ISFAHAN. CALL WAS IN FARSI FROM AN APPARENTLY WELL-EDUCATED MALE WHO STATED THAT THE IAS FACILITY SHOULD BE "CLOSED BECAUSE WE ARE GOING TO THROW A BOMB IN IT WITHIN ONE-HALF HOUR." POLICE WERE NOTIFIED. BOMB SEARCH PROVED NEGATIVE. EXTRA POLICE REMAINED ON THE PREMISES THROUGHOUT THE DAY. IAS FACILITIES REMAINED OPEN.

THAT SAME DAY, A TELEPHONE BOMB THREAT WAS RECEIVED EARLY IN THE EVENING AT LA FONTAINE RESTAURANT IN ISFAHAN MINUTES BEFORE THE SCHEDULED ARRIVAL OF SECRETARY OF THE ARMY CLIFFORD C. ALEXANDER AND HIS PARTY, WHO WERE VISITING ISFAHAN. THE CALL WAS IN FARSI, DIRECTED TO THE RESTAURANT, AND MADE NO MENTION OF SECRETARY ALEXANDER OR ANY OTHER AMERICANS. THE CALL INDICATED THAT THERE WAS A BOMB IN THE RESTAURANT WHICH WAS ABOUT TO EXPLODE. ALEXANDER PARTY CANCELED THEIR VISIT TO THE RESTAURANT. SUBSEQUENT SEARCH OF THE PREMISES PROVED NEGATIVE.
DURING CALL ON MFA DEPARTMENT HEAD DAVOUDI MAY 10 BY POLCOUNS WITH VISITING BAGHDAD EMBOFF MACK AND KUWAIT EMBOFF BUCK, DISCUSSION TURNED TO EVENTS IN KUWAIT-IRAQ RELATIONS.

DAVOUDI VOLUNTEERED THAT CABINET CHANGE CAN BE EXPECTED IN KUWAIT THIS SUMMER OR BY OCTOBER AT THE LATEST. HE GAVE NO SPECIAL REASON EXCEPT THAT PRESENT CABINET HAD BEEN HASTILY PUT TOGETHER FOLLOWING DEATH OF LATE AMIR. WHILE SPECULATING THAT IT MIGHT INVOLVE A PUSH FOR MORE MEMBERS OF RULING SABAH FAMILY IN IT, DAVOUDI WAS NOT PRECISE. HE ALSO SUGGESTED IN MORE TENTATIVE MANNER THAT NEW ASSEMBLY WOULD HAVE TO BE CONVENED TO TAKE CARE OF PASSING OF NEW LAWS ACCORDING TO CONSTITUTION.

ON KUWAIT-IRAQ BORDER DAVOUDI EXPRESSED PESSIMISM. HE THOUGHT KUWAIT WILL CONTINUE TO RESIST IRAQI DEMANDS SUCH AS ON ISLANDS OF WARBA AND BUBYAN. THIS RESISTANCE IS BASED ON HISTORY. GIVEN LONG RECORD OF IRAQI CLAIM TO ALL OF KUWAIT, KUWAITIS FEEL THAT CONCESSION OF TERRITORY WILL ONLY WHET IRAQI APPETITE. MEANWHILE, KUWAITIS CONTINE TO TURN BACK IRAQI REQUESTS FOR COOPERATION ON VARIETY OF ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL MATTERS WITH THE REQUEST THAT BOUNDARY DIFFERENCES BE SETTLED FIRST.

IN REPLY TO BUCK'S QUESTION REGARDING KUWAIT-SAUDI UNDEFINED OFFSHORE BOUNDARY LINE, DAVOUDI SAID HE WAS NOT FAMILIAR WITH LEGAL DETAILS BUT KNEW OF NO POLITICAL PROBLEM INVOLVING IRAN. IN ANY CASE, HE ADDED, KUWAIT CANNOT AFFORD ANY PROBLEMS WITH IRAN, SINCE IT NEEDS THE SUPPORT OF IRAN AND ALL THE OTHER COUNTRIES OF THE REGION AGAINST IRAQI THREAT. IF IRAQ HAD NOT HISTORICALLY PUSHED THREATS TO SO MANY OF THE AREA COUNTRIES, DAVOUDI COMMENTED, IT WOULD PROBABLY BE THE MOST INFLUENTIAL ARAB NATION IN THIS PART OF THE WORLD.

1978TEHRAN04455.subject: DEMONSTRATIONS, VIOLENCE IN IRAN ON MAY 9; PUBLIC REACTION COMPLEX

segments.text: SUMMARY: DESPITE LULL AFTER EARLY INCIDENTS, VIOLENCE FLARED ON MAY 9 IN SEVERAL IRIANS COTIES, ESPECIALLY QOM, WHERE FIVE WERE KILLED, SEVERAL BANKS AND HOTELS WERE BURNED AND POWER CABLES CUT. IRAN AMERICAN SOCIETY IN ISFAHAN AND RESTAURANT RECEIVED THREATS, AND STUDENT DEMONSTRATIONS ACROSS COUNTRY HAVE CLOSED MOST UNIVERSITIES EARLY. IRANIAN VIEWS ON VIOLENCE REMAIN COMPLEX, OFTEN SCHIZOPHRENIC. GOI HAS ANNOUNCED CRACKDOWN. END SUMMARY.

ALTHOUGH REFTELS REPORTED QUIET MAY 9 AFTER EARLY INCIDENTS MAY 8, FURTHER INFORMATION BASED ON MAY 10 PRESS REPORTS AND OTHER SOURCES SHOW DEFINITE UPSURGE OF VIOLENCE. WORST HIT WAS RELIGIOUS CITY OF QOM WHERE, ACCORDING TO FARSI (BUT NOT ENGLISH) PRESS, FIVE PEOPLE DIED OF INJURIES RECEIVED IN RIOTING, 300 CARS WERE BURNED, SEVERAL BANKS AND HOTELS WERE ATTACKED AND BURNED, ONE POLICE STATION WAS ATTACKED, MAIN POWER CABLE TO CENTER OF TOWN WAS CUT, AND TEHRAN-KHORRAMSHAR TRAIN WAS STOPPED AT A STATION FOR 90 MINUTES. OTHER SOURCES TELL US SITUATION WAS TOUCH AND GO BEFORE POLICE RESTORED ORDER, AND THREEE FIRE TRUCKS WERE BADLY DAMAGED.

PRECISE IDENTITY OF ATTACKERS NOT RPT NOT KNOWN, BUT THEY APPEAR TO HAVE COME FROM MOSQUES WHICH HELD 40TH DAY COMMEMORATIVE SERVICES. GOI HAS ADVISED US VIOLENCE IS CONTINUING MAY 10 WITH AT LEAST ONE DEAD BY 1300 LOCAL TIME.

IN SHIRAZ ON MAY 8, PRESS REPORTS 300 PEOPLE POURED OUT OF MOSQUE IN EVENING AND WENT WINDOW-SMASHING. DISTURBANCES AT PAHLAVI UNIVERSITY IN SHIRAZ RESULTED IN ARREST OF 14, MOSTLY STUDENTS, AND BURNING OF STUDENT AFFAIRS OFFICES. CONSULATE SHIRAZ REPORTED MORE DISTURBANCES MAY 10, WHEN STUDENTS GROUPS ATTACKED PAHLAVI UNIVERSITY ENGINEERING COLLEGE ABOUT 0900 LOCAL TIME AND BURNED NEARBY CAR. ABOUT ONE HOUR LATER, THERE WAS SIMILAR TROUBLE AT PAHLAVI'S COLLEGE OF AGRICULTURE AND DEMONSTRATIONS IN MAIN DORMITORY AREA.

PRESS COVERAGE OF RIOTS AT AZARBADEGAN UNIVERSITY IN TABRIZ (REF B) WAS HEAVY. POLICE AND SECURITY FORCES WERE FORCED TO SHOOT INTO MOB, KILLING TWO STUDENTS OUTRIGHT AND INJURING MANY OTHERS. NUMBER OF SECURITY AGENTS AND UNIVERSITY GUARDS WERE ALS SENT TO HOSPITAL. ATTACKS WERE ALSO REPORTED AGAINST BANKS IN AHWAZ, BEHBANDAN, KHORRAMSHAR, KERMANSHAH, BOBOL, YAZD, SHAHABAD.

CONSULATE ISFAHAN REPORTS TWO BOMB THREAT CALLS (BEING REPORTED SY CHANNEL SEPTEL), ONE AGAINST IAS AND ONE AGAONST LA FONTAINE RESTAURANT SEVERAL MINUTES BEFORE U.S. ARMY SECRETARY ALEXANDER WAS DUE TO ARRIVE FOR DINNER. NO BOMBS WERE FOUND. ------------------067742 110742Z /16 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 8250 INFO AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY LONDON USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 4455

STUDENTS DEMONSTRATIONS IN TEHRAN AND ELSEWHERE HAVE RESULTED IN MOST UNIVERSITIES CLOSING FOR EXAMS ONE TO TWO WEEKS EARLY. SOCIAL SCIENCE STUDENTS AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY CALLED FOR BOYCOTT, AND UNIVERSITY LAB AND ARYAMEHR, NATIONAL AND TEHRAN POLYTECHNIC UNIVERSITIES IN TEHRAN ARE ALSO CLOSED, ALONG WITH PAHLAVI IN SHIRAZ AND ISFAHAN UNIVERSITY. FOR FIRST TIME, DEMONSTRATIONS IN TEHRAN REACHED DOWN TO NON-POLITICAL TEHRAN COLLEGE OF INSURANCE (TCI), AND IT'S OFFSHOOT, REGIONAL COOPERATION AND DEVELOPMENT (RDC) INTERNATIONAL COLLEGE, WHERE EMBOFFS AND LECTURED PEACEFULLY EARLIER IN WEEK. FOLLOWING RIOT AT TCI, (MAY 9 (FIRST IN SCHOOL'S 10-YEAR HISTORY), WHICH BROKE ALL CORRIDOR AND LIBRARY WINDOWS, REST OF CLASSESS WERE CANCELLED. DR.

ALI CHEYBANI, JOINT PRESIDENT OF BOTH SCHOOLS, TOLD EMBOFF IN CONFIDENCE HE KNEW SOME OF DEMONSTRATORS, BUT WOULD HANDLE DISCIPLINE INTERNALLY, SINCE HE WITNESSED FOUR OR FIVE RIOT LEADERS ARRIVE FROM ELSEWHERE (HE THOUGH TEHRAN UNIVERSITY OF BAZAAR) BY TAXI WITH BILLY CLUBS TO WHIP UP STUDENT ENTHUSIASM. CHEYBANI SAID ABOUT 10-15 TCI STUDENTS WERE INVOLVED. THOUGH THERE WERE NO DEMONSTRATIONS AT RCD, CHEYBANI CLOSED THIS REGIONAL SCHOOL AS WELL TO AVOID POSSIBLE TROUBLE FOR PAKISTANI AND TURKISH STUDENTS IF "OUTSIDE AGITATORS" GOT INVOLVED THERE.

RECENT UPROAR IN MAJLES (REF A) AND INITIAL REACTION TO VIOLENCE SURROUNDING MAY 9 POINT UP COMPLEX, AMBIVALENT PUBLIC AND ELITE ATTITUDES DEVELOPING OVER QUESTION OF POLITICAL LIBERALIZATION AND VIOLENCE IN IRAN, NOT ONLY AMONG MAJLES DEPUTIES BUT AMONG PEOPLE AT EVERY LEVEL. DISSIDENTS, AS WELL AS AT LEAST TWO MAJLES DEPUTIES, HAVE CRITICIZED GOI FOR FAILURE TO STOP BOMBINGS AND BEATING OF INDIVIDUALS. "ESTABLISHMENTARIANS" YELL RIGHT BACK THAT CRITICS OF GOI ARE QUICK TO JUMP ON GOI, BUT SILENT ABOUT VIOLENCE INSTIGATED BY "THEIR OWN" MOBS. THERE IS SIZEABLE MIDDLE-LEVEL (AND MIDDLE CLASS) FEELING THAT GOI OUGHT TO ACT MORE FORCEFULLY TO RESTORE ORDER.

THIS ALSO GENERATES OCCASIONAL VERBAL SWIPES AT EMBOFFS ALONG LINES OF "SEE WHAT YOUR PRESIDENT'S POLICIES HAVE BROUGHT US." PITCH TO EMBOFF FROM OTHER SIDE OF FENCE RUNS SOMETHING LIKE "WHY DOESN'T THE UNITED STATES ACT MORE FORCEFULLY TO RESTORE HUMAN RIGHTS IN IRAN, SINCE YOU HAVE SO MUCH INFLUENCE WITH THE SHAH? OR, "WE HAVE LOST ALL FAITH IN YOUR PRESIDENT'S PROMISES." IRONIC FEATURE OF ALL THIS IS ALMOST AUTOMATIC BLAMING OF TROUBLES ON FOREIGN ELEMENTS, EITHER COMMUNIST OR WESTERN, AND APPEAL TO WESTERNERS, PARTICULARLY U.S., AS "POINT MAN" ON HUMAN RIGHTS, TO DO SOMETHING.

REAL PROBLEM IS, IRANIANS THEMSELVES DISAGREE ON BOTH CAUSES AND REMEDIES, WITH RESULT THAT PUBLIC AND ELITE OPINION SEEMS TO BE POLARIZING IN DIRECTIONS COMPARABLE TO SPLIT IN U.S. DURING LATE 60'S-EARLY 70'S. PERHAPS BEST ILLUSTRATION OF CURRENT SCHIZOPHRENIA WAS REMARK BY SEASONED POLITICAL BROKER TO EMBOFF MAY 8, WHEN HE DEPLORED GOI EXTRA-LEGAL AND POLICE ACTIONS AGAINST RELIGIOUS DEMONSTRATORS, BUT IN VERY NEXT BREATH SAID GOI OUGHT TO "CLAMP DOWN HARD ON THE COMMUNIST TROUBLEMAKERS IN OUR MIDST."

AS IF IN ANSWER TO THESE CRIES, TEHRAN RADIO ANNOUNCED THIS AFTERNOON, MAY 10, THAT GOI WILL BE LESS PERMISSIVE THAN IT HAS BEEN IN RECENT PAST AND CRACK DOWN TO APPLY LAW AND ORDER. WE SHALL SEE WHAT THIS MEANS.
MEANWHILE IAS ACADEMIC CENTER IN TEHRAN RECEIVED BOMB THREAT SAME AFTERNOON WHICH BEING INVESTIGATED AS OF THIS WRITING. (WILL BE REPORTED SEPTEL).

1978TEHRAN04456.subject: BOMB THREAT--IRAN AMERICA SOCIETY ACADEMIC CENTER-- TEHRAN AT 1400 HOURS LOCAL TIME, THE LOCAL SWITCHBOARD OP

segments.text: TEHRAN AT 1400 HOURS LOCAL TIME, THE LOCAL SWITCHBOARD OPERATOR AT THE IRAN AMERICA SOCIETY ACADEMIC CENTER IN TEHRAN RECEIVED A TELEPHONE BOMB THREAT FROM AN UNIDENTIFIED IRANIAN MALE WHO STATED SIMPLY: "THERE IS A BOMB AT IAS" AND HUNG UP. POLICE WERE NOTIFIED AND REPORTED TO BOTH THE IAS ACADEMIC CENTER AND THE IAS CULTURAL CENTER TO ASSIST LOCAL PERSONNEL IN CONDUCTING SEARCHES OF THE PREMISES. SO FAR SEARCHES HAVE PROVED NEGATIVE.

BRITISH AMBASSADOR WAS ALSO CALLED TO FONOFF MAY 8 BY KHALATBARY FOR DISCUSSION ON SITUATION IN AFGHANISTAN. KAHLATBARY'S PRESENTATION, WHICH HE MADE FROM PREPARED NOTES, WAS VERY SIMILAR TO THAT MADE TO US (REFTEL).

AT RECEPTION MAY 9, MINISTER COUNSELOR, WHO HAS KNOWN SHAHI FOR OVER 20 YEARS, WAS DRAWN ASAIDE BY HIM FOR PRIVATE LECTURE IN WHICH HE WOVE THEMES PRESENTED TO AMBASSADOR BY KHALATBARY. SHAHI NOTED THAT THE "GREAT GAME" HAD NOW CONCLUDED AFTER A CENTURY OF COMPETITION. THE RUSSIAN BOOT WAS IN KABUL. PAKISTAN CERTAINLY IS NOT IN POSITION TO PROVIDE THE HISTORICAL COUNTERPOISE TO RUSSIAN POWER. ONLY ANOTHER GREAT POWER COULD DO THIS. BUT, HE SAID WITH A SAD SHAKE OF HIS HEAD, THE U.S. APPEARS TO BE IN A MOOD OF WITHDRAWAL--STILL CONDITIONED BY THE VIETNAM AND WATERGATE EXPERIENCES.

HE REFERRED WITH SOME IRRITATION TO A WASHINGTON POST EDITORIAL WHICH SAID THE NEW SITUATION IN AFGHANISTAN WAS A PROBLEM FOR THE REGIONAL STATES, THUS ABSOLVING THE U.S. FROM ANY RESPONSIBILITY. HOWEVER, HE CONTINUED, PAKISTAN MUST LOOK OUT FOR ITS OWN INTERESTS AND, IF THE BALANCE OF POWER HAS SHIFTED, MAKE THE NECESSARY ADJUSTMENTS IN ITS POLICIES. IN THIS CONNECTION, THE REGIONAL STATES HAD, HE CONCLUDED, WATCHED EVENTS IN THE HORN OF AFRICA WITH GREAT INTEREST.

1978TEHRAN04467.subject: AFGHAN EVENTS CONTINUE TO RECEIVE PRESS ATTENTION

segments.text: LOCAL PRESS CONTINUES TO FOLLOW CLOSELY AFGHAN DEVELOPMENTS, RUNNING FRONT PAGE STORIES MAY 10 ON TARAKI'S LUNCH MEETING WITH TWO PAK POLITICIANS "PROMINENTLY LINKED WITH SECESSIONIST TENDENCIES". REUTERS ACCOUNT, PUBLISHED IN BOTH ENGLISH LANGUAGE DAILIES, NOTES THAT ABDUL GHAFFAR KHAN AND AJMAL KHATTAK WERE THE FIRST NON-DIPLOMAT FOREIGNERS TO BE RECEIVED BY THE REGIME.

FRENCH LANGUAGE JOURNAL DE TEHRAN MAY 10 COMMENTED THAT IN HIS CONTACTS WITH IRANIANS EARLIER IN THE WEEK PAK FOREIGN ADVISER AGHA SHAHI HAD MADE NO SECRET OF HIS APPREHENSION OVER THE FUTURE POLICIES OF THE NEW AFGHAN REGIME, QUOTING HIM AS SAYING THAT "DEVELOPMENTS IN AFGHANISTAN WILL OPEN THE WAY FOR CONFUSION." EDITORIALLY THE JOURNAL C A "RELENTLESS PURGE" BY THE GOVERNMENT OF ALL THE SENIOR CIVIL AND MILITARY FIGURES ASOCIATED WITH THE FORMER REGIME. THE EDITORIAL REFERS TO TRIBAL CHIEFS WHO "HAVE ALREADY 'DISAPPEARED'...REDUCING THE TRIBES TO OBEDIENCE, ESPECIALLY THOSE WITH CLOSE RELATIONS WITH THE OLD REGIME."

COMMENT: CONTINUED PROMINENCE GIVEN TO EACH NEW STEP OF AFGHAN GOVENMNENT INDICATES WIDESPREAD, HIGH-LEVEL IRANIAN CONCERN WITH TREND OF DEVELOPMENTS IN THAT COUNTRY. REPORTS NOTED ABOVE CANNOT BE VERY COMFORTING.

1978TEHRAN04499.subject: ANTI-HIJACKING GROUP--NEW APPROACH TO SAUDI ARABIA AND IRAN

segments.text: DUTCH HERE HAVE RECEIVED INSTRUCTION BUT ARE AWAITING SOME MORE BACKGROUND. THEY EXPECT TO SET UP JOINT APPROACH TO MFA FOR NEXT WEEK, FOLLOWING WHITSUN WEEKEND.

I BRIEFED KHALATBARY ON SUBSTANCE OF REFS A AND B LATE AFTERNOON MAY 11. (IN THE EVENT, SHAH'S TRIP TO BALKANS HAS BEEN POSTPONED FOR FEW DAYS.) IN DOING SO, I STRESSED THAT WASHINGTON ASSESSMENT WAS A VERY PRELIMINARY ONE, WHICH WOULD REQUIRE MORE STUDY OVER TIME.
KHALATBARY SEIZED ON OUR CONCERN ABOUT AFGHAN INTENTIONS IN PUSHTOONISTAN AND BALUCHISTAN, SAYING THAT RECENT STATEMENTS FROM KABUL HAD ACCENTUATED THIS ISSUE. HE SAID AGHA SHAHI FEARED THE WORST.

THIS COMMENT LED TO HIS DISCUSSION OF OUR LAST MEETING AND MY STATEMENT THAT IT WOULD BE VERY DIFFICULT FOR US TO HELP PAKISTAN IF THEY INSIST ON THE REPROCESSING PLANT. KHALATBARY HAD REPORTED THIS TO SHAH, WHO RAISED THE PROBLEM OF THE PLANT THREE TIMES IN HIS TALK WITH AGHA SHAHI.

AT AIRPORT UPON HIS DEPARTURE, AGHA SHAHI ASKED KHALATBARY TO PROPOSE TO SHAH THAT REPROCESSING ISSUE MIGHT TO NEUTRALIZED IF IRAN WOULD JOIN WITH PAKISTAN IN THE ENTERPRISE AND COULD ACT AS GUARANTOR THAT PLANT WOULD NOT BE USED FOR WEAPONS PURPOSES. KHALATBARY HAD RELAYED THIS TO SHAH, WHO TOLD HIM TO TELL AGHA SHAHI THAT IRAN WOULDN'T TOUCH THE PLANT WITH A TEN-FOOT POLE. KHALATBARY WILL SEND THIS MESSAGE TO AGHA SHAHI TOMORROW.
KHALATBARY SAID HE HOPED HE WOULD HAVE FURTHER CHANCE TO DISCUSS REGIONAL SITUATION AT RCD MEETING LATER THIS MONTH IN ANKARA.

1978TEHRAN04524.subject: MAY 11 RELIGIOUS PROTEST SMALLER THAN EXPECTED AND CONTROLLED BY SECRUTIY FORCES SUMMARY: SUMMARY: LARGEST PROTEST DEMONSTRATION BY

segments.text: CONTROLLED BY SECRUTIY FORCES SUMMARY: SUMMARY: LARGEST PROTEST DEMONSTRATION BY RELIGIOUS MILITANTS IN THE COUNTRY MAY 11 TOOK PLACE IN TEHRAN AT BAZAAR MOSQUE. IT WAS MORE LIMITED IN NUMBERS THAN EXPECTED (UNDER TWO THOUSAND) AND WAS DISPERSED IN FAIRLY SHORT ORDER BY SOME TWO THOUSAND SECURITY POLICE AND TROOPS WITH APPARENTLY FEW, IF ANY, CASUALTIES. A HEAVY SECURITY PRESENCE IN OTHER PARTS OF THE COUNTRY APPEARS TO HAVE PREVENTED LARGE DEMONSTRATIONS BUT SITUATION REMAINS TENSE AS OF MAY 12 ESPECIALLY IN GHOM. END SUMMARY.

ACCORDING TO NUMBER OF EMBASSY SOURCES, INCLUDING GOOD JOURNALISTIC SOURCE WHO HAD POLICE AS WELL AS EYE-WITNESS ACCOUNTS, GOVERNEMENT MASSED SOME TWO THOUSAND POLICE AND ARMY AT THREE POINTS AROUND BAZAAR AREA WHICH CONTAINS MOSQUE AT WHICH RELIGIOUS PEOPLE ARRIVED, PRESENCE OF SECURITY FORCES FAIRLY INTIMIDATING. NEVERTHELESS, NUMBER OF SPEAKERS IN MOSQUE DELIVERED FIERY VERSIONS OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI'S ATTACKS ON GOVERNMENT, INCLUDING ATTACKS ON MONARCHY AND THE SHAH. AT ONE POINT PARTICULARLY FIERY SPEAKER REPORTEDLY SAID SHAH SHOULD TURN OVER GOVERNEMENT TO RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP IF HE CANNOT RUN THE COUNTRY, AND THEY WILL RUN IT ACCORDING TO GOOD ISLAMIC PRINCIPLES.
CROWD APPLAUDED AND ROSE AS IF TO TAKE TO THE STREETS BUT SPEAKER CALMED THEM DOWN BEFORE MEETING BROKE UP AROUND ONE P.M.

AS CROWD LEFT BAZAAR, SECURITY TROOPS FORCED IT TO BREAK UP INTO TWO DIFFERENT DIRECTIONS. THEY WENT ONLY A SHORT WAY SHOUTING ANTI-SHAH SLOGANS, AND BEFORE GETTING TO PTT OR INANCE MINISTRY, ENCOUNTERED SOLID PHALANX OF TROOPS WHICH BROADCAST WARNINGS TO DISPERSE BY LOUDSPEAKER. AFTER A FEW TEAR GAS GRENADES WERE THROWN AND SOME SHOTS FIRED INTO THE AIR CROWD DISPERSED. POLICE AND TROOPS DID NOT RPT NOT CHASE THEM DOW SIDE ALLEYS AS HAS BEEN CASE IN DEMONSTRATIONS IN THE PAST. THEREFORE, POLICE ASSERT FEW, IF ANY, CASUALTIES RESULTED AND BBC REPORTS OF DEAD ARE FALSE. OTHER JOURNALIST SOURCE TELLS US NORMAL OPPOSITION INFORMANTS UNABLE CONFIRM ANY CASUALTIES.)

RELIABLE JOURNALIST TELLS US HE WAS PRESENT NEAR HIGH RANKING POLICE OFFER ABOUT 10:30 A.M. WHEN INSTRUCTIONS CAME "FROM THE HIGHEST SOURCE" THAT POLICE WERE TO ISSUE WARNINGS, THROW TEAR GAS, AND FIRE INTO THE AIR IF NECESSARY, BUT AVOID SHOOTING AT DEMONSTRATORS. IF USE OF BATONS BECAME NECESSARY, THEY WERE TO BE EMPLOYED BELOW THE WAIST. OFFICER TRANSMITTED THESE INSTRUCTIONS, ADDING THAT IF TROOPS WERE UNDER PERSONAL DANGER AND FELT THEY HAD TO DEFEND THEMSELVES THEY SHOULD DO WHAT IS NECESSARY WITHOUT ASKING PERMISSION TO SHOOT. SOURCE ASSERTS SHAH WAS PERSONALLY IN OPERATIONS ROOM OF NIAVARAN PALACE DURING MORNING AND AFTERNOON AND PERSONALLY ISSUED INSTRUCTIONS AS EVENTS WENT ALONG.

SIMILARLY HEAVE SECURTIY DISPOSITIONS WERE REPORTEDLY IN PLACE IN MANY OTHER MAJOR CITIES. POLICE SAY DEMONSTRATORS HAD INTENDED TO ATTACK SOME SHOPS WHICH WERE OPEN. BY 2:30 P.M. DEMONSTRATORS EFFECTIVELY DISPERSED FROM BAZAAR AREA. QUIET MORNING MAY 12 EYE WITNESSES DIFFER AS TO THE EXTENT OF SECURITY PRESENCE, WITH NORMAL ACTIVITY BY SIDEWALK PEDDLERS AS USUAL ONF FRIDAY.

FULL GARRISION OF APPROXIMATELY 1,000 TROOPS TOOK POSITIONS IN GHOM WITH CHIEFTAIN TANKS STATIONED AT STRATEGIC CROSSROADS AND NEAR MOSQUE AND SQUADS OF ARMED SOLDIERS SITTING ON THEM. NO LARGE ------------------089570 130205Z /73 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 8296 INFO AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MOSCOW SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 4524 DOMONSTRATIONS TOOK PLACE IN GHOM BUT SITUATION REMAINS TENSE TODAY.

CONSULATES TABRIZ, ISFAHAN AND SHIRAZ CONFIRM HEAVY PRESENCE OF SECURITY TROOPS MAY 11 WITH TENSION BUT NO MAJOR ACTIVITY. CONSULATE ISFAHAN HAS NOT CONFIRMED REPORTS OF SOME RIOTING IN SOUTH PART OF CITY NEAR UNIVERSITY AND IN THE NORTH, AND BUILDING SET AFIRE ON PRINCIPAL AVENUE OF ISFAHAN. CONSULATE SHIRAZ STATES SOME DISORDER OCCURED IN PAHLAVI UNIVERSITY 1900 MAY 11 BUT INCIDENT WAS OVER TWO HOURS LATER WHEN POLICE AND FIRE TRUCKS CALLED IN. UNIVERSITY OF AZARBADEGAN IN TABRIZ AND PAHLAVI IN SHIRAZ, WERE CLOSED. SHIRAZ REPORTS LESS VISIBLE SECURITY MAY 12.

BRITISH EMASSY HAS PICKED UP REPORTS THAT MORE STUDENTS THAN THE THREE REPORTED IN PRESS WERE KILLED IN TABRIZ MONDAY, MAY 8. JOURNALISTIC SOURCE HAS IT FROM POLICE AND PRESS SOURCES THAT AS MANY AS EIGHT PEOPLE MAY HAVE BEEN KILLED IN GHOM RIOTING MAY 9 AND 10. NO POLICE KILLED. ABOUT ONE DOZEN INJURED ALL TOGETHER. THEORY MAKING THE ROUNDS IS THAT DEMONSTRATORS SCHEDULED TABRIZ ON MONDAY, GHOM TUESDAY NIGHT AND WEDNESDAY, AND TEHRAN THURSDAY, SO THAT THEY COULD CONCENTRATE NUMBER OF TRAVELLING AGITATORS FROM CITY TO CITY. WHILE THIS HAS SOME LOGIC TO IT, NO ONE HAS PRODUCED PROOF.

COMMENT: LIMITED SIZE OF DEMONSTRATION IN TEHRAN, PLUS COMPARATIVELY EFFECTIVE WAY IN WHICH MASSIVE GOVERNEMENT SECURITY PRESENCE LIMITED EFFECT OF DEMONSTRATORS IN TEHRAN SUGGEST GOVERNEMENT IS CAPABLE OF PUTTING IT ALL TOGEHTER TO MAINTAIN LAW AND ORDER WITHOUT EXCESSIVE INJURIES AND BLOODSHED. REPORT THAT SHAH PERSONALLY DIRECTED SECURITY FORCES RINGS TRUE TO US. WITH SITUATION IN GHOM AND ELSEWHERE STILL TENSE, IT SEEMS VERY LIKELY SHAH RELUCTANT TO LEAVE ON EAST EUROPEAN TOUR UNTIL THINGS SETTLE DOWN. WE SUSPECT THERE IS MORE THAN HIS LINGERING COLD TO EXPLAIN HIS POSTPONEMENT OF DEPARTURE FROM MAY 12 TO MAY 16 (TEHRAN 4522 NOTAL).
HE WILL PROBABLY WANT TO ASSURE RELATIVE QUIET BEFORE HE DEPARTS. WE WOULD NOT BE SURPRISED TO SEE FURTHER CRACKDOWN, INCLUDING SOME ARRESTS OF OPPOSITION LEADERS.

SUMMARY: AMID CONTINUING CLASHES IN QOM AND OTHER CITIES, GOI HAS ANNOUNCED CRACKDOWN ON DEMONSTRATORS AND A REDUCTION IN PERMISSIVENESS, VARIETY OF GOVERNMENT STATEMENTS INTENDED TO SHOW CONFIDENCE IN FREEDOM OF EXPRESSION BY VAST SILENT MAJORITY COUPLED WITH DETERMINATION TO END OUTRAGES BY FRACTIOUS MINORITY. END SUMMARY

INCIDENTS DESCRIBED IN SOME DETAIL REFTEL YESTERDAY CONTINUED MAY 10, WITH WIDESPREAD CLASHES BETWEEN STUDENTS AND OLDER DEMONSTRATORS IN QOM AND ELSEWHERE WITH GOI SECURITY GORCES, RESULTING IN NUMBER OF INJURIES AND POSSIBLE DEATHS. DESTRUCTION OF PROPERTY REPORTEDLY INCLUDED THE HOMES OF SOME MULLAHS IN QOM, WHILE ON THE OTHER HAND, PHOTOS OF THE ACTION SHOWED MULLAHS INVOLVED WITH DEMONSTRATORS AS WELL.

WE UNDERSTAND SOME MULLAHS IN PLACES SUCH AS KERMANSHAH (NEAR IRAQI BORDER) HAVE SPOKEN UP AGAINST RELIGIOUS VIOLENCE, AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI AND EVEN QOM GROUP HEADED BY AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI, BUT VAST MAJORITY OF RELIGIOUS LEADERS APPEARS TO BE GOING ALONG WITH RESISTANCE LED BY KHOMEINI AND QOM GROUP OR KEEPING THEIR SILENCE

AS REPORTED REFTEL, GOI ISSUED ANNOUNCEMENT OVER RADIO LATE MAY 10 AND IN PRESS MAY 11 THAT "HUMAN RIGHTS VIOLATIONS" BY DEMONSTRATORS WILL NOT BE TOLERATED. GOVERNMENT ARGUMENT IS THAT VAST MAJORITY OF PEACEFUL CITIZENS ARE OUTRAGED BY SMALL MINORITY INTENT ON VIOLENT ACTS IN UNIVERSITIES, AS WELL AS IN CITY STREETS AND RELIGIOUS CNETERS. GOVERNMENT HAS BEEN PERMISSIVE SO AS NOT TO APPEAR REPRESSIVE, BUT TIME HAS COME TO PROTECT THE RIGHTS OF THE PEACEFUL MAJORITY AGAINST SUCH TROUBLE.

PRESS GIVES PROMINENCE TO ANNOUNCEMENT BY PROGRESSIVE WING OF RESURGENCE PARTY, HEADED BY MAJID MAJIDI, THAT ACTION IT HAS CALLED FOR IS IN THE FIELD OF ENLIGHTENMENT AND NOT VENGEANCE. THIS IS OBVIOOUSLY AN ITERATION OF EARLIER MAJIDI EFFORTS TO DISASSOCIATE HIMSELF AND HIS WING OF THE PARTY FROM BOMBINGS AND BEATINGS OF PROMINENT OPPOSITIONISTS BY THE CLANDESTINE GROUP CALLING ITSELF "THE UNDERGROUND GROUP FOR VENGENACE." IT REMAINS TO BE SEEN IF THIS MAJIDI STATEMENT PRESAGES AN END TO VENGEANCE GROUP ACTIVITIES.

ALSO PROMINENT IN THE PRESS IS PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR'S SPEECH TO STUDENT GATHERING CONVOKED BY RASTAKHIZ PARTY, MAY, O, IN WHICH HE URGED STUDENTS TO DISCUSS THEIR IDEAS OPENLY AND WITHOUT RESERVE, SINCE THE FUTURE OF IRAN DEPENDS ON THEIR KNOWLEDGE, TALENT, SINCERITY AND WILLINGNESS TO WORK HARD. AMOUZEGAR NOTED THAT EVEN THE TINIEST EUROPEAN COUNTRIES ARE NOT UNAWARE OF THE FACT THAT THEY MUST BE MILITARILY STRONG TO DEFEND THEMSELVES AGAINST EXTERNAL THREATS. AT THE SAME TIME, EUROPEAN HISTORY INDICATES IMPORTANCE OF ECONOMIC PROGRESS, SINCE COUNTRIES WHICH REMAINED BACKWARD ECONOMICALLY LOST THEIR FORMER PROMINENCE BASED ON POLITICAL POWER.

ALSO IN THE PRESS WAS A REPORT ON SURPRISE VISIT TO SOUTH TEHRAN RESIDENTS BY EMPRESS FARAH APPARENTLY MAY 10, DRIVING AROUND IN A MINIBUS. STORY SAID LARGE CHEERING CROWDS GATHERED AROUND HER AND DISCUSSED THEIR PROBLEMS. IT ALSO STATES THAT SHE HAS MADE MANY SUCH SURPRISE VISITS IN PUBLIC WITHOUT "ANY SECURITY GUARDS." (COMMENT: WE ARE INCLINDED TO DOUBT ABSENCE OF SECURITY GUARDS, THOUGH THEY MAY HAVE BEEN BETTER DISGUISED THAN USUAL ON THIS OCCASION. REASON FORRITEM IN THE PRESS OBVIOUS). ------------------100844 140848Z /10 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 8298 INFO AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY IALAMABAD USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 04526

EMBASSY HAS LEARNED IN CONFIDENCE THAT EFFORTS TO OPEN DIALOGUE BETWEEN THE QOM RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP LED BY AYATOLLAH SHARITMADARI AND THE SHAH HAD MADE SOME PROGRESS PRIOR TO EVENTS MAY 9-10. IT REMAINS TO BE SEEN WHAT EFFECT THOSE EVENTS HAVE. IN ANY CASE, THERE WOULD APPEAR TO BE LITTLE GOI OR RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP CAN DO IN REGARD TO POSSIBLE FURTHER CLASHES TODAY,MAY 11. IT HAS BEEN ANNOUNCED THAT LARGE NUMBRS WILL ATTEND MOURNING CEREMONIES TODAY FOR PEOPLE KILLED IN QOM AND TABRIZ MAY 9, TREATING TODAY AS THE THIRD DAY AFTER THE EVENT.
COUPLED WITH OTHER REPORTS WE HAVE BEEN RECEIVING OF DEMONSTRATIONS IN TEHRAN AND PERHAPS ELSEWHERE, WE CAN EXPECT ANOTHER HOT DAY.

COMMENT: OUR INITIAL ESTIMATE IS THAT GOI ANNOUNCEMENT OF CRACKDOWN WILL EXPRESS ITSELF PRIMARILY IN MORE POLICE AND ARMY FORCES BEING BROUGHT TO BEAR ON DEMONSTRATIONS, RATHER THAN AFFECTING BROADER RANGE OF LAWENFORCEMENT LIBERALIZATION OF RECENT MONTHS. WE HOPE, AND ON THE WHOLE BELIEVE, THE GOI AND SHAH WILL CONTINUE TO EXPLORE POSSIBILITY OF DIALOGUE WITH CONSERVATIVE RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP IN CONTEXT OF SUBSTANTIAL LIBERALIZATIONS, THOUGH COUPLED WITH GREATER EMPHASIS ON NEED TO AVOID FURTHER TROUBLEMAKING IN CITIES AND IN UNIVERSITIES. FURTHER GOI MOVEMENT WILL PROBABLY DEPEND ON OUTCOME OF DIALOGUE AND LEVEL OF VIOLENCE IN NEXT FEW WEEKS.
AMBASSADOR HOPES TO GET A READING OF GOI THINKING WHEN HE SEES AMOUZEGAR EARLY NEXT WEEK.

1978TEHRAN04527.subject: AFGHAN AND SOVIET STATEMENTS DRAW PRESS ATTENTION IN IRAN

segments.text: FALLOUT FROM AFGHAN COUP CONTINUES TO DRAW MEDIA ATTENTION. LOCAL PRESS MAY 11 CARRIED WIRE SERVICE STORIES ON PRESIDENT TARAKI'S "FIRST MAJOR POLICY STATEMENT" EMPHASIZING THAT THE NEW REGIME WISHES "TO STRENGTHEN AND EXPAND FRIENDLY RELATIONS WITH THE GREAT NEIGHBOR IN THE NORTH, THE SOVIET UNION." FACT THAT MAY 9 SPEECH WAS DELIVERED IN PUSHTU LANGUAGE ALSO NOTED HERE.
JOURNAL DE TEHRAN'S MAY 11 EDITORIAL WAS DEVOTED TO COMMENT ON USSR AMBASSADOR'S INTERVIEW IN ISLAMABAD.

ENTITLED "PAKISTAN MUST QUIT CENTO" THE EDITORIAL CHARACTERIZES THE AMBASSADOR'S TONE AS THREATENING WHEN HE REPROACHED PAKISTAN AS "BEING THE FIREND OF OUR ENEMIES AND THE ENEMY OF THE FRIENDS OF THE SOVIET UNION." EDITORIAL FURTHER QUOTES THE AMBASSADOR AS SAYING THAT "FRIENDLY RELATIONS EXIST BETWEEN OUR COUNTRY AND THE TWO NEIGHBORS OF PAKISTAN, INDIA AND AFGHANISTAN, AND SUCH RELATIONS COULD BE ESTABLISHED WITH PAKIST IF IT QUITS CENTO." EDITORIAL NOTES THAT THE USSR "HAS MULTIPLIED ITS EFFORTS DURING THE PAST FEW MONTHS TOWARD THE THREE REGIONAL MEMBERS OF CENTO TO MAKE THEM ABANDON THEIR POLICY AGAINST THE INFLUENCE OF THE USSR IN THE MIDDLE EAST AND ADJACENT REGIONS.

THE EFFORTS OF THE SOVIET GOVERNMENT WERE DIRECTED PARTICULARLY AGAINST TURKEY BECAUSE OF THE DISSENTION BETWEEN THE TURKISH GOVERNMENT AND THE U.S. OVER THE U.S. ARMS EMBARGO. PRESSURE EXERCISED BY THE USSR ON TURKEY IN THIS AREA HAS RESULTED IN THE LIFTING OF THE U.S. EMBARGO. THE AFGHAN COUP REPRESENTS FOR SOVIET DIPLOMACY AN EXCELLENT TRUP TO PRESSURE PAKISTAN....THE INHERENT WEAKNESS OF THE PAKISTAN STATE ORGANIZATION, AGGRAVATED BY POLITICAL INITIATIVES OF THE PRESENT LEADERS, IS ANOTHER 'TRUMP' FOR THE USSR." EDITORIAL CONCLUDES, "FOR THE MOMENT IRANIAN DIPLOMACY REMAINS PRUDENT TOWARD KABUL.

THE IRANIAN AMBASSADOR HAS RETURNED TO HIS POST AND HIS CONTACTS WITH THE NEW LEADERS WILL PERMIT THE GOI TO STUDY THE POSITION WHICH IT WILL ADOPT TOWARD ITS EASTERN NEIGHBOR AND TO RESUME ITS FORMER INITIATIVES SUPPORTING PEACE IN THIS REGION AND ESPECIALLY THE NON-INTERVENTION OF THE (MAJOR) POWERS."

COMMENT: PRESS REPORTS CARRIED LOCALLY CONTINUE TO EMPHASIZE THREATENING CHARACTER OF NEW REGIME TO BASIC IRANIAN INTERESTS. SOVIET INTERVIEW PLAYED UP IN JOURNAL DE TEHERAN APPEARS TO BE PRESS STATEMENT MADE BY AMBASSADOR AZIMOV IN APRIL PRIOR TO AFGHAN COUP BUT ONLY PUBLISHED IN EARLY MAY BY URDU ISLAMABAD WEEKLY NEWSPAPER. COINCIDING WITH COUP, THIS INTERVIEW HAS SERVED UP "ONE-TWO PUNCH" TO IRANIAN OBSERVERS.

1978TEHRAN04531.subject: THE "NEUTRON BOMB" ISSUE AT THE UN SPECIAL SESSION ON DISARMAMENT

segments.text: POL-MIL COUNS DISCUSSED SPECIAL SESSION ON DISARMAMENT (SSOD) WITH FOURTH POLITICAL DEPARTMENT HEAD GOODARZNIA AND INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS DEPARTMENT DEPUTY HEAD DABIRI (IN ABSENCE IO DEPARTMENT HEAD EHSASSI) MAY 11 DRAWING ON REFTEL. POL-MIL COUNS STRESSED US INTEREST IN HAVING SERIOUS, CONSTRUCTIVE SSOD THAT MIGHT LEAD TO EXPANDING ARMS CONTROL AREAS OF AGREEMENT, AS OPPOSED TO STERILE, PROPAGANDA EXERCISE FOCUSING ON DISAGREEMENTS, AND HOPED THAT OTHERS WHO SUPPORTED USEFUL SSOD WOULD WORK TO AVOID HAVING IT BECOME PROPAGANDA VEHICLE. POLMIL COUNS USED ENHANCED RADIATION WEAPON AS CURRENT EXAMPLE OF PROPAGANDA ITEM THAT US HOPED TO AVOID IF SSOD WAS TO MAKE CONSTRUCTIVE CONSTRIBUTION.

DABIRI SAID GOI SHARES US AIM FOR SSOD, AND PREPARED TO WORK FOR CONSTRUCTIVE RESULTS. DABIRI SAID HE WOULD REPORT DISCUSSION WITH POL-MIL COUNS "TO HIS SUPERIORS". DABIRI ASKED ABOUT POSSIBLE CHANGES IN DISARMAMENT MACHINERY WHICH ARE BEING DISCUSSED. POL-MIL COUNS SAID HE HAD BEEN AWAY FROM ARMS CONTROL FOR SEVERAL YEARS, BUT PERSONALLY FELT IT UNNECESSARY TO CREATE NEW FORUM; IMPORTANT THING WAS TO MAKE CONSTRUCTIVE AND SERIOUS USE OF CCD, AND AMPLE ALL AUTUMN OPPORTUNITY EACH YEAR FOR DISARMAMENT DISCUSSION IN UN, INCLUDING GENERAL ASSEMBLY GENERAL DEBATE AND MORE SPECIFICALLY IN FIRST COMMITTEE.

MOST IMPORTANT LESSON LEARNED FROM EARLIER ENDC, NOW CCD EXPERIENCE IS NEED FOR EXPERT DISCUSSION, OUT OF THE LIMELIGHT, IN RELATIVELY SMALL FORUM IF ONE IS SERIOUSLY SEEKING PROGRESS TOWARDS ARMS CONTROL AGREEMENTS. POL-MIL COUNS UNDERSCORED ESSENTIALITY OF CONSENSUS, RATHER THAN VOTING, APPROACH IN ANY SUCH FORUM.

DABIRI AGREED ENTIRELY, AND WENT ON TO ASK ABOUT CO-CHAIRMAN ARRANGEMENT. POL-MIL COUNS SAID AGAIN HE COULD ONLY GIVE PERSONAL VIEW, TO WIT: THAT IF ONE GIVES UP THE CO-CHAIRMAN ARRANGEMENT ONE SHOULD GET SOMETHING IN EXCHANGE, AND IT SEEMED TO HIM THAT FRENCH (AND IDEALLY PRC) MEMBERSHIP IN THE ARMS CONTROL NEGOTIATING FORUM WOULD BE EXCELLENT RETURN IN EXCHANGE FOR GIVING UP CO-CHAIRMANSHIP.
POL-MIL COUNS CONCLUDED BY STRESSING US INTEREST IN CONSTRUCTIVE, NON-PROPAGANDISTIC SSOD. DABIRI AFFIRMED THAT GOI SHARED THIS AIM AND WOULD WORK TO ACHIEVE IT.

WHEN I MET WITH FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY AFTERNOON MAY 11, I ASKED WHETHER AGHA SHAHI, DURING HIS TEHRAN SOJOURN, HAD RAISED THE QUESTION OF BHUTTO'S FATE. KHALATBARY SAID AGHA SHAHI HAD SAID "NOT A WORD". THE IRANIANS HAD EXPECTED THAT HE WOULD AT LEAST ACKNOWLEDGE IRANIAN PLEAS WHICH HAD BEEN MADE TO SPARE BHUTTO'S LIFE. IN THE ABSENCE OF ANY INITIATIVE BY SHAHI, THE IRANIANS DID NOT PURSUE THE SUBJECT.

I TOLD KHALATBARY THAT TURKISH AMBASSADOR TOLD ME HIS GOVERNMENT HAD OFFERED TO TAKE BHUTTO IN EXILE IN TURKEY, BUT THE PAKISTANIS DID NOT APPEAR INTERESTED. KHALATBARY SAID THAT, AT ONE POINT A FEW WEEKS AGO, THE PAKISTANI AMBASSADOR HERE HAD BROACHED THE IDEA OF EXILE IN IRAN. HE HAD THEN COME BACK A FEW DAYS LATER TO SAY THAT HIS GOVERNMENT HAD CHANGED ITS MIND AND WAS THINKING OF EXILE FOR BHUTTO IN CHINA, WHERE HIS POLITICAL ACTIVITIES MIGHT BE MORE EFFECTIVELY CONTROLLED.

COMMENT: ALL THIS CHATTER ABOUT EXILE FOR BHUTTO SEEMS TO SUGGEST THAT ZIA IS SERIOUSLY CONSIDERING A COMMUTATION OF THE DEATH SENTENCE. DOES DEPARTMENT OR ISLAMABAD HAVE ANY INDICATION THAT CHINA WOULD SERIOUSLY ACCEPT BHUTTO UNDER THE TERMS THE PAKISTANIS APPARENTLY WISH TO PROPOSE?

1978TEHRAN04547.subject: POLICY PROSPECTS FOR NEAR FUTURE IN AFGHANISTAN

segments.text: AS REPORTED REF A, I DUTIFULLY GAVE FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY GIST OF REF B, WHICH REPRESENTED PRELIMINARY WASHINGTON VIEWS ON NEW STRATEGIC SITUATION RESULTING FROM COUP IN AFGHANISTAN. GIVEN THE RECENCY OF EVENTS IN KABUL AND THE DIFFICULTY IN DISCERNING THE FUTURE OF AFGHANISTAN, IT WAS UNDERSTANDABLY PRETTY THIN GRUEL.

IN XAMINING OUR POLICY PROSPECTS FOR THE NEAR FUTURE, I AM CONCERNED THAT, TO ALL EXTERNAL APPEARACNES, OUR GRUEL IS GOIN TO GET EVEN THINNER. AS WE LOOK AHEAD, THE ACTIONS WHICH WE WILL BE ABLE TO TAKE, AND THE INACTION WHICH WILL BE FORCED UPON US, ALL CONSPIRE TO CREATE EXACTLY THE WRONG SIGNALS TO MOSCOW AND OTHER INCIPIENT MALEFACTORS AS WELL AS TO THOSE FRIENDS WHICH MAY FEEL THREATENED AND INSECURE IN THE CURRENT CIRCUMSTANCES.

IT IS OBVIOUS, GIVEN THE POTENTIAL THAT AFGHANISTAN REPRESENTS FOR SOVIET MISCHIEF-MAKING IN THIS REGION, THAT WE SHOULD BE MOVING TO STRENGTHEN NOT ONLY THE POLITICAL WILL BUT ALOS THE MATERIAL MEANS OF OUR LOCAL FRIENDS TO PROTECT AND PRESERVE THEIR INTEGRITIES. ABOVE ALL, THIS MEANS THAT WE SHOULD ACT TO ENHANCE THE STRENGTH OF THE REGIONAL MEMBERS OF CENTO.

HOWEVER, IF WE EXAMINE OUR POSSIBILITIES FOR DOING JUST THAT IN THE NEAR TERM, THEY LOOK VERY BLEAK INDEED. IN THE CASE OF TURKEY, ALL REPORTS FROM WASHINGTON INDICATE THAT THE PROSPECTS FOR GETTING THE CONGRESS TO LIFT THE BAN ON THE PROVISION OF MILITARY EQUIPMENT TO THE TURKS ARE VERY DIM. IN THE CASE OF PAKISTAN, THE INHIBITIONS ON ASSISTANCE ARISING FROM THE PAKISTANI INSISTENCE ON ITS REPROCESSING PLANT SEEM BOUND TO STYMIE ANY EFFECTIVE AID TO THAT COUNTRY.

WHILE THE PROSPECTS FOR IRAN SEEM SOMEWHAT BRIGHTER THAN FOR THE OTHER TWO, CURRENT PERCEPTIONS OF THIS COUNTRY IN THE UNITED STATES MAY BECOME INCREASINGLY AND NEGATIVELY PREJEDUCED BY THE POLITICAL UNREST BEING MANIFESTED HERE.

IN SHORT, UNLESS WASHINGTON TAKES ACTION TO TURN THESE SITUATIONS AROUND, WE ARE GOING TO FIND OURSELVES IN A POSTURE OF HAND-WRINGING DESPAIR WHICH MAY ENCOURAGE MOSCOW TO MOVE MORE SMARTLY AND MORE RECKLESSLY TO STIR UP TROUBLE AMONG THE PUSHTUNS AND THE BALUCHIS, USING THEIR NEW AFGHANISTANI ASSETS MUCH SOONER THAN WE ANTICIPATE.

IT THEREFORE SEEMS TO ME THAT WASHINGTON NEEDS TO ORGANIZE AN EFFORT TO REMEDY THIS SITUATION IN AN INGEGRATED WASY AND MOVE BEYOND THE CASE-BY-CASE TREATMENT WHICH HAS HITHERTO CHARACTERIZED OUR ACTIONS IN THIS AREA. THIS REQUIRES AN EDUCATIONL EFFORT WITHIN OUR OWN GOVERNMENT, PARTICULARLY WITH THE CONGRESS, TO DEMONSTRATE THE LARGER IMPLICATIONS FOR RISK TO THE PERSIAN GULF AND ULTIMATELY TO THE ENERGY SUPPLIES OF WEST EUROPE AND JAPAN IF THE CENTO TIER CRUMBLES. IT REQUIRES AN INTERNATIONAL CONCERT SO THA T OUR NATO ALLIES, JAPAN, AND EVEN CHINA ARE SENSITIZED TO THE NEED FOR CONTRIBUTING TO THE STABILIZATION OF THIS AREA.
AND IT REQUIRES A CAREFUL ORDERING OF OUR OWN POLICY PRIORITIES, SO THAT WE DO NOT JEOPARDIZE VITAL INTERESTS BY MINDLESS PURSUIT OF MERELY DESIRABLE ONES.

AS AN EXAMPLE OF THE SORT OF COMPLEX ISSUE WHICH NEEDS TO BE SURMOUNTED SOONEST, I OFFER THE PAKISTAN REPROCESSING ------------------101055 141123Z /16 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 8311 INFO AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY LONDON USLO PEKING AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY TOKYO USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE CINCPAC SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 4547 LIMDIS PLANT. WHILE IT HAS SPORADICALLY ATTRACTED THE ATTENTION OF SENIOR POLICY MAKERS, IT HAS BEEN LARGELY ADDRESSED, ON OUR PART, BY TECHNICAL EXPERTS INTHEFIELD OF NUCLEAR POLICY.

WE NEED TO PULL TOGETHER AN APPROACH TO THIS PROBLEM WHICH WILL INVOLVE OURSELVES, THE FRENCH, THE IRANIANS, THE INDIANS, AND POSSIBLY EVEN THE CHINESE. THERE MUST BE MORE THAN JUST A MORAL DISSUASION OF THE PAKISTANIS FROM THEIR FOLLY. THEY MUST BE PRESENTED WITH AN OPPORTUNITY TO BE ABLE TO CHANGE THEIR PLANS IN RETURN FOR CERTAIN BENEFITS THAT MAKESUCH A CHANGE PALATABLE. THIS MAY INVOLVE ARRANGEMENTS WITH RESPECT TO BHUTTO, UNDERTAINING OF A SPECIFIC QUALITY BY INDIA, AID MEASURES FROM A BROADENED CONSORTIUM, AND PERHAPS SOME FIRM DIALOGUE WITH THE SOVIETS AND THE AFGHANS.

MY POINT, HOWEVER, IS THAT ALL OF THIS NEEDS TO BE PERCEIVED AS BEING PART OF A WIDER AND DEEPER EFFORT TO STRENGTHEN AND STIFFEN THE CAPABILITIES OF OUR FRIENDS IN THIS REGION TO RESIST THE DANGERS WHICH THEY FEAR AND TO PRESERVE THE INTERESTS WHICH ARE VITAL TO NATO AND JAPAN. WE AND OUR ALLIES AND OUR FRIENDS NEED TO BE SEEN AS GALVANIZED RATHER THAN ANESTHETIZED. THIS DOES NOT MEAN THAT WE NEED OVER-REACT IN AFGHANISTAN OR "WRITE IT OFF".

IT DOES MEAN, HOWEVER, THAT WE SHOULD IMMEDIATELY TAKE ACTION TO UNDO THE CONTORTED POSTURE OF INACTION INTO WHICH WE HAVE BEEN TWISTED BY EVENTS OF THE PAST FEW YEARS AND MAKE OURSELVES CAPABLE OF LEADING A POSITIVE POLICY IN THIS REGION. 1978TEHRAN04578.subject: TRAVEL OF JOSEPH DI GIORGIO, ASSISTANT DIRECTOR, GAO

1978TEHRAN04582.subject: GOI DISCOURAGEMENT OF DISSIDENT POLITICAL ACTION

segments.text: I MET WITH PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR AFTERNOON MAY 14 TO DISCUSS CASES OF VIOLENCE AGAINST NATIONAL FRONT DISSIDENTS BY "UNDERGROUND REVENGE COMMITTEE". I REMINDED AMOUZEGAR OF OUR EARLIER DISCUSSION OF HIS PLAN TO MOBILIZE "SILENT MAJORITY" AND MY EXPRESSED CONCERN THAT THIS EFFORT SHOULD NOT DEGENERATE INTO STRONG-ARM TACTICS.

I SAID THAT PATTERN OF EVENTS WAS SUCH THAT THE BOMBINGS AND BEATINGS SEEMED TO HAVE TOLERANCE OF GOVERNMENT. IN FACT, THE CONVENTIONAL WISDOM WAS THAT THEY WERE THE WORK OF SAVAK. I SUGGESTED THAT THESE ACTIONS WERE NOT ONLY COUNTERPRODUCTIVE, BUT CONTRARY TO ASSURANCES HE HAD GIVEN ME ABOUT VIOLENCE.

AMOUZEGAR SAID THAT HE SHARED MY VIEW THAT THE BOMBINGS AND BEATINGS WERE COUNTERPRODUCTIVE AND HAD SERIOUSLY DAMAGED IRAN'S REPUTATION ABROAD. HE SAID THE "UNDERGROUND REVENGE COMMITTEE" WAS NOT PART OF HIS SILENT MAJORITY. HE HAD ASKED THE JUSTICE MINISTRY TO INVESTIGATE THEM AND HAD INSTRUCTED THE INFORMATION MINISTRY TO CONDEMN THEM. HE HAD BEEN ASSURED THEY WERE NOT RPT NOT SAVAK, BUT HE WAS AT A LOSS TO SAY WHO THEY WERE. HE SAID HIS EFFORTS TO APPREHEND THEM WERE CONTINUING.

COMMENT: I THINK AMOUZEGAR IS PROBABLY SINCERE IN HIS PROTESTATIONS ON THIS SUBJECT. HE HAS HAD THE PRESS SPEAK OUT AGAINST THE BOMBINGS AND BEATINGS. NONE HAS OCCURRED FOR SEVERAL DAYS. WE SHALL OBSERVE TO LEARN WHETHER THE CAMPAIGN IS FINISHED.

1978TEHRAN04583.subject: MORE INCIDENTS, SUPPORT EXPRESSED FOR GOVERNMENT CRACKDOWN

segments.text: SUMMARY: RIOTS IN TEHRAN MAY 11; QOM REMAINS UNDER MARTIAL LAW. TEACHERS, STUDENTS, LABOR SUPPORT GOI'S DECISION TO CRACK DOWN ON LAW-BREAKING DEMONSTRATORS. SHAH CALLED FOR CONTINUED LIBERALIZATION WITHOUT VIOLENCE. GOI APOLOGIZES FOR INTRUSION INTO RELIGIOUS LEADER'S QOM HOME. SEVERAL MORE ARRESTS FOR VIOLENCE. RUMORS CONTINUE. END SUMMARY.

PRESS MAY 14 REPORTS 100 ARRESTS IN SOUTH TEHRAN MAY 11 AS RESULT OF RIOTING WHICH ATTACKED SHOPS, BANKS AND VEHICLES (ISOLATED RIOTING REPORTEDLY CONTINUED AFTER MAIN BAZAAR INCIDENT) FOR MORE THAN FOUR HOURS. QOM REMAINS UNDER MARTIAL LAW, BUT CITY REMAINED QUIET THROUGH MORNING MAY 14.

VARIOUS GROUPS OVER PAST FEW DAYS HAVE STRONGLY SUPPORTED GOI'S ANNOUNCEMENT THAT ILLEGAL ACTIVITY BY DEMONSTRATORS WILL NOT BE TOLERATED. ON MAY 11, PARLIAMENTARY DEPUTIES SPOKE IN FAVOR OF GOVERNMENT DECLARATION AND DREW APPLAUSE FROM THE FLOOR. LEADERS OF IRANIAN WORKER'S ORGANIZATION AS WELL AS TEHRAN'S 145 TRADE GUILDS ISSUED STATEMENTS SUPPORTING GOI STAND AGAINST DESTRUCTION OF PROPERTY AND INTIMIDATION OF BUSINESSMEN BY RELIGIOUS DISSIDENTS WHO TRIED TO SHUT DOWN BUSINESSES.

PRESS REPORTS TEACHING STAFFS OF TEHRAN'S MAJOR UNIVERSITIES EXPRESSED "FULL SUPPORT" FOR GOI MOVES TO END CAMPUS UNREST AND "HOOLIGANISM IN THE STREETS". IN LETTER TO PRIME MINISTER, SUBSTANTIAL NUMBERS OF TEHRANBASED FACULTY MEMBERS CALLED FOR RESPECT OF INDIVIDUAL RIGHTS AND RULE OF LAW. NUMBER OF PERSIANS IN MANY SOCIAL GROUPINGS ARE QUITE FRANKLY RELIEVED BY GOI CRACKDOWN STATEMENT, WHICH MAY DO AS MUCH TO CLEAR AIR AND RESTORE CONFIDENCE AS ACTUAL POLICE ACTIVITY. SEVERAL SOURCES REPORT POLICE NOT PLANNING ANY MAJOR CHANGES IN THEIR ACTIVITIES OTHER THAN MOVING IN A LITTLE EARLIER ON POTENTIAL DEMONSTRATIONS BEFORE THEY HAVE A CHANGE TO BUILD UP STEAM.

DURING PRESS CONFERENCE WHICH BEING REPORTED IN DETAIL SEPTEL, SHAH STATED THAT RECENT GOVERNEMENT STATEMENT INDICATING HARD LINE AGAINST VIOLENT DEMONSTRATORS DID NOT RPT NOT MEAN DECISION HAD BEEN MADE TO HALT POLITICAL LIBERALIZATION. SHAH STRESSED THAT LEGAL LIBERTIES WOULD BE BROADENED, BUT LAW-BREAKING AND VIOLENCE AGAINST LIVES AND PROPERTY WOULD BE SEVERALY PUNISHED. IN PERIPHERALLY-RELATED EVENT, STUDENT SEMINAR ON IRANIAN ISSUES CALLED FOR RESURGENCE PARTY TO CURTAIL INTERFERENCE IN EDUCATION AND FOR ESTABLISHMENT OF AN EDUCATION CORPS TO UNDERTAKE IRAN'S POLITICAL, SOCIAL, AND ECONOMIC TRAINING.

STUDENT SEMINAR CALLED FOR NUMBER OF OTHER IMPROVEMENTS IN EDUCATION, INCLUDING STUDENT PARTICIPATION IN ALL NON-ACADEMIC DECISIONS AND JOINT MEETINGS WITH ADMINISTRATORS AND PROFESSORS TO IRON OUT PROBLEMS.

PRESS MAY 14 ALSO REPORTS GOI APOLOGY TO UNNAMED RELIGIOUS LEADER FOR POLICE INTRUSION INTO HIS HOME IN QOM LAST WEEK. GOI STATEMENT EXPRESSED "DEEP REGRET" AND NOTED POLICE WERE NOT LOCAL RESIDENTS OF QOM AND DID NOT REALIZE THEY WERE ENTERING RELIGIOUS LEADER'S HOUSE. GOI STATEMENT NOTED "RIOTERS" INSIDE HOUSE CONTINUED TO CHANT ANTI-NATIONAL SLOGANS AND ATTACK POLICE, DURING WHICH TWO RIOTERS WERE WOUNDED. ONE OF THEM SUBSEQUENTLY DIED. OTHER SOURCE TELLS US HOME BELONGED TO AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI, LEADING QOM AYATOLLAH.

SEVERAL ADDITONAL ARRESTS OF INDIVIDUALS FOR ANTISTATE ACTIVITY HAVE TAKEN PLACE OVER PAST FEW DAYS. MOST NOTABLE WAS ARREST IN ABADAN OF THEOLOGY STUDENT MOHAMMAD HOSSAIN RAMSHAHRI AS HE WAS BOARDING PLANE FOR TEHRAN. ACCORDING TO POLICE, RAMSHARI HAD GIVEN HEATED SERMON MAY 10 AT BEHBAHANI MOSQUE IN ABADAN AND HAS ADMITTED BEING SENT TO ABADAN FROM QOM BY ANOTHER QOM RESIDENT WHOSE NAME WAS WITHHELD BY POLICE. THISIS FIRST PUBLIC INDICATION OF STORY WE HAVE HEARD PRIVATELY FROM NUMBER OF SOURCES THAT RELIGIOUS LEADERS IN QOM HAVE BEEN COORDINATING MUCH RELIGIOUS DISSIDENT ACTIVITY BY MESSENGER AND TELEPHONE FROM THEIR HEADQUARTERS IN QOM.

NUMBER OF RUMORS ABOUND THAT THERE MAY BE ADDITIONAL DEMONSTRATIONS IN TEHRAN, MONDAY, MAY 15. ONE SOURCE SAID LEAFLETS HAVE BEEN PASSED OUT CALLING FOR DEMONSTRATIONS AND FOR PEOPLE TO STAY OUT OF DOWNTOWN AREA WITH VEHICLES. POLICE REMAIN ON ALERT.

1978TEHRAN04584.subject: SHAH SPEAKS OUT AGAINST DISSIDENTS- AND MENTIONS U.S.

segments.text: SHAH GAVE 90 MINUTE INTERVIEW TO IRANIAN MEMBERS OF LOCAL MEDIAA ON MAY 13 IN WHICH HE CHARACTERIZED RIOTERS AS "INDIVIDUALS WANTING TO CONVERT IRAN INTO "IRANISTAN", ADDING THAT "WE WILL NOT PERMIT IRAN TO BE DIVIDED INTO ZONES OF INFLUENCE AS PLOTTED BY FOREIGN POWERS EARLY THIS CENTURY. IRAN IS INDIVISIBLE". CONTINUING HIS "FOREIGN DEVILS" THEME, THE SHAH SAID, "IF YOU REVIEW THE PAGES OF HISTORY YOU WILL CLEARLY SEE THAT NATIONAL EVENTS HAVE REPEATED THEMSELVES. IN 1907 IRAN WAS DIVIDED BETWEEN RUSSIA AND BRITAIN.

IN 1945 THE FOREIGN MTERS OF BRITAIN AND AMERICA (IN FARSI TEXT, "BEVIN AND WELLES") PROPOSED TO SOVIET FOREIGN MINISTER MOLOTOV THAT IRAN BE DIVIDED INTO THE REPUBLICS OF AZARBAIJAN, KURDESTAN AND KHUZESTAN-- LET ALONE THE EVENTS OF 1919 WHEN THE COUNTRY WAS WHOLLY DELIVERED TO THE BRITISH."

IN A RELATED ANSWER, SHAH TERMED THOSE WHO WANT A RETURN TO THE CONSTITION AS "THE SAME GENTLEMEN WHO RAISED GLASSES OF WINE IN A TOAST TO PISHEVARI (A MOSCOW BASED SEPARATIST) MORE THAN THIRTY YEARS AGO. THESE PEOPLE ARE POLITICALLY BANKRUPT CASES WHOSE ONLY HOPE IS THE DISMEMBERMENT OF IRAN IN THE 1907 STYLE. WHENEVER THE CENTRAL GOVERNMENT BECAME WEAK, THE QUESTION OF IRAN'S PARTITION CAME TO THE FORE. THEIR ONLY HOPE IS FOR IRAN TO BE PARTITIONED INTO TWO LARGE STATES. THEY RECKON THEY CAN PERHAPS STAY IN POWER IN THE SOUTH AFTER AN AGREEMENT WITH THE TUDEH (OUTLAWED COMMUNIST PARTY OF IRAN).

BUT THERE ARE NO TRIBES IN THE SOUTH ANYMORE." (FYI: THIS LAST COULD BE VEILED WARNING ALSO TO FOREIGN MEDDLERS, SUCH AS NEW AFGHAN REGIME AND ITS RELATIONSHIP WITH BALUCHIS.) SPECIFICALLY REFERRING TO MAY 11 DEMONSTRATION AT TEHRAN BAZAAR (REPORTED SEPTEL) THE SHAH SAID, " SOME PEOPLE EVEN WAVED FLAGS WITH SPECIAL EMBLEMS. WELL, THEIR INTENTIONS COULD NOT HAVE BEEN STATED MORE CLEARLY," AN OBVIOUS REFERENCE TO THE HAMMER AND SICKLE BANNERS CARRIED BY SOME DEMONSTRATORS.

IN A MORE DEFENSIVE VEIN, THE SHAH SAID THAT THERE WERE OF COURSE SOME GENUINE CASES OF DISCONTENT CAUSED BY FAULTY DECISIONS BY GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS. BUT THESE PROBLEMS WERE KNOWN, WERE BEING TACKLED AND THERE WAS NO REASON THEREFORE FOR THOSE WHO WERE DISCONTENT TO DESTROY THEIR OWN NATION IN REVENGE. THE SHAH ADDED THAT THE RECENT STATEMENT PLEDGING TOUGH MEASURES AGAINST RIOTERS (TEHRAN 4526) IN NO WAY INDICATED A DECISION TO SLOW DOWN OR HALT THE POLITICAL LIBERALIZATION PROGRAM.

IN RESPONSE TO ONE OF THE FEW FOREIGN POLICY QUESTIONS, THE SHAH EXPRESSED HOPE THAT PARTITION OF PAKISTAN "DOES NOT OCCUR BECAUSE IT WILL DRASTICALLY CHANGE THE GEOPOLITICAL SITUATION IN THE REGION. SUCH DEVELOPMENTS ON IRAN'S EASTERN BORDERS HAVE DEMONSTRATED ONCE AGAIN THE NECESSITY FOR IRAN TO REINFORCE ITS DEFENSIVE STRATEGY."

COMMENT: PURPORTED REASON SHAH POSTPONED MAY 12-16 STATE VISIT TO BULGARIA (DIPLOMATIC "LINGERING COLD") WAS NOT IN EVIDENCE DURING INTERVIEW. HIS RESPONSES TO REPORTERS QUESTIONS GIVE IMPRESSION THAT SHAH WAS LETTING OFF STEAM AND VENTING FRUSTRATION AT THE UNRELENTING DOMESTIC CRITICISM OF HIS REGIME AND THE THREATENING FOREIGN DEVELOPMENTS IN NEIGHBORING AFGHANISTAN AND PAKISTAN. REGARDING SHAH'S ASSERTION ABOUT "BEVIN AND WELLES" PARA 1, WOULD APPRECIATE HISTORICAL DATA OF THAT EVENT WHICH AMBASSADOR MIGHT USE AT SOME EARLY OPPORTUNITY TO SET RECORD STRAIGHT AT LEAST WITH SHAH HIMSELF.

ANNOUNCEMENT HAS BEEN MADE OF THE APPOINTMENT OF HASSAN IZADI AS GOI AMBASSADOR TO OMAN. IZADI, 54, (NOT TO BE CONFUSED WITH FORMER NIOC OFFICIAL OF SAME NAME) HAS MOST RECENTLY SERVED AS CHARGE D'AFFAIRES AT GOI EMBASSY IN COLOMBO.

ACCORDING TO SKETCHY BIOGRAPHIC DETAILS AVAILABLE, IZADI RECEIVED A DOCTORATE IN LAW FROM THE SORBONNE AND HAS SERVED IN GOI MISSION IN NEW YORK AND AS MINISTER AT EMBASSY IN WASHINGTON. FROM AT LEAST 1974 UNTIL 1976 HE WAS HEAD OF THE 9TH POLITICAL DEPARTMENT (PERSIAN GULF), MFA. IN 1976 WHEN IRAN OPENED A RESIDENT EMBASSY IN COLOMBO, IZADI WAS POSTED AS CHARGE. HE AND HIS WIFE SPEAK FLUENT ENGLISH AND HAVE TWO CHILDREN WHO ATTENDED HIGH SCHOOL AND COLLGE IN THE U.S.

FORMER EMBASSY CONTACT FOUND IZADI VERY FRIENDLY, VERY PRO-AMERICAN BUT NOT PARTICULARLY CAPABLE. IF EMBASSY COLOMBO HAS MORE UP-TO-DATE ASSESSMENT OF IZADI'S PERFORMANCE WHILE IN SRI LANKA, THAT WOULD BE APPRECIATE.

ENROUTE TO PEKING PRESIDENT CEAUSESCU SPENT TWO HOURS ON THE GROUND IN TEHRAN EVENING OF MAY 14, HELICOPTERING FROM AIRPORT TO NIAVARAN PALACE FOR MEETING WITH THE SHAH. MRS. CEAUSESCU AND ROMANIAN AMBASSADOR TO IRAN MET SEPARATELY WITH THE EMPRESS. LOCAL PRESS REPORTS, LIGHT ON SUBSTANCE OF VISIT, SPECULATE THAT THE ROMANIAN PRESIDENT MAY ACT AS DIPLOMATIC MIDDLEMAN IN CURRENT BORDER CLASH BETWEEN CHINESE AND SOVIETS WHILE IN PEKING.

ROMANIAN EMBOFF TOLD US THAT SHAH AND CEAUSESCU MET ALONE FOR ONE HOUR AND FIFTY MINUTES. AS FAR AS EMBASSY IS AWARE DISCUSSION CENTERED ABOUT BILATERAL RELATIONS, PARTICULARLY THE SHAH'S PLANNED VISIT IN SEPTEMBER TO ROMANIA. EMBOFF CHARACTERIZED TALKS AS CORDIAL AND NOTED THA CEAUSESCU SEEMED PLEASED WITH HIS VISIT. WHILE PRINCIPALS WERE MEETING, REST OF PARTY, INCLUDING RESPECTIVE FOREIGN MINISTERS, REMAINED AT AIRPORT, WHERE INFORMAL DISCUSSION FOCUSED ON ITINERARY OF TRIP WHICH INCLUDES IN ADDITION TO THE PRC, NORTH KOREA, LAOS, CAMBODIA AND VIETNAM WITH A RETURN THROUGH KARACHI. APPARENTLY THE ROMANIANS ARE FACING WITH SOME TREPIDATION THE LONG, HOT JOURNEY THROUGH ASIA.

COMMENT: THIS IS SECOND HIGH LEVEL MEETING BETWEEN GOI AND ROMANIAN OFFICIALS WITHIN TWO DAYS. IRANIAN PARLIAMENTARY DELEGATION HEADED BY SENATE PRESIDENT SHARIF EMAMI IS CURRENTLY VISITING ROMANIA AND HELD ONE HOUR MEETING WITH CEAUSESCU ON MAY 13. SHAH'S BILATERAL WAS MADE POSSIBLE AS RESULT OF HIS POSTPONEMENT OF BULGARIAN STATE VISIT ORIGINALLY SCHEDULED FOR MAY 12-16.

RUMORS WERE RIFE MAY 14 THAT DRIVERS AND OTHERS WOULD DEMONSTRATE AGAINST HIGH PRICE OF GASOLINE MAY 15 BY ATTACKING VEHICLES THAT MOVED AROUND THE CITY THAT DAY. THIS BROUGHT MOST SCHOOL BUS SERVICES TO A HALT, THUS VIRTUALLY SHUTTING DOWN MANY SCHOOLS, AND MADE TEHRAN TRAFFIC BEARABLE ONCE AGAIN, FOR THOSE OF US WHO DROVE TOWORK ANYWAY. DESPITE REPORTS THAT ARMOR WAS STATIONED ON CITY STREETS, THOROUGH RECONNAISSANCE BY DAO IN MANY CITY AREAS UNCOVERED ONLY GROUPS OF ARMY TROOPS WITH A COUPLE OF BIG WRECKERS, ONE OR TWO BULLDOZERS AND A TRUCK AND COMMAND JEEP AT KEY INTERSECTIONS.
ALSO MORE THAN USUAL POLICE VEHICLES AND TRUCKSBUT NO VISIBLE RIOT POLICE. FEWER PEOPLE THAN USUAL, PARTICULARLY WOMEN, ON THE STREETS.
THREE ARMISH MAAG CARS (ONE OFFICIAL, TWO PRIVATE) WERE DISCOVERED MAY 14 SPRAY PAINTED IN PERSIAN "DEATH TO THE SHAH". THIS IS ISOLATED INCIDENT, AND WE ARE NOT GIVING IT PUBLICITY.

WITNESSES HAVE SEEN CITY FIRE TRUCKS HEADED TOWARD SOUTH PART OF CITY, ALTHOUGH NO ONE HAS YET REPORTED SEEING ANY FIRES OR BURNING CARS AS RUMOR WOULD HAVE IT. WE ARE THEREFORE REPORTING AS OF COB TEHRAN WITH VERY INCOMPLETE INFORMATION ON EXACT EVENTS IN THE CITY TODAY. AS WE CONTEMPLATE DRIVING HOME THROUGH BEAUTIFULLY THIN TRAFFIC WE CAN FACETIOUSLY ADD THERE IS AT LEAST ONE GOOD THING ABOUT TENSION BUILT FROM RUMOR MONGERING; TRAFFIC MOVES.

1978TEHRAN04693.subject: IRANIAN ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING UNIFIL PRESS MAY 15 CARRIED MFA SPOKESMAN'S ANNOUNCEMENT THAT IRAN WILL WITHDRAW ITS CONTINGENT TO UNIFIL SCHEDULED

segments.text: PRESS MAY 15 CARRIED MFA SPOKESMAN'S ANNOUNCEMENT THAT IRAN WILL WITHDRAW ITS CONTINGENT TO UNIFIL SCHEDULED ARRIVE MAY 20 IF CONTINGENT IS FORCED TO DO ANY FIGHTING. MFA INFORMS US THIS POSITION HAS BEEN OFFICIALLY COMMUNICATED TO SYG WALDHEIM AND IS OFFICIAL GOI REACTION TO REPORTS THAT UNIFIL FORCES MAY GET INVOLVED IN FIGHTING WITH VARIETY OF PARTIES IN SOUTH LEBANON.

TEHRAN JOURNAL MAY 16 EDITION CARRIED UNATTRIBUTED ARTICLE ON EDITORIAL PAGE ENTITLED "BUILDING A NEW AFGHANISTAN". ARTICLE CONTAINS INSET WITH FOLLOWING DESCRIPTION OF AUTHOR: "THE WRITER OF THIS DESPATCH HAS BEEN IN AFGHANISTAN SINCE SHORTLY AFTER THE APRIL 27 MILITARY COUP. DURING HIS STAY HE SPENT 48 HOURS IN CUSTODY AFTER HIS ARREST WHILE INTERVIEWING TWO MOSLEM PRIESTS. HE WAS RELEASED UNHARMED". SINCE DETAILS COINCIDE CLOSELY WITH EXPERIENCE OF AP CORRESPONDENT BARRY SHLACHTER REPORTED REFTEL, WE BELIEVE HIM TO BE AUTHOR OF PIECE.

AUTHOR LEADS OFF BY DESCRIBING "IDEALISTIC YOUNG OFFICERS WHO TOOK COMMAND OF THIS TRADITIONALIST MOSLEM COUNTRY" AS WANTING TO BUILD "A SOCIALIST STATE ON AN ISLAMIC FOUNDATION". HE VIVIDLY ILLUSTRATES THE POWER OF THE REGIME'S NEW SECURITY CHIEF AZIZ AHMED AKBARI, A 25 YEAR OLD FORMER CLERK IN THE KABUL POLICE LOGISTICS SECTION, A YOUND MAN WHO GIVES "ORDERS TO SUBORDINATES TWICE HIS AGE WHO BOW AS THEY LEAVE HIS OFFICE AT THE INTERIOR MINISTRY". HE QUOTES AKBARI AS SAYING THIRTEEN DAYS AFTER COUP THAT, "WE WANT TO BUILD A SOCIALIST AFGHANISTAN, A MARXIST-LENINIST AFGHANISTAN".

ACCORDING TO AUTHOR, AKBARI SHOWED "NO RELUCTANCE IN VOICING WHAT HE SAYS ARE AIMS OF THE COUP" AND "WAS OBLIVIOUS TO THE TWO MEN IN THE ROOM WHO APPEARED UNEASY BY THE SUDDEN DISCLOSURE TO A FOREIGNER..". AKBARI, WHO SEEMS TO BE PARTICULARLY LOQUACIOUS INFORMANT, ALSO TOLD AUTHOR THAT ONLY A HANDFUL OF POLICE OFFICERS, MANY OF WHOM HE HELPED RECRUIT, JOINED THE KHALQ PARTY. AS A RESULT POLICE ARE NOT TRUSTED BY THE MILITARY AND POLICE STATIONS AROUND THE COUNTRY ARE GUARDED BY TROOPS.

DESCRIPTION OF AUTHOR'S ARREST CLOSELY FOLLOWS SCENARIO OUTLINED REFTEL AND INCLUDES QUOTES FROM VARIOUS ARMY OFFICERS INVOLVED IN HIS DETENTION. ONE ARMY LIEUTENANT INADVERTENTLY POINTS UP ANOMALY BETWEEN TRADITION AND MODERNITY IN AFGHANISTAN WHEN HE SAYS" WOMEN SHOULD BE TREATED EQUAL TO MEN BUT SHOULD STILL WEAR VEILS. THAT IS WHAT THE ISLAMIC RELIGION SAYS". ANOTHER MILITARY CONTACT TOLD HIM THAT "IT WAS DANGEROUS BEING A KHALQ MEMBER DURING THE DAOUD REGIME. WE MET IN DARK CINEMA HALLS AND PASSED ALONG PARTY INSTRUCTIONS BY SLIPPING NOTES INTO OUR COMRADES POCKETS".

COMMENT: WE ARE TOLD SHLACHTER REMAINS IN KABUL. SINCE IT IS UNATTRIBUTED, ARTICLE MIGHT HAVE BEEN CARRIED OUT BY TEHRAN JOURNAL REPORTER JAHAN-SHALI, WHO JUST RETURNED FROM KABUL AND WHOSE INTERVIEW WITH TARAKI (SEPTEL) APPEARED SAME ISSUE. POLITICAL ORIENTATION OF YOUNG MILITARY OFFICERS, AS REPORTED BY SHLACHTER, DIFFERS SIGNIFICANTLY FROM PUBLIC IMAGE BEING PROJECTED BY PRIME MINISTER TARAKI-PARTICULARLY THE LATTER'S PROTESTATIONS THAT THE NW AFGHAN REGIME SHOULD IN NO WAY BE CONSIDERED COMMUNIST OR PRO
SUMMARY: ONLY A FEW ISOLATED INCIDENTS OCCURRED IN TEHRAN MAY 15 AND REST OF CONSULATES REPORT NO SERIOUS INCIDENTS. TEHRAN MOSQUES MAIN CLOSED TODAY. END SUMMARY.

IN THE EVENT, ONLY A FEW INCIDENTS OCCURRED MAY 15. POLICE ARRESTED A FEW YOUNG MEN ON MOTORCYCLES WHO WERE DUMPING NAILS ON ONE OF THE STREETS LEADING TO SOUTH TEHRAN. SOME TEHRAN UNIVERSITY STUDENTS TRIED TO BEGIN A DEMONSTRATION OUTSIDE THE UNIVERSITY IN LATE MORNING BUT WERE PREVENTED BY SECURITY FORCES WITH NO ARRESTS BUT REPORTEDLY SOME BEATINGS. THERE WERE SOME FALSE ALARMS WHICH TURNED OUT TO BE JUST THAT ON INVESTIGATION. SOME LOCAL PRESSMEN ARE TREATING YESTERDAY AS A NON-EVENT. HOWEVER, BAZAAR WAS CLOSED AS WERE THE MAIN MOSQUES IN TOWN.
MOSQUES REMAIN CLOSED TODAY DUE TO ACTIVITY BY KHOMEINI SUPPORTERS, BUT EMBASSY HAS LEARNED IN CONFIDENCE THAT EFFORT WILL BE MADE TO OPEN THEM TOMORROW.

CONSULATE SHIRAZ REPORTS THAT OLD BAZAAR WAS CLOSED MAY 15 BUT UNIVERSITY OPENED. THERE WAS GREATER POLICE PRESENCE THAN USUAL IN AND AROUND UNIVERSITY WITH MILITARY UNITS HELD ON THE EDGE OF THE CAMPUS. ONLY INCIDENT REPORTED BY FAIRLY CREDIBLE EYEWITNESS WAS CASE OF TWO BOYS ON A MOTORCYCLE THROWING ACID ON TWO GIRLS WHO WERE WEARING SCARS BUT NO CHADORS.

CONSULATE ISFAHAN REPORTS NO INCIDENTS, WHICH IN A SENSE IS UNUSUAL SINCE ISOLATED INCIDENTS HAVE BEEN REPORTED ALMOST EVERY DAY UP TO MAY 15. THERE WERE MORE TROOPS THAN USUAL, BUT BAZAAR REMAINED OPEN.

CONSULATE TABRIZ NOTED MORE SHOPS WERE CLOSED MAY 15 AND BAZAAR WAS CLOSED. CONSUL HAS HEARD OF NO INCIDENTS AND NOTES FAR LESS MILITARY AND POLICE IN EVIDENCE ON THE STREETS MAY 16 THAN FOR SEVERAL DAYS PREVIOUSLY.
THERE WAS A BOMB THREAT PHONED IN BY UNIDENTIFIED IRANIAN MAN AT LOCKHEED BUILDING MORNING MAY 16. POLICE SEARCH FOUND NOTHING.

MEANWHILE PRESS CARRIES STATEMENT BY MINISTER OF INFORMATION HOMAYOUN ASSERTING GOI IS IN COMPLETE CONTROL OF SITUATION, AND PEOPLE SHOULD PAY NO ATTENTION TO "EMPTY AND RIDICULOUS" RUMORS STARTED BY "SABOTEURS INTENDING TO DISRUPT LIFE AND BUSINESS". REFERRING TO NUMBERS OF MESSAGES GOI HAS RECEIVED FROM BUSINESSMEN, ACADEMICS, WRITERS AND OTHER PROMINENT CITIZENS EXPRESSING SUPPORT FOR ITS CRACKDOWN ON THOSE WHO DISRUPT LAW AND ORDER (THE LATEST IS LETTER TO AMOUZEGAR FROM IRANIANS RESIDENT IN KUWAIT). HOMAYOUN VOWED PO MEET SUCH TROUBLEMAKERS "WITH STRINGENT ACTION WITHIN THE FRAMWORK OF THE LAW".

1978TEHRAN04710.subject: MULTILATERAL AFFAIRS: IRANIAN ASSESSMENT OF THE 34TH SESSION OF THE UN HUMAN RIGHTS COMMISSION (HRC)

segments.text: ON MAY 15 POLCOUNS HAD OCCASION TO EXCHANGE VIEWSON 34TH SESSION OF UNHRC WITH MFA INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS DEPARTMENT HEAD EHSASSI WHO ATTENDED CONFERENCE WITH PRINCESS ASHRAF.

EHSASSI VOLUNTEERED HIS OWN ASSESSMENT WHICH CLOSELY PARELLELED FIRST POINT MADE BY DEPT IN REFTEL (SECT 2A AND B). HE SAID HRC SESSION MOVED SMOOTHLY AND MORE AND MORE COUNTRIES ARE INTERESTED IN BEING MEMBERS. THERE WAS VERY GREAT COMPETITION, PARTICULARLY AMONG WESTERN EUROPEAN COUNTRIES.

HE NOTED UK FAILED TO BE ELECTED FOR THE FIRST TIME, WITH CANADA TAKING THEIR PLACE. HE ATTRIBUTED THIS BOTH TO INERTIA BASED ON OVERCONFIDENCE BY BRITISH DELEGATION AND TO BRITISH BEHAVIOR IN THE CONFERENCE. IN LATTER REGARD, HE CONTRASTED CANADIAN COOPERATION WITH CONCERNS OF DEVELOPING COUNTRIES AGAINST BRITISH "EXTREME ATTITUDES" ON CERTAIN HUMAN RIGHTS QUESTIONS. AS EXAMPLE HE WAS INVOLVED IN, HE NOTED CONTROVERSY AS TO WHO SHOULD BE MEMBERS OF COMMITTEE REVIEWING COVENANT ON CIVIL AND POLITICAL RIGHTS. IRAN AND OTHER DEVELOPING COUNTRIES THOUGHT ONLY SIGNATORIES SHOULD BE MEMBERS WHILE BRITISH WERE AMONG THOSE ADVOCATING MEMBERSHIP FOR ALL COUNTRIES INTERESTED.
CANADIANS WERE INSTRUMENTAL IN WORKING OUT A COMPROMISE, FOR WHICH DEVELOPING NATIONS WERE GRATEFUL.

EHSASSI MENTIONED IN PASSING THE INTEREST THERE IS IN EXPANDING AND RESTRUCTURING THE COMMISSION. THERE IS TALK ABOUT WESTERN EUROPEANS BEING OVERREPRESENTED, BUT EHSASSI OPINED THAT KIND OF RESTRUCTURING WOULD PROBABLY BE TOO CONTROVERSIAL AND NOT GET VERY FAR. WHEN WE MADE FURTHER POINT, REGARDING NAM THRUST ON HUMAN RIGHTS ISSUES (PARA 2D), EHSASSI SUGGESTED "NON-ALIGNED" IS WRONG NOMENCLATURE. SINCE THESE ARE NOT POLITICAL BUT ECONOMIC AND SOCIAL PROBLEMS, "DEVELOPING COUNTRIES" MORE APPROPRIATE. AS FAR AS GROUP OF 77 GOES, THERE IS GENERALLY SHARED INTERPRETATION OF HUMAN RIGHTS DEFINING THEM IN TERMS BEYOND THE "SIMPLY POLITICAL".

IRAN PLAYED A LEADING PART IN GETTING PASSAGE OF RESOLUTION DEFINING HUMAN RIGHTS AS ECONOMIC AND SOCIAL, AS WELL AS POLITICAL AND WAS GRATIFIED US DELEGATION SUPPORTED THIS STATEMENT. IN REPLYING TO OUR QUESTION, HE NOTED SOME WESTERN EUROPEANS, SUCH AS FRG, HAD A DIFFERENT VIEW, LIMITED THEIR DEFINIATION TO POLITICAL FREEDOM AND DEMOCRACY.

POLCOUNS COMMENTED THAT IT IS HARD TO ARGUE AGAINST INCLUDING ECONOMIC AND SOCIAL RIGHTS WITH THE POLITICAL, BUT ASKED WHAT HAPPENS IF A QUESTION OF PRIORITY ARISES. HE ASKED IF MEMBERS OF G-77 HAD ANY PROBLEMS IN THAT REGARD, EHSASSI REPLIED THAT G77 WOULD NOT WANT TO GET INVOLVED IN U.S. CONFLICT WITH THE SOCIALIST BLOCK COUNTRIES REGARDING POLITICAL RIGHTS. HE SAID MAJORITY OF AFRICANS AND ASIANS AGREE IN THEIR VIEWS. LATIN AMERICANS ARE DIFFERENT, IN THATPOLITICAL RIGHTS DIVIDE THEM, AND SOME DO NOT CONSIDER THEMSELVES AS DEVELOPING NATIONS. HE REPEATED THAT INTEREST IN MEMBERSHIP ON HRC IS GROWING RAPIDLY AMONG ALL THESE COUNTRIES.
PERHAPS THEY THINK BY PARTICIPATING ON THE COMMISSION THEY WILL BE IN A BETTER POSITION TO EXPLAIN THE HUMAN RIGHTS SITUATION IN THEIR OWN COUNTRIES.

EHSASSI COMPLETED THE REVIEW BY AGAIN EXPRESSING SATISFACTION THAT IT WAS PRINCESS ASHRAF'S THREE STATEMENTS DEFINING HUMAN RIGHTS WHICH FORMED THE BODY OF THE RESOLUTION PASSED BY HRC, A MAJOR ACCOMPLISHMENT.

ONLY INCIDENT OF NOTE MAY 16 WAS ATTEMPTED DEMONSTRATION BY TEHRAN UNIVERSITY STUDENTS FOR SECOND DAY IN A ROW. OCCASION WAS ANNIVERSARY OF DEATH OF ISLAMIC REFORMER ALI SHARIATI, WHOSE TEACHINGS ARE PARTICULARLY POPULAR AMONG MANY STUDENTS. IN KEEPING WITH CURRENT GOI POLICY, GROUP, WHO DID NOT HAVE A PERMIT TO DEMONSTRATE, WERE DRIVEN OFF OF CAMPUS BY POLICE AND SECURITY GUARDS, BUT SMASHED WINDOWS AT FACULTY OF DENTRISTRY BEFORE BEING BROUGHT UNDER CONTROL. AS DAY BEFORE, THERE APPEARS TO HAVE BEEN NO ARRESTS AND NO MAJOR INJURIES OR DEATHS.

AUTHORITIES ANNOUNCED 219 HAD BEEN ARRESTED OVER PAST FEW DAYS IN TEHRAN, OF WHOM 102 ARE IN PRISON AWAITING TRIAL, 77 HAVING CASES STILL BEING INVESTIGATED, 29 REMANDED TO MINORS COURT, AND 6 TO BE TRIED BY MILITARY TRIBUNAL (NOTE: NUMBERS DO NOT ADD UP). PRESS SAYS LATTER 6 WERE CHARGED WITH DISTRIBUTING SUBVERSIVE LITERATURE; ANOTHER REPORT FROM JOURNALIST SOURCE IS THAT THEY WERE TRYING TO BLOW UP A PETROL STATION.

NO SERIOUS INCIDENTS REPORTED IN PROVINCIAL CENTERS THOUGH TENSION REMAINS HIGH. TABRIZ STORES AND MANY SCHOOLS WERE CLOSED OR WITH LIMITED ATTENDANCE. AZARABADEGAN UNIVERSITY WAS CLOSED, AS WAS TECHNICAL UNIVERSITY IN ISFAHAN. VISITING NEW YORK TIMES CORRESPONDENT TELLS US HE COUNTED 42 TANKS IN CITY OF QOM. SEVERAL OTHER CITIES (HAMADAN, QAZVIN, KASHAN) LISTED IN PRESS AS QUIET WITH STORES GENERALLY CLOSED. EXPRESSIONS OF SUPPORT FOR GOVERNMENT CONTINUE TO COME IN, INCLUDING UNIVERSITY FACULTY FROM MANY UNIVERSITIES. ONE EXCEPTION IS AZARBADEGAN UNIVERSITY FACULTY WHICH HAS POSED A SERIES OF DEMANDS TO THE CHANCELLOR THAT GENERALLY SUPPORT STUDENT POSITIONS.

CONFERENCE OF CHANCELLORS FROM 20 UNIVERSITIES AROUND THE COUNTRY OPENED IN TEHRAN TODAY, MAY 17, FOR PURPOSE OF DISCUSSING CAUSES OF UNREST AND DISTURBANCES. SUCH CONFERENCES WILL TAKE PLACE EVERY TWO MONTHS, ACCORDING TO ANNOUNCEMENT IN PRESS. MEMBERS OF TEHRAN UNIVERSITY TEACHING STAFF HAVE ALSO SIGNED JOINT LETTER TO THEIR CHANCELLOR ASKING FOR REVERSAL OF TENTATIVE DECISION TO EXPEL SOME STUDENTS (THUS INDIRECTLY APPEARING TO SUPPORT STUDENT DEMONSTRATION MAY 15 WHICH WAS SPECIFICALLY FOR PURPOSE OF ASKING SAME THING).

MAJLES, TOON HAS BEEN DEBATING SITUATION, WITH MOST SPEAKERS EXPRESSING SUPPORT FOR LAW AND ORDER. TABRIZ DEPUTY BANIAHMAD AND GOVERNMENT CRITIC PEZESHKPUR POSED USUAL CHALLENGING QUESTIONS TO THE GOVERNMENT.

COMMENT: SITUATION ON THE GROUND REFLECTS UNCERTAINTY AND AURA OF EXPECTATION WHICH GENERALLY PERVADES IRANIAN PUBLIC. PEOPLE, INCLUDING MANY IN THE ESTABLISHMENT, ARE TRYING TO FIGURE OUT EXACTLY WHAT GOI POLICY IS TOWARD DEMONSTRATORS AND PARAMETERS OF ANNOUNCED GOI CRACKDOWN, IN VIEW OF APPARENT WILLINGNESS OF THE GOVERNMENT TO CONTINUE DISCUSSION OF SOME PROBLEMS DEMANDS OF SHAH'S UNINTERRRUPTED LIBERALIZATION POLICY.

1978TEHRAN04745.subject: BIOGRAPHIC BACKGROUND FOR GOI AMBASSADOR GHASSEMI

segments.text: REZA GHASSEMI, BORN 1932, HAS DOCTORATE IN POLITICAL SCIENCE FROM TEHRAN UNIVERSITY AND ALSO GRADUATED FROM NATIONAL DEFENSE UNIVERSITY. HE ENTERED GOVERNEMENT SERVICE IN 1951 FIRST WORKING FOR MINISTRY OF FINANCE THEN IN 1962 TRANSFERRING TO MFA. HIS ONLY OVERSEAS POSTING PRIOR TO BEING NAMED AMBASSADOR TO KUWAIT WAS FOUR YEARS SERVICE IN THE PRESS SECTION OF THE GOI EMBASSY IN ROME. HE WAS HEAD OF THE FIRST POLITICAL DEPT (IRAQ, SAUDI ARABIA, KUWAIT GULF COUNTRIES, NORTH AND SOUTH YEMEN) FOR EIGHT YEARS, 1968-76. HE SPEAKS FRENCH AND ITALIAN WELL BUT HAS ONLY LIMITED ENGLISH.

EMBASSY OFFICERS HAVE HAD MIXED REACTIONS FROM THEIR CONTACTS WITH GHASSEMI. DURING HIS MFA DAYS HE WORKED EXCEPTIONALLY LONG HOURS FOR THAT ORGANIZATION, OFTEN BEING AT HIS DESK PAST 6P.M. HE IMPRESSED ONE EMBOFF AS THE BEST INFORMED DEPARTMENT HEAD IN MFA WHILE ANOTHER FOUND HIM KNOWLEDGEABLE BUT PEDANTIC AND LEGALISTIC IN HIS APPROACH TO POLITICAL ISSUES. AT ONE TIME HE WAS RUMORED TO BE A SAVAK OFFICIAL ON LOAN TO MFA. ALTHOUGH QUITE ACCESSIBLE DURING OFFICE HOURS (ONE OF FEW MFA OFFICIALS WHO WOULD PROVIDE DETAILED INFORMATION OVER THE PHONE ONCE RAPPORT WAS ESTABLISHED) GHASSEMI TURNED DOWN EVERY SOCIAL INVITATION EXTENDED BY EMBOFFS.
WE UNDERSTAND FROM EMBASSY KUWAIT'S COMMENT LAST YEAR (KUWAIT 2328) THAT HE MAY HAVE BEEN MALADROIT IN HANDLING HIS AMBASSADORIAL RESPONSIBILITIES THERE.

1978TEHRAN04779.subject: MEETING BETWEEN BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND NATIONAL FRONT LEADER

segments.text: FILE; TELEGRAM TEXT FOR THIS MRN IS UNAVAILABLE

SITUATION CONTINUES QUIET WITH PRESS REPORTING VARIOUS DEMONSTRATIONS AROUND THE COUNTRY IN SUPPORT OF THE GOVERNMENT AND ONLY TWO INCIDENTS MAY 17. AT AHWAZ, POLICE FIRED INTO THE AIR TO DISPERSE DEMONSTRATION AND UNIVERSITY REMAINS CLOSED. IN SHIRAZ TWO SCHOOL GIRLS AND ONE ENGINEERING STUDENT WERE ARRESTED FOR ANTI-NATIONAL LITERATURE (PERHAPS MAY 16). TOTAL NUMBER ARRESTED HAS NOW RISEN TO 266, ABOUT 40 HIGHER THAN IN YESTERDAY'S PRESS.

FOLLOWING MEETING OF UNIVERSITY CHANCELLOR IN TEHRAN, PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR ANNOUNCED A LAW IS BEING WRITTEN TO EXTEND THE POWERS OF UNIVERSITY CHANCELLORS. CHANCELLOR OF ONE UNIVERSITY INFORMS US NEW LAW IS SIMPLY THE CONTROVERSIAL ONE LONG IN PREPARATION WHICH WILL ABOLISH MINISTRY OF SCIENCE AND HIGHER EDUCATION AND MAKE UNIVERSITY CHANCELLORS RESPONSIBLE TO THE NEW GOI BOARD OF SUPERVISORS. IT WILL BE INTRODUCED IN PARLIAMENT IN ABOUT 10 DAYS. CHANCELLORS WERE ENCOURAGED TO DEAL MORE VIGOROUSLY WITH STUDENT DEMONSTRATORS BUT NO SPECIFIC NEW POWERS GIVEN.

AMOUZEGAR IN SEPARATE SPEECH TO RESURGENCE PARTY POLITICAL BUREAU ORDERED MORE AUSTERITY AND CUTTING OF RED TAPE ON PART OF GOI BUREAUCRACY, BUT CHARACTERIZED DEMONSTRATORS AS SMALL MINORITY OF "DETERMINED ANARCHISTS" WHO DO NOT REPRESENT VAST POPULATION OF IRAN AND CANNOT BE ALLOWED TO CONTINUE DISRUPTING THE COUNTRY. HE ALSO ANNOUNCED 1,900 RASTAKHIZ MEMBERS OF CENTRAL COMMITTEE FROM ALL OVER IRAN WILL MEET IN TEHRAN SATURDAY, MAY 20, TO ELECT NEW RASTAKHIZ EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE OF 55.

1978TEHRAN04807.subject: ANTI-HIJACKING GROUP--NEW APPROACH TO SAUDI ARABIA AND IRAN

segments.text: JOINT APPROACH MADE TO MFA DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR INTERNATIONAL AFFAIRS SADIQ-ESFANDIARY MAY 18 BY REPRESENTATIVES OF FRG, JAPANESE, U.K. AND U.S. EMBASSIES HERE WITH DUTCH REPRESENTATIVE TAKING THE LEAD. ESFANDIARY REACTED POSITIVELY ON A PERSONAL BASIS AND SAID HE WOULD GIVE OFFICIAL REPLY PROBABLY NEXT WEEK.

HE TOUCHED BRIEFLY ON POLITICAL PROBLEM FACED BY FIVE ARAB GOVERNMENTS TO BE APPROACHED AND READILY AGREED WITH OUR SUGGESTION THAT, IF IRAN AGREED TO MAKE THE APPROACHES, IT COULD LATER REPORT ON THEM TO THE CONTACT GROUP, CITING ANY SPECIFIC REASONS GOVERNMENTS APPROACHED MIGHT HAVE FOR HESITATION IN JOINING.
ESFANDIARY ALSO AGREED SIMULTANEOUS APPROACH BY SAUDI ARABIA WOULD BE HELPFUL IN OVERCOMING POSSIBLE OBJECTIONS TO IRANIANS ON THE PART OF THE ARAB GOVERNMENTS INVOLVED.

OVER THE PAST FEW DAYS AMBASSADOR AND OTHER EMBOFFS HAVE BEEN GETTING REACTIONS FROM VARIOUS INFORMED AND LESSINFORMED MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC TO THE SHAH'S INTERVIEW OF MAY 13. A LARGE BODY OF OPINION APPEARS TO HAVE BEEN SURPRISED, DISAPPOINTED, AND PERHAPS EVEN A LITTLE SCARED BY WHAT THESE PEOPLE PERCEIVED AS INDECISIVENESS, NERVOUSNESS, AND IMPRECISION IN THE WAY THE SHAH CONDUCTED THE INTERVIEW.

THEY TELL US THEY HAD EXPECTED THIS FIRST INTERVIEW GIVEN ONLY FOR IRANIAN MEDIA REPRESENTATIVES AND CONCENTRATING MAINLY ON DOMESTIC AFFAIRS TO BE DEFINITIVE AND GIVE THE LEAD TO GOVERNMENET AND PEOPLE IN FACE OF A VARIETY OF UNCERTAINTIES CREATED HERE BY ALMOST DAILY DEMONSTRATIONS AND VANDALISM THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY AS WELL AS SOME PRETTY WILD RUMORS.

UNLIKE HIS BEHAVIOR IN THE PAST IN SUCH APPEARANCES, THE SHAH WAS PERCEIVED AS NERVOUS, SOME THOUGHT PERHAPS EVEN A BIT SHAKEN OR SCARED. HE DID NOT ANSWER QUESTIONS PUT TO HIM, FOR EXAMPLE A DIRECT QUESTION ON THE REASON BEHIND THESE PUBLIC DEMONSTRATIONS AND OUTBURSTS. HE DECLINED TO GIVE THE FIGHTING ANSWER AS HE HAS IN THE PAST, I.E., BLAMING FOREIGN INVOLVEMENT AND RED AND BLACK REACTIONARIES, BUT NEITHER DID HE TRY A CONCILIATORY LINE, WHICH WAS ANOTHER POSSIBILITY.

MANY IN THE ESTABLISHMENT WHO SUPPORT THE SHAH AND COUNT ON HIS LEADERSHIP FELT THAT HE HAD FALLEN BETWEEN TWO VIABLE APPROACHES: EITHER FIRM AND HARD LINE OR SOFT AND CONCILIATORY. INSTEAD, THEY FIND IT DIFFICULT TO INTERPRET WHAT HE SAID OR GLEAN AN IDEA OF THE DIRECTION IN WHICH HE WANTS THEM TO GO.

INTERESTINGLY, ONE EMBASSY CONTACT WHO SEES A GOOD DEAL OF THE CONSERVATIVE RELIGIOUS ESTABLISHMENT SAYS THAT THE INTERVIEW WAS RELATIVELY WELL RECEIVED IN THOSE CIRCLES. IT WAS PERCEIVED AS SUFFICIENTLY CONCILIATORY TO PERMIT HOPE OF SOME SORT OF DIALOGUE BETWEEN THE LEADERS OF ISLAM AND THEIR MONARCH.

COMMENT: EMBASSY SEES THIS INTERVIEWAS ANOTHER EXAMPLE OF THE SHAH'S UNCERTAINTY AT THIS STAGE OF HIS INTERNAL LIBERALIZATION PROGRAM. HE IS EMBARKED ON AN UNFAMILIAR VENTURE: TO LOOSEN THE REINS OF POWER AND PERMIT EXPRESSIONS OF OPPOSITION FROM A VARIETY OF QUARTERS WITHOUT ALLOWING THE FORMATION OF A CREDIBLE THREAT TO HIS DYNASTY. HE ALSO HOPES BY THIS MEANS TO CREATE GREATER POPULAR ENTHUSIASM FOR HIS RULE AND PROGRAMS. HOWEVER, HIS EXPERIENCE OF POWER TO DATE HAS INVOLVED WINNING IT FROM OPPOSITION ELEMENTS WHO RESISTED HIS TAKING IT AND THEN CONSOLIDATING HIS HOLD WITHOUT MUCH REGARD FOR HIS OPPONENTS' LIBERTY OF EXPRESSION.

WHILE POLITICAL SKILLS MUST HAVE PLAYED SOME ROLE IN THE INITIAL CONSOLIDATION OF POWER, AGAINST HEAVY ODDS AT TIMES, OTHER FACTORS SUCH AS STEADFASTNESS AND FIRMNESS IN THE FACE OF ADVERSITY, COMPLETE LOYALTY, MILITANCY AND READINESS TO CONFRONT BY FORCE AS NECESSARY, ALL PLAYED A MORE IMPORTANT ROLE.

THE LONG PERIOD OVER THE PAST 15 YEARS DURING WHICH THE SHAH HAS BEEN PUSHING HIS "SHAH-PEOPLE REVOLUTION" RIDING OVER OPPONENTS OF A RELIGIOUS AS WELL AS LEFTIST CAST HAS DONE LITTLE TO DEVELOP HIS POLITICAL SKILLS. HE HAS GAINED EVEN MORE SELF-CONFIDENCE AND GRUADUALLY WORKED HIMSELF INTO A POSITION WHERE HE CONSULTS FEWER AND FEWER PEOPLE IN THE SENSE OF GETTING THEIR ADVICE. MANY IN THE ESTABLISHMENT REMARK ON THIS SHRINKAGE OF DIALOUGE BETWEEN THE SHAH AND HIS RELATIVELY CLOSE SUPPORTERS.

SINCE HIS RULE CONTINUES TO BE HIGHLY PERSONAL AND ALL DECISIONS OF ANY SIGNIFICANCE MUST BE MADE BY HIM, THE PERCEPTION OF WHAT DIRECTION HE IS MOVING IN BECOMES VERY IMPORTANT FOR HIS FOLLOWERS AS WELL AS THE OPPOSITION.

YET LIBERALIZATION IS PRECISELY SOMETHING WITH WHICH THE SHAH IS PERSONALLY LESS FAMILIAR. HIS DOUBTS AS TO TACTICS TO USE TRANSLATE THEMSELVES TO HIS FOLLOWERS AS SELF-DOUBT: HIS LAUDABLE WILLINGNESS TO EXPERIMENT IN AN EFFORT TO CREATE MORE PUBLIC PARTICIPATION MAY APPEAR AS INABILITY TO MAKE UP HIS MIND. THE NORMAL CONCLUSION THAT MANY DRAW IS THAT HE IS LOSING HIS TOUCH. WE ARE NOT SURE THAT THE SHAH HAS SUFFICIENT FEEDBACK TO REALIZE THIS IS THE IMAGE HE IS PROJECTING AT LEAST IN SOME QUARTERS.

THUS, THE GAP GROWS EVEN GREATER BETWEEN THE SHAH AND MANY OF HIS FOLLOWERS AS HE STRIVES FOR A VIABLE POLICY WHICH WILL BE AS CONSISTENT AS HIS POLICIES HAVE GENERALLY BEEN IN THE PAST. IRONICALLY, THE SHAH'S OWN WELL DOCUMENTED RECORD OF UNUSUAL CONSISTENCY ON MOST QUESTIONS (SOME CALL IT STUBBORNESS) WORKS IN THIS REGARD AGAINST HIM.

AT THE SAME TIME, THERE IS LITTLE DOUBT IN OUR MINDS THAT THE SHAH REMAINS MASTER OF ALL NECESSARY INSTRUMENTS OF POWER. THUS, THE REALITY IS DIFFERENT FROM HIS IMAGE. THE SHAH IS MORE OPEN-MINDED AND READY TO SHIFT TACTICS THAN MANY OF HIS HARD-LINE FOLLOWERS. WHAT MIGHT SUGGEST WEAKNESS AND SELF DOUBT TO SOME OF THEM IS PROBABLY SEEN BY THE SHAH AS THE WORKING OUT OF A DIFFICULT PROBLEM.
POST REGRETS IT NO LONGER HAS COPY OF 75 STATE A-5895 IN ITS FILES AND REQUESTS THAT IT BE REPEATED TO US.

VERY FULL BIOGRAPHIC BACKGROUND PROVIDED REFAIR MUCH APPRECIATED. WE HAVE REVIEWED EMBASSY FILES WHICH REVEAL THAT JENAB WAS ACTING DIRECTOR SAVAK MASHAD IN 1963. FROM JUNE 1970 TO 1974 HE WAS ATTACHE IN JIDDA, HIS FIRST TOUR OVERSEAS WITH THE GOI. OUR RECORDS INDICATED HE WAS FORMERLY A BIOLOGY PROFESSOR IN A BOYS SCHOOL IN IRAN. JENAB MAINTAINS AN AMATEUR INTEREST IN BOTANY AND ORNITHOLOGY. FYI: APPARENTLY JENAB'S RELATIONSHIP WITH FORMER IRANIAN AMBASSADOR AT TIME OF HIS FIRST JIDDA TOUR WAS VERY POOR; WERE REPORTEDLY BARELY ON SPEAKING TERMS. ALSO HIS RELATIONSHIP AT THAT TIME WITH SAVAK WAS POOR.
GIVEN HIS PRESENT POSITION, HOWEVER, SAVAK'S ASSESSMENT OF JENAB MUST HAVE CHANGED. END. FYI.

IRAN WHO'S WHO 1976 EDITION HAS LISTING UNDER DR. MOHAMMAD ALI JENAB; COMPLETE TEXT FOLLOWS: "B. 1926, BANDAR PAHLAVI; P. EDUCATIONIST; E. PHD. IN POLITICAL SCIENCE; C. TEACHER IN HIGH SCHOOLS; CHIEF OF EDUCATION IN THE SOUTHERN PORTS PROVINCE; SPECIAL INSPECTOR OF THE MINISTER OF EDUCATION; PARTICIPATED IN THE PERSIAN GULF SEMINAR (1962) L. ENGLISH. PUBL. SOME TEXTBOOKS ON NATURAL SCIENCE AND HEALTH SUBJECT FOR THE FIRST COURSE IN HIGH SCHOOLS."

1978TEHRAN04877.subject: AN IRANIAN MFA VIEW OF AFGHANISTAN SUMMARY: MFA IS VERY PESSIMISTIC ON AFGHANISTAN. END SUMMARY.

segments.text: SUMMARY: MFA IS VERY PESSIMISTIC ON AFGHANISTAN. END SUMMARY.

IN COURSE OF COURTESY CALL MAY 21 ON MFA DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR ASIA AND AFRICA SANANDAJI, DCM AND POLCOUNS DISCUSSED CURRENT SITUATION IN AFGHANISTAN WITH PARTICULAR EMPHASIS ON HUMAN RIGHTS. SANANDAJI IMMEDIATELY PROFFERED HIS VIEW THAT MOSCOW HAD WON AN EASY AND COMPLETE VICTORY. IT HAD BEEN WELL PREPARED DATING FROM DAOUD'S ASSUMPTION OF PRIME MINISTERSHIP IN 1953 AND TAKING ADVANTAGE OF HIS "UNJUSTIFIED AMBITION" SINCE THEN.

MOST STRIKING THING FOR SANANDAJI WAS TARAKI'S FIRST MAJOR PUBLIC SPEECH (KABUL 3806), IN PARTICULAR THREE THEMES. TARAKI HAD SAID HE WOULD SOLVE THE PROBLEM OF NATIONALITY THROUGH THE CREATION OF A "PROGRESSIVE SYSTEM" OF NATIONAL CULTURE AND EDUCATION. HE ALSO PLEDGED SUPPORT FOR NATIONAL LIBERATION MOVEMENTS AND SOLUTION OF THE PUSHTUN AND BALUCH PROBLEMS. UP TO NOW, AFGHANISTAN HAS BEEN DIVIDED AMONG AS MANY AS 25 NATIONALITIES, WITH CHINESE, PERSIAN, AND INDIAN CULTURAL INFLUENCES AFFECTING SEPARATE SECTIONS OF THE COUNTRY.

HE WAS SURE, SANANDAJI SAID, THAT THOUSANDS OF SOVIET TADZHIKS, UZBEKS AND TURKOMANS, SUPPLIED WITH AFGHAN IDENTITY CARDS, WERE ALREADY DESCENDING ON KABUL AND OTHER MAIN CITIES TO TAKE OVER KEY POSTS IN NEW ADMINISTRATION. IF THEY HAD NOT, THEY WOULD BE SOON. COUNTRY WOULD BE TURNED INTO ONE OF THE AUTONOMOUS REGIONS OF USSR.

SANANDAJI SAID HE THOUGHT IT WOULD BE LESS THAN A YEAR BEFORE NEW GOVERNMENT TURNED ITS ATTENTION TO PUSHTUNISTAN AND BALUCHISTAN. MEANWHILE THERE WOULD BE "TOTAL EXTERMINATION OF BRAINS" AS IN EASTERN EUROPE AFTER WORLD WAR TWO. HE THOUGHT BABRAK IS A FIGUREHEAD WITHOUT POWER. WHEN DCM NAAS SAID HE COULD NOT AGREE, HAVING KNOWN BARAK FOR FOUR YEARS AND FOUND HIM A VERY TOUGH LITTLE GUY, SANANDAJI SAID HE WOULD BE ELIMINATED.

SANANDAJI ASKED IF USG HAD INFORMATION ABOUT A PUSTUN DIVISION TRAINING IN RUSSIA FOR PAST 15 YEARS. NAAS NOTED THIS WAS PAKISTANI IDEA, WHICH SANANDAJI ADMITTED. SANANDAJI SAID IT WAS LOGICAL BUT INDICATED IRANIANS HAD NO INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE. IRANIANS ALSO SEEMED TO HAVE NO CONFIRMED REPORTS OF MASS ARRESTS AND EXECUTIONS (PER KABUL 3933, ON WHICH WE BRIEFED HIM). SANANDAJI NOTED UNCONFIRMED NEWS REPORTS SPEAKING OF MORE THAN 300 PEOPLE ARRESTED AND EVENTS "APPROACHING A BLOOD BATH". NEW AFGHANISTAN FOREIGN MINISTER HAD TOLD IRANIAN AMBASSADOR THERE WOULD SOON BE A TOTAL PURGE OF MFA OFFICIALS IN KABUL. SANANDAJI WAS UNIMPRESSED BY AFGHAN MAY 17 STATEMENT (KABUL 4069).
