THOUGH HE AGREED WITH NAAS THAT WE SHALL ALL HAVE TO WAIT AND SEE WHAT AFGHANS ACTUALLY DO IN VIEW OF TARAKI'S AND OTHER PUBLIC ASSURANCES, SANANDAJI COMMENTED THAT WITH SUCH COMMUNIST REGIMES WORDS ARE WORTHLESS. ------------------076609 221042Z /13 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 8485 INFO AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY CAIRO AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY BELGRADE SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 04877

IN A VERY PERSONAL ASIDE, SAANDAJI CONFIDED THAT ONLY GOOD THING TO COME OUT OF THIS BAD BUSINESS WAS DESTRUCTION OF THE MOHAMMADZAI FAMILY. HE INSISTED, DESPITE A DEMURRER FROM NAAS, THAT MOHAMMADZAIS HAVE BEEN IMPLACABLY HOSTILE TOWARD IRAN AND PERSIAN CULTURE FROM THE BEGINNING AND WITHOUT ANY GOOD REASON, THOUGH AT TIMES THEIR HOSTILITY WAS DISGUISED.

LATER IN THE CONVERSATION WE ASKED SANANDAJI IF GOI HAD BEEN IN TOUCH WITH INDIANS ABOUT THIS SITUATION AT ALL. HE WAS CATEGORICAL THAT INDIANS, SHORTSIGHTEDLY, ARE HAPPY WITH THE COUP. ALL THEY CAN THINK ABOUT, HE INSISTED, IS DESTRUCTION OF PAKISTAN. HE NOTED VERY RAPID RECOGNITION BY INDIA, IN COMPANY WITH SOVIET UNION AND BULGARIA, OF THE COUP ITSELF, EVEN BEFORE THERE WAS A NEW GOVERNMENT TO RECOGNIZE. IRANIANS HAD NOTED (OR BEEN TOLD) SOVIET AMBASSADOR IN KABUL WAS ABSENT DURING THE PERIOD OF TIME THAT COLONEL QOADER WENT TO INDIA.
SANANDAJI RECALLED THAT TITO HAD TOLD AFGHAN AMBASSADOR AMIN ETEMADI, AT THE TIME THAT SOVIET AMBASSADOR IN BELGRADE HAD BEEN TRANSFERRED TO KABUL: "GOD HAVE MERCY ON YOU".

COMMENT: SANANDAJI IS OF PREDOMINANTLY FRENCH EDUCATION AND GIVEN TO EXAGGERATION AND THE STRIKING "BON MOT". WHILE HIS VIEWS WERE PRESENTED AS PERSONAL, THEY CLOSELY PARALLEL OTHER "PERSONAL" VIEWS WE HAVE HEARD IN THE MFA. SANANDAJI SEVERAL TIMES EXPRESSED THE HOPE HE WOULD BE PROVEN WRONG, BUT SEEMED SURE HE WOULD NOT.

WHILE GOI, IN THE PERSON OF ITS CHIEF POLICY MAKER THE SHAH, IS NOT PREPARED TO EXPRESS SIUCH AN ASSESSMENT OF AFGHANISTAN YET, WE NOTE SANANDAJI'S VIEWS FALL IN LINE WITH THOSE OF OTHER HIGH OFFICIALS IN THE OTHER CENTO REGIONAL COUNTRIES, E.G., VIEWS EXPRESSED BY AGA SHAHI DURING HIS RECENT VISIT TO TEHRAN, AND STATEMENTS BY TURKISH MFA OFFICIAL SUBASI (ANKARA 3833).

PRESS HERE MAY 22 PROMINENTLY CARRIES REPORT THAT IRANIAN AMBASSADOR ZAND FARD CALLED ON PAK FOREIGN SECRETARY SHAHNAWAZ YESTERDAY TO DENY TRUTH OF BBC REPORT THAT PRIMIN AMOUZEGAR HAD SAID IRAN WILL STOP ALL ASSISTANCE TO PAKISTAN IF DEATH SENTENCE AGAINST BHUTTO IS CARRIED OUT.

MFA SPOKESMAN CONFIRMED DENIAL TO US AND SAYS OFFENDING JOURNALIST, BBC'S RESIDENT CORRESPONDENT ANDREW WHITLEY, WROTE LETTER OF APOLOGY TO AMOUZEGAR YESTERDAY IN WHICH HE STATES HE MISUNDERSTOOD FACTS ON WHICH HE BASED HIS REPORT. THUS, AS FAR AS GOI IS CONCERNED THE WHOLE THING IS A BIG MISTAKE.

COMMENT: FYI ONLY. WE BELIEVE WHITELY PICKED UP THIS STORY QUITE CASUALLY FROM VISITING AMERICAN CORRESPONDENT WHO HAD INTERVIEWED AMOUZEGAR ON BACKGROUND BASIS. IF AMOUZEGAR SAID SOMETHING OF THIS SORT IN PRIVATE, HE IS CERTAIN TO DENY IT--IF FOR NO OTHER REASON THAN THAT THE SHAH DOES NOT CONSIDER HIS PRIME MINISTER A SPOKESMAN ON FOREIGN AFFAIRS. THE WHOLE EPISODE WILL PROBABLY TAKE AMOUZEGAR (AND WHITLEY) SOME TIME TO LIVE DOWN. IT MAY ALSO REQUIRE SOME FURTHER IRANIAN MASSAGING OF PAK EGOS.

WHAT EFFECT, IF ANY, THIS LEAK (WHICH WE DO NOT BELIEVE WAS INTENTIONAL) MIGHT HAVE ON EFFECTIVENESS OF KNOWN IRANIAN REPRESENTATIONS IN FAVOR OF CLEMENCY FOR BHUTTO, ISLAMABAD IS IN A BETTER POSITION THAN WE TO

1978TEHRAN04892.subject: SADDAM HUSSEIN SPEAKS ON GULF SECURITY

segments.text: MFA'S DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR ASIA AND AFRICA SANANDAJI TOLD US MAY 21 THAT HE WAS AWARE OF SADDAM HUSSEIN'S SPEECH OF MAY 10 (REFTEL) BUT DID NOT CONSIDER IT PARTICULARLY APPLICABLE TO IRAN. MFA OFFICIALS APPARENTLY FOCUSED ON WHAT SADDAM HUSSEIN SAID ABOUT FOREIGN WORKERS IN THE LOWER GULF STATES AND FOUND REST OF SPEECH UNEXCEPTIONABLE. OUR SUGGESTION THAT AMBASSADOR SADRIEH MAY HAVE RECEIVED SOME BETTER ELUCIDATION FROM SADDAM HUSSEIN BROUGHT BLANK STARE AND REITERATION THAT NOTHING IN SADDAM HUSSEIN'S RECENT UTTERRANCES INVOLVED ANYTHING OF SIGNIFICANCE ON GULF SECURITY.

ON MAY 22, I VISITED ZAHEDAN, CAPITAL OF THE BALUCHISTAN PROVINCE, WHICH IS LOCATED IN THE NEXUS OF THE IRANIAN, AFGHAN, AND PAKISTAN FRONTIERS. DURING MY VISIT THERE, AT A LUNCHEON ARRANGED BY THE GOVERNOR GENERAL, I HAD AN OPPORTUNITY TO FEEL THE PULSE OF THE LOCAL GENTRY IN THE WAKE OF THE RECENT COUP IN KABUL.

IN GENERAL, I FOUND THEM ALL RATHER WORRIED, BUT FAR FROM PANICKY, ABOUT THEIR FUTURE. SINCE MOST OF THE OFFICIALS ARE EDUCATED IRANIANS FROM OTHER PARTS OF IRAN, THEIR IDENTITY WITH THEIR IMMEDIATE NEIGHBORHOOD IS SOMEWHAT LESS THAN TOTAL, BUT THEY DO SHARE A SENSE OF RESPONSIBILITY TOWARDS IMPENDING EVENTS.

BY FAR THE MOST NERVOUS MAN I MET WAS THE PAKISTAN CONSUL, AN ENGAGING YOUNG CAREER OFFICER FROM THE NORTHWEST FRONTIER PROVINCE. HE IS FULL OF FOREBODING ABOUT SOVIET INTENTIONS TO USE AFGHANISTAN AS THE "BEAR'S PAW" IN FOMENTING TROUBLE AMONG THE TRIBES. HE BELIEVES THAT THE FLOOD OF PUSHTOON AND BALUCHI CABLES OF CONGRATULATIONS SENT TO KABUL WERE FRAUDULENT AND ARE PART OF A SOVIET "BLACK PROPAGANDA" EFFORT.

THE HEAD OF THE RASTAKHIZ PARTY, ON THE OTHER HAND, WHO IS AN ARTICULATE, TEHRAN UNIVERSITY-EDUCATED BALUCHI, WAS MORE BALANCED IN HIS APPRAISAL OF THE BALUCHI PROBLEM. HE FELT THE NEW AFGHAN GOVERNMENT (WHICH HE SAYS CONTAINS FIVE BALUCHI MINISTERS) WILL DIRECT ITS ATTENTION TO ALL BALUCHIS IN PAKISTAN AND IRAN. SINCE THE OVERWHELMING MAJORITY ARE IN PAKISTAN, THAT IS WHERE HE EXPECTS THE PRIMARY FOCUS OF KABUL'S INTEREST.

HE TENDS TO BELIEVETHE CONGRATULATORY CABLES FROM BALUCHIS WERE GENUINE, ALTHOUGH HE THINKS MANY CAME FROM PAKISTAN BALUCHI LEADERS CURRENTLY IN EXILE. HE SAYS THAT SEVERAL OF THE LEADERS FLED DURING THE BHUTTO REGIME AND ARE CURRENTLY IN IRAQ AND IN THE GULF STATES. HE BELIEVES THESE LEADERS WILL BE ATTRACTED TO THE NEW KABUL REGIME AND WILL REQUIRE VERY CAREFUL HANDLING BY ISLAMABAD.

HE THOUGHT THAT WALI KHAN MIGHT BE THE KEY TO THE FUTURE OF BALUCHI REGION. IF WALI CAN SATISFY HIS AMBITION TO BECOME PRIME MINISTER OF ALL PAKISTAN, HE MAY BE ABLE TO HOLD THE TRIBAL GROUPS LOYAL TO ISLAMABAD. IF, ON THE OTHER HAND, HE IS FRUSTRATED IN THAT AMBITION, HE COULD BE A WILLING TOOL FOR SOVIET-SPONSORED EFFORTS AT PARTITIION AND SEPARATION. 7.ON THE OFFICIAL LEVEL, THE GOVERNOR GENERAL EXPECTED THINGS TO REMAIN QUIET IN HIS LOCAL RELATIONS WITH AFGHANISTAN. HESAIDTHERE WERE VERY FEW AFGHANS EITHER LEGALLY OR ILLEGALLY IN HIS PROVINCE. HIS MAIN CONCERN WAS THE HELMAND RIVER AGREEMENT.

IF THE AFGHAN REGIME ABIDES BY THE TERMS OF THE ACCORD, HE HOPES TO DEVELOP SIGNIFICANT AGRICULTURE IN THE SISTAN DISTRICT. IF, AFTER THE NEW DAMS ON THE RIVER RE COMPLETED, KABUL DECIDED TO CUT OFF THE WATER FLOW TO IRAN, HE EXPECTS TROUBLE. BUT HE SEES THE POTENTIAL FOR THAT ACTION AT LEAST A FEW YEARS IN THE FUTRE.

ONE FINAL OBSERVATION. THIS IS MISERABLE TERRITORY AND IT WOULD BE OBVOUSLY UNIVITING TO ANYONE EXCEPT FOR THE FACT THAT IT OFFERS AFGHANISTAN (AND HENCE THE SOVIETS) A CORRIDOR TO THE SEA. BUT IT WILL NEVER BE A TEMPTING PARADISE FOR SETTLERS OF ANY ILK.

1978TEHRAN04981.subject: POSSIBILITY OF BHUTTO EXILE IN IRAN

segments.text: DURING DISCUSSION OF OTHER MATTERS IN AUDIENCE MORNING MAY24, SHAH TOLD ME THAT IRAN WOULD BE PREPARED ACCEPT BHUTTO AS POLITICAL EXILE IN THIS COUNTRY AND WOULD AGREE TO ANY PAKISTAN CONDITIONS CONCERNING HIS ABNEGATION OF POLITICAL ACTIVITY.

SHAH SAID THIS INFORMATION HAD BEEN CONVEYED TO PAKISTANI AMBASSADOR IN RESPONSE TO TENTATIVE INQUIRY LATTER HAD MADE. HE SAID IT WAS NOT RPT NOT CLEAR THAT AMBASSADOR WAS ACTING UNDER INSTRUCTIONS FROM HIS GOVERNMENT WHEN HE MADE THE INQUIRY.

1978TEHRAN04982.subject: DISCUSSION WITH SHAH ON INTERNAL AFFAIRS OF IRAN

segments.text: DURING AUDIENCE WITH SHAH MORNING MAY 24 ON OTHER MATTERS, WE HAD LONG DISCUSSION ON INTERNAL AFFAIRS OF IRAN, WITH SPECIFIC EMPHASIS ON RECENT DISTURBANCES. SHAH REPEATED MANY OF HIS USUAL PERCEPTIONS OF CAUSES UNDERLYING SOCIAL UNREST, BUT ALSO LAID OUT HIS THINKING ABOUT DEALING WITH CURRENT SITUATION.

HE SAID, IN THE FIRST PLACE, THAT HE WOULD CONTINUE THE PROCESS OF LIBERALIZATION. THIS, HE SAID, WAS IRREVERSIBLE AND WAS A NATURAL COMPONENT OF THE MODERNIZATION PROCESS. MOREOVER, HE FELT HE OWED IT TO HIS SON TO INVEST HIM WITH A SET OF POLITICAL INSTITUTIONS WHICH WERE MORE OR LESS SELF SUSTAINING WHEN HE ASSUMES THE THRONE.

VIEWED IN THIS PERSPECTIVE, HE FELT THE GREATEST DANGER TO THE COUNTRY WAS NOT FROM THE RELIGIOUS DISSIDENTS, BUT FROM THE MARXISTS. THE "CLERGY" KNEW THAT THE PEOPLE OF IRAN WOULD NEVER ACCEPT TOTAL RELIGIOUS ORTHODOXY IN THE MOST PRIMITIVE SENSE. HENSE, THEY WOULD, IN THE FINAL ANALYSIS, HAVE TO MAKE SOME COMPROMISE WITH MODERNIZATION.

BECAUSE OF THIS FACT, THE SHAH FELT HE COULD WORK OUT SOME UNDERSTANDINGS WITH RESPONSIBLE RELIGIOUS ELEMENTS. HE WAS HARSH ABOUT KHOMEINI AND FELT IT WAS IMPOSSIBLE TO SATISFY HIM. ALTHOUGH FAR FROM FLATTERING IN HIS APPRAISAL OF SHARIATMADERI, HE INDICATED THAT HE EXPECTED TO BE ABLE TO REACH SOME UNDERSTANDINGS WITH HIM THROUGH INTERMEDIARIES. HE SAID, HOWEVER, THAT THESE UNDERSTANDINGS WOULD HAVE TO INVOLVE MATTERS OF A RELIGIOUS AND MORAL CONTENT, RATHEN THATN POLITICAL ISSUES.

HE SAID THAT, IN THE NEXT FEW DAYS, HE WOULD MEKE HIS ANNUAL PILGRIMAGE TO THE SHIRNE OF IMAM REZA IN MASHAD. THIS WOULD GIVE HIM AN OPPORTUNITY TO TALK WITH MANY OF THE "CLERGY" AND PROVIDE HIM A POINT OF DEPARTURE FOR HIS DIALOGUE. WITH RESPONSIBLE RELIGIOUS DISSIDENTS. HE SEEMED CONVINCED THAT THE CONTEST WITH THE "CLERGY" WOULD SOON BE AT AN END.

THE SHAH CONTINUED SCATHING IN HIS CHARACTERIZATION OF THE OLD NATIONAL FRONT GROUP. HE SAID IT WAS A MISTAKE FOR THE WESTERN PRESS TO LABEL THEM "LIBERAL" SINCE THEY HAD DEMONSTRATED THEIR AUTHORITARIAN NATURE IN THEIR TUDEH PAST. BUT, HE DISMISSED THEM AS WITHOUT DOMESTIC SIGNIFICANCE.

COMMENT: IN PURSUIT OF HIS TRADITIONAL TACTICS OF DIVIDING THE OPPOSITION, THE SHAH SEEMS SET UPON A COURSE OF SEEKING RECONCILIATION WITH THE ISLAMIC GROUPS AND DIVIDING THEM FROM THEIR TEMPORARY SECULAR ALLIES.

1978TEHRAN04994.subject: ITALIAN COMMUNISTS SUPPORT THEIR IRANIAN BROTHERS

segments.text: FRENCH LANGUAGE JOURNAL DE TEHRAN ON MAY 17 PUBLISHED LETTER FROM LUIGI LONGO, A LEADER OF THE ITALIAN COMMUNIST PARTY, TO THE OUTLAWED TUDEH PARTY ON THE OCCASION OF "POLITICAL PRISONERS DAY". THE LETTER PLEDGES SUPPORT AND ADMIRATION OF THE ITALIAN COMMUNISTS FOR THE DIFFICULT BATTLE WHICH TUDEH IS ENGAGED IN TO BRING LIBERTY TO IRAN. LETTER ALSO CITES FORMER HEAD OF IRANIAN PART KHOSROW ROUZBEH FOR HIS COURAGE, PRIDE AND FAITH-"A POLITICAL AND SPIRITUAL EXAMPLE FOR THE IRANIAN AND ITALIAN COMMUNISTS". LETTER WAS ORIGINALLY PUBLISHED IN UNITA, ITALIAN COMMUNIST PARTY PAPER.

IN SAME JOURNAL ARTICLE REFERENCE IS MADE TO L'AVANTI, ORGAN OF THE ITALIAN SOCIALIST PARTY, WHICH HAS PUBLISHED RECENT NEWS STORIES ABOUT IRAN, "CITING FOREIGN INFORMATION AGENCIES". L'AVANTI REPORTEDLY STATED THAT ON MAY 13 CEREMONIES WERE HELD AT FILUME, "THE PLACE WHERE A STATUE OF ROUZBEH WAS ERECTED LAST YEAR BY A COMMUNIST MAYOR WHICH WAS MADE BY A COMPATRIOT OF ROUZBEH NAMED REZA OVLIA". (FYI: EMBASSY HAS NO PREVIOUS INFORMATION ON REZA OVLIA.) THE PAPER ADDED THAT THESE CEREMONIES WERE ATTENDED BY LOCAL POLITICAL AND CULTURAL GROUPS, REPRESENTATIVES OF THE TUDEH PARTY AND A NUMBER OF "DEMOCRATIC" IRANIANS.

COMMENT: THIS IS FIRST REPORT WE HAVE HAD ON THESE INTERPARTY RELATIONS SINCE LATE 1976 WHEN IRAJ ESKANDARI, TUDEH SYG, VISITED ROME AND MET WITH BERLINGUER. ARTICLE FIRST APPEARED MAY 16 IN ETELAAT, PERSIAN LANGUAGE DAILY WITH SAME OWNERSHIP AS JOURNAL. WE HAVE REASON TO BELIEVE THAT ARTICLE WAS ORGINALLY PUBLISHED ON INSTRUCTIONS FROM THE MINISTRY OF INFORMATION BUT THAT IT WAS NOT INTENDED PUBLICATION LOCAL FOREIGN LANGUAGE PAPERS.

1978TEHRAN05009.subject: SHAH'S VISIT TO BULGARIA AND HUNGARY

segments.text: SHAH TOLD ME MAY 24 THAT HIS VISITS TO BULGARIA AND HUNGARY WERE ROUTINE, WITH NO PARTICULARLY INTERESTING ASPECTS.HE SAID BOTH COUNTRIES OBVIOUSLY ACCEPT THEIR IRREVERSIBLE POSITIONS IN THE WARSAW PACT AND THE FACT OF THEIR DOMINATION BY THE SOVIETS.
HE SAID THE CONSTANT THEME IN ALL DISCUSSIONS WITH HIM WAS DETENTE, WITH EMPHASIS UPON THE NEED FOR WORLD PEACE. LEADERS OF BOTH COUNTRIES PLACED GREAT EMPHASIS UPON TRADE AND ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT.

OTHER IRANIAN OFFICIALS WHO ECCOMPANIED THE SHAH TOLD ME THEY WERE IMPRESSED BY DIFFERENCE INHUNGARIAN AND BULGARIAN ATTITUDES TOWARDS SOVIETS. THEY SAID HUNGARIANS PRIVATELY MADE NO SECRET OF THEIR CONTEMPT FOR THE RUSSIANS.

1978TEHRAN05032.subject: GOI FOREIGN MINISTER ON RCD, TURKEY-NATO AND AFGHANISTAN

segments.text: AFGHANISTAN

SPEAKING UPON HIS RETURN FROM ANKARA MAY 24 FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY CHARACTERIZED RCD MINISTERIAL MEETING AS "USEFUL". WHILE NO SPECIFIC PROTOCOL WAS SIGNED, TENTATIVE PLANS HAVE REPORTEDLY BEEN FORMULATED FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF AN RCD INVESTMENT BANK TO PROMOTE ECONOMIC COOPERATION AMONG THE THREE MEMBER COUNTRIES. REFERRING TO THE EARLIER IZMIR HEADS OF STATE MEETING KHALATBARY SAID THAT "RCD HAS NOT YET FULFILLED ITS COMMITMENTS TAKEN AT THAT CONFERENCE".

RESPONDING TO A QUESTION REGARDING TURKISH-NATO RELATIONS THE FOREIGN MINISTER SAID THAT HE DOES NOT BELIEVE THAT TURKEY IS LEANING TOWARDS THE EAST BLOC, "THESE CHANGES ARE NOT MEANT TO BE UNFRIENDLY SIGNS OF REVENGE AIMED AGAINST ANYONE." HE ADDED THAT, "WE HOPE TO INITIATE CLOSER ECONOMIC AND POLITICAL TIES WITH EAST EUROPEAN COUNTRIES".

WHEN ASKED ABOUT THE NEW AFGHAN GOVERNMENT, KHALATBARY RESPONDED THAT "TARAKI HAS PLEDGED FRIENDLY RELATIONS WITH US AND THE OTHER NEIGHBORING COUNTRIES" AND "WE ARE WATCHING CLOSELY ANY NEW DEVELOPMENTS IN AFGHANISTAN THAT MIGHT GIVE US A CLEARER PICTURE OF KABUL'S NEW POLITICAL POSTURES".

COMMENT: WE UNDERSTAND PROPOSALS FOR FREE TRADE AMONG RCD COUNTRIES WERE PRESENTED FOR RATIFICATION TO IRANIAN PARLIAMENT YESTERDAY. MEANWHILE LOCAL PRESS ARTICLES IN WAKE OF MINISTERIAL HAVE TENDED TO FEATURE "UNFULFILLED HOPE" THEME WHEN COMMENTING ON RCD EDFORTS AT INCREASING ECONOMIC COOPERATION AMONG MEMBERS.

1978TEHRAN05043.subject: SHAH UNDERLINES POLITICAL USE OF OIL

segments.text: LOCAL PRESS GAVE FRONT PAGE TREATMENT TO SHAH'S MAY 24 CHICAGO TRIBUNE INTERVIEW. HEADLINES HIGHLIGHTED SHAH'S WARNING THAT OIL MIGHT BE USED AS "A WEAPON TO FORCE ISRAEL INTO A MORE FLEXIBLE MIDDLE EAST POLICY, BUT ONLY UNDER THE AUSPICES OF THE UNITED NATIONS". GIVEN EQUALLY PROMINENT ATTENTION WAS THE SHAH'S PRONOUNCEMENT THAT HE HAS NO OBJECTION TO THE SOVIET UNION BUYING OIL FROM OPEC: "IF THEY ARE GOOD CUSTOMERS, WHY SHOULD WE REFRAIN?"

IN A RELATED MATTER THE SHAH IS QUOTED AS SAYING THAT HE HAS NOT DECIDED WHETHER TO PUSH FOR AN OPEC PRICE INCREASE AT THE END OF THE YEAR AND THAT HE WANTS TO CONSULT OTHER OPEC MEMBERS, PARTICULARLY SAUDI ARABIA.

COMMENT: SHAH IN PRIVATE CONVERSATIONS HAS RAISED POSSIBILITY OF OIL EMBARGO AGAINST ISRAEL--ALWAYS WITH THE CAVEAT THAT SUCH ACTION, TO BE EFFECTIVE, MUST BE TAKEN IN CONCERT WITH OTHER COUNTRIES IN A UN CONTEXT. THE TRIBUNE INTERVIEW IS THE MOST EXPLICIT PUBLIC STATEMENT ON EMBARGO POLICY AND A CHANGE FROM HIS EARLIER VIEW OF LAST YEAR THAT OIL SHOULD NOT BE USED AS POLITICAL WEAPON.

THE SHAH REPORTEDLY IS A BIT PUT OUT AT THE SOMEWHAT SENSATIONALIST TREATMENT GIVEN WHAT HE CONSIDERS AN OLD POSITION (IT DATES BACK AT LEAST SIX MONTHS TO HIS WASHINGTON VISIT), BUT THERE CAN BE LITTLE DOUBT THIS IS A CONSIDERED POSITION HE HAS TAKEN, PRESUMABLY AS PART OF HIS CONTINUING IMAGE CAMPAIGN AMONG THE ARABS BUT ALSO, WE THINK, TO PUT SOME EDGE ON HIS REPORTED GENUINE DISAPPOINTMENT AT ISRAELI RECALCITRANCE IN THE PEACE PROCESS.

1978TEHRAN05045.subject: RUMORED MINISTERIAL CHANGES SUMMARY: NUMBER OF STORIES SUGGEST SEVERAL MINISTERS WILL BE CHANGED WITHIN NEXT TWO MONTHS. MORE VAGUE RUMORS

segments.text: SUMMARY: NUMBER OF STORIES SUGGEST SEVERAL MINISTERS WILL BE CHANGED WITHIN NEXT TWO MONTHS. MORE VAGUE RUMORS SUGGEST PRIME MINISTER MAY BE IN JEOPARDY. MINOR CABINET CHANGES SEEM MOST LIKELY TO USE. END SUMMARY.

NUMBER OF EVENTS OVER PAST MONTH HAVE COMBINED TO CONVINCE MANY INDIVIDUALS THAT AT LEAST CABINET CHANGES AND PERHAPS CHANGE IN PRIME MINISTER MAY BE FORTHCOMING OVER NEXT TWO MONTHS OR SO. UNREST IN CITIES AND PERSISTENT RUMORS THAT AMBASSADOR ZAHEDI WILL RETURN TO IRAN HAVE BEEN PRINCIPAL ELEMENTS GIVING RISE TO THESE STORIES.

KNOWLEDGEABLE SOURCES SUGGEST THAT MINISTER OF HEALTH SHEIKHOLESLAMZADEH IS ON THE WAY OUT. HIS DISMISSAL HAS BEEN RUMORED FOR MONTHS AND SPECULATION ON A SUCCESSOR HAS BEEN STEADY FOR SOME TIME. RECENT REVELATIONS REGARDING HEALTH MINISTER'S INCOMPETENCE IN DEALING WITH HOSPITAL SITUATION SUGGEST HE IS INDEED ON THE WAY OUT.

MINISTER OF COMMERCE KHOSROWSHAHI HAS FOR SOME TIME BEEN UNHAPPY WITH GOI RULES REGARDING DIVESTITURE OF PRIVATE INTERESTES AND EVEN PRIME MINISTER HAS CONFIDED PRIVATELY THAT KHOSROSHAHI WILL BE LEAVING THE CABINET SHORTLY. HE IS KNOWN TO HAVE TRIED TO RESIGN TWICE PREVIOUSLY.

IN THE MORE SPECULATIVE CATEGORIES ARE THE RUMORED DEPARTURES OF INTERIOR MINISTER NASR-ESFAHANI AND MINISTER OF INFORMATION HOMAYOUN. NASR-ESFAHANI WOULD REPORTEDLY BE PICKED AS A SCAPEGOAT FOR POLICE DIFFICULTIES IN HANDLING RECENT DEMONSTRATORS. EMBASSY DOE NOT, HOWEVER, BELIEVE HIS DEPARTURE IS IMMINENT AND BELIEVES GOI, AS IT DID IN CASE OF TABRIZ RIOTS, WILL SEEK SCAPEGOATS MORE DIRECTLY CONNECTED WITH RIOT CONTROL INADEQUACIES. PRESS HAS REPORTEDLY BEEN UNHAPPY WITH HOMAYOUN FOR SOME TIME. HOWEVER, GIVEN HIS CONNECTIONS, HIS DEPARTURE WOULD REPORTEDLY TAKE THE FORM OF A PROMOTION INTO ANOTHER JOB NOT CONNECTED DIRECTLY WITH GOVERNMENT ADMINISTRATION. MOST FREQUENTLY MENTIONED JOB IS THAT OF SECRETARY GENERAL OF THE RESURGENCE PARTY.

PRIME MINISTER'S SITUATION OVER PAST MONTH HAS COME MILDLY INTO QUESTION. OVERWHELMING MAJORITY OF EDUCATEED IRANIANS SEE HIS ADMINISTRATION AS PERHAPS TECHNICALLY COMPETENT BUT POLITICALLY INADEQUATE TO DEAL WITH PROBLEMS CREATED BY RELIGIOUS DEMONSTRATORS. WHETHER THIS IS CAUSE OR EFFECT OF RUMORS CONCERNING AMBASSADOR ZAHEDI'S RETURN TO IRAN IS DIFFICULT TO SAY. IN ANY EVENT RECENT CRITICISMS OF RESURGENCE PARTY IN PRESS AND PRIVATELY COULD BE CONSTRUED AS OBLIQUE ATTACKS ON PRIME MINISTER. WHILE AMOUZEGAR HAS NEVER POLITICALLY BEEN TAGGED WITH ANY RESPONSIBILITY ARISING OUT OF ADMINISTRATIVE FAILURE TO HANDLE TABRIZ RIOTS, FACT THAT HIS UNCLE WAS SACKED AS EAST AZARBAIJAN GOVERNOR GENERAL HAS NOT BEEN MISSED.

BASIC PROBLEM IS THAT MANY IRANIANS PERCEIVE THAT GOI MUST MIX MORE IN POLITICAL ARENA AND BECOME MORE SKILLFUL AT BALANCING VARIOUS GROUPS. IRONIC FEATURE OF THIS IS THAT AMOUZEGAR WOULD HAVE MADE EXCELLENT PRIME MINISTER 2-3 YEARS AGO WHEN SUCH POLITICAL ACTIVITY WAS NOT CONTEMPLATED BY GOVERNMENT.

NIOC CHAIRMAN HOUSHANG ANSARY LEADS DISCUSSION AS POSSIBLE SUCCESSOR TO AMOUZEGAR. MANY PEOPLE, HOWEVER, REGARD ANSARY AS A BIT OF A THIEF AND NOT SOLID ENOUGH FOR PRIME MINISTER'S JOB. MANY MORE REGARD HIM AS BRIGHTEST MAN IN GOI. CONFIDENTIAL SOURCES INVOLVED IN POLITICAL BROKERING BETWEEN DISSIDENT GROUPS AND GOVERNMENT SUGGEST WHAT IRAN NEEDS IS SOLID STATESMAN, RESPECTED ON ALL SIDES.

WHILE NOT RULING OUT POSSIBILITY HOVEYDA MIGHT BE PUSHED BACK INTO PRIME MINISTERSHIP, THOUGHTS RANGE RATHER TOWARD SOMEONE SUCH AS CHIEF OF SHAH'S SPECIAL ------------------122797 260649Z /11 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 8562 SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 05045 BUREAU, GENERAL NASTRATOLLAH MOINIAN OR GENERAL HOSSEIN FARDOUST, CHIEF OF THE IMPEIAL INSPECTORATE. MOINIAN RECEIVED HIGH MARKS IN MOST SECTORS FOR HIS DEFT HANDLING OF IMPERIAL COMMISSION ON WASTE AND CORRUPTION AND BOTH HAVE EXHIBITED POLITICAL SKILLS IN PAST. WHILE MOINIAN HAS POPULAR FOLLOWING AS RESULT OF IMPERIAL COMMISSION WORK, FARDOUST DOES NOT.

FROM PUBLIC PERSPECTIVE, SELECTION OF GENERAL AS PRIME MINISTER MIGHT SEEM TO STRIKE DISCORDANT NOTE IN TERMS OF "POLITICAL LIBERALIZATION". HOWEVER, BOTH HAVE RESPECT OF BUREAUCRACY (AND SECURITY FORCES) AS WELL AS SUBSTANTIAL SEGMENTS OF PRIVATE SECTOR. THIS MIGHT COMMEND ITSELF TO SHAH, WHO IS CONCERNED WITH KEEPING MORE HARD LINE ELEMENTS OF GOI IN LINE WITH POLITICAL LIBERALIZATION. APPOINTMENT OF GEN. SHAFAQAT AS EAST AZARBAIJAN PROVINCIAL GOVERNOR AFTER TABRIZ RIOTS SUGGESTS POSSIBLE PRECEDENT.

EMBASSY DOES NOT BELIEVE SHAH PLANS MAJOR CHANGE IN GOVERNMENT, I.E. SHIFT OF PRIME MINISTERS, IN THE ABSENCE OF SOME POLITICAL DISASTER WHICH WOULD MAKE SUCH CHANGE MANDATORY. SOME MINISTERS, HOWEVER, ARE ALMOST CERTAIN TO GO, AND QUESTION IS ONLY ONE OF TIME. IN THIS CATEGORY WE WOULD PUT MINISTER OF HEALTH SHEIKHOLESLAMZADEH AND MINISTER OF COMMERCE KHOSROWSHAHI. DEPARTURE OF MINISTER OF INFORMATION HOMAYOUN AND MINISTER OF INTERIOR NASRESFAHANI ARE MUCH LESS LIKELY. OTHER CANDIDATES FOR DEPARTURE WHOSE NAMES HAVE APPEARED AT LEAST ONCE IN RUMORS ARE MINISTER OF JUSTICE KIANPUR, MINISTER OF EDUCATION GANJI, MINISTER OF HOUSING TOWFIQ, AND EVEN FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY (VICE ZAHEDI).

OF THESE, ONLY ONE EMBASSY WOULD CURRENTLY PUT IN ENDANGERED SPECIES CATEGORY WOULD BE MINISTER OF JUSTICE KIANPUR, WHO MIGHT BE FORCED TO WALK THE PLANK IF SHAH DECIDED TO MAKE WHOLESALE SHIFT ON THE INTERNAL SCENE.
WHILE MOST OF FOREGOING COMES FROM RUMOR MILL, THERE ARE CONSISTENT HINTS FROM VERY KNOWLEDGEABLE SOURCES THAT AT LEAST SOME CHANGES ARE PLANNED. ABOVE OFFERED AS SPECULATION WHICH IS CURRENT HERE.

1978TEHRAN05046.subject: INTERNAL SITUATION: UNIVERSITIES TO THE FORE

segments.text: SUMMARY: A FEW SMALL INCIDENTS OF VIOLENCE, ARREST OF 10 IN QOM, PLUS MORE PROMINENT DIFFICULTIES WITH UNIVERSITIES HAVE MARKED WEEK JUST PAST. NUMBER OF MAJLES DEPUTIES TO INCREASE SEVERAL GROUPS HAVE WRITTEN LETTERS OR OTHERWISE SUPPORTED GOI STAND AGAINST VIOLENCE. BAR ASSOCIATION INTERNAL STRUGGLE PITS DISSIDENTS AGAINST ESTABLISHMENT. END SUMMARY.

JUST A FEW INCIDENTS OF REPORTED VIOLENCE MARKED PREVIOUS WEEK IN IRAN. MAY 17, FIVE PEOPLE WERE ARRESTED IN SIRJAN FOR BREAKING INTO BUILDINGS AND IN REZAYIEH MAY 22, NUMBER OF RIOTERS (PRESS SAYS 22) WERE ARRESTED FOR MOVING FROM BAZAAR TO BREAKING WINDOWS AT THREE BANK SADERAT BRANCHES.

PROBABLY MOST INTERESTING AND SIGNIFICANT INCIDENTS WERE IN QOM, WHERE AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI SPOKE TO LARGE GROUP OF STUDENTS MAY 20, AFTER HIS TALK, NUMBER OF INDIVIDUALS WHOM CONFIDENTIAL SOURCE IDENTIFIES AS KHOMEINI SUPPORTERS AGITATED CROWD AND BEGAN DEMONSTRATING. POLICE CAME IN AND BROKE UP GROUP, ARRESTING ABOUT TEN. PRESS ACCOUNT OF INCIDENT LIMITED TO NOTICE THAT TEN WERE ARRESTED. OTHER SOURCES TELL US THAT POST TWO WEEKS HAVE SEEN MANY OTHER DEMONSTRATIONS IN QOM, AND THAT CITY REMAINS TENSE. EMBASSY INFORMED BY OBSERVER THAT ARMY, INCLUDING ARMOR, WHICH HAD BEEN IN CITY THROUGH MAY 20 WAS REMOVED EARLY THIS WEEK.

UNIVERSITIES HAVE BEEN SCENE OF MUCH ACTIVITY, WITH CLASSES CANCELLED AT MOST SCHOOLS OR PARTS OF MOST SCHOOLS. EXCEPTIONS ARE SMALLER TEHRAN UNIVERSITIES WHERE EXAMS ARE IN PROGRESS, AND TEHRAN UNIVERSITY, WHICH ANNOUNCED MAY 24 THAT CLASSES WOULD RESUME AND THOSE NOT ATTENDING WOULD BE COUNTED ABSENT (AND PRESUMABLY BOUNCED OUT OF SCHOOL WHEN THEY HAVE REACHED THEIR "CUT" LIMIT). MILD RIOTING OCCURRED AT NATIONAL AND REZAYIEH UNIVERSITIES MAY 21, WITH SOME WINDOWS BROKEN. PRESS OVER PAST FEW DAYS HAS FEATURED TABRIZ' AZARBADEGAN UNIVERSITY, WHERE CHANCELLOR MORTEZAVI RESIGNED MAY 21.

DEPUTY CHANCELLOR QOBAD FATHEY WAS NAMED ACTING CHANCELLOR, BUT HIS SITUATION STILL SOMEWHAT UNSETTLED BECAUSE SHAH HAS NOT YET ACCEPTED MORTEZAVI'S RESIGNATION FORMALLY. AZARBADEGAN UNIVERSITY COUNCIL MET MAY 24 TO DISCUSS REOPENING, BUT APPARENTLY NO DECISION REACHED. U.S. TABRIZ CONSUL METRINKO HAS LEARNED THAT FACULTY AND STAFF AT AZARBADEGAN CALLEDFOR END TO PRESENCE OF SECURITY FORCES ON CAMPUS AND RELEASE WITH NO PENALITIES FOR STUDENTS WHO HAD DEMONSTRATED AND BEEN ARRESTED IN MAY 8 RIOTS WHEN TWO STUDENTS WERE KILLED. SITUATION REMAINS DIFFICULT AND CONFLICT ON CAMPUS MAY HAVE BEEN MAJOR REASON FOR CHANCELLOR'S RESIGNATION.

BIGGEST EMERGENT BROUHAHA IS AT TEHRAN'S ARYAMEHR UNIVERSITY, WHERE FACULTY HAS CEASED TEACHING IN PROTEST AGAINST PROJECTED MOVE OF SCHOOL TO NEW ISFAHAN CAMPUS NEXT YEAR. (STUDENTS WERE ALREADY ON STRIKE) ACCORDING TO MEMBER OF 27-MAN UNIVERSITY SENATE, WHICH IS INDEPENDENT BODY UNIQUE IN IRANIAN ACADEMIC CIRCLES, FACULTY PROTEST AT MOVE BEGAN TWO YEARS AGO, WITH VISITS TO THEN-PRIME-MINISTER HOVEYDA. RECENT CALL ON CURRENT PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR REAFFIRMED GOI'S INTENTION TO MOVE SCHOOL.

RULES FOR NEW CAMPUS HAVE BEEN DRAWN TO CURTAIL INDEPENDENCE OF UNIVERSITY SENATE; THIS FACT IS SEEN AS REAL REASON FOR GOI WISH TO DISCONTINUE USE OF TEHRAN CAMPUS (DESPITE OBVIOUS NEED FOR ADDITIONAL ACADEMIC INSTITUTIONS IN IRAN). TALK GOING AROUND ARYAMEHR FACULTY IS THAT POSSIBLE COMPROMISE WILL EVENTUALLY INVOLVE SOME LOSS OF FACULTY ADMINISTRATIVE FREEDOM IN EXCHANGE ------------------122625 260626Z /14 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 8564 INFO USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY LONDON USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 05046 FOR KEEPING ALL (OR PART) OF SCHOOL IN TEHRAN.

STUDENT GROUPS IMMEDIATELY MOVED TO SUPPORT FACULTY, WHICH HAS ANNOYED MORE MODERATE TEACHERS BECAUSE ARYAMEHR FACULTY PREROGATIVES THUS BEING TIED IMPLICITLY INTO DISSIDENCE PROBLEMS. SOURCE ALSO SAID FOUR SENATE MEMBERS HAD RECEIVED THREATS FROM "UNDERGROUND COMMITTEE FOR VENGEANCE" WITHIN PAST WEEK.

MINISTRY OF INTERIOR HAS ANNOUNCED THAT FOR THE 1979 MAJLES ELECTIONS, NUMBER OF MAJLES DEPUTIES WILL BE EXPANDED FROM PRESENT 268 TO 335 TO REFLECT POPULATION CHANGES. THIS IS PURSUANT TO LAW WHICH REQUIRES GOI TO REASSESS MAJLES REPRESENTATION ON BASIS OF CENSUS EVERY TEN YEARS. MAJLES DEPUTIES INVOLVED WITH REFORMS TOLD EMBOFFS OTHER MAJOR REFORM WHICH WILL BE ENACTED IS SINGLE MEMBER LISTS FOR CITIES, WHICH HAVE UNTIL NOW ELECTED ALL DEPUTIES AT LARGE. UNDER NEW LEGISLATION, TEHRAN WILL BE DIVIDED INTO 45 DISTRICTS, AND EACH MEMBER WILL BE ELECTED FROM GIVEN AREA (ALL WERE CHOSEN "ATLARGE" IN 1975).

THIS REFORM WELCOMED BY VIRTUALLY EVERYBODY, INCLUDING MORE MODERATE DISSIDENTS WITH WHOM WE HAVE DISCUSSED IT. SOME IRANIAN OBSERVERS HAVE NOTED THIS MIGHT MAKE IT EASIER TO HAVE "MORE REPRESENTATIVE" MAJLES IF RESURGENCE PARTY CANDIDATE SELECTION MACHINERY IS NOT RPT NOT OPERATED TO EXCLUDE A SUBSTANTIAL NUMBER OF MORE MODERATE NON-ESTABLISHMENT TYPES FROM RUNNING.

GROUP OF EDITORS, SUB-EDITORS, AND REPORTERS HAS REPORTEDLY WRITTEN LETTER TO PRIME MINISTER PRAISING GOI MEASURES TO COMBAT "DISRUPTIVE ELEMENTS", AND THANKING GOI FOR "OPENING UP THE NATIONAL POLITICAL ATMOSPHERE", AND ALLOWING DISCUSSION AND EXPRESSION OF OPINION ON ALL MATTERS OF NATIONAL IMPORTANCE. WOMEN'S GROUP HAS MADE SIMILAR OFFERING (TO BE REPORTED SEPARATELY).

IN RARE PUBLIC OUTBURST, NUMBER OF YOUNG LAWYERS HAVE CHARGED THAT BAR ASSOCIATION'S OUTGOING BOARD WAS A "DONOTHING" GROUP. DISPUTE ERUPTED INTO PRESS MAY 24 WHEN OUTGOING BAR CHAIRMAN JALALI NAINI REFUSED TO COMMENT ON CHARGES AND SAID HE MUST REMAIN NEUTRAL IN MATTER BECAUSE HE IS CHAIRMAN OF ELECTIONS COMMITTEE. STORY ALSO REPORTED SPEECH OF YOUNGER LAWYERS' REPRESENTATIVE, HASSANQLIO KATEBI, AT A PROVINCIAL MEETING WHICH INDICATED YOUNGER LAWYERS HAD MET WITH PRIME MINISTER AND URGED LAWYERS BE CONSULTED IN PREPARATION OF LAWS. YOUNGER GROUP ALSO WANTS GOI GUARANTEES THAT LAWYERS WHO DEFEND "UNPOPULAR" DEFENDANTS WILL NOT BE PENALIZED.
WE UNDERSTAND FROM SEVERAL LAWYERS WITH FRIENDS ON BAR ASSOCIATION COUNCIL THAT YOUNGER GROUP PLANS TO MOUNT SERIOUS TAKEOVER ATTEMPT DURING FORTHCOMING ELECTIONS.

1978TEHRAN05047.subject: CIVAIR: FAA CIVIL AVIATION SECURITY SERVICE MEETING

segments.text: MFA INFORMED US MAY 25 THAT IRAN IS INTERESTED IN SENDING REPRESENTATIVES TO PROPOSED FAA MEETING. POLCOUNS EXPRESSED GRATITUDE AND POINTED OUT MANY OTHER COUNTRIES SIMILARLY INCLINED BUT HAVING DIFFICULTY WITH JUNE PROPOSED TIMING. THEREFORE, JUNE MEETING CANCELLED AND CURRENT SUGGESTION IS FOR ONE-DAY MEETING IN OCTOBER AT POSSIBLE EUROPEAN LOCATION. MFA INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS DEPARTMENT HEAD EHSASSI REPLIED THAT BASIC DECISION TO ATTEND HAD BEEN MADE AND QUESTION OF WHEN AND WHERE MEETING TAKES PLACE IS SECONDARY, THEREFORE, GOI WILL AWAIT FURTHER NOTIFICATION OF DATE AND PLACE FOR MEETING.

1978TEHRAN05076.subject: DISCUSSION WITH COURT MINISTER ON INTERNAL AFFAIRS OF IRAN

segments.text: COURT MINISTER HOVEYDA ASKED ME TO SEE HIM MORNING MAY 26 AT HIS RESIDENCE. HE REFERRED TO MY CONVERSATION WITH SHAH (REFTEL) AND SAID THAT, SUBSEQUENT TO THAT TALK, SHAH HAD ASKED HIM TO TAKE CHARGE OF ARRANGING RECONCILIATION BETWEEN GOVERNMENT AND MODERATE ISLAMIC CLERGY.

HOVEYDA SAID HE ACCEPTED THE ASSIGNEMENT RELUCTANTLY, SINCE HE KNOW FROM HIS DAYS AS PRIME MINISTER, THAT IT WOULD BE AWKWARD FOR AMOUZEGAR TO HAVE HOVEYDA ACTING IN A MATTER WHICH SHOULD PROPERLY BE A TASK FOR THE GOVERNMENT. HE HAD NEVERTHELESS BEGUN HIS EFFORT AND WAS PULLING TOGETHER THOSE POLITICAL PERSONALITIES WHO SHOULD BE ENGAGED IN THE EFFORT. (HUSHANG ANSARY WAS LEAVING THE RESIDENCE AS I ARRIVED.)

HOVEYDA SAID THAT THERE WOULD HAVE TO BE SOME GIVE AND TAKE IN THESE NEGOTIATIONS. IT WAS NO LONGER POSSIBLE MERELY TO TELL THE MULLAHS THE GOVERNMENT POSITION AND EXPECT THEM TO SUPPORT IT. "WE WILL HAVE TO MAKE SOME CHANGES IN OUR POSITION."

N SIMILAR VEIN, HOVEYDA WENT ON TO SAY THAT THE GOVERNEMENT NEEDED TO DO A FAR MORE EFFECTIVE JOB IN PRESENTING ITS VARIOSS PROGRAMS TO THE PUBLIC. THERE NEEDED TO BE DEBATE ON PROGRAMS IN ADVANCE OF THEIR FINAL FORMULATION SO THAT THE GENERAL PUBLIC WOULD FEEL IT HAS PLAYED SOME ROLE IN THEIR DEVELOPMENT. NEW POLITICAL SKILLS WILL BE NEEDED IN ORDER TO MAFE GOVERNEMENT PROGRAMS EFFECTIVE.

COMMENT: BY TURNING TO HOVEYDA AS THE PRINCIPAL INSTRUMENT OF HIS EFFORT TO SEEK CONCILIATION WITH THE MULLAHS, THE SHAH HAS SELECTED HIS MOST ADROIT AND EXPERIENCED POLITICIAN, WHO HAS GOOD WORKING RELATIONS WITH THE ISLAMIC CLERGY. HOVEYDA'S DEMURRER ABOUT ENGAGING IN AMOUZEGAR'S BUSINESS SHOULD BE TAKEN WITH A GRAIN OF SALT, SINCE IT WAS OBVIOUS THAT HE RELISHES HIS NEW ASSIGNMENT AND IS UNDERTAKING IT WITH CONSIDERABLE ZEAL. AS I LEFT, HE SAID HE HOPED TO AVOID A "HOT SUMMER" IN IRAN.

TEHRAN JOURNAL MAY 28 RAN THREE PARAGRAPH LETTER ON EDITORIAL PAGE FROM YAR TEHRAN EMBASSY REFUTING "UNTRUE NEWS THAT THERE HAVE BEEN SOME UPRISINGS IN SOME PARTS OF THE COUNTRY, AND THAT YEMEN IS FACING A CIVIL WAR, AND OTHER FALSE DREAMS AND WICKED HOPES". ACCORDING TO EMBASSY, ALL PARTS OF YAR " ARE IN ABSOLUTE CALMNESS AND STABILITY." UNIDENTIFIED NEWS AGENCIES AND PAPERS ARE PRINTING UNFOUNDED RUMORS "ABOUT THE UPRISING BY MAJOR ABDULLAH ABDUL-ALIM" AN OFFICER WHO"HAS BEEN EXEMPTED OF HIS POST BECAUSE OF SOME NERVE SICKNESS, AND MAJOR MOHAMMED SAYF WAS APPOINTED IN HIS PLACE AS THE COMMANDER OF THE PARATROOPS.
ALL THIS HAPPENED IN A VERY CALM AND STALBE ATMOSPHERE..."
COMMENT: EMBASSY LETTER INDICATES YAR SENSITIVITY RE ABDUL ALIM'S RELATIONSHIP WITH NEW GOVERNMENT AND CONFIRMS RECENT REPORTING FROM EMBASSY SANA.

1978TEHRAN05105.subject: BOMB THREAT--IRAN AMERICA SOCIETY ACADEMIC CENTER-- TEHRAN AT 1515 HOURS LOCAL TIME ON MONDAY, MAY 29, THE LO

segments.text: TEHRAN AT 1515 HOURS LOCAL TIME ON MONDAY, MAY 29, THE LOCAL SWITCHBOARD OPERATOR AT THE IRAN AMERICA SOCIETY ACADEMIC CENTER IN TEHRAN RECEIVED A BOMB THREAT FROM AN UNIDENTIFIED IRANIAN MALE WHO STATED IN FARSI: "THERE IS A BOMB IN THE BUILDING WHICH WILL EXPLODE IN TEN MINUTES." CALL WAS TERMINATED AFTER PASSING THIS MESSAGE. BUILDING, WHICH WAS FULL OF STUDENTS, WAS QUICKLY EVACUATED. POLICE WERE SUMMONED AND ARRIVED ALMOST IMMEDIATELY. SUBSEQUENT SEARCH PROVED NEGATIVE.

DESPITE AN OCCASIONAL INCIDENT HERE AND THERE, ADDRESSEES WILL HAVE NOTED THAT RELATIVE QUIET HAS REPLACED THE RECENT TURBULENCE ON IRAN'S INTERNAL DISSIDENT FRONT. WHILE ONE OR MORE INCIDENTS OCCURRED ALMOST DAILY OVER THE PAST COUPLE OF MONTHS, THE NUMBER HAS RECENTLY FALLEN TO THREE OR FOUR A WEEK. IN ATTEMPTING TO EXPLAIN WHY THIS IS HAPPENING WE OFFER THE FOLLOWING THOUGHTS.

THE CRACKDOWN ON STREET DEMONSTRATIONS AND VANDALISM ANNOUNCED BY THE GOVERNMENT AND PUT INTO EFFECT BY THE SECURITY SERVICES AS OF MAY 11 WAS PROBABLY ONE REASON. ARRESTS OF SEVERAL HUNDRED DEMONSTRATORS IN TEHRAN ALONE (ONLY SOME OF THEM SINCE RELEASED) HAS PROBABLY REDUCED THE NUMBER OF ACTIVE, TRUSTWORTHY CADRES AVAILABLE TO THOSE WHO WOULD MAKE TROUBLE ON THE STREETS. IT HAS PROBABLY SCARED OFF CASUAL DEMONSTRATORS WHO WOULD PREFER TO HIT AND RUN WITHOUT BEING ARRESTED, WHILE FORCING THE LEADERSHIP (PRO-KHOMEINI OR OTHERWISE) TO GIVE SOME THOUGHT TO RATIONAING ITS CADRES FOR THE LONG HAUL.

THE SECOND REASON PROBABLY IS THAT 40-DAY COMMEMORATIONS AT THE END OF MOURNING PERIODS FOR DEMONSTRATORS KILLED IN CLASHES WITH SECURITY SERVICES PROVIDE EXCELLENT OPPORTUNITIES FOR DEMONSTRATING IN A MORE FAVORABLE CONTEXT THAN OTHER TIMES. ATTENDANCE AT MOSQUES ON SUCH OCCASIONS GIVES POTENTIAL DEMONSTRATORS AN INNOCENTLY LEGITIMATE PURPOSE TO CONGREGATE AND BUTTRESSES THEIR PLEAS OF INNOCENCE IF THEY ARE SUBSEQUENTLY HAULED BEFORE A CIVILIAN COURT. BY THE SAME TOKEN, SUCH OCCASIONS HELP MOBILIZE MORE DISINTERESTED RELIGIOUS PEOPLE IN SUPPORT OF THE RING LEADERS, THUS SWELLING THE SIZE OF THE DEMONSTRATIONS AND GIVING GOVERNMENT SECURITY SERVICES A MORE TYRANNICAL APPEARANCE AS THEY TRY TO ESTABLISH LAW AND ORDER.

PERHAPS THE MOST IMPORTANT OF ALL REASONS DERIVES FROM THE MOTIVATION OF THE MAJORITY OF RELIGIOUS LEADERS IN THE COUNTRY. THESE CONSERVATIONS HAVE FOUND IT USEFUL, OR NECESSARY, TO JOIN THE EXTREMISTS MANAGED FROM HIS IRAQI EXILE BY AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, BUT THEIR MOTIVATION IS DIFFERENT FROM HIS. UNLIKE KHOMEINI, WHO MAKES NO SECRET THAT HIS INTENTION IS TO OVERTHROW THE SHAH AND SEVERELY RESTRICT THE MONARCHY, THESE LEADERS HAVE MORE LIMITED AIMS IN MIND. CHIEFLY, THEY WISH TO CALL ATTENTION TO THEIR GRIEVANCES. AS LONG AS THE GOVERNMENT WAS PAYING LITTLE ATTENTIONTO THEM, THEY HAD NO REASON TO WITHHOLD SUPPORT FOR KHOMEINI.

NOW THERE ARE INDICATIONS THAT THE GOVERNMENT IS BEGINNING TO LISTEN. THE SHAH'S INTERVIEW TO IRANIAN PRESS MEN ON MAY 13 INSTRUCT SOME OF THESE LEADERS AS REASONABLY CONCILIATORY--WHATEVER MAY HAVE BEEN THE REACTION OF OTHERS CLOSE TO THE SHAH (TEHRAN 4836) OR IN THE NATIONAL FRONT LAY OPPOSITION (BEING REPORTED SEPARATELY). WE KNOW THAT EFFORTS ARE ON THE WAY BEHIND THE SCENES TO GET DIALOGUE GOING WITH THE RELIGIOUS CONSERVATIVES, SPLITTING THEM OFF FROM KHOMEINI IF POSSIBLE.

SINCE MANY OF THESE RELIGIOUS LEADERS SEE THE MONARCHY AS A NECESSARY INSTITUTION WHICH HELPS PROTECT ISLAM AGAINST COMMUNIST CHALLENGES, AND NO ALTERNATIVE TO THE SHAH IS APPARENT TO ANYONE, THEY PROBABLY ARE PREPARED TO BE REASONABLE AND SETTLE FOR A RATIONAL, RESPONSIVE ATTITUDE ON THE PART OF THE GOVERNEXENT WITHOUT ANY MAJOR CHANGES IN INSTITUTIONS. RATHER, THEY HOPE FOR A MORE UNDERSTANDING APPLICATION OF LAWS AND REGULATIONS AND A GREATER, MORE PUBLIC RECOGNITION OF THE CONTINUING IMPORTANCE OF RELIGION IN IRANIAN LIFE.

OF COURSE, THE DIALOGUE PROCESS HAS NOT GONE VERY FAR YET, AND ONLY A FEW TOP LEADERS ARE AWARE OF IT. THUS THERE ARE LIKELY TO BE MORE RELIGIOUSLY ORIENTATED DISTURBANCES IN THE COMING WEEKS, BUT THEIR MAGNITUDE MAY BE REDUCED AND LONGER PERIODS OF CALM BETWEEN INCIDENTS. WE HAVE BEEN TOLD, FOR EXAMPLE, THAT MINOR DISTURBANCES ARE POSSIBLE AROUND JUNE 5, THE OCCASION BEING OBSCURE, BUT PROBABLY RELATED TO SOME MOURNING PERIOD. WE ARE ALSO TOLD TO EXPECT MORE SERIOUS DISTURBANCES AROUND JUNE 19, WHICH IS 40 DAYS AFTER THE KILLING OF SOME ACOLYTES OF AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI IN HIS OWN HOUSE BY POLICE MAY 10.

OUR PURPOSE IN SUPPLYING THE ABOVE ANALYSIS HAS BEEN MAINLY TO MARK THE OCCASIONS OF REDUCED VIOLENCE AND TROUBLE HERE WITHOUT IMPLYING THAT THE GOVERNMENT IS YET OUT OF THE WOODS. HARD, DEDICATED EFFORTS WILL STILL BE REQUIRED ON THE PART OF GOVERNMENT LEADERS SUCH AS COURT MINISTER HOVEYIA BEFORE THE TREND OF THE PAST FIVE OR SIX MONTHS CAN BE REVERSED. BUT A BEGINNING IS BEING MADE.

ACCORDING TO MFA'S KAZEMI, GOI REPRESENTATIVE FOR LOS, IRANIANS HAVE NOT YET GIVEN THOUGHT TO COMPOSITION OF POTENTIAL DELEGATION TO LOS RESUMED SEVENTH SESSION. KAZEMI TOLD DCM THAT HE HAD NOT FAVORED SUCH A QUICK RESUMPTION OF NEGOTIATIONS AND DOES NOT BELIEVE SUCH HASTE WAS REQUIRED. (VOTE WAS 51-46 FOR EARLY RESUMPTION, HE NOTED).

WITH REGARD TO OUTCOME OF SEVENTH SESSION, KAZEMI FEELS THAT FIRST COMMITTEE MADE GOOD PROGRESS AND THAT THE SECOND WAS DOING WELL, BUT AS NEGOTIATORS PURSUED SUCH COMPLICATED MATTERS AS THE CONTINENTAL SHELF, NEW ISSUES KEPT COMING UP WHICH REQUIRE A GREAT DEAL OF FURTHER DISCUSSION. OVERALL KAZEMI EXPRESSED SATISFACTION WITH JUST CONCLUDED SESSION.
COMMENT: KAZEMI, AS POINT OF CONTINUITY FOR GOI THROUGHOUT THESE PROTRACTED NEGOTIATIONS, WILL UNDOUBTEDLY HEAD THE IRANIAN DELEGATION TO RESUMED SESSION.

AS OF MAY 28 SHAH AND EMPRESS ARE MAKING ANNUAL PILGRIMAGE TO HOLY CITY OF MASHAD. ACCOMPANIED BY GREATER THAN NORMAL PRESS AND TV COVERAGE, SHAH SPOKE TO CLERGYMENT AT THE HOLY SHRINE OF IMAM REZA ON FIRST DAY OF VISIT.

THEME OF SHAH'S MESSAGE WAS WARNING THAT THREAT TO THE SECURITY OF IRAN COULD ALSO POSE THREAT TO IRAN'S ISLAMIC HERITAGE: "IF THIS COUNTRY IS PRESERVED IN A STRONG POSITION, IT WILL AUTOMATICALLY ASSIST THE SPREAD OF OUR RELIGIOUS BELIEFS." SHAH ALSO REVIEWED PROGRESS ON RELIGIOUS FRONT MADE SINCE ADVENT OF PAHLAVI DYNASTY CITING EXAMPLES SUCH AS RESTORATION OF IMAM REZA SHRINE AND HIS OWN "DEEP INTEREST IN RELIGION AS WELL AS HOW I RUN THE COUNTRY."

IN RESPONSE TO SHAH'S ADDRESS, MASHAD CLERGY GAVE THEIR ASSESSMENT OF PROBLEMS CONFRONTING IRANIAN YOUTH. ACCORDING TO THE CLERGY, THE YOUNGER GENERATION DOES NOT HAVE SUFFICIENT UNDERSTANDING OF TRUE PRINCIPLES OF ISLAM AND THE MASS MEDIA AND EDUCATIONAL SYSTEM MUST BE MORE RESPONSIVE TO STEER PUBLIC AWAY FROM CORRUPT VIEWS AND UNETHICAL ATTITUDES.

ON SECOND DAY IN MASHAD SHAH SPOKE TO WORKERS AT IRAN NATIONAL AUTOMOBILE SPARE PARTS COMPLEX. SHAH REFERRED TO EXPANSION OF INDUSTRIAL OWNERSHIP BY WHICH FACTORY WORKERS ARE ENTITLED TO BUY SHARES OF THEIR FACTORIES (319 OF 1,000 WORKERS ARE SHARE HOLDERS AT MASHAD PLANT). URGING WORKERS TO LEARN ABOUT CONDITIONS IN OTHER COUNTRIES, HE SAID THE GOVERNMENT WOULD FINANCE TRIPS ABROAD FOR WORKERS TO COMPARE FOR THEMSELVES.

COMMENT: ANNUAL MASHAD TRIP GAVE SHAH OPPORTUNITY TO PURSUE HIS "OPENING TO THE RIGHT" CAMPAIGN TO MOLLIFY CONCERNED CLERGY. PROMINENTLY PUBLICIZED RECEPTION WITH "TENS OF THOUSANDS" LINING FLOWER-STREWN ROUTE FROM AIRPORT TO SHIRINE AND HEAVY COVERAGE OF EMPRESS IN FULL LENGTH CADOR GARB WILL NOT BE LOST ON ISLAMIC COMMUNITY IN OTHER PARTS OF IRAN. ONE INTERESTING FACET OF SHRINE VISIT WAS "EXCHANGE OF VIEWS" BETWEEN SHAH AND ISLAMIC LEADERS. ALTHOUGH NEITHER TOLD THE OTHER ANYTHING NEW, AT LEAST A DIALOGUE IS UNDERWAY.

1978TEHRAN05135.subject: PERMANENT SITE FOR INTERNATIONAL FUND FOR AGRICULTURAL DEVELOPMENT (IFAD)

segments.text: EMBASSY HAS NOTED WITH MUCH INTEREST OPEC FINANCE MINISTER'S PRESS COMMUNIQUE OF MAY 23, REPORTED REFTEL A, INTER ALIA, QUOTING FINANCE MINISTERS AS SUPPORTING "ESTABLISHING THE PERMANENT SEAT OF IFAD IN TEHRAN, IRAN." AS DEPARTMENT KNOWS, GOI IN MAY 1977 PUSHED STRONGLY TO HAVE IFAD PERMANENTLY LOCATED IN TEHRAN EVEN THOUGH IFAD HAD BARELY BEEN SET UP AND IFAD'S INITIAL RESOURCES HAD NOT YET BEEN COMMITTED. REF B 77 STATE 099214 PROVIDED RATIONALE FOR OUR WISHING TO AVOID CONFRONTATION ON THE SITE SELECTION ISSUE AT THAT TIME.

SUBSEQUENTLY, ANF FOLLOWING OUR PRESENTATION OF AN AIDE MEMOIRE TO GOI AS INSTRUCTED BY WASHINGTON, EMBASSY WAS INFORMED BY MFA THAT IRAN WOULD NOT RPT NOT MAKE AN ISSUE OF SITE QUESTION BUT WOULD MOVE AHEAD TO RATIFY IFAD (REFTEL C). NOW THAT IRAN EVIDENTLY HAS IN HAND ALL CATEGORY II VOTES FAVORING TEHRAN AS PERMANENT IFAD SITE, AND ASSUMING THAT GOI IS MOVING TO CAPTURE AS MANY CATEGORY III VOTES AS IT CAN, EMBASSY JUDGES THAT IFAD SITE ISSUE HAS COME ALIVE ONCE AGAIN.

EMBASSY HAS NOT APPROACHED GOI AT ANY LEVEL FOR FURTHER PARTICULARS ON ANNOUNCEMENT REPORTED REFTEL A LEST THIS PROMPT GOI TO SEEK OUR SUPPORT ON TEHRAN AS PERMANENT IFAD SITE. NONETHELESS, EMBASSY ASSUMES THAT U.S. WILL BE HEARING FROM IRANIANS ON THIS ISSUE, IF NOT IN TEHRAN THEN ROME, NEW YORK OR WASHINGTON. EMBASSY CAN ONLY CONJECTURE AS TO DEPTH OF IRANIAN FEELING ON THIS ISSUE BUT WE WOULD NOT BE AT ALL SURPRISED IF IRAN'S INTEREST DEEPLY HELD AND AT A HIGH LEVEL.

ACTION REQUESTED: DEPARTMENT PLEASE SUPPLY EMBASSY WITH GUIDANCE ON CURRENT U.S. POSITION RE PERMANENT SITE FOR IFAD. QUERY: HAS IFAD PREPARED ANY STUDIES ON RESPECTIVE COSTS AND BENEFITS OF VARIOUS POSSIBLE SITES?

1978TEHRAN05152.subject: WAIVER OF IMMUNITY - JACK N. SNYDER

segments.text: STARRETT HAS WITHDRAWN EMPLOYMENT OFFER TO SNYDER IN LIGHT PROTRACTED DELAY IN DEPARTMENT'S RESPONSE TO REFTEL, SENT MAY 8.
SNYDER SEEKING ALTERNATIVE EMPLOYER.
PLEASE ADVISE PROBLEM (S) DEPARTMENT ENCOUNTERED WITH SNYDER REQUEST AND ESTIMATED TIME NEEDED FOR APPROVAL SUCH REQUESTS SO DEPENDENTS CAN ADVISE WOULD-BE EMPLOYERS.

1978TEHRAN05177.subject: INTERNAL DEVELOPMENTS: GOVERNMENT PITCH TO OPPOSITION AND OTHER MOVES. SUMMARY: EXCEPT FOR SHOOTOUT WITH TWO TERRORISTS N

segments.text: OPPOSITION AND OTHER MOVES. SUMMARY: EXCEPT FOR SHOOTOUT WITH TWO TERRORISTS NEAR KARAJ, COUNTRY HAS CONTINUED RELATIVELY QUIET FOR PAST WEEK. GOI SPOKESMAN HAVE CALLED FOR A FAIR HEARING FOR ALL OPPOSITIONISTS WHO ARE WILLING TO EXPRESS BASIC LOYALTY TO COUNTRY AND MONARCHY. PRIME MINISTER HAS CALLED FOR WAR ON RED TAPE. GOI APPEARS TO BE MOVING IN DIRECTION OF TACIT/INDIRECT ADMISSION OF SOME OPPOSITIONISTS INTO POLITICAL PROCESS ON ONE HAND AND ON OTHER, TOWARD IMPROVEMENT IN GOI SERVICES TO CITIZENS. END SUMMARY.

PRESS CARRIED STORY OF DEATHS OF TWO TERRORISTS, ONE A WOMAN, IN APOLICE SHOOTOUT AFTER PAIR HAD ALLEGEDLYKIDNAPPED A DOCTOR AND HIS FAMILY AND HAD HELD THEM HOSTAGE FOR TEN HOURS. DEAD OF WOUNDS WERE SOLAIMAN PAVASTEH HAJI MAHALEH AND MS. RAFAT MEMARAN BENAM. ALL MEMBERS OF THE KIDNAPPED FAMILY WERE SAFE.

MINISTER OF INFORMATION HELD A PRESS CONFERENCE MAY 27 WHICH COVERED NUMBER OF DOMESTIC ISSUES. RECEIVING WIDE PUBLICITY WAS HIS STATEMENT THAT THOSE WHO DECLARE THEIR FAITH IN THE COUNTRY AND MONARCHY WILL BE GIVEN A FAIR HEARING. RESPONDING TO PRESS QUESTION WHY GOI TARS ALL DISSIDENTS WITH SAME BRUSH, HOMAYOUN SAID GOI "INVITES ALL PATRIOTIC ELEMENTS WHO SUPPORT MONARCHY TO COME FORWARD AND STATE THEIR CASE." MINISTER SUGGESTED SOME DISSIDENT GROUPS LACK INDEPENDENT POSITIONS. ON OTHER ISSUES, HOMANYOUN SAID THERE WOULD BE NO WATER AND POWER SHORTAGES IN IRAN, THOUGH REPAIRS TO NATIONAL POWER GRID MAY LEAD TO SOME "TEMPORARY" CUTS.
IN COMMENT ON IRANIAN STUDENTS IN U.S., MINISTER SAID THOSE DEPORTED FOR BREAKING LAWS DO NOT RPT NOT DESERVE ANY SUPPORT FROM TEHRAN.

ECHOING MINISTER'S REMARKS ON LOYALTY, FULL-COLUMN EDITORIAL IN FRENCH JOURNAL DE TEHRAN ON MAY 29 (BEING POUCHED) REVIEWED HOMAYOUN'S REMARKS AND ANALYZED DIFFERENCES IN OPPOSITION GROUPS. EDITORIAL MADE IMPORTANT DISTINCTION BETWEEN RELIGIOUS GROUPS LOYAL TO EXILED AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, WHO WISH TO OVERTHROW SHAH, AND THOSE WHO SEE MONARCHY AS BULWARK OF IRAN AND ARE THEREFORE MORE MODERATE. DISTINCTION ALSO MADE BETWEEN GROUPS WITHIN THE NATIONAL FRONT WHO ARE REVOLUTIONARY LEFTIST AND THOSE WHO ARE "NATIONALISTS AND LIBERAL." EDITORIAL MADE FLAT STATEMENT THAT GOI CANNOT ACCEPT CONTACT WITH THOSE OPPOSED TO THE REGIME, AND CALLED UPON OTHERS TO ACCEPT MONARCHY AND BEGIN TALKING.

EDITORIAL WAS OF OFFICIALLY INSPIRED, ACCORDING TO SENIOR PRESSMAN, AND TO EMBASSY'S KNOWLEDGE, IS FIRST TIME GOI EITHER FORMALLY OR INFORMALLY HAS SUGGESTED SOME DISSIDENTS ARE LESS DISSIDENT THAN OTHERS. THIS IS A VERY USEFUL DEPARTURE IN EMBASSY'S OPINION.

MEANWHILE, MAY 29, PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR ANNOUNCED FORMATION OF SPECIAL COMMITTEES IN ALL MINISTRIES TO BATTLE "RED TAPE AND PETTY OFFICIALDOM". THIS IS THIRD TIME IN RECENT WEEKS PM HAS STRESSED IN PUBLIC IMPROVED ADMINISTRATIVE EFFICIENCY EITHER IN GOVERNMENT OR RESURGENCE PARTY OR BOTH. AMOUZEGAR ALSO SAID CABINET WAS FOCUSING ON PROBLEMS CREATED BY OVERPAID URBANIZATION AND INSTANT SHANTYTOWNS AROUND LARGE CITIES. HE CALLED ON GOI TO MINIMIZE BAD EFFECTS OF THIS DEVELOPMENT.
EMBOFF HAD INTERESTING DISCUSSION WITH DIRECTOR IN QUEEN'S BUREAU SECRETARIAT, WHO ECHOED CONCERN WITH PROBLEMS OF GOVERNMENTAL EFFICIENCY AND CONCERN WITH PEOPLE.

HE CONFIRMED QUEEN'S INCREASED PUBLIC ACTIVITY IN PAST ------------------033100 010630Z /15 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 8637 INFO USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY LONDON USCINCER VAIHINGEN GE SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 05177 TWO-THREE WEEKS INVOLVING VISITS TO CITIES AND NOTED QUEEN'S SPECIAL BUREAU DIRECTOR NAHAVANDI HAD PUT BUREAU STAFF TO WORK GENERATING IDEAS BOTH WITHIN AND OUTSIDE GOI TO DEAL WITH PROBLEMS CAUSED BY "INSTANT URBANIZATION." SOURCE SAID COURT WAS COMING TO CONCLUDE THAT ORIGINAL DECISION NOT RPT NOT TO PROVIDE CITY SERVICES TO NEW SHANTYTOWNS WHICH HAD GROWN UP (FOR FEAR OF MAKING THEM EVEN MORE ATTRACTIVE TO RURAL DWELLERS) WAS "PROBABLY A MISTAKE." SHANTYTOWNS AND URBAN SLUMS EXPANDED RAPIDLY AT TIME OF LAND REFORM (BEGINNING 1963) WHEN MANY RURAL DWELLERS, UNCERTAIN WITH THEIR NEWFOUND FREEDOM, HAD FLOCKED TO CITIES AND OVERSUBSCRIBED PROFFERED INDUSTRIAL JOBS.
SAME THING HAD HAPPENED AT TIME OF OIL BOOM (1973 AND GOI WAS NOW FACED WITH CONSEQUENCES.

SAME SOURCE COMMENTED THAT COURT'S COMMUNICATION WITH RELIGIOUS LEADERS WAS "BETTER THAN GOVERNMENT'S." HE NOTED THAT GOI'S (READ PRIME MINISTER) TIES WITH RELIGIOUS COMMUNITY WERE NOT ALL THAT BAD, BUT CONCEDED THERE HAD BEEN BREAKDOWN AFTER QOM EVENTS (JAN. 9, 1978) WHICH HAD NOT RPT NOT BEEN FULLY HEALED. ALTHOUGH VERY CIRCUMSPECT, HE LEFT DEFINITE IMPRESSION THAT MANY IN HIS BUREAU, INCLUDING HIS BOSS, FELT AMOUZEGAR WAS NOT GOOD AT THIS KIND OF POLITICKING. SOURCE ADDED PM WAS ADMIRED BY MOST IN GOI FOR DOING EXCELLENT AND VERY DIFFICULT JOB OF QUIETLY SHAKING UP GOVERNMENT AND PRESSING TOWARD BETTER PERFORMANCE.
SOURCE ADDED WRYLY THAT PRIME MINISTER WOULD PROBABLY NEVER GET CREDIT FOR THIS, EVEN IF HE SUCCEEDED IN MOVING "THE IMMOVABLE OBJECT."

COMMENT: HOMAYOUN APPEAL, AND FRENCH PRESS EDITORIAL, TAKEN TOGETHER WITH OTHER SIGNS OF PAST TWO WEEKS SUGGEST GOI IS NOW MOVING TOWARD MORE CONCILIATORY STRATEGY IN DEALING WITH OPPOSITION. PROCESS IS LIKELY, HOWEVER, TO BE FITFUL ONE. OPPOSITIONISTS OF OUR ACQUAINTANCE ARE DEEPLY SUSPICIOUS OF SHAH'S MOTIVES AND SINCERITY IN MOVING TOWARD FREER POLITICAL SYSTEM, AND "SHOW ME" ATTITUDE ON ALL SIDES, AS WELL AS SUBSTANTIAL POLICY DIFFERENCES, ARE LIKELY TO INHIBIT DIALOG.

ON OTHER HAND, GOI IS CLEARLY SERIOUS ABOUT IMPROVING SERVICES TO CITIZENRY. PUBLIC STATEMENTS NOTED ABOVE, PLUS RECENT IMPERIAL COMMISSION REPORTS FOCUSING ON BETTER GOVERNMENT PERFORMANCE, HAVE PENETRATED TO LOWER LEVELS OF GOI WHO ARE BECOMING MORE SENSITIVE TO CHARGES THEY ARE NOT RESPONSIVE TO CITIZENRY. THIS DOES NOT MEAN WEBBERIAN MILLENIM IS AROUND THE CORNER IN IRAN, SIMPLY THAT PETTY BUREAUCRAT IS BEING PRESSED TO SUPPRESS HIS ANNOYANCE, AND MAYBE EVEN FEEL A QUALM OR TWO, WHEN HE KEEPS PEOPLE WAITING FOR SERVICE.

1978TEHRAN05195.subject: IMPERIAL COMMISSION TARGETS ADMINISTRATIVE INEFFICIENCY SUMMARY: GOI IS AGAIN PUSHING ADMINISTRATIVE REFORM. IT REMAINS TO BE SEEN WHAT ACTUAL IMPRO VEMENTS WILL R

segments.text: SUMMARY: GOI IS AGAIN PUSHING ADMINISTRATIVE REFORM. IT REMAINS TO BE SEEN WHAT ACTUAL IMPROVEMENTS WILL RESULT. END SUMMARY.

ELEVENTH SESSION OF THE IMPERIAL COMMISSION HELD ON MAY 20 AT SAADABAD PALACE HEARD SPEECHES FROM GOVERNMENT LEADERS AND REVIEWED REPORTS OF ITS VARIOUS INSPECTORATE COMMITTEES. NOSRATOLLAH MOINIAN, CHIEF OF THE SHAH'S SPECIAL BUREAU AND COORDINATOR OF THE IMPERIAL COMMISSION, WARNED THAT LACK OF RESPONSIBILITY AND COORDINATION, WHICH TEND TO DELAY NATIONAL DEVELOPMENT PROJECTS, WILL NOT BE TOLERATED. REVIEWING COMMISSION INSPECTORATE REPORTS FOR THE PAST YEAR, MOINIAN SAID INVESTIGATIONS INDICATED THAT OFFICIALS WERE RESPONSIBLE FOR SHORTCOMINGS IN A NUMBER OF PROJECTS. THE IMPERIAL COMMISSION INSPECTED ALMOST 15,000 PROJECTS AND MOINIAN CITED TWO AREAS OF SERIOUR MISMANAGEMENT.

IN THE FIRST INSTANCE MANAGEMENT WEAKNESS IN ELECTRICITY PROJECTS CAUSED HEAVY DAMAGE TO THE NATIONAL ECONOMY DURING THE PAST YEAR, SECONDLY, A NUMBER OF DEVELOPMENT PROJECTS UNDER THE RESPONSIBILITY OF PLAN AND BUDGET ORGANIZATION WERE NOT PROPERLY PLANNED OR SUPERVISED.

SHAH'S MESSAGE TO COMMISSION MEMBERS, READ BY COURT MINISTER HOVEYDA, STRESSED VITAL IMPORTANCE OF FULL MOBILIZATION OF MANPOWER AND NECESSITY TO INCREASE WORKERS KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND EFFICIENCY PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR REFERRED TO ADMINISTRATIVE BOTTLENECKS WHICH ARE DELAYING DEVELOPMENT PROJECTS AND CAUSING PUBLIC DISSATISFACTION. HE CALLED FOR AN ADMINISTRATIVE REVOLUTION TO CUT EXCESS RED TAPE.

IN THE FIRST OF A SERIES OF RELATED ACTIONS THE PRIME MINISTER IN A MAY 17 PRESS CONFERENCE CRITICIZED THE "INAPPROPRIATE APPROACH OF SOME GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS" AND ADMITTED THAT A GOOD DEAL OF PUBLIC DISSATISFACTION IS BEING CAUSED BY THESE OFFICIALS. HE REFERRED SPECIFICALLY TO THOSE WORKERS WHO DO NOT RESPOND TO REQUESTS FOR SERVICE BUT ACKNOWLEDGED THAT "THE ATTITUDE OF 700,000 GOVERNMENT WORKERS CANNOT BE CHANGED OVERNIGHT". FYI: IN ORDER TO GARNER PUBLIC APPROVAL A HIGHLY PUBLICIZED GOVERNMENT WIDE AUSTERITY PROGRAM IS UNDERWAY WITH SUCH MEASURES AS REDUCTION OF 100 GOVERNMENT POSITIONS ABROAD AND THE REQUIREMENT THAT ALL GOI OFFICIALS MUST USE LOCALLY MANUFACTURED CARS.

ON MAY 29, FOLLOWING CABINET DISCUSSION, AMOUZEGAR ANNOUNCED THAT SPECIAL COMMITTEES WOULD BE ESTABLISHED IN EACH MINISTRY TO RECEIVE COMPLAINTS FROM PUBLIC. COMMITTEES WILL CONSIST OF FIVE TO SEVEN MEMBERS, HALF OF WHOM WILL BE NOMINATED BY RASTAKHIZ PARTY (PUBLIC MEMBERS) AND HELF FROM THE APPROPRIATE MINISTRY. ON MAY 30, AMOUZEGAR, CONTINUING HIS CAMPAIGN, ADDRESSED A MEETING OF ALL GOVERNMENT WORKERS, DIRECTOR GENERAL AND ABOVE, AND CALLED FOR A "NATION WIDE MORAL MOBILIZATION TO ELIMINATE IRRESPONSIBILITY AND INABILITY TO MAKE DECISIONS TO TRY AND REMOVE PUBLIC DISSATISFACTION AS FAR AS POSSIBLE".

COMMENT: LATEST GOVERNMENT CAMPAIGN FOR GREATER ADMINISTRATIVE EFFICIENCY HAS PINPOINTED A MAJOR CAUSE OF PUBLIC DISSATISFACTION--LACK OF ACCESS BY THE PUBLIC TO GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS AND THE LATTER'S INABILITY TO MAKE DECISIONS. MEDIA COMMENTS HAVE BEEN UNIFORMLY SUPPORTIVE OF "ADMINISTRATIVE REFORM", ONE DAILY NOTING EDITORIALLY THAT THE PRESENT INITIATIVES ARE THE FIRST CONCRETE STEP TOWARD IMPLEMENTATION OF THE SO CALLED ADMINISTRATIVE REVOLUTION (PRINCIPLE NUMBER 12 OF THE SHAH-PEOPLE REVOLUTION) SINCE IT WAS ANNOUNCED IN 1965. A CAUTIONARY NOTE MAY BE IN ORDER, HOWEVER, SINCE A NUMBER OF EARLIER GOVERNMENT PROGRAMS OF ONE SORT OR ANOTHER HAVE BEEN STARTED WITH GREAT EXPECTATIONS ONLY TO WITHER ON THE VINE.

ADMINISTRATIVE "REFORM" IS A PARTICULARLY INTRACTABLE PROBLEM SINCE IT IS NO SECRET THAT THE CONCEPT OF PUBLIC SERVICE, AN ALIEN TRADITION, IS NOT WELL DEVELOPED WITHIN THE GOI BUREAUCRACY.GOVERNMENT CREDIBILITY IS AGAIN BEING TESTED AND THIS LATEST INITIATIVE COULD BOOMERANG AND BECOME COUNTERPRODUCTIVE-- ONCE MORE RAISING EXPECTATIONS WHICH REMAIN UNFULFILLED.

1978TEHRAN05225.subject: OPPOSITIONISTS CALLING FOR STAY-HOME ON JUNE 5

segments.text: EMBASSY HAS LEARNED FROM SEVERAL SOURCES, INCLUDING LEADERSHIP OF LIBERATION MOVEMENT OF IRAN, THAT DISSIDENT GROUPS HAVE JOINED TOGETHER IN A CALL FOR PEOPLE TO REMAIN AT HOME JUNE 5, WHICH IS 15TH ANNIVERSARY OF ARMY'S FORCEIBLE SUPPRESSION OF NATIONAL FRONT RIOTS OF 1963. DESCRIBED BY TWO DISSIDENTS AND AT LEAST ONE LEAFLET AS "GENERAL STRIKE," GOAL OF EVENT IS TO BRING COUNTRY TO A STOP FOR ONE DAY, OR AT LEAST MAKE SEVERE IN ROADS INTO NORMAL OPERATIONS.

DISSIDENT LEADERS TOLD EMBOFF MAY 30 THAT SAVAK HAD WARNED MOSQUES NOT RPT NOT HOLD COMMEMORATIVE SERVICES JUNE 5, AND OPPOSITIONISTS, NOT WISHING TO CAUSE VIOLENCE, HIT UPON IDEA OF STAY-AT-HOME GENERAL STRIKE. RELIGIOUS SOURCES IN ISFAHAN HAVE INFORMED CONSULATE THAT JUNE 5 MARKS 15TH ANNIVERSARY OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI'S EXILE (SIC), AND PEOPLE ARE BEING URGED TO SHOW SOLIDARITY WITH RELIGIOUS GROUPS ON THIS OCCASION AS EVIDENCE THEY WANT HIM TO COME BACK TO IRAN.

CONSULATE ISFAHAN ALSO REPORTS THERE ARE RUMORS OF MASS DEMONSTRATIONS TO BE HELD IN QOM, AND POSSIBLE A MARCH ON TEHRAN BY QOM MULLAHS WHOSE INTENTION IS TO CLOSE QOM-TEHRAN ROAD. THIS SEEMS UNLIKELY, IN VIEW OF GOVERNMENT EFFORTS TO BE READY FOR ANYTHING THAT COMES. MOST FAR-OUT RUMOR CURRENTLY CIRCULATING AMONG SOME SMALLER EMBASSIES HERE IS THAT THERE WILL BE A MARCH ON NIAVARAN PALACE ON JUNE 5. AGAIN, EMBASSY BELIEVES THIS IS VERY UNLIKELY.

POLICE IN ISFAHAN HAVE CAUTIONED FOREIGNERS TO AVOID UNNECESSARY TRIPS TO UNIVERSITIES AND BAZAAR, IN TEHRAN, NORMAL PRUDENCE FOR UNSETTLED DAYS BEING COUNSELED. THERE HAVE BEEN NO REPEAT NO ANTI-AMERICAN MANIFESTATIONS ACCOMPANYING THIS DEVELOPMENT. EMBASSY CLOSELY MONITORING EMERGING DEVELOPMENTS.

MFA HEAD OF INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS DEPARTMENT ASSURED POLCOUNS MAY 30 THAT ARGUMENTS CONTAINED REFTEL WILL BE TAKEN EFFECTIVELY INTO CONSIDERATION AS GOI WORKS OUT INSTRUCTIONS FOR ITS REPRESENTATIVES TO ILO CONFERENCE JUNE 7-28. SAME DAY, MINISTER OF LABOR TOLD LABOR REPORTING OFFICER THAT IRANIAN DELEGATION WILL AS USUAL LOOK OUT FOR AND FAVOR U.S. INTERESTS. BOTH MEN EXPRESSED REGRET AT CONTINUED U.S. ABSENCE FROM ILO AND HOPE U.S. COULD SEE ITS WAY CLEAR TO RETURNING SOON SO AS TO SWING ITS CONSIDERABLE INFLUENCE FROM WITHIN THE ORGANIZATION.
AN AIDE MEMOIRE CONTAINING MAIN POINTS EXTRACTED FROM REFTEL WAS LEFT WITH MFA.

SUMMARY: "STAY-HOME" BEING URGED BY DISSIDENTS, UNIVERSITIES SCENE OF VIOLENT RIOTS, UNREST. SHAH STANDS FIRM AGAINST DISRUPTION BY "SO-CALLED PEOPLES GUERILLAS." HUSHANG ANSARY RESIGNS AS RESURGENCE PARTY'S CONSTRUCTIVE WING CHIEF. PRIME MINISTER CONTINUES PUSH TO ELIMINATE RED TAPE. END SUMMARY.
OPPOSITIONIST ELEMENTS HAVE CALLED FOR ALL PEOPLE TO STAY AT HOME JUNE 5 (BEING REPORTED IN DETAIL BY SEPTEL) RATHER THAN TO CONGREGATE AT MOSQUES.

OVER PAST TWO DAYS, THERE HAVE BEEN RIOTS AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY DORMITORIES. MAY 30 EVENTS SAW GIRL STUDENTS INJURED IN ATTACK BY MALE AND GIRL STUDENTS ON GIRLS' HOSTEL. TWO UNIVERSITY OFFICIALS, INCLUDING THE HOSTEL WARDEN, MRS. AZARPIRA, WERE STABBED SOME DAYS PREVIOUSLY, AND SOURCES AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY INDICATE DISTURBANCES ARE CONTINUING. USICA INFORMANT REPORTS WITH CLOSURES OF CLASSES AND OTHER PROBLEMS, SOME 2,000 OF TEHRAN UNIVERSITY'S 10,000 STUDENTS WILL PROBABLY BE INELIGIBLE TO TAKE EXAMS IF CLOSURES CONTINUE.

CONSULATE ISFAHAN REPORTS THAT STUDENTS AT ISFAHAN UNIVERSITY AND ISFAHAN CAMPUS OF ARYAMEHR UNIVERSITY ARE PREPARING DEMONSTRATIONS ON JUNE 5 AIMED AT REVERSING EXPULSION OF 80 PER CENT OF ARYAMEHR STUDENT BODY AND CLOSURE OF TWO OF ISFAHAN UNIVERSITY'S SEVEN COLLEGES. FRIEND OF EMBOFF REPORTED SOUNDS LIKE FIRING NEAR NORTHERN DORMITORY BLOCK OF TEHRAN UNIVERSITY MID-MORNING JUNE 1, BUT WE HAVE NO FURTHER INFORMATION.

POLYTECHNIC STUDENTS IN TEHRAN MAY 31 OVERTURNED CAR NEAR COLLEGE ON HAFEZ STREET, AND ONE RELAIBLE OBSERVER REPORTED GIANT PICTURE OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI HAD BEEN HUNG IN UNIVERSITY BUILDING SO AS TO BE VISIBLE FROM OUTSIDE. AS OF JUNE 1, POLICE HAD NOT ENTERED CAMPUS TO REMOVE IT.

TEHRAN JOURNAL ENGLISH EDITION JUNE ONE HEADLINED SHAH'S DEPARTURE PRESS CONFERENCE IN MASHAD WHERE HE UNDERLINED HIS FIRM DETERMINATION NOT TO ALLOW THE SO-CALLED PEOPLES GUERILLAS TO "DISRUPT LAW AND ORDER OF IRAN". SHAH TOOK JAB AT THOSE WHO WOULD CLOSE DOWN UNIVERSITIES BY RIOTING, SAYING IT SHOWS THEY WANT THE COUNTRY TO HAVE UNEDUCATED PEOPLE. SHAH NOTED THAT MASHAD, AS WELL AS REST OF COUNTRY, HAS DEFECTS AND THESE SHOULD BE KEPT IN FOREFRONT UNTIL THEY ARE EASED.

IN OTHER INTERNAL DEVELOPMENTS, HUSHANG ANSARY RESIGNED AS HEAD OF THE CONSTRUCTIVE WING OF THE RESURGENCE PARTY, CITING HIS PREOCCUPATION WITH NIOC WORK. VIRTUALLY NO RPT NO POLITICAL OBSERVERS HERE BELIEVE THAT IS REAL OR AT LEAST FULL REASON. MOST TIE HIS DEPARTURE TO CONTINUING RIVALRY WITH PRIME MINISTER AND RESURGENCE PARTY SECRETARY GENERAL JAMSHID AMOUZEGAR. LATTER HAS CONTINUED TO HAMMER AWAY PUBLICLY AT NEED TO ELIMINATE RED TAPE, CALLING FOR GREATER PUBLIC PARTICIPATION IN ATTEMPTS TO OVERHAUL BUREACY. THERE ARE RUMORS THAT PROGRESSIVE WING HEAD MAJIDI MAY ALSO RESIGN.

1978TEHRAN05247.subject: VISIT OF INDIAN FOREIGN MINISTER TO IRAN

segments.text: SUMMARY: ACCORDING TO IRANIAN AND LOCAL INDIAN SOURCES, VAJPAYEE AND IRANIANS "AGREED" ON A "WAIT AND SEE" APPROACH TO NEW AFGHAN GOVERNMENT--THOUGH MUCH MORE PESSMISTIC UNOFFICIAL IRANIAN VIEW WAS HINTED AT. VAJPAYEE DISCUSSED MBER OF BILATERAL ECONOMIC ISSUES AND THE PROBLEM OF VISAS FOR NON-IMMIGRANT INDIANS WISHING TO TRAVEL TO IRAN. INDIAN PRIME MINISTER DUE TO STOP BRIEFLY IN TEHRAN JUNE 5. END SUMMARY.

WE HAVE NOW TALED WITH BOTH INDIAN EMBASSY AND MFA ON VISIT OF FM VAJPAYEE TO TEHRAN MAY 27-29. VISIT WAS ORIGINALLY TO BE SHORT TRANSIT STOP ON WAY BACK TO INDIA BUT DEVELOPED INTO LONGER STAY FOR WHICH VAJPAYEE MADE SPECIAL TRIP HERE FROM NEW DELHI. INDIANS WERE ANXIOUS TO DISCUSS A NUMBER OF BILATERAL ISSUES WITH IRAN, THEY TELL US, THOUGH WE ARE SURE CHANCE TO FEEL EACH OTHER OUT ON APPRAISAL OF EVENTS IN AFGHANISTAN WAS ANOTHER IMPORTANT REASON ON BOTH SIDES.

AFGHANISTAN APPARENTLY WAS DISCUSSED MAINLY IN VAJPAYEE'S PRIVATE AUDIENCE WITH THE SHAH AND NEITHER MFA NOR INDIAN EMBASSY KNOW EXACTLY WHAT WAS SAID. HOWEVER, MFA DEPARTMENT HEAD TOLD POLCOUNS THAT IRAN PUT FORTH ITS OFFICIAL ASSESSMENT AND ONLY HINTED AT ITS UNOFFICIAL ASSESSMENT. OFFICIALLY, IRANIANS TAKE THE POSITION THAT THEY ARE WAITING TO SEE WHAT AFGHAN GOVERNMENT WILL DO TO SUPPORT ITS PROTESTATIONS OF TRUE NON-ALIGNMENT AND LACK OF AGRESSIVE INTENTIONS TOWARD PAKISTAN OR OTHER NEIGHBORS. UNOFFICIALLY, MOST IRANIAN OBSERVERS ARE VERY PESSIMISTIC, AS OUR OTHER REPORTING HAS ABUNDANTLY INDICATED.

IN VAJPAYEE'S MEETING WITH FREIGN MINISTER AND MFA OFFICIALS, AS WELL AS TO A SMALL EXTENT IN HIS MEETING WITH PM AMOUZEGAR, IRANIANS BROUGHT UP THE QUESTION OF PUSHTUNISTAN AND BALUCHISTAN. THEY MENTIONED FM AMIN'S STATEMENT IN HAVANA AS WELL AS THE 25TH POINT OF THE 30 POINT PROGRAM ANNOUNCED BY TARAKI ON BEHALF OF THE NEW GOVERNMENT. THEY EXPRESSED THEIR CONCERN AT PHRASING WHICH SUGGESTED SOLUTION, ALBEIT PEACEFUL, WOULD BE ON THE BASIS OF "HISTORICAL BACKGROUND" AND THE WISHES OF THE PEOPLE INVOLVED THEMSELVES. VAJPAYEE APPARENTLY REACTED PREDICTABLY, DOWNPLAYING ANY CAUSES FOR ALARM AND EMPHAZING ASSURANCES BEING GIVEN BY NEW GOVERNMENT.
MFA OFFICIALS SEE NO CHANGE IN INDIAN VIEW, WHICH THEY CONSIDER PARALLEL TO OFFICIAL IRANIAN, BUT VERY DIFFERENCT FROM GROWING UNOFFICIAL IRANIAN.

AS ON EXPRESSION OF THAT UNOFFICIAL VIEW, FRENCH LANGUAGE JOURNAL DE TEHERAN EDITORIALIZED MAY 28 WHILE VAJPAYEE WAS STILL HERE THAT "IT IS NO SECRET THAT IRAN WILL NOT PERMIT THE DISMEMBERMBET OF ITS PAKISTANIAN NEIGHBOR AND WILL NOT HESITATE, IF NECESSARY, TO USE ITS MILITARY POTENTIAL TO PREVENT ALL ATTEMPTS IN THAT REGARD." REFERRING TO THE POSSIBILITY OF A TRIPARTITE ALLIANCE AMONG PAKISTAN, INDIA AND IRAN THE JOURNAL CONCLUDED THAT INDIA "HAS NO INTENTION OF JOINING," WHILE THE "IRANIAN VIEW IS THAT A DEFENSIVE POLITICAL AGREEMENT BETWEEN THESE THREE POWERS WILL SUFFICE TO MAKE THE AFGHAN LEADERS THINK TWICE BEFORE BECOMING INVOLVED IN NEW ADVENTURES."

FOUR BILATERAL ECONOMIC ISSUES WERE DISCUSSED ACCORDING TO ALL SOURCES. VAJPAYEE BROUGHT THE FEASIBILITY REPORT ON THE RAJESTHAN CANAL PROJECT AND A FOLLOW UP VISIT BY EXPERTS WILL TAKE PLACE SOON. THERE WAS DISCUSSION OF THE TWIN PROJECT INVOLVING PRODUCTION OF ALUMINA IN MYSORE AND PRODUCTION OF ALUMINUM FROM THAT IN IRAN. FEASIBILITY REPORT SCHEDULED TO BE READY BY SEPTEMBER. INDIANS ASSURED IRANIANS THAT IRON ORE PROJECT AT KUDREMUKH DUE TO GO INTO OPERATION IN 1980 IS PROCEEDING ON SCHEDULE, AND THEY WISHED TO ASSURE THEMSELVES THAT AHQAZ STEEL PLANT TO USE THAT IRON ORE IS ALSO MOVING AHEAD (IT APPARENTLY IS).

FINALLY, INDIANS PROPOSED EXPORTS OF CEMENT AND OR FOOD GRAINS (PRINCIPALLY WHEAT). IRANIANS EXPRESSED SOME INTEREST AND NEGOTIATIONS WILL PROBABLY PROCEED. INDIAN EMBOFF MADE IT CLEAR THAT ALL THESE PROJECTS ARE BEING PAID FOR BY IRANIAN OIL. HE ALSO TOLS US RAJESTHAN CANAL PROJECT CALLS FOR SHARING OF GRAIN PRODUCED ON FIFTY-FIFTY BASIS OVER FIRST TEN YEARS OF OPERATION.

PM DESAI IS SCHEDULED FOR AIRPORT TRANSIT STOP JUNE 5 ON HIS WAY TO BRUSSELS FOR STATE VISIT. IRANIANS COULD CONCEIVABLY REQUEST STOP AT PRESENT SCHEDULED TO BE OF ONE HOUR ONLY BE LENGTHENED TO ALLOW FOR AUDIENCE WITH SHAH OR OTHER DISCUSSIONS.

1978TEHRAN05278.subject: ZAIRE-IRAN RELATIONS SUMMARY: ZAIRE FOREIGN MINISTER HAS DELIVERED MESSAGE FROM MOBUTU TO THE SHAH. ZAIREAN AMBASSADOR UNABLE PRO

segments.text: SUMMARY: ZAIRE FOREIGN MINISTER HAS DELIVERED MESSAGE FROM MOBUTU TO THE SHAH. ZAIREAN AMBASSADOR UNABLE PROVIDE DETAILS BUT SEEMS TO BE PRESSING FOR WESTERN POWERS TO PROD MOBUTU INTO MAKING CONCESSIONS TO ANGOLAN GOVERNEMENT AND KATANGAN REBELS. REQUEST BIOGRAPHIC INFORMATION (PARA 4). END SUMMARY.

PRESS CARRIED BRIEF ANNOUNCEMENT MAY 17 THAT ZAIRE'S FOREIGN MINISTER LUMBADI LUTETE HAD AN AUDIENCE WITH THE SHAH MAY 25 AND PRESENTED MESSAGE FROM PRESIDENT MOBUTU TO HIM. PRESS SPECULATED MESSAGE DISCUSSED REBEL INVASION OF SHABA PROVINCE AND PROSPECTS FOR IRANIAN FINANCIAL AND POLITICAL ASSISTANCE. WHEN POLCOUNS CHECKED ON THIS STORY WITH MFA AFRICA DEPARTMENT HEAD MAY 30, DEPARTMENT HEAD KNEW NOTHING OF DETAILS DISCUSSED. AS FAR AS HE WAS CONCERNED, IRAN WAS GOIN AHEAD WITH SENDING ITS AMBASSADOR IN EUROPEAN COMMUNITY AS REPRESENTATIVE TO BRUSSELS MEETING ON FINANCIAL ASPECTS OF ZAIRE'S SITUATION BUT WITHOUT ANY COMMITMENT TO PROVIDE ASSISTANCE.

ON MAY 31 ZAIRE AMBASSADOR MBEKA MAKOSSO CALLED ON AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN AT HIS OWN REQUEST. NATURE OF HIS MISSION IS SOMEWHAT OBSCURE. AFTER EXPRESSING THANKS OF HIS GOVERNMENT FOR USG ASSISTANCE DURING RECENT SHABA PROBLEM, MBEKA LAUNCHED INTO A RAMBLING DISCUSSION OF THE NEED FOR ZAIRE GOVERNEMENT TO REACH SOME KIND OF AGREEMENT WITH ANGOLAN AUTHORITIES, IF RECURRENCE OF SHABA AND SIMILAR INCIDENTS TO BE AVOIDED. HE SEEMED TO BE STRESSING NEED FOR HIS OWN GOVERNEMENT TO MAKE CONCESSIONS WHICHWOULD SATISFY THE KATANGAN REBELS AND THE AGOLAN GOVERNMENT WHICH HARBORS THEM SINCE REBELS ARE MEMBERS OF A TRIBE WHICH IS SPREAD OVER TERRITORY SHARED BY ZAIRE, ANGOLA AND ZAMBIA.
HE SAID THERE WERE 200,000 REFUGEES FROM ZAIRE NOW IN ANGOLA.

WHEN AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN PROBED AS TO HOW THIS MIGHT BE DONE AND WHETHER REBELS ARE REPRESENTED IN ZAIRE'S CENTRAL GOVERNMENT, MBEKA SAID THERE WERE SOME MINISTERS IN KINSHASA GOVERNEMENT BUT THEY WERE REGARDED AS TRAITORS BY THEIR FELLOW TRIBESMEN ONCE THEY WERE APPOINTED. WITHOUT BEING EXPLICIT, MBEKA APPEARED TO BE ASKING FOR USG AND OTHER WESTERN PRESSURE TO GET MOBUTU GOVERNMENT TO MAKE NECESSARY CONCESSIONS.

IN COURSE OF THIS DISCUSSION MBEKA REFERRED TO A MISSION TO WASHINGTON HE HAD BEEN ON DURING APRIL 1975. HE REFERRED TO A CONVERSATION WITH DEPUTY SECRETARY INGERSOLL AT THAT TIME ON ZAIRE'S NEEDS AND LAMENTED THAT IT HAD BEEN UNFORTUNATE TIMING SINCE EVERYBODY'S ATTENTION HAD BEEN RIVETED ON THE FALL OF SOUTH VIETNAM. ALTHOUGH MBEKA ARRIVED HERE JULY 24, 1976, POST FILES UNFORTUNATELY HAVE NO BACKGROUND INFORMATION ON HIM. WOULD APPRECIATE DEPARTMENT PROVIDING US HIS BACKGROUND, PARTICULARLY WHAT POSITION HE MIGHT HAVE HELD PRIOR TO COMING HERE (WHEN HE WAS ON THIS MISSION.)

IN RESPONSE TO A QUESTION MBEKA SAID ZAIRE'S FOREIGN MINISTER HAD DELIVERED MESSAGE FROM MOBUTU TO THE SHAH, AND HE THOUGHT THINGS WENT ALL RIGHT. HE WAS ELUSIVE ABOUT COMMENTING FURTHER ON THE VISIT IN A WAY WHICH SUGGESTS TO US THAT HE HAD BEEN COMPLETELY CUT OUT. THIS IN TURN SUGGESTS HE MAY NOT BE IN THE BEST GRACES OF MOBUTU GOVERNMENT.
WE ARE TOLD MBEKA MADE SIMILAR CALL ON BRITISH CHARGE.

DARIUSH BAYANDOR, SPECIAL ASSISTANT TO THE PRIME MINISTER, TOLD ME EVENING JUNE 1 THAT HE EXPECTS AMBASSADOR ZAHEDI TO RETURN TO TEHRAN IN THE NEAR FUTURE TO TAKE OVER THE FOREIGN MINISTRY. HE OPINED THAT ZAHEDI IS BECOMING "BORED" IN WASHINGTON AND WILL ACCEPT SOMETHING LESS THAN THE COURT MINISTRY, TO WHICH HE HAS ASPIRED.

HE SAID HE DID NOT KNOW WHETHER THIS MOVE WAS IN ANY WAY CONNECTED WITH HUGHANG ANSARY'S RECENT DEMISSION AS HEAD OF THE CONSTRUCTIVE WING OF THE RASTIKHIZ PARTY, BUT THOUGHT IT NOT UNLIKELY THAT ZAHEDI MIGHT ALSO ASSUME THE ANSARY POSITION AS WELL.

ACTING FOREIGN MINISTER ZELLI ASKED ME TO SEE HIM AFTERNOON JUNE 1 TO SHARE VIEWS ON NON ALIGNED MEETING WHICH RECENTLY TOOK PLACE IN HAVANA. HE SAID HE WAS DISMAYED TO READ THE TENOR OF THE RESOLUTIONS PASSED THERE AND COULD ONLY CONCLUDE THAT THE NAM HAD BEEN CAPTURED BY THE SOVIETS. HE WAS PARTICULARLY UNHAPPY AT THE PERFORMANCE OF THE YUGOSLAVS, WHO PERMITTED THEMSELVES TO BE "LED BY THE NOSE".

ZELLI ASKED WHETHER U.S. HAD ANY PLANS TO TRY TO MOBILIZE COUNTERACTION TO THESE VARIOUS RESOLUTIONS BEFORE THE HAVANA SUMMIT. MEETING. HE THOUGH THE CHINESE, THE FRENCH, THE INDIANS, AND POSSIBLY THE YUGOSLAVS COULD BE TALKED TO IN ORDER TO HELP MAKE THE HAVANA MEETING LESS OF A SOVIET COUP.

I SAID I HAD RECEIVED ONLY SKETCHY REPORTS OF THE HAVANA MEETING AND NO THOROUGH ANALYSIS OF THE ACTIONS TAKEN THERE. I DID NOT KNOW IF U.S. HAD ANY PLANS TO TRY TO LEAD AN EFFORT TO NEUTRALIZE THE PRO-SOVIET BIAS AT THE SUMMIT MEETING. ZELLI SAID THAT IRAN WOULD BE PREPARED TO BE OF ASSISTANCE, WHEN IT COULD, IN ANY SUCH EFFORT. HE THOUGHT, FOR EXAMPLE, THAT TEHRAN HAD SOME INFLUENCE IN BELGRADE AND PEKING.

ACTION REQUESTED: PLEASE PROVIDE SOONEST OUR OFFICIAL ANALYSIS OF NAM RESOLUTIONS AND ADVISE WEHTHER U.S. INTENDS TO ATTEMPT TO LEAD ANY CONCERTED EFFORT TO NEUTRALIZE PROSOVIET POSITIONS AT NAM SUMMIT.

1978TEHRAN05283.subject: REQUEST FOR LONG RANGE STUDIES ON SOVIET UNION PRODUCED FOR NATION SUMMIT MEETING

segments.text: PRODUCED FOR NATION SUMMIT MEETING
I NOTE SEVERAL PRESS STORIES CONCERNING LONG RANGE STUDIES ON SOVIET UNION WHICH WERE PRODUCED FOR RECENT NATO SUMMIT MEETING. I WOULD APPRECIATE RECEIVING ONE COPY OF EACH RELEVANT STUDY.

SINCE THEY ARE NATO DOCUMENTS, I ASSUME I WOULD BE UNABLE TO SHARE THEM WITH THE SHAH IN THE ABSENCE OF CONSENT BY ALL MEMBERS OF THE ALLIANCE. HOWEVER, I WOULD BE INTERESTED IN PROVIDING HIM A SUMMARY IF SUCH IS AVAILABLE IN THE SAME TO SELECTED MEMBERS OF THE PRESS.
PLEASE ADVISE IF SUCH VERSION AVAILABLE FOR USE WITH SHAH.

CHINESE AMBASSADOR, WHO HAS JUST RETURNED TO TEHRAN AFTER SEVERAL WEEKS IN CHINA (WITH A WIFE WHO WEARS WESTERN CLOTHES), BRACED ME AT A RECEPTION JUNE 1 FOR HAVING "LOST AFGHANISTAN". I COUNTERED WITH MY CONDOLENCE AT CHINESE "LOSS OF VIETNAM" AND OFFERED TECHNICAL ADVICE ON EVACUATION FROM THAT COUNTRY. HAVING THUS DISPOSED OF OUR RITUAL BELLY-LAUGHS, WE TURNED TO DISCUSSION OF REGIONAL SITUATION FOLLOWING KABUL COUP.

AMBASSADOR SAID HIS GOVERNMENT WAS MOST CONCERNED ABOUT INTEGRITY OF PAKISTAN. HE SAID CHINA COULD NOT PROVIDE MUCH ASSISTANCE AND "COULD ONLY PRAY". HE FELT U.S., IRAN, AND SAUDI ARABIA NEEDED TO SHOW SUPPORT FOR PAKISTAN. I SAID PAKISTANIS SOMETIMES MADE IT DIFFICULT FOR US TO ASSIST THEM AND CHINA COULD PERHAPS PERSUADE PAKISTAN LEADERS TO BE SOMEWHAT MORE REALISTIC.

THIS LED TO DISCUSSION OF INDIAN-PAKISTAN RELATIONS. CHINESE AMBASSADOR SAID HIS GOVERNMENT FELT INDIA STILL HAD DESIGNS ON PAKISTAN AND WOULD FAVOR FURTHER DISMEMBERMENT. I SAID WE DOUBTED THIS AND FELT INDIA HAD PLENTY OF DOMESTIC PREOCCUPATIONS. CHINESE PERSISTED IN CONTRARY VIEW.

IN CLOSING, HE EXPRESSED ADMIRATION FOR PRESIDENT CARTER'S RECENT STATEMENTS AT NATO SUMMIT. HE SAID CHINA SHARED VIEW THAT NATO ALLIANCE MUST BE CONCERNED WITH EVENTS OUTSIDE IMMEDIATE EUROPEAN THEATER WHICH COULD HAVE NEGATIVE EFFECT ON ALLIANCE.

COMMENT: THIS IS FAR MORE CONCRETE DISCUSSION THAN MY CHINESE COLLEAGUE USUALLY PERMITS HIMSELF. HE HAS PREVIOUSLY CONFINED HIMSELF TO PLATITUDES. IT MAY MERELY REPRESENT RECENT TOUCH WITH AUTHORITY IN PEKING, OR IT COULD MEAN GREATER CHINESE WILLINGNESS TO EXCHANGE VIEWS WITH U.S.

SUMMARY: IN RECAP OF 32ND UNGA, IRANIAN MFA OFFICIAL COMMENTED ALONG PREDICTABLE LINES ON DYNAMICS OF THE SESSION, ASIAN AMBITIONS, MIDDLE EAST, SOUTHERN AFRICA, AND THE MIDDLE EAST NUCLEAR WEAPONS-FREE ZONE PROPOSAL. END SUMMARY.

AS PART OF CONTINUING CONSULTATION PROCESS, POLCOUNS VISITED MFA HEAD OF INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS DEPARTMENT EHSASSI MAY 30 TO TALK ABOUT 32ND UNGA AND OUTLOOK FOR 33RD. EHSASSI REMARKED AS HE HAS IN THE PAST, THAT 32ND UNGA WAS GOOD AND A PLEASANT SESSION. THERE WERE LESS CONTROVERSIAL PROPOSALS THAN IN THE PAST AND PRESIDENT MAJSOV WAS VERY GOOD. WHILE BEING A STAUNCH SUPPORTER OF THE NON-ALIGNED NATIONS HE MANAGED CONFLICTS VERY WELL BEHIND THE SCENES AND IN ADVANCE OF SESSIONS SO THAT FEW SURPRISES OR COMPLICATIONS AROSE.
OF COURSE, EHSASSI COMMENTED, WITH SO MANY DIFFERENT INTERESTS REPRESENTED IN UNGA AND INCREASING TREND TOWARD REACHING DECISIONS MAINLY THROUGH CONSENSUS, FEWER SUBSTANTIVE RESULTS ARE POSSIBLE.

ON QUESTION OF ASIANS SEEKING THEIR OWN REGIONAL GROUP, EHSASSI SAID THAT WAS NOTHING NEW. HE NOTED THAT AFRICANS WERE EXTREMELY UNHAPPY WHEN VOTING ON MEMBERSHIP OF HUMAN RIGHTS COMMITTEE RESULTED IN SIX ASIAN SEATS AND SIX AFRICAN, RATHER THAN THE FIVE TO SEVEN QUOTA GENERALLY AGREED ON. AFRICANS WORK TOGETHER EFFECTIVELY BECAUSE THEY HAVE A FUNCTIONING OAU ORGANIZATION. ASIANS HAVE TO LOOK OUT FOR THEMSELVES. THEY NATURALLY WOULD LIKE MORE SEATS THAN AT PRESENT GIVEN THAT THEY HAVE SOME VERY LARGE, IMPORTANT NATIONS WHICH SEEK REPRESENTATION ON ALMOST AS MANY BODIES AS DO THE WESTERN EUROPEAN PERMANENT MEMBERS OF THE SECURITY COUNCIL.
HE WAS THINKING OF NATIONS SUCH AS CHINA, JAPAN OR INDIA. HE RECOGNIZED, HOWEVER, THAT ISSUE OF SEAT DISTRIBUTION WAS VERY SENSITIVE AND ANY CHANGES WOULD OCCUR VERY SLOWLY.

ON MIDDLE EAST, POLCOUNS REGISTERED U.S. DISAPPOINTMENT (REFTEL) WITH UN DEBATES WHICH FOLLOW STOCK, STALE ARGUMENTS AND DO NOT TAKE COGNIZANCE OF PROMISING NEW DEVELOPMENTS SUCH AS THE SADAT-BEGIN INITIIVE. EHSASSI POINTED OUT THE POLITICAL REALITIES AS SEEN FROM IRAN, BUT TOOK IN OUR POINT ABOUT THE NEED TO TRY TO GET MORE HELPFUL, REALISTIC RESOLUTIONS IN THE ANNUAL UNGA EXERCISE AS AN AID TO NEGOTIATIONS TAKING PLACE ELSEWHERE.

ON SOUTH AFRICAN ISSUES, EHSASSI COMMENTED THAT THE ATTITUDE TAKEN BY U.S. REMAINS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT. IF A NAMIBIAN SETTLEMENT COULD BE REACHED, THAT WOULD BE VERY USEFUL FOR DISCUSSIONS IN NEXT UNGA. HOWEVER, IN VIEW OF SWAPO'S REFUSAL TO ACCEPT SETTLEMENT PROPOSAL, HE WAS NOT OPTIMISTIC. AT THE SAME TIME HE DID NOT THINK WESTERN POWERS WOULD PERMIT ANY SANCTIONS RESOLUTION AGAINST SOUTH AFRICA EVEN IF OTHER NATIONS TRIED TO PUSH ONE THROUGH.

ON NUCLEAR WEAPONS-FREE ZONES, EHSASSI NOTED IRAN WAS THE FIRST TO PROPOSE MIDDLE EAST ZONE AND EGYPTIANS IN PARTICULAR HAVE SEIZED THE ISSUE AND RUN WITH IT. ISRAEL RESISTS IT. IRANAINS HAVE DISCUSSED THIS MATTER WITH ISRAELIS AND FIND THEM UNYIELDING. IRANIANS CAN UNDERSTAND ISRAELI CONCERNS, BUT THIS MAKES AGREEMENT ON MIDDLE EAST ZONE AS DIFFICULT TO REACH AS EVER.
WE SHALL BE DISCUSSING ISSUES FOR 33RD UNGA AT MFA AGAIN LATER THIS SUMMER.

1978TEHRAN05312.subject: CONSULTATIONS ON RECOVERY EFFORT FOR ZAIRE

segments.text: PLEASE REPEAT BY IMMEDIATE CABLE STATE 137343 WHICH NOT RECEIVED HERE. PRESENTATION TO MFA SCHEDULED TOMORROW MORNING LOCAL.

1978TEHRAN05341.subject: JUNE 5 STAY-HOME: TEHRAN, OTHER CITIES NEAR NORMAL

segments.text: SUMMARY: AS OF 1500 LOCAL TIME, TEHRAN REMAINED QUIET WITH TRAFFICE ABOUT 80-85 PER CENT OF NORMAL THROUGHOUT CITY, SPARSER IN BAZAAR AREA. GOI HAD STATIONED POLICE AND ARMY UNITS IN TRUCKS NEAR BAZAAR KEY INTERSECTIONS, BUT VISIBLE POLICE PRESENCE IN TOWN LESS THAN DURING MAY 15 QUIET DAY, AND MOSTLY GONE BY 1400. SITUATION IN ISFAHAN QUIET, BUT DOWNTWON PEDESTRIAN AND VEHICLE TRAFFIC 20 PER CENT OF NORMAL. ONLY VIOLENCE REPORTED IN COUNTRY OVER PAST 24 HOURS WAS IN AHWAZ WHERE VISITING US CONSUL SAW SCENE WHERE TWO RESTAURANTS HAD BEEN BURNED OUT AND THREE BANK SADERAT BRANCHES TRASHED EVENING JUNE 4. END SUMMARY.

UP TO 1500 LOCAL TIME, "STAY-HOME DAY" IN TEHRAN HAS BEEN QUIET, BUT WITH TRAFFIC AND PEOPLES' PRESENCE IN TOWN RUNNING ABOUT 80-85 PER CENT OF NORMAL. AFTER HOLDING THEIR BREATH MOST OF MORNING, MOST TEHRANIS ARE BEGINNING TO JOKE ABOUT ANOTHER NON-EVENT.

IN TEHRAN, ARMY AND POLICE WERE PRESENT AT KEY POINTS IN SOUTH TEHRAN DURING EARLY MORNING RUSH. NORMAL UNIT OF OPERATION WAS TRUCKLOAD OF SOLDIERS ACCOMPANIED BY COMMAND JEEP. AS DAY WORE ON AND NOTHING HAPPENED, POLICE PRESENCE BEGAN TO THIN OUT, AND TOUR OF SOUTHERN AREAS CONCLUDED AT 1400 SAW NO RPT NO EVIDENCE OF POLICE OR ARMY PRESENCE BEYOND NORMAL STREET PATROLS. BAZAAR WAS SLOW OPENING, BUT BY NOON, MOST BAZAAR SHOPS AS WELL AS ALL OTHERS WERE OPEN AND BUSINESS WAS IN FULL SWING. WHILE SOME FOLKS OBVIOUSLY STAYED HOME, NET EFFECT IN TEHRAN WAS TO LIGHTEN MORNING SHOPPING TRAFFIC AND MAKE CITY MORE BEARABLE.
UNIVERSITIES IN TEHRAN WERE QUIET DURING LATE MORNING TOUR BY EMBASSY LOCAL, WITH NO SIGNS OF BREWING STORM.

IN ISFAHAN, TOWN WAS MUCH QUIETER, BUT THERE WERE NO TROUBLES. ISFAHAN UNIVERSITY CLOSED FOR THREE DAYS BEGINNING JUNE 4, AND THRE WAS HEAVY POLICE PRESENCE IN DOWNTOWN AREAS. PEDESTRIAN AND VEHICULAR TRAFFIC WAS ABOUT 20 PER CENT OF NORMAL ACCORDING TO CONSULATE. SHIRAZ CONSULATE REPORTED NORMAL DAY, BUT WITH SOME BAZAAR SHOPS CLOSED. EVENING JUNE 4 SAW SEVERAL FLYERS DISTRIBUTED WHICH STRONGLY CRITICIZED SHAH'S REGIME AND "FOREIGN RUNNING DOGS." THIS HAS BEEN ONLY ANTIFOREIGN SIGN IN EVENTS TO DATE. IN FACT, ONLY VIOLENCE REPORTED IN COUNTRY OVER PAST 24 HOURS APPARENTLY WAS IN AHWAZ, WHERE VISITING U.S.

CONSUL MCNAUL SAW EVIDENCE OF TRASHING OF THREE BANK SADERAT BRANCHES AND LOCATIONS WHERE TWO WESTERN-STYLE RESTAURANTS HAD BEEN BURNED OUT EVENING JUNE 4. TABRIZ WAS VIRTUALLY CLOSED UP JUNE 5, AND "STAY-HOME" APPEARS TO HAVE BEEN MOST SUCCESSFUL THERE.

STRAY RUMORS STILL ABOUND THAT AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI WILL RETURN TO IRAN BY FOOT TO QOM. MORE ELABORATE VERSION HAS HIM FLYING TO QOM TO LEAD A MARCH ON TEHRAN. MOSQUES QUIET, HOWEVER, AND INDICATIONS ARE THAT STORIES OF KHOMEINI RETURN BELONG ON LIGHT FICTION SHELF.

MOSCOW 1108 (NOTAL) SUMMARY: KURDISH REPRESENTATIVE ALI-SULAIMAN BRIEFED EMBOFF ON KDP SITUATION IN IRAQ, WHERE PARTY STILL ON SIDELINES WITH SOME OF ITS FORCES FIGHTING UNDER TALABANI. INFORMED EMBASSY THAT IDRIS BARZANI WANTS TO TRAVEL TO U.S. AND EXPECTS RECEIVE PERMISSION FROM IRANIAN AUTHORITIES MOMENTARILY. KDP HERE EXPECTING U.S. WILL TAKE 300 TO 600 KURDISH IMMIGRANTS THIS YEAR; WEST GERMANS HAVE SAID THEY WILL TAKE AN ADDITIONAL 100 KURDISH REFUGEES. END SUMMARY.

KDP REPRESENTATIVE ALI-SULAIMAN CALLED ON EMBOFF AT HIS REQUEST TO REVIEW KURDISH SITUATION SINCE LAST MEETING (REF A) AND INFORM US THAT IDRIS BARZANI WOULD BE PRESENTING HIS PASSPORT FOR VISA (UNDER USUAL ASSUMED NAME OF IDRIS IRANI) TO VISIT HIS FATHER IN U.S. PER REF B. ALI-SULAIMAN SAID SAVAK HAD TOLD HIM APPROVAL FOR TRIP WOULD BE FORTHCOMING SHORTLY. PASSPORT WILL BE SENT TO EMB FOR VISA WHEN READY.

KDP REP SAID BARZANI FORCES STILL SQUEEZED OUT OF MAIN ACTION IN IRAQ AND SOME BARZANI UNITS ARE NOW FIGHTING WITH TALABANI FACTION, WHICH IS RECEIVING EXTENSIVE SUPPORT FROM CHINA. KDP REP SAID HIS FORCES THOUGHT SOVIETS WERE AIDING TALABANI, BUT HAVE ACQUIRED RECENT EVIDENCE THAT SHOWS TALABANI IS CLOSE TO CHINESE, WHO HAVE STARTED TO PROVIDE SOME ASSISTANCE. AT LEAST SOME OF THIS ASSISTANCE IS SOVIET-MADE.

OVER PAST TWO MONTHS, IRAQI ARMY HAS BEEN EVACUATING KURDS FROM 20-MILE STRIP NEXT TO IRAQI BRODERS WITH IRAN AND TURKEY. PROCESS INVOLVES ABOUT 500,000 PEOPLE BEING RESETTLED. SULAIMAN CITED PUSHDA (PHONETIC) TRIBE OF ABOUT 2,000 FAMILIES WHICH HAD BEEN ALIGNED WITH IRAQI GOVT AND WAS NEVERTHELESS BEING MOVED FROM KALAADZA REGION TO ARBIL.

AROUND HAJIUMRAN, ABOUT 100 PESH MERGA (BARZANI FIGHTERS) HAVE GONE OVER TO TALABANI FORCES COMPLETELY, AND BARZANI GROUP IN IRAN IS SOMEWHAT DISPIRITED THAT STUDENTS AND YOUNGER MEN ARE SHOWING MUCH MORE ENTHUSIASM FOR LEFT-WING LEADERS LIKE ALI ASCARI AND TAHIR ALIWALI, WHO ARE ESTABLISHING LARGE GROUP (INCLUDING 500 PESH MERGA) STRADDLING IRAN-IRAQ-TURKEY BORDER. TALABANI HIMSELF HAS TAKEN FORCE TO REGION NEAR SULAIMANYA.

IRANIAN AUTHORITIES ARE STILL CONTROLLING IRAN-IRAQ BORDER VERY STRICTLY, AND ALI-SULAIMAN LEFT IMPRESSION WITHOUT SAYING SO THAT BARZANI GROUP IN IRAN HAD NOT ATTEMPTED ANY LARGE-SCALE SMUGGLING OF FIGHTERS AND WEAPONS ACROSS BORDER IN RECENT PAST. (COMMENT: ONE REASON FOR IDRIS' VISIT TO U.S. AT THIS TIME IS ALMOST CERTAINLY TO REASSESS KDP POSTURE IN LIGHT OF PRESENT SITUATION. EMB BELIEVES KDP REMAINS IN CONTACT WITH SUPPORTERS IN IRAQ, THOUGH PERHAPS MORE SPORADICALLY THEN BEFORE).

UNLIKE LAST VISIT, ALI-SULAIMAN MADE NO RPT NO ATTEMPT TO PRESS FOR GREATER U.S. ROLE IN SUPPORT OF REBEL KURDS (REF A), OTHER THAN STANDARD PLEA FOR ASSISTANCE. HE NOTED IN PASSING THAT KDP SOURCES IN WASHINGTON FELT U.S. WOULD TAKE BETWEEN 300 AND 600 KURDISH REFUGEES THIS YEAR, AND EXPRESSED KDP'S HOPE HIGHER FIGURE WOULD PROVE CORRECT. WEST GERMANS HAVE INFORMED KDP AND IRANIAN GOVERNMENT THEY ARE PREPARED TO TAKE ADDITIONAL 100 KURDISH REFUGEES INTO GERMANY THIS YEAR. MECHANICS OF PROGRAM REMAIN TO BE WORKED OUT.

COMMENT: ALI-SULAIMAN WAS UNUSUALLY FORTHCOMING ON SUBJECTS DISCUSSED, PROBABLY BECAUSE OF FORTHCOMING REQUEST FOR BARZANI VISA. NEVERTHELESS, WOULD APPRECIATE ANY ADDRESSEE COMMENTS ON ACCURACY OF INFO OFFERED ABOVE, PARTICULARLY INFO INTERNAL TO IRAQ.

RUMORS WE HAVE BEEN HEARING FOR SOME TIME OF POSSIBLE CHANGES IN AMOUZEGAR CABINET APPEAR VERY CLOSE TO FRUITION. TO THEM ARE LIKELY TO BE ADDED SOME HIGH LEVEL CHANGES IN SECURITY AND POLICE DIRECTORS.

A NUMBER OF REPORTS REACHING THE EMBASSY FROM DIFFERENT SOURCES SUGGEST STRONGLY THAT, ONCE TODAY'S (JUNE 5) TEST OF STRENGTH WITH THE OPPOSITION HAS PASSED, SHAH WILL ANNOUNCE A NUMBER OF GOVERNMENT CHANGES. MOST PERSISTENT RUMOR IS THAT UP TO FOUR OF FOLLOWING FIVE MINISTERS SLATED FOR REPLACEMENT: MINISTER OF COMMERCE KHOSROWSHAHI, MINISTER OF HEALTH AND WELFARE SHEIKHOLESLAMZADEH, MINISTER OF EDUCATION GANJI, MINISTER OF INFORMATION AND TOURISM HOMAYOUN AND MINISTER OF INTERIOR NASR-ESFANANI. ALSO PROBABLY ARE CHANGES IN HEAD OR SAVAK, HEAD OF POLICE, AND POSSIBLY EVEN HEAD OF GENDARMERIE. (WE HAVE BEEN HEARING REPORTS SAVAK GENERAL NASSERI HAS ALREADY RESIGNED).

WE WOULD ESTIMATE THIS TO BE PART OF SHAH'S CURRENT DRIVE TO SEPARATE MAJORITY OF RELIGIOUS OPPOSITION FROM KHOMEINI-LED RELIGIOUS EXTREMISTS WHO HAVE CLOSE WORKING RELATIONS WITH NATIONAL FRONT AND OTHER OPPOSITION ELEMENTS. WHILE SOME OF THESE CHANGES (IN THE CABINET) HAVE BEEN IN THE WORKS FOR SOME TIME AND FOR A VARIETY OF REASONS, CHANGES IN SECURITY DIRECTORS WOULD BE INTENDED TO CONVEY READINESS TO BE MORE CONCILIATORY TOWARD RELIGIOUS OPPOSITION.

ONCE SUCH CHANGES ANNOUNCED, HOWEVER, PEOPLE WILL BE LOOKING TO SEE WHAT NEW INSTRUCTIONS ARE ISSUED TO SECURITY SERVICES SO AS TO DETERMINE WHETHER CHANGES ARE DUE TO A TRUE DESIRE TO CONCILIATE OR SIMPLY REFLECT EFFORT TO JACK UP THE ESTABLISHMENT AND OBTAIN GREATER EFFICIENCY IN LAW ENFORCEMENT AS IN OTHER SECTORS OF GOVERNMENT ACTIVITY.

ABOVE CHANGES COULD HAVE SOME BEARING ON CHANGING LEADERSHIP IN RASTAKHIZ PARTY, AS EVIDENCED BY RESIGNATIONS OF WING HEADS ANSARY AND MAJIDI TO DATE. RUMORS OF POSSIBLE THIRD WING PERSIST, AS DOES RUMOR THAT ZAHEDI MIGHT ASSUME A ROLE IN THE PARTY IN ADDITION TO MFA.
