THUS PARTY ROLE COULD BE PLAYED UP AS PART OF SHAH'S DESIRE FOR GREATER POLITICAL PARTICIPATION.

1978TEHRAN05386.subject: SAVAK CHIEF NEW IRANIAN AMBASSADOR TO PAKISTAN ON 1400 LOCAL NEWS, MOFA ANNOUNCED SAVAK CHIEF NEMATOLLAH NASSIRI HAS BEEN APPOINTED IRANIAN AMBA

segments.text: ON 1400 LOCAL NEWS, MOFA ANNOUNCED SAVAK CHIEF NEMATOLLAH NASSIRI HAS BEEN APPOINTED IRANIAN AMBASSADOR TO PAKISTAN. NO FURTHER INFORMATION PROVIDED. POST WILL SUPPLY BIO DATA SEPARATELY.

1978TEHRAN05387.subject: SHAH'SEPLY TO PRESIDENT CARTER'S LETTER OF JUNE 4

segments.text: I DELIVERED LETTER FROM PRESIDENT CARTER CONTAINED REFTEL TO SHAH MORNING JUNE 6. AFTER SHAH HAD READ TEXT, I ALSO CONVEYED ORAL MESSAGES ABOUT REPROCESSING PLANT AND PROJECTED NEWSOM VISIT.

SHAH ASKED ME TO INFORM PRESIDENT THAT HE WAS PLEASED WITH WARM AND POSITIVE TONE OF LETTER. WITH RESPECT TO AFGHANISTAN, HE AGREED THERE WAS NO OTHER COURSE TO FOLLOW THAN ACTIONS OUTLINED IN PRESIDENT'S LETTER. HOWEVER, HE FELT WE SHOULD HAVE NO ILLUSIONS ABOUT ORIENTATION OF AGHANISTAN REGIME. EVEN IF REGIME IS COMPLETELY A SOVIET SATELLITE, SOVIETS WILL DOUBTLESS ENCOURAGE KABUL TO MAINTAIN ECONOMIC TIES WITH THE WEST, IN ORDER TO EASE THE BURDEN ON SOVIET ECONOMY. HE HAD RECENTLY SEEN THE SAME PATTER, FOR EXAMPLE, IN BALKAN STATES, WHOSE LARGEST TRADING PARTNER IS NOW WEST GERMANY.

AS FOR PAKISTAN REPROCESSING PLANT, HE SAID THAT ALTHOUGH HE HAD NOT YET RECEIVED FORMAL ANSWER TO HIS LETTER TO GISCARD, FRENCH HAD GIVEN HIM INFORMAL INDICATIONS THAT MATTER WOULD BE RESOLVED. HE SAID HE HAD TALKED RECENTLY WITH "SEVERAL PAKISTANIS" TO TRY TO CONVINCE THEM TO MAKE THINGS EASIER FOR THEIR FRIENDS TO HELP THEM. HE CHARACTERIZED AGHA SHAHI AS "DANGEROUSLY" ANTI-INDIAN AND BAD INFLUENCE ON THE MLA GENERALS. HE SAID PAKISTAN HAD TO COOPERATE WITH INDIA IN ORDER TO SURVIVE.

IN GENERAL OBSERVATION ON PRESIDENT'S LETTER, HE SAID HE WAS PLEASED THAT U.S. IS REACTING TO SOVIET OPERATIONS IN AFRICA AND ELSEWHERE. HE CHARACTERIZED THIS AS A "TURNING POINT" IN POST-VIETNAM PSYCHOLOGICAL ATMOSPHERE WHICH HAS CRIPPLED EXECUTIVE AUTHORITY. HE EXPRESSED THE HOPE THAT THE CONGRESS WOULD UNDERSTAND THIS IN ITS TREATMENT OF THE TURKISH EMBARGO.
DEPT PLEASE PASS WHITE HOUSE.

1978TEHRAN05388.subject: SHAH'S DISCUSSIONS WITH INDIAN PRIME MINISTER DESAI

segments.text: SHAH TOLD MEMORNING JUNE 6 THAT HIS DISCUSSIONS WITH INDIAN PRIME MINSTER DESAI PREVIOUS DAY HAD TOUCHED UPON POSSIBILITY OF INDIAN ASSOCIATION WITH NUCLEAR-FREE ZONE THAT WOULD EASE PAKISTANI VIEWS ON REPROCESSING NEEDS. HE SAID DESAI REPEATED HIS USUAL FORMULA FOR US-USSR-UK AGREEMENT WHICH WOULD PERMIT INDIA TO ACCEPT SAFEGUARDS. DESAI HAD, HOWEVER, GONE ON TO SAY THAT HE WOULD BE WILLING GIVE ANYONE, INCLUDING PAKISTAN, ASSURANCES THAT INDIA WOULD NOT MANUFACTURE OR USE NUCLEAR WEAPONS.
SHAH OBVIOUSLY REGARDED THIS INDIAN POSITION AS SOMEWHAT AMORPHOUS, BUT PASSED IT ALONG FOR WHATEVER ANYONE MIGHT BE ABLE TO BUILD ON IT.

1978TEHRAN05390.subject: DISCUSSION WITH SHAH ON IRAN'S DOMESTIC PROBLEMS

segments.text: DURING MY JUNE 6 AUDIENCE WITH THE SHAH, I FOUND HIM FAR MORE RESILIENT AND CONFIDENT IN HIS DISCUSSION OF IRAN'S DOMESTIC PROBLEMS THAN IN OTHER RECENT DISCUSSIONS (REFTEL). IN PART, THIS WAS PORBABLY DUE TO DEMONSTRATED FAILURE OF OPPOSITION ELEMENTS TO ARRANGE "GENERAL STRIKE" THEY HAD CALLED FOR JUNE 5 AND IN GREAT PART TO RECENT VISIT WHICH SAH HAD MADE TO MASHAD WHERE HE MET WITH ISLAMIC LEADERS.

HE SEEMED CONVINCED THAT NATIONAL FRONT LEADERS HAD NO FOLLOWING AND THAT THEY WERE UNABLE TO GENERATE RESPONSE FROM ISLAMIC FAITHFUL. HE SAID HE WOULD " LEAVE THEM ALONE" IN THE FUTURE BECUASE THEIR ONLY AUDIENCE SEEMED TO BE THE BRITISH PRESS.

HE WAS RATHER PHILOSOPHIC IN DISCUSSING THE PROSPECT OF CONTINUING TURBULENCE IN IRAN. I SAID THAT THIRTY-FOUR YEARS AGO THAT SAME MORNING, I HAD BEEN AT THE NORMANDY BEACHES AND, BY COMPARISON, THE TURBULENCE HERE WAS BENIGN. HE PICKED UP FROM THE OBSERVATION TO SAY THAT, IN LOOKING BACK OVER THE PAST THIRTY-SEVEN YEARS, THERE HAD ALWAYS BEEN TURBULENCE AS CHANGES TOOK PLACE. THE NET RESULT HAD BEEN AN OBVIOUS IMPROVEMENT IN IRAN. HE HAD BEEN REQUIRED TO CHANGE HIS LEADERSHIP STYLE SEVERAL TIMES AND IT WAS OBVIOUS HE WOULD HAVE TO DO SO AGAIN.
THE NEW STYLE MIGHT BE A LITTLE MORE UNTIDY, BUT THAT WAS PERHAPS THE ONLY WAY YOUNG PEOPLE COULD GET INVOLVED IN THE GOVERNMENT PROCESS.

COMMENT: MY IMPRESSION IS THAT THE SHAH HAD DECIDED ON A GENERAL POLITICAL COURSE WHICH HE IS PREPARING TO IMPLEMENT IN THE NEAR FUTURE. THE REMOVAL OF NASSIRI AS HEAD OF SAVAK IS A PRECURSOR OF THAT COURSE AND THE RUMORED CHANGES IN BOTH THE CABINET AND THE RASTAKHIZ PARTY ARE PART OF THE SAME PATTERN. THE IMPRESSION HE CONVEYED IS THAT THE NEW PATTERN WILL BE LESS AUTHORITARIAN THAN IN THE PAST, WITH AN EMPHASIS ON ATTEMPTING TO APPEAL TO THE YOUTH OF THE COUNTRY.

1978TEHRAN05398.subject: ZAIRE AMBASSADOR TO IRAN RESIGNS, PROTESTS ZAIRE POLICY

segments.text: SUMMARY: ERSTWHILE ZAIREAN AMBASSADOR HAS DEPARTED FOR BRUSSELS, HAVING GIVEN US A COPY OF LETTER HE WROTE TO MOBUTU URGING MORE CONCILIATORY, POLITICAL APPROACH RATHER THAN FOREIGN INTERVENTION IN SHABA PROBLEM. HIS DIFFERENCES WITH ZAIRE GOVERNMENT REPORTEDLY CAME TO THE FORE DURING ZAIREAN FOREIGN MINISTER'S BRIEF STOPOVER HERE LAST WEEKEND WITH MESSAGE TO THE SHAH FROM MOBUTU. END SUMMARY.

ZAIRE AMBASSADOR MBEKA MAKOSSO ANNOUNCED HIS RESIGNATION AS AMBASSADOR JUNE 4. HE TOLD PRESS IT WAS FOR "PERSONAL REASONS" BUT HAS MADE LITTLE SECRET THAT HE WROTE A LETTER TO PRESIDENT MOBUTU PROTESTING ZAIRE GOVERNMENT'S RECENT ACTION IN SHABA AND RECOMMENDING A MORE CONCILIATORY POLICY TOWARD KATANGAN REBELS. THIS BROUGHT INTO THE OPEN WHAT WAS IMPLICIT IN MBEKA'S CALL ON AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN AND BRITISH CHARGE (REFTEL). MBEKA WAS REPORTED TO HAVE FLOWN TO BRUSSELS JUNE 5, WHERE HE IS EXPECTED TO MAKE FURTHER STATEMENTS.

COPY OF LETTER (IN FRENCH) TO MOBUTU WAS GIVEN BY MBEKA TO AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN AND IS BEING POUCHED TO NEA/IRN FOR APPROPRIATE DISTRIBUTION IN WASHINGTON. GIST OF MESSAGE IS TO PROTEST INVOLVEMENT OF FOREIGN TROOPS AND RESORT TO FORCE IN SHABA. MBEKA MAINTAINS THAT FRANCO/BELGIAN INTERVENTION PRODUCED A SHOCK WHICH WAS UNNECESSARY SINCE MORE FLEXIBILITY AND CALMNESS WOULD HAVE PREVENTED THE TERRIBLE MASSACRE AT KOLWEZI. HE WRITES THAT THE SHABA PROBLEM IS POLITICAL, AND IT IS A MISTAKE TO THINK OF KATANGAN REBELS IN SAME TERMS AS "MULELISTE" LEFT WING REBELS OF THE PAST.

KATANGANS ARE BETTER ORGANIZED AND CAN TAKE REFUGE IN COUNTRY ACROSS THE BORDER (ANGOLA) WHICH PROVIDES THEM UNLIMITED SOURCE OF ARMS. UNDER SUCH CIRCUMSTANCES, THERE IS NO ALTERNATIVE BUT TO DEAL WITH THEM POLITICALLY SO AS TO PREVENT CONTINUING TROUBLES WHICH ARE BOUND TO RECUR. LUNDA TRIBE AS A WHOLE MUST BE BROUGHT TO TERMS WITH CENTRAL GOVERNMENT OF ZAIRE LEST FOREIGN CADRES WHO WORK IN SHABA CONTINUE THEIR FLIGHT, WITH THE ECONOMIC DETERIORATION THAT WILL BRING.

LETTER IS WRITTEN DIPLOMATICALLY AND IN VERY GOOD FRENCH. IT IS CLEAR THAT AMBASSADOR HAS DEDICATED HIMSELF TO A TASK WHICH IS MORE IMPORTANT TO HIM THAN HIS AMBASSADORIAL POSITION. EVEN THOUGH HE HAS TOLD PRESS THAT HE DOES NOT INTEND TO SEEK POLITICAL OFFICE IN ZAIRE AT THE PRESENT TIME, IT SEEMS OBVIOUS HE IS SEEKING TO INFLUENCE FOREIGN GOVERNMENTS TO PUT PRESSURE ON MOBUTU FOR A MORE CONCILIATORY APPROACH.

TEHRAN NEWSPAPERS GAVE SOME BIOGRAPHICAL BACKGROUND ON MBEKA. HE HAS REPORTEDLY SERVED AS ZAIRE AMBASSADOR TO WASHINGTON, PARIS AND BONN, AND AS MINISTER OF INDUSTRY AND FINANCE. WE ASSUME IT WAS IN HIS LATTER CAPACITY THAT HE VISITED WASHINGTON ON A MISSION IN 1975(REFTEL).
COMMENT: WE HOPE TO GET A READING ON GOI'S CURRENT APPRECIATION OF SITUATION IN ZAIRE OVER NEXT FEW DAYS.

1978TEHRAN05435.subject: GEN NASSER MOGHADAM NEW SAVAK CHIEF

segments.text: 1400 LOCAL NEWS ANNOUNCED PRIME MINISTER HAD PRESENTED GENERAL NASSER MOGHADAM TO SHAH AS MINISTER OF STATE AND NEW HEAD OF SAVAK, IRANIAN NATIONAL SECURITY ORGANIZATION. MOGHADAM WAS SERVING AS HEAD OF MILITARY STAFF J-2, MILITARY INTELLIGENCE DIVISION. POST WILL REPORT MORE DETAILED BIO INFO BY SEPTEL.

POL COUNS PASSED INFORMATION ABOUT BROADCASTS (OMITTING BBC BROADCAST) TO MFA DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR ASIA AND AFRICA SANANDAJI JUNE 7. THIS WAS NEWS TO SANANDAJI, AND HE IMMEDIATELY RELAYED IT TO ACTING FOREIGN MINISTER ZELLI. IRANIANS ARE INVESTIGATING, AND WE SHALL REPORT ANY REACTION THEY MAY PASS TO US IN DUE COURSE.

SANANDAJI VOLUNTEERED THATIRANIAN AMBASSADOR HOVEYDA IN NEW YORK HAD CHARACTERIZED AFGHAN FOREIGN MINISTER'S SPEECH THERE AS FITTING THE PATTERN OF SOCIALIST BLOC OR EXTREME NON-ALIGNED COUNTRIES SUCH AS CUBA. THIS HAS DONE NOTHING TO IMPROVE IRANIAN IMPRESSION OF DIRECTION BEING TAKEN BY NEW AFGHAN REGIME.
AS DEPARTMENT AWARE, AMBASSADOR SAW SHAH JUNE 6, AND HE IS WELL AND FIT.

1978TEHRAN05444.subject: AN AMERICAN TRAVELLER'S VIEWS ON AFGHAN EVENTS

segments.text: ON JUNE 5, AN AMCIT RESIDENT IN IRAN AND A FREQUENT TRAVELLER TO AFGHANISTAN, CALLED AT CONSULATE TO DISCUSS EMPLOYMENT PROBLEMS. SUBJECT IS A FORMER LONG-TIME RESIDENT OF KANDAHAR AREA WITH APPARENT EXCELLENT KNOWLEDGE OF BALUCHI DISTRICTS OF IRAN, AFGHANISTAN AND PAKISTAN. HE HAD SEVERAL OBSERVATIONS ON RECENT EVENTS IN AFGHANISTAN. DURING CONVERSATION HELD ON PREVIOUS VISIT TO CONSULATE, WHICH WAS REPORTED BY MEMCON ON FEB 5, 1978, HE MENTIONED THAT ABOUT EIGHTY-FOUR YOUNG AFGHAN AIR FORCE PILOTS WERE IN SOVIET UNION RECEIVING SPECIAL TRAINING ON ADVANCE AIRCRAFT. SUBJECT CLAIMED THIS KNOWLEDGE WAS BASED ON PERSONAL ACQUAINTANCE WITH FAMILY OF ONE SUCH PILOT.
AT THAT TIME, SUBJECT CITED RUMORS THAT THESE PILOTS WERE INTENDED FOR EVENTUAL USE AGAINST PAKISTAN IN SUPPORT OF RENEWED PAKHTUNISTAN/BALUCHI SEPARATIST ACTIVITIES.

AMCIT NOW REPORTS THAT LATEST RUMORS ARE THAT THESE PILOTS FLEW AIRCRAFT USED TO SUPPORT COUP IN KABUL. ALLEGEDLY, AIRCRAFT WERE FLOWN DIRECTLY FROM THE SOVIET UNION TO KABUL AT OPENING OF COUP. COUP SYMPATHIZERS REPORTEDLY SABOTAGED AIRCRAFT AT FIELDS IN KABUL AREA TO PREVENT THEIR USE BY DAOUD FORCES. AMCIT CLAIMS THIS INFORMATION IS BASED ON REPORTED COMMENTS OF SOME OF THESE SPECIAL PILOTS, ALL OF WHOM ARE NOW BACK IN AFGHANISTAN. SUBJECT IDENTIFIES ONE SUCH PILOT AS THE SON OF BAHADUR KAKAR, FORMER POLICE COMMANDER FOR THE HERAT AREA.
RUMORS ALSO INCLUDE REPORT THAT AFGHAN ARMY ELEMENTS OF COUP FORCES WERE RE-EQUIPPED WITH AK-47 AUTOMATIC WEAPONS JUST PRIOR TO COUP.
AMCIT MENTIONED DEATH OF PERSONAL FRIEND AND ENTIRE FAMILY IN COUP AFTERMATH. FAMILY, NAME PIRZAND OR PIRZAD, ALLEGEDLY MURDERED BECAUSE OF POLITICAL CONNECTIONS IN KANDAHAR AREA.

AMCIT ALSO REPORTED DELIBERATE MURDER OF A MULLAH, MOHAMMAD GOL MOHAMMAD, IN KABUL SEVERAL DAYS AFTER TAKEOVER. AMCIT ALLEGES THAT MULLAH, WHO SUPPOSEDLY NEVER PARTICIPATED IN POLITICS, WAS KILLED BECAUSE OF HIS RELIGIOUS FOLLOWING IN THE KANDAHAR AREA.

COMMENT: THE INFORMANT APPEARS TO HAVE DETAILED KNOWLEDGE OF PERSONALITIES AND EVENTS IN AFGHANISTAN. WHILE EMBASSY HAS NO WAY OF VERIFYING HIS STATEMENT HERE, INFO MAY OF OF INTEREST OR VALUE TO EMBASSY KABUL.

1978TEHRAN05445.subject: GOI PROPOSES TO LIBERALIZE MILITARY COURT PROCEDURES

segments.text: GOI PROPOSALS FOR REVISION OF MILITARY JUDICIAL PROCEDURE CODE WERE ANNOUNCED BY JUSTICE MINISTER KIANPUR AT PRESS CONFERENCE JUNE 6. FOLLOWING AMENDMENTS WERE MADE PUBLIC

CENTERPIECE OF PROPOSAL IS PROVISION FOR CIVILIAN LAWYERS TO PLEAD BEFORE A MILITARY COURT WITHOUT THE REQUIREMENT TO SEEK PRIOR AUTHORIZATION FROM A SPECIAL MILITARY COMMITTEE. IN ADDTION, CIVILIAN LAWYERS WILL NOT BE SUBJECT TO DISCIPLINARY MEASURES OF THE SPECIAL MILITARY COMMITTEE. UNDER PROPOSED AMENDMENT, LAWYERS MAY PLEAD BEFORE A MILITARY COURT BY DECLARING THEIR READINESS TO THE APPROPRIATE MILITARY COURT.
RESTRICTIONS ON THE NUMBER OF DEFENSE LAWYERS AT EACH TRIAL WILL BE ELIMINATED AND THE ACCUSED MAY HENCEFORTH CHOOSE ONE OR TWO CIVILIAN OR MILITARY LAWYERS.
THOSE UNDER INVESTIGATION MAY HAVE DEFENSE LAWYERS BEFORE THE EXAMINING MAGISTRATE TO PRESENT FINAL DEFENSE STATEMENTS.
LAWYERS PLEADING BEFORE A MILITARY COURT WILL BE ALLOWED TO STUDY THE CASE FOR UP TO 20 DAYS, AS IS THE PRACTICE IN CIVILIAN CRIMINAL CORTS.

RESPONDING TO A QUESTION ON CIVILIAN COURT PROCEDURES, KIANPUR SAID THAT "DURING THE PAST YEAR 2,756,819 CASES CAME BEFORE THE COURTS, AN INCREASE OF 699,878 CASES OVER THE PREVIOUS YEAR. THE NUMBER OF MAGISTRATES IN THE MINISTRY OF JUSTICE IS PRESENTLY 1700. A COMPARISON BETWEEN THE NUMBER OF MAGISTRATES AND THE NUMBER OF CASES BEFORE THE COURTS SHOWS THE INTENSE ACTIVITY OF OUR MAGISTRATES". KIANPUR REVEALED THAT STUDIES ARE IN PROGRESS TO MODIFY A NUMBER OF OTHER JUDICIAL STATUTES INCLUDING THE CODE OF CIVIL PROCEDURE, CODE OF PENAL PROCEDURE, FAMILY PROTECTION LAW AND BANKRUPTCY LAW.

COMMENT: TIMING OF THESE PROPOSALS LEADS US TO BELIEVE THAT ACTION IS AT LEAST IN PART A CONSEQUENCE OF WILLIAM BUTLER'S MAY 2 AUDIENCE WITH THE SHAH (REFTEL). AT THAT TIME SHAH INDICATED THAT HE ACCEPTED BUTLER'S SUGGESTIONS RE ACCUSED RIGHT TO CIVILIAN COUNSEL AND ORDERED COURT MINISTER HOVEYDA TO FOLLOW UP. PROPOSAL AMENDMENTS MEET MANY SUGGESTIONS CONTAINED BUTLER'S MEMO TO THE SHAH. GOI RESPONSE REINFORCES OUR VIEW THAT BUTLER IS HIGHLY EFFECTIVE HUMAN RIGHTS PROPONENT WITH DEMONSTRATED INFLUENCE ON GOI DECISION MAKERS. DEPARTMENT MAY WISH INFORM HIM OF THIS GOI ANNOUNCEMENT.

THANKS FOR INCLUDING US ON REFTEL, WHICH WAS FIRST MESSAGE REPORT WE HAVE RECEIVED ON SSOD ACTIVITIES. WOULD APPRECIATE RECEIVING AT LEAST WEEKLY SUMMARIES (WE ASSUME SOMEONE IS PREPARING THEM) ON SSOD ACTIVITIES, AS WELL AS CONTINUING TO RECEIVE INDIVIDUAL MESSAGES ON ANY ISSUES OF MORE PARTICULAR INTEREST TO US. WE, OF COURSE, HAVE BEEN RECEIVING DAILY SPEECH SUMMARIES IN WIRELESS FILE.

1978TEHRAN05501.subject: UNSSOD: IRAQI DRAFT RESOLUTION ON MILITARY AND NUCLEAR ASSISTANCE

segments.text: AS INSTRUCTED REFTEL EMBASSY MADE DEMARCHE TO GOI (MFA IO DEPARTMENT HEAD, EHSASSI) JUNE 8 EMPHASIZING UNACCEPTABILITY OF IRAQI DRAFT RES, URGING NEGATIVE VOTE IF IT GETS TO THAT, AND POINTING OUT UTILITY OF DEFERRAL.

EHSASSI SAID IRANIAN DEL HAD ALREADY BEEN WORKING TOWARDS DEFERRAL, SAID IRAN CERTAINLY COULD NOT SUPPORT IRAQI RES, AND PROMISED TO INFORM "THE MINISTER" OF US DEMARCHE. EHSASSI AGREED THAT IRAQI RES INAPPROPRIATE TO SSOD, BUT SAID IRAQ HAD MADE CLEAR IT WOULD INTRODUCE AND PRESS RES.

EHSASSI SAID IT SEEMED CLEAR TO HIM THAT IF RES PRESSED TO VOTE IT WOULD PASS EVEN THOUGH PROBABLY NOT ALL NON-ALIGNED AND THIRD WORLD WOULD VOTE FOR IT. HE FELT CHANCE OF DEFERRAL WOULD BE GREATLY ENHANCED IF KEY MEMBERS GROUP OF 77 WERE TO TAKE LEAD IN SUPPORT OF SUCH A MOVE.

1978TEHRAN05503.subject: BIO BACKGROUND ON GOI AMBASSADOR NASSIRI

segments.text: CONFIRMING INTERMITTENT RUMORS, GENERAL NEMATOLLAH NASSIRI HAS BEEN RELIEVE OF HIS POSITION AS DIRECTOR OF THE STATE SECURITY AND INTELLIGENCE ORGANIZATION (SAVAK) TO BECOME GOI AMBASSADOR TO PAKISTAN. NASSIRI, 68, AN OLD AND LOYAL FRIEND OF THE SHAH, HAD BEEN SAVAK CHIEF SINCE 1965. HE IS KNOWN TO BE A HARD LINER IN HIS APPROACH TO OPPOSITION GROUPS AND TO HAVE URGED THE SHAH NOT TO GIVE IN TO DISSIDENT DEMANDS LEST STATE SECURITY SUFFER. NASSIRI HAS A REPUTATION AS A GOOD ADMINISTRATOR BUT A MAN WHO IS POLITICALLY INFLEXIBLE AND LESS SOPHISTICATED THAN THE TIMES DEMAND.

HIS REMOVAL FROM STATE SECURITY AFFAIRS HAD LONG BEEN SOUGHT BY THOSE WITH A MORE CONCILIATORY APPROACH TO MANIFESTATTIONS OF DISCONTENT. ON THE MORE POSITIVE SIDE, HOWEVER, NASSIRI HAS UP TO NOW HAD UNLIMITED ACCESS TO THE SHAH-SURELY AN ASSET IN THIS RELATIONSHIP WITH THE GOP.

A FULL BIOGRAPHIC SUMMARY PREPARED BY DIA IN MARCH 1969 IS BEING POUCHED TO ISLAMBAD SEPARATELY. BRIEFLY, NASSIRI IS A CAREER MILITARY OFFICER WHO ATTENDED TEHRAN MILITARY ACADEMY IN THE MID-30S WITH THE THEN CROWN PRINCE. SINCE THAT TIME HE HAS BEEN CLOSELY ASSOCIATED WITH THE SHAH AND WAS APPOINTED COMMANDER OF THE IMPERIAL GUARD IN 1951 AND CHIEF OF NATIONAL POLICE IN 1960. NASSIRI PLAYED AN INSTRUMENTAL ROLE, DEMONSTRATING GREAT LOYALTY AND COURAGE, IN THE OVERTHROW OF MOSADEQ IN 1953 BY DELIVERING THE ROYAL FIRMAN DISMISSING MOSADEQ AS PRIME MINISTER-FOR WHICH MOSADEQ IMPRISONED HIM.

NASSIRI, PREVIOUSLY MARRIED TO A GERMAN WOMAN, PRESENTLY HAS A YOUNG IRANIAN WIFE AND TWO SONS. ALTHOUGH HE DID NOT PARTICIPATE IN DIPLOMATIC FUNCTIONS IN TEHRAN HE IS KNOWN TO ENJOY BRIDGE AND POKER WITH FRIENDS. HE SPEAKS FAIR FRENCH AND POOR ENGLISH.
STATE 140847

IRANIAN "OBSERVER" TO MEETING WILL BE AMBASSADOR ABDOL-ALI JAHANSHAHI, IRANIAN REPRESENTATIVE TO EUROPEAN COMMUNITY RESIDENT IN BRUSSELS. HE MAY HAVE ONE OR TWO MEMBERS OF HIS STAFF ASSISTING HIM. MFA DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR ASIA AND AFRICA SANANDAJI REITERATED TO POLCOUNS JUNE 7 THAT SENDING AN OBSERVER HAS BEEN DONE AT BEHEST OF VARIOUS FRIENDS OF IRAN. HOWEVER, IRAN DOES NOT HAVE FINANCIAL RESOURCES TOASSIST ZAIRE IN THE FORESEEABLE FUTURE. HE SAID HE WAS UNAWARE OF ANY CHANGEOF THIS POSITION AS A RESULT OF MESSAGE FROM MOBUTU TO THE SHAH DELIVERED HERE BY ZAIRE FOREIGN MINISTERLAST WEEK.
POLCOUNTS TOOK OCCASION TO BRIEF SANANDAJI ON USG APPROACH TOWARD ASSISTANCE TO ZAIRE PER REFTELS C AND D.

POLCOUNS DISCUSSED THESE SUBJECTS WITH MFA DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR ASIA AND AFRICA SANANDAJI JUNE 7. SANANDAJI VOLUNTEERED INFORMATION THAT MOSCOW IS AT PRESENT BACKING KURDISH REBELLION, OR AT LEAST THERE IS GOOD REASON TO BELIEVE THIS IS SO. IF IT TURNS OUT TO BE TRUE, IT COULD BE AN IMPORTANT FACTOR IN PUSHING IRAQIS TO MAKE AN OPEN BREAK WITH SOVIETS. HE DID NOT BELIEVE IT HAD COME TO THAT YET, BUT HE ALLOWED HIMSELF TO HOPE IT MIGHT.

WITHOUT BEING ANY MORE SPECIFIC ON SOURCES, SANANDAJI SPOKE GENERALLY OF CURRENT IRAQI UNHAPPINESS WITH THE SOVIETS. FOR ONE THING, MILITARY ARE UNHAPPY WITH SOVIET WEAPONRY AS COMPARED TO WESTERN. HE GAVE AS AN EXAMPLE ACCIDENTS WITH SOVIET PLANES RECENTLY, THOUGH HE DID NOT TIE THIS IN ANY WAY TO RECENT VISIT OF IRAQI AIR FORCE COMMANDER HERE (REF A), WHICH HE TERMED PROBABLY A PROTOCOL VISIT ONLY. BESIDES, IRAQIS MUST BE CONSIDERABLY UPSET AFTER EVENTS OF AFGHANISTAN, AND THEY KNOW THEY NEED WESTERN TECHNOLOGY AND MONEY. ALL THIS MIGHT ADD UP TO A BREAK EVENTUALLY.

SANANDAJI EXPRESSED COMPLETE DISBELIEF IN REPORT THAT MAINLAND CHINESE MAY BE PROVIDING ASSISTANCE TO TALABANI KURDS (REF B). HE THOUGH THAT WAS OUT OF THE QUESTION. HE SAID CHINESE HAVE BEEN CAREFUL FOR PAST TEN YEARS NOT TO INTERVENE IN THIS PART OF THE WORLD IN SUCH AFFAIRS.

COMMENT: WE PASS ON THESE COMMENTS AS PART OF CONTINUING DIALOGUE WITH IRANIANS. REPORT OF CHINESE ASSISTANCE TO TALABANI KURDS, WHICH CAME TO US FROM BARZANI REPORTER, COULD BE COMPLETE RED HERRING, BUT WE LEAVE IT TO WASHINGTON TO EVEALUATE. BY SAME TOKEN WOULD BE INTERESTED IN ANY EVIDENCE AVAILABLE OF SOVIET BACKING FOR KURDISH REBELS, SINCE SANANDAJI WAS SO VAGUE ABOUT SOURCES. FYI: WE NOTE THAT LAST PARA OF BAGHDAD'S 1176 (JUST RECEIVED) PROVIDES AT LEAST PARTIAL COMMENT FROM USINT ON THIS QUESTION.
ANY INFORMATION ABOUT THE SITUATION IN UAE WHICH MIGHT ASSIST OUR DIALOGUE WITH THE IRANIANS.

1978TEHRAN05513.subject: SHAH PREDICTS LONG TERM UNREST IN IRAN

segments.text: SHAH ONCE AGAIN UNDERLINED HIS CONTINUING SUPPORT FOR LIBERALIZATION WHEN SPEAKING ON JUNE 7 BEFORE A GROUP OF ACADEMICS WHO ARE STUDYING RECENT IRANIAN HISTORY, FOCUSING ON THE SHAH-PEOPLE REVOLUTION'S ACHIEVMENTS. PREDICTING THAT THE "UPROAR BY THE DEMONSTRATORS WILL CONTINUE FOR A YEAR OR TWO," THE SHAH SAID, "THIS IS THE PRICE WE MUST PAY IN ORDER TO ACHIEVE OUR GOAL, WHICH IS MAXIMUM FREEDOM WITHIN THE LAW". WHILE PATH TO LIBERALITZATION WILL NOT BE SMOOTH, THE SHAH CALLED FOR TOLERANCE BY "PATRIOTS" SINCE "THE WILL OF THE PEOPLE SHOULD BE HEEDED AND IMPLEMENTED."

STRIKING OUT (AGAIN) AT FOREIGN EVILS, THE SHAH RECAPITULATED IRAN'S TWENTIETH CENTURY HISTORY HIGHLIGHTING ANGLI-RUSSION ZONES OF INFLUENCE AND OCCUPATION DURING WORLD WAR II. SHAH IS QUOTED IN PERSIAN PRESS (BUT NOT FOREIGN LANGUAGE) AS SAYING, "ONE DAY THE BRITISH EMBASSY REPRESENTATIVE WOULD MEET THE PRIME MINISTER AND NAME THE PERSONS WHOM THEY FAVORED AS THEIR CANDIDATES, AND ON THE SAME AFTERNOON THE SOVIET EMBASSY MAN WOULD PRESENT HIM THEIR OWN LIST OF CANDIDATES".

CONINUING HIS REFERENCE TO THE BAD OLD DAYS BEFORE THE SHAH-PEOPLE REVOLUTION, THE SHAH RECALLED THAT DURING THE 40S AND EARLY 50S THE IRANIAN PARLIAMENT VOTED FUNDS TO THE GOVERNMENT ONLY MONTH BY MONTH INSTEAD OF ANNUALLY.

IN ANOTHER SWIPE AT HOSTILE FOREIGNERS, TEHRAN JOURNAL LEAD EDITORIAL JUNE 8 COMMENTS THAT INTERNATIONAL MASS COMMUNICATIONS MEDIA ATTACKS, DISCREDITS AND CRITICIZES IRAN. JOURNAL FINDS IT "SURPRISING THAT ATTACKS DO NOT ALWAYS COME FROM KNOWN ENEMIES BUT SOME OF THE MOST VITRIOLIC COMMENTS COULD BE ATTRIBUTED TO THE PRESS OF COUNTRIES WHO ARE VERY VOCAL IN PROFESSING THEIR FREINDSHIP WITH IRAN." EDITORIAL REASONS THAT THESE ATTACKS COME FROM "THOSE WHO HAD BECOME ACCUSTOMED TO DICTATING THEIR VIEWS TO IRAN... SO GROUNDS FOR UNHAPPINESS WITH THE INDEPENDENT STANCE OF THIS COUNTRY ARE AMPLE AND NOT SURPRISING".

COMMENT: SHAH ONCE AGAIN HAS STRESSSED THAT HE WILL NOT BE DETERRED FROM LIBERALIZATION PATH BY A FEW "MISGUIDED PERSONS". IN A CONFIDENT TONE HE HAS PUBLICLY ACCEPTED FACT THAT TUMULT WILL INEVITABLY ACCOMPANY HIS INITIATIVE---AND WILL PERSIST BEYOND IMMEDIATE FUTURE. THEREFORE, ZEALOUS PATRIOTS SHOULD NOT OVERREACT TO PROVOCATIONS FROM DEMONSTRATORS NOR JUMP TO CONCLUSION THAT SHIP OF STATE IS SINKING, A MESSAGE UNDOUBTEDLY ALSO DIRECTED AT FOREIGN OBSERVERS.

1978TEHRAN05534.subject: U.S. MISSION TO SOUTH YEMEN MFA DEPARTMENT HEAD DAVOUDI CALLED US JUNE 11 WITH INQUIRY CONCERNING WIRE SERVICE REPORTS THAT FOUR-MAN USG

segments.text: MFA DEPARTMENT HEAD DAVOUDI CALLED US JUNE 11 WITH INQUIRY CONCERNING WIRE SERVICE REPORTS THAT FOUR-MAN USG MISSION HEADED BY TWINAM IS GOING TO ADEN TO DISCUSS USG RELATIONSHIP WITH PDRY. WE SAID WE WOULD GIVE HIM BACKGROUND AS SOON AS WE GOT IT. PLEASE PROVIDE ASAP.

1978TEHRAN05557.subject: UNSSOD: IRAQI DRAFT RESULATION ON MILITARY AND NUCLEAR ASSISTANCE

segments.text: MFA IO DEPARTMENT HEAD EHSASSI INFORMED EMBASSY BY TELEPHONE JUNE 11 THAT INSTRUCTIONS ON SUBJECT HAVE BEEN SENT TO IRANIAN UN DEL. INSTRUCTIONS MAKE CLEAR THAT GOI COULD NOT SUPPORT IRAQI RES, AND DIRECT IRANIAN UN DEL TO WORK CLOSELY WITH WEO.

IT CLEAR FROM EHSASSI COMMENTS THAT EXPECTATION HERE IS THAT WORKING CLOSELY WITH WEO WOULD LEAD TO NEGATIVE VOTE ON IRAQI RES. IF, HOWEVER, WEO ENDS UP BADLY SPLIT IT POSSIBLE THAT IRANIAN DEL COULD ABSTAIN.

MFA DIRECTOR GENERAL SANANDAJI CALLED POLCOUNS JUNE 12 TO PASS ON MESSAGE THAT GOI FULLY SUPPORTS USG POSITION AMBASSADOR DICKMAN HAS BEEN INSTRUCTED TO TAKE WITH UAE RULERS RE WORKING OUT THEIR PROBLEMS (REFTELS). IRANIAN AMBASSADOR HAS BEEN INSTRUCTED TO TAKE SIMILAR LINE IN HIS TALKS WITH RULERS.

SHAH TOLD AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN IN HIS LAST AUDIENCE FEW DAYS AGO THAT RASHID AND ZAYID HAVE BOTH BEEN COMING TO HIM WITH COMPLAINTS ABOUT THE OTHER. ASSUME IRANIAN AMBASSADOR'S INSTRUCTIONS WILL PROVIDE HIM TALKING POINTS WHEN SUCH CONTACTS RECUR.

BEGIN SUMMARY. FOLLOWING CRITICISM BY THE SHAH AT HIS PRESS CONFERENCE MAY 13, THE GOVERNMENT-SPONSORED RESURGENCE PARTY HAD UNDERGONE A NUMBER OF ADMINISTRATIVE CHANGES AND HAS HELD TWO INTRAPARTY ELECTIONS. END SUMMARY.

MEDIA CRITICISM AND PUBLIC APATHY WITH REGARD TO PARTY ACTIVITIES PRECEDED RESIGNATIONS BY THE TWO PARTY WING LEADERS. HUSHANG ANSARY, MANAGING DIRECTOR OF NIOC, RESIDGNED AS COORDINATOR OF THE CONSTRUCTIVE WING ON MAY 31. HE WAS FOLLOWED ON JUNE 4 BY ABDOL MAJID MAJIDI, HEAD OF EMPRESS FARAH'S FOUNDATION, WHO GAVE UP HIS POSITION AS COORDINATOR OF THE PROGRESSIVE WING. BOTH LEADERS CITED THEIR OTHER GOVERNMENT DUTIES AS LEAVING THEM INSUFFICIENT TIME FOR PARTY RESPONSIBILITIES. THEIR RESIGNATIONS WERE ACCOMPANIED BY MEDIA COMMENTARY STRESSSING TIME HAS COME TO PUT LIFE INTO RESURGENCE PARTY IF IT IS TO HAVE IMPOACT ON IRANIAN LIFE AND BE WORTHY OF PUBLIC SUPPORT.
SPECULATION RE SUCCESSORS TO ANSARY AND MAJIDI HAS FOCUSED ON INDIVIDUALS WITH LOWER GOVERNMENT PROFILE WHO WOULD BE ABLE TO DEVOTE MORE ENERGY TO PARTY ACTIVITIES.

IT IS BECOMING INCREASINLGY CLEAR THAT THE PARTY STRUCTURE WILL BE REORGANIZED AND A THIRD WING ESTABLISHED. HUSHANG NAHAVANDI, FORMER CHANCELLOR OF TEHRAN UNIVERSITY AND DIRECTOR OF EMPRESS FARAH'S SPECIAL BUREAU, IS BEING TOUTED AS FUTURE HEAD OF SUCH A WING. HE HIMSELF HAS SAID THAT A THIRD WING WILL BE FORMED ONLY IF IT WILL NOT BECOME "A MERE SHOWPIECE WITH NO PROGRAM, NOR PLATFORM, NOR PROJECTS, SUCH AS ITS PREDECESSORS."" NAHAVANDI WHO HAS AS MANY--IF NOT MORE-GOVERNMENT RESPONSIBILITIES AS EITHER ANSARY OR MAJIDI IS PRESIDENT OF THE GROUP FOR THE STUDY OF IRANIAN PROBLEMS, A GROUP WCICH IS STUDYING THE IDEA OF TRANSFORMING ITSELF INTO A THIRD WING.

REPORTEDLY THE GROUP IS NOT UNANIMOUSLY IN FAVOR OF "POLITICIZING" ITSELF, FEARING THAT IT MIGHT BE DRAWN AWAY FROM ITS CURRENT RESEARCH ENDEAVORS AND REDUCED TO ISSUING RESTATEMENTS OF PRINCIPLE AS THE PRESENT WINGS. AHMAD QOREISHI, CHANCELLOR OF NATIONAL UNIVERSITY AND PRESIDENT OF THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE OF THE PARTY, TOLD AMBASSADOR JUNE 10 THAT MOST LIKELY THERE WILL BE THREE WINGS AND NAHAVANDI, WHOM QOREISHI CONSIDERS COMPETENT AND AMBITIOUS, WILL BECOME THE THIRD COORDINATOR. PURPOSE OF THIRD WING WOULD BE TO APPEAL TO INTELLECTUALS AND GALVANIZE THEIR SUPPORT IN A WAY PARTY HAD NOT BEEN ABLE YET TO DO.

IN RELATED PARTY ACTIVITY, EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE MEMBERS WERE ELECTED MAY 20 BY THE 2,000 MEMBER CENTRAL COUNCIL OF THE PARTY. AMONG THE 55 ELECTED BOARD MEMBERS ARE TWO SENATORS AND 32 MAJLIS DEPUTIES. COMPOSIION OF THE COMMITTEE HAD DIRECT BEARING ON SUBSEQUENT JUNE 10 ELECTION OF PARTY'S 15 ELECTED POLITBURO SEATS. (EMEMBERSHIP LISTS OF TWO BODIES WILL BE TRANSMITTED SEPARATELY VIA AIRGRAM) SHARPLY CONTESTED ELECTION GAVE PARLIAMENTARIANS 13 OF THE 15 SEATS AND RENEWED THE TERM OF QOREISHI AS PRESIDENT OF THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE. TWO VICE PRESIDENTS, HOSSAIN ESKANDARI AND SEIFOLLAH AFSHAR, AND TWO SECRETARIES, NOZAR SADEQI AND FARHANG BEITVAND, WERE ALSO ELECTED.

IN ADDITION TO THE 15 ELECTED MEMBERS, THERE ARE NINE EX-OFFICIO MEMBERS IN CONSEQUENCE OF THEIR PARTY OFFICE, AND SIX NOMINATED BY THE PRIME MINISTER FROM AMONG MINUSTERS OR OTHER HIGH GOI OFFICIALS. THESE LATTER SIX ARE YET TO BE NOMINATED.

COMMENT: ALL THIS ACTIVITY HAS BEEN ACCOMPANIED BY WIDE COVERAGE IN ALL MEDIA AND QUIET HO-HUMS BY GENERAL PUBLIC. UP TO PRESENT MOST IRANIANS HAVE APPEARED GENUINELY PUZZLED BY PARTY MACHINATIONS. THIS HAS BEEN RECOGNIZED BY THE SHAH WHO SEEMS WILLING TO TRY, THROUGH ADMINISTRATIVE SHAKE UP, TO PUT SOME SPARK INTO PARTY. AS ONE MINISTER WHO WAS PREVIOUSLY VERY ACTIVE IN THE PARTY ADMITTED TO DCM JUNE 11, THE PARTY COMMANDS ONLY A MINORITY OF THE PEOPLE AND MUST WORK ON BUILDING ITS POPULAR BASE IF IT IS TO LAST. HOW MUCH DIVERGENCE OF OPINION WILL BE TOLERATED IS A QUESTION WHICH REMAINS IN MINDS OF MANY.

ONE HINT MAY HAVE COME IN SHAH'S JUNE 8 ADDRESS TO GROUP FOR STUDY OFIRANIAN PROBLEMS (REFTEL) IN WHICH HE IS QUOTED AS SAYING THAT APART FROM THE INITIAL SIX PRINCIPLES OF THE REVOLUTION, WHICH DEAL WITH THE COUNTRY'S NATURAL RESOURCES BECOMING PUBLIC PROPERTY, THE OTHER PRINCIPLES ARE OPEN TO DISCUSSION AND REPLACEMENT BY ANY IDEAS WHICH MIGHT PROVE BETTER. THE SHAH WOULD OBVIOUSLY LIKE TO HAVE THE PARTY COOPT (AND THUS CONTROL) COMPETING IDEAS ON IRAN'S POLICIES AND FUTURE RATHER THAN HAVE THE IDEAS CONTINUE TO SEARCH FOR ALTERNATIVE FORA.

COMMENT: I SUSPECT THAT SHAH HAS BECOME AWARE, BASED ON CONVERSATION REPORTED REFTEL, THAT WE KNEW ABOUT IRANIAN INVOLVEMENT WITH UNITA AND DECIDED TO SLIP THE INFORMATION OUT THIS WAY SO THAT HIS CONSCIENCE WOULD BE CLEAR.

1978TEHRAN05574.subject: RESIGNATION OF ZAIRIAN AMBASSADOR TO IRAN

segments.text: PER REQUEST REFTEL, TEXT OF AMBASSADOR MBEKA'S MESSAGE TO MOBUTU FOLLOWS: MESSAGE AU GENERAL MOBUTU SESE SEKO PRESIDENT DE LA REPUBLIQUE ET AU PEUPLE DU ZAIRE L'ENJEU DES EVENEMENTS TRAGIQUES QUI SE DEROULENT ACTUELLEMENT AU SHABA EST CONSIDERABLE. L'UNITE ET L'INTEGRITE NATIONALES SONT EN DANGER. LES ARMES NE PEUVENT, SEULES, RESOUDRE LE GRAVE PROBLEME QUI EST POSE. PAS PLUS D'AILLEURS, QUE L'INTERVENTION DIRECTE DES TROUPES ETRANGERES QUI, LOIN DE CONTRIBUER A LA SOLUTION DU PROBLEME, TEND, AU CONTRAIRE, A L'AGGRAVER ET A LE DRAMATISER. IL N'EST QUE DE CONSIDERER, A CET EGARD, LES RESULTATS PEU CONVEAINCANTS DE LA RECENTE INTERVENTION FRANCO-BELGE SUR KOWEZI ET L'ONE DE CHOC QU'ELLE A PROVOQUEE.

AVEC UN PEU PLUS DE SOUPLESSE ET DE SANG FROID, IL EUT ETE POSSIBLE D'EVITER CE CARNAGE AFFREUX ET INDIGNE QUE NOUS DEPLORONS AUJOURD'HUI. AU CONTRAIRE, ON A OPTE POUR UNE DEMONSTRATION DE FORCE ET ON A EU LE RETOUR REGRETTABLE ET DRAMATIQUE DES FLAMMES. EN VERITE, LE PROBLEME DU SHABA EST POLITIQUE. IL POSTULE UNE REPONSE EGALEMENT POLITIQUE. EN L'OCCURENCE, CELLE-CI S'IMPOSE D'UNE MANIERE IMPERIEUSE-D'ABORD, POUR SAUVEGARDER LA VIE DE NOMBREUSES PERSONNES TANT ZAFROISES QU'ETRANGERES VIVANT ENCORE AU SHABA.

ENSUITE, POUR SAUVER D'UNE DESTRUCTION APOCALPYTIQUE L'OUTIL DE PRODUCTION DE LA NATION QUI EST SERIEUSEMENT MENACE EN CE MOMENT - ENFIN, ET SURTOUT, POUR PRESERVER LA PAIX, L'UNITE ET L'INTEGRITE NATIONALES. DANS CETTE CRISE OUVERTE POUR LA SECONDE FOIS AU SHABA DU FAIT DE L'INTERVENTION DES EX-GENDARMES KATANGAIS, IL NE FAUT POINT PERDRE DE VUE LE FAIT QUE CES DERNIERS, EN DEPIT DES FORFAITS CONDAMNABLES DONT ILS VIENNENT DE SE RENDRE COUPABLE A KOLWEZI,- SONT ET DEMEURENT DES ZAIROIS A PART ENTIERE - LEUR COMPORTEMENT ETONNANT S'IDENTIFIE, PLUS A CELUI D'ETRES TRAQUES, FRUSTRES ET DESESPERES QU'A CELUI D'EGARES IRREDUCTIBLES, AVEUGLES ET SADIQUES.

IL N'EST, EN EFFET, PIRE DAMNATION POUR UN ETRA HUMAIN QUE D'ETRE HABITE PAR LES DEMONS DE LA HAINE ET DU DESESPOIR. PAR AILLEURS, ON AURAIT TORT DE COMPARER LES EXGENDARMES KATANGAIS AUX ANCIENS REBELLES MULELISTES DE SINISTRE MEMOIRE-CE SERAIT COMMETTRE UNE ERREUR DANS L'APPROCHE DES PROBLEMS. LES ANCIENS MULELISTES ETAIENT DES REVOLUTIONNAIRES INSTINCTIFS, PRESQUE SAUVAGES, SANS EXPERIENCES, SANS ENCADREMENT SERIEUX ET SURTOUT SANS TERRITOIRE "ALLIE" DE REPLI-AINSI DONC, ENFERMES DANS LE QUADRILATERE NATIONAL, ILS ETAIENT PLUS VULNERABLES, ET POUVAIENT ETRE POURCHASSES ET DECIMES.

EN REVANCE, LES EX-GENDARMES KATANGAIS SONT DES GENS EXPERIMENTES, ENDOCTRINES ET BIEN ENCADRES, ET SURTOUT, DISPOSENT D'UN TERRITOIRE "HOMOGENE ET COMPLICE" DE REPLI QUI LEUR SERT DE RESERVOIR INEPUISABLE D'ARMES ET DE MUNITIONS ET DE BASE LOGISTIQUE TENUE PAR DES EXPERTS VENUS OUTRE-ATLANTIQUE-AINSI ABRITES ET PROTEGES, ILS PEUVENT LANCER CONTINUELLEMENT DE NOUVELLES INCURSIONS DE PLUS EN PLUS MEURTRIERES DET DESTRUCTRICES. L'HEURE EST VENUE DE FAIRE, SANS COMPLAISANCE, UN EXAMEN DE CONSCIENCE. A CES DESESPERES ET A CES MALHEUREUX REFUGIES, ERRANT SUR LES ROUTES LES YEUX HAGARDS, OUVRONS NOTRE COEUR ET APPERTONS UN MESSAGE D'AMOUR, D'ESPERANCE ET DE TOLERANCE.

OUBLIONS NOS HAINES ET NOS RANCUNES. ------------------029962 120716Z /11 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 8845 AMEMBASSY BRUSSELS INFO AMEMBASSY KINSHASA SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 5574 OURRONS NOS BRAS ET ACCUEILLONS-LES FRATERNELLEMENT AU SEIN DE LA FAMILLE. REJETES HORS DE CELLE-CI, ILS SE SENTIRONT PERPETUELLEMENT FRUSTRES ET DEMEURERONT SOUS L'INFLUENCE D'UNE PROPAGANDA MALEFIGUE, DEVENANT, DE CE FAIT, DES PROIES FACILES AUX MUNIPULATIONS EXTERIEURES. RETIRONS DES MAINS DE L'ENNEMI L'EPEE QU'IL TIENT SUSPENDU AU-DESSUS DE NOT TETES ET DE CELLES DE NOT ENFANT. ESAYONS DE RETROUVER AU FOND DE NOUS-MEMES LE RESSORT NECESSAIRE A NOTRE SURVIE.

ET, AYONS LE COURAGE D'INITIER UN PROCESSUS D'ARRANGEMENT POLITIQUE CONDUISANT A LA RECONCILIATION NATIONALE - SEULE, UNE POLITIQUE DE TOLERANCE ET D'APAISEMENT NATIONAL EST SUSCEPTIBLE DE CREER UNE DYNAMIQUE SLAUTAIRE AU SEIN DE LA NATION. NOUS AVONS LE DEVOIR IMPERIEUX DE NE PAS NOUS Y DEROBER. LE BONHEUR DURABLE DE NOTRE PEUPLE EN DEPEND. L'INTERET SUPERIEUR DE LA NATION L'EXIGE. IL EST DANS NOTRE POUVOIR A NOUS AZROIS DE REGLER, SEULS, NOS DIFFERENDS INTERNES; ET CELA EN TOUTE SOUVERAINETE ET INDEPENDANCE. UN TEL CONSENSUS, S'IL ECHET, GARANTIRAIT PLUS SUREMENTDE L'INTERIEUR - NOTRO DEFENSE ET NOTRE SECURITE COLLECTIVES.

AINSI, MORALESMENT MIEUX ARMES, IL NOUS SERA POSSIBLE DE REPOUSSER LE SPECTRE HIDEUX ET MENACANT DES INGERENCES ETRANGERES DANS NOS AFFAIRES INTERIEURES. DANS LES CIRCONSTANCES PENIBLES QUE NOUS VIVONS, IL NOUS FAUT NOUS EFFORCER DE NOUS DEPARTIR DES ELEMENTS TROP EMOTIFS POUR REGARDER LA VERITE EN FACE. TANT QUE NOUS NE SERIONS PAS CAPABLE DE TROUVER UN ARRANGMENT POLITIQUE NATIONAL ET NEGOCIE IL NOUS FAUDRAIT CRAINDRE LE A CHAQUE INSTANT ET NOUS ATTENDRE A UNE REPETITION CYCLIQUE ET INFERNALE DES EVENEMENTS DU GENRE DE CEUX QUE NOUS DEPLORONS AUJOURD'HUI.

CEUX-CI, A FORCE DE SE REPETER, RISQUENT DE NOUS DEPASSER VOIRE NOUS ECHAPPER POUR EMBRASER LA REGION DU SHABA TOUTE ENTIERE ET, PAR RICOCHET, CONTAMINER SANS DOUTE L'ENSEMBLE DU PAYS-IL NE FAUT POINT SE LEURRER. LE RISQUE DE CONTAGION EST GRAND, COMPTE TENU DE LA CONJONCTURE PRESENTE DANS LE PAYS-DEJA, IL NOUS REVIENT QUE, PRIS DE PANIQUE ET CRAIGNANT D'EVENTUELLES REPRESAILLES, DE NOMBREUX CADRES TECHNIQUES DTRANGERS EMPLOYES PAR DIVERSES SOCEITES AU SHABA S'APPRETENT A QUITTER LA REGION. SI LES CHOSES CONTINUENT A CETTE ALLURE, L'ECONOMIE DE LA REGION RISQUE D'ETRE ASPHYXIEE.

CES QUELQUES REFLEXIONS M'ONT ETE DICTEES UNIQUEMENT PAR LAS CONSCIENCE AIGUE QUE J'AI DU PERIL QUI PESE SUR LA NATION ET PAR L'AMOUR QUE JE PORTE A MA PATRIE TEHERAN, LE 22 MAI 1978 AMBASSADOR - MBEKA MAKOSSO

FORMER AMBASSADOR MALIKYAR INFORMED US JUNE 12 THAT HE HAS TURNED OVER TO AFGHAN EMBASSY HERE ROUGHLY DLS 3 MILLION WHICH HAD BEEN RECEIVED FROM SALE OF AFGHAN EMBASSY PROPERTY BEFORE THE COUP. MONEY HAD BEEN IN BANK UNDER HIS NAME. HE INFORMED FOREIGN MINISTER AMIN THROUGH A LETTER TO BE DELIVERED BY HIS (MALIKYAR'S) FORMER CHAUFFEUR (WHO TURNED OUT TO BE A LONG TIME PARCHAMIST) THAT THIS ACTION WAS EVIDENCE OF HIS GOOD INTENTIONS TOWARD NEW GOVERNMENT. HE THEN QUERIED ABOUT HIS DAUGHTERS. SO FAR HE HAS RECEIVED NO RESPONSE.

WE INFORMED HIM OF AMIN'S STATEMENT TO ASST SEC SAUNDERS (PARA 12 OF STATE 146488) AND ENCOURAGED HIM TO SEEK WAYS TO PICK UP AMIN ON HIS OFFER. DOES EMBASSY KABUL HAVE ANY ADVICE THAT WE COULD INFORMALLY PASS TO MALIKYAR ON THIS MATTER?
HE ALSO ASKED FOR ANY CURRENT INFORMATION CONCERNING NIZAMUDDIN GHAZI TO PASS TO FAMILY.
FOR AMBASSADOR: MALIKYAR IS DEEPLY APPRECIATIVE FOR ALL THAT YOU HAVE DONE TO KEEP HIM INFORMED ABOUT HIS FAMILY.

1978TEHRAN05721.subject: ANOTHER "STAY-HOME" DAY BEING PREPARED BY OPPOSITION WE HAVEJUST LEARNED FROM RELIABLE SOURCE THAT RELIGIOUS OPPOSI- TION ELEMENTS HAVE AGREED AMONG THEMSELVES THAT, I

segments.text: WE HAVEJUST LEARNED FROM RELIABLE SOURCE THAT RELIGIOUS OPPOSITION ELEMENTS HAVE AGREED AMONG THEMSELVES THAT, INSTEAD OF COMMEMORATIVE MEETINGS IN MOSQUES ON JUNE 17, CALL WILL GO OUT FOR PEOPLE SIMPLY TO STAY HOME THAT DAY. THREE TOP AYATOLLAHS (SHARIATMADARI, GOLPAYEGANI AND MARASHI) ISSUED FORMAL CALL TO THAT EFFECT JUNE 11, BEING CIRCULATED PRIVATELY. THIS IS A WELCOME DEVELOPMENT SINCE IT MINIMIZES CHANCES OF LARGE-SCALE CLASHES WITH SECURITY FORCES AND THE RISK OF MORE DEMONSTRATORS BEING KILLED, THUS SETTING OFF A NEW 40-DAY CYCLE FOR FURTHER DEMONSTRATIONS.

(IT WOULD APPREAR JUNE 17 RATHER THAN JUNE 19-29TH KHORDAD-IS THE DATE DHOSEN TO COMMEMORATE THE KILLING OF TWO YOUTHS BY POLICE IN AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI'S HOUSE MAY 10. SOME LOCAL OBSERVERS HAVE EVEN BEEN WORKING ON ASSUMPTION IT WOULD BE JUNE 20.)

1978TEHRAN05768.subject: DEMONSTRATIONS SUBSIDE, PARTY REORGANIZATION CONTINUES SUMMARY: COUNTRY HAS REMAINED QUIET FOR PAST WEEK ALTHOUGH THERE ARE PREDICTIONS BY OPPOSITIO N SOURCES OF COU

segments.text: SUMMARY: COUNTRY HAS REMAINED QUIET FOR PAST WEEK ALTHOUGH THERE ARE PREDICTIONS BY OPPOSITION SOURCES OF COUNTRY WIDE DAY OF MOURNING ON JUNE 17. ISFAHAN CIVILIAN COURT TRIES STUDENT DEMONSTRATORS. DISSIDENT LAWYER ACQUITTED IN WEST AZARBAIJAN. ELECTION BILL DELAYED TO NEXT FALL. RESURGENCE PARTY WING CHAIRMAN TO BE ANNOUNCED NEXT WEEK. GROUP FOR STUDY OF IRANIAN PROBLEMS SUMMONED TO JUNE 18 MEETING. END SUMMARY.

GOI IS REPORTEDLY TAKING PRECAUTIONS IN CONNNECTION WITH JUNE 17, WHICH HAS BEEN DECREED DAY OF MOURNING FOR TWO MEN KILLED IN AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI'S HOME MAY 10 AS WELL AS "FOURTH FORTIETH DAY" AFTER DEATHS AT QOM AND ELSEWHERE JANUARY 7-9. WE UNDERSTAND MOVE TO JUNE 17 WAS MADE BECAUSE 19TH (FORTIETH DAY FROM MAY 10) IS RELIGIOUS HOLIDAY. SCENARIO STILL CALLS FOR PEOPLE STAYING HOME TO MOURN.

FOLLOWING UP REPORT IN PERISAN (BUT NOT FOREIGN LANGUAGE) PRESS, CONSULATE ISFAHAN REPORTS THAT 16 STUDENTS ARE PRESENTLY ON TRIAL IN ISFAHAN'S CRIMINAL COURT NUMBER 1 FOR DESTROYING PROPERTY AND DISTURBING THE PEACE. TEN OF THESE STUDENTS WERE ARRESTED FOR BREAKING WINDOWS AT ISFAHAN UNIVERSITY, A GROUP OF FOUR AND A GROUP OF TWO WERE ARRESTED SEPARATELY OUTSIDE THE UNIVERSITY. CONSULATE HAS LEARNED THAT THE OFFENSES ARE CONSIDERED MINOR AND THAT NO SEVERE SENTENCES ARE EXPECTED.

IN ANOTHER COURT CASE LAWYER AMIR MASHALLAH BOZCHELOW WAS ACQUITTED OF "ABUSE OF LAWYER'S POWERS" CHARGE BY WEST AZARBAIJAN PROVINCIAL COURT JUNE 14. CASE GAINED PROMINENCE FOLLOWING DECISION OF THREE "PROGRESSIVE LAWYERS," INCLUDING MATIN-DAFTARI, TO REPRESENT BOZCHELOW IN HIS APPEAL OF THE DECISION BY THE PUBLIC SECURITY COMMISSION OF REZAYIEH TO EXILE HIM FROM AZARBAIJAN FOR SIX MONTHS. MATIN-DAFTARI BASED HIS APPEAL ON THE GOVERNMENT'S USE OF UNRELIABLE AND CIRCUMSTANTIAL EVIDENCE.

MAJLES CHAIRMAN RIZAI ANNOUNCED JUNE 14 THAT CONSIDERATION OF ELECTIONS BILL WOULD BE POSTPONED UNTIL AFTER PARLIAMENTARY SUMMER RECESS DUE TO END OCTOBER 6. MAJLES JUSTICE COMMITTEE HAS BEEN CONSIDERING THE BILL FOR SOME WEEKS AND HAS RECEIVED OVER 250 AMENDMENTS FROM DEPUTIES WHICH MUST BE REVIEWED IN COMMITTEE BEFORE BILL IS SENT FOR SECOND READING BEFORE FULL MAJLES. CLEARLY, MEMBERSHIP WAS NOT UP TO FACING SUCH A MONUMENTAL TASK SO CLOSE TO WIND-UP OF CURRENT SESSION. REPORTS WE HAVE HEARD (FOR EXAMPLE, SENATE PRESIDENT SHARIF-EMAMI TOLD AMBASSADOR HE THOUGHT ELECTION LAW HAD AND UNNECESSARY) SUGGEST POSTPONEMENT MAY EVENTUALLY LEAD TO RADICAL TRANSFORMATION OF THIS BILL, IF NOT ACTUAL DEFEAT.
THIS IS FIRST EXAMPLE IN RECENT MEMORY OF MAJLES OPENLY RESISTING A PIECE OF IMPORTANT GOVERNMENT LEGISLATION--A SIGN OF THE TIMES.

ANNOUNCEMENT OF NEW RESURGENCE PARTY WING CHAIRMEN HAS BEEN POSTPONED TO NEXT WEEK. WINGS ARE SCHEDULED TO MEET JUNE 18 FOR PRESENTATION OF CANDIDATES WITH ELECTIONS TO BE HELD JUNE 20. A NUMBER OF NAMES HAVE SURFACED FOR BOTH GROUPS. THE PROGRESSIVES ARE RUMORED TO HAVE GHOLAM REZA AFKHAMI/(LITERACY CORPS HEAD) AND SENATORS MOJDEHI AND NARAGHI AS CANDIDATES. THE CONSTRUCTIVES WILL CHOOSE AMONG MOSTAFA ALAMOUTI (MAJLES DEPUTY AND RESURGENCE EXECUTIVE BOARD MEMBER), MANUCHEHR TASLIMI (FORMER COMMERCE MINISTER) AND SENATOR MAHDI SAMII.

MEANWHILE DISCUSSION OF PARTY REORGANIZATION CONTINUES. GROUP FOR STUDY OF IRANIAN PROBLEMS UNDER THE SHAH-PEOPLE REVOLUTION HAS BEEN CALLED TO AN EXTRAORDINARY MEETING ON JUNE 19. EIGHT HUNDRED MEMBER GROUP WILL SUBMIT TO THE SHAH A REPORT WITH PROPOSALS FOR MORE EFFECTIVELY RESPONDING TO PRESENT PROBLEMS FACING THE GOVERNMENT. JUST WHAT THESE PROPOSALS ARE OR WHAT TYPE OF STRUCTURAL CHANGES WOULD BE SUGGESTED FOR THE RASTAKHIZ PARTY IS UNCLEAR. SPECULATION FOCUSES ON THE POSSIBILITY THAT HUSHANG NAHAVANDI, CHAIRMAN OF THE GROUP, MAY RELINQUISH HIS POSITION AS HEAD OF EMPRESS FARAH'S SECRETARIAT TO BECOME THE FULL TIME LEADER OF A NEW POLITICAL MOVEMENT.

NAHAVANDI IS KNOWN FOR HIS CRITICAL VIEWS OF THE PARTY'S PERFORMANCE, URGING A MORE RIGOROUS ATTACK ON CORRUPT OFFICIALS AND A REVIVED PARTY PROGRAM. NAHAVANDI, WHO IS EXCEEDINGLY AMBITIOUS, MAY WELL BE ON A COLLISION COURSE WITH THE PRIME MINISTER, WHO IS ALSO SECRETARY-GENERAL OF THE PARTY AND WHO WE KNOW ALREADY CONSIDERS NAHAVANDI A COMPETITOR AS ADVISOR TO THE SHAH ON THESE MATTERS.

REPORT UNDER REFERENCE CARRIED NOFORN CAPTION. BODY OF REPORT DOES NOT INDICATE TO US ANY REASON THAT WE SHOULD NOT DISCUSS IT WITH IRANIAN OFFICIALS. IS THIS ACCEPTABLE? SUCH DISCUSSION MIGHT ELICIT INFORMATION ON ONE PRESS STORY WE HAVE SEEN ALLEGING TWO THOUSAND ADDITIONAL IRANIAN TROOPS WILL BE SENT TO OMAN. PLEASE LET US KNOW BY SUNDAY, JUNE 18.

1978TEHRAN05771.subject: VOICE OF AMERICA FARSI LANGUAGE BROADCASTS

segments.text: I WHOLEHEARTEDLY ENDORSE AMBASSADOR ELIOT'S RECOMMENDATION. 1978TEHRAN05772.subject: PRELIMINARY REACTIONS TO CHANGE OF SAVAK CHIEF

segments.text: PRELIMINARY REACTIONS TO APPOINTMENT OF GENERAL NASSER MOGHADAM INDICATED MORE ABOUT THE REPUTATION OF HIS PREDECESSOR, GENERAL NASSIRI, THAN ABOUT MOGHADAM HIMSELF. NASSIRI'S DEPARTURE HAS BEEN GREETED WITH RELIEF IN MANY CIRCLES WHICH BELIEVED HE WAS PRESSING THE SHAH TO REVERT TO A HARDER POLICY ON INTERNAL SECURITY WITH MORE ACTIVE REPRESSION OF DEMONSTRATIONS AND OPPOSITION.

AS REPORTED REFTEL, ONE EARLIER PRESS REPORT SUGGESTED "FORMER POLITICAL PRISONERS" WERE HAPPY WITH MOGHADAM BECAUSE HE OPPOSED THE USE OF TORTURE (THE IMPLICATION BEING NASSIRI DID NOT). A PRIVATE REACTION GIVEN US BY ONE OF THE LEADERS OF NATIONAL FRONTIST OPPOSITION SUGGESTS MOGHADAM IS SEEN AS MORE MODERATE AND DECENT THAN HIS PREDECESSOR, THOUGH STILL PRETTY MUCH A "SERVANT OF THE SHAH." FURTHER REACTION FROM RELIGIOUS OPPOSITIONIST CIRCLES DESCRIBES MOGHADAM AS EXTREMELY BRIGHT AND RELATIVELY MORE UNDERSTANDING OF THE COMPLAINTS RELIGIOUS PEOPLE HAVE ABOUT EVENTS IN IRAN.
NASSIRI IS DESCRIBED BY THESE SOURCES AS A "THIEF" WHO EMBEZZLED FUNDS FREELY IN ADDITION TO TAKING VERY REPRESSIVE ATTITUDE TOWARD RELIGIOUS PEOPLE.
THERE HAVE BEEN NO FURTHER ANNOUNCEMENTS FROM OR ABOUT MOGHADAM, BUT HE HAS ASSUMED HIS NEW DUTIES.

LOCAL PRESS JUNE 18 GAVE PROMINENT PLAY TO DOLS SEVEN MILLION IRANIAN CONTRIBUTION TO UN SPONSORED INTERNATIONAL YEAR OF THE CHILD. AMBASSADOR HOVEYDA IS QUOTED AS SAYING THIS AMOUNT WILL BE WITHDRAWN FROM GOI DEFENSE BUDGET, AN OBVIOUS TIE-IN WITH CURRENT SPECIAL SESSION ON DISARMANENT.

ACCORDING TO MFA INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS SOURCE, THIS PLEDGE IS CONSIDERABLY LARGER THAN IRAN'S NORMAL DOLS ONE MILLION VOLUNTARY CONTRIBUTION TO UNICEF. YEAR OF THE CHILD EVENT HAS DRAWN HIGH LEVEL INTEREST HERE WITH NATIONAL COMMITTEE ESTABLISHED UNDER THE AUSPICES OF EMPRESS FARAH. MFA SOURCE BELIEVES IRAN TO BE FIRST COUNTRY TO SET UP SUCH COMMITTEE.

1978TEHRAN05822.subject: JUNE 17 MIXED DAY OF NORMALITY AND QUIET PROTEST

segments.text: CITY OF QOM WAS PRETTY WELL SHUT DOWN ACCORDING TO EYE WITNESS REPORTS JUNE 17 IN RESPONSE TO CALLS BY THREE AYATOLLAHS (REFTELS) FOR QUIET DAY OF MOURNINGIN REMEMBERANCE OF TWO YOUNG MEN KILLED IN AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI'S HOME MAY 10 AS WELL AS PEOPLE KILLED IN QOM RIOTING EARLY JANUARY. THERE WAS NO VIOLENCE, AND ONLY OCCASIONAL BUS LOADS OF POLICE SEEN SPREAD THINLY AROUND TOWN.

CALL FOR SIMILAR ACTION WENT OUT TO SIX OTHER CITIES, INCLUDING TRADITIONALLY RELIGIOUS CENTERS OF ISFAHAN AND TABRIZ (MASHAD HAS GENERALLY GONE ITS SEPARATE WAY). ACCORDING TO CONSULATE ISFAHAN, CITY SHOWED FEW EXTERNAL SIGNS OF MOURNING JUNE 17 BUT BLACK MOURNINGCOLORS MORE IN EVIDENCE TODAY, JUNE 18. (IT IS POSSIBLE ISFAHAN GOT THE WORD TOO LATE, OR FOR SOME REASON IS FOLLOWING DIFFERENT SCHEDULE). CONSULATE TABRIZ REPORTS THAT CENTRAL (BAZAAR) AREA OF THE CITY PRETTY WELL CLOSED DOWN JUNE 17 AND 18. CONSULATE SHIRAZ REPORTS ONLY PARTIAL CLOSURES AND CITY FAIRLY NORMAL JUNE 17 AND 18.
TEHRAN ITSELF WAS GENERALLY NORMAL JUNE 17 WITH ABOUT HALF THE SHOPS IN BAZAAR CLOSED BUT LITTLE OTHER EVIDENCE THAT PROTEST HEEDED.

LOCAL WIRE SERVICE REPRESENTATIVE INTERVIEWED AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI WHO EXPRESSED SATISFACTION WITH DAY OF MOURNING IN QOM AND SAID HE HOPPED THAT 40-DAY CYCLE WOULD NOW END. HE ALSO TOLD INTERVIEWER THAT GOI HAS APPROACHED RELIGIOUS LEADERS TO NEGOTIATE SITUATION AND THIS IS WELCOME, BUT RELIGIOUS LEADERS CANNOT MAKE DEALS THIS WAY. RATHER, SHARIATMADARI SAID IN INTERVIEW ATTENDED BY MANY OF HIS FOLLOWERS, RELIGIOUS COMMUNITY WILL WAIT TO SEE WHAT CHANGES GOI MAKES TO MEET ITS DEMANDS.

IN RESPONSE TO A QUESTION, SHARIATMADARI EXPRESSED A DEGREE OF SATISFACTION FROM WHAT HE HEARS ABOUT NEW CHIEF OF SAVAK, BUT THOUGHT WIDE-RANGING CHANGES ARE REQUIRED IN SAVAK ORGANIZATION AND THE PEOPLE WOULD WAIT TO SEE IF THESE WERE FORTHCOMING. SAVAK STICKS ITS NOSE INTO EVERYBODY'S BUSINESS AND THIS SHOULD BE CHANGED, SHARIATMADARI REPORTEDLY SAID.

IN RESPONSE TO FURTHER QUESTIONS, SHARIATMADARI ADDED THAT HIS PEOPLE DESIRE ENFORCEMENT OF THE IRANIAN CONSTITUTION. HE REFUSED TO BE DRAWN OUT FURTHER. HE DID SAY HE WAS WAITING TO SEE FREE ELECTIONS (PRESUMABLY TO THE PARLIAMENT, WHICH ARE SCHEDULED FOR LATE 1979, BUT ARE ALREADY BEGINNING TO ATTRACT POPULAR ATTENTION).

FINALLY, SHARIATMADARI REVEALED HE HAD RECEIVED A LETTER FROM IRANIAN STUDENTS IN U.S. WHICH ALLEGED IRAN HAD AGREED THAT AUSTRIA MIGHT BURY ITS ATOMIC WASTE IN IRAN'S DESERT. SHARIATMADARI ADMITTED HE KNEW LITTLE ABOUT THE TECHNICAL ASPECTS BUT SAID HE WAS INVESTIGATING. HE WAS WORRIED ABOUT THE EFFECT THIS MIGHT HAVE ON THE HEALTH OF THE PEOPLE LIVING IN THE DESERT. (COMMENT: ISSUE HAS SURFACED ONCE OR TWICE IN IRANIAN PRESS THOUGH, AS ADDRESSEES ARE AWARE, THERE HAS BEEN NO IRAN-AUSTRIAN AGREEMENT ON THIS QUESTION YET. IT IS INTERESTING THAT STUDENT OPPOSITION MOVEMENT IN U.S. HAS PICKED UP THIS SUBJECT FOR EXPLOITATION.)

1978TEHRAN05936.subject: NEW IRANIAN CONSUL GENERAL IN MILAN

segments.text: MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS JUNE 19 ANNOUNCED THE APPOINTMENT OF FARAJ PANAHI AS CONSUL GENERAL IN MILAN. PANAHI HAS BEEN SERVING SINCE JANUARY 1976 AS DEPUTY CHIEF OF MISSION AT THE IRANIAN EMBASSY IN MEXICO CITY.

PANAHI, A CAREER DIPLOMAT, IS IN HIS MID-FORTIES. HE IS EXTREMELY WELL CONNECTED WITHIN GOI HAVING A SISTER, MARYAM, WHO IS THE WIFE OF HUSHANG ANSARY, THE HEAD OF NATIONAL IRANIAN OIL COMPANY. REPORTEDLY HE ALSO HAS CLOSE TIES TO FORMER FOREIGN MINISTER ARDESHIR ZAHEDI, CURRENTLY AMBASSADOR TO THE U.S. HIS FORMER AMBASSADOR IN MEXICO, HOSSEIN ESHRAGHI, IS NOW DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR POLITICAL AFFAIRS (EUROPE AND AMERICA) IN MFA.
ANY ADDITIONAL COMMENT OR ASSESSMENT OF PANAHI'S PERFORMANCE FROM EMBASSY MEXICO CITY WOULD BE APPRECIATED.

1978TEHRAN05944.subject: OPPOSITION LAWYERS CAPTURE BAR ASSOCIATION AND PLAN CLOSER SCRUTINY OF POLITICAL COURT CASES.

segments.text: CLOSER SCRUTINY OF POLITICAL COURT CASES.

FOR SEVERAL WEEKS NOW IRANIAN LAWYERS' FEDERATION HAS BEEN SCENE OF INTERESTING CONFLICT BETWEEN INCUMBENT LEADERSHIP WHICH IS INTERESTED PRIMARILY IN BREAD AND BUTTER ISSUES AND REBELLIOUS YOUNGER MEMBERS, INTERESTED IN POLITICAL LIBERALIZATION, WHO ORGANIZED THEMSELVES INTO A "PROGRESSIVE MOVEMENT". THEY PUT UP SEPARATE SLATE FOR ELECTIONS TO GROUP'S BOARD OF DIRECTORS (WHICH TOOK PLACE JUNE 10). A NOISY POLITICAL CAMPAIGN FOLLOWED, WHICH APPEARED REGULARLY IN THE LOCAL PRESS.

COUNTING OF THE BALLOTS HAS BEEN COMPLETED AND WE WERE INFORMED JUNE 15 BY ONE OF THE LEADERS OF THE PROGRESSIVE SLATE THAT THE PROGRESSIVES WON FIVE OF THE 12 SEATS ON THE BOARD AS WELL AS TWO OF THE SIX ALTERNATES ALSO ELECTED. THEY WOULD HAVE WON ONE MORE SEAT, BUT A TIE VOTE WAS DECIDED BY CHANCE AND THEY LOST IT. NINE BALLOTS WERE INVALIDATED BECAUSE THEY WERE SIGNED OR HAD OTHER IMPERMISSIBLE MARKINGS ON THEM. ALL NINE OF THESE WERE VOTES FOR THE PROGRESSIVES AND, HAD THEY BEEN COUNTED, WOULD HAVE RESULTED IN TWO MORE SEATS FOR THE PROGRESSIVES THAN THEY GOT.

EXULTANT OVER THE VICTORY, OUR INFORMANT NOTED THAT HIS SLATE HAD SUPPORTED FOUR MORE INDEPENDENTS WHO WON SEATS ON THE BOARD, SO THAT IN EFFECT THEY WILL HAVE A WORKING MAJORITY FOR MOST PURPOSES. HE WAS SARCASTIC IN REGARD TO THE INVALID BALLOTS, COMMENTING THAT MANY YOUNG AND NOT-SO-YOUNG LAWYERS (SOME IN THEIR 40S) HAD BEEN CONFUSED AS TO THE EXACT RULES OF BALLOTING SINCE THIS WAS THE FIRST DEMOCRATIC ELECTION OF ANY KIND IN WHICH THEY HAD PARTICIPATED*

THE FOLLOWING CANDIDATES WERE ELECTED: NAME FACTION VOTES HEDAYTOLLAH MATIN-DAFTARI PROG. 668 HASSAN NAZIH " 665 MOHAMMAD JALALI N'INI FORMER BAR 630 MOHSEN PEZESHKPOUR INDEP 624 SAREMEDDIN SADEGH-VAZIRI PROG 617 MOHAMMAD TAGHI DAMGHANI " 598 MAHMOOD MO'INI ARAGHI " 566 MASSOUD ETESSAM FORMER BAR 558 ABDOLMAJID ARDALAN INDEP 550 ESMAIL ZAHED FORMER BAR 535 ABDOLKARIM ANVARI INDEP 532 VALIOLLAH SHAHAB-FERDOWS " 514 ALTERNATE MEMBERS: ALI HASHEMIAN FORMER BAR 494 MOHAMMAD REZA FEIZ-MAHDAVI " 469 MOHAMMAD JAVAD RAZAVI PROG 469 JAHANGI AMIR-HOSSEINI FORMER BAR 454 ALI SHAHANDEH PROG 434 ABOLFAZL SAGHER YAGHMAI FORMER BAR 434

PROGRESSIVES HAVE GREATLY IMPORVED THEIR POSITION IN THE FEDERATION; PREVIOUSLY THEY HAD ONLY THREE SEATS ON THE EXECUTIVE COUNCIL AND THESE WERE ONLY AS RELATIVELY POWERLESS ALTERNATE MEMBERS. ALTHOUGH ELECTION FOR CHAIRMAN OF THE FEDERATION WILL NOT BE HELD UNTIL JULY 6, IT IS ANTICIPATED THAT PROGRESSIVE CANDIDATE HASSAH NAZIEH WILL BE CHOSEN. BY LAW THE CHAIRMAN MUST BE AT LEAST FIFTY YEARS OF AGE, MUST HAVE PRACTICED LAW FOR AT LEAST TWENTY YEARS AND MUST BE LECTED BY A TWO-THIRDS MAJORITY TO HIS POST.

TOP VOTE GETTER MATIN-DAFTARI, A PROMINENT FIGURE IN THE INTERNAL OPPOSITIONIST MOVEMENT, AND GRANDSON OF MOSSADEQ, WAS EXCLUDED FROM ELIGIBILITY (HE IS 46 YEARS OLD AND IN LAW PRACTICE FOR LESS THAN 20 YEARS).

THE CAMPAIGN WAS HARD FOUGHT AND EXHILARATING TO MANY OBSERVERS WHO HAVE NOT BEEN ACCUSTOMED TO THE EXPERIENCE; THEY ALSO HOPE THAT THE BAR ELECTION IS ONE MORE INDICATION OF THE SHAH'S INTENT TO STICK TO HIS OBJECTIVE OF MOVING TOWARD A MORE OPEN SOCIETY. LAWYERS HAVE BEEN AT THE FOREFRONT OF THE OPPOSITION MOVEMENT IN TEHRAN AND WE CAN EXPECT A RENEWED DETERMINATION OF THIS GROUP TO KEEP PRESSING FOR FURTHER CHANGE. THEY HAVE TOLD US PRIVATELY THAT THEY WILL BE MONITORING COURT CASES CLOSELY FOR EVIDENCE OF IMPROPER PROCEDURE ON THE PART OF GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS INCLUDING PROSECUTORS AND JUDGES.
