1978TEHRAN05965.subject: DISSIDENT ACTIVITIES CONTINUE AT LOW LEVEL

segments.text: ONE GUARD WAS KILLED AND TWO OTHERS INJURED JUNE 18 WHEN, ACCORDING TO THE PRESS, A GROUP OF 15 MARKED STUDENTS ATTACKED THE SECURITY OFFICE AT FERDOWSI UNIVERSITY IN MASHAD. THE ATTACKERS REPORTEDLY FIRST SET FIRE TO THE UNIVERSITY GENERATOR AND THEN ATTACKED THE GUARD'S OFFICE WITH MOLOTOV COCKTAILS. THE ATTACKERS FLED THE SCENE AND NO ARRESTS WERE REPORTED. THIS INCIDENT WAS CITED TO THE CHARGE AT A GATHERING RECENTLY WITH THE IMPLICATION IT WAS EVIDENCE OF "AGENTS PROVOCATEURS" ACTING ON BEHALF OF THE GOVERNMENT. NO PROOF WAS GIVEN FOR THE ALLEGATION--A STANDARD ONE OVER PAST MONTHS IN DISSIDENT CIRCLES.

ISFAHAN CRIMINAL COURT BENCH TWO ON JUNE 18 HANDED DOWN FOUR MONTH PRISON SENTENCES TO FOUR STUDENTS FOR DESTROYING PUBLIC PROPERTY AND DISRUPTING LAW AND ORDER. ANOTHER SIX STUDENTS WHO WERE ALSO ACCUSED OF THE ABOVE CHARGES WERE ACQUITTED BY THE COURT ON GROUNDS OF INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE. DURING THE FIVE DAY TRIAL FIVE HEARINGS WERE HELD AND JUDGES DELIBERATED TEN HOURS BEFORE ANNOUNCING VERDICT. THE FOUR CONVICTED STUDENTS HAVE APPEALED. MEANWHILE THE TRIAL OF ANOTHER FOUR STUDENTS ACCUSED OF DISRUPTING PUBLIC ORDER AND CAUSING PROPERTY DAMAGE DURING A DEMONSTRATION AT ISFAHAN UNIVERSITY (REFTEL) BEGAN JUNE 18 AT ISFAHAN CRIMINAL COURT BENCH ONE.
SIX OF THE ORIGINAL GROUP OF TEN WERE RELEASED FOR LACK OF EVIDENCE.

IN OTHER STUDENT ACTION A GROUP OF 700 TEHRAN UNIVERSITY STUDENTS HAVE FILED A COMPLAINT AGAINST CHANCELLOR GHASSEM MOTAMEDI FOR TEMPERING WITH THEIR EXAMINATION GRADES. ACCORDING TOTHE STUDENTS LAWYERS, THEY ARE OBJECTING TO FAILING GRADES BEING GIVEN WITHOUT THEIR KNOWLEDGE OR APPROVAL OF THEIR TEACHERS. (FYI: MOTAMEDI HAS ALSO FIGURED PROMINENTLY IN THE NEW LATELY AS ONE OF THE LEADERS OF THE PROGRESSIVE WING OF THE RESURGENCE PARTY.) THE EMBASSY HAS LEARNED(THOUGH IT WAS NOT IN THE PRESS) THAT SOME TEACHERS HAVE ASSOCIATED THEMSELVES WITH THE STUDENTS COMPLAINT AND ARE ALSO SUING MOTAMEDI ON CHARGES OF FRAUD.
COMMENT: LIBERALIZATION, AND ITS ATTENDANT DISORDERS, CONTINUE , THOUGH CLEARLY AT A SLOWER PACE AS WE ENTER THE SUMMER MONTHS.

WE ARE TRYING TO DETERMINE WHICH MFA OFFICIALS ARE LIKELY TO BE HERE IN JULY 8-10 SUGGESTED TIME FRAME. PRINCIPAL OFFICIAL HANDLING MATTERS ON WHICH AMBASSADOR LEONARD WISHES TO CONSULT IS UNDERSECRETARY (FOR ECONOMIC AND INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATION AFFAIRS) JAFAR NADIM. SINCE NADIM'S EXACT TRAVEL PLANS ARE NOT KNOWN AT MFA HERE AND HE IS AT PRESENT IN NEW YORK WITH IRANIAN DELEGATION TO SSOD, AMBASSADOR LEONARD'S OFFICE MAY WISH TO CHECK DIRECTLY WITH HIM.
NORTH SOUTH ECONOMIC ISSUES HAVE LARGELY FALLEN TO ECONOMICS AND FINANCE MINISTER YEGANEH. WE WILL CHECK ON HIS AVAILABILITY OR OF APPROPRIATE ALTERNATE AFTER USUN HAS SET A FIRM SCHEDULE.
WE WOULD BE DELIGHTED TO HAVE AMBASSADOR LEONARD VISIT WITH US EVEN SHOULD WE NOT BE ABLE TO OFFER NOURISHING FULL PLATE.

1978TEHRAN06014.subject: RESURGENCE PARTY SURGING AHEAD, BUT WILL THIRD WING FLY? SUMMARY. A LIVELY WEEK OF POLITICAL ACTIVITY WAS L

segments.text: FLY? SUMMARY. A LIVELY WEEK OF POLITICAL ACTIVITY WAS LEFT OFF JUNE 18 WITH ELECTION OF SENATOR MOQTADER-MOZDEHI AS COORDINATOR OF PROGRESSIVE WING OF RESURGENCE PARTY. ONE DAY LATER DEPUTY PEZESHKPOUR ANNOUNCED THAT PN-IRANIST PARTY WOULD BE REVIVED. FOLLOWING DAYS OF SPECULATION, HUSHANG NAHAVANDI'S GROUP FOR THE CONSIDERATION OF IRANIAN PROBLEMS WILL APPARENTLY FORM A THIRD WING WITHIN THE RESURGENCE PARTY. END SUMMARY.

PROGRESSIVE WING OF THE RESURGENCE PARTY HAS ELECTED SENATOR NASSROLLAH MOQTADER-MOZDEHI AS COORDINATOR, ENDING TWO WEEKS OF SPECULATION AS TO WHO WILL REPLACE MAJIDI. OTHER CONTENDERS FOR POSITION, AHMAD QOREISHI, GHOLAM REZA AFKHAMI AND EHSAN NARAQI WITHDREW THEIR NAMES FROM CONSIDERATION PLEADING INSUFFICIENT TIME FOR THE JOB. BY ELECTING MOQTADER-MOZDEHI AS COORDINATOR, THE PROGRESSIVES INDIRECTLY REJECTED A PROPOSAL BY HUSHANG NAHAVANDI TO HAVE A PARTY COORDINATING COMMITTEE RATHER THAN INDIVIDUAL WING COORDINATORS. SELECTION OF A COORDINATOR FOR CONSTRUCTIVE WING OF THE PARTY, EXPECTED EARLIER THIS WEEK, HAS BEEN UNEXPLICABLY DELAYED.

DEPUTY MOHSEN PEZESHKPOUR, A FREQUENT GOVERNMENT CRITIC, DECLARED JUNE 19 THAT HE IS REVIVING HIS NATIONALISTIC PANIRANIST PARTY (FORMED THIRTY YEARS AGO) WHICH WAS DISSOLVED FOUR YEARS AGO WHEN THE RESURGENCE PARTY WAS ESTABLISHED. THREE OTHER DEPUTIES, MANOUCHEHR YAZDI, HOSSEIN TABIB AND PARVIZ ZAFARI, FORMER MEMBERS OF THE PAN-IRANIST, HAVE LEFT THE RESURGENCE PARTY AND JOINED PEZESHKPOUR. EARLIER PEZESHKPOUR, IN A STATEMENT TO THE MAJLES, DECLARED THAT THE RESURGENCE PARTY HAD FAILED TO GAIN POPULAR SUPPORT AND HAD NOT FULFILLED ITS MISSION.

BASING HIS REMARKS ON A DEFENSE OF THE "HOLY TRINITY" OF MONARCHY, CONSTITUTION AND THE SHAH-PEOPLE REVOLUTION, PEZESHKPOUR SAID PARTY LEADERS HAD CREATED A GULF BETWEEN THE PARTY AND THE PUBLIC. IN A JUNE 20 ADDRESS TO PAN-IRANIST FAITHFUL HE DECLARED PANIRANIST PHILOSOPHY IS NEITHER FOR NOR AGAINST THE GOVERNMENT AS SUCH, SINCE WHAT WE ARE CONCERNED WITH IS THE INTERESTS OF THE NATION AND SO OUR POSITION VIS-A-VIS THE GOVERNMENT, DEPENDS ON ITS SUCCESS OR FAILURE TO EALIZE NATIONAL INTERESTS".

PEZESHKPOUR HAS ANNOUNCED THAT THE PARTY'S FORMERNEWSPAPER WILL BEGIN PUBLISHING AGAIN AND THAT HE HAS DISPATCHED A REPRESENTATIVE TO WESTERN EUROPE "TO HOLD TALKS WITH PARTY SYMPATHIZERS IN GERMANY, FRANCE AND BRITAIN.

FOLLOWING DAYS OF SPECULATION, RESURGENCE PARTY SECRETARY GENERAL AMOUZEGAR ANNOUNCED JUNE 21 THAT THE PARTY'S POLITICAL BUREAU HAS AGREED TO THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A THIRD WING OF THE PARTY. AMOUZEGAR SAID THIS ACTION WAS TAKEN FOLLOWING CONSIDERATION OF A LETTER FROM HUSHANG NAHAVANDI, PRESIDENT OF THE GROUP FOR THE CONSIDERATION OF IRANIAN PROBLEMS UNDER THE SHAH-PEOPLE REVOLUTION, IN WHICH NAHAVANDI PROPOSED THAT HIS GROUP BE ALLOWED TO FORM A NEW WING WITHIN THE PARTY. A COMMITTEE IS TO BE APPOINTED TO REVISE THE PARTY CHARTER TO PROVIDE FOR THE NEW BODY.

AMOUZEGAR'S ANNOUNCEMENT CAME AS SOMEWHAT OF A SURPRISE SINCE WE HAD HEARD THAT NAHAVANDI'S GROUP WAS RESISTING INCORPORATION INTO THE RESURGENCE PARTY AND HAD ANNOUNCED THEY ONLY WANTED TO ACT AS "AN INDEPENDENT NUCLEUS" WITHIN THE PARTY AND WOULD SOON REVEAL THEIR OWN PLANS FOR REORGANIZATION AND REORIENTATION OF THE PARTY. IT IS NOT CLEAR IF NAHAVANDI ACTUALLY REQUESTED THIRD WING STATUS FOR HIS GROUP AND, IF HE DID, IF MEMBERS OF HIS GROUP WERE IN AGREEMENT. THUS THE ISSUE REMAINS SOMEWHAT IN DOUBT.

IN A RELATED DEVELOPMENT SEVERAL DEPUTIES HAVE WRITTEN TO THE MAJLES SPEAKER REQUESTING THAT THE PROPOSED SUMMER RECESS BE POSTPONED IN VIEW OF THE MAJOR POLITICAL EVENTS TAKING PLACE. THE SPEAKER HAS AGREED THAT ANY DECISION ON A RECESS DATE WILL BE VOTED ON BY THE WHOLE LOWER HOUSE. THE SENATE HAS ALREADY ADJOURNED.

COMMENT: SPATE OF UNPRECEDENTED INTERNAL POLITICAL ACTIVITY HAS LEFT CONSIDERABLE CONFUSION IN ITS WAKE. SOME IRANIAN POLITICAL OBSERVERS HAVE COMMENTED TO CHARGE AND OTHERS THAT REVIVIAL OF THE PAN-IRANIST PARTY HAS BEEN UNDERTAKEN WITH BLESSING OF THE SHAH; OTHERS OPINE THAT IT IS A CHALLENGE TO ISTABLISHED AUTHORITIES. WHAT SEEMS CLEAR IS THAT PEZESHKPOUR IS DEFINITELY PLANNING TO PUSH FOR A SEPARATE POLITICAL ORGANIZATION (WITHIN PROVISIONS OF THE CONSTITUTION) WHICH UP TO NOW APPEARS NOT TO BE RECEIVING ANY EFFECTIVE OPPOSITION FROM THE AUTHORITIES. ESTABLISHMENT OF A THIRD WING OF THE RESURGENCE PARTY ENABLES AMOUZEGAR TO RESPOND TO RECENT CRITICISM OF THE PARTY EXPRESSED BY NUMEROUS IRANIANS, INCLUDING THE SHAH.

BY PLACING THE GOUP FOR CONSIDERATION OF IRANIAN PROBLEMS UNDER HIS JURISDICTION, AMOUZEGAR HAS EFFECTIVELY NIPPED NAHAVANDI'S BUDDING ASPIRATIONS TO LEADERSHIP OF A MORE INDEPENDENT POLITICAL ORGANIZATION AND BROUGH GROUP'S EXPERTISE INTO RESURGENCE PARTY. WE SHALL CONTINUE TO FOLLOW AND REPORT THESE MANEUVERINGS.

1978TEHRAN06100.subject: IRAN AND KURDISH QUESTION IN TURKEY

segments.text: IRANIAN OFFICIALS HAVE BEEN UNHAPPY ABOUT CHARGES IN THE TURKISH PRESS THAT IRAN IS ASSISTING A SEPARATISTS MOVEMENT AND, WITHOUT EXCEPTION, THEY TURN THESE CHARGES PREPOSTEROUS SINCE THEY WOULD MAKE NO SENSE EITHER IN TERMS OF IRAN'S LONGSTANDING CLOSE RELATIONSHIP WITH TURKEY, OR IN CONTEXT OF ITS CURRENT POLICY TOWARDS IRAQ AND THE KURDS.

PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR TOOK THE OCCASION TO UNDERLINE THIS POSITION IN AN INTERVIEW HE GAVE KUWAITI NEWSPAPER "AS SIYASSA," QUOTED IN IRANIAN PRESS JUNE 26. HE DESCRIBED IRANIAN RELATIONS WITH IRAQ AS VERY GOOD AND REJECTED THE TURKISH PRESS REPORTS ACCUSATION OF IRAN STIRRING UP TURKISH KURDS AGAINST THE TURKISH GOVERNMENT. HE SAID IRAN HAS NO INTEREST IN INTERFERRING IN THE INTERNAL AFFAIRS OF TURKEY OR OF TURKISH KURDS.

WE AGREE THAT THESE PRESS REPORTS MAKE NO SENSE. IRAN IS CURRENTLY VERY INTERESTED IN THE POSSIBILITY OF A FALLOUT BETWEEN IRAQ AND THE SOVIET UNION WHOSE LONG TERM EFFECTS FOR IRAN WOULD BE MUCH MORE VALUABLE THAN ANY FOLLING WITH THE KURDS. IRAN IS CURBING THE KURDISH REFUGEES IT CONTROLS MORE TIGHTLY THAN EVER AND WATCHING EVENTS IN IRAQ VERY CLOSELY. OUR ONLY COMMENT AS TO THE PROVENANCE OF THESE REPORTS WOULD BE THAT THEY SEEM TO SERVE SOVIET PURPOSES MORE THAN THOSE OF ANY OTHER PARTY.

1978TEHRAN06112.subject: SOVIETS ATTACK PRC'S PERSIAN GULF POLICY

segments.text: RADIO MOSCOW, IN PERSIAN-LANGUAGE BROADCAST MONITORED HERE ON JUNE 24, LAUNCHED SHARP ATTACK ON THE PRC'S POLICY IN THE PERSIAN GULF AND THE PROPOSED VISIT OF CHINESE PREMIER HUA KUO FENG TO IRAN. BROADCAST, WHICH WAS PROMINENTLY REPORTED IN IRANIAN PRESS, ACCUSED CHINA OF "SOWING SEEDS OF ENMITY" BETWEEN THE PERSIAN GULF STATES AND THE SOVIET UNION THROUGH RECENT VISITS OF SENIOR CHINESE OFFICIALS TO THESE COUNTRIES, SPECIFICALLY THE VISIT TO IRAN BY PRC FOREIGN MINISTER HUANG HUA (REFTEL). RADIO MOSCOW ACCUSED THE CHINESE OF FOLLOWING A STRONG ANTISOVIET POLICY AND CHARGED THAT HUANG CHARACTERIZED THE SOVIET UNION AS AN ENEMY OF THE WHOLE WORLD AND AS PREPARING FOR WAR.

CONTINUING ITS ATTACKS ON THE CHINESE FOREIGN MINISTER, RADIO MOSCOW ALLEGED THAT THE PRC SOUGHT IRANIAN HELP IN ESTABLISHING CONTACTS WITH OTHER PERSIAN GULF STATES BY ATTEMPTING TO CONVINCE THE GOI THAT THIS POLICY WAS NOT ONLY IN THE BEST INTERESTS OF THE PRC BUT ALSO OF IRAN.

COMMENT: SOVIETS HAVE OBVIOUSLY BEEN STUNG BY PRC DIPLOMATIC OFFENSIVE IN PERSIAN GULF REGION. BEAMING ANTI-CHINESE BROADCASTS TO IRAN, THEREBY PLAYING UP INTRACOMMUNIST RIVALRY, WILL DO NOTHING TO SOOTHE JANGLED NERVES WITHIN GOI. LEADERSHIP PRECEPTION OF SOVIET THREAT TO REGION IS ALREADY HIGH AND IS INCREASINGLY REFLECTED AT PRESENT IN ANTI-SOVIET SLANT IN GOI PUBLIC STATEMENTS AND PRESS TREATMENT. HOWEVER, WE HAVE NO EVIDENCE THAT SHAH HAS AGREED TO SECOND CHINESE APPLICATIONS FOR ESTABLISHMENT OF RELATIONS WITH ARAB COUNTRIES OF THE GULF EVEN IF CHINESE ASKED FOR SUCH SUPPORT.

WHILE SHAH MAY FAVOR ESTABLISHMENT OF SUCH RELATIONS (AS THEIR RECENT ACCEPTANCE BY OMAN, A CLOSE FRIEND OF IRAN'S, WOULD SUGGEST) HE IS CERTAINLY AWARE THAT IRAN'S OPEN PROMOTION OF THEM WOULD PROBABLY BE COUNTERPRODUCTIVE WITH MOST GULF ARAB STATES.

1978TEHRAN06115.subject: NY TIMES ARTICLE ON GULF SECURITY DISCUSSIONS

segments.text: WE AGREE WITH PARIS REFTEL THAT THERE IS NOTHING NEW OF SUBSTANCE IN FLORA LEWIS' ARTICLE. BY COINCIDENCE OR NOT PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR SAID AS MUCH TO THE KUWAITI NEWSPAPER "AS SIYASSA," IN INTEVIEW WHICH IS CARRIED IN TEHRAN PRESS JUNE 26. AMOUZEGAR IS REPORTED TO HAVE TOLD THAT NEWSPEPAR THAT IRAQ, SAUDI ARABIA, AS WELL AS THE OTHER PERSIAN GULF COUNTRIES, HAVE REACHED A DEADLOCK IN NEGOTIATIONS TO REACH AN AGREEMENT ON PERSIAN GULF SECURITY.

CONTACTS HAVE BEEN MADE BETWEEN IRAN AND OTHER PERSIAN GULFOUNTRIES ON THE POSSIBILITIES OF REACHING A DEFENSE PACE OR ESTABLISHING COORDINATION AMONG IRAN, SAUDI ARABIA AND IRAQ, BUT ALL OF THESE CONTACTS HAVE NOW STOPPED. AMOUZEGAR IS QUOTED AS SAYING: "IRAN HAS BECOME WEARY OF TAKING THE INITIATIVE IN PROPOSING COMMON PERSIAN GULF COORDIANTION PLANS AND NOT RECEIVING ANY AGREEABLE ANSWERS FROM THE PERSIAN GULF ARAB STATES."

THIS CONFIRMS OUR UNDERSTANDING THAT DISCUSSIONS BEING REFERRED TO ARE EITHER THE OLD ONES DATING BACK MANY MONTHS AND EVEN YEARS OR MORE RECENTONES REFERRED TO TEHRAN REFTEL BETWEEN IRAN AND SAUDI ARABIA PRIMARILY WHICH WOULD APPEAR TO FOCUS ON PROTECTION AGAINST SABOTAGE TO OIL FILDS RATHER THAN BROADER ISSUESOF GULF SECURITY. IT IS POSSIBLE THAT THE SUBJECT HAS BEEN BROACHED RECENTLY IN CONVERSTATIONS BETWEEN IRAN AND IRAQ, WHICH GO ON FREQUENTLY, THOUGH ALL OUR MFA SOURCES DENY IT.

IT IS QUITE CLEAR, HOWEVER, THAT IRAQ HAS NOT CHANGED ITS APPROACH ON THIS ISSUE, AS NEW YORK TIMES ARTICLE WOULD IMPLY, AND THEREFORE WE ARE LEFT WITH IRAN PUSHING THE IDEA AS IT ALSWAYS HAS BUT NONE OF THE OTHERS RESPONDING IN ANY SIGNIFICANT WAY, AS THEY ALWAYS HAVE FAILED TO RESPOND.

WE ARE NOT AWARE OF IRAQI NAVY BUILDING PROGRAMS, THOUGH THAT WOULD LEND ITSELF TO VARIOUS INTERPRESTATIONS IF TRUE. IN OUR MOST RECENT CONVERSATION AT THE MFA ON THIS SUBJECT, DEPARTMENT HEAD TOLD POLCOUNTS THAT THE IRAQIS HAD PRESSED KUWAIT AGAIN DURING RECENT BILATERALS ON AN IRAQ-KUWAIT SECURITY AGREEMENT, BUT KUWAITIS STILL RESIST IT. THE SEVERAL SAUDI COMINGS AND GOINS HERE HAVE SO FAR NOT RESULTED IN ANYTHING SPECIFIC, AND THE SHAH'S WELL-KNWON DESIRE TO HELP WEAN IRAQ FROM THE CLOSE SOVIET EMBRACE HAVE NOT FOUND EXPRESSION, AS FAR AS WE KNOW, IN ANY SPECIFIC NEW POLITICAL AGREEMENTS OR ARRANGEMENTS BETWEEN THE TWO COUNTRIES.

SUMMARY: GOI SEEKS TO CLARIFY FUTURE DIRECTION AND ORGANIZATION OF RESURGENCE PARTY. MAJORITY OF HUSHANG NAHAVANDI'S GROUP FOR THE STUDY OF IRANIAN PROBLEMS OPPOSE INCORPORATION AS THIRD WING OF PARTY. GROUP'S REPORT TO THE SHAH, CRITICAL OF FORMER POLITICAL ORGANIZATIONS AS WELL AS RESURGENCE PARTY, ALLEGES THAT RECENT DISTURBANCES ARE RESULT OF LOWER CLASS FRUSTRATIONS AND ANGER AT FALSE PROMISES OF GOVERNMENT. POWER STRUGGLE BETWEEN AMOUZEGAR AND NAHAVANDI CONTINUES UNABATED. END SUMMARY.

SPECULATION CONTINUES WITH REGARD TO FUTURE DIRECTION AND STRUCTURE OF THE RESURGENCE PARTY. SEEKING TO CLARIFY SITUATION, GOI SPOKESMAN MINISTER HOMAYOUN, FOLLOWING JUNE 26 CABINET MEETING, HELD SPIRITED SESSION WITH LOCAL NEWS REPRESENTATIVES. THE GOVERNMENT'S LINE AT PRESENT, ACCORDING TOHOMAYOUN, CHARACTERIZES THE RESURGENCE AS "THE ONLY POLITICAL PARTY WHICH HAS THE FULL SUPPORT OF THE NATION". HOMAYOUN ADDED THAT WHILE PARTY MEMBERSHIP HAS NEVER BEEN OBLIGATORY, THOSE WHO DECIDE NOT TO REMAIN IN THE PARTY CANNOT EXPECT TO BE ENTRUSTED WITH GOVERNMENT RESPONSIBILITIES.

THIS COULD BE INTERPRETED TO SUGGEST THAT THOSE WHO WISH TO FORM SEPARATE POLITICAL ORGANIZATIONS, SUCH AS DEPUTIES PEZESHKPORRAAND BANI AHMAD AND THEIR SUPPORTERS, MIGHT BE EXCLUDED FROM PARTICIPATION IN NEXT YEAR'S MAJLES ELECTIONS.

MEANWHILE THE RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN THE GROUP FOR THE STUDY OF IRANIAN PROBLEMS, A NAISSANT THIRD WING, AND THE PARTY REMAINS MURKY.HUSHANG NAHAVANDI, PRESIDENT OF THE GROUP, SAID ON JUNE 24 THAT THE GROUP WOULD RETAIN HITS INDEPENDENT IDENTITY WHILE ACTING AS A PARTY WING. HOWEVER, THE GROUP SAYS IT HAS SUBMITTED A LETTER WITH TEN "NONNEGOTIABLE" DEMANDS TO BE HONORED BY THE PARTY IN ORDER THAT THE GROUP MAY CONTINUE ITS POLITICAL ACTION WITHIN THE FRAMEWORK OF THE PARTY. ONE SOURCE IN A POSITION TO KNOW TELLS US THAT THERE ARE IN EFFECT NO SUCH DEMANDS, BUT THAT IS A PRETEXT TO HOLD BACK FROM WING MEMBERSHIP.

IT IS CLEAR THAT GROUP'S MEMBERSHIP CONTINUES TO BE SHARPLY DIVIDED OVER THE QUESTION OF INCORPORATION WITHIN THE PARTY. APPARENTLY AMOUZEGAR'S ANNOUNCEMENT (REFTEL) CAUGHT MOST OF THE GROUP UNAWARE SINCE A MAJORITY HAD OPPOSED GROUP'S TRANSFORMING ITSELF INTO A THIRD WING.

IN A RELATED DEVELOPMENT, SOME DETAILS FROM THE REPORT WHICH THE GROUP PRESENTED TO THE SHAH HAVE NOW BEEN MADE PUBLIC. REPORRT, DIVIDED INTO THREE SECTIONS, IS CRITICAL OF THE FORMER RULING IRAN NOVIN PARTY FOR FAILING TO PROVIDE ANY REAL LEADERSHIP, THUS, ACCORDING TO THE REPORT, LEADING THE SHAH TO CREATE THE RESURGENCE PARTY. THIS PARTY IN TURN HAS FAILED TO MEET POLITICAL NEEDS OF THE COUNTRY.

REPORT ASCRIBES THIS YEAR'S RIOTS IN PLACES SUCH AS TABRIZ TO LOWER CLASS FRUSTRATIONS AND ANGER RESULTING FROM FALSE PROMISES BY THE GOVERNMENT;"ROOTS OF UNREST AND CYNICISM ARE TO BE FOUND IN THE LACK OF TRUE DEMOCRACY AS ORIGINALLY PROMISED BY THE RESURGENCE PARTY."

IN THE MIDST OF THIS CRITICAL DEBATE, PARTY APPOINTMENTS INCH ALONG. NO COORDINATOR FOR THE CONSTRUCTIVE WING OF THE PARTY HAS YET BEEN SELECTED BUT FOUR POLITICAL BUREAU OFFICERS HAVE BEEN ANNOUNCED: MOSTAFA ALAMOUTI AND MRS. FARROKH-LAGHA BABAN AS DEPUTY CHAIRPERSONS (TO AMOUZEGAR) AND HASSAN ALI MOHAGHEGH AND FERISOUN MOTAMED-VAZIRI AS SECRETARIES. STRONGEST RUMOR IS THAT LABOR MINISTER MOINI MIGHT BE INTERESTED IN THE WING JOB.

COMMENT: INDICATIONS ARE WE ARE WATCHING FIERCE POWER PLAY BETWEEN PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR AND EMPRESS SECRETARIAT HEAD NAHAVANDI. LATTER, THROUGH HIS GROUP, HAS DONE HIS BEST TO DISCREDIT AMOUZEGAR'S PERFORMANCE AS PARTY AND GOVERNMENT LEADER. AMOUZEGAR FOR HIS PART IS ATTEMPTING TO FINESSE NAHAVANDI OUT OF HIS POWERFUL COURT POSITION BY BRINGING HIM WITHIN RESURGENCE ORGANIZATION IN FULLTIME CAPACITY. MEANWHILE, ON THESE SIDELINES, POTENTIAL INDEPENDENT LEADERS SUCH AS BANI AHMAD ARE CLOSELY WATCHING GOVERNMENT REACTION TO PEZESHKPOUR'S ATTEMPTS TO REVIVE SEPARATE POLITICAL PARTY.
SHAH AND AHAHBANOU HAVE INVITED MRS LYNDON JOHNSON AND THE CHAIRMAN OF THE NATIONAL GEOGRAPHIC SOCIETY AND HIS WIFE FOR LUNCH ON JULY 1. IT APPEARS THAT JEAN AND I WILL ALSO BE INCLUDED .
I WOULD APPRECIATE GUIDANCE SOONEST ON FOLLOWING SUBJECTS WHICH COULD COME UP IN CONVERSATION WITH HIM.
HOW FAR CAN I GO IN DESCRIBING CURRENT STATE OF PLAY ON PAKISTAN REPROCESSING AND OUR TENTATIVE PACKAGE FOR PAKS?
SHAH IS LIKELY TO RAISE STATUS OF US CONSIDERATION OF LONG TERM ARMS ACQUISTION LIST, IN PARTICULAR FRIGATE AND F-4 ISSUES. IT WOULD BE USEFUL, THEREFORE, TO HAVE A REPORT ON OUTCOME OF PRC MEETING.

GOI IS GREATLY CONCERNED BY EVENTS IN YAR AND PDRY AND, OF COURSE, SEES EVENTS AS FURTHER TIGHTENING OF SOVIET GRIP. PLEASE OBTAIN CONTINUING ASSESSMENTS OF THESE EVENTS, EVEN IF OUR KNOWLEDGE IS SKIMPY.
IS THERE ANYTHING ON MIDEAST PEACE TALKS BEYOND DEPARTMENT SPOKESMAN'S ENUNCIATIONS?
ON AFGHANISTAN I CAN DRAW UPON EMBASSY KABUL'S REPORTING UNLESS THERE ARE FEW PARTICULAR POINTS YOU WOULD WANT MADE. NAAS NOTE BY OC/T: DISTRIBUTION CO-ORDINATED WITH S/S-O MS. KENNEDY

1978TEHRAN06202.subject: PRE-UNGA CONSULTATIONS: VISIT OF AMB LEONARD

segments.text: LOOK FORWARD TO AMB LEONARD'S VISIT HERE. WOULD APPRECIATE CONFIRMATION DATES JULY 8-10 AND SPECIFIC FLIGHT INFORMATION SO AS TO MAKE ARRANGEMENTS. PLAN CALLS AT MFA AND MINISTRY OF ECONOMY AND FINANCE JULY 9, AND, IF AMB LEONARD HAS NO OBJECTION, I WOULD LIKE TO GIVE AN INFORMAL DINNER IN HIS HONOR THAT EVENING.

SEVEN OF THE TEN STUDENTS ON TRIAL IN ISFAHAN FOR DISRUPTING THE PEACE (REFTEL) WERE ACQUITTED JUNE 24 BY ISFAHAN PROVINCIAL COURT. THREE STUDENTS WERE FOUND GUILTY OF HAVING BEEN PART OF A MOB THAT ATTACKED AND RANSACKED PEPSI COLA TRUCKS PARKED OUTSIDE THE COMPANY'S FACTORY. THEY HAVE BEEN SENTENCED TO THREE AND ONE HALF MONTHS IMPRISONMENT AND PAYMENT OF 5,000 RIALS FINE. THE COURT AGREED WITH DEFENSE LAWYERS CONTENTION THAT MUCH OF THE EVIDENCE PRESENTED BY THE PROSECUTOR WAS OF DUBIOUS ORIGIN. THE CONVICTED STUDENTS ARE APPEALING DECISION. DEFENSE ATTORNEYS HAD ARGUED THAT THE CASE WAS ESSENTIALLY POLITICAL AND SHOULD NOT BE BROUGHT TO CRIMINAL COURT.
THIS DEFENSE ARGUMENT, THAT STUDENTS HAVE "RIGHT" TO DEMONSTRATE, HAS BEEN PRESENTED BEFORE--WITH EQUALLY UNSUCCESSFUL RESULTS.

TEN STUDENTS FOUND GUILTY SIX MONTHS AGO OF DEMONSTRATING AND DISTRUBING THE PEACE HAD THEIR CONVICTIONS OVERTURNED JUNE 25 BY TEHRAN SUPERIOR PROVINCIAL COURT. THE STUDENTS HAD BEEN FINED 30,000 RIALS EACH FOR DEMONSTRATING DURING ASHURA PERIOD OF MOURNING LAST DECEMBER.

ON JUNE 27 FOUR STUDENTS ARRESTED LAST JANUARY ON CHARGES OF DISTURBING PUBLIC ORDER IN ISFAHAN WERE FINED 30,000 RIALS EACH BY THE ISFAHAN MISDEMEANOR COURT. DEFENSE LAWYER MANUCHEHR MASUDI USED ARGUMENT SIMILAR TO THAT IN PARA 2 ABOVE, ALLEGING CONSTITUTIONAL RIGHT OF CITIZENS TO ORGANIZE DEMONSTRATIONS.

IN RELATED DEVELOPMENT, MINISTER OF EDUCATION GANJI HAS SAID THAT STUDENTS THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY HAVE THE RIGHT NOT TO ACCEPT THE UNFAVORABLE CONDITIONS WHICH ARE PRESENT IN SOME SCHOOLS, HE HAS REPORTEDLY SENT A CIRCULAR TO ALL PROVINCIAL EDUCATION DEPARTMENTS REQUIREING OFFICALS TO HOLD MONTHLY DISCUSSION SESSIONS WITH MEMBERS OF STUDENT ORGANIZATIONS.

COMMENT: LATTER INSTRUCTION, IF EFFECTIVELY IMPLEMENTED BY AUTHORITIES AND ACCEPTED BY STUDENTS, SHOULD HELP ALLEVIATE MANY OF STUDENTS MORE BASIC, NON-POLITICAL DEMANDS, THEREBY REMOVING SOME IRRITANTS WHICHAVE BEEN CITED BY STUDENTS TO JUSTIFY THEIR DISRUPTIVE ACTIVITIES.
ON JUNE 29 POLCOUNS PASSED INFORMATION REFTEL REGARDING PURGE OF PARCHAMISTS FROM AFGHAN GOVERNMENT TO MFA DEPARTMENT HEAD SHIVA, FOR WHOM IT WAS NEWS. HE WAS VERY INTERESTED AND NOTED IT ALL DOWN.

POLCOUNS ALSO ASKED IF THERE WAS ANY RECENT INFORMATION ABOUT LARGE NUMBERS OF SOVIET ARMED SECRUTIY TROOPS (GIVING PAKISTAN AS PLACE OF ACQUISITION THIS REPORT BUT CITING NO SOURCES). SHIVA SAID THERE HAD BEEN A RECENT CABLE THAT 1,000 SOVIET ECONOMIC EXPERTS HAVE ARRIVED AND ARE WORKING ON PROJECTS MAINLY IN KABUL AND HERAT AREAS. DESPITE SEVERAL QUESTIONS, HE COULD NOT CONFIRM ANYTHING ABOUT SOVIET SECURITY TROOPS, UNLESS THEY HAPPEN TO BE DISGUISED AS ECONOMIC EXPERTS.

SHIVA ALSO PASSED ON RUMORS AND FOLLOWING BITS AND PIECES OF INFORMATION: (A) SOVIET MILITARY ADVISORS IN HERAT AND KABUL HAVE BEGUN TO APPEAR IN THEIR MILITARY UNIFORMS, WHICH WAS NOT THE CASE IN THE PAST, (B) SOME 2-300 RUSSIANS FROM THE THREE REPUBLICS NEIGHBORING AFGHANISTAN ARE IN THE PROCESS OF OCCUPYING POSTS IN VARIOUS MINISTRIES IN KABUL WHICH HAVE BEEN MADE VACANT BY RECENT DISMISSALS OF THEIR INCUMBENTS, (C) MANY SOVIET PLANES ARE ARRIVING LATE AT NIGHT IN KABUL-ONE WONDERS WHAT THEY ARE CARRYING, (D) GIVEN LARGE NUMBER OF ECONOMIC AGREEMENTS SIGNED BETWEEN AFGHANISTAN AND USSR SINCE THE COUP, ONE WONDERS HOW MUCH TIME WAS SPENT IN NEGOTIATING THEM.

IT WOULD APPEAR THAT AGREEMENTS ARE PREPARED IN ADVANCE AND ARE SIMPLY SIGNED BY THE AFGHANS. AMONG MAJOR PROJECTS AGREED UPON IN RECENT AGREEMENTS ARE 1. EXPLOITATION OF COPPER MINES, 2. OIL AND GAS EXPLORATION 3. BUILDING OF ANOTHER BRIDGE OVER RIVER WHICH FORMS BOUNDARY BETWEEN AFGHANISTAN AND THE SOVIET UNION.

LOCAL PRESS HAS REPORTED THAT FIRST AMBASSADOR FROM DEMOCRATIC REPLUBLIC OF AFGHANISTAN WILL BE DRM (FNU) NADJIB, A 31 YEAR OLD MEDICAL DOCTOR. ACCORDING TO PRESS, DR. NADJIB BECAME A MEMBER OF THE PEOPLE'S DEMOCRATIC PARTY OF AFGHANISTAN (PDPA) IN 1965 AND WAS IMPRISONED BY THE GOVERNMENT FOR HIS POLITICIAL ACTIVITY AGAINST DAOUD. UPON LEAVING PRISON NADJIB RESUMED HIS ANTI-GOVERNMENT ACTIVITIES AND WAS ELECTED A MEMBER OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL OF THE DRA. ACCORDING TO INFORMATION FROM KABUL NADJIB SPEAKS ENGLISH, URDU AND PUSHTU.

JOURNAL DE TEHRAN JUNE 29 COMMENTED THAT DR. NADJIB'S APPOINTMENT, DESPITE HIS YOUTH, IS OF PARTICULAR IMPORTANCE SINCE IT INDICATES THE NEW REGIME'S INTEREST IN IRAN BY SENDING NADJIB WHO IS ONLY A MEMBER OF THE COUNCIL OF THE REVOLUTION BUT ALSO OF THE CENTRAL COMMITTEE OF THE PDPA. MFA CONFIRMS REQUEST FOR AGREMENT HAS BEEN RECEIVED, BUT THEY TOO HAVE NO FIRST NAME FOR HIM. WE WOULD BE INTERESTED IN EMBASSY KABUL'S ASSESSMENT OF THIS APPOINTMENT IN LIGHT OF ANIMOSITY BETWEEN THE TWO WINGS OF THE PDPA REPORTED REFTEL.

BAYANDOR, ASSISTANT TO PRIMIN AMOUZEGAR, HAS CALLED CHARGE TO STATE THAT PRIMIN HAS DISCUSSED AMBASSADOR'S APPROACH (TEHRAN 5640) WITH "HIGHER AUGHORITY." IRANIAN POSTION WAS, HE SAID, THAT IF US EXTENDED REPROCESSING RIGHTS TO ANOTHER PARTY FOLLOWING RATICIFCATION OF THE US-IRAN BILATERAL, THEN IRAN SHOULD ALSO HAVE THE SAME BENEFITS. IRAN WANTED AUTHENTIC MOST-FAVORED -NATION TREATMENT, HE CONCLUDED.

BAYANDOR HAS LITTLE BACKGROUND ON NUCLEAR NEGOTIATIONS. HE RECEIVED HIS INSTRUCTIONS ORALLY FROM THE PRIMIN AND HIS FIRST REPORT TO ME WAS SO CONFUSED THAT IT WAS UNREPORTABLE. I REQUESTED CLARIFICATION AND A PRECISE STATEMENT OF THE IRANIAN POSITION AND PARA ONE WAS THE RESULT. I NOTED THAT THIS FORMULATION APPEARED TO BE A REGRESSION FROM THE PRIMIN'S TENTATIVE THOUGHTS AS EXPRESSED TO AMBASSADOR. BAYANDOR DID NOT DISAGREE.

COMMENT: PRIMIN'S STATEMENT IS, OF COURSE, CONSISTENT WITH POSITION GOI HAS TAKEN IN ALL NEGOTIATIONS THIS YEAR FOLLOWING PRESDIENT'S MEETING WITH SHAH. IT IS POSSIBLE THAT GOI WOULD AGREE THAT VERY REPEAT VERY LIMITED EXCEPTIONS FOR SCEINTIFIC, RESEARCH OR INFCE RELATED PURPOSES DO NOT GIVE IRAN THE RIGHT FOR FULL SCALE REPRECESSING. HOWEVER, EVEN IN SUCH INSTANCES, THE GOI MAY DEMAND EQUIVALENT RIGHTS AS A CONTINGENCY FOR THEIR WON FUTURE RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM. WE HAVE REACHED, IN OUR VIEW, THE FINAL CRUNCH: IF WE WISH TO CONCLUDE A BILATERAL AGREEMENT WITH IRAN, THE MOSTFAVORED-NATION CONCEPT MUST BE APPLIED CLEARLY AND UNAMBIGUOUSLY.

IN THE MEANTIME, IRAN IS MOVING APACE WITH IT POWER REACTOR PROGRAM AND APPEARS TO BE ON THE VERGE OF SIGNING UP FOR AT LEAST TWO AND POSSIBLY FOUR MORE REACTORS FROM FRANCE. THIS DEAL WILL, REPORTEDLY, INVOLVE AT LEAST PARTIAL FINANCING BY OIL BARTER. END COMMENT.

THE PRIMIN'S OFFICE HAS ALSO INFORMED US THAT FUTURE NEGOTIATIONS ON THE BILATERAL SHOULD BE PURSUED WITH THE MINISTRY OF ENERGY WHICH, UNDER RECENTLY APPROVED LEGISLATION, HAS THE AUTHORITY FOR NEGOTIATING AGREEMENTS, PROCUREMENT, CONSTRUCTION AND OPERATION OF NUCLEAR POWER PLANTS.

COMMENT: LEGISLATION APPEARS TO LEAVE AEOI WITH ESSENTIALLY REGULATORY RESPONSIBILITIES. ITS ROLE IN NUCLEAR RESEARCH AND TRAINING IS NOT CLEAR AT THIS TIME BUT THE PROPOSED MOVE OF AEOI TO ISFAHAN, THE LOCALE FOR IRAN' MAJOR RESEARCH LABORATORY, MAY INDICATE THAT AEOI WILL HAVE THE LEAD IN SUCH ACTIVITIES.
WE ASSUME THAT THE DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY WILL ABSORB SUCH AEOI SPECIALISTS AS MANZOOR OR WILL SECURE THEM FOR THE PURPOSES OF NEGOTIATING THE BILATERAL. END COMMENT.

DR. KHOSROW FATEMI, DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR INTERNATIONAL COOPERATION IN GOI MINISTRY OF COMMERCE, TOLD E/C COUNSELOR TODAY, JULY 2 , THAT GOI HAS AT LAST DECIDED TO MAKE A DEFINITIVE JUDGMENT ON WHETHER GOI SHOULD PARTICIPATE IN MTN. FOR LAST WEEK OR SO DR. FATEMI HAS BEEN TRYING TO GET AIRLINE ACCOMMODATIONS OUT OF TEHRAN AND NOW EXPECTS TO TRAVEL TO GENEVA ON JULY 3. HE MADE PARTICULAR POINT WITH EMBOFF OF SAYING THAT HE VERY MUCH WISHED TO SPEAK WITH KNOWLEDGEABLE PERSON ON USDEL TO GET SOME GUIDANCE AND RECOMMENDATIONS AS TO WHETHER IRAN SHOULD JOIN THE RANKS OF THOSE NATIONS PARTICIPATING IN MTN.

HE SAID THAT HE IS OPEN-MINDED ON THE SUBJECT. HE IS TAKING WITH HIM A LIST OF COMODITIES BUT WILL NOT FORMALLY SUBMIT THES FOR NEGOTIATION SINCE IT IS NOT YET DECIDED THAT IRAN WILL IN FACT PARTICIPATE ALTHOUGH HE SEEMED TO BE COMPARATIVELY OPTIMISTIC.

ACTION REQUESTED. EMBOFF SUGGESTED THAT DR. FATEMI GET IN TOUCH WITH OFFICE OF AMBASSADOR MCDONALD AND WORK OUT CONVENIENT TIME TO SEE EITHER AMBASSADOR OR SOMEONE ON HIS STAFF. DR. FATEMI IS A VALUABLE CONTACT OF THIS EMBASSY AND WE HOPE THAT A USDEL REPRESENTATIVE WILL BE ABLE TO GIVE HIM SOME TIME. EMBASSY WOULD APPRECIATE BEING INFORMED OF ANYTHING OF SUBSTANCE WCHIH MIGHT TRANSPIRE IN THE CONVERSATION.

LOCAL PRESS HAS WIDELY PUBLICIZED WEEKEND RELIGIOUS DEMONSTRATIONS WHICH TOOK PLACE IN SHIRAZ AND KERMANSHAH. ACCORDING TO THESE REPORTS "THOUSANDS" OF PEOPLE CONGREGATED AT THE FRIDAY MOSQUE TO HEAR SHIRAZI MULLAH DASTGHEIB SPEAK ON JUNE 29. UPON LEAVING THE MOSQUE, CROWD STARTING CHANTINGSLOGANS AND RIOTING WHICH BROUGHT REACTION BY POLICE WHO USED TEARGAS TO END THE DEMONSTRATION.

IN ANOTHER RELIGIOUS-ORIENTED DEMONSTRATION A REPORTED 5,000 PEOPLE LEFT THE MOTAZADI MOSQUE IN KERMANSHAH AND PROCEEDED TO DEMONSTRATE ON JULY 1. WINDOWS AT THE LOCAL BANK SADERAT AND BANK PARS WERE SMASHED AND SECURITY GUARDS USED TEARGAS AND HIGH PRESSURE WATER HOSES TO DISPERSE THE DEMONSTRATORS. PRESS REPORTED 12 ARRESTS.

COMMENT: PRESS HEADLINES APPEAR GROSSLY OVERBLOWN. CONSULATE SHIRAZ STAFF, UNABLE TO CONFIRM SUCH LARGE GATHERING, WAS TOLD BY SHIRAZ CHIEF OF POLICE SALARIE THAT THERE WAS SMALL DEMONSTRATION JUNE 29 FOLLOWING TALK BY WELL KNOWN MULLAH DASTGHEIB. SALARIE TOLD CONSULAR OFFICER THAT NO ARRESTS WERE MADE. FROM ON-THE-SCENE REPORTS, DEMONSTRATION IN KERMANSHAH APPEARS TO HAVE BEEN EQUALLY OVERPUBLICIZED. WE BELIEVE-BUT HAVE NOT YET CONFIRMED-THAT DEMONSTATIONS WERE INSPIRED BY PRO-KHOMEINI RELIGIOUS LEADERS.

1978TEHRAN06311.subject: ACTIVITY ON POLITICAL FRONT HEATS UP SUMMARY: MAJLIS ADJOURNS FOR SUMMER RECESS FOLLOWING FINAL STORMY SESSION ATTACKING "BREAKAWAY" DEPUTY BANI-A

segments.text: SUMMARY: MAJLIS ADJOURNS FOR SUMMER RECESS FOLLOWING FINAL STORMY SESSION ATTACKING "BREAKAWAY" DEPUTY BANI-AHMAD. DEPUTY PEZESHKPOUR LOSING SUPPORT OF SOME CONSTITUENTS. GROUP FOR STUDY OF IRANIAN PROBLEMS HOLDING MEETINGS THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY. CONSTRUCTIVE WING SELECTS LABOR MINISTER MOINI AS COORDINATOR WHILE NIOC CHIEF ANSARY REMAINS IN WING AS CHAIRMAN OF THE COORDINATING COUNCIL. IN A FURTHER NEW TWIST, GOVERNMENT SPOKESMEN AFFIRM GOI INTENTION TO CONTINUE EFFORTS TO WIDEN SCOPE OF POLITICAL DISCUSSION BY TOLERATING OPPOSITION "GROUPS" AND INDEPENDENT CANDIDATES IN JUNE 1979 PARLIAMENTARY ELECTIONS. TO US, IT SEEMS A SHORT SKIP AND A JUMP FROM "GROUPS" TO MORE POLITICAL PARTIES.

1.MAJLIS WRAPPED UP ITS SPRING SESSION WITH A HEATED SESSION JUNE 29 DURING WHICH MAJORITY OF MEMBERS VOICED STRONG OPPOSITION TO POLITICAL MANEUVERINGS OF THOSE WHO HAVE QUITE RESURGENCE PARTY SUCH AS TABRIZ DEPUTY AHMAD BANI-AHMAD, WHO HAS BEEN CONTEMPLATING THE FORMATION OF WHAT HE CALLS A POLITICAL PARTY SIMILAR TO THE EUROPEAN SOCIAL DEMOCRATIC PARTIES.

IN A SHARP PERSONAL ATTACK DEPUTY SADRI KEIVAN, REFERRING TO PRESS REPORTS THAT BANIAHMAD WAS CREATING A PARTY WHICH WOULD SPAN THE GAP BETWEEN THE COUNTRY'S INTELLECTUALS AND ITS RELIGIOUS LEADERS, CHARGED THAT, "WHAT BANI-AHMAD REALLY INTENDS TO DO IS BRIDGE THE GAP BETWEEN IRAN'S MASKED MARXISTS AND ITS CLERGY." BANI-AHMAD WHO TOOK THE ROSTRUM TO REPLY WAS UNABLE EFFECTIVELY TO REFUTE THIS ALLEGATION, BEING CONSTANTLY INTERRUPTED BY OTHER DEPUTIES (EMBASSY OBSERVER CANNOT REMEMBER SUCH A FRACTIOUS LOWER HOUSE SESSION.) STUNG BY THE VOCIFEROUS CRITICISM LEVELED AT HIM IN THE MAJLIS, BANI-AHMAD ON JULY 1 ISSUED A STATEMENT VOWING TO CONTINUE TO PURSUE HIS COMMITMENT TO DEMOCRACY ALTHOUGH "WE DO NOT FEEL THAT THE RIGHT ATMOSPHERE EXISTS FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A POLITICAL ORGANIZATION AT THE MOMENT." CLEARLY THE "BREAKWAY" DEPUTIES HAVE RECEIVED NO SIGNIFICANT SUPPORT FROM THEIR COLLEAGUE IF THE VOTE FOR A SUMMER RECESS IS ANY INDICATION.

MOHSEN PREZESHKPOUR, ANOTHER "BREAKAWAY", HAD ASKED THAT THE PRESENT SESSION BE PROLONGED IN ORDER THAT ALL MIGHT HAVE A CHANCE TO DEBATE ONGOING DEVELOPMENTS. SUMMER ADJOURNMENT, UNTIL OCTOBER, WAS SUPPORTED BY 167 DEPUTIES WITH EIGHT AGAINST AND FOUR ABSTENTIONS.

MEANWHILE, PEZESHKPOUR IS HAVING OTHER PROBLEMS CLOSER TO HOME. REPORTEDLY ONE THOUSAND RESURGENCE PARTY MEMBERS MET LAST WEEK AT MINOO ISLAND NEAR KHORRAMSHAHR TO CALL FOR WITHDRAWAL OF CONFIDENCE FROM THEIR DEPUTY (PEZESHKPOUR). REPRESENTATIVES OF SEVERAL TRIBES AND AGRICULTURAL COOPERATIVES ANNOUNCED DURING THE MEETING THAT THEY HAD WITHDRAWN THEIR SUPPORT FROM PEZESHKPOUR. AT CLOSE OF MEETING A RESOLUTION WAS ADOPTED PLEDGING ALLEGIANCE TO THE PRINCIPLES OF THE PARTY AND DECLARING THAT THOSE WHO BETRAYED PEOPLE IN PARLIAMENT WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED BY PEOPLE OF KHORRAMSHAHR.

PEZESHKPOUR IS ALSO FENDING OFF CHARGES THAT HIS PARTY'S PHILOSOPHY IS FASCIST BY DEFENSIVELY ASSERTING: "WHENEVER A PATRIOTIC MOVEMENT HAS TRIED TO UNDERMINE THE POWER OF FOREIGN IMPERIALISM OR ITS AGENTS, IT HAS BEEN ACCUSED OF BEING A FASCIST MOVEMENT".

THIRD WING LEADER NAHAVANDI HAS BEEN CRISS-CROSSING IRAN MEETING WITH MEMBERS OF HIS GROUP FOR THE STUDY OF IRANIAN. PROBLEMS. IN SHIRAZ JUNE 29 HE SAID, "WE ARE WORKING TO CREATE A STRONG BUT RESPONSIBLE POLITICAL ORGANIZATION COUPLED WITH FARSIGHTEDNESS IN THE FRAMEWORK OF THE RESURGENCE PRINCIPLES". NAHAVANDI IS SCHEDULED TO MEET WITH REPRESENTATIVES OF HIS GROUP IN KERMANSHAH AT ------------------009005 031018Z /14 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 9189 INFO AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY LONDON USINT BAGHDAD SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 6311 THE END OF THE WEEK.

SYMPTOMATIC OF INTENSE PRESS PLAY GIVEN POLITICAL DYNAMICS THESE DAYS, PRESS HAS REVEALED INTERNAL TIFF BETWEEN SECRETARIAT OF PARTY AND NAHAVANDI OVER QUESTION WHETHER THE LATTER LEARNED ABOUT THE PARTY'S APPROVAL OF ESTABLISHMENT OF THIRD WING DIRECTLY OR ONLY FROM PUBLISHED PRESS REPORTS.

NOT TO BE OUTDONE ON THE NEWS FRONT THE CONSTRUCTIVE WING OF THE RESURGENCE PARTY, FOLLOWING WEEKS OF SPECULATION, ON JULY 1 FINALLY REACHED A DECISION ON ITS NEW COORDINATOR; MINISTER OF LABOR AMIR QASSEM MOINI WILL SHARE RESPONSIBILITY AS COORDINATOR WITH NIOC CHARIMAN ANSARY, THE FORMER COORDINATOR, WHO WILL REMAIN IN THE WING AS CHAIRMAN OF THE COORDINATING COUNCIL. PRESUMABLY THIS SHARING OF RESPONSIBILITY WILL ENABLE THESE TWO OVERWORKED GOVERNMENT LEADERS TO CARRY OUT THEIR PARTY DUTIES. ANSARY IN HIS RESIGNATION STATEMENT LAST MAY HAD PLEADED PREOCCUPATION WITH NIOC AS NOT ALLOWING HIM SUFFICIENT TIME TO DEVOTE TO PARTY MATTERS.

PURSUING LIBERALIZATION PROGRAM, MINISTER OF INFORMATION HOMAYOUN TOLD NEWSMEN JUNE 29 THAT THE GOVERNMENT WILL CONTINUE ITS EFFORTS TO WIDEN THE SCOPE OF POLITICAL DISCUSSION AMONG POLITICAL GROUPS AND THE PRESS. HE ADDED THAT THE GOVERNMENT WAS "TOLERATING THE OPPOSITION GROUPS OUTSIDE THE SINGLE PARTY SYSTEM" AND "WILL HAVE NO OBJECTION TO INDEFENDENTS RUNNING IN THE JUNE 1979 PARLIAMENTARY ELECTIONS. IRAN IS A ONE PARTY COUNTRY, BUT NOT LIKE CLASSICAL EXAMPLES. THERE ARE GROUPS OUTSIDE THE PARTY. THESE ARE TOLERATED." IN FOLLOW UP ON JULY 1, MINISTER OF INTERIOR SPOKESMAN SAID THE COMMISSION SUPERVISING THE ELECTIONS NEXT YEAR WILL PICK CANDIDATES FOR ELECTION""REGARDLESS OF THE NATURE OF THEIR POLITICAL BELIEFS".
THERE HAD BEEN INTENSIVE CRITICISM IN THE MAJLIS DURING DEBATE ON THE NEW ELECTIONS BILL THAT THE GOVERNMENT WOULD NOT ALLOW THE NOMINATION OF CANDIDATES CRITICAL OF ITS POLICIES.

COMMENT: WITH ADJOURNMENT OF MAJLIS AND SUMMER EXODUS FOR FOREIGN VACATION RETREATS, WE MAY SEE LET UP IN RECENT UNPRECEDENTED PERIOD OF POLITICAL ACTIVITY. ALTHOUGH "BREAKAWAY" DEPUTIES APPEAR TO HAVE SUFFERED SETBACKS LAST WEEK THERE SEEMS TO BE CLEAR INDICATION THAT GOVERNMENT AUTHORITIES ARE MOVING TOWARD TOLERATION OF POLITICAL PLURALISM OF SOME, AS YET UNDEFINED, DIMENSION. IF POLICY ENUNICATED BY GOVERNMENT SPOKESMEN HOLDS FIRM DURING NEXT TWELVE MONTHS, CANDIDATES, AS INDIVIDUALS OR IN "GROUPINGS" OUTSIDE RESURGENCE FRAMEWORK, WILL BE ABLE TO CHALLENGE THE GOVERNMENT PARTY FOR ELECTIVE OFFICE. WHETHER THESE INDEDEPENDENTS WILL GENERATE SUFFICIENT POPULAR SUPPORT OR BE ALLOWED TO WIN ELECTION IS ANOTHER QUESTION.

MEANWHILE THE RESURGENCE PARTY HAS YET TO GET ITS ACT TOGETHER. NAHAVANDI'S PEREGRINATIONS TO DRUM UP SUPPORT FROM HIS GROUP FOR THIRD WING STATUS CONTINUE, WHILE THE OTHER TWO WINGS ARE IN THE TRHROES OF REORGANIZATION AND REDEFINITION OF GOALS. AS OF NOW, A HARD-FOUGHT MAJLIS ELECTION SEEMS TO BE BUILDING UP FOR NEXT SUMMER. OUR GUESS IS THE MOMENTUM OF LIBERALIZATION WILL PRODUCE A FAIR VARIETY OF VIEWS AND CANDIDATES, EVEN PERHAPS POLITICAL PARTIES-SOMETHING UNSEEN HEREABOUTS FOR QUITE A FEW YEARS.

1978TEHRAN06312.subject: IRAN RELATIONS WITH IRAQ AND SAUDI ARABIA

segments.text: POLCOUNS PRODDED MFA DEPT HEAD DAVOUDI JUNE 29 ON QUESTION OF WHETHER OR NOT THERE IS ANY TRUTH IN NEWSPAPER AND OTHER REPORTS REGARDING GULF SECURITY DISCUSSIONS. DAVOUDI CATEGORICALLY DENIED ANY DISCUSSIONS ON GULF SECURITY BETWEEN IRAN AND IRAQ OVER THE PAST FEW MONTHS, THROUGH MFA CHANNELS AT LEAST. HE ADMITTED IT WAS POSSIBLE SUCH DISCUSSIONS MIGHT HAVE TAKEN PLACE DIRECTLY WITH THE SHAH, BUT WAS NOT AWARE OF ANY OCCASIONS RECENTLY WHEN THIS WOULD HAVE APPEARED PROBABLE. HE INSISTED THAT IRAQ HAS NOT CHANGED ITS POLICY OF BILATERALISM ON THIS ISSUE.

WHIILE IRAQ HAS ALWAYS BEEN PREPARED FOR DISCUSSION OF A BILATERAL AGREEMENT WITH IRAN(IN WHICH IRAQ WOULD PROBABLY RAISE THE QUESTION OF THE KURDS AS WELL AS GULF AND OTHER MATTERS), IRAQ CONTINUES TO AVOID MULTILATERAL DISCUSSION OF THE ISSUE. DAVOUDI THOUGHT IT WAS BECAUSE IRAQ IS NOT YET PREPARED TO DROP ITS CLAIMS TO KUWAITI TERRITORY NOR TO MAKE AN AGREEMENT WHICH MIGHT ALARM AND FURTHER SOUR RELATIONS WITH THE RUSSIANS. HE REFUSED TO BELIEVE AN IRAQI BREAK WITH THE RUSSIANS IS ON THE HORIZON.

AS TO IRANIAN TALKS WITH SAUDIS, DAVOUDI MAINTAINED THAT UNDERSECRETARY ZELLI'S TWO OR THREE TRIPS TO JIDDA WITH MESSAGES FROM THE SHAH HAVE MAINLY CONCERNED OTHER ISSUES, SUCH AS HORN OF AFRICA OR THE YEMENS. HE THOUGHT IT POSSIBLE THERE MIGHT HAVE BEEN DISCUSSIONS OF IMPROVING COOPERATION BETWEEN INTELLIGENCE SERVICES FOR ANTI-TERRORITST PURPOSES, BUT FELT SURE NOTING OF BROADER IMPORT HAD BEEN DISCUSSED IN ANY SERIOUS MANNER.

ON AMBASSADOR SADRIEH MOVING TO GERMANY FROM IRAQ , DAVOUDI CONFIRMED THIS WAS A MATTER OF PERSONAL PREFERENCE PRIMARILY. SADRIEH HAS AN EXCELLENT REPUTATION AS AN ABLE AMBASSADOR, BUT HIS WIFE IS "SICK" AND NOT ABLE TO GO TO A PLACE LIKE BAGHDAD. AMBASSADOR AMIR-MOKRI IS BEING MOVED TO WARSAW AFTER ONLY A YEAR IN BONN MAINLY FOR SADRIEH'S CONVENIENCE, WE GATHER, BUT DAVOUDI WAS VAGUE ON THIS QUESTION. HE ALSO CONFIRMED THAT IRAN'S PROBABLE NEXT AMBASSADOR TO BAGHDAD WOULD BE FEREIDUN ZANDFARD, FORMERLY AMBASSADOR TO PAKISTAN.

1978TEHRAN06313.subject: AFGHAN POSITION ON HELMAND RIVER WATERS TREATY

segments.text: ONE OR TWO LOCAL NEWSPAPERS JULY 2 HEADLINED BBC STORY THAT NEW AFGHAN GOVERNMENT HAS DECLARED HELMAND WATERS TREATY IS AMONG THOSE THAT MUST BE REVIEWED BEFORE NEW GOVERNMENT DECIDES WHETHER OR NOT TO HONOR IT. WE HAVE CHECKED THIS WITH BBC'S ANDREW WHITLEY WHO FILED STORY WITH BBC FROM AFGHANISTAN LAST WEEK AND CONFIRMS IT. HE TOLD US HE WAS INTERVIEWING FOREIGN MINISTER AMIN AND SUBJECT OF TREATIES CAME UP. AMIN VOLUNTEERED THAT BORDER TREATY WITH PAKISTAN WOULD HAVE TO BE REVIEWED. WHITLEY ASKED IF THIS REVIEW WOULD BE GENERAL AND INCLUDE HELMAND RIVER WATERS TREATY WITH IRAN. AMIN REPLIED IN THE AFFIRMATIVE.
WE ARE OBTAINING TEXT OF WHITELY'S STORY AND HOPE TO GET A BRIEFING ON SEVERAL OTHER STORIES HE WROTE WHILE VISITING AFGHANISTAN, WHICH APPARENTLY INCLUDE A FAIR AMOUNT OF INTERESTING INFORMATION.

1978TEHRAN06332.subject: MINISTRY OF ENERGY TAKEOVER OF MAJOR AEOI RESPONSIBILITIES

segments.text: FRONT PAGE BANNER HEADLINE ARTICLE IN KAYHAN INTERNATIONAL ENGLISH LANGUAGE NEWSPAPER OF JUNE 29 IS REPEATED FOR DEPT INFORMATION. TO OUR KNOWLEDGE IT IS AN ACCURATE REPORT.

HEADLINE: NUCLEAR POWER CONTROL SHIFT, BY BIJAN MOSSAVAR-RAHMANI. IRAN'S ATOMIC ENERGY ORGANISATION HAS LOST ITS MANDATE TO PLAN, CONSTRUCT AND OPERATE THE COUNTRY'S NUCLEAR POWER REACTORS TO THE MINISTRY OF ENERGY. PARAGRAPH. THE MOVE IS EXPECTED TO TRIGGER A REASSESSMENT OF IRAN'S LARGE SCALE NUCLEAR POWER PROGRAMME, ACCORDING TO INFORMED SOURCES IN TEHRAN. PARAGRAPH. AEOI, THE COUNTRY'S FASTEST GROWING BUREAUCRATIC EMPIRE SINCE ITS INCEPTION SOME FOUR YEARS AGO, MAY ALSO CEDE PART OF ITS RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT RESPONSIBILITIES, ITS URANIUM EXPLORATION DIVISION AND ITS TRAINING FUNCTIONS TO A NUMBER OF OTHER ORGANIZATIONS. PARAGRAPH.

AS A RESULT, THE ORGANIZATION MAY BE REDUCED TO A REGULATORY AUTHORITY RESPONSIBLE ONLY FOR GENERAL SUPERVISION OF NUCLEAR-RELATED ACTIVITIES, INCLUDING SAFEGUARDS, PHYSICAL PLANT SECURITY AND RADIATION PROTECTION. OTHER PRINCIPAL NUCLEAR COUNTRIES HAVE SIMILARLY SEPARATED REGULATORY WATCHDOG AGENCIES FROM BODIES INVOLVED IN THE MANAGEMENT AND OPERATION OF THEIR POWER REACTORS. PARAGARPH. SUCH A SHIFT HAD BEEN POSSIBLE EVER SINCE THE MAJLIS (PARLIAMENT) VOTED TO EXPAND THE MINISTRY OF ENERGY'S CHARTER TO INCLUDE THE CONSTRUCTION AND OPERATION OF NUCLEAR POWER REACTORS. PARAGRAPH.

IT HAD REMAINED UNCLEAR, HOWEVER, WHETHER THE MINISTRY WOULD MOVE TO EXERCISE THE OPTION AND, IF SO, WHETHER THE MINISTRY EFFORTS WOULD CONFLICT WITH OR SUPPLEMENT THOSE OF AEOI.THESE QUESTIONS WERE ANSWERED AT THE END OF THIS WEEK'S CABINET MEETING WHEN A SPOKESMAN ANNOUNCED THAT ALL ACTIVITIES RELATED TO NUCLEAR POWER REACTORS WOULD HENCEFORTH BE TRANSFERRED FROM AEOI TO THE MINISTRY AND ALL NECESSARY PREPARATIONS FOR THE MOVE HAD BEEN MADE. PARAGRAPH. NO CLUE WAS GIVEN ABOUT THE ROLE OF AEOI DURING THE TRANSITIONAL PERIOD. PARAGRAPH. "WE STILL DON'T KNOW WHAT ALL THIS MEANS," A HIGH RANKING AEOI OFFICAL SAID LAST NIGHT. PARAGRAPH.

IN 1974 IRAN ANNOUNCED PLANS TO INSTALL 23,000 MEGAWATTS OF NUCLEAR POWER CAPACITY WITHIN A 20 YEAR PERIOD AND ENTRUSTED THE TASK TO THE NEWLY FORMED ORGANIZATION HEADED BY DR. AKBAR ETEMAD. PARAGRAPH. TO DATE, FOUR PLANTS WITH A COMBINED CAPACITY OF 4,200 MEGAWATTS HAVE BEEN ORDERED AND ARE PRESENTLY UNDER CONSTRUCTION BY WEST GERMAN AND FRENCH CONCERNS NEAR BUSHEHR AND AHVAZ. NEGOTIATIONS FOR ADDITIONAL PLANTS FROM THESE TWO COUNTRIES AND THE UNITED STATES HAVE ALSO BEEN UNDERWAY FOR SOME TIME. PARAGRAPH.

BUT DESPITE THE SPEED AT WHICH THE AEOI HAS MOVED--ANDPERHAPS BECAUSE OF IT--THE ORGANIZATION HAS COME UNDER INCREASING CRITICISM FROM SOME CIRCLES FOR ITS HANDLING OF THE COUNTRY'S NUCLEAR POWER PROGRAMME. PARAGRAPH.

AMONG THE CRITICISMS VOICED: THE AEOI HAS NOT DRAWN ON A LARGE POOL OF IRANIAN SPECIALISTS IN OTHER INSTITUTIONS SUCH AS THE UNIVERSITIES, NOR IS IT FULLY UTILIZING ITS OWN EXPERTISE IN DRAWING UP AND EXECUTING PROJECTS; THE ULTIMATE GOAL OF TRANSFERRING NUCLEAR TECHNOLOGY INTO THE COUNTRY CANNOT BE SATISFIED BY PURCHASE OF REACTORS ON A "SUPER TURNKEY" BASIS IN WHICH IRANIANS ARE INVOLVED ONLY NOMINALLY; THE AEOI HAS PAID EXORBITANT SUMS TO FOREIGN CONTRACTORS IN ITS HASTE TO MAKE PURCHASES, INCLUDING WHAT IS VARIOUSLY ESTIMATED AT BETWEEN DOLS 7 TO DOLS 10 BILLION FOR THE FIRST TWO 1,200 MEGAWATT REACTORS; THE GIANTSIZED REACTORS ORDERED BY THE AEOI ARE NOT TECHNICALLY COMPATIBLE WITH THE LIMITED IRANIAN GENERATION AND TRANSMISSION NETWORK AS SMALLER ONES WOULD HAVE A FAR LESS DISRUPTIVE IMPACT ON THE COUNTRY'S ELECTRICAL SUPPLY IN CASE OF ACCIDENTAL OR RE-LOAD SHUT-DOWNS; AND, FINALLY, THE AEOI HAS NOT MOVED QUICKLY ENOUGH TO REASSESS ITS EARLIER GOALS IN THE LIGHT OF A DRAMATICALLY CHANGING NUCLEAR POWER PICTURE WORLDWIDE.

PARAGRAPH. SEVERAL NON-AEOI EXPERTS HAVE CALLED FOR SUCH A REASSESSMENT CITING MUSHROOMING REACOR CONSTRUCTION AND FUEL COSTS, WHICH MAKE NUCLEAR POWER SUBSTANTIALLY LESS COMPETITIVE WITH NATURAL GAS AND EVEN CRUDE OIL, INCREASING DEPENDENCE ON FOREIGN SOURCES OF EQUIPMENT, KNOW-HOW, SPARE PARTS, TECHNICIANS AND FUEL, HIGH COSTS OF THE NECESSARY HIGH VOLTAGE TRANSMISSION LINES, GENERAL SAFETY AND ENVIRONMENTAL HAZARDS OF REACTORS PARTICULARLY IN HIGH SEISMIC ZONES AND THE BALANCE OF PAYMENTS DIFFICULTIES RESULTING FROM THE LARGE SCALE PURCHASES FROM ABROAD. UNQUOTE.

1978TEHRAN06356.subject: BIOGRAPHIC BACKGROUND ON RESURGENCE PARTY WING COORDINATORS

segments.text: RESURGENCE PARTY WING COORDINATORS ABDOL MAJID MAJIDI AND HUGHANG ANSARY RESIGNED FROM THEIR PARTY POSITIONS FIVE WEEKS AGO CITING OTHER GOVERNMENT RESPONSIBILITIES AS LEAVING THEM INSUFFICIENT TIME FOR PARTY ACTIVITIES. SPECULATION ON THEIR SUCCESSORS ORIGINALLY CENTERED ON INDIVIDUALS WITH LOWER GOVERNMENT PROFILES WHO WOULD BE ABLE TO DEVOTE MORE ENERGY AND IMAGINATION TO THE PARTY. SELECTION OF SUCCESSORS TO MAJIDI AND ANSARY TOOK AN UNEXPECTEDLY LONG TIME, IN PART DUE TO EXTENSIVE DEBATE BOTH WITHIN THE PARTY AND IN PUBLIC ON REORGANIZATION OF PARTY STRUCTURE AND REVITALIZATION OF PARTY PHILOSOPHY AND OBJECTIVES.

DURING THE PERIOD THAT NEW WING COORDINATORS WERE BEING SOUGHT, THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A THIRD WING, COMPOSED ESSENTIALLY OF MEMBERS OF THE GROUP FOR THE STUDY OF IRANIAN PROBLMES UNDER THE SHAH-PEOPLE REVOLUTION, WAS ANNOUNCED BY PARTY SECRETARY GENERAL AMOUZEGAR. AS REPORTED EARLIER (REFTELS) THE PARTY NOW HAS THREE NEW WING COORDINATORS, TWO OF WHOM, DESPITE EARLIER RUMORS, CURRENTLY HOLD HIGH LEVEL GOVERNMENT POSTS. IN ADDITION ANSARY HAS RETAINED A WING POST AS CHAIRMAN OF THE CONSTRUCTIVE WING'S COORDINATING COUNCIL. BRIEF BIOGRAPHIC SKETCHES OF THE NEW COORDINATORS FOLLOW.

SENATOR NASROLLAH MOQTADER-MOZDEHI WAS UNANIMOUSLY ELECTED COORDINATOR OF THE PROGRESSIVE WING ON JUNE 18 OVER OTHER BETTER KNWON CANDIDATES AHMAD QOREISHI AND GHOLAM REZA AFKHAMI. MOQTADER-MOZDEHI WAS BORN IN 1919 IN RASHT AND RECEIVED A MEDICAL DEGREE FROM TEHRAN UNIVERSITY IN 1946. HE LATER SPECIALIZED IN TROPICAL DISEASES AT THE UNIVERSITY OF LONDON AND INFECTIOUS DISEASES IN THE UNITED STATES. HE HAS SERVED AS DEPARTMENT HEAD AT PAHLAVI HOSPITAL AND BECAME HEAD OF STUDENT AFFAIRS AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY IN 1968. HE WAS LATER DEAN OF THE FACULTY OF MEDICINE AT TEHRN UNIVERSITY AND IN SEPTEMBER 1973 BECAME CHANCELLOR OF FERDOWSI UNIVERSITY IN MASHAD.
HE WAS ELECTED SENATOR FROM TEHRAN IN THE 1975 ELECTIONS. HE SPEAKS FRENCH AND ENGLISH.

ON JUNE 21 ESTABLISHMENT OF A THIRD WING WITH HUSHANG NAHAVANDI AS WING COORDINATOR WAS ANNOUNCED. NAHAVANDI, PRESIDENT OF THE GROUP FOR THE STUDY OF IRANIAN PROBLEMS, WHICH WILL ESSENTIALLY FORM THE NEW WING, IS CONCURRENTLY DIRECTOR OF EMPRESS FARAH'S SPECIAL BUREAU. NAHAVANDI, 48 ORIGINALLY A PROTEGE OF HASSAN ALI MANSUR AND A MEMBER OF THE IRAN NOVIN PARTY, HAS BEEN THE SUBJECT OF EARLIER BIOGRAPHIC SKETCHES AVAIALABLE IN THE DEPARTMENT.

CONSTRUCTIVE WING ON JULY 1 ANNOUNCED ELECTION OF MINISTER OF LABOR AMIR QASSEM MOIN AS WING COORDINATOR. MOINI, 53, HAS SERVED IN A NUMBER OF MINISTERIAL POSTSHE WAS MINISTER OF INTERIOR FOR 10 MONTHS BETWEEN STINTS AS LABOR MINISTER. HE HAS EXTENSIVE POLITICAL EXPERIENCE AS A FORMER DEPUTY AND WAS A LEADER IN THE RULING IRAN NOVIN PARTY PRIOR TO HIS INITIAL APPOINTMENT TO THE CABINET IN 1973. HE IS THE SUBJECT OF IRN REPORTS CR M 76-12210 AND CR M 77-11586.

EMBASSY IS POUCHING (JULY 5) TO DEPT FOR OFFICE OF THE GEOGRAPHER 20 MAP SHEETS DELINEATING IRAN-PAKISTAN BOUNDARY AS WELL AS BOOKLET CONTAINING IRAN-BOUNDARY AGREEMENT OF FEB. 6, 1958, ACCOMPANYING LETTERS EXCHANGED, AND FINAL PROTOCOAL GIVING DESCRIPTIONS AND COORDINATES OF BOUNDARY PILLARS. THESE WERE OBTAINED FROM THE LEGAL DEPARTMENT OF THE MFA. AN EXPRESSION OF APPRECIATION BY THE GEOGRAPHER ADDRESSED TO DEPARTMENT HEAD DR. EZEDINE KAZEMI WOULD BE WELCOME. IT COULD BE POUCHED TO EMBASSY (C/O POLITICAL COUNSELOR) AND WILL BE FORWARDED TO KAZEMI.

1978TEHRAN06392.subject: AFGHAN POSITION ON HELMAND RIVER WATERS TREATY

segments.text: NEWSPAPERS JULY 5 PROMINENTLY CARRIED FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARI'S PRESS CONFERENCE JULY 4 IN WHICH HE DENIED BBC STORY (REFTEL) THAT AFGHANISTAN GOVERNMENT IS SUSPENDING ITS ADHERENCE TO HELMAND RIVER WATERS TREATY PENDING A GENERAL REVIEW OF ALL TREATIES CONCLUDED BY DAOUD GOVERNMENT. KHALATBARI TOLD PRESS, INQUIRIES THROUGH IRANIAN AMBASSADOR IN KABUL ELUCIDATED A DENIAL OF BBC REPORT BY FOREIGN MINISTER HAFIZULLA H AMIN. KHALATBARI WAS QUOTED AS SAYING IRANIAN AMB DAVOUDI HAD BEEN TOLD THAT REPORT WAS "COMPLETELY UNFOUNDED."

KHALATBARI WAS FURTHER QUOTED AS SAYING: "WE BELIEVE THAT THE REPORT BY THE BBC WAS NOTHING BUT PURE PROVOCATION, AIMED AT FRIENDLY RELATIONS BETWEEN THE TWO COUNTRIES." THIS SLAP AT BBC IS QUITE OBVIUOSLY INTENDED TO COVER FOR MOMENTS OF DOUBT IN IRANIAN REACTION TO BBC REPORT BUT PROBABLY ALSO REPRESENTS EXPRESSION OF PENT-UP IRANIAN IRE AT BBC REPORTING IN GENERAL, A CONSTANT THEME IN GOVT CIRCLES HERE. IT REMAINS TO BE SEEN IF THIS INCIDENT WILL HAVE RAMIFICATIONS ON STATUS OF RESIDENT BBC CORRESPONDENT WHITLEY WHO FILED THIS STORY.

IN SAME PRESS CONFERENCE, KHALATBARI SAID IRAN WILL CONTINUE TO PROVIDE AFGHANISTAN WITH NECESSARY ECONOMIC AND FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE, ALTHOUGH THERE HAS BEEN NO AGREEMENT BETWEEN IRAN AND THE NEW AFGHAN GOVT ABOUT THE FORMS WHICH THIS ASSISTANCE MIGHT TAKE. KHALATBARI IS QUOTED AS SAYING: "ALTHOUGH WE PROMISED HELP TO THE FORMER GOVT OF AFGHANISTAN, WE NEVER TRIED TO DICTATE TO FORMER PRESIDENT DAOUD HOW WE WOULD PROVIDE THIS HELP. THIS POLICY WE WILL FOLLOW AGAIN, EVEN THOUGH THE GOVT OF AFGHANISTAN HAS CHANGED."

1978TEHRAN06398.subject: UNDER SECRETARY NEWSOM'S VISIT: THE MOD OF THE SHAH

segments.text: THE SHAH

THE SHAH AND THE FOREIGN MINISTER ARE EAGERLY LOOKING AHEAD TO THE UNDER SEC NEWSOM'S VISIT. IN RECENT MONTHS THE SHAH HAS BEEN GLOOMY AND HAS AT TIMES HAD AN AIR OF FATALISM BROUGHT ABOUT BY, AS HE SEES IT, THE ABSENCE OF A U.S. RESPONSE TO SOVIET EXPANSIONISM. TO THE SHAH IT MATTERS LITTLE IN THE REAL WORLD WHETHER THE SOVIETS-HAVING PLACED THEMSELVES WELL IN THE AREA-TOOK ADVANTAGE OF ESSENTIALLY INTERNAL EVENTS IN AFGHANISTAN AND THE YEMENS OR IN FACT STIMULATED THE EVENTS.
THE NET RESULT IS IN HIS VIEW FURTHER ADVANCES IN THE SOVIET LONG-TERM MASTER PLAN TO ENCIRCLE IRAN AND EVENTUALLY TO CONTROL DIRECTLY OR INDIRECTLY THE FLOW OF OIL.

U.S. POLICY IN THE HORN OF AFRICA AND OUR RELATIVE SILENCE RE AFGHANISTAN AND THE YEMENS HAVE ONCE AGAIN RAISED THE BOGEY IN HIS MIND OF A SOVIET-US UNDERSTANDING TO DIVIDE THE AREA INTO SPHEERES OF INFLUENCE (TEHRAN 6349). HE MADE MUCH THE SAME POINTS TO A RECENT HIGH-LEVEL BRITISH VISITOR. WHILE PART OF HIS MUSING CAN BE ATTRIBUTED TO HIS FORM OF GAMESMANSHIP, THE RUSSO-BRITISH 1907 AGREEMENT AND THE DIVISION OF IRAN DURING WORLD WAR 11 NAG HIM WHEN THE SOVIETS ARE IN A PERIOD OF EXPANSIONISM AND THE US CONTINUES TO EMPHASIZE DETENTE AND THE LARGER ISSUES SUCH AS SALT AND MBFR.

THE MOST IMPORTANT ASPECT OF YOUR TALKS WITH HIM WILL BE TO ASSURE HIM OF OUR DEEP CONCERN OVER SOVIET POLICY AND THE READINESS TO WORK OUT WITH HIM AND OTHERS A POLICY TO COUNTER THE THREAT. AS OUR MESSAGES HAVE INDICATED, THE SHAH VIEWS PAKISTAN AS THE SOFT SPOT IN THE AREA, POLITICALLY UNSTABLE, BEREFT OF DECISIVE LEADERS WHO HAVE POPULAR FOLLOWING, AND VERY VULNERABLE TO SUBVERSION FROM AFGHANISTAN. HE IS DEEPLY WORRIED BY THE SITUATION IN PAKISTAN AND WILL WARMLY WELCOME STEPS WE HAVE IN MIND ONCE THE REPROCESSING ISSUE IS OUT OF THE WAY.

HOWEVER, HE IS DEEPLY PESSIMISTIC THAT THE PAKISTANIS HAVE THE WISDOM OR POLITICAL STRENGTH TO FACE UP TO THE CHANGED GEO-POLITICAL SITUATION. HE IS WORRIED BY THE PAKISTANI THREATS TO REFURBISH RELATIONS WITH THE USSR BUT LOOKS UPON THIS PAKISTANI RESPONSE AS SYMPTOMATIC OF A DEEPER MALAISE-THE ABSENCE OF AN INTERNAL CONSENSUS ON THE NATURE OF PAKISTAN AND A PSYCHOLOGICAL INABILITY TO PUT THE TRADITIONAL INDIAN THREAT TO THE SIDE. FOR THE SHAH THE FATE OF BHUTTO (ISLAMABAD 6400) IS A PRAGMATIC ISSUE: BHUTTO WAS A FOOL, HE HAS SAID, BUT HIS EXECUTION WOULD FURTHER DESTABILIZE AN ALREADY SHAKY SITUATION.
HE BELIEVES FIRMLY THAT THE PAK LEADERS SHOULD BE ABLE TO RECOGNIZE THIS AND, IN LIGHT OF MORE SERIOUS MATTERS, TAKE THE APPROPRIATE ACTION.

HE WILL BE PREPARED, WE BELIEVE , TO GIVE A GENERAL COMMITMENT TO JOIN US IN A MULTILATERAL PROGRAM FOR PAKISTAN, BUT HE MAY NOT MAKE SPECIFIC PLEDGES. AT THIS TIME IRAN'S OIL EXPORTS ARE DOWN AND THE BUDGET WILL LIKELY BE IN DEFICIT; IRAN FOR A YEAR OR SO HAS HELD BACK ON MAKING LARGE FOREIGN ASSISTANCE COMMITMENTS. HE WILL LEAN TOWARD MOVING SLOWLY IN THE TRANSFER OF RESOURCES TO PAKISANI TO SEE WHETHER THE PAKS CAN ADJUST THEIR SIGHTS FROM INDIA TO THE USSR AS THE MAIN THREAT.

ONE IMPORTANT STEP THAT HE COULD TAKE NOW OR IN THE NEAR FUTURE WOULD BE THE IRANIAN GUARANTEE FOR THE DOLS 300 MILLION LOAN TO PAKISTAN BY AN INTERNATIONAL SYNDICATION OF BANKS. THERE ARE A NUMBER OF DIFFICULT TECHNICAL ISSUES TO BE WORKED OUT AND THE IRANIANS ARE RELUCTANT TO MOVE ON IT AS LONG AS THE PAK CONSORTIUM DOES NOT AGREE TO RESCHEDULE PAKISTAN'S OVERALL DEBT. IN THE DEFENSE FIELD, WE ARE CONFIDENT THE SHAH WOULD AGREE TO SOME TRANSFERS OF HARDWARE AND THE PROVISION OF TRAINING IN A NUMBER OF FIELDS.

FOLLOWING PREPARATION OF ABOVE CHARGE MET WITH BRITISH CHARGE WHO HAS IN THE LAST MONTH BEEN PRESENT AT FOUR AUDIENCES (PARLIAMENTARY DELEGATION, EDWARD HEATH, HAROLD WILSON, AND CHIEF, DEFENSE STAFF). SHAH'S COMMENT WERE IN LINE WITH ABOVE BUT FEW POINTS ARE WORHT ADDING. SHAH REVEALED SENSITIVITY THAT WESTERN POWERS DO NOT SUFFICIENTLY RECOGNIZE EFFORTS HE HAS BEEN MAKING TO IMPROVE IRAN'S RELATIONS WITH BOTH PAKISTAN AND INDIA AND TO BRING THE TWO TOGETHER. HE REMARKED THAT HE IS NOT MEDDLING BUT TRYING TO SHOW THE RIGHT DIRECTION BY HIS ACTIONS AND POLICIES.

HE DEVELOPED AT LENGTH FOR HIS BRITISH AUDIENCES HIS CONCERN THAT THE US IS UNABLE OR UNWILLING TO SACRIFICE FOR THE DEFENSE OF THE AREA. "IF I COULD NOT PAY FOR THE MILITARY EQUIPMENT, WOULD I RECEIVE ANY? LOOK AT TURKEY AND PAKISTAN." AS EXPECTED, HE MOANED ABOUT THE POWER OF CONGRESS AND ITS ASSUMPTION OF EXECUTIVE BRANCH POWERS AND WONDERED WHETHER THE TREND COULD BE REVERSED. FINALLY, HE EXPRESSED IRRITATION THAT HIS EFFORTS (UNSTIPULATED) TO ASSIST IN SOUTHERN AFRICA HAVE NOT BEEN APPRECIATED.
IN THIS CONNECTION, IT WOULD BE HELPFUL IF THE UNDER SECRETARY WERE IN A POSITION TO BRIEF THE SHAH ON THE US-UK APPROACH TO SOUTH AFRICA ON NUCLEAR MATTERS.

1978TEHRAN06403.subject: GOI AMBASSADOR TO BAHRAIN SPEAKS OUT ON SOUTH YEMEN AND PERSIAN GULF SECURITY

segments.text: LOCAL PRESS JULY 4 CARRIES EXTENSIVE REPORT ON GOI AMBASSADOR FARBOD'S INTERVIEW WITH BAHRAIN WEEKLY "AL-MASIRAH" IN WHICH FARBOD SAID IRANIANS FELT "HATRED" FOR AL-GHASHIMI ASSASSINATION. AMBASSADOR IS REPORTED TO HAVE CONVEYED DEEP SORROW OF GOI AT THE MURDER AND SAID THAT GOI HAS ANNOUNCED A THREEDAY OFFICIAL MOURNING PERIOD. WITH REGARD TO FUTURE RELATIONS, FARBOD SAID THAT DUE TO CONTINUATION OF DIPLOMATIC RELATIONS WITH THE YAR, IRAN DID NOT HAVE AN EMBASSY IN ADEN AND GOI HAD RECEIVED ONLY UNSUBSTANTIATED RUMORS REGARDING ACTIVITES THERE.
TURNING TO THE PERSIAN GULF, FARBOD SAID THE GOI WOULD WELCOME THE SIGNING OF AN AGREEMENT FOR THE EXCHANGE OF SECURITY INFORMATION TO PROTECT THE REGION FROM FOREIGN INTERVENTION.

COMMENT: POINT OF INTEREST HERE IS THAT GOI AMBASSADOR IS MAKING PUBLIC STATEMENT, PRESUMABLY PRECLEARED WITH MFA, ON THESE TWO SENSITIVE ISSUES. FARBOD REMARKS ON PERSIAN GULF SECURITY FOLLOW BY ONLY FEW DAYS PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR'S INTERVIEW WITH KUWAITI PAPER (REFTELS) WHICH WAS PUBLIC ACKNOWLEDGEMENT OF GOI FRUSTRATION AT CONTINUING FAILURE TO SECURE AGREEMENT OF GULF STATES FOR REGIONAL SECURITY ARRANGEMENT.

WE HAVE HAD CONFIRMATION OF JULY 5 PRESS STORY (REFTEL) CARRIED HERE THAT AFGHANISTAN GOVERNMENT WILL ADHERE TO EXISTING AGREEMENTS WITH IRAN. AFGHAN FIRST SECRETARY MOHAMMAD NADIR AYUBI (PROTECT TOLD EMBOFF THAT HELMAND RIVER WATER TREATY CONTINUES TO BE RECOGNIZED BY NEW REGIME. AS FOR ECONOMIC ASSISTANCE AGREEMENTS, AYUBI SAID THAT IRAN HAD DELIVERED 26 BUSES TO AFGHANISTAN THIS WEEK.

ACCORDING TO AYUBI, AMBASSADOR NAJIB, NEWLY APPOINTED AMBASSADOR TO IRAN, WILL ARRIVE IN TEHRAN WITHIN THE NEXT FEW DAYS. AYUBI, A CAREER DIPLOMAT WHO HAS SERVED PREVIOUSLY IN CAIRO, QUETTA AND WASHINGTON, IS UNCERTAIN REGARDING HIS TENURE UNDER NEW AMBASSADOR, A PUSHTUN FROM KANDAHAR, AYUBI SAYS HE HAS HAD NO POLITICAL AFFILIATIONS AND LITTLE PROPERTY IN AFGHANISTAN--THUS SHOULD NOT BE TARGET OF NEW REGIME. HIS TWO CHILDREN ATTEND CAIRO UNIVERSITY MEDICAL SCHOOL. HE SPEAKS GOOD ENGLISH AS WELL AS DARI, PUSHTU, AND SOME ARABIC.

COMMENT: AT LEAST THIS AFGHAN EMBASSY SOURCE GIVES IMPRESSION OF BUSINESS-AS-USUAL RELATIONS BETWEEN IRAN AND NEW AFGHAN REGIME. AYUBI HAS NOT RETURNED TO KABUL SINCE THE COUP, HOWEVER, AND HIS REMARKS MAY INDICATE SOME WISHFUL THINKING ON HIS PART.

1978TEHRAN06456.subject: DRA FONMIN BBC INTERVIEW REMARKS RE TREATIES

segments.text: ISLAMABAD'S INFERENCE PARA 1 REFTEL IS CORRECT. CONFUSION RESULATED FROM GARBLED TELEPHONE CONVERSATION. EXACT WORDS SUBMITTED BY WHITLEY TO BBC REGARDING NEGOTIATIONS TOWARD BORDER AGREEMENT ARE AS FOLLOWS: "WITH PAKISTAN, AND THE LONG-STANDING QUARREL OVER THE STATUS OF ITS PATHAN AND BALUCH PEOPLE, THE AFGHANISTAN GOVERNMENT SAYS IT WILL NOT BE BUILDING ON THE PROGRESS TOWARDS SETTLEMENT MADE UNDER PRESIDENT DAOUD. THE SURPRISING SPEED WITH WHICH DAOUD APPEARED TO BE MOVING TOWARDS A SETTLEMENT WITH PAKISTAN EALIER THIS YEAR IS THOUGHT BY DIPLOMATIC OBSERVERS HERE TO HAVE BEEN ONE OF THE FACTORS BEHIND LAST APRIL'S COUP. ACCORDING TO MR.
AMIN, AFGHANISTAN HOPES THE PROBLEM CAN BE SOLVED THROUGH FRIENDLY NEGOTIATIONS, BUT IT IS IN NO HURRY TO RESUME THE TALKS."

WHITLEY HAS PASSED US FULL TEXT THAT SUBMISSION PLUS EIGHT OTHERS. THEY WERE POUCHED JULY 6 TO DEPT (NEA/PAB), KABUL, AND ISLAMABAD. WE SHALL REPORT ANY HIGHLIGHTS WE NOTE WHEN WE HAVE HAD A CHANCE TO READ THEM.

WHITLEY HAS WRITTEN FONMIN KHALATBARY LETTER JUSTIFYING HIS ARTICLE FOR BBN, ON HELMAND WATERS AGREEMENT (TEHRAN REFTEL), HE IS ALSO PLANNING GIVE LETTER TO THE PRESS. THIS MAY PROLONG LIFE OF THE AFFAIR. WHITLEY'S OWN GUESS IS THAT AFGHANS CHANGED THEIR TUNE (TEHRAN 6392 -DN 6429) ONCE IRANIAN AMBASSADOR MADE THREATENING NOISES OF AID CUT-OFF. WE ARE NOT SO SURE IT WAS THAT BLUNT. SAME EFFECT WOULD HAVE BEEN PRODUCED BY AFGHANS THINKING OVER WHAT THEY HAVE TO GAIN OR LOSE, IN TERMS OF POLITICAL RELATIONS AS WELL AS HOPEDFOR AID FROM IRAN.

ANNOUNCEMENT HAS BEEN MADE OF THE APPOINTMENT OF MAJOR GENERAL ALI MOTAZED AS GOI AMBASSADOR TO SYRIA. UNTIL RECENTLY MOTAZED WAS DEPUTY CHIEF OF SAVAK, A POST HE ASSUMED IN 1973. HE WAS BORN IN 1916 IN ISFAHAN AND IS A 1937 GRADUATE OF MILITARY COLLEGE TEHRAN. EARLY IN HIS CAREER HE HAD A NUMBER OF ARTILLERY ASSIGNMENTS AND PARTICIPATED IN US TRAINING PROGRAMS AT FT. SILL (1953) AND FT. LEAVENWORTH (1956). HE TRANSFERRED TO SAVAK IN EARLY 1960'S BECOMING CHIEF, COUNTER INTELLIGENCE, SAVAK IN 1966. MOTAZED IS CONSIDERED WESTERN ORIENTED AND PRO-U.S. IN OUTLOOK, HIGHLY INTELLIGENT, EFFICIENT, WITH A SENSE OF HUMOR AND EXCELLENT CONVERSATIONALIST.

HE SPEAKS FRENCH AND ENGLISH AND IS MARRIED WITH THREE CHILDREN. MOTAZED IS THE SECOND SAVAK OFFICIAL TO RECEIVE AN AMBASSADORIAL POST DURING THE PAST MONTH. HIS FORMER CHIEF, GENERAL NASSIRI, IS NOW GOI AMBASSADOR TO PAKISTAN.

HASHEM HAKIMI, A CAREER DIPLOMAT, HAS BEEN APPOINTED AMBASSADOR TO SUDAN. HAKIMI, 52, REPORTEDLY HAS A DIPLOMA FROM THE SCHOOL OF MODERN PHOTOGRAPHY, NEW JERSEY. HE HAS SERVED AT MFA SINCE 1951 IN VARIOUS BUREAUS INCLUDING INFORMATION; SUBCONTINENT; ARAB STATES AND ISRAEL: INFORMATION AND PRESS; PASSPORT AND VISAS AND CULTURAL RELATIONS AND STUDENTS. ABROAD HE HAS SERVED AT KARACHI, CALCUTTA, NEW DELHI, BELGRADE, BAGHDAD, ROME AND OSLO. HIS MOST RECENT POSITION WAS CHIEF OF THE DEPARTMENT FOR INFORMATION AND PRESS AFFAIRS. HE SPEAKS ENGLISH AND FRENCH.
ANY ADDITIONAL INFORMATION WHICH BECOMES AVAILABLE ON THESE TWO AMBASSADORS DURING THEIR TOURS ABROAD WOULD BE APPRECIATED.

SUMMARY: TWO STUDENTS FINED, 40 RELEASED ON BAIL. ONE STUDENT TRIAL POSTPONED. OPPOSITION LEADER HAILS IMPROVED POLITICAL ATMOSHPHERE, BUT QUESTIONS ITS DEPTH. PAHLAVI UNIVERSITY FACULTY URGES PRIME MINISTER TO KEEP ARYAMEHR UNIVERSITY OPEN. EMPRESS SURPRISE VISITOR AT SOUTH TEHRAN WEDDING. END SUMMARY.

PRESS JULY 5 AND 6 REPORTS COURTS FINED TWO ARYAMEHR UNIVERSITY STUDENTS 30,000 RIALS EACH (ABOUT $425) ON CHARGES OF DISTURBING PUBLIC ORDER WHILE DEMONSTRATING ON STREETS. COURT FREED ON BAIL 40 STUDENTS ACCUSED OF UNRULY DEMONSTRATIONS IN TEHRAN, LEGAL AUTHORITIES SAID GROUP HAD BEEN RELEASED PENDING TRIAL.

GOI ALSO ANNOUNCED THAT TRIAL OF 18 STUDENTS OF NARMAK COLLEGE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY WHICH WAS TO HAVE BEGUN JULY 5 HAS BEEN POSTPONED UNTIL LATE SEPTEMBER OR OCTOBER. COLLEGE OFFICIAL TOLD EMBOFF IN CONFIDENCE THAT POLICE HAD MADE HASH OF INVESTIGATION, AND THAT THILE STUDENTS WERE UNDOUBTEDLY GUILTY OF SEVERAL COUNTS OF MALICIOUS DAMAGE (ABOUT HALF A MILLION DOLLARS), CASE PRESENTED TO COURT MIGHT NOT BE VERY SOLID. POSTPONEMENT UNTIL SEPTEMBER WAS PROSECUTOR'S SUGGESTION FOR KEEPING GROUP ON GOOD BEHAVIOR THRU SUMMER AND START OF SCHOOL YEAR.

UNION OF NATIONAL FRONT GROUPS SENIOR FIGURE DR. KARIM SANJABI TOLD LOCAL REUTERS MAN: "THE NEW POLITICAL ATMOSPHERE IS VERY VERY ENCOURAGING AND GIVES US HOPE, BUT WE FEEL THIS MOVEMENT IS NOT AS DEEP AS THEY SAY IT IS. WE'LL HAVE TO WAIT AND SEE WHAT DEVELOPS." (COMMENT: DISPITE DISCLAIMERS, STATEMENT (IF REPORTED CORRECTLY BY FARSI PRESS) IS MORE POSITIVE THAN ANY PREVIOUS PUBLIC OPPOSITION COMMENT OVER PAST FEW MONTHS.)

LETTER FROM PAHLAVI UNIVERSITY FACULTY TO PRIME MINISTER HAS SUPPORTED ARYAMEHR UNIVERSITY'S FACULTY CAMPAIGN TO KEEP TEHRAN CAMPUS OF UNIVERSITY OPEN (SEE REFTEL). LETTER, WHICH MENTIONED IN FARSI PRESS JULY 6, POINTED OUT IRAN WILL NEED 50,000 ENGINEERS OVER COMING YEARS AND SCHOOL IS PRODUCING NEARLY 7,000 PER YEAR. THIS IS FIRST PUBLIC OUTSIDE SUPPORT ARYAMEHR FACULTY HAS PICKED UP IN ITS CAMPAIGN TO KEEP TEHRAN BRANCH OPEN.

ROYAL POLITICS: ALL JULY 5 PAPERS CARRIED REPORT OF EMPRESS FARAH'S "SURPRISE" VISIT TO WEDDING OF A YOUNG TEACHER AND HS BRIDE IN POORER DISTRICT OF SOUTH TEHRAN. EMPRESS HAD HEARD OF THE WEDDING FEW WEEKS EARLIER ON UNANNOUNCED TOUR OF SCHOOLS AND WELFARE CENTERS WHEN GROOM MENTIONED PROBLEM OF FINANCING HIS WEDDING. EMPRESS THEN REPORTEDLY TOLD EDUCATION MINISTER GANJI TO ARRANGE MARRIAGE AND SAID SHE WOULD FOOT THE BILL. EMPRESS CAME ALONE WITHOUT FORMAL COURT PROCEDURES AND GAVE USUAL WEDDING GIFTS, PLUS ADDITIONAL EXTRA OF NEW COLOR TELEVISON SET. (COMMENT: WHILE GIMMICKY, THIS IS LATEST EXAMPLE OF INCREASING ROYAL ATTENTION TO POLITICS BY ROYAL FAMILY.
QUICK REVIEW OF PRESS FOR PAST MONTH INDICATES MORE PUBLICITY GIVEN TO VISITS AND SPEECHES BY SHAH'S BROTHERS AND SISTERS AS WELL AS IMMEDIATE FAMILY.)

1978TEHRAN06510.subject: REPLY TO QADHAFI'S INDEPENDENCE DAY MESSAGE
