1978TEHRAN06552.subject: THE SHAH'S VIEWS OF AFGHANISTAN SUMMARY: SHAH BELIEVES AFGHANISTAN NOW FIRMLY UNDER SOVIET CONTROL. COUP CAME FIVE YEARS EARLY, BEFORE IRAN'

segments.text: SUMMARY: SHAH BELIEVES AFGHANISTAN NOW FIRMLY UNDER SOVIET CONTROL. COUP CAME FIVE YEARS EARLY, BEFORE IRAN'S EASTERN BASES WERE READY. HE EXPECTS SOVIETS TO MOVE SLOWLY, BUT ANTICIPATES EVENTUAL AFGHAN STIMULATION OF THE BALUCHISTAN AND PUSHTUNISTAN ISSUES. SARDAR ABDUL WALI, FORMER KING ZAHIR SHAH'S SON-IN-LAW, WILL BE VISITING IRAN SOON. SHAH PROFESSED NOT TO KNOW PRECISELY WHAT WALI WANTED, BUT THOUGHT PERHAPS IT WOULD BE BETTER FOR HIM TO BE BASED SOMEWHERE ELSE, PERHAPS SAUDI-ARABIA. SHAH REALIZED POSSIBILITIES OF DIRECT COUNTERACTION VIS-A-VIS NEW AFGHAN GOVERNMENT ARE VERY LIMITED. END

DURING MY AUDIENCE WITH THE SHAH ON JULY 9, HE SAID, AS HE HAS BEFORE, THAT THE COUP, ALTHOUGH ANTICIPATED, HAD COME BEFORE EXPECTED. THE KGB HAND WAS CLEAR, BECAUSE WHENEVER BEFORE HAS THE MILITARY IMMEDIATELY HANDED OVER POWER TO THE CIVILIANS? IN THIS INSTANCE HE THOUGHT, OUTSIDERS HAD SO DIRECTED. AFGHANISTAN IS UNDER THE CONTROL OF THE SOVIETS, HE CONCLUDED.

HE EXPECTED THE SOVIETS TO MOVE SLOWLEY; THEY WILL WANT THE CURRENT REGIME TO BE FIRMLY IN POWER BEFORE TAKING FURTHER MOVES. FIRST, WILL COME LAND REFORM ("WHO CAN OPPOSE LAND REFORM-I MYSELF HAVE DONE IT"), BUT THE LAND REFORM WILL UNDERMINE THE POWER OF THE TRADITIONAL TRIBAL LEADERS AND OTHERS. THE RELIGOUS LEADERS WILL BE NEXT AND, IN FACT, ARE BEING DEALT WITH HARSHLY NOW.

AFTER THE REGIME IS WELL ESTABLISHED, IT WILL TURN TO THE BALUCHISTAN AND PUSHTUNISTAN ISSUES. ALSO, IMPLICITY REFERRING TO THE HELMAND WATERS AGREEMENT, "WE HAVE REASON TO BELIEVE THE BBC REPORT ON THE NON-RECOGNITION OF PREVIOUS AGREEMENTS WAS ACCURATE".

THE AFGHANS SAY THEY WANT AID FROM ALL SOURCES, HE SAID, BUT THAT IT IS NATURAL FOR THE SOVIETS TO SUPPORT THIS POSITION. ANY THIRD COUNTRY AID REDUCES THE BURDEN ON THE SOVIETS. HOWEVER, FOR THE PRESENT, THERE WAS NO ALTERNATIVE BUT TO WAIT AND SEE, HE SAID, (AT THE SAME TIME LEAVING NO DOUBT BY HIS GESTURES THAT HE WAS VERY PESSIMISTIC).

IN RESPONSE TO MY QUESTION, HE ADMITTED TO NOT HAVING A CLEAR IDEA NOR MUCH INFORMATION ABOUT THE EXTENT AND ORGANIZATION OF THE OPPOSITION TO TARAKI. THE EXILE OF THE PARCHAMISTS STILL LEFT AFGHANISAN IN THE HANDS OF THE SOVIETS WHO WILL BE PATIENT. HE THEN SAID THAT SARDAR ABDUL WALI, THE SON-IN-LAW OF FORMER KING ZAHIR SHAH, WILL BE VISITING IRAN SOON. THE SHAH SAID THAT HE SAW NO REASON TO DENY THE VISIT WHICH WILL BE HANDLED WITH DISCRETION.
HE DID NOT KNOW WHAT PRECISELY ABDUL WALI WANTED BUT PERHAPS IT WOULD BE BETTER FOR HIM TO SET UP HIS BASE OF OPERATIONS, IF THAT IS WHAT HE WANTED, IN SAUDI ARABIA-ALSO A GOOD MUSLIM COUNTRY.

COMMENT: THERE WAS LITTLE THAT WAS NEW IN THIS PART OF OUR CONVERSATION (EXCEPT THE VISIT OF ABDUL WALI) BUT THE SHAH EMPHASIZED THAT AFGHANISTAN, IN HIS VIEW, IS GONE. AS A PRAGMATIST, HE REALIZED THAT POSSIBILITIES OF DIRECT COUNTERACTION ARE VERY LIMITED AND IS LOOKING AHEAD TO THE NEXT PROBLEM (PAKISTAN). ALTHOUGH HE HAS SLIGHT "I TOLD YOU SO" APPROACH, HE WAS NOT CRITICAL ABOUT US POLICY. AT A LATER POINT HE REFERRED BACK TO AFGHANISTAN AND SAID THAT HIS DEFENSE PLANS WERE FIVE YEARS BEHIND SCHEDULE: THE COUP CAME EARLY AND IRAN'S EASTERN BASES WHERE NOT COMPLETED.
REFTEL ARRIVED AFTER DEPARTURE OF ROSTOW FROM TEHRAN.

1978TEHRAN06624.subject: NEW CENTO POLITICAL GUIDANCE PAPER DURING JULY 10 MEETING, FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY TOLD CHARGE IRAN WILL BE SUBMITTING A NEW POLITICAL GUI

segments.text: DURING JULY 10 MEETING, FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY TOLD CHARGE IRAN WILL BE SUBMITTING A NEW POLITICAL GUIDANCE PAPER FOR CENTO CONSIDERATION SOON. HE DID NOT GO INTO FURTHER DETAILS.

DEPUTY ASSISTANT SECRETARY NOSENZO, ASSISTANT LEGAL ADVISOR BETTAUER AND SCIATT MET WITH AEOI PRESIDENT DR. ETEMAD, VICE PRESDIENT (INTERNATIONAL AFFAIRS) MANZOOR AND LEGAL ADVISOR TABARI ON JULY 8-11 TO CONSIDER OUTSTANDING ISSUES IN DRAFT NUCLEAR COOPERATION AGFEEMENT AND ACCOMPANYING NOTE. REMAINING ISSUES RESOLVED AND DRAFT AGREEMENT AND ACCOMPANYING NOTE INITIALED AD REFERENDUM ON JULY 11. TEXTS ARE BEING HAND CARRIED TO WASHDC.
PRINCIPAL MODIFICATIONS TO NOTE (PARA 3 REFTL) ARE AS FOLLOWS

REPROCESSING MFN (NEW PARA 9 OF NOTE): "NOTWITHSTANDING THE PREVIOUS PARAGRAPHS, WHEN THE NEED ARISES FOR IRAN TO ARRANGE FOR DISPOSITION OF ITS SPENT FEUL, IF THE UNITED STATES HAS, SUBSEQUENT TO THE DATE OF ENTRY INTO FORCE OF THIS AGREEMENT, APPROVED THE REPROCESSING OF ANY OTHER COOPERATING STATE'S SPENT FUEL TO ACCOMMODATE THAT STATE'S FUEL CYCLE MANAGEMENT, THE UNITED STATES WOULD APPROVE REPRECESSING OF IRANIAN SPENT FUEL TO MEET COMPARABLE IRANIAN NEEDS, IN THE UNITED KINGDOM, FRANCE OR OTHER MUTUALLY AGREED STATES UNDER ARRANGEMENTS WHICH PROVIDE IRAN WITH BENEFITS COMPARABLE TO THOSE PROVIDED TO SUCH OTHER STATE AND UNDER TERMS AND CONDITIONS NO LESS FAVORABLE THAN THOSE APPLICABLE TO SUCH OTHER STAE."

RETRANSFER (NEW PARAGRAPH TO BE INSERTED IN NOTE BETWEEN PARA 10 AND 11): "WITH REFERENCE TO ANY MATERIAL, EQUIPMENT OR COMPENENTS TRANSFERRED BY THE UNITED STATES PURSUANT TO THE AGREEMENT, OR PRODUCED THROUGH THE USE THEREOF, THE UNITED STATES WILL ACT ON A TIMELY BASIS ON REQUESTS FROM IRAN FOR AGREEMENT TO TRANSFER SUCH MATERIAL, EQUIPMENT OR COMPONENTS TO OR FROM IRAN.

MOREOVER, THE UNITED STATES INTENDS TO ACT EXPEDITIOUSLY ON ANY REQUEST FOR AGREEMENT TO TRANSFER TO INTERMEDIATE DESTINATIONS FOR PURPOSES OF CONVERSION, ENRICHMENT, FABRICIATION OR OTHER PROCESSING IN THE PREPARATION OF FUEL ELEMENTS FOR USE IN IRAN WHERE SUCH TRANSFERS HAVE BEEN IDENTIFIED IN AN APPLICABLE EXPORT LICENSE APPLICATION. THE UNITED STATES WILL PROMPTLY ADVISE IRAN OF ITS AGREEMENT TO TRANSFER REQUESTS OR OF THE REASONS FOR ANY OTHER ACTION ON SUCH REQUESTS."

GENERAL MFN (SENTENCE ADDED TO END OF PARA 3): "MOREOVER, THE UNITED STATES INTEDNS TO IMPLEMENT THE PROVISIONS OF THE AGREEMENT IN SUCH A MANNER AS TO FACILITATE THE EFFICIENT AND ECONOMIC OPERATION OF IRAN'S NUCLEAR PROGRAM AND THE SATISFACTION OF IRAN'S LEGITIMATE NEEDS FOR TECHNOLOGY TRANSFER."

IMPLEMENTATION (NEW PARAGRAPH TO BE INSERTED IN NOTE BETWEEN PARAGRAPHS 11 AND 12): "THE PARTIES AFFIRM THEIR INTENTION TO IMPLEMENT THE AGREEMENT ANDTHIS NOTE IN GOOD FAITH AND IN A SPIRIT OF CLOSE COOPERATION, IN ACCORDANCE WITH THEIR APPLICABLE TREATIES, NATIONAL LAWS, REGULATION AND LICENSE REQUIREMENTS."

PRINCIPAL MODIFICATIONS TO AGREEMENT (PARA 2 REFTEL) WERE ADDITION OF COMPONENTS AS DEFINED CATEGORY UNDER AGREEMENT WITH PROVISION FOR IAEA AND BACK UP SAFEGURADS, NO-EXPLOSIVE PLEDGE AND U.S. CONSENT FOR RETRANSFER. WE PROPOSED NEW LANGUAGE CONTAINED IN MODEL AGREEMENT ON PROTECTION OF THE INTERNATINAL ENVIRONMENT, BUT IRANIAN SIDE PREFERRED EXISTING LANGUAGE OF ARTICLE 13 OF DRAFT US-IRAN AGREEMENT, NOTING THAT U.S. AND IRAN ALREADY HAVE ACTIVE COOPERATIVE EFFORT IN ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AREA.

U.S. AND IRANIAN PROCEDURES FOR APPROVAL WERE REVIEWED WITH ETEMAD AND MANZOOR. PLAN IS TO SUBMIT TEXTS FOR APPROVAL BY TWO GOVERNMENTS WITH SUBSEQUENT SIGNING OF AGREEMENT IN TEHRAN (IRANIAN PREFERENCE). WE INDICATED THAT U.S. SHOULD BE READY FOR SIGNATURE IN ABOUT ONE MONTH IF ALL NECESSARY ACTIONS WERE TAKEN ON URGENT BASIS. ETEMAD SAID THAT GOI WOULD NEED ABOUT SAME AMOUNT OF TIME. IT WAS AGREED THAT SINCE AGREEMENT IS AD REFERENDUM THERE SHOULD BE MINIMAL PUBLICITY OF MATTER UNTIL OFFICIAL SIGNING. PRESS WOULD BE TREATED ON AN IF ASKED BASIS, ACKNOWLEDGING THAT TEXTS HAVE BEEN AGREED AD REFERENDUM AND WERE NOW BEING CONSIDERED BY TWO GOVERNEMENTS.

1978TEHRAN06681.subject: IRANIAN QUERIES ON MAURITANIA COUP AND OAU CONFERENCE MFA HAS ASKED US FOR OUR ASSESSMENT OF MAURITANIA COUP AS WELL AS RECENT OAU SESSION IN KHARTO UM. APPREC

segments.text: MFA HAS ASKED US FOR OUR ASSESSMENT OF MAURITANIA COUP AS WELL AS RECENT OAU SESSION IN KHARTOUM. APPRECIATE WHATEVER DEPARTMENT CAN PROVIDE IN NEXT FEW DAYS.

AT LUNCHEON MEETING BETWEEN AEOI PRESDENT ETEMAD, VICE PRESDIENT MANZOOR AND DEPUTY ASSISTANT SECRETARY NOSENZO, ASSISTANT LEGAL ADVISOR BETTAUER AND SCIATT, IN CONNECTION WITH NEGOTIATIONS OF NCULEAR COOPERATION AGREEMENT, ETEMAD ENGAGED IN TOUR DU'HORIZON ON NON-PROLIFERATION AREA.

KEY ITEMS DISCUSSED WERE: (A) SOUTH AFRICA: ETEMAD SAID THAT THE HAD HELD TWO DAYS OF DISCUSSIONS WITH ROUX LAST MONTH TO TRY TO CONVINCE ROUX THAT SAG HAS NO CHOICE BUT JOINT NPT IF IT IS TO PREVENT TOTAL ISOLATION, EVEN FROM WESTERN COUNTRIES. WHILE CLEARLY THERE WAS NO GUARANTEE THAT WEST WOULD SUPPORT SAG, PARTICULARLY EC, BEST HOPE FOR SAG WAS TO ADHERE TO NPT. IF SAG HAS NO NUCLEAR WEAPON INTENTIONS, SAG SHOULD HAVE NOTHING TO LOSE AND PERHPAS SOMETHING TO GAIN, I.E., U.S. SUPPORT AND STRONG EVIDENCE OF PEACEFUL INTENTIONS OF SAG NUCLEAR PROGRAM. ETEMAD SAID THAT HE BELIEVED ROUX WAS FINALLY CONVINCED OF ABOVE LOGIC.

ETEMAD WISHED TO KNOAT PROGRESS IF ANY WE WERE ACHIEVEING. NOSENZO TOLD HIM ON CONFIDENTIAL BASIS THAT AMBASSADOR SMITH'S VISIT TO SA HAD BEEN GENERALLY PRODUCTIVE AND THAT THERE WAS POSSIBILITY OF SAG ADHERENCE TO NPT AND ACCEPTANCE OF FULL-SCOPE SAFEGUARDS IN EXCHANGE FOR U.S. NUCLEAR COOPERATION AND SUPPLY GUARANTEES. (B) PAKISTANC ETEMAD SAID THAT IN HIS VIEW PAKS FULLY AWARE OF PURPOSE OF JACOMET MISSION AND WERE IN VERY DIFFICULT POSITION. HE CHARACTERIZED ZIA GOVERNEMENT AS VERY WEAK AND UNABLE TO TAKE REPROCESSING DECISION ON ITS OWN. PAKS WERE PARANOID ABOUT INDIA AND NEEDED TO BE PERSUADED THAT SITUATION HAD CHANGED AND THAT IT SHOULD REASSESS ITS PRIORITIES.

HE SAID THAT GOP HAD BOXED THEMSELVES IN BY INFLATING IMPORTANCE OF REPROCESSING PLANT. HE ADDED THAT IT IS ESSENTIAL THAT PAKS HAVE FACE-SAVING WAY OUT IF FRENCH DECIDE TO CANCEL. HE ADDED THAT FRENCH WERE UNDER GREAT DOMESTIC PRESSURE TO NOT CANCEL AND TO MEET THEIR COMMITMENT. THE SAME WAS TRUE IN IRAQ WITH REGARD TO THE HEW RESEARCH REACTOR AND BOTH TRANSFERS WERE NOT ADDING TO THE STABILIZATION OF THE REGION. U.S. SIDE ANOTED THAT ONE CONCERN OF FRENCH WAS THEIR IMAGE AS RELIABLE SUPPLIER AND THAT WHATEVER MORAL SUPPORT IRAN COULD GEIVE THE FRENCH IN THIS REGARD WOULD BE EHLPFUL. (C) INDIA: U.S.

SIDE GAVE HIGHLIGHTS OF SITUATION WITH INDIA VIS-A-VIS TARAPU AND INDIAN ACCEPTANCE OF FULLSCOPE SAFEGUARDS. ETEMAD SAID THAT HE SAW MOVE OF ROMANI TO DEFENSE MINSTRY AND SETHNA TO DELHI AS FURTHER EVIDENCE THAT INDA UNDER DESAI GOVERNMENT HAD ABONDONED ANY PLANS FOR NUCLEAR WEAPONS DEVELOPMENT. HE WELCOMED U.S. EFFORTS TO ENCOURAGE INDIA-TO ACCEPT CTB AND FULL-SCOPE SAFEGUARDS AS EQUIVALENT NPT COMMITMENT: ETEMAD SAID THAT PROC VERY EAGER TO ACQUIRE NUCLEAR POWER PROGRAM. HE THOUGHT SAFEGUARDS PROBLEM COULD BE WORKED OUT THROUGH FRENCH BILATERAL SAFEGUARDS APPROACH AND COULD BE JUSTIFIED TO INDIA ON BASIS THAT PRC WAS NO MEMBER OF IAEA.

HE OFFERED THAT REACTOR TECHNOLOGY TRANSFER AND APPLICATION CONTROLS, IF ANY, WOULD BE MORE DIFFICULT TO OBTAIN FROM PRC. BASED ON RECENT CONVERSATIONS OF IRANIAN OFFICIALS WITH PRC, ETEMAD FELT THAT THE PRC WAS NOT PARTICULARLY INTERESTED IN JOINING NPT ANYTIME IN NEAR FUTURE SINCE THEY SAW NO PARTICULAR VALUE IN IT AND BECAUSE OF TAIWAN PROBLEM (HE SAID PRC HAD GIVEN INDICATIONS THAT THEY WISHED IAEA SAFEGUARDS TO CONTINUE ON TAIWAN). (E) INFCE: ETEMAD INQUIRED AS TO U.S. VIEW OF ------------------009397 140203Z /62 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 9366 INFO AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PRETORIA SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 6683 EXDIS PROGRESS OF INFCE.

NOSENZO SAID THAT WITH THE POSSIBLE EXCEPTION OF WORKING GROUP 3, WHICH HAD BECOME OVERLY POLITICAL, ALL OTHER WORKING GROUPS SEEM TO BE MOVING WELL THROUGH FIRST PHASE OF BASICALLY DATA COLLECTION. SECOND YEAR WOULD BE CRITICAL IN PULLING EXERCISE TOGETHER. U.S. WAS NO EXPECTING MIRACLES. HOWEVER, WE WERE LOOKING TOWARD CONSENSUS BY PARTICIPANTS THAT

MOST COUNTRIES DID NOT NEED FULL FUEL CYCLE CAPABILITIES AND COULD GET ALONG QUITE WELL WITH SERVICES, AND (2) SENSITIVE FACILITIES REPRESENTED A SIGNIFICANT PROLIFERATION RISK THAT WAS DIFFICULT TO CONTROL WITH AGENCY SAFEGUARDS ALONE. SOLUTION IS TO BUILD SUCH FACILITIES TO EXTENT POSSIBLE, AND TO LOCATE NEW FACILITIES IN SAFEST POSSIBLE PLACES. ANY NEW PLANTS SHOULD UTILIZE SAFEST TECHNOLOGY AVAILABLE, AND BE MULTINATIONAL, BOTH TO ENSURE ADDITIONAL POLITICAL BARRIERS TO DIVERSION OR ABROGATION AND TO ALLOW GREATER GUARANTEE OF ACCESS TO SERVICES BY PARTICPATING COUNTRIES.

WHILE WE COULD ARGUE OVER QUESTION OF WHEN REPROCESSING MAY BE NEEDED ECONOMICALLY, ABOVE PRINCIPLES PROVIDED REASONABLE BASIS FOR HARMONIZING POLICIES AND PROGRAMS OF U.S., EURATOM, IRAN AND OTHER COUNTRIES. ETEMAD SAID HE FULLY AGREED AND FELT MOST COUNTRIES WOULD GO ALONG WITH THE CONCEPT, PROVIDED THAT ACCESS TO SERVICES WAS AVAILABLE WITH REASONABLE CERTAINTY. HE SAID HE BELIEVED THIS WAS A REALISTIC AND ACHIEVABLE OUTCOME OF INFCE AND HE PERSONALLY COULD SUPPORT THIS POSITION. (F) FUEL BANK: IN RESPONSE TO ETEMAD'S QUERY CONCERNING WHAT MIGHT BE DONE WITH WORKING GROUP 3, U.S.

SIDE BRIEFLY DISCUSSED CONCEPT OF FUEL BANK IN CONTEXT OF PROVIDING GUARANTEES OF FRONT END SUPPLY YO VENCOURAGE COUNTRIES NOT TO DEVELOP INDIGENOUS ENRICHMENT AND PREPROCESSING, AND NOTED THAT CURRENT U.S. IDEA WAS FOR A SMALL BANK. ETEMAD SAID THAT THIS MADE THE MOST SENSE TO HIM AND THAT LARGE BANK WAS UNNECESSARY TO GUARANTEE FUEL SUPPLY IN HOPEFULLY ISOLATED AND SHORT TERM SITUATIONS.

1978TEHRAN06697.subject: POLITCAL ACTIVITY: THIRD WING SPEAKS, LAWYERS ELECT PROGRESSIVE LEADER, ELECTORAL LISTS BEING PREPARED, NEW DEMONSTRATION LAW

segments.text: SUMMARY: RESURGENCE PARTY'S THIRD WING HAS CRITICIZED GOI ECONOMIC EFFORTS AND CALLED FOR NEW MEASURES WHICH HAVE DRAWN FIRE FROM FINANCE MINISTER YEGANEH. SUBSURFACE POLITICAL ACTIVITY CONTINUES AS PARLIAMENTARY MEMBERS QUIETLY MANEUVER TOWARD RASTIKHIZ WING AND OTHER ALLEGIANCES. BAR ASSOCIATION ELECTS HASSAN NAZIEH, PROGRESSIVE, AS NEW CHEIF. NEW JURISTS ASSOCIATION SAYS IT WILL BE CONSTITUTIONAL WATCHDOG. PRIME MINISTER SAYS GOVERNMENT WILL PRESENT NEW LAW TO MAJLES SETTING GROUND RULES FOR POLITICAL ASSICIATIONS AND LEGAL DEMONSTRATION WHICH WILL TAKE INTO ACCOUNT NEW POLITICAL ATMOSPHERE. END SUMMARY.

RESURGENCE PARTY'S THIRD WING ISSUED SET OF ANTIINFLATIONARY AND OTHER ECONOMIC PROPOSALS ON JULY 10 WHICH CALLED, INTER ALIA, FOR REDUCING GOI CREDITS FOR CONSUMPTION AND INCREASING THEM FOR PRODUCTION, DISSOVLING THE GUILD'S CHAMBERS, ENDING IMPORT MONOPOLIES AND REVISING TAX POLICY TO REMOVE PRESSURE ON SALARY EARNERS (COMPENSATING FOR THIS BY INCREASING TAXES ON THE RICH AND ON TAX EVADERS). GUILDS IMMEDIATELY CRITICIZED WING'S PROPOSALS AND JULY 12, ECONOMICS AND FINANCE MINISTER YEGANEH CASTIGATED REPORT WHILE IMPLICITLY ACCEPTING SUGGESTION TO HUNG DOWN TAX EVADERS AND GO AFTER THE WEALTHY. YEGANEH SAID ONLY 12,000 OF 30,000 COMPANIES IN IRAN HAD ANY TAX RECORDS AND SITUATION WOULD BE STRAIGHTENED OUT.

YEGANEH CRITICIZED SUGGESTION FOR TAX CUTS AND REVISED GOI CREDIT POLICY, SAYING THESE WOULD STUNT NATIONAL ECONOMY. HE NOTED GOI HAD CUT INFLATION RATE FROM 30.8 TO 10.1 PER CENT FROM MAY 1977 TO MAY 1978. WING LEADER NAHAVANI SAID HE WAS PLEASED GROUP'S REPORT HAD TRIGGERED DEBATE.

SUBSTANTIAL JOCKEYING BELOW SURFACE CONTINUES WITH MAJLES DEPUTIES CHOOSING WING ALLEGIANCES THEN CHANGING THEIR MINDS. SURVEY BY EMBASSY ON BASIS LOCAL REPORTS AND PERSONAL CONTACTS GIVES THE FOLLOWING VERY ROUGH BREAKDOWN OF CURRENT WING ALIGNMENTS OF MAJLES DEPUTIES (THESE ARE HOWEVER, SUBJECT OT CHANGE ON SHORT NOTICE): CONSTRUCTIVE 140, PROGRESSIVE 50, THIRD WING 40, PAN IRANIST (PEZESHKPOUR) 7, OTHER OR NONE 31. THERE HAS BEEN SOME EROSION FROM THIRD WING TOTAL SINCE SURVEY PREPARED AS SOME DEPUTIES HAVE REPORTEDLY DEFECTED IN WAKE OF CRITICISM OF WING REPORT. ALLEGIANCES ARE NOT RPT NOT OFTEN MADE PUBLIC. SITUATION IS INDICATIVE OF FLUID STATE OF CURRENT POLITICAL DISCUSSION.

EMBASSY HAS HAD CONFIRMATION FROM SEVERAL SOURCES OF GOI'S INTENT TO ALLOW ALL WHO WISH TO RUN FOR PARLIAMENT TO DO SO (REFTEL) IN EFFECT REMOVING RESURGENCE PARTY AS SCREENING DEVICE. SOURCE CLOSE TO AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI TOLD US SHAH HAD CONFIRMED TO RELIGIOUS LEADERS THAT ANYONE COULD RUN, NOTING THAT KHOMEINI FACTION HAD ALREADY STARTED PREPARING ELECTORAL LIST EVEN WHILE ITS LEADERS WERE DECRYING OF ELECTIONS. SHARIATMADARI GROUP EXPECTED TO DO SAME THING OVER COMING MONTHS, AND UNION OF NATIONAL FRONT GROUPS WILL NOT BE FAR BEHIND. WE HAVE HEARD THAT SHARIATMADARI GROUP DISTRUSTS EX-NATIONAL FRONT LEADERSHIP; HENCE THERE WILL BE PROBLEMS WITH POTENTIAL ELECTORAL ALLIANCES.

ON JULY 11, IRANIAN BAR ASSOCIATION EXECUTIVE COUNCIL ELECTED HASSAN NAZIEH, PROGRESSIVE CANDIDATE, AS ITS ------------------010590 140338Z /14 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 9369 INFO USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY LONDON SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 06697 CHAIRMAN, (INDEPENDENT ABDOL KARIM ANVARI AND PROGRESSIVE HEDAYATOLLAH MATIN-DAFTARI WERE CHOSEN VICE CHAIRMEN, AND PROGRESSIVES SAREMEDDIN SADEGH-VAZIRI AND MOHAMMAD-TAGHI DAMGHANI WERE VOTED AS PROSECUTORS). FOLLOWING DAY, NAZIEH ANNOUNCED THAT BAR ASSOCIATION WILL STRIVE FOR TOTAL INDEPENDENCE OF JUDICIARY AND EXTENSION OF INDIVIDUAL FREEDOM.

IRANIAN ASSOCIATION OF JURISTS (IAJ) ANNOUNCED SIMILAR GOALS, INCLUDING ABOLITION OF ALL SPECIAL COURTS (SUCH AS THE CIVIL SERVANTS' COUNCIL) OUTSIDE THE JUDICIAL SYSTEM. ASSOCIATION HELD ITS FIRST MEETING JULY 9 AND ELECTED 21-MAN CENTRAL COUNCIL, INCLUDING SEVEN OF EIGHT PROGRESSIVES WHO ALSO HOLD BAR ASSOCIATION EXECUTIVE COUNCIL SEATS. IAJ SPOKESMAN SAID IAJ AND BAR ASSOCIATION WOULD REMAIN COMPLETELY SEPARATE. IAJ PLANS TO ESTABLISH INTERNATIONAL CONTACTS IN INTEREST OF FURTHERING RULE OF LAW. ALL OF ABOVE REPORTED SUBSTANTIALLY IN PRESS.

IN PRESS CONFERENCE JULY 10, FOLLOWING CABINET MEETING, PRIME MINISTER COVERED SEVERAL ROUTINE ITEMS THEN DROPPED BOMBSHELL THAT MINISTRY OF JUSTICE WOULD PRESENT BILL TO FALL MAJLES SESSION CONCERNING LEGAL FRAMEWORK FOR POLITICAL ASSOCIATIONS AND DEMONSTRATIONS. PM SAID BILL WOULD PROBABLY CONTAIN PROVISION FOR NOTIFICAION OF MEETING/RALLY, NAMES OF ORGANIZERS, DATE, HOUR AND PLACE, BUT PROVISIONS NOT YET DRAFTED. NEWS WAS HEADLINED IN FARSI PRESS BUT RECEIVED SHORT INSIDE PAGE COVERAGE IN FRENCH AND ENGLISH PAPERS.

PM SAID "THERE IS NO POINT TALKING ABOUT AN OPEN POLITICAL ATMOSPHERE UNLESS WE CREATE THE RIGHT INSTITUTIONS AND LAWS GIVING IT A MORE SOLID FOUNDATION." THIS COMMENT HAS SPARKED LIVELY DISCUSSION ON SUBJECT WHETHER BILL WILL BE LIBERAL OR RESTRICTIVE. INITIAL OPINION LEANS TOWARD IDEA THAT IT WILL REFLECT GOI'S INTENTION TO OPEN UP POLITICAL ATMOSHPHERE BY SETTING REASONABLE STAGE AND RULES FOR NEXT YEAR'S PARLIAMENTARY CAMPAIGN.

1978TEHRAN06721.subject: RESURGENCE PARTY DEFECTIONS SIGNAL POLITICAL SHIFTS

segments.text: SUMMARY: SEVERAL RESURGENCE PARTY (RPPI) OFFICIALS HAVE RESIGNED OVER PAST WEEK. BACKROOM POLITICAL DISCUSSIONS AND RUMORS OF PROJECTED SHIFTS ARE WIDESPREAD. END SUMMARY.

RPPI DEPUTY SECRETARY GENERAL MOHAMMAD REZA AMELI-TEHRANI RESIGNED JULY 12 BECAUSE HE CLAIMED PARTY EXECUTIVIDES DID NOT LISTEN TO HIS ADVICE. HIS RESIGNATION, MADE PUBLIC JULY 15, SAID HE HAD PROPOSED A SET OF SOLUTIONS TO PARTY PROBLEMS WHICH HAD NOT BEEN GIVEN ENOUGH CONSIDERATION BY THE PARTY ORGANIZATTION. AMELI-TEHRANI IS A FORMER VICE CHAIRMAN OF THE (RIGHT WING) PAN IRANIST PARTY (PIP), WHICH WAS RECENTLY REVIVED BY MAJLES DEPUTY MOHSEN PEZESHKPOUR (REF A).

SPECULATION HAS BEEN GROWING OVER PAST FEW WEEKS THAT AMELI-TEHRANI MIGHT RETURN TO HIS OLD POST, AND PEZESHKPOURTOLD LOCAL PRESS AFTER RESIGNATION ANNOUNCED THAT HE WAS "EAGERLY WAITING" TO SEE HIS FORMER COLLEAGUE RETURN TO THE PIP TRENCHES. AMELI-TEHRANI HAS NOT INDICATED WHAT HE WILL DO, BUT SAID HE STANDS READY TO DISCUSS HIS RESIGNATION"IN DETAIL" WITH RPPI OFFICIALS IF ASKED.

SEVERL LESSER RPPI OFFICIALS HAVE ALSO RESIGNED FOR SIMILAR REASONS. MOST NOTABLE DEFECTIONS ARE THOSE OF EAST AZARBAIJAN PARTY SECRETARY AND KERMANSHAH PARTY CHIEF, WHO BOTH QUIT WITHIN PAST TEN DAYS. SOURCE CLOSE TO PRIME MINISTER'S OFFICE (PM IS ALSO RPPI HEAD) AND OTHERS BELIEVE THERE WILL PROBABLY BE MORE DEFECTIONS FROM IRAN'S SINGLE PARTY AS MORE PEOPLE BELIEVE GOI IS SERIOUS ABOUT LETTING "NON-OFFICIAL"(I.E., NON-RPPI) CANDIDATES RUN FOR MAJLES AND SENATE POSTS NEXT YEAR. EFFECT OF GOI'S ACTIONS HAVE BEEN TO REMOVE OFFICIAL MANTLE FROM RPPI AND OPEN WAY TO FURTHER DEFECTIONS.

WHILE RPPI IS SOMEWHAT DISPIRITED AT MOMENT, IT STILL REMAINS MAJOR FEATURE OF POLITICAL LANDSCAPE. NUMBER OF SOURCES WITH VARYING RPPI CONNECTIONS AT SEVERAL LEVELS HAVE SUGGESTED THAT RPPI WOULD HAVE TO "GET ITS ACT TOGETHER" (REF B) IF IT WERE TO COMPETE SUCCESSFULLY IN OPEN ELECTIONS WHERE IT DID NOT HAVE VETO ON CANDIDATES AS IT DID IN 1975. PRESENT DEFECTIONS SHOULD BE SEEN AS NECESSARY PART OF SHAKEDOWN AND REALIGNMENT IN RESPONSE TO EMERGING PERCEPTIONS THAT RULES OF POLITICAL GAME IN IRAN ARE CHANGING.

POLITICAL TALK HAS ACCELERATED DRAMATICALLY IN PAST FEW WEEKS, AND EACH EVENING BRINGS FRESH WAVES OF RUMORS OF POTENTIAL REALIGNMENTS, DEFECTIONS FROM RPPI, FORMATION OF NEW GROUPS, ETC. (REF C). OF INTEREST IS THAT WITH EXCEPTION OF EMERGENCE OF "THIRD WING" OF RPPI, DISCUSSION TO DATE HAS CENTERED AROUND NUCLEI OF OLDER GROUPS-NATIONAL FRONT, PAN-IRANISTS, TOILERS, AND RELIGIOUS GROUPS. DESPITE TALK OF EMERGENT NEW FORCES, THUS FAR DISCUSSIONS HAS LOOKED LIKE NEW WINE IN OLD BOTTLES--RPPI. THE WAY IS STILL OPEN FROM SOME NEW EVOLUTION, BUT TO DATE OPPOSITIONIST POLITICIANS SEEM TO HAVE CONFINED THEMSELVES TO OLD FORMS, WHILE "ESTABLISHMENT"FIGURES ARE STICKING TO THE RPPI BUT PROMOTING SOME NEW RHETORIC.

1978TEHRAN06750.subject: BAR ASSOCIATION CALLS FOR CIVILIAN TRIALS OF "POLITICAL" PRISONERS

segments.text: REPORTER (WHICH ALSO PUBLISHED IN FARSI PRESS), MAIN THRUST OF WHICH IS THAT BAR ASSOCATION WILL BE MORE ACTIVE GROUP IN COMING YEAR. PROJECTED ACTIVITIES INCLUDE MORE COUNCIL MEETINGS, A MONTHLY REPORT TO THE COUNTRY'S LAWYERS, PROSECTION OF CORRUPT LAWYERS, AND ATTACKS ON BUREAUCRATIC RED TAPE.

AS IF TO UNDERLINE ABOVE, PRESS JUNE 17 CARRIED STORY THAT 50 MEMBERS OF PROGRESSIVE LAWYERS GROUP HAVE OFFERED TO DEFEND 24 STUDENTS CHARGED WITH VIOLENT DESTRUCTION WHO WILL GO ON TRIAL IN SARI, JULY 30.

COMMENT: TO BEST OF OUR KNOWLEDGE THIS IS FIRST TIME PRESS HAS USED TERM "POLITICAL PRISONERS" SO EXTENSIVELY AND IN SENSE IT IS BEING USED BY OPPOSITIONIST ELEMENTS. USUAL STORIES HAVE INCLUDED REFERENCES TO "ANTI-STATE HOOLIGANS" OR SIMILAR TERMS. COUPLE OF LAWYERS HAVE HINTED THAT EVEN MINISTRY OF JUSTICE PRIVATELY FAVORS RETURN OF SECURITY TRIALS TO CIVILIAN COURTS. ISSUE AS POSED BY NAZIEH LIKELY TO EVOLVE THROUGH BAR ASSOCIATION PRESENTATION AND WORK ITS WAY INTO GOVERNMENTAL SYSTEM. WE WOULD NOT EXPECT IMMEDIATE ACTION ON THIS PROPOSAL, AND WOULD NOT WANT TO LOBBY PRECIPITATELY FOR IT.

MIGHT BE USEFUL, HOWEVER, FOR DEPT TO POINT OUT TO ICJ OR AMNESTY THAT HERE IS LOCAL PEG ON WHICH TO HANG THEIR EFFORTS IN THIS DIRECTION. RECENT PRESS STORIES, INCLUDING EXTENDED COVERAGE GIVEN TO PROGRESSIVE LAWYERS AND FRACTIOUS MAJLES SESSIONS, ARE GOOD EXAMPLE OF WAY INTERNAL PUBLIC DEBATE HAS OPENED UP OVER PAST FIVE-SIX WEEKS.

1978TEHRAN06762.subject: HOST GOVERNMENT PUBLIC REACTION TO SOVIET TALKS

segments.text: RECENT TRIALS AND SENTENCINGS OF SOVIET DISSIDENTS RECEIVED WIDESPREAD PLAY IN IRANIAN MEDIA, PARTICULARLY THE PRESS. SO ALSO DID PRESIDENT'S AND SECRETARY'S STATEMENTS ON THE ISSUE, AS WELL AS COMMENTARY BY VARIOUS WESTERN NEWS COLUMNISTS AND OTHERS. SO FAR, HOWEVER, THER HAS BEEN NO IRANIAN COMMENT NOR EDITORIALS. NEWSPAPERS IN IRAN, WHILE CONSIDERABLY MORE INDIVIDUALISTIC THAN BEFORE, ARE STILL EXPECTED TO FOLLOW GOVERNMENT POLICY IN FOREIGN AFFARIS AND DEFENSE MATTERS AND ANY COMMENT THEY MIGHT HAVE MADE WOULD ALMOST CERTAINLY HAVE BEEN INTERPRETED BY EVERYBODY AS GOVERNMENT COMMENT.

WHILE THE GOVERNMENT DOES NOT HESITATE TO GIVE ITS OPINION ON SOMETHING DIRECTLY RELATING TO IRANIAN INTERESTS OR RELATIONS WITH THE SOVIET UNION, THIS ISSUE WAS PROBABLY SEEN AS SOMETHING IRANIAN GOVERNMENT WOULD DO WELL TO STAY OUT OF. THE GOI'S SILENCE IS PROBABLY ATTRIBUTABLE TO ITS TRADITIONALLY CAUTIOUS APPROACH TO INTERNAL MATTERS OF ALL STATES AND THE SOVIET UNION IN PARTICULAR.

AS POSSIBLE INDICATION OF INHIBITING FACTOR WOULD BE PERSONAL COMMENT MADE TO ONE EMB OFFICER BY MFA DEPARTMENT HEAD PRIVATELY. HE WONDERED WHY USG FELT IT HAD THE RIGHT TO TELL SOVIET UNION IT COULD NOT BRING SOME OF ITS CITIZENS TO TRIAL. ALTHOUGH EMB OFFICER PRESENTED THE SUITABLE COUNTERARGUMENTS, INCLUDING THE RELEVANCE OF THESE CASES TO AN AGREEMENT SIGNED BY THE SOVIET UNION, THE NATURE OF THE INQUIRY WAS REVEALING.

1978TEHRAN06804.subject: MID-LEVEL GOI VIEW OF POLITICAL LIBERALIZATION SUMMARY: MID-LEVEL GOI OFFICIALS VIEW PROJECTED DEMONSTRATION LAW AS NECESSARY AND LIBERAL. GOI PREPA RED TO LET

segments.text: SUMMARY: MID-LEVEL GOI OFFICIALS VIEW PROJECTED DEMONSTRATION LAW AS NECESSARY AND LIBERAL. GOI PREPARED TO LET PARLIAMENT DEBATE NEW ELECTORAL LAW AND OPERATE UNDER OLD ONE IF MAJLIS CANNOT AGREE. PRIME MINISTER MOVING TO STRENGTHEN HIS HOLD OVER RESURGENCE PARTY. INTERIOR MINISTRY PLEAANTLY SURPRISED BY NEW SAVAK CHIEF. DECENTRALIZATION WILL MOVE ALONG SLOWLY AS PROVINCIAL GOVERNORS BEGIN TO TRAIN THEIR MEN. PLAN AND BEDGET ORGANIZATION TO HAVE PROVINCIAL ROLE. END SUMMARY.

MID-LEVEL INTERIOR MINISTRY OFFICIAL WHO IS PERSONAL ALLY OF PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR AND HAS BEEN CLOSE PERSONAL FRIEND OF EMBOFF FOR THREE YEARS GAVE FOLLOWING VIEWS OF RECENT POLITICAL LIBERALIZATION WHICH HE SAYS ARE HELD BY MOST UPPER AND MIDDLE LEVEL INTERIOR MINISTRY OFFICIALS AND MANY OTHERS.

NEW DEMONSTRATION LAW-INTERIOR MINISTRY BILL TO BE PRESENTED TO NEW MAJLIS SESSION IN EARLY SEPTEMBER IS ABSOLUTELY NECESSARY TO PAVE THE WAY FOR THE NEXT YEAR'S ELECTORAL CAMPAIGN. GOI INTENDS FOR THAT LAW TO BE HOUSEKEEPING DEVICE TO FACILITATE MANAGEMENT OF INCREASED POLITICAL ACTIVITY. LAW WILL BE DRAFTED TO PROVIDE FOR NOTIFICATION OF DEMONSTRATIONR MEETING, NAME OF GROUP, EXPECTED NUMBERS PARTICIPATING, AND ROUTE OF ANY PROJECTED PARADE. LAW IS NOT INTENDED TO BE USED AS REPRESSIVE DEVICE BUT AS LEGAL FOUNDATION TO MANAGE LARGE MEETINGS AND DEMONSTRATIONS, TO AVOID VIOLENCE OR CONTROL IT WITH MINIMUM ADVERSE CONSEQUENCES. SOURCE EXPECTED MAJLIS WOULD PASS BILL FAIRLY SWIFTLY.

ELECTORAL LAW-AFTER VARIOUS CRITICISMS WERE LEVELED AT INTERIOR MINISTRY'S PROPOSED ELECTORAL LAW, GOI IS CONTENT TO SIT BACK AND LET PARLIAMENT SORT OUT ITS OWN PRIORITIES. SOURCE NOTED THAT GOI HAS STATED THAT ELECTIONS WILL BE HELD UNDER OLD LAW IF MAJLIS CANNOT AGREE ON NEW ONE. INTERIOR MINISTRY FEELS AGREEMENT WILL BE LIKELY SOMETIME IN FALL OF 1978 AFTER MAJLIS DEPUTIES HAVE MILKED ISSUE FOR WHAT IT'S WORTH.

RESURGENCE PARTY (RPPI) AFFAIRS-CONSTRUCTIVE WING LEADER MOINI WILL BE A "POLITICAL DISASTER", BUT IT DOESN'T MAKE ANY DIFFERENCE SINCE HUSHANG ANSARY IS REAL FORCE IN CONSTRUCTIVE WING. ANSARY CAN BE EXPECTED TO SET POLICY AND USE WING AS HIS STEPPING STONE TO PLACE IN ACTIVE POLITICS. PROGRESSIVE WING LEADER MOJDEHI WHO WAS CHANCELLOR OF FERDOWSI UNIVERSITY IN MASHAD IS A FAIRLY DYNAMIC INDIVIDUAL WHO HAS BEEN GIVEN A MANDATE BY PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR TO MAKE PROGRESSIVE WING AN ACTIVE AGENT OF PRIME MINISTER'S POLICIES. MOJDEHI WILL WORK CLOSELY WITH AMOUZEGAR AND PROGRESSIVE WING LIKELY TO REPRESENT PRIME MINISTER'S VIEWS.

SOURCE DESCRIBED NAHAVANDI AND THIRD WING AS EFFORT WHICH IS BEING BACKED BY SHAH "TO STIR UP THE POLITICAL FIRES A BIT". NAHAVANDI HAS COURT BACKING FOR HIS EFFORTS TO STIMULATE DEBATE, AND HIS GROUP IS SOMEWHAT CLOSED. PEOPLE WHO WISH TO JOIN ARE GIVEN A PRETTY THOROUGH GRILLING AND MUST QUALIFY AS "INTELLECTUALS" IN SOME FASHION. SOURCE THOUGHT OPEINING UP OF POLITICAL SYSTEM WOULD RESULT IN HUNDREDS OF PARTIES AND THOUGHT PROBLEM OF KEEPING UP WITH SHIFTING ELECTORAL ALLIANCES WOULD SEVERELY TAX LOCAL POLITICAL REPORTERS, LET ALONE SOME EMBASSYIES.

(COMMENT: SOURCE IS CLOSE FRSIEND AND CONFIDANT OF AMOUZEGAR AND CAN BE EXPECTED TO PUT PRIME MINISTER'S CASE IN BEST LIGHT. NEVERTHELESS, SOURCE SEEMS CONFIDENT THAT PRIME MINISTER WILL BE ABLE TO USE RPPI MECHANISM, PARTICULARLY PROGRESSIVE WING, TO EVENUTALLY GARNER SUBSTANIAL POLITICAL SUPPORT.)

SAVAK-INTERIOR MINISTRY OFFICIALS, INCLUDING SOURCE, HAVE BEEN PLEASED AND IN SOMECASES SURPRISED WITH WORK OF NEW SAVAK CHIEF MOGHADDAM. SOURCE DESCRIBED MOGHADDAM AS VERY INTELLIGENT, MUCH WISER THAN HIS PREDECESSOR, AND ENERGETIC. INTERIOR MINISTRY HAS ALREADY SEEN SOME POSITIVE RESULSTS OF HIS ADMINISTRATION INCLUDING GREATER COOPERATION WITH SAVAK.

DECENTRALIZATION-SOURCE HAD JUST FINISTHED PARTICIPATING IN EXTENDED CONFERENCE OF PRIVINCIAL GOVERNORS. HE SAID DECENTRALIZATION WAS MOVING SLOWLY BUT DEFINITELY MOVING. GOVERNORS WERE PRECEEDING VERY CAUTIOUSLY AND HAD AGREED TO ESTABLISHMENT OF DEPUTY GOVERNOR GENERAL FOR MANAGEMENT AND PROGRAMS. THESE POSITIONS WILL BE FILLED BY MANAGEMENT EXPERTS FROM THE PLAN AND BUDGET ORGANIZATION WHICH WILL THEN BE DIRECTLY INVOLVED IN DECENTRALIZATION. SOURCE SAID GOVERNORS HAD AGREED TO SEVERAL OTHER MINOR MEASURES WHICH THEY HAD BALKED AT LASTYEAR. DECENTRALIZATION WOULD ONLY WORK IF PERSONNEL WERE WELL TRAINED. THIS WAS WHY INTERIOR MINISTRY WAS MOVING SLOWLY AND GETTING AS MANY PEOPLE AS POSSIBEL BEHIND MOVES BEFORE THEY WERE TAKEN.
SOURCE THOUGHT INVOLVEMENT OF PBO OFFICIALS WHOULD HASTEN DECENTRALIZATION BY PROVIDING INCREASED EXPERTS AND ONE EXTRA BODY AT PROVINCIAL LEVEL.
YORK 2343

CHARGE AND POLCOUNS CALLED ON MFA UNDER SECRETARY NADIM JULY 18 TO DISCUSS FORTHCOMING BELGRADE NAM MEETING. NADIM WAS AWARE OF CURRENT USG INTEREST IN LIMITING CUBAN ROLE, AN INTEREST WHICH GOI SHARES. DISCUSSION OF VARIOUS POINTS IN REFTELS WAS ABSORBED BY NADIM WHO SAID HE WOULD REPORT HIGHER (I.E., TO THE SHAH). NADIM SAID THAT WHILE GOI HAS DONE NOTHING VIS-A-VIS ANY OTHER GOVERNMENT IN REGARD TO NAM CONFERENCE SO FAR, IT MAY BE THAT AFTER BEING APPRISED OF OUR OWN EFFORTS GOI WOULD WISH TO BE MORE ACTIVE.

NADIM INFORMED US GOI IS PLANNING TO SEND AN OFFICIAL (DABIRI MFA INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS DEPARTMENT) TO BE PRESENT IN BELGRADE DURING CONFERENCE. ARRANGEMENTS HAVE BEEN MADE CONFIDENTIALLY FOR YOUGOSLAVS TO BRIEF HIM DAILY SO THAT HE CAN REPORT CONFERENCE EVENTS TO TEHRAN. NADIM BRIEFLY REVIEWED GOI'S UNHAPPY EXPERIENCE WITH NAM. HAVING BEEN REFUSED ENTRANCE TO NAM CONFERENCE IN PERU, AND BEEN GIVEN DUSTY ANSWER BY SRI LANKA GOVERNMENT TO INQUIREY WHEN NAM WAS MEETING IN COLOMBO, GOI HAS GIVEN UP AMBITIONS TO PARTICIPATE -EVEN THOUGH IT CONSIDERS ITSELF MORE TRULY NON ALIGNED THAN SOME NAM PARTICIPANTS, E.G. THE CUBANS.

SPEAKING MORE GENERALLY, NADIM NOTED UNFORTUNATE FACT THAT EGYPT'S STANDING IN NAM COUNCILS HAS FALLEN OF LATE. THIS WOULD SUGGEST LITTLE CHANGE THAT ANY EGYPTIAN INIATIVE AGAINST CUBA WOULD BE EFFECTIVE. MUCH MORE EFFECTIVE SPONSORS OF ANY SUCH MOVE WOULD BE YUGOSLAVS OR POSSIBLE INDIANS.

1978TEHRAN06817.subject: IRANIANS CONSIDERING CLOSING EMBASSY IN ADDIS ABABA

segments.text: AT CHARGE'S INSTRUCTION, POLCOUNS UNDERTOOK TO PASS ESSENTIALS OF MESSAGE ADDIS ABABA REFTEL TO MFA DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR ASIA AND AFRICA SANANDAJI JULY 18. TREADING CAREFULLY, HE NOTED EMB ADDIS ABABA CONSIDERS ETHIOPIANS QUITE CAPABLE OF HARASSING FOREIGN DIPLIMATIC MISSIONS AS THEY HAD SUDANESE AND SOMALIS IN EARLY 1977 BUT SUCH HARASSING TENDED TO BE OVERT, UNSUBTLE AND ACCOMPANIED BY PRESS CAMPAIGN. U.S. EMB HAD NOT NOTICED SPECIAL HARASSMENT OF IRANIAN MISSION, AND SOME OF THE ADMINISTRATIVE DIFFICULTIES DESCRIBED BY IRANIANS ARE EXPERIENCED BY OTHER EMBASSIES IN ADDIS.

ON THE CONTRARY, EMB IN ADDIS CONSIDERED CONTINUED IRANIAN PRESENSE VERY USEFUL FROM POINT OF VIEW OF FREE WORLD INTERESTS, PARTICULARLY IN VIEW OF SOME CHINKS APPEARING IN HERETOFORE SOLID MENGISTU RELATIONSHIP WITH SOVIETS AND CUBANS. HE NOTED SERIOUSNESS OF ANY MOVE TO CLOSE EMBASSY AND DIFFICULTY REOPENING IT ONCE CLOSED.

IN PASSING, POLCOUNS MADE REFERENCE TO BATTLE FATIGUE WHICH CAN SOMETIMES AFFLICT AMERICAN AS OTHER DIPLOMATS IN DIFFICULT SITUATIONS. HE ASKED IF ARIANIAN CHARGE HAD BEEN IN ETHIOPIA A LONG TIME. SANANDAJI IMMEDIATELY REPLIED CHARGE HAD BEEN THERE LONG TIME,THROUGH THE WAR, AND WAS VERY GOOD, VERY INTELLIGENT MAN. HE SAID ONE THING SURPRISED IRANIANS. THEY WOULD HAVE UNDERSTOOD SOME HARASSMENT AT HEIGHT OF OGADEN FIGHTING, BUT IT WAS SURPRISING TO HAVE IT HAPPEN NOW.

WHEN POLCOUNS ASKED IF PERHAPS ETHIOPIANS DID NOT RELAIZE THE WAY SITUATION WAS BEING INTERPRETED BY IRANIANS, SANANDAJI REPLIED DIRECT OFFICIAL CONVERSATION HAD TAKEN PLACE ON THIS SUBJECT IN ADDIS, AND ETHIOPIANS ANSWERED CALLING IRAN "AN ENEMY STATE."

SANANDAJI IN TURN ASKED IF AMERICAN EMB HAD DISCUSSED SITUATION WITH IRANIANS IN ADDIS BEFORE REPLYING. POLCOUNS SAID HE DID NOT THINK SO, PERHAPS IN VIEW OF BUSY LOCAL SCENE, BUT HE KNEW EMB HAD VERY GOOD RELATIONS WITH IRANIAN EMB.
SANANDAJI SAID HE WOULD REPORT OUR REPLY UPWARDS.

COMMENT: IT MAY BE THAT SANANDAJI WILL MULL OVER CONVERSATION IN PROCESS OF REPORTING IT AND PERCEIVE WHAT WE WERE TRYING TO TELL HIM. WE ARE NOT SURE OF HOW SENSITIVE HIS ANTENNAE ARE, HOWEVER, AND IT WOULD NOT SURPRISE US IF HE MISSED THE POINT.

1978TEHRAN06818.subject: IRANIANS FOCUS ON NEXT PARLIAMENTARY ELECTION

segments.text: AS IRANIAN POLITICAL SCENE SETTLES DOWN FOR THE SUMMER IT MIGHT BE USEFUL TO REVIEW BRIEFLY MAIN DIRECTION IN WHICH INTERNAL POLITICAL PROCESS SEEMS TO BE HEADING. OVER PAST FEW WEEKS THE PROCESS HAS BEGUN TO CONCENTRATE ON PREPARATIONS FOR PARLIAMENTARY ELECTION WHICH WILL TAKE PLACE SUMMER 1979.

DEBATE OVER REVISED GOVERNMENT ELECTION BILL WAS INCONCLUSIVE IN THE MAJLES PRIOR TO ITS RECESSION END OF JUNE, AND THERE IS GOOD CHANCE VARIETY OF OBJECTIONS AND SUGGESTIONS FOR AMENDMENT OF BILL WILL RESULT IN NO BILL BEING PASSED AND ELECTION TAKEING PALCE UNDER PREVIOUS, PRESENT LAW. THIS IS IN ITSELF, LESS IMPORTANT, HOWEVER, THAN NONLEGAL ASPECTS OF SITUATION. MOST IMPORTANT IS DEGREE OF PERMISSIVENESS ON SHAH'S PART AS TO INDIVIDUALS AND PARTIES WHO WILL BE ALLOWED TO COMPETE FOR ELECTION.

TIED TO THIS IS ELECTION PROCESS ITSELF, PARLARLY QUESTION WHETHER OR NOT RASTIKHIZ PARTY WILL BE EMPOWERED TO PASS ON QUALIFICATIONS OF ALL CANDIDATES, THUS IN EFFECT CONTROLLING WHO CAN RUN. ALL SIGNS INDICATE INDEPENDENTS WILL BE ALLOWED --AND THERE IS GOO CHANCE THIS MIGHT DEVELOP INTO "GROUPS" OR POLITICAL PARTIES AS WELL.

CLOSING DAYS OF PARLIAMENT BROUGHT INTERESTING NEW DEVELOPMENTS. ONE WAS ANNOUNCEMENT BY DEPTUY PEZESHKPOUR THAT HE WAS REVIVING HIS RIGHT WINGPAN-IRANIST PARTY AND THUS CHALLENGING THE UNWRITTEN RULE (THERE IS NOW LAW AS SUCH) THAT RASTIKHIZ IS THE ONLY PERMISSIBLE POLITICAL PARTY. HE SOFTENED THIS CHALLENGE BY PLEDGING ALLEGIANCE OF ALL HIS PEOPLE (SOME ONE-HALF DOZEN DEPUTIES) TO THE THREE PRINCIPLES OF THE RASTAKHIZ; MONARCHY, CONSTITUTION, AND SHAH-PEOPLE REVOLUTION. HE DESCRIBED RASTAKHIZ AS A MOVEMENT TO WHICH ALL MIGHT SUBSCRIBE WHATEVER THEIR POLITICAL PARTY.

ANOTHER DEPTUY, BANI-AHMAD OF TABRIZ, ANNOUNCED FORMATION OF HIS OWN GROUP (SAID TO BE OF MORE LEFTEIST, SOCIAL DEMOCRATIC LEANINGS) BUT HAS SO FAR REFRAINED FROM ANNOUNCING WITHDRAWAL FROM RASTIKHIZ. OUR ASSUMPTION IS HE IS WAITING TO SEE IF PEZESHKPOUR GETS AWAY WITH IT. BANI-AHMAD IS BEING ASSISTED BY SOME OF THE NATIONAL FRONT OPPOSIONISTS, THOUGH THIS ASSISTANCE IS STILL TENTATIVE AND SECRET.

AT THE SAME TIME RASTAKHIZ ITSELF HAS BEEN UNDERGOING CHANGES. AS SERIES OF MANEUVERS REMOVED PROGRESSIVE WING HEAD MAJIDI, WHO HAD BECOME A SYMBOL OF THE PAST SOMEWHAT COMPARABLE TO SAVAK GENERAL NASSIRI, WHO SHAH ALSO RECENTLY REMOVED. AFTER A BRIEF RESIGNATION, NIOC HEAD HOUSANG ANSARY WAS REINSTATED AS HEAD OF THE CONSTRUCTIVE WING COORDINATING COMMITTEE, THOUGH SHARING HIS COORDINATING FUNCTION WITH NEWLY ELECTED WING COORDINATOR MOINI, WHO IS CONCURRENTLY MINISTER OF LABOR.

THE "GROUP FOR THE STUDY OF IRANIAN PROBLEMS" SUDDENLTY GAINED PROMINENCE THIS SPRING AND, HEADED BY HUSHANG NAHAVANDI, FORMERLY CHANCELLOR OF TEHRAN UNIVERSITY AND PRESENTLY HEAD OF THE QUEEN'S BUREAU, HAS BEEN ACCEPTED AS A THIRD WING OF THE RASTIKHIZ. AS OF THIS WRITING MANY OF THE GROUP DISPUTE MEMBERSHIP IN RASTIKHIZ, AND PREFER TO ISSUE THEIR FINDINGS IN THE NAME OF THE "GROUP" ONLY. THIS HAS FURTHER CONFUSED THE INTERNAL SITUATION, A CONFUSION WHICH HAS BECOME CHARACTERISTIC OF THIS PERIOD OF UNCERTAINTY AS THE SHAH CONTINUES TO LIBERALIZE WITHOUT YIELDING ANY SIGNIFICANT POLITICAL POWER.

THE EMBASSY HAS LEARNED VERY CONFIDENTIALLY THAT LEADERS OF THE RELIGIOUS OPPOSITION HAVE BEEN GIVEN TO UNDERSTAND THAT THE SHAH WILL PERMIT RELATIVELY "FREE"ELECTIONS AND THEY ARE WELCOME TO PUT UP THEIR OWN CANDIDATES. THE EXREMIST RELIGIOUS WING HEADED BY KHOMEINI IN IRQA HAS ALREADY BEGUN PUTTING TOGETHER SOME NAMES. AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI AND PERHAPS OTHER AYATOLLAHS CAN BE EXPECTED TO DRAW UP SIMILAR LISTS IN THE WEEKS AND MONTHS AHEAD.

AS THINGS LOOK NOW, THESE CANDIDATES WOULD PRESUMABLY COMPETE WITH DANDIDATES PUT UP BY THE VARIOUS WINGS OF RASTIKHIZ AS WELL AS OTHER PARTIES AND GROUPS SUCH AS THE PAN-IRANISTS THE BANI-AHMAD GROUP AND ANY OTHERS THAT MAY BE FORMED IN THE YEAR AHEAD (BY NATIONAL FRONT AND OTHER OPPOSITIONISTS).

ALL IN ALL, THE POLITICAL AIR IN IRAN THESE DAYS IS CONSIDERABLY MORE INVIGORATING FOR LOYALISTS AND OPPOSITIONISTS ALIKE. THE SHAH'S READINESS TO COUNTENANCE OPEN POLITICAL ORGANIZATION BY OPPOSITIONISTS-IF IT CONTINUES AS IT SEEMS IT WILL-HAS LARGELY DISARMED THE OPPOSITION OF ITS ONE MAJOR ISSUE WHICH COULD HAVE UNIFIED IT IN AN EFFECTIVE CAMPAIGN AGAINST HIM. BY MOVING TO ASSURE FAIRLY FREE PARTICIPATION IN NEXT SUMMER'S ELECTIONS THE SHAH IS GIVING THE FIRST TRULY POLITICAL INTERPRETATION TO HIS LIBERALIZATION DRIVE AND IS MOVING AHEAD OF OPPOSITIONIST PRESSURES RATHER THAN REACTING TO THEM. THIS ACTIVITY WILL UNDOUBTEDLY GROW MORE VIGOROUS IN THE FALL.

QUEEN'S SPECIAL BUREAU INFORMS US THAT GOI SEVEN MILLION CONTRIBUTION IS TO BE USED WITHIN IRAN. DETAILS OF PROGRAM NOT YET WORKED OUT, BUT SOURCE SAID SEVEN MILLION WILL COVER PROGRAMMING AND ADMINISTRATIVE COSTS.

1978TEHRAN06864.subject: VIEWS OF AN EX-POLITICAL PRISONER SUMMARY: CHARGE AND POLOFF STEMPEL RECENTLY MET WITHAN IRANIAN EDUCATED IN THE U.S. WHO HAD BEEN IN PRISON FOR ABO UT A YEA

segments.text: SUMMARY: CHARGE AND POLOFF STEMPEL RECENTLY MET WITHAN IRANIAN EDUCATED IN THE U.S. WHO HAD BEEN IN PRISON FOR ABOUT A YEAR PRIOR TO HIS AMNESTY EARLIER THIS YEAR. HE SHARED WITH US SOME FRANK OBSERVATIONS ON HIS OWN SITUATION AND THE LOT OF POLITICAL PRISONERS IN IRAN. END SUMMARY.

POST-RELEASE SITUATION: AT THE PRESENT TIME, THERE IS NO STIGMA ATTACHED TO HIS PRISON TERM AND PEOPLE HAVE NOT BEEN AFRAID TO HELP HIM. FOR EXAMPLE, HE HAD BEEN REHIRED BY HIS OLD ENGINEERING FIRM AT A 40,000 RIAL-A-MONTH (ABOUT DOLS567) RAISE. MOREOVER, HE HAD FOUND AN APARTMENT WHICH HAD BEEN OFFERED TO HIM AT A SUBSTANTIAL RENT REDUCTION BECAUSE OF HIS "SUBZERO" ECONOMIC STATUS AT THE TIME OF THIS RELEASE. HE AND HIS WIFE INTEND TO STAY IN IRAN FOR A YEAR OR SO, THEN LEAVE FOR A BRIEF TIME OR PERHAPS PERMANENTLY.
HE HAS NOT BEEN HARASSED OR, TO THE BEST OF HIS KNOWLEDGE, FOLLOWED SINCE HIS RELEASE AND STATED HE WAS CONCENTRATING ON WORK AND IGNORING POLITICS NOW.

EFFECT OF AMNESTY: THE TERMS OF THE AMNESTY HE AND OTHERS RECEIVED REMOVE THE CRIME FROM THE INDIVIDUAL'S RECORD.. HE COULD WORK FOR THE GOVERNMENT. HE IS FREE TO APPLY FOR (AND PRESUMABLY RECEIVE) A PASSPORT FOR FOREIGN TRAVEL, BUT WAS URGED BY FRIENDS TO WAIT A COUPLE OF MONTHS BEFORE DOING SO IN ORDER THAT THE IRANIAN BUREAUCRACY COULD CLEAR ITS RECORDS. HE "DIDN'T WANT TO SEE ANY BLUE UNIFORMS OF ANY KIND" ANYWAY FOR AWHILE.

CIRCUMSTANCES OF ARREST AND INTERNMENT: HE SAID HE HAD BEEN PICKED UP BY SAVAK FOR HIS "ATTENDANCE AT A FEW STUDENT DEMONSTATIONS" DURING HIS STUDENT DAYS IN CHICAGO. (NOTE: HIS CASE IS SOMEWHAT MORE COMPLEX THAN HE PRESENTED HERE, AND HIS PRESENTATION TO US MINIMIZED CIRCUMSTANCES WHICH HE MAY NOT HAVE WANTED TO DISCUSS WITH HIS WIFE PRESENT. HE MAY ALSO HAVE BEEN UNAWARE THAT WE ALREADY KNEW SIGNIFICANT DETAILS OF HIS CASE.) HE WAS TRIED IN EARLY 1977 IN MILITARY COURT AND SENTENCED.

HE WAS HELD VIRTUALLY INCOMMUNICADO FOR THE FIRST TWO-THREE MONTHS AFTER HE WAS PICKED UP, THEN AFTER TRIAL SENT TO EVIN PRISON AND LATER TRANSFERRED TO QASR PRISON AFTER PRISON VISITS BY OUTSIDERS BEGAN. MOST OF THE PRISONERIN THIS SECTION OF THE PRISON WERE YOUNG UNIVERSITY STUDENTS.

PRISON CONDITIONS WERE NOT BAD, BUT BECAME MUCH BETTER AFTER THE INTERNATIONAL RED CROSS (ICRC) BEGAN ITS VISITS IN OCTOBER OF 1977. AFTER ICRC VISITS STARTED, POLIITICAL PRISONERS WERE ALLOWED AS MANY BOOKS AS THEY WANTED, UNCENSORED. FOOD WAS ADEQUATE, AND HE WAS HOUSED IN A SECTION OF THE PRISON USED FOR POLITICAL PRISONERS. THIS SECTION WAS SIGNIFICANTLY BETTER KEPT AND ACCOMMODATIONS WERE BETTER THAN THOSE OF THE REGULAR PRISON-CENTRAL HEATING, AIR CONDITIONING AND BETTER LEIGHTING. PARENTHETICALLY, HE NOTED THAT ONE IRONIC RESULT OF THE SHIFT OF DISSIDENT TRIALS FROM MILITARY TO CIVILIAN COURTS HAS BEEN THAT THOSE CONVICTED MUST SERVE THEIR TERMS IN THE REGULAR PRISONS.

UNLESS THE SENTENCE IS SEVERE, HOWEVER, THERE IS PROVISION IN LAW FOR THOSE SO SENTENCED TO BUY THEIR WAY OUT OF THEIR SENTENCES AT THE RATE OF 50P RIALS PER DAY, WHICH MITIGATES THE FACT THAT REGUALR PRISON CONDITIONS ARE A CUT BELOW THOSE OF "POLITICIALS". IT SEEMED TO HIM THAT POLITICAL CONDITIONS IN THE COUNTRY WERE MORE FREE AND RELAXED NOW, AND THIS, PLUS U.S. INTEREST IN HUMAN RIGHTS, WERE THE MOST IMPORTANT FACTORS IN HIS BEING AMNESTIED.

1978TEHRAN06890.subject: POLITICAL ACTIVITY --PROJECTED MEETINS, MORE RESURGENCE PARTY (RPPI) RESIGNATIONS, ARYAMEHR UNIVERSITY TO STAY IN TEHRAN

segments.text: SUMMARY: CELEBRATIONS, SOME WITH POLITICAL OVERTONES, PLANNED FOR JULY 21 BIRTHDAY OF 12TH IMMAM. MULLAH RETURNS PEACEFULLY TO ISFAHAN FROM INTERNAL EXILE. ANOTHER RESURGENCE PARTY DEPUTY SECRETARY RESIGNS GOI SOURCE CONFIRMS INDEPENDENT CANDIDATES WILL BE ABLE TO RUN IN 1979 PARLIAMENTARY ELECTIONS. ARYAMEHR UNIVERSITY TEHRAN CAMPUS TO REMAIN OPEN, TERMS NOT YET SET. END SUMMARY.

FROM SEVERAL SOURCES EMBASSY HAS LEARNED THAT JULY 21 ANNIVERSARY OF 12TH IMMAM'S BIRTHDAY WILL BE HOLIDAY WITH POLICICAL CROSS CURRENTS. AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI AND HIS FOLLOWERS ARE ARRANGING NORMAL LARGE DEMONSTRATIONS ON THIS VERY IMPORTANT SHIA EVENT. AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI'S FOLLOWERS AND LIBERATION MOVEMENT OF IRAN LEADER BAZARGAN AND OTHER POLITICAL FIGURES HAVE CALLED FOR A QUIET, SOMBER POLITICAL MEETING IN TEHRAN FOR THE EVENING OF JULY 20 IN LIEU OF NORMAL JOYFUL DEMONSTRATIONS. DISSIDENTS EXPECT NO TROUBLE, EXCEPT PERHAPS OVERCROWDING BUT BELIEVE THERE WILL BE A POLICE PRESENCE.

TWO RELIGIOUS FACTIONS APPEAR TO BE TRYING TO MINIMIZE THIS FIRST OPEN DIFFERENCE OVER THEIR APPROACHES TO OPPOSING GOI, SO EXTERNAL VIOLENCE NOT EXPECTED TO REFLECT INTERNAL STRUGGLE (COMMENT: BUT ALWAYS POSSIBLE).

RELIGIOUS GROUPS HAVE NOT MADE MAJOR ISSUE OF CELEBRATIONS IN SHIRAZ AND TABRIZ, THOUGH CELEBRATIONS EXPECTED. IN ISFAHAN EVENING JUNE 19, MULLAH TAHERI RETURNED FROM TWO MONTHS EXILE TO HAMMADAN. RELIABLE EYEWITNESS REPORTS INDICATEHE WAS MET BY LARGE BUT UNCOUNTED CROWD AT EDGE OF CITY SHOUTING SLOGANS. ROUTE TOOK THEM PAST U.S. CONSULATE, BUT THERE WAS NO ANTI AMERICAN MANIFESTATION. ASIDE FROM WINDOWS BROKEN IN JOLFA MOVIE HOUSE, THERE WERE NO INJURIES OR MAJOR DAMAGE.

RPPI FERMENT--ON JULY 18 RPPI DEPUTY SECRETARY TABRIZ SENATOR MOHAMMAD MOUSAVI RESIGNED TO GIVE SECRETARY GENERAL (AND PRIME MINISTER) AMOUZEGAR A FREE HAND AT REORGANIZING RPPI. HE FOLLOWS FELLOW DEPUTY SECGEN AMELI TEHRANI TO THE SIDELINES (REFA). THIRD SENIOR DEPUTY, MAHMOUD JAFFARIAN IS REPORTEDLY ON VERGE OF DEPARTURE AS WELL. SOME QUARTERS BELIEVE ALL 13 ASSISTANT SECRETARIES AT CENTRAL PARTY HEADQUARTERS WILL GO AS WELL. NUMBER OF INTERNAL PARTY MEETINS HAS INCREASED, INCLUDING JULY 19 MEETING OF THREE WING LEADERS WITH PRIME MINISTER. SHAKEUP OF PARTY ORGANIZATION CLEARLY IN PROGRESS.

OPEN ELECTIONS--PRESS JULY 19 CARRIED STATEMENT BY AUTHORITATIVE SOURCE (REPORTEDLY EITHER MININFO HOMAYOUN OR OTHER SENIOR MININFO FIGURE) THAT INDEPENDENT AND DISSIDENT CANDIDATES COULD RUN IN 1979 NATIONAL ELECTIONS, THIS IS FIRST "SEMI-OFFICIAL" INDICATION TO PUBLIC OF DECISION WHICH EMB BELIEVES HAS ALREADY BEEN MADE(REFB).

ARYAMEHR UNIVERSITY--NATIONAL IRANIAN RADIO AND TELEVISION REPORTED STATEMENT JULY 17 BY ARYAMEHR UNIVERSITY CHANCELLOR ALI-REZA MEHRAN THAT TEHRAN CAMPUS WOULD NOT BE CLOSED. DIFFERENCES STILL REMAIN BETWEEN PRIME MINISTER, WHO WANTS ARYAMEHR TO CONCENTRATE ON GRADUATE STUDIES, AND UNIVERSITY FACULTY WHO WANT CAMPUS TO REMAIN AS IT IS, BUT A CAMPUS WILL STAY IN TEHRAN WHILE ISFAHAN BRANCH WILL STILL GO FORWARD AS PLANNED.
BEGIN UNCLASSIFIED

LOCAL PRESS JULY 19 AND 20 CARRIED PARS NEWS AGENCY STORY OF DOWNING OF TWO IRANIAN HELICOPTERS IN SOVIET AIR SPACE THREE WEEKS AGO. REPORTED BY REFTEL AND SUBSEQUENT MESSAGES. STORY SAID BOTH HELICOPTERS HAD GONE ABOVE CLOUDS TO ESCAPE WEATHER BETWEEN MASHAD AND SABEZEVAR IN NORTHEAST IRAN AND STRAYED INTO SOVIET TERRITORY. SOVIET FIGHTERS SHOT DOWN BOTH PLANES, DESTROYING ONE WITH LOSS OF ALL EIGHT ABOARD. SECOND PILOT LANDED AND WAS LATER RETURNED TO IRANIAN AUTHORITIES. SOVIETS WILL SHORTLY DELIVER THE DAMAGED HELICOPTER TO IRAN. END UNCLASSIFIED. BEGIN CONFIDENTIAL

SENIOR IRANIAN OFFICER CONFIRMED TO DAO JULY 19 THAT ONE PLANE SHOT DOWN IN AIR, OTHER FORCED DOWN. HE NOTED CREW HAD NOT RPT NOT ACTUALLY BEEN RETURNED YET, BUT THEY WERE EXPECTED BACK IN 5-7 DAYS. SPECULATION HERE OVER REASON FOR DELAY IN GOI ANNOUNCMENT CENTERS AROUND IRANIAN EFFORTS TO NEGOTIATE FOR RETURN OF CREW AND PLANE. SHAH WAS APPARENTLY ANNOYED AND UPSET BY MISHAP. ONE OR TWO FOREIGN JOURNALISTS HERE ARE SEARCHING FOR DEEPER MEANING (SENSATIONAL BACKGROUND) BEHIND STORY, BUT BEST INFO HERE IS THAT INCIDENT IS WHAT IT SEEMS TO BE. END

1978TEHRAN06939.subject: TARAKI TALKS FOR NIRT SUMMARY: AFGHANISTAN PRESIDENT TARAKI CALLS FOR EXPANSION OF EXISTING FRIENDLY RELATIONS, VOWS TO ROOT OUT OPPO

segments.text: SUMMARY: AFGHANISTAN PRESIDENT TARAKI CALLS FOR EXPANSION OF EXISTING FRIENDLY RELATIONS, VOWS TO ROOT OUT OPPOSITION TO HIS REGIME AND HOPES IRAN WILL INCREASE ITS ASSISTANCE TO AFGHANISTAN. TARAKI PLEDGED AFGHANISTAN WILL NOT BE A PARTY TO ANY AMILITARY BLOCK AND WILL ADHERE TO THE PRINCIPLES OF NON-ALIGNMENT. END SUMMARY.

IN AN INTERVIEW WITH IRAN'S NATIONAL RADIO AND TELEVISION REPORTER RELEASED OVER WEEKEND AND GIVEN PRESS PLAY JULY 23, AFGHANISTAN PRESIDENT TARAKI MADE NUMBER OF POINTS GIVEN BELOW. FULL PERSIAN TEXT OF INTERVIEW BEING POUCHED KABUL AND DEPT.

RELATIONS WITH IRAN-TARAKI CALLED FOR THE EXPANSION OF EXISITING FRIENDLY RELATIONS AND EXPRESSED HOPE THAT GOI WOULD NOT ONLY CONTINUE ITS ECONOMIC ASSISTANCE TO AFGHANISTAN BUT WOULD FURTHER EXPAND IT. "WE WANT CORDIAL RELATIONS WITH IRAN BASED ON PRINCIPLES OF NONINTERFERENCE IN THE DOMESTIC AFFAIRS OF EACH IN RESPECT TO THE TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY AND INDEPENDENCE BETWEEN THE TWO COUNTRIES." LOCAL ENGLISH LANGUAGE TEHRAN JOURNAL NOTED JULY 23 THAT POLITICAL OBSERVERS HERE WELCOMED WHAT IT DESCRIBED AS "TARAKI'S FRIENDLY GESTURES".

OTHER INTERNAL RELATIONS-TARAKI SAID AFGHANISTAN AND PAKISTAN WERE BOTH FACED WITH THE ISSUE OF PUSHTUNS IN PAKISTAN. HE STATED HIS HOPE THAT THE ISSUE WOULD BE RESOLVED THROUGH FRIENDLY NEGOITATIONS. TARAKI ALSO SAID THAT AFGHANISTAN WILL AVOID JOINING MILITARY ALLIANCES AND WILL ADHERE TO THE PRINCIPLES OF NON-ALIGNMENT.

INTERNAL AFGHANISTAN POLITICS-PRESIDENT VOWED TO ROOT OUT OPPOSITION TO HIS THREE-MONTH-OLD REGIME AND SAID HE CONSIDERED "REACTIONARIES AND AGENTS OF IMPERIALSM" HIS ENEMIES WHO WERE SEEKING TO BLOCK THE ENFORCEMENT OF "SOCIALISTIC PRINCIPLES". INTERVIEW SINGLED OUT PARCHAM FACTION FOR SHARP ATTACK, NOTING THAT "THERE NEVER WAS A PARCHAM PARTY AND THERE ISN'T ONE NOW." TARAKI SAID PEOPLE'S DEMOCRATIC PARTY HAS ENGINEERED THE APRIL COUP WHICH TOPPLED PRESIDENT DAOUD SINGLE HANDEDLY. TARAKI CLAIMED HIS PEOPLE'S DEMOCRATIC PARTY WAS THE SOLE POLITICAL ORGAINZATION IN AFGHANISTAN.

EMBOFF DISCUSSED SUBJECT SOVIET TAX DECREE WITH BIJAN NOZARI, DEPUTY UNDERSECRETARY FOR INTERNATIONAL AFFAIRS, MINISTRY OF ECONOMIC AFFAIRS AND FINANCE. NOZARI SAID IRAN HAS NO TAX AGREEMENTS WITH THE USSR NOR ARE ANY PENDING NEGOTIATION. AN EXCHANGE OF LETTERS ON CIVIL AVIATION DOES CONTAIN RECIPROCAL EXEMPTION FROM TAXATION OF AIRLINES. NOZARI HAD NOT HEARD OF THE NEW DECREE AND WAS NOT PREPARED TO STATE WHAT IF ANY REACTION THE GOI MIGHT PROPOSE.

1978TEHRAN06956.subject: SUBJ: PROPOSED VISIT BY PRIME MINISTER FUKADA TO IRAN

segments.text: WE HAVE LEARNED FROM TEHRAN JAPANESE EMBASSY OFFICER OF PROPOSED VISIT BY PRIME MINISTER FUKUDA TO IRAN, TENTATIVELY SCHEDULED FOR TWO FULLY DAYS BEGINNING EITHER SEPTEMBER 5 OR 6. SOURCE BELIEVED FUKUDA VISIT WOULD INCLUDE THREE AREA COUNTRIES. WE WOULD APPRECIATE ANY INFORMATION EMBASSY TOKYO MIGHT BE ABLE TO PROVIDE.

LONG EXPECTED CABINET CHANGES ANNOUNCED AT 2 P.M. TODAY. DR. NASROLLAH MOGHTADER-MODJEHI REPLACES DR SHEIKHOLESLAMZADEH WHO IS OUT COMPLETELY. MANUCHEHR AGAH, FORMERLY PLAN AND BUDGET ORGANIZATION DIRECTOR (PBO) BECOMES MINISTER OF STATE WITHOUT PORTFOLIO AND MORTEZAH SALEHI MOVES FROM MINISTER OF ROADS TO DIRECTOR OF PBO.

MEHDI SAFAVIAN, FORMERLY DEPUTY MINISTER OF PBO, BECOMES THE NEW MINISTER OF ROADS. IN ADDITION TO THESE SHIFTS, MAHMOUD JAFARIAN, CURRENTLY DEPUTY SECRETARY GENERAL OF THE RESURGENCE PARTY IS EXPECTED TO MOVE TO THE CABINET AS MINISTER OF STATE WITHOUT PORTFOLIO. MAGID MOULAVI WILL BECOME THE NEW CHANCELLOR OF AZARBADEAGAN UNIVERSITY.

SEMI-OFFICIAL SOURCES TELL US THAT GOI WAS ALSO SET TO ANNOUNCE APPOINTMENT OF PRIME MINISTER'S BROTHER JAHANGIR AMOUZEGAR AS MINISTER OF COMMERCE TO REPLACE KHOSROWSHAHI. THIS APPOINTMENT MAY STILL BE ANNOUNCED WITHIN NEXT COUPLE OF DAYS.

POST WILL FORWARD BIO DATA ON NEW MINISTERS SHORTLY. INITIAL REACTION OF SEVERAL INFORMED OBSERVERS IS THAT THIS SHUFFLE REPRESENTS CLEAR CUT VICTORY FOR PRIME MINISTER WHO IS BEGINNING TO TIGHTEN UP GOI IN PREPARATION FOR NEXT YEAR'S ELECTORAL CAMPAIGN.

1978TEHRAN06976.subject: IRANIAN/FRG PUBLIC STATEMENTS ON NUCLEAR ISSUES AND STATUS-BILATERAL AGREEMENT

segments.text: SECURITY, ETC., AND PRESUMABLY REMAINS SILENT ON THE MATTER OF REPROCESSING. COOPERATION.

EMBASSY CONTINUES TO SEEK INFORMATION ON REF A PARA 2A DEALING WITH NUCLEAR WEAPON FREE ZONE. POLMIL COUNSELOR MARTIN RETURNS TO POST LATER THIS WEEK. WE WILL REVIEW THIS SUBJECT AND ADVISE FURTHER. FROM SCIATT CONVERSTAION WITH MANZOOR, EMBASSY BELIEVES SHAH MAY HAVE MADE STATEMENT AT PRESS CONFERENCE IN WASHINGTON RECENTLY. IF DEPT KNOWS MONTH IN WHICH REMARKS WERE MADE, IT WOULD ASSIST SEARCH HERE. PLEASE ADVISE.

FOLLOWING IS RELATED EXCERPT FROM SHAH'S TELEVISION INTERVIEW OF 12 NOVEMBER 1976, CARRIED BY FINANCIAL TIMES ON NOVEMBER 13, 1976. : THE SHAH, WHO RECENTLY SIGNED AGREEMENTS WITH FRANCE FOR THE SUPPLY OF NUCLEAR PLANTS, WAS ASKED WHETHER IT WAS UNTHINKABLE THAT IRAN MIGHT BE A CANDIDATE FOR NUCLEAR WEAPONS. PARAGRAPH. HE SAID: "THAT'S VERY, VERY REMOTE, I SAY ALMOST IMPOSSIBLE." PARAGRAPH. THE SHAH SAID THAT IF IRAQ, LIBYA, OR SOME OTHER PEOPLE TRIED TO GET NUCLEAR WEAPONS AND THE WORLD DID NOT DO ANYTHING ABOUT IT THEN THE QUESTION WOULD ARISE: WHAT TO DO? PARAGRAPH. "BUT WE HAVE GOT TO DO SOMETHING AGAINST THE PROLIFERATION OF WEAPONS.

WE HAVE GOT TO DO THAT ON THE WORLD SCALE." PARAGRAPH. HE SAID IRAN'S DEAL WITH FRANCE WAS NOT FOR FUEL REPORCESSING FACILITIES,. "THERE ARE SEVERAL POSSIBILITIES. ONE IS TO HAVE THE GUARANTEE THAT, OF FUEL, SPENT FUEL WILL BE REPROCESSED IN THE U.S. OR IN FRANCE," HE SAID. REUTER. UNQUOTE. ADDITIONALLY, QUESTION AND ANSWER EXCHANGE BY SHAH IN INTERVIEW GRANTED TO SENIOR EDITOR NEWSWEEK (ARNUAD DE BORCHGRAVE) IN NOVEMBER, 1977, FOLLOWS: : QUESTION: ISRAEL AND SOUTH AFRICA ARE KNOWN TO HAVE MILITARY NUCLEAR CAPABILITIES(JOHN VORSTER CONFIRMED IT TO ME 18 MONTHS AGO), THOUGH THEY BOTH DENY IT.

UNLESS THE WORLD CHANGES DRASTICALLY, WHAT ARE YOUR OWN INTENTIONS IN THIS FIELD? SHAHANSHAH: SO FAR NON-NUCLEAR. AGAINST WHOM SHOULD WE HAVE SUCH WEAPONS? MY IMMEDIATE NEIGHBOURS AND WE WILL TRY TO MANAGE TO COPE WITH CONVENTIONAL WEAPONS. AS FOR THE USSR, IT'S UTTERLY RIDICULOUS TO ARM YOURSELF WITH TWO OR THREE NUCLEAR DEVICES AGAINST ALL THEIR MEGATONS. END .

IN SCIATT DISCUSSIONS WITH MANZOOR RE BILATERAL, PERTINENT REFS B AND C INFORMATION WAS OUTLINED. MANZOOR IS FORWARDING INITIALLED AGREEMENT IN BOTH ENGLISH AND FARSI TO FORMIN THIS WEEK FOR FINAL LEGAL REVIEW. HE ESTIMATES ONE WEEK OR TEN DAYS NEEDED FOR THIS ACTIVITY; DOCUMENTS WILL BE RETURNED TO HIM BY FOREIGN MINISTRY AND WILL THEN BE SENT TO PRIME MINISTER'S OFFICE WITH REQUEST THAT ETEMAD SIGN ON BEHALF OF GOI. MANZOOR ESTIMATES APPROXIMATELY SIXTEEN TO SEVENTTEN DAYS TOTAL FOR GOI PREPARATION FOR SIGNATURE.
UPON COMPLETION FOREIGN MINISTRY'S LEGAL REVIEW OF THE BILATERAL, MANZOOR WILL PROVIDE COPY OF FARSI TEXT TO EMBASSY FOR DEPARTMENT'S USE.

1978TEHRAN07023.subject: POLITICAL ACTIVITY-RESURGENCE PARTY AND ELECTIONS SUMMARY: 1979 ELECTIONS WILL BE FOUGHT UNDER OLD ELECTORAL LAW MAJLES TO BE INCREASED FROM 268 TO 345 DEPUTIES NE

segments.text: SUMMARY: 1979 ELECTIONS WILL BE FOUGHT UNDER OLD ELECTORAL LAW MAJLES TO BE INCREASED FROM 268 TO 345 DEPUTIES NEXT YEAR. JUSTICE MINISTER AGREES TO CONSULT WITH BAR ASSOCIATION ON PROPOSED NEW LEGISLATION. RESURGENCE PARTY WINGS WILL NOT FIELD SEPARATE CANDIDATES. PRIME MINISTER CALLS ON MEDIA TO ASCERTAIN WHETHER PEOPLE WANT SINGLE-MEMBER CONSTITUENCIES. END SUMMARY.

FOLLOWING RESURGENCE PARTY POLITICAL BUREAU MEETING, PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR (ALSO SECGEN OF PARTY) SAID NEXT YEAR'S ELECTIONS WILL BE HELD UNDER EXISTING ELECTORAL LAWS SINCE THE NEW GOVERNMENT ELECTION BILL WAS NOT CERTIFIED IN PARLIAMENT AND WOULD NOT BE READY IN TIME.

AMOUZEGAR WAS SUITABLY CONFSUING ON QUESTION OF WHETHER OTHER THAN RESURAGENCE PARTY CANDIDATES CAN RUN FOR PARLIAMENT. HE RULED OUT POSSIBILITY OF OTHER INDEPENDENT POLITICAL GROUPS RUNNING BUT LEFT WAY OPEN FOR INDIVIDUALS WHO MAY WANT TO RUN WITHOUT RESURGENCE PARTY ELECTORAL PERMISSION. (COMMENT: SIGNIFICANCE OF RETURN TO OLD ELECTION LAW MEANS THAT GROUPS NOT BARRED FROM NAMING CANDIDATES. AMOUZEGAR IS APPARENTLY BEING OBSCURE ON QUESTION OF OPPOSITIONISTS RUNNING AS PART OF EFFORT TO KEEP THEM OFF BALANCE.

IT SEEMS CLEAR TO MOST POLITICAL OBSERVERS HERE, HOWEVER, THAT GOI PLANS TO LET NON-OFFICIAL CANDIDATES RUN WHATEVER THE VERBAL CIRCUS ABOUT THEIR MEMBERSHIP IN GROUPS.) AMOUZEGAR SAID RESURGENCE PARTY WOULD NAME PARLIAMENTARY CANDIDATES, BUT WINGS WOULD NOT HAVE SEPARATE NOMINEES.

GOI HAS CERTIFIED TO PARLIAMENT, THAT POPULATION EXPANSION WILL REQUIRE ENLARGEMENT OF MAJLES FROM PRESENT 268 DEPUTIES TO 345. THIS IS IN LINE WITH EARLIER ESTIMATES. AMOUZEGAR CALLED ON MEDIA TO POLL THE IRANIAN PEOPLE TO SEE IF THEY PREFERRED SINGLE-MEMBER CONSTITUENCIES (COMMENT: NUMBER OF DEPUTIES EMBOFF HAS TALKED WITH OVER PAST TWO MONTHS SEEM TO FAVOR SHIFT TO SINGLE-MEMBER CONSTITUENCIES TO PROMOTE GREATER IDENTIFICATION OF PARLIAMENTARIANS WITH THEIR CLIENTS.).

ON JULY 20 JUSTICE MINISTER KIANPOUR TOLD IRAN'S BAR ASSOCIATION TI WOULD HENCEFORTH BE CONSULTED AND ALLOWED TO PARTICIPATE IN THE FORMULATION OF GOVERNMENT DRAFT LEGISLATION. KIANPOUR MADE UNUSUAL CALL ON BAR ASSOCIATION EXECUTIVE BOARD AT ITS HEADQUARTERS AND SAID HE AGREED WITH BAR ASSOCATION PROPOSALS TO SPEED UP THE JUDICIAL PROCESS. THE NEW BAR ASSOCIATION EXECUTIVE COUNCIL IN TURN PROMISED INCREASED COOPERATION BY LAWYERS IN IMPLEMENTING LEGAL GOALS AND IN FORMING JUDICIAL LEGISLATION.
I HAVE PASSED YOUR VIEWS ON THE AFGHAN SITUATION (REFTELS) TO THE SHAH THROUGH THE MINISTRY OF COURT. I WAS ASKED TODAY TO EXPRESS TO YOU HIM'S APPRECIATION.

1978TEHRAN07042.subject: HIGH LEVEL ATTENDANCE AT UNGA: REQUEST FOR MEETING WITH SECRETARY

segments.text: FOREIGN OFFICE DEPUTY MINISTER NADIM INFORMED US JULY 24 THAT FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY WILL LEAD IRANIAN UNGA DELEGATION FOR PERIOD SEPTEMBER 26-OCTOBER 6. HE IS INSCRIBED TO SPEAK ON OCTOBER 3. FOLLOWING KHALATBARY'S DEPARTURE FROM NEW YORK, PRINCESS ASHRAF WILL LEAD IRANIAN DELEGATION.

NADIM STATED THAT KHALATBARY STRONGLY DESIRES A MEETING WITH SECRETARY VANCE. IF ABOVE DATES DO NOT OVERLAP WITH SECRETARY'S PERIOD IN NEW YORK, KHALATBARY WOULD BE WILLING TO GO TO WASHIINGTON FOR MEETING WITH SECRETARY-EXCEPT FOR OCTOBER 2 AND 3.

FOR THE LAST THREE WEEKS TEHRAN AND ISFAHAN (AND WE ASSUME OTHER CITIES AS WELL) HAVE BEEN AWASH WITH RUMORS RE THE SHAH'S HEALTH. AT EVERY SOCIAL OCCASION EMBASSY OFFICERS AND I HAVE RECEIVED ANXIOUS INQUIRIES FROM AMERICANS, IRANIANS, AND OTHER DIPLOMATS. BY NOW MOST OF THE HOME OFFICES OF U.S. FIRMS HAVE PROBABLY RECEIVED THE STORY OF ILL HEALTH. THE RUMORS RANGE FROM TERMINAL MALIGNANCY, LEUKEMIA, SIMPLE ANEMIA TO HAVING BEEN WOUNDED IN THE ARM OR SHOULDER BY GENERAL KHATEMI'S SON OR PRINCESS ASHRAF'S SON.

THE LATTER RUMOR HAS THE ASSASSINATION ATTEMPT TAKING PLACE AT KISH ISLAND EARLIER THIS YEAR OR RECENTLY AT THE CASPIAN AND HAS ON OCCASION INCLUDED THE DEATHS OR WOUNDING OF A NUMBER OF SECURITY GUARDS.

THE SHAH WAS SICK (ILLNESS UNKNOWN) IN LATE JUNE AND EARLY JULY WHICH CAUSED HIM TO CANCEL A NUMBER OF APPOINTMENTS. HE THEN WENT TO THE CASPIAN ON JULY 6 OR 7 AND THE DAILY FLOW OF PICTURES IN THE PAPER OR NEWSREEL CLIPS OF HIS MEETINGS WITH THIS OR THAT DIGNATARY HAS BEEN ABSENT, THUS FEEDING THE RUMOR MILLS THAT HE IS INCAPACITATED. IN RESPONSE TO THE RUMORS A PICTURE OF THE SHAH AND SHAHBANOU AT THE CASPIAN APPEARED IN THE PRESS ON JULY 23 BUT THAT HAS DONE NOTHING TO HALT THE STORIES. SOME PERSIAN CYNICS CLAIM THE PICTURE IS A COUPLE OF YEARS OLD*

AS YOU KNOW, I SAW THE SHAH ON JULY 1 WITH MRS JOHNSON AND ON JULY 9 WITH UNDER SECRETARY NEWSOM. HE LOOKED A LITTLE TIRED BUT OTHERWISE FINE. HE DID TAKE SOME MEDICATION WITH HIS TEA DURING THE LATTER VISIT. GENERAL TOUFANIAN TOLD ME THE OTHER NIGHT THAT HE HAS SEEN THE SHAH TWICE A WEEK SINCE THE CASPIAN VACATION STARTED AND THAT THE SHAH IS FINE AND ENJOYING HIS REST. TOUFANIAN BLAMES THE RUSSIANS FOR STARTING THE RUMORS. OUR OWN SOURCES INDICATE THAT THERE IS NO DOUBT THE RUSSIANS IN FACT ARE SPREADING THE STORIES, BUT AT THIS POINT EVERYBODY IS IN THE ACT.

AT THIS TIME I TEND TO DISCOUNT WELL OVER 90 PERCENT OF THE NONSENSE BUT WE SHALL CONTINUE TO TRY TO KEEP OURSELVES INFORMED. WE ARE TAKING THE LINE, WHEN COMMENT IS UNAVOIDABLE, THAT "TO THE BEST OF OUR KNOWLEDGE THE SHAH IS FINE."
DR. CYRUS MANZOOR PHONED AEOI CONCURRENCE TO PARA ONE REFTEL UNCHANGED, JULY 26.
SCIATT RESTATED U.S. INTEREST IN RECEIVING FARSI TEXT OF INITIALED AGREEMENT AND NOTE, AT EARLIEST DATE, AND WAS ASSURED BY MANZOOR THAT HE WILL SEND COPY ASAP.
PLEASE CORRECT REFTEL'S REF (TEHRAN 9490) TO READ TEHRAN 6976. TEHRAN 9490 IS NON-EXISTENT.

1978TEHRAN07069.subject: DEMONSTRATIONS AND VIOLENCE IN IRAN'S PROVINCES

segments.text: SUMMARY: CELEBRATIONS SURROUNDING 12TH IMAM'S BIRTHDAY JULY 21 INCLUDED DEMONSTRATIONS IN MOST CITIES AND VIOLENCE AT A FEW POINTS. MOST OF VIOLENCE RELATED TO EFFORTS OF PRO KHOMEINI RELIGIOUS FACTION TO TURN NORMALLY JOYOUS CELEBRATIONS INTO MOURNING MEETINGS. MASHAD WAS SCENE OF LARGEST OUTBREAK WITH SOME DEATHS. TROOPS STILL PATROLLING CITY AS OF MORNING JULY

DETAILED STORY OF MASHAD EVENTS CONFUSED AND FIRST PRESS MENTION WAS IN JULY 26 PAPERS. JAHROM (FARS PROVINCE) HAD DEMONSTRATION WHICH ESCALATED TO VIOLENCE IN WHICH FOUR GENDARMES WERE REPORTED KILLED. ISFAHAN HAD QUIET PRAYER MEETINGS, SOME WITH ANTI-GOVERNMENT SPEAKERS. IN SHIRAZ, DISTURBANCE AT SHAH CHERAGH MOSQUE LATE EVENING JULY 20, INVOLVED INJURIES AND MAY HAVE RESULTED IN A DEATH ACCORDING TO ONE UNCONFIRMED REPORT. TABRIZ WAS PEACEFUL. END SUMMARY.

EVENTS SURROUNDING CELEBRATION OF 12TH IMAM'S BIRTHDAY LEAD TO SUBSTANTIAL VIOLENCE IN MASHAD AND JAHROM, PLUS MORE TROUBLE IN A FEW LOCATIONS. VIOLENCE WAS CAUSED BY PRO KHOMEINI RELIGIOUS FACTIONS AND SOME OF THEIR ALLIES AMONG OPPOSITION POLITICIANS WHO TRIED TO TURN NORMALLY HAPPY EVENT INTO POLITICALLY SIGNIFICANT MOURNING AFFAIRS FOR THOSE KILLED OR WOUNDED IN VARIOUS INCIDENTS SINCE JANUARY 19 RIOTS. (REFTELS).

MASHAD STORY CONFUSED. DEMONSTRATION APPARENTLY BEGAN AROUND SHIRINE ON JULY 21 BUT DID NOT TURN VILENT UNTIL MORNING JULY 22 WHEN MOB BEGAN THROWING STONES. AS A RESULT OF THIS, ONE DEMONSTRATOR AND ONE POLICEMAN WERE SEEN KILLED. AS DEMONSTRATION TURNED INTO A RIOT, TROOPS WERE CALLED IN, INCLUDING EVENTUALLY ARMORED UNIT. THIS MUCH IS CONFIRMED BY RELIABLE EUROPEAN EYEWITNESS. ACCORDING TO STORIES FROM DISSIDENT SOURCES. IN COURSE OF DAY JULY 22, NINE POLICEMEN AND 15 DEMONSTRATORS IDENTIFIED AS THEOLOGICAL STUDENTS WERE KILLED AND 30 OR 40 MORE INJURIED.

ONE JOURNALIST HERE HAS HEARD POLITICAL STATEMENT ISSUED BY FIVE OR SIX SENIOR AYATOLLAHS IN MASHAO CALLING FOR MOURNING PERIOD FOR THOS KILLED, STATEMENT SPEAKS OF ATTACK BY POLICE ON THEOLOGICAL SCHOOL, AND MENTIONS GATHERING OF PEOPLE IN SHRINE. EYEWITNESS REPORT INDICATES THERE WERE SEVERAL THOUSAND PEOPLE IN SHRINE COMPOUND AS OF LATE JULY 24, WITH MORE COMING. ENGLISH AND PERSIAN PRESS MORNING JULY 26 REPORTED ONE POLICEMAN KILLED, 33 CIVILIANS WOUNDED JULY 22 AS RESULT OF FUNERAL PROCESSION FOR PROMINENT AYATOLLAH KAFI, WHO WAS FROM MASHAD AND DIED IN AN AUTO ACCIDENT TWO DAYS PREVIOUSLY.
STORY AS RELEASED BY OFFICAL PARA NEW AGENCY, REPORTED SEVEN POLICEMEN HAD BEEN WOUNDED ALONG WITH 26 DEMONSTRATORS.

PRESS STORIES SOMEWHAT UNUSUAL IN REFERENCE TO KAFI BURIAL, WHICH WAS NOT CITED EITHER BY EYEWITNESS SOURCES NOR BY OTHERS, INCLUDING STATEMEMENT OF PROMINENT AYATOLLAHS. (COMMENT: UNDOUBTEDLY SOME PEOPLE WERE KILLED, BUT NEITHER OFFICAL PRESS VERSION NOR MORE ABSURD DISSIDENT ESTIMATES OF UP TO 200 KILLED SQUARE WITH EYEWITNESS VERSION OF SUBSTANTIAL PORTION OF EVENTS. SIGNIFICANTLY, THIS IS FIRST TIME IN A LONG WHILE THAT MASHAD HAS BEEN IN FOREFRONT OF VIOLENCE ON MAJOR HOLIDAY, ESPECIALLY WITH RESPECT TO "NATIONAL" POLITICO-RELIGIOUS ISSUE.

SOURCE WHO HAS SERVED AS POLITICAL BROKER BETWEEN COURT AND RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP THINKS GOI WILL HAVE SOME PROBLEMS CALMING MASHAD DOWN AND PREVENTING RELIGIOUS LEADERS THERE FROM BEING DRAWN INTO NATIONAL POLITICAL ORBIT.

INFO ON JAHROM EVENTS MUCH MORE FRAGMENTARY. SOURCE CLOSE TO, BUT NOT OF, GOI SAYS FOUR GENDARMES WERE KILLED AFTER DEMONSTRATION BY PRO KHOMEINI GROUP GOT VIOLENT. OTHER SOURCES SAY THERE WAS SOME LOSS OF LIFE, INCLUDING CIVILIANS, BUT NO NUMBERS ARE GIVEN. CONSULATE SHIRAZ NOTES JAHROM HAS BEEN CENTER OF RELIGOUS DISTURBANCES FOR SOME TIME.

IN ISFAHAN, THERE WERE NO DEMONSTRATIONS OVER WEKEND, BUT ON JULY 21, THERE WERE AT LEAST SEVEN LARGE PRAYER MEETINGS IN MOSQUES AND IN LARGE PRIVATE HOMES. THREE OF THESE MEETINGS STUCK TO PRAYER; FOUR OTHERS HAD ANTIGOVERNMENT SPEAKERS WHO HARSHLY CRITICIZED THE GOVERNMENT AND TOOK A PRO-KHOMEINI LINE, BUT DID NOT CALL FOR ANY ACTION. POLICE GUARDS WERE STATIONED AROUND THE MOSQUE WHERE MULLAH TAHERI (JUST RETURNED FROM INTERNAL EXILE-REF A) SPOKE.

SHIRAZ HAD ONLY ONE MAJOR DUSTUP OVER WEEKEND, DEMONSTRATION AT SHAH CHERAGH MOSQUE LATE EVENING JULY 20 AT WHICH SOME VIOLENCE REPORTEDLY ERUPTED. NUMBER OF PEOPLE INJURED, AND ONE STORY HAS ONE PERSON DEAD, BUT THIS IS NOT CONFIRMED BY OTHERS.

WEEKEND PASSED QUIETLY IN TABRIZ WITH LARGE POSTERSIZE PICTURES OF AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI (A TABRIZI BY BIRTH) BLOSSOMING IN VITUALLY ALL OF CITY'S SHOPS. CONSULATE REPORTS TABRIZ BAZAAR CLOSED ON JULY 23 IN MORNING FOR "MARTYRS" KILLED AT MASHAD.

1978TEHRAN07128.subject: NAMIBIA: UK APPROACH TO THE SHAH

segments.text: BRITISH CHARGE HAD AUDIENCE WITH THE SHAH ON THECASPIAN JULY 26. APPARENTLY, BETWEEN THE TIME THAT REFTEL WAS SENT TO US AND FINAL INSTRUCTIONS RECEIVED FROM LONDON BY THECHARGE, FOREIGN MINISTER BOTHA HAD AGREED TO INTERCESSION BY SECRETARY VANCE TO ATTEND THE SC MEETING. THEREFORE, THE BRITISH CHARGE'S INSTRUCTIONS WERE MODIFIED AT THE LAST MOMENT AND HE ESSENTIALLY BROUGHT THE SHAH UP TO DATE ON NAMIBIAN AFFAIRS SINCE THE TIME OF THE LUANDA AGREEMENT.

THE SHAH READ THEDRAFT SC RESOLUTION CONCERNING WALVIS BAY AND NOTED THAT IT WOULD BE PRETTY TOUGH TO SWALLOW FOR THE SOUTH AFRICANS. IT REMAINED HIS VIEW THAT WALVIS BAY IF LEGALLY A PART OF SOUTH AFRICA. HOWEVER, HE WAS STILL OF THE OPINION, WHICH HE HAD MADE CLEAR MANY TIMES TO SOUTH AFRICAN LEADERS, THAT SOUTH AFRICAN ACCEPTANCE OF THE FIVE-POWER PROPOSALS WAS THE ONLY WAY TO AVOID A VERY MESSY SITUATION.

THESHAH SAID THAT SOUTH AFRICA WOULD EVENTUALLY HAVE TO FACE UP TO THE NECESSITY OF GIVING UP WALVIS BAY, BUT PRIME MINISTER VORSTER HAS NOT EDUCATED HIS CABINET OR THE PUBLIC ON THIS MATTER TO PERMIT A SETTLEMENT. THE SOUTH AFRICANS WOULD HAVE TO BE COAXED INTO TAKING A BROADER VIEW. HE THOUGHT THAT IT WOULD BE HELPFUL IF "THE FINAL ACT" ON WALVIS BAY COULD TAKE PLACE AFTER THE NEXT ELECTIONS IN SOUTH AFRICA.

THE SHAH ASKED WHETHER THERE WAS ANYTHING NEW THAT HE COULD DO AT THIS TIME BEYOND WHAT HE HAS BEEN DOING FOR SO LONG. HE SAID THAT HE WOULD BE SEEING "THE SOUTH AFRICANS" IN TWO OR THREE DAYS, AND, IF THE UK HAD VIEWS OF HELPFUL STEPS HE COULD TAKE, HE SHOULD BE INFORMED.

COMMENT: IN VIEW OF THE CHANGED SITUATION, WE HAVE NOT FOLLOWED UP AS REQUESTED IN PARA 3 OF REFTEL. IF THE DEPARTMENT WISHES TO TAKE ADVANTAGE OF THE SHAH'S FORTHCOMING MEETING WITH THESOUTH AFRICANS, PLEASE LET US KNOW.

1978TEHRAN07129.subject: BRIEFING ON MIDDLE EAST TALKS AT LEEDS CASTLE

segments.text: BECAUSE OF ABSENCE OF FOREIGN MINISTER AND OTHER HIGH OFFICIALS, I BRIEFED DIRECTOR GENERAL AMIRI ON CONTENTS OF REFTEL. HE WAS VERY APPRECIATIVE AND INDICATED HE WOULD SEND A REPORT TO THE FOREIGN MINISTER AND TO THE SHAH.

THE BRITISH CHARGE HAD AN AUDIENCE WITH THE SHAH YESTERDAY AT THE BEACH HOUSE ON THE CASPIAN TO TAKE UP THE NAMIBIA ISSUE (SEPTEL). THE BRITISH CHARGE TOLD ME THAT THE SHAH SEEMED TO BE IN EXCELLENT HEALTH, WAS BRONZED, VERY RELAXED, AND IN FINE HUMOR. IN VIEW OF THE RUMORS OF AN ATTEMPTED ASSIASSINATION OF THE SHAH, THE CHARGE TOOK SPECIAL NOTE OF SECURITY ARRANGEMENTS AND FOUND THEM PRACTICALLY NON-EXISTENT.

WE WERE STRUCK IN THE LAST SUBPARA OF PARA 3 OF REFTEL, COVERING OTHER AMENDMENTS RELATED TO HOUSE ACTION ON SECURITY ASSISTANCE, TO SEE THAT THERE IS EXPECTATION OF "AN AMENDMENT TO LIMIT ARMS SALES TO IRAN." THAT IS A NEW ONE TO US, AND WE WOULD APPRECIATE RECEIVING DETAILED PARTICULARS, INCLUDING FULL BACKGROUND.

IF, INDEED, SUCH AN AMENDMENT IS A REAL PROSPECT, WE IMAGINE THAT OUR FRIENDS HERE WILL HAVE CONSIDERABLY MORE THAN A MILD REACTION. IT SEEMS TO US THAT THEY MIGHT WONDER ABOUT THE DISCUSSIONS ON ARMS SALES DURING THE SHAH'S VISIT LAST NOVEMBER, THE UTILITY OF HAVING AGREED TO A LONG RANGE PROCUREMENT APPROACH, AND THE DEGREE OF CREDENCE TO BE PLACED IN UNDER SECRETARY NEWSOM'S INSTRUCTED REPORT TO THE SHAH JULY 9 THAT THE U.S. REACTION TO "THE LONG TERM LIST IS GENERALLY SYMPATHETIC."
IT WOULD BE HELPFUL TO HAVE YOUR THOUGHTS IN HAND, AT LEAST ON A CONTINGENCY BASIS, IN CASE ANY WORD OF THIS POSSIBLY WORKS ITS WAY INTO THE PRESS.

SUMMARY: VIOLENCE IN SHIRAZ AND ISFAHAN OVER PAST WEEKEND HAS TOUCHED ON AMERICANS. THESE AND SEVERAL OTHER INCIDENTS APPEAR TO HAVE STEMMED FROM MEMORIAL CEREMONIES LINKED TO BURIAL OF AYATOLLAH KAFI. RELIGIOUS COMMUNITY TOUCHY. END SUMMARY

SHIRAZ CONSUL TOMSETH REPORTS CROWD BROKE ALL WINDOWS IN SHIRAZ IAS ABOUT 10 PM EVENING JULY 27. POLICE GUARDING INSTALLATION RAN AWAY AND HID, FINALLY REPORTING INCIDENT FOLLOWING MORNING. INVESTIGATION UNDERWAY. CONSUL KNOWS OF NO OTHER UNTOWARD EVENTS IN SHIRAZ IN PAST FEW DAYS.

ON JULY 28-29, ISFAHAN SAW MAJOR DEMONSTRATION AND VIOLENCE, SOME OF WHICH COINCIDENTALLY AFFECTED AMERICANS. ACCORDING TO ANCONSUL MCGAFFEY, TROUBLE BEGAN EVENING JULY 28 WHEN CROWD EXITED ABOUT 9:30 PM FROM MEMORIAL SERVICE FOR AYATOLLAH KAFI AT WHICH MASHAD MULLAH'S STATEMENT WAS READ, REPORTEDLY REFEREING TO "MASSACURE" IN MASHAD. CROWN SURROUNDED PASSING GRUMMAN CO. BUS AND BROKE SEVERAL WINDOWS, BUT THERE WERE NO INJURIES.

ISFAHAN CROWN THEN PROCEEDED DOWN STREET, BREAKING ALL WINDOWS IN 60-PLUS PARKED AUTOMOBILES AND CAME TO MAIN INTERSECTION NEAR U.S. CONSULATE. MOB INTERRUPTED TRAFFIC OVER NEARBY CITY BRIDGE. IN PROCESS, ONE AMERICAN'S CAR WAS SURROUNDED AND ONE WINDOW BROKEN. POLICE EVENTUALLY BROKE UP MOB AND CHASED PEOPLE AWAY, SUBSEQUENTLY CLOSING OFF CHAR BAGH ST., A MAIN DOWNTOWN ARTERY. CITY HAS REMAINED UNEASY FOR PAST TWO DAYS. CITY BUS DRIVERS ARE ON STRIKE, AND SERVERAL BUSSES HAVE REPORTEDLY BEEN STONED. U.S. CONSUL REPORTS MULLAHS IN LOCAL MOSQUES HAVE BEEN MORE STRIDENTLY ANTI-STATE OVER PAST WEEK, AND VOCAL DISCONTENT HAS INCREASED.
DEMONSTRATION WERE NOT RPT NOT DIRECTED AGAINST AMERICANS, BUT SOME HAVE BEEN CAUGHT UP AT RANDOM. CONSUL HAS SUGGESTED TO AMERICAN COMMUNITY THAT PRUDENCE DICTATES KEEPING CLEAR OF CROWDS.

ON EVENINGS JULY 27 AND 28, TEHRAN POLICE ARRESTED TOTAL OF 12 INDIVIDUALS FOR TWO DISRUPTIONS RELATED TO MEMBORIAL SERVICES FOR AYATOLLAH KAFI, ACCORDING TO PRESS. OTHER SOURCES SAY NUMBER ARRESTED MAY HAVE BEEN SOMEWHAT HIGHER, IN 15-20 RANGE, WITH OVER 20 PEOPLE HURT IN MEMORIAL EVENTS. ONE SOURCE NOTED POLICE OBVIOUSLY READY FOR TROUBLE IN WAKE OF EARLIER OUTBREAKS (REFTEL).

ACCORDING TO REPORTS REACHING ISFAHAN, ON JULY 26 CROWD IN RAFSANJAN (KERMAN PROVINCE) TRIED TO PULL DOWN STATUE OF SHAH. POLICE TRIED TO DISPERSE CROWN AND EVENTUALLY FIRED ON GROUP, WITH SOME DEATHS (NO NUMBERS GIVEN). EMBASSY HAS HEARD THIS STORY FROM TWO DIFFERENT SOURCES BUT HAS NO INDEPENDENT CONFIRMATION SPECIFIC DETAILS.

PRESS JULY 20 ALSO CARRIES STORY ABOUT DEMONSTRATION IN HAMADAN WHICH INJURED NUMBER OF PEOPLE WHEN POLICE PREVENTED FURNERAL CROWD FROM SETTING FIR TO RED LIGHT DISTRICT. PRESS SAID TROUBLE BEGAN WHEN FUNERAL FOR AYATOLLAH MOLLAH MOLLAH ALI HAMADANI PASSED NEAR RED LIGHT DISTRICT.

CURRENT RUMOR MAKING ROUNDS IN TEHRAN AND MAJOR CITIES IS THAT DEATHS OF SEVERAL AYATOLLAHS OVER PAST FEW MONTHS MAY INVOLVE SOME OFFICIAL SKULDRUGGERY. FACT THAT ALL THOSE MENTIONED WERE IN THEIR LATE 80'S EXCEPT KAFI, PLUS LACK OF SUSPICIOUS STORIES AT THE TIME SUGGESTS DEATHS WERE NATURAL OR ACCIDENTAL, PRESENCE OF RUMOR SUGGESTS HOW TOUCHY POLITICAL-RELIGIOUS CLIMATE IS HERE AT THE MOMENT.

segments.text: IN ABSENCE DR. KAZEMI WHO IS ON VACATION, EMBOFF CALLED ON HIS DEPUTY, SAID-VAZIRI, WITH REGARD TO USG POSITION ON CONTINENTAL SHELF ISSUE PER REFTEL. SAID-VAZIRI WHO WAS NON-COMMITTAL ON GOI POSITION, PROMISED TO PASS ALONG POINTS TO KAZEMI AT EARLY OPPORTUNITY.

SUMMARY: PRESS WRAPUP REPORTS 300 ARRESTED, SIX KILLED AND 26 INJURED IN 13 CITIES OVER PAST TWO WEEKENDS. SIZABLE DEMONSTRATIONS IN QOM OVER PAST WEEKEND INCLUDING TWO-HOUR RAMPAGE. ONE POLICEMAN KILLED IN EARLIER INCIDENT. ADDITIONAL RIOTS OCCURRED IN KASHAN AND BEHBAHAN, TABRIZ TENSE, DISCONTENT UP ELSEWHERE. END SUMMARY.
KEYHAN INTERNATIONAL (ENGLISH) ON JULY 30, 31 CARRIED SEMIOFFICIAL WRAPUPS ON PAST WEEKEND'S DEMONSTRATIONS. NEW ITEMS NOT REPORTED REFTEL INCLUDE DESCRIPTION OF QOM EVENTS AND INFO ON OTHER RIOTS.

IN QOM, AYATOLLAHS SHARIATMADARI, GOLPAYEGAN AND NAJAFI MAR'ASHI HAD ORGANIZED MOURNING CEREMONIES AT AZAM MOSQUE EVENING JULY 27. ABOUT 10 P.M. CROWD SET OUT FROM MOSQUE AND BROKE BANK AND SHOP WINDOWS ALONG MAIN STREET. POLICE WERE UNABLE TO BRING EVENTS UNDER CONTROL UNTIL MIDNIGHT. ON JULY 27, POLICEMAN WAS KILLED WHEN HE TRIED TO FIELD A LIVE HAND GRENADED THROWN IN FROM A PASSING CAR.

PRESS ALSO REPORTS EVENTS IN SHIRAZ ADDITIONAL TO THOSE REPORTED REFTEL, INCLUDING ARREST OF 60-70 DEMONSTRATORS FOLLOWING MOURNING CEREMONIES AT JAMEH ATHIGH MOSQUE. IN ADDITION TO IAS STONING (REFTEL), TWO MOVIEW HOUSES AND SEVERAL BANKS WERE DAMAGED.
US CONSUL METRINKO REPORTS TABRIZ BAZAAR WAS CLOSED JULY 29 IN COMMEMORATION OF DEATHS OF AYATOLLAHS. VOCAL DISCONTENT HAS INCREASED SHARPLY IN TABRIZ AS WELL AS IN ISFAHAN.

JOURNALIST HERE WHO HAS JUST BEEN IN CONTACT WITH NUMBER OF HIS PROVINCIAL SOURCES SAYS DISCONTENT WITH CURRENT SITUATION IS UP ELSEWHERE IN IRAN. THIS TAKES TWO FORMS: DISGUST THAT GOI HAS NOT CLAMPED DOWN ON DEMONSTRATORS AND INCREASED VOCAL EXPRESSIONS OF DISSATISFACTION WITH COST OF LIVING, BUREAUCRATIC INEFFECTIVENESS OF GOI AND "WHATEVER LOCAL ISSUES ARE BUGGING THE POPULACE." LATTER IS WIDESPREAD, FORMER IS PRIMARILY FOUND AMONG CIVIL SERVANTS, MERCHANTS AND OTHERS TIED TO MODERN SECTOR. WE HAVE HAD SOME HINTS THAT POLICE ARE BECOMING "FED UP" WITH WHAT THEY CONSIDER GOI'S SOFT POLICY, PARTICULARLY IN WAKE OF POLICE KILLINGS OVER PAST WEEKEND.
BEST ROUNDUP BEING SENT VIA USINFO TODAY.

1978TEHRAN07243.subject: IMPLEMENTATION OF ANTI-HIJACKING DECLARATION REACHED AT BONN ECONOMIC SUMMIT CONFERENCE

segments.text: STATE 186923

ACTING HEAD OF POLITICAL SECTION GAVE ACTING DIRECTOR OF INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS AFFAIRS AT MFA U.S. STATEMENT ON BONN DECLARATION CONTAINED REF A. ALTHOUGH GERMANS HAVE NOT YET MADE FULL PRESENTATION MFA, EMBOFF TOOK OPPORTUNITY TO REVIEW POINTS IN PARA 7 REF B. ACTING DIRECTOR REPLIED THAT IRAN IS CERTAINLY IN SYMPATHY WITH BONN DECLARATION AND, SUBJECT TO DISCUSSION AT SENIOR LEVELS, WILL RESPOND FAVORABLY IN SOME WAY. HE ALSO EXPRESSED INTEREST IN MODALITIES WHICH ARE DEVELOPED TO IMPLEMENT DECLARATION.

CONSUL MC GAFFEY IN ISHAHAN HAS JUST INFORMED US BY TELEPHONE THAT PIPE BOMB WAS THROWN OVER REAR WALL OF CONSULATE/ RESIDENCE COMPOUND AT 2330 HOURS LOCAL TIME. NO ONE INJURED. BOMB WAS APPARENTLY LOW CHARGE AND ONLY SUPERFICIAL DAMAGE CAUSED TO STRUCTURE. FRAGMENTS OF BOMB RECOVERED.

ISHAHAN POLICE ARE INVESTIGATING AND POLICE SECURITY AROUND CONSULATE/RESIDENCE HAS BEEN REINFORCED. EMBASSY SECURITY OFFICER WILL GO TO ISHAHAN FIRST AVAILABLE FLIGHT AUGUST 2 AND HAS IN MEANTIME GOT IN TOUCH WITH IRANIAN NATIONAL POLICE HERE.

THS IS FIRST CLEARLY ANTI-AMERICAN INCIDENT IN ISHAHAN IN RECENT DEMONSTRATIONS AND RIOTS. MC GAFFEY BELIEVES PREVIOUSLY REPORTED INCIDENTS INVOLVING GRUMMAN BUS AND PRIVATE AMERICAN CAR WERE SIMPLY CASES OF THESE VEHICLES BEING CAUGHT UP IN STREET DEMONSTRATIONS.
