IN VIEW OF THE ONSET OF RAMAZAN AUGUST 3 AND THE POSSIBILITY OF FURTHER DISTURBANCES IN IRAN, I HAVE AUTHORIZED THE FOLLOWING STATEMENT TO BE GIVEN TO THE AMERICAN COMMUNITY. THE EVENING OF AUGUST 3 IS THE BEGINNING OF THE MOSLEM HOLY MONTH OF RAMAZAN. A NUMBER OF RELIGIOUS CEREMONIES WILL BE HELD AT VARIOUS TIMES FOR THE NEXT TWO OR THREE DAYS. IN VIEW OF DISTURBANCES FOLLOWING RECENT MEMORIAL SERVICES THE EMBASSY SUGGESTS THAT AMERICANS RESIDING IN TEHRAN AND OTHER CITIES AVOID AREAS WHERE THERE ARE LIKELY TO BE LARGE PUBLIC GATHERINGS FOR THE NEXT FEW DAYS. SUCH AREAS WOULD INCLUDE BAZAARS AND MOSQUES.
THERE IS NO SUGGESTION THAT ANY ACTIVITIES ARE BEING DIRECTED AGAINST FOREIGNERS, BUT IN VIEW OF THE CIRCUMSTANCES WE BELIEVE PRUDENCE SUGGESTS A LOW PROFILE. UNQUOTE

I HAVE READ THE STATEMENT AND DISCUSSED THE GENERAL SECURITY SITUATION WITH DARIUS BOYANDOR, THE PRIME MINISTER'S SPECIAL ASSISTANT, AND HE SHOWED COMPLETE UNDERSTANDING OF WHAT WE ARE DOING. NAAS *** Current Handling Restrictions *** n/a *** Current Classification *** CONFIDENTIAL
PAN AM OFFICE TEHRAN ADVISED THAT IRANIAN GOVERNMENT TURNED DOWN PAN AM'S REQUEST FOR EXTENSION OF 21-45 DAY EXCURSION FARES.

SUMMARY: BOMBING AT ISFAHAN CONSULATE EVENING AUG. 1 APPEARS DIRECTLY RELATED TO RELIGIOUS UNREST FOLLOWING APPREHENSION OR KIDNAPPING OF MULLAH TAHERI. TAHERI'S DISAPPEARANCE (EVENING JULY 31) SPARKED SUBSTANTIAL WAVE OF RIOTING IN ISFAHAN AGU. 1 WHICH RESULTED IN POLICE FIRING INTO CROWDS ON AT LEAST TWO KNOWN OCCASIONS. IN VIEW OF THESE INCIDENTS AND ONSET OF RAMAZAN EVENING AUG. 3, EMBASSY AND CONSULATE ADVISING AMERICANS TO MAINTAIN LOW PROFILE AND AVOID CROWDED PUBLIC AND RELIGIOUS AREAS. END SUMMARY.

FOLLOWING COMPILED FROM NUMBER OF SOURCES BOTH OFFICIAL AND OTHERWISE NOT ALL OF WHICH IDENTIFIED IN TEXT. CONSULAR OFFICER MCGAFFEY IN ISFAHAN INFORMS EMBASSY NEW INFORMATION AVAILABLE INDICATES MULLAH TAHERI WHO HAD RETURNED FROM INTERNAL EXILE ABOUT TWO WEEKS AGO WAS TAKEN FROM HIS HOME EVENING OF JULY 31 BY PERSONS UNKNOWN. HIS RELIGIOUS SUPPORTERS, SUSPECTING OFFICIAL INVOLVEMENT, WENT ON RAMPAGE IN HOSSEINABAD AREA OF ISFAHAN AUG. 1. EYEWITNESS REPORTS BURNING STREET BARRICADES AT SEVERAL LOCATIONS, SUBSTANTIAL DAMAGE TO BANKS AND OTHER BUILDINGS INCLUDING SIX INCENDIARY BOMB INCIDENTS, AND POLICE FIRING INTO CROWDS.

THESE ARE BELIEVED TO BE THE WORK OF RELIGIOUS GROUPS WHO ARE EITHER SUPPORTERS OF TAHERI AND AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI OR PERHAPS FANATIC FACTIONS TAKING ADVANTAGE OF THE DISTURBANCES. MCGAFFEY NOTES TAHERI MIGHT AS EASILY HAVE BEEN KIDNAPPED BY MOSLEM FANATIC RIGHTISTS AS BY OFFICIAL SOURCES.

TAHERI'S SUPPORTERS ARE THOSE WHO FORMED SEVERAL DEFENSE GROUPS AGAINST OFFICIALLY INSPIRED CIVILIAN RESISTANCE GROUPS WHO ATTEMPTED TO CONTROL DEMONSTRATORS IN APRIL/MAY. ALTHOUGH THERE HAS BEEN NO KNOWN ACTIVITY BY EITHER CIVILIAN RESISTANCE UNITS OR OTHER VIGILANTE GROUPS IN INTERVENING MONTHS, TAHERI DISAPPEARANCE APPARENTLY WAS SPARK WHICH TRIGGERED MORE SUBSTANTIAL VIOLENCE.

AMERICAN CITIZEN EYEWITNESS WHO FOUND HIMSELF IN A CROWD AUG. 1 REPORTS POLICE FIRED AT THE CROWD AND ONE CHILD WAS HIT IN THE HEAD AND DIED. OTHERS MAY HAVE BEEN INJURED AND POSSIBLY KILLED AS WELL. SAME SOURCE SAW SMALL GROUPS OF POLICE CHASE SOME RIOTERS INTO SMALL ALLEYS AND RETURN AFTER SINGLE SHOT HAD BEEN FIRED. SOURCE DID NOT SEE ANYONE DEAD AS A RESULT OF THESE FORAYS BUT BELIEVES THERE IS HIGH PROBABILITY DEMONSTRATORS WERE KILLED. REPORT, NOT FULLY CONFIRMED, INDICATES AT LEAST ONE BELL HELICOPTER EMPLOYEE WAS SHOT AT ON WAY TO WORK AUG. 2.
SOURCE OF SHOTS UNKNOWN (BUT BEST INFORMATION INDICATES POLICE ONLY GROUP FIRING UP TO THIS POINT).

EMBASSY COMMENT: RELIGIOUS UNREST FOLLOWING MOURNING CEREMONIES FOR DECEASED RELIGOUS LEADERS HAS BEEN REPORTED SEPTELS. KHOMEINI RELIGIOUS FORCES HAVE CLEARLY USED MOURNING CEREMONIES FOR POLITICAL PURPOSES AND RESULTANT UNREST HAS SIGNIFICANTLY INCREASED TENSENESS IN COUNTRY, PARTICULARLY IN CITIES WHERE DEMONSTRATIONS HAVE OCCURRED. FACT THAT SUCH EVENTS OCCURRED SO CLOSE TO BEGINNING OF FASTING PERIOD OF RAMAZAN HAS INCREASED POTENTIAL FOR CIVILIAN VIOLENCE AND UNREST.

BOMBING AT ISFAHAN CONSULATE IS FIRST INCIDENT THERE ESPECIALLY DIRECTED AT AMERICANS OR AMERICAN INSTALLATIONS. FACT THAT BOMBING WAS SIMPLE PIPE BOMB AND NOT INCENDIARY DEVICE AS VIRTUALLY ALL PREVIOUS ONES IN ISFAHAN, SUGGESTS IT MAY NOT HAVE BEEN SAME GROUP. UNLESS TAHERI SUPPORTERS MAY HAVE HIT CONSULATE ALONG WITH OTHER TARGETS USING DIFFERENT TYPE OF WEAPON, EMBASSY'S BEST GUESS IS THAT CONSULATE BOMBING WAS WORK OF SMALL FANATIC FRINGE GROUP WHICH MAY NOT HAVE PREVIOUSLY SURFACED. ALTHOUGH BOMB PRODUCED SUBSTANTIAL FRAGMENTATION, TIMING OF INCIDENT SEEMED DESIGNED TO FRIGHTEN RATHER THAN TO HURT.
ADDITIONAL GURDS HAVE BEEN REQUESTED FROM IRANIAN AUTHORITIES FOR CONSULATE ISFAHAN AS WELL AS CONSULATES SHIRAZ AND TABRIZ.

THERE IS NO INDICATION THAT RELIGIOUS ACTIVITY HAS BEEN OR WILL BE DIRECTED AGAINST FOREIGNERS, HOEVER, THE COMPETITION BETWEEN IRANIAN MULLAHS FOR POLITICAL/ RELIGIOUS PROMINENCE CAN HAVE THE EFFECT OF FORCING ALL MULLAHS TO SUPPORT THEIR MORE EXTREME BRETHERN, HOWEVER LUKEWARMLY, IN ANY CIVILIAN CONFRONTATION WITH SECURITY FORCES. THIS WOULD, OVER TIME, ACTIVATE THE LATENT XENOPHOBIA IN IRANIAN RELIGIOUS FUNDAMENTALISM. RELIGIOUS DISSIDENCE IS LIKELY TO EVOLVE SUBSTANTIALLY OVER THE NEXT FIVE WEEKS, THOUGH IN WHAT DIRECTION, IT IS NOW DIFFICULT TO TELL. OVER PAST TWO WEEKS, THERE HAS BEEN GENERAL PERCEPTION THAT GOI EFFORTS TO COME TO SOME SORT OF ARRANGEMENT WITH RELIGIOUS FORCES HAVE NOT BEEN SUCCESSFUL.
THERE ARE LIKELY TO BE RENEWED EFFORTS IN THIS DIRECTION, BUT ALSO SOME, IF NOT SUBSTANTIAL, STIFFENING OF GOVERNMENT ATTITUDES.
IN VIEW OF ONSET OF RAMAZAN, AMERICAN CITIZENS ARE BEING CAUTIONED TO MAINTAIN A LOW PROFILE (SEPTEL).

SUMMARY: TWO MORE BOMBING INCIDENTS IN ISFAHAN, MULLAH TAHERI UNDER ARREST IN TEHRAN. ELSEWHERE QUIET REIGNS. END SUMMARY

AT ABOUT 5 P.M. AUGUST 2, FOUR UNKNOWN INDIVIDUALS BROKE WINDOWS OF THE POL RESTAURANT AND FIRE BOMBED IT, COMPLETELY GUTTING IT. TWO EMPLOYEES IN BUILDING ESCAPED UNHURT, NO INJURIES KNOWN. RESTAURANT IS SITUATED IN COMPLEX WHICH INCLUDES SUITE AND PARK RESIDENTIAL HOTELS WHICH WERE DAMAGED BY SMOKE AND ARE USED EXTENSIVELY BY BELL HELICOPTER INTERNATIONAL AND IRANIAN ARMY AIR FORCE. ALTHOUGH RESTAURANT OWNED BY A KOREAN, IT WAS USED ALMOST ENTIRELY BY AMERICANS.

ABOUT FIVE HOURS LATER, LARGE FIRE WITH HIGH RISING SMOKE COLUMN WAS NOTED NEAR SEITOON MOSQUE (MULLAH TAHERI'S HOME MOSQUE) IN SOUTHERN ISFAHAN. EXTENT OF DAMAGE THERE NOT KNOW. ISFAHAN QUIET SO FAR ON AUGUST 3.

ISFAHAN U.S. CONSUL MCGAFFEY NOTES THAT THIS IS SECOND INCIDENT WHICH SEEMS AT LEAST PARTIALLY TARGETED AT FOREIGNORS (WHICH IN ISFAHAN VIRTUALLY MEANS AMERICANS, GIVEN PREPONDERANT NUMBER OF AMCITS THERE). SO FAR AUGUST 3 SCENE IS QUIET.

SAVAK ISFAHAN CONFIRMED TO MCGAFFEY THAT MULLAH TAHERI HAD BEEN ARRESTED BY SAVAK TEAM BECAUSE HE HAD CONTINUED TO "SAY BAD THINGS," AFTER HIS RETURN FROM EXILE. ACCORDING TO SAVAK SOURCE IN ISFAHAN, TAHERI HAS BEEN MOVED TO TEHRAN.
ELSEWHERE IN IRAN, SITUATION APPEARS QUIET.

1978TEHRAN07372.subject: BIOGRAPHIC BACKGROUND ON NEW GOI AMBASSADORS

segments.text: A SERIES OF INTERDEPENDENT CHANGES IN GOI REPRESENTATION ABRAOD TOOK PLACE RECENTLY. ALL THREE OF THE REASSIGNED AMBASSADORS ARE CAREER DIPLOMATS WHO HAVE PREVIOUSLY HELD SENIOR POSITIONS WITHIN THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS.

SADEGH SADRIEYH, 54, HAS BEEN APPOINTED AMBASSADOR TO THE FEDERAL REPUBLIC OF GERMANY. HE IS A GRADUATE OF TEHRAN UNIVERISITY (LAW; 1945) AND HAS A DOCTORATE IN ECONOMICS FROM THE UNIVERSITY OF COLOGNE (1953). PREVIOUS POSTS INCLUDED STUTTGART, PARIS, HERAT (AFGHANISTAN), KUWAIT, TEL AVIV AND BERN. HE WAS AMBASSADOR IN BUCHAREST FROM 1970 TO 1973 AND AMBASSADOR IN BAGHDAD FROM 1976 UNTIL HIS RECENT APPOINTMENT. FROM 1973-1976 HE WAS DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR ASIAN AND AFRICAN AFFAIRS AT THE MINISTRY. SADRIYEH HAS HELD SEVERAL OTHER MINISTRY ASSIGNMENTS, INCLUDING CHIEF OF THE SECRETARIAT. EMBASSY TEHRAN OFFICES HAVE FOUND HIM COOPERATIVE, KNOWLEDGEABLE AND WELL-DISPOSED TOWARD THE UNITED STATES.

ALTHOUGH HE DOES NOT READILY VOLUNTEER INFORMATION, HE IS QUITE FORTHCOMING (BY IRANIAN OFFICIAL STANDARDS) IN RESPONSE TO SPECIFIC QUESTIONS. SADRIEYH WAS MARRIED IN 1974 AND BOTH HE AND HIS WIFE SPEAK ENGLISH AND FRENCH. HE, AT LEAST, SPEAKS GERMAN. THEY HAVE TWO CHILDREN. (MOST RECENT BIO UPDATE PROVIDED BAGHDAD 1282.)

HOOSHANG AMIR-MOKRI, HAVING BEEN REPLACED BY SADREIYH, WILL BE MOVING EASTWARD AS AMBASSADOR TO POLAND. MFA SOURCES ASSERT THAT AMIR-MOKRI'S BRIEF ENNURE IN BONN (LESS THAN ONE YEAR) IS NOT THE RESULT OF ANY PERSONAL FAILING ON HIS PART BUT RATHER A RESULT OF "ADMINISTRATIVE NECESSITY". IN FACT, PRESIDENT AND MRS. SCHEEL PAID A HIGHLY SUCCESSFUL OFFICIAL VISIT TO IRAN LAST APRIL. PRIOR TO HIS SERVICE IN GERMANY AMIR-MOKRI WAS A DIRECTOR GENERAL IN MFA SUPERVISING SEVERAL DEPARTMENTS, INCLUDING INTERNATIONAL AFFAIRS. HE ALSO SERVED A NUMBER OF YEARS WITH THE IRANIAN DELEGATION TO THE UNITED NATIONS IN NEW YORK. EMBASSY TEHRAN CONTACTS HAVE FOUND AMIR-MOKRI FRIENDLY AND KNOWLEDGEABLE.

HE LISTENS CAREFULLY, UNDERSTANDS THE POINT QUICKLY AND DOES NOT INDULGE IN PALAVER. HE HAS BEEN USEFUL IN OBTAINING DECISIONS FOR US WITHIN DEADLINES, SOMETIMES IMMEDIATELY MAKING THE DECISION HIMSELF. (WE WOULD BE INTERESTED IN EMBASSY BONN'S ASSESSMENT OF AMIR-MOKRI'S TOUR AND ANY ADDITIONAL BIOGRAPHIC INFORMATION WHICH MIGHT BE AVAILABLE AT THAT POST.)

FEREIDOUN ZANDFARD, RECENTLY REPLACED IN PAKISTAN BY SAVAK CHIEF GEN. NASSIRI, HAS NOW BEEN NAMED AMBASSADOR TO IRAQ REPLACING SADRIEYH. ZANDFARD, 52, GRADUATED FROM THE UNIVERSITY OF TEHRAN IN POLITICAL SCIENCE. HE ENTERED MFA IN 1948 AND HAS SERVED IN THE FOLLOWING DEPARTMENTS: RECORDS, TREATIES AND LEGAL AFFAIRS; PERSONNEL; ECONOMIC AFFAIRS; INTERNATIONAL COOPERATION DEPT; AND MIDDLE EAST AND PERSIAN GULF AFFAIRS. ABROAD HE HAS SERVED AT THE IRANIAN MISSION TO THE UNITED NATIONS IN NEW YORK AND WAS IRANIAN AMBASSADOR TO KUWAIT 1971-76. FOLLOWING HIS RETURN FROM KUWAIT HE WAS HEAD OF THE MFA DIPLOMATIC PLANS AND PROJECTS COUNCIL (SIMILAR TO STATE'S S/P).

ZANDFARD SERVED ABOUT ONE YEAR IN ISLAMBAD BEFORE BEING TRANSFERRED TO MAKE WAY FOR THE POLITICALLY HARD-TO-PLACE NASSIRI. THE EMBASSY HAS HAD A GOOD WORKING RELATIONSHIP WITH ZANDFARD FOR A NUMBER OF YEARS, GOING BACK TO THE LATE 60S WHEN HE WAS HEAD OF THE MIDDLE EAST AND PERSIAN GULF AFFAIRS DEPT. HE HAS BEEN GENERALLY WELL INFORMED, THOUGH DISCREET, AND REASONABLY FORTHCOMING IN DISCUSSING GOI POSITIONS. ALTHOUGH HIS PRIMARY AREA OF EXPERTISE HAS BEEN THE PERSIAN GULF, HE HAS BECOME KNOWLEDGEABLE OF WIDER CONCERNS THROUGH HIS POLICY PLANNING EXPERIENCE.

WHILE HE PRESENTS A FAIRLY UNIMPRESSIVE FIRST IMPRESSION, A SHY PERSON WITH RETIRING DEMEANOR, HE IS REPORTEDLY HELD IN PARTICULARLY HIGH REGARD BY HIS MFA COLLEAGUES. THIS IS REFLECTED BY HIS RELATIVELY RAPID REASSIGNMENT TO ONE OF IRAN'S MOST IMPORTANT DIPLOMATIC POSTS.

1978TEHRAN07449.subject: WIND ENERGY PLEASE INFORM DR. WILLIAM L. HUGHES, U.S. COORDINATOR ON WIND ENERGY, OKLAHOMA STATE UNIVERSITY, STILLWATER

segments.text: PLEASE INFORM DR. WILLIAM L. HUGHES, U.S. COORDINATOR ON WIND ENERGY, OKLAHOMA STATE UNIVERSITY, STILLWATER, OKLAHOMA, (TELEPHONE (405) 624-5157), THAT PROFESSOR SABZEWARI OF PAHLAVI UNIVERSITY IN SHIRAZ AGREES TO HUGHES PROPOSALS IN LETTERS OF JULY 20 AND 25, 1978.

1978TEHRAN07454.subject: WEEKEND RELATIVELY QUIET, ANTI-AMERICANISM APPEARS INCREASING

segments.text: SUMMARY: ADDITIONAL INCIDENTS IN ISFAHAN, TEHRAN QUIET, QOM SCENE OF DISTRUBANCES. ANTI-AMERICAN STRAIN DEVELOPING IN OPPOSITION STATEMENTS. END SUMMARY.

IN ADDITION TO ISFAHAN INCIDENTS NOTED REFTEL, PERSONAL VEHICLE OF HARZA COMPANY EMPLOYEE WAS DESTROYED BY FIREBOMB AUG. 3 IN ISFAHAN. ON AUG. 6, TWO MOLOTOV COCKTAILS WERE THROWN AGAINST ONE BUILDING OF ISFAHAN AMERICAN SCHOOL, BUT SUBSEQUENT INVESTIGATION TENDSTO INDICATE BOMBS THROWN BY TWO AMERICAN YOUTHS. INVESTIATION CONTINUING.

PAST WEEKEND WAS GENERALLY QUIET IN IRAN, AS COUNTRY BEGAN RAMAZAN. NO DISTURBANCES WERE NOTED IN TEHRAN. EXCEPT FOR ISFAHAN AND QOM, PROVINCIAL TOWNS, INCLUDING MASHAD, WERE QUIET. SHIRAZ REPORTED POLICE GUARD AROUND MOSQUE AUG 4, BUT NO DISTURBANCES. ISRAELI DIPLOMAT TRAVELING IN KURDESTAN AND AZARBAIJAN REPORTS ALL QUIET THERE, BUT TENSE, WITH MINORITY RELIGIOUS COMMUNITIES FEELING ISLAMIC PRESSURE.

SOURCE WHO WAS IN QOM FRIDAY THRU SUNDAY SAYS THERE WAS DEMONSTRATION AUG. 4 LATER ACCOMPANIED BY POLICE FIRING. AUG. 5 WAS QUIET, BUT THERE WAS RELIGIOUS MOURNING SERVICE IN HONOR OF CONSTITUTION DAY. THIS WAS FOLLOWED AUG. 6 BY RENEWED DEMONSTRATIONS AND MORE POLICE FIRING. SOURCE SAID FIRING WAS SPORADIC AND THERE WAS NO TALK OF CASUALTIES OTHER THAN A FEW INJURED.

KNOWLEDGEABLE SOURCE WHO HAS BEEN IN CONTACT WITH MULLAHS AND OPPOSITION LEADERS OVER PAST WEEK OR TEN DAYS TOLD POLOFF THAT NUMBER OF OPPOSITION FIGURES TAKING MORE ANTI-AMERICAN LINE THAN PREVIOUSLY. ACCORDING TO SOURCE, ISFAHAN MULLAHS, LED BY AYATOLLAH KHADEMI, HAVE BEEN PUTTING FORTH LINE THAT AMERICANS ARE CHIEF SUPPORTERS OF SHAH, PRINCIPAL EXPLOITERS OF IRAN'S WEALTH, AN ELITE GROUP OF FOREIGNERS WITH SPECIAL PRIVILEGE, AND THE PRINCIPAL CAUSES OF TENSION BETWEEN THE USSR AND IRAN. THIS THEME WAS PARTICULARLY PREVALENT IN ISFAHAN WEEKEND JULY 28-29.

SOME UNION OF NATIONAL FRONT LEADERS HAVE BEEN MAKING POINT PRIVATELY TO DIFFERENT GROUPS THAT AMERICANS HAVE NOT BEEN RESPONDING FAST ENOUGH TO IRAN'S POLITICAL NEEDS AND HAVE NOT BEEN PUTTING ENOUGHT PRESSURE ON SHAH. MAJLES DEPUTY BANI-AHMAD SAID SAME THING ABOUT TEN DAYSAGO IN SPEECH TO TABRIZ GROUP. (COMMENT: THIS LINE MAY CHANGE IN VIEW OF SHAH'S AUG 5 CONSTITUTION DAY SPEECH OF POLITICAL LIBERALIZATION BEING REPORTED SEPTEL.).

INCREASING ANTI-U.S. TENOR OF OPPOSITION STATEMENTS HAS NOT YET SURFACED PUBLICLY AND MAY NOT BECOME REGULAR PART OF OPPOSITION LITANY. MOST DISSIDENTS STILL COUNT ON U.S. GOOD WILL, BUT PARADOXICALLY, GOI LIBERALIZATION MEASURES SEEM TO INCREASE INTERNAL TENSIONS WITHIN OPPOSITION GROUPS AND THIS, PLUS INEVITABLE PERSONAL JOCKEYING FOR POSITION, HAS PRODUCED PRESENT ANTI-U.S. TONE. ONE SOURCE BELIEVES KHOMEINI GROUP IS DELIBERATELY SPREADING ANTI-US LINE BECAUE OF ITS BASIC IDEOLOGICAL STANCE AND ITS DESIRE TO TRY AND CUT SUPPORT AWAY FROM MORE MODERATE LEADER, AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI.

FOR NEA/IRN ONLY. IT APPEARS TO US THAT AMERICAN SOURCES ARE FINALLY CATCHING UP WITH THE RUMORS WHICH I PASSED TO YOU PREVIOUSLY. THERE IS NOTHING NEW IN THIS FRONT EXCEPT A PERSISTENT REFRAIN THAT THE SHAH'S HEALTH MAY NOT BE AS GOOD AS DESIRED. THERE IS, HOWEVER, NO BASIS IN FACT FOR THIS LINGERING STORY TO THE BEST OF OUR KNOWLEDGE.

SHAH DELIVERED VIDEOTAPED CONSTITUTION DAY SPEECH AUG 5 AND APPEARED IN GOOD HEALTH. SENIOR PRESSMAN WHO WAS PRESENT FOR AT LEAST PART OF FILMING LATE LAST WEEK SAID SHAH LOOKED IN EXCELLENT HEALTH AND DISPLAYED GOOD SENSE OF HUMOR. MOST LOCAL NEWSMEN BEGINNING TO DISCOUNT RUMORS AND SEE THEM AS WORK OF OPPOSITIONISTS, BUT FOREIGN AND DOMESTIC. IRANIAN OFFICIAL, WHEN CONFRONTED BY RUMORS OF SHOOTING IN LEG AS LATE AS AUG 1 OR 2, REMARKED RATHER DRYLY THAT SHAH DID NOT SEEM TO BE SUFFERING MUCH DURING IMPROMPTU NOWSHAHR VOLLEYBALL GAME PRIOR TO A MINISTERIAL AUDIENCE NEAR THE END OF LAST WEEK.

COMMITTED RUMORMONGERS HERE, OF COURSE, EVEN INSIST THIS IS PART OF COURT COVERUP, WITH SHAH TAPING CONSTITUTION SPEECH TWO MONTHS PREVIOUSLY. RAPIDITY WITH WHICH RUMORS HAVE CHANGED TO AVOID REALITY HAS BEEN TRULY IMPRESSIVE. BLOC DIPLOMATS ALSO CONTINUE TO DISSEMINATE RUMORS. JUST RECENTLY BULGARIAN CHARGE GAVE ME SONG AND DANCE ABOUT SHAH'S ILL-HEALTH. UNFORTUNATELY, SOME AMERICAN CITIZENS ARE AS PRONE TO "RUMOR RECONSOLIDATION" TOO, AND THIS MAY BE SOURCE OF "CONFIRMATIONS," WHICH KEEP STORIES CYCLING IN U.S.
OUR BASIC LINE REMAINS THAT GIVEN IN REF B.

ONE OF THE MORE DISTURBING ASPECTS OF THE ACTIVITIES OF THE MORE EXTREME RELIGIOUS GROUPS THAT HAS COME TO LIGHT IS A VICIOUS ANTI-SEMITIC CAMPAIGN. WE FIRST HEARD OF THIS DEVELOPMENT A FEW WEEKS AGO BUT, IN VIEW OF THE ABSENCE OF HARD EVIDENCE, WE DID NOT REPORT ON IT. ALSO, ONE OF OUR PRINCIPAL SOURCES AFFIRMED THAT THE PROPAGANDA WAS ANTI-ZIONIST (AGAINST ISRAEL'S POLICY RE OCCUPIED LANDS) AND NOT DIRECTED AT THE JEWISH COMMUNITY. THI FACILE-- AND SUSPICIOUS AT THE TIME-EXPLANATION HAS BEEN BELIED BY A NUMBER OF TRACTS CURRENTLY BEING PASSED OUT IN TEHRAN AND ELSEWHERE.
A JUNE 2 FLYER WHICH WE JUST OBTAINED READS AS FOLLOWS: "WARNING TO ALL THE JEWS OF IRAN.

YOU BLOOD-SUCKING PEOPLE WHO HAVE GATHERED IN OUR ISLAMIC COUNTRY AND ARE BLEEDING EVERYONE OF US MOSLEMS BY EXTORTING MONEY-LENDING INTEREST, THEFT AND SWINDLING AND SENDING THE WEALTH COLLECTED IN THIS WAY TO THE ZIONIST COUNTRY OF ISRAEL, AND BY APPROPRIATING THE HOUSES OF HOMELESS MOSLEMS ARE CAUSING DAILY INCREASE OF HOUSING COSTSS* BE AWARE NOW THAT YOUR GOLDEN DAYS ARE OVER, AND YOU ARE HEREBY WARNED TO LEAVE THIS COUNTRY AS SOON AS YOU CAN; OTHERWISE WE WILL MASSACRE ALL JEWS, BIG AND SMALL, AND WILL LOOT YOUR ILLEGALLY GAINED RICHES* "A HITLER IS A NECESSITY ONCE IN A WHILE TO EXTERMINATE THE JEWS FROM THE EARTH'S FACE SO THAT OUR ARAB BROTHERSIN -FAITH MAY AT LAST LIVE IN PEACE. "YOU HAVE BUT A LITTLE TIME TO ESCAPE* THE NATIONAL FRONT OF YOUNG MOSLEMS IN IRAN" WE UNDERSTAND THAT A PARTICULARLY VILE PAMPHLET DRAWING UPON THE MOSQUE SPEECHES OF AYATOLLAH NOURI OF QOM IS BEING DISTRIBUTED (WE EXPECT TO GET A COPY SOON).
ALSO, A FEW WEEKS AGO THE HOME OF A PROMINENT JEWISH DOCTOR IN HAMADAN WAS BOMBED WITH SERIOUS INJURIES TO A SON, AND A SYNAGOGUE WAS SLIGHTLY DAMAGED IN THE RECENT TROUBLES IN ISFAHAN.

THE ISRAELI MISSION IN TEHRAN IS, OF COURSE, ACUTELY SENSITIVE TO THIS MATTER AND HAS DRAWN THE EVENTS AND TRACTS TO THE ATTENTION OF THE FOREIGN OFFICE. THE JEWISH COMMUNITY IS NERVOUS EMIGRATION HAS INCREASED AND OTHERS ARE TRANSFERRING ASSESTS ABROAD.

THE ANTI-JEWISH EFFORT IS PARALLELED BY RENEWAL OF EFFORTS AGAINST MEMBERS OF THE BAHAI FAITH AND MANY OF THE BANKS AND BUSINESS ESTABLISHMENTS DAMAGED BY THE DEMONSTRATORS ARE OWNED BY BAHAIS OR PERSONS SUSPECTED OF BEING SECRET BAHAIS. IN ADDITION, SEVERAL BAHAI CONTACTS REPORT INDIVIDUAL HARASSMENT ON A SCALE NOT SEEN SINCE THE EARLY 60'S.

COMMENT: THE INCREASED EMIGRATION OF IRANIAN JEWS PARALLELS THE SWELL OF DEPARTURES WE HAVE NOTICED OF ARMENIANS AND ASSYRIANS--MANY TO THE UNITED STATES WHERE MEMBERS OF THEIR FAMILIES HAVE BEN LONG ESTABLISHED. THE MINORITIES, IN SUM, ARE AFRAID THAT THE CURRENT PUBLIC PROMINENCE AND STRENGTH OF THE MORE EXTREME ISLAMIC CONSERVATIVES PORTEND A DIFFICULT PERIOD AHEAD FOR NON-MUSLIMS. MOREOVER, THANKS TO IRAN'S OIL-FED PROSPERITY, MANY NOW HAVE THE CAPITAL TO RESETTLE.

IRAN HAS TRADTIONALLY BEEN A RELIGIOUSLY PLURALISTIC COUNTRY WHERE THE VARIOUS COMMUNITIES HAVE LIVED TOGETHER EASILY. IRANIANS FOR YEARS HAVE TAKEN PRIDE IN PERSIAN TOLERANCE OF MANY FAITHS (EXCEPT FOR BAHAIS) WHICH HAS BEEN IN STRIKING CONTRAST TO THE PRACTICES IN A NUMBER OF COUNTRIES IN THE AREA. THIS CURRENT CAMPAIGN IS DISTRESSING AND ABHORRENT TO MOST OF OUR EDUCATED FRIENDS, BUT THE GOVERNEMENT HAS NO SIMPLE ANSER. A CRACKDOWN ON THE PERPETRATORS OF THIS KIND OF PROPAGANDA WOULD LIKELY NOT BE SEEN FOR WHAT IT WAS BUT RATHER WOULD BE INTERPRETED AS A DIRECT ATTACK ON ALL THE RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP.
THE LIBERALIZATION PROCESS WILL BRING OUT, UNFORTUNATELY, THE SEAMIER SIDE OF IRANAIN POLITICS.

WE BELIEVE THAT SO FAR THE ANTI-SEMITISM CAMPAIGN INVOLVES ONLY A FRINGE OF THE RELIGIOUS LEADERS. IT IS HIGHLY LIKELY THAT THIS EXTREME FACTION IS TIED DIRECTLY TO AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI (IN EXILE IN IRAQ) WHO IN RECENT INTERVIEWS HAS SHOWN A VERY STRONG ANTI-ISRAEL BIAS. KHOMEINI HAS CLOSE TIES WITH THE PLO AND OTHER PALESTINIAN GROUPS, AS WILL AS WITH THE TUDEH PARTY AND TERRORIST GROUPS IN IRAN. THE JUNE 2 FLYER QUOTED ABOVE WAS DISTRIBUTED ACCORDING TO A GOOD SOURCE, BY A GROUP WHICH TAKES IS GUIDANCE FROM KHOMEINI LOYALISTS IN TEHRAN AND HAS SOUGHT TO STRI UP TROUPBLE ON ANY PRETEXT IN THE PAST TWO WEEKS.

1978TEHRAN07512.subject: REPEATED INCIDENTS AT IRAN AMERICA SOCIETY, SHIRAZ, FACILITY

segments.text: WITHIN THE LAST TWO WEEKS, THERE HAVE BEEN THREE INCIDENTS AT THE IRAN AMERICA SOCIETY (IAS) IN SHIRAZ. A DEMONSTRATINGCROWDBROKE IAS WINDOWS DURING THE LATE EVENING HOURS OF JULY 27 AS REPORTED REFTEL. AT APPROXIMATELY 1600 HOURS ON AUGUST 6, A CROWD OF APPROX 200 INDIVIDUALS IN A MARCH OBSERVING THE START OF THE HOLY MOSLEM MONTH OF RAMAZAN GATHERED IN THE STREETS IN THE VICINITY OF THE IAS BUILDING. THEIR MAIN ATTENTION WAS INITIALLY DIRECTED AT A THEATER AND A NEWSPAPER OFFICE ACROSS THE STREET WHERE THEY BROKE WINDOWS, ENTERED THE THEATER, AND CAUSED A FAIR AMOUNT OF PROPERTY DAMAGE UTILIZING STICKS, CLUBS AND STONES.

THE CROWD THEN ATTEMPTED TO ENTER THE IAS FACILITY BUT WERE THWARTED BY A LOCKED PERIMETER GATE. IAS FACILITY WAS OCCUPIED BY STUDENTS AT THE TIME. STONES WERE THROWN AT IAS EMPLOYEES AND STUDENTS CAUSING NO INJURIES BUT KNOCKING OUT 8 WINDOWS WHICH HAD RECENTLY BEEN REPAIRED FROM THE 7/27 INCIDENT. SEVERAL STUDENTS ATTEMPTING TO LEAVE THE BUILDING WERE HARRASSED BY THE CROWD. POLICE WERE SUMMONED AND ARRIVED APPROX FIVE MINUTES AFTER THE CROWN FORMED IN FRONT OF IAS AND WERE SUCCESSFUL IN DISPERSING THE CROWN WHILE FIRING SEVERAL SHOTS INTO THE AIR FOR EFFECT. NO ARRESTS WERE MADE.

AT APPROX 1615 HOURS ON AUG 8, A CROWN OF 200 INDIVIDUALS MARCHED FROM A NEARBY MOSQUE TOWARD THE IAS FACILITY BUT WERE DISPERSED BY POLICE BEFORE THEY COULD ACTUALLY ENTER IAS GROUNDS OR CAUSE ANY DAMAGE. POLICE AGAIN FIRED SHOTS INTO THE AIR FOR EFFECT IN DISPERSING THE CROWD.

IN VIEW OF REPEATED ATTENTION GIVEN IAS FACILITY IN SHIRAZ BY DEMONSTRATING CROWDS, POLICE PROTECTION AT THAT FACILITY HAS BEEN BEEFED UP ALTHOUGH POLICE IN SHIRAZ, AS IN MANY OTHER MAJOR IRANIAN CITIES, ARE ALREADY STRETCHED THIN IN RESPONDING TO CIVIL DISORDERS.

1978TEHRAN07514.subject: IMPLEMENTATION OF ANTI-HIJACKING DECLARATION REACHED AT BONN ECONOMIC SUMMIT CONFERENCE

segments.text: ACTING DIRECTOR INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS DIVISION OF MFA CONFIRMED TO POLOFF THAT GOI WILL BE ISSUING PUBLIC STATEMENT SHORTLY IN SUPPORT OF BONN DECLARATION.

1978TEHRAN07545.subject: POLITICAL SCENE SUMMARY: IAS SHIRAZ AGAIN TARGET FOR DEMONSTRATORS. SOME RIOTERS CONVICTED, OTHERS FREED IN CIVILIAN TRIALS

segments.text: SUMMARY: IAS SHIRAZ AGAIN TARGET FOR DEMONSTRATORS. SOME RIOTERS CONVICTED, OTHERS FREED IN CIVILIAN TRIALS. ANXIETY REMAINS HALLMARK OF POLITICAL SCENE.

AUG. 6 THE IAS BUILDING IN SHIRAZ WAS AGAIN THE TARGET OF DEMONSTRATIONS BY APPROXIMATELY 200 INDIVIDUALS FROM CONSERVATIVE RELIGIOUS ELEMENTS. GROUP BROKE WINDOWS AT IAS AND SOME TRIED TO ENTER THE BUILDING BUT WERE LOCKED OUT. POLICE ARRIVED AND DISPERSED THE CROWD DURING THE COURSE OF WHICH WEAPONS WERE FIRED IN THE AIR.

PRESS AUG 9 ANNOUNCED THAT 24 STUDENTS ON TRIAL IN SARI WERE FREED AFTER WEEK-LONG TRIAL. AT THE SAME TIME, PRESS ANNOUNCED 13 DEMONSTRATORS FROM TEHRAN'S APRIL UNREST HAD BEEN GIVEN THREE-MONTH SENTENCES FOR DISTURBING PUBLIC ORDER.

MINISTRY OF JUSTICE ANNOUNCED AUG. 8 THAT LEGISLATION LEGALIZING DEMONSTRATIONS UNDER CONDITIONS LAID DOWN BY THE SHAH IN HIS CONSTITUTION DAY SPEECH WOULD BE PRESENTED TO PARLIAMENT DIRECTLY AFTER THE SUMMER RECESS WHICH WILL END SEPT. 5 OR 6.

POLITICLY AWARE IRANIANS REMAIN IN A STATE OF ANXIETY. WHILE MANY WELCOME SHAH'S LIBERALIZATION, PROBLEM OF HOW TO TAKE ADVANTAGE OF SITUATION LEAVES MANY ANXIOUS AND OTHERS CONCERNED THAT THE SHAH IS NOT BEING POLITICLY FORCEFUL. A NUMBER OF CONTACTS NOW BELIEVE THEY SEE EVIDENCE THAT THE UNDERGROUND TUDEH (COMMUNIST) PARTY ORGANIZATION HAS QUIETLY MOVED IN TO TACITLY SUPPORT RELIGIOUS GROUPS LOYAL TO AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI. A NUMBER OF ACADEMICS BELIEVE THAT THE OPENING OF THE UNIVERSITY YEAR IN LATE SEPTEMBER WILL BE TIME OF CIVIL UNREST. THE HIGH MOURNING DAYS OF RAMAZAN, AUG 24-26 ARE SEEN AS POTENTIALLY DANGEROUS FOR RELIGIOUS DEMONSTRATIONS.

SUMMARY: AFTER QUIET FEW DAYS SURROUNDING CONSTITUTION DAY AUG. 5, SIFAHAN SUFFERED EVENING OF ROAMING CROWDS, FIREBOMBING AND EXTENSIVE DAMAGE TO BUILDINGS AND BANKS. SEVERAL THREATS MADE OT AMCITS, BUT NO CONCERTED ANTI-U.S. CAMPAIGN IN EVIDENCE. END SUMMARY.

CONSUL MCGAFFEY REPORTS THAT NIGHT AUG. 8 SAW CROWDS ROAMING OUTWARD FROM MULLAH TAHERI'S HOME MOSQUE BEGINNING AT 10PM TO SET FIRE TO A NUMBER OF BUILDINGS, INCLUDING SEVERAL BANKS. THRE WAS A CONFRONTATION WITH POLICE, SHOTS WERE HEARD, AND AMBULANCES WERE SEEN IN CITY. NO CASUALTY FIGURES ARE AVAILABLE.
AMOUNG BUILDINGS HIT WAS JOLFA HOTEL, ONE-THIRD OF WHOSE ROOMS ARE RENTED TO AMERICANS WORKING IN ISFAHAN AND PIZZA HUT, A RESTAURANT ON HAKIM-NEZAMI STREET, FREQUENTED BY MANY AMERICANS.

CONSULATE HAS COLLECTED REPORTS OF SEVERAL INSTANCES ADDITIONAL TO THOSE REFTEL WHERE AMERICANS HAVE BEEN THREATENED AND ONE CASE WHERE AMCIT WAS APPARENTLY SHOT AT BY PELLET GUN. DESPITE THIS, CONSUL DOES NOT RPT NOT BELIEVE RELIGIOUS EXTREMEISTS ARE TARGETING AMERICANS AS SUCH, BUT SITUATION CLEARLY INVOLVES MORE POTENTIAL DANGER THAN IT DID TWO OR THREE WEEKS AGAO. BENEFICIAL SIDE EFFECT HAS BEEN NUMBER OF SMALLER U.S. OUTFITS AND STRAY INDIVIDUALS AMCITS ARE REGISTEREING WITH CONSULATE WHO HAD NOT DONE SO PREVIOUSLY.

DEPUTY MINISTER NADIM TOLD ME AUGUST 10 THAT IRANIAN DELEGATION TO COMMITTEE OF 24 HAS GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS TO SUPPORT US ON GUAM ISSUE. HE WILL BE SENDING SEPARATE INSTRUCTIONS ON THE SOVIET RESOLUTION TO REINFORCE THE GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS THE DELEGATION HAS.

1978TEHRAN07617.subject: MARTIAL LAW IN ISFAHAN; DEMONSTRATIONS IN SHIRAZ.

segments.text: SUMMARY. ISFAHAN PLACED UNDER MARTIAL LAW AFTER HOURS OF MAJOR DISORDERS. UNCONFIRMED REPORTS OF SHOOTINGS IN SHIRAZ AS WELL. END SUMMARY.

CONSUL MCGAFFEY IN ISFAHAN HAS INFORMED US THAT ISFAHAN WAS PLACED UNDER MARTIAL LAW LATE AFTERNOON AUGUST 11. CURFEW ANNOUNCED FOR 8:00PM. PUBLIC ANNOUNCEMENT STATED THAT ANY GROUP LARGER THAN THREE PERSONS WILL BE STOPPED AND SEARCHED; POSSESSION OF ANYTHING CONSIDERED A WEAPON WILL RESULT IN TRIAL UNDER MARTIAL LAW FOR TERRORISM. SUBSTANTIAL MILITARY FORCES ARE DEPLOYED IN CITY.

LARGE AMERICAN COMMUNITY ALERTED IN LATE MORNING BY CONSULATE OF TROUBLE IN CITY AND ADVISED TO STAY HOME. CONSUL NOW ENSURING THAT COMMUNITY AWARE OF MARTIAL LAW REGIME ENFORCEMENT OF CURFEW. THERE ARE RUMORS THAT SOME AMERICANS WERE CAUGHT UP IN DEMONSTRATIONS BUT WE HAVE NO CONFIRMED REPORTS OF INJURIES.

ACCORDING TO MCGAFFEY, STORY IN ISFAHAN IS THAT POLICE TRIED TO END AT 0100 TO 0200 THIS MORNING A HUMGER STRIKE OF MULLAHS DEMANDING RELEASE OF MULLAH TAHERI. THIS ACTION WAS FOLLOWED BY WIDESPREAD DEMONSTRATIONS AND RIOTS; MILITARY FORCES CALLED IN TO SUPPORT POLICE AND THERE HAS BEEN FAIRLY WIDESPREAD FIRING IN CITY. SEVERAL PERSONS KILLED OR WOUNDED ACCORDING TO EYEWITNESSES.
POLICE SECURITY AROUND CONSULATE HAS BEEN STRENGTHENED.
WE HAVE UNCONFIRMED REPORTS OF POLICE FIRING IN SHIRAZ LATE AFTERNOON AUGUST 10 AGAINST MOB WHICH HAD EMERGED FROM MOSQUE. ACCORDING TO VICE CONSUL, SHIRAZ IS QUIET AT THIS TIME.
TABRIZ IS QUIET AND WE HAVE NO REPORTS OF VIOLENCE IN TEHRAN.

1978TEHRAN07659.subject: IRANIAN POLITICAL SITUATION-OVERT VIOLENCE GIVES WAY TO QUIET RUMBLING

segments.text: SUMMARY: AFTER SOMEWHAT TUMULTOUS WEEKEND, SITUATION LESS TENSE IN IRAN AS A RESULT OF MARITAL LAW. STORIES OF ADDITIONAL RIOTS IN SHIRAZ APPEAR INCORRECT. RANDOM VIOLENCE STRUCK OTHER CITIES OVER WEEKEND, HOWEVER, END SUMMARY.

CONSULATE ISFAHAN REPORTS THAT CITY IS QUIET IN WAKE OF GOVERNMENT'S DECLARATION OF MARTIAL LAW AUG 11 (REF A). ONLY TWO INCIDENTS OF BURNING REPORTED, BOTH UNCONFIRMED. CURFEW IS HOLDING BUT GOVERNMENT HAS ISSUED A COMMUNIQUE WARNING PEOPLE NOT TO BE OUT AFTER 8 P.M. PLEADING IGNORANCE OF THE CURFEW. WHILE SITUATION STILL TENSE, CALM PREVAILS.

CONSULATE SHIRAZ REPORTS INITIAL RUMORS THAT 10 HAD BEEN KILLED AND HUNDREDS INJURED ON AUG 11 OR 12 APPEAR IN ERROR. IN MORNING PRESS AUG 13, FARS PROVINCE GOVERNOR AZMOUN ALSO SAID REPORTS WERE WRONG. ONLY MAJOR OUTBREAK IN PAST FEW DAYS IN SHIRAZ WAS THAT ON AUG 11 (REFTELS). CONSULATE HAS HELD MEETING WITH PRINCIPAL AMERICAN BUSINESSMEN AND SITUATION IS RELAXED BUT WATCHFUL.

LOW LELVEL VIOLENCE AFLICTED TEHRAN OVER WEEKEND. TEHRAN PARS AMERICAN CLUB SUFFERED BROKEN WINDONWS AUG 11. IN SOUTH TEHRAN, SEVERAL BANKS AND MOVIES HAD WINDONWS BROKEN AND OTHER DAMAGE DONE. PRESS AUG 13 REPORTS EIGHT BANKS AND THE RESURGENCE PARTY HEADQUARTERS IN KHORAMABAD WERE BURNED AUG 11-12.

IN TABRIZ, CITY REMAINED GENERALLY QUIET. ONLY STUDENTS AT AZARBADEGAN UNIVERSITY RAISED PROTEST AUG 12 OVER RIOTERS IN IRAN. CONCURRENTLY, AN INDUSTRIAL STRIKE CONTINUES OVER ANNUAL BONASES BUT THIS HAS TAKEN ON AIR OF PICNIC RATHER THAN CONFRONTATION.
IN QAZVIN PRESS REPORTS POLICE WERE FORCED TO FIRE IN AIR AND USE TEAR GAS TO BREAK UP DEMONSTRATION.
GOI SOURCES EXPECT FURTHER ATTEMPTS AT DEMONSTRATIONS IN QOM, MASHAD AND TABRIZ.

GOVERNMENT REMAINS FIRM AGAINST VIOLENCE AND FOR POLITICAL LIBERALIZATION. TEHRAN JOURNAL AUG 12 ECHOES GOVERNMENT STATEMENT THAT BALLOT BOX AND NOT VIOLENCE WILL CHART IRAN'S FUTURE COURSE. INTRODUCTION OF SECURITY FORCES TO IRAN IS WELCOMED AND GOVERNMENT'S DETERMINATION TO CARRY ON LIBERALIZATION IS APPLAUDED. KAYHAN EDITORIAL AUG 13 DEPLORES "BLOOD AND DESTRUCTION" AND NOTES THAT IRAN IS SUFFERING FROM INDUSTRIALIZATION AND URBAN PROBLEMS AND CALLS GOVERNMENT'S DECISION TO IMPOSE MARTIAL LAW, A TEMPORARY SOLUTION TO A TEMPORARY PROBLEM. KAYHAN APPLAUDS GOVERNMENT'S DECISION TO GO AHEAD WITH POLITICAL LIBERALIZATION AND SUGGESTS DIVERTING MORE RESOURCES TO THE REMOVAL OF FRUSTRATING URBAN PROGRAMS.

1978TEHRAN07702.subject: PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR-THE FIRST YEAR SUMMARY: PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR HAD MIXED SUCCESS DURING HIS FIRST YEAR IN OFFICE. HIS GOVERNMENT HAS REDU

segments.text: SUMMARY: PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR HAD MIXED SUCCESS DURING HIS FIRST YEAR IN OFFICE. HIS GOVERNMENT HAS REDUCED IRAN'S INFLATION RATE, CUT THE COST OF HOUSING, RELAXED PRICE CONTROLS, RESHAPED IRAN'S IMAGE WITHIN OPEC, OPENED ACTIVE POLITICAL DEBATE AND ACQUIESCED IN THE SHAH'S POLITICAL LIBERALIZATION PROGRAM. THE MEASURES TAKEN TO CURB INFLATION, HOWEVER, HAVE REDUCED INVESTMENT ACTIVITY AND WITH OTHER NAGATIVE ECONOMIC FACTORS RESULTED IN ECONOMIC RETRENCHMENT. THIS, COUPLED WITH UNCERTAINTIES REGARDING THE POLITICAL SYSTEM AND THE RISE OF VIOLENCE WHICH HAS NOT BEEN SUFFICIENTLY CONTROLLED BY POLICE, HAVE LEFT IRAN'S POLITICAL AND ECONOMIC CLIMATE IN A STATE OF UNCERTAINTY.

AMOUZEGAR HIMSELF HAS SHOWN SKILL AND ACCOMPLISHMENT AS AN ADMINISTRATOR, BUT HE HAS NOT SHOWN POLITICAL BROKERAGE SKILLS WHICH WILL BE NECESSARY TO COPE WITH INCREASINGLY ACTIVE RELIGIOUS AND POLITICAL OPPOSITION ND TO ACTIVATE THE RESURGENCE PARTY (RPPI). END SUMMARY.

ON AUG. 6, PRIME MINISTER AMOUZAGAR COMPLETED HIS FIRST YEAR IN OFFICE. TEHRAN JOURNAL AUG. 6 NAND KAYHAN AUG. 8 CARRIED GOOD REVIEWS OF AMOUZEGAR'S FIRST YEAR AS SEENBY LOCAL PRESS. WHILE THESE PAPERS, BOTH IN ENGLISH AND FARSI EDICTIONS, CRITICIZED SOME ASPECTS OF AMOUZEGAR'S HANDLING OF THE ECONOMY, RESURGENCE PARTY PAPER RASTAKHIZ PREDICTABLY HAD NOTHING BUT PRAISE FOR PRIME MINISTER.

AMOUZEGAR'S PERFORMANCE IN ECONOMIC ARENA RECEIVES SCANT PRAISE, PARTIALLY DUE TO THE INCONSPICOUS NATURE OF MOST OF HIS FEW ACCOMPLISHMENTS. FOR EXAMPLE, EN NEITHER HIS CAUTIOUS DISMANTLING OF PRICE CONTROLS NOR ANY EXERCISE OF CONSTRAINT IN APPROVING NEW GOVERNMENT PROGRAMS ANDPROJECTS ARE HEADLINE MATERIAL. THE ABSENCE OF PERCEPTIBLE ECONOMIC DIRECTION, WHILE PERHAPS REFLEXING A DELIBERTATE LAW PROFILE ON THE PART OF THE GOI, IS STRONGLY CRITICIZED BY THE PRIVATE SECTOR. UNCERTAINTIES DERIVING FROM LONG-PROMISED, YET UNACCOMPLISHED, REFORMS IN SUCH AREAS AS TAX AND LABOR LAW AND CONFUSION OVER PRICE AND COMMODITIES' PROCUREMENT POLICIES SUPPORT THE MALAISE EVIDENCED IN LAST YEAR'S ABSOLUTE FALL IN PRIVATE SECTOR INVESTMENT.

SYMPTOMATIC OF WHAT IRANIANS VIEW AS AMOUZEGAR'S INABILITY TO"GET HIS ECONOMIC ACT TOGETHER" IS THE YET UNVEILED SIXTH DEVELOPMENT PLAN, NOW ONE YEAR LATE. ALTHOUGH THERE IS ARGUMENT OVER SPECIFIC FIGURES, AMOUZEGAR GOVERNMENT HAS SUCCEEDED IN LOWERING INFLATION--PRIME MINISTER SAID INFLATION RATE (I.E. POINT TO POINT, NOW AVERAGE) NOW 7.9 PERCENT COMPARED TO 35 PERCENT A YEAR AGO DUE CHEIFLEY TO A COOLING OF LAND AND HOUSING PRICES. YET EVEN IN THIS IRANIANS EXPRESS SKEPTICISM OVER GOVERNEMENT COST OF LIVING FIGURES, SEEING LITTLE SLOWING IN PRICES AFFECTING THEIR OWN COSTS.

PRESS CLAIMS AMOUZEGAR HAS RESHAPED IRAN'S REPUTATION AS A HAWK WITHIN OPEC COUNCILS. (COMMENT: THISACCOMPLISHMENT CAN HARDLY BE CREDITED TO PRIME MINISTER, WHO IS PRINCIPAL SYMBOL OF IRAN'S TOUGH STANCE FOR HIGHER PRICES. DECISION NOT TO SEEK OIL PRICE INCREASE WAS SHAH'S. END COMMENT)

PRESS GIVEN PRIME MINISTER CREDIT FOR WHAT IT CALLS "MANAGMENT OF THE DEVELOPMENT OF DEMOCRACY". PRIME MINISTER HAS CONSISTENTLY CALLED FOR GREATER PARTICIPATION IN RESURGENCE PARTY ACTIVITIES BUT MOST IRANIANS KNOW THAT REAL IMPETUS FOR LIBERALIZATION HAS COME FROM ELSEWHERE. AMOUZEGAR'S GOVERNMENT IS ALSO BLAMED BY MANY FOR GOI'S FAILURE TO CONTROL THE RISE OF POLITICAL VIOLENCE ------------------087855 141433Z /45 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 9802 INFO AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY LONDON SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 7702 IN CONNECTION WITH THE LIBERALIZATION PROCESS. IN THIS CASE, HOWEVER, MOST IRANIANS SEE SHAH AND COURT AS LEADERS ON MAJOR ISSUES OF POLITICAL CONTROL AND VIOLENCE.

AMOUZEGAR HIMSELF, HOWEVER, MUST INHERIT SOME OF THE BLAME FOR IRAN'S UNCERTAIN POLITICAL CLIMATE. HE HAS SHOWN SKILL AND ADMINISTRATIVE ACCOMPLISHMENTS IN ATTACKING SOME PERSISTENT PROBLEMS OF THE PERSIAN BUREAUCRACY. HIS APPOINTMENTS BY ANDLARGE HAVE BEEN CAPABLE, AND MANY GIVE HIM POSITIVE CREDIT FOR RIDDING THE CABINET OF HEALTH MINISTER SHEIKHOLESLAMZADEH REPORTEDLY GUILTY OF LARGE SCALE CORRUPTION. THE BIGGEST CRITICISM OF THE PRIME MINISTER HAS BEEN HIS UNWILLINGNESS TO DEAL WITH SOMEOF THE POLITICAL ISSUES RISING FROM THE LIBERALIZATION PROCESS. IT HAS BEEN THE COURT, NOT THE GOVERNMENT, THAT HAS BEGUN A TENTATIVE DIALOGUE OF SORTS WITH RELIGIOUS LEADERS.

IF AMOUZEGAR HAS MADE RECOMMENDATIONS TO THE SHAH FOR HANDLING POLITICAL UNREST AND UNIVERSITY DISTURBANCES, THESE ARE UNKNOWN TO THE POLITICAL ELITE AS WELL AS TO THE GENERAL POPULACE. THE MOST PROMINENT CRITICISM OF AMOUZEGAR IS THAT HE LACKS THE DEFT POLITICAL TOUCH TO DEAL WITH THOSE WHO DIFFER WITH HIM IN THE MANNER OF A POLITICAL BORKER RATHER THAN AN AUTHORITARIAN LEADER. AMOUZEGAR'S FIRST YEAR HAS COINCIDED WITH A TIME OF SUBJSTANTIAL SOCIOPOLITICAL CHANGE IN IRAN AS WELL AS ECONOMIC RETRENCHMENT. GIVEN CONDITIONS HE INHERITED AND THE SHAH'S CLEAR DOMINANCE IN THE POLITICAL SYSTEM, THE EMBASSY BELIEVES HE HAS NOT DONE ALL THAT BADLY.

HOWEVER, THE GENERAL PERCEPTION OF THE POLITICAL ELITE HERE, WHICH WE SHARE, IS THAT HE MUST BECOME A MORE EFFECTIVE POLITICIAN IF HE IS TO SURVIVE A SECOND YEAR SUCCESSFULLY. POLITICAL ATTENTION IS LIKELY TO FOCUS ON NEXT YEAR'S NATIONAL ELECTIONS. IN THIS CONNEDTION, THE RESURGENCE PARTY IS IN SOMEWHAT DISARRAY. AS SECRETARY GENERAL, AMOUZEGAR NOW HAS APPOINTEES LOYAL TO HIM IN KEY CENTRAL OFFICE POSITIONS AND ELSEWHERE, EXCEPT FOR THIRD WING LEADER NAHAVANDI AND ANSARY IN THE CONSTRUCTIVE WING. IF THE GOVERNMENT-SUPPORTING RPPI IS TO WAGE A SUCCESSFUL POLITICAL CAMPAIGN AGAINST VARIOUS OPPOSITION GROUPS, AMOUZEGAR AND HIS LIEUTENANTS WILL HAVE TO IMPROVE IT'S PERFORMANCE SUBSTANTIALLY.

IT SEEMS INEVITABLE TO US THAT IF HE IS TO BE POLITICALLY EFFECTIVE HE MUST BE DRAWN IN TO WHATEVER DIALOGUE EMERGES WITH OPPOSITION RELIGIOUS AND POLITICAL GROUPS. THIS IS LIKELY TO TEST HIS SKILLS AS A NEGOTIATOR AS WELL AS AN ADMINISTRATOR AND DETERMINE WHETHER HE CAN SUCCESSFULLY FUNCTION AS A POLITICAL BROKER OR NOT. FROM THE GOVERNMENT'S POINT OF VIEW, THE SUCCESS OF THE SHAH'S LIBERALIZATION POLICIES MAY DEPEND UPON HIS ABILITY TO DO SO.

DURING AUDIENCE AUGUST 13 I INFORMED SHAH THAT LETTER FROM PRESIDENT (REFTEL) WOULD BE COMING THIS WEEK AND THAT WE WOULD APPRECIATE HIS ASSESSMENT OF THE PEACE PROSPECTS. HE EXPRESSED HIS APPRECIATION AND SAID THAT HE WOULD BE PLEASED TO SHARE HIS OBSERVATIONS. AT THE SAME TIME, HE WAS CLEARLY DISAPPOINTED THAT NEITHER YOU NOR ROY COULD VISIT AT THIS TIME.

COMMENT: I HOPE THE LETTER WILL BE HIGHLY SUBSTANTIVE AND WILL SHARE WITH THE SHAH MANY OF OUR PRESENT CONSIDERATIONS CONCERNING THE SUMMIT AND THE PEACE PROCESS. I REALIZE THAT YOU HAVE MANY CONSTITUENCIES WHICH NEED TO BE BRIEFED BUT I URGE YOU TO MAKE THIS LETTER, IF AT ALL POSSIBLE, PERSONAL IN TONE. THE SHAH IS CURRENTLY GOING THROUGH ONE OF HIS PERIDOC EPISODES OF WONDERING WHERE HE STANDS WITH US. ONE RECEIVES CONTINUOUSLY FROM TOP OFFICIILS THE TENTATIVE QUERY WHETHER THE US AND SOVIETS HAVE STRUCK A DEAL WHICH WOULD BE DETRIMENTAL TO IRAN.

UNDER SECRETARY NEWSOM HIT THIS ONE HEAD ON WITH THE SHAH DURING HIS AUDIENCE IN JULY, BUT IT IS CLEAR TO ME THAT HE CONTINUES TO BE NERVOUS AND SUSPICIOUS. ON HIS PART, HE HAS CONCLUDED THAT THE AFGHAN GOVERNMENT SPEAKS WITH THE SAME VOICE AS THAT OF MOSCOW, AND IS ONCE AGAIN CONERNED THAT THE US DOES NOT RECOGNIZE THE SERIOUSNESS OF THE SITUATION. ALSO, AS YOU HAVE SEEN FROM OUR REPORTING, IRAN IS UNDERGOING A CONSIDERABLE AMOUNT OF POLITICAL TURMOIL --MUCH OF IT THE RESULT, OF COURSE, OF THE SHAH'S OWN DETERMINATION OT OPEN THE SOCIETY AFTER FIFTEEN YEARS OF RATHER STRONG CONTROL.

HE IS JUST AS UNCERTAIN AS ANY OTHER IRANIAN OF PRECISELY HOW THIS POLICY WILL UNFOLD AND NERVOUS ABOUT AMERICAN REACTION TO CURRENT EVENTS AS WELL AS HAVING NAGGING SUSPICIONS THAT WE ARE SOMEHOW, WHETHER CONSCIOUSLY OR UNCONSCIOUSLY, ENCOURAGING THE DISSIDENTS. AS YOU KNOW, THE BELIEF, NO MATTER HOW RIDICULOUS, OF A FOREIGN HAND BEING INVOLVED IN ALMOST ANYTHING OF CONSEQUENCE IS DEEP IN THE PERSIAN SOUL. THE SHAH, HIMSELF, IS NO MORE IMMUNE FROM THESE FEARS THAN ANY OF HIS COMPATRIOTS.

THERE ARE LIMITS TO WHAT WE CAN DO DURING THESE PERIODS BUT I WANTED TO SHARE WITH YOU BRIEFLY THE CURRENT MOOD AND TO LET YOU KNOW THAT A LETTER DESIGNED SPECIFICALLY FOR HIM COULD BE HELPFUL ON SEVERAL ACCOUNTS. END COMMENT.

I HAVE BEEN ASSURED BY DEPUTY MINISTER OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS JAFAR NADIM OF IRANIAN SUPPORT ON THE PUERTO RICAN ISSUE. THE PRESIDENT'S STATEMENT ON PUERTO RICO, WHICH WE SUPPLIED TO THE FOREIGN OFFICE WITH A NOTE OF APPREICATION OF PAST IRANIAN SUPPORT, WAS SENT DIRECTLY TO THE SHAH FOR HIS INFORMATION.

MESSAGE FROM PRESIDENT CARTER TO THE SHAH WAS DELIVERED TO MINISTRY OF COURT THIS MORNING AND BAHADORI, UNDER SECRETARY FOR EXTERNAL AFFAIRS, SAID MESSAGE WOULD BE DELIVERED IMMEDIATELY TO THE SHAH WHO IS STILL AT THE CASPIAN. NAAS NOTE BY OC/T: DISTRIBUTION COORDINATED WITH MS SMITH S/S-O.

1978TEHRAN07750.subject: AUDIENCE WITH THE SHAH WHEN I DELIVERED THE LETTER FROM PRESIDENT CARTER TO THE SHAH THIS MORNING, BAHADORI INFORMED ME THAT THE S

segments.text: WHEN I DELIVERED THE LETTER FROM PRESIDENT CARTER TO THE SHAH THIS MORNING, BAHADORI INFORMED ME THAT THE SHAH IS EXPECTED TO END CASPIAN SOJOURN AND RETURN TO TEHRAN WITHIN THE NEXT FEW DAYS. WOULD YOU LIKE ME TO SCHEDULE AN AUDIENCE FOR YOUR RETURN OR WOULD YOU PREFER TO WAIT UNTIL YOU ARRIVE?

1978TEHRAN07770.subject: IRANIAN CONCERN THAT AFGHANISTAN INCREASINGLY ACTS AS SOVIET CLIENT STATE SUMMARY. ACTING HEAD OF MFA'S 4TH POL DIVISION MAG

segments.text: SOVIET CLIENT STATE SUMMARY. ACTING HEAD OF MFA'S 4TH POL DIVISION MAGIDI ROSHANGAR, ON INSTRUCTIONS FROM DEPUTY FM ZELLI, EXPRESSED GOI CONCERN TO ACTING POL SECTION HEAD STEMPEL THAT AFGHANISTAN IS NOW CLOSELY FOLLOWING SOVIET LINE IN WORLD AFFAIRS. HE CITED: (A) NONALIGNED CONFERENCE IN BELGARDE, WHERE GOA POSITION REFLECTED SOVIET POLICY: (B) ASSIGNMENT OF ABDUL RAHIM, AN OFFICER WITH STRONG SOVIET TIES, TO EMBASSY WASHDC: AND (C) ANTI-PAKISTAN RHETORIC AT BELGRADE WHICH ASSERTED THAT GOP IS A CLIENT OF THE WEST. END SUMMARY.

ROSHANGAR REVIEWED SPEECH OF AFGHAN FM AMIN IN BELGRADE, STRESSING THAT AMIN'S ANTI-WESTERN RHETORIC WAS STRONGER IN PERSIAN THAN IN ENGLISH TRANSLATION. THIS SPEECH WAS BROUGHT TO SHAH'S ATTENTION (WHO MENTIONED IT IN PASSING TO CHARGE AUG. 13). ROSHANGAR LISTED AREAS OF GOA SUPPORT FOR SOVIET POLICY: MIDDLE EAST--GOA CALLS FOR GENEVA CONFERENCE; SOUTH AFRICA--GOA DEPLORES WESTERN POLICY; ANGOLA--GOA SUPPORTS REGINE; CYPRUS--GOA SUGGESTS TURKS WITHDRAW; INDIAN OCEAN--GOA CALLS FOR TERMINATING DIEGO GARCIA AND OTHER BASES. GOA ALSO ADOPTS SOVIET POSITION ON DISARMAMENT, AND EVEN REFERS TO CENTO AS "AN AGGRESSIVE PACT".

ROSHANGAR SAID THAT ACCORDING TO RELIABLE SOURCES (EMBASSY COMMENT: SAVAK), ABDUL RAHIM WILL GO TO WASHINGTON AS 2ND SECRETARY. RAHIM HAS BEEN A STUDENT IN MOSCOW FOR TEN YEARS AND WENT DIRECTLY FROM MOSCOW TO WASHINGTON. NEW AMBASSADOR NOOR SPEAKS LITTLE ENGLISH, AND RAHIM, WHO DOES SPEAK ENGLISH, IS EXPECTED TO PARTICIPATE IN MOST NEGOTIATIONS.

ROSHANGAR NOTED HARSH AFGHAN ATTACKS ON PAKISTAN FOR ATTENDING BELGRADE CONFERENCE, EVEN AS A GUEST. ACCORDING TO GOA, PAKISTAN COULD NOT BE CALLED "NONALIGNED" SINCE IT WAS MEMBER OF CENTO, AN "AGGRESSIVE BLOC".
EMBOFF INFORMED ROSHANGAR THAT USG REPORTS OF BELGRADE CONFERENCE SIMILARLY PORTRAYED AFGHAN STANCE AND THAT USG FOUND THIS DISAPPOINTING.

1978TEHRAN07779.subject: LOW LEVEL VIOLENCE CONTINUES THROUGHOUT IRAN

segments.text: SUMMARY: ISFAHAN TENSE WITH ENFORCED CALM. SPORADIC VIOLENCE CONTINUES IN OTHER AREAS OF IRAN, SUCH AS AHWAZ AND TABRIZ. MINOR PROBLEM IN TEHRAN. GOVERNMENT DENIES SPREAD OF MARTIAL LAW. END SUMMARY.

CONSULATE ISFAHAN REPORTS THAT TANKS AND ARMORED VEHICLES, ORDERED OFF STREETS BY MILITARY GOVERNOR LTG NAJI, HAVE BEEN REPLACED BY REGULAR ARMED TRUCKS. ACCORDING TO CONSUL MCGAFFEY, EVENING OF AUG 13 BANK AND THEATRE WERE BOMBED AND NIGHT OF AUG 14 A BANK WAS BURNED IN AREAS SUPPOSEDLY UNDER CONTROL OF MARTIAL LAW. IN SEPARATE INCIDENT AUG 13 MILITARY FIRED ON A CROWN AFTER THREE WARNINGS WHICH WERE IGNORED, RESULTING IN ONE KILLED AND A NUMBER OF ARRESTS. MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES HAVE ANNOUNCED THAT THOSE ARRESTED FOR VIOLATING CURFEW AND ATTEMPTING PROVOCATIVE ACTS WILL FACE MILITARY TRIALS.

CONSULATE ISFAHAN REPORTS FURTHER THAT NIGHT OF AUG 14 TWO APARTMENT BUILDINGS IN ISFAHAN WERE ATTACKED SIMULTANEOUSLY BY SMALL GROUPS OF UNKNOWN DEMONSTRATORS USING ROCKS AND BRICKS CAUSING WINDOW DAMAGE BUT NO INJURIES. BOTH APARTMENTS CONTAIN ITALIAN NATIONALS EMPLOYED WITH SIESICOM, A SUBCONTRACTOR OF MERZ QUANTA, A BRITISH FIRM. CONSULATE BELIEVES TWO BUILDINGS WERE SPECIFICALLY SINGLED OUT AND NOTES A CHANGE IN PATTERN IS OCCURRING WITH RESPECT TO INCIDENTS IN ISFAHAN AREA.

IN CONTRAST TO EARLIER INCIDENTS INVOLVING LARGE GROUPS HITTING GENERAL TARGETS SUCH AS RESTAURANTS, BANKS OWNED BY BAHAIS AND CINEMAS, THE MOST RECENT INCIDENTS RESULT FROM SMALL, WELL ORGANIZED GROUPS ATTACKING SELECTED TARGETS SUCH AS BANK MELLI, AND INSTALLATIONS WITH ARMY OR FOREIGN CONNECTIONS.

TABRIZ EXPERIENCED DEMONSTRATIONS AUG 14 WHICH INCLUDED, ACCORDING TO UNCONFIRMED REPORTS, FIRE BOMBING OF ARYA CINEMA. CONSULATE HAS CONFIRMED REPORT OF AUG 13 BURNING OF ONE OF TABRIZ'S LARGE WESTERN STYLE RESTAURANTS WHICH RESULTED IN NO INJURIES. VICE CONSUL METRINKO HAS RECEIVED UNCONFIMRED REPORT OF RIOTING AUG 14 IN CITY OF S4-?, 150 KMS. NORTHEAST OF TABRIZ. IN TABRIZ, CONFRONTATION BETWEEN STUDENTS AND ADMINISTRATION REMAINS UNRESOLVED AT AZARABADEGAN UNIVERSITY WITH SECURITY GUARDS TAKING CONTROL OF CAMPUS AUG 14. TWO WEEKS AGO, IN CONCILIATORY GUESTURE TO STUDENTS, NEW CHANCELLOR MAJID MOLAVI HAD REMOVED GUARDS FROM CAMPUS.

AZARABADEGAN HAS NOW CANCELLED FINAL TERM OF CURRENT ACADEMIC YEAR (WHICH HAD BEEN SEVERELY INTERRUPTED BY EARLIER DEMONSTRATIONS) FOLLOWING STUDENTS REFUSAL TO RETURN TO CLASSES UNLESS A NUMBER OF THEIR DEMANDS, IN ADDITION TO REMOVAL OF GUARDS, WERE MET.

IN TEHRAN, AFTERNOON OF AUG 15, POLICE WERE ON HAND AS INDIVIDUALS EXITED FROM TWO MOSQUES IN DOWNTOWN AREAS TO DISPERSE EMERGING CROWDS. THOSE WHO TRIED TO STICK AROUND WERE SCATTERED. NUMBER OF RUMORS BEGINNING TO CIRCULATE AMONG BOTH FOREIGN AND IRANIAN CITIZENS IN TEHRAN ABOUT ALLEGED SHOOTINGS OR DISTURBANCES. TWO HAVE PROVED TOTALLY FALSE AND WE SUSPECT RUMOR PURVEYORS ARE ON THE MARCH AGAIN.

DEMONSTRATION IN AHWAZ LAST WEEKEND LED TO 19 ARRESTS AND INTERNAL BANISHMENT OF "PREACHER" REZA GOLSORKHI WHO WAS CHARGED WITH INCITING A RIOT. SHIRAZ CONSUL TOMSETH RECEIVED A CALL FROM U.S. PERSONNEL MANAGER OF PARSONS CO. IN AHWAZ REPORTING SPORADIC, LOW LEVEL VIOLENCE IN THAT CITY AUG 15 WITH ALL STORES AND BANKS CLOSE. SITUATION HAS PERSISTED TO POINT WHERE LOCAL INHABITANTS HAVING DIFFICULTY OBTAINING FOOD SUPPLIES.

GOI SPOKESMAN HOMAYOUN, FOLLOWING CABINET MEETING AUG 14, DENIED PRESS REPORTS OF MARTIAL LAW IN AREAS OUTSIDE OF ISFAHAN, SUCH AS SHAHREZA. THE AREA OF HOMAYOUSHAHR IS PART OF GREATER ISFAHAN AND THUS AUTOMATICALLY COMES UNDER ORIGINAL MARTIAL LAW DECLARATION, HOMAYOUN SAID. ALTHOUGH LTG NAJI HAS REQUESTED MILITARY JURISDICTION OVER TOWN OF NAJAFABAD THE REQUEST APPARENTLY IS STILL BEING CONSIDERED BY PROVINCIAL SECURITY COUNCIL. IF COUNCIL APPROVES REQUEST IT WILL BE FORWARDED TO CABINET FOR FINAL DECISION. HE ADDED THAT SITUATION IN SHIRAZ DID NOT WARRANT IMPOSITION OF MARTIAL LAW.
HOMAYOUN REFERRED TO FREEDOM OF RELIGIOUS RITES BUT REQUESTED CLERGY AND CONGREGATIONS NOT TO ALLOW "A HANDFULL OF MASKED AGITATORS" TO PUT RELIGION TO TREASONOUS ABUSES.

1978TEHRAN07791.subject: IMPLEMENTATION OF ANTI HIJACKING DECLARATION REACHED AT BONN ECONOMIC SUMMIT CONFERENCE

segments.text: FOREIGN MINISTRY SPOKESMAN ISSUED DECLARATION OF SUPPORT FOR BONN ANTI HIJACKING STATEMENT AUG 7. STATEMENT CONTAINED IN STORY PRINTED IN RESURGENCE PARTY NEWSPAPER AUG 8.

TITLE: IRAN SUPPORTS FIGHT AGAINST WORLD TERRORISM. TEXT: THE SPOKESMAN OF THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS DECLARED YESTERDAY THAT ANY MEASURE TAKEN TO COMBAT TERRORISM AND AIRCRAFT HIJACKING WILL HAVE IRAN'S SUPPORT. REFERRING TO THE RECENT DECISIONS OF THE BONN HIGH LEVEL CONFERENCE ON COUNTERING TERRORISM AND AIRCRAFT HIJACKING , THE FOREIGN MINISTRY SPOKESMAN SAID THAT THE IMPERIAL GOVERNMENT OF IRAN HAS ALWAYS BEEN AGAINST ACTS OF TERRORISM AND PARTICULARLY OF AIRCRAFT HIJACKING AND SUPPORTS ANY ACTION TAKEN ON AN INTERNATIONAL LEVEL TO FIGHT SUCH ACTS.

1978TEHRAN07793.subject: ANTI-SEMITIC CAMPAIGN BY RELIGIOUS EXTREMISTS TEF: TEHRAN 07504 (NOTAL)

segments.text: TEF: TEHRAN 07504 (NOTAL)

EMBASSY HAS OBTAINED FURTHER DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE OF ANTI-SEMITIC CAMPAIGN BY EXTREME RELIGIOUS GROUPS. TWO TRACTS ATTRIBUTED TO AYATOLLAH YAHYA NOURI STRONGLY ATTACK "THE JEWISH ENEMY" WHO, AIDED BY WESTERN IMPERIALISM, HAS ESTABLISHED "AN AGRESSOR AND MURDERER" IN ISRAEL.

ONE TRACT RECEIVED BY EMBASSY LOCAL, IS ENTITLED A "DECLARATION OF AYATOLLAH YAHYA NOURI," AND CALLS ON MUSLIMS TO BOYCOTT COCA-COLA, "A BIG JEWISH COMPANY." JUST AS MUSLIMS MUST BOYCOTT PEPSI-COLA BECAUSE OF ITS BAHAI CONNECTION, "IT IS A HUNDRED TIMES MORE IMPORTANT TO REFRAIN FROM THE SALE AND PURCHASE OF COCA-COLA, AS ITS CONSUMPTION BACKS UP THE JEWISH ENEMY WHICH THROUGH ZIONISM HAS GIVEN BIRTH TO THE HOSTILE AND USURPANT ISRAEL AND THROUGH ITS 'CABALISM' HAS CREATED BAHAISM."

SECOND, LONGER PAMPHLET (OBTAINED FROM ISRALELI MISSION) GIVES EXCERPTS FROM TWO SPEECHES OF NOURI IN MARCH, SUBTITLED "THE BARBARISM AND AGGRESSION OF ISRAEL AGAINST MUSLIMS IN LEBANON." NOURI ASSAILS ISRAEL, AMERICAN IMPERIALISM, AND ISLAMIC GOVERNMENTS WHICH HAVE GONE SOFT ON ZIONISM. HE ALSO ATTACKS JEWS PER SE. "EVEN BEFORE THE INCEPTION OF ZIONISM THE JEWS NEVER LIVED IN PEACE AND HARMONY WITH THEIR NEIGHBORS.

DUE TO THEIR TRANSGRESSION AND HOSTILITY TO OTHERS THEY WERE ALWAYS REJECTED BY SOCIETY." THESE JEWS THEN CALLED ON WESTERN IMPERIALISM, FOR "THE UNION OF ZIONISM AND IMPERIALISM IS A DEEP-ROOTED UNION OF PRINCIPLE: ZIONISM AND THE STATE OF ISRAEL IS (SIC) AN ILLEGITIMATE CHILD OF IMPERIALISM AND THE WEST."

NOURI DEVOTES MUCH SPACE TO CRITICISM OF ISLAMIC NATIONS WHICH FAIL TO "DEAL THE AGRESSIVE ENEMY AND ITS COLLABORATORS SUCH A BLOW THAT THEY WILL NOT RISE AGAIN." WITHOUT MENTIONING THE SHAH OR IRAN BY NAME, NOURI STATES THAT MUSLIMS DEPLORE "THE SILENCE, INACTION, INDECISION, AND EVEN SECRET AFFILIATIONS WITH ISRAEL BY THEIR GOVERNMENTS," AND "THEY THINK OF THE CHANGING OF SUCH GOVERNMENTS AS A VICTORY FOR ISLAM AND THE ISLAMIC SOCIETY." HE CALLS FOR MUSLIMS TO AVENGE JEWISH BLOODSHEDDING IN LEBANON BY "AN EYE FOR AN EYE.."
NOURI IS ONE OF PREACHING MULLAHS WHO IS BIDDING FOR INCREASED EMINENCE THROUGH HIS DEMAGOGIC OUTBURSTS. SIMILAR THEMES HAVE ACCOMPANIED SPEECHES IN SOUTH TEHRAN OVER PAST WEEK.
COMPLETE TEXTS BEING POUCHED.

THE DEPUTY MINISTER OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS, JAFAR NADIM, ASSURED ME TODAY OF IRAN'S SUPPORT FOR THE U.S. CANDIDATE. NADIM SAID THAT IT HAS LONG BEEN ESTABLISHED POLICY OF THE GOI TO SUPPORT THE INCLUSIION ON THE COURT OF A REPRESENTATIVE FROM ALL THE PERMANENT MEMBERS OF SECURITY COUNCIL.

1978TEHRAN07821.subject: AMNESTY, LEGAL FOLLOW ON TO MARTIAL LAW

segments.text: ANNOUNCMENT HAS BEEN MADE BY GOI THAT 62 ANTI-STATE PRISONERS WILL BE RELEASED BY IMPERIAL AMNESTY ON THE OCCASION OF THE 28TH OF AMORDAD (ANNIVERSARY OF THE NATIONAL UPRISING) AND THE BIRTH CENTENARY OF REZA SHAH. DATE OF RELEASE IS SCHEDULED FOR AUGUST 17 AND WILL INCLUDE OVER 700 PRISONERS IN TOTAL. REPORTEDLY A SPECIAL COMMISSION COMPRISED OF REPRESENTATIVES FROM THE COURTS, PRISONS AND POLICE DEPARTMENTS THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY SUBMITTED TO THE MINISTERY OF JUSTICE LISTS OF PRISONERS CONSIDERED TO BE ELIGIBLE FOR AN IMPERIAL PARDON.

IN ISFAHAN, MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES HAVE WARNED UNDERGROUND PUBLISHERS AGAINST PUBLISHING ANY MATERIAL MALICIOUS OR INJURIOUS TO PEACE AND ORDER. IT HAS ALSO BEEN ANNOUNCED BY MILITARY GOVERNOR LTG NAJI THAT A GROUP OF RING LEADERS BEHIND THE WEEKEND RIOTS IN ISFAHAN HAS BEEN ARRESTED. MILITARY AUTHORITIES PERMITTED WORKERS AT A NUMBER OF ISFAHAN FACILITIES TO STAGE GATHERINGS AUGUST 15 IN SUPPORT OF THE GOVERNMENT, FOLLOWING WHICH A MESSAGE WAS SENT TO PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR "DEPLORING THE RECENT EVENTS IN ISFAHAN ENGINEERED BY A GROUP EXPLOITING UNDER-AGE YOUNGSTERS." SIMILAR MASS MEETINGS BY WORKERS HAVE BEEN HELD IN SOUTHERN CITIES OF BUSHEHR AND KHORRAMSHAHR.

FOLLOWING RECENT DEMONSTRATIONS IN SHIRAZ FILES OF 113 OF THOSE ARRESTED HAVE BEEN SENT TO MILITARY COURTS WHILE 96 OTHERS WILL FACE CIVILIAN TRIALS. TWO OF THE THREE DEMONSTRATORS KILLED IN SHIRAZ OVER THE WEEKEND HAVE BEEN IDENTIFIED. SCORES OF OTHERS ARE CONTINUING TO RECEIVE HOSPITAL CARE.

DR. MANZOOR OF AEOI INFORMED US TODAY THAT THE CABINET HAS NOW AUTHORIZED SIGNATURE OF THE AGREEMENT. HE SAID THAT A NUMBER OFCHANGES HAD BEEN MADE IN THE PERSIAN LANGUAGE TEXT AT THE REQUEST OF THE LEGAL DEPARTMENT OF THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS. HE SAID THAT THESE CHANGES WILL NOT REQUIRE ANY CHANGES IN THE ENGLISH LANGUAGE TEXT AND RECALLED THAT THE ONLY CHANGE IN THIS TEXT IS AT THE END WHERE "PERSIAN" SHOULD BE SUBSTITUTED FOR "FARSI."
DR. MANZOOR SAID THAT HE WOULD GIVE US THE FINAL PERSIAN TEXT ON SATURDAY, AUGUST 19. WE WILL SEND IT TO YOUR BY THE QUICKEST POSSIBLE MEANS.
HE SAID HE WOULD APPRECIATE INFORMATION ON THE STATUS OF OUR PROCEDURES IN OBTAINING AUTHORIZATION FOR SIGNATURE.

1978TEHRAN07863.subject: REASSESSMENT OF IRAN'S NUCLEAR ENERGY PLANS?

segments.text: EDITORIAL IN AUGUST 15 "KAYHAN INTERNATIONAL" TITLED "IT'S TIME TO CALL A MORATORIUM ON ALL NEW NEGOTIATIONS IN NUCLEAR SECTOR" IS OSTENSIBLY AIMED AT AUSTRALIAN URANIUM PURCHASE DEAL BUT CLEARLY IMPLIES CRITICISM OF PENDING U.S. BILATERAL AGREEMENT. EDITORIAL SINGLES OUT RETRANSFER AND REPROCESSING CLAUSES AS MOST OBJECTIONABLE , SAYING THAT THEY "COULD SERIOUSLY RESTRICT IRAN'S OPTIONS WITH RESPECT TO THE DEVELOPMENT OF ITS NUCLEAR POWER PROGRAMS." EDITORIAL CLAIMS THAT WITH COMMITMENT FROM FRENCH AND GERMAN CONTRACTORS FOR UP TO TEN YEAR FUEL SUPPLY, PAST PURCHASES OF 30,000 TONS OF URANIUM ORE FROM OTHER COUNTRIES, PLUS PROPOSED 15,000 TO 20,000 TONS OF AUSTRALIAN ORE, IRAN MAY FIND ITSELF WITH OVERSUPPLY.

SALE OF SURPLUS ORE, VOLUME OF WHICH MAY BE INCREASED "IF SIZE OF NUCLEAR PROGRAM IS IN FACT REDUCED AS WE HAVE LONG ADVOCATED," COULD BE BLOCKED BY COMPETITOR SUCH AS AUSTRALIA DUE TO PRIOR CONSENT FOR RETRANSFER. ON REPROCESSING, "IRAN HAS NO PLANS FOR SETTING UP DOMESTIC REPROCESSING FACILITIES AT PRESENT. BUT THEN IT SHOULD NOT FORCLOSE ITS OPTION TO REPROCESS ITS FUEL INDEFINITELY EITHER." CALLING FOR NEW NUCLEAR PROGRAM TO BE "DRAWN UP, NEEDS ASSESSED, AND RESPONSIBILITIES CLARIFIED" EDITORIAL URGES THAT "IRAN SHOULD NOT RUSH INTO AN AGREEMENT WHOSE IMPLICATIONS OVER THE NEXT DECADE OR TWO ARE AT BEST UNCLEAR, AND AT WORST UNDESIRABLE."

THIS CRITICISM OF TWO SPECIFIC CLAUSES IN THE AUSTRALIAN DRAFT IMPLIES AN UNUSUAL ACCESS OF THE MEDIA TO THE NEGOTIATIONS. FRONT PAGE OF PAPER CARRIES ARTICLE REPORTING AUSTRALIAN URANIUM ORE AGREEMENT AS "RESTRICTIVE NUCLEAR DEAL". ARTICLE IS ALSO CRITICAL OF IRAN'S AMBITIOUS NUCLEAR POWER PLANS, WHICH IT STATES ARE UNDERGOING A REASSESSMENT.

WE HAVE HEARD THAT SUCH A REASSESSMENT IS UNDERWAY, BUT HAVE YET TO DETERMINE ITS MANDATE OR COMPLETE COMPOSITION OF REVIEW TEAM. AT THIS POINT IT COULD BE ONLY AN EXPRESSION OF CONCERN BY A SMALL GROUP, SINCE THE OFFICIAL LINE REMAINS FULFILLMENT OF COMMITMENT TO 23,000 MWE OF NUCLEAR POWER INSTALLED BY AROUND 1993.

INVOLVEMENT OF "KAYHAN" JOURNALIST BIJAN MOSSAVAR-RAHMANI (PROTECT EMBASSY KNOWLEDGE) IN AUSTRALIAN URANIUM TALKS AS WELL AS NUCLEAR REVIEW STRONGLY SUGGESTS THAT THIS EDITORIAL HAS GOI, EVEN PM'S BLESSING AND MAY SERVE AS INTRODUCTION OF OFFICIALLYADMITTED RETHINK OF GOI ENERGY STRATEGY.

1978TEHRAN07882.subject: IRAN: WHERE ARE WE NOW AND WHERE ARE WE GOING?

segments.text: TAL) D. TEHRAN A-80 (NOTAL) E) TEHRAN 7702 (NOTAL). SUMMARY: THE SHAH'S CONSTITUTION DAY SPEECH AND THE IMPOSITION OF MARTIAL LAW IN ISFAHAN INDICATE THAT HE IS COMMITTED TO THE LIBERALIZATION PROCESS BUT THAT THE GOI WILL DEAL MORE FIRMLY WITH THOSE WHO STIMULATE VIOLENCE. MAJOR QUESTION IS WHAT IMPACT RELIGIOUSLY INSPIRED AGITATION WILL HAVE ON IRANIAN POLITICAL SYSTEM AND WHAT GOVERNMENT'S REACTION WILL BE. POLITICAL VIOLENCE HAS BEEN TRADITION IN IRAN. SHAH IS ON A TIGHT ROPE--TRYING TO MINIMIZE VIOLENCE WHILE CHANNELING POLITICAL CONFLICT INTO ELECTORAL REALM. SUCCESS IS TO A CONSIDERABLE EXTENT DEPENDENT ON CONTINUED EXERCISE OF RESTRAIN BY ARMY AND SECURITY FORCES.

WE BELIEVE HE MUST MANEUVER CAREFULLY, PERHPS INCLUDING SOME STEPS TO MEET OPPOSITION DEMANDS, IF VIOLENCE IS TO BE REDUCED. GIVEN THE NATURE OF THE OPPOSITION, HOWEVER, THE SHAH MAY ULTIMATELY HAVE TO RESORT TO FORCE. THE PRIMARY HOPE OF AVOIDING THIS OPTION IS TO RESHAPE MODERATE OPPOSITION ATTITUDES AND IMPROVE GOVERNEMENT SENSITIVITY IN THE PROCESS OF FURTHER POLITICAL ACTIVITY. END SUMMARY

WITH THE IMPOSITION OF MARTIAL LAW IN ISFAHAN AND THE STATIONING OF MORE MILITARY UNITS ELSEWHERE FOLLOWING CLOSELY ON THE HEELS OF THE SHAH'S CONSTITUTION DAY SPEECH(REFS A AND B) WHICH REAFFIRMED HIS COMMITMENT TO POLITICAL LIBERALIZATION, IT SEEMS A GOOD TIME TO REVIEW WHERE WE ARE AND TAKE A TENTATIVE AND SPECULATIVE LOOK AHEAD. THIS IS A PERIOD OF CONSIDERABLE POLITICAL TURMOIL IN IRAN FROM WHICH MANY OUTCOMES ARE THEORETICALLY POSSIBLE. MANY OF THE GIVENS OF THE PAST ARE BEING CALLED INTO QUESTION, NOT ONLY BY VOCAL OPPONENTS OF THE REGIME BUT BY THE SHAH HIMSELF.

IT IS CLEAR TO US AND THE OVERWHELMING MAJORITY OF DIPLOMATIC OBSERVERS HERE THAT THE SHAH IS SINCERE IN HIS DESIRE TO LEAD IRAN TOWARD LIBERALIZED POLITICAL INSTITUTIONS (REF C). THERE IS SOME QUESTION IN HIS OWN MIND AS TO EXACTLY WHAT HE WANTS AND HOW HE IS TO ACHIEVE HIS BROAD OBJECTIVE, AND THERE REMAINS DEEP SUSPICION OF HIS INTENTIONS AMONG THOSE WHO HAVE LONG OPPOSED HIM. AFTER ALL, HE HAS NOT EVER WILLINGLY PLAYED THE DEMOCRATIC GAME BEFORE: WHY NOW?

THE ANSWER, WE BELIEVE, IS IN HIS REAL BELIEF THAT HIS SON CANNOT SUCCESSFULLY SUCCEED HIM UNLESS IRAN'S POLITICAL TRANSITION TO MORE DEMOCRATIC INSTITUTIONS IS MANAGED BEFORE THE CROWN PRINCE TAKES THE THRONE. THE SHAH, MORE THAN ANY OTHER MODERNIZING MONARCH, IS CONCERNED WITH THE PROBLEM OF SUCCESSION. HE HAS STRESSED THE NEED TO PREPARE THE GROUND FOR HIS SON TO THE AMBASSADOR, TO ME, AND MOST FOREIGNERS HE RECEIVES. HE REMEMBERS HIS OWN DIFFICULT FIRST YEARS AND HAS GRADUALLY COME TO THE CONCLUSION THAT ROOM MUST BE MADE FOR IRAN'S EXPANDING MIDDLE CLASS IN THE POLITICAL PROCESS.

THIS DOES NOTMEAN, HOWEVER, THAT HE IS PREPARED TO TURN THE COUNTRY OVER TO MEN HE REGARDS AS UNPATRIOTIC, OBSCURANTIST AND IRRECONCILABLY HOSTILE TO THE MONARCH. THE CONTINUATION OF THE MONARCHY FOR THE SHAH IS MORE THAN SIMPLY AN ARROGANCE--HE WANTS THE PAHLAVI DYNASTY TO SURVIVE AND CONTINUE HIS POLICIES. HE DEEPLY BELIEVES THAT IRANIAN HISTORY PROVES THE NEED FOR AMONARCH TO GIVE THE LEAD TO HIS DISPARATE AND HETEROGENEOUS SOCIETY. HE IS, HOWEVER, PREPARED TO BEGIN A POLITICAL PROCESS DESPITE MISGIVINGS ABOUT SOME OF THE PLAYERS.

HOWEVER, MANY SO-CALLED LIBERAL OPPOSITION LEADERS AT HEART BELIVE HE SHOULD REMOVE HIMSELF FORTHWITH FROM THE GOVERNING PROCESS . MANYOF OUR CONTACTS WHO ADMIRE AND SUPPORT THE SHAH BELIEVE AS WELL THAT HIS INVOLVEMENT IN MOST DECISIONS SETS HIM UP AS THE TARGET FOR CRITICIZM WHEN THE POLICIES IN PRACTICE DO NOT WORK WELL AND THAT HE SHOULD MOVE TOWARD REIGNING AND NOT RULING.

A SUBSTANTIAL, IF NOT OVERWHELMING, MAJORITY OF IRANIANS HOWEVER AGREE WITH THE SHAH THAT THE MONARCHY REMAINS NECESSARY FOR THE COUNTRY BUT THEY WISH TO SEE ITS OPERATIONS ADJUSTED. ------------------124574 171630Z /44 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 9894 INFO USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY KABUL USCINCEUR SECTION 2 OF 3 TEHRAN 7882 NOFORN

THOSE FAMILIAR WITH THE MOSSADEQ PERIOD (1949-53) SEE NO EVIDENCE THAT MANY OF THE OPPOSITION LEADERS HAVE CHANGED THEIR OWN AUTHORITARIAN COLORATION DESPITE THEIR RHETORIC TODAY ABOUT CONSTITUTIONAL PRINCIPLES. RELIGIOUS OPPOSITION RETAINS THE VIOLENT ELEMENT THATHAS MARKED SHIITE ATTITUDES TOWARD GOVERNMENT SINCE THE EIGHTH CENTURY. THERE ARE, OF COURSE, ALL STRAINS OF RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP, FROM THOSE FAVORING MODIEFIED CONSTITUTIONAL RULE TO THOSE SEEKING A RETURN TO THE DAYS OF SHAH ABBAS. THERE IS ALSO AN ESSENTIALLY ANARCHIC MASS RESPONSIVE TO THE LOUDEST VOICE.

THOSE RELIGIOUS ELEMENTS PRESENTLY DOMINATING THE IRANIAN SCENE, BOTH ORGANIZATIONALLY AND IDEOLOGICALLY, ARE COMMITTED TO VIOLENCE AND OBSTRUCTION AS TOOLS FOR ATTAINING POWER. AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI HAS SPECIFICALLY CALLED FOR THE SHAH'S VIOLENT REMOVAL AND SOME OF HIS FOLLOWERS IN ISFAHAN AND SHIRAZ HAVE OPENLY CALLED FOR THE DEATH OF THE SHAH. (THIS EXTREMISM WAS IN PART THE REASON THE POLICE CRACKED DOWN ON THE HUNGERSTRIKING MULLAHS--TEHRAN 7618).

MODERATES SUCH AS AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI DO NOT AT THIS TIME FEEL CAPABLE OF OPPOSING KHOMEINI OPENLY, THOUGH THEY REPORTEDLY STILL WORK FOR MODERATION WITHIN THE RELIGIOS MOVEMENT AND WOULD DOUBTLESSLY WELCOME A CHANCE TO PARTICIPATE IN AN ELECTORAL PROCESS WHICH MIGHT NOT LEAVE THEM WHOLLY SUBSERVIENT TO KHOMEINI, WHO REMAINS OUTSIDE THE COUNTRY. IN SHIA ISLAM THERE IS NO INSTITUTIONALIZED HEIRARCHY: A RELIGIOUS LEADER ATTAINS HIS PROMINENCE BY CONSENSUS WITHIN HIS PARISH. SOME OF THE VIOLENCE WE ARE WITNESSING HERE RESULTS FROM A FERVID COMPETITION FOR EMINENCE BY THE AYATOLLAHS; MODERATION APPARENTLY DOES NOT BEGET FOLLOWERS FROM THE WORKERS, SMALL SHOP KEEPERS AND ARTISANS AT THIS TIME.
A TRADTION OF THRONE/OPPOSITION DIALOG DOES NOT EXIST IN IRAN, AND NEITHER TEMPERMENT NOR TRADITION FAVOR WESTERN CONCEPTS OF POLITICAL CONCILATION AND BROKERAGE.

WHATEVER THE SHAH WISHES TO DO NEXT, HE MUST MEET HEAD ON THE VIOLENT CHALLENGES TO BOTH HIS GOVERNEMENT AND IRAN'S SOCIAL FABRIC. IMPOSITION OF MARTIAL LAW IS SEEN HERE AS A SIGNAL TO VIOLET ELEMENTS THAT THIS TYPE OF ACTIVITY WILL NOT BE TOLERATED. FOR IRAN, IT IS A SURPRISINGLY RESTRAINED REACTION SO FAR. THE ARMY HAS BEEN ORDERED TO HOLD ITS FIRE AND RESTRAINTS AGAINST PREMATURE POLICE USE OF WEAPONS REMAIN IN EFFECT. IRONICALLY, THIS LAUDABLE RESTRAINT HAS ITS DISADVANTAGES: MANY IRANIAN OF THE MIDDLE AND WEALTHY CLASSES BELIVE THE SHAH IS NOT ACTING FORCEFULLY ENOUGH, THAT HE IS WEAK AND INDESICIVE.

SOME BELIEVE THE AMERICANS FORCED HIM TO BE RESTRAINED, SINCE THEY CANNOT CONCEIVE OF HIS WILLINGNESS TO DO SO IN HIS OWN INTEREST. THE IMMEDIATE DANGER IS THAT THE SHAH HIMSELF (OR ARMY UNITS GOADED BEYOND PATIENCE) WILL REACT INDISCRIMINATELY AND ATTEMPT TO SOLVE THE PROBLEM WITH BULLETS INSTEAD OF BALLOTS. THE ARMED FORCES ARE NOT LIKELY TO DO SO UNLESS OPPOSITIONISTS MOVE FROM STONES TO FIREARMS.

MANY OBSERVERS HERE HOPE THAT THE END OF RAMAZAN WILL BRING SOME SURCEASE BUT WE ARE BECOMING INCREASINGLY DUBIOUS. THE RELIGIOUS LEADERS, EVEN THE MODERATES, ARE FEELING THEIR OATS AND ARE UNLIKELY, WE BELIEVE, TO EASE OFF THE PRESSURES UNTIL THEY RECEIVE AT LEAST SOME SATISFACTION. THE SHAH IS ON THE CLEFT STICK AT THE MOMENT. HE COULD ALMOST CERTAINLY SUCCESSFULLY SUPPRESS THE RELIGIOUS DISSIDENTS FOR THE TIME BEING BY MASS ARRESTS AND VERY CONSIDERABLE BLOOD LETTING.

IT WOULD NOT BE EASY, HOWEVER BECAUSE UNLIKE 1963, DISSIDENT ACTIVITIES ARE WIDESPREAD IN THE COUNTRY AND VANDALISM IS USUALLY PERPETRATED BY A NUMBER OF GROUPS IN SEPARATE PARTS OF THE CITIES AND TOWNS. IF HE TAKES THISPATH, HOWEVER, IT WOULD NEGATE HIS OBJECTIVE OF LIBERALIZATION AND BRING DOWN ON HIMSELF SIGNIFICANT FOREIGN CRITICISM TO WHICH HE IS SENSITIVE.

THE SHAH AND THOSE AROUND HIM, WE NOW BELIEVE, HAVE UNDERESTIMATED THE CHALLENGE. IRAN REMAINS BY AND LARGE A CONSERVATIVE ISLAMIC STATE AND, ONCE LIBERALIZATION OPENED THE POLITICAL SCENE, THE LOCAL RELIGIOUS LEADERS AGAIN BECAME THE CENTERS OF POLITICAL POWER--AS THEY WERE WHEN THE LID WAS PUT ON IN 1963. (OUR A-80 DEALT WITH SOME OF THE PSYCHOLOGICAL/ECONOMIC/SOCIAL FACTORS WHICH HAVE CONTRIBUTED TO THE FRUSTRATIONS HERE.) ALSO, SINCE THAT TIME COMMUNICATIONS HAVE VASTLY IMPROVED IN THIS COUNTRY AND THE VARIOUS LEADERS CAN DAILY STAY IN TOUCH WITH EACH OTHER.

NEIGHER THE INTELLECTUALS AND BUREAUCRATS OF THE RASTIKHIZ PARTY, THE OLD NATIONAL FRONTIERS, NOR THE LEADERS OF THE NEW GROUPS HAVE DEEP-ROOTED POLITICAL POWER OR INFLUENCE. IN THE PRESENT POLITICAL AND SOCIAL SCENE, THE GOVERNEMENT CANNOT AVOID DEALING WITH THE RELIGIOUS ELEMENTS.

THE EARLIER EFFORTS TO ESTABLISH A DIALOGUE WITH THE MORE MODERATE LEADERS WERE NOT PURSUED WITH MUCH VIGOR AND THE OBJECTIVE OF SPLITTING THE RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP HAS SIMPLY NOT WORKED SO FAR. PART OF THE REASON FOR THIS LATTER FAILURE HAS BEEN THE THREATS AND HARASSMENT OF THE MODERATES BY THE WELL-ORGANIZED KHOMEINI FANATICS; ALSO, AS NOTED EARLIER, NO AYATOLLAH WISHES TO LOSE HIS FOLLOWERS BY APPEARING SOFT.

FURTHERMORE, THE AMOUZEGAR GOVERNMENT (AS OPPOSED TO THE SHAH AND THE COURT) HAS PROVED SURPRISINGLY INEPT AT DEALING WITH RELIGIOUS ELEMENTS ON ANYTHING OTHER THAN A TAKE IT OR LEAVE IT BASIS. ------------------124977 171631Z /44 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 9895 INFO USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY KABUL USCINCEUR SECTION 3 OF 3 TEHRAN 7882 NOFORN

IF OUR GENERAL ASSESSMENT IS VALID, THE SHAH HAS TO FIND A WAY TO OPEN SERIOUS GIVE AND TAKE WITH THE SOCALLED RELIGIOUS (AND SOME POLITICAL) MODERATES (THIS WILL BE HARD TO SWALLOW BECAUSE OF HIS UTTER DISDAIN FOR "THE PRIESTS"). WE SHOULD REALIZE AT THE OUTSET THAT THIS MAY ULTIMATELY PROVE IMPOSSIBLE BECAUSE OF THEIR ULTIMATE DEMANDS (AS OPPOSED TO WHAT THEY MIGHT ACCEPT AS A PART OF AN ON-GOING PROCESS) WOULD MEAN RELIGIOUS CONTROL OF THE GOVERNEMENT AND REDUCTION OF THE SHAH TO A CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCH.

THE SHAH WOULD NEVER ACCEPT THE FIRST AND WOULD SEE THE LATTER EMERGING ONLY IN THE CONTEXT OF RULE PASSING TO HIS SON. THE CURRENT "WANT LIST" OF THE RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP IS UNCLEAR, BUT WE UNDERSTAND THAT CHANGE OF PRIME MINISTER AND AT LEAST SOME CABINET MEMBERS TOPS THE LIST--THE GOVERNMENT HAS BEEN TOO TARRED WITHTHE VIOLENCE OF THE PAST EIGHT MONTHS AND IS SEEN AS NOT AT ALL RESPONSIVE TO THE RELIGIOUS CONSTITUENCY. EVEN SOME ESTABLISHMENT FIGURES NOW TALK THIS WAY PRIVATELY. ACTION AGAINST INDIVIDUALS WHO ARE WIDELY PERCEIVED TO HAVE CORRUPTLY BENEFITED FROM IRAN'S RECENT DEVELOPMENT IS NEXT.

THIS IS A PARTICULARLY TOUGH ONE BECAUSE THE POPULACE HAS SEEN ANTI-CORRUPTION CAMPAIGHNS COME AND GO AND A NEW EFFORT WILL HAVE NO CREDIBILITY UNLESS PERSONS VERY CLOSE TO THE SHAH ARE AT LEAST REPRESENTED INANY ROUNDUP. A NUMBER OF LESSER MATTERS ALSO REQUIRE ACTION: MORE HAJ SEATS AND BETTER ALLOCATION OF EXISTING CAPACITY BY IRANAIR, MORE RESTRAINED MOVIE ADVERTISING, ETC.

CONCESSIONS OF THIS NATURE MIGHT AT LEAST BRING THE MODERATES INTO THE POLITICAL PROCESS AND PERMIT THE GOI TO DIRECT ITS POLICE AND INTELLIGNECE EFFORTS AGAINST EXTREMISTS WHO ARE UNDOUBTEDLY RECEIVING HELP FROM EX-TUDEH PARTY ELEMENTS, AND OTHER OUTSIDE FORCES. HOWEVER, GIVEN THE ORGANIZATIONAL FLUIDITY OF THE OPPOSTION, ITS PENCHANT FOR PRESSING FOR THE JUGULAR RATHER THAN COMPROMISING AND SIMPLY THE EVANESCENT NATURE OF PUBLIC OUTBREAKS OVER THE PAST FEW MONTHS, EVEN THIS MIGHT NOT BE ENOUGH. AT SOME POINT, THE SHAH MAY BE FORCED TO REPRESS AN OUTBREAK WITH THE IRON FIST AND NOT THE VELVET GLOVE IF IRAN IS TO RETAIN ANY ORDER AT ALL.

WE HAVE NO DOUBT THAT HE WILL DO SO IF THAT BECOMES ESSENTIAL. HE IS NOT DEALING WITH DEMOCRATIC GROUP POLITICS AS WE IN THE WEST KNOW AND PLAY TEM, AND HE IS MINDFUL OF WHAT VACILLATION BROUGHT AYUB KHAN AND BHUTTO IN PAKISTAN.

FOR THE U.S. AS WELL THIS IS A DELICATE PERIOD. AS WE HAVE MENTIONED IN PREVIOUS REPORTING, VIRTUALLY ALL IRANIANS BELIEVE THAT FOREIGN HANDS ARE INVOLVED IN WHATEVER HAPPENS HERE. WHATEVER WE AS A GOVERNMENT OR AS OFFICIALS SAY WILL BE MISCONSTRUED BY SOMEBODY HERE EITHER AS SUPPORT FOR OR OPPOSITION TO THE SHAH. THIS PERCEPTION OF INFLUENCE IN FACT GIVES US SOME INFLUENCE. WE WILL HAVE FURTHER OBSERVATIONS ON OUR ROLE HERE OVER THE NEXT FEW WEEKS AFTER THE AMBASSADOR RETURNS.
DEPARTMENT REPEAT TO OTHER POSTS AS DESIRED.
