1978TEHRAN07890.subject: INCREASE IN RELIGIOUS PRESSURE ON GOVERNMENT

segments.text: SUMMARY: RHETORIC AND CROWD ACTIVITY IN TEHRAN IS INCREASING SLIGHTLY. RELIGIOUS ELEMENTS APPEAR TO BE PLANNING SIGNIFICANT DEMONSTRATIONS FOR THREE-DAY MOURNING FOR DEATH OF IMAM ALI. SECRET TALKS BETWEEN GOI AND GOVERNMENT CONTINUE. RELIGIOUS LEADERS SEE CHANGE NECESSARY. END SUMMARY.

EYEWITNESS IRANIAN SOURCE TELLS US THERE HAS BEEN ALMOST CONTINUAL MINOR UPHEAVEL IN SOUTH TEHRAN FOR PAST SEVEN TO TEN DAYS. AYATOLLAHS AT MAJOR MOSQUES HAVE BECOME MORE ANTIGOVERNMENT AND IN SOME CASES ANTI-FOREIGN AND DIRECTLY ANTIAMERICAN. RESULT HAS BEEN SMALL GROUPS OF MEN IN THEIR TEENS OR TWENTIES HAVE BEEN ROAMING THE STREETS BREAKING WINDOWS. THE LOW LEVEL VIOLENCE THUS FAR HAS BEEN SPORADIC.

FIRST SERIOUS INDICATIONS THAT MOSQUE CROWDS MAY BE PREPARED FOR DEMONSTRATIONS FOLLOWING EARLY AFTERNOON PRAYER SESSIONS CAME AUG 15. LARGE CROWD LEAVING MOSQUE AT SHAHNAZ SQUARE REFUSED TO DISPERSE WITH USUAL ENCOURAGEMENT BY POLICE AND LED AUTHORITIES ON A BIT OF A CHASE UP TO THE CORNER OF TAKTE JAMSHID AND OLD SHEMIRAN ROAD, SOME SIX BLOCKS FROM THE EMBASSY. GOI THAT DAY BEGAN PRECAUTIONARY STATIONING OF MILITARY UNITS AT KEY POINTS IN THE CITY. TO THE BEST OF OUR KNOWLEDGE, THERE HAS BEEN NO OUTBREAK OF SIGNIFICANT VIOLCNE, BUT POLICE REMAIN IN POSITION AROUND MOSQUES TO ENCOURAGE SUFFICIENT SWIFT DISPERSAL AFTER MAJOR PRAYER MEETING. ON AUG.
16, TEHRAN BAZAAR WAS CLOSED, BUT TROOPS WERE NEEDED TO BREAK UP CROWD EXITING FROM BAZAAR MOSQUE.

OUR SOURCES CLOSE TO THE RELIGIOUS COMMUNITY SAY THAT MORE DEMONSTRATIONS ARE PLANNED FOR THE AUG. 24 TO 26 PERIOD, THE VERY EMOTIONAL MOURNING OF THE DEATH OF IMAM ALI. ONE SOURCE TELLS US THAT SOME SOUTH TEHRAN MOSQUES ARE CIRCULATING SIGN-UP LISTS FOR A SIT IN TO BE HELD ON THE SHAHANSHAHI EXPRESSWAY AUG. 26. WE UNDERSTAND THE ARMENIAN MOSQUE NEAR THE BAZAAR HAS BEEN CLOSED FOR A WEEK.

POLITICAL BYPLAY AMOUNG RELIGIOUS LEADERS AND BETWEEN THEM AND THE GOVERNEMENT HAS INCREASED RAPIDLY OVER THE PAST FEW WEEKS. AYATOLLAH SHARITMADARI TOLD AGENCE FRANCE PRESS (AFP) THAT HIS PEOPLE WERE AGAINST COMMUNISM AND THAT THE SHAH HIMSELF SHOULD SPEAK WITH THE PEOPLE. SHARIATMADARI CRITICIZED THE GOVERNMENT'S HANDLING OF DEMONSTRATIONS IN SHIRAZ AND OPPOSED MARTIAL LAW IN ISFAHAN. HE STRONGLY OPPOSED VIOLENT ACTIVITIES ON BEHALF OF HIS FOLLOWERS BUT SAID THE GOVERNEMENT SHOULD OD MORE FOR THE PEOPLE.

WE UNDERSTAND FROM ONE WELL PLACED SOURCE THAT COURT MINISTER HOVEYDA WAS VERY IRRITATED WITH THIS INTERVIEW, BUT WAS TOLD BY A SENIOR IRANIAN THAT "AFTER ALL, SHARIATMADARI IS NOT A MEMBER OF YOUR STAFF."

WITHIN PAST FEW DAYS AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI SENT SHARIATMADARI A MESSAGE TO STOP TALKING ABOUT A CONSTITUTION AND PARLIAMENT SINCE KHOMEINI OPPOSED THEM ALL. SOURCE WHO HAS BEEN INVOLVED IN GOVERNEMENT/RELIGIOUS DISCUSSIONS TELLS US SHARIATMADARI SENT KHOMEINI "PUT UP OR SHUT UP" MESSAGE TO THE EFFECT THAT IF KHOMEINI WAS SO STRONG, HE SHOULD COME TO TEHRAN AND SPEAK FACE TO FACE WITH THE AYATOLLAHS WHO LIVE IN IRAN. SHARIATMADARI NOTED KHOMEINI LIVED FAR AWAY FROM IRAN AND HAD REFUSED TO CRITICIZE THE IRAQI GOVERNEMENT WHEN IT TOOK SEVERE ACTION AGAINST DEMONSTRATORS IN NAJAF ABOUT TWO YEARS AGO.

SHARIATMADARI HAS TOLD HIS ADVISORS THAT HE "DOES NOT WISH TO BE SHAH" BUT WANTS CONSTITUTIONAL LAW AND A PARLIAMENT. SUBSEQUENT TO THIS, KHOMEINI REPORTEDLY ISSUED A PROCLAMATION CALLING ON ARMY ------------------120391 171348Z /42 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 9903 INFO AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY LONDON SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 7890 NOFORN AND POLICE OFFICERS NOT TO FIRE ON THEIR BROTHERS AND GO AGAINST THE GOVERNEMENT. ONE SOURCE REPLIED THIS IS THE FIRST OCCASION IN SOME TIME THAT ONE OF HIS MESSAGES HAS FALLEN ON DEAF EARS.

VERY SENSITIVE SOURCE RELAYED TO US THE SUBSTANCE OF A MEETING BETWEEN SAVAK CHIEF MOGHADDAM AND SHARIATMADARI'S SON-IN-LAW ABBASI NIGHT OF AUG. 15. MOGHADDAM REPORTEDLY ASKED WHAT THE RELIGIOUS COMMUNITY WANTED AND ABBASI TICKED OFF FOLLOWING POINTS: A) THERE MUST BE A NEW GOVERNMENT. THE PRESENT CABINET IS UNRESPONSIVE TO THE PEOPLE AND IS BLAMED FOR THE KILLING THAT HAS TAKEN PLACE SINCE JANUARY.

THE NEXT GOVERNMENT MUST AT A MINUMUM CALL TO ACCOUNT SOME OF THE MAJOR INDIVIDUALS SUSPECTED OF CORRUPTION, SUCH AS ALI REZA'I, MANSOUR YASSINI AND MAJOR INDUSTRIALISTS LAJEVARDI AND FOULADI. C) THE ACTIVITIES OF PRINCESS ASHRAF ARE ANATHEMA TO THE RELIGIOUS COMMUNITY. SHE MUST BE CURTAILED. THE FINANCIAL ACTIVITIES OF AT LEAST TWO MEMBERS OF THE ROYAL FAMILY, GHOLAM REZA, AND MAHMOUD REZA MUST AT A MINIMUM BE REINED IN. ABBASSI TOLD MOGHADDAM CRITICALLY THAT MAHMOUD'S FRIEND MOZZAFARI JANDARI SHOULD BE FORCED OUT OF THE OPIUM GROWING BUSINESS.

D) THE POEPLE MUST BE FREE TO TALK AND WORSHIP, SHARIATMADARI'S PEOPLE GREATLY APPROVED OF THE SHAT'S CONSTITUTION DAY SPEECH AND MOGHADDAM WAS TOLD TO TELL THE SHAH THIS. MOGHADDAM REPLIED HE WOULD BE SEEING THE SHAH THAT EVENING.

AS A RESULT OF THE ABOVE DISCUSSION, THREE MAJOR AYATOLLAHS, SHARIATMADARI, GOLPAYGAN AND MARIASHI, DECIDED TO ISSUE A BULLETIN WHICH, WHILE ANTI -GOVERNMENT IN TONE, WILL CALL FOR MOSLEMS TO STOP KILLING THEIR BROTHERS AND TO REFRAIN FROM PUBLIC DISORDER. WE UNDERSTAND FROM OUR BEST SOURCE THAT RELIGIOUS GROUPS AT SOME POINT HAVE DISCUSSED POSSIBLE PRIME MINISTERS TO REPLACE AMOUZEGAR. MODERATE RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP BELIEVES SENIOR STATESMAN IS NECESSARY, SOMEBODY WITH CONFIDENCE OF BOTH SHAH AND PEOPLE. OUR SOURCE THOUGHT TWO NAMES HAD BEEN BANDIED ABOUT: ALI AMINI AND SENATE PRESIDENT SHARIF EMAMI. HE HIMSELF ADDED SHAH'S ADVISORS FARDUST AND MOINIAN.
ACCORDING TO SOURCE, SHARIF EMEMAI WAS THOUGHT TO BE THE BEST CANDIDATE BECAUSE HE IS A VERY RELIGIOUS MAN HIMSELF AND HAS SOLID POLITICAL BACKING.

OUR RELIGIOUS SOURCES ARE ALL PESSIMISTIC THAT FURTHER VIOLENCE CAN BE AVOIDED UNLESS THERE ARE SOME CHANGES IN THE OFFING. RADICAL RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP PLAYS ON EVERY INCIDENT TO WHIP UP MORE FEELING AND THE MOOD, PARTICULARLY IN TEHRAN, IS COMING TO AN ACCEPTANCE OF MORE DEMONSTRATIONS.

1978TEHRAN07900.subject: 375 KILLED IN ABADAN THEATER FIRE BOMBING

segments.text: PERSIAN RADIO NOW CARRYING STORY OF FIRE BOMBING OF REX THEATER IN ABADAN AUGUST 19. ACCORDING TO STORY, 375 WERE KILLED WITH ONLY A HANDFUL ESCAPING WHEN FIRE BOMB OR BOMBS WERE THROWN INTO PACKED MOVIE HOUSE. ABOVE CONFIRMED BY GOI SECURITY AUTHORITIES.
AS OF NOW AUTHORITIES KNOW OF NO RPT NO FOREIGNERS KILLED. SINCE MOVIE WAS IN PERSIAN, EMBASSY BELIEVES THERE IS STRONG KIKELIHOOD THAT NO AMCITS WERE INVOLVED.
THIS DISASTER FOLLOWS INCIDENT IN MASHAD AUG. 17, WHEN ARYA MOVIE HOUSE IN THAT CITY WAS SET ABLAZE AND THREE PEOPLE, ALL THEATER EMPLOYEES, WERE KILLED.

ON 19 AUGUST, AEOI'S MANZOOR PROVIDED SCIATT WITH OFFICIAL (CABINET APPROVED) PERSIAN TEXT OF SUBJECT AGREEMENT AND NOTE, AND MARK-UP OF VERSION ALREADY SENT TO WASHINGTON. THE LATTER IS INTENDED AS CONVENIENT REFERENCE TO ALL CHANGES MADE. MANZOOR ASSURES US THAT, DESPITE NUMEROUS CHANGES TO PERSIAN TEXT, THE ONLY CHANGE TO ENGLISH VERSION IS THAT STATED REFTEL, PARA 1. AS SOON AS DOCUMENTS ARE SENT TO WASHINGTON, EMBASSY WILL PROVIDE DETAILS ON TRANSMITTAL.

MANZOOR STATED THAT DR. ETEMAD INTENDS TO SIGN AND WILL BE AVAILABLE FOR THE SIGNING IN TEHRAN THROUGH SEPTEMBER TENTH; HOWEVER, MANZOOR URGED STRONGLY THAT SIGNING BE SCHEDULED DURING NEXT TWO WEEKS IF AT ALL POSSIBLE.

MANZOOR OFFERED TO PROVIDE ON BEHALF OF AEOI TWO COPIES OF ENGLISH AND TWO COPIES OF PERSIAN TEXTS FOR SIGNING CEREMONY. AS IS CUSTOMARY FOR AEOI, THE COPY TO BE RETAINED BY GOI WILL STATE GOI NAME FIRST, TO BE FOLLOWED BY USG, WITH OTHER COPY WHICH IS TO BE RETAINED BY U.S., PRINTED IN THE REVERSE ORDER, WITH RESPECT TO THE TWO GOVERNMENT. AEOI ASKS IF U.S. SIDE IS SATISFIED THAT GOI PROVIDE THESE COPIES FOR SIGNING OR IF U.S. HAS ANOTHER PREFERENCE. PLEASE CONFIRM ACCEPTANCE OF AEOI TO FURNISH THE TEXTS FOR SIGNING CEREMONY OR PROVIDE ALTERNATIVE RECOMMENDATION ASAP.

SUBSEQUENT TO OUR EARLIER REPORT (REFTEL), GOVERNMENT SOURCES HAVE TOLD US THAT SURVIVORS HAVE ASCRIBED CINEMA DISASTER TO EXPLOSION IN CEILING. WE HAVE IMPRESSION THAT TEHRAN OFFICIALS STILL HAVE INCOMPLETE UNDERSTANDING OF WHAT OCCURRED PRECISELY. OFFICIALS ARE STILL BLAMING SUBVERSIVE TERRORIST ELEMENTS.

1978TEHRAN07949.subject: SHAH GIVES WARNING AND PROMISES TO DISSIDENTS BEGIN UNCLASSIFIED SUMMARY: IN PRESS CONFERENCE AUG 17 WITH IRANIAN E

segments.text: BEGIN UNCLASSIFIED SUMMARY: IN PRESS CONFERENCE AUG 17 WITH IRANIAN EDITORS. SHAH WARNED THAT HE AND ARMY WOULD NOT PERMIT RECURRENCE OF 1953 CIVIL DISORDER. ON THE OTHER HAND, RECENT DISTURBANCES, WHICH HE ATTRIBUTED TO ISLAMIC MARXISTS, WOULD NOT HALT LIBERALIZATION. NEW LEGISLATION AFTER SUMMER RECESS WILL GUARANTEE FREEDOM OF PRESS, SPEECH, AND ASSEMBLY WITHIN BOUNDS OF NATIONAL LAWS. HE REAFFIRMED THAT OPPOSITION CANDIDATES MAY RUN IN NEXT ELECTION BUT DID NOT SAY WHETHER OPPOSITION PARTIES WOULD BE ALLWED. HE HAS ISSUED ORDERS BARRING MEMBERS OF THE IMPERIAL FAMILY FROM PARTICIPATING IN BUSINESS VENTURES OR MAKING RECOMMENDATIONS TO GOI OFFICIALS. HE DENIED RUMORS OF ILL HEALTH. END SUMMARY.

ON EVE OF CELEBRATION OF TWENTY-FIFTH ANNIVERSARY OF 1953 NATIONAL UPRISING, SHAH DISCUSSED CIVIL UNREST AND FUTURE OF LIBERALIZATION PROGRAM WITH IRANIAN MEDIA REPRESENTATIVES. AFTER REMINISCING ABOUT EVENTS OF AUGUST 1953, SHAH MADE FOLLOWING POINTS REGARDING PRESENT AND FUTURE

RIOTS ARE WORK OF ISLAMIC MARXISTS. HE CITED NO FOREIGN POWERS, BUT SAID LOGANS CARRIED BY RIOTERS SHOWED WHO WAS BEHIND THEM. AS IN 1953, COMMUNISTS ARE TRYING TO MAKE IRAN INTO "IRANISTAN", BUT "THE PATRIOTS, THE ARMED FORCES AND I WILL NOT LET THEM EXECUTE THEIR PLOT." WHILE HE TOOK A LONG TIME TO ACT IN 1953, "THE SITUATION IS DRASTICALLY DIFFERENT NOW." HE HAD CONSIDERED RIOTS TO BE PRICE OF DEMOCRATIZATION, BUT " I DID NOT THINK THIS PRICE WOULD BE SO HIGH." COMMUNISTS ARE OFFERING THE GREAT TERROR IN CONTRAST WITH HIS GREAT CIVILIZATION.

LIBERALIZATION PROGRAM WILL CONTINUE. FIRST BILLS TO BE SUBMITTED TO MAJLES AFTER SUMMER RECESS WILL PROVIDE GUARANTEES FOR FREEDOM OF SPEECH, PRESS, AND ASSEMBLY. "IT IS YOUR DUTY, AS REPRESENTATIVES OF THE PRESS, TO DISTINGUISH BETWEEN FREE EXPRESSION AND LIBEL, BETWEEN CRITICISM AND SLANDER." SHAH STATED THAT OTHER CAUSES OF DISATISFACTION MAY TAKE TIME TO CORRECT--FOR EXAMPLE, GOI HAS COMPILED "HUNDREDS OF THOUSANDS OF CASES OF PROFITEERING," AND IT WOULD TAKE TEN YEARS TO DEAL WITH THEM, UNLESS GOI CHOOSES TO WRITE THEM OFF, ON UNDER-STANDING THAT PROFITEERS HAVE LEARNED THEIR LESSON. SHAH EMPHASIZED ECONOMIC PROGRESS AS FULFILLING A HUMAN RIGHT, "THE RIGHT TO HAVE EMPLOYMENT".
AGRICULTURAL COOPERATIVES AND INDUSTRIAL PROFIT-SHARING ARE FURTHER EXAMPLES OF EXPANSION OF HUMAN RIGHTS.

ELECTIONS WILL TAKE PLACE AS SCHEDULED. OPPOSITION CANDIDATES MAY RUN FOR MAJLES, PROVIDED THYE ACCEPT THE OATH TAKEN BY ALL NEW MAJLES REPRESENTATIVES: "WE ---TAKE GOD AS WITNESS AND SWEAR ON THE HOLY KORAN TO---BE SINCERE AND TRUTHFUL TO HIS IMPERIAL MAJESTY THE SHAHANSHAH...

AND TO REFRAIN FROM BETRAYING THE FOUNDATION OF THE THRONE AND THE RIGHTS OF THE NATION." SHAH REQUESTED PRESS TO PRINT OATH, ADDING "I HAVE NOTHING TO SAY IF THEY ABIDE BY IT." ASKED WHETHER FURTHER RIOTS MIGHT CAUSE POSTPONEMENT OF ELECTIONS, SHAH LEFT SOME ROOM FOR DOUBT: "I WISH TWO POINTS WILL HAVE BECOME CLEAR BY THE TIME OF THE ELCTIONS: THE FIRST ONE IS WHETHER THE GOVERNEMENT HAS THE POWER TO PRESERVE LAW AND ORDER; TH E SECOND ONE IS THE CODE OF ALL KINDS OF FREEDOM WHICH IS THE FIRST BILL TO BE SUBMITTED TO PARLIAMENT AFTER THE SUMMER RECESS." HE WARNED: "IF, DESPITE ALL THE CIVIL, INDIVIDUAL AND POLITICAL LIBERTIES THEY, ARE TO ENJOY...

THEY STILL REFUSE TO QUIET DOWN, THEN WHAT ARE WE SUPPOSED TO DO? I DO NOT NEED TO SPELL IT OUT. YOU CAN READILY COME UP WITH THE ANSWER." (COMMENT: PRESS NOTED THIS COULD MEAN CHANGE IN LIBERALIZATION PLANS BUT SAW IT AS REAFFIRMATION OF GOI DESIRE TO MOVE FORWARD DESPITE HEAVY SLEDDING.)

RASTIKHIZ PARTY NO LONGER EXPECTED TO BE PARTY OF ALL IRANIANS. " NOW THAT WE ARE PROGRESSING TOWARDS MAXIMUM ENJOYMENT OF CIVIL AND POLITICAL LIBERTIES, WE DON NOT EXPECT 100 PER CENT OF THE POPULATION TO JOIN THE RASTIKHIZ." THOSE WHO WISH MAY PARTICIPATE IN POLITICS OUTSIDE RASTIKHIZ. SHAH STOPPED SHORT OF SAYING, HOWEVER, THAT DISSIDENTS MAY ORGANIZE INTO COMPETING PARTIES. ASKED WHETHER WINGS OF RASTIKHIZ MIGHT BECOME INDEPENDENT ASSOCATIONS, SHAH SAID IT WAS A LIGITIMATE QUESTION WHICH RASTIKHIZ PARTY SHOULD CONSIDER.

IMPERIAL DECREE REGARDING BUSINESS DEALINGS BY MEMBERS OF ROYAL FAMILY WAS CONFIRMED AFTER QUESTIONER RAISED THE ISSUE. (EMBASSY COMMENT: COURT MINISTER REPORTEDLY PLANTED THIS QUESTION.). NO MEMBER OF IMPERIAL FAMILY MAY PARTICIPATE IN PUBLIC OR PRIVATE BUSINESS VENTURES OR MAKE RECOMMENDATIONS DIRECTLY OR INDIRECTLY TO GOI OFFICIALS ON THEIR OWN BEHALF OR THAT OF OTHERS.
SHAH'S HEALTH IS EXCELLENT DESPITE RUMORS TO CONTRARY. (EMBASSY COMMENT: CHARGE NOTED SHAH APPEARED FIT AND WELL AT AUDIENCE AUG 13.)

ARMED FORCES OF IRAN WILL BE READY IN FIVE YEARS TO DEFEND A NATION OF FORTY MILLION. END UNCLASSIFIED. BEGONFIDENTIAL. COMMENT: DESPITE WINNING HEADLINES "NO SLOWDOWN TO LIBERALIZATION" IN TEHRAN JOURNAL, SHAH IMPLIED THAT FUTURE POLICY DEPENDS ON RESPONSIBLE ATTITUDE OF CITIZENRY. HE INDICATED THAT IF NEW OPENNESS IN PUBLIC EXPRESSION AND IN MAJLES ELECTIONS CREATES EXTENSIVE TROUBLE RATHER THAN PROGRESS, HE HAS NECESSARY FORCE TO MAINTAIN INTERNAL SECURITY. AUG. 19 ABADAN THEATRE DISASTER (TEHRAN 7900 NOTAL) HAS STIFFENED GENERAL NATIONAL MOOD ON QUESTION OF VIOLENCE. FURTHER COMMENT WILL FOLLOW.
TEXT OF PRESS COVERAGE BEING POUCHED.
B1-7606; INVOICE NO. A-196.

SUMMARY: TEHRAN PRESS AUGUST 21-22 GIVES LAVISH COVERAGE TO AUGUST 19 FIREBOMBING OF REX THEATER, ABADAN. DEATH TOLL UNOFFICIALLY STANDS AT 430. DETAILS STILL UNCLEAR. OFFICIALS SAY TERRORISTS POURED GASOLINE ON ALL SIDES OF THEATER, THEN IGNITED IT, BUT SOME WITNEESSES HEARD AN EXPLOSION. PRESS REPORTS EXPRESSIONS OF CONDOLENCE AND OUTRAGE. OPPOSITION LEADERS SUSPICIOUS, BUT HOLDING OFF PUBLIC COMMENT. END SUMMARY.

TEHRAN PRESS OF AUGUST 21-22 DEVOTES BANNER HEADLINES AND NUMEROUS PHOTOS TO DISASTROUS FIRE IN REX THEATER, ABADAN (REFTELS). FIREMEN FOUND 377 BODIES INSIDE, AND DEATH TOLL HAS UNOFFICIALLY RISEN TO 430. IT WILL PROBABLY RISE STILL HIGHER, SINCE ESTIMATES OF THE THEATER AUDIENCE RANGE FROM 600 TO 700, AND ONLY TWENTY TO FORTY PPLE ARE THOUGHT TO HAVE ESCAPED WITHOUT INJURY. AUTHORITIES DO NOT KNOW HOW MANY ATTENDED FILM BECAUSE CHILDREN WERE ADMITTED FREE.

FIRE STARTED ABOUT 2145, SHORTLY AFTER PERSIAN LANGUAGE FILM BEGAN. MOST REPORTS STATE ARSONISTS POURED GASOLINE AROUND BUILDING, WAITED FOR IT TO SEEP INSIDE, THEN LIGHTED IT. SOME SURVIVORS, HOWEVER, REMEMBER HEARING EXPLOSION BEFORE FLAMES BROKE OUT. WITNESSES AGREE THEATER WAS ALMOST IMMEDIATELY ENGULFED IN FLAME. CROWD RAN FOR ONLY EXIT AND FOUND DOOR LOCKED. DOORKEEPER SAID IT WAS LOCKED TO PREVENT TERRORIST ATTACK. (SAME FILM WAS SUBJECT OF BOMBING INCIDENT TWO MONTHS AGO.) FIREMEN COULD NOT CONTROL BLAZE UNTIL 0200. THEN THEY COULD ONLY RETRIEVE BODIES.

POLICE REPORT TEN ARRESTS, INCLUDING THREE PEOPLE WHO HAD EXPLOSIVES IN THEIR POSSESSION, BUT DO NOT CLAIM TO HAVE CAUGHT THE ACTUAL PERPETRATORS. THREE OF THOSE ARRESTED ARE CINEMA OWNER AND TWO EMPLOYEES, WHO HAVE BORNE HEAVY CRITICISM FOR NEGLIGENCE.
EXPRESSIONS OF GRIEF OVER "THE WORST TERRORIST OUTRAGE IN LIVING MEMORY" FILL PRESS. SHAH, SHAHBANOU AND PM AMOUZEGAR SENT MESSAGES OF CONDOLENCE.

SPOKESMAN FOR GROUP FOR THE STUDY OF IRANIAN PROBLEMS DEMANDED SEVERE PUNISHMENT FOR ARSONISTS, ADDING: "WORDS ARE INCAPABLE OF EXPRESSING OUR DISGUST AND ANGER AT SUCH MASS MURDER." MAJLIS DEPUTY MOHSEN PEZESHKPOUR, SPOKESMAN FOR OPPOSITION TO MARTIAL LAW IN ISFAHAN DURING AUGUST 20 SPECIAL SESSION, EXPRESSED SHOCK: " I DO NOT KNOW WHO COULD COMMIT THIS ACT." RELIGIOUS LEADERS CALLED ATTACK "UNISLAMIC." AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI IS QUOTED AS CONDEMNING ACTION OF "HOT-HEADED PEOPLE WITH WHOM WE HAVE NO LINKS WHATSOEVER." LEADING MASHAD AYATOLLAH SHIRAZI ALSO CONDEMNED ARSONISTS, AND AYATOLLAH NOURI DESCRIBED INCIDENT AS "INHUMAN." DR.

SAYED HEJAZI DEPLORED "A COWARDLY ACT MOST HATED BY THE CULTURE AND TEACHINGS OF ISLAM." AYATOLLAH VAHIDI (COMMENT: A KHOMEINI SUPPORTED END COMMENT) DECLINED TO GIVE SIMILAR STATEMENT"SINCE THE TRUTH CONCERNING THIS INCIDENT IS NOT YEAR CLEAR." MIN INFO HOMAYOUN, AFTER CABINET MEETING AUGUST 21, COMMENTED THAT PEOPLE MUST UNITE AGAINST "THE GREAT TERROR," AND ASSURED PUBLIC THAT FULLER SECURITY MEASURES WOULD BE TAKEN.

MILITANT OPPOSITIONIST SOURCE EVENING AUGUST 21 SET FORTH TO EMBOFF HIS VIEW OF UNCERTAINTIES SURROUNDING ABADAN IN WAY WHICH SUGGESTED GOI CONNIVANCE IN FIRE, THOUGH HE BACKED OFF DIRECT STATEMENT BY SAYING OPPOSITIONIST INVESTIGATION NOW UNDERWAY. IN VIEW OF MILITANTS, FACT THAT ABADAN POLICE CHIEF RAZMI WAS POLICE CHIEF OF QOM DURING JANUARY RIOTS PLUS DELAY IN FIRE EQUIPMENT GETTING TO SCENE SUGGESTS, AT A MINIMUM, THAT OFFICIALS WERE NOT ON THEIR TOES. SOURCE PARTICULARLY EAGER TO ESTABLISH THAT BOMBING/FIRE WAS NOT WORK OF "TERRORISTS," SINCE THEY "NEVER ATTACKED PEOPLE." PROBLEM OF ABADAN FIRE IS OBVIOUSLY ONE WHICH WILL HAUNT OPPOSITION FOR SOME TIME TO COME.
SEVEN MAJLIS DEPUTIES HAVE REQUESTED A SPECIAL SESSION TO INVESTIGATE ABADAN TRAGEDY, CALLING FOR FULL REPORT FROM GOVERNMENT.
MOVIE THEATERS HAVE CLOSED IN PROTEST, AND MOST WILL REMAIN CLOSED UNTIL AUGUST 27. (COMMENT: BY-PASSING AUGUST 24-26 HIGH MOURNING PERIOD. END COMMENT)
