1978TEHRAN08083.subject: NATIONAL FRONT ANNOUNCES ITS REEMERGENCE: HITS GOI ON ABADAN FIRE SUMMARY: AT A PRESS CONFERENCE IN TEHRAN, EVENING

segments.text: ABADAN FIRE SUMMARY: AT A PRESS CONFERENCE IN TEHRAN, EVENING OF AUG. 23, SPOKESMAN DR. KARIM SANJABI ANNOUNCED THE RECREATION OF THE IRANIAN NATIONAL FRONT (INF) AS A FORMAL ORGANIZATION BUT NOT A POLITICAL PARTY. PREPARED STATEMENT BITTERLY ATTACKED GOI AND SHAH PERSONALLY AND CALLED POLITICAL LIBERALIZATION A SHAM. NATIONAL FRONT STATEMENT IDENTIFIED GROUP WITH THE OLD NATIONAL FRONT OF OIL NATIONALIZATION DAYS. INF SEEKS AN INDEPENDENT FOREIGN POLICY BASED ON IRANIAN NATIONAL INTERESTS AND A SOUND FRAMEWORK OF INTERNATIONAL RELATIONS. END SUMMARY.

AT A PRESS CONFERENCE IN HIS HOME THE EVENING OF AUG. 23, DR. KARIM SANJABI, ACTING AS SPOKESMAN FOR THE NEWLY RECONSTITUTED IRANIAN NATIONAL FRONT ANNOUNCED ESTABLISHMENT OF THAT ORGANIZATION AS "A FORMAL ORGANIZATION" BUT NOT A POLITICAL PARTY. PRESENT AT THE PRESS CONFERENCE WERE A NUMBER OF FOREIGN REPORTERS INCLUDING REPRESENTATIVES OF TIME, NEWSWEEK, WASHINGTON POST, MANCHESTER GUARDIAN, WIRE SERVICES AND FRENCH TELEVISION. ORGANIZERS OF THE MEETING SAID REPRESENTATIVES OF THE LOCAL PRESS HAD BEEN INVITED BUT KAYHAN SAID ITS REPORTERS WERE FORBIDDEN TO ATTEND. TEHRAN JOURNAL REPORTER RAISED HIS HAND AND SAID NO ONE HAD FORBIDDEN HIM TO ATTEND.
THERE WAS NO IRANIAN PRESS OR MEDIA COVERAGE OF THIS MEETING, BUT WE UNDERSTAND BBC AND CBS CARRIED SMALL ITEMS ON IT.

MEETING BEGAN WITH READING OF PREPARED STATEMENT BY DR. SANJABI. HE TOOK A VERY HARD LINE AGAINST THE GOVERNMENT AND THE SHAH, STATING "THE REIGN OF TERROR AND DECEPTION IN OUR COUNTRY STILL CONTINUES AND THAT SO FAR NO ACTION WHATSOEVER HAS BEEN TAKEN FOR THE RESTORATION OF THE NATION'S RIGHTS". SANJABI STATED THAT THE SHAH IN THE LAST 25 YEARS "HAS TURNED THE CONSTITUTIONAL SYSTEM INTO A DICTATORIAL, ABSOLUTIST REGIME." ELECTION TO PARLIAMENT HAS BECOME THE EQUIVALENT OF ADMINISTRATIVE APPOINTMENT FROM THE SOLE GOVERNMENT PARTY. MOST LEGAL COMPETENCY IS NOW INVESTED IN SAVAK OR MILITARY COURTS. PRESS FREEDOM IS A PHENOMENON NOT TO BE SEEN.

SANJABI DESCRIBED POLITICAL LIBERATION AS A CABINET RESHUFFLE AND THE "INTRODUCTION OF CERTAIN MINOR AND SUPERFICIAL CHANGES" IN MILITARY PROCEDURES AND SOME NEW APPOINTMENTS IN SAVAK. THE NATIONAL FRONT PROCLAIMS "THERE IS NOT EVEN AN ATOM OF TRUTH IN ALL THESE PRETENTIONS AND THAT THERE HAVE BEEN NO STEPS AT ALL TOWARD THE RESTORATION OF A LIBERAL LEGL SYSTEM". SANJABI CLAIMED THAT IT IS IN THE PERIOD OF POLITICAL LIBERALIZATION THAT "PEACEFUL DEMONSTRATIONS ARE SURPRESSED BRUTALLY AND RELIGIOUS PEOPLE GUNNED DOWN MERCILESSLY WHILE THOUSANDS OF OTHERS ARE SENT TO PRISON."

SANJABI'S STATEMENT CRITICIZED THE SHAH FOR DESCRIBING THE INF AS MORE TRAITOROUS THAN THE TUDEH PARTY. HE SAID THE FRONT PROCLAIMS ONE MORE TO BE "THE PROTAGONISTS OF THE COUNTRY'S SOVEREIGNTY AND ITS POLITICAL, ECONOMIC AND CULTURAL INDEPENDENCE. WE PUBLICLY DELCARE TO BE AGAINST ANY COLONIAL INFLUENCE.....""

SANJABI THEN ANNOUNCED THAT THE NATIONAL FRONT WOULD FOLLOW THREE BASIC PRINCIPLES: (A) IT WOULD SEEK THE INDEPENDENCE OF IRAN WHICH WOULD BE POSSIBLE ONLY WHEN "IRAN IS FREED FROM SLAVE-LIKE AFFILIATIONS I HEGENOMIC POWERS". (B) THE INF SEEKS THE PROTECTION OF HUMAN DIGNITIES AND RECOGNITION OF INDIVIDUAL AND SOCIAL LIBERTIES. IT BELIEVES THE SYSTEM OF DESPOTIC MONARCHY TO BE INCOMPATABLE WITH IRAN'S CONSTITUTIONAL POLITY.

(C) THE INF SEEKS AN INDEPENDENT FOREIGN POLICY BASED ON IRAN'S NATIONAL INTEREST, SOVEREIGNTY OF OTHER NATIONS AND STRUGGLE AGAINST ANY KIND OF COLONIALISM THROUGHOUT THE WORLD. ------------------094975 241312Z /45 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 9998 INFO AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY LONDON

ASKED QUESTION ON CAUSE OF ABADAN THEATRE FIRE, SANJABI CONDEMNED IT AS CRIMINAL, SAID NO MUSLIM OR IRANIAN COULD APPROVE OF WHAT HAPPENED. INF HAD NO CORRECT INFORMATION ON WHAT HAPPENED, ONLY WHAT IT HAD SEEN IN THE PRESS AND FROM THE GOVERNMENT. HE THEN WENT ON, "BUT AS I SAID, THERE IS NO DEFINITE PROOF OF WHO DID THIS, BUT IT REMINDS ME OF THE REICHSTAG FIRE." AUSTRIAN AND PERHAPS OTHER EUROPEAN MEDIA ARE DISPLAYING THIS TO MEAN SANJABI ACCUSED GOI OF SETTING FIRE.

WHEN ASKED WHO WAS RESPONSIBLE FOR RECENT VIOLENCE IN ISFAHAN AND SHIRAZ, SANJABI REPLIED THESE ARE ONLY ORDINARY PEOPLE WHO ARE UNHAPPY WITH THE GOVERNMENT, AND IT'S "ANSWER" TO THEIR PROTESTS IS MACHINE GUNS."

SANJABI WAS ASKED WHETHER INF WOULD COOPERATE WITH THE TUDEH PARTY. HE REPLIED THE INF WOULD COOPERATE WITH ANY PARTY REGARDLESS OF ITS IDEOLOGY. HE WAS ASKED WHETHER THE PRESS CONFERENCE ITSELF WAS NOT EVIDENCE OF GREATER FREEDOM AND REPLIED IF THE MEETING OF A FEW MEANS FREEDOM, THEN IT IS, BUT THE POLICE CAN BE SEEN LIMITING AND HARASSING PEOPLE WHEN THEY TRY TO MEET IN THE MOSQUES. WHEN ASKED IF THE INF WOULD PARTICIPATE IN NEXT YEARS NATIONAL ELECTIONS, SANJABI ELLIPTICALLY REPLIED, "FOR FREE ELECTIONS, A FREE ENVIRONMENT AND FREE PRESS ARE NEEDED. IF THE NATION FEELS THE ENVIRONMENT IS FREE, IT WILL PARTICIPATE.
HE STRESSED THAT THE NATIONAL FRONT IS NOT A POLITICAL PARTY BUT A FORMAL ORGANIZATION TO ENABLE THE MASSES TO ACHIEVE FREEDOM ACCORDING TO LAW.

COMMENT: DETAILS OF SANJABI STATEMENT AND NATIONAL FRONT PRINCIPLES BEING POUCHED NEA/IRN. MOST PUBLICLY IDENTIFIED SENIOR FRONT LEADERS WERE PRESENT WITH SANJABI. WE HOPE TO BE ABLE TO IDENTIFY THEM BY NAME LATER. PRESS CONFERENCE IS CLEARLY INF'S MAIDEN ADVENTURE INTO IRAN'S NEW POLITICAL ATMOSPHERE AND ITSELF, TO SOME DEGREE, CONTRADICTS VERY RIGID INF LINE CLAIMING LACK OF FREEDOM. WHAT IS SURPRISING IS THAT INF, HAVING TAKEN DECISION TO ENTER OPEN ARENA, DID NOT ALSO USE MORE CONCILIATORY REETORIC.

ASIDE FROM FACT THAT MANY FRONT LEADERS ARE IDEOLOGICALLY COMMITTED TO A HARD LINE, WE BELIEVE THIS IS ALSO NECESSARY PART OF COMPROMISE TO HOLD BOTH MILITANTS AND MODERATES TOGETHER IN UNITY. INF'S EXTREME VIEW OF POLITICAL "REALITY" IS NOT RPT NOT SHARED BY OBJECTIVE OBSERVERS, EITHER IRANIAN OR FOREIGN, WHO ARE NOT ALREADY COMMITED TO INF VIEWS.

FOLLOWING IS THE TEXT OF THE ADVISORY ISSUED BY THE US MISSION ON AUGUST 20 TO THE OFFICIAL USE MISSION AND TO THE PRIVATE AMERICAN COMMUNITY: AS A GENERAL PRECAUTIONARY STEP IN RESPECT OF THE DEEP MOURNING DAYS OF THE MOSLEM HOLY MONTH OF RAMAZAN FROM AUGUST 24 THROUGH 27 AND ON AUGUST 31, US MISSION PERSONNEL AND THE AMERICAN COMMUNITY SHOULD MAINTAIN THE LOWEST PROFILE POSSIBLE, REFRAINING FROM PARTICIPATING IN TOURS, HOSTING OR ATTENDING LARGE PARTIES, FESTIVITIES, AND OTHER FORMS OF OVERT PUBLIC ACTIVITY.

AMERICANS SHOULD AVOID DURING THIS PERIOD OF TIME AREAS OF THE CITY SUCH AS BAZAARS, MOSQUES, UNIVERSITY AREAS, AND INSTALLATIONS SUCH AS RESTAURANTS, BANKS, MOVIE THEATERS, ETC., WHERE TROUBLE HAS OCCASIONALLY OCCURRED WITH RESPECT TO INCIDENTS OF CIVIL DISORDER. UNQUOTE.

1978TEHRAN08085.subject: POLITICAL SCENE ON EVE OF RAMAZAN DEEP MOURNING

segments.text: BEGIN LIMITED OFFICIAL USE SUMMARY: CYCLE OF VIOLENCE ABATED SLIGHTLY ON EVE OF DAYS OF DEEP MOURNING, AS IRAN ABSORBS ABADAN TRAGEDY. MASS BURIAL AUGUST 22 WAS SCENE OF HYSTERIA AND GRIEF, COVERED EXTENSIVELY BY LOCAL PRESS. DETAILS OF INCIDENT REMAIN UNCLEAR; ABADAN POLICE CHIEF WAS SUMMONED TO TEHRAN TO REPORT. MORE RELIGIOUS LEADERS HAVE CONDEMNED ACTION OF TERRORISTS, BUT SPORADIC VIOLENCE CONTINUES. END SUMMARY

ON EVE OF DEEP MOURNING (AUGUST 24-26) OF RAMAZAN, IRAN IS TRYING TO ABSORB IMPACT OF ABADAN CINEMA DISASTER (REF A). KAYHAN GAVE HEAVY COVERAGE TO EMOTIONAL SCENE OF MASS BURIAL AUGUST 22 OF VICTIMS, MANY STILL UNIDENTIFIED. POLICE CHIEF GENERAL REZA RAZMI HAS BEEN SUMMONED TO TEHRAN "TO REPORT." PRESS QUOTED HIM AS SAYING THAT POLICE NOW THINK TERRORISTS USED INCENDIARY BOMBS RATHER THAN GASOLINE. WE UNDERSTAND SPECIAL COMMISSION REPORT WILL CRITICIZE RAZMI FOR FAILURE TO TAKE ADEQUATE PRECAUTIONS AND SECURITY MEASURES. FRENCH LANGUAGE JOURNAL DE TEHRAN REPORTS POLICE HAVE ARRESTED PERPETRATORS, BUT OTHER MEDIA DO NOT CORROBORATE.

TEHRAN JOURNAL STATES POLICE ARRESTED FOUR MEN WHO HAD EXPLOSIVES, BUT THIS WAS BEFORE THEATER FIRE. DETAILS STILL UNCLEAR: CINEMA OWNER NOW CLAIMS INFAMOUS LOCKED DOOR WAS UNLOCKED. SPECIAL INVESTIGATION COMMISSION REPORTEDLY WILL SHOW DOOR WAS LOCKED, GAS SUFFOCATED MANY SPECTATORS BEFORE THEY COULD ESCAPE, AND INCENDIARY EFFORT WAS WELL PREPARED.

MORE RELIGIOUS LEADERS HAVE ISSUED STATEMENTS CONDEMNING INCIDENT. AYATOLLAH SALEHI KERMANI OF KERMAN STATED SUCH ATROCITIES ARE UNACCEPTABLE TO TRUE MUSLIMS. AYATOLLAH ABTAHI OF ISFAHAN CALLED IT ONE OF THE MOST TRAGIC INCIDENTS SINCE SECOND WORLD WAR, AND SAID ONLY FASCIST ELEMENTS COULD HAVE COMMITTED THIS CRIME.

OPPOSITIONISTS CONTINUE TO SPREAD RUMOR THAT FIRE WAS SOMEWHOW PERPETRATED BY GOI, CITING SHODDY POLICE AND FIRE BRIGADE WORK AND DELAY IN REPORTING NEWS NATIONALLY. NEWEST WRINKLE IS SUGGESTION THAT OSCO, WESTERN OIL CONSORTIUM'S SERVICE COMPANY, WAS BEHIND FIRE AS PART OF EFFORT TO DISRUPT IRAN AND MAKE IT AN EASIER TARGET IN OIL NEGOTIATIONS. TO BEST OF OUR KNOWLEDGE, NO RPT NO SERIOUS OBSERVER OF TRAGEDY HAS SUGGESTED THERE IS ANY MERIT IN THESE STORIES, BUT LIKE MOST OPPOSITIONINSPIRED POLITICAL RUMORS, THEY HAVE SPREAD AROUND QUITE A BIT, HAVING APPEARED IN MAJOR CITIES ELSEWHERE IN IRAN. END LIMITED OFFICIAL USE - BEGIN CONFIDENTIAL

SHIRAZ ARRESTED TWO YOUTHS ATTEMPTING TO PLANT EXPLOSIVES IN ROOF OF PASARGADE CINEMA.12 YEAR OLD BOY SAW PAIR AT WORK AND REPORTED THEM TO POLICE WHO THEN ROUNDED THEM UP. ONE INDIVIDUAL WAS DESCRIBED AS A 20-YEAR OLD WHO WAS WEARING A WIG AND REPORTEDLY A MEMBER OF THE LITERACY CORPS. PRESS MORNING AUGUST 24 CARRIED SMALL ITEM ON EVENT, WHICH SAID PAIR WERE ALSO BELIEVED TO BE IN PROCESS OF PLANTING BOMB IN ADJOINING THEATER AS WELL. SECURITY SOURCES INDICATE METRO CINEMA IN SHIRAZ HAS ALSO BEEN THREATENED.

THOUGH NUMBER OF INCIDENTS HAS DIMINISHED, THEY STILL CONTINUE. FIRE OF UNKNOWN ORIGIN DESTROYED 30 SHOPS IN SOUTHER TEHRAN'S VEGETABLE MARKET MORNING AUGUST 23 BUT THERE WERE NO CASUALTIES. EXPLOSION AND FIRE IN TABRIZ SHOP AUGUST 22 KILLED ONE PERSON AND INJURED TWO OTHERS. IN GOUCHAN, FIRE BADLY DAMAGED AN ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGE COMPANY, WHILE IN ILAM, FIRE SET BY FOUR UNIDENTIFIED MEN DESTROYED RESTAURANT BUILT ENTIRELY OF NATURAL WOOD.

CHECK AROUND TEHRAN AND WITHOUT BETTER-INFORMED DIPLOMATIC COLLEAGUES INDICATES NO RPT NO NEW UNSETTLING INCIDENTS AS OF 1500 LOCAL TIME. RUMORS ABOUND, HOWEVER, INCLUDING VAGUE SUGGESTIONS THAT SOME HOTELS AND AIR TRANSPORT MAY BE TARGETS. GOI AND MOST OF COUNTRY, INCLUDING U.S. MISSION, ARE AT HIGH LEVEL OF ALERT AGAINST VIOLENCE.

1978TEHRAN08101.subject: MEETING WITH SHARIF-EMAMI WHO EXPECTS TO BE NEXT PRIME MINISTER SUMMARY: DCM MET WITH SENATE PRESIDENT SHARIF-EMA

segments.text: PRIME MINISTER SUMMARY: DCM MET WITH SENATE PRESIDENT SHARIF-EMAMI, AT LATTER'S REQUEST, AUG. 26. EMAMI SAID HE WOULD BE NAMED NEW PRIMIN IN NEAR FUTURE, WANTED CLOSE RELATIONS WITH US AND FRANK EXCHANGE ON ANY DIFFERENCES -- EITHER INTERNAL OR EXTERNAL POLICIES, FELT HE WOULD HAVE TO CONCENTRATE ON SOVIET MEDDLING IN IRANIAN AFFAIRS AND DID NOT "WANT TO BE DIVERTED BY ACTIONS OF IRAN'S FRIENDS." END SUMMARY.

SENATOR MESBAHZADEH, PUBLISHER OF KAYHAN PUBLICATIONS, CALLED DCM EVENING AUG. 25 TO REQUEST DCM (SENATOR WAS UNAWARE AMBASSADOR HAD RETURNED TO POST) TO CALL ON SENATE PRESIDENT SHARIF-EMAMI "WHO WILL BE NEW PRIME MINISTER". MEETING TOOK PLACE AT 0800 AUG. 26 AT PAHLAVI FOUNDATION.

SHARIF-EMAMI WASTED NO WORDS AND IMMEDIATELY SAID THAT HE HAD BEEN ASKED TO TAKE OVER AS PRIMIN AND WOULD SEE THE SHAH LATER IN DAY. "I HAVE GIVEN CERTAIN CONDITIONS TO THE SHAH BUT I BELIEVE HE WILL ACCEPT THEM." THE COUNTRY, HE SAID, WAS GOING THROUGH A VERY DIFFICULT PERIOD--RIOTS, ARSON, ETC. AT THE BEGINNING, THE DEMONSTRATIONS MAY HAVE BEEN SPONTANEOUS BUT NOW HE COULD NOT HELP BUT BELIEVE THAT AN OUTSIDE FORCE OR FORCES WERE INVOLVED. THE SOVIETS CLEARLY WOULD BE THE ONLY ONES TO GAIN FROM DISORDER.

HE COULD HANDLE THIS THREAT AS LONG AS HE WAS NOT "DIVERTED BY ACTIONS OF IRAN'S FRIENDS." THEREFORE, HE WANTED TO ESTABLISH CLOSE LINKS WITH THE US--EITHER DIRECTLY WITH HIM OR THROUGH TRUSTED INTERMEDIARIES--SO THAT ANY DIFFERENCES COULD BE FULLY DISCUSSED AND RESOLVED--THIS COVERED EXTERNAL AS WELL AS INTERNAL POLICIES. WHEN THE DCM MENTIONED THAT THE AMBASSADOR HAD RETURNED, SHARIF-EMAMI ASKED THAT THE CONVERSATION BE FULLY REPORTED TO THE AMBASSADOR WITH WHOM HE WANTED A CLOSE RELATIONSHIP.

THE "PREVIOUS" GOVERNMENT, HE SAID, HAD ACTED UNWISELY WITH RESPECT TO BOTH INTERNAL AND EXTERNAL MATTERS. HE HAD ALREADY ESTABLISHED CONTACTS WITH ALL THE MAJOR RELIGIOUS LEADERS, AND EXPECTED THEIR SUPPORT.

HIS GOVERNMENT WOULD TRULY WORK WITHIN THE BOUNDS OF THE CONSTITUTION, THE SHAH WILL NOT BE INVOLVED IN DAY-TO-DAY AFFAIRS ("MY GOVERNMENT WILL NEVER SAY THE SHAH ORDERED THIS OR THAT"), HE AND THE MINISTERS WILL BE RESPONSIBLE AND THE PEOPLE WILL FIND THEM RESPONSIVE TO THEIR NEEDS, AND THE SHAH'S FAMILY WILL NOT BE PERMITTED IN ANY WAY TO INTERFERE IN GOVERNMENT. "I AM SIXTY-EIGHT YEARS OLD, FORTY OF WHICH HAVE BEEN IN SERVICE, AND I KNOW MY PEOPLE AND WHAT THEY WANT. I AM NOT AFRIAD TO TELL THE SHAH THINGS HE MAY NOT WISH TO HEAR."

IN RESPONSE TO SHARIF-EMAMI'S QUERY OF WHAT WAS THE US ASSESSMENT OF CURRENT EVENTS IN IRAN, THE DCM NOTED THAT HE HAD NO INSTRUCTIONS BUT COULD WITH COMPLETE CONFIDENCE STATE THAT THE STABILITY OF IRAN WAS OF GREAT IMPORTANCE TO THE U.S., THAT OUR FOREIGN/SECURITY INTERESTS WERE NEARLY IDENTICAL IN MOST INSTANCES AND THAT NO US INTEREST WHATSOEVER WAS SERVED BY THE CURRENT DISORDERS. THE DCM COMMENTED THAT IT SEEMED ESSENTIAL TO ESTABLISH A CLOSE DIALOGUE WITH RELIGIOUS LEADERS, THE MAJORITY OF WHOM WERE RESPONSIBLE AND SUPPORTED THE MONARCHY AND CONSTITUTION. THE EXTREMISTS HAD TO BE ISOLATED AND THE PROVOCATEURS IDENTIFIED.

HIS MAJESTY'S POLICY OF LIBERALIZATION AND THE DEVELOPMENT OF DEMOCRATIC INSTITUTIONS HAD OUR FULL SUPPORT, HE SAID, AND, IF HIS MAJESTY SELECTED SHARIF-EMAMI AS PRIME MINISTER, WE WISHED HIM EVERY SUCCESS.

SHARIF-EMAMI SAID HE APPRECIATED THESE VIEWS BUT AGAIN REVERTED TO THE THEME THAT HE COULD UNDERSTAND WHY THE SOVIETS WOULD ATTEMPT TO DESTABILIZE IRAN BUT HE COULD NOT COMPREHEND WHY OTHERS WOULD DO SO. "YOU HAD DIFFERENCES WITH THE PREVIOUS GOVERNMENT ON OIL PRICES AND THERE ARE HUMAN RIGHTS, THE DOLLAR AND LIBERALIZATION." ALL THESE MATTERS SHOULD BE DISCUSSED.

WHEN DCM INTERJECTED A COMMENT ABOUT OUR GOOD RELATIONS WITH PREVIOUS GOVERNMENTS, SHARIF-EMAMI HELD UP HIS HAND AND SAID "BUT PERHAPS YOU DO NOT KNOW EVERYTHING THAT SOME AGENCIES OF YOUR GOVERNMENT DO." HE STRESSED THAT HE WANTED EVERYTHING OUT IN THE OPEN BETWEEN US; IF WE HAD COMPLAINTS AND PROBLEMS HE WANTED TO HEAR THEM DIRECTLY FROM US AND WOULD PASS HIS COMPLAINTS TO US AS WELL. THE DCM REPLIED, IN CONCLUDING THE CONVERSATION, THAT IT WAS IN OUR MUTUAL INTERESTS TO HAVE A COMPLETELY CANDID RELATIONSHIP.

COMMENT: THIS WAS A STRANGE CONVERSATION FOR SHARIFEMAMI CLEARLY BELIEVES THAT WE HAVE PLAYED A ROLE IN THE CURRENT DISORDERS. AS AN OLD TIMER IN IRANIAN POLITICS, HE REMEMBERS WELL THE DAYS WHEN WE WERE MORE DIRECTLY INVOLVED IN MANY INTERNAL AFFAIRS BECAUSE OF OUR LARGE ECONOMIC AND MILITARY AID PROGRAMS. LIKE SO MANY IRANIANS, HE SEES THE FOREIGN HAND WHEN THINGS GO BADLY. THERE WAS ALSO MORE THAN A HINT IN HIS COMMENTS OF THAT OTHER PERVASIVE IRANIAN FEAR--THAT FOR SOME ARCANE REASON THE US AND SOVIETS ARE COLLUDING TO DIVIDE IRAN INTO SPHERES OF INFLUENCE.
IN HIS VIEW HE WAS PLACING HIS CARDS ON THE TABLE--ASKING FOR SUPPORT AND WARNING US AT THE SAME TIME.

SHARIF-EMAMI COMES AS CLOSE AS ANYONE HERE OF BEING THE ELDER STATESMAN, THE GENERALLY RESPECTED FIGURE WHO PROBABLY CAN ESTABLISH A DEGREE OF TRUST WITH THE RELIGIOUS LEADERS. THE SHAH NEEDS THIS KIND OF PERSON AT THIS TIME. IF SHARIF-EMAMI IS INDEED DESIGNATED, AMBASSADOR WILL MEET WITH HIM AS SOON AS POSSIBLE IN ATTEMPT DISPEL ANY ILLUSIONS HE MAY HAVE ABOUT MALIGN US INVOLVEMENT IN IRAN'S INTERNAL AFFAIRS.

AMBASSADOR WILL HAVE AUDIENCE WITH SHAH MONDAY, AUG. 28 AND WILL ALSO ATTEMPT TO DISABUSE SHAH OF HIS LINGERING CONCERNS ABOUT US-SOVIET DESIGNS AND US MEDDLING IN IRAN'S INTERNAL AFFAIRS. SULLIVAN *** Current Handling Restrictions *** EXDIS *** Current Classification *** SECRET

1978TEHRAN08102.subject: SHARIF-EMAMI SLATED TO BECOME PRIME MINISTER

segments.text: OTHER SOURCES HAVE NOW INFORMED US THAT PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR HAS ALREADY RESIGNED OR WILL DO SO DURING DAY. SHARIF-EMAMI AND NEW CABINET EXPECTED TO BE PRESENTED TO SHAH AUG. 27. MAJOR CHANGES IN CABINET AND RASTAKHIZ PARTY ARE RUMORED.

1978TEHRAN08133.subject: REQUEST FOR THREAT ASSESSMENT ON IRAN

segments.text: NEA/IRN CAN PROCIDE UP-TO-DATE BACKGROUND ASSESSMENT ON QUESTIONS A AND C.

RE QUESTION B, WE HAVE NO EVIDENCE THAT THE MUJAHIDIN AS AN ORGANIZATION HAS CHANGED ITS "STAND DOWN" POLICY ON TERRORIST ACTS. A POSSIBILITY EXISTS THAT FANATIC GROUPS RESPONSIBLE FOR HOSTILE ACTS MAY BE IN TOUCH WITH MAJAHIDIN BUT NOT CONTROLLED BY IT.

1978TEHRAN08134.subject: NEW CENTRIST POLITICAL ORGANIZATION UNDER PIRASTEH

segments.text: SAYED MEHDI PIRASTEH ANNOUNCED AUG. 21 HE HAS FORMED "CONSTITUTION DEFENDERS FRONT". CLAIMING SUPPORT OF 300 PROMINENT IRANIANS, PIRASTEH PLEDGED TO WORK FOR PROTECTION OF FREEDOM AND IMPLEMENTATION OF CONSTITUTION. PRESENT CONDIDTIONS REQUIRE ENTIRE NATION TO BE MOBILIZED TO DEFEND INTEGRITY AND INDEPENDENCE OF IRAN. "OUR ENDEAVORS WILL BE TO FIGHT FOR THE CAUSE OF THE EFFECTIVE IMPLEMENTATION OF THE CONSTITUTION IN COMPLIANCE WITH TEACHING OF ISLAM. WE ARE OF THE CONVICTION THAT EVERY IRANIAN WILL ASSIST US IN THIS MISSION."

PIRASTEH IS A FORMER VIGOROUS ADMINISTRATOR WHOSE DIFFERENCES WITH TOP GOI LEADERS DROVE HIM INTO POLITICAL EXILE (DIPLOMATIC SERVICE) IN 1960S. AFTER CAREER IN MINISTRY OF JUSTICE, HE JOINED MAJLIS AND WAS BITTER OPPONENT OF MOSADEQ'S NATIONAL FRONT. HE HAS STRONGLY SUPPORTED SHAH'S AUTHORITY. AS GOVERNOR-GERNERAL OF FARS AND THEN KHUZISTAN (1959-62) HE MADE REPUTATION AS FLAMBOYANT BUT EFFECTIVE ADMINISTRATOR WITH A "NEW BROOM" IMAGE. HE ENTERED CABINET AS MINISTER OF JUSTICE IN 1963, BUT AFTER DISPUTES WITH PM MANSUR, HE WAS APPOINTED AMBASSADOR TO IRAQ. HE WON PRAISE FOR THREE YEARS SERVICE IN DIFFICULT POST, HAVING SUCCEEDED IN REESTABLISHING TIES BETWEEN GOI AND IRAQI SHIITE COMMUNITY.
HE SUBSEQUENTLY SERVED AS AMBASSADOR IN BRUSSELS.

PIRASTEH CARRIES REPUTATION AS HEADLINE GRABBER WHO BACKS UP PUBLIC RELATIONS CAMPAIGN WITH SOLID ACCOMPLISHMENT. HE IS THOUGHT TO BE FAIRLY CLOSE TO SHAH. HE HAS CLAIMED, APPARENTLY WITH JUSTICE, TO ENJOY GOOD RELATIONS WITH RELIGIOUS COMMUNITY, AS SHOWN BY SUCCESS IN IRAQ. HE IS PAST PRESIDENT OF IRAN-AMERICAN SOCIEITY AND LIKES TO DEAL WITH AMERICANS.

COMMENT: SEVERAL OPPOSITIONISTS HAVE TOLD EMBOFF THE PIRASTEH IS CONSIDERED TOO CLOSE TO SHAH TO BE EFFECTIVE IN NEW ROLE. IN ANY CASE, FORMATION OF FRONT W WAS ANNOUNCED JUST DAYS BEFORE PROJECTED AUG. 27 CHANGE OF PRIME MINISTER, PIRASTEH IS ONE MAJOR FIGURE QUOTED APPROVINGLY ON SHARIF-EMAMI APPOINTMENT, AND FRONT'S FUTURE MUST BE RECKONED UNCERTAIN AT THIS POINT.

CONSULATE SHIRAZ LEARNED AUG. 23 THAT AN EX-AFGHAN POLICE OFFICER NAMED ABDOL GHAFOOR SAYADI HAD ASKED FOR ASYLUM FROM LOCAL SHIRAZ POLICE. ACCORDING TO HIS STORY, HE HAD WALKED ACROSS IRANIAN BORDER AFTER HIS WIFE AND ALL BUT ONE OF HIS CHILDREN WERE KILLED IN THE APRIL COUP. HE ARRIVED WITH HIS DAUGHTER.

BRIEF PRESS COVERAGE (BEING POUCHED KABUL) INCLUDING PICTURE OF SAYADI AND HIS DAUGHTER APPEARED IN AUGUST 27 TEHRAN JOURNAL. PRESS ACCOUNT ADDS THAT SAYADI WAS ARRESTED FOR ENTERING COUNTRY ILLEGALLY AND IS STILL IN DETENTION. ARTICLE DESCRIBES HIM AS AFGHAN REPUBLIC PARTY SECRETARY FOR KANDAHAR PROVINCE "AND ALSO A MEMBER OF THE POLICE FORCE....."
FOR KABUL: WOULD BE INTERESTED IN KNOWING IF THIS CASE IS SOMETHING WORTH TRACKING OR SIMPLY ADDITIONAL REVOLUTIONARY FLOTSAM.

1978TEHRAN08148.subject: SHARIF-EMAMI SWORN IN AS PRIME MINISTER WITH NEW CABINET

segments.text: CABINET

ABOUT 1030 LOCAL TIME AUG 27 SENATE PRESIDENT JAFAR SHARIF-EMAMI BECAME IRAN'S PRIME MINISTER AND PRESENTED HIS NEW CABINET TO THE SHAH. SHARIF-EMAMI MADE TWO MAJOR POINTS DURING HIS PRESENTATION TO THE THRONE: A) ANYONE IS FREE TO ENTER POLITICAL ACTIVITY IN ANY LEGAL POLITICAL PARTY (THIS PRESUMABLY EXCLUDES ONLY THE COMMUNIST TUDEH PARTY); B) IRAN WILL REVERT TO USING THE ISLAMIC CALENDAR INSTEAD OF THE IMPERIAL CALENDAR BASED ON THE FOUNDING OF THE PERSIAN EMPIRE.

THERE ARE 15 NEW FACES IN THE 21 MAN CABINET. REMAINING WERE THE FOLLOWING: KARIM MOTAMEDI, MIN. OF POST AND TELEGRAPH AND TELEPHONE; MANUCHEHR GANJI, MIN. OF EDUCATION; GEN REZA AZIMI, MINISTER OF WAR; MINMOJHDEHI, MIN. OF HEALTH; MOHAMMED YEGANEH, MIN. OF ECONOMIC AFFAIRS AND FINANCE, REZA AMIN, MIN OF INDUSTRY AND MINES. THE NEW MINISTERS INCLUDE: KHOSROW AFSHAR-GHASSEMLOU, MIN. OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS; MOHAMMED BAHERI, MIN. OF JUSTICE; KAZEM VADIEI, MIN. OF LABOUR AND SOCIAL AFFAIRS; HUSHANG NAHAVANDI MIN. OF SCIENCE AND HIGHER EDUCATION; GEN. ABASS GHARABAGHI, MIN. OF INTERIOR; MOHSEN FOROGHI, MIN. OF CULTURE AND ARTS; AMIR PARVIZ, MIN. OF AGRICULTURE AND RURAL DEVELOPMENT; MAHD MINA, MIN.

OF POWER; BAGHER AMELI-TEHRANIE, MIN. OF INFORMATION; HASSAN ALI MEHRAN, MIN. OF STATE FOR PLAN AND BUDGET; ESSATULLAH YAZDANPANAN, MIN. OF STATE; MANUCHEHR ZZOMOUN, MIN. OF STATE FOR EXECUTIVE AFFAIRS; HASSAN CHALCHIAN, MIN. OF ROADSND COMMUNICATIONS; PARVIZ AVINI, MIN. OF HOUSING; MOHAMMAD RAZI VISHKAHI. MIN. OF TRADE.

BULK OF NEW MEN HAVE BEEN ACTIVE IN POLITICS AT SOME POINT IN PST, BUT NOT INVOLVED IN RECENT GOVERNMENTS. MAJOR CHANGES OF INTEREST ARE AFSHAR-GHASSEMLOU APPOINTMENT AS FOREIGN MINISTER, GENDARMERIE CHIEF GHARABAGHI'S ASSUMPTION OF INTERIOR PORTFOLIO AND THE DUMPING OF ROYAL FAMILY MEMBER MEHRDAD PAHLBOD AS MINISTER OF CULTURE AND ARTS. EMBASSY WILL BE PROVIDING BIO DATA AND FURTHER ANALYSIS IN DAYS TO COME.

1978TEHRAN08150.subject: RAMADAN DEEP MOURNING WEEKEND WRAP UP SUMMARY: SPORADIC VIOLENCE, PARTICULARLY ARSON, CONTINUED THROUGHOUT THREE DAY DEEP MOURNING PERIOD.

segments.text: SUMMARY: SPORADIC VIOLENCE, PARTICULARLY ARSON, CONTINUED THROUGHOUT THREE DAY DEEP MOURNING PERIOD. WEEKEND BROUGHT NO MASSIVE RIOTS OR LARGE SCALE ACTS OF VIOLENCE, ALTHOUGH EMB HAS UNCOMFIRMED REPORT OF SHOOTOUT BETWEEN POLICE AND TERRORISTS. WORST INCIDENT WAS RAMPAGE IN ABADAN BY MOB STILL INCENSED OVER THEATER FIRE. OFFICIAL INVESTIGATION OF ABADAN FIRE CONCLUDED ARSONISTS USED HIGH OCTANE FUEL TO SET FIRE FROM AT LEAST TWO DIFFERENT POINTS. END SUMMARY.

RAMAZAN DEEP MOURNING WEEKEND PASSED WITHOUT COLLAPSE OF PUBLIC ORDER OR LARGE-SCALE CONFRONTATIONS. TEHRAN REMAINED RELATIVELY QUIET AUGUST 26, ASSUMED TO BE PEAK DAY FOR DEMONSTRATIONS. THERE WAS LIGHT VIOLENCE IN SOUTH TEHRAN; A NUMBER OF DEMONSTRATIONS, INVOLVING SMASHING BANK WINDOWS. POLICE USED TEARGAS TO DISPERSE CROWD. WORSE OUTBREAK WAS IN ABADAN, AND IT FALLS OUTSIDE PATTERN OF ANTIMODERNIST VIOLENCE, BECAUSE MOB WAS PROTESTING GOVERNMENT NEGLIGENCE IN PROTECTING REX THEATRE AGAINST TERRORISTS. CROWD BECAME UNRULY, REPORTEDLY DESTROYING BANKS AND OTHER CITY INSTALLATIONS. DURING THIS DISTURBANCE, A FIRE DESTROYED 200 SHOPS IN ABADAN BAZAAR.

MORE STANDARD BOMBINGS AND BURNINGS CONTINUED THROUGHOUT WEEKEND. FIRE IN TOYOTA PARKING GARAGE IN KHORRAMSHAHR KILLED TWO PEOPLE AND INJURED THREE. OTHER FIRES DAMAGED A TEHRAN BREWERY, A KHORRAMABAD FIBER PLANT, A PARKING LOT IN QOM, A CONSTRUCTION WAREHOUSE IN QOUCHAN, AND A PRIVATE CAR IN AHVAZ. A MOSAIC PLANT IN AHVAZ WAS DESTROYED BY FIRE, INJRUING FOUR PEOPLE, RIOTERS SMASHED BANK WINDOWS IN RASHT. BOMBS EXPLODED IN YAZD'S GOLDEN HEN RESTAURANT AND IN DARVISH NIGHT CLUB IN TEHRAN. BOTH PLACES WERE CLOSED FOR RAMAZAN.
EMB RECEIVED REPORT THAT SHOOTOUT BETWEEN SECURITY FORCES AND TERRORIST GROUP OCCURED AUGUST 24. ACCORDING TO REPORT, SEVERAL TERRORISTS WERE KILLED. EMB HAS NO CONFIRMATION YET FROM SECURITY FORCES.

OFFICIAL INVESTIGATION INTO ABADAN TRAGEDY BROUGHT NO DRASTIC NEW INFORMATION. INQUIRY DETERMINED THAT FIRE WAS INDEED ARSON, STARTED WITH HIGH OCTANE GASOLINE RATHER THAN BOMBS. ARSONISTS REPORTEDLY SPREAD INCENDIARY MATERIALS IN WAITING ROOM AND MAIN HALL, IN ADDITION TO WAREHOUSE. DEATH TOLL IS BACK TO 377 BASED ON ACTUAL BODY COUNT, ALTHOUGH THIS APPARENTLY LEAVES A LOT OF POEPLE UNACCOUNTED FOR. INVESTIGATORS CRITICIZED POLICE AND FIREFIGHTERS FOR NEGLIGENCE BUT ACKNOWLEDGED THAT RAPID SPREAD OF BLAZE PRODUCED NOXIOUS GAS WHICH KILLED VICTIMS IN FIRST FEW MINUTES.

1978TEHRAN08162.subject: IMPLEMENTATION OF BONN SUMMIT ANTI-HIJACKING DECLARATION

segments.text: FRG CHARGE CALLED ON DEPUTY FOREIGN MINISTER NADIM AUGUST 24 ON BEHALF OF BONN GROUP TO RAISE IMPLEMENTATION OF BONN SUMMIT ANTI-JIJACKING DECLARATION. NADIM STATED THAT THE GOI STATEMENT ISSUED EARLIER (REF B) WAS PROBABLY THE MAXIMUM THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT COULD DO AT THIS TIME. IN RESPONSE TO THE FRG'S CHARGE'S STATEMENT THAT IT WOULD BE HELPFUL IF GOI COULD SPECIFICALLY ASSOCIATE ITSELF WITH THE BONN DECLARATION, NADIM SAID THAT THE GOI STATEMENT HAD BEEN VERY CAREFULLY DRAFTED AND HAD AVOIDED ANY REFERENCE TO THE BONN SUMMIT IN VIEW OF THE AUTOMATIC SANCTIONS.
IN VIEW OF THE APPROACH BY SEVEN COUNTRIES, NADIM SIAD HE WOULD RAISE THE ISSUE AGAIN TO THE FOREIGN MINISTER BUT HE DID NOT EXPECT ADDITIONAL GOI ACTION.
GOI SPOKESMAN SAID THAT CHANGE OF GOVERNMENT AUG. 27 WILL HAVE NO EFFECT ON IMMINENT VISITS BY CHINA'S KUA AND JAPAN'S FUDUKA.

RESIGNATION OF PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR AND APPOINTMENT OF NEW CABINET UNDER EX-SENATE PRESIDENT SHARIF-EMAMI CAME ONLY TWO DAYS BEFORE CHAIRMAN HUA WAS DUE IN FOR A THREE-DAY STATE VISIT. SPOKESMAN SAID THERE WOULD BE NO CHANGE IN THE CHINESE LEADER'S SCHEDULE. HIS TALKS "WOULD BE PRIMARILY WITH THE SHAH RATHER THAN WITH MEMBERS OF THE NEW GOVERNMENT."

THERE WAS NO MENTION OF SCHEDULE FOR FUKUDA VISIT DUE TO START SEPT. 5, BUT SPOKESMAN NOTED THAT THESE TALKS WERE EXPECTED TO CONCENTRATE MORE ON ECONOMIC THAN POLITICAL AFFAIRS, AND MINISTER OF FINANCE AND ECONOMIC AFFAIRS DR. MOHAMMED YEGANEH HAD RETAINED HIS POST FROM THE PREVIOUS CABINET.
THERE NEW GOI AMBASSADORS WERE PRESENTED TO SHAH AUG. 23-AHMAD HUSHANG SHARIFI AS AMB. TO UNESCO; JAVAD VAFA AS AMB. TO EUROPEAN COMMUNITY; AND KAZEM SHIVA AS AMB. TO ALGERIA.

SHARIFI (NAME IS SOMETIMES HYPHENATED AND FILED UNDER HUSHANG) SERVED MOST RECENTLY AS CHANCELLOR TO TEHRAN UNIVERSITY. BORN IN 1925, HE HOLDS A PH.D. IN LAW FROM UNIVERSITY PARIS. EARLY IN HIS CAREER, HE WORKED IN IRANIAN DELEGATION TO UNESCO AND IN IRANIAN EMBASSY, PARIS. IN 1957 HE JOINED STAFF OF TEHRAN UNIVERSITY AS FRENCH LANGUAGE TRANSLATOR. HE BECAME FINANCE TEACHER THE FOLLOWING YEAR, LECTURER IN POLITICAL SCIENCE IN 1960, AND PROFESSOR OF POLITICAL SCIENCE IN 1966. APPOINTED FINANCIAL AND ADMINISTRATIVE ADVISOR TO MINISTRY OF EDUCATION IN 1964, HE BECAME UNDER SECRETARY LATER THAT YEAR. IN 1968 HE BECAME PRINCIPAL OF TEACHER'S TRANING COLLEGE, TEHRAN.

HE HAS RETURNED TO UNESCO AND OTHER INTERNATIONAL CONFERENCES AS MEMBER OF IRANIAN DELEGATION. SHARIFI SERVED AS CHANCELLOR OF NATIONAL UNIVERSITY, TEHRAN 1973-74, AND AS MINISTER OF EDUCATION FROM APRIL 1974 TO NOVEMBER 1976, WHEN HE BECAME CHANCELLOR OF TEHRAN UNIVERSITY. HE IS DESCRIBED AS A WEAK ADMINSTRATOR WHO DELEGATES AUTHORITY BUT DOES NOT FOLLOW UP. FLUENT IN FRENCH, SHARIFI ALSO UNDERSTANDS ENGLISH FAIRLY WELL, BUT SPEAKS VERY LITTLE. HE HAS PUBLISHED BOOKS IN PERSIAN AND FRENCH ON LAW, POLITICS AND ECONOMICS.

VAFA HAS SERVED SINCE AUG. 1974 AS VICE MINISTER FOR INTERNATIONAL AFFAIRS IN MINISTRY OF ECONOMIC AFFAIRS AND FINANCE. BORN ABOUT 1922 HE RECEIVED HIS HIGHER EDUCATION AT INDIANA UNIVERSITY, INCLUDING MA IN ECONOMICS AND POLITICAL SCIENCE AND PH.D. IN EDUCATION. WHILE IN THE UNITED STATES, HE HELPED FOUND IRANIAN STUDENTS ORGANIZATION. RETURNING TO IRAN IN 1957, VAFA USED HIS WIFE'S FAMILY CONNECTIONS TO BECOME IMMEDIATELY CHIEF EDITOR OF TEHRAN JOURNAL. IN 1960 HE JOINED THE PLAN ORGANIZATION AS CHIEF OF MANPOWER UTILIZATION. TWO YEARS LATER, HE BECAME DEPUTY DIRECTOR OF PROJECTS AND PLANNING BUREAU.

SUBSEQUENT POSTS HAVE FEATURED ECONOMIC PLANNING AND RESEARCH, UNTIL HIS APPOINTMENT IN QOUR AS VICE MINISTER FOR INTERNATIONAL AFFAIRS. LONG ASSOCIATED WITH THE UNITED STATES, VAFA SPEAKS EXCELLENT ENGLISH IN ADDITION TO FRENCH. EMB. RELATIONS WITH JAFA HAVE NOT BEEN WHOLLY POSITIVE, AS HE HAS REPUTATION FOR STONEWALLING ON ISSUES AND BEING UNRESPONSIVE. GOI HAS NEVER GIVEN VAFA RESPONSIBLE POSITION THAT HIS EXPERIENCE WOULD SEEM TO JUSTIFY, APPARENTLY SHARING EMB. VIEW THAT HE IS SHORT OF FIRST RATE.

SHIVA HOLDS A PH.D. IN LAW FROM TEHRA UNIVERSITY. A CAREER DIPLOMAT, HE HAS SERVED IN PARIS AND NEW DELHI IN ADDITION TO MFA. EMB. HAS FOUND HIM TO BE MODERATELY USEFUL BUT HE IS INCLINED TO KEEP TO GENERALITIES AND AVOID DISCUSSION OF SUBSTANCE. HE HAS MOST RECENTLY BEEN HEAD OF MFA'S FIFTH POLITICAL DIVISION, WITH RESPONSIBILITIES FOR TURKEY, CYPRUS AND THE SOUTH ASIAN SUBCONTINENT.

AT NOON, AUGUST 28, I HAD MY FIRST AUDIENCE WITH THE SHAH SINCE MY RETURN FROM HOME LEAVE. I WAS SANDWICHED IN BETWEEN AUDIENCES HE WAS HAVING WITH SENIOR MINISTERS OF THE NEW CABINET, WHO HAS BEEN APPOINTED THE PREVIOUS DAY.

I FOUND THE SHAH THIN, TENSE, AND DISPIRITED. THERE WERE UNACCUSTOMED GAPS IN HIS CONVERSATION, WHEN HE WOULD GAZE OFF INTO SPACE. HE APPEARED TIRED AND AFFECTED AN ALMOST FATALISTIC VIEW ABOUT HIS AND HIS COUNTRY'S FUTURE.

AT THE OUSET OF OUR CONVERSATION, HE TURNED TO THE INTERNAL DISTURBANCES WHICH HAVE WRACKED THE COUNTRY THIS PAST SUMMER AND TO THE DRASTIC CHANGES IN GOVERNEMENT COMPOSITION AND POLICY WHICH HE HAS HAD TO TAKE IN AN EFFORT TO RESTORE TRANQUILITY. HE SAI HE HAD DELIBERATELY CONTRIVED TO PRESENT THESE CHANGES SO THAT THEY WOULD BE SEEN AS CONCESSIONS FROM HIM PERSONALLY ("ALMOST A PERSONAL DEFEAT"), BUT HE HAD NO CONFIDENCE THAT "THESE PRIESTS" CAN EVER BE FULLY SATISFIED. HE SAID "THEIR" DEMANDS ARE UNENDING-AND CITED "THEIR" INSISTENCE ON NO WOMEN IN THE CABINET, NO WOMEN IN HIGH PLACES, ETC.

THE SHAH SAID THAT HIS NEW PRIME MINISTER SHARIF-EMAMI HAD TAKEN SOUNDINGS WITH RELIGIOUS ELEMENTS PRIOR TO ASSUMING OFFICE AND THAT, IF ANYONE CAN PLACATE THEM, HE IS THE ONE WHO CAN DO IT. HOWEVER, HE EVINCED NO RPT NO CONVICTION THAT EMAMI WOULD SUCCEED. HE FELT AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, "THAT MAD MAN," IS FORCING THE ISLAMIC PACE AND THAT THE OTHER AYATOLLAHS ARE SCARED TO RESIST HIM.

HE RESTATED HIS BELIEF THAT THE ONLY WAY TO BRING HIS COUNTRY THROUGH THESE TURBULENT TIMES IS TO "LIBERALIZE" AND TO TRY TO ESTABLISH A FIRM DEMOCRATIC BASE FOR THE GOVERNEMENT. HE WAS DETERMINED, THEREFORE, TO GO THROUGH WITH "100 PERCENT FREE" ELECTIONS IN THE HOPE THAT THEY WILL PRODUCE A GROUP OF RESPONSIBLE LEGISLATORS WHO WILL SHARE POLITICAL AUTHORITY. HOWEVER, HE SEES NO RPT NO INDICATION THAT TRULY COMPETENT PEOPLE ARE PREPARED TO GO INTO THE ARENA OF POLITICS. INSTEAD, ALL THOSE "OLD WORMS" WITHOUT POLITICAL CONSTITUENCIES OR PARTIORTIC INSTINCTS SEEM TO BE COMING FORWARD AS POTENTIAL CANDIDATES.

THEREFORE, THERE IS THE GREAT RISK THAT THE ONLY RESULT OF HIS LIBERALIZATION POLICY AND THE "FIASCO" OF THE RASTIKHIZ PARTY WILL BE THE COLLAPSE OF THAT GENERATION OF LEADERS WHO HAVE ASSUMED PATRIOTIC RESPONSIBILITIES IN THE PAST FEW YEARS AND THEIR REPLACMENT BY A VACUUM.

IN THAT CASE, HE SOLILIQUIZED, IRAN WOULD ITSELF FACE COLLAPSE. THE SOVIETS COULD MOVE IN RAPIDLY AND "PRETEND TO SPEAK FOR THE POEPLE OF IRAN." THE UNITED STATES, WETERN EUROPE AND JAPAN WOULD BE THE LOSERS, AND THE SOVIETS WOULD HAVE WON THEIR GREAT STRATEGIC VICTORY. FOR THIS REASON, HE ASSUMES THE KGB IS ACTIVELY INVOLVED IN STIRRING UP TROUBLE IN IRAN. HE THEN WENT ON TO SAY THAT THE "POPULAR IRANIAN MENTALITY" SEES A FOREIGN HAND IN EVERYTHING. THIS IS NATURAL FROM THE HISTORY OF BRITISH AND RUSSIAN INTRIGUE IN THIS COUNTRY.
IT IS FOR THIS REASON THAT "MANY PEOPLE" BELIEVE THE UNITED STATES IS ALSO INVOLVED IN THE CURRENT EFFORT TO DESTABILIZE IRAN.

I TOLD THE SHAH THAT I HAD HEARD SUCH REPORTS AND WAS DISTURBED TO LEARN FROM MY DCM THAT THESE RUMORS WERE BEING REPEATED BY SENIOR IRANIAN OFFICIALS. I SAID THIS REMINDED ME OF THE FINAL DAYS OF BHUTTO'S REGIME, WHEN HE HAD APPARENTLY COME TO BELIEVE THAT THE U.S. WAS INTRIGUING AGAINST HIM. SINCE BHUTTO WAS AN INTELLIGENT MAN, HE MUST HAVE BEEN THE VICTIM OF A "DISINFORMATION" CAMPAIGN, WHICH COULD HAVE INCLUDED FABRICATED DOCUMENTS. IF THERE WERE ANY DOCUMENTS ON ALLEGED U.S. ACTIVITIES IN IRAN OR EVEN SPECIFIC INSTANCES OF SUCH ALLEGATIONS, I WOULD HOPE THE SHAH WOULD HAVE THEM BROUGHT DIRECTLY TO MY ATTENTION.
HE HASTENED TO SAY THAT THERE WERE NO RPT NO SPECIFIC ACCUSATIONS, MERELY THE VAGUE MENTAL DOUBTS OF THE AVERAGE IRANIAN.

WE THEN TURNED TO DISCUSSING WHAT THE UNITED STATES GOVERNEMENT MIGHT DO TO DISPEL THESE RUMORS. WE BOTH AGREED THAT ANY FULSOME U.S. PRAISE MIGHT BE COUNTERPRODUCTIVE AND HE FINALLY, AFTER SHAKING HIS HEAD AS IF HIS WERE OVER-TIRED, SUGGESTED I DISCUSS THE MATTER WITH COURT MINISTER HOVEYDA AND THE NEW PRIME MINISTER.

OUR DISCUSSION OF FOREIGN POLICY, WHICH FOLLOWED THIS LONG DIALOGUE ON THE DOMESTIC SCENE, WAS CONCENTRATED ON REGIONAL MATTERS, BUT THE SHAH WAS MUCH LESS TRENCHANT THAN USUAL AND APPEARED NOT TO HAVE BEEN FOLLOWING FOREIGN AFFAIRS WITH HIS USUAL ACUITY. I SHALL REPORT HIGHLIGHTS OF THOSE DISCUSSIONS IN SEPARATE CABLES.

DURING AUGUST 28 AUDIENCE WITH SHAH, I ASKED FOR HIS ASSESSMENT OF RECENT EVENTS IN AFGHANISTAN. HE SAID THAT I WAS ALREADY AWARE OF HIS GENERAL VIEWS ON THAT COUNTRY. RECENT EVENTS HAD MERELY REINFORCED HIS FEELING WHAT THE SOVIETS HAD TAKEN OVER COMPLETE CONTROL AND WERE IN EFFECT TREATING AFGHANISTAN AS ONE OF THEIR "SOCIALIST REPUBLICS."

I SAID OUR EMBASSY IN KABUL FELT THE REGIME HAD NARROWED ITS BASE OF SUPPORT TO A RATHER SURPRISING DEGREE, PARTICULARLY BT THE ELIMINATION OF THE MILITARY FROM THE CABINET. HE SAID THAT DIDN'T MATTER TO THE SOVIETS BECUSE THEY HAD PUT THEIR OWN OFFICERS IN CHARGE OF THE MILITARY. MOREOVER, THE SOVIETS COULD ALWAYS BRING BACK THE PARCHANI "EXILES" IN THE EVENT TARAHI, AMIN, AND THE KHALQ FAILED.

WHEN ASKED HIS ESTIMATE OF POTENTIALS FOR RESISTANCE AND REVOLT, HE SAID HE THOUGHT THEY WERE VERY LIMITED. THERE MIGHT BE A FEW ASSASSINATIONS AND PERHAPS SOME SOVIETS WOULD BE KILLED IN PATHAN AMBUSHES. BUT ORGANIZED REVOLT WAS UNLIEKLY.

AS FAR AS PUSHTOONSTAN AND BELUCHISTAN WERE CONCERNED, HE HAD NO RPT NO EVIDENCE THAT A SUBVERSIVE CAMPAIGN HAD YET BEGUN IN THOSE AREAS. HE FELT THE SOVIETS WOULD CONCENTRATE ON CONSOLIDATING THEIR POSITION IN AFGHANISTAN BEFORE MOVING INTO THE REGION TO THE SOUTH. BUT HE CONSIDERED THEIR MOVE INEVITABLE.

DESPITE THESE VIEWS, HE SAID HE WOULD CONTINUE TO ABIDE BY THE "U.S. AND INDIAN" FORMULA FOR TREATING AFGHANISTAN OSTENSIBLY AS IF IT WERE NON-ALIGNED. HE SAID HE WOULD DO THIS WITH NO ILLUSIONS THAT SUCH A POLICY COULD PRODUCE GENUINE NON-ALIGNMENT, BUT ONLY BECAUSE HE DID NOT WISH TO PROVIDE THE SOVIETS OR THE AFGHANS ANY PREMISE OF PROVOCATION FOR SHARPENDED ACTION AGAINST PAKISTAN OR IRAN.

1978TEHRAN08204.subject: BIOGRAPHIC INFORMATION ON JAAFAR SHARIF-EMAMI SUMMARY: ENGINEER JAAFAR SHARIF-EMAMI, A RESPECTED CONSER- VATIVE STATEMAN, HAS BEEN PRESIDENT OF SENA TE SINC

segments.text: SUMMARY: ENGINEER JAAFAR SHARIF-EMAMI, A RESPECTED CONSERVATIVE STATEMAN, HAS BEEN PRESIDENT OF SENATE SINCE 1963. A FORMER PRIME MINISTER (1960-61) WHO WAS OFTEN RUMORED TO BE CANDIDATE FOR THAT OFFICE IN SUBSEQUENT YEARS, HE HAS SINCE PLAYED ROLE OF ELDER STATESMAN, ENJOYING CLOSE TIES WITH SHAH, SENATE, RELIGIOUS LEADERS, AND BUSINESS COMMUNITY. END SUMMARY

SHARIF-EMAMI WAS BORN ABOUT 1910 INTO OLD ECCLESIASTICAL FAMILY. HIS FATHER, HAJ MOHAMMAD NEZAM-OLESLAM, WAS A LEADING ISLAMIC CLERGYMAN IN TEHRAN, AND HIS GREAT GRANDFATHER, MIRZA ABUTALEB ESFAHANI, WAS PRIMINENT RELIGIOUS LEADER IN QAJAR PERIOD. ANOTHER GREAT GRANDFATHER, MIRZA ABDOLQASEM HOSSEINI, WAS AN ISFAHAN CLERGYMAN. HIS OWN EDUCATION WAS DEVOTED TO ENGINEERING--THE IRAN-GERMAN SECONDARY SCHOOL IN TEHRAN, GERMAN CENTRALRAILWAY SCHOOL, AND BORAS TECHNICAL SCHOOL IN SWEDEN. HE BEGAN A CAREER WITH IRANIAN STATE RAILWAY IN 1931, AND IN 1942, BECAME ITS DEPUTY CHIEF. FOLLOWING ALLED INTERVENTION, HE SPENT TWO YEARS INTERNMENT IN ARAK FOR PRO-GERMAN STANCE. IN POST WAR PERIOD HE WORKED IN PRIVATE CONTRACTING AS HEAD OF IRRIGATION AGENCY.

HE RETURNED TO GOVERNMENTIN JUNE 1950 AS UNDERSECRETARY MINISTRY OF ROADS AND IN 1951 HE ENTERED CABINET AS MINISTER OF ROADS. HE JOINED HIGH COUNCIL OF PLAN ORGANIZATION IN 1952, AND FOLLOWING COLLAPSE OF MOSSADEQ GOVERNEMENT IN AUGUST 1953, HE MANAGED IRAN'S PLAN ORGANIZATION. HIS TERM OF OFFICE WAS ONLY TWO MONTHS AS RESULT OF HIS RELUCTANCE TO BREAK WITH MOSSADEQ'S MEN WHO HAD REMAINED IN GOVERNMENT IN 1954 HE ENTERED SENATE FROM TEHRAN, LEADING OPPOSITION TO PM ZAHEDI. RETIRING FROM SENATE IN 1957, HE RETURNED TO CABINET AS MINISTER OF INDUSTRIES AND MINES. HE HELD OFFICE UNTIL AUGUST 1960, WHEN HE REPLACED EQBAL AS PM.

DURING NINE MONTHS IN OFFICE SHARIFI-EMAMI SOUGHT GREATER INDEPENDENCE FOR PREMIERSHIP AND CONDUCTED 1961 ELECTIONS WHICH WERE SECOND ATTEMPT TO ELECT 20TH MAJLIS. IN FOREIGN AFFAIRS, HE WORKED TO IMPROVE RELATIONS WITH IRAQ AFGHANISTAN AND USSR. HE FOUND ROUGH GOING DOMESTICALLY AND RESIGNED IN MAY 1961, OSTENSIBLY DUE TO CRITICISM OF HIS HANDLING OF TEACHERS STRIKE. IN 1962 HE WAS APPOINTED HEAD OF PAHLAVI FOUNDATON (PHILANTHROPIC ORGANIZATION FUNDED BY SALE OF CROWN LANDS). FOLLOWING YEAR HE RETURNED TO SENATE, WHERE HE WAS QUICKLEY ELECTED PRESIDENT, A POST HE HAS HELD UNTIL NOW, HE HAS HEADED SEVERAL SERVICE AND INDUSTRIAL ORGANIZATION, HOLDING AS MANY AS ELEVEN PAYING JOBS AT ONE TIME.

NEVER ENTIRELY FORSAKING HIS ENGINEERING/INDUSTRIAL BACKGROUND, SHARIF-EMAMI RETAINED EXTENSIVE BUSINESS CONNECTIONS. INEVITABLY THESE HAVE LED TO CHARGES OF CORRUPTION, SPECIFICALLY OF SERVING BRITISH OR GERMAN INTERESTS. HE DAMAGED HIS REPUTATION WHEN IN DEFIANCE OF 1959 CONFLICT OF INTEREST LAW, HE REFUSED TO SURRENDER EITHER HIS BUSINESS INTERESTS OR HIS POST AS MINISTER OF INDUSTRIES.

HE HAS ALSO CLUNG TO HIS RELIGIOUS HERITAGE, AND HIS CREDIBILITY AS BROKER BETWEEN GOVERNEMENT AND RELIGIOUS LEADERS HAS BEEN ONE HIS GREATEST STRENGTHS. SHAH DELEGATED HIM IN 1970 TO EXPLAIN REFORMS TO SHIITE HEIRARCHY. HE HAS CRITICIZED USE OF FORCE AGAINST RELIGIOUS CONSERVATIVES, TELLING EMBOFF IN 1965: "YOU CAN ANSER BOOKS WITH BOOKS, GUNS WITH GUNS, AND YOU CAN ONLY ANSWER MULLAHS WITH MULLAHS." CLERGY, HE ARGUED, MUST BE ASSOCIATED WITH REFORM PROGRAM. HE HAS REMAINED TRUSTED CONFIDANT OF SHAH, PLAYING KEY ROLE IN PERSUADING HIM TO ESTABLISH REGENCY COUNCIL IN 1967 TO PROVIDE FOR SUCCESSION.

DESPITE EARLY IMAGE OF ANTI-AMERICANISM, SHARIF-EMAMI DEVELOPED CLOSE RELATIONS WITH EMB. HIS PREMIERSHIP WAS MARKED BY EFFORTS TO IMPROVE SOVIET-IRAN RELATIONS, AND MUCH RUMORED RETURN AS PM IN MID 1960S WAS PRESUMED TO REPRESENT GOI RELAXING TIE WITH USG. TRUTH WAS PROBABLY ALWAYS OTHERWISE, AND SHARIF-EMAMI BECAME USEFUL CONTACT FOR EMBASSY, TO POINT OF TAKING WEEKLY ENGLISH LESSONS FROM EMBOFF IN 1966-67. SINCE THAT TIME, HE HAS BEEN FRANK, FRIENDLY, AND HELPFUL TO SENIOR AMERICANS, BUT NOT EXTREMELY CLOSE TO EMBASSY OFFICIALS ON A REGULAR BASIS IN THE 1970'S. HE IS ONE OF FOUR LIVING HOLDERS OF IRAN'S ORDER OF THE TAJ, FIRST CLASS.

ENERGETIC AND RATHER STERN IN APPEARANCE, SHARIF-EMAMI IS AN AVID HORSEBACK RIDER AND MAINTAINS A LIVESTOCK FARM. WIDELY TRAVELED, INCLUDING TRIPS AS HEAD OF PARLIAMENTARY DELGATIONS, HE ENJOYS BROAD DISCUSSION OF WORLD AFFAIRS AS THEY AFFECT IRAN. HE IS MARRIED ANDHAS THREE CHILDREN. ONE OF HIS DAUGHTERS STUDIED AT OHIO WESLYAN AND COLUMBIA IN THE EARLY 1970'S. HE SPEAKS FARSI, ENGLISH, GERMAN, AND SOME SWEDISH AND RUSSIAN.

1978TEHRAN08217.subject: RECOMMNDATION FOR PRESIDENT TO SHAH LETTER

segments.text: IN THE FEW DAYS THAT I HAVE BEEN BACK IN TEHRAN, IT HAS BECOME CLEAR TO ME THAT THE SHAH HAS MADE A FUNDAMENTAL POLITICAL DECISION, AS ANNOUNCED IN HIS CONSTITUTION DAY SPEECH, TO TRANSFORM HIS AUTHORITARIAN REGIME INTO A GENUINE DEMOCRACY. HE HAS REACHED THIS DECISION AS A RESULT OF HIS OWN INTELLECTUAL CONVICTIONS, BECAUSE HE FEELS IRAN HAS BECOME TOO COMPLEX AND TOO VOLATILE TO GOVERN THROUGH THE CURRENT PROCESSES OF BENEVOLENT AUTHORITARIANISM. HE THEREFORE FEELS THAT THE ONLY WAY TO PRESERVE THE INTEGRITY OF THE COUNTRY IS TO CHANGE POLITICAL SYSTEM, EVEN IF THAT CHANGE PUTS THE MONARCHY AT RISK.
INDEED, HE REALIZES THAT, UNLESS THE SYSTEM CHANGES, THE MONARCHY IS PREDICTABLY DOOMED.

UNITED STATES POLICY ON HUMAN RIGHTS HAS HAD ONLY A PERIPHERAL BEARING ON THIS DECISION, AND WE SHOULD THEREFORE REFRAIN FROM CLAIMING THIS A "VICTORY" FOR THAT POLICY. IT NEVERTHELESS REPRESENTS A DEVELOPMENT WHICH WE CAN ONLY WELCOME, BECAUSE OF OUR OWN INSTINCTIVE CONVICTIONS THAT THE PROCESSES OF DEMOCRACY, UNTIDY AS THEY MAY BE, ARE THE BEST GUARANTEES OF SURVIVAL AND PROGRESS FOR ANY NATION. I BELIEVE, THEREFORE, THAT WE SHOULD DEVELOP POLICIES AND TAKE ACTIONS DESIGNED TO ENCOURAGE AND ENHANCE THIS NEW DEVELOPMENT IN IRAN.

THE IRANIAN PUBLIC HAS NOT YET FULLY ABSORBED THE IMPORT OF THE SHAH'S DECISION. INDEED, IN THEIR TRADITIONAL CYNICISM, MOST OF THEM DO NOT SEEM TO REGARD THE ANNOUNCED INTENTIONS AS BEING GENUINE. THE REACTION IN THE BAZAAR IS THAT THIS IS ALL "PLAY ACTING" FOR THE BENEFIT OF THE WEST, AND PARTICULARLY FOR THE UNITED STATES. NEVERTHELESS, TO AN OUTSIDE OBSERVER LIKE MYSELF, WHO HAS BEEN ABSENT FOR TWO MONTHS, THE CHANGES IN THE POLITICAL CLIMATE ARE STRIKING. THE PRESS, EVEN BEFORE THE NEW PRESS LAW HAS BEEN ENACTED, HAS COME TO RESEMBLE A WESTERN EUROPEAN PRESS. THE LIBERTY OF POLITICAL PERSONALITIES TO SPEAK OUT CRITICALLY IS UNPRECEDENTED.

THOSE IN POSITIONS OF AUTHORITY, ESPECIALLY THE MILITARY AND SECURITY OFFICIALS, ARE AWARE OF THE GENUINE NATURE OF THE SHAH'S DECISION BECAUSE THEY HAVE RECEIVED ORDERS FROM HIM TO IMPLEMENT THE CHANGES. MANY WHOM I HAVE SEEN HAVE GREAT DOUBTS ABOUT THE WISDOM OF THE SHAH'S COURSE, EVEN THOUGH THEY REMAIN LOYAL TO HIS ORDERS. THEY ARE NERVOUS AND AFRAID OF "THAT GREAT BEAST," THE PEOPLE OF IRAN. SOME OF THE MORE SOPHISTICATED OFFICIALS NOT ONLY AGREE WITH THE SHAH'S ACTIONS, BUT HAVE ENCOURAGED HIM IN THAT DIRECTION.
EVEN THEY, HOWEVER, ARE NERVOUS, BECAUSE THEY HAVE NEVER PLAYED THE DEMOCRATIC GAME BEFORE AND THEY ARE NOT SURE HOW THINGS WILL TURN OUT.

AS FOR THE SHAH HIMSELF, YOU WILL HAVE READ IN MY 8187 THAT HE HAS NOT MADE HIS DRAMATIC DECISION IN A BURST OF EXHILARATION AND ZEAL. HE IS MOROSE, NERVOUS AND SUSPICIOUS. HIS GAME PLAN, WHICH HE NURTURED IN SUCH CONFIDENCE FOR TWO DECADES, HAS HAD TO BE SCRAPPED. HE HAS LITTLE CONFIDENCE IN THE WISDOM OR RESPONSIBILITY OF THE IRANIAN PEOPLE, EVEN THOUGH HE HAS DECIDED TO PUT HIS FATE AND THAT OF HIS COUNTRY IN THEIR HANDS. HE FEARS EVERYBODY WILL PERCEIVE HIM AS SLIPPING AND THEN, IN THE BEST MIDDLE EAST TRADITION, JOIN IN KICKING HIM AS HE GOES DOWN.
HE ESPECIALLY FEARS THE UNITED STATES WILL DO THIS.

THE REACTION OF HIS REAL ENEMIES, FROM THE SOVIETS THROUGH THE RADICAL ARABS AND THE FUNDAMENTALIST MUSLIMS, IS FORESEEABLE. THEY WILL TRY TO CAUSE SUCH TROUBLES IN THE STREETS THAT THE SHAH WILL BE FORCED TO IMPOSE MARTIAL LAW COUNTRY-WIDE. ON THE OLD LENINIST PREMISE THAT "WORSE IS BETTER," THEY WILL SEEK TO FRUSTRATE POLITICAL LIBERALIZATION AND INSTIGATE THE WORST SORT OF POLITICAL REPRESSION. IN THIS WAY, THEY WILL ATTEMPT TO PROVE TO THE WORLD THAT THE SHAH'S "DEMOCRACY" IS A FARCE AND THAT ANY ELECTIONS TO BE HELD ARE MOCKERY. ------------------002816 291137Z /16 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 59 SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 8217 NODIS

IT IS FAR FROM CERTAIN HOW THE POLITICAL SCENE WILL DEVELOP HERE. IRANIANS ARE AN UNDISCIPLINED PEOPLE, WITH CLANNISH, QUERULOUS, INTERNECINE HABITS AND WITH NO REAL ACQUAINTANCE WITH THE PRACTICE OF DEMOCRACY. COOPERATIVE ACTION FOR THE GENERAL GOOD IS NOT AN IRANIAN CHARACTERISTIC. THE FABRIC OF THIS SOCIETY, UNDER THE STRESS OF A GENUINE DEMOCRATIC OPPORTUNITY, MAY DISINTEGRATE AND THE SHAH MAY FEEL HE HAS TO REIMPOSE STRICT POLITICAL CONTROLS. THAT SORT OF THING HAS HAPPENED BEFORE AND THE U.S.
ASSISTED IN THE RE-ESTABLISHMENT OF "INTERNAL SECURITY." IF WE CONSIDER IT IN OUR INTERESTS TO SEE THE SHAH PERSEVERE IN HIS DEMOCRATIC DECISION THIS TIME, WE SHOULD CONSIDER WHAT WE CAN DO TO HELP.

THE SHAH'S PARTISANS HAVE ALREADY BEGUN VYWFFES Q (#) ME WITH SUGGESTIONS OF PUBLIC ACTIONS WE COULD TAKE TO SHOW OUR SUPPORT FOR HIS POLICY OF LIBERALIZATION AND TO SUSTAIN HIM IN HIS DETERMINATION TO CONTINUE. THEY ARE PARTICULARLY MINDFUL OF THE RUMORS PREVALENT HERE THAT THE U.S. WISHES TO "DUMP" THE SHAH OR DESTABILIZE THE COUNTRY. SINCE I FEEL WE WILL HAVE TO WEIGHT ANY CORRECTIVE ACTIONS VERY CAREFULLY, I AM NOT YET PREPARED TO PROPOSE ANY SUCH MEASURES UNTIL I CAN HAVE FAR WIDER CONSULTATIONS WITH ALL SECTORS OF THE IRANIAN BODY POLITIC.

IN THE MEANTIME, HOWEVER, I BELIEVE A LITTLE PRIVATE ENCOURAGMENT TO THE SHAH WOULD BE IN ORDER. ACCORDINGLY, I HAVE DRAFTED THE FOLLOWING PROPOSED LETTER FROM THE PRESIDENT TO THE SHAH. I WOULD GREATLY APPRECIATE AUTHORITY TO DELIVER IT, WITH WHATEVER MODIFICATIONS THE PRESIDENT MAY MAKE, AT THE EARLIEST OPPORTUNITY. I HAVE AN APPOINTMENT WITH COURT MINISTER HOVEYDA AT 1100 THE MORNING OF THURSDAY, AUGUST 31. WHILE I REALIZE THIS IS VERY SHORT NOTICE, IT WOULD BE THE IDEAL TIME TO ACT.

DRAFT LETTER FOLLOWS: "YOUR IMPERIAL MAJESTY, I HAVE BEEN FOLLOWING RECENT EVENTS IN IRAN WITH CONCERN AND WITH GREAT SYMPATHY FOR THE PROBLEMS YOU HAVE ENCOUNTERED IN ATTEMPTING TO PURSUE A COURSE OF POLITICAL LIBERALIZATION IN THE FACE OF AGGRAVATED CIVIC DISORDER. ALL OF US WHO WISH IRAN WELL HAVE ADMIRED THE COURAGE YOU DISPLAYED IN THE POLICY WHICH YOU ANNOUNCED IN YOUR CONSTITUTION DAY MESSAGE. AS I HAVE TOLD YOU, THE UNITED STATES REGARDS THE INDEPENDENCE, THE STRENGTH, AND THE PROSPERITY OF IRAN AS CRITICAL TO OUR OWN SECURITY AND THAT OF OUR CLOSEST FRIENDS AND ALLIES. THEREFORE, EVENTS IN YOUR COUNTRY ARE OF MAJOR IMPORTANCE TO US.

FROM WHAT I KNOW OF POLITICAL AND HISTORICAL DYNAMICS, I FIRMLY BELIEVE THAT YOU HAVE MADE THE RIGHT DECISION IN MOVING AT THIS STAGE TOWARDS A CHANGE IN IRAN'S POLITICAL SYSTEM, DESPITE THE RISKS INHERENT IN SUCH A DECISION. IT SEEMS TO ME THAT ANY OTHER COURSE WOULD ENTAIL EVEN GREATER FUTURE RISKS TO THE INTEGRITY OF YOUR COUNTRY AND ITS INSTITUTIONS.

AT THE SAME TIME, FROM WHAT I UNDERSTAND OF IRAN'S HISTORY AND IN THE CONTEXT OF CURRENT POLITICAL AND SOCIAL CONDITIONS, I FIRMLY BELIEVE THAT THE INSTITUTION OF THE MONARCHY AND YOU, PERSONNALLY, WITH YOUR VAST EXPERIENCE, ARE BEST EQUIPPED TO GUIDE IRAN THROUGH THESE DANGEROUS BUT EXCITING CHANGES. AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN HAS REPORTED TO ME HIS RECENT CONVERSATION WITH YOU IN WHICH YOU INDICATED THAT THERE ARE THOSE IN IRAN WHO BELIEVE THAT MY GOVERNMENT HAS HAD A HAND IN RECENT EVENTS WHICH WOULD TEND TO DESTABILIZE YOUR SOCIETY OR DIMINISH THE RESPECT IN WHICH WE CONTINUE TO HOLD YOU PERSONALLY.

I AM DEEPLY TROUBLED BY THIS REPORT AND DISTURBED BY THE MOTIVATIONS OF THOSE WHO WOULD SPREAD SUCH FALSE ACCUSATIONS. I KNOW I DO NOT NEED TO REASSURE YOU PERSONALLY OF MY CONTINUING SUPPORT. HOWEVER, I SHALL ASK SECRETARY VANCE AND OTHERS TO STUDY WAYS IN WHICH WE CAN EFFECTIVELY CONVINCE EVERYONE OF ITS SINCERITY AND DURABILITY. PLEASE ACCEPT ALL MY BEST WISHES AS YOU MOVE AHEAD IN YOUR EFFORTS TO FIND A POSITIVE, CONSTRUCTIVE, AND DEMOCRATIC SOLUTION TO YOUR COUNTRY'S PROBLEMS. IT IS MY CONVICTION THAT, DESPITE THE TRAUMA THAT MAY RESULT, IT IS MORE SATISFACTORY IN THE LONG RUN TO MEET DIFFICULT PROBLEMS SQUARELY AND DIRECTLY.

I KNOW, FROM THE REMARKABLE HISTORY OF YOUR LONG REIGN AND FROM ALL THE ACHIEVEMENTS YOU HAVE BROUGHT YOUR NATION, THAT YOU SHARE THIS VIEW. WITH WARMEST PERSONAL REGARDS TO YOU AND THE LOVELY SHAHBANU, IN WHICH ROSALYNN JOINS, I AM, SINCERELY, JIMMY CARTER"

I BELIEVE THIS PRPOSED LETTER WOULD HAVE THE EFFECT OF STIFFENING THE SHAH IN HIS RESOLVE TO HOLD GENUINELY DEMOCRATIC ELECTIONS AND THAT ITS EARLY DELIVERY IS A TIMELY NECESSITY. SULLIVAN NOTE BY OC/T: TEHRAN 8217 2/2 (#) AS RECEIVED. CORRECTION TO FOLLOW. (PARA. 8).

EMBASSY HAS READ WITH INTEREST REFTEL, PARTICULARLY PARA 4, RHETORICAL AS AMIN'S DESIRE FOR "KING-KILLER" MAY BE, WE BELIEVE OUR OWN TIES WITH THE SHAH REQUIRE US TO SAY SOMETHING ABOUT THIS. WE WOULD LIKE TO HAVE KABUL'S PERMISSION TO PASS ON IN CONFIDENCE THE THRUST OF DUPREE'S REMARKS ON AFGHANISTAN, SPECIFICALLY THOSE RELATING TO THE SHAH.

FRANKFURT FOR EDER EMBASSY AND ARMISH/MAAG WILL BE PLEASED TO COOPERATE WITH GAO TEAM (REFTEL). WE AWAIT DETAILS, BUT FOR AN INITIAL COMMENT WE OFFER THOUGHT THAT SIX WEEKS IN IRAN WILL PROBABLY NOT BE NEEDED FOR DISCUSSIONS WITH CONTRACTOR AND OFFICIAL COMMUNITY.

1978TEHRAN08282.subject: DEMONSTRATIONS CONTINUE; GOI TO REVIEW SITUATION OF POLITICAL PRISONERS SUMMARY: OVER PAST THREE DAYS DEMONSTRATIONS TOOK

segments.text: OF POLITICAL PRISONERS SUMMARY: OVER PAST THREE DAYS DEMONSTRATIONS TOOK PLACE IN TABRIZ, QOM AND TEHRAN. MINOR RIOTS HAVE OCCURRED IN OTHER TOWNS. CLERGY URGING CALM IN MANY PLACES. NO OVERT ANTIAMERICANISM. GOI WILL RELEASE SOME, REVIEW CASES OF OTHERS POLITICAL PRISONERS. END SUMMARY.

IN TABRIZ AUG. 28, TWO THOUSAND PEOPLE GATHERED ON FRIDAY MOSQUE AND BEGAN TO CHANT "DEATH TO THE SHAH". POLICE MOVED INTO THE MOSQUE AND BROKE UP THE DEMONSTRATION AFTER MULLAHS FAILED TO CALM DOWN THE CROD INSIDE AND AROUND THE MOSQUE. PRESS REPORTS NOTE THE CONFRONTATION LASTED FOUR HOURS. U.S. CONSUL METRINKO IN TABRIZ REPORTS GOI WAS TAKING VISIBLE HARD LINE WITH A MAJOR SHOW OF FORCE. TANK BATALLION HAS BEEN ASSIGNED FULL TIME TO THE CITY. THERE WERE NO DEATHS.

ON AUG 28 CROWDS DEMONSTRATED OUTSIDE TWO MOSQUES NEAR THE TEHRAN BAZAAR WHEN MULLAHS FAILED TO SHOW UP FOR SERVICES. CROWDS WERE QUICKLY DISPERSED BY POLICE. PRESS REPORTS TOTAL OF 27 PEOPLE ARRESTED IN CLASHES IN TEHRAN AUG. 28 AND 29.

FOUR HOURS OF RIOTING OCCURRED IN QOM BEGINNING EVENING OF AUG. 28 AND FINALLY ENDED IN EARLY MORNING OF AUG. 29. PRESS REPORTS FIVE ARRESTED. OBSERVERS SAY CROWDS HAVE FREQUENTLY TAKEN TO THE STREETS OVER THE PAST FEW DAYS DESPITE STATEMENTS FROM RELIGIOUS LEADERS IN QOM URGING CALM AND AVOIDANCE OF VIOLENCE.

SMALLER RIOTS TAOOK PLACE IN GORGAN, RASHT, FARAJ, ARSANJAN, ZANJAN AND SONGHOR OVER PAST FEW DAYS. IN RASHT, POLICE ROUNDED UP 80 DEMONSTRATORS. TABRIZ CONSUL REPORTS EYE WITNESS OBSERVER STATES 6 WERE KILLED IN SONGHOR INCLUDING TWO POLICEMEN.

ONLY INCIDENT WITH ANY ANTI-AMERICAN OVERTONES OF PAST FEW DAYS WAS BOMB THREAT RECEIVED AT GRUMMAN OFFICES IN TEHRAN ABOUT NOON AUG. 29. POLICE RESPONDED IMMEDIATELY BUT NO BOMB WAS FOUND. GRUMMAN HAS TWICE BEFORE BEEN RECEPIENT OF NOTES OR THREATS OVER PAST EIGHT MONTHS.

AFTER CABINET MEETING, PRIME MINISTER SHARIF-EMAMI ANNOUNCED GOI WOULD REVIEW CASES OF POLITICAL PRISONERS AND AMNESTY THOSE HELD FOR MINOR OFFENSES. IN CASE OF MORE SERIOUS OFFENSES HARMFUL TO NATION, GOI WOULD CONSIDER LENIENCY WHERE APPLICABLE UNDER LAW. SHARIFEMAMI STRESSED THAT FREEDOM DID NOT MEAN LICENSE TO COMMIT CRIMES.

1978TEHRAN08283.subject: POLITICAL ACTIVITY AND OPPOSITION: EXCURSION THROUGH BABEL

segments.text: SUMMARY: GOI NAMESNEW GENDARMERIE CHIEF AND KHORASSAN PROVINCE GOVERNOR. GOI DENIES CONTACTS WITH KHOMEINI HAVE TAKEN PLACE, BUT SAYS THEY WILL. RESURGENCE PARTY (RPPI) STRIPPED OF SUBSIDY, GETS NEW DEPTUY SECRETARY GENERAL. IRANIAN NATIONAL FRONT DEMANDS SAVAK BE DISSOLVED AND POLITICAL PRISONERS BE RELEASED AND REJECTS COMPROMISE WITH SHARIF-EMAMI GOVERNEMENT. OVER TEN OPPOSITION PARTIES ANNOUNCED, MOST HAVEONLY A FEW ADHERENTS. NEW GOI PROGRAMS EXPECTED NEXT WEEK. END SUMMARY.

MORNING AUGUST 30 PRESS ANNOUNCED GENERAL AHMAD ALI MOHAQEQI HAS BEEN NAMED TO HEAD IRAN'S GENDARMERIE AND SEYED MOHAMMAD SARAJI HEJAZI WAS APPOINTED GOVERNEOR OF KHORASSAN PROVICNE (MASHAD). MOHAQEQI IS A CAREER OFFICER WITH A GOOD REPUTATION. HEJAZI HAS BEEN A SENATOR AND IS A LONG-TIME CONFIDENT OF SHARIF-EMAMI FROM THEIR DAYS TOGETHER ON THE BOARD OF A GERMAN IMPORT ORGANIZATION IN IRAN.HEJAZI REPORTEDLY HAS EXCELLENT RELIGIOUS CONTACTS IN MASHAD. MORE COMPLETE BIO INFO WILL BE PROVIDED LATER.

ONE OF FIRST GOI EXPERIMENTS WITH PRESS FREEDOM RESULTED IN CONFUSION WHEN SOME FARSI PAPERS AUGUST 29 SAID CONTACTS BETWEEN AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI AND NEW GOI HAD ALREADY TAKEN PLACE. MORNING PRESS AUGUST 30 CARRIED GOI SPOKESMAN'S CONFIRMATION THAT GOI INTENDED TO CONTACT KHOMEINI BUT HAD NOT YET DONE SO. FARSI ETTELA'AT HAD ALREADY SPECULATED FURTHER THAN KHOMEINI HAD ALREADY REJECTED COMPROMISE WITH GOI, BUT BEST INFO HERE IS THAT THERE HAS BEEN NO COMMENT YET FROM NAJAF (KHOMEINI'S PLACE OF EXILE IN IRAQ).

RESURGENCE PARTY ALSO SUBJECT OF CONFUSION WHEN FIRST REPORTS INDICATED EX-PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR HAD RESIGNED AS SECRETARY GENERAL (REF A). THIS PRESS REPORT WAS DENIED AUGUST 29, AND APPOINTMENT OF DR. JAVAD SA'EED AS NEW DEPUTY SECRETARY GENERAL WAS ANNOUNCED. THE 54-YEAR OLD PHYSICIAN HAS BEEN LIAISON OFFICER BETWEEN THE RPPI POLITICAL BUREAU AND PARLIAMENT, AND HAS SERVED SEVERAL PARLIAMENTARY TERMS. HE WAS ALSO DEPUTY CHIEF OF THE NOW-DEFUNCT IRAN NOVIN PARTY. HE WOULD TAKE OVER AS HEAD OF RPPI IF AMOUZEGAR RESIGNS AS EXPECTED. RPPI RECIEVED ANOTHER BLOW WHEN IT WAS CONFIRMED THAT PARTY WOULD LOSE ITS GOVERNMENT SUBSIDY.

PRIME MINISTER HAD ALREADY SAID HE WOULD NOT BE MEMBER OF RPPI, AND GOI SPOKESMAN HAD ANNOUNCED IT WOULD NO LONGER BE IRAN'S SOLE POLITICAL PARTY. (WE UNDERSTAND THAT NOW EVEN SHAH WILLING TO ADMIT THAT RPPI NEVER MADE IT, AND UNLESS SOME MODERATE GROUP AROUND PRESENT GOVERNMENT SEIZES REMAINING BULK FOR ITS OWN PURPOSES, RPPI IS LIKELY TO SLOWLY WEAKEN TO MINOR SINGNIFICANCE.

IRANIAN NATIONAL FRONT (INF), WHICH RECONSTITUTED ITSELF AUGST 23 (REFTEL B), CALLED FOR DISSILUTION OF SAVAK, IMMEDIATE RELEASE OF ALL POLITICAL PRISONERS, AND ABOLITION OF ALL MILITARY TRIBUNALS. IN COMMUNIQUE RELEASED AUGUST 30, INF ALSO REJECTED COMPROMISE WITH SHARIF-EMAMI GOVERN MENT AND CALLED FOR FUEL FREEDOM OF THOUGHT, SPEECH, PRESS, AND POLITICAL PARTIES. INF ALSO ASKED THAT THOSE RESPONSIBLE FOR RECENT KILLINGS IN COUNTRY SHOULD BE PUNISHED, EXILES SHOULD BE ENDED, AND BALCKLISTED IRANIAN DISSIDENTS BE ALLOWED TO RETURN HOME.

KEY SPOKESMEN FOR THIS GROUP ARE KARIM SANJABI AND DARIUSH FOROUHAR, BUT OPPOSITION FIGURES KAZEM HASIBI, MEHDI BAZARGAN, AND REZA SHAYAN (ALSO CHIEF OF VIRTUALLY NON-EXISTENT SOCIALIST PARTY) HAVE ALSO PUBLICLY PROCLAIMED THEMSELVES INF MEMBERS.

RUNDOWN OF OTHER ANNOUNCED OPPOSITION GROUPS GIVEN BELOW, TAKE FROM LOCAL PRESS: A)THE RADICAL MOVEMENT LED BY RAHMATOLLAH MOQADAM THE FREEDOM MOVEMENT LED BY MEHDI BAZARGAN AND YADOLLAH SAHABI THE LABOURERS PARTY LED BY MOZAFAR BAQAIEE KERMANI THE PAN-IRANIST PARTY LED BY MOHSEN PEZESHKPOUR THE SOCIAL DEMOCRATIC PARTY WHICH WILL BE FORMED BY MAJLIS DEPUTY ADMAD BANI AHMAD AN INTELLECTUAL MOVEMENT ORGANIZED AND HEADED BY PROMINENT WRITER HAJ SYED JAVADI THE ASSOCIATION FOR THE PROTECTION OF THE IRANIAN CONSTITUTION LED BY SYED MEHDI PIRASTEH THE ASSOCIATION OF NATIONALISTSLED BY FAZLOLAH SADR AND DR. ZARRINPOUR THE ISLAMIC LIBERAL PARTY LED BY DR. SEIFEDDIN NABAVI THE DEMOCRATIC PARTY OF IRAN FORMED BY ALAMIR DAVALOO THE ARYA SOCIALIST PARTY HEADED BY HADI SEPEHR.
BULK OF THESE GROUPS ARE ELITIST PARTIES WITH FEW ADHERENTS. REF C GIVES BACKGROUND OF CENTRISTS GROUP LED BY PIRASTEH: EMBASSY WILL ATTEMPT TO DEVELOPE INFO ON OTHERS WHO SHOW SIGNS OF LIFE.

COMMENT: CACAPHONOUS SOUND YOU WILL HEAR FROM IRAN IS THE NEW POLITICAL PROCESS BEGINNING. MOST PARTIES HAVE BARELY ANNOUNCED THEIR EXISTENCE. TO OUR KNOWLEDGE, ONLY INF HAS PUT FORWARD A PROGRAM. MOST OPPOSITIONISTS ARE STILL BIDING THEIR TIME OR TEMPORIZING UNTIL NEW CABINET GETS DOWN TO SPECIFICS ON ITS POLICIES, THIS IS EXPECTED TO BEGIN DURING MAJLES SESSION WEEK OF SEPT 4. END COMMENT.

1978TEHRAN08299.subject: SHARIATMADARI VIEWS SUMMARY: IN TWO SEPARATE INTERVIEWS, AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI STRESSED NEED TO RETURN TO CONSTITUTION, DENIED CO

segments.text: SUMMARY: IN TWO SEPARATE INTERVIEWS, AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI STRESSED NEED TO RETURN TO CONSTITUTION, DENIED CONTACT BETWEEN ISLAMIC AND MARXIST CIRCLES IN IRAN, AND STATED RELIGIOUS LEADERS OF IRAN DID NOT RPT NOT WANT TO "BRING ABOUT SOCIETY WHICH EXISTS IN LIBYA OR SAUDI ARABIA." END SUMMARY

IN INTERVIEW PUBLISHED IN ENGLISH AND FARSI PRESS AUGUST 29 BUT WHICH HAD APPARENTLY BEEN CONDUCTED PRIOR TO AUGUST 27 GOVERNMENT CHANGE, AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI CLARIFIED SOME OF HIS POLITICAL VIEWS. SHARIATMADARI TOLD DER SPIEGEL REPORTERS IRAN'S RELIGIOUS LEADERS ARE NOT AFTER POLITICAL POWER, BUT MERELY SEEK TO RESTORE THE IRANIAN CONSTITUTION. HE CLAIMED ORDINARY PEOPLE OF IRAN ROSE UP, AND THAT CLERICS HAD MERELY "GIVEN THEM OUR SUPPORT." HE TOOK ISSUE WITH IDEA THAT ISLAMIC TEACHINGS WERE IRRELEVANT BUT SAID NO MOSLEM WOULD REJECT ACHIEVEMENTS OF LAST 1400 YEARS.

SHARIATMADARI SAID TERM "ISLAMIC-MARXIST" WAS CONTRADICTION IN TERMS, SINCE ISLAM AND MARXISM WERE FUNDAMENTALLY OPPOSED TO EACH OTHER. HE SPECIFICALLY DENIED THERE HAD BEEN CONTACT BETWEEN ISLAMIC CIRCLES AND MARXISTS IN IRAN. HE SAID RELIGIOUS COMMUNITY SUPPORTED LAND REFORM IF IT WAS DONE PROPERLY AND LEFT PEOPLE WITH NECESSARY TOOLS, TRAINING AND EQUIPMENT.

AYATOLLAH SAID HIS OBJECTION TO IMPERIAL CALENDAR WAS ARBITRARY CHANGING OF "VERY BASIS OF OUR HISTORY" WITHOUT EVEN OBTAINING PARLIAMENTARY APPROVAL. HE CLAIMED QOM DEMONSTRATIONS HAD BEEN PEACEFUL UNTIL "TROOPS OPENED FIRE ON INNOCENT AND UNARMED." HE ESCHEWED DESIRE TO RETURN TO ISLAMIC FUNDAMENTALISM AS OTHER STATES HAD DONE, AND ADDED "NOR DO WE WANT TO IMPLEMENT THE TRADITIONAL ISLAMIC CODES SUCH AS CUTTING OFF THIEVES HANDS OR STONING ADULTERERS." HE SAID SUCH ACCUSATIONS WERE OUTMODED AND EVERY REASONABLE MOSLEM KNEW IN HIS HEART THAT SUCH CRIMINAL CODES WERE NOT THE TRUE TENETS OF ISLAM.

SECOND INTERVIEW, GIVEN TO TWO PAKISTAN NEWSPAPERS, "PAKISTAN TIMES/ AND "MACHRIGH," REPORTED IN AUGUST 30 TEHRAN PRESS, ALTHOUGH INTERVIEW TOOK PLACE WHILE AMOUZEGAR WAS STILL PRIMIN. HERE SHARIATMADARI TOOK MUCH TOUGHER LINE. HE RECOUNTED DEVELOPMENT OF CURRENT UNREST, BEGINNING WITH JOURNAL ARTICLE WHICH ATTACKED KHOMEINI. ROOT OF THE PROBLEM LIES IN GOVERNMENT'S LACK OF RESPECT FOR LAWS AND DISREGARD FOR INDIVIDUAL AND SOCIAL FREEDOMS. HE FLATLY DENIED ANY RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN SHIITES AND COMMUNISTS. GOVERNMENT HAS USED THIS "OUTRIGHT LIE" FOR PROPAGANDA. ASKED WHETHER COMMUNISTS COULD NOT EXPLOIT CURRENT DISSENSION, HE SAID HIS MOVEMENT WOULD STRENGTHEN BOTH RELIGION AND NATION, AND WHEN BOTH WERE STRONG, COMMUNISTS COULD DO NOTHING.
HE WOULD CONTINUE TO ASK PEOPLE TO KEEP CALM. IF GOVERNMENT MEETS LEGITIMATELY TO SATISFY PEOPLE, PROBLEM WILL BE SOLVED.

FRENCH PRESS VERSION, WHICH WAS LONGER, SHOWED S-M TO BE LESS CONCILIATORY THAN ENGLISH PRESS INDICATED. WHEN ASKED WHETHER RELIGIOUS LEADERS COULD RESOLVE MATTERS AMICABLY WITH GOVERNMENT, HE REPLIED THERE WAS NO NEED FOR AMICABLE NEGOTIATIONS: IT WAS UP TO THE GOVERNMENT TO IMPLEMENT DEMANDS OF RELIGIOUS LEADERS.

WHEN ASKED WHETHER IRANIAN ELECTORATE HAD SUFFICIENT EDUCATION TO CHOOSE PARLIAMENT WHICH WOULD RESPECT RELIGIOUS LAWS, HE SAID: "IF THEY NEED GUIDANCE, THE RELIGIOUS CLASS WILL POINT OUT THE WORTHY CANDIDATES." ASKED WHETHER HIS MOVEMENT SOUGHT TO INSTALL ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT IN IRAN, HE SAID THAT ESTABLISHMENT OF AN ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT WAS "HIS PROFOUND WISH," BUT THAT UNDER PRESENT CONDITIONS HIS MOVEMENT SOUGHT ABOVE ALL TO HAVE THE CONSTITUTION ENFORCED IN ITS RELIGIOUS ASPECTS.

COMMENT: ABOVE GIVES FLAVOR OF SHARIATMADARI UTTERANCES, THOUGH HE MAY NOW BE MORE CIRCUMSPECT AND LESS HARD-NOSED IN WAKE OF GOVERNMENTAL CHANGE. SHARIATMADARI HAS NOT YET ISSUED OFFICIAL STATEMENT ON AUGUST 27 CHANGE OF GOVERNMENT. END COMMENT.

I PAID A COURTESY CALL ON NEW FOREIGN MINISTER KHOSROW AFSHAR-GHASSEMLOU EVENING AUGUST 30. THIS WAS SOMEWHAT EXTRAORDINARY GESTURE ON HIS PART SINCE I WAS THE FIRST AMBASSADOR HE HAS RECEIVED AND SINCE CALL TOOK PLACE IN MIDDLE OF HUA KUO-FENG VISIT.

UNFORTUNATELY, THE GENEROSITY OF THE GESTURE IS NOT MATCHED BY MY INITIAL IMPRESSIONS OF THE MINISTER. HE IS SMALL, DAPPER, RATHER FOPPISH MAN WITH SOME SEMANTIC AFFECTATIONS WHICH PRESUMABLY REFLECT HIS TENURE AS AMBASSADOR TO LONDON. HE MADE EVERY EFFORT TO BE FORTHCOMING, BUT IT ALL CAME OUT IN A RATHER POMPOUS, CONDESCENDING WAY.

THE FIRST ITEM HE CHOSE TO DISCUSS WAS THE EXISTENCE OF RUMORS "AMONG A CERTAIN CLASS OF IRANIANS" TO THE EFFECT THAT CIA HAS HAD A HAND IN RECENT DISTURBANCES HERE. ( I AM BEGINNING TO RESENT THIS DITHYRAMB AND POLITELY SUGGESTED SAME BY ASKING WHAT ACTION GOI INTENDED TO TAKE TO QUASH THESE RUMORS.)

UNDETERRED, THE MINISTER MOVED ON TO SUGGEST THAT THE USG UNDERTAKE TO ISSUE A RINGING STATEMENT OF SUPPORT FOR THE SHAH WHICH WOULD DISPEL THESE BASE RUMORS. HE PRODUCED AN EDITORIAL FROM THE MANCHESTER UNIONLEADER WHICH HE FELT SET JUST THE RIGHT TONE FOR SUCH A STATEMENT AND WHICH COULD INDEED SERVE AS A MODEL.

WHEN I COULD GET A WORD IN EDGEWISE, I PATIENTLY TRIED TO EXPLAIN THE POTENTIAL COUNTER-PRODUCTIVITY OF AN OFFICIAL USG STATEMENT AT THIS TIME, DESCRIBED THE GENERAL POLITICAL POSTURE OF MR. LOEB AND THE UNIONLEADER AND SUGGESTED THAT HE READ JOE KRAFT'S RECENT COLUMN AS A MORE USEFUL DOCUMENT TO WHICH GOI COULD POINT. I SAID WE, OF COURSE, WERE INTERESTED IN DISPELLING FALSE RUMORS AND THE SHAH HAD ASKED ME TO DISCUSS THE PROBLEM WITH HOVEYDA AND SHARIF-EMAMI.

HAVING THUS LEVITATED MY WAY OUT OF HIS BASIC SUGGESTION, I TURNED THE CONVERSATION TO IRANIAN RELATIONS WITH IRAQ. I SAID I HAD BEEN STRUCK BY ALACRITY WITH WHICH BAGHDAD HAD ARRESTED AND RETURNED THE ALLEGED CULPRIT IN THE ABADAN FIRE. I ASKED FOR THE MINISTER'S INTERPRETATION OF THIS ACT. HE PURSED HIS LIPS AND SAID IT WAS TOO EARLY TO SAY, BUT POINTED OUT THAT EXTRADITION WAS ACCOMPLISHED WITHOUT FORMALITY AND NO FORMAL REQUEST HAD TO BE MADE BY TEHRAN. HE THOUGHT THAT WAS A GOOD SIGN.

COMMENT: THESE INITIAL IMPRESSIONS MAY IMPROVE WITH TIME, BUT MY GUESS IS THAT WE ARE GOING TO MISS THE GOOD, GREY INTEGRITY OF KHALATBARY AND THAT THE PLODDING, PRECIOUS PEDANTRY OF DEPUTY MINISTER ZELLI MAY BEGIN TO LOOK GOOD BY COMPARISON.
I HAD A GOOD LONG MEETING WITH HOVEYDA MORNING AUGUST 31 AT HIS RESIDENCE. I WAS DELIGHTED TO FIND HIM FULL OF BEANS AND ITCHING TO HAVE A CANDID CONVERSATION WITH ME.

AS MIGHT BE EXPECTED, HE TOOK SOME CREDIT FOR LEADING THE SHAH TO THE CONCLUSION THAT POLITICAL LIBERALIZATION AND FREE ELECTIONS WERE THE ONLY WAY TO GO. HE REVIEWED THE ALTERNATIVES "A MILITARY SOLUTION WOULD LAST FOR ONE DAY ONLY") AND SAID THE SHAH WAS FIRMLY AND IRREVOCABLY SET ON THIS COURSE OF ACTION BECAUSE ANY OTHER COURSE WOULD SPELL THE END OF THE MONARCHY.
I SAID WE SHARED HIS ANALYSIS OF SITUATION BUT IT WAS MY IMPRESSION THAT SHAH HAD NO RPT NO ENTHUSIASM FOR HIS DECISION. I HAD FOUND HIM TENSE AND DEPRESSED.

HOVEYDA CUT IN TO SAY THE RIGHT WORD WAS "DISGUSTED." SHAH FELT IRANIANS WERE BENT UPON TEARING THEIR NATION APART. HE WAS GOING TO LET THEM HAVE DEMOCRACY BUT SEEMED CONVINCED THEY WOULD MAKE A MESS OF IT.

I SAID THAT SHAH COMPLAINED THERE WERE NO"PATRIOTS" COMING FORWARD TO STAND IN THE ELECTIONS. HOWEVER, IF HE CONFRONTED SUCH "PATRIOTS" WITH HIS CURRENT HANGDOG EXPRESSION RATHER THAN A SHOW OF CONFIDENCE, WE WOULD FIND ALL THE POTENTIAL CANDIDATES LINED UP AT OUR CONSULATE LOOKING FOR GREEN CARDS. HOVEYDA AGREED AND SAID FIRST STEP IN THE DEMOCRATIC PROCESS HAD TO BE TO GET THE SHAH OUT OF HIS CURRENT MOOD AND TO GIVE A SENSE OF LEADERSHIP TO THE "DECENT" POLITICAL FIGURES.

HE SAID HE WAS CONVICNED THSH'S MOOD WAS TEMPORARY. HE WAS A FIGHTER BY INSTINCT AND ONCE HE GOT INTO THE SPIRIT OF A GENUINE ELECTION CAMPAIGN, HE WOULD GIVE IT SOME SPARK. HE SAID HE THOUGHT A LETTER FROM PRESIDENT CARTER WOULD PROBABLY BE A GOOD FLINT TO IGNITE THE SPARK. I SAID I HAD SOME INDICATIONS FROM WASHINGTON THAT SUCH A LETTER WAS CURRENTLY IN PREPARATION. HE SUGGESTED, WHEN IT CAME, THAT I LET HIM PRESENT IT TO THE SHAH "WITH THE RIGHT MAYONNAISE."

I THEN ASKED WHO WAS GOING TO ORGANIZE THE ELECTION CAMPAIGN. I SAID AHMAD QUOREISHI OF THE REASTIKHIZ TOLD ME HE WAS PREPARED TO TAKE A LEADING ROLE, BUT WAS NOT SURE WHAT VEHICLE TO USE. HOVEYDA SAID HE WAS MEETING WITH RASTIKHIZ LEADERS THAT AFTERNOON TO DECIDE WHETHER TO KEEP THE PARTY OR START A FEW NEW ONES. HE ALSO SAID HE HAD SCHEDULED MEETINGS WITH OPPOSITION LEADERS (HE WAS HAVING LUNCH WITH DR. AMINI) BECAUSE "IT IS ALSO IMPORTANT TO DECIDE WHO YOUR OPPOSITION SHOULD BE."

I ASKED HIS ASSESSMENT OF POLITICAL ORGANIZATIONS IN THE COUNTRY. HE SAID THAT, AT THE MOMENT, NOBODY HAD A DECENT POLITICAL RPT POLITICAL ORGANIZATION. THE MULLAHS AN AYATOLLAHS OBVIOUSLY HAD AN ORGANIZATION, BUT HE WAS NOT SURE THEY COULD OR WOULD USE IT FOR POLITICAL PURPOSES.

THIS LED TO A DISCUSSION OF HIS CONTACTS WITH THE CLERGY. I RECALLED THAT HE HAD TOLD ME IN JUNE THAT HE EXPTECTED TO BE ABLE TO SPLIT THE CLERGY AND BRING THE MODERATES BEHIND THE GOVT. HE SAID IT DIDN'T WORK BECAUSE THE KHOMEINI PEOPLE HAD FRIGHTENED THE MODERATES. I SAID I ASSUMED THAT THE IISUES OF CORRUPTION AND THE INFLUENCE OF THE ROYAL FAMILY HAD ALSO STOOD IN THE WAY. HE AGREED AND SAID, "THANK GOD WE'VE FINALLY FACED THOSE ISSUES."

WE THEN DISCUSSED THE QUESTION OF RUMORS CONCERNING A U.S. ROLE IN THE DISTURBANCES. I SAID I WAS ANNOYED THAT SENIOR OFFICIALS KEPT RAISING THIS WITH ME IN MANNER WHICH SUGGESTED THEY THEMSELVES BELIEVED IT. I THOUGH EVEN THE SHAH HAD SEEMED AMBIVALENT ABOUT IT. I REPORTED WHAT FOREIGN MINISTER HAD ASKED ME TO DO (SEPTEL) AN SAID I THOUGHT THAT WAS SIMPLISTIC AND POSSIBLY COUNTER-PRODUCTIVE. HOVEYDA AGREED AND TOL ME TO IGNORE THE SUGGESTION.

INSTEAD, HE PROPOSED TWO COURSES OF ACTION: (A) HAVE OUR "SERVICES" TALK WITH CHIEF OF SAVAK AND COMPARE INFORMATION BOTH HAVE ON FOREIGN INVOLVEMENT IN RECENT EVENTS, (B) HAVE OUR EMBASSY OFFICERS INDICATE TO THEIR IRANIAN INTERLOCUTORS THAT THE U.S. BELIEVES THE SHAH IS THE BEST PERSON TO LEAD THE MOVEMENT TO POLITICAL DEMOCRACY.

I AGREED TO BOTH HIS SUGGESTIONS AND SAID I WOULD ARRANGE TO CARRY THEM OUT. HE SAID THESE WERE ONLY OFF THE TOP OF HIS HEAD AND HE MIGHT WISH TO SUGGEST OTHER ACTIONS AS WE GO ON. HE PROPOSED THAT WE MEET REGULARLY ON AN INFORMAL BASIS TO COMPARE NOTES AND KEEP THE SHAH POINTED IN THE RIGHT DIRECTION.

TEHRAN 7890 (NOTAL) BEGIN LIMITED OFFICIAL USE SUMMARY: MASHAD AYATOLLAH GIVES RELIGIOUS LEADERS' DEMANDS ON NEW GOVERNMENT. LIST CALLS FOR FREEDOM OF CLERGY, HARMONIZATION OF ALL LAWS WITH TENETS OF ISLAM, END TO EXILE FOR RELIGIOUS LEADERS, AND ALL CABINET MINISTERS TO BE MOSLEMS WITH DISMISSAL OF BAHAIS FROM GOVERNMENT SERVICE. AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI AND OTHERS MAKE SIMILAR COMMENTS. EXILED CLERGY HAVE BEGUN TO RETURN TO THEIR HOMES. DESPITE GOI MEASURES TO DATE, CLERGY HAVE HUNG BACK FROM MORE FULSOME EMBRACE OF NEW GOI. END SUMMARY.

PRESS MORNING AUGUST 31 FEATURED STATEMENT OF RELIGIOUS DEMANDS ON NEW GOI BY MASHAD AYATOLLAH HAJ SEYED ABDOLLAH SHIRAZI. HE SAID THESE CONSTITUTED WHAT RELIGIOUS COMMUNITY EXPECTS OF NEW GOI TO SEAL "NATIONAL RECONCILIATION," AND ADDED DEMANDS HAD ALREADY BEEN RELAYED TO GOI.

RELIGIOUS DEMANDS INCLUDE GUARANTEE OF CLERGY'S "FREEDOM OF EXPRESSION AND FUNCTION;" ABOLITION OF ALL LAWS VIOLATING PRECEPTS OF KORAN; CLOSING DOWN OF "IMMORAL ESTABLISHMENTS;" FREEING OF POLITICAL PREISONERS; ALLOWING EXILED CLERGYMEN SUCH AS AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI TO RETURN TO IRAN; DISMISSAL OF ALL BAHAIS FROM GOVERNMENT SERVICE; INSURING THAT ALL CABINET MINISTERS ARE SHI'ITE MOSLEMS; AND COORDINATION OF CULTURAL POLICIES WITH "ISLAMIC TENETS."

AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI OF QOM, IN FOLLOW-UP TO EARLIER SIMILAR COMMENTS( REF B) STATED AUGUST 30 THAT MOSLEM CLERGY WERE NOT RELIGIOUS FANATICS AND "ADHERED TO PROGRESSIVE PRINCIPLES." HE CATEGORICALLY DENIED ACCUSATIONS THAT HE FAVORED BURNING MOVIE HOUSES, BUT SAID "WE ARE OPPOSED TO MOVIES WHICH DAMAGE ISLAMIC MORAL AND SPIRITUAL LAWS." SHARIATMADARI ALSO DENIED DIFFERENCES OF OPINION BETWEEN HIMSELF AND KHOMEINI, SAYING A FRIENDLY CONTACT ALWAYS EXISTED BETWEEN THE RELIGIOUS CENTERS AT QOM AND NAJAF (IN IRAQ).

PRESS ALSO REPORTS SOME EXILED CLERGYMEN ARE RETURNING HOME, INCLUDING KHOMEINI'S BROTHER HOJJATOLISLAM MORTEZA PASANDIDEH, WHO HAD BEEN ARRESTED TWO MONTHS AGO. IT ALSO NOTES THAT CLERGY HAVE "SHOWN EXTREME RELUCTANCE TO REACT POSITIVELY TO THE GOVERNMENT'S OVERTURES AND APPEARS TO BE WAITING FOR MORE PROOF FROM THE GOVERNMENT THAT IT WILL ENACT ITS PROMISES." END LOU - BEGIN CONFIDENTIAL

COMMENT: EMBASSY WOULD AGREE THAT CLERGY HAVE BEEN SLOW TO REACT POSITIVELY, BUT HISTORICAL BACKGROUND OF THEIR TIES WITH GOI WOULD NOT ENCOURAGE OPTIMISM UNDER BEST OF CIRCUMSTANCES. DENIAL OF NAJAF-QOM CONFLICT IS PATENT NONSENSE, BUT CLERGY ON BOTH SIDES SITLL TRYING TO SMOOTH OVER DIFFERENCES. COMPETITION AMOUNG LOCAL RELIGIOUS LEADERS (REF C) IS NOT CONDUCIVE TO COOPERATIVE POSTURE WITH GOI.

REACTIONS TO RELIGIOUS ATTITUDED EXPRESSED TO DATE (REFS B, D AND PRESENT TEL) HAVE RANGED FROM APPROVAL BY MANY MOSLEMS TO OUTRIGHT HORROR AMOUNG MANY MODERNISTS WHO BEGIN TO FEAR ACCOMMODATION WITH CLERGY "MEANS TURNING THE CALENDAR BACK 1400 YEARS." SO FAR MAJORITY ATTITUDE IS "WAIT AND SEE," SINCE MORE PERCEPTIVE MODERNISTS REALIZE RHETORIC IS NOT ACTION.

MANY IN POLITICAL ELITE, HOWEVER, ARE BEGINNING TO FEEL SHAH AND GOI, HAVING DECISIVELY SOLVED PROBLEM OF "THOSE PRIESTS" IN 1963 HAVE SIMPLY OPENED DORR TO TO RETURN OF "SAME OLD TROUBLES." VARIATION IN MOOD REFLECTS GENERAL UNCERTAINTY AS WELL AS VIRTUALLY UNIVERSAL PERCEPTION THAT RELIGIOUS FORCES ARE "BACK IN THE BALL GAME," FOR GOOD OR ILL.

SUMMARY: PAST TWO DAYS HAVE SEEN STREET RIOTS IN TEHRAN WITH 183 DETAINED, MORE RIOTING IN TABRIZ AND SOME FAINT STIRRINGS IN ISFAHAN. MANY CLERGY NOW TRYING TO SETTLE MOBS DOWN WITH SPORADIC SUCCESS. END SUMMARY.

PRESS REPORTS SEVERAL CLASHES BETWEEN MOBS AND POLICE IN SOUTH TEHRAN, AND ONE IN SHEMIRAN AREA OF NORTH TEHRAN BETWEEN CROWD OF SEVERAL HUNDRED WHICH LEFT TAJRISH MOSQUE EVENING AUGUST 29. LATTER CONFIRMED BY OTHER SOURCE. ONE DEATH AND 200 ARRESTS REPORTED COUNTRY-WIDE FOR PAST FEW DAYS, WITH 183 DETAINED IN TEHRAN. DEATH OCCURRED IN REZAYIEH RIOT AROUND A MOSQUE.

SHIRAZ CONSULATE REPORTS THAT CITY QUIET. ISFAHAN NOW QUIET AFTER BRIEF FLURRY WHEN FARSI PRESS ON AUGUST 28 ERRONEOUSLY REPORTED THAT AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI WOULD BE RETURNING TO IRAN. U.S. CONSULATE THERE REPORTS THAT GROUPS WHICH BEGAN TO FORM IN CONTRAVENTTION OF MARTIAL LAW WERE DISPERSED BY ARMY WITH MUCH TACT AND DISCRETION AND THEREBY PROBABLY PREVENTED SERIOUS BLOWUP. U.S. CONSULATE TABRIZ REPORTS MOBS HAVE FOUGHT WITH POLICE EVERY DAY FOR PAST FIVE DAYS. SIMILAR SITUATION HAS OCCURRED AT MARGARAGEH.

COMMENT: WE UNDERSTAND MANY CLERGY ARE NOW TRYING TO CALM DOWN MOSQUE CONGREGATIONS, BUT THERE ARE STILL MULLAHS WHO PERSIST IN AGITATING. IN SOME CASES, CROWDS TAKE IT UPON THEMSELVES TO REACT. SHEMIRAN MOB IS FIRST TIME NORTHERN PART OF CITY HAS SEEN THIS KIND OF EVENT, BUT THERE HAVE BEEN OCCASIONAL REPORTS OF POLICE GUNFIRE IN THIS AREA IN PAST. WEEKEND EXPECTED TO BE FAIRLY QUIET, WITH FAITHFUL LOOKING FORWARD TO END OF RAMAZAN SEPT 4.

I MADE MY FIRST CALL AT NOON SEPTEMBER 2 ON NEWLY INSTALLED PRIME MINISTER SHARIF-EMAMI. I FOUND HIM COMFORTABLY ENSCONED IN OFFICE, EMPLOYING THE SAME PERSONAL STAFF AS HAD AMOUZEGAR. THERE WAS NO GREAT WHIRR OF ACTIVITY IN THE ANTECHAMBERS AND HIS DESK WAS RELATIVELY CLEAR OF DOSSIERS. WE TALKED FOR OVER AN HOUR AND HE SEEMED TO HAVE PLENTY OF TIME AT HIS DISPOSAL.

WE BEGAN THE CONVERSATION BY DISCUSSING THE DOMESTIC SCENE. HE SAID HE HAD DEVELOPED GOOD CONTACTS WITH THE MODERATE CLERGY AND HOPED THE STREET VIOLENCE WOULD SOON ABATE. HE OUTLINED PLANS TO EASE TENSION IN THE BAZAARS BY PERMITTING THE MERCHANT GUILDS TO ELECT THEIR OWN OFFICIALS RATHER THAN CONTINUE WITH THOSE SAVAK HAD FOISTED ON THEM. HE WOULD ALSO DESTROY 200,000 DOSSIERS ON BAZAARIS HELD BY THE MINISTRY OF JUSTICE (READ SAVAK) WHICH HAD BEEN USED TO INTIMIDATE THE BAZAARS.

HIS BIGGEST PROBLEM, HE SAID, WAS AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI. HE HAD EXAMINED VARIOUS WAYS TO DEAL WITH HIM AND DECIDED THAT, SO LONG AS KHOMEINI REMAINED IN IRAQ, HE WOULD BE A SERIOUS PROBLEM. HE PLANNED TO ASK IRAQ TO DEPORT HIM BACK TO TURKEY, WHERE HE COULD STILL BE A PROBLEM, BUT A MANAGEABLE ONE. HE HAD NOT YEET APPROACHED EITHER THE IRAQIS OR THE TURKS, BUT SEEMED TO THINK THEY WOULD FIND HIS PROPOSAL REASONABLE.

HE THEN TURNED TO THE "FOREIGN HAND" IN RECENT TROUBLES. HE ASSUMED THAT KGB AND KHADDAFI WERE INVOLVED, BUT "PEOPLE" CAME TO HIM EVERY DAY ASSERTING THE CIA WAS ALSO INVOLVED. HE SAID HE WOULD LIKE TO HAVE MY CATEGORIC ASSURANCES THIS WAS NOT SO IN ORDER TO BE ABLE TO TELL THESE "PEOPLE" THEY WERE WRONG. I SAID THE ONLY "PEOPLE" WHO KEPT RAISING THESE RUMORS WITH ME WERE SENIOR GOI OFFICIALS, WHO OUGHT TO BE ABLE TO REACHTHEIR OWN LOGICAL CONCLUSIONS THIS WAS UNTRUE.

I SAID I DID NOT KNOW WHETHER THESE OFFICIALS BELIEVED THEIR RUMORS, BUT WHAT DISTURBED ME WAS THAT, BY BLAMING A "FOREIGN HAND" FOR THEIR TROUBLES, THEY WERE APPARENTLY ABLE TO IGNORE OR EXCULPATE THE GENUINE ECONOMIC, SOCIAL AND POLITICAL CAUSES FOR THE RECENT TROUBLES.

I THEN TICKED OFF A LONG LIST OF ISSUES, -- CORRUPTION, INFLUENCE OF ROYAL FAMILY MEMBERS, INADEQUATE ATTENTION TO THE RURAL AREAS, BUREAUCRATIC INEFFICIENCY, ETC. -AND SAID THE COMBINATION OF ALL OF THESE WAS QUITE ADEQUATE TO EXPLAIN THE MALAISE WITHOUT SEARCHING FOR FOREIGN DEVILS. I COMPLIMENTED HIM ON THE START HE HAD MADE IN FACING SOME OF THESE ISSUES AND HOPED HE WOULD CONTINUE. IN ANY EVENT, I SAID, HE COULD CATEGORICALLY DENY TO EVERYONE THAT CIA WAS INVOLVED IN THE CURRENT CHAOS.

SHARIF-EMAMI SAID HE WOULD BE PLEASED TO KNOCK THE CIA RUMORS DOWN. HE SAID IT WOULD HELP, HOWEVER, IF WE COULD GENERATE A FEW SYMBOLIC ACTIONS WHICH WOULD INDICATE CONTINUING CLOSE U.S. SUPPORT FOR IRAN. HE THOUGHT THAT SIGNATURE OF THE U.S.-IRAN NUCLEAR BILATERAL WAS PERHAPS THE MOST FEASIBLE ACTION IN THE SHORT RUN. HE URGED THAT THIS BE DONE AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. HE FELT IT WOULD BE SEEN AS A GOOD POLITICAL STEP. I SAID I WOULD RELAY THIS REQUEST TO WASHINGTON IMMEDIATELY.

(COMMENT: PLEASE GET THE BUREAUCRACY ENERGIZED ON THIS RATHER SIMPLE ACTION.) ------------------111216 030930Z /12 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 135 INFO AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY MOSCOW SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 08366 LIMDIS

SHARIF-EMAMI THEN TURNED TO THE IRANIAN STUDENT ASSOCIATION IN THE U.S. AND ASKED IF THERE WAS SOME WAY WE COULD CURB THEIR ACTIVITIES AND THEIR SLANDEROUS PUBLICATIONS. I EXPLAINED THAT OUR LAWS WERE PARTICULARLY TOLERANT ON PUBLIC ASSEMBLY AND THE PRESS. I DOUBTED WE COULD DO MUCH UNLESS IRAN COUDL PROVE THEY WERE ACTING AS AGENTS FOR A FOREIGN POWER. I WENT ON TO SAY THAT, IN MY JUDGMENT, THE ISA WAS LOSING CREDIBILITY WITH THE AMERICAN PUBLIC.

I SUGGESTED THAT THE BEST THING IRAN COULD DO WAS TO ASSURE THAT, BY WORD AND DEED, THE SHAH WAS SEEN TO BE "PROGRESSIVE" AND HIS OPPOSITION AS "REACTIONARY." IF THIS POSTURE DEVELOPED, THE ISA WOULD BECOME IRRELEVANT.

FINALLY, WE TALKED ABOUT ECONOMIC POLICY. I ASKED IF THE ESSENTIAL RETENTION OF AMOUZEGAR'S ECONOMIC TEAM MEANT THE POLICIES OF RESTRAINT WOULD BE CONTINUED. THE ANSWER WAS ESSENTIALLY YES, BUT IT WAS ALSO QUITE CLEAR THAT SHARIF-EMAMI HAD NOT GIVEN MUCH THOUGHT TO ECONOMIC POLICY. HE DID SAY, HOWEVER, THAT MORE STRESS WOULD BE LAID ON AGRICULTURE AND THAT THE AMOUZEGAR BUDGET WOULD BE REVISED TO REFLECT THIS.

COMMENT: IT IS TOO EARLY TO TELL WHETHER SHARIFEMAMI WILL REALLY TRY TO GET HOLD OF THE REINS OF GOVT AND SET POLICY. HE STRESSED SEVERAL TIMES THAT THE WAS OPERATING ON HIS OWN RESPONSIBILITY AND LIABILITY IN ORDER TO KEEP THE SHAH ABOVE THE HURLY-BURLY OF THIS TUMULTUOUS PERIOD. HOWEVER, FOR THE TIME BEING AT LEAST, I BELIEVE COURT MINISTER HOVEYDA COMES CLOSER TO BEING THE REAL SOURCE OF POLITICAL INSPIRATION AND POWER IN THIS ORGANIZATION THAN DOES SHARIF-EMAMI, WHOSE PARTICULAR FORTE IS HIS OPPORTUNITY TO BUILD BRIDGES TO THE ISLAMIC LEADERSHIP ON BEHALF OF THE SHAH.
WOULD APPRECIATE SWISS FINGERPRINT CHART FOR NAJMABADI, AMIR ABBAS, BE FORWARDED THIS POST TO ASSIST IN CHECKING BONA FIDE.
