1978TEHRAN08399.subject: ASSISTANCE TO ATOMIC ENERGY ORGANIZATION OF IRAN (AEOI) BY USNRC AND OTHER GOVERNMENTS IN NUCLEAR SAFETY

segments.text: PASS TO DR. J. LAFLEUR, NRC. IN MEETING 30 AUG WITH DR. M. FARZIN, DIRECTOR FOR NUCLEAR SAFELY, AEOI, SCIATT DISCUSSED QUESTIONS STATED IN REFERENCE LETTER DEALING WITH DIFFERENCES BETWEEN METHODS AND CONTENT OF SAFETY RELATED ASSISTANCE PROVIEDED BY NRC AND OTHER GOVERNMENT ORGANIZATIONS TO IRAN. FOLLOWING IS A RESTATEMENT OF THE QUESTIONS ASKED BY EMBASSY AND FARZIN'S RESPONSES

QUESTON: DOES AEOI HAVE CONTRACT OR OTHER FORMAL UNDERSTANDING REGARDING SITING, REACTOR DESIGN, OR OTHER TYPES OF SAFETY OR ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION ANALYSES OR REVIEWS WHICH INVOLVES ASSISTANCE FROM A GOVERNMENT AGENCY OR MINISTRY OF A FOREIGN COUNTRY? ANSWER: AEOI HAS CONTRACTS AND UNDERSTANDINGS WITH SEVERAL COUNTRIES; E.G., A CONTRACT IN THE AREA OF NUCLEAR SAFETY EXISTS WITH THE UKAEA; UNDERSTANDING (OR WORKING RELATIONSHIP) EXISTS FOR CERTAIN PROJECTS WITH JAPAN AND TO A LESSER EXTENT, WITH FRANCE AND GERMANY IN THE SAFETY AREA. IN THE CASE OF JAPAN A GOOD WORKING RELATIONSHIP AND CONSEQUENTLY IMPROVED RAPPORT IS THE APPARENT OBJECTIVE OF MITI.

SERVICES ARE PROVIDED THROUGH MITI IN EARTHQUAKE RESISTANT STRUCTURE DESIGN ON A NO-COST BASIS TO AEOI. REGIONAL COOPERATION DEVELOPMENT (RCD) ALSO EXISTS AMONG TURKEY, PAKISTAN AND IRAN. RCD IS A DEVELOPMENT FROM CENTO COVERING COOPERATION IN VARIOUS FIELDS INCLUDING NUCLEAR. MEETINGS ARE HELD YEARLY ON ALMOST EVERY ASPECT OF NUCLEAR POWER DEVELOPMENT INCLUDING SAFETY.

QUESTION: WHAT COUNTRIES AND AGENCIES ARE INVOLVED? ANSWER: AS STATED ABOVE THE UK THROUGH UKAEA, THE GOJ THROUGH MITI, AND TO A LESSER EXTENT FRANCE AND GERMANY THROUGH CEA AND THE MINISTRY OF TRADE RESPECTIVELY. IN THE CASE OF FRG, THE MINISTRY IS THE COORDINATING BODY FOR PROVISION OF SERVICES THROUGH TUV, GRS, AND OTHER GERMAN SAFETY RELATED ORGANIZATIONS.

QUESTON: WHAT TYPES OF REVIEWS WILL BE PERFORMED? ANSWER: THE UK PROVIEDES SERVICES UNDER A GENERAL NUCLEAR SAFETY AGREEMENT. THE GOJ PROVIDES SERVICES IN THE FIELD OF HIGH SEISMIC DESIGN. IN THE CASE OF FRG, AEOI HAS BEEN TRYING ACCORDING TO FARZIN TO REACH AN UNDERSTANDING FOR THREE YEARS; HOWEVER, HE STATES THAT THERE IS A LACK OF CONCENTRATION OF LICENSING ACTIVITIES IN GERMANY MAKING COORDINATION DIFFICULT, FURTHER, THE GERMAN NUCLEAR MODUS OPERANDI IS HIGHLY INTEGRATED SUCH THAT EVEN NUCLEAR LICENSING IS PRESUMED NOT TO BE INDEPENDENT OF INDUSTRY PRESSURES, AS CONTRASTED WITH THE USNRC. CONSEQUENTLY, AEOI HAS NOT UP SPECIFIC SAFETY PROJECTS WITH GERMANY AT THIS TIME.

QUESTIONS: WHO DETERMINED SCOPE, INTENSITY, TIMING AND DURATION OF THE REVIEWS/ANSWERS: IN GENERAL, AEOI ESTABLISHES THESE PARAMETERS; HOWEVER, THE TIMING DEPENDS ON AVAILABLE MANPOWER AND BUDGET. FOR EXAMPLE, IN THE CASE OF THE UKAEA CONTRACT, AEOI PAYS THE COSTS AND THEREFORE ESTABLISHES THE INTENSITY OF SERVICES TO BE PROVIDED THROUGH ITS BUDGET ALLOCATION. SINCE IN THE CASE OF THE JAPANESE UNDERSTANDING, NO DOLLARS FLOW FROM AEOI, A PROBLEM SOLVING EFFORT IS MUTUALLY AGREED UPON AS A FUNCTION OF THE GOJ BUDGET IN THAT FIELD.
QUESTION: WHAT LIMITATIONS ARE THERE REGARDING MINIMUMOR MAXIMUM LEVELS OF EFFORT? ANSWER: BUDGET AND MANPOWER AVAILABILITY AS DETERMINED BY BOTH SIDES.

QUESTION: ARE REVIEWS BEING PERFORMED UNDER A CONSULTANCY CONTRACT? DOES THE CONTRACT CONCERN ONLY SUCH ASSISTANCE OR DOES IT CONCERN A WIDE RANGE OF SERVICES BY OTHER GOVERNMENTAL OR COMMERCIAL ENTITIES? ANSWER: A MIXTURE OF THE ABOVE.

QUESTION: WHAT IS THE COST OF THE REVIEW SERVICES? ANSWER: IT VARIES OVER A WIDE RANGE. IN SOME CASES THE COST IS PAID FOR BY AEOI AND IN OTHER CASES BY THE GOVERNMENT PROVIDING THE ASSISTANCE (AS STATED ABOVE).
QUESTION: HOW IS REIMBURSEMENT HANDLED? ANSWER: IT IS BASED ON HOURS OR DAYS WORKED WITH CORRESPONDING BILLINGS.

QUESTION: TO WHAT EXTENT IS SAFETY ASSISTANCE PROVIDED AT NO COST TO AEOI BY OTHER COUNTRIES? ANSWER: SO FAR ONLY JAPANESE SERVICES HAVE BEEN PROVIDED AT NO COSTS. IN ALL OTHER CASES THE PROFESSIONAL SERVICES ARE PROVIDED FROM FOREIGN GOVERNMENT ON A COST REIMBURSABLE BASIS TO AEOI.

IN SEPARATE BUT RELATED MATTER, DR. FARZIN, DISCUSSED WITH SCIATT, LETTER OF 4 AUG WHICH HE RECIEVED FROM NRC'S DR.J. LAFLEUR (COPY NOT RECIEVED BY EMBASSY) CITING HIS REGRET ABOUT THE INABILITY OF AEOI TO ACCEPT SIHWEIL AS EXPERT TO IRAN. DR. FARZIN IS TRYING TO COME UP WITH APPROACH WHEREBY TOP U.S. NUCLEAR SAFETY EXPERTS CAN BE ACCEPTABLE ON COMPETITIVE COST BASIS TO IRAN FROM U.S., HOWEVER, IN CONTRAST TO LAFLEUR LETTER QUESTIONING VALIDITY OF LARGE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN SIHWEIL COSTS AND COUNTERPART EUROPEAN EXPERT COSTS. FRAXIN AND SCIATT HAVE NO CHOICE BUT TO CONCLUDE THAT THESE DIFFERENCES ARE REAL AND POTENTIALLY UNAVOIDABLE.

CONSEQUENTLY, EMBASSY RECOMMENDS DEPT., WITH NRC ASSISTANCE, INITIATE COST COMPARISON PREFERABLY THROUGH IAEA, OF TWO YEAR (OR LESS) ASSIGNMENT FOR SPECIFIC POTENTIAL CANDIDATES FROM U. S. AND WESTERN EUROPE, ON COMPARABLE BASIS, AND ADVISE EMBASSY OF RESULTS.

1978TEHRAN08418.subject: BIOGRAPHIC INFORMATION ON IRAN'S NEW CABINET

segments.text: NEW CABINET INCLUDES SIX HOLDOVERS FROM AMOUZEGAR CABINET AND SIXTEEN NEW MINISTERS. RETAINED WERE THE FOLLOWING: GENERAL REZA AZIMI, MINISTER OF WAR; MOHAMMAD YEGANEH, MINISTER OF ECONOMIC AFFAIRS AND FINANCE; KARIM MOTAMEDI, MINISTER OF POST, TELEPHONE, AND TELEGRAPH; MANUCHEHR GANJI, MINISTER OF EDUCATION; NASROLLAH MOJDEHI, MINISTER OF HEALTH AND SOCIAL WELFARE; MOHAMMAD REZA AMIN, MINISTER OF INDUSTRY AND MINES. BIOGRAPHICAL INFORMATION ON NEW MINISTERS FOLLOWS

AMIR-HOSSEIN AMIR-PARVIZ----MINISTER OF AGRICULTURE. BORN 1922, AMIR-PARVIZ IS AN EXPERIENCED AGRONOMIST. HE GRADUATED IN AGRICULTURAL STUDIES FROM KARAJ UNIVERSITY AND RECEIVED AN ADVANCED DEGREE IN AGRICULTURAL ECONOMICS FROM MINNESOTA AND ALSO STUDIED AT PURDUE. IN 1946 HE JOINED THE MINISTRY OF AGRICULTURE AND HELD A VARIETY OF POSTS, ADVANCING TO DEPUTY MINISTER IN 1967. HE SERVED AS GOVERNOR-GENERAL OF LURISTAN AND HAMADAN 1974-75 AND HAS BEEN GOVERNOR-GENERAL OF KERMANSHAHAN SINCE DEC. 1975. AMIR-PARVIZ IS OUTGOING AND INTELLIGENT, AND HE HAS PROVED VERY HELPFUL TO AMCONSUL TABRIZ. HE IS MARRIED AND HAS TWO CHILDREN, A DAUGHTER PRESENTLY STUDYING ON THE ISLE OF WIGHT, AND A SON IN HIGH SCHOOL IN TEHRAN.
HE SPEAKS ENGLISH AND FRENCH.

HASSAN ALI MEHRAN---MINISTER OF STATE FOR THE PLAN AND BUDGET ORGANIZATION. BORN 1937, MEHRAN GRADUATED IN POLITICAL SCIENCE AND ECONOMICS FROM UNIVERSITY OF NO NOTTINGHAM, ENGLAND. AFTER LECTURING THREE YEARS AT BRISTOL UNIVERSITY. HE JOINED STAFF OF INTERNATIONAL MONETARY FUND IN WASHINGTON. IN OCTOBER 1969 HE RETURNED TO IRAN AND ENTERED MINISTRY OF ECONOMICS WHERE HE WAS APPOINTED DIRECTOR-GENERAL OF PROJECTS AND RESEARCH. AND DEPUTY MANAGING DIRECTOR OF RESEARCH CENTER FOR INDUSTRIAL AND TRADE DEVELOPMENT. HE SERVED AS UNDERSECRETARY FOR ECONOMIC AFFAIRS FROM 1971 TO JUNE 1974.

WHEN HE BECAME DEPUTY MINISTER FOR ECONOMIC AFFAIRS IN OCTOBER 1975 HE BECAME GOVERNOR OF THE CENTRAL BANK, HE JOINED NIOC FEBRUARY 1978 AS DEPUTY DIRECTOR. MEHRAN HAS PREVIOUS LINKS WITH NEW PM SHARIF-EMAMI. MEHRAN'S UNCLE WAS CABINET MINISTER IN SHARIF-EMAMI'S PREVIOUS GOVERNMENT, 1960-61. FURTHERMORE, AS DEP MIN MEHRAN WAS INSPECTOR OF INDUSTRIAL AND MINING DEVELOPMENT BANK OF IRAN OF WHICH SHARIF-EMAMI IS CHAIRMAN OF THE BOARD. MEHRAN HAS ALSO LONG BEEN CONSIDERED A PROTEGE OF HUSHANG ANSARI. ALTHOUGH A RIFT REPORTEDLY DEVELOPED BETWEEN THEM IN LATE 1977, SPLIT (IF THERE WAS ONE) MUST HAVE HEALED, BECAUSE ANSARI BROUGHT MEHRAN TO NIOC IN FEB. 1978.

USG OFFICIALS HAVE FOUND HIM INTELLIGENT, CAPABLE AND PERSONABLE. HE IS NONETHELESS ARDENT ADVOCATE OF INDEPENDENCE IN WORLD ECONOMIC AFFAIRS, AND HE HAS SAID DAYS OF AMERICAN TUTELAGE ARE OVER. UNMARRIED, HE IS WELL KNOWN AS A DON VIVANT. HE USUALLY WEARS DARK GLASSES AS RESULT OF AUTOMOBILE ACCIDENT WHICH INJURED ONE EYE. HE SPEAKS ENGLISH AND SPANISH.

GENERAL ABBAS QARABAGHI---MINISTER OF INTERIOR. QARABAGHI IS A CADET CORPS CLASSMATE OF SHAH. BORN 1918 IN TABRIZ, HE GRADUATED FROM TEHRAN MILITARY ACADEMY IN 1938. HE EARNED A PH.D. IN LAW FROM UNIVERSITY OF PARIS. HE HELD VARIETY OF STAFF AND COMMAND POSITIONS. AS COMMANDER, 1ST GUARD DIV 1965-69, HE WAS RESPONSIBLE FOR PERSONAL PROTECTION OF SHAH, HE WAS CHIEF OF STAFF, IMPERIAL IRANIAN GROUND FORCES FROM MAY 1972, BECOMING COMMANDER, I CORPS, IIGF UNTIL IT WAS DEACTIVATED 22 APR 1974. HE HAS BEEN COMMANDER, IMPERIAL IRANIAN GENDARMERIE SINCE THAT TIME. WELL--CONNECTED TO SHAH FROM STUDENT DAYS, QARABAGHI ALSO HAS TIES TO GENERAL HOSSEIN FARDUST, CHIEFT OF IMPERIAL INSPECTORATE.

WESTERN-ORIENTED, HE HAS COOPERATED WITH U.S. ADVISORS. HE PRESENTS FINE MILITARY BEARING. HE IS CONSIDERED CAPABLE, SINCERE AND HONEST. HE IS MARRIED AND HAS AT LEAST THREE DAOUGHTERS. HE SPEAKS FRENCH AND FAIR ENGLISH. ------------------123152 061714Z /42 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 194 DIA WASHDC CIA WASHDC USICA WASHDC INFO AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMEBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MUSCAT SECTION 2 OF 4 TEHRAN 8418

PARVIS AVINI---MINISTER OF HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT. BORN 1919 IN TEHRAN, AVINI RECEIVED DEGREE IN ENGINEERING FROM TEHRAN UNIVERSITY AND STUDIED RAILWAY AFFAIRS IN FRANCE, BELGIUM, SWITZERLAND, AND WEST GERMANY. HE SPENT MOST OF HIS CAREER IN SERVICE OF IRAN STATE RAILWAYS, INCLUDING TWO TOURS AS DIRECTOR. ALSO HE SERVED AS DEPUTY CHANCELLOR OF NATIONAL UNIVERSITY, RETURNING AS CHIEF OF IRAN STATE RAILWAYS IN 1971. HE WAS A FOUNDER OF IRAN-NOVIN PARTY. AVINI HAS POWERFUL FRIEND IN NASRATOLLAH MOINIAN, CHIEF OF SHAH'S SPECIAL SECRETARIAT. HE SPEAKS ENGLISH AND FRENCH.

HUSHANG NAHAVANDI--- MINISTER OF SCIENCE AND HIGHER EDUCATION. BORN ABOUT 1930 IN RASHT, NAHAVANDI GRADUATED IN LAW AND POLITICAL SCIENCE FROM TEHRAN UNIVERSITY AND RECEIVED A DOCTORATE IN ECONOMICS FROM UNIVERSITY OF PARIS. HE JOINED STAFF OF IRAN CREDITS IN 1958, AND FROM 1958 TO 1961 WAS ADVISOR TO HIGH ECONOMIC COUNCIL. HE WAS ALSO PROFESSOR OF ECONOMICS AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY. HE WAS ECONOMIC COUSELOR IN IRANIAN EMBASSY, BRUSSELS, 1961-63. THE LAST TWO OF THOSE YEARS HE WAS ALSO DEPUTY CHIEF OF IRANIAN DELEGATION TO EUROPEAN ECONOMIC COMMUNITY. HE BECAME MINISTER OF HOUSING AND DEVELOPMENT IN 1964. HE TAUGHT ECONOMICS AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY WHILE RETAINING CABINET POST.

IN SEPT 1968 HE BECAME CHANCELLOR OF PAHLAVI UNIVERSITY, SHIRAZ. REPORTEDLY DIESCOURAGED OVER HIS LACK OF AUTHORITY, HE ACCEPTED NEW POST IN AUG. 1971 AS CHANCELLOR OF TEHRAN UNIVERSITY. HE HAS BEEN EMPRESS FARAH'S SPECIAL BUREAU CHEIF SINCE NOV. 1976. HE IS HEAD OF BOARD OF TRUSTEES OF TEHRAN UNIVERSITY. NAHAVANDI ENJOYED PATRONAGE OF FORMER PM HASAN ALI MANSUR AND PROJECTED IMAGE OF BOY WONDER. DESPITE RELATIVE YOUTH WHEN FIRST GIVEN IMPORTANT POSTS, HE WAS BEEN ONLY A MILD REFORMER. SHAH CHOSE HIM TO HEAD TEHRA UNIVERSITY IN 1971 TO DEFUSE SITATUION CAUSED BY STUDENT STRIKES. HE DID SO BY BUYING OFF STUDENTS WITH MANY HIGH-PAYING NONWORK JOBS.

NAHAVANDI IS HEAD OF GROUP FOR THE STUDY OF IRANIAN PROBLEMS, THE THIRD WING OF RPPI. A FRANCOPHILE, HE HAS SLOWLEY LEARNED ENGLISH BUT IS NOT AT EASE USING IT. HE IS CONSIDERED COURTEOUS AND MODEST. HIS DAUGHTER ENTERED UNIVERSITY OF UTAH 1976.

MOHAMMAD AMELI-TEHRANI---MINISTER OF INFORMATION AND TOURISM. BORN 1927 IN TEHRAN, HE PURSUED MEDICAL EDUCATION, RECIEVING M.D. 1953 FROM TEHRAN UNIVERSITY. HE SERVED AS DEPUTY LEADER OF PAN-IRANIST PARTY, WHICH HE HELPED FOUND IN 1947. HE HAS BEEN ASSOCIATE PROFESSOR OF TEHRAN MEDICAL SCHOOL SINCE 1962. AS DEPUTY LEADER OF PAN-IRANIST PARTY, HE WAS ELECTED TO 22ND MAJILS (1967-71). FROM 1971 TO 1975 HE SERVED AS DIRECTOR OF MINISTRY OF INFORMATION'S SCHOOL OF TOURISM SERVICES. HE JOINED NEW RESURGENCE PARTY. IN FEB. 1975 AND WAS ELECTED IN THAT YEAR TO 24TH MAJLIS. WITHIN THE PARTY HE HEADED POLITICAL EDUCAL ON COMMITTEE, THEN SERVED AS PARTY SECRETARY IN THE CENTRAL PROVINCE.

HE WAS DEPUTY SECRETARY GENERAL WHEN HE RESIGNED JULY 1978 REPORTEDLY TO JOIN HIS OLD PAN-IRANIST COLLEAGUES WHO REFORMED THE PARTY AS A NEW OPPOSITION GROUP. AMELITEHRAN IS MARRIED AND HAS FOUR CHILDREN. HE SPEAKS ENGLISH.

JAHANGIR MAHDMINA-MINISTER OF ENERGY. MAHDMINA GRADUATED FROM POLYTECHNIC COLLEGE. HE IS A FORMER DEPUTY MINISTER AND HAS ALSO SERVED AS CHIEF OF TEHRAN POWER BOARD AND DIRECTOR OF TAVANIR (POWER GENERATION AND TRANSMISSION COMPANY OF IRAN). EMB WILL SUPPLEMENT SKETCHY INFORMATION LATER.

HASSAN SHALCHIAN--MINISTER OF ROADS AND TRANSPORTATION. BORN 1910 SHALCHIAN EARNED CIVIL ENGINEERING DEGREE FROM STATE UNIVERSITY OF BELGIUM IN LIEGE. HIS CAREER HAS BEEN DEVOTED TO SERVICE IN MINISTRY OF ROADS. HE WAS PLAN ORGANIZATION PROJECT DIRECTOR IN THE MINISTRY. AS TEACHER IN RAILWAY SCHOOL, HE TOUGHT NASRATOLLAH MOINIAN (PRESENTLY CHIEF OF SHAH'S SPECIAL BUREAU). WHEN MOINIAN BECAME MINISTER OF ROADS, HE MADE SHALCHIAN HIS DEPUTY. SHALCHIAN BECAME MINISTER OF ROADS OIN OCT. 1963; HE SERVED ONLY 4 MONTHS AT THAT TIME, BUT RETRUNED IN DEC. 1964 AS MINISER OF ROADS.

HE HAS BEEN ACCUSED OFHEAVY INVOLVEMENT IN CORRUPTION, IN PARTICULAR, THAT HE PREVENTED THE COURTS FROM OBTAINING FILES RELATING TO HIS PREDECESSOR MOINIAN'S ACTIVITIES. CLEARLY EXPERIENCED IN TRANSPORTATION MATTERS, SHALCHIAN IS NOT SCONSIDERED AN INNOVATOR. HE IS SOMEWHAT OLD-FASHIONED IN HIS ENGINEERING IDEAS. HE IS DIVORCED. HE SPEAKS ENGLISH AND FRENCH, BUT PREFERS FRENCH. ------------------123362 061715Z /46 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 195 DIA WASHDC CIA WASHDC USICA WASHDC INFO AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMEBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MUSCAT SECTION 3 OF 4 TEHRAN 8418

ALI NAQI KANI---MINISTER OF ENDOWMENTS. BORN 1926 IN TEHRAN, KANI IS SON OF MULLAH. HE GRADUATED IN PHYSICS, LAW, JUSTICE AND POLITICAL SCIENCE FROM TEHRAN UNIVERSITY. HE EARNED PH.D. IN LAW IN SWITZERLAND AND ENGLAND. A FRIEND OF ASADOLLAH ALAM, HE BEGAN CAREER IN MIN. OF JUSTICE, THEN MOVED TO PM'S OFFICE 1962 WHERE HE HEADED SECRETARIAT. IN 1963 HE BECAME DEPTUY MIN. OF STATE IN ALAM'S SECOND CABINET. HE SERVED AS DIRECTOR GENERAL OF REZA PAHLAVI CULTURAL FOUNDATION. KANI WAS SECRETARY-GENERAL OF OFFICIAL OPPOSITION MARDOM PARTY MAY 1971-JULY 1972.

HAVING TAKEN OPPOSITION ROLE SERIOUSLY, HE RESIGNED AFTER HIS CRITICISM OF RULING NOVIN PARTY BROUGHT ACCUSATIONS THAT HE WAS TOO RADICAL. HIS STRNG OUTBURSTS AGAINST GOVERNMENT, WHICH REPRESENTED A NEW DEPARTURE FOR THE MARDOM PARTY, BROUGHT REACTION AMOUNG THE CONSERVATIVE MARDOM MEMBERS AS WELL AS IRAN NOVIN PARTY. UNCONFIRMED RUMORS INDICATED SHAH ORDERED HIM TO RESIGN. KANI GIVES IMPRESSION OF ONE USED TO EASY LIVING. HE IS MARRIED, BUT HE SAID 1971 HE HAD AVOIDED HAVING CHILDREN BECAUSE HIS CAREER OBLIGATIONS WERE SO HEAVY. HE CONSIDERS HIMSELF AN INTELLECTUAL OF GREAT STATURE AND PREFERS TO BE CALLED DR. HE SPEAKS ENGLISH AND FLUENT FRENCH.

MANUCHEHR AZMOUN-MINISTER OF STATE FOR EXECUTIVE AFFAIRS: BORN 1930, HE IS GRANDSON OF RELIGIOUS LEADER SHEIKH NOURI. HE ATTENDED UNIVERSITIES IN LEIPZIG, COLOGNE, AND TUBINGEN. HE HOLDS DOCTORATE IN ECONOMICS FROM TUBINGEN. HE BEGAN GOVERNMENT SERVICE OF STAFF OF PRIME MINISTER'S OFFICE. IN 1967 HE WAS NAMED DEPUTY DIRECTOR OF IRAN NATIONAL TELEVISION. FOLLOWING YEAR HE BECAME CHIEF OF PARS NEWS AGENCY. HE SERVED AS UNDERSECY IN MIN OF INFORMATION 1969-71. HE BECAME UNDERSECY OF MIN OF INTERIOR MAY 1971, BUT LEFT IN SEPT TO HEAD ENDOWMENT ORGANIZATION. AZMOUN WAS ELECTED TO 24TH MAJLIS IN 1975. HE JOINED CABINET AS MINISTER OF LABOR AND SOCIAL WELFARE IN NOV 1976.

IN AUG 1977 HE BECAME GOVERNOR-GENERAL OF FARS. AZMOUN IS FORMER TUDEH PARTY MEMBER WHO WAS RECRUITED BY SAVAK CHIEF BAKHTIAR. HE WORKED AMONG STUDENTS, DISCOURAGING OPPOSITION TO SHAH. IT IS NOT KNOWN WHETHER HIS CONNECTION WITH SAVAK CONTINUES. HE WANTS TO BE KNOWN AS GOOD MUSLIM. AS CHIEF OF ENDOWMENT ORGANIZATION HE INITIATED TIGHT GOI CONTROL OF HAJ FLIGHTS TO MECCA. AS GOVERNOR-GENERAL OF FARS, HE SOUGHT CLERICAL FAVOR BY INSISTING OFFICIALS AVOID PUBLIC FLOUTING OF ISLAMIC LAWS, SUCH AS USING ALCOHOL. HIS WHOLESALE DISMISSALS OF PROVINCIAL OFFICIALS, INCLUDING POPULAR SHIRAZ MAYOR MOVAHEDI, COUPLED WITH GENERALLY IMPERIOUS ATTITUDE, CAUSED MUCH DISCONTENT.
HE EMPHASIZED HE WAS PERSONAL REPRESENTATIVE OF SHAHANSHAH AND COULD OD AS HE PLEASED. HE SPEAKS ENGLISH AND GERMAN.

MOHAMMAD REZA VISHKAI-MINISTER OF COMMERCE: BORN 1918, HE GRADUATED IN SCIENCE AND PHILOSOPHY FROM TEHRAN UNIVERSITY. VISHKAI BEGAN A LONG CAREER IN MINISTRY OF FINANCE IN 1940, RISING TO PERMANENT DEPUTY MINISTER. HE ALSO SERVED AS INSPECTOR OF NATIONAL BANK, DIRECTOR GENERAL OF BUDGET, AND DIRECTOR GENERAL OF PERSONNEL. HE IS KNOWN AS AN ORGANIZATION MAN WITH THOROUGH GRASP OF EXISTING SYSTEM. HE IS EXPECTED TO USE THE SYSTEM RATHER THAN MAKE SIGNIFICANT CHANGES. HE IS NOT MUCH INTERESTED IN INTERNATIONAL TRADE, AND WILL PROBABLY LEAVE THAT AREA TO HIS DEPUTY. VISHKAI IS MARRIED TO A SISTER OF PM SHARIF-EMAMI. HE SPEAKS FRENCH AND ENGLISH.

EZZATOLLAH YAZDANPANAH--MINISTER OF STATE FOR PARLIAMENTARY AFFAIRS. BORN 1920 IN NUR (MAZABDARAN), HE EARNED LAW DEGREE FROM TEHRAN UNIVERSITY AND DOCTORATE IN LAW FROM UNIVERSITY OF PARIS. YAZDANPANAH ENTERED GOVERNMENT SERVICE IN 1941 IN FOREIGN EXCHANGE CONTROL COMMISSION AND ULTIMATELY BECAME A DIRECTOR. HE JOINED PROGRESSIVE CENTER FOUNDED BY MANSUR IN 1961. LATER HE WAS FOUNDER OF IRAN NOVIN PARTY. HE WAS ELECTED TO 21ST THROUGH 23RD MAJLIS' ON IRAN NOVIN TICKET ALSO SERVING AS DEPUTY SECRETARY-GENERAL OFTHE PARTY. IN APRIL 1974 HE ENTERED CABINET AS MINISTER OF STATE AND PARLIAMENTARY DEPUTY, THE POST HE NOW HOLDS AGAIN.

HE RESIGNED MAY 1975 AND ENTERED SENATE, WHERE HE WORKED WITH THEN-SENATOR SHARIF-EMAMI. HE IS MARRIED, AND SPEAKS ENGLISH AND FRENCH. ------------------124210 061713Z /41 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 196 DIA WASHDC CIA WASHDC USICA WASHDC INFO AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMEBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MUSCAT SECTION 4 OF 4 TEHRAN 8418

MOHAMMAD BAHERI--MINISTER OF JUSTICE: BORN 1916 IN SHIRAZ, HE GRADUATED IN LAW AND RELIGIOUS SCIENCES FROM TEHRAN 1941, AND RECEIVED DOCTORATE IN LAW FROM INSTITUTTE OF INTERNATIONAL LAW AND POLITICAL SCIENCE, PARIS (1954). BAHERI CONDUCTED LEGAL PRACTICE IN IRAN, USING ALAM'S BACKING TO BECOME LECTURER (1957) AND PROFESSOR AT LAW COLLEGE, TEHRAN UNIVERSITY. HE BECAME DEPUTY PM IN FIRST ALAM KABINET (1962), THEN MINISTER OF JUSTICE IN ALAM'S SECOND CABINET (1963). HE HAS SERVED SINCE NOV 1966 AS DEPUTY MINISTER OF THE IMPERIAL COURT. HE WAS A TUDEH PARTY MEMBER IN MID-1949S BUT BROKE WITH PARTY, REPORTEDLY USING PARTY FUNDS TO FINANCE HIS DOCTORAL PROGRAM IN FRANCE. A CLOSE FRIEND OF ASADOLLAH ALAM, HE HELPED FOUND MARDOM PARTY. HE LEFT WHEN ALAM RESIGNED PARTY LEADERSHIP. HE HAS WRITTEN, AMONG OTHER WORKS, POPULAR BOOK ON PENAL LAW. SINCE AMOUZEGAR REPLACED HIM AS PARTY CHIEF IN JANUARY, HE HAS CLUNG TO HIS COURT POSITION AND STAYED OUT OF THE POLITICAL ARENA. BAHERI IS MARRIED AND HAS TRHEE CHILDREN. HE SPEAKS FRENCH AND ENGLISH.

KAZEM VADI'I - MINISTER OF LABOR AND SOCIAL WELFARE: BORN 1928 IN SHIRAZ, VADI'I GRADUATED IN HISTORY, GEOGRAPHY, AND PEDAGOGY FROM TEHRAN UNIVERSITY. HE RECEIVED PH.D. IN GEOGRAPHY FROM UNIVERSITY OF PARIS. NEARLY HIS ENTIRE PROFESSIONAL LIFE HAS BEEN SPENT IN EDUCATIONAL AFFAIRS. HE WAS TEACHER IN AHWAZ AND QAZVIN, ACTING PRINCIPAL OF RUDAKI SCHOOL, TEHRAN AND PRINCIPAL OF MOHAMMAN QAZVINI SCHOOL, TEHRAN. HE THEN WORKED AS LECTURER AT TABRIZ UNIVERSITY AND PROFESSOR AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY. HIS ONLY PRIVIOUS HIGH GOVERNMENT SERVICE WAS ALSO IN ACADEMIC FIELD AS UNDERSECRETARY FOR EDUCATIONAL AFFAIRS. VADI'I HAS RECENTLY BEEN ASSOCIATED WITH GROUP FOR STUDY OF IRANIAN PROBLEMS, NEW THIRD WING OF RPPI.

VADI'I'S MOST IMPORTANT QUALIFICATION FOR NEW POST IS HIS FRINEDSHIP WITH HUGHANG NAHAVANDI, MINISTER OF SCIENCE AND HIGHER EDUCATION. NAHAVANDI IS REPORTEDLY RESPONSIBLE FOR HIS APPOINTMENT. HE SPEAKS FRENCH.

MOHSEN FOROUGHI-MINISTER OF ARTS AND CULTURE: BORN 1913, FOROUGHI IS SON OF ZAKAL-MULK FOROUGHI, FORMER PM (1925, 1933, AND 1941) AND A FAMOUS WRITER AND PHILOSOPHER. HE STUDIES BUILDING ENGINEERING IN WESTERN EUROPE AND BECAME WELL-KNOWN ARCHITECT. HE WAS ELECTED TO 19TH MAJLIS, 1956. HE ALSO SERVED AS DEAN OF FACULTY OF FINE ART, TEHRAN UNIVERSITY, BEFORE HIS APPOINTMENT AS SENATOR IN 5TH SENATE. HE HAS CONTINUED TO SERVE IN 6TH AND 7TH SENATES. A MEMBER OF HIGH COUNCEL OF CULTURE AND ART, AND ACADEMY OF LITERATURE AND ART, FOROUGHI IS ONE OF FOREMOST COLLECTORS OF IRANIAN ARTIFACTS. HE IS A FORMER CHAIRMAN OF THE BOARD OF THE IRAN-AMERICAN SOCIETY.
HE SPEAKS FRENCH AND ENGLISH.

AMIR KHOSROW AFSHAR-QASEMLU - MINISTER OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS: BORN 1914, AFSHAR-QASEMLU GRADUATED IN ECONOMICS AND SOCIAL SCIENCES FROM UNIVERSITY OF GENEVA. A CAREER DIPLOMAT, HE JOINED FOREING SERVICE IN 1941. HIS POSTS INCLUDE: FIRST SECRETARY IN WASHINGTON 1946, IRANIAN DELEGATE TO UNITED NATIONS, 1947; COUNSELOR IN WASHINGTON, 1950; HEAD OF THIRD POLITICAL DEPARTMENT, 1951; INSPECTOR, 1952; HEAD OF FOURTH POLITICAL DEPARTMENT (AMERICAN AFFAIRS), 1953; MINISTER IN LONDON, 1957 AND DIRECTORGENERAL FOR POLITICAL AFFAIRS, 1959. HE HAS SERVED AS AMBASSADOR IN BONN, PARIS, AND LONDON, AND AS DEP FONMIN. AFSHAR-QASEMLU IS USUALLY WELL-BRIEFED AND IS CONSIDERED VERY BRIGHT.

HE IS COURTEOUS AND PLEASANT WHEN SEEKING HELP, BUT HE CAN BE VERY TOUGH, EVEN ARROGANT ON OTHER OCCASIONS. AFSHAR-QASEMLU WAS NOTICED EARLY ON AS RISING STAR IN MFA. SYMPATHETIC TO THE WEST, HE IS NONETHELESS TOTALLY PREFESSIONAL AND WILL TOE WHATEVER LINE DECREES. OUR INITIAL IMPRESSION IS THAT DESPITE HIS BACKGROUND, HE IS NOT A HEAVY WEIGHT AND ENJOYS THE FULL CONFIDENCE OF NEITHER THE SHAH NOR THE PRIME MINISTER. A BIT PRISSY, HE SPEAKS FRENCH AND EXCELLENT ENGLISH. HIS WIFE ALSO SPEAKS GOOD ENGLISH.

TEHRAN IS AWASH WITH RUMORS THAT COURT MINISTER HOVEYDA WILL SOON BECOME NEXT VICTIM OF CURRENT ISLAMIC UNREST. ALTHOUGH HOVEYDA HIMSELF PROFESSES TO BE FAITHFUL MUSLIM AND HAS RECENTLY BEEN CONSPICUOUSLY SEEN AT PRAYERS WHERE HE RECITES KORAN IN FLUENT ARABIC, HE IS TAINTED BY FACT THAT HIS FATHER WAS ACTIVE IN BAHAI SECT. HE IS THEREFORE ALLEGEDLY A TARGET OF SEVERAL ORTHODOX MULLAHS, ACCORDING TO SEVERAL OF MY ARAB DIPLOMATIC COLLEAGUES, WHO CLAIM FIRST-HAND INFORMATION FROM THE MULLAHS THEMSELVES.

MOST CREDIBLE VERIFICATION OF THESE RUMORS CAME SEPT 5 FROM HOUSHANG RAM, PRESIDENT OF BANK OMRAN AND CONFIDANT OF SHAH, WHO CAME TO SEE ME TO SHARE HIS WORRIES ABOUT CURRENT STATE OF AFFAIRS. ACCORDING TO HIM, BOTH HOVEYDA AND GENERAL KHADEMI OF IRAN AIR (A REPUTED BAHAI) ARE SCHEDULED FOR THE AXE.

ADDITIONAL FILLIP IS GIVEN TO THESE STORIES BY ARRIVAL IN TEHRAN OF ARDESHIR ZAHEDI, WHO HAS LONG SAID HE WOULD LEAVE HIS POST AS AMBASSADOR TO WASHINGTON IN ORDER TO TAKE HOVEYDA'S PLACE AS COURT MINISTER. ONE OF MOST KNOWLEDGEABLE JOURNALISTS IN TOWN, WHO HAS APPOINTMENT WITH ZAHEDI EVENING SEPT 5, IS PUBLICLY ACCEPTING WAGERS THAT LATTER WILL REPLACE HOVEYDA BEFORE THE WEEK IS OUT.

1978TEHRAN08452.subject: ID-E-FETR DEMONSTRATIONS SUMMARY: PAST WEEKEND SAW SOME VIOLENCE, BUT MASSIVE PEACEFUL RALLIES IN TEHRAN AND SHIRAZ WERE MAJOR FEATURE OF

segments.text: SUMMARY: PAST WEEKEND SAW SOME VIOLENCE, BUT MASSIVE PEACEFUL RALLIES IN TEHRAN AND SHIRAZ WERE MAJOR FEATURE OF WEEKEND. POLICE AND ARMY WERE PLENTIFUL BUT THERE WERE NO CLASHES AND CROWDS EVEN DRAPED FLOWER GARLANDS AROUND SOME SECURITY FORCES. RELIGIOUS LEADERS CALLED FOR PEACE AND NO RPT NO BLOODSHED. WORKERS STRIKES HAVE TAKEN PLACE. DESPITE OPPOSITION HARD LINE ON COMPROMISE WITH GOVERNMENT, RECENT EVENTS SUGGEST POSSIBLE LESSENING OF VIOLENT SYNDROME OF PAST FEW WEEKS. OPPOSITION CALLS FOR SHOP CLOSING SEPT. 7. END SUMMARY.

SEPT 4 ID-E-FETR (END OF RAMAZAN) CELEBRATIONS IN TEHRAN INCLUDED SEVERAL LARGE RALLIES AND PARADES (FEATURED IN LOCAL PRESS AS "PEACE MARCH") WHICH WERE CONDUCTED PEACEFULLY UNDER WATCHFUL EYE OF POLICE AND ARMY TROOPS. MARCHERS DISRUPTED TRAFFIC ON MAIN ARTERIES ALL OVER CITY AT VARIOUS TIMES DURING THE DAY, BUT THERE WERE NO VIOLENT INCIDENTS, AND ONE GROUP EVEN PLACED GARLANDS AROUND POLICE AND ARMY UNITS. MAJOR MARCH, FROM SHEMIRAN IN NORTH TO SOUTH TEHRAN'S SHOUSH SQUARE HAD BETWEEN 100,000 AND A MILLION MARCHERS ACCORDING TO LOCAL PRESS, BUT TRAINED EUROPEAN EYEWITNESS SAID CROWD WAS MUCH LESS AND PUT MAXIMUM NUMBER AT 50,000.

OTHER RALLIES MAY HAVE PRODUCED TOTAL IN RANGE GIVEN BY PRESS. ONE LOCAL OBSERVER NOTED RELIGIOUS LEADERS WERE MAKING MAXIMUM EFFORT TO GET PEOPLE INTO STREETS AND EXPERIENCED AMERICAN REPORTER SAID MARCHERS ON OLD SHEMIRAN ROAD WERE WELL-ORGANIZED WITH PARADE MONITORS AND UNIT LEADERS.

IN ADDITION TO FOUR MAJOR RALLIES, SEVERAL SMALLER ONES WERE CENTERED AROUND VARIOUS MOSQUES IN ALL AREAS OF THE CITY. PRESS SUGGESTED THAT ARMY AND POLICE "BECAME TENSE" AT SOMEOF THE SLOGANS, BUT DID NOT PUBLISH ANY EXCEPT "BRING BACK KHOMEINI", AND "WHY DO GOVERNMENT TROOPS KILL OUR PEOPLE?" EMBASSY SOURCES NOTE THAT MORE INFLAMATORY "DEATH TO THE SHAH" SLOGAN WAS SHOUTED IN SEVERAL CASES.

ELSEWHERE IN IRAN, DEMONSTRATTIONS WERE PEACEFUL IN SHIRAZ, BUT FAMILIAR PATTERN OF VIOLENCE REPEATED ITSELF ELSEWHERE. EIGHT PEOPLE WERE KILLED, INCLUDING TWO POLICEMEN, AND BETWEEN 50 AND 100 WERE INJURED. IN ELAM, THREE PROTESTERS AND TWO POLICEMENWERE REPORTED KILLED WHEN A PEACEFUL DEMONSTRATION TURNED VIOLENT. TWO OTHER DEATHS OCCURRED IN KARAJ, AND IN QOM, 30 WERE REPORTED INJURED AND ONE KILLED WHEN VIOLENCE OVERTOOK FRINGE CROWD WHICH BROKE AWAY FROM LARGE DEMONSTRATION TO ATTACK STORES. DEMONSTRATORS IN AHWAZ SET TWO BANKS AFIRE.

RELIGIOUS LEADERS HAD CALLED FOR PEACFUL DEMONSTRATIONS AND "NO BLOODSHED". MANY MULLAHS IN TEHRAN AREA WERE WORKING TO KEEP CROWDS PEACEFUL, BUT EMBASSY SOURCES INDICATE SOME MULLAHS CONTINUED TO PURSUE KHOMEINI'S VERY HARD LINE CONFRONTATIONAL POSITION.

EMBASSY HAS HAD REPORTS IN PAST FEW DAYS OF THREE LABOR "STRIKES" ALTHOUGH NONE HAVE AS YET DEVELOPED POLITICAL OVERTONES, THEY ARE EVIDENCE OF MORE OPEN ATMOSPHERE AND WERE COVERED BY PRESS. FIRST WAS STRIKE OF WORKERS IN TRANSFORMER PLANT NEAR TEHRAN, REPORTEDLY OVER WORKING CONDITIONS AND SALARIES. SECOND WAS STRIKE OF QOM TRANSPORT WORKERS PROTESTING LOW PAY, EXTENDED WORKING HOURS AND "UNORDERLY CONDITIONS" OF THE MEDICAL INSURANCE PLAN.

WORKERS COMPLAINED TO PRESS THAT HOUSING COSTS WERE TOO HIGH, ANDLABOR MINISTRY HAS MISCLASSIFIED JOBS ------------------115798 051447Z /43 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 172 DIA WASHDC CIA WASHDC USICA WASHDC USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE INFO AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY LONDON USINT BAGHDAD SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 8452 RESULTING IN LOW WAGES. THIRD LABOR DISPUTE INVOLVED ONEHOUR WORK STOPPAGE BY CENTRAL BANK EMPLOYEES TO DEMAND 15 PER CENT SALARY INCREASE. SEPT. 5 PRESS ACCOUNT OF STRIKE SAYS ACTION WILL CONTINUE "INDEFINITELY" UNTIL THEIR DEMANDS ARE MET.

(COMMENT: WE UNDERSTAND CENTRAL BANK RAISES OF 9 PER CENT WERE APPROVED LAST YEAR, BUT BANK MANAGEMENT DIDN'T FEEL IT WAS ENOUGH, AND DIDN'T WANT TO JEOPARDIZE CHANCE FOR BETTER ADJUSTMENT SO IT DID NOT IMPLEMENT RAISES. IMPLICATIONS OF STRIKE NOT YET CLEAR.)

OPPOSITION VIEWS BEING REPORTED SEPTEL, BUT GENERAL THRUST THUS FAR IS UNCOMPROMISING LINE AGAINST NEGOTIATIONS WITH GOI. DESPITE THIS, VAST MAJORITY OF RELIGIOUS LEADERS AND OPPOSITION POLITICIANS HAVE ARGUED AGAINST VIOLENCE. WITH EXCEPTION OF SOME OUTSPOKEN KHOMEIN FIGURES AND PERHAPS THOSE WHO DO NOT WISH VIOLENCE TO SUBSIDE; THRUST OF PUBLICE STATEMENTS IS TO CHANNEL POLITICAL ACTION TOWARD LESS VICIOUS VENUES. PRESS REPORTS OPPOSITIONIST CALL FOR GENERAL STRIKE SEPT. 7, BUT MEDIA SOURCE WHO HAS TALKED WITH BOTH RELIGIOUS AND SECULAR OPPOSITIONISTS TELLS US "GENERAL STRIKE" MERELY MEANS CLOSING OF ALL SHOPS AND TEHRAN BAZAAR; PEOPLE ARE SUPPOSED TO REMAIN QUIETLY AT HOME.

COMMENT: ALTHOUGH OPPOSITION LANGUAGE STILL FLINTY (AND THIS HAS RAISED QUESTIONS OF SINCERITY AND POLITICAL COMPETENCE IN SOME GOI CIRCLES), DYNAMICS OF SITUATION SUGGEST VIOLENT CYCLE OF PAST SEVERAL WEEKS MAY BE EASING. PRESENTATION OF EFFECTIVE GOI PROGRAM TO PARLIAMENT BY PRIME MINISTER ALSO SCHEDULED FOR SEPT. 7 COULD PUSH PROCESS ALONG. WE UNDERSTAND CABINET EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE HAS BEEN MEETING INCESSANTLY DURING PAST FEW DAYS TO HAMMER OUT PROGRAM DESIGNED "TO PUT IRAN ON RIGHT TRACK", IN WORDS OF PM'S SPECIAL ASSISTANT. ONE NEW ITEM IN RALLIES OF PAST TWO DAYS IS APPEAL BY DEMONSTRATORS TO SECURITY POLICE IN EFFORT TO SOFTEN THEIR ATTITUDES TOWARD DEMONSTRATORS.
IF THIS CONTINUES, IT MIGHT IN TIME EFFECT READINESS OF SOME UNITS TO TAKE FORCEFUL ACTION AGAINST DEMONSTRATORS UNDER CERTAIN CIRCUMSTANCES.

1978TEHRAN08473.subject: CONGRESSIONAL INQUIRY: ISFAHAN AND SHIRAZ DEMONSTRATIONS

segments.text: TEHRAN 7618, F. TEHRAN 7659, G. TEHRAN 7779, H. TEHRAN 8013 STATE 220088

REFTELS GIVE RUNNING ACCOUNT OF UNFOLDING EVENTS IN SHIRAZ AND ISFAHAN WHICH MAY BE DRAWN ON TO ANSWER FRASER QUESTIONS REF I. BELOW IS ADDITIONAL INFORMATION FROM U.S. CONSULS IN SHIRAZ AND ISFAHAN SPECIFICALLY RELATING TO FRASER QUESTIONS.

ISFAHAN: CONGRESSMAN FRASER'S INFORMATION REGARDING DEMONSTRATION IN ISFAHAN ON AUG 13 IS INCORRECT. MARTIAL LAW WAS IMPOSED ON ISFAHAN ON AUG. 11 (REFS. D AND E) AND ONLY INCIDENT KNOWN IN ISFAHAN ON AUG. 13 WAS BURNING OF A RESTAURANT, WHICH MAY HAVE BEEN ACCIDENTIAL. THIS OCCURRED DURING MARTIAL LAW CURFEW HOURS.

ISFAHAN DID HAVE PERIOD OF MAJOR UNREST, WITH DAILY DEMONSTRATIONS AND CONFRONTATIONS BETWEEN POLICE AND CROWDS, COMMENCING ON AUG. 1 AND CONTINUING THROUGH AUG. 11. DURING THIS PERIOD, THERE WAS MASSIVE PROPERTY DAMAGE, ESPECIALLY TO BANKS, MOVIE THEATRES, LIQUOR STORES, RESTAURANTS AND HOTELS, AND SOME INJURIES FROM FIRE, AND PROJECTILES. THERE ARE UNCONFIRMED REPORTS THAT SOME DEMONSTRATORS WERE KILLED OR INJURED IN CONFRONTATIONS WITH POLICE. EVENING OF AUG. 10/11 THESE DEMONSTRATIONS REACHED A PEAK, WITH MANY MAJOR STREERS BLOCKED AND AT LEAST TWELVE ARSON CASES. POLICE, WITH TROOPS, AND VIOLENT CONFRONTATION WITH THE MOBS.

OFFICIAL REPORTS INDICATE FOUR DEMONSTRATORS WERE KILLED AND SEVEN WOUNDED WHILE 45 POLICEMEN AND 14 FIREMEN WERE ALSO INJURED. AT 3:00 P.M. AUG. 11, MARTIAL LAW WAS DECLARED WITH A CURFEW FROM 8:00 P.M. TO 6:00 A.M. (10 HOURS). SINCE THAT TIME ARMY TROOPS HAVE MAINTAINED CONTROL IN THE CITY AND THERE HAVE BEEN NO FURTHER DEMONSTRATIONS. THE CURFEW HAS BEEN REDUCED TO 10:00 P.M. TO 5:00 A.M. (7 HOURS).

THERE ARE RUMORS THAT NUMBER OF DEAD AND INJURED MAY HAVE BEEN SOMEWHAT HIGHER THAN ANNOUNCED. SINCE SOME FAMILIES FEARED LEGAL CONSEQUENCES OF ADMITTING PARTICIPATIONS IN RIOTS, THEY MAY HAVE TREATED INJURED PERSONS AT HOME, AND POSSIBLY HAD PRIVATE BURIALS OF THE DEAD. WHILE THIS APPEARS PROBABLE, IT IS IMPOSSIBLE TO VERIFY IN TERMS OF EXAXT NUMBERS. NO AMERICANS HAVE BEEN INJURED IN ANY OF THE DEMONSTRATIONS OR INCIDENTS TO THE PRESENT.

WITH RESPECT TO SHIRAZ, THERE WAS NO DEMONSTRATION AUG. 12, BUT ON AUG. 10 THERE WAS SUBSTANTIAL RIOTING WHEN A CROWD EXITED FROM A MOSQUE AFTER VIOLENT HARANGUE (REF 3) AND BEGAN BREAKING WINDOWS AND ENGAGING IN OTHER VIOLENT ACTIVITY. POLICE AND ARMY REACTED FIRMLY AND SWIFTLY TO RESTORE ORDER. GOI ANNOUNCED AT TIME, THREE OR FOUR HAD BEEN KILLED AND MANY INJURED. LOCAL OFFICIALS TOLD CONSUL SEPT. 4 THAT ADDITIONAL THREE OR FOUR HAD DIED. SUBSEQUENTLY, BRINGING TOTAL TO SEVEN OR EIGHT DEAD. CHECK WITH LOCAL HOSPITALS CONFIRMS THOSE INJURED SERIOUSLY ENOUGH TO REQUIRE AT LEAST MINOR TREATMENT WERE NOT MORE THAN 70-80.

LOCAL HEALTH AND BLOODBANK OFFICLAS CATEGORICALLY DENIED FRASER RUMORS ON REFUSAL OF TREATMENT AND TRANSFUSIONS. CONSUL NOTES RUMOR MAY HAVE STARTED BECUASE BLOOD BANK IS TRADITIONALLY SHORT DURING RAMAZAN, WHEN MOSLEMS WILL NOT GIVE BLOOD. TREATMENT WAS NOT RPT NOT REFUSED AT HOSPITALS AND CLINICS, BUT SOME MAY NOT HAVE WISHED TO ATTEND FOR FEAR THEY WOULD BE ASSOCIATED WITH OUTBREAK OF CIVIL VIOLENCE.

APPRECIATE FRASER'S BRINGING THESE STORIES TO OUR ATTENTION. FIGURES HE CITES FOR WOUNDED IN SHIRAZ AND UNSAVORY RUMORS ABOUT TREATMENT AND TRANSFUSION ARE SIMILAR TO EXAGGERATIONS PASSED AROUND BY OPPOSITIONIST FIGURES AFTER MOST MAJOR OUTBREAKS HERE, THEY HAVE NO BASIS IN FACT, BASED ON CONSUL'S CHECK WITH LOCAL OFFICIAL AND PRIVATE SOURCES.

EMBASSY POUCHING ISFAHAN AIRGRAM A-009 THIS WEEK WHICH CONTAINS GOOD REVUIEW OF MARTIAL LAW PROCESS IN ISFAHAN WHICH HE MAY WISH TO REVIEW. THAT PLUS ISFAHAN'S EARLIER A-007, WHICH SHOULD NOW BE IN DEPARTMENT, GIVE EXCELLENT SUMMARY OF ISFAHAN EVENTS WHICH DEPT. MAY WISH TO USE IN CONFIDENTIAL BRIEFING FOR CONGRESSMAN FRASER OR HIS STAFF.

1978TEHRAN08485.subject: OPPOSITION PROGRAMS AND PRONOUNCEMENTS, GOI POST- PONES ANNOUNCEMENT OF OWN PROGRAM SUMMARY: RELIGIOUS AND SECULAR OPPOSITION LEADERS

segments.text: PONES ANNOUNCEMENT OF OWN PROGRAM SUMMARY: RELIGIOUS AND SECULAR OPPOSITION LEADERS CONTINUE TO REJECT COMPROMISE OR NEGOTIATION WITH NEW GOVERNMENT, BUT OPENLY CONDEMN VIOLENCE AND CALL FOR PEACEFUL POLITICAL ACTION. SHARIATMADARI, REPORTEDLY ASSUMING TITLE OF "ERJAH" OR SUPREME SHIITE LEADER, DECLARED RELIGIOUS MOVEMENT BELONGS TO NO PARTICULAR PARTY. HE AND OTHERS DENIED OPPOSITION IS AGAINST RELIGIOUS MINORITIES (EXCEPT FOR BAHAIS). SHARIATMADARI SAID HE WILL GIVE GOVERNMENT REASONABLE TIME TO MEET DEMANDS, BUT MANY CAN BE MET IMMEDIATELY. SEVERAL OPPOSITIONISTS, INCLUDING NATIONAL FRONT, SAY THEY WILL BOYCOTT ELECTIONS IF HELD UNDER EXISTING LAW. NATIONAL FRONT LEADER SAID COMMUNIST PARTY SHOULD BE LEGALIZED.

NEW VERSION OF OLD SOCIALIST SOCIETY OF FREE MUSLIMS ANNOUNCED RETURN TO POLITICAL ARENA. MORE RELIGIOUS LEADERS HAVE RETURNED FROM EXILE. GOI HAS POSTPONED PRESENTING ITS PROGRAM TO PARLIAMENT UNTIL SEPT. 10. END SUMMARY.

OPPOSITION LEADERS HAVE REPEATED IN SPEECHES AND INTERVIEWS THAT THEY WILL NOT NEGOTIATE OR COMPROMISE WITH NEW SHARIF-EMAMI GOVERNMENT. AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI REITERATED IT IS UP TO GOVERNMENT TO MEET DEMANDS OF THE PEOPLE. INITIAL REPORTS THAT HE GAVE GOVERNMENT TIME LIMIT OF THREE MONTHS WERE DENIED BY SPOKESMAN. SSHARIATMADARI DID SAY THAT AS GOVERNMENT ALTERED CALENDAR OVERNIGHT BY DECREE, IT COULD MEET OTHER DEMANDS, SUCH AS FREEING POLITICAL PRISONERS. RELIGIOUS DEMANDS WERE CLEARLY STATED IN COMMUNIQUE FROM AYATOLLAH SEYED ABDOLLAH SHIRAZI OF MASHAD.

SHIRAZI DEMANDED: (A) ALL LAWS VIOLATING KORAN MUST BE ABOLISHED; (B) ALL EXILED MUSLIM LEADERS, ESPECIALLY KHOMEINI, MUST BE ALLOWED TO RETURN; (C) PUNISHMENT FOR THOSE RESPONSIBLE FOR RECENT VIOLENCE; (D) LESSENING OF FINANCIAL BURDEN ON THE PEOPLE, EXPECIALLY TAXES; (E) COORDINATION OF CULTURAL POLICIES IN ACCORDANCE WITH TENETS OF ISLAM; (F) CABINET MINISTERS MUST BE SHIITE MUSLIMS; AND (G) DISMISSAL OF ALL BAHAIS FROM GOVERNMENT SERVICE.

QUESTION OF RELIGIOUS MINORITIES HAS BECOME A SORE POINT, AND ITEMS (F) AND (G) ARE NOT LIKELY TO SOOTHE MATTERS. SHARIATMADARI TOOK PAINS TO EMPHASIZE OPPOSITION MOVEMENT IS NOT AGAINST JEWS, CHRISTIANS, OR ZOROASTRIANS. MEMBERS OF THESE GROUPS HAVE REPORTED RECEIVING THREATENING LETTERS. WHILE ASSURING THE OFFICIALLY RECOGNIZED MINORITIES THAT THEY WOULD BE PROTECTED, SHARIATMADARI POINTEDLY EXCLUDED BAHAI COMMUNITY, WHICH HAS "ACTED AGAINST IRAN'S INTERESTS AND IN COMPLICITY WITH FOREIGN GOVERNMENTS IN THE PAST."

SHARIATMADARI REEMPHASIZED THERE IS NO DIVISION AMONG SHIITE LEADERS. HE AND KHOMEINI, WHO SHOULD RETURN TO IRAN, CAN COOPERATE FULLY. (COMMENT: THIS REMAINS PUBLIC LINE, BUT IN OTHER CONTACTS SHARIATMADARI IS MUCH MORE CAUTIOUS AND LEAVES ROOM FOR EVENTUAL DIFFERENCES OF OPINION.) ACCORDING TO FRENCH ACCOUNT SHARIATMADARI USED FOR THE FIRST TIME THE TITLE "ERJAH" (SUPREME SHIITE LEADER) TO DESCRIBE HIMSELF.

HE ALSO DECLARED RELIGIOUS MOVEMENT IS NOT CONNECTED TO ANY PARTICULAR PARTY: "MY PARTY IS MY NATION." (COMMENT: AN INDIRECT SLAP AT THE NATIONAL FRONT WHICH IS TRYING TO COOPT A RELIGIOUS MASS BASE.) ALTHOUGH ASSERTING RELIGIOUS MOVEMENT WAS PROGRESSIVE, NOT REACTIONARY, HE CONDEMNED "MOVIES WHICH DAMAGE ISLAMIC MORAL AND SPIRITUAL LAWS." HE CALLED, HOWEVER, FOR STRICTLY NONVIOLENT ACTION. ------------------124488 061823Z /43 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 185 USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MUSCAT SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 8485

MORE EXILED RELIGIOUS LEADERS, INCLUDING KHOMEINI'S BROTHER, HAVE RETURNED TO THEIR FORMER CITIES. HOJJATOLISLAM MORTEZA PASANDIDEH, WHO WAS ARRESTED TWO MONTHS AGO, HAS BEEN FREED. OTHER RETURNEES ARE HOJJATOLISLAM NASSER SHIRAZI, WHO WAS EXILED IN BASRA, AND AYATOLLAH HASSAN TABATABAIQOMI, WHO SPENT TWELVE YEARS EXILE IN KARAJ.

OLD RELIGIOUS PRESSURE GROUP ANNOUNCED RETURN TO POLITICAL ARENA. SOCIALIST SOCIETY OF FREE MUSLIMS UNDER SHAIKH MOSTAFA RAHNEMA DECLARED IT WILL FIGHT FOR UNITY AMOUNG MUSLIMS, DEFEND ISLAMIC IDEALS, AND COMBAT INTERNATIONAL COLONIALISM, IMPERIALISM AND ZIONISM.

ON SECULAR FRONT, HARD-LINERS ARE UNMOVED. RAHMATOLLAH MOQADEM, LEADER OF RADICAL MOVEMENT OF IRAN, DEMANDED IMMEDIATE DISSOLUTION OF BOTH HOUSES OF PARLIAMENT AND STATE AND CITY COUNCILS. RADICAL MOVEMENT MANIFESTO LISTS DEMANDS AS FOLLOWS: (A) FULL OBSERVANCE OF CONSTITUTION; (B) FULL FREEDOM FOR RELIGIOUS GROUPS, POLITICAL PARTIES AND TRADE UNIONS; (C) FREEDOM FOR ALL POLITICAL PRISONERS AND RETURN OF LL THOSE IN EXILE; (D) FULL FREEDOM OF PRESS; (E) INDEFENDENCE OF JUDICIARY; (F) PUNISHMENT OF ALL WHO HAVE VIOLATED RIGHTS OF THE PEOPLE; (G) PUNISHMENT OF CORRUPT ELEMENTS: AND (H) INDEPENDENCE OF UNIVERSITIES AND ATTENTION TO STUDENTS' DEMANDS.

AHMAD BANI-AHMAD, WHO HEADS UNITY FOR LIBERTY SOCIETY, DEMANDED BOYCOTT OF NEGOTIATIONS WITH GOVERNMENT, AND HE CALLED FOR A NEW CABINET OF NATIONAL UNITY. LABOURERS' PARTY SPOKESMAN HASSAN VAHIDI ANNOUNCED IT WILL BOYCOTT ELECTIONS. MAHAMAD HOSSEIN ESHAGI-NEJAD, MAJLES DEPUTY FROM TABRIZ AND DEPUTY DIRECTOR OF THE WORKER'S ORGANIZATION, ANNOUNCED SEPT 5 THAT HE WAS GOING OVER TO THE OPPOSITION IN PARLIAMENT "BECAUSE THE WORKERS HAVE BEEN LIED TO BY THE GOVERNMENT." HIS DEFECTION FROM GOI RANKS COULD BE AN INTERESTING HARBINGER OF NEWLY-VISIBLE UNREST IN IRANIAN LABOR.

NATIONAL FRONT (INF), APPARENTLY BEST ORGANIZED SECULAR OPPOSITION MOVEMENT, ANNOUNCED IT TOO WILL BOYCOTT ELECTIONS IF HELD UNDER EXISTING LAW. (COMMENT: ALTHOUGH GOI MAINTAINS EXISTING LAW WILL GOVERN ELECTIONS, EMB. HAS LEARNED PRIME MINISTER WILL OFFER NEW ELECTION LAW, BUT THIS HAS NOT YET BEEN MADE PUBLIC.). KARIM SANJABI SAID IN SEPT 3 INTERVIEW THAT PRESENT GOVERNMENT IS UNFIT TO RUN ELECTIONS OR OVERSEE TRANSITION. HE REPEATED HE WILL NOT NEGOTIATE WITH GOVERNMENT. HE ALSO CLAIMED ASSOCIATION WITH WRITERS UNION AND IRANIAN ASSOCIATION OF JURISTS, ALTHOUGH ON AN INDIVIDUAL BASIS. AT INF RALLY SEPT 2 SANJABI DECLARED COMMUNIST PARTY SHOULD BE LEGALIZED.

ALTHOUGH HIS PARTY WOULD NOT ALIGN ITSELF WITH ANY PARTY WHICH HAD FOREIGN CONNECTIONS, HE CLAIMED CHANGES IN COMMUNIST PARTIES IN EUROPE SHOWED THESE PARTIES COULD FUNCTION WITHOUT FOREIGN TIE. AT SAME RALLY DARIOUSH FARUHAR DEMANDED "CHANGE IN THE VERY FOUNDATION OF THE PRESENT POLITICAL SYSTEM." A CHANGE IN CABINET IS INADEQUATE. GOI IS TRYING TO CONVINCE USG THAT IRAN IS UNREADY FOR DEMOCRACY. HE ECHOED RELIGIOUS LEADERS IN WARNING AGAINST USE OF VIOLENCE, WHICH HE CALLED "IRRATIONAL MEANS AND METHODS."

KEYHAN SEPT. 5 EDITORIAL CALLED ON BOTH GOI AND OPPOSITION TO EMPHASIZE PEACE, BUT STRONGLY ATTACKED SANJABI FOR ADVOCATING LEGALIZATION OF TUDEH AND SAID IT HAS "NOT SO FAR RECEIVED A SHRED OF EVIDENCE" THAT "TUDEH WOULD NOW BE INDEPENDENT FROM MOSCOW." KEYHAN ADDED THAT WOULD APPARENTLY RULE OUT INF COOPERATION WITH TUDEH SINCE IT IS ATTACHED TO A FOREIGN POWER.

GOI MINISTER OF STATE AZMOUN TOLD PRESS EVENING SEPT. 5 THAT GOI WAS POSTPONING ANNOUNCEMENT OF ITS PROGRAM TO PARLIAMENT UNTIL SEPT. 10. DELAY WAS TAKEN TO ALLOW MAJLES (LOWER HOUSE) TO GATHER IN ITS MEMBERS AND ADEQUATELY PREPARE FOR DISCUSSION. (COMMENT: PARLIAMENTARY SOURCE TOLD EMBOFF THAT GOI WAS HAVING DIFFICULT TIME FINDING SPOKESMEN OF ADEQUATE STATURE TO DEFEND GOI PROGRAM). AZMOUN SAID COMMENDED AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI FOR HIS ROLE IN KEEDPING ID-E-FETR DEMONSTRATIONS SEPT 4 PEACEFUL. AZMOUN SAID MOST LOGICAL GOI OBJECTIVE WOULD BE TO PURSUE CREATION OF A CLIMATE IN WHICH ALL POLITICAL PARTIES AND SOCIAL GROUPS COULD FREELY PARTICIPATE IN ELECTIONS.

1978TEHRAN08497.subject: SHAH VISIT TO ROMANIA AND GERMAN DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC ANNOUNCED BEGIN UNCLASSIFIED 1. COURT MINISTRY ANNOUNCED SEP

segments.text: ANNOUNCED BEGIN UNCLASSIFIED 1. COURT MINISTRY ANNOUNCED SEPT. 5 THAT SHAH AND SHABANOU WILL PAY STATE VISITS TO ROMANIA (SEPT. 11

AND EAST GERMANY (SEPT. 14-17) AT THE OFFICIAL INVITATION OF THOSE COUNTRIES' RESPECTIVE PRESIDENTS. END UNCLASSIFIED. BEGIN CONFIDENTIAL. 2. ANNOUNCEMENT OF THESE VISITS NOW AT TIME OF SUBSTANTIAL DOMESTIC UNREST AND LESS THAN ONE MONTH AFTER NEW PRIME MINISTER JAAFAR SHARIF-EMAMI HAS TAKEN OFFICE COMES AS REAL SURPRISE TO MANY HERE. ALTHOUGH EASTERN EUROPEAN TOUR HAD BEEN RUMORED PRIVATELY FOR SOME TIME, ASSUMPTION FOR PAST TEN DAYS HAS BEEN THAT IT WOULD MOST PROBABLY BE POSTPONED. TRIP WILL PLACE SHAH AT SOME DISTANCE FROM RAPIDLY-EVOLVING POLITICAL SITUATION AND FOLLOWS CLOSE ON HEELS OF VISITS TO IRAN BY CHINESE PREMIER HUA AND JAPAN'S PRIME MINISTER FUKUDA.

TRIP TO GDR IS ESPECIALLY INTRIGUING BECAUSE COUNTRY IS PRESENT HOME BASE OF EXILED TUDEH (COMMUNIST) PARTY LEADERSHIP, WHICH IS CURRENTLY THE ONLY OUTLAWED POLITICAL GROUP IN IRAN. WITHIN PAST TWO DAYS, IRANIAN NATIONAL FRONT (AN OPPOSITION COALITION) CALLED FOR RETURN OF TUDEH TO IRNIAN POLITICS, BUT THIS HAS BEEN ATTACKED IN PRESS EDITORIALS. EMBASSY WOULD APPRECIATE RECEIVING FAIRLY EXTENSIVE COVERAGE OF SHAH'S GDR VISIT, ESPECIALLY ANY ELEMENTS RELATING TO TUDEH PARTICIPATION.

ON MORNING SEPTEMBER 6, I CALLED ON NEWLY INSTALLED MINISTER OF INTERIOR, GENERAL ABBAS GHARABAGHI. I FOUND HIM STILL WEARING HIS MILITARY UNIFORM AND JUST HAVING RETURNED FROM AN AUDIENCE WITH THE SHAH WHERE HE HAD PRESENTED TWO NEW MAYORS FOR INSTALLATION.

GHARABAGHI BEGAN THE CONVERSATION BY SAYING THAT THE COUNTRY WAS IN THE GRIP "OF COMMUNIST SUBVERSION." HE DREW ON HIS STUDIES AT THE FRENCH ECOLE SUPERIEUR DE GUERT TO DESCRIBE THE CURRENT SITUATION AS "PHASE II" IN THE "SUBVERSIVE WAR." HE SAID THAT THE MONDAY DEMONSTRATIONS IN TEHRAN HAD DEMONSTRATED "SUPERB ORGANIZATION" (COMMENT: THEY DID) AND THAT THIS WAS BEYOND THE CAPABILITY OF THE MULLAHS. HE ALSO CITED THE ATTACK MORNING SEPT 6 ON A POLICE UNIT BARRACKS TO INDICATE THAT THE COMMUNIST TERRORIST GROUPS WERE AT WORK.

WE THEN WENT THROUGH THE USUAL DIALOGUE ABOUT FOREIGN INSTIGATION RELATIVE TO INDIGENOUS INSPIRATION AND EVEN RANG THE CHARGES OR THE RUMORS OF CIA INVOLVEMENT. AS FOR THE ORGANIZATION OF THE DEMONSTRATION, I POINTED OUT THAT IRANIAN STUDENTS IN THE U.S. PROVED THEMSELVES CAPABLE OF SUCH ORGANIZATION ON A NOTOROUSLY REGULAR BASIS.

GHARABAGHI SAID MONDAY'S "FLOWER-POWER" APPROACH TO THE TROOPS WAS DANGEROUS. HE SAID IT WAS DESIGNED TO "SEDUCE" THE MILITARY AND MAKE THEM UNABLE TO SHOW A FIRM HAND IF ONE BECAME NECESSARY AT A LATER DATE. WHILE HE AGREED THAT A MILITARY SOLUTION WAS IMPOSSIBLE, HE FEARED A CONFRONTATION MIGHT BE PROVOKED.

CONVERSATION THEN TURNED TO SUBJECT OF ELECTIONS. MINISTER SAID THE BAZAARS DID NOT BELIEVE SHAH WOULD PERMIT FREE ELECTIONS. HE WAS GOING TO TEHRAN BAZAAR THAT SAME AFTERNOON TO ANNOUNCE THAT THERE WOULD BE FREE ELECTIONS FOR THE BAZAARI GUILDS. HE FELT THAT, ONCE THE BAZAARIS EXPERIENCED THIS IN PRACTICE, THEY WOULD HAVE MORE FAITH IN THE SHAH'S PROMISE FOR FREE PARLIAMENTARY ELECTIONS.

AS FOR THE PARLIAMENTARY ELECTIONS, THE GOVT WILL "PROBABLY" WITHDRAW THE ELECTION LAW CURRENTLY BEFORE THE MAJLES AND CONDUCT THE ELECTIONS ON THE BASIS OF THE OLD LAW. THIS HAS SOME ANACHRONISMS, SUCH AS MULTIPLE MEMBER DISTRICTS, BUT IT IS LESS CONTROVERSIAL THAN THE PROPOSED LAW. ALTHOUGH THERE ARE CLAMORS FOR AN EARLY DISSOLUTION OF THE PARLIAMENT AND ELECTIONS NOW, THE MINISTER FEELS IT WILL REQUIRE MORE TIME TO ORGANIZE GENUINE ELECTIONS AND POLITICAL GROUPS WILL NEED THE TIME ALSO. THE CURRENT PLAN IS TO STAY WITH THE JUNE DATE ANNOUNCED BY THE SHAH.

COMMENT: GHARABAGHI IS A DECENT, STRAIGHT-ARROW SOLDIER OF COMPLETE LOYALTY TO THE SHAH (THEY WERE CLASSMATES). HE CAN BE CONSIDERED GENUINE IN HIS DESIRE TO ORGANIZE HONEST ELECTIONS. HOWEVER, HE SAYS HE PLANS TO USE THE BUREAUCRATIC STAFF HE HAS INHERITED UNLESS HE FINDS SOME REAL ROTTEN APPLES IN THE MINISTRY. HE IS A MAN WITHOUT POLITICAL GUILE AND SUBJECT TO THE LIMITATIONS OF A FRENCH-ORIENTED MILITARY BACKGROUND (OUR CONVERSATION WAS IN FRENCH). HE WILL BE AN IMPECCABLE BUT UNIMAGINATIVE MINISTER OF INTERIOR.

AMBASSADOR AND DCM ON SEPTEMBER 5 MET WITH URIEL LUBRANI AND MOSHE GILBOA, THE DE FACTO AMBASSADOR AND DCM RESPECTIVELY OF THE ISRAELI MISSION HERE, FOR GENERAL REVIEW OF CURRENT IRANIAN DOMESTIC SCENE. THE NOTED THAT JEWISH COMMUNITY IN IRAN (ABOUT 80,000 POPULATION) IS EXTREMELY APPREHENSIVE OVER POLITICAL SITUATION IN IRAN. EXTREMIST MULLAHS AND THOSE UNDER THEIR INFLUENCE ARE ISSUING STRIDENTLY ANTI-JEWISH PAMPHLETS AND DIRECTING OTHER THREATS AGAINST THE COMMUNITY. STATEMENT BY SHARIAT MADARI (TEHRAN 98485) IS HELPFUL BUT COMMUNITY WILL CONTINUE TO FEAR THAT ONCE THE RELIGIOUS CONSERVATIVES ACHIEVE SUCCESS IN PURGING THE BAHAIS FROM GOVERNMENT, ATTENTION WILL FOCUS AGAIN ON JEWISH COMMUNITY.

IN RESPONSE TO AMBASSADOR'S QUERY, LUBRANI SAID THAT RELATIONS BETWEEN ISRAEL AND IRAN AND THE NUMEROUS AREA OF COOPERATION, INCLUDING THE INTELLIGENCE EXCHANGE, HAVE NOT BEEN AFFECTED. NOR, HE SAID, DID HE EXPECT THE ANTI-JEWISH CAMPAIGN OR THE STRENGTH OF THE ISLAMIC FUNDAMENTALISTS TO BE TRANSLATED INTO A COOLING OF THE TIES. (COMMENT: WE ARE NOT AS SANGUINE.)

IN GENERAL, THE TWO ISRAELI OFFICIALS ARE PESSIMISTIC OVER FUTURE DEVELOPMENTS. LUBRANI, WHO HAD MOVED INTO ONE OF THE SEPTEMBER 4 MARCHES, COMMENTED THAT THEY WERE WELL AND TIGHTLY ORGANIZED AND DISCIPLINED BY MARCH WARDENS. THE LARGE PERCENTAGE OF THE DEMONSTRATORS WAS IN THEIR LATE TEENS AND EARLY TWENTIES AND REASONABLY WELL DRESSED. MANY OF THE SLOGANS WERE VIRULENTLY ANTI-SHAH AND HE HAD PERSONALLY WITNESSED THE SHOWERING OF FLOWERS ON SOME OF THE POLICE AND MILITARY. HE VIEW THE EFFORT TO WIN OVER THE SECURITY FORCES AS POTENTIALLY OMINOUS FOR THE FUTURE OF THE GOVERNMENT.

LUBRANI MUSED THAT AT THIS TIME IT IS DIFFICULT TO SPECULATE HOW FAR THE RELIGIOUS LEADERS WISH TO PUSH THE SHAH BUT HE WAS CONCERNED THAT THEIR SUCCESSES TO DATE, AND THEIR LIKELY ASSESSMENT THAT THE SHAH HAS LOST CONTROL, WOULD WORK AGAINST A REASONABLE COMPROMISE OR POLITICAL CONSENSUS.

GILBOA, WHO TENDS TO VIEW EVENTS DARKLY, STATED THAT "A REVOLUTIONARY SITUATION" NOW PREVAILS IN IRAN BUT, IN CONTRAST TO MOST HISTORICAL REVOLUTIONS, THERE IS NO CLEARLY IDENTIFIED LEADER OR LEADERS TO CONTROL, OR TAKE ADVANTAGE OF, THE REVOLUTION.

LUBRANI COMMENTED THAT HE IS STILL CONCERNED BY THE SHAH'S HEALTH AND THE FACT THAT THERE IS ON ONE LIKE FORMER COURT MINISTER ALAM TO GIVE FRANK AND WISE COUNSEL TO THE SHAH. WHEN HE SAW HOVEYDA ON SEPTEMBER 4, THE LATTER WAS OUT OF SORTS AND DISCOURAGED; THIS WAS WORRISONE, HE SAID, FOR HOVEYDA DOES HAVE SOME INFLUENCE WITH THE SHAH AND IS A SHREWD OPERATOR. (COMMENT: DESCRIPTION OF HOVEYDA IS IN MARKED CONTRAST TO FEISTY APPEARANCE ON AUGUST 31 WHEN AMBASSADOR SAW HIM, AND MAY GIVE WEIGHT TO RUMOR THAT HOVEYDA'S TENURE IS SHAKY.)

THERE WAS GENERAL AGREEMENT AMONG US THAT THE SHAH HAS TO PULL OUT OF HIS CURRENT DEPRESSION SOON, GIVE AN APPEARANCE OF CONFIDENT LEADERSHIP AGAIN, AND START TO RALLY THE MODERATE AND CENTRIST FORCES WHICH SUPPORT HIM AND THE MONARCHY.

1978TEHRAN08539.subject: NATIONAL FRONT (INF) REJECTION OF REPORTED TUDEH PARTY DEMARCHE BEGIN LIMITED OFFICIAL USE

segments.text: TUDEH PARTY DEMARCHE BEGIN LIMITED OFFICIAL USE

INF REJECTED SEPT 6 A REPORTED TUDEH PARTY CEN JASD COMMITTEE OFFER TO JOIN FORCES IN OUSTING IRANIAN REGIME. INCIDENT BEGAN WITH AFP REPORT FROM PARIS SEPT 5 THAT TUDEH PARTY CENTRAL COMMITTEE HAD ISSUED APPEAL TO ALL OPPOSITION FORCES TO UNITE AND TOPPLE GOI. TUDEH DECLARATION GAVE AS PROGRAM OF THE RESULTING "GOVERNMENT OF NATIONAL UNITY" PUNISHMENT OF WRONGDOERS, NULLIFICATION OF LAWS CONTRARY TO CONSTITUTION AND FUNDAMENTAL RIGHTS, DISSOLUTION OF MAJLES AND SENATE, ABOLSHIMENT OF POLITICAL POLICE, CONVENING OF A CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY, NATIONALIZATION OF PETROLEUM INDUSTRIES, DISMISSAL OF U.S.
MILITARY ADVISORS, ABROGATION OF U.S.-IRAN MILITARY AGREEMENT, WITHDRAWAL FROM CENTO, EXPROPRIATION OF PRIVATE FORTUNES, AND REJECTION OF OPEN DOOR ECONOMIC POLICY.

FRONT LEADER KARIM SANJABI SAID THAT GIVEN THE "TRAGIC EXPERIENCE" OF INF RELATIONS WITH TUDEH IN EARLY 1950S, ANY FORM OF POLITICAL ALLIANCE NOW WOULD BE "INCONCEIVABLE." HIS EARLIER STATEMENT ADVOCATING LEGALIZATION OF TUDEH PARTY SHOULD NOT BE MISCONTRUED AS NATIONAL FRONT WILLINGNESS TO COLLABORATE WITH TUDEH, A PARTY WHICH IS AN APPENDAGE OF A FOREIGN POWER, BUT SIMPLY OF REFLECTION OF DEGREE TO WHICH GOI SHOULD LIBERALIZE. END LIMITED OFFICIAL USE-BEGIN CONFIDENTIAL

COMMENT: STORY HAS A PECULIAR ASPECT. IT IS UNUSUAL FOR A TUDEH DECLARATION TO BE ISSUED IN PARIS, BECAUSE PARTY HEADQUARTERS ARE IN EAST BERLIN. PERHAPS GDR DID NOT WANT TO EMBARRASS SHAH ON EVE OF HIS VISIT THERE, AND TUDEH SIMPLY USED ITS TIES TO ACTIVE IRANIAN STUDENT GROUPS IN PARIS TO ADVANTAGE. POSSIBILITY CANNOT BE DISMISSED THAT TUDEH MANIFESTO WAS SA SAVAK PLOY DESIGNED TO EMBARRASS NATIONAL FRONT AND OTHER OPPOSITION GROUPS. WHATEVER CAUSE, PRINCIPAL SIGNIFICANT RESULT HAS BEEN TO GET INF ON RECORD AGAINST A TUDEH ALLIANCE.

1978TEHRAN08540.subject: RESURGENCE PARTY'S THIRD WING BECOMES INDEPENDENT PARTY

segments.text: SUMMARY: GROUP FOR THE STUDY OF IRANIAN PROBLEMS, WHICH IN JUNE BECAME THIRD WING OF RESURGENCE PARY (RPPI) DECLARED INDEPENDENCE SEPT. 5 AS THE NEW SOCIETY PARTY. MANIFESTO PROCLAIMED SUPPORT FOR MONARCHY, NATIONAL INDEPENCE, CONSTITUTION, AND SHAH-PEOPLE REVOLUTION. GROUP, COMPOSED MAINLY OF INTELLECTUALS, INCLUDES SIX CABINET MINISTERS. END SUMMARY.

GROUP FOR THE STUDY OF IRANIAN PROBLEMS, WHICH EMERGED LAST JUNE SOMEWHAT AGAINST ITS WILL AS THE THIRD WING OF RESURGENCE PARTY, DECLARED SEPT 5 IT IS HENCEFORTH AN INDEPENDENT POLITICAL PARTY. IT WILL BE CALLED THE NEW SOCIETY PT SY. WARNING THAT ANARCHY AND VIOLENCE THREATEN THE GROWTH OF FREEDOM IN IRAN, PARTY DECLARED IN FIRST MANIFESTO THAT IT STANDS FOR MONARCHY, NATIONAL INDEPENDENCE, CONSTITUTION, AND SHAH-PEOPLE REVOLUTION. "IF FREEDOM IS FOLLOWED BY AN ANARCHY AND VIOLENCE AND DENIES PEOPLE THEIR SAFETY IT WILL EVENTUALLY BE MET WITH REACTION, WHICH IS NOT IN THE BEST INTERESTS OF THE COUNTRY AND THOSE WHO ADVOCATE THE RULE OF LAW."

SUBSTANTIVE THEME OF GROUPS MANIFESTO WAS DEFENSE OF MODERNISM: "HOW IN IT BE IMAGINED THAT THE FARMERS, WORKERS, AND IRANIAN WOMEN WHO HAVE ACHIEVED SOCIAL, POLITICAL AND ECONOMIC RIGHTS DURING THE PAST 15 YEARS WILL BE WITNESS TO THE DESTRUCTION OF ALL THESE BENEFITS?" GROUP ATTACKED "THOSE WHO ARE IGNORANT OF THE LAWS OF DEVELOPMENT OF HISTORY, SOCIAL AND ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT," AND CALLED FOR ALL RESPONSIBLE NATIONAL FORCES TO JOIN IN DEFENSE OF NATIONAL GAINS. DECLARATION REPEATED WHAT GROUP HAS ALWAYS STOOD FOR--CONTROLLED REFORM AND LIBERALIZATION UNDER TH SHAH.

FOUNDED IN 1973 AS AN ACADEMICALLY-INCLINED POLICY REVIEW ORGANIZATION, GROUP ASSUMED NEW ROLE IN GROWING POLITICAL FERMENT OF SUMMER 1978. REFTELS A AND B. REPORTED TRANSFORMATION OF GROUP INTO THIRD WING. FORMALLY ANNOUNCED BY PARTY CHIEF AMOUZEGAR JUNE 21, REF. C REPORTED DISSATISFACTION AMONG MEMBERS OF GROUP TOWARD NEW ROLE. WITH PARTIES SPRINGING UP ON ALL SIDES AN RPPI COLLAPSING, GROUP DECISION TO GO IT ALONE IS NOT SURPRISING.

STUDY GROUP PLEDGED TO "KEENLY WATCH THE FUNCTIONS OF THE NEW GOVERNMENT." IT CAN HARDLY DO OTHERWISE, SINCE ITS LEADER HUSHANG NAHAVANDI IS MINISTER OF SCIENCE AND HIGHER EDUCATION, MINISTER OF EDUCATION MANOUCHEHR GANJI, MINISTER OF LABOR AND SOCIAL WELFARE KAZEM VADI'I, MINISTER OF ARTS AND CULTURE MOHSEN FOROUGHI, MINISTER OF JUSTICE MOHAMMAD BAHERI, AND MINISTER OF PTT KAZEM MOTAMEDI ARE ALSO MEMBERS OF THE STUDY GROUP.

1978TEHRAN08546.subject: TERRORIST INCIDENTS SUGGESTS RENEWED ATTENTION TO FOREIGN COMMUNITY

segments.text: FOREIGN COMMUNITY

SUMMARY. CHARIKHA-YE-FEDAI-YE-KHALQ HAS TAKEN CREDIT FOR ATTACK ON POLICE STATION EARLY MORNING SEPT. 6. IN MIDAFTERNOON SAME DAY IN DIFFERENT PART OF CITY PIPE BOMB WAS THROWN AT BUSSES CONTAINING BRITISH TECHNICIANS. LATTER ACTION RESENTLY APPEARS UNRELATED TO THAT OF CHARIKS AND POSSIBLY WAS WORK OF FANATICAL ISLAMIC SPLINTER GROUP. END SUMMARY.

AT 0445 HOURS ON WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 6, BARRACKS OF IRANIAN NATIONAL POLICE GUARD (INPG) (FYI: THIS IS A SPECIAL SWAT-TYPE RIOT CONTROL UNIT OF IRAN NATIONAL POLICE) LOCATED SEVERAL BLOCKS SOUTHEAST OF THE AMERICAN EMBASSY COMPOUND IN TEHRAN AND ADJACENT TO AN ARMISH MAAG MOTORPOOL/APO OFFICE COMPLEX WAS ATTACKED BY TERRORISTS. A CITROEN VAN CONTAINING AN UNDETERMINED NUMBER OF INDIVIDUALS DROVE INTO THE INPG COMPOUND AREA. CITROEN HAD 200 LITERS OF GAS INSIDE CONTAINER ATTACHED FOR APPARENT PURPOSE OF EXPLODING IN COMPOUND. VEHICLE WAS CHALLENGED BY INPG GUARD WHO WAS CUT DOWN AND KILLED BY BURST OF FIRE FROM AUTOMATIC WEAPON(S).

OCCUPANTS THEN LEFT VEHICLE, INSIDE OF COMPOUND, FIRED AT VEHICLE IN UNSUCCESSFUL ATTEMPT TO DETONATE GAS CONTAINER AND LEFT AREA BEFORE OTHER INPG BARRACKS PERSONNEL COULD REACT. LEAFLET DISTRIBUTED AT SCENE BY CHARIKHA-YE-FEDAI-YE-KHALQ (THE PEOPLE'S SACRIFICE GUERRILLAS) CLAIMED RESPONSIBILITY FOR INCIDENT. LEAFLET IS APPARENTLY PHRASED IN ANTI-GOI AND ANTI-US TERMS. EMBASSY EXPECTS TO OBTAIN LEAFLET AND WILL TRANSLATE.

AT APPROXIMATELY 1620 HOURS ON WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 6, A BOMB WAS THROWN AT TWO BUSSES CONTAINING EMPLOYEES OF BRITISH AEROSPACE CORPORATION IN TEHRAN IN A RESIDENTIAL AREA IN NORTH TEHRAN, AS THEY WERE PROCEEDING FROM WORK AT THE DOSHAN TAPPEH AIRBASE. A PIPE BOMB EXPLODED BETWEEN THE BUSES WHICH WERE DRIVING ON A SET SCHEDULE AND ROUTE, WHICH IS FOLLOWED EACH WORKDAY. NO INJURIES OCCURRED, ALTHOUGH BOMB FRAGMENTS TORE HOLES IN BOTH BUSES, SHATTERED THE REAR WINDOW OF A CAR IN FRONT OF THE BUSES, AND SHATTERED SEVERAL WINDOWS OF NEARBY HOUSES. BOTH BUSES, CAPACITY 33 INDIVIDUALS EACH, WERE FILLED WITH MALE AND FEMALE BRITISH AEROSPACE EMPLOYEES.

BUSES ARE EXACTLY SIMILAR IN MODEL AND COLORING TO THOSE UTILIZED BY SEVERAL AMERICAN BUSINESS COMPANIES AND BY ARMISH-MAAG PERSONNEL WHO ALSO WORKED AT DOSHAN TAPPEH. THE "AMERICAN " BUSES TRAVERSE THE SAME GENERAL NEIGHBORHOODS WHERE THIS PARTICULAR INCIDENT OCCURRED.

COMMENT: AT PRESENT TIME TWO INCIDENTS DO NOT APPEAR TO BE RELATED. CHARIK ACTION, WE BELIEVE,WAS DESIGNED TO SHOW IRANIAN PUBLIC THAT CHARIKS ARE CUTTING EDGE OF REVOLUTIONAORY VANGUARD-ROLE IT HAS TRIED TO AS UME IN PAST AND PREPARED TAKE ON SECURITY AUTHORITIES. WE HAVE NO EVIDENCE AT THIS TIME THAT CHARIKS PLAN TO TARGET FOREIGNERS BUT SHALL MONITOR CAREFULLY.

BOMBING OF BUS IN REMINISCENT OF BOMB ATTACK ON ISFAHAN CONSULATE AND KHANSALAR RESTAURANT AND PROBABLY WORK OF FANATIC FRINGE GROUP WHO, UNLIKE CHARIKS,HAVE USED CRUDE EXPLOSIVES INDISCRIMINATELY AND HAVE NO COMPUNCTION AGAINST ATTACKING FOREIGNERS. THIS LATEST BOMBING HAS COME AT A TIME OF INCREASED ANTIFOREIGN/ANTI-AMERICAN SLOGANEERING AND PAMPHLETING BY DEMONSTRATORS.

1978TEHRAN08548.subject: MULLAH'S PRESECRIPTION FOR THE NEW IRAN

segments.text: HOJJATOLISLAM HAJ MIRZA HAMID BANABI, A TABRIZ CLERGYMAN, STATED HIS DEMANDS SEPT 6 IN A PRESS INTERVIEW: NO LAW CAN BE IMPLEMENTED WHICH CONTRAVENES ISLAMIC LAW.

HIS SPECIFIC DEMANDS INCLUDED: (A) ABOLISHMENT OF COEDUCATION; (B) ALL LIQUOR STORES MUST BE CLOSED; (C) MOVIE THEATERS AND TELEVISION SHOULD SHOW ONLY EDUCATIONAL FILMS; (D) MUSLIM POLITICAL PRISONERS SHOULD BE FREED, AND ALL THOSE IN EXILE MUST BE ALLOWED TO RETURN; (E) PERSONNEL WORKING IN THE JUDICIAL SYSTEM SHOULD BE ACQUAINTED WITH THE BASIC LAWS OF ISLAM: (F) ONLY MUSLIMS SHOULD BE EMPLOYED IN GOVERNMENT AND INSTITUTIONS SPECIFICALLY DEALING WITH CULTURAL AFFAIRS; AND (G) RELIGIOUS EDUCATION SHOULD BE INTRODUCED AT EVERY LEVEL OF THE EDUCATIONAL SYSTEM.

COMMENT: WHILE SOME OF BANABI'S POINTS ARE SIMILAR TO THOSE MADE BY MORE ESTABLISHED LEADERS, HE HAS ALSO VOCALIZED HERE FOR FIRST TIME IN MEDIA SOME OF THE MORE RADICAL RELIGIOUS DEMANDS MAKING THE TEA ROOM AND COFFEE HOUSE ROUNDS. THEY ARE DRAWING STRONG REACTION FROM MORE WESTERNIZED IRANIANS AND HAVE BEGUN TO STIMULATE TALK OF POLITICAL COUNTER ACTIVITY. END COMMENT

1978TEHRAN08552.subject: REQUEST FOR BHI PERSONNEL TO ASSIST PREPARATION OF HELICOPTERS FOR EMERGENCY FLIGHTS

segments.text: HELICOPTERS FOR EMERGENCY FLIGHTS

BELL HELICOPTER (BHI) OFFICIALS HAVE BEEN ASKED BY IRANIAN ARMY TO HAVE THEIR PERSONNELREPORT TO WORK IMMEDIATELY (ON FRIDAY HOLIDAY) IN ORDER TO ASSIST IN PREPARATION OF HELICOPTERS FOR EMERGENCY FLIGHTS. I HAVE INSTRUCTED CHIEF ARMISH TO ASK BHI PRESIDENT WILLIAMS, WHO IS CURRENTLY IN IRAN, TO EXPLAIN TO IRANIAN ARMY THAT BHI CONTRACT WITH USG PROVIDES EXCLUSIVELY FOR MAINTENANCE AND TRAINING ACTIVITY, AND THAT BHI PERSONNEL CAN NOT RPT NOT BECOME INVOLVED IN INTERNAL SECURITY OPERATIONS. I HAVE FURTHER ASKED THAT WILLIAMS SEEK OUT SENIOR ARMY OFFICER RESPONSIBLE AND EMPHASIZE ADVERSE REPERCUSSIONS WHICH WOULD RESULT IF U.S.
PERSONNEL WERE PERCEIVED TO BE INVOLVED IN CURRENT IRANIAN EFFORTS TO ESTABLISH LAW AND ORDER.

I HAVE APPOINTMENT WITH FOREIGN MINISTER AT 5:30 THIS AFTERNOON. I WILL USE THAT OCCASION TO EXPLAIN THE LIMITS WHICH WILL GUIDE U.S. PERSONNEL WHO ARE IN IRAN ON FMS CONTRACTS AND WILL EMPHASIZE TO HIM THE NECESSITY OF AVOIDING ANY SUGGESTION THAT U.S. NATIONALS ARE ENGAGED IN THE ENFORCEMENT OF MARTIAL LAW.

1978TEHRAN08554.subject: TEXT OF GOVERNMENT STATEMENT ANNOUNCING MARTIAL LAW

segments.text: AT 6:00 A.M. THIS MORNING, SEPTEMBER 8, THE GOVERNMENT ANNOUNCED THE IMPOSITION OF MARTIAL LAW AND A DUSK TO DAWN CURFEW IN TEHRAN AND 11 OTHER CITIES FOR SIX MONTHS. CURFEW HOURS IN TEHRAN ARE FROM 9:00 P.M. TO 5:00 A.M. THE TEXT OF THE GOVERNMENT STATEMENT, AS READ OVER THE INTERNATIONAL RADIO STATION NEWS, IS AS FOLLOWS: : A GOVERNMENT ANNOUNCEMENT DATED THE 15TH OF SHAHRIVAR, OR 6TH OF SEPTEMBER, PROHIBITS GATHERINGS ON PUBLIC STREETS. DISREGARDING RELIGIOUS LEADERS' DIRECTIONS TO KEEP PEACE AND NOT CREATE DISTURBANCES, PROTESTORS DEMONSTRATED AND DISPLAYED PLACARDS AND SLOGANS AGAINST THE IRANIAN CONSTITUTION YESTER.

BY DOING SO, THEY DISRUPTED THE ACTIVITIES OF EVERDAY LIFE AND FRIGHTENED THE PEOPLE. EVEN THOUGH IT WAS VERY EASY FOR THE ARMED FORCES TO ENFORCE THE LAW, THE ANTI-STATE DEMONSTRATION WAS PERMITTED AND TOLERATED BY THE GOVERNMENT IN ORDER TO AVOID BLOODSHED. THE PLOT, WHICH IS FINANCED AND MASTERMINED BY OUTSIDE FORCES, IS INCREASING IN DIMENSION EVERY DAY, IS ENDANGERING EVERY INDIVIDUAL'S RIGHTS, IS AGAINST THE FREEDOM AND INDEPENDENCE OF THIS NATION, AND IS AIMED AT DISRUPTING IRAN'S PROGRESS AND GOVERNMENT. THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT HEREBY DECLARES MARTIAL LAW FOR SIX MONTHS IN TEHRAN, KARAJ, GHAZVIN, QOM, MESHAD, TABRIZ, AHWAZ, ABADAN, ISFAHAN, SHIRAZ, KAZEROON AND JAHRUM. END .

1978TEHRAN08555.subject: IMPOSITION OF MARTIAL LAW FOLLOWS DAY-LONG DEFIANCE OF GOVERNMENT

segments.text: OF GOVERNMENT

GOI ANNOUNCED SEPT 6 THAT DEMONSTRATIONS AND LARGE PUBLIC GATHERING COULD NOT BE HELD WITHOUT OFFICIAL PERMISSION. ANNOUNCEMENT WAS INTENDEDTO HEAD OF ANTICIPATED LARGE DEMONSTRATIONS SEPT 7 TO MARK SEVENTH DAY OF MOURNING FOR PERSONS KILLED IN CALSH PREVIOUS WEEK IN TEHRAN. VARIOUS AYATOLLAHS AND POLITICAL LEADERS ISSUED CONFLICTING ADVISE TO GATHER RO NOT TO GATHER AND SOME CALLED FOR GENERAL STRIKE. IT WAS CLEAR FROM THESE REPORTS THAT GOVERNMENT HAD WON OVER SOME IMPORTANT AYATOLLAHS IN EFFORT TO COOL SITUATION BUT THAT MANY OTHERS WERE INTENT ON DEFYING GOVERNMENT'S BAN.

AT LEAST THREE LARGE MARCHES, TOTALING BETWEEN 50 - 1000,000 PERSONS, TOOK PLACE SEPT 7 MOVING TO AND FRO IN VARIOUS PARTS OF CITY. MARCHES WERE VERY WELL ORGANIZED WITH PHALANXES OF YOUNG MOTORCYCLISTS TO CLEAR THE STREETS AND REDIRECT TRAFFIC (DONE WITH POLITENESS BUT FIRMNESS WHEN SOME AMERICANS DROVE UP TO ROUTE OF MARCH), ACCOMPANYING MARSHALLS, WATER AND FOOD TRUCKS, ETC.

MANY OF THE SOLOGANS AND PLACARDS WERE STRONGLY ANTI-SHAH AND ANTI-FOREIGN; (E.G., "DEATH TO PAHLAVI DYNASTY," "HAIL KHOMEINI," "SUPPORT OR PALESTINIAN BROTHERS," "ISLAMIC NATION CANNOT HAVE MONARCHY," "AMERICAN GO HOME") POLICE AND MILITARY UNITS WERE GENERALLY RESTRAINED, ALTHOUGH TEAR GAS WAS USED IN ISOLATED INSTANCES AND SHOTS WERE FIRED IN THE AIR. TO THE BEST OF OUR KNOWLEDGE, THERE WERE NO CASULATIES.

FACED WITH THIS OVERT DEFIANCE OF THE GOVERNMENT RULING ON DEMONSTRATION, THE CABINET MET NIGHT OF SEPT 7 AND MARTIAL LAW WAS ANNOUNCED AT 6:00 A.M. SEPT 8. GATHERING ON PUBLIC STREETS WERE BANNED AND A CURFEW ESTABLISHED FROM 8 PM TO 5 AM FOR SIX MONTHS.

EARLY REPORTS INDICATE THAT A LARGE CROWD GATHERED IN JALEH SQUARE (NEAR MAJLES) IN SOUTH TEHRAN AND REFUSED APPEAL OF AYATOLLAH NOURI TO DISPERSE. CROED, ACCORING TO RADIO PRESS TICKERS, VANCED ON SECURITY FORCES ATTEMPTING TO DISARM THEM. TROOPS OPENED FIRE AND "MANY WERE KILLED AND WOUNDED." ONE SECURITY OFFICIAL HAS INFORMED US THAT THERE ARE A FEW OTHERS POCKETS OF DEMONSTRATIONS: "THEY WILL BE SEVERELY DEALT WITH." WE ALSO HAVE UNCONFIRMED REPORTS OF ARSON IN SOUTH TEHRAN.

OBSERVATIONS BY EMBASSY OFFICERS THROUGHOUT TEHRAN INDICATE THAT, WITH EXCEPTION OF MILITARY CONCENTRATION NEAR MAJLES, TROOP DISPOSITION ELSEWHERE ARE DISCREET, WITH LIMITED NUMBER OF TANKS AND PERSONNEL CARRIERS CONTROLLING KEY INTERSECTIONS AND APPROACHES TO IMPERIAL PALACES. CONSULS IN TABRIZ, ISFAHAN AND SHIRAZ REPORT ALL QUIET IN THOSE CITIES.

ACCORING TO AP TICKER REPORT, SENIOR MILITARY OFFICERS APPROACHED SHAH EARLIER THIS WEEK TO INFORM HIM THAT "THEY CAN NO LONGER STAND THE LEFTISTS AND ISLAMIC GROUPS PROVOCATIONS." WE CANNOT CONFIRM THIS REPORT BUT DURING LAST FEW DAYS HAVE BEEN RECEIVING RUMORS OF INCREASING MILITARY UNEASINESS WITH GOVERNMENT'S FAILURE TO END DEMONSTRATIONS. THE SHAH ALLEGEDLY ADVISED MILITARY TO CONSULT WITH PRIME MINISTER AND SEPT 7 CABINET MEETING WAS THE REPORTED RESULT.

1978TEHRAN08558.subject: IRANIAN REQUEST FOR MEETING WITH SECRETARY AT UNGA

segments.text: NEW IRANIAN FORIEGN MINISTER WILL ATTEND UNGA, ARRIVING NEW YORK SEPTEMBER 26 AND DEPARTING OCTOBER 7. HE DEFINITELY WISHES TO MEET WITH SECRETARY.

EMBASSY RECOMMENDS STRONGLY MEETING BE SCHEDULED. FAILURE TO DO SO, PARTICULARLY IN LIGHT OF SECRETARY'S CONGRATULATORY MESSAGE (STATE 219149) WOULD BE SEEN AS CALCULATED SLAP. IRAN IS CURRENTLY GOING THROUGH DIFFICULT DOMESTIC PERIOD AND MANY IRANIANS, INCLUDING FOREIGN MINISTER, HAVE DOUBTS AS TO U.S. POLICY TOWARD IRAN. THE SECRETARY COULD AUTHORITATIVELY ADDRESS THESE ISSUES.
FONOFF OFFICIAL SAID HE WOULD LET US KNOW IF FOREIGN MINISTER HAD SPECIAL ISSUE TO RAISE.

1978TEHRAN08564.subject: WAIVER OF IMMUNITY OF DEPENDENT SPOUSES

segments.text: BY REFTEL, WHICH WAS SENT ON AUGUST 14, 1978, THE EMBASSY REQUESTED WAIVER OF IMMUNITY FOR THE SPOUSE OF FSO-6 SANDRA A. MENDYK TO PERMIT HIM TO ACCEPT EMPLOYMENT WITH NON-U.S. GOVERNMENT ORGANIZATION. THE DELAY IN RESPONDING ON THE PART OF THE DEPARTMENT IS CAUSING UNDUE HARDSHIP ON THE MENDYK FAMILY AND COULD VERY WELL RESULT IN MR. MENDYK LOSING THIS EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNIGY. AS DEPARTMENT'S RECORDS WILL REVEAL, IT ASSURED THE EMBASSY THAT PROMPT ATTENTION WOULD BE GIVEN TO ITS WAIVER OF IMMUNITY CASES TO AVOID JUST SUCH DIFFICULTIES NOW BEING EXPERIENCED BY THE MENDYKS.
THE DEPARTMENT IS THEREFORE URGED TO REVIEW THE MENDYK CASE AND ADVISE THE EMBASSY BY RETURN CABLE.

FOR DEPARTMENT'S INFORMATION, EMBASSY HAS NOW REACHED AGREEMENT WITH MFA ON THE ANNOTATION OF IDENTIFICATION CARDS FOR LIMITED WAIVER OF IMMUNITY ANDHHAS RECEIVED THE FIRST SUCH CARD. THIS REPRESENTS A SIGNIFICANT BREAKTHROUGH IN REGULARIZING LOCAL PROCEDURES AND IN FACILITATING THE EMPLOYERS OBTAINING WORK PERMITS. THIS ALSO MAKES PROMPT ACTION BY THE DEPARTMENT AND EMBASSY IN GRANTING THE WAIVERS OF IMMUNITY EVEN MORE IMPORTANT, I.E., WE CAN NO LONGER BLAME THE GOI FOR DELAYS.

WITH REGARD TO AVOIDING DELAYS IN THESE CASES, THE EMBASSY WOULD LIKE TO AGAIN PROPOSE TO THE DEPARTMENT THAT THE AUTHORITY TO GRANT WAIVERS OF IMMUNITY BE GIVEN TO THE AMBASSADOR RATHER THAN HAVING TO REFER EACH CASE TO THE DEPARTMENT. THERE WILL PROBABLY BE MANY MORE REQUESTS FOR OUTSIDE EMPLOYMENT IN THE COMING MONTHS AND THE SIMPLIER WE CAN KEEP PROCEDURES THE BETTER. THE AMBASSADOR WOULD, OF COURSE, EXERCISE ALL DUE CAUTION IN GRANTING WAIVERS OF IMMUNITY AND WOULD EITHER REFUSE OR REFER ANY QUESTIONABLE CASES TO THE DEPARTMENT.

PLEASE INFORM PRESIDENT THAT SHAH WILL BE EXPECTING HIS TELEPHONE CALL AT 1600 TEHRAN TIME WHICH IS 0800 WASHINGTON TIME. I HAVE PASSED ORAL MESSAGE CONTAINED REFTEL AND HAD OVER AN HOUR AUDIENCE WITH SHAH SUNDAY MORNING.

I FOULD HIM TIRED AND DISTURBED BUT WITH CONSIDERABLY GREATER SPIRIT THAN AT MY LAST AUDIENCE. HE REAFFIRMED HIS INTENTION TO CONTINUE LIBERALIZATION PROCESS AND SPOKE OF SEVERAL LEGISLATIVE ACTS WHICH WILL BE SUBMITTED TO MAJLES IN THAT CONTEXT. HE ALSO SPOKE OF A CRACKDOWN ON CORRUPTION. HE RECOGNIZED THAT MARTIAL LAW COULD NOT BE A SOLUTION, BUT ONLY AN INTERIM MEASURE TO RESTORE ORDER BEFORE PROCEEDING TO FREE ELECTIONS.

HE BELIEVES THAT SOVIET AGITATORS HAVE HAD A HAND IN RECENT EVENTS AND THAT PURPOSE OF DEMONSTRATORS ON FRIDAY HAD BEEN TO OCCUPY THE PARLIAMENT BUILDING AND THE CENTRAL COMMUNICATIONS AT THE POST AND TELEGRAPH BUILDING. WHEN HE BEGAN TO REFER TO REPORTS OF U.S. INVOLVEMENT, I INTERRUPTED HIM TO GIVE HIM A RATHER SHARP LECTURE ON U.S. POLICY AND INTEGRITY. HE TOOK HIS IN GOOD GRACE AND SAID HE ACCEPTED MY ASSURANCES.

HE THEN INDICATED THAT HE FELT THE NEED FOR A PUBLIC STATEMENT OF U.S. SUPPORT IN CURRENT CIRCUMSTANCES. HE SAID HE WOULD INDICATE TO THE PRESIDENT THAT SUCH A STATEMENT WOULD "CLEAR THE AIR HERE AND IN THE REGION."

ACTION REQUESTED: PLEASE ALERT THE PRESIDENT, PRIOR TO HIS 0800 TELEPHONE CALL, THAT THE SHAH WILL BE SEEKING FROM HIM SOME UNDERTAKING TO MAKE A PUBLIC INDICATION OF U.S. SUPPORT, SO THAT THE PRESIDENT CAN CONSIDER HOW TO HANDLE THIS. IT MIGHT BE POSSIBLE, FOR EXAMPLE, TO HAVE WHITE HOUSE SPOKESMAN ANNOUNCE THAT TELEPHONE CALL WAS MADE. SUCH ANNOUNCEMENT COULD ALSO BE VEHICLE FOR CONVEYING SHAH'S ASSURANCES (WHICH HE WILL PRESUMABLE MAKE TO PRESIDENT) CONCERNING CONTINUED DRIVE FOR LIBERALIZATION. SULLIVAN NOTE BY OC/T: NOT PASSED.

COURT OFFICIAL HAS TOLD US HE CAN FIND NO RECORD OF THIS CASE. THIRTY EIGHT CIVILIANS WERE ARRESTED IN ANOTHER TOWN AFTER THEY ATTENDED FUNERAL FOR WELL-KNOWN COMMUNIST. TWENTY THREE WERE RELEASED SHORTLY AFTER ARREST; FIFTEEN HAVE BEEN DETAINED.
IN VIEW OF RECENT DEVELOPMENTS WE ARE UNLIKELY TO BE IN A POSITION TO PURSUE THIS CASE MUCH FURTHER AT THIS TIME. REGARDS TO BILL BUTLER.

STROBE TATBOTT AND DEAN BROLIS, TIME MAGAZINE, HAD AN AUDIENCE WITH THE SHAH ON SEPTEMBER 9 AT 10:30 A.M. THIS MESSAGE, BASED ON EMBOFF'S CONVERSATION WITH THEM, REPORTS MATERIAL WHICH THE SHAH PROVIDED ON AN OFF-THE-RECORD BASIS. THE REMAINDER OF THE INTERVIEW WILL APPEAR IN THIS WEEK'S ISSUE OF TIME, WHICH WILL FEATURE A COVER STORY ON THE SHAH AND IRAN.

TALBOTT SAID THE SHAH"LOOKED AWFUL," DESCRIBING HIM AS A SHATTERED MAN WHO LOOKED TO BE ON THE BRINK OF A NERVOUS COLLAPSE. HE SAID THE SHAH TOLD THEM THAT PEOPLE CLOSE TO THE THRONE WHOM HE HAS ALWAYS TRUSTED IN THE PAST ARE TELLING HIM THAT THE CIA IS VERY ACTIVE IN THE CURRENT DISTURBANCES, TO THE POINT OF HAVING PENETRATED THE NATIONAL FRONT AT A HIGH LEVEL. HE DID NOT ELABORATE ON WHAT THE CIA'S MOTIVES WOULD BE IN DESTABILIZING HIS REGIME. THE SHAH ALSO REFERRED TO THE "BIG GAME," MUSING THAT PERHAPS THE U.S. HAD CONCEDED IRAN TO THE SOVIET OR "NEUTRAL" SPHERE OF INFLUENCE.
HE DID NOT ELABORATE ON EITHER THEME.

THE CORRESPONDENTS ASKED THE SHAH IF HE HAD CONSIDERED LEGALIZING THE TUDEH PARTY. HE REPLIED THAT HE HAD NO INTENTION OF DOING SO, AS A LEGAL TUDEH PARTY WOULD BE NO MORE THAN A "TROJAN HORSE," LIKE THE HUSAK FORCES IN CZECHOSLAVAKIA HAD BEEN IN 1968, WHICH COULD CONCEIVABLE INVITE THE SOVIETS TO INTERVENE IN IRAN UNDER THE BREZHNEV DOCTRINE.

THE CORRESPONDENTS ASKED THE SHAH IF HE WAS CONSIDERING ABDICATION IN FAVOR OF HIS SON. TALBOTT SAID THERE WAS A LONG PAUSE AFTER THIS QUESTION BEFORE THE SHAH REPLIES, "THAT IS A VERY EMBARRASSING QUESTION." AFTER ANOTHER PAUSE HE SAID,"FOR ME TO DO THAT WOULD BE EASY. I WOULD LIKE TO WAVE GOODBYE, BUT .... THAT WOULD BE A CATASTROPHE."

TALBOTT REPORTED THAT ALTHOUGH THE SHAH WAS CLEARLY DISAPPOINTED IN HIS COUNTRYMEN'S INABILITY TO COPE WITH THE LIBERALIZATION PROCESS, HE ALSO SHOWED OBVIOUS DISTASTE FOR THE CARTER ADMINISTRATION'S HUMAN RIGHTS POLICIES. WHEN ASKED IF SUCH POLICIES HAD AIDED HIS OPPONENTS, HE SMILED WRYLY AND SAID,"YOU WILL HAVE TO ASK THEM."

TALBOTT SAID THE INTERVIEW WAS SO NEGATIVE THAT HE TRIED TO GIVE THE SHAH A CHANCE TO SAY SOMETHING POSITIVE BY NOTING THAT THE FIRST NIGHT OF THE CURFEW HAD APPARENTLY GONE WELL. THE SHAH'S RESPONSE WAS THAT "IT'S TOO EARLY TO TELL."

TALBOTT HAD BEEN SCHEDULED TO GO TO ANKARA YESTERDAY TO INTERVIEW PREMIER ECEVIT, BUT TIME HAD DECIDED TO RUN THE IRAN STORY AS ITS FEATURE ARTICLE, SO HE STAYED THE EXTRA DAY TO INTERVIEW THE SHAH. HE IS NOW FLYING TO WASHINGTON TO TAKE A WEEK'S REST. BROLIS IS STILL IN TEHRAN, AND WILL BE AT THE HILTON (ROOM 1322) FOR THE NEXT WEEK.

DURING PAST THREE DAYS, I HAVE MET WITH FOREIGN MINISTER ASHRAF, EDUCATION MINISTER NAHAVANDI (LEADER OF LARGEST BLOC IN CURRENT GOVT), SENIOR MILITARY OFFICERS, AND HAD AN AUDIENCE OF OVER AN HOUR WITH THE SHAH. IT MAY BE USEFUL FOR DEPT AND INFO ADDRESSEES TO HAVE SOME FLAVOR OF THESE DISCUSSIONS.

THE FOREIGN MINISTER, WHOM I MET SEPT 8, SHORTLY AFTER DECLARATION OF MARTIAL LAW, SPENT MOST OF OUR MEETING EXPLAINING AND JUSTIFYING THE INTRODUCTION OF MARTIAL LAW. SINCE THE MEETING WAS AT HIS REQUEST, HE WAS WELL PREPARED WITH COPIES OF STATEMENTS MADE BY OPPOSITION, WITH TEXTS OF BANNERS DISPLAYED IN MANIFESTATION SEPT 7, AND WITH RATIONALE FOR GOVT ACTION. HE WAS UNWILLING TO CONCEDE ANY DEFICIENCIES ON THE PART OF THE SHAH OR THE GOVT AND PERSISTED IN DEPICTING THE DISTRUBANCES AS FOREIGN-INSPIRED. HE SHOWED LITTLE SENSITIVITY TO THE DEATHS THAT HAD OCCURRED IN THE CLASHES EARLIER THAT DAY AND INSISTED THAT NO MORE THAN TEN HAD DIED.
(HE LATER TELEPHONED ME AT HOME TO CHANGE THAT FIGURE TO "ABOUT 100.") HE SEEMED EAGER TO HAVE AN OFFICIAL U.S. REACTION TO EVENTS AND ASKED IF I HAD ANY VIEWS ABOUT NEXT STEPS IRAN MIGHT TAKE.

EDUCATION MINISTER NAHAVANDI, BY CONTRAST, INDICATED GREAT CONCERN OVER POSSIBLE CONSEQUENCES OF MARTIAL LAW. DURING SEPT 9 MEETING (WHICH WAS HELD AT MY REQUEST) HE CONTINUED TO RECEIVE TELEPHONE REPORTS ON VARIOUS POCKETS OF VIOLENCE THROUGHOUT CITY. HE SAID CABINET MEETING NIGHT OF SEPT 7 WHICH HAD DECIDED ON MARTIAL LAW HAD BEEN AN EMOTIONAL ONE, AND HAD BEEN HELD UPON THE INSISTENCE OF THE MILITARY. HE SAID HE AND HIS GROUP HAD REFUSED TO ACCEPT THESIS THAT "FOREIGNERS" HAD CAUSED ALL RECENT DISTURBANCES AND HAD PROPOSED SWEEPING REFORMS ("NETTOYAGE TOTALE").
HE OBVIOUSLY FEELS THAT HIS VIEWS HAVE NOT RPT NOT BEEN ADEQUATELY ACCEPTED AND HAS ISSUED A PUBLIC STATEMENT SAYING THAT REFORMS MUST FOLLOW MARTIAL LAW.

HE THEN WENT ON TO MAKE "ONE OBSERVATION INFANTILE." HE SAID THE UNITED STATES GOVT COULD PLAY A KEY ROLE IN CURRENT SITUATION. PERHAPS WE HAD MORE INFLUENCE WITH SHAH THAN THE GOVT DID. WE SHOULD ACT TO USE THAT INFLUENCE. "FAITES VITE."

IN TALKING TO SENIOR MILITARY OFFICERS, I FIND THEM, ON THE SURFACE, EXPRESSING GREAT SATISFACTION WITH DECLARATION OF MARTIAL LAW. THEY, LIKE THE FOREIGN MINISTER EXPAND AT GREAT LENGTH ON THE MALICIOUS INTENTIONS OF THE DEMONSTRATORS AND THE EXTENT OF THE THREAT TO THE NATION. IN THE COURSE OF DETAILED DISCUSSION, HOWEVER, THEY DISPLAY REAL NERVOUSNESS ABOUT FUTURE COURSE OF EVENTS. THEY EXPECT TERRORISM, SABOTAGE, AND INDUSTRIAL STRIKES. THEY WERE CLEARLY SHAKEN BY THE SIZE AND ORGANIZATION OF THE DEMONSTRATIONS, PARTICULARLY THAT OF SEPT 7.

AS FOR THE SHAH, WHOM I MET SEPT 10, I FOUND HIM TIRED AND UNHAPPY, BUT CONSIDERABLY MORE SPIRITED THAN HE WAS A WEEK AGO.HE DISPLAYED CONSIDERABLY GREATER ------------------075399 101435Z /46 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 246 INFO AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY CAIRO AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS AMEMBASSY TEL AVIV SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 08614 LIMDIS SENSITIVITY TO THE DEATHS THAT HAD OCCURRED THAN DID HIS FOREIGN MINISTER. HE PERSISTS IN SAYING THAT HE SEES THE SOVIET HAND IN ALL THE DEMONSTRATIONS AND DISTURBANCES THAT HAVE TAKEN PLACE.

AT THE SAME TIME, HE SAYS THAT "PAST MISTAKES" MUST BE CORRECTED. HE SAYS HE HAS ORDERED A CAMPAIGN AGAINST CORRUPTION. NINE ARRESTS HAVE ALREADY BEEN MADE AND WILL SHORTLY BE ANNOUNCED. MORE ASSISTANCE WILL BE GIVEN THE COUNTRYSIDE. THE PROCESS OF LIBERALIZATION WILL CONTINUE. LEGISLATION ON FREEDOM OF ASSEMBLY AND OF PRESS WILL BE INTRODUCED INTO THE PARLIAMENT. THE ELECTIONS WILL BE HELD-AS FREE ELECTIONS-IN JUNE.

HE IS EAGER FOR SOME PUBLIC EXPRESSION OF U.S. SUPPORT FOR HIM, FOR HIS REGIME, AND FOR HIS PROGRAM. HE HAS A MORE COHERENT PLAN OF ACTION THAN HE EARLIER DISPLAYED. HE CATEGORICALLY ESCHEWS ANY SUGGESTION THAT HE WILL ABDICATE OR FLEE THE CURRENT SITUATION. ON THE OTHER HAND, HE DOES NOT MINIMIZE THE PROBLEMS HE FACES. HE REALIZES THAT MARTIAL LAW MAY FORCE HIS OPPOSITION UNDERGROUND AND INTO ACTS OF TERRORISM AND SABOTAGE. HE IS CONCERNED THAT A WAVE OF INDUSTRIAL STRIKES MAY BE IN THE OFFING. HE APPRECIATES THAT THE IMAGE OF MARTIAL LAW WILL BE OFFENSIVE TO MANY INTERNATIONALY, INCLUDING THE UNITED STATES.

THE NET IMPRESSION I DERIVE FROM THESE SEVERAL INTERVIEWS IS THAT THE ESTABLISHMENT IN IRAN IS BADLY SHAKEN BY RECENT EVENTS. THERE IS STILL A STRONG ELEMENT, NOT ONLY IN THE MILITARY, BUT ALSO IN THE CABINET WHICH FAVORS THE RETURN TO A HARSH, AUTHORITARIAN ROLE TO SUPPRESS THE OPPOSITION. THERE IS, AT THE SAME TIME, A SIGNIFICANT GROUP IN THE LEADERSHIP THAT BELIEVES REPRESSIVE ACTION WILL NOT WORK AND THAT THE TIME IS OVERDUE FOR ACTIONS WHICH WILL MEET LEGITIMATE GRIEVANCES. THE SHAH, IN THE PAST FEW WEEKS, HAS PLAYED A HAMLET-LIKE ROLE, WITHOUT ASSERTING HIS INFLUENCE IN EITHER DIRECTION.

HE SEEMS, AS OF TODAY, TO HAVE RECOVERED SOME OF HIS FORMER CONFIDENCE AND TO HAVE RESUMED CONTROL OF GOVERNMENTAL ACTION. HE IS CONVINCING WHEN HE SAYS THAT HE HAS SIDED WITH THOSE WHO WANT REFORMAND WE CAN EXPECT HIM TO ATTEMPT TO CARRY OUT THOSE CHANGES.

IT IS STILL TOO EARLY, HOWEVER, TO ESTIMATE WHETHER HE WILL BE ABLE TO DO WHAT HE SAYS HE WANTS TO DO WHILE HE IS SADDLED WITH THE HUBRIS OF A SULLEN POPULATION CHAFING AT THE IMPOSITION OF MARTIAL LAW.

AMIR ABAS HOVEYDA RESIGNED SEPT. 9 AS COURT MINISTER. NO REPLACEMENT HAS BEEN NAMED. GENERAL NASROLLAH AMIR FAZLI HAS REPLACED GENERAL ALI MOHAMMAD KHADEMI AS MANAGING DIRECTOR OF IRAN AIR. KHADEMI RESIGNED SEPT. 5.

TWO RESIGNATIONS TEND TO CONFIRM RUMORS REPORTED IN REFTEL THAT MULLAHS HAVE DEMANDED THEIR OUSTER DUE TO ALLEGED BAHAIISM. KHADEMI WAS FLATLY ACCUSED OF BEING BAHAI (OUR RECORDS SHOW HE IS A BAHAI). CASE AGAINST HOVEYDA IS LESS CLEAR. HE CLEARLY PRACTICES ISLAM BUT IS NONETHELESS TAINTED BY HIS FATHER'S LINKS WITH BAHAI SECT.

1978TEHRAN08616.subject: MARTIAL LAW REPORT: MOURNING DAY SET FOR SEPT 12 IN TEHRAN: GOI PROGRAM GOES TO PARLIAMENT

segments.text: SUMMARY: MINOR VIOLENCE FLARED IN TEHRAN SEPT 9 AND 10 AND ISFAHAN SEPT 10, BUT SITUATION IS QUIETING DOWN. MANY CITIES' BAZAARS REMAIN CLOSED SINCE SEPT 7 OR 8. MARTIAL LAW OFFICERS HAVE BEEN INSTRUCTED TO ENFORCE REGULATIONS MORE RIGOROUSLY. NEWS PHOTOS NOW BEING CENSORED. OFFICIAL TEHRAN DEATH TOLL FOR SEPT 8 NOW SET AT 86, BUT 300 PROBABLY MORE ACCURATE. RELIGIOUS LEADERS SOMEWHAT SPLIT ON REACTION TO ARMY CRUSHING SEPT 8 DEMONSTRATION, BUT BOTH FACTIONS CRITICIZE THOSE RESPONSIBLE. GOI PRESENTED PROGRAM TO PARLIAMENT; EIGHT DEPUTIES WALKED OUT. END SUMMARY.

TROOPS FIRED SHOTS IN AIR NEAR TEHERAN'S BAZAAR TO BREAK UP BRAWL AND THERE WERE MINOR SCUFFLES ELSEWHERE IN CITY SEPT 9. ON SEPT 10 THERE WAS VERY SPORADIC SHOOTING IN SOUTH TEHRAN. IN CONVERSATION OVERHEARD AT A MARTIAL LAW SUBHEADQUARTERS, AMERICAN WHO SPOKE FARSI (THIS WAS UNKNOWN TO OFFICER IN CHARGE) OVERHEARD COMMANDING GENERAL DESCRIBE INCIDENT MORNING OF SEPT 10 AT AN "ECONOMIC FACULTY" (WHICH COULD HAVE BEEN TEHRAN UNIVERSITY OR NATIONAL UNIVERSITY) DURING WHICH 200 DEMONSTRATORS HAD BEEN FIRED UPON SEPT 10 RESULTING IN SUBSTANTIAL NUMBER OF DEAD.

GENERAL WAS AGHAST AND ISSUED IMMEDIATE ORDERS FOR NORTHERN TEHRAN SECTOR TROOPS TO REVIEW STANDING ORDER TO FIRE ONLY INTO AIR OR AT PAVEMENT UNLESS DIRECTLY ATAACKED. IN OTHER TEHRAN DEVELOPMENTS, MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR AFTERNOON SEPT 10 ANNOUNCED RELAXATION OF CURFEW HOURS FROM 10 P.M. INSTEAD OF 9 P.M. TO 5 A.M. RELIGIOUS LEADERS, INCLUDING SHARIATMADARI, CALLED FOR SEPT 11 TO BE A DAY OF MOURNING (3RD DAY AFTER SEPT 8 DEATHS). IT IS NOT RPT NOT CLEAR WHETHER THIS IS TO BE PEACEFUL DAY OF MOURNING OR MAY INCLUDE DEMONSTRATIONS WITH POTENTIAL FOR VIOLENCE.

ISFAHAN, SHIRAZ AND TABRIZ CONSULS REPORT THOSE CITIES QUIET FOR ENTIRE WEEKEND, EXCEPT IN ISFAHAN WHERE CROWDS APPARENTLY BURNED FOUR BUILDINGS NEAR SITE OF EARLY AUGUST DISTURBANCES ON MORNING OF SEPT 10. IN MASHAD, QUIET REIGNED FOR PAST FOUR DAYS EXCEPT SEPT 8, WHEN MASS PRAYER MEETING CALLED IN DEFIANCE OF MARTIAL LAW WAS SCATTERED BY TROOPS WITH SOME SHOOTING AND POSSIBLE LOSS OF LIFE.

BAZAARS IN MOST MAJOR CITIES REMAIN CLOSED OVER WEEKEND, AND TEHRAN MEDIA REPORTED ALL QUIET ELSEWHERE IN COUNTRY. MARTIAL LAW CURFEW HOURS GENERALLY BEING FOLLOWED, BUT THERE MAY HAVE BEEN SCATTERED INCIDENTS AROUND COUNTRY, OF WHICH WE ARE UNAWARE. FIRE BROKE OUT IN KHORRAMSHAR WAREHOUSE SEPT 8, BUT NO CAUSE HAS BEEN ASSIGNED YET.

SENIOR LOCAL JOURNALIST INFORMS US MARTIAL LAW OFFICERS HAVE TOLD HIM THEY HAVE BEEN INSTRUCTED TO APPLY REGULATIONS MORE RIGOROUSLY. HE HIMSEL HAD TO GO TO POLICE STATION TO BAIL OUT HIS PHOTOGRAPHER WHO WAS TAKING PICTURES ILLEGALLY. SOURCE ALSO SAYS FOR FIRST TIME IN IRAN, MARTIAL LAW CENSORSHIP IS BEING EXERCISED ON NEWS PHOTOS GOING OUTSIDE THE COUNTRY.
