LOCAL PRESS GENERALLY APPROVES MARTIAL LAW ON EDITORIAL SIDE, BUT BOTH ENGLISH PAPERS CALL FOR LOOK BEYOND MARTIAL LAW TO MEASURES GOI MUST TAKE TO SATISFY COUNTRY IN THE LONGER TERM. NEWS COVERAGE CONTINUES TO BE FULL AND COMPLETE BUT NOTHING CARRIED SEPT 10 REGARDING RELIGIOUS LEADERS'VIEWS. GOI HAS SAID 86 DEATH CERTIFICATES HAVE BEEN ISUED, BUT SEVERAL SOURCES, INCLUDING GOVERNMENTCONNECTED ONES WILLING TO ADMIT PRIVATELY THAT BEST ESTIMATE OF TOTAL DEAD PROBABLY AROUND 250 TO 300.

IN STATEMENT CARRIED OUT OF PARIS BY AFP, AYATOLLAH KHOMHINI SAYS RECENT DEMONSTRATIONS SHOW THAT THE PEOPLE WANT THE DEPARTURE OF THE SHAH AND DISMANTLING OF HIS REGIME. HE APPLAUDED THE ARMY FOR NOT FIRING ON THE PEOPLE SEPT 7 AND CALLED THIS THE "DECISIVE HOUR" FOR THE IRANIAN PEOPLE TO GET RID OF THE SHAH. AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI, ALSO IN AFP STATEMENT OUT OF PARIS, CALLED FOR "REVENGE FROM GOD" ON THOSE RESPONSIBLE FOR DEATHS. SHARIATMADARI CAREFULLY SKIRTED ISSUE OF EXACTLY WHO WAS TO BLAME FOR DEATHS, HOWEVER, BUT NOTED THAT "CERTAIN ELEMENTS" ARE TRYING TO DISRUPT RELIGIOUS UNITY.
HE URGED VERY CORRECT BEHAVIOR ON MOSLEMS TO AVOID GIVING EXCUSES TO "COLONIALSISTS AND TYRANTS."

GOI PRESENTED ITS PROGRAM TO MAJLES SEPT 10, AND WILL MAKESAME PRESENTATION TO SECTATE SEPT 11 (SUBSTANCE WILLBE COVERED SEPTEL, BUT THERE WERE NO REAL SURPRISES). PAN IRANIST PARTY LEADER PEZESHKPOUR AND SEVEN OTHER DEPTUIES WALKED OUT ON PRIME MINISTER, AND GADFLY DEPUTY BANI-AHMAD DID NOT ATTEND THE SESSION, HAVING GONE ON A HUNGER STRIKE UNTIL THE PRESENT GOVERNEMENT RESIGNS. MAJLES SPEAKER CLOSED SESSION IMMEDIATELY AFTER PRIMIN SPOKE AND SAID DEBATE ON MOTION WILL BEGIN SEPT 12, WITH 25 GOVERNEMENT SPEAKERS AND FOUR OPPOSITION ONES INSCRIBED ON SCHEDULE.

1978TEHRAN08647.subject: SHAH ON VISIT OF GENERAL ZIA

segments.text: SHAH TOLD ME SEPT 10 THAT HIS DISCUSSIONS WITH GENERAL ZIA AL HAQ HAD GONE REASONABLY WELL. HE SAID ZIA HAD REPORTED FROM HIS VISIT TO KABUL, THAT HE WAS CONVINCED AFGHANISTAN HAD GONE IRRETRIEVABLY COMMUNIST. HE SAID HE AND ZIA BOTH AGREED THAT SOVIETS WOULD NEVER LET COUNTRY OUT OF THEIR GRIP.

THEY HAD ALSO SPENT CONSIDERABLE TIME DISCUSSING HTE MECHANICS OF MARTIAL LAW. HE SAID ZIA HAD SOME GOOD ADVICE ON WAYS OF MAINTAINING CROWD CONTROL WITHOUT CAUSING FATALITIES. SHAH SEEMED PARTICULARLY INTERESTED IN OBTAINING RUBBER BULLETS AND OTHER SOPHISTICATED EQUIPMENT WHICH HE UNDERSTOOD JAPANESE MANUFACTURED.

THERE WAS ALSO CONSIDERABLE DISCUSSION ON PAKISTAN POSTURE WITH RESPECT TO CENTO. HE SAID HE TOLD ZIA THAT CONTINUING PAKISTAN MEMBERSHIP WAS A MATTER FOR PAKISTAN GOVT TO DECIDE. HOWEVER, HE THOUGHT SYMOBLISM OF PAKISTANI WITHDRAWAL AT THIS TIME WOULD BE DISRUPTIVE. (IT IS HIS UNDERSTANDING THAT CHINESE ARE GIVING PAKISTANIS THE SAME ADVISE, BUT MORE VEHEMENTLY.)

SHAH SAID THAT HE WAS ESPECIALLY TROUBLED THAT SOME OF ZIA'S ADVISERS WERE SUGGESTING THAT A GESTURE OF WITHDRAWAL FROM CENTO WOULD IMPROVE RELATIONS WITH THE SOVIETS. HE SAID ZIA POINTED OUT THAT PAKISTANI AIRLINES COULD NOT EVEN FLY TO MOSCOW. SHAH REJOINED BY STATING THAT IRAN AIR FLIES REGULARLY TO MOSCOW WHILE IRAN REMAINS A STEADFAST MEMBER OF CENTO.
IN AN ASIDE, SHAH SAID THAT HE THOUGHT AGHA SHAHI WAS RESPONSIBLE FOR MOST OF THE BAD ADVICE ZIA WAS GETTING ON FOREIGN AFFAIRS. HE DESCRIBED HIM AS "SOME STRANGE KIND OF FISH."

1978TEHRAN08648.subject: POSSIBLE MUZOREWA VISIT TO IRAN : STATE 229090

segments.text: STATE 229090
SHAH INFORMED ME SEPT 10 THAT BISHOP MUZOREWA HAD COME TO TEHRAN OVER THE WEEKEND BECAUSE SHAH HAD SENT WORD TO HIM IN LONDON THAT IRAN FELT BISHOP SHOULD ATTEND ALL-PARTY CONFERENCE.

HE SAIE BISHOP HAD MADE RATHER EMOTIONAL PRESENTATION OF HIS POSITION, MAINTAINING THAT OVERWHELMING MAJORITY OF ZIMBABWE PEOPLE SUPPORTED HIM AND THAT HE HAE NO REASON TO SHARE POWER WITH NKOMO. SHAH SAID HE GAVE BISHOP A "COLD SHOWER" BY POINTING OUT THAT NKOMO HAD THE GUNS WHILE THE BISHOP HAD NONE AND THAT SOME SORT OF UNDERSTANDING WITH THE MILITARY LEADERS WOULD SEEM PRUDENT.

HAH WENT ON TO TELL ME THAT HE HAD NO WAY TO MAKE INDEPENDENT ASSES MENT OF RHODESIAN SITUATION BUT WAS RELYING ON BRITISH-AMERICAN JUDGEMENT BECAUSE HE ASSUMED OUR INTERESTS PARALLELED THOSE OF IRAN. HE THEREFORE COUNSELLED MUZOREWA TO ACCEPT BRITISH ADVICE AND GUIDANCE.

HE SAID HE GAVE MUZOREWA SOME MONEY, ENCOURAGED HIM TO THINK CONSTRUCTIVELY AND CAME AWAY WITH THE IMPRESSION THAT MUZOREWA WOULD RELUCTANTLY AGREE TO ATTEND ALL-PARTY CONFERENCE. IT IS MY UNDERSTANDING THAT BISHOP HAS FLOWN BACK TO LONDON. SULLIVAN #8648

1978TEHRAN08659.subject: SHARIF-EMAMI GOVERNMENT PRESENTS PROGRAM TO MAJLES

segments.text: SUGGESTING AS A MINIMUM A "LOW PROFILE" FOR SUCH "HIGH TECHNOLOGY" ACTIVITIES).

FOREIGN AFFAIRS AND DEFENSE WERE COVERED BRIEFLY NEAR THE END OF SPEECH, REFLECTING SHARIF-EMAMI'S FOCUS ON DOMESTIC AFFAIRS. HE SAID NATIONAL DEFENSE WILL BE KEPT STRONG TO INSURE IRAN'S INDEPENDENCE, ECONOMIC GROWTH AND SOCIAL WELFARE POLICIES. HE REAFFIRMED IRAN'S "INDEPENDENT NATIONAL FOREIGN POLICY", INCLUDING RESPECT FOR OTHERS' RIGHT OF INDEPENDENCE, NON-INTERFERENCE IN OTHERS' INTERNAL AFFAIRS, PROMOTION OF PEACE BASED ON THE U.N. CHARTER.

IN POST-SPEECH STATEMENT, MINISTER OF STATE FOR EXECUTIVE AFFAIRS AZMOUN CONFIRMED THAT MARTIAL LAW WAS "AN INTERIM SOLUTION" WHICH GOI HAD TAKEN WITH "UTMOST REGRET." HE CONCEDED THAT FOR A LIMITED PERIOD, ACTIVITIES OF POLITICAL GROUPS WOULD HAVE TO BE SUSPENDED SO THAT FAVORABLE CIRCUMSTANCES FOR THE REVIVAL OF THOSE GROUPS MAY BE ESTABLISHED. GOI SPOKESMAN ALSO SAID GOVERNMENT HAS DECIDED TO COMPENSATE VICTIMS FOR DAMAGES SUFFERED DURING RECENT DEMONSTRATIONS (ASSESSMENTS TO BE WORKED OUT WITH LOCAL GOVERNING AUTHORITIES), AND THAT MINISTRY OF INFORMATION WOULD REVIEW BANNED PUBLICATIONS WITH AN EYE TO RESCINDING THE BANNINGS.

PARLIAMENTARY SESSION WAS HELD IN PEACE, THOUGH TANKS AND TROOPS RINGED BUILDING IN CASE OF TROUBLE. EIGHT OPPOSITION DEPUTIES WALKED OUT (REFTEL), AND PERSIAN PRESS CARRIED STATEMENT BY PAN IRANIST LEADER PEZESHKPOUR THAT HE COULD NOT ACCEPT PRIME MINISTER, WHO "HAS BLOOD ON HIS HANDS." GENERAL REACTION OF DEPUTIES TO GOI'S NEW PROGRAM WAS POSITIVE, BUT DEBATE IS EXPECTED TO BELIVELY WHEN IT BEGINS SEPT. 12.

EMBASSY'S INITIAL REACTION TO PROGRAM IS THAT IT IS GOOD GENERAL FORMULATION WHICH WILL COMMAND WIDESPREAD SUPPORT. CRITICAL QUESTION, HOWEVER, IS HOW FAST GOI CAN MOVE TO IMPLEMENT PRIME MINISTER'S PROGRAM AND CONVINCE FENCE-SITTERS AND OPPOSITIONISTS THAT GOI IS SERIOUS ABOUT POLITICAL FREEDOM AND SOCIAL JUSTICE. EVIDENCE IS ALREADY SEEN OF CURRENT BUDGET WITH REALLOCATIONS, I.E., FROM MILITARY TO AGRICULTURE; AS WELL AS CURRENT ACCOUNT SAVINGS EFFORTS. ROUNDUP OF INDIVIDUALS ON CORRUPTION CHARGES WHICH HAS ALREADY STARTED IS HAVING POSITIVE IMPACT OUT OF PROPORTION TO LIMITED RESULTS SO FAR.

OUR INITIAL CONTACT WITH OPPOSITIONISTS SINCE PROGRAM ANNOUNCED SUGGESTS SUBSTANTIAL AMOUNT OF CONFUSION OVER PROGRAM, ANGER AT GOI FOR ARRESTING SOME OPPOSITIONIST FIGURES, AND UNCERTAINTY WHETHER TO LIE LOW OR TO CONTINUE CONFRONTATION. FOR OPPOSITION, AS FOR GOI, NEXT FEW DAYS AND WEEKS ARE GOING TO BE REAL TIME OF SOULSEARCHING. IF GOI CAN MOVE RAPIDLY ON ITS PROGRAM, THIS MAY OFFSET TO SOME DEGREE IMPOSITION OF MARTIAL LAW AND MAKE POINT THAT GOI DOES WANT TO OPEN POLITICAL ATMOSPHERE BUT WILL NOT TOLERATE VIOLENCE.

SUMMARY: OFFICIAL DEATH TOLL FROM SEPT 8 SHOOTING HAS REACHED 95, BUT TEHRAN REMAINED RELATIVELY QUIET SEPT. 10 TO MIDDAY SEPT. 11. DAY OF MOURNING THREE DAYS AFTER SEPT 8 DEATHS DID NOT, CONTRARY TO SOME EXPECTATIONS, PRODUCE CROWDS GATHERING IN DEFIENCE OF MARTIAL LAW. OCCASIONAL SOUND OF GUNFIRE CAN GENERALLY BE ATTRIBUTED TO MILITARY POLICY OF FIRING IN THE AIR FOR EFFECT. PERSONAL INSPECTION BY CONSULATE ISFAHAN DOES NOT CONFIRM PREVIOUS REPORTS OF PROPERTY DAMAGE MORNING SEPT. 10. WIDESPREAD ARRESTS FOR CORRUPTION OR SECURITY OFFENSES TOOK PLACE SEPT. 11. END SUMMARY.

OFFICIAL DEATH TOLL FROM SEPT . 8 STREET BATTLE HAS REACHED 95, BUT TEHRAN REMAINED RELATIVELY QUIET SEPT. 10 THROUGH MIDDAY SEPT 11. THERE ARE NO NEW REPORTS OF DEATHS, INJURY OR PROPERTY DAMAGE. ALTHOUGH SEPT. 11 IS A TRADITIONAL DAY OF MOURNING (THREE DAYS AFTER DEATHS SEPT. 8 IN JALEH SQUARE) CROWDS HAVE NOT ASSEMBLED IN DEFIANCE OF MARTIAL LAW. GUNFIRE WAS HEARD THROUGHOUT NIGHT SEPT. 10-11, ESPECIALLY IN SOUTH TEHRAN, BUT THIS PROBABLY ATTRIBUTABLE TO SECURITY FORCES POLICY OF FIRING INTO THE AIR TO HALT OR DETER VIOLATORS. RUMORS OF REAL OR IMPENDING DISASTER ARE NONETHELESS FLOURISHING; THE GERMAN COMMUNITY IS PARTICULARLY ON EDGE.

CONSULATE ISFAHAN INSPECTED SITES OF RUMORED PROPERTY DAMAGE REPORTED REFTEL, BUT SAW NO EVIDENCE OF DESTRUCTION. ISFHAN DID EXPERIENCE DEMONSTRATIONS MORNING SEPT. 10, BUT THESE WERE DISPERSED BY MARTIAL LAW TROOPS. BAZAAR HAS DEFIED MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATION BY CLOSING SHOPS. EIGHTY PERCENT WERE CLOSED SEPT. 10. AFTER MILITARY GOVERNOR ISFAHAN WARNED SHOPKEEPERS THEY MUST KEEP BUSINESSES OPEN, MOST CLOSED SEPT. 11.
CONSULATE SHIRAZ REPORTS QUIET CONDITIONS AFTER SOME TURMOIL FIRST DAY OF MARTIAL LAW. SHOPS ARE CLOSED THERE ALSO.

WIDESPREAD ARRESTS FOR EITHER SECURITY OR CORRUPTION OFFENSES TOOK PLACE SEPT. 11 AND MORE ARE EXPECTED TO FOLLOW. MARTIAL LAW FORCES IN SHIRAZ ARRESTED TWO CLERGYMEN-MULLAH MESHUHEE AND MULLAH TAHERI. SECURITY FORCES IN ISFAHAN ARRESTED SIX MEN ALLEGED TO BE CONSPIRATORS BEHIND THE VIOLENCE THERE. ATTORNEY AHMAD GHAISARI, EX-NATIONAL FRONTER WHO WAS EXPECTED TO BECOME INF PARTY LEADER IN ISFAHAN, IS UNDER ARREST AS RINGLEADER. OTHERS ARE FAGHIH IMANI, HOJATOLLAH TAHERI (NOT THE TAHERI WHOSE ARREST SPARKED RIOTING AND LED TO MARTIAL LAW IN ISFAHAN), HOJATOLLAH NIRDAMADI, DR. SAED HOSSEIN VAEZI (A PHARMACIST WHO ALLEGEDLY MADE FIREBOMBS), AND FOULADGAR (FIRST NAME UNKNOWN).

IN TEHRAN, EIGHT PROMINENT MEN ARE JAILED UNDER ARTICLE 5 OF MARTIAL LAW ACT (OPPOSING CONSTITUTIONAL GOVERNEMENT AND LAW AND ORDER). NO SPECIFIC CHARGES HAVE BEEN FILED, ALTHOUGH IT APPEARS THE CHARGE WILL BE CORRUPTION. DR. SHOJAEDIN SHEIKHOLESLAMZADEH, FORMER MINISTER OF HEALTH, HEADS THE LIST. OTHERS ARE HIS TWO FORMER UNDERSECRETARIES, ASSADOLLAH NILI-ARAM AND MOHAMMAD REZA NEGHABAT; FORMER HEAD OF THE GUILDS CHAMBER RASOUL RAHIMI; ALI-ASGHAR RAZAZIAN, IRAN'S BIGGEST FRUIT IMPORTER; MOHAMMAD ALI NAGHIB-ZADEH, FORMER MANAGING DIRECTOR OF THE EDUCATORS COOPERATIVE; BAGHER AMELI, FORMER MANAGING DIRECTOR OF RURAL AND TOWN COOPERATIVE; AND SAREBANHA (FNU), OWNER OF MAJOR TRUCKING FIRM.

GOI ANNOUNCED SEPT. 11 THAT HIGH MINISTRY OF JUSTICE OFFICIALS, INCLUDING THE ATTORNEY GENERAL OF TEHRAN, HAVE BEEN REPLACED. GOVERNMENT ALSO ANNOUNCED, WITHOUT GIVEING ANY DETAILS, A MAJOR REORGANIZATION OF NATIONAL IRANIAN OIL COMPANY.

1978TEHRAN08714.subject: OPPOSITION LEADERS ARRESTED OR BEING SOUGHT; CONTROVERSY SEPT 8 OVER DEATHS; 333 ANTI-STATE SECURITY PRISONERS RELEASED

segments.text: CONTROVERSY SEPT 8 OVER DEATHS; 333 ANTI-STATE SECURITY PRISONERS RELEASED REF (A) TEHRAN 8563 (B) TEHRAN 8670 SUMMARY: SOME OPPOSITION LEADERS, INCLUDING HUMAN RIGHTS FIGURES, HAVE BEEN ARRESTED; OTHERS ARE BEING SOUGHT. COMMITTEE FOR DEFENSE OF HUMAN RIGHTS AND FREEDOM (CDHRF) CLAIMS MORE KILLED IN SEPT 8 RIOT THAN GOI WILLING TO CONCEDE. NEWSMEN DOUBT COMMITTEE CLAIM. GOI ANNOUNCES RELEASE OF 333 ANTI-STATE SECURITY PRISONERS OVER PAST WEEK. NEIGHER MORTEZA MOHIT NOR FATEMEH NASRI-GHAJARI ERER ON LIST. END SUMMARY

SECOND OPPOSITION SOURCE HAS CONFIRMED ARREST OF DR. MEHDI BAZARGAN AND DR. MOFATEH REPORTED REF A. SOURCE ALSO SAID WARRANTS ARE DEFINITELY OUT FOR DR. ALI ASGHAR HAJ SEYED JAVADI, PROMINENT WRITER AND DR. ABDUL KARIM LAHIDJI, LAWYER WHO HAS DEFENDED HUMAN RIGHTS CASES, BUT BOTH ARE "STAYING WITH FRIENDS" FOR TIME BEING. ENG. RAMATOLLAH MOQHADDAM-MARAGHEI, RADICAL MOVEMENT CHIEF, IS ALSO UNDER ARREST, CDHRF SECRETARY DR. NASSER MINATCHI IS ALSO WANTED FOR QUESTIONING SINCE HIS RETURN TO IRAN ON SEPT 8, DAY MARTIAL LAW WAS DECLARED.

COINCIDENTALLY, MINATCHI CALLED ON DEPUTY POL SECTION HEAD STEMPEL SEPT 11 TO ESTABLISH CONTACT AS RESULT OF HIS RECENT MEETING IN WASHINGTON WITH HA'S MARK SCHNEIDER. HE CONFIRMED HE WAS WANTED BY SAVAK FOR QUESTIONING AND SAID HE WOULD BE CHECKING IN WITH SAVAK DURING COURSE OF DAY SEPT 12. HE ALSO INDICATED CDHRF HAD EVIDENCE THAT SEPT 8 RIOTS PRODUCED MORE DEATHS THAN GOI CLAIMS. STATEMENT OF EVIDENCE WAS BEING TRANSMITTED TO SCHNEIDER AND TO INTERNATIONAL LEAGUE OF HUMAN RIGHTS BY CABLE, BUT MINATCHI WANTED EMBASSY TO KNOW DETAILS AND ASKED TO BE PUT IN TOUCH WITH SOME NEWSMEN(EMBOFF DID SO).

CDHRF STORY IS THAT REGISTRATION OF BODIES AT ONLY TEHRAN CEMETARY EXCEEDED NORMAL 750-800 PER DAY BODY COUNT BY 2000 ON SEPT 9 AND BY 1000 ON SEPT 19. MINATCHI CLAIMED THESE EXTRAS COULD BE CONSIDERED RIOT VICTIMS, BASED ON EVIDENCE OF WITNESSES WHO HAD BEEN NEAR JALEH SQUARE. EMBOFF RECOMMENDED HE TELL STORY TO NEWSMEN WHO MIGHT BE IN BETTER POSITION TO CHECK CLAIMS.

FOLLOWING MINATCHI SESSION, STEMPEL HAD OPPORTUNITY FOR EXTENDED DISCUSSION WITH THREE NEWSMEN WHO HAD VISITED TEHRAN CEMETARY SEPT 9 AND 10 PRIOR TO LEARNING OF MINATCHI STORY. ALL THREE DOUBTED CDFHR FIGURES BASED ON THEIR REVIEW OF CEMETARY BURIALS ON THOSE TWO DAYS. AT LEAST ONE OTHER PRESSMAN WILL BE CHECKING REGISTRATION BOOKS AND EMBASSY MAY BE FORTUNATE ENOUGH IN COMING WEEK TO GET YET ANOTHER INDEPENDENT ASSESSMENT OF CDFHR CLAIMS. VERTERAN U.S.

NEWSMAN WHO HAS HAD SOME THREE YEARS' EXPERIENCE ESTIMATED TEHRAN CROWDS AND WITNESSED EVENTS SAID THERECOULD NOT HAVE BEEN MORE THAN 2,000-3,000 PEOPLE IN JALEH SQUARE WHEN FIRING STARTED SEPT 8; DISIDENT CLAIM THAT THERE WERE 6,000-7,000 THERE IS "RIDICULOUS". HIS OWN ESTIMATE OF DEAD IS IN RANGE OF 300-500.

PRESS MORNING SEPT 12 CARRIES STATEMENT FROM "AUTHORITATIVE SOURCES" THAT GOI HAS RELEASED 333 PRISONERS CONVICTED OF ANTI-STATE ACTIVITIES OVER PAST WEEK. FULL LIST GIVEN IN PERSIAN PRESS IS BEING POUCHED DEPT, BUT QUICK SCAN INDICATES MORTEZA MOHIT AND FATEMEH NASRI-GHAJARI WERE NOT RPT NOT AMONG GROUP. JUST ANNOUNCED SHAKEUP IN JUDICIARY (REF B) WILL MAKE IT MORE DIFFICULT TO NAIL DOWN TOTALS AND OTHER DETAILS UNTIL DUST SETTLES.

1978TEHRAN08766.subject: SHAIKH YAYHA ALAMEH NOURI ARRESTED FOR INCITING RIOT

segments.text: SUMMARY: SHAIKH NOURI'S ARREST WAS ANNOUNCED SEPT. 12 BY MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES ON CHARGES OF INCITING TO RIOT. GOI CLAIMS EVIDENCE FOUND SHOWS HE WAS INCITING RIOTS AND PLANNING ARSON, MOST IMPRESSIVE REVELATION WAS SIZE OF FAMILY BANK ACCOUNTS FOUND IN NOURI HOME, TOTALING NEARLY A MILLION DOLLARS. NOURI IS A SENIOR FIGURE WHO HAS SUPPORTED KHOMEINI AND IS A LEADING ANTI-SEMITE AMONG MULLAHS. END SUMMARY.

RADIO EVENING SEPT 12 AND PRESS MORNING SEPT 13 CARRIED MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATION (MLA) STATEMENT ANNOUNCING ARREST OF SENIOR AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI SUPPORTER SHAIKH YAYHA ALLAMEH NOURI ON CHARGES OF INCITING RIOTS AND INSTIGATING ARSON, (COMMENT: NOURI'S NAME IS SOMETIMES GIVEN AS SHAIKH YAHYA NASSIR OR NASSIRI, KNOWN AS NOURI, WHO "SOMETIMES ADDS TITLE ALLAMA TO HIS NAME." NOURI IS WELL-KNOWN RELIGIOUS FIGURE WHO HAS USED TITLE "AYATOLLAH" IN SOME OF HIS PREVIOUS PUBLIC PRONOUNCEMENTS, INCLUDING MAJOR ANTI-SEMITIC WORKS DESCRIBED REFTELS.)

STATEMENT SAYS MLA HAS EVIDENCE INCLUDING DOCUMENTS, TAPES, AND TELEPHONE CALLS WHICH SHOW NOURI INCITED PEOPLE TO REVOLT AGAINST GOI AND URGED PEOPLE TO BURN BANKS, MOVIE HOUSES, SHOPS AND PUBLIC BUILDINGS. HE ALLEGEDLY ORDERED SUPPLIES OF GAS AND SAWDUST TO BE DISTRIBUTED IN THE STREETS, AND MLA SAYS IT HAS NAMES OF THOSE WHO SUPPLIED THESE MATERIALS AND HAVE ADMITTED TO FILLING HIS ORDER.

MOST INTERESTING REVELATION WAS MLA'S LISTING OF NOURI'S ASSETS AT TIME OF ARREST: 6,645,275 RIALS (NEARLY DOLS 95 THOUSAND) CASH IN HIS HOME; 234,290 RIALS (JUST OVER DOLS 3,300) IN HIS POCKETS; AND UNCASHED CHECKS IN HIS POCKETS FOR 2,068,700 RIALS (JUST UNDER DOLS 30 THOUSAND) WHICH HE HAD NOT HAD TIME TO DEPOSIT. FIVE SAVINGS ACCOUNT BOOKS WERE FOUND IN HIS HOME IN HIS OWN AND HIS CHILDRENS' NAMES WHICH SHOWED DEPOSITS OF NEARLY DOLS 852,000. MLA ASKED MEDIANTO ANALYZE WHERE THESE FUNDS CAME FROM AND BY WHAT MEANS.

COMMENT: NOURI HAS BEEN A MAJOR KHOMEINI SUPPORTER AND IS BELIEVED TO BE ONE OF THE PRINCIPAL ORGANIZERS AND LEADERS OF RIOTS SEPT. 8 AND 9. HIS ARREST MAY ANTAGONIZE MANY RELIGIOUS DISSIDENTS, BUT THIS WILL PROBABLY BE TEMPERED BY SUBSTANTIAL PUBLIC INTEREST IN WHERE HIS MONEY CAME FROM. HIS ARREST WILL ALSO BE SIGNAL TO ALL THAT MLA IS GOING AFTER THOSE WHO FOMENTED TROUBLE. WE UNDERSTAND OTHER RELIGIOUS FIGURES HAVE BEEN PICKED UP ON SIMILAR CHARGES, SUCCESSFUL ROUNDUP OF OTHER KEY KHOMEINI ORGANIZATIONAL FIGURES SUCH AS NOURI COULD CONSIDERABLY ASSIST GOI EFFORTS TO ESTABLISH CALMER ATMOSPHERE WHICH IS SEEN AS PRECONDITION FOR EASING MARTIAL LAW STRICTURES.

1978TEHRAN08794.subject: NEED FOR CROWD CONTROL EQUIPMENT IN IRAN

segments.text: ONE TROUBLING FEATURE ABOUT THE IMPOSITION OF MARTIAL LAW IN IRAN IS THE ABSENCE OF ANY UNITS WITHIN THE IRANIAN ARMY WHICH SPECIFICALLY TRAINED AND EQUIPPED FOR NONLETHAL CROWD CONTROL. WHEN TROOPS WERE BROUGHT INTO TEHRAN LAST WEEK TO TAKE OVER FROM THE POLICE, THEY CAME EQUIPPED IN FULL BATTLE DRESS, ARMED WITH G-3 RIFLES, WITH FIXED BAYONETS.

CONSEQUENTLY, WHEN THESE TROOPS WERE ATTACHED BY A STONE-THROWING, CLUB-WIELDING CROWD AT JALLEH SQUARE, THEY HAD NO WEAPONS WITH WICH TO RETALIATE OTHER THAN THEIR RIFLES. THEY WORE HELMENTS, BUT CARRIED NO SHIELDS. WHEN THEIR RIFLE BURSTS INTO THE AIR FAILED TO STOP THE ADVNNCING CROWD, THE RESULTING SLAUGHTER WAS INEVITABLE.

IT IS SIMILARLY INCONGROUS TO SEE THE CHIEFTAN TANKS POSTED CONSPICOUSLY AROUND THE CITY, WITH THEIR ENORMOUS, LONG-BARRELED CANNONS. IT IS HARD TO CONCEIVE HOW THEY COULD BE USED AS A CROWD-CONTROL INSTRUMENT EXCEPT TO THE ACCOMPANIMENT OF SIGNIFICAT PHYSICAL DESTRUCTION WELL BEYOND THE NEEDS OF ANY ANTICIPATED CIRCUMSTANCE.

THE INCONGRUITY OF IRANIAN MILITARY WEAPONRY FOR THE CURRENT SITUATION IS EXPLAINED BY THE FACT THAT IRAN, DURING THE PAST FIFTEEN YEARS WHICH HAVE SEEN CIVIL UNREST IN OTHER PARTS OF THE WORLD, HAS NEVER EXPERIENCED THIS PHENOMONON DOMESTICALLY UNTIL RECENT MONTHS. PUBLIC ASSEMBLIES HAVE USUALLY BEEN ABORTED BEFORE THEY BEGAN BY THE CONSTANT SURVELLANCE OF SAV

WHEN IRANIAN AUTHOTITIES BEGAN TO RELAX SAVAK CONTROLS AND PUBLIC ASSEMBLIES BEGAN TO TAKE PLACE OVER THE LAST FEW MONTHS, IRAN BELATEDLY UNDERTOOK TO ACQUIRE A LIMITED NUMBER OF SHIELDS, HELMENTS, AND TEAR GAS FOR THEIR POLICE FORCES. HOWEVER, IN THE ABSENCE OF ANY PROFFESSIONAL TRAINING ASSISTANCE FOR THESE FORCES, THE POLICE PROVED SIGNIFICANTLY INEPT IN THEIR NEW ROLES.

THE RESULTS OF ALL THESE CIRCUMSTANCES IS AN UNEASY SITUATION IN WHICH A RENEWED OUTBREAK OF PUBLIC AGITATION COULD PREDICTABLY RESULT IN MORE VIOLENT DEATHS. THE KNOWLEDGE OF THAT FACT MAY SUCCEED IN INTIMIDATING POTENTIAL DEMONSTRATORS AND, INDEED, SOME SENIOR ARMY OFFICIALS ARE COUNTING ON THAT VERY FACT IN THEIR ASSURANCE THAT MARTIAL LAW WILL SUCCEED.

ON THE OTHER HAND, IT IS THE SHAH'S AND THE GOVT'S ANNOUNCED INTENTION TO INTRODUCE LEGISLATION WHICH WILL PERMIT PUBLIC ASSEMBLY AND FREEDOM OF SPEECH IN THE NEAR FUTURE. THE TRANSITION TO THIS NEW FEATURE OF PUBLIC LIFE IN IRAN WILL REQUIRE A READJUSTMENT OF OFFICIAL IRANIAN THINKING ABOUT THE SUBJECT OF CROWD CONTROL.

I HAVE SPOKEN IN RECENT DAYS TO THE SHAH, TO THE CHAIRMAN OF THE SUPREME COMMANDER'S STAFF, GENERAL AZHARI, AND TO THE MINISTER OF THE INTERIOR ABOUT THIS PROBLEM. I HAVE DESCRIBED DEMONSTRATIONS I HAVE SEEN IN TOKYO WITH FAR GREATER NUMBERS OF PARTICIPANTS AND FAR GREATER PROVOCATION BY THE PARTICIPANTS WHICH WERE EFFECTIVELY BROKEN UP WITHOUT A SINGLE FATALITY. THEY ALL AGREE THAT IRAN MUST CHANGE ITS CURRENT POSTURE WITH RESPECT TO CONTROL OF CIVIL DISORDER. (GEN.

AZHARI GAVE ME A GRAPHIC DESCRITION OF FINDING HIMSELF IMMOBILIZED IN HIS AUTOMOBILE ON THE FIRST NIGHT OF MARTIAL LAW BY A SOLDIER WHO HAD HALTED HIS CAR AND KEP ITS OCCUPANTS UNDER THE MUZZLE OF HIS GUN FOR OVER TEN MINUTES UNITL A POLICEMEN "SLOWLY" CAME TO CHECK IDENTITIES.)

THE NET RESULTS SEEMS TO BE A CRASH EFFORT ON THE PART OF THE MINISTRY OF WAR TO OBTAIN NON-LETHAL CROWD CONTROL EQUIPMENT. AT THE MOMENT, FOCUS SEEMS TO BE ON BRITISH AND GERMAN EQUIPMENT WITH SOME GROWING INTEREST IN THE JAPANESE. I ASSUME THERE WILL CONTINUE TO BE THEUSUAL DEMAND FOR PAT DERIAN'S TEAR GAS FROM THE USA.

POL COUNS MADE POINTS REFTEL A TO MFA INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS DEPT HEAD EHSASSI SEPT 14. EHSASSI, WHO WAS AWARE OF LEBANESE UN MISSION'S LETTER TO SECURITY COUNCIL, REPLIED THAT IRAN SEES NO NEED TO CHANGE ITS PAST POSITION AND WILL SUPPORT RENEWAL OF SIX MONTHS, AT LEAST INITIALLY. HE DID NOTE THAT MUCH DEPENDED ON POSITION TAKEN BY OTHER ARAB

1978TEHRAN08834.subject: MARTIAL LAW AND MAJLES: GOVERNMENT BY DICHOTOMY

segments.text: SUMMARY: MAJLES DEBATES CONTINUE TO OCCUPY PUBLIC ATTENTION. MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATION CONTINUES SMOOTHLY, FACES POSSIBLE CHALLENGES SEPT. 14 AND 15. PROVINCES QUIET, BAZAARS CLOSED WITH MANY OTHER SHOPS OPEN. TEHRAN CEMETERY CEREMONY SCHEDULED FOR LATER TODAY. RUMORS BEGINNING THAT TEHRAN BAZAAR WILL BE CLOSED FOR 10-20 DAYS. SOME STRAY TALK OF PROBLEMS WITHIN THE ARMY, BUT NO CONFIRMATION, GOI WILL HAVE TO RESOLVE DICHOTOMY BETWEEN FREE (IF FRACTIOUS) DEBATE IN MAJLES AND PRESS AS CONTRASTED WITH CONTROL OF ASSEMBLY (AND UNPUBLICIZED ARRESTS) UNDER MARTIAL LAW. END SUMMARY.

THIRD DAY OF MAJLES DEBATE ON NEW GOVERNMENT WAS REPLAY OF OLD THEMES (REFTEL) BY OPPOSITION AND STANDARD DEFENSE THAT NEW GOVERNMENT OFFERS BEST CHANCE FOR PROGRESS. OPPOSITION SPEAKERS CHARGED THAT CORRUPTION WAS MAJOR PROBLEM IN PUBLIC LIFE AND HINTED THAT SOME HOLDOVER MINISTERS WERE NOT SPANKING CLEAN (NO NAMES MENTIONED). PAN IRANIST SPEAKER AYNOLLAH GHEMI CALLED FOR MAJOR CHANGE IN SYSTEM. SINCE MORE SPEAKERS HAVE INSCRIBED THEMSELVES ON SCHEDULE, IT NOW APPEARS THAT DEBATE WILL LAP OVER UNTIL SEPT. 16 OR 17 BEFORE CONFIDENCE VOTE IS TAKEN.
ONE SOURCE HAS SUGGESTED THAT REVELATIONS IN MAJLES DEBATES MAY HAVE EVEN GIVEN SHAH SOME INSIGHT INTO MATTERS WHICH HAD BEEN KEPT FROM HIM BEFORE.

MEANWHILE, MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATION CONTINUES TO RUN MAJOR CITIES AND QUIET REIGNS IN TEHRAN, ISFAHAN, SHIRAZ, AND TABRIZ AND PROBABLY OTHERS. CITIZENS ADOPTING RATHER WELL TO CURFEWS. MOST CITIES' BAZAARS WERE CLOSED ALL DAY SEPT. 13 TO MIDDAY SEPT. 14. WORD IN TEHRAN IS THAT THERE WILL BE SIZABLE "MOURNING CEREMONY" AT CITY'S ONLY CEMETARY BEGINNING LATE AFTERNOON SEPT. 14. EVENT IS LIKELY TO INCLUDE DEMONSTRATION AGAINST GOI FOR FIRING WHICH KILLED RIOTERS SEPT. 8, ACCORDING TO SEVERAL SOURCES. CEMETARY IS SO FAR SOUTH OF TOWN THAT CITY IS UNLIKELY TO FEEL MUCH DIRECT EFFECT.
OTHER STORIES HAVE IT THAT TEHRAN BAZAAR AND PERHAPS OTHERS WILL REMAIN CLOSED FOR 10 OR 20 DAYS (PICK YOUR STORY).

WORD CONTINUES THAT THERE HAVE BEEN DISCIPLINARY PROBLEMS WITH SOME TROOP UNITS, BUT REPORTS ARE VAGUE AND UNCONFIRMED. POSSIBILITY EXISTS THAT MINOR INCIDENTS HAVE BEEN BLOWN UP OUT OF PROPORTION BY THOSE WHO HAVE POLITICAL INTEREST IN SPREADING SUCH RUMORS (A TECHNIQUE OFTEN RESORTED TO IN RECENT PAST).

INTERESTING DICHOTOMY CONTINUES BETWEEN FREE (AND SOMETIMES VICIOUS) DEBATE IN PARLIAMENT BEING BROADCAST LIVE TO COUNTRY AS CONTRASTED WITH STRICTURES ON PRESS AND ASSEMBLY UNDER MARTIAL LAW, AND UNPUBLICIZED ARRESTS OF DISSIDENT LEADERS. FOR THE TIME BEING, MAJLES DEBATE PROVIDING USEFUL OUTLET FOR ACCUMULATED FRUSTRATIONS WHILE GOI ATTEMPTING UNDER MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATORS TO GET SECURITY SITUATION UNDER CONTROL. SO FAR, SYSTEM SEEMS TO BE WPRKING, BUT IT OBVIOUSLY CANNOT CONTINUE FOR PROLONGED PERIOD OF TIME, GENERAL PUBLIC IS VERY INTERESTED IN MAJLES BROADCASTS, BUT ACTIVE POLITICAL FIGURES ARE NERVOUS BECAUSE OF POSSIBILITY OF ARREST, AND NEWLYOPENED POLITICAL ACTIVITY IS AT STANDSTILL UNDER MARTIAL LAW.
(SUBSTANTIAL PART OF NERVOUSNESS IS DUE TO LACK OF PUBLICITY ABOUT MARTIAL LAW ARREST POLICY.)

IF GOI CAN GET BY COMING WEEKEND WITHOUT LARGE SCALE VIOLENCE AND NEW SHARIF-EMAMI GOVERNMENT IS CONFIRMED AS EXPECTED, THERE WILL BE BRIEF BREATHING SPACE FOR GOI. HOWEVER, MONTHS AHEAD FEATURE SEVERAL OCCASIONS FOR TROUBLE. MOST IMPORTANT IS OPENING OF SCHOOL YEAR OCT. 7. ALL FACULTY, STUDENTS AND ADMINISTRATORS, INCLUDING MINISTER OF HIGHER EDUCATION, BELIEVE THERE WILL BE TROUBLE, AND MANY FEAR "SCHOOL YEAR" WILL LAST A WEEK OR LESS. FOLLOWING THAT, SHAH'S BIRTHDAY, OCTOBER 26, IS NATURAL TARGET FOR ANTI-REGIMEEDEMONSTRATORS. NEXT MAJOR RELIGIOUS DATE WILL BE OCT. 18 FORTIETH DAY "COMMEMORATION" FOR THEOSE KILLED SEPT 8.
MOST OBSERVERS AGREE BEST WAY FOR GOI TO KEEP INITIATIVE WILL BE TO PUT ITS OWN POSITIVE PROGRAM BEFORE THE MAJLES AS SOON AS POSSIBLE AND MAKE CONCURRENT EFFORT TO SHORTEN MARTIAL LAW PERIOD.

1978TEHRAN08835.subject: COMMITTEE FOR THE DEFENSE OF HUMAN RIGHTS AND FREEDOM (CDHRF)

segments.text: SUMMARY: CDHRF REPRESENTATIVES CALLED AT EMBASSY TO PRESENT LETTER TO MARK SCHNEIDER FOR TRANSMITTAL. LETTER SETS FORTH CDHRF VIEW OF SEPT 8 DEMONSTRATIONS. CDHRF REPS CONFIRMED ONE ADDITIONAL ARREST AND SUGGEST 20 POLITICAL TYPES AND 100 RELIGIOUS FIGURES HAVE BEEN ARRRESTED IN TEHRAN SINCE IMPOSITION OF MARTIAL LAW SEPT. 8. END SUMMARY.

ABBAS RADNIA AND HADI HARANDI, MEMBERS OF CDHRF, CALLED ON POLOFF STEMPEL MORNING SEPT. 14 TO ASK EMBASSY TO TRANSMIT LETTER TO MARK SCHNEIDER WHICH GIVES COMMITTEE'S VIEW OF SEPT. 8 RIOT (SEE REFTEL FOR EARLIER DESCRIPTION). LETTER, BEING POUCHED TO SCHNEIDER, CLAIMS 60,000 DEMONSTRATORS ASSEMBLED IN JALEH SQUARE MORNING SEPT 8 AND WERE SEATED WHEN ARMY FIRED "WITH NO WARNING." LETTER CLAIMS "SEVERAL THOUSANDS" WERE KILLED, THEN GIVE FIGURE 3,000 DEAD WITH MANY WOUNDED. LETTER THEN NOTES ARREST OF CDHRF'S EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE HEAD, ENG. MEHDI BAZARGAN AND SAYS THERE IS NOW NO POSSIBILITY OF ENFORCING INTERNATIONAL HUMAN RIGHTS CONVENTIONS.
IT CALLS ON SCHNEIDER TO "TAKE IMMEDIATE ACTION" TO PUT AN END TO THIS BRUTALITY AND INJUSTICE, AND REQUESTS THIS BE TRANSMITTED TO ALL HUMAN RIGHTS ASSOCIATIONS IN THE WORLD TO ASSIST CDHRF'S CAUSE.

PAIR ASKED IF EMBASSY WOULD TRANSMIT COPIES OF LETTER WITH SAME TEXT TO AMNESTY INTERNATIONAL, INTERNATIONAL RED CROSS, AND INTERNATIONAL LEAGUE OF HUMAN RIGHTS (OF WHICH CDHRF IS AN AFFILIATE). EMBOFF DECLINED, SAYING IT WOULD NOT BE APPROPRIATE TO DO SO, AND CDHRF REPS SAID THEY WOULD POST OTHER LETTERS FROM ABROAD.

RADNIA AND HARANDI CONFIRMED BAZARGAN'S ARREST AND ADDED NEW NAME TO LIST: ISLAMIC SCHOLAR GHAFFARI, A FREQUENT LECTURER AT LARGE MOSQUES WHO HAS BEEN ARRESTED BY SECURITY FORCES. THEY INDICATED THEIR OWN FIGURES SHOWED 20 "POLITICIANS" HAD BEEN ARRESTED AND ABOUT 100 RELIGIOUS PERSONS--MULLAHS AND OTHERS--IN TEHRAN. ACCORDING TO THEIR SOURCES, OTHER RELIGIOUS FIGURES WHERE BEING ARRESTED IN OTHER MARTIAL LAW CITIES, BUT THEY HAD NO ESTIMATES OF NUMBERS. CDHRF MEMBERS MINATCHI, SANJABI, LAHIDJI AND HAJ SEYED JAVADI REMAIN AT LARGE.

COMMENT: FIGURES IN CDHRF LETTER ARE AT SUCH VARIANCE WITH FACTS AS WE AND OTHERS KNOW THEM (SEE REFTEL) AS TO MAKE WHOLE EFFORT SEEM LIKE PROPAGANDA PLOY. EMBOFF SAID HE HAD SOME DIFFICULTY ACCEPTING CDHRF FIGURES, SINCE HE COULD NOT CONFIRM THEM FROM ANY OTHER SOURCE (INCLUDING OWN OBSERVATION OF TV FILM OF DEMONSTRATION). CDHRF PAIR STUCK DOGGEDLY TO THEIR STORY, ADDING AT END OF DISCUSSION THAT "SHAH HAS TO GO, YOU KNOW, AND WE WANT THE U.S. TO HELP." EMBOFF CITED CARTER-SHAH PHONE CALL AS EVIDENCE OF OUR CONCERN FOR AND SUPPORT OF SHAH, IRAN AND CONTINUED POLITICAL LIBERALIZATION.

UNLESS AND UNTIL WE CAN GATHER ANY OTHER CORROBORATING EVIDENCE, BELIVE EMASSY AND DEPT SHOULD MERELY RECEIVE LETTER AND MAKE NO FURTHER COMMENT. MAGNITUDE IN DISCREPANCY BETWEEN CDHRF STORY AND FACTS AS WE HAVE GATHERED THEM FROM NUMBER OF RELIABLE EUROPEAN AND AMERICAN EYEWITNESSES, INCLUDING TRAINED JOURNALISTS, CAN BE SHOWN BY FOLLOWING: ALL EYEWITNESSES AGREE CROWD WAS ABOUT 20003000; JALEH SQUARE ITSELF IS APPROXIMATELY 80 YARDS BY 80 YARDS (MAXIMUM POSSIBLE DIMENSIONS) WHICH WOULD PHYSICALLY PRECLUDE NUMBERS CDHRF CITIES, ESPECIALLY IN SEATED POSITION, EVEN IF ALL CORNERS OF SQUARE WERE JAMMED, WHICH THEY WERE NOT. EYEWITNESSES ALL SAY AT LEAST TWO WARNINGS WERE GIVEN DEMONSTRATORS.

THIS CDHRF EFFORT, UNLIKE SOME MORE BALANCED PREVIOUS PRESENTATIONS, APPEARS TO BE PRIMARILY BENT ON PICTURING MARTIAL LAW AS BRUTAL SUPRESSION RATHER THAN ATTEMPT TO PROVIDE FACTS ON DEMONSTRATION. THIS IS LINE WHICH RELIGIOUS AND OTHER HARD-LINE OPPOSITIONISSTS HAVE BEEN TAKING OVER PAST WEEK IN ATTEMPT TO KEEP ANTI-GOI MOMENTUM GOING.

SUMMARY: MARCH TO TEHRAN CEMETERY BY SEVERAL THOUSAND PEOPLE AFTERNOON SEPT 14 REMAINED PEACEFUL THANKS IN PART TO ASTUTE HANDLING BY ARMY AUTHORITIES. MOST SHOPS WERE CLOSED IN TEHRAN AND OTHER CITIES RESPONDING TO CALLS IN KHOMEINI'S NAME AND NAMES OF LOCAL ISFAHAN MULLAHS WHICH WERE MORE EXTREME AND RAN PARTLY COUNTER TO MORE MODERATE CELT BY AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI FOR PEOPLE TO COURN QUIETLY AT HOME. SERIES OF FIRE BOMBINGS IN ISFAHAN IMMEDIATELY AFTER DUSK SEPT 14 BORE MARKS OF SMALL TERRORIST OPERATION; GRUMMAN CO. MOTOR POOL ESCAPED WITH LIGHT DAMAGE. ISFAHAN AUTHORITIES CONSIDERING EXTENDING CURFEW HOURS.

TWO MORE FORMER MINISTERS HAVE BEEN ARRESTED (PRESUMABLY FOR CORRUPTION)M WHILE DIFFERENCE OF APPROACH BETWEEN SHARIATMADARI RELIGIOUS MODERATES AND KHOMEINI EXTREMISTS REMAINS, INCIDENTS SUCH AS ISFAHAN FIRE BOMBING POINT TO POSSIBLY INDEPENDENT ACTION BY TERRORISTS WHO MAY NOT NECESSARILY OWE ALLEGIANCE TO RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP. MEANWHILE, NATIONS SHOPKEEPERS SEEM MORE IMPRESSED BY OPPOSITION ORDERS FOR SHOP CLOSURES ON SPECIFIC DAYS THAN BY ORDERS TO STAY OPEN FROM MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES. END SUMMARY.

CROWD ESTIMATED BY VARIOUS SOURCES AT 3-10 THOUSAND GATHERED AT BEHEST-E-ZAGRA CEMETERY SEVERAL KILOMETERS SOUTH OF TEHRAN LATE AFTERNOON SEPT. 14 TO MARK SEVENTH DAY AFTER SEPT 8 "MASSACRE" OF DEMONSTRATORS. LED BY MINOR MULLLAHS, CROWD SHOUTED ANTI-SHAH AND ANTI-GOVERNMENT SLOGANS BUT WAS QUIETED DOWN BY APPEAL OVER LOUDSPEAKER FROM ARMY OFFICER WHO SPOKE TO CROWD AS "BROTHERS" WHOM MILITARY HAD NO DESIRE TO HURT. ONE REPORT HAS IT THAT TROOPS EVEN PRESENTED DEMONSTRATORS WITH FLOWERS, WHILE OTHER REPORTS SAY DEMONSTRATORS GAVE FLOWERS TO TROOPS. CROWD DISPERSED PEACEFULLY, RETURNING TO TEHRAN IN RENTED BUSES AND PRIVATE CARS.

LARGER NUMBER OF SHOPS THAN USUAL IN TEHRAN AND OTHER MAJOR CITIES STAYED SHUT SEPT 14 INSIDE BAZAARS AND ELSEWHERE. THIS WAS TRUE OF TABRIZ TOO, ACCORDING TO OUR CONSUL, DESPITE PUBLIC CLAIMS BY MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES TO THE CONTRARY. CLOSURE WAS APPARENTLY IN RESPONSE TO ORDER ISSUED IN AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI'S NAME SEPT 13, THOUGH PHRASING OF ANNOUNCEMENT AND LACK OF HIS PERSONAL SEAL SUGGESTS TO SOME THAT IT MAY HAVE BEEN PUT OUT IN HIS NAME BY LEFT-WING ALLIES OF HIS.

LEADER OF MODERATE MULLAHS, AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI, PUT OUT HIS OWN PROCLAMATION-BROADCAST OVER LOCAT RADIO-CALLING FOR QUIET MOURNING IN HOMES BUT NO CLOSURE OF ESSENTIAL SHOPS OR SPECIFIC CHALLENGE TO AUTHORITIES. CONSUL MCGAFFEY IN ISFAHAN REPORTS LOCAL MULLAHS IMMEDIATELY CIRCULATED THEIR OWN CALL SAME AFTERNOON (SEPT 13) CHALLENGING RIGHT OF SHARIATMADARI OR OTHER "OUTSIDERS" TO DICATE TO ISFAHAN RELIGIOUS AND BACKING KHOMEINI'S CALL FOR "GENERAL STRIKE" WITHOUT MENTIONING KHOMEINI DIRECTLY. ISFAHAN MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES THEMSELVES ISSUED ORDER TO STAY OPEN, THREATENING CONFISCATION OF BUSINESS LICENCES OF SHOPS WHICH CLOSE. WHILE ABOUT 60 PERCENT OF SHOPS WERE OPEN AFTERNOON SEPT 13, CONSUL REPORTS ALMOST GENERAL CLOSURE SEPT 14.
ISFAHAN AUTHORITIES HAVE SINCE ARRESTED A NUMBER OF LOCAL MULLAHS, INCLUDING SHEIKH MAHBUBI.

EVENING SEPT 14 ISFAHAN SAW SERIES OF FIRE BOMBINGS. SHORTLY AFTER DUSK AT 7 PM EYEWITNESSES, INCLUDING SOME AMERICANS LIVING IN NEARBY HOTEL, SAW TWO YOUTHS ON MOTORCYCLES THROW ROCKS WHICH BROKE UPPER STORY WINDOWS IN TWO GOVERNMENT BUILDINGS WHICH WERE CLOSED FOR THE DAY-BRANCH OF MINISTRY OF INFORMATION AND TOURISM AND A BRANCH MUNICIPALITY. PEYKAN CAR CONTAINING TWO MORE YOUTHS FOLLOWED WITH FLASHLIGHT INSPECTION TO BE SURE WINDOWS BROKEN. SECOND PAYKAN THEN ARRIVED WITH TWO MORE YOUTHS WHO THREW FIRE BOMBS THROUGH BROKEN WINDOWS. SHORTLY THEREAFTER THREE BANK OFFICES WERE SIMILARLY FIRE BOMBED (NO EYEWITNESSES). SO WAS HOME OF LOCAL CHIEF OF TRAFFIC POLICE.

FINALLY, AT SOME TIME AFTER 9 PM MOLOTOV COCKTAILS THROWN OVER WALL INTO GRUMMAN MOTOR POOL AREA, BURNING ONE CAR. PIPE BOMB LATER DISCOVERED UNEXPLODED BY NIGHT WATCHMAN NEAR INFLAMMABLE PETROL RESERVOIR; HE REMOVED IT AND THREW IT INTO STREET, FROM WHICH POLICE TOOK IT AWAY STILL - HAPPILY - UNEXPLODED. SEQUENCE OF EVENTS PERMITS POSSIBILITY THAT ALL INCIDENTS PERPETRATED BY SINGLE BAND OF TERRORISTS. CONSUL REPORTS THAT MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES ARE CONSIDERING EXTENDING CURFEW HOURS IN ISFAHAN.

EVENING SEPT 14 MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES ANNOUNCED ARREST OF TWO MORE FORMER GOI MINISTERS (FROM HOVEYDA CABINETS): FORMER AGRICULTURE (AND PREVIOUSLY WATER AND POWER) MINISTER RUHANI AND FORMER COMMERCE MINISTER (AND MINISTER OF STATE) FEREIDUN MAHDAVI. UNDER ARTICLE 5 OF MARTIAL LAW NO CHARGES NEED BE SPECIFIED AND NONE HAVE BEEN, AT LEAST PUBLICLY.

COMMENT: THREE PATTERNS EMERGE. FIRST, AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI APPEARS TO BE MAINTAINING HIS INDEPENDENCE FROM MORE EXTREMIST KHOMEINI SUPPORTERS DESPITE HIS LOSS OF RELATIVE PRESTIGE, AS WITNESS ATTACK ON HIM BY LOCAL ISFAHAN MULLAHS. SECOND, TERRORISTS AND LAY LEFT WING MILITANTS WHOM WE HAVE ASSUMED TO BE ALLIED WITH KHOMEINI'S EXTREMIST EFFORTS ARE PROVIDING EVIDENCE OF ACTIVITY PERHAPS INDEPENDENTLY FROM KHOMEINI'S RELIGIOUS FOLLOWERS. THIRD, SHOPKEEPERS CONTINUE TO OBEY ORDERS FOR CLOSURE OF SHOPS EMANANTING FROM OPPOSITION CIRCLES MORE THAN APPEALS AND ORDERS FROM MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES TO STAY OPEN. SULLIVAN *** Current Handling Restrictions *** n/a *** Current Classification *** CONFIDENTIAL

EXCEPT FOR VARIOUS INCONVENIENCES OCCASIONED BY MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS, THERE APPEARS TO BE NO SECURITY REASON WHY U.S. BUSINESS TRAVELERS SHOULD POSE OR CANCEL SCHEDULED VISIT TO TEHRAN OR OTHER MAJOR IRANIAN CITIES.

ONE WEEK AFTER THE IMPOSITION OF MARTIAL LAW, TEHRAN IS CALM AND RELATIVELY UNCHANGED IN APPEARENCE EXCEPT FOR TROOPS IN BATTLE DRESS AND ARMORED VEHICLES POSTED AT KEY POSITIONS. PREPARATIONS ARE GOING AHEAD FOR THE MOST IMPORTANT COMMERCIAL EVENT OF THE YEAR, THE ANNUAL TEHRAN INTERNATIONAL TRADE FAIR WHICH RUNS FROM SEPTEMBER 19 TO OCTOBER 1. TRAFFIC, TRADITIONALLY HEAVIER AFTER THE START OF SCHOOL, IS AT LEAST AS HEAVY AND HECTIC AS BEFORE THE IMPOSITION OF MARTIAL LAW. WITH THE REOPENING OF THE BAZAAR THIS WEEK, BUSINESS IS BEING CARRIED ON VERY MUCH AS USUAL.
FOREIGNERS, INCLUDING AMERICANS, HAVE NOT BEEN SINGLED OUT BY DISSIDENTS FOR SPECIAL ATTENTION NOR HAS THERE BEEN AN ANTI-FOREIGN THEME RUNNING THROUGH THE DEMONSTRATIONS.

THERE ARE INCONVENIENCES. THERE IS A RIGID CURFEW, A REGULATION AGAINST UNAUTHORIZED GATHERING, AND INTERNAL FLIGHTS HAVE BEEN RESCHEDULED DURING NON-CURFEW HOURS AS HAVE SOME INTERNATIONAL FLIGHTS. PASSENGERS ARRING ON FLIGHTS AFTER CURFEW COMMENCES TAKE TAXIS WITH SPECIAL CURFEW PASSES TO THEIR DESTINATIONS, WHICH FREQUENTLY INVOLVES A NUMBER OF STOPS AT CHECKPOINTS EN ROUTE. THE EVENING CURFEW, ORIGINALLY 9 P.M., ALREADY HAS BEEN RELAXED TWICE AND NOW BEGINS AT 11 P.M. IT MAY BE STILL FURTHER RELAXED, BUT IN THE MEANTIME MANY TEHRANIS HAVE BEEN ENJOYING NEARLY FORGOTTEN HOURS OF HOMELIFE EACH EVENING AS SOCOAL FUNCTIONS HAVE BEEN MOVED UP OR CANCELLED.
MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES TAKE A JAUNDICED VIEW OF PHOTOGRAPHING TROOPS, MILITARY VEHICLES, OR CROWDS. PHOTOGRAPHERS SHOULD EXERCISE RESTRAINT.

INTENDING BUSINESS VISITORS SHOULD NOTE, HOWEVER, THAT IT IS EXTREMELY DIFFICULT TO OBTAIN APPOINTMENTS WITH MANY GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS, OR TO IDENTIFY SUCH OFFICIALS IN THE WAKE OF RECENT PERSONNEL SHIFTS, DISMISSALS, AND ARRESTS. SUCH OFFICIALS ARE INCREASINGLY RELUCTANT TO MAKE DICISIONS, CONCLUDE CONTRACTS, SIGN PAPERS, ETC., IN VIEW OF THE GROWING POSSIBILITY THAT THEY MAY LATER BE CALLED TO ACCOUNT BY HIGHER AUTHORITY. SIMILARLY, BUSINESSMEN ARE HESITANT TO MAKE OR IMPLEMENT EXECTIVE DICISIONS, OR EVEN MAKE SERIOUS BUSINESS PLANS, UNTIL THE CIVIL UNREST AND POLITICAL TURMOIL DISSIPATE AND THEY GAIN A CLEARER SENSE OF DIRECTION REGARDING THE COUNTRY'S ECONOMIC PLANS IN THE WEEKS AND MONTHS AHEAD. MANY ARE TAKING VACATIONS.
TRAVELERS, IN ADDITION TO RECONFIRMING HOTEL AND AIRLINE RESERVATIONS, SHOULD BE CERTAIN OF THE AVAILABILITY OF KEY CONTACTS.
FOR LONDON: PLEASE PASS ABOVE INFO TO ANIS ABUHAMDEH, STANFORD RESEARCH INSTITUTE, CROYDEN.

1978TEHRAN08900.subject: AFGHAN AMBASSADOR TO IRAN REMAINS IN TEHRAN

segments.text: AFGHAN FIRST SECRETARY AYUBI CONFIRMED TO POLOFF SEPT. 16 THAT AMBASSADOR NAJIB HAS BEEN RECALLED BUT THAT HE HAS NOT LEFT IRAN YET. WHEN ASKED WHEN NAJIB WOULD GO, AYUBI SAID HE "DIDN'T KNOW", AND LEFT IMPRESSION AFGHAN EMBASSY SITUATION HERE VERY FLUID RIGHT NOW.
FOR NEA/IRN ONLY. WOULD APPRECIATE YOUR SENDING TO US BY TELEGRAM FULL TEXT OF 22 U.S. CODE SECTIONS 611 THROUGH 621 TO WHICH YOU REFERRED IN RECENT MESSAGE. WE ARE UNABLE LOCATE FULL TEXT HERE.

1978TEHRAN08925.subject: REQUEST FOR APPROVAL OF EMPLOYMENT ACCEPTANCE BY DEPENDENT OF EMBOFF (DENNIS MENDYK)

segments.text: TIMELY ARRIVAL OF REF A DEPRIVED ME OF OPPORTUNITY TO SEND PURPLE REPLY TO REF B. REPLY MIGHT HAVE BEEN THERAPEUTIC TO MY PSYCHE BUT WOULD HAVE ADDED LITTLE TO THE RESOLUTION OF OUR PROBLEM.

PLEASE ASK LEGAL ADVISOR TO FOREGO TELEPHONE CALL IN FAVOR OF MORE PRESSING DUTIES ON HIS CALENDAR. I CAN EMPATHIZE WITH HIS PROBLEM OF BRIDGING THE GENERATIONAL GAP IN RESTRAINING THE TERROR OF LIBIDINAL EXPRESSION.
WE WILL SEND FUTURE MESSAGES TO NEA/IRN.

1978TEHRAN08926.subject: JANUARY 1979 SOUTH ASIA CHIEFS OF MISSION CONFERENCE

segments.text: AS OF NOW, JANUARY 11-12 LOOK APPROPRIATE FOR COM CONFERENCE AND I SHALL BLOCK THEM OUT ON MY CALENDAR.

1978TEHRAN08927.subject: ASSESSMENT OF AFGHAN DEVELOPMENTS AND US- AFGHAN RELATIONS

segments.text: I HAVE READ WITH GREAT INTEREST THE THOUGHTFUL ANALYSIS AND RECOMMENDATIONS WITH RESPECT TO AFGHANISTAN WHICH AMBASSADOR DUBS HAS MADE IN REFTEL.

I AM CONFIENT THAT GOVT OF IRAN WOULD WELCOME AN OPPORTUNITY TO EXCHANGE VIEWS WITH THE UNITED STATES AND OTHER INTERESTED GOVTS AND TO COORDINATE OUR POLICIES, PARTICULARLY IN THE FIELD OF ECONOMIC ASSISTANCE.

WITH THE MAJOR ADVANCE IN U.S. REGIONAL OBJECTIVES RESULTING FROM THE SUCCESS AT CAMP DAVID, IT WOULD BE A PSYCHOLOGICALLY VALUABLE TIME TO CATALYZE PURPOSEFUL RESILIENCE HERE IN THE NORTHERN TIER OF THE REGION.

DURING PERIOD MENTIONED (REFTEL) AFSHAR-QASEMLU WAS NO LONGER ON DUTY WITH FOREIGN SERVICE. HE WAS CONNECTED WITH COURT MINISTRY, APPARENTLY WITH TITLE OF DEPUTY MINISTER. HE APPEARED TO HAVE NO SPECIFIC DUTIES BEYOND FACILITATING PROGRAMS OF CERTAIN VISITORS. FOR YOUR INFORMATION HE IS REFERRED TO IN SOME PRESS REPORTS SIMPLY AS "AFSHAR," AND GENERALLY USES ONLY THE SINGLE LAST NAME HIMSELF.

1978TEHRAN08968.subject: IRANIAN HUMAN RIGHTERS HOLE UP IN QOM

segments.text: SUMMARY: MEMBERS OF COMMITTEE FOR THE DEFENSE OF HUMAN RIGHTS AND FREEDOM (CDHRF) HAVE TAKEN REFUGE IN HOME OF AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI. CDHRF HAS CALLED ON GOI TO ALLOW THEM TO PURSUE INVESTIGATIONS OF HUMAN RIGHTS WITHOUT FEAR OF ARREST. BAZARGAN FREED. CDHRF HAS ASKED INTERNATIONAL LEAGUE OF HUMAN RIGHTS TO INVESTIGATE. END SUMMARY.

DR NASSER MINATCHI TELEPHONED POLOFF STEMPEL FROM QOM MORNING OF SEPT. 18 TO INFORM EMBASSY THAT 12 MEMBERS OF CDHRF WERE TEMPORARILY IN REFUGE IN HOME OF RYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI. MEMBERS OF CDHRF HE NAMED WERE: DR. MABASHERI, DR NASSERI, DR MADANI, DR SADR HAJ SEYED JAVADI, DR MALEKI, DR TAHBANDEH, ENG. BANAFTI, DR NAZIRI, DR MASSOUDI, MR RADNIA AND HIMSELF. HE SAID FIVE OTHER MEMBERS REMAIN UNDER ARREST: ENG. MOGHADDAM-MARGAREH, MR AKBAR ZARENEHBAF, MR ALI ZARENEHBAF, MR MORTAZAVI AND MR MAHMOUD MANIAN. ENG. MEHDI BAZARGAN HAS BEEN RELEASED FROM JAIL ND IS EXPECTED TO ARRIVE IN QOM EVENING SEPT 18.

MINATCHI ALLUDEE TO FOUR OTHERS EXPECTED IN QOM, BUT WOULD NOT GIVE NAMES. (COMMENT: THREE OF THEM ARE PROBABLY ALI ASGHAR HAJ SEYED JAVADI, ABDOL KARIM LAHIDJI AND HASSAN NAZIEH, HEAD OF THE BAR ASSOCIATION.)

MINATCHI SAID CDHRF HAD SENT MESSAGES TO INTERNATIONAL LEAGUE OF HUMAN RIGHTS, OF WHICH IT IS AN AFFILIATE, TO INVESTIGATE SITUATION IN IRAN. HE SAID HE HAD HEARD VIA BBC SEP 18 THAT LEAGUE HAD DECIDED TO SEND COMMITTEE TO INVESTIGATE. (COMMENT: IT APPEARS TO US EXTREMELY UNLIKELY THAT GOI WILL ALLOW SUCH A COMMITTEE TO ENTER IRAN. UNDER CURRENT POTITICAL CONDITIONS WE DO NOT RPT NOT THINK IT IS IN EITHER GOI'S OR OUR OWN INTEREST TO ENCOURAGE THIS SORT OF THING.)

CDHRF GROUP HAS WIRED IRANIAN GOVERNMENT REQUESTING MEMBERS BE ALLOWED TO GO ABOUT THEIR BUSINESS WITHOUT FEAR OF ARREST AND INVESTIGATE HUMAN RIGHTS PROBLEMS. SO FAR THERE HAS BEEN NO REPLY. AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI HAS SAID GROUP CAN HAVE REFUGE IN HIS HOME UNTIL AGREEMENT WITH GOI REACHED.

ON BASIS REFTEL POL COUNS DISCUSSED UPCOMING UNGA WITH MFA HEAD OF INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS DEPT EHSASSI SEPT 14. EHSASSI WAS RELAXED AND THERE WERE NO SURPRISES IN IRANIAN POSITION. THERE ISSOME MILD DIVERGENCE OF IRANIAN POSITION FROM U.S. ON QUESTION OF 1981 ENERGY CONFERENCE AND SEVERAL POLITICAL ISSUES WHERE IRAN CONTINUES TO PROTECT ITS POSITION IN THE G-77, ITS IMAGE WITH THE ARABS, AND ITS CLOSE RELATIONSHIP TO TURKEY. ON THE WHOLE, HOWEVER, IRAN THINKS AS WE DO ON MOST QUESTIONS WHERE A G-77 POSITION DOES NOT CONFLICT WITH OURS, AND IT VIEWS ITS ROLE IN G-77 AS A MODERATING ONE. SPECIFIDC COMMENTS BELOW ARE KEYED TO REFTEL.

ENERGY. EHSASSI NOTED THAT THE SHAH IS AMONG THE FIRST WHO SPOKE PUBLICLY OF THE WORLD'S NEED TO DEVELOP ALTERNATIVE SOURCE OF ENERGY. IRAN WAS DISAPPOINTED THAT THE SYG'S PAPER PROPOSING A CONFERENCE ON NONFOSSIL FUELS FOR 1981 WAS SO SHORT. MORE DOCUMENTATION WOULD HAVE HELPED. G-77 HAS DISCUSSED THIS QUESTION AND DECIDED TO LEAVE OT TO UNGA TO DECIDE WHETHER 1981 MAY BE TOO SOON. A CONFERENCE OF THIS SORT REQUIRES LONG PREPARATION.

MIDDLE EAST: PALESTINIANS. EHSASSI EXPRESSED DOUBT THAT ALL ARAB GOVERNMENTS WOULD AGREE WITH U.S. POSITION THAT PROGRESS ON PALESTINAIAN ISSUE CAN ONLY COME AT THE NEGOTIATING TABLE, BUT HE ASSUMED OUTCOME OF CAMP DAVID SUMMIT WILL HAVE GREAT INFLUENCE ON THIS ISSUE. HE EXPECTED ARABS TO WANT TO USE A SPECIAL SESSION FOR PALESTINAINS FOR PROPOGANDA PURPOSES BUT THAT TOO WOULD DEPEND ON POST-SUMMIT ATMOSPHERE. HE LEFT LITTLE DOUBT THAT GOI WOULD GO ALONG WITH MODERATE ARAB POSITION.

MIDDLE EAST: Z-R LINKAGE. EHSASSI SAID HE DOUBTED ZIONIST-RACISM ISSUE WOULD BE BROUGHT UP AT NEXT UNGA. ARABS HAS PERFECT OPPORTUNITY TO RAISE THE ISSUE IN RECENT GENEVA CONFERENCE ON RACISM BUT HAD NOT DONE SO, PROBABLY IN THE FACE OF UNITED WESTERN EUROPEAN POSITION AGAINST THEM. HE THOUGHT THIS INDICATED A TACTICAL DECISION WHICH WOULD CARRY ALSO TO THE UNGA.

NAMIBIA. U.S. PROPOSAL THAT UNTAG FOR NAMIBIA SHOULD BE FINANCED BY SUPPLEMENTAL APPROPRIATION TO REGULAR 78-79 BUDGET IS NOT LIKELY TO BE SUPPORTED BY GOI OR G-77. UN PRECEDENT IN OTHER PEACE-KEEPING OPERATIONS HAS BEEN TO SET UP SEPARATE FINANCING AND G-77 WILL PROBABLY VOTE TO FOLLOW THAT PRECEDENT.

RHODESIA. IRAN WILL SUPPORT OUR PROPOSAL FOR AN ALL-PARTY CONFERENCE ON RHODESIA. WHILE ASIANS AND LATIN AMERICANS COULD BE EXPECTED TO GO ALONG WITH THIS, AFRICANS SHOW EVERY INDICATION OF OBJECTING. SINCE AFRICANS ARE THE KEY ELEMENTS, EHSASSI DOUBTED THE PROPOSAL WOULD WIN G-77 SUPPORT IN THE ABSENCE OF ANY NEW DRAMATIC DEVELOPMENT PROVIDING SOLID BASIS FOR AN AGREEMENT.

CYPRUS. EHSASSI CONFIRMED THAT GOI WILL AGAIN FEEL IT NECESSARY TO SUPPORT ITS TURKISH ALLY ON CYPRUS REPRESENTATION ISSUE. HOWEVER, IN BILATERALS, GOI HAS TRIED TO PUSH THE TURKS TOWARD A SOLUTION WHICH WILL BE MORE ACCEPTABLE TO OTHER COUNTRIES. ------------------100007 181455Z /11 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 424 INFO USMISSION GENEVA USMISSION USUN NEW YORK SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 8969

UN MACHINERY. IRAN AGREES WITH EFFORT TO MAKE UN MACHINERY MORE EFFECTIVE. WHILE IRAN WOULD NOT HAVE MINDED SOME CHARTER AMENDMENT IF REALIZES THE DANGER OF TRYING TO CHANGE BASIC PRINCIPLES. IT WILL THEREFORE COOPERATE IN MAKING ECONOMIES AND OTHER STREAMLINING SHORT OF CHARTER AMENDMENT. INCIDENTALLY, EHSASSI THOUGHT THERE MAY BE PROBLEMS IN NEW PLEDGING PROCEDURE BEING INSTALLED THIS YEAR. WHILE A SINGLE PLEDGING SESSION FOR ALL PROGRAMS TOGETHER MAY BE MORE EFFICIENT AND SAVE PARTICIPANT TIME, IT ALSO MIGHT REDUCE GENEROSITY OF UN MEMBERS IN PROVIDING FOR UN PROGRAMS.

HUMAN RIGHTS. IRAN CONTINUES TO BE REPRESENTED IN HUMAN RIGHTS COMMITTEE BY MINISTER OF EDUCATION GANJI AND APPRECIATES USG POSITION RE INSEPARABILITY OF POLITICAL, CIVIL, ECONOMIC, SOCIAL AND CULTURAL RIGHTS WHICH IRAN KNOWS RUNS CONTRARY TO POSITION TAKEN BY SOME WEST EUROPEAN COUNTRIES.

DISARMAMENT. IRAN UNDERSTANDS U.S. POSITION AND TRIES TO COOPERATE WITH IT. IT IS HAPPY WITH CHANGES MADE IN THE METHODS OF THE CCD OT GIVE THAT ORGANIZATION A MORE EFFECTIVE ROLE IN DISARMAMENT NEGOTIATIONS.
POL COUNS THANKED EHSASSI FOR GOI'S EFFORT IN SUPPORT USG DURING RECENT COMMITTEE OF 24 DELIBERATIONS ON PUERTO RICO ISSUE.

TWO FIRE BOMBS EXPLODED DAMAGING HOUSE AND CAR OF BELL HELICOPTER MAINTENANCE MANAGER IN ISFAHAN NIGHT SEPT. 17. A PIECE OF CARDBOARD WITH "AMERICAN GO HOME" WRITTEN ON IT WAS REPORTEDLY SEEN IN CROWD OUTSIDE HOME. CASE IS BEING INVESTIGATED. MEANWHILE, WE UNDERSTAND THE EMPLOYEE WANTS TO LEAVE THE COUNTRY. WE SHALL BE LOOKING FOR UNIQUE CIRCUMSTANCES THAT MIGHT HAVE BROUGHT INCIDENT ABOUT, EVEN THOUGH PRELIMINARY INVESTIGATION HAS NOT UNCOVERED ANYTHING SPECIAL INVOLVING THE INDIVIDUAL CONCERNED. CONSULATE ISFHAN REPORTING SEPARATELY.

SENATE TODAY APPROVED SHARIF-EMAMI GOVERNMENT BY NEAR UNANIMOUS VOTE (44 TO NOTHING, ONE NOT VOTING). DEBATE AND VOTE ON MARTIAL LAW SCHEDULED FOR SEPT. 20. MEANWHILE, SHARIF-EMAMI GOVERNMENT HAS HELD ITS FIRST CABINET MEETING AND ISSUED STATEMENTS TO PRESS WHICH SUGGEST GREAT DEAL OF ACTIVITY TO MEET ECONOMIC AND SOCIAL NEEDS OF THE COUNTRY.
MARTIAL LAW CURFEW HOURS HAVE BEEN SHORTENED FOR THREE MORE CITIES (ABADAN, AHWAZ AND SHIRAZ).
EMBASSY WILL DISCONTINUE DAILY MARTIAL LAW REPORTS UNLESS SITUATION HEATS UP AGAIN. INDIVIDUAL INCIDENTS OF INTEREST WILL, OR COURSE, CONTINUE TO BE REPORTED.

THE DEAN OF THE LOCAL DIPLOMATIC CORPS IS A SHEIK NASR AL-JABER, A BRIGHT YOUNG KUWAITI PRINCELING. THE NEPHEW OF BOTH THE EMIR AND THE PRIME MINISTER OF KUWAIT. LIKE ALL GOOD KUWAITIS, HE CELEBRATED THE END OF RAMAZAN BY LEAVING TEHRAN AND HEADING FOR THREE WEEKS IN PARIS.

I WAS THEREFORE SOMEWHAT STARTLED TO RECEIVE A TELEPHONE CALL FROM HIM THE EVENING OF SEPT. 18, SAYING HE WAS IN TOWN "INCOGNITO" AND THAT HE WANTED TO SEE ME. I STOPPED IN ON HIM WHILE ENROUTE TO A PAKISTAN RECEPTION AND FOUND HIM IN A PHILOSOPHICAL MOOD.

THE EMIRI HAD SUMMONED HIM HOME FROM PARIS, GIVEN HIM A MESSAGE OF ENCOURAGEMENT FOR THE SHAH AND SUPPLIED HIM WITH A JETSTAR TO FLY HIM TO TEHRAN. NASR HAD AN AUDIENCE WITH THE SHAH THE MORNING OF SEPT. 19. HE CONVEYED CONDOLENCES FOR THE EARTHQUAKE, BUT, MORE PARTICULARLY, A LETTER WHICH ASSURED THE SHAH OF THE EMIR'S UNFAILING SUPPORT IN THE SHAH'S EFFORTS TO RESTORE HIS POSITION OF LEADERSHIP IN IRAN.

NASR CALLED ME AFTER HIS AUDIENCE TO SAY IT HAD GONE WELL AND THAT HE FOUND THE SHAH MORE SELFCONFIDENT THAN HE HAD BEEN AT THE ID SALAAM. HE CHARACTERIZED THE SHAH'S ATTITUDE AS "PERFECT", AND DESCRIBED HIM AS BEING IN FULL CONTROL.
WITH THIS GOOD DEED DONE, THE SHEIK CLIMBED INTO HIS JETSTAR AND FLEW BACK TO THE FLESHPOTS OF PARIS.

SUMMARY: NUMBER OF INDIVIDUALS WHO SUPPORT SHAH, CONSTITUTION, AND SHAH-PEOPLE REVOLUTION ARE BEGINNING TO EXPLORE THEIR POLITICAL OPTIONS. CURRENT DISCUSSION TUURNS AROUND WHETHER RESURGENCE PARTY (RPPI) HULK CAN BE SALBAGED OR WHOLLY NEW GROUP OR GROUPS ARE NECESSARY. SOME IN THIS CATEGORY ARE AT T TACITLY ANGLING FOR AMERICAN SUPPORT. END SUMMARY.
NUMBER OF CONTACTS OVER PAST WEEK HAVE SUGGESTED THAT THOSE WHO BASICALLY FAVOR SHAH, CONSTITUTIONAL GOVERNMENT, AND LOOK AT OPTIONS FOR POLITICAL ACTIVITY OVER THE NEXT SIX TO 12 MONTHS.

SOURCE CLOSE TO SENATOR MOHANNAED HOSSEIN MUSSAVI, EX-RESURGENECE PARTY DEPUTY SECRETARY GENERAL, SAYS HE IS CURRENTLY EXTENDING FEELERS TO POLITICAL CALLIES AND OTHER CONCERNING FORMATION OF A NEW MODERATE MOVEMENT BASED ON SUPPORT OF MONARCHY, CONSTITUTION AND MODERNIZATION. HE AND NUMBER OF POLITICIANS WITH BASES IN AZARBAIJAN, KERMANSHAHAN AND OTHER EASTERN AND SOUTHERN PROVIDENCES WANT TO DEVELOP CENTRIST GROUP TO CONTEST NEXT YEAR'S PARLIAMENTARY ELECTIONS.

(COMMENT: MUSSAVI AND HIS SUPPORTERS WILL BACK SHARIF-EMAMI GOVERNMENT FOR NOW, BUT THEY AND SEVERAL OTHER "MIDDLE-OF-THE-ROAD" POLITICIANS, EITHER FROM CONVICTION OR DESIRE FOR PERSONAL ADVANCEMENT, SEE SHARIF-EMAMI CABINET AS INTERIM GOVERNMENT WHICH WILL LST NO LONGER THAN NEXT NATIONAL ELECTIONS IN JUNE 1979.)

BIGGEST DECISION FACING MUSSAVI GROUP AND ANOTHER GROUP CLUSTERING, FOR THE MOMENT AT LEAST, AROUND FORMER PRIME MINISTER HOVEYDA, IS QUESTION OF WHAT TO DO WITH REMAINS OF RESURGENCE PARTY. RPPI REMAINS A SHELL UNDER NOMINAL CONTROL OF DR. SAEED, WHO WAS NAMED INTERIM ACTING SECRETARY-GENERAL UPON EX-PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR'S RESIGNATION AS SYG. SAEED IS REGARDED BY ALL AS A HOVEYDA MAN, BUT MUSSAVI GROUP HAS SUBSTANTIAL NUMBER OF SUPPORTERS IN OTHER KEY POSITIONS, MOST OF THEM PUT THERE BY MUSSAVI HIMSELF. RPPI CONSTITUTION CALLS FOR PRIME MINISTER TO BE HEAD OF THE POLITICAL BUREAU AND TEN MINISTERS TO BE MEMBERS OF EXECTIVE COMMITTEE.

MUSSAVI IS EXPLORING POSSIBILITY OF TAKING OVER RPPI AND CHANGING CONSTITUTION ON BASIS THAT IT IS NO LONGER RELEVANT TO PARTY WHICH DOES NOT HAVE SOLE PARTY STATUS. MUSSAVI GROUP REJECTS PARTICIPATION IN NAHAVANDI'S GROUP FOR THE STUDY OF IRANIAN PROBLEMS (REF A) WHICH IS SEEN AS TOO CLOSELY TIED TO SHARIF-EMAMI GOVERNMENT AND TOO MUCH A VEHICLE FOR NAHAVANDI'S SELF-AGGRANDIZEMENT. ------------------117317 191458Z /46 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 443 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MUSCAT SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 9022

MUSSAVI ASSOCIATE NOTED SHAH HAS NEVER DISAVOWED RPPI, AND SAYS MUSSAVI IS SEEKING "GUIDANCE" FROM THRONE ON WHETHER RPPI COULD BE REFURBISHED. ON OTHER HAND, MUSSAVI SEES MANY ADVANTAGES TO STARTING FRESH, PROVIDED HE CAN PULL ALL HIS ALLIES WITH HIM INTO NEW GROUP. MUSSAVI IS CLOSE FRIENDS WITH PRESENT MINISTERS KANI AND YEGANEH AND HAS BEEN IN TOUCH WITH OTHER RANKING POLITICIANS. IN POTENTIALLY INTERESTING DEVELOPMENT, SOURCE SAID MULLAHS OSTENSIBLY REPRESENTING AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI HAVE CONTACTED MUSSAVI AND GONE AS FAR AS SUGGESTING MUTUAL ASSISTANCE. SOURCE WOULD GIVE NO FUR DETAILS.

SOURCE MADE PLEA OF AMERICAN ASSISTANCE FOR MUSSAVI. EMBOFF STUCK TO BASIC U.S. POSITION OF SUPPORT FOR SHAH AND POLITICAL LIBERALIZATION BUT NO INTERFERENCE INTO INTERNAL POLITICS. SOURCE THEN SAID U.S. WAS MAKING A MISTAKE SINCE "IT IS WELL KNOWN THAT SHARIF-EMANI AND THIS CABINET ARE BASICALLY BRITISH AGENTS." EMBOFF DOUBTED THIS WAS THE CASE. THIS SOURCE AND OTHERS, EVEN ON MODERATE SIDE, CONTINUE TO SEE FOREIGN HAND IN ALL POLITICAL MOVES.

OTHER SOURCES SUGGEST HOVEYDA AND SOME OF HIS POLITICAL ASSOCIATES ARE HAVING SAME TYPE OF DISCUSSION, WITH ALTERNATIVE TO CAPTURING RPPI BEING THE RESTABLISHMENT OF THE IRAN NOVIN PARTY. HOVEYDA COMMANDS PERSONAL LOYALTY OF NUMBER OF ACTIVE LOWER LEVEL POLITICIANS, BUT MAIN QUESTION AMONG THIS GROUP IS WHETHER HOVEYDA HIMSELF HAS NOT BEEN, OR WILL NOT BE, TOO TARNISHED BY HIS GOVERNMENTAL ROLE IN PAST. AT LEAST ONE LOCAL POLITICAL COLUMNIST HAS HINTED THAT HOVEYDA MAY GET BACK INTO ACTIVE POLITICS, BUT STORIES ALSO CONTINUE TO CIRCULATE THAT HE MAY BE PICKED UP ON CHARGES SIMILAR TO THOSE UNDER WHICH OTHER FORMER MINISTERS HAVE BEEN DETAINED.

BASIC POSTURE OF THAT PART OF THE IRANIAN"ESTABLISHMENT" WHICH COULD BE EXPECTED TO SUPPORT SHAH'S BASIC GOALS FOR MODERNIZING IRAN IS ONE OF THRASHING AROUND FOR APPROPRIATE ORGANIZATION FORMS TO CONTAIN THE NEW WINE OF THEIR POLITICAL ACTIVISM. ONE SLIGHTLY HUMOROUS NOTE: THOUGH MANY OF THESE POLITICIANS WANT TO GO OFF INDEPENDENTLY, THEY ALSO SEEK ASSURANCE FROM THE SHAH THAT THEIR ACTIVITIES WILL RECEIVE, AT A MINIMUM, A BENIGH SMILE FROM THE THRONE. SHAH HAS THUS FAR AVOIDED GIVING ANY GROUP THE "IMPERIAL NOD", ACCORDING TO SOURCES ON ALL SIDES.

1978TEHRAN09157.subject: IRAN AND THE SHAH: A ROCKY ROAD AHEAD

segments.text: IN THE COURSE OF THE PAST SEVERAL DAYS, AND IN THE SHADOW OF A MAJOR EARTHQUAKE DISASTER IN EASTERN IRAN, THE NEW GOVT OF IRAN HAS RECEIVED ITS VOTE OF CONFIDENCE IN THE PARLIAMENT AS WELL AS PARLIAMENTARY APPROVAL FOR SIX MONTHS OF MARTIAL LAW. AN AIR OF CALM HAS BEEN RESTORED TO THE CITIES, EXCEPT FOR MINOR INCIDENTS OF LAWLESSNESS, BUT THE SHAH AND THE GOVT FACE ENORMOUSLY COMPLICATED PROBLEMS IN THE FUTURE.

THE GOVT NOW FACES THE COMPLICATED TASK OF ESTABLISHING ITS LEADERSHIP, CREATING SOME SENSE OF CONFIDENCE IIN GOVT ITSELF, AND ACHIEVING A POPULAR CONSENSUS FOR ITS POLICIES. IN ORDER TO DO THIS, IT MUST MOVE CONVINCINGLY TO LIBERALIZE AND BROADEN ITS BASE SO THAT RESPONSIBLE POLITICAL GROUPS WITH DEMOCRATIC AMBITIONS CAN PLAY A ROLE IN THE PROCESSES OF GOVT. AT THE SAME TIME, IT MUST PLACATE THE MANY WHO HAVE LENT THEMSELVES TO A LEADERSHIP WHICH HAS CALLED FOR THE OVERTHROW OF THE CURRENT REGIME.

IF IT DOES NOT SUCCEED IN THE LATTER EFFORT, IT IS PREDICTABLE THAT THE LIFTING OF MARTIAL LAW AND THE RE-OPENING OF THE LIBERALIZATION PROCESS WILL RESULT ONCE AGAIN IN THE TURBULENCE OF THE RECENT PAST AND A REVIVAL OF THE SORRY CYCLE OF MILITARY SUPPRESSION. THE CONSEQUENCES FOR THE SHAH AND THE MONARCHY COULD BE OMINOUS.

THE SHAH HAS BEEN DIRECTING HIS LIBERALIZTION PROGRAM OVER THE PAST TWO YEARS ON LARGELY AN AD HOC BASIS. EVENTS THEMSELVES DETERMINED THAT TWO HISTORIC CONSTITUTIONAL ISSUES WOULD BE REOPENED: THE INDEPENDENCE OF THE PRIME MINISTER AND HIS CABINET AS REPRESENTATIVES OF, AND RESPONSIBLE TO, THE PARLIAMENT AND THE POWERS OF THE SHI'A ISLAMIC CLERGY AS TRADITIONAL GUARDIANS OF THE PEOPLE'S RIGHTS AND EXPONENTS OF THEIR GRIEVANCES. BOTH ISSUES HAD PREVIOUSLY BEEN SETTLED IN THE SHAH'S FAVOR, ONE WITH SUPPRESSION OF MOSSADEGH AND RESTRAINT OF HIS SUCCESSORS IN THE 1950'S, THE OTHER WITH REPRESSION OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI'S MOBS IN 1963.

OVER THE PAST SUMMER THE SHAH DEMONSTRATED THAT HE WAS WILLING TO YIELD SOME POWER TO A PRIME MINISTER AND PARLIAMENT AS PART OF THE LIBERALIZATION LEADING TO PROMISED FREE PARLIAMENTARY ELECTIONS NEXT JUNE. HE AND THE AMOUZEGAR GOVT SHOWED LESS WILLINGNESS OR ABILITY TO ACCOMMODATE THE SHI'A CLERGY OR TO RECOGNIZE THE AREAS OF POPULAR DISCONTENT WHICH THAT CLERGY MIGHT BE ABLE TO EXPLOIT.

CONSEQUENTLY, THE CLERGY USED CENTURIES-OLD TECHNIQUES TO CALL OUT THEIR MASSES. BOTH THE MODERATE CLERGY BEHIND AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI OF GHOM (WHO IS ALLIED WITH NATIONAL FRONT AND OTHER MIDDLE CLASS CONSTITUTIONALIST POLITICIANS WHO HAVE SOPHISTICATION BUT NO MOB APPEAL) AND, ON THE OTHER HAND, THE EXTREMIST COALITON OF FANATIC MOSLEMS LED BY AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI IN IRAQ (WHICH HAS REPORTEDLY BEEN PENETRATED AND IS ASSISTED BY A VARIETY OF TERRORIST, CRYPTO-COMMUNIST, AND OTHER FAR LEFT ELEMENTS) LAUNCHED STRONG APPEALS TO LARGE SECTIONS OF THE ECONOMICALLY DISADVANTAGED ELEMENTS OF SOCIETY WHO NURSE A WHOLE HOST OF ECONOMIC AND SOCIAL GRIEVANCES.

THESE ARE GRIEVANCES BROUGHT ON TO A CONSIDERABLE EXTENT BY THE FRUSTRATIONS, INEQUITIES, CORRUPTION, AND RISING EXPECTATIONS ENGENDERED BY THE SHAH'S PROGRAM OF ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AND WESTERNIZED SOCIAL REFORM SINCE 1963.

SINCE THESE DISCONTENTED PEOPLE HAVE LITTLE TO LOSE AND SINCE THE MODERATE CLERGY HAD LITTLE GAIN TO OFFER THEM, THEY SOON LENT THEMSELVES TO THE MORE RADICAL LEADERSHIP OF KHOMEINI, WHO CALLED FOR THE OVERTHROW OF THE SHAH AND THE DESTRUCTION OF THE CURRENT SYSTEM. ------------------075639 211457Z /47 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 499 INFO AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY PARIS USLO PEKING USCINCEUR SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 09157 LIMDIS

THE GRIEVANCES WHICH MOTIVATED THIS EXTREMIST OPPOSITION ARE TO A LARGE EXTENT SHARED BY MANY POLITICIANS AND OTHER CITIZENS WHO SUPPORT THE SHAH AND WHO FEAR THE CHAOS WHICH WOULD RESULT FROM THE END OF THE MONARCHY. NEVERTHELESS, THE MODERATE LEADERS COOPERATED WITH THE EXTREMISTS TO SCARE MORE CONCESSIONS OUT OF THE SHAH, AND THE SHARIATMADARI CLERGY DID NOT DARE TO LET ITSELF BE OUTFLANKED ON THE LEFT AND LOSE MASS SUPPORTERS TO THE EXTREMISTS. THE NET RESULT WAS AN APPARENT COALESCENCE OF ALL STREAMS OF OPPOSITION IN ONE MASSIVE FIRESTORM DIRECTED AGAINST THE SHAH.

IN PRACTICE, AS INDICATED IN THE FOREGOING PARAGRAPHS, THE NATURE OF THE OPPOSITIONS IS NOT AS UNIFIED AS IT MIGHT APPEAR. MOREOVER, THE PROBLEM OF DEALING WITH IT IS NOT AS SIMPLISTIC AS SOME HAVE SUGGESTED. FOR EXAMPLE, THERE ARE SOME WITHIN THE GOI, AND PARTICULARLY IN THE MILITARY, WHO BELIEVE THAT THE PROBLEM THEY FACE CAN BE HANDLED BY THE INCARCERATION OF OPPOSITION POLITICIANS AND LESSER MULLAHS AMONG THOSE WHO LEAD THE MALCONTENTS, ON THE GROUNDS THAT THEY ARE SUBVERSIVES.

MORE SOPHISTICATED OBSERVERS, INCLUDING THE SHAH, RECOGNIZE THAT THE TOP RELIGIOUS LEADERS SUCH AS KHOMEINI AND SHARIATMADARI ARE ABOVE ARREST UNDER PRESENT CONDITIONS AND IN ANY CASE OTHER LEADERS WOULD SOON TAKE THE PLACE OF THOSE ARRESTED. RATHER, THE PROBLEM MUST BE MET BY ADDRESSING THE SOURCES OF DISCONTENT, WHILE GAINING TIME FOR GOVT PROGRAMS TO TAKE EFFECT.

AS PART OF THIS HOLDING ACTION, TO PLACATE THE DISCONTENTED, THE SHAH HAS AUTHORIZED A CAMPAIGN AGAINST PAST CORRUPTION FEATURING ARRESTS OF FORMER MINISTERS AND OTHERS YET TO COME. THE ULTIMATE RESULTS OF THESE ARRESTS--WHICH ARE ORGANIZED BY SAVAK UNDER MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS EVEN THOUGH IT IS GENERALLY BELIEVED SUFFICIENT PROOF CAN NEVER BE PRODUCED TO CONVICT MANY OF THE ARRESTEES IN A CIVILIAN COURT OF LAW--MIGHT BE COUNTER-PRODUCTIVE.

THERE ARE MANY AMONG THE SHAH'S SUPPORTERS AS WELL AS THE OPPOSITION WHO CRITICIZE HIS THROWING OF FORMER SUBORDINATES TO THE WOLVES AS A MATTER OF EXPEDIENCY WHEN HE HIMSELF HAS BEEN RESPONSIBLE FOR ALL MAJOR POLICIES UNDER EVERY GOVT IN THE PAST FIFTEEN YEARS OR MORE.

THE REAL ISSUE YET TO BE RESOLVED IS WHETHER, IN THE SHORT SPACE OF THE SIX MONTHS OR SO WHICH THE GOVT HAS ALLOWED ITSELF TO TERMINATE MARTIAL LAW AND PUSH THROUGH LIBERALIZING LEGISLATION, IT CAN CONVINCE THE IRANIAN PUBLIC THAT IT IS SINCERELY TACKLING THE CAUSES OF DISCONTENT AND PLACATE, ISOLATE, OR OTHERWISE PREVENT THE OPPOSITION FROM INITIATING THE MOB ACTION WHICH WOULD AGAIN THREATEN THE WHOLE ESTABLISHMENT EDIFICE. THE SHAH AND HIS BUREAUCRACY HAVE A MANDARIN MENTALITY WHICH WILL HAVE TO STRAIN ENORMOUSLY TO EMPATHIZE SUCCESSFULLY WITH THE MALCONTENTS.

MEANWHILE, THOSE POLITICAL LEADERS--WHETHER IN SUPPORT OF OR IN OPPOSITION TO THE CURRENT GOVT--WHO WISH LIBERALIZED EVOLUTIONARY CHANGE WILL HAVE TO EXERT THEMSELVES SIGNIFICANTLY IF THEY ARE TO ACHIEVE THE DEGREE OF POLITICAL ORGANIZATION REQUIRED TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THE SORT OF FREE ELECTIONS WHICH THE SHAH HAS ORDAINED. AS OF NOW, MANY OF THEM HAVE ONLY THE LEAKIEST POLITICAL VESSELS WITH WHICH TO CONTEST THE ELECTIONS. THEY THEREFORE STAND THE RISK OF BEING SWAMPED BY THE ONLY APPARENT POLITICAL FORCE WHICH CURRENTLY EXISTS IN IRAN--THE RELIGIOUS-POLITICALEXTREMIST OPPOSITION.

THESE, THEN ARE THE CONDITIONS UNDER WHICH THE SHAH AND HIS NEW GOVT FACE THE IMMEDIATE FUTURE. THE FUNDAMENTAL STRUCTURE OF THE COUNTRY REMAINS INTACT, BUT THE TURBULENCE OF THE RECENT PAST, LIKE THE EARTH TREMORS WHICH CONTINUE TO TROUBLE THE EASTERN PROVINCES, ARE SYMPTOMS OF THE SORT OF DISRUPTION WHICH COULD POTENTIALLY OVERWHELM THIS SOCIETY. THE EMBASSY, IN SUBSEQUENT MESSAGES, WILL ATTEMPT TO ASSESS THE STRENGTH OF THE VARIOUS FORCES AT WORK, THE COURSES OF ACTION THEY MAY BE EXPECTED TO FOLLOW, AND THE INTERPLAY WHICH MUST BE ANTICIPATED.

1978TEHRAN09158.subject: ECONOMIC IMPACTS OF IAN'S POLITICAL PROBLEMS

segments.text: SUMMARY: SINCE REPORTING (REFTEL) FIRST INDICATIONS OF EFFECTS ON IRAN'S ECONOMY FROM THE LAST MONTH'S POLITICAL DISTURBANCE AND MARTIAL LAW, SOME FACTORS SUCH AS CAPITAL FLIGHT HAVE BECOME BETTER KNWON WHILE OTHERS REMAIN UNCLEAR, SUCH AS NEW IMPORT ORDERS. HESITANCY REMAINS A BASIC BUSINESS CHARACTERISTIC, ALTHOUGH RETAIL TRADE IN THE BAZAARS IS RETURNING TO NORMAL WITH THE PASSING OF MORE RELATIVELY UNEVENTFUL MARTIAL LAW DAYS AND BUSINESS CONFIDENCE APPEARS MENDING. CAPITAL FLIGHT IS REPORTED SUBSIDING AND THE TEHRN STOCK EXCHANGE, OFF AS MUCH AS 80-90 PERCENT IN VOLUMES, IS RECOVING SOMEWHAT. END SUMMARY.

A SENIOR CENTRAL BANK (CBI) OFFICIAL'S STATEMENT THAT CAPITAL FLIGHT IS UP 40 PRCENT OVER LAST YEAR APPEARS MODERATE. REPRESENTATIVES OF TWO U.S. BANKS HERE BELIEVE CAPITAL FLIGHT IS UP SUBSTANTIALLY, PARTICULARLY AS EVIDENCED IN PRIVATE IRANIAN APPLICATIONS FOR U.S. BANK ACCOUNTS AND CERTIFICATES OF DEPOSIT. (WHILE CBI REGULATIONS DO NOT EXPLICITLY PROHIBIT REPRESENTATIVE BANK OFFICES FROM SOLICITING OR ACCEPTING U.S. BANK ACCOUNT BUSINESS FROM IRANIANS MOST "REPS" DO NOT SOLICIT BUT DO FACILITATE THE OPENING OF U.S.

ACCOUNTS BY PROVIDING APPLIATIONS AND TRANSMITTING DOLLAR DRAFTS) ONE BANK FOUND ACCOUNT APPLIATIONS IN THE THREE WEEKS ENDING SEPTEMBER 14 UP FROM AN AVERAGE OF FIVE A WEEK TO 20 A DAY, WITH ALL INITIAL DEPOSITS EXCEEDING DLS 100,000 (MOSTLY CD'S). ANOTHER BANK, WHICH ALMOST SHUNS THE ACCOUNT ACTIVITY, WAS RECEIVING 10 TO 15 A WEEK VERSUS ONE OR TWO BEFORE; SOME TRANSFERS REACHED SEVERAL MILLION DOLLARS AND WERE DESTINED TO THE BANK'S NASSAU BRANCH. ONE IRANIAN DEPOSIT BANK REPORTED CAPITAL OUTFLOWS UP 50 PERCENT IN THE MONTH ENDING AUGUST 22, WITH FLOWS THE NEXT TWO WEEKS EXCEEDING THE ENTIRE PREVIOUS MONTH.

ADMITTEDLY, ONE MUST TREAT STATEMENTS OF CAPITAL FLIGHT WITH CAUTION OWING PARTICULARLY TO DEFINITIONAL PROBLEM. WE BELIEVE THE FOREGOING GENERALLY CONSIDERS ALL NON-REGISTERED FLOWS AND NON-COMMERCIAL TRANSACTIONS AS CAPITAL FLIGHT. THE ABOVE FLOWS MUST BE SEEN IN LIGHT OF THE GENERALLY HELD VIEW THAT THE "BIG MONEY" LEFT IRAN SOME TIME AGO. RECENT FLOWS ARE THUS VIEWED WITH GREATER CONCERN BECAUSE IT IS BELIEVED THEY REPRESENT THE NEWER RICH FROM WHOSE RANKS MANY HOPED WOULD COME THE "NEXT WAVE" OF ENTREPRENEURS AND INVESTORS. A FAIRLY CONNSISTENT VIEW IS THAT THE SIGNIFICANT UPTURN IN OUTFLOWS PEACKED THE WEEK ENDING SEPTEMBER 14.

FOREIGN EXCHANGE REPORTEDLY IS ADEQUATE TO MEET DEMANDS WITH NO NEW CBI OR BANK MELLI RESTRICTIONS APPLYING ON THE NON-COMMERCIAL MARKET. ------------------006509 230843Z /10 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 501

SEVERAL BANKERS REPORT AN UNUSUALLY STRONG TRADE IN IMPORT FINANCING IN THE LAST WEEK, WHICH CONTRASTS TO HIGHLY NEGATIVE REPORTS CONCERING NEW TRADE ORDERS REPORTED IN REFTEL. ONE LARGE U.S. BANK REP OFFICE PROCESSED DLS 30 MILLION SHORT-TERM TRADE FINANCING TO PRIVATE COMMERCIAL BANKS IN SEVERAL DAYS LAST WEEK, A CONSIDERABLY HIGHER THAN USUAL LEVEL. ANOTHER U.S. BANK REP OFFICE PROCESSED DLS 20 MILLION ALSO FOR PRIVATE IMPORTS IN THE LAST WEEK TO 10 DAYS, WELL ABOVE NORMAL LEVELS OF BUSINESS.

U.S. BANKERS CONTACTED REPORT THE VIEW THAT NO NEW, I.E. ADVERSE, POLITICAL RISK ASSESSMENT IS REFLECTED IN RECENT EXTERNAL LENDING RATES TO IRAN. IN FACT, ONE VIEW IS THAT THE CONTINUING HIGHLY LIQUID STATE OF INTERNATIONAL FINANCIAL MARKETS OVERRIDES ANY PERCEPTION OF NEW POLITICAL RISK IN IRAN. THUS, ONE BANK JUST LOWERED ITS SHORT-TERM EURODOLLAR LENDING RATE TO IRAN WHICH FOR MOST BANKS HERE IS ONE-HALF OVER LIBOR. ON THE OTHER HAND, BOTH LEADING U.S. BANKERS AND MEAF AND CBI OFFICIALS CONCEDE THAT WERE IRAN TO TAKE A SYNDICATION TO THE LONDON MARKET NOW THERE WOULD BE SOME SKITTISH REACTIONS.

THUS, EFFORTS BY THE MEAF TO SEEK A REFINANCING OF THE DECEMBER 1976 IMPERIAL GOVENMENT EURODOLLAR BORROWING OF DLS 500 MILLION HAVE BEEN TEMPORARILY SHELVED. (IT HAD BELIEVED IT COULD OBTAIN AS LOW A RATE AS FIVE-EIGHTHS OVER LIBOR, 10 YEARS TERM).

ONE U.S. BANK REP BELIEVES THAT THE SEPTEMBER 9-14 BANK MELLI 50TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATIONS, WHICH BROUGHT SOME 103 FOREIGN BANKERS AND FINANCIAL LEADERS TO IRAN (INCLUDING SOME 18 FROM THE U.S), BROUGHT IRAN THE ORIGINALLY UNINTENDED BENEFIT OF SUBSTANTIALLY CONFORTING THE INTERNATIONAL FINANCIAL COMMUNITY CONCERNING IRAN. THE VISITORS, SO THE VIEW GOES, HAD OBTAINED FROM THEIR NATIONAL PRESS A RECENT PICTURE OF IRAN IN FLAME, SUCCUMBED BY RIOTS. ALTHOUGH MOST ARRIVED IN A TEHRAN JUST SUBJECTED TO MARTIAL LAW AND CURFEW, AND HAD TO ADJUST TO A CHANGED PROGRAM OF EVENTS, THEY FOUND TEHRAN GENERALLY "BUSINESS AS USUAL" AND WITH IRANIAN HOSTS WHO EVIDENCED TO THEM SURPRISING CALM.

A U.S. FINANCIAL OFFICER HERE, WHOSE FIRM HAS A SEAT ON THE TEHRAN STOCK EXCHANGE, REPORTS THAT THE TSE HAS BEGUN A SLOW RECOVERY FROM THE 80-90 PERCENT FALL IN VOLUMES OF SOME THREE WEEKS AGO. THE SHARE MARKET IS STILL QUIET, ALTHOUGH THERE WAS AT THE OUTSET OF RIOTS IN EARLY SEPTEMBER SOME PANIC SALES OFFERINGS. BOND ACTIVITY, ON THE OTHER HAND, IS STRONG, WITH YIELDS CONSEQUENTLY DOWN. PENSION FUNDS ARE HIGHLY LIQUID AND ARE SEEN AS THE CAUSE OF THE UPTURN IN BOND PURCHASING. THIS SOURCE REMARKED ON THE SUBSTANTIAL UPTURN IN ECONOMIC CONFIDENCE BY IRANIANS IN THE LAST WEEK.

1978TEHRAN09160.subject: DEMANDS OF PARLIAMENTARY OPPOSTION CENTER ON REVENGE

segments.text: OUR CLOSE READING OF RECENT MAJLES AND SENATE DEBATES REGARDING SHARIF-EMAMI'S PROGRAM CONFIRMS WHAT IS APPARENT AT FIRST CLANCE--OPPOSITION, AT LEAST IN PARLIAMENT, HAS AS YET NO SUBSTANTIVE PROGRAM. OPPOSITIONISTS LOGICALLY ALSO OPPOSED MARTIAL AND BLAMED GOVERNMENT FOR DEATHS AT JAHEL SQUARE. CLAIMING INCIDENT COULD HAVE BEEN AVOIDED. SOME DEPUTIES DEMANDED REVITALIZATION OF AGRICULTURE, GOVERNMENT HAD ALREADY PICKED OUT AT TOP PRIORITY ITEM. DEPUTIES MATLAQ AND ESHAQI-NEJAD CALLED FOR IMPROVED RELATIONS WITH RELIGIOUS LEADERS. TWO SPEAKERS SPECIFICALLY PROPOSED LIFTING CONTROLS ON HAJ FLIGHTS (GOI ANNOUNCED END OF RESTRICTIONS SEPT. 19).
A FEW DEPUTIES DEMANDED NEW LABOR LEGISLATION; DEPUTY JAVADI PROPOSED ELIMINATING UNNECESSARY FOREIGN WORKERS. ON THE WHOLE, SPEAKERS INGNORED SUBSTANTIVE ISSUES.

DEBATES NONETHELESS FEATURED ONE OVERWHELMING THEME-CORRUPTION, PUNISHMENT, AND INDEED REVENGE. SUPPORTERS OF GOVERNMENT IN FACT SOUNDED NO DIFFERENT FROM OPPONENTS. POSTAM RAFA'ATI, FOR EXAMPLE, CAMETO DEFEND GOVERNMENT PORGRAM YET ASSAILED FORMER PM HOVEYDA, DEMANDING INVESTIGATION INTO HIS LONG CAREER. ONE DEPUTY AFTER ANOTHER CRIED FOR PROSECUTION OF "THOSE WHO HAVE PLUNDE RED THE NATIONAL WEALTH", OR WORDS TO THAT EFFECT.

COMMENT: USE OF PAST TENSE IS SIGNIFICANT. THIS IS NOT A NORMAL "CLEAN-UP-CORRUPTION" CAMPAIGN, ALTHOUGH IT IS A PARTLY THAT. DEPUTIES GIVE IMPRESSION THEY ARE BURNING TO DIG INTO HISTORY AND "GET" A GROUP WHICH SURELY MUST INCLUDE BULK OF NATIONAL LEADERSHIP DURING THOSE YEARS. STATUTE OF LIMITATIONS OF 15 YEARS IS OFTEN MENTIONED, CONVENIENTLY MATCHING PERIOD SINCE 1963 OF SHAH'S UNQUESTIONED SUPREME RULE. DEPUTIES' ACCUSATIONS OF COURSE HAVE FACTUAL BASIS, ALTHOUGH IT IS EASY TO SEE WHY THEIR SPIRIT OF SELF-PRESERVATION LEADS TO THEIR WISHING TO EXCLUDE EARLIER ABUSES FROM INVESTIGATION.

MOST STRIKING ASPECT IS FACT THAT PARLIAMENT, WHICH MIGHT SEIZE UPON LIBERALIZING TREND AND LOOK AHEAD TO ENHANCED ROLE IN POLITICAL DECISIONMAKING, HAS INSTEAD CONCENTRATED UPON EVENING UP OLD SCORES.

1978TEHRAN09163.subject: CONGRESSIONAL DELEGATION TO UNGA POST REQUESTS NAMES OF U.S. CONGRESSIONAL DELEGATION TO UNGA.

segments.text: POST REQUESTS NAMES OF U.S. CONGRESSIONAL DELEGATION TO UNGA.

OUR SOURCES CONFIRM THAT THERE IS NO RPT NO IRANIAN LAW REGARDING MEMBERSHIP IN IRANIAN STUDENTS ASSOCIATION OR CONFEDERATION OF IRANIAN STUDENTS. IN ANY EVENT, THESE ORGANIZATIONS ARE NOT RPT NOT REGISTERED UNDER IRANIAN LAW BECAUSE THEY DO NOT RPT NOT EXIST IN IRAN. ONLY ORGANIZATION WHICH IS OUTLAWED IS TUDEH (COMMUNIST) PAETY TO BEST OF OUR KNOWLEDGE.

HAVING SAID THAT, IT SHOULD BE NOTED THAT GOI HAS NOT RPT NOT LOOKED WITH FAVOR UPON MEMBERSHIP IN EITHER STUDENT ORGANIZATION, PARTICULARLY IF THIS ALSO INVOLVES ANTI-STATE OR ANTI-SHAH ACTIVITY, BOTH OF WHICH ARE ILLEGAL UNDER IRANIAN STATUTE. PRACTICE OF GOI IN LASTYEAR OR TWO (WHICH WE BELIEVE IS GETTING MORE, NOT LESS, LIBERAL) IS TO MORE OR LESS IGNORE MERE MEMBERSHIP IN THESE ORGANIZATIONS WHILE STUDENT IS/WAS ABROAD, BUT TO CONCERN ITSELF WITH POTENTIALLY SUBVERSIVE OR ILLEGAL ACTIVITIES STUDENT MAY HAVE COMMITTED.

TO OUR KNOWLEDGE OVER PAST YEAR ONLY EX-STUDENTS PICKED UP HAVE BEEN THOSE WHO HAVE BEEN SUSPECTED OF DOING SOMETHING HERE IN IRAN AFTER THEIR RETURN; THERE HAVE BEEN ONLY TWO OR THREE CASES OF THIS IN APPROXIMATELY 5,000 RETURNEES, AND THERE HAVE BEEN DEALT WITH RATHER LENIENTLY. INITIAL THRUST OF SHARIF-EMAMI GOVERNMENT HAS SUGGESTED EVEN LESS CONCERN WITH "NORMAL" RANGE OF IRANIAN STUDENT ACTIVITIES ABROAD THAN PREVIOUS GOVERNMENTS.

1978TEHRAN09198.subject: POLITICAL REPORT--QUIET WEEKEND, GOI CONTINUES ACTIVE

segments.text: SUMMAR: IRAN QUIET OVER WEEKEND; TROOP AND ARMOR PRESENCE REDUCED IN TEHRAN AND SHIRAZ. PRESS FREEDOM BILL PUBLISHED FOR PUBLIC COMMENT BEFORE PRESENTATION TO MAJLES. MEDIA OBJECT TO IT. MINISTER OF JUSTICE DIRECTS OFFICIALS TO MAKE MONTHLY PRISON VISIT. ARDALAN TO BE COURT MINSTER. CONTROVERSY OVER PROSECUTION OF MAJLES DEPUTIES. CIVIL SERVICE ORGANIZATION ADOPTS STRICTER STANDERS TO ELIMINATE DOUBLE EMPLOYMENT. CONTROVERSY OVER UNIVERSITY AUTONOMY BILL. ISFAHAN DEATH SENTECES NULLIFIED BY SUPREME COURT. RESIRGENCE PARTY TO TRY REVIVAL; OPPOSITION CONFERENCE TO BE HELD IN ROME. SOME POLITICAL PRISONERS RELEASED. PROMINENT MULLAH'S SON DIED. END SUMMARY.

WEEKEND PASSED QUIETLY IN IRAN WITH VISIBLE REDUCTION IN TROOP AND TANK PRESENCE IN CITY SEPT. 23. SHIRAZ ALSO REPORTS REMOVAL OF TANKS FROM CITY LOCATIONS. RUMOR MILL HAS OT THAT MARTIAL LAW WILL BE ENDED WITHIN A SHORT TIME, BUT OUR BETTER SOURCES SUGGEST THAT IT WILL REMAIN IN FORCE AT LEAST UNTIL OPENING OF UNIVERSITY YEAR OCT. 7, AND PROBABLY UNTIL END OF MAJOR MOSLEM HOLY DAY OF ASHURA, DEC. 11, WHICH MARKS END OF DEEP MOURNING PERIOD.
ON SEPT. 23, GOI RELEASED DRAFT PRESS FREEDOM BILL.

EMBASSY HAS NOT YET OBTAINED FULL TEXT, BUT PROVISIONS AS PUBLISHED IN LOCAL PRESS INCLUDE, A) PUBLISHING PERMIT CAN BE OBTAINED BY ANY DIPLOMA-HOLDING IRANIAN OVER 30 WITH "SOUND MIND, HIGH MORALS, GOOD PERSONAL RECORD, AND NO CRIMINAL PAST;" B) PRESS COMMISSION TO APPROVE PUBLISHING LICENSES WHICH WILL INCLUDE A MININFO OFFICIAL, TEHRAN CITY COUNCIL CHAIRMAN, PROSECUTOR GENERAL, A UNIVERSITY PROFESSOR, AND A SENIOR EDITOR ELECTED BY COUNRY'S EDITORS; C) NO BANNING OF PUBLICATIONS EXCEPT BY COURT ORDER EXCEPT IN CASES OF DISCLOSURE OF MILITARY SECRETS AND AGITATION TO REVOLT AGAINST LEGAL GOVERNMENT; $) LIBEL RULES WHICH REQUIRE PRESS TO PROVIDE EVIDENCE TO COMPLAINTANT AND PUBLISH HIS SIDE OF STROY WITHIN LIMITS AND E) PROVISION THAT PUBLISHERS MUST HAVE ENOUGH MONEY TO KEEP GOING FOR A YEAR.

REACTION OF LOCAL PRESS AND JOURNALISTS HAS BEEN PROMPT AND ACID. IN ADDITION TO PERSONAL COMMENTS FROM PRESSMEN ABOUT UNSUITABILITY OF PRESS COMMITTEE AND ABSIRDITY OF REGULATIONS GOVERNING ISSUANCE OF PUBLISHING LICENSES, TEHRAN JOURNAL FULL COLUMN EDITORIAL MORNING SEPT. 24 SAYS PRESS COMMUNITY SEEKS BASIC SITUATION WHERE ANYONE WITH SOMETHING TO SAY SHOULD BE ABLE TOO DO SO AS LONG AS IT FALLS WITHIN THE LAW REGARDING SUCH THINS AS LIBEL AND PLAGIARISM.

JOURNAL ADDS, "WE VERY MUCH REGRET TO SAY THAT THE EAGERLY AWAITED NEW PRESS LAW NOT ONLY FAILS TO GUARANTEE THAT THIS WISH BECOMES FACT BUT COULD BE CONSTRUED AS WORKING AGAINST IT." MINISTER OF JUSTICE BAHERI HAS ISSUED CIRCULAR CALLING ON ALL PROSECUTORS AND DISTRICT COURT OFFICIALS TO INSPECT PRISONS AND STUDY CONDITIONS OF PRISONER AT LEAST ONCE EVERY MONTH. CIRCULAR ALSO SUGGESTED THAT OFFICIALS TAKE REPRESENTATIVES OF PRISONER PROTECTIVE SOCIETIES" ALONG WITH THEM. (COMMENT : HUMAN RIGHTS TYPES HERE ARE NOT CERTAIN IF THIS MEANS NON-GOVERNMENTAL REPRESENTATIVES CAN VISIT, BUT THERE IS SPECULATION THAT THIS COULD AT LEAST OPEN THE WAY FOR SOME CITIZEN ACTIVITY IN THIS AREA. ON OTHER HAND, WE KNOW BAHERI REJECTET RECENT EFFORT BY COMMITTEE FOR DEFENSE OF POLITICAL PRISONER IN IRAN TO ACCOMPANY OFFICAL ON ONE SUCH VISIT).

IRAN'S CIVIL SERVICE COURT HAS ASKED MAJLES AND SENATE TO INFORM IT OF ANY KNOWN CASES OF CORRUPTION. THIS TOUCHED OFF MINOR BROUHAHA FOLLOWING REPORTS THAT MINISTRY INTENDED TO PROSECUTE MAJLES DEPUTIES WHO ARE ACCUSED OF HOARDING, PROFITEERING AND "IMPROPER DEALINGS" IN TEXTILES AND GLASS PRODUCTS. MAJLES SPEAKER HAS MADE IT CLEAR THAT FIRST STEP IN THIS PROCESS IS SUBMISSION BY MINISTRY TO PARLIAMENTARY COMMITTEE WHICH WILL REVIEW EVIDENCE AND MAKE DECISION ON WHETHER OR NOT TO LIFT PARLIAMENTARY IMMUNITY. IF IMMUNITY IS LIFTED, PROSECUTION CAN CONTINUE.

POLITICAL COLUMNIST SEPT. 24 REPORTS RETURN TO TEHRAN OF ALI-OHOLI ARDALAN AND RUMOR THAT HE WILL BE NEW COURT MINISTER. EMBASSY HAS LEARNED RUMOR IS TRUE. FULL BIO REVIEW WILL FOLLOW, BUT ARDALAN IS WELL KNOWN TO U.S., HAS SERVED IN WASHINGTON AS AMBASSADOR AND DONE TOUR AS FOREIGN MINISTER IN 1950'S. HE HAS SINCE BEEN AMBASSADOR TO MOSCOW AND WEST GERMANY AND SPENT PERIODS AS HEAD OF IRAN'S INSTITUTE OF MASS COMMUNICATION.

STATE ORGANIZATION FOR EMPLOYMENT AND ADMINISTRATION (SOEA IS IRANIAN CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION) ANNOUNCED SEPT 21 THAT EMPLOYMENT REGULATIONS HAVE BEEN AMENDED SO THAT CIVIL SERVANTS WHO ARE NOT CURRENTLY EMPLOYED WILL HAVE TO REPORT ON THEIR EMPLOYMENT STATUS EVERY SIX MONTHS AND WILL NOT RECEIVE SALARY PAYMENTS IF THEY ARE FOUND TO BE WORKING IN PRIVATE BUSINESS. (COMMENT: IF FULLY ENFORCED, THIS WILL DISCOURAGE INDIVIDUALS FROM CARRYING ON TIMEHONORED PERSIAN PRACTICE OF LINGERING ON CIVIL SERVICE ROLLS WHILE ENJOYING LUCRATIVE PRIVATE POSITION.)

RESURGENCE PARTY (RPPI) MAY BE PLANNING TO REENTER POLITICAL ARENA. RPPI EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE IS SCHEDULED TO MEET SEPT 25 TO CHOOSE NEW SECRETARY GENERAL (SYG) AND ELECT 15 NEW MEMBERS FOR POLITICAL BUREAU, MOSTLY TO REPLACE GOVERNMENT MINISTERS WHO ARE NO LONGER PARTY OFFICIALS. WE UNDERSTAND FROM SOURCE INVOLVED IN PROCESS THAT NEW SYG WILL BE JAVAD SAEED, NOW ONLY REMAINING RPPI DEPUTY SYG. MOST OBSERVERS, INCLUDING EMBASSY, ARE AWAITING RESULTS OF FURTHER ACTIVITY WITHIN PARTY, IN INCLUDING CHANGES IN PARTY RULES AND GUIDELINES, BEFORE ANALYZING RPPI'S FUTURE ELECTORAL CHANGES.
PRESS HAS INDICATED SOME POLITICAL PRISONERS HAVE BEEN RELEASED OVER WEEKEND. EMBASSY WILL POUCH NAMES WHEN AVAILABLE.

HOJATOLISLAM HAJ SEYED MEHDI GOLPAYEGANI, SON OF AYATOLLAH HAJ SEYED MOHAMMAD REZA GOLPAYEGANI OF QOM, DIED IN CAR ACCIDENT SEPT 22 WHILE ENROUTE TO TABAS EARTHQUAKE SCENE. CAR COLLIDED WITH AN OIL TANKER AND VICTIM AND FIVE OTHERS WERE KILLED. SIGNIFICANTLY, PRIME MINISTER SHARIF-EMAMI SENT CONDOLENCE MESSAGE TO AYATOLLAH GOLPAYEGANI, AND SEVERAL THOUSAND PEOPLE ESCORTED BODY THROUGH YAZD PEACEFULLY SEPT 23.

SOURCE SAID HIS AFGHAN EMBASSY CONTACTS IN WASHINGTON SAID AFGHAN AMBASSADOR TO THE U.S. NOOR WAS REPORTEDLY HEADED FOR ALGERIAN EXILE.
