1978TEHRAN09251.subject: KHOMEINI PLACED UNDER HOUSE ARREST, LIBERATION MOVEMENT OF IRAN (LMI) SEEKS FURTHER U.S. CONTACT SUMMARY: LMI REPRESENTATIVES INFORMED EMBOFF THAT

segments.text: MOVEMENT OF IRAN (LMI) SEEKS FURTHER U.S. CONTACT SUMMARY: LMI REPRESENTATIVES INFORMED EMBOFF THAT IRAQI GOVERNMENT HAS PLACED AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI UNDER HOUSE ARREST AND WILL ONLY ALLOW RELATIVES TO VISIT. KHOMEINI MAY WANT TO LEAVE IRAQ. LMI BELIEVES EITHER USSR OR US PRESSURED IRAQIS TO MAKE MO EMBOFF DENIED US ROLE. LMI SUGGESTS MEETING WITH US REPRESENTATIVES TO CLARIFY ITS GOALS AND ENLIST US ASSISTANCE. IN VIEW OF INCREASING ACTIVITY BY LEFTISTS, FURTHER DEMONSTRATIONS MAY BE IN STORE. END SUMMARY.

AT URGENT REQUEST OF LMI REPRESENTATIVE, POLOFF STEMPEL MET WITH TWO REPRESENTATIVES OF MOVEMENT SEPT 25. LMI ASKED FOR MEETING BECAUSE NEWS HAD REACHED IRAN SEPT. 24 THAT IRAQI GOVERNMENT HAS PLACED SOLDIERS AROUND KHOMEINI HOUSE AND HAD ONLY ALLOWED TWO PEOPLE, BOTH RELATIVES, THROUGH POLICE LINE. POLICE TOLD KHOMEINI MOVE TAKEN BECAUSE IRAQ WANTS GOOD RELATIONS WITH IRAN. KHOMEINI SAID HE WOULD PROBABLY WANT TO LEAVE IRAQ. LMI REPRESENTATIVES SAID MOVEMENT CONVINCED IRAQIS WOULD NOT DO THIS ON THEIR OWN, AND ACCUSED EITHER US OR USSR OF "FORCING" IRAQ TO DO THIS.

LMI REPS SAID IRANIAN RELIGIOUS COMMUNITY VERY TENSE AND SOME RELIGIOUS LEADERS WERE CONSIDERING ISSUING ORDER TO KILL US AND SOVIET CITIZENS. IF COMPLICITY OF EITHER IS PROVED. EMBOFF TOLD LMI PAIR IT WAS ABSURD TO THINK US HAD A HAND IN SUCH ACTION AND, WHATEVER CAUSE OF AYATOLLAH'S INCARCERATION, IT WOULD BE DISASTROUS FOR ALL CONCERNED IF ATTACKS WERE MADE ON FOREIGNERS. LMI MEN SEEMED MOLLIFIED AND STOOD DOWN FROM HOSTILE ATTITUDE.

LMI PAIR THEN SKETCHED POPOSITION VIEW OF PRESENT SITUATION: SHAH IS HATED BY "VAST MAJORITY" OF IRANIAN PEOPLE. LEFTISTS, ESPECIALLY TUDEH UNDERGROUND GROUPS, ARE BECOMING ACTIVE AND ARE ORGANIZATIONALLY BETTER ABLE TO TAKE ADVANTAGE OF MARIAL LAW THAN OTHERS. US SHOULD STEP IN TO HELP IRAN THROUGH DIFFICULT TRANSITION. SENIOR LMI MAN PRESENT THEN SAID MEETING WITH STEMPEL HAD BEEN REQUESTED TO ARRANGE "HIGH LEVEL" CONTACT WITH USG TO PRESENT LMI VIEWS. SUCH MEETING COULD CONSIST OF TWO OR THREE INDIVIDUALS PER SIDE AND WOULD HAVE AS ITS GOALS EXPLANATION OF LMI POLICIES AND SECURING U.S.

BLESSING FOR TRANSITIONAL ARRANGEMENTS WHICH WOULD CULMINATE IN END OF PAHLAVI DYNASTY "IN BEST INTERESTS OF BOTH IRAN AND U.S." LMI WOULD ESTABLISH IT HAD GOOD RELIGIOUS CONTACTS AT SUCH A MEETING. EMBOFF REPLIED U.S. STARTS FROM PREMISE THAT SHAH HAS KEY ROLE IN FUTURE POLITICAL DEVELOPMENTS AND IDEA OF SUCH A MEETING SEEMED PREMATURE AND SOMEWHAT GRANDIOSE. HE PROMISED RESPONSE LATER. (COMMENT: DESPITE EMBOFF'S RATHER HARSH DENIALS, LMI TEAM INSISTED U.S. "COULD DO ANYTHING IT WANTED TO" WITH RESPECT TO IRANIAN GOVERNMENT. EMBOFF SAID THIS WAS RIDICULOUS.)

IN PROCESS OF DISCUSSION, LMI TEAM HAMMERED HEAVILY ON THEME THAT ANARCHY SERVED NO ONE AND THAT SHAH AND PRESENT GOI COULD NOT BE TRUSTED TO IMPLEMENT PROMISES. EMBOFF ASKED LMI WHAT STEPS IT WOULD BE TAKING TO ADAPT MORE OPEN SITUATION TO ITS OWN ENDS. DESPITE LMI DENIAL THAT IT WOULD COOPERATE WITH GOI, IT WAS CLEAR SOME INTENSIVE THOUGHT HAD BEEN GIVEN TO POSSIBLE ELECTORAL STRATEGY AND LMI WAS EXTREMELY UPSET BY FACT KHOMEINI'S WINGS HAD BEEN CLIPPED. LMI SAID THERE WOULD BE PUBLIC STRIKE, PROBABLY A "QUIET DAY," IN TWO OR THREE DAYS" TIME TO PROTEST TREATMENT OF KHOMEINI.

PAIR ALSO ADDED THAT TUDEH UNDERGROUND GROUPS WERE PLANNING DEMONSTRATION FOR OCTOBER 15 WHICH WOULD PROBABLY BE CONFRONTATION WITH GOI FI NOT HANDLED PROPERLY. (THIS LAST REPORT, IN SOMEWHAT DIFFERENT FORM, ALSO CAME TO POL CONUNS FROM DIFFERENT SOURCE.)

COMMENT: LMI CLEARLY OFF BALANCE BY IRAQI MOVE AND REMAINS UNSURE HOW IT SHOULD PLAY PRESENT IRANIAN LIBERALIZATION PROGRAM. REQUEST FOR MEETING WITH "POLICY LEVEL" U.S. OFFICIALS, A LONG-TERM OPPOSITION AIM, APPEARS EFFORT TO GET USG TO HELP PULL LMI CHESTNUTS OUT OF FIRE.
FOR BAGHDAD: WOULD APPRECIATE ANY INFO YOU CAN DEVELOP ON OFFICIAL IRAQI LINE AND ACTUAL SITUATION OF KHOMEINI IN NAJAF OR BAGHDAD.

1978TEHRAN09253.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY DEVELOPMENTS SUMMARY: GOI HAS ALREADY ALTERED PROPOSED PRESS LAW IN PESPONSE TO CTITICISM. MINISTER OF JUSTICE COMPLAINS PRESE

segments.text: SUMMARY: GOI HAS ALREADY ALTERED PROPOSED PRESS LAW IN PESPONSE TO CTITICISM. MINISTER OF JUSTICE COMPLAINS PRESENT LAWS DO NOT PERMIT EFFECTIVE PROSECUTION OF CORRUPTION. PM SHARIFEMAMI STATED ONLY 123 DIED IN SEPT. 8 JALEH SQUARE INCIENT AND THAT ONLY 117 ARE PRESENTLY DETAINED UNDER MATRIAL LAW, WHICH WILL END SOON AS POSSIBLE. TEHRAN MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATION HAS AGAIN EASED CURFEW; HOURS ARE NOW 12 MIDNIGHT TO 4:30 A.M. PRO-GOVT CROWS DEMONSTRADED IN SHARH-E-KORD AND IN SOUTHEASTERN DESERT AREA. LARGE CROWD ASSEMBLED (WITHOUT INCIDENT) IN QOM FOR FUNERAL OF MULLAH MEHDI GOLPAYEGANI. UNRULY CROWD IN GOPLAYEGAN WAS DISPERSED BY POLICE, WITH SEVERAL ARRESTS BUT NO REPORT OF INJURIES. END SUMMARY.

PROPOSED PRESS LAW, MEETING HEAVY CRITICISM FROM PRESS AND OPPOSITION LEADERS, HAS ALREADY BEEN ALTERED. DEP MINISTRY OF INFORMATION FATHOLLAH SA'ADAT ANNOUNCED SEPT 24 THAT A SENTENCE HAS BEEN ADDED TO ARTICLE 5: "PULICATION OF NEWSPAPERS AND PERIODICALS IS ENTIRELY FREE." HE SAID THE BILL NOW INCLUDES A NEW ARTICLE PROVIDING FOR CREATION OF A PRESS ASSOCIATION. FUTHERMORE, DEAN OF THE COLLEGE OF MASS COMMUNICATION WILL SIT ON PROPOSED PRESS COMMISSION INSTEAD OF THE PRESIDENT OF TEHRAN CITY COUNCIL.

ON THE ANTI-CORRUPTION FRONT, MINISTER OF JUSTICE BAHERI MET SEPT 24 WITH HEADS OF LOCAL COUNCILS OF TEHRAN TO EXPLAIN HIS CAMPAIGN. HE COMPLAINED THAT EXISTING LAWS ARE NOT EFFECTIVE ENOUGH FOR HIM TO STAMP OUT CORRUPTION. HE DID NOT SAY WHAT CHANGES HE WOULD LIKE TO SEE, BUT WARNED AUDIENCE THAT UNDER PRESENT LAW MASSIVE EVIDENCE MUST BE COLLECTED BEFORE HE COULD PROSECUTE THE ALLEGED VIOLATORS.

PM SHARIF-EMAMI TOLD SIEDDEUTSCHE ZEITUNG REPORTER THAT ONLY 123 DEMONSTRATORS DIED IN SEPT 8 CLASH IN JALEH SQUARE. HE ADDED THAT ALTHOUGH 1,106 PEOPLE HAVE BEEN ARRESTED UNDER MARTIAL LAW, ONLY 117 OF THESE ARE STILL IN DETENTION. HE SAID MARTIAL LAW WILL END SOON AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. TEHRAN MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATION MEANWHILE FURTHER EASED CURFEW HOURS TO 12 MIDNIGHT TO 4:30 AM.

CROWED BUT PEACEFUL FUNERAL TOOK PLACE SEPT 24 IN QOM FOR HOJJATOLISALM SAYED MEHDI GOLPAYEGANI, WHO DIED IN TRAFFIC ACCIDENT. IN TOWN OF GOLPAYEGAN (ISFAHAN PROVIDENCE), HOWEVER, CROWD OF DEMONSTRATORS SEPT 23 BECAME UNRULY. POLICE DISPERSED THEM, MAKING SEVERAL ARRESTS, BUT THERE WERE NO INJURED REPORTED.

TWO PRO-REGIME DEMONSTRATIONS OCCURED OVER THE WEEKEND. ONE IN SHAHR-E-KORD (CAPITAL OF CHAHARMAHAL AND BAKHTIARI PROVIDENCE, SOUTHWEST OF ISFAHAN) INCLUDED TRIBESMEN AND RURAL PEOPLE FROM 79 VILLAGES WHO SHOWED SUPPORT FOR SHAH, PRESENT GOVERNMENT, AND SHAH-PEOPLE REVOLUTION. ANOTHER DEMONSTRATION WAS ORGANIZED IN SOUTHEAST DESERT REGION, WITH NO SPECIFIC LOCATION GIVEN.

1978TEHRAN09254.subject: RECENT OPPOSITION EFFORTS IN HUMAN RIGHTS FIELD SUMMARY: PROMINENT OPPOSITION LAWYER HAS DESCRIBED TO US VARIOUS STEPS BAR ASSOCIATION AND IRANIAN J URISTS

segments.text: SUMMARY: PROMINENT OPPOSITION LAWYER HAS DESCRIBED TO US VARIOUS STEPS BAR ASSOCIATION AND IRANIAN JURISTS ASSOCIATION ARE TAKING TO CHALLENGE EXISTING MILITARY COURT PROCEDURES. HE ALSO DESCRIBED CURRENT ACTIVITIES OF COMMITTEE FOR DEFENSE OF POLITICAL PRISONERS IN IRAN AND NEW JUSTICE MINISTER'S REACTION TO IT. HE IS PLANNING TO VISIT WASHINGTON IN NEXT TWO WEEKS AND WILL PROBABLY STOP BY DEPT, AS WELL AS SEE ICJ'S BUTLER IN NEW YORK. END SUMMARY.

PROMINENT OPPOSITION LAWYER MATIN-DAFTARY DROPPED IN TO VISIT POL COUNS SEPT 24 FOR FIRST REVIEW OF HIS LEGAL AND HUMAN RIGHTS OPPOSITION ACTIVITIES IN A COUPLE OF MONTHS. MATIN-DAFTARY IS ON A PRIVATE TRIP TO LONDON AND NEW YORK AND PLANS TO SPEND A DAY OR TWO IN EARLY OCTOBER SEEING PEOPLE IN WASHINGTON. HE PLANS TO CALL ON ICJ'S BUTLER IN NEW YORK AND WAS GIVEN NEA/IRN DIRECTOR PRECHT'S NAME.

MATIN-DAFTARY SAID THAT, FOLLOWING BUTLER'S LAST VISIT IN EARLY MAY (TEHRAN 4257), OPPOSITION LAWYERS HAVE BEEN TRYING TO FORCE THE PACE OF LEGAL PROCEDURAL REFORM. BAR ASSOCIATION, IN WHICH MATIN-DAFTARY IS PROMINENT, HAS PUT AN END OT PREVIOUS PRACTICE OF PROVIDING "INTRODUCTION" FOR CIVILIAN LAWYERS WISHING TO PRACTICE BEFORE MILITARY GOVERNMENT COURTS. INSTEAD, BAR ASSOCIATION HAS TAKEN POSITION THAT ANY QUALIFIED LAWYER MAY PRACTICE BEFORE ALL COURTS IN NATION AND ADVISED LAWYERS SIMPLY TO DEPOSIT POWERS OF ATTORNEY WITH MILITARY GOVERNMENT COURT CLERKS. HE SAID BAR ASSOCIATION MAINTAINS RECORDS OF CIVILIAN LAWYERS WHO HAVE BEEN ADMITTED BEFORE MILITARY GOVERNMENT COURTS.
TO BEST HIS KNOWLEDGE THOSE THAT HAVE SO FAR BEEN ADMITTED HAVE BEEN INVOLVED WITH NON-POLITICAL CASES SUCH AS DRUG SMUGGLING, ETC.

ASSOCIATION OF IRANIAN JURISTS, IN WHICH MATIN-DAFTARY ALSO PROMINENT, HAS BEGUN TO TEST OTHER MILITARY GOVERNMENT PROCEDURES. SEVENTEEN LAWYERS HAVE FILED POWERS OF ATTORNEY WITH MILITARY COURT IN REZAIEH TO DEFEND 16 PEOPLE ACCUSED OF "SECESSIONISM". SINCE ONLY ONE OF THEM HAS OFFICES IN REZAIEH, THESE TEHRAN LAWYERS ARE CHALLENGING MILITARY COURT REGULATION WHICH PERMITS ONLY LAWYERS WHO HAVE OFFICES IN CLOSE PROXIMITY TO MILITARY COURT TO APPEAR BEFORE THAT COURT. CASE INVOLVES PEOPLE ARRESTED IN CONNECTION WITH DEMONSTRATION AT A CEMETARY IN MAHABAD (KURDISTAN). GROUP HAD GATHERED TO COMMEMORATE 7TH DAY AFTER DEATH OF FAMOUS POLITICAL PRISONER AZIZ YOUSSEFI.
POLICE ACCUE GROUP OF HAVING SHOUTED "LONG LIVE KURDISTAN" AND HAVING MOVED ON TO TOMB OF LOCAL ANTI-BARZANI KURDISH HERO.

IN COMPANION MOVE, MATIN-DAFTARY AND ONE OTHER LAWYER HAVE FILED POWERS OF ATTORNEY TO DEFEND ONE OF A GROUP OF YOUNG PEOPLE ARRESTED IN ISFAHAN LAST FEBRUARY FOR POSSESSION OF SEDITIOUS PAMPHLETS. THIS ARREST PRE-DATES REFORM WHICH PLACES SUCH CASES IN CIVILIAN COURT SYSTEM; THUS CASE SCHEDULED FOR MILITARY COURT.

MATIN-DAFTARY ADDED THAT IRANIAN JURISTS ASSOCIATION LAWYERS HAVE MADE A PRACTICE IN RECENT MONTHS OF ACTIVELY DEFENDING PEOPLE BEFORE CIVILIAN COURTS OR AT LEAST SITTING IN AS OBSERVERS. HE SAID THAT MANY DEFENDANTS WERE RECEIVING LIGHT SENTENCES OR OUTRIGHT ACQUITTAL IN SITUATIONS WHICH PRIOR TO THE REFORMS EARLIER THIS YEAR WOULD HAVE DRAWN THEM LONG PRISON SENTENCES IN MILITARY COURTS. HE EXPLAINED BAR ASSOCIATION AND IRANINA JURISTS ASSOCIATION HAVE OVERLAPPING LEADERSHIPS. LATTER IS RUN BY 7-MEMBER COMMITTEE. ------------------049059 251833Z /43 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHZC 555 SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 09254

SIMULTANEOUSLY, COMMITTEE FOR DEFENSE OF POLITICAL PRISONERS IN IRAN (CDPPI), IN WHICH MARIN-DAFTARY VERY ACTIVE, PRESENTLY INTERESTED IN CASE OF TWO PRISONERS IN KERMANSHAH WHO ARE ENTERING 8TH WEEK OF HUNGER STRIKE. THEY ARE RING LEADERS OF QASR PRISON HUNGER STRIKE LAST SPRING AND WERE TRANSFERRED TO KERMANSHAH DESPITE GOVERNMENT PROMISES TO QASR PRISONERS THAT THERE WOULD BE NO PUNISHMENT FOR THEIR STRIKE. MATIN-DAFTARY VISITED NEW JUSTICE MINISTER BAHERI ON THIS CASE. BAHERI IMMEDIATELY SENT PRISON INSPECTOR IN SPECIAL PLANE TO INVESTIGATE, BUT REFUSED REQUEST THAT REPRESENTATIVE OF CDPPI ACCOMPANY THE INSPECTOR.

INSPECTOR MANAGED TO AVOID OTHER PEOPLE CDPPI SENT TO PRISON SITE, AND SO FAR APPARENTLY NOTHING HAS BEEN DONE ABOUT THE PRISONERS. MATIN-DAFTARY ALSO GAVE US COPY OF CDPPI NEWS BULLETIN NO. 10 OF SEPTEMBER 1 WHICH REQUESTS UNCONDITIONAL FREEDOM OF ALL POLITICAL PRISONERS AND RETURN OF THE EXILED WITHOUT THE REQUIREMENT THAT THEY REQUEST FORGIVENESS AND SHOW PENITENCE AS PRESENT LAW PROVIDES. BULLETIN LISTS A NUMBER OF INDIVIDUAL CASES OF PRISONERS STILL HELD. MATIN-DAFTARY ALSO NOTED GOVT LIST OF 333 PEOPLE ARRESTED UNDER MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS RECENTLY, WHOM GOVT ANNOUNCED RELEASED LAST WEEK, ARE UNKNOWN TO HIM AND HIS FRIENDS.
THEY MAY INDEED HAVE BEEN RELEASED BUT CREDIBILITY OF GOVT IS SO LOW THAT HIS PEOPLE REFUSE TO BELIEVE IT.

MATIN-DAFTARY RECOUNTED STORY OF HIS BRIEF ARREST BY MILITARY GOVERNMENT AUTHORITIES COUPLE OF WEEKS AGO AND RELEASE SAME DAY. HE WAS TOLD BY DIRECTOR OF KOMITE PRISON WHERE HE WAS HELD AND INTERROGATED THAT GOVT HAD NO QUARREL WITH POLITICIANS WHO WERE ACTING WITHIN THE LAW. (COMMENT: THIS DOES NOT EXPLAIN CONTINUED INCARCERATION OF ENGINEER MOGHADAM-MARAGHEI WHO IS ONLY MAJOR POLITICIAN STILL BEING HELD.) MATIN-DAFTARY TOLD AUTHORITIES AND CONFIRMED TO US THAT HE HAD NOT RESPONDED TO INVITATION FROM NATIONAL FRON LEADERS TO JOIN AN ORGANIZATIONAL GATHERING AND PREFERRED FOR THE TIME BEING TO STAY OUT OF PARTY POLITICS, DEVOTING HIMSELF TO RELATIVELY NON-PARTISAN WORK SUCH AS ASSISTING POLITICAL PRISONERS.

AMONG VARIOUS GENERAL COMMENTS ON SITUATION, MATINDAFTARY SAID MANY OF THE GROUPS WHICH HAVE BEEN CIRCULATING THEIR OPINIONS IN RECENT MONTHS ARE AFRAID TO PUBLISH UNDER MILITARY GOVERNMENT. HE HAS BEEN URGING THEM NOT TO BE SO TIMOROUS BUT SOME OF THE LEADERS ARE VERY OLD MEN AND FEEL THEY DO NOT WANT TO RISK IMPRISONMENT AT THIS STAGE IN LIFE.

WE EXPECT MATIN-DAFTARY WILL REHEARSE THESE THEMES WITH ICJ'S BUTLER AND PROBABLY COME TO DEPT TO TALK WITH PRECHT. FYI: MATIN-DAFTARY TOLD US HE HAD BEEN ASKED TO PARTICIPATE TELEPHONICALLY IN A CONGRESSIONAL PRESS CONFERENCE ABOUT TEN DAYS AGO ORGANIZED BY RAMSAY CLARK AND NOAM CHOMSKY BUT FAULTY ARRANGEMENTS PREVENTED HIS TALKING TO ANYONE BUT CONGRESSMAN'S SECRETARY.

1978TEHRAN09279.subject: IRANIAN ASSESSMENT OF AFGHAN DEVELOPMENTS AND U.S.-AFGHAN RELATIONS

segments.text: ADDRESSEES AWE THAT SHAH HAS VIRTUALLY FROM THE FIRST HELD PRIVATE VIEW OF NEW AFGHAN GOVERNMENT AS FOR ALL INTENTS AND PURPOSES A SERVANT OF THE SOVIETS. HE HAS DISGUISED THIS VIEW BEHIND AN OFFICIAL POLICY OF "WAIT-AND-SEE" GIVING THE NEW GOA EVERY BENEFIT OF THE DOUBT. FORMAL RELATIONS HAVE CONTINUED AS BEFORE, INCLUDING CONTINUING DISBURSEMENTS ON EXISTING ECONOMIC COMMITMENTS (TEHRAN 7818 AND MEMORANDUM TO DEPT AND KABUL OF AUGUST 23) BUT ALWAYS WARILY.

SHAH MADE IT CLEAR TO THE AMBASSADOR, AT THE TIME, THAT HE SAW LITTLE TO GAIN FROM "CODDLING" NEW AFGHAN REGIME, BUT HE WOULD GO ALONG WITH USG DESIRES IN THE MATTER. HE SHOULD THEREFORE BE GIVEN ADVANCE WARNING IF USG POLICY IS TO UNDERGO A CHANGE (VIZ. SENATE AMENDMENT TO FOREIGN ASSISTANCE APPROPRIATIONS BILL, STATE 241684 NOTAL).

1978TEHRAN09281.subject: CAMP DAVID FOLLOWUP: ATHERTON DISCUSSIONS IN KUWAIT

segments.text: SEPT 25 I MET FOR HALF HOUR WITH ACTING FOREIGN MINISTER SHAIKH SALEM, NEARLY TWO HOURS WITH AMIR, AND FINALLY HALF HOUR WITH CROWN PRICE/PRIME MINISTER. ACTING FOREIGN MINISTER ATTENDED LATTER TWO MEETINGS.

WITH AMIR I MADE POINTS ON BENEFITS OF CAMP DAVID AGREEMENTS FOR ARABS ALONG LINES OF SECRETARY'S EXPLANATIONS TO FAHD AND HUSSEIN, APPROPRIATELY MODIFIED AND WITH SPECIAL STRESS ON PALESTINIAN ASPECTS. ACTING FOREIGN MINISTER AND CROWN PRINCE/PRIME MINISTER ASKED A NUMBER OF NOW FAMILIAR QUESTIONS ON WITHDRAWAL, PALESTINIAN PARTICIPATION, STATUS OF JERUSALEM, AND SETTLEMENTS AND I RESPONDED ALONG LINES SECRETARY HAD USED IN AMMAN, RIYADH, AND DAMASCUS. THEY PARTICULARLY NOTED BEGIN'S POST-CAMP DAVID STATEMENTS IN APPARENT CONTRADICTION TO OUR EXPLANATION OF CERTAIN ELEMENTS OF THE AGREEMENTS. IN RESPONDING I STRESSED PRESIDENT'S COMMITMENT THAT U.S. WILL REMAIN ACTIVELY ENGAGED IN NEGOTIATING PROCESS AND SEE IT THROUGH.

AMIR, AFTER HEARING ME OUT PATIENTLY, ASKED NO SPECIFIC QUESTIONS ABOUT AGREEMENTS. INSTEAD HE GAVE GOK REACTION AS FOLLOWS: KUWAIT NEVER DOUBTED PRESIDENT DOING HIS BEST TO ACHIEVE PEACE, BUT RESULTS OF CAMP DAVID TOTALLY DIFFERENT FROM PRINCIPLES TO WHICH KUWAIT ADHERES. UNLIKE CONFRONTATION STATES WITH SPECIAL INDIVIDUAL AXES TO GRIND, KUWAIT HAS OVERALL ARAB VIEW OF PEACE PROBLEM. CORE OF PROBLEM IS PALESTINIAN ISSUE. CAMP DAVID TALKS DID NOT INCLUDE PALESTINIAN PEIPLE WHOSE FATE WAS BEING DECIDED, AND SADAT HAD NO MANDATE TO SPEAK FOR THEM. WHAT EGYPT AGREES WITH ISRAEL ABOUT EGYPTIAN-ISRAELI PEACE IS EGYPT'S BUSINESS. FROM GENERAL ARAB VIEWPOINT, HOWEVER, CAMP DAVID DID NOT ACHIEVE DESIRED RESULTS.

KUWAIT MUST AS AN OLD FRIEND OF U.S. SPEAK FRANKLY. CAMP DAVID AGREEMENTS ARE A BACKING DOWN FROM UN RESOLUTIONS TO WHICH U.S. HAS AGREED AND FROM STATED U.S. POSITIONS. RESULTS ARE MERELY AN EGYPTIANISRAEL AGREEMENT AND A TOUCHED-UP VERSION OF BEGIN'S PLAN FOR WEST BANK/GAZA. BEGIN STATEMENTS AFTER CAMP DAVID SUGGEST ISRAEL WILL NEVER GIVE UP GOLAN OR JERUSALEM WHILE SADAT SAYS WEST BANK PRINCIPLES APPLY TO JERUSALEM. FUTURE IN MIDDLE EAST IS NOT CLEAR, AND KUWAIT IS NOT ASSURED. WHAT IS FATE OF UN'S ROLE, AND OF GENEVA? KUWAIT BELIEVES U.S. SEEKS PEACE IN AREA, BUT CAMP DAVID RESULTS WILL ONLY AGGRAVATE SITUATION, CAUSING "EXPLOSIONS."

IN RESPONSE I NOTED OUR RECOGNITION OF CENTRALITY OF PALESTINIAN ISSUE AND SADAT'S AND OUR OWN AWARENESS THAT HE HAD NO MANDATE TO SPEAK FOR PALESTINIANS. FOR THIS VERY REASON WE DID NOT SEEK TODETERMINE IN DETAIL WHAT ONLY PALESTINIANS CAN DETERMINE FOR THEMSELVES.

INSTEAD WE GOT ISRAELI RECOGNITION OF LEGITIMATE RIGHTS OF PALESTINIANS, AND, BEYOND ABSTRACT PRINCIPLES, WE BROUGHT FORTH CONCRETE PROCEDURES THROUGH WHICH PALESTINIANS IN WEST BANK/GAZA COULD HAVE VOICE IN DETERMINING THEIR OWN FUTURE. ------------------058498 261128Z /23 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 568 INFO AMEMBASSY AMMAN IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY ALGIERS IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY ANKARA IMMEDIATE USINT BAGHDAD IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY BEIRUT IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY BONN IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY CAIRO IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY DAMASCUS IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY DOHN IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY JERUSALEM IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY JIDDA IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY KUWATI IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY LONDON IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY MANAMA IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY MUSCAT IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY PARIS IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY RABAT IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY SANA IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY TEL AVIV IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY TUNIS IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY TRIPOLI IMMEDIATE SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRNAN 09281 NODIS U.S.

STANDS FULLY BEHIND ALL PAST STATEMENTS RE JUST SETTLEMENT, WITHDRAWAL, PEACE, AND SECURITY, INCLUDING UN RESOLUTIONS OVER THE YEARS SUCH AS UNGA RES. 194 ON REFUGEES. I STRESSED THAT PURPOSE OF CAMP DAVID WAS NOT JUST TO STATE U.S. POSITIONS BUT TO BRING TWO PARTIES TOGETHER TO A POINT THAT IS NOT ALL WE WOULD PREFER BUT WELL AHEAD OF WHERE THEY WERE. I NOTED CAMP DAVID AGREEMENTS ARE NOT END OF THE ROAD BUT A FRAMEWORK, AND THAT AGREEMENTS DO NOT PRECLUDE ACHIEVING ADDITIONAL ARAB OBJECTIVES THROUGH NEGOTIATION. I POINTED OUT HOW AGREEMENTS ARE A MAJOR CHANGE FROM BEGIN PLAN.
I EXPLAINED WE HAD NOT ABANDONED GENEVA AS ULTIMATE OBJECTIVE, BUT SAW NO PRACTICAL ALTERNATIVE TO CAMP DAVID AGREEMENTS IF WE ARE TO MOVE TOWARD FINAL AGREMENT AT GENEVA.

I WAS STRUCK THAT ACTING FOREIGN MINISTER EARLY IN FIRST MEETING AND LATE IN THE LAST (FOR PM'S BENEFIT) ASKED NOT ABOUT ISRAELI OR JORDANIAN REACTION TO SECRETARY'S VISIT BUT ABOUT ASSAD'S. IN RESPONSE I STRESSED THAT ASSAD, WHILE MAINTAINING HIS OBJECTION TO AGREEMENTS AND REFLECTING A PREOCCUPATION THAT SADAT SEEKS A SEPARATE PEACE, LISTENED CAREFULLY TO OUR RESPONSES TO HIS QUESTIONS, REMAINS COMMITTED TO 242 VIA 338, AND CLEARLY WANTS TO KEEP OPEN THE DIALOGUE WITH U.S. TO AMIR I NOTED OUR UNDERSTANDING OF PRESSURES HUSSEIN IS UNDER AND THAT HE IS KEEPING OPEN MIND WHILE WE ANSWER HIS SPECIFIC QUESTIONS AND HE REFLECTS AND CONSULTS WITH NEIGHBORS.
I STRESSED THAT WHILE SAUDIS ALSO KEEPING AN OPEN MIND THEY EMPHASIZED THEIR WISH TO SUPPORT PRESIDENT'S PEACE EFFORT AND THEIR DESIRE TO SUPPORT SADAT.

I FOUND IT INTERESTING THAT AMIR RAISED SOVIET REACTION TO CAMP DAVID, EXPRESSING SOME CONCERN THAT IN OPPOSITION SOVIETS WOULD MAKE CONSIDERABLE MISCHIEF IN MIDDLE EAST. I REAFFIRMED AMBASSADOR MAESTRONE'S EARLIER OBSERVATION TO HIM THAT SOVIET INTERESTS IN OVER-ALL RELATIONSHIP WITH U.S. PLACE RESTRAINTS ON HOW ACTIVELY THEY CAN OPPOSE CAMP DAVID PROCESS.

IN FINAL MEETING WITH CROWN PRICE/PRIME MINISTER, I STRESSED NEED FOR KUWAIT TO PONDER CAREFULLY BEFORE IT TOOK POSITION ON AN OPPORTUNITY FOR PEACE THAT MIGHT NOT COME AGAIN. HE, LIKE AMIR EARLIER, INDICATED TIME WILL TELL WHETHER U.S. OR KUWAITI VIEW OF PROSPECTS FOR CAMP DAVID AGREEMENTS IS CORRECT.

COMMENT: AS EXPECTED, THE KUWAITIS AT BEST WILL STAY FIRMLY ON THE SIDELINES. THEY REFLECT DEEP CONCERN FOR PALESTINIAN OBJECTIONS TO THE AGREEMENTS. YET THEIR RECEPTION WAS WARM, THEY STRESSED FRIENDSHIP FOR THE U.S. AND CONFIDENCE IN THE PRESIDENT'S DEVOTION TO MIDDLE EAST PEACE. AND THEY LISTENED CAREFULLY. PERHAPS SOME OF OUR ARGUMENTS MAY GET PLAYED BACK IN KUWAIT'S NOT INSIGNIFICANT DIALOGUE WITH A SPECTRUM OF PALESTINIANS.
AMBASSADOR MAESTRONE MAY WISH TO COMMENT FURTHER.

1978TEHRAN09307.subject: POLITICAL DEVELOPMENTS: RASTAKHIZ PARTY, IMAM SADR SUMMARY: RESURGENCE PARTY (RPPI) POLITICAL BUREAU DECIDED SEPT. 25 TO CARRY ON AS A POLITICAL PAR TY UNDER NE

segments.text: SUMMARY: RESURGENCE PARTY (RPPI) POLITICAL BUREAU DECIDED SEPT. 25 TO CARRY ON AS A POLITICAL PARTY UNDER NEW SECRETARY GENERAL JAVAD SAYEED. RELIGIOUS LEADERS AND AT LEAST ONE SECULAR OPPOSITION LEADER HAVE MADE AN ISSUE OF THE DISSAPPEARANCE OF IMAM MOUSSA SADR OF LEBANON, TAKING INDEPENDENT ACTION AND ALSO CALLING ON GOI TO ASSIST. END SUMMARY.

RESURGENCE PARTY (RPPI), LIMPING ALONG WITHOUT ITS PO POLITICAL MONOPOLY, GOVERNMENT FUNDING, AND WITHOUT MANY OF ITS FORMER MEMBERS, DECIDED SEPT. 25 TO CONINUE FUNCTIONING AS A POLITICAL PARTY. JAVAD SAYEED, WHO WAS ELECTED SECRETARY GENERAL AT SAME MEETING OF POLITICAL BUREAU, STATED THAT THE SUBJECT OF DISBANDING NEVER EVEN CAME UP. HE ANNOUNCED RPPI WILL WRITE A NEW CHARTER TO REFLECT FACT THAT IT IS ONLY ONE OF SEVERAL PARTIES. WITH EXCEPTION OF DAILY NEWSPAPER RASTAKHIZ, ALL PARTY PUBLICATIONS WILL CEASE. SAYED SAID RPPI WILL CONTINUE TO ADHERE TO PRINCIPLES OF MONARCHY, CONSITUTION, AND SHAH-PEOPLE REVOLUTION.
IN RECENT DAYS, SOME OTHER RPPI CONNECTED SOURCES HAVE SUGGESTED THAT THERE REMAINS IN PARTY A SUBSTANTIAL HARD CORE WHO WANT TO USE RPPI AS MOBILIAATION ORGANIZATION FOR MODERATE RIGHTISTS.
NATIONAL FRONT ANNOUNCED THAT ITS DETAILED PROGRAM AND FULL SCALE POLITICAL CAMPAIGN WILL SOON BE FORTHCOMING.

DISAPPEARANCE OF IMAM MOUSSA SADR HAS RECEIVED GOOD PRESS COVERAGE AND HAS BEEN SEIZED BY OPPOSITION LEADER MOHSEN PEZESHKPOUR. PRESS REPORTED SHIITE LEADERS CABLED GOVTS OF LIBYA, SYRIA, ALGERIA, JORDAN, AND LEBANON AND PALESTINE LIBERATION ORGANIZATION TO EXPRESS CONCERN. PAN-IRANIST PARTY LEADER PEZESHKPOUR MADE WELL-PUBLICIZED APPEAL TO GOVT SEPT 24 TO TAKE ALL POSSIBLE STEPS TO FIND SADR. IN LETTER TO SPEAKER OF THE MAJLIS, PEZEKPOUR STATED GOI HAS BOTH RELIGIOUS AND PATRIOTIC DUTY (SINCE SADR IS IRANIAN) TO LEND ASSISTANCE. THREE CLERGYMEN REPORTEDLY FLEW TO DAMASCUS SEPT 26 TO SEEK AUDIENCE WITH PRESIDENT ASSAD AND ASK ASSISTANCE. THEY ALSO PLAN TO VISIT AMMAN AND APPEAL TO KING HUSSEIN.
IRANIAN SHIITE SPOKESMAN SAID NO GOVERNMENT HAS YET RESPONDED POSITIVELY TO HIERARCHY'S REQUEST FOR AID IN LOCATING SADR.

1978TEHRAN09308.subject: THE TRAVELS OF AN IRANIAN STUDENT IN THE U.S. SUMMARY: IRANIAN STUDENT WHO HAS JUST RETURNED FROM U.S. TELLS US HE WAS THREATENED AND THEN BEATEN UP BY L

segments.text: SUMMARY: IRANIAN STUDENT WHO HAS JUST RETURNED FROM U.S. TELLS US HE WAS THREATENED AND THEN BEATEN UP BY LEFTIST IRANIAN STUDENTS IN NEW JERSEY COLLEGE BECAUSE HE WOULD NOT JOIN THEM. HE ALSO SAYS NETWORK OF STUDENTS CIRCULATED HIS PHOTO SO THAT HE COULD NOT EASILY TRANSFER TO ANOTHER COLLEGE AND ESCAPE. WE ARE NOT ABLE TO EVALUATE TRUTH OF THIS REPORT BUT IT AT LEAST RAISES QUESTIONS ABOUT IRANIAN STUDENT RECRUITING METHODS IN U.S. COLLEGES. END SUMMARY.

POL COUNS HAPPENED BY CHANCE TO JOIN LUNCHEON CONVERSATION OF ONE RAMIN LIARI, RETURNED IRANIAN STUDENT FROM U.S. SEPT. 21. LIARI HAD COME TO LUNCH AT INVITATION OF EMBASSY LOCAL WHO HAD INVITED POL SECTION LOCAL TO HEAR HIS STORY. LIARI IS A STUDENT WHO REFUSED TO JOIN IRANIAN OPPOSITIONISTS IN HIS COLLEGE AND HAS PAID FOR IT BY NOT BEING PERMITTED TO COMPLETE HIS EDUCATION THERE. HE SAID HE HAD NOT TOLD THIS STORY TO ANY IRANIAN AUTHORITIES NOR GAVE ANY INDICATION OF BEING A SAVAK PLANT.

LIARI SPENT TWO YEARS AT BERGEN COMMUNITY COLLEGE IN NEW JERSEY. THERE WERE ABOUT 40 OTHER IRANIAN STUDENTS THERE, ALL MOBILIZED IN OPPOSITION TO THE CURRENT IRANIAN REGIME. FROM THE VERY FIRST THEY VISITED HIM IN SHIFTS OF TWO DISCUSSING SITUATION IN IRAN AND TRYING TO ENROLL HIM IN THEIR ACTIVITIES. ALTHOUGH THEY WERE MEMBERS OF IRANIAN STUDENT CONFEDERATION IT WAS CLEAR FROM THEIR LITERATURE THAT THEY SUBSCRIBED TO COMMUNIST IDEAS AND WERE ALSO MEMBERS OF LEFT-WING OR COMMUNIST GROUPS.

LIARI WAS APPARENTLY BEING SOUGHT BECAUSE OTHERS TOLD HIM HE WAS EFFECTIVE IN DEBATE. AFTER A YEAR OF THIS, THEY TURNED UGLY. LEADER OF GROUP FINALLY RESORTED TO THREATS TO LIARI, WIFE AND FAMILY IF HE DID NOT JOIN THEM. THIS WAS FOLLOWED BY A BEATING ADMINISTERED BY A GROUP OF STUDENTS ON CAMPUS WHICH RESULTED IN HIS BEING HOSPITALIZED FOR 15 DAYS. HE FILED A COMPLAINT WITH THE LOCAL COUNTY POLICE WHO WERE AT FIRST TOLD BY THE CAMPUS SECURITY PEOPLE THAT THEY COULD NOT FIND THE STUDENTS INVOLVED.
EVENTUALLY, LIARI ACTED ON GOOD ADVISE AND THREATENED THE CAMPUS SECURITY PEOPLE WITH A SUIT IF THEY DID NOT ARREST THE STUDENTS. THIS RESULTED IN SOME FINES BUT NO OTHER PENALTY.

THE THREATS AND HARASSMENT ACCELERATED AFTERWARD, AND LIARI WAS UNABLE TO CONCENTRATE ON HIS STUDIES. HE THOUGHT OF TRANSFERRING TO ANOTHER COLLEGE IN THE U.S. BUT A FRIEND IN TEXAS TOLD HIM HIS PHOTO HAD BEEN REPRODUCED AND SENT TO OTHER COLLEGES WHERE IRANIAN STUDENTS WERE ENROLLED. LIARI SAID HE GAVE UP TRYING TO PURSUE HIS STUDIES AND HAS LEFT HIS WIFE (WHO IS STILL CONTINUING HER STUDIES) AND BOY IN U.S. WHILE RETURNING HIMSELF TO IRAN. A STUDENT OF ARCHITECTURE HE HAD INSUFFICIENT CREDITS TO PERMIT TRANSFER TO TEHRAN UNIVERSITY AND HAS NOW GONE TO WORK HERE FOR A PRIVATE COMPANY.

LIARI SAID THE STUDENTS APPARENTLY RECEIVED FINANCIAL AID FROM AN UNKNOWN SOURCE AND SOME OF THEM HAVE RETURNED TO IRAN RECENTLY. THEY HAVE BEEN BRAGGING THAT THEY WOULD BE GETTING HIGH POSITIONS WHEN THE PRESENT REGIME GOES. HE BUMPED INTO ONE OF THEM AT A NEW YORK AIRPORT. SINCE THE STUDENT WAS BOUND FOR TEHRAN, LIARI JOKINGLY ASKED HIM IF HE WOULD BECOME A MINISTER, THE STUDENT REPLIED THAT HE HAD FAMILY REASONS TO BE RETURNING.

COMMENT: WE ARE UNABLE OF COURSE, TO EVALUATE AUTHENTICITY OF THIS STORY. ONE CAN NEVER RULE OUT LIARI BEING A GOVT AGENT WHO CAME TO THE EMBASSY FOR THE PURPOSE OF PLANTING HIS TALE. NEVERTHELESS, IT PRESENTS A SIDE OF THE SITUATION WE HAVE NOT SEEN FREQUENTLY MENTIONED AND SHOULD AT LEAST RAISE SOME QUESTIONS IN OUR MINDS AS TO THE RECRUITING METHODS BEING USED BY IRANIAN STUDENT ORGANIZATIONS IN AMERICAN COLLEGES.

1978TEHRAN09310.subject: PROPOSAL FOR A CONFERENCE ON THE INDIAN OCEAN

segments.text: POL COUN MADE POINTS IN REFTEL TO MFA DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR INTERNATIONAL AFFAIRS SADIQ-ESFANDIARY SEPT. 25.ESFANDIARY LISTEN ED BUT DID NOT SEEM OVERLY IMPRESSED. HE COUNTERED SUGGESTION THAT WE FELT INTERNATIONAL CONFERENCE ON INDIAN OCEAN WOULD NOT BE PRODUCTIVE WITH QUESTION WHETHER MORE PROGRESS IS FORESEEN IN U.S.-SOVIET BILATERAL NEGOTIATIONS. HE SAID IT MIGHT BE WORTHWHILE TO MOBILIZE PUBLIC OPINION IN SUPPORT OF INDIAN OCEAN SECURITY.

ESFANDIARY LEAVES TOMORROW, SEPT 26, FOR NEW YORK. FONMIN AFSHAR AND HIS TOP DEPUTIES ARE ALREADY IN NEW YORK. IF DEPT WISHES PURSUE THIS FURTHER, NEW YORK IS BEST LOCUS, ALTHOUGH WE TEND TO AGREE THAT MORE FORCEFUL APPROACH MIGHT BE COUNTERPRODUCTIVE IN ABSENCE OF OUR ABILITY TO ASSURE AD HOC COMMITTEE MEMBERS THAT BILATERAL DISCUSSIONS WITH SOVIETS HOLD SOME TANGIBLE PROMISE IN FORESEEABLE FUTURE.

I ACCOMPANIED ATHERTON TO AUDIENCE WITH SHAH SEPT 25 AND FOUND HIS MOOD SIGNIFICANTLY IMPROVED OVER MY LAST TWO AUDIENCES. HE HAS REGAINED HIS COMPOSURE, THE SPRING IN HIS STEP, AND HIS SENSE OF HUMOR. HE KEPT HIS ATTENTION ON ATHERTON THROUGHOUT AND WAS INTELLECTUALLY ENGAGED IN THE DISCUSSIONS.

AT THE END OF THE TALK ON CAMP DAVID, I ASKED FOR HIS REACTION TO REPORTS THAT THE IRAQI AUTHORITIES HAD PLACED HEAVY SURVEILLANCE ON AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI. SHAH SMILED AND SAID THAT, IN FACT, THE CONTROLS WERE PROBABLY TOO TIGHT. HE EXPECTED THERE WOULD BE UNFORTUNATE REACTIONS IN THIS COUNTRY. HE WAS THEREFORE PASSING WORD TO "OUR IRAQI FRIENDS" SUGGESTING THEY EASE UP A BIT ON THE CONTROLS.

IN A RELATED DEVELOPMENT, I LEARN FROM MY BRITISH COLLEAGUE THAT SHAH HAD REQUESTED HIM TO GET WORD TO SHARIATMADARI ON TRUE POSITION OF UK GOVT, SINCE HE FELT AYATOLLAHS IN QOM WERE LISTENING TO BBC AND GETTING FALSE IMPRESSION. BRITISH AMBASSADOR, ACCORDINGLY, SENT RESPONSIBLE BRITISH JOURNALIST WITH FLUENT FARSI TO QOM, WHERE HE HAD PRIVATE SESSION WITH SHARIATMADARI AND PRESENTED ORAL BRIEF AS FROM UK GOVT. SHARIATMADARI WAS OBVIOUSLY UNHAPPY TO RECEIVE THIS BRIEF AND SAID HE HAD EXPECTED UK POSITION TO BE DIFFERENT. HOWEVER, "IT WAS ALWAYS GOOD TO KNOW THE TRUTH."

SHARIATMADARI THEN ASKED UK JOURNALIST FOR STATEMENT OF U.S. POSITION. JOURNALIST SAID HE COULD SPEAK ONLY FOR THE UK. SHARIATMADARI SAID HE WOULD APPRECIATE HAVING SOME ONE GIVE HIM AN AUTHORITATIVE STATEMENT OF U.S. VIEWS AND WENT ON TO HINT THAT NATIONAL FRONT LEADERS HAD INDICATED TO HIM THAT U.S. WISHES TO BE RID OF THE SHAH.

UK JOURNALIST, WHO SERVED AS BRITISH AMBASSADOR'S AGENT IN THIS CASE, HAS INTERVIEW WITH SHAH SCHEDULED FOR SEPT 27. HE WILL GIVE SHAH FULL ACCOUNT OF HIS MEETING IN QOM. IT WILL BE INTERESTING TO SEE WHETHER SHAH SUBSEQUENTLY ASKS ME TO SEND AN EMISSARY TO SHARIATMADARI AS HE DID THE BRITISH. IF SO, I SHALL SEND A POLITICAL OFFICER FROM THE EMBASSY, BUT ONLY WITH THE SHAH'S SPECIFIC SANCTION.

SHAH TOLD BRITISH AMBASSADOR, INCIDENTALLY, THAT HIS URGENCY IN ASKING THAT UK GOVT MAKE ITS VIEWS CLEAR TO SHARIATMADARI DERIVED FROM FACT THAT GOVT OF IRAN WAS OPENING ITS OWN DISCUSSIONS WITH SHARIATMADARI TODAY, SEPT 26. HE DID NOT INDICATE WHO THE GOI INTERLOCUTOR MIGHT BE. SULLIVAN NOTE BY OC/T: DISTRIBUTION CO-ORDINATED WITH S/S-O MR.MCCALLIE.

ON SEPT. 24 PAKISTAN AMBASSADOR AHMED TOLD ME THAT GENERAL ZIA HAD DECIDED TO REJECT AGHA SHAHI'S SCHEME FOR WITHDRAWING FROM CENTO IN RETURN FOR SOVIET ASSURANCES CONCERNING THHE INTEGRITY OF PAKISTAN. HE ATTRIBUTED THIS DECISION TO STRONG PRESSURES FROM THE CHINESE AND "SOUND ADVICE" FROM THE SHAH. HE WENT ON TO SAY THAT AGHA SHAHI BLAMED HIM FOR GETTING THE SHAH TO PRESSURE ZIA AND THAT HE HAD BEEN INFORMALLY ADVISED BY ISLAMABAD TO PREPARE TO LEAVE TEHRAN NO LATER THAN OCTOBER 15. HE ASKED ME TO CONVEY ALL THIS TO THE SHAH WHEN NEXT I SAW HIM.

ON SEPTEMBER 25, DURING AUDIENCE WITH ATHERTON, I GAVE SHAH SUBSTANCE OF ABOVE INFORMATION. HE SAID HE FELT ZIA WOULD HAVE BEEN FOOLISH TO QUIT CENTO IN ANTICIPATION OF SOVIET GENEROSITY. HE INDICATED UNHAPPINESS THAT PAKISTAN AMBASSADOR MIGHT BE TRANSFERRED.

ON SEPT 26 I INFORMED PAKISTAN AMBASSADOR OF MY CONVERSATION WITH THE SHAH. HE SAID IT LOOKED AS THOUGH HIS "GOOSE WAS COOKED." HE FELT THAT AGHA SHAHI AND SHAHNAWAZ REALIZED THEIR OWN TIME IN THE CURRENT CABINET WAS LIMITED AND WERE LOOKING FOR PLACES TO ROOST. IT WAS HIS UNDERSTANDING THAT SHAHNAWAZ WOULD BE NAMED TO TAKE HIS PLACE IN TEHRAN. HE WAS UNCERTAIN OF HIS OWN FUTURE, BUT INDICATED HE MIGHT PREFER TO RETURN TO RETIREMENT.

1978TEHRAN09345.subject: IRAN/BRITISH RELATIONS AND THE BBC PROBLEM

segments.text: BRITISH AMBASSADOR SIR ANTHONY PARSONS HAS RECENTLY TALKED TO ME IN SOME DETAIL ABOUT HIS PROBLEMS WITH THE PERSIAN LANGUAGE BROADCAST SERVICE OF BBC. THE SERVICE IS HEADED BY A BRITISH PROFESSIONAL WHO HAS ONLY LIMITED KNOWLEDGE OF THE PERSIAN LANGUAGE. THE STAFF IS RECRUITED FROM IRANIAN EXPATRIATES IN THE UK, MANY OF WHOM ARE POLITICAL ANTAGONISTS OF THE SHAH. THE NET RESULT IS THAT BBC BROADCASTS TO IRAN ARE HEAVILY FLAVORED WITH ANTI-SHAH CONTENT AND APPARENTLY ALSO WITH SEMANTIC INNUENDOES THAT THE GOI CONSIDERS OFFENSIVE.

THE AVERAGE IRANIAN CONSIDERS THAT BBC REPRESENTS THE OFFICIAL LINE OF THE UK GOVT. CONSEQUENTLY, PARSONS FINDS HIMSELF CONSTANTLY EXCORIATED BY THE GOVT, MISUNDERSTOOD BY THE DISSIDENTS, AND HOPELESSLY OVERWHELMED WHEN HE ATTEMPTS TO MAKE KNOWN THE OFFICIAL UK LINE AS REPRESNETED,FOR EXAMPLE, IN CALLAGHAN'S RECENT LETTER TO THE SHAH.

DURING HIS RECENT HOME LEAVE, PARSONS TRIED WITHOUT SUCCESS TO HAVE THE BBC TAKE FIRMER CONTROL OF ITS PERSIAN SERVCIE. HOWEVER, HE ENCOUNTERED STIFF OPPOSITION BASED ON THE PRINCIPLE OF BBC'S CHERISHED INDEPENDENCE. ALTHOUGH HE HAD SOME SUCCESS IN GETTING HIS POINT ACROSS TO FONSEC OWEN, HE BELIEVES OWEN DOES NOT HAVE THE CLOUT TO BRING BBC AROUND AND THAT PRIME MINISTER CALLAGHAN HAS TO BE ENGAGED.

PARSONS FURTHER SAYS THAT, WITH OWEN CURRENTLY IN NEW YORK, HE IS EFFECTIVELY BLOCKED FROM GETTING TO CALLAGHAN, BECAUSE THE MINISTER OF STATE, CURRENTLY DIRECTING FCO, IS HIMSELF ANTI-SHAH. HE THEREFORE WONDERED IF IT MIGHT BE POSSIBLE FOR YOU TO HAVE A WORD WITH CALLAGHAN ON THE BBC PROBLEM.

I TOLD PARSONS I WAS CERTAIN YOU WOULD BE MOST RELUCTANT TO BECOME INVOLVED IN AN INTERNAL UK PROBLEM. I DID AGREE, HOWEVER, TO SEND YOU A MESSAGE GIVING AS MY OWN OPINION THE FACT THAT BBC BROADCASTS IN THE PERSIAN LANGUAGE WERE CAUSING GREAT CONFUSION IN IRAN WITH RESPECT TO THE TRUE NATURE OF BRITISH POLICY HERE. I COULD EVEN SAY THAT THEY HAVE DONE MUCH TO NEGATE CALLAGHAN'S LETTER TO THE SHAH. IF YOU CHOOSE TO PASS ON THIS COMMENT TO CALLAGHAN ON SOME APPROPRIATE OCCASION, IT WOULD HAVE TO BE ATTRIBUTED TO ME RATHER THAN TO PARSONS.
PARSONS APPRECIATED THE OFFER AND ASKED, BY ALL MEANS, THAT HIS NAME BE KEPT OUT OF THE FRAY.

1978TEHRAN09353.subject: GOI AMBASSADORIAL APPOINTMENTS: BUENOS AIRES, JAKARTA, LAGOS, WARSAW

segments.text: FONMIN AFSHAR-QASEMLU INTRODUCED FOUR NEW AMBASSADORS TO SHAH SEPT 17: HUSHANG AMIR-MOKRI AS AMBASSADOR TO POLAND, JAMSHID TAVALLALI AS AMBASSADOR TO ARGENTINA, PARVIZ SAFINIA AS AMBASSADOR TO INDONESIA, AND KARIM SHARABIANLU AS AMBASSADOR TO NIGERIA. REFTEL PROVIDED BIOGRAPHIC INFORMATION ON AMIR-MOKRI.

PARVIZ SAFINIA (ALSO SPELLED SAFI-NIA) IS A CAREER DIPLOMAT. BORN 1925 IN TEHRAN, HE RECEIVED B.A. IN ECONOMICS FROM HOFSTRA UNIVERSITY AND M.A. IN INTERNATIONAL ECONOMICS FROM NEW YORK UNIVERSITY. HE ALSO ATTENDED UNIVERSITY OF SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA ON UNITED NATIONS POST GRADUATE FELLOWSHIP IN PUBLIC ADMINISTRATION. HE ENTERED MFA 1957 AND HAS SERVED IN DEPARTMENTS OF INTERNATIONAL COLLABORATION, INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS, ECONOMIC AFFAIRS, AND AS DIRECTOR OF REGIONAL COOPERATION FOR DEVELOPMENT. HE HAS SERVED ABROAD AS THIRD SECRETARY IN PRAGUE, AND LONDON, FIRST SECRETARY AND COUNSELLOR IN ANKARA, AND MINISTER COUNSELLOR IN PEKING. SINCE DEC.

1974, HE HAS BEEN CONSUL GENERAL IN SAN FRANCISCO, WHERE HE PERFORMED WELL IN DIFFICULT CIRCUMSTANCES. HE WAS MARRIED IN 1949. HE SPEAKS ENGLISH, FRENCH AND TURKISH. A BRIDGE FANATIC, SAFINIA IS EBULLIENT, FUN-LOVING, GRACIOUS, AND DOWN TO EARTH.

JAMSHID TAVALLALI GOES TO BUENOS AIRES FROM POST AS MINISTER COUNSELLOR AND DCM IN WASHINGTON. HE HAS SERVED PREVIOUSLY IN MFA AND IN EMBASSY MADRID. BORN INTO WEALTHY SHIRAZ FAMILY, HE IS POLISHED, GRACIOUS AND SOCIAABLE. HE IS VERY FRIENDLY TOWARD AMERICANS AND CAN BE EXPECTED TO ESTABLISH CLOSE CONTACT WITH AMEMBASSY. HE PROVED HELPFUL AND INFORMATIVE DURING TOUR IN WASHINGTON. HE IS A PROTEGE OF AMBASSADOR ARDESHIR ZAHEDI TO WHOM HE HAS A DISTANT FAMILY RELATIONSHIP. HIS WIFE NINA (NEE TCHAIKAR) IS FROM RASHT. SHE IS ALSO FRIENDLY AND GRACIOUS TOWARD AMERICANS. BOTH SPEAK EXCELLENT ENGLISH AND SPANISH.
THEY HAVE TWO SONS--ONE STUDYING MEDICINE IN AMERICA, AND THE OTHER AT HARROW. HE PLANS TO ATTEND COLLEGE IN UNITED STATES.
NO INFORMATION IS AVAILABLE ON SHARABIANLU. EMBASSY HAS REQUESTED BIOGRAPHIC INFORMATION FROM MFA AND WILL SEND WHEN AVAILABLE.

THUS FAR, THE CAMP DAVID ACCORDS HAVE BEEN DEPICTED BY MEDIA HERE IN POSITIVE TERMS WITH ESPECIALLY AMPLE COVERAGE OF SADAT AND CARTER. EDITORIAL COMMENT, THOUGH SPARSE, HAS GENERALLY SUPPORTED SADAT AND DECRIED ARAB DISUNITY. THE GOI HAS PUBLICLY BEEN SILENT ON THE ACCORDS BUT, PRIVATELY, THE SHAH AND OTHER KEY OFFICIALS AND ESTABLISHEMTN FIGURES SEE CAMP DAVID AS A STEP FORWARD AND HOPE THE MOMENTUM TOWARDS RELIZATION OF THE ACCORDS WILL BE MAINTAINED.

THERE IS A SECTOR OF THE IRANIAN DISIDENT MOVEMENT WHICH IS STRONGLY SUPPORTIVE OF THE PALESTINAIN CAUSE BUT WITH THE POLITICAL PREOCCUPATION HERE SO INTERNALIZED THE LIKELIHOOD OF ITS SEIZING ON ISSUES ARISING FROM CAMP DAVID IS REMOTE.

AS THE SPECIFICS OF HOW PUBLIC DIPLOMACY CAN ENCOURAGE STEADFASTNES BYTHE GOI IN ITS GENERALLY POSITIVE VIEW OF THE ACCORDS, THE FOLLOWING OCCURS: A. HIGH LEVEL U.S. OFFICIAL VISITS (A LA ATHERTON) AND PERSONAL MESSAGES AT HEAD OF STATE LEVEL TO KEEP GOI TOTALLY INFORMED OF ALL DEVELOPMENT AND U.S. INTERPRETATION THEREOF. CONTINUE TO CIRCULATE TO PRIMARY AUDIENCES, ARAB MISSIONS HERE, AND PLACE IN MEDIA AUTHORITATIVE U.S. VIEWS (E.G. SAUNDERS VTR INTERVIEW). ENCOURAGE EGYPTIANS TO SIMILARY ENGAGE IRAN. CONTENT OF SUCH PUBLIC AND PRIVATE EFFORTS SHOULD STRESS SOVIET MOTIVES IN DISCREDITING THE ACCORDS, AND, WHERE DEMONSTRABLE, HOW IT IS ORCHESTRATING NEGATIVE REACTIONS.

WEST EUROPEAN INTERVENTION AT OFFICIAL LEVELS WOULD NOT HAVE MUCH INFLUENCE HERE BUT UNQUESTIONABLY THE FARSI SERVICES OF THE BBC AND DEUTSCHE WELLE, IN SO FAR AS THEY TREAT THE UNFOLDING NEGTIATIONS OBJECTIVELY AND KEEP THEM IN PRESPECTIVE, COULD CONTRIBUTE TO THE ENCOURAGEMENT EFFORT. THE BBC, ESPECIALLY, HAS IMMENSE CLOUT AMONG POLITICALLY CONCERNED IRANIANS. B. WE SEE LITTLE LIKELIHOOD OR UTILITY IN IRAN'S FOSTERING USEFUL CONTACTS BETWEEN ARABS AND ISRAELIS. INSO FAR AS CONFERENCES OR SEMINARS ARE ORGANIZED OUTSIDE OF IRAN TO WHICH ARABS AND ISRAELIS ARE ATTRACTED, APPROPRIATE IRANIANS MIGHT ALSO BE INVITED.

WE WOULD BE IN A POSITION TO ADVISE ORGANIZERS OF SUCH EVENTS WHO WOULD PROFIT MOST FROM SUCH INVOLVEMENT. C. IRAN'S PREOCCIPATION WITH INTERNAL DIFFICULTIES, THE DISRUPTIONS AT UNIVERSITIES DELIMIT THE NORMAL COMMUNICATION CHANNELS FOR NON GOVERNMENTAL EXCHANGES OF VIEWS ON INTERNATIONAL AFFAIRS. A RECOGNIZED SCHOLAR OR CONGRESSIONAL FIGURE, KNOWLEDGEABLE AND ARTICULATE WITH RESPECT TO THE SIGNIFICANCE OF CAMP DAVID COULD HOWEVER DRAW THE INTEREST AND ATTENTION OF INFLUENTIAL IRANIANS ESPECIALLY IF THE INDIVIDUAL WERE HERE IN PERSON AND HAD STAR STATUS (KISSINGER?). THE ASPEN INSTITUTE, BROOKINGS, STANFORD RESEARCH INSTITUTE AND OTHER U.S. THINK TANKS MAINTAIN ACTIVE LINKS WITH IRANIAN COUNTERPARTS.

OVERTURES FROM THE FORMER FOR A SHARING OF VIEWS ON THE MEANING OF CAMP DAVID WOULD DOUBTLESS DRAW POSITIVE RESPONSE HERE ESPECIALLY IF THE VENUE IS OUTSIDE OF IRAN. D. ENGAGING NON-U.S. RESOURCES OTHER THAN THOSE MENTIONED IN THE FOREGOING (E.G., BBC, EGYPTIAN) WILL NOT HAVE MUCH OF AN IMPACT ON IRANIAN THINKING THIS SUBJECT, ALTHOUGH ANY ILLUMINATIONS AS TO WHAT THE SOVIETS ARE UP TO IN THE M.E. REGARDLESS OF SOURCE WILL DRAW RAPT ATTENTION HERE.

BEGIN LIMITED OFFICIAL USE SUMMARY: NEW COURT MINISTER ARDALAN REVEALED DETAILS OF SHAH'S DECREE BARRING ROYAL FAMILY FROM INVOLVEMENT IN STATE AFFAIRS OR BUSINESS DEALINGS. HE ALSO ANNOUNCED SHAH HAS ORDERED SPECIAL COMMISSION TO ASSESS ALL FOUNDATIONS OR ORGANIZATIONS CHAIRED BY ROYAL FAMILY MEMBERS. ALL SUCH ORGANIZATIONS WILL BE TURNED OVER TO APPROPRIATE GOVT AGENCIES. MINISTER OF JUSTICE BAHERI ANNOUNCED SPECIAL INSPECTION GROUP TO INVESTIGATE CORRUPTION AND SAID 250 JUDGES HAVE RESIGNED OR RETIRED IN PAST TWO YEARS DUE TO DECLINE IN PRESTIGE OF JUDICIARY. SPECIAL INQUIRIES HAVE BEGUN AT NATIONAL IRANIAN PETROCHEMICAL COMPANY AND ATOMIC ENERGY ORGANIZATION. UNRULY CROWD CAUSED CANCELLATION OF EXAMINATIONS SEPT.

27 AT NATIONAL UNIVERSITY. GOVT UNIVERSITY BILL HAS MET HEAVY CRITICISM FROM FACULTY COUNCILS. PARLIAMENTARIANS CONSIDER PARTY SITUATION TO BE FLUID, WITH MAJOR NEW GROUPINGS OR REALIGNMENTS LIKELY. END SUMMARY.

ALI QOLI ARDALAN, WHO WAS NAMED COURT MINISTER SEPT. 26, IMMEDIATELY MADE HIGHLY PUBLICIZED STATEMENT REGARDING CONTROLS ON QUESTIONABLE DEALINGS OF ROYAL FAMILY. HE CITED SHAH'S DECREE JUNE 7, WHICH WAS MADE PUBLIC AUG. 17 (REF A) IN BROAD OUTLINE, AND FOR FIRST TIME GAVE DETAILS.

ROYAL CODE OF CONDUCT PRIVIDES: (A) FAMILY MEMBERS MUST NOT ENGAGE IN BUSINESS ACTIVITIES WHICH MIGHT INVOLVE USE OF INFLUENCE WITH GOVT; (B) THEY MUST NOT ATTEMPT TO INFLUENCE GOVT OFFICIALS REGARDING BUSINESS TRANSACTIONS, EVEN THOUGH THEY HAVE NO PERSONAL INVESTMENT INVOLVED; (C) THEY ARE BARRED FROM MEMBERSHIP ON BOARDS OF BANKS, INSURANCE COMPANIES, OR OTHER PRIVATE BUSINESSES; (D) THEY ARE FORBIDDEN ANY INVOLVEMENT WITH LAND OR PROPERTY BELONGING TO GOVT OR PUBLIC AGENCIES; AND (E) THEY ARE GENERALLY ADMONISHED TO REFRAIN FROM ANY ACTIVITY WHICH MIGHT BE INCOMPATIBLE WITH THEIR STATUS AS MEMBERS OF IMPERIAL FAMILY.

ARDALAN ALSO ANNOUNCED A SECOND IMPERIAL DECREE, THAT HE IS TO INSTITUTE A JOINT COMMISSION COMPOSED OF OFFICIALS OF COURT MINISTRY AND PRIME MINISTER'S OFFICE WHICH WILL ASSESS ALL FOUNDATIONS, SOCIETIES, OR SIMILAR ASSOCIATIONS WHICH ARE HEADED BY MEMBERS OF IMPERIAL FAMILY. AFTER INVESTIGATION OF NO MORE THAN TWO MONTHS, THESE INSTITUTIONS WILL BE GIVEN OVER TO APPROPRIATE GOVT AGENCIES. HE ADDED THAT ALL DEPUTY COURT MINISTERS SUBMITTED RESIGNATIONS, AND HE WILL REORGANIZE MINISTRY WITH SIGNIFICANTLY SMALLER STAFF.

MINISTER OF JUSTICE BAHERI GAVE STATUS REPORT OF HIS ANTICORRUPTION CAMPAIGN, INSISTING AGAIN THAT NAMES OF THE ACCUSED SHOULD BE WITHHELD UNTIL SOLID EVIDENCE IS GATHERED. HE CITED A SHORTAGE OF JUDGES AS ONE REASON WHY THE CAMPAIGN IN NOT PROCEEDING AS RAPIDLY AS IT MIGHT. IN LAST TWO YEARS 250 JUDGES HAVE RESIGNED OR RETIRED, PARTLY DUE TO INSUFFICIENT PAY BUT PRINCIPALLY DUE TO DECLINE IN PRESTIGE OF THE PROFESSION. FIFTEEN INSPECTION TEAMS WILL ASSUME MAIN TASK OF INVESTIGATING ORGANIZATIONS AND AGENCIES. MINISTRY IS REPORTEDLY ACTING ON NUMEROUS CASES, BUT BAHERI GAVE NO DETAILS. PRESS REPORTS INSPECTORS HAVE BEGUN PROBE OF NATIONAL PETROCHEMICALS COMPANY AND ATOMIC ENERGY ORGANIZATION ACTIVITIES.

CIVIL SERVICE TRIBUNAL PROSECUTOR HAS ISSUED APPEAL TO ALL CITIZENS TO FURNISHED (COMMENT: GOVT'S PUBLICITY CAMPAIGN IS IN HIGH GEAR, AND PROMINENT REPORTS OF ARDALAN'S STATEMENTS COME THE CLOSEST SO FAR TO FACING FACT OF ROYAL INVOLVEMENT IN CORRUPTION. BAHERI HAS PRUDENTLY REMINDED PUBLIC THAT THE ACCUSED DESERVE DUE PROCESS OF LAW. NEVERTHELESS, EFFECT OF PUBLICITY CAMPAIGN IS TO PRODUCE EXPECTATION THAT LARGE NUMBERS OF IMPORTANT PEOPLE WILL GO TO PRISON).

SCHEDULED EXAMINATIONS POSTPONED FROM LAST SPRING TERM AT NATIONAL UNIVERSITY WERE BROKEN UP SEPT. 27. ACCORDING TO UNIVERSITY SOURCE, SOME 250-300 STUDENTS RUSHED IN SHOUTING ANTI-SHAH SLOGANS (IN ITSELF A NEW DEVELOPMENT AT NATIONAL UNIVERSITY) AND SOME 50 RINGLEADERS BROKE DOORS, WINDOWS, ETC. WHOLE THING WAS OVER IN A FEW MINSTES, AND STUDENTS DEPARTED WITHOUT POLICE OR GUARDS BEING CALLED IN. UNIVERSITY AUTHORITIES WILL PROBABLY SCRAP THE EXAMS, THUS SCRAPPING HALF YEAR'S WORK FOR THE STUDENTS. INCIDENT CASTS FURTHER DOUBTS ON ABILITY OF TEHRAN'S MAJOR UNIVERSITIES TO OPEN OCT. 7 AS SCHEDULED, AND STAY OPEN.

SINCE PRESENTATION OF UNIVERSITY INDEPENDENCE BILL, AS IT IS CALLED BY GOI, NUMBER OF OBJECTIONS HAVE BEEN VOICED BY FACULTY COUNCILS AT MAJOR INSTITUTIONS. MAJOR CRITICISM IS THAT FACULTY COUNCILS HAVE NO VOICE IN SELECTIONS OF CHANCELLORS AND DEANS AS LEGISLATION IS CURRENTLY DRAFTED.

MINISTER OF HIGHER EDUCATION NAHAVANDI, IN PRESS CONFERENCE SEPT 25, APPEARING IN SEPT 27 PAPERS, BLAMED UNIVERSITY ILLS ON EXCESSES OF STATE BUREAUCRACIES AND SAID BILL HAS CERTAIN SHORTCOMINGS (IMPLYING THEY COULD BE RECTIFIED IN LEGISLATIVE PROCESS), BUT ADDED "AFTER ALL, THE GOVERNMENT HAS INITIATED THIS BILL BECAUSE IT BELIEVES THAT UNIVERSITIES SHOULD BE RUN BY THEIR MEMBETS." HE CAUTIONED, HOWEVER, THAT THERE WOULD HAVE TO BE A TRANSITIONAL PERIOD, AND CALLED FOR COOPERATION BETWEEN TEACHING STAFFS, STUDENTS AND ADMINISTRATORS TO RESOLVE PROBLEMS.

INITIAL REACTION OF SOME FACULTY HAS BEEN FAIRLY STIFF CRITICISM OF NAHAVANDI FOR CLOUDING THE ISSUE AND A DETERMINATION TO PUSH FOR REAL AUTONOMY IN UNIVERSITY PROCESS. (COMMENT: CONTRARY TO EARLIER-EXPRESSED GOI HOPE (REFTEL B) THAT IF BILL WERE BEING REVIEWED WHEN SCHOOL OPENS THIS WOULD HELP QUIET THINGS DOWN, IT NOW APPEARS THAT UNLESS GOI IS WILLING TO MAKE REAL CONCESSIONS ON AUTONOMY NOW, IT WILL HAVE LEFT MAJOR ISSUE ON TABLE WHICH CAN BE EASILY SEIZED UPON BY THOSE WHO WISH TO PROVOKE DEMONSTRATIONS.

PARLIAMENTARY CROSS CURRENTS: IN CONVERSATION WITH HEADS OF SECURITY AND PROTOCOL FOR MAJLES AND SENATE AND SEVERAL MAJLES DEPUTIES DURING RECEPTION AT POL COUNS' RESIDENCE, EMBOFFS GOT INTERESTING PICTURE OF IMPACT OF RECENT EVENTS ON PARLIAMENTARY LIFE. BOTH SECURITY/ PROTOCOL HEADS FELT RECENT OPEN DEBATES ON SHARIF-EMAMI GOVERNMENT HAD LOOSENED THINGS UP A GREAT DEAL. BOTH ALSO SPECULATED THAT OVER HALF OF ELECTED SENATORS AND MAJLES DEPUTIES WOULD PROBABLY NOT RPT NOT BE RETURNED TO OFFICE, EVEN IF ALL INCUMBENTS CONTESTED ELECTIONS. DEPUTIES PRESENT MADE IT CLEAR THAT ORGANIZATIONAL LOYALTIES VERY FLUID AT MOMENT.

OF THREE RESURGENCE PARTY (RPPI) DEPUTIES WHO WERE "POLLED" INFORMALLY, ONE IS REMAINING WITH RPPI, ONE HAS ALREADY JOINED MINISTER NAHAVANDI'S GROUP FOR THE STUDY OF IRANIAN PROBLEMS, AND A THIRD (WHO REPORTEDLY TURNED DOWN THE HEALTH MINISTRY PORTFOLIO IN THE WANING DAYS OF AMOUZEGAR GOVERNMENT) IS VERY MUCH ON THE FNECE, NOMINALLY AN RPPI MEMBER BUT LOOKING AROUND.

DEPUTIES' VIEWS ON OPPOSITION GADFLY BANIAHMAD WERE ALSO FAIRLY TRENCHANT: BANIAHMAD WILL CONTINUE TO PROVIDE "SOUND AND THUNDER" ON OPPOSITON SIDE, BUT WILL NOT BE A SERIOUS FACTOR IN NEXT YEAR'S ELECTIONS. PARLIAMENTARIANS ARE HOLDING INTENSE DISCUSSIONS AMONG THEMSELVES AS TO WHAT TO DO AND HOW TO GET ORGANIZED. BANIAHMAD WILL BE REJECTED BY RADICALS AND IS ANATHEMA TO MODERRATES. 8.COMMENT: WHOLE TENOR OF TALKS WITH PARLIAMENTARIANS AND OFFICIALS STRONGLY SUPPORTED EMERGING HYPOTHESIS THAT THERE WILL BE AT LEAST TWO OR THREE "MIDDLE OF THE ROAD" GROUPS IN THE FIELD FOR PARLIAMENTARY ELECTIONS.

CONTINUANCE OF RPPI IS VIEWED BY MANY HERE AS MAKING OTHERS SO-CALLED "MODERATE" ORGANIZATIONS INEVITABLE, SINCE MANY CENTRISTS BELIEVE RPPI HAS NO CREDIBILITY. RPPI ORGANIZATIONAL BASE WILL THUS APPARENTLY BE RESERVED FOR SOLID SUPPORTERS OF THE "MONARCHIC COMPLEX", WHILE MOST OF REST OF MIDDLE CLASS/UPPER MIDDLE CLASS ESTABLISHMENTARIANS SEEM HEADED FOR NEW ORGANIZATIONAL FORM OR FORMS.

A TYPED THREAT LETTER IN FARSI ADDRESSED TO THE AMERICAN AMBASSADOR WAS RECEIVED AT THE CHANCERY ON 9/26. LETTER REFERS TO IRANIANS KILLED BY GOI IN INCIDENTS SUCH AS THAT ON SEPTEMBER 8 IN TEHRAN AT JALEH SQUARE; ASSOCIATES U.S. GOVERNMENT AND AMERICAN COMMUNITY WITH GOI; STATES THAT , BEGINNING WITH A CERTAIN DATE THE SLAUGHTER OF ALL AMERICANS RESIDING IN IRAN WILL COMMENCE, UNQUOTE; AND THAT THEIR DEMAND IS, ONE HEAD AGAINST EACH MARTYRED HEAD, UNQUOTE. LETTER WAS SIGNED BY, , THE FATHERS, SPOUSES, CHILDREN, AND RELATIVES OF THE MARTYRS AND OTHER MEMBERS OF THE MOURNERS' MOVEMENT, UNQUOTE.

COPIES OF ORIGINAL THREAT LETTER RECEIVED AT CHANCERY ADDRESSED TO CHIEF, U.S. ARMED FORCES HOSPITAL AND TO BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND WERE RECEIVED AT HOSPITAL AND BRITISH EMBASSY ALSO ON 9/26. LETTER TO BRITISH AMBASSADOR HAD COVERING NOTE URGING BRITISH COMMUNITY TO DISASSOCIATE THEMSELVES FROM U.S. COMMUNITY BECAUSE OF THREAT OUTLINED IN ATTACHED LETTER.

TRANSLATION AND FULL TEXT OF LETTER BEING POUCHED TODAY. ORIGINAL HAS BEEN PROVIDED TO SAVAK FOR THEIR INVESTIGATION. NO INFORMATION AVAILABLE AS YET AS TO ACTUAL IDENTITY AND/OR PURPOSE OF MOURNERS' MOVEMENT.

BOTH OFFICIAL AND PRIVATE AMERICAN COMMUNITIES HAVE BEEN ON A GENERAL ALERT STATUS THROUGHT RECENT WEEKS. NO FURTHER ACTION BEING TAKEN AT THIS TIME PENDING RESULTS OF INVESTIGATION NOW BEING CONDUCTED IN COORDINATION WITH LOCAL POLICE.

IRANIAN PRESS SEPT 27 CARRIED BRIEF AFP ITEM BASED ON TALKS WITH IRANIAN SHIITE MUSLIM SPOKEMAN IN QOM WHICH SAID IRAQ HAS "WITHDRAWN" RESTRICTIVE MEASURES REPORTEDLY IMPOSED ON AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI. SHIITE SPOKESMAN HERE WELCOME REPORT, BUT CRITICIZED IRAQIS FOR INITIAL DECISION TO RESTRICT KHOMEINI'S ACTIVITIES IN FIRST PLACE (REF A). STROY REFERRED TO REPORTS OF KHOMEINI RESTRICTION COMING FROM PARIS COMMUNIQUE OF AN IRANIAN HUMAN RIGHTS GROUP WHICH SAID IRAQ "BOWING TO PRESSURE FROM IRAN, HAS CUT OFF VISITORS" TO KHOMEINI HOME.

PRESS REPORT ABOVE WAS FIRST OFFICIAL REFERENCE TO KHOMEINI HOUSE ARREST IN PERSIAN PRESS. THERE HAS APPARENTLY BEEN DISCUSSION OF MATTER WITHIN RELIGIOUS COMMUNITY, BUT NO OVERT ACTION OR REFERENCE TO MATTER AS REF A HAD SUGGESTED. ACCORING TO SOME RELIGIOUS SOU, KHOMEINI'S HOUSE ARREST APPEARS TO HAVE TAKEN BACK SEAT TO DISCUSSION OF DISAPPEARANCE OF IMAM SADR AT LEAST PARTLY BECUASE NEWS OF HIS TROUBLES WAS NOT WIDESPREAD AND SADR MATTER HAD ALREADY ENTERED PUBLIC DISCUSSION HERE (REF B).
WOULD APPRECIATE ANY INDEPENDENCE CONFIRMATION BAGHDAD COULD TURN UP REGARDING EXACT STATUS OF KHOMEINI.

1978TEHRAN09428.subject: RECENT DEVELOPMENTS IN THE OIL SECTOR

segments.text: ON SEPTEMBER 23, THE LOCAL PRESS CARRIED SOMEWHAT CONTRADICTORY REPORTS OF AN EXPLOSION ON SEPT. 21 WHICH DESTROYED A SECTION OF THE 42-INCH PIPELINE (IGAT I) WHICH CARRIES ABOUT ONE BILLION SCF/DAY OF NATURAL GAS FOR EXPORT TO THE USSR. THE RUPTURE OCCURRED NEAR SAVEH, TO THE NORTH OF QUM.

THE EXPLOSION INVOLED A SEVEN RPT SEVEN METER SECTION OF PIPE ALTHOUGH, DURING THE REPAIRS WHICH WERE COMPLETED IN JUST OVER 48 HOURS, 70 METERS OF PIPE WERE REPLACED. OUR SOURCES AT NIGC MAINTAIN THAT EXPLOSION RESULTED FROM CORROSION AND PIPE STRESS. HOWEVER, IN VIEW OF THE VERY UNUSUAL AMOUNT OF DIFFICULTY WE HAD IN OBTAINING INFORMATION ON EXPLOSION AS WELL AS THE INTENSE LEVEL OF ACTIVITY AT NIGC DURING THE PAST WEEK (INCLUDING, WE UNDERSTAND, A HURRIEDLY SCHEDULED MEETING BETWEEN THE PRIME MINISTER AD TOP NIGC OFFICIALS), WE DO NOT RULE OUT THE POSSIBILITY THAT TERRORISTS MIGHT RPT MIGHT HAVE BEEN RESPONSIBLE.

RECENT RUMORS ABOUT IMMINENT DEPARTURE OF HUSHANG ANSARY (COMMENTED ON IN TEHRAN 8721 AND 8971) HAVE LARGELY SUBSIDED. WE HAVE HEARD THAT ANSARY IS ONE OF THOSE IDENTIFIED BY OPPOSITIONIST GROUPS AS ONE OF MANY IN GOVERNMENT WHO WILL HAVE TO GO. WHETHER FOR BAHAI CONNECTIONS OR CORRUPTION OR BOTH IS NOT CLEAR ALTHOUGH BOTH ALLEGATIONS HAVE MADE THE RUMOR CIRCUIT. HOWEVER, SUCH RUMORS ARE CIRCULATING IN TEHRAN ABOUT MANY AND IT IS NOT AT ALL CLEAR THAT ANSARY HAS HAD IT. WE TEND TO DISBELIEVE THE EXISTENCE OF BAHAI CONNECTIONS AND THUS FAR THERE HAVE BEEN NO PUBLIC CHARGES OF CORRUPTION LEVIED AGAINST ANSARY.
HE, AND NIOC, COULD OF COURSE BE CAUGHT UP IN THE ANTI-CORRUPTION DRIVE BUT IT IS A DEVELOPMENT THAT CANNOT BE PREDICTED.

THE DRIFT AT NIOC COMMENTED UPON IN REFTEL HAS BEEN EVIDENT FOR FAR LONGER THAN THE RUMORS ABOUT ANSARY'S LIKELY OUSTER. WE BELIEVE THAT THIS DRIFT IS LARGELY A REFLECTION OF (A) THE DEPARTURE IN FEBRUARY OF NIOC'S TWO BEST AND MOST EXPERIENCED DIRECTORS (MINA AND NABEGH), (B) THE LACK OF PRACTICAL OIL INDUSTRY EXPERIENCE OF ANSARY AND MEHRAN, AND (C) THE DIFFICULTY OF MOVING AN ORGANIZATION AS LARGE AND LETHARGIC AS NIOC. THE CONCERN ABOUT PROTECTING ONES SELF FROM THE POSSIBILITY OF AN OFFICIAL INVESTIGATION IS OF COURSE MUCH INCREASED AT PRESENT; AND, AS WE POINTED OUT IN TEHRAN 8971, ANSARY IS PROBABLY EXHIBITING THIS CONCERN.

IT SHOULD ALSO BE NOTED, THOUGH, THAT THERE ARE SCORES OF SENIOR AND MIDDLE-LEVEL OFFICIALS OF NICO(AND OF MANY OTHER GOI ENTITIES) WHO DO NOT RELISH THE PROSPECT OF AN EXTENSIVE INVESTIGATION AND ARE PERFECTLY WILLING TO LET THINGS DRIFT.

REPORTS OF STRIKE AFFECTING NIOC/OSCO OPERATIONS, INCLUDING PRODUCTION AND OPERATIONS OF KHARG ISLAND EXPORT TERMINAL, WHICH HAVE BEEN CIRCULATING IN INDUSTRY CIRCLES IN TEHRAN(AND IN U.S. JUDGING FROM REFTEL) HAVE TENDED TO EXAGGERATE PRESENT AND SHORT-TERM IMPACT AND HAVE UNTIL YESTERDAY EXAGGERATED EXTENT OF WALK-OUT. THE STRIKE BEGAN ON SEPT 23 BY A FAIRLY SMALL NUMBER OF DAILY RATED EMPLOYEES (DRE'S) IN AHWAZ. HOWEVER, IT GRADULLY SPREAD AND BY YESTERDAY APPROXIMATELY 90 PERCENT OF DRE'S IN AHWAZ, AGHAJARI, GACHSARAN, AND KHARG ISLAND WERE PARTICIPATING IN WALK-OUT. OSCO MANAGEMENT WAS PRESENTED WITH A LIST OF 20 DEMANDS, INCLUDING BOTH SALARY AND FRINGE BENEFITS.

HOWEVER, OSCO HAS TAKEN A RELATIVELY PASSIVE ROLE IN SUBSEQUENT NEGOTIATIONS, AND THE PRINCIPAL ACTORS HAVE BEEN THE LABOR MINISTRY, NIOC, SYNDICATES, AND UNOFFICAL REPS OF THE DRE'S. EVERYTHING WE HAVE HEARD INDICATES THAT THE WALK-OUT IS STRICTLY ECONOMICALLY MOTIVATED AND THAT THERE HAVE BEEN NO POLITICAL OVERTONES. ------------------004794 281418Z /53 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 639 SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 9428

THERE HAVE BEEN SEVERAL NEGOTIATING MEETINS BUT THERE HAS BEEN NO EVIDENCE OF PROGRESS. THE MINISTRY OF LABOR AND NIOC HAVE REPORTEDLY TAKEN THE LINE THAT EVERYTHING IS NEGOTIABLE BUT ONLY AFTER THE ILLEGAL STRIKE IS TERMINATED. WE UNDERSTAND THAT GOI NEGOTIATORS MADE A VAGUE THREAT YESTERDAY AGAINST DRE'S WHO DID NOT REPORT FOR ESSENTIAL JOBS (INCLUDING ALL JOBS ON KHARG) BY 2:00 P.M. THE SAME DAY--SEPT. 27. REPORTEDLY, A FEW REPORTED TO WORK LATE YESTERDAY AND THIS MORNING BUT COMPLIANCE WITH THE DEMAND TO RESUME WORK HAS BEEN SPOTTY AT BEST.
IT IS IMPOSSIBLE TO PREDICT THE LIKELY OUTCOME, BUT THE STRIKE HAS NIOC AND, REPORTEDLY, THE SHAH VERY NERVOUS; AND, THE WORKERS MAY ACHIEVE MANY OF THEIR GOALS.

THE WALK-OUT HAS THUS FAR HAD ALMOST NO IMPACT ON PRODUCTION OR EXPORTS. ONE SMALL FIELD (MANSURI WITH A CAPACITY OF 20MB/D) IS SHUT IN AS ARE TWO DESLTING PLANTS. AT KHARG, OPERATIONS ARE PROCEEDING NORMALLY. OSCO HAS TWO TUGS UNDER CONTRACT (NOT INVOLVED IN LABOR DISPUTE), IS OPERATING ONE OF ITS OWN TUGS WITH STAFF, AND IS ENGAGING THE SERVICES OF A THIRD CONTRACT GUG TODAY. AS THE DEPT IS AWARE, OIL PRODUCTION AND THE OPERATION OF KHARG IS NOT LABOR INTENSIVE; AND, OSCO MANAGEMENT AND STAFF CAN CONTINUE FOR SOME TIME ON THEIR OWN WITHOUT GREATLY AFFECTING PRODUCTION/EXPORT LEVELS.

NEVERTHELESS, MAINTAINANCE WILL SUFFER, ACCIDENTS ARE MORE LIKELY, DEVELOPMENTAL DRILLING AND THE ACTIVITIES OF WORK-OVER RIGS HAS STOPPED, ETC., ETC.; AND EVERYONE IS MOST ANXIOUS TO SEE THE DRE'S RETURN TO WORK.
SINGLE ROOM BOOKED AT SEMIS HOTEL (WHICH WITHIN SHORT WALK FROM EMBASSY) BEGINNING MORNING 5 OCTOBER.

1978TEHRAN09431.subject: IRANIAN PERMRE TO UNITED NATIONS URGES USG ROLE IN IRANIAN CRISIS

segments.text: DEPT WILL RECOGNIZE SUBSTANCE OF HOVEYDA CONVERSATION WITH LEONARD AS RECRUDESCENCE OF VITRIOL WHICH HAS ENVENOMED RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN ZAHEDI AND HOVEYDA'S BROTHER AMIR ABBASS. COUNTERPART OF THIS COMMENTARY WAS ZAHEDI CONVERSATION WITH ACTING SECRETARY CHRISTOPHER REPORTED REF B IN WHICH ZAHEDI LASHED OUT AT HOVEYDA.

AS FOR SUBSTANCE OF HOVEYDA'S SUGGESTIONS, DEPT WILL ALSO HAVE DESCERNED, FROM OTHER REPORTING, THAT SHAH IS INDEED ALREADY EMBARKED ON PROGRAM VERY MUCH ALONG LINES OF HOVEYDA'S RECOMMENDATIONS. AT CURRENT MOMENT, HE IS, FOR TACTICAL REASONS, ATTRIBUTING ALL THESE ACTIONS TO SHARIF-EMAMI RATHER THAN TO HIMSELF. HE HAS LARGELY RECOVERED FROM THE "IMMOBILISM" WITH WHICH OVEYDA HAS ACCURATELY CHARACTERIZED HIS MOOD OF TWO WEEKS AGO. HE HAS ASSURED ME HE HAS NO RPT NO INTENTION OF STEPPING DOWN IN FAVOR OF THE CROWN PRINCE, A REGENCY, OR ANYONE ELSE.

HOVEYDA MAY BE CORRECT IN SAYING THAT SHARIFEMAMI IS AN IMPERFECT IMPLEMENT FOR CARRYING OUT A PROGRAM TO PROPITIATE THE ISLAMIC CLERGY, BUT HE IS BETTER THAN ANY OTHER POLITICAL FIGURE AVAILABLE. HE IS ALSO CORRECT IN SAYING THAT THE SHAH MUST CRACK DOWN ON THE ROYAL FAMILY; BUT HE HAS ALREADY PUBLICLY DONE SO--TO INCLUDE HOVEYDA'S QUONDAM BOSS, PRINCESS ASHRAF.

IT IS MY UNDERSTANDING THAT AMIR ABBASS HOVEYDA, WHO IS CURRENTLY LIVING MODESTLY WITH HIS MOTHER, CONTINUES TO PASS HIS VIEWS TO THE SHAH, VERY LARGELY THROUGH THE EMPRESS WHO KEEPS IN TOUCH WITH HIM THROUGH DAILY TELEPHONE CALLS. I EXPECT TO PAY HIM A VISIT NEXT WEEK TO SAMPLE HIS MOOD AND TO FIND OUT HIS FUTURE PLANS. LAST TIME I TALKED WITH HIM, HE SAID HE WOULD PROBABLY TRY TO REVIVE HIS IRAN NOVIN PARTY, BUT IN THE HANDS OF YOUNGER MEN WHILE HE STAYED IN THE BACKGROUND. HE SAID HE HAD NO DESIRE TO GO ABROAD.
THE ATTACK ON ZAHEDI COULD MEAN THAT TH HAS CHANGED HIS MIND AND WANTS THE WASHINGTON EMBASSY.
AS FOR THE CIA STUDY, I, TOO, WOULD LIKE TO SEE IT IF IT EXISTS.

FINALLY, WITH RESPECT TO HOVEYDA'S SUGGESTION FOR A DISCUSSION OF IRAN WITH THE SOVIETS, NOTHING COULD BE BETTER CALCULATED TO START THE RUMOR THAT WE AND THE SOVIETS HAVE DECIDED TO "DIVIDE UP" IRAN. WE COULD COUNT ON THE SOVIETS TO LEAK THE FACT OF ANY SUCH DISCUSSION TO THE IRANIANS AND TO CREATE ALL SORTS OF MISCHIEF HERE. MOREOVER, MY SOVIET COLLEAGUE HAS GONE OUT OF HIS WAY TO AVOID ANY DISCUSSION OF RECENT IRANIAN EVENTS WITH ME AND I FEEL THAT IS THE BEST WAY TO KEEP THINGS AT THIS TIME.

HAVING SAID ALL FOREGOING, I WOULD BE INTERESTED TO CONTINUE TO RECEIVE REPORTS OF ANY FURTHER CONVERSATIONS EITHER ZAHEDI OR HOVEYDA HAVE WITH U.S. OFFICIALS ON SUBJECT OF INTERNAL IRANIAN POLITICAS BECAUSE THEY HELP US OBTAIN BETTER FOCUS ON ALL PRESSURES WHICH ARE CURRENTLY BEING CONCENTRATED ON THE SHAH.
REQUEST DEPT PASS USUN.

1978TEHRAN09464.subject: REORGANIZATION OF NUCLEAR ACTIVITIES IN IRAN

segments.text: ON 30 SEPTEMBER, DR. AHMAD SOTOODEHNIA WAS INTRODUCED TO HIS IMPERIAL MAJESTY BY MINISTER OF POWER JAHANGIR MAHD MINA, AND HIS DEPUTY AND PRESIDENT OF THE ATOMIC ENERGY ORGANIZATION OF IRAN. AEOI IN ITS ENTIRETY, WILL CONTINUE OPERATIONS UNDER THE MINISTRY OF POWER ALTHOUGH PREVIOUSLY, ITS ACTIVITIES WERE CONDUCTED AS AN INDEPENDENT ORGANIZATION.

FOR THE TIME BEING AT LEAST, REGULATORY, RESEARCH AND TRAINING FUNCTIONS ARE UNDER THE DIRECT RESPONSIBILTY OF SOTOODEHNIA, TOGETHER WITH HIS JOB OF PROCURING, CONSTRUCTING AND OPERATING ALL NUCLEAR POWER PLANTS FOR IRAN.

IT WAS REPORTED IN THE 1 OCTOBER TEHRAN JOURNAL, THAT DURING THE MAHD MINA/SOTOODEHNIA AUDIENCE WITH THE SHAH, THE SHAHANSHAH "INSTURCTED THE NEW CHEIF OF THE AEOI TO EXPEDITE THE CONSTRUCTION WORK OR THE ATOMIC REACTORS AT BUSHEHR AND KAROUN." THE ARTICLE CONTINUES: "THE MONARCH ALSO ORDERED THE ESTABLISHMENT OF MORE ATOMIC REACTORS AT DIFFERENT PARTS OF THE COUNTRY. HE SAID THAT ALL ENERGY SOURCES PRESENT IN THE COUNTRY SHOULD BE EXPLOITED."

HIGH OFFICIAL IN AEOI TOLD MINISTER-COUNSELOR ON OCTOBER 1 THAT AKBAR ETEMAD, WHO RESIGNED RECENTLY AS HEAD OF AEOI, WAS DEFINITELY INTERESTED IN REPLACING EKLUND NEXT YEAR. SOURCE STATED THAT, ALTHOUGH EKLUND HAD BEEN REAPPOINTED FOR OFUR YEARS, THERE WAS AN INFORMAL UNDERSTANDING THAT IN FACT EKLUND WOULD SERVE ONLY TWO YEARS AND THAT THE POSITION WOULD BE OPEN IN SEPTEMBER 1979. HE ALSO SAID THAT HE WOULD INFORMALLY ADVISE THE FRENCH, GERMANS, AND AUSTRALIANS OF ETEMAD'S INTEREST.

HE SAID THAT HE EXPECTED THE INVESTIGATION OF AEOI WOULD BE COMPLETED WITHIN THE NEXT TWO TO THREE MONTHS AND THAT NO CHARGES WOULD BE BROUGHT AGAINST DR. ETEMAD. IT APPEARED, HE SAID, THAT THE INVESTIGATION WOULD CENTER ON IMPROPRIETIES IN THE DEVELOPMENT OF THE ISFAHAN TECHNOLOGICAL CENTER AND THAT THOSE WHO HAD ALREADY BEEN FOUND RESPONSIBLE FOR THE IMPROPRIETIES BY A SEPARATE INVESTIGATION HAD BEEN FIRED.

SUMMARY: LARGE-SCALE SHOP CLOSURES OCCURRED OCT 1 IN TABRIZ, KERMAH, ISFAHAN, SHIRAZ, YAZD AND TEHRAN BAZAAR AREA IN PROTEST OF ALLEGED HOUSE ARREST OF KHOMEINI. BANK MELLI AND PTT MAINTENANCE AND SATELLITE COMMUNICATION PERSONNEL ARE ALSO ON STRIKE. GOVT TO PRESENT SEVERAL BILLS TO MAJLES. ARYAMEHR UNIVERSITY COUNCIL REJECTED UNIVERSITY INDEPENDENCE BILL. PRESS WRITERS SYNDICATE REJECTED PRESS BILL. GOI ANNOUNCED RELEASE OF 237 PERSONS HELD FOR ANTI-STATE VIOLATIONS. CENTRAL TEHRAN PRODUCE MARKET BURNED, REPORTEDLY KILLING THREE PEOPLE. SHOTS HEARD IN SOUTH TEHRAN AFTER CURFEW, BUT NO REPORTS OF INJURIES. MORE NONVIOLENT DISPLAYS OF ANTIAMERICAN FEELING IN TEHRAN. RESURGENCE PARTY REPORTEDLY TO DISBAND WITHIN TWO DAYS.
SHAH SENT ENVOY TO AMMAN TO INQUIRE ABOUT IMAM SADR; OPPOSITION DEPUTY REPORTS SADR IS SAFE IN LIBYA. END SUMMARY.

LARGE SCALE SHOP CLOSURES OCCURRED OCT 1 TO PROTEST ALLEGED IRAQI HOUSE ARREST OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, NATIONAL FRONT ISSUED APPEAL, QUICKLY JOINED BY RELIGIOUS LEADERS, FOR NATIONWIDE STRIKE OCT 1. BBC BEGAN BROADCASTING APPEAL SEPT. 28 . (COMMENT: BBC'S FREQUENT REPETITION OF APPEAL HAS DAMAGED ITS ALREADY LOW STOCK WITH GOI.) GOVT ISSUED DENIAL THAT IRAQ HAD PALACED KHOMEINI UNDER HOUSE ARREST AND CHIDED PRESS FOR PUBLISHING UNCONFIRMED STORY. AS REPORTED REFTEL, INDICATIONS ARE THAT IRAQIS DID RELAX POLICE CONTROLS, ALTHOUGH KHOMEINI'S PRESENT SITUATION IS UNKNOW,. NATIONAL FRONT APPEAL BROUGHT SIZABLE RESPONSE. ISFAHAN, YAZD AND SHIRAZ REPORT ALMOST TOTAL RETAIL SHOP CLOURES, ALTHOUGH OFFICES ARE OPEN.

TABRIZ AND KERMANSHAH SHOPS ALSO LARGELY CLOSED DOWN. SOUTH TEHRAN IS CLOSED, INCLUDING BAZAAR, BUT AREA NORTH OF FERDOWSI INCLUDES MANY OPEN SHOPS. MEANWHILE, GTE COMMERCIAL AND PRIVATE TELEX LINES ARE DOWN, WITH AT LEAST SATELLITE COMMUNICATION AND MAINTENANCE SECTIONS, OF PTT APPARENTLY ON STRIKE. BANK MELLI ALSO REPORTS STRIKE CONDITIONS. HOWEVER, BOTH APPEAR ECONOMIC AND NOT POLITICAL.

EMERGENCY SESSION OF MAJLES SCHEDULED OCT 1 TO RECEIVE SEVERAL GOVT BILLS. GOVT IS PRESENTING PROPOSED LAWS GOVERNING PUBLIC DEMONSTRATIONS, LOWERED TAXES ON INCOME, ABROGATION OF LAW ON EMPTY HOUSES (EXISTING LAW ALLOWS GOVT TO RENT PRIVATE HOUSING IF IT LIES EMPTY AND LANDLORD REFUSES TO SEEK TENANT). AND PROPOSAL TO STRIP PARLIAMENTARY IMMUNITY FROM ONE OF THE DEPUTIES (MANSOUR YASINI, WHO IS SUSPECTED OF CORRUPTION). MEANWHILE TWO KEY BILLS-PROPOSED PRESS LAW AND UNIVERSITY INDEPENDENCE BILL- RECEIVED FURTHER NEGATIVE RESPONSE FROM CONSTITUENCIES THEY WERE INTENDED TO PLEASE. SCIENTIFIC COUNCIL OF ARYAMEHR TECHNICLA UNIVERSITY JOINED THOSE OF AZERBADEGAN AND TEHRAN UNIVERSITY IN FORMALLY REJECTING UNIVERSITY BILL.
WRITERS' AND REPORTERS' SYNDICATE SIMILARLY DENOUNCED PRESS BILL. (COMMENT: GOI MAKES CLEAR BOTH BILLS ARE NEGOTIABLE BUT MUST BE TAKEN ABACK BY ALMOST TOTAL CRITICISM WHICH BILLS HAVE AROUSED).

GOVE ANNOUNCED 237 PRISONERS WHO WERE HELD FOR ANTISTATE ACTIVITIES WERE RELEASED LAST WEEK. STATEMENT ADDED THAT ABOUT 100 ARE STILL INCUSTODY FOR VIOLATIONS OF MARTIAL LAW. TEHRAN CENTRAL PRODUCE MARKET BURNED NIGHT OF SEPT 30-OCT 1, REPORTEDLY KILLING THREE PEOPLE. CAUSE IS UNKNOWN. SHOTS WERE HEARD AFTER CURFEW IN SOUTH TEHRAN, FRIDAY NIGHT. BUT THERE ARE NO REPORTS OF INJURIES. SECURITY SITUATION OTHERWISE QUIET. HOWEVER, NONVIOLENT ANTIAMERICAN DISPLAYS, SUCH AS INSULTS SHOUTED AT AMERICAN MOTORISTS (USUALLY WOMEN), INCREASED IN LAST COUPLE OF DAYS.

SOME PRESS REPORTS, ALTHOUGH NOT ALL, INDICATE RESURGENCE PARTY (RPPI) WILL DISBAND. ONE NEWSPAPER REPORTS SECRETARY GENERAL JAVAD SAYEED RESIGNED YESTERDAY, STATING PARTY IS DISBANDED. OTHER JOURNALS SAY HE IS EXPECTED TO RESIGN OCT 3 AND THAT PARTY DISSOLUTION WILL FOLLOW. SAYEED IS EXPECTED TO RUN MAJLES SPEAKERSHIP, CHALLENGING RIAZI AFTER MAJLES FORMALLY RECONVENES OCT.6.

SHAH HAS DISPATCHED SPECIAL ENVOY TO AMMAN TO INQUIRE INTO FATE OF IMAM SADR. MEANWHILE, AHMAD BANI-AHMAD ANNOUNCED FROM ROME HE HAS LEARNED SADR IS SAFE AND WELL IN LIBYA. ACCORDING TO BANI-AHMAD, SADR'S ELDEST SON, SADREDDIN SADR, HAS CONFIRMED HIS FATHER'S WHEREABOUTS.

1978TEHRAN09521.subject: MORE ON LABOR PROBLEMS IN OIL SECTOR

segments.text: REF (A) STATE 246376 (B) TEHRAN 9428

THE GOI AND NIOC HAVE IMPOSED A VERY EFFECTIVE SHROUD OF SECRECY AROUND THE LABOR DISTURBANCES AMONG OIL INDUSTRY WORKERS IN THE SOUTH. OSCO AND LOCAL CONSORTIUM REPS HAVE BEEN INSTRUCTED BY NIOC NOT TO DISCUSS THE SITUATION WITH ANYONE AND THE NUMBER OF PEOPLE AT NIOC WHO ARE WELL INFORMED ABOUT THE STRIKE IS VERY SMALL--EVEN ALTERNATE DIRECTORS WITH WHOM WE HAVE TALKED HAVE HEARD ONLY RUMORS, SOME OF WHICH ARE WRONG.

WE HAVE, HOWEVER, CONFIRMED ACCURACY OF REPORT (REF A) THAT DRE'S HAVE DEMANDED A FIFTY PERCENT WAGE INCREASE. GOI AND NIOC NEGOTIATORS HAVE OFFERED AN IMMEDIATE TEN PERCENT PAY INCREASE AND PROMISED TO CONSIDER ADDITIONAL PAY RAIS AND/OR WORKER DEMANDS FOR IMPROVED SOCIAL BENEFITS IF THE DRE'S WOULD RETURN TO WORK. AS OF OCTOBER 1, THE OFFER HAD NOT BEEN ACCEPTED AND THE DRE'S REMAIN OUT OF STRIKE.

ANOTHER INTERESTING FACET OF OSCO LABOR PROBLEM IS FACT THAT STRIKE WAS CALLED AND DRE DEMANDS ARE BEING NEGOTIATED BY EMPLOYEES WHO HAVE NO FORMAL RIGHT TO REPRESENT DRE LABOR FORCE. PRESENT STRIKE LEADERS MAINTAIN THAT THEIR NOMINAL REPRESENTATIVES ARE TOO COMPLIANT AND DO NOT REPRESENT THE WILL OF THE OVERWHELMING MAJORITY OF OSCO WORKERS. NIOC AND MINISTRY OF LABOR OFFICIALS INITIALLY RESPONDED BY RECOMMENDING THAT ESTABLISHED ELECTION PROCEDURES BE USED BY THE DRE'S TO SELECT NEW REPRESENTATIVES WHO WOULD HAVE A LEGAL RIGHT TO NEGOTIATE ON GENERAL TERMMS OF EMPLOYMENT. APPARENTLY THE DRE'S ARE MORE ANXIOUS TO PRESS THEIR IMMEDIATE GRIEVANCES THAN TO SELECT NEW SYNDICATE REPRESENTATIVES.

IT IS IN ANY CASE SOMEWHAT OF A MOOT POINT SINCE NIOC AND MINISTRY OF LABOR OFFICIALS HAVE BEEN NEGOTIATING WITH THE STRIKE LEADERS AND HAVE, THEREBY, GIVEN DE FACTO RECOGNITION OF THE DRE'S RIGHT TO CHOOSE THEIR OWN INFORMAL SPOKESMEN.

DESPITE THE CONTINUATION OF THE WALK-OUT, CRUDE PRODUCTION AND EXPORTS CONTINUE AT HIGH LEVELS. MOREOVER, AN EARLIER THREAT THAT THE DRE'S WOULD BE JOINED IN THEIR WALK-OUT BY IRANIAN PROFESSIONAL STAFF OF OSCO HAS NOT MATERIALIZED, AND FEARS HAVE ABATED SOMEWHAT THAT THE STRIKE WILL SPREAD BEYOND THE RANKS OF THE DRE'S.

WE HAVE ALSO LEARNED THAT LABOR UNREST IN THE OIL SECTOR IS NOT CONFINED TO THE SOUTH. MANY OF THE DRE'S AT THE TEHRAN REFINERY (NIOC AND NOT OSCO EMPLOYEES) HAVE BEEN ON STRIKE FOR NEARLY TWO WEEKS. THEIR PRINCIPAL DEMANDS ARE HIGHER SALARIES AND COMPANY-PROVIDED HOUSING. LIKE THE SOUTHERN OIL FIELDS, THE IMPACT OF THE STRIKE ON THE TEHRAN REFINERY HAS BEEN MINIMAL.

SUMMARY: FIRST SERIOUS DEMONSTRATION IN SOME DAYS OCCURRED EVENING OCT 1 IN KERMANSHAH, WHERE THERE IS NO MARTIAL LAW OR CURFEW. POLICE CHIEF ALSO ASSASSINATED IN MASHAD. MEANWHILE, GOVERNMENT HAS ISSUED CALL FOR ALL IRANIAN POLITICAL EXILES LIVING ABROAD TO RETURN IN SPIRIT OF NATIONAL RECONCILIATION WITH NO FEAR OF PROSECUTION FOR PAST ACTS; THIS COULD INCLUDE KHOMEINI. INTRODUCTION OF "FREEDOM OF ASSEMBLY BILL" CAUSED UPROAR IN PARLIAMENT LEADING IN WALKOUT OF 30 OPPOSITION DEPUTIES. RASTAKHIZ PARTY BEING DISSOLVED WITH NEW PARTIES EXPECTED TO SHARE ITS FORMER FOLLOWING. 200 UNIVERSITY PROFESSORS CALL FOR END OF MARTIAL LAW.

SHAH'S SPECIAL EMISSARY CONTINUING HIS VISITS TO ARAB CHIEFS OF STATE INQUIRING INTO DISAPPEARANCE OF IMAM MUSA SADR; OPPOSITION ASSOCIATION FOR DEFENSE AND FREEDOM OF HUMAN RIGHTS HAS REPORTEDLY ASKED INTERNATIONAL HUMAN RIGHTS ASSOCIATION IN NEW YORK ALSO TO INVESTIGATE. END SUMMARY.

SERIOUS DEMONSTRATION OCCURRED NIGHT OF OCT 1 IN WEST IRAN TOWN OF KERMANSHAH. ACCORDING TO PRELIMINARY EYE WITNESS REPORTS, MOB WRECKED MOVIE HOUSE, 10 BANKS AND SEVERAL LIQUOR STORES AS WELL AS DAMAGING A HOTEL. KERMANSHAH IS NOT UNDER MARTIAL LAW AND NO CURFEW HAS BEEN IMPOSED UP TO NOW.

UNIDENTIFIED PERSONS SHOT AND KILLED PRECINCT CHIEF OF POLICE COL. ZAMANIPOUR IN MASHAD OCT 1, ALSO KILLING HIS DRIVER. WE HAVE ASKED FOR MORE DETAILS OF GOVERNMENT INVESTIGATION AS TO WHETHER THESE WERE TERRORISTS OR SOMETHING MORE SPECIFICALLY INVOLVING THE VICTIM.

OCT 1 ALSO SAW A MAJOR GOVERNMENT ANNOUNCEMENT CALLING ON ALL IRANIANS LIVING ABROAD, POLITICAL EXILES INCLUDED, TO RETURN HOME. MIN OF STATE FOR EXECUTIVE AFFAIRS AZMOUN CHARACTERIZED THIS DECISION AS GOI DESIRE FOR GENUINE NATIONAL RECONCILIATION.

QUESTIONED BY THE PRESS WHETHER THIS WOULD ALSO APPLY TO AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, HE SAID "ALL POLITICAL EXILES WHO ARE PREPARED TO ACCEPT THE PRINCIPLES OF THE IRANIAN CONSTITUTION FRAMEWORK WILL BE SUPPORTED BY THE GOVERNMENT." ASKED WHETHER THE DECISION APPLIES TO MEMBERS OF THE CONFEDERATION OF IRANIAN STUDENTS ABROAD, AZMOUN SAID IT APPLIES TO ALL POLITICAL EXILES "NO MATTER WHAT THEIR IDEOLOGICAL OR POLITICAL VIEWS MIGHT BE." HE REPORTEDLY ADDED: "IT IS ONLY UNDER SUCH DEMOCRATIC CONDITIONS THAT NATIONAL UNITY AND INTEGRITY WILL MATERALIZE ...

THIS IS WHY WE ANNOUNCE AT THIS CRITICAL MOMENT THAT ALL THOSE STUDENTS WHO HAVE SPENT YEARS OF HARDSHIP ABROAD CAN RETURN HOME WITHOUT ANY FEARS ABOUT THEIR POSSIBLE PROSECUTION." (COMMENT: WELCOME IN ITSELF, WE EXPECT THIS ANNOUNCEMENT WILL NOT BE TAKEN AT FACE VALUE ------------------075101 021318Z /43 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 696 INFO USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY AMMAN AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY TRIPOLI USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 09526 BY MANY OPPONENTS OF THE REGIME.

WE KNOW, HOWEVER, THAT SEVERAL HIGH-RANKING MEMBERS OF THE ESTABLISHMENT HAVE FAVORED SUCH AN APPROACH, EVEN INCLUDING THE RETURN OF KHOMEINI TO IRAN, AS A RISK WORTH RUNNING TO HELP ACHIEVE A NEW NATIONAL CONSENSUS.)

GOI INTRODUCTION OF "FREEDOM OF ASSEMBLY" BILL BEFORE SPECIAL SESSION OF MAJLES OCT 1 DREW IMMEDIATE ATTACK FROM OPPOSITION SPOKESMAN PEZESHKPOUR. JUSTICE MINISTER BAHERI'S DEFENSE OF THE BILL AND ATTACK ON ITS CRITICS BROUGHT WALKOUT OF SOME 30 OPPOSITION DEPUTIES WITH PEZESHKPOUR IN THE LEAD. SOME OF THE DEPUTIES ARE KNOWN TO THE EMBASSY, AND THIS IS THE FIRST INDICATION THAT THEY ARE LINING UP WITH THE PEZESHKPOUR OPPOSITION. OFFICIAL OPENING OF MAJLES IS STILL SCHEDULED FOR NEXT FRIDAY, OCT 6, THOUGH SPECIAL SESSION MIGHT BE RESUMED BEFORE THAT.

DISSOLUTION OF GOVERNMENT RASTAKHIZ (RESURGENCE) PARTY IS NOW FOREGONE CONCLUSION. ITS EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE WILL MEET TOMORROW, OCT 3, TO FORMALIZE THIS FACT. GOVT WILL ASSUME ITS ASSETS EXCEPT FOR PARTY NEWSPAPER WHICH WILL CONTINUE INDEPENDENT EXISTENCE. ITS TWO WINGS ARE ALSO EXPECTED TO DISAPPEAR, WITH MANY MEMBERS BEING ABSORBED INTO NEW PARTIES STILL TO APPEAR. NAHAVANDI IS EXPECTED TO FORM A NEW PARTY, AS IS AZMOUN. WE CONTINUE TO HAVE REPORTS THAT FORMER PARTIES SUCH AS IRAN NOVIN, MARDOM, AND THE IRANIANS PARTY WILL BE REVIVED.

EMBASSY IS IN PROCESS OF ANALYZING SIGNATURES ON PETITION BY SOME 200 UNIVERSITY PROFESSORS ASKING FOR END TO MARTIAL LAW. MEANWHILE, MINISTER OF HIGHER EDUCATION NAHAVANDI APPEARED ON TV TO DEFEND THE NEW UNIVERSITIES BILL, CHALLENGING ITS CRITICS AS NON-REPRESENTATIVE, OF THE VAST MAJORITY OF UNIVERSITY PROFESSORS.

PRESS CONTAINED PUBLICITY ON VISIT TO SYRIAN PRESIDENT ASSAD BY SHAH'S SPECIAL EMISSARY FEREIDOUN MOVASSEQI OCT 1 INQUIRING INTO DISAPPEARANCE OF IMAM MOUSA SADR. THIS FOLLOWS EMISSARY'S VISIT TO KING HUSSEIN. PRESS ALSO REPORTS SHI'ITE LEADER IN EUROPE SAYED MEHDI ROUHANI HAS ASKED PRESIDENT GISCARD D'ESTAING TO ORDER A THOROUGH INVESTIGATION OF IMAM'S DISAPPEARANCE. IN TEHRAN, ASSOCIATION FOR DEFENSE OF FREEDOM AND HUMAN RIGHTS (WHICH IS ASSOCIATED WITH NATIONAL FRONT OPPOSITION) ASKED INTERNATIONAL ASSOCIATION OF HUMAN RIGHTS IN NEW YORK TO SET UP COMMITTEE TO PROBE SAME PROBLEM.

1978TEHRAN09563.subject: POSSIBLE SOVIET MOVE TO REUNIFY AZERBAIJAN

segments.text: DURING CONVERSATION WITH PRIME MINISTER REPORTED SEPTEL, HE TOLD BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND ME THAT, IN CONSEQUENCE OF RECENT SOVIET MEETING IN BAKU, A "COMMITTEE" HAD BEEN ESTABLISHED IN THE SOVIET UNION TO PRESS FOR REUNIFICATION OF AZERBAIJAN. HE INTERPRETED THIS AS RESUMPTION OF OVERT SOVIET EFFORT TO GRAB OFF PIECE OF IRANIAN TERRITORY.
WOULD APPRECIATE WASHINGTON OR MOSCOW COMMENT ON THIS REPORT, AS WELL AS ANY INFORMATION ON STATEMENTS CONCERNING AZERBAIJAN WHICH MAY HAVE EMANATED FROM BAKU CONGRESS.

DURING DISCUSSION OCTOBER 2 WITH PRIME MINISTER SHARIF-EMAMI REPORTED SEPTEL, HE TOLD BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND ME THAT HIS GOVT HAD BEEN IN CONTACT WITH IMAM MUSA SADR SHORTLY BEFORE LATTER'S DISAPPEARANCE IN LIBYA. HE CLAIMED THAT MUSA SADR HAD AGREED TO BREAK WITH AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI AND ANNOUNCE HIS SUPPORT FOR THE SHAH. AT ONE POINT, HE USED THE PHRASE "WE HAD BROUGH HIM OFF."

IF THE WILY IMAM HAD INDEED MADE A DEAL WITH THE GOI, WHILE AT THE SAME TIME ALLEGEDLY ACTING AS A CHANNEL FOR LIBYAN FUNDS BEING SENT TO KHOMEINI, THIS FACT COULD BE A CONTRIBUTING ELEMENT IN HIS DISAPPEARANCE. I WOULD IMAGINE THAT COLONEL QADDAFI DOES NOT APPRECIATE BEING DOUBLE-CROSSED.

LOCAL WIRE SERVICE REPORTER TELLS US THAT IRAQI EMBASSY HERE HAS DENIED TO HIM IT IS HOLDING KHOMEINI UNDER ANY SORT OF ARREST. MEASURES TAKEN AROUND KHOMEINI'S HOUSE WERE FOR HIS OWN SECURITY. IRAQI GOVT WAS WORRIED ABOUT LARGE NUMBERS OF PEOPLE GOING IN AND OUT OF HIS HOUSE.

HOWEVER, IN VIEW OF KHOMEINI'S OBJECTIONS, IRAQI AUTHORITIES REMOVED ARMED GUARDS. KHOMEINI SPECIFICALLY ASSUMED RESPONSIBILITY FOR HIS OWN SAFETY, WITH OWN GUARDS. NEVERTHELESS, IRAQIS KEEP SOME PLAINCLOTHESMEN AROUND TO WATCH SITUATION.

ABOVE MAY BE BEHIND AFP STORY OCT 2 FROM PARIS QUOTING COMMITTEE FOR DEFENSE OF HUMAN RIGHTS IN IRAN AS SAYING RESTRICTIONS IMPOSED ON AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI IN NAJAF HAVE BEEN LIFTED. THIS STORY APPEARS TO BE DEFUSING LOCAL EMOTIONS FOR THE MOMENT.
AEOI'S DR. HASHEMIAN HAS REQUESTED DETAILED BREAKDOWN OF COSTS UNDER SUBJECT TRAINING PROGRAM FOR MONTHLY STATEMENTS RECEIVED DURING SEPTEMBER.

IN ACCORDANCE WITH ARTICLE 8 OF THE AGREEMENT, "MONTHLY INVOICES SUBMITTED BY ORAU WILL BE ACCOMPANIED BY AN ITEMIZATION OF EXPENSES". SINCE "AEOI SHALL PAY INVOICES DIRECTLY TO ORAU WITHIN THIRTY CALENDAR DAYS OF RECEEIPT", ALSO PER ARTICLE 8, DETAILS ARE NEEDED BY AEOI ASAP.

AEIO SUGGESTS DETAILED BREAKDOWN OF COSTS CONSISTENT WITH ANNEX II (BUDGET) ITEMS 1 THROUGH 5 TO THE AGREEMENT. ALSO, PLEASE EXPLAIN MONTHLY FLUCTUATIONS ON SAME ITEMS; FOR EXAMPLE, PROGRAM MANAGER AND INSTRUCTION COSTS VARIED SIGNIFICANTLY FROM ONE MONTH TO THE NEXT.
AEOI HAS EMPHASIZED TO EMBASSY THE INCREASED NEED FOR DETAIL IN DOCUMENTING PAYMENTS UNDER ALL ITS CONTRACTS, IN PAST, DUE TO RECENT EVENTS.
GOI HAS REQUESTED USG APPROVAL TO TRANSFER MAIN SPARE PARTS FOR THE AN/GRC-9 AND AN/PRC-6, 8, 9, AND 10 RADIOS TO THE GOVT OF PAKISTAN (GOP).
DETAILS OF THE REQUESTED TRANSFER ARE PROVIDED BELOW COUNTRY PROPOSING TO MAKE THE TRANSFER IS GOVT OF IRAN.

REQUEST IS FOR TRANSFER OF RADIO SPARE PARTS AS FOLLOWS: 14 LINE ITEMS FOR THE AN/GRC-9 RADIO AND 43 LINE ITEMS FOR THE AN/PRC-6, 8, 9, AND 10 RADIOS. CONDITIONS OF SPARE PARTS UNKNOWN BUT ASSUMED TO BE SERVICABLE. CURRENT ESTIMATED VALUE FROM THE ARMY MASTER DATA FILE IS AN/GRC-9: DOLS 25 THOUSAND AND AN/PRC 6, 8, 9, AND 19: DOLS 35 THOUSAND. TOTAL ESTIMATED VALUE THIS REQUESTED TRANSFER IS DOLS 60 THOUSAND.
PROPOSED RECIPIENT IS THE PAKISTAN ARMY.
REASON FOR THE PROPOSED TRANSFER IS ASSISTANCE TO CENTO COUNTRY.
TRANSFER DESIREF ASAP.
RECOMMEND APPROVAL OF PROPOSED TRANSFER.

SUMMARY: UNREST INCREASED SEPT 30-OCT 1; PRESS REPORTS SIX KILLED. OPPOSITION CONTINUES TO CRITICIZE DRAFT "FREEDOM OF ASSEMBLY" BILL; GOI IS CONCILIATORY REGARDING AMENDMENTS TO UNIVERSITIES BILL. "UNITY FOR FREEDOM" PARTY TO SEEK MEMBERSHIP IN SOCIALIST INTERNATIONAL. EDITOR FREED ON BAIL. PROSECUTOR REVERSES ROLE, URGES CASE AGAINST 18 STUDENTS BE THROWN OUT.

NUMBER OF SOURCES HERE, INCLUDING AMERICAN CITIZENS IN OUTLYING TOWNS, REPORT GREATER NUMBER OF SECURITY INCIDENTS SEPT 30-OCT 1 THAN EVEN PRESS HAS COVERED. REF A NOTED ASSASSINATION OF LOCAL POLICE CHIEF IN MASHAD AND DEMONSTRATION IN KERMANSHAH, THE MOST SERIOUS MANIFESTATION. PRESS MORNING OCT. 3 INCLUDED OTHER CITIES--REZAIYEH, DOUROUND, ZANJAN, AND HAMADAN--IN LIST OF PLACES WHERE VIOLENCE OCCURRED LAST SUNDAY AND LISTED SIX DEAD AND ABOUT 30 WOUNDED. IN THESE TOWNS, DEMONSTRATORS PROTESTING IRAQI TREATMENT OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI USED BOMBS AND GRENADES. ELSEWHERE THERE WERE DEMONSTRATIONS, BUT THEY REMAINED PEACEFUL IN DEZFUL, MAHABAD, SHAHABAD, GARB AND BANEH.

POLICE SOURCES REPORT DEMONSTRATIONS IN MANY OTHER TOWNS, PERHAPS INCLUDING SOME ADDITIONAL VIOLENCE. INCIDENTS RELATED TO PROBLEMS CONCERNING KHOMEINI, AND SITUATION MAY ABATE A BIT WITH MEDIA REPORTS THAT COMMITTEE FOR THE DEFENSE OF HUMAN RIGHTS IN IRAN (CDHRF) ANNOUNCED IN PARIS THAT RESTRICTIONS ON KHOMEINI HAD BEEN LIFTED. (ENT: EVENTS OF LAST FEW DAYS SHOW OPPOSITION STILL HAS CAPACITY TO MOUNT EFFORT IN STREETS IF IT WISHES TO DO SO AND IS WILLING TO PAY PRICE. DEMONSTRATIONS SUNDAY OCCURRED ONLY IN CITIES NOT UNDER MARTIAL LAW, HOWEVER. IN MARTIAL LAW CITIES, ACTION WAS LIMITED TO SHOP CLOSURES.)

PRESS MORNING OCT. 2 CARRIED STRONG CRITICISM OF GOVERNMENT "FREEDOM OF ASSEMBLY" BILL BY OPPOSITION LEADERS AS WELL AS STRONG EDITORIAL OPPOSING RESTRICTIVE PROVISIONS OF BILL IN KEYHAN INTERNATIONAL. NATIONAL FRONT (NFI) LEADER SANJABI IS QUOTED AS SAYING BILL SHOULD BE CALLED LIMITED ASSEMBLY BILL AND IS CONTRARY TO CONSTITUTION. SANJABI CLAIMS GOVERNMENT HAS NO RIGHT TO RESTRICT FREEDOM OF POLITICAL ASSOCIATIONS AND MEETINGS-ONLY CORTS HAVE RIGHT TO DO SO. FORMER PRIME MINISTER ALI AMINI ATTACKED BILL IN SIMILAR VEIN. NFI EXECUTIVE BOARD MEMBER SHAPOUR BAKHTIAR SAID NO POLITICAL PARTY NEEDS PERMISSION TO ORGANIZE, AND MINISTRY OF INTERIOR HAS NO RIGHT (AS BILL WOULD GIVE IT) TO DISSOLVE POLITICAL PARTIES.
