GOI HAS BEEN MORE CONCILIATORY TO PARLIAMENTARY OPPOSITION IN PAST 24 HOURS.

MINISTER OF JUSTICE BAHERI OFFERED IMPLICIT APOLOGY TO MAJLES IN TV INTERVIEW WHICH HAS SOOTHED SOME RUFFLED FEATHERS, BUT NOT BEFORE 63 MEMBERS OF PARLIAMENT JOINED 30 WHO WALKED OUT OCT 1 (REF A). MORE DIRECT APOLOGY TO PARLIAMENT IS BEING DEMANDED BY DEPUTIES IN CLOSED MAJLES MEETING TODAY. MINISTER OF SCIENCE AND HIGHER EDUCATION NAHAVANDI HAS ANNOUNCED UNIVERSITY INDEPENDENCE BILL WILL BE CHANGED, AND EMBASSY HAS LEARNED PRIVATELY THAT NAHAVANDI'S INTENT IS TO BRING TOGETHER UNIVERSITY REPRESENTATIVES TO "REVISE" BILL, PROBABLY BEGINNING SOMETIME NEXT WEEK. AT MOMENT, THIS SUBJECT AMONG OTHERS IS BEING DISCUSSED AT MEETING OF UNIVERSITY CHANCELLORS IN TEHRAN.

IN PHONE CALL FROM ROME, WHERE HE HAS BEEN ATTENDING "NON-COMMUNIST IRANIAN STUDENTS CONGRESS", MAJLES DEPUTY BANI-AHMAD ANNOUNCED HIS UNITY FOR FREEDOM PARTY WILL APPLY FOR MEMBERSHIP IN THE SOCIALIST INTERNATIONAL.
EDITOR OF "RANGIN KAMAN" MAGAZINE, DR. MOHAMMAD HOSSEIN MAYMANDI NEJAD, WAS FREED ON BAIL OCT. 1. HE HAD BEEN ARRESTED ABOUT TWO WEEKS AGO ON CHARGES OF DEFAMING THE RELIGIOUS COMMUNITY.

A TEHRAN DEPUTY PROSECUTOR SWITCHED SIDES DURING A TRIAL OCT 1 AND CALLED FOR COURT TO RELEASE 18 STUDENTS FROM TEHRAN'S UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY WHO WERE ARRESTED IN JANUARY FOR DEMONSTRATING ILLEGALLY. PROSECUTOR CLAIMED EVIDENCE WAS INCONSISTENT AND INSUFFICIENT FOR CONVICTION, AND STUDENTS HAD BEEN "VICTIMS" OF PREVIOUS GOI WHICH HAD KEPT PEOPLE IN THE DARK. (COMMENT: ASIDE FROM NOVELTY OF POLITICAL ATTACK AGAINST GOI, THIS CASE IS ONE OF SEVERAL WE HAVE BEEN TOLD HAVE SHAKY LEGAL OR EVIDENTIARY BASIS, RESULTING IN ACQUITTALS OR MUCH LIGHTER SENTENCES THAN WOULD HAVE BEEN THE CASE A YEAR OR TWO AGO.) SULLIVAN

EMBASSY APPROACHED AEOI'S MANZOOR ON 2 OCT WITH RESPECT TO DELETING WORDS "NUCLEAR ARMS" IN ACCORDANCE WITH PARA 2 REF A. DEPT REQUEST FOR DELETION OF THESE WORDS WILL BE CONVEYED BY MANZOOR ALONG WITH ALL OTHER POINTS, AS AGREED TO IN REF A, BY LETTER TO LEGAL OFFICE OF FOREIGN MINISTRY.

SINCE WE DO NOT YET KNOW WHETHER GOI IS PREPARED TO AGREE TO REQUESTED DELETION, EMBASSY HAS NOT VOLUNTEERED ALTERNATIVE PERSIAN WORDING OF PARA 2 REF A AT THIS TIME, FOR GOI CONSIDERATION. EMBASSY HAS BEEN SENSITIVE TO AND AWARE OF KEY REASON (FYI IN PARA 14 OF REF C) FOR PREFERRED DELETION, AND CONSEQUENTLY WILL NOT PROPOSE THE ALTERNATIVE PERSIAN WORDING UNLESS DICTATED BY AN AEOI RESPONSE TO OUR REQUEST.

LINE OF REASONING FOR DELETION OF WORDS "NUCLEAR ARMS" WAS EXPLAINED BY SCIATT TO MANZOOR BY NOTING THAT NON-PROLIFERATION IS REFERRED TO SEVERAL TIMES IN NOTE WITHOUT BEING MODIFIED BY WORDS "NUCLEAR ARMS" OR SIMILAR CONCEPT. MANZOOR SEES A DISTINCTION IN USAGE OF THE TERM "NON-PROLIFERATION" IN PERSIAN, ON PAGES 1 AND 2 OF NOTE, AS THESE RELATE (PRESUMABLY) TO DISCUSSION OF NPT. MANZOOR STATES THAT IF ONLY "GHOSTARESH" IS USED PER PAGE 4 OF NOTE, ITEM C, LINE 1, IT STILL HAS NO REAL MEANING.

ACIATT ASKED IF FOREIGN MINISTRY MIGHT CONSIDER TOTAL SUBSTANCE OF NOTE AND BY SO DOING AGREE THAT THE INFERRED MEANING FOR THIS TERM "NON-PROLIFERATION" ON PAGE 4 IS AS DEFINITIVE AS THAT USED ON PAGES 1 AND 2. MANZOOR SAID THAT THIS IS THE APPROACH HE WILL USE IN TRANSMITTING THIS REQUEST TO THE FOREIGN MINISTRY.

PLANNED EVENT SEQUENCE AS EXPLAINED BY MANZOOR FOR STEPS REMAINING PRIOR TO SIGNING AGREEMENT FOLLOWS: (A) HE WILL INCORPORATE ALL THE CHANGES AND CORRECTIONS TO THE PERSIAN TEXT IN A LETTER TO THE FOREIGN MINISTRY AND SEEK THEIR ARRPOVAL; (B) THE FOREIGN MINISTRY IS EXPECTED TO APPROVE THE CHANGES; (C) MANZOOR WILL GIVE THE EMBASSY CORRECTED FINAL PERSIAN TEXT FOR TRANSMITTAL TO DEPT AND ASK WHEN IT WILL BE CONVENIENT FOR THE U.S. TO SIGN THE AGREEMENT.

1978TEHRAN09617.subject: UNIVERSITY DISTURBANCES AHEAD SUMMARY: UNIVERSITIES ARE STILL OFFICIALLY SCHEDULED TO OPEN OCT 7, BUT MANY SECTIONS OF THE MORE IMPORTANT, LA

segments.text: SUMMARY: UNIVERSITIES ARE STILL OFFICIALLY SCHEDULED TO OPEN OCT 7, BUT MANY SECTIONS OF THE MORE IMPORTANT, LARGER ONES ARE EXPECTED TO SHUT AGAIN THEREAFTER. SOME WILL DELAY OPENING. MANY OF THE MORE SERIOUS STUDENTS ARE SEEKING TRANSFERS ABROAD. FACULTY AND ADMINISTRATORS--SEVERAL OF THE LATTER NEW TO THEIR JOBS--ARE CAUTIOUS IN THE FACE OF UNCERTAINTY AS TO HOW MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES WILL DEAL WITH STUDENTS ON CAMPUS AND THE IMPONDERABLES OF THE FUTURE AS POLITICAL LIBERALIZATION LUMBERS ON. FACULTY OPPOSITION TO MINISTER NAHAVANDI'S NEW UNIVERSITIES ORGANIZATION BILL ADDS TO DISARRAY AMONG THE ADMINISTRATORS.

IT IS CLEAR THAT THIS YEAR WILL SEE MORE STUDENT UNREST THAN EVEN LAST YEAR, WITH THE STUDENTS OPENLY TIED TO THE DISSIDENT BEHAVIOR OF MANY OF THEIR ELDERS IN THE POLITICO-RELIGIOUS ARENA BEYOND THE CAMPUS. DATES WHEN FURTHER TROUBLE CAN BE EXPECTED WILL OCCUR IN OCTOBER AND IN THE INTENSELY RELIGIOUS MONTHS THAT COINCIDE WITH DECEMBER AND JANUARY. END SUMMARY

THE SHARIF-EMAMI GOVERNMENT POSTPONED OPENING OF IRAN'S UNIVERSITIES BY TWO WEEKS TO OCT 7. THIS IS STILL THE OFFICIALLY SCHEDULED DATE, THOUGH MOST OF OUR CONTACTS FAMILIAR WITH THE SITUATION EXPECT THE MAJOR SCHOOLS WITHIN MANY OF THE MORE IMPORTANT UNIVERSITIES TO CLOSE ALMOST IMMEDIATELY AFTER THEY OPEN. SOME ARE DELAYING THEIR OPENING. RECENT INCIDENTS SUCH AS STUDENT INTERFERENCE WITH EXAMINATIONS FOR LAST SPRING'S UNFINISHED TERM AND OTHER STUDENT DEMONSTRATIONS INDICATE STUDENTS ACTIVISTS ARE IN NO MOOD FOR QUIET RETURN TO A YEAR OF STUDY.

WHILE LITTLE OF THE CAMPUS UNREST HAS REACHED THE IRANIAN PRESS, THE MOOD OF THE STUDENTS IS WELL UNDERSTOOD BY FACULTY, ADMINISTRATORS, PARENTS AND OTHERS WITH AN INTEREST IN UNIVERSITY AFFAIRS. MANY OF THE MORE SERIOUS STUDENTS ARE TRYING TO LEAVE THE COUNTRY AND REGISTER IN UNIVERSITIES ABROAD SO AS NOT TO RISK LOSING STILL ANOTHER ACADEMIC YEAR.

THEIR ABILITY TO ORGANIZE SUCH A TRANSFER MAY BE COMPLICATED SOMEWHAT BY THE GREAT UPSURGE IN APPLICATIONS FOR STUDY ABROAD WHICH IS EXPECTED AS A RESULT OF GOI'S ANNOUNCEMENT THAT IT WILL NO LONGER ADMINISTER A QUALIFYING EXAMINATION BEFORE PERMITTING STUDENTS TO APPLY FOR FOREIGN STUDY. ------------------070348 072120Z /66 R 040805Z OCT 78 ZDK FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 749 CIA WASHDC DIA WASHDC INFO USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY AMMAN AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY ATHENS AMEMBASSY BONN AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY DAMASCUS AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY TEL AVIV USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC SECTION 2 OF 3 TEHRAN 9617

THE SITUATION IN SPECIFIC UNIVERSITIES IS FAIRLY MURKY, AS FACULTY AND ADMINISTRATORS THEMSELVES ARE UNWILLING TO PREDICT SPECIFIC EXTENT OF STUDENT VIOLENCE GIVEN A NUMBER OF UNKNOWNS. FOR EXAMPLE, IT IS NOW KNOWN TO WHAT EXTENT MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES WILL INTERVENE ON CAMPUSES-AS THEY ARE CERTAIN TO DO OFF CAMPUSES-TO PREVENT STUDENT VIOLENCE IN TEHRAN AND THE 11 OTHER CITIES PRESENTLY UNDER MARTIAL LAW. SO FAR, THEY HAVE NOT INTERVENED IN THE INCIDENTS WE HAVE HEARD ABOUT, WHICH INVOLVED QUICK ACTION BY ONLY A FEW HUNDRED STUDENTS AT A TIME WHO DISPERSED WITHIN ONLY A FEW MINUTES.

GIVEN THE GOI POLICY OF LIBERALIZATION AND THE UNCERTAINTY AS TO HOW MUCH FREEDOM WILL BE PERMITTED POLITICAL PARTIES, MANY FACULTY MEMBERS AND ADMINISTRATORS ARE RELUCTANT TO APPEAR REPRESSIVE VIAS-A-VIS THE STUDENTS LEST THEY BE TAGGED AS PARTISANS OF THE PAST.

THE SITUATION IS FURTHER COMPLICATED BY RECENT CHANGES IN MANY TOP CHANCELLORSHIPS IN TEHRAN AND ELSEWHERE. IT IS USUAL IN IRAN THAT SUCH CHANGES INVOLVE FURTHER CHANGES OF SUBORDINATES. THIS HAS NOT SO FAR HAPPENED TO ANY GREAT DEGREE BUT MANY OF THE UNIVERSITY CHANCELLORS AND OTHER ADMINISTRATORS ARE CONSCIOUS OF WALKING ON EGGS AND ARE NOT LIKELY TO STICK THEIR NECKS OUT. THE WAVE OF CHANGES IS ASCRIBED TO MINISTER OF SCIENCE AND HIGH EDUCATION NAHAVANDI WHO IS SAID TO BE MAKING A GRAB FOR WIDER POWER WITH THESE APPOINTMENTS.

HOWEVER, NAHAVANDI AND HIS "GROUP FOR THE STUDY OF IRANIAN PROBLEMS" ARE NO MORE MONOLITHIC THAN ANY GROUP THAT TRIES TO ORGANIZE ACADEMICS ANYWHERE IN THE WORLD. IT IS CLEAR THERE IS OPPOSITION TO NAHAVANDI'S LEADERSHIP EVEN WITHIN HIS "STUDY GROUP," NOT TO MENTION THE JEALOUSY FROM AMONG ACADEMICS WHO ARE NOT HAPPY WITH HIS RAPID RISE TO PROMINENCE. THUS, EVEN THOUGH CONSIDERED PERSONALLY AN ABLE MAN, IT IS NOT CLEAR TO WHAT EXTENT NAHAVANDI WILL SUCCEED IN WIDENING THE APPEAL OF HIS "GROUP" AS A LARGER POLITICAL PARTY.

THE GOI'S NEW BILL ADVERTISED AS ASSURING INDEPENDENCE AND AUTONOMY TO THE VARIOUS UNIVERSITIES HAS COME UNDER STEADY ATTACK FROM MANY ACADEMICS WHO ANALYZE IT AS IN FACT CONTINUING THE SUBORDINATION OF UNIVERSITIES TO THE GOVERNMENT. FACULTY MEMBERS OBJECT THAT IT DOES NOT PROVIDE FOR THEIR DIRECT PARTICIPATION IN ELECTION OF UNIVERSITY CHANCELLORS. ADMINISTRATORS OBJECT TO THE VERY PROCEDURE OF INTRODUCING A DRAFT BILL WITHOUT SUFFICIENT CONSULTATION OR CONSENSUS BEHIND IT. NAHAVANDI IS PUTTING UP A GOOD FIGHT IN DEFENDING HIS OWN GOOD INTENTIONS AND SHOWING A READINESS TO MODIFY THE BILL AS NECESSARY.
IT LOOKS AS IF BROAD CONSULTATION AND JOINT DRAFTING WITH ALL THE UNIVERSITIES INVOLVED IS LIKELY TO BE THE NEXT STEP.

MEANWHILE, THE BILL HAS INCREASED THE ALREADY CONSIDERABLE DISARRAY AMONG FACULTIES AND ADMINISTRATORS EXISTING ON THE EVE OF UNIVERSITY OPENING. ------------------127144 060430Z /21 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 759 CIA WASHDC DIA WASHDC INFO USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY AMMAN AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY ATHENS AMEMBASSY BONN AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY DAMASCUS AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY TEL AVIV USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC SECTION 3 OF 3 TEHRAN 9617

THIS IS NOT TO SAY THAT SOME UNIVERSITIES, PARTICULARLY ELSEWHERE THAN IN TEHRAN, MAY NOT BE ABLE TO FUNCTION IN REASONABLY ORDERLY FASHION. INDEED SOME OF THE SMALLER COLLGES IN TEHRAN HAVE ALREADY OPENED AND EXPECT LITTLE TROUBLE UNLESS THE NATIONAL POLITICAL SITUATION FURTHER DETERIORATES SIGNIFICANTLY. SEVERAL UNIVERSITIES ELSEWHERE, HOWEVER, ARE ALSO LOATED IN CITIES WHERE RELIGIOUS UNREST IS STRONG (MASHAD, TABRIZ, ISFAHAN, EVEN SHIRA) AND THAT FACTOR IN ITSELF WILL PROBABLY OPERATE TO CREATE SUFFICIENT HAVOC IN THE STUDENT BODY SO THAT EDUCATION WILL PROCEED LAMELY WHEN IT PROCEEDS AT ALL.

SOME GRADUATE STUDENTS ARE LIKELY TO CONTINUE THEIR INDIVIDUAL STUDIES AS THEY DID LAST YEAR IN THE WAKE OF STUDENT DISTURBANCES, BUT THE VAST MAJORITY OF UNDERGRADUATES IN THE COUNTRY'S MAJOR UNIVERSITIES WILL BE THE FIRST AFFECTED BY DISLOCATION AND DISTURBANCES.

ALL IN ALL, WE FORESEE A YEAR FRAUGHT WITH EVEN MORE DISLOCATION THAN LAST YEAR. THIS TIME THE CONNECTION BETWEEN UNIVERSITY DISSIDENCE AND THE POLITICAL AND RELIGIOUS OPPOSITION OF THEIR ELDERS IS MUCH MORE OPEN. THERE IS LITTLE CHANCE OF THE GOI DEALING WITH UNIVERSITY PROBELMS SEPARATELY FROM THE LARGER PROBLEMS OF POLITICAL DISSIDENCE AND OPPOSITIONIST ACTIVITY IN THE SOCIETY AT LARGE.

OF COURSE THE OPENING OF UNIVERSITIES OCT 7 IS ONLY THE FIRST OF SEVERAL POSSIBLE "HOT" DAYS HERE IN THE NEAR FUTURE. 40TH DAY AFTER SEPT 8 JALEH SQUARE DEATHS FALLS ON TUESDAY, OCT 17 AND COULD BE MOVED BACK TO THURSDAY, OCT 19 OR FORWARD TO ABOUT OCT 15 ACCORDING TO VARIOUS REPORTS. ANY DEATHS THAT MIGHT RESULT FROM THAT COMMEMORATION WOULD THEMSELVES CREATER FURTHER THIRD AND FORTIETH DAY COMMEMORATIONS. THE LATTER WOULD FALL IN THE HOLY MONTH OF MOHARRAM (THIS YEAR IN DECEMBER), WHICH WOULD PROVIDE MANY OPPORTUNITIES FOR THE GATHERED FAITHFUL TO MANIFEST ACTIVE DISCONTENT. IT WILL BE FOLLOWED BY SAFAR, ANOTHER HOLY MONTH AFFORDING FURTHER OPPORTUNITIES.

(WHILE WE CANNOT RULE OUT THE POSSIBILITY OF POLITICALLY INSPIRED VIOLENCE ON THE SHAH'S BIRTHDAY OCT 26 OR EVEN THAT OF HIS SON OCT 31, THIS IS LESS LIKELY SINCE THE SHAH HAS ANNOUNCED NO PUBLIC CELEBRATION OF THOSE OCCASIONS, THE FUNDS TO BE USED FOR ASSISTANCE TO THE VICTIMS OF THE TABAS EARTHQUAKE INSTEAD.)

WHEN BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND I RETURNED TO PRIME MINISTER SHARIF-EMAMI AT NOON OCTOBER 4 TO CARRY OUT OUR INSTRUCTIONS RE AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, SHARIF-EMAMI BEGAN CONVERSATION BY READING FROM REPORT OF SAVAK EMISSARY WHO HAD MET WITH CHIEF OF IRAQI SECURITY IN BAGHDAD OCTOBER 3. ACCORDING TO THAT REPORT, IRAQ WAS FED UP WITH KHOMEINI AND PREFERRED TO HAVE HIM OUT OF COUNTRY. HOWEVER, THEY REALIZED SENSITIVITY OF LETTING HIM RETURN TO IRAN. THEREFORE, IRAQ SECURITY CHIEF AGREED TO BRING MATTER BEFORE MEETING OF REVOLUTIONARY COMMAND COUNCIL THAT EVENING.

SHARIF-EMAMI SAID THAT NEXT WORD HE RECEIVED WAS MESSAGE AT MIDNIGHT FROM KUWAIT REPORTING THAT KHOMEINI AND SMALL GROUP OF HIS FOLLOWERS HAD JUST ARRIVED IN KUWAIT BY AUTOMOBILE. IRAQIS SUBSEQUENTLY HAVE CONFIRMED THAT HE HAD LEFT "OF HIS OWN VOLITION" AND SAID THEY THOUGHT HE WAS EN ROUTE TO SYRIA RATHER THAN TO IRAN.

PRIME MINISTER SAID SHAH BECAME MOST AGITATED WHEN HE RECEIVED THIS NEWS, PARTICULARLY BECAUSE IT COINCIDED WITH DISTRIBUTION OF LEAFLETS IN TEHRAN CALLING FOR GENERAL STRIKE THROUGHOUT COUNTRY ON OCTOBER 6 AND 7. SHAH REPORTEDLY FEELS KHOMEINI PLANS TO PRECIPITATE SUCH A STRIKE AND THEN RETURN IN THE ACCOMPANYING CONFUSION.

ACCORDING TO PRIME MINISTER, SHAH HAS TAKEN FIRM DECISION THAT KHOMEINI SHOULD BE IMMEDIATELY ARRESTED IF HE RE-ENTERS IRAN. GOVT WOULD THEN HAVE TO FACE THE CONSEQUENCES OF "INCIPIENT CIVIL WAR." PRIME MINISTER HAD DOUBTS THAT AN EFFECTIVE GENERAL STRIKE COULD BE CALLED THIS WEEKEND, BECAUSE GOVT HAD RECENTLY SETTLED "ABOUT FIFTY" INDUSTRIAL AND SERVICE STRIKES TO SATISFACTION OF WORKERS.

BRITISH AMBASSADOR SAID THAT UK AND US INSTRUCTIONS HAD BOTH INDICATED THAT OUR PREFERENCE HAD BEEN THAT KHOMEINI REMAIN IN IRAQ. HOWEVER, SINCE HE HAD ALREADY CROSSED TO KUWAIT, IT WAS NOW IMPERATIVE THAT HE STAY THERE OR ELSE MOVE ON TO SOME DESTINATION OTHER THAN IRAN. PRIME MINISTER AGREED AND SAID HE WOULD SEEK AUTHORITY FROM SHAH TO HAVE IRANIAN AMBASSADOR IN KUWAIT ASK KUWAITI AUTHORITIES TAKE APPROPRIATE ACTION. HE ASKED IF UK AND US WOULD BE WILLING TO SECOND THIS REQUEST TO THE KUWAITIS. WE BOTH SAID WE WOULD ASK OUR GOVTS AND FELT SURE THEY WOULD AGREE.
I ALSO SUGGESTED IRANIANS ASK SAUDIS TO WEIGH IN AS WELL. PRIME MINISTER SAID HE WOULD PROPOSE THIS TO SHAH.

PRIME MINISTER THEN WENT ON TO SAY THAT IRAN WOULD HAVE NO PARTICULAR OBJECTION IF KHOMEINI WERE TO GO TO SYRIA. IN ANTICIPATION OF THIS POSSIBILITY, HE HAD MADE SOME MOVES TO PREPARE FOR "A DEAL" WITH SYRIANS. HE SAID A SYRIAN MINISTER HAD ARRIVED IN TEHRAN SEEKING FINANCIAL AID. HE HAD INSTRUCTED FOREIGN MINISTRY TO KEEP HIM ON THE STRING IN CASE IT MIGHT BE WISE TO PUSH A LITTLE MONEY TO DAMASCUS IN RETURN FOR UNDERSTANDINGS ABOUT THE TREATMENT OF KHOMEINI.

THIS OFFICIAL HAS NO KNOWLEDGE OF ANY BOUNDARY AGREEMENT WITH PAKISTAN ON JULY 25, 1963 AND CAN FIND NO MENTION OF SUCH AN AGREEMENT IN HIS REFERENCE MATERIALS. IF DEPT HAS FURTHER INFORMATION BEYOND THAT PROVIDED STATE 127023 WE CAN ASK AGAIN. HOWEVER, MFA OFFICIAL DID SAY PRESENT SITUATION ON THE BORDER IS THAT IRANIAN INDIVIDUALS WHO OWN LAND ON PAKISTANI SIDE AND PAKISTANIS WHO OWN LAND ON IRANIAN SIDE ARE PERMITTED TO CROSS OVER AND CULTIVATE THEIR LAND. THIS PROCEDURE RUNS SOMEWHAT CONTRARY TO 1931 LAW IN IRAN WHICH CALLED FOR PHASING OUT FOREIGN-OWNED AGRICULTURAL PROPERTIES.
INDIVIDUALS ARE PERMITTED TO SELL OR OTHERWISE TRANSFER THEIR OWNINGS BUT APPARENTLY MANY OF THEM HAVE CHOSEN NOT TO DO THIS. MFA IS CONSCIOUS OF NO PROBLEMS IN ADMINISTERING THIS ARRANGEMENT.

1978TEHRAN09667.subject: FURTHER REACTION OF SHAH TO CAMP DAVID ON DAY OF HIS DEPARTURE AT CONCLUSION OF TOUR, URI LUBRANI OF ISRAELI MISSION WAS CALLED FOR FAREWELL MEETING

segments.text: ON DAY OF HIS DEPARTURE AT CONCLUSION OF TOUR, URI LUBRANI OF ISRAELI MISSION WAS CALLED FOR FAREWELL MEETING WITH SHAH. UBRANI HAD NOT REQUESTED AUDICENCE ACCORDING TO ISRAELI OFFICIAL. SHAH CONGRATULATED ISRAELI GOVERNMENT FOR ITS DECISIONS AT CAMP DAVID AND NOTED THAT AGREEMENTS WERE VERY IMPORTANT STEPS TOWARDS PEACE BUT "ONLY A BEGINNING." HE INDICATED CONSIDERABLE IRRITATION THAT KING HUSSEIN, WHO HAS BEEN SEEING WIDE VARIETY OF INTERESTED PARTIES, HAS NOT BEEN IN TOUCH WITH HIM RE CAMP DAVID.

MAJLIS COULD BE RE-ELECTED IN AN HONESTLY FREE ELECTION. HE SAID THESE DEPUTIES HAD LOCAL ROOTS AND COULD COUNT ON THEIR CONSTITUENCIES. HE FELT IT WOULD BE UNWISE TO TRY TO ORGANIZE MASS NATIONAL PARTIES BEFORE JUNE BECUASE THERE WAS NOT TIME. DEPUTIES COULD RUN AS SPLINTER GROUPS OR AS INDEPENDENTS, AND A PRO-SHAH PARLIAMENT WOULD BE ELECTED. ------------------005604 051052Z /21 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 781 INFO AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY LONDON SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 9689 LIMDIS

AFTER THAT HURDEL HAD BEEN CLEARED, HE FELT THE VARIOUS DEPUTIES COULD GET TOFETHER AND COALESCE AROUND A GOVT WITH A SUBSTANTIAL MAJORITY SUPPORT. I WAS HARD TO SAY WHO THE PRIME MINISTER WOULD BE, BUT HOVEYDA SEEMED TO HINT THAT SAEED WAS HIS FAVORITE. IN SUCH A SITUATION, THERE WOULD PROBABLY BE AN OPPOSITION TO THE GOVT INTHE MAJLIS OF NEARLY ONE HUNDERED, PERHAPS HALF OF WHOM WOULD BE ESSENTIALLY ANTI-SHAH. HE FELT THE SHAH WOULD BE ABLE TO LEARN TO LIVE WITH THIS SORT OF SITUATION.

IF, INSTEAD, HE INSISTED ON TRYING TO FORM A PRO-SHAH PARTY IN ADVANCE OF ELECTIONS, THE CHANGES ARE THAT, IN FREE ELECTIONS, THERE WOULD BE AN ANTI-SHAH MAJORITY IN THE MAJLIS AND WE WOULD HAVE 1953 ALL OVER AGAIN.

I ASKED HOVEYDA IF HE HAD PUT ALL THIS TO THE SHAH. HE SAID HE HAD NOT, BECUASE THE SHAH WAS NOT YET PREPARED TO THINK IN THESE TERMS. I ASKED IF HE WOULD OBJECT TO MY DISCUSSING IT WITH THE SHAH AND ATTRIBUTING IT TO HOVEYDA. HE SAID HE WOULD BE HAPPY IF I DID. I SAID I HAD ONE OR TWO OTHERS I WANTED TO SPEAK TO, SUCH AS HUSHANG ANSARY, BEFORE I WENT TO THE SHAH, BUT I FELT THE TIME HAD COME TO GET THE SHAH TO LOOK AHEAD IN PRACTICAL TERMS.
I WOULD, IN ANY EVENT, WAIT UNTIL AFTER THE SHAH HAD MADE HIS SPEECK FROM THE THRONE AT THE OPENING OF PARLIAMENT OCTOBER 6 BEFORE SEEING HIM.

HOVEYDA SAID HE FELT IT WAS IMPORTANT SHAH CHOOSE A TIME TO SPEAK OUT AND SHOW HIS LEADERSHIP. I SAID MANY OF HIS SUPPORTERS, PARTICULARLY IN THE MILITARY, FELT STRONGLY THE NEED OF HIS LEADERSHIP AND WERE PUZZLED BY HIS CURRENT RETICENCE. PERHAPS, AFTER TENTH OF MOHARRAM, IN MID-DECEMBER, IF THE KHOMEINI MENACE APPEARED UNDER CONTROL, MIGHT BE THE TIME FOR THE SHAH TO REDEFINE HIS LEADERSHIP. I THOUGH HE SHOULD MOVE AWAY FROM HIS USUAL CALL FOR THE "GREAT CIVILIZATION" AND FOCUS ON SOMEWHAT MORE MODEST AND CURRRENT GOALS, BUILT AROUND TANGIBLE NEEDS FOR THE PEOPLE, AND CENTERED AROUND FULFILLING HIS PUBLIC COMMITMENT TO FREE ELECTIONS IN JUNE.
HOVEYDA AGREED.

I ASKED HOVEYDA WHO WAS SEEING THE SHAH THESE DAYS AND GIVING HIS ADVICE. HIS ANSWER WAS "PRACTICALLY NOBODY". THE EMPRESS, NATURALLY. ANSARY, TWO OR THREE TIMES A WEEK. SHARIF-EMAMI REGULARLY, BUT ALWAYS ON CONCRETE PROBLEMS. ARDALAN, STRICTLY FOR CEREMONIAL MATTERS. BUT NOBODY IS PREPARED TO ARGUE WITH HIM OR DISCUSS POLITICAL RELITIES. HE URGED ME TO HAVE A LONG TALK WITH HIM.
AFTER I SEE ANSARY (OCTOBER 5) AND AFTER THE SPEECK FROM THE THRONE (OCTOBER 6) AND, ASSUMING KHOMEINI COMES TO ROOST IN SOME QUIET PERCH, I SHALL PURSUE ALL THIS WITH THE SHAH.

1978TEHRAN09704.subject: APPARENT SABOTAGE OF IRANIAN HELICOPTER AN IRANIAN CH-47 HELICOPTER IN ISFAHAN WAS DAMAGED BY AN EXPLOSION ON OCTOBER 1. LATER INVESTIGATION BY A U

segments.text: AN IRANIAN CH-47 HELICOPTER IN ISFAHAN WAS DAMAGED BY AN EXPLOSION ON OCTOBER 1. LATER INVESTIGATION BY A U.S. CIVILIAN ENGINEER TEAM HAS CONCLUDED THAT SABOTAGE WAS REASON FOR EXPLOSION. TEAM FOUND REMAINDER OF TIMING DEVICE AND PLASTIC EXPLOSIVE ON AIRCRAFT, WHICH HAD BEEN SCHEDULED FOR ROUTINE FLIGHT AT TIME OF EXPLOSION. FLIGHT HAD BEEN POSTPONED AND AIRCRAFT WAS UNMANNED AND STILL ON RAMP. IRANIAN AND U.S. AUTHORITIES HAVE AGREED TO DISCUSS EXPLOSION ONLY ON NEED-TO-KNOW BASIS.

THE SECOND LARGEST FARSI NEWSPAPER, THE ETTELAAT, PUBLISHED IN ITS OCTOBER 3 EDITION, INTERVIEWS WITH SEVERAL FORMER AEOI SENIOR SPECIALISTS CONCERNING RECENT DEVELOPMENTS IN AEOI. EMBASSY IS NOT AWARE OF ANY REPERCUSSIONS AT THIS TIME AS A RESULT OF THESE INTERVIEWS, EITHER WITHIN MINISTRY OF ENERGY'S AEOI OR OUTSIDE OF GOVERNMENT.
THE EIGHT FORMER AEOI EMPLOYEES ARE: DR. A. ZERESHKIAN, NUCLEAR GEOLOGIST; DR. K. PAHTEMAN, MINERALOGIST; 3. DR. M.R. KATOUZI, GEOLOGIST; EGINEER G.H. PARAM, GEOCHEMIST

ENGINEER F. JADALI, CIVIL ENGINEER; ENGINEER E. ASLANI, NUCLEAR SCIENTIST; ENOINEER E. ASHKOURI, GEOLOGIST; AND, ENGINEER SH. TOWFIGHI, OEOLOOIST. THESE EIGHT PEOPLE REPRESENT 32 SCIENTISTS WHO RESIGNED IN THE PAST 36 MONTHS DUE TO ALLEGED MISMANAGEMENT, PERSONAL INTEREST, LACK OF SUFFICIENT INTEREST IN THE JOB BY FORMER HEAD OF AEOI, ABSENCE OF ATTENTION TO SPECIALISTIES, AND MISAPPROPRIATION OF FUNDS.

DIFFERENT VIEWS OF PARTICIPANTS ARE AS FOLLOWS: ENGINEER E. ASLANI: BEGIN : ISFAHAN NUCLEAR CENTER PROJECT WAS HANDED TO FOREIGN CONTRACTOR FROM THE BEGINNING AND IRANIANS WERE NOT GIVEN ANY RESPONSIBILITIES. TECHNICAL CALCULATIONS WERE DONE IN "CLOSED DOOR" ROOMS WITHOUT IRANIANS PARTICIPATION. WHEN FINAL TENHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS WERE ANNOUNCED, CONTROVERSY BEGAN OVER CERTAIN MISCALCULATION. HOWEVER, ISFAHAN NENTER WENT AHEAD DESPITE THE FACT THAT PROJECT WAS NOT ECONOMICAL AND HAD DIFFICULTIES AS FAR AS THE ENVIRONMENTAL FACTORS WERE CONCERNED. CONCERNING THE BUDGET, ISFAHAN CENTER HAS NEVER PUBLICLY ANNOUNCED COST OF THE PROJECT.
IT IS BELIEVED THAT THE COST OF "KWU" PROJECT WHICH WAS ESTIMATED AT DOLLARS 2 BILLION IS RUNNING AROUND DOLLARS 10 BILLION. END .

ENGINEER F. JADALI: BEGIN : AEOI MANAGEMENT LACKED SUFFICIENT TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE OF NUCLEAR TECHNOLOGY. INDIVIDUALS INTEREST SEEMED MORE IMPORTANT THAN ULTIMATE GOAL. IT WAS DUE TO THESE INTERESTS THAT IN ON MEETING IN ISFAHAN CENTER, 32 OUT OF 60 SPECIALISTS WORKING FOR CENTER SUBMITTED THEIR RESIGNATION. ANOTHER PROBLEM WAS MISALLOCATION TRAINING BUDGET FOR IRANIAN TRAINEES. ACCORDING TO COST ANALYSIS SCHEDULE AVAILABLE, COST OF A FOUR-WEEK FRENCH LANGUAGE COURSE IN TEHRAN RAN ABOUT FF 13,000 (DOLLARS 2785) END .

DR. A. ZERESHKIAN: BEGIN : AEOI, BASED ON ORDER OF FORMER HEAD OF ORGANIZATION, RENTED A HUGE BUILDING IN A RESIDENTIAL AND HEAVILY-POPULATED AREA OF TEHRAN FOR "RAW MATERIAL AND FUEL" DIVISION. THERE WERE ABSOLUTELY NO SAFETY PRECUATIIONS CONCERNING THE ITEMS KEPT IN THAT BUILDING. SO IT IS BELIEVED THAT THE BUILDING AND ENTIRE AREA IS BEING POLLUTED. SINCE FORMER HEAD OF ORGANIZATION HAS A CLOSE FRIEND OF VIENNA'S ATOMIC ENERGY ORGANIZATION (AUSTRIA), HE HIRED SEVERAL AUSTRIANS WITH UNREASABLE SALARIES TO RUN THE "EXPLORATION AND EXTRATION" DIVISION.

THESE AUSTRIANS WITH HELP OF ANOTHER CLOSE FRIEND OF FORMER HEAD (REZA NIAZMAND) SET UP A COMPANY (URIRAN CO.) TO UNDERTAKE EXPLORATION AND EXTRACTION PROJECTS FOR AEOI FOR A 2.5 PERCENT COMMISSION FEE. AEOI ALSO SIGNED AN AGREEMENT FOR EXPLORATION PROJECTS WITH URIRAN COMPANY FOR DOLLARS 80 MILLION. HOWEVER, IRIRAN NEVER DID UNDERTAKE ANY RESEARCH. END . ------------------008922 051402Z /44 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 799 INFO USDOE WASHDC AMEMBASSY VIENNA UNCLAS SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 9738

ENGINEER G.H. PARAM: BEGIN : TO GET A PICTURE OF HOW DISQUALIFIED THE TOP MANAGEMENT WAS, TWO INSTANCES CAN BE MENTIONED. AEOI'S MANAGER FOR "GEOCHEMISTRY" DIVISION HELD A B.S. IN GEOLOGY AND ONE OF THE TOP ADVISORS WAS A TAXI DRIVER FOR 11 YEARS BEFORE HE JOINED AEOI. END .

ENGINEER E. ASLANI: BEGIN . IT IS PROVEN THAT TOTAL PRODUCTION CAPACITY OF A POWER PLANT SHOULD NOT BE MORE THAN 8 PERCENT OF NATIONAL GRID CAPACITY. IN 1981, WHEN BUSHEHR POWER PLANTS START PRODUCTION WITH MORE THAN 8 PERCENT OF NATIONAL GRID CAPACITY, WE WILL HAVE SERIOUS PROBLEMS IN OUR NATIONAL GRID. WE TALKED TO GERMANS ABOUT THIS AND THEIR ANSWER WAS THAT MANAGEMENT DID NOT SPECIFY THIS MATTER IN AGREEMTN. END .

DR. K. PAHLEVAN: BEGIN : IN MOST CASES WHAT DETERMINED POSITIONS N AEOI WAS THE RELATIONSHIP WITH AEOI'S HEAD AND/OR VICE PRESIDENTS NOT THE EDUCATIONAL BACKGROUND AND EXPERIENCE. FOR INSTANCE, "NUCLEAR WASTE DIVISION" MANAGER WAS AN EXPERT IN FOSSIL. END .

DR. M. R. KATOUZI: BEGIN : ALL THE PROBLEMS AND DIFFICULTIES WERE REPORTED REPEATEDLY TO AEOI'S HEAD AND VICE PRESIDENTS IN DUE TIMES. HOWEVER, MANGEMENT DID NOT TAKE ANY ACTION. FOR THIS REASON A GROUP OF EDUCATED AND HIGHLY EXPERIENCED IRANIAN SCIENTISTS RESIGNED ONE AFTER ANOTHER. END .

(NOTAL),D. TEHRAN 9582 (NOTAL), E. TEHRAN 9617 SUMMARY: CONTINUED VIOLENCE IN KERMANSHAH ND CLASHES IN OTHER CITIES MAR SECURITY SCENE. OPPOSITION PUSHING FOR GENERAL STRIKE OCT 7, AND LABOR UNREST POSING PROBLEM TO GOI. THUS FAR GOI APPEARS TO BE CAPITULATING TO VIRTUALLY ALL MONETARY DEMANDS. UNIVERSITY SCENE STILL SHAKY. PRESS OCT 5 REPORTS CONTINUING VIOLENCE IN KERMANSHAH OCT 1-3 WITH OFFICIAL DEATH TOLL OF 12. RELIGIOUS LEADER TOLD PRESS 30,000 PEOPLE DEMONSTRATED (GIVEN RATHER INEPT CROWD-COUNTING CAPABILITY AND CLERGYMAN'S SELF-INTEREST, WE DOUBT TOTAL; MINISTRY OF INTERIOR SOURCE PUT FIGURE AT THREE TO FOUR THOUSAND; TRUTH PROBABLY IN BETWEEN). KERMANSHAH SCHOOLTEACHERS ENDED THEIR SIT-IN OF MINISTRY OF EDUCATION OFFICES THERE AFTER AUTHORITIES GRANTED THEIR DEMANDS TO USE A LOCAL AUDITORIUM FOR MEETINGS.

PRESS OCT 4 REPORTS CLASH IN KASHAN BETWEEN POLICE AND DEMONSTRATORS WITH 250 INJURED. PARENTS AND TEACHERS PROTESTED POLICE "INTERFERENCE" IN DEMONSTRATIONS. ON OCT 3, IN HAMEDAN, POLICE DISPERSED GROUP OF 100 GIRL STUDENTS WHO WERE CARRYING BANNERS AND SHOUTING SLOGANS WITH WATER FROM LOCAL FIRE SYSTEM. POLICE IN NORTHERN CITY OF SHAHI BROKE UP PROTEST AGAINST EDUCATIONAL SYSTEM WITH TEAR GAS AFTER GROUP OF GIRLS WAS JOINED BY MALE STUDENTS. TEACHERS IN KHORRAMABAD HAVE REFUSED TO RETURN TO WORK UNTIL POLICE AGREED NOT TO INTEREFERE WITH CITY'S STUDENT ACTIVITIES AND RELEASE ALL TEACHERS PREVIOUSLY ARRESTED.

GROUP OF PEOPLE IN BANEH (KURDESTAN) HELD DEMONSTRATION OCT 2 AND PRESENTED LIST OF 14 DEMANDS TO BANEH GOVERNOR WHICH INCLUDED, INTER ALIA, RELEASE OF POLITICAL PRISONERS, RETRIAL OF SOME PRISONERS, REMOVAL OF THE MAYOR, IMPROVEMENT OF EDUCATIONAL CONDITIONS, DISSOLUTION OF GUILDS CHAMBER AND IMPROVEMENT OF HEALTH, EDUCATION, AND AGRICULTURAL FACILITIES. FOLLOWING SUBMISSION OF THIS LIST, MAYOR AND DIRECTOR OF THE LOCAL RED LION AND SUN (RED CROSS) SOCIETY RESIGNED.

MINISTER OF JUSTICE BAHERI SAID OCT 4 IN MEETING WITH BAR ASSOCIATION BOARD OF DIRECTORSTHAT A SPECIAL COMMISSION WOULD BE SET UP TO REVIEW CASES OF POLITICAL PRISONERS FOR RELEASE. BAHERI INDICATED HE PLANNED TO HAVE BAR ASSOCIATION REPRESENTATION ON COMMITTEE. BAR ASSOCIATION TOLD MINJUSTICE MARTIAL LAW WAS UNNECESSARY, SAID MINISTRY OF JUSTICE HAD TOO OFTEN BEEN USED AS A TOOL OF GOI'S POLITICAL POLICIES AND NEEDED TO BE STRENGTHENED, AND CALLED FOR PUNISHMENT OF THOSE RESPONSIBLE FOR KILLINGS IN JALEH SQUARE SEPT 8. MINISTER PLEDGED TO STRENGTHEN ADMINISTRATION OF JUSTICE.

EFFORTS TO HOLD "CLOSED DOOR" SESSION IN MAJLES OCT 3 FIZZLED WHEN THOS WHO WANTED SESSION COULD MUSTER ONLY 20 OF NECESSARY 66 SIGNATURES. SPEAKER RIAZI SAID HE WOULD NOT PRESIDE AT SESSION, WHICH HE TOLD PRESS HAD DETERIORATED INTO A CAMPAIGNING SESSION FOR THE POST OF MAJLES SPEAKER, WHO WILL BE CHOSEN OCT 7 WHEN THE NEW PARLIAMENT FORMALLY CONVENES.

RIZAI'S TESTINESS PARTLY DUE TO FACT HE IS BEING SERIOUSLY, AND APPARENTLY SUCCESSFULLY, CHALLENGED FOR POST HE HAS HELD FOR PAST 14 YEARS BY EX- RESURGENCE PARTY (RPPI) FIGURE JAVAD SAEED, WHO HASTILY RESIGNED THE RPPI SECRETARY GENERALSHIP HE HAD HELD FOR LESS THAN TWO WEEKS WHEN INDICATIONS SHOWED HE COULD BE ELECTED SPEAKER. EVEN PRESS NOW CONVINCED SAEED WILL BE CHOSEDN TO REPLACE RIAZI, WHO HAS SAID IN ANY CASE HE WOULD NOT RUN FOR PARLIAMENT AGAIN NEXT YEAR BECAUSE OF AGE. ON SENATE SIDE, NEW SENATE PRESIDENT IS EXPECTED TO BE SHARIF-EMAMI'S FORMER DEPUTY, SENATOR MOHAMMAD SAJJADI.

SAEED'S HASTY DECISION TO DESERT RPPI IS SYMPTOMATIC OF CONFUSION ON POLITICAL SCENE. RPPI EXECUTIVE BOARD COULD NOT MUSTER QUORUM OCT 3 FOR WHAT WAS TO BE FINAL MEETING, AND MEETING HAS BEEN RESCHEDULED FOR OCT 10. IN MEANTIME, SEVERAL BOARD MEMBERS WERE ANNOYED AT SAEED'S RESIGNATION AND SAID IT COULDN'T BE ACCEPTED UNTIL A DEPUTY WAS CHOSEN. AT LEAST A FEW SAID RPPI "HAS NO NEED TO DISBAND."

EMBASSY CONTINUES TO RECEIVE REPORTS OF NEW POLITICAL PARTIES. SOURCES INVOLVED IN POLITICAL ORGANIZATION STATE THAT SHAH HIMSELF TALKED TO AT LEAST TWO AND PERHAPS MORE POLITICAL FIGURES AND ACCORDING TO THEM, GAVE THEM GREEN LIGHT TO GO AHEAD AND FORM POLITICAL PARTIES. SHAH DEFINITELY TALKED TO MINISTER OF SCIENCE AND HIGHTER EDUCATION NAHAVANDI AND ENDOWMENTS MINSTER KANI, URGING FORMER TO GO AHEAD WITH PLANS TO TURN HIS STUDY GROUP INTO POLITICAL PARTY AND SUGGESTING THAT LATTER REVIVE MARDOM PARTY. SIMILAR MESSAGE MAY HAVE BEEN GIVEN TO MINISTER OF STATE AZMOUN, POINTING HIM TOWARD EITHER REVIVAL OF IRAN NOVIN PARTY OR CONVERSION OF SOME RPPI REMNANTS INTO NEW PARTY.

LABOR UNREST (REF C) IS BEGINNING TO POSE PROBLEM TO GOI. THOUGH OIL COMPANY, TELECOMMUNICATIONS AND BANK STRIKE REPORTEDLY HAVE BEEN SETTLED(REF D) NUMBER OF GROUPS ARE NOW ON STRIKE OR INTENDING TO STRIKE, INCLUDING NURSES, STATE TOBACCO MONOPOLY WORKERS, TEACHERS, AND SOME PARASTATAL EMPLOYEES. PM TOLD AMBASSADOR OCT 4 HE HAD SETTLED SOME 50 PUBLIC SECTOR STRIKES ADDING THAT GENEROUS SETTLEMENTS WERE A NECESSITY. GOI CABINET MADE DECISION OCT 3 TO GRANT CIVIL SERVANTS PAY INCREASE AND LOW-COST HOUSING LOANS IN EFFORT TO HEAD OFF PROJECTED GENERAL STRIKE SATURDAY OCT 7.

IT IS NOT CLEAR WHETHER THIS PLOY WILL BE SUCCESSFUL, BUT DETAILED NEGOTIATIONS ARE UNDERWAY IN SEVERAL MINISTRIES BETWEEN GOI AND EMPLOYEES. TEHRAN JOURNAL OCT 5 POINTED OUT GOI'S BASIC PROBLEM: THERE ARE LEGITIMATE GRIVANCES, BUT TO ALLOW ACROSS THE BOARD FAVORABLE SETTLEMENTS RISKS SETTING OFF NEW INFLATIONARY SPIRAL.

JOURNAL MAKES SUGGESTION THAT PLACING GOI IN POSITION OF HAVING TO GIVE IN OR RISK ALIENATING PEOPLE MAY BE POLITICAL GOAL OF SOME, AND SUGGESTS THERE ARE ZHINTS OF POLITICAL FORCES WORKING BEHIND THE SCENES FOR THEIR OWN ENDS." (COMMENT: POLITICAL FACTIONS ARE UNDOUBTEDLY EGGING GROUPS ON, ES ESPECIALLY GOI EMPLOYEES, FOR THEIR OWN ENDS, BUT THE GRIEVANCES ARE ALSO UNDOUBTEDLY THERE, AND GOI'S ATTEMPT TO SETTLE SOME STRIKES QUICKLY WITH VERY FAVORABLE SETTLEMENTS MAY BACKFIRE.

SETTLEMENTS KNOWN TO US IN ANY IL REVEAL SUBSTANTIAL INCREASES IN THE FRINGE BENEFITS (WAGE INCREASES REQUIRE CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION ACTION AND THUS TAKE LONGER), SUCH AS HOUSING ALLOWANCES AND FOOD SUBSIDIES, WHICH RAN THE OVERALL COMPENSATION PACKAGE IN ONE KNOWN CASE UP 178 PERCENT AND IN MOST, 50 TO 100 PERCENT.

UNIVERSITY SCENE IS STILL SHAKY. UNIVERSITY FACULTY NOW SERIOUSLY CONSIDERING AN ACADEMIC UNION. IN MIDST OF THIS, GOI IS QUIETLY COUNSELING UNIVERSITIES TO STAGGER OPENINGS, IN MAY CASES POSTPONING PLANNED OPENING SET FOR OCT 7. AS WE UNDERSTAND IT, SOME SCHOOLS MAY OPEN THEN, BUT REST WILL OPEN AT INTERVALS OF SEVERAL DAYS OR A WEEK LATER. THIS DEVELOPMENT COMES JUST AS SOME FACULTY AND ADMINSTRATORS ARE BEGINNING TO THINK SCHOOLS MIGHT MAKE IT THROUGH A WEEK OR TWO OF CLASS BEFORE HAVING TO FACE UP TO TROUBLE.

OPTIMISM HAS BEEN PREVALENT IN LAST FEW DAYS AT TEHRAN'S NATIONAL UNIVERSITY AND AT UNIVERSITY OF ISFAHAN, AS RESULT OF PEACEFUL AND ENTHUSIASTIC REGISTRATIONS JUST COMPLETED. TEHRAN UNIVERSITY FACULTY STILL FORESEE MAJOR PROBLEMS THERE. MOOD OF ESTABLISHMENT ACADEMICS CAN BE SEEN IN FACT THAT AMONG 200 SIGNATORIES OF ACADEMIC DECLARATION ATTACKING GOI FOR MARTIAL LAW "KILLINGS" PUBLISHED SEPT 30 CAN BE FOUND HEADS OF SEVERAL TEHRAN UNIVERSITY FACULTIES, PLUS VICE CHANCELLOR FOR PLANNING AT NATIONAL UNIVERSITY. THOSE ON LIST WHO ARE KNOWN TO EMBASSY WOULD NOT HAVE BECOME INVOLVED WITH SIMILAR EFFORT EVEN AS RECENTLY AS SIX MONTHS AGO.

I SPENT TWO HOURS OCTOBER 5 WITH HUSHANG ANSARY, HEAD OF NATIONAL IRANIAL OIL COMPANY AND ECONOMIC ADVISER TO THE SHAH. MOST OF OUR DISCUSSION WAS ON POLITICAL MATTERS, ALTHOUGH WE DID DISCUSS CERTAIN ECONOMIC SUBJECTS WHICH WILL BE REPORTED SEPARATELY.

AFTER A GENERAL REVIEW OF RECENT EVENTS IN THIS COUNTRY, ANSARY TOOK THE VIEWS THAT ERS WERE NOT FUNDAMENTALLY AS BAD AS CONVENTIONAL WISDOM PERCEIVED. HE BELIEVED THE BASIC HEALTH OF THE COUNTRY WAS SOUND AND THAT EFFECTIVE LEADERSHIP COULD STRAIGHTEN OUT THE POLITICAL FUTURE.

HE SAID HE HAD SEEN THE SHAH TWO DAYS AGO AND FOUND HIM DOWN IN THE DUMPS AGAIN. (THIS WAS PRESUMABLY AFTER HE RECEIVED WORD THAT KHOMEINI WAS IN MOTIONE.) HE FELT BUREAUCRACY WAS PARALYZED, BUSINESS WAS DORMANT, AND POLICY WAS STANGNANT. HOWEVER, MOST OF THIS WAS SELF-INDUCED. HE RECALLED FRANKLIN ROOSEVELT'S STATE: "THE ONLY THING WE HAVE TO FEAR IS FEAR ITSELF."

IN HIS VIEW, SHAH HAS TO DRAW LESSONS FROM RECENT EVENTS AND REVISE HIS PRIORITIES. IN PAST FEW YEARS, TWO-THIRDS OF BUDGET HAS GONE TO FIVE "PROJECTS:" (A) ARMED FORCES, (B) NIOC, (C) PETROCHEMICALS, (D) NUCLEAR POWER PLANTS, AND (E) STEEL MILLS. THESE "PROJECTS" AND THE VISION OF IRAN THEY REPRESENT HAVE NOT CAUGHT THE POPULAR IMAGINATION. IRANIANS HAVE BEEN FAR MORE INTERESTED IN THE BREAD AND BUTTER OPPORTUNITIES WHICH THEY HAVE HAD TO DEFER WHILE BUILDING THE GREAT CIVILIZATION.UNFORTUNATELY, IRANIANS ARE NOT JAPANESE AND WILL NOT ACCEPT SUCH ABSTINENCE AND ABNEGATION.

ANSARY FEELS THE SHAH NOW HAS TO REDEFINE HIS "VISION" IN MORE MODEST TERMS. THIS DOES NOT MEAN THAT HE HAD TO ABANDON ANY OF HIS PREVIOUSLY STATED GOASL. IT MERELY MEANS THAT HE HAS TO DIRECT SOME BUDGET REALLOCATIONS AND THEN ANNOUNCE SOME PROGRAMS, SUCH AS ELECTRIFICATION FOR 18,000 VILLAGES, AT AN APPROPRIATE TIME. HE FEELS THE SHAH'S PERSONALITY IS SUCH THAT HE NEEDS TO GRAPPLE WITH SOME TANGIBLE PROGRAMS SUCH AS THIS IN ORDER TO SNAP OUT OF HIS FUNK.

TURNING TO THE QUESTION OF ASSURING SATISFACTORY ELECTIONS, ANSARY INDICATED NEARLY COMPLETE UNANIMITY WITH THE VIEWS EXPRESSED BY HOVEYDA IN REFTEL. IN FACT, HOVEYDA HAD ALREADY CALLED HIM ABOUT MY CONVERSATION WITH HIM AND THE TWO ARE TO MEET ON SATURDAY FOR MORE EXTENSIVE DISCUSSION OF THE IDEAS HOVEYDA AND I HAD EXPLORED. HE SAID, INCIDENTALLY, THAT, IN THE LAST FEW MONTHS, HE HAD LOST HIS AMBITION TO BE PRIME MINISTER. HE NOW FELT IT WAS BETTER TO STAY WHERE HE WAS AT NIOC, WORK IN THE POLITICAL BACKGROUND, AND TRY TO DEVELOP SOME YOUNGER MEN AS THE NEW LEADERS. HE, TOO, EXPRESSED GENERAL SUPPORT FOR JAVAD SAEED.

AS USUAL IN TALKS WITH IRANIAN POLITICAL FIGURES, HE URGED THAT THE UNITED STATES SHOW SOME INDICATION OF OUR PREFERENCE AMONG THE POTENTIAL POLITICAL LEADERS. WHEN I SAID THIS WAS NOT THE WAY WE DID BUSINESS, HE URGED THAT WE AT LEAST INDICATE THOSE WE DID NOT RPT NOT CONSIDER QUALIFIED. HE SAID TOO MANY OPPOSITIONISTS WERE WALKING AROUND SAYING THAT THEY WERE SPECIALLY ANNOINTED BY THE U.S. EMBASSY. I SUGGESTED THEY BE ASKED TO SHOW THE OIL ON THEIR FOREHEADS, SINCE WE WERE NOT IN THE ANNOINTING BUSINESS.

FINALLY, WE BOTH AGREED THAT WE WOULD MENTION OUR CONVERSATION TO THE SHAH ON THE NEXT OCCASION. I SAID I WOULD SEE GENERAL TOUFANIAN ON SUNDAY AND WOULD PROBABLY ASK FOR AN AUDIENCE WITH THE SHAH SOMETIME NEXT WEEK.

ACTING FONMIN ZELLI ASKED ME TO MEET WITH HIM MORNING OCTOBER 9. PRINCIPAL PURPOSE OF MEETING WAS TO DISCUSS STATE OF PLAY IN IRAN'S EFFORT TO PERSUADE KING HUSSEIN TO TAKE ADVANTAGE OF CAMP DAVID AGREEMENTS FOR NEGOTIATING FRAMEWORK ON WEST BANK AND GAZA.

ACCORDING TO ZELLI, SHAH HAS SENT AN ANSWER THROUGH AMBASSADOR ZAHEDI TO PRESIDENT CARTER'S LETTER OF SEPTEMBER 29. IN THAT LETTER, SHAH REPORTEDLY SAID HE WOULD SEND EMISSARY TO HUSSEIN. (REQUEST DEPT SEND TEXT OF SHAH'S LETTER SOONEST, SINCE I EXPECT HAVE AUDIENCE WITH SHAH IN NEXT FEW DAYS.)

ZELLI WANTED TO INFORM ME THAT EMISSARY HAD GONE TO AMMAN OCTOBER 6 AND HAD MET WITH HUSSEIN THAT SAME DAY. HE CONVEYED SHAH'S VIEW THAT HUSSEIN WOULD BE WELL ADVISED TO TAKE ADVANTAGE OF CAMP DAVID OPPORTUNITIES. HUSSEIN HAD REPLIED THAT HIS CURRENT POSITION IS TO EXPRESS NO RPT NO VIEWS ON CAMP DAVID AND TO MAKE NO RPT NO COMMITMENTS ONE WAY OR THE OTHER. HE SAID HE HAD SUBMITTED LIST OF QUESTIONS TO WASHINGTON AND WOULD AWAIT ANSWERS BEFORE TAKING A FIRM POSITION.
HUSSEIN ASSURED SHAH THAT HE WOULD BE IN TOUCH TO INFORM HIM OF HIS POSITION AS SOON AS IT IS FORMULATED.

EGYPTIAN AMBASSADOR INFORMS ME HE HAS BEEN URGING SADAT TO SEND LETTER TO SHAH ON CAMP DAVID ACCORDS AND NOT RPT NOT ACT AS THOUGH HE TAKES IRAN FOR GRANTED IN THIS ISSUE. TO DATE, HE HAS RECEIVED NO ANSWER FROM CAIRO.

I TOLD HIM I SHARED HIS VIEW THAT SADAT LETTER WOULD BE WELCOME HERE, PARTICULARLY SINCE EGYPTIANS WERE ANNOUNCING FACT THEY HAD SENT LETTERS TO A HOST OF OTHER NATIONS OF LESSER SIGNIFICANCE TO THE FUTURE WELL-BEING OF EGYPT.

1978TEHRAN09767.subject: DEPARTURE OF MAURITANIAN AMBASSADOR FOR UNGA

segments.text: SIDI BOUNA OULD SIDI, CURRENTLY MAURETANIAN AMBASSADOR TO IRAN AND NEWLY DESIGNATED AMBASSADOR TO U.S., CAME TO SEE ME MORNING OCTOBER 8 TO INFORM ME THAT HE HAD BEEN ORDERED SUDDENLY TO JOIN HIS DELEGATION AT UNGA. ACCORDINGLY, HE IS LEAVING OCTOBER 9 DIRECTLY FOR NEW YORK. HIS FAMILY, CURRENTLY IN PARIS, WILL FLY DIRECTLY TO WASHINGTON IN ORDER THAT HIS CHILDREN CAN BE ENROLLED IN FRENCH LYCEE AT THIS TIME.

AMBASSADOR WAS NOT CLEAR HOW HE WOULD HANDLE PRESENTATION OF CREDENTIALS IN U.S., SINCE HE HAS NOT RPT NOT YET MADE FORMAL FAREWELLS IN TEHRAN. HE MAY, HOWEVER, TRY TO GET LETTERS OF CREDENCE SENT TO HIM WHILE IN NEW YORK SO THAT HE CAN COME TO WASHINGTON AND PRESENT THEM SOMETIME DURING GENERAL ASSEMBLY SESSION.

IN ANY EVENT, AMBASSADOR EXPECTS RETURN TO TEHRAN BRIEFLY AFTER GENERAL ASSEMBLY RECESS IN MID-DECEMBER TO MAKE HIS FAREWELLS HERE BEFORE ENTERING FULL TIME ON HIS DUTIES IN WASHINGTON AT END OF YEAR.
FULL TEXT OF DECREE IS NOT YET AVAILABLE. REPORT BY COURT MINISTER ARDALAN WHICH APPEARED IN KAYHAN SEPTEMBER 27 AND TEHRAN 9366, WHICH DREW UPON KAYHAN, HAVE ALL THE INFORMATION AVAILABLE TO US.

1978TEHRAN09787.subject: POLITICAL REPORT; SHAH REAFFIRMS LIBERALIZATION; NEW MAJLES SPEAKER SELECTED; NAHAVANDI PARTY FINALLY ANNOUNCED

segments.text: NEW MAJLES SPEAKER SELECTED; NAHAVANDI PARTY FINALLY ANNOUNCED SUMMARY: THE SHAH'S SPEECH TO THE FORMAL OPENING OF PARLIAMENT OCT 6 STRESSED THAT POLITICAL LIBERALIZATION WILL CONTINUE, ADMITTED PAST ERRORS AND CALLED FOR PUBLIC CALM SO THAT DEMOCRATIZATION COULD CONTINUE. FORMER RESURGENCE PARTY SECGEN SAEED WON ELECTION AS MAJLES SPEAKER UPSETTING INCUMBENT RIAZI. MINISTER NAHAVANDI'S STUDY GROUP FORMALLY ANNOUNCED IT WILL BECOME A POLITICAL PARTY. IMPERIAL INVESTIGATING COMMISSION DISCONTINUED. PUBLIC ORDER SITUATION SUBJECT OF SEPTEL. END SUMMAR.

SHAH'S SPPECH TO THE FORMAL OPENING OF PARLIAMENT WAS ESSENTIALLY A DECLARATION THAT POLITICAL LIBERLIZATION WILL CONTINUE DESPITE THE DEMONSTRATIONS AND UNREST WHICH HE CONCEDED WAS WIDER THA EXPECTED. THE SHAH URGED UNITY TO PROTECT NATIONAL INDEPENDENCE EVEN WHILE ADMITTING THERE HAD BEEN ERRORS AND MISUSE OF SOCIAL POSITION WHICH CREATED DISCONTENT, BUT HE INDICATED IT HAD BEEN SHOWN THAT BEHIND THE SCENES PROVOCATION AND PLOTS HATCHED FOR SPECIAL PURPOSES WERE FACTS IN INTENSIFYING THE PRESENT CRISIS.

THE SHAH EMPHASIZED THAT DEMOCRACY PLACES SPECIAL INDIVIDUAL AND SOCIAL RESPONSIBILITIES UPON ALL AND CALLED FOR THE FAITFUL OBSERVANCE OF LEGAL RULES AND REGULATIONS. HE ADDED "TO POSSESS DIFFERENT VIEWS AND BELIEFS ON ALL MATTERS OF NATIONAL CONCERN...IS COMPLETELY SUPPORTED BY US." HE SAID THIS LEGITIMATE RIGHT SHOULD NOT BE USED TO BREAK LAWS AND DESTROY PUBLIC ORDER BECUASE THIS "WILL DISSOLVE THE LINKS WHICH BIND THE SOCIETY TOGETHER." HE CALLED FOR CLEAR ACTION BY THE JUDICIARY TO ROOT OUT CORRUPT GROUPS AND ADDED FOR THE FIRST TIME IN A PUBLIC SPEECH THAT THERE HAD BEEN MISAPPROPROATIONS OF PUBLIC FUNDS.
HE CALLED FOR CONTINUED ECONOMIC MEASURES TO REMOVE BOTTLENECKS AND SHORTCOMINGS SO THAT ECONOMIC PROGRESS COULD BE FULLY COORDINATED.

HE PAID DUE DEFERENCE TO IRAN'S STATUS AS A MOSLEM NATION, STRESSED THAT THE DEFENSE OF THE COUNTRY WILL REMAIN STRONG AND SAID IRAN'S FOREIGN POLICY REMAINS BASED ON ITS NATIONAL INDEPENDENCE POLICY AND NON-INTERVENTION IN OTHER COUNTRIES' AFFAIRS. (COMMENT: THIS SPEECH WAS ESSENTIALLY A RESTATEMENT OF THE SHAH'S POLICY FOR IRAN. HE MENTIONED MISAPPROPRIATION FOR THE FIRST TIME AND WENT FURTHER THAN HE HAS IN A PUBLIC TALK BEFORE IN SAYING THAT OTHER HAD A RIGHT TO DIFFERENT VIEWS ON NATIONA MATTERS. IMPLICIT IN HIS REMARKS WERE THE CENTRAL ROLE OF THE MONARCHY AS A CONTINUING GUIDING INSTITUTION IN IRAN.

THE CEREMONY OF THE FORMAL OPENING WAS MORE LOW KEY THAN IN THE PAST. THE SHAH DELIVERED HIS SPEECH WHILE SEATED RATHER THAN STANDING. APART FROM THE EMPRESS, NO OTHER MEMBERS OF THE ROYAL FAMILY WERE PRESENT THOUGH CHAIRS WERE PROVIDED FOR THEM.

ON SAME DAY, MAJLES MEMBERS ELECTED FORMER RESURGENCE PARTY SECGEN JAVAD SAEED AS MAJLES SPEAKER, 144 VOTES TO 103 VOTES WITH 7 ABSTENTIONS. SAEED UNSEATED FORMER SPEAKER ABDULLAH RIAZI, WHO HAD HELD OFFICE FOR 15 YEARS. OTHER MAJLES EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE MEMBERS RETAINED THEIR SEATS. (COMMENT: SAEED'S VICTORY RESULTED FROM THE BELIEF BY MANY PRESENT GOVERNMENT DEPUTIES THAT A MORE DYNAMIC INDIVIDUAL WAS NECESSARY TO COPE WITH THE PROBLEMS PARLIAMENT MUST FACE IN THE COMING MONTHS AND SOME BACKSTAGE POLITICKING. SOME OPPOSITION PARLIAMENTARIANS VOTED FOR SAEED AS WELL, AND OUR PARLIAMENT SOURCES TELL US THAT THE TRANSITION WENT MORE SMOOTHLY THAN EXPECTED.)

IN THE SENATE, SENATOR SEYED MOHAMMAD SAJJADI WAS ELECTED PRESIDEING OFFICER. HE HAD SUCCEEDED JAAFAR SHARIF-EMAMI WHEN THE LATTER WAS NAMED PRIME MINISTER IN AUGUST. TWO NEW DEPUTY SPEAKERS, SENATORS AMANOLLAH ARDALAN AND EMAD TORBATI, WERE ELECTED AS WELL.

ON OCT 6 MINISTER OF SCIENCE AND HIGHER EDUCATION NAHAVANDI SAID HIS GROUP FOR THE STUDY OF IRANIAN PROBLEMS WILL ESTABLISH A NATIONAL POLITICAL PARTY, THE NAME OF THE PARTY WAS NOT ANNOUNCED, BUT NAHAVANDI SAID BOTH NAME AND PROGRAM WOULD BE OFFERED TO THE PUBLIC SHORTLY. THE PARTY IS NOW CORRALLING FOUNDING MEMBERS AND WHEN APPROXIMATELY ONE THOUSAND HAVE BEEN CHOSEN, THEY WILL HOLD THEIR FIRST CONGRESS IN A CITY WHICH IS NOT UNDER MARTIAL LAW.

NAHAVANDI NOD NOT REVEAL THE NAMES OF THE FOUNDING MEMBERS OTHER THAN TO NOTE THERE WOULD BE FIVE SENATORS AND THREE OTHER MINISTERS, MINISTER OF LABOR AND SOCIAL AFFAIRS KAZEM VADI'I MINISTER OF ART AND CULTURE, MOHSEN FOROUGHI, AND MIN PTT MOTAMEDI.

SMALL ITEM IN PRESS OCT 8 ANNOUNCED THAT THE IMPERIAL COMMISSION WILL CEASE TO EXIST. THE COMMISSION, WHOSE HEARING HAD BEEN TELEVISED DURING STATE'S INVESTIGATION OF ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT ACTIVITIES, WILL BE REPLACED BY A PLAN AND BUDGET ORGANIZATION COMMITTEE ANSWERABLE TO THE CABINET (THIS APPEARS TO BE IN LINE WITH THE SHARIF-EMAMI'S GOVERNMENT'S DECISION TO PLAY SOWN THE INVOLVEMENT OF THE ROYAL FAMILY IN POLITICS.).

PRESS OCT 8 ANNOUNCED 86 ANTISTATE SECURITY PRISONERS HAVE BEEN RELEASED INCLUDING RADICAL MOVEMENT LEADER RAHMATOLLAH MOGHADAM MARAGHEI. AT THE SAME TIME, BAR ASSOCIATION PRESIDENT HASSAN NAZIEH CALLED FOR AN IMMEDIATE RELEASE OF ALL PRISONERS.

1978TEHRAN09790.subject: SECURITY REPORT SUMMARY: KHOMEINI IN PARIS, REPORTEDLY PLANS TO SETTLE IN MUSLIM COUNTRY OTHER THAN IRAN. NASSIRI RESIGN

segments.text: SUMMARY: KHOMEINI IN PARIS, REPORTEDLY PLANS TO SETTLE IN MUSLIM COUNTRY OTHER THAN IRAN. NASSIRI RESIGNED AS AMB TO PAKISTAN, INTENTIONS AND WHEREABOUTS UNKNOWN. DEMONSTRATIONS IN NONMARTIAL LAW TOWNS CAUSED AT LEAST TWO DEATHS IN KHORRAMABAD AND ONE IN AMOL. WIDESPRED STRIKES AFFECTED TAXIS, IRAN AIR, STATE RAILWAY, MANY OTHER BUREAUS. MAJOR STRIKE SET FOR OCT 9 AT POLY ACRYL, ISFAHAN. SOME UNIVERSITIES OPENED, WITH OR WITHOUT STUDENTS. OTHER FAILED TO OPEN. TWO ATTEMPTED FIREBOMBINGS OF UNOCCUPIED AMERICAN-OWNED VEHICLES IN ISFAHAN. END SUMMARY

AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI LANDED IN PARIS OCT 6 AFTER KUWAITI REFUSAL TO ADMIT HIM. PRESS REPORTS HE IS NOT RECEIVING JOURNALISTS BUT HIS ASSOCIATES DECLARE HE WILL NOT RETURN TO IRAN (COMMENT: BRINGING SIGNS OF RELIEF FROM GOI). LIBERATION MOVEMENT LEADER RAHIM SAFFARI SAYS KHOMEINI MAY CHOOSE TO REMAIN IN PARIS IF HE IS TREATED AS POLITICAL REFUGEE AND SHIITE LEADER. OTHERWISE, HE WILL GO TO ALGERIA. OTHER REPORTS INDICATE HE WILL GO TO "A MUSLIM COUNTRY." FRENCH AMB INFORMED EMBASSY GOF HAD NO KNOWLEDGE KHOMEINI WAS COMING. VISA WAS NOT IN ANY CASE REQUIRED. GOF HAS MADE NO OFFICIAL COMMENT REGARDING KHOMEINI, AND FRENCH EMB SAYS NONE WILL BE FORTHCOMING.
FULLER REPORT SEPTEL.

MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS ANNOUNCED OCT 7 GEN NASSIRI HAS RESIGNED AS AMB TO PAKISTAN. HE HAS BEEN UNDER HEAVY FIRE FOR ALLEGED CORRUPTION AND VIOLATION OF HUMAN RIGHTS WHILE CHIEF OF SAVAK. MILITARY TRIBUNAL WILL REPORTEDLY SOON BEGIN INVESTIGATION ON HIS ALLEGED CORRUPT ACTIVITIES. (COMMENT: EMB LEARNED FROM HIGH GOI OFFICIAL THAT NASSIRI WAS UNHAPPLY IN ISLAMABAD AND LOOKING FOR EXCUSE TO RESIGN. PRESENT CRITICISM THUS PROVIDED CONVENIENT OPPORTUNITY.) NASSIRI'S INTENTIONS AND WHEREABOUTS ARE UNKNOWN. IT IS NOT CERTAIN HE WILL RETURN TO FACE CHARGES.

DEMONSTRATIONS IN MONMARTIAL LAW CITIES AND MANY SMALLER TOWNS LEFT WIDESPREAD DESTRUCTION AND AT LEAST THREE DEAD. HOTTEST SPOT WAS KHORRAMABAD, WHERE PREDOMINANTLY STUDENT GROUP ATTACKED PARS NEWS AGENCY BUILDING, OFFICE OF MINISTRY OF INFORMATION, SEVERAL BANKS, AND TWO GIRLS' SCHOOLS. DURING SECOND DAY OF RIOTS, POLICE FIRED TEARGAS, THEN BULLETS, OFFICIAL IS 2 DEAD, 47 INJURED, BUT PRESS CITES EYEWITNESS ACCOUNT WHICH PLACES TOLL HIGHER. ARMY UNITS WERE CALLED IN TO RESTORE ORDER. THIRD DEATH OCCURED IN VIOLENT DEMONSTRATION OCT 7 IN AMOL, WHERE RIOTERS DESTROYED SEVERAL BUILDING, SECURITY FORCES OPENED FIRE AS CROWD ATTACKED A GIRLS' SCHOOL.

RIOTERS THEN BURNED OR SEVERELY DAMAGED FOUR BANKS, AMOL HOTEL, MOVIE THEATER, AND TWO LIQUOR STORES. OTHER WEEKEND DISTURBANCES TOOK PLACE IN KERMAN, ZANIAN, SONGHOR KOLYAI, BOUKAN AND REZAIYEH. IN BEHBAHAN, A SCHOOL PRINCIPAL'S HOME WAS BOMBED, A BANK WAS BURNED IN ISFAHAN. PRESS REPORTS MANY OTHER TOWNS INVOLVED.

SECURITY SITUATION EXACERBATED BY PROBLEMS IN BEGINNING UNIVERSITY TERM. MOST MAJOR UNIVERSITIES HAVE DIFFICULTY. ISFAHAN UNIVERSITY HAS STUDENT BOYCOTT, WITH ANTIREGIME SLOGANS DISPLAYED. ARYAMEHR ISFAHAN DID BEGIN CLASSES, BUT ANTIREGIME PLACARDS AND LEAFLETS ARE EVIDENT. WOMEN STUDENTS APPEAR FRIGHTENED, AND ALL ARE WEARING CHADOR. LARGE PEACEFUL DEMONSTRATION IN ISFAHAN OCT 7 CALLED FOR HIGHER TEACHERS' SALARIES. CROWD DISPERSED IN PANIC WHEN SOMEONE SET FIRE TO FRASH. CONSUL REPORTS MOOD OF CITY UGLY AND NERVOUS. TEHRAN UNIV PLANS TO OPEN OCT 9, WHILE NATIONAL UNIV WILL OPEN OCT 10. BOTH, HOWEVER, WILL REGISTER STUDENTS BY FIELD OF STUDY IN SLOW PROCESS TAKING SIX WEEKS.

MEANWHILE STUDENTS ARE CIRCULATING LEAFLETS ATTACKING MARTIAL LAW. PAHLAVI UNIV IN SHIRAZ AND JONDI SHAPUR IN AHWAZ ARE UNDER STUDENT BOYCOTT. NINE THOUSAND STUDENTS STAGED WALKOUT AT AZERBADEGAN UNIV IN TABRIZ OCT 7. STUDENTS ARE ALSO ON STRIKE AT GILAN AND FERDOWSI UNIV MASHAD. ARYAMEHR TEHNICAL UNIV, TEHRAN, HAS DELAYED STARTING CLASSES UNTIL AT LEAST OCT 14. SOME SMALL COLLEGES ARE HOLDING CLASSES WITHOUT INCIDENT, BUT NATIONAL ATTENTION FOCUSES ON MAJOR INSTITUTIONS.

WEEKEND IN ISFAHAN INCLUDED TWO FIREBOMB ATTEMPTS ON UNOCCUPIED AMERICAN-OWNED AUTOMOBILES. ONE EFFORT FAILED COMPLETELY; THE OTHER DAMAGED VEHICLE ONLY SLIGHTLY. CONSUL ISFHAN REPORTS AMERICAN COMMUNITY INCREEASINGLY WORRIED.

WAVE OF STRIKES HAS AFFECTED SEVERAL GOVT DEPARTMENTS. TAXI DRIVERS, IRAN AIR AND STATE RAILWAY EMPLOYEES STAGED STRIKE OCT 7, BUT HAVE RETURNED TO WORK. EMPLOYEES AT MINISTIERS OF ARTS AND CULTURE, LABOR AND SOCIAL WELFARE, INDSTRY & MINES, JUSTICE, FINANCE, INFORMATION AND TOURISM, AND COMMERCE OCT 7 JOINED POSTAL WORKERS, HOSPITAL, MUNICIPAL AND MINISTRY OF ENERGY EMPLOYEES, WHO WERE ALREADY ON STRIKE. NIRT RADIO WENT ON STRIKE OCT 8. POLICE FIRED INTO AIR AND USED TEARGAS TO DISPERSE ANGRY CROWD OF TAXI DRIVERS. STRIKES ARE GENERALLY OF SIT-DOWN VARIETY.
THEY INCLUDE ONLY SOME SECTIONS OF EACH ORGANIZATION, BUT NONETHELESS DISRUPT NORMAL FUNCTIONS OF GOVT, MAJOR STRIKE IS ANNOUNCED FOR OCT 9 AT POLY ACRLY, ISFAHAN.

1978TEHRAN09792.subject: AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI'S PLANS SUMMARY: KHOMEINI FOLLOWERS HAVE REPORTEDLY BEEN PRESSING HIM TO GO TO U.S. RELIGIOUS LEADERS IN IRAN ARE P

segments.text: SUMMARY: KHOMEINI FOLLOWERS HAVE REPORTEDLY BEEN PRESSING HIM TO GO TO U.S. RELIGIOUS LEADERS IN IRAN ARE PASSING HIM MESSAGE TO SLOW HIS FOLLOWERS' ACTIVITIES DOWN BECAUSE DEMONSTRATIONS GETTING OUT OF CONTROL, BAZAARI MERCHANTS ARE HURTING, AND KHOMEINI BEING ACCUSED OF PLAYING BALL WITH COMMUNISTS. GOI RELIEVED AT REPORT KHOMEINI WILL NOT TRY TO COME TO IRAN. VARIETY OF REPORTS SUGGEST HE MIGHT GO TO ALGERIA OR SYRIA. REQUEST PARIS INFORM US (AND DEPT) IMMEDIATELY IF KHOMEINI SHOULD ASK FOR U.S. VISA. END SUMMARY

SOURCE WITH GOOD ACCESS TO RELIGOUS CIRCLES TELLS US THAT A NUMBER OF PEOPLE AROUND AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI HAVE BEEN URGING HIM TO GO TO U.S. AS A WAY OF PUBLICIZING OPPOSITION CAUSE WHERE IT WILL DO EVEN MORE GOOD THAN IN PARIS. ONE REASON KHOMEINI HAS GONE TO PARIS (APART FROM PRESENCE THERE OF MANY IRANIAN OPPOSITION REPRESENTATIVES) IS SAID TO BE BECAUSE FRENCH GOVT HAS BEEN "HARD" ON IRANIAN STUDENTS THERE. KHOMEINI IS TO TRY TO INFLUENCE PARLIAMENTARIANS AND OTHER PROMINENT FRENCHMEN TO GO EASIER ON STUDENTS. (COMMENT: THIS SOUNDS LIKE A PRETTY LAME EXPLANATION TO US.)

PROMINENT PERSONALITIES AMONG RELIGIOUS ESTABLISHMENT IN IRAN HAVE CONVINCED KHOMEINI'S SON-IN-LAW (WHO STUDIES RELIGION HERE) TO JOIN KHOMEINI IN PARIS AND EXPLAIN TO HIM THAT HE IS PUSHING THINGS TOO FAST; HE MUST SLOW HIS FOLLOWERS DOWN. SAME MESSAGE HAS BEEN TELEPHONED TO KHOMEINI BY HIS BROTHER, PASSANDIDE, A RELIGIOUS LEADER WHO HAS BEEN LANGUISHING IN PRISON FOR MANY YEARS AND WAS RECENTLY RELEASED (BY SHARIF-EMAMI GOVT).

REASONS FOR "GO SLOW" MESSAGE, ACCORDING TO SAME SOURCE (AND OTHERS WE HAVE HEARD), ARE ESSENTIALLY THAT (A) TOP RELIGIOUS LEADERS HERE BELIEVE MOB DEMONSTRATIONS HAVE GOTTEN OUT OF THEIR OWN CONTROL AND ARE BEING STIMULATED BY UNKNOWN ELEMENTS NOT RESPONSIVE TO RELIGIOUS APPEALS, (B) MANY PROMINENT BAZAARI MERCHANTS ARE HURTING ECONOMICALLY AS A RESULT OF FREQUENT CLOSINGS OF BAZAARS, AND (C) ACCUSATION IS BEGINNING TO GAIN CURRENCY HERE HAT KHOMEINI IS ALLIED WITH THE COMMUNISTS. SOURCE FOR THE ABOVE ASSURED POL COUNS THAT SOME PROMINENT RELIGIOUS LEADERS (THOUGH NOT THE TOP ONES YET) ARE THEMSELVES BEGINNING TO SUSPECT THERE MAY BE TRUTH IN THAT ACCUSATION.

MEANWHILE PRESS OCTOBER 8 PLAYED UP REUTERS REPORT FROM PARIS THAT KHOMEINI WILL NOT RETURN TO IRAN DESPITE THE GOI'S NEW AMNESTY OFFER. PRESS NOTES VARIETY OF REPORTS THAT KHOMEINI IS UNDECIDED WHERE TO GO--ALGERIA BEING ONE OF THE POSSIBLE HAVENS MENTIONED. PRESS ALSO CARRIES JOINT STATEMENT FROM SEVERAL TOP SHIITE LEADERS IN IRAN (SHARIATMADARI, GOLPAYEGANI, NAJAFI-MARASHI) CONDEMNING IRAQI "EXPULSION" OF KHOMEINI. (COMMENT: THOUGH NOT KUWAITI REFUSAL OF ENTRY OF HIM) AS WELL AS SEPARATE CONDEMNATION OF IRAQIS BY NATIONAL FRONT POLITICAL LEADERSHIP.

ACTING FON MIN ZELLI MADE IT CLEAR TO AMBASSADOR MRONING OCTOBER 8 THAT GOI IS RELIEVED BY REPORT THAT KHOMEINI DOES NOT PLAN TO RETURN TO IRAN AT PRESENT. HE SAID GOI STILL SUSPECTS KHOMEINI MIGHT DECIDE TO GO TO SYRIA. FRENCH AMBASSADOR, ON THE OTHER HAND, SEEMED MORE IMPRESSED BY REPORT THAT ALGERIA HAS INVITED KHOMEIN; ONLY PARTLY TONGUE-IN CHEEK, HE TOLD THE AMBASSADOR THAT HE WAS SURE PLETHORA OF PRYING, EMBARRASSING QUESTIONS FROM FRENCH PRESS WOULD DRIVE KHOMEIN OUT OF PARIS IN PRETTY SHORT ORDER. LOCAL WIRE SERVICE REPRESENTATIVE TELLS US PRESS CANNOT FIND KHOMEINI IN PARIS AND AUTHORITIES ARE BEING CLOSE-MOUTHED ON HIS WHEREABOUTS.
FOR PARIS: REQUEST WE (AND DEPT) BE INFORMED IMMEDIATELY IF KHOMEINI SHOULD APPLY FOR U.S. VISA.

1978TEHRAN09822.subject: RESIGNATION OF MINISTER OF HEALTH ACCEPTED AFTER LESS THAN THREE MONTHS IN OFFICE, MINISTER OF HEALTH NASROLLAH MOJDEHI RESIGNED ON OCTOBER EIGHT. R EASO

segments.text: AFTER LESS THAN THREE MONTHS IN OFFICE, MINISTER OF HEALTH NASROLLAH MOJDEHI RESIGNED ON OCTOBER EIGHT. REASON GIVEN IN PRESS WAS CONFLICT WITH MINISTER OF STATE FOR EXECUTIVE AFFAIRS OVER MOJDEHI'S CHOICE OF DEPUTY MINISTERS. NEW HEALTH MINISTER IS SENATOR MOHAMMAD HASSAN MORSHED, A PHYSICIAN WHO WAS DEPUTY MINISTER OF HEALTH TEN YEARS AGO, BUT NOT ONE OF THOSE WHOM MOJDEHI HAD NOMINATED FOR HIS TEAM.

ARDESHIR ZAHEDI RETURNED TO TEHRAN AFTERNOON OCTOBER 9, AMID FLURRY OF RUMORS THAT HE WAS BRINGING EITHER U.S. OR HIS OWN PROPOSALS TO RESOLVE CURRENT CRISIS. CHEIF AMONG THESE RUMORS WAS REPORT THAT HE WAS GOING TO PROPOSE AMINI BE MADE PRIME MINISTER.

I WAS INVITED TO DINNER AT HIS HOUSE, ALONG WITH ABOUT FIFTY OF HIS MOST INTIMATE FRIENDS, ON EVENING OF OCTOBER 9 IN ORDER TO DO THE GREAT MAN HONOR. WHEN WE ARRIVED, WE WERE TOLD THAT HE HAD GONE TO HAVE DINNER WITH THE SHAH AND THAT WE WOULD HAVE TO DEFER THE PLEASURE.

HE THEN TELEPHONE ME MORNING OF OCTOBER 10 AND WE ARRANGED THAT HE WOULD COME FOR DRINKS AT 5:00 P.M. I WAS SUBSEQUENTLY TOLD MY AUDIENCE WITH SHAH WOULD BE AT 5:30, SO I WENT TO SEE HIM AT 1130 A..M. IN HIS HOME. THE SCENE WAS LIKE A BARONIAL LEVEE. JAMSHID AMOUZEGAR WAS JUST LEAVING, ASLAN AFSHAR WAS WAITING AND AT LEAST A DOZEN OTHER POLITICAL FIGURES HOVERED IN THE WINGS.

WE TALKED OVER AN HOUR AND IT APPEARS THAT HE HAS NO RPT NO PARTICULARLY DAZZLING PROPOSALS TO MAKE. HE SPECIFICALLY DENIED THAT HE WAS SPONSORING AMINI, ALTHOUGH HE ADMITTED AMINI WOULD COME TO SEE HIM LATER IN THE DAY. HE SAID HE FELT A CABINET CHANGE AT THIS TIME WOULD BE A SIGN OF WEAKNESS THAT WOULD CONTRIBUTE TO PUBLIC CAHOS.

HE ENCOURAGED ME TO URGE THE SHAH TO TAKE A MORE ACTIVE ROLE IN CURRENT AFFAIRS. HE SAYS HE IS AGAINST SOME OF THE TOUGHER MEASURES BEING PROPOSED BY THE MILITARY, ALTHOUGH HE WAS CRITICAL OF THOSE NATIONAL FRONT OPPOSITIONISTS WHO "PLACE TOO MUCH STRESS ON HUMAN RIGHTS." I WILL SEE HIM AGAIN BEFORE HE RETURNS TO WASHINGTON.

1978TEHRAN09855.subject: CUTBACK IN IRANIAN NUCLEAR POWER PROGRAM

segments.text: PRESS HAS REPORTED, WE BELIEVE ACCURATELY, THAT NUCLEAR POWER PROGRAM HAS BEEN CUT BACK TO ONLY THE FOUR POWER PLANTS NOW UNDER CONSTRUCTION AT BUSHEHR AND KARUN SITES. THIS ACTION IS PART OF GOVERNMENT'S OVERALL FISCAL RETRENCHMENT AND REASSESSMENTOF DEVELOPMENT PRIORITIES. INDUSTRY SOURCES AND GERMAN EMBASSY, HOWEVER, REPORT THAT THEY HAVE NOT YET BEEN TOLD TO CEASE PRELIMINARY WORK ON ADDITIONAL NUCLEAR POWER PLANTS, SO SITE SURVEY AND SIMILAR ACTIVITIES CONTINUE. GENERAL BELIEF OF UNOFFICIAL SOURCES IS THAT CUTBACK WILL BE MORE A PAUSE THAN A PERMANENT DECISION BECUASE IF COUNTRY IS TO CONTINUE ITS ADVANCEMENT, IT WILL NEED MORE NUCLEAR POWER.

AEOI VICE PRESIDENT MANZOOR TELLS US THAT "HE WON'T BE SURPRISED" IF NUCLEAR POWER PROGRAM IS CUT BACK, BUT THAT HIS ORGANIZATION HAS RECEIVED NO OFFICIAL NOTIFICATION. THE PROGRAM IS UNDER REVIEW, HE SAID, AND A DECISION WILL BE MADE WITHIN TWO WEEKS. HE SURMISED THAT PRESS REPORTS OF CUTBACK COME FROM PRIME MINISTER'S OFFICE SINCE THEY DEFINITELY DID NOT ORIGINATE IN AEOI.

I HAD LONG, SOMBER AUDIENCE WITH SHAH EVENING OCTOBER 10. HE WAS DRAWN-LOOKING AND TENSE, BUT THE CONVERSATION WAS ANIMATED. MY PURPOSE, AS HE KNEW IN ADVANCE FROM OTHERS I HAD SPOKEN WITH, WAS TO TRY TO SNAP HIM OUT OF HIS CURRENT FUNK AND TO FOCUS HIS ATTENTION ON PROBLEMS REQUIRING HIS LEADERSHIP. THE TWO AREAS WHICH I SUGGESTED AS NEEDING HIS PERSONAL CACHET WERE (A) THE REALLOCATION OF NATIONAL BUDGET RESOURCES AND REORDERING OF PRIORITIES, AND (B) THE ELECTIONS WHICH HE HAD ANNOUNCED FOR NEXT JUNE.

ALTHOUGH HE SEEMED PREPARED TO ADDRESS THOSE TWO ISSUES IN PRINCIPLE, HE WAS OBVIOUSLY PREOCCUPIED WITH THE CURRENT PANICKY STATE OF THE COUNTRY AND WITH THE PRESSURES HE WAS RECEIVING FROM ALL SIDES TO TAKE VARIOUS ACTIONS TO COPE WITH THE CURRENT EMERGENCY.

HE SAID HE HAD RECEIVED ALL SORTS OF SUGGESTIONS FOR CABINET CHANGES. HOWEVER, NONE OF THE PERSONS PROPOSED SEEMED TO HAVE ANY BETTER QUALIFICATIONS THAN THE CURRENT GROUP TO HANDLE THE PROBLEMS AT HAND. HE FELT THAT CHANGING CABINETS EVERY MONTH WOULD MERELY INDICATE WEAKNESS AND BE TREATED AS ANOTHER "CONCESSION" WHICH WOULD BEGET DEMANDS FOR FURTHER CONCESSIONS. CONSEQUENTLY, ALTHOUGH HE WAS FAR FROM HAPPY WITH THE JOB THE CURRENT CABINET WAS DOING, HE FELT IT BEST TO KEEP THEN ON, AND AVOID FURTHER CONFUSION.

HE THEN TURNED TO MATTER OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, WHICH HAS BEEN OCCUPYING MUCH OF HIS ATTENTION. HE SAID THAT AYATOLLAH SHARIAT-MADARI HAD SUGGESTED THAT SHAH PUBLICLY INVITE KHOMEINI TO RETURN TO IRAN. I SAID THAT I ASSUMED THIS WOULD INVOLVE CONDITION THAT KHOMEINI ACCEPT THE SHAH. HE SAID SHARIAT-MADARI WANTED THAT ASPECT TO BE TACITLY UNDERSTOOD, BUT THAT THE PUBLIC INVITATION BE UNCONDITIONAL. HE ASKED WHAT I THOUGHT.

I SAID I THOUGHT HE WOULD BE OUT OF HIS MIND TO ISSUE A PUBLIC UNCONDITIONAL INVITATION AND THEN, IF KHOMEINI ACCEPTED AND CONTINUED TO CONDEMN THE SHAH, HAVE THE MAN ARRESTED. MY OWN OPINION WAS THAT KHOMEINI HAD NO INTENTION TO RETURN TO IRAN. (HIS SUBSEQUENT PARIS INTERVIEW SEEMS TO REINFORCE THIS VIEW.) THEREFORE, IT WOULD BE BETTER TO LET THE MATTER REST WHERE IT STOOD. HE COULD GIVE NO EXPLANATION FOR SHARIATMADARI'S SUGGESTION.

AFTER DISPOSING OF THESE MATTERS, HE REVERTED TO THE TWO SUGGESTIONS I HAD MADE. HE SAID, AS FAR AS BUDGET REALLOCATION WAS CONCERNED, HE HAD ALREADY ORDERED CUTS IN THE MILITARY PROCUREMENT PROGRAM (NO MORE F-14, AND PERHAPS NO ADDITIONAL F-16 AIRCRAFT). HE HAD TOLD MILITARY THAT ALL BRITISH CHIEFTAIN TANKS HAD TO BE PURCHASED AGAINST PARALLEL OIL SALES TO BP AND SHELL. HE HAD ALSO STOPPED THE NUCLEAR REACTOR PROGRAM AT THE TWO FRENCH AND TWO GERMAN REACTORS NOW UNDER CONSTRUCTION. HE EXPECTED "LONG FACES" FROM THE GERMANS AND FRENCH. THESE BUDGET CUTS WOULD SUPPLY FUNDS FOR OTHER PROJECTS.
AS FOR WHAT THE OTHER PROJECTS WOULD BE, HE HAD GIVEN SOME HINTS IN HIS SPEECH FROM THE THRONE.

I SAID MY IMPRESSION WAS THAT GOVT PLANNERS NEEDED SOME GUIDANCE FROM HIM ABOUT THE AMOUNTS HE WANTED TO GO TO EACH PROGRAM. I ALSO THOUGHT IT WAS IMPORTANT THAT HE TAKE THE ELAD IN PRESENTING THESE PROGRAMS WHEN THEY ARE AGREED SO THAT THE PUBLIC WOULD KNOW THEY WERE HIS IDEAS AND NOT RPT NOT FURTHER "CONCESSIONS" CARVED OUT OF ------------------100424 111036Z /12 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 882 INFO AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY LONDON SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 09872 EXDIS PROGRAMS PREVIOUSLY IDENTIFIED WITH HIM.
HE TOOK THE SUGGESTION, BUT SEEMED TO HAVE SOME PROBLEMS KNOWING EXACTLY HOW HE WOULD GO ABOUT DOING IT.

TURNING TO ELECTIONS, HE SAID HE HAD BEEN GIVING THE MATTER THOUGHT. I SAID THE PROBLEM WAS HE HAD NOT YET SHARED THOSE THOUGHTS WITH HIS POLITICAL SUPPORTERS, WHO WERE MARKING TIME AWAITING HIS LEADERSHIP. I TOLD HIM OF HOVEYDA'S IDEAS ABOUT HAVING HIS SUPPORTERS RUN AS INDEPENDENTS. HE SAID HE DIDN'T AGREE. THEY HAD TO HAVE SOME PARTY PLATFORMS. MAYBE THERE WOULD BE A WHOLE RAFT OF PARTIES RATHER THAN A SINGLE NATIONAL PARTY, BUT THERE HAD TO BE SOME PARTIES OTHER THAN THE NATIONAL FRONT. HE WENT ON TO SAY THAT, UNFORTUNATELY, HE COULD NOT USE HOVEYDA IN ANY PUBLIC ROLE FOR THE TIME BEING.
THERE WAS TOO MUCH "JEALOUSY" INVOLVED.

HE THEN WENT INTO A LONG LAMENT ABOUT THE PERSIAN PERSONALITY, WHICH SEEMED TO CAUSE SO MANY PETTY QUARRELS AND TO INHIBIT EFFECTIVE TEAMWORK FOR THE NATIONAL INTEREST. HE WOULD LIKE TO USE ALL THE "ELDER STATESMEN" BUT THEY SEEMED UNABLE TO WORK WITH EACH OTHER.

NEXT, HE DISCUSSED HIS PROBLEMS WITH THE MILITARY. HE SAID THE GENERALS WERE CONCERNED THAT, IF THE CURRENT DISORDERS CONTINUED, THEY WOULD SPREAD TO THE TROOPS. THEY WERE PARTICULARLY WORRIED ABOUT YOUNG CONSCRIPTS FROM URBAN AREAS. AS A CONSEQUENCE, THEY WANTED TO CLAMP DOWN SHARPLY ON ALL DISORDER. HE WAS HAVING TO HOLD THEM BACK. THEY WERE STILL LOYAL BUT THEY SEEMED TO THINK HE HAD GROWN SOFT.

IN CLOSING, I TOLD HIM I HAD MET WITH TOUFANIAN TO POINT OUT THE ANNUAL SUPPORT COSTS AND THE ADDITIONAL ACQUISITION COSTS INHERENT IN MILITARY MATERIAL ALREADY PURCHASED FROM THE U.S. HE WAS A BIT TAKEN ABACK BY THE SIZE OF THE FIGURES. HE SAID THESE PURCHASES WOULD HAVE TO BE MADE AGAINST PARALLEL OIL BUYS. I POINTED OUT THAT IRAN LAST MONTH EXPORTED ABOUT 5.9 MILLION BARRELS A DAY. AT BEST, IT COULD STRETCH TO 6.2 MILLION. THERE WAS CONSEQUENTLY VERY LITTLE ADDITIONAL OIL THAT COULD BE PUT ON THE MARKET.

I ALSO SAID THAT, IF THE NIOC-CONSORTIUM DEADLOCK CONTINUED, THE MEMBERS WOULD PROBABLY LIFT LESS OIL BECUASE THEIR PROFITS WOULD SHRINK. HE SAID WE WOULD HAVE TO FIND INDEPENDENTS TO PICK UP THE SLACK. I DOUBTED THERE WERE THAT MANY AND THEIR DISTRIBUTION SYSTEMS WERE LIMITED. HE SAID HE WOULD DISCUSS IT WITH BLUMENTHAL WHEN HE ARRIVES.

COMMENT: ALL IN ALL, IT WAS A LESS THAN SATISFACTORY CONVERSATION, ALTHOUGH MORE DIRECT AND FRANK THAN OUR RECENT TALKS. I AM NOT SURE THAT HE WILL PICK UP MY SUGGESTIONS FOR LEADERSHIP ACTIONS, AND DOUBT HE WILL DO MUCH OF ANYTHING UNTIL THE CURRENT AFTERSHOCKS SETTLE DOWN. HOWEVER, IN CONTRAST TO HIS EARLIER MOODS, HE DID SEEM AT LEAST INTERESTED IN TALKING ABOUT THOSE ACTIONS. AS P.G. WODEHOUSE WOULD HAVE SAID, HE WAS NOT REALLY DISGRUNTLED, BUT THEN HE WAS NOT EXACTLY GRUNTLED, EITHER.

1978TEHRAN09892.subject: LIBERATION MOVEMENT OF IRAN (LMI): NEXT STEPS

segments.text: SUMMARY: LMI WANTS TO RESERVE POSSIBILITY OF MEETING WITH U.S. OFFICIALS. LMI BELIEVES BRITISH ARE BACKING NAHAVANDI STUDY GROUP. GROUP EXPECTS PRESENT SITUATION WILL CHANGE IN IMPORTANT WAYS OVER NEXT TWO WEEKS. END SUMMARY.

LMI REPRESENTATIVES CONTACTED POLOFF STEMPEL MORNING OCT 11 FOR ANSWER TO THEIR REQUEST FOR POLICY-LEVEL MEETING WITH U.S. OFFICIALS (REFTEL). THEY PAINTED SCENE IN IRAN AS VERY GREY, WITH SOME PEOPLE ON STRIKE BECAUSE OF DISCONTENT WITH GOVERNMENT, AND OTHERS STRIKING BECAUSE GOI ORDERED THEM TO DO SO TO HIDE "REAL NATURE OF UNREST." LMI REPS THEN ASKED WHAT U.S. RESPONSE WAS.

EMBOFF THEN SKETCHED U.S. POLICY: SUPPORT FOR SHAH AS BEST MEANS OF ACHIEVING SUCCESSFUL POLITICAL LIBERALIZATION, SUPPORT FOR POLITICAL LIBERALIZATION, BUT NON-INTERVENTION IN INTERNAL IRANIAN AFFAIRS. EMBOFF SAID THIS WAS USG POLICY, AND USG COULD NOT AGREE WITH LMI ASSUMPTION THAT SHAH HAD TO GO. IT WAS TIME FOR OPPOSITION ELEMENTS TO WORK TOGETHER TO PRESERVE SYSTEM FROM CHAOS THAT WOULD BENEFIT NO ONE AND POSSIBLY LEAD TO MILITARY OR TOTALITARIAN TAKEOVER. THERE APPEARED TO US ENOUGH ELEMENTS OF COMMON INTEREST EVEN BETWEEN LMI AND GOI THAT THERE WAS A GREAT DEAL MORE ROOM FOR GENUINE POLITICAL WORK THAN THERE HAD BEEN.
SHARIF-EMAMI GOVERNMENT WAS SEEKING GOALS--PRESS FREEDOM, UNIVERSITY INDEPENDENCE, FREEDOM OF ASSEMBLY, AND FREE ELECTIONS-WHICH ALL SUPPORTED.

LMI REPS SAID THEY COULD AGREE WITH MOST OF WHAT WAS SAID EXCEPT FOR ROLE OF SHAH, THEY EXPRESSED CONCERN FOR POSSIBLE "UNFORTUNUTE OUTCOME" OF ANARCHY AND SAID EVENTS IN COMING TWO WEEKS WOULD PROBABLY GIVE EVERYONE DIFFERENT PERSPECTIVE (COMMENT: IN MARKED CONTRAST TO ANXIETY EXPRESSED AT MEETING DESCRIBED REFTEL, LMI PAIR SEEMED CONFIDENT THAT TIME AND CIRCUMSTANCE WOULD BRING USG CLOSER TO THEIR VIEWS).

EMBOFF SAID LMI COULD HEAR USG POLICY EXPRESSED AT POLICY LEVEL IN WASHINGTON IF DESIRED. LMI REPS HASTENED TO REASSURE EMBOFF THAT THEY BELIEVED THEY WERE GETTING STRAIGHT U.S. LINE AND THOUGHT WASHINGTON MEETING "WAS NO NECESSARY "AT MOMENT"; THEY WISHED, HOWEVER, TO LEAVE OPEN THE POSSIBILITY AND THEREFORE RESERVED FORMAL RESPONSE TO OFFER UNTIL LATER.

LMI OFFICIAL THEN ASKED WHAT USG THOUGHT BRITISH ROLE WAS. EMBOFF REPLIED LIMI WOULD HAVE TO ASK UK, (WHICH THEY NOT PREPARED TO DO, ACCORDING TO SOURCE). EMBOFF THOUGHT UK POSTURE TOWARD GOI WAS ESSENTIALLY SAME AS U.S., BUT LMI REPS SAID THEY HAD IMPRESSION UK WAS MUCH MORE DISPOSED TO HELP SHAH AND ROYAL FAMILY AND WERE DEFINITELY SUPPORTING MINISTER OF SCIENCE AND HIGHER EDUCATION NAHAVANDI'S NASCENT POLITICAL GROUP. U.S. AT LEAST "HAD ITS HEART IN THE RIGHT PLACE." EMBOFF CAUTIONED LMI NOT TO MISINTERPRET U.S. POLICY--WE THOUGH SHAH'S CONTINUED PRESENCE NECESSARY FOR SUCCESSFUL OUTCOME O CHANGES IRAN WAS GOIN THROUGH.

IN RESPONSE TO EMBOFF'S QUESTION ABOUT DEVELOPMENTS IN NEAR FUTURE, LMI REPS SAID THERE WOULD PROBABLY BE RELIGIOUS PARADS ON OCT. 14 HOLIDAY CELEBRATING BIRTH OF IMAM REZA, AND THERE WOULD UNDOUBTEDLY BE "GENERAL STRIKE" OF SOME KIND OCT 18 OR 19 (PAIR LEFT IMPRESSION EXACT DATE AND MODE NOT YET SET). LMI REPRESENTATIVES THEN GAVE EMBOFF LATEST STATEMENT OF MOVEMENT'S POSITION IN PERSIAN AND ASKED TO SEE ENGLISH TRANSLATION. EMBOFF SUGGESTED THEY RECONTACT HIM IN TWO OR THREE DAYS, AND PAIR AGREED TO DO SO.
FOR PHILIP JOHNSON, EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR, OAK RIDGE ASSOCIATED UNIVERSITIES. PLEASE FURNISH DETAILED COST BREAKDOWN TO ACCOMPANY BILL TO ENTEC AS REQUESTED REFTEL.

KHAZANEH HAS RECEIVED LETTER FROM MOHAMMAD KARIM GHAMBARI ACKNOWLEDGING THAT HS IS ON PROBATION BUT CRITICAL OF ALLEGED STUDY PROGRAM. SINCE KHAZANEH MUST REPLY, HE WOULD APPRECIATE OAK RIDGE SENDING ITS OBSERVATIONS AND CURRENT STATUS OF GHAMBARI'S PROGRAM.

LAST, ENTEC REQUIRES FORMAL PROGRESS/PERFORMANCE REPORT FOR ALL TRAINEES. PERIODIC REPORTS, MORE OF WHICH YET RECEIVED, REQUESTED ON REGULAR BASIS, PER ARTICLE SIX OF CONTRACT. SULLIVAN NOTE BY OC/T: REFTEL NOT IN DEPARTMENT.

MY DISCUSSION WITH SHAH ON ELECTIONS WAS SOMEWHAT MORE BLUNT THAN REPORTED REFTEL. I STARTED BY TELLING HIM THAT HIS CURRENT SUPPORT IN THE UNITED STATES RESTED LARGELY ON FACT THAT HE WAS PERCEIVED AS PROPONENT OF DEMOCRACY. THIS HAD COME ABOUT IN LARGE MEASURE BECUASE OF HIS CONSTITUTION DAY SPEECH PROMISING "ONE HUNDRED PERCENT FREE ELECTIONS" IN JUNE.

IF HE FAILED TO HOLD THOSE ELCTIONS, THAT SUPPORT WOULD EVAPORATE. IF THE ELECTIONS WERE RIGGED, THE COUNTRY WOULD ERUPT. THEREFORE, LIKE IT OR NOT, HE WAS COMMITTED TO FREE ELECTIONS IN JUNE. HE SAID THAT WAS INDEED HIS POSITION.

IN THAT CASE, I SAID, NOBODY SEEMED TO BE DOING ANYTHING ABOUT PREPARING TO WIN THE ELCTIONS. IF EVERYONE CONTINUED PREOCCUPIED WITH DAILY CRISES, THE ELECTIONS WOULD BE SOON UPON US AND HE'D HAVE A MAJLIS FULL OF MULLAHS WHOSE FIRST ACT WOULD BE TO VOTE TO ABOLISH THE MONARCHY.
HIS HEAD DROOPED AT THIS DESCRIPTION AND HE LOOKED VERY TIRED. HE THEN STIFFENED AND CONTINUED WITH THE CONVERSATION AS REPORTED REFTEL.

AS I WAS FINISHING MY AUDIENCE WITH SHAH EVENING OCTOBER 10, OUR DISCUSSION TURNED TO PAKISTAN. I SAID IT LOOKED AS THOUGH SUPREME COURT REVIEW OF BHUTTO CASE WOULD BE COMPLETED SOON AND THERE SEEMED TO BE GENERAL CONSENSUS THAT SUPREME COURT WOULD UPHOLD HIS CONVICTION AND HIS SENTENCE.

LOOKING VERY GRAVE, SHAH SAID IN FLAT VOICE, "IN THAT CASE, ZIA WILL HANG HIM." I SAID THAT THE RESULTANT CHAOS WOULD BLOW PAKISTAN APART. THE SHAH SAID THAT ZIA REALIZES THAT, BUT WAS CONVINCED HIMSELF THAT HIS HONOR REQUIRES HIM TO CARRY OUT JUSTICE WITHOUT REGARD TO THE CONSEQUENCES. HE SAID THIS WAS HIS CLEAR IMPRESSION FROM THE LAST TALK HE HAD WITH ZIA.

1978TEHRAN09907.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT OCT 11 SUMMARY: WIDESPREAD UNREST CONTINUES -- DEMONSTRATIONS CONFIDENTIAL

segments.text: SUMMARY: WIDESPREAD UNREST CONTINUES -- DEMONSTRATIONS IN NONMARTIAL LAW TOWNS, STRIKES, AND UNIVERSITY CLOSURES. MANY SECONDARY SCHOOLS ALSO CLOSED. BRIEF DEMONSTRATIONS ALSO OCCUR IN MARTIAL LAW CITIES, DISPERSING WHEN TROOPS ARRIVE. ARMORED VEHICLES RETURNED TO STREETS OF ISFAHAN. CITIZENS' GROUP REPORTEDLY PETITIONED FOR MARTIAL LAW IN AMOL. PRESS REPORTS SIMILAR RESPONSE IN OTHER CITIES. A NUMBER OF POLITICAL PRISONERS WILL BE PARDOED ON SHAH'S BIRTHDAY OCT 26. ZAHEDI'S VISIT TO TEHRAN PROVOKES SPECULATION HE CARRIES MESSAGE FROM PRESIDENT CARTER. KHOMEINI ATTACKS BIG POWER PLOT" AGAINST IRAN. SANJABI DENIES NF WILL JOIN SOCIALIST INTERNATIONAL. IRANIAN CONSULATES WILL RENEW PASSPORTS SO LONG AS PERSON HAS NO CRIMINAL RECORD.
END SUMMARY

WIDESPRED DEMONSTRATIONS CONTINUE IN NONMARTIAL LAW TOWNS. POLICE FIRED ON UNRULY CROWD OCT 9 IN SANANDAJ, CROWD HAD SET FIRE TO THREE BANKS. TWENTY INJURIES ARE REPORTED, SOME OF THEM SERIOUS, BUT NO DEATHS. POLICE SISPERSED LARGE CROWD IN KHORRAMABAD WITH TEAR GAS SAME DAY. STUDENT WAS KILLED DURING CLASHES WITH SECURITY FORCES IN AMOL, BRINGING DEATH TOLL THERE TO AT LEAST FOUR. PRESS NAMES 23 OTHER TOWNS, BROADLY DISTRIBUTED THROUGHOUT IRAN, WHERE OTHER NEW DEMONSTRATIONS HAVE OCCURRED. ACCORDING TO PRESS, CITIZENS COMMITTEE IN AMOL PETITIONED GOVERNOR GENERAL OF MAZANDARAN TO DECLARE MARTIAL LAW. SIMILAR REACTIONS ARE REPORTED FROM ARAK, KERMANSHAH, SANANDAJ AND REZAIYEH.

PROTESTERS, MOSTLY STUDENTS, ARE ALSO DEMONSTRATING IN MARTIAL LAW CITIES. NEW FACTOR IS PARTICIPATION BY GROUPS OF HIGH SCHOOL AGE STUDENTS WHO APPEAR AND DISAPPEAR IN WIDELY SCATTERED LOCATIONS. POLICE DO NOT IMMEDIATELY ENFORCE MARTIAL LAW BAN ON GATHERING OF MORE THAN TWO PEOPLE. GROUPS ASSEMBLE AND SHOUT SLOGANS, POLICE OR SOLDIERS SEND FOR HELP, POWERFUL FORCE ARRIVES, AND CROWD INSTANTLY DISPERSES. MORNING OCT 11 A GROUP OF 15 TO 18 YEARS OLDS DEMONSTRATED IN FRONT OF NIOC ON TAKHTE JAMSHID, NOT FAR FROM EMBASSY. PRESS REPORTS ONE PERSON INJURED BY POLICE GUNFIRE IN SOUTH TEHRAN.

MORNING OCT 11 A GROUP SHOUTED ANTO SHAH SLOGANS AT REZA SHAH KEBIR HIGH SCHOOL NEAR EMBASSY. SECURITY FORCES DISPERSED CROWD WITHOUT INCIDENT. INCREASED MILITARY PRESENCE IS EVIDENT IN TEHRAN AND ISFAHAN. ARMORED VEHICLES HAVE RETURNED TO ISFHAN STREETS. IN TEHRAN TROOPS HAVE ASSEMBLED AT GOBA MOSQUE AND HOSSEINIEH ERSHAT RELIGIOUS SCHOOL NEAR FRIDAY MOSQUE. CITIES STILL INDER CONTROL; MILITARY BUILDUP APPEARS TO BE IN ANTICIPATION OF THREE DAY WEEKEND (OCT 14 IS BIRTHDAY OF IMAM REZA). SITUATION COMPLICATED BY FACT THAT LABOR-RELATED GATHERING HAVE BEEN PERMITTED DESPITE MARTIAL LAW.
OTHERWISE, AUTHORITIES DO BREAK UP POLITICAL ASSEMBLIES, AND WHEN STRIKE-RELATED GATHERING OF STUDENTS OUTSIDE NIOC TOOK POLITICAL ASPECT, SECURITY FORECES DISPERSED IT.

STUDENTS AND FACULTY STRIKES PREVENT MANY SCHOOLS FROM FUNCTIONING. AT LEAST 13 UNIVERSITIES AND COLLEGES HAVE NOT CONDUCTED CALSSES. REPORTS INDICATE UP TO 2000 HIGH SCHOOLS NATIONWIDE ARE NOT IN SESSION. SCHOOL CLOSURES PLUS LABOR DISPUTES CREATE SIZABLE SUPPLY OF AVAILABLE DEMONSTRATORS AT ANY TIME OF DAY.

AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI IN PARIS RELEASED ATTACK ON MAJOR POWERS, EAST AND WEST, FOR INTERFERING IN IRAN'S INTERNAL AFFAIRS. HE URGED STUDENTS TO CARRY ON FLIGHT AGAINST COLONIALISM BUT ALSO ADMONISHED THEM NOT TO DISRUPT THEIR EDUCATIONAL PLANS. HE EXPLICITY CRITICIZED COMMUNISM AND TUDEH PARTY FOR CONSPRIRING TO WEAKEN ISLAMIC FREEDOM MOVEMENT. HIS STATEMENT CAME DESPITE NUMEROUS REPORTS THAT FRENCH GOVT HAD FORBIDDEN HIM TO SPEAK OUT POLITICALLY.

IN POSSIBLY RELATED INCIDENT, MASKED GUNMEN ATTACKED IRAQI CONSULATE IN KHORRAMSHAHR OCT 10, KILLING GUARD. KHOMEINI'S FOLLOWERS HAVE CRITICIZED GOVT OF IRAQ FOR NOT ALLOWING KHOMEINI FREEDLY TO CONDUCT ACTIVITIES IN NAJAF.
IMPERIAL PARDON WILL BE GRANTED TO NUMBER OF PRISONERS ON SHAH'S BIRTHDAY OCT 26. SPECIFIC NUMBER HAS NOT BEEN REVEALED.
NATIONAL FRONT LEADER KARIM SANJABIDENIED PARTY WILL JOING SOCIALIST INTERNATIONAL. HE CONFIRMED, HOWEVER, HE WILL ATTEND SOCIALIST INTERNATIONAL CONGRESS NOV 3-5 IN VANCOUVER.
GOI ANNOUNCED IRANIAN CONSULATES WORLDWIDE WILL HENCEFORTH AUTOMATICALLY EXTEND PASSPORTS OF IRANIANS UNLESS THEY HAVE CRIMINAL RECORDS.

1978TEHRAN09908.subject: PIPE BOMB THROWN IN BELL HELICOPTER INTERNATIONAL ISFAHAN BUS - THREE INJURED

segments.text: INTERNATIONAL ISFAHAN BUS - THREE INJURED

AT APPROXIMATELY 1745 HOURS LOCAL TIME IN ISFAHAN, A PIPE BOMB EXPLODED IN A BHI BUS INJURING THREE AMERICAN BHI EMPLOYEES. TWO SUFFERED SUPERFICIAL CUTS TO FACE AND LEGS. THE THIRD SUFFERED A FLESH/PUNCTURE WOUND IN REAR THIGH AREA, WAS TREATED AND RELEASED FROM LOCAL HOSPITAL. NO INJURIES CONSIDERED SERIOUS.

BHI BUS, PROVIDED BY GOI, WAS PROCEEDING ON SCHEDULED AND REGULARLY FOLLOWED ROUTE FROM OFFICE TO BHI RESIDENTIAL COMPLEX LOCATED 15 MILES OUTSIDE OF ISFAHAN. WHEN BUS HAD PULLED TO ONE OF ITS REGULAR STOPS, MOTORCYCLE WITH TWO IRANIAN MALES SWUNG ALONGSIDE AND THREW ONE PIPEBOMB THROUGH OPEN WINDOW. BOMB EXPLODED ALMOST IMMEDIATELY CAUSING MINOR DAMAGE TO BUS AS WELL AS ABOVE-INDICATED INJURIES. TWELVE MALE AND FEMALE BHI EMPLOYEES WERE ON THE 30-CAPACITY BUS AT TIME OF EXPLOSION WITH DRIVER. BUS HAD NO GUARD. MOTORCYCLISTS ESCAPED. NO POLICE IN IMMEDIATE AREA.

RECOVERED FRAGMENTS OF BOMB INDICATE THAT A YELLOW POWDER SUBSTANCE EASILY PURCHASABLE IN LOCAL BAZAARS WAS USED AS EXPLOSIVE, ENCASED IN PIPE APPROXIMATELY ONE FOOT IN LENGTH, TWO-INCHES IN DIAMETER. EXPLOSIVE WAS APPARENTLY IGNITED BY FLAMING RAG IN MOLOTOV COCTAIL FASHION.

POLICE CONVINCED THAT INCIDENT HAS NO CONNECTION WITH CURRENT STRIKE IN ISFAHAN INVOLVING A BHI SUBCONTRACTOR. WE AGREE WITH INITIAL POLICE ASSESSMENT THAT BOMB WAS PROBABLY THROWN BY FANATICAL FRINGE OF DISSIDENCE MOVEMENT AS AGAINST BY MORE ORGANIZED, DISCIPLINED, PROFESSIONAL TERRORIST GROUPS SUCH AS CHARIKS OR MUJAHIDIN. BOMB, ITSELF, WAS OF CRUDE VARIETY COMMON TO INCIDENTS INVOLVING FIRE BRAND ELEMENTS OF CONSERVATIVE/RELIGIOUS GROUPS.
NO GROUP HAS PUBLICALLY CLAIMED RESPONSIBILITY FOR BOMBING. INVESTIGATION CONTINUING.

THANKS FOR YOUR THOUGHTFUL CABLE ATTEMPTING TO PULL TOGETHER SUGGESTIONS FOR COHERENT U.S. POLICY TOWARDS CURRENT SITUATION IN IRAN. EVENTS ARE MOVING SO FAST HERE THAT IT IS, INDEED, DIFFICULT FOR USG TO PAUSE LONG ENOUGH TO FORMULATE POLICY.

IN GENERAL, I THINK WE MUST FOUND OUR POLICY ON THREE PRINCIPLES: (A) U.S. WANTS STRONG IRAN; (B) IN ORDER TO REMAIN STRONG, IRAN MUST MAKE CURRENT TRANSITION IN CONTROLLED AND ORDERLY FASHION; (C) THERE IS NO OTHER INSTITUTION OR PERSONALITY WHICH CAN GUIDE THAT TRANSITION EXCEPT THE SHAH. THEREFORE, WE SUPPORT THE SHAH IN HIS EFFORT (BELATED, I'LL GRANT) TO GUIDE HIS COUNTRY THROUGH CURRENT TURMOIL.

THERE IS FAINT HOPE EMERGING THAT THE RESPONSIBLE MAJORITY OF IRANIANS ARE BEGINNING TO REALIZE THAT CURRENT CONFUSION CAN LEAD ONLY TO CHAOS OR TO A MILITARY TAKEOVER. MANY OF THE POLITICIANS WHO PRECIPITATED THIS TURMOIL ARE BEGINNING TO REALIZE IT IS GETTING OUT OF HAND. THEY PARTICULARLY REALIZE THAT SHAH MAY SOON BE THE ONLY PERSON WHO CAN PREVENT A MILITARY TAKEOVER. CONSEQUENTLY, THEY MAY BE PREPARED TO SWALLOW THEIR RHETORIC AND ACCEPT HIS CONTINUITY AS THE LESSER OF TWO EVILS.

THIS ACCEPTANCE WOULD, OF COURSE, ENTAIL UNDERSTANDING THAT SHAH'S POWERS WOULD BE REDUCED. PARLIAMENT WOULD BE FREELY ELECTED, CABINET WOULD ACTUALLY MAKE DAY-TO-DAY DECISIONS. SHAH WOULD, HOWEVER, SET THE POLICY LINES AND BE ACKNOWLEDGED LEADER. SITUATION WOULD BE LIKE THAT WHICH PREVAILS IN FRANCE WITH BARRE AS PRIME MINISTER BUT GISCARD AS RECOGNIZED LEADER.

IF THE POLITICIANS ACCEPT THIS OPPORTUNITY, RATHER THAN INSISTING ON THE SHAH'S HEAD, THEIR BEST COURSE OF ACTION SEEMS TO BE TO STAND FOR ELECTION TO PARLIAMENT. PROBLEM HERE IS THAT THEY ARE ALL CYNICS WHO DOUBT SINCERITY OF SHAH'S COMMITMENT TO FREE ELECTIONS. HOVEYDA HAS SUGGESTED HANDLING THIS PROBLEM BY HAVING A MEETING OF ALL POLITICAL PARTIES AND GROUPS (SOMETHING LIKE YOUR ROUND-TABLE IDEA) TO DEVELOP AN "ELECTION CHARTER" WHICH WOULD SET THE GROUND RULES AND WOULD THEN HAVE TO BE PUBLICLY ACCEPTED BY THE SHAH.

AS FOR NEW FACES IN GOVT, IT IS POSSIBLE A FEW MAY EMERGE. HOWEVER, AS YOU WILL HAVE SEEN FROM OUR REPORTING, ISLAMIC MODERATES FROM QOM SEEM TO HAVE MADE RETENTION OF CURRENT GOVT A CONDITION FOR THEIR COOPERATION. SHAH APPEARS TO THINK THIS GAME IS WORTH THE CANDLE.

ON TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE, I HAVE ALREADY OFFERED THE NATIONAL RURAL ELECTRIFICATION PEOPLE TO BOTH MINISTERS OF ENERGY AND AGRICULTURE. I THINK THEY SHOULD BE PUSHED, THROUGH THE JOINT COMMISSION. DICK COOPER CAN BRING THIS SUGGESTION. HE CAN ALSO BRING THE PROPOSAL THAT WORLD BANK ASSISTANCE BE SOUGHT. HOWEVER, THIS WILL NEED ENDORSEMENT OF JEHANGIR AMOUZEGAR, WHO HAS BLOCKED ALL BOB MC NAMARA'S OFFERS IN THE PAST.

PRESIDENT'S PRESS CONFERENCE STATEMENT OBVIATES NEED FOR TELEPHONE CALL FROM SECRETARY. HOWEVER, IT WOULD BE HELPFUL IF SECRETARY COULD SWING BY HERE FOR A FEW HOURS ON HIS WAY BACK FROM MOSCOW. WORK ON THAT ONE.
MY READING OF U.S. LEGISLATION EFFECTIVELY PROHIBITS US FROM HELPING OUT ON THE CROWD CONTROL/POLICE MEASURES. BELIEVE IT IS BEST TO LEAVE THIS IN HANDS OF BRITISH.

YOU WILL HAVE SEEN ACTIONS I HAVE TAKEN WITH SHAH AND OTHERS LOOKING TOWARDS THE FUTURE. I BELIEVE THIS IS WHERE WE CAN BEST CONCENTRATE OUR EFFORTS AT THIS TIME, WITH SPECIAL EMPHASIS ON ASSURING THAT THE ELECTIONS ARE PROPERLY HELD. I FEEL, AS THE PRESIDENT HAS STATED, THAT WE SHOULD NOT RPT NOT GET DEEPLY INVOLVED WITH INTERNAL POLITICS AND PERSONALITIES. THAT IS A VENOMOUS BUSINESS HERE AND ALL RPT ALL IRANIAN POLITICIANS ARE NOTORIOUSLY SELF-SERVING.

EMBASSY HAS STUDIED SPECIFICS INVOLVED IN BOMBING OF BELL HELICOPTER BUS, REPORTED REFA. INCIDENT WAS CLEARLY WORK OF NEWER TYPES OF TERRORISTS WHO HAVE MADE OCCASIONAL APPEARANCES OVER PAST FEW MONTHS, MAINLY IN ISFAHAN. THEIR WORK (AND EXPLOSIVES) ARE AMATEUR COMPARED TO MORE PROFESSIONAL TERRORIST GROUPS SUCH AS CHARIKS OR MUJAHIDIN, THOUGH THEIR CHOICE OF TARGETS ALSO SEEMS LESS DISCRIMINATING (E.G., BUS THIS TIME WITH WOMEN AS WELL AS MEN EMPLOYEES IN IT, OR EARLIER BOMBING OF FRONT DOOR OF ISFAHAN BHI EMPLOYEE'S HOME WITH HIS FAMILY IN IT).

WE BELIEVE PERPETRATORS BELONG TO FRINGE GROUPS OF OPPOSITION WHO MAY BE MOTIVATED BY EITHER RELIGIOUS OR LEFT-WING FANATICISM AGAINST WESTERN INFLUENCES IN IRANIAN LIFE. ATTACKS APPEAR INTENDED TO SOW ALARM AMONG FOREIGH (AMERICAN) COMMUNITY. THEIR INCIDENCE CORRESPONDS TO STEADILY INCREASING (IF STILL STATISTICALLY INSIGNIFICANT) NUMBER OF MINOR INCIDENTS SUCH AS THOSE INVOLVING INSULTS SHOUTED AT AMERICAN OR EUROPEAN MOTORISTS (ESPECIALLY LONE WOMEN) BY PEDESTRIANS OR PASSING MOTORISTS. THESE INCIDENTS HAVE NOT SO FAR REQUIRED ANY SPECIAL SECURITY COUNTER-MEASURES.

BUS CARRYING BHI EMPLOYEES HAD WIDE OPEN WINDOWS, NO GUARDS ON IT, DID NOT VARY ITS SCHEDULE, AND DRIVER DID NOT STAY ALERT TO SUSPICIOUS MOVEMENTS (AS OF MOTORCYCLISTS) AROUND HIM -- ALL VIOLATIONS OF GOOD SECURITY PRACTICE ALREADY RECOMMENDED TO, AND ACCEPTED BY, BHI AS WELL AS OTHER LEADING AMERICAN FIRMS HERE. AFTER FURTHER CONSULTATION WITH EMBASSY, BHI HAS ASSURED US IT IS TAKING STEPS TO IMPROVE ITS SECURITY PERFORMANCE. EMBASSY AND CONSULATE ISFAHAN WILL BE FOLLOWING UP THROUGH LOCAL U.S. SECURITY COMMITTEES.

WE BELIEVE STRICTER ADHERENCE TO ONGOING, FREQUENTLY ITERATED SECURITY PROCEDURES IS BEST RESPONSE WE CAN MAKE TO BUS INCIDENT. EMBASSY DOES NOT AT THIS TIME BELIEVE IT HELPFUL TO ISSUE RENEWED FORMAL STATEMENT OF ADVICE TO AMERICAN RESIDENTS OR TRAVELERS. THE AMERICAN COMMUNITY CONTINUES TO ENJOY THE FULLEST COOPERATION OF IRANIAN AUTHORITIES IN SECURITY MEASURES TO PROTECT AMERICANS AND THE EMBASSY IS RENEWING ITS REGULAR REMINDERS TO THE COMMUNITY TO KEEP ALERT.

1978TEHRAN09928.subject: NEWSPAPERS STRIKE IN REACTION TO CENSORSHIP

segments.text: WHEN I SAW THE SHAH EVENING OCTOBER 10, HE RAILED CONSIDERABLY AGAINST TEHRAN'S TWO LEADING NEWSPAPERS, KAYHAN AND ETELA'AT, WHICH, HE SAID, HAD BECOME VEHICLES FOR AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI. I SAID I READ THEIR ENGLISH LANGUAGE EDITIONS AND FOUND THEM RELATIVELY INOFFENSIVE. HE SAID THE FARSI EDITIONS WERE SLANDEROUS.

AS I WAS LEAVING, HE CAME BACK TO THIS SUBJECT AND SAID HE DID NOT RPT NOT WANT TO IMPOSE CENSORSHIP, BUT HE HOPED THE PUBLISHERS COULD BE PERSUADED TO BE LESS "LICENTIOUS." HE ASKED IF I COULD USE MY INFLUENCE WITH BOTH PUBLISHERS. I WAS NON-COMMITAL. MY SUBSEQUENT CHECKS INDICATE THAT THE FIRSI EDITIONS HAVE BEEN OCCASIONALLY SENSATIONAL, BUT HARDLY LICENTIOUS.
