OCTOBER 11 WAS THE SHAH'S DAY TO RECEIVE THE MILITARY IN AUDIENCE. I SUSPECT HE MADE SIMILAR REMARKS ABOUT THE PRESS TO THEM, BECAUSE THAT EVENING, GENERAL OVEISI, MILITARY GOVERNOR OF TEHRAN, SENT MILITARY CENSORS TO BOTH PAPERS. IN REACTION, THE STAFF OF BOTH PAPERS WENT ON STRIKE.

THE IRONY IS THAT THE JOURNALISTIC STAFF OF BOTH PAPERS WERE PREPARING TO STRIKE FOR WAGE DEMANDS THIS WEEKEND ANYWAY. BY HIS HEAVY-HANDED ACTION, OVEISI HAS GIVEN THEM A POPULAR ISSUE TO JUSTIFY THEIR STRIKE AND HAS GIVEN THE GOVT A BLACK EYE IN THE PROCESS.

THE PRIME MINISTER HAS PERSUADED OVEISI TO REMOVE THE CENSORS (A SOMEWHAT EMPTY GESTURE SINCE THE PAPERS ARE SHUT DOWN) AND WILL MEET WITH PUBLISHERS AND JOURNALISTS AT LUNCH OCTOBER 12 TO TRY TO RESOLVE THE ECONOMIC AND WAGE DEMANDS. 6.THE MEANTIME, I HAVE CONSULTATED WITH MY BRITISH COLLEAGUE AND HE HAS AGREED TO JOIN ME IN A DEMARCHE TO GENERAL OVEISI EITHER OCTOBER 13 OR 14 (BOTH OF WHICH ARE IRANIAN HOLIDAYS). OUR PURPOSE WILL BE TO REGISTER OUR DISMAY AT HIS STUPIDITY IN MOVING CENSORS INTO THESE PAPERS.

AT THE SAME TIME, WE WILL REGISTER OUR STRONG VIEWS THAT HE SHOULD EASE UP THE PRESSURES HE HAS BEEN PUTTING ON THE SHAH FOR SHARPER MILITARY ACTIONS IN THE CURRENT CRISIS. BEFORE DOING THIS, HOWEVER, WE WILL CHECK WITH PRIME MINISTER AFTER HIS LUNCHEON TO SEE IF SUCH A DEMARCHE WOULD, IN ANY WAY, FOUL UP HIS PLANS AND ACTIONS.

SUMMARY. STRIKES CONTINUE TO PROLIGERATE IN IRAN. THIRTY THOUSAND WORKERS AT THE ARYAMEHR STEEL MILL IN ISFHAN STRUCK ON OCTOBER 9TH. ON OCTOBER 10TH, EMPLOYEES FROM THE SARCHESHMEH COPPER COMPLEX AND THE BESHSHAHR INDUSTRIAL COMPLEX BEGAN STIKE ACTIONS. ON THE SAME DAY, ALMOST TWO THOUSAND WORKERS AT THE TABRIZ TRACTOR PLANT CEASED WORK. ON OCTOBER 11TH, EMPLOYEES OF PERSIAN AND ENGLISH LANGUAGE NEWSPAPERS IN TEHRAN STUCK, REPORTELY TO PROTEST MARTIAL LAW CENSORSHIP. WORK STOPPAGES CONTINUE AMONG SATE RAILWAY EMPLOYEES, NIRT REMAINS ON STIKE, AND THE STAFF OF SEVERAL OTHER GOVERNMENT MINISTRIES HAVE NOT YET RETURNED TO WORK. TEHRAN HOSPITALS ARE AFFECTED BY WORK STOPPAGES.

THROUGHOUT IRAN, EMPLOYEES OF RURAL COOPERATIVES, SOCIAL SECURITY FUNDS WORKERS, POSTAL WORKERS, ELECTRICITY AND WATER BOARD EMPLOYEES, AND EMPLOYEES OF NIOC COOPERATIVES ARE ON STRIKE. IN CONTRAST TO THE GREAT MAJORITY OF STRIKERS, TEACHERS AND STUDENT ACTIONS SEEM TO BE LARGELY POLITICALLY NOTIVATED. AT LEAST A PORTION OF WORKER RESENTMENT SEEMS NOW TO BE FOCUSIN THE EMPLOYMENT OF FOREIGN NATIONAL IN IRAN. THE GOVERNMENT DOES NOT YET SEEM TO BE RESPONDING TO THE STIKE ACTIONS IN A COORDINATED FASHION. STRIKES HAVE ALSO SEVERELY AFFFECTED PRIVATE SECTOR ENTERPRISES IN IRAN. END SUMMARY.

ACCORDING TO NEWSPAPER ACCOUNTS, THIRTY THOUSAND WORKERS AT THE ARYMEHR STEEL MILL IN ISFAHAN WENT ON STRIKE ON OCTOBER 9TH, DEMANDING THAT A 25 POINT PETITION OF DEMANDS BE APPROVED BY MANAGEMENT. WE AS YET DO NOT HAVE THE SPECIFIC LIST OF DEMANDS, BUT MEDIA REPORTS INDICATE THAT THE WORKERS WERE INSISTING ON THE DISMISSAL OF SELECTED DEPARTMENT HEADS. THE STRIKERS TOOK TO THE STREET OF ISFAHAN, SHOUTING AND WAVING PLACARDS, BUT THE DEMONSTRATION TROOPS NOW GUARD THE DESERTED MILL.

TWO THOUSAND WORKERS FROM THE SARCHESHMEH COPPER COMPLEX AND ANOTHER THREE THOUSAND EMPLOYEES OF THE BESHAHAR INDUSTRIAL COMPLEX STRUCK ON OCTOBER 10TH. WORKER'S DEMANDS INCLUDE PAID HOUSING ALLOWANCE AND INCREASES IN MEDICAL INSURANCE COVERAGE. PRESS REPORTS ALSO INCICATE THAT 1700 EMPLOYEES OF THE TABRIZ TRACTOR PLANT HAVE STRUCK IN PROTEST AGAINST THEIR LOW PAY AND POOR WORKING CONDITIONS. THEY ALSO DEMAND THAT THE GOVERNMENT NOT INTERFERE IN WORKERS' ATTEMPT TO ORGANIZE TRADE UNIONS.

ALL OF TEHRAN'S MAJOR NEWSPAPERS STRUCK THE MORNING OF OCTOBER 12TH. WHILE NEWSPAPER STAFF MEMBERS HAVE RECENTLY BEEN THREATENING A STRIKE ACTION IN DEMAND OF INCREASED SALARY AND BETTER WORKING CONDITIONS, THIS MASSIVE SHUT-DOWN WAS IN RESPONSE TO AN ATTEMPT ON THE PART OF MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES TO RE-INSTITUTE STRICT CENSORSHIP OF THE LOCAL PRESS. MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTATOR FOR TEHRAN, GENERAL OVEISI, SUPPOSEDLY ANGERED BY THE COVERAGE OF RECENT LABOR DISTURBANCES IN THE COUNTRY AND PERHAPS BY THE EXTENSIVE MEDIA TREATMENT GIVEN AYATTOLAH KHOMEINI IN RECENT DAYS, SENT CENSORS TO THE TWO MAJOR NEWSPAPER CHAINS WITHIN TEHRAN, KAYHAN AND ETTELAAT.

RATHER THAN SUBMIT THEIR STORIES FOR GOVERNMENT APPROVAL, THESE TWO ORGANIZATIONS SHUT DOWN AND OTHR CITY NEWSPAPERS STRUCKIN SYMPATHY. WE DO NOT YET HAVE INFORMATION ON THE CURRENT STATE OF NEGOTIATIONS BETWEEN THE AUTHORITIES AND NEWSPAPER EMPLOYEES.

AN ARTICLE IN THE OCTOBER 10TH ISSUE OF THE "TEHRAN JOURNAL" STATED THAT DESPITE A RADIO ANNOUNCEMENT TO THE COUNTRARY, THE STRIKE OF 30,000 RAILWAY EMPLOYEES CONTINUES. THE WORKERS CLAIM, ACCORDING TO THIS PRESS REPORT, THAT IN RECENT DAYS ONLY TWO OF A SCHEDULED FIFTEEN DAILY TRAINS HAVE BEEN ABLE TO DEPART FROM TEHRAN, AND THAT THOSE TWO WERE MOVED ONLY WHEN SECURITY FORCES THREATENED VIOLENCE. NEWSPAPER REPORT ALSO ERRED IN STATING THAT NIRT STRIKE ACTION HAD ENDED ON OCTOBER 9TH.

PRESS REPORTS NOW INDICATED THAT, WITH THE EXCEPTION OF THE STAFF OF THE CENTRAL NEWS OFFICE, NIRT EMPLOYEES HAVE DECIDED TO CONTINUE THEIR STRIKE DESPITE PROMISES BY THE MINISTER OF INFORMATION REZA AMELI THAT THEIR DEMANDS HAD BE ACCEPTED BY THE CABINET. ------------------126281 121350Z /41 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 926

GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES OF THE MINISTRIES OF FINANCE, COMMERCE, JUSTICE, THE PLAN AND BUDGET ORGANIZATION AND AT LEAST A SEGMENT OF THE EMPLOYEES OF SEVERAL OTHER MINISTRIES CONTINUE THEIR STRIKE. NEWSPAPER ACCOUNTS AN EMPLOYEE OF THE MINISTRY OF COMMERCE AS SAYING THAT GOVERNMENT WORKERS WOULD CONTINUE THEIR ACTION UNTIL MANAGEMENT AGREED TO RAISE SALARIES BY 100 PERCENT. THE EMPLOYEE CONTINED THAT GOVERNMENT WORKERS WERE ALSO DEMANDING THE RIGHT TO ESTABLISH A GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEE'S UNION, WHICH WOULD COORDINATE THE ACTIVITIES OF WORKERS IN ALL MINISTRIES AND RELATED AGENCIES.

TEHRAN HOSPITALS SUPERVISED BY THE MINISTRY OF HEALTH HAVE ALSO BEEN AFFECTED BY WORK STOPPAGES. EMPLOYEES ARE DEMANDING 100 PERCENT INCREASES IN SALARY AND STATE THAT ALLOWANCES SHOULD BE BROUGHT TO THE LEVEL OF THOSE ENJOYED BY FOREIGN STAFF MEMBERS. MEDIA REPORTS NOTE THAT THE HOSPITAL EMPLOYEES ARE ALSO INSISTING THAT THEIR WORK WEEK BE REDUCED TO 36 HOURS, AND THAT THEY RECEIVE BETTER OVERTIME AND HOLIDAY PAY. HOSPITAL STRIKES, INITIALLY CONFINED TO TEHRAN, ARE NOW REPORTEDLY IN EFFECT IN MANY PROVINCIAL CITIES.

UNCONFIRMED REPORTS IN OCTOBER 11TH NEWSPAPERS INDICATED THAT DOCTORS AND HOSPITAL EMPLOYEES AFFILIATED WITH THE MINISTRY OF HEALTH AGREED TO END THEIR STRIKE IN RESPONSE TO A HUMANITARIAN APPEAL MADE BY THE NEWLY APPOINTED MINISTER OF HEALTH AND WELFARE, DR. MOHAMMAD HASSAN MORSHED.

THROUGHOUT IRAN, A LARGE NUMBER OF RURAL COOPERATIVE WORKERS, TEACHERS, STUDENTS, SOCIAL SECURITY FUND WORKERS, POSTAL EMPLOYEES, ELECTRICITY AND WATER BOARD WORKDERS, AND EMPLOYEES OF VARIOUS NIOC COOPERATIVES REMAIN ON STRIKE. DEMANDS GENERALLY INCLUDE, ACCORDING TO MEDIA REPORTING, INCREASES IN PAY AND OVERTIME, MORE GENEROUS HOUSING LOANS AND AN END TO THE SYSTEM OF FAVORITISM ALLEDGEDLY PRACTICED IN MANY GOVERNMENT ORGANIZATIONS. AS MIGHT BE EXPECTED, WHILE MOST OF THE STRIKES HAVE BEEN MOTIVATED BY BASIC ECONOMIC ISSUES, THE TEACHER AND STUDENT ACTIONS ARE LARGELY POLITICALLY MOTIVATED.

IN A LETTER SENT TO THE PRESS ON OCTOBER 9TH, A GROUP OF ACADEMICIANS DEMANDED THAT TEACHERS NO LONGER BE FORCED TO DEMONSTRATE IN SUPPORT OF GOVERNMENT POLICIES. THEY ALSO DEMANDED THAT TEACHERS AND STUDENTS WHO WERE DISCREDITED DURING RECENT DISTURBANCES "BE REHABILITATED," THAT ALL ARRESTED TEACHERS AND STUDENTS BE IMMEDIATELY FREED, AND THAT PERMISSION BE GRANTED FOR THE REOPENING OF A CENTER FOR SAFEGUARDING TEACHERS' RIGHTS.

AT LEAST A PORTION OF WORKERS' RESENTMENT SEEMS NOW TO BE FOCUSING ON FOREI EMPLOYEES. GOVERNMENT WORKERS REPORTEDLY INCLUDE AMONG THEIR DEMANDS THE EXPULSION OF FOREIGN EXPERTS AND ADVISORS WHOM IRANIAN STRIKERS STATE RECEIVE HIGHER SALARIES AND WIELD MORE INFLUENCE THAN THEIR INDIGENOUS COUNTERPARTS. PRESS REPORTS INDICATE THAT AGRICULTURE AND RURAL AFFAIRS MINISTER AMIR PARVIZ, DURING A RECENT MEETING WITH DISGRUNTLED EMPLOYEES, FELT COMPELLED TO ADDRESS THIS QUESTION DIRECTLY, STATING THAT NO FOREIGN ADVISORS WITHIN HIS MINISTRY WERE RECEIVING UNDULY HIGH SALARIES.

THE DIRECTORS OF THE WORKERS' SYNDICATE OF THE FIRUZA ENGINEERING COMPANY, DURING A 10 OCTOBER MEETING WITH THE PRESIDENT OF THE IRAN WORKERS' ORGANIZAION, REPORTEDLY DEMANDED THAT THE "EXORBITANT" SALARIES OF FOREIGN WORKERS BE CONTROLLED, ADDING THAT THE HIGH WAGES PAID TO FOREIGN EMPLOYEES WERE A MAJOR SOURCE OF RESENTMENT AMONG IRANIAN WORKERS.

COMMENT: GOVERNMENTAL RESPONSE TO LABOR UNREST SEEMS ILL-COORDINATED AND POORLY PLANNED. WE HAVE CLEAR INDICATIONS THAT, FOR WHATEVER REASON, THE GOVERNMENT HAS NOT YET ATTEMPTED TO USE ESTABLISHED MECHANISMS TO DEAL WITH THE STRIKE SITUATIONS. DURING AN OCTOBER 9TH DISCUSSION WITH AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN, MINISTER FOR ECONOMIC AFFAIRS AND FINANCE YEGANEH ADMITTED THAT THE WAGE COUNCIL, THE ORGANIZATION WHICH NORMALLY WOULD COORDINATE WAGE POLICY, HAD NOT UP TO AT THAT TIME EVEN CONVENED. VARIOUS MINISTRIES SEEM TO DATE TO BE DEALING WITH STRIKERS IN AN AD HOC FASHIION.

WHILE MOST MEDIA REPORTING HAS FOCUSED ON LARGE SCALE STRIKES OF GOVERNMENT OR QUASI-GOVERNMENTAL EMPLOYEES, LABOR ACTIVITY HAS BY NO MEANS BEEN LIMITED TO PUBLIC SECTOR ENTERPRISES. STRIKES AND OTHER LABOR ACTIONS ARE NOW COMMON AMONG PRIVATE SECTOR CORPORATIONS, AND THIS PHENOMENON SEEMS TO BE ON THE INCREASE. "HE GOT HIS, NOW I'LL GET MINE" PHILOSOPHY SEEMS TO NOW BE RAMPANT IN IRAN. NO ONE, EITHER IN THE PUBLIC OR PRIVATE SECTOR, WANTS TO BE LEFT OUT IN THE RACE FOR HIGHER SALARIES AND MORE BENEFITS.

PRIME MINISTER SHARIF-EMAMI HAS BEEN BUSY OCT 12 AND 13 IN EFFORT RESOLVE NEWSPAPER STRIKE AND CENSORSHIP ISSUE. HE MET WITH BOTH PUBLISHERS AND JOURNALISTS AND HAS REPORTEDLY AGREED TO ACCEPT THEIR POLITICAL DEMANDS; I.E. HE WILL ISSUE A LETTER OCTOBER 15 SAYING THAT GOVERNMENT WILL RESPECT FREEDOM OF PRESS AND WILL NOT RPT NOT IMPOSE CENSORSHIP.
HE QUALIFIES THIS, HOWEVER, BY POINTING OUT THAT MARTIAL LAW GOVENOR CAN MAKE HIS OWN DECISIONS ON CENSOR SHIP WITHOUT REFERENCE TO GOVERNMENT AND COULD, INDEED, ARREST THE PRIME MINISTER.

PUBLISHERS AND JOURNALISTS HAVE REPORTEDLY DECIDED TO TAKE PRIME MINISTER AT HIS WORD AND GO BACK TO PUBLICATION ON OCTOBER 15. THIS COULD, OF COURSE, LEAD TO CONFRONTATION WITH GNERAL OVEISI AND, ULTURNATELY, BETWEEN PRIME MINISTER AND OVEISI.

IN VIEW THESE DEVELOPMENTS, BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND I HAVE DECIDED TO LET PRIME MINISTER'S STRATEGY RUN ITS COURSE BEFORE WE MOVE WITH OVEISI. IF PAPERS DO, INDEED RESUME PUBLICATION ON OCTOBER 15, WE WILL SEE OVEISI THAT DAY IN ORDER TO MAKE OUR POINTS. IF WE WERE TO SEE HIM BEFORE THAT TIME, WE COULD CONCEIVABLY UPSET THE RATHER DELICATE NEGOTIATIONS CURRENTLY IN TRAIN.

ADRESHIR ZAHEDI CAME TO DINNER OCTOBER 12 AND REMBLED ON FOR A THREE HOUR MONOLOGUE. NOT MUCH EMERGED THAT WE DO NOT ALREADY KNOWN EXCEPT FOR SOME HIGHLY EMBROIDERED REMINISCENCES OF HIS FATHER, HIMSELF AND A FEW OTHER LESSER FIGURES, SUCH AS THE SHAH.

HOWEVER, THERE WERE A FEW NUGGETS IN THE EFFLUVIUM: (A) HE WILL REMAIN HERE UNITL OCTOBER 20, AND MAYBE AS LATE AS OCTOBER 24. HE WILL BRING CROWN PRINCE TO WHITE HOUSE OCTOBER 26. (B) PRINCIPAL PURPOSE OF HIS STAY SEEMS TO BE POLITICKING. I HAVE DISTINCT IMPRESSION HW WILL RUN AS A CANDIDATE IN MAJLIS ELECTIONS NEXT JUNE AND HAS EVERY AMBITION TO BECOME IRAN'S NEXT PRIME MINISTER. (C) HE WOULD PERSONALLY HAVE NO OBJECTIONS IF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI WERE TO GO THE U.S. THE U.S. PRESS WOULD DEVOUR HIM. HE WOULD FEED HIM TO MIKE WALLACE AND BARBARA WALTERS.

(D) HE IS URGING THE SHAH TO GIVE MUCH MORE ATTENTION TO THE ELECTION PROCESS. (E) HE HAS TOLD SHARIF-EMAMI TO LET THE NEWSPAPER STRIKE GO ON "FOR THIRTY DAYS." IT WILL CUT DOWN THE FLOW OF DESTABLIIZING RUMORS AND, BY THE TIME THE PAPERS RE-OPEN, THE PUBLISHERS WILL BE MORE RESPONSIBLE.
HE IS OFF ON OCTOBER 15 FOR MASHAD AND QOM TO RALLY THE AYATOLLAHS.

1978TEHRAN09989.subject: PRESS STRIKE ENDS AS GOVERNMENT PROMISES NO FURTHER CENSORSHIP SUMMARY: PRESS RESUMED PUBLICATION OCT 15 AFTER P

segments.text: CENSORSHIP SUMMARY: PRESS RESUMED PUBLICATION OCT 15 AFTER PRIMIN SHARIFEMAMI SIGNED CHARTER AFFIRMING PRESS FREEDOM. GOVERNMENT PROMISED NOT TO INTERFERE DIRECTLY OR INDIRECTLY IN LAWFUL DUTIES OF NEWSPAPER MEN OR TO USE UNDUE INFLUENCE. CHARTER FURTHER GUARANTEES PROFESSIONAL SECURITY OF JOURNALISTS. END SUMMARY.

PRESS RESUMED PUBLICATION OCT. 15 AFTER WINNING WRITTEN GUARANTEE OF PRESS FREEDOM FROM SHARIF-EMAMI PREVIOUS EVENING. FOUR-DAY WALKOUT FOLLOWED MARTIAL LAW ATTEMPT TO CENSOR KAYAN AND ETELA'AT. JOURNALISTS DEMANDED: (A) ANNOUNCEMENT OF COMPLETE LIFTING OF CENSORSHIP; (B) NO DIRECT OR INDIRECT INTERFERENCE BY AN EXECUTIVE BODY IN NEWSPAPER PUBLICATION, AND FREEDOM FOR ALL PRESSMEN TO WORK AT THEIR POFESSION; (C) FULL MEDIA COVERAGE OF ATTEMPTED CENSORSHIP AND RESULTING STRIKE; AND (D) OFFICIAL WRITTEN GUARANTEE BU GOVERNMENT OF THESE RIGHTS.

AFTER EIGHT HOURS OF NEGOTIATING OCT 14 (IN ADDITION TO MANY HOURS ON DAYS BEFORE), SHARIF-EMAMI AND MINISTERS AZMOUN AND AMELI-TEHRANI MET JOURNALISTS' DEMANDS. ATTEMPT TO CENSOR PRESS WAS COVERED IN FORST POST-STRIKE EDITION, AND JOINT COMMUNIQUE WAS PRINTED ON FRONT PAGE. IN THIS CHARTER GOVERNMENT GUARANTEED: (A) FULL FREEDON OF THE PRESS IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE CONSTITUTION; (B) NONINTERFERENCE, DIRECT OR INDIRECT, BY GOVERNMENT AGENCIES IN THE EXERCISE OF THE LAWFUL DUTIES OF JOURNALISTS, AND NO USE OF UNDUE INFLUENCE IN THIS RESPECT; AND (C) PROFESSIONAL SECURITY FOR ALL MEMBERS OF THE PRESS; JUDICAIL AUTHORITIES ARE RESPONSIBLE FOR INVESTIGATING PRESS OFFENCES UNDER THE CONSTITUTION.

TEHRAN'S NEWSPAPER STIKE ENDED SUNDAY, OCTOBER 15, IN CONCONANCE WITH THE ARRANGEMENTS PRIME MINISTER HAD INDICATED EARLIER THIS WEEKEND. BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND I WENT AROUND SUNDAY MORNING TO CONGRATULATE HIM, TO INDICATE OUR SUPPORT FOR HIS ACTIONS, AND TO TAKE HIS PULSE.

WE FOUND HIM EBULLIENT AND OBVIOUSLY FEELING MORE SECURE NOW THAT THE SHAH HAS MADE CLEAR THAT DE DOES NOT INTEND TO CHANGE HIM. AS AN INDICATION OF THIS NEW DONFIDENCE, HE SAID THAT ALI AMINI, WHO HAD BEEN MOST ACTIVE CONTENDER FOR HIS JOB, HAD COME TO SEE HIM SATURDAY TO ASSURE HIM THAT HE HAD NO RPT NO AMBITION TO BE PRIME MINISTER AND THAT HE WOULD BE A LOYAL SUPPORTER.

PRIME MINISTER AVERRED THAT "90 PERCENT" OF ALL STRIKESHAD BEEN SETTLED AND HE EXPECTED TO HANDLE THE REST SHORTLY. HIS ARRANGEMENTS WITH AYATOLLAH SHARIAT-MANDARI WERE NEARLY COMPLETE. HE EXPECTED KHOMEINI TO GO TO SOME ARAB COUNTY, SUCH AS SYRIA AND REMAIN QUIET.

HE SAID HE HAD TOLD GENERAL OVEISI TO MOUNT A MAXMUM SHOW OF FORCE TO DISCOURAGE PROBLEMS ON OCTOBER 16, WHEN FORTY DAY MOURNING PERIOD FOR THOSE WHO LOST THEIR LIVES AT JALLEH SQUARE WILL TAKE PLACE. BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND I SAID WE WOULD BE SEEING OVEISI AFTERNOON OCTOBER 15. PRIME MINISTER THOUGHT THAT WAS GOOD IDEA.
AS WE WERE LEAVING, HE INDICATED THAT HE MIGHT CHANGE A FEW MINISTERS IN HIS GOVT DURING THE NEXT FEW DAYS. HE OBVIOUSLY DID NOT WISH TO REVEAL HIS HAND AT THIS TIME, HOWEVER.

POSTAL WORKERS THROUGHOUT IRAN HAVE BEEN ON STRIKE FOR OVER ONE WEEK. WE HAVE NO RELIABLE INDICATION AS TO HOW LONG STRIKE WILL LAST, BUT EXPECT NO RESOLUTION FOR NEXT SEVERAL DAYS AT LEAST. WILL ADVISE WHEN ADDITIONAL INFORMATION RECEIVED.

1978TEHRAN10007.subject: PRESIDENTIAL MESSAGE NEA/IRN PRECHT. WE ARE CONFIDENT YOU HAVE ANNUAL MESSAGE FOR OCTOBER 26 UNDER PREPARATION BUT WANTE

segments.text: NEA/IRN PRECHT. WE ARE CONFIDENT YOU HAVE ANNUAL MESSAGE FOR OCTOBER 26 UNDER PREPARATION BUT WANTED TO BE CERTAIN PRESS OF EVENTS HAS NOT DISTRACTED YOU. (THIS HAPPENED TO AN UNNAMED DIRECTOR A FEW YEARS AGO.)

1978TEHRAN10024.subject: GENERAL STRIKE CALLED FOR OCTOBER 16 PRESS AND BBC HAVE REPORTED AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI HAS CALLED FOR NATIONAL DAY OF MOURNING OCT 16 TO COMMEMORATE

segments.text: PRESS AND BBC HAVE REPORTED AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI HAS CALLED FOR NATIONAL DAY OF MOURNING OCT 16 TO COMMEMORATE THOSE KILLED SEPT 8 AT JALEH SQUARE. APPEAL FOLLOWS TRADITIONAL ISLAMIC CUSTOM OF MOURNING FORTY DAYS AFTER DEATH. NATIONAL FRONT HAS ECHOED APPEAL, SPECIFICALLY PROPOSING GENERAL STRIKE FOR OCT. 16. THIS CONFIRMS EARLIER REPORTS RECEIVED OVER THE WEEKEND FROM A VARIETY OF SOURCES. LEAFLET PURPORTING TO COME FROM KHOMEINI MADE APPEARANCE IN TEHRAN SUBURB OF DAROUS OCT 15; WHILE IT CALLS FOR 40TH DAY MOURNING, IT DOES NOT SET DATE OF 40TH DAY. COMMENT: WOULD APPEAR THESE CALLES ARE NOT RPT NOT FOR STREET DEMONSTRATIONS BUT FOR QUIETER FORMS OF PROTEST.
HOWEVER, SUCH DAYS HAVE RESULTED IN SOME (PERHAPS UNCOORDINATED) STREET DEMONSTRATIONS IN THE PAST.
BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND I SPENT AN HOUR THE AFTERNOON OF OCTOBER 15 WITH MARTIAL LAW MILITARY GOVERNOR GENERAL OVEISI. IT WAS A USEFUL MEETING.

WE FIRST DISCUSSED AT SOME LENGTH THE PROSPECTS FOR VIOLENCE ON OCTOBER 16, DURING ACTIVITIES WHICH WOULD COMMEMORATE THOSE KILLED AT JALLEH SQUARE ON SEPTEMBER 8. OVEISI SAID HE BELIEVED DAY OF MOURNING WOULD BE PEACEFUL. HE EXPECTED BAZAARS AND MANY BUSINESSES TO CLOSE, BUT DOUBTED THERE WOULD BE DEMONSTRATIONS.

WE COUNSELLED USE OF MINIMUM FORCE AND NON-LETHAL CROWD CONTROL TECHNIQUES IF THERE WERE ANY CONFRONTATIONS. HE ASSURED US THAT NON-LETHAL EQUIPMENT, INCLUDING RUBBER BULLETS, HAD BEEN WIDELY ISSUED TO HIS FORCES. HOWEVER, HE SAID HE HAD GIVEN ORDERS TO USE PERSUASION, DISCUSSION, AND SWEET REASON RATHER THAN RESORT TO ANY WEAPONS, IF POSSIBLE. NEVERTHELESS, HE HAD BROUGHT A GREAT NUMBER OF TROOPS INTO TEHRAN AS A MEANS OF DISSUASION.

I THEN GAVE THE GENERAL A VERY STERN LECTURE ABOUT THE TEMPTATIONS OF MILITARY COUPS. I SAID THERE WERE MANY RUMORS WHICH SUGGEST THE ARMY FEELS THE SHAH IS TOO SOFT, AND THAT HE SHOULD BE PUSHED INTO THE BACKGROUND WHILE THE MILITARY TAKES OVER. I SAID THESE THOUGHTS WERE ALLEGEDLY BEING JUSTIFIED BY SUGGESTIONS THAT U.S. AND U.K. WERE NOT RPT NOT REALLY SUPPORTING THE SHAH. I SAID I HOPED ALL OFFICERS UNDER HIS COMMAND KNEW THAT WE DID SUPPORT THE SHAH AND THAT WE DID NOT RPT NOT BELIEVE THE ARMY, WITHOUT THE SHAH, COULD COPE WITH THE CURRENT SITUATION.
WE WOULD STRONGLY OPPOSE ANY ACTION BY THE MILITARY TO TAKE OVER.

OVEISI PLEADED AT GREAT LENGTH HIS LOYALTY TO THE SHAH, THE DISCIPLINE OF HIS FORCES, AND HIS REJECTION OF ANY THOUGHTS ABOUT A MILITARY USURPATION. HE ATTRIBUTED FALSE RUMORS TO THE COMMUNISTS AND PLEADED WITH US TO TRUST THE LOYALTY AND LEGITIMACY OF THE ARMY.

I SAID WE HAD NO DOUBT OF HIS OWN INTEGRITY. HOWEVER, IF I WERE SUSPICIIOUS, I WOULD WONDER WHY HIS OFFICERS MOVED TO CENSOR THE PRESS AT THE VERY TIME THE PAPERS WERE TO CARRY PRESIDENT CARTER'S STATEMENT OF SUPPORT FOR THE SHAH. I ALSO POINTED OUT THAT THE CENSORSHIP HAD GIVEN THE SHAH A BAD IMAGE INTERNATIONALLY. BOTH THESE CONSEQUENCES WOULD CAUSE A SUSPICIOUS MAN TO WONDER ABOUT THE MOTIVIATIONS FOR CENSORSHIP.

OVEISI GASPED A LITTLE AND THEN LAUNCHED INTO A LONG DEFENSE OF HIS CNESORSHIP ACTION. HE PRODUCED LAWBOOKS, NEWSPAPERS, REPORTS AND BRIEFS TO JUSTIFY HIS ACTION. I REMAINED STUBBORNLY SUSPICIOUS, IN A PROLONGED PARODY OF PERSIAN PARANOIA. (IT REPAID ME IN GOOD PART FOR THE LONG HOURS IN WHICH I HAVE HAD TO EXPLAIN WHY THE CIA WAS NOT INVOLVED IN DESTABILIZING IRAN.)

FINALLY, WE TURNED TO OUR MEETING IN THE MORNING WITH THE PRIME MINISTER AND THE "CHARTER" HE HAD ISSUED GUARANTEEING FREEDOM OF THE PRESS. OVEISI SAID THE "CHARTER" WENT BEYOND THE LAW." HE HAD BEEN RIGHT IN CENSORING THE PRESS AND THE PRIME MINISTER WAS TECHNICALLY INCORRECT IN HIS ACTION. NEVERTHELESS, HE HASTENED TO SAY, HE RESPECTED THE ACTION THE PRIME MINISTER HAD TAKEN AND WOULD ALSO RESPECT THE PLEDGE OF NO CENSORSHIP. HE ONLY HOPED THE PRESS WOULD BEHAVE RESPONSIBLEY.

WE SAID WE FELT IT WAS IMPORTANT THAT NO DIVISIONS IN THE GOVT SHOULD BE OPENED UP FOR EXPLOITATION AGAINST THE INTERESTS OF THE NATION. SOME PEOPLE WERE SUGGESTING DIFFERENCES BETWEEN HIM AND THE PRIME MINISTER ON THIS CENSORSHIP ISSUE AS WELL AS OTHER MATTERS. WE WOULD FEEL REASSURED IF WE KNEW THAT HE WAS, INDEED, SUPPORTING THE PRIME MINISTER. HE SWORE ON THE QORAN THAT HE WAS.

COMMENT: I THINK WE GOT ACROSS ALL THREE POINTS: (A) NO MILITARY COUPS; (B) NO MORE CENSORSHIPV AND (C) NO RESORT TO LETHAL FORCE IN HANDLING POTENTIAL POPULAR DISTURBANCES. THE RESORT TO HISTRIONICS WAS, I BELIEVE, JUSTIFIED IN THE INTERESTS OF MAKING THE MESSAGE LOUD AND CLEAR.

1978TEHRAN10032.subject: PROPOSED GOI POLICE VISIT TO US

segments.text: IN EFFORT TO PROVIDE BETTER PROTECTION TO DIPLOMATIC COMMUNITY AND TO RELIEVE SOME PRESSURE FROM IRANIAN NATIONAL POLICE PRECINCTS, THE JOINT/SAVAK/INP COMMITTEE TASKED BY GOI WITH COORDINATING SECURITY MATTERS FOR FOREIGN COMMUNITY WISHES EXPLORE POSSIBILITY OF ESTABLISHING AN ORGANIZATION WITH FUNCTIONS SIMILAR TO EXECUTIVE PROTECTION SERVICE.

GOI WOULD LIKE TO SEND SELECTED DELEGATES FOR CONSULTATION WITH APPROPRIATE EPS, DC POLICE, AND/OR OTHER OFFICIALS. EMBASSY ENDORSES THIS REQUEST AS CONSTRUCTIVE. PLEASE ADVISE IF CONSULTATIONS CAN BE ARRANGED.

1978TEHRAN10036.subject: MILITARY VIEWS ON CURRENT IRANIAN SITUATION

segments.text: TWO RECENT PRIVATE CONVERSATIONS BETWEEN U.S. MILITARY OFFICERS AND VERY SENIOR IRANIAN OFFICERS ARE NOTEWORTHY INDICATIONS OF THE MODD AND THINKING AT TOP OF IRANIAN MILITARY ESTABLISHMENT.

ADMIRAL HABIBOLLAHI, COMMANDER-IN-CHIEF OF IMPERIAL IRANIAN NAVY, TOLD ADMIRAL COLLINS, CHIEF OF ARMISH/MAAG NAVY SECTION, THAT SHAH HAD GIVEN UP TOO MUCH TOO FAST DURING EVENTS OF RECENT WEEKS. ALTHOUGH IN NO WAY SUGGESTING HE DID NOT SUPPORT SHAH, HABIBOLLAHI SAID SHAH WOULD NO BE ABLE TO REMAIN IN POWER IF CURRENT ACTIVITIES AND TRENDS CONTINUE. HABIBOLLAHI NOTED RECENT EVENTS SUCH AS DEMONSTRATIONS, STRIKES, PAY INCREASES AS EXAMPLES OF ACTION HE HAD IN MIND. HE THOUGHT THAT PRIME MINISTER SHARIF-EMAMI WAS WEAK.

HABIBOLLAHI CLAIMED THAT WHENEVER ARMED FORCES TOOK CHARGE, PEOPLE WERE UNDERSTANDING AND SUPPORTIVE. AS AN EXAMPLE, HE DESCRIBED NAVY'S ACTIONS TAKING ON DUTIES OF STRIKING LONGSHOREMEN AND PILOTS IN BANDAR ABBAS AND VICINITY. HABIBOLLAHI CONCLUDED THAT IF SHAH FORCED FROM POWER, CIVIL WAR WOULD SURELY FOLLOW. MILITARY COULD NOT ALLOW THAT TO HAPPEN.

GENERAL RABII, COMMANDER-IN-CHIEF OF IMPERIAL IRANIAN AIR FORCE, FOLLOWED SIMILAR LINE IN CONVERSATION WITH GENERAL GAST, COMMANDER OF ARMISH/MAAG. LT. GENERAL JAHANBANI, IIAF DEPUTY COMMANDER FOR PLANS AND PROGRAMS, WAS PRESENT. RABII SAID SO MANY UNFORTUNATE EVENTS TAKING PLACE IN IRAN THAT FUTURE MAY WELL DEPEND ON ARMED FORCES. AT A CERTAIN POINT, ONLY MILITARY RULE COULD SAVE THE COUNTRY. RABII DID SUGGEST THAT ONE EFFECT OF RECENT DOMESTIC EVENTS COULD BE TO WEAKEN DISCIPLINE WITHIN ARMED FORCES. LIKE HABIBOLLAHI, RABII IN NO WAY SUGGESTED THAT SHAH HAD LOST HIS WELL-KNOWN, PERSONAL SUPPORT.

AMBASSADOR HAS DIRECTED CARMISH MAAG GENERAL GAST TO INFORM CHIEF SUPREME COMMANDER STAFF GENERAL AZHARI ON OCT 16, WITHOUT IDENTIFYING THE INDIVIDUAL OFFICERS RESPONSIBLE FOR THESE COMMENTS, THAT THE AMBASSADOR WAS DEEPLY TROUBLED BY THESE STATEMENTS. HE WANTED AZHARI TO KNOW THAT U.S. FELT THE SHAH WAS THE INSTITUTION THAT COULD LEAD THE NATION THROUGH ITS CURRENT CRISIS. WE DID NOT RPT NOT FEEL ARMED FORCES COULD BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS COMPLICATED TASK. THE CURRENT SITUATION WAS FAR MORE COMPLEX THAT IT WAS IN 1953.

THE AMBASSADOR WAS PREPARED TO PRESENT THESE VIEWS TO ANY GROUP OF OFFICERS SUGGESTED BY AZHARI AND TO EXPLAIN THE PREDICTABLE CONSEQUENCES OF A MILITARY TAKEOVER. AMBASSADOR HAS ALREADY TALKED WITH GENERAL OVEISI ON THIS SUBJECT.
WE WILL REPORT RESULTS OF GENERAL GAST CONVERSATION WITH AZHARI.

I CALLED ON COURT MINISTER ARDALAN MORNING OCTOBER 16 AND FILLED HIM IN ON DISCUSSION I HAVE HAD IN PAST FEW DAYS, SOME IN CONJUNCTION WITH MY BRITISH COLLEAGUE. I SAID THESE TALKS HAD BEEN FOR PURPOSE MAKING U.S. POSITION CLEAR TO ALL INTERESTED PARTIES AND DISPELLING FALSE RUMORS.
ARDALAN SAID HE WAS VERY PLEASED WITH POSITION TAKEN BY U.S., ESPECIALLY RECENT STATEMENT BY PRESIDENT CARTER. HE SAID THIS HAD SERVED TO GIVE SHAH NEW SENSE OF CONFIDENCE.

I SAID I FELT I SHOULD TELL HIM THAT MY SENIOR MILITARY OFFICERS WERE HEARING DISTURBING STATEMENTS OF IMPATIENCE FROM SOME SENIOR IRANIAN MILITARY OFFICERS. I HAD INSTRUCTED MAAG CHIEF TO TELL GENERAL AZHARI THAT WE WOULD FIRMLY OPPOSE MILITARY TAKE-OVER. I HAD ALSO MADE SAME POINT TO GENERAL OVEISI, IN COMPANY WITH BRITISH AMBASSADOR. ARDALAN LOOKED VERY SOBERED AND THANKED ME FOR THAT ACTION.

HE THEN SAID SHAH HAD CONSULTED HIM ABOUT MY RECOMMENDATION THAT HE SPEAK OUT ON NEW PROGRAMS AND NEW DIRECTIONS. SHAH HAD APPARENTLY WANTED TO SPEAK VERY SOON AND ARDALAN HAD PERSUADED HIM TO WAIT A BIT. HE ASKED MY ADVICE.

I SAID IT WAS HIGHLY IMPORTANT SHAH NOT GO OFF HALFCOCKED. IF HE ANNOUNCED NEW PROGRAMS, THEY SHOULD HAVE BEEN CAREFULLY STUDIED IN ADVANCE TO MAKE SURE THEY WERE REALISTIC AND ACHIEVABLE. I FELT HE SHOULD DELAY HIS SPEECH UNTIL ALL THESE ASPECTS HAD BEEN CAREFULLY STUDIED. ARDALAN AGREED AND THOUGHT SOMETIME IN MID TO LATE NOVEMBER WOULD BE PROPITIOUS. SULLIVAN NOTE BY OC/T: NOT PASSED TO ABOVE ADDRESSEES.

AS YOUR WILL SEE FROM SEPTEL, I DO NOT SEE ANY POINT IN PRESSING AHEAD AT THIS TIME WITH THE NUCLEAR AGREEMENT. WE CAN LET EVENTS TAKE THEIR NATURAL COURSE (E.G. CLEANING UP REMAINING PERSIAN TEXT ISSUES) AND AWAIT THE MOST POLITICALLY PROPITIOUS TIME TO CONCLUDE THIS SAGA. IT, THEREFORE, SEEMS LIKELY THAT THE IRANIAN AGREEMENT WILL NOT BE THE FIRST UNDER THE NEW POLICY GUIDELINES AND THAT OTHERS WILL BE COMPLETED IN THE MEANTIME. THE DRAFT IRANIAN AGREEMENT IS IN MY VIEW AN EXCELLENT NON-PROLIFERATION DOCUMENT AND ONE THAT MAY BE DIFFICULT TO DUPLICATE ELSEWHERE.

THE IRANIANS WILL BE WATCHING EVENTS CAREFULLY AND MAY WISH TO REOPEN NEGOTIATIONS SHOULD OTHER AGREEMENTS PROVE TO BE MORE FAVORABLE. WE WILL FIND THIS OUT WHEN WE OURSELVES REOPEN THE REPROCESSING MATTER VIA THE EXCHANGE OF NOTES.
GENERAL GAST MET MID-DAY OCTOBER 16 WITH GENERAL AZHARI, CHIEF OF SUPREME COMMANDER'S STAFF, AND MADE AMBASSADOR'S POINTS REPORTED IN REFTEL.

AZHARI TOOK MORE MODERATE APPROACH TO CURRENT SITUATION THAN HAD ADMIRAL HABIBOLLAHI AND GENERAL RABII. HE SAID SHAH STILL VERY MUCH IN CONTROL OF COUNTRY AND IRANIAN MILITARY TAKES ITS ORDERS FROM THE SHAH.

AS FOR PRIME MINISTER SHARIF-EMAMI, MILITARY DOES NOT RPT NOT TAKE ORDERS FROM HIM, BUT RESPONDS TO HIM BECAUSE HE IS GOOD, PATRIOTIC MAN. IF AN UNTRUSTWORTHY PRIME MINISTER SHOULD REPLACE SHARIF-EMAMI, CLEARLY THAT SITUATION WOULD CHANGE.

AZHARI STATED FIRMLY THAT MILITARY RULE IS NOT NOW NEEDED IN IRAN. SITUATION IS INDEED DIFFERENT FROM THAT OF 1953. THE PEOPLE WOULD NOT UNDERSTAND OR ACCEPT MILITARY RULE UNDER PRESENT CIRCUMSTANCES. THE SHAH WILL NOT RPT NOT ASK FOR MILITARY RULE EXCEPT AS A LAST RESORT AND THE MILITARY WILL ASSUME GOVERNMENTAL AUTHORITY ONLY IF SHAH SO REQUESTS.

AZHARI REPORTED THAT HE AND MILITARY SERVICE CHIEFS HAD PARTICIPATED IN CABINET MEETING WHICH MADE DECISION ON MARTIAL LAW DECLARATION. IN FACT HE AND PRIME MINISTER HAD HAD JOINT TELEPHONE CONVERSATIONS WITH SHAH DURING DECISION-MAKING PROCESS. IN ADDITION, SHAH HAD AGREED THAT AZHARI'S J-1, LT. GEN. MUSA RAHIMI LARIJANI, A "WISE MAN," WOULD BE GENERAL OVEISI'S DEPUTY AS TEHRAN MARTIAL LAW COMMANDER.
IN HIS CAPACITY AS TEHRAN MARTIAL LAW COMMANDER, OVEISI REPORTS DIRECTLY TO SHAH, BUT KEEPS AZHARI INFORMED. AZHARI PERSONALLY SUPERVISES COMMANDER'S IN IRAN'S OTHER CITIES UNDER MARTIAL LAW.

AZHARI SAID HE HAD, IN CONNECTION WITH IRAN'S INTERNAL SITUATION, REGULAR MEETINGS WITH MOST SENIOR MILITARY OFFICERS. HE WANTED THEM TO UNDERSTAND IMPORTANCE OF KEEPING BLOOD OFF MILITARY'S HANDS. HE MENTIONED SOME OF THE NON-LETHAL EQUIPMENT (RUBBER BULLETS, WATER CANNONS) GOI HAS ACQUIRED FOR CROWD CONTROL. MEETING OF SENIOR MILITARY OFFICERS HAD TAKEN PLACE JUST EVENING BEFORE. AMONG OTHER THINGS THEY HAD DISCUSSED POINTS MADE BY AMBASSADOR IN HIS CALL EARLIER THAT DAY ON GENERAL OVEISI (TEHRAN 10031 NOTAL).

AZHARI IS PROUD THAT IRANIAN MILITARY IS HIGHLY RESPECTED BY THE PEOPLE. JUST DAY BEFORE HE HAD IN FULL UNIFORM DRIVEN FOR TWO HOURS THROUGH SOUTH TEHRAN AND RECEIVED FRIENDLY GREETINGS FROM MANY PEOPLE.

1978TEHRAN10061.subject: THE SHARIF-EMAMI GOVERNMENT: AN ANALYSIS AND PROJECTION

segments.text: SUMMARY: THIS IS THE FIRST OF A SERIES OF CABLES WHICH WILL ANALYZE IMPORTANT FACTORS INVOLVED IN THE IRANIAN INTERNAL SITUATION AS PROMISED IN REFTEL. THE SHARIF-EMAMI GOVT OF ACCOMMODATION BEGAN LIFE UNDER HANDICAP OF MARTIAL LAW AND IS STILL STRUGGLING WITH THE CENTRAL PROBLEM OF STILLING WIDESPREAD CIVIL UNREST LED BY IRAN'S RELIGIOUS LEADERS AND FUELED BY A WIDE SPECTRUM OF POLITICAL AND ECONOMIC COMPLAINTS. IT STUMBLED BADLY BY INTRODUCING THREE DRAFT LAWS FOR FREEDOM OF THE PRESS, OF UNIVERSITY ADMINISTRATION, AND OF ASSEMBLY WHICH WERE IMMEDIATELY CRITICIZED AS MORE RESTRICTIVE THAN THE SITUATIONS THEY WERE SUPPOSED TO CORRECT.

IT IS NEVERTHE LESS DETERMINED TO SOLDIER ON, HAVING MADE CONCESSIONS TO THE RELIGIOUS LEADERS (WITH WHOM IT IS AT PRESENT TRYING TO NEGOTIATE), APPROVED LARGE WAGE INCREASES TO SILENCE STRIKING CIVIL SERVANTS AND OTHER GOVERNMENT WORKERS, AND PRESSED ITS ANTI-CORRUPTION CAMPAIGN IN RESPONSE TO PARLIAMENTARY AND PUBLIC DEMANDS FOR PUNISHMENT OF PROFITEERS. FAILURE IN THE NEGOTIATIONS WITH RELIGIOUS LEADERS WOULD ALMOST CERTAINLY BRING EARLY DEMISE OF THIS GOVT. EVEN SUCCESS IN REACHING A MODUS VIVENDI WITH THEM, HOWEVER, DOES NOT IN ITSELF GUARANTEE GOI LONGEVITY.

THE GOI'S DEMONSTRATED LACK OF FORESIGHT, PLUS THE PROBLEMS OF SERVING A DIFFICULT MASTER IN THE SHAH AND COORDINATING WITH A SEPARATE MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATION, HAVE CREATED A HOST OF SIDE PROBLEMS. THESE MIGHT CONTINUE TO GENERATE UNREST WHICH THE RELIGIOUS LEADERS CANNOT CONTROL. ANY GOI RESORT TO REPRESSIVE MEASURES INVOLVING BLOODSHED THEN COULD FORCE THE RELIGIOUS LEADERS TO RENEGE ON THE MODUS VIVENDI. END SUMMARY.

FACED BY INCREASINGLY LARGE SCALE PROTESTS UNDER THE LEADERSHIP OF RELIGIOUS CONSERVATIVES, THE SHAH DISMISSED THE AMOUZEGAR TECHNOCRAT GOVT AND ON AUGUST 27 APPOINTED A NEW GOVT UNDER SHARIF-EMAMI. ITS MISSION WAS TO CALM THE UNREST AND ACCOMMODATE ITSELF TO RELIGIOUS AND OTHER ELEMENTS OF THE POPULATION INVOLVED IN WIDESPREAD DEMONSTRATIONS. THE NEW CABINET REPRESENTS A POTPOURRI OF VARIOUS SKILLS AND INTERESTS. ITS OVERALL AGE IS CONSIDERABLY GREATER THAN IN AMOUZEGAR'S CABINET, THERE ARE FAR FEWER MINISTERS TRAINED IN THE U.S., AND THERE ARE SEVERAL WHO IN EARLY LIFE WERE TUDEH (COMMUNIST) PARTY MEMBERS. SHARIF-EMAMI HIMSELF IS A FORMER P.M.

AND SIX OF HIS MINISTERS, MAINLY IN ECONOMIC AREAS, ARE CARRYOVER FROM THE PREVIOUS CABINET. THE REST ARE MAINLY ELDER STATESMEN WHO PROMISED GREATER SENSITIVITY TO POPULAR GRIEVANCES. IN A SYMBOLIC GESTURE, THE MINISTRY FOR WOMEN AFFAIRS WAS ABOLISHED AND THE ENDOWMENT FUND (THE OLD ISLAMIC VAQF) WAS RAISED TO CABINET LEVEL UNDER KANI, A MINISTER WHO IS VERY POPULAR WITH THE RELIGIOUS SECTOR. SHARIF-EMAMI HIMSELF, COMING FROM A RELIGIOUS FAMILY, WAS REPUTED TO HAVE STRONG RELIGIOUS TIES, AS WAS MINISTER FOR EXECUTIVE AFFAIRS AZMOUN. NEVERTHELESS, THE GOVT REMAINS ONE OF SHAH LOYALISTS, THE PRIME MINISTER HIMSELF BEING KNOWN AS PERSONALLY VERY CLOSE TO THE SHAH.

MOREOVER, THE RELIGIOUS CREDENTIALS OF SHARIF-EMAMI AND AZMOUN ARE WIDELY QUESTIONED AMOUNG ORTHODOX RELIGIOUS CIRCLES, WHO CONSIDER NON-RELIGIOUS BEHAVIOR TO HAVE TARNISHED THEIR RELIGIOUS BIRTHRIGHTS. ------------------059311 161500Z /50L FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 978 INFO USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY PARIS USLO PEKING USCINCEUR SECTION 2 OF 4 TEHRAN 10061

REPORTS PUT OUT AT THE TIME OF SHARIF-EMAMI'S PRESENTATION OF HIS GOVT TO THE SHAH SUGGESTED TO NEW PRIME MINISTER HAD DEMANDED AND GOTTEN A GREAT DEAL MORE INDEPENDENCE THAN AMOUZEGAR OR HOVEYDA BEFORE HIM, AND THAT HE WOULD BEGIN A TRANSITION TO STRONGER MINISTERIAL GOVT. INDEED HE MOVED FAST IN ATTEMPTING TO DEFUSE THE MOST EXPLOSIVE ISSUE, GRANTING SEVERAL CONCESSION IN THE RELIGIOUS FIELD.

THE HEGIRA CALENDAR REPLACED THE PAHLAVI IMPERIAL CALENDAR (ONLY INTRODUCED A FEW YEARS AGO), IRAN'S FEW GAMBLING CASINOS FOR THE VERY RICH WERE CLOSED, A FEW PROMINENT MEMBERS OF THE BAHAI RELIGION--AND OTHERS SUSPECTED OF TIES TO THIS GROUP DETESTED BY ORTHODOX SHIISM (SUCH AS HOVEYDA HIMSELF)--WERE DISMISSED FROM HIGH OFFICE, AND THE SHAH'S TWIN SISTER PRINCESS ASHRAF-AGAINST WHOM MANY COMPLAINTS ARE AIRED-- DISAPPEARED FROM NEWS COVERAGE. INDEED MANY PROMINENT MEMBERS OF THE ROYAL FAMILY (WHO ARE WIDELY ACCUSED OF CORRUPTION) HAVE LEFT THE COUNTRY. ONLY THE QUEEN HAS SHARED RECENT PUBLIC APPEARANCES WITH THE SHAH.

UNFORTUNATELY, SHARIF-EMAMI'S ELAN WAS SEVERELY JOLTED WHEN LARGE DEMONSTRATIONS IN TEHRAN AT THE END OF RAMAZAN ALARMED THE ARMY, GOVT, AND SHAH TO THE POINT THAT MARTIAL LAW WAS INSTITUTED IN 11 IRANIAN CITIES (ADDED TO ISFAHAN, THE ONLY CITY WHERE IT ALREADY EXISTED). THE ARMY MET ITS FIRST CHALLENGE FROM DEMONSTRATORS IN TEHRAN'S JALEH SQUARE ON SEPT 8 BY KILLING LARGE NUMBERS OF THEM. THIS "MASSACRE" IMMEDIATELY TURNED EVEN THE MODERATE RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP AGAINST SHARIF-EMAMI'S GOVT, AND HE HAS BEEN TRYING TO LIVE DOWN THAT INCIDENT SINCE.

ANOTHER MAJOR PROGRAM LAUNCHED BY SHARIF-EMAMI IS THE ANTI-CORRUPTION CAMPAIGN. AS PRACTICED TO DATE IT HAS CONSISTED OF PUBLIC ARRAIGNMENT OF THE FORMER MINISTER OF HEALTH (UNDER HOVEYDA AND AMOUZEGAR GOVTS) AND CHARGES LODGED AGAINST A HANDFUL OF LESSER HIGH OFFICIALS, AS WELL AS THE NAMING OF SEVERAL LARGER BUSINESSMEN AS TARGETS OF SPECIAL INVESTIGATIONS (ONE OF WHOSE PARLIAMENTARY IMMUNITY WAS REMOVED). THERE IS TALK OF A LIST OFPEOPLE TO BE INVESTIGATED GOING INTO THE THOUSANDS, AND HUNDREDS HAVE REPUTEDLY BEEN WARNED NOT TO LEAVE THE COUNTRY.

NEVERTHELESS, MINISTER OF JUSTICE BAHERI (HIMSELF A TUDEH COMMUNIST PARTY MEMBER IN HIS YOUTH), HAS WARNED THAT LEGAL PROCESSES WILL TAKE TIME AND PROOF OF WRONG-DOING WILL NOT BE EASY TO PRODUCE IN MANY CASES. MEANWHILE, A LEGAL CASE HAS BEEN PUT WITH THE MILITARY COURT SYSTEM AGAINST FORMER SAVAK CHIEF GEN. NASSIRI NEW COURT MINISTER ARDALAN (WHO HAS REPLACED HOVEYDA) HAS ANNOUNCED WITH HEAVY PUBLICITY THAT THE SHAH HAS BARRED MEMBERS OF HIS FAMILY FROM INVOLVEMENT IN BUSINESS DEALS.

ALL THIS HAS SO FAR BEEN RECEIVED WITH NOTICEABLE SKEPTICISM BY THE PUBLIC AT LARGE AS WELL AS THE IRANIAN PARLIAMENT, WHERE EVEN MANY PARLIAMENTARIANS WHO ARE CONSIDERED CONSERVATIVES AND LOYAL TO THE SYSTEM HAVE BEGUN TO ATTACK PAST GOVT PRACTICES ALLEGING WIDESPREAD CORRUPTION AND INEFFICIENCY IN THE GOI BUREACRACY. ------------------059471 161501Z /50L FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 979 INFO USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY PARIS USLO PEKING USCINCEUR SECTION 3 OF 4 TEHRAN 10061

IN THE POLITICAL FIELD, THE SHARIF-EMAMI GOVT HAS MOVED VIGOROUSLY BUT CLUMSILY. IT DELIBERATELY BROUGHT THE COLLAPSE OF THE SINGLE GOVT PARTY, THE "RASTAKHIZ" (RESURGENCE) PARTY, AND HAS ENCOURAGED ITS REPLACEMENT BY A MULTIPLICITY OF POLITICAL GROUPS AND PARTIES IN PREPARATION FOR THE FREE ELECTIONS PROMISED BY THE SHAH NEXT JUNE. THE PRESS HAS BEEN ALLOWED TO BECOME ASTONISHINGLY FREE AFTER YEARS OF MUCH MORE STRINGENT, EXPLICIT OR IMPLICIT, CENSORSHIP. LIVE RADIO AND TV CARRIED IN FULL MANY STRONG ANTI-GOVT SPEECHES FROM PARLIAMENT FOR THE FIRST TIME IN RECENT MEMORY.

A FEW DAYS OF CENSORSHIP BY MILITARY LAW AUTHORITIES OCT 12-14 HAS RESULTED IN AN UNPRECENDENTED "CHARTER" GUARANTEEING FREEDOM OF THE PRESS FROM SHARIF-EMAMI ON BEHALF OF HIS GOVT. MEANWHILE, THE GOVT INTORDUCED IN RAPID SUCCESSION THREE NEW DRAFT LAWS TO GOVERN FREEDOM OF THE PRESS, INDEPENDENCE OF THE UNIVERSITIES, AND FREEDOM OF ASSEMBLY. UNFORTUNATELY THE FIRST AND THIRD OF THESE BILLS HAD BEEN DRAFTED BY THE OUTGOING GOVT, AND NONE OF THEM WAS SHOWN TO MEMBERS OF THE CONSTITUENCY MOST AFFECTED.

THUS THERE WAS AN IMMEDIATE OUTCRY FROM MEMBERS OF THE PRESS, FROM UNIVERSITY FACULTIES AND ADMINISTRATORS, AND FROM LAWYERS AND PARLIAMENTARIANS, ALL ALLEGING THAT THESE BILLS WERE IN FACT MORE RESTRICTIVE THAN THE SITUATIONS THEY WERE SUPPOSED TO BE CORRECTING. CONSEQUENTLY, WHATEVER THE DETAILED MERITS OF THESE CRITICISMS MAY BE, ALL THREE BILLS RAN INTO TROUBLE IN PARLIAMENT AND HAVE BEEN RECALLED FOR FURTHER DISCUSSION AND EMENDATION. THIS DID LITTLE TO IMPROVE THE ALREADY SHAKY CREDIBILITY OF THE NEW GOI.

THE GOI'S EFFORTS TO AVOID ROCKING THE BOAT IN THE ECONOMIC SPHERE RAN INTO STORMY WEATHER WHEN STRIKES BROKE OUT AMONG A VARIETY OF CIVIL SERVANTS, OIL FIELD WORKERS AND OTHER INDUSTRIAL WORKERS. IN THE SPIRIT OF ACCOMMODATION, THE GOVT HAS SPEEDILY GIVEN IN TO ALMOST ALL ECONOMIC DEMANDS WITH THE RESULT THAT WAGES HAVE VIRTUALLY DOUBLED IN MANY AREAS, AND MORE CIVIL SERVANTS ARE GOINGON STRIKE TO GET SIMILAR BENEFITS. THE WAGE INCREASES TO CIVIL SERVANTS WILL LIKELY BE FOLLOWED BY INCREASES TO EMPLOYEES OF PRIVATE COMPANIES.

THUS AN INFLATIONARY CYCLE HAS BEEN FUELED DESPITE THE PARTIALLY DEFLATIONARY EFFECT THAT THE GOVT EXPECTS TO GET FROM CUTTING THE DEFENSE BUDGET AND INSTITUTING OTHER LARGE-SCALE ECONOMIES SUCH AS A FREEZE ON FUTURE PROCUREMENT OF NUCLEAR REACTORS.

ALL OF THESE ERRORS AND REVERSES, COMPOUNDEDBY PARLIAMENTARY AND PUBLIC CRITICISM, HAVE NATURALLY BROUGHT CONFLICTS WITHIN THE CABINET, ITSELF A DISPARATE BODY OF PEOPLE. DESPITE UNHAPPINESS BY THOSE IN CHARGE OF THE ECONOMIC MINISTRIES, AND OTHER REPORTED PERSONAL ANIMOSITIES, ONLY TWO RESIGNATIONS HAVE OCCURED TO DATE, THAT OF THE MINISTER OF HEALTH, WHO WAS IMMEDIATELY REPLACED, AND, ON OCT 12, THE MINISTER OF SCIENCE AND HIGHER EDUCATION (WHOSE RESIGNATION IS NOT YET PUBLIC).

A FEW MORE RESIGNATIONS CANNOT BE RULED OUT, PARTICULARLY IN VIEW OF THE SCATTERGUN APPROACH OF PARLIAMENTARY AND OTHER CRITICS WHOSE ALLEGATION OF INEFFICENCY AND CORRUPTION COULD EXTEND TO SOME OF THE PRESENT INCUMBENTS AS IT ALREADY HAS TO MANY OF THEIR PREDECESSORS. NEVERTHELESS, THE SHAH IS DETERMINED TO CONTINUE WITHOUT A CHANGE IN PRIME MINISTER FOR THE PRESENT, AND WE EXPECT STRONG EFFORTS TO CONTINUE TO BE MADE MTING CABINET CONFLICTS. ------------------059540 161502Z /50L FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 980 INFO USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY PARIS USLO PEKING USCINCEUR SECTION 4 OF 4 TEHRAN 10061

THE MOST CRITICAL IMMEDIATE PROBLEM FACING THE GOVT IN MID-OCTOBER IS SOMEHOW BRINGING AN END TO WIDESPREAD DISORDERS WHICH HAVE AFFECTED SCORES OF IRANIAN CITIES AND TOWNS AND CAUSED CASUALTIES AMOUNG DEMONSTRATORS AS WELL AS POLICE FORCES. AN IMPORTANT ELEMENT IS THE EXTENSIVE UNREST AMOUNG UNIVERSITY STUDENTS, OFTEN SUPPORTED BY FACULTY MEMBERS, WHICH HAS EXTENDED RECENTLY TO MANY SECONDARY SCHOOLS AND THEIR TEACHERS. THE GOT'S STRATEGY IS TO NEGOTIATE QUIETLY WITH THE BLOC OF MODERATE RELIGIOUS LEADERS AND OPPOSITION POLITICIANS AND MEANWHILE CONTAIN THE DISTURBANCES, IN THE HOPE THAT SUCH A DEAL WILL ISOLATE TROUBLEMAKERS WHO COME FROM MORE EXTREMIST GROUPS.

INDIRECT EFFORTS ARE REPORTEDLY BEING MADE TO PROPITIATE EVEN AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI. SHOULD THESE EFFORTS BE SUCCESSFUL, THEY WILL GO A LONG WAY TOWARD ACCOMMODATING SIMILAR GOVT DIFFICULTIES WITH UNIVERSITY FACULTIES AND THE MAJOR STUDENT GROUPS. THE GOVT'S OBJECTIVE IS OBVIOUSLY TO AVOID HAVING TO EXTEND MARTIAL LAW, AND IN FACT TO END IT AS SOON A PRACTICIABLE PRIOR TO NEXT SUMMER'S ELECTIONS.

THUS, AFTER NEARLY TWO MONTHS IN OFFICE IN A PERIOD OF UNPRECENDENTED TURMOIL, THE SHARIF-EMAMI GOVT HAS TURNED IN A SPOTTY PERFORMANCE AND, ALTHOUGH THE SHAH APPEARS READY TO KEEP IT IN OFFICE FOR THE NEAR FUTURE AT LEAST, IT IS STILL VIEWED AT LARGE AS A TRANSITIONAL BODY OF BRIEF TENURE. ITS ERRATIC PERFORMANCE IS NOT SURPRISING. THE NATION HAS BEEN SHAKEN TO ITS VERY ROOTS IN THE LAST FEW MONTHS. NO PREVIOUS GOI IN RECENT MEMORY INHERITED SUCH ACOMPLEX AND VOLATILE SET OF PROBLEMS.

MOREOVER, THE PRIME MINISTER HAS HAD TO CONTEND INSIDE THE ESTABLISHMENT WITH AN INTROSPECTIVE, ALOOF, AND OFTEN ARBITRARY SHAH AS WELL AS AN ANGRY, IMPATIENT, AND AT TIMES RASH MILITARY HIGH COMMAND. THAT HE CONSEQUENTLY HAS TO WORK WITHIN NARROW PARAMETERS IS STARKLY APPARENT.

IF SHARIF-EMAMI IS SUCCESSFUL IN ACHIEVING A MODUS VIVENDI WITH THE RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP THOUGH HIS CURRENT NEGOTIATIONS, HE MAY HAVE TAKEN A MAJOR STEP TOWARD AN EVENTUAL CALMING OF THE BODY POLITIC. THIS EFFORT CLEARLY HAD TO BE HIS FIRST PRIORITY. HOWEVER, HIS GOVT HAS SINGULARLY DISTINGUISHED ITSELF BY A FAILURE TO LOOK AHEAD TO THE CONSEQUENCES OF ITS HASTY AND AD HOC ACTIONS. BY ATTEMPTING TO PLACATE VARIOUS SEGMENTS OF THE NATION WITH THE QUICK FIX -- SUCH AS THE LARGE PAY RAISES, THE ILLCONSIDERED PIECES OF LEGISLATION, ETC. THE GOI HAS UNWITTINGLY CONTRIBUTED TO STIRRING UP A NUMBER OF OTHER HORNETS NESTS.

THESE COMPOUND THE GOVT'S ALREAD CONSIDERABLE PROBLEM OF COORDINATING WITH THE SHAH'S MOODS AND THE ARMY'S ACTIONS, AND COULD HELP UNDERMINE WHATEVER THE GOVT MIGHT ACHIEVE IN THE NEGOTIATIONS WITH THE RELIGIOUS LEADERS.

A FURTHER QUESTION IS WHETHER THE RELIGIOUS LEADERS THEMSELVES CAN FULLY CONTROL OR CHANNEL THE WIDESPREAD DISORDER. THEY HAVE BEEN LEADING THE UNREST THIS YEAR; IT IS YET TO BE PROVEN THAT THEY CAN REVERSE THE TREND IN VIEW OF THE MANY DISPARATE ELEMENTS OF THE POPULATION NOW AGITATING FOR THEIR OWN SEPARATE INTERESTS. SHOULD THE RELIGIOUS LEADERS PROVE ONLY PARTIALLY EFFECTIVE IN THIS REGARD, THE GOVT WOULD HAVE TO FACE UP TO CONTINUING DISTURBANCES WHOSE FORCEFUL REPRESSION MIGHT INVOLVE BLOODSHED--AND THUS FORCE THE RELIGIOUS LEADERS BACK ON THE WARPATH TO PRESERVE THEIR POSITION WITH THE POPULATION.

SUMMARY: EMBASSY IS CALLING DEPT'S ATTENTION TO RECENT ARTICLE ON CAMP DAVID AGREEMENTS BY PROMINENT NEWSPAPER COMMENTATOR IN IRAN. ARTICLE IS ONE OF A SERIES MOSTLY ATTACKING THE AGREEMENTS AND SUGGESTING THEY INDICATE U.S. POLICY IS FALLING INTO A BILATERAL APPROACH WHICH THREATENS TO REPEAT THE MISTAKES OF THE 1950S. WHILE COMMENTATOR'S AUDIENCE IS LIMITED, WE SEE SOMETHING TO BE GAINED BY ARGUING WITH HIM IN PRIVATE AND WOULD APPRECIATE ANY SPECIFIC ASSISTANCE ON HIS ARGUMENTS THAT DEPT OR OTHER ADDRESSEES CARE TO PROVIDE. END SUMMARY.

NEWSPAPER ARTICLE IN REFTEL IS AN EXAMPLE OF NEGATIVE LOCAL COMMENT ON CAMP DAVID AGREEMENTS BEING PUBLISHED ESPECIALLY BY FARIBORZ ATAPOUR, ONE OF IRAN'S MOST PROLIFIC COMMENTATORS ON FOREIGN AFFAIRS.

ATAPOUR IS A SPECIAL PERSON. WITH A LONG, DEEP BACKGROUND IN MIDDLE EASTERN AFFAIRS HE PRIDES HIMSELF ON FORESIGHT AND PERSPECTIVE. HE TOLD THE AMBASSADOR RECENTLY TO BE ON THE LOOK-OUT FOR THIS ARTICLE, WHICH THE AMBASSADOR WOULD NOT LIKE, AND HAD SINCE TOLD THE POLITICAL COUNSELOR THERE ARE AT LEAST TWO MORE ARTICLES ABOUT TO APPEAR WHICH COMPLETE HIS NEGATIVE ANALYSIS OF CURRENT U.S. POLICY IN THE M.E.

ON THE BASIS OF INTERNAL EVIDENCE, THE AMBASSADOR SUSPECTED CONSIDERABLE INPUT FROM THE SOVIET EMBASSY HER, PARTICULARLY AMBASSADOR VINOGRADOV WHO REMAINS CO-CHAIRMAN OF THE GENEVA CONFERENCE. HOWEVER, ATAPOUR HAS DENIED ANY SUCH INSPIRATION, OR INDEED CONTACT WITH THE SOVIETS ON CAMP DAVID. HE TOLD POL COUNSELOR THE SOVIETS ARE HARDLY READING THE DOCUMENTS AND ARE INCAPABLE OF HIS OWN SUBTLETY OF ANALYSIS ANYWAY. HE ADDS THAT THE ARTICLES ARE EACH THE PRODUCTS OF 16-17 HOURS OF CONCENTRATED THOUGH AND RESEARCH ON HIS PART.

WE HAVE SOME DOUBTS, FRANKLY, AS TO HOW MANY PEOPLE ARE READING ATAPOUR'S ARTICLES ANYHOW. SINCE CAMP DAVID IS NOT PERCEIVED AS DEALING WITH LIFE-OR-DEATH ISSUES BY THE EDUCATED ELITE HERE, AND ARE GENERALLY IGNORED BY THE MASS AUDIENCE WHICH IS WRAPPED UP ALMOST ENTIRELY IN ITS OWN IRANIAN PROBLEMS AT THE MOMENT, THE DAMAGE ATAPOUR CAN DO IS LIMITED. NEVERTHELESS, THE ARGUMENTS HE PRESENTS COULD BE CONVINCING TO THE FEW WHO ARE INTERESTED IN THE ISSUE AND MIGHT INFLUENCE SUCH PUBLIC OPINION AS EXISTS.

ATAPOUR'S CURRENT THESIS IS THAT U.S. IS SLIPPING INTO A BILATERAL APPROACH ON MIDDLE EAST PROBLEMS WHICH THREATENS TO REPEAT THE MISTAKES OF THE 1950S AND MIGHT PLAY INTO SOVIET HANDS IN THE LONG RUN, AS WELL AS WEAKENING INSTITUTIONS SUCH AS THE U.N. HE ALSO SAYS U.S. HARDSELL APPROACH ON CAMP DAVID AS EVIDENCED BY SAUNDERS AND QUAFDT "SET UP" INTERVIEWS TURNS PEOPLE OFF AND IS COUNTER-PRODUCTIVE. THIS HE SAYS ALSO APPLIES TO THE MODERATE ARAB GOVERNMENTS, WHO HAVE (SOMEWHAT SURPROSINGLY) AGREED TO GO TO BAGHDAD CONFERENCE.

EMBASSY/ICA OFFICERS WHO COME INTO CONTACT WITH HIM WILL TAKE TIME TO POINT OUT THE IMPORTANT ELEMENTS OF U.N. MULTILATERALISM INVOLVED IN OUR AREA APPROACH (INCLUDING UNDOF, UNIFIL, ETC.) AS WELL AS THE PRACTICAL PROBLEMS WHICH HAVE IMPEDED PROGRESS IN GENEVA OVER SO MANY YEARS.

(ATAPOUR REFUSES TO SEE LOCAL ISRAELI -- OR LEBANESE -- REPRESENTATIVES SINCE HE SAYS THEY HAVE EACH THREATENED HIS LIFE IN THE PAST.) IT WOULD BE HELPFUL, HOWEVER, TO GET FROM THE DEPT ANY ADDITIONAL COUNTERARGUMENTS THERE MAY BE TO ATAPOUR'S BASIC THEORY INTHE ARTICLE UNDER REFERENCE, I.E., THAT THE SOVIETS AND OTHER UNSC PERMAMENT MEMBERS ARE BEING INSULTED GRATUITOUSLY BY ONE PASSAGE IN THE AGREEMENTS AND THEIR EXCLUSION (AS WELL AS THAT OF OTHER ARABS) FROM THE USG'S PEACEMAKING APPROACH BODES ILL FOR FREE WORLD INTERESTS IN THIS PART OF THE WORLD.

1978TEHRAN10063.subject: ALLEGED EXECUTION OF TWO IRANIAN TRAINEES

segments.text: WITHOUT MENTIONING SENATOR RIBICOFF OR HARTFORD CURRENT, WE CONTACTED IRANIAN NAVY RE STATUS OF JAMAL HOSSEINI AND AKBAR ZADAH. BOTH MEN ARE ALIVE, WELL AND IN PRISON. IN IRAN, THEY WERE CONVICTED OF USE OF HASHISH, A CRIME WHICH REQUIRES MUCH SHORTER SENTENCE THAN POSSESSION OF HARHISH. BOTH MEN WERE PLEASED THAT THAT DISTINCTION WAS MADE. WHEN 13-MONTHS SENTENCES ARE COMPLETED, HOSSEINI AND ZADAH WILL BE GIVEN DISHONORABLE DISCHARGES.

1978TEHRAN10066.subject: SECURITY REPORT, OCTOBER 16 SUMMARY: AMID MILITARY PRECAUTIONS OF UNPRECEDENTED EXTENT IN TEHRAN, NATIONAL MOURNING DAY FOR JALEH SQUARE VIC

segments.text: SUMMARY: AMID MILITARY PRECAUTIONS OF UNPRECEDENTED EXTENT IN TEHRAN, NATIONAL MOURNING DAY FOR JALEH SQUARE VICTIMS PROCEEDED QUIETLY TO MIDDAY, POSSIBLY WORSENING IN AFTERNOON. BAZAARS AND MANY SHOPS CLOSED WITH SOME DEMONSTRATORS DEFYING MARTIAL LAW BUT NO REPORTS OF VIOLENCE. MORE DEMONSTRATIONS OVER PAST DAYS LEFT FOUR DEAD IN PROVINCIAL TOWNS. LARGE FIRE IN TABRIZ BAZAAR OCT 15. 12 AYATOLLAH ESFAHANI RELEASED FROM DETENTION. WIDESPREAD STRIKES CONTINUE. MANY UNIVERSITIES REMAIN CLOSED WITH PROSPECT OF ORGANIZED EFFORT TO CLOSE THOSE THAT ARE SUNCTIONING. SEVERE RIOTING IN DEZFUL BY MID-AFTERNOON. END SUMMARY.

SECURITY FORCES BRACED FOR POSSIBLE TROUBLE ON FORTIETH DAY COMMEMORATION OF JALEH SQUARE DEATHS. MILITARY BUILDUP IN TEHRAN WAS LARGEST IN MARTIAL LAW PERIOD. EXTRAORDINARY SECURITY MEASURES WERE EVIDENT AT MEHRABAD AIRPORT. TEHRAN MORNING TRAFFIC WAS NORMAL, AND NEARLY ALL BUSINESSES OUTSIDE BAZAAR OPENED INITIALLY. MOST SHOPS HAVE CLOSED DURING MORNING, HOWEVER, AS SHOPKEEPERS EVALUATED LOCAL SITUATION; NO ONE WANTS TO HAVE THE ONLY OPEN SHOP ON THE BLOCK. RESULT IS SPORADIC PATTERN-SOME GROUPS OF SHOPS IN NORTH TEHRAN ARE CLOSED, WHILE SEPAH SQUARE IN SOUTH TEHRAN REMAINED OPEN AS OF MIDDAY.

(COMMENT: SCENARIO SHOWS LACK OF KNEE-JERK RESPONSE TO KHOMEINI AND NATIONAL FRONT.) EVERYONE KNEW OF KHOMEINI'S APPEAL, YET VAST MAJORITY CAME TO WORK, THEY DECIDED TO STAY OR RETURN BASED ON WHAT NEIGHBORS WERE DOING.)

AT LEAST ONE GROUP OF DEMONSTRATORS HAD ASSEMBLED BY MIDDAY, BUT AS OF MIDDAY THERE WERE NO CLASHES WITH SECURITY FORCES. IRANIAN SCHOOLS WHICH WERE IN SESSION CLOSED FOR THE DAY; INTERNATIONAL SCHOOLS HELD CLASSES, ALTHOUGH SOME FAMILIES ELECTED NOT TO SEND CHILDREN. THIS WAS ALSO PATTERN IN OTHER CITIES. CONSULATE REPORTS ISFAHAN BAZAAR AND SHOPS CLOSED, ALSO SOME PROVISION STORES WHICH HAD REMAINED OPEN DURING PREVIOUS MOURNING DAYS. NO DEMONSTRATIONS OCCURED TO MIDDAY. SHIRAZ BAZAAR WAS CLOSED BUT CITY WAS QUIET. RABRIZ AND KERMANSHAH BAZAARS AND SHOPS WERE CLOSED, ACCORDING TO RIZ CONSULATE, BUT AGAIN NO REAL TROUBLE. OFFICES THROUGHOUT IRAN OPENED AS USUAL.

(COMMENT: GENERAL STRIKE BY NO MEANS SHUT DOWN THE COUNTRY, WHICH WAS PARTIALLY HALTED ANYWAY DUE TO RASH OF ECONOMIC STRIKES. VIOLENT DEMONSTRATIONS HAVE OCCURRED NEARLY EVERY DAY IN VARIOUS NONMARTIAL LAW TOWNS AND WILL UNDOUBTEDLY DO SO TODAY, BUT SITUATION TO MIDDAY WAS DEFINITELY QUIET IN MAJOR CITIES. EMBASSY HAS LEARNED TROOPS ARE EQUIPPED WITH WATER CANNON AND RUBBER BULLETS AND ARE INSTRUCTED TO USE MINIMUM OF FORCE TO QUELL DISTRUBANCES.

HEAVY MILITARY PRESENCE IN TEHRAN HAS FUELED RUMORS OF SHIFT TOWARD MILITARY RULE BUT ACTUALLY REPRESENTS MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATION ATTEMPT TO COW DEMONSTRATORS BEFORE THEY GET STARTED.) ------------------059755 161526Z /44 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 986 CIA WASHDC DIA WASHDC INFO USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 10066

MORE DEMONSTRATIONS IN MASHAD AND NONMARTIAL LAW TOWNS LAST FEW DAYS BROUGHT FURTHER DESTRUCTION, INJURY, AND AT LEAST FOUR DEATHS. ONE DIED AND TWO WERE BADLY INJURED EVENING OCT 14 IN MASHAD. ANOTHER WAS KILLED IN DARAB (FARS PROVINCE) AND TWO IN SAVEH (CENTRAL PROVINCE). SAVEH RIOT INCLUDED USUAL VANDALISM OF BANKS AND MVIE THEATERS. VIOLENT DEMONSTRATION TOOK PLACE IN BUSHEHR, REQUIRING MARINES TO ASSIST POLICE, BUT NO REPORTS SO FAR OF DEATH OR INJURY. MANY OTHER TOWNS WITNESSED DEMONSTRATIONS, GENERALLY CALLED TO PROTEST RECENT DEATHS IN KHORRAMABAD. THREE HOUSES OF POLICE OFFICIALS IN BEHBAHAN WERE BOMBED, BUT NO DEATHS REPORTED.
PRESS REPORTS FIRE OCT 13 IN TABRIZ BAZAAR WITH DAMAGE INTO MILLIONS OF RIALS AND ALLEGED ARSON. CONSUL TABRIZ REPORTS DAMAGE IS GREATLY EXAGGERATED AND IS DUBIOUS ABOUT ARSON CHARGE.
AYATOLLAH HAJ-AGHA ATAOLLAH ASHRAFI ESFAHANI OF KERMANSHAH, WHO WAS ARRESTED DURING RECENT DEMONSTRATION THERE, HAS BEEN RELEASED (COMMENT: MANY MULLAHS REMAIN IN DETENTION).

WIDE SPREAD STRIKES (REPORTED SEPTEL) CONTINUE TO COMPOUND SECURITY SITUATION. WHILE SOME HAVE ENDED, OTHERS HAVE BEGUN, AND EVEN SOME GROUPS WHO HAVE RETURNED TO WORK PLAN TO RENEW STRIKES UNLESS DEMANDS ARE MET.

NO NEW UNIVERSITY HAS SUCCEEDED IN OPENING. FERDOWSI UNIVERSITY CHANCELLOR PARVIZ AMOUZEGAR SUBMITTED RESIGNATION, SAYING HE COULD NOT RUN UNIVERSITY UNTIL UNIVERISTY INDEPENDENCE IS ACHIEVED. EMBASSY HAS LEARNED THAT SMALL COLLEGES, WHICH HAVE GENERALLY FUNCTIONED WITHOUT DIFFICULTY, ARE RECEIVING, STUDENT DELEGATIONS FROM MAJOR SCHOOLS ADVISING THEM TO STRIKE.

LATE ITEM: ARMISH/MAAG OBSERVER REPORTS SEVERE RIOTING IN DEZFUL WITH MANY FIRES BURNING. IN LATE AFTERNOON WE RECEIVED NUMBER OF REPORTS OF CROWDS GATHERING IN VARIOUS PARTS OF CITY AND ADDITIONAL TROOP MOVEMENTS. THESE SUGGEST POSSIBILITY OF CLASHES BEFORE END OF DAY.

1978TEHRAN10090.subject: GENERAL NASSERI PLANS RETURN TO IRAN

segments.text: FONMIN AFSHAR TOLD ME EVENING OCTOBER 16 THAT GENERAL NASSERI AND HIS ENTIRE FAMILY WILL BE ARRIVING IN TEHRAN BY SPECIAL PLANE ON OCTOBER 17. HE ASKED THAT NO RPT NO PUBLICITY BE GIVEN TO THIS FACT.
AFSHAR SAID GOI HAD INTERPOSED NO OBJECTION TO TRAVEL BY WIFE AND CHILDREN TO U.S. OR OTHER DESTINATION. HOWEVER, HE SAID FAMILY SEEMED TO HAVE CHANGED THEIR MINDS OVER THE WEEKEND.

1978TEHRAN10091.subject: LAWS ON ANTI-STATE OR ANTI-SHAH ACTIVITY

segments.text: RELEVANT REFERENCES CAN BE FOUND IN IRANIAN CRIMINAL CODE, CHAPTERS ONE AND TWO, ARTICLES 80, 981, AND 82. POST POUCHING COPY OF CHAPTERS ONE AND TWO, BUT THESE SHOULD BE AVAILABLE IN NEA/IRN IN BOOK CALLED "IRANIAN LAW AND THE IRANIAN LEGAL SYSTEM," PUBLISHED IN 1966 OR 1967 BY IRANIAN ARMY AND JUDGE ADVOCATE BRANCH OF ARMISH/MAAG. COPY WAS FORWARDED TO DESK MOST RECENTLY IN 1975.

I MET FOR OVER AN HOUR EVENING OCTOBER 16 WITH FOREIGN MINISTER AFSHAR, WHO HAS JUST RETURNED FROM UNGA. I FOUND HIM VERY SATISFIED BY TALKS HE HAD IN NEW YORK AND WASHINGTON WITH SENIOR U.S. OFFICIALS. HE SAID HE CLEARLY UNDERSTANDS U.S. POSITION OF SUPPORT FOR THE SHAH ON THE GROUNDS THAT SHAH IS ONLY ONE WHO CAN LEAD IRAN THROUGH CURRENT CRISIS TOWARDS A DEMOCRATIC FUTURE.

WE THEN DISCUSSED AT SOME LENGTH THE DOMESTIC SITUATION. HE STRESSED THE NEED TO TAKE RAPID ACTION ON THOSE WHO HAVE BEEN GUILTY OF CORRUPTION, AND THEN TO "DRAW THE LINE" IN ORDER TO AVOID APPEARANCES OF A WITCH-HUNT. HE SAID TWO PARTICULAR INDIVIDUALS WERE OF CRITICAL IMPORTANCE IN THIS PROCESS. ONE WAS HOVEYDA AND THE OTHER NASSERI. ON THE LATTER (WHO WILL BE SUBJECT OF SEPTEL), HE WAS INCLINED TO BE MAGNANIMOUS. ON HOVEYDA, HOWEVER, HE, LIKE HIS COUSIN ARDESHIR ZAHEDI, WAS CLEARLY VENGEFUL AND AFTER HIS SCALP.

I REFUSED TO BE DRAWN INTO DISCUSSION OF EITHER PERSONALITY, BUT POINTED OUT THAT BOTH HAD BEEN VERY CLOSE TO SHAH AND THAT ANY ACTION DIRECTED AGAINST EITHER WOULD INEVITABLY TOUCH THE SHAH HIMSELF. HE RATHER AIRILY DISAGREED AND CITED SOME VAGUE CONSTITUTIONAL REVERENCE TO INDICATE THAT MINISTERS COULD NOT HIDE BEHIND THE KING'S SKIRTS.

ON FOREIGN AFFAIRS, HE SAID HE WAS PLEASED AT THE SUPPORT FOR IRAN THAT HE FOUND AT THE UNGA, PARTICULARLY AMOUNG ARABS. HE CITED HIS SEVERAL CONVERSATIONS WITH THE IRAQI FOREIGN MINISTER AS BEING QUITE CONSTRUCTIVE. HE THOUGHT KHOMEINI WAS ON THE DECLINE AND THAT THIS WOULD HELP IRAN IN THE ISLAMIC WORLD. ON THE MIDDLE EAST, HE FEARED ISRAEL WOULD BE TOO STUBBORN TO PERMIT AN AGREEMENT ON THE WEST BANK AND GAZA, BUT APPLAUDED U.S. DETERMINATION TO PERSEVERE.

FINALLY, ON PAKISTAN, HE SAID HE FELT BHUTTO WOULD PROBABLY BE HANGED, BUT SEEMED LESS PERTURBED BY THIS PROSPECT THAN OTHER IRANIANS. HE SEEMED MORE INTERESTED IN THE FACT THAT PAKISTAN SEEMED PREPARED TO STAY IN CENTO THAN IN THE POTENTIAL REPERCUSSIONS OF A BHUTTO EXECUTION.

IRAN HAS ENTERED A PERIOD OF CONSIDERABLE POLITICAL AND SECURITY UNCERTAINTY WHICH CAN BE EXPECTED TO CONTINUE AT LEAST THROUGH THE PARLIAMENTARY ELECTIONS PROMISED BY THE SHAH NEXT JUNE. THIS COULD CONCEIVABLY CHANGE OR NEW FACTORS ENTER THE SCENE BETWEEN NOW AND THEN, BUT IN ANY CASE IT IS DIFFICULT TO PREDICT WHAT THE LOCAL POLITICAL AND SECURITY SITUATION WILL BE IN JULY 1979. MAJOR UNDERTAKING SUCH AS BOY SCOUTS JAMBOREE FOR THE FIRST TIME EVER IN IRAN WILL OBVOUSLY REQUIRE OUTLAY OF MONEY AND ENERGIES OF CONSIDERABLE PROPORTIONS. WE CANNOT RULE OUT ITS BEING JEOPARDIZED AT THE LAST MINUTE BY UNFORESEEN SECURITY AND OTHER PROBLEMS.
EMBASSY IS THEREFORE UNABLE TO PREDICT SATISFACTORY CONDITIONS FOR NISHAPUR JAMBOREE NEXT JULY.

THIS IS OBVIOUSLY A DECISION BOY SCOUTS OF AMERICA (BSA) MUST MAKE FOR THEMSELVES. WE BELIEVE IT WOULD BE WISE FOR THEM TO DISCUSS THE QUESTION WITH GOI REPRESENTATIVES, NOT ONLY DR. HOSSEIN BANAI, BUT ANY OTHERS WHOSE COOPERATION WOULD REALISTICALLY BE REQUIRED IF EXTENSIVE ADMINISTRATIVE, LOGISTIC AND SECURITY PREPARATIONS FOR JAMBOREE WERE TO TAKE PLACE. FRANKLY, WE THINK IT AN EXCEEDINGLY AMBITIOUS PROJECT UNDER CONDITIONS WE FORESEE FOR IRAN BETWEEN NOW AND NEXT JULY WITH CHANGES OF GOVT AND MINISTRY PERSONNEL POSSIBLE, ADMINSTRATIVE PREPARATIONS IN THEMSELVES MIGHT BE DIFFICULT TO COMPLETE IN TIME.

STRAIN AND STRESSES ON DECISION MAKERS MIGHT CAUSE A CHANGE IN GOI ATTITUDE HALF WAY THROUGH THE ENTERPRISE. NEVERTHELESS, WE DO NOT BELIEVE EMBASSY OR USG SHOULD BE PUT IN POSITION OF MAKING THIS DECISION FOR BSA AND IRANIAN GOVT. ABOVE SIMPLY REPRESENTS EMBASSY'S BEST READING OF THE SITUATION.

TAKING INTO ACCOUNT SETBACK TO NUCLEAR POWER PROGRAM, OVERALL POLITICAL SITUATION, AND DISORGANIZATION OF BUREAUCRACY, WE DO NOT BELIEVE THAT NOW IS THE TIME TO ATTEMPT TO PUSH GOI INTO QUICK SIGNATURE OF NUCLEAR AGREEMENT. THE SHAH INFORMED AMBASSADOR THAT ONLY FOUR POWER PLANTS, NAMELY THOSE AT BUSHEHR AND KARUN, WHICH ARE PRESENTLY UNDER CONSTRUCTION BY GERMAN AND FRENCH CONTRACTORS RESPECTIVELY, WILL MOVE AHEAD AT THIS TIME. THEREFORE, NO U.S. NUCLEAR REACTOR SUPPLIER SALES WILL TAKE PLACE IN NEAR FUTURE AND THERE IS NO PRESSURE ON US TO RESOLVE WHATEVER ISSUES ARE OUTSTANDING.

ALSO, RECENT CHANGES IN THE ATOMIC ENERGY ORGANIZATION OF IRAN, INCLUDING THE REPLACEMENT OF DR. ETEMAD BY DR. SOTOODEHNIA, THE ABSORPTION OF AEOI INTO THE MINISTRY OF ENERGY, THE REEXAMINATION OF IRAN'S FUTURE ENERGY NEEDS, AND THE INVESTIGATIONS OF SOME OFFICIALS OF AEOI FOR POSSIBLE CORRUPTION HAVE CREATED GREAT CONFUSION WITHIN THIS BUREAUCRACY. GOI OFFICIALS IN EFFECT ARE NOT IMMEDIATELY SEIZED OF THE QUESTION OF THE BILATERAL.

ANOTHER ARGUMENT FOR DELAY IS THAT MOST-FAVORED NATION CLAUSE OF US-IRAN AGREEMENT BECOMES OPERATIONAL WITH RESPECT TO "COMPARABLE NEEDS" CONCEPT, ONLY IF U.S. APPROVAL TO OTHERS FOR REPROCESSING IS GIVEN SUBSEQUENT TO ENTRY INTO FORCE OF THE AGREEMENT. CONSEQUENTLY, IIF SIGNING OF THIS AGREEMENT IS DEFERRED AND U.S. APPROVALS AS CITED REFTEL ARE GRANTED PRIOR TO SAID SIGNING, ISSUE OF PRIOR APPROVAL AND INFERRED PRECEDENT FOR INVOKING "COMPARABLE NEEDS" CLAUSE BECOME ACADEMIC.

REFTEL ON RECENT OPPOSITION EFFORTS IN HUMAN RIGHTS FIELD. MENTIONS REPRESENTATIONS MADE BY THE COMMITTEE FOR DEFENSE OF POLITICAL PRISONERS IN IRAN (CDPPI) TO THE JUSTICE MINISTER ON BEHALF OF TWO PRISONERS IN KERMANSHAH WHO WERE ENTERING THEIR EIGHTH WEEK OF HUNGER STRIKE TO PROTEST THEIR TRANSFERS TO KERMANSHAH, WHICH THEY CONSIDERED PUNISHMENT FOR THE ROLE THEY PLAYED AS RINGLEADERS IN TEHRAN'S QASR PRISON HUNGER STRIKE LAST SPRING. PRESS OCT 16 LISTED THREE PRISONERS (RAHIMI, SAMAKAR, AND FORMER JUDGE KHAH KAKHSAZ) AS NOT INVOLVED IN NEW QASR HUNGER STRIKE (TEHRAN 10059) BECAUSE THEY WERE RECUPERATING FROM NEARLY THREE MONTHS OF HUNGER STRIKE IN KERMANSHAH, DEMANDING A TRANSFER TO TEHRAN.

WE ARE VIRTUALLY CERTAIN THESE THREE ARE--OR INCLUDE--THE MEN ON BEHALF OF WHOM CDPPI WAS WORKING. THEIR RETURN TO QASR PRISON WOULD THEREFORE REPRESENT A CONCESSION BY THE JUSTICE MINISTER--ALBEIT A SMALL ONE--TO THE CDPPI'S REPRESENTATIONS.

BUT WOULD ONLY COMMENT THAT HE WOULD PASS ALL INFORMATION TO HIS SUPERIORS AND TO IRANIAN MISSION IN NEW YORK. MEHDI EHSASSI, CHIEF OF THE DEPARTMENT, IS PRESENTLY IN NEW YORK AND USUN MAY WANT TO MAKE FURTHER APPROACH TO HIM.

I TOOK CONGRESSMAN SOLARZ TO CALL ON SHAH MORNING OCTOBER 17. I FOUND SHAH FAR MORE ROBUST THAN HE HAS BEEN RECENTLY, AND OBVIOUSLY MORE CONFIDENT IN LIGHT OF THE SUCCESSFUL WEATHERING OF THE FORTY DAY MOURNING EVENTS OF OCTOBER 16. HE ANSWERED THE CONGRESSMAN'S MANY QUESTIONS CAUTIOUSLY, BUT WITH CANDOR.

THERE WAS NOTHING PARTICULARLY NEW IN HIS DISCUSSION OF THE DOMESTIC SCENE. HE DID, HOWEVER, REITERATE HIS COMMITMENT TO FREE ELECTIONS NEXT JUNE AND HIS CONFIDENCE THAT THEY WOULD BE WON BY HIS SUPPORTERS, "IF THEY ARE CONDUCTED IN A CALM ATMOSPHERE."

HE EXPRESSED CONCERN THAT "COMMUNISTS" WOULD BE ABLE TO ORGANIZE THEMSELVES MORE EFFICIENTLY IN THE CURRENTLY RELAXED POLITICAL ATMOSPHERE, BUT DID NOT RPT NOT ATTRIBUTE RECENT UNREST EXCLUSIVELY TO COMMUNIST MANIPULATION. HE SAID THAT "FRUSTRATION" HAD OCCURED BECUASE "WE WERE TRYING TO MOVE TOO FAST."

HE EXPRESSED APPRECIATION FOR STATEMENTS OF SUPPORT WHICH CONGRESSMAN MADE AND INDICATED THAT HE WAS GENERALLY PLEASED WITH U.S. POLICY TOWARD IRAN. IN ANSWER TO CONGRESSMAN'S QUESTION ABOUT ACTION U.S. MIGHT TAKE TO ASSIST, HE SAID HE FELT WE COULD EXPLAIN TO GENERAL PUBLIC WHAT DEMOCRACY REALLY WAS AND HOW IT DEPENDED UPON MAJORITY RULE AND THE RULE OF LAW.

1978TEHRAN10130.subject: VISIT OF HUMAN RIGHTS FACT FINDING MISSION

segments.text: ON OCTOBER 15 AN INTERNATIONAL FACT FINDING MISSION ON HUMAN RIGHTS IN IRAN PAID A CALL ON THE AMBASSADOR. THIS WAS FIRST TIME THE EMBASSY HAD HEARD OF SUCH A MISSION BEING IN IRAN. IT REPORTEDLY ARRIVED OCTOBER 10 OR 11. IT CONSISTED OF AMERICAN PROF. JAMES COCKCROFT OF RUTGERS UNIVERSITY, BRITISH LABOR PARTY MP RUSSELL KERR,AND ABSENT ITALIAN CHRISTIAN DEMOCRAT MP CARLO FRANCANZANI, WHO HAD LEFT OCTOBER 13. GROUP WAS ASSITED BY MRS. COCKCROFT AND ANOTHER LADY.

ALTHOUGH, IN MAKING THE APPOINTMENT, GROUP MENTIONED INTERNATIONAL COMMISSION OF JURISTS (ICJ) AND AD HOC "INTERNATIONAL LEGAL COMMITTEE FOR THE RIGHTS AND REHABILITATION OF PEOPLES," BASED IN ROME, WHEN ASKED OF THEIR EXACT STATUS KERR AND COCKCROFT TOLE POL COUNS THEY WERE VISITING SIMPLY AS INDICIDUALS AT THE INVITATION OF ASSOCIATION OR IRANIAN JURISTS, SPECIFICALLY LAYER LAHIDJI.

KERR ACTED AS MAIN SPOKESMAN FOR THE GROUP AND READ OUT A LIST OF POINTED QUESTION ON U.S. ATTITUDE TOWARD VARIOUS POLITICAL AND HUMAN RIGHTS EVENTS IN IRAN. ONE QUESTION, FOR EXAMPLE, WAS WEATHER USG DID NOT CONSIDER KILLING OF "PEACEFULLY ASSEMBLED PEOPLE" IN TEHRAN'S JALEH SQUARE SEPT 8 A "SERIOUS HUMAN RIGHTS VIOLATION" BY IRANIAN GOVERNMENT. OTHER QUESTIONS WERE EVEN MORE POINTED, BORDERING ON THE "HAVE YOU STOPPED BEATING YOUR WIFE YET" VARIETY. AFTER ABOUT 40 MINUTES GROUP EXPRESSED THEMSELVES VERY SATISFILED WITH RESPONSES AND EXPLANATION OF U.S. POLICY PROVIDED BY THE AMBASSADOR.
AFTER AMBASSADOR HAD TO LEAVE FOR A PREVIOUS APPOITMENT DISCUSSION CONTINUED FOR A SHORT TIME WITH POL COUNS AND HUMAN RIGHTS POLITICAL OFFICER STEMPEL.

WHEN ASKED AFTER THE MEETING IF THEY PLANNED TO VISIT PRISONS IN IRAN, COCKCROFT AND KERR SAID THEY HAD PUT IN SUCH A REQUEST AND EXPECTED TO RECEIVE AN ANSWER WHEN THEY SAW MINISTER OF INFORMATION AND TOURISM AMELI-TEHRANI THE NEXT DAY. GROUP DID NOT VLUNTEER MORE INFO ON CONTACTS IN IRAN, AND WE DID NOT PRESS.

WE HAD LEARNED FROM BRITISH EMBASSY PRIOR TO GROUP'S CALL THAT KERR ALONE HAD CALLED ON BRITISH AMBASSADOR A FEW DAYS BEFORE, ACCOMPAINED BY AN IRANIAN LAWYER WHOSE NAME BRITISH EMBASSY DID NOT GET. KERR HAD DESCRIBED HIS VISIT IN VAGUE TERMS AS SIMPLY "HAVING A LOOK AROUND," AND THIS HAD LEFT BRITISH EMBASSY SOMEWHAT PUZZLED. KERR INDICATED TO THE BRITISH EMBASSY AND TO US THAT THE GROUP WOULD PROBABLY TRAVEL AROUND THE COUNTRY, ESPECIALLY TO THE SOUTH, BUT WAS VAGUE ABOUT SPECIFIC ITINERARY OR TIMING.

POL COUNS SUBSEQUENTLY LEARNED FROM ITALIAN AMBASSADOR THAT FRANCANZANI HAD CALLED, ALONE, ON AMBASSADOR OCT 12. MEETING HAD BEEN GENERAL TOUR D'HORIZON WITH ITALIAN AMBASSADOR DOING MOST OF THE TALKING. UP TO THEN, GROUP HAD SEEN NATIONAL FRONT'S DR. SANJABI, WHO IS SPOKESMAN FOR IRANIAN COMMITTEE FOR FREEDOM AND HUMAN RIGHTS.

COMMENT: WHILE KERR, WHO ASKED MOST OF THE QUESTION, WAS CORDIAL THROUGHOUT, COCKCROFT WAS STIFF IN MANNER ONCE HE BEGAN TO TALK, AFTER THE AMBASSSADOR HAD GONE. BY THEIR GENERAL ATTIDTUDE, AS WELL AS THE PHRASING OF THE QUESTIONS, IT WAS APPARENT THE GROUP HAD COME WARILY, PERHAPS EXPECTING A HOSTILE RECEPTION. THAT THEY LEFT IN A RELATIVELY FRIENDLY AND/MORE FORTHCOMING MOOD IN PROBABLY A GOOD INDICATOR, BUT WE STILL HAVE THE IMPRESSION THAT THEY CONSIDERED THEIR MEETING WITH IS AS SOMETHING TO BE HANDLED GINGERLY. THIS MAY SIMPLY BE DUE TO INEXPERIENCE IN SUCH A ROLE.

THIS WAS FIRST TIME ANY OF THE GROUP HAD BEEN TO IRAN (AND PERHAPS COCKCROFT'S FIRST CALL ON AN AMERICAN AMBASSADOR). WE ASSUME THEY ARE VOLUNTEERS RECRUITED BY ASSOCIATION OF IRANIAN JURISTS (IN WHICH LAWYER MATIN-DAFTARY IS ACTIVE ALONG WITH LAHIDJI). THE OBVIOUSLY DIDNOT THINK IT USEFUL TO VISIT BRITISH OR ITALIANS AS A GROUP -- OR ASK ANY POINTED QUESTIONS ON HUMAN RIGHTS OF THEM. IT IS QUITE POSSIBLE THAT QUESTIONS THEY PUT TO US (WHICH WERE ALL READ BY KERR FROM A PIECE OF PAPER HE HAD ON HIM) HAD BEEN INSPIRED BY THE GROUP'S HOSTS HERE.

SINCE THEY APPEARED TO BE HAVING SOME TROUBLE DECIDING WHAT INTERNATIONAL GROUP OR GROUPS THEY REPRESENTED, WE WOULD BE INTERESTED IN KNOWNING IF THEY HAVE ANY AFFILIATION WITH ICJ, OR IF ICJ'S BUTLER IS AWARE OF THEIR VISIT.

SUMMARY: OCT 16 MOURNING DAY WENT QUIETLY IN TEHRAN. AT LEAST ONE SMALL DEMONSTRATION WAS BROKEN UP WITHOUT DIFFICULTY. LARGE DEMONSTRATION AT CEMETARY TOOK PLACE WITHOUT VIOLENCE. NO MAJOR CONFRONTATIONS IN ISFAHAN, SHIRA, OR TABRIZ, BUT VIOLENCE IN NONMARTIAL LAW TOWN LEFT AT LEAST 16 DEAD AND HUNDREDS INJURED. FALSE REPORTS OF SEVERAL AMERICANS KILLED RECENTLY IN ISFAHAN HAVE CAUSED CONCERN THERE. VIOLENCE IN KERMAN INCLUDED CLASH BETWEEN PRO AND ANTIGOVT DEMONSTRATORS. PRESS REPORTS KHOMEINI WILL ATTEMPT TO EXTEND STAY IN FRANCE. BANI-AHMAD AND OTHER OPPOSITIONISTS CALL FOR ECONOMIC RETALIATION AGAINST FRANCE BECAUSE OF RESTRICTIONS PLACED ON KHOMEINI'S POLITICAL ACTIVITY. PRESS ANNOUNCED NATHAVANDI'S RESIGNATION.
DIRECTOR OF KISH ISLAND RESORT (CLOSELY ASSOCIATED IN PUBLIC MIND WITH THE SHAH) HAS REPORTEDLY FLED IRAN AMID CHARGES OF GROSS EMBEZZLEMENT. END SUMMARY.

MASSIVE MILITARY PRESENCE COMBINED WITH RESTRAINT ON BOTH SIDES CREATED GENERALLY PEACEFUL MOURNING DAY IN MAJOR CITIES. LARGE CROWD GATHERED AT BEHESHT-E-ZARA CEMETARY OUTSIDE TEHRAN WHERE JALEH SQUARE VICTIMS ARE BURIED; TROOPS WATCHED WITHOUT INTERFERING, AND NO VIOLENCE RESULTED. SMALL DEMONSTRATION ON ELIZABETH BOULEVARD WAS DISPERSED WITHOUT INJURY. PRESS REPORTSD BRIEF, SPORADIC DEMONSTRATIONS WITH TOTAL 40 INJURED. ONE PAPER (ETELAAT) REPORTED VIOLENT CLASH LEAVING THREE DEAD, BUT GOI DENIES THIS, AND OTHER REPORTERS BELIEVE STORY FALSE. CONSULATES REPORT TABRIZ, KERMANSHAH, SHIRAZ AND ISFAHAN ALSO QUIET WITH NO DEMONSTRATIONS REPORTED.
SHOP CLOSURES INCREASED THROUGHOUT THE DAY TO BECOME VIRTUALLY TOTAL EXCEPT FOR BAKERIES, GREENGROCERS AND FOOD STORES. SOME OF THESE WERE CLOSED AS WELL.

DAY IN MANY NONMARTIAL LAW TOWNS WAS FAR FROM QUIET. PRESS PUTS DEATH TOLL AT 16, WITH HUNDREDS MORE INJURED. (COMMENT: IT SHOULD BE NOTED PRESS NO LONGER HAS TO OFFICIAL FIGURES. PAST ASSUMPTION THAT PRESS FIGURES WERE UNDERSTATED DOES NOT NECESSARILY HOLD TODAY.) HOTTEST SPOTS WERE KERMAN AFD DEZFUL (KHUZESTAN PROVINCE), EACH WITH FIVE DEATHS. MANY OTHER TOWNS WERE INVOLVED. EVENTS IN KERMAN MARKED FIRST TIME IN MANY MONTHS THAT PRO-GOVT DEMONSTRATORS CLASHED IN STREET BATTLE WITH ANTIGOVT RIOTERS.

ACCORDING TO CONSUL, RADIO AND AT LEAST ONE FARSI NEWSPAPER IN ISFAHAN FALSELY REPORTED OCT 16 THAT SEVERAL AMERICANS WERE KILLED RECENTLY IN ISFAHAN, IN CONNECTION WITH RECENT BHI BUS BOMBING. EMBASSY AND CONSULATE ISFAHAN HAVE ACTED TO CORRECT THE STORY (EXPLAINING ONLY THREE LIGHTLY INJURED).

HOWEVER, CONSULATE REPORTS AUTHORITIES AT AMERICAN HIGH SCHOOL IN ISFAHAN ANNOUNCED OCT 16 THAT STUDENTS SHOULD BE ON GUARD AGAINST ANTIAMERICAN ACTIONS, AND STUDENTS RODE ON FLOOR OF THEIR SCHOOLBUS GOING HOME. ------------------074939 171503Z /42 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1023 INFO USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC

AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI REPORTEDLY WILL ATTEMPT TO EXTEND HIS STAY IN FRANCE, HOPING TO GAIN FRENCH PERMISSION TO CONDUCT POLITICAL ACTIVITIES THERE. OPPOSITION LEADER BANI-AHMAD, WHO HAS CLOSELY ALLIED HIMSELF WITH RELIGIOUS OPPOSITION, ATTACKED FRENCH GOVT FOR PLACING RESTRICTIONS ON KHOMEINI. HE CRITICIZED EXISTING FRENCH CONTRACTS FOR TWO NUCLEAR REACTORS AND TEHRAN METRO, LINKING THEM TO DOMESTIC CORRUPTION ISSUE AND DEMANDING AN INVESTIGATION. STORY OUT OF PARIS CITES FRENCH JOURNAL "LIBERATION" AS STATING TEHRAN BAZAAR MERCHANTS THREATEN BOYCOTT OF FRENCH GOODS IF FRENCH DO NOT LIFT RSTRICTIONS ON KHOMEINI.

MINISTER OF SCIENCE AND HIGHER EDUCATION NAHAVANDI'S RESIGNATION (REPORTED REFTEL) WAS FINALLY ANNOUNCED IN MORNING PRESS, THOUGH WITH PROVISO THAT IT APPARENTLY HAS NOT YET BEEN ACCEPTED. (WE ASSUME GOI IS STILL SEEKING A SUCCESSOR-IF THE POST IS NOT ABOLISHED ALTHOGETHER). PRESS AND OTHER SOURCES SUGGEST HE RESIGNED TO GET MANEUVERING ROOM FOR HIS OWN POLITICAL AMBITIONS (AND TO AVOID FURTHER ANTAGONIZING ACADEMIC COMMUNITY). HIS NEW PARTY WILL TAKE NAME "IRAN'S NATIONAL MOVEMENT."

MAHMOUD MONSEF, MANAGING DIRECTOR OF LAVISH KISH ISLAND RESORT, REPORTEDLY LEFT IRAN AMID ACCUSATIONS OF GROSS EMBEZZLEMENT OF FUNDS. KISH ISLAND IS PERSIAN GULF GAMBLING AND INDOOR-OUTDOOR SPORTS RETREAT FOR MANY OF IRAN'S NEW WLITE. IT IS CLOSELY ASSOCIATED IN THE PUBLIC MIND WITH THE SHAH(WHO HAS FREQUENTLY SPENT VACATIONS THERE IN RECENT YEARS) AND GOI HIGH OFFICIALDOM. THIS STORY WILL NOT HELP THEIR IMAGE.

1978TEHRAN10171.subject: CONTINUING REPORTS ON KHOMEINI ARE VALUABLE

segments.text: WE WOULD APPRECIATE CONTINUING REPORTS ON KHOMEINI'S STATEMENTS AND MEETINGS OR MOVEMENTS. KHOMEINI REMAINS KEY OPPOSITION FIGURE IN A SITUATION WE DO NOT EXPECT TO SEE RESOLVED FOR SOMETIME. EMBASSY WILL CONTINUE UNLESS DIRECTED BY YOU TO INCLUDE PARIS ON OUR ALMOST DAILY POLITICAL AND SECURITY ROUNDUPS AS WELL AS PERTINENT LONGER PIECES SUCH AS ANALYIS OF SHARIF-EMBMI GOVERNMENT CONTAINED IN TEHRAN 10061.

1978TEHRAN10172.subject: RELIGIOUS GUERRILLA GROUP TAKES CREDIT FOR ATTACK ON AMERICANS IN ISFAHAN

segments.text: KARACHI, NAIROBI FOR RSS

PRESS OCT 18 REPORTED THAT A GROUP CALLING ITSELF THE "MONOTHEISTIC GROUP" HAS PUT OUT A DECLARATION TAKING CREDIT FOR PIPEBOMB ATTACK ON BELL HELICOPTER BUS OCT 11 (REFS A AND B) AS WELL AS OCTOBER 1 SABOTAGE OF IRANIAN AIR FORCE HELICOPTER (REF C).

THIS TENDS TO CONFIRM OUR FIRST ASSUMPTION THAT PIPEBOMB INCIDENT WAS CARRIED OUT BY A NEWER TERRORIST GROUP USING MORE AMATEUR TACTICS AND WEAPONS THAN THE TWO ESTABLISHED GUERILLA MOVEMENTS -- CHARIKS AND MUJAHIDIN. IF THE DECLARATION IS TO BE BELIEVED, THE GROUP SEEMS TO BE ON THE EXTREMISH RELIGIOUS FRINGE, THOUGH WE CANNOT RULE OUT AN "AGENT PROVOCATEUR" ACTION BY LEFTWING EXTREMISTS POSING AS RELIGIOUS EXTREMISTS. THIS IS ALSO OUR FIRST INDICATION THAT HELICOPTER EXPLOSION, WHICH APPEARED TO BE A MORE PROFESSIONAL JOB CARRIED OUT POSSIBLY BY MILITARY PERSONNEL WITH ACCESS TO AIRFIELD, IS IN SOME WAY LINKED TO ATTACK ON BUS.
EMBASSY AND CONSULATE ISFAHAN CHECKING INTO THIS FURTHER.

1978TEHRAN10189.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT, OCTOBER 18 SUMMARY: OPPOSITION DEPUTY TABLED NINE POINT CENSURE MOTION AGAINST SHARIF-EMAMI GOVT OCT 17. PRIMIN TO DEFEN

segments.text: SUMMARY: OPPOSITION DEPUTY TABLED NINE POINT CENSURE MOTION AGAINST SHARIF-EMAMI GOVT OCT 17. PRIMIN TO DEFEND POLICY IN CLOSED DOOR SESSION OCT 22. NATIONAL FRONT LEADER SANJABI STATED MONARCHY NOT OBJECTIONABLE IF IT IS CONSTITUTIONAL. KHOMEINI CRITICIZED PRESIDENT CARTER FOR IGNORING HUMAN RIGHTS VIOLATIONS IN IRAN. 340 IRANIAN PROFESSORS PETITIOND FRENCH PRESIDENT TO REMOVE RESTRICTIONS FROM KHOMEINI. FORMER SAVAK CHIEF NASSIRI RETURNED TO TEHRAN TO FACE CHARGES OF CORRUPTION AND ABUSE OF AUTHORITY. GOI OFFICIAL ANNOUNCED MAJORITY OF POLITICAL PRISIONER WILL BE RELEASED WITHIN TWO WEEKS. AMERICAN PEN CLUB EXPRESSED SUPPORT FOR IRANIAN JOURNALISTS REGARDING RECENT STRIKE.

AYATOLLAH JAVAD DASTGHEIB RELEASED AFTER TWO MONTHS DETENTION IN SHIRAZ. NO NEW REPORTS OF CLASHES BETWEEN DEMONSTRATORS AND SECURITY FORCES. TWO AMERICAN STUDENTS WERE FRIGHTENED AND ONE STRUCK BY A ROCK WHEN THEYHAPPENED UPON DEMONSTRATION IN ISFAHAN. DEATH TOLL FROM OCT 16 DEMONSTRATIONS APPEARS TO BE 12. END SUMMARY.

OPPOSITION MAJLIS DEPUTY DEPUTY ABBAS AKHBARI MOVE YESTERDAY TO CENSURE GOVT. TRADITION GIVES GOVT ONE WEEK TO PREPARE REPLY. AMJLIS WILL MEET IN CLOSED SESSION OCT 22 TO CONSIDER OTHER QUESTIONS AND ABJECTIONS RAISED BY MAJLIS DEPUTIES. IT IS NOT YET KNOWN WHEN MAKLIS WILL DEAL WITH CENSURE MOTION ITSELF. IN NINE POINT DECLARATION AKHBARI ATTACKED GOVT FOR FAILING TO END BLOODSHED IN IRAN AND VIOLATING IMMUNITY OF RELIGIOUS LEADERS. HE ASKED WHY THOSE RESPONSIBLE FOR SENDING KHOMEINI INTO EXILE HAVE NOT BEEN PUNISHED, AND HE CITED REPORTS THAT GOI HAS PRESSURED IRAQ, KUWAIT AND FRANCE TO DENY FREEDOM TO KHOMEINI.

GOVT HAS ALLOWED OIL REVENUES TO DROP AS RESULT OF DECLINE OF DOLLAR, HAS PERMITTED OIL CONSORTIUM TO PLUNDER NATION'S WEALTH AND HAS WASTED OIL INCOME ON SUCH PROJECTS AS KISH ISLAND RESORT. HE ATTACKED BILLS ON FREE ASSEMBLY, FREE PRESS, AND INDEPENDENCE OF UNIVERSITIES. PRESENT GOVT CANNOT CONCILIATE NATION BECAUSE IT IS FULL OF REPRESENTATIVES FROM PAST REPRESSIVE GOVTS. GOVT HAS FAILED, FOR EXAMPLE, TO PROSECUTE HOVEYDA, WHO HEADED GOVT DURING CORRUPTION PERIOD. FINALLY, GOVT HAS TRIED TO COMPENSATE FOR PAST MISGOVERNMENT WITH EXCESSIVE WAGE SETTLEMENTS WHICH WILL ONLY ADD TO INFLATION.

NATIONAL FRONT LEADER KARIM SANJABI STATED IN INTERVIEW HE HAS NO OBJECTION TO CONTINUED MONARCHY PROVIDED IT IS CONSTITUTIONAL. HE ALSO SAID GOVT HAS TO CHOOSE BETWEEN REAL DEMOCRACY OR MILITARY RULE; THERE IS NO OTHER OPTION.

AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, IN INTERVIEW GIVEN TO FRENCH REPORTER SEPT 21 AND PUBLISHED OCT 17 IN LE MONDE, CRITICIZED PRESIDENT CARTER FOR IGNORING HUMAN RIGHTS VIOLATIONS IN IRAN. CARTER PROTESTED SOVIET POLICY BUT THEN SUPPORTED SHAH AFTER SEPT 8 KILLING. PRESS REPORTS 340 IRANIAN PROFESSORS SENT LETTER TO FRENCH PRESIDENT GISCARD ASKING REMOVAL OF RESTRICTIONS PLACED ON KHOMEINI. ------------------123841 190556Z /12 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 1049 INFO USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWIAT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 10189
FORMER SAVAK CHIEF NASSIRI RETURNED TO TEHRAN OCT 17. HE IS EXPECTED TO FACE CHARGES OF CORRUPTION AND VIOLATION OF HUMAN RIGHTS. HE HAS NOT SPOKEN TO JOURNALISTS AND PRECISE WHEREABOUTS ARE UNKNOWN.

OFFICIALS ANNOUNCED YESTERDAY MOST POLITICAL PRISONERS WILL BE RELEASED WITHIN TWO WEEKS. GOVT HAS CLASSIFIED PRISONERS INTO TWO GROUPS-THOSE IMPRISONED FOR POLITICAL ACTS, AND THOSE ARRESTED FOR TERRORISM. FIRST GROUP MAY BE RELEASED, MINISTER OF STATE FOR EXECUTIVE AFFAIRS AZMOUN SAID TERRORISTS WILL NOT BE PARDONED, BUT OTHER REPORTS INDICATE THEY MAY HAVE SENTENCES REMITTED. AZMOUN SAID THOSE WHOSE ACTIONS HAD BEEN IN ACCORDANCE WITH CONSTITUTION WOULD BE RELEASED. PRESS CARRIES DIFFERING REPORTS OF HUNGER STRIKES AMONG POLITICAL PRISONERS. APPARENTLY PRISONERS IN SHIRAZ AND TABRIZ WENT ON STRIKE WITHIN LAST FEW DAYS, JOINING STRIKES ALREADY UNDERWAY IN KARAJ AND QASR PRISON, TEHRAN.
A TEHRAN JUDGE IS ALSO ON HUNGER STRIKE TO PROTEST ALLEGED TEMPORARY DETENTION OF THREE JUDGES AS THEY DEPARTED MINISTRY OF JUSTICE ON SUNDAY.
PRESS REPORTS AMERICAN PEN CLUB, AN ASSOCIATION OF 1600 WRITERS, EXPRESSED SUPPORT FOR STRIKING TEHRAN JOURNALISTS DURING RECENT WORK STOPPAGE.
AYATOLLAH HAJ SEEYED JAVAD DASTGHEIB WAS RELEASED FROM DETENTION OCT 17. HE WAS ARRESTED TWO MONTHS AGO IN SHIRAZ.

NO NEW REPORTS OF VIOLENT DEMONSTRATIONS. DEATH TOLL FROM OCT 16 INCIDENTS APPEARS TO BE 12. KERMAN HAD FEWER DEATHS THAN WAS ORIGINALLY REPORTED, BUT ATTACK THERE STANDS OUT AMONG POLITICAL VIOLENCE OF RECENT MONTHS. CROWD (REPORTS RANGE FROM 200 TO 3,000) STORMED PRINCIPAL MOSQUE DURING RELIGIOUS SERVICES, SETTING MOTORCYCLES ON FIRE, BURNING PICTURES OF KHOMEINI, DAMAGING MOSQUE, AND ATTACKING WORSHIPPERS.

MINOR ANTI-AMERICAN INCIDENT OCCURRED MORNING OCT 18 IN ISFAHAN. TWO AMERICAN HIGH SCHOOL GIRLS WALKING TO SCHOOL ACCIDENTALLY CROSSED PATHS WITH GROUP OF 40-50 DEMONSTRATORS. WHEN CROWD BEGAN SHOUTING AT GIRLS THEY RAN. ONE WAS STRUCK BY STONE HURLED FROM CROWD. CROWD CONTINUED ON ITS WAY WITHOUT PURSUING THEM. (INCIDENT WAS FRIGHTENING FOR TWO AMERICANS, BUT CROWD, EXCEPT FOR STONE-THROWER, WAS MORE INTENT ON ITS MARCH THAN ON SEEKING OUT AND INJURING AMERICANS.)

EMBASSY FOUND AHMED FRIENDLY, MILD-MANNERED, AND OF AVERAGE INTELLIGENCE. NOT AN ACTIVIST, HE NONETHELESS ADEQUATELY REPRESENTED BANGLADESH INTERESTS IN IRAN. THIS SEEMS TO COINCIDE WITH IMPRESSION OTHER U.S. OFFICIALS RECEIVED PER REFTEL.

BANGLADESH EMBASSY HAS NOT ANNOUNCED AMBASSADOR'S NEW APPOINTMENT, ALTHOUGH ADMITTING IT TO US PRIVATELY. MAIN REASEON FOR SECRET APPEARS TO BE THAT AMBASSADOR DOES NOT WANT TO BEGIN GIVING FAREWELL DINNERS, CALLS, ETC. BEFORE HE IS READY. IT IS POSIBLE, ALSO, THAT EMBASSY IS WAITING FOR NAME OF NEW APPOINTEE HERE.

1978TEHRAN10223.subject: RELEASE OF POLITICAL PRISONERS GOVT ANNOUNCED 182 ANTI-SECURITY PRISONERS HAVE BEEN RELEASED. UNCLEAR WHETHER THEY WERE ARRESTED BEFO

segments.text: GOVT ANNOUNCED 182 ANTI-SECURITY PRISONERS HAVE BEEN RELEASED. UNCLEAR WHETHER THEY WERE ARRESTED BEFORE OR AFTER DECLARATION OF MARTIAL LAW BUT IMPLICATION IS BEFORE. WILL TRY TO CLARIFY. MEANWHILE, LIST OF NAMES BEING POUCHED TO DEPT.

1978TEHRAN10261.subject: BERTRAND RUSSELS TRIBUNAL REPRESENTATIVES REPORTEDLY IN IRAN

segments.text: SMALL PRESS ITEMS KAYHAN INTERNATIONAL OCT 22 IDENTIFIED AMERICAN, BRITISH AND ITALIAN HUMAN RIGHTS FACT FINDING MISSION REPORTED REFTEL AS REPRESENTING THE BERTRAND RUSSELL TRIBUNAL. ITEM SAID THEY HAD VISITED IRAN IN AN ATTEMPT TO FILE A REPORT ON THE RECENT BLOODSHED.

SUMMARY: WHILE IT IS TOO EARLY TO MAKE DEFINITIVE PREDICATIONS, THERE ARE ENCOURAGING INDICATIONS THAT THE IRANIAN CRISIS MAY HAVE PASSED A FEVER POINT AND OPENED SOME PROSPECTS FOR ITS CONSTRUCTIVE RESOLUTION. HOWEVER, A NUMBER OF OTHE R DANGER POINTS LIE AHEAD BETWEEN NOW AND THE GENERAL ELECTIONS SCHEDULED FOR NEXT JUNE. END SUMMARY.

WITH THE RELATIVELY UNEVENTFUL PASSAGE OF THE DAY OF MOURNING FOR THE VICTIMS OF MARTIAL LAW ON OCTOBER 16, THE RESOLUTION OF MOST CURRENT LABOR DISPUTES, THE PARISIAN EXILE OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, AND THE SIGNS OF CONSOLIDATION WITHIN THE SHARIF-EMAMI GOVT, THE POLITICAL SITUATION IN IRAN HAS BEGUN TO EASE SOMEWHAT. HOWEVER, SINCE MARTIAL LAW IS FIRMLY IN CONTROL OF ALL MAJOR POPULATION CENTERS, IT IS NOT REALLY POSSIBLE TO GET AN EFFICTIVE READING TO VERIFY THE DEPTH OF THIS RELAXATION.

POLITICAL FIGURES AMONG THE OPPOSITION, WHO ATTEMPTED TO RIDE THE WAVE OF POPULAR DISCONTENT LED BY AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI AND THE MULLAHS, HAVE BEGUN TO LOWER THEIR APPARENT AMBITIONS. WHILE TWO OR THREE WEEKS AGO, MANY OF THESE POLITICIANS WERE OPENLY CALLING FOR THE DISMISSAL OF THE HAH, MOST OF THEM NOW QUIETLY STATE THAT THEY ACCEPT THE NEED FOR THE SHAH'S CONTINUED LEADERSHIP, ALBEIT WITHIN THE FRAMEWORK OF A DEMOCRATIC, CONSTITUTIONAL SOCIETY. THESE SAME FIGURES HAVE ALSO BEGUN DISCREETLY TO DISASSOCIATE THEMSELVES FROM KHOMEINI AND TO URGE RESTRAINT UPON THE MULLAHS.

IN PART, THIS CHANGE OF POSITION MAY BE PURELY TACTICAL, REFLECTING A LACK OF ARDOR FOR A FRONTAL CHALLENGE TO MARTIAL LAW. MORE FUNDAMENTALLY, HOWEVER, IT SEEMS TO BE A REFLECTION OF THEIR REALIZATION THAT THE PROSPECTS FOR A LIBERALIZED, "NATIONAL FRONT" GOVT IN THE CURRENT CIRCUMSTANCES ARE FAR LESS LIKELY THAN THE INTRODUCTION OF A REPRESSIVE MILITARY REGIME IF THE TURBULENCE FAILS TO SUBSIDE. INHERENT IN THIS REFLECTION IS THE KNOWLEDGE THAT ONLY THE SHAH CAN PREVENT THE IMPOSITION OF A MILITARY GOVT AND THAT HIS CONTINUING PRESTIGE IS NECESSARY FOR RESTRAINT.

THESE SAME LEADERS ARE CURRENTLY, THEREFORE, SEEKING TO FIND SOME WAY TO PARTICIPATE IN THE GOVERNMENTAL STRUCTURE. IDEALLY, THEY WOULD LIKE TO BE GIVEN THE GOVERNMENTAL MANDATE AND TAKE OVER THE CABINET. MEN LIKE ALI-AMINI, FOR EXAMPLE, WHO HAD EARLIER "DEMANDED" THAT HE BE MADE PRIME MINISTER WITH FULL POWERS OVER THE MILITARY, ARE NOW SAYING THAT THEY WOULD SETTLE FOR CONTROL OF GOVT WITH THE EXCEPTION OF THE MILITARY, WHOSE LEADERSHIP THEY WOULD LEAVE DIRECTLY WITH THE SHAH. OTHER, MORE MODEST AND REALISTIC OPPOSITIONISTS ARE TALKING IN TERMS OF A "COALITION GOVT."
