IN ALL LIKELIHOOD, THERE SEEMS VERY LITTLE CHANCE THAT THE SHAH WILL INTRODUCE NATIONAL FRONT POLITICIANS INTO THE CURRENT CABINET UNLESS OR UNTIL THOSE POLITICIANS CAN DEMONSTRATE THAT THEY HAVE GENUINE POPULAR POLITICAL SUPPORT THROUGH THE TEST OF A FREE ELECTION. HE HAS INDICATED HIS PREFERENCE TO RETAIN SHARIF-EMAMI, PERHAPS WITH A SLIGHTLY RESHUFFLED CABINET, UNTIL THE JUNE ELECTIONS. HIS CHALLENGE TO THE OPPOSITIONISTS IS TO COMPETE IN THOSE ELECTIONS AND SHOW WHETHER THEY CAN TRULY MERIT A MANDATE, OR A COALITION, OR EVEN A PARTIAL PARTICIPATION.

THE OPPOSITION, OF COURSE, TAKES THE POSITION THAT THE ELECTIONS WILL NOT RPT NOT BE FREE, AND THAT THEY WOULD ONLY BE TRICKED INTO SACRIFICING THEIR AMBITIONS IF THEY WERE TO DEFER THEM AND WAIT UNTIL NEXT JUNE. THE SHAH, ON THE OTHER HAND, REPEATS HIS ASSURANCES OF OPEN ELECTIONS AND SUGGESTS THAT THE OPPOSITION IS SEEKING TO AVOID THE DISPLAY OF THEIR OWN WEAKNESS. THERE ARE SOME RECENT SIGNS THAT TENTATIVE, INDIRECT, DIALOGUE ABOUT ELECTIONS IS TAKING SHAPE BETWEEN OPPOSITION AND LOYALISTS.

ONE LEADING OPPOSITIONIST HAS TOLD THE AMBASSADOR HE WOULD BE WILLING TO TRY TO WORK OUT AN "ELECTION CHARTER" WITH THE GOVT TO DEFINE FREE ELECTIONS AND TO PROVIDE FOR INTERNATIONAL OBSERVERS AND OTHER SUCH SAFEGUARDS.

THE THE MEANTIME,THE KHOMEINI STAR SEEMS TO BE WANING. HIS PUBLIC STATEMENTS IN FRANCE HAVE SUGGESTED THE FUZZY, ARCHAIC NATURE OF HIS POLITICAL PERCEPTIONS. THE FACT THAT HE IS FAR AWAY AND IN A CHRISTIAN COUNTRY MAY BE ERODING HIS INFLUENCE HERE. THE AYATOLLAHS OF QOM SEEM TO FEEL A GREATER SENSE OF SELF-CONFIDENCE AND ARE IN THE PROCESS OF NEGOTIATING AN UNDERSTANDING WITH THE GOVT, WHICH WOULD ENTAIL THEIR ALLEGIANCE TO THE SHAH. ------------------057436 221326Z /43 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 1087 INFO AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY PARIS SECTION 2 OF 3 TEHRAN 10267 LIMDIS

ARRANGEMENTS WORKED OUT BETWEEN THE GOVT AND THE PRESS HAVE RESULTED IN THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A FREE PRESS, WHICH CAN BE GENUINELY REGARDED AS INDEFPENDENT. IF THE PRESS BEHAVES RESPONSIBLY IN THIS CIRCUMSTANCE, IT CAN DO MUCH TO LANCE THE BOILS OF PUBLIC SUSPICION, WHICH HAVE FESTERED UPON THE VENOM OF OUTRAGEOUS RUMORS. SUCH WIDELY ACCEPTED CANARDS AS THE STORY THAT ISRAELI SOLDIERS WERE RESPONSIBLE FOR THE JALLEH SQUARE MASSACRE, OUGHT NOT TO HAVE AS MUCH CURRENCY IN THE FUTURE IF THE PRESS IS BOTH FREE AND RESPONSIBLE.

TROUBLESOME PROBLEMS, HOWEVER, REMAIN AHEAD. THE SETTLEMENT OF THE STRIKE WAVE HAS ENTAILED AN ENORMOUS EXPENDITURE WHICH, TAKING INTO ACCOUNT WAGE AND FRINGE BENEFIT INCREASES, WILL ADD 3.5 TO 4.3 BILLION DOLLARS TO THE BUDGET IN THE PERIOD SEPT 23, 1978, TO MARCH 20, 1979. IRANIAN FISCAL YEAR STARTING MARCH 21, 1979, IS ALREADY BURDENED WITH ANOTHER TWELVE AND HALF PERCENT WAGE INCREASE, WHICH WILL TOTAL SOME THREE BILLION DOLLARS THAT YEAR. SIMILAR WAGE COSTS IN THE PRIVATE SECTOR WILL SURELY RESTORE THE INFLATIONARY SPIRAL OF 1976-77.
IF GOODS ARE NOT AVAILABLE IN THE EARLY PART OF 1979 TO MEET THIS NEW PURCHASING POWER DEMAND, PROBLEMS COULD ARISE AT THE TIME WHEN MARTIAL LAW IS SCHEDULED TO BE LIFTED.

THE PROBLEM OF THE UNIVERSITIES IS YET TO BE SETTLED. THE MINISTER OF HIGHER EDUCATION HAS RESIGNED AND THE UNIVERSITY AUTONOMY BILL HAS BEEN WITHDRAWN "FOR FURTHER STUDY." IT IS PROVING VERY DIFFICULT TO FIND ANYONE WILLING TO TAKE THE HIGHER EDUCATION PORTFOLIO AND IT IS DOUBTFUL TAHT ANYONE CAN BE FOUND WHO WILL PROVE ACCEPTABLE ENOUGH TO THE UNIVERSITIES TO ASSURE THEIR REOPENING. THIS IS PARTLY BECAUSE THE DEMANDS EMANATING FROM THE CAMPUS ARE SO CONFUSED. ON THE ONE HAND, THERE ARE THE RELIGIOUS NATIONALISTS. ON THE OTHER, THERE ARE THE MARXISTS.
ADDITIONALLY, THERE ARE THE EXPONENTS OF CAMPUS AUTONOMY AND THE FACULTY MEMBERS WHO WANT SALARY AND PERQUISITE IMPROVEMENTS.

THE MILITARY PRESENT A SPECIAL COMPLICATION. ALTHOUGH THEIR LEADERS MAINTAIN THEIR LOYALTY AND ALLEGIENCE TO THE SHAH, THEY MAKE NO SECRET OF THE FACT THAT THEY BELIEVE HE IS MAKING TOO MANY "CONCESSIONS." THEY WOULD PREFER A FAR TOUGHER COURSE OF ACTION, ARRESTING "DISSIDENTS" AND INSISTING UPON A GREATER RESPECT FOR "LAW AND ORDER." THEY PLEAD THIS POINT OF VIEW CONSTANTLY WITH THE SHAH AND WILL CONTINUE TO HAVE SOME INFLUENCE ON HIS VIEWS BECAUSE OF THE INFORMATION AND INTELLIGENCE WHICH THEY BRING TO HIS ATTENTION. THEY WILL CONTINUE TO BE DEEPLY DISTURBED, ESPECIALLY WHEN THE BUDGET CUTS THE GOVT WILL BE FORCED TO MAKE IMPINGE HEAVILY UPON WEAPONS PROCUREMENT.

THERE ARE NO RPT NO SIGNS, AT THISJUNCTURE, OF EVEN INCIPIENT DISLOYALTY OR HINTS OF A MILITARY COUP, BUT THE SHAH WILL CLEARLY HAVE TO GIVE CONTINUING ATTENTION TO MILITARY MALAISE AS HE MOVES AHEAD. ------------------057585 221326Z /43 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 1088 INFO AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY PARIS SECTION 3 OF 3 TEHRAN 10267 LIMDIS

IN ADDITION TO THESE MORE OR LESS SUBSTANTIVE PROBLEMS, THERE ARE THE EVER-PRESENT EMOTIONAL RISKS THAT ARISE FROM THE RELIGIOUS AREA. THE PERIOD OF MOHARRAM, SHI-ITE DAYS OF DEEP MOURNING FOR THE DEATH OF ALI, WILL FALL IN THE FIRST PART OF DECEMBER. THIS TRADITIONALLY TENSE PERIOD COULD PROVIDE OCCASIONS FOR CLASHES BETWEEN MILITANT MUSLIMS AND THE MILITARY.

FINALLY, THERE WILL BE THE PSYCHOLOGICAL AND PHYSICAL PROBLEMS INHERENT IN THE PROCESS OF "DECOMPRESSION" FROM A PERIOD OF MARTIAL LAW. ALTHOUGH THE GOVT ASKED FOR AND RECEIVED PARLIAMENTARY AUTHORITY FOR SIX MONHTS OF MARTIAL LAW, THEY EARNESTLY HOPE THAT, TOWARDS THE END OF DECEMBER, IF ALL REMAINS CALM, THEY MAY BE ABLE TO LIFT IT, PERHAPS A CITY AT A TIME, IN ORDER TO RETURN TO CIVIL GOVT IN THE EARLY PART OF 1979. IF THIS PROCESS RESULTS IN A NEW ROUND OF RIOTS AND LAWLESSNESS, THE WHOLE SCHEDULE OF LIBERALIZATION COULD BE PLACED IN JEOPARDY.

THUS, THE EIGHT MONTHS REMAINING BETWEEN NOW AND THE ELECTIONS ARE GOING TO BE A VERY COMPLICATED PERIOD FOR THE SHAH AND HIS GOVT TO NEGOTIATE SUCCESSFULLY. TO ARRIVE AT ELECTION EVE IN THE SPIRIT OF DEMOCRATIC GOOD FELLOWSHIP WHICH WILL BE PREPARED TO CONTEMPLATE A NATIONAL ELECTION IN GOOD FAITH AND CIVILITY WOULD BE PERHAPS TOO MUCH TO ASK OF THE IRANIAN NATION AT THIS STAGE OF ITS POLITICAL DEVELOPMENT. TO ARRIVE AT THAT JUNCTURE IN RELATIVE DOMESTIC PEACE AND TRANQUILLITY WILL DEMAND MORE SOPHISTICATION THAN HAS BEEN DISPLAYED IN THE PAST SEVENTY YEARS. HENCE, WE SOULD NOT ASSUME THIS GOAL AS GRANTED EVEN IF THE CURRENT TURMOIL SUBSIDES.
HOWEVER, THE OBJECTIVE IS STILL A WORTHY ONE AND IT HAS NOT YET DISAPPEARED FROM VIEW.

1978TEHRAN10281.subject: OPPOSITION ON THE MOVE: DEAL IN THE WIND?

segments.text: SUMMARY: JOINT DELEGATION LEAVES IRAN FOR PARIS OCT 21 TO SEE AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI. NATIONAL FRONT (INF) SPOKESMEN EMPHASIZE POSSIBILITY OF COALITION, ATTACK GOI FOR CORRUPTION AND CALL FOR "NEUTRAL" GOVERNMENT TO SUPERVISE ELECTIONS. END SUMMARY.

PRESS MORNING OCT 22 REPORTS DEPARTURE OF ENG MEHDI BAZARGAN AND DR. NASSER MINATCHI FROM IRAN FOR PARIS TO "DISCUSS CRITICAL MATTERS" WITH AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI.BAZARGAN, WHO IS HEAD OF COMMITTEE FOR THE DEFENSE OF HUMAN RIGHTS AND FREEDOM (CDHRF) AS WELL AS LIBERATION MOVEMENT OF IRAN (LMI); AND MINATCHI, WHO IS CDHRF TREASURER AND CLOSE FRIEND OF AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI, APPEAR TO BE ON POLITICAL CONCILIATION MISSION (SEE REF A). EXECUTIVE BOARD MEMBER TOLD POLOFF STEMPEL MORNING OCT 22 THAT INF HAS HAD REGULAR CONTACT WITH KHOMEINI EVER SINCE HE CAME TO PARIS AND HAS NOTED SOFTENING OF HIS POSITION OVER PAST WEEK.

INF SOURCES SAYS KHOMEINI ATTACK ON TUDEH PARTY IN PARIS LAST WEEK WAS SHARP DEPARTURE FROM PREVIOUS POSITION. KINI HAS ALSO MODIFIED HIS CALL FOR AN "ISLAMIC STATE" AND IS NOW CALLING FOR RULE BASED ON "ISLAMIC JUSTICE" OR "ISLAMIC PRINCIPLES." SOURCE SAID THESE CHANGES IN POSITION, IF CONFIRMED, WOULD CLEAR WAY FOR BAZARGAN/MINATCHI MISSION TO DISCUSS SOME FORM OF COLLABORATION BETWEEN INTERNAL RELIGIOUS LEADERS AND KHOMEINI. SOURCE THOUGHT TEAM MUST WIN AT LEAST TACIT COOPERATION OF KHOMEINI IN ORDER TO PERMIT AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI TO COOPERATE WITH GOI.

COMMEENT: MINATCHI HAD EARLIER TOLD EMBOFF THAT MISSION TO PARIS WOULD GO ONLY IF SHARIATMADARI GROUP FELT IT HAD SOMETHING TO OFFER. THIS, PLUS INFERENCE FROM OCT 20 DISCUSSION WITH LMI REPRESENTATIVE (DESCRIBED BELOW), SUGGESTS THAT AT LEAST THE BEGINNINGS OF A DEAL SEEM TO BE IN THE WORKS. ON THE OTHER HAND, OUR READING OF THE KHOMEINI PUBLISHED INTERVIEWS OUT OF PARIS DOES NOT LEAD US TO FULLY SHARE INF SOURCE'S OPTIMISM THAT KHOMEINI MAY BE WILLING TO GO ALONG WITH LOCAL LEADERS. WOULD APPRECIATE CONTINUED REPORTING FROM PARIS ON ANY KHOMEINI STATEMENTS.

EARLIER SCHEDULED MEETING BETWEEN EMBOFF AND LMI REPRESENTATIVE OCT 20 PRODUCED SHORT DISCUSSION OF RECENT RIOTS IN KERMAN (LMI CLAIMS 20 KILLED, 50 INJURED) AND NON MARTIAL LAW CITIES, PLUS REVIEW OF BASIC U.S. ATTITUDES. IN DISCUSSING POSSIBILITY OF ELECTIONS, HOWEVER, SOURCE WAS LESS NEGATIVE THAN IN PAST, AND WHEN EMBOFF PRESSED HARD FOR REASONS WHY LMI WAS UNWILLING TO PUSH FOR ELECTIONS, REPRESENTATIVE SUGGESTED LMI "MIGHT CONSIDER" WAYS TO INSURE ELECTIONS WERE "FREE." LMI REPRESENTATIVE SAID CONTINUED RIOTS WILL PRODUCE MILITARY REACTION, AND EMBOFF INFORMED HIM U.S.

POLICY OPPOSED MILITARY GOVERNMENT IN PRINCIPLE AND PRESSED HARD ON THEME THAT LMI AS WELL AS OTHER OPPOSITIONISTS WOULD BEST INSURE THEIR OWN GOALS BY WORKING TO PRODUCE SITUATION WHICH WOULD PRECLUDE GOI'S FEELING NECESSITY TO TAKE ADDITIONAL MILITARY MEASURES. LMI REPRESENTATIVE INDICATED HE WOULD LIKE TO TALK AGAIN ON OCT 31 (BUT DID NOT MENTION PROJECTED BAZARGAN TRIP TO PARIS). LMI REPRESENTATIVE WAS PLEASED THAT U.S. WAS STILL PUSHING FOR ELECTIONS AND AFTER USUAL RECITAL OF INADEQUACIES OF SHARIF-EMAMI GOVERNMENT SUGGESTED LMI FAVORED "NEUTRAL" GOVERNMENT, TO SUPERVISE ELECTIONS.

(COMMENT: OCT 20 MEETING MAY HAVE TAKEN PLACE BEFORE SOURCE KNEW OF IMPENDING BAZARGAN TRIP, BUT HIS MORE POSITIVE ATTITUDE TOWARD FORMS OF POLITICAL ACTIVITY OTHER THAN REPETITION OF DEMONSTRATIONS SEEMS TO SUGGEST MORE FLEXIBILITY IN LMI THAN HERETOFORE SHOWN TO EMBOFF.) ------------------057853 221456Z /40 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 1097 AMEMBASSY PARIS PRIORITY INFO USINT BAGDAD SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 10281 LIMDIS

PAST FEW DAYS HAVE SEEN SEVERAL STATEMENTS BY NATIONAL FRONT LEADERS WITH COMMON THEMES: A) GOVERNMENT MUST ADMIT PAST MISTAKES; B) ELECTIONS CAN ONLY BE RUN BY THOSE WHO HAVE HAD NO PART IN CORRUPTION OF PAST 25 YEARS; AND C) MILITARY RULE IN IRAN WILL LEAD TO CATASTROPHE. EXECUTIVE BOARD MEMBER BAKHTIAR TOLD EMBOFF KEY FACTOR IN GETTING INF TO GO ALONG WITH ANY ELECTION SCHEME WAS ASSURANCE THAT THOSE RESPONSIBLE FOR IMMEDATE PAST WOULD NOT HAVE CONTROL OF PROCESS. OTHER MAJOR ISSUES FACING IRAN WERE TO STOP STRIKES AND TORROOT OUT CORRUPTION.

SHAH OUGHT TO A TXKV BEFORE PARLIAMENT AND ACKNOWLEDGE MISTAKES OF PAST AND PLEDGE RESPECT FOR CONSTITUTION AND SAY HE WOULD ACT AS A CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCH. ADMITTING IT WOULD BE DIFFICULT FOR HIM TO DO THIS, BAKHTIAR NOTED THAT SHAH'S SPEECH TO PARLIAMENT OCT 19 (BEING REPORT SEPTEL) WHICH SPOKE OF TRANSITION ARRANGMENTS GAVE EVIDENCE SHAH WAS MELLOWING IN WHAT OPPOSITION SEES AS HIS STUBBORN REFUSAL TO ACCEPT CONSTITUTIONAL LIMITS. BAKHTIAR THOUGHT BIGGEST STUMBLING BLOCK TO FREE ELECTIONS WOULD BE PROBLEM OF MEANS TO ASSURE FREE PARTICIPATION OF OPPOSITION GROUPS. AS ONE POSSIBILITY, HE SUGGESTED PERHAPS TRANSITIONAL GOVERNMENT HEADED BY RESPECTED JUDGE SHOULD TAKE OVER A MONTH BEFORE ELECTIONS.

EMBASSY COMMENT: OPPOSITION ACTIVITIES OF PAST FEW DAYS TAKEN AS A WHOLE SUGGEST THAT MORE SERIOUS CONSIDERATION BEING GIVEN TO SOME FORM OF "COOPERATION" WITH GOI BY INF-RELATED FORCES. WHILE THIS GOES DOWN HARD WITH OLDER OPPOSITION LEADERS, THEY ARE ALSO AMONG FIRST TO REALIZE CONSTANT STRIKES AND VIOLENCE ARE NOT DOING COUNTRY ANY GOOD. BOTH LMI AND REGULAR INF SOURCES HAVE STRESSED OPPORTUNITIES FOR COMMUNISTS INHERENT IN PRESENT SITUATION. BOTH ALSO CLAIM TO HAVE EVIDENCE THAT TUDEH (COMMUNIST) SUPPORTS ARE WORKING BEHIND SCENES IN UNIVERSITIES AND ELSEWHERE, PARTICULARLY LABOR FRONT--MANY STRIKES HAVE AT LEAST ONE OR TWO "POLITICAL" DEMANDS INCLUDED AMONG ECONOMIC DEMANDS.

RESULTS OF MEETINGS IN PARIS BETWEEN KHOMEINI AND OPPOSITION VISITORS, IF SUFFICIENTLY FAVORABLE TO SOME FORM OF COOPERATION BETWEEN IN COUNTRY RELIGIOUS LEADERS AND GOI, COULD HELP START TENSION REDUCING PROCESS.

1978TEHRAN10282.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT, OCTOBER 22 SUMMARY: UNREST CONTINUED OVER WEEKEND IN MANY CITIES, UNIVERSITIES AND SCHOOLS. IT WAS CONTAINED WITH LI

segments.text: SUMMARY: UNREST CONTINUED OVER WEEKEND IN MANY CITIES, UNIVERSITIES AND SCHOOLS. IT WAS CONTAINED WITH LITTLE BLOODSHED FOR THE MOST PART. ANTI-WESTERN AND ANTI-U.S. SLOGANS APPEARED AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY WHERE DISTINCT RELIGIOUS AND LEFT-WING GROUPS HELD JOINT DEMONSTRATION. LARGE RELEASE OF POLITICAL PRISONERS SLATED FOR THIS WEEK HAS INSPIRED SOME CONFUSION AS TO EXACT GOI POLICY. SHAH'S REMARKS TO HEADS OF PARLIAMENT OCT 19 AND SEVERAL OTHER POLITICAL DEVELOPMENTS MENTIONED BELOW ALSO BEING REPORTED SEPTELS. END SUMMARY.

WEEKEND SAW UNREST IN PROVINCES TOO WIDESPREAD TO DESCRIBE IN DETAIL. LARGE NUMBER OF DEMONSTRATORS WERE INVOLVED IN SEVERAL OF THEM, BUT FOR THE MOST PART THEY WERE CONTAINED AND DISPERSED BY POLICE AND SECURITY FORCES WITH MINOR INJURIES, RESULTING IN FEW, IF NAY, DEATHS. TEAR GAS AND OTHER MORE SOPHISTICATED CROWD CONTROL MEASURES WERE USED IN SOME OF THESE INCIDENTS. MANY OF THE INCIDENTS WERE SPECIFIC PROTESTS FOR ATTACK BY "GYPSIES" ON CROWD PRAYING IN KERMAN MOSQUE LAST MONDAY, OCT 16. THAT INCIDENT CONTINUES TO RAISE QUESTIONS.

OPPOSITION IS ACCUSING GOVT OF INSTIGATING IT, AS WELL AS SMALLER SKIRMISH IN SHRINE AT RAY LAST FRIDAY NIGHT IN WHICH HOOLIGANS ATTACKED SOME PILGRIMS. THREE HOOLIGANS WERE REPORTEDLY ARRESTED BY POLICE, UNLIKE "GYPSIES" IN KERMAN, AMONG WHOM NO ARRESTS WERE REPORTED. ONE SOURCE, WHO MAY OR MAY NOT BE RELIABLE, TELLS US THERE HAVE BEEN PLANS FOR SIMILAR PRO-GOVT DEMONSTRATIONS IN MAZANDERAN, ISFAHAN AND EVENTUALLY TEHRAN. OUTCRY AGAINST PERPETRATORS, WHICH INCLUDES PRIVATE GOI EXPRESSIONS OF DISAPPROVAL, MAY PUT AN END TO THIS TYPE OF TENTATIVE PRO-GOVT ACTIVITY --IF THAT IS WHAT IT IS.

PARALLEL UNREST TOOK PLACE IN MANY SCHOOLS AND UNIVERSITIES. ONE OF THE LATEST DEMONSTRATIONS OCCURRED AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY SATURDAY OCT 21, BY STUDENTS REPORTED IN PRESS AS NUMBERING 4,000 (ONE PRIVATE SOURCE SAYS 2,000). STUDENTS WERE SEEN TO BE IN TWO GROUPS, ONE ISLAMIC, THE OTHER LEFT-WING, IT IS NOT CLEAR IF BOTH GROUPS-- OR JUST ONE -- SHOUTED ANTI-U.S. AND ANTI-WESTERN SLOGANS. ARMY WAITED OUTSIDE UNIVERSITY BUT DID NOT INTERVENE AS DEMONSTRATION REMAINED PEACEFUL. SIMILAR DEMONSTRATION BY UP TO 1,000 STUDENTS TOOK PLACE AT NATIONAL UNIVERSITY.

AS OF THIS WRITING MIDDAY OCT 22, GROUP OF YOUTHS ARE REPORTED THROWING ROCKS AND OTHERWISE DEMONSTRATING (AS THEY DID TO SOME EXTENT YESTERDAY TOO) IN NORTHEAST SECTION OF ISFAHAN. TWO BUSES OF AMERICAN SCHOOL CHILDREN HEADING TOWARD HIGH SCHOOL REPORTEDLY WERE HIT BY ROCKS. CONSUL REPORTS POLICE HAVE ORDERS TO BE GENTLE WITH DEMONSTRATORS. CIRCLING HELICOPTERS MIGHT BE RELEASING TEARGAS TO CALM THEM DOWN. IN RELATED ACTIVITY, SECONDARY SCHOOL TEACHERS ALL OVER THE COUNTRY CONTINUE TO BOYCOTT MANY CLASSES. PRESIDENT OF TEACHERS ASSOCIATION MOHAMMAD DERAKHSHESH HAS ISSUED CALL FOR LIFTING OF MARTIAL LAW, RELEASE OF POLITICAL PRISONERS AND DISSOLUTION OF THE PARLIAMENT.

THIS LAST IS A NEWER THEME WHICH IS ENJOYING SOME CURRENCY AMONG ELEMENTS OF THE OPPOSITION, WHO ARGUE THAT PRESENT PARLIAMENT IS NOT RESPONSIVE AND DOES NOT POSSESS CONFIDENCE OF THE PEOPLE. ------------------057797 221452Z /40 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 1099 INFOR AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 10282

MINISTER OF JUSTICE BAHERI MET WITH RELATIVES OF PRISONERS CONVICTED ON POLITICAL CHARGES IN THE PAST, AS WELL AS WITH REPRESENTATIVES OF BAR ASSOCIATION AND SOME OPPOSITIONIST AND HUMAN RIGHTS REPRESENTATIVES WITH WHOM HE SAID HE DISCUSSED MAKE-UP OF LISTS OF PRISONERS TO BE RELEASED THIS WEEK IN CONNECTION WITH SHAH'S BIRTHDAY OCT 26. PRESS REPORTS "SENIOR SECURITY AUTHORITIES" CONFIRM RELEASE OF 1,160 POLITICAL PRISONERS WILL TAKE PLACE, IN ADDITION TO SOME 600 "POLITICAL ACTIVISTS" ARRESTED RECENTLY BUT NOT YET BROUGHT TO TRIAL. NUMBERS GAME IS CONFUSING.

IT IS NOT CLEAR TO US WHETHER 182 (PLUS 14 MAKING TOTAL OF 196) WHO HAVE ALREADY BEEN RELEASED LAST WEEK ARE INCLUDED IN EITHER OF THESE TOTALS. IT IS WORTH NOTING THAT "SENIOR SECURITY AUTHORITIES" (I.E. SAVAK) WENT OUTOF THEIR WAY IN TALKING TO THE PRESS TO DENY JUSTICE MINISTER IS RESPONSIBLE FOR THE RELEASE, NOTING SAVAK PREPARED RELEASE LIST AT ORDER OF SHAHANSHAH SOME SIX WEEKS AGO. BAHERI ALSO TOLD RADIO IRAN THAT FROM NOW ON, THERE WILL BE NO POLITICAL PRISONERS IN IRAN. ONLY THOSE CONVICTED OF TERRORIST ACTIVITIES OR ACTS AGAINST STATE SECURITY WILL FACE IMPRISONMENT. UNQUOTE (CARRIED IN OCT 19 ICA WIRELESS FILE).

AS FAR AS WE KNOW THIS IS PERSONAL POSITION OF BAHERI, SO FAR. WHILE SGYN POLITICAL CHARGES IN THE FUTURE, THERE IS NO FORMAL PLEBEN AT LEAST AS YET, FROM ANY OTHER OFFICIAL SOURCE BESIDES BAHERI ON MORE GENERAL POLICY. OPPOSITION IS PRESSING FOR RELEASE OF ALL PRISONERS HELD ON ANTI-SECURITY CHARGES (INCLUDING TERRORISM), RETRIAL OF ANY WHO GOVT BELIEVES SHOULD BE RETRIED, AND PLEDGE THAT NO MORE POLITICAL PRISONERS WILL BE TAKEN.

POLITICAL SCENE REMAINED VERY ACTIVE, WITH NATIONAL FRONT'S LEADING MEMBER SHAPUR BAKHTIAR TELLING PRESS HIS PARTY IS PREPARED TO ENTER A COALITION NATIONAL GOVT MADE UP OF PEOPLE WHO HAVE NOT BEEN INVOLVED IN POLITICAL AFFAIRS OF PAST 25 YEARS (SEPTEL). MEHDI BAZARGAN, LEADER OF A DIFFERENT WING OF THE NATIONAL FRONT PARTY, HAS GONE TO PARIS TO SEE KHOMEINI; HE IS ACCOMPANIED BY HUMAN RIGHTS ACTIVIST NASSER MINATCHI (SEPTEL). BAR ASSOCIATION IS PUSHING PLAN FOR SPECIAL TRIBUNALS TO TRY CASES OF CORRUPTION AFTER THESE HAVE BEEN INSTPECTED AND REFERRED TO THEM BY THE JUSTICE COMMISSION OF THE MAJLIS.

PRIME MINISTER HAS ASKED PRESS RELEASES AND OTHER NEWS MATERIAL FROM THE MINISTRIES BE SENT FIRST TO THE PRIME MINISTER'S OFFICE WHERE A SPECIAL UNIT WILL SORT THEM OUT AND RELEASE THEM TO THE MEDIA RATHER THAN THIS BEING DONE DIRECTLY BY THE MINISTRIES (NO ONE HAS YET COMPLAINED THAT THIS IS INTERNAL "CENSORSHIP"). SEPTEL ANALYSES SHAH'S FORMAL REMARKS TO HEAD OF SENATE AND MAJLIS WHEN ON OCT 19 THEY PRESENTED A REPLY FROM PARLIAMENT TO HIS OPENING STATEMENT OCT 6.

MEANWHILE, SHARIF-EMAMI AND MINISTERS ARE REPLYING TO QUESTIONS POSED BY PARLIAMENT IN A CLOSED SESSION TODAY, AND MEMBERS ARE REPORTEDLY BEGINNING TO SLEEP IN THE MAJLIS SO AS TO HAVE AN OPPORTUNITY TO SPEAK WHEN MAJLIS GOES INTO OPEN SESSION ON TUESDAY, OCT 24.

IN AN UNUSUAL MOVE, JUSTICE DEPT OFFICIALS IN AMOL HAVE ISSUED WARRANT FOR ARREST OF A POLICE OFFICER, TWO POLICMEN, AND TWO CIVILIANS ACCUSED OF SHOOTING AT DEMONSTRATORS IN THE CITY LAST WEEK WHEN THREE PEOPLE WERE KILLED AND 25 OTHERS INJURED. SIMILARLY, PUBLIC PROSECUTOR AT DEZFUL REPORTEDLY HAS WRITTEN TO CENTRAL POLICE STATION DEMANDING NAMES OF THOSE WHO FIRED ON DEMONSTRATORS IN THAT CITY LAST WEEK. (THIS MIGHT BE THE BEGINNING OF A TREND.)SULLIVAN

AEOI HAS AGAIN EMPHASIZED NEED FOR DETAIL COST BREAKDOWN, AS CALLED FOR IN ARTICLE 8 OF AGREEMENT, BEFORE OUTSTANDING BILL CAN BE PAID. PLEASE FURNISH VIA EMBASSY SINCE IRANIAN POSTAL STRIKE CONTINUES.

1978TEHRAN10338.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT, OCT 23 SUMMARY: VIOLENT DEMONSTRATIONS OCCURRED OCT 22 IN HAMADAN, BUSHEHR, AND KHORRAMABAD. CROWDS DEFIED

segments.text: SUMMARY: VIOLENT DEMONSTRATIONS OCCURRED OCT 22 IN HAMADAN, BUSHEHR, AND KHORRAMABAD. CROWDS DEFIED MARTIAL LAW IN MASHAD AND ISFAHAN BUT SERIOUS CLASH WAS AVOIDED. STUDENTS DEMONSTRATED ON TEHRAN CAMPUSES BUT WERE UNDISTURBED BY TROOPS. AMERICANS VICTIMS OF MINOR BUT NUMEROUS ANTI-FOREIGN INCIDENTS. GOVT ANNOUNCED 1,160 PRISONERS INCLUDING ABOUT 1,000 POLITICAL DETAINEES WILL BE FREED OCT 25. PRESS REPORTS NATIONAL FRONT LEADER SANJABI WILL MEET WITH KHOMEINI IN PARIS, REPORTEDLY TO PATCH UP SPLIT IN OPPOSITION. SANJABI ALSO PLANS VISIT TO U.S. KHOMINI ATTACKED USG IN MESSAGE TO HAJ PILGRIMS. FORMER PRIMIN AMINI DENIED ANY CONNECTION WITH CIA. ABDULFAZI QAZI SHARIAT-PANAHI IS NEW MIN OF SCIENCE AND HIGHER EDUCTION.
FIVE NEW GOV-GENS HAVE BEEN APPOINTED. END SUMMARY.

DEMONSTRATORS CLASHED WITH SECURITY FORCES OCT 22 IN HAMADAN, LEAVING A REPORTED 15 DEAD AND MANY MORE INJURED. PRESS REPORTS VARY WIDELY AS TO NUMBERS OF CASUALTIES, BUT SEPARATE EVIDENCE INDICATES HIGH FIGURE OF 15 IS MOST ACCURATE. ONE REPORT ATTRIBUTES CAUSE TO 17AYEAR OLD GIRL WHO COMMITTED SUICIDE AFTER BRIEF ARREST. APPARENTLY SOMEONE IN CROWD OF DEMONSTRATORS THREW EXPLOSIVE DEVICE AT POLICE WHO THEN OPENED FIRE. (COMMENT: THIS WOULD EXPLAIN OUTBREAK OF VIOLENCE. SECURITY FORCES THROUGHOUT IRAN ARE UNDER STRICT ORDERS TO USE MAXIMUM RESTRAINT, AS WAS CLEARLY INDICATED YESTERDAY IN OTHER DEMONSTRATIONS.) RIOTS CONTINUED IN HAMADAN THROUGHOUT THE DAY.
DESTRUCTIVE RIOTS AND ARSON ALSO OCCURRED IN BUSHEHR AND KHORRAMABAD.

DEMONSTRATORS OPENLY DEFIED MARTIAL LAW IN MASHAD AND ISFAHAN. IN MASHAD, CROWDS PROTESTING RECENT COUNTERRIOT IN KERMAN HECKLED TROOPS WHO DID NOT TRY TO DISPERSE THEM. UNREST IN ISFAHAN SET POSSIBLE DANGEROUS PRECEDENT. CONSULATE REPORTS AT LEAST THREE MAJOR DEMONSTRAZIONS INVOLVING GROUPS FROM SEVERAL HIGH SCHOOLS. LARGEST CROWD OF MORE THAN 500 MARCHED TOWARD GOV-GEN'S OFFICE BUT WAS DIVERTED. STUDENTS DEMANDED KHOMEINI'S PICTURE REPLACE SHAH'S, RELEASE OF ARRESTED STUDENTS AND TEACHERS, AND A NORMAL WORKDAY ON SHAH'S BIRTHDAY. CROWD THEN SWELLED TO OVER 1,000 (FIGURES ARE FROM MLA) STUDENTS, WITH SPRINKLING OF ADULTS, AND CONFRONTED TROOPS IN CENTER CITY. DEMONSTRATORS REFUSED ORDER TO DISPERSE, EVEN WHEN TROOPS FIRED INTO THEAIR.

TROOPS WERE FINALLY ABLE TO BREAK UP CROWD WITH SOME FORCE BUT NO SHOOTING AND NO MAJOR INJURIES. (COMMENT: CONFRONTATION ENDED FAIRLY WELL BUT COULD HAVE BEEN SERIOUS. PRECIDENT IS OMINOUS BECAUSE DEMONSTRATORS HAVE NOW DEFIED ORDER TO DISPERSE AND HAVE SEEN TROOPS BACK DOWN TO SOME DEGREE. ALL SECURITY FORCES IN IRAN ARE UNDER ORDERS TO AVOID BLOODSHED IF AT ALL POSSIBLE.)

SIMILAR RESTRAINT WAS DISPLAYED ON TEHRAN UNIVERSITY CAMPUSES, WHERE STUDENTS AGAIN DEMONSTRATED WITHOUT INTERFERENCE. TROOPS HAVE KEPT OFF UNIVERSITY GROUNDS. TEHRAN UNIVERSITY CHANCELLOR ABDULLAH SHAIBANI HAS PUBLICLY DEFENDED RIGHT OF STUDENTS TO STAGE PROTEST RALLIES. PRESS TAKES DIFFERING EDITORIAL VIEWS OF STUDENT PROTESTS, ALTHOUGH ALL ARE WONDERING WHEN CLASSES WILL BEGIN (UNIVERSITIES ARE THEORETICALLY FUNCTIONING BUT CLASSROOMS ARE NOT). PRESS AND INDEPENDENT EMBASSY EVIDENCE CONFIRMS FORMAL SPLIT BETWEEN ISLAMIC AND LEFTIST STUDENT GROUPS, WHO GATHER IN DIFFERENT AREAS OF CAMPUS INDEPENDENTLY OF EACH OTHER. A THIRD, SMALLERGROUP OF MODERATE NATIONAL FRONT-STYLE DEMONSTRATORS IS ALSO REPORTED.

ANTI-AMERICAN OR ANTI-FOREIGN INCIDENTS HAVE MARKEDLY INCREASED. IN ABADAN, FOUR TEAMS OF AERONEUTRONIC OVERSEAS SERVICES WHICH WERE ATTEMPTING TO SURVEY FOR TELEPHONE CABLES ABANDONED EFFORT AFTER REPEATED CONTACT WITH UNRULY CROWDS. IRANIANS STONED AMERICANS CARS, BROKE SURVEYING EQUIPMENT, AND ONE SHOT AT AMERICANS WITH PELLET GUN. THIS OCCURRED AT SEVERAL LOCATIONS IN CITY. IN BUSHEHR, HOME OF GENERAL ELECTRIC EMPLOYEE WAS ATTACKED BY ROCKTHROWERS LAST NIGHT. ALL WINDOWS WERE BROKEN, AND OCCUPANT MOVED TO AIR BASE HOUSING.

REPORTS INDICATE ------------------062278 231420Z /46 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1127 INFO USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS AMEMBASSY MUSCAT USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 10338 ROCK-THROWERS ATTACKED NUMEROUS OTHER FOREIGN COMMUNITY (NOT NECCESSARILY AMERICAN) HOMES, BREAKING WINDOWS. THEY HAVE ALSO LEFT PAMPHLETS WARNING FOREIGNERS TO LEAVE WITHIN THREE DAYS. INCIDENTS FOLLOW PATTERN PARTICULARLY CONSULATE ISFAHAN, HAVE NOTED INCREASE IN SPONTANEOUS INCIDENTS INVOLVING AMERICANS.

EXPRESSION USUALLY CONSISTS OF FARSI INSULTS OR "YANKEE GO HOME," BUT PHYSICAL ABUSE, THUS FAR OF RELATIVELY MINOR NATURE, HAS ALSO INCREASED. FURTHER EXAMPLES ARE GRAVEL THROWN AT SCHOOLBUSES IN ISFAHAN AND SPRAY-PAINTING CAMPAIGN IN TEHRAN. LETTERS "JM" AND "JB" APPEAR IN SPRAY PAINT ON CARS AND HOUSES OF AMERICANS, INCLUDING ONE EMBOFF. "JM" IS PROBABLY JEBHE MELLI, OR NATIONAL FRONT.

GOVT ANNOUNCED YESTERDAY 1,160 PRISONERS WILL BE FREED OCT 25, EVE OF SHAH'S BIRTHDAY. OF THESE ABOUT 1,000 WILL BE POLITICAL PRISONERS. JUSTICE MINISTER BAHERI SAID THEY WILL RETURN TO FORMER EMPLOYMENT WITH FULL SALARIES AND OTHER BENEFITS.

PRESS REPORTS NATIONAL FRONT LEADER SANJABI WILL FLY TO FRANCE TO CONFER WITH AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, ALLEGEDLY TO PATCH UP SPLIT WHICH AS DEVELOPED IN OPPOSITION MOVEMENT. SANJABI WILL CONTINUE ON TO CANADA FOR SOCIALIST INTERNATIONAL MEETING AND TO U.S. (SEE BELOW). ACCORDING TO THIS ACCOUNT, KHOMEINI'S OBSESSION WITH FIGHT AGAINST FOREIGN INFLUENCE AND DESPOTISM CONFLICTS WITH MORE MODERATE GROUPS, SUCH AS NF WHO SEEK DEMOCRCY UNDER THE CONSTITUTION. IN OTHER KHOMEINI DEVELOPMENTS, PRESS REPORTS DENIALS BY IRANIAN SOURCES THAT ARDESHIR ZAHEDI MET WITH THE AYATOLLAH. MEANWHILE KHOMEINI ATTACKED USG IN MESSAGE TO HAJ PILGRIMS, ACCUSING EMERICANS OF SUPPORTING STATE VIOLENCE IN IRAN.
GREAT BRITAIN AND USSR ALSO CAME UNDER FIRE FOR ROBBING IRAN OF RESOURCES. KHOMEINI ADDED HE IS IN FRANCE BECAUSE NO ISLAMIC COUNTRY WOULD GIVE HIM REFUGE.

IN INTERESTING SIDE DEVELOPMENT, MFA SENT SANJABI'S DIPLOMATIC PASSPORT TO U.S. CONSULATE UNDER COVER OF DIPLOMATIC NOTE OCT 23 SEEKING VISA FOR TWO WEEKS TRAVEL TO U.S. FOR TOURISM. SANJABI WAS ISSUED DIPLOMATIC TOURIST VISA. APLICATION SAID HE PLANS TO VISIT NEW YORK AND WASHINGTON. (COMMENT: U.S. TRIP WILL PRESUMABLY COME AFTER PARIS VISIT. MFA INVOLVEMENT STRONGLY REINFORCES SUSPICION THAT DEAL IS IN THE WIND BETWEEN GOI AND OPPOSITION)

FORMER PRIMIN ALI AMINI, WHOSE NAME STILL APPEARS AS POSSIBLE NEW PRIMIN, DENIED IN INTERVIEW THAT HE HAS BEEN CONNECTED WITH CIA (AMINI IS HAVING DIFFICULTY SHAKING CHARGE THAT KENNEDY ADMINISTRATION PUT HIM IN OFFICE IN 1961.)

DR. ABDULFAZL QAZI SHARIAT-PANAHI BECAME MINISTER OF SCIENCE AND HIGHER EDUCATION OCT 22, HE IS A FORMER UNIVERSITY PROFESSOR AND PLANNING EXPERT. (FULLER BIOGRAPHIC INFORMATION WILL FOLLOW SEPTEL), FIVE NEW GOVERNORS GENERAL WERE ALSO PRESSENTED TO SHAH--MOHAMMAD ALI AHMADI FOR KERMAN, SAYEED BAHADOURI FOR MAZANDARAN, PARVIZ SOHRABIAN FOR LORESTAN, NASSER MAJIDIYEH FOR KEHKOLIYEH AND BOHER AHMAD, AND ABBAS ZARIF FOR CHAHARMAHAL AND BAKHTIARI.

1978TEHRAN10360.subject: STONING OF LOOCKHEED AIRCRAFT INDUSTRY BUSES FOUR INJURIES

segments.text: FOUR INJURIES

ON OCTOBER 23, 1978, ELEVEN BUSES BELONGING TO LOCKHEED AIRCRAFT INDUSTRY WERE STONED IN THE VICINITY OF DOSHAN TAPPEH AIRBASE, TEHRAN. FOUR INJURIES RESULTED FROM SHATTERING GLASS. NONE SERIOUS. ONE ADMITTED TO HOSPITAL WITH SCALP LACERATION AND THEN RELEASED.

THE INCIDENT OCCURED AS BUSES DEPARTED DOSHAN TAPPEH ENROUTE HOME WITH APPROXIMATELY 300 LOCKHEED EMPLOYEES ABOARD. BUSES WERE STOPPED AT A TRAFFIC LIGHT IN THE VICINITY OF DAMAMAND SCHOOL (IRAN PUBLIC HIGH SCHOOL) AND 45-METER ROAD WHEN A GANG OF APPROXIMATELY FIFTY SCHOOL-AGE IRANIAN YOUTHS (15-17 YEARS OLD) BEGAN TO HURL STONES, ROCKS, AND BRICKS AT THE LEAD BUSES.

ALL ELEVEN BUSES SUSTAINED DAMAGE -- MOSTLY BROKEN WINDOWS. BUSES MOVED OUT OF RANGE OF CROWD AS SOON AS TRAFFIC CLEARED. INCIDENT REPORTED BY BUSES IMMEDIATELY TO LOCAL PRECINCT. POLICE RESPONDED TO AREA. CROWD HAD ALREADY DISPERSED.

COMMENT: CROWD WAS PREARMED WITH ROCKS, BRICKS, ETC. AND WAS APPARENTLY WAITING FOR SUITABLE TARGETS TO BE IMMOBILIZED IN FRONT OF THEIR AREA BY TAFFIC LIGHT. NUMEROUS BUSES IDENTICAL IN SHAPE, SIZE, AND MARKING TO LOCKHEED BUSES CONTAINING AMERICAN CONTRACTOR PERSONNEL FROM NUMEROUS COMPAINES EXIT AIR BASE AND TRAVEL SAME ROUTE. OUR INITIAL ASSESSMENT, CONCURRED BY LOCKHEED AND GOI, IS THAT LOCKHEED WAS NOT SPECIFICALLY TARGETED BUT, RATHER, THAT TARGET WAS MORE GENERALLY ONE OF AMERICAN CONTRACTOR PERSONNEL. CROWD MADE NO ATTEMPT TO DIRECT THEIR MISSILES TOWARD OTHER VEHICLES STALLED IN TRAFFIC. ALL AMERICAN CONTRACTOR BUSES IN VICINITY OF CROWD AT TIME OFINCIDENT RECEIVED STONES.
EYEWITNESSES ON BUSES STATE YOUTHS IN CROWD WERE CHANTING ANTI-GOI AND ANTIAMERICAN ("YANKEE") REMARKS.
LOCKHEED BUSES AND PERSONNEL REPORTED FOR WORK IN NORMAL FASHION NEXT ALTHOUGH TIMES AND ROUTES OF BUSES ARE NOW BEING STAGGERED WHERE POSSIBLE.
SENATOR WHO IS BEHIND-THE-SCENES CONFIDANT OF PM SHARIF-EMAMI BRIEFED POLITICAL COUNSELOR OCT 23 ON ONGOING EFFORTS TO WEAN BAZAAR MERCHANTS FROM OPPOSITION TO GOI SIDE.

FIRST, THERE IS THE GUILDS ORGANIZATION ("ASNAF") WHOSE LEADERSHIP SENATOR KNOWS WELL AND CAN VOUCH FOR. HE BROUGHT LEADERSHIP TO SEE PM FRIDAY OCT 20, AND THEY LEFT HAPPY. A SPECIAL COMMISSION HAS BEEN APPOINTED WHICH IS TO REPORT BACK IN 20 DAYS WITH A DRAFT LAW FOR SUBMISSION TO PARLIAMENT WHICH WILL GIVE GUILDS SUBSTANTIAL CONTROL OVER THEIR OWN AFFAIRS, AS THEY WANT. ON THE OTHER HAND, FIXING OF PRICES, PRICE CONTROL, AND ANTI-PROFITEERING EFFORTS WILL BE GOI RESPONSIBILITY, NOT THAT OF THE GUILDS AS IN RECENT PAST. IN EFFECT GUILDS WILL BECOME INDEPENDENT SYNDICATE.

SINCE FORMER PRESIDENT HAS BEEN REMOVED (FOR CORRUPTION) NEW ELECTIONS WERE SCHEDULED FOR SEPT 19. INSTALLATION OF MARTIAL LAW FORCED THEIR POSTPONEMENT, BUT THEY WILL EVENTUALLY TAKE PLACE. MEANWHILE, AN HONEST, RESPECTED CIVIL SERVANT IN MINISTRY OF COMMERCE HAS BEEN ACTING AS "SUPERVISOR" ADMINISTERING THE GUILD'S AFFAIRS WITH THE HELP OF FIVE GUILD MEMBERS. SENATOR (WHO IS PROMINENT OLD-TIMER IN TEHRAN POLITICS) SAID THERE IS NO PROBLEM WITH THEM; THEY WILL WORK WITH THE GOI.

A VERY DIFFERENT GROUP ARE SOME PROMINENT BAZAARI MERCHANTS WHO HAVE BEEN SUPPORTING( AND FOLLOWING) AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI. HE PROVIDED POL COUNS A LIST OF THEM, WHICH IS BEING TRANSLATED. HE HAS NOT GIVE UP ON THIS GROUP AND WILL KEEP WORKING ON THEM.

REAL TARGET NOW IS THIRD GROUP--BAZAARIS WHO GENERALLY FOLLOW MODERATE COURSE OF AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI. THEY ARE AFRAID OF KHOMEINI'S PEOPLE BUT AREGETTING FED UP WITH THE SITUATION AND ARE LOSING MONEY. SENATOR HAS APPOINTMENT TO LUNCH WITHTHEM IN THE BAZAAR IN TWO WEEKS.
MEANWHILE, SENATOR IS CONTINUING TO WORK HARD ON A NUMBER OF OTHERS WHO OPPOSE GOI. HE MENTIONED A PROMINENT POLITICAL LEADER, SEHJAVADI, ON WHOM HE IS WORKING NEXT.
HE AGAIN CAUTIONED THAT ALL THIS INFORMATION MUST BE HELD VERY CLOSELY FOR TIME BEING.

1978TEHRAN10378.subject: ELEMENTS OF GOI AGREEMENT WITH RELIGIOUS OPPOSITION SUMMARY: PRIME MINISTER'S CONFIDEANT HAS PROVIDED DETAILS OF AGREEMENT BETWEEN PM AND A MODERATE RELIGIOUS L

segments.text: SUMMARY: PRIME MINISTER'S CONFIDEANT HAS PROVIDED DETAILS OF AGREEMENT BETWEEN PM AND A MODERATE RELIGIOUS LEADER AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI AS WELL AS MEHDI BAZARGAN, LEADER OF ONE FACTION IN OPPOSITION NATIONAL FRONT. HE SAID HE HAD NOT RPT NOT INFORMED PM HE WAS GIVING POL COUNS THIS INFORMATION AND ASKED IT BE KEPT EXTREMELY CONFIDENTIAL. ITS SENSITIVITY COULD ACCOUNT FOR FACT OUR INFORMATION FROM SEVERAL OTHER SOURCES TEND TO CONTRADICT IT. END SUMMARY.

SENATOR WHO IS CLOSE BEHIND-THE-SCENES COLLABORATOR OF PM SHARIF-EMAMI SOUGHT OUT POLITICAL COUNSELOR OCT 23 TO BRIEF HIM ON RECENTLY CONCLUDED AGREEMENT BETWEEN SHARIFEMAMI AND REPRESENTTATIVES OF SHARIATMADARI'S MODERATE RELIGIOUS OPPOSITION. P.M. AGREED TO 9 OF 12 OPPOSITION DEMANDS IN RETURN FORWHICH HE WAS PROMISED QUIET COOPERATION BY THAT (IMPORTANT) SECTION OF THE OPPOSITION.

IN ADDITION, OPPOSITION LEADERS BAZARGAN AND MINIATCHI HAVE GONE TO FRANCE TO TALK TO KHOMEINI. CONTRARY TO COVER STORY THEY GAVE PRESS, THEIR REAL MISSION IS TO SEE IF KHOMEINI WILL AGREE TO RETURN TO IRAN IN 9-10 MONTHS ON THE BASIS OF HIS RESPECTING THE CONSTITUTION, I.E., CEASING HIS DEMANDS FOR OVERTHROW OF THE MONARCHY, ESTABLISHMENT OF ISLAMIC REPUBLIC, ETC. IF KHOMEINI AGREES, CHANGE IN HIS PUBLIC POSTURE WILL BE GRADUAL. BARARGAN AND MINIATCHI HAVE ALLOWED THEMSELVES 10 DAYS IN FRANCE TO ACCOMPLIIS TASK.

DEMANDS WERE PRESENTED IN SECRET MEETING WITH PM BY BAZARGAN, MINATCHI, AND SHARIATMADARI'S SON, WITH OUR SOURCE, WHO ARRANGED THE WHOLE THING, PRESENT. (NATIONAL FRONT LEFT-WINGER SAHABI WAS ORIGINALLY SCHEDULED TO COME TOO, BUT HE DID NOT SHOW, OUR SOURCE ADDS.) WE HAVE BEEN PROMISED COPY OF WRITTEN DEMANDS. MEANWHILE FOLLOWING ARE A REPRODUCED FROM SENATOR'S MEMORY. NINE DEMANDS ACCEPTED ARE

BAZARGAN, MINATCHI AND RELIGIOUS LEADERS WANT TO FORM THEIR OWN PARTY. THEY REQUESTED NON-INTERFERENCE FROM GOI AND POSITIVE SUPPORT IF POSSIBLE. PM PROMISED SUPPORT. (B) REQUEST THAT RELIGIOUS MEETING PLACE ("HOSSEINIYE") NEAR OLD SHEMIRAN ROAD BE ALLOWED TO REOPEN. GRANTED. (C) BAZARGAN-MINATCHI HUMAN RIGHTS ORGANIZATION BE FORMALLY ALLOWED TO REGISTER. GRANTED. (D) COMPLETE FREEDOM OF THE PRESS. GRANTED. (THIS PREDATED RECENT JOURNALISTS' DEMANDS.) (E) ROYAL FAMILY TO STAY OUT OF ALL BUSINESS AND GENERALLY BE KEPT IN TIGHT REIN. PM SAID HE ENTHUSIASTICALLY AGREED AND WOULD PRESS FOR THIS. (F) NEXT SUMMER'S FREE ELECTIONS NOT BE POSTPONED. GRANTED. (G) SPECIAL LAW TO SPEED TRIALS FOR CORRUPTION.

PM AGREED TO ASK THAT MAJLIS PASS SUCH A LAW BUT POINTED OUT IT MUST BE MODERATE, NOT SO DRASTIC AS TO UNDERMINE GOI. (H) SHAH TO REIGN, NOT RULE, AND THUS NOT INTERFERE IN DAILY GOI BUSINESS. PM AGREED, NOTING HOWEVER THAT SHAH WOULD ALWAYS REMAIN COMMANDER-IN-CHIEF OF ARMED FORCES. HE INDICATED HE IS HAVING HIS OWN PROBLEMS WITH SHAH AND THE ARMY AT PRESENT AND SAID HE COULD GO NO FURTHER UNDER PRESENT CONDITIONS. (I) MORE RELIGIOUS MATERIALS IN SCHOOL TEXTBOOKS. PM AGREED TO INSERTION OF THINGS PEOPLE LIKE BAZARGAN, MINATCHI, AND SHARIATMADARI BELIEVE IN, NOT A LOT OF THE JUNK PREACHED BY SOME MULLAHS.
THREE DEMANDS NOT ACCEPTED BY PM ARE
IMMEDIATE END TO MARTIAL LAW. PM SAID HE WOULDTO END IT BEFORE SIX MONTHS IF POSSIBLE.
IMMEDIATE DISSOLUATION OF PARLIAMENT. PM SAID HE MIGHT LATER CONSIDER POSSIBILITY OF DISSOLVING PARLIAMENT ONE OR TWO MONTHS EARLIER THAN NEXT JUNE AND GOING INTO ELECTORAL PERIOD THEN.
RELEASE OF ALL POLITICAL PRISONERS. PM POINTED OUT UPCOMING (SHAH'S BIRTHDAY) RELEASE OF ALL EXCEPT THOSE CONVICTED OF SPECIFIC CRIMES OF MURDER, TERRORISM, ETC.

GROUP EXPRESSED INTEREST IN CONTINUING DIALOGUE ON BEHALF OF AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI. HOWEVER, MANY PEOPLE ARE CLAIMING TO SPEAK FOR HIM THISE DAYS. PM SHOULD KNOW THAT SHARIATMADARI'S ONLY LEGITIMATE REPS WOULD BE EITHER MINATCHI OR ABBASSI (A CLOSE CONFIDANT OF SHARIATMADARI'S). THEY WOULD GO EITHER DIRECTLY TO THE PM HIMSELF OR TO THE SENATOR INTERMEDIARY, NO ONE ELSE.

COMMENT: NOT CLEAR TO US WHY SENATOR CHOSE THIS MOMENT TO REVEAL DETAILS TO EMBASSY EXCEPT THAT HE SEEKS LONG-TERM GOOD RELATIONSHIP WITH US (HE SAID HE WAS DOING THIS "FOR MY COUNTRY") AND MIGHT PREFER TO TELL US FIRST IN CASE WE WERE TO LEARN OF IT FROM THE OPPOSITION. TRUST OF THIS REPORT RUNS CONTRARY TO INFORMATION FROM VARIOUS OTHER SOURCES WHICH DENY THAT ANY AGREEMENT HAS YET BEEN CONCLUDED, THOUGH CONFIRMING AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI IS ANXIOUS FOR ONE. EXTREME SENSITIVITY OF INFORMATION AT THIS TIME COULD ACCOUNT FOR CONFLICTING STORIES.
WE TRUST INTERESTED OFFICES ARE RECEIVING PERIODIC SECURITY AND POLITICAL REPORTS FROM EMB TEHRAN WHICH DEAL ON REGUALR BASIS WITH SECURITY SITUATION.

DUPONT POSTER STORY (REFTEL) IS EXREMELY GARBLED. APPARENTLY LARGE POSTERS WERE PUT UP IN SHAH ABBAS HOTEL IN ISFAHAN WITH CAPTION "WHAT SHOULD BE DONE FOR THE SHAH ON HIS BIRTHDAY?" SOMEONE HAD SCRIBBLED ON ONE POSTER IN ENGLISH "GIVE HIM A DEAD AMERICAN." THOSE WHO SAW POSTER THOUGHT OF IT AS SICK JOKE, NOT SERIOUS THREAT, BUT STORY WAS OBVIOUSLY ELABORATED IN RETELLING, BOTH IN IRAN, AND U.S.

WE UNDERSTAND THAT 46 BELL HELICOPTER EMPLOYEES HAVE TAKEN UP OPTION TO TERMINATE TOURS EARLY, BUT NOT ALL OF THESE HAVE FAMILIES. ABOUT 60 BELL EMPLOYEES HAVE SENT DEPENDENTS HOME. AT LEAST FOUR COMPANIES HAVE EXTENDED TEN PER CENT "HARDSHIPS" OR "MARTIAL LAW" BONUS FOR THOSE WHO STAY. EMBASSY DOES NOT BELIEVE IT WOULD BE NECESSARY OR HELPFUL TO COMMENT PUBLICLY ON THESE MEASURES. BELL, OF COURSE, IS A PRIVATE FIRM AND DOES NOT NEED OUR "CONSENT" TO PERMIT PERSONNEL TO LEAVE COUNTRY. SEVERAL COMPANIES HERE HAVE EASED CONTRACT TERMS AND WILL PERMIT PERSONNEL TO LEAVE, AT COMPANY EXPENSE, PRIOR TO THE CONTRACT TERMINATION DATE.

IN UNREST OF PAST TWO WEEKS THERE HAVE BEEN MORE INCIDENTS (INSULTS, EPITHETS, ROCK THROWING) INVOLVING FOREIGNERS, INCLUDING AMERICANS, AND EMBASSY AND CONSULATES HAVE BEEN DEALLING WITH THESE ON A CASE-BY-CASE BASIS. AS A RESULT OF THESE INCIDENTS THERE HAS BEEN A SHARP INCREASE IN RUMORS OF VARIOUS KINDS AND INCREASED NERVOUSNESS WITHIN THE AMERICAN COMMUNITY. WE HAVE NO EVIDENCE OF A CONCERTED, WIDESPREAD ANTI-AMERICAN CAMPAIGN; MOST INCIDENTS OF ROCK THROWING, ETC. APPEAR TO BE ISOLATED ACTS, FREQUENTLY BY TEEN AGERS. THE ATTACK ON THE LOCKHEED BUSES (SEPTEL) AND BOMBING OF BELL BUS IN ISFAHAN MAY BE EXCEPTIONS.
THE FLURRY OF INCIDENTS AGAINST BELL PERSONNEL IN ISFAHAN HAS ANTIAMERICAN OVERTONES BUT OTHER AMERICAN CONTRACT PERSONNEL IN ISFAHAN HAVE SO FAR REMAINED UNSCATHED.

IN AN ATTEMPT TO KEEP THE RUMORS*UNDER CONTROL THE EMB HAS ISSUED THE FOLLOWING SECURITY ADVISORY TO TEHRAN AND THE CONSULATES: "DURING THE UP-COMING WEEKEND THE AMERICAN COMMUNITY SHOULD OBSERVE NORMAL PRECAUTIONARY PROCEDURES, LIMIT MOVEMENT, AND AVOID CROWDS. "THIS IS A PRECAUTIONARY ANNOUNCEMENT AND WE WISH TO STRESS THAT THERE IS NO, REPEAT NO, EVIDENCE THAT THERE WILL BE DISORDERS. RUMORS APPEAR TO BE JUST THAT--RUMORS."
THE SENTENCE ON NO DISORDERS WILL BE MODIFIED FOR ISFAHAN WHERE SOME DEMONSTRATIONS ARE EXPECTED ON OCTOBER 26.

WHEN I TOOK DEPSEC DEFENSE DUNCAN TO CALL ON SHAH MORNING OCT 24, IT WAS CLEAR THAT THE IMPERIAL ATTENTION WAS SERIOUSLY DISTRACTED FROM ANY DISCUSSION OF MILITARY PROCUREMENT MATTERS. SHAH LET TOUFANIAN DO MOST OF THE TALKING AND THEN BROUGHT AUDIENCE TO AN END IN LESS THAN THIRTY MINUTES. HOWEVER, HE ASKED ME TO STAY BEHIND.

TO MY SURPRISE, WE WERE THEN JOINED BY BRITISH AMBASSADOR (WHO LATER TOLD ME HE HAD BEEN SUMMONED QUITE UNEXPECTEDLY). SHAH SAID HE WISHED REVIEW CURRENT SITUATION WITH THE TWO OF US AND WOULD VALUE OUR CANDID ADVICE.

WE THEN WENT THROUGH A TWO HOUR SESSION WHICH LOOKED AT ALL THE MAJOR PROBLEMS CURRENTLY FACING IRAN AND EXAMINED SEVERAL OPTIONS FOR DEALING WITH THEM. THE ONLY INTERRUPTIONS WERE THREE TELEPHONE CALLS TO THE SYAH REPORTING INCIDENTS IN QOM AND AHWAZ.

IT SEEMS THAT THE PRIMARY STIMULUS FOR THIS UNUSUAL MEETING WAS THE CONTINUING STRIKE AT NIOC PRODUCTION AND REFINING FACILITIES IN AHWAZ AND ABADAN. SHAH SAID THAT HUSHANG ANSARY, WHO WAS STILL IN AHWAZ, HAD BEEN "IMPRISONED" NIGHT OF OCT 23 BY CLERICAL STAFF OF OSCO AND HAD "ESCAPED" ONLY BY RUNNING OUT A BACK DOOR WHEN HE HAD GONE TO TAKE A TELEPHONE CALL. HE SAID TECHNICIANS AND LABORERS WERE PREPARED TO RETURN TO WORK, BUT CLERICAL STAFF WAS PROLONGING THE STRIKE BY INSISTING ON "POLITICAL" RATHER THAN ECONOMIC DEMANDS. HE SAID STRIKE LEADERS WERE YOUNG, JUNIOR "CLERKS" WHO HAD ARROGATED CONTROL OF THE ACTION TO THEMSELVES.
HE CLAIMED THERE WAS ALREADY A 600,000 BARREL LOSS OF NIOC PRODUCTION OCTOBER 23.

BEYOND THIS SITUATION, HE SAID HE WAS CONCERNED BY RIOTS IN HAMADAN, UNREST AT THE UNIVERSITIES, AND THE CONSTANT STREET DEMONSTRATIONS BY SECONDARY SCHOOL STUDENTS. THE REPORTS FROM QOM WHICH CAME IN WHILE WE TALKED TOLD OF "SNIPER FIRE" FROM THE TOPS OF BUILDINGS WHICH HAD ALREADY WOUNDED THREE OR FOUR SOLDIERS.

FACED WITH ALL THIS, SHAH SAID HE WAS REVIEWING SEVERAL OPTIONS. ONE WAS TO INSTALL A MILITARY GOVT. HE PERSONALLY FELT THIS WAS A NON-STARTER. THE MILITARY COULD NOT EVEN BEGIN TO RUN THE OIL INDUSTRY. IF THEY TRIED, EVERYTHING ELSE WOULD SHUT DOWN AND THEY WOULD HAVE TO TRY TO RUN THE WHOLE NATION. AT BEST, A "MILITARY SOLUTION" WOULD BE A VERY SHORT-TERM FIX.

ANOTHER OPTION, HE SAID, WOULD BE TO TRY A COALITION GOVT. HE HAD NO RPT NO CONFIDENCE SUCH A MEASURE WOULD SUCCEED. FIRST, HE DID NOT KNOW HOW "LOYAL" SUCH A COALITION WOULD BE. SECOND, HE HAD NO ASSURANCES ABOUT THEIR COMPETENCE. BUT, SUCH A MOVE MIGHT HAVE PSYCHOLOGICAL EFFECTS WHICH WOULD CALM DOWN THE CURRENT "FRENZY." HE ASKED FOR OUR VIEWS.

BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND I, IN MUTUALLY REINFORCING STATEMENTS, SAID THE FOLLOWING: (A) WE DID NOT RPT NOT SEE THE SITUATION QUITE AS DARKLY AS THE SHAH. ALTHOUGH THERE WERE DISRUPTIONS, LIFE WAS GOING ON MORE OR LESS NORMALLY IN MOST OF THE COUNTRY. PEOPLE WERE AT WORK, SERVICES CONTINUED, SHOPS WERE OPEN, ETC. WE ADMITTED THAT THE NIOC STRIKE AND THE INDISCIPLINE AMONG SCHOOL CHILDREN WERE TROUBLING, BUT NOT NECESSARILY FATAL. (B) WE AGREED THAT A "MILITARY SOLUTION" IS A NONSTARTER.

IT WOULD MERELY CREATE WORSE PRESSURES, WHICH ------------------020578 271553Z /43 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1148 INFO AMEMBASSY LONDON IMMEDIATE AMCONSUL DHAHRAN IMMEDIATE SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 10383 - DELETING ANALYSIS NOTE EXDIS DHAHRAN PASS DEPSECDEF DUNCAN MIGHT LEAD TO A REAL EXPLOSION. (C) WE HAD VERY LITTLE BASIS ON WHICH TO JUDGE THE COMPETENCE OR LOYALTY OF THOSE WHO MIGHT ENTER A "COALITION" GOVT. WE NOTED SOME POLITICIANS WERE CONSULTING IN PARIS WITH KHOMEINI. HOWEVER, LATTER SEEMED TO BE ADAMANTLY ANTI-SHAH.

WHILE IT MIGHT BE ADVISABLE TO BRING SOME OPPOSITION MEMBERS INTO CURRENT GOVT IF THEY WOULD AGREE, WE THOUGHT THAT DISMISSAL OF GOVT AT THIS STAGE WOULD BE FURTHER DESTABILIZING. (D) WHAT SEEMED MOST NECESSARY AT CURRENT STAGE WAS APPEARANCE OF POSITIVE, PROGRAMMED ACTION BY GOVT. PUBLIC PERCEPTION OF GOVT CURRENTLY WAS ONE OF DRIFT AND PASSIVITY. GOVT NEEDED TO PROPOSE AND ANNOUNCE SOME SOUND AND POSITIVE STEPS SO THAT IT COULD LEAD RATHER THAN FOLLOW. (E) AS FAR AS NIOC STRIKE WAS CONCERNED, WE DOUBTED GOVT WOULD BE WISE TO CAPITULATE ON "POLITICAL" DEMANDS (PRIMARY DEMAND IS LIFTING OF MARTIAL LAW NATIONWIDE).

IF A STRIKE DID FORCE OIL INDUSTRY TO SHUT DOWN FOR AWHILE, IT NEED NOT BE FATAL. IN FACT, IT MIGHT BRING SOME PEOPLE TO THEIR SENSES BY FORCING THE REALIZATION THAT ALL THESE DISRUPTIONS COULD REALLY BEGIN TO HURT THOSE WHO WERE CARRYING THEM OUT.

SHAH, WHO WAS SOBER, BUT NOT DEPRESSED, THROUGHOUT THIS CONVERSATION, THANKED US FOR OUR VIEWS AND FOR OUR REACTION TO HIS VIEWS. HE SAID HE WOULD WORK WITH HIS PEOPLE TO SOLVE THE IMMEDIATE ISSUES AND HOPED HE COULD CALL US IN AGAIN "WITHIN A FEW DAYS" FOR FURTHER DISCUSSIONS.

COMMENT: IT WOULD SEEM, FROM THIS MEETING, THAT SHAH REALLY FEELS HIMSELF WITHOUT ANY CLEAR PLAN FOR THE IMMEDIATE FUTURE. IT WOULD ALSO APPEAR THAT HE FEELS HIMSELF WITHOUT RELIABLE IRANIAN ADVISERS FROM WHOM HE CAN GET OBJECTIVE REACTIONS. I BELIEVE THE MILITARY, WHO WOULD LIKE TO TAKE OVER IN THEIR OWN WAY, ARE DELIBERATELY FEEDING HIM THE DARKEST POSSIBLE VIEWS OF THE CURRENT SITUATION. HIS FEAR OF AN NIOC SHUTDOWN REFLECTS HIS "CONSPIRACY" VIEW OF COMMUNIST INTENTIONS. I HAVE ASKED THE OSCO REPRESENTATIVE TO GET AN OBJECTIVE APPRAISAL OF THE STRIKE SITUATION IN AHWAZ AND GIVE ME A BRIEFING OCTOBER 25.
I WILL REPORT THE RESULTS OF THAT COVERSATION IMMEDIATELY.

1978TEHRAN10384.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT OCT 24 SUMMARY: GOVT WILL RELEASE 1,126 POLITICAL PRISONERS OCT 25. MLA RELEASED TEACHERS' LEADER MOHAMMAD DERAKHSHESH

segments.text: SUMMARY: GOVT WILL RELEASE 1,126 POLITICAL PRISONERS OCT 25. MLA RELEASED TEACHERS' LEADER MOHAMMAD DERAKHSHESH. MIN OF SCIENCE AND HIGHER EDUCATION ANNOUNCED NEW UNIVERSITY BILL WILL GRANT STUDENTS FULL POLITICAL FREEDON. METRO PROJECT COMES UNDER SCRUTINY. POLITICALLY-BASED STRIKE AT NIRT BEGAN YESTERDAY. JUDGES IN SAGHEZ STAGED ONE-DAY HUNGER STRIKE TO PROTEST ILLEGAL ARRESTS. PRESS ALLEGES CENSURE MOTION WHICH MAJLES WILL TAKE UP TODAY IS PLOY BY SHARIF-EMAMI TO BOLSTER HIS POSITION. RADICAL MOVEMENT LEADER MOGHADAM CALLS FOR DISSOLUTION OF PARLIAMENT. STONE-THROWING HIGH SCHOOL STUDENTS DAMAGED 11 LOCKHEED BUSES, INJURING FOUR AMERICANS (SEPTEL). VIOLENT DEMONSTRATION IN KHORRAMABAD WITH TWO REPORTED KILLED.
OTHER DEMONSTRATIONS DISPLAY DEFINANCE OF MARTIAL LAW IN TEHRAN. SECOND COUNTER INCIDENT NEAR KERMAN. END SUMMARY.

GOVT ANNOUNCED 1,451 PRISONERS WILL BE FREED TOMORROW ON EVE OF SHAH'S BIRTHDAY. OF THESE, 1,126 ARE POLITICAL PRISONERS. MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES YESTERDAY RELEASED MOHAMMAD DERAKHSHESH, PRESIDENT OF THE IRANIAN TEACHERS ASSOCIATION. HE HAD BEEN ARRESTED OCT 8, APPARENTLY BECAUSE AN ASSOCIATION JOURNAL HAD CRITICIZED SAVAK.

NEW MINISTER OF SCIENCE AND HIGHER EDUCATION ABDOLFAZL QASI SHARIAT-PANAHI ANNOUNCED WITHDRAWAL OF CONTROVERSIAW UNIVERSITY INDEPENDENCE BILL. HE WILL OFFER A NEW BILL AFTER CONSULTATION WITH UNIVERSITIES. HE PLEDGED NUMEROUS CONCESSIONS FOR NEW BILL, INCLUDING PROVISION THAT STUDENTS WILL BE IMMUNE FROM ARREST WHILE ON CAMPUS. UNIVERSITY CHANCELLORS WILL BE APOLITICAL, AND THEY AS WELL AS DEPARTMENT HEADS WILL BE ELECTED BY ACADEMIC STAFFS OF INDIVIDUAL UNIVERSITIES. BOARDS OF TRUSTEES WILL DISBAND AND UNIVERSITIES WILL INDIVIDUALLY DEVELOP NEW DECISION-MAKING BODIES WHICH WILL DETERMINE UNIVERSTIY POLICIES. THIS WILL INCLUDE MAINTENANCE OF ORDER ON CAMPUS; GOVT WILL WITHDRAW GUARDS.

PROFESSORS WHO WERE FORCED INTO RETIREMENT MAY RESUME ACADEMIC CAREERS. STUDENTS WHO HAVE BEEN DETAINED FOR POLITICAL REASONS WILL BE FREED (COMMENT: IF GOI DOES WHAT IT PROMISES, IRANIAN UNIVERSITITES WILL BE MORE INDEPENDENT THAN AMERICAN UNIVERSITIES OR THOSE OF MOST OTHER DEMOCRATIC COUNTRIES.)

TEHRAN METRO PROJECT HAS BECOME GROWING ISSUE OF GOVT WASTE AND CORRUPTION. IT IS LIKELY PRESSURE WILL BUILD FOR GOI TO SCRAP PROJECT OR AT LEAST DRASTICALLY CUT BACK. ONE EDITOR CALLS IT A "WHITE MOLE."
NATIONAL IRANIAN RADIO AND TELEVISION WENT ON STRIKE YESTERDAY. WORK STOPPAGE WAS AT LEAST PARTIALLY POLITICAL; STRIKERS DEMAND THAT SUPERVISORS WHO ASSISTED IN CENSORSHIP BE FIRED.

JUDGES IN SAGHEZ (KORDESTAN PROVINCE) STAGED ONEDAY HUNGER STRIKE TO PROTEST ILLEGAL ARRESTS. SECURITY FORCES HAD ALLEGEDLY ARRESTED ANTISECURITY VIOLATORS AND TURNED THEM OVER TO MILITARY COURTS WITHOUT REFERENCE TO CIVIL COURTS. SAGHEZ IS NOT UNDER MARTIAL LAW.

MAJLIS IS SCHEDULED TO CONSIDER CENSURE MOTION TABLED BY ABBAS AKHBARI TODAY. SOME OBSERVERS CONSIDER ENTIRE AFFAIR A PLOY ON PART OF SHARIF-EMAMI TO BEAT TRUE OPPOSITIONISTS (SUCH AS BANI-AHMAD) TO THE PUNCH. NOTION IS THAT MAJLIS ------------------074883 241520Z /44 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1150 INFO USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 10384 WILL OVERWHELMINGLY REJECT CENSURE MOTION WHICH BLAMES SHARIF-EMAMI FOR EVERYTHING WRONG IN IRAN, AND PRIMIN'S POSITION WILL THEREFORE BE STRENGTHENED.

(COMMENT: ARCHETYPICAL PERSIAN VIEW OF THE SITUATION IS NOT IMPLAUSIBLE. AKHBARI HAD NEVER TAKEN OPPOSITION LINE IN THE PAST AND IS CERTAINLY A BRAND NEW CONUERT IF HE IS IN FACT SINCERE.) RAHMATOLLAH MOGHADAM-MAREGHI, LEADER OF THE RADICAL MOVE MENT OF IRAN, HAS MEANWHILE CALLED FOR DISSOLUTION OF BOTH HOUSES OF PARLIAMENT ON GROUNDS THAT WITH RESURGENCE PARTY NO LONGER MONOPOLIZING POLITICS, IT IS WRONG TO HAVEAN RPPI MAJLIS AND SENATE VOTING ON LEGISLATION.

DEMONSTRATIONS AND VIOLENCE CONTINUE EVEN IN MARTIAL LAW CITIES. KHORRAMABAD (NOT UNDER MARTIAL LAW) WITNESSED RIOTS LEAVING A REPORTED TWO DEAD AND HEAVY DSTRUCTION. PRESS REPORTS ANTIGOVT DEMONSTRATIONS IN AT LEAST 20 OTHER CITIES. IN TEHRAN, STUDENT GROUPS HAVE MARCHED AND DEMONSTRATED IN MANY PARTS OF THE CITY. THEY NOW NO LONGER MAKE ANY EFFORT TO REMAIN ON SCHOOL PROPERTY BUT TAKE TO STREETS AS IF MARTIAL LAW DID NOT EXIST. TODAY TWO GROUPS OF 300-400 EACH LEFT MEN'S SCHOOLS ON IRANSHAHR AND MARCHED PAST U.S. CONSULATE. ABOUT FIFTY PASSED IN FRONT OF EMBASSY.

BANNERS IN FARSI READ: "DOWN WITH THE SHAH" AND "BRING BACK KHOMEINI." OTHER CROWDS, ONE INCLUDING 1500-200 STUDENTS, ARE MARCHING IN TEHRAN. (COMMENT: WITHIN LAST FEW DAYS PROTESTS HAVE BECOME NOTICEABLY BOLDER. MARTIAL LAW PROHIBITION AGAINST PUBLIC GATHERINGS IS A MOCKERY. PATTERN OF EVEN A WEEK AGO, WHEN DEMONSTRATORS WOULD GATHER BUT THEN DISPERSE INSTANTLY AS TROOPS APPEARED, IS NO LONGER EVIDENT. ORDER HAS BY NO MEANS COLLAPSED, AND SECURITY FORCES WILL BREAK UP CROWDS IF THEY BECOME TOO UNRULY.
MORNING OCT 24 A YOUNG GROUP WAS FORCIBLY DISPERSED WHEN THEY BEGAN SHOVING PARKED CARS INTO BUSY STREET, BUT TROOPS ARE UNDER ORDERS TO USE MINIMUM FORCE, AND PROTESTERS SEEM TO KNOW THIS.)

STUDENT DEMSONTRATORS HAVE BEEN OVERWHELMINGLY ANTIGOVT RATHER THAN ANTIFOREIGN, BUT TEHRAN'S WORST ANTIAMERICAN INCIDENT OCCURRED YESTERDAY AS STONE-THROWING STUDENTS DAMAGED 11 LOCKHEED BUSES AND INJURED FOUR AMERICANS (REFPORTED SEPTEL). RELIABLE EYEWITNESS IN ABADAN HAS SEEN SIGNS: "BRITISH PIGS GO HOME." SOURCE ALSO REPORTS WESTERNOWNED AUTOMOBILES IN ABADAN ARE HAVING LICENSES RIPPED OFF. 10 . SECOND INCIDENT OF COUNTER-VIOLENCE OCCURRED IN RAVAR (NEAR KERMAN, SITE OF FIRST INCIDENT). INDIVIDUAL ATTACKED FRIDAY MOSQUE, TEARING PAGES FROM KORAN AND SETTING FIRE TO MOSQUE. BUILDING WAS NOT DESTROYED; REPORTS DIFFER AS TO EXTENT OF DAMAGE. INCIDENT IS A BIT PUZZLING, TO SAY THE LEAST.

1978TEHRAN10401.subject: IRAN SEVERS MILITARY TIES WITH ISRAEL

segments.text: GOI HAS NEVER ANNOUNCEDPUBLICLY THE NATURE OF ITS TIES WITH ISRAEL. I WOULD THEREFORE NOT RPT NOT EXPECT AN OFFICIAL ANNOUNCEMENT CONCERNING THE CANCELLATIONS WICH TOUFANIAN HAS REPORTED.

HOWEVER, MANY THINGS ARE KNOWN TO MANY PEOPLE, INCLUDING ISLAMIC EXTREMISTS, WITHOUT BENEFIT OF OFFICIAL ANNOUNCEMENTS. MOREOVER, GIVEN CURRENT FREE PRESS IN IRAN, THERE IS NO WAY OF PREDICTING WHAT MIGHT BECOME PUBLIC KNOWLEDGE WITHOUT AN OFFICIAL ANNOUNCEMENT. IT MAY HAVE BEEN THIS WHICH PROMPTED TOUFANIAN TO TAKE HIS ACTION.

I HAVE SEEN NO RPT NO EVIDENCE THAT IRAN IS PREPARED TO TAKE FURTHER ACTION AGAINST ISRAEL. IF THE MULLAHS MAKE DIRECT ATTACKS AGAINST THE UNOFFICIAL ISRAELI MISSION HERE, IT COULD BE A FRAGILE TARGET; BUT I BELIEVE THE IRANIANS WOULD CONTINUE AGREE TO THEIR PRESENCE IF THE ISRAELS WERE PREPARED TO TOUGH IT OUT IN THOSE CIRCUMSTANCES.

OIL SUPPLY IS HANDLED BY THE SOPHISTRY OF SHIPMENTS BY THE MAJORS WITH DESTINATION LISTED AS GIBRALTAR AND SEALED ORDERS TO BE OPENED AT SEA. THERE IS NO REASONS TO BELIEVE GOI WILL CHANGE THAT PATTERN. IF ISLAMIC EXTREMISTS PUT PRESSURE ON THE MAJOR, THEY COULD, PERHAPS, PROVE VULNERABLE. HOWEVER, THIS SITUATION WOULD PROBABLY ARISE ONLY IF REJECTIONIST FRONT SUCCEEDS IN DEVELOPING AN ALL-ARAB (LESS EGYPT) POLICY OF DIRECT PRESSURE ON ISRAEL WHICH WOULD BE DIRECTED AGAINST THE OIL COMPANIES.

1978TEHRAN10405.subject: SHAH INTERVIEW IN LE FIGARO PRESS OCT 25 CARRIES REUTERS ITEM DAY BEFORE QUOTING THE SHAH AS SAYING HE HAS NO INTENTION OF RESIGNIN

segments.text: PRESS OCT 25 CARRIES REUTERS ITEM DAY BEFORE QUOTING THE SHAH AS SAYING HE HAS NO INTENTION OF RESIGNING, AND OTHER REMARKS ON CROWN PRINCE, AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI ETC. ARE ATTRIBUTED TO INTERVIEW WITH LE FIGARO. WOULD APPRECIATE FULL TEXT BY TELEGRAM.

1978TEHRAN10421.subject: TRADITIONAL IRANIAN POLITICS--THE CURE FOR THE FUTURE? SUMMARY: A RETURN TO TRADITIONAL IRANIAN POLITICS

segments.text: FOR THE FUTURE? SUMMARY: A RETURN TO TRADITIONAL IRANIAN POLITICS MAY REPRESENT THE BEST CHANCE FOR PRESENT REGIME TO MOBILIZE NECESSARY SUPPORT AMONG THE PEOPLE ACCORDING TO TAHIR AMIRI. END SUMMARY.

AMIR TAHERI, EDITOR-IN-CHIEF OF KAYHAN DAILY, IS PROBABLY THE BEST JOURNALISTIC COMMENTATOR ON THE COMPLEX IRANIAN SCENE TODAY. IN COURSE OF LUNCH OCT 23 WITH VISITING ICA AREA DIRECTOR CURRAN, CPAO, AND POLITICAL COUNSELOR HE PUT FORTH AN INTERESTING ANALYSIS OF PRESENT SITUATION AND A PRESECRIPTION FOR IMPROVING IT. IN SHORT, HE BELIEVES THERE IS NO SINGLE NATIONWIDE ISSUE FUELING THE OPPOSITION BUT RATHER A GENERAL DISCONTENT BUILT ON A VARIETY OF COMPLAINTS AND GRIVEANCES.

CONSEQUENTLY THE GOVT SHOULD MOBILIZE ITS HUMAN RESOURCES TO REBUILD SUPPORT THROUGH THE MYRIAD TRADITIONAL IRANIAN ORGANIZATIONS WHICH EXIST IN EVERY LOCALITY DEALING WITH LOCAL ISSUES RATHER THAN WORRYING ABOUT FORMING ANY NEW-FANGLED LARGE NATIONWIDE ORGANIZATIONS, WITH NATIONAL ISSUES. IN SHORT, THE GOI TECHNOCRATS SHOULD LEARN TRADITIONAL IRANIAN POLITICS AND/OR FORGE ALLIANCES WITH TRADITIONAL POLITICIANS. HOVEYDA UNDERSTOOD THIS PROCESS AND KEPT CONTROL THROUGH IT (TAHERI IS A HOVEYDA MAN). AMOUZEGAR THE TECHNOCRAT, DID NOT, AND HIS ENDING OF SUBVENTIONS TO NEEDY MULLAHS, AS WELL AS OTHER MEASURES OF ECONOMIC RETRENCHMENT, CONTRIBUTED IN NO SMALL MEASURE TO CURRENT PROBLEM.

TAHERI INDICATED HE WAS CASTING ABOUT FOR A WAY TO GET THIS MESSAGE TO GOI. HE KNOWS NONE OF THE MEMBERS OF SHARIF-EMAMI GOVT. THOUGH HE SAW ARDESHI ZAHEDI BRIEFLY DURING LATTER'S RECENT VISIT HERE, IT WAS HURRIED MEETING IN PRESENCE OF MANY OTHERS AND HE COULD NOT TALK. ZAHEDI IS, INCIDENTALLY, A POTENTIAL POLITICIAN WHO-BECAUSE HE COMES OF COMMON STOCK AND HAD LITTLE FORMAL EDUCATION--STILL CAN COMMUNICATE IN A TRADITIONAL IRANIAN WAY WITH THE POEPLE, ACCORDING TO TAHERI. A START MUST BE MA DE, TAHERI SAYS WITH THE MANY CITIES AND PROVINCES WHICH ARE NO-MAN'S LAND, NOT YET CONQUERED BY THE OPPOSITION.

A FEW INCIDENTS INSTIGATED THERE, UNREST LEADING TO THE KILLING OF ONE OR TWO LOCAL PEOPLE AND ANOTHER LOCALITY IS LOST TO THE OPPOSITION. YET THERE ARE MANY GOOD MEN--MEMBERS OF MAJLIS, GOVERNORS GENERAL, OLD RASTIKHIZ ACTIVIISTS, OTHERS OF LOCAL PROMINENCE--WHO ARE LOYAL TO THE SHAH AND CONTINUE TO ASK WHAT THEY SHOULD DO. GOI SHOULD RESTORE COMMUNICATIONS WITH THEM. A CENTRAL COORDINATING BODY SHOULD BE SETUP QUIETELY IN TEHRAN AND USE NETWORK OF MAJLIS DEPTUIES (AT LEAST 100 OR 110 OF THEM HAVE GOOD LOCAL ROOTS AND WILL BE REELECTED IN ANY FREE ELECTION) AND VARIETY OF LOCAL BOSSES IN TRADITIONAL IRANIAN WAY.
THEY FADED IN 1962-63, AND SHAH FURTHER RUPTURED SUCH POLITICAL ACTIVITY BY DISBANDING POLITICAL PARTIES, TRYING TO BREAK UP THE ORGANIZATIONS OF THE BAZAAR, ETC.

BY CHANCE LATER THAT SAME DAY POL COUNSELOR MET WITH A CLOSE CONFIDANT OF SHARIF-EMAMI, A SENATOR WITH LONG POLITICAL CONNECTIONS IN THE TEHRAN AREA WHO, AS HE HIMSELF PUT IT, HAS BEEN "INVOLUNTARILY RETIRED" FROM ACTIVE POLITICS FOR 15-18 YEARS. HE BLAMES NASSIRI, HOVEYDA, AND ALAM FOR DRAWING A CURTAIN AROUND THE SHAH, CUTTING HIM OFF. NASSIRI HIMSELF WARNED THE SENATOR FIFTEEN YEARS AGO THAT THERE WERE TOO MANY PEOPLE WANDERING IN AND OUT OF THE SENATOR'S HOUSE, SOMEHOW MAKING IT DANGEROUS, AND SENATOR WAS OBLIGED TO STOP RECEIVING THEM.

SENATOR HAS NOW COME OUT OF "RETIREMENT" AND, WHILE REFUSING OFFER OF POSITION IN SHARIF-EMAMI CABINET, HAS BEEN VERY ACTIVE BEHIND THE SCENES. SOME OF HIS ACTIVITIES HAVE BEEN REPORTED IN SEPTELS. ONE CURRENT PROJECT, HE SAID, IS TO IDENTIFY PEOPLE WITH A POPULAR FOLLOWING IN (POORER, TROUBLED) SOUTHERN TEHRAN AND GIVE THEIR NAMES TO PM WITH RECOMMENDATION HE MEET AND RECRUIT THEM. SENATOR INDICATED HE AND PM HAD ALSO GIVEN THOUGHT TO USING MEMBERS OF PARLIAMENT FOR SUCH MOBILIZATION OF SUPPORT. HE READILY ADMITTED NEED KOF WHICH TAHERI HAD SPOKEN) TO MOBILIZE THE PROVINCES, THOUGH HE ASSERTED TEHRAN ITSELF MUST LEAD WAY; AS TEHRAN GOES SO GO THE PROVINCES.

COMMENT: TAHIRI'S ANALYSIS AND PRESECRIPTION ARE PROBABLY WHAT HOVEYDA HAD IN MIND EARLIER TALKS WITH AMBASSADOR. THE TRADITIONAL POLITICIANS WERE AFTER ALL BACKBONE OF SHAH'S POLITICAL SUPPORT (SUCH AS IT WAS) IN 1950'S. WHILE WE WOULD NOT EXPTECT WHOLESALE RETURN OF ALL OLD POLITICIANS (WHOM SHAH CONSIDERED OBSTRUCTIONIST IN HEY DAY OF HIS "WHITE" REVOLUTION (A DECADE AND A HALF AGO), A GOOD SMATTERING OF THEM, BLENDED WITH NEWER (AND PERHAPS ALSO YOUNGER) POLITICAL LEADERS WOULD PROBABLY STAND BETTER CHANCE OF MOBILIZING THE "SILENT MAJORITY" IN THIS COUNTRY THAN ANY RENEWED EFFORT TO CREATE LARGE, WESTERNSTYLE POLITICAL PARTIES.

PLAN AND BUDGET ORGANIZATION OFFICIALS ANTICIPATE THE FOLLOWING SEQUENCE OF PRESENTATIONS TO THE PARLIAMENT: (A) REVISED CURRENT FISCAL YEAR BUDGET WITHIN SEVERAL WEEKS (E.G. MID-NOVEMBER); (B) THE SIXTH ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT PLAN (MARCH 21, 1978 TO MARCH 20, 1983) IN NOVEMBER OR DECEMBER, AND (C) THE BUDGET FOR THE YEAR BEGINNING MARCH 21, 1979 BY JANUARY. PBO MINISTER MEHRAN OUTLINED THIS SCENARIO IN TERMS OF THE GOI'S DESIRE TO PORTRAY ECONOMIC DIRECTOR AND DECISIVE ADJUSTMENTS TO NEW REALITIES.

AS REPORTED IN REF (B), THE CURRENT AUTHORIZED BUDGET HAD A PARALLEL, LOWER-LEVEL "SHADOW-BUDGET", A CIRCUMSTANCE WHICH WE POINTED OUT MEANT THAT PARTICULARLY IN THE CAPITAL BUDGET A REVISED, LOWER BUDGET NEED NOT REFLECT ANY SUBSTANTIAL CUTS. THE GOVERNEMENT'S AUSTERITY PROGRAMS ON THE CURRENT BUDGET ARE NOW MORE THAN OFFSET BY UNPLANNED RESOURCES REQUIRED TO MEET RECENT PUBLIC SECTOR COMPENSATION DEMANDS. MEHRAN'S OCTOBER 24 REVELATION TO EMBOFFS INDICATES A DECISION TO LEGITIMIZE THE BUDGET REVISIONS AND THUS CREATE A MORE REALISTIC BASE YEAR FOR THE SIXTH PLAN AS WELL, PERHAPS, AS TO BE MORE OEPN WITH THE PARLIAMENT.
MEHRAN WOULD NOT DISCUSS REVISED FISCAL DEBT FIGURES, CAPITAL BUDGET ADJUSTMENTS BY PROJECT OR AGGREGATE NOR THE OVERALL BUDGET LEVELS, SAYING THAT "ALL WILL BE KNOWN IN SEVERAL WEEKS TIME."

BY MEMORANDA DATED JULY 27 AND AUGUST 31, EMBASSY UPDATED REF (A) AND ADVISED MOST INTERESTED USG ELEMENTS THAT THE SIXTH PLAN WOULD BE DELAYED FURTHER BY CHANGES IN THE PBO, IN THE FIRST INSTANCE, AND SECONDLY, BY THE AUGUST CHANGE IN THE CABINET. THE PLAN, CONTINUOUSLY POSTPONED DURING THE AMOUZEGAR GOVERNMENT AND NEVER CLEAR IN ITS LEGAL CHARACTER, FORM OR TERM, IS PREDICTED BY MINISTER MEHRAN TO APPEAR IN NOVEMBER OR DECEMBER AND TO FOLLOW THE TRADITION OF PREVIOUS PLANS, I.E. EMCOMPASS FIVE YEARS AND CONTAIN BUDGETARY AUTHORITY WITH PROJECT DETAIL.

PBO UNDER SECRETARY MEJLOUMIAN SEPARATELY SAID THAT MEHRAN IS ADDING "ACTION POLICIES" SUCH AS ADMINISTRATIVE REFORMS TO THE QUANTITATIVE CONTENT. HE SAID THAT THE "NATIONAL OBJECTIVES" PLAN, WHICH READERS WILL RECALL THE SHAH DIRECTED BE DONE A YEAR AGO, IS MOSTLY COMPLETED BUT WILL NOT SEE THE LIGHT OF DAY. ------------------093441 251531Z /45 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 1174

FIFTH PLAN DATA ARE AVAILABLE IN THE ENGLISH SUMMARY OF THE CENTRAL BANK OF IRAN'S ANNUAL REPORT WHICH IS CURRNTLY AT THE PRINTERS AND WILL BE SUBMITTED WEHN AVAILABLE (CERP PUB 003). THESE DATA ARE CONTAINED IN THE RECENT IMF REPORT "IRAN-RECENT ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENTS" (SM/78/239), DATED SEPTEMBER 28. THE LATTER CONTAINS SOME EVALUATION, BUT THE PBO'S EVALUATION IS NOT YET COMPLETE, WITH SOCIAL SECTORS BEING MOST DIFFICULT. THE AVAILABLE NUMBERS ARE ESSENTIALLY THE COMPILATION OF FIVE YEARS' NATIONAL/ SECTORAL ACCOUNTS DATA. THIS, OF COURSE, DOES NOT REVEAL HOW MUCH OF THE PLAN'S OBJECTIVE WAS ACHIEVED IN ANY GIVEN SECTOR NOR IN THE AGGREGATE.

IN CONFIDENCE, MEJLOUMIAN PROVIDED SOME PRELIMINARY FINDINGS OF THE EVALUATION STILL IN PROCESS BY THE COORDINATION AND SUPERVISION AREA OF PBO: SECTOR PERCENT OF PHYSICAL PERCENT OF PLAN OBJECTIVE FUNDS DISBURSED HOUSING 50 77 (LOW-COST) (32) (76) POWER GENERATION 92 200 TRANSMISSION 34 199
PORTS 17 80 (NOTE: OBJECTIVE WAS 24 MILLION TONS CAPACITY, BASE OF 5 MILLION TONS) MANUFACTURING (CAPACITY) 64 73

PBO HAS BEEN THROUGH A MOST DIFFICULT PERIOD SINCE THE DRAFT SIXTH PLAN MET WITH POLITICAL INDECISION IN JUNE 1977. THE SHAH PLACED IT UNDER A CLOUD IN HIS AUGUST 1977 CHANGE OF GOVERNMENT SPEECH WHEN HE ACCUSED IT OF BEING A ROADBLOCK TO PROGRESS. IT HAS HAD FIVE MINISTERS IN 14 MONTHS AND THREE UNDER SECRETARIES HAVE CHANGED IN THAT TIME.

IT SURVIVED THE SHAH'S DECISION TO TRANSFER THE BUDGET FUNCTION TO THE MINISTRY OF ECONOMIC AFFAIRS AND FINANCE AND MOST RECENTLY RECOUPED ITS ROLE WHEN THE FUNCTION OF THE IMPERIAL COMMISSION ON THE EFFICIENT ALLOCATION OF RESOURCES (WHICH COMPLETED LAST YEAR INVESTIGATIONS ON ALL TIMED PROJECTS) REVERTED TO IT. MINISTER MEHRAN IS WELL REGARDED BY THOSE WHO FELT HIS IMMEDIATE PREDECESSORS LACKED DECISIVENESS AND MANAGMENT ABILITIES, COULD NOT SET PRIORITIES AND FAILED TO GRASP ECONOMIC AND POLITICAL REALITIES.

MEHRAN, DURING A CALL BY THE ECONOMIC COUSELOR AND ECN/FIN OFFICER VIEWED THE CURRENT ECONOMIC/ POLITICAL UPHEAVAL WITH ITS FISCAL CONSEQUENCES IN AS POSITIVE A LIGHT AS POSSIBLE, NECESSITATING AN IN-ANY-CASE REQUIRED REASSESSMENT OF ECONOMIC PROGRAMS AND REALLOCATION OF RESOURCES.

1978TEHRAN10440.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT, OCT 25 SUMMARY: WIDESPREAD DEMONSTRATIONS RECURRED YESTERDAY. WORST-HIT CITY WAS GORGAN WHERE MANY FIRES AND SEV

segments.text: SUMMARY: WIDESPREAD DEMONSTRATIONS RECURRED YESTERDAY. WORST-HIT CITY WAS GORGAN WHERE MANY FIRES AND SEVERAL DEATHS OCCURRED. THERE WERE FIRES AND VIOLENT CLASHES IN QOM AND HAMADAN. TEHRAN SAW LARGE STUDENT DEMONSTRATIONS ON AND OFF CAMPUS WITH SOME CONFRONTATIONS AND ARRESTS, BUT SITUATION REMAINED RELATIVELY PEACEFUL. ONE JOURNAL ALLEGES COUNTER TERROR IN HAMADAN. GOVT BEGAN RELEASING PRISONERS LAST NIGHT, APPARENTLY INCLUDING 212 ADDITIONAL CIVIL COURT PRISONERS. MAHMOOD ETEMADZADEH (ALSO CALLED BEH A'ZIN), LEADER OF SMALL OPPOSITION PARTY "UNIVERSITY FOR DEMOCRACY" WAS ARRESTED OCT 23. HAMADAN LAWYERS AND RELIGIOUS LEADERS ARE STAGING HUNGER STRIKE TO PROTECT DEATHS IN RIOTING OCT 22.

MAJLIS TOOK UP CENSURE MOTION YESTERDAY WITH ATTENTION FOCUSED ON SAVAK REPORTS. OPPOSITION LEADER PEZESHKPOUR CRITICIZED BRITISH FONSEC FOR INTERFERENCE IN IRANIAN AFFARIS. REPORTS OF MODERATE OPPOSITION CAMPAIGN TO DEFUSE CIVIL UNR CONTRAST WITH NEW THREAT CARD BEING LEFT AT EMBASSY LOCATIONS IN ISFAHAN AND TEHRAN ALLEGING ALL IRANIAN PEOPLE "HATE" AMERICANS. END SUMMARY

DEMONSTRATIONS RECURRED YESTERDAY ON USUAL WIDE GEOGRAPHIC FRONT. THIS TIME GORGON (MAZANDARAN PROVINCE) OFFERED WORSE VIOLENCE, AS RIOTERS SET FIRE TO BANKS, MOVIE THEATERS, AND OTHER BUILDINGS. WHEN CROWD REPORTEDLY TRIED TO BURN SAVAK HEADQUARTERS, TROOPS FIRED INTO CROWD. UTHORITIES ADMIT ONE DEATH BUT PRESS BELIEVES SEVERAL KILLED. MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES IN QOM HAVE ADVANCED THE START OF CURFEW HOURS FROM 11 P.M. TO 9 P.M. AS RESULT OF CONTINUED DISTURBANCES. RADIO IRAN REPORTED DEMONSTRATORS THREW GRENADES AND FIRED UPON TROOPS (EMB HAS NO INDEPENDENT CONFIRMATION). MORE ARSON AND RIOTS OCCURRED IN KHORRAMABAD.
ONE PRESS REPORT CLAIMS KERMAN-STYLE COUNTER VIOLENCE IN HAMADAN YESTERDAY BY CROWD OF 5,000 BUT IS NOT SUPPORTED BY OTHER MEDIA SOURCES.

TEHRAN SAW A FULL DAY OF LARGE STUDENT DEMONSTRATIONS ON AND OFF CAMPUS. ALL SCHOOLS WERE CLOSED IN TEHRAN AS THOUSANDS OF HIGH SCHOOL STUDENTS TOOK TO THE STREETS OR HEADED FOR TEHRAN UNIVERSITY WHERE LARGEST DEMONSTRATION TOOK PLACE. ON CAMPUS, STUDENTS DIVIDED, AS THEY HAVE DONE BEFORE, INTO RELIGIOUS AND LEFTIST GROUPS. SOME LEFTISTS DID NOT STAY FOR MASS PRAYER WHICH WAS MEANT TO BE GRAND FINALE OF RALLY. STUDENTS ISSUED 17 POINT RESOLUTION INCLUDING RELEASE OF ALL POLITICAL PRISONERS, RETURN OF KHOMEINI, AND GOVT DECREE TO FORCE ALL SCHOOLS TO HOLD MIDDAY MASS PRAYERS.

SMALLY GROUP OF SHOUTING STUDENT PASSED EMBASSY MORNING OCT 25, AND AS OF MIDDAY, SIMILAR SERIES OF STUDENT PROTESTS ARE EVIDENT AROUND TEHRAN. TROOPS HAVE MADE ARRESTS AND DISPERSED CROWDS IF THEY BECOME UNRULY, BUT MARCHING GROUPS ARE GENERALLY LEFT ALONE. (COMMENT: DAILY MARCHES AND STUDENTS' KNOWLEDGE THAT MARTIAL LAW AUTIES WILL PERMIT THEM CREATES POTENTIALLY VOLATILE SITUTION FOR OCT 26.) STUDENTS WILL UNDOUBTEDLY ASSEMBLE AGAIN.

ACCORDING TO OSCO REPRESENTATIVES IN TEHRAN, SITUATION IN OIL INSTALLATIONS HAS EASED SOMEWHAT AS OF MORNING OCTOBER 26. THE STRIKE OF PILOTS AT KHAIG ISLAND HAS ENDED AND TANKERS ARE BEING FILLED, BUT ONLY TWO AT A TIME.

FOREIGN MINISTER ASHRAF ASKED ME TO SEE HIM EVENING OCT. 25. HE SAID SHAH HAD BEEN VERY PLEASED WITH TENOR OF MESSAGE HE HAD RECEIVED FROM PRESIDENT CARTER. ASHRAF ASKED IF WE WOULD HAVE ANY OBJECTIONS TO HIS RELEASING IT TO THE PRESS.

I SAID WE WOULD HAVE NO OBJECTIONS, BUT I ASKED IF IT WAS THE ONLY ONE TO BE RELEASED. HE SAID THAT ALL THE OTHERS WERE PRO-FORMA AND THE PRESIDENT'S WAS THE ONLY "NICE" ONE. HE THOUGHT THE PUBLIC SHOULD SHARE IT.

I SUGGESTED THIS MIGHT BE MISUNDERSTOOD AND WONDERED IF IT WOULDN'T BE BETTER TO RELEASE IT ALONG WITH SEVERAL OTHERS, SUCH AS THE MESSAGE FROM BREZHNEV, IF THERE WAS ONE. HE SAID THERE WAS A BREZHNEV MESSAGE AND HE COULD, OF COURSE, RELEASE OTHERS.

HE THEN TELEPHONED THE COURT MINISTER AND INSTRUCTED THEM TO RELEASE SOVIET, IRAQI, GERMAN, JAPANESE, TURKISH AND AMERICAN MESSAGES. HE SAID OTHERS COULD MERELY BE ACKNOWLEDGED BY NAME OF THE COUNTRY WHICH SENT THEM.
COMMENT: THE MAN CLEARLY LACKS SOUND JUDGMENT.

THANK YOU FOR SENDING ME COPY OF NEA MEMO TO SECRETARY AND PROVIDING ME OPPORTUNITY TO COMMENT PRIOR TO SECRETARY'S MEETING WITH DR. BZREZINSKI. I HAVE, NATURALLY, BEEN THINKING ALONG THESE SAME LINES AND YESTERDAY HAD A LONG MEETING WITH BRITISH AMBASSADOR ON ACTIONS WHICH WE MIGHT TAKE.

ESSENTIALLY, WE FEEL THAT GOVERNMENT HAS TO BEGIN TAKING POSITIVE ACTIONS WHICH WILL CAPTURE PUBLIC ATTENTION AND FOCUS PUBLIC INTEREST ON CONSTRUCTIVE MEASURES. IN ABSENCE SUCH ACTIONS, PUBLIC IS CAUGHT UP IN FRENZY OF DESTRUCTIVE AND NEGATIVE CONCERNS. I HA*E REM*NDUD IRANIAN OFVICIALS OF(FRANKLIN ROOSEVELT'S TACTIC* IN CONQUERING "FEAR ITSELF" BY A DAILY STREAM OF POSITIVE ANNOUNCEMENTS ON TANGIBLE GOVERNMENT ACTIONS.

GENERAL IRANIAN REACTION TO THESE SUGGESTIONS* HAS BEEN THAT ECONOMIC A*D SOCIAL ECTIONS WILL ONLY BE BRUSHED ASIDE BECAUSE LOCUS OF INTEREST IS IN POLITICAL ACTION. HOWEVER, NONE OF THEM HAS ANY POSITIVE SUGGESTION FOR POLITICAL ACTION EXCEPT THE SHAH'S VAGUELY WORDED REFERENCE TO A "COALITION GOVERNMENT". ONE OF THE REAL PROBLEMS, OF COURSE, IS THAT MOST OF THE LOQUACIOUS POLITICAL DEMANDS ARE STILL DIRECTED PERSONALLY AGAINST THE SHAH, WITH INSISTE*CE THAT HE ABDICATE. ANOTHER PRACTICAL PROBLEM MS THAT THERE IS NO RPT NO OUTSTANDING POLITICAL FIGURE IN OPPOSITION AROUND WHOM A COALITION CAN BE$BUILT.
THE ONLY TANGIBLE POLITICAL FIGURE IN OPPOSITION IS AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, WITH HIS INTRACTIBLE DEMANDS THAT THE MONARCHY BE OVERTHROWN AND AN "ISLAMIC REPUBLIC" PUT IN ITS PLACE.

I SHARE YOUR VIEW THAT A FURTHER DETERIORATION COULD CAUSE THE MILITARY TO INTERVENE, PROBABLY WITH THE SHAH'S RELUCTANT BLESSING. I ALSO SHARE YOUR VIEW THAT THIS WOULD BE A DELAYED DISASTER. IN CURRENT CONTEXT, AND IN ABSENCE OF CONSTRUCTIVE GOVERNMENTAL ACTIONS WHICH WILL ATTRACT PUBLIC PARTICIPATION, I FEEL THAT THE LONG PERIOD BETWEEN NOW AND THE ELECTIONS WHICH ARE SCHEDULED FOR NEXT JUNE WILL PRODUCE THE KIND OF DETERIORATION WHICH WOULD MAKE SUCH MILITARY INTERVENTION INEVITABLE.

THEREFORE, I FULLY ENDORSE THE "THREE MAIN THRUSTS" OF YOUR MEMO AND BELIEVE THEY ARE AN EXCELLENT, SUCCINCT STATEMENT OF OUR POLICY. THE SHAH IS THE UNIQUE ELEMENT WHICH CAN, ON THE ONE HAND, RESTRAIN THE MILITARY, AND, ON THE OTHER, LEAD A CONTROLLED TRANSITION. HOWEVER, HE NEEDS TO CLOAK HIMSELF WITH PUBLIC SUPPORT. THIS MEANS THE MIDDLE-CLASS POLITICAL LEADERSHIP FROM ALL PARTIES AND THE MODERATE AYATOLLAHS, WHO ARE PREXARED TO ACCEPT THE CONTINUATION OF A CONSTI*UTIONAL, ALBEIT MORE LIMITED, FORM OF MONARCHY.

THEREFORE, BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND I HAVE ARRANGED MEETING WITH PRIME MINISTER SHARIF-EMAMI FOR SUNDAY, OCTOBER 29. IN THAT MEETING, WE WILL URGE HIM TO BEGIN A POLITICAL PROCESS WHICH WILL BE CENTERED UPON ESTABLISHING THE GROUND RULES FOR GENERAL ELECTIONS. THE BASIC IDEA WOULD BE TO BRING IN ALL THE POLITICAL LEAD*RSHIP WHICH ACCETTS THE CURRENT CONSTITUTION, WHICH WILL ACCEPT NON-PARTICIPATION BY THE TUDEH PARTY IN THE ELECTION PROCESS, AND WHICH WILL BE PREPARED TO TAKE PART IN A GENUINELY FREE ELECTION.

ULTIMATELY, THESE POLITICAL LEADERS WOULD BE EXPECTED INFO OCT-01 ISO-00 ( ISO ) W ------------------013373 271104Z /14 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 1185 SECTION 2 OF 3 TEHRAN 10445 NODIS TO MEET PUBLICLY WITH THE SHAH AND OBTAIN HIS IMPRIMATUR UPON THE CHARTER WHICH THEY WOULD WORK OUT TO DEFINE THE FREE ELECTORAL PROCESS.

IF THE PRIME MINISTER AGREES WITH OUR PROPOSAL, WE WOULD EXPECT A NUMBER OF CONDITIONS TO EMERGE. FIRST, WE WOULD EXPECT THE OPPOSITION TO DEMAND THAT THE CURRENT PARLIAMENT BE DISSOLVED IN A VERY SHORT PERIOD, WELL BEFORE NEXT JUNE. SECOND, WE WOULD EXPECT A DEMAND FOR LIFTING OF MARTIAL LAW WELL BEFORE NEXT MARCH. THIRD, WE WOULD EXPECT SOME REDEFINITION OF THE ROLE OF THE MONARCHY, AND THE AUTHORITY OF THE PARLIAMENT VIS-A-VIS THE CABINET. FINALLY, THERE MIGHT ALSO BE THE DEMAND THAT THE CONSTITUTIONAL PROVISION FOR A LEGISLATIVE REVIEW PANEL OF ISLAMIC LAW EXPERTS BE IMPLEMENTED.

IN OUR JUDGMENT, ALL OF THESE DEMANDS ARE NEGOTIABLE AND COULD ESSENTIALLY BE SATISFIED, IF THE QUID PRO QUO ENTAILED AN END TO VIOLENCE AND THE INSTITUTION OF CONSTRUCTIVE POLITICAL ACTIVITY. WE BELIEVE THAT ONLY SOME SUCH PROCESS WILL GET THIS COUNTRY OUT OF ITS CURRENT UNSTRUCTURED CHOAS. THE VERY LACK OF STRUCTURE TO THE CURRENT SITUATION IS WHAT MAKES IT DIFFICULT TO GET A HANDLE ON IT BY ANY NEATER OR MORE TRADITIONAL MANEUVER.

IF THIS PROPOSAL DOES TAKE HOLD, IT WOULD HAVE A NUMBER OF EFFECTS: (A) IT WOULD RESTORE, IN SOME MEASURE, THE STATUS OF THE SHAH; (B) IT WOULD GET THE MILITARY BACK TO THE BARRACKS; (C) IT WOULD TURN POLITICAL ACTIVITY FROM A FOCUS ON THE WICKED PAST TO THE BRIGHT FUTURE; (D) IT WOULD FORCE THE MODERATE CLERGY AND THE RESPONSIBLE POLITICIANS TO MAKE A FINAL BREAK WITH KHOMEINI; (E) IT WOULD GIVE THE ELECTION PROCESS A SPECIAL LEGITIMACY; AND (F) IT WOULD EVENTUALLY PRODUCE A PARLIAMENT WHICH WOULD ALSO HAVE LEGITIMACY.

WE ARE NOT SO NAIVE AS TO EXPECT THIS PROCESS TO WORK SPONTANEOUSLY OR IN THE SPIRIT OF NATIONAL SALVATION. IRANIAN POLITICIANS ARE A NOTORIOUSLY SELF-SERVING LOT WHO SPEND MOST OF THEIR TIME TRYING TO SHOVE STILLETOS INTO EACH OTHER. MOST OF THEM, AT THE CURRENT MOMENT, ARE TRULY SHAKEN BY THE NATIONAL TURMOIL AND SEE THEIR OWN MATERIAL POSSESSIONS IN JEOPARDY. THEREFORE, GIVEN A FEW MORE DAYS OR WEEKS OF THIS CHAOS, THEY MAY BE WILLING TO PULL TOGETHER LONG ENOUGH TO AGREE TO SOME CONCENTRATED ACTION OF THE KIND INDICATED ABOVE.

(WE HAVE EVEN CONSIDERED THE POSSIBILITY THAT THE SHAH IS DELIBERATELY LETTING THE DETERIORATION PROCEED FAR ENOUGH SO THAT THE POLITICIANS WILL SCRAMBLE BACK TOWARDS HIM AS THEY VIEW THE ABYSS. HOWEVER, WE CAN NOT RPT NOT VOUCH THAT HIS NERVES HAVE THAT MUCH STEEL.)

OUR REASON FOR STARTING THIS IDEA WITH THE PRIME MINISTER RATHER THAN WITH THE SHAH IS THAT WE BELIEVE IT MUST BE ALL ARRANGED AND WORKED OUT WITHOUT THE SHAH'S VISIBLE PARTICIPATION BEFORE HE MAKES A PUBLIC STATEMENT. SINCE THIS WOULD INVOLVE INITIAL ACTION BY THE PRIME MINISTER, WE CONSIDER IT PSYCHOLOGICALLY PRUDENT TO ASSOCIATE HIM FORM THE START.

IN COMMENT ON SOME OF THE SPECIFIC PROPOSALS IN YOUR MEMO, I FEEL I SHOULD SAY THAT THE LESS THE U.S. HAND SHOWS PUBLICLY, THE BETTER. THERE IS A BREWING XENOPHOBIA HERE. DAVID OWEN'S RECENT STATEMENT OF SUPPORT WAS SHARPLY CRITICIZED BY THE OPPOSITION. THERE IS NO RPT NO CURRENT NEED FOR MORE PUBLIC STATEMENTS BY THE PRESIDENT, OR VISITS BY HIGH RANKING EMISSARIES, OR PUBLIC APPEALS BY U.S. OFFICIALS. NOW IS THE TIME FOR SOME TRULY QUIET DIPLOMACY.

FORMAL CONSULTATIONS WITH FRIENDLY COUNTRIES, OTHER THAN THE BRITISH, IS OF QUESTIONABLE UTILITY. ONLY THE U.S. AND THE UK HAVE POLITICAL RPT POLITICAL CLOUT HERE. THE GERMANS ARE ILL-INFORMED (THE GERMAN AMBASSADOR TOLD ME OCT 25 THAT 800 IRANIAN ARMY OFFICERS HAD BEEN EXECUTED FOR ANTI-SHAH VIEWS). THE FRENCH ARE CYNICAL. ONLY THE ISRAELIS HAVE USEFUL ------------------012808 271050Z /12 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 1186 SECTION 3 OF 3 TEHRAN 10445 NODIS INFORMATION, DERIVED FROM THE LARGE JEWISH COMMUNITY HERE. BUT THEIR IDEAS ARE HEAVILY LARDED WITH SELF-INTEREST.

ON THE MILITARY SIDE, I SEE NO RPT NO NEED FOR A HIGH LEVEL DOD MANAGEMENT TEAM. ARMISH CHIEF GENERAL GAST IS ONE OF THE BEST MANAGEMENT MEN I HAVE ENCOUNTERED IN LONG YEARS WITH THE MILITARY. HE CAN HANDLE THAT PROBLEM. I ALSO WISH TO RECORD MY STRONG OPPOSITION TO ANY PROPOSALS FOR U.S. ASSISTANCE TO THE IRANIAN MILITARY FOR CROWD CONTROL PURPPSES (SECRETARY DUNCAN MET WITH A DECIDEDLY COLD RESPONSE FROM THE SHAH AND TOUFANIAN WHEN HE RAISED THIS IDEA).

MY OPPOSITION IS BASED ON MY CONCERN THAT SUCH AN OFFER COULD GIVE THE IRANINA MILITARY THE IDEA THAT WE WISH TO HELP THEM HAVE THE CAPABILITY OF MAINTAINING THEMSELVES IN POWER BLOODLESSLY IF THEY TOOK OVER. MOREOVER, THE BRITISH, WHO HAVE MORE EXPERIENCE THAN WE, ARE PROVIDING ABOUT ALL THE IRANIANS ARE PREPARED TO ABSORB.

FINALLY, I WOULD STRONGLY OPPOSE ANY OVERTURE TO KHOMEINI. HIS STATEMENTS ON AN "ISLAMIC REPUBLIC" AND THE PENCHANT OF HIS FOLLOWERS FOR THE QUASIMARXIST WRITINGS OF ALL SHARIATI SUGGEST THAT HE WOULD WISH TO LEAD THE COUNTRY IN A NASSER-QADDAFI DIRECTION. HE SHOULD BE FIRMLY QUARANTINED. OUR DESTINY IS TO WORK WITH THE SHAH. HE HAS SHOWN SURPRISING FLEXIBILITY AND IS, IN MY JUDGMENT, PREPARED TO ACCEPT A TRULY DEMOCRATIC REGIME HERE IF IT CAN BE ACHIEVED RESPONSIBLY.

BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND I CALLED ON PRIME MINISTER MORNING OCTOBER 29 TO REVIEW CURRENT SITUATION AND URGE HIM TO TAKE SOME POLITICAL INITIATIVES. PM BEGAN BY SAYING THAT HE HAD JUST COME FROM PARLIAMENT AND FOUND THE MOOD AMONG THE POLITICIANS MUCH RELAXED. HE SAID HE HAD SCHEDULED HIS ANSER TO A HOSTILE INTERPELLATION FOR OCTOBER 31 AND LOOKED FORWARD TO A RESOUNDING VOTE OF CONFIDENCE.

HE THEN WENT ON TO SAY THAT HE FELT DISTURBANCES WHICH HAD RECENTLY PLAGUED THE COUNTRY WERE THE WORK OF AN ELEMENT IN SAVAK LED BY GENERAL SABETI. THESE PEOPLE WERE PARTISANS OF GENERAL NASSERI WHO WERE TRYING TO DEMONSTRATE THE NEED FOR A MILITARY TAKE-OVER WHICH WOULD, IN TURN, FREE NASSERI FROM ANY VULNERABILITY ON THE CORRUPTION CHARGES WHICH HE WAS FACING. HE HAD CONVINCED THE SHAH OF THIS SITUATION AND, WITH HIS PERMISSION, HAD FIRED SABETI.

HE HAD ALSO DECIDED TO FIRE JUSTICE MINISTER BAHERI. HE HAD COME TO THE CONCLUSION THAT BAHERI WAS DRAGGING HIS FEET IN PROSECUTION OF THOSE ACCUSED OF CORRUPTION. HE WOULD THEREFORE REPLACE HIM AND WOULD GIVE SHAH HIS NOMINEE OCTOBER 30.

PM ALSO SAID, IN CONFIDENCE, THAT HE HAD TRAVELLED TO QOM FOR 2 1/2 HOUR MEETING WITH AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI ON OCTOBER 27. HE HAD TRIED TO PERSUADE SHARIATMADARI TO CONVENE MEETING OF ALL SENIOR AYATOLLAHS TO SELECT A LEADER. SHIRAZI OF MASHAD WAS WILLING, BUT SHARIAT MADARI DID NOT DARE CONFRONT KHOMEINI IN SUCH A SHARP MANNER. HE NEVERTHELESS CONTINUES TO GIVE QUIET SUPPORT TO THE GOVT.

ON THE UNIVERSITIES, PM SAID HE HAD ASSEMBLED ALL THE DEANS ON OCTOBER 28. THEY AGREED TO WRITE THEIR OWN DRAFT OF A UNIVERSITY AUTONOMY BILL AND SUBMIT IT TO THE NEW MINISTER FOR HIGHER EDUCATION. IF IT WAS ACCEPTABLE, IT WOULD BE PRESENTED TO THE MAJLIS IN AD BID TO GET THE UNIVERSITIES OPEN. IF THE STUDENTS STILL REFUSE TO RETURN TO CLASS, HE IS CONSIDERING CLOSING THEM ALTOGETHER FOR A SEMESTER.

WE THEN TURNED TO THE NEED FOR SOME POLITICAL INITIATIVES WHICH WOULD TURN POPULAR ATTENTION TO CONSTRUCTIVE IDEAS. WE SAID THAT PREPARATIONS FOR GENERAL ELECTIONS SEEMED TO BE THE MOST LOGICAL ISSUE WHICH COULD CATALYZE SUCH A POSITIVE POSTURE. WE WONDERED IF PM COULD TAKE THE LEAD IN CONVENING A GROUP OF POLITICAL LEADERS FROM ALL PERSUASIONS EXCEPT THE TUDEH IN ORDER TO FRAME PLANS FOR GENERAL ELECTIONS. AT FIRST PM REACTION WAS RATHER NEGATIVE. HE SSSAID POLITICIANS WOULD DEMAND IMMEDIATE DISSOLUTION OF PARLIAMENT. WE SAID THAT COULD BE NEGOTIATED, BECUASE THEY WOULD AL L REALIZE TIME WAS NEEDED TO PREPARE FOR ELECTIONS.
THIS NEED WOULD GIVE THE PARLIAMENT SOME ADDITIONAL TIME, BUT PROBABLY NOT UNTIL NEXT JUNE.

WE THEN DISCUSSED MARTIAL LAW. PM SAID THERE WOULD NATURALLY HAVE TO BE LIFTING OF MARTIAL LAW WELL BEFORE PERIOD IS SHORTENED, THAT MARTIAL LAW WOULD HAVE TO END FAIRLY SOON. AS FOR OTHER CHANGES, HE FELT THAT PARLIAMENT COULD ACCEPT THE IDEA OF FIVE MULLAHS IN THEIR MIDST TO REVIEW LEGISLATION AND THAT WOULD POSE NO REAL PROBLEM.

BY THIS TIME, P.M. HAD RATHER WARMED TO OUR IDEA AND SAID HE WOULD DISCUSS IT WITH SHAH OCTOBER 30. HE SAID THAT, UP TILL NOW, SHAH HAD INSTRUCTED HIM TO REFRAIN FROM MEETING WITH OPPOSITION LEADERS EN MASSE, ALTHOUGH HE HAD UNDERTAKEN INDIVIDUAL MEETINGS WITH THEM.

ON OUR WAY BACK FROM THIS MEETING, WE ENCOUNTERED A MOB WHICH WAS OVERTURNING AUTOMOBILES AND SHOUTING SLOGANS. WE DID AN ABOUT-FACE TO EVADE THEM, BUT FOUND IT CURIOUS THAT NO RPT NO POLICE OR TROOPS WERE IN EVIDENCE TO RESTRAIN THEM. THEY HAD THE GENERAL APPEARANCE OF A SAVAK-TYPE CROWD, ALTHOUGH THAT CONCLUSION IS PURELY CONJECTURAL. IN ANY EVENT, THEY WERE NOT RPT NOT STUDENTS, BUT WERE HEADED IN THE GENERAL DIRECTION OF TEHRAN UNIVERSITY.

UPON MY RETURN TO THIS EMBASSY, I LEARNED THAT PM HAD CALLED EMERGENCY CABINET MEETING FOR THIS EVENING. I ALSO LEARNED THAT GENERAL SABETI HAD BEEN IN TOUCH WITH US AND THAT WILL BE THE SUBJECT OF SEPTEL. BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND I HAVE AUDIENNE WITH SHAH MORNING OCTOBER 31.
