1978TEHRAN10499.subject: SHARIATMADARI REJECTS COMPROMISE IN STRONG TERMS

segments.text: SUMMARY: AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI FOLLOWS AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI IN PUBLIC CALL FOR NO COMPROMISE WITH GOI. SANJABI OFF TO PARIS. SHAH CALLS FOR STRENGTHENING OF JUDICIARY AND PRESERVATION OF COUNTRY'S INDEPENDENCE. END SUMMARY.

IRANIAN PRESS MORNING OCT 29 HEADLINES AFP INTERVIEW WITH SHARIATMADARI IN WHICH HE REJECTS COMPROMISE WITH PRESENT IRANIAN GOVT AND EXPRESSED TOTAL SOLIDARITY WITH EXILED RELIGIOUS LEADER AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI. HE SUGGESTED THAT IT WAS POSSIBLE THAT HIS FOLLOWERS MIGHT TAKE UP ARMS IN THE FUTURE TO SET UP AN "ISLAMIC DEMOCRACY" IN IRAN, BUT HE SPOKE OF ADHERENCE TO THE CONSTITUTION AND HIS TONE WAS MODERATE.

SHARIATMADARI SAID "WE WANT THE CONSTITUTION TO CHANGE THE GOVT. WE WANT DICTATORSHIP TO BE REPLACED BY TRUE DEMOCRACY." HE DISMISSED REPORTED DIFFERENCES BETWEEN HIMSELF AND KHOMEINI, AND SAID, "WE THE RELIGIOUS HIERACHY AND THE PEOPLE HAVE NO HOPES FOR THE PRESENT GOVT ANY MORE. IT'S PRESENT ATTITUDE OF KILLING PEOPLE HAS SPOILED ITS CHANCES TOTALLY."

SHARIATMADARI SAID HE HAD TURNED DOWN GOI REQUEST FOR TALKS AND REJECTED GOI PROPOSAL TO NOMINATE FIVE PEOPLE FOR MAJLIS COUNCIL OF FIVE RELIGOUS LEADERS TO OVERSEE LAWS (CALLED FOR IN CONSTITUTION). HE ECHOED OPPOSITIONIST VIEW THAT THERE IS NO QUESTION OF ELECTIONS UNLESS THERE IS A "TRUSTWORTHY GOVT." HE SINGLED OUT NATIONAL FRONT AND PAN-IRANISTS AS THOSE WHO COULD EXPECT SHI-ITE SUPPORT "IF THEY SERVE THE INTERESTS OF THE PEOPLE."

EMBASSY COMMENT: WE HAVE NOT RPT NOT YET BEEN IN PRIVATE TOUCH WITH THOSE CLOSE TO RELIGOUS LEADERS DUE TO NONAVAILABILITY OF BEST SOURCES. SHARIATMADARI PUBLIC STATEMENT, HOWEVER, APPEARS TO REPRESENT SETBACK TO THOSE WHO WERE OPTING FOR SOME SORT OF CONCILIATION BETWEEN GOI AND AT LEAST MODERATE FACTION OF RELIGIOUS LEADERS. FACT SHARIATMADARI FELT HE HAD TO MAKE STATEMENT IN SPITE OF LONGSTANDING DIFFERENCES BETWEEN HIM AND AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI UNDERLINES DEGREE TO WHICH THIS LEADING MODERATE FEELS HE CANNOT DEPART TOO FAR FROM AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI PUBLICLY EVEN WHEN LATTER TKES UNCOMPROMISING STAND AGAINST ANY SORT OF MODUS VIVENDI (SEE REF A).

NEVERTHELESS, WE ARE NOT SURE INTERVIEW REFLECTS TRUE FEELINGS OF MODERATE RELIGIOUS GROUP. PRIME MINISTER SEEMS TO HOPE OTHERWISE (SEE SEPTEL). OVER NEXT FEW DAYS, WE WILL BE TRYING TO OUTLINE CURRENT POLITICAL GEOGRAPHY IN WAKE OF SHARIATMADARI STATEMENT.

KARIM SANJABI LEFT FOR PARIS AMID SPECULATION (WHICH HE DENIED) THAT HE WOULD TRY TO CONVINCE KHOMEINI TO TAKE A MILDER LINE TOWARD GOI. PERSISTENCE IN HARD LINE BY KHOMEINI WILL CAUSE AGAONIZING "CRISE DE CONSCIENCE" AMONG SECULAR NATIONAL FRONTERS WHO SEE COMPROMISE AS ESSENTIAL AS THEIR ALLIANCE WITH RELIGOUS FORCES.

SHAH, AT BIRTHDAY SALAAM OCT 26, REPLIED TO PARLIAMENTARY SALUTATIONS BY CALLING FOR CONTINUED LIBERALIZATION, LAUDING PARLIAMENT, AND CALLING ON ALL IRANIANS TO SUPPORT NATIONAL INDEPENDENCE, SINCE ITS LOSS WOULD BE IRREVERSIBLE. NOTABLE FEATURE OF SPEECH WAS ADMISSION OF PAST MISTAKES AND CALL FOR STRENGTHENED JUDICIARY AND CONTINUATION OF CAMPAIGN AGAINST CORRUPTION.

1978TEHRAN10501.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT OCT 29 SUMMARY: WEEKEND MARKED BY RIOTS AND DEMONSTRATIONS, LEAVING ABOUT 15 DEAD AND MANY INJURED. STUDENTS I

segments.text: SUMMARY: WEEKEND MARKED BY RIOTS AND DEMONSTRATIONS, LEAVING ABOUT 15 DEAD AND MANY INJURED. STUDENTS IN TEHRAN CLASHED WITH SECURITY FORCES WHO PREVENTED THEM FROM ENTERING TEHRAN UNIVERSITY CAMPUS. TEHRAN AND MELLI UNIVERSITIES CLOSED TO AVOID FURTHER DEMONSTRATIONS. PRO-GOVT CROWDS HAVE ALSO APPEARED AND HAVE CLASHED WITH PROTESTORS IN SEVERAL CITIES. PRESS REPORTS SOLDIER ARRESTED FOR SNIPER ATTACK WHICH KILLED POLICE CHIEF OF JAHROM AND WOUNDED MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR. UNREST SHOWS CONTINUED ANTI-FOREIGN TREND. END SUMMERY.

DEMONSTRATIONS, BOTH PEACEFUL AND VIOLENT, OCCURRED IN MOST CITIES THROUGHOUT WEEKEND. SEVERAL BLOODY CLASHES CAUSED ABOUT FIFTEEN DEATHS AND MANY INJURIES. KERMANSHAH WAS ONE OF WORST HIT, AND CONSULATE TABRIZ REPORTS STREETS OF KERMANSHAH STILL NOT QUIET. FIVE DEMONSTRATORS DIED IN KABOTARAHANG (NEAR HAMADAN). OTHER MAJOR SITES OF INJURY AND DESTRUCTION WERE DEZFUL, ZANJAN, QOM, KHORRAMABAD, AND FASA. MANY OTHER TOWNS WERE AFFECTED. POLICE IN NON-MARTIAL LAW TOWNS REPORTEDLY LOST TEMPORARY CONTROL OF SOME SECTIONS OF CITIES. EMB HAS UNCONFIRMED REPORT POLICE HAVE VIRTUALLY SURRENDERED CONTROL OF ZANJAN.

IN TEHRAN, STUDENTS CLASHED REPEATEDLY WITH SECURITY FORCES. PROTESTORS BARRICADED MAJOR TRAFFIC ARTERIES NEAR TEHRAN UNIVERSITY AND TRIED TO ASSEMBLE FOR MAJOR DEMONSTRATION. TROOPS PREVENTED STUDENTS FROM REACHING UNIVERSITY, WHICH WAS LOCKED. PRESS REPORTS 19 STUDENTS INJURED IN FRACAS. AUTHORITIES CLOSED TEHRAN UNIVERYSITY FOR TWO DAYS TO FORESTALL DEMONSTRATIONS, AND NATIONAL UNIVERSITY CLOSED UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE. PERHAPS AS RESULT, MARCHING, CHANTING STUDENT GROUPS ARE EVIDENT THROUGHOUT TEYRAN TODAY. TWO GROUPS HAVE PASSED BY EMBASSY. SECURITY FORCES HAVE USED TEAR GAS AT LEAST TWICE ON ELIZABETH BLVD, AND MORE ARRESTS AND INJURIES ARE LIKELY.

IN RELATED DEVELOPMENT, STUDENTS AT TEHRAN TECHNICAL COLLEGE HAVE SENT LETTER OF SUPPORT TO YASIR ARAFAT. PRESS REPORTS CONFRONTATION AND NEAR VIOLENT CLASH BETWEEN LEFTIST AND RELIGIOUS PROTESTORS AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY RALLY WEDNESDAY. NATIONAL SOLIDARITY WEEK BEGAN SATURDAY AT IRANIAN UNIVERSITIES. NATIONAL ORGANIZATION OF UNIVERSITY PROFESSORS CALLED EVENT TO DEBATE PRESENT POLITICAL SITUATION.

PRO-GOVT DEMONSTRATORS HAVE APPEARED IN INCREASED NUMBERS AND HAVE CLASHED WITH PROTESTORS IN SEVERAL CITIES. PRESS REPORTS STREET BRAWLS IN GORGAN, REZAIYEH, ROUDSAR, MIANDOAB AND KASHAN. GORGAN CROWD INCLUDED FARMERS WIELDING THEIR SPADES ( COMMENT : GOI HAS USUALLY TURNED TO RURAL POPULATION, MANY OF THEM SUNNI MOSLEM, IN ADDITION TO TRIBES, WHEN PRO-GOVT CROWDS WERE NEEDED). PEACEFUL PRO-GOVT RALLY TOOK PLACE SATURDAY IN TEHRAN.
TWENTY TWO YEAR OLD SOLIDER WAS ARRESTED FOR KILLING POLICE CHIEF AND SEVERELY WOUNDING MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR OF JAHROM.

ANTI-FOREIGN FEELING INCREASINGLY EVIDENT. (WILL BE REPORTED SEPTEL.) WEEKEND'S EVENTS INCLUDED STONING OF HOSTEL,BURNING OF BRITISH BUS, SECOND STONING OF AMERICAN BUSES LEAVING DOWSHAHN TAPPEH AIR BASE, AND RECEIPT OF THREATENING LETTERS. CONSULATES REPORT WORRY AMONG FOREIGN COMMUNITY DESPITE RELATIVE ABSENCE OF ATTACKS DURING WEEKEND.
MLA IN MASHAD HAS ANNOUNCED CURFEW ADVANCED TO 8 P.M. FROM MIDNIGHT, WITH THREAT THAT IT WILL BE FURTHER ADVANCED IF UNREST CONTINUES.

SENATOR CLOSE TO PM SHARIF-EMAMI (REFTELS) GOT BACK IN TOUCH WITH POLITICAL COUNSELOR OCT 29, THROUGH INTERMEDIARY, TO SAY HE JUST SEEN PM, WHO WAS HOLDING FIRM DESPITE RUMORS AROUND TOWN THAT HIS GOVT IS ABOUT TO FOLD. PM HAD TALKED WITH SHARIATMADARI. LATTER IS SENDING HIS SON AND SON-IN-LAW ABBASSI TO PARIS (PRESUMABLY TO DISCUSS FURTHER WITH KHOMEINI).

HE ALSO SAID THAT MINISTER FOREXECUTIVE AFFAIRS AZMOUN HAS RESIGNED AND HIS RESIGNATION HAS BEEN ACCEPTED. (RESIGNATION WAS DENIED IN PRESS TODAY.) HE IS OCCUPYING HIS OFFICE UNTIL REPLACEMENT IS FOUND. REPLACEMENT HAS NOW BEEN FOUND AND RESIGNATION WILL BE ANNOUNCED SOON. (THIS SEEMS TO FIT IN WITH REPORT FROM ANOTHER SHARIF-EMAMI CONFIDANT WHO TOLD US THAT PM WAS UNHAPPY TO HAVE 11 OF HIS ORIGINAL MINISTERS DICATED BY SHAH, INCLUDING THE FOREIGN MINISTER, AND THAT HE WOULD WORK AT REMOVING THEM. AZMOUN WAS THE ONE PM IS SUPPOSED TO HAVE OBJECTED TO THE MOST, AMIN (INDUSTRY AND MINES) AND KANI (ENDOWMENT FUND) THE LEAST.
MORTEZA MOHIT WAS AMONG THOSE PRISONERS RELEASED ON OCCASION OF SHAH'S BIRTHDAY.

1978TEHRAN10548.subject: 33RD UNGA: IRAQI RESOLUTION ON MILITARY COOPERATION WITH ISRAEL

segments.text: POLITICAL COUNSELOR DISCUSSED THIS ISSUE ALONG LINES REF A WITH MFA UNDERSECRETARY NADIM OCT 30. HE ALSO MENTIONED THE NEED TO DELAY A VOTE ON IRAQI RESOLUTION IF POSSIBLE.

NADIM SAID GOI IN ITS PRESENT CONDITION HAS NO INFLUENCE --PARTICULARLY WITH IRAQ FEELING ITS OATS AS "LEADING POWER IN THIS AREA OF WORLD." HE DID NOT THINK IRAQ WILL HEED FIRST COMMITTEE CHARIMAN BUT WILL PRESS FOR EARLY VOTE. IRAN REP HOVEYDA HAS INSTRUCTIONS TO ABSTAIN OR BE ABSENT. LATTER IS MOST LIKELY COURSE.
NADIM ADDED THAT HE HAD BEEN STRUCK WHILE IN NEW YORK BY THE WAY ALL OTHER ARAB DELEGATES OSTRACIZED THE EGYPTIAN DELEGATE. HE FELT SORRY FOR HIM.
NADIM CONFIDED HE HIMSELF IS RUNNING FOREIGN POLICY ON SUCH ISSUES AT THE MOMENT. SHAH AND FONMIN ARE ALMOST ENTIRELY ABSORBED BY DOMESTIC AFFAIRS.
AMBASSADOR, DCM AND POL/MIL COUNSELOR WILL BE AVAILABLE IN NOVEMBER 27-29 PERIOD TO BE INTERVIEWED BY MR. GLENNON. WE ARE APPRECIATIVE THAT MR. MARKS WILL ALSO BE PRESENT.
WE HAVE A SECRETARY WHO HAS DONE COURT REPORTING. HER SKILLS ARE A LITTLE RUSTY BUT PROBABLY ADEQUATE. WE MAY ALSO WISH TO TAPE INTERVIEWS.
IT MUST BE UNDERSTOOD THAT MR. GLENNON'S ACTIVITIES WILL BE RESTRICTED ONLY TO OFFICIAL U.S. PERSONNEL AND THAT NO RPT NO EFFORT WILL BE MADE ON HIS PART TO INTERVIEW IRANIAN NATIONALS.

POL COUNS MADE APPROACH ALONG LINES REFTEL TO DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR ASIA AND AFRICA SANANDAJI OCT 30. SANANDAJI SAID HE WOULD REFER THE ISSUE TO THE FOREIGN MINISTER. SPEAKING PERSONALLY, HE INDICATED STRONG INDIGNATION AT "ISRAELI ARROGANCE." HE SUSPECTED THE TIMING OF THIS ISRAELI MOVE AS A DELIBERATELY PROVOCATIVE BOTH TO DEMONSTRATE CONTEMPT FOR THE UPCOMING ARAB SUMMIT AND PERHAPS TO UNDERCUT SADAT FURTHER. SINCE OPPOSITION PARTY IN ISRAEL IS SUPPORTING CAMP DAVID ACCORD, GOI COULD NOT USE ARGUMENT THAT THICKENING OF SETTLEMENTS AND POSSIBLE MOVE OF PM'S OFFICE ARE NEEDED FOR DOMESTIC PURPOSES AT THIS TIME.

SANANDAJI ADDED THAT IN HIS OWN MIND ATLEAST THERE HAS BEEN NO DOUBT OF ISRAELI DETERMINIATION TO TAKE OVER WEST BANK, NOT FORMALLY AT FIRST, BUT IN FACT. THIS DETERMINIATION HAD COME OVER LOUD AND CLEAR SOME 4 OR 5 MONTHS AGO WHEN HE LED MFA SIDE IN DISCUSSIONS WITH VISITING ISRAELI DELEGATION LED BY EVRON. EVRON AND OTHER ISRAELIS HAD MADE IT OBVIOUS THAT ISRAEL DID NOT INTEND TO BACK AWAY FROM ITS CONQUESTS, PARTICULARLY THE WEST BANK.
COMMENT: SANANDAJI NORMALLY TAKES A VERY CYNICAL VIEW OF ARABS. HIS VIEW OF ISRAELI POSITION IS THEREFORE ALL THE MORE SIGNIFICANT.

DURING MEETING WITH NIOC CHAIRMAN ANSARY OCTOBER 30, HE SPOKE IN SOME DESPAIR ABOUT CURRENT PRIME MINISTER SHARIF-EMAMI. HE CLAIMED THAT PM WAS MERELY REACTING TO EVENTS AND FAILING TO PROVIDE LEADERSHIP. AS RESULT, AGITATORS FELT THEY COULD CONTINUE TO ESCALATE DEMANDS, SINCE THERE SEEMED TO BE NO LIMIT TO GOVT CONCESSIONS.

ANSARY COMPLAINED THAT PM HAD NEVER TELEPHONED HIM ONCE WHILE HE WAS ENGAGED IN NEGOTIATIONS WITH STRIKERS AND SEEMED UNAWARE OF THEIR SIGNIFICANCE. IN CONTRAST, THE SHAH HAD CALLED TWO OR THREE TIMES A DAY. LAST NIGHT, WHEN ANSARY CALLED FROM ABADAN TO REPORT TO THE PM, HE FOUND HE WAS ALREADY ASLEEP AT 10:30 PM. THIS MORNING, AT 10:30 AM, HE FELL ASLEEP DURING THE MEETING ON APPLICATION OF MARTIAL LAW TO NIOC. (COMMENT: HE WAS VERY TIRED WHEN BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND I SAW HIM SUNDAY.)

ANSARY'S CONCLUSION WAS THAT SHARIF-EMAMI WAS NOT PHYSICALLY OR MENTALLY UP TO HIS JOB AND THAT HE HAD TO GO. HE CONTINUED TO ESCHEW ANY PERSONAL AMBITION FOR THE POSITION HIMSELF, BUT PLEADED WITH ME NOT RPT NOT TO TRY TO PERSUADE SHAH TO RETAIN CURRENT GOVT. HE SAID INITIATIVE WAS NEEDED AND SHARIF-EMAMI DID NOT HAVE IT.

1978TEHRAN10558.subject: SECURITY OF PERSONNEL: THREAT ASSESSMENT OCT 30, 1978

segments.text: TEHRAN 10441 SUMMARY: WEEKEND PASSED QUIETLY DESPITE RUMORS OF ACTION AGAINST FOREIGNERS. EMB BELIEVES TERRORIST THREAT REMAINS STABLE. GROWING NUMBERS OF DEMONSTRATORS IN STREET COUPLED WITH ANTI-FOREIGN ATTITUDE HAS HIGHTENED POSSIBILITY FOR INCIDENTS INVOLVING AMERICAN AND OTHER FOREIGNS. END SUMMARY.

RUMOR MILL HAD SUGGESTED PAST WEEKEND WAS HIGHLY LIKELY TIME FOR ANTI-FOREIGN INCIDENTS AND GENERAL VIOLENCE. REF B REPLIED TO REF A BASED ON EVENTS PRIOR TO WEEKEND. FOLLOWING IS UPDATE OF THREAT ASSESSMENT BASED ON EVENTS OF PAST FIVE DAYS.

ACTUAL INCIDENTS OVER PAST WEEKEND WERE LIMITED TO STONING OF ARMISH MAAG BUSES OCT 28 WHILE LEAVING DOSHENTAPPEH AIR BASE (NOTED REF C), AND BURNING OF BRITISH BUS IN ISFAHAN, AND OTHER MINOR ITEMS REFERRED TO IN REF C. LACK OF INCIDENTS HAS NOT ABATED WORRY IN FOREIGN COMMUNITY, AND RECEIPT OF SEVERAL WRITTEN THREATS OVER PAST FEW DAYS, INCLUDING BOMB THREATS (ALL UNFOUNDED), HAS NOT REDUCED SENSE OF UNEASE AMONG FOREIGN COMMUNITIES HERE.

SITUATION HAS CHANGED SOMEWHAT OVER PAST WEEK WITH INCREASING NUMBER OF DEMONSTRATORS BEING SEEN ON STREETS. IN SOME CASES, SCHOOL BUSES HAVE BEEN REROUTED TO AVOID CROWDS, BUT MANY AMERICANS AND OTHER HAVE SEEN STREET DOMONSTRATIONS IN MANY LOCATIONS, ESPECIALLY NEAR IRANIAN SCHOOLS WHERE TEACHERS HAVE ENCOUAGED STUDENTS "STRIKES" FROM HIGH SCHOOLS DOWN TO HIGH ELEMENTARY LEVELS. THERE HAVE BEEN REMARKABLY FEW PROBLEMS WITH THESE DEMONSTRATIONS, EVEN IN CASES WHERE MILITARY AND POLICE HAVE MOVED IN (SEE REFS C AND D RECENT CASES).
AMERICAN HAVE BEEN CAUTIONED TO LIMIT MOVEMENT AND STAY AWAY FROM OBVIOUS CROWD DEMONSTRATIONS AREAS (EMB HAS NOT RPT NOT, AS SOME INCORRECTLY SAYING, URGED ALL AMERIANS TO STAY HOME).

WE BELIEVE TERRORIST THREAT REMAINS ESSENTIALLY UNCHANGED. THERE IS NO RPT NO EVIDENCE THAT 'PROFESSIONAL' GROUPS SUCH AS MUJAHEDIN AND CHARIKS ARE BECOMING MORE ACTIVE AGAINST FOREIGN TARGETS. AT SAME TIME, INCIDENTS DURING PAST SEVERAL MONTHS INDICATE THAT THERE HAS GROWN UP THREAT FROM AD HOC PRESUMABLY PRO-ISLAMIC GROUPS OR INDIVIDUALS (THEIR EXACT CHARACTER IS NOT KNOWN) WHO ALSO HAVE THE CAPABILITY OF ATTACKING LOCAL TARGETS. WHILE MOST ACTIVITIES OF THESE GROUPS OR INDIVIDUALS HAVE BEEN DIRECTED AGAINST AMERICANS. MOREOVER, THREAT FROM THIS QUARTER CAN APPEAR MORE "SPECTACULAR" THAN THE SCOPE OF TERRORISM WVE BEEN DEALING WITH IN THE PAST--THE BOMBING OF THE BHI BUS IN ISFAHAN BEING AN EXAMPLE.

GROWTH OF PUBLIC DEMONSTRATIONS AND PUBLIC EXPRESSIONS OF HERETOFORE MUTED ANTI-FOREIGN SENTIMENT ALSO OFFERS PROSPECT THAT THERE MAY BE MORE INCIDENTS INVOLVING AMCITS AS WELL AS OTHER NATIONALITIES. OUR FRENCH, BRITISH, AND ITALIAN COLLEAGUES REPORT THE SAME TYPE OF OCCASIONAL LOW-LEVEL HARASSMENT AGAINST THEIR NATIONALS THAT WE HAVE EXPERIENCED AND ALSO SHARE OUR FEELING THAT THE POTENTIAL FOR ADDITIONAL INCIDENTS HAS INCREASED. EMERGING UNRULINESS HAS TAKEN SOMEWHAT MORE VOCAL ANTI-AMERICAN TONE, LARGELY BECAUSE WE ARE LARGEST AND MOST VISIBLE GROUP HERE. THUS FAR IT HAS BEEN LIMITED TO RANDOM INSULTS, OCCASIONAL ROCK-THROWING, WITH A VERY FEW ATTEMPTED CAR-BURNING OR BOMBING.

THERE IS NOT RPT NO EVIDENCE OF SPECIFIC ANTIAMERICAN "CAMPAIGN" OR DELIBERATE, ORGANIZED EFFORT TO HARASS AMERICANS BECUASE THEY ARE AMERICANS. MANY PERSIANS DESCRIBE SITUATION AS ONE OF GREATER PUBLIC EXPRESSION OF SENTIMENTS WHICH HAVE EXISTED FOR SOME TIME, BUT HAVE THUS FAR BEEN HELD BACK BY FEAR MIXED WITH COURTESY.

GREATER POLITICAL ACTIVITY IN THE STREETS HAS INCEASED THE POSSIBILITY RPT POSSIBILITY OF AMCIT INVOLVEMENT IN UNPLEASANT OR DANGEROUS INCIDENTS. SAME EXPANDED RISK APPLIES TO ALL INDIVIDUALS, BOTH FOREIGN AND IRANIAN, DURING CURRENT TIME OF POLITICAL STRESS. SECURITY WATCH COMMITTEE MET OCT 22 AND OCT 25 TO EVOLVE ABOVE ASSESSMENT.

SECURITY WATCH COMMITTEE ALSO DISCUSSED PROBLEM OF PSYCHOLOGY OF AMERICAN COMMUNITY, WHICH HAS NATURALLY FOCUSED ON ITS OWN PROBLEMS. MISSION OFFICERS HAVE BEEN MAKING SPECIAL EFFORT TO SEE THAT NUANCES OF SITUATION ARE BETTER UNDERSTOOD BY KEY CORPORATE OFFICERS AND INDIVIDUALS. SIMPLISTIC ATTITUDES THAT "ANTI-AMERICANISM IS INCREASING," MISS COMPLEXITY OF DEVELOPMENT AND FACT THAT SITUATION HAS BECOME MORE UNSETTLED FOR EVERYONE, NOT JUST AMCITS. CONDITIONS ARE LIKELY TO REMAIN UNCERTAIN UNTIL LOCAL POLITICAL FACTORS--STRIKES, DEMONSTRATIONS, ETC.--CHANGE SIGNIFICANTLY, EITHER FOR BETTER OR WORSE.
EMB WILL CONTINUE TO MONITOR CONDITIONS AND ADVISE DEPARTMENT OF CHANGE IN ABOVE ASSESSMENT.

1978TEHRAN10559.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT, OCT 30 SUMMARY: DEMONSTRATIONS IN 37 CITIES LEFT 8 DEAD. HEAVY STUDENT DEMONSTRATIONS THROUGHOUT TEHRAN; TR

segments.text: SUMMARY: DEMONSTRATIONS IN 37 CITIES LEFT 8 DEAD. HEAVY STUDENT DEMONSTRATIONS THROUGHOUT TEHRAN; TROOPS USED TEARGAS BUT NO REPORTS OF INJURIES. OPPOSITION ACCUSED GOVT OF ORGANIZING COUNTER RIOTS TO ATTACK DEMONSTRATORS. 5,000 RESIDENTS OF VILLAGE NEAR KERMANSHAH WENT ON HUNGER STRIKE TO PROTEST RECENT KILLINGS. GOVT HAS PUBLICIZED "PURGE" OF SAVAK. PRESS REPORTS RECENT STONING OF AMERICAN BUSES. PRESS SPECULATES ABOUT POSSIBLE MILITARY TAKEOVER. SANJABI SAYS HE WILL BOYCOTT WORLD SOCIALIST CONGRESS AS PROTEST AGAINST STATEMENTS OF BRITISH FONSEC. MAJLIS DEBATE FEATURED ATTACK AGAINST HOVEYDA. END SUMMARY.

DAILY ROUND OF VIOLENT DEMONSTRATIONS CONTINUED YESTERDAY, AFFEDTING 37 CITIES AND TOWNS. EIGHT NEW DEAD ARE REPORTED FROM CLASHES IN KERMANSHAH AND DEZFUL. RIOTERS HIT USUAL TARGETS OF BANKS AND CINEMAS. BANKERS IN KERMANSHAH REPORTEDLY CLOSED UNTIL THEY RECEIVE PROTECTION. ONE REPORT ATTRIBUTES VIOLENCE IN KERMANSHAH TO BATTLE BETWEEN PRO AND ANTI-GOVT CROWDS. CONSULATES REPORT CONDITIONS QUIET IN ISFAHAN, TABRIZ AND SHIRAZ.

TEHRAN SAW LARGE-SCALE STUDENT DEMONSTRATIONS AND SOME DESTRUCTION, BUT NO REPORTS OF INJURIES. SECURITY FORCES USED TEARGAS AS THEY CONFRONTED ROVING STUDENT GROUPS THROUGHOUT THE DAY. GATES AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY WERE UNLOCKED ABOUT NOON, RELIVEING PRESSURE FROM STREETS AS STUDENTS POURED ONTO CAMPUS. RIOTERS SET FIRE TO AT LEAST ONE MOVIE THEATER AND DAMAGED BANKS AND LIQUOR STORES. SMALL BAND OF FLEEING DEMONSTRATORS ENTERED PIRUZI SCHOOL GROUNDS (ATTENDED BY MANY AMERICAN CHILDREN) BUT DEPARTED WITHOUT INCIDENT. THERE WAS AT LEAST ONE PRO-GOVT DEMONSTRATION BUT TROOPS KEPT RIVAL GROUPS APART.

OPPOSITION ACCUSES GOVT OF ORGANIZING COUNTER GROUPS TO ATTACK DEMONSTRATORS. INVESTIGATORS SENT BY AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI REPORTED THAT VIOLENCE IN KERMAN WAS CAUSED BY POLICE AND HIRED THUGS DRESSED AS GYPSIES. MAJLIS DEPUTY AHMAD BANI AHMAD PLACED IMILAR CHARGE, WARNING DEMONSTRATORS TO WATCH OUT FOR CLUB-CARRYING HOOLIGANS WHO WILL ATTACK AT LEAST PRETEXT. HE CHARGES GOVT WITH PLANNING CIVIL WAR WHICH WILL LEAD TO NEWLY OPPRESSIVE REGIME.

RUMORS SPEAK OF EXTRA TROUBLE OCT 31, BIRTHDAY OF CROWN PRINCE REZA. BUT TROOPS HAVE SO FAR GENERALLY BEEN SUCCESSFUL, AT LEAST IN TEHRAN, CONTROLLING DEMONSTRATORS WITHOUT KNOWN BLOODSHED. INFORMATION MINISTER AMELI REVEALED PUBLICY YESTERDAY WHAT STUDENTS MUST ALREADY HAVE KNOWN--TROOPS HAVE ORDERS NOT TO USE LETHAL FORCE.

5,000 RESIDENTS OF KABOUTARAHANGE (VILLAGE NEAR KERMANSHAH) HAVE GONE ON HUNGER STRIKE TO PROTEST SHOOTING OF DEMONSTRATORS OCT 27. TWELVE PEOPLE DIED FROM INCIDENT. STRIKERS DEMAND PROSECUTION OF SIX GENDARMES WHO REPORTEDLY DID SHOOTING.

GOVT ANNOUNCED PURGE OF SAVAK, INCLUDING PARVIS SABETI, WHO IS FAMOUS IN IRAN FOR TELEVISION APPEARANCES DEFENDING THE ORGANIZATION. THIRTY-THREE OTHERS ARE NAME AS HAVING BEEN DISMISSED OR FORCED INTO RETIREMENT.

UNDETERMINED NUMBER OF LOWER RANKING PERSONNEL HAVE ALSO BEEN RELEASED. ------------------056559 301847Z /43 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1236 INFO USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 10559 (COMMENT: A NUMBER OF THE 34 OFFICERS WERE ACTUALLY PURGED WHEN MOGHADAM REPLACED NASSIRI AND HAVE ONLY JUST BEEN ANNOUNCED. ACTION FOLLOWS BY ONE DAY A PUBLISHED INTERVIEW WITH FORMER POLITICAL PRISONERS WHO DETAILED SAVAK'S TORUTURE METHODS.)
PRESS OCT 30 REPORTS RECENT STONING OF BUSES CARRYING AMERICANS FROM DOWSHAN TAPPEH AIR BASE. REPORT SAYS SEVERAL WERE INJURED.
PRESS OPENLY SPECULATES ABOUT POSSIBLE MILITARY TAKEOVER IF UNREST DOES NOT CEASE. ONE REPORT SAYS ACTION WAS PLANNED FOR EARLY LAST WEEK BUT SHELVED AT LAST MOMENT.

NATIONAL FRONT LEADER KARIM SANJABI ANNOUNCED HE WILL BOYCOTT WORLD SOCIALIST CONGRESS, WHICH HE HAD PREVIOUSLY SAID HE WOULD ATTEND. REASON GIVEN IS THAT BRITISH FONSEC AND SOME OTHER LABOR PARTY LEADERS ATTENDING HAD SPOKEN IN SUPPORT OF SHAH'S REGIME.

MAJLIS DEBATE YESTERDAY FEATURED ATTACK ON HOVEYDA BY MOHAMMAD HOSSEIN DELKHOSH FOUMANI. HE DEMANDED PROSECUTION OF HOVEYDA FOR CORRUPTION, ASKING "ARE WE GOING TO CONFINE OURSELVES TO THE LACKEYS WHILE THE REALS, KEY FIGURES REMAIN BEHIND THE SCENES?" HE BLAMED HOVEYDA FOR HAVING PRESIDED OVER 13 YEARS OF GROWING PUBLIC DISSATISFACTION.

EMBASSY HAS AGAIN BEEN PRESSED BY ATOMIC ENERGY ORGANIZATION OF IRAN (AEOI), CONSISTENT WITH REFTELS, AND IN PARTICULAR PARA 2, REF B. WOULD VERY MUCH APPRECIATE YOUR MAKING DIRECT CONTACT WITH OAK RIDGE'S JOHNSON TO URGE THAT DATA BE SUPPLIED SOONEST.
SUGGEST POUCH OR APO BE USED FOR TRANSMITTAL OF ITEMIZED COST DATA DUE TO CURRENT DIFFICULTIES WITH POSTAL SERVICES IN COUNTRY.
BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND I MET FOR AN HOUR WITH SHAH MORNING OCTOBER 31. WE FOUND HIM SOMBER, BUT CONTROLLED, AND OCCASIONALLY DISPLAYING A RATHER MACABRE TOUCH OF HUMOR.

SHAH ANALYZED SITUATION AS HE SAW IT IN A FEW PHRASES. CURRENT GOVT HAS PROVED UNABLE TO SEIZE THE INITIATIVE. IT WAS NOT ACCEPTED BY SHARIAT-MADARI AND THE MODERATE CLERGY. IT WAS UNABLE TO GET THE UNIVERSITIES OPEN OR THE OIL STRIKE SETTLED.

IN THE MEANTIME, IRAN WAS "MELTING AWAY" DAILY, AND TIME WAS RUNNING OUT. HE THEREFORE HAD TO LOOK AT ALTERNATIVES. AS HE SAW IT, THERE WERE ONLY TWO: (A) A MILITARY GOVT, OR (B) A "COALITION GOVT." THE MILITARY SOLUTION WOULD AT BEST BE A QUICK FIX AND, IN THE LONG RUN, NO SOLUTION AT ALL. HE WAS THEREFORE THINKING IN TERMS OF A COALITION.

IN RESPONSE TO OUR QUESTIONS ABOUT THE NATURE OF THIS COALITION, HE SAID, IT WOULD HAVE TO BE FORMED AROUND A DISTINGUISHED NEUTRAL FIGURE WHO WOULD BE ACCEPTABLE TO ALL"CONSTITUTIONAL" FACTIONS. BUT, IT WOULD ALSO BE A GOVT IN WHICH THE INDIVIDUAL MINISTERS WOULD HAVE TRUE POLITICAL AND ADMINISTRATIVE AUTHORITY. THEREFORE, THEIR OWN VALENCE WITHIN THE GOVT WOULD BE GREATER THAN THAT ENJOYED BY TECHNOCRATIC MINISTERS OF RECENT PAST.

SHAH SAID HE HAD RECEIVED WORD FROM NATIONAL FRONT POLITICIANS THAT THEY WOULD BE PREPARED TO JOIN SUCH A GOVT. HE SAID THEY HAD INDICATED THEY WOULD ACCEPT NASROLLAH ENTEZAM AS THE NEUTRAL DISTINGUISHED FIGURE WHO COULD BE PRIME MINISTER. (ENTEZAM, FORMER FOREIGN MINISTER, IS 78 YEARS OLD AND COULD OBVIOUSLY ONLY BE A FIGUREHEAD IN SUCH A GOVT. THIS WOULD MEAN THAT THE SHAH WOULD BE THE EFFECTIVE LEADER.)

WHEN ASKED WHAT THIS GOVT WOULD BE EXPECTED TO DO, SHAH SAID ITS FIRST TASK WOULD BE TO SETTLE THE OIL STRIKE, OPEN THE UNIVERSITIES AND GENERALLY RESTORE ORDER SO THAT MARTIAL LAW COULD BE LIFTED. ITS SECOND TASK WOULD BE TO PRESS THE ANTI-CORRUPTION CAMPAIGN. (HE SAID HE EXPECTED NASSERI-SURELY-AND HOVEYDAPROBABLY- WOULD GO TO JAIL.)

NEXT, HE WANTED THEM TO REORDER THE BUDGET AND ESTABLISH NEW ECONOMIC AND SOCIAL PRIORITIES. FINALLY, THEY WOULD HAVE TO DISSOLVE THE PARLIAMENT AND SUPERVISE HONEST GENERAL ELECTIONS. THIS WOULD PRESUMABLY BE EARLIER THAN NEXT JUNE, BUT ONLY IF THE TURMOIL SUBSIDES ENOUGH TO MAKE ELECTIONS ORDERLY.

I ASKED WHAT WOULD HAPPEN IF THE POLITICIANS DECLINED TO TAKE PART IN THIS GOVT OR IF ENTEZAM DECLINED TO TAKE THE JOB. SHAH SAID HE WOULD THEN TRY ALI-AMINI, BUT HE DOUBTED AMINI HAD THE CLOUT, PARTICULARLY WITH THE MODERATE CLERGY. THE ALI-AMINI GOVT, IN HIS VIEW, WOULD NOT RPT NOT BE A "COALITION" GOVT, BUT WOULD BE PUT TOGETHER ON AMINI'S INITIATIVE.

WE THEN ASKED WHAT TIME-FRAME SHAH ENVISAGED. HE SAID AGAIN THAT TIME WAS RUNNING OUT AND THAT HE WOULD HAVE TO ACT IMMEDIATELY. HE ASKED WHETHER WE SAW ANY VIABLE ALTERNATIVES. WE SAID WE DID NOT. HE THEN SAID HE WOULD GET IN TOUCH WITH ENTEZAM TODAY. IT WOULD TAKE A FEW DAYS TO PUT THIS EFFORT TOGETHER IF ENTEZAM ACCEPTS. IF HE DOES NOT, THERE MIGHT PERHAPS BE SOME OTHER DISTINGUISHED NEUTRAL FIGURE SUCH AS MOHAMMAD SORURI (FORMER CHIEF JUSTICE, AGE 72) WHO WOULD BE WILLING. BUT, HE JOKED, SORURI MIGHT BE TOO DEAF TO HEAR IF HE WERE ASKED.

FINALLY, SHAH SAID, RATHER WISTFULLY, THAT LIFE WAS CRUEL. HIS LOYAL PRIME MINISTER WAS, AT THAT VERY MOMENT, COURAGEOUSLY PLEADING HIS HEART OUT IN THE MAJLIS TO OBTAIN A VOTE OF CONFIDENCE, WHILE HE SAT PLOTTING WITH THE BRITISH AND AMERICAN AMBASSADORS TO REPLACE HIM. ON THAT NOTE, WE LEFT TO SIGN THE BIRTHDAY BOOK FOR THE CROWN PRINCE AT GOLESTAN PALACE.

FOR NEA/IRAN JOE KRAFT TOLD THE AMBASSADOR HE HAD BEEN GIVEN A COPY OF THE SHAH'S ORDER AFFECTING MEMBERS OF THE ROYAL FAMILY AND WOULD GIVE THE AMBASSADOR A COPY OF HIS COPY. UNFORTUMATELY HE LEFT WITHOUT DOING SO. WE WONDER IF YOU COULD BET ONE FROM HIM AND REPRODUCE FOR YOUR FILES AND OURS.

1978TEHRAN10619.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT, OCT 31 SUMMARY: HOSSEIN NAJAFI AND MOSTAFA PAYEDAR BECAME MINISTER OF JUSTICE AND STATE IN CHARGE OF EXECUTI

segments.text: SUMMARY: HOSSEIN NAJAFI AND MOSTAFA PAYEDAR BECAME MINISTER OF JUSTICE AND STATE IN CHARGE OF EXECUTIVE AFFAIRS. YESTERDAY EX-MINISTER OF STATE AZMOUN FORMED NEW POLITICAL PARTY. SANJABI-KHOMENI MEETING YESTERDAY REPORTEDLY FAILED TO PRODUCE AGREEMENT BUT GIVES IMPRESSION NATIONAL FRONT HAS MOVED TOWARD KHOMEINI'S OBDURATE POSITION. RANK OF ADJUTANT DROPPED FROM SHAH'S ENTOURAGE. PEOPLE OF EARTHQUAKE-STRIKEN TABAS REPORTEDLY MOVING FROM VILLAGE AS RESULT OF SHODDY REHABILITATION PERFORMANCE OF GOVT. FEWER DEMONSTRATIONS REPORTED THAN USUAL, BUT BLOODY PRO-ANTO CLASHES IN WESTERN IRAN LEFT AT LEAST 36 DEAD. LARGE STUDENT RALLIES IN TEHRAN WITHOUT SERIOUS INCIDENT.

SCHOOLS CLOSED TODAY AND INCREASED DISTURBANCES EXPECTED ON OCCASION OF CROWN PRINCE'S BIRTHDAY. SAVAK STATES 600 POLITICAL PRISONERS STILL INCUSTODY, CLAIMS ARE ARE ASSOCIATED WITH ACTS OF VIOLENCE. GOVT RELEASED TWO DISSIDENT CLERGY. END SUMMARY.

TWO OF MOST PROMINENT MINISTER IN SHARIF-EMAMI GOVT RESIGNED YESTERDAY. MINISTER OF STATE FOR EXECUTIVE AFFAIRS MANOUCHEHR AZMOUN, WHO HAS BEEN SOURCE OF CONTROVERSY FOR SEVERL WEEKS, GAVE WAY TO CAREER JUSTICE OFFICIAL MOSTAFA PAYEDAR. JUSTICE MINISTER MOHAMMAD BAHERI, ALSO VERY MUCH IN HEADLINES AS LEADER OF ANTICORRUPTION CAMPAIGN, WAS REPLACED BY STATE PROSECUTOR GENERAL HOSSEIN NAJAFI. BIOGRAPHIC DATA OF NEW MINISTERS WILL FOLLOW IN SEPTEL. AZMOUN HAD QUICKLY BECOME VIRTUAL GOVT SPOKESMAN, AND VARIETY OF SOURCES DESCRIBED HIM AS SUPREMELY ARROGANT, EVEN TOWARD OTHER MINISTERS. APPARENTLY AN ARGUMENT BETWEEN HIM AND SHARIF-EMAMI'S FIRST HEALTH MINISTER, MOJDEHI, CUASED LATTER'S RESIGNATION.

RESIGNATION OF BAHERI IS LESS EASILY EXPLAINED, EXCEPT AS PART OF SERIATIM HOUSE-CLEANING BY SHARIF-EMAMI OF MANY MINISTERS WHOSE CHOICE WAS DECTATED TO HIM BY THE SHAH. AS POSSIBLE PROXIMATE CAUSE, BAHERI WAS INVOLVED IN SHOUTING MATCH WITH MAJLIS DEPUTIES FEW WEEKS AGO AND SOME SPECULATE HE WAS DISMISSED TO IMPROVE GOVT RELATIONS WITH DEPUTIES, PRIOR TO IMPORTANT VOTE OF CONFIDENCE DUE TODAY. HE WAS ONCE IN TUDEH PARTY (AS WAS AZMOUN), AND ALTHOUGH THIS WAS LONG AGO, OLD ASSOCIATION HAS CONTINUED TO HAUNT HIM.

AZMOUN FOLLOWED RESIGNATION WITH ANNOUNCMENT OF NEW POLITICAL PARTY OPPOSED TO SHARIF-EMAMI GOVT. MARDOM OR PEOPLES PARTY WILL ADHERE TO PRINCIPLES OF ISLAM AND CONSTITUTION. MARDON WAS NAMED OF OFFICIAL OPPOSITION PARTY BEFORE MONOPOLY RESIRGENCE PARTY WAS CREATED. IT IS UNCLEAR WHETHER AZMOUN INTENTIONALLY WISHES TO SUGGEST THAT ROLE WITH HIS CHOICE OF PARTY NAME.

MEETING BETWEEN NATIONAL FRONT LEADER KARIM SANJABI AND AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI DID NOT GET ANY CLOSER TO MELLOWING THE AYATOLLAH. INSTEAD, EFFECT OF THEIR MEETING IS TO MAKE NATIONAL FRONT APPEAR MORE OBDURATE THA PREVIOUSLY. REPORTEDLY KHOMEINI STILL REJECTS ANY COMPROMISE WHICH DOES NOT INCLUDE IMMEDIATE DISSOLUTION OF PAHLAVI DYNASTY. SANJABI SAID KHOMEINI'S STRUGGLE IS THE NATIONAL FRONT'S STRUGGLE AND DENIED THERE WAS DISAGREEMENT BETWEEN THE TWO MEN. SANJABI AND KHOMEINI DOD NOT HOWEVER, ISSUE ANY JOINT STATMENT AND THEIR INDEPENDENT COMMENTS MAKE CLEAR THEY ARE STILL FAR APART. WE BELIEVE NF SEEKS COMPROMISE TO DEFUSE PRESENT SITUATION AND IT DOES SUPPORT CONSTITUTION.

BY REJECTING THE MONARCHY, KHOMEINI OPPOSES COMPROMISE OPENLY AND THE CONSTUTION IMPLICITLY. ------------------069687 311456Z /46 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1268 INFO USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 10619
IN FURTHER EFFORT TO LOWER PROFILE OF ROYAL ENTOURAGE, COURT HAS ELIMINATED RANK OF ADJUTANT TO SHAH.

GOVT PROGRAM TO REHABILITATE EARTHQUATE-STRIKEN TABAS HAS MAKING OF LARGE SCANDAL. CITIZENS HAVE LODGED MANY COMPLAINTS THAT AIDS IS NOT GETTING TO THE VICTIMS. PRESS REPORTS POPULATION IS LEAVING TABAS FOR OTHER TOWNS, HAVING GIVEN UP HOPE GOVT WILL REINSTALL THEM IN FORMER HOME.

FEWER DEMONSTRATIONS THAN USUAL WERE REPORTED AROUND IRAN BUT CASUALTIES WERE HIGHER. TEHRAN AGAIN HAD LARGE MARCHING CROWDS OF STUDENTS CULINATING IN RALLY AT TEHRAN UNIVERSTIY. MELLI UNIVERSITY HAD SEPARATE RALLY. A THIRD RALLY TOOK PLACE AT TEHRAN TEACHERS COLLEGE. ORGANIZERS APPARENTLY HAVE DECIDED TO MAKE MORE USE OF SACROSANCT CAMPUSES FOR DEMONSTRATIONS. (COMMENT: THIS WILL REDUCE RISK OF VIOLENT CONFRONTATION WITH TROOPS). TROOPS USED TEAR GAS TO DISPERSE CROWDS IN SEVERAL OFF CAMPUS LOCATIONS, BUT THERE WERE NO SERIOUS CLASHES. LARGE BUT PEACEFUL MARCH TOOK PLACE IN MASHAD. VIOLENCE CAME TO TWO TOWNS IN KERMANSHAHAN NEAR IRAQI BORDER.

IN BOTH CASES PRO-GOVT GROUPS FOUGH WITH PROTESTORS, LEAVING, ACCORDING TO PRESS, 25 DEAD IN POL-E-ZAHAB AND 11 MORE IN PAVEH. (IN LATTER TOWN HUNDREDS OF TRIBESMEN ON HORSEBACK RAIDED TOWN IN WILD WEST STYLE.) IN OPPOSITE CORNER OF IRAN, BALUCH TRIBESMEN DEMONSTRATED SUPPORT FOR REGIME IN ZAHEDAN. AT LEAST ONE GROUP OF WELLDRESSED YOUNG PRO-GOVT DEMONSTRATORS WAS SEEN DESCENDING FROM NORTH TOWARD CENTRAL TEHRAN LASTVENING, APPARENTLY GETTING HEAD START IN CELEBRATING CROWN PRINCE'S BIRTHDAY. JOURNALIST SOURCE REPORTS LEAFLETS DROPPED IN SRMANSHAH INDICATING PRO-GOVT GROUPS WILL DEMONSTRATE THERE TOMORROW.

TOWNPEOPLE REPORTEDLY PETITIONED FOR INSTALLATION OF MARTIAL LAW TO PROTECT THEM, AND ARMY PROMISED PROTECTION EVEN IN ABSENCE OF FORMAL MARTIAL LAW. SIMILAR PATTERN EMERGING IN CASPIAN CITY OF RASHT, WHERE ARMY REPORTEDLY CARRYING OUT POLICE FUNCTIONS AND ENFORCING REGULATIONS EVEN IN ABSENCE ANY FORMAL DECLARATION OF MARTIAL LAW. SCHOOLS ARE CLOSED TODAY THROUGHOUT IRAN AND EXTRA DISTURBANCES WERE ANTICIAPTED ON OCCASION OF CROWN PRINCE REZA'S BIRTHDAY.
SAVAK SPOKEMAN SAID 600 POLITICAL PRISONERS REMAIN IN CUSTODY. ALL OF THESE, HE MAINTAINED, WERE ASSOCIATED WITH VIOLENT ACTS AGAINST THE STATE.
GOVT RELEASED TWO DISSIDENT CLERGY YESTERDAY, AYATOLLAHS SHAIKH HASSAN ALI MONTAZERI AND SAYED MAHMOUD TELEGANI.

1978TEHRAN10620.subject: SHARIF-EMAMI WINS CENSURE VOTE BEGIN UNCLASSIFIED

segments.text: BEGIN UNCLASSIFIED

AFTER FOUR HOURS OF INTENSE DEBATE, IRANIAN MAJLIS VOTED DOWN CENSURE MOTION, 176 OPPOSED 35 IN FAVOR AND 7 BLANK BALLOTS. SOME 50 MAJLIS DEPUTIES WERE NOT RPT NOT IN ATTENDANCE. DEBATE WAS VICIOUS AND INCLUDED PERSONAL ATTACKS AGAINST EX-MINISTERS BAHERI AND AZMOUN (SEE SEPTEL FOR AZMOUN DEPARTURE FROM GOVT) AND MIN EDUCATION GANJI. END UNCLASSIFIED - BEGIN CONFIDENTIAL

OPPOSITION SOURCES HAD INDICATED PRIVATELY TO POL OFF THAT SOME 80 VOTES WERE EXPECTED IN FAVOR OF CENSURE MOTION. EMBASSY UNDERSTANDS FROM OTHER SOURCES THAT NUMBER OF TOWNS IN SOUTHERN AND WESTERN IRAN HAD CABLED THEIR DEPUTIES TO VOTE AGAINST GOI (ONE SOURCE SPECULATED THIS MAY HAVE ACCOUNTED FOR UNNATURALLY LARGE NUMBER OF ABSENTEES). PRO-GOI MAJLIS DEPUTY TWO DAYS PREVIOUSLY HAD ESTIMATED BETWEEN 40-50 VOTES WOULD GO AGAINST PRIME MINISTER.

EMBASSY COMMENT: NUMBER OR PRO-GOVERNMENT OBSERVERS WERE HOPEFUL RESOUNDING VOTE WOULD LIFT FLAGGING FORTUNES OF EMBATTLED PRIME MINISTER. OTHERS LESS PERSONALLY INVOLVED WITH GOI FELT THIS RESULT COULD BE MARRED BY POSSIBLE INCREASED DEMONSTRATIONS IN WAKE OF VOTE PLUS RENEWED OPPOSITION CHARGES THAT PRESENT MAJLIS IN UNREPRESENTATIVE. ULTIMATE OUTCOME MIGHT BE INCREASED SHORT-TERM PRESSURE TO DISSOLVE MAJLIS EARLYER THAN SCHEDULED (NEXT JUNE). END CONFIDENTIAL

1978TEHRAN10621.subject: LOOKING AHEAD: SHIFTING IRANIAN PUBLIC ATTITUDES SUMMARY: EVENTS OF PAST MONTH, PARTICULARLY PAST WEEK, HAVE LED TO CLEARLY DISCERNABLE SHIFTS IN AT TITUDES REG

segments.text: SUMMARY: EVENTS OF PAST MONTH, PARTICULARLY PAST WEEK, HAVE LED TO CLEARLY DISCERNABLE SHIFTS IN ATTITUDES REGARDING SHAH AND GOI AMONG MANY GROUPS OF IRANIANS. SUCH CHANGES, WHILE SIGNIFICANT IN THE SHORT RUN, ARE ESPECIALLY IMPORTANT BECAUSE THEY FORESHADOW CHANGED WAYS OF THINKING AND BELIEVING ABOUT POLITICS IN IRAN.

MOST IMPORTANT CURRENTS ARE: A) RENEWED QUESTIONING OF SHAH'S EFFECTIVENESS AND LEGITIMACY, PARTICULARLY BY GROUPS WHICH HERETOFORE HAVE GIVEN AT LEAST TACIT ALLEGIANCE (AND USUALLY MUCH MORE) TO SHAH AND GOVERNMENT; B) GROWING BELIEF AMONG ALL SEGMENTS OF SOCIETY NOT DIRECTLY INVOLVED IN GOVERNMENT THAT SHARIF-EMAMI REGIME CARRIES TOO MUCH BAGGAGE FROM PAST TO BE ABLE TO SUCCESSFULLY RESTORE ORDER OR PROVIDE FOR TRANSITION TO FREELY-ELECTED GOVERNMENT; C) REALIZATION AMONG MIDDLE CLASS MODERNIZERS THAT BOTH RELIGIOUS FORCES AND COMMUNISTS HAVE MUCH MORE ORGANIZATIONAL CAPACITY THAN MOST IMAGINED; AND D) RAPIDLY SPREADING FEELING THAT PRESENT GOI WILL NOT BE ABLE TO COMPROMISE WITH RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP AND THAT ALTERNATIVE IS LIKELY TO BE MILITARY GOVERNMENT AND RATHER SOONER THAN LATER (LATTER BELIEF IS WIDESPREAD AMONG BOTH SUPPORTERS AND OPPONENTS OF SHAH).

DESPITE PERSIAN TENDENCY TO MANICDEPRESSIVE CYCLES IN POLITICS, SHIFT IN BASIC ASSUMPTIONS WHICH HAVE UNTIL NOW GOVERNED MOST PEOPLES' BEHAVIOR WILL FURTHER REDUCE STABILITY OF IRANIAN PUBLIC OPINION. BOTH PRO-AND ANTI-SHAH ELEMENTS ARE AGREED MONARCH MUST SHOW BETTER LEADERSHIP AND DETERMINATION IF HE IS TO SHAPE EVENTS HIS WAY AND REVIVE THE CENTER IN IRANIAN POLITICS. END SUMMARY.

OVER PAST TEN DAYS, NUMBER OF EMBOFFS HAVE NOTICED BASIC CHANGES IN ATTITUDES AMONG DIFFERENT CLASSES AND CATEGORIES OF INDIVIDUALS. WHAT FOLLOWS IS COMPILATION AND INITIAL ANALYSIS OF SOME CHANGES WHICH ARE BOUND TO AFFECT FUNDAMENTAL PERCEPTIONS OF POLITICS AND GOVERNMENT IN IRAN. WHILE THEY WILL UNDOUBTEDLY HAVE AN IMPACT IN THE SHORT RUN, PERHAPS THEIR GREATER IMPORTANCE IS IN FORESHADOWING CHANGED WAYS OF THINKING ABOUT POLITICS WHICH IN THE LONG RUN MAY ALTER THE POLITICAL SHAPE OF THE COUNTRY.

MOST SIGNIFICANT OF THESE IS WIDESPREAD, NEARLY UNIVERSAL PESSIMISM AMONG VIRTUALLY ALL GROUPS IN MODERN SECTOR OF SOCIETY ABOUT FUTURE OF COUNTRY AND GOVERNMENT. PUBLIC REFUSAL OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI TO COMPROMISE WITH GOI AND ECHOING VIEWS OF AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI (TEHRAN 10499) HAVE CREATED PESSIMISM ABOUT POSSIBILITY OF ENDING CURRENT UNREST AND POLITICAL CRISIS ANY TIME SOON ON TERMS WHICH WOULD ALLOW CONTINUED POLITICAL LIBERALIZATION. UPPER CLASS SUPPORTERS OF SHAH (INCLUDING SOME SENIOR GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS), WIDE RANGE OF BUSINESSMEN, PLUS SUBSTANTIAL NUMBERS OF IRAN'S MODERATE ACADEMIC "ESTABLISHMENT", BELIEVE THAT "END" OF PRESENT POLITICAL GAME IS LIKELY TO BE MILITARY RULE.

THERE IS WIDESPREAD AGREEMENT AMONG SUBSTANTIAL MEMBERS OF THOUGHTFUL PERSIANS THAT SHAH HAS NOT EXERCISED EFFECTIVE LEADERSHIP. HE HAS NOT EVEN TAKEN "OBVIOUS" OPPORTUNITY TO ADDRESS HIS POEPLE DIRECTLY ON TV AND DISCUSS ISSUES WITH THEM. HE SEEMS STILL TO THINK THE PEOPLE TOO IMMATURE FOR SERIOUS EXPLANATIONS. THIS IS PARALLELED BY A WILLINGNESS AMONG SIZABLE NUMBERS WHO HAVE SUPPORTED THE SHAH CONSISTENTLY AS IRAN'S BEST HOPE FOR THE FUTURE TO QUESTION WHETHER THE SHAH SHOULD REMAIN.

THEY DO NOT WISH TO DO HIM IN, BUT THEY SEE LITTLE HOPE TO BREAK THE DEMONSTRATION CYCLE IN ------------------074213 312024Z /14 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 1271 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR USCINCPAC SECTION 2 OF 3 TEHRAN 10621 PRESENT CIRCUMSTANCES. SOME WOULD EVEN CHANCE A REGENCY FOR THE CROWN PRINCE. THEY ARE, FOR THEM, "THINKING THE UNTHINKABLE" FOR THE FIRST TIME.

SUBSTANTIAL ELEMENT IN THIS PATTERN IS WIDESPREAD PERCEPTION BY GROUPS NOTED ABOVE PLUS CIVIL SERVANTS AND EVEN SOME MILITARY, THAT SHARIF-EMAMI GOVERNMENT IS BEING OVERTAKEN BY EVENTS. MORE IN SORROW THAN IN ANGER, SUBSTANTIAL NUMBERS OF BUREAUCRATS, YOUNG TECHNOCRATS, BUSINESSMEN AND OTHERS WITH LARGEST STAKE IN MODERNIZATION (WHICH GOI ITSELF HAS FOSTERED FOR PAST TWO DECADES) ARE CONCLUDING THAT SHARIF-EMAMI GOVERNMENT MUST GO. TOP ECHELON MINISTRY MEN NOTE WAY CROWDS HAVE "RAMPAGED AT WILL" THROUGH MINISTRIES FOR PAST FOUR OF FIVE DAYS, AND HAVE VIRTUALLY BROUGHT CERTAIN MINISTRIES' WORK TO A HALT.

THIS IS REINFORCED BY VIRTUALLY UNANIMOUS VIEW OF ALL POLITICIANS WHO THEMSELVES DO NOT HAVE DIRECT STAKE IN GOVERNMENT THAT SHARIF-EMAMI GOVERNMENT AND PRIME MINISTER HIMSELF ARE TOO BURDENED WITH PAST TO EVER BE ABLE TO PRESIDE OVER FREE ELECTIONS. FROM MODERATE POLITICIANS NOW ORGANIZING CENTRIST GROUPS (WHO AVOW SUPPORT FOR PRIMIN "AT LEAST UNTIL ELECTIONS") TO NATIONAL FRONTERS WHO CALL FOR "NEUTRAL" GOVERNMENT, THERE IS BELIEF THAT GOVERNMENTAL CHANGE MUST COME. ECHOING VIEW IS THAT ANY NEW TRANSITIONAL GOVERNMENT MUST CONTAIN AT LEAST SOME "NON-ESTABLISHMENT" POLITICIANS IN IT.

CORRUPTION ISSUE HAS BEEN WELL USED BY OPPONENTS OF REGIME TO DISCREDIT MANY IF NOT MOST POLITICIANS OF PAST FIVE TO SEVEN YEARS. EVEN POLITICIANS CLOSE TO PRESENT SCENE WILL RELUCTANTLY CONCLUDE IN PRIVATE THAT DAYS OF SHAH'S HANDPICKED GOVERNMENTS ARE PROBABLY GONE FOREVER. GOVERNMENT'S INABILITY TO RESTORE PUBLIC ORDER, MORE THAN ANY PRONOUNCEMENT ABOUT POLITICAL LIBERALIZATION, HAS TURNED MODERN IRAN INTO PARTICIPATORY STATE IN PUBLIC EYE.

(COMMENT: PROBLEM WITH THIS PERCEPTION IS THAT SUBSTANTIAL NUMBER OF PEOPLE, ESPECIALLY FORMERLY ALIENATED NON-POLITICALS AND OPPOSITIONISTS, BUT ALSO INCLUDING ESTABLISHMENT TYPES SUCH AS CIVIL SERVANTS, SEE EFFECTIVE POLITICAL ACTION NOW IN TERMS OF STRIKES AND DEMONSTRATIONS, NOT ORDERED PARTICIPATION IN ELECTION OF PUBLIC OFFICIALS.)

ANOTHER NEW PERCEPTION, WHICH HAS COME AS A RATHER UNPLEASANT SURPRISE TO GOVERNMENT, SECULAR OPPOSITION, AND MODERNIZERS OF ALL STRIPES IS REALIZATION THAT RELIGIOUS LEADERS AND ESPECIALLY EX-TUDEH (COMMUNIST) SUPPORTERS ARE MUCH BETTER ORGANIZERS THAN ANYONE IMAGINED. VIRTUALLY ALL ACADEMICS AGREE THAT MAJOR IRANIAN UNIVERSITY STUDENT BODIES ARE BEING POLARIZED ABOUT 70-30 BETWEEN STUDENTS ADHERING TO ISLAMIC AND COMMUNIST ORGANIZATIONS RESPECTIVELY. UNDERGROUND ORGANIZATION OF TUDEH HAS SURFACED WITHIN PAST WEEK AT VIRTUALLY ALL UNIVERSITIES (INCLUDING AMERICAN-FOUNDED DAMAVAND COLLEGE FOR GIRLS, WHICH HAS NEVER HAD A SERIOUS DEMONSTRATION BEFORE THIS YEAR) FOR UNIVERSITY REFORMS AND FULL INDEPENDENCE FOR GOI.

NUMBER OF OUR BEST ACADEMIC SOURCES HAVE SUGGESTED THAT MIDDLE GROUP HAS EVAPORATED ON UNIVERSITY CAMPUSES AND STUDENTS ARE BEING DRAWN TO ONE OF TWO POLES, NEITHER OF WHICH REALLY WANTS SETTLEMENT UNDER PRESENT GOI. THIS HAS, UNDERSTANDABLY, DEPRESSED MANY, AND IN MANY CASES CREATED EXTREMELY VISCERAL REACTIONS AGAINST WHAT IS BELIEVED TO BE UNWISE AMERICAN HUMAN RIGHTS POLICY WHICH HAS "FORCED" IRAN TO PRESENT SUTUATION. OTHERS REGARD U.S. AS TRAITOR TO IRANIAN PEOPLE FOR FAILING TO PRESS HOME CAMPAIGN FOR HUMAN RIGHTS, THEREBY LEAVING COUNTRY IN PRESENT MESS.

CLEARLY ONE CASUALTY OF CURRENT UNREST IN IRAN HAS BEEN OBJECTIVE, UNEMOTIONAL ANALYSIS BY VERY GROUP--PROFESSORS--WHICH MIGHT HAVE BEEN ABLE TO PROVIDE STABILIZING LEADERSHIP UNDER OTHER CIRCUMSTANCES.

IF PEOPLE PERCEIVE THAT RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP IS CAPABLE OF KEEPING PEOPLE IN STREETS AGAINST WILL OF GOVERNMEFT, ALTERNATIVE HAS INCREASINGLY COME TO BE SEEN AS MILITARY GOVERNMENT. OPPOSITIONISTS WOULD PREFER DEPARTURE OF SHAH, BUT SUSPECT THIS WILL NOT HAPPEN VOLUNTARILY. SUPPORTERS OF THE SHAH SEE IRAN'S FIRST NEED AS SOCIAL ORDER. BOTH NOW TEND TO PERCEIVE INEVITABILITY OF MILITARY GOVERNMENT WITH OVERWHELMING PROBABILITY IT WILL BE HARD-LINE AFFAIR, ENDING DOMESTIC POLITICAL LIBERALIZATION AND PROVOKING GREATER ORGANIZED TERRORIST ACTIVITY.

PRO-MONARCHISTS SEE ------------------074006 312025Z /14 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 1272 INFO AMVEMBAVSSY ABU DHABI 1052 AMEMBASSY ANVKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR USCINCPAC SECTION 3 OF 3 TEHRAN 10621 THIS AS REGRETTABLE NECESSITY TO PRESERVE MODERN SOCIAL AND ECONOMIC FABRIC; OPPOSITIONISTS VIEW IT AS TRAGEDY FOR COUNTRY AND REGRESSIVE FASCISM WHICH WILL OPEN OPPORTUNITIES FOR TERRORISM.

MANY GOVERNMENTAL AND INDUSTRIAL SECTOR EMPLOYEES, ESPECIALLY BANKERS AND ECONOMIC PLANNERS, SEE CURRENT RASH OF STRIKES SLOWLY STRANGLING COUNTRY WITH NO "WAY OUT." PRIVATELY, MANY SAY SHARIF-EMAMI POLICY OF LETTING MOBS VENT FEELING HAS GONE BEYOND HOPE OF SUCCESS TO DISRUPT ON OF BOTH ECONOMY AND SOCIAL FABRIC. OIL PRODUCTION IS DOWN, FACTORIES ARE IDLE AND INFRASTRUCTURE PROJECTS SUCH AS KHUZISTAN SUGAR PLANATION COMPLEX WILL BE IN RUINS AFTER MONTH OR SO OF NEGLECT. MANY FEEL (AND ARE NOW READY TO DISCUSS WITH THEIR FRIENDS) THAT SOME SORT OF BASIC CHANGE IS NECESSARY.
WHILE PERHAPS NOT YET READY TO SERIOUSLY ADVOCATE NEW GOVERNMENT OR REGIME, THEY ARE NOW LISTENING SERIOUSLY TO OPPOSITION ANALYSIS THAT SIX MONTHS AGO WOULD HAVE BEEN CONSIDERED BALDERDASH.

FOLLOWERS OF PERSIAN SCENE WHO ARE USED TO MANICDEPRESSIVE NATURE OF PERSIAN POLITICAL THOUGH MAY TEND TO ASCRIBE FEATURES DESCRIBED ABOVE TO STANDARD TO-ING AND FRO-ING OF PEOPLE UNUSED TO DEMOCRATIC RHETORIC AND PARTICIPARTORY PROBLEMS. SHIFTS IN ATTITUDES GO DEEPER THAN THAT, HOWEVER, TO QUESTIONNING OF BASIC ASSUMPTION OF PAST 15 YEARS THAT SHAH IS TOUGH, UNCHALLENGEABLE LEADER WHO IS EFFECTIVE LEADER OF COUNTRY. FEELING THAT POLITICAL PROCESS IS AT DEADEND HAS PRODUCED SENSE OF FRUSTRATION WHICH MAY ULTIMATELY BE MORE DAMAGING TO STABILITY OF IRANIAN PUBLIC OPINION THAN MERE FACTS OF PRESENT UNREST.

OVERWHELMING BULK OF IRANIANS OF ALL CLASSES, EVEN HIS OPPONENTS, SEEM TO BE WAITING FOR SHAH TO DO SOMETHING. HABIT OF WAITING FOR THE TOP TO ACT IS HARD TO ERADICATE. SEVERAL PERCEPTIVE PERSIAN OBSERVERS HAVE NOTED THAT ESTABLISHMENT FIGURES SEEM TO BE WAITING AROUND FOR SHAH TO "GIVE THE NOD" TO SOME GROUP OR GROUPS TO BEGIN OPERATING ON HIS BEHALF WITHIN POLITICAL ARENA. EFFECT OF THIS "WAITING FOR GODOT" ATTITUDE I THAT MYRIAD OF NEW POLITICAL PARTIES LACK IMPACT. VIRTUALLY EVERYONE, ESPECIALLY VAST MAJORITY OF THOSE WHO MIGHT BE CONSIDERED PART OF POLITICAL CENTER, ARE TOOKING FOR LEADERSHIP, HOPEFULLY FROM THE THRONE.

EVEN OPPOSITIONISTS FEEL THEY HAVE TO HAVE SOMETHING TO OPPOSE AND THEY SEE THIS AS SHAH AND HIS POLICIES, NOT GOVERNMENT. FOR BOTH SYMBOLIC AND PRACTICAL REASONS, SHAH'S FAILURE TO ACT DECISIVELY (IN FULFILLMENT OF PERSIAN STEREOTYPE), OR EVEN APPEAR ON TV AND ADDRESS HIS PEOPLE, HAS LED TO MORE QUESTIONING, LESS SECURE ATTITUDE AMONG VIRTUALLY ALL SECTORS OF PUBLIC OPINION.

EVEN IF ORDER IS RESTORED SHORTLY WITHOUT A MOVE TO MILITARY GOVERNMENT, MOST PERSIANS FEEL SHAH MUST DO BETTER TO SURVIVE. FOR FIRST TIME IN TWO DECADES SERIOUS COFFEEHOUSE THOUGHT IS BE NG GIVEN TO OTHER POSSIBILITIES. LACK OF DIRECT ACTION THUS FAR BY THOSE WHO DO NOT OPPOSE SHAH AND BY MAN WHO DO OENERALLY REFLECTS ONE ASSUMPTION FROM PAST THAT REMAINS: THERE IS NO VIABLE ALTERNATIVE TO SHAH. FOR THIS REASON, EVEN MANY OPPOSITIONISTS THUS FAR REMAIN WILLING TO LIVE WITH HIM, ALBEIT AS THE LESSER OF EVILS. HOWEVER , THIS ASSUMPTION TOO IS COMING UNDER INCREASING CHALLENGE.
DURING DISCUSSION WHICH BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND I HAD WITH SHAH ON "COALITION GOVERNMENT" OCT 31 AS REPORTED REFTEL, WE MADE TWO POINTS IN COMMENT ON HIS PROPOSALS.

WE HAD NO RPT NO ASSURANCE THAT THE POLITICAL FIGURES HE INTENDS TO INCLUDE IN THE COALITION HAVE THE INFLUENCE NEEDED TO RESTORE LAW AND ORDER, OR TO SETTLE STRIKES AND GET THE UNIVERSITIES OPEN. THEY WERE SPEAKING THE SAME LANGUAGE AS THE DISSIDENTS, BUT WE COULD NOT BE SURE THAT THEY WERE LEADERS, RATHER THAN FOLLOWERS.

WE AGAIN EMPHASIZED THE IMPORTANCE OF BRINGING A POLITICAL FOCUS ON THE ELECTION PROCESS AS A POSITIVE GOAL FOR ACTIVISTS. WE FELT THAT THE SHAH HIMSELF WOULD PROBABLY HAVE TO REITERATE THAT PUBLICLY AT THE TIME ANY SUCH GOVERNMENT MIGHT BE INSTALLED.

SHAH ACCEPTED VALIDITY OF BOTH THESE COMMENTS. HE FELT THE DRAMATIC CHANGE EMBODIED IN A "COALITION GOVERNMENT" WOULD BE SEEN AS A "180 DEGREE TURN" WHICH WOULD ATTRACT FOLLOWERS. AS FOR THE ELECTION PROCESS, HE AGREED IT WOULD HAVE HIS PERSONAL BLESSING.

COMMENT: I HAVE NO RPT NO DEFINITIVE FEEL FOR THE LINKS BETWEEN THE NATIONAL FRONT POLITICIANS AND THE CROWDS IN THE STREETS. STRUCTURALLY, THEY DO NOT RPT NOT EXIST. THEREFORE, ANY POPULAR RESPONSE TO THE SORT OF GOVERNMENT THE SHAH PROPOSES WOULD HAVE TO BE PSYCHOLOGICAL AND SPONTANEOUS. THIS IS A RATHER THIN THREAD. I ALSO HAVE NO RPT NO FEEL FOR THE WILLINGNESS OF THE FRONT TO ACCEPT AN AGED FIGUREHEAD LIKE ENTEZAM, ALTHOUGH THE SHAH CLAIMS TO HAVE VALID INDICATIONS PASSED THROUGH JAMSHID AMOUZEGAR. ON BALANCE, THEREFORE, THIS TACTIC PROPOSED BY THE SHAH IS PRETTY IFFY.

IN MY MORE CYNICAL MOMENTS, I ENTERTAIN THE SUSPICION THE BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND I MAY BE GETTING CONNED INTO A SITUATION IN WHICH A PROPOSITION WHICH WE HAVE AGREED IS A GOOD FAITH EFFORT COLLAPSES OF ITS OWN INADEQUACY AND A MILITARY SOLUTION IS THEN PRESENTED AS THE ONLY ALTERNATIVE. WE BOTH AGREE THAT THE SHAH APPEARS TO BE SINCERE; BUT, IF I WERE BACK IN SOUTHEAST ASIA, I WOULD HAVE MY DOUBTS. THE PROBLEM IS THAT WE HAVE NO RPT NO IMAGINATIVE SURE-FIRE ALTERNATIVES TO PROPOSE OURSELVES.

1978TEHRAN10653.subject: TALKS WITH SENIOR IRANIAN MILITARY OFFICERS

segments.text: FOLLOWING UP EARLIER CONVERSATION (REFTEL), GENERAL GAST, CHIEF, ARMISH/MAAG, DISCUSSED ON OCT 30-NOV 1 IRAN'S INTERNAL POLITICAL SITUATION WITH FOUR MOST SENIOR IRANIAN OFFICERS: GENERAL AZHARI, CHEIF, SUPREME COMMANDER'S STAFF; GENERAL OVEISI, COMMANDER GROUND FORCES; ADMIRAL HABIBOLLAHI, NAVY COMMANDER; AND GENERAL RABII, AIR FORCE COMMANDER.

ALL FOUR WERE OPEN AND FRIENDLY IN THE SEPARATE CONVERSATIONS AND GENERALLY MORE OPTIMISTIC ABOUT IRAN'S SITUATION THAN HAD BEEN CASE IN CONVERSATIONS REPORTED REFTEL. COMMON THEMES WERE SERIOUSNESS OF DOMESTIC SITUATION, COMMUNIST INVOLVEMENT IN RIOTS AND STRIKES, LIBERALIZATION STEPS HAD MOVED AHEAD TOO QUICKLY, COUNTRY WILL SURELY SURVIVE. ALL NOTED THAT LAST RESORT WOULD BE MILITARY RULE. IN THAT CONNECTION, THEY WOULD OBEY THE SHAH.

AZHARI AND OVEISI WERE ESPECIALLY RELAXED, EVEN THOUGH MAKING ABOVE POINTS. AZHARI DESCRIBED HIS MEETING DAY BEFORE WITH PRIME MINISTER AND HIS DESIRE TO HELP LATTER OFFICIAL. RABII AND HABIBOLLAHI WERE LESS PATIENT AND UNDERSTANDING OF LOCAL SITUATION THAN TWO OLDER OFFICERS. BOTH REFERRED TO POSSIBLE OPTION OF ORGANIZING PATRIOTIC RESISTANCE GROUPS, BUT OVEISI COMMENDTED HE HAD TURNED AWAY APPROCHES TO HIM ON THAT SUBJECT.

OFFICERS CLEARLY HAD STRIKE AT OIL FIELDS IN FOREFRONT OF THEIR MINDS. HABIBOLLAHI THOUGH ARMED FORCES COULD RUN FIELDS IF NECESSARY. OVEISI SAID DISMISSAL OF POLITICALLY-ORIENTED STRIKE LEADERS WOULD END THE STRIKE.

WHEN I MET WITH ANSARY EVENING OCTOBER 31 TO DISCUSS OIL STRIKE (SEPTEL) HE SAID HE HAD HELD LONG DISCUSSION WITH SHAH THAT AFTERNOON ON POLITICAL SITUATION. SHAH HAD INFORMED HIM OF HIS CONVERSATION WITH BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND MYSELF AND OF HIS INTENTION TO FORM "COALITION" GOVT.

ANSARY SAID HE HAD REACTED VERY CAUTIOUSLY TO SHAH'S PROPOSAL AND HAD EXPRESSED DOUBTS THE COALITION WOULD WORK. HE SAID HE HAD NO ASSURANCES THE NATIONAL FRONT TYPES COULD CONTROL THE MOBS. HE FELT ENTEZAM WAS TOO OLD, ALTHOUGH HE ADMITTED HE WAS ONE OF THE FEW PERSONS ACCEPTABLE TO EVERYBODY. HOWEVER, HE FELT A COALITION WOULD BE ROCKED BY INTERNAL BICKERING AND ENTEZAM WOULD BE UNABLE TO CONTROL THAT.

FINALLY, HE SAID, THE CABINET WOULD NEED SOME PEOPLE WHO COULD RUN THE ECONOMY. NONE OF THE NATIONAL FRONT FIGURES HAD ANY EXPERIENCE IN THIS FIELD. HE SAID THESE OBSERVATIONS SEEMED TO GIVE THE SHAH SOME "SECOND THOUGHTS."

I SAID THE SHAH SEEMED DETERMINED TO GO THROUGH WITH HI PROPOSAL. WHILE BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND I HAD EXPRESSED SOME OF SAME CAUTIONS, SHAH SEEMED TO FEEL THAT PSYCHOLOGICAL IMPACT OF HIS PROPOSAL WOULD CARRY IT.
ANSARY ADMITTED THIS AND SAID THAT, AS HE WAS LEAVING NIAVARAN PALACE, ENTEZAM WAS ENTERING. THE PROJECT WAS, THEREFORE, PRESUMABLY ALREADY IN PLAY.
COMMENT: I AM MEETING ANSARY AGAIN NOVEMBER 1. AT THAT TIME, I WILL ENCOURAGE HIM TO PUT FORWARD NAMES OF COMPETENT ECONOMIC ADMINISTRATORS WHO MIGHT BE ACCEPTABLE IN A COALITION.

WHEN I MET WITH NIOC CHAIRMAN ANSARY AT NOON NOVEMBER 1, WE QUICKLY AGREED THAT SHAH WAS DETERMINED TO MOVE AHEAD WITH HIS COALITION CONCEPT AND OUR CURRENT EFFORT SHOULD BE TO COUNSEL HIM ON MAKING IT AS EFFECTIVE AS POSSIBLE. TO THAT END, WE CANVASSED NAMES WHICH MIGHT BE PROPOSED BY ANSARY TO SHAH TO HANDLE ECONOMIC MATTERS IN SUCH A CABINET.

OUR CONSENSUS CAME TO REST ON MEHDI SAMII, CURRENTLY HEAD OF AGRICULTURAL DEVELOPMENT BANK AND AT ONE TIME HEAD OF MINISTRY OF PLANNING. SAMII HAS REPUTATION FOR INTEGRITY, ENJOYS BROAD RESPECT, AND IS WELL KNOWN INTERNATIONALLY. MOREEOVER, HE IS ASSOCIATED IN PUBLIC MIND WITH RURAL DEVELOPMENT, WHICH WOULD PRESUMABLY BE MAJOR THRUST IN NEW GOVT. ANSARY WILL PUT HIS NAME TO SHAH AFTERNOON NOVEMBER 1.

AS OF EARLY AFTERNOON NOVEMBER 1, DIPLOMATIC COMMUNITY IS AWASH WITH RUMORS OF IMPENDING POLITICAL CHANGE, BUT WITHOUT MUCH CLUE AS TO ITS DIRECTION. GERMANS, AND OTHER VOLATILE TYPES ARE PREDICTING MILITARY GOVT. INDIAN AND TURKISH AMBASSADORS HAVE BOTH URGED ME TO INTERVENE WITH SHAH TO PREVENT TURNOVER TO MILITARY. I ASSUME THE EMTEZAM PLOY WILL BE LEAKING SOON.

ANSARY ALSO TELLS ME THAT ALI-AMINI HAS HAD A LONG AUDIENCE WITH SHAH, BUT APPARENTLY SHAH HAS NOT CONFIDED IN HIM THAT AMINI IS HIS FALLBACK SOLUTION IF ENTEZAM DECLINES. AMINI MAY BE SOURCE OF DIPLOMATIC GOSSIP.
