1978TEHRAN10668.subject: IRAN AIR STRIKE THREATENS CLOSURE OF MEHRABAD INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT

segments.text: INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT

IRAN AIR PERSONNEL AT MEHRABAD INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT WENT ON TOTAL STRIKE MORNING NOVEMBER ONE. WE HAVE BEEN ADVISED BY PANAM MANAGMENT THAT, SINCE FOREIGN AIRLINES LARGELY SERVICED BY IRAN AIR GROUND PERSONNEL, IT IS LIKELY THAT ALL RPT ALL OUTGOING FLIGHTS WILL CEASE BY LATE EVENING NOVEMBER ONE AND FOREIGN AIRLINES WILL BE FORCED TO OVERFLY TEHRAN. CONTROL TOWER AND OTHER FLIGHT CONNECTED SERVICES STILL FUNCTIONING AND AIRCRAFT LANDING AT MEHRABAD ARE IN NO DANGER.

PANAM ACTING DIRECTOR FOR IRAN AND AFGHANISTAN MALONE ADVISED EMBOFF THAT DIRECTOR OF CIVIL AVIATION TOLD HIM MORNING ONE NOVEMBER THAT STRIKE IS POLITICAL IN NATURE AND THUS WILL BE DIFFICULT TO SOLVE. DIRGEN ASSURED MALONE THAT ALL NECESSARY STEPS WOULD BE TAKEN TO SEE THAT AIRLINE PASSENGERS NOTHARASSED BY STRIKERS.

1978TEHRAN10671.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT, NOV 1 SUMMARY: POLICE AND SECURITY FORCES HAVE BEEN INSTRUCTED TO TAKE ORDERS FROM MINISTRY OF JUSTICE. TROOPS GUAR

segments.text: SUMMARY: POLICE AND SECURITY FORCES HAVE BEEN INSTRUCTED TO TAKE ORDERS FROM MINISTRY OF JUSTICE. TROOPS GUARDING OIL INSTALLATIONS DURING VIRTUAL SHUTDOWN. IRAN AIR SHUT DOWN, OTHER AIRLINES AFFECTED. DEMONSTRATIONS THROUGHOUT IRAN WITH 15 NEW DEATHS REPORTED. INCREASED APPEARANCE OF PROGOVT DEMONSTRATORS WHO HAVE CLASED WITH PROTESTORS. INFORMATION MINISTER DENIES SUPPORT FOR VIOLENT PROGOVT FORCES. STUDENTS IN AMOL HAVE MADE CITIZENS ARRESTS, PROMISING TO FORM CITIZENS COURTS IF FURTHER "POLICE STOOGES" TRY TO ENTER AMOL. GOVT HAS TAKEN OVER RED LION AND SUN AND IMPERIAL ORGANIZATION FOR SOCIAL SERVICES. END SUMMARY.

PRIMIN SHARIF-EMAMI HAS INSTRUCTED CHIEFS OF POLICE, GENDARMERIE AND SAVAK THAT THESE FORCES WILL HENCEFORTH CARRY OUT ORDERS OF MINISTRY OF JUSTICE. THIS HAS NOT BEEN THE CASE PREVIOUSLY. (COMMENT: ACTION COINCIDES WITH MANY STATEMENTS THAT KEY TO REFORM IS TO INCREASE POWER OF JUDICIARY.)

TROOPS BEGAN GUARDING PERSIAN GULF OIL INSTALLATIONS YESTERDAY AMID VIRTUAL SHUTDOWN. (COMMENT: ARRIVAL OF CIVIL UNREST AT IRAN'S ECONOMIC HEART HAS RAISED PUBLIC APPREHENSION THAT SERIOUS CRISIS IS AT HAND.) PRIMIN HAS TRIED TO FOCUS ATTENTION ON INSTRIGATORS OF STRIKE. ALI AMINI'S MANE HAS AGAIN COME UP IN MAJLIS AS TOOL OF OIL CONSORTIUM AND SOMEHOW PREPRETRATOR OF OIL DIFFICULTIES.

IRAN AIR DTIKE, WHICH STARTED YESTERDAY WITH BAGGAGE HANDLERS, HAS SPREAD TO ALL PERSONNEL AND SHUT DOWN ALL SERVICE. STRIKE WILL PROBABLY FORCE SUSPENSION OF ALL FLIGHTS IN AN OUT OF TEHRAN AS OTHER AIRLINES DEPEND ON IRAN AIR GROUND SUPPORT PERSONNEL.

DAILY ROUND OF DEMONSTRATIONS BROUGH REPORT OF 15 NEW DEATHS. HOTTEST SPOTS WERE SANANDAJ AND AZARSHAHR. TEHRAN UNIVERSITY HAD LARGE RALLY WITH "TEACH IN" BY DISSIDENT SAYED JAVADI. ISFAHAN REPORTS MLA THERE HAS FOR PAST FEW DAYS ISSUED PERMITS FOR DEMONSTRATIONS. THUS SEVERAL DEMONSTRATIONS (THROUGH NOT ALL) IN ISFAHAN HAVE BEEN LEGAL, THE FIRST SUCH SINCE MARTIAL LAW WAS DECLARED.

APPEARANCE OF BELLICOSE PROGOVT GROUPS HAS INCREASED, AND POPULATION, ESPECIALLY IN SOUTH, FEARS ARRIVAL OF MANY MORE. THESE AMOUNT, IN PUBLIC MIND, TO TRIBAL RAIDS ON CITY-DWELLERSM PROGOVT FORCES DID CLASH WITH PROTESTORS IN SANANDAJ, ZANJAN, AND BAM. SIZABLE PORTION OF THESE GROUPS PROBABLY BELONG TO TRIBES, WHICH ARE LOYAL TO SHAH AND ARE SUNNI RATHER THAN SHIITE, SO THAT THEY CARE LITTLE FOR PROBLEMS OF SHIITE HIERARCHY. CITIZENS OF PAVEH HAVE ASKED DISMISSAL OF THEIR MAJLIS DEPUTY SALARJOF, WHO IS NA IMPORTANT KURDISH CLAN LEADER. THEY BELIEVE HIM TO BE BEHIND THE RECENT WILD WEST RAID ON THEIR TOWN BY RPOGOVT TRIBESMEN.

IN AMOL, STUDENTS PARTROL STREET AT NIGHT, WATCHING FOR PROGOVT "OUTSIDERS". THEY ARRESTED SIX SUCH SUSPECTS LAST NIGHT, ANNOUNCED THESE WERE SECURITY MEN, AND TURNED THEM OVER TO JUSTICE AUTHORITIES. BUT THEY HAVE WARNED THAT, IF THEY FIND FURTHER CULPRITS, THEY WILL TRY THEM IN A "NATIONAL (EXTRALEGAL) COURT." MEANWHILE MINISTER OF INFORMATION AMELI STATED GOVT DOES NOT WANT CLUB-WIELDING GROUPS TO TAKE ACTION ON BEHLAF OF REGIME. GOVT WELCOMES SHOW OF SUPPORT, HE SAID, PROVIDED IT IS PEACEFUL AND LEGAL.

AS COURT MINISTER ARDALAN HAD PREVIOUSLY INDICATED GOVT IS MOVING TO TAKE OVER PRIVATE ORGANIZATIONS THAT WERE CONSIDERED POSSIBLE SOURCE OF CORRUPTION. CABINET VOTED TO ASSUME CONTROL OF RED LION AND SUN (IRANIAN RED CROSS) AND IMPERIAL ORGANIZATION FOR SOCIAL SERVICES. BOTH RECEIVE PUBLIC FUNDS, AND IOSS IN ADDITION RECEIVES INCOME FROM NATIONAL LOTTERY. BOTH WILL COME UNDER MINISTER OF HEALTH.

BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND I MET FOR OVER TWO HOURS WITH SHAH EVENING NOV (OMISSION) HE TOLD US HE HAD MET WITH ENTEZAM OCTOBER 31 AND THAT LATTER HAD RELUCTANTLY ACCEPTED MANDATE TO HEAD COALITION GOVERNMENT. HOWEVER, WHEN HE HAD CONTACTED BAHKTIAR OF NATIONAL FRONT, THROUGH AMOUZEGAR, HE HAD ENCOUNTERED RUDE SHOCK.

HE SAID BAHKTIAR HAD INFORMED AMOUZEGAR THAT NATIONAL FRONT HAD REACHED AGREEMENT WITH AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI THAT FRONT COULD ENTER GOVERNMENTAL ARRANGEMENT WITH SHAH ONLY ON CONDITION THAT SHAH WOULD SUBMIT QUESTION OF MONARCHY TO NATIONAL REFERENDUM WITHIN ONE YEAR. THEREFORE, FRONT WOULD JOIN COALITION WITH ENTEZAM ONLY ON THOSE TERMS.

SHAH SAID HE WOULD NEVER ACCEPT SUCH TERMS AND, THEREFORE, HIS WHOLE PLAN SEEMED UP IN AIR. I URGED HIM TO IGNORE BAHKTIAR STATEMENT AND TO CALL IN NATIONAL FRONT ANYWAY, TO CONFRONT THEM WITH HIS ANALYSIS OF SITUATION, PARTICULARLY AS IT CONCERNED POSSIBLE MILITARY GOVERNMENT, AND TO ASK THEM UNCONDITIONALLY TO JOIN COALITION. IN DUE COURSE, HE AGREED TO THIS. BUT ASKED THAT I REINFORCE HIS APPEAL TO NATIONAL FRONT THROUGH OTHER CHANNELS, WHICH I HAVE SUBSEQUENTLY DONE.

HE THEN ASKED WHAT WE THOUGHT HE SHOULD DO IF NATIONAL FRONT INSISTS ON UNACCEPTABLE CONDITIONS. WE DISCUSSED ALI-AMINI OPTION AT SOME LENGTH AND AGREED IT WAS PROBABLY NON-STARTER. BRITISH AMBASSADOR THEN SUGGESTED THAT HE SHOULD THINK IN TERMS OF A TOTALLY NEUTRAL, RESPECTABLY ACCEPTABLE GOVERNMENT FOR THE SOLE PURPOSE OF HOLDING ELECTIONS. AFTER MUCH DISCUSSION, HE AGREED THIS WAS PROBABLY HIS ONLY ALTERNATIVE.

ONCE AGAIN HE REHEARSED PRESSURES FROM MILITARY TO FORM MILITARY GOVERNMENT AND HIS RESERVATIONS ABOUT THIS COURSE OF ACTION. HE SAID, HOOWEVER, THAT HE FELT HE HAD ONLY FEW DAYS IN WHICH HE COULD HOLD OFF THIS OPTION. HE SAID MANY PEOPLE, INCLUDING HIS MILITARY, PROBABLY CONSIDERED HIM COWARDLY OR INDECISIVE FOR FAILING TO TAKE THE MILITARY COURSE OF ACTION. HE WONDERED HOW HISTORY WOULD JUDGE HIM. BOTH BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND I ASSURED HIM THAT IN WASHINGTON AND LONDON HIS STAND WAS VIEWED AS PRUDENT AND COURAGEOUS (HIP, HIP, HOORAY)

THERE WAS THEN QUITE A BIT OF DIGRESSION IN OUR TALKS, INCLUDING A TELEPHONE CALL FROM ARDESHIR ZAHEDI AND THE CROWN PRINCE, BEFORE WE SETTLED ON A FINAL ACCOUNTING. THIS AMOUNTED TO AN AGREEMENT THAT (A) THE CURRENT GOVERNMENT COULD NOT HACK IT (HE SAID PRIME MINISTER HAD AGREED THIS MORNING) (B) A COALITION UNDER EMTEZAM WAS THE NEXT BEST COURSE (C) IF THE COALITION COULD NOT BE FORMED, HE WOULD TRY TO DEVELOP A NEUTRAL GOVERNMENT FOR THE SOLE PURPOSE OF HOLDING ELECTIONS.

THIS WHOLE DRILL HAS BECOME COMPLICATED BY THE FACT THAT IRAN AIR HAS GONE ON STRIKE AND INTERNATIONAL CARRIERS FROM WESTERN EUROPE ARE HAVING DIFFICULTIES LANDING AT TEHRAN. MOST OF THE NATIONAL FRONT ARE SCATTERED IN PARIS, LONDON, ETC, AND MAY BE DIFFICULT TO REGROUP. WITH TIME OF THE ESSENCE, THIS BLOWS IT FAIRLY CLOSE TO THE WIND.

1978TEHRAN10698.subject: MORE ON AUDIENCE WITH SHAH, NOVEMBER I

segments.text: DURING OUR AUDIENCE WITH SHAH EVENING NOVEMBER 1, BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND I DETECTED FIRST SIGNS THAT HE MIGHT BE THINKING OF ABDICATION. IN DISCUSSING PROPOSAL WHICH NATIONAL FRONT HAS FLOATED ABOUT A REFERENDUM ON THE ISSUE OF THE MONARCHY, SHAH SAID HE WOULD RATHER "LEAVE THE COUNTRY THAN SUBMIT TO THAT."

IF NATIONAL FRONT INSISTS UPON THIS CONDITION, AND THEREFORE REFUSES TO JOIN A COALITION GOVT, SHAH HAS AGREED TO MOVE TOWARDS A TOTALLY NEUTRAL GOVT WHOSE SOLE PURPOSE WOULD BE TO PREPARE AND SUPERVISE GENERAL ELECTIONS. HOWEVER, SUCH ELECTIONS COULD BE HELD ONLY IF TURMOIL SUBSIDES.

BBC PERSIAN LANGUAGE BROADCAST THIS MORNING IS ALREADY CARRYING THE REFERENDUM PROPOSAL, PRESUMABLY GIVEN TO THEM BY THE NATIONAL FRONT. IT COULD THEREFORE DEVELOP THAT THIS PROPOSAL, RATHER THAN GENERAL ELECTIONS, WOULD BECOME THE FOCUS OF POLITICAL DEMANDS. IF THIS PROVES TO BE THE CASE, IT SEEMS DOUBTFUL THAT A NEUTRAL GOVERNMENT COULD SUBLIMATE THE TURMOIL IN ORDER TO HOLD GENERAL ELECTIONS.

IN ANY EVENT, WE WILL BE FACED WITH THE BOTTOM-LINE DILEMMA. IF THE SHAH STAYS, HE CAN ONLY ATTEMPT TO GOVERN THROUGH THE MILITARY. IF HE LEAVES, THE MILITARY CAN BE EXPECTED TO TAKE OVER IN A COUP WITHOUT THE SHAH. IN MY JUDGMENT, A MILITARY GOVERNMENT WITHOUT THE SHAH WOULD BE REPRESSIVE, BRUTAL, AND TOTALLY UNIMAGINATIVE. THEY WOULD ABANDON TOTALLY ANY PLANS FOR LIBERALIZATION AND WOULD SET THE CLOCK BACK ON DEMOCRACY. TERRORISM, SABOTAGE, AND SULLEN DESPERATION WOULD RESULT.

IF THE SHAH STAYS AND ATTEMPTS TO GOVERN THROUGH THE MILITARY, HE WILL AT LEAST HAVE THE INTELLECTUAL CONVICTION THAT IT IS A SHORT-TERM FIX AND WILL ATTEMPT TO GET BACK ON THE LIBERALIZATION PATH AGAIN. HE SAYS THAT HE WOULD TRY, AS SOON AS POSSIBLE, TO GO THROUGH WITH THE GENERAL ELECTIONS EVEN THOUGH HE REALIZES THAT MAY PROVE IMPOSSIBLE.

I FEEL WE NEED TO ANTICIPATE A MEETING IN THE NEAR FUTURE IN WHICH THE SHAH REPORTS THAT NONE OF HIS EFFORTS AT A POLITICAL SOLUTION WILL WORK AND THAT HE NEEDS TO DECIDE WHETHER TO ABDICATE AND TURN THE COUNTRY OVER TO THE MILITARY OR TO IMPOSE MILITARY GOVERNMENT UNDER HIS CONTINUING RULE. HE WOULD DOUBTLESS SAY THAT HE WOULD STAY AS THE RULER ONLY IF THE U.S. AND U.K. SAY THEY WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT HIM.

THIS IS A DECISION WHICH PROBABLY HAS TO BE MADE FOR THE UNITED STATES BY THE PRESIDENT. I CERTAINLY CANNOT RPT NOT COMMIT OUR GOVERNMENT ON MY OWN AUTHORITY. THEREFORE, I SHALL NEED CONTINGENCY GUIDANCE SOONEST. I HAVE NOT RPT NOT DISCUSSED THIS WITH BRITISH AMBASSADOR.

IN THE MEANTIME, I SHALL CONTINUE TO DO WHAT I CAN TO PERSUADE THE NATIONAL FRONT POLITICIANS TO KEEP THEIR DEMANDS WITHIN THE FRAMEWORK OF THE CONSTITUTION. THIS EFFORT HAS TO GO FORWARD SILENTLY, EVEN CLANDESTINELY, AND WE CANNOT RPT NOT TAKE A PUBLIC POSTURE, OR WE WILL DESTROY THE WHOLE EFFORT BY STIGMATIZING THESE ESSENTIALLY MODERATE POLITICIANS AS BEING TOOLS OF U.S. INFLUENCE.
AT THE RATE THINGS ARE MOVING HERE, I BELIEVE THE DECISION POINT MAY BE REACHED WITHIN THE NEXT FORTY-EIGHT HOURS. I WOULD THEREFORE APPRECIATE GUIDANCE WITHIN THAT TIME-FRAME.

ZAHEDI TELEPHONED SHAH WHILE I WAS AT PALACE NOV 1 AND SUGGESTED TACTIVS CONTAINED REFTEL. SHAH CUT HIM OFF SHORT WITH STATEMENT THAT THIS WAS NOT RPT NOT 1953 AND WAS NOT EVEN SAME SITUATION THAT EXISTED TWO WEEKS AGO WHEN ZAHEDI WAS HERE.

THERE HAVE BEEN SOME SUGGESTIONS THAT ZAHEDI WAS BEHIND EVENTS IN KERMAN ABOUT TWO WEEKS AGO WHERE MOSQUE WAS ATTACKED AND NUMBER OF PEOPLE KILLED. WHOLE INCIDENT BADLY BACKFIRED. NEVERTHELESS, A KURDISH TRIBAL LEADER (WHO IS A MEMBER OF THE PARLIAMENT) IS ACCUSED OF INSTIGATING A BLOODY ATTACK BY TRUCKLOADS OF HIS PEOPLE ON THE LITTLE KURDISH TOWN OF PAVEH A FEW DAYS AGO LEAVING 11 DEAD BY OFFICIAL ADMISSION. THE SAME GOVERNMENT SUPPORTERS THREATENED TO ATTACK THE PROVINCIAL CENTER OF KERMANSHAH THE NEXT DAY UNTIL PREVENTED BY ARMY PROMISES OF PROTECTION FOR THE CITIZENS. REZAIYEH AND OTHER TOWNS HAVE SEEN PRO-GOVERNMENT DEMONSTRATIONS.

BALUCHI TRIBESMEN PARADED IN ZAHEDAN MONDAY AND ALAM FAMILY SUPPORTERS CAME OUT IN BIRJAND YESTERDAY. POPULAR "ARREST" OF 2-6 (VERSIONS VARY) POLICE OR SECURITY OFFICIALS IN AMOL NIGHT BEFORE LAST IS BEING INTERPRETED BY MANY AS EVIDENCE THAT SECURITY FORCES ARE BEHIND MANY OF THE TROUBLSOME INCIDENTS--ESPECIALLY AS THE ARRESTEES WERE WHISKED OFF YESTERDAY IN A COMMANDO-LIKE RAID BY THE MILITARY, WHEN THEY WERE BEING HELD FOR TRAIL BY CIVILIAN COURT OFFICIALS. OBVIOUSLY THE 1953 MENTALITY HAS ITS SUPPORTERS HERE WHETHER THEY ARE UNDER ZAHEDI'S LEADERSHIP OR NOT.

IN 1953, THE BAZAARIS AND MULLAHS LED MOBS IN SUPPORT OF THE MONARCHY. IN 1978, THEY ARE LEADING MOBS AGAINST THE MOBARCHY. ZAHEDI CANNOT SWITCH THE BAZAARIS AND MULLAHS OF TODAY. RECOURSE TO MOB VIOLENCE UNDER PRESENT CONDITIONS WOULD ONLY ASSIST THE POLARIZATION BETWEEN SHAH AND KHOMEINI SUPPORTERS WHICH WE ALL HOPE TO AVERT. ONLY A POLITICAL SOLUTION WHICH CAPITALIZES ON THE MODERATES OF THE CENTER, WITH "GIVE" BY BOTH THE SHAH AND THE RELIGIOUS OPPOSITION, CAN PRESERVE IRAN'S BASIC STABILITY WHILE PROMOTING THE ORDERLY DEVELOPMENT OF DEMOCRATIC PRACTICES THAT WE SUPPORT.
SUMMARY: A MILITARY TAKEOVER IS FEASIBLE, BUT AT HEAVY LONG-TERM COST FOR U.S. INTERESTS AS WELL AS FOR IRAN. END SUMMARY

IT HAS BECOME A COMMONPLACE IN TEHRAN CONVERSATIONS THESE DAYS THAT THE COUNTRY IS HEADING EVER CLOSER TO SOME SORT OF MILITARY TAKEOVER AS THE ONLY EFFECTIVE WAY OF STOPPING STREET DISORDERS AND VIOLENCE. THE MAIN DIFFERENCE OF OPINION IS BETWEEN THOSE WHO BELIEVE THAT THE POLARIZATION OF OPPOSING FORCES BETWEEN THE KHOMEINI CAMP AND THE CHAH'S HAS REACHED THE POINT OF NO RETURN, LEADING TO A TEST OF STRENGH, AND THOSE WHO BELIEVE THAT THIS TEST OF STRENGTH CAN STILL BE POSTONED OR AVERTED BY INTRODUCTION OF A POLITICAL SOULTION WITHIN THE PRESENT CONSTITUTIONAL FRAMEWORK.

ALMOST EVERYONE AGREES A MILITARY TAKEOVER WILL BE ORDERED BY THE SHAH EVENTUALLY IF THE DISORDERS CONTINE. DIFFERENCE OF OPINION EXIST AS TO THE DEGREE OF CHAOS THAT WILL BE AVERTED BY SUCH A MILITARY TAKEOVER, THE DEGREE OF LONG-TERM HARM THAT WILL BE DONE BY IT, ITS LIKELY DURATION, AND THE FORCES WHICH WILL EMERGE IN IRAN UNDER THE MILITARY REGIME AND AFTERWARD.

MOST PEOPLE BELIEVE THE MILITARY ARE PRESSING FOR SUCH A TAKEOVER. TOP MILITARY OFFICERS HAVE CONTINUED TO EXPRESS TO US IN A VERY DIRECT WAY THEIR IMPATIENCE WITH THE PRESENT GOVERNMENT. AIR FORCE GENERAL RABII HAS BEEN THE MOST FLUNT AND OUTSPOKEN, AND HE IS CHAMPING AT THE BIT TO IMPOSE ORDER. ADMIRAL HABIBOLLAHI, GENERAL OVEISI, AND OTHERS, WHILE NOT AS EXTREME AS RABBI, BELIEVE A HALT MUST BE CALLED TO THE VAST PUBLIC DISORDERS.

GENERAL AZHARI, PERHAPS THE MOST REFLECTIVE AND SOBER OF THE MILITARY ESTABLISHMENT, APPEARS TO BE WOBBLING: HE RECENTLY TOLD GENERAL GAST, CHEIF OF ARMISH-MAAG, THAT PERHAPS THE SHAH HAD GONE TOO FAR TOO QUICKLY IN HIS LIBERALIZATION. THSE OFFICERS PROFESS LOYALTY TO THE SHAH -- WE BELIEVE SINCERELY -- AND IMPLY THAT NO ACTION WOULD BE TAKEN WITHOUT HIS BLESSING. THEY ALSO RELIZE THAT WITHOUT THE SHAH'S APPROVAL A MILITARY GOVERNMENT WOULD LOSE ANY VENEER OF "LEGITIMACY." THEY ARE, HOWEVER, DEEPLY DISTURBED BY THE APPARENT WEAKNESS AND VACILLATION OF THE SHAH CURRENTLY, AND IN DUE COURSE MAY ATTEMPT TO FORCE HIS HAND -- JOIN IS OR LEAVE.

SUPPORTING THE IDEA OF TAKEOVER ARE MANY EMBASSY CONTACTS WITHIN THE BUSINESS AND GOVERNMENT ESTABLISHMENT HERE, INCLUDING SOME TECHNOCRATS. THEY FREQUENTLY PHRASE THE THOUGHT MORE GENTLY "AS THE NEED FOR FIRM LEADERSHIP" AND VIEW IT AS THE LESSER OF TWO EVILS IF DISORDERS CONTINUE AND POLITICAL REMEDIES SEEMS UNAVAILING. MANY HAVE CONVINCED THEMSELVES THAT NOTHING LESS THAN THE NATIONAL SURVIVAL OF IRAN AND ITS NON-COMMUNIST FUTURE ARE AT STAKE. A GOODLY PORTION OF THESE PEOPLE CONSISTS, ON THE OTHER HAND, OF MODERATES WHO EAGERLY WISH FOR A POLITICAL SOLUTION RATHER THAN A MILITARY TAKEOVER.

EVEN THE STRINGER PARTISANS OF A TAKEOVER READILY ADMIT IT WOULD INFLICT DEEP WOUNDS ON NATIONAL COHESINENESS IN THE LONG RUN. ------------------102966 021109Z /12 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1327 INFO USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS AMEMBASSY ROME USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC SECTION 2 OF 3 TEHRAN 10706 EXDIS

THE SHAH HIMSELF TOLD THE AMBASSADOR THAT ONE OF HIS OPTIONS WOULD BE A MILITARY GOVERNMENT. HE HAS SAID THIS COULD BE EITHER STRAIGHT-OUT RULE BY THE ARMED FORCES OR A MIXED CIVILIAN/MILITARY GOVERNMENT WITH A GENERAL AS PRIME MINISTER. HE HAS NOT SPECIFIED WHO THE GENERAL WOULD BE, THOUGH FEREIDUM JAM, A FORMER CHEIF OF STAFF AND PRESENT AMBASSADOR TO SPAIN, HAS OFTEN BEEN MENTIONED BY CIRCLES BEST DESCRIBED AS NEITHER WHOLE-HEARTEDLY PRO-SHAH NOR OPPOSITIONIST.

ANY TAKEOVER WOULD HAVE TO INVOLVE A VERY HARD CRACKDOWN ON DEMONSTRATORS IN THE STREETS, STUDENTS AND PROFESSORS DEMONSTRATING IN THE UNIVERSITIES, SCHOOL CHILDREN AND TEACHERS DEMONSTRATING IN THE SCHOOLS, RELIGIOUS LEADERS AND THEIR BAZAARI MERCHANT BACKERS, LEFT-WINGERS OF ALL SORTS, AND SUFFICENT NUMBER OF STRIKING WORKERS TO GET ALL SRTIKERS BACK ON THE JOB. SOME CURBS ON THE PRESS WOULD BE INEVITABLE. THE MOMENTUM OF THIS OPERATION WOULD INVOLVE THOUSAND OF ARRESTS, AMONG THE FIRST PROBABLY BEING MANY OF THE POLITICAL PRISONERS THAT HAVE BEEN RELEASED OVER THE PAST YEAR OR TWO.

SINCE THE OPPOSITION HAS MADE IT CLEAR IT IS PREPARING CUERRILLA-STYLE RESISTANCE, THE ARMY WOULD HAVE TO FACE EXTENSIVE URBAN VIOLENCE AND A DEGREE OF HIT-AND-RUN TERRORISM OUTSIDE THE CITIES. GIVEN THE PRO-GOVERNMENT PASSIVITY OF LARGE AREAS OF THE COUNTRYSIDE(MANY OF THEM INHABITED BY SUNNI MOSLEM TRIBES WHO WERE PACIFIED BY REZA SHAH AND THE PRESENT SHAH NOT SO LONG AGO), THE ARMY SHOULD BE ABLE TO HANDLE DISTURBANCES OUTSIDE THE LARGER CITIES. FOR URBAN PURPOSES, THE POLICE AND SAVAK WOULD HAVE TO BE GIVEN A FREER HAND IN RECENT MONTHS, PERHAPS ASSISTED BY SOME SORT OF MILITARY INTELLIGENCE IN WHOM THE ARMY HIGH COMMAND WOULD HAVE GREATER CONFIDENCE.
TO BE EFFECTIVE, THE TAKEOVER WOULD HAVE TO TURN IRAN BACK INTO THE TIGHTLY CONTROLLED STATE IT WAS BEFORE LIBERALIZATION BEGAN IN MID-1976.

WE ARE QUITE SURE THIS CAN BE DONE -- BUT AT A COST. WE BELIEVE THE VAST PERCENTAGE OF THE MILITARY OFFICERS WOULD BE LOYAL TO SUCH A GOVERNMENT -- PARTICULARLY IF THE SHAH'S IMPROMATUR WAS ON IT -- AND A LARGE PERCENTAGE OF THE TROOPS WOULD FOLLOW THEIR OFFICERS.

(THE GOVERNMENT'S POLICY OF STATIONING TROOPS AWAY FROM THEIR HOME AREA WOULD HELP IN THIS RESPECT, THOUGH WE WOULD WITNESS SOME DESERTIONS AND EVEN DEFECTIONS TO THE OTHER SIDE.) A DEGREE OF ANTAGONISM EXISTS BETWEEN THE MILITARY AND THE SECURITY FORCES, BUT THIS IS MORE IN THE NATURE OF RIVALRY THAN ANY DIFFERENCE OF POLICY, AND WE WOULD EXPECT THE SECURITY AGENCIES TO COOPEATE.

ON THE OTHER HAND, ALMOST EVERYONE AGREES THE LONGTERM COSTS WOULD BE HEAVY. IN THE EYES OF VAST NUMBERS OF MODERATES WHO HAVE BEEN HOPING FOR A MODERATE OUTCOME, ANY RESIDUAL CREDIBILITY RETAINED BY THE SHAH-- AND HIS PROMISES OF LIBERLIZATION -- WOULD BE LOST. POLARIZATION BETWEEN SUPPORTERS AND OPPONENTS OF THE NEW REGIME WOULD OCCUR VERY RAPIDLY, ERODING ANY CONSENSUS OF THE MODERATES IN THE CENTER. TERRORISTS, AND THOSE MOST EXPERIENCED IN GUIDING THEM, WOULD RAPIDLY GAIN INFLUENCE AND PRESTIGE AS LEADERS OF THE OPPOSITION.

THE MILITARY, WHO HAVE SO FAR MADE AN EFFORT TO PRESENT THEMSELVES AS ABOVE THE POLITICAL SQUABBLE, WOULD BE IDENTIFIED FOR THE FUTURE ON THE SIDE OF REPRESSION. THE INTERNATIONAL OUTCRY IN THE U.S. AND ELSEWHERE WOULD REACH NEW DECIBEL LEVELS. THE SITUATION WOULD IN THIS SENSE BE LESS COMPARABLE TO LEBANON TODAY THAN TO THE REGIME OF THE COLONELS IN GREECE OR TO LATIN AMERICAN JUSTAS OVER THE YEARS. BLOODSHED WOULD INCREASE AND AFFECT LARGER NUMBERS OF THE POPULATION THAN EVER BEFORE IN PAHLAVI HISTORY. THE PSYCHOLOGICAL WOUNDS OF THIS PROCESS WOULD LINGER ON A LONG TIME AFTER THE MILITARY TAKEOVER ENDED.

THE TECHNICAL PROBLEMS ARE ALSOWORTH CONSIDERING. IT IS HIGHLY DOUBTFUL THAT THE MILITARY HAVE EXPERTS AND TECHNICAL KNOWN-HOW SUFFICENT TO RUN THE OIL FIELDS AND REFINERYS, RUN A NATIONAL BUDGET, AND OTHERWISE KEEP THE ECONOMIC LIFE OF THE NATION ON AN EVEN KEEL. WITH BAZAARI LEDERSHIP BOUND TO BE AGINST THEM, MANY MODERATE TECHNOCRATS RELUCTANT TO BE ASSOCIATED WITH A MILITARY REGIME, AND OIL WORKERS AND OTHERS UNHAPPY AND JUMPY, THE MILITARY REGIME WOULD HAVE ITS HANDS FULL. THREATS OF PRISON AND WORSE WOULD WORK ONLY UP TO A POINT.

THIS COULD BECOME A CONSIDEABLE FACTOR SLOWING DOWN ECONOMIC LIFE IN THE COUNTRY AND DOING LITTLE TO INCREASE THE POPULARITY OF THE MILITARY AMONG THE POPULATION AT LARGE. ------------------102824 021048Z /10 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1328 INFO USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS AMEMBASSY ROME USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC SECTION 3 OF 3 TEHRAN 10706 EXDIS

TIMING OF THE TAKEOVER IS ALSO IMPORTANT. THE ABOVE COSTS WOULD BE LESS HIGH IF THE TAKEOVER CAME LATER RATHER THAN SOONER. DELAY BY THE SHAH AND THE MILITARY IN IMPOSING THIS OPTION WILL HELP CONVINVE MANY CONSERVATIVES WHO ARE WAUVERING THAT THE TAKEOVER WAS INDEED JUSTIFIED. A CLEVER PUBLIC RELATIONS CAMPAIGN (FOR WHICH, HOWEVER, THE GOI HAS SO FAR SHOWN LITTLE TALENT) WOILD ALSO HELP SWAY PEOPLE TO THE PROPOSITION THAT THE TAKEOVER WAS FORCED ON THE GOVERNMENT BY THE OBTUSENESS OF THE OPPOSTION.

WHETHER ENOUGH MODERATES WOULD BE SWAYED BY SUCH ARGUMENTS TO HOLD OUT HOPES FOR AN EVENTUAL MAJORITY FAVORING THIS REGIME IT IS DIFFICUWT AT THIS TIME TO SAY. MOST INDICATIONS ARE THAT THE GOVERNMENT SUPPORTERS WOULD BE WHITTED AWAY OVER THE LIFE OF SUCH A GOVERNMENT AS THE INTERNATIONAL PRESS PLAYED UP EXCESSES WHICH WOULD BE BOUND TO OCCUR IN THE PROCESS OF LAW ENFORCEMENT.

A FURTHER FACTOR TO BE CONSIDERED WOULD BE THE EFFECT ON USG IMAGE AND POLICY -- AS WELL AS THE INCREASED URBAN TERRORISM AGAINST AMERICAN CITIZENS HERE. THE OPPOSITIONISTS CLAIM, WITH CONSIDERABLE JUSTIFICATION, THAT A MILITARY TAKEOVER WOULD STRENGTHEN THE HANDS OF THE LEFT-WINGERS AND THE SOVIETS. OUR LONG ASSOCIATIONS WITH THE SHAH'S REGIME AND HIS ARMY WOULD MAKE US A TARGET FOR THE ACCUSATION THAT WE WERE BEHIND THE TAKEOVER AND CONTINUING TO SUPPORT IT AGAINST THE WILL OF THE IRANIAN PEOPLE.

PERHAPS THIS WILL PROVE TO BE AN UNAVOIDABLE PENALTY WE WILL HAVE TO PAY, BUT WE SHOULD BE UNDER NO ILLUSIONS THAT A PENALTY IT WILL BE, COUNTING AGAINST US IN WOLD PUBLIC OPINION AND PRABABLY RETURNING TO HAUNT US IN IRAN ONCE THE MILITARY REGIME HAS RUN ITS COURSE. MEANWHILE, WE WOULD HAVE TO EXPECT RENEWED ATTACKS ON AMERICAN CITIZENS HERE BY THE ORGANIZED URBAN TERRORIST ORGANIZATIONS, WHICH HAVE FOR THE MOST PART CEASED THEIR ACTIVITIES AGAINST US OVER THE PAST TWO YEARS.

1978TEHRAN10724.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT, NOV 2 SUMMARY: SHARIATMADARI SOFTENED EARLIER COMMENT ABOUT RESORT TO ARMED INSURRECTION. INF LEADER SANJABI REITERAT

segments.text: SUMMARY: SHARIATMADARI SOFTENED EARLIER COMMENT ABOUT RESORT TO ARMED INSURRECTION. INF LEADER SANJABI REITERATED CONDEMNATION OF VIOLENCE AND CALLED FOR SUPPORT OF CONSTITUTION. KHOMEINI SAYS HE WILL ACCEPT "WHATEVER IRANIAN PEOPLE DECIDE." GANJI AND AZMOUN REACT BITTERLY TO AKHBARI'S CHARGE OF CORRUPTION AND DEMAND INVESTIGATION. IRAN AIR DOMESTIC FLIGHTS GROUNDED BY POLITAL STRIKE. INTERNATIONAL FLIGHTS CONTINUE. AMINI MET WITH SHAH, LATER EXPRESSED SUPPORT FOR SHARIF-EMAMI GOVT. JUDGES IN SANANDAJ RESIGNED TO PROTEST SEVERAL KILLINGS THERE. MIN OF JUSTICE HOPES ALL POLITICAL PRISONER WILL BE RELEASED BY DEC 10.

MAZANDARAN GOV-GEN DENIED STUDENTS EVER TOOK OVER AMOL; SAID PEOPLE WHOM THEY ARRESTED AS PROGOVT STOOGES WERE REPORTEDLY TWO GENDARMES AND A CRIMINAL SUSPECT. MANY DEMONSTRATIONS, SOME PROGOVT, BUT NO DEATHS REPORTED. LARGE DEMONSTRATIONS AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY AND IN STREETS; ISLAMIC AND LEFTIST STUDENTS HAVE APPARENTLY PATCHED UP DIFFERENCES. RELIABLE SOURCE INDICATES GOVT NOT ALARMED BY UNREST, AS IT MAKES ULTIMATE CRACKDOWN MORE PALATABLE. SOURCE ALSO STATED SAVAK PURGE CAME AFTER PRIMIN LEARNED ORGANIZATION WAS BEHIND AT LEAST SOME OF RECENT PROGOVT STREET BRAWLERS. ISFAHAN AYATOLLAHS ISSUE CALL FOR RETURN OF KHOMEINI. MORE REPORTS OF ANTIFOREIGN HOSTILITY. END SUMMARY.

AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI STRONGLY QUALIFIED PREVIOUS STATEMENT THAT OPPOSITION MIGHT HAVE TO RESORT TO ARMED INSURRECTION. IN INTERVIEW YESTERDAY HE OPPOSED ANARCHY AND TERROR BUT AGAIN SAID "IF WE CANNOT GET WHAT WE WANT THROUGH REASONABLE MEANS WE WILL START FIGHTING." HE ATTACKED AFP FOR MISINTERPRETING HIM. MEANWHILE IN PARIS, NATIONAL FRONT LEADER KARIM SANJABI AND AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI SPOKE SEPARATELY TO JOURNALISTS BUT SAID VIRTUALLY NOTHING REGARDING THEIR TALKS WITH EACH OTHER. SANJABI AGAIN CONDEMNED VIOLENCE AND SUPPORTED SONSTITUTION, SAYING FRONT DEMANDS ONLY THAT FUTURE GOVERNMENT HAVE THREE ELEMENTSNATIONALISM, DEMOCRACY, AND SOCIALISM. KHOMEINI STATED HE WOULD SIMPLY COMPLY WITH THE WILL OF THE IRANIAN PEOPLE.
HE PROPOSED A NATIONAL ASSEMBLY TO DIRECT ADMINISTRATIVE AFFAIRS. IN TEHRAN, INF SPOKESMAN DARIOUSH FOROUHAR SAID FUTURE SHOULD BE DECIDED BY NATIONAL REFERENDUM.

MAJLES DEPUTY ABBAS AKHBARI'S CHARGE THAT EDUCATION MINISTER GANJI AND FORMER MINISTER OF STATE AZMOUN WERE GUILTY OF CORRUPTION BROUGHT STRONG COUNTERATTACK FROM BOTH MEN. GANJI DEMANDED OFFICIAL INVESTIGATION INTO HIS OWN ACTIVITIES . PRESS REPORTS SHOW OF SUPPORT FOR MINISTER FROM TEACHERS THROUGHOUT IRAN. AZMOUN ALSO CALLED FOR PROSECUTOR GENERAL TO PROVE HIS SUPPOSED CORRUPTION. HE IS SUING AKHBARI FOR FALSE ACCUSATION.

FORMER PRIMIN ALI AMINI MET WITH SHAH YESTERDAY. AUDIENCE REVIVED PERSISTENT RUMORS AMINI WILL BE NEXT PRIMIN, BUT AMINI HIMSELF EXPRESSED SUPPORT FOR SHARIFEMAMI GOVT. HE DESCRIBED MEETING AS EXCHANGE OF VIEWS.

IRAN AIR DOMESTIIGHTS ARE GROUNDED BY POLITICALLYBASED STRIKE. EMPLOYEES DEMAND RELEAST OF POLITICAL PRISONERS, END OF MARTIAL LAW, DISMISSAL OF ALL FOREIGN IRAN AIR EMPLOYEES, PUNISHMENT OF FO DIRECTOR KHADEMI, AND AN END TO FIXED RIAL-DOLLAR EXCHANGE RATE. INTERNATIONAL FLIGHTS ARE PROCEEDING, BUT PANAM REPORTS HARASSMENT AND SOME DIFFICULTY INMANAGING PASSENGER LOS. ------------------105740 021457Z /43 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1338 INFO USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 10724
ALL JUDGES OF SANANDAJ (CAPITAL OF KORDESTAN) HAVE RESIGNED IN PROTEST AGAINST RECENT DEATHS OF SEVERAL DEMONSTRATORS.

NEW MINISTER OF JUSTICE HOSSEIN NAJAFI STATED YESTERDAY HE EXPECTS ALL REMAINING POLTICAL PRISONERS TO BE RELEASED BY DEC 10, HUMAN RIGHTS DAY, REMARK WAS SHORT OF A DEFINITE ASSURANCE; HE SAID SINCE THESE PRISONERS HAD BEEN TRIED BY MILITARY COURTS, ONLY SHAH COULD RELEASE THEM. SAVAK HAD PREVIOUSLY STATED 600 POLITICAL PRISONERS REMAIN. FIGURE IS DISPUTED BY HEDAYATOLLAH MATIN-DAFTARY OF COMMITTEE FOR THE DEFENSE OF POLITICAL PRISONERS, WHO SAID THERE ARE AT LEAST 900.

OCT 31 INCIDENT IN AMOL, WHEN STUDENTS REPORTEDLY TOOK OVER TOWN REMAINS FUZZY. MAZANDARAN GOV-GEN SAYEED BAHADORI DENIED THESE REPORTS. HE SAID STUDENTS DID PARTOL STREETS LOOKING FOR PROGOVT "HOOLIGANS," AND ARRESTED THREE SUSPECTS. THESE WERE, HOWEVER, ACCORDING TO GOVT, TWO GENDARMES AND A CRIMINAL SUSPECT WHO WAS BEING TAKEN TO AMOL FOR INDICTMENT. PRESS REPORTS ARMY TROOPS FREED GROUP, NUMBERED FROM 3 TO 6.

MANY DEMONSTRATIONS AGAIN TOOK PLACE WITH SOME CLASHES BUT NO DEATHS REPORTED. PROGOVT DEMOS ALSO OCCURRED, ONE INVOLVING ALAM FAMILY CLAN IN BIRJAND. IN TEHRAN STUDENTS RALLIED ON CAMPUS AS USUAL. AMCIT EYEWITNESS REPORTED ISLAMIC AND LEFTIST GROUPS SEEM TO HAVE PATCHED UP DIFFERENCES. THEY ASSEMBLED TOGETHER INSTEAD OF SEPARATELY AS HAD BEEN THE CASE PREVIOUSLY. LARGE CROWD ALSO DEMONSTRATED IN STREETS. PRESS ESTIMATES CROWD AT 100,000 BUT RELIABLE EYEWITNESSES PUT IT IN 15,000 TO 20,0000 RANGE. EMBASSY HAS LEARNED NATIONAL FRONT CALLED RALLY FOR NOV 2 BUT THAT BAZAAR LEADERSHIP (WHO USUALLY SUPPORT RELIGIOUS HIERARCHY) ARRANGED DEMONSTRATION A DAY EARLIER.

(COMMENT: THIS COULD REPRESENT DELIBERATE ATTEMPT TO KEEP DISTANCE BETWEEN RELIGIOUS LEADERS AND NATIONAL FRONT). AMCIT EYEWITNESS REPORTS WHEN SOME DEMONSTRATORS BEGAN TO ROCK STATUE OF REZA SHAH, CROWD SHOUTED "NO, NO" AND STATUE WAS LEFT UNDAMAGED.
CONSULATE ISFAHAN REPORTS AYATOLLAHS OF THAT CITY HAVE JOINTLY DECLARED KHOMEINI MUST RETURN TO IRAN.

IRANIAN WHO IS EXPERIENCED IN HIGH GOVT CIRCLES INFORMED EMBOFF EVENING NOV 1 THAT MINISTRY OF INTERIOR IS RELATIVELY UNWORRIED BY RASH OF STRIKES AND DEMONSTRATIONS. GOVT FEELS THIS WILL MAKE EVENTUAL CRACKDOWN MORE PALATABLE TO GENERAL PUBLIC. HE BELIEVES MODERATE RELIGIOUS LEADERS WILL ULTIMATELY ACCEPT A COMPROMISE. THE EXTREMISTS MAY HAVE TO BE QUELLED FORCIBLY, WHICH WOULD MEAN TEMPORARY MILITARY GOVT, PERHAPS ONE OR TWO MONTHS. (COMMENT: SOURCE REPRESENTS AN EXCELLENT AND PROBABLY ACCURATE MIDLEVEL BUREAUCRATIC VIEW WITHIN THE GOI. WE SENSE HE MAY BE UNDERESTIMATING DIFFICULTY WITH BOTH RELIGIOUS ELEMENT AND EFFICACY OF CRACKDOWN).

SAME SOURCE REPORTS PURGE OF SAVAK CAME AFTER PRIMIN LEARNED ORGANIZATION ARRANGED RECENT VIOLENT PROGOVT DEMONSTRATIONS. SAVAK MAY ALSO HAVE STAGED SOME OF THE ANTIGOVT SHOWS. FURTHERMORE MAJLIS DEPUTY AKHBARI, WHO BROUGHT CENSURE MOTION AGAINST SHARIF-EMAMI, IS LONGTIME SAVAK AGENT. SHARIF-EMAMI'S ANGER AT THIS NEWS SPELLED END FOR PARVIS SABETI.

ANTIFOREIGN INCIDENTS CONTINUE, STILL WITHOUT ANY SERIOUS INJURIES TO AMCITS BUT RESULTING IN INCREASED APPREHENSION. CONSULATE ISFAHAN REPORTS ABORTIVE ATTEMPT TO FIREBOMB ENTRANCE TO FLUOR THYSSEN. CONSULATE ALSO REPORTS THREE AMCITS WHO HAD RECEIVED THE WIDELY-DISTRIBUTED "CURSED YONKY" NOTE RECEIVED A FOLLOWUP NOTE: YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED. GO HOME OF WE WILL KILL YOU. UNQUOTE. ALL THREE HAVE LEFT IRAN. EARLIER REPORTS THAT IRANIANS IN AHWAZ AREA WERE THROWING ROCKS AND BRICKS AT FOREIGNERS IS CONFIRMED. FLUOR IRAN HAS REMOVEDIITS PERSONNEL FROM OILFIELDS AFTER TWO DAYS OF SUCH INCIDENTS. VIOLENCE WAS ANTIFOREIGN RATHER THAN ANTIAMERICAN; NONAMERICAN EXPATRIATES ALSO WERE ATTACKED.

SOLAR TURBINE, SUBSIDIARY OF INTERNATIONAL HARVESTER, HAS SENT HOME ALL DEPENDENTS, INCLUDING 10 FAMILIES IN AHWAZ AND 15 FAMILIES FROM TEHRAN. CONTROL DATA HAS SENT HOME ITS DEPENDENTS, NUMBERING 26. EMB HAS SECOND HAND BUT RELIABLE REPORT THAT IBM HAS ALSO SENT DEPENDENTS HOME.
I WAS AMAZED TO READ 3 NOVEMBER NID CABLE ITEM CONCERNING IRAN. THE INFORMATION CONTAINED IN THAT SUMMARY, WHICH IS DISTRIBUTED TO HALF THE WORLD, CAME FROM A NODIS CABLE.
THIS SORT OF INFORMATION NEEDS SOME BETTER MEANS OF PROTECTION IF WE ARE TO AVOID JEOPARDIZING AN EXTREMELY SENSITIVE TACTICAL SITUATION.
PLEASE INFORMA ME OF GROUND RULES UNDER WHICH THIS DISTRIBUTION WAS MADE, AND WHAT CLASSIFICATION I CAN USE IN FUTURE REPORTING CABLES TO PREVENT A RECURRENCE OF THIS TYPE.

APART FROM DUSTUP AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY THURSDAY IN WHICH POLICE USED SOME TEARGAS, BUT NO CASUALTIES REPORTED, THINGS APPEAR VERY QUIET AS OF NOON FRIDAY, NOVEMBER 3. FOCUS IS MORE ON NATIONAL FRONT LEADERS RETURNING FROM PARIS AMONG RUMORS CIRCULATING THAT THEY WILL BE SEEING THE SHAH. PM CONTENDER ALI AMINI HAS EXPRESSED PUBLIC SURPRISE (HAH*) THAT HIS AUDIENCE WITH THE SHAH COUPLE OF DAYS AGO GOT INTO THE PRESS. HE HAS SAID SHAH INTENDS TO SEE NATIONAL FRONT LEADERS. MEANWHILE, AMINI IS REPORTED GOING TO SEE AYATOLLAH SHARIAT-MADARI AND OTHER RELIGIOUS LEADERS ON QOM TODAY.
OIL REPORT AND OTHER MATTERS BEING CABLED SEPARATELY. UNLESS SOMETHING OF MAJOR PROPORTIONS OCCURS, DO NOT EXPECT TO REPORT AGAIN UNTIL SUNDAY.

EVENING NOV 3 SENATOR CONFIDANT OF PM SHARIF-EMAMI ASKED TO SPEAK TO POLITICAL COUNSELOR IMMEDIATELY. READING FROM CAREFUL WRITTEN PRESENTATION IN FRENCH, HE GAVE FOLLOWING MESSAGE HE HAD RECEIVED FROM PM THAT NOON.
SHARIF-EMAMI IS A GOOD COLLABORATOR FOR USG. HE HAS SAME IDEAS AND ENTREES. WY DOESN'T USG COUNSEL HIM ON PROGRAM TO FOLLOW? HE KNOWS THAT WITHOUT SUPPORT OF U.S. IRAN IS LOST.

FROM TIME HE BEGAN COOPERATING WITH U.S., WHEN HE UNDERTOOK PM DUTIES 60 DAYS AGO, HE AND USG HAVE AGREED A DICTATORIAL OR MILITARY GOVT SHOULD BE AVOIDED BECUASE IT IS DANGEROUS. HE KNOWS USG HAS WANTED DEMOCRACY IN IRAN FOR A LONG TIME.

VIOLENT MANIFEST ACTIONS PRESENTLY IN IRAN ARE VERY DANGEROUS FOR THE COUNTRY AND FOR THE WEST. THEY PREPARE THE WAY FOR COMMUNIST. IF PM HIMSELF IS A CAUSE FOR THESE VIOLENT MANIFESTATIONS HE IS READY TO LEAVE HIS JOB IMMEDIATELY. WHAT DOES USG THINK HE SHOULD DO?

USG MUST ALREADY UNDERSTAND THAT PM BELIEVE SHAH SHOULD REIGN, NOT RULE. FOUR YEARS AOG, AT BEGINNING OF PRESENT SENATE'S TERM, SHARIF-EMAMI HAD PERSONALLY TOLD THE SHAH HE SHOULD MAKE A START TOWARD DEMOCRACY, BUT SHAH HAD NOT LISTENED.

SHARIF-EMAMI WANTS US TO KNOW HE HIMSELF ORDERED ARMY TAKEOVER OF OIL FIELDS WHICH HAS JUST BEEN COMPLETED. LIKEWISE HE WAS THE ONE TO ORDER MILITARY TRANSPORT TO FLY LAST 10,000 IRANIAN PILGRIMS TO MECCA WHEN IRAN AIR WENT ON STRIKE. SHAH IS INCAPABLE OF TAKING ANY DECISIONS AT PRESENT.
IF SITUATION CALMS DOWN, SHARIF-EMAMI IS READY TO ANNUL PARLIAMENT IN ABOUT TWO MONTHS FROM NOW AND CALL FOR NEW ELECTIONS.

PM HAS NOTED PUBLIC STATMENT BY NATIONAL FRONT'S SANJABI THE HE WILL BRING DOWN THE GOVERNMENT. U.S. SHOULD KNOW SANJABI HAS MEAGER PUBLIC POLITICAL SUPPORT, ONLY A FRACTION OF SUPPORT COMMANDED BY EVEN SUCH OTHER OPPOSITION LEADERS AS BAZARGAN AND MINATCHI, WITH WHOM SHARIFEMAMI HAS BEEN NEGOTIATING. ONLY ONE OGRANIZATION APPEARS TO BE SUPPORTING SANJABI, AND U.S. EMBASSY SHOULD KNOW WHAT ORGANIZATION THAT IS.

SENATOR REFUSED TO BE DRAWNOUT ON LAST REFERENCE TO "ORGANIZATION" SUPPORING SANJABI EXCEPT TO DENY TO POL COUNS THAT IT WAS THE COMMUNISTS. BROAD IMPLICATION WAS IT WAS CIA. HE WAS UNIMPRESSED BY POL COUNSELOR'S DENIAL THAT USG WAS INVOLVED IN INTERNAL POLITICS OF IRAN AND SEEMED INTENT ON KEEPING THAT HALF-STATED ACCUSATION AS ATTENTION-GETTING WEDGE, PERHAPS FOR REST OF PM'S MESSAGE. SENATOR SUGGESTED, PURPORTEDLY AS HIS OWN IDEA, THAT US AMBASSADOR CALL ON SHARIF-EMAMI NEXT DAY TO DISCUSS THESE POINTS WITH HIM. PM WOULD BE WAITING.

COMMENT: POL COUNS PASSED MESSAGE TO AMBASSADOR PRIOR TO LATTER'S AUDIENCE WITH THE SHAH NEXT AFTERNOON, NOV 4. AMBASSADOR JUDGED THIS IS SHARIF-EMAMI'S REACTION WORD FROM THE SHAH THAT HIS GOVT IS NOT TO REMAIN MUCH LONGER. IN THAT SENSE PM'S MESSAGE WAS OVERTAKEN BY EVENTS. THEREFORE, AMBASSADOR SAW NO REASON TO CALL ON SHARIF-EMAMI IN CONNECTION WITH THIS MESSAGE AT THIS TIME. (DESPITE HIS OWN YEOMAN EFFORTS TO DATE, SHARIF-EMAMI'S PASTIMAGE UNFORTUNATELY HAS BLUNTED HIS EFFECTIVENESS WITH IRANIAN PUBLIC.) PM CALLED AMBASSADOR DIRECTLY NOV 5 TO REQUEST MEETING THAT MORNING.
BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND I SPENT LONG PRAYER SESSION WITH SHAH LATE AFTERNOON NOVEMBER 4. NOTHING REALLY NEW EMERGED, AS WE REHEARSED ESSENTIALLY THE SAME CONTINGENCIES COVERED IN PREVIOUS MEETINGS.

SHAH BEGAN MEETING BY REFERRING TO DR. BRZEZINSKI'S TELEPHONE CALL. HE SAID HE APPRECIATED PRESIDENT'S WILLINGNESS TO SUPPORT HIM IN ANY DECISION, INCLUDING A DECISION TO FORM A MILITARY GOVT. HOWEVER, HE WONDERED WHY PRESIDENT THOUGHT A MILITARY GOVT WOULD BE SUCCESSFUL. HE CITED THE DAY'S EVENTS TO DEMONSTRATE HIS OWN DOUBTS ABOUT THE MILITARY'S CAPABILITIES TO RESTORE LAW AND ORDER.

HE POINTED OUT THAT TROOPS HAD STOOD FIRM AGAINST UNIVERSITY DEMONSTRATORS THAT MORNING, HAD BEEN ATTACKED, AND THEN HAD COUNTER-ATTACKED. HE DID NOT KNOW IF THERE WERE ANY FATALITIES. BUT HE DID KNOW THAT HIT AND RUN DEMONSTRATIONS HAD THEN BROKEN OUT ALL OVER TOWN BEYOND THE CAPABILITY OF TROOPS TO CONTROL.

HE ALSO SAID THAT WHILE HE WAS PLEASED TO HAVE THE PRESIDENT'S STATEMENT OF SUPPORT, HE COULD NOT SEE WHAT PRESIDENT COULD ACTUALLY DO IN TANGIBLE TERMS. HE POINTED OUT ONCE AGAIN THAT SITUATION WAS VASTLY DIFFERENT FROM 1953, WHEN U.S. ASSISTANCE HAD BEEN HELPFUL.

I ANSWERED THESE TWO OBSERVATIONS FIRST, BY DESCRIBING THE CIRCUMSTANCES (ABC TELEVISION REPORT, ETC.), WHICH LAY BEHIND THE BRZEZINSKI CALL AND SECOND, BY SUGGESTING SHAH LOOK AT WHAT SITUATION WOULD BE IF PRESIDENT WITHDREW HIS SUPPORT. HE SEEMED TO ACCEPT THOSE COMMENTS AND MOVED ON TO HIS OWN VIEWS.

HE SAID HE FELT ONLY HOPE FOR LAW AND ORDER WOULD BE IN FORMATION OF GOVT WHICH WOULD, ON THE ONE HAND, ACCEPT THE CONSTITUTION, I.E., THE MONARCHY, AND, ON THE OTHER HAND, HAVE THE SUPPORT OF SHARIAT-MADARI AND THE MODERATE CLERGY. THAT IS WHY HE WANTS TO TRY A COALITION. HOWEVER, TO FORM THIS, THE NATIONAL FRONT AND SHARIAT-MADARI WILL HAVE TO HAVE THE COURAGE TO MAKE AN OPEN BREAK WITH KHOMEINI. HE FELT THE ENSUING CONFRONTATION WOULD BE MANAGEABLE AND LAW AND ORDER COULD BE RESTORED.

HOWEVER, IN A SITUATION WHERE THE GOVT, OR THE MILITARY, FACED AN OPPOSITION WHICH INCLUDES KHOMEINI, SHARIATMADARI, AND THE NATIONAL FRONT, KHOMEINI WOULD CALL FOR A JIHAD AND THERE WOULD BE A BLOODBATH. EVEN SOME OF THE MILITARY WOULD TAKE THEIR OBLIGATIONS TO ISLAM AHEAD OF THEIR OBLIGATIONS TO THE SHAH.
WE THEN WENT THROUGH A STERILE DISCUSSION OF CONTINGENCIES IN THE EVENT HE COULD NOT CONVINCE THE NATIONAL FRONT TO JOINT A COALITION. THEY ARE ALL RATHER BLEAK AND HARDLY WORTH RECORDING HERE.

I ASKED WHY THE ARMY WAS NOT MORE SUCCESSFUL IN THE OIL FIELDS. HE SAID NO ARRESTS WERE BEING MADE. I SAID I THOUGHT THE ARMY HAD BEEN INSTRUCTED TO MAKE ARRESTS. HE TELEPHONED GENERAL OVEISI AND REPORTED TO THE CONTRARY. NO ARRESTS WERE BEING MADE. HE THEN CHANGED THE SUBJECT. (I WILL PURSUE THIS FURTHER WITH THE PRIME MINISTER THIS MORNING.)

LATER ON NIGHT OF NOVEMBER 4, HE HAD HIS AIDE CALL ME TO COMPLAIN THAT NATIONAL FRONT TYPES HAD NOT RETURNED FROM PARIS. BRITISH AMBASSADOR IS MEETING THIS MORNING WITH ONE OF THEIR REPRESENTATIVES. WE MAY SEE SHAH AGAIN LATER TODAY TO SUGGEST HE ISSUE INVITATION TO NATIONAL FRONT WITH SPECIFIC DATE AND TIME FOR MEETING IN ORDER TO FORCE THEIR HAND.

1978TEHRAN10755.subject: MORE ON AUDIENCE WITH THE SHAH, NOVEMBER 4

segments.text: WHEN BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND I MET WITH SHAH NOVEMBER 4, SHAH SAID THAT HE FELT PUBLIC STATEMENTS OF SUPPORT FOR HIM BY U.S. AND U.K. OFFICIALS WERE BECOMING COUNTERPRODUCTIVE. THEY WERE VIEWED BY THE OPPOSITION AS PROVOCATIONS AND THEY MADE HIM LOOK AS THOUGH HE WERE UNDER FOREIGN CONTROL.

I GAVE HIM TEXT OF VANCE PRESS CONFERENCE STATEMENT AND SAID IT WAS VERY CAREFULLY PHRASED. SECRETARY COULD NOT AVOID PRESS QUERIES. HE SAID HE APPRECIATED THAT, BUT THE HEADLINES NEVER CAUGHT THE CAREFUL PHRASING OF THE STATEMENTS.
BRITISH AMBASSADOR SAID UK MINISTERS HAD SIMILAR PROBLEM, ESPECIALLY SINCE PARLIAMENT WAS DEBATING QUEEN'S SPEECH FROM THRONE.

COMMENT: AFTER WORD OF SECRETARY'S STATEMENT WAS BROADCAST BY NIRT, MILITARY SENT STRONG FORCE OF TROOPS TO GUARD EMBASSY. ALTHOUGH SOME STUDENTS MILLED AROUND, THERE NO RPT NO INCIDENTS. THIS MORNING, THOUSANDS OF YOUNG MEN ARE STREAMING TOWARD UNIVESITY. I ASSUME MORE CLASHES WILL ENSUE TODAY.

PRIME MINISTER SHARIF-EMAMI ASKED ME TO SEE HIM MORNING NOVEMBER 5. HE BEGAN BY SAYING THAT LAW AND ORDER WAS RAPIDLY EVAPORATING AND THAT HE FELT A MILITARY GOVT WAS NEEDED. HE ASKED WHAT U.S. POSITION WOULD BE ON MILITARY GOVT.

I TOLD HIM U.S. WAS PREPARED SUPPORT ANY ACTION TAKEN BY SHAH. WE RECOGNIZED NEED FOR LAW AND ORDER AND WOULD SUPPORT MILITARY GOVT IF THAT WAS SHAH'S DECISION. I STRESSED THAT MILITARY MUST NOT TAKE MATTERS INTO THEIR OWN HANDS.

I DESCRIBED GIST OF TALKS SHAH HAD BEEN HAVING WITH BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND MYSELF. I ASKED WHETHER HE AGREED WITH SHAH'S ANALYSIS. HE SAID IT WOULD BE FINE IF SHARIATMADARI AND NATIONAL FRONT WOULD AGREE TO OPENLY BREAK WITH KHOMEINI. HOWEVER, HE DOUBTED THEY WOULD EVER HAVE THE COURAGE.

HE THEN SAID BARZAGAN WAS BACK IN TEHRAN AND WOULD BE SEEING SHARIAT-MADARI THIS AFTERNOON. SANJABI REMAINED IN PARIS AND REPORTEDLY WAS STILL DISCUSSING EVENTS WITH KHOMEINI. HE WOULD TRY TO GET A READING ON THE RESULTS OF THE BARZAGAN MEETING WITH SHARIAT-MADARI.

I THEN ASKED WHY THE ARMY WAS BEING SO PASSIVE IN ITS EFFORTS TO RESTORE OIL PRODUCTION. I DESCRIBED MY CONVERSATION WITH SHAH ON THIS SUBJECT. SHARIF-EMAMI SAID THAT PART OF THE PROBLEM WAS THAT SAVAK WAS BEHIND THE OIL STRIKE. WHEN I EXPRESSED INCREDULITY, HE SAID HE WAS CONVINCED OF IT. SAVAK WOULD SO ANYTHING TO PROTECT GENERAL NASSERI.
WE CONCLUDED THE MEETING WITH MY SUGGESTION THAT HE DISCUSS HIS VIEWS DIRECTLY WITH THE SHAH. HE SAID HE WOULD AND THAT HE WOULD RECOMMEND THE INSTALLATION OF A MILITARY GOVT.

1978TEHRAN10759.subject: NEW MINISTER OF JUSTICE THREATENS RESIGNATION OVER SECURITY ISSUE

segments.text: OVER SECURITY ISSUE

A SOURCE WITH GOOD ACCESS WHO IS A NEIGHBOR OF THE NEW MINISTER OF JUSTICE TOLD POL COUNS NOV 3 THAT THE MINISTER HAD COME OVER TO TELL HIM HIS TROUBLES. IN A WORD, THE SECURITY FORCES HAVE NOT BEEN COOPERATING WITH HIM EVEN THOUGH THEY WERE ORDERED TO. SHAH AT FIRST TOLD PM SHARIF-EMAMI TO PASS ON HIS ORDERS THAT SAVAK, POLICE, AND GENDARMERIE HEREAFTER TAKE ORDERS FROM THE MINISTER OF JUSTICE (AS REPORTED TEHRAN POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT NOV 1) THOUGH NO CHANGE WAS MADE IN FORMAL LOCATION OF THE SERVICES WITHIN MINISTRY OF INRERIOR.

NEW JUSTICE MINISTER QUICKLY DISCOVERED HE WAS GETTING NO COOPERATION AND TENDERED HIS RESIGNATION WEDNESDAY (NOV 1). SHARIF-EMAMI CALLED THE SHAH WITH JUSTICE MINISTER PRESENT, AND SHAH SAID HE HIMSELF WOULD ORDER THE SECURITY SERVICES TO COOPERATE. HEAD OF POLICE WAS WAITING IN MINISTER OF JUSTICE'S OFFICE WHEN MINISTER RETURNED. FOR FOUR HOURS, THEY DISCUSSED VARIOUS CHANGES OF PERONNEL IN THE PROVINCES AND SIMILAR MATTERS. BUT MIN OF JUSTICE STILL DOES NOT FEEL HE IS GETTING FULL COOPERATION.

MEANWHILE MIN OF JUSTICE (WHO WAS TEHRAN ATTORNEY GENERAL BEFORE APPOINTMENT) HAS EVOLVED NEW PLAN FOR SPEEDY TRIALS OF TOP FIGURES ACCUSED OF CORRUPTION. HE PLANS TO ASSIGN ONE JUDGE FULL TIME TO EACH CASE. THUS HE HOPES TO GET TO END OF TRIAL IN 2-3 MONTHS. MEANWHILE ON NOV 2, MAJLIS JUSTICE COMMITTEE VOTED TO LIFT PARLIAMENTARY IMMUNITY FROM ACCUSED MULTI-MILLIONAIRE YASSINI. SENATE IS REPORTEDLY MOVING FAST TO DO LIKEWISE WITH OTHER PROMINENT BUSINESSMAN, ALI REZAI.

COMMENT: INTERESTING AS ALL THIS IS, NEW MIN OF JUSTICE IS UNLIKELY TO HAVE MUCH CHANCE TO PUT HIS PLANS INTO ACTION SINCE LIFE OF SHARIF-EMAMI GOVT SEEMS RAPIDLY NEARING ITS END -- UNLESS OF COURSE JUSTICE MINISTER WERE REAPPOINTED TO THAT JOB BY A NEW GOVT, WHICH SEEMS UNLIKELY.

1978TEHRAN10767.subject: VISIT OF DR. L. MALECKI TO UNITED STATES

segments.text: DR. MALECKI, DIRECTOR, OFFICE OF INTERNATIONAL RELATIONS, TECHNICAL SCIENTIFIC UNIVERSITY OF THE IMPERIAL IRANIAN ARMED FORCES (TECH/SCI U), WILL VISIT U.S. IN NOVEMBER FOR PRINCIPAL PURPOSE OF CONCLUDING ARRANGMENT WITH GEORGIA TECH. SCIATT RECOMMENDED MALECKI CONTACT J. ZIMMERMAN OF NASA, AS WELL AS DEPARTMENT'S BUREAU OF OES, TO DISCUSS POSSIBLE JOINT ACTIVITIES IN SPACE SHUTTLE AREA, WITH EMPHASIS ON TRAINING AND ACQUISITION OF TECHNICAL KNOW-HOW IN TELEMETRY AND SPACE SCIENCE.

TECH/SCI UNIVERSITY IS INTERESTED IN SENDING POST-DOCTORAL CANDIDATES TO STUDY AT UNIVERISTIES IN THE UNITED STATES AND IN THE PROSPECTS FOR AN NSF-CENTO PROGRAM UNDER WHICH SCIENTISTS WOULD BE EXCHANGED AND WOULD WORK IN EACH OTHER'S COUNTRY FOR AGREED PERIODS OF TIME.
OBJECTIVE OF JOINT PROGRAMS IS CROSS FERTILIZATION OF TECHNOLOGY AND EXPANSION OF COMPETENCE WITHIN THIS NEW UNIVERSITY.
GOI FINANCING OF JOINT PROJECTS APPROVED BY THIS UNIVERSITY SHOULD NOT POSE PROBLEM, SINCE IT IS SUPPORTED ENTIRELY THROUGH DEPARTMENT OF WAR.

1978TEHRAN10771.subject: MEETING WITH KAYHAN PUBLISHER AND EDITOR

segments.text: AT MY REQUEST, SENATOR MEZBAZADEH, PUBLISHER OF KAYHAN, AND KARIM ZARNEGAR, EDITOR OF THE KAYHAN INTERNATIONAL, CALLED AT RESIDENCE LATE AFTERNOON OF NOVEMBER 3. DCM WAS ALSO PRESENT. I TOLD THEM THAT THE SHAH HAD ASKED ME TO MEET WITH THEM TO URGE GREATER PRESS RESPONSIBILITY AND A MORE CAREFUL DISTINCTION BETWEEN RUMORS AND FACTS. I EXPLAINED THAT THE SHAH IS UNDER CONSIDERABLE PRESSURE FROM THE MILITARY TO CRACK DOWN AND THAT THE MILITARY OFFICERS COMPLAINED DAILY OF THE LACK OF BALANCE IN THE PAPERS AND CITED TO HIM VARIOUS NEWSPAPER ARTICLES WHICH MISREPRESENTED THE SITUATION, WERE INACCURATE, OR INFLAMMATORY.
AS ONE RECENT EXAMPLE, I NOTED THAT KAYHAN'S ARTICLE WHICH STATED THAT OIL PRODUCTION HAD EFFECTIVELY CEASED WAS OFF THE MARK AND ADDED TO THE SENSE OF CRISIS AND ALARM IN THE COUNTRY.

BOTH OF MY INTERLOCUTORS WERE AT FIRST SOMEWHAT TAKEN ABACK AND CURIOUS WHY I HAD BEEN ASKED TO PASS SUCH A MESSAGE. WE KICKED THAT ONE AROUND WITH A BIT OF BANTER ABOUT THE HAH'S SUSPICION THAT KAYHAN AND THE AMERICAN EMBASSY HAS ALWAYS BEEN CLOSE AND THAT PERHAPS AN AMERICAN HAD A LOT OF EXPERIENCE WITH PRESS EXCESSES.

MEZBAZADEH THEN EXPLAINED AT CONSIDERABLE LENGTH THAT HE AND HIS EDITOR IN FACT NO LONGER REALLY CONTROLLED WHAT WAS PRINTED IN HIS OWN PAPERS. WITH SOME BITTERNESS HE STATED THAT SHARIF-EMAMI SPOKE ELOQUENTLY OF TOTAL FREEDOM OF THE PRESS BUT AS YET NOT OF PRESS RESPONSIBILITY. THE PRIME MINISTER SIGNED THE NEW PRESS CHARTER WITH THE WRITERS AND WORKERS AFTER THE MARTIAL LAW CENSORSHIP FAASCO; THE PUBLISHERS WERE NOT PART OF THE UNDERSTANDING. NOW THE TYESETTERS, THE WRITERS AND LOWER-LEVEL EDITORS BELIEVE THEY RUN THE PAPER AND HAVE THE FULL FREEDOM TO PUT TOGETHER AN ISSUE SUITING THEIR OWN POLITICAL VIEWS.

ON OCCASION THE TYPESETTERS HAVE THREATENED TO STRIKE WHEN THEY FELT THE COVERAGE WAS NOT TO THEIR LIKING. THE SAME SITUATION WAS AFFECTING OTHER PAPERS, HE SAID, AND AYENDEGAN HAD IN EFFECT BEEN TAKEN OVER BY A COMMITTEE, A SOVIET; THE EDITOR WAS OUT AND THE PAPER WAS PRINTED AT A PRIVATE PRITING PRESS, NOT AT AYENDEGAN'S OWN PRESS. (ANOTHER SOURCE HAS CONFIRMED THAT THE OPPOSITION CONTROLS ESSENTIALLY THE TEHRAN JOURNAL PAPERS AND THAT PUBLISHER MASSOUDI HAD LITTLE TO SAY ABOUT HIS PAPERS.)

I COMMENTED THAT THE PICTURE HE HAD PAINTED APPEARS TO VINDICATE THE CHARGES BY THE MILITARY AND THAT HE SEEMED TO HAVE A STARK CHOICE: ATTEMPTS TO CONTROL HIS OWN PAPER BY INSISTING THAT REPORTS WERE ACCURATE AND THE COVERAGE BALANCED, OR HAVE THE MILITARY DO IT FOR HIM. HE NODDED SADLY AND SAID THAT HE MIGHT SIMPLY CLOSE DOWN HIS PAPER FOR A PERIOD OF TIME; HE WOULD MAKE SUCH A DECISION WITHIN A FEW DAYS. HE HAD ASKED FOR AN AUDIENCE WITH THE SHAH TO DISCUSS THIS ISSUE.

1978TEHRAN10773.subject: ALLEGED SOVIET INVOLVEMENT IN CURRENT EVENTS IN IRAN

segments.text: ACCORDING TO NOV 5 TEHRAN PRESS, USG "SOURCES" IN WASHINGTON STATE THAT USG HAS MADE DEMARCHE TO SOVIETS OVER ALLEGED SOVIET INVOLVEMENT IN CURRENT EVENTS IN IRAN. IT IS STIPULATED BY THESE SAME "SOURCES" THAT IRAN HAS BECOME A TEST OF DETENTE.

THIS REPORT COMES AT A TIME WHEN SOVIET EMBASSY HERE HAS ISSUED RARE "CLARIFICATION" ON AFP REPORT THAT SOVIET PRESS HAS ATTACKED AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI AS A PROVOCATEUR. SOVIET EMBASSY ACTION CLEARLY DESIGNED TO PROTECT ITSELF FROM VENGEFUL WRATH OF PRO-KHOMEINI ACTIVISTS.
COMMENT: I WOULD APPRECIATE DEPT COMMENT ON PARAGRAPH ONE AND MOSCOW COMMENT ON PARAGRAPH TWO. I WOULD ALSO APPRECIATE ANY INFORMATION WASHINGTON HOLDS ON SOVIET INVOLVEMENT HERE.

1978TEHRAN10775.subject: A DAY IN THE LIFE OF A MARTIAL LAW DETAINEE SUMMARY: MARTIAL LAW DETAINEE CONDITIONS IN TEHRAN ARE LESS HARSH THAN ONE MIGHT IMAGINE, ACCORDING TO ON

segments.text: SUMMARY: MARTIAL LAW DETAINEE CONDITIONS IN TEHRAN ARE LESS HARSH THAN ONE MIGHT IMAGINE, ACCORDING TO ONE WITNESS. MOST DETAINEES ARE YOUNGSTERS, MANY FROM THE POOREST PARTS OF TOWN. ARMY OFFICERS GO OUT OF THEIR WAY TO PROPAGANIDZE AMONG THE DETAINEES, MAKING A DISTINCTION (FAVORABLY) BETWEEN THE ARMY AND THE POLICE, WHICH CARRIES OUT MOST OF THE ARRESTS. END SUMMARY.

MICHAEL IS IN HIS 30S, IRANIAN OF ARMENIAN BACKGROUND, AN ARCHITECT BY PROFESSION, A PHOTOGRAPHER BY AVOCATION. ONE DAY ABOUT TWO WEEKS AGO HE SNAPPED SOME PHOTOGRAPHS OF ARMY AND POLICE DISPERSING A MOB IN FRONT OF TEHRAN UNIVERSITY. HE WAS ARRESTED DESPITE EFFORTS TO AVOID ARREST BY GIVING UP HIS CAMERA. THIS IS A SUMMARY OF WHAT HE DID AND SAW, AS HE TOLD IT TO HIS FRIEND, THE EMBASSY'S POLITICAL COUNSELOR.

AS IS USUAL, HE WAS BROUGHT BY THE ARRESTING POLICE BEFORE THE AD HOC MARTIAL LAW TRIBUNAL IN THE ABBASABAD SECTION OF TEHRAN. THE ARMY OFFICER HEARD HIS STORY AND WAS SYMPATHETIC. HE SAID HE WOULD NOT HAVE ARRESTED MICHAEL, BUT NOW THAT THE ARREST WAS MADE HE HAD TO GO THROUGH THE PROCESS. MICHAEL WAS SENT TO THE ARMY BARRACKS NEAR POLICE HEADQUARTERS WHICH HAVE BEEN TURNED INTO A DETENTION CENTER. THERE WERE LITERALLY THOUSANDS OF PEOPLE THERE--MEN SEPARATED FROM WOMEN ONCE THEY GOT OFF THE BUS. MOST WERE YOUNG AND FROM THE POORER SECTIONS OF SOUTH TEHRAN.
SOME NATIVE TEHRANIS DID NOT KNOW WHERE ELIZABETH BOULEVARD OR FARAH PARK ARE (WELL WITHIN NORTH PART OF DOWNTOWN, NEAR UNIVERSITY STUDENT RESIDENCES) --THEY HAD NEVER BEEN THERE*

SEVERAL WERE FRANK ABOUT HAVING BEEN ARRESTED FOR PASSING OUT ANTI-SHAH, ANTI-GOVT LITERATURE; ONE OF THEM WAS 13 YEARS OLD. OTHERS WERE CAREFUL NOT TO TALK. ONE GROUP OF YOUTHS SAID THEY WERE IN A CAR GOING TO FETCH COOKING GAS WHEN POLICE STOPPED THEM AND RADIOED HEADQUARTERS AS IF THEY HAD CAUGHT FLEEING THIEVES (PERHAPS A CASE OF MISTAKEN IDENTITY). MANY WERE THERE FOR OVERSTAYING THE CURFEW. SEVERAL WERE DUE TO GO TO U.S. TO STUDY SOON AND WERE WORRIED ARREST MIGHT PREVENT THEIR LEAVING.

OF INTEREST WAS THEIR TREATMENT. FOOD WAS GOOD AND WELL SERVED. ARMY OFFICERS PAID FREQUENT VISITS TO THE BARRACKS ROOM HE WAS IN AND EXPLAINED THE NEED FOR ORDER AND ARMY'S DESIRE NOT TO HURT THE POEPLE. ARMY MEN SEEMED TO DELIGHT IN DRAWING COMPARISONS BETWEEN THEMSELVES AND THE POLICE, TO THE POLICE'S DISFAVOR. DETAINEES COOPERATED AND AGREED VOCALLY WITH ARMY OFFICERS (SINCE THEY WANTED TO BE FREED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE). ONE FELLOW DETAINEE ON LEARNING MICHAEL WAS ARMENIAN (CHRISTIAN) TOLD HIM HE SHOULDN'T BE THERE AT ALL -- THE PRISON TREATMENT WAS AIMED AT MOSLEMS.

ALL THIS IMPRESSED MICHAEL, WHO WORRIED LESS ABOUT HIS OWN SORT THAN DID HIS BROTHER AND OTHERS WHO WERE TRYING TO GET HIM OUT. NEVERTHELESS, THE ARMY GUARDS WITH FIXED BAYONETS WHO LINED THE CORRIDORS THE MEN TOOK AT REGULAR INTERVALS TO USE THE TOILETS DID NOT LOOK LIKE THEY WERE JOKING....

PEOPLE SEARCHING FOR MICHAEL WERE UNABLE TO CONTACT ANYONE IN AUTHORITY. THEY KNEW NO NAMES AND PHONE CALLS LED NOWHERE. BY BRIBING A SERGEANT THEY WERE ABLE TO FOLLOW MICHAEL'S MOVEMENTS VAGUAELY. (HE WAS SCHEDULED TO APPEAR AGAIN BEFORE THE COURT IN ABBASSABAD ON SATURDAY-SINCE FRIDAY, THE DAY AFTER HIS ARREST, WAS A HOLIDAY.) EVENTUALLY SOMEONE MADE CONTACT (THEY NEVER KNEW WHO) AND MICHAEL WAS RELEASED ON FRIDAY WITHOUT AN APPEARANCE BEFORE THE TRIBUNAL.

AMONG THE ARGUMENTS PEOPLE WERE USING TO GET HIM OUT WAS THAT HE WAS WORKING ON A GOVERNMENT CONTRACT, ENTITLED TO AN OFFICIAL PASSPORT, AS ARCHITECT FOR THE NEW IRANIAN EMBASSY IN KUWAIT, AND HAD THEREFORE BEEN CLEARED BY SAVAK.

AMONG THE STORIES MICHAEL HEARD WAS THAT 2,000 PEOPLE WERE BEING ARRESTED EVERY DAY, AND SOME LINGERED IN DETENTION WITHOUT EVEN BEING QUETIONED FOR SEVERAL WEEKS ON END. THIS WAS NEVER PROVED OR DEMONSTRATED, AND SOME DISCREET EMBASSY INQUIRIES THROUGH MILITARY CONTACTS DREW A DENIAL FROM THE MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATORS.
THE MOST COLORFUL DETAINEE MICHAEL ENCOUNTERED WAS AN 80 YEAR OLD "GRANDPA" WHO WAS READING DISSIDENT POET SAADI'S WORKS OUT LOUD.

SUMMARY: WIDESPREAD DEMONSTRATIONS, THIS TIME RESULTING IN VIOLENT CONFRONTATION IN TEHRAN. TROOPS CLASHED WITH STUDENTS NEAR TEHRAN UNIVERSITY NOV 3, THEN FIRED ON SIMILAR CROWD NOV 4. PRESSSFULL OF REPORTS KARIM SANJABI MAY FORM NEW GOVT, PERHAPS SHARING POWER WITH AMINI. KHOMEINI HOWEVER THREATENS TO OSTRACIZE ANY WHO DEAL WITH PRESENT REGIME. OPPOSITION DEPUTY BANI-AHMAD RESIGNED TO PROTEST ALLEGED SEIZURE OF PAVEH BY ITS MAJLIS DEPUTY SALAR JAAF. JUSTICE COMMITTEE OF MAJLIS AGREED TO STRIP DEPUTY YASSINI OF PARLIAMENTARY IMMUNITY. FORMER SAVAK FIGURES NASSIRI AND SABETI ARE BARRED FROM LEAVING IRAN.

IRAN AIR HAS ANNOUNCED AIR FORCE PERSONNEL WILL OPERATE AIRLINE IF STRIKERS DO NOT RETURN TO WORK BY NOV 6. MINISTER OF EDUCATION GANJI REPORTEDLY SUBMITTED RESIGNATION. NEW MINISTER OF SCIENCE PANAHI RESIGNED TODAY. NATIONAL BANK HAS IMPOSED RESTRICTIONS ON TRANSFER OF CURRENCY OUT OF IRAN. RIOTS AND FIRES THROUGHOUT TEHRAN TODAY. END SUMMARY.

DEMONSTRATIONS AGAIN BLANKETED IRAN OVER THE WEEKEND. FOR FIRST TIME IN SEVERAL WEEKS, TEHRAN HAD WORST VIOLENCE. CONSULATES REPORT DEMONSTRATIONS DISPERSED BY TEAR GAS IN TABRIZ AND PEACEFUL MARCHES IN SHIRAZ. SCHOO BUS LEAVING INTERNATIONAL SCHOOL IN SHIRAZ WAS PELTED WITH STONES, BUT THERE WERE NO INJURIES. TWO DEATHS WERE REPORTED IN BABOL. EVERY CITY, MARTIAL LAW OR NOT, HAD SIZABLE CROWDS IN STREETS.

IN TEHRAN, WHICH HAD FOR DAYS EXPERIENCED LARGE STUDENT RALLIES WITHOUT MUCH VIOLENCE, TROOPS FIRED ON CROWDAS STUDENTS ATTEMPTED TO MOVE FROM TEHRAN UNIVERSITY INTO CITY STREETS. SCENARIO WAS ENACTED TWICE, AS STUDENTS TRIED TO LEAVE EN MASSE ON NOV 3 AND

FIRST DAY, TROOPS FIRED TEAR GAS AND CHARGED CROWD, USING CLUBS. STUDENTS NONETHELESS RIOTED IN SMALLER HIT AND RUN GROUPS, DAMAGING BUILDINGS IN THE AREA. YESTERDAY, HUGH CAMPUS RALLY AGAIN CONFRONTED TROOPS AT MAIN CAMPUS EFTRANCE, THROWING ROCKS AND BOTTLES WHEN TROOPS TOLD THEM TO DISPERSE. JOURNALIST EYEWITNESS SAID TROOPS FIRED TEAR GAS, THEN FIRED IN THE AIR, FINALLY SHOOTING INTO CROWD. REPORTS OF CASUALTIES VARY WIDELY. IT WAS NOT A JALEH SQUARE INCIDENT, BUT REPORTS INDICATE BETWEEN 2 AND 10 WERE KILLED. GOVT ADMITS SHOOTING, DENIES THERE WERE FATALITIES. TEHRAN UNIVERSITY CHANCELLOR, WHO HAS WORKED TO RETAIN CREDIBILITY WITH STUDENTS, ALSO DENIED ANY WERE KILLED THOUGH 11 WOUNDED.

THIS WAS IN ANY CASE THE WORST INCIDENT IN TEHRAN SINCE JALEH SQUARE. SHOOTING DID NOT PREVENT CROWD FROM RANSACKING BANKS, SHOPS, ETC. PRESS IS FULL OF REPORTS OF POLITICAL MOVES, USUALLY INVOLVING A NEW GOVT UNDER NATIONAL FRONT LEADER SANJABI, PERHAPS IN COALITION WITH FORMER PRIMIN ALI AMINI. SANJABI IS EXPECTED TO RETURN FROM PARIS TOWORROW, AND SPECULATION IS RIFE THAT SHAH WILL SUMMON HIM TO DISCUSS FORMING GOVT. ALL THIS REMAINS UNCERTAIN, ESPECIALLY POSSIBILITY THAT AMINI AND INF WOULD COLLABORATE. FRONT SPOKESMAN DARIUSH FOROUHAR YESTERDAY STRONGLY CRITICIZED AMINI FOR BACKSTAGE MANEUVERING. FURTHERMORE, AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI HAS AGAIN REJECTED ANY COMPROMISE, ADDING HE WILL OSTRACIZE ANY PERSON WHO NEGOTIATES WITH THE REGIME.

SENIOR NATIONAL FRONT OFFICIAL PRIVATELY ACCUSED KHOMEINI OF IRRESPONSIBILITY AND SAID HE "ACTS LIKE A FALSE GOD." BUT WE HAVE NO SIGN HE OR ANY OTHER OPPOSITIONIST DARES TO ATTACK KHOMEINI PUBLICLY. AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI HAS REITERATED STANCE THAT HE ONLY WANTS TO SEE CONSTITUTION OBSERVED. HIS POSITION IMPLIES A BREAK WITH KHOMEINI, BUT LIKE OTHER OPPOSITION LEADERS, SHARIATMADARI FEARS TO STATE CLEARLY THAT KHOMEINI IS WRONG.
PRESS REPORTS MINISTER OF EDUCATION MANUCHEHR GANJI HAS SUBMITTED RESIGNATION AND NO LONGER ATTENDS CABINET MEETINGS. TODAY NEW MINISTER OF SCIENCE AND HIGHER EDUCATION PANAHI ALSO RESIGNED.

OPPOSITION DEPUTY AHMAD BANI-AHMAD HAS RESIGNED IN PROTEST OF ALLEGED SEIZURE OF TOWN OF PAVEH (KERMANSHAHAN) BY AGENTS OF TOWN'S MAJLIS DEPUTY SALAR JAAF. HE ACCUSED JAAF OF ORGANIZING VIOLENT COUNTERDEMONSTRATIONS AGAINST JAAF'S OWN TOWN AND OF SEALING IT OFF WITH ARMED AGENTS ON THE HIGHWAY. BANI-AHMAD DEMANDED THAT JAAF BE STRIPPED OF PARLIAMENTARY IMMUNITY AND THEN PROSECUTED. MEANWHILE JAAF IS CONFINED TO PARLIAMENT BUILDING WHILE JUSTICE COMMITTEE CONDUCTS INVESTIGATION. COMMITTEE HAS ALREADY VOTED TO STRIP DEPUTY MANSOUR YASSINI OF IMMUNITY, AND FULL MAJLISSWILL DECIDE ISSUE. YASSINI, A DEPUTY FROM TEHRAN, IS ACCUSED OF CORRUPTION.

FORMER SAVAK CHIEF NASSIRI AND RECENTLY-SACKED HIGH OFFICIAL PARVIZ SABETI ARE CONFINED TO IRAN WHILE THEY FACE MURDER CHARGES IN CONNECTION WITH THEIR LONG TENURE AT SAVAK. JUDICIAL AUTHORITIES HAVE IMPOUNDED THEIR PASSPORTS.

IRAN AIR'SSPOLITICALLY-BASED STRIKE CONTINUES, AND THOSE FOREIGN CARRIERS WHO DEPEND ON IRAN AIR GROUND SUPPORT PERSONNEL HAVE CANCELLED FLIGHTS TO IRAN. MANAGEMENT HAS REPORTEDLY TOLD STRIKERS THAT IF THEY DO NOT RETURN TO WORK BY NOVE 6, AIR FORCE PERSONNEL WILL OPERATE THE AIRLINE.

BANK MELLI(NATIONAL BANK) ACTED YESTERDAY, NOV 4, TO STIFLE FLOW OF CURRENCY ABROAD. ACCORDING TO NEW REGULATIONS NO MORE THAN DOLS 5,000 MAY BESTRANSFERRED IN EACH TRANSACTION, AND CLIENTS MUST FURNISH DOCUMENTS DEMONSTRATING NEED FOR THE TRANSFER. OTHER COMMERCIAL BANKS HAVE FOLLOWED SUIT. *** Current Handling Restrictions *** n/a *** Current Classification *** UNCLASSIFIED
