segments.text: UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, WE RECOMMEND THAT NON-ESSENTIAL TRAVEL TO TEHRAN BE AVOIDED. SOME INTERNATIONAL FLIGHTS AS OF EARLY EVENING ARE OVERFLYING TEHRAN.

1978TEHRAN10782.subject: NOV 5: DAY OF VIOLENCE & BURNING - TEL RELEASED TO HOUSE JUDICIARY COMMITTEE 2-1980 - SEE MEMO FROM A:JAMES MCDONNELL TO FADRC DATED 2-29-80 (P80003 2-1357 EXCISED COPY ATTACHED)

segments.text: AT MID-MORNING LARGE MOBS STARTED TO ASSEMBLE IN VARIOUS PARTS OF THE CITY , PARTICULARLY IN THE SOUTHERN HOTSPOT AREAS OF THE UNIVERSITY AND JALEH SQUARE. AS THE DAY WORE ON, CROWDS LEFT THESE AREAS AND ROAMED THROUGHOUT MANY PARTS OF THE CITY SETTING FIR TO BANKS, CINEMAS, AUTOMOBILES, BUSES, AIRLINE OFFICES, ETC. A PALL OF SMOKE HANGS OVER SOUTH TEHRAN, AND FROM THE EMBASSY WINDOWS LOOKING NORTH WE CAN SEE SOME FIRES. IT APPEARS THAT FIREMENT ARE HAVING DIFFICULTY REACHING THE SCENES OF FIRES OR ARE SIMPLY LETTING THEM BURN THEMSELVES OUT.

BRITISH AMBASSADOR HAS ADVISED THAT AT 1700 HOURS LOCAL THAT BRITISH EMBASSY, WHICH WAS UNPROTECTED, IS UNDER ATTACK AND THAT ENTRANCE TO CHANCERY HAS BEEN GAINED. WE HAVE INFORMED MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES WHO ARE REPORTEDLY SENDING ASSISTANCE. TROOPS HAVE NOW ARRIVED THERE BUT TELEPHONE SYSTEM IN BRITISH COMPOUND IS OUT AND WE HAVE NO REPORT OF DAMAGES.

WE HAVE NOW RELIABLE INFORMATION CONCERNING CASUALITIES. IT APPEARS TO US THAT IN FACT SECURITY FORCES DID NOT USE MUCH FORCE DURING DAY BUT WE NOW (1800 HOURS LOCAL) HAVE REPORTS OF HEAVY SHOOTING IN SOUTH TEHRAN. THE EMBASSY COMPOUND HAS BEEN SURROUNDED BY TROOPS AND THE STREETS LEADING TO THE EMBASSY HAVE BEEN SEALED OFF. WE HAVE NO REPORTS OF INJURIES TO AMERICANS BUT HAVE GIVEN RUFUGE TO FOUR AMERICANS WHO WERE IN THE WALDORF HOTEL WHICH HAS BEEN BURNED. IN EARLY AFTERNOON WE ADVISED THE AMERICAN COMMUNITY TO STAY AT HOME UNLESS TRAVEL IS ESSENTIAL. MANY COMPANIES HAD ALREADY SENT THEIR EMPLOYEES HOME.

WE ARE SENDING OUT A SECOND ADVISORY THIS EVENING RECOMMENDING THAT AMERICAN STAY HOME IN THE MORNING UNTIL WE HAVE HAD AN OPPORTUNITY TO APPRAISE THE SECURITY SITUATION IN THE CITY. THE AMERICAN SCHOOLS WILL BE CLOSED TOMORROW.

COMMENT: THE NUMBER OF DEMONSTRATORS TODAY PROBABLY EXCEEDED THOSE ENGAGED IN THE SEPTEMBER 7 DEMONSTRATION WHICH LED TO THE IMPOSITION OF MARTIAL LAW. EYE WITNESSES HAVE NOTED THAT CROWDS OF FOUR OR FIVE HUNDRED PEOPLE, A SMALL NUMBER HAVE BEEN DOING THE LOOTING, BURNING, BURNING, AND DESTROYING, WITH THE REMAINING MEMBERS OF THE CROWD LOOKING ON AND THE POLICE AND MILITARY EITHER ABSENT OR DOING NOTHING. THE MASSIVE DEMONSZRATIONS TODAY MAY IN PART BE IN RSPONSE TO THE SHOOTINGS AT THE UNIVERSITY YESTERDAY, BUT THERE IS ALSO A SENSE IN THE CITY THAT THE CURRENT CRISIS IS RAPIDLY COMING TO A HEAD.

THE VARIOUS PROTAGONISTS APPEAR TO BE DOING THEIR VERY BEST TO ACCELERATE CRITICAL DECISIONS. THE CITY HAS BEEN RIFE WITH RUMORS AND THE CROWDS OFTEN APPEAR TO BE ACTING UPON THESE RUMORS. CURFEW HAS BEEN IMPOSED FOR 2100 HOURS TONIGHT.

IT IS CLEAR THAT THE CURRENT SITUATION CANNOT BE PERMITTED TO CONTINUE MUCH LONGER. THE NATIONAL FRONG IS (SEPARATE REPORTING) MAKING AN EFFORT TO ARRIVE AT A POLITICAL SOLUTION. IF THAT EFFORT FAILS, WE WOULD EXPECT THE MILITARY TO ATTEMPT TO IMPOSE ITS SOLUTION WITHIN THE NEXT 48 HOURS.

1978TEHRAN10783.subject: WELFARE OF BRITISH EMBASSY STAFF, TEHRAN ALL SAFE AT BRITISH EMBASSY. CONSIDERABLE DAMAGE BY RANSACKING CROWDS. AMBASSADOR AT FRENCH EMBASSY.

segments.text: ALL SAFE AT BRITISH EMBASSY. CONSIDERABLE DAMAGE BY RANSACKING CROWDS. AMBASSADOR AT FRENCH EMBASSY. WILL MOVE HOME VIA ARMORED VEHICLE. TROOPS REPORTEDLY NOW HAVE EMBASSY COMPOUND SECURED. STATE WILL TELEPHONE DETAILS.

1978TEHRAN10784.subject: SCHEDULE AUDIENCE WITH SHAH, NOVEMBER 5 SHAH HAS ASKED ME TO COME SEE HIM. I AM LEAVING IMMEDIATELY. GIVEN CONFUSED SITUATION IN CITY, MA

segments.text: SHAH HAS ASKED ME TO COME SEE HIM. I AM LEAVING IMMEDIATELY. GIVEN CONFUSED SITUATION IN CITY, MAY BE SOME TIME BEFORE I CAN REPORT RESULTS OF THE MEETING.

BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND I HAVE JUST COME FROM TWO HOUR SESSION WITH SHAH. HE TOLD US THAT NATIONAL FRONT HAD REFUSED TO COLLABORATE, AND THAT HE HAD NO ALTERNATIVE BUT TO FORM MILITARY GOVERNMENT. HE INTENDED TO MOVE IMMEDIATELY.

HE WILL APPEAR ON TV MORNING NOVEMBER 6 AT 8AM TO GIVE NATION A SUMMARY OF HIS EFFORTS TO REACH POLITICAL SOLUTION, ANNOUNCE THAT GENERAL AZHARI WILL BE NEW PRIME MINISTER AND THAT MILITARY GOVERNMENT WILL BE TEMPORARY REGIME TO RESTORE LAW AND ORDER. TONIGHT, HE WILL FLOOD TEHRAN WITH TROOPS SO THAT CITY WAKES UP TO FULL MILITARY CONTROL.

MILITARY HAS FULL PLANS TO IMPLEMENT THIS DECISION AND WILL DIVIDE MINISTERIAL RESPONSIBILITIES AMONG VARIOUS SERVICE CHIEFS. HE DOES NOT PERSONALLY KNOW WHETHER THE WHOLE SCHEME WILL WORK, BUT FEELS HE HAS NO CHOICE. HE EXPECTS KHOMEINI TO CALL FOR JIHAD AND ASSUMES THERE WILL BE MORE BLOODSHED.

HE SAID HE WILL ALSO ANNOUNCE THAT ELECTIONS WILL BE HELD AS SOON AS LAW AND ORDER PERMITS. TO FACILITATE THIS AND ALSO TO ENABLE A MILITARY GOVERNMENT TO TAKE OFFICE WITHOUT THE NEED FOR A VOTE OF CONFIDENCE, HE WILL PROBABLY DISSOLVE BOTH HOUSES OF PARLIAMENT.

HE SEEMED RATHER CALM ONCE HE HAD MADE HIS DECISION AND EVEN JOKED A BIT. HE SAID NELSON ROCKEFELLER HAD CALLED HIM YESTERDAY TO STIFFEN HIS SPINE AND HE WAS PREPARED TO OFFER HIM A SEAT IN THE CABINET.

THE CITY WE DROVE THROUGH THIS EVENING LOOKS LIKE A BATTLEFIELD. HOWEVER, CURFEW SEEMS TO BE HOLDING. THE FIRE BRIGADES ARE EXTINGUISHING THE LAST FIRES IN OUR PART OF THE CITY. THERE ARE REPORTS OF CONTINUED CLASHES IN THE SOUTH.

WE ARE SENDING SEPTEL WITH MESSAGE FROM BRITISH AMBASSADOR FOR FCO. BECAUSE HIS COMMUNICATIONS ARE OUT, HE MAY BE USING THIS CHANNEL FOR NEXT FEW DAYS. EMBASSY LONDON IS REQUESTED ACT AS CHANNEL WITH FCO AS NEEDED.
AS FAR AS WE KNOW, ALL U.S. COMMUNITY SAFE. WE MANAGED TO GET MOST OF OUR STAFF HOME AND I HAVE PUT TOMORROW'S ATTENDANCE AT OFFICE ON VOLUNTARY BASIS.
FOR LONDON: YOU SHOULD SHARE ABOVE IN FULL WITH FCO.

SINCE EMBASSY'S REPORT AT 1800 HOURS, THE VIOLENCE IN TEHRAN GRADUALLY DIMINISHED AFTER THE ANNOUNCEMENT OF THE 2100 HOURS CURFEW. SO FAR AS WE CAN TELL THE IRANIAN MILITARY AND POLICE HAVE MOVED RAPIDLY INTO AN EFFECTIVE CURFEW POSTURE. WHILE SOME FIRES ARE STILL SMOLDERING AND SMALL ARMS FIRE HAS BEEN HEARD FROM TIME TO TIME, INCLUDING SOME JUST AFTER THE CURFEW, THE CITY APPEARS GENERALLY, AND POSSIBLY TEMPORARILY, TO BE QUIET.

TEHRAN'S CRISIS TODAY WAS NOT REFLECTED IN THE AREAS OF OUR CONSTITUENT POSTS. REPORTING FROM ISFAHAN, TABRIZ, AND SHIRAZ INDICATES RELATIVE QUIET. THE EXPERIENCE OF RAMPAGING YOUNG PEOPLE PUTTING THE TORCH TO BUILDINGS, CARS, ETC., WAS CONCENTRATED IN THE CAPITAL. AS WE COLLATE INFORMATION AVAILABLE TO US, WHILE AMERICANS AND OTHER FOREIGNERS FOUND THEMSELVES IN DIFFICULT SITUATIONS DURING THE DAY AND THE U.K. EMBASSY WAS SEVERELY DAMAGED, WE KNOW OF NO AMERICANS OR OTHER FOREIGNERS WHO SUFFERED PERSONAL INJURY. OBVIOUSLY IN THE BRIGHT LIGHT OF MORNING WE MAY FIND THIS AN OVERLY SANGUINE OBSERVATION.

THE FREEDOM ENJOYED BY THE RIOTERS TODAY-- THERE WAS VERY LITTLE INTERFERENCE BY THE ARMED FORCES OR POLICE -- WAS STRIKING. THE MILITARY STILL APPEARS TO HAVE SUFFICIENT PRESTIGE TO INTIMIDATE -- WITNESS THE APPARENTLY EFFECTIVE CURFEW -- BUT MEASURES MUST BE TAKEN BY THE GOI IN THE MORNING TO ENSURE A SIMILAR DEGREE OF STABILITY DURING THE WORKING DAY OR WE WOULD ANTICIPATE AN INCREASE IN UNREST TOMORROW, WHICH IS SOMETHING THE TORN FABRIC OF THIS NATION'S CAPITAL CANNOT WITHSTAND.
WHEN ANNOUNCEMENT OF MILITARY GOVERNMENT DID NOT RPT NOT APPEAR ON NIRT AT 0800 NOVEMBER 6 AS I HAD ANTICIAPATED, I TELEPHONE SHAH'S AIDE, AFSHAR, TO FIND OUT WHAT WENT WRONG.
AFSHAR SAID SHAH WAS AT THAT MOMENT (0830) VIDEOTAPING HIS STATEMENT. IT WOULD BE BROADCAST ON NIRT RADIO "WITHIN AN HOUR", BUT TV WOULD CARRY IT ONLY LATER THIS EVENING.

GENERAL AZHARI, WHO WILL BE NAMED NEW PRIME MINISTER, HAS ASKED TO SEE GENERAL GAST, WHOSE OFFICE IS LOCATED IN SAME BUILDING. I HAVE TOLD GAST TO ASSURE AZHARI OF USG SUPPORT AND TO SAY I WAS AVAILABLE TO MEET WITH HIM AT HIS CONVENIENCE. GAST WILL REPORT TO ME AFTER HIS MEETING.

1978TEHRAN10806.subject: TELEPHONE REPORT FROM SHAH MORNING NOVEMBER 6

segments.text: SHAH TELEPHONE ME AT 1045 TO REPORT THAT MILITARY GOVT HAS JUST BEEN INVESTED. HE SAID PUBLIC ANNOUNCEMENT WOULD BE MADE SHORTLY.

I ASKED WHETHER TROOPS HAD ORDERS TO DISPERSE CROWDS. HE REPLIED AFFIRMATIVELY. I THEN RELAYED REPORTS THAT SEVERAL LARGE CROWDS WERE ASSEMBLING IN VARIOUS PARTS OF CITY AND FEW TROOPS PRESENT SEEMED PASSIVE. HE SAID HE WOULD PROD MILITARY AGAIN.

MEETING WHICH GENERAL GAST HAD SCHEDULED WITH GENERAL AZHARI ABORTED BECUASE AZHARI HAS SPENT MOST OF MORNING IN PALACE. GAST IS IN TOUCH WITH GENERAL HATEM, AZHARI'S DEPUTY AND DETECTS NO RPT NO CHANGE AS YET IN MILITARY'S STANCE. ALTHOUGH SEVERAL ARMORED UNITS ARE IN CITY, THERE IS NO "FLOOD" OF TROOPS AS WE HAD BEEN LED TO EXPECT.

1978TEHRAN10817.subject: SHAH SPEECH TO NATION SUMMARY: SHAH SAYS INSECURITY AND KILLING HAVE ENDANGERED COUNTRY. HE HAS DECIDED ON ASTEMPORARY GOVT UNTIL

segments.text: SUMMARY: SHAH SAYS INSECURITY AND KILLING HAVE ENDANGERED COUNTRY. HE HAS DECIDED ON ASTEMPORARY GOVT UNTIL A NATIONAL COALITION GOVT CAN BE FORMED. ADMITTING PAST MISTAKES HE APPEALED TO THE PUBLIC FOR FULL COOPERATION UNTIL THE NEXT GOVT AND FREE ELECTIONS. END SUMMARY
FOLLOWING IS ROUGH TRANSLATION IN ENGLISH OF NOTES TAKEN ON SHAH'S SPEECH TO NATION DELIVERED AT 12 NOON TEHRAN TIME.

BEGIN TEXT: IRANIANS IN THE FREE POLITICAL ATMOSPHERE DEVELOPED IN THE PAST TWO YEARS HAVE RISEN AGAINST ALL INJUSTICES AND THIS REVOLUTION HAS NOT BEEN DISAPPROVED BY ME. UNFORTUNATELY IT HAS REACHED THE POINT WHERE IT HAS CREATED ANARCHY (PERSIAN "HARJOMARGE" WAS USED), RIOTS, DEMONSTRATIONS AND STRIKES. IT REACHED THE POINT WHERE THE OIL WAS CUT WHICH IS THE MAIN SOURCE FOR THE LIFE OF THE COUNTRY. INSECURITY AND KILLING HAVE CREATED ECONOMIC PARALYSIS AND THE COUNTRY IS IN DANGER. WHAZ HAS HAPPENED YESTERDAY COULD NOT BE TOLERATED. 8I HAVE THEREFORE DECIDED TO HAVE A TEMPORARY GOVT UNTIL WE CAN HAVE A NATIONAL COALITION GOVT.

I EMPHASIZE THAT THIS IS TEMPORARY UNTIL LAW AND ORDER ARE RESTORED. I HAVE SWORN AS KING TO PROTECT THE CONSTITUTION, RESTORE LAW AND ORDER AND FIGHT CORRUPTION TO MAKE SURE IT WILL NOT REPEAT ITSELF.

I COMMIT MYSELF TO MAKE UP FOR PAST MISTAKES, TO FIGHT CORRUPTION, INJUSTICES AND TO FORM A NATIONAL GOVT TO CARRY OUT FREE ELECTIONS. I GUARANTEE THAT AFTER THE MILITARY GOVT, FREEDOM AND THE CONSTITUTION WILL BE FULLY IMPLEMENTED. YOUR REVOLUTIONARY MESSAGE WAS HEARD* I AM AWARE OF EVERYTHING YOU HAVE GIVEN YOUR LIVES FOR. UNDER PRESENT CIRCUMSTANCES IT IS THE DUTY OF THE MILITARY TO PROTECT THE COUNTRY AND THEY NEED YOUR FULL COOPERATION UNTIL THE NEXT GOVT AND FREE ELECTIONS.

YOU AND I IN THE PAST 30 PLUS YEARS HAVE SEEN MANY THINGS HAPPEN AND I HOPE GOD WILL HELP US TO REACH A PEACEFUL SOLUTION. ONCE LAW AND ORDER ARE ESTABLISHED UNDER THIS GOVT THE NEXT COALITION GOVT WILL SPEED UP WORK AND GET DOWN TO THE BUSINESS OF HOLDING FREE ELECTIONS.
I HAVE ASKED THE RELIGIOUS HEADS, THE YOUTH AND PARENTS TO ELIMINATE THE PRESENT SITUATION. I ASKED THE YOUTH NOT TO DRAG THE COUNTRY INTO FIRE AND BLOOD.
I HAVE ASKED POLITICAL LEADERS TO LEAVE ASIDE THEIR DIFFERENCES AND UNITE. WORKERS AND FARMERS HAV BEEN ASKED TO COOPERATE ALSO. I HOPE GOD WILL HELP TO SOLVE ALL OUR PROBLEMS. END .

SPEECH WILL BE REPLAYED ON TV LATER THIS AFTERNOON. IN DELIVERING SPEECH SHAH SOUNDED A BIT TIRED AND SLIGHTLY DEPRESSED BUT FIRM.EMBASSY WILL BE PROBBING REACTION INITIAL VIEW OF SEVERAL ESTABLISHMENT PERSIANS WAS THAT SPEECH HAD COME OFF WELL, BUT THAT RESULTS WOULD BE SEEN IN THE STREETS.

1978TEHRAN10818.subject: MORE ON MEETING WITH SHAH, NOVEMBER 5

segments.text: FOR THE RECORD, FOLLOWING DETAILS OF NOVEMBER 5 AUDIENCE WITH SHAH MAY BE OF INTEREST. SINCE I ARRIVED AT PALACE NEARLY ONE HOUR BEFORE BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND HAVE NOT YET SHARED ALL THIS WITH HIM, EMBASSY LONDON MAY WISH FILL IN FCO.

SHAH AND I DISCUSSED QUESTION OF DISSOLVING PARLIAMENT FOR SOME TIME. WHILE HE WANTED TO PRESERVE ESSENCE OF CONSTITUTION, HE DID NOT FEEL A PARLIAMENTARY DEBATE AND VOTE OF CONFIDENCE ON MILITARY GOVT WAS FITTING. ON THE OTHER HAND, IF HE DISSOLVED PARLIAMENT, HE WOULD THEORETICALLYHAVE TO HOLD ELECTIONS WITHIN THREE MONTHS. HE RAISED ISSUE AGAIN WITH BRITISH AMBASSADOR AFTER LATTER'S ARRIVAL, AND FINALLY CAME DOWN ON SIDE OF DISSOLUTION.

SHAH SAID HE HAD GIVEN EXPLICIT ORDERS THAT NO MEMBERS OF THE NATIONAL FRONT, PAN IRAN, OR OTHER MODERATE OPPOSITION GROUPS SHOULD BE ARRESTED. HE SAID HE STILL HAD HOPES OF BRINGING SOME OF THOSE PEOPLE INTO A COALITION GOVT. AS FOR KHOMEINI, HE DOUBTED FRENCH COULD SILENCE HIM, BUT, AT LEAST IN THE FIRST FEW DAYS, HE WOULD CUT OFF KHOMEINI'S MASS APPEALS BY TIGHT CONTROL OF THE LOCAL MEDIA.

HE SAID MILITARY WANTED TO ARREST SOME TWO HUNDRED "CORRUPT PEOPLE" TO DEMONSTRATE THEIR COMMITMENT TO MORALITY. BOTH BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND I SUGGESTED THAT, IN FIRST SEVERAL DAYS, GOVT SHOULD DEVOTE ITSELF EXCLUSIVELY TO RESTORING LAW AND ORDER. ALL FOREIGN TRAVEL COULD BE STOPPED AND POTENTIAL CULPRITS KEPT AVAILABLE FOR ARREST LATER. HE SEEMED TO ACCEPT THIS.

HE DISCUSSED THE QUESTION OF THE MEDIA. HE WONDERED IF HE SHOULD TRY TO KEEP PAPERS OPEN OR CLOSE THEM. AS FAR AS NIRT WAS CONCERNED, HE FELT GOVT SHOULD BE ABLE TO REGAIN CONTROL. I URGED HIM TO KEEP NIRT OPEN AND PROTECT ITS FACILITIES AGSINST SABOTAGE. HE CALLED GENERAL OVEISI AND TOLD HIM TO SEND TANKS TO NIRT. WITHIN TEN MINUTES, WE HEARD THEM CLANKING BY THE PALACE. ON THE PRESS, HE FINALLY DECIDED TO CLOSE PAPERS FOR FEW DAYS UNTIL PUBLISHERS AND EDITORS COULD REGAIN CONTROL.
ON SCHOOLS AND UNIVERSITIES, HE EXHIBITED NO RPT NO DOUBTS. SCHOOLS WOULD BE CLOSED FOR A FEW DAYS, UNIVERSITIES INDEFINITELY.
I ASKED WHETHER THERE WAS ANY VALUE IN SENDING A MESSAGE TO AYATOLLAH SHARIAT-MADARI EXPLAINING HIS ACTIONS, IN AN ATTEMPT TO KEEP HIM FROM JOINING THE KHOMEINI OPPOSITION. HE SAID HE WOULD TRY.

IN DESCRIBING PASSIVE BEHAVIOR OF TROOPS DURING DAY'S RAMPAGE, I SAID THERE WERE SOME CYNICS WHO FELT MILITARY HAD LET THE DESTRUCTION TAKE ITS COURSE IN ORDER TO FORCE THE SHAH'S HAND. HE GAVE A WEARY SHRUG AND SAID, "THESE DAYS, ANTHING IS POSSIBLE." I ALSO ASKED ABOUT PRIME MINISTER'S ALLEGATIONS THAT SAVAK WAS BEHIND MANY CURRENT PROBLEMS IN COUNTRY. HE SAID HE DOUBTED IT, BUT FRANKLY COULD NOT BE SURE.

WHEN SHAH HAD MADE ALL HIS DECISIONS, HE PUT IN CALL TO SHAHBANOU. WHILE MY COMPREHENSION OF FARSI IS MINIMAL, I GATHERED IMPRESSION THAT SHE WAS RATHER RESISTANT TO THE MOVE TO A MILITARY GOVT. HE SPENT TEN MINUTES VERY PATIENTLY AND GENTLY EXPLAINING HIS DECISION AND THEN ASKED HER TO THINK OF SOMEONE WHO MIGHT SERVE AS A MESSENGER TO SHARIAT-MADARI. THIS WAS A RATHER INTERESTING INSIGHT INTO THE PAVHLAVI FAMILY RELATIONSHIP.

ONE CURIOUS PIECE OF EVIDENCE ABOUT THE STATE OF CONFUSION AT NIAVARAN. I WAS WISKED THROUGH THE GATE BY A VERY ALERT IMPERIAL GUARD COLONEL. HOWEVER, WHEN I REACHED THE PALACE ITSELF THERE WAS NO ONE AT THE DOOR, WHICH WAS NOT LOCKED. I OPENED DOOR AND WANDERED INTO THE MAIN RECEPTION ROOM. FIRST PERSON I ENCOUNTERED WAS SHAHBANOU, WHO WAS COMING OUT OF SITTING ROOM. SHE CALLED A FLUNKY WHO EVENTUALLY PRODUCED AN AID-DE-CAMP. NOT THE USUAL APPROACH TO THE PEACOCK THRONE.

1978TEHRAN10820.subject: IRANIAN OIL CUTBACK AND PEACE NEGOTIATIONS

segments.text: THE BULK (APPROXIMATELY 80 PERCENT) OF THE CRUDE SUPPLIED BY IRAN TO ISRAEL IS PRODUCED BY THE JOINT VENTURE IPAC (50 PERCENT NIOC AND 50 PERCENT AMOCO) AND LAPCO (50 PERCENT NIOC WITH THE REMAINING SHARE DIVIDED EQUALLY BETWEEN ARCO, MURPHY, SUN AND UNION, ALL U.S. FIRMS). AS WE HAVE REPORTED, IPAC PRODUCTION HAS BEEN COMPLETELY SHUT-DOWN FOR ALMOST TWO WEEKS, AND LAPCO PRODUCTION WAS SHUT IN, FOR THE SECOND TIME, ON NOVEMBER 4.

ALMOST ALL OF THE CRUDE PRODUCED BY IPAC AND LAPCO WHICH NORMALLY FLOWS TO ISRAEL IS SOLD FOR THE ACCOUNT OF NIOC (I.E., ISRAEL'S PRINCIPAL SUPPLIER IS NIOC RATHER THAN THE SECOND PARTIES IN IPAC AND LAPCO). SINCE IPAC AND LAPCO ARE COMPLETELY SHUT-DOWN THE OBVIOUS OPTION IS ONE OF STOCK MANAGEMENT RATHER THAN PRORATIONING OF REDUCED LIFTINGS. HOWEVER, IPAC HAS PRACTICALLY NO CRUDE LEFT IN STORAGE ON KHARG ISLAND (AND PROBABLY LITTLE IF ANY ON THE OFF SHORE BARGE THROUGH WHICH CYRUS FIELD CRUDE IS EXPORTED).
WE DO NOT HAVE ANY SPECIFIC INFORMATION ON HOW MUCH CRUDE IS LEFT IN LAPCO'S APPROXIMATELY 3 MILLION BARRELS OF TANKAGE ON LAVAN ISLAND BUT IT IS UNLIKELY THAT THERE IS MUCH.

MOST OF THE REMAINING 20 PERCENT OF THE CRUDE EXPORTED TO ISRAEL (IN NORMAL TIMES) IS PRODUCED IN THE KHUSESTAN FIELDS BY OSCO. ACCORDING TO OUR INFO ALL OF THIS CRUDE IS SOLD FOR THE ACCOUNT OF NIOC AND DOES NOT INVOLVE ANY OF THE CONSORTIUM TRADING COMPANIES. GIVEN THE SMALL AMOUNTS INVOLVED, NIOC WOULD PROBABLY HAVE LITTLE DIFFICULTY MAINTAINING ITS NORMAL DELIVERIES OF KHUSESTAN FIELDS CRUDE TO ISRAEL.

THE IMPORTANT QUESTION IS WHETHER AND HOW NIOC COULD OBTAIN INCREMENTAL QUANTITIES OF KHUZESTAN FIELDS CRUDE TO REPLACE THAT LOST FROM THE SHUT DOWN OF IPAC AND LAPCO. WE DO NOT KNOW EXACTLY HOW THE CONSORTIUM AND NIOC ARE DIVIDING THE CRUDE THAT IS AVAILABLE FOR EXPORT (BETWEEN 700,000 AND 1,232,000 BARRELS DURING THE PAST WEEK), BUT WE UNDERSTAND THAT THE TANKERS AWAITING CARGOS AT KHARG ARE LOADED ON THE BASIS OF THEIR PLACE ON THE LOADING SCHEDULE WHICH HAD, PRIOR TO THE CUT-BACK, BEEN FINALIZED BY THE CONSORTIUM OFFICE IN LONDON ON THE BASIS OF BOTH NIOC AND CONSORTIUM MEMBER COMPANY NOMINATIONS.
EMBASSY LONDON COULD PROBABLY OBTAIN MORE DETAILED INFORMATION, BUT IT IS OUR IMPRESSION THAT NIOC WILL ONLY GET ITS PRORATA SHARE OF THE REDUCED QUANTITIES OF CRUDE AVAILABLE FOR EXPORT.
IN SUMMARY, WE BELIEVE THAT SHIPMENT OF CRUDE TO ISRAEL HAS BEEN SEVERELY CURTAILED AND WE SEE LITTLE LIKELIHOOD THAT NIOC WILL BE WILLING OR ABLE TO REVERSE THE SITUATION.

ALTHOUGH EMBASSY TEL AVIV IS UNDOUBTEDLY BETTER QUALIFIED THAN WE TO ASSESS THE IMPACT ON ISAEL'S ECONOMY AND SECURITY OF THE CURTAILMENT OF IRANIAN CRUDE EXPORTS, WE HAVE THE IMPRESSION THAT ISRAEL'S SECURITY IS NOT AND WILL NOT BE SERIOUSLY AFFECTED BY EVEN A TOTAL CUT IN SUPPLY OF IRANIAN CRUDE. THAT WAS THE THRUST OF THE COMMENTS MADE YESTERDAY BY THE NEW ECONOMIC COUNSELOR OF THE ISRAELI MISSION IN TEHRAN WHEN HE CALLED ON OUR E/C COUNSELOR.

ACCORDING TO THE ISRAELI DIPLOMAT, THE WELLS IN THE SINAI PRODUCE 40 PERCENT OF DOMESTIC REQUIREMENTS AND HE SAID THAT SUCCESS OF ONGOING NEGOTIATIONS WITH EGYPT OVER WITHDRAWAL FROM THE SINAI WILL DEPEND IN PART ON ASSURANCES OF CONTINUED ISRAELI ACCESS TO THAT OIL. OUR ISRAELI INTERLOCUTOR ALSO MENTIONED THAT MEXICO NOW SUPPLIES SOME OF ISRAEL'S CRUDE IMPORTS, ALBEIT AT A HIGHER PRICE THAN FOR IMPORTS FROM IRAN, AND HE SAID THAT ISRAEL COULD, IF NEEDED, INCREASE ITS IMPORTS FROM MEXICO.

1978TEHRAN10826.subject: POLITICAL/ SECURITY REPORT NOV 6 CONFIDENTIAL CONFIDENTIAL

segments.text: SUMMARY: SHARIF-EMAMI GOVT RESIGNED, HAS BEEN REPLACED BY MILITARY GOVT UNDER GENERAL AZHARI.TEHRAN MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATION ISSUED TOUGH DIRECTIVE. CROWDS NONETHE LESS GATHERED IN DEFINANCE, AND SOME INCIDENTS HAVE TAKEN PLACE. AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI CALLS FOR CALM, WITHOUT NEW MARCHES. ARMY SEIZED NIRT YESTERDAY TO PREVENT SABOTAGE. ARRESTS ARE EXPECTED. EMB ADVISED AMCITS TO STAY HOME TODAY. SANJABIKHOMEINI JOINT COMMUNIQUE REJECTS COMPROMISE, CALLS MONARCHY ILLEGAL. YESTERDAY'S DAMAGE WAS SELECTIVE AND WIDESPREAD. END SUMMARY

SHARIF EMAMI GOVT HAS RESIGNED IN WAKE OF YESTERDAY'S LARGE-SCALE RIOTING, TO BE REPLACED BY MILITARY GOVT HEADED BY GEN QOLAM REZA AZHARI, CHIEF OF SUPREME COMMANDER'S STAFF, AND ASSISTED BY CHIEFS OF INDIVIDUAL SERVICES. EACH MILITARY CHIEF WILL SUPERVISE SEVERAL MINISTERIES, WITH DAY TO DAY OPERATIONS IN HANDS OF CAREER UNDERSECRETARIES. SHAH ADDRESSED THE NATION LATE MORNING (SEPTEL).

SHAH HAS TOLD AMBASSADOR PARLIAMENT WILL PROBABLY BUT HE WAS NOT SURE (NOTE: SPEECH IN SEPTEL DOES NOT HAVE THIS), BE DISSOLVED, AND THERE WILL BE ARRESTS OF DISSIDENTS, BUT NO NATIONAL FRONT, PAN-IRANIST (PEZESHKPOUR) OR BANI-AHMAD FOLLOWERS WILL BE ARRESTED. (COMMENT: THIS MIGHT POSSIBLY LEAVE SUCH PROMINENT DISSIDENTS AS MINATCHI, MOGHADAM, AND THE LIBERATION MOVEMENT OF IRAN LIABLE TO ARREST.)

TEHRAN MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATION THIS MORNING ISSUED TOUGH NEW DIRECTIVE. REPEATING PREVIOUS ANNOUNCEMENT OF NEW CURFEW HOURS OF 9 PM TO 5 AM, MLA RESTATED ORIGINAL POLICY THAT GATHERINGS OF TWO OR MORE PEOPLE ARE PROHIBITED. MARTIAL LAW VIOLATORS WILL BE WARNED BY AN OFFICER; IF THEY DO NOT OBEY, TROOPS WILL FIRE ON THEM. ALL SCHOOLS ARE TO REMAIN CLOSED THROUGH NOV 12. TROOPS HAVE BEEN CONCENTRATED IN SOUTH TEHRAN AND NEAR UNIVERSITY. EMBASSY HAS REPORTS OF FIRING NEAR ROUDAKI HALL IN CENTRAL CITY AND HEAVY FIRING, INCLUDING AUTOMATIC WEAPONS, IN TEHRAN UNIVERSITY AREA HOWEVER, MUCH OF FIRING HAS BEEN IN AIR.

CAMPUS WAS LOCKED BUT STUDENTS FORCED THEIR WAY IN. POLICE THEN DISLODGED THEM, AND THEY CONFRONTED TROOPS DEPLOYED IN UNIVERSITY STRICT. PEOPLE ALSO GATHERED NEAR BRITISH EMBASSY, WHICH WAS DAMAGED YESTERDAY AND TROOPS WERE SENT AT OUR REQUEST TO PROTECT U.S. EMBASSY IS, HOWEVER, UNDER MILITARY GUARD.

ARMY LAST NIGHT SET UP GUARD AT NATIONAL IRANIAN RADIO AND TELEVISION (NIRT), AND TODAYS BROADCASTS INCLUDED VOICES DIFFERENT FROM THOSE USUALLY HEARD. NIRT DIRECT HAS RESIGNED. ONLY RASTAKHIZ NEWSPAPER APPEARED THIS MORNING.

PROMINENT DISSIDENT AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI WAS QUOTED OVER GOVT RADIO AS APPEALING FOR CALM TODAY, TELLING PROTESTORS NOT TO MARCH IN STREETS, WHICH RAISES QUESTIONS AS TO WHO TODAY'S DEMONSTRATORS ARE. ------------------025739 061644Z /44 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1410 INFO USINT BAGHDAD AMCONSUL DHAHRAN AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE CINCPAC AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 10826

SHAH CONSULTED WITH SEVERAL LEADERS, INCLUDING AMINI AND ENTEZAM BEFORE AGREEING TO MILITARY GOVT. HE DID NOT SEE BAZARGAN OR MINATCHI AND HAS INTERPRETED NATIONA FRONT POSITION AS INFLEXIBLE. EMBOFF LEARNED AFTERNOON NOV 5 THAT KARIM SANJABI HAS ISSUED JOINT STATEMENT WITH AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI IN PARIS, WHICH CONTAINED THREE POINTS

THE MONARCHY WITH ITS PERPETUAL VIOLATIONS OF CONSTITUTION, TERRORISM AND CORRUPTION MUST NOT BE SUPPORTED. B) THE NATIONAL-ISLAMIC MOVEMENT CANNOT APPROVE AN ILLEGAL MONARCHY. C) THE GOVERNMENT OR IRAN OUGHT TO BE BASED ON DEMOCRATIC PRINCIPLES "APPROVED BY THE VOICE OF THE PEOPLE". (VOICE OF THE PEOPLE" WAS DESCRIBED TO LOCAL PRESS BY NATIONAL FRONT SPOKESMAN AS "REFERENDUM OF THE PEOPLE," THOUGH NATIONAL FRONT LEADER SHAHPOUR BAKHTIAR TOLD EMBOFF AND VISITORS HE THOUGHT IT MEANT MERELY FREE ELECTIONS.) MAKHTAIR'S INTERPRETATION OF AGREEMENT WAS THAT IT OPENED WAY FOR POSSIBLE MODERATE RELIGIOUS PARTICIPATION IN GOVERNMENT, BUT PREDOMINANT LOCAL INTERPRETATION SEES TEXT AS VICTORY FOR KHOMEINI.
BAKHTIAR RECEIVED PHONE CALL FROM PARIS WHICH INFORMED HIM THAT RADICAL IRANIAN STUDENT GROUPS, ESPECIALLY GERMAN CONFEDERATION, WERE "VERY DISAPPOINTED" THAT KHOMEINI HAD "BEEN SO SOFT."

YESTERDAY'S VIOLENCE WAS SELECTIVE AND VERY HEAVY. IN LARGE SECTIONS OF TOWN EVEY BANK WAS LOOTED OR BURNED. TRAVEL OFFICES, MOVIE THEATERS, LIQUOR STORES AND SEVERAL HOTELS WERE DESTROYED OR HEAVILY DAMAGED. RIOTERS ALSO BURNED MANY BUSES AND AUTOMOBILES. MIN. OF INFORMATION AMELI-TEHRANI WAS REPORTEDLY BEATEN WHEN MOB STORMED HIS MINISTRY, SETTING IT ON FIRE. PUBLIC ORDER IN CENTRAL TEHRAN COLLAPSED FOR SEVERAL HOURS. WHERE TROOPS WERE PRESENT, THEY DID LITLE OR NOTHING TO PREVENT ATTACKS ON BUILDINGS. CONSULATES TABRIZ AND ISFAHAN REPORT NO SPECIAL DISTURBANCES YESTERDAY. TABRIZ DID HAVE DEMONSTRATIONS BUT NO VIOLENCE.

CONSULATE SHIRAZ REPORTS LARGE DEMONSTRATION NOV 4 AND ANOTHER YESTERDAY, THIS TIME RESULTING IN TROOPS OPENING FIRE. THERE ARE REPORTS OF TWO KILLED. TEAR GAS FORCES EVACUATION OF SAIDI HOSPITAL. TODAY LARGE CROWD IS GATHERING ON PAHLAVI UNIVERSITY CAMPUS.

NEW AZHARI GOVT HAS ANNOUNCED FOLLOWING MINISTERIAL ASSIGNMENTS: INCLUMBENT AFSHAR - FOREIGN AFFAIRS; INCLUMBENT AZIMI WAR; INCLUMBENT MOTAMEDI - PTT; INCLUMBENT AMIN - INDUSTRY AND MINES; INCLUMENT GENERAL GHARABAGHI - INTERIOR PLUS (NEW ASSIGNMENT); ECONOMY AND FINANCE; GEN. OVEISI (COMMANDER OF GROUND FORCES AND MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR OF TEHRAN)LABOR; GEN. RABII (COMMANDER OF AIR FORCE)-HOUSING; LT. GEN. MOGHADAM (DEPUTY FOR AMMUNITION, MIN. OF WAR) - POWER; GEN ABDOL ASSAN SAEDATMAND (CHIEF OF HIGH DISCIPLINARY COURT IIGF)-INFORMATION AND TOURISM; ADM HABIBOLLAHI (COMMANDER OF NAVY)-EDUCATION, SCIENCE AND HIGHER EDUCATION, CULTURE AND ARTS.
REST OF MINISTRIES WILL BE RUN BY PRESENT UNDERSECRETARIES UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE.
AS INDICATED BY THE SHAH, THESE ASSIGNMENTS ARE BROADLY SUPERVISORY WITH DAY-TO-DAY WORK BEING RUN BY UNDERSECRETARIES AND CIVIL SERVANTS IN THE MINISTRIES.

1978TEHRAN10828.subject: SECURITY ADVISORY - TEL WAS RELEASED TO HOUSE JUDICIARY COMMITTEE 2-1980 - SEE MEMO FR A:JIM MCDONNELL TO FADRC DATED 2-29-80 (P800032-1357)

segments.text: WE HAVE ISSUED FOLLOWING SECURITY ADVISORY TO AMERICAN COMMUNITY: . THE LAW AND ORDER HAS IMPROVED. WITH APPROPRIATE CAUTION YOU CAN PLAN ON RESUMING IMPORT WORK TOMORROW MORNING. WE WILL ADVISE YOU IF THE SITUATION CHANGES. UNQUOTE.

1978TEHRAN10832.subject: FOLLOW-UP POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT NOV 6 CONFIDENTIAL CONFIDENTIAL

segments.text: CONSULATE ISFAHAN REPORTS SCATTERED VIOLENCE FOLLOWING NOON ANNOUNCMENT OF NEW MILITARY GOVT. MLA HAD HEAVILY REINFORCED ARMY CONTINGENT THIS MORNING AFTER STUDENTS DISTRIBUTED CIRCULARS CALLING FOR ARMED REBELLION IF MILITARY GOVT ESTABLISHED. WITHIN TEN MINUTES OF OFFICIAL ANNOUNCEMENT, DEMONSTRATIONS LED TO VIOLENT CONFRONTATIONS BETWEEN TROOPS AND SMALL GROUPS. FIRING IS REPORTED IN AT LEAST FOUR PLACES, INCLUDING NEAR CONSULATE. CROWD PELTED GRUMMAN OFFICE BUILDING WITH STONES, BREAKING WINDOWS, THEN WERE QUICKLY DISPERSED. LARGE CROWDS ARE GATHERING ON CAMPUS, REPORTEDLY TO WAIT FOR KHOMEINI'S REACTION TO MILITARY RULE.

IN VIEW OF ATTACK ON GRUMMAN OFFICES, CONSULATE ISFAHAN HAS ISSUED SAME ADVISORY TO AMCITS AS WAS ISSUED IN TEHRAN YESTERDAY. (BUT REVISED TODAY) CITIZENS ARE TO GO HOME AND STAY THERE UNTIL FURTHER NOTIFICATION BY CONSULATE.
CONSULATE TABRIZ REPORTS LARGE DEMONSTRATION IN AREA OF CONSULATE. SECURITY FORCES SEEM UNABLE TO CONTROL DEMONSTRATORS EFFECTIVELY.
TROUBLE SEEMS TO BE BUILDING UP IN THE SHAH REZA AND TEHRAN UNIVERSITY AREAS.

ON OPPOSITION REACTION WE HAVE COMES FROM RELIGIOUS AND HUMAN RIGHTS SPOKEAN MINATCHI. HE SAID SPEECH IS NOT BAD IF MILITARY GOVT IS SHORT AND LEAVES THE WAY OPEN FOR A NEW COALITION GOVT TO EMERGE EARLY. EARLIER IN THE DAY, NATIONAL FRONT'S SPOKESMAN HAD SPOKEN OF THE NEED TO MAINTAIN UNITY AND CALM, REFRAINING FROM "ILLOGICAL EXCITEMENT." THIS FALLS IN THE SAME CATEGORY AT AYATOLLAH TALAGHANI (KHOMEINI SUPPORTER) CALL EARLY TODAY FOR THE MASSES TO AVOID CONFLICTS SO AS NOT TO BE BLAMED FOR ARSON, DESTRUCTION AND BLOODSHED. LEADING OPPOSITION POLITICIAN MOGHADAM ALSO FELT SPEECH SEEMS GOOD.
FINALLY, NATIONAL FRONT LEADER BAKTIAR TOLD US HE THOUGHT SPEECH WAS "CALM AND RESONABLE."

AMERICAN BUSINESSMEN, PRESUMABLY REFLECTING REACTIONS OF THEIR IRANIAN COUNTERPARTS, ESPECIALLY LIKED SHAH'S REFERENCE TO RE-ESTABLISHMENT OF LAW AND ORDER. MEMBER OF IRANIAN BANKING COMMUNITY SAW IN THE SPEECH A FIRM HAND BY SHAH, HAVING LEARNED THE LESSONS OF THE PAST.

LOYALIST LADY MEMBER OF PARLIAMENT THOUGHT THE SPEECH GOOD, BUT NOTED ITS SIGNIFICANCE WOULD DEPEND ON HOW IT IMPRESSED THE DEMONSTRATORS IN THE STREET. GOVT NEEDS PRACTICAL MEASURES IN ORDER TO REGAIN ITS CREDIBILITY. LONG TIME IRANIAN JOURNALIST NOTED ONE IMPORTANT ELEMENT MISSING FROM OTHERWISE GOOD SPEECH -- NO MENTION OF PUNISHMENT OF THOSE GUILTY OF PAST WRONGS. HE THOUGHT THIS WOULD BE AN OMISSION THAT WOULD BE REMARKED UPON.

IN BRIEF SAMPLING BY ICA OFFICERS OF SENIOR NATIONAL EMPLOYEES, A SENATOR, INTERNATIONAL LAWYER, SOME STAFF MEMBERS OF NIRT, THE UNIVERSTIY CHANCELLOR, A COLLEGE PROFESSOR AND TWO IRANIAN BUSINESSMEN, FOLLOWING WAS THE GENERAL CONSENSUS: (A) SPEECH WAS GENERALLY APPEALING; IT IS GOOD THAT THE SHAH APOLOGIZED FOR PAST ACTIONS AND SUPPORTED CONTINUED MOVEMENT TOWARD DEMOCRACY; (B) SPEECH SHOULD HAVE BEEN MADE MONTHS AGO; MAY BE TOO LATE; (C) MILITARY GOVT WILL NOT LAST LONG BUT MAY COOL THE SITUATION FOR TIME BEING; (D) ALL DOUBTED ABILITY OF THE MILITARY TO RUN THE GOVT OVER AN EXTENDED PERIOD OF TIME DUE TO ITS INEXPERIENCE IN CIVILIAN MATTERS; (E) THOSE WHO KNOW NEW PM PERSONNALY SPOKE HIGHLY OF HIM AS AN HONEST AND INCORRUPTIBLE OFFICER.

A VERY SMALL SAMPLING OF COLLEGE STUDENTS FOUND THEM GENERALLY CYNICAL AND BELIEVING THAT YESTERDAY'S VIOLENCE WAS CAREFULLY STAGE-MANAGED TO PERMIT THE IMPOSITION OF MILITARY RULE. TO THESE STUDENTS, THE SHAH'S CREDIBILITY REMAINS VERY MUCH IN QUESTION.

APPRECIATE REFTEL. WE HAVE TWO INITIAL THOUGHTS: (A) QUICK WASHINGTON REPLIES TO GOI QUERIES ABOUT NON-LETHAL EQUIPMENT WOULD BE VERY HELPFUL (SUCH AS TO TEHRAN 10829 ON PERSONEL CARRIERS); AND (B) WE WILL MAKE DISCREET INQUIRIES WITH BRITISH AND IRANIAN TO SEE IF WE CAN BE HELPFUL TO MEET CURRENT GOI NEEDS. WILL KEEP YOU INFORMED ON LATTER.

NIOC CHAIRMAN HUSHANG ANSARY WENT TO NEW YORK NOVEMEBER 2 AND TOLD ME HE WOULD RETURN TO TEHRAN ABOUT NOVEMBER 4. AS OF NOVEMBER 7, HE HAS NOT RPT NOT RETURNED AND HIS ABSENCE IS CAUSING CONSPICIOUS CONCERN AT NIOC.

ANSARY HAD TOLD ME, IN CONFIDENCE, THAT HE WAS CONSIDERING RESIGNATION FROM NIOC IF A NEW GOVT WERE FORMED. I HAD COUNSELLED AGAINST SUCH ACTION AS A FURTHER DESTABILIZING FACTOR IN TRYING TO RESTORE OIL PRODUCTION.

IN SPECULATING ON HIS CONTINUED ABSENCE, I AM MOVED TO WONDER WHETHER HE FEARS ARREST BY MILITARY IF HE RETURNS TO IRAN. HE PROBABLY KNOWS MILITARY HAS LIST OF ABOUT TWO HUNDRED "CORRUPT PERSONS" SCHEDULED FOR PROSECUTION AND MAY WONDER IF HE IS ON THAT LIST. HE THEREFORE MAY BE DELAYING RETURN UNTIL THE LIST IS PUBLISHED.
IN ANY EVENT, I BELIEVE HIS CONTINUED ABSENCE IS A HANDICAP TO THOSE NIOC OFFICIALS ATTEMTING TO RESTORE PRODUCTION. IF DEPT CAN LOCATE HIM, I WOULD BE INTERESTED IN KNOWNING HIS INTENTIONS.

WE BELIEVE INCLUDING AIRCRAFT CARRIER IN MIDLINK WOULD NOT RPT NOT BE USEFUL IN TERMS OF OUR RELATIONS WITH IRAN. FACT THAT CARRIER WAS INVOLVED IN EXERCISE WOULD PROBABLY NOT BE KNOWN TO WIDE RANGE OF IRANIANS, BUT MANY OF THOSE WHO WERE AWARE OF IT (IN BOTH GOVERNMENT AND MODERASE OPPOSITION) WOULD VIEW SUCH INVOLEMENT AS HEAVY-HANDED OR COUNTERPRODUCTIVE. IN ADDITION, CHANGING CENTO SCENARIO AT THIS LATE DATE WOULD PROBABLY RESULT IN UNNECESSARY FLAP AMONG INDIVIDUALS AND GOVERNMENTQ INVOLVED.

1978TEHRAN10858.subject: SAFETY OF AMERICANS AND EMBASSY PREMISES

segments.text: WE ARE RECEIVING ANXIOUS INQUIRIES BY LONG DISTANCE TELEPHONE APPARENTLY STIMULATED BY FALSE UPI REPORT THAT EMBASSY PREMISES WERE ATTACKED ON NOV 5. PLEASE DO WHATEVER YOU CAN TO CORRECT THE RECORD AND ENSURE THAT SCS, LOUNGE AND OTHER OFFICES WHICH MAY RECEIVE INQUIRIES ARE AWARE THAT IRANIAN GOVT PROVIDED EXCELLENT SECURITY, EMBASSY WAS NOT ATTACKED AND THAT, AS FAR AS WE KNOW, NO AMERICAN, PRIVATE OR OFFICIAL, HAS BEEN INJURED. ALSO, WOULD APPRECIATE YOUR USING ABOVE TO KEEP DOWN THE NUMBER OF W/W REQUESTS.
I UNDERSTAND BBC WORLD SERVICE IS CARRYING REPORT THAT AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI HAS CALLED FOR "ARMED REBELLION" AGAINST SHAH. WE HAVE SOME REASON TO BELIEVE (AND TO HOPE) THAT THIS REPORT IS INACCURATE.
IT WOULD BE THE HEIGHT OF IRRESPONSIBILITY FOR BBC PERSIAN SERVICE TO CARRY SUCH A REPORT IF IT IS INACCURATE. THE REUTERS VERSION IS MUCH MILDER.

BRITISH AMBASSADOR HAS CALLED MICHAEL WEIR IN EFFORT TO FORESTALL BBC CALL TO ARMS. NEXT PERSIAN BROADCAST SCHEDULED IN AN HOUR. IF YOU COULD ADD YOUR VOICE, PREFERABLY AT MINISTERIAL LEVEL, TO RESTRAIN BBC UNTIL FACTS ARE CLEAR, IT BE ENORMOUS SERVICE TO ALL.
AS OF THIS MOMENT, ALL IRAN IS WAITING TO HEAR HOW AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI WILL REACT TO THE SHAH'S SPEEH AND THE INSTALLATION OF A MILITARY GOVT. WE HAVE SEEN NOTHING AS YET ON THE TICKERS FROM PARIS.

HOWEVER, BRITISH EMBASSY SAYS IT HAS TWO CONFLICTING REPORTS FROM PARIS. REUTERS SAYS KHOMEINI HAS CALLED ON HIS FOLLOWERS TO "CONTINUE RESISTANCE." BBC WORLD SERVICE SAYS HE HAS CALLED FOR "ARMED REBELLION." BRITISH AMBASSADOR HAS CALLED FCO TO TRY TO GET BBC TO AVOID IRRESPONSIBILITY ON ITS PERSIAN LANGUAGE SERVICE, WHICH WILL NEXT BROADCAST AT 1530. IT WOULD BE PARTICULARLY UNFORTUNATE FOR BBC TO REPORT "ARMED REBELLION" IF THAT INDEED IS INCORRECT.

KHOMEINI'S CALLS FOR RESISTANCE WILL POSE A CRITICAL SITUATION HERE. IT REMAINS TO BE SEEN WHETHER THE LOCAL CLERGY WILL BREAK WITH HIM AND URGE MODERATION OR WHETHER THEY WILL DENSORSE HIS RADICAL CALLS. THAT DECISION WILL DETERMINE NATURE OF POLITICAL FUTURE HERE.

IN ANY EVENT, IF KHOMEINI'S CALLS ARE LOCALLY HEEDED, WE CAN EXPECT ANTI-FOREIGN QUOTIENT TO THIS CONTENT. LARGE U.S. COMMUNITY HERE WOULD BE VULNERABLE. THEREFORE, WE STRONGLY SUGGEST ANY PUBLIC STATEMENTS OF SUPPORT FOR MILITARY GOVT WHICH U.S. OFFICIAL FEEL THEY MUST ARTICULATE IN WASHINGTON BE CLEARED WITH THIS EMBASSY IN ADVANCE, IF THAT IS AT ALL POSSIBLE.

1978TEHRAN10866.subject: SECURITY ADVISORY WE HAVE ISSUED FOLLOWING SECURITY ADVISORY TO AMERICAN COMMUNITY

segments.text: WE HAVE ISSUED FOLLOWING SECURITY ADVISORY TO AMERICAN COMMUNITY RESUME NORMAL ACTIVITIES, WITH APPROPRIATE PRECAUTIONS.
OBSERVE CURFEW.
OBEY MARTIAL LAW.
EMBASSY HAS HAD NO REPEAT NO REPORTS OF ANY AMERICAN KILLED OR SERIOUSLY INJURED DURING THE RECENT DISTURBANCES IN IRAN.
THE FOLLOWING PERSONS HAVE BEEN CONTACTED DIRECTLY, OR WORD ON THEIR WELFARE HAS BEEN RECEIVED THROUGH THEIR EMPLOYERS
KOSKORES, WILLIAM T., 11/8/51, CANADA: MR. REYNOLDS, BUSINESS MANAGER OF COMMUNITY SCHOOL REPORTED KOSKORES SEEN MORNING OF NOVEMBER 7, WELL AND GOOD HEALTH. SENATOR KENNEDY INTERESTED.
GUHL, NORA, 11/8/51, PA., ALSO SEEN BY REYNOLDS OF COMMUNITY SCHOOL MORNING OF 11/7, WELL AND WITH A TENNIS RACKET IN HAND.
MCCARON, VINCENT, MAUREEN AND TWO CHILDREN, DEFENSE INTELLIGENCE, AMEMBASSY, TEHRAN, CONTACTED DIRECTLY. ENTIRE FAMILY IS WELL, CALL RECEIVED FROM U.S. EVENING OF NOV 6.
COOPER, WILLIAM K., PATRICIA AND TWO CHILDREN. MRS. COOPER WAS CONTACTED DIRECTLY, WHOLE FAMILY IS WELL. CONGRESSMAN LOTT INTERESTED.
WHITAER, HOWARD JAMES, ON BEHALF OF MOTHER, MRS. BAYLES, CONTACTED DIRECTLY BY EMBASSY, IS WELL AND IN GOOD HEALTH.
SMITH, SANDRA ANN AND HUSBAND, STEVEN. CONSOFFICER SPOKE WITH FRIEND REACHED AT SMITH'S HOME WHO REPORTED ALL WERE WELL AND IN GOOD HEALTH. APPARENTLY MR. SMITH'S PARENTS PHONED EVENING OF NOV. 6.
HOLME, DEBORAH NEE MAIER, 2/9/48, N.Y. NOT CONTACTED DIRECTLY, BUT IRANIAN WORKING AT EDUCATIONAL TV ADVISED CONOFFICER THAT HE KNEW MS. HOLME AND HAD SEEN HER NOV. 6. SHE WAS QUITE WELL.
PULFORD, JOHN, ON BEHALF ON SKY PULFORD. PULFORD WAS SEEN MORNING OF NOV. 7 BY MR. REYNOLDS OF COMMUNITY SCHOOL. HE IS FINE.
HART, HOWARD PHILLIPS, AMERICAN EMBASSY POLITICAL SECTION. MESSAGE PASSED, HART HAS PHONED HIS FATHER.
ZOHDI, CATHERINE, NEIGHBOR OF EMBASSY ECON OFFICER, WAS SEEN EVENING OF NOV. 6 AND IS WELL.
WIND, MR. AND MRS. EUGENE, EMPLOYER AMERICAN BELL INTERNATIONAL REPORTS WINDS ARE IN INDIA ON LEAVE AND ARE DUE TO RETURN TO TEHRAN NOVEMBER 10.

EVERT, DAVID, 12/1/47, OHIO, SPENT EVENING NOV. 5 ON EMBASSY COMPOUND. IS BELIEVED TO HAVE LEFT FOR AIRPORT ON NOV. 6. EVERT ADVISED EMBASSY PERSONNEL OFFICER HE WAS HEADED FOR BANGKOK. FYI EMBASSY UNDERSTANDS AIR FRANCE HEADED FOR FAR EAST STOPPED IN TEHRAN THAT EVENING.
EMBASSY ATTEMPTING TO LOCATE REMAINING PERSONS LISTED REFTELS, WILL ADVISE SEPTEL.

SUMMARY: AZHARI GOVT PROMISES TO STEP DOWN WHEN SECURITY RESTORED, ASSURES FREE ELECTIONS WILL BE HELD. TEHRAN BASIALLY BACK TO NORMAL BUT WITHOUT BUSES OR NEWSPAPERS. YESTERDAY RELATIVELY PEACEFUL IN TEHRAN: ARMY DID NOT RIGIDLY ENFORCE HARSH NEW DIRECTIVE AGAINST ASSEMBLIES. REPORTS OF FRATERNIZATION BETWEEN TROOPS AND RIOTERS NOV 5. IRAN AIR ANNOUNCED STRIKE OVER BUT HAS NOT RESUMED SERVICE. TABRIZ HAD LARGE DEMONSTRATION, SHIRAZ REPORTED SEVERAL DEMONSSTRAIONS DISPERSED BY TEAR GAS BUT NO SHOOTING. ISFAHAN HAD SOME VIOLENCE. GENERAL JAAFARIAN IS APPOINTED GOV-GEN OF KHUZISTAN. ATTACK ON PARSONS CO. AHWAZ. GROWING UNAVAILABILITIY OF CASH DUE TO WIDESPREAD BURNINGS AND CLOSURE OF BANKS. END SUMMARYM

FIRST COMMUNIQUE OF PRIMIN GEN AZHARI STATES MILITARY GOVT ONLY A TEMPORARY MEASURE: GOVT WILL STEP DOWN ONCE SECURITY IS RESTORED. AZHARI PROMISED REGIME STILL INTENDS TO HOLD TOTALLY FREE ELECTIONS (SEE SEPTEL). MAJLIS WAS SUPPOSED TO MEET TODAY IN OPEN SEEEION BUT IS POSTPONED TO NOV 9.

TEHRAN IS BASICALLY BACK TO NORMAL, BUT BUSES ARE STILL NOT RUNNING AND THERE ARE NO NEWSPAPERS FOR A NEWS-STARVED PUBLIC. BBC CITES MLA AS STATING TROOPS HAVE TAKEN OVER JOURNALS AND NONE WILL APPEAR FOR SEVERAL DAYS. IN ANY CASE TROOPS HAVE SURROUNDED KEYHAN AND ETELAAT BUILDINGS AND ARE LETTING NO ONE ENTER. IRAN AIR ANNOUNCED STRIKE OVER BUT HAS NOT RESUMED SERVICE. SEVERAL OTHER GROUPS OF STRIKERS HAVE RETURNED TO WORK.

YESTERDAY DID NOT BRING EXPECTED TEST OF WILL BETWEEN TROOPS AND PROTESTERS, AS SECURITY FORCES DID NOT ENFORCE NEW HARSHLY-WORDED BAN ON GATHERINGS. PERHAPS AUTHORITIES WANTED TO AVOID REPETITION OF SEPT 8, WHEN THEY WERE ACCUSED OF FIRING ON CROWD THAT DID NOT UNDERSTAND DEMONSTRATIONS WERE ILLEGAL. CROWDS DID GATHER YESTERDAY NEAR ROUDAKI HALL AND PARTICULARLY NEAR TEHRAN UNIVERSITY. THEY WERE NOT GUNNED DOWN AS THREATENED. EMB RECEIVED MANY REPORTS OF SHOTS FIRED, BUT RELIABLE SOURCES REPORT THATIN AT LEAST SOME OF THESE INSTANCES TROOPS FIRED INTO THE AIR. BBC REPORTS MANY INJURIES AND SOME DEATHS BUT THESE ARE UNCONFIRMED.
WE PRESUME MLA INTENDS GRADUALLY TO ENFORCE TOTAL BAN ON EVEN SMALL DEMONSTRATIONS, BUT THAT REMAINS TO BE SEEN.

FOREIGN NEWS CORRESPONNENT REPORTED AT LEAST FOUR DEFINITE CASES OF TROOPS FRATERNIZING WITH RIOTERS. ONE OF THESE INVOLVED BRITISH EMBASSY, WHERE TRUCKLOAD OF TROOPS JOKED WITH DEMONSTRATORS, THEN DEPARTED (IT IS NOT CLEAR WHEN) AND THUS WERE ABSENT WHEN RIOTERS STORMED COMPOUND.
TODAY TEHRAN HAS REMAINED GENERALLY QUIET TO LATE MORNING, EXCEPT FOR SOME SHOOTING IN FAR SOUTH-WEST OF CITY AND RUNNING CONFRONTATIONS BETWEEN YOUTH AND SECURITY FORCES IN UNIVERSITY AREA.

CONSULATE SHIRAZ REPORTED YESTERDAY GENERALLY QUIET, WITH SOME DEMONSTRATIONS DISPERSED BY TEAR GAS BUT NO SHOOTING. CONSULATE TABRIZ REPORTED LARGE DEOMONSTRATION NEAR CONSULATE. FOR ONLY SECOND TIME THIS YEAR, HE WAS WARNED BY POLICE NOT TO GO OUTSIDE, BUT DEMONSTRATORS DID NOT REACH CONSULATE BUILDING. CONSULATE ISFAHAN REPORTED VIOLENCE, INCLUDING ATTACK ON GRUMMAN BUILDING (PREVIOUSLY REPORTED). AMERICANS WERE ADVISED TO REMAIN AT HOME. CROWD OF STUDENTS ASSEMBLED AT ISFAHAN UNIVERSITY TO AWAIT KHOMEINI'S RESPONSE TO MILITARY GOVT, BUT WHEN NONE WAS FORTHCOMING THEY DISPERSED. POLICE OFFICIAL ADMITTED PRESENT POLICY IS TO FIRE ON GROUPS THAT DO NOT DISPERSE, SAYING TROOPS FIRE AT LEGS IN ORDER NOT TO KILL.

CONSUL REPORTS A NUMBER OF INJURIES AND UNCONFIRMED RUMORS OF SEVERAL DEATHS. THREE BANKS WERE BURNED IN ISFAHAN. NORTHRUP BUS WAS STONED, BUT THERE WERE NO INJURIES. AUTOMOBILE IN AMERICAN NEIGHBORHOOD WAS FIREBOMBED LAST NIGHT. THIS MORNING MANY AMERICANS AND IRANAINS STAYING HOME UNTIL SITUATION CLARIFIES. CONSULATE SHIRAZ REPORTS MOB ATTACK ON PARSONS COMPANY IN AHWAZ YESTERDAY. EMPLOYEES BARRICADED BUILDING FOR TWO HOURS, THEN LEFT FROM REAR VIA BUS WHICH WAS ATTACKED BY ROCK-THROWERS. OFFICER ALSO REPORTS THAT WHILE IRAN AIR OFFICE AHWAZ IS OFFICIALLY OPEN, THE DOORS ARE LOCKED.
KHUZISTAN PROVINCE, WHICH HAS BEEN WITHOUT A GOV-GEN DURING RECENT UNREST, NOW HAS A MILITARY GOVERNOR, GENERAL BOGHRAT JAAFARIAN, APPOINTED YESTERDAY NOV 6.
RECENT BURNINGS AND CLOSINGS OF SO MANY BANK IS BEGINNING TO CAUSE FAIRLY WIDESPREAD SHORTAGES OF CASH. MANY TEHRAN SHOPS REMAIN CLOSED. CARS ARE QUEUING AT STATIONS FOR SCARCE GAS.

1978TEHRAN10877.subject: FOLLOWUP SECURITY REPORT, NOV 7 CONFIDENTIAL CONFIDENTIAL

segments.text: CONSULATE TABRIZ REPORTS SITUATION HEATING UP, WITH LARGE CROWDS GATHERING AGAIN. GURADS HAVE ORDERS TO SHOOT RIOTERS IF THEY THREATEN CONSULATE.
EMB HAS REPORTS OF SHOOTING NEAR TEHRAN UNIVERSITY. THIS AGAIN MAY INVOLVE FIRING INTO AIR. NO CASUALITIES REPORTED.

EMB HAS UNCONFIRMED REPORTS THAT SEVERAL (UP TO 40) PROMINENT FORMER OFFICIALS, INCLUDING EX-MINISTERS, HAVE BEEN PLACED UNDER HOUSE ARREST. THESE INCLUDE GEN. NASSIRI AND SEVERAL OF THOSE MOST OFTEN ACCUSED OF CORRUPTION. (COMMENT: WE KNOW SUCH ARRESTS HAVE BEEN INTENDED BY P.M. AZHARI.)
MILITARY TAKEOVER OF KAYAN REPORTEDLY INCLUDED ARREST OF FIVE WRITERS. THESE ARE SAID TO BE OPPOSITIONIST REPORTERS WHOM NEWSPAPER WAS FORCED TO REHIRE WHEN STRIKE WAS SETTLED AND CENSORSHIP REMOVED.
IN REZAYIEH, WHICH WAS SCENE OF PRO-GOVT DEMONSTRATION SEVERAL DAYS AGO, RELIGIOUS LEADERS REPORTEDLY ASKED BAZAARIS TO REOPEN, AND THE HAVE DONE SO.

ASSILANTS BEING DESCRIBED BY GOVT SOURCES AS "AN ISLAMIC GROUP" REPORTEDLY SHOT AND WOUNDED GEN. KHADEMI, FORMER HEAD OF IRAN AIR, IN HIS HOUSE THIS MORNING. HE WAS RUSHED TO HOSPITAL AND ATTACKERS ESCAPED. GEN. KHADEMI WAS REMOVED FROM HIS POSITION BY SHARIF-EMAMI GOVT AND WAS AMONG THOSE FORBIDDEN TO LEAVE THE COUNTRY PENDING INVESTIGATION.

1978TEHRAN10878.subject: PRIMIN AZHARI'S SPEECH NOV 6 SUMMARY: NEW PRIMIN GEN AZHARI ECHOED SHAH'S EARLIER SPEECH TO THE NATION, PROMISING TO STAMP OUT CORRUPTION A

segments.text: SUMMARY: NEW PRIMIN GEN AZHARI ECHOED SHAH'S EARLIER SPEECH TO THE NATION, PROMISING TO STAMP OUT CORRUPTION AND APPEALING TO CLERGY AND PEOPLE TO HELP RESTORE DOMESTIC PEACE. HE PLEDGED THAT, WHEN THIS IS ACCOMPLISHED, A CIVILIAN GOVT WILL TAKE OVER, AND NATIONAL ELECTIONS WILL TAKE PLACE. END SUMMARY.

NEW PRIMIN GENERAL GHOLAM REZA AZHARI ADDRESSED THE NATION 2200 NOV 6 ON RADIO AND TELEVISION. HE WORE MILITARY UNIFORM. IN A SPEECH FULL OF RELIGIOUS ALLUSIONS, HE PLEDGED TO END "THE CURRENT CHAOTIC SITUATION, SO THAT EVERY INDIVIDAUL MAY RESUME HIS HEALTHY AND PEACEFUL LIFE, AND SO THAT FINANCIAL, ECONOMIC AND SOCIAL SECURITY--WHICH HAS BEEN DESTROYED AS A RESULT OF RIOT-MONGERING BY ENEMY AND COLONIAL LACKEYS--AND THE PEOPLE'S MENTAL SECURITY--WHICH HAS BEEN SHATTERED TO A DANGEROUS EXTENT THANKS TO CALCULATED PROPAGANDA--MAY BE RESTORED."

AZHARI PROMISED ABOVE ALL TO ATTACK CORRUPTION, ASKING RELIGIOUS LEADERS TO "GUIDE, DIRECT, AND ASSIT." HE ITEMIZED THE BREAKDOWN IN PUBLIC ORDER, NOTING: "PATIENTS AND HOSPITALS, WHICH ARE NEVER DEPRIVED OF SERVICES AND ATTENTION EVEN BY THE ENEMY IN TIMES OF WAR, ARE NOW DEPRIVED OF THESE SERVICES." ALL THIS BE BLAMED, ON THE ONE HAND, ON "PROPAGANDA BY FOREIGNERS AND XENOPHILES," AND THE THE OTHER, ON "PAST MISTAKES, UNLAWFUL ACTIVITIES, CRUELTY, AND CORRUPTION, WHICH WILL NOT ONLY NOT BE REPEATED FROM NOW IN, BUT WILL BE AMENDED IN EVERY RESPECT." LEGITIMATE GRIEVANCES COULD HAVE BEEN RECTIFIED IF "THE HAND OF THE FOREGINER" HAD NOT BEEN PRESENT.

THE GOAL OF HIS GOVT IS TO ACHIEVE SECURITY; ONCE THAT IS ACCOMPLISHED, "WE WILL MAKE WAY FOR A GOVERNMENT WHICH WILL HAVE THE FREEDOM TO CARRY OUT THE MOST FUNDAMENTAL TASK OF THE COUNTRY--NAMELY THE HOLDING OF A 100 PERCENT NATIONAL ELECTION--SO THAT, UNDER TRE FREEDOM, THE FUTURE OF THE COUNTRY IS CLARIFIED IN THE BEST MANNER."

EVEN DURING MILITARY RULE, HOWEVER, AZHARI PLEDGED TO MAINTAIN THE INDEPENDENCE OF THE JUDICIARY, "PROMOTING AND ELEVATING, AS MUCH AS POSSIBLE, THE PRESTIGE, STATUS AND STANDING OF THE JUDGES." GOVT WILL ALSO RESPECT THE ROLE OF THE LEGISLATIVE BRANCH, "PARTICULARLY THE SUPERVISORY AUTHORITY OF THE LEGISLATIVE POWER OVER THE EXECUTIVE."

AS FOR OPPOSITION, "THIS GOVERNMENT DOES NOT REGARD ANY INDIVIDUAL OR GROUP AS AN OPPOSITION IN ANY WAY WHATSOEVER. IT REGARDS ALL GROUPS AS SERVANTS OF THE NATION AND STATE, EXCEPT THOSE WHO IGNORE THE CONSTITUTION, FOR THIS CONSTITUTION, AS I HAVE ALREADY SAID, IS INSPIRED BY THE TEACHING OF THE HOLY ISLAMIC RELIGION. NATURALLY, THE PRESENT GOVERNMENT, WHICH IS HUMBLY BOWING BEFORE THE ALTAR OF RELIGION, CANNOT REGARD THESE PEOPLE AS BEING ON ITS SIDE."
AZHARI THEN REPEATED THE CALL TO PRESERVE THE NATION AGAINST EXTINCTION AT THE HANDS OF COLONIALISTS AND XENOPHILES, CONCLUDING WITH A KORANIC VERSE.

COMMENT: AZHARI'S HOMAGE TO ISLAMIC LEADERS COULD NOT HAVE BEEN MORE PRONOUNCED, AND ONE WOULD NEVER GUESS FROM HIS ORDER THAT THESE LEADERS HAVE PLAYED A VITAL ROLE IN THE OPPOSITION. HIS EMPHASIS ON FOREIGN INFLUENCES BEHIND THE UNREST WOULD NORMALLY BE AN EFFECTIVE PLAY TO SHIT THE BURDEN FOR PAST MISTAKES BY APPEALING TO IRANIAN XENOPHOBIA, BUT WE WONDER IF THAT THEME HAS NOT LOST ITS CREDIBILITY BY NOW AFTER MONTHS OF BELABORING BY THE "ANCIENT REGIME", INCLUDING THE RECENTLY DECRASED SHARIF-EMAMI GOVERNMENT. NEVERTHLESS THE SPEECH CONTAINED MANY EFFECTIVE ELEMENTS--ISLAM, CONTINUED COMMITMENT OT LIBERALIZATION, ADMISSION OF PAST MISTAKES, AND DEFENSE OF IRANIAN NATIONALISM.
IT REMAINS TO BE SEEN WHETHER THE OPPOSITIONISTS AND THEIR MASS FOLLOWINGS ARE NOT SO EMBITTERED THAT THEY REFUSE TO LISTEN.

1978TEHRAN10880.subject: PRESS REPORTS OF ANTI-FOREIGN ORIENTATION IN RECENT UNREST CONFIDENTIAL

segments.text: UNREST

WE HAVE NOTED THAT PRESS ACCOUNTS OF SERIOUS UNREST IN TEHRAN AND MANY PROVINCIAL CITIES OVER RECENT PAST HAVE BEGUN TO MAKE MAJOR POINT OF ANI-FOREIGN SENTIMENT ON THE PART OF DEMONSTRATORS. WE WOULD LIKE TO PUT THEM INTO PERSPECTIVE.

OVER SEVERAL WEEKS, INDEED MONTHS, WE HAVE RECEIVED REPORTS OF VARIOUS INCIDENTS INVOLVING AMERICANS, AND TO A LESSER DEGREE OTHER FOREIGNERS. THESE RANGE ALL THE WAY FROM INSULTS SHOUTED AT WOMEN DRIVERS TO THE FIRE BOMBING OF A FEW CARS, A BUS, AND EVEN OUTSIDE OF HOMES, PARTICULARLY IN ISFHAN. MORE RECENT DEMONSTRATIONS IN TEHRAN AND ISFAHAN HAVE SEEN CASES OF AMERICANS AND OTHER FOREIGNERS CAUGHT BY DEMONSTRATORS IN THEIR CARS AND EFFORTS MADE TO OVERTURN THE CARS TO GET INTO THEM. THERE HAVE BEEN A FEW CASES OF ORGANIZED STONE-THROWING AT BUSES OF AMERICAN EMPLOYEES LEAVING, FOR EXAMPLE, THE MILITARY AIRPORT AREA IN TEHRAN.
THESE INCIDENTS HAVE BEEN SCARY AND POTENTIALLY SERIOUS. HOWEVER, THEY HAVE SO FAR RESULTED IN ONLY MINOR INJURIES AND NO DEATHS OF AMERICANS, OR OF OTHER FOREIGNERS THAT WE ARE AWARE OF.

THERE ARE ALSO SOME COUNTER-INDICATIONS. FOR EXAMPLE, THE MOB WHICH WENT INTO THE BRITISH EMBASSY COMPOUND AND WRECKED GOOD PORTION OFTHE CHANCERY NOV 5 MADE SURE THERE WERE NO INURIES TO PERSONS. FOREIGNERS ON FOOT CAUGHT IN OR NEAR MOBS HVAE NOT BEEN INURED BY THE MOBS (SOMETIMES THEY HAVE BY THE POLICE). SINCE ANTIJEWISH SENTIMENTS HAVE APPEARED AT TIMES IN SLOGANS OR PREACHINGS BY OPPOSITION RELIGIOUS LEADERS, IT IS INTERESTING TO NOTE THAT OBVIOUS TARGET SUCH AS THE JEWISH CARPET SHOPS ON FERDOWSI STREET VERY NEAR THE SCENE OF MANY OF THE TEHRAN DEMONSTRATIONS HAVESSO FAR REMAINED UNSCATHED.
ON THE OTHER HAND , AT LEAST ONE OF THE HOTELS WHICH WAS BURNED RECENTLY IS RUMORED TO HAVE JEWISH OWNERSHIP.

THRE HAVE BEEN REQUENT ACCUSATIONS FROM OPPOSITION SOURCES THAT THE WELL ORGANIZED MOBS WHICH HAVE DONE MOST OF THE DAMAGEIN RECENT RIOTING WERE REALLY GOVT SUPPORTERS IN DISGUISE. RELIGIOUS LEADERS IN PARTICULARLY HAVE REQUENTLY CALLED ON THEIR SUPPORTERS TO AVOID VIOLENCE. ALL IMPORTANT SPOKESMEN OR LEADERS OF OPPOSITION GROUPS WITH WHOM WE HAVE SPOKEN HAVE INVARIABLY ASSURED US THAT ANTI-FOREIGNER SENTIMENT IS AGAINST THEIR RELIGIOUS BELIEFS.

NEVERTHELESS, IT IS CLEAR THAT SOME OPPOSITIONISTS, MOST PROMINENTLY INCLUDING AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI HIMSELF, HAVE FREQUENTLY ASSOCIATED AMERICANS, BRITISH, AND SOMETIMES RUSSIANS AND CHINESE WITH THE SHAH'S REGIME, WHICH THEY ARE SWORN TO OVERTHROW.

THUS THE PICTURE IS MIXED. WE CAN DEDUCE MOTIVES WHICH WOULD INCLUDE A) RELIGIOUS FANATICISM, B) LEFTWINGER FANATICISM, C) PERHAPS PRO-GOVT "AGENT PROVOCATEUR" BEHAVIOR. ON THE OTHER HAND, AT LEAST ONE KNOWLEDGEABLE LEFT-WING JOURNALIST TELLS US LOCAL COMMUNISTS AND OTHERS RESPONSIVE TO SOVIET LINE ARE DEFINITELY NOT INVOLVED IN STOKING ANTI-FOREIGN FIRES SINCE THEY REALIZE ANTI-SOVIET FEELING WOULD BE POTENTIALLY MUCH MORE WIDESPREAD THANT ANTI-AMERICAN OR ANTI-WESTERN FEELING. AT THIS JUNCTURE, THEREFORE, WE ARE ARRIVING AT NO ALARMISH CONCLUSIONS FROM THE OCCASIONAL INCIDENTS NOTED ABOVE BUT CONTINUE TO FOLLOW THE SITUATION CLOSELY.

PNAM REP TOLD EMBOFF THAT PANAM SERVICE TO TEHRAN EFFECTIVE TODAY AND FOR NEXT FEW DAYS, WILL BE LIMITED TO ONE TURN AROUND FLIGHT DAILY ARRIVING FROM ISTANBUL AT 1930 HOURS (PA 110) AND DEPARTING FOR ISTANBUL AT 2100 HOURS (PA 111). PANAM AROUND-THE-WORLD FLIGHTS (AP 001 AND 002) WILL STOP AT ISTANBUL TEMPORARILY TO CONNECT WITH TEHRAN FLIGHTS. THIS DECISION WAS MADE AS A PRECAUTION IN ORDER TO GUAGE THE GENERAL SITUATION AND THE SAFETY ENVIRONMENT FOR OVERNIGHTING CREWS.

THE LOCAL MEDIA ANNOUNCED NOVEMBER 6 THAT THE IRAN AIR STRIKE WAS ENDING. AIRPORT OBSERVERS INFORMED EMBOFF THAT SOME IRAN AIR EMPLOYEES DID REPORT FOR WORK ON TUESDAY MORNING, BUT DEPARTED AFTER ABOUT TWO HOURS, LEAVING IRAN AIR COMPLETELY SHUT DOWN. AMONG OTHER THINGS, IRAN AIR EMPLOYEES WERE REPORTED TO HAVE OBJECTED TO THE PRESENCE OF TROOPS AT THE AIRPORT. MORE SIGNIFICANT FACTOR IN RESUMPTION OFSTRIKE MAY HAVE BEEN THREATS RECEIVED BY EMPLOYEES WILLING TO RETURN TO WORK. ACCORDING TO BRITISH EMBASSY, TWO BRITISH PILOTS EMPLOYED BY IRAN AIR RECEIVED THREATS TO PERSONAL SAFETY IF THEY SHOULD RESUME WORK.

1978TEHRAN10883.subject: OPPOSITION SPLIT ON REACTION TO SHAH'S SPEECH

segments.text: SUMMARY: IN COMPANY OF WASHINGTON VISITORS EMOBFFS SPOKE WITH DR. MINATCHI AS WELL AS LIBERATION MOVEMENT OF IRAN (LMI) LEADERS. THEIR REACTIONS TO MILITARY TAKEOVER ARE SUBSTANTIALLY DIFFERENT. MINATCHI BELIEVES STEP MAY WORK IF MILITARY GOVERNMENT IS SUCCEEDED BY NATIONAL COALITION GOVERNMENT WITHIN SHORTEST TIME POSSIBLE. LMITLEADERSHIP MAINTAINS ABSOLUTELY RIGID VERBAL ADHERENCE TO KHOMEINI LINE AND INSISTS SHAH MUST GO. LMI WOULD NOT PARTICIPATE IN COALITION GOVERNMENT UNLESS KHOMEINI APPROVED IT AND CLAIMS "PEOPLE" WILL NEVER ACCEPT MILITARY GOVERNMENT. LMI CLAINS NO ONE WILL PARTICIPATE IN COALITION GOVERNMENT IF KHOMEINI CONTINUES TO OPPOSE IT. END SUMMARY.

VISITING H.A. DEPUTY ASSISTANT SECRETARY COHEN, IRAN DESK OFFICER CLEMENT AND EMBOFF STEMPEL SPOKE WITH DR. NASSER MINATCHI NOV 6 IN WAKE OF ANNOUNCEMENT BY SHAH THAT TEMPORARY MILITARY GOVERNMENT WAS TAKING OVER (REFTEL). MINATCHI SAID MOVE MIGHT WORK AS LONG AS MILITARY GOVERNMENT RE REMAINS IN OFFICE A SHORT TIME AND DOES NOT DO ANYTHING WHICH WOULD PROHIBIT RAPID EMERGENCE OF A NEW NATIONAL COALITION GOVERNMENT AS THE SHAH PROMISED. MINATCHI MADE SUGGESTION THAT SHAH MIGHT THEN INTRODUCE A DEPUTY TO NEGOTIATE SUCH A GOVERNMENT OR DEVELOP SOME FORM OF A REGENCY COUNCIL OR A CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY TO SET FORTH OR RATIFY OF NEW FRAMEWORK FOR GOVERNMENT.

HE THOUGHT IT WOULD BE POSSIBLE TO BRING ALONG THE RELIGIOUS LEADERS (HE MEANT THE MODERATES) IN SOME SORT OF ARRANGMENT. .MOST SIGNIFICANT FEATURE OF HIS DISCUSSION WAS HIS PERCEPTION THAT THERE IS ROOM FOR MANEUVER. MINATCHI WILL BE SEEING AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI IN QOM NOV 7. HE IS STILL LOOKING FOR USG ENDORSEMENT OF HIS EFFORTS AND PROPOSALS.

OF EQUAL INTEREST WAS MINATCHI'S DESCRIPTION OF NEGOTIATIONS BETWEEN KHOMEINI AND ENG. MEHDI BAZARGAN OF LMI AND HIMSELF. MINATCHI SAID KHOMEINI MAINTAINED A VERY HARD AND FIRM POSTION (HE SPOKE OF THIS WITH OBVIOUS PERSONAL DISAPPOINTMENT). KHOMEINI INSTISTS ON THREE POINTS

SHAH MUST ABDICATE AND LEAVE COUNTRY; 2) MONARCHIAL DYNASITIES SHOULD BE DISCONTINUED; 3) THE REGIME MUST BE A REPUBLIC WITH THE CHIEF OF STATE ALWAYS ELECTED. KHOMEINI SAID HE HAD A PROGRAM FOR THE FUTURE. MINATCHI SAID AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI'S SON AND SON-IN-LAW HAD GONE TO PARIS TO GIVE KHOMEINI A LETTER FROM SHARIATMADARI REQUESTING KHOMEINI'S PROGRAM IN WRITTEN FORM. SHARAITMADARI EXPECTS TO RECEIVE AN ANSWER AT THE END OF THIS WEEK OR EARLY NEXT WEEK. HE WILL POSTPONE DECISION UNTIL THAT TIME.

FLEXIBILITY SHOWN BY MINATCHI AND IMPLIED BY OTHER NATIONAL FRONT LEADER BAKHTIAR A DAY EARLIER IS IN SIGNIFICANT CONTRAST TO SHARP HARDLINE ATTITUDE SHOWN BY NATIONAL FRONT LEADERSHIP GROUP COMPOSED OF ENG. BAZARGAN, PROFESSOR SAHABI AND MOHAMMAD TAVAKOLI, WHICH MET WITH COHEN, CLEMENT, STEMPEL AND POLCOUNS LAMBRAKIS EVENING NOV 6. INTRODUCTORY MEETING INCLUDED INFORMATION THAT BAZARGANAHAD GONE TO PARIS VIA LONDON WHERE HE VISITED AMNESTY INTERNATIONAL WHICH IS EXPECTED TO SEND A TEAM TO IRAN BY NEXT WEEK TO WORK ON THE PRISONER SITUATION. THE LMI TEAM THOUGH THERE WERE MORE THAN 600 POLITICAL PRISONERS REMAINING.

THE LMI TEAM THEN NOTED THAT THERE WERE TWO UNDISPUTED FACTS IN THE PRESENT CASE: A DISTINCT MAJORITY TO IRANIANS DO NOT WANT THE SHAH AND HIS REGIME, AND A CRUCIAL MAJORITY OF THOSE IN OPPOSITION CONSIDER KHOMEINI AS THEIR LEADER AND ARE LOOKING FORWARD TO AN ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT. THE MONARCHY IS OVERWHELMINGLY HATED. THOSE, INCLUDING SOME COUNTRIES WHO SEEK STABILITY IN IRAN, ARE NOT CORRECT IN THINKING THE SHAH CAN MAINTAIN IT. THEY SHOULD CONSIDER THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT. CLEMENT DISPUTED LMI FIGURES ON MAJORITY OPPOSING SHAH, BUT GROUP REMAINED ADAMAN AND BAZARGAN INSISTED KHOMEINI IS THE LEADER OF IRANIANS BECAUSE OF HIS CLEAR POSITION AGAINST THE SHAH.

HE SAID EVEN SHARIATMADARI'S FOLLOWERS DEFER TO KHOMEINI ON POLITICAL QUESTIONS. IN RESPONSE TO LAMBRAKIS ON WHETHER PEOPLE FAVOR AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC, SAHABI SAID PEOPLE WANT ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT NOT NECESSARILY AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. ------------------038464 071811Z /53 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 1436 SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 10883 LIMDIS THE LMI THOUGHT A COMMITTEE SELECTED BY THE PEOPLE SHOULD REPLACE THE DYNASTY TEMPORARILY AND SHOULD RULE UNTIL AFTER FREE ELECTIONS WOULD BE HELD. WITH REFERENCE TO PRESENT EVENTS, BAZARGAN SAID THE ISSUE WAS CLEAR: EITHER THE SHAH GOES OR A MAJORITY OF IRANIANS WILL HAVE BE BE KILLED. THE LMI EXPECTS NOTHING BUT KILLING FROM THE MILITARY GOVT.

BAZARGAN SHARPLY CHALLENGED THE SHAH'S STATEMENT THAT HE HAD BEEN SEEKING A COALITION GOVT. BAZARGAN SAID THE SHAH WISHED TO MAINTAIN MILITARY AND POLICE UNDER HIS CONTROL TO INTERFERE WITH GOVT. THIS IS WHY THE DEAL WITH AMINI FELL THROUGH. HE ADDED AS AN AFTERTHOUGHT THAT EVEN SHARIF-EMAMI WOULD HAVE HAD MORE LUCK IF HE HAD SOME CONTROL OVER THE ARMY.

LAMBRAKIS PROBED THE LMI'S INSISTENCE THAT THE SHAH LEAVEAS THE FIRST STAGE OF ANY AGREEMENT. HESUGGESTED THAT THE SHAH COULD NOT BE EXPECTED TO GIVE EVERYTHING UP AT ONCE, AND THE SHAH WAS VALUABLE IN GUARANTEEING DELIVERY OF ANY POTENTIAL AGREEMENT BETWEEN HIMSELF AND THE OPPOSITION. BAZARGAF REITERATED THAT THERE WAS NO WAY OUT OF DEADLOCK UNLESS THE SHAH LEFT.

HE SAW A STAGE BY STAGE PROCESS WITH THE SHAH LEAVING AND WITH OTHERS TAKING OVER TO WORK OUT A GOVT ACCEPTABLE TO KHOMEINI, (WHEN ASKED WHAT THIS MEANT, BAZARGAN SAID THAT KHOMEINI WAS JUST NOW BEGINNING TO WORK OUT SOME SORT OF PRESECRIPION ON WHAT SORT OFGOVT IRAN WANTS TO HAVE). SAHABI SAID THE FIRST TAGE CLEARLY MUST BE THE SHAH'S DEPARTURE. THE SECOND STAGE WOULD BE FREE ELECTIONS OF PEOPLE TO PARLIAMENT AND THE EVENTUAL EMERGENCY OF ISLAMIC GOVT. LAMBRAKIS ASKED WHAT WOULD PREVENT SOME COLONEL FROM TAKING OVER AFTER THE SHAH LEFT AND SHOOTING ALL THE OPPOSITIONISTS.
BAZARGAN REMAINED STEADFAST AND IN EFFET DENIED THE SITUATION COULD COME ABOUT. THE SUGGESTION, HOWEVER, APPEARED TO MAKE HIM SOMEWHAT UNEASY.

IN RESPONSE TO COHEN'S QUESTION AS TO WHETHER THERE WAS ANYTHING HOPEFUL IN THE SHAH'S SPEECH TO THE NATION, BAZARGAN (SOMEWHAT CONTRADICTORILY) SAID THE ANNOUNCEMENT WAS WELL ORGANIZED AND WELL PREPARED AND WOULD HAVE BEEN "EXACTLY WAHT WE WANTED" WITHOUT THE MILITARY GOVT. IT COULD BE IMPLEMENTED IF THERE WAS GOOD WILL, BUT THE PEOPLE WOULD NOT BELIEVE THE SHAH'S PROMISES, EVEN HIS COMMITMENT TO THE CONSTITUTION. CLEMENT THEN ASKED WHETHER THE LMI WOULD PARTICIPATE IN A COALITION GOVT THAT MIGHT EMERGE.

BAZARGAN REPLIED THAT THE PEOPLE WOULD NEVER ACCEPT THE MILITARY GOVT AND THAT A COALITION GOVT WOULD NOT EMERGE; IN FACT NO GOVT COULD EMERGE IF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI OPPOSED IT, AND THE SHAH WOULD FIND ITIMPOSSIBLE TO CONVINCE ANY OTHER OPPOSITIONISSTS TO FORM A COLAITION GOVT.

EMBASSY COMMENT: BOTH EMBOFFS AND VISITORS WERE STRUCK BY EXTREME HARDLINE TAKEN BY LMI LEADERSHIP. CLEARLY BAZARGAN'S REACTION TO KHOMEINI'S DEMANDS WAS TO GO DOWN THE LINE, WHILE MINATCHI'S WAS TO LOOK ARAOUND FOR A WAY AROUND THEM. NONE OF THE LMI LEADERS DISPLAYED ANY OF THE LIMITED FLEXIBILITY PRESENT IN PAST CONVERSATIONS WITH EMBOFF. IN FACT, AS ONE VISITOR NOTED, IT IS DIFFICULT TO IMAGINE THIS GROUP OF LMI LEADERS BEING ABLE TO GOVERN A LARGE, MODERN NATION LIKE IRAN. CONVERSATION TOOK ON TRAPPING OF IDEOLOGICAL DEBATE RATHER THAN POLITICAL DISCUSSION.
ABOVE CLEARED BY ALL USG PARTICIPANTS.
IN REPLY TO EMBASSY PARIS QUESTIONS REFTEL
EMBASSY SUBSCRIBERS TO AP TICKER. COVERAGE OF AFP/REUTERS STORIES VERY SPOTTY VEN WHEN PRESS APPEARING. WOULD APPRECIATE GETTING THEM FROM EMBASSY PARIS, THOUGH ICA TELEX.

FBIS HAS BEEN PROVIDING GOOD, RAPID COVERAGE OF KHOMEINI SPEECHES ON BBC BUT COVERAGE OF FRENCH MEDIA MORE SPOTTY. HERALD TRIBUNE IS ALWAYS AT LEAST ONE DAY LATE AND FREQUENTLY SEVERAL DAYS LATE. EMBASSY HAS ALSO BEGUN TO PURCHASE LE MONDE, SEVERAL DAYS LATE. ALL NEWSPAPER DELIVERIES ARE SUBJECT TO SUDDEN INTERRUPTION, AS AT PRESENT, DUE TO VARIOUS STRIKES AND SHORTAGES.

ITEMS BY ICA TELEX ARE VERY TIMELY AND USEFUL. THIS IS EMINENTLY ACCEPTABLE WAY FOR EMBASSY/PARIS TO TRANSMIT. WE ARE PARTICULARLY INTERESTED IN KHOMEINI NEWS, AND THOSE OF OTHER IRANIAN OPPOSITION LEADERS EITHER VISITING OR LIVING IN FRANCE. WE AGREE WITH PARIS THAT MUCH GENERAL PRESS REPORTING ON IRAN IS PROBABLY DUPLICATORY AND NOT ESPECIALLY INFORMATIVE OR RELIABLE. SPECIFIC ITEMS CHOSEN BY EMBASSY WOULD BE USEFUL TO US, HOWEVER.

OF SPECIAL USEFULNESS ARE EMBASSY TELEGRAMS SUCH AS PARIS 36703, JUST RECEIVED, WHICH INCLUDE UNPUBLISHED BACKGROUND DETAIL FROM THE REPORTERS CONCERNED. KNOW THIS IS AN ADDITIONAL BURDEN ON EMBASSY BUT IT IS VERY MUCH APPRECIATED BY US HERE.
TEHRAN NO LONGER ON LIMITEL.

1978TEHRAN10928.subject: BAZAARI VIEWS ON CURRENT SITUATION SUMMARY: THREE PROMINENT BAZAARIS TAKE REASONABLE APPROACH TOWARD SITUATION, ASSERTING THEY WOULD BE WILLING

segments.text: SUMMARY: THREE PROMINENT BAZAARIS TAKE REASONABLE APPROACH TOWARD SITUATION, ASSERTING THEY WOULD BE WILLING TO PRESS KHOMEINI TO PERMIT RESOLUTION OF CIRRENT CRISIS IF SHAH WOULD (A) RELEASE ALL POLITICAL PRISONERS IMMEDIATELY, (B) PUNISH ABOUT TEN OF THE MOST PROMINENT MALEFACTORS OF PAST YEARS, AND (C) MOVE TO COALITION GOVT. THEY SUGGEST A COUNCIL OF REPRESENTATIVES FROM BAZAAR, UNIVERITIES, AND OTHER INTERESTS OF COUNSEL NEW GOVT AND CALM THE STREET DEMONSTRATORS. THIS CONVERSATION PREDATED MILITARY GOVT, BUT COULD STILL HAVE RELEVANCE IN THE FUTURE. END SUMMARY

EVENING NOVEMBER 5 VISITING DEPUTY ASSISTANT SECY (HA) CHOEN, NEA/IRN'S CLEMENT, POLITICAL COUNSELOR LAMBRAKIS AND POLOFF STEMPEL MET WITH THREE LEADING BAZAARIS IN HOME OF AN INTERMEDIARY. BAZAARIS WERE HAJ KARIM HOSSEINI, WHO WAS DESCRIBED AS CLOSE SUPPORTER OF AYATOLLAH SHARIAT-MADARI AND AYATOLLAH KHONSARI, HAJ MOHAMMED TAGHIE ETTEFAH, DESCRIBED AS CLOSE SUPPORTER OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, AND HAJ ALI AGHA AZHTARI. BAZAARIS LED OFF WITH PASSIONATE REHERSAL OF SHAH'S SINS OVER PAST 5-6 YEARS AND THAT OF PEOPLE WHO HAVE SURROUNDED HIM SUCH AS SAVAK' NASSIRI. ALMOST EVERY FAMILY HAS SOMEONE WHO HAS BEEN KILLED OR GONE TO PRISON.

THEY DETAILED SPECIFIC CASES OF POLITICAL PRISONERS SUCH AS ONE FARHAD MENUKADE AND HIS BROTHER WHO WERE ARRESTED FOR POSSESSION OF RELIGIOUS BOOK BY AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI AND HAVE BEEN IN QSAR PRISON FOR FOUR YEARS. THEIR AGED MOTHER WAS TOLD THEY WOULD BE RELEASED ON SHAY'S BIRTHDAY, AND SHE WENT TO THE PRISON BUT THEY WERE NOT RELEASED. THERE ARE OTHER EXAMPLES OF SOME 3 TO 4 THOUSAND POLITICAL PRISONERS THEY BELIEVE ARE STILL BEING KEPT IN JAIL. ONLY BETTER KNOWN CASES HAVE BEEN RELEASED. VISITORS TO THESE PRISONS ARE BADLY TREATED BY OFFICIALS.

IN THE OLD DAYS (50S AND 60S) UNDER AYATOLLAH BOURUJERDI, REGIGIOUS PEOPLE GOT DUE CONSIDERATION FROM THE SHAH AND THE PEOPLE AROUND HIM. SIMILARLY, BAZAARIS WERE REPRESENTED BEFORE THE GOVT BY AN ORGANIZATION WITH A SPOKEMAN. BUT ALL OF THIS HAS CHANGED. THE GOVT HAS BURNED MOSQUES, THEY HAVE IMPOSED CONTROLS ON THE BAZAAR-BREAKING THE NETWORK WHICH ASSURED THEM DUE REPRESENTATION INTHE GOVT.

BAZAARIS SAID THEIR ESSENTIAL DEMANDS ARE FEW. THEY WANT IMMEDIATE RELEASE OF ALL POLITICAL PRISONERS -WHY WAIT UNTIL ASHURA DEC 11 WHEN GOVT HAS SAID IT WILL RELEASE THEM? THEY ALSO WANT EXEMPLARY PUNISHMENT FOR ABOUT 10 PEOPLE WHO ARE NOTED FOR CORRUPTION AND BAD ACTIONS SUCH AS GENERAL NASSIRI. THIRD, A NEW GOVT SHOULD BE FORMED UNDER SOMEONE ACCEPTABLE TO ALL SIDES OF THE POLITICAL SPECTRUM SUCH AS ALI AMINI. HE SHOULD CHOOSE HIS OWN CABINET, BUT SHOULD BE CONSULTING A COUNCIL OF REPRESENTATIVES FROM VARIOUS INTEREST GROUPS SUCH AS THE BAZAAR, THE UNIVERSITIES, ETC. THEY ASSERTED REPRESENTATIVES TO THIS COUNCIL COULD BE SELCTED OR ELECTED WITHIN 48 HOURS.

IF COUNCIL MEMBERS WERE ASSURED THAT THE GOVT WAS WORKING IN FAVOR OF THE PEOPLE, THE COUNCIL WOULD TELL DEMONSTRATORS TO BE QUIET. THE FEW DEMONSTRATORS WHO WOULD NOT LISTEN WOULD IN TIME BE ISOLATED AND THEIR ACTIVITIES WOULD PETER OUT. ------------------053729 081709Z /64 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 1449 INFO AMCONSUL DHAHRAN USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 10928

BAZAARIS SAID THEY ARE WORRIED ABOUT TUDEH (COMMUNIST) PARTY. ITS MEMBERS HAVE ALREADY TAKEN OVER THE TELEVISION, KAYHAN NEWSPAPER AND OTHER SUCH STRATEGIC ORGANS. T PEOPLE,AND "OTHER" (I.E. PRO-GOVT FORCES) HAVE BEEN RESPONSIBLE FOR THE VIOLENCE THAT ACCOMPAINES DEMONSTRATIONS SUCH AS SETTING FIRES, HURTING PEOPLE, ETC. RELIGIOUS PEOPLE ARE NOT INVOLVED IN THESE ACTS.

THE BAZAARIS ARE TIRED OF CURRENT UNREST. THEY ARE RUNNING LOW ON MONEY. ONE OF THEM SAID HIS OUTSTANDING DEBT ALREADY TOTAL 60 MILLION RIALS (CLOSE TO DOLS 1 MILLION). THEY ARE WILLING TO CALM THINGS DOWN IF THEIR IMMEDIATE THREE DEMANDS ARE MET. THEY REALIZE AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI IN PARIS IS HOLDING OUT FOR DEPARTURE OF THE MONARCH, AND INDEED OF THE MONARCHY, IN FAVOR OF AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. IF SATISFIED ON THEIR ESSENTIAL DEMANDS, THEY WOULD GO TO PARIS AND PRESS KHOMEINI TO PERMIT A RESOLUTION OF THE SITUATION ALONG THESE LINES, SINCE THEY WILL HAVE GOTTEN 80 PERCENT OF WHAT THEY WANTED.

BEYOND THAT, BAZAARIS EXPRESSED OPINION MARTIAL LAW MAKES THINGS WORSE. SAVAK HAS BEEN ORGANIZING PROVICATIVE ACTS. THEY CITED AS EVIDENCE THE AMOL INCIDENT IN WHICH SECURITY FORCES, CARRYING BOMBS AND ANTI-SHAH LITERATURE, WERE ACCIDENTALLY DISCOVERED BY LOCAL MILITIA. THE SHAH CAN REMAIN, BUT HE SHOULD CUT THE TIES OF MEMBERS OF THE ROYAL FAMILY TO BUSINESS, IN WHICH THEY CONTINUE TO HAVE VAST STOCK HOLDING. WELL KNOWN PEOPLE WHO HAVE NOT BEEN INVOLVED IN GOVT OVER PAST 20 YEARS SHOULD BE BROUGH INTO NEW GOVT. IN RESPONSE TO A SPECIFIC QUESTION FROM COHEN, THEY EXPRESSED DISBELIEF THAT TORTURE HAS CEASED IN IRANIAN PRISONS JUST BECAUSE SHAH SAID IT WOULD.
IT HAS SIMPLY BEEN REDUCED.

COMMENT: THOUGH PREDATING THE INSTALLATION OF MILITARY GOVT NOV 6, THIS CONVERSATION WOULD HAVE RELEVANCE IF COALITION NEGOTIATIONS RESUME AFTER THE MILITARY GOVT HAS ESTABLISHED ORDER INTHE STREETS -- INSHALLAH.

SUMMARY: GENERALLY QUIET, BUT REPORTS OF DEMONSTRATIONS FOR TODAY OR TOMORROW AND POSSIBLE ARMED INSURRECTION NOV 10. THREE AMERICAN RESIDENCES FIRBOMBED. SIGNIFICANT OUTFLOW OF AMCITS; HANDBILL WARNS FOREIGNERS TO LEAVE IN 30 DAYS. NUMEROUS ARRESTS. SOVIET AMBASSADOR SPEAKS TO IRAN. END SUMMARY

TEHRAN IS GENERALLY QUIET, AND CONSULATES ISFAHAN, TABRIZ, AND SHIRAZ REPORT SIMILAR CONDITIONS. EMBASSY HAS UNCONFIRMED REPORTS OF GATHERING AT TEHRAN CEMETARY LAST NIGHT, UNDISTURBED BY SECURITY FORCES. THERE IS PERSISTENT RUMOR OF APPEAL FOR MASSIVE DEMONSTRATIONS IN TEHRAN TODAY OR TOMORROW, WHICH WOULD INCLUDE ATTACKS ON BANKS AND EMBASSIES. THERE IS LESS SUBSTANTIAL RUMOR OF HOLY WAR TO BEGIN NOV 11 (THIS IS EID-E-GORBAN, A "HAPPY " MUSLIN HOLIDAY,BUT IT IS ALSO FIRST ANNIVERSARY OF GOON SQUAD RAID ON DISSIDENT MEETING ON THE KERAJ ROAD IN 1977.). EMBASSY SOURCE REPORTS GOVT HAS MOVED 40 MORE TANKS INTO SOUTH TEHRAN TODAY TO HEAD OF TROUBLE.
PRESS SOURCE REPORTS UNCONFIRMED RUMOR OF FIVE KILLED IN HAMADAN AND SIX IN TEHRAN NOV 6. RELIABLE SOURCE DROVE THROUGH KERMANSHAH, HAMADAN AND QAZVIN YESTERDAY AND FOUND EVERYTHING QUIET.

ANTI-FOREIGN LITERATURE AND LOW-LEVEL INCIDENTS HAVE BECOME COMMONPLACE. EMBASSY HAS HANDBILL WRITTEN BY GIRU-E-TOWHID-E-SAF (GROUP WHICH CLAIMED CREDIT FOR BELL HELICOPTER BUS BOMBING), ORDERING ALL FOREIGNERS TO LEAVE IRAN WITHIN 30 DAYS. CONSULATE ISFAHAN REPORTED TEN AMERICAN TEACHERS AT UNIVERSITY OF ISFAHAN YESTERDAY RECEIVED HANDWRITTEN, PERSONALLY-ADDRESSED NOTES WARNING THEY WOULD BE KILLED IF THEY WENT TO CAMPUS. THEY STAYED HOME. CONSUL ALSO REPORTS DEATH THREAT PLACED ON WINDSHIELD OF AMERICAN'S CAR; NOTE CONTAINS CRYPTIC MOSQUE AND CROSS LOGO WITH THREE DOTS AND LETTERS "MP" THAT HAS APPEARED ELSEWHERE. IN TEHRAN LAST NIGHT THREE AMERICAN RESIDENCES WERE FIREBOMBED.

IN ONE CASE AMCIT LIVES ON THIRD FLOOR, BUT AUTOMOBILE HAD EARLIER BEEN FIRBOMBED. THERE WERE NO INJURIES OR MAJOR DAMAGE. IRANIAN MILITARY HAS PLACED GUARDS OUTSIDE OFFICES AT STAFF HEADQUARTERS OCCUPIED BY AMERICANS. SOURCE STATES THIS HAS NOT BEEN DONE SINCE ASSASSINATIONS OF AMERICANS OVER TWO YEARS AGO. ONE AMERICAN BUSINESSMAN LONG-ESTABLISHED HERE RECEIVED DEATH THREAT PHONE CALL.

EMBASSY HAS RELIABLE EVIDENCE OF SIGNIFICANT AMERICAN DEPARTURES. IBM, CONTROL DATA CORP AND HARRIS INTERNATIONAL HAVE ORDERED EMPLOYEES AND FAMILIES TO LEAVE. TEXAS INSTRUMENTS AND UNITED TECHNOLOGIES ARE WITHDRAWING DEPENDENTS. BELL HELICOPTER INTERNATIONAL HAS INTRODUCED MORATORIUM ON NEW ARRIVALS UNTIL JANUARY, WHEN SITUATION WILL BE REEVALUATED. POLICY WOULD MEAN DECREASE OF 125 EMPLOYEES PER MONTH FOR NOV AND DEC.

THIS IS IN ADDITION TO THOS WHO HAVE OBTAINED PERMISSION TO DEPART BEFORE TOUR IS COMPLETED (OVER 100 EMPLOYEES). ------------------055142 081759Z /41 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1469 INFO AMCONSUL DHAHRAN USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 10956

RELIABLE REPORTS INDICATE FORMER HEAD OF IRAN AIR GEN ALI-MOHAMMAD KHADEMI WAS TO BE ARRESTED BUT EITHER DIED RESISTING ARREST OR SHOT HIMSELF TO AVOID ARREST. ( HIS FAMILY IS PUTTING OUT LESS CREDIBLE STORY HE WAS ASSASSINATED--SEE YESTERDAY'S POL/SECURITY REPORT.) PARVIS SABETI, FORMER HIGH SAVAK OFFICIAL, WAS ALSO APPARENTLY ON THE LIST BUT HAD PREVIOUSLY FLED THE COUNTRY. NUMEROUS REPORTS, INCLUDING NEW PRO-GOVT NEWSPAPER, STATE THAT HOVEYDA WAS ARRESTED, BUT EMBASSY HAS LEARNED FROM HOVEYDA HIMSELF VIA BRITISH EMBASSY) THAT THIS IS FALSE. THIS LIST (LIKELY TO GROW TO ABOUT 200) INCLUDES PEOPLE WHOM OPPOSITIONISTS HAVE LONG DEMANDED BE PUT BEHIND BARS.

GOVT HAS NOT ANNOUNCED SECURITY ARRESTS, BUT THERE APPEAR TO BE SOME, INCLUDING NUMBER OF NIRT AND KAYHAN JOURNALISTS. MILGOVT WAS REPORTEDLY OUTRAGED AT PICTURES AND TV COVERAGE SHOWING TROOPS FIRING ON STUDENTS AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY NOV 4. JOURNALISTS (TEN OF THEM) WERE REPORTEDLY RELEASED TODAY.

PUBLISHERS MESBAHZADEH (KAYHAN) AND MASSOUDI (ETELAAT AND TEHRAN JOURNAL) REPORTEDLY REACHED AGREEMENT WITH NEW MIN OF INFORMATION TO START PUBLISHING AGAIN UNDER SELF-CENSORSHIP, BUT NEWSPAPER WRITERS; SYNDICATE TURNED DEAL DOWN. THUS PAPERS REMAIN CLOSED.

ON OCCASION OF SOVIET NATIONAL DAY, SOVIET AMBASSADOR REQUESTED AND RECEIVED PERMISSION TO ADDRESS THE NATION. ON TV IN HIS SPEECH, CARRIED BY NIRT, HE DWELT ON DESIRE TO MAINTAIN STRONG TIES AND GOOD MUTUAL RELATIONS. SPEECH FOLLOWS PATTERN OF SIMILAR ADDRESSES ON PREVIOUS SOVIET NATIONAL DAYS, BUT TIMING OF THIS ONE IS SUPERB**...

FIVE ADDITIONAL MINISTERS HAVE BEEN ANNOUNCED(SEE SEPTEL). NEW PRO-GOVT AND SO FAR MONOPOLY NEWSPAPER (SEE SEPTEL). REPORTED CHANCELLOR FARHANG MEHR OF PAHLAVI UNIVERSITY,SHIRAZ, HAS RESIGNED. JOURNAL ALSO STATES IT HAS LEARNED MOST PROVINCES WILL RECEIVE NEW GOVERNORS-GENER.

1978TEHRAN10957.subject: STRIKE CONDITIONS CONTINUE IN MANY GOVERNMENT MINISTRIES AND PUBLIC SECTOR CORPORATIONS.

segments.text: MINISTRIES AND PUBLIC SECTOR CORPORATIONS.

AS OF LATE AFTERNOON 8 NOVEMBER, EMBASSY ABLE TO CONFIRM THAT THE FOLLOWING MINISTRIES WERE STILL CRIPPLED BY WORK STOPPAGES: HEALTH AND SOCIAL WELFARE; COMMERCE; AGRICULURE; HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT; INDUSTRIES AND AMINES; LABOR; ENERGY; ROADS AND TRANSPORT; AND ECONOMICS AND FINANCE. CUSTOMS' EMPLOYEES ALSO REAMIN OFF THE JOB. DESPITE MEDIA ANNOUNCEMENTS TO THE CONTRARY, THE IRAN AIR STRIKE REMAINS EFFECTIVE. THE CENTRAL BANK IS PARTIALLY OPERATIVE AND, WHILE MOST OTHER BANKS IN TEHRAN ARE NOW OPEN, SERVICE HAS NOT RETURNED TO NORMAL DUE TO DAMAGE INCURRED DURING THE NOVEMBER 5 RIOTS. THE CONDITIONS AT THE TELECOMMUNICATIONS CORPORATION OF IRAN BUILDING CAN BEST BE DESCRIBED AS CHAOTIC.

IRANIAN EMPLOYEES HAVE NOT ONLY CONTINUED THEIR STRIKE BUT HAVE REPORTEDLY LOCKED OUT THEIR AMERICAN BELL INTERNATIONAL COOUNTERPARTS. TELEGRAPH AND TELEX SERVICES ARE SHUT DOWN. TAVINIR, THE STATE POWER AUTHORITY, REMAINS ON STRIKE.

THE INSTALLATION OF A MILITARY GOVERNMENT HAS NOT YET HAD A SIGNIFICANT IMPACT IN ENDING LABOR PROBLEMS WITHIN THE GOVERNMENT AND PUBLIC SECTOR ORGANIZATIONS, AND HAS PROBABLE HAD AN EQUAL LACK OF SUCCESS IN THE PRIVATE SECTOR TO DATE. EMBOFFS, HOWEVER, HAVE HAD REPORTS FROM SEVERAL OF THE MINISTRIES INDICATING THATHEIR EMPLOYEES ARE EXPECTED TO RETURN TO WORK ON SUNDAY, NOVEMBER 12 AFTER THE END OF A THREE-DAY LOCAL RELIGIOUS HOLIDAY. THIS HOLIDAY, COMBINED WITH THE EFFECTS OF THE LACK OF GASOLINE IN TEHRAN AND THE CONCURRENT LACK OF PUBLIC TRANSPORATATION, MAY INDEED BE RESPONSIBLE, ATLEAST IN PART, FOR THE LACK OF RESPONSE TO THE GOVERNMENT'S RETURN-TO-WORK CALL.
THE ACID-TEST WILL COME ON SUNDAY AND THE DAYS IMMEDIATELY FOLLOWING.

SUMMARY: NUMBER OF RELIABLE EYEWITNESSES SAW MILITARY ADOPT STAND BACK POLICY TOWARD DEMONSTRATORS NOV 5, WHICH DIFFERED FROM OBSERVED MILITARY BEHAVIOR NOV 4 AND 6. POSSIBLE MOTIVATIONS FOR THIS ARE COMPLEX; SIMPLISTIC VERSIONS WHICH MAY BE TOUTED BY MEDIA AND OPPOSITION SHOULD BE VIEWED ACCORDINGLY. END SUMMARY.

EMBASSY HAS TALKED WITH A NUMBER OF EYEWITNESSES TO EVENTS OF NOV 4-6 INCLUDING RELIABLE AMERICAN JOURNALISTS WHO WERE ON THE STREETS ALL THREE DAYS AS WELL AS PRIVATE CITIZENS CAUGHT UP IN VARIOUS MELEES. THRUST OF THEIR DESCRIPTIONS IS THE SAME: MILITARY ADOPTED A STANDBY ATTITUDE ON NOV 5 (CRITICAL DAY OF IRANIAN RIOTING) WHICH DIFFERED FROM THEIR OBSERVED BEHAVIOR NOV 4 AND AFTER MILITARY GOVERNMENT DECLARED NOV 6.

ONE EXPERIENCED JOURNALIST SAID TROOPS AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY NOV 4 MOVED RIGHT UP TO FIRING LINE WHEN STUDENTS BORKE OUT OF UNIVERSITY THAT DAY AND DISPERSED STUDENT MOB. FOLLOWING DAY TROOPS MERELY STOOD BY WHILE STUDENTS EXITED FROM UNIVERSITY. SEVERAL JOURNALISTS WERE PRESENT ON SHAHREZA STREET WHICH WAS CENTER OF VANDALISM AND NOTED TROOPS STANDING BY ON SIDE OF STREETS, BUT NOT INTERFERING WITH DEMONSTRATORS' ATTEMPTS TO GATHER MATERIAL FOR FIRES. TROOPS MOVED IN ONLY WHEN IT APPEARED PEOPLE WERE THREATENED.

AMCIT VISITOR TO MINISTRY OF INFORMATION DURING SACKING OF THAT BUILDING SAID TROOPS STOOD BY WHILE DEMONSTRATORS ENTERED BUILDING BUT DID ASSIST BYSTANDERS WHO WERE CAUGHT IN AREA TO LEAVE. BRITISH JOURNALIST WHO SPOKE WITH TWO EYEWITNESSES SAID TRUCK LOAD OF TROOPS LEFT BRITISH EMBASSY PRIOR TO ATTACK ON CHANCERY REPORTED PREVIOUSLY. JOURNALIST WHO RETURNED TO STREETS NOV 6 SAID TROOPS WERE MORE AGGRESSIVE THAN DAY BEFORE, MOVING IN ON SMALL GROUPS AND BREAKING UP DEMONSTRATORS WITH MORE NORMAL DISPATCH. OBSERVERS NOTED RATION OF TROOPS TO DEMONSTRATORS WAS LESS ON NOV 5 THAN PREVIOUS TWO DAYS.

WE HAVE PROBED NUMBER OF SOURCES FOR MOTIVATION OF ARMY DURING THIS PERIOD. OPPOSITION AND SOME OTHERS ARE CLAIMING THAT ARMY DELIBERATELY STOOD BY EITHER ON ORDERS OF SHAH OR OF SENIOR ARMY COMMANDERS TO PROVIDE PRETEXT FOR MARTIAL LAW. GIVEN DRIFT OF GOVERNMENT DELIBERATIONS AND PERCEPTION OF INEVITABILITY OF MARTIAL LAW IN NOV 4-5 PERIOD, THIS STRIKES US AS TOO SIMPLE AN EXPLANATION. CROSS CURRENTS AMONG MILITARY WERE INTESE DURING THIS PERIOD. HYPOTHESIS HAS BEEN ADVANCED BY KNOWLEDGEABLE PERSIANS THAT ARMY DID NOT WISH TO BE ACCUSED OF BLOOD BATH AND THEREFORE HELD OFF ATTACKING DEMONSTRATORS, DELIBERATELY PRESERVING LIVES BY SACRIFICING PROPERTY.

(SENIOR MILITARY OFFICER TOLD DAO ESSENTIALLY SAME THING--BEING REPORTED SEPTEL NOTAL.) OTHERS FEEL SOME TROOP COMMANDERS MADE THEIR OWN DEALS WITH DEMONSTRATORS TO TAKE IT EASY WHILE GOVERNMENTAL SCENARIO BEING PLAYED OUT. GIVEN EYEWITNESSES" VIEWS THAT ALL TROOPS' BEHAVIOR ROUGHLY THE SAME THROUGHOUT DOWNTOWN AREA, LIKELIHOOD IS THAT ARMY FOR WHATEVER REASON WAS ORDERED NOT TO VIGOROUSLY DEFEND BUILDINGS AND PROPERTY. CONTINUAL DISCUSSIONS AND SOMETIMES CONFLICT BETWEEN SHARIF-EMAMI GOVERNMENT AND MILITARY LEADERS OVER QUESTION OF HOW MUCH FORCE TO USE IN PUTTING DOWN DEMONSTRATIONS MAY HAVE CONTRIBUTED TO ARMY'S DECISION TO GO EASY.

ANOTHER LINE OF THOUGHT SUGGESTS THAT RATHER LURID NOV 4 EVENING TV COVERAGE OF ARMY ACTIVITIES AT UNIVERSITIES THAT DAY MAY HAVE CAUSED ARMY TO DECIDE ON MORE LENIENT POSTURE NOV 5. PERHAPS FULLY ACCURATE STORY MAY NEVER BY KNOWN. GIVEN MULTIPLE MOTIVATIONS, HOWEVER, ADDRESSEES SHOULD BE CAUTIONED AGAINST ACCEPTING SIMPLIED VIEWS AT FACE VALUE.

RADIO NOV 8 ANNOUNCED APPOINTMENT OF ADDITIONAL MINISTERS IN NEW GOVT. TWO ARE NEW FACES, ONE (AMELITEHRANI) AND INCUMBENT FROM SHARIF-EMAMI'S GOVT WHO HAS CHANGED JOBS. THEY ARE: INCUMBENT HOSSEIN NAJAFI - JUSTICE INCUMBENT ALI-NAQI KANI - ENDOWMENTS INCUMBENT HASSAN CHALCHAIN - ROADS AND COMMUNICATIONS BAGHER AMELI-TEHRAN (FORMERLY INFORMATION & TOURISM) EDUCATION (PRESUMABLY REGIQUINHED BY HABIBOLLAHI) AMHAD MEMARZADEH (VICE GOVERNOR CENTRAL BANK AND UNDER SECRETARY OF COMMERCE BEFORE THAT - COMMERCE HOMAYOUN FAHR (UNDERSECRETARY MINISTRY OF AGRICULTURE) MINISTER OF STATE

THESE APPOINTMENTS RAISE NUMBER OF CIVILIANS IN GEN. AZHARI'S "MILITARY" GOVT TO 9, AS AGAINST 8 MILITARY MEN, INCLUDING THE PRIME MINISTER. CIVILIANS SEEM TO BE CHOSEN MAINLY FOR THEIR TECHNICAL EXPERTISE IN THEIR ASSIGNED AREAS.

1978TEHRAN10961.subject: NEW NEWSPAPER APPEARS; HOVEYDA NOT UNDER ARREST

segments.text: FIRST NEWSPAPER TO APPEAR SINCE MILITARY GOVT CLOSED ALL NEWSPAPERS WHEN IT TOOK OFFICE NOV 6, IS REVIVED MINOR NEWSPAPER CALLED "MARDEH MOBRES," WHICH CAN BE VARIOUSLY TRANSLATEDAS THE "FIGHTING MAN" OR THE "CAMPAIGNER." IT WAS APPARENTLY CLOSED DOWN SOME FOUR AND HALF YEARS AGO ALONG WITH MANY OTHER NEWSPAPERS BY HOVEYDA GOVT OF THAT TIME AND ARRIES A GRUDGE AGAINST HOVEYDA. ITS EDITOR IS KHALIL AZADEH RAZMARA.

ITS MAIN HEADLINE TODAY ALLEGES HOVEYDA ARRESTED ALONG WITH A NUMBER OF OTHER FORMER MINISTERS AND IMPORTANT OFFICIALS OR BUSINESSMEN CHARGED WITH CORRUPTION. BRITISH AMBASSADOR CHECKED WITH HOVEYDA THIS MORNING AND FOUND HIM SITTING QUIETLY AT HOME, NOT UNDER ARREST. AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN ALSO CALLED HIM ,HE SAID HE SILL HAD POLICE PROTECTION.

NEWSPAPERS CARRIES A NUMBER OF OTHER NEWS WHICH WE ARE REPORTING IN THE POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT. IN THE ABSENCE OF ANY CLEAR INDICATION FROM THE NEW GOVT ON WHAT ITS POLICE TOWARDS THE PRESS WILL BE, AND THE REPORTED ARREST OF SEVERAL JOURNALISTS, APPEARANCE OF A NEWSPAPER, HOWEVER, INSIGNIFICANT AN INFLUENCE IT HAS HAD IN THE PAST, IS A GOOD SIGN. IT SUGGESTS GOVT WILL ALLOW MORE NEWSPAPERS TO REAPPEAR -- THOUGH MARTIAL-LAW CENSORSHIP IS LIKELY TO BE APPLIED.

THE MESSAGE WHICH WAS SENT IN YOUR NAME TO FOREIGN MINISTER GENSCHER REPRESENTS A FAR MORE SANGUINE VIEW OF THE SHAH'S ABILITY TO CONTROL FUTURE EVENTS IN IRAN THAN I COULD CURRENTLY ENDORSE. I REALIZE THE NEED TO BUCK UP PANICKY WEST EUROPEANS BY STOUT DECLARATIONS. HOWEVER, I TRUST THAT CABLE DOES NOT REPRESENT THE DEPT'S INTERPRETATION OF THIS EMBASSY'S REPORTING. IF SO, THERE SEEMS TO BE A COMMUNICATION GAP.

THE SHAH HIMSELF HAS REGULARLY EXPRESSED DOUBT THAT THE MILITARY WILL BE ABLE TO TAKE THE STEPS NECESSARY TO LEAD IRAN THROUGH THIS VERY COMPLEX PERIOD. HE DOES NOT BELIEVE THEY HAVE THE PROPER SOPHISTICATION AND WILL RESORT TO SIMPLISTIC APPROACHES. THIS EMBASSY HAS ALSO EXPRESSED ITS RESERVATIONS IN ASSORTED CABLES.

THE RESULTS OF THE LAST FEW DAYS SUGGEST THAT THE MILITARY MAY HAVE MANIPULATED EVENTS AND THE SHAH TO FORCE THE MANDATE IN THEIR DIRECTION. WHEN I SAW THE SHAH SUNDAY EVENING, HE SEEMED UNCERTAIN WHETHER OR NOT HE WAS BEING USED BY THE MILITARY AND /OR SAVAK. THESE ARE, OF COURSE, THOSE CYNICS (MANY OF THEM QUITE RESPONSIBLE IRANIANS) WHO BELIEVE THE SHAH STAGE-MANAGED THE WHOLE SEQUENCE, INCLUDING THE INCENDIARY VANDALISM. THE BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND I HAVE DISCUSSED THIS FROM OUR RATHER SPECIAL VANTAGE POINT AND SHARE THE CONCLUSION THAT HE IS NOT RPT NOT SUCK A MASTERFUL THEATRICAL GENIUS.

IN VIEW OF ALL THESE OBSERVATIONS, I GAG A LITTLE AT THE STATEMENT IN YOUR LETTER THAT "WITH THE POLITICAL SHREWDNESS HE HAS SHOWN INTHE PAST, HE RETAINS THE CAPABILITY TO LEAD THE COUNTRY TO ELECTION." I THINK THAT CONCLUSION IS FAR FROM PROVEN.

THE INITIAL TEST WILL BE TO SEE WHETHER THE MILITARY CAN RESTORE THE COUNTRY NOT ONLY TO AN ABSENCE OF VIOLENCE, BUT TO PRODUCTIVE WORK. AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI HAS INDICATED HIS PREFERENCE TO ACHIEVE HIS ENDS THROUGH NON-VIOLENT STRIKES. AS OF TODAY (WHICH IS A QUASI-HOLY DAY), MOST MINISTERS ARE ON STRIKE, THE TELECOMMUNICATIONS SERVICES ARE OUT, IRAN AIR STAYS CLOSED DOWN, AND NIOC OIL PRODUCTION HAS DROPPED. THE NEXT THREE DAYS ARE HOLIDAYS. HENCE, THE REAL TEST WILL COME ON SUNDAY NOVEMBER 12.

IF THE MILITARY CAN RESTORE NORMAL WORK PATTERNS, THEY WILL PROBABLY HAVE BROKEN KHOMEINI'S BACK, AND IT WOULD BE FECKLESS FOR HIM TO CALL FOR ARMED RESISTANCE, PARTICULARLY SINCE HIS FOLLOWERS HAVE VERY FEW ARMS.

ON THE OTHER HAND, IF THE MILITARY CANNOT RPT NOT BREAK THE STIKES, IT IS DIFFICULT TO SEE HOW THE SHAH WILL BE ABLE TO LEAD THE NATION TO THE ELCTIONS HE HAS PROMISED. IN FACT, IT WOULD LEAD HIM TO A CHOCE WHICH HE HAS HOPED TO AVOID--EITHER THE IMPOSITIONOF A HARSH, REPRESSIVE REGIME WHICH WOULD SHOOT ITS WAY BACK TO PRODUCTION, OR HIS ABDICATION (WHICH WOULD SOLVE NOTHING).

IF THE HARSH REGIME IS INSTALLED, AND EVEN IF PRODUCTION IS RESUMED, IT IS DIFFICULT TO IMAGINE THAT THE POLITICAL FIGURES WHO WOULD BE NECESSARY TO FORM A NATIONAL GOVT WOULD, UNDER THOSE CIRCUMSTANCES COME TOGETHER WITH THE SHAH TO ESTABLISHED THE CONDITIONS NECESSARY FOR FREE ELECTIONS. MOREOVER, SINCE THE MILITARY HAVE NO FAITH IN FREE ELECTIONS, THEY WOULD BE OF NO HELP TO THE SHAH IN THIS REGARD.

IN SHORT, I THINK THE NEXT FEW DAYS WILL BE CRITICAL IN DETERMINING WHETHER THE STRIKERS WHO HAVE PARALYZED THIS COUNTRY WILL RETURN FROM THE LONG WEEKEND PREPARED TO WORK. ONLY IF THEY DO WOULD I BE PREPARED TO ENDORSE THE FULL CONFIDENCE THAT HAS BEEN PASSED TO GENSCHER.
