1978TEHRAN10963.subject: IRAN'S MONETARY AND FINANCIAL DEVELOPMENT -- IRAN PROVIDES RELIEF TO INJURED BANKING SECTOR

segments.text: PROVIDES RELIEF TO INJURED BANKING SECTOR

SUMMARY: IN LIGHT OF NOVEMBER 5 CIVIL DISORDERS WHICH DESTROYED OR DAMAGED MANY BANKS AND CONTINUED HIGH LIQUIDITY PREFERENCE, THE CENTRAL BANK OF IRAN (CBI) WILL ANNOUNCE NOVEMBER 8 RELIEF TO BANKS IN THE FORM OF REDUCED RESERVE REQUIREMENTS. A SENIOR MEAF OFFICIAL HAS CONFIRMED OUR REPORTED CONCLUSION THAT THE GOI FOR ALL PRACTICAL PURPOSES HAS FOR THE PRESENT WRITTEN OFF THE INTERNATIONAL MONEY MARKET AS A SOURCE OF FINANCING, GIVEN THE STATE OF IRAN. FURTHER, THIS OFFICIAL SAID THAT THE FISCAL CONCERNS ARE THE LEAST IRAN FACES; IF IT CAN BUT SURVIE THIS BASIC POLITICAL TEST, IT WILL MERELY FINANCE THE DEFICITS BY CBI PURCHAEES OF BONDS.

FOREIGN EXCHANGE RESERVES REPORTEDLY STAND AT DOLLARS 10.3 BILLION, WHICH COMPARES WITH DOLLARS 10.9 BILLION ON AUGUST 22. THE FOREIGN EXCHANGE CONTROLS RECENTLY REPORTEDLY ARE BEING DESCRIBED BY THE CBI AS MERELY AN AGREEMENT BY IRAN'S BANK MANAGERS, NOT A CBI POLICY. THE UNCERTAIN STATUS OF THE PARLIAMENT IMPACTS ON THE HERETOFORE EXPECTED SCENARIO OF ECONOMIC PLANNING ACTIONS; THE COUNCIL OF MINISTERS IS EMPOWERED TO APPROVE A RESIVED/ AMENDED BUDGET IF PARLIAMENT IS IN RECESS, BUT IT APPEARS THAT ONLY PARMIAMENT CAN ACT ON THE LONG-AWAITED SIXTH DEVELOPMENT PLAN. END SUMMARY.

IRAN'S BANKS HAVE BEEN A PRIME TARGET FOR VANDALISM AND BURNING SINCE A YEAR AGO WHEN THE MULLAHS IN SOME FOUR PROVINCES LED A PROTEST AGAINST BANK SADERAT, THE LARGEST PRIVATE BANK, DUE TO A BAHAI BEING A MAJOR SHARE HOLDER. WHILE THE FOCUS ON BANKS SWITCHED TO BANKWIDE STRIKES IN THE LAST SEVERAL MONTHS, VANDALISM AND SOME BURNING OF BRANCHES CONTINUED. THE EXTENSIVE VIOLENCE OF NOVEMBER 5, MAINLY IN TEHRAN, RESSULTED IN A LARGE, BUT AS YET UNDETERMINED NUMBER OF BANK BRANCHES DESTROYED OR DAMAGED.

BANK MELLI, THE GOIOWNED AND LARGEST COMMERICAL BANK, REPORTEDLY LOST 300 BRANCHES THAT DAY; BANK OMRAN, ABOUT THE FIFTH RANKED BANK, LOST 13 IN TEHRAN AND 48 WERE DAMAGED. THIS ACTION ILLISTRATES THESCAUSE OF LOST CONFIDENCE IN THE BANKS AND, WITH THE GENERAL ENVIRONMENT OF UNCERTAINTY IN IRAN, HELPS EXPLAINS THE INCREASED LIQUIDITY PREFERENCE AND DECLINE IN BANKS' DEPOSITS REPORTED IN TEHRAN 10430. CBI VICE GOVERNOR INFORMED EMBOFF THAT BY MOST RECENT FIGURES, FOR THE MONTH ENDING SEPTEMBER 22, BANKS' DESPOSITS DDCLINED RAILS 16 BILLIONS (DOLLARS 227 MILLION) GROSS, RLS 10 BILLION (DOLLARS 141 MILLION) NET.

THE CBI HAS INJECTED RIALS 100 BILLION (DOLLARS 1.42 BILLION) NOTES IN CIRCULATION SINCE MARCH 21, THE START OF THIS IRANIAN YEAR; RIALS 50 BILLION WAS IN THE SIXTH MONTH ALONE, THAT ENDING SEPTEMBER 22. THESE FIGURES COMPARE WITH RIALS 81 BILLION NET NOTES ADDED THE ENTIRE LAST YEAR, OF WHICH RIALS 60 BILLION WERE ADDED IN THE 12TH MONTH.

ON NOVEMBER 8, CBI GOVERNOR KHOSHSISH IS TO APPEAL TO THE PUBLIC FOR CALM CONCERNIGN THE LIQUIDITY PROBLEM, ASSURE THAT THOSE WITH ACCOUNTS IN DESTROYED BANKS WILL BE SERVED IN A FEW DAYS AND ANNOUNCED THAT IN ORDER TO INCREASE LIQUIDITY AND LOANABLE FUNDS THE CREDIT AND CURRENCY COUNCIL, WHICH MET NOVMEBER 7, AGREED TO LOWER THE RESERVE REQUIREMENTS ON DEMAND DEPOSITS FROM 25 TO 10 PERCENT ON PASSBBOK AND TIME DESPOSITS AND FROM 30 TO 20 PERCENT FOR SHORT-TERM EXTERNAL BORROWINGS. ------------------055497 081827Z /43 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 1477 SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 10963

MEAF UNDERCRETARY KOOROS CONFIRMED TO EMBOFF EMBASSY'S ASSUMPTIONS REPORTED IN TEHRAN 10812, I.E. THAT GIVEN IRAN'S POLITICAL UNCERTAINTIES, IT WOULD NOT SEEK FINANCING FROM THE INTERNATIONAL MONEY MARKET FOR THE TIME BEING, KOOROS SAID THT THE GOVERNMENT WILL STOP-GAP ANY WAY IT MUST TO FINANCE ITSELF AND THAT IT WOULD NOT MAKE SENSE TO EXPOSE ITS PROBLEMS AND JEOPARDIZE ITS RECORD OF PRIME RISK BY SEEKING FUFNDS ABROAD NOW. WHEN ASKED HOW THE GOI WOULD MEET ITS INCREASING RIAL REQUIREMENTS, HE SAID THAT THE COUNCIL OF MINISTERS HAS AUTHORITY TO AUTHORIZE THE SALE OF BONDS FOR CBI PRUCHASE.

AS POINTED OUT IN TEHRAN 10244 AND PREVIOUS, THE EMBASSY CONCLUDED THAT ANYTHING OVER WHAT THE DOMESTIC CAPITAL MARKET COULD PROVIDE, AND THATGENERALLY IS THROUGHT THE RESERVE REQUIREMENT, PLUS BORROWINGS ABROAD (THEN DEEMED A MAXIMUM DOLLARS 3 BILLIONS, BUT NOW LESS) WOULD BE IN EFFECT PRINTED MONEY. WITH THE LOWER RESERVE REQUIREMTN AND CURTAILMENT OF AT LEASTSYNDIACTED FOREIGN BORROWINGS, WE EXPECT THE DOMESTIC DEBT TO THE BANKING SYSTEM, PARTIUCLARLY TO THE CBI, TO MOUNT RAPIDLY AND THE FOREIGN EXCHANGE RESERVES TO BE DRAWN DOWN FURTHER THAN THEAPPROMXIMATELY DOLLARS 1 BILLION HERTOFORE PREDICTED.

THE LATTER FUNCTION DEPENDS ALSO ON THE IMPORT PAYMENTS, WHICH IN THE PRIVATE SECTOR ARE EXPECTED TO EXCEED 17 PERCENT, AND THE DECLINE IN EXPECTED RECEIPTS FROM OIL EXPORTS, WHICH WILL EACH DAY OF OIL STRIKES INCREASES. SHOULD OTHER EXTERNAL FLOWS FOLLOW OUR EXPECTATIONS AND THE OIL STRIKE SETTLE AND NORMAL EXPORT VOLUMES RESUME WITHIN THE WEEK, THE CURRENT ACCOUNT DEFICIT WOULD INCRASE FROM OUR FORECAST COLLARS 1.5 TO 2.0 BILLION TO SOMEDOLLARS4 BILLION.

A CBI VICE GOVERNOR ON NOVEMBER 8 SAID THAT IRAN'S OFFICIAL FOREING EXCHANGE RESERVES STOOD AT DOLLARS 10.3 BILLION, WHICH WOULD COMPARE WITH DILLARS 10.9 BILLIMN ON AUGUST 22, HHE LAST MONTH FOR WHICH WE HAVE COMPLETE DATE (TEHRAN A-123). USING THE LAST KNOWN GOLD AND IMF GOLD TRANCHE AND SHARES, THIS WOULD PUT OFFICIAL RESERVES AT DOLLARS 10.7 BILLION. THE CURBS PLACED ON FOREIGN EXCHANGE OUTFLOWS REPORTED IN TEHRAN 10811 ARE STILL GENERALLY UNKNOWN IN TEHRAN'S BANKING COMMUNITY DUE TO THE PARTIAL CLOSING OF BANKS AND LACK OF MEDIA OPERATIONS.

SEVERAL BANKERS REPORTED NOVEMBER 8 THAT LARGE AMOUNTS WERE STILL BEING SOLD IN WAYS THAT COULD ONLY BE TERMED CAPITAL FLIGHT. GIVEN THE RATHER OPEN ACKNOWLEDGEMENT BY A CBI DIRECTOR GENERAL OF THE GENESIS OF THE NEW POLICY ADOPTED NOVEMBER 5, IT WAS INTERESTING TO BE TOLD VY A VICE GOVERNOR NOVEMBER 8 THAT THESE MEASURES WERE NOT CBI POLICY, BUT RATHER REFLECTED A DECISION BY A METTING OF COMMERCIAL BANK MANAGERS AT THE CBI ON NOVEMBER 4. PERHAPS THIS CHARACTERIZATION OF THE MEASURES WILL PLACE THE RESTRICTIONS BEYOND THE PALE OF IMF OVERVIEW, BUT OUR UNDERSTANDING IS THAT THE EFFECT IS NOT CHANGED.

THE REVISED CURRENT YEAR BUDGET, WHICH WAS TO HAVE BEEN SUBMITTED TO THE PARLIAMENT THI OR LASTWEEK, MAY NOW BE ADOPTED BY THE COUNCIL OF MINISTERS. ALL DEPENDS ON THE AS YET UNCERTAIN FUTURE OF THE PARLIAMENT. WHEN IN RECESS, THE COUNCIL HAS THE POWER TO AMEND/REVISE THE BUDGET. MEAF'S KOOROS BELIEVES THAT THIS IS MORE LIKELY. BEST INFORMATION INDICATES, HOWEVER, THAT ONLY THE PARLIAMENT CAN ACT ON A DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

THUS, THE LONG-AWAITED SIXTH ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT PLAN (1978-83) WHICH MOST RECENTLY (TEHRAN 10433) WAS PREDICTED TO BE SUBMITTED TO PARLIAMENT IN NOVEMBER/EARLY DECEMBER, MAY REVERT TO THE IN-HOUSE TOOL IT HAS BEEN SINCE THE DRAFT WAS COMPLETED IN JUNE 1977. THE DEPARTURE FROM THE PLAN AND BUDGET ORGANIZATION OF MINISTER MEHRAN IS UNFORTUNATE, AND IF THE MINISTERIAL VACANCY IS FILLED, IT WILL BE THE SIXTH MINISTER IN FIFTEEN MONTHS.
INQUIRIES LATER TODAY INDICATE THAT, CONTRARY TO RUMOR, NATIONAL FRONT AND OTHER OPPOSITION POLITICIANS HAVE NOT, RPT NOT, BEEN ARRESTED.
WE HAVE NOT BEEN ABLE TO GET THROUGH TO HOVEYDA TODAY AND MUST, THEREFORE, ASSUME REPORTS OF HIS ARREST ARE CORRECT.

AFTER POSTPONING SESSION SCHEDULED FOR NOV 7, MAJLIS MET IN OPEN SESSION NOV 9. IN QUIET PROCEEDING IT DEBATED AND THEN APPROVED LIFTING OF IMMUNITY FROM MEMBER MANSUR YASSINI, WHO IS ACCUSED OF CORRUPTION. PEZESHKPOUR OPPOSITION PARTY PUT A QUESTION TO THE NEW GOT ASKING ABOUT "THE EVENTS OF 17TH SHAHRIVAR" (SEPT 8) IN THE SOUTHERN PORT OF JAS (WHERE THERE WERE SOME DEMONSTRATIONS, APPARENTLY, ON THE SAME DAY AS THE JALEH SQUARE INCIDENT HERE). PEZESHPOUR ALSO SENT THE SPEAKER A PARLIAMENTARY NOTICE, SUBJECT OF WHICH IS NOT KNOWN.
SESSION ENDED AFTER SPEAKER, ON BEHALF OF PARLIAMENT, EXPRESSED APPROVAL OF SHAH'S NOV 6 MESSAGE TO THE NATION.

PARLIAMENTARY SOURCE INFORMS US SPEAKER HAS PAID SEVERAL VISITS TO THE SHAH OVER PAST FEW DAYS. HE WAS TOLD THAT, IF PARLIAMENT REMAINS QUIET AND COOPERATES WITHTHE GOVT, THE NEW GOVT WILL PRESENT ITS PROGRAM TO IT FOR APPROVAL. IF MAJLIS DOES NOT REMAIN QUIET, SHAH WILL EXERCISE HIS CONSTITUTIONAL PREROGATIVE AND DISSOLVE IT.

SUMMARY: AZHARI GOVT MILITARY MINISTERS BEGIN TRY AT RALLYING SUPPORT. ISRAELIS BELIEVE FOUR GERMANS WERE KILLED IN SARI ON CASPIAN NOV 8, BUT NO CONFIRMATION AVAILABLE. SCATTERED INCIDENTS OF VIOLENCE ELSEWHERE IN PROVINCES: SOME INCLUDE REPORTS OF ARMED DISSIDENTS. SHAH'S PHYSICIAN REPORTED TO BE UNDER ARREST. UPI CORRESPONDENT TO BE EXPELLED. MANY RUMORS ABOUND. AS OF 1200 LOCAL, NO DEMONSTRATIONS UNDERWAY IN TEHRAN. END SUMMARY

ARMISH-MAAG CHIEF WAS TOLD ADMIRAL HABIBOLLAHI, NEW EDUCATION AND HIGHER EDUCATION MINISTER, MET NOV 8 WITH UNIVERSITY CHANCELLORS, WHO HAD COME WITH RESIGNATIONS IN POCKET. HABIBOLLAHI REPORTEDLY TALKED GROUP INTO REMAINING ON JOB BUT DAUTHTER OF TEHRAN UNIVERSITY CHANCELLOR SHAIBANI TOLD BRITISH EMBOFF HE HAS RESIGNED. GENERAL RABII, NEW HOUSING MINISTER, CALLED IN OPPOSITION MAJLIS DEPUTIES AND ASKED THEM TO COOPERATE WITH GOVT DURING NATIONAL CRISIS.

ISRAELI MISSION HAS WHAT THEY CONSIDER WELL FOUNDER REPORT THAT FOUR GERMANS WERE KILLED IN SARI ON CAPIAN SEA. EMBASSY UNABLE TOCONFIRM. SHIRAZ HAS BEEN QUIET PAST TWO DAYS WITH ONE FIRE EACH DAY. U.S. CONSUL ON VISIT TO AHWAZ REPORTS THAT CITY QUIET NOV 8, WITH NIOC EMPLOYEES AND MANAGEMENT WARILY EYEING EACH OTHER FROM OPPOSITE SIDES OF BARRICADES. NIOC HAS NOT RPT NOT RETURNED TO OPERATION THERE. INCIDENTS OF VIOLENCE REPORTED IN ZANJAN, MARAGHEH, SANANDAJ AND ZAHEDAN, WHERE REPORTEDLY MANY WERE KILLED, INCLUDING POLICE OFFICERS. THERE IS SOME INDICATION DISSIDENTS IN ZAHEDAN MAY HAVE HAD SOME ARMS.

TELEPHONE REPORT FROM TAFT TEAM AT VADATI AIRBASE NEAR DEZFUL INDICATES ARMED FARMERS ARE ATTACKING SOME BRIDGES IN AREA DNAMAY BE COMING TO THE BASE. U.S. SOURCE IN AREA REPORTS IN NEJAFABAD, NEAR ISFAHAN, ATTACK BY DISSIDENTS ON MUNICIPAL BUILDING RESULTED IN SEVERAL KILLED, WITH RUMOR THAT SIX-YEAR OLD CHILD WAS AMONG THEM.

UNDP RESREP ASKED FOREIGN MINISTRY FOR ADVICE REGARDING PERSONNEL AND WAS TOLD, SINC MINISTRIES WERE NOT REALLY WORKING, IT MIGHT BE BEST FOR U.N. EMPLOYEES TO REMAIN AT HOME UNTIL NOTIFIED. HE HAS SO INSTRUCTED HIS STAFF. LOCAL SOURCE TOLD ASST CIVAIR ATTACHE THAT IRAN AIR WILL BE SENDING ALL EXPATRIATE PERSONNEL HOME FOR THREE MONTHS. IF AIRLINE CAN OPERATE WITHOUT THEM, OK; IF NOT, THEYWILL BE REHIRED LATER AND GIVEN THREE MONTHS BACK PAY. HOWEVER, EMBASSY LEARNED TODAY THIS ORDER WAS RESCINDED AFTER IT WAS ISSUED.

THERE HAS BEEN INCREASE IN NUMBER OF RANDOM TELEPHONE THREATS TO FOREIGNERS. MANY CALLERS KNOW NAME OF RECIPIENT AND THOSE RECEIVING CALLS ARE BEING ADVISED TO LEAVE IRAN IN 24 HOURS, TWO WEEKS, OR BY DECEMBER 1, OR BE KILLED.
UPI CORRESPONDENT SAJID RIZVI (PAKISTANI NATIONAL) HAS BEEN ARRESTED AND IS BEING EXPELLED (BEING REPORTED SEPTEL NOTAL).

ABSENCE OF NEWSPAPERS AND MINIMAL REPORTING ON RADIO HAS LEFT BOTH IRANIANS AND FOREIGNERS PREY TO LOOSEST KINDS OF RUMORS. EXAMPLE IS STORY WHICH IS UNTRUE, RPT UNTRUE, THAT THREE AMERICANS WERE KILLED EVENING NOV 8 IN TAJRISH AREA OF NORTH TEHRAN. IT APPEARS OPPOSITION IS ATTEMPTING TO INCREASE PSYCHOLOGICAL PRESSURE ON FOREIGN RESIDENTS BY THREATS AND RUMOR MONGERING.
AS OF NOV 9 1200 LOCAL TIME, THERE HAVE BEEN NO RPT NO INCIDENTS OR DEMONSTRATIONS IN TEHRAN TODAY.
GEN ABDOL KARIM AYADI, PERSONAL PHYSICIAN TO SHAH, IS REPORTED TO BE UNDER ARREST. OPPOSITIONISTS BAZARGAN AND FOROUHAR ARE NOT RPT NOT UNDER ARREST(CONTRARY TO EARLIER RUMOR).

1978TEHRAN11035.subject: OPPOSITION'S PLAN FOR SHAH'S ABDICATION SUMMARY: BRITISH EMBASSY AND WE HAVE BEEN PRESENTED WITH LATEST OPPOSITION PROPOSAL FOR SOLUTION TO TH

segments.text: SUMMARY: BRITISH EMBASSY AND WE HAVE BEEN PRESENTED WITH LATEST OPPOSITION PROPOSAL FOR SOLUTION TO THE PRESENT CRISIS. IT ENVISAGES SHAH'S ADBICATION, REGENCY COUNCIL, FREE ELECTION, AND CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY TO CONSIDER CONTINUATION OF MONARCHY OR CHANGE TO OTHER FOQM OF GOVT. BRITISH AND WE HAVE BEEN ASKED TO PRESENT THIS TO THE SHAH. END SUMMARY

CIVIL RIGHT-RELIGIOUSOPPOSITION LEADER MINATCHI APPROACHED BRITISH AMBASSADOR NOV 4 AND HAD FOLLOW-UP MEETING WITH BRITISH HEAD OF CHANCERY YESTERDAY, NOV 8, TO PRESENT PLAN FOR CONSTITUTIONAL SOLUTION OF PRESENT SITUAOION. MINATCHI REPEATED ELEMENTS OF HIS PLAN TO POL COUNS NOV 9 AFTER BRITISH BRIEFED US ON THE APPROACH.

SOLUTION VISUALIZES ABDICATION AND DEPARTURE OF THE SHAH. REGENCY COUNCIL HEADED BY QUEEN OR SOMEONE ELSE THE SHAH MIGHT APPOINT WOULD BE FLESHED OUT WITH AT LEAST FOUR CIVILIAN AND THREE MILITARY. AMONG THE CIVILIANS WOULD BE REPRESENTATIVES OF POLITICAL PARTIES AS WELL AS, POSSIBLY, PRIME MINISTER AND CHIEF OF PARLIAMENT. THREE MILITARY WOULD INCLUDE RETIRED GENERALS SUCH AS JAM, GARZAN, MADANI, OR AKHAVI. THEIR PRESENCE IS INTENDED TO MAINTAIN COOPERATION OF THE MILITARY IN THIS PROCESS. ELECTIONS FOR CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY WOULD FOLLOW SHORTLY, AND IT WOULD MEET TO DECIDE WHETHER ANY ARTICLES OF THE CONSTITUTION NEEDED AMENDMENT.

MINATCHI NOTED THERE HAS BEEN TALK OF REFERENDUM ON CONTINUATION OF MONARCHY, BUT OPPOSITION DID NOT LIKE THE IDEA GIVEN PAST EXPERIENCE IN IRAN. CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY WOULD BEGIN WITH 1906 CONSTITUTION AND SEE WHAT IS NECESSARY TO ADD OR CHANGE.

HAVING JUST RETURNED FROM QOM, MINATCHI SAID HE HAS OBTAINED AGREEMENTOF SHARIAT-MADARI AND HIS FELLOW AYATOLLAHS GOLPAYEGANI AND MARASCHI TO THESE PROPOSALS. HE HAS ALSO OBTAINED AGREEMENT OF BAZARGAN (WITH WHOM MINATCHI IS VERY CLOSE) AND EXPECTED OTEHRS SUCH AS SANJBAI TO FALL QUICKLY INTO LINE, AS THIS REPRESENTED WHAT THEY WANTED. WHEN POL COUNS SUGGESTED THIS REPRESENTS CONSIDERABLEHARDENINGIN THE POSITION OF THE MODERATE OPPOSITION (KHOMENI ASIDE), MINATCHI ONLY PARTIALLY ADMITTED IT DID. HE SAID SHARIAT-MADARI AND OTHERS HAVE BEEN TALKING ABOUT APPLYING 1906 CONSTITUTION. TECHNICALLY, THIS DOES NOT INCLUDE LATER AMENDMENTS.IT IS 1925 AMENDMENT WHICH SPEAKS OF PERPETUAL REIGN BY PAHLAVI DYNASTY.

HE ALSO ADMITTED IT WAS AMENDMENTS THAT INCLUDE PROVISION FOR FIVE MULLAHS TO APPROVE ALL ACTS OF PARLIAMENT. THUS, MINATCHI IMPLIED THAT SHARIAT-MADARI HAS BEEN TALKING ABOUT AN END TO THE PAHLAVI DYNASTY ALL ALONG.

MINATCHI WAS QUITE CLEAR THAT HE WAS PRESENTING THIS PLAN TO BRITISH AND US, SO THAT THE TWO AMBASSADORS COULD PRESENT IT TO THE SHAH AND URGE THAT HE ACCEPT IT. OPPOSITION WAS PREPARED TO PUT PROPOSAL TO THE SHAH DIRECTLY, BUT ONLY AFTER BRITISH AND AMERICANS HAD REPARED HIM FOR IT. HE IS A STONG DICTATOR, MINATCHI SAID, AND WOULD CERTAINLY DISMISS PLAN OUT OF HAND IF OPPOSITION PRESENTED IT TO HIM FIRST. SINCE SHAH RELIES HEAVILY ON CONTINUING SUPPORT FROM USG AND BRITISH, HIS CONSIDERATION OF THE PROPOSAL WOULD BE GREATLY FACILITATED IF THOSE GOVTS SHOWED SUPPORT FOR IT.
OPPOSITION WISHED REASSURE USG AND UK THAT IT CONSIDERS THEM ITS FRIENDS TOO, AND RECOGNIZES THEY HAVE BASIC INTERESTS TO PROTECT IN IRAN.

POL COUNS SAID HE WAS HAPPY TO HAVE PLAN SPELLED OUT IN THIS DETAIL AND WOULD OF COURSE REPORT IT TO AMBASSADOR AND WASHINGTON. HE THOUGHTBRITISH HEAD OF CHANCERY HAD GIVEN PRELIMINARY NEGATIVE REACTION, WHICH IN ALL HONSESTY POL COUNS THOUGH WOULD BE USG REACTION TOO. MINATCHI WAS AWARE THAT HE WAS ASKING US AND UK TO INTERVENE IN INTERNAL POLITICALPROCESS IN IRAN. HE DOUBTED US AND UK GOVTS WOULD WISH TO DO SO, OR TO UNDERTAKE THE RESPONSIBILITY SUCH A STEP WOULD ENTAIL IN GUARANTEEING A SATISFACTORY OUTCOME FROM THEPOINT OF VIEW FOM ALL PARTIES CONCERNED, AND THE IRANIAN PEOPLE.

BEYOND THAT HE ONLY VENTURED TO SAY, IN A PERSONAL WAY, THAT THE PROPOSAL SEEMED TO HIM ILL-TERMED WITH THE SHAH HAVING BEEN UNABLE TO CONCLUDE NEGOTIATIONS FOR A COALITION GOVT ONLY A FEW DAYS AGO, AND HAVING AUTHORIZED INSTALLATION OF A MILITARY GOVT, PROPOSAL SEEMS TO BE EITHER TOO EARLY OR TOO LATE. MINATCHI SMILED HIS UNDERSTANDING AND DID NOT TAKE ISSUE.

COMMENT: PROPOSAL AS IT STANDS AMOUNTS OF COURSE TO POLITE INVITATION THAT SHAH SURRENDER. IT INCORPORATES ALL ELEMENTS OF BEST POSSIBLE RESULT FROM OPPOSITION'S POINT OF VIEW. AT THE SAME TIME, THERE IS LITTLE INDICATION OPPOSITION IS PREPAREDTO NEGOTIATE BACK FROM THIS PROPOSAL VERY MUCH. WE CANNOT FORESEE SHAH GIVING IT SERIOUS CONSIDERATION UNLESS MILITARY GOVT FAILS TO REESTABLISH LAW AND ORDER AND HE IS LEFT WITHOUT ANY OTHER VIABLE OPTIONS IN HIS DESIRE TO MAINTAIN STABILITY IN IRAN.

I MET FOR AN HOUR EVENING NOVEMBER 9 WITH PRIME MINISTER AZHARI. HE MET WITH ME IN PRIME MINISTER'S RESIDENCE EXPLAINING THAT HE WAS MEETING WITH PARLIAMENTARY LEADERSHIP SHORTLY AT HIS OFFICE ON THE NEXT BLOCK. HE SEEMED HIS USUAL, GENTLE, CANDID, AND FRIENDLY SELF.

I BEGAN BY THANKING HIM FOR PROTECTION WHICH HAD BEEN AFFORDED MY EMBASSY DURING LAST FEW DAYS, ESPECIALLY LAST SUNDAY, WHEN ARSON HAD SURROUNDED US ON ALL SIDES. I ALSO REHEARSED THE SEQUENCE OF CONSULTATIONS WITH SHAH WHICH ENDED WITH INVESTITURE OF MILITARY GOVERNMENT.
WITH THIS FAR OFF AOUT OF THE WAY, I ASKED HOW HE SAW CURRENT SITUATION. HE TOLD ME A FEW THINGS OF INTEREST

PUBLIC SCHOOL OPEINING WOULD BE DELAYED UNTIL SATURDAY 18 NOVEMBER, BECAUSE MANY SCHOOLS HAD SUFFERED PHYSICAL DAMAGE WHICH NEEDED REPAIR (I ASKED WHETHER THIS WAS AT REQUEST OF TEACHERS. WHEN HE ANSWERED IN AFFIRMATIVE I CONCLUDED THAT TEACHERS WANTED TO SEE HOW WIND WAS BLOWING BEFORE THEY AGREED TO RETURN TO WORK).

ON CIVIL SERVANTS, HE EXUDED CONFIDENCE THAT ALL WOULD RETURN TO WORK SUNDAY. I STRESSED IMPORTANCE OF CUSTOMS AND TRANSPORT OFFICIALS BECAUSE OF HEAVY IRANIAN DEPENDEANCE (30 PERCENT) ON IMPORTED FOODS. HE SAID HE FELT SURE THEY WOULD RETURN. THEY HAD CUT WORK BECAUSE THEY WERE AFRAID, RATHER THAN DISAFFECTED.

ON OIL PRODUCTION, HE SAID ARMY HAD FINALLY BEGUN TO CRACK DOWN. ABOUT FIFTEEN RINGLEADERS HAD BEEN ARRESTED TODAY AND MORE WOULD BE "CAPTURED" TOMORROW UNLESS THEY COOPERATED. WHEN I EXPRESSED AMAZEMENT THAT NIOC HAD PAID WORKERS YESTERDAY, HE SAID THAT WAS DELIBERATE DECISION TO CREATE GOOD WILL. HE FELT CONFIDENT THAT THE COMBINATION OF THAT GOOD WILL PLUS THE ARRESTS OF ACTIVISTS WOULD RETURN NIOC TO FULL PRODUCTION.
ON TELECOMMUNICATIONS AND IRAN AIR, HE INSISTED STRIKES WERE OVER AND THAT IT WAS ONLY MATTER OF TIME BEFORE THEY WERE BACK IN FULL SWING.

I THEN ASKED WHAT HE INTENDED TO DO IF ALL HIS ROSY PREDICTIONS WENT AWRY. HE SAID HE WOULD HAVE TO ARREST A NUMBER OF PEOPLE AT SAME TIME, HE SAID THIS WOULD BE UNFORTUNATE, BECAUSE HE WISHED TO GOVERN WITHOUT ANY ORGANIZED OPPOSITION.

HE THEN TOLD ME THAT HE HAD HAD TWO-HOUR TELEPHONE CONVERSATION LAST NIGHT WITH AYATOLLAH SHIRAZI AND ALL HIS MULLAHS IN MASHAD. HE HAD ALSO EXCHANGED INDIRECT MESSAGES WITH THE AYATOLLAHS OF QOM. THE ALL OF THEM HE HAD SAID THAT HE WAS INSTRUCTING LOCAL GOVERNMENTS AT ALL LEVELS TO CREATE JOINT COMMITTEE S, WHICH WOULD INCLUDE EXECUTIVE BRANCH, COMMUNITY REPRESENTATIVES AND THREE MULLAHS.

I ASKED WHAT WOULD HAPPEN IF ALL THIS FAILED. HE SAID HE WOULD HAVE TO BEGIN SOME ARRESTS. IF THIS FAILED, THEY MIGHT HAVE SOME "CONFRONTATIONS" I ASKED IF IRANIANS HAD ADEQUATE NON-LETHAL CROWD CONTROL EQUIPMENT. HE SAQD HE HAD APPROVED LIST OF REQUIREMENTS TODAY- HE COULDN'T REMEMBER IT ALL, BUT WATER CANNONS WERE IN IT. HE SUGGESTED GENERAL GAST GET IT FROM GENERAL HATAM. I THEN RAISED QUESTION OF TRAINING BY BRITISH. HE INSISTED BRITISH WERE ACCEPTABLE AND GENERAL GAST AGAIN COULD INQUIRE OF GENERAL HATAM.

WE TALKED ALSO ABOUT THE NEED FOR HONEST PUBLIC RELATIONS, FOR THE NEED TO PROTECT AMERICANS. FOR THE VALUE OF FIXING A DEFINITE LIMIT TO HIS ARRESTS OF "CORRUPT PERSONS" IN ORDER TO AVOID A WITCH-HUNT, AND FOR THE REQUIREMENT THAT HE SHOULD OBSERVE PERSONAL SECURITY PRECAUTIONS.

FINALLY, I ASKED IF THERE WAS ANYTHING I COULD DO TO ASSIST. HE THEN TOOK OFF ON BBC AND ASKED IF I COULD HELP INTRODUCE RESPONSIBILITY AND ACCURACY IN ITS BROADCASTS. I DESCRIBED PROBLEMS BRITISH AMBASSADOR HAD EXPERIENCED IN DEALING WITH BBC AUTONOMY. HOWEVER, I AGREED RAISE QUESTION TO HIGHEST LEVEL. (SEPTEL).

AS I WAS LEAVING, I ASKED WHY HE WAS MEETING WITH PARLIAMENTAN LEADERS. HE SAID HE INTENDED TO PRESENT HIS GOVERNMENT TO PARLIAMENT FOR RATIFICATION. HE SAID IT HAD BEEN DIFFICULT TO GET CIVILIANS TO SERVE IN HIS GOVERNMENT BECAUSE THEY WERE "INTIMIDATED" BY KHOMEINI. HOWEVER, HE FELT A SOUND ROUT OF KHOMEINI FORCES IN STRIKES WOULD BRING MANY OTHERS TO RALLY TO HIS SIDE.

COMMENT: MY IMPRESSION IS THAT AZHARI REMAINS A DECENT PERSIAN GENTLEMAN DEALING WITH PEOPLE AND FORCES HE DOES NOT FULLY UNDERSTAND. HE PROPOSES TO WORK WITHIN THE MARQUIS OF QUEENSBURY RULES, WHILE HIS OPPONENTS IN THE KHOMEINY CAMP ARE PREPARED TO RESORT TO MORE AGGRESSIVE TACTICS. I DO NOT BELIEVE HE HAS YET GRASPED THE NATURE OF HIS CONFRONTATION. IT THEREFORE REAMINS TO BE SEEN WHETHER HE WILL GET THIS NATION BACK TO WORK.

WITH THE INCIDENCE OF SHI'A HOLY DAY ID-E-GHORBAN ON SATURDAY, NOVEMBER 11, AND WITH ITS NORMAL THURSDAYFRIDAY WEEKEND, IRAN HAS ENTERED ON A LONG THREE DAY HOLIDAY. CURRENT INDICATIONS ARE THAT IT WILL BE QUIET, BUT WE SHALL HAVE TO TEST ITS TEMPER AS THE DAYS PASS. SUNDAY, NOVEMBER 12, WILL BE ASCRITICAL DAY, BECAUSE ONLY THEN WILL WE SEE WHETHER THE MILITARY GOVT WILL BE SUCCESSFUL IN GETTING THIS COUNTRY BACK TO PRODUCCTIVE WORK.

IN THE MEANTIME, IT MIGHT BE USEFUL TO ENGAGE IN SOME FUNDAMENTAL EXAMINATIONS OF THE SITUATION IN IRAN AND THE FUTURE OF U.S.-IRAN RELATIONS. IN DOING THIS, IT IS PROBABLY HEALTHY TO EXAMINE SOME OPTIONS WHICH WE HAVE NEVER BEFORE CONSIDERED RELEVEANT.

FOR FOREIGNERS, THE GENERAL CLICHE ABOUT IRAN HAS BEEN HAT ITS SOCIETY RESTED ON TWO PILLARS--THE MONARCHY AND THE SHI'A RELIGION. FOR THE PAST FIFTEEN YEARS, THE RELIGIOUS PILLAR HAS BEEN VERY MUCH SUBORDINATED AND THE TILT HAS BEEN DECIDEDLY TOWARDS THE MONARCHY. IT IS NOT NECESSARY IN THIS MESSAGE TO DESCRIBE THE WAY IN WHICH THE RELIGIOUS PILLAR HAS BEEN ENCHANCED IN THE PAST TEN MONTHS. HOWEVER, IT MAY BE NECESSARY TO EXAMINE VERY CLOSELY THE CHANGES WHICH HAVE TAKEN PLACE IN THE MONARCHIC PILLAR.

FIRST, THE AUTHORITY OF THE SHAH HAS CONSIDERABLY SHRUNK. HIS SUPPORT AMONG THE GENERAL PUBLIC HAS BECOME ALSMOT INVISIBLE THESE DAYS. PORTRAITS OF THE IMPERIAL FAMILY, WHICH FORMERLY ADORNED EVERY SHOP WINDOW, HAVE NEARLY TOTALLY DISAPPEARED. WHETHER THE VIEWS OF THE SILENT MAJORITY, THE ONLY TANGIBLE EVIDENCE OF IRANIAN SUPPORT FOR THE MONARCHY COMES FROM THE ARMED FORCES. IT HAS THEREFORE BECOME COMMONPLACE TO REFER TO THE MONARCHY AS THE "SHAH--SUPPORTED BY THE MILITARY."

HOWEVER, EVEN WITHIN THAT RELATIONSHIP, EVENTS OF RECENT DAYS MAY HAVE PRODUCED A SUBTLE CHANGE. IT MAY BE MORE CORRECT AT THIS TIME TO SPEAK OF THE MONARCHI PILLAR AS BEING CONSTITUTED ESSENTIALLY OF THE MILITARYWHICH (CURRENTLY) SUPPORTS THE SHAH. IN CONSEQUENCE, THE TWO ELEMENTS THAT NEED OUR EXAMINATION ARE THE MILITARY AND THE RELIGIOUS.

AT THE MOMENT, THESE TWO ELEMENTS ARE OSTENSIBLY IN CONFRONTATION. THE RELIGIOUS HAVE CALLED FOR THE EQUIVALENT OF SATYAGRAHA--PASSIVE RESISTANCE WITH STRIKES IN STRATEGIC AREAS OF THE ECONOMY. THE OIL PRODUCTION FACILITIES, IRAN AIR AND THE TELECOMMUNICATIONS SYSTEM SEEM TO BE THE PRIME TARGETS OF THEIR ATTENTION. IF THE MILITARY CAN GET THESE AREAS OF THE ECONOMY BACK IN FULL PRODUCTION PEACEABLY, THEY WILL PROBABLY BE ABLE TO PREVAIL OVER THE RELIGIOUS, BUT THE RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN THE TWO PILLARS WILL BE TINGED WITH TENSION, AND THE PROBABILITY OF TERRORISM, SABOTAGE AND XENOPHOBIA (SEE TEHRAN 10706).

ON THE OTHER HAND, IF THE MILITARY AIL TO RESTORE PRODUCTION AND TO BREAK THE TIDE OF PASSIVE RESISTANCE, THEY WILL REACH THE POINT OF MAKING A FATEFUL DECISION-EITHER TO ENFORCE PRODUCTION BY A BLOODBATH OR TO REACH AN ACCOMMODATION WITH THE RELIGIOUS. SINCE THE LATTER ARE DOMINATED BY AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, IT MUST BE ASSUMED THAT A PRE-CONDITION FOR AN ACCOMODATION WOULD BE THE ACCEPTANCE OF HIS INSISTENCE THAT THE SHAH MUST LEAVE AND THE MONARCHY BE DIS-ESTABLISHED IN FAVOR OF AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC.

IT IS RATHER DIFFICULT TO IMAGINE A MAN LIKE PRIME MINISTER GENERAL AZHARI WILLINGLY PLUNGING HIS COUNTRY INTO A BLOOD BATH. IT IS EQUALLY DIFFICULT TO IMAGINE HIM, OR MOST MILITARY OFFICERS OF HIS VINTAGE, INVITING THE SHAH TO ABDICATE. HOWEVER, IF THE SHAH AND THE MILITARY BOTH SHY AWAY FROM THE BLOODBATH, IT MAY EVENTUATE THAT BOTH THE SHAH AND THE MORE SENIOR MILITARY WOULD ABDICATE, LEAVING THE ARMED FORCES UNDER THE LEADERSHIP OF YOUNGER OFFICERS WHO WOULD BE PREPARED TO REACH AN ACCOMODATION WITH THE RELIGIOUS.

IF SUCH A TURN OF EVENTS SHOULD TRANSPIRE, IT WOULD BE IMPORTANT FOR THE U.S. TO HAVE DONE A CAREFUL EVALUATION OF ITS CONSEQUENCES FOR OUR POSITION AND THAT OF OUR ALLIES WITH RESPECT TO IRAN. THE FOLLOWING CONSIDERATIONS ARE RELEVANT: ------------------098794 100618Z /12 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1521 SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 11039 EXDIS (HANDLE AS NODIS) (A) BOTH THE IRANIAN ARMED FORCES AND THE KHOMEINI MUSLIMS ARE STRONGLY ANTI-COMMUNIST AND ANTI-SOVIET. (WE SAY THIS DESPITE REPORTS OF ALLEGED COMMUNIST INFILTRATION OF KHOMEINI'S CIRCLE OF ADVISERS.) (B) THE YOUNGER MILITARY OFFICERS HAVE A GENUINE PRO-WEST ORIENTATION.

ALL AIR FORCE, MOST ARMY, AND MANY NAVY OFFICERS HAVE BEEN TRAINED IN U.S. THOSE NAVY NOT TRAINED IN U.S. HAVE BEEN TRAINED IN U.K. AND ITALY. (C) DESPITE RELIGIOUS COMPLAINTS THAT THE WEST IS "STEALING" IRANIAN OIL, LOGIC OFIRAN'S ECONOMIC TIES WITH WEST WOULD HAVE TO ASSERT ITSELF IN ANY REALISTIC APPRAISAL OF IRAN'S ECONOMIC SURVIVAL. (D) IRANIAN MILITARY OUGHT TO BE ABLE TO PRESERVE ITS INTEGRITY AND NOT RPT NOT EVAPORATE. RELIGIOUS WOULD FIND IT USEFUL FOR MILITARY TO REMAIN INTACT, BECAUSE THEY HAVE NO RPT NO ISLAMIC INSTRUMENTS FOR MAINTAINING LAW AND ORDER OR THE INTEGRITY AND DEFENSE OF THE NATION.

(E) AS CONSEQUENCE OF ANY MILITARY-MULLAH ACCOMMODATION, KHOMEIVI COULD BE EXPECTED RETURN TO IRAN IN TRIUMPH AND HOLD A GANDHI-LIKE POSITION IN THE POLITICAL CONSTELLATION. HE HAS SAID THAT, AT SUCH TIME, HE WOULD "REVEAL" THE NAME OF HIS CANDIDATE FOR POLITICAL LEADERSHIP. HOWEVER, IT WOULD PRESUMABLY HAVE TO BE SOMEONE ACCEPTABLE TOTHE MILITARY RATHER THAN A NASSER-QADHAFI TYPE THAT MIGHT BE THE AYATOLLAH'S PREFERRED CANDIDATE. (F) IF, AS RESULT OF FOREGOING CONSIDERATIONS, NONCOMMUNIST, MODERATE POLITICAL FIGURES LIKTDCHP SQ ZO SEZTZINATCHI# SHOULD EMERGE IN POSITIONS OF RESPONSIBILITY, THEY WOULD CALL FOR ELECTIONS TO A CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY TO DRAW UP A CONSTITUTION FOR AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN.

IF ELECTIONS ARE HELD IN ANY ATMOSPHERE OTHER THAN ONE OF FRENZY, SUCH ASSEMBLY OUGHT TO CONTAIN A STRONG PRESENCE OF NON-COMMUNISTS, NON-ISLAMIC-FANATICS, AND PRO-WESTERN MODERATES WHO WOULD HAVE CONSIDERABLE INFLUENCE IN DEVELOPING A RESPONSIBLE CONSTITUTIONAL DOCUMENT. (G) WHILE IT IS DIFFICULT TO PREDICT THE SORT OF GOVT WHICH MIGHT EMERGE FROM SUBSEQUENT GENERAL ELECTIONS, THERE WOULD BE REASONS TO HOPE THAT IT WOULD MAINTAIN IRAN'S GENERAL INTERNATIONAL ORIENTATION EXCEPT THAT IT WOULD CEASE ITS TIES WITH ISRAEL AND ASSOCIATE ITSELF WITH THE ARABS, PROBABLY CLOSER TO THE REJECTIONIST FRONT THAN TO SAUDI ARABIA. IT WOULD PROBABLY BE A KUWAIT WRIT LARGE IN ITS GENERAL ORIENTATION. (H) ALTHOUGH U.S.

INVOLVEMENT WOULD BE LESS INTIMATE THAN WITH THE SHAH, IT COULD BE AN ESSENTIALLY SATISFACTORY ONE, PARTICULARLY IF THE MILITARY PRESERVES BOTH ITS INTEGRITY AND ITS STATUS AS ONE OF THE "PILLAS" OF THE NATION. THERE WOULD PRESEUMABLY BE FEWER AMERICANS HERE AND THEY WOULD HAVE A REDUCED STATUS. BUT THEY COULD PROBABLY STAY IF THEY CHOSE.

ALL THIS RATHER POLLYANNISH SCENARIO COULD COME ABOUT ONLY IF EVERY STEP ALONG THE WAY TURNED OUT WELL. ANY SINGLE MISSTEP ANYWHERE COULD DESTROY IT AND LEAD TO UNPREDICTABLE CONSEQUENCES. THEREFORE, IT SHOULD NOT RPT NOT BE INTERPRETED AS THIS EMBASSY'S PREDICTION OF FUTURE EVENTS.

OUR CURRENT POSTURE OF TRUSTING THAT THE SHAH, TOGETHER WITH THE MILITARY, WILL BE ABLE TO FACE DOWN THE KHOMEINI THREAT IS OBVIOUSLY THE ONLY SAFE COURSE TO PURSUE AT THIS JUNCTURE. HOWEVER, IF IT SHOULD FAIL AND IF THE SHAH SHOULD ABDICATE, WE NEED TO THINK THE UNTHINKABLE AT THIS TIME IN ORDER TO GIVE OUR THOUGHTS SOME PRECISION SHOULD THE UNTHINKABLE CONTINGENCY ARISE. SULLIVAN NOTE BY OC/T: TEHRAN 11039/2. #PARA 9F AS RECEIVED.

WHEN I MET WITH PRIME MINISTER AZHARI EVENING NOV 9, I MENTIONED NEWSTICKER REPORT THAT SANJABI IS ON HIS WAY BACK TO TEHRAN FROM PARIS. HE SAID HE WAS AWARE OF THAT REPORT. HE FURTHER SAID, IF SANJABI WILL ACCEPT THE CONSTITUTION, I AM PREPARED OFFER HIM PORTFOLIO IN MY CABINET. .

HE THEN WENT ON TO STRESS THAT HE REGARDED HIMSELF PURELY AS A CARETAKER WITH A LIMITED MANDATE. AS SUCH, HE FELT HE HAD NO RPT NO OPPOSITION AND HE DID NOT CTEND TO ARREST ANY POLITICIANS ON GROUNDS THEY ARE OPPOSED TO HIM. IN FACT, HE SAID SEVERAL NATIONAL FRONT POLITICAL TYPES HAD TELEPHONED TO EXPRESS THEIR SYMPATHY WITH HIS TASK AND TO PRAISE THE SHAH'S SPEECH.

COMMENT: AZHARI'S STATEMENTS INDICATE THAT HE IS STILL ON TRACK WITH THE SHAH'S DESIRE TO FORM A NATIONAL GOVERNMENT AND HOLD ELECTIONS ONCE THE NATION IS RETURNED TO NORMAL FUNCTIONING. WE WILL HAVE TO OBSERVE HOW WELL THIS PATTERN HOLDS IF THE POLITICIANS BEGIN TO AGITATE IN FAVOR OF STRIKES AND AGAINST MILITARY GOVERNMENT.
TEHRAN WAS QUIET LAST NIGHT AND SO FAR THIS FRIDAY MORNING. ANTI-GOVT GRAFFITI DOWNTOWN HAVE ALMOST ENTIRELY BEEN PAINTED OVER BY PRO-GOI GRAFFITI. TEHRAN BUS SERVICE HAS (PARTIALLY) RESUMED.

THURSDAY SAW LARGE PRO-GOI DEMONSTRATION IN ZANJAN, ACCOMPANIED BY SOLDIERS, WHICH COMPLETED WITH ANTI-GOI DEMONSTRATION. LARGE ANTI-GOI DEMONSTRATIONS ALSO OCCURRED IN MASHAD AND AHWAZ ACCORDING TO JOURNALIST SOURCE. NO CLASHES OR CASUALTIES REPORTED.

EIGHTEEN TVRE ARRESTS OF PEOPLE ON CORRUPTION CHARGES WERE REPORTEDLY MADE YESTERDAY, THOUGH NAMES NOT YET AVAILABLE. UPI RESIDENT REP RIZVI (A PAKISTANI NATIONAL) WAS DEPORTED TODAY TO LONDON AS PUNISHMENT FOR FILING FALSE AND BASELESS REPORTS IN RECENT WEEKS . THIS DESPITE FACT UPI HAD APPARENTLY SENT MESSAGE TO MINISTRY OF INFORMATION ABSOLVING RIZVI OF ANY COMPLICITY IN FALSE ADVISORY OF SHAH'S ASSASSINATION THE NIGHT BEFORE.

JOURNALIST SOURCE TELLS US CBS CAMERA CREW ACCOMPANYING MIKE WALLACE IS CONVINCED IT SAW BURYING OF EIGHT CHILDREN AT TEHRAN'S CEMETERY WHO DIED OF GUNSHOT WOUNDS FROM EVENTS NOV 5, FOUR BURIED NOV 7, FOUR NOV 8. THIS IS COMPLETELY UNCONFIRMED FROM ANY OTHER SOURCE, AND WE WONDER HOW CAMERA CREW KNEW CHILDREN DIED OF BULLET WOUNDS.

CONTRARY TO OUR POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT YESTERDAY (NOV 4#, WESTERN EMBASSY, WHICH CHECKED WITH ITS NATIONALS RESIDING IN ZAHEDAN AT POL COUNSELOR'S REQUEST REPORTS THE CITY HAS BEEN ENTIRELY QUIET IN RECENT WEEKS. THIS SUPPORTS OUR UNDERSTANDING THAT BALUCHISTAN AREA HAS BEEN FREE OF ANY ANTI-GOI OR ANTI-SHAH DEMONSTRATIONS.

NATIONAL FRONT LEADER SANJABI RETURNED FROM PARIS YESTERDAY AND GAVE UNCOMPROMISING STATEMENT TO REPORTERS. HE SPOKE OF NEW NATIONAL ISLAMIC MOVEMENT OF IRAN IN ALLIANCE WITH AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI AND SAID HE WOULD NOT DISCUSS COALITION OR TRANSITION GOVT WITH SHAH OR WITH NEW GOI. AS CALLED PRESS CONFERENCE FOR 5 P.M. LOCAL TIME TOMORROW, NOV 11 (A LOCAL HOLIDAY). JOURNALIST SOURCE TELLS US RIVAL LEADER ALIEDAMINI, WHO IS AMONG SEVERAL WORKING BEHIND THE SCENES FOR A COALITION GOVT, WAS VERY UPSET BY SANJABI'S HARD LINE.

ANOTHER NATIONAL FRONT LEADER, DARIUSH FORUHAR, HAS REITERATED NEED FOR AN IMMEDIATE REFERENDUM TO DECIDE BETWEEN A MONARCHY OR A REPUBLICAN FORM OF GOVERNMENT, AND, IF A MONARCHY, AS TO WHO SHOULD BE THE MONARCH.

SITUATION QUIET TO MIDDAY. CALL FOR GENERAL STRIKE NOV. 12 BY AYATOLLA KHOMEINI AND NATIONAL FRONT LEADER KARIM SANJABI HAS BEEN WIDELY HEARD VIA BBC. EMB EXPECTS THIS APPEAL TO HAVE SIGNIFICANT IMPACT ON SHOPS AND BUSINESSES. THERE HAS, HOWEVER, BEEN NO CALL FOR RIOTS OR DEMONSTRATIONS TOMORROW.
ONLY REPORTED DISTURBANCE TODAY WAS GROUP WHO TRIED THIS MORNING TO CHANGE NAME OF SHAHYAD MONUMENT TO KHOMEINI MONUMENT. THEY WERE DISPERSED BY TROOPS.
ROYAL CEREMONIES IN OBSERVANCE OF EID-E-OORBAN ARE PROCEEDING ROUTINELY AT NIAVARAN PALACE.
NATIONAL FRONT LEADER SANJABI IS SCHEDULED TO HOLD PRESS CONFERENCE AT HIS HOME 1700 TODAY, AMID SPECULATION SECURITY FORCES MAY INTERVENE AND MAKE ARRESTS.

THERE WERE REPORTEDLY DEMONSTRATIONS IN MASHAD YESTERDAY AND SOME SHOOTINGS AND DEATHS. ALSO, RIOTING TOOK PLACE IN BESHAHR ON THE CASPIAN AND IN AMOL. THERE WAS CONSIDERABLE FIRING AND A FEW DEATHS. IT IS POSSIBLE THAT THERE WERE SIMILAR OCCURENCES IN OTHER CITIES BUT WE HAVE NO INFORMATION.

AS WE MOVE PEACEFULLY THROUGH THE CELEBRATION OF IDE-GHORBAN, THE FOCUS OF INTEREST IN IRAN IS ON THE CONFRONTATION WHICH WILL DEVELOPE NOV. 12 BETWEEN THE MILITARY GOVERNMENT AND THOSE WORKERS IN VARIOUS SECTIONS OF THE ECONOMY WHICH ARE ON STRIKE. NATIONAL FRONT LEADER SANJABI SAYS STRIKES WILL CONTINUE. BBC PERSIAN SERVICE GOES FURTHER AND SAYS AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI CALLS FOR A GENERAL STRIKE ON NOV 12.

THE MILITARY GOVERNMENT, IN EITHER EVENT, HAS CHOSEN TO HANDLE THE STRIKES IN A PHASED APPROACH. GENERAL AZHARI INFORMED THE AMBASSADOR THAT THE OIL INDUSTRY HAS FIRST PRIORITY AND HIS GOAL IS TO RETURN TO FULL PRODUCTION AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. HE WILL THEN APPROACH KEY SECTORS SUCH AS TRANSPORTATION AND COMMUNICATIONS. HE BELIEVES THE BUREAUCRACY WILL RETURN TO WORK BECAUSE THEIR ABSENCE HAS BEEN DUE TO INTIMIDATION MORE THAN DISAFFECTION.

THE CONFRONTATION WITH SCHOOL TEACHERS HAS BEEN DELAYED UNTIL NOV .18. ONE SENIOR MILITARY OFFICER HAS SAID THIS IS BECAUSE THEY BELIEVE THE TEACHERS WILL RETURN TO WORK QUIETLY IF THEY SEE OTHERS GOING. ON THE OTHER HAND, IF THEY WERE CONFRONTED AT THE OUTSET, THEY WOULD NOT RPT NOT HESITATE TO USE CHILDREN AS SHIELDS AND CAUSE A MOST UNPLEASANT PROBLEM.

THIS TEST OF WILLS IS ALSO GOING TO BE A TEST OF STRENGTH. ONE OF THE GREAT PROBLEMS IN EVALUATING THE CURRENT CRISIS IS THAT NO ONE HAS A CLEAR ESTIMATE OF THE RELATIVE STRENGTH OF THE FORCES IN CONTENTION. THE STRIKERS COULD, OF COURSE, BE EXPECTED TO BE SUPPORTED BY STREET MOBS, USING HIT AND RUN TACTICS. THESE, HOWEVER, WOULD HAVE TO BE CONDUCTED IN THE FACE OF A DEMONSTRATED MILITARY DETERMINATION TO SHOOT FOR EFFECT IN ORDER TO BREAK UP CROWDS.
BECAUSE THE NATIONAL FRONT BELIEVES KHOMEINI MAY INDEED CONTROL THE ENORMOUS NUMBERS HE CLAIMS, THEY FEAR TO BREAK WITH HIM EVEN TO ACCEPT THE SORT OF GOVERNMENT AUTHORITY FOR WHICH THEY YEARN.

IF THE MILITARY, THEREFORE, SUCCEED IN BREAKING THE STRIKES, THIS MAY INDICATE TO MANY FENCE-SITTERS TAHT THEY HAVE NOT ONLY GREATER FORCE, BUT ALSO GREATER POPULAR SUPPORT THAN KHOMEINI. THIS OBSERVATION COULD CAUSE A MOVE ON THE PART OF THE SILENT MAJORITY AWAY FROM THE EXTREME POSITIONS ESPOUSED BY KHOMEINI AND A GRADUAL ACCRETION OF POWER TO THE MILITARY, AND, BY INDIRECTION, TO THE SHAH.

IN THIS CASE, KHOMEINI WOULD BE FACED WITH THE CHOICE TO CALL FOR ARMED REBELLION OR TO MODIFY HIS EXTREME DEMANDS. MERCIFULLY, THERE APPEAR TO BE RELATIVELY FEW LETHAL WEAPONS AFLOAT IN THIS COUNTRY AND, FOR THAT REASON ALONE, KHOMEINI MIGHT BACK AWAY FROM SUCH A CALL. (GOI SECURITY FORCES ARE CONCERNED THAT MOVES ARE AFOOT TO FILL THIS ARMS VACUUM.) HOWEVER, KHOMEINI IS AN UNPREDICTABLE MAN WITH AN APPARENTLY IMPLACABLE HATRED FOR THE SHAH.

IF KHOMEINI RESILES FROM HIS EXTREME POSTIONS, THE NATIONAL FRONT AND OTHER POLITICIANS NECESSARY TO FORM A COALITION GOVERNMENT WOULD PROBABLY BEGIN TO NEGOTIATE WITH THE SHAH TO THAT END. HOWEVER, MOST OF THEM DISTRUST HIS INTENTIONS AND DO NOT RPT NOT BELIEVE SUCH NEGOTIATIONS WOULD LEAD TO GENUINLY FREE ELECTIONS. (EMBASSY'S VIEW IS THAT SHAH HAS REACHED STAGE AT WHICH HE WILL ACCEPT FREE ELECTIONS.) THEREFORE, THIS SCENARIO COULD GET IRAN THROUGH AND OVER ITS CURRENT CRISIS.

ON THE OTHER HAND, IF MILITARY GOVERNMENT FAILS TO BREAK THE STRIKES AND/OR IF KHOMEINI CALLS FOR ARMED REBELLION, THE CRISIS WOULD DEEPEN. AT THAT STAGE, THE SHAH AND THE MILITARY WILL HAVE TO DECIDE HOW BRUTAL THEY ARE PREPARED TO BE IN THEIR EFFORT TO PRESERVE THE MONARCHY.

1978TEHRAN11060.subject: POLITICAL SECURITY SITUATION: NATIONAL FRONT LEADERS ARRESTED

segments.text: SHORTLY BEFORE SCHEDULED PRESS CONFERENCE NATIONAL FRONT LEADERS SANJABI AND FOROULAR WERE ARRESTED PERSONNALY BY GENERAL OVEISI. NATIONAL FRONTER BAKHTIAR AND LEADING BAZAARIS WHO WERE PRESENT, WERE NOT ARRESTED. ACCORDING TO LOCAL NEWSMAN, BAKHTIAR TOLD THOSE PRESSMEN WHO WERE ASSEMBLED THAT PURPOSE OF MEETING WAS TO ANNOUNCE ALLIANCE WITH KHOMEINI AND DEMAND FOR REFERENDUM WHETHER IRAN WILL BE A MONARCH OR REPUBLIC. WE EXPECT BBC TO CARRY ALL OF THIS SHORTLY.
MRS. SANJABI TOLD PRESS PURPOSE OF MEETING WAS TO CALL FOR GENERAL STRIKE ON SUNDAY, NOVEMBER 12.
LMI MEMBERS , WHO MET WITH POL OFFICER THIS EVENING, TOOK HARD LINE, DEMANDING THAT SHAH ABDICATE AND THAT AN ADVIRORY (REGENCY) COUNCIL BE ESTABLISHED.
MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES HAVE ISSUED PUBLIC DIRECTIVE THAT MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS WILL BE STRICTLY ENFORCED NOVEMBER 12. SECURITY AUTHORITIES EARLIER IN DAY MADE SIMILAR STATEMENTS TO US.
COMMENT: OPPOSITION AND GOVERNMENT AS OF MOMENT APPEAR HEADED FOR CONFRONTATION TOMORROW OR NEAR FUTURE.

1978TEHRAN11066.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT NOV.12 SUMMARY: SITUATION IN TEHRAN TIGHTENING UP MORNING CONFIDENTIAL

segments.text: SUMMARY: SITUATION IN TEHRAN TIGHTENING UP MORNING NOV. 12. CONFRONTATIONS APPEAR BUILDWNG BETWEEN STUDENTS AND MILITARY AND RELIGIOUS GROUPS AND GOVT. MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATION HAS ANNOUNCED PRAYER MEETINGS WILL BE ALLOWED, BUT THESE MAY FEATURE EITHER TAPE OF KHOMEINI DIATRIBE FROM PARIS OR SERMONS USING PROVOCATIVE THEMES. IRAN AIR OPERATING SEVERAL FLIGHTS, OIL WORKERS STILL ON STRIKE. SEVERAL INCIDENTS IN PROVINCES NOV. 11, BUT TEHRAN WAS RELATIVELY QUIET. FOUR NEW MINISTERS NAMED. NATIONAL FRONT APPEARS IN PROCESS OF LINKING COMPLETELY WITH KHOMEINI. STRIKE EFFECTIVENESS SPORADIC. END SUMMARY.

WHILE MUCH OF TEHRAN RETURNED TO NORMAL WORK MORNING NOV . 12, PROJECTED CONFRONTATION BETWEEN STUDENTS AND MILITARY AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY APPEARS LIKELY. SOURCES HAVE SEEN STUDENTS HEADING FOR TEHRAN UNIV. WITH AVOWED PURPOSE OF PROVOKING CLASH. SOURCES ALSO SUGGEST THAT NOON PRAYER MEETINGS IN MOSQUES MAY BE HIGHLY AGITATIONAL. AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI IS REPORTED TO HAVE CALLED TEHRAN AND TAPED VERY INFLAMMATORY ANTI-FOREIGN REMARKS. ONE STORY SAYS THESE TAPES WILL BE USED; OTHER SOURCES SUGGEST SERMONS WILL PROBABLY BE BASED ON KHOMEINI REMARKS WHETHER TAPE ITSELF IS ACTUALLY PLAYED.

MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATION AT 10 AM, NOV. 12, ANNOUNCED THAT PRAYER MEETINGS WILL BE ALLOWED AND CALLED UPON CLERGY TO KEEP PEOPLE CALM. IT HAS ALSO BEEN ANNOUNCED THAT ALL SCHOOLS WOULD BE CLOSED UNTIL NOV. 18, WHEN PRIMARY SCHOOLS WOULD OPEN. SECONDARY SCHOOLS AND UNIVERSITIES OPENINGS WILL BE ANNOUNCED LATER.

IRAN AIR IS OPERATING BOTH DOMESTIC AND FOREIGN FLIGHTS TODAY (SEPTEL NOTAL WILL PROVIDE DETAILS) AND TEHRAN AIRPORT APPEARS OPERATING NORMALLY. OIL WORKERS REMAIN ON STRIKE (DETAILS SEPTEL NOTAL). THERE HAVE BEEN INCIDENTS OF VIOLENCE IN PAST 24 HOURS AT AHWAZ, BANDAR SHAPUR, AND BUSHEHR, AND OIL WORKERS DO NOT RPT NOT APPEAR TO BE RETURNING TO WORK.

MORRISION KNUDSEN REPORTS ITS CAMP AT SHUSHTAR, 100 KM NORTH OF AHWAZ, WAS ATTACKED BY LOCAL GROUP NOV. 10. ATTACK WAS BEATEN OFF, BUT POLICE AND GENDARMES RETURNED NOV. 11 TO SAY THEY WOULD BE UNABLE TO PROTECT CAMP. ENTIRE 60-PERSON CONTINGENT WAS MOVED TO AHWAZ NOV. 11 AND WILL COME TO TEHRAN NOV. 12.

SHIRAZ WAS QUIET NOV. 11, BUT IN ISFAHAN, DEMONSTRATORS TRIED TO ATTACK MOVIE HOUSE. TROOPS FIRED; AT LEAST ONE DEMONSTRATOR WAS REPORTED KILLED. FRAGMENTARY REPORTS AND BRIEF NEWS STORIES INDICATE THERE WAS VIOLENCE IN BESHAHR, KHORRAMSHAHR, ZANJAN, (WHERE CENTER OF CITY WAS BURNED) AND AMOL. DETAILS NOT RPT NOT KNOWN. TABRIZ HAS BEEN QUIET PAST TWO DAYS, THOUGH BAZAAR IS LOCKED AND GUARDED BY TROOPS AND CITY IS TENSE.

ALMOST LOST IN HASSLE OF PAST 24 HOURS WAS GOI ANNOUNCEMENT OF FOUR NEW MINISTERS: HASSAN ALI MEHRAN BECOMES MINISTER OF ECONOMIC AFFAIRS AND FINANCE; AMIR PARVIZ REMAINS AGRICULTURE MINISTER; MORTEZA SALEHI, WHO HAD MOVED FROM PLAN ORGANIZATION (PBO) TO BE AMOUZEGAR'S MINISTER OF ROADS RETURNS TO PBO AS CHIEF AND MINISTER OF STATE; AND GENERAL KATOUZIAN (FNU) WILL BE LABOR MINISTER.

SOURCE SAID GOI WAS SEEKING CIVILIAN FOR LABOR MINISTRY, BUT WHEN MAJOR CANDIDATES DECLINED UPON LEARNING THAT GOI WANTED NEW MINISTER TO MOBILIZE LABOR IN SUPPORT OF GOVT, THEN PRIME MINISTER DECIDED ON MILITARY MAN. ------------------113924 121213Z /23 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1542 INFO USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY ABU DHABU AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC AMEMBASSY BONN AMCONSUL DHAHRAN SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 11066

ONE REASON ADVANCED BY NATIONAL FRONT SUPPORTERS FOR ARREST OF SANJABI AND FOROUHAR (REPORTED TEHRAN 11060) IS THAT SANJABI WAS GOING TO ANNOUNCE GENERAL STRIKE FOR NOV. 12 AS WELL AS COMPLETE NATIONAL FRONT LINKUP WITH KHOMEINI. LIBERATION MOVEMENT OF IRAN (LMI) LEADERS BAZARGAN AND SAHABI CONFIRMED TO EMBOFF EVENING NOV 11 AFTER ARREST THAT LMI WAS STICKING WITH KHOMEINI ALL THE WAY AND THAT BLOODSHED WOULD BE SHAH'S FAULT FOR STAYING ON THRONE. LMI SAID IT SEES ONLY THREE OPTIONS FOR COUNTRY: (A) CONTINUATION OF PRESENT DISORDERS; (B) MILITARY TO IMPOSE ARTIFICIAL ORDER; OR (C) NATIONAL GOVERNMENT WITHOUT SHAH.

EMBOFF REPLIED NONE OF THESE SEEM SATISFACTORY TO U.S., WHICH STILL BELIEVES COALITION GOVERNMENT UNDER SHAH WOULD BE BEST FOR ALL. LMI SAID IT DOUBTED THAT EVEN ITS LEADERS WOULD HAVE SUPPORT OF PEOPLE IF THEY ENTERED COALITON GOVERNMENT AND INDICATED THEY DEFERRED COMPLETELY TO KHOMEINI. EMBASSY COMMENT: IT APPEARS THAT BOTH NATIONRONT AND LMI ARE IN PROCESS OF ASSOCIATING THEMSELVES SO COMPLETELY WITH KHOMEINI THAT THEY HAVE SUSPENDED INDEPENDENT JUDGEMENT ON CURRENT POLITICAL EVENTS FOR THE MOVEMENT. QUICK IMPROMPTU EMBASSY SURVEY OF STRIKE SITUATION SHOWS FOLLOWSING: HEALTH MINISTRY AND CUSTOMS OFFICE ARE NOT WORKID, BUT OTHER GOVERNMENT OFFICES SEEM TO BE OPEN FOR BUSINESS. TELECOMMUNICATIONS CORP.

OF IRAN (TCI) HAS ABOUT 50-60 PERCENT OF WORKERS ON JOB. POWER OUTAGES WHICH AFFECTED NORTHEASTERN QUADRANT OF CITY FOR MOST OF MORNING WERE RESULT OF STRIKE ACTION, BUT CORRECTIVE MEASURES ARE BEING TAKEN, POWER IS BEING RESTORED AND MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATION EXPECTS TO HAVE POWER BACK BY 1400 LOCAL TIME.
AS OF 1200 LOCAL TIME, THERE WAS A LARGE, PEACEFUL DEMONSTRATION IN ISFAHAN NEAR TEHRAN TRAFFIC CIRCLE IN NORTHERN AREA OF CITY.

CONFRONTATION DEVELOPMENTS REPORTED REFTEL HAVE NOT RESULTED IN MAJOR DEMONSTRATIONS IN TEHRAN. THE CITY APPEARS TO HAVE HAD ITS MOST NORMAL DAY OF BUSINESS SINCE THE 5 NOV. 1978 RIOTING. MANY BUSINESSES, APPROXIMATELY 20 TO 30 PERCENT, APPEAR TO HAVE BEEN CLOSED, BUT WE DO NOT KNOW IF SUCH CLOSURES WERE STRIKE RELATED OR FROM OTHER CAUSES. IN ANY CASE, THERE WAS LITTLE EVIDENCE OF AN EFFECTIVE GENERAL STRIKE.

MOST OBVIOUS INDICATION OF STRIKE ACTIVITY WAS JOBACTION/STRIKE AT TAVANIR POWER TRANSMISSION FACILITIES WHICH RESULTED IN POWER BLACKOUTS IN SOME AREAS TEHRAN DURING LATE MORNING AND EARLY AFTERNOON. POWER SITUATION APPEARS TO HAVE NOW RETURNED TO NORMAL.
WE HAVE NO INDICATIONS OF RESPONSE TO KHOMEINI TAPED MESSAGE OR ATTENDANT PRAYER MEETINGS, AT LEAST IN TEHRAN. RELIGIOUS OPPOSITION APPEARS QUIET.
WE HAVE NO FURTHER INFORMATION FROM CONSULATES DUE TO INABILITY TO MAKE LONG DISTANCE TELEPHONE CONNECTIONS. WILL ATTEMPT TO CALL EARLY 13 NOV. 1978.
STRIKE SITUATION REMAINS UNCHANGED WITH OIL FIELD SCENE DETAILS REPORTED SEPTEL.

1978TEHRAN11097.subject: OPPOSITION PROPOSALS FOR THE SHAH'S FUTURE

segments.text: SUMMARY: IN SECOND MEETING WITH MINATCHI AND OTHER OPPOSITION LEADERS, "THINKING ALOUD" ON PRESENT POLITICAL SITUATION PRODUCED SOME "GIVE" IN OPPOSITION POSITION AND TWO OTHER POSSIBLE SCENARIOS FOR SHAH'S FUTURE IN ADDITION TO THAT GIVEN REFTEL. END SUMMARY.

EMOBFFS LAMBRAKIS AND STEMPEL PLUS HAS DEP ASST. SECY COHEN AND INR'S GRIFFIN MET WITH DR. NASSER MINATCHI AND EXECUTIVE BOARD OF COMMITTEE FOR THE DEFENSE OF HUMAN RIGHTS AND FREEDOM, WHICH INCLUDED LIBERATION MOVEMENTS KLMI) ENG. MEHDI BAZARGAN, PROMINENT WRITER ALI ASGHAR HAJ SEYED JAVADI, AND RADICAL MOVEMENT LEADER RAHMATOLLAH MOGHADAM. AFTER REVIEW OF COMMITTEE'S HUMAN RIGHTS WORK (WHICH WILL BE REPORTED SEPARATELY), GROUP SAID HUMAN RIGHTS COULD NOT BE CONSIDERED APART FROM "NOEW POLITICAL FRAMEWORK" EMERGING IN IRAN. "THERE ARE NO HUMAN RIGHTS UNDER MILITARY GOVERNMENT," MODHADAM SAID.

GROUP THEN TURNED TO DISCUSSION OF PRESENT POLITICAL SITUATION AND OPPOSITION PROPOSAL THAT SHAH ABDICATE. LAMBRAKIS RAISED GENERAL QUESTION: IS IT TOO LATE TO TALK AT ALL? PRESENT SITUATION APPEARS TO GIVE SHAH TWO CHOICES IF OPPOSITION MAINTAINS ITS PRESENT VIEW-EITHER MILITARY GOVERNMENT OR ABDICATION. UNLESS OPPOSITION WILLING AT LEAST TO DISCUSS MATTER, EVENTS WOULD SEEM TO POINT TO A TEST OF STRENGTH, WHICH COULD LEAD TO UNFORTUNATE RESULTS FOR ALL, REGARDLESS OF WHO WINS. MOGHADAM SAID THAT DESPITE SHAH'S SPEECH , GOI WAS NOT TALKING TO OPPOSITION GROUPS AND POLLED MEN AROUND TABLE WHO AGREED.

IN ENSURING DISCUSSION, PRESSED BY ANOTHER QUESTION FROM GRIFFIN, IT BECAME EVIDENT THAT IRANIANS PRESENT WERE WILLING TO TOSS ALL QUESTIONS AROUND. BAZARGAN AND HAJ SEYED JAVADI WERE MORE HAD LINE IN PERSIAN DISCUSSIONS AMONG THEMSELVES THAN MINATCHI AND MOGHADAM. GROUP HINTED AT POSSIBILITY OF INTERMEDIARY TO RAISE ISSUES WITH SHAH. IN ENGLISH PRESENTATION TO ENTIRE GROUP, MINATCHI SUGGESTED SECOND ALTERNATIVE TO THAT ADVANCED REFTEL: SHAH WOULD APPOINT REGENCY COUNCIL AND TURN OVER ALL WORK TO IT BUT REMAIN IN COUNTRY AS CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCH IN CONSULTATIVE CAPACIY AND IN CHARGE OF THEARMY FOR TWO YEARS UNTIL FREELY ELECTED PARLIAMENT AND GOVERNMENT WOULD RULE WHILE REGENT REIGNED.
CROWN PRINCE IS 20, THEN RETIRE IN HIS FAVOR. HAJ SEYED JAVADI PRESENTED THIRD ALTERNATIVE WHICH CONTAINED FOLLOWING POINTS

A "CRIDIBLE" GOVERNMENT WOULD BE FORMED; B) SHAH WOULD AGREE TO TAKE HIMSELF OUT OF POLITICS; C) A FREE ELECTION WOULD BE HELD WHICH WOULD LEAD TO D) FORMATION OF NEW GOVERNMENT, FOLLOWED BY RESIGNATION OF SHAH IN FAVOR OF HIS SON, AND E) CONVENING OF A CONSTITUTIONAL CONVENTION WHICH WOULD DECIDE ON FUTURE OF MONARCHY. THIS ALTERNATIVE WAS NOT DISCUSSED BEYOND INITIAL PRESENTATION.

MINATCHI SAID OPPOSITION LEADERS STOOD READY TO GO BACK TO KHOMEINI AND EVEN HAD AGREEMENT OF THREE MAJOR RELIGIOUS LEADERS IN QOM (SHARIAT-MADARI, MARASHI, AND GOLPAYEGAN) ALSO TO GO TO PARIS IF SHAH AGREED TO FIRST REFTEL PROPOSAL. MINATCHI ADDED THAT IF AGREEMENT COULD BE WORKED OUT ON BASIS OF ALTERNATIVE HE HAD JUST MENTIONED, THIS WOULD REQUIRE MORE DIFFICULT SELLING JOB ON KHOMEINI, BUT THEY WOULD TRY. MINATCHI AGAIN PRESSED US TO DISCUSS OPPOSITION PROPOSALS WITH SHAH. IN REPLY TO QUESTION WHY OPPOSITION DID NOT DO SO ITSELF, MINATCHI SAID FINDING CHANNEL WAS DIFFICULT; U.S.
AND BRITISH SUPPORT MIGHT MAKE DIFFERENCE; AND OPPOSITION WAS FRANKLY AFRAID OF SHAH'S REACTION IF THEY PUT TO HIM THE SUGGESTION HE ABDICATE. DIRECTLY, WITHOUT PREPARATION.

IN RESPONSE TO QUESTION WHETHER OPPOSITIONISTS HAD CONSIDERED MILITARY REACTION TO THEIR PROPOSALS, GROUP BRUSHED ASIDE MILITARY PROBLEM BY SUGGESTING THAT SHAH'S AGREEMENT PLUS MILITARY REPRESENTATION ON REGENCY COUNCIL WOULD SOLVE THAT PROBLEM. MINATCHI WAS ASKED HOW HE WAS SO CERTAIN KHOOEINI COULD BE PERSUADED TO CHANGE HIS STAND. MINATCHI REPLIED KHOMEINI WOULD NOT CHANGE HIS POSITION, BUT WOULD SIMPLY AGREE NOT TO OPPOSE WORK OF OTHERS IN IRAN.

REPLYING TO FOLLOW-ON QUESTION WOHETHER OPPOSITION COULD DELIVER ON ITS PROMISE TO BRING PEACE BACK TO COUNTRY, MINATCHI SAID HE WAS CONFIDENT RELIGIOUS LEADERS COULD DO IT, BUT IN NEXT BREATH SAID THERE WERE UNDOUBTEDLY OTHER ELEMENTS INVOLVED IN LOCAL DISTURBANCES WHICH MIGHT NOT RESPOND FULLY. IN FACT, THESE ELEMENTS ARE LIKELY TO GET INCREASINGLY OUT OF CONTROL AS LONG AS CURRENT CRISIS REMAINS UNRESOLVED. GROUP NOTED THAT "THE PEOPLE" WANTED REVOLUTIONARY CHANGE.

EVEN IF MODERATE LEADERS AGREED TO SOMETHING LESS, THEY WOULD PROBABLY BE UNABLE TO SELL IT TO THE PEOPLE---AND THUS IT WOULD NOT STICK. ------------------117568 131640Z /42 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 1558 SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 11097 EXDIS

COMMENT: FRANKLY, GROUP SURPRISED US BY BEING PREPARED TO "BRAINSTORM" IN OUR PRESENCE AND COME UP WITH ALTERNATIVES THAT MIGHT BE MORE PALATABLE TO THE SHAH. AS MODERATES, THEY WOULD CLEARLY LIKE A CONSTITUTIONAL SOLUTION. THEY HAVE ITERATED THEIR AGREEMENT THAT U.S. AND WEST HAVE AN IMPORTANT STRATEGIC INTEREST IN STABILITY AND PRO-WEST ORIENTATION OF IRAN. THEY CLEARLY HOPE THAT U.S. AND UK WILL PERCEIVE THE DANGEROUS DRIFT OF THE PRESENT SITUATION AND DECIDE TO ASSIST IN A NEGOTIATED SOLUTION.

THEY NOTE SHAH HAS ON OCCASION TAKEN THE POSITION THAT HE WOULD LEAVE IF IT WERE NOT FOR THE UNCERTAINTIES OF WHAT WOULD HAPPEN TO THE GOVERNMENT WHEN HE DID, AND SUGGEST THEIR PROPOSAL SAFEGUARDS CONSTITUTIONAL PROCESSES AND THUS THE GOVERNMENT.

AS INDICATED REFTEL WE SERIOUSLY DOUBT SHAH WOULD CONSIDER ABDICATION PROPOSAL. THE SAME IT TRUE OF PROPOSAL HE REMAIN IN CONSULTATIVE, BEHIND-THE-SCENES ROLE ONLY. A GREAT DEAL DEPENDS ON SUCCESS OR FAILURE OF HIS MILITARY GOVERNMENT. OBVIOUSLY, A FAILURE WOULD BRING SHAH FACE TO FACE WITH A GRIM REALITY, AND RESUMABLY MAKE HIM MITIGATE HIS STAND. A SUCCESS, ON THE OTHER HAND, HOULD IN TIME WORK TO MODERATE OPPOSITION DEMANDS--THOUGH IT MIGHT DRIVE SOME OPPOSITIONISTS TO EVEN MORE EXTREMIST DESPERATION. MEANWHILE, IT IS CLEAR THE OPPOSITION MODERATES WISH TO KEEP DISCUSSION CHANNELS OPEN.

1978TEHRAN11099.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT, NOV 13 SUMMARY:TEHRAN QUIET TO MIDDAY. REPORTS OF DEATHS YESTERDAY CONFIDENTIAL

segments.text: SUMMARY:TEHRAN QUIET TO MIDDAY. REPORTS OF DEATHS YESTERDAY IN TABRIZ AND KHORRAMSHAHR. SEVERAL NEW GOV-GENS, HEAD OF PAHLAVI FOUNDATION APPOINTED. SPECIAL JUSTICE COMMISSION TO EXAMINE FINANCIAL DEALINGS OF ROYAL FAMILY. FORMER MAYOR OF TEHRAN ARRESTED. GOVT HAS SACKED OFFICIALS IN JAHROM. TCI LABOR DISPUTE AFFECTS AMERICANS. END SUMMARY.

TEHRAN REMAINED PEACEFUL YESTERDAY AND THIS MORNING. THREATENED VIOLENT CONFRONTATION BETWEEN STUDENTS AND TROOPS DID NOT DEVELOP YESTERDAY. WE DO NOT BELIVE, HOWEVER, THAT HIS CONSTITUTED ULTIMATE TEST OF WILL BETWEEN TROOPS AND PROTESTORS; POSSIBILITY OF STREET VIOLENCE THEREFORE REMAINS.

TROOPS CLASHED WITH PROTESTORS IN TABRIZ AND KHORRAMSHAHR YESTERDAY, REPORTEDLY LEAVING FIVE DEAD IN EACH CITY. UNABLE TO CONTACT CONSULATES TODAY DUE TO TELEPHONE SERVICE MALFUNCTION. EMBASSY HAS NO REPORTS OF VIOLENCE AS OF MIDDAY.
GOVT ANNOUNCED LEADING OFFICIALS OF LOCAL GOVT IN JAHROM HAVE BEEN DISMISSED. MOVE APPARENTLY RESULTS FROM RECENT SNIPER ATTACK ON JAHROM POLICE CHIEF AND MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR.

SHAH HAS INSTRUCTED JUTICE MIN NAJAFI TO APPOINT A SPECIAL COMMISSION TO INVESTIGATE EXPENDITURES BY MEMBERS OF ROYAL FAMILY. ALSO ON ANTI-CORRUPTION FRONT, AUTHORITIES HAVE ARRESTED SENATOR GHOLAMREZA NIKPAY, FORMER MAYOR OF TEHRAN, WHO IS WIDELY ACCUSED OF CORRUPT ACTIVITIES.

GOVT ANNOUNCED SEVERAL NEW APPOINTMENTS, INCLUDING EIGHT NEW GOVERNORS-GENERAL AND NEW HEAD OF PAHLAVI FOUNDATION. THE GOV-GENS ARE: GEN SADEGH AMIR AZIZI, KHORASAN; GEN (AND SENATOR) KARIM VARAHRAM, WEST AZERBAIJAN; GEN (AND SENATOR) AZIZOLLAH PALIZBAN, KERMANSHAHAN; ABDOL-AL DAHESTANI, CENTRAL PROVINCE; HAMID ZAHEDI, TEHRAN PROVINCE: GEN MAGHSOUD HAMPAI, BOYER AHMAD AND KOHGILUYEH; REAR ADM NASROLLAH MOVAGHARI, BUSHEHR, AND MOHAMMAD TABATABAI, GILAN. SEYED AHMAD EMAMI HAS BEEN APPOINTED HEAD OF THE PAHLAVI FOUNDATION. EMBASSY WILL FURNISH BIOGRAPHIC DATA LATER.

STRIKE SITUATION GENERALLY UNCHANGED. IRAN AIR CONTINUES TO RESTORE SERVICE TO NEAR NORMAL. CUSTOMS OFFICIALS ARE STILL ON STRIKE. SITUATION AT OTHER GOVT BUREAUS IS UNCHANGED. LABOR DISPUTE WITH POLITICAL OVERTONES AT TELECOMMUNICATIONS CORP OF IRAN (TCI) RESULTED TODAY IN EXPULSION OF AMERICAN EMPLOYEES OF AMERICAN BELL INTERNATIONAL FROM TCI OFFICES. CROWD OF STRIKERS FORCED THEM OUT OF ONE TCI BUILDING, AFTER WHICH ABI EVACUATED ALL ITS AMERICANS FROM TCI COMPLEX. THEY WILL NOT RETURN TO THESE OFFICES UNTIL SITUATION CLARIFIES. (COMMENT: LABOR DISPUTE AT TCI IS ONE OF MANY FEATUREING RESENTMENT OF FOREIGN EMPLOYEES).
FILE; TELEGRAM TEXT FOR THIS MRN IS UNAVAILABLE

ON NOV 14 POL COUNSELOR CHECKED WITH MFA DIRGEN SANANDAJI AS TO STATUS OF REPRESENTATION MADE ON THIS SUBJECT OCT 30. SANANDAJI SAID GOI BELIEVES THERE IS NO USE IN DOING ANYTHING ABOUT ISRAELI DECISION. IF USG COULD NOT MOVE ISRAELIS, HOW COULD IRAN? ISRAELIS ARE BEHAVING AS THE "UNCHECKED MASTERS OF THEIR REGION" ANYWAY.

POL COUNSELOR EXPLAINED WE HAD HOPED IRAN COULD JOIN A NUMBER OF OTHER COUNTRIES WHO WOULD ALL COMPLAIN TO ISRAEL ON THIS MOVE, THUS PERHAPS HAVING SOME CUMULATIVE EFFECT. SANANDAJI AGAIN DECLINED. HE SAID GOI IS SO BUSY ON ITS OWN AFFARIS THIESE DAYS IT IS IN NO POSITION TO EXERT INFLUENCE ON ANYONE ELSE.

COMMENT: SANANDAJI IS NOT EXAGGERRATING THE DEGREE OF PARALYSIS THAT AFFECTS THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS THESE DAYS. WE DO NOT BELIEVE WE CAN PROD ANY GOI ACTIVITY ON THIS SUBJECT IN THE ABSENCE OF SOME COMPELLING NEW ARGUMENT.

IT IS UNCLEAR TO US FR OM REFTELS IF USE OF "VILLAINS" INSTEAD OF "VIOLENCE" WAS TYPOGRAPHICAL ERROR IN PREPARATION OF STATE 288575 OR ORIGINAL ERROR IN TRANSCRIPT WHICH WIRE SERVICE AND OTHERS, INCLUDING BBC, DREW UPON.
IF LATTER IS THE CASE, WE WOULD APPRECIATE EMBASSY LONDON ENSURING THAT BBC HAS CORRECT TEXT.

IT HAS COME TO OUR ATTENTION THROUGH CONSULTATIONS WITH THE LOCAL AMERICAN BUSINESS COMMUNITY THAT THE TRAVEL ADVISORY CONTAINED IN REFTEL WAS APPARENTLY NOT REPEATED BY THE DEPARTMENT TO THE OTHER POSTS. AS A RESULT, COMPANY OFFICIALS WHO WENT TO OTHER POSTS AROUND THE WORLD REQUESTING INFORMATION ON TRAVEL TO IRAN COULD NOT BE GIVEN ADVICE.
EMBASSY URGENTLY REQUESTS THE DEPARTMENT TO REPEAT THE TEXT OF REFTEL TO ALL POSTS THROUGHOUT THE WORLD.

WE ARE QUITE SURE NOBODY RPT NOBODY IN GOVT, SHAH'S ENTOURAGE, OR THE ESTABLISHMENT HAS GIVEN ANY THOUGHT TO, MUCH LESS MADE PREPARATIONS FOR, MECHANICS OF NEXT ELECTIONS. VOTER REGISTRATION AND LISTS WOULD HAVE TO BE PREPARED AS PAST ELECTION LISTS WOULD BE OUT OF DATE. POLL WATCHERS AND OTHERS WOULD HAVE TO BE ORGANIZED, ETC. ALL THAT WOULD TAKE A MATTER OF 6-10 WEEKS ACCORDING TO EMBASSY'S BEST INFORMATION.

MORE TO THE POINT IS COMPLETE LACK OF READINESS ON ANYONE'S PART FOR ANY ELECTION. PARTIES HARDLY EXIST, THERE HAS BEEN NO THOUGHT GIVEN TO CAMPAIGNING, AND AT LEAST ONE FORMIDABLE OBSTACLE EXISTS IN THE PERSON OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, WHO HAS CALLED FOR DEPARTURE OF THE SHAH BEFORE ANY THING ELSE IS DONE. OPPOSITION POLITICIANS THEMSELVES HAVE TOLD US BLUNTLY THEY WANT AND NEED 6 MONTHS TO GET ORGANIZED; PRO-GOVT ORGANISMS WANT AT LEAST THAT LONE.

COUNTRY HAS A MILITARY GOVT AND MAJOR CITIES ARE UNDER MARTIAL LAW. IF MARTIAL LAW WERE LIFTED BETWEEN NOW AND MOHARAM, WIDESPREAD RIOTING IS PREDICTABLE. THESE FACTORS TOO ARE SERIOUS IMPEDIMENTS TO ANY ELECTORAL PROCESS, NOT TO MENTION PRE-ELECTORAL CAMPAIGNS.

1978TEHRAN11210.subject: POLITICAL /SECURITY REPORT, NOV 15 SUMMARY: TROOPS FIRED ON CROWD IN SOUTH TEHRAN YESTERDAY. CONFIDENTIAL

segments.text: SUMMARY: TROOPS FIRED ON CROWD IN SOUTH TEHRAN YESTERDAY. RUMORS OF PROTESTERS OBTAINING ARMS. PARLIAMENT TO MEET NOV 18; PRIMIN GEN AZHARI WILL INTRODUCE PROGRAM AND MINISTERS. NEWSPAPERS MAY REAPPEAR NOV 20. PRO GOVT DEMONSTRATIONS. VIOLENCE IN ISFAHAN YESTERDAY. ARRESTS IN OILFIELDS. UNOCCUPIED BUS BOMBED. END SUMMARY.

AMID MANY INDEPENDENT REPORTS OF SHOOTING IN SOUTH TEHRAN YESTERDAY, GOVT ANNOUNCED TROOPS DID FIRE INTO CROWD. THERE ARE UNCONFIRMED REPORTS OF MANY CASUALTIES. SITUATION QUIET AT MIDDAY TODAY. CONSULATE ISFAHAN REPORTS VIOLENCE LAST EVENING AS CROWDS EXITING THREE MOSQUES JOINED IN ATTACKING BANKS. SECURITY FORCES WERE CAUGHT OFF GUARD, AND MOB SUCCEEDED IN BURNING THREE BUILDINGS. TROOPS RESTORED ORDER AFTER SOME FIRING; TROOPS ARE REINFORCED ON CITY STREETS TODAY.

EMBASSY HAS SEVERAL UNCONFIRMED REPORTS THAT OPPOSITIONISTS HAVE OBTAINED WEAPONS, POSSIBLE INCLUDING AUTOMATIC WEAPONS. THESE WERE REPORTEDLY TAKEN FROM SECURITY FORCES IN SOUTH TEHRAN. CLASHES BETWEEN TROOPS AND MOBS HAVE NOT, HOWEVER, SO FAR SEEN ANY SUCH WEAPONS USED EXCEPT PERHAPS IN ISOLATED SNIPER INCIDENTS.
MAJLIS WILL MEET IN OPEN SESSION NOV 18 TO HEAR PRIMIN GEN AZHARI PRESENT HIS PROGRAM AND HIS MINISTERS. PARLIAMENT WILL PRESUMABLY VOTE CONFIDENCE IN MILITARY GOVT.
IRAN IS STILL WITHOUT NEWSPAPERS BUT REPORTS ARE CIRCULATING THAT JOURNALS MAY APPEAR BEGINNING NOV 20. THESE MAY BE BASED ON BEHIND-THE-SCENES NEGOTIATIONS.
HIGH IRANIAN MILITARY SOURCE TOLD EMBOFF GOVT HAS ARRESTED 43 "COMMUNISTS" IN OILFIELDS

NIRT REPORTS NUMEROUS PRO-GOVT DEMONSTRATIONS, MOST OF THEM IN EASTERN OR WESTERN BORDER REGIONS (COMMENT: IN OTHER WORDS, OUTSIDE THE FARSI-SPEAKING NUCLEUS WHERE STRUGGLE FOR CONTROL OF IRAN MUST TAKE PLACE).
BUS USED TO TRANSPORT AMERICAN CONTRACTORS IN SEMNAN WAS BOMBED YESTERDAY WHILE UNOCCUPIED.

1978TEHRAN11213.subject: REPORT THAT ARMS BEING ISSUED TO KURDS

segments.text: MFA DIR GEN SANANDAJI TOLD POL COUNSELOR IN COURSE OF CONVERSATION NOV 14 THAT HE WAS WORRIED ABOUT REPORTS "HIS PEOPLE" HAD GIVEN HIM THAT "SOME ORGANIZATION" (UNKNOWN) IS PASSING OUT ARMS TO KURDS IN MAHABAD AND OTHER TOWNS OF IRANIAN KURDISTAN. THIS HAS BEEN GOING ON FOR SOME TIME. AN OATH TO KURDISH INDEPENDENCE IS REQUIRED OF THE PERSON BEFORE HE GETS HIS WEAPON. THERE WAS A SMALL CHARGE BEING MADE FOR THE WEAPONS AT FIRST BUT NOW THEY ARE BEING GIVEN OUT FREE.

SANANDAGI TENDS TO BE EXCITABLE AND AN UNCERTAIN SOURCE. AS FAR AS WE AWARE, GOI POLICY IS RESTRICTIVE ON IRAQI KURDS AT PRESENT. HOWEVER, SANANDAJI SAID HE HAD PASSED THIS INFORMATION TO THE SECURITY SERVICES AND THEY WERE INVESTIGATING. WE ARE ASKING CONSUL IN TABRIZ TO CHECK IT OUT.

BBC PERSIAN LANGUAGE RENDITION OF PRESIDENT'S STATEMENT ON IRAN AS HEARD BY SEVERAL EMBASSY SOURCES TRANSLATES "VILLIANS" AS, ROUGHLY "SCUM". THIS HAS RAISED HACKLES AMONG THE OPPOSITION, WE HEAR. PROMINENT RELIGIOUS LEADER SHARIAT-MADARI IN QOM REPORTEDLY CALLED SAVAK CHIEF GENERAL MOGHADAM ABOUT THIS MATTER. WE ARE THEREFORE HASTENING TO DISTRIBUTE COPIES OF PRESIDENTIAL TEXT (USING THE CORRECT WORD "VIOLENCE" IN PLACE OF "VILLIANS") TO PEOPLE, INCLUDING GENERAL MOGHADAM, WHO WILL SEE THAT OPPOSITION LEADERS KNOW WHAT THE PRESIDENT SAID.
THIS AGAIN POINTS OUT URGENT REQUIREMENT FOR SUBSTANTIVE REVIEW OF WHITE HOUSE TRANSCRIPTS BEFORE RPT BEFORE THEY ARE RELEASED.

DEPUTY MINISTER OF COURT BAHADORI MADE INQUIRIES AT OUR REQUEST YESTERDAY AND INFORMS US SANJABI IS IN COMFORTABLE CIRCUMSTANCES WHILE UNDER ARREST. HEAD OF SAVAK GENERAL MOGHADAM, WHO WAS SANJABI'S LAW STUDENT, HAS PERSONALLY INDICATED TO US THE SAME THING. WE HAVE ALREADY REPORTED CIRCUMSTANCES OF HIS ARREST UNDER MARTIAL LAW REGULATION SECTION 5 OV 11 WHEN HE WAS ILLEGALLY TRYING TO HOLD A PRESS CONFERENCE.

1978TEHRAN11241.subject: DISCUSSIONS WITH OPPOSITION MODERATES AND LOYALIST

segments.text: LOYALIST

ON SUCCESSIVE NIGHTS RECENTLY POL COUNSELOR MET WITH MOHAMAD DERAKHSHESH, HEAD OF TEACHERS UNION, AND SENATOR MOHAMAD ALI MASSOUDI, PROMINENT SUPPORTER OF SHARIF-EMAMI AND SHAH LOYALIST. CONVERSATION WITH DERAKHSHESH COVERED A LOT OF GROUND OVER PAST 17YEARS HE HAS BEEN INACTIVE IN GOVERNMENT AFTER HAVING SERVED AS MINISTER OF EDUCATION AND REFUSED OFFER FOR THAT JOB IN ALAM CABINET OF THOSE DAYS. HE WAS RELEASED FROM PRISON ABOUT A WEEK AGO AFTER SPENDING TWO WEEKS, MAINLY IN A MILITARY HOSPITAL DUE TO BLOOD PRESSURE PROBLEM, HAVING BEEN ARRESTED BY MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES FOR OPPOSITION STATEMENTS.

AS LEADER OF A UNION WHICH CONSISTS OF FOUR HUNDRED THOUSAND TEACHERS THROUGHOUT IRAN, DERAKHSHESH IS ONE OF RELATIVELY FEW PEOPLE IN IRAN WHO CAN MOBILIZE SOME SORT OF ORGANIZATION. HE INDICATED HE WOULD DEARLY LOVE TO FOLLOW CONCILIATORY COURSE WHICH WOULD PERMIT SHAH TO REMAIN AND REIGN, NOT RULE, BUT GOVERNMENT HAS CLOSED DOWN ALL EFFORTS HE AND HIS GROUP HAVE MADE TO PUBLISH OR BE POLITICALLY ACTIVE.

DERAKHSHESH DESCRIBES GROUP THAT FOLLOWS HIM AS MAJORITY OF TEACHERS. SMALL MINORITY FOLLOW CRYPTO COMMUNIST ORGANIZATION ACCORDING TO HIM WHILE LARGER MINORITY ARE RELIGIOUS SUPPORTERS DOMINATED BY KHOMEINI. HE CONSIDERS PEOPLE WHO HAVE POSITIONS IN GOVERNMENT OVER PAST 17 YEARS AS "CORRUPT" MORALLY EVEN IF NOT IN EVERY CASE FINANCIALLY. HE CITES HIS OWN EXPERIENCE WHEN HIS SALARY WAS CUT OFF FOR SEVERAL YEARS AND HE HAD TO SURVIVE ON HIS WIFE'S EARNINGS.

ALL THIS APPEARS TO LEAVE HIM NOT TOO EMBITTERED, AND POL COUNSELOR AS WELL AS VISITING INR DEPARTMENT OFFICER GRIFFIN WERE IMPRESSED BY HIS READINESS TO FOLLOW A MIDDLE COURSE THAT MIGHT SAVE HIS COUNTRY FROM THE POLARIZED EXTREMES INTO WHICH SITUATION IS SLIPPING. HE EXPRESSED AN INTEREST IN REMAINING IN TOUCH WITH THE EMBASSY.

MASSOUDI, WHO WAS ACTIVE BEHIND-THE-SCENES IN SUPPORT OF SHARIF-EMAMI AS PRIME MINISTER, AND CONTINUES ACTIVE WITH MANY OPPOSITION AS WELL AS LOYALIST ELEMENTS, REPRESENTED CONTINUING LOYALTY MANY IRANIANS FEEL FOR THE KING, DESPITE THEIR RECOGNITION OF HIS HAVING MADE MANY ERRORS. MASSOUDI AND HIS DAUGHTERS WENT ON AT SOME LENGTH ABOUT THE SINS OF PEOPLE WHO SURROUNDED THE KING OVER PAST DECADE AND PROFITED BY THEIR ROLE AS INTERMEDIARIES BETWEEN THE KING AND HIS PEOPLE. HOVEYDA IN PARTICULAR CAME IN FOR HEAVY CRITICISM.

WE REPORT THESE TWO MEETINGS TO INDICATE COMPLEXITY IN DOMESTIC IRANIAN SITUATION. THERE ARE A VARIETY OF ELEMENTS IN THE POPULATION WHO WOULD DEARLY LIKE TO SEE SOME SORT OF COMPROMISE SOLUTION WHICH WOULD KEEP THE SHAH AND AVOID A TOTAL VICTORY FOR KHOMEINI FORCES. MANY OF THESE PEOPLE ARE CONVINCED COMMUNISTS WILL EVENTUALLY MANAGE TO TAKE OVER ANY SUCCESSOR GOVERNMENT DESPITE THEIR RELATIVELY LOW POSTURE IN PRESENT OPPOSITION. OTHERS WANT TO AVOID WHAT THEY SEE AS RELIGIOUS FANATICISM. ALL RECOGNIZE KEY ROLE TO BE PLAYED BY THE ARMED FORCES WHATEVER THE OUTCOME OF PRESENT SITUATION MIGHT BE.

ISRAELI MISSION'S NUMBER TWO MAN MOSHE GILBOA CONFIRMED TO POL COUNSELOR IN COURSE OF CONVERSATION NOVEMBER THAT MUCH OF TOP JEWISH LEADERSHIP HAS ALREADY PHYSICALLY LEFT IRAN AND MOST OTHERS ARE MAKING UP THEIR MINDS TO DO SO ONCE CONDITIONS PERMIT DISPOSAL OF BUSINESSES AND PROPERTY. HE ASKED THIS INFORMATION BE HELD VERY CLOSE.

HE ADDED THERE IS CONTINUING EVIDENCE JEWS ARE BEING INCLUDED IN TARGET GROUPS OF RELIGIOUS DEMONSTRATORS. HE CITED DESTRUCTION OF JEWISH BUSINESSES PARTICULARLY IN BABOL, AMOL, AND SOME OTHER CITIES. HE SAID BAHAIS ARE ALSO INVOLVED IN THIS FLIGHT AS ARE SOME CHRISTIAN MINORTIES.

GILBOA AFFIRMED THAT RECENT DEATH OF FORMER IRAN AIR HEAD GENERAL ALO MOHAMMAD KHADEMI WAS NOT SUICIDE AS OFFICIALLY ANNOUNCED BUT PLAIN MURDER BY UNKNOWN PERSONS IN PRESENCE OF KHADEMI'S FAMILY. KHADEMI WAS OF COURSE A BAHAI. BAHAIS PLANS MANIFESTATION OF SOME SORT IN NEW YORK IN NEAR FUTURE TO PROTEST AND PUBLICIZE THIS MURDER.
COMMENT: GILBOA MAY BE DRAMATIZING A BIT, BUT SITUATION CERTAINLY PRESENTS LITTLE REASSURANCE TO MINORITIES SUCH AS JEWS HERE. WE HAVE NO INDEPENDENT CONFIRMATION OF KHADEMI/BAHAI STORY.

TELECOMMUNICATIONS COMPANY OF IRAN. MOREOVER, SERVICE CONTRACTS HAVE BEEN WIDELY CTITICIZED AS BEING EXTRAVAGENT AND WASTEFUL. THE EMBASSY IS ALREADY OBSERVING WIDESPREAD CUTBACKS IN EXPATRIATE REPRESENTATION AS BUSINESS PROSPECTS DIMINISH AND FIRMS TAKEN TO REDUCE THEIR EXPOSURE. WE ARE HEARING INCREASING REPORTS OF GOI ARREARAGES IN PAYMENTS TO U.S. FIRMS, SOME OF WHICH MAY PARTLY REFLECT THE LAST MONTHS'S VIRTUAL PARALYSIS OF THE GOI.

CONCLUSION. IRAN'S ECONOMY HAS SUFFERED A SEVERE SETBACK, BUT THE OUTLOOK IS NOT ENTIRELY BLEAK. IMMEDIATE RECOVERY WILL DEPEND ON THE NEW MILITARY GOVERNMENT'S ABILITY TO ASSURE PUBLIC ORDER, RESTORE OIL PRODUCTION AND ESSENTIAL SERVICES, AND PRODUCE A CREDIBILE ECONOMIC PLAN AND PROGRAM FOR MANAGING THE ECONOMY. IT THIS CAN BE DONE, IRAN'S OIL CAN PROVIDE THE FINANCIAL BASE NEEDED TO REPAIR THE DAMAGE OF RECENT MONTHS AND TO BEGIN TO CORRECT THE SERIOUS UNDERLYING DISTORTIONS CREATED BY THE SHAH'S WASTEFUL EFFORTS TO TRANSFORM IRAN INTO AN ADVANCED ECONOMIC AND MILITARY POWER WITHIN A FEW DECADES.
A MORE REALISTIC VISION OF IRAN'S PROSPECTS IS AN ESSENTIAL INGREDIENT OF LONGER TERM ECONOMIC RECOVERY.

THE MILITARY GOVERNMENT IS ACUTELY AWARE OF THE NEED TO RESTORE OIL PRODUCTION AND OTHER VITAL ECONOMIC ACTIVITIES. THEIR CAUTIOUS STEP-BY-STEP APPROACH HAS BEEN PARTIALLY SICCESSFUL IN RESTORING OIL PRODUCTION AND LARGELY SUCCESSFUL IN RESTORING CIVIL AIR SERVICE AND IN MAINTAINING MOST ESSENTIAL PUBLIC UTILITY SERCIVE. MUCH REMAINS TO BE DONE BEFORE THE ECONOMY CAN BE BROUGHT BACK TO ANYTHING APPROACHING NORMAL LEVELS OF ACTIVITY, BUT AT LEAST THE TREND IS UP.

THE NEW GOVERNMENT HAS ALSO RETAINED A CORE GROUP OF COMPETENT ECONOMIC TECHNOCRATS TO MANAGE ITS ECONOMIC HOUSE--NOTABLY FORMER MINISTER OF STATE FOR THE PLAN AND BUDGET ORGANIZATION HASSAN ALI MEHRAN WHO HAS BEEN SHIFTED TOTHE VITAL ECONOMICS AND FINANCE PORTFOLIO.

THE GAINS OF THE MILITARY GOVT ARE, HOWEVER, TENUOUS, AND SERIOUS DISORDER IN THE PERIOD OF MOHARRAM COULD QUICKLY REVERSE THE CURRENT TREND. IT WILL BE IMPORTANT FOR SECRETARY BLUMENTHAL TO FOCUS ON THESE ISSUES IN HIS DISCUSSIONS IN TEHRAN. WE ARE SENDING SEPARATE MESSAGES THROUGH MILITARY CHANNELS ON CRISIS OF PAYMENTS FOR MILITARY PROCUREMENTS FROM U.S. PAYMENTS FOR THIS U.S. FISCAL YEAR ARE SCHEDULED AT 3.5 BILLION DOLLARS.

TEHRAN HAD AT LEAST TWO BRIEF SCUFFLES BETWEEN OPPOSITION AND SECURITY FORCES YESTERDAY, BUT CITY WAS GENERALLY QUIET. CONSULATES ISFAHAN AND SHIRAZ REPORT CONDITIONS QUIET. VIOLENCE WAS REPORTED YESTERDAY IN ZANJAN, QOM, AND HAMEDAN, BUT THERE ARE NO DETAILS ON DEATHS OR INJURIES. ATMOSPHERE IN AHWAZ CONTINUES VERY UGLY AS RESULT OF LABOR DISPUTE WITH ANTIFOREIGN OVERTONES. KERMANSHAH IS TENSE FOLLOWING ROWDY CLASH NOV 12, CONFIRMED BY CONSULATE SHIRAZ, IN WHICH ABOUT 12 PEOPLE DIED. TODAY IS "HAPPY SHIITE HOLIDAY MARKING BIRTHDAY OF TENTH IMAM. NOV 19 IS MAJOR HAPPY HOLIDAY OF EID-E-GHADIR-E-KHOM( COMMEMORATING ALI'S CONSECRATION AS THE PROPHET'S SUCCESSOR)
GOI IMPOSED RESTRICTIONS NOV 15 ON TRANSFER OF CURRENCY OUT OF IRAN (BEING REPORTED SEPTEL).

GOVT HAS CANCELLED ARMED FORCES DAY PARADE SCHEDULED FOR TOMORROW. NO REASON WAS GIVEN. (COMMENT: PARADE IS AN ANNUAL EVENT, AND EMBASSY EXPECTED GOI TO USE OCCASION TO SHOW ITS POWER AND PERHAPS INSPIRE SUPPORT. PARADE WOULD, ON THE OTHER HAND, HAVE GIVEN CROWDS AN EXCUSE TO GATHER IN TECHNICAL VIOLATION OF MARTIAL LAW WITH GREAT POTENTIAL FOR ANTIREGIME DISPLAYS.)

LOW LEVEL ANTI-FOREIGN HARRASSMENT CONTINUES. EVENTS THAT WERE REPORTABLE SEVERAL WEEKS AGO ARE NOW ROUTINE AND ARE NOT MENTIONED UNLESS THERE IS DESTRUCTION OF PROPERTY OR THREAT OF PERSONAL INJURY. TYPICAL OF ACT REPEATED MANY TIMES OVER WAS INCIDENT YESTERDAY IN WHICH YOUNG (PRE-TEEN) IRANIAN BOYS WERE CAUGHT PAINTING WORDS ON GATE TO NAVAL ATTACHE'S HOUSE. HOME HAS TWICE PREVIOUSLY HAD ANTIREGIME SLOGANS PAINTED ON IT. ATTACHE TOOK BOYS TO THEIR NEARBY PARENTS FOR A GOOD SCOLDING.

CONSULATE SHIRAZ REPORTS CITY FEARS POWER OUTAGES UNLESS GAS SUPPLY IS RESTORED TO POWER GENERATORS. BLACKOUTS WOULD SEVERELY AFFECT FOREIGN COMMUNITY WHICH HAS IN RECENT WEEKS ENJOYED RELATIVELY PEACEFUL CONDITIONS.
IF SITUATION IS QUIET TOMORROW, EMBASSY MAY OMIT SENDING ANY POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT. NEXT REPORT WOULD THEN BE SATURDAY, NOV 18.
SUMMARY: SANJABI IN MILITARY PRISON UNDER MARTIAL LAW CHARGE. IN GOOD HEALTH AND HAS BEEN IN CONTACT WITH GOI. END SUMMARY.
WE HAVE REPORTED THAT COURT MINISTRY SOURCE CONFIRMED TO POLCOUNS MORNING NOV 12 SANJABI IS BEING HELD UNDER ARTICLE FIVE OF MARTIAL LAW.

DR. MINATCHI, TREASURER OF IRANIAN COMMITTEE FOR DEFENSE OF HUMAN RIGHTS AND FREEDOM (CDHRF) TOLD EMBOFF STEMPEL LATER ON NOV 16, IN CONFIDENCE, THAT SANJABI IS IN TEHRAN'S JAMSHIDABAD MILITARY PRISON "ALONG WITH ALL THE OTHER EX/MINISTERS WHO WERE ARRESTED." HIS WIFE VISITS HIM REGULARLY. MINATCHI DESCRIBED CONDITIONS AS "VERY GOOD." IN FACT, MINATCHI SAID SANJABI HAD BEEN HAVING CONVERSATIONS WITH THE GOVERNMENT AND DESCRIBED SITUATION AS "VERY SATISFACTORY." HE SAID HE WOULD REPORT FURTHER TO EMBOFF ON SATURDAY, NOV 25.

EMBASSY WOULD HAVE NO OBJECTION TO PASSING ABOVE TO SENATORS AND CONGRESSMEN WITHOUT REFERENCE TO SOURCE AND OMITTING FACT THAT SANJABI IS TALKING WITH GOVERNMENT. PERHAPS DEPARTMENT ITSELF COULD REASSURE SANJABI'S SON THAT HIS FATHER APPEARS IN GOOD CONDITION AND IS BEING SEEN REGULARLY BY THE FAMILY, THEN PERHAPS ALLUDE TO FACT THAT INCARCERATION DOES NOT AT THE MOMENT SEEM TO BE MAJOR PROBLEM FOR HIMSELF AND HIS POLITICAL ASSOCIATES. MINATCHI GAVE EMBOFF IMPRESSION, THOUGH HE WOULD NOT SAY SO DIRECTLY, THAT SITUATION IS NOT ENTIRELY UNWELCOME TO SANJABI AND NATIONAL FRONT.

RUMOR THAT SHAH ALSO MET WITH SANJABI HAS BEEN MAKING THE ROUNDS HERE. WE HAVE NO CONFIRMATION, THOUGH THAT WOULD BE VERY DIFFERENT THAN HIS MEETING JUST WITH GOVERNMENT. DEPARTMENT WILL RECALL SHAH WAS INTERESTED IN TALKING WITH SANJABI JUST AS SANJABI LEFT FOR PARIS TO SEE KHOMEINI--AND CAME BACK, PUBLICLY AT LEAST, CONVERTED TO KHOMEINI'S HARD LINE.

FORMER PRIME MINISTER ALI AMINI ASKED ME TO MEET HIM DISCREETLY AT HOME OF MUTUAL FRIEND EVENING NOVEMBER 16. DISCUSSION BEGAN WITH MUTUAL EXPRESSIONS OF PREVIOUS RELUCTANCE TO MEET BECAUSE OF TEHRAN GOSSIP THAT AMINI WAS "AMERICAN PUPPET" OR "CIA AGENT". AMINI SAID THAT ASPECT CONCERNED HIM AS LONG AS HE HAD HARBORED AMBITIONS TO BE PRIME MINISTER. HE HAD FINALLY DECIDED FORESWEAR SUCH AMBITIONS AND THEREFORE SOUGHT OPPORTUNITY TO EXCHANGE VIEWS WITH ME.

AMINI SAID HE HAD DECIDED HE COULD BEST SERVE HIS COUNTRY BY ACTING AS AN INTERMEDIARY AND CATALYST FOR COMPROMISE. HE AND ENTEZAM HAD BEEN MEETING RATHER REGULARLY WITH SHAH AND ALSO WITH OPPOSITION GOUPS. HE SAID HE FELT SOME PROGRESS WAS BEING MADE, BUT HE HAD YET TO BRIDGE THE GREAT GAP OF DISTRUST. HE ASKED HOW I SAW THE SITUATION, SINCE HE KNEW WE HAD ALSO HAD CONTINUING CONTACTS BOTH WITH SHAH AND WITH OPPOSITION GROUPS.

I SAID IT WAS MY IMPRESSION SHAH WAS SINCERE IN HIS DESIRE TO FORM NATIONAL GOVERNMENT AND PROCEED WITH FREE ELECTIONS. THE DEPTH AND THE SCOPE OF POPULAR OPPOSITION TO HIM AND HIS REGIME HAD SHOCKED HIM. HOWEVER, WE FOUND THE OPPOSITION GROUPS INTRANSIGENT AND UNWILLING TO COMPROMISE. THEY DEEPLY DISTRUSTED THE SHAH AND FELT THAT ANY DISCUSSIONS WITH HIM WOULD SOMEHOW LEAD TO ENTRAPMENT. THEY WANTED THE BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND ME TO BE THEIR INTERMEDIARIES WITH THE SHAH, BUT THEIR TERMS INVOLVED SURRENDER BY THE SHAH. WE FLATLY REFUSED TO MEDIATE. THE U.S. POSITION HAD BEEN CATEGORICALLY STATED SEVERAL TIMES BY PRESIDENT CARTER.
WE WOULD NOT RPT NOT INVOLVE OURSELVES IN ATTEMPTING TO STRUCTURE THE INTERNAL POLITICS OF IRAN. THAT HAD TO BE AN IRANIAN EFFORT.

AMINI SAID HE AGREED WITH THAT POSITION AND WAS ATTEMPTING TO BE THE INTERMEDIARY. HIS IDEA WAS TO BRING SMALL GROUPS OF INFLUENTIAL PEOPLE FROM VARIOUS SECTORS OF IRANIAN PUBLIC LIFE INTO INTIMATE MEETINGS WITH THE SHAH. HE FELT THIS WOULD GIVE WIDER CURRENCY TO OUR IMPRESSION THAT SHAH WAS SINCERE IN HIS DESIRE TO HOLD FREE ELECTIONS. IF THIS IMPRESSION COULD BE WIDESPREAD, IT WOULD BREAK DOWN THE WALL OF DISTRUST. HE INTENDED TO START WITH A SMALL NUMBER OF UNIVERSITY TYPES AND EVENTUALLY LEAD TOWARDS THE NATIONAL FRONT POLITICIANS. HE ASKED WHAT I THOUGHT.

I SAID ONE GROUP WHICH OUGHT TO BE INCLUDED WAS THE LEADERS OF THE BAZAAR. I THOUGHT THEY HAD GREAT INFLUENCE AND ALSO GREAT DISTRUST. AMINI READILY AGREED AND SAID HE WOULD GATHER FOUR OR FIVE LEADERS TOGETHER IF THE SHAH AGREED.

I SAID THERE WERE RUMORS IN TOWN THAT SHAH HAD ALREADY SEEN SANJABI. ALI AMINI SAID HE HAD HEARD THEM, BUT HE DOUBTED THEM. HOWEVER, HE WOULD SEE SHAH SATURDAY AND FIND OUT. I SAID I WOULD ALSO SEE SHAH SATURDAY AND WE AGREED WE WOULD BOTH INFORM HIM OF FACT OF OUR MEETING.

WE THEN TURNED TO DISCUSSION OF TIME FRAME ENTAILED IN THE POLITICAL DISCUSSION PROCESS. AMINI HAD OUTLINED. HE SAID IT HAD TO BE RAPID AND BE COMPLETED BEFORE MOHARRAM. HE FELT THAT MODERATE AYATOLLAHS COULD KEEP THE PUBLIC ------------------054999 171017Z /21 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1663 SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 12296 LIMDIS CALM UNTIL THAT TIME; BUT, IF SOME RAPPORT BETWEEN MODERATES AND SHAH NOT ESTABLISHED PRIOR THAT TIME, KHOMEINI COULD USE THE FERVOR OF THE MOHARRAM PERIOD TO PRODUCE CHAOS.

IN GENERAL, HOWEVER, HE THOUGHT THE KHOMEINI INFLUENCE WAS SLIPPING. I SAID HE WAS ONE OF MANY POLITICAL FIGURES WHO HAD TOLD ME THAT, BUT I WONDERED WHETHER IT REFLECTED SITUATION AMONG STUDENTS AND BAZAARI. HE FELT COMMON LINK BETWEEN HOSE TWO GROUPS AND KHOMEINI WAS INTENSE HATRED FOR THE SHAH, BUT HE DOUBTED THEY WERE ORGANICALLY LINED TO KHOMEINI.

I ASKED AMINI FOR HIS VIEWS ON HOW GENUINELY FREE ELECTIONS HELD IN A RELATIVELY CALM ATMOSPHERE WOULD TURN OUT. HE SAID, MUCH AS OTHER POLITICAL FIGURES HAVE SAID, THAT THEY WOULD RETURN A "BALANCED" PARLIAMENT WHICH WOULD RESPECT THE CONSTITUTION AND PREFER A MONARCHY WHICH REIGNED BUT DID NOT RULE. THEY WOULD ALSO RESPECT THE SHAH'S ROLE AS COMMANDER IN CHIEF OF THE ARMED FORCES. HE BASED THIS PREDICTION ON THE FACT THAT MOST POLITICAL LEADERS HAD THEIR OWN LOCAL CONSTITUENCIES.
HOWEVER, HE SAID THE ELECTION LISTS WOULD HAVE TO GET THE BLESSINGS OF THE MULLAHS AND THIS WAS WHY IT WAS IMPORTANT TO ESTABLISH THE RAPPORT BETWEEN THEM AND THEIR SUPPORTERS WITH THETSHAH.
IN PAVTING, WE AGREED TO KEEP IN TOUCH, BUT ALSO AGREED THAT U.S. ROLE WOULD BE SUPPORTIVE, RATHER THAN CENTRAL, TO ANY PROCESS OF RESTORING IRANIAN CONFIENCE IN THE SHAH.

KOREAN AMBASSADOR CAME TO SEE ME MORNING NOV 17. HE SAID KOREAN LABOR FORCE IN IRAN--ABOUT 11,000 MEN--WAS DEEPLY TROUBLED. THERE WERE ESSENTIALLY TWO PROBLEMS: (A) DEFAULTS IN PAYMENTS BY IRANIAN GOVERNMENT AND IRANIAN FIRMS, (B) THREATS AGAINST LIVES AND WELFARE OF KOREAN PERSONNEL.

AS A RESULT, HE HAD STOPPED THE INFLUX OF NEW OR REPLACEMENT LABOR CADRES (HE ESTIMATED ABOUT 2,000 WERE AFFECTED). HE HAD ALSO APPEALED TO IRANIAN GOVERNMENT FOR PROTECTION OF THE LABOR SITES, BUT DID NOT RPT NOT FEEL RESPONSE WAS ADEQUATE.

HE ASKED IF WE HAD ANY WAY TO PROD IRANIANS INTO MAKING PROGESS PAYMENTS. I SAID THAT, FOR THOSE GOI PROJECTS UNDER MILITARY AEGIS, WE DEALT DIRECTLY WITH GENERAL TOUFANIAN. HE SAID NEARLY HALF KOREAN PROJECTS WERE MILITARY RELATED AND UNDERTOOK TO MEET WITH TOUFANIAN.

1978TEHRAN11300.subject: MEETING WITH KAYHAN PUBLISHER AND EDITOR

segments.text: AT THEIR REQUEST KAYHAN PUBLISHER, SENATOR MEZBAZADEH AND EDITOR ZARNEGAR CALLED ON AMBASSADOR AT HIS RESIDENCE NOV. 17. DCM ALSO PRESENT. MEZBAZADEH WRYLY NOTED THAT THE STRIKE BY THE NEWSPAPER STAFF HAD BROUGHT ABOUT THE CLOSURE OF THE PRESSE, THE VERY CONDITION WHICH, AS WE KNEW FROM OUR PAST DISCUSSION, HE HAD BEEN CONTEMPLATING TO DO ON HIS OWN. HE ASSUMED THAT THE MILITARY GOVERNMENT AND MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES WERE NOT TOO CONCERNED BY THE PRESS STRIKE AND WOULD BE QUITE HAPPY TO HAVE NO PUBLISHING OF PAPERS FOR SOME TIME TO COME.
THE AMB NOTED THAT INDEED THE PRIME MINISTER DID NOT APPEAR TO HAVE THE ENDING OF THE PRESS STRIKE HIGH ON HISSLIST OF PRIORITIES.

MEZBAZADEH STATED THAT A FEW DAYS AGO A SMALL STAFF PREPARED A SIX-PAGE ISSUE RECAPITULATING THE DEVELOPMENTS SINCE THE LAST ISSUE OF THE PAPER. HOWEVER, THE PRINTERS REFUSED TO PUBLISH THE PAPER AND THAT WAS THE LAST MAJOR EFFORT OF MANAGEMENT TO BRING OUT THE PAPER. MANAGEMENT HAD THOUGHT THAT THE ENGLISH LANGUAGE INTERNATIONAL EDITION MIGHT NOT BE AS POLITICALLY SENSITIVE AS THE PERSIAN LANGUAGE DAILY BUT HAD FAILED IN ITS PLOY.

THE GENTLEMEN EXPLAINED THAT THERE ARE THREE UNIONS OR SYNDICATES IN THE PRESS FIELD: WRITERS AND JOURNALISTS, ADMINISTRATIVE STAFF, AND WORKERS WHICH INCLUDES THE PRINTING TECHNICIANS. EACH SYNDICATE HAS A SMALL GROUP OF RADICIALS, LARGELY OF THE LEFT THEY THOUGHT, WHICH DOMINATES THE OTHERS. EACH TIME THAT SOME PROGRESS HAS BEEN MADE IN NEGOTIATIONS WITH ONE SYNDICATE, THE PRO-STRIKE GROUPS FROM THE OTHER SYNDICATES INTERVENED TO CAUSE NEGOTIATIONS TO COLLAPSE. THE RADICALS WHO WERE ARRESTED ON THE FIRST DAY OF THE NEW MILITARY GOVT WERE HELD FOR ONLY 24 HOURS OR SO AND WERE RELEASED.

KAYHAN NOW HAS MAJOR FINANCIAL PROBLEMS; NOT ONLY HAS THE STRIKE DEPRIVED THE PAPER OF IMMEDIATE REVENUE, BUT MANAGEMENT HAS ALSO BEEN UNABLE TO COLLECT OUTSTANDING BILLS. PAYDAY FOR THE EMPLOYEES IS TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 21 AND THERE IS NO MONEY TO PAY THEM. THAT WILL BE A DAY OF TESTING WHETHER THE STRIKE CONTINUES. THE RADICAL PRO-STRIKE GROUP, HOWEVER, HAS DUGIN ITS HEELS AND IS INSISTING ON THREE POINTS: THE MILITARY GOVT MUST REAFFIRM THE PRESS CHARTER AGREED TO BY SHAJIF-EMAMI, ALL POLITICAL PRISONERS MUST BE RELEASED, AND JOURNALISTS SHOULD NOT BE ARRESTED.

MEZBAZADEH COMMENTED THAT, WHEN HE PUT WORD OUT OF THE FINANCIAL PROBLEMS OF THE PAPER, HE WAS TOLD THAT MONEY WOULD BE MADE AVAILABLE TO HIM FROM THE BAZARRIS. THE SENATOR NOTED THAT HE HAD ALSO HEARD THE SAME RUMOR WHICH HAD COME TO OUR ATTENTION THAT SOME BAZAARIS WOULD PAY THE WORKERS IN ORDER TO KEEP THE STRIKE GOING. HE DOUBTED THAT IN FACT THE BAZARR GROUP WOULD COME UP WITH THE 10-11 MILLION TOMANS REQUIRED FOR THE MONTHLY EXPENSES.

MEZBAZADEH SAID HE HAS HELD LONG MEETINGS WITH REPRESENTATIVES OF THE SYNDICATES TO DISCUSS THE INHERENT LIMITATIONS ON AFREE PRESS DURING A PERIOD OF MILITARY GOVT. HE HAS AGREED TO LET THE SYNDICATES BRING OUT A DUMMY COPY OF WHAT THEY BELIEVE THE PAPER SHOULD LOOK LIKE IN THESE CIRCUMSTANCES. HE WAS DUBIOUS THAT THIS EXPERIMENT WOULD BE SUCCESSFUL.

TURNING TO THE OVERALL POLITICAL SITUATION, THE SENATOR EXPRESSED THE VIEW THAT THE MILITARY GOVERNMENT HAD PERFORMED AS WELL AS COULD BE EXPECTED. IT WAS UNREALISTIC, HE SAID, TO EXPECT THAT THE EMOTIONS OF THE PAST FEW MONTHS COULD BE QUICKLY REVERSED. OIL PRODUCTION IS GOING UP SLOWLY, PEOPLE ARE RETURNING TO WORK IN VARIOUS MINISTRIES AND THERE IS A BETTER SECURITY SITUATION ON THE STREETS. THAT, HE THOUGHT, WAS ABOUT ALL THE GOVT COULD DO IN THE TWO WEEKS THAT IT HAS BEEN IN POWER.

CONTRARY TO WHAT OTHERS HAVE TOLD US, HE SUGGESTED THAT THE CONSULTATIONS BETWEEN THE OPPOSITION AND THE SHAH AND HIS REPRESENTATIVES SHOLD NOT BE BROUGHT TO FRUITION BEFORE MOHARRAM. BETWEEN NOW AND THE BEGINNING OF MOHARRAM THE MILITARY GOVT SHOULD DO ITS BEST, HE RECOMMENDED, TO AVOID MAJOR CONFRONTATIONS WITH THE OPPOSITION. HOWEVER, IT MUST BE PREPARED TO HAVE A MASSIVE MILITARY PRESENCE IN THE STREETS DUJING MOHARRAM TO PREVENT MAJOR DEMONSTRATIONS OR TO DEAL WITH THEM VIGOROUSLY SHOULD THEY OCCUR.

IF THE GOVT IS SUCCESSFUL DURING THE MOHARRAM PERIOD IN GENERALLY MAINTAINING LAW AND ORDER, IT WOULD THEN BE IN A STRONG POSITION TO NEGOTIATE WITH THE MPPOYP TION AFTER MOHARRAM HAD PAST AND THE KHOMEIMI CHALLENGE HAD BEEN HANDLED. HE WAS DOUBTFUL THAT THE OPPOSITION LEADERS IN FACT WOULD WANT TO REACH AGREEMENT WITH THE GOVT AND THE SHAH UNTIL THE MOHARRAM PERIOD WAS OVER AND EVERYBODY HAD A BEZTER ESTIMATE OF THE STRENGTH OF KHOMEINI.

AS HE PREPARED TO DEPART, THE SENATOR ASKED THE AMB TO CONVEY TO THE SHAH THE VIEW THAT IT WAS ESSENTIAL FOR THE SHAH TO BRING TOGETHER AN SUBSTANTIAL NUMBER OF LEADING PERSONAGES WHO WERE UNCONNECTED WITH THE GOVT IN THE 1963-68 PERIOD. HE BELIEVED IT WAS ESSENTIAL TO GO BEYOND NATIONAL FRONT FIGUES AND EVEN TO GO BACK TO TRADITIONAL LEADERS WHO WERE PROMINENT BEFORE 1951-53.
