BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND I SPENT MORE THAN TWO HOURS WITH SHAH EVENING NOVEMBER 18. ALTHOUGH MEETING WAS AT OUR REQUEST, HE SEEMED RELIEVED TO HAVE AN OPPORTUNITY TO SPEAK AT EASE AND RELAX SOMEWHAT. HE SEEMED TIRED, RATHER TENSE, BUT IN POSITIVE FRAME OF MIND. HE SAID HE HAD BEEN ON THE PHONE ALL DAY LONG DIRECTING DETAILS OF THE CURRENT GOVT. HE SAID MILITARY HAD THE HABIT OF SEEKING HIS COMMAND ON THEIR FUNCTIONS. THIS WAS DIFFERENT FROM SHARIF-EMAMI GOVT. HOWEVER, IT WAS HARD ON HIS NERVES. HIS STOMACH WAS IN KNOTS. HE HOPED WE HAD NO RPT NO SERIOUS PROBLEMS TO LAY BEFORE HIM.

WE SAID WE HAD COME TO OBTAIN HIS EVALUATION OF CURRENT EVENTS, BUT HAD NO RPT NO PARTICULAR REQUESTS TO ASK OF HIM. HE SAID HE FOUND CURRENT SITUATION "ABNORMAL," BUT FELT THAT ANY CHANGES WOULD HAVE TO WAIT UNTIL AFTER MOHARRAM.

THE THING THAT SEEMED TO DISTURB HIM MOST WAS ESKANDARI INTERVIEW (MOSCOW 27992) WHICH SUGGESTED THAT TUDEH HAD THROWN IN ITS LOT IN SUPPORT OF KHOMEINI. HE SAID THAT IF THIS MEANT SOVIETS WERE PREPARED BACK KHOMEINI BY SENDING WEAPONS INTO THIS COUNTRY, IT COULD MEAN CIVIL WAR. HE HOPED SHARIAT-MADARI, THE NATIONAL FRONT, AND OTHERS WHO CONSIDERED THEMSELVES IRANIAN PATRIOTS, WOULD UNDERSTAND THE SIGNIFICANCE OF THIS.

HE THEN GAVE A SORT OF ARCH MONOLOGUE ON THE "STRANGE EVENTS" OF LAST THURSDAY. HE SAID THAT HE HAD RECEIVED A TELEPHONE CALL FROM WASHINGTON PURPORTING TO COME FROM SENATOR KENNEDY. WHEN HE TOOK THE CALL, THERE WAS A QUIET VOICE SAYING "MOHAMMED, ABDICATE, MOHAMMED, ABDICATE." THEN HE HAD TWO DIFFERENT SOURCES TELL HIM THAT THE U.S. AMBASSADOR HAD SUMMONED THE AMERICAN COMMUNITY WEDNESDAY EVENING TO TELL THEM THAT THE SHAH HAD TO GO. FINALLY, HE HAD BEEN INFORMED THAT HAMILTON JORDAN HAD SAID THE U.S. HAD "CONTINGENCY PLANS" IN CASE THE SHAH WAS DEPOSED.

I SAID I ASSUMED HE REALIZED THE KENNEDY CALL WAS A HOAX (HE DID). I ALSO SAID I HAD TAKEN THE PRECAUTION OF TAPE RECORDING MY REMARKS TO THE AMERICAN COMMUNITY. I DESCRIBED THEIR ESSENCE AND OFFERED TO SEND HIM A TAPE (HE DECLINED GRACIOUSLY). I GAVE HIM THE TEXT OF THE JORDAN STATEMENT, WHICH HE READ CAREFULLY, BUT SAID IT STILL CONTAINED THE SUGGESTION THAT WE CONTEMPLATED THE CONTINGENCY OF HIS DEPARTURE.

AFTER A LITTLE MORE THERAPY AND AFTER A RITUAL BALLET WITH THE BRITISH AMBASSADOR ABOUT BBC, WE SETTLED INTO A MORE RATIONAL DISCUSSION ON THE EVENTS OF THE DAY. HE SAID HE FELT THE MILITARY GOVT WAS DOING REASONABLY WELL. HE WAS FAR FROM SATISFIED WITH PRODUCTION PROGRESS IN OIL, BUT SEEMED TO RECOGNIZE THAT U.S. AND BRITISH EXPATRIATES HAD BEEN LARGELY RESPONSIBLE FOR HOLDING THE LINE. HE SAID HIS INSTRUCTIONS TO THE MILITARY IN THIS AND OTHER AREAS WERE TO MOVE STEADILY BUT SLOWLY AND TO AVOID CONFRONTATIONS. HE SAID HE HOPED HIS CAUTION WAS NOT CONSIDERED WEAKNESS.

HE THEN TURNED TO ME AND SAID THAT MANY WELL-MEANING AMERICANS WERE SENDING HIM MESSAGES, LARGELY THROUGH ZAHEDI, TELLING HIM TO BE "TOUGH," TO ASSERT CONTROL AND TO FACE DOWN THE OPPOSITION. HE ALSO "HEARD" THAT HE WAS GETTING OLD, UNABLE TO MAKE DECISIONS, AND LACKING IN "GUTS." HE SAID I SHOULD TELL THESE PEOPLE THAT HE HAD ------------------092319 191020Z /11 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1673 INFO AMEMBASSY LONDON PRIORITY SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 11314 EXDIS GUTS, BUT HE ALSO HAD A HEART AND A BRAIN. HE DID NOT RPT NOT INTEND TO MURDER THE YOUTH OF HIS NATION IN ORDER TO RULE IT.

HE SAID HIS PRINCIPAL CONCERN AT THIS JUNCTURE WAS TO AVOID A PROVOCATION WHICH WOULD BRING THE HIGH SCHOOL STUDENTS BACK INTO THE STREETS. THEREFORE, HE WAS PROCEEDING ON TWO TRACKS. FIRST, HE WOULD KEEP STEADY PRESSURE ON THE STRIKERS AND THE DEMONSTRATORS (HE SAID PEOPLE WERE BEING KILLED DAILY IN CLASHES). SECOND, HE WOULD CONTINUE HIS EFFORTS TO OPEN A DIALOGUE WITH THE OPPOSITION. HE HAD AGREED WITH ALI-AMINI TO FORM A CONSULTATIVE COUNCIL WHICH WOULD ACT AS AN INTERMEDIARY TO BRING IN OPPOSITION ELEMENTS FOR DISCUSSION. THIS GROUP WOULD BE COMPOSED OF ALI-AMINI, ENTEZAM, ARDALAN AND SURORI (HE JOKED ABOUT KEEPING THEM ALL AWAKE).

THIS COUNCIL WOULD ATTEMPT TO DEVELOP THE DIALOGUE WHICH WOULD EVENTUALLY PRODUCE THE "NATIONAL GOVT" TO SUPERVISE GENERAL ELECTIONS. HE FELT SANJABI WAS OUT OF THE PICTURE. HE HAD NOT RPT NOT MET WITH HIM AS RUMORED. SAVAK CHIEF MOGHADAM HAD, AND HE CONCLUDED THAT SANJABI WOULD NOT ACCEPT THE MONARCHY. HOWEVER, THERE WERE MANY OTHERS WHO WOULD. HE HOPED, AS THE SITUATION IMPROVED, THAT THEY WOULD BECOME COOPERATIVE.

I THEN TOLD HIM OF MY MEETING WITH ALI-AMINI. HE SEEMED AWARE OF IT. HE SAID AMINI'S PLAN TO BRING IN SAMLL GROUPS FOR DISCUSSION WAS SOUND, BUT AMINI HAD YET TO PRODUCE ANY WARM BODIES. HE PARTICULARLY WANTED TO TALK WITH THE BAZAARIS, SINCE HE THOUGHT THEY MUST BE HURTING FROM ALL THE BUSINESS INTERRUPTIONS.

AFTER A DISCUSSION OF THE THREATS TO THE EXPATRIATE COMMUNITY HERE AND OF IRANIAN MEASURES TO PROTECT THEM (AND AFTER COMMANDING WHISKY AND SODA FOR THE TWO OF US), HE ASKED OUR VIEWS. WE BOTH SAID THAT WE WERE DISCOURAGED BY THE TOTAL ABSENCE OF REALITY AMONG THE OPPOSITIONISTS, WHO SEEMED TO FEEL THAT THEY COULD DEMAND THE ABDICATION OF THE SHAH WITHOUT ACCEPTING ANY RESPONSIBILITY FOR THE CHAOS THAT WOULD FOLLOW. WE GAVE AS OUR VIEWS THE OPINION THAT IRANIANS SEEMED TO POSSESS A COMBINATION OF VICIOUS CYNICISM AND IGNORANT NAIVETE. WE FOUND IT HARD TO GRAPPLE WITH THE FRAME OF MIND WHICH WE ENCOUNTERED.
WITH A SWEEPING IMPERIAL EXIT LINE, HE SAID, "MAYBE YOU WILL UNDERSTAND WHY IT IS SO DIFFICULT TO GOVERN THIS COUNTRY."

IN VIEW SERIOUS CONCERNS SHAH HAS EXPRESSED TO ME ABOUT SOVIET INTENTIONS AND IN VIEW POSSIBLE MISINTERPRETATIONS OF BREZHNEV STATEMENT (WHICH HAS ALREADY BEEN MADE), IT MIGHT BE USEFUL FOR ME TO BE ABLE PASS PERTINENT TEXT OF BREZHNEV LETTER TO SHAH.

I WILL SEE HIM AT 1100 NOVEMBER 21 TEHRAN TIME WITH SECRETARY BLUMENTHAL. I WOULD APPRECIATE RECEIVING INSTRUCTION PRIOR TO THAT TIME, TOGETHER WITH ANY INDICATION AVAILABLE ABOUT PRESIDENT'S INTENDED REACTION.

1978TEHRAN11317.subject: VISIT OF IRANIAN EMPRESS TO IRAQ

segments.text: SHAH TOLD BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND ME EVENING NOVEMBER 18 THAT EMPRESS AND THEIR SECOND AND THIRD OLDER CHILDREN HAD LEFT THAT AFTERNOON FOR NAJAF, IN IRAQ, TO HELP CELEBRATE EID-E-GHADIR AT THAT HOLY SHRINE.
HE SAID THEY WOULD RETURN TO TEHRAN EVENING NOVEMBER 19. SINCE EMPRESS CAME FROM "RELIGIOUS FAMILY," HE FELT THIS GESTURE WOULD BE PROPERLY UNDERSTOOD AMONG THE CLERGY.

SUMMARY: TEHRAN QUIET, TROUBLE IN ISFAHAN AND SHIRAZ. SENATE WILL RECEIVE NEW CABINET TOMORROW. MAJLIS WILL DEBATE, NEW GOVT NOV 21. A FEW SMALL JOURNALS PUBLISHED. ELEMENTARY SCHOOLS OPEN BUT ATTENDANCE SPORADIC. THREE ROYAL/PRIVATE ORGANIZATIONS TO COME UNDER GOVT CONTROL. SHAH WILL RELEASE 400 POLITICAL PRISONERS. SHAH DENIED HE EVER RECEIVED SANJABI. END SUMMARY.

TEHRAN REMAINS QUIET WITH MOHARRAM (BEGINNING DEC 2) NOW LESS THAN TWO WEEKS AWAY; MOST OBSERVERS EXPECT OPPOSITION TO MARSHAL FORCES FOR DECISIVE EFFORT AT THAT TIME. ANTICIPATING VIOLENCE, GOI HAS CANCELLED CELEBRATION OF AZERBAIJAN DAY (DEC 12) WHICH THIS YEAR FALLS ONE DAY AFTER ASHURA. TROUBLE NONETHELESS CONTINUES IN OTHER CITIES. CONSULATE ISFAHAN REPORTS MLA ANNOUNCED YESTERDAY ALL SHOPS WOULD OPEN; PROTESTORS BURNED THREE SEPARATE BUILDINGS IN RESPONSE. NINE AMERICAN-OWNED VEHICLES HAVE BEEN DAMAGED BY ARSONISTS IN PAST THREE DAYS. THREATENING LETTERS ARE DISTRIBUTED ON MASS BASIS. CONSUL CONFIRMS AT LEAST 614 AMCITS HAVE DEPARTED. TROOPS HAVE REPORTEDLY FIRED OVER HEADS OF DEMONSTRATORS IN ISFAHAN TODAY.

SHIRAZ, WHICH HAS SEEMED A HAVEN IN RECENT WEEKS, SAW VIOLENCE THIS MORNING. CONSULATE REPORTS TROOPS FIRED INTO CROWD OF SEVERAL THOUSAND AFTER UNSUCCESSFULLY ORDERING THEM TO DISPERSE. 15-16 ARE REPORTED SHOT, BUT THERE IS NO CONFIRMATION AS YET OF FATALITIES.

PRIMIN GEN AZHARI WILL PRESENT CABINET TO SENATE TOMORROW. FOLLOWING DAY MAJLIS WILL DEBATE CABINET AND GOVT PROGRAM. TEN DEPUTIES WILL SPEAK FOR GOVT AND TEN AGAINST. (COMMENT: SIMILAR EVENT WHEN SHAH APPOINTED SHARIF-EMAMI BROUGHT STRIKINGLY OPEN ANTO-GOVT SPEECHES BROADCAST LIVE OVER RADIO AND TELEVISION. THIS IS UNLIKELY IN THE PRESENT CASE.) LEADING OPPOSITION DEPUTY AHMADBANI-AHMAD HAS WITHDRAWN HIS RESIGNATION.
MAJOR NEWSPAPERS HAVE STILL NOT APPEARED. SEVERAL MINOR PERSIAN LANGUAGE JOURNALS ARE BEING PUBLISHED, ONE OF WHICH (ATESH, OR FLAME) IS SOMEWHAT CRITICAL OF GOVT.

REGIME IS CARRYING OUT PLEDGE TO TRANSFER SEMIPRIVATE ORGANIZATIONS WHICH WERE UNDER ROYAL CONTROL TO DIRECT GOVT CONTROL. IMPERIAL ORGANIZATION FOR SOCIAL SERVICES AND RED LION AND SUN ARE NOW UNDER MINISTER OF HEALTH. NASRATOLLAH MOINIAN'S IMPERIAL INSPECTORATE WILL GIVE WAY TO A JUSTICE INSPECTORATE WITHIN THAT MINISTRY ONCE APPROPRIATE LAWS PASSED BY PARLIAMENT.

SHAH CONFIDED TO JOURNALIST ON BACKGROUND THAT HE PLANS TO RELEASE 400 MORE POLITICAL PRISONERS IN NEAR FUTURE. ACCORDING TO SHAH, THIS WOULD LEAVE IN PRISON ABOUT 300 POLITICAL DETAINEES, ALL OF WHOM ARE "MURDERERS."

PRIMARY SCHOOLS ARE OFFICIALLY IN SESSION SINCE YESTERDAY, BUT TEACHERS' UNION SOURCE CLAIMED 95 PERCENT OF PROVINCIAL SCHOOLS WERE CLOSED YESTERDAY. SOURCE SAID THAT IN TEHRAN, 50 PERCENT OF STUDENTS AND 90 PERCENT OF TEACHERS ATTENDED. ABOUT 5 PERCENT OF INSTRUCTORS WHO ATTENDED DID NOT, HOWEVER, DO ANY TEACHING.
SHAH HAS PRIVATELY DENIED HE RECENTLY MET WITH SANJABI. HIS STATEMENT IS SUPPORTED BY COMMENTS OF OPPOSITION IN PARIS.

IF I AM ABLE TO GIVE SHAH BACKGROUND ON BREZHNEV LETTER AND STATEMENTS ISSUED BY SOVIETS AND U.S. WHEN I SEE HIM WITH SECRETARYBLUMENTHAL NOVEMBER 21, I AM SURE HE WILL ASK FOR OUR EVALUATION OF SOVIET MOTIVATIONS. HE IS DEEPLY DISTRUSTFUL OF SOVIETS IN CURRENT CIRCUMSTANCES, ESPECIALLY IN LIGHT OF TUDEH PRAISE FOR AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI AND EVIDENCE OF TUDEH ACTIVISM IN RECENT DISTURBANCES.

THEREFORE, HE IS LIKELY TO VIEW BREZHNEV LETTER AND PUBLIC STATEMENT AS SMOKESCREENDESIGNED TO PUT U.S. OFF BALANCE WHILE SOVIETS PURSUE SUBVERSIVE OBJECTIVES. HE WILL ESPECIALLY FEAR SMUGGLING OF WEAPONS FROM USSR OR AFGHANISTAN INTO HANDS OF MILITANT OPPOSITION THROUGH TUDEH CHANNELS.

I WOULD THEREFORE URGENTLY APPRECIATE GUIDANCE WITH RESPECT TO U.S. ESTIMATE OF SOVIET POSTURE AND INTENTIONS RELATING TO IRAN. ANY VIEWS AVAILABLE CONCERNING CURRENT DEGREE OF SOVIET CONTROL OVER TUDEH PARTY AND SOVIET WILLINGNESS HOLD TUDEH IN CHECK WOULD BE DIRECTLY RELEVANT.

1978TEHRAN11363.subject: MESSAGE FROM SOUTH AFRICAN CONSULATE, TEHRAN

segments.text: CHARGE OF SOUTH AFRICAN CONSULATE GENERAL IN TEHRAN CONTACTED EMBASSY MORNING 20 NOVEMBER AND REQUESTED FOLLOWING MESSAGE BE PASSED TO HIS FOREIGN MINISTRY IN PRETORIA: : TO SECRETARY FOR FOREIGN AFFAIRS. ATTENTION: MR. HUGO, (SECTION 7). ALL TELEGRAPHIC AND TELEPHONIC COMMUNICATIONS ARE ON STRIKE FOR INDEFINITE PERIOD. WILL ENDEAVOR CONTACT PRETORIA AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. SUNDE. UNQUOTE. SULLIVAN NOTE: UPGRADED TO CONFIDENTIAL PER TIM TAYLOR OC/NEA & MR LIEBAU

IN VIEW OF TENSIONS ANTICIPATED IN IRAN DURING PERIOD OF RELIGIOUS MOURNING CALLED MOHARRAM, EMBASSY REQUESTS DEPT TO REFRAIN FROM SCHEDULING ANY OFFICIAL VISITORS TO IRAN OTHER THAN THOSE ALREADY SCHEDULED DURING TWELVE DAYS BEGINNING DECEMBER 1 THROUGH DECEMBER 12.

BAZAARS AND MOST BUSINESSES WILL, IN ANY EVENT BE CLOSED DECEMBER 2 THROUGH DECEMBER 11. MONDAY, DECEMBER 11, IS ASHURA, THE DAY OF DEEPEST MOURNING, AND WE ANTICIPATE THAT NORMAL ACTIVITY THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY ON THAT DAY WILL DIMINISH TO ZERO IF CALM PREVAILS. CONVERSELY, IF CALM DISRUPTED, WE WOULD EXPECT VIOLENCE TO BE AT ITS WORST ON THAT DATE.
DEPT IS REQUESTED TO COORDINATE THIS LIMITATION WITH OTHER ELEMENTS OF EXECUTIVE BRANCH AND WITH THE LEGISLATIVE BRANCH TO PRECLUDE CONGRESSIONAL TRAVEL IN THE MOHARRAM PERIOD.

SAEED GOUDARZNIA, THE HEAD OF AMERICAS DIVISION IN FOREIGN MINISTRY, REQUESTED DCM CALL ON HIM NOVEMBER 20 CONCERNING OUR EARLIER APPROACH ON SAVAK (REFTEL). GOUDARZNIA SAID THAT HE WISHED TO MAKE THREE POINTS
THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS HAS ADVISED SAVAK TO OBEY U.S. LAWS IN ALL OF ITS ACTIVITIES IN THE U.S.
THE GOI WOULD APPRECIATE MORE SPECIFIC INFORMATION ON WHAT U.S. LAWS SAVAK HAS ALLEGEDLY TRANSGRESSED IN THE U.S.
DOES THE USG HAVE FURTHER INFORMATION ON WHO PAID THE ANTI-SHAH DEMONSTRATORS? IS THIS ISSUE ALSO BEING PURSUED AS VIGOROUSLY BY U.S. AUTHORITIES AS IS PAYMENT TO THE PRO-SHAH DEMONSTRATORS?
PLEASE ADVISE.

EMBASSY TEHRAN REQUESTS ENGLISH TRANSLATION OF FULL TEXT OF ESKANDARI STATEMENT (REFTEL). SUMMARY PROVIDED BY REFTEL WAS GIVEN TO IRANIANS. HIGHEST LEVELS CONCERNED THAT ESKANDARI STATEMENT MAY MARK CHANGE IN SOVIET POSTURE TO MORE ACTIVE MEDDLING IN CURRENT IRANIAN TROUBLES.

FOLLOWING IS THE ADVISORY USED WHEN AMERICANS ASK FOR GUIDANCE. "WE BELIEVE THAT AMERICANS CAN PLAN ON GOING ABOUT THEIR NORMAL ACTIVITIES. THEY SHOULD, HOWEVER, SHOW APPROPRIATE CAUTION, AVOID CROWDS, AND BE PARTICULARLY ALERT IN SOUTHERN AREAS OF THE CITY." THIS ADVICE HAS BEEN IN USE SINCE NOVEMBER 12. WE OF COURSE WATCH SCENE DAILY WITH GREAT CARE AND WILL CHANGE THE ADVISORY WHENEVER THIS APPEARS NECESSARY. CERTAINLY, AS WE APPROACH THE MOHARRAM PERIOD, WE SHALL BE ISSUING NEW ADVISORIES.

WE HAVE ESTABLISHED AN INFORMATION CENTER IN THE EMBASSY WHICH HAS OFFICERS (EMBASSY AND MAAG) ON DUTY FROM 0730 HOURS TO ROUGHLY 1900 HOURS. THIS CENTER HAS FOUR EXTENSIONS AND WE ARE NOW IN A MUCH BETTER POSITION TO HANDLE THE FLURRY OF CALLS ASKING FOR ADVICE OR PASSING INFORMATION AND RUMORS TO US.

DCM AND COUNSELORS FOR ADMINISTRATIONS AND CONSULAR AFFAIRS HAVE STARTED PROCESS OF MEETING WITH GROUPS OF CONTRACTORS TO DISCUSS GENERAL SITUATION IN FOLLOW-UP TO AMBASSADOR'S MEETING WITH CONTRACTORS LAST WEEK. THE MEETING LASTED ALMOST TWO HOURS AND WE DO NOT HAVE THE RESOURCES AT THIS TIME TO TRANSCRIBE THE AMBASSADOR'S COMMENTS AND THE QUESTIONS AND ANSWERS THAT FOLLOWED. WE ARE POUCHING TAPE TO YOU TODAY VIA UNCLASSIFIED POUCH NO. BR-10354, INVOICE NO. --255 DATED NOVEMBER 20.

1978TEHRAN11387.subject: ROK INQUIRY ABOUT SITUATION IN TEHRAN

segments.text: INTERRUPTION IN TELEPHONE AND TELETYPE COMMUNICATIONS IS A RESULT OF CONTINUING STRIKE/WORK SLOW-DOWN BY THE TELECOMMUNICATIONS COMPANY OF IRAN. WE ARE TRANSMITTING URGENT MESSAGES FOR KOREAN EMBASSY HERE. TO THE BEST OF OUR KNOWLEDGE KOREANS IN COUNTRY ARE SAFE.

SUMMARY: EMPRESS RETURNS FROM IRAQ AFTER VISIT TO AYATOLLAH KHOI. RADIO AND PRESS REPORT 210 POLITICAL PRISONERS FREED; ISLAMIC PAPER APPEARS; BLAMES IRAN'S TROUBLES ON BAHAIS. AYATOLLAH TALEQANI CALLS FOR CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY AFTER OVERTHROW OF REGIME, BUT SAYS CLERGY ARE NOT RPT NOT CALLING FOR MASS UPRISING. PROVINCIAL SCENE RELATIVELY QUIET, THOUGH ONE DEATH REPORTED IN DEMONSTRATIONS NOV 19 IN MASHAD. MINOR SCUFFLES IN ISFAHAN REPORTED, BUT EMBASSY IS UNABLE TO CONFIRM DETAILS. RURAL TRANQUILITY MARKS INTERESTING CONTRAST TO CONCERN IN CITIES. END SUMMARY.

MEDIA EVENING NOV 19 REPORTED RETURN OF EMPRESS FARAH FROM SHORT ONE-DAY VISIT TO IRAQ (REFTEL). WHILE THERE, SHE PAID CALL ON AYATOLLAH KHOI, CONSIDERED SENIOR SHIA AYATOLLAH BY MANY. IN PRESS COMMENT ON HER RETURN, EMPRESS WAS QUOTED AS SAYING IRAN WAS PASSING THROUGH TIME OF PROBLEMS, BUT MANY OTHER COUNTRIES HAVE DONE SO, AND IRAN HOPES TO RESOLVE ITS DIFFICULTIES. SHE SAID IRAQ AND IRAN CONTINUE TO HAVE GOOD RELATIONS, AND THAT SHE "DID NOT FEEL A STRANGER" DURING HER VISIT. (COMMENT: CALL ON KHOI, WHILE VIRTUALLY OBLIGATORY, SOUNDS TO US LIKE DISCREET ROYAL POLITICKING AMONG SENIOR SHIAS.)

NIRT IN PERSIAN AND LOCAL PERSIAN TEARSHEET NEWSPAPER FLAME (ATESH) REPORTED NOV 20 THAT GOI HAD RELEASED 210 POLITICAL PRISONERS YESTERDAY BUT DID NOT HAVE NAMES FOR PUBLICATION. RELEASE CONFIRMED BY EYEWITNESS. ISLAMIC PAPER "STAR OF ISLAM" MADE INITIAL APPEARANCE NOV 20. ENTIRE CONTENTS OF FOUR-PAGE SHEET WERE DEVOTED TO LAYING BLAME FOR IRAN'S PRESENT TROUBLES ON BAHAIS.

EMBASSY HAS OBTAINED COPY OF AYATOLLAH TALEQANI STATEMENT ISSUED ABOUT NOV 10 (BEING POUCHED DEPT) WHICH SAYS, INTER ALIA, THAT THE PEOPLE OF IRAN ARE FIGHTING FOR THE OVERTHROW OF NOT JUST THE SHAH BUT ALL DYNASTIES. HE SAYS AFTER SHAH'S DEMISE, CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY WILL BE ESTABLISHED TO HOLD FREE ELECTIONS AND ESTABLISH A NEW CONSTITUTION BASED ON TENETS OF ISLAM. CLERGY ARE NOT CALLING FOR ARMED UPRISING, BECAUSE "FOR THE TIME BEING, HOWEVER, THE RELIGIOUS AND SECULAR OPPOSITION ARE TRYING TO BRING DOWN THE REGIME WITH 'MINIMUM BLOODSHED'." TALEQANI NOTES THAT SECTIONS OF THE SHAH'S ARMED FORCES INCLUDING TOP MILITARY OFFICERS WOULD BACK ANY ARMED INSURRECTION.

(COMMENT: THIS IS FIRST TIME TO OUR KNOWLEDGE THAT LOCAL BROADSIDE HAS REFERRED TO POSSIBILITY OF ARMED STRUGGLE AND SUGGESTED THAT PARTS OF ARMY WOULD NOT BE LOYAL. IN TEHRAN SECURITY SCENE HAS BEEN RELATIVELY QUIET, WITH LOCAL OFFICIALS MONITORING GRADE SCHOOL SCENE NOV 20. DESPITE YESTERDAY'S DISTURBANCES, SHIRAZ IS QUIET NOV 20. AND US CONSULATE REPORTS VIRTUALLY ALL ELEMENTARY SCHOOLS IN THE CITY ARE NOW OPEN. IN ISFAHAN, THERE WERE TWO OR THREE DISTURBANCES AFTERNOON OF NOV 19, BUT EMBASSY CANNOT ELABORATE ON DETAILS BECAUSE OF DIFFICULTY WITH TRUNK TELEPHONES TO ISFAHAN. MASHAD SAW DEMONSTRATIONS NOV 19 AS WELL, AND TEHRAN RADIO IN PERSIAN REPORTED ONE DEMONSTRATOR WAS KILLED.

EMBOFF WHO VISITED TWO SMALLER VILLAGES TO EAST OF TEHRAN IN COMPANY WITH LOCAL FRIENDS ON IO-E-GHADIR HOLIDAY NOV 19 WAS STRUCK BY RURAL UNCONCERN WITH WHAT WAS HAPPENING IN TEHRAN AND REST OF COUNTRY. OPINIONS EXPRESSED RAN GAMUT OF MILD HOPE THAT GOI COULD RESTABLISH ORDER IN CITIES TO BELIEF THAT SHAH OUGHT TO "DO SOMETHING" ABOUT PRESENT SITUATION. RELAXED HOLIDAY ATMOSPHERE AND APPARENT LACK OF INTEREST IN MILITARY GOVERNMENT, WHICH HAD NOT YET AFFECTED VILLAGE LIFE, CONTRAST RATHER SURPRISINGLY WITH MORE CONCERNED ATMOSPHERE OF CITIES.

(COMMENT: WHILE WE WOULD NOT TAKE THIS ONE VIGNETTE AS EVIDENCE OF RURAL PEACE, IT IS AN INTERESTING REMINDER THAT BULK OF POPULACE OUTSIDE CITIES MAY NOT SHARE EVOLVING POLITICAL BELIEFS OF URBAN SCENE.)
I TOLD SHAH I HAD BEEN INSTRUCTED TO ASK FOR HIS ASSESSMENT AND VIEWS ON SOVIET MOTIVATIONS AND APPROACH. SHAH, WHO WAS VERY SUBDUED AND SOLEMN, SAID HE THOUGHT SOVIET MOTIVATIONS WERE VERY CLEAR.

HE SAID HE ASSUMED SOVIETS, LIKE HIMSELF, HAD BEEN STRUCK BY HAMILTON JORDAN'S REFERENCE TO CONTINGENCIES UNQUOTE, AND ASSUMED THESE CONTINGENCIES WOULD INVOLVE U.S. MILITARY ACTION. SUMMARY: AFTER LITTLE MORE THAN TWO WEEKS ON THE JOB, THE AZHARI GOVT HAS RESTORED A SURPRISING DEGREE OF SECURITY IN TEHRAN AND KEY IRANIAN CITIES ALTHOUGH MUCH REMAINS TO BE DONE BEFORE LAW AND ORDER CAN BE SAID TO BE RESTORED COMPLETELY. GOVT HAS ACHIEVED A MEASURE OF SUCCESS IN GETTING KEY STRIKERS BACK TO WORK, THOUGH THAT TASK IS NOT COMPLETE AND MANY SERIOUS WEAKNESSES REMAIN IN THE GOVT SECTOR, PARTICULARLY IN THE KEY ECONOMIC MINISTRIES. IT HAS JUST BEGUN TO TACKLE THE PROBLEM OF REOPENING SCHOOLS, AND DONE NOTHING TO REOPEN UNIVERSITIES.

IT IS NOT PERTURBED BY -- PROBABLY WELCOMES -CONTINUING PRESS STRIKES WHICH HAVE REMOVED ALL IMPORTANT NEWSPAPERS FROM THE NEWSTANDS, THUS FACILITATING GOI CENSORSHIP. IT HAS FIELDED A STRONG TEAM -- 18 CIVILIANS AND 6 MILITARY -- WHO ARE FOR THE MOST PART TECHNICALLY COMPETENT AND GENERALLY DO NOT BEAR STIGMA OF ASSOCIATION WITH SHAH'S PERSONAL REGIME OF PAST 15 YEARS. WE EXPECT GOVT TO STAY IN POWER AT LEAST THROUGH MOHARRAM (DECEMBER) WHEN THE CRITICAL TEST OF STRENGTH WITH THE OPPOSITION IS EXPECTED.

ASSUMING HE WEATHERS THAT TEST, THE SHAH INTENDS TO INTENSIFY HIS SEARCH FOR A SUCCESSOR CIVILIAN GOVT, PERHAPS OF A COALITION NATURE WITH ELEMENTS OF THE OPPOSITION. SUCH A GOVT WOULD PRESUMABLY SEEK TO LIFT MARTIAL LAW ONCE THE LEVEL OF VIOLENCE SUBSIDED (PERHAPS NOT UNTIL AFTER THE RELIGIOUS MONTH OF SAFAR -- JANUARY -- OR LATER), AND MOVE TO ELECTIONS. END SUMMARY

AFTER A LITTLE MORE THAN TWO WEEKS OF MILITARY GOVERNMENT, AND WITH ITS SUBMISSION TO PARLIAMENT FOR APPROVAL, THIS SEEMS A GOOD TIME FOR PRELIMINARY ESTIMATE IN RESPONSE TO DEPT'S REQUEST, REFTEL. OUR COMMENTS ARE PEGGED MAINLY TO QUESTIONS ASKED BY REFTEL, AND USUAL CAVEATS ON FAST-CHANGING SITUATION CONTINUE TO APPLY.

LAW AND ORDER. SINCE INSTALLATION OF AZHARI GOVT SECURITY CONDITIONS HAVE GENERALLY IMPROVED BOTH IN TEHRAN AND IN THE PROVINCES. IT SHOULD BE RECALLED THAT VIOLENCE IN PROVINCES HAD REACHED LEVEL OF 42 OR MORE CITIES ON A SINGLE DAY JUST PRIOR TO NOV 5. IT HAS NOW BEEN REDUCED TO ONLY A HANDFUL OF PROVINCIAL CITIES ON ANY GIVEN DAY. THIS IS A RELATIVE IMPROVEMENT. ALL INDICATIONS ARE TROOPS CONTINUE TO OPERATE UNDER INSTRUCTIONS NOT TO GET TOO TOUGH, AND IN PARTICULAR TO MINIMIZE SHOOTING AT DEMONSTRATORS.

THIS ATTITUDE IS AFFECTED BY FACT THAT IN TEHRAN AND SOME OTHER LARGE CITIES WOMEN AND CHILDREN HAVE BEEN IN FOREFRONT OF DEMONSTRATING CROWDS, AND THERE IS RELUCTANCE ON THE PART OF THE GOVT AND THE AUTHORITIES TO CAUSE TOO MANY CASUALTIES AMONG THEM.

STRIKES. GOI SEEMS TO REALIZE THAT GETTING STRIKERS BACK TO WORK IS A GRADUAL PROCESS IN WHICH STICK AND CARROT ARE BOTH NEEDED. OF MAJOR STRIKES EXISTING WHEN IT TOOK OVER, GOI HAS PRETTY WELL SOLVED IRAN AIR WALKOUT AND MANY OF THE STRIKES AMONG CIVIL SERVANTS (THE CUSTOMS SERVICE AND TAX ADMINISTRATION BEING EXCEPTIONS). WHILE SITUATION IN OIL SECTOR IS SHOWING ENCOURAGING PROGRESS, SIGNIFICANT NUMBERS OF HARD CORE STRIKERS (PERHAPS 15 PERCENT) STILL HAVE NOT RETURNED TO WORK, AND WE RECEIVE CONTINUING REPORTS THAT OTHERS HAVE OFFICIALLY ENDED THEIR STRIKE BUT ARE NOT WORKING VERY HARD.

MOREOVER, THE HARD CORE ARE STILL TRYING TO INTIMIDATE THEIR WORKING COLLEAGUES, AND THERE COULD BE SOME SLIPPAGE. THE SHAH HAS TOLD THE AMBASSADOR HE IS NOT PRESSING OIL WORKERS TOO HARD, SO AS NOT TO EXACERBATE TENSIONS OR INTERFERE WITH RETURNING DEGREE OF NORMALCY BEFORE MONTH OF MOHARRAM, TWO WEEKS HENCE. WITH PRODUCTION RISING, WE JUDGE GOI PERFORMANCE IN OIL STRIKE NOT TOO BAD.

CIVIL SERVANTS. MILITARY GOVT HAS BEEN CONCEIVED FROM FIRST AS A TEMPORARY EXPEDIENT. ITS SINGLE PURPOSE IS TO RESTORE LAW AND ORDER AND A DEGREE OF NORMALCY, AFTER WHICH IT WILL TURN GOVT BACK TO COALITION OF CIVILIANS -- IF SHAH IS ABLE TO FORM SUCH A GOVT. UNDER THE CIRCUMSTANCES, IT WOULD NOT BE REALISTIC TO EXPECT TOP IRANIAN POLITICANS TO ENTER MILITARY GOVT. IN FACT, AZHARI HAS NOT PARTICULARLY SOUGHT SUCH PEOPLE. HE HAS TAKEN A NUMBER OF SHARIF-EMAMI'S APPOINTEES AND ADDED TOP CIVIL SERVANTS WITH TECHNICAL QUALIFICATIONS IN THEIR PARTICULAR MINISTRIES.

MANY OF THEM ARE OF HIGH REPUTE IN THEIR FIELDS, EVEN THOUGH NOT IN THE GOVERNMENTAL SPOTLIGHT IN RECENT YEARS (A FACTOR IN THEIR FAVOR). THERE ARE MANY, HOWEVER, WHO WELCOMED ITS INSTALLATION AT A TIME WHEN IT LOOKED LIKE THE ONLY ALTERNATIVE WAS LAWLESSNESS AND CHAOS. PEOPLE BELIEVE OR DISBELIEVE THE SHAH'S ASSERTIONS THAT THIS IN ONLY A TEMPORARY EXPEDIENT, DEPENDING ON WHERE THEIR POLITICAL SYMPATHIES LIE. AS OUR PROJECTION OF PROBLEMS MILITARY GOVT WOULD BRING INDICATED (TEHRAN 10706) THERE IS A PRICE TO BE PAID WHICH WILL INCREASE THE LONGER THIS MILITARY GOVT REMAINS IN POWER.

THIS IS TRUE EVEN THOUGH THREE QUARTERS OF THE MINISTERS ARE CIVILIANS. THERE IS LITTLE DOUBT THAT THE GOVT IS CARRYING OUT A HOLDING OPERATION WITH A VIEW TO A REAL SHOWDOWN DURING THE MONTH OF MOHARRAM. THE SHAH HAS MADE IT CLEAR TO THE AMBASSADOR THAT THE AZHARI GOVT REFERS ALMOST ALL ISSUES FOR DECISION TO HIM. AS LONG AS THE SHAH MAINTAINS THE INTENTION OF MOVING TO A COALITION GOVT AND FREE ELECTIONS, THE MILITARY GOVT SHOULD NOT INPEDE AN EVENTUAL POLITICAL SOLUTION.

IT IS TRUE THAT THE OPPOSITION RESENTS THE PRESENT GOVT, AND SERIOUS BLOODSHED DURING THE MONTH OF MOHARRAM MIGHT FURTHER REDUCE THE OPPOSITION'S READINESS TO ENTER A COALITION. HOWEVER, THINGS HAD COME TO A CROSSROADS ON NOV 5 WHICH REQUIRED MEASURES TO RESTORE LAW AND ORDER, OR SUBMISSION OF THE DEMANDS OF THE OPPOSITION LED BY ATYATOLLAYH KHOMEINI WHICH HAD BEEN MOVING FROM VICTORY TO VICTORY AND WHICH STILL EXPECTS TO TOPPLE THE SHAH DURING MOHARRAM. IF THE MILITARY ARE ABLE TO BLUNT THAT EXPECTATION OF VICTORY THIS WOULD PROBABLY CONTRIBUTE TO AN EVENTUAL WILLINGNESS BY THE OPPOSITION TO SETTLE FOR SOMETHING LESS.

IF THE INEVITABILITY OF KHOMEINI'S VICTORY BEGINS TO RECEDE IN PEOPLES' MINDS AND THE BANDWAGON EFFECT IS REVERSED, A NEW GOVT COULD POSSIBLY BE INSTALLED AND BENEFIT BY A CONTRAST IN ITS OWN IDENTITY FROM THAT OF THE MILITARY. THIS GOVT WOULD HAVE TO BE COMPOSED ENTIRELY OF PEOPLE WHO HAVE NOT BEEN ASSOCIATED WITH THE SHAH'S GOVT OVER THE PAST 15 OR 20 YEARS. IT MIGHT OR MIGHT NOT INCLUDE PROMINENT MEMBERS OF THE NATIONAL FRONT OPPOSITION.

SIMILARLY, ALTHOUGH KHOMEINI HAD DEMANDED THAT THE BAZAARS STAY CLOSED, THE TEHRAN BAZAAR HAS OPENED FULLY FROM NOVEMBER 20 WITH THE SANCTION OF SCORES OF LOCAL MULLAHS.

ON THE OTHER HAND, OTHER STRIKES, PARTICULARLY IN GOVT MINISTRIES, CONTINUE UNABATED BECAUSE SHAH AND PRIME MINISTER DO NOT WANT TO BE "PROVOCATIVE" BY WITHHOLDING SALARIES OF STRIKERS. IN THIS AMBIGUOUS SITUATION, THERE IS ANTICIPATION OF FURTHER STRIKES IN PUBLIC UTILITIES, ETC., DURING MOHARRAM.

THE QUESTION OF THE IMPERIAL STYLE AT THIS JUNCTURE IS ALSO RELEVANT TO THE SHAH'S EFFORTS TO OPEN A DIALOGUE FOR THE FORMATION OF A COALITION NATIONAL GOVT AFTER THE PASSAGE OF MOHARRAM. HE FEELS THAT ANY FLAMBOYANCE ON HIS PART WILL SCARE OFF THOSE MODERATE OPPOSITION POLITICIANS WHOM HE WISHES TO ENLIST IN AN EFFORT TO GIVE A COALITION CREDIBILITY. HE FEELS THESE MEN WILL NEED THE COURAGE TO BREAK WITH KHOMEINI (HOPEFULLY AFTER THE NATION IGNORES THE MULLAH'S CALL FOR MARTYRDOM DURING MOHARRAM) AND ALSO THE CONFIDENCE THAT THE SHAH REALLY WILL ADOPT A "CONSTITUTIONAL" RATHER THAN AN "IMPERIAL" ROLE WITH SUCH A COALITION.
THIS IS A FURTHER REASON FOR HIS MORE HUMBLE DEMEANOR.

YOU MAY BE ASSURED THAT, IN ALL OUR CONTACTS WITH THE OPPOSITION, REPRESENTATIVES OF THIS EMBASSY STRESS OUR CONVICTION THAT THE SHAH MUST REMAIN AND THAT THE ULTIMATE SOLUTION MUST BE WITHIN THE CONSTITUTION. THE FACT THAT, DESPITE THIS ADAMANT POSITION ON OUR PART, THE OPPOSITION DEEPS COMING BACK TO US WITH EVER-DINIMISHING DEMANDS SUGGESTS THAT THEY DO NOT BELIEVE IN THE REALITY OF THEIR OWN EXTREME POSITIONS AND WOULD BE PREPARED ULTIMATELY TO ACCEPT THE CONDITIONS WE POSE.

I BELIEVE THE SHAH WILL CONTINUE HIS PATTERN OF CANDID CONSULTATION WITH ME AND PROBABLY ALSO WITH THE BRITISH AMBASSADOR, WHO IS AN OLD HAND HERE. I ALSO BELIEVE THAT HE ACCEPTS THE FACT THAT HE ALONE CAN MAKE THE DECISIONS NEEDED TO FORMA GOVT WHICH WOULD LEAD TO RATIONAL POLITICAL SOLUTIONS ONCE HE WEATHERS MOHARRAM.

I WILL, OF COURSE, CONVEY WHATEVER MESSAGE WASHINGTON FEELS SHOULD BE MADE AT THIS JUNCTURE. HOWEVER, YOU SHOULD KNOW THAT HIS DECISION TO ADOPT A LESS THAN COMMANDING LEADERSHIP POSTURE IS ONE THAT IS RATIONALLY THOUGHT OUT IN TERMS OF HIS PERCEPTIONS OF PERSIAN PSYCHOLOGY AND DOES NOT DERIVE FROM TOTAL FUNK OR DIFFIDENCE. THE SHAH KNOWS THAT ZAHEDI FEELS HE SHOULD ACT OTHERWISE, BUT HAS REJECTED HIS ADVICE. GIVEN THE FACT THAT THE SHAH HAS SURVIVED THIRTY-SEVEN YEARS BY ACCURATELY GAUGING THE INSTINCTS OF HIS PEOPLE, I FEEL WE HAVE TO GIVE SIGNIFICANT RESPECT TO HIS JUDGMENT THIS TIME.

SUMMARY: IN SECOND MEETING WITH EMBASSY OFFICERS, GROUP OF BAZAAR LEADERS SHOWED DEGREE OF INDEPENDENCE FROM KHOMEINI AND WILLINGNESS AT LEAST TO PRESENT THEIR CASE TO HIM IF GOVT GIVES THEM EVIDENCE IN ITS DEEDS THAT IT IS PREPARED TO MEET A MAJOR PART OF THEIR DEMANDS. IT WOULD APPEAR THEY AND OTHER BAZAARIS REOPENED TEHRAN BAZAAR NOV 20 ON THEIR OWN, RISKING THE DISPLEASURE OF KHOMEINI. THEY EXPRESSED FRIENDSHIP FOR U.S., GRATITUDE FOR PRESIDENT CARTER'S HUMAN RIGHTS PROGRAM, AND A DESIRE TO COOPERATE IN TRYING FOR A MODERATE SOLUTION TO IRAN'S CURRENT PROBLEMS. END SUMMARY

EMBOFFS HAD FOLLOW-UP MEETING WITH BAZAARIS AT INTERMEDIARY'S HOUSE NOV 21. THIS TIME HAJ KARIM HOSSEINI AND HAJ MOHAMMED TAGHIE ETTEFAH BROUGHT A DIFFERENT THIRD MEMBER OF THE GROUP, HAJ AHMAD POURGHADIRI ESFAHANI. ETTEFAH DID MOST OF THE TALKING FOR THE GROUP.

AFTER INITIAL WARMUP, IT BECAME EVIDENT THESE BAZAARIS ARE ACTIVELY TRYING TO MODERATE EVENTS SAS TO PREVENT THE CONSEQUENCES OF A LASTING POLARIZATION BETWEEN SUPPORTERS OF THE SHAH AND SUPPORTERS OF KHOMEINI. KNOWING VARIETY OF COMPLAINTS PEOPLE HAVE AGAINST THE SHAH HIS GOVERNMENTS OF RECENT YEARS, ETTEFAH NEVERTHELESS CONFIDED HE IS PREPARED TO TRAVEL TO PARIS AND PLEAD WITH KHOMEINI IF HE IS GIVEN SOME CONCRETE EVIDENCE OF THE GOVERNMENS READINESS TO MODIFY VARIOUS POLICIES AND RIGHT VARIOUS WRONGS. HE ALSO CONFIDED TO US THAT THIS GROUP OF BAZAARIS HAD RECENTLY MET WITH AN UNNAMED MEMBER OF THE AZHARI GOVT W PROMISED TO HELP THEM.
ETTEFAH IS PREPARED TO TRAVEL AS EARLY AS NEXT WEEK, SECRETELY, IF HE IS GIVEN SUFFICIENT JUSIFICATION.

ASKED WHAT KINDS OF THINGS THESE BAZAARIS WANTED FROM THE GOVERNMENT AT THIS TIME (SOMETHING ON WHICH CONSIDERABLE DISCUSSION HAD TAKEN PALCE AT THE FIRST MEETING, SEE REFTEL), ETTEFAH LISTED SEVERAL.

FIRST, GOVERNMENT SHOULD "STOP KILLING PEOPLE." WHEN WE NOTED SUCH KILLING TAKES PLACE IN REACTION TO MASS DEMONSTRATIONS, HE, AND THE INTERMEDIARY, NOTED HOW OFTEN NOTHING IS DONE BY POLICE OR TROOPS WHEN PEOPLE ARE BEGINNING TO GATHER FOR A DEMONSTRATION, BUT THE GROUP IS ALLOWED TO GROW TO PROPORTIONS WHERE CLASH OCCURS AND PEOPLE ARE KILLED. BAZAARIS SUSPECT THIS IS A CONSCIOUS GOVERNMENT POLICY. IF IT IS NOT, GOVERNMENT SHOULD HAVE THE CAPABILITY TO MONITOR SUCH GROUPS EARLY ON AND BREAK THEM UP WITH WATER OR TEAR GAS RATHER THAN SHOOTING.

SECOND, SOME OF THESE PROMINENT PEOPLE SUCH AS SAVAK'S GENERAL NASSIRI AND FORMER MINISTER OF INFORMATION HOMAYOUN SHOULD BE QUESTIONED AND BROUGHT SPEEDILY TO TRIAL NOW THAT THEY ARE ARRESTED. GROUP THOUGHT SUFFICIENT LAWS EXIST AND SPECIAL NEW COURTS ARE NOT NECESSARY. GOVERNMENT MOVES WITH GREAT SPEED IN QUESTIONING ITS OPPONENTS. SLOWNESS IN THIS CASE IS JUST AN EXCUSE. AFTER ALL, EVERYBODY KNOWS IT WAS HOMAYOUNS ARTICLE IN ETELAAT ATTACKING KHOMEINI IN JANUARY WHICH SET OFF THE SPARK OF THE RELIGIOUS REACTION. HOMAYOUN IS THEREBY RESPONSIBLE FOR A LOT OF DEATHS AND SHOULD ANSSER FOR THEM.

THIRD, LAND REFORM WAS NOT CARRIED OUT PROPERLY AND HAS KILLED AGRICULTURE. SOME CHANGES IN THESE LAWS ARE NECESSARY. BAZAARIS CONFIDED THAT A GROUP IN THE BAZAAR IS WORKING ON PROPOSED CHANGES TO THESE LAWS AND TO OTHERS.

FOURTH, A WIDE VARIETY OF RULES AND REGULATIONS HAVE ------------------016407 221858Z /64 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1772 INFO USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY PARIS SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 11499 LIMDIS BEEN IMPOSED WHICH IMPEDE BUSINESS AND HAND WINDFALL PROFITS TO THE FEW WHO HAVE BEEN GRANTED MONOPOLIES BY THE GOVERNMENT. EVEN RELIGIOUS LAWS ARE OVERLOOKED. BUTCHERS ARE FORCED TO BUY FROZEN MEAT FROM ABROAD WHICH HAS NOT BEEN SLAUGHTERED IN THE PRESCRIBED MOSLEM WAY.

IT WOULD ACUTALLY COST NO MORE, EVEN LESS, TO IMPORT SHEEP ON THE HOOF FROM NEIGHBORING COUNTRIES SUCH AS TURKEY, WHICH HAS A SURPLUS FOR EXPORT, AND SLAUGHTER THE SHEEP HERE, BUT THE GOVERNMENT DOES NOT ALLOW IT. SUCH REGULATION SHOULD BE ABOLISHED.

FIFTH, THE GOVERNMENT, EXPECIALLY SAVAK, MUST STOP ACTING SO BADLY WITH THE ULEMA. THEY PULL IN RELIGIOUS LEADERS FOR QUESTIONING ON THE SLIGHTEST PRETEXT AND TREAT THEM BADLY. JUST THE OTHER DAY, A RELIGIOUS LEADER WHO WAS RETURNING FROM A VISIT WITH KHOMEINI IN PARIS WAS ARRESTED AS HE GOT OFF THE PLANE. HE HAS NOW BEEN FREED, AFTER MUCH INTVERVENTION ON HIS BEHALF, BUT HE NEVER SHOULD HAVE BEEN ARRESTED.

SIXTH, THE NEWSPAPERS WHICH HAVE BEEN REAPPEARING RECENTLY (AFTER A FIVE-YEAR ABSENCE) SUCH AS "ATESH" AND OTHERS SHOULD NOT BE ALLOWED TO PUBLISH. THEY WRITE ANTYTHING PEOPLE PAY THEM TO WRITE AND THEY AGGRAVATE T MASSES. THIS IS NOT HELPFUL AT THE PRESENT TIME.

AT THAT POINT HOSSEINI AND ETTEFAH TOGETHER SAID THEY WISHED TO TAKE THE OPPORTUNITY TO SAI THEY LIKE AMERICANS AND THANKS AMERICANS FOR THE HELP THEY HAVE GIEVEN TO IRAN. THEY THANKED PRESIDENT CARTER FOR HIS EMPHASIS ON HUMAN RIGHTS. THEY WONDERED IF THEY COULD COUNT ON COOPERATION WITH AMERICANS. POL COUNS EXPRESSED GRATITUDE AND SAID COOPERATION WAS EXACTLY WHAT WE ALSO HAD IN MIND AND WHAT WE ARE IN THEPROCESS OF DOING IN THIS CONVERSATION. HE THEN ASKED THE GROUP ABOUT REPORTS THAT BEGINNING OF MOHARRAM WILL BRING SERIOUS SECURITY PROBLEMS TO THE COUNTRY. ETTEFAH AND HOSSEINI IMMEDIATELY DENIED THIS.

THEY SAID OPPOSITION EXTREMISTS ARE THREATENING AN EXPLOSIVE SITUATION IN DECEMBER IN REACTION TO GOVERNMENT THREATS TO CLOSE THE MOSQUES. GOVERNMENT SHOULD NOT CLOSE THE MOSQUES AND SHOULD KEEP COOL. BAZAARIS HAVE SENT A MESSAGE TO THE GOVERNMENT THAT IT SOULD APPROACH LEADERS OF VARIOUS SECTORS OF IRANIAN SOCIETY (BAZZARIS, STUDENTS, ETC.) AND ASK THAT THEY KEEP THEIR FOLLOWERS UNDER CONTROL. BAZAARIS CAN DO THIS FOR THEIR OWN FOLLOWERS. THEY PLAN TO KEEP BAZAAR OPEN DURING MOHARRAM--IF GOVERNMENT DOES NOT PROVOKE TROUBLE--EXCEPT FOR SIX DAYS DECEMBER 8-13, AROUND ASHURA. THEY DESCRIBED AS "LIES" THREATS OF TROUBLE MADE BY OPPOSITION SPOKESMEN SUCH AS THE YOUNGER SANJABI IN THE U.S.

ETTEFAH THEN SAID HE WOULD CONFIDE ANOTHER SECRET TO US. IF GOVERNMENT GIVES HIM SUFFICIENT EVIDENCE OF MOVING ON BAZAARIS' DEMANDS, HE IS READY TO LEAVE FOR KERBELA WITHIN A FEW DAYS AND GO ON TO PARIS TO TALK TO KHOMEINI. POL COUNS ASKED IF THE THOUGHT HE WOULD SUCCEED WITH KHOMEINI WHEN SO MANY OTHERS FAILED. POL COUNS NOTED THERE ARE OTHER BAZAARIS WHO APPEAR TO REPRESENT KHOMEINI AND ARE TAKING A HARD LINE. ETTEFAH, HOSSEINI, AND ESFAHANI REPEATED THAT THEY CONSIDERED GOING TO KHOMEINI TO BE THEIR DUTY. BAZAARIS' MONEY IS GONE.
THEY WILL PRESS KHOMEINI TO ACCEPT A SHAH WHO IS OPERATING WITHIN THE CONSTITUTION AND STOP SENDING HIS INFLAMMATORY MESSAGES TO IRAN.

IN A SEPARATE SMALL MEETING AFTERWARD, HOSSEINI, ETTEFAH, AND THE INTERMEDIARY SAID THEY WOULD LIKE TO CALL ON THE SHAH, AND ASKED OUR ASSISTANCE IN ARRANGING THIS. POL COUNS SAID HE WOULD HAVE TO REFER THIS REQUEST TO THE AMBASSADOR. AFTER DOING SO THE NEXT DAY, HE IS PASSING MESSAGE BACK THAT WE KNOW ALI AMINI (WHOM THESE BAZAARIS THINK WELL OF) IS PLANNING TO MEET WITH BAZAARI REPRESENTATIVES IN NEXT DAYS AND HAS BEEN ENTRUSTED BY THE SHAH WITH AN INTERMEDIARY ROLE.

INCIDENTALLY, EMBASSY TRANSLATIONS OF FLYERS IN FARSI ISSUED IN TEHRAN NOV 15 INDICATE THAT REOPENING OF BAZAAR NOV 20 WAS CALLED FOR BY OVER 80 LOCAL RELIGIOUS LEADERS RATHER THAN BY KHOMEINI. FLYER SAYS OPENING IS TO BE UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE. THIS SUPPORTS POSITION TAKEN BY BAZAARIS WITH US AND SUGGESTS A GROWING WILLINGNESS BY BAZAAR AND RELIGIOUS LEADERS TO PROTECT THEIR OWN INTERESTS EVEN AT THE RISK OF DISPLEASING AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI. THIS PROCESS HAS NOT GONE VERY FAR YET, HOWEVER, AND THERE IS DOUBT IN OUR MINDS AS TO HOW FAR IT CAN GO BEFORE THE ONSET OF MOHARRAM.

MINATCHI SAID THE COALITION GOVERNMENT WOULD THEN ORGANIZE NATIONAL ELECTIONS FOR JUNE, AFTER WHICH PARLIAMENT WOULD CALL A CONSTITUTIONAL CONVENTION TO DISCUSS AMENDING THE CONSTITUTION AND THE FUTURE OF THE DYNASTY. EMBOFF SPECULATED WHETHER SOME OTHER METHOD OF DELIVERING MINISTERIAL MANDATE WOULD NOT ENABLE BOTH SIDES TO FINESSE PROBLEM, BUT MINATCHI SAID NO --ONLY WAY GROUP COULD GET KHOMEINI TO REMAIN SILENT AND NOT INTERFERE WITH COALITION WAS TO GET SHAH "TO ONE SIDE." MINATCHI ADDED AS AFTERTHOUGHT THAT VAST MAJORITY OF RELIGIOUS FAITHFUL AND "ALL LEADERS EXCEPT KHOMEINI" WANTED MONARCHY TO REMAIN.
