IF A SOLUTION IS NOT REACHED, MOHARRAM COULD SEE SOME UNPLEASANT INCIDENTS OR "ACCIDENTS" WHICH WOULD LEAD TO VIOLENCE WHICH WOULD SEVERELY INHIBIT ANY EFFORTS AT NATIONAL RECONCILIATION.

IN REPLY, EMBOFF SUGGESTED PERHAPS MODERATES IN IRAN MIGHT RETHINK THEIR LINKS TO KHOMEINI AND PERHAPS LEAN ON HIM TO BE MORE CONCILIATORY. MINATCHI REPLIED THAT WAS WHAT SANJABI AND BAZARGAN HAD TRIED TO DO IN PARIS; KHOMEINI WAS AFRAID OF NOTHING, NOT EVEN HIS OWN DEATH, AND SIMPLY WAS NOT YET READY TO SETTLE FOR ANYTHING LESS THAN WHAT HE WANTED. EMBOFF PROBED POSSIBILITY OF MODERATES IN COUNTRY BREAKING WITH KHOMEINI. MINATCHI SAID SECULAR POLITICIANS MIGHT EVENTUALLY BE TALKED INTO DOING SO, BUT RELIGIOUS LEADERS STILL FELT THEY COULD NOT.

MINATCHI ADDED THAT IF "ANYTHING" HAPPENED TO KHOMEINI, CONCILIATION WOULD BE IMPOSSIBLE--MODERATES LIVED IN FEAR SOMEONE WOULD TRY TO KILL KHOMEINI AND RECOUNTED STORY OF FRENCH SECURITY CHIEF FOR KHOMEINI VILLA, WHO TOLD HIM DURING PARIS VISIT THAT KHOMEINI CARED NOTHING FOR SECURITY PRECAUTIONS.

MINATCHI THEN ASKED EMBOFF IF U.S. THOUGHT HE SHOULD RESPOND TO URGING FROM SHARIF-EMAMI TO MAKE ABOVE CASE TO SHAH, DESPITE FACT (AS HE RUEFULLY ADMITTED) TWO SIDES ARE STILL TOO FAR APART FOR A DEAL. EMBOFF SAID HIS PERSONAL VIEW AS THAT CONTINUED TALK MIGHT EITHER PRODUCE NEW IDEAS OF PERHAPS NEW PERCEPTIONS, AND IN ANY CASE, TALK WAS PREFERABLE TO VIOLENCE. MINATCHI AGREED. (AFTER CHECK WITH AMBASSADOR, EMBOFF REAFFIRMED PERSONAL VIEW AS EMBASSY VIEW THAT FURTHER DISCUSSION MIGHT PROVE USEFUL AND SUGGESTED ONE OR TWO NAMES OF INTERLOCUTORS SHAH APPEARS TO ACCEPT, WHO MIGHT BE HELPFUL.)

COMMENT: MINATCHI DID NOT DEAL DIRECTLY WITH QUESTION OF SHAH'S ROLE AS COMMANDER IN CHIEF OF ARMY, BUT AGREED CONSTITUTION PROVIDED FOR SHAH IN THAT ROLE AND THAT GOAL OF GROUP WAS CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCHY. WHILE MINATCHI GROUP CLEARLY THINKING IN TERMS OF EVENTUAL CHANGE OF CONSTITUTION BY CONSTITUTIONAL CONVENTION, IT WAS CLEAR THAT THIS IS QUESTION FOR FUTURE. MINATCHI SAID QUESTION OF TRUST STILL REMAINED--OPPOSITION DID NOT TRUST SHAH. EMBOFF NOTED THAT SHAH, GOI AND ARMY LACKED CONFIDENCE IN OPPOSITION AS WELL. SOLUTION SEEMED TO BE QUESTION OF WORKING OUT STEPS WHICH BOTH SIDES COULD IMPLEMENT THAT WOULD BUILD UP MINIMUM TRUST NECESSARY TO COOPERATE FOR GOOD OF COUNTRY.

MINATCHI AGREED, BUT SAID KHOMEINI PROBLEM STILL REMAINED. THUS, IN SPITE OF INTENSE TALK OVER PAST DAYS, MINATCHI EFFORT HAS NOT ADVANCED MUCH BEYOND REFTEL. PERCEIVED TIME PRESSURES OF APPROACH OF MOHARRAM, HOWEVER, ARE BEGINNING TO WORK ON MODERATE OPPOSITION AS WELL AS GOI.

SITUATION GENERALLY QUIET AGAIN IN TEHRAN. ONE OR TWO REPORTS OF SMALL GROUPS MOVING AROUND TOWN, BUT NOTHING MAJOR. YESTERDAY'S SMALL CLASH IN BAZAAR REPORTEDLY RESULTED IN ONE MAN WOUNDED IN THE LEG. BAZAAR REMAINS OPEN (WITH PLENTY OF TROOPS IN INCIDENCE). TENSION YESTERDAY NEAR TEHRAN UNIVERSITY RESULTED IN FACULTY BEING DENIED ENTRANCE BY TROOPS (THEY HAD PREVIOUSLY ALLOWED ENTRY OF FACULTY THOUGH DENYING IT TO STUDENTS). NATIONAL UNIVERSITY HIGHER ADMINISTRATORS (CHANCELLORS AND DEAMS) HAVE BEGUN GOING TO OFFICES PAST WEEK TO TEND TO WORK BACKLOGED THOUGH NOBODY EXPECTS REOPENING OF UNIVERSITIES UNTIL NEXT SEMESTER.

CONTRARY TO SOME PRESS REPORTS, CONSUL SHIRAZ REPORTS ALL QUIET IN SHIRAZ YESTERDAY AND TODAY. WHILE ALMOST ALL STORES WERE CLOSED YESTERDAY IN THIRD DAY OF MOURNING FOR DEMONSTRATORS KILLED BY TROOPS IN THE ONE SERIOUS CLASH EARLIER THIS WEEK, MOST STORES OPEN AGAIN TODAY. SOME TROUBLE REPORTED IN ONE OR TWO SMALLER TOWNS OF FARS PROVINCE.

SELECTIVE POWER CUTS AGAIN AFFECTING TEHRAN TODAY. WHILE ARMY IS REPORTED TO BE IN CONTROL OF AT LEAST ONE POWER DISTRIBUTION FACILITY, STRIKING WORKERS OBVIOUSLY ABLE TO CONTINUE THEIR HARASSING TACKIC, WITH THREAT OF TOTAL POWER CUTOFF BY SATURDAY, NOV 25, IF THEIR (HIGHLY POLITICAL) DEMANDS NOT MET.

TELECOMMUNICATIONS STILL A PROBLEM, PARTICULARLY TELEPHONE AND TELEX CONTACT BETWEEN IRAN AND OTHER COUNTRIES. SELECTIVE STRIKE ACTION AS WELL AS SOME TECHNICAL DEGRADATION OF EQUIPMENT IS RESPONSIBLE.

SHAH ASKED WE MEET WITH HIM EVENING NOVEMBER 23 TO DISCUSS MEETING WITH YOU, BRZEZINSHI, ET ALS HAD WITH ZAHIDI. HE SAID HIS REPORTS OF MEETING SEEMED TO INDICATE THAT IT WAS BASICALLY A SESSION ON THE STATE OF HIS OWN MORALE. HE WAS SURPROSED THAT THE WHOLE "HIGH COMMAND" OF THE USA WOULD BE GATHERED FOR SUCH A PURPOSE. HE ASKED WHAT MY REPORT OF MEETING INDICATED.

I SAID I HAD NOT RECEIVED A REPORT ON THE MEETING BUT DID HAVE SOME QUESTIONS FROM YOU WHICH SUGGESTED THAT THERE HAD BEEN DISCUSSION OF A MORE VIGOROUS LEADERSHIP ROLE ON HIS PART. HE THEN REPORTED HIS VIEWS AS I HAVE CONVEYED THEM TO YOU, SAYING THAT LEADERSHIP HAD TO BE TAILORED TO THE CIRCUMSTANCES. HE SAID PEOPLE HAD TO LIVE IF IRAN TO UNDERSTAND THOSE CIRCUMSTANCES.

HE THEN SAID ZAHIDI REPORTED THAT THE "U.S. HIGH COMMAND" HAD URGED HIM TO COME BACK TO TEHRAN TO BUCK UP THE SHAH'S MORALE AND GIVE HIM ADVICE ON LEADERSHIP. SHAH INDICATED THAT HE HAD NO GREAT DESIRE TO HAVE ZAHIDI HERE DURING A DELICATE PERIOD SUCH AS MOHARRAM.

WE THEN TURNED TO DISCUSSION OF ACTION SHAH MIGHT TAKE IN CURRENT SITUATION. I MENTIONED TV APPEARANCES. HE SHRUGGED AND SAID IT WAS A QUESTION WHAT TO SAY. HE COULD NOT REPUDIATE HIS EARLIER STATEMENT BUT HE COULD NOT IMPROVE ON IT UNTIL HE COULD SHOW SOME PROGRESS TOWARDS FORMATION OF A COALITION GOVERNMENT. I SAID THAT ONE OF MY CONSULS HAD SUGGESTED PERSONAL APPEARANCES IN THE PROVINCES. HE SEEMED TO CONSIDER THIS SERIOUSLY FOR A WYILE, BUT FINALLY LET IT LIE THERE.

WITH SOME ANIMATION, HE SAID HE WOULD BE MEETING WITH UNIVERSITY REPRESENTATIVES ON SATURDAY. ONCE AGAIN, I ENCOURAGED HIM TO MEET WITH REPRESENTATIVES OF VARIOUS SECTORS OF THE BODY POLITIC. AS BEFORE, HE SEEMED TO AGREE BUT GAVE NO INDICATION HE WOULD INITIATE ACTION.

I THEN TURNED TO HIS APPARENT SUSPICION OF THE UNITED STATE , BASED ON HIS TIME MAGAZINE INTERVIEW. AGAIN, HE SHRUGGED AND SAID TIME HAD DRAMATIZED A PASSING REFERENCE HE HAD MADE. IT WAS NOT A QUESTION OF CONVINCING HIM OF OUR STEADFASTNESS, BUT RATHER OF CONVINCING SOVIETS THAT U.S. WAS STEADFAST. I SAID THE SAME THING WAS TRUE OF HIS APPEARANCE TO THE SOVIETS. IF THEY THOUGHT HE WAS FALTERING,THEY WOULD NOT HESITATE TO MOVE AGAINST HIM.

HE ACKNOWLEDGE THE POINT AND SAID THIS MIGHT EXPLAIN WHY THE ENTIRE "HIGH COMMAND" IN WASHINGTON WAS CONCERNED ABOUT HIS MORALE. IT MADE SENSE IN SUPERPOWER TERMS. I SAID IT ALSO MADE SENSE IN IRANIRAN TERMS. AGAIN, HE ACKNOWLEDGE THE POINT AND SAID HE WOULD GIVE IT FURTHER THROUGHT.

WE THEN TURNED TO DISCUSSION OF VARIOUS OTHER POINTS. I URGED ACTION TO FINISH THE STRIKES IN THE VARIOUS INDUSTRIES, MORE SUPPORT FOR U.S. TECHNICIANS WHO WERE BEING HARASSED OUT OF THEIR WORK PLACES AND MORE PREPARATION FOR CONTINGENCIES DURING MOHARRAM. HIS REACTION TO ALL THIS WAS RATHER WEARY, BUT HE UNDERTOOK TO DO HIS BEST.

FINALLY, I TALKED ABOUT OUR CONTACTS WITH THE OPPOSITION, SAYING THAT THEY SEEMED TO BE GRADUALLY MOVING TOWARDS REALITY, BUT HAD YET TO ACCEPT THE FACT THAT HE WOULD REMAIN AS SHAH IN A CONSTITUTIONAL MODE, INCLUDING COMMANDER-IN-CHIEF OF THE ARMED FORCES. I ASSURED HIM THAT ALL MY OFFICERS WERE STANDING FAST ON THAT LINE AND FOUND IT ENCOURAGING THAT THE OPPOSITION POLITICIAN DEPT GRADUALLY CREEPING IN THAT DIRECTION.

COMMENT: HE WAS BETTER IN THIS SESSION THAN IN OUR MEETING WITH BLUMENTHAL ON NOVEMBER 21. HOWEVER, HE STILL SEEMS CONVINCED THAT HIS BEST TACTIC IS TO TAKE A VERY LOW POSTURE UNTIL THE TEST OF MOHARRAM IS OVER. WE WILL HAVE ANOTHER GO WITH HIM WHEN SENATOR BYRD AND I SEE HIM NOVEMBER 27. IF YOU HAVE ANYTHING YOU WANT ME TO PUT TO HIM BEFORE THEN, PLEASE INSTRUCT. I EXPECT HUSSEIN WILL BE HERE NOV. 25.

SUMMARY: SENATE APPROVED AZHARI GOVT, 42-1. ATTEMPTED BOMBING OF BELL HELICOPTER CLINIC IN ISFAHAN NOV 23; CAR BURNED IN ISFAHAN. TEHRAN QUIET THROUGH AFTERNOON NOV 24. SOME HOSTILITY TOWARD AMERICANS IN SOUTH. END SUMMARY.
AFTER AN ADDRESS BY PRIME MINISTER AZHARI, THE IRANIAN SENATE VOTED 42-1 TO APPROVE HIS GOVERNMENT NOV 23. THIS COMPLETES CONSTITUTIONAL PARLIAMENTARY RATIFICATION PROCESS.

ABOUT 2130 EVENING NOV. 23, A BOMB CONSISTING OF THREE STICKS OF DYNAMITE IN A METAL CASE WAS DISCOVERED IN THE BELL HELICOPTER (BHI) CLINIC IN ISFAHAN. DEVICE HAD A BURNING FUSE WHICH HAD BEEN LIT AND THEN GONE OUT. POLICE TOOK BOMB AWAY AND EXPLODED IT IN VACANT LOT. SIZE OF CHARGE INDICATES SUBSTANTIAL DAMAGE AND INJURY, PERHAPS DEATH, COULD HAVE RESULTED. WARNING NOTE HAD PRECEDED EVENT BY A FEW DAYS.
IN SEPARATE ISFAHAN INCIDENT SOMEWHAT LATER IN EVENING, A TELEMEDIA EMPLOYEE'S CAR WAS COMPLETELY BURNED. CAR HAD BEEN LIGHTLY DAMAGED IN EARLIER ATTACK.

ELSEWHERE, QUIET HAS REIGNED. IN TEHRAN, NO INCIDENTS HAVE BEEN REPORTED. SEVERAL INDIVIDUALS LIVING IN SOUTH TEHRAN AREA REPORT TENSIONS THERE HAVE ABATED A BIT OVER PAST FEW DAYS, THOUGH MANY BELIEVE OPPOSITION IS JUST GIRDING FOR MOHARRAM CONFRONTATION. MOST WERE COMFORTED BY FACT THAT POLICE AND MILITARY PATROLS HAVE BEEN MORE ACTIVE OVER PAST THREE DAYS, AND ONE WELLINFORMED PERSIAN FROM JALEH SQUARE AREA IS FRANKLY CHEERED BY EVIDENCE THAT POLICE AND ARMY SEEM TO HAVE THEIR MARCHING ORDERS. HE ATTRIBUTED THIS TO FACT THAT AZHARI GOVERNMENT HAS NOW RECEVED ITS VOTE OF CONFIDENCE AND IS BETTER PREPARED TO ACT THAN IN FIRST WEEK OF NEW ADMINISTRATION.

PERSIAN-SPEAKING ENGLISHMAN, WHO HAS JUST RETURNED FROM FIVEDAY VISIT TO SOUTH, REPORTS THAT AN OLD FRIEND WHO IS A BAKHTIARI TRIBAL LEADER, SAID THAT IN KHORASAN PROVINCE TOWN OF MASJEDE-SULIEMAN, ENGLISH AND EUROPEANS ARE SAFE, BUT "THERE ARE A NUMBER OF STUPID PEOPLE WHO DO NOT WISH THE AMERICANS WELL". SOURCE WAS SURPRISED AT THIS, SINCE BRITISH HAVE TRADITIONALLY TAKEN THEIR LUMPS IN THE SOUTH. TRIBAL LEADER, WHO IS IN HIS LATE FIFTIES, PASSED THIS BY WITH A WAVE OF THE HAND, SAYING THAT ITS THE YOUNGER PEOPLE IN HIS AREA WHO "MAKE THE NOISE ABOUT AMERICA."

RUMORS STILL ABOUND THAT THERE WILL BE A SUBSTANTIAL ELECTRICITY CUT IN TEHRAN NOV.25, BUT TIMING OF CUTS AND DISCREET ENQUIRIES SUGGEST OUTTAGES OF PAST FEW DAYS MAY HAVE BEEN RESULT OF "FAILURES" OF GENERATORS AND PROBLEMS CONNECTED WITH POWERSHARING. MINOR INTERRUPTIONS NOV. 23 SUGGEST GRID HAS GOT ITSELF BALANCED BETTER NOW.

DCM HAD LENGTHY CONVERSATION WITH GENERAL KHOSRODAD, THE FLAMBOYANT HEAD OF THE IIGF'S AVIATION COMMAND, ON NOV. 22. KHOSRODAD, IN RESPONSE TO DCM QUERY, SAID MILITARY PREPARED FOR VARIOUS CONTINGENCIES AND WILL TAKE VERY FIRM ACTION DURING MOHARRAM IF OPPOSITION TAKES TO THE STREETS.

WITH RESPECT TO THE OVERALL POLITICAL SITUATION, THE GENERAL STATED THAT POLITICAL LIBERALIZATION HAD BEEN ALLOWED TO PROCEED TOO QUICKLY; A MEASURED PACE OVER A FEW YEARS WAS NECESSARY AND HE HOPED U.S. WOULD BE UNDERSTANDING. IN THIS PROCESS THE SHAH HAD TO REMAIN AND PLAY KEY ROLE. WITHOUT HIM AT THE TOP, IRAN WOULD RESEMBLE SYRIA OF A FEW DECADES AGO; THERE WOULD BE AN ENDLESS SERIES OF COUPS AND COUNTER-COUPS BY THE GENERALS AND THE COLONELS. "YOU WOULD HAVE TO LOOK OVER YOUR SHOULDER ALL THE TIME." THE SHAH HAD THE PERSONAL LOYALTY OF THE OFFICER CORPS AND WAS ALSO THE SYMBOL OF THE STATE.
THE MILITARY WOULD NOT HAVE THE SENSE OF LOYALTY TO A CIVILIAN GOVERNMENT SANS SHAH.

THE EXTENT OF SUPPORT FOR THE SHAH, HE SAID WAS FAR GREATER AMONG THE POPULACE THAN PERCEIVED IN TEHRAN AND THE MAJOR CITIES. HE FREQUENTLY VISITED SMALL TOWNS AND VILLAGES IN THE ISFAHAN AREA AND FOUND THE POPULACE RELATIVELY UNTOUCHED BY THE POLITICAL UPHEAVAL AND STRONGLY SUPPORTIVE OF THE MONARCH. TURNING TO BLACK SUNDAY ON NOVEMBER 5, HE SAID SMALL CADRES OF WELLDISCIPLINED PEOPLE HAD EXECUTED MOST OF THE BURNINGS; HE DID NOT KNOW, HE SAID, FROM WHENCE SUCH GROUPS RECEIVED THEIR ORDERS. THE REST OF THE DEMONSTRATORS WAS A MELANGE OF DEDICATED LEFTISTS AND RIGHTISTS, AND THE GENERAL POPULACE WHICH, AS IN NEW YORK AND OTHER U.S.
CITIES A DECADE AGO, TOOK THE OPPORTUNITIES TO LOOT AND GET A KICK OUT OF CONFLAGRATION AND DESTRUCTION.

AT THE CONCLUSION OF THE CONVERSATION, KHOSRODAD NOTED THAT CUBA WAS ESTABLISHING AN EMBASSY IN KABUL AND THAT KABUL WOULD BECOME THE SOVIET/CUBAN BASE FOR ACTIONS AGAINST IRAN AND PAKISTAN. THE ARMED FORCES WERE QUITE DISTURBED BY THIS DEVELOPMENT, HE SAID.

1978TEHRAN11518.subject: AMBASSADOR'S MEETINGS FRIDAY, NOVEMBER 24 AMBASSADOR WILL MEET WITH FORMER PRIME MINISTER SHARIF- EMAMI TOGETHER WITH SENATOR ZIAI AND HIS MAJLIS ME

segments.text: AMBASSADOR WILL MEET WITH FORMER PRIME MINISTER SHARIFEMAMI TOGETHER WITH SENATOR ZIAI AND HIS MAJLIS MEMBER BROTHER EARLY AFTERNOON FRIDAY, NOVEMBER 24, AND WITH ALI AMINI SEPARATELY LATER IN DAY. SHARIF-EMAMI IS NOT AMONG THOSE DESIGNATED BY SHAH AS INTERMEDIARY WITH OPPOSITION BUT SHAH HAS BEEN IN TOUCH WITH HIM. AMBASSADOR PARTICULARLY INTERESTED IN ENLISTING THEIR EFFORTS TO MAINTAIN TRANQUILITY DURING MOHARRAM AND TO PROD THEM TOWARD BRINGING MORE MEMBERS OF MODERATE OPPOSITION INTO CONSULTATIONS DIRECTLY WITH SHAH.

1978TEHRAN11520.subject: AMBASSADOR'S MEETINGS WITH SHARIF-EMAMI AND ALI- AMINI

segments.text: AMINI

I MET SEPARATELY AND CONSECUTIVELY AFTERNOON NOVEMBER 24 WITH EX-PRIME MINISTERS SHARIF-EMAMI AND ALI-AMINI. THE TWO MEN OFFER AN INTERESTING CONTRAST. SHARIF-EMAMI IS THE HEAVY, SLOW, GERMAN-TRAINED ACOLYTE OF THE SHAH, WHO HAS HANDLED THE ACCOUNTS OF THE PAHLEVI FOUNDATION AND WAS THE SHAH'S CHOICE AS THE LAST LEADER IN HIS CAMPAIGN OF LIBERALIZATION. ALI-AMINI IS AN ELFIN LITTLE MAN, FRENCH-EDUCATED, PERSONALLY WEALTHY, IRREVERANT ABOUT THE SHAH, AND THE FAIR-HAIRED AMERICAN PROTEGE OF THE KENNEDY PERIOD.

SHARIF-EMAMI, WHOM I MET ALONE IN THE HOME OF THE ZIAI BROTHERS, GAVE ME A LONG RECITAL OF A PROPOSAL MADE TO HIM BY MEMBERS OF THE NATIONAL FRONT. IT WAS THE FAMILIAR CALL FOR A REGENCY COUNCIL WHICH WOULD REPLACE THE SHAH AND PASS THE AUTHORITY FOR FORMATION OF A NATIONAL COALITION GOVERNMENT ON TO SOME VAGUELY DEFINED GROUP WHO WOULD THEN HOLD FREE ELECTIONS AND ASSURE THE RETENTION OF THE MONARCH FOR THE CROWN PRINCE.

I GAVE HIM A FEW WELL-CHOSEN GROUPS ON THE UNREALITY OF THIS PROPOSAL AND TOLD HIM THAT IT HAD BEEN MADE TO ME INDIRECTLY AT LEAST THREE TIMES. I STRESSED THAT THERE COULD BE NO COMPROMISE WITH KHOMEINI, THAT THE SHAH HAD TO REMAIN AS BOTH KING AND COMMANDER-IN-CHIEF, AND THAT THE NATIONAL FRONT HAD TO FACE THOSE FACTS AS REALITY. I WAS PARTICULARLY HEAVY HANDED IN MAKING THESE POINTS, PARTLY BECAUSE I THINK SHARIF-EMAMI IS NOT VERY BRIGHT AND PARTLY BECAUSE I THINK HE MAY HAVE BEEN PUT UP TO THIS INTERVIEW BY THE SHAH TO TEST OUR STEADFASTNESS.
AT ANY RATE, I MADE HIM REPEAT THE LESSON POINT-BY-POINT AFTER I FINISHED MY LECTURE TO BE SURE HE HAD IT RIGHT.

AFTERWARDS, I URGED HIM AND THE ZIAI BROTHERS, WHO LATER JOINED US, TO WORK ON BAZAARIS, INDUSTRIALISS, AND MULLAHS TO UNDERSTAND THAT THE SHAH WAS SINCERE IN SEEKING A DEMOCRATIC FUTURE AND TO DEFUZE THE TENSIONS IN THE PERIOD OF MOHARRAM. I STRESSED THAT THE SHAH WAS WILLING TO MEET ANY DOUBTERS PRIVATELY AND THAT THEY WOULD HELP RECRUIT THOSE WHO WOULD BE INFLUENTIAL TO MEET WITH HIM.

SUBSEQUENTLY, I SAW ALI-AMINI, WHO TOLD ME HE HAD ALSO BEEN DELUGED WITH THESE SAME OFFERINGS FROM THE NATIONAL FRONT AND HAD TOLD ALL OF THEM TO GO BACK AND GET THEIR HEADS RIGHT BEFORE TRYING TO PURSUE THEIR AMBITIONS. HE SAID HE HAD FOUND ONE SENSIBLE NATIONAL FRONT TYPE WHOM HE WAS BRINGING TO SEE THE SHAH THAT SAME EVENING. (I UNDERSTOOD IT TO BE FORMER MOSSADEQ MINISTER SADIQI, ALTHOUGH AMIMI SEEMED A LITTLE CONFUSED ABOUT HIS FIRST NAME.) AMIMI CONSIDERS HIM HONEST, REALISTIC, AND SENIOR TO SANJABI IN THE FRONT CONSTELLATION. HE BELIEVES THE SHAH COULD NAME HIM PRIME MINISTER IN A COALITION GOVERNMENT.
HE SAYS THE BAZAARIS SUPPORT HIM AND THAT HE HAS THE SYMPATHY OF SHARIAT-MADARI.

AMINI ALOS TOLD ME OF HIS MEETINGS WITH UNIVERSITY, BAZAAR, AND INDUSTRIAL TYPES WHOM HE HAS BEEN ROUNDING UP TO MEET THE SHAH. HE WILL BRING THE UNIVERSITY GROUP TO SEE THE SHAH ON SATURDAY AND HOPES TO GET THE BAZAARIS TOGETHER BY MONDAY.

I TOLD AMIMI THAT I HAD DISCUSSED AT LENGTH WITH THE SHAH THE PROBLEM OF DISTRUST IN WHICH THE POLITICIANS AND BAZAARIS APPROACH THE PROBLEM OF REACHING AGREEMENTS WITH HIM. I SAID THAT MOST OF THEM WERE TRYING TO GET THE UNITED STATES TO ACT AS THEIR GUARANTOR IN ANY DEALS THEY MADE WITH THE SHAH. I POINTED OUT THAT SUCH GUARANTEES WOULD BE IMPOSSIBLE FOR A FOREIGN POWER TO MAKE. HOWEVER, I SUGGESTED THAT HE, ENTEZAM, AND WHATEVER OTHER NOTABLES MIGHT BE APPOINTED BY THE SHAH AS HIS "PRIVY COUNCIL" COULD ACT AS GUARANTORS. AMINI SAID HE HAD BEEN THINKING OF THE SAME THING.

HE AND HIS GROUP, WITH GENERAL PUBLIC CONFIDENCE, COULD PARTICIPATE IN THE UNDERSTANDINGS BETWEEN THE SHAH AND THE POLITICIANS. IF ONE SIDE OR THE OTHER VIOLATED THE TERMS OF THE AGREEMENTS, THE COUNCIL COULD DECLARE A FOUL. HE FELT THIS WOULD BE ADEQUATE ASSURANCE TO BOTH SIDES, SINCE HE AND HIS COLLEAGUES WOULD BE ABOVE REPROACH AND REPROOF.

FINALLY, WE TALKED ABOUT THE NEED TO ASSURE AGAINST CONFRONTATIONS DURING MOHARRAM. I SAID I HAD SENT GENERAL GAST TO TALK WITH GENERAL OVEISII ABOUT THE NEED TO WORK OUT PRECISE GROUND RULES BETWEEN THE MARTIAL LAW AUTHORIITES AND THE MULLAHS WITH RESPECT TO PROCESSIONS, ETC., DURING MOHARRAM. I EXPRESSED A FEAR THAT TUDEHI PROVOCATION SQUADS WOULD INFILTTRATE THE FAITHFUL AND PRODUCE CONFRONTATIONS.

COMMENT: THERE IS A GLACIAL AMOUNT OF MOVEMENT BACK TOWARDS SOME SENSE OF COMMUNICATIONS BETWEEN THE SHAH AND THE OPPOSTION. I AMINI AND OTHERS CAN CONTINUE TO STIMULATE THIS AND AT THE SAME TIME THE SHAH CAN KEEP THE MILITARY FORCES STEADFAST, THERE MAY BE A POSSIBILITY TO PRECLUDE SOME OF THE WORST POTENTIALS OF MOHARRAM. I INTEND TO WORK ON SOME OF THE MILITARY ACTIVISTS IN THE NEXT FEW DAYS TO CHANNEL THEIR ENERGY INTO CONSTRUCTIVE EFFORTS.

1978TEHRAN11521.subject: POLITICAL SECURITY REPORT, NOV. 25 CONFIDENTIAL CONFIDENTIAL

segments.text: TEHRAN IS QUIET AGAIN WITH BUSINESS FUNCTIONING NORMALLY. BRIEF STRIKE-RELATED DISTURBANCE TOOK PLACE THIS MORNING OUSIDE NIOC BUILDING NEAR EMBASSY. TROOPS DISPERSED SMALL CROWD WITH TEAR GAS BUT THERE WERE NO INJURIES. ANOTHER AMERICAN-OWNED VEHICLE WAS BURNED LAST NIGHT IN ISFAHAN.

PREVIOUSLY-REPORTED INCIDENT IN MASHAD IN WHICH TROOPS ALLEGEDLY ENTERED, SHOOTING, INTO SHRINE OF IMAMA REZA, HAS SLOWLY LEAKED OUT AND THREATENS TO CAUSE UPROAR. PRESS SOURCE REPORTS LARGE CROWDS MARCHED IN MASHAD YESTERDAY TO PROTEST INCIDENT. DESPITE MARTIAL LAW, TROOPS PERMITTED DEMONSTRATION WHICH REMAINED PEACEFUL. AYATOLLAHS GOLPAYGANI OF QOM AND SHIRAZI OF MASHAD HAVE CALLED FOR DAY OF MOURNING TOMORROW. THIS MAY AFFECT OTHER CITIES AS WELL. AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI AND OTHER CLERGY OF QOM HAVE REPORTEDLY ISSUED STATEMENT STRONGLY CONDEMNING INCIDENT.
PRESS SOURCE REORTS KING HUSSEIN OF JORDAN WILL ARRIVE TOMORROW ACCOMPANIED BY SERVAL PRINCES FOR UNSCHEDULED PRIVATE VISIT. HE IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN THREE DAYS.
THREATENED POWER CUTOFF FOR TODAY HAS NOT OCCURRED BY MIDDAY.

1978TEHRAN11552.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT, NOV 26. SUMMARY: GENERAL STRIKE PROVING EFFECTIVE TODAY. SPORADIC POWER OUTAGES. DEMONSTRATIONS IN PROVINCES. MORE M

segments.text: SUMMARY: GENERAL STRIKE PROVING EFFECTIVE TODAY. SPORADIC POWER OUTAGES. DEMONSTRATIONS IN PROVINCES. MORE MINOR NEWSPAPERS. POLITICAL PRISONERS RELEASED. PRIMIN AZHARI'S INFORMAL SPEECHES WIN APPROVAL OF POLITICAL CENTER. MORE SCHOOLS OPEN. END SUMMARY.

IRAN IS GENERALLY SHUT DOWN TODAY IN OBSERVANCE OF AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI'S CALL FOR MOURNING DUE TO DESECRATION OF SHRINE IN MASHAD NOV. 20. NEWD OF INCIDENT SPREAD SLOWLY; RUMOR MILL EXPLAINS THIS IS BECAUSE SAVAK, COGNIZANT OF HOW EXPOLSIVE THE STORY WAS, WORKED TO KEEP NEWS FROM OTHER CITIES. COMMUNIQUE ISSUED BY AYATOLLAHS SHARIATMADARI, GOLPAYEGANI, AND NAJAFI USES STRONG LANGUAGE IN CONDEMNING SECURITY FORCES AND CALLING FOR DAY OF MOURNING. IT SAYS THIS CRUEL ACT WILL ONLY STRENGTHEN NATION'S RESOLVE TO CONTINUE STRUGGLE, AND THAT THE FOUNDATION OF THE OPPRESSORS WILL FINALLY BE DESTROYED. APPROXIMATELY TWO THIRDS OF TEHRAN SHOPS ARE CLOSED.

AS WITH PREVIOUS STRIKES, CLOSURES ARE INCONSISTENT: SHOPS WERE OPEN THIS MORNING IN SOME SOUTHERN SECTIONS, WHILE WHOLE BLOCKS WERE CLOSED IN THE NORTH. AS BEFORE, HOWEVER, WE EXPECT SHOPS TO CONTINUE CLOSING AS DAY PROGRESSES, LEAVING CITY CLOSED BY LATE AFTERNOON. STRIKE HAS PUBLIC A BIT EDGY IN LIGHT OF PRESS REPORTS TODAY FROM PARIS THAT KHOMEINI MEANS TO BRING DOWN REGIME THROUGH STRIKE ACTION. NONETHELESS TODAY'S SITUATION HAS ITS OWN RATIONALE, AND KHOMEINI'S NAME WAS NOT ASSOCIATED WITH THE COMMUNIQUE WHICH CALLED FOR STRIKE. SCATTERED POWER OUTAGES TODAY CONTRIBUTE TO ATMOSPHERE OF SEMIPARALYSIS.

PRESS SOURCE TOLD EMBOFFS NUMEROUS ACCOUNTS SUPPORT OPPOSITION CLAIM THAT TROOPS DID ENTER SHRINE ITSELF AND KILL SEVERAL DEMONSTRATORS. APPARENTLY TROOPS WERE PURSUING PROTESTORS WHO HAD ASSEMBLED OUTSIDE SHRINE.

COMMUNICATIONS IS STILL POOR WITH PROVINCES BUT EMBASSY HAS REPORTS OF DEMONSTRATIONS IN MASHAD, SARI, AND SANANDAJ. IN TEHRAN, SOME MODEST CROWDS HAVE GATHERED IN CENTRAL CITY BUT BY MIDDAY NO MAJOR INCIDENTS HAVE BEEN REPORTED. ONLY CONFIRMED SCUFFLE WAS BRIEF CLASH NEAR EMBASSY AT NIOC BUILDING. STRIKE-RELATED GROUP WAS DISPERSED WITH TEAR GAS AND SHOTS IN THE AIR. TROOP PRESENCE IN TEHRAN IS MODEST DESPITE ADVANCE KNOWLEDGE OF DAY OF MOURNING. CONSULATE ISFAN REPORTS EXPLOSION IN NEARBY BANK LAST NIGHT.

HEAD OF TEACHERS UNION AFFIRMS MORE SCHOOLS ARE OPENING (WITH EXPIRATION OF TODAY'S MOURNING. HE SAYS, HOWEVER, THAT MANY TEACHERS WHO COME TO SCHOOL HOLD POLITICAL DISCUSSION RATHER THAN TEACH. HE INFORMED EMBOFF THAT HE HAD REJECTED MINISTER OF EDUCATION'S REQUEST FOR A MEETING.

TWO NEW NEWSPAPERS WITH OLD HISTORIES, AHANG-E-SIASI (POLITICAL HARMONY) AND SAISAT-E-MA (OUR POLICY) HAVE APPEARED. THESE ARE SMALL AND NOT TOTALLY PROGOVT, BUT CERTAINLY NOT CRITICAL EITHER. THE FIRST OF THESE CLAIMS KHOMEINI IS UNDER CONTROL OF COMMUNNISTS, NAMING THREE PERSONS AROUND KHOMEINI IN PARIS: GHOTBAZADEH, YAZDI AND BANISADR. SAISAT-E-MA BLAMES PRESIDENT CARTER'S HUMAN RIGHTS PLICY FOR IRAN'S PROBLEMS.
GOVT ANNOUNCED 261 POLITICAL PRISONERS HAVE BEEN RELEASED, TOTALLING 471 FOR THE PAST WEEK.

EMBASSY HAS RECEIVED MANY FAVORABLE COMMENTS FROM EDUCATED MIDDLE CLASS CONTACTS ON PRIMIN AZHARI'S SPEECH TO PARLIAMENT. THEY ADMIRED HIS INFORMAL, CONVERSATIONAL TONE AND THE ABSENCE OF HAUGHTINESS. THESE ARE NOT, HOWEVER, HARDCORE OPPOSITIONISTS.

1978TEHRAN11555.subject: SECOND POLITICAL / SECURITY REPORT, NOV 26 CONSUL ISFAHAN REPORTS CITY HAS BEEN GOING THROUGH GROWING PATTERN OF VIOLENCE TODAY. EARLY DEMONSTRATION AR

segments.text: CONSUL ISFAHAN REPORTS CITY HAS BEEN GOING THROUGH GROWING PATTERN OF VIOLENCE TODAY. EARLY DEMONSTRATION AROUND BANK GREW INTO LARGE PROPORTIONS. TWO POLICMEN SHOT AND KILLED (ONE REPORT) SAID BY POLICEMEN'S OWN WEAPON WHICH WAS WRESTED AWAY FROM HIM). MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES MUSTERING HEAVY FORCE BUT BARRICADES UP ALL OVER NORTHERN TIER OF CITY. SEVEN BUILDINGS CONFIRMED BURNING AS OF 1630 LOCAL. FOUR ATTACKS ON AMERICAN VEHICLES CONFIRMED, NO CASUALITIES. AMERICAN SCHOOL ENDED EARLY TODAY AND WILL REMAIN CLOSED TOMORROW. 3-4 HOUR POWER STRIKE AFFECTED CITY. NO IRAN AIR PLANES ARRIVED ISFAHAN AFTER 10A.M. (WE DO NOT KNOW IF RUMORS OF STRIKE ARE TRUE). CURFEW HAS BEEN EXTENDED; NOW 8P.M.
TO 6A.M.

IRAN AIR NOW SEEMS TO BE OPERATING NORMALLY. ONLY INTERNATIONAL FLIGHT WHICH SUSPENDED (TEMPORARILY IN ORDER TO PROVIDE AIRCRAFT FOR RETURNING HAJJI PILGRIMS) WAS ITS FLIGHT 779 TO PARIS AND NEW YORK. SOME DOMESTIC FLIGHTS (E.G. AHWAZ, TEHRAN) HAVE BEEN MOVED UP BECAUSE OF THE 2100 HOURS CURFEW. ALL FOREIGN EMPLOYEES ARE BACK AT WORK. STRIKERS AGREED TO KEEP DEMAND THAT EXPATRIATE EMPLOYEES BE REPLACED BY IRANIAN NATIONALS IN ABEYANCE FOR THREE MONTHS WHILE IRAN AIR MANAGEMENT CONSIDERS FEASIBILITY. (COMMENT: ALTHOUGH FOREIGN STEWARDESSES COULD BE REPLACED BY IRANIANS, IT SEEMS UNLIKELY THAT JOBS REQUIRING TECHNICAL EXPERTISE (SUCH AS MAECHANICS) WILL BE SO EASILY FILLED BY IRANIANS.)

1978TEHRAN11611.subject: WHEREABOUTS OF IMAM MUSA SADR WHILE THE SOURCING IS INDIRECT, WE HAVE BEEN TOLD THAT THE IMAM IS NOW IN DAMASCUS, GUEST OF PRESIDENT ASSAD. THE SO

segments.text: WHILE THE SOURCING IS INDIRECT, WE HAVE BEEN TOLD THAT THE IMAM IS NOW IN DAMASCUS, GUEST OF PRESIDENT ASSAD. THE SOURCE SAYS HE TALKED RECENTLY BY TELEPHONE WITH THE IMAM'S WIFE WHO IS RECOVERING FROM SURGERY IN A PARIS HOSPITAL. SHE WOULD NOT SAY WHY HER HUSBAND HAS CHOSEN NOT TO REVEAL HIS WHEREABOUTS, BUT SAID HE HAD SPENT SOME DAYS WITH KHOMEINI BEFORE GOING ON TO DAMASCUS. THE TROUBLED SITUATION IN LEBANON MAY BE ONE REASON FOR HIS ABSENCE ACCORDING TO THE SOURCE WHOSE FATHER IS A COUSIN OF THE IMAM. THE TROUBLED IRAN SITUATION MAY BE ANOTHER. WE PASS THIS ALONG FOR WHAT IT IS WORTH.

SUMMARY: WORKERS APPEAR GENERALLY TO HAVE GONE BACK TO WORK TODAY AFTER YESTERDAY'S GENERAL STRIKE, WHICH CLOSED ABOUT TWOTHIRDS OF TEHRAN SHOPS. TEHRAN AND SHIRAZ ARE QUIET, EXCEPT FOR ARMY DISPERSAL OF CROWD NEAR UNIVERSITY IN TEHRAN. ISFAHAN CONTINUES TO HAVE SECURITY PROBLEMS NIGHT OF NOV 26. PERSIAN MAGAZINE KHANDANIHA STRONGLY CRITICIZES US AND WEST FOR MEDDLING IN IRAN. JUSTICE MINISTER NAMES THREE TO ROYAL INVESTIGATION COMMISSION. STORIES NOW CIRCULATING IN TEHRAN AND ISFAHAN THAT "PEOPLE" ARE PREPARING FOR MARTYRDOM. NATURAL GAS GOING TO USSR AGAIN. END SUMMARY.

TEHRAN APPEARS TO HAVE RETURNED TO WHAT PASSES FOR NORMAL THESE DAYS IN WAKE OF GENERAL STRIKE WHICH CLOSED ABOUT TWO-THIRDS OF SHOPS ON CITY-WIDE BASIS. TEHRAN BAZAAR IS OPEN AND PEACEFUL AS OF NOON. THERE HAVE BEEN MINOR OUTTAGES OF WATER AND POWER, WHICH HAVE BEEN RESTORED QUICKLY. IN SEVERAL CASES, DISRUPTION APPEARS TO HAVE BEEN DUE TO PIPE-LAYING OR OTHER CONSTRUCTION, NOT STRIKE ACTION. MORNING NOV 27, ARMY REPORTEDLY FIRED SHOTS IN AIR NEAR TEHRAN UNIVERSITY TO DISPERSE CROWD WHICH HAD FORMED TO CHANT ANTI-GOVERNMENT SLOGANS.

SHIRAZ IS QUIET AS OF NOON NOV 27. IN ISFAHAN, HOWEVER, NIGHT OF NOV 26 SAW 16 DIFFERENT LOCATIONS FIREBOMBED. THOSE PRIOR TO CURFEW WERE NEAR CENTER OF TOWN, BUT SEVERAL OCCURRED AFTER CURFEW IN SUBURBAN AREAS. IN ADDITION TO CONFIRMED CAR BURNINGS NOTED REFTEL, US CONSUL REPORTS FOUR MORE BURNINGS OF AMCIT CARS NOT YET POSITIVELY CONFIRMED. ONE DYNAMITE EXPLOSION BLEW TWO RISERS OUT OF STEPS TO SECOND FLOOR APARTMENT OF US LT. COL LIVING IN ISFAHAN. BLAST WAS APPARENTLY PLACED TO FRIGHTEN, NOT KILL, BUT CONCUSSION BLEW OUT ALL WINDOWS. CHARGE APPEARED TO BE SINGLE STICK OF DYNAMITE.

CONSUL ALSO REPORTS UNOFFICIAL CHECKS INDICATE ABOUT 25 WERE KILLED DURING RIOTING IN ISFAHAN NOV 26, INCLUDING TWO POLICEMEN NOTED REFTEL. MORNING NOV 27 SHOPS WERE OPEN, BUT BEGAN TO CLOSE IN LATE MORNING. MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITY HAS LARGE AMOUNTS OF TROOPS ON ISFAHAN STREETS NOV 27. STORIES ARE SPREADING THAT THERE WILL BE PRAYER SERVICES NOV 28 FOR THOSE KILLED NOV 26, WHICH WOULD OFFER POTENTIAL FOR VIOLENCE. SIMILAR STORY SUGGESTING MOURNING AND GENERAL STRIKE IN TEHRAN MAKING ROUNDS AFTERNOON NOV. 27.

PERSIAN MAGAZINE KHANDANIHA HAS MAJOR STORY WHICH BLAMES PRESENT IRANIAN PROBLEMS ON MACHINATIONS OF ENGLAND AND US TO GET IRAN TO SIGN NEW CONTRACT WITH OIL CONSORTIUM. ARTICLE ALSO CRITICIZES BBC FOR TRYING TO DESTABILIZE IRAN. THESIS IS NOT SOUND IN TERMS OF KNOWN EVENTS AND LOGIC, BUT IT IS ONE WHICH MANY PERSIANS BELIEVE, NONETHELESS, PERHAPS BECAUSE IT FITS THEIR PRECONCEPTIONS. AUTHOR IS MEMBER IRAN-SOVIET CULTURAL SOCIETY.

JUSTICE MINISTER NAJAFI ANNOUNCED NAMES OF THREE PROMINENT JURISTS TO MAN COMMISSION TO INVESTIGATE ASSETS OF ROYAL FAMILY: ALI ASGHAR AMIN, NASSRIDIN HAJAVID, AND BAGHERI SHAHADI, EMBASSY DOES NOT YET HAVE FULL BIO DATA, BUT THREE ARE WELL RESPECTED LEGAL OFFICIALS WHOSE APPOINTMENT WAS APPROVED BY SHAH.

WE HAVE HEARD FREQUENT STORIES IN TEHRAN OF PEOPLE GOING OUT TO BUY WHITE CLOTHES OR MATERIAL TO "PREPARE THEMSELVES FOR MARTYRDOM." ONLY DATE ATTACHED TO THIS HAS BEEN BEGINNING OF MOHARRAM; ALL PREPARATIONS ARE SUPPOSED TO BE READY BY THEN. ISFAHAN REPORTS LOCAL OPPOSITIONISTS ARE COMMEMORATING MARTYRDOM OF FOURTH YEAR STUDENT NAMED APTHAI WHO WAS SHOT WHILE WRITING "DEATH TO SHAH" AND FINISHED SIGN IN HIS OWN BLOOD. THERE IS NO HINT OF ANTI-FOREIGN OVERTONES YET, BUT MARTYRDOM THEME WILL PROBABLY BECOME MORE PREDOMINANT AS DISTANCE TO MOHARRAM CLOSES.

AS BEST EXAMPLE OF FAR-OUT STORY EXHORTING FAITHFUL TO ACTION, EMBASSY OFFERS FOLLOWING WHICH IS MAKING ROUNDS IN WEST TEHRAN MOSQUES: MULLAHS ARE TELLING THEIR FOLLOWERS THAT KHOMEINI DREAMED HE WOULD DIE ON 8TH OF MOHARRAM (DEC. 9) AND HAS ASKED HIS FOLLOWERS TO DEPOSE THE SHAH BY THAT TIME SO HE CAN DIE A FULFILLED MAN. (WE HAVE NOT HEARD ABOVE FROM OUR MAJOR RELIGIOUS SOURCES, HOWEVER).
IGAT-1 GAS PIPELINE BEGAN PUMPING NATURAL GAS TO USSR NOV 26.

1978TEHRAN11616.subject: STATUS OF IRANIAN PETROLEUM SECTOR NOVEMBER 26/27

segments.text: IRAN PRODUCED 5.7 MILLION BBLS OF CRUDE OIL NOVEMBER 26, OF WHICH 4.9 MILLION BBLS WAS AVAILABLE FOR EXPORT. PRODUCTION AND EXPORT AVAILABILITIES FOR NOVEMBER 27 WILL BE UNCHANGED.

ALL PRODUCERS EXCEPT OSCO (E.G. IPAC, LAPCO, SIRIP, IMINOCO, SOFIRAN, AND NIOC WITH A COMBINED CAPACITY OF ABOUT 750,000 B/D) ARE, FOR THE PRESENT AT LEAST, PRODUCING AT OR VERY NEAR CAPACITY RATES. FOR THE PAST TWO DAYS OSCO HAS PRODUCED SLIGHTLY IN EXCESS OF 5 MILLION B/D AND DELIVERIES OF CRUDE TO DOMESTIC REFINERIES ARE RUNNING AT 800-850,000 B/D.

OSCO IS INCREASING PRODUCTION AS RAPIDLY AS POSSIBLE BUT NORMAL TECHNICAL DIFFICULTIES WILL DICTATE GRADUAL IMPROVEMENTS. APPROXIMATELY 10 PERCENT OF OSCO'S EMPLOYEES ARE STILL NOT WORKING OR ARE WORKING AT LESS THAN FULL POTENTIAL. HOWEVER, THESE ARE TRAINEES AND OTHER VERY JUNIOR EMPLOYEES WHOSE POTENTIAL PRESENT CONTRIBUTIONS ARE NOT GREAT, AND OSCO MANAGEMENT MAINTAINS THATT THE LINGERING STRIKE IS NOT HAVING ANY APPRECIABLE IMPACT ON OPERATIONS.

OSCO HAS NOW RECOMMISSIONED FIVE OF THE SIX NGL PLANTS AND DELIVERIES OF NATURAL GAS TO IGAT-I AND LPG PRODUCTION AT BANDAR MAHSHAHR ARE NEARLY BACK TO NORMAL. NIGC HAS RESUMED GAS DELIVERIES TO ALL DOMESTIC CUSTOMERS AND TO THE USSR.

GIVEN THE RETURN TO RELATIVE NORMALCY IN THE IRANIAN OIL SECTOR, WE WILL CEASE SENDING DAILY REPORTS. THE SITUATION IS STILL SOMEWHAT FLUID (SIC); HOWEVER, AND WE WILL OF COURSE CONTINUE TO FOLLOW DEVELOPMENTS VERY CLOSELY AND REPORT AS APPROPRIATE. IF SITUATION DETERIORATES,WE WILL RESUME DAILIES.

1978TEHRAN11617.subject: POLICY OF IRANIAN GOVT DURING MOHARRAM

segments.text: DURING MEETING WITH SENATOR BYRD MORNING NOVEMBER 27, PRIME MINISTER AZHARI SAID HIS GOVERNMENT'S POLICY TOWARDS RELIGIOUS ACTIVITIES DURING PERIOD OF MOHARRAM WOULD BE SOMEWHAT MORE FLEXIBLE THAN SHAH HAD EARLIER INDICATED TO AMBASSADOR. HE INDICATED THAT MOSQUES AND THEIR CONGREGATIONS WOULD BE PERMITTED TO HOLD PUBLIC OBSERVANCES PROVIDED THAT MULLAHS GAVE ORAL ASSURANCES SUCH ACTIVITIES WOULD NOT RPT NOT BE TURNED INTO POLITICAL DEMONSTRATIONS.

PRIME MINISTER SAID HE WOULD ANNOUNCE POLICY OVER NATIONAL RADIO AND TELEVISION SHORTLY BEFORE BEGINNING OF MOHARRAM AND WOULD BE CERTAIN THAT ALL MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES UNDERSTOOD IT. HE SEEMED CONFIDENT THAT, BY PLACING RELIGIOUS AUTHORITIES ON THEIR HONOR TO MONITOR ACTIVITIES OF THEIR CONGREGATIONS, VIOLENT CONFRONTATIONS WOULD BE AVERTED. HE SAID, HOWEVER, THAT SUFFICIENT FORCE WOULD BE AVAILABLE, IN PLACE, TO ENFORCE LAW AND ORDER IF THAT PROVED NECESSARY.

1978TEHRAN11631.subject: STATEMENT BY SENATOR ROBERT C. BYRD ON DEPARTURE FROM TEHRAN, NOVEMBER 27, 1978

segments.text: TEHRAN, NOVEMBER 27, 1978
FOLLOWING IS THE OFFICIAL TEXT OF THE STATEMENT BY SENATOR BYRD ISSUED ON HIS DEPARTURE FROM TEHRAN.

"I AM HERE TO EMPHASIZE THE STRONG SUPPORT OF THE PRESIDENT OF THE UNITED STATES AS WELL AS MY OWN SUPPORT FOR IRAN, AND FOR THE EFFORTS TO RESTORE PEACE AND CIVIL ORDER. WE BELIEVE THE SHAH IS TAKING STEPS TO MAKE IT POSSIBLE FOR IRAN TO CONTINUE TO MOVE FORWARD--POLITICALLY, ECONOMICALLY, AND AS AN IMPORTANT MEMBER OF THE INTERNATIONA COMMUNITY. "THE UNITED STATES WANTS AND INTENDS TO CONTINUE ITS STRONG BILATERAL POLITICAL, ECONOMIC, AND SECURITY RELATIONSHIP WITH IRAN.

IT IS A RELATIONSHIP WHICH IS MUTUALLY BENEFICIAL TO THE PEOPLES OF BOTH THE UNITED STATES AND IRAN, AND WE WANT TO PURSUE THESE STRONG TIES. " THE UNITED STATES HAS MADE CLEAR THAT IT HAS NO INTENTION OF INTERFERING IN IRAN'S INTERNAL AFFAIRS. THE SOVIET UNION HAS COMMITTED ITSELF NOT TO INTERFERE IN THE AFFAIRS OF IRAN; WE EXPECT THE SOVIET UNION TO HONOR THAT COMMITMENT.

IN MY JUDGEMENT, ANY INTERFERENCE IN THE INTERNAL AFFAIRS OF IRAN OR ANY VIOLATION OF ITS TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY, ITS SOVEREIGNTY, OR INDEPENDENCE WOULD BE VIEWED BY THE UNITED STATES AS A MATTER OF UTMOST GRAVITY AND CONCERN. "AN INDEPENDENT AND STABLE IRAN IS CRUCIALLY IMPORTANT TO THE UNITED STATES, TO THE REGION, AND TO THE ENTIRE WORLD. OUR FRIENDSHIP AND CLOSE TIES ARE VITAL ELEMENTS OF UNITED STATES FOREIGN POLICY, AND WE WANT AND INTEND TO CONTINUE THAT RELATIONSHIP."

LONG TIME AP REP PARVIZ RAEIN IS APPARENTLY UNDER ATTACK WITHIN HIS OWN ORGANIZATION AS INEFFECTIVE CORRESPONDENT COMPARED WITH COMPETING WIRE SERVICES WHICH ARE STAFFED BY NONIRANIANS. WE DO NOT WANT TO INSERT OURSELVES IN THIS AS IT MIGHT BE COUNTERPRODUCTIVE. SHOULD AP MAKE ANY INQUIRIES OF YOU OR ANYONE ELSE IN THE DEPARTMENT WHICH COME TO YOUR ATTENTION, HOWEVER, YOU MAY WISH TO PASS ON OUR FOLLOWING ESTIMATE OF THE MAN'S PERFORMANCE.

WE THINK RAEIN HAS BEEN A RESPONSIBLE CORRESPONDENT WHO CHECKS OUT HIS FACTS CAREFULLY. HE IS LESS LIKELY THAN OTHERS TO RUSH INTO PRINT WITH UNCONFIRMED INFORMATION, BUT NOT BASHFUL ABOUT PRINTING FACTS AS THEY DEVELOP. ONE EXAMPLE IS HIS CONTINUING ADHERENCE TO ESTIMATE THAT TOTAL PEOPLE KILLED AT JALEH SQUARE SEPT 8 WAS NOT MUCH ABOVE 100, AS OPPOSED TO CLAIMS OF 3 TO 4 THOUSAND PUT OUT BY OPPOSITION AND EXPLICITLY OR IMPLICITLY ACCEPTED BY MANY CORRESPONDENTS.

TYPICALLY, RAEIN STICKS TO HIS OWN VERSION BECAUSE HE WAS THE ONLY WIRE SERVICE REPRESENTATIVE ACTUALLY PRESENT AT THE EVENT AND OVERHEARD CONVERSATION ON POLICE RADIO NEARBY WHICH WAS CALLING FOR TRUCKS TO CARRY AWAY ABOUT 90 OR 100 BODIES, AFTER THE SHOOTING HAD STOPPED. AS A MATTER OF FACT RAEIN'S LONG BACKGROUND AND IRANIAN VIEWPOINT HAVE PROVIDED INSIGHTS INTO THE NEWS BEHIND THE NEWS AND REASONS FOR THINGS HAVING HAPPENED WHICH HIS FOREIGN COMPETITORS (RIZVI OF UPI, RAFFAELI OF AFP AND VARIOUS CHANGING PERSONS FOR REUTERS) CANNOT PROVIDE. BAEIN IS AWAY DEFENDING HIMSELF.

NEW SUBJECT. THROUGH AN INTERMEDIARY AT THE EMBASSY, LAMBRAKIS WAS PUT IN TOUCH A COUPLE OF MONTHS AGO WITH KHOSRO EQBAL (SEE MEMCON DATED OCT 11, 1978) A BROTHER OF MANUCHEHR, WHO NORMALLY LIVES IN PARIS BUT HAS RETURNED TO IRAN FOR THE DURATION OF IRAN'S PRESENT PROBLEMS. HE IS IN HIS LATE 60S BUT STILL VIGOROUS, A LAWYER, SOMETHING OF A DABBLER IN POLITICS, WITH A REPUTATION AS A SMOOTH OPERATOR IN THE PAST. HE HAS HAD CONTACT WITH MANY EMBASSY OFFICERS IN PREVIOUS YEARS AND LAMBRAKIS HAS MAINTAINED A WEEKLY DIALOGUE WITH HIM SINCE OCTOBER.

EQBAL HAS CONTACTS WITH A VARIETY OF SOURCES, INCLUDING THE PRESENT MINISTER OF JUSTICE, NAJAFI. HE HAS JUST DECIDED TO TRY REVIVING A NEWSPAPER (APPARENTLY HE EDITED ONE SOME 30 OR MORE YEARS AGO) AND IS REPORTEDLY GOING TO SEE THE SHAH ABOUT IT. MEANWHILE, HE IS TAKING A QUICK TRIP TO THE U.S. ON PERSONAL BUSINESS (A RELATIVE IS VERY SICK, WE BELIVE) AND WILL BE IN WASHINGTON DEC 4 AND 5. LAMBRAKIS GAVE HIM YOUR NAME. SUGGEST YOU DISCUSS HIS VIEWPOINT AND SEE IF OTHERS IN INR OR ELSEWHERE WOULD BE INTERESTED.

HE IS ONE OF MANY MODERATES WHO ARE TRYING TO FIND A SOLUTION WHICH WILL RETAIN THE SHAH AS CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCH WITH GREATLY REDUCED POWERS. HE GIVES THE IMPRESSION OF BEING MORE OF AN INSIDE MAN THAN HE IS, BUT IT MAY BE USEFUL TO EXPOSE SOME PEOPLE IN WASHINGTON TO HIS APPROACH.

BAHAI SITUATION IN IRAN HAS MARGINALLY IMPROVED SINCE REESTABLISHMENT OF DEGREE OF ORDER BY NEW MILITARY GOVERNMENT. THERE REMAINS MAJOR DEGREE OF HOSTILITY AGAINST BAHAIS, PARTICULARLY ON PART OF ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS OPPOSITION, WHICH IS LEADING ELEMENT OF POLITICAL OPPOSITION TO SHAH AND GOI. GOI HAD RECOGNIZED THIS PRESSURE AND BAHAIS ARE STILL BEING DISMISSED FROM GOVERNMENT JOBS. SEVERAL DOCTORS AT GOVERNMENT HOSPITALS WERE DISMISSED LAST WEEK, ACCORDING TO PERSIAN FRIENDS WHO KNOW THE INDIVIDUALS. HOWEVER, THERE IS NO OPEN STREET HOSTILITY TOWARD BAHAI SECT BEING MANIFEST AT THE MOMENT.
BAHAI TEMPLE HAD MILITARY GUARD DURING RECENT DISTURBANCES, BUT AS FAR AS WE KNOW THERE WERE NO ATTACKS AGAINST IT IN RECENT MONTHS.

WE UNDERSTAND BAHAIS ARE LEAVING IRAN, BUT SOME PROMINENT ONES DO REMAIN. LOWER MIDDLE CLASS BAHAIS TELL US HARASSMENT FROM MOSLEM NEIGHBORS AND PROSELYTIZING MULLAHS INCREASED THROUGH OCTOBER BUT HAS EASED OFF SINCE GENERAL AZHARI BECAME PRIME MINISTER. NO CONNECTION IS ALLEGED, BUT SOME SAY THAT MOSLEM OPPOSITION IS NOW FOCUSING ON CONFRONTATION WITH GOI DURING MOHARRAM (ADDING THAT IF KHOMEINI "WINS," BAHAI SITUATION IN IRAN WILL BECOME INTOLERABLE).

WE BELIEVE DEPTOFFS COHEN AND PRECHT TOOK RIGHT LINE ON POTENTIAL FOR POSITIVE USG ACTION. SINCE U.S. IS SEEN AS SUPPORTING GOI, ANY PUBLIC ACTIONS ARE LIKELY TO ENRAGE PRECISELY THOSE PEOPLE MOST LIKELY TO COMMIT VIOLENCE AGAINST BAHAIS. WE BELIEVE BEST POSSIBILITY FOR INFLUENCING SITUATION IN POSITIVE DIRECTION IS CONTINUED DISCREET DISCUSSION WITH GOI OFFICIALS ON NECESSITY TO PROTECT MINORITIES, COUPLED WITH REPEATED REITERATION TO OUR OPPOSITION CONTACTS THAT PERSECUTION/VIOLENCE AGAINST BAHAIS DOES THEIR CAUSE LITTLE GOOD. WE BELIEVE THIS REMAINS BEST POLICY FOR USG SPOKESMEN AT HOME AS WELL.

COMPLICATING FACTOR IN SITUATION IS FACT THAT SOME BAHAIS PARTICIPATED IN WHAT ARE SEEN AS EXCESSES AND CORRUPTION OF PAST FEW YEARS. PERHAPS THE MOST NOTABLE BAHAI BUSINESSMAN CASE IS PROMINENT INDUSTRIALIST FINANCIER HOJABR YAZDANI, WHO HAS BEEN HELD SINCE AUGUST ON CHARGES OF FRAUD AND ILLEGAL USE OF GOVERNMENT LANDS. WE HOPE DISTINCTIONS WILL BE MADE BETWEEN THOSE WHO MAY BE ARRESTED AND TRIED FOR POSSIBLE CORRUPTION OR OTHER SPECIFICALLY ILLEGAL ACTIVITIES AND GENERAL PERSECUTION AGAINST SECT. CONCERNING THE SABET FAMILY WE UNDERSTAND ALL KEY MEMBERS ARE OUTSIDE IRAN: IRAJ IN SWITZERLAND, HARMOZ IN THE U.S. AND THE FATHER, HABIB, BETWEEN NEW YORK AND SWITZERLAND.

AFTER INTELLIGENCE BRIEFING GIVEN AFTERNOON NOVEMBER 28 BY GENERAL TIGHE AND DR. BOWIE TO SHAH, LATTER ASKED ME TO STAY BEHIND FOR FURTHER DISCUSSIONS. IT WAS ESSENTIALLY A HAND-HOLDING OPERATION (MY THIRD IN FOUR DAYS) AND REVIEWED A LOT OF TERRITORY PREVIOUSLY TROD.

HE WAS GREATLY PREOCCUPIED BY PROSPECTS OF SABOTAGE DURING MOHARRAM. DURING COURSE OF DISCUSSION, WE WERE INTERRUPTED SEVERAL TIMES BY CALLS FROM GENERAL OVEISI REPORTING ON STRIKE AT REY WHICH WAS DISRUPTING PRODUCT DISTRIBUTION PIPELINE AND LEADING TO GASOLINE SHORTAGES IN TEHRAN AS WELL AS JP-4 PROBLEMS AT AIRPORT. HE WAS ALSO CONCERNED ABOUT PROSPECTS FOR ELECTRIC POWER CUTOFFS (TEHRAN SUFFERED MASSIVE POWER OUTAGE LATER THAT EVENING).

IN DISCUSSING POLITICAL ACTIVITY, HE SAID THAT HE HAD CONCURRED IN FACT OF ALI-AMINI TELEVISION INTERVIEW, BUT HAD NO RPT NO PRIOR KNOWLEDGE OF ITS CONTENT. WHILE HE OBVIOUSLY WINCED AT SOME OF THE THINGS AMINI SAID, HE FELT THE BASIC THRUST WAS CONSTRUCTIVE AND MIGHT HELP ACTIVATE THE SILENT MAJORITY TOWARDS COMPROMISE. HE ASKED HOW WE HAD PERCEIVED IT AND I GAVE HIM GENERALLY POSITIVE REACTIONS FROM OUR MIDDLE CLASS IRANIAN CONTACTS.

ON CONTACTS WITH NATIONAL FRONT, HE SAID SADIQI HAD RENEGED ON HIS MEETING ABOUT ONE HOUR BEFORE IT WAS SCHEDULED. HE HAD CALLED COURT MINISTER ARDALAN TO SAY THAT IT WOULD BE MORE EFFECTIVE IF HE CAME IN COMPANY WITH "A FEW OTHER" NATIONAL FRONT LEADERS, AND BEGGED "TWO OR THREE DAYS" GRACE UNTIL HE COULD LINE THEM UP. THERE HAS BEEN NO WORD SINCE THEN, BUT HE UNDERSTANDS FROM AMINI THAT FRONT IS ACTIVELY SEEKING TO RECONCILE CONFLICTING VIEWS.

WHEN I SAID I UNDERSTOOD SADIQI MIGHT HAVE SOME POLITICAL LIABILITIES IN CURRENT CIRCUMSTANCES BECAUSE HE WAS ALLEGEDLY AN AVOWED ATHEIST, SHAH WAS ENORMOUSLY AMUSED. HE GAVE WAY TO ONE OF THE FEW GENUINE LAUGHS THAT I HAVE OBSERVED FROM HIM IN RECENT WEEKS.

THE UNIVERSITY GROUP WITH WHOM HE MET NOVEMBER 26 WAS, IN HIS OPINION, SURPRISINGLY CONFIDENT THAT THEY COULD OPERATE THE UNIVERSITIES EFFECTIVELY IF THEY HAD GENUINE AUTONOMY. HE HAS ASKED THEM TO PUT THEIR VIEWS IN MORE CONCRETE FORM AND WILL SEE THEM AGAIN. HE HAS NOT YET SEEN BAZAARIS.
I TOLD HIM MARVIN ZONIS WAS SEEING AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI IN THE HOSPITAL AND HAD PROMISED TO BRIEF ME ON THE MEETING. HE ASKED THAT I FURTHER INFORM HIM OF THE RESULTS.

FINALLY, HE SAID ARDESHIR ZAHEDI WOULD BE ARRIVING IN TEHRAN THAT EVENING, BUT WOULD STAY ONLY SHORT TIME. HE THOUGHT IT WOULD BE USEFUL FOR ZAHEDI TO GET A FEEL FOR THE CURRENT MOOD HERE SINCE IT WOULD BE HELPFUL IN EXPLAINING SHAH'S POLICIES TO WASHINGTON.

SUMMARY: IN THIRD MEETING WITH EMBOFFS, PROMINENT BAZAARIS SAID THEY HAD BEEN UNABLE TO MEET WITH SHAH OR SHAH'S REPRESENTATIVE. DEMONSTRATIONS WILL CONTINUE AND GOVT FORCES SHOULD USE RESTRAINT IN CONTROLLING THEM. PEOPLE ARE WORRIED ABOUT MOHARRAM, BUT CEREMONIES CAN BE KEPT PEACEFUL IF GOVT CURFEW FOR THREE HOLIEST DAYS. THEY EXPECT NO NEW GOVT BEFORE MOHARRAM AND THEY LAMENTED GOI'S INABILITY TO DEAL POLITICALLY WITH SITUATION. INTERMEDIARY WARNED THAT OPPOSITION LINKING PRESIDENT CARTER WITH SHAH IN POETRY NOW. END SUMMARY.

EMBOFFS STEMPEL AND PERETT MET WITH BAZAARIS HAJ KARIM HOSSEINI AND HAJ AHMAD POUGHADIRI ESFAHANI NOV 28 IN HOME OF HEDAYAT ESLAMINIA. MEETING INDICATED NO IMMEDIATE PROSPECT OF SETTLEMENT BETWEEN GOVT AND MODERATE OPPOSITION. BAZAARIS SAID THEY HAD BEEN UNABLE TO MEET WITH SHAH OR HIS REPRESENTATIVE AS THEY HAD HOPED (REF B). THEY DO NOT EXPECT A COALITION GOVT TO BE FORMED BEFORE MOHARRAM.

EVERYONE IS WORRIED ABOUT WHAT WILL HAPPEN DURING MOHARRAM, BUT THEY BELIEVE VIOLENCE IS AVOIDABLE IF THE GOVT DOES NOT PROVOKE THE CROWD. ALL USUAL CEREMONIES SHOULD TAKE PLACE WITH EXCEPTION OF BREAST-BEATING AND CHAIN-FLAILING. PASSIONS WILL REMAIN PURELY RELIGIOUS IF GOVT ACTS INTELLIGENTLY. BEST POLICY WOULD BE TO ELIMINATE CURREW FOR EVENINGS DEC 9-11 AND TO REMOVE TROOPS FROM STREETS. (SEE SEPTEL FOR GOI ANNOUNCEMENT OF MOHARRAM ASSEMBLY RULES.) MARCHERS WILL TIRE THEMSELVES OUT AND THEN GO HOME. IF CROWDS DO BECOME UNRULY POLICE CAN ALWAYS CALL FOR TROOPS, WHICH SHOULD BE AVAILABLE, BUT HIDDEN FROM VIEW.
WORST POLICY WOULD BE ROUND THE CLOCK CURFEW AS IS RUMORED; PEOPLE WILL TAKE TO THE STREETS ANYWAY AND TROOPS CANNOT SHOOT EVERYONE.

MEANWHILE, DEMONSTRATIONS WILL CONTINUE. AS IN PREVIOUS MEETINGS, THEY CRITICIZED GOVT FOR USING EXCESSIVE FORCE TO QUELL DEMONSTRATIONS. TROOPS SHOULD USE WATER CANNON AND TEAR GAS, NOT BULLETS. THOSE BEING KILLED ARE NOT THE ONES WHO BURNED BUILDINGS NOV 5. PEOPLE SEE NO FUNDAMENTAL CHANGE IN GOVT BECAUSE NOTHING HAS BEEN DONE WITH CRIMINALS LIKE NASSIRI AND HOMAYOUN EXCEPT TO ARREST THEM; PROSECUTION MUST GET UNDERWAY. KILLINGS IN MASHAD ALSO HINDER RECONCILIATION. THEY REFERRED TO LIST WHICH APPEARED THAT MORNING GIVING NAMES OF PEOPLE WHO HAVE ALLEGEDLY TRANSFERRED GREAT AMOUNTS OF CASH OVERSEAS. EMBOFF TOLD THEM LIST WAS A FRAUD, AND THEY EVENTUALLY SEEMED CONVINCED.
IN RESPONSE TO QUESTION, THEY SAID AZHARI'S SPEECHES CONTAINED FINE WORDS, BUT THEY WERE WAITING FOR ACTION.

BAZAARIS AND INTERMEDIARY BLASTED GOVT FOR FAILURE TO ESTABLISH VEN RUDIMENTARY CONTACT WITH SOCIAL GROUPS OR TO DEAL WITH BASICALLY MANAGEABLE SITUATION. FOR EXAMPLE, MANY "AKHUN," OR RELIGIOUS ORATORS, WERE IN KHOMEINI'S PAY AND WOULD ATTACK REGIME DURING MOHARRAM. MANY OTHERS, AND EVEN SOME OF THOSE PRESENTLY FOLLOWING KHOMEINI WOULD STICK TO PURELY RELIGIOUS SPEECHES IF MONEY IS PROVIDED. FOR TEN DAYS ESLAMINIA HAS URGED GOVT TO DO THIS SIMPLE THING, BUT NO ONE LISTENS. HE AND THESE BAZAARIS HAVE BEEN PAYING OUT OF THEIR OWN POCKETS. ALSO, WHEN INTERMEDIARY HEARD OF INCIDENT IN MASHAD, HE TELEPHONED AZHARI, URGING HIM TO CONTACT AYATOLLAHS AND EXPRESS SORROW.

SAVAK OR SOMEONE ELSE MUST HAVE INTERVENED, BECAUSE AZHARI NEVER CALLED THEM. THERE IS A CHAMBER OF COMMERCE GROUP WHICH WANTS TO DISCUSS PROBLEMS WITH SHAH, BUT SAVAK AND OTHERS IN SHAH'S ENTOURAGE BLOCK ALL ACCESS. SAVAK SAYS IT WILL RELAY A MESSAGE, BUT ONE NEVER KNOWS WHETHER THEY DO SO. SHAH MUST MEET WITH BUSINESS AND RELIGIOUS LEADERS, EVEN IF ONLY ONCE EVERY SIX MONTHS, TO FIND OUT THEIR PROBLEMS.

AT CONCLUSION OF MEETING, INTERMEDIARY CALLED EMBOFFS ASIDE TO REQUEST THAT PRESIDENT CARTER NOT ALIGN HIMSELF SO THOROUGHLY WITH SHAH. IT IS ALL RIGHT TO SUPPORT SHAH BUT NOT IN THIS MANNER. HE CITED A JINGLE WHICH IS BEING HEARD ALL OVER TOWN: SHAH JENAYAT MIKONE, CARTER HEMAYAT MIKONE (SHAH COMMITS CRIMES, CARTER SUPPORTS HIM.).

1978TEHRAN11690.subject: VIEWS OF NATIONAL FRONT (INF) LEADER SHAPOUR BAKHTIAR SUMMARY: BAKHTIAR TOLD EMBOFF HE HAD BEEN IN CONTACT SEVERAL TIMES IN PAST TWO WEEKS WITH INF' S SANJABI AND FOR

segments.text: SUMMARY: BAKHTIAR TOLD EMBOFF HE HAD BEEN IN CONTACT SEVERAL TIMES IN PAST TWO WEEKS WITH INF'S SANJABI AND FOROUHAR, WHO REMAIN IN PRISON, AND HE HAS BECOME DEFACTO INF SPOKESMAN. BAKHTIAR HAD BEEN APPROACHED ABOUT POSSIBILITY OF FORMING GOVERNMENT AND INSISTED ON THREE POINTS: KING MUST BE A CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCH, THE CORRUPT MUST BE RAPIDLY AND SEVERELY PUNISHED, AND HE MUST HAVE AT LEAST A MONTH TO FORM A GOVERNMENT. KHOMEINI WAS LOSING SOME STRENGTH, AND BAKHTIAR IMPLIED THAT THOUGHT HAD BEEN GIVEN TO FORMING A COALITION GOVERNMENT WHICH MIGHT NOT HAVE KHOMEINI IMPRIMATEUR. SUCH A GOVERNMENT COULD SUCCEED IF IT OPERATED EFFECTIVELY AND GAINED CONFIDENCE OF PEOPLE.

KEY POINT WAS GUARANTEE FROM KING "AND HIS SUPPORTERS, ESPECIALLY THOSE ABROAD," THAT HE WOULD NOT MEDDLE IN INTERNAL AFFAIRS. BAKHTIAR OUTLINED HIS PROGRAM (COMMENT: WHICH WOULD PROBABLY BE INF "PUBLIC" PROGRAM AT THIS POINT) AND LET SLIP INF FEELING THAT KING SHOULD ONLY REMAIN "TEMPORARILY," BUT THIS MIGHT RUN UP TO TWO OR THREE YEARS. HE SAW SOME VIOLENCE COMING OVER MOHARRAM, BUT URGED GOI "BE CALM." END SUMMARY.

EMBOFF STEMPEL MET WITH INF'S SHAPOUR BAKHTIAR MORNING NOV 28 FOR DISCUSSION OF POLITICAL SITUATION. BAKHTIAR SAID HE HIMSELF WAS NOW ACTING SENIOR INF OFFICIAL "AT LARGE," AND SAID HE HAD SEEN SANJABI AND FOROUHAR IN PRISON ON THREE OCCASIONS. HE APPEARED UNINFORMED OF TALKS BETWEEN SANJABI AND GOI AUTHORITIES, BUT THIS MAY HAVE BEEN A POSE. HE BAKHTIAR SAID MAIN EFFORT OF INF WAS NOW BEING DIRECTED TOWARDS GETTING AN OFFICE AND OPENING UP SHOP IN FACILITIES WHERE PEOPLE COULD GET TOGETHER. THE GOI (SAVAK, POLICE) WOULD BE APPROACHED ON THIS MATTER IN THE NEAR FUTURE.

IN RESPONSE TO EMBOFF QUESTION ON PRESENT SITUATION, BAKHTIAR SAID GOAL WAS STILL FORMATION OF A "GOOD" GOVERNMENT, FREE OF INFLUENCES OF PAST. THIS COULD PROBABLY NOT BE DONE PRIOR TO ASHURA; TIME WAS GROWING TOO SHORT. MOREOVER, IT WOULD TAKE AT LEAST THREE OR FOUR WEEKS TO FORM A GOVERNMENT THAT COULD PERFORM PROPERLY ONCE IN OFFICE (BAKHTIAR, UNLIKE MANY OF HIS COLLEAGUES, HAS OBVIOUSLY GIVEN SOME THOUGHT TO WHAT A NATIONAL COALITION GOVERNMENT MUST BE ABLE TO DO.). BAKHTIAR THEN SAID HE HAD BEEN APPROACHED THREE TIMES BY REPRESENTATIVES OF SHAH, WHO DISCUSSED, AMONG OTHER THINGS, THE POSSIBILITY OF HIS FORMING A GOVERNMENT.

AMINI OBVIOUSLY WAS NOT GOING TO FORM A GOVERNMENT, "HE HAS BEEN AVAILABLE FOR HALF A CENTURY TO FORM A GOVERNMENT, BUT WHEN HE DID--PFFFFFT." SANJABI HAD PROBABLY LOST HIS CHANCE TO BECOME PRIME MINISTER. HE HAD SIMPLY TAKEN TOO MANY POSITIONS ON BOTH SIDES OF TOO MANY QUESTIONS. EVEN MANY FRONT MEMBERS WERE DISGUSTED WITH HIS FLIPFLOP ON KHOMEINI IN PAST TWO WEEKS. (COMMENT: WHILE THESE COMMENTS ARE OBVIOUSLY SELF-SERVING, OTHERS HAVE SAID SIMILAR THINGS.)

BAKHTIAR SAID HE WOULD INSIST ON THREE POINTS: A) THE KING MUST BE A CONSITUTIONAL MONARCH. BAKHTIAR COULD ACCEPT THE KING AS COMMANDER IN CHIEF OF THE ARMY, ON THE UNDERSTANDING THAT THIS MIGHT "EVENTUALLY" GIVE WAY TO AN ARRANGEMENT "MORE LIKE THE ENGLISH QUEEN." POLICE AND SAVAK, HOWEVER, WOULD HAVE TO COME UNDER THE PRIME MINISTER, THOUGH IF BAKHTIAR WERE PRIME MINISTER, THERE WOULD ALWAYS BE CLOSE PM-THRONE CONSULTATION AND HE WOULD BE WILLING TO ASK THE SHAH'S ADVICE. B) "THE CORRUPT" MUST BE PUNISHED.

BAKHTIAR WAS NOT, LIKE SOME OF HIS COLLEAGUES, WANTING TO HANG 25 OR 30 CULPRITS FROM THE NEAREST LAMP POST, BUT PUNISHMENT SHOULD BE JUDICIAL, SWIFT, AND SEVERE"THREE TO FIVE OUGHT TO BE HANGED." C) HE MUST BE GIVEN AT LEAST FOUR WEEKS TO FORM A GOVERNMENT. IT WOULD NOT DO MERELY TO PICK A PRIME MINISTER; A WHOLE COMPETENT TEAM ------------------130297 291229Z /11 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 1885 SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 11690 LIMDIS (HE USED THE FRENCH "EQUIPE") MUST BE ASSEMBLED SO THAT THE GOVERNMENT CAN REALLY WORK.FIRST PRIORITY MUST BE GIVEN TO GETTING THE ECONOMY STRAIGHTENED AROUND, CUTTING MILITARY EXPENDITURE AND PREPARING FOR ELECTIONS.

WAXING MORE PHILOSOPHICALLY, BAKHTIAR SAID HE WAS AGAINST KHOMEINI AND WOULD "LET HIM WITHER; IF A COALITION GOVERNMENT CAN GAIN THE TRUST OF THE PEOPLE, KHOMEINI WILL GRADUALLY FADE IN IMPORTANCE IN SIX MONTHS' TIME." HE WOULD NOT CRUSH THE TUDEH (COMMUNIST) PARTY REVIVAL, BUT KEEP IT UNDER FIRM CONTROL. THE MILITARY BUDGET MUST BE CUT, AND IRAN "MUST STOP PLAYING POLICEMAN IN THE PERSIAN GULF." IN RESPONSE TO A QUESTION ON THE STRAITS OF HORMOZ, BAKHTIAR SAID ALL SENIOR OPPOSITION LEADERS WANTED TO SEE IT OPEN AND WOULD BE PREPARED TO USE IRANIAN MILITARY FORCE TO THAT END. THE IDEA OF A PERSIAN GULF "IMPERIUM" HAD TO GO, HOWEVER.

FINALLY HE GOT DOWN TO THE CRUX OF THE MATTER: THE KING MUST ACCEPT THE CONSITITUTIONAL ROLE; HE MUST GUARANTEE TO TAKE HIMSELF OUT OF INTERNAL POLITICS--AND HIS FOREIGN SUPPORTERS MUST "ASK HIM TO BE A DEMOCRATIC KING." THE U.S. AND BRITAIN WOULD HAVE TO DISCREETLY TELL THE SHAH THAT THEY SUPPORTED THE COALITION GOVERNMENT "AS A GOVERNMENT, NOT AS A SECRETARY TO THE KING." EMBOFF SAID U.S. WAS NOT INTERFERING WITH IRANIAN ATTEMPTS TO FIND A SOLUTION TO IRAN'S PRESENT CRISIS; WE COULD NOT DIRECT THE SHAH TO DO SOMETHING ANY MORE THAN WE COULD DIRECT INF TO DO SOMETHING.

DISCUSSION THEN DEALT WITH PROSPECT THAT SITUATION WOULD EVOLVE TOWARD CONSTITUTIONAL FORM DESIRED BY INF. BAKHTIAR SAID GREATEST FEAR OF ALL OPPOSITIONISTS, ESPECIALLY KHOMEINI IS THAT SHAH WILL STABILIZE THINGS, THEN RETURN TO OLD WAYS. EMBOFF SUGGESTED RECENT EVENTS PLUS SHAH'S OWN WORDS SUGGESTED THIS CRISIS WAS DIFFERENT IN DEGREE AND KIND FROM THOSE IN PAST. OF COURSE, EFFECTIVENESS OF NEW COALITION GOVERNMENT WOULD BE KEY FACTOR IN POSITIVE EVOLUTION. BAKHTIAR SAID A WORKING GOVERNMENT WAS ESSENTIAL, NOT ONLY TO GET THE COUNTRY GOING AGAIN, BUT TO UNDERCUT KHOMEINI. REGRETFULLY, BAKHTIAR CONCEDED THERE WOULD PROBABLY BE VIOLENCE LEADING UP TO ASHURA (DEC.
11), BUT HE HOPED THE GOVERNMENT COULD "REMAIN CALM," ANDHE HAD SENT SUCH A MESSAGE THROUGH HIS INTERMEDIARIES.

BAKHTIAR ADDED ALMOST AS AN AFTERTHOUGHT THAT KING'S ROLE MIGHT BE ONLY TEMPORARY, SINCE "MANY" INF MEMBERS DID NOT WANT KING TO REMAIN AT ALL. STILL, "TEMPORARY" PRESENCE OF SHAH AS CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCH MIGHT LAST TWO OR THREE YEARS, AND "WHO KNOWS HOW SITUATION WILL CHANGE; WE MIGHT EVEN CHANGE OUR MINDS ABOUT HAVING HIS SON" (I.E., BE WILLING TO KEEP THE DYNASTY).

EMBASSY COMMENT: BAKHTIAR OBVIOUSLY FEELS HIMSELF TO BY PLAYING A BIGGER ROLE THAN HE HAS BEEN PREVIOUSLY. HIS VIEW ON SUBSTANTIVE ISSUES IS SIMILAR TO THAT OF THER FRONT MEMBERS, AND HE IS CLEARLY REPRESENTING FRONT PUBLICLY AT LEAST DURING INCARCERATION OF SANJABI AND FOROUHAR. (BAKHTIAR SAID HE HAS SEEN MANY MEDIA REPRESENTATIVES OVER PAST TWO WEEKS, INCLUDING REPS OF NEWSWEEK, TIME AND "THE MAJOR AMERICAN NEWSPAPERS.") HE IS NOT RPT NOT IN CLOSE CONTACT WITH RELIGIOUS LEADERS, HOWEVER, AND IS NOT KNOWN TO REPRESENT A PARTICULAR GROUP WITHIN THE INF, HAVING BEEN A BIT OF A LONE RANGER FOR YEARS.

WE COULD SEE HIM AS A CABINET MEMBER IN A COALITION GOVERNMENT, BUT CERTAINLY NOT AS A PRIME MINISTER EXCEPT UNDER REMOTE POSSIBILITY OF AN EXTREMELY COMPLEX OFFICE-SHARING ARRANGEMENT IN A TRANSITION GOVERNMENT LEADING TO ELECTIONS. HIS UNWILLINGNESS TO DISCUSS IN DETAIL POSSIBLE SCENARIOS FOR VIOLENCE IN NEXTTWO WEEKS SUGGESTS BOTH LACK OF KNOWLEDGE OF KHOMEINI PLANS AS WELL AS HIS OWN FERVENT HOPE THAT VIOLENCE CAN BE KEPT TO MINIMUM TO AVOID COMPLETELY RUINING CHANCES FOR COALITION GOVERNMENT WHICH MIGHT INCLUDE ROLE FOR HIMSELF.

DURING YUGOSLAV NATIONAL DAY RECEPTION, I HAD OCCASION FOR A LONG TALK WITH MY SOVIET COLLEAGUE VINOGRADOV, WHOM I HAVE NOT SEEN FOR LAST FEW WEEKS. HE WAS OBVIOUSLY EAGER TO TALK AND WAS HIS USUAL SMOOTH, AFFABLE SELF.

VINOGRADOV BEGAN BY SAYING THAT THINGS SEEMED TO BE IMPROVING BECAUSE GAS SHIPMENTS TO USSR WERE RESUMED TWO DAYS AGO. HOWEVER, HE SAID THERE WERE REPORTS OF SOME INTERRUPTIONS TODAY WHICH HE HAD NOT FULLY EXAMINED.

WHEN I ASKED FOR HIS VIEWS OF SITUATION, HE SAID IT WAS STILL IN FLUX. HE FELT SHAH HAD TO REALIZE THAT OPPOSITION WAS NOT MERELY A RELIGIOUS REVOLT BUT INVOLVED ECONOMIC AND SOCIAL PROBLEMS. HE SAID HE WAS ENCOURAGED BY TALKING TO SOME OF "INNER CIRCLE" TO SEE THAT THEY SEEMED TO UNDERSTAND THIS.

HE ASKED WHETHER I THOUGHT SHAH WAS PREPARED MAKE NECESSARY COMPROMISES. I SAID I FELT HE WAS WILLING REDUCE HIS POWERS TO CONSTITUTIONAL PROPORTIONS PROVIDED HE COULD CONTINUE TO CONTROL THE MILITARY. MAIN PROBLEMS IN REACHING POLITICAL SOLUTION WERE THAT OPPOSITION POLITICIANS (A) WERE FRIGHTENED OF OFFENDING KHOMEINI AND (B) DISTRUSTED THE SHAH.

VINOGRADOV DOWNPLAYED SIGNIFICANCE OF KHOMEINI AND FELT HE WAS BEING USED AS A SYMBOL. I SAID ONE OF SHAH'S CONCERNS WAS THAT TUDEH PARTY WAS USING HIM AS A SYMBOL AND THAT THIS REFLECTED SOVIET WILLINGNESS TO OVERTHROW THE MONARCHY. VINOGRADOV SAID SHAH KNEW BETTER. THIS WAS "OLD LINE" THAT HE USED TO WORRY THE U.S. TUDEH WAS NOT RPT NOT UNDER SOVIET CONTROL AND HAD A LONG HISTORY OF ITS OWN.

HE THEN TURNED TO BREZHNEV STATEMENT, EMPHASIZING ITS POSITIVE ASPECTS (I.E., NO SOVIET INTERFERENCE) AND MADE NO REFERENCE TO ITS APPLICATION TO THE U.S. IN FACT, THROUGHOUT OUR CONVERSATION, THERE WAS NO HINT OF ACCUSATION ABOUT U.S. BEHAVIOR.

I SAID I WAS SURE SHAH WOULD APPRECIATE SOME STATEMENT FROM HIM OR HIS GOVT INDICATING THAT SOVIETS EXPECTED MONARCHY TO SURVIVE AND WERE NOT COUNTING HIM OUT. VINOGRADOV SAID SHAH KNEW THAT AND THERE WAS NO NEED TO REPEAT IT TO HIM. SHAH WOULD SURVIVE "IF HE DRAWS THE RIGHT LESSONS AND TAKES THE RIGHT ACTION." IT IS NOT A QUESTION OF THE POSITION OF THE SOVIET UNION.

VINOGRADOV THE ASKED IF MANY AMERICANS WERE LEAVING. I GAVE HIM THE FIGURES AS I KNEW THEM, POINTING OUT THAT MOST WERE DEPENDENTS. HE SAID THE SAME WAS TRUE FOR HIS PEOPLE. NOT A SINGLE SOVIET TECHNICIAN HAD LEFT AND HE WAS STILL BRINGING IN NEW ONES AS SCHEDULED. HOWEVER, HE HAD AGREED TO LET SOME DEPENDENTS "FROM REMOTE AREAS" GO HOME BECAUSE THERE WERE DISTRIBUTION PROBLEMS WITH FOOD, GAS, ETC.

I ASKED IF HE DETECTED ANTI-SOVIET FEELINGS AGAINST HIS PEOPLE. HE SAID HE WOULD CALL THEM "ANTI-FOREIGN," BUT THEY WERE NOT SERIOUS. HIS PEOPLE CONTINUED TO WORK, BUT SOMETIMES HAD TO STOP BECAUSE OF STRIKES. HE FELT THERE WAS A GREAT DEAL OF IRRATIONALITY IN SOME OF THESE EVENTS.

COMMENT: VINOGRADOV WENT OUT OF HIS WAY TO BE FRIENDLY AND REFRAIN FROM PROVOCATION. FOR EXAMPLE, IT WAS HE WHO INTRODUCED THE QUESTION OF DEPARTING NATIONALS SO THAT HE COULD DEMONSTRATE SOVIET STEADFASTNESS IN FACT OF CURRENT SITUATION. HE AVOWED SOVIET DESIRE FOR STABILITY HERE. IF THIS IS ALL A SMOKESCREEN, HE IS A VERY ACCOMPLISHED ACTOR.

1978TEHRAN11700.subject: CENTRAL BANK EMPLOYEES LIST OF CAPITAL FLIGHT

segments.text: BEGIN UNCLASSIFIED: ON OR ABOUT NOVEMBER 26, A LIST OF IRANIANS WHO TRANSFERRED FUNDS OUT OF IRAN THROUGH THE NONCOMMERCIAL MARKET DURING THE TWO MONTHS ENDING OCTOBER 22 WAS RELEASED IN THE NAME OF THE CENTRAL BANK EMPLOYEES ASSOCIATION. IT WAS PICKED UP BY AT LEAST ONE OF THE DAILY NEWSPAPERS, ATESH (THE FLAME) AND WAS CARRIED IN PART ON NOVEMBER 27. BY WORD OF MOUTH AND EFFORTS OF ITS PERPERATORS THE LIST OF 119 ENTRIES AND 102 DIFFERENT NAMES RECEIVED WIDE CIRCULATION THROUGHOUT TEHRAN. THE NAMES INCLUDE PROMINENT MILITARY AND GOI OFFICIALS, BUSINESSMEN AND THE ROYAL FAMILY.

CBI VICE GOVERNOR INTERNATIONAL SHIRAZI AND THE PROSECUTOR GENERAL OF THE MINISTRY OF JUSTICE MADE PUBLIC MEDIA STATEMENTS FOR THE NIGHT OF NOVEMBER 28 IN WHICH SHIRAZI SAID THAT THE NAMES AND NUMBERS ON THE LIST ARE A FABRICATION AND HAVE NO RELATIONSHIP WITH FACT. THE PROSECUTOR SAID INVESTIGATORS WOULD BE SENT TO THE CBI TO INVESTIGATE THE ALLEGED TRANSFERS AND IF THEY ARE UNTRUE THE PERPETRATORS OF THE FALSE LIST WOULD BE PROSECUTED. THE BBC ON NOVEMBER 28 CARRIED THE ACCOUNT OF THE LIST, THE REFUTATION BY THE CBI AND THE CALL BY THE PROSECUTOR GENERAL TO INVESTIGATE THE LIST.

THE LIST IS BY NAME AND AMOUNT OF FUNDS TRANSFERRED IN MILLION TOMAS (EQUALS 10 MILLION RIALS) AND TOTALS, WITHTHE ADDITION OF THE LAST ENTRY, I.E. 17 TRANSFERS UNDER DIPLOMATIC CODE TO PRIVATE ACCOUNTS, 12,882.5 MILLION TOMAS, WHICH AS THE THEN NON-COMMERCIAL SELLING RATE OF ONE DOLLAR FOR 70.6 RIALS EQUALS DOLLARS 1.8 BILLION (DOLS. 1,824,716,714.) (THE READING OF OUR COPY IS CLEAR BUT NUMBERS TWO AND THREE ARE CLOSE IN APPEARANCE AND MAY ACCOUNT FOR SOME DISCREPANCY WITH ANOTHER'S TOTAL). END UNCLASSIFIED.

BEGIN CONFIDENTIAL: THE DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR EXCHANGE CONTROL (FARHANG) TOLD EMBOFF NOVEMBER 28 THAT THE LIST WAS FALSE. HE SAID HE EXPECTED THE CBI TO REFUTE IT PUBLICALLY, AS IT SUBSEQUENTLY DID. TO SUBSTAINIATE HIS POINT, HE SAID THAT THE SUM OF THE LIST, WHICH THE EMPLOYEES SAID IN THE COVERING LETTER INCLUDED TRANSFERS ONLY EXCEEDING 10 MILLION TOMAS, EXCEEDED ALL THE FOREIGN EXCHANGE THE CBI PROVIDED THE NON-COMMERCIAL MARKET IN THAT TWO MONTH PERIOD, WHICH WAS ALMOST EXACTLY DOLS ONE (1) MBILLION.

FARHANG SAID THAT THE ENTIRE ACTION WAS UNRELATED TO THE CBI; THAT NONE OF THE BANK'S EMPLOYEES (MOST OF WHOM ARE PRESENTLY ON STRIKE) CLAIM CREDIT FOR THE ACTION NOR ARE ANY AT THIS POINT SUSPECT BY CBI OFFICIALS. THUS, IT IS CONSIDERED AN OUTSIDE FABRICATION. TWO OR THREE OF THOSE ON THE LIST REPORTEDLY HAVE BEEN DEAD FOR OVER SIX MONTHS.

MEAF UNDERSECRETARY KOOROS COMMENTED TO EMBOFF THAT WHILE THE LIST IS A FABRICATION IT WAS IN GENERAL A WELL-CONCOCTED PIECE OF WORK, WITH AMOUNTS APPEARING PROPORTIONATE TO THE REAL OR PUBLICLY PERCEIVED PERSONAL WEALTH OF THE INDIVIDUAL. THE DIFFICULTY FOR EVEN A WEALTHY PERSON TO "LIQUIFY" HIS ASSETS TO LEVELS AS HIGH AS DOLS 59.5 MILLION IN A TWO MONTH PERIOD IS MISSED BY THE HIGHLY BELIEVING PUBLIC. EMBASSY CONTACTS, INCLUDING AMERICANS, ARE WELL PREPARED TO ACCEPT THE AUTHENTICITY OF THE LIST. THUS, DESPITE THE DENIALS BY THE GOI, INDIVIDUAL REPUTATIONS WILL BE DAMAGED AND THE ALREADY WELL-DOCUMENTED CORRUPT TARNISHMENT OF THE REGIME AND ITS SUPPORTERS WILL BE FURTHER BESMIRCHED.

OBVIOUSLY, IN ADDITION TO THESE SUMS A GREAT AMOUNT OF SMALLER SUMS HAVE BEEN SENT ABROAD, AS WELL AS OTHER LARGER SUMS TRANSFERRED THROUGH SPECIALIZED BANKS AND UNDER COMMERCIAL EXCHANGE REGULATIONS WHICH ARE NOT AVAILABLE FOR PUBLICATION.
