1978TEHRAN11702.subject: POLITICAL SECURITY REPORT, NOV 29 SUMMARY: CHANGES FOR COALITION GOVERNMENT BEFORE ASHURA DISAPPEARING. GOI ANNOUNCES RULES FOR RELIGIOUS ME

segments.text: SUMMARY: CHANGES FOR COALITION GOVERNMENT BEFORE ASHURA DISAPPEARING. GOI ANNOUNCES RULES FOR RELIGIOUS MEETINGS DURING MOHARRAM--NO MARCHING, BUT OTHER CEREMONIES ALL RIGHT IF POLICE NOTIFIED. POWER OUTAGES IN ISFAHAN/TEHRAN NOV 28. MINOR DEMONSTRATIONS. AMCIT CARS HAVE TIRES SLASHED IN TEHRAN. BBC REPORTING KHOMEINI CALL FOR GENERAL STRIKE DEC 2. RUMORS OF GAS STRIKE HAVE SENT PEOPLE TO THE PUMPS, BUT SUPPLIES ARE ADEQUATE FOR NEAR TERM. END SUMMARY.

GENERAL TENOR OF EMBASSY CONTACTS WITH OPPOSITIONISTS AND OTHERS (BEING REPORTED SEPTEL NOTAL) SUGGESTS CHANCES FOR COALITION GOVERNMENT TO BE NAMED BEFORE ASHURA (DEC 11) ARE DISAPPEARING RAPIDLY. GOI AND OPPOSITION LEADERS STILL DIFFER ON SOME MAJOR POINTS, AND THRUST OF KHOMEINI ACTIVITY IN RECENT DAYS SUGGESTS HE IS FAR FROM READY TO ACCEPT, EVEN TACITLY, ANY COMPROMISE. OVERWHELMING MAJORITY OF IRANIANS ARE GIRDING FOR CONFRONTATION DURING MOHARRAM. THERE ARE HINTS THAT MANY MODERATE RELIGIOUS LEADERS ARE NOW BEGINNING TO BACK AWAY FROM IDEA OF FIERCE AND BLOODY CONFRONTATION AND LOOK FOR OTHER WAYS TO KEEP PRESSURE ON GOI. OUTCOME WILL LARGELY BE DETERMINED BYSITUATIONAL FOLOW OF EVENTS, HOWEVER.
RELIGIONISTS AND BAZAARIS ARE URGING GOI REACT IN MEASURED AND CALM WAY TO DEMONSTRATIONS TO AVOID PROVOKING CROWDS.

AMIDST SOME CONFUSION OF LANGUAGE, GOI ANNOUNCED ITS POLICY OF MEETINGS AND RULES FOR MOHARRAM. POLICY, AS OBTAINED FROM OFFICIAL TRANSLATION OF ANNOUNCEMENT, IS AS FOLLOWS: GOI URGES "CALM, DIGNIFIED, AND ORDERLY" MOURNING FOR IMAM HOSSEIN, AND DIRECTS ALL RELIGIOUS LEADERS TO PREVENT "SABOTEURS" FROM DISRUPTING CEREMONIES FOR POLITICAL ENDS. GOI STATES CATEGORICALLY, "THE MARCHING OF MOURNING GROUPS IS ABSOLUTELY FORBIDDEN." HOLDERS OF REGUALAR CEREMONIES ARE TO NOTIFY POLICE OF SUCH CEREMONIES TO ENABLE THEM TO BE HELD IN PEACEFUL MANNER. FOR MARTIAL LAW TOWNS, CEREMONIES AFTER CURFEW HOURS ARE PERMITTED IF APPROVED BY MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES. ORGANIZERS OF ALL CEREMONIES "ARE NOT TO ALLOW SABOTEURS TO DISTURB THEM".

HOWEVER, IF THIS HAPPENS, GOI "WILL UNWILLINGLY TAKE SERIOUS ACTION SOLELY TO PROTECT LIVES AND PROPERTY." OUR SOURCES TELL US GOI DISCUSSED THESE RULES WITH SOME RELIGIOUS LEADERS BEFORE ISSUING THEM. POLICE SOURCES INDICATE TO EMBASSY THAT NO CHANGE IN CURFEW HOURS IN TEHRAN ARE PRESENTLY CONTEMPLATED UNLESS SPECIFIC INCIDENTS LATER SUGGEST LOWERING OF CURFEW HOURS. RUMORS ABOUND IN TEHRAN AND PROVINCES, HOWEVER, WHICH SUGGEST CURFEW WILL BE SET AT SIX A.M. TO SIX P.M. FOR HIGH MOURNING DAYS (DEC 9-11).

OTHER STORIES HAVE IT THAT THERE WILL BE A 48-HOUR CURFEW DURING DEC 10-11, WE HAVE NO INFORMATION TO INDICATE THAT THESE ARE OTHER THAN RUMORS, PERHAPS BORN FROM LOOSE TONGUES OF GOI CONTINGENCY PLANNERS TALKING SHOP AT HOME, OR PURE IMAGINATION. ------------------009279 291854Z /42 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1893 INFO USINT BAGHDAD AMCONSUL DHAHRAN USLO PEKING AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY BONN AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY TOKYO USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 11702

VIRTUALLY ALL OF TEHRAN SUFFERED 2-3 HOUR POWER OUTAGE NIGHT OF NOV 28. ISFAHAN HAD TWO OUTAGES FOR A COMBINED TOTAL OF 6 HOURS WITHOUT POWER. SHIRAZ SUFFERED ONE HOUR OUTAGE EVENING NOV 28. BBC PERSIAN SERVICE EVENING NOV 28 ANNOUNCED KHOMEINI CALL FOR GENERAL STRIKE DEC 2 (FIRST DAY OF MOHARRAM). ELECTRIC WORKERS IN ISFAHAN HAVE ALREADY ANNOUNCED THEY WILL HONOR STRIKE WITH 24HOUR BLACKOUT (THIS WILL ALSO LEAVE CITY WITHOUT WATER AFTER FIRST THREE HOURS OR SO). IN EXPECTATION OF GAS SHORTAGES IN RESPONSE TO RUMORS, TEHRANIS HAVE LINED UP FOR BLOCKS AT GAS STATIONS. NIOC CONTINUES TO INSIST THERE ARE AMPLE SUPPLIES.

SOME FILLING STATION EMPLOYEES HAVE SPORADICALLY WALKED OFF THE JOB. STAMPEDE EFFECT MAY BE IN OPERATION. AS ON NOV 28 THERE IS NO SHORTAGE; THERE REMAINS POTENTIAL FOR SHORTAGE SOME TIME IN FUTURE IF REFINERY OUTPUT DOES NOT TURN UP A BIT MORE--TEHRAN REFINERY HAS BEEN PRODUCING AT ABOUT HALF CAPACITY FOR ABOUT TWO WEEKS, AND RESERVES ARE NOT AS HIGH AS THEY NORMALLY WOULD BE. EARLIER KHOMEINI CALL FOR STRIKE AGAINST OIL EXPORTS HAS BEEN GARBLED HERE AND MAY BE INCREASING PSYCHOLOGICAL PRESSURE.

THERE WERE ONLY MINOR DEMONSTRATIONS IN CITIES WE HAVE CONTACT WITH NOV 28. IN TEHRAN, POLICE AND ARMY HAD TO FIRE IN AIR TO DISPERSE CROWD OF ABOUT 50 OR 60 ASSEMBLED ON SHAH REZA STREET, BUT THERE WERE NO CASUALTIES TO BEST OF OUR KNOWLEDGE. IN EAST TEHRAN DURING EVENING BLACKOUT, TWO OR THREE GROUPS GATHERED WITH LANTERNS AND WERE DISPERSED BY POLICE. IN SHIRAZ, ONE SMALL DEMONSTRATION WAS BROKEN UP BY POLICE EARLY EVENING NOV 28. IN ISFAHAN, DAYTIME BLACKOUT SENT SEVERAL GROUPS TO STREETS DURING NONCURFEW HOURS, BUT THESE WERE DISPERSED PEACEFULLY. IRAN AIR DID NOT FLY TO ISFAHAN AND SHIRAZ NOV 28.

SOME PERSONNEL AT IRAN AIR COUNTER AT TEHRAN'S MEHRABAD AIRPORT ARE TURNING AWAY PASSENGERS TODAY WITH ANNOUNCEMENT IRAN AIR IS ON STRIKE. SITUATION IS NOT RPT NOT COMPLETELY CLEAR, HOWEVER. WE UNDERSTAND 18 IRAN AIR EMPLOYEES WERE ARRESTED AND REST OF EMPLOYEES ARE THREATENING STRIKE. CONTINUING CENTRAL BANK STRIKE IS EXACERBATING LEGITIMATE FOREIGN EXCHANGE DEALINGS AND BANKING OPERATIONS (SEPTELS WILL COVER STRIKE DEVELOPMENTS).

MAJOR GENERAL GAST, CHIEF ARMISH/MAAG, CALLED ON GENERAL AZHARI NOV 28 FOR FIRST TIME SINCE AZHARI BECAME PRIME MINISTER. GAST FOUND AZHARI BOUNCY AND HAPPY WITH HIS WORK. AZHARI SAID HE WAS LEARNING NEW THINGS AT THIS JOB EVERY DAY. IN PARTICULAR HE WAS IMPRESSED WITTENT TO WHICH IRAN IS RIDDLED WITH COMMUNISM, CORRUPTION AND IMCOMPETENCE. HE DID NOT ELABORATE ON THIS COMMENT.

AZHARI SAID WHEN HE FIRST WAS APPOINTED TO THE JOB NO ONE WANTED TO COME SEE HIM AND HELP HIM FORM A GOVERNMENT. NOW POLITICIANS AND MANY OTHERS ARE FLOCKING TO HIM WITH ADVICE AND ABITIONS, BUT HE HAS FORMED HIS GOVERNMENT AND DOES NOT PLAN CHANGES. HE ADDED THAT HE HAS JUST SIGNED ON AN "OIL MINISTER." HE IMPLIED THIS WAS A MAN WHO HAD NOT BEEN VERY PROMINENT RECENTLY; AZHARI DID NOT KNOW HIM PERSONALLY BUT HE PICKED HIM OUT FROM HIS FILE AS HE DID SO MANY OTHER MINISTERS. IT WAS NOT CLEAR HOW THIS (PRESENTLY NON-EXISTENT) JOB WOULD RELATE TO NIOC CHAIRMAN.

AZHARI SAID HE WAS AMAZED WHAT HE LEARNED FROM TALKING TO YOUNG PEOPLE. IN A RECENT CONVERSATION, A YOUNG MAN HAD COMPLAINED ABOUT THE SHAH "TAKING ALL OUR LAND," AZHARI REMONSTRATED THAT SHAH HAD ONLY TAKEN LAND IN HIS REFORM SO AS TO REDISTRIBUTE IT TO THE PEOPLE. YOUNG MAN ASKED: "THEN WHY DO I SEE EVERYWHERE I GO SIGNS SAYING 'HIS IMPERIAL MAJESTY'S GAME PRESERVE.'" AZHARI WAS NON-PLUSED BY SUCH EVIDENCE OF MISUNDERSTANDING AND MISLEADING SIGNS, AND HE HAS SINCE ORDERED ALL SUCH SIGNS REMOVED FROM NATIONAL GAME PRESERVES.

ASKED ABOUT STRIKE PROBLEMS, AZHARI INDICATED HE WAS RELATIVELY RELAXED. FOR EXAMPLE, HE IS BRINGING IN GERMANS TO RUN THE POWER PLANTS AND "TRAIN IRANIANS" AT THE SAME TIME. THEY SHOULD BE ARRIVING SOON AND ARE LIKELY TO BE HERE AT LEAST 5 YEARS.

IN REPLY TO ANOTHER QUESTION AZHARI SAID HE THINKS THE SOVIETS ARE INVOLVED BEHIND-THE-SCENES IN MUCH OF WHAT IS HAPPENING HERE, BUT WILL NOT INTERVENE DIRECTLY. HE PLEADED THAT AMERICANS REMAIN IN IRAN AND NOT LET THE PRESENT EVENTS "SPLIT US APART."

AZHARI SAID GOVT IS PRESENTLY ENGAGED IN PSYCHOLOGICAL WARFARE WITH THE OPPOSITION. IT AND THE SHAH AS WELL MUST STOP REACTING AND LAUNCH POSITIVE PROGRAMS TO WIN THIS WAR. HE ALSO SAID HE WAS GETTING WORRIED ABOUT HIS OFFICERS. HE NEEDS TO GET BACK TO THEM TO PULL THEM TOGETHER INTO A TEAM. THEY ARE NOT COORDINATING AS THEY SHOULD. (GAST INTERPRETED THIS TO MEAN HARDLINE BUT AZHARI MIGHT HAVE HAD OTHER THINGS IN MIND.)

COMMENT: IT IS GOOD TO KNOW PRIME MINISTER IS OF STOUT SPIRIT AS HE APPROACHES DIFFICULT MOHARRAM PERIOD BEGINNING DECEMBER 2. IT IS ALSO GOOD TO SEE HE APPRECIATES NEED TO MEET WITH MANY DIFFERENT KINDS OF PEOPLE, INCLUDING THE YOUNG. AZHARI AND THE SHAH HIMSELF HAVE SERIOUS PUBLIC RELATIONS HURDLES TO OVERCOME, AND IT IS GOOD TO SEE THAT THE PRIME MINISTER FINDS HIS CONTACTS WITH THE GENERAL PUBLIC VALUABLE.

1978TEHRAN11704.subject: THREAT TO EMBASSY TEHRAN POLITICAL COUNSELOR

segments.text: INVESTIGATION INTO AUTHENTICITY OF THREAT HAS BEGUN AND DEPARTMENT WILL BE KEPT INFORMED OF FINDINGS.

IMMEDIATE ARRANGEMENTS HAVE BEEN MADE TO PROVIDE POLITICAL COUNSELOR LAMBRAKIS WITH PARTIALLY ARMORED VEHICLE, ARMED GUARD FROM NATIONAL POLICE WHO WILL ACCOMPANY HIM AT ALL TIME WHEN HE IS AWAY FROM HOME OR OFFICE, AND FOLLOW CAR WITH TWO ARMED MEMBERS OF NATIONAL POLICE. IN ADDITION, A POLICE OFFICER HAS BEEN AND WILL REMAIN POSTED AT HIS RESIDENCE. LATTER IS STANDARD PROCEDURE FOR ALL OFFICERS OF COUNSELOR RANK.

AS AN ADDITIONAL PRECAUTIONARY MEASURE WE HAVE REQUESTED NATIONAL POLICE TO PROVIDE ARMED GUARD FOR ALL OTHER COUNSELORS, PLUS THREE MILITARY ATTACHES, AND HAVE VERIFIED THAT POLICE ARE POSTED AT THEIR RESIDENCES. THESE INDIVIDUALS WILL COMMENCE TRAVELLING, TO DEGREE POSSIBLE, IN INDIVIDUAL PARTIALLY ARMORED VEHICLES AS WELL, BUT FOLLOW CAR PROCEDURES WILL BE USED ON A SELECTIVE BASIS.

1978TEHRAN11717.subject: EMBASSY ADVISORY RE MOHARRAM WE HAVE ISSUED FOLLOWING ADVISORY TO AMERICAN COMMUNITY: "THE MOSLEM MOURNING MONTH OF MOHARRAM IS DECEMBER

segments.text: WE HAVE ISSUED FOLLOWING ADVISORY TO AMERICAN COMMUNITY: "THE MOSLEM MOURNING MONTH OF MOHARRAM IS DECEMBER 2 TO DECEMBER 30. DURING THIS PERIOD, ESPECIALLY THE DAYS OF DECEMBER 10 (TESSUA) AND DECEMBER 11 (ASHURA), SHIA MOSLEMS COMMEMORATE THE DEATH OF THE IMAM HOSSEIN WHO IS DEEPLY REVERED AS ONE OF THE PRINCIPAL PILLARS OF THE SHIA FAITH. "THERE HAVE BEEN A NUMBER OF RUMORS CONCERNING THE POSSIBILITY FOR VIOLENCE DURING THIS PERIOD. THE EMBASSY HAS NO INFORMATION INDICATING DIRECT ACTION IS PLANNED AGAINST FOREIGNERS, BUT THIS IS TRADITIONALLY A TIME WHEN VERY DISCREET BEHAVIOR IS REQUIRED BY FOREIGNERS.

ESPECIALLY DURING THE PERIOD DECEMBER 8 TO 12, AMERICANS SHOULD AVOID PLACES WHERE CROWDS ARE KNOWN TO GATHER, PARTICULARLY BAZAARS, MOSQUES, UNIVERSITIES, ETC. "AMERICANS SHOULD SHOW FULL RESPECT TO OUR MOSLEM HOSTS. AMERICANS SHOULD MAKE NO EFFORT TO WATCH RELIGIOUS CEREMONIES ESPECIALLY ON DECEMBER 9 TO 11, AND UNDER NO CONDITIONS SHOULD PHOTOGRAPHIC EQUIPMENT BE USED NEAR RELIGIOUS CEREMONIES OR PARADES. LOUD PARTIES SHOULD NOT BE HELD, AND RECORD PLAYER AND RADIO COLUME SHOULD BE KEPT LOW. THE DECEMBER 9 TO 11 DEEP MOURNING PERIOD WOULD BE A GOOD TIME TO CATCH UP ON FAMILY BUSINESS RATHER THAN ENGAGING IN SIGNIFICANTLY VISIBLE PUBLIC AND SOCIAL ACTIVITIES.

WE URGE ALL AMERICAN WOMEN TO BE PARTICULARLY DISCREET IN THEIR DRESS IN PUBLIC. "BECAUSE THIS YEAR'S ASHURA DEMONSTRATIONS MAY COINCIDE WITH POLITICAL ACTIVITIES, AMERICANS SHOULD BE ESPECIALLY CONSCIOUS OF CULTURAL SENSIBILITIES. IT IS POSSIBLE THERE WILL BE THREATS OR COMMENTS DIRECTED AGAINST FOREIGNERS, AND RUMORS MAY BE SPREAD. DURING MOHARRAM, THE AMERICAN EMBASSY WILL MAINTAIN AN INFORMATION CENTER. IF AMERICANS ARE INVOLVED IN OR WITNESS ANY INCIDENTS, WISH TO CHECK ON RUMORS, OR VERIFY CURFEW TIMES, THEY SHOULD CALL THE U.S. EMBASSY, TELEPHONES 829051 AND 824001 AND ASK FOR THE MISSION INFORMATION CENTER. "IF CIRCUMSTANCES WARRANT, THE EMBASSY WILL ISSUE ADDITIONAL ADVISORY NOTICES AS APPROPRIATE."

PASS TO DR. J. LAFLEUR, NRC. AS RESULT OF 27 NOVEMBER DISCUSSION BY SCIATT WITH DR. A. NOWROOZI, ATOMIC ENERGY ORGANIZATION OF IRAN'S SAFETY DIRECTOR, IT HAS BECOME CLEAR TO US THAT AEOI IS HAVING SECOND THOUGHTS CONCERNING ADEQUACY OF FRAMATOME SLIDING PAD CONCEPT TO ACCOMMODATE DESIGN EARTHQUAKE LOADS AT KARUN SITE.

ACCORDING TO NOWROOZI, THE SLIDING PAD CONCEPT ACCOMMODATES HORIZONTAL EARTHQUAKE VECTOR BUT DOES NOT DEAL ADEQUATELY WITH VERTICAL COMPONENT OF THESE LOADS. THE FRENCH HAVE EMPLOYED, FOR PURPOSES OF THE KARUN DESIGN, THE STANDARD ELECTRICITE DE FRANCE (EDF) STRUCTURAL DESIGN ANALYSIS WHICH IS USED FOR COMPARABLE NUCLEAR UNITS AT FRENCH SITE; HOWEVER, KARUN SEISMIC AND SOIL PARAMETERS ARE SUBSTANTIALLY IDFFERENT FROM FRENCH SITING PARAMETERS; FRAMATOME ABILITY TO BUILD UNITS SAFELY AT KARUN FROM SEISMIC DESIGN VANTAGE POINT IS BEING QUESTIONED AT HIGHEST MINISTERIAL LEVEL HERE.

FRAMATOME BELIEVES THAT BY BUILDING THE UNIT ON A SLIDING PAD, WHICH IN TURN IS ON SOUND FOUNDATION, THEY HAVE AMPLE MARGIN OF SAFETY FOR BOTH HORIZONTAL AND VERTICAL EARTHQUAKE LOADS ANTICIPATED IN KARUN.

PROBLEM WITH FRENCH REASONING SEEMS TO BE THAT FOUNDATION USED FOR THE SLIDING PAD IN FRANCE HAS HIGHER INTEGRITY THAN SIMILAR FOUNDATION IN IRAN, MAINLY BECAUSE OF EXPECTED LARGE DIFFERENTIAL SETTLEMENT OF THE FOUNDATION STRUCTURE AT THE KARUN SITE. A 5 DEGREE TILT DUE TO DIFFERENTIAL SETTLEMENT OF THE SLIDING PAD AND ITS FOUNDATION HAS BEEN CALCULATED TO CAUSE SUPER-STRUCTURE FAILURE.

THE SLIDING PAD CONCEPT HAS NOT REPEAT NOT BEEN EVALUATED IN PRACTICE ON ANY OPERATING NUCLEAR REACTORS ACCORDING TO NOWROOZI. ITS APPLICATION OT DATE HAS BEEN LIMITED TO BRIDGE CONSTRUCTION. THE CONCEPT HAS APPARENTLY BEEN SOLD TO SOUTH AFRICA BUT AT THIS TIME, NUCLEAR SAFETY AUTHORITIES IN SOUTH AFRICA HAVE NOT APPROVED THE CONCEPT EITHER.

NOWROOZI STATED THAT THE DIRECTOR OF FRAMATOME WILL VISIT DR. AHMAD SOTOODEHNIA VICE MINISTER IN CHARGE OF NUCLEAR POWER VERY SOON, TO DISCUSS THIS PROBLEM. IT IS CLEAR THAT THE SAFETY PEOPLE INCLUDING NOWROOZI, AND POSSIBLY FARZIN, HIS DEPUTY, ARE NOT SATISFIED WITH THIS DESIGN ANY LONGER. DR. FARZIN HAD SENT SOME OF THE DOCUMENTS PERTINENT TO AN ANALYSIS OF THE SLIDING PAD ARRANGEMENT TO U.S. NUCLEAR REGULATORY COMMISSION ASKING THEM FOR REACTION IN SPRIN OF 1977. NOWROOZI STATED THAT NRC INDICATED AN IN-DEPTH REVIEW WOULD BE REQUIRED TO JUDGE ADEQUACY OF DESIGN IN COMPARATIVE TERMS, TO USNRC DESIGN CRITERIA.

BECAUSETHE SUBJECT IS OF GREAT SENSITIVITY TO FRAMATOME, THEY ARE RELUCTANT TO HAVE AEOI CONTACT OTHER AGENCIES, PARTICULARLY IN THE U.S.; HOWEVER, UNDER THE SAFETY AGREEMENT WHICH WAS SIGNED AT SHIRAZ BETWEEN NRC AND AEOI, USNRC HAS A LEGITIMATE INVOLVEMENT. IN ADDITION THERE IS SOME LIKELIHOOD THAT U.S. ARCHITECT ENGINEER (GIBBS AND HILL) MAY BECOME COMMERCIALLY INVOLVED IN THE ANALYSIS IN THE NEAR FUTURE.

EMBASSY RECOMMENDS THAT NRC RESPOND THROUGH DEPARTMENT CHANNELS CONCERNING THE EXTENT TO WHICH, UNDER THEIR AGREEMENT WITH AEOI, THEY FEEL NRC HAS IN PAST, AND CAN CONTRIBUTE IN FUTURE, TO THIS VERY IMPORTANT AEOI DECISION MAKING PROCESS.

WE HAVE BEEN UNABLE TO ASCERTAIN WITH ANY ACCURACY THE NUMBER OF AMERICANS WHO HAVE DEPARTED EITHER PERMANENTLY OR TEMPORARILY. THE PICTURE IS VERY MIXED WITH NO DEFINABLE PATTERN. ROUGHLY 1200 BELL HELICOPTER INTL. DEPENDENTS/ EMPLOYEES HAVE GONE HOME SINCE OCTOBER 1. BOEING HAS LOST FIVE EMPLOYEES BUT ABOUT 140 DEPENDENTS HAVE DEPARTED FOR THE IMMEDIATE FUTURE. ON THE OTHER HAND AMERICAN BELL IRAN MAY HAVE A SLIGHT INCREASE. ENROLLMENT AT TEHRAN AMERICAN SCHOOL IS DOWN A LITTLE OVER 10 PERCENT.
IN SUM, THE PICTURE IS MURKY AND WE GUESS REPEAT GUESS 3 - 4000 AMERICANS (NOT COUNTING DUAL NATIONAL IRANIANS) HAVE DEPARTED SINCE EARLY OCTOBER.

NOV 30 SUMMARY: APPROACH OF MOHARRAM BRINGS CONCERN AND RUMORS BUT IRAN IS REALTIVELY QUIET. DEMONSTRATIONS REPORTED IN HAMEDAN, MASHAD, GORGAN AND BABOL. TELEVISION CURTAILED DUE TO STRIKE. GOVT REPORTEDLY SEIZED ARMS IN MASHAD AND REZAIYEH. SENATE RECEIVES BILLS TO DISSOLVE IMPERIAL INSPECTORATE AND TO REHIRE FORMER JUDGES. NABEGH IS RUMORED TO BECOME NIOC DIRECTOR. BBC BROADCAST OF TIMES EDITORIAL CALLING FOR REGENCY COUNCIL TO REPLACE SHAH HAS TOWN BUZZING. ISFAHAN UNIVERSITY FACULTY PROTEST PRESIDENT CARTER'S SUPPORT OF SHAH. END SUMMARY.

APPROACH OF MOHARRAM IS CAUSING EXTRAORDINARY RUSH OF RUMORS, BUT IRAN IS BASICALLY QUIET TO MIDDAY. WE HAVE UNCONFIRMED REPORT OF SHOOTING INCIDENT AT POLICE PRECINCT IN CENTRAL TEHRAN YESTERDAY. DEMONSTRATIONS REPORTEDLY TOOK PLACE IN HAMADAN, GORGAN, MASHAD, AND BABOL. CONSUL TABRIZ REPORTS SITUATION QUIET.

ALREADY POOR DISSEMINATION OF NEWS IS NOW CRIPPLED ON EVE OF MOHARRAM. IT WAS EXPECTED (THOUGH NEVER OFFICIALLY ANNOUNCED) THAT TELEVISION WOULD CEASE DURING THREE HOLIEST DAYS DEC 9-11 IN UNUSUALLY PIOUS OBSERVANCE OF MOHARRAM. THEN YESTERDAY A FIGHT BROKE OUT IN NIRT CAFETERIA OVER SOLDIERS BREAKING INTO LINE. SOLDIERS WERE BEATEN UP, AND TROOP REINFORCEMENTS THEN MOVED INTO NIRT, ROUGHING UP EMPLOYEES. NIRT WORKERS LEFT EN MASSE, DECLARING STRIKE UNTIL DEC 17. EXECUTIVES MANAGED TO KEEP ONE FARSI CHANNEL ON THE AIR BUT ARE CAUGHT BETWEEN MLA ORDERS TO STAY ON THE JOB AND STRIKERS' THREATS THAT ANYONE WHO COMES TO WORK ONCE MOHARRAM BEGINS WILL SUFFER CONSEQUENCES.

MILITARY BELIEVES IT CAN KEEP NIRT IN OPERATION. NIRT INTERNATIONAL RADIO WILL BE REDUCED DURING SAME PERIOD TO 1200-1700. NO POPULAR MUSIC WILL BE BROADCAST FROM BEGINNING OF MOHARRAM THROUGH DEC 16. (COMMENT: IN THE PAST, POPULAR MUSIC LEFT AIRWAVES FOR ONLY THREE HOLIEST DAYS). NEWSPAPER SITUATION IS UNCHANGED. ONE STRIKING NEWSMAN TOLD EMBOFF THAT BAZAAR IS PAYING SALARIES OF STRIKERS.

GOVT ANNOUNCED IT HAS SEIZED ARMS IN MASHAD AND REZAIYEH. AMOUNTS WERE NOT LARGE, THREE-FOUR DOZEN WEAPONS IN ALL, BUT CONFIRMATION THAT OPPOSITION HAS OBTAINED ARMS IS NEW ELEMENT IN SECURITY PICTURE.

SENATE MET YESTERDAY AND APPROVED WITHDRAWAL OF IMMUNITY FROM ALI REZA'I, SENATOR FROM TEHRAN WHO IS WIDELY ACCUSED OF CORRUPTION. JUSTICE MINISTER NAJAFI PRESENTED TWO BILLS-ONE TO REPLACE IMPERIAL INSPECTORATE WITH NEW AGENCY IN HIS MINISTRY, AND ANOTHER TO INVITE THE RETURN OF JUDGES WHO HAVE RESIGNED OR RETIRED. (COMMENT: DEPLETION OF JUDGES CORPS HAS OFTEN BEEN STATED AS MAJOR HINDRANCE TO PURSUIT OF ANTICORRUPTION CAMPAIGN.) SENATORS ALSO DISCUSSED THE SENSATIONAL FRAUDULENT LIST OF IRAFIANS WHO ALLEGEDLY SENT HUGE SUMS OF MONEY OVERSEAS SEPTEL).
( OPPOSITION SENATOR NAINI SAID THAT THE GOVT AND CENTRAL BANK MAY DENY THIS LIE 100 TIMES, BUT PEOPLE HAVE SO LOST FAITH IN THE GOVT THAT THEY WILL NOT BELIEVE THEM.

EMBASSY HAS UNCONFIRMED REPORT THAT DR. MOHAMMAD ALI NABEGH WILL REPLACE ANSARY AS DIRECTOR OF NIOC. NABEGH HAS HELD SEVERAL KEY POSTS IN THE OIL INDUSTRY, MOST RECENTLY, DIRECTOR OF EXPLORATION AND PRODUCTION WITH NIOC. HE IS PRESENTLY A PRIVATE CONSULTANT.

BBC HAS BROADCAST REPORT OF LONDON TIMES EDITORIAL WHICH CALLS FOR SHAH TO RESIGN IN FAVOR OF REGENCY COUNCIL (I.E., CLOSE TO WHAT THE NATIONAL FRONT IS PROPOSING). WITH BBC ALREADY UNDER HEAVY FIRE AND GOI DETERMINED TO HOLD BRITISH GOVT RESPONSIBLE, INCIDENT IS LIKELY TO BRING ADDITIONAL IRANIAN PRESSURE ON BRITISH TO MUZZLE NETWORK. SEVERAL MAJLES DEPUTIES AND NIRT HAVE STRONGLY REACTED. NIRT CALLS BBC THE VOICE OF COLONIALISM.
CONSULATE ISFAHAN REPORTS FACULTY OF UNIVERSITY OF ISFAHAN ARE SENDING LETTER TO PRESIDENT CARTER PROTESTING HIS SUPPORT OF SHAH.

1978TEHRAN11756.subject: SHARIATMADARI AND THE MODERATES SUMMARY: AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI IS DEEPLY CONCERNED THAT MOHARRAM CONFRONTATION BETWEEN RELIGIOUS FAITHFUL

segments.text: SUMMARY: AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI IS DEEPLY CONCERNED THAT MOHARRAM CONFRONTATION BETWEEN RELIGIOUS FAITHFUL AND GOVT WILL LEAD TO EXTENSIVE BLOODSHED. HE AND OTHER AYATOLLAHS IN QOM FEEL A GREAT DEAL OF RESPONSIBILITY FOR THEIR FOLLOWERS. ONE OBSERVER BELIEVES AN INITIATIVE COULD BE MADE BETWEEN THE SHAH AND THE MORE MODERATE RELIGIOUS LEADERS WHICH MIGHT EASE TENSION AND HELP LIMIT PROSPECTS FOR VIOLENCE. END SUMMARY.

AT HIS REQUEST SHAHRIAR AHY MET WITH EMBOFF STEMPEL TO DISCUSS PRESENT SITUATION IN IRAN. AFTER DISCUSSION OF ECONOMIC SITUATION, AHY GOT TO HIS MAIN POINT: HE HAD SPENT FOUR HOURS WITH SHARIATMADARI WEEK OF NOV 13-17. AHY HAD BEEN SENT TO SEE SHARIATMADARI BY HIS UNCLE HUSHANG RAM WHO IS PRESIDENT OF BANK OMARAN AND WHO, ACCORDING TO AHY, HAS BEEN ON THE PHONE WITH THE SHAH EVERY EVENING SINCE NOV 5. AHY SAID SHARIATMADARI IS DEEPLY CONCERNED ABOUT THE PROSPECTS FOR VIOLENCE AND INJURY TO THE FAITHFUL. SHARIATMADARI REACTED VERY STRONGLY TO DISCUSSIONS OF HOW MANY MIGHT BE KILLED IF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI'S CALL FOR PUBLIC CONFRONTATION IS OBEYED.

AHY SAID SHARIATMADARI FEELS SPECIAL RESPONSIBILITY TO AVOID BLOODSHED LEADER OF QOM'S RELIGIOUS SCHOOL, THE HOSSENIEH ELAMIEH. AHY DESCRIBED SHARIATMADARI AS CONCERNED WITH PROBLEMS OF OSQ BZATION AND THE WELFARE OF "HIS PEOPLE." UNLIKE KHOMEINI, WHO HAS HAD NO RESPONSIBILITY FOR 15 YEARS, SHARIATMADARI IS NOT WILLING TO SACRIFICE HUNDREDS OF PEOPLE TO SOME SORT OF ISLAMIC PURITY.

SHARIATMADARI BELIEVES THE SHAH MUST REMAIN. HE IS DEEPLY CONCERNED ABOUT THE PROBLEMS OF GOVERNING IRAN WITHOUT THE SHAH. SHARIATMADARI APPRECIATES THE COMPLICATIONS ANY COALITION GOVERNMENT WILL HAVE, AND IN AHY'S ESTIMATION IS WILLING TO THROW HIS SUPPORT BEHIND "GOOD" COALITION GOVERNMENT.

IF TALKS WERE STARTED BETWEEN THE SHAH AND SHARIATMADARI AT AN ACCEPTABLE LEVEL OF SENIOR OFFICIALDOM, SHARIATMADARI WOULD PROBABLY BACK AWAY FROM CONFRONTATION AT THE LAST MINUTE AND MIGHT CARRY OUTHER AYATOLLAHS WITH HIM. AHY SAID THERE COULD BE NO ADVANCE GUARANTEES, BUT THE MORE SHARIATMADARI HEARS ESTIMATIONS OF VIOLENCE, THE MORE HE RECOILS FROM ACTIVELY ORDERING HIS FOLLOWERS INTO THE STREETS TO CONFRONT THE GOVT. AHY IS CONVINCED THAT, IF SHARIATMADARI EVEN PERCEIVES AN OPENING FOR COALITION IN THE POST-ASHURA PERIOD, HE WILL IN THE FINAL ANALYSIS BREAK WITH KHOMEINI--NOT OPENLY BUT BY SILENCE--WHEN THE ULTIMATE CONFRONTATION COMES.

EMBOFF ASKED AHY WHAT HE HAD IN MIND FOR A DIALOGUE BETWEEN THE SHAH AND SHARIATMADARI. AHY REPLIED PREVIOUS ATTEMPTS BY THE SHAH TO CONTACT SHARIATMADARI HAD BEEN AD HOC AFFAIRS WITH NO FOLLOW THROUGH. SHARIATMADARI IS A PROUD, OLD PERSIAN; HE NEEDS PERSONAL STROKING. AHY'S UNCLE IS CONSIDERING GETTING TOGETHER 5 OR 10 KEY INDIVIDUALS ACROSS THE IRANIAN POLITICAL SPECTRUM AND DISCUSSING THE PROBLEM WITH THE SHAH, THEN CALLING ON SHARIATMADARI.

AHY FRANKLY DOESN'T KNOW IF SUCH A PROCESS COULD EVENTUALLY PRODUCE COALITION GOVT, BUT HE SEEMS IT MIGHT HAVE A POSITIVE EFFECT ON LIMITING THE CHANCES FOR VIOLENCE DURING MOHARRAM, WHICH WOULD KILL ANY ATTEMPT AT A GOVT OF NATIONAL UNION. AHY ADDED THAT SUCH AN EFFORT WOULD AT LEAST HAVE TO HAVE THE TACIT APPROVAL OF THE U.S. FOR TWO REASONS: THE SHAH NEEDS IT PSYCHOLOGICALLY AND HE DOES NOT TRUST HIS OWN INTELLIGENCE SOURCES ANY MORE. AHY ADDED THIS HAD BEEN CLEAR WHEN HE REPORTED ON HIS MEETING WITH SHARIATMADARI TO HIS MAJESTY PERSONALLY.

EMBOFF ASKED AHY TO KEEP IN TOUCH AND LET HIM KNOW WHEN THE APPROACH WOULD BE MADE. EMBOFF ADDED, SPEAKING PERSONALLY, THAT THE SHAH SEEMED INTERESTED IN TALKING WITH MANY PEOPLE AND MIGHT WELL BE INTERESTED IN SUCH AN IDEA.

COMMENT: IT IS DIFFICULT TO SAY WHETHER RAM'S INITIATIVE WILL HAVE ANY BETTER LUCK THAN SEVERAL OTHERS THAT HAVE BEEN TRIED. SHOULD IT GO FORWARD, HOWEVER, IT MIGHT BE USEFUL, AT A MINIMUM, IN COUNTERING THE TENDENCY OF THE MODERATES TO FOLLOW KHOMEINI SLAVISHLY. IT SEEMS CLEAR FROM AHY'S COMMENTS THAT ORDERING THE FAITHFUL INTO THE STREETS IS A MUCH BIGGER WATERSHED FOR THE MODERATES THAN FOR KHOMEINI.

1978TEHRAN11758.subject: POSITION OF MISSION IN POLITICAL DISCUSSIONS

segments.text: FOR THE RECORD, FOLLOWING PARAGRAPHS SUMMARIZE POSITION WHICH ALL ELEMENTS OF THIS MISSION ARE TAKING IN CONTACTS WITH IRANIANS WHO DISCUSS INTERNAL POLTICAL SITUATION. THIS HAS RELEAVANCE PARTICULARLY IN OUR MEETINGS WITH MEMEBERS OF, OR INTERMEDIARIES FOR, THE POLITICAL OPPOSITION.

BEGIN TEXT: WE START FROM OUR CONVICTION THAT SHAH IS SINCERE IN HIS DESIRE TO RETURN THE MONARCHY TO CONSTITUTIONAL PROPORTIONS. BY THIS, WE MEAN THAT HE WOULD, IN EFFECT, "REIGN BUT NOT RULE." HOWEVER, IN ACCORDANCE WITH AMENDMENTS TO THE CONSTITUTION, HE WOULD REMAIN COMMANDER-IN-CHIEF OF IRANIAN ARMED FORCES.

WHILE WE REALIZE THIS LAST POINT IS VERY SENSITIVE TO THOSE CONSTITUTIONALISTS WHO WISH TO ESTABLISH DEMOCRATIC CONTROLS, WE BELIEVE THE ARMED FORCES WILL TAKE ORDER ONLY FROM THE SHAH. WE DO NOT RPT NOT BELIEVE THEY WILL OBEY THE EMPRESS, A REGENCY COUNCIL, OR A CIVILIAN PRIME MINISTER. WITHOUT THE SHAH TO LEAD THEM, WE BELIEVE ARMED FORCES WOULD BECOME A "LOOSE CANNONBALL" WHICH WOULD EVENTUALLY SEEK POLITICAL POWER AND WOULD PRODUCE SUCCESSIVE MILITARY COUPS AND COUNTERCOUPS AS HAS BEEN THE CASE IN NEIGHBORING COUNTRIES.

WHILE WE REALIZE DISTRUST WHICH MOST OPPOSITION LEADERS HAVE IN SHAH'S PROMISES, WE BELIEVE IT IS UNREALISTIC FOR THEM TO INSIST ON SHAH'S ABDICATION. WE BELIEVE THAT THEY SHOULD UNDERTAKE TO NEGOTIATE WITH THE SHAH, EITHER DIRECTLY OR INDIRECTLY, FOR THE FORMATION OF A NATIONAL COALITION GOVT WHICH WOULD ORGANIZE FREE ELECTIONS IN ORDER TO GET FRESH START ON DEMOCRATIC PROCESS.

WE DOUBT AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI WOULD EVEN ENDORSE THIS "COMPROMISE" BECAUSE WE BELIEVE HE HAS IMPLACABLE HATRED FOR SHAH AND FOR THE PAHLAVI DYNASTY. HIS ONLY PROGRAM SEEMS TO BE A NEGATIVE ONE, DESIGNED TO SERVE HIS PERSONAL REVENGE. HIS CONCEPT OF AN "ISLAMIC REPUBLIC" IS NEBULOUS, AND IN THE FACE OF THE POWER CONTROLLED BY THE ARMED FORCES, IS UNREALISTIC. THEREFORE, WE BELIEVE POLITICIANS MUST MAKE THEIR CHOICE BASED ON PROSPECTS FOR RETAINING THE INTEGRITY OF THE COUNTRY AND WITHOUT REFERENCE TO THE PROBABILITY THAT KHOMEINI WOULD RENOUNCE IT.

IN ANY EVENT, WE DOUBT KHOMEINI PERSONALLY COMMANDS ALL THE POWER THAT IS OFTEN ATTRIBUTED TO HIM. WE FEEL MANY GROUPS, WHICH ARE FAR FROM RELIGIOUS MOSLEMS, ACCEPT KHOMEINI AS A SYMBOL AND USE HIS RHETORIC BECAUSE IT SERVES THEIR OWN PURPOSES AND COINCIDES WITH THEIR OWN AIMS. WE DOUBT HE WOULD HAVE MUCH CONCEPT OF HOW TO ORGANIZE THE GOVT OF A NATION.

WE CONSIDER TIME FOR BEGINNING OF REALISTIC NEGOTIATIONS WITH SHAH IS NOW. CONTACTS SHOULD BEGIN BEFORPAMOHARRAM IN ORDER MITIGATE PASSIONS WHICH COULD BE EXPLOITED IF CURRENT STALEMATE CONTINUES. WHILE IT MAY NOT BE POSSIBLE TO FORM GOVT IN IMMEDIATE FUTURE, THE PROCESS OF NEGOTIATTION HAS ITS OWN IMPORTANCE. .

OUR USUAL EXPERIENCE WITH THIS PRESENTATION IS THAT OUR INTERLOCUTORS LISTEN CARFULLY, AGREE WITH EVERY POINT, AND SAY IT IS AN OBVIOUSLY LOGICAL POSITION. THEN, TO OUR CONTINUING FRUSTRATION, THEY CONCLUDE, "NEVERTHELESS, HE HAS TO GO."

DESPITE THIS FRUSTRATION AND DESPITE LACK OF ANY TANGIBLE PROGRESS IN THE POLITICAL PROCESS, WE WILL CONTINUE TO PRESENT THIS POSITION TO OUR INTERLOCUTORS IN THE EXPECTATION THAT EVENTS WILL EVENTUALLY CONFIRM ITS LOGIC.

AS WE ENTER THE EVE OF MOHARRAM, THE MOOD IN IRAN IS EXTREMELY TENSE. PEOPLE OF ALL PERSUASIONS EXPECT BLOODY CLASHES BETWEEN RELIGIOUS DEMONSTRATORS AND TROOPS THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY. THERE IS ALSO WIDESPREAD EXPECTATION OF STRIKES AND SHUTDOWNS IN PUBLIC UTILITIES.

DESPITE THE SELF-INTEREST AND INSTINCT FOR SURVIVAL WHICH WE HAVE COME TO ASSOCIATE WITH IRANIANS, ALL OUR SOUNDINGS PROVE DISTURBING. OUR CONTACTS, DIRECT AND INDIRECT, IN THE BAZAAR AND IN THE RELIGIOUS COMMUNITY, ALL UNIFORMLY INDICATE A MOOD OF DEFIANCE AND CONFRONTATION AGAINST THE SHAH AND THE MILITARY.

WHETHER OR NOT IT REFLECTS BRAVURA OR BLUFF, WE FIND MANY RESPONSIBLE PEOPLE WHO SAY THEY ARE PERSONALLY PREPARED TO BE MARTYRS DURING THIS PERIOD. THE SHRILL CALLS FROM KHOMEINI ARE AVIDLY RECEIVED HERE, DESPITE DIFFICULTIES IN THEIR DISSEMINATION. THE CONVENTIAL WISDOM IS THAT THEY WILL BE MADE MORE EXPLICIT AND MORE INTENSE AS THE PERIOD OF RELIGIOUS FERVOR MOUNTS TO A CLIMAX ON DECEMBER 11.

IN THESE CIRUCUMSTANCES, WE HAVE TO EXERCISE EXTREME CONCERN FOR THE SAFETY AND SECURITY OF THE AMERICAN COMMUNITY HERE. THEY ARE ALREADY SINGLED OUT FOR ATTENTION IN KHOMEINI'S LATEST BLAST. THE MISSION HAS CIRCULATED AN ADVISORY TO THE COMMUNITY RECOMMENDING PRUDENCE IN THEIR CONDUCT DURING THIS PERIOD. WE WILL MONITOR EVENTS AND PROVIDE FURTHER ADVICE AS THE PERIOD PROGRESSES.

TO SUPPLEMENT THIS PROCESS, WE RECOMMEND UTMOST RETICENCE BY OFFICIALS IN WASHINGTON IN MAKING PUBLIC STATEMENTS ABOUT IRAN. NO MATTER HOW CAREFULLY THEY ARE CRAFTED AND WHAT NUANCES ARE INTRODUCED, THEY ARE SPREAD HERE IN DISTORTED FORM. WHETHER BY THE EDITORS OF BBC OR BY THE MULLAHS IN THEIR SERMONS, CHANGES ARE MADE TO GIVE OFFICIAL U.S. STATEMENTS A PROVOCATIVE TENOR. UNFORTUNATELY, THEY ALSO REACH THE U.S. COMMUNITY IN THIS DISTORED FORM, AND GIVE THEM THE FEELING THEY ARE BEING UNNECESSARILY EXPOSED TO HAZARD.

WE REALIZE THE PROBLEMS OF RESTRAINT IN A SOCIETY DEVOTED TO A FREE PRESS AND FREE SPEECH, ESPECIALLY IF IRAN ONCE AGAIN BECOMES A MAJOR FOCUS OF ATTENTION IN THE DAYS AHEAD. BUT, WE WISH TO EMPHASIZE THE SENSITIVITY OF THE PROBLEM HERE.
TEHRAN QUIET AS OF MIDDAY, NO REPORTS YET OF ANY TROUBLE IN PROVINCES.

REPORT CIRCULATING WIDELY HERE SINCE YESTERDAY THAT KHOMEINI HAS ISSUED "ELAMIEH" CALLING FOR DEMONSTRATIONS TO PARADE IN STREETS DURING MOHARRAM WITHOUT SEEKING MILITARY GOVT PERMISSION AND BE PREPARED TO DIE FOR THE CAUSE OF OVERTHROWING SHAH AND HIS DYNASTY. AS DEPT AWARE WE HAVE TEXT IN TRANSLATION OF THIS ELAMICH FROM A RELIABLE SOURCE. IT DESCRIBES SHAH AS "SATANIC" AND HIS "HENCHMEN" AS "PARASITIC" AND URGES PEOPLE TO DRESS IN WHITE AS SYMBOL OF THEIR READINESS TO DIE FOR THE ISLAMIC CAUSE. IT ALSO URGES PREACHERS TO SPREAD THIS WORD WIDELY.

IT PREDICTS A GREAT ISLAMIC VICTORY OF FREEDOM AND JUSTICE OVER CRUELTY AND TREASON, PROCLAMATION OF AN ISLAMIC GOVT, AND SAYS "TORRENTS OF BLOOD WILL BE SPILLED ON ASHURA TO MARK THE DAY OF VENGEANCE AGAINST CRUELTY AND OPPRESSION." ONLY MENTION OF U.S. IS: "ON THE ADVICE OF THE AMERICANS, THE SHAH HAS RUINED AGRICULTURE. HE HAS WEAKENED THE COUNTRY TO BENEFIT THE CAPITALISTS." ELAMICH ENDS WITH PASSAGE PREDICTING "A GREAT ISLAMIC REVOLUTION IN IRAN AND OTHER MOSLEM COUNTRIES."

IN CONNECTION WITH ABOVE, VISITING AMERICAN OBSERVER WITH LONG BACKGROUND IN IRAN TELLS US HE IS AMAZED BY VIGOR AND EFFICIENCY WITH WHICH PRO-KHOMEINI ORGANIZERS ARE PASSING KHOMEINI'S MESSAGE AMOUNG THE PEOPLE OF SOUTHERN TEHRAN. HE HEARD THAT KHOMEINI CALLED FOR 72 VOLUNTEERS TO GIVE THEIR LIVES AS DID THE COMPANIONS OF KERBELA, AND 1500 PEOPLE HAD ALREADY VOLUNTEERED IN TEHRAN BY END OF FIRST DAY. WIRE SERVICE REPORTER TELLS US HE HAS (UNCONFIRMED ) REPORT SOME 7,000 PEOPLE IN QOM ALONE HAVE PREPARED WHITE GARMENTS IN WHICH TO MARCH.
ANOTHER SOURCE TELLS US HE HEARD ON RADIO MOSCOW PERSIAN LANGUAGE SERVICE LAST NIGHT (NOV 30) THAT KHOMEINI HAS CALLED FOR GENERAL STRIKE TOMORROW, DEC 2.

GENERAL STRIKE CALL IS CONFIRMED BY EMBOFF WHO VISITED BAZAAR TODAY. PEOPLE PREPARING FOR GENERAL STRIKE EXPECTED TOMORROW IN BELIEF IT WILL CONTINUE INTO MOHARRAM. HOARDING OF FOOD, COOKING GAS, AND OTHER SUPPLIES TAKING PLACE. PEOPLE FIND SUPPLIES OF FOOD PLENTIFUL BUT EXPENSIVE. THEY ARE HEARD TO COMPLAIN ABOUT FOREIGNERS (ESPECIALLY AMERICANS JAPANESE AND RUSSIANS) WHO GET COUNTRY'S OIL AND GAS SUPPLIES, WHILE CROOKED IRANIANS AT THE TOP, IN LEAGUE WITH THEM, GET THE MONEY FROM THESE SALES.

EMBOFF NOTES ANTI-FOREIGNER SENTIMENT IN BAZAAR MUCH HIGHER THAN IN PREVIOUS YEARS AT MOHARRAM. AMERICANS MOST UNPOPULAR OF FOREIGNERS BECAUSE OF SUPPORT EXPRESSED BY PRESIDENT CARTER FOR SHAH (THOUGH PRESIDENT'S MOST RECENT SUCH STATEMENT, YESTERDAY, HAS NOT YET BECOME WIDELY KNOWN HERE). SEVERAL GOOD BAZAARI FRIENDS OF EMBOFF (ESCUDERO) WARNED HIM HIS LIFE IN DANGER, AND HE SHOULD NOT IDENTIFY HIMSELF AS AMERICAN TO STRANGERS. RUMORS ABOUND.

ONE, RECOUNTED TO HIM AS FACT, WAS (FALSE REPORT) THAT FIVE OR SIX AMERICANS WERE RECENTLY KILLED IN ISFAHAN. ------------------046265 011238Z /12 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1927 INFO USINT BAGHDAD AMCONSUL DHAHRAN USLO PEKING AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY BONN AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY TOKYO USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 11771

SEPARATE RUMOR CIRCULATING SINCE YESTERDAY IS THAT NEW, CIVILIAN GOVT WILL BE INSTALLED TOMORROW. BBC PERSIAN LANGUAGE SERVICE WAS HEARD TO CARRY REPORT NEW CIVILIAN GOVT IN PREPARATION AND MIGHT BE INSTALLED AS EARLY AS TOMORROW OR SUNDAY. THREE NAMES MENTIONED AS POSSIBLE PRIME MINISTERS -- AMINI, ENTEZAM, AND NATIONAL FRONT'S SHAHPUR BAKHTIAR. WE HAVE ASKED BAKHTIAR ABOUT THIS REPORT. HE KNOWS NOTHING MORE THAN WE HAVE ALREADY REPORTED ABOUT THIS AND SERIOUSLY DOUBTS ANY POSSIBILITY MILITARY GOVT WOULD LEAVE BEFORE END OF MOHARRAM.

BAKHTIAR TOLD POL COUNSELOR TODAY THAT A FRIEND OF HIS HAD GIVEN HIM A REPORT WHICH WORRIED HIM. THE FRIEND ARRIVED BY SWISSAIR FROM SWITZERLAND YESTERDAY (NOV 30). THERE WAS A GROUP OF ABOUT TEN PERSONS IN THE PLANE WHO SPOKE NOT A WORD TO ANYONE DURING THE ENTIRE FLIGHT AND COMMUNICATED WITH EACH OTHER BY SIGN LANGUAGE. THEY FRANKLY LOOKED LIKE "CARLOS TYPES." BAKHTIAR SAID HE WAS TRYING TO REACH SAVAK CHIEF MOGHADAM TO PUT HIM INTO CONTACT WITH HIS FRIEND WHO WOULD PROVIDE DETAILS.
BAKHTIAR SAID HE FEARED THESE MIGHT BE SABOTEURS OF SOME NATIONALITY UP TO NO GOOD -- SUCH AS BLOWING UP A DAM OR ELECTRICAL INSTALLATIONS.
ELECTRICITY WAS CUT AGAIN IN MANY SECTIONS OF TEHRAN LAST NIGHT.

AFP CORRESPONDENT TELLS US HE FOUND PM AZHARI EXTREMELY SURE OF HIMSELF AND READY FOR ALL EVENTUALITIES. WHEN HE INTERVIEWED HIM EARLIER HIS WEEK..INTERVIEW APPARENTLY CARRIED IN "LE MONDE" NOV 28, THOUGH WE DO NOT HAVE A COPY YET. AFP MAN SAYS HE SUSPECTS ALI AMINI HIMSELF RESPONSIBLE FOR RUMOR OF IMMINENCE NEW CIVILIAN GOVT AS PART OF POWER PLAY TO FORCE SUCH DEFELOPMENT. THAT IS A POSSIBILITY, THOUGH WE ARE NOT AWARE AMINI IS THAT FAR INTO HIS TASK OF PULLING TOGETHER POSSIBLE NEW GOVT YET.

HOMEMADE EXPLOSIVE DEVICE TOSSED THROUGH HOME WINDOW OF AMERICAN SERGEANT (WHO WORKS AT ARMISH/MAAG HOSPITAL IN TEHRAN) LAST NIGHT CAUSING SOME SUPERFICIAL INJURIES FROM BROKEN GLASS. SMALL FIRE EASILY PUT OUT.

1978TEHRAN11776.subject: ESCUDERO-TAVAKOLI MEMCON OF NOV 30 SUMMARY: DISCUSSIONS WITH VARIOUS BAZAAR MERCHANTS ON LAST DAY BEFORE MOHARRAM REVEAL HIGHLY VOLATILE SITUATI

segments.text: SUMMARY: DISCUSSIONS WITH VARIOUS BAZAAR MERCHANTS ON LAST DAY BEFORE MOHARRAM REVEAL HIGHLY VOLATILE SITUATION. CONBINATION OF FUEL SHORTAGE, HIGH FOOD PRICES, XENOPHOBIA, OPPOSITION TO SHAH AND USUAL RELIGIOUS FRENZY ASSOCIATED WITH MOHARRAM HAVE INCREASED READINESS OF MANY PEOPLE TO GO ON STRIKE AND TO TAKE TO THE STREETS IN DEFIANCE OF GOI BAN ON DEMONSTRATIONS. JEWISH BAZAARIS APPEAR TO BE PLAYING AN EXTREMELY CAUTIOUS ROLE WHILE HOPING MUSLIM EMOTIONS WILL NOT BE DIRECTED AGAINST THEM. END SUMMARY.

EMBOFF ESCUDERO VISITED FRINGES OF GREAT BAZAAR DEC 1. (IT BEING FRIDAY, MOST OF MAIN BAZAAR AREA WAS CLOSED) TO GET SAMPLING OF VIEWS JUST BEFORE MOHARRAM. BLACK MOURNING BANNERS WERE DISPLAYED IN PROFUSION AND PEOPLE, IN ANTICIPATION OF GENERAL STRIKE IN BAZAAR WHICH MANY BELIEVE WILL BEGIN DEC 2, ARE STOCKING UP ON FUEL OIL AND FOODSTUFFS WHILE COMPLAINING BITTERLY OF HIGH PRICES. KEROSENE IS, OF COURSE, IN SHORT SUPPLY, BUT THERE APPEARED TO BE AMPLE COOKING OIL, RICE, EGGS AND FRESH MEAT. HOWEVER, BAZAARIS COMPLAIN THEY CAN AFFORD ONLY SMALL QUANTITIES OF THESE IRANIAN STAPLES.

THEY BLAME INFLATION AND THEIR OWN DETERIORATING ECONOMIC POSITION SIMULTANEOUSLY ON THE CORRUPTION OF HIGH-LEVEL OFFICIALS AND FOREIGN COUNTRIES, PARTICULARLY THE UNITED STATES, WHICH TAKE IRAN'S MONEY AND NATURAL RESOURCES AND SERVE AS HAVENS FOR MONEY SPIRITED OUT OF IRAN BY CORRUPT OFFICIALS. THE SHORTAGE OF KEROSENE, NATURAL GAS AND GASOLINE IS ALSO BLAMED ON PURCHASE CONTRACTS BY FOREIGN COUNTRIES, WHO, THE BAZAARIS FEEL, BUY UP AND EXPORT ALL THE OIL, LEAVING TOO LITTLE FOR IRANIANS. THE U.S., UK, JAPAN AND THE SOVIET UNION RECEIVE PROMINENT MENTION IN THIS REGARD.

XENOPHOBIA IS ALWAYS PRESENT IN IRAN AND IS ESPECIALLY NOTICEABLE DURING MOHARRAM. HOWEVER, ANTIFOREIGN AND ESPECIALLY ANTI-AMERICAN EMOTIONS NOW RUNNING STRONGER IN BAZAAR THAN AT ANY TIME IN EMBOFF 'S PREVIOUS EXPERIENCE. EMBOFF'S OLD FRIENDS AMONG BAZAARIS WELCOMED HIM TO THEIR HOMES AND SHOPS -- GIVEN STRICTURES OF IRANIAN HOSPITALITY THEY COULD HARDLY DO OTHERWISE. HOWEVER, THEY URGED EMBOFF TO IDENTIFY HIMSELF AS FRENCH OR GERMAN IF ASKED, RATHER THAN AMERICAN. SEVERAL REPEATED RUMOR THAT FOUR OR FIVE AMERICANS HAVE BEEN SLAIN IN ISFAHAN AND ALL ADVISED EMBOFF TO STAY OUT OF BAZAAR DURING MOHARRAM. EVEN OLD FRIENDS EXPRESSED ANIMOSITY TOWARDS USG, BASED UPON SUPPORT BY CARTER ADMINISTRATION FOR SHAH.

BAZAARIS DID NOT SEEM WELL-INFORMED AS TO NATURE OR DETAILS OF U.S. SUPPORT FOR SHAH BUT ALL WERE AWARE THAT SUCH SUPPORT EXISTS AND ALL EXPRESSED OPPOSITION TO IT. THE BAZAARIS WERE EXCESSIVELY CRITICAL OF THE SHAH, INSISTING THAT HE MUST GO AND HOLDING HIM RESPONSIBLE FOR VARIOUS ILLEGAL AND IRRELIGIOUS ACTS SUCH AS THE CONTINUED SHOOTING OF IRANIAN DEMONSTRATORS. THE MOST CHARITABLE COMMENT MADE ABOUT THE SHAH WAS THAT, AS ONLY ONE MAN, HE CULD DO LITTLE TO HALT THE NATIONS'S DOWNWARD ECONOMIC SLIDE. BUT THIS REMARK WAS WITHIN CONTEXT OF A CONDEMNATION OF U.S. AND USSR FOR EXPLOITATION OF IRANIAN NATURAL RESOURCES.

BAZAARIS WERE ALL AWARE OF KHOMEINI'S CALL FOR A GENERAL STRIKE BEGINNING DEC 2 AND FOR MOHARRAM DEMONSTRATIONS IN DEFIANCE OF GOI PROHIBITIONS. WITH EXCEPTION OF JEWISH MERCHATS, BAZAARIS WERE PREPARED TO CLOSE DOWN IN SUPPORT OF STRIKE CALL BUT, ALTHOUGH THEY EXPECTED DEMOS TO TAKE PLACE, THEY WERE SOMEWHAT EVASIVE REGARDING THE POSSIBILITY OF THEIR OWN PARTICIPATION.

BASED ON CONVERSATIONS WITH THREE JEWISH MERCHANTS, IT APPEARS THAT THE JEWISH COMMUNITY INTENDS TO AVOID INVOLVEMENT IN THE STRUGGLE BETWEEN THE SHAH AND KHOMEINI BUT REMAINS NERVOUS AS TO ITS FATE IF THE CONSERVATIVE MOSLEMS SHOULD WIN. WHEN THE PRESENT TROUBLES BEGAN THE JEWISH COMMUNITY WAS STARTLED BY THREATS TO CONFISCATE THEIR PROPERTY AND EXPEL THEM FROM IRAN. LATER HOWEVER, KHOMEINI STATED THAT, AS THE JEWS HAVE LIVED PEACEFULLY IN IRAN FOR CENTURIES UNDER THE MANTLE OF ISLAM, THEY SHOULD NOT BE BOTHERED NOW. BECAUSE THE JEWS FEAR THAT HE OR SOME SUCCESSOR MIGHT CHANGE, THEY ARE NOT ACQUIRING NEW INVENTORY AND ARE MAXIMIZING THEIR LIQUIDITY.

THE JEWISH MERCHANTS NOTED THAT THEIR COMMUNITY RELIES UPON ITS ELDERS, PARTICULARLY SENATOR YUSEF KOHAN. THEY SEEMED TO FEEL THAT BECAUSE OF ITS SPECIAL RELATIONSHIP WITH ISRAEL, THE USG HAS SOME OBLIGATION TO IRANIAN JEWS.

COMMENT: A GENERAL STRIKE IN THE BAZAAR IS A VIRTUAL CERTAINTY AND IT ALSO SEEMS LIKELY THAT SOME KIND OF DEMONSTRATION WILL TAKE PLACE IN THE BAZAAR DEC 2.
