1978TEHRAN11777.subject: REPORTS OF WAVERING OF LOYALTY AMONG NAVAL PERSONNEL

segments.text: NAVAL PERSONNEL

IN DECEMBER 2 DISCUSSION WITH JAMSHID BROTHERS IN BANDAR ABBAS, PRINCE SHAHIYAR COMMENTED THAT SOME NON-COM AND ENLISTED MEN AMONG THE NAVY ARE BEGINNING TO TALK AMONG THEMSELVES REGARDING THE POSSIBILITY THAT KHOMEINI MIGHT BE RIGHT AND THAT SHAH MUST GO. SHAHIYAR SAID IRANIAN NAVAL OFFICERS ARE MOST CONCERNED ABOUT THESE REPORTS, WHICH HAVE ONLY COME TO THEIR ATTENTION WITHIN PAST MONTH AND WHICH THEY REGARD AS EVIDENCE OF GROWING DETERIORATION OF MORALE AMONG LOWER LEVELS OF IRANIAN MILITARY.

REFERRING TO RECENT DEMONSTRATIONS IN BANDAR ABBAS, SHAHIYAR NOTED THAT POLICE HAD ORDERS TO FIRE FIRST BURST UP INTO THE AIR. CONSEQUENTLY, FIRST CANISTERS OF TEAR GAS WERE DISCHARGED STRAIGHT UP AND FELL BACK AMONG POLICE WHO HAD TO RETIRE IN DISORDER, LEAVING THE FIELD TO THE DEMONSTRATORS. THERE WERE NO INJURIES.

1978TEHRAN11779.subject: E AND E PLAN FOR IRAN

segments.text: OUR E AND E PLAN BASED PRIMARILY ON AIR TRANSPORT FROM TEHRAN AND OTHER CITIES. HOWER, DEPARTURE BY LAND FROM TABRIZ CONSULAR AREA IS UN OPTION. AMERICANS IN TABRIZ CONSULAR AREA TOTAL ABOUT 1040.
FRANKFURT, ROME, AND ATHENS HAVE BEEN DESIGNATED SAFEHAVENS IN THE EVEN E AND E PLAN ACTIVATED.

1978TEHRAN11781.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT DEC 2 SUMMARY: WIDESPREAD DEMONSTRATIONS AFTER CURFEW LAST NIGHT LED TO VERY HEAVY FIRING BY SECURITY FORCES IN MAN

segments.text: SUMMARY: WIDESPREAD DEMONSTRATIONS AFTER CURFEW LAST NIGHT LED TO VERY HEAVY FIRING BY SECURITY FORCES IN MANY AREAS OF TEHRAN. OPPOSITION CLAIMS HEAVY CASUALTIES, ASKS EMB TO EPD THE KILLING. TWO AYATOLLAHS PLAN CALL FOR GENERAL STRIKE. SHOOTING AND MORE DEMONSTRATIONS THIS MORNING IN TEHRAN. WEAPONS MOVING INTO IRAN. POWER OUTAGES. MORE POLITICAL PRISONERS TO BE RELEASED. END SUMMARY

AS MOHARRAM ARRIVED LAST EVENING, DEMONSTRATORS IMMEDIATELY DEFIED CURFEW, EXITING MOSQUES AND TAKING TO STREET IN LARGE NUMBERS. RESULT WAS VIOLENT CONFRONTATIONS WITH HEAVY FIRING IN AT LEAST FIVE SECTIONS OF CITT. GOVT ANNOUNCED 7 KILLED, 26 WOUNDED, OVER 100 ARRESTED. SOURCE IN POSITION TO KNOW SAYS FIGURE MAY BE SUBSTANTIALLY HIGHER. AMCITS THROUGHOUT TEHRAN LISTENED TO HEAVY FIRING, INCLUDING AUTOMATIC WEAPONS, FROM 2100 (BEGINNING OF CURFEW) TO 0130. ARMOR WAS ALSO HEARD MOVING IN NORTHEASTERN TEHRAN. SECTIONS OF CITY INVOLVED WERE DISPERSED FROM SOUTH TO NORTH. OPPOSITION CLAIMS MANY MORE KILLED THAN GOI ADMITS.
OBSERVERS WHO CHECKED SITES THIS MORNING FOUND NO EVIDENCE OF A BATTLEGROUND AND NO PROPERTY HAS BEEN DAMAGED AS HAS USUALLY OCCURRED. THERE ARE NO REPORTS OF INJURIES TO AMCITS.

OPPOSITIONISTS CONTACTED EMBOFF STEMPEL EVENING DEC 1 TO REPORT CROWDS FLEEING MOSQUES. COMMITTEE FOR THE DEFENSE OF HUMAN RIGHTS AND FREEDOM TREASURER MINATCHI SAID HE WAS TRYING TO CONTACT SENIOR GOI OFFICIALS TO GET SHOOTING STOPPED. HE SAID CROWDS HAD BROKEN OUT OF MOST SIZABLE MOSQUES IN SOUTH TEHRAN AND WERE ENGAGED IN CONFRONTATION WITH MILITARY. LIBERATION MOVEMENT OF IRAN CONTACT REPORTED SAME INCIDENTS AND CALLED UPON U.S. TO "MAKE THEM (GOI) STOP FIRING." EMBOFF POINTED OUT USG WAS NOT INVOLVED IN FIRING AND IN FACT HAD BEEN WORKING AWFULLY HARD, AS LMI REP WELL KNOW, TO WORK OUT COMPROMISE TO AVOID BLOODSHED.

LMI REP THEN SAID IMPLIATIONS OF PRESENT EVENTS WOULD MAKE IT "NOT SAFE" FOR AMERICANS TO GO OUT. EMBOFF REPLIED THAT WE CERTAINLY HOPED LMI AND OTHERS, IF THEY SOUGHT CONFRONTATION, WOULD CONFINE IT TO INTERESTED PARTIES AND NOT EXTEND IT TO BYSTANDERS. LMI REP HOPED FOR BEST, BUT WAS PESSIMISTIC AND INDICATED HE WOULD BE IN TOUCH AGAIN. LMI REP CALLED AGAIN DEC 2 AND INDICATED FIRING CONTINUED, AND AGAIN URGED USG TO ACT TO EASE SHAH OUT.

LARGE PEACEFUL MARCH TOOK PLACE IN MASHAD YESTERDAY. CONSUL TABRIZ REPORTS QUIET WITH ALL SHOPS CLOSED; INDUSTRY IS OPERATIING WITH EXCEPTION OF ONE FACTORY STRIKE. CONSUL SHIRAZ REPORTS QUIET. TENSION CONTINUES IN ISFAHAN. NIGHT BEFORE LAST AN AMCIT'S HOME WAS ALMOST COMPLETELY DESTROYED BY GAS EXPLOSION SET BY INTRUDERS. TWO AMCITS WERE HOME BUT ESCAPED INJURY AS THE SECTION OF HOUSE WHICH THEY OCCUPIED WITHSTOOD BLAST. LAST NIGHT 5 AMERICAN-OWNED (ALL BHI) VEHICLES WERE FIREBOMBED.

THERE WERE TROOPS IN FRONT OF CONSULATE. ------------------001384 031959Z /64 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 1936 INFO USINT BAGHDAD AMCONSUL DHAHRAN USLO PEKING AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY BONN AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MUSCAT NEW DELHI 32"7 AMEMBASSY PARIS AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY TOKYO USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 11781 CONSUL REPORTS AT LEAST THREE MULLAHS IN SEPARATE MOSQUES HAVE TOLD PEOPLE TO IDENTIFY AMERICAN DWELLINGS, BREAK IN, AND REMOVE FURNITURE FOR BURNING IN STREET. MULLAHS SAID NOT TO INJURE AMERICANS.
SIGNS HAVE BEEN PAINTED AT ENTRACE TO KUCHE STREETS INDICATING WHICH HOUSES ON THAT KUCHE ARE OCCUPIED BY AMERICANS.

CONSUL ISFAHAN HAS INFORMATION FIREARMS AVAILABLE TO OPPOSITION. LEBANESE NATIONAL MARRIED TO AMCIT TOLD HIM PRICE OF FIREARMS IN LEBANON HAS DRASTICALLY INCREASED BECAUSE SO MANY IRANIAN AGENTS ARE PURCHASING THEM. IANIAN TOLD EMBOFF THAT WEAPONS WERE AVAILABLE FOR PURCHASE IN ISFAHAN; WHEN PRESSED, HE PRODUCED HIS OWN HANDGUN WHICH HE SAID HE HAD JUST PURCHASED. (COMMENT: FIREARMS ARE STRICTLY CONTROLLED IN IRAN AND ARE GENERALLY UNOBTAINABLE EXCEPT FOR SECURITY FORCES.)

POWER WAS OUT ACROSS IRAN THIS MORNING IN ACCORDANCE WITH WORKERS' PREVIOUS ANNOUNCEMENT OF OUTAGES 0900-1200. NEXT SCHEDULED OUTAGE IS EVENING DEC 4. CONSUL ISFAHAN REPORTS TELEPHONE EMPLOYEES MAY JOIN THE ONGOING SERIES OF POLITICALLY-BASED STOPPAGES. THEY ALREADY USE THEIR POSITION TO ALLOW IRANIANS TO BREAK INTO AMERICAN CONVERSATIONS, SHOUTING INSULTS.
MINISTER OF JUSTICE HOSSEIN NAJAFI ANNOUNCED NOV 30 THAT MORE POLITICAL PRISONERS WOULD BE RELEASED THIS WEEK AND THAT INQUIRY INTO WEALTH OF IMPERIAL FAMILY WOULD OPEN TODY.

MOOD CONTINUES TENSE TODAY. TEHRAN AMERICAN SCHOOL AND COMMUNITY SCHOOL ARE CLOSED; PIRUZI IS OPEN. NEARLY ALL SHOPS ARE CLOSED. UPI SOURCE IN CONTACT WITH SHARIAT-MADARI REPORTS THE AYATOLLAH SPOKE WITH ATATOLLAH SHIRAZI OF MASHAD TODAY AND MAY CALL FOR GENERAL STRIKE THIS AFTERNOON. EMBOFF LEARNED FROM BAZAAR SOURCE THAT TEHRAN BAZAAR, WHICH DID NOT OPEN TODAY, WILL PROBABLY REMAIN CLOSED FOR 7 DAYS LEADING UP TO TRADITIONAL 6-DAY MOHARRAM CLOSING PERIOD. SHOTS ARE HEARD AGAIN TODAY AND WE HAVE CONFIRMED REPORTS OF SOME SHOOTING INTO CROWDS. TROUBLE IS AGAIN WIDESPREAD WITH CROWDS ASSEMBLING AT SUCH DISTANT PLACES AS PARLIAMENT SQUARE AND NIRT HEADQUARTERS.

AT LEAST TWO GROUPS APPARENTLY HAD EMBASSY AS GOAL AND ONE REACHED MAIN GATE ABOUT NOON BEFORE TROOPS DISPERSED IT. GROUPS OBSERVED BY EMBOFFS HAVE PLAYED FLUID CATAND-MOUSE GAME WITH TROOPS, SCATTERING WHEN TROOPS FIRE OVER THEIR HEADS AND REASSEMBLING A BLOCK AWAY. TROOP REINFORCEMENTS HAVE ARRIVED NEAR EMBASSY. DESPITE DEMONSTRATIONS, WE HAVE SO FAR SEEN NO RPT NO COLLAPSE OF PUBLIC ORDER AS OCCURRED NOV 5. TROOPS ARE ACTIVELY BREAKING UP CROWDS WHEREEVER THEY CONFRONT THEM, AND WE KNOW OF NO BURNING OR LOOTING. WE UNDERSTAND GOVT EXPECTS FURTHER AFTER-CURFEW DEMONSTRATIONS TONIGHT. SO POTENTIAL FOR VIOLENCE REMAINS HIGH. DEMONSTRATORS MAY GO DOOR-TO-DOOR SOLICITING OTHER PARTICIPANTS.

PRIMIN AZHARI HAS CALLED FOR INVESTIGATION INTO LAST NIGHT'S CONFRONTATION, WHICH INSTANTLY DASHED HOPES OF THOSE FEW OPTIMISTS WHO HAD BELIEVED MOHARRAM MIGHT NOT BRING NEW VIOLENCE. MORE DEMONSTRATORS WILL PROBABLY BE KILLED TONIGHT AND SUBSEQUENTLY AS OPPOSITION TRIES TO PRESS SECURITY FORCES TO THE BREAKING POINT. IN THIS REGARD WE ARE STARTING TO RECEIVE A FEW REPORTS THAT MIDDLE GRADE OFFICERS OF IIAF AND IIN BELIEVE SHAH CANNOT HOLD ON AND WILL HAVE TO LEAVE THE COUNTRY.

CONSUL METRINKO FROM TABRIZ JUST INFORMED US THAT AMCIT CHIEF OF UN BRANCH OF WATERSHED MANAGEMENT PROJECT IN MAHABAD TOLD HIM THAT UN OFFICE AND CAR WERE BURNED OUT MORNING DEC 2, ALONG WITH A NUMBER OF OTHER GOVERNMENT OFFICES. NO ONE RPT NO ONE WAS INJURED.

1978TEHRAN11782.subject: MOOD AMONG TEHRAN RIOTERS: EMBOFF'S OBSERVATIONS

segments.text: EMBOFF SPENT SEVERAL HOURS ON TEHRAN STREETS THIS MORNING OBSERVING GROUPS OF DEMONSTRATORS AND REACTIONS OF MILITARY TO WHAT WAS A VERY FLUID AND ALMOST WHOLLY NON-VIOLENT MOB ACTION. SMALL KNOTS OF DEMONSTRATORS WOULD COALESCE FROM AMONG THE LARGE NUMBER OF PEOPLE ON THE STREETS, SHOUT RELIGIOUS AND ANTI-SHAH SLOGANS AND THEN DISPERSE QUICKLY WHEN MILITARY FIRED SHORT BURSTS OF MACHINEGUN FIRE INTO AIR. EMBOFF WAS SOMETIMES AS CLOSE TO 30 METERS TO FIRING TROOPS AND WAS EASILY ABLE TO DETERMINE THAT NO RPT NO DEMONSTRATORS WERE HIT IN DEMONSTRATIONS HE WITNESSED. (THERE ARE UNCONFIRMED REPORTS FROM ELSEWHERE IN CITY THAT SOME DEMONSTRATORS HAVE BEEN KILLED OR INJURED.)

ANTI-AMERICANISM PLAYS SIGNIFICANT ROLE IN ANIMATING DEMONSTRATORS. FRESH SLOGANS HAVE BEEN PAINTED ON EMBASSY COMPOUND WALLS AND SMALL HANDWRITTEN POSTERS TAPED TO WALLS ON STREETS RAILING AGAINST AMERICANS AS WELL AS SHAH. ON TWO OCCASIONS LARGER (ABOUT 100) AND BETTER ORGANIZED GROUPS OF DEMONSTRATORS ATTEMPTED TO REACH U.S. EMBASSY. FIRST GROUP WAS TURNED BACK SOME TWO BLOCKS FROM ITS GOAL BUT SOME MEMBERS OF SECOND GROUP WERE ABLE TO PARADE PAST EMBASSY COMPOUND.

DEMONSTRATORS WERE ALMOST ENTIRELY YOUNG PEOPLE. NO RELIGIOUS FIGURES WERE OBSERVED AMONG DEMONSTRATORS BUT SOME OF THE YOUNG, STUDENT-AGED DEMONSTRATORS WERE CLEARLY EXPERIENCED IN SUCH MATTERS AND CAUTIONED THOSE RUNNING FROM MILITARY GUNFIRE TO WALK SLOWLY LEST THEY EXCITE THE SOLDIERS AND DRAW FIRE.

NATURALLY RUMORS ABOUND REGARDING HUGE NUMBERS OF DEAD AND WOUNDED. OFFICIAL FIGURES, ACCORDING TO 2:00 P.M. NEWS ARE EIGHT DEAD, 35 WOUNDED AND 150 ARRESTED. EMBOFF PERSONALLY CHECKED OUT TALE OF 30 DEAD DURING DEMO AT CENTRAL BANK AND FOUND NO EVIDENCE THAT ANY SORT OF VIOLENT CONFRONTATION HAD TAKEN PLACE THERE. EMBASSY LOCAL POLITICAL ADVISOR INVESTIGATED STORY OF HEAVY FIGHTING NEAR PARLIAMENT BUILDING AND WAS RELIABLY INFORMED THAT REPORT WAS UNTRUE. AT 3:00 P.M. SEMBOFF AGAIN RAN SPOT CHECK ON STREETS BETWEEN EMBASSY AND BAZAAR AND FOUND THEM ALMOST DESERTED. SOME SHOPS WERE OPEN EARLIER IN THE DAY BUT ALL ARE CLOSED NOW.

CITY APPEARS OMINOUSLY QUIET WITH TROOPS STILL ON THE SCENE BUT SITTING IN THEIR TRUCKS AND MOST PEOPLE ARE OFF THE STREETS. SAME CONDITION PREVAILS AS OF 1630 LOCAL BUT POST-CURFEW ACTION ANTICIPATED AGAIN TONIGHT.

COMMENT: MOST STRIKING ASPECT OF THE DAY'S ACTIVITIES WAS THAT RIOTERS MADE NO ATTEMPT TO BURN BUILDINGS AND NO BROKEN WINDOWS WERE OBSERVED. DEMONSTRATORS CLEARLY HAD NO INCLINATION TO CONFRONT THE MILITARY AND THE LATTER REACTED WITH THE MINIMUM APPLICATION OF FORCE. SULLIVAN NOTE BY OC/T: MESSAGE DELAYED IN TRANSMISSION.

THE ATTENTION OF IRANIANS AND FOREIGNERS ALIKE IS NOW FOCUSED ALMOST EXCLUSIVELY ON THE TEST OF STRENGTH WHICH KHOMEINI HAS NOW CALLED FOR. WE APPRECIATE THE THOUGHTFUL MESSAGE (REFTEL) WITH ITS IDEAS OF HOW WE OR OTHERS CAN HELP PREVENT OR MODERATE THE CLASH. UNHAPPILY, WE SEE NO DEUS EX MACHINA AVAILABLE TO US OR OTHER FOREIGNERS WHICH COULD BE EFFECTIVE IN A MAJOR WAY IN WHAT IS AN INTERNAL CRISIS, THE OUTCOME OF WHICH IS GOING TO BE DETERMINED BY PERSIANS.

HOWEVER, THE FOLLOWING COMMENTS ARE KEYED TO THE REFTEL AND NOTE AREAS WHERE ACTIONS MIGHT AMELIORATE AN OTHERWISE SOMBER SITUATION. A.1. ALMOST ANY STATEMENT U.S. OFFICIALS MAKE ABOUT IRAN IS DISTORTED BY THE TIME IT REACHES THE PUBLIC. A CALL BY THE U.S. FOR CONCILATION, ETC, WOULD UNFORTUNATELY BE VIEWED BY THE SHAH, THE MILITARY, AND THE OPPOSITION AS A WAVERING IN OUR POSITION, THEREBY WEAKENING THE RESOLVE OF THE SHAH AND HIS SUPPORTERS AND STRENGTHENING THAT OF THE OPPOSITION. A.2.

WITH RESPECT TO THE NATIONAL FRONT, WE HAVE PUSHED THEM AND THE SHAH TO MOVE MORE RAPIDLY TO REACH AGREEMENT ON A NATIONAL GOVERNMENT BUT SEE LITTLE LIKELIHOOD WE CAN STEP UP THE PACE. IN DEALING WITH THE SHAH, THE OPPOSITION ELEMENTS DO NOT WISH TO EFFECT A COMPROMISE WHILE THE OUTCOME OF MOHARRAM IS STILL UNCERTAIN. IF KHOMEINI SHOULD PREVAIL, THEY WISH TO BE ON HIS TEAM. ALSO, THE NATIONAL FRONTERS HAVE LITTLE OR NO DIRECT INFLUENCE AT THIS TIME WITH KHOMEINI AND HIS SUPPORTERS -- THE PEOPLE WHO SPEARHEAD THE REVOLT AGAINST THE SHAH.

THERE IS, ON THE OTHER HAND, SOME EVIDENCE THAT MANY NATIONAL FRONTERS SHARE A COMMON DESIRE WITH THE MORE MODERATE AYATOLLAHS TO REDUCE THE VIOLENCE SO AS TO CREATE AN ATMOSPHERE MORE CONDUCIVE TO NEGOTIATIONS FOR A NATIONAL GOVERNMENT IN THE POST-MOHARRAM PERIOD. WE ARE ENCOURAGING THEM IN THIS EFFORT. A.3. THE PEOPLE WHO MAY BE PREPARED TO FACE THE BULLETS DURING MOHARRAM WILL NOT BE DETERRED BY THIRD COUNTRY APPEALS BUT IT IS POSSIBLE THE MODERATE RELIGIOUS LEADERS COULD BE BUCKED UP IN THEIR DESIRE TO MINIMIZE BLOODSHED. KING HUSSEIN HAS SAID HE WILL MAKE SUCH AN EFFORT.

DEPARTMENT MAY HAVE THOUGHTS ON OTHER MUSLIM LEADERS WHO MAY BE ABLE TO BRIDE THE SHIA-SUNNI GAP. FRANKLY, WE ARE UNCERTAIN WHETHER KUWAITI OR SAUDI RULERS OR RECTOR OF AL AZHAR HAVE THE KINDS OF CONTACT AND INFLUENCE TO BE HELPFUL. AN EFFORT IN THIS DIRECTION COULD DO NO HARM.

FOOD SUPPLIES ARE ADEQUATE FOR SEVERAL MONTHS BUT STRIKES AND OTHER DISTRIBUTIONAL PROBLEMS MAY CREATE TEMPORARY SHORTAGES IN VARIOUS AREAS. COLD STORAGE HAS ABOUT THREE MONTHS' SUPPLY OF POULTRY/EGGS/ FRUIT. RICE AND WHEAT ARE IN GOOD SUPPLY. DOMESTIC WHEAT CROP WAS ABOUT FIVE MILLION TONS AND GOVERNMENT HAS ABOUT 750,000 TONS IN RESERVE STORAGE; 90-100,000 TONS OF RICE ARE ALSO IN GOVERNMENT STORAGE. FEED GRAINS, PARTICULARLY FOR POULTRY, ARE IN LOW SUPPLY BUT THIS IS NORMAL PATTERN. THIS COULD CAUSE SCARCITY OF POULTRY EARLY NEXT YEAR. ALSO, DELAYS IN ISSUANCE OF LETTERS OF CREDIT MAY RESULT IN ISOLATED SHORTAGES NEXT YEAR.
IN SUM, SUPPLIES ARE SUFFICIENT FOR THE TIME BEING BUT WE MAY HAVE TO GIVE PRIORITY ATTENTION AND ASSISTANCE TO FOOD SITUATION NEXT YEAR.

CUSTOMS PICTURE HAS BEEN VERY MIXED. CUSTOMS AT PORTS ARE WORKING, WE ARE TOLD, BUT PROBLEM IS TRANSPORTATION FROM POSTS. MEHRABAD AIRPORT CUSTOMS CLEARANCE IS A SOMETIMES THING; OPEN FOR SOME GOOD AT IRREGULAR HOURS. RESPONSIBLE MINISTERS ALLEGE THEY ARE STRUGGLING FOR RESOLUTION, BUT WE SEE NO EVIDENCE OF SUCCESS. THIS AREA OF BUREAUCRACY IS CLEARLY DISAFFECTED.

AMBASSADOR SEVERAL TIMES IN PAST HAS RAISED WORLD BANK ASSISTANCE AND, AS REFTEL NOTES, SECRETARY BLUMENTHAL DID SO. SO FAR THERE SIMPLY IS NO INTEREST. WHEN POLITICAL SITUATION ONCE AGAIN SETTLES DOWN, AND GOI ASSESSES FULL ECONOMIC IMPACT OF DISORDER OF LAST THREE MONTHS, IT MAY BE MORE RECEPTIVE TO KINDS OF HELP WORLD BANK CAN OFFER. WE SHALL KEEP THIS VERY MUCH IN MIND.

AMBASSADOR WHO DISCUSSED GOI POSTURE ON MOHARRAM PROCESSIONS AGAIN WITH PRIME MINISTER DECEMBER 3 AND IS REPORTING SEPTEL. OTHER EMBASSY REPORTS WHICH HAVE BEEN SUBMITTED GIVE FLAVOR OF DISTURBANCES BEING EXPERIENCED IN TEHRAN.

WE APPLAUD EMBOFF JIDDA'S CONTINUING GOOD UNDERSTANDING OF SITUATION IN IRAN AND HIS FULL REPORT ON CONVERSATION NOV 22 WITH SAUDI FOREIGN MINISTER PRINCE SA'UD (AS WELL AS CONVERSATION NOV 20 WITH SENIOR IRANIAN DIPLOMAT, SEPTEL NOTAL). WOULD LIKE TO CALL TO ADDRESSEES' ATTENTION HOWEVER, THAT COMMENT (IN PARA 5 REFTEL) TO THE EFFECT SHAH MIGHT BACKTRACK ON REFORMS AND ON GIVING UP REAL POWER RUNS CONTRARY TO U.S. POLICY POSITION THAT WE BELIEVE SHAH IS SINCERE IN BEING PREPARED TO MAKE SUCH REFORMS AND GRADUALLY GIVE UP MOST OF HIS POWER, EXCEPT CONTROL OVER THE MILITARY.

WE THINK IT WOULD BE UNFORTUNATE IF SAUDI FOREIGN MINISTER -- OR ANY ONE ELSE -GAINED THE IMPRESSION USG IS CARRYING OUT A CYNICAL, DUPLICITOUS POLICY IN SUPPORTING THE SHAH AND SHAH'S CONTINUING LIBERALIZATION WHILE PRIVATELY BELIEVING SHAH WILL BACKTRACK AWAY FROM LIBERALIZATION IF HE MANAGES TO CLAMP LID BACK ON PRESENT CRITICAL SITUATION.

1978TEHRAN11807.subject: REDUCTION IN SIZE OF AMERICAN COMMUNITY IN IRAN

segments.text: I AM INFORMED THAT YOU WOULD LIKE A CABLE FROM ME CONCERNING THE RELATIONSHIP OF THE AMERICAN COMMUNITY IN IRAN TO THE CURRENT CRISIS. I WELCOME THE OPPORTUNITY TO DO THIS AND FRANKLY FEEL THE NEED OF YOUR CANDID ADVICE. I HOPE YOU CAN GIVE IT TO ME BY IMMEDIATE RETURN CABLE.

THE DILEMMA WE FACE IN THIS SITUATION IS THAT THE U.S. GOVERNMENT, IN DISPLAYING ITS STEADFASTNESS FOR THE SHAH AND ITS HOPE FOR HIS SURVIVAL, HAS ONLY ONE TANGIBLE MANIFESTATION OF THAT POLICY IN THIS COUNTRY, AND THAT IS THE AMERICAN COMMUNITY. BECAUSE THIS COMMUNITY IS LARGE AND CONSPICIOUS, IT IS WATCHED VERY CLOSELY BY ALL ELEMENTS OF THE POLITICAL SPECTRUM.

MOREOVER, SINCE MANY OF THE MEMBERS OF THE COMMUNITY ARE ENGAGED IN DEFENSE-RELATED BUSINESS, THE PRESENCE OF THIS COMMUNITY IS DIRECTLY RELEVANT TO THE INTEGRITY OF THE IRANIAN ARMED FORCES. SENIOR IRANIAN MILITARY OFFICERS HAVE MADE A POINT OF URGING US TO RETAIN OUR COMMUNITY HERE AT ALL COSTS.

THE IRONY OF THIS SITUATION IS THAT WE ARE TOTALLY DEPENDENT FOR OUR SECURITY UPON THE INTEGRITY AND GOOD WILL OF THOSE SAME IRANIAN ARMED FORCES. IF THEY FELT WE WERE PREPARED TO "DESERT" THEM, WE COULD NO LONGER EXPECT EFFECTIVE PROTECTION FROM THEM, EITHER IN THE CURRENT TURBULENCE OR IN THE EFFECTUATION OF A LARGE-SCALE EVACUATION. WE ARE, THEREFORE, IN THE POSITION OF TWO SCORPIONS IN A BOTTLE. WE ARE MUTUALLY DEPENDENT ON EACH OTHER.

IN THE LARGER POLITICAL SENSE, A SIGNIFICANT EVACUATION OF AMERICANS AT THIS DELICATE STAGE COULD BE THE DECISIVE ACTION WHICH WOULD RESULT IN THE COLLAPSE OF THE SHAH. IT WOULD BE VIEWED BY JUST ABOUT EVERYONE AS EVIDENCE THAT WE HAD LOST CONFIDENCE IN HIS ABILITY TO SURVIVE. IT COULD START AN AVALANCHE OF IRANIAN DESERTIONS AND PRECIPITATE THE DISASTER.

BECAUSE AMERICANS ARE SEEN TO BE IN SUCH A CENTRAL ROLE IN THIS COUNTRY, THEY ARE THE TARGET OF INTENSIVE PSYCHOLOGICAL WARFARE. THREATENING TELEPHONE CALLS, FIREBOMBING, ETC., ARE BECOMING COMMONPLACE. IT IS A MINOR MIRACLE THAT WE HAVE NOT YET HAD A SERIOUS CASUALTY IN THE COMMUNITY, AND WE OBVIOUSLY HAVE TO ANTICIPATE SOME AT ANY MOMENT.

GIVEN THESE CIRCUMSTANCES, OUR MISSION POSTURE HAS BEEN TO TELL THE CORPORATE MANAGERS HERE THAT THEY SHOULD LOOK CAREFULLY AT THEIR PERSONNEL STRUCTURES AND AT THEIR FAMILY MEMBERS TO IDENTIFY THOSE WHO MIGHT VOLUNTARILY LEAVE IRAN SHOULD CIRCUMSTANCES WARRANT AND THAT WE WERE NOT DISCOURAGING DEPARTURES OF DEPENDENTS NOW IF THE CORPORATE EXECUTIVES BELIEVE THIS IS BEST. WE BELIEVE ABOUT TWO THOUSAND HAVE LEFT PERMANENTLY AND ANOTHER THREE OR FOUR THOUSAND DEPENDENTS HAVE TAKEN ADVANTAGE OF THE SEASONAL SLOWDOWN TO LEAVE THE COUNTRY TEMPORARILY.

THIS STILL LEAVES US A VERY LARGE COMMUNITY WHICH IS SO WIDESPREAD THAT IT IS DIFFICULT TO PROTECT AND SO NUMEROUS THAT IT WOULD BE DIFFICULT TO EVACUATE EFFECTIVELY IF THERE WERE A SUDDEN COLLAPSE OF AUTHORITY HERE.

I NOW FACE THE FOLLOWING OPTIONS. I CAN CHANGE MY PASSIVE ADVICE ABOUT DEPARTURE OF DEPENDENTS TO A POLICY OF ENCOURAGING NON-OFFICIAL DEPENDENTS TO LEAVE AS SOON AS POSSIBLE, BUT AS DISCREETLY AS FEASIBLE. IF I DO THIS, I WOULD CREATE TWO OTHER PROBLEMS. FIRST, WOULD BE THE IMPOSSIBILITY OF KEEPING THIS ADVICE CONFIDENTIAL, THEREBY ------------------002673 032223Z /70 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 1945 SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 11807 NODIS CHEROKEE POSSIBLY TOUCHING OFF A PANICKY PUBLIC EXODUS. SECOND WOULD BE THE PROBLEM OF OFFICIAL DEPENDENTS. MANY OF THESE, ESPECIALLY AMONG MILITARY DEPENDENTS, FEEL THEMSELVES TO BE THE MOST DIRECTLY TARGETED AND THEREFORE THE MOST EXPOSED.

IT WOULD BE IMPOSSIBLE TO GIVE EVACUATION ADVICE TO THE NON-OFFICIAL COMMUNITY WITHOUT INCLUDING OFFICIAL DEPENDENTS AS WELL. BUT THE DEPARTURE OF ANY OFFICIAL DEPENDENTS WOULD BE TRUMPETED IN THE WORLD PRESS AND BE SEEN BY THE ANTI-SHAH FORCES AS A VERY SIGNIFICANT VICTORY.

I HAVE DISCUSSED ALL THIS CANDIDLY WITH THE PRIME MINISTER. HE TAKES THE POSITION THAT WE ARE CAUGHT UP IN PSYCHOLOGICAL WARFARE AND SHOULD TREAT THE PROBLEM AS SUCH. HE POINTS OUT, CORRECTLY, THAT THERE HAVE BEEN NO RPT NO CASUALTIES AMONG THE AMERICAN COMMUNITY DESPITE ITS CONSPICIOUS SIZE. ON THE OTHER HAND, HE SAYS THAT ANY DEPENDENTS WHO FEEL SO INSECURE THAT THEY ARE "SICK" SHOULD BE QUIETLY REMOVED FROM THE COUNTRY. BUT, HE ASKS THAT THE FACT OF THEIR DEPARTURE BE DONE WITHOUT PUBLICITY.

HE DOES NOT, OF COURSE, UNDERSTAND THAT WE CANNOT RPT NOT OFFER TO REMOVE SOME DEPENDENTS WITHOUT MAKING THE SAME OPTION OPEN TO ALL. I HAVE TOLD HIM THIS AND SAID THAT I FEARED SUCH AN OFFER WOULD BECOME PUBLICLY DISTORTED AS AN AMERICAN "EVACUATION" MOVE. HIS REACTION WAS THAT I SHOULD AVOID THAT SITUATION.

IN SHORT, I AM PREPARED TO TAKE THE STEP OF ADVISING THE NON-OFFICIAL COMMUNITY TO THIN OUT ITS DEPENDENTS AND, AT THE SAME TIME, OFFERING OFFICIAL DEPENDENTS THE OPTION TO LEAVE ON A VOLUNTARY BASIS. WE HAVE ALREADY ASKED FOR FUND CITATIONS TO COVER THE LATTER OPTION.

HOWEVER, IF I WERE TO DO THIS, I WOULD WANT WASHINGTON TO UNDERSTAND FULLY THAT IT COULD BE THE STRAW WHICH WOULD BREAK THE CAMEL'S BACK. I WOULD, OF COURSE, CONSULT WITH THE SHAH BEFORE DOING IT IN ORDER TO MINIMIZE THE NEGATIVE CONSEQUENCES. I FEEL HIS REACTION WOULD BE VERY MUCH THE SAME AS THE PRIME MINISTER'S IN THAT HE WOULD FEEL, IN THE ABSENCE OF SOME DEMONSTRATED SERIOUS INCIDENT IN THE AMERICAN COMMUNITY, WE WOULD BE YIELDING TO PSYCHOLOGICAL PRESSURE. THE BASIC QUESTION IS WHETHER WE WAIT FOR SUCH AN INCIDENT TO HAPPEN BEFORE WE ACT.

FINALLY, IT IS MY OPINION THAT, IF WE ACT TO REMOVE DEPENDENTS AND NON-ESSENTIALS, THE SECURITY OF THOSE WHO REMAIN WOULD BECOME LESS VIABLE. THIS IS NOT ONLY BECAUSE THE CULTURAL RELUCTANCE TO INJURE WOMEN AND CHILDREN WOULD HAVE BEEN REMOVED, BUT ALSO BECAUSE THE ANTI-SHAH GROUP WOULD BE ENCOURAGED TO STEP UP THE NATURE OF THE PRESSURES AGAINST AMERICANS ONCE THEY REALIZED THEY HAD THE COMMUNITY PARTLY ON THE RUN.
THIS IS THE BURDEN OF MY BURDEN. PLEASE GIVE ME YOUR REACTION SOONEST.

DURING DEC 3 MEETING ON SEVERAL MATTERS, POL/MIL COUNSELOR INFORMED VICE MINISTER OF WAR TOUFANIAN OF PLANNED SEC COMPLAINT AGAINST MCDONNELL DOUGLAS. TOUFANIAN HAD INITIATED DISCUSSION BY RAISING FACT HIS NAME WAS ON FRADULENT DOCUMENT CLAIMING TO LIST PROMINENT IRANIANS WHO HAD SMUGGLED LARGE AMOUNTS OF MONEY FROM COUNTRY IN RECENT WEEKS. (TEHRAN 11700). THAT LIST, COMPLETELY UNTRUE THOUGH IT WAS, HAD MADE GREAT CHANGE IN TOUFANIAN'S LIFE. HIS FAMILY WAS FRIGHTENED TO LEAVE HOME AND HE PERSONALLY HAD RECEIVED THREATS AGAINST HIS LIFE.

INFORMATION ABOUT IRAN IN SEC COMPLAINT AGAINST MCDONNELL DOUGLAS WOULD INEVITABLY, ACCORDING TO TOUFANIAN, BE LINKED IN PUBLIC MIND TO HIM. TOUFANIAN BECAME EXTREMELY EXCITED AND SAID WHATEVER IRANIAN NAME WAS ASSOCIATED WITH ALLEGED MCDONNELL DOUGLAS PAYMENTS MUST BE RELEASED. TO WITHHOLD SUCH INFORMATION WOULD ONLY ADD TO GREAT SUSPICION ALREADY BEING DIRECTED AGAINST HIM. TOUFANIAN THEN LAUNCHED INTO LONG STATEMENT CONCERNING GREAT CARE HE HAD TAKEN OVER THE YEARS TO BE COMPLETELY "CLEAN" IN ALL OF HIS FINANCIAL DEALINGS. HE HAD NEVER TAKEN A PENNY AND HAD NEVER WITHDRAWN EVEN A CENT FROM IRAN.
TOUFANIAN ASKED THAT THIS MESSAGE BE PASSED TO WASHINGTON AND THAT SPECIFICS OF ALLEGED MCDONNEL DOUGLAS PAYMENT TO AN IRANIAN BE RELEASED SO ALL FINGERS WOULD NOT BE POINTED AT HIM.

SINCE TOUFANIAN WILL PROBABLY RAISE THIS WITH US AGAIN, WOULD APPRECIATE ANY INFORMATION WE COULD USE WITH HIM TO EXPLAIN ARRANGEMENTS UNDER WHICH NAMES OF COUNTRIES RATHER THAN INDIVIDUALS RECEIVING ALLEGED PAYMENTS WILL BE RELEASED.

I MET AT MY REQUEST WITH PRIME MINISTER AZHARI MORNING DECEMBER 3. WHEN I ASKED FOR HIS VIEWS OF CURRENT SITUATION, HE DESCRIBED IT AS ESSENTIALLY A BATTLE OF PSYCHOLOGICAL WARFARE. HE SAID PURPOSE OF ANTI-SHAH OPPOSITION WAS TO PANIC THE PUBLIC TO POINT WHERE THEY WOULD INSIST ON SHAH'S DEPARTURE TO SAVE THEIR OWN SKINS.

AS EXAMPLE OF SITUATION, HE SAID THAT MUCH OF THE TURBULENCE WHICH LAW-ABIDING PUBLIC HEARD EACH NIGHT AFTER CURFEW WAS TAPE-RECORDED SOUND EFFECTS BROADCAST FROM ROOFTOPS. THESE TAPES NOT ONLY CARRIED ULULATIONS OF GREAT CROWDS, BUT ALSO THE REPEATED FIRING OF MACHINE GUNS TO GIVE THE IMPRESSION THAT THERE WAS GREAT VIOLENCE IN THE STREETS. HIS TROOPS HAD "CAPTURED" SOME OF THE TAPES AND HE WOULD HAVE THEM PLAYED ON TELEVISION BEFORE CURFEW THIS EVENING TO CALM THE PUBLIC.

IN FACT, HE ASSERTED, THERE WERE RATHER FEW PEOPLE WHO ACTUALLY CAME INTO THE STREETS AFTER CURFEW AND THE TROOPS WERE BREAKING THEM UP WITHOUT MUCH TROUBLE. HE SAID THERE WERE MORE FATALITIES IN THE DAYTIME (TEN ON DECEMBER 2) THAN AT NIGHT (SEVEN ON DECEMBER 1 AND FIVE ON DECEMBER 2). HIS FORCES DID NOT RPT NOT FEEL SEVERELY CHALLENGED OR EVEN STRAINED BY CURRENT SITUATION.

AZHARI SAID THAT HE HAD SUCCEEDED IN GETTING AYATOLLAH KHO'I OF NAJAF, IN IRAQ, WHO IS MOST VENERATED SHIA CLERGYMAN ALIVE, TO SEND WORD TO THE AYATOLLAHS OF IRAN ASKING THEM TO CALM THE PEOPLE AND AVOID BLOODSHED. HE HOPED THIS WOULD REDUCE THE LEVEL OF CONFRONTATION IN THE DAYS AHEAD.

I SAID I WAS SOMEWHAT CONFUSED ABOUT THE REGULATIONS WHICH GOVERNED RELIGIOUS PROCESSIONS, BECAUSE SOME OFFICIAL STATEMENTS MADE IT SOUND AS THOUGHALL MANIFESTATIONS WERE BANNED. HE REPEATED HIS EARLIER FORMULATION, SAYING THAT THEY COULD BE HELD IF THEY WERE NOT POLITICAL AND NOT DISCORDELY.

GREATEST PROBLEM IN ALL THIS SITUATION WAS LACK OF HARD INTELLIGENCE. HE COULD NOT PUT HIS FINGER ON THOSE WHO WERE ACTUALLY PLANNING AND LEADING ALL THESE EVENTS. IT WAS HIS CONCLUSION, HOWEVER, THAT THEY MUST BE TUDEH BECAUSE NOBODY ELSE WAS SO WELL ORGANIZED OR DISCIPLINED.

COMMENT: ALTHOUGH IT IS TRUE THAT MUCH OF THE SOUND AND FURY WHICH IS BECOMING A NIGHTLY POST-CURFEW EVENT MAY COME FROM TAPE-RECORDERS AND LOUD-SPEAKERS, THERE ARE STILL A GREAT MANY REAL PEOPLE WHO HAVE GATHERED AT VARIOUS POINTS IN THE CITYTHE PAST TWO NIGHTS, AND THE CONFRONTATIONS ARE QUITE REAL. (THE SOUND EFFECTS, INCIDENTALLY, ARE ALSO VERY EFFECTIVE. THIS COMPOUND HAS EXPERIENCED TWO NIGHTS IN A ROW THE SOUNDS OF THOUSANDS OF WILD, FRENZIED VOICES, APPARENTLY ONLY A BLOCK OR TWO AWAY, SURROUNDING IT ON ALL FOUR SIDES.
IT IS DIFFICULT TO TELL HOW MANY OF THESE VOICES WERE TAPED AND HOW MANY CAME FROM LIVE THROATS, WHICH WERE ALSO PRESENT IN THE BLACKNESS OF THE NIGHT.)

MOHAMMAD TAVASSOLI OF REFTEL IS INDIVIDUALLY KNOWN TO US AS MOHAMMAD TAVAKOLI WITH WHOM POLOFF STEMPEL HAS BEEN IN CONTACT REGULARLY SINCE MAY 1978. HE IS NOT RPT NOT A "KHOMEINI MAN" EXCEPT IN LIMITED SENSE. HE IS A SECOND-ECHELON LIBERATION MOVEMENT OF IRAN (LMI) LEADER BEHIND MORE PROMINENT FIGURES SUCH AS BAZARGAN AND SAHABI WITH WHOM WE HAVE ALSO HAD CONTACTS. LMI IS, OF COURSE, MOST PRO-KHOMEINI GROUP IN OPPOSITIONIST GALAXY.

TAVASSOLI WAS SOMEWHAT DISCONCERTED TO HAVE DEMONSTRATED TO HIM THE EMBASSY KNEW WHO HE REALLY WAS. THIS CONTACT IS PARTICULARLY NEGATIVE FOR SEVERAL REASONS. WE WOULD BE INTERESTED IN KNOWING WHETHER SOURCE GAVE US THIS NAME ON HIS OWN INITIATIVE. EMBASSY REALIZES WHOLE QUESTION OF U.S. CONTACTS WITH OPPOSITION HAS REGRETABLY ENTERED PUBLIC AREA AT HOME, BUT HOPES DEPARTMENT CAN PROTECT SENSITIVE SOURCES SUCH AS THIS ONE AND OTHERS.

NEWSPAPER ARTICLES SUCH AS NOV 28 WASHPOST OBERDORFER PIECE, WHICH WAS JUST PLAIN WRONG FOR STARTERS, CAST UNHELPFUL GLARE OF PUBLICITY WHICH IN PRESENT CIRCUMSTANCES COULD CAUSE LMI AND OTHERS TO PULL BACK DURING PERIOD WHEN IT COULD BE VERY IMPORTANT TO KEEP SUCH DISCREET CHANNELS OPEN.

1978TEHRAN11813.subject: DEMONSTRATIONS IN NORTHERN TEHRAN, NIGHT OF DEC 2 SUMMARY: PRE AND POST CURFEW RELIGIOUS DEMONSTRATIONS TOOK PLACE ACROSS NORTHERN TEHRAN.EMBOFFS HA VE ASSEMBLE

segments.text: SUMMARY: PRE AND POST CURFEW RELIGIOUS DEMONSTRATIONS TOOK PLACE ACROSS NORTHERN TEHRAN.EMBOFFS HAVE ASSEMBLED SOLID, RELIABLE, EYEWITNESS ACCOUNTS, WHICH GIVE FLAVOR OF MOHARRAM ACTIVITIES. MILITARY IN EVIDENCE FIRING INTO AIR. CASUALTIES BELIEVED TO BE FEW. PUBLIC PARTICIPATION WAS SUBSTANTIAL. END SUMMARY.
FROM RELIABLE AMERICAN EYEWITNESSES POLOFFS HAVE PIECED TOGETHER PICTURE OF RELIGIOUS DEMONSTRATIONS IN DARROUS/GOLHAK/QATARIEH/NIAVARAN, NORTHERN AREA OF TEHRAN.

ACTIVITIES BEGAN ABOUT 1830 HOURS WHEN ARMY TROOPS CAME TO GHOBA MOSQUE AND INFORMED GATHERING MULTITUDE AND MOSQUE OFFICIALS THAT THEY HAD NOT RECEIVED PERMISSION TO HOLD A CEREMONY. TROOPS THEREUPON CLOSED THE MOSQUE AND ASSEMBLED CROWD HELD RUMP SERVICE OUTSIDE MOSQUE AND THEN DISPERSED SHOUTING "GOD IS GREAT," "THERE IS NO GOD BUT ALLAH" AND "DEATH TO THE SHAH." TROOPS BROKE UP CROWDS BY FIRING INTO AIR AND USING TEAR GAS. THERE WERE SOME WOUNDED, BUT NONE WERE OBSERVED DEAD, THROUGH THIS IS POSSIBLE.

LIBERATION MOVEMENT OF IRAN SOURCE INFORMED EMBOFF THAT GHOBA MOSQUE OFFICIALS ARE ADHERING STRONGLY TO KHOMEINI STRICTURE AGAINST GETTING POLICE PERMISSION FOR MEETINGS, AND ARE PREPARING TO TRY THEIR HAND WITH ANOTHER OUTDOOR SERVICE EVENING DEC. 3. SOURCE HOPED SERIOUS CONFRONTATION WITH MILITARY WOULD NOT OCCUR BUT WAS NOT HOPEFUL. 4.CROWDS BEGAN ASSEMBLING FROM 1900 HOURS ON AT MOSQUES THROUGHOUT NORTHERN REGION (AS WELL AS IN SOUTH AND SOUTHWEST PARTS) OF TEHRAN. AT 2100 HOURS SHARP (BEGINNING OF CURFEW) GROUPS EXITED SOME MOSQUES AND BEGAN CHANTING SLOGANS NOTED ABOVE. GROUPS WALKED DOWN MOST MAIN STREETS BETWEEN SALTANADABAD AND OLD SHEMIRAN ROAD.

A SUBSTANTIAL GROUP LEFT TAJRISH MOSQUE AND WAS BROKEN UP BY MILITARY WHO HAD TO ENGAGE IN HEAVY FIRING. SOME CASUALTIES APPEARED TO HAVE OCCURRED, BUT THERE ARE NO ESTIMATES OF NUMBERS. CROWDS IN VIRTUALLY ALL LOCATIONS WALKED PEACE-FULLY AND VANDALISM WAS MINIMAL. ROGANIZERS TELEPHONED PERSIANS THROUGHOUT AREA AND SUBSTANTIAL NUMBERS OF IRAN'S MIDDEL OR UPPER-MIDDLE CLASS EITHER TOOK TO STREETS ALONG WITH DEMONSTRATORS OR SHOUTED SLOGANS IN UNISON FROM THEIR HOUSE TOPS. TWO EMBOFFS WITH PARTICULARLY GOOD ROOFTOP VANTAGE POINTS NOTED THAT BETWEEN 50 AND 80 PERCENT OF HOMES ALONG ROUTE OF MARCH HAD SOMEONE WHO JOINED IN SHOUTING SLOGANS.

INDIVIDUALS WHO OBSERVED MARCHERS NOTED HEAVY CONCENTRATION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN. EVENING BETWEEN 2100 AND 2300 HOURS TOOK ON ALMOST FESTIVE AIR WITH CHANTS BEING HEARD THROUGHOUT NORTHERN AREA. IN SOME CASES ORGANIZERS WERE USING BULLHORNS AND LEADING CHANTS.

MILITARY MAINTAINED RELATIVELY LOW PROFILE AFTER CURFEW BEGAN. ARMORED VEHICLES WERE SENT TO MOSQUES ON DOWLAT AVENUE AND CROWDS THERE DISPERSED QUIETLY WITH VIRTUALLY NO FIRING. SUBSTANTIAL RANDOM SHOOTING WAS HEARD ELSEWHERE THROUGHOUT AREA, HOWEVER. THERE APPEARED TO BE FEW, IF ANY, CASUALTIES IN DARROUS/GOLHAK REGION AND IN FACT THROUGHOUT NORTHERN AREA WITH ONLY OCCASIONAL SCREAMS (AS OPPOSED TO CHANTS) HEARD. TANKS WERE BROUGHT INTO PLACE ALONG AXIX OF OLD SHEMIRAN ROAD BUT THEIR HEAVY WEAPONS WERE NOT USED. NO MILITARY WAS IN EVIDENCE AROUND CENTRAL GROUP OF DEMONSTRATORS WHICH GATHERED NEAR QATARIEH REGION AND MOVED SOUTH.

EVENTS OF EVENING AFFECTED FOR FIRST TIME MANY AMERICANS LIVING IN AREAS, WHO HAVE NOT PREVIOUSLY BEEN EXPOSED AT SUCH CLOSE RANGE TO RELIGIOUS CHANTING. VETRAN OBSERVERS OF PAST MOHARRAMS SAY THIS IS CLEARLY LARGEST AND EARLIEST OUTBREAK OF DEMONSTRATIONS. A SUBSTANTIAL OUTBREAK OF NERVOUSNESS HAS OCCURRED AMONG FOREIGNERS LIVING IN THIS AREA, BUT TO BEST OF OUR KNOWLEDGE, THERE WERE NO INCIDENTS INVOLVING FOREIGNERS. MOST OBSERVERS WERE IMPRESSED THAT NUMBERS RELIGIOUS GROUPS WERE ABLE TO MOBILIZE ON THIS OCCASION. IT APPEARS THAT EFFORTS WILL BE MADE TO CONTINUE DEMONSTRATIONS ON SUBSEQUENT NIGHTS AND IF POSSIBLE INCREASE THEIR SIZE.

CHANTING AND SINGING CONTINUED FROM JUST AFTER 2100 HOURS UNTIL AFTER 2300 HOURS WHEN LIGHT SPRINKLE OF RAIN AND PERHAPS VOCAL FATIGUE CAUSED SHOUTS TO DIMINISH AND VIRTUALLY DRIFT AWAY AFTER MIDNIGHT.

1978TEHRAN11814.subject: LOOKING AHEAD: RECOVERY OF THE IRANIAN ECONOMY

segments.text: THE SPECIFIC QUESTIONS RAISED IN REFTEL ABOUT POSSIBLE U.S. ASSISTANCE TO IRAN ARE ADDRESSED BELOW. THE FOLLOWING GENERAL COMMENTS ARE INTENDED TO PROVIDE PERSPECTIVE.

THE PREMISE IN REFTEL THAT POLITICAL STABILITY IN IRAN WILL DEPEND HEAVILY ON A FUNCTIONING ECONOMY IS VALID, BUT THE OBVERSE IS EVEN MORE APPARENT IN THE SHORTRUN-A FUNCTIONING ECONOMY IS NOT POSSIBLE WITHOUT A POLITICAL ENVIRONMENT WHICH ASSURES PUBLIC ORDER AND THE OPERATION OF ESSENTIAL PUBLIC AND PRIVATE SERVICES. AT THIS STAGE, AND FOR THE IMMEDIATE FUTURE, THERE IS LITTLE THAT WE CAN DO TO ASSIST IN REVIVING IRAN'S ECONOMY.

IRAN'S CRISIS, BOTH POLITICAL AND ECONOMIC, IS ESSENTIALLY AN INTERNAL ONE WHICH CAN ONLY BE REVERSED BY INTERNAL ACTION. THE CRISIS ITSELF IS IN LARGE MEASURE A REACTION TO THE SHAH'S EFFORTS TO TRANSFORM IRAN INTO A MODERN STATE THROUGH A MASSIVE AND SUDDEN APPLICATION OF EXTERNAL RESOURCES, INCLUDING A LARGE CORPS OF FOREIGN TECHNICIANS AND EVEN LABORERS WHO SUPPLEMENT THE COUNTRY'S INADEQUATE MANPOWER RESOURCES. THE RISING RESENTMENT AGAINST SUCH TECHNICAL SPECIALISTS AND "GUEST" LABORERS HAS IN SOME CASES BECOME OPENLY HOSTILE. EVEN WHERE RESENTMENT HAS NOT REACHED XENOPHOBIC LEVELS, THE GOI IN MANY CASES IS CUTTING BACK THE LEVEL OF FOREIGN INVOLVEMENT.
ANY ASSISTANCE WE MAY OFFER WILL HAVE TO TAKE THIS GROWING NATIONALISM INTO ACCOUNT.

AFTER RESTORATION OF OIL PRODUCTION THE SINE QUA NON FOR ANY SEMPLANCE OF ECONOMIC NORMALCY IS THE RESTORATION OF VITAL PUBLIC UTILITIES, BANKING AND FINANCIAL SERVICES, AND EFFECTIVEERNMENT ECONOMIC MANAGEMENT. ALL THESE SERVICES HAVE BEEN SEVERELY IMPAIRED. KEY GOVERNMENT INSTITUTIONS, SUCH AS THE MINISTRY OF ECONOMIC AFFAIRS AND FINANCE, ITS SATELLITE CUSTOMS AND TAX SERVICES, AND THE CENTRAL BANK, HAVE FUNCTIONED ONLY PARTIALLY OR SPORADICALLY IN THE PAST TWO MONTHS. THERE IS LITTLE HOPE THAT THE SITUATION WILL IMPROVE DURING THE CURRENT MOHARRAM PERIOD.

AFTER MOHARRAM, AND ASSUMING PROGRESS ON THE POLITICAL FRONT, THE GOI MAY BE ABLE TO RESTORE SOME ORDER OUT OF THE PREVAILING CHAOS IN THE ECONOMY. ONCE SOME SEMBLANCE OF ORDER IS RESTORED, THE GOVERNMENT'S ECONOMIC MANAGERS WILL HAVE TO TAKE A FIRM HAND IN THE DAY-TO-DAY MANAGMENT OF THE ECONOMY, ASSESS THE DAMAGE, AND PLAN ECONOMIC RECOVERY IN RELATION TO NEW AND MORE MODEST GOALS FOR THE ECONOMY. THE EMBASSY BELIEVES THAT THE GOI HAS THE TALENT FOR THIS TASK, IF IT CAN BE ORGANIZED AND GIVEN ADEQUATE AUTHORITY IN A SUFFICIENTLY STABLE POLITICAL ENVIRONMENT.

IRAN'S UNDIMINISHED OIL AND GAS RESOURCES WILL PROVIDE THE BASIC ECONOMIC MEANS FOR THE RECOVERY EFFORT. AT THAT STAGE OF THE RECOVERY, THE U.S. MAY BE ABLE TO TAKE SOME ACTION TO ASSIST IRAN. IT IS OUR VIEW THAT THIS SHOULD BE DONE UNDER THE UMBRELLA OF THE ALREADY-ESTABLISHED U.S.-IRAN JOINT COMMISSION.

A. OIL PRODUCTION: ALL OF THE STRIKES WHICH HAVE AFFECTED IRANIAN CRUDE PRODUCTION (I.E. THE STRIKES AGAINST OSCO AND THE FOUR JOINT VENTURES) HAVE NOT BEEN RESOLVED. IPAC WAS SHUT DOWN AGAIN DECEMBER 2 BY A STRIKE (REFTEL), AND THE STRIKE AGAINST OSCO HAS STILL NOT BEEN COMPLETELY RESOLVED. HOWEVER, BARRING SERIOUS REVERSALS IT IS ACCURAGE TO SAY THAT THE SITUATION (EXCLUDING IPAC) HAS IMPROVED TO SUCH A DEGREE THAT THE MAJOR PROBLEMS ARE TECHNICAL; AND THE RETURN TO WORK OF THE REMAINING OSCO STRIKERS OR THE USE OF GREATER NUMBERS OF EXPATRIATE WORKERS WOULD NOT MATERIALLY IMPROVE PRODUCTION RATES.

THE MANAGING DIRECTOR OF OSCO, GEORGE LINK, TOLD US THAT HE COULD HAVE MORE NAVY PERSONNEL BUT THAT THEY WERE NOT NEEDED. ACCORDING TO LINK, OSCO PRODUCTION WILL SLOWLY BUT GRADUALLY CLIMB BACK AND SHOULD--BARRING UNFORESEEN DEVELOPMENTS--REACH PRE-STRIKE LEVEL OF 5.5 MILLION B/D WITHIN 7-10 DAYS. CONSEQUENTLY, THE QUESTION RAISED IN REFTEL REGARDING THE POSSIBILITY OF USING GREATER NUMBERS OF EXPATRIATE WORKERS MAY BE DISREGARDED, FOR THE TIME AT LEAST. IF THERE WERE TO BE A LARGE-SCALE RESUMPTION OF THE STRIKE BY PRODUCTION WORKERS OSCO AND/OR NIOC MIGHT REPEAT MIGHT CONSIDER THE TEMPORARY EMPLOYMENT OF ADDITIONAL NUMBERS OF EXPATRIATES.

HOWEVER, THE PROBLEMS WOULD BE NUMEROUS AND WE BELIEVE THAT SUCH AN APPROACH SHOULD NOT EVEN BY CONSIDERED UNLESS AND UNTIL THE GOI AND NIOC DEMONSTRATE FAR MORE DETERMINATION THAN THEY HAVE THUS FAR IN ATTEMPTING TO BREAK THE STRIKES. THE GOI AND NIOC HAVE BEEN SO CONCERNED ABOUT THE POSSIBILITY OF CREATING PROBLEMS AND ANIMOSITIES THAT THEIR APPROACH HAS ------------------001214 032256Z /66 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 1951 SECTION 2 OF 3 TEHRAN 11814 EXDIS BEEN, WE BELIEVE, OVERLY PERMISSIVE AND GENEROUS.

ALL OF THE NIOC, OSCO, AND JOINT VENTURE STRIKERS WERE PAID AT LEAST THROUGH NOVEMBER 12; AND MANY OF THE RELATIVELY FEW STRIKERS WHO WERE DISMISSED SINCE THEN (I.E., THOSE WHO HAVE NOT BEEN PAID SINCE NOVEMBER 12) ARE NOW BEING RE-EMPLOYED ON "PROBATION." MOREOVER, MANY OF THE MAJOR STRIKE LEADERS AND AGITATORS WHO WERE ARRESTED HAVE NOW BEEN RELEASED IN RESPONSE TO THE DEMANDS OF THE RELATIVELY FEW REMAINING STRIKERS. WE HAVE ALSO LEARNED THAT EXTREMELY FEW STRIKERS WERE EVICTED FROM COMPANY HOUSING. IN FACT, THE IRANIAN OSCO OFFICIALS IN AHWAZ WITH WHOM THE PETOFF TALKED ON NOVEMBER 16 COULD NOT CONFIRM THAT ANYONE HAD BEEN EVICTED.

WE HAVE TALKED TO A NUMBER OF SENIOR NIOC AND OSCO OFFICIALS (IRANIAN AND EXPATRIATE) WHO ARE CONVINCED THAT THE SEEDS OF FURTHER PROBLEMS ARE BEING SOWN BY THE GOI'S AND NIOC'S WILLINGNESS TO CAPITULATE. WE DISCUSSED THE SECURITY SITUATION AT SOME LENGTH WITH LINK AND OTHER OSCO OFFICIALS AND THEY ARE SATISFIED THAT THE LIKELIHOOD OF SABOTAGE OF PRODUCTION FACILITIES IS FAIRLY REMOTE AND WOULD, IN ANY CASE, NOT BE TOO DIFFICULT TO EITHER PREVENT OR REPAIR. THEIR CONFIDENCE IS BASED ON

THE PRESENCE OF MILITARY GUARDS (AS WELL AS OIL COMPANY GUARDS) AT ALL MAJOR FACILITIES, (2) THE PRESENCE OF MIDDLE-LEVEL AND SUPERVISORY IRANIAN STAFF WHO WOULD NOT WILLINGLY PERMIT SABOTAGE, (E) THE FACT THAT ONLY A RELATIVELY SMALLY NUMBER OF EMPLOYEES ARE HIGHLY POLITICIZED AND RADICALIZED, (4) THE FACT THAT THERE HAVE BEEN NO CREDIBLE THREATS OF SERIOUS ATTEMPTS TO SABOTAGE FACILITIES, AND (5) THE FACT THAT KNOWN STRIKERS ARE BEING DENIED ACCESS TO JOB SITES.

WHEN ASKED ABOUT THE VULNERABILITY OF PIPELINES, WE WERE ASSURED THAT OSCO HAS THE CAPABILITY TO QUICKLY REPAIR SUCH DAMAGES AND THAT ONLY A VERY LARGE AND WELL TRAINED ORGANIZATION WITH THE ABILITY TO REPEATEDLY BLOW UP LARGE TRANSMISSION LINES COULD CAUSE SERIOUS LONG-TERM DISRUPTIONS. THE QUESTION OF SECURITY OF PERSONNEL IS OF MORE IMMEDIATE CONCERN TO OSCO (AND PRESUMABLE TO NIOC) BUT THE SITUATION SEEMS TO BE UNDER CONTROL.

THE MILITARY IS PROVIDING EFFECTIVE SECURITY FOR EMPLOYEES ON THE JOB SITES (WHETHER IN OSCO OFFICES IN AHWAZ OR IN THE FIELDS) AND THE POTENTIAL THREAT TO PERSONS AND PROPERTY IN RESIDENTIAL AREAS HAS BEEN GREATLY REDUCED BY FREQUENT MILITARY PATROLS. THE MORALE OF OIL FIELD WORKERS (IRANIAN AND EXPATRIATE) IS BETTER AND THE LEVEL OF TENSION IN AHWAZ IS LESS THAN WE HAD THOUGHT TWO WEEKS AGO. IN SUMMARY, THE SITUATION INSOFAR AS OIL PRODUCTION IS CONCERNED HAS STABILIZED AND THERE SEEMS TO BE NO NEED FOR OUTSIDE ASSISTANCE; AND IN THE EVENT OF A DETERIORATION IN THE SITUATION LOCAL RESOURCES SHOULD STILL BE SUFFICIENT.

B. TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE: THERE CONTINUES TO BE A VIRTUAL BREAKDOWN IN FUNCTIONING OF THOSE MINISTRIES MOST RESPONSIBLE FOR ECONOMIC POLICY MAKING. FROM A SITUATION OF OBVIOUS STRIKES, THE BUREAUCRACY IN GENERAL HAS MOVED TO A NON-WORKING STANCE WHICH COULD BE INTERPRETED AS PASSIVE RESISTANCE. ONE SENIOR GOI OFFICIAL DESCRIBED IT AS PERVASIVE LETHARGY. THE UNDERSECRETARIES AND DIRECTORS GENERAL, WHO REFLECT LITTLE CHANGE FROM A YEAR OR MORE AGO, ADMIT TO LIVING A SHORT-TERM EXISTENCE, WHERE LONG-TERM CONSIDERATIONS LITERALLY MEAN SOMETHING OVER 48 HOURS. BASIC ADMINISTRATIVE FUNCTIONS CONTINUE AS, IN GENERAL, OPERATIONS WITH IMMEDIATE RESULTS.

THE PREOCCUPATION OF SENIOR OFFICIALS IS IN MAINTAINING TRANQUILITY AND OTHER ENERGIES SEEM DIRECTED TOWARD SELF-PERSERVATION AND FOLLOWING POLITICAL DEVELOPMENTS. THE DIRECTOR GENERAL LEVEL EXPRESSES EXASPERATION WITH THE UNDERSECRETARIES FOR IGNORING POLICY STUDIES AND FUNDAMENTALS. AS REVEALED IN THE BLUMENTHAL/MEHRAN MEETING NOVEMBER 20, THE PRESENT GOVERNMENT CONSIDERS IT INAPPROPRIATE TO MOVE AHEAD WITH A SIXTH DEVELOPMENT PLAN BECAUSE OF ITS TEMPORARY STATUS.

THIS PERHAPS OVERSTATEMENT OF INACTIVITY IGNORES THE FACT THAT A REVISED BUDGET HAS BEEN PREPARED FOR THE CURRENT YEAR WHICH ACKNOWLEDGES NOT ONLY THE INCREASED COSTS OF WAGES BUT EXPENDITURE-CUTTING DECISIONS ON THE EQUIPMENT AND OTHER CAPITAL COSTS IN ORDER TO MINIMIZE THE CURRENT DEFICIT. PREPARATION CONTINUES FOR THE NEXT BUDGET. WORK LIKEWISE CONTINUES ON SUCH TOPICAL ITEMS AS THE TAX REFORM. THE UNFORTUNATE ASPECT IS THAT ANY VIGOR OR DISCIPLINE IN THESE EFFORTS IS BASED MORE ON "WHAT ELSE IS THERE TO DO?" THAN ON INTELLIGENT, SYSTEMATIC POLICY REVIEW, PLANNING AND DECISION MAKING.

WE FIND THIS ENVIRONMENT OF DRIFT, ------------------001256 032259Z /66 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IIMMEDIATE 1952 SECTION 3 OF 3 TEHRAN 11814 EXDIS EVEN IN THE EXCEPTIONS WHERE IT HAS AIM, INHOSPITABLE TO POSSIBILITIES OF TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE REGARDLESS OF ITS NATURE. NONETHELESS, WE PROPOSE TO TAKE ADDITIONAL INFORMAL SOUNDINGS WITH CLOSE CONTACTS AT THE UNDERSECRETARY LEVEL WITH THE VIEW THAT THE GOVERNMENT MAY SEE THINGS FROM A LONGER-TERM PROSPECTIVE, AFTER THE DECEMBER MOHARRAM PERIOD. OUR SOUNDINGS CONFIRMED THE FOREGOING ANALYSIS AND OUR PRESUMPTION THAT ANY ADDITIONAL U.S. PRESENCE NOW WOULD COMPLICATE THE GOI'S FIRST PRIORITY OF REDUCING TENSION AND ESTABLISHING ORDER.

REFLECTING THE POLITICAL CONCERN, WE DO BELIEVE THAT THE USIRJC UMBRELLA WOULD PROBABLY PROVIDE THE LOWEST PROFILE FOR ANY TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE. THE AMBASSADOR WILL SEEK AN OPPORTUNITY TO RAISE THESE IDEAS WITH MINISTERS MEHRAN AND AMIN. OUR PERCEPTION OF AMOUZEGAR'S STATUS, I.E., NOT "FINGERED" FOR CORRUPTION BUT GENERALLY DISCREDITED IN IRANIAN EYES, WOULD PRECLUDE HIM ON AN APPROACH AND YEGANEH IS UNDER MEDICAL TREATMENT IN HOUSTON.

CONTRACT CANCELLATION: EMBASSY HAS MADE SAMPLE OF U.S. FIRMS INVOLVED IN MAJOR PROJECTS AND FINDS THAT MOST IRANIAN CONTRACTS WITH U.S. FIRMS HAVE TERMINATION PROVISIONS THAT ARE CONSIDERED ADEQUATE PROVIDED THEY ARE HONORED. CURRENTLY, MANY COMPANIES THAT FEEL VULNERABLE ARE ATTEMPTING TO MAINTAIN AS LIQUID A POSITION AS POSSIBLE. THEY ALSO ARE VOLUNTARILY OR BY REQUEST LOOKING INTO STRETCHING OUT CONTRACTS, CUTTING COSTS WHERE FEASIBLE AND REDUCING FOREIGN VISIBILITY. ALTHOUGH GOI PAST RECORD IN HONORING VALID CONTRACTUAL ARRANGEMENTS HAS BEEN GOOD--ASIDE FROM FREQUENT LATE PAYMENTS--IT SHOULD BE NOTED THAT EXISTENCE OR ABSENCE OF A SPECIFIC CONTINGENCY CLAUSE IS NOT CONTROLLING IN ITSELF.
KEY FACTOR HAS BEEN DESIRE OF GOI TO HONOR VALID COMMITMENTS AND MAINTAIN GOOD INTERNATIONAL IMAGE AND CREDIT STANDING.

FOREIGN NATIONAL WORKERS: THE DEPUTY MINISTER OF LABOR IN CHARGE OF MANPOWER TOLD EMBOFF NOVEMBER 27 THAT, AS A MATTER OF GENERAL POLICY, THE GOI WILL NOT IN THE FUTURE ISSUE WORK AND RESIDENCE PERMITS FOR FOREIGN NATIONAL SKILLED AND SEMISKILLED WORKERS BELOW THE PROFESSIONAL LEVEL. HE ASSURED EMBOFF THAT WORK PERMITS FOR AMERICAN PROFESSIONALS IN ESSENTIAL JOBS FOR WHICH IRANIANS ARE NOT AVAILABLE WILL CONTINUE TO BE ISSUED.

SO FAR THERE APPEARS TO BE NO EFFORT TO EXPELL NONPROFESSIONAL FOREIGN NATIONAL WORKERS WHO ARE LEGALLY RESIDENT HERE, BUT THE AUTHORITIES ARE CRACKING DOWN ON ILLEGAL RESIDENTS AND IT APPEARS PROBLEMATICAL WHETHER THE WORK AND RESIDENCE PERMITS OF SKILLED AND SEMISKILLED FOREIGN WORKERS WILL BE RENEWED, ONCE THEY EXPIRE. WE NOTE THAT THE DEMANDS OF SOME STRIKERS AGAINST THE NIOC AND IN SOME OTHER CASES HAVE INVOLVED EXPULSION OF EXPATRIATE WORKERS.

DESPITE GOI ASSURANGCES THAT ESSENTIAL FOREIGN PROFESSIONAL PERSONNEL WILL CONTINUE TO BE ADMITTED TO IRAN, WE BELIEVE THE GOI WILL SCRUTINIZE SUCH APPLICATIONS MUCH MORE STRICTLY THAN IN THE PAST AND WILL, IN FACT, TURN DOWN MANY APPLICATIONS WHEN THEY BELIEVE IRANIANS CAN DO THE JOBS. THIS TIGHTER POLICY ON THE USE OF EXPATRIATE MANPOWER WILL BE AN INCONVENIENCE AND MAY BE HARMFUL IN SOME CASES. GIVEN THE CURRENTLY DETERIORATING ECONOMIC CLIMATE, THE GOI'S TIGHTER POLICY IS NOT LIKELY TO HAVE SERIOUS EFFECTS ON THE ECONOMY.

1978TEHRAN11815.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT, DEC 3 SUMMARY: HEAVY FIRING AFTER CURFEW LAST NIGHT. STREET DEMONSTRATIONS AND ROOFTOP RALLIES. HEAVY FIRING I

segments.text: SUMMARY: HEAVY FIRING AFTER CURFEW LAST NIGHT. STREET DEMONSTRATIONS AND ROOFTOP RALLIES. HEAVY FIRING IN ISFAHAN YESTERDAY. TEHRAN SCHOOLS CLOSED FOR TEN DAYS. GOVT SAYS ARMS HAVE BEEN USED BY OPPOSITION. GOVT DISSOLVES GUILDS CHAMBER. MOTION OF CENSURE IN MAJLES. SEVERAL DEMONSTRATIONS UNDERWAY NORTH OF EMBASSY. END SUMMARY.

DEMONSTRATORS AGAIN CHALLENGED THE CURFEW LAST NIGHT, AND TEHRANIS LISTENED TO SEVERAL HOURS OF GUNFIRE, INCLUDING AUTOMATIC WEAPONS FIRE, AND TANKS MOVING THROUGH THE CITY. MOST OF THE SHOOTING WAS INTO THE AIR, BUT GOVT ACKNOWLEDGES FIVE DEAD AND TWENTY WOUNDED. MLA HALTED SERVICE AT GHOBA MOSQUE IN NORTH TEHRAN, SAYING WORSHIPPERS HAD NOT OBTAINED AUTHORIZATION (BEING REPORTED SEPTEL). A NEW TWIST WAS SERIES OF LOUD ROOFTOP RALLIES AFTER CURFEW IN WHICH PEOPLE SHOUTED SLOGANS, BOTH RELIGIOUS AND POLITICAL, FROM HOUSETOP TO HOUSETOP. LOUDSPEAKERS ADDED TO THE DIN. WE ARE CHECKING OUT RUMOR THAT DISPLAY WAS SIGNALLED BY LARGE BONFIRE ON MOUNTAIN NORTH OF TOWN.
LARGE FIRE WAS VISIBLE THROUGH THE MIST HIGH ABOVE TEHRAN. SOME SECTIONS OF TOWN HAD A SECOND POWER OUTAGE LASTING SEVERAL HOURS.

CONSULATE SHIRAZ REPORTS ALL QUIET EXCEPT FOR POWER OUTAGES. YESTERDAY SHOP CLOSURES WERE VIRTUALLY TOTAL; TODAY ABOUT 25 PERCENT ARE OPEN. AHWAZ IS ALSO QUIET ALTHOUGH EXPERIENCING POWER AND WATER OUTAGES. CONSULATE HAS REPORTS OF VIOLENCE FRIDAY IN BUSHEHR, BAR, AND JAHROM. CONSULATE ISFAHAN REPORTS CONSIDERABLE VIOLENCE YESTERDAY, WITH SHOOTING IN AT LEAST EIGHT LOCATIONS. LOUDSPEAKERS ON ONE BUILDING CALLED FOR HOLY WAR AGAINST REGIME. PEOPLE ON ROOF THREW PROJECTILES ON SOLDIERS, PREVENTING THEM FOR THREE HOURS FROM SILENCING PA SYSTEM. IN APPARENT AMBUSH, ONE CROWD PURSUED BY TROOPS RAN INTO MOSQUE, WHEREUPON MEN STATIONED ON ROOF THREW DOWN HEAVY CONCRETE CLOQKS ONTO SOLDIERS, SEVERAL OF WHOM WERE INJURED.

CONSUL LEARNED FROM LOCAL PHYSICIANS THAT A NUMBER OF BODIES WERE BROUGHT TO HOSPITALS. ARMY SET UP FIRST-AID STATION IN HOSPITALS, WHICH HAD BEEN CLOSED. THERE WERE DEMONSTRATIONS IN THREE NEARBY VILLAGES. IN ONE OF THESE, CROWD TOOK ANTIFOREIGN LINE AND BURNED HAMMER AND SICKLE. MARTIAL LAW FORCE IN ISFAHAN WAS SUPPLEMENTED 2-3 DAYS AGO BY AIR FORCE AND ARMY AVIATION TROOPS. AVIATION SOLDIERS HAVE PROVED LESS DISCIPLINED AND HAVE BEEN GUILTY OF ABUSES. ONE OF THEM WAS BEATEN BY ANGRY CROWD. ARMY AVIAITION HAS ASKED U.S. ADVISORS TO REMOVE AVIATION INSIGNIA FROM THEIR UNIFORMS. FIREBOMBS WERE THROWN YESTERDAY INTO OFFICE OF FORD SUBSIDIARY AND INTO TRAILER PARK WHERE U.S.
PERSONNEL LIVE, NO ONE HURT. POWER WAS OUT TOTAL OF EIGHT HOURS IN ISFAHAN YESTERDAY. IIAF REPORTEDLY PLANNED SEIZE POWER STATION IN EVENT OF OUTAGE BUT FAILED TO DO SO.

MAJLES HELD OPEN SESSION TODAY AND PRESENTED THREE CENSURE MOTIONS AGAINST AZHARI GOVT. OPPOSITION DEPUTIES CITED KILLING AT DEMONSTRATIONS AND PRESS CENSORSHIP. MINISTER OF COMMERCE ANNOUNCED YESTERDAY THAT GUILDS CHAMBER WAS DISSOLVED AND THAT NEW ELECTIONS WOULD BE HELD AFTER APRIL 4. REASON GIVEN FOR DISSOLUTION WAS NEGLIGENCE ON PART OF CHAMBER OF FULFILLING ITS DUTIES. GOI ALSO ANNOUNCED SIX NEW DEP MINS OF ECONOMY AND FINANCE-HASSAN HADAVI, HASSAN-ALI REJAI, SEYED MOHAMMED MIRMIRAN, ABDUL RAHAM SADRIEH, AND BIJAN NOURI.

PRIM GENERAL AZHARI ACTED YESTERDAY TO JUSTIFY MILITARY ACTION AGAINST DEMONSTRATORS AND TO SEPARATE RELIGIOUS FROM POLITICAL FERVOR. IN TWO-HOUR MEETING WITH 100 REPRESENTATIVES OF VARIOUS GROUPS, AZHARI SAID HE HAD BEEN ADVISED TO BAN ALL MEETINGS, BUT AS PRIMIN OF A SHIITE COUNTRY HE DID NOT WANT TO DO THAT. "TREACHEROUS AND XENOPHILE ELEEMENTS," HOWEVER, TOOK ADVANTAGE OF CEREMONIES. FORCES TRIED TO MINIMIZE INJURIES BUT HAD TO NEUTRALIZE THESE ATTACKS. HE SAID THE TUDEH PARTY DISTRIBUTED LITERATURE INSTRUCTING PEOPLE HOW TO HOLD DEMONSTRATIONS. IN A SEPARATE STATEMENT, HE AGAIN ALLUDED TO TUDEH ACTIVITY WHICH WAS DESIGNED TO TURN RELIGIOUS MOURNING INTO CHAOS.
HE CLAIMED TO POSSESS A TUDEH GAME PLAN FOR DEMONSTRATIONS, ARSON, AND ASSASSINATION. AZHARI CALLED ON CLERGY TO UNMASK THESE PLOTTERS SO PEOPLE WILL NOT BE MISLED BY THE.

GOVT SAYS SOME DEMONSTRATORS USED ARMS AGAINST SECURITY FORCES. EMBASSY HAS REPORT FROM MILITARY SOURCE THAT TROOPS WHO WERE SEARCHING CARS COMING FROM KARAJ YESTERDAY FOUND FOUR AUTOMOBILES CARRYING WEAPONS, TWO OF WHICH WERE SEIZED AND TWO ESCAPED. AMERICAN EYEWITNESSES TOLD AMERICAN PRESS SOURCE OF IRANIANS WITH TAPE RECORDERS IN UPPER PAHLAVI AVENUE (NEAR CHATTANOOGA RESTAURANT) LAST NIGHT WHO WERE BROADCASTING MOB AND SHOOTING NOISES VERY LOUDLY, FRIGHTENING THE NEIGHBORHOOD.
GOI ANNOUNCED YESTERDAY IRAN WILL NOT PARTICIPATE IN THE ASIAN GAMES SCHEDULED TO BEGIN DEC 9 IN BANGKOK.

MOOD CONTINUES TENSE TODAY. GOVT ANNOUNCED TEHRAN SCHOOLS WILL BE CLOSED UNTIL DEC 13. (HOWEVER, TEHRAN AMERICAN SCHOOL WILL OPEN TOMORROW, DEC 4.) MANY SHOPS OPENED THIS MORNING, BUT BY MIDDAY TEHRAN TOOK ON BUTTONED-UP APPEARANCE OF YESTERDAY. EVEN SOME BANK MELLI BRANCHES ARE CLOSED. EMBOFF OBSERVER REPORTS SOUTH TEHRAN IS CLOSED DOWN BUT QUIET, WITH PEOPLE MILLING ABOUT, APPARENTLY LOOKING (IN VAIN) FOR OPEN SHOPS. SHOOTING HAS OCCURRED IN CENTRAL AND NORTHERN TEHRAN. EMBASSY DRIVER PASSING THROUGH CROWD AT 25TH SHARIVAR SQUARE NORTH OF EMBASSY SAYS HE SAW SOLDIERS SHOOT DEMONSTRATORS.

AMERICAN PRESS SOURCE AT SAME EVENT SAYS MOST SHOOTING WAS IN THE AIR WITH SOLDIERS USING BUTTS OF THEIR RIFLES AGAINST DEMONSTRATORS WHO WERE DISRUPTING TRAFFIC. NO DEATHS REPORTED YET TODAY. DEMONSTRATIONS ARE TAKING PLACE IN SEVERAL AREAS NORTH OF EMBASSY WITH MUCH SHOOTING, BUT MOST OF IT APPARENTLY IN THE AIR.
MINISTER OF JUSTICE HOSSEIN NAJAFI ANNOUNCED 120 POLITICAL PRISONERS WILL BE RELEASED AND THAT HE HOPES TO ARRANGE RELEASE OF MORE DETAINEES. (BEING REPORTED SEPTEL).

IRANIAN CRUDE PRODUCTION REMAINED ALMOST CONSTANT AT 5.9 MILLION B/D FROM NOVEMBER 29 THROUGH DECEMBER 2. HOWEVER, IPAC EMPLOYEES RENEWED THEIR STRIKE LATE AFTERNOON DECEMBER 2 AND AS A RESULT OF THE SHUT-IN OF IPAC'S 425,000 B/D, PRODUCTION DECEMBER 3 IS SCHEDULED TO BE 5.5 MILLION B/D.

ACCORDING TO AMOCO OFFICIALS, IPAC EMPLOYEES WENT BACK ON STRIKE SOLELY IN RESPONSE TO KHOMEINI CALL. IPAC HAS CHARTERED AN AIRCRAFT WHICH IS NOW AT KHARE ISLAND AND PLANS ARE TO REMOVE ABOUT 150 OF THE YOUNGER, MORE JUNIOR EMPLOYEES FROM THE ISLAND. IPAC WOULD THEN RESUME PARTIAL PRODUCTION WITH THE APPROXIMATELY 100 REMAINING SENIOR IRANIAN STAFF AND EXPATRIATES. THE 150 JUNIOR STAFF WOULD BE SCREENED IN AN ATTEMPT TO IDENTIFY THE HARDCORE AGITATORS AND HOPEFULLY A MAJORITY WILL BE WILLING TO RETURN AND TO WORK.
THE SITUATION IN THE REFINERIES IS UNCHANGED. ABADAN IS RUNNING AT CLOSE TO CAPACITY; SHIRAZ IS STILL CLOSED DOWN; AND, TEHRAN IS OPERATING AT ABOUT HALF NORMAL THROUGH-PUT.
WE EXPECT TO GET MILITARY ANNEX TO YOU MONDAY, DECEMBER 4, WHICH WILL ANSWER SOME OF QUESTIONS REFTEL. WE SHALL PROMPTLY ADDRESS REMAINING QUERIES.

1978TEHRAN11831.subject: REDUCTION IN SIZE OF AMERICAN COMMUNITY IN IRAN

segments.text: THANKS FOR YOUR RAPID RESPONSE TO MY MESSAGE ON REDUCTION IN SIZE OF AMERICAN COMMUNITY IN IRAN. IN YOUR CONTEMPLATION OF THIS PROBLEM, PLEASE REALIZE THAT WE MAY CURRENTLY BE DOWN TO ABOUT 35,000 AND, IF WE ENCOURAGED VOLUNTARY DEPARTURE OF DEPENDENTS WE STILL WOULD NOT GET MUCH BELOW 20,000. IN SHORT, THE SIZE OF THE COMMUNITY UNDER ANY FORESEEABLE CIRCUMSTANCE WOULD BE INEVITABLY SO LARGE AS TO CAUSE US SIGNIFICANT PROBLEMS IN EVENT AUTHORITY COLLAPSES.

THE SUGGESTIONS YOU HAVE MAUE IN SECOND PARAGRAPH REFTEL HAVE ALREADY BEEN ACTED UPON AS BEST WE CAN. FOR EXAMPLE, IN ISFAHAN, WE HAVE MADE MAJOR EFFORT TO CONCENTRATE AMERICAN COMMUNITY IN TWO DEFENSIBLE ENCLAVES. HOWEVER, SOME FAMILIES RESIST SUCH MOVES AND PREFER REMAIN WHERE THEY ARE.

IRANIAN ARMED FORCES HAVE BEEN GENEROUSLY RESPONSIVE TO OUR REQUESTS FOR ASSISTANCE. FOR EXAMPLE, YESTERDAY, WHEN WE REOPENED TEHRAN AMERICAN SCHOOL, GENERAL AZHARI INSTRUCTED GENERAL OVEISI PERSONALLY TO PROVIDE SECURITY FOR THE SCHOOL GROUNDS AND THE BUSES. WHEN WE TALKED WITH OVEISI, HE WAS ACTUALLY PREPARED TO GIVE US MORE THAN WE REALLY WANTED.

COMMUNITY ITSELF HAS SHOWN REMARKABLE FORTITUDE. MEETING YESTERDAY OF FOURTEEN ECUMENICAL PASTORS REPORTS THEIR ASSESSMENT THAT PARISHIONERS, ALTHOUGH NERVOUS, SHOW NO SIGNS OF PANIC. IF SITUATION DETERIORATES AS WE APPROACH ASHURA, THIS COULD, OF COURSE, CHANGE.

1978TEHRAN11835.subject: FURTHER EMBOFF OBSERVATIONS ON TEHRAN SCENE DEC3 AND 4

segments.text: EMBOFF COVERED EXTENSIVE AREA OF TEHRAN SOUTH AND EAST OF EMBASSY ON DEC 3. LEVEL OF TRAFFIC WAS MUCH REDUCED AND GREAT BAZAAR WAS COMPLETELY CLOSED BUT, BEGINNING A FEW BLOCKS NORTH OF BAZAAR, MANY SHOPS, PARTICULARLY THOSE SELLING PERISHABLE FOODSTUFFS, WERE OPEN. INTERESTINGLY MANY BANKS, INCLUDING SOME DIRECTLY ACROSS FROM BAZAAR, WERE OPEN. AS ONE MOVED NORTH FROM BAZAAR FREQUENCY OF OPEN SHOPS INCREASED AND, IN GENERAL, LARGER NUMBER OF SHOPS WERE OPEN DEC 3 THAN ON PREVIOUS DAY.

LARGEST DEMONSTRATION OBSERVED INVOLVED SOME 20 YOUNG MEN MARCHING DOWN SIDEWALK ACROSS STREET FROM MINISTRY OF JUSTICE NEAR BAZAAR AND SHOUTING RELIGIOUS AND ANTISHAH SLOGANS. IN CENTRAL PART OF CITY EMBOFF OBSERVED SMALL GROUPS OF 5-6 MALE DEMONSTRATORS WHO DISPERSED FOLLOWING ONE AIR SHOT FROM TROOPS. SEVERAL BLOCKS AWAY SAME GROUP AGAIN COALESCED AND RESUMED SHOUTING SLOGANS. FOLLOWING REPORTS OF SIZEABLE DEMO AND GUNFIRE FROM NEZAMABAD SECTION NEAR QASR PRISON, EMBOFF WENT THERE BUT DISTURBANCE HAD CEASED. AREA SHOPKEEPERS CONFIRMED THAT DEMONSTRATION HAD TAKENPLACE AND HAD BEEN DISPERSED BY SOLDIERS. THERE WERE NO RELIABLE OR EYEWITNESS REPORT OF CASUALTIES AMONG DEMONSTRATORS.
THROUGHOUT CITY, INCLUDING BAZAAR AREA, BOTH PRO AND ANTI-SHAH SLOGANS WERE SPRAY-PAINTED ON WALLS, INCLUDING TWO ANTISHAH SLOGANS ON WALLS OF SOVIET EMBASSY.

ON DEC 4 EMBOFF MADE BRIEF WALKING TOUR OF STREETS NEAR EMBASSY. ONE 18-MAN DEMONSTRATION WAS ENCOUNTERED SOME SIX BLOCKS FROM EMBASSY, BUT IT DID NOT ATTRACT ONLOOKERS OR ADHERENTS AND PROCEEDED OUT OF SIGHT WITHOUT VIOLENCE AND WITHOUT ENCOUNTERING TROOPS. SEVERAL SHARP REPORTS WERE HEARD FROM OPPOSITE DIRECTION BUT ABSENCE OF TROOPS IN THAT AREA SUGGESTS NOISE WAS MADE BY FIRECRACKERS.

ISRAELI REPRESENTATIVE HERMELIN CALLED ON ME MORNING DECEMBER 4 TO EXCHANGE VIEWS. HIS ESTIMATE OF LOCAL SITUATION ACCORDS VERY MUCH WITH OUR OWN AND HE SAYS HIS LARGE JEWISH COMMUNITY HERE IS TENSE AND PESSIMISTIC.

GREATEST CONCCERN AMONG LOCAL JEWS IS THAT IRANIAN DISSIDENTS MAY BE RECEIVING WEAPONS FROM PLO. HE BELIEVES IRAQ WOULD REFUSE, FOR ITS OWN SECURITY REASONS, TO FACILITATE INFILTRATION OF WEAPONS THROUGH ITS TERRITORY. BUT HE BELIEVES OTHER GULF STATES, SUCH AS KUWAIT AND BAHRAIN, WHICH MIGHT NOT HAVE SUCH EFFECTIVE CONTROL OVER ITS TERRITORY AND ITS RESIDENTS, COULD BECOME CONDUITS FOR PLO WEAPONS.

HE HAS NO RPT NO REASON TO BELIVE SOVIETS ARE ENGAGED IN ARMS SMUGGLING, EITHER DIRECTLY OR THROUGH AFGHANISTAN. HE TEREFORE CONCLUDES THAT IRAN'S MOST VULNERABLE FRONTIERS ARE THOSE ALONG THE PERSIAN GULF.
BEFORE HIS ASSIGNMENT TO TEHRAN, HERMELIN WAS SENIOR ISRAELI INTELLIGENCE OFFICIAL.

1978TEHRAN11843.subject: OPPOSITION PROPOSALS FOR DEPARTURE OF SHAH

segments.text: SUMMARY: DR. MINATCHI TOLD EMBOFF PROPOSAL FOR A REGENCY COUNCIL IS BEING PUT TO LEADING KHOMEINI REPRESENTATIVES DEC 4, THEY WILL GO TO PARIS TO CONVINCE KHOMEINI, WITH PRESSURE IF NECESSARY TO ACCEPT THEM. MINATCHI HAD HEARD RUMOR SHAH MIGHT BE READY TO AGREE TO REGENCY COUNCIL. ALI AMINI HAD TOLD MINATCHI"FOREIGN MILITARY ADVISERS" HAD SAID MILITARY COMMANDERS WOULD NOT AGREE TO DEPARTURE OF SHAH AND SAID IF COUNCIL IDEA ADOPTED, SHAH WOULD HAVE TO CHANGE MILITARY COMMANDER. EMBOFF DENIED U.S. ADVISERS WOULD HAVE MADE SUCH STATEMENTS. MINATCHI SAID OPPOSITION WOULD ACCEPT PRESENT ARMED SERVICES HEADS ON REGENCY COUNCIL.
IN REPLY TO MINATCHI QUESTION AS TO WHETHER HE SHOULD CONTINUE HIS EFFORTS, EMBOFF SAID ALL PEACEFUL EFFORTS ARE USEFUL AND URGED REALITY OF SITUATION BE IMPRESSED ON ALL SIDES. END SUMMARY.

AT MINATCHI'S REQUEST, EMBOFF STEMPEL MET AGAIN WITH DR. NASSER MINATCHI, TREASURER OF COMMITTEE FOR THE DEFENSE OF HUMAN RIGHTS AND FREEDOM AND ASSOCIATE OF AYATOLLAH SHARIAT-MADARI. MINATCHI WANTED TO REVIEW DEVELOPMENTS AND HEAR ANY LATEST U.S. IDEAS, BECAUSE HE WAS MEETING WITH TWO OF THREE LEADING KHOMEINI AYATOLLAHS OVER LUNCH TO PREPARE THEM FOR TRIP TO PARIS WITHIN NEXT TWO OR THREE DAYS. AYATOLLAHS WHO WILL GO TO PARIS ARE MONTAZARI OF QOM AND RAFSANJANI OF TEHRAN (THEY, PLUS TALEQANI OF TEHRAN, MAKE UP KHOMEINI "HIGH COMMAND" WITHIN IRAN, ACCORDING TO MINATCHI).

THEY WILL PLACE BEFORE KHOMEINI THE IDEA OF A REGENCY COUNCIL TO REPLACE THE SHAH (SEE REFTELS FOR DETAILS) WHICH WOULD THEN APPOINT A COALITION GOVERNMENT. THEY ARE PREPARED TO "PRESSURE" KHOMEINI TO ACCEPT THIS. ALL OPPOSITIONISTS AND THE SHARIAT-MADARI GROUP IN QOM AND MASHAD HAVE AGREED TO COOPERATE WITH AND SUPPORT SUCH A GOVT.

MINATCHI DESCRIBED PAST TEN DAYS' NEGOTIATIONS WITH ALI AMINI AND FORMER PRIME MINISTER SHARIF-EMAMI WHICH LED UP TO PRESENT SITUATION AND SAID BOTH AMINI AND SHARIF-EMAMI HAD ACCEPTED IDEAS AS VALUABLE ON FIRST HEARING, ONLY TO BECOME STANDOFFISH. (MINATCHI SAID AT FIRST MEETING WITH AMINI, LATTER HAD SAID "AMERICANS HAVE AUTHORIZED CONTACT WITH YOU." EMBOFF DENIED THIS, AND SAID WE SIMPLY HAD URGED AMINI AND OTHERS TO TALK WITH ALL THOSE INVOLVED.) EMBOFF SAID HIS UNDERSTANDING WAS THE SHAH WOULD REJECT ANY SOLUTION THAT DID NOT ENABLE HIM TO REMAIN AS CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCH AND COMMANDER-IN-CHIEF OF THE ARMY.

MINATCHI SHOULD NOT RPT NOT LET WISHFUL THINKING MISLEAD HIS GROUP ON THAT SCORE. MINATCHI ADDED NONE OF HIS GROUP REALLY TRUSTED AMINI OR SHARIF-EMAMI IN ULTIMATE ANALYSIS BECAUSE THEY "WERE AFRAID."

OTHER PROBLEM WAS SITUATION WITHIN ARMY, WHICH EMBOFF HAD DISCUSSED WITH MINATCHI AT LAST MEETING. ACCORDING TO MINATCHI, AMINI TOLD HIM THAT "FOREIGN MILITARY OFFICERS, WHO ADVISE IRANIAN ARMED FORCES" TOLD AMINI THAT IS SHAH GOES, ARMY COMMANDERS WOULD NOT OBEY WHOEVER FOLLOWED. EMBOFF ASKED IF THAT MEANT U.S. OFFICERS AND MINATCHI SAID AMINI CERTAINLY MEANT IT THAT WAY. EMBOFF FLATLY DENIED U.S. OFFICERS MAKE SUCH COMMENTS, ESPECIALLY TO POLITICAL LEADERS. AS MINATCHI KNEW, HOWEVER, EMBOFF AT LAST MEETING (REF A) HAD EXPRESSED DOUBTS THAT MILITARY OFFICERS WOULD WILLINGLY GO ALONG WITH SCENARIO WHICH SAW SHAH'S DEPARTURE.
MINATCHI SAID SHAH COULD ALWAYS NAME NEW TROOP COMMANDERS BEFORE HE LEFT, AND IN ANY CASE, THERE WOULD BE LOYALISTS ON REGENCY COUNCIL.

HE NAMED FOLLOWING RETIRED GENERALS WHO WERE ACCEPTABLE TO OPPOSITION: ASGHAVI, JAM, BATMANGELIDJ, GARZAN AND REZVANI, PLUS RETIRED ADMIRAL MADANI, WHOM HE DESCRIBED AS VERY TRUSTED BY THE SHAH, A BRILLIANT MAN, AND SYMPATHETIC TO THE NATIONAL FRONT. ------------------009181 050520Z /46 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 1978 SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 11843 EXDIS WHEN EMBOFF EXPRESSED DOUBT THAT SERVING TROOP COMMANDERS WOULD EASILY ACQUIESCE IN THEIR OWN REPLACEMENT, MINATCHI SAID THAT WAS POSSIBLE, BUT WHEN STATED THERE WOULD BE NO DIFFICULTY HAVING MEMBERS OF PRESENT ARMED SERVICES ON REGENCY COUNCIL.

EMBOFF ASKED HIM QUESTION SECOND TIME, AND MINATCHI SAID THIS WAS TRUE, BASIC POINT WAS TO GET SHAH OUT OF POWER--ALL OPPOSITIONISTS HAD AGREED THEY COULD SERVE UNDER REGENCY COUNCIL WHICH HAD PRESENT MILITARY LEADERS ON IT. (COMMENT: THIS REPRESENTS MODEST CHANGE FROM PROPOSITION APUT FORWARD IN REFTEL. WHILE IT WOULD NOT MAKE THIS PROPOSAL ANY MORE PALATABLE TO SHAH, IT IS USEFUL TO KEEP IN MIND.)

MINATCHI DESCRIBED IDEA OF REGENCY COUNCIL--IN HIS AND OPPOSITION'S EYES, THIS IN NOT ADVISORY COUNCIL SET FORTH IN AMENDED ARTICLE 38 OF SUPPLEMENTARY CONSTITUTIONAL LAW OF 1907. OPPOSITION CONCEPT IS THAT REGENCY COUNCIL AS A GROUP WOULD ASSUME REGENCY IN PLACE OF SHABANOU AND HAVE NO NEED FOR STATUTORY COUNCIL. REGENCY COUNCIL WOULD HAVE TWO OR THREE GENERALS FROM LIST ABOVE, FOUR CIVILIANS AND PRESENT CHIEF OF STAFF AND OTHER SERVICE REPRESENTATIVES "IF THIS WAS NECESSARY." EMBOFF MADE NO COMMENT OTHER THAN TO NOTE THAT THIS PROPOSAL SEEMED UNACCEPTABLE TO SHAH.

AT CONCLUSION OF MEETING, MINATCHI ASKED IF EMBOFF PERSONALLY THOUGHT HE SHOULD GO AHEAD DISCUSSING PROPOSAL AND EVEN SEND AYATOLLAHS TO PARIS, SINCE IT SEEMED THAT THE SITUATION WAS NOT YET FULLY RIPE. EMBOFF REPLIES CONTINUED DISCUSSION WAS PREFERABLE TO VIOLENCE, AND PROBED POSSIBILITY THAT SHARIAT-MADARI AND KHOMEINI LEADERS IN COUNTRY MIGHT BE DRAWN AWAY FROM HARD INSISTENCE THAT SHAH LEAVE. MINATCHI WAS MILDLY UNCOMFORTABLE WITH QUESTION, BUT EVENTUALLY OPINED THAT SUCH A SHIFT SEEMED UNLIKELY. HE EXPRESSED HOPE EVENTS MIGHT SHIFT VIEWS ON BOTH SIDES AND HOPED VIOLENCE WOULD NOT ACCOMPANY CONTINUAL POST-CURFEW ACTIVITIES.

EMBOFF URGED HIM TO DESCRIBE REAL SITUATION AS PRECISELY AS POSSIBLE TO AYATOLLAHS, ADDING THAT NONE OF US WANTED BLOODSHED AND THAT THE BEST WAY TO AVOID IT WOULD BE FOR "PEOPLE" TO SHOW A LITTLE MORE FLEXIBILITY AND BASE THEIR OWN IDEAS ON WHAT MIGHT PROVIDE THE STUFF OF COMPROMISE. MINATCHI NODDED THAT HE UNDERSTOOD.

MINATCHI ADDED RITUAL PITCH THAT U.S. TAKE THIS PROPOSAL TO THE THRONE "TO PAVE THE WAY," AND ACCEPTED WITH GOOD GRACE EMBOFF'S CHI THAT HE WAS ONCESAGAIN TRYING TO GET U.S. TO MEDDLE IN IRANIAN INTERNAL AFFAIRS. OTHER DISCUSSION ON POLITICAL PRISONERS BEING REPORTED SEPTEL.

COMMENT: ASIDE FROM STANCE OF PRESENT SENIOR MILITARY MEN ON PROPOSED REGENCY COUNCIL, ONLY NEW ELEMENT IS FORTHCOMING PITCH TO KHOMEINI. AS FAR AS HP KNOW, THIS WILL BE ONLY EFFORT IN IMMEDIATE FUTURE FROM OPPOSITION'S OWN SUPPORTERS TO PRESS KHOMEINI FOR ANY "GIVE" DEVELOPING IN HIS POSITION.

VMOW TOUFANIAN INVITED POL/MIL COUNSELOR TO THIS OFFICE ON URGENT BASIS NVPVC##DEC 4. AT FOLLOWING MEETING, TOUFANIAN SAID HE HAD BEEN THINKING A GREAT DEAL SINCE DAY BEFORE ABOUT IMFORMATION THAT MIGHT BECOME PUBLIC KNOWLEDGE AS RESULT OF ACTION AGAINST MCDONNEL DOUGLAS (REFTEL). TOUFANIAN HAD EVEN MENTIONED SEC COMPLAINT TO SHAH IN A DEC 3 MEETING.

IT WAS TOUFANIAN'S CONCLUSION THAT PRESENT TIME COULD BE DISASTEROUS OCCASION FOR PUBLIC TO LEARN ABOUT ONE MORE CASE OF QUESTIONABLE PAYMENTS INVOLVING IRAN AND POSSIBLY IRANIAN OFFICIALS. ON LATTER, TOUFANIAN SAID HE HAD CONCLUDED IN HIS OWN MIND THAT ONLY SENIOR GOI OFFICIAL WHO COULD HAVE BEEN INVOLVED IN ANY MCDONNEL DOUGLAS PAYMENTS WAS GENERAL KHATAMI. TOUFANIAN URGED THAT IN THIS VERY CRITICAL TIME FOR GOI ALL REFERENCES TO IRAN IN ANY DOCUMENTATION INVOLVED IN SEC COMPLAINT BE ELIMINATED. POL/MIL COUNSELOR COMMENTED THAT WAS PROBABLY IMPOSSIBLE SINCE CASE APPARENTLY INVOLVED A KEY DOCUMENT WHICH REFERRED TO NUMBER OF COUNTRIES.

TOUFANIAN, AS A SECOND POSSIBILITY, RETURNED TO HIS SUGGESTION OF PREVIOUS DAY, THATIF INFORMATION ABOUT IRAN MUST BE RELEASED, IT SHOULD INCLUDE THE NAME OF THE IRANIANS INVOLVED. OTHERWISE, TOUFANIAN WAS SURE, AS HE HAD BEEN DAY BEFORE, THAT HE WOULD BE ASSUMED BY EVERYONE TO HAVE BEEN RECIPIENT OF MCDONNELL DOUGLAS MONEY.

POL/MIL COUNSELOR DID NOT EXPRESS ANY OPTIMISM ABOUT ACHIEVING EITHER OF TOUFANIAN'S OPTIONS, BUT DID PROMISE TO REPORT IMMEDIATELY THE GENERAL'S VERY STRONG CONCERNS ABOUT IRAN'S INVOLVEMENT IN SEC COMPLAINT.
WOULD APPRECIATE REPORT ON STATUS OF SEC COMPLAINT AND INFORMATION ABOUT DEP'S EFFORTS IN CONNECTION WITH TOUFANIAN'S REQUESTS. SULLIVAN NOTE BY OC/T: ##AS RECEIVED.

1978TEHRAN11846.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT, DEC 4 SUMMARY: GENERALLY LESS NOISE LAST NIGHT, BUT SHOUTING AND SHOOTING IN MANY SECTIONS OF TEHRAN. PRIMIN AZ

segments.text: SUMMARY: GENERALLY LESS NOISE LAST NIGHT, BUT SHOUTING AND SHOOTING IN MANY SECTIONS OF TEHRAN. PRIMIN AZHARI ASKS PUBLIC TO DISREGARD "PSYCHOLOGICAL WARFARE," AND ALSO BLASTS FOREIGN NEWS REPORTING. KHOMEINI CALLS FOR SOLDIERS TO DESERT AND WARNS POLITICIANS NOT TO COMPROMISE. DEMONSTRATIONS CONTINUE TODAY, WITH REPORTS OF ATTACKS ON POLICEMEN. END SUMMARY.

ROOFTOP SYMPHONY ACCOMPANIED BY POWER BLACKOUT DISRUPTED TEHRAN AGAIN LAST NIGHT. RAIN MAY HAVE DAMPENED ENTHUSIASM OF DEMONSTRATORS, WHO WERE LESS NOISY IN SOME LOCALES BUT UP TO NORMAL VOLUME IN OTHERS. LOUDSPEAKERS AND RECORDED SOUND EFFECTS WERE USED IN SOME AREAS, SO THAT WHEN POWER WENT OUT (ABOUT 2200), THE NOISE DECREASED. SOME DEMONSTRATORS TOOK TO THE STREETS AFTER CURFEW AND WERE DISPERSED BY TROOPS. GUNFIRE WAS MORE SCATTERED THAN ON PREVIOUS TWO NIGHTS, BUT MANY SHOTS WERE HEARD AT JALEH SQUARE AND UNIVERSITY AREA. TAJRISH WAS NOISIEST OF ALL AND APPARENTLY SCENE OF SIGNIFICANT CONFRONTATION.

CASUALTIES PROBABLY RESULTED BUT NEITHER GOVT NOR OPPOSITION HAS INDICATED FIGURES FOR LAST NIGHT. RADIO HAS REPORTED ATTACK ON POLICE STATION ABOUT 5 A.M. THIS MORNING. ONE POLICEMAN KILLED, ONE SERIOUSLY WOUNDED. ATTACKERS FROM NEARBY OVERPASS FIRED FIFTY ROUNDS AND THREW HOME MADE GRANADE WHICH DID NOT EXPLODE.

CONSULATE TABRIZ REPORTS BOMB EXPLODED IN GOVT COOPERATIVE ACROSS STREET FROM CONSULATE YESTERDAY. OTHERWISE, CITY IS QUIET AND STILL SHUT DOWN. KERMANSHAH HAD MINOR DEMONSTRATION. CONSULATE SHIRAZ REPORTS DEMONSTRATION LAST NIGHT WITH SHOTS FIRED AND WINDOWS BLOWN. CONSULAR OFFICER IN AHWAZ REPORTS DEMONSTRATIONS DEC 2-3 AND HEAVY TROOP PRESENCE. MOBS ATTACKED TWO AMERICAN-OCCUPIED HOMES DEC 1. OCCUPANTS WERE PRESENT IN ONE OF THEM BUT FLED, ESCAPING INJURY. BEHBAHAN AND NEARBY OILFIELDS WERE PACKED WITH TROOPS. WE HAVE REPORTS THROUGH MAAG CHANNELS OF DISTURBANCES LAST NIGHT IN ISFAHAN BUT HAVE BEEN UNABLE TO CONTACT CONSULATE. FIVE PEOPLE WERE REPORTED KILLED IN BABOL YESTERDAY.

IN RADIO SPEECH, PRIMIN GENERAL AZHARI CALLED THE ROOFTOP TACTICS "PSYCHOLOGICAL WARFARE," CLAIMING OPPOSITION USES TAPE-RECORDED SOUND EFFECTS TO CAUSE PANIC, THUS WEAKENING MORALE OF PUBLIC AND SECURITY FORCES. SOUNDS OF RELIGIOUS SLOGANS, CROWD NOISES, AND GUNFIRE ARE BROADCAST ACROSS THE CITY. (COMMENT: AZHARI'S CLAIM, ALTHOUGH SELF-SERVING, IS PROBABLY TRUE. MANY OBSERVERS BELIEVE THEY HEARD TAPE-RECORDED SOUNDS, AND THE OACTIC IS IN ANY CASE A PLAUSIBLE ONE. THIS IS A WELL-ORCHESTRATED EFFORT.)

AZHARI ALSO BLASTED FOREIGN NEWS REPORTING FOR INFLATED ESTIMATES OF CASUALTIES. IN A RADIO SPEECH, HE CRITICIZED REUTERS INFLAMMATORY REPORTING, CONTRASTING IT WITH THE BETTER PERFORMANCE OF AFP. BBC IS SIMPLY REFERRED TO AS "COLONIALIST RADIO" AND NOT MENTIONED BY NAME. ACCURATE CASUALTY FIGURES ARE DIFFICULT TO OBTAIN SINCE MUCH OF THE VIOLENCE OCCURS AFTER CURFEW.

BBC DID BROAD------------------009397 041555Z /46 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1981 INFO USINT BAGHDAD AMCONSUL DHAHRAN USLO PEKING AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY BONN AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY TOKYO USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 11846 CAST AN ESTIMATE OF 700 KILLED, UNDOUBTEDLY ONE SOURCE OF AZHARI'S IRE. OFFICIAL OF COMMITTEE FOR THE DEFENSE OF HUMAN RIGHTS AND FREEDOM TOLD EMBOFF TODAY THAT 600-700 COUNTRYWIDE HAD DIED DURING MOHARRAM.

MORE THAN HALF OF THESE WERE WOUNDED IN THE STREETS BUT DIED LATER. IRANIAN MEDICAL SOURCE (ADMITTEDLY ANTI-SHAH) CLAIMED TO HAVE TREATED NUMEROUS GUNSHOT WOUNDS IN PAST THREE DAYS AND ALSO ARGUED MLA TRIES TO SEND VICTIMS TO MILITARY HOSPITALS SO TRUE FUGURES CANNOT BE KNOWN. DEATH TOLL IS ALMOST CERTAINLY HIGHER THAN OFFICIALLY ANNOUNCED, BUT NOT OF PROPORTIONS CLAIMED BY OPPOSITION. WE HAVE MANY EYEWITNESS ACCOUNTS IN WHICH TROOPS MEETING A CROWD FIRE INTO THE AIR, CREATING LOTS OF NOISE BUT NO INJURIES.
IN RARE DEPARTURE FROM HIS MOUNTAINSIDE PALACES, SHAH VISITED DOSHEN TAPPEH AIR BASE DEC 3 FOR INSPECTION TOUR.

AFP REPORTS FROM PARIS THAT KHOMEINI YESTERDAY URGED SHAH'S TROOPS TO DESERT AND CALLED ON OIL WORKERS TO CONTINUE THEIR STRIKE. HE ALSO WARNED POLITICIANS TO MAKE NO COMPROMISE BY FORMING, AS HE TERMED IT, AN ANTIISLAMIC GOVT. ONLY SOLUTION IS DEPARTURE OF THE SHAH. PRESS SOURCE HAS REPORT THAT DURING WIDESPREAD DISTURBANCES IN MASHAD YESTERDAY, FORU SOLDIERS WERE SHOT IN THE BACK BY OFFICERS FOR REFUSING TO FIRE ON DEMONSTRATORS. WE HAVE NO SUPPORTING EVIDENCE OR CORROBORATING REPORT.

TODAY IS ANOTHER DAY OF HIT AND RUN PRESSURE BY DEMONSTRATORS. CROWDS HAVE FORMED IN CENTRAL AND NORTH TEHRAN AND THEN DISPERSED AS TROOPS FIRED OVER THEIR HEADS. WE HAVE REPORTS OF HEAVY FIRING AND PERHAPS CASUALTIES IN QEYTARIEH AND TAJRISH AREAS. CONSULATE EVACUATED SHORTLY BEFORE 1300, NOT IN RESPONSE TO SPECIFIC THREAT BUT BECAUSE CROWDS WERE MOVING IN GENERAL AREA. (QEYTARIEH AND TAJRISH ARE FAR TO ITS NORTH.) ONE PRESS SOURCE TELLS US THREE BANK SADERAT STRIKERS WHO WERE BEING RECALCITRANT WHEN STRIKE TURNED INTO DEMONSTRATION WERE SHOT DEAD BY TROOPS IN FRONT OF THE BANK.

A NUMBER OF SHOPS ARE OPEN TODAY, BUT OPPOSITION HAS SUCCEEDED IN CUTTING POWER AGAIN IN AT LEAST THE NORTHERN SECTION OF CITY. TEHRAN BUS SYSTEM WENT ON STRIKE YESTERDAY TO PROTEST KILLING OF A DRIVER BY TROOPS. AS USUAL, THERE HAS BEEN NO BIG BLOWUP SO FAR TODAY. CROWDS AND TROOPS INSTEAD PURSUE CAT AND MOUSE GAME, WHICH NONETHELESS OCCASIONALLY ENDS IN KILLED OR WOUNDED DEMONSTRATORS. HIGH IRANIAN MILITARY SOURCE EXPRESSED CONFIDENCE TODAY TO EMBOFF THAT TROOPS COULD MEET THE CHALLENGE. HE SAID INCREASED NUMBERS OF ARMORED PERSONNEL CARRIERS WERE ON THE STREETS LAST NIGHT AND WORKED OUT WELL. MLA WILL CONTINUE USING AUGMENTED APC'S TO PATROL STREETS.

WE HAVE REPORTS OF MOR ARMED ATTACKS AGAINST SECURITY FORCES. FOR EXAMPLE, PRESS REPORTS POLICE "ADMIT" TWO POLICE GUARDS WERE SHOT IN FRONT OF EGYPTIAN EMBASSY; EGYPTIAN EMBASSY COUNSELOR TOLD US HE HAD HEARD OF NO SUCH THING. ON THE OTHER HAND, SOMEONE STOLE HIS NEW MERCEDES BENZ FROM FRONT OF HIS HOUSE FEW DAYS AGO. SO GOES TEHRAN RUMOR MILL.

1978TEHRAN11857.subject: DEPT SPOKESMAN'S REMARKS ON IRAN DEC 4 APPRECIATE FULL TRANSCRIPT HODDING CARTER'S REMARKS ON IRAN AT PRESS BRIEFING NOON DEC 4 ASAP. (ONLY

segments.text: APPRECIATE FULL TRANSCRIPT HODDING CARTER'S REMARKS ON IRAN AT PRESS BRIEFING NOON DEC 4 ASAP. (ONLY SUMMARIZED IN WIRELESS FILE.)

FOREIGN MINISTER AFSHAR ASKED ME TO COME TO HIS HOUSE EVENING DECEMBER 4 FOR AN INFORMAL DISCUSSION. IN ANTICIPATION OF THIS TALK, I GATHERED TOGETHER LIST OF ACTIONS WHICH I FELT FOREIGN MINISTRY SHOULD PURSUE IN BUREAUCRACY TO GET SOME EFFECTIVE MOVEMENT INTO THIS GOVT.

DURING ONE HOUR DISCUSSION, FOREIGN MINISTER HAD VERY LITTLE TO OFFER EXCEPT SOME CLUCKING OBSERVATIONS ABOUT THOSE PEOPLE WHO HAD BENEFITED FROM SHAH AND WHO WERE NOW SPEAKING OUT AGAINST HIM. IN RESPONSE TO THE VARIOUS ACTION ITEMS WHICH I PRESENTED, HE MADE A NOTE ON ONLY ONE OF THEM - THE QUESTION OF CUSTOMS CLEARANCES-AND SAID RATHER AIRILY THAT THE REST WOULD HAVE TO WAIT UNTIL AFTER ASHURA (DEC 11) BECAUSE PEOPLE WERE DISTRACTED BY THE RELIGIOUS HOLIDAYS.

FINALLY, AS OUR CONVERSATION TERMINATED, HE TOLD ME BLANDLY THAT HE WAS LEAVING DECEMBER 5 FOR LONDON TO VISIT WITH HIS SON DURING THE LATTER'S UNIVERSITY HOLIDAYS AND THAT I COULD HANDLE ANY PROBLEMS IN THE INTERIM WITH HIS DEPUTY.

WHILE MOST PUBLIC ATTENTION SEEMS TO FOCUS ON STREET CLASHES BETWEEN DEMONSTRATORS AND SECURITY FORCES, THE REAL STRUGGLE FOR THE FUTURE OF THIS COUNTRY MAY BE TAKING PLACE IN THE ECONOMIC SECTOR. DEPT ALREADY HAS OUR REPORTING ON OIL AND GAS SITUATION. SEPTEL WILL GIVE AMERICAN BUSINESS PERCEPTIONS OF BANKING, COMMERCIAL, AND BUREAUCRATIC STAGNATION.

I HAVE DISCUSSED THIS WITH PRIME MINISTER AND FOREIGN MINISTER, WITHOUT BEING ABLE TO SPUR THEM TO URGENT REACTION. I SHALL TRY TODAY WITH ARDESHIR ZAHEDI, WHO IS BUSTLING AROUND HERE. THE FRUSTRATING REACTION SO FAR IS THAT EVERYTHING SHOULD WAIT FOR ASHURA.

1978TEHRAN11874.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT, DEC 5 SUMMARY: ANOTHER ACTIVE NIGHT BUT LESS NOISY THAN BEFORE. SEVERAL INCIDENTS INVOLVING AMERICAN-OCCUPIED DWEL

segments.text: THAT OUTCOME WAS PROBABLY UP IN THE AIR, AND WOULD PROBABLY DEPEND ON KHOMEINI BEHAVIOR IN INTERIM. HE IMPLIED AYATOLLAH CERTAINLY COULD NOT SIMPLY EXIT FRANCE AFD RETURN AGAIN AS A TOURIST WITHOUT AT LEAST SOME OFFICIAL CONTACT REGARDING HIS STATUS.

TEHRAN WAS FILLED WITH RUMORS THAT AIR FRANCE IS HALTING SERVICE AND THAT FRENCH WILL EVACUATE. ONLY SUBSTANCE IS THAT PARIS-?BANGKOK FLIGHT IS NO LONGER STOPPING HERE DUE TO LACT OF MAINTENANCE FACIL-583 . MANY FRENCH ARE LEAVING NOW FOR HOLIDAYS, SINCE FRENCH LYCEE IS CLOSED UNTIL JANUARY, BUT THERE IS CERTAINLY NO EVACUATION. 5 SITUATION TODAY IS REMARKABLY QUIET. BAZAAR AND MANY OTHER SHOPS ARE CLOSED, BUT MANY ARE OPEN, PARTICULARLY IN NORTH TEHRAN. WE HAVE OBTAINED A COUNTERDEMONSTRATION LEAFLET WHICH MAY OR MAYK NOT HAVE AFFECTED THE NOISE LEVEL.

LEAFLET SPEAKS OF HOW DIFFICULT LIFE IS IN IRAN DUE TO STRIKES AND OTHER DISTURBANCES, AND IT BLAMES FOREIGN ELEMENTS FOR ORGANIZING ROOFTOP DEMONSTRATIONS. IT ENDS WITH WARNING THAT HOMES OF THOSE WHO SHOUT FROM THE ROOFTOPS WILL BE BOMBED. CONSUL SHIRAZ REPORTS 70-80 PERCENT OF SHOPS ARE NOMINALLY CLOSED, BUT MANY OF THESE ARE SERVING REGULAR CUSTOMERS. WESTINGHOUSE HAS SENT ENTIRE COMMUNITY TO USA FOR CHRISTMAS VACATION. POWER IS OUT AGAIN THROUGHOUT TEHRAM. WE BELIEVE PRESENT LULL IS MERELY BRIEF RESTING PERIOD AND THAT MASSIVE DISTURBANCES WILL TAKE PLACE AS ASHURA DRAWS NEAR.

THERE IS REPORT THAT AYATOLLAH KHOI IN NAJAF HAS SENT MESSAGE ASKING SHIITE FAITHFUL TO OBSERVE MOHARRAM QUIETLY. THIS APPARENTLY CONFIRMS EARLIER CONFIDENTIAL REPORTS WE RECEIVED THAT KHOI WOULD APPEAL TO PEOPLE NOT TO RIOT.

1978TEHRAN11876.subject: MORE STIRRING AMONG MODERATE LEADERS SUMMARY: HEAD OF TEACHERS' UNION SPEAKS OF FINDING A "THIRD WAY" TO AVOID EITHER RESURGENCE OF SHAH'S POWER OR

segments.text: SUMMARY: HEAD OF TEACHERS' UNION SPEAKS OF FINDING A "THIRD WAY" TO AVOID EITHER RESURGENCE OF SHAH'S POWER OR KHOMEINI VICTORY. HE BELIEVES SHAH MUST GO, HOWEVER, YEILDING TO A REGENCY COUNCIL. THIS IDEA IS CURRENT AMONG NATIONAL FRONT OPPOSITIONISTS TOO. END SUMMARY.

ON DEC 3 POL COUNSELOR WAS INVITED FOR CONVERSATION WITH MOHAMAD DERAKHSHESH, HEAD OF TEACHERS UNION WHO IS ACTIVE POLITICALLY WITH FRIENDS IN VARIOUS OTHER OCCUPATIONS. DERAKHSHESH WENT ON AT SOME LENGTH ABOUT THE NEED HE AND LIKE-MINDED MODERATE OPPONENTS OF THE SHAH FEEL FOR FINDING SOME "THIRD COURSE" WHICH WILL NOT BE THAT OF KHOMEINI. HE AND HIS FRIENDS VISUALIZE THIS AS INVOLVING THE DEPARTURE OF THE SHAH IN FAVOR OF A REGENCY COUNCIL TO BE MADE UP OF HIGHLY RESPECTED MEN-JUDGES, ETC. THIS COUNCIL WOULD THEN APPOINT REPRESENTATIVE GROUP OF POLITICAL LEADERS FROM NATIONAL FRONT, OTHER PARTIES, BAZAARIS, HIMSELF, ETC.
WHO WOULD FORM GOVT, PREPARE FREE ELECTIONS AND WIAT FOR NEW GOVT TO COME OUT OF FREELY ELECTED NEW MAJLIS.

DERAKHSHESH WAS AWARE THIS IS KIND OF SOLUTION MANY ARE TALKING ABOUT. HE DID NOT SHOW GREAT APPRECIATION FOR EFFECT DEPARTURE OF THE SHAH WOULD HAVE ON MILITARY HIGH COMMAND (THINKING THAT COULD BE HANDLED WITH FORMER RETIRED OFFICERS OF GOOD REPUTE) BUT WAS WILLING TO DISCUSS, AND SEEMED TO BE MODERATELY IMPRESSED, BY PROBLEMS THAT WOULD ARISE IF ARMY CRUMBLED. HE KEPT REPEATING NEED FOR ARMY TO BE "NATIONAL" RATHER THAN OWING ITS ALLEGIENCE TO ONE MAN, THE SHAH. HAVING DONE HIS MILITARY SERVICE AS AN OFFICER HIMSELF IN REZA SHAH'S ARMY, HE REMEMBERED CORRUPTION AND COWARDISE OF TOP OFFICERS.
NEVERTHELESS, HE GRANTED THE POINT THAT CHANGE IN ARMY MIGHT HAVE TO BE MORE GRADUAL, WHILE IT SERVES AS AN UMBRELLA TO PROTECT BASIC CHANGES IN THE POLITIAL SYSTEM.

DERAKHSHESH VOLUNTEERED THAT HE FEARED EITHER A RELIGIOUS DICTATORSHIP UNDER KHOMEINI OR A COMMUNIST TAKEOVER ONCE KHOMEINI IS SWEPT ASIDE. HIS OBJECTIVE IS TO START IRAN ON THE ROAD TOWARDS DEMOCRATIC GOVT. HE DID NOT QUARREL WITH POL COUNSELOR'S POINT THAT IRAN WAS HEADED THAT WAY UNDER SHAH'S LIBERALIZATION PLAN, BEYOND EXPRESSING CONTINUING INABILITY TO BELIEVE ANYTHING THE SHAH SAYS. HE SAID HE OR HIS FRIENDS WOULD IMMEDIATELY BE BRANDED TRAITORS AND LOSE THEIR FOLLOWERS IF THEY ACCEPTED TO WORK IN A GOVT UNDER THE SHAH.

HE KEPT RETURNING TO THE POINT THAT THE SHAH MUST GO--OTHERWISE KHOMEINI FOLLOWERS WILL NOT BE REDUCED IN POWER SUFFICIENTLY TO ALLOW DEMOCRATIC ELEMENTS TO BECOME ACTIVE AND ORGANIZE A DEMOCRATIC PROCESS FOR IRAN.

DERAKHSHESH SHOWED HE WAS IN TOUCH WITH MANY TEACHERS, PULLING OUT LONG SIGNATURES ON THEM, WHICH HE HAS BEEN RECEIVING FROM THE PROVINCES. IN ONE CASE THE TEACHERS HAD SOUGHT REFUGE IN A MOSQUE AND SIGNED THIS PETITION AFTER FIVE OF THEIR NUMBER HAD BEEN ARRESTED. ALL THE PETITIONS ARE ANTI-SHAH.

DERAKHSHESH COMPLAINED OF HAVING BEEN ARRESTED WHEN HE AND HIS PEOPLE TRIED TO PRINT SOME TRACTS AND A NEWSPAPER EARLIER THIS YEAR. HE NOTED THAT SHAH HAD MADE A MISTAKE IN APPOINTED SHARIF-EMAMI, WITH HIS IMAGE, AS PRIME MINISTER AT A TIME OF SUCH GREAT CRISIS. SHAH MIGHT HAVE SALVAGED A GREAT PART OF THE SITUATION IF HE HAD APPOINTED A COALITION GOVT INCLUDING SOME OPPOSITION FIGURES. HE INDICATED NEED HE AND HIS FRIENDS FELT TO BE POLITICALLY ACTIVE DESPITE HOPELESSNESS OF POLITICAL ACTION IN THE IMMEDIATE FUTURE, WHILE TEST OF STRENGTH BETWEEN KHOMEINI AND SHAH IS AT ITS HEIGHT.

HE AGREED WITH POL COUNSELOR THAT ONCE MOHARRAM PERIOD HAS PASSED IT WOULD BE WORTHWHILE TO TAKE ANOTHER LOOK AT THE SITUATION TO SEE WHETHER COMPROMISE SOLUTION WITH SHAH CONTINUING IN ROLE OF CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCH WOULD NOT MAKE SENSE FOR POLITICAL MODERATES LIKE HIMSELF, WHO RECOGNIZE DANGER OF MOB RULE, OR WORSE, SHOULD KHOMEINI OPPOSITION HAVE ITS WAY.

HE ALSO TOOK IN (SEVERAL TIMES DURING MEETING) POL COUNSELOR'S POINT THAT ECONOMIC PROBLEMS OF MODERN IRAN REMAIN FOR ANY FUTURE GOVERNMENT TO DEAL WITH AND, BY ENCOURAGING POPULAR BELIEF ON ROOT CAUSE OF ALL THEIR PROBLEMS AS THE SHAH, EXPECTATION IS CREATED AMONG THE PEOPLE THAT PROBLEMS WILL DISAPPEAR WHEN SHAH GOES; DISAPPOINTMENT WHEN PROBLEMS DO NOT DISAPPEAR COULD REDOUND AGAINST ANY FUTURE GOVT, EVEN ONE OF NATIONAL FRONT OPPOSITION. NEVERTHELESS, DERAKHSHESH EXPRESSED STRONG DOUBTS ANY SOLUTION WHICH DID NOT INCLUDE DEPARTURE OF THE SHAH COULD WORK.

COMMENT: DERAKSHSHESH IS TYPICAL OF MANY MODERATE LEADERS WHO ARE AFRAID OF KHOMEINI VICTORY AND WOULD LIKE TO FIND A "THIRD WAY." IN DERAKSHESH'S CASE HE IS CONVINCED THIS WOULD NO WORK UNLESS SHAH LEFT IN FAVOR OF A REGENCY COUNCIL. THAT IS POSITION VERY CLOSE TO OPPOSITIONIST NATIONAL FRONT'S, AS EXPRESSED BY MINATCHI TO EMBOFF VERY NEXT DAY (SEPTEL). THEY HAVE CLEARLY BEEN IN TOUCH.

1978TEHRAN11877.subject: SOME MILITARY MISGIVINGS ABOUT CURRENT IRANIAN SITUATION SUMMARY: OR IRANIAN GENERAL EXPRESSED FEELING SHAH

segments.text: SITUATION SUMMARY: OR IRANIAN GENERAL EXPRESSED FEELING SHAH MIGHT NOT BE ABLE TO SURVIVE. HE NOTED POSSIBLE POST-SHAH SCENARIOS. AZHARI MUST RETURN TO MILITARY IF SERVICES ARE NOT TO DEGENERATE INTO INTERSERVICE SQUABBLING. GENERAL FEARS NATIONWIDE UPRISING WHICH ARMY COULD NOT HANDLE WITHOUT GROUND WORK WHICH IS NOT RPT NOT NOW BEING DONE. HE ALSO SPOKE FAVORABLY OF REGENCY COUNCIL PROPOSAL MENTIONED BY LONDON TIMES. COLONELS IN ARMY AVIATION UNIT AT KERMANSHAH HAVE APPROACHED AMERICAN ADVISER TO TELL HIM SHAH SHOULD NOT STAY. GROUP BELIEVES IT IS IMPORTANT THAT AMERICANS AND ARMY REMAIN. END SUMMARY

IN DEC 3 CONVERSATION WITH ARMISH-MAAG CHIEF, GENERAL GAST, LT. GENERAL BAKHSHIARZAR, WHO IS DIRECTOR OF J-5 ON SUPREME COMMANDER'S STAFF, MENTIONED FOR FIRST TIME HIS OWN VIEW THAT SHAH MIGHT HAVE TO GO.
