THRUST OF CONVERSATION WITH GAST WAS THAT THINGS HAVE GONE FAR ENOUGH AND THAT IT'S TIME TO THINK ABOUT WHAT A NEW GOVERNMENT WOULD MEAN IF SHAH HAD TO LEAVE. BAKHSHIAZAR SAID IF NEW GOVERNMENT IS REQUIRED, SHAH SHOULD TRY TO PUT HIS SON ON THRONE AND REORGANIZE MILITARY BEFORE HE LEAVES.

ALTERNATIVE SCENARIO WOULD SEE SHAH TAKING 4-5 MONTHS "VACATION," BUT HE WOULD STILL HAVE TO ORGANIZE MILITARY--IRANIAN ARMED FORCES SIMPLY DO NOT HAVE LEADERSHIP TO HANDLE THIS PROBLEM, ESPECIALLY WITH GENERAL AZHARI IN EFFECT "ON SIDELINES" TRYING TO COPE WITH PRIME MINISTER'S JOB. GENERAL SAID IN HIS VIEW, ALI AMINI IS THE ONLY MAN WHO COULD ORGANIZE A CIVILIAN GOVERNMENT--HE IS THE ONLY ONE WITH SUPPORT, ENOUGH INTELLIGENCE, AND SUFFICIENT ADMINISTRATIVE ABILITY TO MAKE A GO OF A CIVILIAN CABINET.

BASHSHIAZAR SAID IT IS ABSOLUTELY ESSENTIAL THAT AZHARI RETURN TO MILITARY. YOUNGER OFFICERS ARE BEGINNING TO TALK ABOUT THEIR DISSATISFACTIONS, WHICH ARE NOTHING NEW, BUT "OPEN" TALK ABOUT THEM IS. MEN ARE TALKING TO HIM AND OTHER SENIOR OFFICERS ABOUT WAY THINGS ARE BEING RUN.

GENERAL'S GREATEST FEAR IS THAT UPRISINGS MIGHT TAKE PLACE COUNTRYWIDE. IN HIS VIEW, TABRIZ IS READY NOW FOR A BLOOD BATH. (HE INFORMED GAST THAT AN ARMORED BATTALION IS BEING MOVED INTO THE CITY WITHIN THE NEXT FEW DAYS.) ARMY IS SIMPLY NOT RPT NOT READY TO COPE WITH CONSEQUENCES OF COUNTRYWIDE REVOLT. THAT WOULD REQUIRE PLANNING AND LAYING GROUND WORK WHICH HAS NOT BEEN DONE.

AT END OF CONVERSATION, BAKHSHIAZAR LET DROP FACT THAT HE PERSONALLY FAVORED IDEA OF REGENCY COUNCIL (COMMENT: TO REPLACE SHAH) WHICH LONDON TIMES (IN IRAN, VIA BBC PERSIAN SERVICE) HAD SURFACED SEVERAL DAYS EARLIER. GAST REGARDS BAKHSHIAZAR AS ONE OF MORE INTELLIGENT IRANIAN OFFICERS AND ONE WHO HAS SERVED SHAH DIRECTLY OFTEN IN PAST AND HAS ALWAYS BEEN LOYAL TO MONARCHY AND SHAH PERSONALLY. THUS HIS VIEWS ARE MORE SIGNIFICANT THAN THOSE OF MOST SENIOR MILITARY MEN.

U.S. REGIONAL AVIATION ADVISER TO IRANIAN ARMY AVIATION DIRECT SUPPORT GROUP (ADSG) AT KERMANSHAH WAS APPROACHED BY THREE IRANIAN COLONELS FROM ADSG ON DEC 4. TRIO WANTED TO MAKE TWO POINTS TO HIM: A) THEY HAD CONCLUDED THAT THE SHAH COULD NOT REMAIN, AND AMERICANS SHOULD KNOW THAT; AND B) IT WAS VERY IMPORTANT FOR IRAN THAT THE ARMY REMAIN AND THAT AMERICANS REMAIN IN IRAN AS PART OF WHATEVER FOLLOWS SHAH'S DEPARTURE.

EMBASSY COMMENT: ABOVE IS AN INDICATION OF "THINKING THE UNTHINKABLE" WHICH IS GOING ON IN SOME QUARTERS OF MILITARY. WHILE WE DO NOT BELIEVE THIS IS THE DOMINANT MILITARY VIEW, IT IS IMPORTANT THAT IT EXISTS AT ALL, AND THAT OFFICERS NOW FEEL CONSTRAINED TO MENTION THEIR MISGIVINGS ABOUT PRESENT SITUATION TO AMERICAN OFFICERS WITH WHOM THEY HAVE BUILT UP RELATIONSHIPS.
ABOVE COORDINATED WITH DAO.

1978TEHRAN11878.subject: BLEAK OUTLOOK FOR THE IRANIAN ECONOMY

segments.text: THE AMBASSADOR HOSTED THE BOARD OF IRAN AMERICAN CHAMBER OF COMMERCE AT ITS REGULAR MONTHLY MEETING ON DECEMBER 4. THE MEMBERS PRESENT (ALL AMERICAN BUSINESSMEN EXCEPT FOR AHMAD LADJEVARDI OF THE BEHSHAHR INDUSTRIAL GROUP) PAINTED A BLEAK AND VERY DISCOURAGING PICTURE OF THE IRANIAN ECONOMY.

THE MOST PRESSING PROBLEM IS THE VIRTUAL SHUTDOWN OF IRAN'S BANKING AND FINANCIAL SYSTEM. THE SYSTEM HAS BEEN PLAGUED WITH STRIKES FOR TWO MONTHS, BUT THE VIRTUAL CLOSURE OF THE CENTRAL BANK OF IRAN SINCE NOVEMBER 25 HAS PARALYZED FINANCIAL TRANSACTIONS AND, IF NOT REMEDIED, WILL SOON PARALYZE BUSINESS ACTIVITY. THEY REPORTED THAT BUSINESSMENARE PLAGUED BY SEVERE SHORTAGES OF BOTH IRANIAN MONEY AND FOREIGN EXCHANGE. LADJEVARDI, WHO HAS NO SHORTANGE OF LIQUID ASSETS, FEARS THAT HE WILL NOT BE ABLE TO FIND ENOUGH CASH TO MEET HIS NEXT PAYROLL. AMERICAN CITIZEN EMPLOYEES, IF PAID IN RIALS, ARE NOT ABLE TO CONVERT THEIR PAY INTO DOLLARS.
THE CONSENSUS WAS THAT BUSINESS ACTIVITY WILL VIRTUALLY CEASE IF THE PROBLEM IN THE BANKING SYSTEM IS NOT RESOLVED WITHIN THE NEXT FEW DAYS.

THE CRISIS IN THE BANKING SYSTEM IS THE MOST IMMEDIATE CONCERN, BUT THE SHUTDOWN OF THE IGAT GAS PIPELINE, THE STRANGULATION OF GOODS IN THE CUSTOMS, AND THE FAILURE OF THE GOVERNMENT TO PAY OBLIGATIONS WERE CITED AS INCREADINGLY SERIOUS PROBLEMS. THE FEELING WAS THAT THE CURRENT GOVERNMENT OF PRIMIN AZHARI IS NOT SUFFICIENTLY AWARE OF THE DIMENSIONS OF THE ECONOMIC CRISIS IMPENDING OR OF ITS ACCELERATING NATURE. THEY RECOGNIZED THAT THE PRIMARY CONCERN OF THE GOVERNMENT IS TO MAINTAIN ORDER, BUT THEY STRONGLY RECOMMENDED THAT THE GOVERNMENT BE MADE AWARE OF THE IMPENDING DISASTER.

SEVERAL BOARD MEMBERS EXPRESSED CONFIDENCE IN LONG-TERM PROSPECTS FOR IR,. ONE MEMBER ACKNOWLEDGED THAT THE GOVERNMENT HAD NOT PAID OBLIGATIONS TO HIS COMPANY SINCE LAST MAY, BUT SAID HIS COMPANY IS WILLING TO RIDE OUT THE CURRENT CRISIS IN VIEW OF THEIR LONGER TERM OPTIMISM ABOUT IRAN.

COMMENT: MOST AMERICAN BUSINESSES ARE IN IRAN FOR THE LONG TERM, ARE WELL FUNDED, AND ARE WILLING TO ACCEPT THE DIFFICULTIES PREVAILING IN THE CURRENT CRISIS BECAUSE OF THEIR FAITH THAT IN THE END A SOLUTION WILL BE FOUND AND IRAN'S ECONOMY WILL BE RESTORED. THE BANKING CRISIS POSES AN IMMEDIATE PRACTICAL FINANCIAL PROBLEM FOR THEM, HOWEVER, IN MEETING THEIR PAYROLLS. SOUND IRANIAN COMPANIES, SUCH AS THE BEHSHAHR INDUSTRIAL GROUP ARE IN A SIMILAR SITUATION. THEY WILL BE ABLE TO WEATHER THE CURRENT STORM EASILY IF IT IS NOT PROLONGED. IN SOME CASES, HOWEVER, PARTICULARLY IN CONSTRUCTION PROJECTS, AN ACUTE CASH FLOW PROBLEM IS DEVELOPING.

IF A SOLUTION IS NOT FOUND QUICKLY MANY INDUSTRIES WILL CEASE TO PRODUCE, CONSTRUCTION PROJECTS WILL BE SUSPENDED, AND THERE IS A POSSIBILITY THAT LARGE BANKRUPTCIES WILL OCCUR IN AT LEAST SEVERAL CASES.

THERE APPEARS TO BELLITTLE PROSPECT THAT THE BANKING SYSTEM CAN BE FULLY REVIVED PRIOR TO ASHURA, WHICH WILL OCCUR ON DECEMBER 11. THE AMERICAN BUSINESS COMMUNITY IS ALARMED AND IS PRESSING THE EMBASSY FMR ACTION TO RESOLVE THE PROBLEMS. SOME HAVE EVEN SUGGESTED THAT THE EMBASSY MAKE DOLLAR EXCHANGE AVAILABLE TO AMERICAN CITIZENS DURING THE EMERGENCY PERIOD. THE EMBASSY FULLY APPRECIATES THEIR DESPAIR IN OBSERVING THE FAILURE OF THE AZHARI GOVERNMENT TO KEEP THE CENTRAL BANK AND OTHER VITAL PUBLIC FUNCTIONS IN OPERATION.

THE AMBASSADOR HAS USED EVERY AVAILABLE OPPORTUNITY TO PRESS GOI OFFICIALS TO ASSURE THAT VITAL PUBLIC SERVICES AND OIL PRODUCTION ARE NOT INTERRUPTED. IMMEDIATELY AFTER HIS MEETING WITH THE CHAMBER BOARD, HE TOOK ADVANTAGE OF A PREVIOUSLY SCHEDULED MEETING WITH FONMIN AFSHAR TO RAISE THE SERIOUS MATTERS POSED BY THE CHAMBER BOARD. AFSHAR REPORTED THE CONVERSATION TO CENTRAL BANK PRESIDENT KHOSKISH, WHO TELEPHONED THE AMBASSADOR ON DECEMBER 5 TO REPORT THAT THE CENTRAL BANK AND THE BANKING SYSTEM ARE FUNTIONING AND CAN HANDLE THE BUSINESS COMMUNITY'S NEEDS.
WE ARE NOT FULLY CONFIDENT THAT KOSHKISH IS RIGHT (SEE SEPTEL) BUT THE EMBASSY IS FOLLOWING UP THE SPECIFIC COMPLAINTS MADE AT YESTERDAY'S MEETING.

1978TEHRAN11882.subject: VIEWS OF PROMINENT BAZAARIS ON IRANIAN POLITICAL SITUATION

segments.text: SUMMARY: EMBOFF MET DEC 4 WITH HAJI ALI ASGHAR KASHANI AND HAJI (FNU) JAFFARI, PROMINENT BAZAAR MERCHANTS FOR FOUR HOUR DISCUSSION OF IRANIAN POLITICAL SITUATION. BAZAARIS PROVIDED EYEWITNESS ACCOUNTS OF DEMONSTRATIONS, DATA ON BAZAAR ORGANIZATION, COMPLAINTS AGAINST THE GOVERNMENT, SOME IDEA OF A SOLUTION FOR IRAN WHICH THEY WOULD FIND SATISFACTORY, AND AN OFFER OF COOPERATION TO ENABLE EMBOFF TO MAKE ADDITIONAL CONTACTS IN THE BAZAAR AND AMONG RELIGIOUS ELEMENTS. END SUMMARY.

EMBOFF MET AFTERNOON OF DEC 4 WITH HAJI ALI ASGHAR KASHANI, A WEALTHY BAZAARI WHOSE CONTRIBUTIONS TO SMALLER BAZAAR MERCHANTS ENABLE THEM TO TAKE PART IN CURRENT STRIKE AND WHO SERVES AS CONDUIT FOR FUNDS TO KHOMEINI, AND HAJI (FNU) JAFFARI, A STRONG SUPPORTER OF KHOMEINI WHO IS ALSO A COUSIN OF PROSHAH MOB LEADER SHABAN JAFFARI. BAZAARIS PROVIDED FOLLOWING INFORMATION.

DOMONSTRATIONS: ACCORDING TO JAFFARI, NIGHT OF DEC 2 WAS PARTICULARLY VIOLENT IN BAZAAR AREA. TROOPS KILLED SOME 300 DEMONSTRATORS. JAFFARI CLAIMED TO HAVE SEEN THE SHOOTING AND THE BODIES LITTERING SAR CHESHMEH STREET. DURING CLEANUP THE SHOES LEFT LYING IN THE STREET FILLED TWO LARGE GUNNY SACKS. (COMMENT: EMBOFF HAS OBSERVED SPRAY-PAINTED SLOGANS ON WALLS IN SAR CHESHMEH STREET NEAR BAZAAR WHICH READ, THE SHAH HAS KILLED 300 PEOPLE IN SAR CHESHMEH--WE WILL KILL THE SHAH END . END COMMENT.) KASHANI DID NOT WITNESS THE INCIDENT ALTHOUGH HE BELIEVES IT TOOK PLACE.

HE STATED THAT A FEMALE RELATIVE LIVING IN SAR CHESHMEH WAS KILLED ALONG WITH HER HUSBAND AND TWO SMALL SONS WHEN SOLDIERS BURST INTO THEIR HOME AND BEGAN FIRING. KASHARI HAD CANCELED DEC 3 MEETING WITH EMBOFF IN ORDER TO ATTEND THEIR FUNERALS. AS FURTHER EVIDENCE OF DEC 2 INCIDENT KASHARI CITED APPEARANCE AT HIS DOOR OF TWO TERRIFIED TEEN AGED BOYS WHO CLAIMED THAT THREY AND THREE FRIENDS HAD JOINED THE DEMONSTRATION IN SAR CHESHMEH WHERE OTHER THREE WERE SHOT BY SOLDIERS. THE TWO BOYS SPENT REMAINDER OF NIGHT IN KASHANI'S HOME.

(COMMENT: EMBOFF DID NOT KNOW KASHANI DURING EARLIER ASSIGNMENT TO IRAN BUT MUTUAL ACQUAINTANCE NOTES KASHANI IS INCLINED TO EXAGGERATE IN ORDER INCREASE IMPORT OF A STORY. GIVEN GENERAL IRANIAN ATTITUDE TOWARD WOMEN AND CHILDREN, EMBOFF DOUBTS THAT SOLDIERS WOULD HARM THEM IF THEY WERE NOT AMONG THE DEMONSTRATORS IN THE STREETS. HOWEVER, IT SEEMS LIKELY THATSOME VIOLENT INCIDENT TOOK PLACE IN SAR CHESHMEH. JAFFARI SWORE BY QORAN AND BY IMAM JAFAR SADEQ THAT HE WITNESSED SHOOTINGS AND, IN COMMEMORATION, HAS VOWED TO TAKE NO FOOD OUTSIDE OF BAZAAR UNTIL END OF MOHARRAM.
JAFFARI IS VERY RELIGIOUS MAN AND SUCH STEPS LEND CREDENCE TO HIS WORDS AMONG THOSE WHO KNOW HIM. END COMMENT)

KASHANI AND JAFFARI AGREED THAT THOSE PHYSICALLY DEMONSTRATING ARE PRIMARILY STUDENTS RATHER THAN BAZAARIS, ALTHOUGH MANY OF THESE STUDENTS ARE CHILDREN OF BAZAARIS. THE BAZAAR SUPPORTS THESE STUDENTS MORALLY AND FINANCIALLY BUT HAS NOT SO FAR SUPPLEMENTED THEIR NUMBERS. THE STUDENTS ARE ORGANIZED BY OTHER STUDENTS AND TEACHERS RATHER THAN BY BAZAAR. KASHANI AND JAFFARI DO NOT KNOW WHO THE STUDENT ORGANIZERS ARE BUT DO NOT BELIEVE THAT THEY REPRESENT THE TUDEH PARTY. KASHANI RATHER DRAMATICALLY VOWED TO KILL HIS OWN SON IF HE SHOULD BCOME COMMUNIST.

BAZAAR ORGANIZATION AND OUTLOOK: ACCORDING TO BOTH KASHANI AND JAFFAIR, BAZAAR IS HIGHLY INDIVIDUALISTIC PLACE WHICH OPERATES, IN MANY WAYS, LIKEAN EXTENDED FAMILY. ASNAF ARE IMPORTANT BAZAARI ORGANIZATIONS BUT THEIR INFLUENCE IS LIMITED ESSENTIALLY TO MATTERS OF TRADE AND ECONOMICS. OTAQE-ASNAF NEVER SPOKE FOR BAZAAR. IT WAS ARTIFICIAL GOVERNMENT CREATION GRAFTED ONTO BAZAAR AND DESPISED BY BAZAARIS, WHO WERE DELIGHTED AT ITS DISSOLUTION BUT GAVE GOI NO CREDIT FOR ABOLISHING SOMETHING WHICH SHOULD NEVER HAVE EXISTED. IN POLITICAL MATTERS BAZAAR DOES NOT NECESSARILY SPEAK WITH ONE VOICE.

IT MIGHT HAVE SEVERAL LEADERS INCLUDING MERCHANTS SUCH AS KASHANI, NATIONAL FRONT POLITICIANS SUCH AS BAZARGHAN OR SANJABI, OR AYATOLLAH SUCH AS KHOMEINI, TALEGHANI OR NOURI. JAFFARI REGARDS THE LATTER AS BETER INFORMED THAN TALEGHANI ON POLITICAL MATTERS. ------------------019399 051711Z /43 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 2000 SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 11882

BAZAARIS FOLLOW KHOMEINI BECAUSE HE FOCUSES AND EXPRESSES THEIR DISCONTENT. HE IS REVERED AS A WISE, HOLY AND HUMBLE MAN. HOWEVER, HELIS NOT A POLITICAL LEADER AND, IF HE SHOULD TOMORROW IDENTIFY WITH THE SHAH, BAZAARIS WOULD FORSAKE KHOMEINI AND SEARCH FOR SOMEONE ELSE TO FOLLOW. BAZAARIS CONTRIBUTE WILLINGLY TO KHOMINI BECUASE THEY BELIEVE HE USES THE MONEY FOR CHARITABLE PURPOSES. JAFFARI DESCRIBED SIMPLICITY OF KHOMEINI'S LIFESTYLE IN NAJAF WHEN HE DELIVERED 15 MILLION TOMANS (ABOUT DOLLARS 2 MILLION) WHICH KASHANI HAD OCOLLECED IN BAZAAR.

BAZAARIS EXPRESSED GENERAL COMPLAINTS AGAINST THE SHAH SIMILAR TO THOSE HEARD ELSEWHERE, I.E., CORRUPTION OF HIGH-LEVEL OFFICIALS, MURDER AND TORTURE OF OPPOSITIONISTS, OVER-CONCENTRATION OF POWER AND POOR ECONOMIC DECISIONMAKING. HOWEVER, BAZAARIS CONCENTRATED THEIR IRE ON SAVAK AND ITS FORMER CHIEF NEMATOLLAH NASSIRI. SAVAK UNDER NASSIRI, THEY SAID, HAS KILLED AND TORUTURED THOUSANDS OF PEOPLE. DURING THE IMPRISONMENT OF THE AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI, SAVAK JAILORS HAD RAPED THE WOMEN IN HIM HOME AND FORCED TALEGHANI TO DRINK HIS JAILORS' URINE. KASHANI AND JAFFARI FELT THAT THEY MIGHT FORGIVE THE CORRUPTION OF A HOVEYDA OR A VALIAN BUT THAT ONLY NASSIRI'S BLOOD WOULD WASH AWAY HIS CRIMES.

(COMMENT: EMBOFF HAS HEARD IRANIANS AT ALL SOCIAL LEVELS CALL FOR EXECUTION OF SOME ARRESTED FORMER HIGH OFFICIALS AS EVIDENCE THAT SHAH IS SERIOUS WHEN HE SAYS INTENDS TO REFORM AND TO PROMOTE REFORM.)

BOTH MEN FELT THAT IRANIANS WOULD NEVER ACCEPT A RETURN TO POLITICAL SITUATION WHICH PREVAILED IN IRAN UNTIL A FEW MONTHS AGO. FIRST, SHAH MUST SHOW SOME INDICATION OF HIS SINCERITY, SUCH AS EXECUTION OF NASSIRI. THEREAFTER, A CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCHY SHOULD BE ESTABLISHED ALONG THE LINES OF THE 1906 CONSTITUTION. IF THE CONSTITUTION PREVAILED, BAZAARIS WOULD SUPPORT RETENTION OF THE THRONE EVEN IF THE CONSTITUTION WERE TO PROVIDED THAT THE SHAH SHOULD BE COMMANDER-IN-CHIEF OF THE ARMED FORCES.

BAZAARIS AGREED THAT IT WOULD BE MUTUALLY ADVANTAGEOUS FOR EMBOFF TO INCREASE HIS KNOWLEDGE OF AND CONTACTS AMONG RELIGIOUS ELEMENTS. THEREFORE, THEY OFFERED THEIR PERSONAL PROTECTION TO EMBOFF IN BAZAAR DURING MOHARRAM AND WILL ATTEMPT TO ARRANGE MEETINGS FOR EMBOFF WITH AYATOLLAHS TALEGHANI AND NOURI.

COMMENT: HIGHLY EMOTIONAL PERSONAL COMMITMENT OF BOTH MEN TO OPPOSITION STRUGGLE CAME ACROSS LOUD AND CLEAR. IN THAT CONTEXT THEIR WILLINGNESS TO ACCEPT A CONSTITUTIONAL SOLUTION IS SOMEWHAT ENCOURAGING.

I AM PLEASED TO HAVE AUTHORIZATION CONTAINED REFTEL TO OFFER OFFICIAL DEPENDENTS OPTION TO LEAVE IRAN TEMPORARILY IF THEY WISH TO DO SO. THIS WILL ADDRESS A MORALE FACTOR WHICH COULD BECOME CRITICAL IN THE DAYS AHEAD.

MESSAGE AS WRITTEN RAISES NUMBER OF QUESTIONS TO WHICH I WILL NEED IMMEDIATE ANSWERS BEFORE EFFECTIVE ACTION CAN BE TAKEN. (A) IS OPTION FOR TEMPORPY DEPARTURE AVAILABLE ONLY AT SAFEHAVEN POSTS, I.E., ATHENS, FRANKFURT, AND ROME? IF SO, WE BELIEVE WE ALREADY HAVE FUND CITATIONS TO COVER SUCH MOVE. WE ASSUME PER DIEM IS AUTHORIZED. (B) IF OPTION ALSO IS TO INCLUDE TRAVEL TO THE UNITED STATES, WILL A SEPARATION ALLOWANCE BE PAID? (C) FORLMILITARY PERSONNEL, ALL COSTS ASSOCIATED WITH TRAVEL, HOUSING, ETC., OF DEPENDENTS CURRENTLY CHARGED TO GOI UNDER REQUIREMENTS OF FMS LEGISLATION. DO WE HAVE LEGAL AUTHORITY TO PAY COSTS FOR ACCOUNT U.S.
GOVT WITHOUT SEEKING COMPENSATION FROM GOI? (D) WILL TRAVEL ON FOREIGN AIROINES BE AUTHORIZED WITHOUT REQUIRING FORTY-EIGHT HOUR WAIT STIPULATED BY USG REGULATIONS?

WHILE THESE QUESTIONS MAY SOUND PICAYUNE, THEIR ANSWERS WILL TO LARGE DEGREE DETERMINE NUMBERS OF DEPENDENTS WHO WILL EXERCISE OPTION TO LEAVE. PERSONAL FINANCIAL VONSIDERATIONS ARE VERY MUCH CENTRAL TO INDIVIDUAL FAMILY DECISIONS IN THIS SITUATION. IT IS OUR ESTIMATE THAT SOMEWHAT FEWER PERSONS WILL LEAVE IF AUTHORIZATION IS ONLY FOR SAFEHAVEN POSTS. HOWEVER, GREATER NUMBERS WOULD GO IF THEY COULD BE PROVIDED MEANS FOR SEPARATE LIVING AND SCHOOLING IN THE UNITED STATES. THIS IS PARTICULARLY APPLICABLE TO FAMILIES OF LOWER RANK MILITARY PERSONNEL.

AS FAR AS DISCUSSION WITH GOI IS CONCERNED, I BELIEVE MY PREVIOUS TALK WITH PRIME MINISTER COVERS THE MATTER IN PRINCIPLE. WHAT I WILL WANT TO DO WHEN WE HAVE A CLEARER PICTURE OF THE NUMBER OF POTENTIAL DEPARTEES IS TO GO BACK TO HIM WITH AN INDICATION OF THE NUMBERS WHO ARE LEAVING AND EXPLAIN THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THEIR DEPARTURE.

PENDING RECEIPT OF ANSWERS TO QUESTIONS PARA 2, I AM HAVING MY STAFF POLL ALL OFFICIAL EMPLOYEES TO ASK HOW MANY WOULD EXERCIS OPTION TO MOVE THEIR FAMILIES (A) IF THEY CAN GO TO SAFEHAVENS AND RECEIVE PER DIEM IN ACCORDANCE WITH STANDARD E AND E AUTHORIZATIONS, AND (B) IF THEY CAN GO TO THE U.S. WITH SOME SORT OF SEPARATION ALLOWANCE (LATTER WOULD BE "SAME OPTION THAT IS AVAILABLE TO AMENDENTS OF OTHER AMERICAN EMPLOYEES IN IRAN" AS CITED REFTEL).

ALTHOUGH MERE FACT OF OUR INQUIRIES AMONG STAFF WILL HAVE SALUTARY MORALE EFFECT, WASHINGTON SHOULD BE AWARE THAT IT WILL PROBABLY PROVE IMPOSSIBLE TO HAVE MANY BEFORE ASHURA. AE ARE ALREADY IN THE EYE OF THAT HURRICANE AND WE HAVE RESTRICTED MOVEMENT THROUGHOUT CITY. MOREOVER, AIRLINES ARE FLYING HEAVILY BOOKED IN THESE FEW DAYS, WITH CONTINGENT ARRANGEMENTS FOR REDUCED PASSENGER LOAD BECAUSE OF PROSPECT THEIR AVIATION FUEL SUPPLIES WILL BE RESTRICTED HERE.

HOWEVER, EVEN IF IRAN SURVIVES ASHURA WITHOUT MAJOR EXPLOSION, ALL INDICATIONS ARE THAT STALEMATE WILL BE PROLONGED, WITH SHORTAGES DEVELOPING IN SUCH AMENITIES AS HEATING FUEL, COOKING GAS, GASOLINE, AND OTHER CREATURE COMFORTS. MOREOVER, SINCE WE HAVE CLOSED TEHRAN AMERICAN SCHOOL UNTIL JANUARY 6, AND SINCE MANY PARENTS WILL WORRY ABOUT PROSPECTS FOR NORMAL SCHOOL ACTIVITY IN 1979, I BELIEVE WASHINGTON SHOULD LOOK UPON THIS DEPARTURE OF DEPENDENTS AS A LONGER TERM ISSUE, RATHER THAN MERELY RELATED TO THE POTENTIAL VIOLENCE OF ASHURA. OF COURSE, A TRULY VIOLENT ASHURA WILL HAVE EFFECT OF SHARPLY INCREASING NUMBERS WHO WILL WISH TO DEPART SOONEST.
THEREFORE, WE ARE ACTING ON ASSUMPTPON THE OPTION FOR DEPARTURE WILL REMAIN OPEN INDEFINITELY FOR AS LONG AS SITUATION REMAINS ABNORMAL.

I HOPE THERE WILL BE NP RPT NO NEED TO PUBLICIZE THIS DECISOON. HOWEVER, I AM AWARE THAT RECENT LETTER FROM ARMY DEPENDENT TO WASHINGTON POST MAY CAUSE INQUIRIES WHICH WILL NEED TO BE ANSWERED. IN SUCH EVENT, EMPHASIS UPON WORDS "VOLUNTARY" AND "DEPENDENTS" MUST BE STRESSED.

USAF TAFT COMMANDER IN TABRIZ REPORTS THAT ON SOME 38-40 F-5S IN TABRIZ WIRES TO MICROSWITCH WHICH CONTROLS LANDING GEAR WERE CUT NIGHT OF DEC 5 OR PERHAPS DURING PREVIOUS 24 HOURS. DISCOVERY APPARENTLY MADE MORNING DEC 6 BEFORE ANY OF THE PLANCES WERE MOVED FROM FLIGHT LINE WHERE THEY WERE PARKED. IN MORNING DEC 6 CONVERSATION, IIAF COMMANDER GENERAL RABII TOLD CHIEF OF MAAG AIR FORCE SECTION IT APPEARED SABOTAGE HAD BEEN CARRIED OUT AGAINST ONE OR PERHAPS A FEW MORE F-5S IN TABRIZ.
TAFT COMMANDER NOTED SOME DISAFFECTION AMONG IIAF HOMAFARS (SOMEWHAT LIKE A WARRENT OFFICER) WITH WHOME HE DISCUSSED THIS SABOTAGE.

IN TELEPHONE CONVERSATION WITH EMBOFF, SMALL BAZAAR MERCHANT ASSADOLLAH ABASSI STATED THAT SERIOUS CLASH HAD TAKEN PLACE BETWEEN BAZAARIS DEMONSTRATING IN BAZAAR AND SOLDIERS DURING NIGHT OF DEC. 5. ABASSI DID NOT WITNESS DEMONSTRATION BUT HAS BEEN TOLD THAT 20-30 PEOPLE WERE SHOT OFF ROOFTOPS WHEN THEY BEGAN THROWING ROCKS AND HOT WATER ONTO TROOPS. DEMONSTRATION WAS IN COMMEMORATION OF DEATH OF SOME 300 PEOPLE IN SAR CHESHMEH STREET DURING NIGHT OF DEC. 2.
BAZAAR REMAINS CLOSED TODAY ALTHOUGH ABASSI AND OTHERS ARE WORKING IN THEIR SHOPS WITH DOORS CLOSED.

IN AN OMINOUS DEVELOPMENT, ABASSI REPORTED THAT LEADERS OF VARIOUS GANGS OF BAZAAR THUGS HAVE BECOME RADICALIZED BY SAR CHESHMEN INCIDENT, WHICH IS BECOMING SOMETHING OF A CAUSE CELEBRE IN BAZAAR. GANG LEADERS, WHO HAVE OBTAINED TWO TRUCK LOADS OF SOVIET SMALL ARMS (ABASSI CANNOT PERSONALLY CONFIRM THIS) HAVE INSTRUCTED THEIR ADHERENTS TO EMULATE THE CHARIKS AND TO SEARCH OUT AND KILL THE SHAH AND GEN. AZHARI EVEN IF THEY SHOULD FLEE IRAN. EMBOFF POINTED OUT THAT ARMED ACTION BY BAZAARIS COULD LEAD TO USE OF TANKS AND OTHER HEAVY WEAPONS BY THE TROOPS BUT ABASSI REPLIED THAT EMOTIONS ARE RUNNING SO HIGH THAT BAZAARIS NO LONGER FEAR THESE WEAPONS.

ACCORDING TO ABASSI, WORD HAS COME UP AGAIN FROM QOM (NO AYATOLLAH SPECIFIED) THAT THE PEOPLE SHOULD DON WHITE AND MAKE THE LARGEST POSSIBLE DEMONSTRATIONS ON ASHURA AND TASSUA. TEHRAN BAZAAR AYATOLLAH SEYYED MASUD TALEGHANI HAS GIVEN HIS IMPRIMATEUR TO THESE DEMONSTRATIONS.

EMBOFF HAS CONFIRMED TALEGHANI'S SUPPORT FOR LARGE TASSUA DEMO (DEC 10) THROUGH SEPARATE BAZAAR SOURCE. CANNOT YET CONFIRM REMAINDER OF ABOVE INFORMATION BUT IT IS SIGNIFICANT THAT IT IS ACCEPTED BY BAZAARIS.

1978TEHRAN11939.subject: REPORTED PARTICIPATION BY U.S.-TRAINED IRANIAN STUDENTS IN ORGANIZING ANTI-SHAH DEMONSTRATIONS IN IRAN

segments.text: IRANIAN STUDENTS IN ORGANIZING ANTI-SHAH DEMONSTRATIONS IN IRAN AT DISCUSSION OVER DINNER IN HOUSE OF DIRECTOR OF ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION DEPT MANOUCHEHR FAELI, DIRECTOR'S WIFE SHAHNAZ EXPRESSED HER UNDERSTANDING THAT MUCH OF THE CURRENT ANTI-SHAH STREET ACTIVITY WAS DIRECTED AND ORGANIZED BY SOME 200 IRANIAN STUDENTS WHO HAD RECENTLY RETURNED FROM THE U.S. SHAHNAZ'S BROTHER-IN-LAW, HOMAN QAVIMI, AGREED, STATING THAT A FORMER CONFEDERATION OF IRANIAN STUDENTS ORGANIZER AT BERKELEY (FNU) PARTOVI, HAD TAKEN ADVANTAGE OF LOOSENED SECURITY PROCEDURES NEAR END OF SHARIF-EMAMI ADMINISTRATION TO RETURN TO IRAN. PARTOVI, LIKE MANY OTHER IRANIAN STUDENTS IN THE U.S., FELT THAT EVENTS IN IRAN HAD RENDERED THEIR MOVEMENT IN THE U.S.
IRRELEVANT AND THAT ONLY MEANINGFUL FIELD OF ENDEAVOR HAD BECOME IRAN ITSELF.

I MET WITH AMBASSADOR ZAHEDIFOR TWO HOURS AT HIS RESIDENCE EVENING DECMEBER 5. GIVEN LETHARGY, DIFFIDENCE, AND PALLOR OF MOST OFFICIAL IRANIANS THESE DAYS, ZAHEDI'S ANIMAL ENERGY WAS A WELCOME RELIEF. WE DISCUSSED ACTION HE IS TAKING TO INFUSE A LITTLE ZEAL INTO GOI AND I PROPOSED SOME OTHER THOUGHTS FOR HIS CONSIDERATION.

IN FIRST PLACE, HE SAID HE HAD CHANGED HIS MIND ABOUT SUGGESTING SHAH GO ON TELEVISION. AFTER ONE LOOK AT SHAH, ZAHEDI DECIDED TV WOULD DO HIM MORE HARM THAN GOOD. HE DID, HOWEVER, TAKE CREDIT FOR GETTING HIM TO VISIT DOSHAN TOPPEH AIR BASE, WHERE HE WAS TELEVISED (UNFORTUNATELY, HE LOOKED LIKE A ZOMBIE).
HE SAYS HE WILL ATTEMPT TO MOVE SHAH TO SOME OTHER MILITARY INSTALLATIONS, BUT WITHOUT TV PUBLICITY. I URGED HIM ALSO TO GET SHAH OVER TO SCS HEADQUARTERS, TO RENEW CONTACT WITH HIS SENIOR MILITARY.
ZAHEDI ALSO REACTED POSITIVELY TO MY SUGGESTION THAT ARMY GET SOME FOOD AND KEROSENE DOWN TO SOUTH TEQRAN AND TAKE CREDIT FOR ITS DISTRIBUTION. THIS, IN TURN , COULD BE TELEVISED.

DISCUSSED PROSPECTS FOR NEGOTIATIONS TO FORM COALITION GOVT. ZAHEDI SAID HE WOULD PERSONALLY BE MEETING WITH SEVERAL OPPOSITIONISTS TO ENCOURAGE THEM TO JOIN. (UNFORTUNATELY, HIS PERSONAL ASKING PRICE FOR THE SHAH'S CONSTITUTIONAL ROLE IS HIGHER THAN THAT DEMANDED BY SHAH.) IN GENERAL, HOWEVER, ZAHEDI HAS DOUBTS COALITION CAN BE FORMED AND SAYS HE IS THINKING IN TERMS OF LONGER DURATION FOR MILITARY GOVT.
I WENT OVER THE TROUBLES IN THE CENTRAL BANK, THE CUSTOMS, MINISTRY OF FINANCE, ETC., IN HOPE HE CAN STIMULATE A LITTLE ACTION. HE MADE NOTES AND SAID HE WOULD TRY.

WE CANDIDLY DISCUSSED SHAH'S LINGERING SUSPICIONS ABOUT U.S. "CONTINGENCY PLANS" AND DECIDED BEST WAY TO COPE WITH THIS WAS FOR ZAHEDI AND MYSELF TO HAVE JOINT AUDIENCE WITH SHAH. HE WILL ARRANGE THIS.

SCENE AT HIS HOME WAS TYPICAL. AS I ARRIVED, TAHERI OF KAYHAN WAS LEAVING. AS I LEFT, SENATOR MEZBAHZADEH AND KHODADAD FARMANFARMIAN WERE ARRIVING. ZAHEDI INTENDS TO STAY THROUGH ASHURA AND ASSURES ME HE WILL KEEP CHURNING ALL THE TIME.

SUMMARY: NO RPT NO EMBASSY HAS EVACUATED DEPENDENTS OUT OF IRAN, THOUGH DEPENDENTS HAVE LEFT ON SCHEDULED HOLIDAYS. ONLY EMBASSY RECOMMENDING DEPARTURE TO ITS PRIVATE CITIZENS (BUT NOT RPT NOT OFFICIAL STAFF) IS NEW ZEALAND, WHICH IS SUGGESTING EARLY CHRISTMAS HOLIDAYS (BEFORE ASHURA, DEC. 11). ON NON-OFFICIAL SIDE, BETWEEN TWENTY AND THIRTY PERCENT OF DEPENDENTS IN PRIVATE SECTOR HAVE LEFT ON AVERAGE. MOST EXPECTED TO RETURN. END SUMMARY.
QUICK SURVEY OF PRINCIPAL FOREIGN EMBASSIES AND MANY MINOR ONES ACCOMPLISHED THROUGH PREVIOUSLY SCHEDULED REGULAR BI-MONTHLY MEETING OF POLITICAL OFFICERS SHOWS FOLLOWING

NO EMBASSY HAS EVACUATED DEPENDENTS. TURKISH AND KOREAN EMBASSIES HAVE ALLOWED DEPENDENTS TO LEAVE AND MODEST PERCENTAGE HAVE TAKEN ADVANTAGE OF OPPORTUNITY FOR EARLY CHRISTMAS HOLIDAY. DEPARTURES FROM OTHER EMBASSIES ARE NORMAL CHRISTMAS LEAVE TAKINGS. SOME SMALLER EMBASSIES (SWEDEN, ETC.) ARE KEEPING FEW PERSONNEL IN TEHRAN DESPITE PREVIOUSLY SCHEDULED LEAVE (MOST FAMILIES ARE STAYING).

SOVIETS APPEAR TO BE ONLY COUNTRY WHICH HAS DIRECTED SUBSTANTIAL NUMBERS OF DEPENDENTS TO LEAVE, AND MOST OF THESE ARE "OFFICIAL" ONLY IN SENSE THAT MOST SOVIETS ABROAD WORK FOR GOVT. EMBASSY FAMILIES MAY BE INCLUDED IN GROUP THAT LEFT, HOWEVER. ROMANIAN EMBASSY FIRST SECRETARY INDICATES NO ROMANIANS HAVE LEFT FOR SECURITY REASONS, BUT NORMALLY SCHEDULED LEAVE IS GOING FORWARD. HE THOUGHT SAME WAS TRUE FOR OTHER EAST EUROPEAN BLOC COUNTRIES.

NO RPT NO EMBASSIES ARE INSISTING THEIR NATIONALS LEAVE. HOWEVER, MANY ARE REPLYING AFFIRMATIVELY WHEN ASKED BY THEIR NATIONALS IF EARLY CHRISTMAS HOLIDAYS WOULD BE GOOD IDEA. NEW ZEALAND EMBASSY IS ONLY ONE WHICH HAS CALLED ITS CITIZENS AND RECOMMENDED THEY CONSIDER EARLY CHRISTMAS HOLIDAYS. BRITISH, FRENCH, CANADIANS, ITALIANS, PAKISTANIS, AND JAPANESE AND MOST SMALLER EMBASSIES HAVE NO RPT NO PLANS TO URGE CITIZEN DEPARTURES, BUT ALL ARE REVIEWING THEIR E AND E PLANS AND BRINGING THEM UP TO DATE.

ON NON-OFFICIAL SIDE, FOLLOWING IS LIST OF COUNTRIES AND BEST ESTIMATES OF DEPARTURES (MOST EMBOFFS CONSIDER THESE ONLY EDUCATED GUESSES) TO DATE: BRITISH - OF 11,000 NATIONALS IN COUNTRY, TWO OR THREE THOUSAND HAVE LEFT, MOST EXPECT TO RETURN. MANY MORE WILL LEAVE FOR HOLIDAYS LATER. FRANCE - OF 6,000 ABOUT 800 HAVE LEFT, WITH CLOSURE OF FRENCH SCHOOL, 1,300 EXPECTED TO DEPART IN COMING WEEK; MOST EXPECT TO RETURN. ITALY - OF TOTAL COMMUNITY BETWEEN 15,000 AND 18,000 "SEVERAL THOUSAND" HAVE LEFT, MANY WILL NOT BE RETURNING FOR ECONOMIC REASONS (CANCELLED CONTRACTS, LACK OF BUSINESS). MORE WILL GO FOR HOLIDAYS.

PAKISTANIS - (OVER 20,000) AND GREEKS (ABOUT 6,000) VIRTUALLY NO ONE DEPARTING. KOREANS - OF 11,000 TWO OR THREE THOUSAND HAVE LEFT, MOST EXPECT TO RETURN. SMALLER EMBASSIES - CANADIAN, NEW ZEALAND, AUSTRALIAN, ROMANIAN, DUTCH, BELGIAM, SWEDISH, AND IRISH - ALL REPORT BETWEEN THIRTY AND FIFTY PERCENT OF PRIVATE CITIZENS LEAVING AT LEAST FOR EXTENDED CHRISTMAS HOLIDAY.

ROUGH AVERAGE OF NON-OFFICIAL DEPARTURES IS BETWEEN TWENTY AND THIRTY PERCENT, WITH MORE TO COME AS HOLIDAYS APPROACH. MOST EMBASSIES ARE WATCHING SITUATION AND WOULD CONSIDER ACCELERATED EVACUATION IF EXPECTED MOHARRAM CONFRONTATION TURNS UGLY. (ONE PROBLEM, HOWEVER, BEING INABILITY TO GET RESERVATIONS ON PLANES OUT.) BRITISH AND FRENCH, BESIDES OURSELVES, ARE MORE CONCERNED ABOUT POSSIBLE DIRECT TARGETING OF THEIR NATIONALS, BUT HAVE NO EVIDENCE YET THAT THIS IS BEING DONE. FRENCH FEAR THEIR RECENT PUBLICIZED TOUGHER LINE WITH KHOMEINI MAY CAUSE SOME BACKLASH.

BECAUSE OF CONFUSION ENGENDERED BY DISTORTED REPORTS OF AMERICAN "EVACUATION" FROM IRAN, EMBASSY ISSUED FOLLOWING ADVISORY THROUGH OUR PYRAMID SYSTEM TO ENTIRE AMERICAN COMMUNITY: : 1. THE EMBASSY HAS NOT REPEAT NOT ORDERED THE EVACUATION OF AMERICANS FROM IRAN.
THOSE DEPENDENTS OF U.S. OFFICIALS WHO WISH TO LEAVE TEMPORARILY HAVE BEEN AUTHORIZED TRAVEL TO SELECTED DESIGNATIONS IN EUROPE. UNQUOTE.

I ALSO PASSED INFORMATION TO THE SHAH THROUGH ASLAN AFSHAR AT THE COURT AND TO THE GOVT THROUGH ACTING FOREIGN MINISTER ZELLI. I HAVE ASKED GENERAL GAST TO TELEPHONE CHIEFS OF EACH OF THE MILITARY SERVICES AS WELL AS ACTING SCS CHIEF GENERAL HATEM, POINTING OUT THAT I HAD DISCUSSED THIS ACTION IN ADVANCE WITH PRIME MINISTER GENERAL AZHARI.

IN THE COURSE OF THESE CONVERSATIONS, I HAVE NOTED THAT TEHRAN AMERICAN SCHOOL HAD ITS LAST CLASSES DECEMBER 6 AND WILL REMAIN CLOSED OVER THE CHRISTMAS AND NEW YEAR PERIOD. IT WAS THEREFORE LOGICAL THAT SOME WIVES AND CHILDREN MIGHT WISH TO SPEND PERIOD IN EUROPEAN LOCATIONS.
(D) TEHRAN 11832 (E) TEHRAN 11838 (F) TEHRAN 11848

FOLLOWING ARE ANSWERS TO THE QUESTIONS POSED IN REF A. AS INDICATED IN REF B, MANY WILL HAVE BEEN PROVIDED IN THE MILITARY ANNEXES TO THE COUNTRYWIDE E AND E PLAN THAT HAVE NOW BEEN TRANSMITTED BY REFERENCES C, D, E AND F. IN THOSE CASES REFERENCE WILL SIMPLY BE MADE TO THE MILITARY ANNEXES. THE ANSWERS ARE KEYED TO THE ORDER OF PRESENTATION IN REF A: --A. SEE MILITARY ANNEXES. --B. TRANSPORTATION OF EVACUEES FROM THEIR HOMES TO DOCUMENTATION CENTERS REPRESENTS A MAJOR PROBLEM AND PARTICULARLY SO IN TEHRAN. U.S.

CITIZENS ARE SCATTERED THROUGHOUT THE CITY AND, BECAUSE OF THE LARGE NUMBER (PROBABLY STILL IN EXCESS OF 35,000) THE USE OF THEIR PRIVATE VEHICLES TO TRAVEL TO DOCUMENTATION CENTERS FOR PROCESSING BEFORE PROCEEDING TO THE AIRPORT FOR EVACUATION DOES NOT APPEAR TO BE PRACTICAL, I.E., THERE WOULD BE MONUMENTAL TRAFFIC JAMS AND CONFUSION AT THE CENTERS WHICH WOULD DRASTICALLY REDUCE THEIR EFFECTIVENESS. THEREFORE, THE U.S.BUSINESS COMMUNITY IS BEING CANVASSED TO DETERMINE WHAT TRANSPORTATION THEY MIGHT PROVIDE FOR THIS PURPOSE.

TENTATIVE PLANNING IS TO DESIGNATE PICKUP POINTS WHERE COMPANY AND SCHOOL BUSSESS WOULD COLLECT THE EVACUEES AND TAKE THEM TO THE DOCUMENTATION CENTERS WHICH WOULD BE LOCATED AT 4-5 SITES, DEPENDING UPON THE SECURITY SITUATION AT THE TIME. THIS TRANSPORTATION WOULD BE AUGMENTED BY USE OF SOME PRIVATELY OWNED VEHICLES WHERE THEIR USE WOULD BE LOGICAL, I.E., WHERE THE NUMBER OF EVACUEES IS RELATIVELY SMALL. HOWEVER, MOST OF THE BUSSES USED BY THE BUSINESS COMMUNITY AND SCHOOLS ARE RENTED AND THEIR AVAILABILITY IS HIGHLY PROBLEMATICAL.

SINCE ARMISH/MAAG WILL HAVE COMMITTED ITS LIMITED GROUND TRANSPORTATION TO THE TRANSPORTING OF EVACUEES FROM THE DOCUMENTATION CENTERS TO THE AIRPORT, THE EMB IS OF THE OPINION THAT IT WOULD BE MOST WISE TO PREPOSITION 20-30 FORTY-PASSENGER BUSSES IN GERMANY FOR QUICK TRANSPORT BY C-5. THERE ARE AREAS AND STREETS IN TEHRAN WHERE BUSSES OF THIS SIZE WOULD HAVE DIFFICULTY MANEUVERING, BUT IN THOSE CASES PRIVATE VEHICLES OR MINI-BUSSES AVAILABLE AT THE EMB WOULD BE USED.

THE USE OF DRIVERS FAMILIAR WITH TEHRAN TRAFFIC AND STREETS IS A MUST AND, IF THE PREPOSITIONING OF BUSSES CONCEPT IS ACCEPTABLE, THE EMB WILL REQUEST ARMISH/MAAG TO IDENTIFY AND TRAIN ENLISTED MEN TO DRIVE THE VEHICLES. --C. THE EMB HAS BEEN ADVISED THAT IT WOULD TAKE TWELVE HOURS FOR THE FIRST MAC AIRCRAFT TO ARRIVE AT TEHRAN. BY THAT TIME THE DOCUMENTATION CENTERS SHOULD BE FULLY OPERATIONAL AND READY TO TRANSPORT THE FIRST EVACUEES TO THE AIRPORT.

IN REALITY, THE EMB BELIEVES IT COULD HAVE THE FIRST EVACUEES READY FOR BOARDING AIRCRAFT WITHIN SIX HOURS AFTER AN EVACUATION ANNOUNCEMENT PROVIDED THE EVACUATION CAN BE MANAGED IN A PHASED AND ORDERLY MANNER, I.E., THAT WE DO NOT GO INTO A IMMEDIATE PHASE III. FROM THE EMBASSY'S POINT OF VIEW A PHASED EVACUATION UNDER CONTROLLED CONDITIONS IS AN ABSOLUTE MUST IF WE ARE TO AVOID TOTAL CONFUSION. MOST CERTAINLY WE CANNOT CONSIDER HAVING EVERYONE GO DIRECTLY TO THE AIRPORT WITHOUT PRIOR PROCESSING. --D. AN ACCURATE ESTIMATE OF THE NUMBER OF EVACUEES BY PICKUP POINT IS DIFFICULT TO DETERMINE NOW, AND ESPECIALLY WITH REGARD TO FOREIGN NATIONAL.

HOWEVER, A STUDY OF THE MILITARY ANNEXES AND E AND E PLAN SHOULD PROVIDE USEFUL INFORMATION. WE ARE WORKING ON THIS PROBLEM WITH THE AMERICAN FIRMS AND WILL PROVIDE MORE PRECISE DETAILS AS SOON AS WE ARE ABLE. --E. NO SPECIAL COMMUNICATIONS EQUIPMENT IS CONSIDERED NECESSARY, BUT MEDEVAC CAPABILITY SHOULD MOST CERTAINLY BE PLANNED. ------------------061887 080922Z /12 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 2063 SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 11974 NODIS --F. NO PRIORITIES HAVE BEEN FORMALLY SET REGARDING WHICH AREAS MIGHT BE EVACUATED FIRST SINCE IT WOULD DEPEND ON WHICH IS CONFRONTED WITH THE GREATEST DANGER AT THE TIME AN EVACUATION IS ORDERED.

FOR EXAMPLE, TABRIZ WAS THE FIRST TO EXPERIENCE CIVIL UNREST DURING THE CURRENT CRISIS, BUT IS NOW RELATIVELY QUIET WHILE TEHRAN IS THE FOCAL POINT OF TROUBLE. PLANNING FOR EVACUATIONBY CATEGORY OF INDIVIDUAL, E.G., WOMEN, CHILDRE, AND NON-ESSENTIAL PERSONNEL FIRST, ETC., IS, WE BELIEVE OF FAR GREATER IMPORTANCE TO AVOID THE CONFUSION THAT WILL RESULT IF A TOTAL EVACUATION IS ORDERED.K --G. AN EVACUATION UNDER HOSTILE ENVIRONMENT WOULD BE EXTREMELY DIFFICULT. THE FIRST MOVE OF EVACUEES WOULD HAVE TO BE FROM THEIR HOMES, AND GIVEN THE LARGE NUMBER INVOLVED, IT WOULD BE HIGHLY IMPRACTICAL TO TRY AND PROTECT THEIR MOVEMENT BY THE USE OF U.S. TROOPS.

SOME ARMISH-MAAG PERSONNEL WILL BE STATIONED AT THE DOCUMENTATION CENTERS AND AIRPORTS AS PART OF OUR TEAM EFFORT, IF THERE IS A HOSTILE ENVIRONMENT. THE LOGICAL APPROACH APPEARS TO US AT THIS TIME TO ORDER A STANDFAST AND KEEP U.S. CITIZENS IN THEIR HOMES UNTIL SOME SEMBLANCE OF ORDER IS RESTORED. IN GENERAL OR IN SPECIFIC AREAS. IN OTHER WORDS AN EVACUATION OF U.S. CITIZENS WILL REQUIRETHE COOPERATION OF LOCAL AUTHORITIES. --H. BECAUSE OF THE MANY OTHER SIZABLE FOREIGN COLONIES IN IRAN WE DO NOT BELIEVE IT IS FEASIBLE TO CONSIDER HAVING THE GOI ASSEMBLE US ALL IN SPECIALLY PROTECTED AREAS.

THE EXACT NUMBER OF ALL PEOPLE WHO MIGHT HAVE TO BE ACCOMMODATED UNDER SUCH A CONCEPT IS, OF COURSE, NOT KNOWN, BUT WOULD NUMBER WELL OVER A HUNDRED THOUSAND. TO CONSIDER THIS FOR THE AMERICANS ONLY IS IMPRACTICAL, BUT WE WOULD CERTAINLY DO YOUR UPMOST TO GET AN ARRANGEMENT. IN ANY EVENT, THE ABILITY AND WILLINGNESS TO PROTECT U.S. CITIZENS DEPENDS ENTIRELY ON THE GOI'S CONTROL OF THE COUNTRY IN TOTAL AND PARTICULARLY THE CITIES. IF THAT CONTROL IS LOST WE WILL BE DEALING WITH ANOTHER SET OF RULERS AND WOULD PROBABLY BE BETTER OFF IN OUR OWN HOMES AND COMPOUNDS.

TEHRAN HAS ALREADY BEEN VISITED BY TWO TEAMS OF E AND E EXPERTS FROM EUROM WHO LOOKED INTO VARIOUS ASPECTS OF OUR PLANNING. OUR E AND E PLAN HAS NOW BEEN REVISED AND THE MILITARY ANNEXES PREPARED AND TRANSMITTED BY TELEGRAM. WE HAVE TASK FORCES WORKING EXCLUSIVELY ON E AND E MATTERS AT BOTH ARMISH/MAAG AND THE EMB. TEAMS ARE NOW VISITING THE CONSTITUENT POSTS AND WILL BE CONCERTRATING INTENSELY ON PUTTING THE FINISHING TOUCHES ON PLANS FOR EVACUATING PERSONNEL FROM THOSE AREAS. WE ARE ACCELERATING THE COORDINATION WITH U.S. FIRMS AND OTHERWISE POLISHING OUR PLANS FOR TEHRAN.

WE ARE FORTUNATE IN HAVING EMB OFFICERS WHO HAVE NOT ONLY SERVED UNDER SIMILAR CIRCUMSTANCES AT OTHER POSTS, BUT WERE IN CHARGE OF, OR ACTIVELY PARTICIPATED IN EVACUATIONS FROM HUNGARY, LEBANON, AND SOUTHEAST ASIS AND ARE INTIMATELY FAMILIAR WITH E AND E PLANNING AND IMPLEMENTATION. IN OTHER WORDS, WE DO NOT NEED ADDITIONAL PERSONNEL FOR THIS PURPOSE, BUT APPRECIATE THE OFFER AND WILL KEEP IT IN MIND.
WE BELIZVE COMMUNICATIONS WITH THE CONSULATES ARE ADEQUATE. THERE ARE STANDING ORDERS FOR DAILY TESTING OF THE RADIO EQUIPMENT AND THIS WILL BE RIGIDLY ENFORCED.

1978TEHRAN11997.subject: SHAH RECEIVES INQUIRY FROM BARBARA WALTERS

segments.text: TO GIVE WASHINGTON SOME INDICATION OF SHAH'S CURRENT MOOD, I RELAY FOLLOWING VIGNETTE. IT SHOULD NOT RPT NOT BE INCLUDED IN DEPT SITREP OR OTHER PUBLICATION.

SHAH ASKED ASLAN AFSHAR TO TELEPHONE ME MORNING DEC.7 TO SAY THAT HE HAD TAKEN CALL FROM BARBARA WALTERS (*) IN WASHINGTON, WHO ASKED HIS COMMENT ON "BRITISH INTELLIGENCE REPORT" THAT HE WOULD NOT RPT NOT SURVIVE THE WEEKEND. SHAH WANTED TO KNOW IF I COULD SHED ANY LIGHT ON THIS.

I SAID WE HAD RECEIVED NO RPT NO SUCH REPORT FROM BRITISH INTELLIGENCE OR ANY OTHER SOURCE. THIS LINE, OF COURSE, COINCIDES WITH POSTURE TAKEN BY KHOMEINI AND I WOULD PUT IT UNDER THE HEADING OF "PSYCHOLOGICAL WARFARE."

I FURTHER SAID THAT OUR ONLY INFORMATION OF CONCERN AFFECTING THIS WEEKEND WAS THE PROCESSION PLANNED BY AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI, WITH POSSIBLE RESULTANT VIOLENCE. AFSHAR SAID SHAH WAS VERY MUCH ALERT TO THAT PROBLEM AND IN CLOSE TOUCH WITH MILITARY. HE CLOSED BY ASKING ME TO TELEPHONE HIM IF I HAD ANY CLARIFICATION OF BARBARA WALTERS' REMARKS.

1978TEHRAN11999.subject: OPPOSITION LEADERS RELEASED; DEMONSTRATIONS PLANNED SUMMARY: GOI RELEASED KARIM SANJABI AND DARIUS FOROUHAR EVENING DEC 6. PAIR WILL MEET WITH FRONT LEADERS DEC 7. N

segments.text: SUMMARY: GOI RELEASED KARIM SANJABI AND DARIUS FOROUHAR EVENING DEC 6. PAIR WILL MEET WITH FRONT LEADERS DEC 7. NATIONAL FRONT (INF) WILL PARTICIPATE IN DEMONSTRATIONS SCHEDULED FOR DEC 10 (TASSUA). U.S. PROFESSOR COTTAM RUMORED IN IRAN. END SUMMARY.

DR. NASSER MINATCHI CALLED EMBOFF STEMPEL AT HOME AFTER CURFEW DEC 6 TO DISCUSS NEWS THAT GOI HAD RELEASED KARIM SANJABI AND DARIUS FOROUHAR. MINATCHI CONFIRMED RELEASE AND SAID HE HAD TALKED TO TWO MEN BY TELEOPHONE. MEETING OF MAJOR NATIONAL FRONT LEADERS WAS SET FOR LATE AFTERNOON DEC 7 TO DISCUSS NEXT MOVES. MINATCHI NOTED GOI HAD MADE DECISION TO RELEASE PAIR ON DEC 4, AND RELEASE WAS BEING VIEWED AS GESTURE OF GOODWILL, AT LEAST BY MODERATE INF LEADERS. LIBERATION MOVEMENT OF IRAN (LMI) CONTACT TOLD EMBOFF MORNING DEC 7 THAT RELEASE WAS "INTERESTING" BUT DID NOT CHANGE MUCH AND ASKED TO GET IN TOUCH MORNING DEC 8.

MINATCHI SAID INF HAD ALREADY MADE PLANS TO PARTICIPATE IN LARGE DEMONSTRATION BEING ORGANIZED BY AYATOLLAH TALEQANI TO BEGIN AT 9 A.M. DEC 10. ACCORDING TO MINATCHI, DEMONSTRATION WILL BEGIN NEAR SHANAZ SQUARE, AT EAST END OF SHAH REZA AND MOVE WEST, BEING JOINED BY GROUPS WHICH WILL FORM UP AT OTHER LOCATIONS IN CITY. MINATCHI SAID IDEA WAS TO HAVE MASSIVE EFFORT; COMMITTEE FOR DEFENSE OF HUMAN RIGHTS AND FREEDOM (CDHRF) HAD PLANNED SEPARATE HUMAN RIGHTS MARCH FOR SAME DAY BUT HAD GIVEN UP IDEA WHEN RELIGIOUS LEADERS OPTED FOR LARGESCALE, ALL-HANDS EFFORT. MINATCHI THOUGHT MOST OPPOSITION GROUPS WOULD PARTICIPATE.

EMBOFF WAS CALLED FROM LONDON BY JOURNALIST WHO WISHED TO CONFIRM STORY THAT U.S. PROFESSOR RICHARD COTTAM, WHO IS CLOSE TO INF LEADERS, WAS IN IRAN. EMBOFF EXPRESSED IGNORANCE OF MATTER. TO BEST OF OUR KNOWLEDGE, COTTAM IS NOT HERE. WOULD APPRECIATE IT IF DEPARTMENT COULD DISCREETLY CONFIRM HIS PRESENCE IN PITTSBURGH.

THE PETROLEUM SECTOR TODAY, DECEMBER 7, IS LITTLE CHANGED FROM YESTERDAY. PRODUCTION DECEMBER 7 IS SCHEDULED TO BE 2.85 MILLION BBLS. (ACCOUNTED FOR BY OSCO - 2,733 MBBLS, AND SIRIP, IMINOCO, NIOC, AND SOFIRAN TOGETHER-APPROXIMATELY 120 MBBLS) OF WHICH 702,000 WILL BE DELIVERED TO DOMESTIC REFINERIES AND THE REMAINDER WILL BE EXPORTED, TODAY'S ESTIMATE MAY BE SOMEWHAT OPTIMISTIC, BUT IT DOES APPEAR THE PRODUCTION IS (HOPEFULLY) BEGINNING TO STABILIZE. 2.NIOC IS STILL STRETCHED VERY THIN. SUPERVISORY PERSONNEL IN THE TEHRAN REFINERY AND ON THE PRODUCT PIPELINE FROM ABADAN TO TEHRAN, WHO ARE FILLING-IN FOR STRIKING OPERATORS, ARE DOING A YEOMAN'S JOB AND ARE STILL HOLDING THEIR OWN.

1978TEHRAN12011.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT DEC 7, 1978 SUMMARY: LESS ROOFTOP CHANTING. STREET GATHERING AND SHOOTING AFTER CURFEW WITH SCATTERED POWER OUTAGES. THREA TE

segments.text: SUMMARY: LESS ROOFTOP CHANTING. STREET GATHERING AND SHOOTING AFTER CURFEW WITH SCATTERED POWER OUTAGES. THREATENING PHONE CALLS AND PAMPHLETS. GOVT RELEASES SANJABI AND FORUHAR (SEPTEL). SHIRAZ AND AHWAZ GENERALLY QUIET. PRIMIN AZHARI ADDRESSED SENATE YESTERDAY. TODAY RELATIVELY QUIET, BUT COMMUNITY BATTENS DOWN FOR LONG WEEKEND. END SUMMARY.

LAST NIGHT BROUGHT MORE ROOFTOP CHANTING, BUT IT HAS DECLINED DRASTICALLY SINCE FIRST DAYS OF MOHARRAM. EMBAOFF OBSERVED IRANIAN INTERRUPT YOUNG PEOPLE'S CHANTING AND TELL THEM TO SHUT UP, WHICH THEY PROMPTLY DID. DEMON STRATIONS AND GUNFIRE WERE REPORTED IN TAJRISH AND SALTANATABAD AREAS OF CITY, BUT IN RELATIVE TERMS AT LEAST, YESTERDAY'S LULL CONTINUED INTO EVENING. THERE WERE POWER OUTAGES LAST NIGHT AND SEVERAL THREATENING TELEPHONE CALLS TO AMCITS. CONSULATE SHIRAZ REPORTS DECREASE IN ROOFTOP SINGERS AND NO CLASHES LAST NIGHT. AHWAZ IS QUIET BUT LOADED WITH TROOPS. BEHBAHAN IS CALM, BUT MOTORISTS ARE BEING REROUTED AROUND CITY.

NATIONAL FRONT LEADERS KARIM SANJABI AND DARIUSH FORUHAR WERE RELEASED FROM PRISON YESTERDAY (BEING REPORTED SEPTEL). GOI ALSO ANNOUNCED IT WILL FREE 120 POLITICAL PRISONERS AND 352 OTHERS WHO WERE SENTENCED BY MILITARY TRIBUNALS.

PRIMIN AZHARI ADDRESSED SENATE YESTERDAY AND URGED CITIZENS TO RESIST ENEMY'S "COLD WAR" AGAINST IRAN. HE SAID SUBVERSIVES HAVE BEEN SO SUCCESSFUL THAT EVEN THE WEALTHY, WHO HAVE PROFITED MOROM THE REGIME, HAVE TURNED AGAINST IT. HE MENTIONED THE NOTORIOUS LIST OF MONETARY TRANSFERS, COMPLAINING THAT EMPLOYEE WHO PUT OUT THE LIST IMMEDIATELY WENT ON STRIKE AND PREVENTED INVESTIGATION. (COMMENT: THIS QUESTION IS STILL ALIVE AND MANY IRANIANS SIMPLY BELIEVE THE LIST DESPITE GOVT MOVES TO DEBUNK IT.) AZHARI SAID SOME IRANIANS HAVE BEEN TRAINED ABROAD AND THEN PLACED IN SENSITIVE POSITIONS, SUCH AS CUSTOMS, SO THEY CAN PARALYZE THE COUNTRY AS THEY ARE NOW TRYING TO DO.

SUBVERSIVES SHUT OFF ELECTRICITY, THEREBY NOT ONLY INCONVENIENCING PEOPLE AT HOME BUT CAUSING FACTORIES TO SHUT DOWN AND ENDANGERING THE LIVELIHOOD OF ORDINARY PEOPLE. MARTIAL LAW WAS APPROVED BY PARLIAMENT, AND IF PARLIAMENT VOTES TO SUSPEND MARTIAL LAW, AZHARI WILL COMPLY. HE WILL, HOWEVER, OPPOSE ALL ENEMIES OF THE PEOPLE, EVEN IF THEY WEAR A MILITARY UNIFORM OR A MULLAH'S CLOTHES. AZHARI REITERATED THAT GOVT FIGURES REGARDING CASUALTIES ARE CORRECT.

TEHRAN MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITY ISSUED COMMUNIQUE DESCRIBING OPPOSITION TACTICS DURING HOLY DAYS: MALE DEMONSTRATORS WILL WEAR CHADORS AND CARRY ARMS; YOUNG MEN WILL SHAVE THEIR HEADS AND PUT ON MILITARY UNIFORMS TO MAKE IT SEEM THAT SOLDIERS HAVE JOINED CROWDS; THEY WILL THROW GRENADES INTO CROWDS AND WILL START FIRES; THEY WILL ATTACK SOLDIERS WITH SHARP INSTRUMENTS; THEY USE TAPE RECORDED SOUNDS, AND THEY POUR RED POWDER INTO JUBES TO MAKE IT SEEM LIKE BLOOD; THEY MAKE THREATENING PHONE CALLS; THEY PUT WOMEN AND CHILDREN IN FRONT OF MOBS; THEY CUT TELEPHONE AND ELECTRICAL POWER; THEY WEAR WHITE SHROUDS AND CARRY CASKETS.
MLA GAVE FIVE TELEPHONE NUMBERS WHICH PEOPLE CAN USE IF THEY HAVE QUESTIONS OR PROBLEMS.

TODAY IS TRADITIONAL DAY FOR UNIVERSITY DEMOS EVEN IN QUIETER TIMES, BUT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY AREA HAS HELD QUIET, ALTHOUGH TENSE, TO MIDDAY. TROOPS ARE REINFORCED AROUND CAMPUS. DEMO WITH SHOOTING HAS OCCURRED AT TAJRISH. GOI SOURCE REPORTS HEAVY VIOLENCE IN GORGAN. CERTAINTY OF LARGE MARCHES AND CONFRONTATIONS HAS NOT CHANGED, AND AMCITS ARE PREPARED FOR LONG WEEKEND (4 DAYS FOR EMBASSY COMMUNITY) SPENT AT HOME. ANNOUNCEMENT OF AUTHORIZATION TO SEND DEPENDENTS TO EUROPE HAS THE WIRES HUMMING, BUT MOST AMERICANS WILL HOLE UP UNTIL DEC 12 AND WAIT TO SEE WHAT IS LEFT WHEN THE SMOKE CLEARS.
FOR THE MOMENT, IT IS RAINY AND FOGGY IN TEHRAN, WEATHER WHICH TENDS TO DISCOURAGE FREE-LANCE DEMONSTRATORS.

MAJLES MET TODAY AND RECEIVED SEVERAL IMPORTANT GOVT BILLS. KEY PROPOSAL WOULD ALLOW COURTS TO TRY IN ABSENTIA THOSE WHO HAVE FLED THE COUNTRY UNDER SUSPICION OF CORRUPTION. IF THEY ARE FOUND GUILTY, GOVT WOULD CONFISICATE LANDS AND PROPERTY EQUAL TO THE AMOUNT STOLEN FROM THE PEOPLE. ANOTHER BILL WOULD LOWER THE MINIMUM AGE FOR GIRLS TO MARRY FROM 18 TO 15. (COMMENT: THIS IS DESIGNED TO PLEASE MOSLEM TRADITIONALISTS WHO WOULD PREFER THEIR DAUGHTERS TO MARRY EVEN YOUNGER THAN 15.) GOVT ALSO PROPOSED TO ELIMINATE MANDATORY NATIONAL SERVICE FOR WOMEN AND TO ESTABLISH STRICTER CONTROLS ON THE PRICE OF REAL ESTATE.

AS FOLLOW UP TO EARLIER CONVERSATION WITH ESLAMINIA (SEE SEPTEL), POL COUNSELOR VISITED DEPUTY MINISTER OF COURT PAKRAVAN TO INQUIRE INTO ESLAMINIA'S 1963 ACTIVITIES AND CREDENTIALS. PAKRAVAN, WHO IS FORMER HEAD OF SAVAK AND FORMER AMBASSADOR TO FRANCE AND OTHER PLACES, IS INTERESTINGLY ENOUGH ONE OF THOSE RARE SOURCES WHO WILL USUALLY GIVE US TRUTHFUL ANSWERS TO A QUESTION. HE DID NOT WISH TO GO INTO DETAIL ABOUT WHAT HAPPENED IN 1963, BUT SAID ESLAMINIA WAS AN EXTREMELY CAPABLE MAN AND VERY EFFECTIVE AMONG THE RELIGIOUS EOPLE. HE WARNED THAT ESLAMINIA DID NOT WORK FOR FREE AND SHOULD NOT BE COMPLETELY TRUSTED, BUT COULD BE USEFUL.
HE THOUGHT ESLAMINIA HAD BEEN EXTREMELY USEFUL TO HOVEYDA AFTER 1965.

PAKRAVAN VOLUNTEERED A NUMBER OF INTERESTING COMMENTS.HE SAID HE HAD BEEN INSPIRED BY HOW WELL ARMY WAS HOLDING TOGETHER. IF THERE WAS SOMEONE AT THE TOP WHO KNEW HOW TO USE IT AND WAS DYNAMIC IN USING IT THERE WOULD BE NO PROBLEMS. AS HE SAW IT, SHAH HAD TWO CHOICES: EITHER IRON CONTROL OR MOVING VERY RAPIDLY TO A CIVILIAN COALITION GOVT. HE WAS GENERALLY AWARE OF NEGOTIATIONS FOR SUCH A CIVILIAN GOVT BY THE SHAH BUT MADE IT CLEAR HE IS NOT INVOLVED IN ANYTHING POLITICAL. AT ONE POINT HE EXPRESSED THE FEAR THAT THE SHAH MIGHT GET TIRED AND QUIT, BUT, PRODUCED NO EVIDENCE OF THIS SUSPICION.

WHO BUT THE SHAH CAN GOVERN THIS UNGOVERNABLE COUNTRY PAKRAVAN ASKED RHETORICALLY. UNFORTUNATELY DYNAMIC PEOPLE ARE LACKING. GENERAL AZHARI IS LOOKED UPON BY THE ARMY AS A KINDLY GRANDMOTHER. SAVAK GENERAL MOGHADAM IS A NICE FELLOW BUT LACKS DYNAMISM. THERE ARE EXCELLENT YOUNGER OFFICERS AT THE BRIGADIER OR COLONEL LEVELS BUT THEY ARE NOT BEING GIVEN A CHANCE TO SHOW WHAT THEY CAN DO. ONE HE HAD BEEN TOLD ABOUT WAS THE MILITARY GOVERNOR OF QAZVIN; HE DID NOT EVEN KNOW HIS NAME. THIS WAS A MAN WHO MATCHED FIRMNESS WITH A WILLINGNESS AND AN ABILITY TO DISCUSS MATTERS WITH THE PEOPLE.

PAKRAVAN SAID THE COMMUNISTS ARE BEHIND KHOMEINI. THE RELIGIOUS LEADERS KNOW NOTHING ABOUT THE MODERN WORLD AND WILL BE SWEPT ASIDE SHOULD KHOMEINI WIN. HE WAS AWARE OF THE LEFT-WINGERS CLUSTERED AROUND KHOMEINI IN PARIS. HE REMEMBERED CALLING XBANI SADR IN FOR AN INTERVIEW WHEN BANI SADR WAS A SAVAK PRISONER IN THE EARLY 60S. BANI SADR, WHO WAS NOT BEING TREATED BADLY, THREATENED PAKRAVAN: "WHEN WE ARE IN CHARGE WE WILL TREAT YOU DIFFERENTLY." PAKRAVAN KNEW WHAT THIS MEANT.

THREE PEOPLE ARE MOST RESPONSIBLE FOR THE PRESENT SITUATION: THE SHAH, GENERAL NASSIRI (BUT HE IS A CRETIN AND CANNOT BE EXPECTED TO HAVE ACTED DIFFERENTLY) AND HOVEYDA (WHO IS AN INTELLIGENT MAN AND COULD HAVE DONE SOMETHING ABOUT IT). HE RECALLED THAT AS MINISTER OF INFORMATION IN 1965 HE HAD PROPOSED LIBERAL CONTROLS ON THE PRESS TO HOVEYDA. HOVEYDA HAD AGREED BUT NOTHING HAPPENED AND PAKRAVAN FOUND HIMSELF SHIPPED OFF TO ANOTHER JOB. YET, AT THE TIME, THE SHAH WAS EXTREMELY POPULAR AND COULD HAVE DONE ANYTHING HE WANTED. THE LAND REFORM WAS A SUCCESSFUL POLITICAL MOVE, THOUGHT ITS ECONOMIC APPLICATION LEFT MUCH TO BE DESIRED.

PAKRAVAN SAID HE WAS PERSONALLY UNINTERESTED IN WHAT HE IS DOING, WHICH IS STRICTLY ADMINISTRATIVE. HE SAID HE WAS CONDUCTING MANY PERSONNEL CHANGES IN THE MINISTRY OF COURT. HE DID NOT DENY THIS WAS A PURGE OF SORTS. HE SAID NO ONE HAD BEEN INTERESTED IN THE PEOPLE WORKING THERE AND SPENDING HAD BEEN DONE IN A GRAND MANNER BY THOSE CONCERNED.

PAKRAVAN SAID HE IS PESSIMISTIC FOR THE LONGER RUN. HE CAN NO LONGER UNDERSTAND THE YOUTH OF THE COUNTRY WHO HAVE SLIPPED INTO COMMUNIST GAP. HE BEMOANED THE DISAPPEARANCE OF THE MODERATE POLITICAL CENTER. HE REPEATED WHAT WE HAD ALREADY HEARD THAT THE RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP HAS NO KNOWLEDGE OF AMERICANS OR AMERICAN PSYCHOLOGY AND WILL MISINTERPRET AMERICAN POLICY. THE MEETING ENDED ON THAT SAD NOTE.

1978TEHRAN12013.subject: RELIGIOUS LEADERS IN IRAN RECOMMENDS POLICIES TO IMPROVE US IMAGE

segments.text: 055541 072249Z /75 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 2080 TEHRAN 12013 EXDIS SUMMARY: INTERMEDIARY WITH GOOD CONTACTS AMONG RELIGIOUS LEADERS RECOMMENDS MORE ACTIVE POLICY TO IMPROVE IMAGE OF U.S. IN IRAN AND WIN OVER ALLEGIANCE OF RELIGIOUS LEADERS. END SUMMARY.

POL COUNSELOR AND EMBOFF PERETT VISITED HEDAYAT ESLAMINIA DEC 4 AT LATTER'S REQUEST. ESLAMINIA HAS BEEN USEFUL INTERMEDIARY WITH RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP AND BAZAARIS. HE SAID HE HAD TWO THINGS TO TALK ABOUT. FIRST HE UNDERSTANDS AMERICAN POLICY BUT RELIGIOUS PEOPLE DO NOT. CONSEQUENTLY PEOPLE GENERALLY BELIEVE THAT KHOMEINI IS RESPONSIBLE FOR SHAH'S LIBERALIZATION TO DATE, AND AMERICANS ARE RESPONSIBLE FOR THE KILLING OF THE PEOPLE BY THE ARMY. FOREIGNERS SUCH AS THE SOVIETS ARE INTERESTED IN PROPAGATING THIS VIEW. SOMEONE SHOULD TELL THE RELIGIOUS PEOPLE THE TRUTH -- THAT AMERICANS ARE RESPONSIBLE FOR THE LIBERALIZATION. HE WOULD BE WILLING TO EXPLAIN PRESIDENT CARTER'S HUMAN RIGHTS PROGRAM IF PROVIDED WITH LITERATURE.
ICA SHOULD MAIL SUCH LITERATURE TO MANY PEOPLE, AS IT HAS DONE IN THE PAST. HE COULD PRIVIDE LIST OF SUCH PEOPLE.

SECONDLY, HE IS DISGUSTED WITH INABILITY OF PROGOVT SOURCES TO SELL THEIR OWN POINT OF VIEW. THE ACTIVE RELIGIOUS SPOKEMEN (AKHUN) SPEAK ON KHOMEINI'S BEHALF BECAUSE THE GOVT NO LONGER GIVES NECESSARY SALARIES AND GIFTS TO KEEP THEM ON GOVT-SIDE OR AT LEAST SILENT. HE HAD BEEN IN TOUCH WITH SAVAK CHIEF MOGHADAM AND MOGHADAM GENERALLY AGREED THAT MORE SHOULD BE DONE, BUT SO FAR THERE WAS ONLY ONE SUCCESSFUL CASE, IN WHICH ESLAMINIA ACTED AS INTERMEDIARY. MOGHADAM AND THE OTHERS SEEMED TO BE UNABLE TO UNDERSTAND HOW TO DO THESE THINGS.

ESLAMINIA RECALLED HOW ACTIVE HE WAS IN 1963. THEN SAVAK CHIEF GENERAL PAKRAVAN HAD EXPRESSED DISBELIEF THAT ESLAMINIA COULD SWING MANY MULLAHS OVER TO GOVT SIDE. HE HAD NEVERTHELESS GOTTEN THE SHAH'S PERMISSION TO DO WHAT HE DID. HE AHD A SERIES OF MEETINGS WITH RELIGIOUS PEOPLE, BAZAARIS AND OTHERS. MONEY CHANGED HANDS. HE WAS SUCCESSFUL, AS THE OUTCOME INDICATED. MUCH THE SAME THING COULD BE DONE VERY EASILY IF ONLY SOMEONE IN THE GOI WOULD AUTHORIZE IT AND PRIVIDE THE FUNDS.

ESLAMINIA HAD VARIOUS CRITICISMS OF OF GOVT INFORMATION, OR NON-INFORMATION, PROGRAM. HE THOUGHT THE GOVT'S STANCE WAS WRONG. GENERALS SHOULD NOT APPEAR WEAK BEFORE THE RELIGIOUS PEOPLE AS THIS CHEAPENS THEM. THEY ARE MILITARY MEN AND SHOULD NOT TRY TO BE SOMETHING ELSE. THE RIGHT APPROACH IN HIS ESTIMATION IS A COMBINATION OF FIRMNESS WITH A WILLINGNESS TO DISCUSS ISSUES WITH REPRESENTATIVES OF VARIOUS GROUPS AND MEET THEIR JUST DEMANDS.

ESLAMINIA SAID VAST MAJORITY OF IRANIANS ARE UNHAPPY WITH MOB RULE LED BY OPPOSITION. THERE ARE PEOPLE WILLING TO STAND UP TO THIS OPPISITION MOB, BUT THEY HAVE NOWHERE TO MEET, NO ONE TO PULL THEM TOGETHER. THEY WANT THE GOVT TO KNOW WHAT THEY ARE DOING FOR IT AND, BY IMPLICATION, BE REWARDED FOR DOING THIS.

ESLAMINIA THEN REHEARSED STORY WE HAD HEARD BEFORE BUT WITH LESS DETAILS. WHEN THE VENERABLE AYATOLLAH KHOI AGREED TO RECEIVE THE QUEEN IN NAJFAF RECENTLY, HE WAS PUBLICLY CRITICIZED BY KHOMEINI AND KHOMEINI'S SUPPORTERS FOR IT. RELIGIOUS STUDENTS IN QOM SENT A MESSAGE THAT THEY WOULD NOT LONGER ACCEPT KHOI'S REGULAR CONTRIBUTIONS FOR THEIR SUPPORT AND THE SHCOLS. AT THAT POINT AYATOLLAH GOLPAYAGANI IN QOM, AND KHONSARI IN TEHRAN SAID, IF STUDENTS WOULD NOT ACCEPT KHOI'S MONEY, THEY WOULD GET NO MONEY FROM THEM. THIS HAS MADE A BREACH IN RELIGIOUS RANKS.

GOVT SHOULD WORK ON SHARIAT-MADARI TO FOLLOW THE OTHER AYATOLLAHS BEHIND KHOI, BUT ESLAMINAIA WAS NOT AWARE THIS WAS BEING DONE (EMBASSY HAS SINCE HEARD RUMOR THAT SHARIAT-MADARI MAY BE ISSUING CALL FOR MODERATION AND PEACEFUL BEHAVIOR DURING ASHURA, AS KHOI DID.)

FINALLY, ESLAMINIA SAID USG SHOULD REALIZE MANY OF THE PEOPLE AROUND THE SHAH ARE JEALOUS OF THAT PREROGATIVE. THEY TELL THE SHAH USG IS WORKING AGAINST HIM, AND THEY TELL THE OPPOSITION USG IS WORKING WITH THE SHAH. HE SAID HIS OLD MENTOR HOVEYDA WAS STILL THE BEST ONE TO ADVISE THE SHAH ON HOW TO OPERATE BEHINDTHE-SCENES IN PRESENT SITUATION. THE SHAH SHOULD GET HIS ADVICE EVEN THOUGH HOVEYDA CANNOT BE BROUGHT OUT INTO THE PUBLIC VIEW.

ALI-AMINI INFORMS US THAT SHAH HAS INTERPRETED PRESIDENT CARTER'S PRESS BREAKFAST REMARKS ABOUT IRAN AS CALLING FOR A POPULAR REFERENDUM ON THE FUTURE OF THE MONARCHY. THIS HAS REPORTEDLY PLUNGED HIM INTO DEEP DEPRESSION.

THIS STATEMENT, WHICH HAS ATTRACTED ATTENTION OF ALL POLITICALLY SOPHISTICATED IRANIANS IN TEHRAN, PLUS FRANTIC SCENES AT AIRPORT INVOLVING LARGE NUMBERS OF AMERICANS SCRAMBLING FOR AIRPLANE SEATS, HAS GIVEN RISE TO WIDESPREAD ASSUMPTIONS THAT U.S. HAS MADE DRAMATIC CHANGE OF POSITION WITH RESPECT TO SHAH.

IN VIEW OF THIS SITUATION ON THE EVE OF ASHURA, I FEEL WASHINGTON SHOULD GIVE URGENT CONSIDERATION TO AUTHORITATIVE TELEPHONE CALL EITHER TO SHAH HIMSELF OR TO ZAHEDI PLACING PRESIDENT'S STATEMENT IN CONSTRUCTIVE CONTEXT.

MEMBER OF MAJLES WHOSE DECEASED FATHER WAS LEADING AYATOLLAH OF KHORASSAN (MASHAD) INFORMED POL COUNSELOR OVER DINNER DECEMBER 7 THAT HE IS ACTING AS REPRESENTATIVE OF LEADING MASHAD AYATOLLAH GHOMI IN SEEKING A MEETING WITH SHARIAT-MADARI. HE WILL PROBABLY GO TO GHOM TO SEE SHARIAT-MADARI DEC 9, UNLESS SHARIAT-MADARI AGAIN AVOIDS THIS MEETING, AS HE DID ONCE BEFORE.

(EMBASSY HAS SEPARATE, UNCONFIRMED, REPORT THAT SHARIAT-MADARI BEING PRESSED TO HELP LEAD MASSIVE PARADE DEC 10 AND MIGHT RPT MIGHT YIELD TO PRESSURE AND COME TO TEHRAN.) BURDEN OF GHOMI'S MESSAGE IS THAT SHARIAT-MADARI SHOULD JOIN IN A CONCERTED EFFORT BY RELIGIOUS LEADERS IN IRAN TO FOLLOW A "THIRD WAY" SOLUTION TO PRESENT CRISIS. THIS ENVISAGES SHAH REMAINING ON THRONE AS CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCH. KHOMEINI WOULD BE "PRESUADED" THIS WAS NECESSARY.
MAJLES DEPUTY PRAISED GHOMI AS A MAN WHO TAKES A POSITION AND STICKS TO IT, UNLIKE SHARIAT-MADARI WHO KEEPS CHANGING HIS MIND, DEPENDING ON WHOM HE TALKED WITH LAST.

DEPUTY ALSO THREW FURTHER LIGHT ON AYATOLLAH KHOI'S "ELAMIEH" TO THE PEOPLE, WHICH WE HAVE ALREADY REPORTED ON. AS DEPUTY SAW IT, KHOI LOST FAVOR WITH RELIGIOUS COMMUNITY WHEN SHAHBANOU INSISTED ON VISITING HIM AT HIS HOME IN NAJAF. (HE HAD STAYED HOME "SICK" AFTER LEARNING SHAHBANOU PLANNED ATTEND HIS PUBLIC PRAYER MEETING AT THE MOSQUE). KHOI WAS VERY ANGRY AT SHAHBANOU FOR THIS ACTION ( WHICH THE FAITHFUL INTERPRET AS HYPOCRISY ON PART OF THE ROYAL FAMILY) AND DECIDED TO ISSUE HIS FIRST "POLITICAL" ELAMIEH AFTER STAYING OUT OF POLITICS SO MANY YEARS. OF COURSE, BEING A NON-VIOLENT MAN, KHOI COULD NOT ISSUE ELAMIEH USING LANGUAGE LIKE KHOMEINI'S.

THUS HIS ELAMIEH CONTAINS MUCH CRITICISM OF "FORMER GOVERNMENTS" AND "THE RESPONSIBLE RULERS" BUT ALSO CAREFUL INJUNCTION FOR THE FAITHFUL TO "M EAIN FULL OBSERVANCE OF THE SACRED RELIGIOUS LAWS," REFUSE TO ALLOW OPPORTUNITIES FOR "ILLINTENTIONED AND ABUSIVE ELEMENTS TO TAKE ADVANTAGE OF THEIR STRUGGLE AGAINST INJUSTICE AND CORRUPTION" AND "RESPECT THE SANCTITY OF THE LINES AND PROPERTIES OF THE MOSLEM PEOPLE."

COMMENT: THESE REPORTS ACCORD WITH REPORTS FROM OTHER MEETINGS WE ARE GETTING WHICH AMOUNT TO EVIDENCE THAT MUCH OF THE TOP RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP IS BEGINNING TO BUILD A FALL-BACK POSITION IF PEACEFUL DEMONSTRATIONS DO NOT FORCE SHAH'S ABDICATION. THIS VISUALIZES A STRICT CONSTITUTIONAL ROLE FOR THE SHAH (IN TERMS OF THE 1906-07 CONSTITUTION) MUCH LIKE THE PRIVATE POSITION BEING TAKEN BY THE POLITICAL LEADERS IN THE OPPOSITION. ALL PREFER TO AVOID "ARMED STRUGGLE" WHICH WILL PIT THEIR INFERIOR FORCES IN OPEN CONFLICT WITH WELL ARMED ARMY.

FROM WHAT DEPUTY SAID, AND FROM OTHER SOURCES, WE BELIEVE A CONSIDERABLE FACTOR IN THEIR CALCULATIONS IN POSITION TAKEN BY U.S., U.K., AND PERHAPS EVEN SOVIET UNION, WHICH THEY INTERPRET AS REFUSAL TO ENVISAGE A DEPARTURE OF THE SHAH - AND TO WHICH THEY FEEL THEY CAN BOW, WITHOUT LOSS OF FACE IN THEIR FOLLOWERS' EYES, IF THEIR OWN MASSIVE DEMONSTRATIONS DO NOT TOPPLE THE SHAH.

SUMMARY: DR. MINATCHI TOLD EMBOFF RELIGIOUS AND POLITICAL OPPOSITION HAVE DEVELOPED ARRANGEMENT WITH GOI FOR PEACEFUL MARCH DEC 10. OPPOSITION DOESN'T TRUST GOI TO KEEP ARMY FROM PROVOKING DISTURBANCES. VARIOUS OPPOSITION LEADERS HAVE AGREED TO MEET DEC. 12 TO HAMMER OUT LIST FOR REGENCY COUNCIL AND CABINET TO PUT BEFORE KHOMEINI, AND IF HE APPROVES, BEFORE SHAH. COMMITTEE FOR THE DEFENSE OF HUMAN RIGHTS AND FREEDOM (CDHRF) WILL GIVE EMBASSY LETTER TO PRESIDENT CARTER DEC. 9 END SUMMARY.

AT DR. NASSER MINATCHI'S REQUEST, EMBOFF STEMPEL MET WITH HIM AT NOON DEC. 8. MINATCHI WISHED TO ELABORATE ON DISCUSSIONS WITH GOI WHICH HAD PRODUCED AGREEMENT FOR PEACEFUL MARCH GIVEN TO EMBOFF OVER PHONE PREVIOUS EVEING (REPORTED SEPTEL), AND TO LAY OUT POLITICAL ACTIVITIES OF OPPOSITION OVER PAST FEW DAYS.

MINATCHI SAID GOI HAD AGREED, THROUGH DEC 7 INTERMEDIARY EFFORT OF ALI AMINI DIRECTLY WITH SHAH, TO PEACEFUL MARCH WITH MILITARY KEPT OUT OF SIGHT. NOW OPPOSITION WAS DISTURBED BY RUMORS THAT MILITARY MIGHT BE DRESSING SOME SOLDIERS IN BALCK TO FOMENT TROUBLE. SAVAK CHIEF MOGHADDAM HAD INVITED THE PARADE ORGANIZERS TO TALK WITH HIM, ACCORDING TO MINATCHI. REPRESENTATIVES OF VARIOUS GROUPS WERE MEETING WITH RECENTLY RELEASED NATIONAL FRONT (INF) LEADER SANJABI, WHO WOULD THEN MEET WITH MOGHADDAM. WHEN MINATCHI ASKED EMBOFF IF HE THOUGHT OPPOSITION COULD TRUST GOI, EMBOFF SAID THERE WERE INDICATIONS GOI WANTED PEACEFUL MARCH, BUT THIS CONCERN HAD BETTER BE RAISED DIRECTLY WITH MOGHADDAM.

AT MEETING OF SANJABI, MINATCHI, AND FOROUHAR DEC. 8, MINATCHI SAID HE INFORMED OTHERS OF HIS CONTACT WITH EMBASSY (COMMENT: WE ASSUMED HE HAD DONE SO EARLIER), AND LEARNED THAT SANJABI HAD NOT SPOKEN DIRECTLY TO SHAH, BUT TOLD SHAH THROUGH INTERMEDIARY THAT ONLY SOLUTION TO IRAN'S PROBLEMS IS REGENCY COUNCIL TO REPLACE SHAH. SHAH REJECTED IDEA. AT LATER MEETING OF CDHRF EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE, WHICH INCLUDES VIRTUALLY ALL PROMINENT OPPOSITION LEADERS--SANJABI, SAHABI, BARZAGAN, LAWYERS LAHIDJI, NAZIEH, MATIN-DAFTARY AND OTHERS--GROUP DECIDED FUTURE EFFORTS TO DISCUSS COALITION GOVERNMENT WOULD BE CHANNELED THROUGH CDHRF (MINATCHI ADDED THAT NONE OF THEM TRUST OTHERS TO NEGOTIATE ALONE).
EMBOFF REPLIED THAT HE WOULD BE HAPPY TO CONINUE MEETING WITH MINATCHI AND ANY OTHERS BY WHATEVER NAME.

EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE ALSO DECIDED TO MEET JOINTLY WITH MOST PROMINENT RELIGIO STGEADERS FROM BOTH KHOMEINI AND SHARIATMADARI CAMPS ON DEC. 12 TO HAMMER OUT A LIST FOR PROPOSED REGENCY COUNCIL AND TO AGREE ON A CABINET LIST. MINATCHI SAID DECISION HAD BEEN TAKEN TO GIVE SHAH SEVERAL NAMES TO PICK FROM, AND IN CASE OF REGENCY COUNCIL, OPEN CHOICE ON TWO ACTIVE DUTY MILITARY COMMANDERS AND SELECTION FROM LIST OF ONE RETIRED OFFICER. AFTER LISTS WERE READY, AYATOLLAH MONTAZERI WOULD DEPART FOR PARIS TO GET KHOMEINI'S TACIT APPROVAL. THEN, SAID MINATCHI, CDHRF WOULD LIKE TO PRESENT LIST TO U.S. AND U.K.

AMBASSADORS AND THEIR POLITICAL STAFFS WITH AN EYE TO GETTING THEM TO AGREE THAT SUCH A PROPOSAL WAS ALL RIGHT AND EVENTUALLY TO SO INFORMING SHAH. EMBOFF REPLIED THERE WERE SOME BIG IF'S ALONG ROAD TO MEETING--WOULD GROUP AGREE ON LIST FIRST, AND THEN WOULD KHOMEINI ACCEPT IDEA. MINATCHI THOUGHT GETTING GROUP TO AGREE ON NAMES WOULD BE MOST DIFFICULT PART; AYATOLLAH MONTAZERI THOUGHT KHOMEINI WOULD AGREE TO SOLUTION WITH PROPOSED REGENCY COUNCIL. EMBOFF SAID THIS WAS MAJOR SUBSTANTIVE PROBLEM--SHAH HAD NOT AGREED TO THIS BEFORE; WHAT MADE CDHRF THINK WE WOULD DO SO NOW?

EMBOFF WAS TREATED TO THREE MINUTES OF RHETORIC ABOUT PEOPLE'S WILLINGNESS TO PUCH FOR THIS SOLUTION AND HOPE THAT EVENTS WOULD EVENTUALLY CONVINCE SHAH THAT REGENCY COUNCIL WAS ONLY WAY OUT. EMBOFF SAID HE WOULD REFER QUESTION OF MEETING WITH AMBASSADORS TO HIS OWN, BUT WOULD NOT EXPECT AN ANSWER UNLESS AND UNTIL GROUP HAD COMPLETED ITS WORK, INCLUDING KHOMEINI APPROVAL IN WHATEVER FORM IT MIGHT COME. MINATCHI NODDED AND SAID HE WOULD NOT PUSH MATTER UNTIL ALL BRIDGES WERE CROSSED.

MINATCHI THEN SAID CDHRF WAS PREPARING LETTER TO PRESIDENT CARTER ABOUT SITUATION IN IRAN, AND WOULD HAVE IT DELIVERED TO EMBASSY DEC. 9. MINATCHI THEN RAISED QUESTION ABOUT PRESIDENT CARTER' S REMARKS TO PRESS DEC. 7, WHICH WERE REPORTED ON DEC. 7 EVENING BBC BROADCAST. MINATCHI SAID CARTER HAD BEEN REPORTED AS SAYING THAT HE DIDN'T KNOW IF THE SHAH WOULD SURVIVE OR NOT, AND THAT SUMMIT MEETING WITH U.K., U.S., FRANCE AND GERMANY WOULD BE CONVENED TO DISCUSS PROBLEMS, ESPECIALLY IRAN. EMBOFF (WHO HAD NOT SEEN TEXT OF PRESIDENT'S BREAKFAST REMARKS AT THAT POINT) SAID HE WAS UNAWARE OF THEM.

LAMBRAKIS FAMILY HAS DECIDED TO LEAVE COUNTRY OVER NEXT WEEK SO AS TO MINIMIZE CHANCES LAMBRAKIS BEING RETRACED WHEN HE MOVES RESIDENCE TO APARTMENT NEAR EMBASSY COMPOUND. LAMBRAKIS WILL REMAIN ON JOB IN TEHRAN FOR FORESEEABLE FUTURE UNTIL SITUATION PERMITS HIS TRANSFER.

MRS. LAMBRAKIS AND TWO CHILDREN - WHO WENT THROUGH LONG SEPARATION WHILE LAMBRAKIS WAS IN BEIRUT TWO YEARS AGO - BOTH MUCH PREFER SAFEHAVEN IN PARIS. GIVEN EMOTIONAL TENSION INVOLVED; SHE PREFERS BE CLOSE TO FRIENDS AND FAMILY IN COUNTRY WHERE SHE SPEAKS THE LANGUAGE. HOWEVER, SEPARATE MAINTENANCE IN PARIS WITH ATHENS PER DIEM AND SCHOOL RATES PROVED TO BE FINANCIAL HARDSHIP WHEN LAMBRAKIS FAMILY WAS THERE LAST TIME (1975-76). THEREFORE LAMBRAKIS REQUESTS EXCEPTION TO PERMIT PAYMENT OF PER DIEM AT PARIS RATE (OR AT FRANKFURT RATE, WHICH IS ONLY ONE DOLLAR LESS) AND PARIS SCHOOLING ALLOWANCE TO PERMIT CHILDREN CONTINUING IN AN AMERICAN SCHOOL THERE.
WOULD ALSO APPRECIATE TRAVEL AUTHORIZATION TO PARIS.
POST SUPPORTS THIS REQUEST IN VIEW OF SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES ON WHICH DEPARTMENT HAS BEEN BRIEFED. APPRECIATE EXPEDITIOUS DETERMINATION.

1978TEHRAN12053.subject: GRUMMAN BLDG IN ISFAHAN BURNED BY MOB CONSULATE ISFAHAN REPORTS UNRULY CROWD OF ABOUT 1000 GATHERED AT 1330 IN CENTRAL ISFAHAN. GROUP OF 100

segments.text: CONSULATE ISFAHAN REPORTS UNRULY CROWD OF ABOUT 1000 GATHERED AT 1330 IN CENTRAL ISFAHAN. GROUP OF 100-200 BROKE OFF AND ATTACKED GRUMMAN NUMBER 2 BLDG WITH ROCKS, THEN SET IT ON FIRE. SIX GRUMMAN EMPLOYEES AND TWO OSI PERSONNEL FLED BLDG, PURSUED BY CROWD, ESCAPING BY HIDING IN CELLAR OF IRANIAN WHO GAVE THEM REFUGE. BUILDING BURNED COMPLETELY (SAFES WERE LOCKED AND OSI PERSONNEL BELIEVE CLASSIFIED DOCUMENTS NOT RPT NOT COMPROMISED). MEANWHILE REST OF CROWD SEVERLY DAMAGED THREE BANKS AND ONE CINEMA. POLICE ASSIGNED TO GUARD GRUMMAN BLDG VANISHED. TROOPS FINALLY ARRIVED BUT ONLY KEPT CROWD AT BAY RATHER THAN ATTACKING RIOTERS. ORDER HAS NOW BEEN

1978TEHRAN12073.subject: REPORTED ARREST OF ACTIVIST IRANIAN STUDENTS

segments.text: IN ATTEMPTING TO CONTACT BERKELEY GRADUATE AND RADICAL STUDENT ORGANIZER (FNU) PARTOVI ON BEHALF OF EMBOFF, HOMAN QAVIMI WAS INFORMED THAT PARTOVI AND AN UNSPECIFIED NUMBER OF OTHER ACTIVIST STUDENTS RECENTLY RETURNED TO IRAN FROM OVERSEAS HAD BEEN ARRESTED DECEMBER 6. ACCORDING TO QAVIMI GOI HAD MAINTAINED AN ENTRY LIST OF SUCH STUDENTS BUT HAD ONLY DECIDED TO MOVE AGAINST THEM JUST BEFORE ASHURA.
QAVIMI DID NOT KNOW HOW MANY STUDENTS HAD BEEN DETAINED, WHEN THEY WOULD BE RELEASED, OR WHAT CHARGES HAVE BEEN PLACED AGAINST THEM.
THIS APPEARS TO BE PART OF RENEWED EFFORT TO ARREST POSSIBLE TROUBLEMAKERS (OF SECOND RANK -- NOT THE MOST PROMINENT) TO HELP DEFUSE TROUBLE DURING NEXT FEW DAYS.

1978TEHRAN12076.subject: SHIFT IN ONE IRANIAN'S MOOD TOWARD RETENTION OF SHAH

segments.text: THE FOLLOWING IS A SYNTHESIS OF SEVERAL CONVERSATIONS BETWEEN EMBOFF AND ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTIVE DEPARTMENT DIRECTOR MANOUCHEHR FAELI DURING WHICH FAELI HAS MAINTAINED AN UNCHARACTERISTICLY CONSISTENT CONCERN THAT CONTINUED INSTABILITY IN IRAN AND PARTICULARLY IN THE CAPITAL COULD LEAD TO A MILITARY COUP AGAINST WHATEVER GOVERNMENT IS IN POWER AT THE TIME. FAELI BELIEVES STRONGLY THAT THE AZHARI GOVERNMENTMUST RE-ESTABLISH CALM TO BUY TIME TO TAKE MEASURES WHICH WOULD ESTABLISH A DEGREE OF CONFIDENCE AMONG THE PEOPLE. AT THE SAME TIME FAELI FEARS THAT THE PEOPLE WILL NOT BE SATISFIED WITH WHATEVER STEPS THE GOVERNMENT MAY TAKE TO PLACATE THEM.

HE FEELS THAT THE DANGER OF A COALITION GOVERNMENT IS THAT PEOPLE LIKE SANJABI NOT HAVE THE COURAGE TO SAY NO TO THE PEOPLE BUT WILL BE LED BY THE RABBLE RATHER THAN THE OTHER WAY AROUND. CONSEQUENTLY, FAELI DOUBTS THAT THE SHAH WOULD LONG SURVIVE, EVEN AS A CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCH, ONCE A COALITION IS IN PLACE. HOWEVER, THE UNCERTAINTY WHICH IS LIKELY TO ACCOMPANY THIS SORT OF WEAK GOVERNMENT MAY WELL LEAD, IN FAELI'S VIEW TO A MILITARY COUP. WHILE SUCH A COUP COULD INITIALLY PRESERVE THE SHAH, FAELI ASSUMES THAT "SOME COLONEL" WOULD SOON REPLACE THE GENERAL(S) WHO LED THE ORIGINAL PUTSCH, WITH UNPREDICTABLE RESULTS.

COMMENT: FAELI'S REMARKS ARE SHEER SPECULATION, AND ARE REPORTED MERELY TO PROVIDE A FLAVOR OF THE SORT OF FEARS WHICH ANIMATE MUCH OF THE UPPER STRATA OF IRANIAN SOCIETY TODAY AND WHICH ARE CAUSING MANY OF THEM TO FAVOR RETENTION OF SHAH IN SOME CAPACITY. FAELI HAS ALREADY TAKEN ACTIONS BASED ON HIS CONCERNS--HIS WIFE AND CHILDREN LEFT FOR NICE ON DECEMBER 6. MORE AND MORE IRANIANS EMBOFF ENCOUNTERS, ATALL SOCIAL LEVELS, ARE EXPRESSING THE VIEW THAT THE SHAH MUST REMAIN IN ORDER TO PREVENT SOMETHING WORSE. TEN DAYS AGO, FAELI WAS VIRTUALLY CERTAIN THAT THE SHAH WOULD HAVE TO GO.

IN THE STREETS PEOPLE WERE SAYING THAT THE DEPARTURE OF THE PAHLAVIS WAS A SINEQUA NON FOR PEACE. NOW EVEN THE COMMON PEOPLE: SHOPKEEPERS, MERCHANTS, SERVANTS, AND THE LIKE, ARE ASKING OF THE SHAH HAS REALLY LEARNED HIS LESSON THIS TIME OR WHAT THE SITUATION WILL BE LIKE OF THE SHAH REMAINS.
