1978TEHRAN12077.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT, DEC. 9, 1978 SUMMARY: TEHRAN QUIET EVENING DEC. 8 - MORNING DEC. 9. EMBASSY SOURCE REPORTS NUMBER OF STUDENT ORGANIZER

segments.text: SUMMARY: TEHRAN QUIET EVENING DEC. 8 - MORNING DEC. 9. EMBASSY SOURCE REPORTS NUMBER OF STUDENT ORGANIZERS WERE ARRESTED EVENING DEC. 6. ISFAHAN CONFIRMS SIX SOLDIERS KILLED. ISFAHAN QUIET BUT TENSE MORNING DEC. 9. CONSUL WITNESSED ATTACK WITH WEAPONS ON POLICE STATION EVENING DEC. 8, AND HIS CONVOY DREW SNIPER FIRE AFTER CURFEW. IN TABRIZ MORNING DEC. 8, SOME SHOOTING OCCURRED NEAR BAZAAR, AND LATE IN DAY TABRIZ MILITARY GOVERNOR LOWERED CURFEW FROM 2300 TO 2100 HOURS. PRIME MINISTER MORNING DEC. 9 ANNOUNCED APPROVAL FOR DEC. 10 TEHRAN RELIGIOUS DEMONSTRATION AND EXTENSION OF CURFEW HOURS IN TEHRAN FROM 2100 TO 2300 HOURS FOR DEC. 10 AND 11.

AYATOLLAH SHARIAT-MADARI CALLED FOR ARMY NOT RPT NOT TO FIRE ON DEMONSTRATORS AND FOR DEMONSTRATORS TO BE CAUTIOUS. RUMORS OF WEAPONS ENTERING CITY CONTINUE; STORIES BEING SPREAD THAT CROWN PRINCE'S PICTURE IS REPLACING SHAH'S IN SOME MILITARY BARRACKS. END SUMMARY.

TEHRAN REMAINED FAIRLY QUIET EVENING DECEMBER 8. LOW LEVEL OF CHANTING WAS PARTLY MUFFLED BY FOG WHICH LEFT FAIRLY HEAVY MIST OVER CITY AGAIN DEC. 9. ONE SOURCE REPORTS ARMY ARRESTED NUMBER OF STUDENT ORGANIZERS DEC. 6. SOURCE SAID THAT TROOPS WERE OBVIOUSLY WORKING FROM PREPARED LIST (COMMENT: THIS MAY EXPLAIN WHY DEC. 7 STUDENT DEMONSTRATION DAY PASSED RATHER QUIETLY IN TEHRAN). INCLUDED WAS U.S. TRAINED STUDENT LEADER PARTOVI. MILITARY ALSO MAKING SPOT CHECKS OF VEHICLES SEARCHING FOR ARMS, LEAFLETS, ETC.

U.S. CONSUL ISFAHAN CONFIRMS RUMORED DEATH OF SIX SOLDIERS EVENING DEC. 6. SOLDIERS WERE KILLED WHEN THEY REPORTEDLY TRIED TO PUT OUT BURNING ROAD BARRICADE AND DEVICE WITHIN BARRICADE BLEW UP KILLING THEM. THOUGH ISFAHAN WAS QUIET MORNING DEC. 9, U.S. CONSUL WITNESSED ARMED ATTACK ON POLICE STATION AFTER CURFEW EVENING DEC. 8. CONSUL WAS RETURNING IN CONVOY FROM OUTLYING SUBURB AND WHILE STOPPED AT STATION TO CHANGE ESCORT, ARMED GROUP THREW BOMB WHICH EXPLODED WITH MINIMAL DAMAGE, THEN PEPPERED STATION WITH SHOTGUN FIRE (PELLETS WERE FIRED FROM SUCH A DISTANCE THEY DID NOT BREAK WINDOW GLASS). ON CONTINUATION OF TRIP TO CONSUL'S RESIDENCE, CONVOY TOOK SNIPER-TYPE FIRE FROM ROOFTOPS.

TROOPS IN CONVOY FIRED AT SURROUNDING BUILDINGS, WITH UNKNOWN RESULTS. IN ISFAHAN DECEMBER 5, THERE WERE 15 MAJOR FIRES AND 9 VEHICLES FIREBOMBED IN ADDITION TO RAZING OF GRUMMAN OFFICE, REPORTED SEPTEL.

TABRIZ REPORTS SCATTERED SHOOTING NEAR BAZAAR MORNING DECEMBER 8, BUT TOWN REMAINED QUIET FOR REST OF DAY. MILITARY GOVERNOR ANNOUNCED TABRIZ CURFEW WILL BE LOWERED FROM 2300 TO 2100 HOURS EFFECTIVE DEC. 8. ANNOUNCEMENT WAS MADE LATE IN DAY, AND U.S. CONSUL BELIEVES NUMBER OF PEOPLE WERE CAUGHT OUT PAST NEW CURFEW (NO AMERICANS).

PRIME MINISTER AZHARI ANNOUNCED PERMISSION HAS BEEN GRANTED FOR RELIGIOUS DEMONSTRATION IN TEHRAN DEC. 10 AND CONCURRENTLY SAID TEHRAN CURFEW WILL BE RAISED FROM 2100 TO 2300 HOURS FOR DEC. 10 AND 11. AMBASSADOR SPOKE ON TELEPHONE WITH AZHARI WHO ASSURED HIM THAT ADEQUATE MEASURES WOULD BE IN PLACE SUNDAY TO CONTAIN DEMONSTRATIONS IF THEY BECAME VIOLENT.

AYATOLLAH SHARIAT-MADARI AND HIS FELLOW AYATOLLAHS IN GHOM HAVE ISSUED MESSAGE WITH TWO KEY ELEMENTS: ------------------077968 091451Z /41 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 2120 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY BONN AMCONSUL DHAHRAN AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY TOKYO USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 12077 SOLDIERS SHOULD NOT SHOOT AT THE DEMONSTRATORS AND DEMONSTRATORS SHOULD BE CAUTIOUS AND ORDERLY OVER TESSUAASHURA.

SEVERAL SOURCES SAY THEY ARE AWARE OF WEAPONS ENTERING TEHRAN. ALTHOUGH DEVOID OF SPECIFICS, LIBERATION MOVEMENT OF IRAN (LMI) SOURCE TOLD EMBOFF DEC. 8 THAT "UNDERGROUND GROUPS" WERE ARMING THEMSELVES, BUT SOURCE EXPECTED THEM TO REFRAIN FROM VIOLENCE DURING RELIGIOUS PARADES. GENERAL JAHANBANI FORMER HEAD OF IRAN'S SPORTS ORGANIZATION TOLD NEW ZEALAND EMBOFF THAT IN "ONE OR TWO" MILITARY BARRACKS, SHAH'S PICTURE WAS COMING DOWN AND CROWN PRINCE'S WAS GOING UP. (COMMENT: JAHANBANI MAY HAVE AXE TO GRIND AND BE LESS THAN FULLY RELIABLE. WHAT SURPRISED EMBOFF, HOWEVER, WAS HOW READILY STORY WAS ACCEPTED BY IRANIAN OFFICIALS LISTENING TO CONVERSATION.)

OPPOSITION WRITER HAJ SAYED JAVADI WAS RELEASED LAST NIGHT AFTER ARREST BY MLA AUTHORITIES EARLIER IN THE DAY. VERSIONS VARY AS TO WHETHER 50 OR 100 OTHERS WERE ARRESTED WITH HIM FOR ILLEGAL ASSEMBLY (OF HIS WRITER'S GROUP) IN HIS HOME.APARENTLY NOT ALL THE OTHERS HAVE BEEN RELEASED. HUMAN RIGHTS DEFENSE LEAGUE HELD PRESS CONFERENCE MID-AFTERNOON TODAY O BRIEF REPORTERS ON ROUTE OF MARCH TOMORROW, INFORM THEM OPPOSITION POLITICAL GROUPS IN ADDITION TO RELIGIOUS LEADERS AND NATIONAL FRONT WERE ALSO INVOLVED IN ORGANIZING TOMORROW'S DEMONSTRATION AND THEY HAD NOT REQUESTED MLA PERMISSION TO HOLD THE MARCH (EVEN THOUGH GOVERNMENT HAS ALREADY ANNOUNCED IT WILL PERMIT IT).

WE HAVE HAD REPORTS FROM TWO GOOD SOURCES (ARMISH/MAAG AND DAO) THAT LATEST GOVERNMENT GAME PLAN FOR TOMORROW (DEC 10) WILL BE TO TURN OVER SOUTHERN PORTION OF TEHRAN TO DEMONSTRATORS, DRAWING LINE ABOVE WHICH THEY WILL NOT BE PERMITTED TO GO. ANNOUNCED LIMIT REPORTEDLY TO BE TAKHTE TAVOUS, REAL LIMIT PERHAPS FURTHER NORTH. NOTE: EMBASSY COMPOUND--ANDMANY OTHER MISSIONS--FALL SOUTH OF THAT LINE. EMBASSY IN PROCESS OF ASSURING GOI CONTINUED PROTECTION OF EMBASSY COMPOUND. SULLIVAN

WE UNDERSTAND FROM LOCAL TWA REPRESENTATIVE AFTERNOON OF 9 DEC. THAT TWA INTENDS TO FLY 707 CHARTER INTO ISFAHAN ON 10 AND ANOTHER ON 12 DECEMBER TO EVACUATE PASSENGERS TO ATHENS. TWA REP ALSO INFORMED EMB OFF THAT HE INTENDED TO OBTAIN APPROVAL FROM IRANIAN CIVAIR ORG. BY TELEPHONE HIMSELF. HOWEVER, TWA REP HAS NOT CALLED US BACK NOR HAVE WE BEEN ABLE TO REACH HIM.

IN MEANTIME, EMB HAS BEEN IN TOUCH WITH CAO, WHICH HAD NOT RECEIVED TWA LANDING REQUEST AS OF 2020 HRS. 9 DEC. CAO HAS ADVISED THAT ISFAHAN CIVIL AIRPORT CANNOT ACCOMMODATE 707 AND THAT REQUEST SHOULD BE MADE FOR LANDING AT KHATIMI AIRBASE. HOWEVER, AS THERE IS NO CUSTOMS POST ISFHAN, SPECIAL ARRANGEMENTS WOULD HAVE TO BE MADE BY CAO, A PROCEDURE WHICH WILL TAKE TIME WITH APPROVAL NOT GUARANTEED. FACT THAT TEHRAN MEHRABAD AIRPORT WILL BE CLOSED FOR 48 HOURS BEGINNING 1000 HRS. 10 DEC. BECUASE OF PLANNED DEMONSTRATIONS WILL ALSO LIMIT POSSIBLE OPTIONS.
SUGGEST YOU ADVISE TWA OF ABOVE WITH RECOMMENDATION THAT LANDINGREQUEST BE SENT IMMEDIATELY TO IRANIAN CAO.

1978TEHRAN12089.subject: PRELIMINARY POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT DEC. 10, 1978 SUMMARY DECEMBER 10 HAS BEEN GREY, FOGGY AND MILD, SETTING

segments.text: SUMMARY DECEMBER 10 HAS BEEN GREY, FOGGY AND MILD, SETTING APPROPRIATE CLIMATE FOR FIRST OF TWO DAYS OF DEEPEST MOURNING. IN ACCORDANCE WITH PREVIOUSLY AGREED PROCEDURES ALL MILITARY AND POLICE PULLED OUT OF SOUTHERN PORTIONS OF CITY, LEAVING CLEAR FIELD TO MOURNERS AND DEMONSTRATORS. SEVERAL HUNDRED THOUSAND HAVE CONVERGED ON SHAH REZA AVENUE IN MIDDLE OF CITY ND MARCHED WESTWARD TO SHAHYAD MONUMENT NEAR AIRPORT, WHERE RELIGIOUS AND POLITICAL LEADERS ARE HARANGING THEM. NO VIOLENCE OR DESTRUCTION REPORTED. MORE LIKELY OCCASION FOR THAT POSSIBILITY WILL BE AFTER SPEECHES FINISHED, AND CROWDS RETURNING HOME. END SUMMARY

IN ACCORDANCE WITVIOUSLY ARRANGED PLANS, MILITARY AND POLICE FORCES PULLED OUT OF SOUTHERN TWO THIRDS OF TEHRAN MORNING DECEMBER 10. FEW DISCREET TROOP UNITS LEFT IN THAT PORTION OF CITY HAVE MOVED OUT OF SIGHT. FOR EXAMPLE, SQUAD ASSIGNED TO PROTECTION OF EMBASSY COMPOUND HAS DRIVEN ITS TRUCK INSIDE AND PARKED IT BEHIND AMBASSADOR'S RESIDENCE. SIMILAR SITUATION AT OTHER "SENSITIVE POINTS" STILL BEING PROTECTED.

IN NORTHERN THIRD OF CITY, WHICH ENCOMPASSES IMPERIAL PALACES, MOST MILITARY HEADQUARTERS AND MOST AFFLUENT RESIDENTIAL AREAS, TROOP CONCENTRATION IS HEAVY. BARRICADES HAVE BEEN ERECTED ON EAST-WEST LINE ROUGHLY ALONG ARDESHIR-E-BABAKAN AND ALL VEHICULAR TRAFFIC THROUGH THOSE BARRICADES IS TIGHTLY CONTROLLED. A FEW HUNDRED THOUSAND RESIDENTS LEFT THE CITY DECEMBER 9, APPARENTLY IN ANTICIPATION OF VIOLENCE.

AT ABOUT 9 A.M., CROWDS BEGAN FORMING AT MOSQUES IN VARIOUS SECTIONS OF CITY AND, UNDER VERY DISCIPLINED MARSHALLING, MOVED RELATIVELY QUIETLY TO CONVERGE UPON SHAH REZA AVENUE, WHICH RUNS EAST-WEST FROM SHAHNAZ CIRCLE TO TEHRAN UNIVERSITY, WHERE IT BECOMES EISENHOWER AVENUE AND CONTINUES TO SHAHYAD MONUMENT NEAR MEHRABAD AIRPORT. TRIBUTARY MARCHING UNITS SEEMED TO NUMBER ONE TO TWO THOUSAND EACH, COMPOSED OF BOTH MEN AND WOMEN, CHANTING RELIGIOUS SLOGANS AND CARRYING PICTURES OF KHOMEINI. VERY FEW POLITICAL BANNERS IN EVIDENCE BUT WALLS ALONG SHAH REZA HAVE BEEN PLASTERED WITH ANTI-SHAH POSTERS. THESE GROUPS HAVE CONVERGED ON SHAH REZA, FORMED UP INTO LARGER UNITS, AND MOVED WESTWARD.
AS OF 3 P.M., THEY STRETCHED MORE THAN THREE MILES TOWARDS THE SHAHYAD AND ARE ESTIMATED TO NUMBER SEVERAL HUNDRED THOUSAND.

THE CROWDS ARE ORDERLY AND HAVE AVOIDED ANY ACTS OF DESTRUCTION ALONG THEIR ROUTES OF MARCH. THERE ARE SIDEWALK VENDORS TO PROVIDE THEM SOFT DRINKS AND BULL-HORNS TO GIVE THEM DIRECTIONS. IN THESE SEVERURS, THEIR MOOD HAS BEEN PEACEFUL AND SUBDUED.

UPON ARRIVAL AT THE OPEN SPACES AROUND SHAHYAD, CROWD HAS SPREAD OUT TO HEAR SPEECHES FROM RELIGIOUS AND POLITICAL LEADERS. AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI, SURROGATE FOR AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, SEEMS TO BE PRINCIPAL LUMINARY AT SHAHYAD SITE. SEVERAL NATIONAL FRONT LEADERS, INCLUDING RECENTLY RELEASED SANJABI, ARE ALSO ON THE PROGRAM. ALTHOUGH TAIL END OF MARCHERS HAS NOT YET PASSED UNIVERSITY, FORMAL ACTIVITIES AT SHAHYAD ARE SCHEDULED TO END WITHIN AN HOUR, AND MARCHERS ARE EXPECTED TO RETURN TO THEIR HOMES OR ORIGINAL ASSEMBLY POINTS.

ALTHOUGH SECURITY OFFICIALS IN TOUCH WITH EMBASSY SEEM SUPREMELY CONFIDENT THAT NO RPT NO DIFFICULTIES WILL ERUPT LATER TODAY,WE FEEL THERE IS CHANCE THAT GROUPS WHICH HAVE BEEN STIRRED UP BY ORATORY AT SHAHYAD, AND WITHOUT DISCIPLINE ENFORCED ON THEM DURING MORNING PROCESSION, COULD PROVOKE INSTANCES OF VIOLENCE OR DESTRUCTION.

THIS IS PARTICULARLY POSSIBLE BECAUSE CURFEW THIS EVENING HAS BEEN EXTENDED TO 2300 HRS.M ------------------087620 101457Z /46 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 2131 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY BONN AMCONSUL DHAHRAN AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY TOKYO USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 12089

OVERWHELMING PORTION OF AMERICAN COMMUNITY IN TEHRAN LIVES NORTH OF THE SECURITY LINE WHICH TROOPS AND POLICE HAVE DRAWN ALONG ARDESHIR-E-BABAKAN AND SHOULD, IN ANY EVENT, BE PROTECTED BY THE HEAVY CONCENTRATION OF SECURITY FORCES THERE. CONSEQUENTLY, THERE SEEMS LITTLE LIKELIHOOD OF DANGER IN THAT DIRECTION. DECEMBER 11, WHICH IS ASHURA ITSELF, WILL APPARENTLY BE OBSERVED BY LESS FORMAL PROCESSIONS, BUT SAME "OPEN CITY" RULES WILL BE OBSERVED BY SECURITY FORCES.
THIS REPORT IS BEING FILED EARLY IN ORDER PROVIDE DEPARTMENT WITH FLAVOR OF EVENTS TO THIS HOUR IN TEHRAN. SECOND PORTION, WHICH WILL ALSO REPORT ON SITUATION IN OTHER CITIES, WILL BE

IN EARLY EVENING DECEMBER 10, AS DEMONSTRATIONS IN TEHRAN WERE COMPLETED AND DEMONSTRATORS BEGAN TO DISPERSEBACK HOME, ARDESHIR ZAHEDI TELEPHONED ME IN A STATE OF CONSIDERABLE EUPHORIA. HE HAD SPENT A GOOD PORTION OF THE AFTERNOON IN A HELICOPTER OVERFLYING THE DEMONSTRATION AND GIVING IT FIRST HAND SURVEILLANCE. HE HAD TAKEN AP CORRESPONDENTS WITH HIM AND HAD PHOTOGRAPHED CROWDS IN ORDER TO OBTAIN INTELLIGENT ESTIMATE OF THEIR NUMBERS.

HE CLAIMED, ON BASIS RATHER COMPLICATED FORMULA,THAT NUMBERS DID NOT RPT NOT EXCEED 300,000. HE HAS CONVEYED THIS ESTIMATE TO THE SHAH AND CONSIDERS IT A GREAT VICTORY AGAINST THE FORCES OF KHOMEINI. HE ALSO BELIEVES THAT THE PEACEFULNESS OF THE DEMONSTRATION IS A PLUS FOR THE GOVERNMENT. HE ATTRIBUTES THIS TO FACT THAT MILITARY HAD SHOWN ITS WILLINGNESS TO GET TOUGH DURING THE PAST TEN DAYS.

I CONGRATULATED ZAHEDI ON THE SUCCESS OF THE CONSIDERABLE GAMBLE WHICH HAD BEEN ENTAILED IN THE DECISION TO PULL ALL SECURITY FORCES OUT OF THE AREA OF THE DEMONSTRATION. I SAID I THOUGHT THE FACT THE OPPOSING SIDES COULD SHOW THAT MUCH GOOD FAITH IN EACH OTHER WAS AN AUGURY FOR A CIVILIZED COMPROMISE RATHER THAN A BLOODY CONFRONTATION. HE MODESTLY ACCEPTED CREDIT FOR THIS DEVELOPMENT, BUT SAID HE HAD SUFFERED TWO SLEEPLESS NIGHTS IN FEAR THAT HE HAVE BEEN WRONG.
WE AGREED THAT WE WOULD JOINTLY SEE THE SHAH EITHER TUESDAY OR WEDNESDAY TO DISCUSS LONGER RANGE PROBLEMS, ASSUMING ALL GOES

SUMMARY: AS OF 1800, DEC. 10, THE PROCESSIONISTS WHO GATHERED AT SHAHYAD MONUMENT HAVE DISPERSED AND ARE WALKING BACK ALONG SAME ROUTES THEY TOOK EARLIER IN DAY. WE HAVE NO REPORTS OF VIOLENCE. SHIRAZ, ISFAHAN AND TABRIZ ALSO WITNESSED ORDERLY, NON-VIOLENT PROCESSIONS. END SUMMARY.

IN MID-AFTERNOON CROWD OF SEVERAL HUNDRED THOUSAND WHICH HAD MARCHED TO SHAHYAD STARTED TO DISPERSE AND IS CURRENTLY RETURNING HOME OR TO MOSQUES, GENERALLY ALONG SAME ROUTES OF MARCH. TO THE BESTOF OUR KNOWLEDGE THERE HAS BEEN NO VIOLENCE THROUGHOUT THE DAYBUT WE STILL HAVE FIVE HOURS TO CURFEW AND DO NOT KNOW WHETHER VIOLATION OF CURFEW IS PLANNED.
WE HAVE AS YET BEEN UNABLE TO DETERMINE WHETHER ANY PROCLAMATIONS OR UTIONS WERE CARRIED AT SHAHYAD.

WE ARE RECEIVING MIXED REPORTS ON WHAT WILL OCCUR TOMORROW, DEC. 11. SOME REPORTS INDICATE THAT TODAY'S MARCH WILL BE REPEATED. OTHERS HAVE REPORTED THAT MORE TRADITIONAL MOHARRAM PROCESSIONS WILL TAKE PLACE AFTER MOSQUE SERVICES.

OUR CONSULS IN SHIRAZ, ISFAHAN AND TABRIZ REPORT SIMILAR PEACEFUL AND WELL-ORGANIZED PROCESSIONS TOOK PLACE. NO VIOLENCE. AS IN TEHRAN, SECURITY FORCES WITHDREW FROM SIGHT OF DEMONSTRATIONS AND WERE READY FOR QUICK REACTION. PRESS SOURCES HAVE TOLD US THAT DEMONSTRATIONS TOOK PLACE IN ALL CITIES OF ANY SIZE AND PARTICULARLY LARGE ONE OCCURRED IN MESHED; AGAIN, NO VIOLENCE

PEACEFUL PROCESSION WHICH TOOK PLACE IN TEHRAN DECEMBER 10 WAS MOBILIZED BY RELIGIOUS LEADERS AND BY REPRESENTATIVES FROM THE BAZAAR. HOWEVER, THE ARRANGEMENTS FOR ITS ORGANIZATION AND THE UNDERSTANDINGS WITH GOI SECURITY OFFICIALS WERE WORKED OUT BY REPRESENTATIVES SPEAKING FOR THE NATIONAL FRONT. IN THE PROCESSION ITSELF, FRONT LEADER KARIM SANJABI WAS LIONIZED AND RECEIVED SIGNIFICANT PUBLIC ACCLAIM.

IN SPEAKING TO ME ABOUT THE DEMONSTRATION LATER THAT EVENING, ARDESHIR ZAHEDI, WHO ACTED AS PRINCIPAL GOVERNMENT NEGOTIATOR IN WORKING OUT ARRANGEMENTS FOR THE PROCESSION, INDICATED THAT A NUMBER OF "OUR PEOPLE" TOOK PART IN THE PROCESSION AND ATTEMPTED TO STEER IT TOWARDS MODERATION. HE MENTIONED THAT "SOME MODERATES" CARRIED PICTURES OF SRIAT RADARI RATHER THAN KHOMEINI.

ALL THIS SEEMS TO INDICATE SOME COLLABORATION BETWEEN THE GOVERNMENT AND THE MODERATE POLITICAL LEADERS TO ENHANCE THE PUBLIC STATUS OF THE LATTER AT THE EXPENSE OF KHOMEINI. THIS WOULD BE AN OBVIOUS TACTIC FOR THE SHAH TO FOLLOW IF HE SUBSEQUENTLY WISHES TO NEGOTIATE A COALITION GOVERNMENT WITH THE NATIONAL FRONT AS HIS PRINCIPAL INTERLOCUTORS. SENATOR MEZBAHZADEH, IN DISCUSSING POLITICAL WEAKNESS OF NATIONAL FRONT WITH US EARLIER, SAID HIS KAYHAN PUBLICATIONS COULD BUILD THEM UP INTO NATIONAL HEROES IN A FEW WEEKS IF THAT WAS WANTED.
WHEN I SAW HIM LAST A FEW DAYS AGO, HE TOLD ME HE WAS HOPING TO BRING OUT SOME SORT OF NEWSPAPER SHORTLY AFTER ASHURA.

IN SHORT, THERE APPEARS TO BE AN EMERGING GAME PLAN TO HAVE THE NATIONAL FRONT STEAL THE LEADERSHIP OF THE OPPOSITION MOVEMENT AWAY FROM KHOMEINI THROUGH MANIPULATION OF PUBLIC OPINION. SHAH HAS ALL ALONG REASONED THAT HE COULD WORK OUT AN ARRWNGEMENT FOR A CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCHY WITH THE FRONT, BUT NEVER WITH KHOMEINI.

KHOOEINI GROUPS ARE PROBABLY ALREADY ALERT TO THIS TACTIC AND MAY CONSIDER THAT DECEMBER 10 DEMONSTRATIONS WERE A "VICTORU FOR MODERATION", AS ZAHEDI BELIEVES. IT IS THEREFORE POSSIBLE THAT THEY MAY WISH TO TURN DECEMBER 11 INTO A MORE RIOTOUS CONFRONTATION, PARTICULARLYBECAUSE KHOMEINI HAS PREDICTED THAT "RIVERS OF BLOOD WILL" ON DECEMBER 11.

THE PATTERN OF ACTIVITIES EMERGING ON MORNING OF DECEMBER 11 GIVES NO CLEAR INDICATION OF THE EVENTS TO FOLLOW. GROUPS WHICH ARE SOMEWHAT SMALLER THAN THOSE WHICH WERE ASSEMBLED DECEMBER 10 BEGAN TO FORM UP QUITE EARLY IN MORNING AND TO MARCH TOWARDS SHAH REZA. THE PATTERN ON SHAH REZA ITSELF IS FAR LESS CLEAR THAN DECEMBER 10, WHEN ALL GROUPS AUTOMATICALLY HEADED WEST TO THE SHAHYAD. AS OFLATE MORNING, THERE IS CONSIDERABLE AIMLESS MILLING AROUND.

THOSE GROUPS IN VICINITY OF EMBASSY ARE ENGAGED IN TYPICAL ASHURA BREASTBEATING AND SELF-FLAGELLATION. (ONE GROUP OBLIGINGLY REMOVED THEIR SHIRTS AND BEAT THEIR BREASTS IN FRONT OF EMBASSY GATES FOR BENEFIT OFTV AND PRESS PHOTOGRAPHERS MOUNTED ON A TRUCK. WHEN PHOTOGRAPHY FINISHED, THEY DONNED THEIR SHIRTS AND CONTINUED SOUTHWARD.)

IF KHOMEINI LEADERS SEEK VIOLENCE DECEMBER 11 IN ORDER REGAIN CONTROL OF SITUATION, THEY WILL DOUBTLESS FIND ENOUGH DEMONSTRATORS AVAILABLE IN A SUFFICIENTLY AGITATED MOOD TO IGNITE. ((E ALREADY HAVE SOME REPORTS OF PROVOCATEURS SUGGESTING THAT THE CROWD BURN SHAH REZA'S PALACE, WHICH IS DOUBTLESS PROTECTED BY THE MILITARY.)

IF, ON THE OTHER HAND, KHOMEINI LEADERS FEEL THAT THEY HAVE SECURE GRIP ON ENOUGH KEY PEOPLE TO CONTINUE THE STRIKES IN THE OIL FIELDS, THE BANKING SYSTEM, AND THEBUREAUCRACY,THEY MAY BE PREPARED TO CONCENTRATE ON THAT METHOD OF STRANGULATION RATHER THAN VIOLENT CONFRONTATION ON ASHURA. HOWEVER, SINCE IT HAS BEEN KHOMEINI AND HIS PARIS ACOLYTES WHO HAVE PLACED SO MUCH FOCUS ON ASHURA AS THE CLIMAX OF THEIR STRUGGLE AGAINST THE SHAH, IT WOULD SEEM IMPORTANT TO THEM NOT TO LET THIS OCCASION PASS WITHOUT SOME MORE SUBSTANTIAL DRAMA.
WE WILL REPORT FURTHER AS DAY DEVELOPS. UNFORTUNATELY, EARLY MORNING RAIN HAS ENDED AND CLEAR, MILD WEATHER SEEMS IN STORE FOR THE NEXT TWELVE HOURS OF ASHURA. SULLIVAN

AT END OF THE DAY DECEMBER 10, SEVERAL PRESS SOURCES OBTAINED TEXT OF SEVENTEEN POINT PROGRAM ALLEGEDLY "ENDORSED" BY DEMONSTRATORS DURING SHAHYAD MONUMENT ASSEMBLY. WE HAVE NOT RPT NOT BEEN ABLE TO VERIFY FACTS CONCERNING THIS PROGRAM, WHICH WAS APPARENTLY DISTRIBUTED TO PRESS BY ANTI-SHAH GROUPS. THERE ARE SOME REPORTS THAT IT WAS MERELY DISTRIBUTED DECEMBER 10 AND WILL BE "PROCLAIMED" DECEMBER 11.

FOLLOWING IS SUMMARY OF PROGRAM AS PROVIDED EMBASSY BY LOCAL PRESS REPRESENTATIVE: "1. KHOMEINI IS THE LEADER OVERTHROW OF REGIME ISLAMIC REPUBLIC DEFENSE OF HUMAN RIGHTS ELIMINATION OF MILITARY GOVERNMENT IMPLEMENTATION OF RELIGIOUS DEMANDS WOMEN'S EMANCIPATION FULL WORKERS RIGHTS END MISUSE OF POWER AGRICULTURAL REFORM FULL SUPPORT OF STRIKERS ANTI-POVERTY SHOOTING AT DEMONSTRATORS IS TREASON CLAIMS THAT INTERNATIONAL COMMUNISM IS BEHIND THE MOVEMENT ARE UTTER NONSENSE MORE ON ISLAM RELEASE OF POLITICAL PRISONERS STRUGGLE SHALL CONTINUE."

IT IS NOT CLEAR WHO DREW UP THIS PROGRAM OR WHO SPONSORED IT AT THE DEMONSTRATION. IT HAS THE EARMARKS OF A KHOMEINI TRACT, BUT IS MORE MODERATE ON SEVERAL POINTS THAN THE USUAL KHOMEINI LINE. IT COULD, THEREFORE, EMANATE FROM THE MORE MODERATE OPPOSITION RIDING ON THE KHOMEINI WAVE. SULLIVAN

SUMMARY. DEMONSTRATION, WHICH NEARLY EQUALLED SIZE OFTHAT YESTERDAY, IS COMMENCING TO DISPERSE. TODAY'S SLOGANS ARE VERY POLITICAL--ANTI-SHAH, ANTI-U.S., ETC. LITTLE OR NO VIOLENCE SO FAR. END SUMMARY.

CROWDS, WHICH GATHERED IN VARIOUS PARTS OF CITY EARLIER IN DAY, MERGED ON SHAH REZA AND MOVED TO SHAHYAD MONUMENT, ARE NOW DISPERSING. WE HAVE RECEIVED VARYING REPORTS INDICATING THAT SLOGANS, CHANTS, ETC. TODAY ARE MUCH MORE POLITICALLY (ANTI-SHAH, ANTI-U.S.) ORIENTED THAN YESTERDAY. ON NUMBER OF OCCASIONS, WE HEAR, EXTREMIST PRO-KHOMEINI, PRO-TUDEH GROUPS HAVE ATTEMPTED TO AGITATE CROWDS TO CHALLENGE AUTHORITY BUT MODERATES HAVE REFUSED AND HAVE ATTEMPTED TO CONTROL THE OTHERS. SMALL GROUPS ARE NOW OCCASIONALY PASSING THE EMBASSY BUT THERE HAVE BEEN NO INCIDENTS NOR, AS FAR AS WE KNOW, ELSEWHERE IN CITY.

IN TABRIZ A CROWD ESTIMATED BY CONSUL METRINKO TO BE 70-80,000 MOVED BY CONSULATE LATE MORNING AND EACH SEGMENT STOPPED BRIEFLY TO SHOUT ANTI-U.S. AND OTHER SLOGANS, BUT THEN MOVED ON. ATTEMPTS WERE MADE TO TEAR DOWN CONSULAR SEAL BUT CROWD MARSHALS GENERALLY KEPT GROUPS UNDER CONTROL. OFFER BY MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES TO LIFT METRINKO FROM CONSULATE BY HELICOPTER WAS POLITELY DECLINED AND, WHEN CROWD RETURNED FROM OBSERVANCES AT CEMETERY, THERE WAS LITTLE OR NO TROUBLE. CONSUL HAS NOT RPTNOT RECEIVED ANY INDICATION OF CLASHES BETWEEN SECURITY AUTHORITIES AND DEMONSTRATORS.

IN SHIRAZ, MAIN EVENT WAS AT MOSQUE, BUT CONSUL TOMSETH ESTIMATES ONLY 5,000 ATTENDED. AFTER CHANTING OF SLOGANS GROUP DISPERSED; NO INCIDENTS AND NO VIOLENCE. SAME GENERAL SITUATION HAS PREVAILED IN ISFAHAN.

THERE ARE BELATED REPORTS THAT SOME CLASHES OCCURRED IN MASHAD LAST EVENING BUT WE HAVE NO INFORMATION ON HOW SERIOUS THEY WERE. THE GOVERNOR OF HAMADAN WAS WOUNDED YESTERDAY AND HIS DRIVER KILLED. AP REPORTS THAT THIS WAS A TERRORIST ACTION BUT MILITARY SOURCES HERE STATE A SOLDIER, WHO LATER COMMITTED SUICIDE

1978TEHRAN12102.subject: SECURITY/POLITICAL SITUATION REPORT, 12-11-78 - TEL RELEASED IN PART TO HOUSE JUDICIARY COMMITTEE 2-1980 - SEE MEMO FROM A:JAMES MCDONNELL TO FADRC DATED 2-29-80 (P800032-1357- EXCISED COPY ATTACHED)

segments.text: AS OF 1800, SITUATION IN TEHRAN IS GENERALLY QUIET.

WE HAVE NUMBER OF REPORTS THAT LEFT AND KHOMEINI FORCES IRRITATED AND FRUSTRATED BY PEACEABLE NATURE OF DEMONSTRATIONS DEC. 1011 ANDARE URGING THIRD DAY OF ACTION FOR DEC. 12 IN HOPE OF CAUSING CONFRONTATION. SAME SOURCES HAVE TOLD US THAT LEADING CLERGY FIGURES HAVE DISASSOCIATED THEMSELVES FROM THIS CALL TO ACTION AND ARE PARTICULARLY ANNOYED BY ATTEMPT OF EXTREME LEFT TO STIR UP VIOLENCE.

AMBASSADOR ZAHEDI TOLD AMBASSADOR THAT HE DOUBTS EXTREMISTS WILL BE ABLE TO GET MUCH GOING ON DEC. 12. HE ALSO SAID THAT AFTER CURFEW TONIGHT THE MILITARY FORCES WILL MOVE BACK INTO THEIR NORMAL PLACES IN THE CITY. MILITARY SOURCE HAS CONFIRMED THAT THIS IS CURRENT INTENTION OF MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES.
EMBASSY WILL BE OPEN DEC. 12. WE ARE ISSUING FOLLOWING ADVISORY TO AMERICAN COMMUNITY: "A. TODAY'S DEMONSTRATIONS WERE PEACEFUL, BUT TENSIONS ARE HIGH.
THERE MAY BE MORE POLITICAL ACTIVITY TOMORROW.
EXERCISE EXTREME CAUTION IN ANY MOVEMENT OUTSIDE YOUR RESIDENCES DURING COURSE OF THE DAY TOMORROW." SULLIVAN
OUR 1800 SITREP DID NOT HAVE BENEFIT LATE REPORT FROM ISFAHAN.

WHEN MARCH OF ROUGHLY 100,000 PEOPLE DISPERSED 1530-1600 SCATTERED VIOLENCE TOOK PLACE, INCLUDING PULLING DOWN OF STATUES OF REZA SHAH AND SHAH. SEQUENCE OF EVENTS AFTER THAT IS NOT FULLY CLEAR BUT THERE WAS OCCASIONAL SHOOTING AND ATTACK ON SAVAK HDQS AND POLICE STATION ON PAHLAVI AVENUE (EAST OF CHARLBAGH CIRCLE). APARTMENT BUILDING IN SAME AREA INHABITED BY AMERICAN AND GERMAN EMPLOYEES OF FLUOR COMPANY WAS ATTACKED BY STONES--ALL WINDOWS BROKEN. MILITARY ARRIVED, OPENED HEAVY FIRE AND DROVE OFF CROWD. A NUMBER OF CASUALTIES CAN BE SEEN IN THE STREET, AND OTHER DEMONSTRATORS WERE FORCED TO JUMP INTO RIVER. NO AMERICANS OR GERMANS HURT, ACCORDING TO CONSUL.
AT THIS TIME THERE ARE NUMEROUS FIRES ON CHAHRBAGH, AND IN TWO OTHER AREAS OF CITY, EXPLOSIIONS OF UNKNOWN ORIGIN IN VARIED PLACES, AND CONSIDERABLE FIRING.
SEVEN SOLDIERS WITH AUTOMATIC WEAPONS HAVE MOVED INSIDE CONSULATE GROUNDS AND HAVE SET UP FIRING POSITIONS FROM ROOF AND GARDEN. CONSUL MCGAFFEY WILL KEEP US INFORMED.

1978TEHRAN12110.subject: ECONOMIC SITUATION IN IRAN AFTER ASHURA

segments.text: NOW THAT IRANIAN GOVT (AND THE SHAH) HAVE WEATHERED THE TEST OF ASHURA, THEY MUST TURN TO THE LESS DRAMATIC, BUT PERHAPS MORE CRITICAL, PROBLEM OF THE NATIONAL ECONOMY. IN PRINCIPLE, THE FOUR DAY HOLIDAY IS OVER DECEMBER 12 AND THE COUNTRY SHOULD GO BACK TO WORK.

SINCE THERE WAS MUCH TALK AMONG THE DEMONSTRATORS DECEMBER 11 OF CONTINUING THE PROTEST ACTIONS, IT MAY BE POSSIBLE THAT THE POLTICAL TURMOIL OF THE PAST TWO DAYS OF DEEP MOURNING WILL BE CONTINUED. IF SO, THE CHANCES OF ANY RETURN TO NORMAL ECONOMIC ACTIVITY WILL BE MINIMAL IN THE IMMEDIATE FUTURE.

IF NOT, AND IF PEOPLE IN GENERAL RETURN TO THEIR WORKPLACES, IT WILL THEN BECOME IMPORTANT TO SEE WHETHER THEY CONSIDERED THEIR STRIKE ACTIONS TO EXPIRE WITH ASURA, OR WHETHER THE EVENTS OF DECEMBER 10 AND 11 HAVE MERELY SERVED TO INSPIRE THEM TO MORE EFFECTIVE STRIKE ACTION.

IT IS INTERESTING TO NOTE THAT, DURING DECEMBER 10 AND 11, THERE WERE NO RPT NO REPORTED POWER OUTAGES IN TEHRAN. TELEX AND TELEPHONE SERVICES SEEM TO HAVE BEEN NORMAL. THERE WERE ALSO NO RPT NO APPARENT RUNS ON GASOLINE STATIONS OR OTHER EVIDENCE OF THE CRITICAL SHORTAGES WHICH HANG OVER THIS CITY. HOWEVER, ONCE AN EFFORT AT NORMAL ECONOMIC ACTIVITY RESUMES, WE WOULD EXPECT THOSE ELEMENTS TO MANIFEST THEMSELVES.

THE CRITICAL AREAS WILL, OF COURSE, BE OIL PRODUCTION, TRANSPORTATION, COMMUNICATIONS, BANKING, AND THE BUREAUCRACY. WE HAVE ALREADY REPORTED THE PROSPECT THAT OIL WORKERS WILL REMAIN ON STRIKE UNTIL NEXT WEEKEND. IT IS UNCLEAR WHETHER IRAN AIR AND OTHER AIRPORT SERVICES WILL RESUME ON DECEMBER 12 AS PROMISED. (MEHRABAD AIRPORT IS SCHEDULED TO OPEN AT 10 AM AND WE WILL CHECK FURTHER AT THAT TIME.) BANKING AND THE BUREAUCRACY MAY BE PARTICULARLY HARD TO STIMULATE. THE OPERATIONS OF ELECTRIC POWER AND TELECOMMUNICATIONS WOULD SEEM TO DEPEND ON THE WHIMS OF THE ANTI-SHAH PROTESTERS.

IF THE SHAH'S GAME PLAN PROVES CORRECT, THE IRANIAN PRODUCTIVE FORCE WILL RESUME ITS ACTIVITY BECAUSE KHOMEINI HAS FAILED IN HIS THREAT TO OUST THE SHAH AT ASHURA. IF OUR MORE DIRE PREDICTIONS ARE ACCURATE, WE EXPECT THE ECONOMIC CRISIS TO DEEPEN AND PRODUCTIVE ACTIVITY TO REMAIN DANGEROUSLY LOW, EVEN IF THERE MAY BE SOME OCCASIONAL RESTORATION, AS THERE WAS EARLIER IN THE OIL FIELDS.

WE WOULD EXPECT KHOMEINI, HAVING FAILED IN THIS PROCLAIMED GOAL OF OVERTHROWING THE SHAH AT ASHURA, TO CONCENTRATE HIS ATTENTION EVEN MORE AVIDLY UPON THE STRIKE ACTION. IT IS THEREFORE THIS SECTOR OF THE POLITICAL STRUGGLE WHICH WILL BECOME MORE CENTRAL FOR THE REMAINDER OF THE MONTH OF DECEMBER.
APPRECIATE REPLY REFTEL. SULLIVAN

MFA DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR ASIA AND AFRICA SANANDAJI TOLD POL COUNSELOR DECEMBER 12 THAT IRANIAN ARMY J-2 AS WELL AS GOVERNOR-GENERAL OF REZAIYEH HAVE CONFIRMED DISTRIBUTION OF ARMS TO MANY KURDS IS TAKING PLACE IN KURDISTAN. THEY BELIEVE TWO ROUTES PROBABLY IN USE: FROM THE SOUTH, PERHAPS FROM LIBYA, AND THROUGH TURKEY, FROM SOVIET/EAST EUROPEAN SOURCES.
SANANDAJI WAS AUTHORIZED TO APPROACH TURKISH GOVT ON THIS. HE SENT MESSAGE OF INSTRUCTIONS TO IRANIAN AMBASSADOR IN ANKARA DECEMBER 5 AND SPOKE TO TURKISH AMBASSADOR HERE DECEMBER 6.

SANANDAJI FEARS REVIVAL OF KURDISH SEPARATISM, WITH SOVIET ENCOURAGEMENT. HE NOTES SCHOOL CHILDREN IN SHAHPOR HIGH SCHOOL SANG KURDISH REPUBLIC'S NATIONAL ANTHEM ONE DAY NOT LONG AGO. HE HAS RECEIVED OTHER REPORTS OF SUCH KURDISH NATIONALIST MANIFESTATIONS.
SANANDAJI HIMSELF (WHO IS KURD) PLANS TRIP TO AREA FOR FIRST-HAND INVESTIGATION LATER THIS MONTH.
AS EMBASSY HAS MADE CLEAR ELSEWHERE, WE HAVE NO INDEPENDENT CONFIRMATION OF THIS INFORMATION.
NEXT TIME DEPARTMENT OFFICER HAS OCCASION TALK TO BARZANI WOULD BE INTERESTED IN WHAT HE HAS TO SAY ON THIS.

1978TEHRAN12140.subject: CIVIL AVIATION: RESUMPTION OF NORMAL OPERATIONS

segments.text: MEHRABAD AIRPORT, TEHRAN, OPENED AT 1000 HOURS, DECEMBER 12, AS SCHEDULED. IRAN AIR FLIGHTS BEGAN OPERATING IMMEDIATELY AND WERE SOON BACK TO NORMAL. FOREIGN AIRLINES BEGAN PHASING IN SERVICES IMMEDIATELY, BUT ARE NOT EXPECTED TO BE BACK TO NORMAL BEFORE DECEMBER 13. PANAM PLANS TO HAVE ITS "ROUND THE WORLD" FLIGHTS, 001 AND 002, LAND IN TEHRAN ON DECEMBER 13, BUT FLIGHT 111 IS STILL IN DOUBT. A SPECIAL PANAM 707 WILL DEPART MEHRABAD TONIGHT AT 1900 HOURS FOR ISTANBUL.

AIRPORT GROUND AND OTHER SERVICES APPEAR TO BE FUNCTIONING NORMALLY, WITH NO APPARENT SHORTAGE OF AVIATION FUEL OR GASOLINE FOR GROUND OPERATIONS. AIRPORT CUSTOMS REMAINS ON "STRIKE", AS BEFORE, BUT IS PROCESSING PASSENGERS AND RECEIVING (NOT CLEARING) CARGO. SULLIVAN

METRINKO VISITED ILAM, SANANDAJ, KERMANSHAH AND SONGHOR. HIS KURDISH CONTACTS SAID THEY KNEW OF NO ARMS SHIPMENTS COMING IN, DESPITE SOME OFFICIAL ANNOUNCEMENTS THAT SOME HAD BEEN FOUND NEAR REZAIYEH. IN FACT, THE COST OF ARMS TO KURDS HAD NEARLY TRIPLED BECAUSE OF THE DEMAND FOR WEAPONS WITHIN IRAN,AND KURDISH CROSS BORDER OPERATIONS INTO IRAQ HAVE REMAINED LIMITED.
MOST KURDISH LEADERS METRINKO TALKED TO DISLIKE THE PRESENT GOI. THERE HAVE BEEN RATHER BAD CLASHES IN MAHABAD AND SANANDAJ WHICH HAVE INVOLVED KURDS ON THE SIDE OF THOSE AGAINST THE GOI.
METRINKO NOTES HIS CONTACTS WERE MORE LIMITED THAN ON OTHER VISITS, BUT OFFERS ABOVE FOR WHAT IT IS WORTH.
ON OTHER HAND SEE SEPTEL TODAY FOR DIFFERENT REPORT.

1978TEHRAN12145.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT, DEC 12 SUMMARY: NO SERIOUS DISTURBANCES IN TEHRAN APART FROM SOME ANTI-FOREIGN INCIDENTS. MODERATES KEPT MAIN

segments.text: SUMMARY: NO SERIOUS DISTURBANCES IN TEHRAN APART FROM SOME ANTI-FOREIGN INCIDENTS. MODERATES KEPT MAIN CROWD UNDER CONTROL. LARGE CROWD IN TABRIZ WROTE ANTI-AMERICAN SLOGANS ON CONSULATE BUT DID LITTLE DAMAGE.SERIOUS TROUBLE IN ISFAHAN WITH MANY FIRES AND HEAVY DESTRUCTION. STANDARD MARTIAL REGULATIONS BACK IN EFFECT, WITH MUCH TALK OF CRACKDOWN. POLITICAL MANUEVERING CONTINUES AMID ATMOSPHERE OF RELIEF THAT ASHURA DID NOT BRING BLOODBATH. END SUMMARY

SECOND DAY OF MASSIVE DEMONSTRATIONS IN TEHRAN PASSED WITHOUT SERIOUS VIOLENCE. TRADITIONAL ASHURA CEREMONIES DID NOT FIGURE HIGHLY IN DEMONSTRATION WHICH WAS ALMOST ENTIRELY POLITICAL. MARCH WAS WELL ORGANIZED AND PEACEFUL. CROWD APPROVED 17-POINT MANIFESTO HAVE REPORTS OF FRICTION BETWEEN MAIN CROWD AND SUBGROUPS WHICH ATTEMPTED TO ENTER SHAHREZA MARCH WITH MARXIST BANNERS. CROWD REPORTEDLY REPELLED THEM. AFTER MASSIVE RALLY AT SHAHYAD MONUMENT, CROWD DISPERSED WITHOUT INCIDENT. IN AMERICAN COMMUNITY, HOWEVER, LAST NIGHT ANOTHER AUTOMOBILE WAS FIREBOMBED. SOMEONE ALSO THREW PIPEBOMB INTO THIRD FLOOR APARTMENT OF LOGISTICS SUPPORT CORP EMPLOYEE, WHERE IT EXPLODED BUT CAUSED NO INJURY.

CROWDS IN PROVINCES WERE LESS PEACEFUL. CONSULATE TABRIZ REPORTS ABOUT 100,000 PEOPLE MARCHED PAST CONSULATE, STOPPING LONG ENOUGH TO COVER WALLS WITH SLOGANS: "KILL AMERICANS," "DEATH TO IMPERIALIST AMERICANS," AND THE LIKE. DEMONSTRATORS TRIED TO TEAR SIGN OFF CONSULATE BUILDING BUT FAILED. CONSULATE SHIRAZ REPORTS NO TROUBLE YESTERDAY OR TODAY. MASHAD HAD VIOLENCE DEC 10 AS GROUP ENTERED HYATT HOTEL AND LOOTED BAR AND SEVERAL SHOPS. (HYATT IS ONE OF FEW PROPERTIES NOT OWNED BY RELIGIOUS ORGANIZATION AND ONLY PLACE WHERE LIQUOR WAS SERVED.) ISFAHAN BECAME SHAMBLES YESTERDAY AS RIOTERS BURNED AND LOOTED.

CONSULATE REPORTS THAT AS MASSIVE DEMONSTRATION WAS DISPERSING ABOUT 1530, GROUPS BEGAN TO ATTACK STANDARD TARGETS OF BANKS, CINEMAS, HOTELS AND RESTAURANTS. TROOPS WHO HAD GIVEN THE FIELD TO DEMONSTRATORS, AS IN TEHRAN, MOVED IN BUT COULD NOT PREVENT LARGE SCALE DESTRUCTION. CROWDS PULLED DOWN STATUES OF SHAH AND REZA SHAH, AND ATTACKED SEVERAL GOVT BUILDINGS, INCLUDING SAVAK HEADQUARTERS. WE HAVE CONFLICTING REPORTS REGARDING DAMAGE TO SAVAK BUILDING, BUT AT LEAST TWO CITY HALL BUILDINGS WERE TOTALLY DESTROYED. EYEWITNESSES REPORT HEAVY DAMAGE TO TWO TCI BUILDINGS, 5 BANKS, 8 LIQUOR STORES AND 4 CINEMAS. SCENE RESEMBLED NOV 5 IN TEHRAN, EXCEPT THAT ARMY DID NOT MERELY LET IT HAPPEN.

TROOPS DEFINITELY FIRED INTO MOB AT SOME LOCATIONS. FOR EXAMPLE, AMCIT FAMILY WHOSE APARTMENT IS LOCATED IN SAME BUILDING AS CHINESE RESTAURANT CALLED FOR ASSISTANCE WHEN MOB ATTACKED RESTAURANT. TROOPS ARRIVED AND FIRED ON CROWD CAUSING UNDETERMINED NUMBER OF CASUALTIES. MLA ANNOUNCED 2115 THAT CITY WATER SUPPLY HAD BEEN POISONED, CAUSING PANIQ, BUT MLA THEN ANNOUNCED AT 2215 WATER SUPPLY WAS BACK TO NORMAL. LAST NIGHT GENERAL NAJI, MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR FOR ISFAHAN, WENT ON TELEVISION TO APPEAL FOR PEACE AND TO WARN THAT TROOPS WILL HENCEFORTH DEAL SEVERLY WITH DISORDER.

NAJI CLAIMED TO "SEE FOREIGNERS HIDDEN BEHIND THESE ACTIONS," AND PLEDGED "ARMY WILL STAND TO LAST DROP OF BLOOD TO DEFEND LAW AND ORDER IN IRAN." UNREST APPARENTLY CONTINUES, AS GUNFIRE IS HEARD THIS MORNING IN ISFAHAN. ------------------108725 121724Z /41 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 2163 INFO USINT BAGHDAD AMCONSUL DHAHRAN USLO PEKING AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY BONN AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY TOKYO USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC SECTION 02 OF 03 TEHRAN 12145 AS HAS GENERALLY BEEN THE PATTERN, DESTRUCTIVE MOBS EXHIBITED RELATIVE RESTRAINT TOWARD PEOPLE, WHOM THEY ALLOWED TO ESCAPE UNHARMED FROM BUILDINGS WHICH THEY WERE DESTROYING.
THERE ARE NO RPT NO REPORTS OF INJURIES TO AMCITS.

ISFAHAN EXCEPTED, COUNTRY SEEMS TO HAVE RETURNED TO NORMAL TODAY, "NORMAL" MEANING STANDARD CURFEW, TROOPS STATIONED THROUGHOUT CITY, POWER OUTAGES (ANOTHER STRUCK PART OF TEHRAN THIS MORNING) AND SHOP CLOSURES. MOST SHOPS IN NORTH AND CENTRAL TEHRAN ARE, HOWEVER, OPEN TODAY, AND GOVT HAS ANNOUNCED PRIMARY SCHOOLS IN TEHRAN AND SUBURBS WILL REOPEN TOMORROW. AIRPORT HAS RESUMED NORMAL SERVICE, AND PAN AM WILL RESTORE TWO FLIGHTS/DAY STARTING TOMORROW. DESPITE TALK OF JET FUEL SHORTAGE, PAN AM STATES ADEQUATE SUPPLIES ARE AVAILABLE. THERE ARE NO DISTURBANCES REPORTED TO EARLY AFTERNOON IN TEHRAN.

SHAH TOOK ADVANTAGE OF HUMAN RIGHTS DAY, DEC 10, TO SEND MESSAGE TO NATION, AVOIDING SELFPPRAISE AND OFFERING GENERALLY-WORDED APPEAL FOR ADVANCEMENT OF HUMAN RIGHTS. AMNESTY INTERNATIONAL HAS RESPONDED WITH CRITICISM OF IRAN'S HUMAN RIGHTS RECORD.

ALL PARTIES ARE BUSILY ASSESSING SIGNIFICANCE OF BLOODLESS DEMONSTRATIONS DEC 10-11. MODERATE PROPONENTS OF REGIME AND OPPOSITION ALL CLAIM VICTORY, ARGUING EITHER THAT REGIME MADE MAJOR CONCESSION OR THAT KHOMEINI EXTREMISTS HAVE BEEN UNDERCUT. EVIDENCE DOES INDICATE EXTREME OPPOSITION WANTED BLOOD AND STILL SEEKS IT. PAMPHLETS DISTRIBUTED IN ISFAHAN CITE TODAY AS BEGINNING OF THE FINAL BATTLE. LEAFLET ALSO ORDERS GENERAL STRIKE TO BEGIN TODAY. THERE IS MUCH TALK THAT EXTREMISTS WILL TAKE TO STREETS AGAIN, THIS TIME TO PROVOKE VIOLENT REACTION.

ON REGIME SIDE, HARDLINERS ARE CALLING FOR FIRM CRACKDOWN. IRANIAN PRESS SOURCE TOLD EMBOFF THAT GENERAL OVEISI, MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR FOR TEHRAN, PLANS STERN MILITARY ACTION TO PREVENT DEMONSTRATIONS AND END STRIKES. OTHER SOURCES TEND TO CONFIRM THIS INFORMATION. FORCES OF ORDER ARE UPSET, DESPITE PEACEFUL TURN OF EVENTS IN TEHRAN, BU THE VIOLENCE IN MASHAD AND ISFAHAN. LATE REPORT FROM CONSULATE ISFAHAN INDICATES TROOPS HAVE ALREADY REACTED STRONGLY. OFFICERS SAY DEMONSTRATORS VIOLATED AGREEMENT TO REFRAIN FROM VIOLENCE. THEY ARE TELLING TROOPS THAT TRUE MOSLEMS COULD NOT HAVE DONE THIS, IMPLYING MILITARY MUST DEFEND THE FAITH AGAINST SUBVERSIVES.

EYEWITNESSES REPORT COUNTERVIOLENCE TODAY, WITH TROOPS SMASHING SHOPS WHICH DISPLAY KHOMEINI'S PICTURE. TROOPS HAVE BLOCKED CITY'S BRIDGES AND ARE APPARENTLY ENGAGED IN WHOLESALE PUNISHMENT OF THOSE WHO FAILED TO KEEP THE BARGAIN.

POLITICAL MANUEVERING IS IN HIGH GEAR. WE HAVE AUTHORITATIVE REPORTS OF MOVES TOWARD THIS OR THAT COALITION GOVT, BUT ALL PLANS HAVE SO FAR FOUNDERED ON QUESTION OF SHAH'S ROLE VIS-A-VIS ARMED FORCES.

CONSUL TOMSETH IN SHIRAZ REPORTS MUNICIPAL EMPLOYEES HAVE GONE ON STRIKE, INCLUDING GARBAGE COLLECTORS. IN AHWAZ TWO POLICEMEN REPORTEDLY KILLED LAST FRIDAY BY SHOTS COMING FROM MOB THEY WERE TRYING TO QUIET. ALSO FRIDAY, MOB BROKE INTO (AMERICAN) PARSONS CO. OFFICES AND WRECKED FURNITURE, POURING KEROSENE OVER THINGS BUT FOR SOME REASON NOT LIGHTING IT. DAMAGE DISCOVERED YESTERDAY. SITUATION GENERALLY QUIET IN KHORAMSHAHR, ABADAN, BANDAR ABBAS.

1978TEHRAN12153.subject: MORE ON AUDIENCE WITH SHAH, DECEMBER 12

segments.text: DURING AUDIENCE WITH SHAH DECEMBER 12 REPORTED SEPTEL, I ASKED ABOUT REPORTS WHICH INDICATED THAT A SOLDIER OF THE IMPERIAL GUARD HAD KILLED SOME OFFICERS. HE SAID THEY WERE TRUE.

AS HE DESCRIBED IT, TWO GUARDSMEN WITH AUTOMATIC WEAPONS ENTERED THE OFFICER'S MESS AT LUNCH TIME DECEMBER 11 FROM OPPOSITE DOORS AND BEGAN TO FIRE AT THE OFFICERS. THE OFFICERS DREW THEIR SIDE-ARMS AND, IN THE SHOOT-OUT, TWELVE PEOPLE WERE KILLED AND ABOUT FORTY WOUNDED. FOUR OF THE BEAD WERE OFFICERS, THE REST ENLISTED PERSONNEL FROM THE MESS WHO GOT CAUGHT IN THE CROSS-FIRE, PLUS THE TWO PERPETRATORS.

I ALSO ASKED ABOUT THE SHOOTING OF THE GOVERNOR GENERAL IN HAMADAN. HE SAID HE FOUND THAT VERY STRANGE. THE GOVERNOR GENERAL WAS SUPERFICIALLY WOUNDED, HIS DRIVER WAS KILLED AND THE "TERRORIST" WHO WAS A GENDARMERIE PRIVATE COMMITTED SUICIDE. SOMETHING DIDN'T RING TRUE IN THE STORY, SO HE ACCEPTED IT WITH GREAT RESERVATION.

I SAID I FOUND THE IMPERIAL GUARD STORY VERY DISTURBING. HE AGREED AND SAIDITINDICATED NEED FOR EARLY RESOLUTION OF THE CRISIS. HE DID NOT KNOW HOW MANY OTHERS WOULD HEED KHOMEINI'S CALL. I ASKED IF THERE WERE MANY DESERTIONS FROM THE MILITARY. HE SAID THERE WERE A FEW. I ASKED IF THEY TOOK THEIR WEAPONS WITH THEM. HE SAID SOME OF THEM DID.
NOT GOOD.
COMMENT: I WANT DISTRIBUTION OF THIS MESSAGE TIGHTLY CONTROLLED, THE INFORELD NOT SHARED AT THIS TIME WITH OTHER GOVERNMENTS AND NO REFERENCE TO THE INCIDENT IN SITREPS ORIGINATED BY DEPT. SULLIVAN
I SPENT LONG SOMBER SESSION WITH THE SHAH EVENING DECEMBER 12. I STARTED BY ASKING HOW HE EVALUATED EVENTS OF PAST TWO DAYS.

HE SAID HE WAS NOT QUITE SURE, BUT THEY SEEMED TO INDICATE THAT KHOMEINI COMMANDED ENORMOUS POWER. HE HAD THOUGHT THAT PEOPLE WERE GETTING TIRED OF HIM, BUT ALL THE BANNERS AND ALL THE SLOGANS SEEMED TO NAME HIM AS THE ONLY LEADER. HE ASKED ME HOW I SAW IT.

I SAID THAT MY EVALUATION WAS SOMEWHAT MORE SANGUINE. I THOUGHT THE MOST SIGNIFICANT THING WAS THAT AN AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE GOVT AND THE OPPOSITION HAD BEEN CARRIED OUT WITH GOOD FAITH ON BOTH SIDES. I THOUGHT THIS WAS A FOUNDATION ON WHICH TO BUILD. IT SUGGESTED THAT THE GREAT MASS OF THE OPPOSITION WANTED A COMPROMISE RATHER THAN A BLOODY CONFRONTATION.

SHAH SAID, OF COURSE, HE WAS TRYING TO REACH A COMPROMISE. HE HAD ALREADY TALKED WITH BAKHTIAR AND SADIQI, BOTH OF WHOM WERE PREPARED TO FORM A COALITION GOVT. BUT NEITHER OF THEM HAD ANY FOLLOWING. HE HAD ARRANGED, "IN THESE NEXT FEW DAYS," TO MEET WITH SANJABI. HOWEVER, SANJABI HAD LET IT BE KNOWN THAT HE WOULD DEMAND THE SHAH'S DEPARTURE. SANJABI HAD SAID THAT NO GOVT COULD BE FORMED WITHOUT THE SUPPORT OF KHOMEINI AND THAT WAS KHOMEINI'S DEMAND.

I SUGGESTED SHAH LOOK AT THE SANJABI SITUATION A LITTLE MORE POSITIVELY. FIRST, HE WAS COMING TO SEE HIM. THAT MEANT HE WAS WILLING TO NEGOTIATE. SECOND, A CAREFUL READING OF HIS STATEMENTS ABOUT THE "ILLEGAL MONARCHY" INDICATED THAT THERE MUST BE A "LEGAL MONARCHY," AND THAT, AS A LAWYER, HE MUST MEAN THAT THE CONSTITUTION IS THE MEASURE OF LEGALITY. FINALLY, I SAID THAT SANJABI'S OPENING STATEMENT WOULD OBVIOUSLY BE HIS BARGAINING POSITION AND THAT SHAH SHOULD BARGAIN WITH HIM.

THE IDEA OF BARGAINING WITH ONE OF HIS SUBJECTS SEEMED TO STRIKE THE SHAH AS RATHER NOVEL, BUT HE DID NOT REALLY SHIRK IT. INSTEAD, HE WENT AHEAD TO LIST HIS OPTIONS, AS HE NOW SAW THEM. - (A) TO PERSEVERE WITH THE EFFORT TO FORM A NATIONAL COALITION AND TO SUCCEED IN GETTING A GROUP WHICH HOULD HAVE THE COURAGE AND THE COMPETENCE TO RUN A GOVT; - (B) TO "SURRENDER" TO OPPOSITION DEMANDS AND LEAVE THE COUNTRY TO CHAOS AND A REGENCY COUNCIL; - (C) TO FORM A "MILITARY JUNTA" WHICH WOULD APPLY AN "IRON FIST" POLICY AND BEAT THE PERSIANS BACK TO THEIR CAGES.
(HE SAID THE MILITARY WERE RECOMMENDING THIS.)

HE SAID A SURRENDER TO KHOMEINI WOULD DOUBTLESS MEAN THE DISINTEGRATION OF THE ARMED FORCES AND A SITUATION WHICH COULD BE EXPLOITED BY TUDEH FOR THE ULTIMATE DISINTEGRATION OF IRAN. AN "IRON FIST" POLICY COULD NEVER BE EXECUTED BY A KING. BUT, IF HE TURNED THE TASK OVER TO A MILITARY JUNTA, THEY WOULD PROBABLY SOON BEGIN TO HAVE THEIR OWN COUPS AND COUNTER-COUPS, WHICH WOULD ALSO LEAD TO THE DISINTEGRATION OF IRAN. HE ASKED WHAT I THOUGHT.

I SAID I SAW VERY LITTLE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN (B) AND (C), SINCE I AGREED THEY WOULD BOTH END UP IN THE SAME PLACE. I THOUGHT COURSE (A) WAS THE ONLY LOGICAL ONE TO FOLLOW AS FAR AS AN ULTIMATE POLITICAL SOLUTION WAS CONCERNED. BUT IT CLEARLY NEEDED TO BE SUPPLEMENTED BY ACTION TO GET THE COUNTRY BACK TO PRODUCTION AGAIN. I THOUGHT THAT COULD BE DONE WITHOUT RESORT TO THE "IRON FIST." IT NEEDED SOME SOUND, COURAGEOUS ADMINISTRATIVE LEADERSHIP.

I POINTED OUT THAT IRAN AIR, TELECOMMUNICATIONS, AND ELECTRIC POWER WERE ALL WORKING BECAUSE THEY HAD GOOD LEADERSHIP. ON THE OTHER HAND NIOC, THE CENTRAL BANK AND THE MINISTRY OF FINANCE WERE FLOUNDERING. I THOUGHT IT WAS HIGH TIME A NEW CHAIRMAN OF NIOC CAS NAMED. I THOUGHT HE OUGHT TO TAKE A LOOK AT THE CENTRAL BANK, AND I FELT IT WAS TIME SOMEONE SHAPED UP THE MINISTRY OF FINANCE.

HE SAID MEHRAN ASSURED HIM THAT FINANCE WOULD BEGIN WORK ON SATURDAY, DECEMBER 16. AS FOR NIOC, HE AGREED THAT A NEW CHAIRMAN WAS NEEDED AND HE MENTIONED EITHER MINA OR NABEGH. HE SAID HE WAS UNFAMILIAR WITH THE ------------------117582 130845Z /17 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 2171 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 12154 EXDIS (HANDLE AS NODIS) SITUATION AT THE CENTRAL BANK.

ON THE OTHER SIDE OF THE COIN, I SAID THAT THE POLITICAL NEGOTIATIONS SEEMED STERILE BECAUSE NOBODY BELIEVED HE WAS PREPARED TO ACCEPT A CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCHY. THEY ALL THOUGHT HE WANTED TO TRAP THEM INTO A GOVT AND THEN GO BACK TO HIS IMPERIAL WAYS. I SAID THAT I HAPPENED TO BELIEVE HE WAS SINCERE, BUT I WAS ALMOST ALONE IN THAT BELIEF. HE NEEDED TO MAKE THE CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCHY POINT OVER AND OVER AGAIN IN ORDER TO CONVINCE PEOPLE THERE WAS A COMPROMISE AVAILABLE.

HE SAID THE SAME WAS TRUE IN REVERSE. IF THE NATIONAL FRONT DIDN'T TRUST HIM, WHY SHOULD HE TRUST THE NATIONAL FRONT? HOW DID HE KNOW SANJABI, FOR EXAMPLE, WOULDN'T TAKE THE JOB AND THEN DOUBLE-CROSS HIM? I SAID HE HAD THE ARMED FORCES, FOR ONE THING, BUT SUGGESTED HE COULD FORM A COUNCIL OF NOTABLES, WHO WOULD ACT AS GUARANTOR FOR WHATEVER AGREEMENT WAS REACHED. HE ASKED WHAT LEGAL POSITION THEY WOULD HAVE UNDER THE CONSTITUTION. I SAID THEY DIDN'T NEED ANY, IF THEY WERE TRUSTED BY BOTH SIDES, THEY COULD JUST BE WITNESSES, WHO WOULD BE PREPARED TO DENOUNCE VIOLATORS.
HE SAID HE WOULD BUY THAT, BUT WOULD THE OPPOSITION? I SUGGESTED HE ASK SANJABI.

I SAID I THOUGHT ARDESHIR ZAHEDI WAS DOING A GOOD JOB IN STIRRING UP ACTIVITY. HE SAID THE TROUBLE WITH ARDESHIR WAS THAT HE WANTED TO RESTORE THINGS THE WAY THEY WERE. HE COULDN'T UNDERSTAND THAT THE MONARCHY HAD TO CHANGE, AND ACCEPT A REDUCED ROLE. HE SAID ZAHEDI HAD WANTED HIM TO MEET ME JOINTLY WITH HIM. IF HE HAD AGREED, WE COULDN'T TALK LIKE THIS BECAUSE ZAHEDI WOULD BE "KISSING MY HAND IN PROTEST" EVERY TIME I SUGGESTED SOME COMPROMISE WITH THE OPPOSITION.

(THIS IS AN INTERESTING OBSERVATION BECAUSE ZAHEDI IS QUITE WILLING TO TALK WITH ME ABOUT COMPROMISE, BUT OBVIOUSLY UNABLE TO PUT IT STRAIGHT TO THE SHAH. THIS MAY BE WHY ZAHEDI WANTED TO HAVE A JOINT AUDIENCE TO LET ME SAY THE UNSAYABLE.)

IN VIEW OF ZAHEDI'S ENERGY, I SAID HE OUGHT TO BE TURNED LOOSE ON GETTING THE BUREAUCRACY IN SHAPE. HE SHRUGGED, BUT DIDN'T REJECT THE SUGGESTION. HE DID AGREE THAT MORE ATTENTION NEEDED TO BE PAID TO THAT PROBLEM.

TURNING TO EVENTS OF THE LAST TWO DAYS, I SAID THAT ISFAHAN LOOKED A LITTLE MESSY. HOWEVER, I THOUGHT THE MILITARY MIGHT BE EXPERIMENTING WITH THE "IRON FIST" POLICY THERE. I DESCRIBED REPORTS FROM OUR CONSUL ABOUT THEIR SWEEP THROUGH TOWN ON MORNING OF DECEMBER 12 AND THEIR EFFORT TO RETALIATE AGAINST THOSE WHO WERE OVERTLY PROKHOMEINI. HE WAS FASCINATED BY THIS RECITAL SINCE HE HAD OBVIOUSLY NOT HEARD IT FROM HIS OWN MILITARY. HE SAID HE WOULD HAVE TO EXAMINE WHETHER IT WOULD REALLY SUCCEED.

IN CLOSING, I EXPRESSED VIEW THAT STEADY, CONSISTENT AND SELF-CONFIDENT DEMEANOR ON PART OF GOVT AND HIMSELF WOULD BRING THE OPPOSITION INTO REALISTIC COMPROMISE. I THOUGHT THEY HAD NO STOMACH FOR KHOMEINI'S PRESCRIPTION OF MARTYRDOM AND WOULD WELCOME SOME WAY OUT OF THEIR CURRENT CONFRONTATION. IF THEY THOUGHT HE WOULD SURRENDER, THEY WOULD NEVER GIVE UP. BUT IF THEY BECAME CONVINCED THAT HE WAS BOTH STEADFAST AND PREPARED TO BECOME A CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCH, I THOUGHT THEY WOULD COME TO TERMS, KHOMEINI TO THE CONTRARY NOTWITHSTANDING. HE SEEMED A LITTLE BRACED BY THIS STATEMENT AND, AS WE PARTED, SAID HE WOULD GET IN TOUCH AFTER HE HAD SEEN SANJABI.

REFS A AND B GIVE OPPOSITION VIEW OF REGENCY COUNCIL PROPOSAL IN CONTEXT. THIS IS BASED ON ARTICLE 38 OF SUPPLEMENTARY CONSITUTIONAL LAW, AS AMENDED SEPT 9, 1967, QUOTED IN ITS ENTIRELY BELOW: - IN THE EVENT OF THE TRANSFER OF THE THRONE, THE CROWN PRINCE SHALL PERSONALLY PERFORM THE FUNCTIONS OF MONARCH WHEN HE HAS REACHED TWENTY YEARS OF AGE (TO BE CALCULATED ON THE BASIS OF THE SOLAR YEAR). IF HE HAS NOT REACHED THAT AGE, THE SHAHBANU, MOTHER OF THE CROWN PRINCE, SHALL ASSUME THE REGENCY, UNLESS ANOTHER PERSON SHALL HAVE BEEN DESIGNATED BY THE MONARCH FOR THAT OFFICE.

THE REGENT SHALL FORM A COUNCIL COMPOSED OF THE PRIME MINISTER, THE HEADS OF BOTH HOUSES OF PARLIAMENT, THE CHIEF JUSTICE OF THE SUPREME COURT AND FOUR OTHER SAGACIOUS, REPUTABLE PERSONALITIES OF THE COUNTRY TO BE SELECTED BY THE REGENT, AND (THE REGENT) SHALL,IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE CONSTITUTION, ASSUME THE DUTIES OF MONARCH IN CONSULTATION WITH THE COUNCIL UNTIL (SUCH TIME AS) THE CROWN PRINCE REACHES THE AGE OF 20. IN THE EVENT OF THE DEMISE OR RESIGNATION OF THE REGENT, THE COUNCIL SHALL TEMPORARILY CARRY OUT THE DUTIES OF THE REGENCY UNTIL ANOTHER REGENT--NOT A MEMBER OF THE QAJAR FAMILY--IS APPOINTED BY THE HOUSES OF PARLIAMENT.
REMARRIAGE BY THE SHAHBANU REGENT SHALL CONSTITUTE RESIGNATION (FROM REGENCY). UNQUOTE

REGENCY COUNCIL, AS SEEN IN LAW, IS BASICALLY TO ADVISE REGENT. NATIONAL FRONT VIEW IS THAT SHAH WOULD APPOINT REGENCY COUNCIL, THEN DESIGNATE IT, NOT SHABANOU, TO PERFORM REGENT'S DUTIES, THEN RESIGN AND TRANSFER HIS POWERS TO COUNCIL. BASIS FOR THIS IS PROVISION IN NEXTTO-LAST SENTENCE FOR COUNCIL TO ACT AS REGENT AFTER DEMISE OR RESIGNATION OF REGENT. ACCORDING TO DR. MINATCHI, NEW REGENT WOULD NOT BE DESIGNATED UNTIL NEW, FREELY-ELECTED PARLIAMENT HAD CONSIDERED STATUS OF MONARCHY, THUS LEAVING REGENCY COUNCIL IN POSITION OF EXERCISING MONARCHIAL POWERS UNTIL GENERAL NATIONAL SORTING-OUT TOOK PLACE.
WHILE THIS WAS NOT EXACTLY THE WAY ARTICLE 38 WAS PROJECTED TO WORK WHEN AMENDED, OPPOSITION SCENARIO APPEARS TO MEET CONDITIONS OF

SUMMARY: LEADING MODERATE AYATOLLAH REPORTEDLY HAS HAD DREAM WHICH IS REPORTEDLY BEING ACCEPTED BY MOSLEM FAITHFUL AS REPROACH FOR THEIR TREATMENT OF THE SHAH. IT IS APPARENTLY HAVING A CONSIDERABLE IMPACT AROUND THE COUNTRY. MEANWHILE, WE HAVE HEARD GHOMI MAY BE DENYING THE STORY. IF HE DOES, THIS PRO-REGIME PSYWAR EFFORT MIGHT BACKFIRE. END SUMMARY

SMALL SENSATION SPREADING AROUND IRAN SINCE YESTERDAY IS STORY OF AYATOLLAH GHOMI"S DREAM. GHOMI IS PROBABLY MASHAD'S FOREMOST AYATOLLAH, AND IT APPEARS HE DREAMED A COUPLE OF NIGHTS AGO THAT THE VERY REVERED IMAM REZA (WHOSE SHRINE GRACES MASHAD) CAME TO HIM TO COMPLAIN ABOUT THE BEHAVIOR OF MOSLEM FAITHFUL THESE DAYS. GHOMI REPORTEDLY TELEPHONED THIS DREAM TO KHOMEINI IN PARIS AND KHOMEINI WAS DISBELIEVING. SO GHOMI HAD SIMILAR DREAM THE NEXT NIGHT AND WROTE DOWN, IN A TRANCE, WHAT WAS SAID TO HIM.
IMAM REZA COMPLAINED ABOUT MASHAD MOB'S ATTACK ON HYATT HOTEL A FEW DAYS BEFORE, AS WELL AS THE ATTACKS BY THE FAITHFUL ON MOHAMMED REZA (SHAH PAHLAVI).

AS A RESULT EMBASSY IS GETTING REPORTS THAT SITUATION IN MASHAD HAS CHANGED CONSIDERABLY SINCE YESTERDAY. PICTURES OF THE SHAH HAVE REAPPEARED AND CROWD HAS GATHERED AROUND GHOMI'S RESIDENCE, TO BE NEAR THE SCENE OF THE MOMENTOUS EVENT AND ALSO TO PROTECT GHOMI SHOULD "COMMUNISTS" SEEK TO DO HIM HARM. PEOPLE ARE REATTENDING THE HOLY SHRINE OF IMAM REZA (OF WHICH THE SHAH IS FORMALLY THE CUSTODIAN) IN LARGER NUMBERS.
STORY HAS REACHED MANY OTHER CITIES. ARMISH/MAAG OFFICER REPORTS PRO-GOVT DEMONSTRATIONS IN ISFAHAN TODAY. OTHER TOWNS, SUCH AS ZABOL AND KERMANSHAH REPORTEDLY SEEING REVIVED PRO-SHAH SENTIMENT.

NEVERTHELESS, WIFE OF MALIS MEMBER WHO IS VERY CLOSE TO GHOMI (REFTEL) TOLD POL COUNSELOR SHE HAS HEARD GHOMI IS ABOUT TO SEND OUT A MESSAGE ("ELAMIEH") DENYING TRUTH OF THIS REPORT AND DESCRIBING IT AS THE WORK OF THOSE WHO SEEK TO DISCREDIT HIM.

COMMENT: SHOULD REPORTS OF GHOMI'S "DREAM" BE TRUE, IT COULD OF COURSE CONSIDERABLY IMPROVE SHAH'S PROSPECTS. SHOULD IT PROVE TO BE CONCOCTED RUMOR (WHICH UNFORTUNATELY APPEARS MORE LIKELY) IT COULD BACKFIRE. WITH MANY GOI OFFICIALS ENGAGED IN SPREADING THE STORY (EMBASSY RSO WAS TOLD IT BY SENIOR POLICE CONTACTS AS WELL) NATURAL SUSPICION WILL BE THAT PRO-SHAH, PRO-GOI ELEMENTS ENGAGED IN (HEAVYHANDED) PSYWAR EFFORT TO DIVIDE THE RELIGIOUS. WHICH WAY THAT MIGHT AFFECT THE EXISTING -- IF TENTATIVE -DIVISIONS AMONG TOP SHI'A CLERY IS HARD AS YET TO GUAGE.

1978TEHRAN12163.subject: MEETING WITH HOUSHANG RAM OF BANK OMRAN

segments.text: HOUSHANG RAM, HEAD OF BANK OMRAN, AND CONFIDANT OF SHAH, CAME TO SEE ME DECEMBER 13. HE WANTED TO INFORM ME THAT HE HAS ORGANIZED GROUP OF YOUNG INTELLECTUALS TO TRY TO INTRODUCE SOME PERSPECTIVE INTO POLITICAL DISCUSSIONS TAKING PLACE AMONG MIDDLE-CLASS IRANIANS. HE WONDERED IF WE WOULD FIND THIS HELPFUL IN ANY WAY.
I SAID WE WOULD, OF COURSE, WISH TO KEEP IN TOUCH WITH ANY SUCH GROUP AND WOULD HOPE THEY COULD BE USEFUL IN BRINGING SOME MODERATION TO BEAR ON LOCAL SCENE.

HOWEVER, I SAID THAT I THOUGHT PEOPLE COULD SPEND TOO MUCH TIME LOOKING AT THE POLITICAL PROBLEMS WHILE THE ECONOMIC STRUCTURE OF THE COUNTRY WAS COLLAPSING. RAM IMMEDIATELY AGREED AND GAVE ME LONG TALE OF WOE ABOUT PROBLEMS HIS BANK WAS HAVING WITH CENTRAL BANK AND BANK MELLI.

TELLING HIM THAT THIS ILLUSTRATED MY POINT EXACTLY, I URGED HIM TO GET TOGETHER A GROUP OF SENIOR COMMERCIAL BANKERS AND LITERALLY MARCH ON THE CENTRAL BANK. I SUGGESTED THEY GO INTO THE VARIOUS DEPARTMENTS AND IDENTIFY THE YOUNG PUPS WHO WERE STRANGLING THE BANK'S ACTIVITIES. ASIDE FROM BOXING THEIR EARS, THESE BANKERS COULD OFFER TO LEND REPLACEMENTS TO COVER FOR ANY WHO NEEDED TO BE FIRED. I SAID I SHOULD THINK THE BANKERS WOULD BE FED UP WITH THE CURRENT SITUATION AND THAT IT WAS ABOUT TIME THEY TURNED AGAINST IT. THE MYSTIQUE OF ASHURA WAS OVER AND IT WAS TIME TO PUT THE COUNTRY BACK TO WORK.

RAM SAID THE SHAH SEEMED OPPOSED TO STRONG ACTIONS OF THIS TYPE. I SAID THE SHAH ALWAYS PHRASED ACTIONS IN TERMS OF "SHOOTING A FEW PEOPLE." I THOUGHT A LITTLE ADMINISTRATIVE WRATH WOULD WORK WITHOUT RESORT TO SHOOTING. RAM AGREED TO TRY THE SUGGESTION WITH HIS FELLOW BANKERS AND LEFT WITH SOME APPARENT DETERMINATION. SULLIVAN

1978TEHRAN12167.subject: WHERE WE ARE NOW: OPPOSITION PROGRAM AND THE FUTURE

segments.text: SUMMARY: BOTH OPPOSITION AND GOI ASSESSING THEIR RESPECTIVE POSITIONS AMIDST MILD EUPHORIA OF RELIEF THAT ASHURA DID NOT PRODUCE EXPECTED VIOLENT CONFRONTATION. KEY QUESTIONS WILL BE HOW GOVERNMENT HANDLES ANNOUNCED REINSTATEMENT OF MARTIAL LAW, AND WHETHER OPPOSITION CAN AGREE AMONG SELVES ON CABINET PROPOSAL AND THEN REACH AGREEMENT WITH SHAH ON HIS CONSTITUTIONAL ROLE AND CONTROL OF THE ARMY. OPPOSITION SEEKING TO DEVELOP SITUATION WHERE IT COULD DISCREETLY DISTANCE ITSELF FROM KHOMEINI WITHOUT DISAVOWING HIM. POTENTIAL FOR VIOLENCE BY DISCONTENTED RADICALS REMAINS DISTINCT POSSIBILITY. END SUMMARY.

SUMMARY OF 17-POINT OPPOSITION PROGRAM GIVEN REFTEL DOES NOT INCLUDE NUANCES OF FULL PRESENTATION, SOME OF WHICH MAY BE IMPORTANT IN SUBSEQUENT MANEUVERING. MANIFESTO WAS APPARENTLY DRAFTED FOR DEC 10 MARCH, BUT WAS FULLY PROCLAIMED AT DEC 11 EVENT. TRANSLATION OF MAIN POINTS FOLLOWS: 1. AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI IS OUR LEADER, WHATEVER HE ASKS WE WILL CARRY OUT. THIS MARCH IS A VOTE OF CONFIDENCE IN KHOMEINI; 2. THE APPARATUS OF THE GOVERNMENTAL DICTATORSHIP MUST BE OVERTHROWN AND POWER TRANSFERRED TO THE PEOPLE

THE RULE OF ISLAMIC SOCIAL AND INDIVIDUAL JUSTICE MUST BE ESTABLISHED ON THE BASIS OF THE VOTES OF THE PEOPLE. (NOTE: THIS IS NOT RPT NOT A CALL FOR AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC PER REFTEL.); 4. THIS IS HUMAN RIGHTS DAY. WE ASK FOR THE HUMAN RIGHTS WHICH OUR STRUGGLE HAS SOUGHT; 5. THE IMPERIA ISM OF EAST AND WEST MUST BE REMOVED. THE IRANIAN PEOPLE WILL CONTINUE AND EXTEND THEIR RELATIONS WITH OTHER NATIONS. (NOTE; THIS DOES NOT CALL FOR ELIMINATION OF MILITARY GOVERNMENT PER REFTEL.); 6. RELIGIOUS MINORITIES AND CITIZENS OF OTHER COUNTRIES MAY CONTINUE TO STAY IN IRAN IF THEY RESPECT ISLAMIC LAW AND HUMAN RIGHTS; 7.

THE REAL FREEDOM AND RIGHTS OF WOMEN WILL BE RESPECTED. WE SHALL USE ALL THE POWER THAT WOMEN IN IRAN CAN GIVE; 8. THE RIGHTS OF WORKERS AND AGRICULTURAL WORKERS SHOULD BE RESPECTED AND THEY SHOULD BENEFIT FROM WORK IN IRAN; 9. PEOPLE SHOULD NOT MAKE MONEY FROM MONEY. THE EXPLOITATION OF HUMAN BEINGS BY OTHERS SHOULD BE STOPPED. THE COLLECTION OF WEALTH IN THE HANDS OF SOME PEOPLE AND THE PROPERTY OF OTHERS SHOULD BE REDISTRIBUTED; 10. AGRICULTURE MUST BE REFORMED AND IRAN'S ECONOMY MUST BE INDEPENDENT OF FOREIGN INFLUENCE; 11. WE SUPPORT THE STRIKERS BOTH IN THE GOVERNMENT AND PRIVATE SECTORS. STRIKERS ARE A BLOW TO THE REGIME.

THEY HAVE NOT DAMAGED LIFE IN IRAN; 12. PEOPLE SHOULD COOPERATE FOR THEIR ESSENTIAL NEEDS AND TO PREVENT PRICE INCREASES AND SHORTAGES; 13. BRINGING THE ARMY INTO THE STREETS AND PLACING IT IN FRONT OF THE IRANIAN PEOPLE IS HIGH TREASON. WE ASK THE ARMY TO BE WITH THE PEOPLE AND NOT AGAINST THEM. (NOTE: NOTHING SAID ABOUT SHOOTING AT DEMONSTRATORS PER REFTEL); 14. THE PROPAGANDA AND CLAIMS OF THE REGIME ABOUT INTERNATIONNL COMMUNISTS INFLUENCING THE STRUGGLE OF THE IRANIAN PEOPLE IS FALSE. THE RUINING OF PLACES WAS BEING DONE BY THE GOVERNMENT; 15. WE SALUTE THE MARTYRS OF THE IRANIAN STRUGGLE; 16.

WE DEMAND RELEASE OF ALL POLITICAL PRISONERS AND RETURN OF ALL THOSE WHO HAVE LEFT THE COUNTRY BECAUSE OF LACK OF FREEDOM; 17. WE WILL CONTINUE THE STRUGGLE UNTIL VICTORY. (NOTE; IN THE ORAL EXPLANATION WHICH FOLLOWED THE MULLAH'S READING THIS LAST POINT, THE STATEMENT WAS MADE THAT THE STRUGGLE WOULD CONTINUE IN ALL ITS FORMS.)
