BOTH SIDES BELIEVE THEY "WON." B) RADICAL FACTIONS WERE UPSET THAT THERE WAS VIRTUALLY NO VIOLENCE AND MAY MOVE TO CREATE SOME. VIRTUAL SIEGE STATE IN ISFAHAN IS NOT RPT NOT ENCOURAGING IN THIS REGARD. C) MASS TEHRAN RALLY WAS NEARLY ENTIRELY POLITICAL WITH MERE LIP SERVICE TO RELIGION. IT WAS IMPRESSIVE DISPLAY OF MASS ORGANIZATIONAL SKILLS OF NATIONAL FRONT (INF) AND SURPRISED MOST OBSERVERS. D) FACT BLOODY CONFRONTATION DID NOT RPT NOT OCCUR HAS BOUGHT TIME FOR REGIME.

GOI HAS SAID IT WILL ENFORCE MARTIAL LAW "WITH DETERMINATION." E) OPPOSITION IS NOW GOING BACK TO INTERNAL BARGAINING TABLE TO TRY AND HAMMER OUT CABINET AND REGENCY COUNCIL PROPOSALS AS A BASIS FOR NEGOTIATION WITH GOI. F) ON THE OTHER HAND, MASSIVE TURNOUT OF PEOPLE HAS IMPRESSED MANY MIDDLE-CLASS PEOPLE WHO WERE NOT AWARE OF BREADTH AND DEPTH OF ANTI-SHAH FEELINGS. SOME OF THESE WERE ALSO DISPLEASED THAT GOVT CHOSE TO PROTECT ONLY A PORTION OF THE CITY WITH THE ARMY, LEAVING OTHERS TO THEIR OWN DEVICES.

THERE ARE SEVERAL MAJOR QUESTIONS AND "IFS" FOR THE IMMEDIATE FUTURE. WILL GOI REINSTATE MARTIAL LAW WITH HEAVY HAND OR LIGHT TOUCH? IT IS CLEAR GOI MUST MOVE TO GET STRIKERS BACK TO WORK, CHILDREN BACK IN SCHOOLS, AND REGAIN CONTROL OF STREETS. IF THIS CAN BE DONE WITH FIRMNESS AND FINESSE, SHAH'S SEARCH FOR COALITION COMBINATION CAN GO FORWARD. MORE AGGRESSIVE ACTION COULD PROVOKE RADICALS TO MORE VIOLENT CONFRONTATION. MANY MILITARY MEN WANT TOUGHER STANCE, WHILE RADICAL GROUPS WERE UPSET THAT MODERATES WOULD NOT LET SOME OF THEM MARCH ON DEC 10 AND EVEN 11, AND THAT PARADE ORGANIZERS DID NOT SEEK GREATER CONFRONTATION.

COMBINATION OF TWO FACTORS COULD PROVE VERY VOLATILE, PARTICULARLY IF ARMY MOVES FORCEFULLY AGAINST CURREW VIOLATORS OVER NEXT FEW EVENINGS. ON THE OTHER HAND, ARMY CANNOT BE TOO SOFT OR IMPETUS TO COMPROMISE WILL SLOW AND OPPPSITION WILL RETURN TO EXTREME DEMANDS.

SECOND MAJOR QUESTION IS WHETHER OPPOSITION CAN GET ITS ACT TOGETHER FOR A UNIFIED APPROACH TO SHAH/GOI. THERE IS EVIDENCE THAT LEADERS OF MARCH CALLED FOR TWO DAYS OF NO DEMONSTRATIONS. MEETINGS AMONG MAJOR OPPOSITION FIGURES ARE GOING ON TODAY, DEC 12 AND DEC 13, TO TRY HAMMERING OUT PROPOSED CABINET LISTS AND NAMES FOR PROJECTED REGENCY COUNCIL. RUMOR HAD FLOWN AROUND TOWN THAT SANJABI RELEASE DEC 7 WAS RESULT OF DEAL OVER PROPOSED COALITION CABINET, BUT THIS APPEARS FALSE. BASIC PROBLEM REMAINS THAT OPPOSITION SAYS PUBLICLY IT DOES NOT WANT SHAH, EVEN IN CONSTITUTIONAL ROLE.

PRIVATELY, INF LEADERS AGREE SHAH IS PROBABLY NECESSARY, BUT THEN DISCUSSIONS BREAK DOWN OVER WHO CONTROLS ARMY, SHAH OR PROJECTED GOI. AT THE MOMENT, DESPITE WHAT IS COMING TO BE CALLED "THE MIRACLE OF MOHARRAM," OPPOSITION AND GOI POSITIONS STILL REMAIN MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE. NEXT FEW DAYS SHOULD OFFER SOME HINTS, HOWEVER, WHETHER EVENTS OF PAST WEEKEND MIGHT NOT HAVE DEVELOPED MORE FLEXIBILITY IN POSITIONS OF BOTH SIDES.

SITUATION FOR IMMEDIATE FUTURE THEREFORE OFFERS BOTH DANGER AND HOPE. DANGER IS THAT RADICALS WILL INSTIGATE VIOLENT INCIDENTS WHICH WILL DRAW MODERATES' ATTENTION AWAY FROM RATHER PLEASANT FEELING OF SUCCESS AND PROVOKE SEVERE MILITARY REACTION.

HOPE IS THAT OPPOSTION CAN GET UNIFIED PROPOSAL READY TO MOVE FORWARD TO COALITION GOVERNMENT REASONABLY SOON ANDALL ELEMENTS CAN MAINTAIN THEIR ------------------122661 131639Z /64 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 2187 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY BONN AMCONSUL DHAHRAN AMEMBASSY DOHA CINCPAC HONOLULU HI AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS USLO PEKING AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY TOKYO USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE SECTION 03 OF 03 TEHRAN 12167 COOL.

EVEN IF THIS CAN BE DONE, HOWEVER, IT WILL NOT ALLEVIATE SHORT RUN DISLOCATIONS, BOTH ECONOMIC (SEE SEPTEL) AND POLITICAL. STRIKES CONTINUE, BANKING SYSTEM IS IN SHAMBLES, OIL PRODUCTION REMAINS DOWN, AND EVEN IF OPPOSITION PUTS FORWARD PROPOSALS, FAIRLY EXTENDED NEGOTIATIONS WOULD HAVE TO ENSUE IF THERE IS TO BE A FIT. SEEN IN ABOVE CONTEXT, OPPOSITION PROGRAM IS INTERESTING PROPOSAL. DESPITE RITUAL REITERATION THAT KHOMEINI IS LEADER, PROGRAM ITSELF IS CLEARLY MODERATE DOCUMENT WHICH, WITH ONE EXCEPTION, DOES NOT RPT NOT CALL FOR EXTREMIST KHOMEINI POSITIONS. MARCHES WERE RUN BY INF, NOT KHOMEINI.

ACCORDING TO THREE DIFFERENT SOURCES, PROGRAM WAS DRAFTED BY INF COMMITTEE, AND BOTH PROGRAM AND MARCHES ACROSS IRAN BEAR MUCH STRONGER INF IMPRINT THAN RELIGIOUS INPUT. EXCEPTION ON EXTREME POSITION IS POINT TWO, WHICH CALLS FOR OVERTHROW OF APPARATUS OF GOVERNMENTAL DICTATORSHIP. ONE EMBASSY SOURCE NOTES THAT THIS IS LESS EXTREME THAN KHOMEINI'S CALL FOR END TO SHAH. WHILE NUANCE MAY ESCAPE MOST, IT DOES LEAVE SLIVER OF LIGHT FOR COMPROMISE, WHICH IS MAIN HOPE OF MODERATES. BASIC STRATEGY OF MORE MODERATE RELIGIOUS AND SECULAR LEADERS IS TO MAINTAIN MOMENTUM ESTABLISHED BY "SUCCESS" OF PAST TWO DAYS' RALLIES AND COME UP WITH CABINET LISTS TO PRESENT TO SHAH.

WITHOUT DISAVOWING KHOMEINI, THEY HAVE TO RENDER HIM INCREASINGLY IRRELEVANT TO ACTUAL POLITICAL CHOICE. IF THIS PROCESS BREAKS DOWN, OR VIOLENT ACTIVITY DISRUPTS CONFERENCE TABLE WORK, PERSIAN POLITICAL NONSYSTEM WILL CONTINUE TO LIMP ALONG, WITH PROSPECT THAT SHARP CONFRONTATION WHICH NEARLY ALL FEARED AT ASHURA MAY MERELY HAVE BEEN POSTPONED A FEW

SUMMARY: IN WAKE OF TEHRAN'S LARGE SCALE PEACEFUL DEMONSTRATIONS DEC 10-11, OPPOSTION LEADERS MET DEC 12 AND PICKED CANDIDATES FOR THEIR PROPOSED REGENCY COUNCIL. NEXT STEP IS TO OBTAIN AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI'S APPROVAL. COMMITTEE FOR THE DEFENSE OF HUMAN RIGHTS AND FREEDOM (CDHRF) IS PLAYING FACILITATIVE ROLE AND STILL HOPES U.S. AND BRITAIN WILL PUSH PLAN FORWARD. MODERATE OPPOSITIONISTS DO NOT THINK MILITARY GOVERNMENT CAN GET STRIKERS BACK TO WORK AND ECONOMY GOING. AMINI IRRITATED THAT GOI TAKING HARSH LINE WITH DEMONSTRATORS IN ISFAHAN. ZAHEDI AND AMINI TOGETHER PUSHED PEACEFUL MARCH IDEA WITH GOI. END SUMMARY.

DR. NASSEE MINATCHI MET WITH EMBOFF STEMPEL AT HOSSENIEH ERSHAT (THEOLOGICAL SCHOOL) OFFICE TO REVIEW EVENTS OF PAST FEW DAYS. EXUDING PLEASURE THAT VIOLENCE HAD BEEN ABSENT FROM TASSUA/ASHURA DEMONSTRATIONS, MINATCHI SAID ALL OPPOSITION LEADERS HAD MET UNDER CDHRF AUSPICES DEC 12 AND HAD AGREED ON NAMES TO PUT FORWARD FOR PROPOSED REGENCY COUNCIL (REF A). GROUP HAD DECIDED NOT RPT NOT TO MAKE PRIME MINISTER AND CABINET CHOICES, LEAVING THIS TO REGENCY COUNCIL (COMMENT; AND THUS AVOIDING DIFFICULT DECISIONS OF PRECEDENCE AMONG THEMSELVES). IN ADDITION TO SHAH'S TWO ACTIVE DUTY MILITARY NOMINEES, HE WOULD CHOOSE BETWEEN RETIRED GENERALS FEREIDOUN JAM AND (FNU) NASSROLAHI FOR THIRD MILITARY SPOT.

SIX CANDIDATES WERE NAMED FOR FOUR CIVILIAN SPOTS, WITH ADDITIONAL POSITION RESERVED FOR KHOMEINI NOMINEE IF AYATOLLAH DEIGNS TO SELECT SOMEONE. CIVILIAN NOMINEES ARE: ABDOLLAH ENTEZAM, EX-FOREIGN MINISER; ALLAHYAR SALEH, EX-MINISTER OF INTERIOR UNDER MOSSADEQ; DR. ALI AKBAR SIASSI, FORMER FOREIGN MINISTER AND TEHRAN UNIVERSITY DEAN; DR. (FNU) AHZAR, EX-MOSSADEQ MINISTER; MR. (FNU) NAJMOLMOLK; AND A MR. MOHAMMAD SOURI, A FORMER MINISTER AYATGOLLAH MONTAZERI, A KHOMEINI LOYALIST, WILL LEAVE FOR PARIS IN TWO OR THREE DAYS TO LAY THIS PROPOSAL BEFORE KHOMEINI. IF HE APPROVES, THEN DR. ALI AMINI AND EX-PRIME MINISTER SHARIF-EMAMI WOULD PRESENT PROPOSAL TO SHAH.

WITH RESPECT TO U.S. AND U.K. ROLE, MINATCHI SAID IT WOULD OBVIOUSLY HELP IF TWO AMBASSADORS WERE WILLING TO PUT LIST FORWARD TO SHAH BUT BECAME VAGUE WHEN PRESSED AS TO WHETHER THIS WAS REALLY ESSENTIAL (REF B). AT MINIMUM, MINATCHI SAID, U.S. AND U.K. SHOULD HAVE NO QUALMS THAT ARMY WOULD BECOME DISAFFECTED BY PROPOSED SOLUTION, WITH TWO NOMINEES FROM PRESENT ACTIVE SERVICE LIST ON COUNCIL. MINATCHI SAID HE HAD MADE SAME PITCH TO BRITISH AMB PARSONS A FEW HOURS EARLIER IN DA AND PARSONS SAID HE WOULD INDICATE NO OBJECTION TO CONCEPT IF ASKED. EMBOFF SAID HE WOULD REPORT ABOVE TO U.S.
AMBASSADOR BUT SUGGESTED CONCEPT WOULD HAVE MORE MEANING IF/WHEN KHOMEINI AAPROVES. MINATCHI REPLIED PROJECT WOULD NOT GO FORWARD UNTIL SOME SIGN OF TACIT AGREEMENT RECEIVED FROM PARIS.

IN RESPONSE TO EMBOFF'S QUESTIONS ABOUT EVENTS OF -AST FEW DAYS, MINATCHI SAID ACHIEVEMENT OF PEACEFUL MARCHES WAS MAJOR MILESTONE FOR MODERATES. ONLY PROBLEM WAS ISFAHAN, WHERE PEOPLE UNKNOWN TO RELIGIOUS MOVEMENT HAD EXHORTED CROWDS TO VIOLENCE EVENING DEC 11 AND DEC 12. MINATCHI ADDED THAT GOI WAS SUSPECTED OF USING SAVAK PROVOCATEURS, BUT MEN COULD HAVE BEEN RADICAL COMMUNISTS JUST AS EASILY. HE THOUGHT MILITARY GOVERNMENT COULD NOT GET STRIKERS BACK TO WORK AND CONFIRMED THAT JOB ACTION AND STRIKE TACTICS REMAINED MAJOR WEAPONS TO "KEEP HEAT ON" SHAH.

MINATCHI THOUGHT ONLY 40 PER CENT OF TEACHERS WOULD GO BACK TO WORK, OTHERS MIGHT SHOW UP BUT WOULD USE SLOWDOWN TACTICS. ECONOMIC CONDITIONS WOULD PROBABLY GET WORSE UNTIL SHAH SAW THE LIGHT AND AGREED TO DEPART. EMBOFF ASKED WHAT IF MILITARY USED TACTICS TO FORCE STRIKERS BACK TO WORK? MINATCHI REPLIED THIS WOULD NOT BE EFFECTIVE; TOO MANY PEOPLE WERE READY TO DEFY MARTIAL LAW NOW, AND "PEOPLE" WERE READY TO PUSH GOI AND SHAH UNTIL THEY GAVE UP. PARTLY IT WAS GOING TO BE A QUESTION OF WHO WOULD OUTLAST WHOM.

MINATCHI SAID DR. ,MINI WAS VERY ANGRY WITH GOI RIGHT NOW. HE HAD GONE TO SHAH EVENING OF DEC 11 TO COUNSEL RESTRAINT BY MILITARY IN ISFAHAN. SHAH AND MILITARY PROMISED TROOPS WOULD BE ORDERED TO TAKE IT EASY, BUT THIS HAD NOT HAPPENED. IMPLICATIONS WERE SOMEWHAT OMINOUS, AND AMINI WAS "TIRED."

MINATCHI SAID SEVENTEEN-POINT PROGRAM ADOPTED BY MASS CROWD DEC 11 (REF C) WAS REALLY VERY FLEXIBLE DOCUMENT. IMPLICATION OF POINT TWO, OVERTHROW OF TYRANNICAL REGIME, WAS THAT NON-TYRANNICAL ONE WAS ALL RIGHT; IF GOI WERE "CLEAN," PEOPLE WOULD OBEY. WORD IN PRINT WAS "REGIME," ------------------120441 131314Z /45 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 2181 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 12168 EXDIS BUT MULLAH HAD USED "MONARCHY" IN ITS PLACE ORALLY AT RALLY. EVEN THIS GAVE MINATCHI NO HEARTBURN; NOR DID POINT THREE, WHICH APPARENTLY CALLED FOR REFERENDUM.

MINATCHI SAID WORDS USED IN PERSIAN CLEARLY MEANT VOTE OF PEOPLE AS USED IN PARLIAMENTARY ELECTIONS, NOT "PUBLIC OPINION POLL." HE SAID MODERATE OPPOSITION NOW FULLY AGREED TO POSTPONEMENT OF DECISION ON MONARCHIAL REGIME UNTIL SOME MONTHS DOWN THE ROAD. HE PERSONALLY THOUGHT NEW PARLIAMENT WOULD VOTE TO KEEP IT BUT WITHOUT SHAH.

ASKED WHO WAS RESPONSIBLE FOR PEACEFUL OUTCOME OF ASHURA RALLIES, MINATCHI SAID AMINI AND ZAHEDI TOGETHER HAD WORKED THINGS OUT ON GOVERNMENT SIDE. HE PERSONALLY DID NOT KNOW WHICH ONE OUGHT TO GET THE MAJOR CREDIT, BUT PAIR WERE DEFINITELY ONES WHO ENGINEERED MILITARY RESTRAINT FROM HIS PERSPECTIVE.

COMMENT: MINATCHI IS USUALLY AN OPTIMIST AND HIS VIEWS MUST BE SEEN WITH THAT IN MIND. NEVERTHELESS, HE TOOK LEAD IN PRESSING OPPOSITIONISTS TO DEAL WITH GOVERNMENT TO GET PEACEFUL MARCH AND IS DEEPLY PLEASED THAT THINGS WORKED OUT WELL. HE MINIMIZES CHANCES FOR VIOLENCE TO DISRUPT GOOD FEELING GENERATED BUT IS ACUTELY AWARE THAT THINGS IN ISFAHAN HAVE NOT GONE WELL. ANSWERS TO QUESTIONS IN REF B CAN BE GLEANED FROM ABOVE, BUT TO SUMMARIZE: CDHRF IS FACILITATIVE GROUP, NOT LEADERSHIP VEHICLE (THIS IS BACKTRACKING FROM EARLIER MINATCHI STATEMENT). SHAH IS TO PICK REGENCY COUNCIL, THEN DEPART.

COUNCIL IN TURN WILL THEN SELECT CABINET IN CONSULATION WITH "TRUE NATIONALISTS" (READ OPPOSITION). ALL PLAYERS IN GAME WOULD DEARLY LOVE FOR U.S. AND U.K. TO MAKE THIS PROJECT THEIR OWN BUT REALISTICALLY WILL SETTLE FOR LESSER GREAT POWER ROLE. MINIMUM ACCEPTABLE WOULD BE U.S. AND U.K. INTERPOSING NO OBJECTIONS IF ASKED BY SHAH/GOI.

CONDITIONS IN TEHRAN AND OTHER CITIES ARE REMARKABLY CALM. WITH EXCEPTION OF DEMONSTRATION (SIZE UNKNOWN) REPORTED AT JALEH SQUARE LAST NIGHT, EVENING PASSED WITHOUT SHOUTING, SHOOTING, OR A SINGLE ATTACK ON AMERICAN RESIDENCE OR VEHICLE. DESPITE RUMORS THAT DISGRUNTLED EXTREMISTS WOULD FORCE VIOLENT CONFRONTATION ON THE HEELS OF PEACEFUL DEC 10-11, THEY HAVE SO FAR REMAINED SUBDUED. TEHRAN PRIMARY SCHOOLS OPENED TODAY. WE DO NOT YET KNOW HOW SUCCESSFUL GOVT HAS BEEN IN GETTING TEACHERS AND STUDENTS TO ATTEND, BUT CITY IS TRANQUIL. SOME POWER OUTAGES DID OCCUR LAST NIGHT, PERHAPS NOT COINCIDENTALLY DURING TELEVISION PROGRAM WHICH PRAISED SHAH. SHOPS ARE GENERALLY OPEN OUTSIDE BAZAAR AREA.

CONSULATE ISFAHAN CONSIDERS PRESS REPORTS OF SITUATION THERE DEC 12 TO BE EXAGGERATED. ASHURA WAS DESTRUCTIVE AND CHAOTIC, WITH DEATH TOLL RANGING BETWEEN GOVT FIGURE OF 9 AND PERHAPS 50. YESTERDAY BROUGHT VENGEFUL MILITARY RESPONSE MOTIVATED BY SENSE OF BETRAYAL, BUT ALTHOUGH TROOPS SMASHED WINDOWS WHICH DISPLAYED KHOMEINI'S PICTURE, IT WAS NONETHELESS A CONTROLLED RESPONSE, AND CONSUL HAS NO REPORTS OF ANY DEATHS. CONSUL SHIRAZ REPORTS SMALL DEMONSTRATION TODAY WITHIN MEDICAL SCHOOL COMPOUND, WITH TROOPS NOT INTERVENING. CITY IS QUIET AND 50 PERCENT OF SHOPS ARE OPEN, BUT INDUSTRIES ARE STILL SHUT DOWN DUE TO NATURAL GAS SHORTAGE.

NIOC DISTRICT OFFICE ALSO STATES KEROSENE AND DIESEL FUEL ARE IN SHORT SUPPLY. GRAFFITI WRITERS HAVE DISCOVERED SPRAY PAINT CANS, PERMITTING A GREATER DISPLAY OF CREATIVITY. SHIRAZ ALSO HAD POWER OUTAGE LAST NIGHT IN APPARENT COORDINATION WITH TEHRAN.

CONSUL SHIRAZ NOTES A SIGNIFICANT NUMBER OF SPRAYPAINTED SIGNS ARE PRO-SHAH, ALTHOUGH STILL IN THE MINORITY. BIGGEST STORY OF THE DAY IS, IN FACT, A GOOD NUMBER OF REPORTS OF PRO-SHAH DISPLAYS. WHILE MANY OF THESE ARE VAGUE REPORTS OF A PRO-SHAH MARCH "SOMEWHERE," CONSUL ISFAHAN REPORTS THREE RALLIES THERE YESTERDAY, AND WE ALSO HAVE RELIABLE REPORT OF DEMONSTRATIONS IN MASHAD YESTERDAY AND TODAY. THESE APPARENTLY STEM FROM WIDESPREAD TALE OF AYATOLLAH GHOMI'S VISIONS DEC 10-11, ALLEGEDLY LEADING GHOMI TO SUPPORT THE SHAH (BEING REPORTED SEPTEL).

THE LABOR SITUATION IN TEHRAN AFTER THE LONG ASHURA HOLIDAY (DECEMBER 8-12) IS ABOUT THE SAME AS BEFORE. MOST GOVERNMENT MINISTRIES ARE OFFICIALLY OPEN, BUT FUNCTION ONLY PARTIALLY. THE MINISTRY OF ECONOMIC AFFAIRS AND FINANCE (MEAF), ONE OF THE WORST AFFECTED BY STRIKE ACTIVITY, WAS VIRTUALLY CLOSED ON DECEMBER 12, BUT IMPROVED SOMEWHAT ON DECEMBER 13 AS THE TREASURY DEPARTMENT (RESPONSIBLE FOR DISBURSEMENT OF FUNDS) BEGAN TO FUNCTION ONCE AGAIN. THE CUSTOMS AND TAX UNITS IN THE MEAF REMAINED ON STRIKE. OTHER ECONOMIC MINISTRIES, INCLUDING AGRICULTURE AND COMMERCE, APPEARED TO BE FUNCTIONING AT THE TOP LEVEL ONLY.

IN CONTRAST, TELECOMMUNICATIONS, ELECTRICITY, CIVIL AVIATION, AND OTHER STATE-OWNED PUBLIC UTILITIES AND SERVICES ARE OPERATING MORE OR LESS NORMALLY. THIS IS A DEFINITE IMPROVEMENT, WHICH APPEARS TO HAVE BEEN ACCOMPLISHED DUE TO THE ESTABLISHMENT OF BETTER DISCIPLINE AND FIRMER LEADERSHIP WITHIN THE AGENCIES INVOLVED. FOR EXAMPLE, TWO OR THREE WEEKS AGO RESPONSIBILITY FOR SECURITY AT THE TELECOMMUNICATIONS COMPANY OF IRAN (TCI) WAS GIVEN TO AN ARMY GENERAL WHO HAS USED FIRM MEASURES TO DEAL WITH THE CHAOTIC CONDITIONS WHICH PREVIOUSLY PREVAILED. THE FIRM POLICIES APPEAR TO HAVE PAID OFF. TELEX, TELEPHONE AND MICROWAVE FACILITIES AT TCI HAVE SUFFERED NO INTERRUPTIONS FOR ABOUT TWO WEEKS.

AS REPORTED SEPARATELY, BANKS ARE OPEN IN GENERAL BUT FULL SERVICES ARE NOT AVAILABLE. SHOPS AND COMMERCIAL AND BUSINESS OFFICES IN THE CITY ARE MOSTLY OPEN, RESULTING IN NORMAL TRAFFIC CONGESTION IN THE DOWNTOWN AREA OF TEHRAN. THE OIL INDUSTRY, AS REPORTED SEPARATELY, REMAINS SEVERELY AFFECTED BY STRIKE ACTIVITY.

COMMENT; GIVEN THE SHORT TWO-DAY WORK WEEK REMAINING BETWEEN THE END OF THE ASHURA HOLIDAY AND THE BEGINNING OF THE IRANIAN WEEKEND ON THURSDAY, IT WAS NOT EXPECTED THAT BUSINESS ACTIVITY WOULD BE RESUMED AT ANYTHING APPROACHING A NORMAL LEVEL. IT IS SOMEWHAT ENCOURAGING, HOWEVER, THAT THE LEVEL OF ACTIVITY IN THE TWO-DAY PERIOD DID NOT DIMINISH FROM THE LEVEL OF THE PRECEDING WEEK. THE MORE DIFFICULT TEST WILL COME ON SATURDAY, DECEMBER 16, AS THE NORMAL IRANIAN WORK WEEK RESUMES. THERE ARE INCREASING INDICATIONS THAT THE GOI INTENDS TO INTENSIFY EFFORTS TO BREAK THE STRIKES IN ESSENTIAL AREAS, SUCH AS THE IRANIAN CUSTOMS SERVICE. SULLIVAN

1978TEHRAN12188.subject: PROPOSAL FOR RETURN OF NASSER KHAN QASHGAI

segments.text: EMBOFF MET DEC 23 WITH HUSHANG SHAHBAZI,.RELATIVE OF QASHGAI CHIEFLY FAMILY, TO HEAR RISCOURSE ON ADVANTAGE TO SHAH OF RETURN TO IRAN OF QASHGAI IL-KHAN, NASSER KHAN QASHGAI. SHABAZI READILY ADMITTED THAT NATURE OF TRIBE HAS CHANGED AS IT BECAME MORE SEDENTARIZED. HOWEVER, HE MAINTAINED THAT NASSER KHAN RETAINS EXTRAORDINARY INFLUENCE AMONG HIS PEOPLE AND AMONG RELIGIOUS LEADERS IN PROVINCE OF FARS. MOREOVER, ACCORDING TO SHAHBAZI, QASHGAI OCCUPIES TRADITIONAL PLACE OF IMPORTANCE AND INFLUENCE AMONG IRAN'S "THOUSAND FAMILIES" AND HIS RETURN COULD HELP TO BOLSTER THEIR SUPPORT FOR MAINTENANCE OF THE PRESENT SYSTEM.
NASSER KHAN WAS PARTICULARLY CLOSE TO GEN ZAHEDI AND ALLEGEDLY HAD A HAND, ALONG WITH ZAHEDI, IN THE DEATH OF MOSSADEGH'S CHIEF OF POLICE, GEN AFSHAR -TUS.

SHAHBAZI DESCRIBED NASSER KHAN AS AN INTELLIGENT AND CLEVER KHAN, BUT ONE WITH WEAKNESSES, INCLUDING A LOVE OF MONEY AND A DESIRE TO RETURN TO A POSITION OF HONOR, RESPECT AND POWER APPROXIMATING THAT WHICH HE ENJOYED IN THE TRIBAL LANDS PRIOR TO HIS EXILE. NASSER KHAN ORIGINALLY FAVORED THE NATIONAL FRONT BECAUSE, IN THE 50'S, THE SHAH POSED THE GREATEST THREAT TO THE ENJOYMENT BY TRIBAL CHIEFS AND LARGE LANDOWNERS OF THEIR TRADITIONAL PREROGATIVES. AT PRESENT, SHAHBAZI BELIEVES, NASSER KHAN WOULD PERCEIVE RETENTION OF THE SHAH AS CONSISTENT WITH A TRADITIONAL VIEW OF IRANIAN AUTHORITY STRUCTURE AND THEREFORE A DESIRABLE OBJECTIVE.
AS AN OLD NATIONAL FRONTER, HE WOULD PRESUMABLY BE WELCOMED BY PRESENT FRONT LEADERS, PARTICULARLY AS HE WOULD HAVE NO AMBITION FOR POLITICAL OFFICE.

SHOULD NASSER KHAN RETURN, SHAHBAZI BELIEVES IT WOULD BE USEFUL IF HE COULD BE ARRESTED FOR A FEW DAYS TO INCREASE HIS CREDIBILITY. ONCE FREE, NASSER KHAN WOULD BE UNABLE TO OPPOSE KHOMEINI DIRECTLY, NOR WOULD SUCH A CONFRONTATION BE DESIRABLE AS IT WOULD FORCE AT LEAST SOME OF THE OPPOSTION BACK INTO A MORE EXTREMIST POSITION IN DEFENSE OF KHOMEINI. RATHER, NASSER KHAN'S CONTRIBUTION, WITHIN THE COUNCILS OF THE OPPOSITION, WOULD BE TO ARGUE IN FAVOR OF THE NECESSITY TO RETAIN THE SHAH.

IN FARS, AND PARTICULARLY IN CITIES SUCH AS SHIRAZ AND JAHROM, NASSER KHAN'S INFLUENCE COULD HELP MAINTAIN ORDER, ESPECIALLY AS THE BOYER-AHMADI AND THE KHAMSEH CONFEDERATION WOULD BE LIKELY TO FOLLOW THE LEAD OF THE QASHGAI.

CLAIMING THAT HE HAS NOT YET APPROACHED NASSER KHAN OR HIS FAMILY ON THIS SUBJECT, SHAHBAZI ASKED IF EMBOFF WOULD BE INTERESTED IN MEETING NASSER KHAN'S BROTHERS FOR FURTHER TALKS. EMBOFF REPLIED THAT HE IS IN NO POSITION TO ASSESS EITHER IMPACT OF NASSER KHAN'S RETURN NOR GOI WILLINGNESS TO HAVE HIM BACK IN IRAN. HOWEVER, AS GOI HAD EXILED HIM IN THE FIRST PLACE, ANY DISCUSSIONS OR AGREEMENTS REGARDING HIS RETURN OUGHT PROPERLY TO FOCUS ON GOI. U.S.

WOULD, IN ANY CASE, TAKE NO STEPS INCONSISTENT WITH ITS SUPPORT OF THE SHAH AND EMBOFF THEREFORE DOUBTED THAT SUGGESTED CONVERSATION WITH NASSER KHAN'S BROTHERS WOULD TAKE PLACE UNLESS PROPOSAL WAS OF INTEREST TO GOI.

COMMENT: AS SHAH, OVER THE YEARS, HAS CONSCIOUSLY REDUCED THE POWER OF TRADITIONAL LEADERS OF IRANIAN SOCIETY WITH NO CONCOMITANT GAIN AMONG OTHER SOCIAL SEGMENTS, HE PRESENTLY FINDS HIMSELF RELYING ALMOST ENTIRELY ON THE MILITARY FOR HIS INTERNAL SUPPORT. UNDER THESE CONDITIONS APPEARANCE OF POWERFUL TRADITIONALLYBASED SUPPORTERS MIGHT PROVE ATTRACTIVE. HOWEVER, GOI WOULD HAVE TO WEIGH CAREFULLY POTENTIAL GAINS OF NASSER KHAN'S PRESENCE AGAINST POSSIBLE IMPACT OF HIS RETURN ON STILL FRAGILE DOMINANCE OF MODERATE OPPOSITION LEADERSHIP WHICH APPEARS TO BE MOVING CLOSE TO DISCUSSIONS WITH SHAH ON COALITION/TRANSITIONAL GOVERNMENT.

IT HAS BEEN FASHIONABLE, DURING PAST DECADE, TO DOWNPLAY INFLUENCE OF TRIBAL CHIEFS AND OTHER TRADITIONAL LEADERSHIP ELEMENTS IN IRAN. WITHOUT COMMENTING ON DEGREE OF INFLUENCE RETAINED BY QASHGAI IL-KHANID FAMILY, WE NOTE THAT RESURGENCE OF ISLAMIC INFLUENCE SUGGESTS THIS WAS TOO FACILE

I SPENT TWO HOURS WITH ARDESHIR ZAHEDI EVENING DECEMBER 13. HE CONTINUES TO CHURN THE LOCAL WATERS, BUT IT IS NOT ENTIRELY APPARENT IN WHICH DIRECTION HE IS HEADING. IT IS CLEAR THAT HE HAS BEEN ACTIVELY INVOLVED IN PRO-SHAH DEMONSTRATIONS OF PAST TWO DAYS, ALTHOUGH HE DENIED MY SUGGESTION THAT HE HAD FINANCED THE DREAM OF AYATOLLAH GHOMI IN MASHAD. (HOWEVER, WHILE I WAS WITH HIM, HE RECEIVED NEWS THAT SIX THOUSAND TELFGRAMS HE HAD COMMISSIONED HAD BEEN DELIVERED TO THE GOOD AYATOLLAH.)

HE GAVE ME MORE DETAILS ABOUT THE ARRANGEMENTS WHICH HAD BEEN MADE FOR THE DEMONSTRATIONS ON DECEMBER 10 AND TOOK FULL CREDIT FOR THEIR NON-VIOLENCE. HE SAID THE MILITARY WERE CHAFING FOR ACTION AGAINST KHOMEINI SUPPORTERS AND THAT HE HAD RESTRAINED THEM BY RESORT TO HIS DEAR FATHER'S MEMORY AND A TELEPHONE CALL FROM THE SHAH. HE CLAIMED PRIME MINISTER AZHARI HAD SUBMITTED HIS RESIGNATION IN THE TRAUMA AND HAD IT REJECTED.

IN HIS BEST GRASSHOPPER STYLE, HE LED ME THROUGH A LONG LIST OF PEOPLE HE HAD BEEN SEEING AND GAVE THE IMPRESSION HE WAS PLAYING BOTH SIDES OF THE STREET. HE WAS SEEING OFF A KHOMEINI SUPPORTER AS I ARRIVED AND CLAIMED TO BE DINING WITH THE PRIME MINISTER. FROM ALL THIS, THERE EMERGED THE GENERAL IMPRESSION THAT HE WAS OPPOSED TO THE SHAH'S NEGOTIATIONS WITH THE NATIONAL FRONT. ON THE OTHER HAND, HE SAID HE WAS HAVING TEA WITH SANJABI DECEMBER 14, TO PREPARE THE LATTER FOR HIS MEETING WITH THE SHAH.

IN DISCUSSING THE IMMEDIATE FUTURE, HE SAID HE FAVORED A GOVERNMENT UNDER ALI-AMINI, WHO WOULD HAVE THE COMPETENCE TO GET THE ECONOMY MOVING. HE FELT THAT A FEW NATIONAL FRONT TYPES MIGHT BE ABLE TO JOIN, BUT HE VERY MUCH DOUBTED THAT SANJABI AND COMPANY COULD FORM A GOVERNMENT. HE WAS UNCOMPLIMENTARY TO SADIQI AND SEVERAL OTHER NATIONAL FRONT TYPES, ALL OF WHOM HE CALLED BY THEIR FIRST NAMES AND ALL OF WHOM WERE ALLEGEDLY RELATED TO HIM OR "GREW UP WITH ME LIKE A BROTHER."

HE THEN READ ME A LIST OF NAMES OF DISTINGUISHED CITIZENS HE WAS INVITING TO LUNCH IN THE NEXT FEW DAYS, AND WHOM HE WOULD THEN TAKE ON TO SEE THE SHAH. HE SAID THESE WERE PEOPLE WHOM HE EXPECTED TO RECRUIT AS ADVOCATES OF THE MONARCHY. THEY WOULD BE SENT AROUND THE COUNTRY ON SPEAKING ENGAGEMENTS TO MAKE CLEAR THAT IT HAS IMPORTANT THE SHAH REMAIN IN PLACE. I WAS STRUCK BY THE FACT THAT ABOUT HALF OF THEM WERE ON THE LIST OF THE COUNCIL OF REGENCY BEING PROPOSED BY MINATCHI (TEHRAN 12168).

I THEREFORE GAVE HIM THE OTHER NAMES ON THAT COUNCIL (WITH THE EXCEPTION OF THE MILITARY) WITHOUT IDENTIFYING THEIR ORIGIN, AND HE EAGERLY ADDED THEM TO HIS LUNCHEON LIST. (THIS IS GETTING TO BE VERY PERSIAN.)

AFTER ALL THIS PARSIFLAGE, WE GOT DOWN TO MY THREE TARGETS FOR THE EVENING--NIOC, THE CENTRAL BANK, AND THE MINISTRY OF FINANCE. HE CONFIRMED THAT ANSARY HAD SUBMITTED HIS RESIGNATION FROM NIOC, BUT READ ME SOME NONSENSE FROM THE NIOC CHARTER WHICH PROVED THAT NEITHER MINA NOR NABEGH COULD BECOME CHAIRMAN BECAUSE THE CHAIRMAN HAD TO HAVE BEEN EITHER A MINISTER OR AN NIOC DIRECTOR FOR FIVE YEARS. HOWEVER, THERE MIGHT BE SOME WAY TO MAKE EITHER MINA OR NABEGH ACTING CHAIRMAN. HE CONFIRMED WHAT THE SHAH HAD TOLD ME THAT HE HAD OFFERED THE JOB TO BOTH ALI-AMINI AND ENTEZAM, EACH OF WHOM HAD DECLINED.
(THEY WOULD HAVE BEEN DISASTERS.)

AFTER DISCUSSION OF NIOC, I TURNED TO THE BANKING SYSTEM AND THE FINANCE MINISTRY. I SAID THEY WERE BOTH A DISGRACE AND SOMEONE SHOULD CLEAN HOUSE AT BOTH PLACES. HE TOOK NOTES AND PROMISED TO GET SOME OF HIS "PEOPLE" AFTER IT. I TOLD HIM OF MY CONVERSATION (TEHRAN 12163) WITH HOUSHANG RAM. HE SAID HE WOULD FOLLOW UP.

COMMENT: ZAHEDI HAS MORE ENERGY THAN MOST PERSIANS, BUT DISSIPATES IT SO BROADLY THAT HIS EFFECTIVENESS IS QUESTIONABLE. IF HE (OR ANYONE ELSE) WOULD CONCENTRATE ON THE TRULY IMPORTANT JOB OF GETTING THE ECONOMY WORKING AGAIN, THERE MIGHT BE TIME FOR ALL THESE FLIGHTS OF INTRIGUE WHICH BRING VENERABLE GENTLEMEN TOGETHER FOR EXERCISES IN CONSTITUTIONAL LOGIC.

WHILE IT SEEMS THAT SUCH EXCURSIONS ARE IMPORTANT TO THE PERSIAN PSYCHE AND MAY, INDEED, ULTIMATELY DISSIPATE ALL THE TENSION THAT HAS BEEN BUILT UP IN RECENT TIMES, I CONTINUE TO BE FRUSTRATED IN MY EFFORT TO FIND SOME PERSONS OF RESPONSIBILITY ------------------000223 140741Z /12 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 2196 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 12203 EXDIS WHO WILL TAKE A SERIOUS INTEREST IN THE ECONOMIC STAGNATION AFFLICTING THIS COUNTRY. NATURALLY, THEY HAVE ALL TAKEN A TWO-DAY WEEKEND AND IT WILL BE SATURDAY, DECEMBER 16,BEFORE I CAN FIND ANOTHER NOSE TO GRIND. SULLIVAN

AMBASSADOR AND DCM HAVE HAD SEVERAL TELEPHONE CONVERSATIONS WITH MR. PEROT. DCM OR COUNSELOR FOR CONSULAR AFFAIRS HAVE BEEN IN DAILY TOUCH WITH EDS OFFICIALS GAYLORD AND CHIAPPARONE AND HAVE BEEN DOING EVERYTHING POSSIBLE TO ASSIST THEM. CONSULAR SECTION ORIGINALLY HELD PASSPORTS OF TWO EDS WITH THEIR PERMISSION AS PART OF AN AGREEMENT WITH THE FOREIGN REGISTRATION BUREAU WHICH WAS READY TO ARREST AND JAIL TWO INDIVIDUALS. APPARENTLY THE MINISTRY OF JUSTICE HAS ISSUED AN ORDER THAT THE TWO ARE NOT TO BE ALLOWED TO LEAVE THE COUNTRY BECAUSE THEY ARE WANTED AS MATERIAL WITNESSES IN THE FUTURE CORRUPTION TRIAL OF MINISTRY OF HEALTH OFFICIALS.

COUNSELOR FOR CONSULAR AFFAIRS HAS INFORMED THE TWO OFFICIALS THAT THEY MAY HAVE THEIR PASSPORTS AT ANY TIME THEY WISH BUT THEY HAVE ALSO BEEN WARNED THAT THE AIRPORT POLICE HAVE BEEN ALERTED TO ARREST THEM SHOULD THEY ATTEMPT TO DEPART COUNTRY.

THE COMPANY HAS AS ITS LEGAL COUNSEL MATIN DAFTARI, A WELL-KNOWN LAWYER AND LEADING FIGURE IN THE HUMAN RIGHTS MOVEMENT IN IRAN, AND WE HAVE BEEN URGING EDS TO GET HIM ACTIVATED TO ASCERTAIN THE PRECISE NATURE OF THE INFORMATION WANTED FROM THE EDS OFFICIALS. WE ALSO ARE ATTEMPTING TO ASCERTAIN THE SAME INFORMATION THROUGH A CONTACT IN THE MINISTRY OF JUSTICE. ADDITIONALLY, WE HAVE INFORMED AMBASSADOR ZAHEDI OF THE SITUATION AND HE HAS PROMISED TO DO HIS BEST TO GAIN PERMISSION FOR THE TWO OFFICIALS TO LEAVE IRAN ON THE BASIS OF THE PERSONAL WORD OF MR.
PEROT THAT THESE INDIVIDUALS OR ANY OTHER EDS OFFICIALS WILL RETURN TO IRAN WHEN THEY ARE NEEDED TO PRESENT EVIDENCE.
EFFORTS TO ASSIST THE TWO EDS OFFICIALS HAVE BEEN HAMPERED BY DECEMBER 7-11 CLOSEDOWN OF ALL GOVERNMENT ACTIVITIES. PLEASE ASSURE MR. PEROT THAT WE ARE DOING

AYATOLLAH GHOMI HAS DENIED STORY ABOUT HIS DREAM REPORTED REFTEL. HE HAS REPORTEDLY BLAMED GOVT PEOPLE WHO WANT TO DESTROY HIS POSITION WITH HIS FOLLOWERS FOR CONCOCTING THE STORY. THIS DENIAL WAS MADE DIRECTLY TO CORRESPONDENTS (INCLUDING BBC'S WHITLEY) YESTERDAY (DEC 13) AND IS GETTING OUT TO THE PUBLIC. POL COUNSELOR HAS CONFIRMED DENIAL THROUGH SOURCE WITH GOOD ACCESS. SOURCE ALSO CONFIRMED FALSENESS OF LATER RUMOR, WHICH SPREAD AROUND TEHRAN DEC 13, THAT AYATOLLAH GHOMI WAS DEAD. HE IS REPORTEDLY ALIVE AT HOME BUT NOT SEEING VISITORS.

COMMENT: THIS LUDICROUS AFFAIR STILL HAS PUZZLING ASPECTS TO IT. FOR EXAMPLE, IT IS NOT CLEAR WHY GHOMI REMAINS IN SECLUSION, RATHER THAN THUNDERING HIS DENIAL IN RIGHTEOUS INDIGNATION. ASSUMING GOVT MONEY WAS BEHIND HIS "DREAM" IN SOME WAY, COULD IT BE GHOMI AGREED TO THE PLOY (IN RETURN FOR SUFFICIENT REIMBURSEMENT) BUT WAS THEN SCARED INTO DENYING IT BY THREATS FROM KHOMEINI FORCES? WHOSE THREATS ARE MORE TO BE FEARED -- THE GOVT'S OR THOSE FROM KHOMEINI'S PEOPLE? WE SUPPOSE QUESTIONS SUCH AS THESE MUST BE PUZZLING MANY OTHERS IN IRAN, AMONG THEM SOME OF GHOMI'S FAITHFUL FOLLOWERS.

MISSION WOULD LIKE TO KNOW ASAP NAME OF ACADEMIC WHO GAVE TAVASSOLI (AKA TAVAKOLI) NAME TO DEPARTMENT. SERIOUS QUESTION HAS ARRSEN AS TO BONA FIDES OF TAVASSOLI, INCLUDING POSSIBILITY HE MAY BE A GOI-CONTROLLED SOURCE, EITHER KNOWN OR UNKNOWN.TO HIS NATIONAL FRONT COLLEAGUES.
SEPTEL DEC 14 REPORTS KKBLQE CONVERSATION WITH TAVASSOLI IDENTIIIED AS "LMI SOURCE." SULLIVAN

1978TEHRAN12249.subject: LIBERATION MOVEMENT OF IRAN (LMI) VIEWS OF RECENT EVENTS SUMMARY: LIBERATION MOVEMENT OF IRAN (LMI) SOURCE

segments.text: RECENT EVENTS SUMMARY: LIBERATION MOVEMENT OF IRAN (LMI) SOURCE OFFERED LMI VIEW OF TASSUA/ASHURA DEMONSTRATIONS AND CALLED FORCEFULLY ON U.S. TO DUMP SHAH. EMBOFF RESTATED SUPPORT FOR COALITION GOVERNMENT UNDER SHAH. END SUMMARY.

LMI SOURCE TELEPHONED EMBOFF STEMPEL AT HOME EVENING DEC 13, PREPARED TO DISGORGE FULL LMI LINE ON RECENT NONVIOLENT TEHRAN DEMONSTRATIONS DEC 10-11 (TASSUA AND ASHURA). SOURCE SAID LMI CROWD COUNT WAS BETWEEN 1 AND 1.5 MILLION DEC 10 AND 1.7-2.0 MILLION DEC 11. EMBOFF SUGGESTED THESE WERE HIGHER THAN ESTIMATES BY PRESSMEN AND OTHERS WHO ATTENDED RALLIES, BUT SOURCE STUCK TO HIS FIGURES.

LMI BELIEVED DEMONSTRATIONS WERE A "WALKING REFERENDUM" AGAINST SHAH. SPIRIT OF PEOPLE WAS TREMENDOUS AND UPLIFTING. FACT THAT PARADE WENT OFF PEACEFULLY SHOWED WHAT COULD HAPPEN IF SHAH "GAVE UP POWER" OVER PART OF TEHRAN AND KEPT HIS TROOPS AND SECURITY PEOPLE OUT OF THE WAY. PARADE ALSO SHOWED NATIONAL FRONT COULD ORGANIZE GOVERNMENT. SOURCE DESCRIBED THOSE WHO MARCHED AS "TIP OF ICEBERG" AND SAID EVENT SHOWED OVERWHELMING SENTIMENT FOR GETTING RID OF SHAH. EMBOFF ASKED ABOUT PRO-SHAH EFFORTS OF PAST TWO DAYS. SOURCE REPLIED THESE WERE GOVERNMENT PROVOCATIONS--IN ISFAHAN GOI TROOPS HAD TURNED VIOLENT AND WERE "MASSACRING" PEOPLE. WHENEVER GOI GOT INVOLVED, THERE SEEMED TO BE TROUBLE.

IN RESPONSE TO QUESTION, SOURCE SAID LMI COULD NOT REALLY GIVE ACCURATE FIGURES ON CASUALTIES, SINCE SOLDIERS "WERE HUNTING DOWN PEOPLE IN THEIR HOME, EVEN BY HELICOPTER IF NECESSARY." HE THOUGHT KILLED NUMBERED BETWEEN 50 AND 2000, HOWEVER. (NOTE; THIS SUBSTANTIALLY EXCEEDS FIGURES REPORTED BY U.S. CONSUL ISFAHAN AND APPEARS TO REPRESENT LMI/NATIONAL FRONT (INF) PROPAGANDA "PITCH.")

SOURCE THEN STATED EVENTS OF PAST FEW DAYS SHOWED U.S. SHOULD FORCE SHAH TO LEAVE. EMBOFF GAVE STANDARD DISCLAIMER THAT U.S. HAS THAT POWER OR WANTS TO INTERVENE IN IRAN. SOURCE REPLIED "U.S. IS ALWAYS AGAINST PEOPLE, FROM VIETNAM TO IRAN." EMBOFF THEN UNLOADED SOMEWHAT SHARPLY ON SOURCE, CHALLENGING HIS PROPAGANDISTIC VIEW OF EVENTS. EMBOFF THEN REITERATED U.S. POSITION THAT COALITION GOVERNMENT REPRESENTED BETTER WAY TO ACHIEVE LMI/INF GOALS THAN CONTINUED CONFRONTATION. WHY DIDN'T INF USE ITS NEW-FOUND CONFIDENCE TO CREATE GOVERNMENT? SOURCE REPLIED WITH FAMILIAR LITANY ON DISTRUST OF SHAH.
RUFFLED FEATHERS WERE SMOOTHED OVER, AND SOURCE OFFERED TO PROVIDE SOME ADDITIONAL DOCUMENTATION ON ASHURA RALLIES WITHIN NEXT FEW DAYS. EMBOFF ACCEPTED GLADLY.

COMMENT: FLAVOR OF ABOVE IS SIMILAR TO COMMENTS FROM VAST MAJORITY OF OUR OTHER INF-SUPPORTING CONTACTS. THOUGH TAVASSOLI HAS ALWAYS BEEN A HARD-LINER, PERHAPS BECAUSE HE IS "OFFICIAL" LMI CONTACT WITH EMBASSY, HIS VIEW THAT PEACEFUL NATURE OF DEMONSTRATIONS MERELY UNDERLINED NATIONAL FRONT STRENGTH AND WAS REASON TO PRESS CHALLENGE TO GOI AUTHORITY IS ALSO PROMINENT AMONG COMMITTED INF MEMBERS. IF THOUGHTS OF MORE CONCILIATORY STRATEGY ARE BEING DISCUSSED, THEY ARE NOT YET REFLECTED IN INF SUPPORTERS' PUBLIC TALK. SULLIVAN

TEHRAN CONTINUES TO BE REMARKABLY QUIET. PROTESTORS ARE NOT TAKING TO THE STREETS AT ALL. EXCEPT FOR STRIKES AND THE NIGHTLY POWER OUTAGE, OPPOSITION ACTIVITY IS TEMPORARILY HALTED, INCLUDING THE CAMPAIGN OF HARRASSMENT AGAINST AMERICANS. THERE HAS BEEN CONSIDERABLE PRO-SHAH ACTIVITY WITH MARCHES IN A NUMBER OF TOWNS INCLUDING ARAK, ABADAN, AND MASHAD. LARGEST CONFIRMED DEMONSTRATION TOOK PLACE IN ISFAHAN WITH ABOUT 20,000 MARCHERS. STORY OF AYATOLLAH'S GHOMI'S DREAM IS STILL MAKING THE ROUNDS ALTHOUGH GOI NEWS SERVICE HAS IGNORED IT. THAT MAY BE JUST AS WELL, BECAUSE WE HAVE REPORTS GHOMI HAS DENIED HAVING THE VISION. REPORTS YESTERDAY THAT HE HAD DIED FROM HEART ATTACK WERE INCORRECT.

REGARDLESS OF TRUTH OF GOI INVOLVEMENT IN THE AFFAIR, PRO-GOVT FORCES HAVE SEIZED OPPORTUNITY TO MOBILIZE PRO-SHAH SENTIMENT. WE HAVE RUMORS OF PRO-SHAH RALLIES TO BE STAGED IN TEHRAN TODAY OR TOMORROW, BUT SO FAR NONE HAS MATERIALIZED. IN ISFAHAN, ORDER IS RESTORED TO THE EXTENT THAT THE CURFEW HAS BEEN CHANGED TO 2200-0600.

PRO-SHAH ACTIVITY HAS GENERALLY BEEN NON-VIOLENT APART FROM TEARING DOWN PICTURES OF KHOMEINI AND COERCING PEOPLE TO DISPLAY SHAH'S PICTURE. IN SHIRAZ, HOWEVER, WHICH HAS SO OFTEN BEEN QUIET WHEN THE REST OF IRAN HAD TROUBLE, SITUATION IS UGLY. SOLE IMPORTANT ANTI-SHAH DEMONSTRATION IS THE ONGOING RALLY WITHIN MEDICAL SCHOOL COMPOUND. EVENING OF DEC 12 ABOUT 2230 (I.E. AFTER CURFEW) A GANG OF TOUGHS STORMED MEDICAL SCHOOL AND ASSAULTED PROTESTORS. YESTERDAY MEDICAL STUDENTS RESPONDED WITH ANOTHER ANTISHAH RALLY. AFTER 2 HOURS TROOPS MOVED IN AND ARRESTED 4 LEADERS. THIS WAS FOLLOWED SHORTLY THEREAFTER BY PROSHAH CAR CARAVAN, DRIVERS HONKING TO SHOW SUPPORT FOR REGIME.

CONSUL SAYS TODAY THE PROGRAM HAS CHANGED TO SHOWING HEADLIGHTS FOR THE SHAH. PROS AND ANTIS HAVE ALSO STEPPED UP THEIR SPRAY PAINT CAMPAIGN, COVERING CITY WITH SLOGANS. TENSION IS HEIGHTENED BY BASICALLY UNRELATED INCIDENT LAST NIGHT BETWEEN MUSLIMS AND BAHAIS. MUSLIMS APPARENTLY BURNED HOUSE OF A BAHAI NEAR TOMB OF SAIDI. RELATIVE OF VICTIM WHO HAPPENED TO BE A SOLDIER AND HENCE ARMED WITH SUBMACHINE GUN, ARRIVED AND AVENGED HIS FAMILY. SECURITY FORCES SAY 10-12 DIED IN SHOOTOUT. IN OTHER PROTEST ACTION, CROWD VISITED ACTING PAHLAVI UNIVERSITY CHANCELLOR BAHMANI AND SAT IN OVERNIGHT.

CONSULATE TABRIZ REPORTS CLASH BETWEEN PROS AND ANTIS TODAY. GROUP OF CIVIL SERVANTS AND RETIRED MILITARY WERE PUTTING A PRO-SHAH DEMONSTRATION AND PEOPLE (OBSERVERS) STARTING BEATING THEM. TWO STREETS ARE CLOSED AND FIGHTING STILL CONTINUES.

GULF AND OIL FIELD REGION CONTINUES NERVOUS ATMOSPHERE. CLUB ROOM AND BAR OF BRITISH FAIRCLOUGH COMPANY WERE BURNED YESTERDAY IN GACHSARAN. AHWAZ IS TENSE BUT TEMPORARILY INCIDENT-FREE. BUSHEHR HAS SEVERAL INCIDENTS EACH DAY.

HEAD OF TEACHERS UNION INFORMED US THAT ABOUT 15 PERCENT OF SCHOOLS (IN REY) FAILED TO OPEN. ALTHOUGH MOST STUDENTS AND TEACHERS ATTENDED, INSTRUCTORS DID NOT ACTUALLY TEACH. IN PROVINCES, HE ESTIMATES 80-90 PERCENT REMAINED CLOSED. HE ADDED THAT IT IS NOT KNOWN WHEN SECONDARY SCHOOLS WILL OPEN. GOVT FEARS STUDENTS WOULD RESPOND BY CLOSING NOT ONLY THEM BUT ALSO PRIMARY SCHOOLS.

THE EVENTS OF NOVEMBER 4 AND 5 (STATE 303228) ARE NOW HISTORY HERE AND THE FULL TRUTH WILL PROBABLY NEVER BE KNOWN. BY NOVEMBER 4 THE MILITARY HAD BECOME VERY FRUSTRATED BY THE RESTRAINTS IMPOSED BY THE SHARIF-EMAMI GOVERNMENT. ALTHOUGH MARTIAL LAW HAD BEEN IN EFFECT SINCE SEPTEMBER 8, THE ATTEMPTS OF THE MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES TO CARRY OUT THE MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS WERE REPEATEDLY OVERRULED BY THE PRIME MINSITER. THE NUMBER AND SIZE OF DEMONSTRATIONS WERE STEADILY INCREASING--MUCH LIKE THE PATTERN OF LATE AUGUST AND EARLY SEPTEMBER--AND IT WAS CLEAR THAT THE SHARIF-EMAMI GOVERNMENT AND MARTIAL LAW WERE UNDER HEAVY CHALLENGE ON THE STREETS.

IN OUR VIEW THE DESTRUCTION AND BURNING WERE PERPETRATED BY A NUMBER OF DIFFERENT GROUPS. EARLY IN THE DAY WELL-ORGANIZED SMALL CADRES--PROBABLY A MIXTURE OF LEFTIST AND KHOMEINI SUPPORTERS--PEELED OFF FROM THE CROWDS, SET FIRE TO SELECTED TARGETS (CINEMAS, BANKS, AIRLINE OFFICES, FOREIGN CAR IMPORTERS, ETC.) AND IN ADDITION AS THE DAY WORE ON, WE SUSPECT THAT PERSONAL GRUDGES AND ANTI-MINORITY SENTIMENTS PLAYED A ROLE IN TARGET SELECTION AND THAT UNDIRECTED VANDALISM TOOK PLACE.

WE HAVE PROBED HARD BUT SO FAR HAVE FOUND NO EVIDENCE THAT SAVAK OR THE MILITARY PLAYED DIRECT ROLES. THE MILITARY STOOD BY AND WATCHED BUT SENIOR OFFICERS HAVE VEHEMENTLY TOLD US THAT SHARIF-EMAMI DIRECTLY ORDERED THAT NO MILITARY FORCE BE USED.

PROBABLY MOST IRANIANS--TO THE EXTENT THAT THEY NOW THINK OF EVENTS ON THOSE DAYS--BELIEVE THE ARMY PROVOKED OR DIRECTLY CAUSED THE VIOLENCE IN ORDER TO PREPARE THE POPULACE FOR A MILITARY GOVERNMENT. WE DO NOT BELIEVE, HOWEVER, THAT THESE VIEWS ARE A SIGNIFICANT FACTOR IN THE CURRENT POLITICAL JOCKEYING EXCEPT AS A REMINDER TO ALO THAT THE MILITARY MUST BE TAKEN INTO ACCOUNT IN THE POLITICAL/POWER EQUATION.
WE HAVE REPLIED SEPARATELY TO YOUR QUESTION ON THE KURDS. (STATE 306748). SULLIVAN

THE EVIDENCE IS NOT YET CONCLUSIVE IN ALL RESPECTS BUT THE PRO-SHAH DEMONSTRATIONS ARE CERTAINLY RECEIVING THE SUPPORT OF THE GOVERNMENT AND THE MILITARY IN REACTION TO THE ANTI-SHAH MARCHES OF DECEMBER 10-11. SOME OF THE PROSHAH ACTIVITIES IN THE WAKE OF AYATOLLAH GHOMI'S DREAM MAY HAVE HAD A DEGREE OF SPONTANEITY. OVER THE LAST FEW WEEKS WE HAVE SEEN SOME--NOT YET MAJOR--BACKLASH BY THE POPULACE TO THE CONTINUING STRIKES AND DEMONSTRATIONS WHICH ARE STARTING TO CAUSE REAL HARDSHIPS FOR THE POORER FOLK, AND DISRUPTING THE LIFE OF MERCHANTS AND OTHERS.
THE GOVERNMENT, OR AT LEAST SOME FIGURES IN IT, ARE ATTEMPTING TO CAPITALIZE ON THIS SENTIMENO TO STRENGTHEN THE HAND OF THE REGIME IN THE POLITICAL NEGOTIATIONS.
WE TEND TO DOUBT THAT THE SHAH IS DIRECTLY INVOLVED-HE IS RATHER CYNICAL ABOUT THE EFFECTIVENESS OF SUCH EFFORTS--BUT SUSPECT THAT ZAHEDI AND CERTAIN GENERALS ARE RATHER DEEPLY ENGAGED.

WE HAVE REPORTED SEPARATELY CONSUL SHIRAZ'S VIEW OF THE ANTI-BAHAI ACTIVITY IN THAT CITY. WHILE WE DO NOT TOTALLY DISCOUNT THE POSSIBILITY THAT PRO-SHAH ELEMENTS WOULD ENGAGE IN "BLACK" ACTIVITIES AGAINST MINORITIES TO DARKEN THE REPUTATION OF THE OPPOSITION IN FOREIGN EYES, WE STRONGLY DOUBT THAT SUCH OPERATIONS ARE SIGNIFICANT WHEN COMPARED TO THOSE BY RIGHTIST ELEMENTS.

THE STRONG REACTION OF THE MILITARY IN SOME CITIES AND THE ORGANIZATION OF PRO-SHAH CROWDS FURTHER HINDER EFFORTS TO BRIDGE THE CREDIBILITY GAP BETWEEN THE REGIME AND THE OPPOSITION BUT SO FAR HAVE NOT BEEN SO SERIOUSLY VIEWED AS TO PREVENT TALKS FROM TAKING PLACE (SEPTEL). SULLIVAN
REFTEL MESSAGE DELIVERED TO COURT MORNING DECEMBER 15. DEPUTY COURT MINISTER CAME TO OFFICE TO RECEIVE MESSAGE AND ASSURED US IT WOULD BE TRANSMITTED DIRECTLY TO SHAH.
WE WOULD EXPECT ANSWER TO BE DELIVERED IN NORMAL MANNER THROUGH IRANIAN EMBASSY WASHINGTON. SULLIVAN

SUMMARY: TEHRAN, ISFAHAN, TABRIZ QUIET DECEMBER 15, SMALL GROUP DEMONSTRATIONS IN SHIRAZ. PRIME MINISTER CALLS ON ALL CIVIL SERVANTS TO GO BACK TO WORK DECEMBER 16 OR FACE DISMISSAL AND LOSS OF PAY. OIL PRODUCTION AT 1.34 MILLION BARRELS DECEMBER 15. POWER STRIKERS APPEAR TO HAVE GOVERNMENT BUFFALOED. TALKS BETWEEN GOVERNMENT AND OPPOSITION CONTINUE. END SUMMARY.

TEHRAN, ISFAHAN AND TABRIZ ARE QUIET. THERE ARE NO REPORTED DEMONSTRATIONS IN TEHRAN AS OF EARLY AFTERNOON DECEMBER 15. IN ISFAHAN, SEVERAL SMALL GROUPS OF PROSHAH DEMONSTRATORS ARE WANDERING THE STREETS, BUT THERE IS NO VIOLENT ACTIVITY. CONSUL HAS BEEN INFORMED THEY WILL REMAIN UNTIL DECEMBER 16, WHEN STATUES TO REPLACE THOSE PULLED DOWN WILL BE UNVEILED. TWO AMERICANS WERE LIGHTLY INJURED WHEN THEIR AUTOMOBILE PASSED ISFAHAN STREET DEMONSTRATION AFTERNOON DECEMBER 15. PAIR DID NOT HAVE LIGHTS ON, AND WHEN CROWD BEGAN THROWING ROCKS, CAR SWERVED INTO TREE. WHEN CROWD DISCOVERED DRIVER AND PASSENGER WERE AMERICANS, HOWEVER, DEMONSTRATORS ASSISTED PAIR.

AFTER YESTERDAY'S ATTACKS ON BAHAI HOMES (REPORTED SEPTELS), SHIRAZ IS QUIET EXCEPT FOR GROUPS OF TEENAGERS WHO HAVE ATTACKED SOME OTHER BAHAI HOMES BUT WERE CHASED OFF BY ARMY. CONSUL OBSERVED KIDS FORMING UP, BEGINNING COMMOTION AND BEING CHASED AWAY, ONLY TO REFORM AGAIN. NUMBER OF OLDER RESIDENTS ARE TAKING ADVANTAGE OF GOOD WEATHER TO WATCH THIS CAT-AND-MOUSE GAME. SIT-IN CONTINUES AT PAHLAVI UNIVERSITY MEDICAL SCHOOL IN SHIRAZ. CONSUL REPORTS MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES HAVE DECIDED TO LET GROUP (WHICH IS SMALLER THAN DECEMBER 14 GROUP) REMAIN AND NOT CHASE THEM OUT.

IN TELEVISED INTERVIEW ON T.V. EVENING DECEMBER 14, PRIME MINISTER AZHARI ONCE AGAIN CRITICIZED ENEMIES OF COUNTRY FOR DISRUPTIVE ACTIVITIES. PERSIANS WHO WATCHED BROADCAST HAVE COMMENTED THAT HE TOOK MORE MORAL TONE THAN PREVIOUSLY, DESCRIBING DISRUPTIVE ACTIVITIES AS "CRIME AND SIN". PRIME MINISTER ANNOUNCED THAT ALL CIVIL SERVANTS SHOULD REPORT FOR WORK MORNING DECEMBER 16 OR RISK LOSS OF PAY AND FIRING. BIG QUESTION IN EVERYONE'S MIND IS WHETHER GOI MEANS WHAT IT SAYS THIS TIME AND WHETHER IT WILL ENFORCE ANNOUNCEMENT.

KEY SECTORS OF OIL AND POWER ARE NOT RPT NOT VERY ENCOURAGING. OIL PRODUCTION REMAINED LOW AT 1.34 MILLION BARRELS PER DAY (SEE REPTEL FOR DETAILS AND STRIKE REPORT). EMBOFF HAD CHANCE TO TALK WITH TAVANIR (ELECTRIC) COMPANY ENGINEERING CONSUTS WHO REPORT STRIKERS HAVE TOLD ARMY THAT IF TROOPS ENTER POWER STATIONS, THEY WILL SHUT DOWN ENTIRE COUNTRY. THEIR DEMANDS ARE POLITICAL.

CONSULTANTS EXPRESSED OPINIONTHATUNLESS ARMY HAS TRAINED ENGINEERS AND IS READY TO USE WELL-PLANNED FORCE TO RECAPTURE CONTROL OF POWER STATIONS, GOI HAS NO RPT NO HOPE OF GETTING STRIKERS TO CUT DOWN ON POWER OUTTAGES WHICH ARE NOW REGULAR DAILY OCCURENCE IN MAJOR CITIES (TEHRAN GRID HAS BEEN OUT PAST THREE NIGHTS BETWEEN ROUGHLY 9 AND 12 P.M.

IN SEPARATE CONVERSATION, AMBASSADOR TALKED WITH HARZA COMPANY VICE PRESIDENT WHO REPORTED ON HIS RECENT VISIT TO REZA SHAH KABIR DAM. THERE, SOURCE SAID, POWER ENGINEERS ON SIGNAL FROM SOMEWHERE, DROP OUTPUT FROM 400 MEGAWATTS TO 20, THEN BRING IT BACK UP AT VARYING TIME INTERVALS. PROBLEM, SAYS HARZA VP, IS NOT ONLY WHAT THIS DOES TO GENERATORS, BUT FACT THAT POWER ENGINEERS HAVE NO IDEA HOW THEY SHOULD BE BLEEDING OFF WATER WHICH IS BUILDING UP BEHIND DAM. CANADIAN WATER CONTROL ENGINEERS APPARENTLY HAVE BEEN BANNED FROM SITE.

WHILE SPIRIT OF IMPENDING POLITICAL CONFRONTATION WHICH PROCEEDED ASHURA A WEEK AGO IS ABSENT, FEELING IS GROWING AMONG PERSIANS AND FOREIGNERS WHO ARE IN POSITION TO ASSESS IMPACT OF AFFECTED ACTIVITIES--BANKING, INDUSTRIAL PRODUCTION, ETC.--THAT COMING WEEK WILL BE MAKEOR-BREAK TIME FOR GOI IN POLITICO-ECONOMIC ARENA. IT IS NOT YET CLEAR WHETHER THIS WILL HAVE PRIMARILY POSITIVE OR NEGATIVE AFFECTS ON COMPROMISE TALKS NOW GOING ON BETWEEN GOI AND OPPOSITION, BUT BOTH SIDES WILL BE WATCHING INTENTLY GOI'S EFFORTS OVER NEXT TWO OR THREE DAYS. TALKS ARE CONTINUING AND ARE BEING REPORTED SEPTELS, NOTAL.

IRAN CONTINUED TO HAVE SCATTERED PRO-SHAH DEMONSTRATIONS YESTERDAY, OCCASIONALLY LEADING TO CLASHES WITH ANTISHAH GROUPS. TEHRAN WAS GENERALLY QUIET. A GROUP OF 155 PRO-SHAH YOUTHS DEMONSTRATED SOUTH OF NIAVARAN PALACE AROUND NOON YESTERDAY.ABOUT THE SAME TIME A GROUP OF ANTISHAH DEMONSTRATORS RALLIED PRIEFLY IN FRONT OF ABBAS-APAD MILITARY COMPOUND. NEITHER DEMONSTRATION LED TO VIOLENCE. A FEW SHOTS WERE HEARD IN QEYTARIFH AREA, (APPARENTLY FIRED AT CURFEW VIOLATION) AND OF COURSE POWER WAS CUT THROUGHOUT MUCH OF THE CITY LAST NIGHT. IN FENERAL, 1HE LULL CONTINUES IN TEHRAN. TODAY SHOPS ARE OPEN AND NO INCIDENTS REPORTED TO MIDDAY.
CONSULATE SHIRAZ REPORTS CITY HAS CALMED DOWN AFTER RECENT MOSLEM ATTACKS ON BAHAIS AND JEWS.

SOME PROBLEMS WERE REPORTED IN PROVINCES. PRO-SHAH RALLIES TOOK PLACE IN REZAIYEH AND MALAYER YESTERDAY. GOVT. RADIO REPORTS CLASH BETWEEN PROS AND ANTIS IN REZAIYEH, WITH SECURITY FORCES INTERVENING. GOVT. SAYS 5 WERE KILLED AND 12 WOUNDED. AFP REPORTS VIOLENCE IN QOM DECEMBER 14-15 WITH 3 DEAD. MLA IN QOM IN EFFECT CONFIRMED DISTURBANCES BY ANNOUNCING YESTERDAY THAT CURFEW IS ADVANCED FROM 22:00 TO 21:00. AFP ALSO REPORTS CONTINUED SERIOUS TROUBLE IN MASHAD, CLAIMING OPPOSITION HAS CONTROL OF STREETS, BUT WE HAVE NO CONFIRMATION. GOVT HAS ISSUED INSTRUCTIONS TO USE FORCE TO QUELL ANY THREAT TO PUBLIC ORDER REGARDLESS OF THE MOTIVES OF THE DEMONSTRATORS.
IF IMPLEMENTED, THIS ORDER SHOULD PREVENT PRO-REGIME RALLIES AS WELL AS OPPOSITION GATHERINGS.

PRIMIN AZHARI HAS ALSO ISSUED TOUGH STATEMENT REGARDING STRIKERS, SAYING HE WILL SEEK PARLIAMENTARY APPROVAL TO DISMISS STRIKING CIVIL SERVANTS. ON THE HEELS OF THIS ANNOUNCEMENT, HOWEVER, AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI URGED PEOPLE TO CONTINUE STRIKES, PARTICULARLY IN OIL INDUSTRY, AND TO WITHHOLD TAXES. HE ALSO DECLARED DECEMBER 18 A NATIONAL DAY OF MOURNING (I.E. GENERAL STRIKE). IF DAY FOLLOWS PATTERN OF PREVIOUS MOURNING DAYS, WE WILL HAVE A FAIR NUMBER OF SHOPS OPENING INITIALLY BUT ALMOST TOTAL CLOSURES BY AFTERNOON.

THERE MAY BE TEMPORARY LIFTING OF KEY STRIKE AT CENTRAL BANK. JUSTICE MINISTRY REPRESENTATIVE LAST WEEK PROMISED TO SOLVE WORKERS' PROBLEMS WITHIN ONE WEEK. THIS MORNING SOME TELLERS WINDOWS OPENED, THEN CLOSED AS WORKERS HELD MEETING TO DECIDE WHAT TO DO. IT IS POSSIPLE THEY WILL WORK THIS WEEK (MONDAY'S DAY OF MOURNING EXCEPTED), TO GIVE GOVT A CHANCE TO FULFILL ITS PLEDGE. WE NOTE, HOWEVER, THAT KHOSHKISH REMAINS IN CHARGE OF CBI, AND ONE KEY WORKERS' DEMAND IS HIS DISMISSAL. (GOVT SOURCE TOLD AMBASSADOR KHOSHKISH WAS EXPENDABLE.)

GOI ANNOUNCED NEW DIRECTOR OF NATIONAL IRANIAN RADIO AND TELEVISION, TURAJ FARAZMAND, FORMER EDITOR OF ETTELAAT HE HAS EDITED OTHER JOURNALS AND HAS WORKED IN IRANIAN RADIO AS COMMENTATOR AND DIRECTOR OF PRODUCTION.
OIL PRODUCTION IS UP SLIGHTLY. DETAILS BE SEPTEL.
NO STATE EMPLOYEES AT THIS POST OR AT THE CONSULATES DEVOTED 50 PERCENT OR MORE TIME TO NARCOTICS MATTERS.
WE UNDERSTAND REPLY TO PRESIDENT'S LETTER WAS SENT TO IRANIAN EMBASSY WASHINGTON DECEMBER 16. SULLIVAN
ARDESHIR ZAHEDI CALLED ME AFTERNOON DECEMBER 17 AFTER HAVING COME FROM LUNCH WITH THE TSHAH. HE SAID HE WANTED TO REPORT ACTION TAKEN ON SEVERAL OF THE ITEMS HE AND I HAD DISCUSSED DECEMBER 13.

FIRST, ON THE QUESTION OF THE CENTRAL BANK, HE SAID THAT INQUIRIES HAD SUGGESTED THE PROBLEMS THERE ARE MORE ADMINISTRATIVE THAN POLITICAL. IT HAS THEREFORE BEEN DETERMINED TO REPLACE GOVERNOR KHOSHHISH AND TO PUT MEHDI SAMII IN HIS PLACE. THE PROPOSAL WILL BE PUT TO SAMII ON DECEMBER 18.

WITH RESPECT TO NIOC, THE DECISION HAS BEEN MADE TO MAKE ENTEZAM THE FIGUREHEAD CHAIRMAN, BECAUSE HE IS ONE OF THE FEW ELIGIBLE UNDER THE NIOC CHARTER. THEN, MINA AND NABEGH WOULD BE BROUGHT BACK AS HIS TWO DEPUTIES AND WOULD RUN THE COMPANY.

ON THE PROBLEM OF THE CUSTOMS STRIKE, HE HAD LESS TO OFFER. HE SAID IT HAD BEEN DECIDED TO WAIT UNTIL MEHRAN RETURNS FROM THE OPEC MEETING (HOPEFULLY EVENING DEC 18) AND WORK THROUGH HIM. SINCE DECEMBER 18 IS CALLED AS GENERAL STRIKE DAY BY THE OPPOSITION, ZAHEDI SAW LITTLE HOPE OF GETTING ACTION BEFORE THEN.

HIS PLAN TO BRING THE GROUP OF DISTINGUISHED CITIZENS TOGETHER FOR LUNCH, TO BE FOLLOWED BY A MEETING WITH THE SHAH, HAS FOUPDERED ON THE PROBLEM THAT MANY OF THEM ARE AT ODDS WITH EACH OTHER AND REFUSE TO LUNCH TOGETHER. HE STILL HOPES TO GET ABOUT TEN OR FIFTEEN TOGETHER FOR TEA WITH THE SHAH IN THE NEAR FUTURE.

HE IS WORKING ON AN EFFORT TO SEND A GROUP OF BAZAARIS TO PARIS (HE SPOKE OF TWO CHARTERED PLANELOADS) TO BRING PRESSURE ON KHOMEINI TO MODERATE HIS POSITION. HE SAYS THESE WILL BE MEN OF CONSIDERABLE SUBSTANCE WHO ARE HURTING BECAUSE OF THE ECONOMIC CHAOS. HE HOPES TO HAVE A FEW MULLAHS WITH THEM.

ZAHEDI HIMSELF WILL GO TO ISFAHA DECEMBER 18 TO TRY TO BRING THE PRO-SHAH ZEALOTS INTO LINE AND PREVENT FURTHER CONFRONTATIONS ON THEIR PART. SINCE I HAVE AN AUDIENCE WITH THE SHAH DECEMBER 18, WE AGREED TO MEET AGAIN DECEMBER 19 TO COMPARE NOTES. SULLIVAN

SUMMARY: EMBOFF MET WITH BAKHTIAR MORNING DEC 27 AT LATTER'S REQUEST. BAKHTIAR HAD DISCUSSED POSSIBLE FORMATION OF GOVERNMENT WITH SHAH DEC 13 AND THOUGHT THERE WERE SOME MODERATES READY TO ACCEPT SHAH IN CONSTITUTIONAL ROLE WITH QUESTION OF ARMY CONTROL TO BE LEFT VAGUE FOR THE MOMENT. BAKHTIAR'S MAIN REASON FOR CALLING THE MEETING WAS TO URGE THE U.S. EMBASSY TO "BE MORE ACTIVE" IN PROMOTING A COALITION GOVERNMENT. BAKHTIAR SAID SHAH HAD TOLD HIM MILITARY GOVERNMENT HAD ASKED TO BE REPLACED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. END SUMMARY.

AT MEETING (WITH) MORNING DEC 27 SHAHPOUR BAKHTIAR BEGAN BY NOTING HE HAD ONN-HOUR AUDIENCE WITH SHAH DEC 13. BAKHTIAR SAID HE HAD OFFERED HIS VIEWS OF SITUATION IN FRANKNESS AND HONESTY TO SHAH ALONG LINES LAID OUT IN REFTEL. IN REPLY TO SHAH'S STATEMENT THAT COMMUNISTS SEEMED TO BE VERY MUCH INVOLVED WITH RELIGIOUS GROUPS, BAKHTIAR SAID HE HAD AGREED AND TOLD SHAH THAT SECOND ECHELON TUDEH MEMBERS WERE WORKING HAND-IN-GLOVE WITH AYATOLLAH TALEQANI. WHEN SHAH ASKED WHAT BAKHTIAR PROPOSED, BAKHTIAR SAID SHAH WOULD HAVE TO PLAY CONSTITUTIONAL ROLE IN WHICH PRIME MINISTER WAS RESPONSIBLE FOR GOVERNMENT AND SHAH WAS CHIEF OF STATE.

ACCORDING TO BAKHTIAR, HE AND SHAH DANCED AROUND QUESTION OF THE ARMY. BAKHTIAR NOTED THAT THE ARMY WAS ANOTHER ADMINISTRATIVE ORGAN OF THATE BUT THAT SHAH OBVIOUSLY WOULD PLAY IMPORTANT ROLE IN GUIDING IT. BAKHTIAR SAID IN TERMS OF GOVERNMENTAL ORGANIZATION HE IS PREPARED TO LET SHAH RETAIN THE ARMY AT LEAST IN THE INITIAL STAGE.

BAKHTIAR THEN WAXED PHILOSOPHICALLY, NOTING THAT SHAH'S BASIC PROBLEM IS THAT NO ONE TRUSTS HIM. THE SHAH HAD MET OVER LAST WEEK WITH VIRTUALLY EVERY FIGURE OF POLITICAL IMPORTANCE IN IRAN. BUT NO ONE WAS QUITE WILLING TO BREAK THE TIE WITH KHOMEINI AND FORM A COALITION GOVERNMENT. NO ONE TRUSTED SHAH TO KEEP HIS WORD AND NOT RETURN TO DICTATORSHIP. BAKHTIAR SAID HE WAS PREPARED TO TRY FORMING A COALITION IF OTHERS WERE, BUT HE SOUNDED A LOT LESS LIKE TH A POTENTIAL PRIME MINISTER DESIGNATE THAN HE HAD IN PREVIOUS CONVERSATION (REFTEL).

BAKHTIAR THEN STRESSED URGENT NEED TO GET CIVILIAN GOVERNMENT IN PLACE. ECONOMIC SITUATION IN THE COUNTRY WAS MISERABLE; ACCORDING TO INF ESTIMATES, OVER 200,000 PEOPLE HAVE LOST THEIR JOBS IN THE PAST MONTH. THE MILITARY GOVERNMENT, BAKHTIAR UNDERSTANDS, HAS ASKED TO BE REPLACED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. BAKHTIAR BELIEVES THE ARMY IS STRONG ENOUGH NOW, BUT IF SUBSTANTIAL INTERNAL POLITICAL AND ECONOMIC PROBLEMS CONTINUE, "THIS WILL DESTROY THE MONARCHY AND THE COUNTRY'S ENTIRE ADMINISTRATIVE STRUCTURE."

BAKHTIAR THEN CAME TO MAIN PURPOSE OF VISIT: U.S. EMBASSY SHOULD TAKE A MORE ACTIVE ROLE IN PROMOTING A SOLUTION TO THE PRESENT CRISES. THE U.S. HAS SUPPORTED THE SHAH FOR 25 YEARS AND CANNOT STAND BY NOW WHILE COUNTRY SLIPS INTO IMPASSE (WHILE BAKHTAIR DID NOT SUGGEST WE "PICK" HIM TO BE PRIME MINISTER, THE THOUGHT HAD OBVIOUSLY CROSSED HIS MIND.). EMBOFF REPLIED WE WERE URGING IDEA OF COALITION GOVERNMENT BUT ROADBLOCK SEEMED TO BE KHOMEINI'S INSISTENCE THAT SHAH LEAVE THE SCENE. BAKHTIAR REPLIED HE THOUGHT THERE WERE ENOUGH MODERATES WHO MIGHT FORM A GOVERNMENT WHICH COULD SLOWLY, OVER 3-6 MONTHS, WEAN PEOPLE AWAY FROM KHOMEINI LINE.

IT WAS NECESSARY THAT A STRONG GOVERNMENT BE FORMED WITH RECOGNIZED OPPOSITION FIGURES WHICH CAN THEN CARRY OUT A REASONABLE PROGRAM. (COMMENT: ABOVE IS WHAT BAKHTIAR HAS BEEN ADVOCATING SINCE BEFORE MOHARRAM. IN HIS EAGERNESS TO TRY AND FORM GOVERNMENT IT APPEARS TO US HE IS OVERLOOKING DIFFICULTY OF GETTING ALLIES AMONG MEMBERS OF OTHER OPPOSITIONISTS. WHILE WE BELIEVE THERE MAY BE SOME EROSION IN KHOMEINI'S STRENGTH AND INFLUENCE, WE DO NOT BELIEVE IT HAS YET REACHED THE POINT WHERE SUBSTANTIAL NUMBER OF MAJOR OPPOSITIONISTS WOULD GO INTO COALITION GOVERNMENT.)

IN FINAL COMMENT, BAKHTIAR NOTED HE HAD TALKED WITH TIME AND WASHINGTON POST REPRESENTATIVES. IN RESPONSE TO THEIR QUESTIONS AS TO WHETHER HE HAD CONTACT WITH U.S. EMBASSY, HE HAD REPLIED ONLY ON A COUPLE OF OCCASIONS IN THE LAST THREE MONTHS. EMBOFF SAID HE HAD NO OBJECTION TO BAKHTAIR INDICATING IN GENERAL WAY THAT THERE HAD BEEN CONTACT, SINCE THIS WAS STANDARD ANSWER STATE DEPARTMENT AND EMBASSY USED WHEN ASKED THIS QUESTION. SULLIVAN

1978TEHRAN12313.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT, DECEMBER 17 SUMMARY: TEHRAN AND MOST CITIES QUIET, BUT TROUBLE IN ISFAHAN, QOM, AND MASHAD. KHOMEINI CALLS FOR GENE

segments.text: SUMMARY: TEHRAN AND MOST CITIES QUIET, BUT TROUBLE IN ISFAHAN, QOM, AND MASHAD. KHOMEINI CALLS FOR GENERAL STRIKE TOMORROW. PROMINENT MULLAH CRITICIZES KHOMEINI. BAHAI COMMUNITY STILL SHAKEN BY RECENT VIOLENCE. END SUMMARY

TEHRAN HAD ANOTHER QUIET DAY, WITH ROUTINE POWER OUTAGE LAST NIGHT. A FEW AMERICANS RECEIVED DEATH THREATS BY TELEPHONE, AN ACTIVITY THAT HAD FALLEN OFF IN RECENT DAYS. TODAY THE CAPITAL IS CALM WITH SHOPS OUTSIDE THE BAZAAR OPEN. TEHRAA BAZAAR WAS CLOSED.

TOMORROW HAS BEEN DECLARED NATIONAL DAY OF MOURNING BY AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI AND, IN HASTY "ME TOO" FASHION, BY THE NATIONAL FRONT. WE HAVE REPORTS OF SHOPKEEPERS RECEIVING WARNINGS NOT TO THINK ABOUT OPENING TOMORROW, AND IT IS LIKELY THE DAY WILL AMOUNT TO A RATHER EFFECTIVE GENERAL STRIKE. PREVIOUS GENERAL STRIKES HAVE NOT NECESSARILY BROUGHT TROUBLE, AND NATIONAL FRONT HAS ASKED PEOPLE TO STAY INDOORS TO AVOID VIOLENCE. THE DAY CONSTITUTES TRADITIONAL SEVEN DAY MOURNING FOR THOSE KILLED IN ASHURA NIGHT RIOTS IN ISFAHAN.

MEANWHILE ISFAHAN, SCENE OF THOSE DEATHS, MAINTAINS TENSE AND UGLY ATMOSPHERE. CONSULATE REPORTS BANDS OF PRO-SHAH GROUPS CONTINUE SPORADIC ARSON AND LOOTING OF BAZAAR SHOPS AND OTHER STORES IDENTIFIED WITH OPPOSITION. ON ONE STREET WHERE IMPORTANT ANTI-SHAH RALLIES HAVE TAKEN PLACE, CONSUL NOTED 90 PERCENT OF SHOPS WINDOWS ARE BROKEN. WHILE SOME ISFAHANIS INITIALLY JOINED IN PROSHAH ACTIVITY, ONLY OUT-OF-TOWNERS (E.G. FARMERS, STEELWORKERS AND MILITARY CADETS) ARE NOW INVOLVED. CONSUL HAS SEVERAL REPORTS OF SHAKEDOWNS BY PRO-SHAH GROUPS, SEARCHING PASSERSBY FOR OPPOSITION DOCUMENTS AND THEN RETURNING ALL OF THEIR POSSESSIONS EXCEPT THEIR MONEY. TROOPS HAVE NOT DONE THIS BUT HAVE DONE NOTHING TO STOP IT.

TROOPS HAVE, HOWEVER, JOINED IN ATTACKS AGAINST SHOPS. ULTIMATE THREAT FROM REGIME SUPPORTERS IS THAT IF BAZAAR STAYS CLOSED TOMORROW IN OBSERVANCE OF GENERAL STRIKE, IT WILL BE DESTROYED. TOWNSPEOPLE, INCLUDING THOSE NOT NORMALLY DEDICATED TO OPPOSITION, ARE FURIOUS AT THESE OUTSIDERS, AND SITUATION IS RIPE FOR FURTHER SERIOUS TROUBLE.

CONSULATE ISFAHAN ESTIMATES TOTAL CASUALTIES IN CITY FROM DEC 11 THROUGH YESTERDAY MORNING TO BE 940, OF WHICH 85 ARE DEATHS. THIS DOES NOT INCLUDE NEARBY NAJAFABAD, SCENE OF ANTI-BAHAI VIOLENCE DEC 13-14. PERHAPS 50 DIED IN THAT FRACAS. CONSUL HAS REPORTS OF HEAVY DESTRUCTION INCLUDING ESSENTIAL BUSINESSES HERETOFORE LEFT UNMOLESTED. A PHARMACIST FRIEND IN ISFAHAN IS ASSEMBLING EMERGENCY SHIPMENT OF MEDICINES FOR NAJAFABAD, BECAUSE PHARMACIES IN NAJAFABAD WERE DESTROYED.

HEAD OF MASHAD IRAN-AMERICAN SOCIETY CONFIRMS SERIOUS DISTURBANCES. TROOPS DID ENTER SHAHREZA HOSPITAL WHERE DOCTORS WERE ON STRIKE; IN RESULTING VIOLENCE 3 DOCTORS AND 2 CHILDREN DIED. MASSIVE OPPOSITION REACTION HAS GIVEN THEM CONTROL OF MUCH OF THE CITY. OPPOSITION SOURCE SAYS THAT WHEN PRO-SHAH GROUPS ATTEMPTED TO HOLD RALLY CONSERVATIVE MOSLEM BANDS ARE STILL ROVING STREETS UNHINDERED, SEEKING SAVAK AGENTS. TROOPS ARE IN TOWN BUT HOLDING BACK AND POLICE HAVE DESERTED STREETS. SOURCES SAY SOME SAVAK AGENTS HAVE BEEN KILLED (NUMBERS RANGE FROM 2 TO "SEVERAL").

OPPOSITION CLAIMS RELIGIOUS SOIL SHOULD BE USED FOR SOMETHING OTHER THAN HOTEL.

VIOLENCE HAS SO FAR NOT BEEN AIMED AT FOREIGNERS (THERE ARE FEW IN MASHAD IN ANY CASE) BUT WARNINGS AND THREATS HAVE BEEN DELIVERED TO IAS HEAD. SOME TEACHERS ON HER STAFF HAVE SUDDENTLY DEPARTED FOR "THE HOLIDAYS," LEAVING IT VAGUE JUST WHICH HOLIDAYS THEY HAVE IN MIND.

QOM HAS HAD UNREST YESTERDAY AND TODAY BUT DETAILS ARE UNCLEAR. INTERCITY BUS WAS HELD ON THE OUTSKIRTS OF TOWN YESTERDAY DUE TO SOME DISTURBANCE. SOURCE REPORTED SAME THING HAPPENED AGAIN THIS MORNING, ALTHOUGH WHEN HIS BUS FINALLY PASSED THROUGH THE CITY HE NOTICED NOTHING UNUSUAL.

EMBASSY LOCAL EMPLOYEE, WHO IS BAHAI, HAS GIVEN US HARROWING STORIES TOLD BY BAHAI REFUGEES FROM SHIRAZ WHO ARE NOW FLOODING INTO THERAN. IN ONE INSTANCE, FATHER WHO FIRED AT MOSLEM CROWD DID SO AFTER LEARNING THAT HIS SON HAD BEEE KILLED AND DAUGHTER RAPED. ANOTHER MAN HAD SEEN HIS WIFE KILLED AND TWO DAUGHTERS TAKEN AWAY, PRESENT WHEREABOUTS UNKNOWN. WHEN AYATOLLAH MAHALATI APPEALED TO MOSLEM CROWD TO STOP ATTACKS ON BAHAIS, CROWD SHOUTED BACK THAT MAHALATI HIMSELF MUST BE BAHAI, AND CONTUNUED ACTIVITIES. REFUGEES REPORT MOSLEM MOB DESECRATED BAHAI CEMETERY DEC 15, AND THAT BODIES OF BAHAIS WHO WERE KILLED CVER PAST FEW DAYS REMAIN UNCLAIMED AND UNBURIED.

MOSLEM CROWD OF 20,000 TOOK AWAY BODIES OF MOSLEMS KILLED. THOSE WHO CAME TO THERAN SAY CROWD WAS YELLING THAT BAHAIS WERE FIRST, THEN JEWS, THEN CHRISTIANS. CROWD THREATENED DESTRUCTION OF PROPERTY, KILLING OF CHILDREN AND RAPING OF WOMEN. EYEWITNESSES REPORT ARMY DID NOT RPT NOT ATTEMPT TO STOP LARGEST CROWD, BUT POSTASHURA HOSTILITY APPEARS TO HAVE BURNED ITSELF OUT. (COMMENT: EVEN MAKING ALLOWANCES FOR CERTAIN AMOUNT OF HYSTERIA, SERIES OF EVENTS IN SHIRAZ OVER FAST FEW DAYS APPEARS TO BE ONE OF UGLIEST INCIDENTS OF IRAN'S RECENT UNREST.) REFUGEES COMING TO TEHRAN HAVE SEVERELY INCREASED ANXIETY OF LOCAL BAHAI COMMUNITY WITH TALES OF SHIRAZ EPISODE.

MAHALATI HAS SINCE ISSUED A COMMUNIQUE DEPLORING ATTACKS ON FOREIGNERS AND MINORITIES AND CALLING FOR NO REPETITION OF THESE ACTS. AN AYATOLLAHA HAS MADE THE FIRST PUBLIC CRITICISM OF KHOMEINI AMONG RELIGIOUS LEADERS. HE SENT LETTER TO PARIS ASKING 11 QUESTIONS, NOTABLY CONCERNING KHOMEINI'S HABIT OF ISSUING DECLARATIONS WITHOUT CONSULTING OTHER RELIGIOUS HEADS. HE ALSO QUESTIONED THE METHODS BY WHICH RELIGIOUS TITHES ARE COLLECTED AND USED BY AYATOLLAH'S PARTY, AND HE ASKED WHY NON-RELIGIOUS OR EVEN ANTI-RELIGIOUS ELEMENTS ARE ADMITTED TO CLOSE CONTACT AND ALLOWED TO GIVE PRESS INTERVIEWS ON KHOMEINI'S BEHALF. WHEN KHOMEINI DID NOT ANSWER HEJAZI'S QUESTIONS, HE PUBLISHED THEM AS OPEN LETTER.

(COMMENT: THESE CHARGES, PARTICULARLY THE FINAL ONE, WHICH IS DEMONSTRABLY TRUE, SHOULD NORMALLY BE AN EFFECTIVE POINT OF ATTACK AGAINST KHOMEINI WHEN DELIVERED BY A RESPECTED RELIGIOUS LEADER. IN THE PRESENT ATMOSPHERE, HOWEVER, IT IS NOT CLEAR THAT THE KINDS OF PEOPLE WHO FILLED SHAHREZA AVE DEC 10-11 WILL PAY ATTENTION.)

WE HAVE RELIABLE REPORT THAT A GROUP OF ABOUT 150 HOVERS AROUND BEHESHT-E-ZARA (THE TEHRAN CEMETARY). WHEN ANYONE BRINGS A BODY TO BE BURIED, REGARDLESS OF THE CAUSE OF DEATH, THE CROWD CLUSTERS AROUND AND HOLDS RALLY FOR THIS BRAVE DEFENDER OF ISLAM WHO WAS MURDERED BY THE SHAH'S TROOPS. IF THE DECEASED'S FRIENDS PROTEST, THEY ARE TOLD TO SHUT UP.

1978TEHRAN12345.subject: GENERAL STRIKE (KHOMEINI) OR BACK TO WORK (AZHERI)

segments.text: THE KHOMEINI CALL FOR A GENERAL STRIKE ON MONDAY, DEC. 18, EVIDENTLY HAD SOME EFFECT IN TEHRAN, BUT DID NOT PARALYZE THE CITY. THERE WAS A SUBSTANTIAL DROPOFF OF COMMERCIAL ACTIVITY, WITH THE BAZAAR REMAINING CLOSED AND WIDESPREAD CLOSING OF SHOPS AROUND THE CITY, WITH THE EXCEPTION OF ESSENTIAL SERVICES SUCH AS SOME GROCERY STORES. THERE ALSO WAS A RISE IN WORKER ABSENTEEISM IN THE FINANCIAL SECTOR AND IN SOME GOVERNMENT AGENCIES.
THE STRIKE CALL APPARENTLY RESULTED IN AN INTENSIFICATION OF THE STRIKE AT CUSTOMS. REPORTS INDICATE THAT THE WAREHOUSES WERE ALL CLOSED THIS MORNING AND ONLY A SKELETON STAFF SHOWED UP FOR WORK.

AT MEHRABAD AIRPORT IRAN AIR PILOTS WALKED OUT THIS MORNING, RECEIVING SOME SUPPORT FROM MAINTENANCE PERSONNEL. THE GROUND CREWS, HOWEVER, REMAINED AT WORK. THE WALKOUT ENDED SHORTLY AFTERWARDS (NINE PILOTS WERE ARRESTED), AND IRAN AIR OPERATIONS ARE NOW RUNNING.

THE BANK SITUATION APPEARS TO BE MUCH AS REPORTED YESTERDAY. MANY BRANCH BANKS WERE OPEN IN THE MORNING, WHILE OTHERS WERE CLOSED. AFTER NOON, HOWEVER, PRACTICALLY ALL BRANCHES WERE CLOSED. IRONICALLY, THE STRIKE CALL HAS ACTUALLY IMPROVED THE OPERATIONS OF THE CENTRAL BANK. NORMALLY EMPLOYEES HOLD AN EMOTIONAL "SOLIDARITY" MEETING BETWEEN THE HOURS OF TEN AND TWELVE IN THE MORNING IN THE MAIN CORRIDOR, SO THE DOORS ARE LOCKED. THESE EMPLOYEES WERE THE VERY TYPE WHO STAYED AWAY TODAY; HENCE THOSE EMPLOYEES WHO DID SHOW UP WERE ABLE TO WORK.

THE MINISTRY OF FINANCE REMAINED CLOSED. THE MINISTRY OF COMMERCE AND THE MINISTRY OF INDUSTRY AND MINES REPORTED THAT EMPLOYEES WERE PRESENT BUT FUNCTIONING AT A VERY LOW LEVEL OF ACTIVITY. THE SAME WAS TRUE OF NIOC. THE MINISTRY OF INFORMATION APPEARED TO BE WORKING NORMALLY. THE PRODUCTION STAFF OF NATIONAL IRANIAN RADIO AND TELEVISION (NIRT) FAILED TO REPRORT, HOWEVER. THE MINISTRY OF ENERGY WAS WORKING NORMALLY.

COMMENT: PRIME MINISTER AZHARI ANNOUNCED ON DEC. 14 THAT ALL CIVIL SERVANTS SHOULD REPORT FOR WORK ON DEC. 16 OR RISK LOSS OF PAY AND DISMISSAL. EXCEPT IN THE OIL INDUSTRY, THERE IS LITTLE EVIDENCE SO FAR THAT THE PRIME MINISTER'S ULTIMATUM IS BEING FOLLOWED UP. FOR INSTANCE, THE AMBASSADOR WAS INFORMED THAT FINANCE MINISTER MEHRAN HAD ASSURED THE SHAH AND OTHER GOI OFFICIALS THAT THE CUSTOMS SERVICE WOULD BE BACK AT WORK CLEARING SHIPMENTS ON DEC. 16. THIS DID NOT HAPPEN, AND WE ARE NOW INFORMED THAT THE DAY OF RECKONING WILL BE TOMORROW, DEC. 19.

WE CONCLUDE THAT, EXCEPT IN THE OIL INDUSTRY, THE GOI HAS NOT YET MADE A SERIOUS EFFORT TO IMPLEMENT THE PRIME MINISTER'S DECISION. ON THE OTHER HAND, KHOMEINI'S CALL FOR A GENERAL STRIKE ON DEC. 18 WAS NOT FULLY

WE ARE CURRENTLY ANTICIPATING DEPARTURE OF LAMBRAKIS LATE JANUARY OR IN FEBRUARY. CURRENT SITUATION HERE OBVIOUSLY REQUIRES NO GAP IN POSITION AND ASSIGNMENT OF OFFICER WHO IS FULLY FAMILIAR/EXPERT ON IRANIAN SCENE. WE DO NOT HAVE LUXURY OF A "BREAKING-IN" PERIOD.
THEREFORE, AMBASSADOR WISHES IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT OF VICTOR TOMSETH TO REPLACE LAMBRAKIS. WE CAN ARRANGE HERE AN OVERLAP SO THAT CONTACTS CAN BE PASSED TO NEW POLITICAL COUNSELOR.

TOMSETH WILL BE TAKING THREE WEEKS' ANNUAL LEAVE IN U.S. AT 560 SOUTH 71ST STREET, SPRINGFIELD, OREGON 97477, TELEPHONE (503) 747-7212. WE HAVE ISSUED ORDERS PROVIDING TWO DAYS OF CONSULTATION, JANUARY 4-5. IF DEPARTMENT WISHES TO TALK WITH HIM PLEASE CONTACT AT ABOVE ADDRESS.

WITH ASSIGNMENT OF TOMSETH TO TEHRAN WE WILL NEED TDY HELP AT SHIRAZ UNTIL NEW PRINCIPAL OFFICER ARRIVES. TWO YOUNG CONSULS THERE ARE DOING A GOOD JOB BUT A MORE EXPERIENCED HAND IS REQUIRED, PREFERABLY AN OFFICER WITH FARSI AND DREVIOUS EXPERIENCE IN IRAN. IN THIS CONNECTION, WE HAVE IN MIND SUCH OFFICERS AS MIKE HORNBLOW, LARRY SEMAKIS, RON NEUMANN, OR ARCHIE BOLSTER.

SHAH INFORMED ME DURING AUDIENCE AT NOON DECEMBER 18 THAT GHOLAM HOSEIN SADIQI ACCEPTED ON AFTERNOON DECEMBER 17 THE TASK OF FORMING GOVERNMENT OF NATIONAL UNION. SADIQI HAD ASKED FOR TWO WEEKS IN WHICH TO PUT SUCH GOVERNMENT TOGETHER. SHAH SAID THIS AGREEMENT WOULD NOT RPT NOT BE PUBLICLY ANNOUNCED, BUT HE ASSUMED ALL TEHRAN WOULD KNOW IT SOON.

SHAH SAID SADIQI SHOWED COURAGE IN THIS UNDERTAKING. CONDITIONS WERE THAT BOTH HE AND SADIQI WOULD ACCEPT THE CONSTITUTION. HE WOULD REMAIN AS COMMANDER-IN-CHIEF OF ARMED FORCES BUT CIVILIAN GOVERNMENT WOULD RUN EVERYTHING ELSE. ARMED FORCES BUDGET "WOULD HAVE TO BE WORKED OUT." HE SAID IT WOULD SPECIFICALLY HAVE TO BE APPROVED BY THE PARLIAMENT. (COMMENT: THIS REPRESENTS SIGNIFICANT CHANGE IN HIS POSITION.)

SHAH ADMITTED THAT SADIQI WOULD HAVE DIFFICULTY IN PUTTING CABINET TOGETHER, BECAUSE MOST OPPOSITION POLITICIANS DO NOT DARE OFFEND KHOMEINI. HE THOUGHT THERE WAS REAL RISK SADIQI WOULD FAIL. IN THAT CASE, HE WOULD PROBABLY TURN TO BAKHTIAR, WHO HAD SAID HE COULD PUT GOVERNMENT TOGETHER.

IN DISCUSSING WHAT HAPPENS IF BOTH THESE EFFORTS FAIL, SHAH LINGERED LONG ON THE REGENCY COUNCIL PROPOSALS THAT HAD BEEN MADE TO HIM BY SANJABI AND ALI AMINI. HE REJECTED SANJABI'S IDEA OF HIS LEAVING THE COUNTRY OUT OF HAND, BUT KEPT COMING BACK TO THE ALI AMINI IDEA OF A COUNCIL WHICH WOULD BE FORMED WHILE HE WAS STILL IN COUNTRY, AND STILL ACTING AS COMMANDER-IN-CHIEF OF ARMED FORCES. HE FINALLY SAID HE WOULD RATHER QUIT THAN "BE CLIPPED LIKE A BIRD AND PUT IN A CAGE."

WE THEN TURNED TO DISCUSSION OF NIOC AND CENTRAL BANK. HE SAID HE EXPECTED ENTEZAM TO TAKE NIOC JOB AS FIGUREHEAD, WITH MINA AND NABEGH RUNNING THE COMPANY. AS FOR CENTRAL BANK, MEHDI SAMII WOULD EVENTUALLY TAKE OVER, BUT NOT IMMEDIATELY, UNDER THREAT OF STRIKERS.

IN DISCUSSING TODAY'S GENERAL STRIKE, HE SEEMED WELL INFORMED IN GREAT DETAIL ABOUT OIL PRODUCTION, IRAN AIR, THE CENTRAL BANK, ETC. HE ALSO SEEMED TO HAVE A MORE ACTIVE INTEREST IN GOVERNMENTAL FUNCTIONS THAN I HAVE RECENTLY OBSERVED. IN GENERAL, HE SEEMED LESS DEPRESSED AND MORE CONFIDENT THAN HE HAS BEEN IN RECENT TIMES. HE EXPRESSED GREAT CONFIDENCE IN SADIQI. SULLIVAN

SUMMARY: SITUATION QUIET LAST NIGHT AND TODAY. GENERAL STRIKE HAS CLOSED MANY SHOPS. SECONDARY SCHOOLS TO OPEN DEC 23. HUMAN RIGHTS GROUP ASSAULTED YESTERDAY IN NAJAFABAD. BUDGET COMMITTEE APPROVES SALARY INCREASES. TENSION CONTINUES IN ISFAHAN AND MASHAD. RECENT VIOLENCE IN REZAIYEH RESULTED IN BURNING OF MOSQUE. END SUMMARY.

TEHRAN HAS REMAINED QUIET APART FROM A FEW MORE TELEPHONE THREATS TO AMERICANS. EVEN THE DAILY POWER OUTAGE WAS SHORTER THAN USUAL. CONSULATES TABRIZ, ISFAHAN, AND SHIRAZ ALSO REPORT QUIET NIGHTS. KHOMEINI'S CALL FOR GENERAL STRIKE TODAY HAS CLOSED MANY, ALTHOUGH CERTAINLY NOT ALL, TEHRAN SHOPS. USUAL PATTERN IS FOR THE OPEN SHOPS TO CLOSE EARLY, RESULTING IN A BUTTONED-UP CITY BY LATER AFTERNOON. MANY OTHER SHOPKEEPERS, WHO HAVE ENDURED SEVERAL PREVIOUS DAYS WITHOUT INCOME IN RECENT WEEKS, EMPLOY THE TECHNIQUE OF APPEARING CLOSED BUT SERVING REGULAR CUSTOMERS.

WINDOW GRATINGS WILL BE PULLED DOWN AND THE DOOR GRATING ALSO PULLED HALFWAY DOWN, BUT RELIABLE CLIENTEL WILL DUCK UNDER THE GRATING AND CONDUCT BUSINESS. GENERAL STRIKE IS RATHER REDUNDANT IN TROUBLED ISFAHAN, BUT IN TEHRAN AND OTHER CITIES, SHOPS OUTSIDE THE BAZAAR HAD RETURNED TO NORMAL UNTIL TODAY. CONSULATE TABRIZ REPORTS CITY COMPLETELY SHUT DOWN TODAY, AND CONSULATE SHIRAZ ALSO REPORTS EFFECTIVE STRIKE.

IN MAJOR STEP TOWARD NORMALCY, GOVT ANNOUNCED TEHRAN SECONDARY AND TECHNICAL SCHOOLS WILL REOPEN DEC 23. THIS WOULD BE A REAL COUP FOR GOI IF IT COMES OFF SUCCESSFULLY, BUT THAT IS FAR FROM CERTAIN. HIGH SCHOOLS HAVE BEEN HOTBEDS OF ANTI-GOVT ACTIVITY EVERY BIT AS MUCH AS UNIVERSITIES. ANTI-SHAH DISPLAYS ARE INEVITABLE, AND IN FACT OPPOSITION STUDENTS WILL PROBABLY TRY TO CLOSE THE SCHOOLS AS SOON AS THEY OPEN.

HUMAN RIGHTS GROUP VISITING NAJAFABAD YESTERDAY WITH GOI APPROVAL MET RUDE RECEPTION. MATIN-DAFTARY AND SADR HAJ SEYED JAVADI, BOTH LAWYERS AND HUMAN RIGHTS ACTIVISTS, AND RALPH SCHOENMAN, AN AMERICAN, OBTAINED PERMISSION TO VISIT ISFAHAN SUBURB WHICH HAS BEEN SCENE OF MAJOR INTERFAITH VIOLENCE AND A NUMBER OF DEATHS. THREE JUSTICE MINISTRY OFFICIALS ACCOMPANIED THEM. DESPITE OFFICIAL SANCTION, THE PARTY WAS APPARENTLY ROUGHLY TREATED. HUMAN RIGHTS GROUP CLAIMS THAT WHILE THEY WERE VISITING HOSPITAL TO CHECK ON CASUALTIES, TROOPS SEIZED THEM AND ASSAULTED THEM, WITH HOSTILE CROWD CHEERING THEM ON. POLICE CHIEF URGED SOLDIERS AND CROWD NOT TO MOLEST THEM.

TROOPS DRAGGED THE GROUP TO POLICE STATION, WHERE THE SIX WERE FURTHER ABUSED BUT FINALLY RELEASED. (COMMENT: TOTAL INEPTITUDE WITH WHICH GOI APPARENTLY HANDLED THIS AFFAIR IS SADLY SYMPTOMATIC OF CURRENT SITUATION.) OPPOSITION CLAIMS THAT ANTI-BAHAI ATTACKS IN NAJAFABAD, AS WELL AS THOSE IN SHIRAZ ARE WORK OF GOVT. UNAVOIDABLE FACT IS THAT CONSERVATIVE MOSLEM RELIGIOUS LEADERS REFUSE TO GUARANTEE BAHAIS SAFETY, AS THEY COULD DO IF THEY ACTED TOGETHER. AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI IN A MAJOR STATEMENT REGARDING MINORITIES A FEW MONTHS AGO EXPLICITLY EXCLUDED BAHAIS FROM HIS PROTECTIVE UMBRELLA.
