1978TEHRAN12401.subject: DESIGNATION OF GHOLAM HOSEIN SADIQI AS FORMATUER OF NATIONAL UNITY GOVERNMENT

segments.text: I AM LESS THAN SANGUINE THAT THE DESIGNATION OF GHOLAM HOSEIN SADIQI AS FORMATEUR OF A NATIONAL UNITY GOVERNMENT REPRESENTS A DEFINITIVE SOLUTION TO THE IRANIAN CRISIS. SADIQI HAS SOLID NATIONAL FRONT CREDENTIALS, HAS SERVED A SHORT JAIL SENTENCE, AND IS A RESPECTED ACADEMIC. BUT HE HAS REAL LIABILITIES.

FIRST OF ALL, HE IS NOT RPT NOT THE NOMINAL LEADER OF THE NATIONAL FRONT, A POSITION HELD BY KARIM SAAJABI. SECOND, HE DOES NOT RPT NOT COMMAND THE LOYALTY OF ANY BROAD ELEMENTS AMONG THE OPPOSITION, PARTICULARLY THE STUDENTS AND THE RELIGIOUS LEADERS.

HE IS ESPECIALLY VULNERABLE IN THE RELIGIOUS AREA, SINCE HE IS WIDELY KNOWN TO BE A NON-BELIEVER IN ISLAM, AND, INDEED, HAS REPORTEDLY PROCLAIMED HIMSELF AN ATHEIST. IT IS TO BE EXPECTED, THEREFORE, THAT HE WILL IMMEDIATELY BE CONDEMNED BY AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI NOT ONLY BECAUSE HE IS COLLABORATING WITH THE SHAH, BUT BECAUSE HE IS NOT A TRUE BELIEVER.

ALL THE FOREGOING FACTORS WILL SEVERELY INHIBIT SADIQI'S CHANCES OF FORMING A GOVERNMENT, BECAUSE THERE ARE VERY FEW IRANIANS OF ANY POLITICAL STATURE WHO APPEAR WILLING TO FACE THE WRATH OF KHOMEINI AND THE STREET MOBS HE CAN COMMAND. THE TWO WEEK PERIOD WHICH SADIQI HAS BEEN GRANTED TO ATTEMPT THE FORMATION OF A GOVERNMENT MAY, THEREFORE, BE SPENT IN A FRUITLESS SEARCH FOR COLLABORATORS. IF HE FAILS TO CONVINCE ANY SIGNIFICANT GROUP TO JOIN HIM AND IF THERE IS NO REAL PROGRESS IN BREAKING THE ECONOMIC STRANGULATION OF THE COUNTRY WHICH RESULTS FROM CONTINUING STRIKES, THESE TWO WEEKS WILL HAVE ACCOMPLISHED LITTLE.

IF, ON THE OTHER HAND, SADIQI DOES SUCCEED IN PUTTING TOGETHER A RESPECTABLE GOVERNMENT AND IS INSTALLED AS PRIME MINISTER, IT IS QUESTIONABLE THAT HE WILL BE ABLE TO COMMAND THE SORT OF NATIONAL COOPERATION NEEDED TO TAKE TRUE LEADERSHIP AND RESTORE THE COUNTRY TO TRANQUILITY AND FULL PRODUCTION. INDEED, IF HE LIFTS MARTIAL LAW AND PROCLAIMS FREEDOM OF THE PRESS, HE IS LIKELY TO GET THE SORT OF TREATMENT WHICH THE OPPOSITION METED OUT TO SHARIFEMAMI. THIS WOULD ENTAIL A SYSTEMATIC FLOUTING OF AUTHORITY IN SEVERAL DIMENSIONS, WITH CONTINUED DEMANDS FOR THE ABDICATION OF THE SHAH.

SUCH CIRCUMSTANCES COULD LEAD THE NATION BACK INTO THE DISMAL CYCLE WE WITNESSED IN OCTOBER, WITH THE GOVERNMENT FINALLY REACHING THE CONCLUSION THAT A RETURN TO MARTIAL LAW AND A STRICT APPLICATION OF MILITARY CONTROLS WERE AGAIN NECESSARY. IT IS NOT CERTAIN HOW THE ARMED FORCES WOULD REACT TO THIS CALL FOR DUTY. HOWEVER, IT IS QUITE POSSIBLE THAT THEY WOULD AGREE TO ENDURE THE OPPROBRIUM ONLY IF THEY WERE GIVEN SWEEPING RESPONSIBILITY TO HANDLE THINGS IN THEIR OWN WAY. IT IS ALSO POSSIBLE THAT SUCH A RETURN TO MARTIAL LAW WOULD PRODUCE NEW AND MORE DANGEROUS TENSIONS IN THE ARMED FORCES.

HAVING SAID ALL THIS, I NEVERTHELESS BELIEVE THERE ARE SOME POSITIVE ASPECTS IN THE DESIGNATION OF SADIQI AS FORMATEUR. FIRST, IT MAY GIVE THE AUTHORITIES SOME TIME TO MAKE MORE EFFECTIVE PROGRESS TOWARDS THE RESTORATION OF PRODUCTION AND ORDERLY FUNCTIONING OF GOVERNMENT. SECOND, IT WILL GIVE THE OPPOSITION SOME RALLYING POINT ALTERNATIVE TO KHOMEINI AND ENCOURAGE THOSE WHO ARE DISMAYED BY THE DANGERS KHOMEINI REPRESENTS. THIS PROCESS WILL BE IMPORTANT TO GETTING SOME MORE POSITIVE AND CONCRETE THINKING ABOUT POLITICAL SOLUTIONS WHICH ARE NOT TRAASFIXED WITH THE IDEA OF THE SHAH'S ABDICATION AS THE SOLE SOLUTION.
FINALLY, IT WILL GIVE THE SHAH AN OPPORTUNITY TO DEMONSTRATE THAT HE IS PREPARED TO BECOME A CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCH AND TO EFFECT SOME GENUINE DEVOLUTION OF POWER.

THEREFORE, ON BALANCE, I THINK WE CAN PROBABLY REGARD THIS DEVELOPMENT AS A FAVORABLE MOVE IN A LONG, TEDIOUS, AND TENDER PROCESS. THIS IS NOT A SITUATION WHICH IS LIKELY TO LEND ITSELF TO CLEAN-CUT SOLUTIONS. THEREFORE, THE BEST WE CAN PROBABLY EXPECT AT THIS TIME IS TO KEEP THE ACTION MOVING IN A CONSTRUCTIVE DIRECTION. SADIQI'S DESIGNATION COULD BE A FIRST STEP IN THAT MOVEMENT. SULLIVAN
ARDESHIR ZAHEDI CAME TO SEE ME LATE MORNING DECEMBER 19. HE WAS OBVIOUSLY UNHAPPY WITH THE SHAH'S DECISION TO DESIGNATE SADIQI AS FORMATEUR OF A COALITION GOVERNMENT.

FIRST, IT SHOULD BE UNDERSTOOD THAT ZAHEDI HAS SOME PERSONAL REASONS TO BE OPPOSED TO SADIQI. IT WAS THE LATTER, WHO WAS THEN MINISTER OF INTERIOR IN MOSSADEQ'S GOVERNMENT, WHO ORDERED ZAHEDI ARRESTED IN 1953 AND WHO REPORTEDLY SLAPPED HIS FACE PUBLICLY. SECOND, ZAHEDI CLEARLY HAS A GAME PLAN BUILT AROUND PUTATIVE PARLIAMENTARY ELECTIONS FROM WHICH HE WOULD PERSONALLY HOPE TO EMERGE AS PRIME MINISTER.

BE THAT AS IT MAY, ZAHEDI COUCHED HIS CONCERN IN HIS FEARS THAT SADIQI, EVEN IF HE MANAGES TO FORM A GOVERNMENT, WILL NOT BE ABLE TO MANAGE THE COUNTRY AND, ABOVE ALL, WILL NOT BE ABLE TO COMMAND THE RESPECT OF THE ARMED FORCES. HE WORRIES THAT, IF THE SITUATION UNDER SADIQI DETERIORATES EVEN FURTHER AND IF THE SHAH, AS CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCH, STANDS BY AND LETS IT SLIP, THIS WILL ERODE THE SHAH'S POSITION AS COMMANDER-IN-CHIEF OF THE ARMED FORCES.

ZAHEDI WOULD PREFER TO LET THE CURRENT GOVERNMENT REMAIN IN POWER AND GIVE IT A LONGER CHANCE TO GET THE COUNTRY BACK TO ACTIVE PRODUCTION. HE SPOKE HIGHLY OF GENERAL AZHARI'S PERFORMANCE, PARTICULARLY IN HIS POLITICAL ADDRESSES TO THE NATION VIA RADIO AND TV. HE SUGGESTED THAT WHEN AZHARI LEAVES HIS CURRENT POSITION, HE SHOULD RESIGN FROM THE ARMY AND ESTABLISH A POLITICAL GROUP AIMED AT THE NEXT ELECTION.

I SAID I THOUGHT AZHARI WAS BADLY NEEDED BACK AT SCS HEADQUARTERS TO PULL THE ARMED FORCES TOGETHER. IF HE IS REPLACED BY SADIQI, HE SHOULD RESUME HIS MILITARY FUNCTIONS AND REPAIR THE ARMED FORCES FOR WHATEVER MAY BE THEIR NEXT TASK. ON REFLECTION, ZAHEDI AGREED THIS OBJECTIVE HAD HIGHER PRIORITY.
FINALLY, ZAHEDI SAID HE WAS THINKING OF RETURNING TO WASHINGTON SOON BECAUSE HE HAD REACHED A STATE OF FRUSTRATION AND DECIDED THERE WAS LITTLE ELSE TO BE DONE IN

TEHRAN AND MOST OTHER CITIES REMAINED QUIET LAST NIGHT AND THIS MORNING. CAPITAL ITSELF WAS INCIDENT-FREE EXCEPT FOR POWER OUTAGE. BAZAAR OPENED FOR THE FIRST TIME IN 20 DAYS, THEN CLOSED AFTER ONE HOUR. (COMMENT: PRESUMABLY UPON ORDERS OF PRO-KHOMEINI TOUGHS.) CONSULATE ISFAHAN REPORTS CONTINUED TENSION BUT NO CLASHES. ONE AMERICAN-OWNED AUTOMOBILE (BHI) WAS BURNED.

CONSULATE SHIRAZ REPORTS CITY GENERALLY QUIET. NEARLY ALL SHOPS WERE CLOSED YESTERDAY BUT HAVE OPENED TODAY, INCLUDING BAZAAR. UNREST CONTINUES AT PAHLAVI UNIVERSITY MEDICAL SCHOOL. AS OF EARLY AFTERNOON TROOPS ARE ASSEMBLED OUTSIDE THE COMPOUND WHILE STUDENTS DEMONSTRATE INSIDE, SHOUTING THE SHAH SHOULD KILL HIMSELF.

SPOTLIGHT IS ON TABRIZ AND DEMONSTRATION DEFINITELY TOOK PLACE YESTERDAY AFTERNOON, WITH SOME SHOOTING AND INJURIES BUT, DESPITE REPORTS OF NUMEROUS DEATHS, OUR CONSUL HAS SPENT GOOD PART OF DAY CHECKING YESTERDAY'S INCIDENT AND HAS BEEN UNABLE TO CONFIRM THAT ANY DEATHS OCCURRED. STORY QUICKLY SPREAD YESTERDAY THAT LARGE MUTINY HAD OCCURRED, WITH INTRA-MILITARY STREET BATTLE AND HEAVY CASUALTIES; ONE VERSION EVEN HAS IT THAT A TANK BRIGADE MUTINED. BBC (GOI NOW CALLS BBC "THE COLONIALIST RADIO") BROADCAST STORY LAST EVENING THAT SOLDIERS IN TABRIZ HAD REFUSED TO OBEY ORDERS. MINISTRY OF INFORMATION IMMEDIATELY ISSUED HOT DENIAL, INTERRUPTING REGULAR PROGRAM TO DISSEMINATE OFFICIAL VERSION.

THIS MORNING BBC STUCK TO ITS VERSION, SAYING MLA HAD DENIED IT (THAT AT LEAST WAS INCORRECT; IT WAS THE MINISTRY OF INFORMATION) BUT THAT IT DID APPEAR TROOPS HAD MUTINED IN FAVOR OF OPPOSITION. CONSUL TABRIZ HAS INVESTIGATED THE MATTER AND BELIEVES TRUTH IS CLOSER TO GOI STATEMENT THAN TO PRESS REPORTS. STORIES ON BOTH SIDES INVOLVE INCIDENT IN WHICH GROUP OF CIVILIANS APPROACHED TROOPS COMMANDED BY A COLONEL, EVENTUALLY SHARING TEA AND REFRESHMENTS WITH THEM. GOVT SAYS THIS WAS A PRO-SHAH GROUP; OPPOSITION SAYS IT WAS ANTI-SHAH GROUP WHICH FRATERNIZED WITH TROOPS AND CARRIED COLONEL AROUND ON THEIR SHOULDERS IN DISPLAY OF SOLIDARITY.

BASED ON CONVERSATIONS WITH RELIABLE CONTACTS, CONSUL REJECTS ACCOUNTS OF GREAT STREET BATTLE. U.S. MILITARY SOURCES REPORT THAT MAIN GROUP OF DEMONSTRATORS WAS PROSHAH, WHICH IS WHY THEY GOT ON SO WELL WITH TROOPS. SENIOR OFFICER IN IMPERIAL GUARD, WHO SAYS HE HAS LEARNED IMMEDIATELY OF PAST CASES OF DISOBEDIENCE AMONG TROOPS, MAINTAINS NO MUTINY TOOK PLACE IN TABRIZ YESTERDAY, CERTAINLY NOT ONE INVOLVING TROOPS FIRING ON ONE ANOTHER. TURKISH CONSUL IN TABRIZ, ON OTHER HAND, HAS REPORTED TO HIS AMBASSADOR THAT SERIOUS CLASH TOOK PLACE AND THAT SOME TROOPS LATER REFUSED TO FIRE AGAIN. (COMMENT: WE WILL VIGOROUSLY CONTINUE INVESTIGATION TO PIN DOWN THIS STORY.)
REPORTS FRON TABRIZ TODAY INDICATE NEW UNREST. U.S. MILITARY CHANNELS REPORT ANTI-SHAH RALLY OF ABOUT 2,000 PEOPLE AND SOME SHOOTING.

WE HAVE REPORT OF MORE ANTI-BAHAI ACTIVITY. MUSLIMS OCCUPIED BAHAI-OWNED SUGAR FACTORY IN SHIRVAN (IN NE CORNER OF IRAN) AND FORCIBLY EVICTED BAHAI EMPLOYEES. ACTION AFFECTS 27 BAHAI FAMILIES. ARMY HAS SAID IT CAN DO

NEARLY 50 PERCENT OF OSCO'S IRANIAN LABOR FORCE IS STILL ON STRIKE BUT PRODUCTION IS STILL INCREASING. PRODUCTION DECEMBER 19 BY OSCO IS SCHEDULED TO BE 3,361,000 BBLS, OF WHICH 776,000 WILL BE DELIVERED TO DOMESTIC REFINERIES AND 2,585,000 WILL BE AVAILABLE FOR EXPORT. IPAC, LAPCO AND IMINOCO ARE STILL COMPLETELY SHUT-DOWN; AND SIRIP, SOFIRAN, AND NIOC CONTINUE TO PRODUCE ABOUT 90,000 B/D. SOME SOFIRAN WORKERS ARE STILL THREATENING TO GO ON STRIKE, BUT NONE HAVE ACTUALLY DONE SO.

AFTER CONSIDERABLE EFFORT AND DELAY, OSCO WAS ABLE TO START NGL PLANT 600. HOWEVER, BECAUSE OF A COMBINATION OF LABOR AND TECHNICAL PROBLEMS NIGC DOES NOT HAVE THE COMPRESSOR OPERATING WHICH IS NEEDED TO PUMP THE NATURAL GAS FROM NGL 600 INTO IGAT-I. CONSEQUENTLY, THE GAS IS BEING FLARED.

ACCORDING TO OUR SOURCES IN BOTH THE LOCAL CONSORTIUM REPRESENTATIVE OFFICE AND IN OSCO/AHWAZ, THE MILITARY ARE NOT YET MOVING TOWARDS A CONFRONTATION WITH THE STRIKERS. OUR SOURCES IN OSCO/AHWAZ, FOR EXAMPLE, KNOW OF ONLY ONE ARREST DURING THE PAST WEEK OF AN OSCO EMPLOYEE. WE SUSPECT THAT THE MILITARY WILL CONTINUE TO POSTPONE TAKING ANY STRONG ACTION AS LONG AS WORKERS CONTINUE TO RETURN VOLUNTARILY, AS THEY ARE SLOWLY DOING, AND AS LONG AS PRODUCTION IS INCREASING.
THE REFINERY SITUATION IS UNCHANGED FROM YESTERDAY.

1978TEHRAN12441.subject: MEETING WITH PRC AMBASSADOR TO IRAN

segments.text: ON THE EVENING OF DECEMBER 16, WHEN NEWS OF US-PRC NORMALIZATION REACHED TEHRAN, PRC AMBASSADOR CHIAO JO-YU TELEPHONED ME TO "CONGRATULATE" THE U.S. ON RECOGNITION OF PRC. SINCE HE IS SENIOR TO ME ON DIPLOMATIC LIST, I THEN ARRANGED APPROPRIATE ORIENTAL GESTURE BY MAKING COURTESY CALL ON HIM AT HIS HOME AFTERNOON DECEMBER 19. HE RECEIVED ME WITH EGG-ROLLS, MAO-TAI AND AN INTEPRETER.

MOST OF OUR CONVERSATION CONCERNED CURRENT SITUATION IN IRAN. PRC SEES IT PURELY AND SIMPLY AS SOVIET POWER GRAB. CHIAO SAID RUSSIANS HAVE BEEN TRYING FOR CENTURIES TO GET THEIR HANDS ON PERSIA, AND ARE NOW MERELY USING NEW TACTICS.

HE SAID THAT LAST SPRING, SHORTLY AFTER THE COUP IN AFGHANISTAN, SOVIETS HELD A CONFERENCE IN CYPRUS AT WHICH IT WAS DECIDED THAT IRAN, RATHER THAN PAKISTAN, WOULD BE THEIR NEXT TARGET. HE SAID THAT WHEN HUA KUO-FUNG VISITED TEHRAN LAST AUGUST HE HAD WARNED SHAH THAT IT WAS MISTAKE TO THINK NEXT SOVIET ACTION WOULD BE DIRECTED TOWARDS BALUCHI/PUSHTOON AREAS. ACTION, INSTEAD, WOULD BE AIMED DIRECTLY AT SHAH.

CHIAO EXPRESSED HIS BELIEF THAT SOVIETS HAVE BEEN INFILTRATING IRANIAN SHI'A CLERGY "FOR FIFTEEN YEARS" AND HAVE SUCCEEDED IN BUILDING UP STRONG FOLLOING THERE. HE ALLEGED THERE WERE TWO KGB AGENTS IN PARIS WITH AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI. HE ALSO WORRIES ABOUT SOVIET PENETRATION OF IRAMIAN ARMED FORCES AND SMUGGLING OF SOVIET WEAPONS INTO IRAN FROM AFGHANISTAN AND THROUGH PALESTINIANS IN KUWAIT.

I THEN GAVE HIM OUR GENERAL PERCEPTION OF SITUATION, INFORMING HIM OF SADIQI EFFORT TO FORM A NATIONAL UNITY GOVERNMENT AND OF OUR CONTINUING SUPPORT FOR ROLE OF SHAH. HE SAID PRC EMBASSY IN WASHINGTON REPORTED THERE IS FACTION IN U.S. GOVERNMENT WHICH WISHES TO DUMP THE SHAH. I SAID I WAS AWARE OF NO SUCH ATTITUDE. HE URGED U.S. TO SUPPORT SHAH STRONGLY AND TO GET HELP FROM NATO AND JAPAA FOR THIS POSITION. HE SAID PEKING WAS SOLID IN ITS POSITION FAVORING THE SHAH AND A STRONG IRAN.

WE THEN TURNED TO DISCUSSION OF OTHER AREAS. HE SAID PRC "DISAGREED" WITH U.S. ABOUT SOME ACTIONS WE INTENDED TO TAKE WITH RESPECT TO TAIWAN. I SAID DISAGREEMENT HAD BEEN NOTED, BUT DID NOT SEEM TO DETER AGREEMENT ON NORMALIZATION. HE THEN ASSENTED QUITE VIGOROUSLY WITH MY OBSERVATION THAT AUTHORITIES IN TAIPEI HAD REACTED VERY RESPONSIBLY TO ANNOUNCEMENT, AND QUOTED TENG HSIAO-PING'S TOKYO STATEMENT ABOUT CHINESE PATIENCE CONCERNING TAIWAN.

ON INDOCHINA, HE SAID VIETNAMESE "HAD GONE TOO FAR." THEY HAD BECOOVIET TOOL IN EFFORT TO "SURROUND" CHINA. HOWEVER, THEY DID NOT HAVE SUFFICIENT POWER TO SERVE THAT PURPOSE. CHINA HAD "MANY FRIENDS" IN ASIA. WHEN I SUGGESTED PE HAD SOME VERY DIFFICULT DECISIONS TO MAKE WITH RESPECT CAMBODIA, HE AGREED AND SAID, IN EFFECT, THAT PRC WOULD DO ITS DUTY.

ON MIDDLE EAST, CHIAO SAID PRC STRONGLY SPORTED U.S. EFFORT TO PRODUCE EGYPT-ISRAEL SETTLEMENT, EVEN IF PEKING DID NOT SAY SO PUBLICLY. I SAID I WAS INTERESTED TO HEAR THAT, BECAUSE, IN MANY WAYS, PRC POSTURE IN MIDDLE EAST WAS AMBIGUOUS. IN FACT, IT WAS DIFFICULT TO DISTINGUISH 5OME PRC POSITIONS FROM THOSE OF SOVIETS. CHIAO SAID HE AGREED PRC POLICY IN MIDDLE EAST WAS VERY DIFFICULT TO DETERMINE. PEKING WAS STUDYING IT IN EFFORT TO PRODUCE "CORRECT" POLICY. HE CITED AS EXAMPLE OF DIFFICULTIES THE QUESTION OF PRC SUPPORT FOR PLO. HE SAID PLO WAS VERY COMPLEX ORGANIZATION, EVEN THOUGH ITS MAIN COURSE SEEMED TO FOLLOW SOVIET POLICY OBJECTIVES.
AFTER SEVERAL TOASTS TO ENDURING US-PRC RELATIONS, HE ENDED BY URGING ME TO BE SURE THE SHAH "HAD A HARD NOSE."

ACTION REQUESTED: I WOULD APPRECIATE ANY INFORMATION ADDRESSEES MAY HAVE ABOUT CYPRUS MEETING CITED BY CHIAO. ------------------073662 201147Z /10 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 2325 INFO AMCONSUL HONG KONG AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY NICOSIA AMEMBASSY PARIS USLO PEKING AMEMBASSY TAIPEI POUCH AMEMBASSY TOKYO SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 12441 LIMDIS

EMBASSY URGENTLY REQUIRES REPLY TO REFTEL. NUMBER OF INQUIRIES GROWS DAILY AND UNLESS WE GET AUTHORITATIVE WORD ON WHAT CAN AND CANNOT BE DONE ON THE VOLUNTARY DEPARTURE PROCEDURES, CERTAIN INDIVIDUALS COULD VERY WELL MAKE THE WRONG DECISION AND END UP WITH SIGNIFICANT LOSSES. PLEASE REPLY BY NIACT IMMEDIATE TELEGRAM. SULLIVAN

REFTEL CONTAINED TEXT OF DRAFT MEMORANDUM ADDRESSED TO COMPLEX QUESTIONS CONCERNING PROCEDURES WHICH APPLY TO THOSE DEPENDENTS OF U.S. OFFICIALS WHO ELECT VOLUNTARY DEPARTURE FROM IRAN IN ACCORDANCE WITH CURRENT WASHINGTON INSTRUCTIONS. IN PREPARING THEIR REPLIES TO THIS MESSAGE, I FEEL IT IS IMPORTANT WASHINGTON AGENCIES BE AWARE OF FOLLOWING CONSIDERATIONS: - (A) MESSAGE WAS PREPARED IN RESPONSE TO MY REQUEST THAT GUIDANCE ON THIS SUBJECT BE SOUGHT FROM WASHINGTON. - (B) I DID NOT CLEAR AND DID NOT SEE ACTUAL TEXT OF MESSAGE BEFORE IT WAS SENT. - (C) DRAFT MEMORANDUM THEREFORE DOES NOT REPRESENT MY CONSIDERED VIEWS ON MANNER IN WHICH PROBLEM SHOULD BE HANDLED.
INSTEAD, IT REPRESENTS UNDERSTANDINGS OF MY STAFF BASED ON RELEVANT REGULATIONS, PRECEDENTS, AND PAST PRACTICES.

CONSEQUENTLY, IN APPROACHING THIS ISSUE, WASHINGTON AGENCIES SHOULD NOT RPT NOT ASSUME THAT THEY WILL HAVE TO "ARGUE" WITH A FIXED POSITION ALREADY TAKEN BY THIS MISSION. IN FACT, MEMORANDUM AS DRAFTED DOES NOT COVER ALL CONCEIVABLE CIRCUMSTANCES THAT MAY ARISE.
WHAT I WANT IS GUIDANCE, WHICH WE WILL THEN ATTEMPT TO MEASURE IN MOST REALISTIC WAY AGAINST THE CIRCUMSTANCES

TEHRAN AND OTHER MAJOR CITIES REMAINED QUIET LAST NIGHT AND THIS MORNING. TELEPHONE THREATS AND PTOWER BLACKOUT RECURRED IN TEHRAN, BUT OTHERWISE THERE WERE NO INCIDENTS. CONSULATES ISFAHAN AND SHIRAZ ALSO REPORT NO MAJOR DISTURBANCES. ISFAHAN BAZAAR AND MOST OTHER SHOPS REMAINED CLOSED YESTERDAY, HOWEVER, AND A FEW SHOTS WERE HEARD LAST NIGHT. A MOLOTOV COCKTAIL WAS THROWN INTO YARD OF BHI EMPLOYEE BUT DID NO DAMAGE. SHIRAZ SHOPS ARE OPEN, INCLUDING BAZAAR. WE HAVE CONFIRMED THAT TEHRAN BAZAAR SHUT DOWN AFTER OPENING YESTERDAY WHEN GROUP OF ABOUT 300 MADE THE ROUNDS, ORDERING OWNERS TO CLOSE OR ELSE. THIS MORNING TEHRAN SHOPS ARE OPEN INCLUDING OUTER SECTIONS OF THE BAZAAR.

MOST STORES IN THE CENTER ARE CLOSED, BUT MANY SHOPOWNERS ARE TRYING THE HALF-OPEN POLICY WE HAVE SEEN BEFORE--SHOP APPEARING CLOSED BUT ACTUALLY OPEN FOR BUSINESS. IT REMAINS TO BE SEEN WHETHER PRO-KHOMEINI TOUGHS WILL ACCEPT THIS HALF MEASURE OR WILL MOVE IN AGAIN TO ORDER CLOSING. CONSULATE TABRIZ REPORTS SHOPS OPEN THROUGHOUT THE CITY YESTERDAY EXCEPT FOR INTERIOR OF THE BAZAAR.

AFFAIR IN TABRIZ DEC 18 STILL DOMINATES SPECULATION. BBC STICKS BY STORY THAT A MUTINY OCCURRED AMONG TROOPS CALLED UPON TO QUELL DEMONSTRATION. PRESS SOURCE WITH STRONG LIST OF CONFIRMATORY CONTACTS TOLD EMBOFF YESTERDAY THAT ONE OR TWO COMPANIES MUTINIED (REPORTED SEPTEL NOTAL). CONSUL TABRIZ REMAINS SKEPTICAL ABOUT PRESS REPORT, AS HIS OWN INVESTIGATION TENDS SO FAR TO SUPPORT GOVT DENIAL OF MUTINY. WE WILL CONTINUE INVESTIGATION.

BBC IS SPECULATING THAT GHOLAM-HOSSEIN SADIQI IS IN PROCESS OF TRYING TO FORM NEW GOVT. SADIQI IS FORMER MINISTER UNDER MOSSADEGH WHO HAS BEEN POLITICALLY INACTIVE (HENCE UNTARNISHED) FOR A LONG TIME. HE IS IN FACT ENGAGED IN ASSEMBLING A GOVT AND WOULD BE WILLING TO BREAK WITH KHOMEINI ON THE QUESTION OF RETAINING THE SHAH. CONSTITUTION WOULD BE STRICTLY OBSERVED. IT REMAINS TO BE SEEN WHETHER HE CAN FIND A VIABLE GROUP OF NATIONAL FRONTERS OR OTHERS WHO COULD WEATHER THE STORM OF KHOMEINI'S WRATH, WHICH WILL FALL ON ANY COMPROMISE GOVT. POSSIBILITY OF KHOMEINI REJECTING ANY SETTLEMENT HAS BEEN SUFFICIENT TO COW OPPOSITION MODERATES UP TO THIS POINT.
SADIQI IS OLD, NOT POLITICALLY AMBITIOUS, AND PROBABLY FEELS HE HAS NOTHING TO LOSE; BUT THAT IS NOT TRUE OF OTHER OPPOSITION LEADERS.
GOVT REPORTEDLY SEIZED CACHE OF ARMS FIVE MILES SOUTH OF TEHRAN.

DOCTORS ARE ON STRIKE IN TABRIZ TO PROTEST DOCTORS KILLED IN MASHAD RECENTLY. WE HAVE REPORT THAT THE ATTACK ON HOSPITAL STAFF, WHICH LED TO MASSIVE UNREST AND LOSS OF CONTROL BY SECURITY FORCES, RESULTED FROM HOSPITAL REFUSING TO TREAT DAUGHTER OF A SERGEANT. HOSPITAL WAS ON STRIKE, AND WE HAVE OTHER REPORTS OF DOCTORS TURNING AWAY MILITARY PERSONNEL. IN MASHAD THE CHILD DIED AND THE ENRAGED SERGEANT ALLEGEDLY CAME TO SHAHREZA HOSPITAL WITH SEVERAL FRIENDS TO TAKE VENGEANCE ON STRIKING DOCTORS.

TEHRAN PUBLIC PROSECUTOR MOJTABA MODARRESI SPOKE ON RADIO THIS MORNING REGARDING THE NOTORIOUS LIST OF TRANSFERS OF FUNDS. MODARRESI DEBUNKED THE LIST TO SOME EXTENT BUT SAID HE WAS WORKING ON A LIST OF 102 NAMES OF PEOPLE WHO HAVE TRANSFERRED LARGE SUMS OF CASH.

HE NOTED THAT WHILE THE TOTAL MONEY TRANSFERRED ACCORDING TO THE PREVIOUS LIST WAS OVER 16 BILLION TOMANS, THE ACTUAL TOTAL DURING THESE TWO MONTHS FROM ALL SOURCES WAS ONLY ABOUT 11 BILLION TOMANS. HE READ MANY OF THE NAMES ON HIS LIST, SAYING HE COULD NOT READ OTHERS UNTIL HE MADE POSITIVE IDENTIFICATION; HE DID NOT WANT TO SAY "JOHN SMITH" OVER THE RADIO AND HAVE EVERY JOHN SMITH IN IRAN ACCUSED OF CORRUPTION. THOSE WHOSE NAMES HE READ INCLUDED ANSARY, SHEIKOLISLAMZADEH AND OTHER WELL-KNOWN FIGURES ACCUSED OF CORRUPTION (BUT NOT MANY EQUALLY WELLKNOWN NAMES WHICH APPEARED ON ORIGINAL LIST). HE GAVE NO AMOUNTS TRANSFERRED.

MODARRESI SAID THESE TRANSFERS WERE NOT IN THEMSELVES ILLEGAL, BUT IN CASES WHERE, FOR EXAMPLE, GOVT EMPLOYEE ON MODEST SALARY TRANSFERRED LARGE SUMS, THE JUSTICE MINISTRY WILL INVESTIGATE HIM FOR CORRUPTION. PROSECUTION WILL THEN PROCEED THROUGH NORMAL COURT CHANNELS.

WIFE OF FORMER GOI OFFICIAL CURRENTLY DETAINED ON SUSPICION OF CORRUPTION INFORMED EMBOFF SHE HAS LEARNED FROM WIFE OF DEPUTY MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR THAT 29 DETAINEES WILL WITHIN SEVERAL WEEKS GO ON TRIAL IN CIVILIAN COURTS. ACCUSED WILL HAVE 20 DAYS TO OBTAIN LAWYERS TO HELP PREPARE THE DEFENSE.

LATE ITEM: TROUBLE REPORTED IN TEHRAN BAZAAR TODAY THROUGH PRESS SOURCES DIFFER AS TO WHAT HAPPENED. AP REPORTS PRO-SHAH GROUP OF FIFTY RAN THROUGH BAZAAR TAUNTING SOME MERCHANTS. ONE OF DEMONSTRATORS WHEN CHALLENGED, PULLED OUT PISTOL AND SHOT TWO MERCHANTS BEFORE HIMSELF BEING SHOT. AFP HAS FIFTY PRO-KHOMEINI (STUDENT) DEMONSTRATORS CLUBBING A SAVAK "POLICEMAN" TO DEATH. HOPE TO GET MORE RELIABLE ACCOUNT BY TOMORROW. SULLIVAN

1978TEHRAN12487.subject: CENTRAL BANK EMPLOYEES LIST OF CAPITAL FLIGHT

segments.text: AS REPORTED IN REF B, RADIO AND TV NEWS REPORTED ON DECEMBER 20 THE MINJUSTICE/PROSECUTOR GENERAL'S FINDING FROM HIS INVESTIGATION AT THE CENTRAL BANK OF THE LIST OF IRANIANS WHO TRANSFERRED FUNDS OUT OF IRAN IN THE TWO MONTHS ENDING OCTOBER 22, A LIST ALLEGEDLY COMPILED BY THE CENTRAL BANK EMPLOYEES ASSOCIATION (SEE REFTEL). PROSECUTOR GENERAL SAID THAT FOUR INVESTIGATORS HAD COMPLETED PRELIMINARY FINDINGS AND COULD CONFIRM TRANSFERS BY 102 OF THE 178 LISTED. THE NAMES OF SOME WERE GIVEN IN THE NEWSCASTS (SEE FOLLOWING LIST OF 44) BUT NO AMOUNTS WERE IDENTIFIED WITH THE NAME, MERELY AN AGGREGATE TOTAL OF RIALS 112,820 MILLION (ROUGHLY DOLS 1.6 BILLION).

THE ENGLISH TV NEWS DECEMBER 20 USED THE WORD "SMUGGLED" THREE TIMES WHEN REFERRING TO THESE TRANSFERS, CLOSING THE COMMENT BY SAYING THAT SUCH TRANSFERS WERE ACCOMPLISHED BEFORE THE IMPOSITION OF EXCHANGE CONTROLS. THE PROSECUTOR GENERAL PROMISED TO INITIATE LEGAL PROCEEDINGS AGAINST PUBLIC OFFICIALS ON THE LIST. INVESTIGATION IS TO CONTINUE, PARTICULARLY TO IDENTIFY THE FIRST NAMES WHEN ONLY THE FAMILY NAME IS GIVEN ON THE TRANSFER.

COMMENT: THERE ARE SERIOUS INCONSISTENCIES AND QUESTIONABLE MAGNITUDES EVEN ON THIS A PRELIMINARY REPORT. HOW COULD ONE BE GUILTY OF A TRANSFER WHEN IT OCCURRED BEFORE THE NOVEMBER 15 IMPOSITION OF EXCHANGE CONTROLS? THE ONLY ISSUE COULD BE WHETHER THE FUNDS WERE "ILL GOTTEN." THE MAGNITUDE, IDENTIFIED AS A REDUCTION FROM THE PREVIOUS RIALS 167,750 MILLIONS (DOLS. 2.4 BILLION) TO THE DOLS 1.6 BILLION STILL APPEARS TOO HIGH AND EXCEEDS THE AMOUNT THE CBI SAYS WAS FED THE FOREIGN EXCHANGE MARKET IN THAT PERIOD. WE ARE ALSO CONFUSED BY THE NUMBER OF NAMES.

WE WERE AWARE THAT DIFFERENT LISTS WERE CIRCULATING BUT BELIEVED THAT THE ONE REPORTED BY REFTEL WAS THE ORIGINAL AND CORRECT ONE. YET NOW THE PROSECUTOR GENERAL HAS REDUCED THE LIST OF NAMES FROM 178 TO 102, THE LATTER BEING THE NUMBER ON THE LIST EMBASSY RECEIVED. PUBLIC FOCUS ON THIS "SCANDAL" CONTINUES HIGH, AND THE GOI APPEARS TO BE RENDERING BUT MORE CONFUSION.
THE FOLLOWING NAMES FROM THE LIST OF 102 WERE MENTIONED ON THE NEWSCASTS: - MOHSEN AZMAYESH ABUNASSR AZOD - ENG.

SIROUS ARJOMAND AHMAD QOTBI - HOOSHANG ANSARI AHMAD KASHANI - HABIB AKHAVAN HABIB LAJVARDI - MAHMOUD AKHAVAN SEYED MOHAMMAD LAJVARDI - NADER AKRAMI ALI REZAI - AHMAD EBRAHIMI SHAHREYAR REZAI - ALI IRAVANI HASSAN RAMZI-ATAI - KHOSROW AKMAL HOOSHANG RAAM - AZARNOUSH EBTAHAJ GENERAL ISMAIL RIYAHI - AZAM ARASTOO IRAJ MOBASHER - HOSSEIN AKHAVAN AMIR MOTTAGHI - HABIB ELGHANIAN AMIR NAVIDI - MANOUCHEHR AZMOON DARYOUSH HOMAYOON - JAMSHID BOZORGMEHR MOHSEN HASHEMI-NEJAD - ANAYAT BEHBAHANI EZATOLLAH YAZDANPANAY - AHMAD NABIPOUR HOJABR YAZDANI - SHAHRYAR PAHLAVI-NIA SHAHRAM PAHLAVI-NIA - ABOLGHASSEM KHERADJOU MAHMOUD KHAYAMI - AMIR-HOSSEIN KHOZIMEH-AALAM ABDOLHOSSEIN SAMII - FATHOLLAH SOTOODEH SHAHPOUR SHAHBAZI - DR. SHEIKHOLISLAMZADEH GENERAL SAMII

EMBOFF MET DEC 17 WITH MALIK MANSOUR KHAN QASHQAI, BROTHER OF QASHQAI IL-KHAN NASSER KHAN. THE MEETING WAS NOT PRECISELY ACCIDENTAL BUT BECAUSE OF DISCUSSIONS WITH THE QASHQAI BROTHERS WHICH HAVE TAKEN PLACE IN OTHER CHANNELS, EMBOFF MADE NO ATTEMPT TO STEER CONVERSATION IN POLITICAL DIRECTION. HOWEVER, MALIK MANSOUR KHAN, AFTER LENGTHY AND NOT WHOLLY UNBIASED TREATISE ON HISTORY OF QASHQAIS AS WARRIOR NATION, DESCRIBED HIS FAMILY AS SUPPORTIVE OF THE SHAH DESPITE WHAT HAS BEEN DONE TO THEM. "I AM NOT AN ORDINARY MAN.

I AM A GREAT KHAN, YET I LIVE IN A RENTED ROOM, CANNOT RETURN TO QASHQAI LANDS, AND MY LANDS FROM ISFAHAN TO THE PERSIAN GULF WERE TAKEN FROM ME BY THIS SO-CALLED PARLIAMENT." HE WAS PARTICULARLY CRITICAL OF FORMER SAVAK CHIEF NASSIRI, WITH WHOM HE HAD A PERSONAL RUN-IN, AND OF THE LATE COURT MINISTER ASSADOLLAH ALAM, WHO MALIK MANSOUR KHAN FEELS BETRAYED HIS CLASS AND THE MEMORY OF HIS FATHER THE REVERED AMIR SHOKAT-OL-MOLK.

MALIK MANSOUR KHAN BELIEVES THAT HIS BROTHER NASSER KHAN, WHO HAS JUST RETURNED TO U.S. FOLLOWING TREATMENT FOR EYE PROBLEM IN MUNICH, MAY SOON RETURN TO IRAN. NASSER KHAN HAS INSTRUCTED HIS FAMILY TO PREPARE LODGINGS FOR HIM WITHIN NEXT TWO WEEKS.

COMMENT: MALIK MANSOUR KHAN'S BITTERNESS WAS PLAIN, AS WAS HIS DESIRE TO REGAIN WHAT HE FEELS IS HIS BIRTHRIGHT. IF HIS BROTHERS FEEL THE SAME WAY, AND IF THE SHAH IS WILLING TO FORGIVE THEIR SUPPORT FOR MOSSADEGH, A DEAL WOULD PROBABLY BE STRUCK ASSURING THE SHAH THE SUPPORT OF THE QASHQAI CHIEFLY FAMILY, FOR WHATEVER THAT SUPPORT WOULD BE WORTH. SULLIVAN

1978TEHRAN12504.subject: MEETING WITH AYATOLLAH QOMI SUMMARY: MASHAD'S MOST SENIOR AYATOLLAH COMES OVER AS INFLEXIBLE. HE SEEMS RELATIVELY NAIVE POLITICALLY

segments.text: SUMMARY: MASHAD'S MOST SENIOR AYATOLLAH COMES OVER AS INFLEXIBLE. HE SEEMS RELATIVELY NAIVE POLITICALLY BUT LENDS GENERAL SUPPORT TO CURRENT (PUBLICLY) UNITED RELIGIOUS OPPOSITION. HE DENIES HAVING HAD HIS FAMOUS DREAM (TEHRAN 12213 AND TEHRAN 12162). END SUMMARY

EMBOFF MET DECEMBER 17 WITH LEADING MASHAD AYATOLLAH HASSAN TABATABAI QOMI IN LATTER'S HOME. ALSO PRESENT WERE QOMI'S SON WHO IS LEADING MASHADI MUJTAHED AND POLITICAL ACTIVIST, ONE LESSER MULLAH AND TWO YOUNGER IRANIANS. BULK OF CONVERSATION WAS TAPED.

AFTER EXPRESSING DEEP PERSONAL SYMPATHIES OVER INCIDENT AT UNIVERSITY HOSPITAL, EMBOFF MADE STATEMENT SIMILAR TO THAT GIVEN IN EARLIER TEHRAN CONVERSATION WITH AYATOLLAH NOURI (TEHRAN 12055) STRESSING U.S. POSITION IN SUPPORT OF SHAH AND POSSIBILITY FOR CONSTITUTIONAL ROLE FOR THE MONARCH WHICH WOULD LEAVE HIM IN COMMAND OF THE ARMED FORCES. QOMI RESPONDED WITH 45 MINUTE DISCOURSE ON ORIGINS OF ISLAMIC LAW AND INHERENT SUPERIORITY OF SHI'A OVER SUNNI INTERPRETATIONS OF ISLAM. HE THEN NOTED NEED FOR END OF CORRUPTION AND RESPECT FOR CONSTITUTION AND FUNDAMENTAL LAWS, WITH SHARIA' ALWAYS TAKING PRECEDENCE.

HOWEVER, RAVAGES OF PRESENT REGIME HAD SO ENRAGED THE PEOPLE THAT QOMI DID NOT BELIEVE THAT THERE IS ANY POSSIBILITY THAT THE SHAH COULD REMAIN. WHEN PRESSED HE AGREED THAT THE 1906 CONSTITUION PROVIDES A ROLE FOR THE SHAH AND SAID THAT HIS ROLE, IF ANY, WOULD HAVE TO BE DECIDED BY THE FUTURE NATIONAL LEADERSHIP. THAT LEADERSHIP, ACCORDING TO THE AYATOLLAH, HAS BEEN DETERMINED BUT ITS IDENTITY MUST REMAIN SECRET FOR THE MOMENT. HOWEVER, THE NEW IRAN TO COME WILL WANT CORRECT BUT RATHER MORE DISTANT RELATIONS (NOT FURTHER DEFINED) WITH COUNTRIES, INCLUDING THE U.S.

QOMI DENIED THE CURRENT TALE OF HIS VISITATION IN A DREAM BY THE IMAM REZA AND PROVIDED A COPY OF HIS LETTER OF DENIAL. HE AND SEVERAL OF HIS FOLLOWERS REMARKED THAT THE STORY OF THE DREAM WAS CLEARLY INSPIRED BY GOI TO PERMIT THEM TO USE THEIR SUPERIOR COMMUNICATIONS FACILITIES TO SOW CONFUSION IN THE MINDS OF THE PEOPLE.

RETURNING TO ATTACK ON REZA SHAH HOSPITAL, QOMI STATED THAT HE AND OTHER RELIGIOUS LEADERS REGARD THIS AS EVEN MORE REPREHENSIBLE THAN EARLIER ATTACKS ON MOSQUE IN KERMAN OR THE SHRINE ITSELF IN MASHAD. HE ASKED HOW PRESIDENT CARTER COULD RECONCILE HIS SUPPORT FOR HUMAN RIGHTS WITH SUPPORT FOR A REGIME WHOSE MINIONS COMITATROCITIES. EMBOFF PROFESSED HIMSELF UNABLE TO SPEAK FOR PRESIDENT BUT NOTED THAT SUPPORT FOR A REGIME, EVEN FOR ONE WHICH HAS ACCOMPLISHED MUCH WHICH IS WORTHWHILE DURING ITS TENURE, DOES NOT EQUATE TO SUPPORT FOR ALL ACTS OF THAT REGIME.
EMBOFF EXPRESSED DOUBT THAT PRESIDENT CARTER IS YET AWARE OF INCIDENT AT SHAH REZA HOSPITAL AND ALSO EXPRESSED DOUBT THAT USG WOULD SUPPORT SUCH ACTIONS.

QOMI IS AN OLD MAN, BUT NOT A WIZENED ONE, WHOSE WHITE BEARD AND BLACK ABA CLOAK AND TURBAN GIVE HIM THE APPEARANCE TRADITIONALLY ASSOCIATED WITH AN AYATOLLAH. THE ABSENCE OF HIS BOTTOM PLATE OF TEETH ADDED TO THE IMPRESSION OF AGE BUT THIS, ON THE OTHER HAND, WAS BELIED BY HIS HANDS, WHICH WERE SURPRISINGLY SMALL, PLUMP AND NOT WRINKLED OR SPOTTED. HE WAS BORN IN NAJAF BUT CAME TO MASHAD AT AGE THREE WITH HIS FATHER, WHO WAS A WELL KNOWN AYATOLLAH OF THE PERIOD. IN 1933, BECAUSE OF QOMI'S FATHER'S OPPOSITION TO REZA SHAH, THE FAMILY WAS EXILED TO IRAQ.

BY THEN QOMI THE YOUNGER HAD ALREADY ATTAINED THE RANK OF AYATOLLAH BUT HE CONTINUED HIS STUDIES IN NAJAF. HE RETURNED TO MASHAD IN 1947 AND, WITH THE EXCEPTIONS OF TWO PERIODS OF IMPRISONMENT, HE HAS BEEN IN MASHAD EVER SINCE. QOMI'S INCARCERATION TOOK PLACE IN 1963, DUE TO HIS SUPPORT FOR AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI'S FIGHT AGAINST IMPERIAL REFORMS, AND AGAIN FROM 1975-77, WHEN HE WAS EXILED TO HOUSE ARREST IN KARAJ FOR OPPOSING PASSAGE OF CERTAIN LAWS BY THE MAJLIS.

QOMI AGREED TO PROVIDE EMBOFF ISLAMIC TRAINING MATERIALS BUT THESE WERE NOT FORTHCOMING. HE ALSO AGREED TO ARRANGE A MEETING FOR EMBOFF WITH MASHAD'S OTHER LEADING CLERIC, THE AYATOLLAH SHIRAZI. BUT ON FOLLOWING MORNING QOMI AND SHIRAZI LED MARCH TO COMMEMORATE DAY OF MOURNING DECREED BY KHOMEINI. SHIRAZI HAVING BEEN ILL, HIS SON-INLAW REPORTED THAT HE HAD EXHAUSTED HIMSELF DURING MARCH AND WOULD NOT BE UP TO RECEIVING EMBOFF.

COMMENT: IN CONTRAST TO AYATOLLAH NOURI, QOMI COMES ACROSS AS INFLEXIBLE (SEE ALSO TEHRAN 12047). HOWEVER, ------------------092774 211328Z /46 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 2353 HIS HARD LINE ON THE SHAH IS UNDERSTANDABLE IN LIGHT OF THE PASSIONS INFLAMED BY THE HOSPITAL INCIDENT. STILL, HIS ANSWERS TO SPECIFIC QUESTIONS WERE VAGUE AND DWELLED HEAVILY UPON ALLUSIONS TO ISLAM. WHILE THIS MAY HAVE REFLECTED NO MORE THAN RELUCTANCE TO PART WITH INFORMATION, IT LEFT EMBOFF WITH IMPRESSION, STRENGTHENED BY COMMENTS HEARD ELSEWHERE IN MASHAD, THAT QOMI IS NOT WELL-INFORMED ABOUT POLITICAL DEVELOPMENTS IN TEHRAN. THE SAME THING WAS HEARD ABOUT AYATOLLAH SHIRAZI.

ACCORDING TO MASHAD UNIVERSITY CHANCELLOR AMOUZEGAR, QOMI AND SHIRAZI DO NOT TAKE AN ACTIVE PART IN THE TACTICAL PLANNING OF OPPOSITION ACTIVITIES IN MASHAD. RATHER, THEY LEND THEIR NAMES, POSITIONS AND MORAL SUPPORT TO THE OPPOSITION WHILE ACTIVIST LEADERSHIP IS PROVIDED BY QOMI'S SON, SHIRAZI'S SONIN-LAW, AND THE LESSER AYATOLLAHS MARASHI AND KHOMA'I. THE MASHADI ISLAMIC ESTABLISHMENT REPORTEDLY HAS FEW DIRECT LINES TO THE NATIONAL FRONT OR OTHER TEHRAN POLITICAL LEADERSHIP. THEIR LINES RUN TO TEHRAN THROUGH THE ISLAMIC TRIAD IN QOM, MADE UP OF THE AYATOLLAHS SHARIAT-MADARI, GOLPAYEGANI AND MARASHI-NAJAFI. (NOTE: THERE ARE TWO AYATOLLAHS NAMED MARASHI, ONE IN MASHAD AND THE OTHER IN QOM.) SULLIVAN
BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND I MET FOR ONE HOUR WITH SHAH STARTING AT NOON DECEMBER 22. ARDESHIR ZAHEDI WAS LEAVING AS WE ARRIVED.

I BEGAN CONVERSATION BY REPORTING THE DEPRESSING CONVERSATION WHICH I HAD WITH PRIME MINISTER AFTERNOON DECEMBER 21. I RECOUNTED AZHARI'S VIEWS THAT HIS CABINET HAD STULTIFIED BECAUSE OF ITS FORESHORTENED FUTURE AND HIS CONCERN THAT INDECISION WOULD PRODUCE EROSION IN THE ARMED FORCES. FINALLY, I TOLD HIM OF AZHARI'S DESPAIR IN LEARNING THAT HE HAD BEEN RELIEVED OF HIS FUNCTION AS CHAIRMAN OF SCS.

SHAH SEIZED FIRST OF THE LAST POINT AND SAID AZHARI HAD BEEN RELIEVED AS CHAIRMAN ONLY BECAUSE CONSITUTION DID NOT PERMIT HIM TO HOLD BOTH FUNCTIONS. HE SAID THAT, IF AND WHEN HE LEAVES PRIME MINISTER'S POST "I WANT HIM BACK AS CHAIRMAN." I SAID I THOUGHT THAT WAS NOT CLEAR TO AZHARI AND IT MIGHT AID HIS DEPRESSION IF SHAH WERE TO CLARIFY THIS VIEW.

WHEREUPON, SHAH PICKED UP PHONE AND TELEPHONED AZHARI. AFTER A RATHER CURT INQUIRY ABOUT THE STATE OF AZHARI'S HEALTH, SHAH WENT INTO LONG EXPLANATION OF REASONS FOR RELIEVING AZHARI OF HIS CHAIRMANSHIP. HOWEVER, HE REFRAINED FROM ACTUALLY UTTERING THE WORDS "I WANT YOU BACK." HE THEN REPORTED TO US THAT AZHARI UNDERSTOOD PERFECTLY WELL AND WAS SATISFIED WITH THE ACTION TAKEN.

WE THEN TURNED TO DISCUSSION OF CURRENT STATE OF PLAY. HE SAID THAT SADIQI, ACCOMPANIED BY ALI AMINI AND ENTEZAM, WOULD REPORT TO HIM DECEMBER 25 CONCERNING HIS EFFORTS TO FORM A GOVERNMENT. SHAH SEEMED TO FEEL SADIQI WOULD PROBABLY PRODUCE A CABINET LIST. IF HE DID, SHAH SAID HE WOULD THEN SEEK THROUGH VARIOUS CHANNELS TO GET NATIONAL FRONT AND MODERATE CLERGY TO HOLD OFF CONDEMNATIONS AND GIVE SADIQI A CHANCE.

HE THEN WENT ON TO INDICATE THAT HE THOUGHT SADIQI WOULD HAVE ONLY LIMITED CHANCES OF RESTORING LAW AND ORDER AND GETTING COUNTRY INTO PRODUCTION AGAIN. HE THEREFORE THOUGHT THERE WAS CONSIDERABLE POSSIBILITY THAT MARTIAL LAW WOULD HAVE TO BE REIMPOSED AND THAT THE MILITARY WOULD HAVE TO TAKE THINGS IN HAND.

I ASKED HIM TO EXPLAIN THAT SCENARIO IN SOMEWHAT GREATER DETAIL. HE SAID THAT HIS BASIC POSITION, AS WE WELL KNEW, AND AS HE HAD PROMISED HIS PEOPLE, WAS TO RETURN TO A CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCHY. THEREFORE, HE WISHED TO IDENTIFY HIMSELF WITH THE SADIQI INITIATIVE. IF SADIQI COULD BE INSTALLED, THE SHAH WOULD THEN TAKE "A WELL DESERVED VACATION." IT WOULD NOT BE OUT OF THE COUNTRY, BUT WOULD BE "VISITING WITH MY NAVY" (I READ THIS TO MEAN ABOARD THE IMPERIAL YACHT, WHICH IS BASED OUT OF BANDAR ABBAS AND COULD EASILY SPEND SOME TIME OUTSIDE THE 12 MILE LIMIT).

IF SADIQI SUCCEEDED, ALL WELL AND GOOD. IF HIS EFFORT FELL APART, THEN IT WOULD HAVE TO BE THE MILITARY WHO WOULD APPLY THE IRON FIST. HE WOULD REMAIN ALOOF (PRESUMABLY ON THE YACHT) AND THE MILITARY WOULD DO WHAT THEY HAVE BEEN WANTING TO DO IN THE RESTORATION OF LAW AND ORDER. HE MUSED ABOUT WHETHER AZHARI WOULD BE HEALTHY ENOUGH OR TOUGH ENOUGH TO DO WHAT WOULD BE NECESSARY. HE WONDERED ALSO WHETHER OVEISI COULD DO IT. IN ANY EVENT, IT WOULD HAVE TO BE IDENTIFIED AS A MILITARY EFFORT, WHILE HE PERSONALLY WOULD REMAIN IDENTIFIED WITH THE CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCHY PLOY.
BRITISH AMBASSADOR ASKED WHETHER SHAH THOUGHT THIS HARD-LINE POLICY WOULD SUCCEED. WITH IMMENSE GRIN, SHAH SAID "I HAVEN'T THE SLIGHTEST IDEA."

WE THEN DISCUSSED WHAT WOULD HAPPEN IF SADIQI FAILED TO FORM A GOVERNMENT. HE SAID, IN THAT EVENT, HE WOULD PROBABLY GIVE UP ANY IDEAS ABOUT ANOTHER POLITICAL EFFORT, AND WOULD SOLDIER ON WITH AZHARI, IF LATTER IS PHYSICALLY ABLE - THIS WOULD MEAN A LONG BATTLE OF ATTRITION. I ASKED WHETHER HE THOUGHT THE OPPOSITION WOULD DISINTEGRATE BEFORE THE GOVERNMENT FORCES DID. HE SAID HE WOULD HAVE TO GET SOME MORE EFFECTIVE GOVERNMENT MINISTERS AND HAVE TO INSURE THE ARMED FORCES WERE BETTER MOTIVATED.

HE TOUCHED ONLY BRIEFLY IN THIS CONVERSATION UPON THE ------------------113278 221721Z /50 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 2381 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 12536 NODIS CHEROKEE POSSIBILITIES OF REGENCY COUNCILS, ABDICATION AND ALL OTHER "ACTS OF SURRDNDER." IN THIS CONTEXT, HE SEEMED QUITE FIRM IN HIS DETERMINATION NOT TO QUIT AND NOT TO ACCEPT A POSITION WHICH WOULD ELIMINATE HIS FUTURE INFLUENCE. HE LOOKED MORE RESOLUTE AND TALKED MORE DEFIANTLY THAN HE HAS FOR MONTHS.

I CONCLUDE (AND BRITISH AMBASSADOR SHARES MY CONCLUSION) THAT, AFTER MONTHS OF INDECISION, SHAH HAS FINALLY MADE UP HIS MIND ON A COURSE OF ACTION. THAT COURSE INVOLVES INVESTING SADIQI WITH THE FULL AUTHORITY OF A CABINET IN CONTEXT OF A CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCHY, BUT WITH A VERY REAL EXPECTATION THAT IT WILL FAIL. BY THE SOPHISTRY OF TAKING "A VACATION WITH THE NAVY," SHAH WOULD WASH HIS HANDS OF THE "BRUTAL REPRESSION" (THE PHRASE WAS HIS) WHICH THE ARMED FORCES WOULD THEN EMPLOY TO RESTORE LAW AND ORDER ONCE SADIQI HAD FAILED.
WHILE HE DOES NOT KNOW WHETHER THIS REPRESSION WILL WORK, HE THINKS IT HAS A BETTER THAN EVEN CHANCE OF SUCCEEEING.

I BELIEVE HE FEELS THIS IS THE ONLY WAY HE CAN (A) PRODUCE A DEFINITIVE SOLUTION TO THE CURRENT STALEMATE, AND (B) RETAIN THE LOYALTY OF HIS OFFICER CORPS, WHICH IS GROWING RESTIVE AND FRUSTRATED WITH HIS INDECISION.

IN OPTING FOR HIS COURSE OF ACTION, HE IS PLACING SIGNIFICANT EMPHASIS UPON THE ABILITY OF SADIQI TO FORM A GOVERNMENT. IN MY JUDGMENT, THIS IS RATHER QUESTIONABLE. SADIQI SPENT THREE HOURS DECEMBER 21 WITH AMINI AND ENTEZAM. GIVEN OUR KNOWLEDGE OF AMINI'S OWN ATTITUDES AND FACT HE AND ENTEZAM WILL ACCOMPANY SADIQI AT THE DECEMBER 25 AUDIENCE, I THINK THERE IS POSSIBILITY SADIQI MAY SEEK TO EXTORT SOME OTHER CONDITIONS, SUCH AS SOME SORT OF REGENCY COUNCIL, BEFORE HE CONTINUES ON HIS TASK AS FORMATEUR.

IF THIS PROVES TO BE THE CASE, WE WOULD THEN FIND OURSELVES BACK IN THE SLOUGH OF ATTRITION. WHETHER THE SHAH, AZHARI, THE CABINET AND THE ARMED FORCES HAVE MORE HOPE FOR DURABILITY IN THAT SORT OF CONFRONTATION THAN KHOMEINI, THE MULLAHS, THE STUDENTS, THE BAZAARIS, THE TUDEH, AND THE GENERAL PUBLIC IS QUESTIONABLE. ENDURANCE IS NOT A NATIONAL CHARACTERISTIC FOR PERSIANS OF ANY PERSUASION.

PAUL GRIM, ACTING HEAD OF OIL SERVICE COMPANY OF IRAN (OSCO), WAS ASSASSINATED MORING IN AHWAZ AS HE DROVE TO WORK. AN IRANIAN DRILLING SUPERVISOR WAS ALSO MURDERED. DETAILS BEING REPORTED SEPTEL NOTAL. AHWAZ HAS HAD UGLY ATMOSPHERE FOR SOME TIME, DUE TO POLITICALLY-BASED STRIKES AND COROLLARY RESENTMENT TOWARD EXPATRIATES.

CONSULATES TABRIZ, ISFAHAN AND SHIRAZ REPORT QUIET CONDITIONS LAST NIGHT AND THIS MORNING. ISFAHAN SHOPKEEPERS OPENED FOR TWO HOURS YESTERDAY BUT THEN CLOSED AGAIN, AND MOST SHOPS ARE CLOSED IN ISFAHAN THIS MORNING. HOME OF GTE EMPLOYEE IN TEHRAN WAS FIREBOMBED EVENING OF DEC 21. MOLOTOV COCKTAIL DID SLIGHT DAMAGE AND MINOR INJURY TO AMCIT AS HE EXTINGUISHED THE BLAZE. AUTOMOBILE WAS FIREBOMBED IN TEHRAN LAST NIGHT. OTHERWISE IT WAS ANOTHER QUIET EVENING FEATURING THE USUAL POWER OUTAGE.

THREAT CAMPAIGN HAS STEPPED UP, AND SEVERAL MORE AMERICANS EACH DAY REPORT THREATENING PHONE CALLS. CURRENT MOST POPULAR DEADLINE IS JANUARY 9, AFTER WHICH AMERICANS WILL BE KILLED. MESSAGE ISUSUALLY DELIVERED BY TAPE RECORDER, AFTER THE CALLER HAS ASKED FOR AMCIT BY NAME.

MLA MASHAD HAS ISSUED COMMUNIQUE AGREEING TO PERMIT RELIGIOUS CEREMONIES DESPITE MARTIAL LAW, IF ORGANIZERS WILL INFORM MLA IN ADVANCE, ANNOUNCEMENT FOLLOWS CONFRONTATION YESTERDAY OUTSIDE REZA SHAH HOSPITAL IN WHICH TROOPS FIRST THREATENED TO DISPERSE CROWD BUT THEN GRANTED PERMISSION FOR LARGE FUNERAL PROCESSION FROM HOSPITAL TO CEMETARY. (COMMENT: AS SEEN FROM HERE, MLA WHICH HAS HAD DIFFICULT TIME MAINTAINING ORDER IN MASHAD HAS SIMPLY ADMITTED WEAKNESS.)

OPENING OF HIGH SCHOOLS IN TEHRAN THIS MORNING PREDICTABLY BROUGHT INSTANT ANTI-SHAH RALLIES AT MANY OF THEM, LEADING TO FIRST STREET DEMONSTRATIONS IN TEHRAN SINCE ASHURA. IT IS DOUBTFUL ANY INSTRUCTION TOOK PLACE TODAY, AND IN FACT WE HAVE SEVERAL REPORTS THAT HIGH SCHOOLS SIMPLY CLOSED AFTER RALLIES BEGAN. THIS OF COURSE PUT STUDENT GROUPS ON THE STREETS, AND BANDS OF SHOUTING YOUNG PEOPLE HAVE MARCHED IN VARIOUS PARTS OF THE CITY. ONE SUCH GROUP PASSED EMBASSY THIS MORNING SHOUTING "YANKEE GO HOME." DEMONSTRATIONS HAVE BLENDED WITH ONGOING SITUATION AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY, WHERE TEACHERS HAVE BEEN ENGAGED IN SIT-IN TO DEMAND THAT UNIVERSITY REOPEN.

LARGE CROWDS OF HIGH SCHOOL AND COLLEGE STUDENTS MASSED OUTSIDE UNIVERSITY THIS MORNING. TROOPS SEALED OFF SHAHREZA AVE. AND CAMPUS, ALLOWING NO ONE TO ENTER OR LEAVE. TROOPS WERE NOT VIGOROUSLY BREAKING UP DEMONSTRATION, IN FACT PERMITTING IT SO LONG AS STUDENTS REMAINED ACROSS SHAHREZA. WE HAVE NO REPORTS OF VIOLENCE OR CLASHES AS OF MIDAFTERNOON, BUT SITUATION IS FLUID AND CLASHES ARE CERTAINLY POSSIBLE BEFORE THE DAY ENDS. SULLIVAN

1978TEHRAN12542.subject: IRANIAN OIL SECTOR STRIKE - DEC 23; ASSASSINATIONS

segments.text: PAUL GRIM, OSCO'S GENERAL MANAGER FOR OPERATIONS, AND AN IRANIAN AREA DRILLING SUPERINTENDENT EMPLOYED BY OSCO WERE MURDERED IN SEPARATE INCIDENTS IN AHWAZ ABOUT 0700 DECEMBER 23. GRIM WAS AN AMCIT ON LOAN TO OSCO FROM TEXACO. ACCORDING TO OUR INFORMATION GRIM WAS KILLED BY AUTOMATIC RIFLE FIRE AS HE WAS DRIVING ALONE, ONTO THE MASJED-E-SULIMAN HIGHWAY (A MAIN ROAD LEADING INTO AHWAZ) ON HIS WAY TO WORK. THE IRANIAN OSCO EMPLOYEE WAS REPORTEDLY KILLED IN FRONT OF HIS HOUSE AS HE WAS PREPARING TO DEPART FOR OSCO OFFICES.

IRONICALLY, GRIM WAS THE EMBASSY'S PRIMARY SOURCE FOR PARA 4 OF OUR OIL SECTOR REPORT OF DECEMBER 14 (TEHRAN 12254) IN WHICH WE REPORTED THAT EXPERIENCED, LEVELHEADED AMERICAN OFFICIALS OF OSCO WERE CONVINCED THAT STRIKERS' THREATS TO TURN TO VIOLENT TACTICS WERE SERIOUS.

OSCO IS HOLDING MEETING IN AHWAZ TO DISCUSS THE SITUATION AND, POSSIBLE EVACUATION AND WE EXPECT THAT MOST REMAINING EXPATRIATE DEPENDENTS AND SOME EXPATRIATE EMPLOYEES WILL CHOOSE TO LEAVE. WE UNDERSTAND THAT THE CONSORTIUM OFFICE IN LONDON HAS MADE STAND-BY ARRANGEMENTS FOR A CHARTER FLIGHT IF MORE PEOPLE WISH TO LEAVE THAN CAN BE ACCOMMODATED ON SCHEDULED FLIGHTS.

WE ALSO HAVE UNCONFIRMED REPORTS THAT ONE PICK-UP AND ONE WIREGGING TRUCK BELONGING TO FOREIGN-OWNED (U.S. AND FRENCH) OIL FIELD SERVICE COMPANIES HAVE BEEN DESTROYED IN AHPH -- PRESUMABLY FIRE-BOMBED. WE HAVE CONFIRMED REPORT REFTEL CONCERNING SABOTAGE TO CRUDE PIPELINE. HOWEVER, LOCAL CONSORTIUM REPRESENTATIVE IS ON VACATION AND HIS DEPUTY DID NOT KNOW OF INCIDENT. THE DEPUTY CONSORTIUM REPRESENTATIVE ALSO HAD NOT HEARD OF MASS-RESIGNATION LETTER (REFTEL) AND WE HAVE BEEN UNABLE THUS FAR TO OBTAIN ANY ADDITIONAL INFORMATION.

EVEN BEFORE THIS CURRENT ROUND OF INCIDENTS, OIL FIELD STRIKERS HAD BEEN HARDENING THEIR ATTITUDES. LAPCO STRIKERS HAVE BEEN SAYING THAT THEY MIGHT RETURN TO WORK ON DECEMBER 26 BUT THAT THEY MIGHT ALSO DECIDE TO CONTINUE THEIR STRIKE UNTIL THERE IS A CIVILIAN GOVERNMENT. THE AMOCO MANAGEMENT OF IPAC HAVE PRACTICALLY GIVEN UP HOPES OF RESUMING PRODUCTION IN THE NEAR FUTURE. IRANIAN EMPLOYEES OF IPAC AT ALL REPEAT ALL LEVELS OF THE COMPANY ARE AT LEAST SYMPATHETIC TO THE DEMANDS OF THE STRIKE-LEADERS, AND IPAC SUPERVISORS REFUSE TO REQUEST OR ENCOURAGE THEIR SUBORDINATES TO RESUME WORK.
TOTAL CRUDE PRODUCTION DECEMBER 21/22 REPORTEDLY AVERAGED 3.6-3.7 MILLION B/D. BECAUSE OF THE TURMOIL IN OSCO WE DO NOT HAVE AN ESTIMATE OF WHAT PRODUCTION WILL BE TODAY, DECEMBER 23.

SINCE THE VERY BEGINNING OF THE OVERTLY POLITICALLYINSPIRED OIL SECTOR STRIKES IN LATE OCTOBER, SENIOR OFFICIALS OF THE GOI, NIOC, AND EVEN THE IRANIAN MILITARY HAVE BEEN WORRIED ABOUT THE POSSIBILITY OF PROVOKING SERIOUS INCIDENTS. IT HAS BEEN LARGELY DUE TO THESE CONCERNS THAT THE MILITARY HAVE BEEN SO RELUCTANT TO EXERT STRONG PRESSURE ON THE STRIKERS. HOWEVER, THE EMPHASIS ON THE CARROT AS OPPOSED TO JUDICIOUS USE OF THE STICK HAS NOT ONLY RESULTED IN A CONTINUATION OF THE STRIKE BUT IT DID NOT EVEN PREVENT THE ADOPTION OF TERRORISM.

THE SITUATION WILL BE EXTREMELY DIFFICULT TO HANDLE BECAUSE OF THE NEW ESCALATION OF VIOLENT TACTICS AND BECAUSE THE GOI, NIOC, AND THE MILITARY HAVE LOST MUCH OF THEIR CREDITABILITY. A SMALL BUT VERY IMPORTANT AND GROWING PERCENTAGE OF OIL FIELD WORKERS (FROM SUPERVISORY STAFF TO THE MOST JUNIOR LEVELS) SEEM TO BE CONVINCED THAT THREATS MADE BY THE GOI WILL NOT BE CARRIED OUT, EITHER BECAUSE OF A LACK OF WILL ON THE PART OF THE GOI AND THE MILITARY OR BECAUSE OF A CONVICTION THAT THE STRIKE HAS SUCH SUPPORT THAT THE WORKERS WILL PREVAIL IN A SHOWDOWN. SULLIVAN

segments.text: RSO BANNERMAN AND SHIRAZ CONSUL MENDYK HAVE GONE TO AHWAZ VIA DATT AIRCRAFT DECEMBER 24. THEY PLAN RETURN TO SHIRAZ AND TEHRAN LATE AFTERNOON TODAY. SULLIVAN

CHANCERY FRONT GATE CAME UNDER ATTACK LITTLE MORE THAN AN HOUR AGO, ABOUT 12:30 LOCAL, BY MOB COMPOSED MAINLY OF YOUTH. THEY THREW STONES OVER WALL LONG WAY INTO COMPOUND, AND BURNED EMBASSY VEHICLE TRYING TO ENTER FRONT GATE (ALLOWING DRIVER TO ESCAPE UNHARMED). SEVERAL WERE TRYING GET OVER FENCE AND A FEW CARS PARKED INSIDE WERE DAMAGED.

REPEATED EFFORTS PRODUCE LOCAL GOVERNMENT REACTION FINALLY PRODUCED MAJOR IN CHARGE OF LOCAL COMPOUND SECURITY WHO AUTHORIZED LIEUTENANT IN CHARGE OF DETAIL GUARDING ROOSEVELT (AMBASSADOR'S) ENTRANCE TO SEND HALF HIS DETAIL TO FRONT GATE. TROOPS HAD REFUSED EARLIER TO MOVE FROM CORNER TO OTHLR GATE TO DEFUSE CROWD.
MEANWHILL AMBASSADOR AUTHORIZED THROWING OF SEVERAL TEAR GAS GRENADES OUT INTO STREET AND CROWD HAS PULLED BACK FROM FRONT GATE AS OF 13:45 LOCAL.
*ARMISH/MAAG HAS MADE NECESSARY CONTACTS WITH MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES. AMBASSADOR HAS APPRISED AMBASSADOR ZAHEDI OF SITUATION, AND HE HAS PROMISED TO HELP.
AT NO TIME HAVE DEMONSTRATORS (WHO HAVE BEEN RUNNING AROUND ROOSEVELT - TAKHTE JAMSHID AREA ALL MORNING) PENETRATED COMPOUND. THERE IS A LULL AS OF THIS WRITING.

1978TEHRAN12563.subject: COMMENTS OF TWO SENIOR IRANIAN MILITARY OFFICERS

segments.text: TWO RECENT CONVERSATIONSBETWEEN GENERAL GAST, CHIEF, ARMISH/MAAG, AND SENIOR IRANIAN OFFICERS ILLUSTRATE AND AMPLIFY POINTS MADE REFTEL.

GENERAL GAST MET DEC 23 WITH LT. GEN.HOUSHANG HATAM, ACTING CHIEF, SUPREME COMMANDER'S STAFF. LATTER WAS VERY CONCERNED ABOUT MORALE OF OFFICERS AND MEN IN IRANIAN ARMED FORCES. HE SAID MANY HAD BEEN THREATENED AND "MANY KILLED, BUT WE DO NOT SAY HOW MANY." (COMMENT: WE HAVE NO EVIDENCE TO SUPPORT USE OF WORD "MANY" HERE.)

HATAM THOUGHT IRAN'S PRIME NEED IS FOR A NEW, "LAWFUL" GOVERNMENT VERY SOON. HE SAID A MILITARY GOVERNMENT WAS NOT WHAT HE HAD IN MIND SINCE MILITARY SHOULD NOT TAKE NEEDED TOUGH APPROACH TO CURRENT SITUATION. INSTEAD MILITARY MUST MAINTAIN ITS INTEGRITY FOR WHATEVER FUTURE MAY HOLD.

HATAM WAS NOT WORRIED FOR NOW ABOUT POSSIBILITY OF A COUP LED BY YOUNGER OFFICERS. HE ADDED THAT MUCH DISSATISFACTION DOES EXIST AND SO HE MIGHT EVENTUALLY HAVE TO CHANGE THAT ASSESSMENT OF YOUNGER OFFICERS.
HATAM HAD NO SPECIFIC RECOMMENDATIONS FOR IRAN'S CURRENT TROUBLES. HE THOUGHT POLITICIANS SHOULD WORRY ABOUT THAT.

ON DEC 24, GENERAL GAST TALKED WITH LT. GEN KHALIL BAKHSHI-AZAR, CHIEF, J-5, SUPREME COMMANDER'S STAFF. LATTER WAS CLEARLY WELL-INFORMED ABOUT EFFORTS TO FORM A SADIQI CABINET. HE MENTIONED SEVERAL NAMES ON CABINET "LIST," INCLUDING ALI AMINI AS MINISTER OF ECONOMICS AND FINANCIAL AFFAIRS. IT WAS, HOWEVER, BAKHSHI-AZAR'S CONCLUSION THAT, IF A SADIQI GOVERNMENT WERE FORMED, IT WOULD FAIL BECAUSE LIST INCLUDES SEVERAL STRONGLY ANTISHAH INDIVIDUALS WHO WOULD WORK TO SEE THAT GOVERNMENT COLLAPSED SO THAT CRISIS WOULD CONTINUE.

BAKHSHI-AZAR SAW NEED FOR AND POSSIBILITY OF CHANGES AMONG SOME TOP MILITARY OFFICERS. IF CIVILIAN CABINET FORMED, GENERAL QARABAQI (PRESENT MINISTER OF INTERIOR) WOULD NOT PARTICIPATE AND THAT WOULD MAKE HIM AVAILABLE TO SUCCEED GENERAL OVEISI, WHO IS "NOT LIKED" BECAUSE OF HIS LACK OF FIELD EXPERIENCE. HATAM MIGHT REPLACE AZHARI AS CHIEF, SUPREME COMMANDER'S STAFF.

SOMEWHAT LIKE HATAM, BAKHSHI-AZAR THOUGHT ARMED FORCES SHOULD NOT TAKE OVER GOVERNMENT BECAUSE THEY WOULD NOT WANT TO LOSE THEIR INTEGRITY AND POPULAR SUPPORT. IN FUTURE, IRANIAN NATION MAY DEPEND ON EFFORTS TO SAFEGUARD THOSE ATTRIBUTES NOW.

AS FOR FUTURE, BAKHSHI-AZAR WAS FATALISTIC. COMMENTED NO ONE WAS PLANNING AND SO WHAT WILL BE, WILL BE. IF SHAH LEFT, HE THOUGHT OPPOSITION GROUPS WOULD FRACTURE AND FIGHT AMONG THEMSELVES. HE WAS NOT SURE WHETHER LATTER WOULD BE GOOD OR BAD DEVELOPMENT. IT IS WORTH NOTING THAT, COMPARED WITH THESE CONCLUSIONS ON DEC 24, WEEK BEFORE BAKHSHI-AZAR HAD FORCEFULLY STATED TO GENERAL GAST CASE FOR TOUGH MILITARY REACTION TO LAWLESSNESS IN VARIOUS PROVINCIAL TOWNS. SULLIVAN

ONE OF THE INTELLIGENCE ITEMS THAT KEEPS CROPPING UP IN WASHINGTON ANALYSIS OF THE IRAN SCENE IS AN APPARENT DIFFERENCE BETWEEN THE BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND MYSELF CONCERNING THE RELATIVE WEIGHTS TO BE ATTACHED TO THE SHAH AND TO PRIME MINISTER AZHARI IN THE CURRENT IRANIAN POLITICAL SCHEME. IN ORDER TO PUT THIS IDLE ISSUE TO REST, TONY PARSONS AND I HAVE COMPARED NOTES AND AGREED THAT THERE IS NO RPT NO DIFFERENCE.

THE FACT IS THAT, EVER SINCE HE APPOINTED SHARIF-EMAMI AS PRIME MINISTER, THE SHAH HAS ATTEMPTED TO COMPORT HIMSELF AS A CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCH. THAT IS TO SAY THAT HE HAS TURNED THE RUNNING OF DAY-TO-DAY GOVERNMENTAL BUSINESS OVER TO THE CABINET, WHICH TAKES ACTIONS ON MANY MATTERS WHICH HE FORMERLY HANDLED IN MINUTE DETAIL HIMSELF. IN THE TIME OF SHARIF-EMAMI, THIS RESULTED IN A CONSIDERABLE AMOUNT OF SLAP-DASH ADMINISTRATION.

IN THE CASE OF AZHARI, WHO HAS FAR GREATER ADMINISTRATIVE EXPERIENCE THAN SHARIF-EMAMI, THE ADMINISTRATIVE PRACTICE IS SMOOTHER. NORMALLY, AZHARI MAKES ALL THE DECISIONS, BUT HIS YEARS OF HABIT IN CHECKING THINGS OUT WITH THE SHAH MEAN THAT HE IS FREQUENTLY ON THE PHONE CONSULTING AND GETTING GUIDANCE.

SHAH, OF COURSE, IS PREOCCUPIED THESE DAYS WITH THE MAJOR POLITICAL PROBLEMS OF TRYING TO THREAD HIS WAY THROUGH A COMPROMISE WHICH WOULD PRESERVE HIS DYNASTY. HE THEREFORE HAS FAR LESS TIME THAN WAS FORMERLY THE CASE TO IMMERSE HIMSELF IN ROUTINE GOVERNMENT BUSINESS.

AS RESULT OF TWO ATTACKS ON MASHAD UNIVERSITY'S SHAH REZA HOSPITAL DECEMBER 15, FOUR PEOPLE DIED AND 14 WERE WOUNDED. (FOR DETAILED REPORT SEE REF A.) ASSAULTS INCLUDED DAMAGE TO VEHICLES PARKED ON HOSPITAL GROUNDS, GUNFIRE AND AT LEAST ONE TANK CANNON ROUND DIRECTED AGAINST CHILDREN'S WARD OF HOSPITAL. SOLDIERS DID NOT ENTER HOSPITAL AND, WITH EXCEPTION OF TWO CHILDREN WHO DIED WHEN THEIR TREATMENT WAS INTERRUPTED, CASUALTIES SEEM TO HAVE OCCURRED OUTSIDE OF HOSPITAL BUILDING.

HOSPITAL INCIDENT IS PERCEIVED BY MASHAD UNIVERSITY AND ISLAMIC OPPOSITION GROUPS AS CONSCIOUS ESCALATION BY GOI OF SERIES OF EARLIER CONFRONTATIONS AT MOSQUE IN KERMAN, AT SHRINE OF IMAM REZA IN MASHAD AND AT GOVERNMENT HOSPITAL IN MASHAD. REACTION AMONG UNIVERSITY STUDENTS AND ISLAMIC ACTIVISTS TOOK ON STRONG ANTI-AMERICAN, ANTICARTER AS WELL AS ANTI-SHAH CHARACTER. OTHER INCIDENTS FOLLOWED, WITH ONE ARMY COLONEL KILLED, ONE OF AYATOLLAH SHIRAZI'S ATTENDANTS WOUNDED AND UNCONFIRMED REPORTS OF OTHER ASSAULTS ON SOLIDERS AND POLICEMEN.

INITIAL REACTION OF LOCAL GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS, ACCORDING MASHAD UNIVERSITY CHANCELLOR PARVIZ AMOUZEGAR FROM WHOM MUCH OF THIS INFORMATION WAS OBTAINED, WAS TO ATTEMP TO FIND SOMEONE TO BLAME, SETTLING EVENTUALLY ON 3RD LIEUTENANT WHO ALLEGEDLY LED THE RAIDS. LATER GOI SENT MINISTERIAL-LEVEL DELEGATION TO MASHAD TO CONVEY APOLOGIES TO UNIVERSITY MEDICAL FACULTY AND TO ISLAMIC LEADERS BUT APOLOGIES WERE NOT ACCEPTED AND DELEGATION WAS SUBJECED TO INSULTS AND RUDE TREATMENT.

UNIVERSITY DOCTORS WERE PREPARING LETTER TO PRESIDENT CARTER ON THIS INCIDENT BUT DROPPED THE IDEA DECEMBER 18 IN VIEW OF LETTER TO PRESIDENT FROM KHOMEINI READ TO CROWD OF OVER 100,000 MET TO MARK KHOMEINI'S DAY OF MOURNING FOR THOSE KILLED IN OPPOSITION TO SHAH. KHOMEINI'S LETTER INCLUDED: CALL ON PRESIDENT CARTER TO CEASE SUPPORTING SHAH IN VIEW OF DISREGARD FOR HUMAN RIGHTS SHOWN IN ATTACK ON HOSPITAL; STATEMENT THAT IRANIAN GASOLINE AND KEROSENE SHORTAGES ARE CAUSED BY SALE OF OIL TO ISRAEL; CALL FOR TRUE BELIEVERS TO TURN UPON THOSE WHO DEMONSTRATE IN SUPPORT OF SHAH.

COMMENT: HOSPITAL INCIDENT HAS STRENGTHENED THE HAND OF UNIVERSITY AND ISLAMIC OPPOSITION GROUPS IN MASHAD AND IT IS DIFFICULT TO SEE WHAT SHORT-TERM STEPS GOI COULD TAKE TO RECOUP THE SITUATION. PRECEDENT IS ALREADY BECOMING SOMETHING OF A CAUSE CELEBRE AMONG IRANIAN UNIVERSITY COMMUNITY AND HAS EARMARKS OF ONE OF THOSE INCIDENTS IN HISTORY OF IRANIAN OPPOSITION WHICH ACQUIRES A SYMBOLIC IMPORTANCE GREATER THAN EVENT ITSELF.

OF ACTIONS WHICH GOI COULD TAKE IN ATTEMPT TO MOLLIFY MASHADI OPPOSITION; I.E., PUNISHMENT OF OFFICER AUTHOIZING ATTACKS, RETURN OF CONTROL OF OQAF OR SHRINE ASSETS TO ISLAMIC CLERGY, OR CREATION OF PUBLIC PARK OUT OF SHAH'S MALIKABAD PALACE IN MASHAD, ONLY LATTER COULD BE UNDERTAKEN WITHOUT POLITICAL COSTS TO GOI AND ANY PALIATIVE ACTION TAKEN FROM APPARENT POSITION OF WEAKNESS MAY ONLY STIMULATE DEMANDS

1978TEHRAN12568.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT, DECEMBER 24 SUMMARY SCATTERED DEMONSTRATIONS IN TEHRAN YESTERDAY HAVE RECURRED TODAY. SOME HIGH SCHOOLS HAVE CLOSED BUT

segments.text: SUMMARY SCATTERED DEMONSTRATIONS IN TEHRAN YESTERDAY HAVE RECURRED TODAY. SOME HIGH SCHOOLS HAVE CLOSED BUT OTHERS WILL KEEP TRYING TO HOLD CLASSES. DEMONSTRATIONS IN BUSHEHR AND MASHAD. ISFAHAN AND SHIRAZ QUIET. STRIKING JOURNALISTS RALLIED AND RECEIVED SUPPORT FROM OPPOSITION MAJLIS DEPUTIES. DEMONSTRATORS ATTACK EMBASSY. END SUMMARY

TEHRAN HAD A LIVELY DAY YESTERDAY AS RESULT OF PREDICTABLY ILL-ADVISED DECISION TO REOPEN SECONDARY SCHOOLS. SCATTERED DEMONSTRATIONS TOOK PLACE IN MANY PARTS OF THE CITY, NEVER BECOMING TRULY VIOLENT BUT TEMPORARILY BLOCKING SOME STREETS. AUTOMOBILE OF BRITISH CITIZEN WAS DAMAGED WHEN HE WAS CAUGHT IN A CROWD. THERE WAS ALSO SOME ROCK-THROWING, AND THE MARCHES COULD NOT BE CALLED CALM, BUT THERE WERE NO SERIOUS ATTACKS ON PEOPLE OR PROPERTY, APART FROM ONE FIREBOMBING OF AMERICAN VEHICLE. LARGE DEMONSTRATION AT NIRT BY "NON-ACCREDITED. EMPLOYEES WAS DISPERSED.

MINISTRY OF EDUCATION RESPONDED TO DISASTROUS SCHOOL DAY BY CLOSING 21 TEHRAN HIGH SCHOOLS, INCLUDING SEVERAL OF THE LARGEST AND BEST KNOWN, UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE. THE REMAINDER (STILL THE MAJORITY) HAVE OPENED THIS MORNING. WHETHER FROM THOSE SCHOOLS OR FROM THE CLOSED ONES, STUDENTS ARE IN THE STREETS AGAIN. MARCHERS PASSED BY THE EMBASSY TWICE THIS MORNING, YELLING "GO HOME, YANKEE." SEVERAL OTHER GROUPS ARE ACTIVE IN GENERAL AREA OF THE EMBASSY. WE ARE AGAIN WITNESSING DISREGARD OF TOUGH MLA DIRECTIVES AGAINST DEMONSTRATIONS. STUDENTS WHO BLOCK INTERSECTIONS ARE EVENTUALLY DISPERSED, BUT THEY ARE SEEMINGLY UNHINDERED IN MARCHING AND SHOUTING. MOTORISTS HAVE JOINED IN RYTHMIC HONKING TO ADD TO THE DIN.

NIRT IS SCENE OF ANOTHER LARGE DEMONSTRATION TODAY WITH TROOPS ON THE SCENE BUT NO CLASHES SO FAR. TROOPS ARE IN FACT BEING HELD BACK OUT OF THE DEMONSTRATORS' WAY IN MOST LOCATIONS, AND MARCHERS, MOST OF WHOM ARE SCHOOL CHILDREN, ARE MAKING THE MOST OF IT. POWER WAS OUT THIS MORNING FOR TWO HOURS, SOMETHING WHICH HAS LATELY OCCURRED ONLY DURING EVENING HOURS.

CONSULATES SHIRAZ AND ISFAHAN REPORT SITUATION QUIET. DEMONSTRATION DISPERSED BY TEAR GAS WAS REPORTED FROM BUSHEHR YESTERDAY. BBC AND SECURITY OFFICER FOR AMERICAN COMPANY REPORT VIOLENCE IN MASHAD YESTERDAY NEAR HOME OF AYATOLLAH SHIRAZI, WITH 8-12 KILLED. CONSUL TABRIZ REPORTS DEMONSTRATIONS UNDERWAY TODAY, WITH SHOOTING AND CONSIDERABLE TROOP MOVEMENT. MILITARY GOVERNOR HAS LED SIZABLE MILITARY CONVOY THROUGH CITY IN SHOW OF FORCE. AT LEAST ONE CITY BUS HAS BURNED AND PERHAPS AS MANY AS THREE.

ABOUT 1,000 STRIKING JOURNALISTS HELD RALLY AT BEHESHT-E-ZARA CEMETARY OUTSIDE TEHRAN DEC 22, ACCOMPANIED BY ABOUT 4,000 SYMPATHIZERS. TWENTY-TWO OPPOSITION MAJLIS DEPUTIES HAVE SENT LETTER TO STRIKERS ANNOUNCING THEIR SUPPORT. CEMETARY HAS BECOME FAVORITE RALLYING PLACE FOR PROTESTORS, PROBABLY DUE TO AUTHORITIES. RELUCTANCE TO INTERVENE.

GROUP OF SEVERAL HUNDRED DEMONSTRATORS RETURNED FOR THIRD TIME ABOUT NOON TODAY AND THIS TIME ATTACKED EMBASSY COMPOUND. CROWD THREW ROCKS AS THEY CHANTED "GO HOME YANKEE," ATTACKED AN IRANIAN OFFICER'S AUTOMOBILE ON TAKHTE JAMSHID, THEN MASSED AT MAIN GATE.

1978TEHRAN12591.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT: CHRISTMAS DAY DEMON- STRATIONS SUMMARY. ABOUT 10-15 MOBS RANGING IN SIZE FROM 20

segments.text: STRATIONS SUMMARY. ABOUT 10-15 MOBS RANGING IN SIZE FROM 200 TO 500 INDIVIDUALS ROAMED CENTER PARTS OF TEHRAN THROUGHOUT MIDDAY DEC 25. WITNESSES SAW TWELVE FIRES STARTED, THREE VEHICLES BURNED. ARMY POSTURE WAS ONE OF CHASING OFF GROUPS WITH SHOTS FIRED OVERHEAD. MOBS WELL ENOUGH ORGANIZED TO TRY BLOCKING TRAFFIC, DISRUPTING TRAVEL THROUGHOUT TEHRAN. ONE GROUP APPROACHED ICA AND PAINTED HOSTILE SLOGANS ON BUILDINGG EMBOFFS CAR SURROUNDED BY HOSTILE GROUP, BUT HE FORTUNATELY MANAGED TO EVADE DAMAGE OR SERIOUS INJURY. MOB MOODS BECOMING MORE AGGRESSIVE. END SUMMARY.

FOLLOWING PUT TOGETHER FROM RELIABLE EUROPEAN AND AMERICAN EYEWITNESSES,INCLUDING EMBOFFS,WHO OBSERVED ALL EVENTS REPORTED. FROM ABOUT MIDDAY TO LATE AFTERNOON, ABOUT 10-15 ORGANIZED MOBS RANGING FROM 200 TO 500 INDIVIDUALS ESTABLISHED THEMSELVES AND MOVED ABOUT THE CENTER OF TEHRAN PASSING OUT LEAFLETS, STARTING AT LEAST 12 SMALL FIRES, AND BURNING THREE VEHICLES. MOBS RANGED FROM KAKH STREET IN WEST TO BEYOND OLD SHEMIRAN ROAD IN EAST, AND FROM BELOW ISTANBUL STREET IN SOUTH TO ABOVE ABBASABAD/25 SHARIVAR IN NORTH. FIRES WERE MOSTLY AIMED AT SMALL SHOPS AND BANKS. ARMY ATTEMPTED TO BREAK UP GROUPS BY FIRING OVER HEADS, BUT GROUPS WOULD REASSEMBLE AFTER A FEW MINUTES AND PROCEED WITH CHANTS.

OBSERVERS OF MOB SAID MOST DEMONSTRATORS WERE IN THEIR MID-TWENTIES WITH GROUP ORGANIZERS SOMEWHAT OLDER. SMALL GROUPS OF DEMONSTRATORS ON SEPAHBOD ZAHEDI AVENUE AND NEAR FERDOWSI CIRCLE WERE PULLING DRIVERS OUT OF THEIR CARS AND LEAVING CARS TO BLOCK TRAFFIC. THIS TACTIC WAS SUCCESSFUL ENOUGH TO DISRUPT MIDTOWN TRAFFIC FOR SEVERAL HOURS. THREE CARS BURNED WERE THOUGHT TO BE THOSE WHOSE DRIVERS RESISTED LEAVING VEHICLES. TWO GROUPS ON PAHLAVI AVENUE WERE STOPPING CARS AND GIVING THEM LEAFLETS.

EARLY MORNING DEC 25, TWO OR THREE INDIVIDUALS APPROACHED GUARD AT ICA OFFICE AND ASKED HIM WHAT IT WAS. GUARD SAID HE DID NOT KNOW; ABOUT 1000 HOURS A GROUP OF ABOUT 300 CAME BACK TO ICA BUILDING AND SPOKE TO GUARD AGAIN. WHILE GUARD WAS AGAIN SAYING HE DIDN'T KNOW, SMALL GROUP OF DEMONSTRATORS PAINTED "THIS IS CIA" ON BUILDING, AND LATER ADDED "DEATH TO SAVAK, DEATH TO CIA." TROOPS CAME FAIRLY QUICKLY AND CHASED MOB AWAY. PARTING SHOUT BY DEPARTING GROUP WAS "WE'LL BE BACK TO BOMB YOU*"

PERHAPS MOST DISTURBING FEATURE OF DEMONSTRATIONS, WHICH BEGAN DEC 24 AND ARE CONTINUING DEC 26 (SEE DAILY REPORT), IS FACT THAT MOOD IS NASTIER AND ARMY FIRING OVERHEAD IS SUFFICIENT ONLY TO BREAK UP GROUPS TEMPORARILY BUT NOT KEEP THEM FROM REFORMING. MOMENT WILL NOT BE LONG IN COMING WHEN ARMY WILL EITHER HAVE TO SHOOT AT DEMONSTRATORS DIRECTLY OR ABANDON AREAS OF TEHRAN TO MOBS.

FACT THAT OFFICERS HAVE BEEN FORCED FROM CARS AND MADE TO SHOUT "DEATH TO THE SHAH," (OUR EYEWITNESS SAW THIS HAPPEN TO A POLICE COLONEL, BUT THERE ARE SEVERAL STORIES SIMILAR TO IT), IS CAUSING CERTAIN AMOUNT OF UNREST ON ONE HAND, AND ITCH TO SEE FIRMER MEASURES ON OTHER. SULLIVAN

I HAD TENSE, PREGNANT HOUR-LONG AUDIENCE WITH SHAH EARLY AFTERNOON DECEMBER 26. HE TOLD ME THAT SADIQI, ALI AMINI AND ENTEZAM HAD MET WITH HIM DECEMBER 25. IN THAT MEETING, SADIQI HAD SAID HE HAD RECRUITED "SEVEN OR EIGHT" POTENTIAL MINISTERS, BUT ASKED FOR MORE TIME IN WHICH TO FORM A GOVERNMENT. I ASKED HOW MUCH TIME HE WANTED. SHAH SAID "UP TO SIX WEEKS."

AT THIS POINT, I TOLD THE SHAH HE WAS BADLY INFORMED IF HE THOUGHT HE HAD SIX WEEKS IN WHICH MATTERS COULD DRIFT. I WENT OVER THE SITUATION IN THE OIL FIELDS, THE CENTRAL BANK, THE VARIOUS MINISTRIES, THE TENSION IN MASHAD AND THE TURMOIL FOR THE PAST FEW DAYS IN THE STREETS OF TEHRAN. I REVIEWED AGAIN THE PRIME MINISTER'S CONCLUSION THAT HIS GOVERNMENT HAD STULTIFIED AND WOULD REMAIN INERT WHILE WAITING FOR SADIQI. I ASKED WHETHER SHAH TRUSTED SADIQI, OR WHETHER LATTER WAS DIDDLING HIM. WHAT WAS HIS RATIONALE IN ASKING FOR SIX MORE WEEKS?

SHAH SAID SADIQI WANTED SITUATION TO DETERIORATE FURTHER SO THERE WOULD BE BACKLASH HE COULD EXPLOIT AGAINST KHOMEINI. I TOLD SHAH I THOUGHT SITUATION WOULD DETERIORATE RAPIDLY AS SOON AS EFFECT OF REDUCED OIL DELIVERIES TO REFINERIES TOOK FORM OF ACUTE PRODUCT SHORTAGE. HOWEVER, I DOUBTED IT WOULD PRODUCE BACKLASH AGAINST KHOMEINI. MY IMPRESSION WAS THAT ALL BACKLASHES WERE AGAINST GOVERNMENT AND AGAINST HIM PERSONALLY. I THEREFORE FOUND SADIQI'S ATTITUDE SPECIOUS.

SHAH SAID SADIQI SEEMED TO BE HIS ONLY HOPE FOR A "MIDDLE OPTION." IF THIS HOPE EVAPORATED, HE WAS LEFT WITH ONLY TWO CHOICES; EITHER TO SURRENDER OR TO USE THE IRON FIST. THIS, THEN, LED TO A DISCUSSION OF THE IRON FIST OPTION. I SAID WASHINGTON WAS VERY CONCERNED WITH SHAH'S PROPOSAL TO LEAVE TEHRAN AND TURN IRON FIST EXECUTION OVER TO MILITARY. IT WAS FELT HIS DEPARTURE WOULD CONVEY WRONG SIGNAL TO EVERYONE. HE REPEATED HIS EARLIER ARGUMENTS THAT, AS A KING, HE COULD NOT PRESIDE OVER A BLOODLETTING AMONG HIS OWN PEOPLE.

I ASKED WHO WAS GOING TO BE DECEIVED BY THE SOPHISTRY OF HIS PRESENCE "WITH THE NAVY" IF HE STILL REMAINED THE SHAH WHEN THE BLOODLETTING TOOK PLACE. CERTAINLY NO FOREIGNERS WOULD BE DECEIVED. WOULD IRANIANS THINK THERE WAS SOME MAGIC INSULATION IN THE DISTANCE BETWEEN TEHRAN AND THE PERSIAN GULF?

SHAH THEN WEARILY PURSUED THE OPTION OF USING CURRENT GOVERNMENT TO APPLY THE IRON FIST. HE SAID AZHARI WAS STILL NOT FULLY RECOVERED AND MIGHT NOT HAVE THE PHYSICAL STAMINA NEEDED TO ACT. HE FRETTED ABOUT THE TROOPS AND WHETHER THEY WOULD BE WILLING TO TAKE THE ACTION NECESSARY. FINALLY, HE WONDERED, WHETHER IT WOULD WORK, PARTICULARLY WHETHER PEOPLE WOULD GO BACK TO PRODUCTION IN THE OIL FIELDS OR WHETHER THEY WOULD SABOTAGE THEM. HE SAID THAT, "AS A PATRIOT," HE HAD TO ASK HIMSELF ALL THESE QUESTIONS.

HE THEN ASKED WHAT I THOUGHT WOULD HAPPEN IF "HE SURRENDERED." I SAID I THOUGHT THE SITUATION LOULD BECOME COMPLETELY UNPREDICTABLE, WITH THE ONLY CERTAINTY BEING CHAOS. I ASKED WHAT HE THOUGHT WOULD HAPPEN TO THE ARMED FORCES IF HE LEFT. HE SAID HE DID NOT KNOW, BUT THERE WAS STRONG PROSPECT THEY WOULD DISINTEGRATE.

SHAH ASKED WHAT UNITED STATES WANTED HIM TO DO. I REPEATED FORMULATION FROM REF A ABOUT U.S. SUPPORT FOR HIS EFFORTS TO REESTABLISH LAW AND ORDER. HE ASKED WHETHER I WAS ADVISING HIM TO USE THE IRON FIST, EVEN IF THAT MEANT WIDESPREAD BLOODSHED AND EVEN IF IT MIGHT FAIL TO RESTORE LAW AND ORDER. I SAID IF HE WAS TRYING TO GET THE UNITED STATES TO TAKE THE RESPONSIBILITY FOR HIS ACTIONS, I DOUBTED I WOULD EVER GET SUCH AN INSTRUCTION FROM WASHINGTON. I SAID HE WAS THE SHAH AND HE HAD TO TAKE THE DECISION, AS WELL AS THE RESPONSIBILITY.
MY ONLY ADVICE AT THIS TIME WAS THAT HE DID NOT HAVE SIX WEEKS IN WHICH TO REMAIN UNDECIDED.

AS IF TO PUNCTUATE THIS REMARK, GENERAL OVEISI TELEPHONED TO REPORT ON THE SITUATION IN THE CITY. AUTOBUSES WERE BEING TIPPED OVER AND BURNED. A SECTOR OF THE UNIVERSITY HAD BEEN TAKEN OVER AND CONVERTED INTO ------------------016366 261554Z /41 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 2418 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 12592 NODIS CHEROKEE A "REVOLUTIONARY HEADQUARTERS." ITS OCCUPANTS HAD PROCLAIMED AN IRANIAN REPUBLIC WITH A CONSTITUTION MODELED ON THAT OF ROMANIA. I ASKED WHAT SHAH WAS GOING TO DO ABOUT THAT. HE SHRUGGED.

AS I LEFT, HE WENT OVER HIS TWO CHOICES AGAIN AND SAID HE WOULD HAVE TO FACE THE DECISION WITHOUT DELAY. I RETURNED TO THE EMBASSY THROUGH A CITY WHICH IS CONSTANTLY ECHOING THE SOUNDS OF GUNFIRE AS TROOPS FIRE INTO THE AIR TO BREAK UP SWIRLING GROUPS OF DEMONSTRATORS WHICH FORM AND REFORM IN AN EFFORT TO ACCUMULATE ENOUGH PEOPLE TO ATTACK SOME WORTHY OBJECTIVE.

COMMENT: WHILE SHAH SEEMS TO BE LEANING TOWARDS THE OPTION OF THE IRON FIST, HE CLEARLY HAS NO RPT NO CONFIDENCE IT WILL WORK. HE WOULD ALSO DEARLY LIKE TO HAVE THE PRESIDENT OF THE UNITED STATES TAKE, OR AT LEAST SHARE, THE DECISION WITH HIM. I BELIEVE, AS I TOLD HIM, THAT IF HE IS GOING TO MOVE IN THAT DIRECTION, THE DECISION AND RESPONSIBILITY HAVE TO BE HIS ALONE. IF WASHINGTON HAS ANY DIFFERENT VIEWPOINT, PLEASE ADVISE. SULLIVAN

1978TEHRAN12596.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT, DEC 26, 1978-1405 SUMMARY: NUMEROUS STUDENT DEMONSTRATIONS DEC 24-25, USUALLY A CAT AND MOUSE GAME WHICH MICE ARE WINNIN

segments.text: SUMMARY: NUMEROUS STUDENT DEMONSTRATIONS DEC 24-25, USUALLY A CAT AND MOUSE GAME WHICH MICE ARE WINNING. ATTACK ON EMBASSY DEC 24 SEEMS LESS SPONTANEOUS IN RETROSPECT. FOUR MEN CONVICTED OF CORRUPTION. DEMONSTRATIONS CONTINUE TODAY.

WIDESPREAD STUDENT MARCHES ACCOMPANIED BY LOW LEVEL VIOLENCE CONTINUE IN TEHRAN AND OTHER CITIES, INEFFECTIVELY OPPOSED BY SECURITY FORCES. DEMONSTRATORS ARE ENJOYING SUCH STUNTS AS ASSEMBLING AT A BUSY INTERSECTION AND ORDERING DRIVERS OUT OF THEIR CARS. THEY LEAVE VEHICLES UNDAMAGED, BUT THE ABANDONED CARS BLOCK TRAFFIC FOR MILES. TEHRAN TRAFFIC, PROBABLY THE WORST IN THE WORLD EVEN UNDER NORMAL CONDITIONS, HAS BECOME IMPOSSIBLE. MOB IS ACTING MOSTLY WITHOUT FEAR OF PUNISHMENT; GROUP ASSEMBLES AND CAUSES SOME DISTURBANCE WHILE TROOPS TRY TO MAKE THEIR WAY THROUGH TRAFFIC SNARL. WHEN TROOPS ARRIVE, STUDENTS MAY HAVE ALREADY MOVED ON.

IF NOT, TROOPS MERELY FIRE OVER THEIR HEADS, AND THEY SCATTER TO A NEW LOCATION. STUDENTS ARE ALMOST NEVER INJURED OR ARRESTED, SO THERE IS NO REASON FOR THEM TO CEASE THE GAME. GOVT ANNOUNCED DEC 24 THAT TEHRAN HIGH SCHOOLS ARE CLOSED UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE. THIS DID NOT DEFUSE SITUATION, AND STUDENTS HAD A FINE CHRISTMAS OF MARCHING AND DISRUPTING (BEING REPORTED SEPTEL).

EXPLOSION OF BUTANE GAS AND BOILER AT HOUSE INHABITED BY WESTERN ELECTRIC EMPLOYEES DEC 22 HAS BEEN DETERMINED TO BE RESULT OF EXPLOSIVE DEVICE INSTALLED BY INTRUDER, BLAST CAUSED EXTENSIVE DAMAGE BUT NO INJURIES TO INHABITANTS WHO WERE NOT PRESENT AT TIME.

CONSULATE TABRIZ REPORTS DEMONSTRATIONS YESTERDAY IN CENTER CITY, WHICH WAS CORDONED OFF. NO FURTHER DETAILS ARE YET AVAILABLE. CONSUL EXPECTS DEMONSTRATION TO FOCUS ON CONSULATE TODAY. WE HAVE REPORT OF RECENT TROUBLE IN FOWMEN (NEAR RASHT).

POWER COMPANY WORKERS GAVE US A CHRISTMAS PRESENT BY LEAVING POWER ON DURING CHRISTMAS EVE (AFTER THE EARLIER CHRISTMAS GIFT OF ATTACK ON EMBASSY). WE UNDERSTAND DISSIDENTS MAY ALSO GIVE US NEW YEAR'S EVE AND POSSIBLE ARMENIAN CHRISTMAS. MEANWHILE WE ARE BACK TO NIGHTLY OUTAGES. ABOUT 120 PROFESSORS ARE STILL HOLDING SIT-IN AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY, DEMANDING THAT IT REOPEN.

SEVERAL TIMES SINCE HIS NOVEMBER ARRIVAL IN TEHRAN, EMBOFF HAS BEEN OFFERED HANDGUNS BY IRANIAN FRIENDS. FOLLOWING DEC 24 ATTACK ON EMBASSY, EMBOFF WAS OFFERED HANDGUN WITH SHOULDER HARNESS AND HAND GRENADES. MOST OF THESE OFFERS, PARTICULARLY THE LATTER ONE, HAVE COME FROM UPPER TO UPPER MIDDLE CLASS IRANIANS WHO ARE APPARENTLY BUILDING UP PRIVATE ARSENALS AGAINST VIOLENCE WHICH THEY FEAR MAY BE DIRECTED AGAINST WEALTHIER TEHRAN RESIDENTS.

ATTACK ON EMBASSY DEC. 24, WHICH APPEARED COMPLETELY SPONTANEOUS, NOW APPEARS LESS SO. LIEUTENANT IN CHARGE OF TRUCKLOAD OF TROOPS AT ROOSEVELT (AMBASSADOR'S GATE) REVEALED THAT MARCHERS FIRST WANTED TO STORM THAT GATE. HE TALKED THEM OUT OF IT, SAYING HE WOULD HAVE TO DEFEND IT AND THERE WOULD BE GREAT LOSS OF LIFE. MOB THEN MOVED TO MAIN GATE. (THIS SAME OFFICER WATCHED ATTACK AGAINST EMBASSY WITHOUT INTERVENING.) ANOTHER INTERESTING ASPECT OF DEMONSTRATION WAS THAT SEVERAL EMBASSY EMPLOYEES HEARD AFGHAN ACCENTS AMONG THE CROWD.

1978TEHRAN12597.subject: MOOD IN THREE TOWNS IN KHORASSAN PROVINCE

segments.text: DURING RECENT TRIP TO MASHAD, EMBOFF ALSO HAD OCCASION TO SPEND VARYING PERIODS IN SMALLER KHORASSAN TOWNS OF NISHABOUR, SABZEVAR AND ESFERAIN. GENERAL MOOD VARIED WIDELY BUT VIEW IN EACH AREA WAS CONDITIONED BY LOCAL DEVELOPMENTS RATHER THAN NATIONAL POLITICS.

NISHABOUR: IN RESPONSE TO UNSETTLED SITUATION FOLLOWING PRO AND ANTI-SHAH DEMONSTRATIONS (REFTEL), ARMY MOVED ARMOURED CAR INTO NISHABOUR. IT ATTRACTS SMALL CROWDS AS MANY AREA PEASANTS HAVE NEVER SEEN ANYTHING LIKE IT BEFORE. HOWEVER, ANTI-SHAH FEELINGS IN WHAT IS NORMALLY AN EXTRAORDINARILY PEACEFUL AGRICULTURAL TOWN ARE KEPT SIMMERING BY THREE LOCAL JUSTICE MINISTRY OFFICIALS: GHOLAM HOSSEIN DANESH TALAB, CHIEF OF THE LOCAL JUSTICE MINISTRY OFFICE AND FORMER HEAD OF THE NISHABOUR BRANCH OF THE RASTAKHIZ PARTY; AYUB BEHMANESH, LOCAL DISTRICT ATTORNEY; AND YADOLAH SETVATI, A LOCAL JUDGE.

APPARENTLY BASED UPON A COMBINATION OF OPPORTUNISM AGREED AND A DRIVE FOR PERSONAL REVENGE, THESE OFFICIALS ARE INSTITUTING AND ENCOURAGING LEGAL ACTIONS AGAINST PRO-SHAH CITIZENS AND PROVIDING COUNSEL AND ENCOURAGMENT TO ANTI-SHAH TEACHERS AND STUDENTS. IN CONSEQUENCE, NISHABOURIS ARE BECOMING LESS WILLING TO SPEAK IN SUPPORT OF THE THRONE.

SABZEVAR: THE RESIDENTS OF THIS CITY HAVE FULLY LIVED UP TOTHEIRREPUTATION AS HOTHEADS. IN A SERIES OF CLASHES WITH SECURITY FORCES AND SOLDIERS AS MANY AS 30 TO 70 CITIZENS HAVE BEEN REPORTED KILLED OR WOUNDED. AS A RESULT MARTIAL LAW WAS INSTITUTED IN SABZEVAR AND THE CIVILIAN FARMANDAR WAS REPLACED BY A MILITARY GOVERNOR.

ESFERAIN: THIS SMALLER FARMING TOWN, SITUATED IN ONE OF THE BROAD EAST-WEST VALLEYS WHICH CHARACTERIZE THE SOUTHERN APPROACHES TO THE MAIN SPINE OF THE ALBORZ IN KHORASSAN, IS LARGELY PRO-SHAH. THERE WERE NO SOLDIERS IN ESFERAIN AND THE ONE SMALL GROUP OF YOUTHFUL DEMONSTRATORS WHICH APPEARS WAS ROUNDED UP BY THE SHIKARBANI (A NATIONAL FORCE OF GAME WARDENS) LECTURED FORCEFULLY AND SENT HOME.

THE PREVAILING VIEW, BOTH IN ESFERAIN AND ITS SATELLITE VILLAGES, MIGHT BE DESCRIBED AS, "WE RESPECT BOTH THE SHAH AND KHOMEINI, BUT SEE NO REASON WHY THEY SHOULD FIGHT." IN CONTRAST TO MANY OTHERS WHO HAVE INFORMED EMBOFF THAT THEY SUPPORT THE SHAH AS THE BEST OF A SERIES OF BAD ALTERNATIVES, SUPPORT FOR THE THRONE IN ESFERAIN SEEMS TO FLOW FROM A POSITIVE BASE.

IT WAS BEST EXPRESSED BY AN OTHERWISE DISAGREEABLE OLD MAN OF KURDISH EXTRACTION WHO POINTED TO A RUINED FORT IN THE VALLEY AND SAID THAT, AS A SMALL BOY HE HAD WORKED WITH HIS FATHER UNDER THE OVERSEER OF THE KHAN (HE MEANT THE ABSENTEE LANDLORD) TO KEEP THE FORT REPAIRED AS A DEFENSE AGAINST THE TURKOMEN RAIDERS. THEN THE ARMY OF THE SHAH CAME AND DROVE THE TURKOMEN AWAY (HE MEANT THE SHAH'S FATHER). STILL THEY HAD TO GIVE MOST OF THEIR CROPS TO THE KHAN. THEN THE SHAH DROVE THE KHAN AWAY. "NOW WE HAVE NEITHER THIEVING TURKOMEN NOR THIEVING KHANS. JAVID SHAH*"

COMMENT: UNFORTUNATELY, IT IS DIFFICULT TO TRANSLATE THIS SORT OF HEARTFELT SUPPORT INTO ANYTHING MEANINGFUL IN THE PRESENT SITUATION. THIS IS SO PRIMARILY BECAUSE ONLY THOSE WHO ARE OLD CAN REMEMBER THE DAYS WHEN DISRUPTION AND PHYSICAL INSECURITY WERE THE NORM IN IRAN. MORE THAN HALF OF IRAN'S POPULATION AND VIRTUALLY ALL OF ITS ANTI-SHAH DEMONSTRATORS (BUT NOT THE ANTI-SHAH LEADERSHIP) ARE UNDER 25 AND TAKE FOR GRANTED THE SECURITY WHICH THE PAHLAVIS HAVE ESTABLISHED. CONSEQUENTLY THE SUPPORT WHICH EXISTS IN ESFERAIN WOULD APPEAR TO HAVE ONLY LOCAL UTILITY.

1978TEHRAN12598.subject: COMMENTS OF COL BEHRUZ SAMSHAHR, INSTRUCTOR AT NATIONAL POLICE ACADEMY

segments.text: NATIONAL POLICE ACADEMY

IN CONVERSATION WHICH INCLUDED EMBOFF, COL. SAMSHAHR STATED THAT ANTI-SHAH DEMONSTRORS DEC 23 HAD ATTACKED THE PRISON IN SANANDAJ, SETTING IT AFIRE, RELEASING THE PRISONERS AND STEALING A NUMBER OF WEAPONS FROM THE PRISON ARMORY.

SAMSHAHR, WHO IS ALSO VICE PRESIDENT OF NATIONAL KARATE FEDERATION, EXPRESSED VIEW THAT WHAT IS NEEDED IS A MILITARY COUP WHICH WOULD THEN GIVE THE ARMY A FREE HAND TO KILL AS MANY DEMONSTRATORS AS NECESSARY UNTIL ORDER IS RESTORED. (COMMENT: INTERESTINGLY PARVIZ AMOUZEGAR, CHANCELLOR OF MASHAD UNIVERSITY, MADE SIMILAR COMMENT TO EMBOFF, OPINING THAT SHAH COULD GO ON VACATION TO JORDAN OR EUROPE SO THAT ANY EXCESSES WHICH TOOK PLACE DURING HIS ABSENCE WOULD NOT BE COMMITTED IN HIS NAME. UPON HIS RETURN TO AN ORDERLY NATION THE GENERAL(S) IN CHARGE COULD BE RELEGATED TO A COMFORTABLE EXILE, AS WAS DONE WITH GENERAL ZAHEDI. END COMMENT) SULLIVAN

FOLLOWING REFTEL, E/C COUNSELOR SPOKE ON DECEMBER 24 WITH AHMAD LADJEVARDI OF THE BEHSHAHR INDUSTRIAL GROUP AND ON DECEMBER 26 WITH RAHIM IRVANI OF MELLI INDUSTRIES. BOTH ARE BOARD MEMBERS OF THE IRAN AMERICAN CHAMBER OF COMMERCE AND DISPOSED TO BE CANDID. LADJEVARDI ATTENDED A MEETING AT THE AMBASSADOR'S RESIDENCE ON DECEMBER 4 IN WHICH THE CHAMBER BOARD PAINTED A GRIM PICTURE OF THE IRANIAN ECONOMY (TEHRAN 11878).

LADJEVARDI SAID THE ECONOMY HAD SUFFERED A FURTHER SERIOUS DETERIORATION SINCE THE EARLY DECEMBER MEETING. THIS WAS TRUE BOTH IN A DOMESTIC SENSE AND IN THE FOREIGN PERCEPTION OF IRAN'S ECONOMY. FOREIGN PESSIMISM CONCERNING IRAN HAD MANIFESTED ITSELF IN VARIOUS WAYS INCLUDING, FOR EXAMPLE, A GENERAL REQUIREMENT THAT CONFIRMED LETTERS OF CREDIT BE ISSUED FOR IRANIAN IMPORTS. THIS MEANS THAT IMPORTERS MUST DEPOSIT THE FULL VALUE OF MERCHANDISE ORDERED AND MAINTAIN SUCH DEPOSITS UNTIL THE ARRIVAL AND CLEARANCE OF IMPORTS. IN THE CURRENT SITUATION, WITH LIQUIDITY SEVERELY STRAINED, THIS IS AN ONEROUS DEVELOPMENT.

LADJEVARDI SAID THE CONSTRUCTION INDUSTRY IS THE WORST AFFECTED SO FAR BY THE CRISIS. MANY PROJECTS HAVE BEEN STOPPED AND FACE POSSIBLE COLLAPSE. LARGE NUMBERS OF WORKERS HAVE BEEN LAID OFF AS A RESULT. THE DISTRESS OF THE CONSTRUCTION INDUSTRY HAS AFFECTED THE BEHSHAHR GROUP DIRECTLY. DEMAND FOR ITS STEEL FABRICATION PRODUCTS HAS DROPPED OFF SIGNIFICANTLY AND HAS RESULTED IN LAYOFFS OF INDUSTRIAL WORKERS. LADJEVARDI SAID MOST OTHER INDUSTRIES HAVE NOT YET BEEN SO SEVERELY CRIPPLED; THE DANGER IS NOT SO MUCH BANKRUPTCY AS A WIDESPREAD SUSPENSION OF INDUSTRIAL PRODUCTION WITH CONSEQUENT LAYOFFS.

IN MOST CASES, FIRMS ARE STILL FINANCIALLY SOUND, BUT HAVE BEEN FORCED TO SUSPEND OR LIMIT PRODUCTION AS INVENTORIES ARE EXHAUSTED, UTILITY SERVICES ARE INTERRUPTED, AND FINANCIAL DEFICIENCIES STRANGLE BUSINESS ACTIVITY.

LADJEVARDI SAID THAT THE DEMAND FOR FOOD PRODUCTS AND OTHER ESSENTIALS IS EXTRAORDINARILY HIGH. FOR EXAMPLE, VEGETABLE OIL IS LIKE GOLD. CUSTOMERS DEMAND ALL THEY CAN GET. ON THE OTHER HAND, DEMAND FOR TEXTILES HAS PLUMMETED.

LADJEVARDI SAID THAT THE BEHSHAHR GROUP WAS ABLE TO PAY ITS WORK FORCE ON DECEMBER 21 AT THE BEGINNING OF THE IRANIAN MONTH, BUT A NOTE WAS INCLUDED IN EACH PAY ENVELOPE ADVISING EMPLOYEES TO SAVE AS MUCH OF THEIR PAY AS POSSIBLE SINCE THERE IS NO CERTAINTY THAT THE NEXT BIMONTHLY WAGE PAYMENT CAN BE MADE.

PAYMENT OF DOLLAR LOANS NOT APPROVED BY THE CENTRAL BANK PRESENTS A SPECIAL PROBLEM TO THE BEHSHAHR GROUP. THE CENTRAL BANK WILL NOT PROVIDE FOREIGN EXCHANGE AT THE OFFICIAL RATE FOR SERVICING SUCH LOANS. TO MEET SUCH OBLIGATIONS, BEHSHAHR WILL BE REQUIRED TO PURCHASE FOREIGN EXCHANGE AT UNOFFICIAL FREE MARKET RATES EXCEEDING RIALS 80 TO THE DOLLAR. BUSINESSMEN, BOTH LARGE AND SMALL, WHO FORMERLY ZEALOUSLY PROTECTED REPUTATIONS FOR PROMPT PAYMENT OF DEBTS, HAVE BEEN FORCED TO AVOID PAYMENT. THIS HAS SUBSTANTIALLY AFFECTED THE ATTITUDE WITH WHICH SUCH OBLIGATIONS ARE REGARDED.

LADJEVARDI SUMMARIZED HIS REVIEW OF THE SITUATION BY EXPRESSING THE OPINION THAT THE ECONOMY CANNOT HOLD UP IN THE PRESENT SITUATION FOR MORE THAN A FEW WEEKS LONGER WITHOUT SERIOUS RISK OF COLLAPSE. THE LONGER A SOLUTION IS DEFERRED, THE MORE DIFFICULT IT WILL BE TO REVIVE THE BUSINESS CLIMATE.

IRVANI PRESENTED A SOMEWHAT DIFFERENT PICTURE--LESS PESSIMISTIC WITH RESPECT TO HIS OWN INDUSTRIAL GROUP, BUT SOMBER CONCERNING THE POLITICAL AND ECONOMIC OUTLOOK. HE SAID, WITH OBVIOUS PRIDE, THAT THE MELLI GROUP WAS WELL PREPARED FOR THE CRISIS. INVENTORIES OF MATERIALS WERE AMPLE AND EMPLOYEE RELATIONS WERE EXCELLENT. THE GROUP EMPLOYS SOME 11,500 WORKERS, 8,600 OF WHOM ARE IN TEHRAN. BARRING UNFORESEEN DEVELOPMENTS, MELLI SHOE FACTORY AND MOST OTHER DIVISIONS OF THE COMPANY WILL BE ABLE TO FUNCTION FOR ANOTHER FOUR TO SIX WEEKS BASED ON THE PRESENT STOCKS.

THERE ARE MANY DIFFICULTIES, HOWEVER; SALES ARE WAY DOWN AND REVENUES ARE EVEN WORSE DUE BOTH TO SALES REDUCTIONS AND THE CRISIS IN THE BANKING SYSTEM. IRVANI INTENDS TO KEEP HIS EMPLOYEES BUSY PRODUCING AS LONG AS POSSIBLE, IN ORDER TO PREVENT A DETERIORATION OF THEIR MORALE.

HE POINTED OUT THAT HE HAD JUST GIVEN HIS EMPLOY------------------020950 270947Z /12 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 2443 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 12634 LIMDIS EES THEIR MONTHLY WAGES BUT HAD (LIKE LADJEVARDI) ENCLOSED A NOTICE SUGGESTING THAT THEY TRY TO KEEP AT LEAST HALF OF THE AMOUNT RECEIVED AS A CASH RESERVE IN CASE THE NEXT MONTHLY WAGE PAYMENT COULD NOT BE MADE.

IRVANI DID NOT PROVIDE DETAILS ABOUT THE SITUATION IN OTHER INDUSTRIES WITH WHICH HE IS ACQUAINTED, EXCEPT TO SAY THAT SUPPLIERS OF CHEMICAL RAW MATERIALS HAD CUT OFF DELIVERIES. IN FACT, IRVANI SPENT MOST OF HIS TIME DURING THE INTERVIEW STRESSING THE NEED FOR A POLITICAL SOLUTION TO THE CRISIS, WHICH (IN HIS VIEW) COULD BE PROVIDED ONLY BY THE UNITED STATES. IRVANI BELIEVES THAT THE SHAH CAN NOT REMAIN MORE THAN A FEW DAYS LONGER. HE INSISTED THAT THE ONLY WAY TO RESOLVE THE CRISIS WAS FOR THE U.S.

TO TAKE A FIRM HAND AND GUARANTEE THE DEPARTURE OF THE SHAH WHILE ATTEMPTING TO STABILIZE THE SITUATION DURING AN INTERVAL OF SOME THREE MONTHS. HE FRANKLY VIEWED THE CRISIS AS A CONSPIRACY ENGINEERED BY THE BRITISH AND THE RUSSIANS, WITH THE FRENCH LOOKING AFTER THEIR OWN SELFISH INTERESTS. WITHOUT STRONG INTERVENTION BY THE UNITED STATES, IRVANI PREDICTED THAT IRAN WILL COLLAPSE INTO COMPLETE ANARCHY WITHIN A VERY SHORT PERIOD.

COMMENT: WHILE E/C COUNSELOR MET WITH LADJEVARDI, THE STREET OUTSIDE ECHOED WITH THE SHOUTS OF ANTI-SHAH MOBS AND GUNFIRE -- A FITTING ATMOSPHERE FOR THE PESSIMISM EXPRESSED. LADJEVARDI, IRVANI AND OTHER RESPONSIBLE INDUSTRIALISTS ARE PROFOUNDLY WORRIED BY THE FAILURE OF THE GOVERNMENT TO PROVIDE PUBLIC SECURITY AND TANGIBLE SIGNS OF PROGRESS IN RESOLVING THE SERIOUS DISRUPTION OF FINANCIAL SERVICES, OIL PRODUCTION, UTILITIES, AND OTHER ESSENTIAL SERVICES WHICH ARE WRACKING THE ECONOMY AND RUINING THE BUSINESS CLIMATE. THE EMBASSY DOES NOT SUBSCRIBE TO IRVANI'S MACHIAVELLIAN VIEW OF THE POLITICAL ORIGIN OF THE CRISIS, BUT WE CONCUR THAT THE SITUATION IS EXTREMELY SERIOUS.

MOST IRANIAN BUSINESSMEN HAVE BEEN VERY PESSIMISTIC ABOUT THE OUTLOOK FOR THE ECONOMY FOR AT LEAST A MONTH. THEIR MOOD OF GLOOM HAS DEEPENED AS THE CRISIS HAS INTENSIFIED, WITH NO POLITICAL SOLUTION IN SIGHT. DESPITE THIS, MOST WELL ESTABLISHED BUSINESSMEN APPEAR DETERMINED TO WEATHER THE CRISIS.
