BEGIN SUMMARY: US MISSION TEAM VISITED AHWAZ 12/24. OSCO FEELS THAT 12/23 ASSASSINATIONS, PARTICULARLY IN VIEW OF THOSE SELECTED AS TARGETS, WERE DIRECT ATTACK UPON OIL PRODUCTION. INFORMATION DEVELOPED SO FAR INDICATES ASSASSINATIONS WERE CARRIED OUT BY PROFESSIONAL TERRORISTS ALTHOUGH ACTS WERE OIL-STRIKE RELATED. AS OF 12/25, NO ONE HAS CLAIMED RESPONSIBILITY FOR ASSASSINATIONS. OIL PRODUCTION DROPPED FROM 3.5 MILLION B/D TO 0.6 MILLION B/D BY 12/26. OSCO HAS BEEN FORCED, BY NEARLY TOTAL WALKOUT OF IRANIAN WORKERS, TO SHUT DOWN NGL PLANTS AND DELIVERIES OF NATURAL GAS TO IGAT-I PIPELINE CEASED ON 12/24. OSCO EVACUATED ABOUT 45 DEPENDENTS BY GULF-AIR CHARTER FROM ABADAN ON 12/24.
BODY OF PAUL GRIMM REMOVED BY IRAN AIR FLIGHT TO LONDON ON 12/24 FOR ONWARD PASSAGE TO U.S. SITUATION IN AHWAZ REMAINS TENSE. END SUMMARY.

AFOSI PREPARING FULL AND DETAILED REPORT RE ACTUAL ASSASSINATIONS. TARGETS SELECTED WERE PAUL GRIMM (U.S. NATIONAL), OSCO GENERAL MANAGER FOR OPERATIONS AND ACTING DIRECTOR; AND M. BROUGERD (IRANIAN NATIONAL), OSCO AREA DRILLING SUPERVISOR. BOTH INDIVIDUALS WERE KEY OFFICERS ON THE PRODUCTION SIDE AND OSCO MANAGEMENT FEELS THAT SELECTION OF THOSE INDIVIDUALS AS TARGETS REPRESENTS DIRECT ACT AND INTIMIDATION AGAINST OIL PRODUCTION.

OSCO NOTES THAT RECENT DEVELOPMENTS SUCH AS STEADILY INCREASING OIL PRODUCTION (UP TO 3.5 MILLION B/D AS OF 12/22) COUPLED WITH THE REOPENING OF THE AHWAZ BAZAAR DURING WEEK OF 12/18 FOR FIRST TIME IN AHWAZ IN OVER 6 WEEKS PROBABLY PROMPTED DRASTIC MEASURE ON PART OF OPPOSITION TO REVERSE TREND. DURING U.S. MISSION VISIT, OSCO REPORTED THAT FURTHER EMPLOYEE WALKOUTS HAD OCCURRED IN LAST TWO DAYS SINCE ASSASSINATIONS. GIVEN THE INCREASED WALKOUT (ALMOST TOTAL IRANIAN WORKFORCE HAD LEFT WORK BY 12/26), OSCO HAS DECIDED ONCE AGAIN TO CONCENTRATE ALL OF ITS RESOURCES AND EFFORTS UPON THE PRODUCTION OF CRUDE OIL.
THE NGL PLANTS HAVE ALL BEEN SHUT DOWN AND DELIVERY OF NATURAL GAS TO THE IGAT-I PIPELINE HAS CEASED.

ASSASSINATIONS TOOK PLACE IN TWO SEPARATE, BUT OBVIOUSLY COORDINATED, INCIDENTS AT APPROXIMATELY 0700 ON 12/23 AS BOTH INDIVIDUALS DROVE ALONE TO WORK FROM THEIR RESIDENCES. WEAPONS USED WERE OF HAND-GUN VARIETY -PROBABLY REVOLVERS. IN CASE OF GRIMM, HE WAS DRIVING OSCO VEHICLE ALONG ONE OF TWO ROUTES AVAILABLE TO HIM, APPROACHING THE INTERSECTION OF THE HEAVILY-TRAFFICKED MIS HIGHWAY, WHEN THREE INDIVIDUALS WHOSE HEADS WERE COVERED WITH FABRIC (TO PROBABLY AVOID IDENTIFICATION BY NEARBY INDIVIDUALS WAITING FOR RIDES ON MIS HIGHWAY) OPENED FIRE FROM BOTH SIDES OF FEEDER ROAD AND FROM REAR OF VEHICLE. ATTACKERS WERE APPARENTLY PRE-POSITIONED TO AVOID FIRING AT EACH OTHER.

GRIMM VEHICLE CAREENED OUT OF CONTROL ACROSS MIS HIGHWAY AND BACK UPON FEEDER ROUTE THROUGH A VACANT LOT WHERE VEHICLE CRASHED TO A STOP. GRIMM WAS FOUND DEAD INSIDE VEHICLE. ATTACKERS DID NOT PURSUE VEHICLE AFTER INITIAL FIRING BUT ESCAPED VIA A WAITING VEHICLE.

OSCO MANAGEMENT REPORTS THAT GRIMM, LIKE ALMOST ALL FOREIGN EMPLOYEES, HAD RECEIVED THREAT LETTERS AND PHONE CALLS. THREATS INCLUDED DEATH. OSCO INDICATED THEY DON'T IGNORE THESE THREATS BUT THAT THEY HAVE BEEN CHARACTERIZED AS PART OF A GENERAL HARRASSMENT CAMPAIGN IN EXISTENCE THROUGHOUT COUNTRYSIDE AGAINST FOREIGN COMMUNITY AND PART OF A SPECIFIC LABOR-STRIKE INTIMIDATION CAMPAIGN. OSCO STATED THEY HAD RECEIVED A DEATH THREAT LETTER RECENTLY LISTING 19 NAMES OF OSCO EMPLOYEES, INCLUDING THAT OF GRIMM. LETTER HAS BEEN TURNED OVER TO POLICE WHO ARE INVESTIGATING AND EVALUATING IT IN LIGHT OF ASSASSINATIONS. EMBASSY ATTEMPTING OBTAIN COPY OF THAT LETTER THROUGH TEHRAN SAVAK.

GRIMM, AS MANY OTHER OSCO EXECUTIVES, LIVED IN A CLOSE-KNIT FOREIGN RESIDENTIAL AREA IN AHWAZ. GOI MILITARY WERE STATIONED AT HIS HOUSE ON A 24-HOUR BASIS. MILITARY CP'S HAVE BEEN ESTABLISHED ON A 24-HOUR BASIS INSIDE EACH OF THE FOREIGN RESIDENTIAL AREAS, FROM WHICH THEY PATROL THE NEIGHBORHOOD, PROVIDING COVERAGE ON A ROVING BASIS TO ACCESS ROUTES AND PROVIDING REACTIVE SUPPORT TO SPECIFIC LOCATIONS WHEN SUMMONED. EACH CP HAS A TELEPHONE. PERSONNEL IN RESIDENCES CALL THEIR LOCAL CP (FARSI REQUIRED) TO REPORT PROBLEMS AND REQUEST ASSISTANCE IF NECESSARY. OSCO REPORTS THAT GOI RESPONSES TO CALLS HAVE BEEN QUICK AND EFFECTIVE.

GRIMM WAS DESCRIBED BY OSCO OFFICIALS AS A VERY PUNCTUAL UNQUOTE INDIVIDUAL WHO FOLLOWED SAME ROUTINE (ROUTE AND TIME) IN TRAVELING TO WORK. GRIMM ROUTINE WAS TO PER------------------022027 271401Z /45 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 2452 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 12645 SONALLY DRIVE AN OSCO VEHICLE TO WORK WHERE HE WOULD THEN TURN VEHICLE AND KEYS OVER TO LOCAL DRIVER WHO WOULD THEN RETURN TO GRIMM RESIDENCE TO BE AVAILABLE TO GRIMM FAMILY FOR REST OF DAY. OSCO MANAGEMENT, IN LIGHT OF GRIMM ASSASSINATION, ARE RE-EVALUATING THEIR PERSONAL SECURITY PROGRAM. MOST VULNERABLE AREA IS MOVEMENTS BETWEEN WORK AND RESIDENCE.

WORK LOCATIONS AND RESIDENTIAL LOCATIONS ARE PROVIDED WITH SUBSTANTIAL, IN-PLACE PROTECTION BY GOI MILITARY. MOVEMENT BETWEEN THOSE LOCATIONS BY OSCO PERSONNEL ARE MADE ALONE ALONG ROUTES PERIODICALLY PATROLLED BY ROVING GOI POLICE/MILITARY. BECAUSE OF LACK OF PERSONAL PROTECTION DURING MOVEMENTS, OSCO MANAGEMENT HAVE URGED PERSONNEL TO BE VARIABLE IN BEHAVIOR. OSCO HAS CONSIDERED POSSIBILITY OF RUNNING A SHUTTLE SYSTEM FOR EMPLOYEES (BULLET-RESISTANT VEHICLES, VARIABLE ROUTES/TIMES, BODYGUARDS, ETC.) BUT HAS REJECTED THIS ON BASIS THAT A SHUTTLE VEHICLE WOULD PRESENT TOO TEMPTING A TARGET TO DEMONSTRATORS/TERRORISTS. INSTEAD, OSCO AND GOI ARE BOTH WORKING OUT SECURITY IMPROVEMENTS ON THEIR EXISTING MOVEMENT SYSTEM.

ROUTES ARE BEING SURVEYED AND THOSE PORTIONS (USUALLY FEEDER ROADS LEADING INTO MAIN THOROUGHFARES) WHICH DO NOT OFFER VARIABLE TRAVEL OPTIONS WILL BE PROVIDED WITH IN-PLACE, FIXED POLICE/MILITARY POSTS AND INCREASED ROVING PATROLS. ON THEIR HAND, OSCO WILL REEMPHASIZE THEIR BRIEFING PROGRAMS STRESSING NEED FOR ALL EMPLOYEES TO BE ALERT, WATCHFUL, AND VARIABLE IN BEHAVIOR. TO ENFORCE VARIABILITY, OSCO IS CONSIDERING CHANGING WORK SHIFTS ON A WEEKLY BASIS, REQUIRING EMPLOYEES TO MOVE FROM ONE SHIFT TO ANOTHER. BODYGUARD ARRANGEMENTS WILL BE CONSIDERED FOR INDIVIDUALS CONSIDERED TO BE UNDER HIGH THREAT. VISITING U.S. MISSION TEAM HAD OPPORTUNITY TO MEET WITH SECURITY REPRESENTATIVES OF LOCAL MILITARY AND POLICE.
RAPPORT BETWEEN OSCO AND LOCAL GOI SECURITY REPS APPEARS TO BE CLOSE AND PRODUCTIVE. DISCUSSION ON TOPIC OF IMPROVING SECURITY IN AHWAZ CONTINUES. EMBASSY HAS OFFERED ITS ASSISTANCE.

MOOD IN AHWAZ ISVERY TENSE NOW WITH PRODUCTION OF OIL AT ALL-TIME LOW FOR RECENT YEARS, WITH ALMOST TOTAL IRANIAN WORKFORCE OFF JOB IN FACE OF GOI ORDERS TO CONTRARY, WITH OIL WORKFORCE EXPRESSING COMMENTS OF SATISFACTION UNQUOTE WITH GRIMM AND BROUGERDI ASSASSINATIONS. 1978TEHRAN12648.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT, DECEMBER 27 SUMMARY: YOUNG DEMONSTRATORS CONTINUE TO PRESS SECURITY FORCES. KILLING OF PROFESSOR YESTERDAY FEEDS UPRO

segments.text: SUMMARY: YOUNG DEMONSTRATORS CONTINUE TO PRESS SECURITY FORCES. KILLING OF PROFESSOR YESTERDAY FEEDS UPROAR. REPORTS OF TROUBLE YESTERDAY IN HOST OF PROVINCIAL CITIES. DISTURBANCES TAKE MORE ANTI-AMERICAN TONE. PRISON REPORTED SET ON FIRE IN MASHAD. REPORTS OF ATTACKS AGAINST SECURITY FORCES. COMBINATION OF DEMONSTRATIONS AND STRIKES PUTS COUNTRY ON ROAD TOWARD PARALYSIS. END SUMMARY

STUDENT GROUPS CONTINUED TO PUT GREAT PRESSURE ON SECURITY FORCES YESTERDAY. TROOPS USED TEARGAS AND SHOTS IN THE AIR TO DISPERSE GROUPS AT KEY LOCATIONS BUT STUDENTS REASSEMBLED A SHORT DISTANCE AWAY AND RESUMED THEIR ACTIVITIES. THESE REPORTEDLY INCLUDED SEVERAL ATTACKS ON SECURITY FORCES. ONE SOURCE SAW POLICEMAN BADLY BEATEN AND PERHAPS KILLED, AND GOVT RADIO REPORTS TROOPS KILLED BY SNIPER FIRE AND GRENADES. GOVT CLAIMS TO HAVE KILLED A MAN WHO HAD A CAR FULL OF HOMEMADE EXPLOSIVES AND THREW SEVERAL OUT AS HE DROVE ALONG.

KAMERON NEJATOLLAHI, A PROFESSOR AT TEHRAN POLYTECHNICAL SCHOOL, WAS KILLED BY SNIPER FIRE AS HE STOOD ON A BALCONY AT THE COLLEGE. FACULTY MEMBERS WERE HOLDING A SIT-IN SIMILAR TO THAT UNDERWAY AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY. OPPOSITION SAYS HE WAS SHOT BY A SOLDIER. MINISTRY OF SCIENCE AND HIGHER EDUCATION WAS TAKEN OVER BY PROFESSORS WHO DECREED THREE DAYS OF CLOSURE IN COMMEMORATION OF THE VICTIM. ARMY ARRESTED THEM 2:30 LAST NIGHT, WITH 1-2 DEATHS REPORTED.

PROFESSOR'S DEATH FEEDS TODAY'S DEMONSTRATIONS WHICH WERE EXPECTED TO INCREASE ANYWAY. CROWDS STARTED AROUND PAHLAVI HOSPITAL. THEY GREW INTOCESSION OF THOUSANDS REPORTEDLY LED BY AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI (WHO CONVINCED AUTHORITIES TO LEAVE BURIAL CEREMONEY TO THE RELIGIOUS LEADERS) AND POLITICAL LEADERS LIKE SANJABI TO ATTENDED. AT SOME POINT IN MARCH, PERHAPS BACK TOWARD UNIVERSITY INSTEAD OF CEMETERY, CROWDS WERE STOPPED BY RIFLEFIRE FROM TROOPS. SOME DEAD POSSIBLE. NOT CLEAR IF PROCESSION BROKE UP OR CONTINUED TO CEMETERY. QUICK FORMING GROUPS WERE ALSO ACTIVE AT TAJRISH AND NEAR THE EMBASSY.

STARTING ABOUT 1030 TROOPS SEEN FIRING WARNING SHOTS AT FREQUENT INTERVALS IN GENERAL PROXIMITY OF THE EMBASSY AND DISSIDENTS MAKE SITUATION APPEAR EVEN MORE UNRAVELLED THAN IT REALLY IS BY SETTING OFF FIREWORKS. EMBASSY COMPOUND IS WELL-GUARDED AND NO CROWDS HAVE REACHED THE GATES. ONE LARGE CROWD ON TAKHTE JAMSHID WAS HEADED OFF BY TROOPS A BLOCK AWAY. ALL TEHRAN SCHOOLS CLOSED INDEFINITELY. T OLE MANY REPORTS AND RUMORS THAT TODAY BEGINS A HEATING UP OF THE CONFRONTATION. SO FAR,TODAY HAS NOT REALLY BEEN MUCH WORSE THAN YESTERDAY.

WHILE MOST SHOPS STILL TRY TO DO BUSINESS, MUCH OF THE CITY HAS GROUND TO A HALT. PANIC GAS LINES ARE EVIDENT AS RESULT OF PETROLEUM SHORTAGE; THE KEROSENE LINES ARE GROWING LONGER. THERE IS ALSO INCREASING PANIC AS RESULT OF SHORTAGES OF HEATING OIL. POST OFFICE AND IRAN AIR BOTH WENT ON STRIKE TODAY, AS DID THE CENTRAL BANK. MOST COMMERCIAL BANKS OPENED BUT HAVE SINCE CLOSED. ALL THIS HAS POPULACE UNDERSTANDABLY DOWNHEARTED, THE MOST OBVIOUS REPERCUSSION SHOWING UP IN THE MONUMENTAL VISA LINES AT OUR CONSULATES. CONSUL TABRIZ REPORTS THAT SOME OF POPULAR RESENTMENT TOWARD PRESENT SITUATION IS TURNING AGAINST MULLAHS WHO, SOME FEEL, HAVE CAUSED IT ALL.

IT WOULD BE A SIGNIFICANT DEVELOPMENT, AS CONSUL TABRIZ POINTS OUT, REGARDLESS OF WHETHER SHAH GOES OR STAYS, BUT IT WILL NOT NECESSARILY AFFECT THE RESULT OF THE IMMEDIATE CONFRONTA------------------022655 271513Z /44 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 2456 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY BONN AMCONSUL DHAHRAN AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS USLO PEKING AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY TOKYO USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE CINCPAC HONOLULU HI SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 12648 TION, WHICH IS LED BY MEN WHO DO NOT CARE ABOUT GASOLINE SHORTAGES.

ANTI-FOREIGN ASPECT OF DEMONSTRATIONS IS GROWING. SCRAWLED SIGNS OF "CARTER IS OUR WORST ENEMY," WHICH WERE NOT TO BE SEEN ONLY A SHORT TIME AGO, ARE NOW EASY TO FIND. FOREIGNERS TRAPPED IN DEMONSTRATIONS WHILE DRIVING HAVE HAD A HARROWING TIME OF IT, ALTHOUGH NONEHAS RECEIVED SIGNIFICANT INJURIES. ONE WEST GERMAN AND ONE DANISH DIPLOMAT WERE CAUGHT. DANE ESCAPED SERIOUS TROUBLE BY PROVING HE WAS DANE. ONE AMERICAN ALSO EXTRICATED HIMSELF FROM A NASTY SITUATION BY CLAIMING TO BE BRITISH. YESTERDAY A CROWD STONED BUS CARRYING APO MAIL TO DOWSHAN TAPPEI AIRBASE. GUARD DISPERSED THEM WITH GUNFIRE.

THERE WAS TROUBLE IN SEVERAL PROVINCIAL CITIES YESTERDAY. WORST-HIT WAS MAHAD, WHERE A TRAFFIC POLICEMAN WAS REPORTEDLY MASSACRED BY A MOB. MASHAD PRISON CAUGHT FIRE YESTERDAY, OPPOSITION CLAIMING GOVT DID IT WITH PRISONERS STILL INSIDE, BUT OTHER SOURCES SAY OPPOSITION DID IT WHILE FREEING PRISONERS. THERE WERE A NUMBER OF DEATHS (SOME SAY 15) BESIDES THE POLICEMAN. THERE WERE ALSO VIOLENT DEMONSTRATIONS IN SHAPUR, SANANDAJ, SHIRAZ, REZAIYEH, MALAYER, KARAJ AND HAMADAN. ISFAHAN, SHIRAZ, AND TABRIZ HOWEVER, REPORT SITUATION QUIET TODAY. ISFAHAN HAS A NEW GOVERNOR-GENERAL, GENERAL AHMAD GHAFFARI.

POLITICAL ASPECT OF CRISIS APPEARS FROZEN FOR THE MOMENT. SADIQI, IS QUOTED AS SAYING THAT HE WILL NOT ACCEPT SHAH'S NOMINATION AS PRIME MINISTER UNTIL AFTER MAJLIS HAS VOTED CONFIDENCE IN HIM. AS ANOTHER SIGN OF TIMES, GOVERNOR GENERAL OF KHUZESTAN TOLD AMERICAN BUSINESSMAN THAT GENERALS AZHARI AND OVEISI HAVE DELIVERED ULTIMATUM TO SHAH -- GIVE THEM AUTHORITY WITHIN 48 HOURS TO BRING ORDER, OR THEY WILL TURN TO THE NATIONAL FRONT. NEEDLESS TO SAY, WE HAVE NO CONFIRMATION OF THIS RUMOR.
AS OF MIDAFTERNOON, SHAH REZA AVE IS LINED WITH BURNING AUTOMOBILES FROM UNIVERSITY TO KENNEDY SQUARE. THIS IS AN AREA WHERE PROCESSION WAS DISPERSED BY GUNFIRE. SULLIVAN

1978TEHRAN12652.subject: ; MINATCHI ON SADIQI'S ATTEMPTS TO FORM GOVERNMENT SUMMARY:MINATCHI CONFIRMED THAT ENG MEHDI BAZARGAN AND LIBERATION MOVEMENT (LMI) ARE DISCREETLY S UPPORTIN

segments.text: SUMMARY:MINATCHI CONFIRMED THAT ENG MEHDI BAZARGAN AND LIBERATION MOVEMENT (LMI) ARE DISCREETLY SUPPORTING SADIQI EFFORT TO FORM GOVERNMENT. COMMITTEE FOR THE DEFENSE OF HUMAN RIGHTS AND FREEDOM (CDHRF) IS ALSO BACKING SADIQI EFFORT. MINATCHI THOUGHT SADIQI WAS ABOUT READY TO ANNOUNCE CABINET, BUT WANTED TO FOLLOW MOSSADEQ PRECEDENT AND GET MAJLES APPROVAL FOR GOVERNMENT BEFORE TAKING MANDATE FROM SHAH. MINATCHI WAFFLED ON QUESTION WHETHER NEW GOVERNMENT WOULD BE ABLE TO END STRIKES NOW PARALYSING IRAN, BUT THOUGH THERE WOULD BE AT LEAST "SOME" AMELIORATION OF SITUATION. HE DOES NOT SEE SADIQI GOVERNMENT AS FINAL SOLUTION TO IRAN'S PROBLEMS.
HE CONFIRMED THAT AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI HAD URGED THE RELIGIOUS FAITHFUL TO KILL THOSE BEARING CLUBS AND DEMONSTRATING AGAINST THEM. END SUMMARY.

DR. NASSER MINATCHI MET WITH EMBOFF STEMPEL AT HOSSEINIYEH ERSHAD OFFICE DEC 27 FOR REVIEW OF PRESENT SITUATION. IN RESPONSE TO EMBOFF'S QUESTION, MINATCHI SAID BOTH LMI AND CDHRF WERE TACITLY SUPPORTING SADIQI EFFORTS TO FORM A GOVERNMENT. ENG BAZARGAN HAD MET WITH SADIQI DEC 23 TO TELL HIM HE WOULD NOT RPT NOT SERVE IN NEW GOVERNMENT, BUT TO ENCOURAGE HIM TO CONTINUE WITH PROCESS. MINATCHI SAID BAZARGAN GROUP BELIEVES IT HAS KHOMEINI'S AGREEMENT NOT TO UPSET APPLECART IF SADIQI IS SUCCESSFUL. MINATCHI THOUGHT SADIQI WOULD BE ABLE TO FORM GOVERNMENT AND HAD ALREADY PICKED MOST, IF NOT ALL, OF HIS CABINET.
MINATCHI SAID HE KNEW OF ONLY TWO SELECTIONS: MOHSEN PEZESHKPOUR, PAN IRANIST OPPOSITION LEADER IN MAJLES, FOR JUSTICE MINISTER; AND DR. HAMID MOWLAVI, PROMINENT ACADEMIC, FOR COMMERCE MINISTER.

ACCORDING TO MINATCHI, SADIQI WANTS TO FOLLOW "MOSSADEQ PRECEDENT" AND GET PARLIAMENTARY APPROVAL OF HIS GOVERMENT BEFORE GETTING IMPERIAL FARMAN FROM SHAH. MINATCHI THOUGHT IT WAS POSSIBLE MATTER WAS BEING DISCUSSED IN PARLIAMENT IN TODAY'S PRIVATE SESSION. (COMMENT: OTHER SOURCES ARE LESS CERTAIN THAT CABINETBUILDING IS THAT FAR ALONG AND BELIEVE SADIQI HAS ASKED FOR MORE TIME TO GET CABINET TOGETHER. PARLIAMENTARY SOURCES SAY TODAY'S SESSION WAS JUST GENERAL DISCUSSION OF PRESENT SITUATION, AND SECOND PRIVATE SESSION WILL BE SET FOR NEXT WEEK.)

EMBOFF ASKED IF SUPPORT FOR SADIQI EFFORT WENT AS FAR AS BEING WILLING TO HELP HALT WAVE OF STRIKES NOW PARALYSING IRAN. MINATCHI WAFFLED ON THIS ONE, FIRST SAYING THAT STRIKES WOULD CONTINUE, BECAUSE "PEOPLE WANTED SHAH TO GO; NOT EVEN KHOMEINI WOULD GET POPULAR SUPPORT AS PM IF SHAH REMAINED." (COMMENT: MINATCHI IN GENERAL WAS HARDER ON "SHAH MUST GO" THEME THIS TIME THAN PREVIOUSLY.) HOWEVER, MINATCHI ALSO SAID THAT IF NEW GOVERNMENT GOT OFF TO GOOD START AND GOT TROOPS OFF THE STREETS, THINGS WOULD BE BETTER AND THERE WOULD BE FEWER RIOTS.

HOWEVER, MINATCHI SAID, SADIQI GOVERNMENT WAS NOT THE FINAL SOLUTION TO IRAN'S PROBLEMS; SHAH WOULD STILL HAVE TO GO. EMBOFF AND MINATCHI AGREED SADIQI EFFORT WOULD BE BETTER THAN VIOLENCE, AND IN RESPONSE TO DIRECT QUESTION BY MINATCHI, EMBOFF SAID HE THOUGHT THERE WAS NO RPT NO CHANCE THAT EITHER ALTERNATIVE WHICH INCLUDED REGENCY COUNCIL AND SHAH'S LEAVING COUNTRY WOULD BE ACCEPTABLE, EVEN IF KHOMEINI AGREED TO THEM. MINATCHI SAID HE THOUGHT HARD-LINE MILITARY SOLUTION WOULD THEN BE TRIED AND CAUSE LOTS OF BLOODSHED. EMBOFF SAID U.S. DID NOT WANT TO SEE THIS HAPPEN; THAT IS WHY WE FAVORED COALITION GOVERNMENT AND COMPROMISE.

MINATCHI NOTED THAT SADIQI EFFORT WAS JUST SUCH AN IDEA AND AGREED WITH EMBOFF THAT IF IT WORKED, IT MIGHT MOVE SITUATION AWAY FROM CONFRONTATION AND TOWARD POLITICS. MINATCHI THEN PAUSED AND ADDED THAT SADIQI COULD HELP SITUATION A BIT BUT WOULD NOT BE THE LONG-RUN ANSWER. ONE POINT OF SADIQI'S PROGRAM, HOWEVER, WOULD BE EARLY ELECTIONS--DISSOLUTION OF PARLIAMENT WITHIN TWO MONTHS AND ELECTIONS "FAIRLY QUICKLY" THEREAFTER. NEW MAJLES COULD THEN DEAL WITH QUESTION OF MONARCHY.

WHEN EMBOFF PRODDED MINATCHI ABOUT CURRENT SPATE OF DEMONSTRATIONS, MINATCHI SAID HAPPILY THAT THESE WERE ALL RELIGIOUS GROUPS. EMBOFF THEN QUERRIED WHY U.S. EMBASSY HAD BEEN SINGLED OUT DEC 24 FOR SPECIAL ATTENTION? STARTLED, MINATCHI AT FIRST ASKED IF WE WERE CERTAIN THESE WERE NOT SAVAK AGENTS AND WHEN TOLD THAT WOULDN'T WASH, ADMITTED THAT "NOT ALL" RELIGIOUS GROUPS WERE REALLY UNDER FIRM CONTROL. HE FLATLY DENIED THAT RELIGIOUS GROUPS HAD ANYTHING TO DO WITH RECENT ASSASSINATIONS IN AHWAZ ANB SAID THESE HAD TROUBLED CDHRF.

EMBOFF NOTED ------------------022802 271524Z /43 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 2460 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 12652 LIMDIS THAT THEY TROUBLED US, TOO. (COMME NT: MINATCHI IS USUALLY NOT VERY WELL INFORMED ON "OPERATIONAL" MATTERS, BUT IT WAS CLEAR THAT HE IS EVEN MORE NERVOUS NOW THAN PREVIOUSLY ABOUT PROSPECTS OF VIOLENT ACTS BEYOND CONTROL OF "THE MOVEMENT.")

MINATCHI SAID KHOMEINI HAD INDEED ISSUED EDICT CALLING FOR THE FAITHFUL TO KILL ANYONE WHO ATTACKED RELIGIOUS DEMONSTRATORS WITH CLUBS OR WEAPONS (A CLEAR REFERENCE TO RECENT PRO-SHAH DEMONSTRATORS). THIS HAD THE FORCE OF LAW, COMING FROM ONE WITH KHOMEINI'S RELIGIOUS AUTHORITY. EMBOFF COMMENTED THAT THIS SEEMED AN EXTREME REACTION IN VIEW OF POTENTIAL PROBLEMS IT COULD CAUSE. MINATCHI ADMITTED THIS, BUT SAID THIS SITUATION WAS WHAT MADE PRESENT CONDITIONS IN IRAN SO EXPLOSIVE--KHOMEINI HAD BOTH RELIGIOUS AND POLITICAL POWER TO WIELD AGAINST SHAH. IN 1953 SHAH HAD SUPPORT OF RELIGIOUS ESTABLISHMENT. CONDITIONS NOW WERE DIFFERENT.
CONVERSATION ENDED WITH MUTUAL EXPRESSIONS OF HOPE THAT VIOLENCE WOULD NOT DOMINATE POLITICS. SULLIVAN

THE IRANIAN NATION IS GRINDING TO A HALT. WITHIN FORTYEIGHT HOURS, ESSENTIAL SERVICES CAN BE EXPECTED TO EVAPORATE IN MOST MAJOR POPULATION CENTERS. IN THE FACE OF THESE CIRCUMSTANCES, THE SHAH REMAINS PARALYZED BY INDECISION.

IT SEEMS APPARENT THAT SHAH HAS NOT RPT NOT BEEN ABLE TO BRING HIMSELF TO ORDER THE IRON FIST OPTION WHICH HE HAS PREVIOUSLY CONSIDERED. MOREOVER, GIVEN SITUATION IN OIL FIELDS, REFINERIES, AND BUREAUCRACY, IT IS QUESTIONABLE WHETHER IRON FIST POLICY IS ANY LONGER A FEASIBLE ALTERNATIVE.

GENERAL OVEISI MET WITH SHAH AFTERNOON DECEMBER 27. SINCE HE PRESUMABLY HAS RECEIVED IMPRESSION OF WHICH WAY SHAH MAY BE LEANING, I HAVE ASKED CHIEF ARMISH/MAAG TO MEET WITH HIM, TO SHARE VIEWS, AND TO ASSURE HIM OF CONTINUING U.S. SUPPORT FOR INTEGRITY OF IRANIAN ARMED FORCES NO MATTER WHAT EVENTUATES. THAT MEETING IS IN PROGRESS AS THIS MESSAGE IS BEING WRITTEN.

I DO HAVE TWO OTHER INDICATORS WHICH SUGGEST DIRECTION IN WHICH SHAH MAY BE MOVING. FIRST IS FACT THAT OUR CONSULATE, AT URGENT REQUEST OF IMPERIAL COURT, ISSUED VISAS EVENING DECEMBER 27 TO QUEEN MOTHER AND HER ENTOURAGE, WITH DESTINATION LOS ANGELES. COURT STRESSED URGENCY THAT VISAS BE IN THEIR HANDS THAT EVENING. HENCE, I ASSUME SHE AND HER PARTY LEFT IRAN EARLY THIS MORNING. SUGGEST DEPT CHECK WITH IRANIAN EMBASSY.

SECOND INDICATOR IS MESSAGE I RECEIVED MORNING DECEMBER 28 FROM ALI AMINI. HE SAID HE HAD BEEN TELEPHONED EVENING DECEMBER 27 BY VERY DEPRESSED SHAH WHO SAID HE DID NOT RPT NOT KNOW WHAT TO DO AND ASKED FOR AMINI'S ADVICE. AMINI REPEATED HIS EARLIER ADVICE THAT SHAH "STEP ASIDE," FORM REGENCY COUNCIL, AND GO ON VACATION. SHAH ASKED AMINI TO COME DISCUSS HIS SUGGESTION MORNING DECEMBER 28, AND I ASSUME THAT MEETING IS ALSO IN PROGRESS.

FROM ALL FOREGOING FACTORS, I BELIEVE WE ARE FAST APPROACHING SITUATION IN WHICH SHAH MAY DECIDE TO TRY ONE OF THE VARIOUS FORMULAE WHICH ARE DESIGNED TO PRESERVE THE CONSTITUTION, RETAIN THE SHADOW OF THE MONARCHY, AND PUT HIS FUNCTIONS IN THE HANDS OF A REGENCY COUNCIL WHILE HE "GOES ON VACATION." AT THIS STAGE, HE APPEARS TO HAVE VERY LITTLE OTHER OPTION LEFT.

IF HE DOES MOVE IN THIS DIRECTION, MUCH WILL DEPEND ON HOW NEATLY HE DOES IT. IF HE ESTABLISHES THE COUNCIL, TAKES APPROPRIATE STEPS TO PRESERVE THE INTEGRITY OF THE ARMED FORCES, AND ASSURES AN ORDERLY TRANSITION FROM THE CURRENT GOVERNMENT PLUS MARTIAL LAW TO A RESPONSIBLE CIVILIAN GOVERNMENT ONCE ORDER AND PRODUCTION ARE RESUMED, HE COULD CUT THE GROUND OUT FROM UNDER KHOMEINI BY REMOVING HIMSELF AS THE ISSUE OF DISSENT. IN THIS EVENT, AS ALL MANNER OF MODERATE OPPOSITIONISTS HAVE BEEN TELLING US, THERE COULD BE A NATIONAL IRANIAN STATE WHICH WOULD ESSENTIALLY MAINTAIN ITS CURRENT PRO-WESTERN ORIENTATION.

SUCH A FORMULA WOULD AT LEAST PRESERVE THE POSSIBILITY THAT HE MIGHT LATER RETURN TO TEHRAN AS A CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCH. IF NOT, IT MIGHT PRESERVE THE DYNASTY IN SUCH FASHION THAT MONARCHY COULD BE SUBSEQUENTLY VESTED IN CROWN PRINCE.

IF, ON OTHER HAND HE MERELY DECIDES TO ABDICATE, WE WOULD HAVE A MORE UNPREDICTABLE SITUATION IN WHICH THE ARMED FORCES, THE MODERATE OPPOSITION, AND THE CLERGY WILL HAVE TO SORT THEMSELVES OUT. IN THAT EVENT, THE INTEGRITY OF THE ARMED FORCES WILL BECOME EVEN MORE SIGNIFICANT, AND OUR CLOSE ASSOCIATION WITH THEM WILL BECOME EVER MORE RELEVANT.

BASED ON THE FACT HE IS CONSULTING AMINI AND ON THE VARIOUS CONVERSATIONS I HAVE HAD WITH HIM ON THIS CONTINGENCY, I BELIEVE WE CAN SAFELY ASSUME THE SHAH WILL TRY TO EXERCISE THE OPTION WHICH ATTEMPTS TO PRESERVE THE MONARCHY AND THE DYNASTY. HOW WELL HE AND THE MODERATES WILL BE ABLE TO ARTICULATE THIS OPTION REMAINS TO BE SEEN. THE MODERATES STRESS THE URGENCY FOR EARLY ACTION BECAUSE OF THEIR FEAR THAT THE STREET MOBS WHO ARE CURRENTLY ROAMING TEHRAN ARE UNDER TUDEH CONTROL, AND HAVE ESCAPED THE INFLUENCE OF THE MULLAHS.

IT IS THE MODERATE VIEW THAT MOST OF THOSE IN THE STREETS ARE EXPERIENCED DEMONSTRATORS, ------------------030409 281237Z /12 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 2472 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 12676 NODIS CHEROKEE WHO HAVE RETURNED FROM THE U.S. AND WESTERN EUROPE, WHERE THEY HAVE BEEN RECRUITED BY THE COMMUNISTS AND DRILLED IN VARIOUS UNITS SUCH AS THE ISA IN THE U.S. MODERATES POINT OUT THAT CURRENT STREET ACTIVITY BEGAN WHEN STUDENTS RETURNED HOME FROM WESTERN INSTITUTIONS CLOSED FOR CHRISTMAS VACATION.
CHIEF ARMISH/MAAG HAS JUST TELEPHONED TO SAY HE IS ON WAY TO EMBASSY TO REPORT HIS MEETING WITH OVEIYI. WE SHOULD KNOW MORE WHEN HE ARRIVES IN ABOUT ONE HOUR.

1978TEHRAN12679.subject: FURTHER MEASURES TO REDUCE OFFICIAL POPULATION

segments.text: WE HAD FOUR DAYS IN A ROW OF SERIOUS DEMONSTRATIONS IN TEHRAN AND IT APPEARS THAT SIMILAR DEMONSTRATIONS HAVE COMMENCED TODAY. FIRING BY TROOPS TO DISPERSE THE CROWDS HAS BEEN FREQUENT AND AT TIMES HEAVY, PARTICULARLY IN THE GENERAL VICINITY OF THE EMBASSY. IN MANY PARTS OF THE CITY THE MOBS HAVE BLOCKED TRAFFIC, DAMAGED OR BURNED CARS AND ANTI-FOREIGN SENTIMENTS AND ACTION HAVE INCREASED DAILY. IN SUM, THE SECURITY SITUATION IS AS BAD, IF NOT WORSE, THAN WHEN THE DEPENDENTS HERE VOLUNTARILY RELOCATED.

IN ADDITION, WE NOW FACE SEVERE SHORTAGES OF GASOLINE, HEATING OIL AND GAS. ONE TO TWO HOURS POWER BLACKOUTS ARE NOW BOTH MORNING AND NIGHT-TIME EXPERIENCES. WE MAY SOON BE FORCED TO ASK OUR TEMPORARY BACHELORS TO DOUBLE OR TRIPLE UP AND OUR SINGLES TO DO THE SAME TO CONSERVE FUEL. THE EMB HAS LESS THAN ONE MONTH OF FUEL SUPPLY FOR ITS GENERATORS AND WE ARE AT THIS TIME NOT IN A POSITION TO PROVIDE MUCH, IF ANY, FUEL TO INDIVIDUAL RESIDENTS.

AS YOU HAVE SEEN IN SEPARATE REPORTING, THIS LONG, DRAWN OUT CRISIS APPEARS TO BE COMING TO A HEAD. WHICHEVER WAY THE SHAH TURNS, I WOULD NOT EXPECT A QUICK RESTORATION OF LAW AND ORDER AND ESSENTIAL SERVICES. THEREFORE, I AGREE FULLY WITH PARA'S 1, 3 AND 4 OL STATE 325503. CONCERNING PARA 2, GENERAL GAST, CHIEF OF ARMISH-MAAG, WILL REVIEW HIS MANNING TABLE BUT AT THIS TIME DOES NOT SEE THE POSSIBILITY OF ANY SIGNIFICANT DECREASE IN SUPPORT PERSONNEL. THE APO, COMMISSARY AND HOSPITAL ALSO SERVICE THE RETIRED MILITARY COMMUNITY WHICH FORMS A KEY ELEMENT IN THE ABILITY OF AMERICAN FIRMS TO FULFILL THEIR CONTRACTUAL OBLIGATIONS TO THE GOI.

HOWEVER, BE ASSURED THAT HE AND WE HERE WILL TAKE A VERY HARD LOOK AT OUR STAFFING PATTERNS. RE PARA 4, WE HAVE 65 DEPENDENTS REMAINING IN THE EMB COMMUNITY. ARMISH-MASS HAS 411 DEPENDENTS REMAINING. ARMISH-MAAG HAS BEEN EXPERIENCEING A TRICKLE OF CONTINUING DEPARTURES UNDER THE VOLUNTARY RELOCATION AUTHORITY AND EXPECTS THAT THIS WILL INCREASE IN VIEW OF THE CONTINUING VERY UNSETTLED CONDITIOMS HERE. OF OUR DEPENDENTS, 15 ARE WORKING IN THE EMB COMMUNITY OR IN THE PRIVATE SECTOR AND THE LOSS OF SOME OF THESE PEOPLE WOULD IMPACT DETRIMENTALLY ON OUR OPERATIONS. AT ANY RATE WE WILL NOT ENCOURAGE DEPENDENTS TO LEAVE UNTIL WE RECEIVE FURTHER GUIDANCE FROM YOU.

IN VIEW LIMITED NUMBER OFFICIAL DEPENDENTS CURRENTLY HERE, WE WOULD LIKE TO RESERVE JUDGMENT ON QUESTION OF ENCOURAGING THEIR DEPARTURE UNTIL WE CAN ASSESS POLITICAL DEVELOPMENTS IMMINENTLY ANTICIPATED. AMBASSADOR IS MEETING WITH NATO COLLEAGUES ON THIS SUBJECT DEC 30.

AS YOU KNOW, SHOULD WE TAKE THE STEP OF ENCOURAGING OFFICIAL DEPENDENTS TO DEPART, WE WOULD BE OBLIGATED TO INFORM THE PRIVATE COMMUNITY OF THIS STEP AND TO GIVE THOSE REMAINING PRIVATE DEPENDENTS THE SAME ADVICE. WITH THE ASSISTANCE OF PANAM WE COULD PROBABLY PHASE OUT ADDITIONAL DEPENDENTS RATHER QUICKLY PROVIDED AIRPORT SERVICES HOLD UP. IF NOT, WE MIGHT HAVE TO RELY ON USAF

SUMMARY: CONSIDERABLE UNCERTAINTY EXISTS AS TO WHERE SADIQI STANDS IN HIS ATTEMPTS TO FORM GOVERNMENT. THERE IS STRONG EVIDENCE HE HAS HAD LITTLE LUCK IN GETTING CABINET TOGETHER, BUT STORIES PERSIST, ESPECIALLY IN DIPLOMATIC CIRCLES, THAT HE MAY BE CLOSE TO TAKING THE REINS. SOME OF HIS REPUTED CABINET CHOICES HAVE SUBSEQUENTLY INDICATED PUBLICLY OR PRIVATELY THAT THEY WOULD NOT SERVE. EVEN IF SADIQI COULD FORM GOVT UNDER PRESENT CIRCUMSTANCES, THERE IS SERIOUS DOUBT IN MANY QUARTERS IT WOULD BE ABLE TO ACCOMPLISH MUCH.

IN WAKE OF GENERAL BREAKDOWN OF PUBLIC ORDER IN TEHRAN AND GROWING PRESENT AND PROJECTED SHORTAGES OF KEY ITEMS SUCH AS HEATING OIL AND GAS, IT APPEARS TO EMBASSY THAT TIME FOR POLITICS IS VERY SHORT. END SUMMARY

PARA SEVEN REF A SUGGESTS POLITICAL INITIATIVES ARE AT DEAD CENTER FOR MOMENT. PUBLICLY, GHOLAM HOSSEIN SADIQI IS STILL SUPPOSED TO BE ATTEMPTING TO FORM A CABINET TO TAKE OVER FROM GEN. AZHARI'S GOVT. AS A RESULT, AZHARI GOVT IS INCREASINGLY SEEN HERE, EVEN BY ITS OWN MEMBERS, AS A LAME DUCK ADMINISTRATION. ITS MINISTERS ARE LOATH TO TAKE INDEPENDENT DECISIONS EVEN ON SIMPLE MATTERS. PRIVATELY, EMBASSY HAS HEARD WIDELY VARYING STORIES, ALL FROM GOOD SOURCES, ABOUT SADIQI PROGRESS. MOST OPTIMISTIC SAY HE HAS CABINET NEARLY FORMED (REF B) AND WILL BE READY TO MOVE WITHIN NEXT FEW DAYS.

THIS COINCIDES WITH RUMORS GOING AROUND DEC 27 AND 28 THAT ANNOUNCEMENT OF NEW GOVT WILL COME DEC 29-31. EQUALLY GOOD SOURCES, HOWEVER, SAY SADIQI HAS HAD MINIMAL LUCK ENLISTING QUALIFIED PEOPLE (I.E., THOSE NOT "TAINTED" BY PARTICIPATION IN PAST 15 YEARS' GOVERNMENTS) AND HAS BEEN ABLE TO LINE UP ONLY FOUR TO EIGHT INDIVIDUALS.

A COUPLE OF HIS REPORTED CABINET CHOICES HAVE SUBSEQUENTLY INDICATED EITHER PUBLICLY OR PRIVATELY THAT THEY ARE NOT INTERESTED IN COALITION GOVT. MOHSEN PEZESHKPOUR TOLD CLOSED SESSION OF PARLIAMENT DEC 27 THAT YOUNG, UNTAINTED RADICAL GOVERNMENT IS NEEDED. IN SUBSEQUENT PRIVATE CONVERSATION INSTIGATED BY US HE CONFIRMED THAT HE WAS READY TO OFFER HIMSELF AS PRIME MINISTERIAL CANDIDATE, THUS SUGGESTING HE WOULD NOT BE INTERESTED IN BEING SADIQI'S MINISTER OF JUSTICE, AS HAD BEEN TOUTED. MEHDI AZAR, WHO HAD BEEN ON AT LEAST TWO "LISTS" OF THOSE SOUGHT BY SADIQI, TOLD FRIENDS PRIVATELY HE WAS NOT INTERESTED IN ANY POST NOW.

FACT THAT RUMORS REGARDING THOSE WILLING TO SERVE ARE SO FEW AND FAR BETWEEN ALSO LENDS CREDENCE TO BELIEF SADIQI IS FACING SERIOUS STRUGGLE, PARTICULARLY SINCE NATIONAL FRONT (INF) LEADER SANJABI HAS PUBLICLY SAID INF NOT INTERESTED IN PARTICIPATING.

ILLUSTRATIVE OF WASTELAND WHICH IS HALLMARK OF POLITICAL SCENE IS GENERAL BELIEF THAT EVEN IF SADIQI FORMS A GOVT, IT WILL NOT BE ABLE TO DO MUCH IN ABSENCE OF SIGNIFICANT ORGANIZED OPPOSITION PARTICIPATION. BAZARGAN'S LIBERATION MOVEMENT (LMI), WHICH IS MAINTAINING BENIGN NEUTRALITY, IS UNWILLING TO SUPPLY EVEN SECOND-LEVEL PERSONNEL FOR SADIQI GOVT. GROWING PUBLIC DISORDERS IN TEHRAN AND VIRTUAL ECONOMIC COLLAPSE OF COUNTRY OVER PAST TWO DAYS, PLUS LOOMING DISAPPEARANCE OF VITAL PETROLEUM PRODUCTS OVER NEXT COUPLE OF DAYS SUGGEST THAT VERY LITTLE TIME, IF ANY, REMAINS TO INDULGE IN LUXURY OF CABINET BUILDING.

EVEN IF SADIQI WERE TO TAKE OVER TOMORROW, IT IS NOT LIKELY THAT STRIKES WOULD CEASE INSTANTLY (OR EVEN AT ALL). THIS WOULD LEAVE NEW GOVT WITH SAME UNENVIABLE OPTIONS FACING PRESENT GOVT -- HARD-LINE MILITARY CRACKDOWN, OR SILENTLY STEALING AWAY.

UNFORTUNATELY FOR THOSE WHO ADVOCATE POLITICAL SOLUTIONS TO IRAN'S PROBLEMS, WE ARE NOT CONVINCED TOP POLITICAL FIGURES SHARE SENSE OF URGENCY EMBASSY FEELS SITUATION DEMANDS. WE HAVE HEARD STORIES THAT SADIQI IS RELUCTANT TO TAKE OVER NOW, PREFERING THAT MATTERS BECOME WORSE SO THAT HIS GOVT WILL HAVE A BETTER CHANCE TO SURVIVE. ANYONE WHO HAS HAD EVEN NODDING ACQUAINTANCESHIP WITH TEHRAN STREETS OR ECONOMIC SITUATION OVER PAST FEW DAYS UNDERSTANDS THAT "THE FUTURE IS NOW." BREAKDOWN OF SOCIAL AND ECONOMIC FABRIC WILL BE NEARLY COMPLETE WHEN REFINED PETROLEUM

1978TEHRAN12698.subject: RADIO MOSCOW COMMENTARY ON SITUATION IN IRAN

segments.text: RADIO MOSCOW COMMENTARY ON SITUATION IN IRAN HAS BECOME VIRULENTLY ANTI-AMERICAN IN PAST FEW DAYS. THIS FACT, PLUS RETURN TO TEHRAN FROM WESTERN COUNTRIES OF SQUADS OF STUDENTS WHO ALLEGEDLY ARE UNDER TUDEH DIRECTION, HAS PRODUCED PARTICULARLY NASTY SITUATION FOR AMERICANS HERE.

USUAL PREMISE FOR SOVIET ATTACKS ON U.S. IS ALLEGED PRESENCE IN IRAN OF SPECIAL "LANDING PARTY" OF CIA AND OTHER OPERATIVES DESIGNED TO SAVE THE SHAH. THIS CANARD, WHICH ORIGINATED WITH RADIO MOSCOW, WAS UNFORTUNATELY GIVEN CREDIBILITY BY IRRESPONSIBLE REPORT FILED BY FORMER NEW YORK TIMES CORRESPONDENT IN TEHRAN.

I DO NOT KNOW THE NATURE OF ANY PREVIOUS DEMARCHES WASHINGTON MAY HAVE HAD WITH MOSCOW ON SUBJECT OF IRAN, BUT BELIEVE CURRENT MEDIA CAMPAIGN SHOULD NOT BE PERMITTED TO CONTINUE WITHOUT PROTEST. SULLIVAN

1978TEHRAN12701.subject: MEETING OF CHIEF ARMISH/MAAG AND GEN OVEISI

segments.text: CHIEF ARMISH/MAAG GENERAL GAST MET MORNING DECEMBER 28 WITH GENERAL OVEISI AT MY REQUEST. ALTHOUGH CONVERSATION WAS INTERRUPTED SEVERAL TIMES BY TELEPHONE CALLS AND WAS THEREFORE SOMEWHAT DISJOINTED, ONE OR TWO SIGNIFICANT IMPRESSIONS EMERGE.
FIRST IS THAT OVEISI AND MILITARY HAVE NO RPT NO MANDATE FOR IRON FIST POLICY. INSTEAD, OVEISI KEPT REPEATING THAT A "POLITICAL SOLUTION" IS NEEDED.
SECOND IS THAT OVEISI FEELS DEPARTURE OF SHAH IS A VERY REAL POSSIBILITY AS ONE SUCH "POLITICAL SOLUTION."

IN DISCUSSING EFFECT WHICH DEPARTURE OF SHAH WOULD HAVE ON ARMED FORCES, OVEISI WAS VERY PESSIMISTIC. HE FELT THERE WAS REAL DANGER THEY WOULD DISINTEGRATE. HE SEEMED TO HAVE DOUBTS ABOUT HIS OWN ABILITY TO CONTROL GROUND FORCES, IN THAT EVENT.

WHEN GAST ASKED WHAT COULD BE DONE TO MAINTAIN INTEGRITY OF ARMED FORCES, OVEISI WENT OFF ON WIDE DIVERSION ABOUT SOVIET INTENTIONS TO BITE OFF NORTHERN PROVINCES OF IRAN AND ON NEED FOR U.S. AND UK TO MOVE. AS FOR SPECIFICS, HIS ONLY RECOMMENDATION WAS THAT U.S. AND UK ARRANGE TO HAVE KHOMEINI MUZZLED.

COMMENT: IF ONE ASSUMES THAT THE SADIQI INITIATIVE IS EITHER DEAD OR DELAYED, THIS CONVERSATION IS ONE FURTHER INDICATION THAT SHAH'S OPTIONS HAVE NARROWED DOWN TO FINDING SOME WAY TO ARRANGE HIS DEPARTURE SO THAT SUBSTANCE OF CONSTITUTION AND INTEGRITY OF ARMED FORCES WILL BE MAINTAINED. OVEISI IS NOT NOTED FOR HIS CANDOR, BUT TENOR OF HIS CONVERSATION WITH GAST WOULD SUGGEST THAT SHAH HAS NOT RPT NOT DISCUSSED "VACATION" SCHEME WITH HIM.

AMBASSADOR ACCOMPANIED BY POL COUNSELOR MET WITH HEAD OF TEACHERS UNION MOHAMAD DERAKHSHESH IN HOME OF AN EMBASSY NATIONAL EMPLOYEE DEC 27. DERAKHSHESH WAS ACCOMPANIED BY TWO OTHER MEMBERS OF HIS POLITICAL GROUP, WHICH HAS SEPARATE BUT PARALLEL EXISTENCE WITH TEACHERS UNION: DR. DAVOUD RASSAI, A LAWYER WHO IS RETIRED TEACHER, AND DR. SADEH RAEISZADEH, DIRECTOR OF TEHRAN'S LARGEST HIGH SCHOOL (WHO REMAINED MOSTLY SILENT). MEETING, WHICH CAME AT DERAKHSHESH'S REQUEST, WAS FOR PURPOSE OF LAYING OUT TO AMBASSADOR GROUP'S IDEAS. (THEY HAD ALREADY BEEN LAID OUT TO POL COUNSELOR IN PREVIOUS MEETING WITH DERAKHSHESH AND RASSAI A WEEK AGO.)

GROUP IS ADAMANT THAT SITUATION HAS EVOLVED TO THE POINT WHERE SHAH MUST LEAVE COUNTRY. EVEN IF KHOMEINI DECIDED SHAH COULD STAY, THE PEOPLE TODAY WOULD NOT ACCEPT THIS. IN ANY CASE, DERAKHSHESH'S GROUP DOES NOT TRUST SHAH'S PROMISES, WHICH HE HAS BROKEN ON MANY OCCASIONS IN THE PAST.

IF SHAH LEAVES, THIS IN ITSELF WILL REDUCE SUPPORT FOR KHOMEINI BY 50 PERCENT. THUS KHOMEINI WILL BE TOO WEAK TO ESTABLISH ISLAMIC REPUBLIC AND MODERATES SUCH AS DERAKHSHESH WILL HAVE CHANCE TO FORM GOVT WHICH WILL BE DEMOCRATIC, ANTI-COMMUNIST, PRO-WESTERN AND ANTI-CLERICAL.

SCENARIO THEY VISUALIZE IS SHAH TURNING OVER HIS POWERS TO A REGENCY COUNCIL. THEY ARE NOT TOO FUSSY ABOUT MEMBERSHIP OF COUNCIL AND HAVE NO OBJECTION TO NAMES SUCH AS ENTEZAM, SORURI, SALEH, ETC. THOUGH THEY OBJECT TO ALI AMINI. THEY THINK COUNCIL SHOULD BE COMPOSED OF 9 TO 11 PEOPLE, 4 TO 5 OF THEM MILITARY. THE MILITARY SHOULD BE RETIRED GENERALS WHO HAVE NOT BEEN CORRUPTED, NOTABLY GENERAL JAM. THIS COUNCIL WOULD APPOINT NEW GOVT, WHETHER IT BE LED BY DERAKHSHESH OR SOME OTHER OPPOSITION FIGURE.

A NEW GOVT WOULD APPEAL TO PEOPLE FOR TWO OR THREE MONTHS TO CARRY OUT A SPECIFIC, CLEARLY ENUNCIATED PROGRAM THAT THE PEOPLE WOULD LIKE. FREE ELECTIONS COULD FOLLOW, LEADING TO A PARLIAMENT WHICH WOULD THEN FORM NEW GOVT.

THE PROBLEM OF A POSSIBLE MILITARY REACTION TO THIS SCENARIO, THE GROUP HOPED, WOULD BE MET BY SHAH HIMSELF, WHO WOULD RESPONSIBLY INSTRUCT MEMBERS OF REGENCY COUNCIL AND TOP ARMY COMMANDERS TO COOPERATE, RETIRING OR TAKING WITH HIM THOSE TOP COMMANDERS WHO ARE CORRUPT. SHAH'S INCENTIVE WOULD BE HIS HOPE TO PRESERVE HIS DYNASTY IN THE FORM OF HIS SON RETURNING IN A FEW YEARS TO REPLACE REGENCY COUNCIL.

GROUP DWELT AT LENGTH ON ITS FEAR OF RELIGIOUS RULE BY KHOMEINI AND THE MULLAHS AND PROBABILITY MANY WOULD FLEE THE COUNTRY IF THAT BECAME A REALITY. GROUP ALSO STRESSED ITS OWN LONG HISTORY OF FIGHTING THE COMMUNISTS, STARTING WITH ITS RESISTANCE TO TUDEH PARTY 30 YEARS AGO (WITH NEWSPAPER "MEHREGAN"). PRESENT POLITICAL GROUP REFORMED ITSELF ABOUT 3 OR 4 YEARS AGO, AT THAT TIME COUNTING SOME 80 MEMBERS. SANJABI, WITH ABOUT A DOZEN OTHER MEMBERS OF THE NATIONAL FRONT, HAD ASKED TO JOIN THE GROUP SHORTLY BEFORE IT WAS DISBANDED BY SHAH.

SOME MEMBERS OF THE GROUP SUCH AS NAJAFI AND PAYDAR HAVE RECENTLY BECOME MINISTERS IN SHARIF-EMAMI AND AZHARI GOVTS AND ARE NO LONGER DIRECTLY ASSOCIATED WITH THE GROUP THOUGH ON GOOD TERMS WITH IT. A COUPLE OF MONTHS AGO GROUP TRIED TO REVIVE NEWSPAPER BY PRINTING FIRST ISSUE OF "AZARDEGAN" BUT DERAKHSHESH WAS ARRESTED AND FURTHER ISSUES WERE NOT PERMITTED. THUS GOVT HAS PREVENTED GROUP'S ENLARGING ITS FOLLOWING WITH WHAT THEY CONSIDER A MODERATE PROGRAM.

DERAKHSHESH POINTED OUT THIS WAS SEVENTH TIME HE HAD BEEN ARRESTED AND SPENT TIME IN JAIL. A FORMER MEMBER OF PARLIAMENT AND MINISTER OF EDUCATION IN THE EARLY 1960S DERAKHSHESH TOLD US HE HAS BUILT A RECORD OF STRENGTH AND INCORRUPTABILITY. HE REFUSED PARTICIPATION IN LATER, TAINTED GOVTS. HE HAS MAINTAINED THE LEADERSHIP OF THE COUNTRY'S SOME 400,000 TEACHERS THROUGH SOME 17 OR 18 YEARS OF POLITICAL INACTIVITY. AS FORMER MEMBER OF PARLIAMENT AND HEAD OF TEACHERS UNION, HE MAINTAINS CONTACTS WITH THE PROVINCES AND HAS MANY MEETINGS IN HIS HOME, MOST OF THEM CONNECTED WITH HIS POLITICAL GROUP RATHER THAN THE TEACHERS UNION.
HE MADE IT CLEAR THAT AMONG CALLERS AT HIS HOME ARE NATIONAL FRONT LEADERS SUCH AS SANJABI AND BAZARGAN AS WELL AS KHOMEINI SUPPORTERS SUCH AS BEHESHTI AND A DR. BAHOUAR.

LARGE NUMBERS OF STUDENTS HAVE RETURNED FROM EUROPE AND AMERICA OVER PAST WEEK AND ARE RESPONSIBLE FOR MORE EFFECTIVE AND MORE VIOLENT STREET TACTICS BEING SEEN IN TEHRAN LAST FEW DAYS. THEY HAVE LEARNED THEIR LESSONS ABROAD AND ARE UNDOUBTEDLY BEING COORDINATED BY COMMUNIST PARTY. TUDEH SUPPORTERS ARE NOT NUMEROUS BUT VERY WELL ORGANIZED AND TRAINED TO SELL THEIR POLITICAL POSITION AMONG OPPOSITION GROUPS.
THIS GIVES THEM A POWER OUT OF PROPORTION TO THEIR REAL NUMBERS.

AMBASSADOR LIMITED HIMSELF TO HEARING THEM OUT, ASKING SOME CLARIFYING QUESTIONS, AND SETTING FORTH U.S. POSITION IN FAVOR OF IRANIAN INDEPENDENCE, A DEMOCRATIC GOVT, AND MODERATE MIDDLE-OF-THE-ROAD SOLUTION TO THE CURRENT PROBLEM, IF SUCH A SOLUTION CAN STILL BE OBTAINED. SULLIVAN

1978TEHRAN12703.subject: POLICIAL/SECURITY REPORT, DEC 28, 1978 SUMMARY; ROVING BANDS CONTINUE TO SPREAD FEAR AND DESTRUCTION; SECURITY FORCES INEFFECTIVE IN COPING

segments.text: SUMMARY; ROVING BANDS CONTINUE TO SPREAD FEAR AND DESTRUCTION; SECURITY FORCES INEFFECTIVE IN COPING. STRIKES AND SHORTAGES PREVENT RESTORATION OF CALM. EMBASSY CAUTIONED AMCITS REGARDING SECURITY SITUATION. MUCH LOCAL RESENTMENT DIRECTED AT FOREIGNERS. END SUMMARY.

DEATHS IN CROWD ON SHAHREZA YESTERDAY HIGHLIGHTED ANOTHER FULL DAY OF RELATIVELY UNHINDERED ROWDINESS. SHOOTINGS TOOK PLACE UNDER CONFUSED CIRCUMSTANCES, AND REPORTS STILL CONFLICT. MARCH TO COMMEMORATE DEAD PROFESSOR CONFRONTED TROOPS AT 24 ESFAND SQUARE. MARCH WAS APPARENTLY TO HAVE BEEN NONPOLITICAL AND WAS TO BE PERMITTED, BUT SOME MARCHERS SHOUTED SLOGANS ANYWAY, AND EVENTUALLY SHOOTING BROKE OUT. AMERICAN EYEWITNESS SAW 30 PEOPLE FALL. SEPARATE AMERICAN PRESS SOURCE SUGGESTS 6 KILLED AND 18 SERIOUSLY WOUNDED. IRANIAN COLONEL WAS AMONG THE DEAD, BUT ACCOUNTS ARE CONTRADICTORY REGARDING HIS ROLE IN THE MARCH.

PRESS SOURCE SAID THIS WAS FIRST OCCASION RANGERS WERE USED IN CROWD CONTROL, PERHAPS EXPLANING TOUGH REACTION ON TROOPS' SIDE. AFTER INCIDENT, MANY CARS WERE SET AFIRE ON SHAHREZA. ROVING TOUGHS AND ARSONISTS WERE ALSO ACTIVE ON OLD SHEMIRAN ROAD SOUTH OF THE BLUE MOSQUE,AND ON SALTANATABAD GANGS DESTROYED 20-30 AUTOMOBILES, BUILT MANY BONFIRES IN STREETS, FORCED DUMPTRUCKS TO DROP LOAD IN STREETS AND FELLED TREES WITH TROOPS FIRING OVER THEIR HEADS TO KEEP THEM ON THE MOVE BUT OTHERWISE LEAVING THEM UNHINDERED. PEOPLE ATOP A BUILDING UNDER CONSTRUCTION NEAR EMBASSY WERE SEEN TRYING TO DROP STEEL BEAMS ON SOLDIERS BELOW. ONE MOB DAMAGED ARMISH-MAAG VEHICLE AND BEAT THE DRIVER.
THERE WAS ALSO A DEMONSTRATION WELL AFTER CURFEW AT NIRT BUILDING.

SECURITY SITUATION IS DIFFERENT IN UNFORTUNATE WAY. THE TERRORIST PROBLEM APART, IN THE PAST OUR CONCERN WAS THAT AMERICANS WOULD WANDER INTO A DEMONSTRATION, BUT WITH GOOD INFORMATION SYSTEM, WE COULD PLOT DEMONSTRATIONS ON MAP AND WARN COMMUNITY. NOW, HOWEVER, "DEMONSTRATIONS" ARE MAINLY THESE ROVING DESTRUCTIVE GROUPS, WHO ARE NOW ON LOOKOUT FOR EXPATRIATES. THEY SUDDENLY SEIZE AN INTERSECTION WHERE THERE WAS NO TROUBLE A FEW MINUTES PREVIOUSLY, PUT KHOMEINI PICTURES ON EACH CAR OR ORDER DRIVERS TO SHOUT "DEATH TO THE SHAH." IF THEY SEE A CAR OR DRIVER WHO SEEMS FOREIGN, PHYSICAL HARRASSMENT BEGINS.

EMBASSY HAS ADVISED COMMUNITY TO REMAIN AT HOME AS MUCH AS POSSIBLE WHEN NOT AT WORK, AND IN PARTICULAR TO STAY NORTH OF TAKHTE TAVOOS. AFTER ADVISORY WAS ISSUED YESTERDAY THERE WAS CONSIDERABLE TROUBLE NORTH OF TAKHTE TAVOOS. TYPICAL OF LOCAL THINKING IS COMMENT FROM THREE PARTNERS IN IRANIAN LAW FIRM TO AMERICAN COWORKER: THEY ARE DISMAYED BY PRESENT SITUATION CAUSED BY SHAH'S REFUSAL TO LEAVE, AND AMERICAN SUPPORT IS THE ONLY REASON THE SHAH TRIES TO REMAIN. SUCH COMMENTS ARE INCREASING.

MANY OTHER CITIES HAD DEMONSTRATIONS YESTERDAY, INCLUDING TABRIZ, REZAIYEH, SHABESTAR AND SHIRAZ. CONSULATE SHIRAZ REPORTS CONDITIONS QUIET THIS MORNING EXCEPT FOR ONE SMALL SIT-IN. CONSULATE TABRIZ REPORTS SITUATION QUIET EXCEPT FOR STUDENT RALLY AT UNIVERSITY OBSERVED FROM OFF CAMPUS BY TROOPS.

AMERICAN BUSINESSMAN TOLD EMBOFF ONE OF HIS EMPLOYEES WHO IS FROM KHOMEIN (BIRTHPLACE OF THE AYATOLLAH) RECENTLY RETURNED WITH NEWS THAT EVERYONE THERE HAD RIFLES AND PISTOLS, WHICH UNKNOWN SOURCE HAD DISTRIBUTED.

STRIKES AND SHORTAGES HAVE HALTED NORMAL LIFE IN TEHRAN AND OTHER CITIES. IRAN AIR IS STILL ON STRIKE (BEING REPORTED SEPTEL). BANKING SYSTEM AND NORMAL COMMERCIAL LIFE HAVE CEASED FUNCTIONING. PETROLEUM SHORTAGE IS NOW CRITICAL (REPORTED SEPTEL). MANY IRANIANS AND FOREIGNERS ARE ALREADY WITHOUT HEATING OIL; NEARLY EVERYONE ELSE WILL RUN OUT IN A MATTER OF DAYS, AND THERE IS NO RESUPPLY AVAILABLE FOR PEAK WINTER COLD PERIOD. GASOLINE LINES, KEROSENE LINES AND VISA LINES AT US CONSULATE RIVAL EACH OTHER IN LENGTH.

ACCORDING MAJLES DEPUTY IRANIAN RADIO REPORTS THAT MAJLES HAS DISCUSSED POSSIBLE ACTION UNDER ARTICLE 38 OF IRANIAN CONSTITUTION, I.E., IN EVENT OF RESIGNATION OF SHAH, ARE NOT RPT NOT CORRECT. HOWEVER, AT SUGGESTION OF ALI AMINI, MAJLES HAS FORMED A "SECRET COMMITTEE" TO MAKE PROPOSALS TO THE AZHARI ADMINISTRATION REGARDING FUTURE FORMS OF GOVERNMENT. ACCORDING TO THIS SOURCE, THE COMMITTEE FIRST MET YESTERDAY DEC 27 AND WILL CONCLUDE ITS EFFORTS AND PROVIDE A REPORT BY TOMORROW DEC 29. SAME SOURCE ALSO REPORTED THAT THE MEETING OF INFLUENTIAL IRANIAN ISLAMIC LEADERS IN QOM TO DISCUSS AN ACCEPTABLE GOVERNMENTAL ARRANGEMENT FOR IRAN (POL/SECURITY REPORT DEC 26) CONTINUED THROUGH DEC 27.
STILL NO WORD ON THE SUBSTANCE OF THESE DISCUSSIONS.
FOUR CUSTOMS OFFICERS FROM MEHRABAD AIRPORT HAVE RECEIVED SENTENCES OF 5-7 YEARS FOR CORRUPTION.
GOVT ANNOUNCED RELEASE OF HOJATOLISLAM TAHERI AND 60 OTHER POLITICAL PRISONERS IN ISFAHAN.

MINISTER OF SCIENCE AND HIGHER EDUCATION MOFIDI WAS REPORTED TO HAVE RESIGNED IN WAKE OF DEATH OF PROFESSOR. WHEN QUESTIONED BY EMBOFF HE WOULD NEITHER CONFIRM OR DENY, INDICATING HE HAS PROBABLY AT LEAST OFFERED HIS RESIGNATION.

TODAY IS ANOTHER TENSE, NOISY ONE IN TEHRAN, WITH GANGS ON THE MOVE AND GUNFIRE AS TROOPS TRY TO MAINTAIN SOME DEGREE OF ORDER. CONSULATE SHIRAZ REPORTS MOB ATTACKED VACANT IAS BUILDING AT 1300 TODAY, THROWING ROCKS AND MOLOTOV COCKTAILS. BUILDING CAUGHT FIRE AND BURNED ABOUT 20 MINUTES BEFORE BEING EXTINGUISHED. EXTENT OF DAMAGE IS YET UNDETERMINED. THERE ARE ALSO STREET DEMONSTRATIONS NEAR PAHLAVI UNIVERSITY MEDICAL SCHOOL WITH SOME FIRES STARTED BY MOBS. TEHRAN MLA HAS AGAIN THREATENED STERN MEASURES IF ROWDINESS CONTINUES.

1978TEHRAN12706.subject: CURRENT BAZAARI ATTITUDES TOWARD ECONOMIC - DIFFICULTIES

segments.text: DIFFICULTIES

EMBOFF HAD BRIEF DISCUSSION WITH BAZAAR MERCHANT ASSADOLLAH ABBASI DEC 28 ON BAZAARI VIEWS OF CONTINUING ECONOMIC PROBLEMS AND POSSIBLE GOVERNMENTAL CHANGES. ABBASI, CLAIMING THAT HE ALSO REFLECTS THE VIEW OF THE GREAT MAJORITY OF OTHER SMALL BAZAARIS WHOM HE KNOWS, STATED CATEGORICALLY THAT THE BAZAAR INTENDS TO REMAIN CLOSED UNTIL THE SHAH LEAVES. THE ONE BRIEF EXCEPTION TO THIS POLICY, AUTHORIZED BY THE ULEMA, WILL BE DEC 30 WHEN THE BAZAAR IS SCHEDULED TO OPEN TO PERMIT THE PEOPLE TO PURCHASE NECESSITIES AND THEN CLOSE AGAIN.

THE BAZAARIS ARE PARTICULARLY IRRITATED BY THE SHORTAGE OF KEROSENE AND GASOLINE WHICH THEY LAY AT THE FEET OF THE UNITED STATES FOR OUR SUPPORT OF THE SHAH. MEETING AT QOM, THE AYATOLLAHS SHARIATMADARI, TALEGHANI AND GOLPAYGHANI HAVE ISSUED A LETTER URGING THE FAITHFUL TO FOREGO THE PURCHASE OF GASOLINE AND KEROSENE AND TO HEAT THEIR HOMES WITH CHARCOAL INSTEAD. ACCORDING TO ABBASI, TOWNS OF TABRIZ, ISFAHAN AND QOM ARE ALREADY ENGAGED IN SUCH A BOYCOTT. (COMMENT: THE SEVERE SHORTAGE OF THESE PRODUCTS WILL MAKE THE BOYCOTT MUCH EASIER TO OBSERVE.)

ABBASI ALSO STATED THAT BAZAARIS WOULD BE WHOLLY OPPOSED TO ANY GOVERNMENT WHICH MIGHT BE FORMED BY DR. SADIQI. HE NOTED THAT THIS OPPOSITION IS SHARED BY NATIONAL FRONT LEADER SANJABI WHO, AS RECENTLY AS DEC 28, WAS INVITED TO SPEAK ON THE SUBJECT IN THE BEHESHT ZAHRA CEMETERY, WHERE HE REITERATED HIS OPPOSITION TO A SADIQI GOVERNMENT.

ANTI-AMERICAN FEELING IN THE BAZAAR IS GROWING, ACCORDING TO ABBASI. HE STATED THAT A GROUP OF 2-3,000 BAZAARIS BEGAN WENDING THEIR WAY NORTH EARLIER TODAY INTENDING TO ATTACK THE AMERICAN EMBASSY. (COMMENT: WE HAVE SEEN NO SIGN OF THIS ATTACK SO FAR.) WHEN EMBOFF SAID EMB HAD ALREADY BEEN ATTACKED, ABBASI REPLIED THAT MANY BAZAARIS FELT THAT EARLIER ATTACK HAD NOT BEEN SUFFICIENT. HE CLOSED BY REPEATING HIS EARLIER ADMONITION TO EMBOFF TO AVOID BATAAR BUT ADDED THAT EMBOFF SHOULD ALSO STAY AWAY FROM EMBASSY AS MUCH AS POSSIBLE. SULLIVAN

EMBOFF DISCUSSED MASHAD SITUATION BY PHONE DEC 27 WH MASHAD UNIVERSITY CHANCELLOR PARVIZ AMOUZEGAR. LATTER NOTED THAT ONE HOPEFUL DEVELOPMENT HAD BEEN END OF SIT-IN STRIKE AT RH REZA HOSPITAL DEC 26 AND RETURN OF DOCTORS TO WORK IN PRIVATE CLINICS.

THIS WAS OFFSET HOWEVER BY DIFFICULTIES IN TEHRAN AT MINISTRY OF SCIENCE AND HIGHER EDUCATION. APPROXIMATELY 70 PROFESSORS WANTED TO TAKE BAST (SANCTUARY) IN MINISTRY BUILDING AND MILITARY DECIDED TO PREVENT THIS. IN ENSUING DEMONSTRATIONS ONE PROFESSOR WAS KILLED. (SEE POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT DEC 27.) HIS DEATH HAS BECOME LATEST CAUSE CELEBRE AMONG MASHAD UNIVERSITY COMMUNITY AND DEC 27 SAW MASS DEMONSTRATION OF SEVERAL HUNDRED THOUSAND PEOPLE IN MASHAD TO MARK PROFESSOR'S TEHRAN FUNERAL. SCIENCE AND HIGHER EDUCATION MINISOER MDI, A GENERALLY RESPECTED PROFESSOR WITH 30 YEARS EDUCATIONAL EXPERIENCE, HAS SINCE RESIGNED, OSTENSIBLY FOR REASONS OF HEALTH, ACCORDING TO AMOUZEGAR.
(MOFIDI HIMSELF DUCKED POL COUNSELOR'S DIRECT QUESTION TODAY ON WHETHER HE HAD RESIGNED, SUGGESTING HE HAS AT LEAST TRIED TO RESIGN.)

IN THE MEANTIME TENSIONS IN MASHAD HAVE BEEN FURTHER HEIGHTENED BY THE PRISON INCIDENT WHICH TOOK PLACE WHEN STRIKING POLITICAL PRISONERS SET THEIR BUILDING AFIRE. A LARGE CROWD, ESTIMATED AT 100,00,WENT TO THE PRISON TO HELP THE PRISONERS AGAINST WHAT THEY BELIEVED WAS A GOVERNMENT ATTEMPT TO BURN THEM AND A CONFRONTATION ENSUED BETWEEN THE CROWD AND THE MILITARY WHICH HAD BEEN REINFORCED BY AS MANY AS 40 TANKS. ON DEC 27 THE MILITARY AUTHORITIES GAVE IN TO THE CROWD AND APPROXIMATELY 38 POLITICAL PRISONERS WERE RELEASED.

THE POSITION OF THE MILITARY AUTHORITIES DURING THE PRISON INCIDENT WAS WEAKENED BY THE ABSENCE OF A MILITARY GOVERNOR. THE FORMER INCUMBENT HAD BEEN REPLACED, FOLLOWING THE DEC 15 ATTACK ON SHAH REZA HOSPITAL,BY A GENERAL FROM KARAJ. DURING HIS EXILE IN KARAJ, THE AYATOLLAH QOMI HAD CLASHED WITH THIS OFFICER AND THE VENERABLE AYATOLLAH LOST NO TIME IN FORCING HIS OLD ENEMY'S RESIGNATION, ONLY THREE DAYS AFTER THE GENERAL'S ARRIVAL IN MASHAD. NO NEW MILITARY GOVERNOR HAS YET ARRIVED.

AMOUZEGAR IS BECOMING MORE AND MORE PESSIMISTIC ABOUT THE FUTURE OF THE SHAH AND THE IMMEDIATE FUTURE OF THE COUNTRY. HIS BLEAK OUTLOOK WAS BASED IN PART UPON RUMORS HE HAS HEARD (ON WHICH EMBOFF MADE NO COMMENT) THAT SADIQI HAS BEEN ABLE TO LOCATE ONLY 6 OR 7 MEN WILLING TO JOIN HIM IN A CABINET AND THAT HE HAS REQUESTED A DELAY OF ABOUT 10 DAYS TO PERMIT HIM TO CONTINUE HIS ATTEMPT. AMOUZEGAR STILL BELIEVES THAT THE SHAH SHOULD LEAVE FOR A TIME TO FACILITATE A SOLUTION WHICH WOULD PERMIT HIS LATER RETURN IN SOME AMBIGUOUS CAPACITY. SULLIVAN

FOCUS TODAY IS ON POLITICAL SCENE. WHILE POL COUNSELOR WAS TALKING WITH AN INTERMEDIARY AFTERNOON DECEMBER 28, CALL CAME IN FROM A GOI MINISTER SAYING GOI DEFINITELY WOULD RESIGN TOMORROW, DECEMBER 30. THIS MORNING, DR. SHAHPOUR BAKHTIAR TELEPHONED EMBOFF STEMPEL TO SAY SHAH HAD CALLED BAKHTIAR TO PALACE PREVIOUS EVENING AND GIVEN HIM MANDATE TO FORM NEW GOVERNMENT. BAKHTIAR SAID HE WAS SETTING ABOUT HIS TASK IMMEDIATELY AND ASKED SEE STEMPEL MORNING DECEMBER 30. HE SAID HE WOULD COMMENT ON HIS PROPOSED POLICIES AND CABINET THEN AND HOPED FOR U.S. SUPPORT. HOW TWO REPORTS FIT TOGETHER NOT ENTIRELY CLEAR.

SEEMS UNLIKELY BAKHTIAR COULD MOVE FAST ENOUGH TO BE READY FOR PUBLIC ANNOUNCEMENT DECEMBER 30. IN VIEW OF HIS PROFESSED ATHEISM WE DOUBT HE CAN GET ENOUGH RELIGIOUS SUPPORT TO MAKE HIS CANDIDACY VIABLE. TO ADD TO CONFUSION AMERICAN REPORTER TELLS US ZAHEDI IS AT PALACE THIS MORNING AND CALLING MANY PEOPLE TO HIS HOME THIS AFTERNOON. OTHER PRESS SOURCES HEAR AZHARI WAS ASKED TO SOLDIER ON FOR A BIT LONGER. ALL SEEM CERTAIN SADIQI EFFORT HAS FAILED. AMBASSADOR HAS AUDIENCE TODAY WHICH SHOULD CLARIFY THE SITUATION.

SITUATION IN TEHRAN WAS QUIETER THAN PAST FEW DAYS THIS MORNING. SOME SHOTS HEARD AROUND EMBASSY EARLY THIS AFTERNOON AND SMOKE SEEN RISING FROM SOUTHEAST, SUGGESTING SOME OPPOSITION ACTIVITY, BUT NOT MUCH SO FAR. FAIR AMOUNT OF CAR TRAFFIC ABOUT DESPITE MOST GAS STATIONS BEING CLOSED. (ACCORDING TO PAA MANAGER ONE AMERICAN WAS REFUSED SERVICE AT GAS PUMP BECAUSE HE WAS AN AMERICAN. PAA CONSEQUENTLY WILL FLY IN AUTO GAS SUPPLIES TO SERVICE ITS OWN EMPLOYEES. INCIDENT COULD HAVE WIDER IMPLICATIONS FOR OTHER AMERICANS, HOWEVER.)

LOCAL BROUHAHA SET OFF BY NATIONAL FRONT CLAIM THAT COUNTRY HAS ENOUGH STOCKS OF GASOLINE TO SERVICE DOMESTIC NEEDS "FOR A YEAR" BUT GOI CREATING ARTIFICIAL SHORTAGE SO THAT IT CAN GO ON EXPORTING TO ISRAEL AND OTHER FOREIGNERS. THIS REPORT HEARD WIDELY THANKS TO BBC PERSIAN LANGUAGE SERVICE. NIOC HEAD ENTEZAM HAS PUBLICLY DENIED REPORT AND INVITED NATIONAL FRONT AND ANY OTHER INTERESTED PARTIES TO VISIT TEHRAN DEPOT AND SEE SHORTAGE OF REFINED PRODUCT FOR THEMSELVES. STOCKS LIKELY TO RUN OUT IN A COUPLE OF DAYS (SEE TEHRAN 12686 NOTAL).

AFP HAS REPORT FROM NATIONAL FRONT SOURCE THAT WORKERS ARE NEGOTIATING WITH NIOC TO PERMIT PRODUCTION LIMITED AMOUNTS FOR DOMESTIC NEEDS IF THEY ALLOWED SUPERVISE ALL ITS DISTRIBUTION. THIS IS NOT CONFIRMED FROM ANY OTHER SOURCE.

PAA MANAGER REPORTS NEW YORK ACCEPTED HIS RECOMMENDATION AND BROUGHT IN PAA-001 THIS MORNING, AS WELL AS ISTANBUL SHUTTLE. HOWEVER, EASTBOUND PAA-002 WILL OVERFLY TONIGHT. FUEL WAS NOT AVAILABLE THIS MORNING. TELEX SERVICE AT AIRPORT HAS ALSO BEEN OUT LAST COUPLE OF DAYS (THOUGH WORKING IN TOWN), FURTHER HAMPERING OPERATIONS. MANAGER PLANS CONTINUE TRY TO BRING IN DAYTIME FLIGHTS, THOUGH THIS IS A DAY-TO-DAY DECISION.

ACCORDING TO JUSTICE MINISTER, SHAH DID NOT APPROVE A COMPANION SUGGESTION THAT SOME 200 PROMINENT PEOPLE BE DEPRIVED OF THEIR CONSTITUTIONAL RIGHTS (INCLUDING THE RIGHT TO HOLD PUBLIC OFFICE) BECAUSE THEY STAND CONDEMNED IN THE EYES OF PUBLIC OPINION.

SAME SOURCE ALSO QUOTES MINISTER OF JUSTICE AS SAYING THAT AS OF A FEW DAYS AGO HEADS OF POLICE, SAVAK, AND GENDARMERIE HAVE BEEN ORDERED BY THE SHAH NO LONGER TO COME TO HIM FOR THEIR INSTRUCTIONS BUT TO GET THEM FROM THE PRIME MINISTER AND THE MINISTER OF JUSTICE. CONSULATE SHIRAZ REPORTS RUMOR WIDESPREAD AROUND SHIRAZ THAT SANJABI IS COMING TO TOWN TODAY TO ORGANIZE OPPOSITION TO SHAH AND CALL FOR A GENERAL STRIKE. (SINCE IRAN AIR REMAINS ON STRIKE, WE ASSUME HE WOULD HAVE TO DRIVE.) GRUMMAN MANAGER ALSO TOLD CONSUL THAT DECISION JUST TAKEN TO REDUCE STAFF TO ABSOLUTE MINIMUM AND MOVE EVERYBODY, WITH CARS, OUT TO THE BASE. THIS IS EXPECTED TO AFFECT F-14 PROGRAM.

CONSUL METRINKO IN TABRIZ WAS TOLD BY LOCAL REFINERY MANAGER THAT HE EXPECTS STRIKERS TO SHUT DOWN HIS PLANT INDEFINITELY AS OF TOMORROW OR SUNDAY. STOCKS OF KEROSENE (FOR HEATING) ENOUGH FOR ONE WEEK, OTHER PRODUCTS SLIGHTLY LONGER. WHEN MANAGER DISCUSSED THIS SITUATION WITH WORKERS AND WITH OTHER CITY LEADERS YESTERDAY, HE ENCOUNTERED OPEN DISBELIEF AND CLAIM (REFERRED TO ABOVE) THAT GOVERNMENT HAS AMPLE STOCKS BUT IS CREATING ARTIFICIAL SHORTAGE. CONSUL REPORTS OPINION HAS BECOME UNANIMOUS AMONG ALL HIS TOP CONTACTS, IN INDUSTRY, AMONG GOVERNMENT, MILITARY, AND POLICE, THAT THE SHAH MUST GO.

AMERICAN TRAVELER (ROUND-THE-WORLD MOTORCYCLE RACER) TOLD HIM GENDARMERIE OFFICERS WITH WHOM HE CAME INTO CONTACT YESTERDAY ALL CARRIED PHOTOGRAPHS OF KHOMEINI IN THEIR POCKETS AND TALKED OPENLY OF HIS IMMINENT RETURN TO IRAN ONCE THE SHAH HAS LEFT. MEANWHILE, SOLDIERS GUARDING CONSULATE COMPOUND AND YOUNG MEN OF THE NEIGHBORHOOD (WHO OFTEN APPEAR AMONG THE DEMONSTRATORS) ARE ENGAGED TODAY IN FRIENDLY FOOTBALL COMPETITION ON CONSULATE PLAYING FIELD.

CONSUL MCGAFFEY REPORTS ANOTHER PEACEFUL MARCH OF SEVERAL THOUSANDS TAKING PLACE IN ISFAHAN TODAY. THIS IS THIRD DAY SHEIKH TAHERI (WHO WAS RELEASED FROM PRISON DECEMBER 26) HAS BEEN PREACHING. MOB IS IN HOLIDAY MOOD AND ARMY AND POLICE KEEPING THEIR DISTANCE.

1978TEHRAN12736.subject: REDUCTION IN OFFICIAL PERSONNEL AND OTHER AMERICAN PRESENCE

segments.text: BEFORE ADDRESSING DEPARTURE OF DEPENDENTS DEFINITIVELY, AMBASSADOR WOULD LIKE TO COMPLETE CONSULTATIONS WITH NATO COLLEAGUES SCHEDULED FOR DECEMBER 30 AT 1730. ASSUMING NOTHING EMERGES FROM THAT MEETING TO CHANGE SITUATION ANTICIPATED PARA 4 REFTEL, WE WOULD PLAN THAT AMBASSADOR WILL SEE FOREIGN MINISTER AND MAKE FOLLOWING POINTS
IN ORDER RELIEVE PRESSURE ON ITEMS IN SHORT SUPPLY, WE SHALL ENCOURAGE THE DEPARTURE OF THE DEPENDENTS OF AMERICAN OFFICIALS AND THOSE IN THE PRIVATE COMMUNITY.

WE HOPE TO HAVE THESE DEPENDENTS DEPART IN AN ORDERLY MANNER AND WOULD APPRECIATE THE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN'S COOPERATION IN PROVIDING LANDING RIGHTS IF IT IS NECESSARY TO BRING IN EXTRA OR CHARTER FLIGHTS.
WE ARE ENCOURAGING THE WORKING PRINCIPALS OF THE PRIVATE FIRMS TO REMAIN IN IRAN IN ORDER TO CARRY OUT THEIR CONTRACTUAL RESPONSIBILITIES.
THE EMBASSY MAY SEND A FEW NONESSENTIAL OFFICIALS OUT OF THE COUNTRY BUT WILL MAINTAIN ALL ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS.
WE HAVE COME TO THIS DECISION RELUCTANTLY, BUT ANTICIPATED PROBLEMS OF THE OPENING OF SCHOOLS AND THE VERY UNSETTLED SECURITY SITUATION WERE FINALLY PERSUASIVE.
THE AMBASSADOR WILL ALSO TAKE THE SAME LINE WITH THE MINISTRY OF COURT SO THAT THE SHAH WILL BE PROMPTLY INFORMED AND CHIEF OF ARMISH/MAAG WILL PASS THE DECISION TO APPROPRIATE MILITARY OFFICIALS.

WE SHALL AT THAT POINT CALL A MEETING OF OFFICIALS OF AMERICAN FIRMS AND ADVISE THEM TO ENCOURAGE THE DEPARTURE OF DEPENDENTS. SO THAT AS MANY AMERICANS AS POSSIBLE WILL BE INFORMED WE SHALL ALSO ISSUE THE FOLLOWING ADVISORY THROUGH THE PYRAMID SYSTEM: IN VIEW OF THE SCARCITY OF HEATING OIL, GASOLINE AND FM IN THIS WINTER PERIOD, AND IN LIGHT OF THE CONDITIONS PREVAILING IN THE MAJOR CITIES OF IRAN, THE EMBASSY RECOMMENDS THAT DEPENDENTS OF AMERICAN CITIZENS TEMPORARILY LEAVE THE COUNTRY. END .
WE SHALL ALSO ADVISE EC EMBASSIES AND EMBASSIES OF OTHER FRIENDLY COUNTRIES OF OUR ACTION.

OUR AIM IN THIS FURTHER RELOCATION OF DEPENDENTS WOULD BE TO PHASE OUT STEADILY, BUT IN AN ORDERLY FASHION, OVER SEVERAL DAYS, AND USE REGULAR PAN AM FLIGHTS TO EXTENT POSSIBLE. PAN AM FLIGHTS 001 AND 110 CAME IN TODAY AND TOOK OUT OVER 500 PEOPLE. (WE DO NOT KNOW HOW MANY AMERICANS WERE INCLUDED.) ONCE DEPARTMENT GIVES THE GREEN LIGHT, IT SHOULD ARRANGE WITH PAN AM TO SHUTTLE AN ADDITIONAL 747 FROM TEHRAN TO ISTANBUL. THERE MIGHT ALSO HAVE TO BE ADDITIONAL PAN AM SECTIONS OUT OF ISTANBUL TO POINTS WEST, IF PASSENGER LOAD REQUIRES, IN ORDER PRECLUDE DELAYS IN TRANSFERS AT HOTEL-SHORT, AND MARTIALLAW TENSE ISTANBUL.

ALTERNATIVELY, SHUTTLE POINT MAY HAVE TO BE ATHENS, IF ISTANBUL IMPOSSIBLE. THIS FLIGHT COULD MAKE TWO OR THREE FLIGHTS A DAY. WE WOULD PLAN TO HAVE ALL PASSENGERS ARRIVE AT THE AIRPORT EARLY IN THE MORNING BEFORE THE DAILY DEMONSTRATIONS COMMENCE AND AWAIT THEIR FLIGHT. SECURITY AT THE AIRPORT HAS BEEN EXCELLENT SO FAR.
WE WOULD EXPECT COMPANIES IN THIS STAGE TO MAKE THEIR OWN TRAVEL ARRANGEMENTS VIA REGULAR COMMERCIAL FLIGHTS AND TRAINS. WE SHALL COOPERATE FULLY IN OBTAINING LANDING RIGHTS.
DOD MAY WISH TO USE MAC FLIGHT(S) FOR TRAVEL OF DOD DEPENDENTS TO EUROPE.

PAN AM SHOULD BE ALERTED TO THE POSSIBILITY OF THE NEED FOR ADDITIONAL FLIGHTS. EUCOM SHOULD INSTITUTE CONTINGENCY PLANNING FOR A LARGER MAC AIRLIFT SHOULD THAT BE NECESSARY. SULLIVAN NOTE BY OC/T: MESSAGE AS RECEIVED.

1978TEHRAN12739.subject: COMMENTS OF LT. GEN. HOSSEIN JAHANBANI

segments.text: IN CONVERSATION DECEMBER 28 WITH FRIEND OF EMBOFF'S, LT. GEN. HOSSEIN JAHANBANI, DEPUTY COMMANDER OF THE ARMY AND SON OF THE GENERAL WHO PACIFIED EASTERN IRAN FOR REZA SHAH, EXPRESSED CONSIDERABLE PESSIMISM AND DEPRESSION. UNDER PRESENT CIRCUMSTANCES, JAHANBANI BELIEVES, THE ARMY WOULD STILL FOLLOW ANY ORDER WHICH THE SHAH MIGHT GIVE INCLUDING ONE TO DEAL VERY HARSHLY WITH DEMONSTRATORS AND STRIKERS. A MONTH FROM NOW, HOWEVER, HE FEARS THAT THE MILITARY WILL NO LONGER RESPOND.

THE MILITARY IS WAITING FOR A COMMAND FROM THE SHAH BUT THE MONARCH SIMPLY ATTENDS MEETINGS WITH THE GENERALS AND DOES NOT PARTICIPATE OR COMMENT. ACCORDING TO JAHANBANI, THE MILITARY WOULD ALSO ACT ON BEHALF OF THE SHAH ON DIRECT USG INSTRUCTIONS.

JAHANBANI REMARKED GLUMLY THAT, IN THE PAST, NO ONE DARED TO TALK TO THE SHAH ABOUT PLANNING FOR A SITUATION SUCH AS THE PRESENT ONE. AS A CONSEQUENCE THERE IS NO PLAN AND NEITHER THE TIME NOR THE WILL TO DEVELOP ONE.

ON THE BASIS OF RECENT EMBASSY SITREPS, MEMCONS, AIRGRAMS, AND REPORTS OF VISITORS HERE, THOSE IN WASHINGTON WHO ARE FOLLOWING EVENTS IN IRAN UNDOUBTEDLY ARE GETTING THE MESSAGE, NAMELY, THAT THE UNITED STATES, INCREASINGLY, IS PERCEIVED BY BOTH SOPHISTICATED AND UNSOPHISTICATED IRANIANS AS BLAMEWORTHY FOR THEIR PRESENT DIFFICULTIES. AT THE SAME TIME THE USG IS ALSO LOOKED TO AS THE ULTIMATE ARBITER OF WHATEVER SOLUTION LIES AHEAD.

THIS PHENOMENON DEFIES EASY EXPLANATION. IT IS MORE THAN SCAPEGOAT-ITIS, BUT IT IS A FACET OF THE IRANIAN PERSONALITY TO BLAME SOMEONE ELSE FOR THEIR TROUBLES. IT IS MORE THAN HARKENING BACK TO EITHER THE CARTER ADMINISTRATION'S HUMAN RIGHTS EMPHASIS OR TO THE SPECIAL PERSONAL RELATIONSHIP WHICH DEVELOPED BETWEEN THE PAHLAVIS AND THE WHITE HOUSE THROUGH MANY PRESIDENCIES. ITS ROOTS LIE IN THE MODERN HISTORY OF IRAN DURING WHICH THE U.S. EVOLVED AS THIS COUNTRY'S MOST PRESTIGIOUS FOREIGN BENEFACTOR, LINCHPIN FOR THE THRONE, ALLY AND PROVIDER OF THE ESSENTIALS ASSOCIATED WITH WORLD POWER STATUS.

WHETHER IN THE FIELDS OF SECURITY, COMMERCE OR EDUCATION, THE IRAN-US RELATIONSHIP ASSUMED CONSPICUOUS PROPORTIONS BEYOND THAT OF IRAN AND ANY OTHER COUNTRY. IT BECAME THE RALLYING POINT FOR BOTH ANTI AND PRO SHAH POLITICAL ACTIVISTS, EITHER CAMP SENSING SOMETHING NEFARIOUS AT WORST, SUSPECT AT BEST, ABOUT THE U.S., BORN OF FRUSTRATION WITH THEIR RESPECTIVE INABILITIES TO ACHIEVE DIFFERING BUT EQUALLY UTOPIAN GOALS.

WHILE PERSONAL CONTACT, ESPECIALLY ONE ON ONE SITUATIONS, RARELY FAIL TO BE WARM, OPEN, AND FORTHCOMING, THE ANONYMOUS AMERICAN OR AMERICAN IMPORT OBSERVED FROM A DISTANCE TAKES ON A NEGATIVE COLORATION, SOMETHING ALIEN, INTRUSIVE AND ULTIMATELY DISRUPTIVE. DESPITE DENIALS THAT WE ARE MANAGING EVENTS HERE, DESPITE PROTESTATIONS THAT THE OUTCOME IS FOR IRANIANS ALONE TO DECIDE, THE BELIEF PERSISTS AT ALL LEVELS OF SOCIETY THAT AMERICA IS THE INVISIBLE GOVERNMENT. THE DEPRIVATIONS OF THESE DAYS WILL BE SEEN AS THE HANDIWORK OF THE U.S.
GOVERNMENT OR THE CIA OR THE OIL COMPANIES AND, WHATEVER ENSUES, BE IT FOR BETTER OR WORSE, THE USG WILL BE CRITICIZED AS HAVING DONE TOO LITTLE, TOO LATE.

DESPITE THE READINESS AT THIS TIME TO BELIEVE THE WORST OF US AS A GOVERNMENT (THOUGH PREFERABLE TO THE USSR), IRANIANS RATE THE U.S. AS THE PREFERRED LOCALE OF ANY IN THE WORLD FOR ITS POLITICAL SYSTEM, FOR FURTHER STUDY, FOR LIVING THE GOOD LIFE, FOR FINDING SOLUTIONS TO PROBLEMS ASSOCIATED WITH MODERNIZATION.

HAVING OUTLINED THE ATTITUDE AND SOME OF ITS GENESIS, WHAT, IF ANYTHING, CAN BE DONE BY WAY OF PUBLIC DIPLOMACY TO MODIFY THE MORE EXTREME SENTIMENTS RE THE U.S. AND ITS IRANIAN CONNECTION? IN THE ABSENCE OF MOST MEDIA, U.S. OFFICIAL POLICY STATEMENTS REGISTER WITH ONLY A HANDFUL, AND EVEN THIS HANDFUL INTERPRET DIFFERENTLY THE INTENT OF THE USG.

MORE SALUTARY ARE CONSTRUCTIONS SUCH AS THE PRESIDENT UTTERED ON NOVEMBER 13, I.E., "OUR INCLINATION IS FOR THE IRANIAN PEOPLE TO HAVE A CLEAR EXPRESSION OF THEIR OWN VIEWS AND TO HAVE A GOVERNMENT INTACT IN IRAN THAT ACCURATELY EXPRESSES A MAJORITY VIEW IN IRAN." LOW PROFILE, BENIGN IN-COUNTRY ACTIVITIES SUCH AS ENGLISH TEACHING, AN OPEN DOOR LIBRARY, STUDENT COUNSELING AND ORIENTATION, CONTINUATION OF AS WIDE A RANGE OY PERSONAL CONTACTS AS MANAGEABLE, PROVIDING MONTHLY AND BIWEEKLY PERIODICALS WHICH LAY STRESS ON U.S. INTERNATIONAL POLICIES AND THE RELEVANCE OF ITS IRAN CONNECTION ARE THE TYPES OF COMMUNICATION FARE (SECURITY PERMITTING) WHICH WE CAN DISSEMINATE.

TO MOUNT MAJOR SPEAKING SEMINARS, CULTURAL PROGRAMS, UNDER THE CIRCUMSTANCES, WOULD BE FOLLY. WE AS AN AGENCY AND A MISSION MUST FACE THE PROSPECT OF A CERTAIN ESTRANGEMENT FROM OUR IRANIAN HOSTS FOR THE PRESENT AND IMMEDIATE FUTURE.

THE PURPORT OF THIS MESSAGE IS TO ADVISE THOSE IN THE U.S. POLICY ARTICULATION ROLE TO BE AWARE OF THE SPECIAL AND PROBLEMATICAL COMMUNICATION RELATIONSHIP WHICH EXISTS THESE DAYS BETWEEN OUR TWO COUNTRIES.

1978TEHRAN12747.subject: PROTECTION AND WELFARE: ADVICE TO AMCITS - DESIRING RETURN TO IRAN

segments.text: WE ARE NOT PERMITTING OFFICIAL DEPENDENTS TO RETURN TO TEHRAN AT THIS TIME AND DO NOT RECOMMEND RETURN OF OTHER AMCITS. DECISION, OF COURSE, IS UP TO PRIVATE CITIZENS AND THEIR COMPANIES. HOWEVER, SECURITY SITUATION IS POOR AND ANTI-FOREIGN SENTIMENT AND ACTIONS HAVE INCREASED. THERE ARE SEVERE SHORTAGES OF HEATING OIL, GAS AND GASOLINE; THIS SITUATION IS NOT LIKELY TO IMPROVE
CONSUL METRINKO HAS JUST INFORMED US THAT CONSULATE IS UNDER ATTACK BY MOB. MILITARY GUARD IS FIRING INTO CROWD.

WE HAD RECEIVED REPORTS THAT EMBASSY WAS TO BE ATTACKED TODAY, BUT SO FAR (1400 LOCAL) CROWDS HAVE NOT COME VERY CLOSE. WE HAVE SIZABLE NUMBER OF TROOPS AROUND EMBASSY AND HAVE ARRANGEMENTS FOR QUICK REACTION FORCE TO COME TO COMPOUND BY HELICOPTER IF ASSAULT OCCURS.

EARLIER REPORT THAT MILITARY WERE SHOOTING INTO CROWD WAS INCORRECT. SECURITY FORCES FIRED IN AIR AND WITHDREW TO CIRCLE CONSULATE BUILDING WHERE ALL EMPLOYEES HAD GATHERED. CONSULATE GROUNDS WERE OVERRUN BY MOB FROM NUMEROUS ENTRY POINTS, INCLUDING MAIN GATES WHICH HAVE BEEN DESTROYED.

MOB DID NOT TEST SECURITY RING BUT LIT FIRES IN COMPOUND. UNCERTAIN HOW MUCH DAMAGE. VERY SUBSTANTIAL MILITARY REINFORCEMENTS HAVE ARRIVED AND CROWD IS BEING DISPERSED BY USE OF WATER HOSING AND FIRING INTO AIR. METRINKO BELIEVES WORST IS OVER. NO INJURIES ON EITHER SIDE AS FAR AS HE CAN ASCERTAIN.
WE HAVE SEPARATE REPORT THAT TURKISH CONSULATE TABRIZ HAS ALSO BEEN ATTACKED. SULLIVAN

DESPITE RUMORS OF IMPENDING ATTACK ON EMBASSY, DECEMBER 30 HAS BEEN PRETTY MUCH BUSINESS AS USUAL. IN TEHRAN: ONE BURNING CAR VISIBLE FROM COMPOUND, SEVERAL OTHER BONFIRES FUELED BY GARBAGE AND AUTO TIRES WITHIN SEVERAL BLOCKS OF EMBASSY, DEMONSTRATORS PLACING ANTISHAH LEAFLETS ON AUTO WINDSHIELDS AND INSISTING THAT DRIVERS TURN THEIR LIGHTS ON AS GESTURE OF SUPPORT FOR DISSIDENT MOVEMENT. IRANIAN ARMY FORCES GUARDING EMBASSY, WHICH WERE REINFORCED IN REACTION TO ATTACK RUMORS, PERIODICALLY FIRE AIRBURSTS TO DISCOURAGE GROUPS OF DEMONSTRATING YOUTHS. OTHER DEMOS REPORTED ELSWHERE IN TEHRAN.

IN MEETING WITH EMBOFF SHAHPUR BAKHTIAR CONFIRMED EARLIER REPORT THAT SHAH HAS ASKED HIM TO FORM CABINET (SEPTEL) AND NOTED THAT HE EXPECTS TO BE SWORN IN BY JANUARY 3 OR 4. BAKHTIAR CLAIMS HE WILL BE PERMITTED TO NAME ALL HIS MINISTERS, THAT FREE PRESS AND SPEECH WILL BE REINSTATED IMMEDIATELY UPON HIS ASSUMPTION OF OFFICE, THAT MARTIAL LAW WILL BE PHASED OUT GRADUALLY, AND THAT THE ANNOUNCEMENT OF HIS APPOINTMENT WILL BE ACCOMPANIED BY A STATEMENT FROM THE SHAH EMPHASIZING IMPERIAL ACCEPTANCE OF A CONSTITUTIONAL POSITION WHEREBY HE WOULD REIGN AND NOT RULE.

AT SOME POINT THEREAFTER, BAKHTIAR REPORTED THAT THE SHAH WOULD TAKE AN EXTENDED VACATION (AMBASSADOR'S TALKS WITH SHAH HAVE REVEALED NO SUCH INTENTION). IT IS NOT CLEAR TO WHAT EXTENT BAKHTIAR ENJOYS SUPPORT OF OPPOSITION ELEMENTS. HE CLAIMS TO HAVE WORKED OUT SUPPORT OF SHARIATMADARI THROUGH AN INTERMEDIARY AND WILL BE CALLING ON BAZARGAN TO ATTEMPT TO ARRANGE HIS SUPPORT AFTERNOON OF DECEMBER 30. BAZAARI TOLD EMBOFF DECEMBER 30 THAT BAZAARIS ARE NOT OF ONE MIND ON POSSIBILITY OF A BAKHTIAR PRIME MINISTRY, WHICH IS SOMEWHAT ENCOURAGING, SINCE BAZAARIS WERE TOTALLY OPPOSED TO SADIQI'S CANDIDACY.

BAZARGAN PARTY SOURCE HAS INDICATED TO EMBOFF THAT HIS MOVEMENT FEARS THE INSTALLATION OF A HARSHER MILITARY GOVERNMENT HEADED BY HARD-LINE OFFICERS AND MAY THEREFORE BE WILLING TO SUPPORT BAKHTIAR AS THE BEST OF A SERIES OF BAD ALTERNATIVES. HOWEVER, BAZARGAN'S LONG-TIME BUSINESS PARTNER, DR. HOSSAIN MIRBABA'I,EXPRESSED DOUBT TO EMBOFF THAT BAZARGAN WILL SUPPORT BAKHTIAR AND KHOMEINI'S POSITION IN ALL THIS IS NOT KNOWN.

IRANIAN OIL PRODUCTION WILL REACH ONLY 231,000 BARRELS TODAY. OSCO EMPLOYEES IN AHWAZ HAVE BEEN SUBJECT TO FURTHER THREATS, SOME EXPATRIATES' CARS HAVE BEEN BURNED AND, AS A CONSEQUENCE OF SECURITY SITUATION AS WELL AS LACK OF WORK DUE TO STRIKES OF IRANIAN EMPLOYEES, OSCO WORKERS AND DEPENDENTS, AS WELL AS THOSE OF IPAC, DOWELLSCHLUMBERGER (DOW), READING & BATES, SEDCO, SANTA FE, AND OTHER SMALL DRILLING CONTRACTORS ARE LEAVING IRAN ON A SERIES OF CHARTER FLIGHTS BEGINNING DECEMBER 30 AND SCHEDULED TO CONTINUE THROUGH JANUARY 2. OSCO EMPLOYEES IN TEHRAN, WITH ONE EXCEPTION, ARE ALSO LEAVING.

AS A RESULT OF GASOLINE SHORTAGE, AS WELL AS KHOMEINI'S DECLARED "DAY OF MOURNING", TRAFFIC IN TEHRAN IS LIGHT. LONG LINES OF OPTIMISTIC CUSTOMERS WAIT OUTSIDE OPEN FILLING STATIONS AND KEROSENE MERCHANTS (FREQUENTLY IN VAIN) AND THE VARIOUS SHORTAGES ARE A MAJOR TOPIC OF CONVERSATION. UNSEASONABLY WARM WEATHER HAS SPARED TEHRAN THE WORST EFFECTS OF THESE SHORTAGES, BUT WHEN WINTER FINALLY COMES CONDITIONS WILL BE VERY SERIOUS.

(MEANWHILE, BAKHTIAR HAS SENT A REPRESENTATIVE TO AHWAZ TO INVESTIGATE AND MAKE RECOMMENDATIONS.)
AMCONSUL SHIRAZ REPORTS NUMEROUS DEMONSTRATIONS ACCOMPANIED BY FIRING FROM SECURITY FORCES BUT NO ACTIVITY APART FROM WHAT IS RAPIDLY BECOMING THE NORM IN MAJOR IRANIAN CITIES.

AMCONSUL TABRIZ, WHICH HAD EARLIER REPORTED VERY LARGE DEMONSTRATIONS AND FREQUENT SMALLER ONES, REPORTEDLY CAME UNDER ATTACK AT ABOUT 1:30 P.M. TROOPS RETREATED TO SURROUND MAIN CONSULATE BUILDING AND FIRED OVER HEADS OF DEMONSTRATORS WHO ENTERED COMPOUND FROM MULTIPLE DIRECTIONS. CONSUL METRINKO SAYS REINFORCEMENTS ARRIVED AND SITUATION STABILIZED BY 14:30 WITH DEMONSTRATORS BEING CHASED OUT OF COMPOUND.

TURKISH EMBOFF REPORTED 14:30 THAT TURKISH CONGEN ALSO CAME UNDER ATTACK AND MOB ENTERED BUILDING. CONGEN WAS PLANNING TO LEAVE THE BUILDING, THOUGH HE REPORTED "HEAVY FIGHTING" ON THE STREET. AT 15:30 TURKS REPORTED CONGEN HAD BEEN BURNED AND ONE SOLDIER SHOT BY THE CROWD. SULLIVAN

PREVIOUS REPORTS HAD SOME INACCURACIES. FOLLOWING IS COURSE OF EVENTS DURING DAY. LARGE MOB (PROBABLY SEVERAL THOUSAND OF MIXED AGE GROUPS) APPROACHED CONSULATE FROM FOUR SIDES ABOUT 1330. FRONT GATES WERE SMASHED OPEN AND SOME DEMONSTRATORS MADE LIMITED ENTRY INTO COMPOUND. ON OTHER SIDES THEY CLIMBED ON TOP OF WALL WITH APPARENT ATTEMPT TO ENTER COMPOUND. THEYE REPELLED BY SHOOTING OVER THEIR HEADS BY SECURITY FORCE WHICH FOR SEVERAL DAYS HAS BEEN BASED INSIDE THE COMPOUND. SECURITY FORCE CIRCLED CONSULATE BUILDING, CONTINUED FIRE OHEADS OF DEMONSTRATORS OR INTO THE WALLS, AND USED CONSULATE TEAR GAS SUPPLY. CROWD DID NOT RUSH BUILDING.

DURINGATTACK MOB THREW CONTAINERS OF BURNING LIQUIDS OVER THE WALLS AND SET NUMBER OF BRUSH FIRES, NONE OF WHICH THREATENED THE CONSULATE OR RESIDENCE. METRINKO CONFIRMS THERE WERE NO INJURIES. ONLY STRUCTURAL DAMAGE WAS TO FRONT GATES, DESTRUCTION OF CONSULATE LETTERED SIGN, AND DOOR TO GUARD HOUSE.
REINFORCEMENTS CAME QUICKLY AND DISPERSED CROWD. CONSULATE HAS 30-40 TROOPS IN CONSULATE AT THIS TIME.
GOVERNMENT COOPERATIVE SHOP ACROSS STREET FROM CONSULATE WAS GUTTED BY FIRE.
PLEASE CALL METRINKO'S FATHER AND MOTHER (717-4893392) AND ASSURE THEM HE IS SAFE AND WELL. IF THEY CANNOT BE REACHED CALL GREGORY METRINKO, PERTHSHIRE PATH, GLEN BURNIE, MD. SULLIVAN

PER INSTRUCTIONS FROM DEPARMENT OF STATE (COORDINATED WITH DOD) WE INTEND TOMORROW (DEC 31) TO RECOMMEND TO REMAINING DEPENDENTS OF OFFICIAL AND PRIVATE COMPANY PERSONNEL TO RELOCATE TEMPORARILY AT SAFEHAVEN POSTS OR CONUS. WE WILL EMPHASIZE TO NON-OFFICIAL COMMUNITY THAT THIS IS OUR ADVICE TO DEPENDENTS-NOT AN EVACUATION OF ALL PERSONNEL--AND THAT WE EXPECT (EXCEPT AS NOTED BELOW) REGULAR AIRLINE FLIGHTS, PLUS CHARTERS ARRANGED BY COMPANIES, TO BE USED IN ORDERLY AND PHASED FASHION.
AMBASSADOR WILL INFORM FOREIGN MINISTER AND MINISTRY OF COURT OF OUR DECISION EARLY ON DEC 31 AND WILL MEET WITH BUSINESS COMMUNITY REPRESENTATIVES IN LATE AFTERNOON TO PASS SAME ADVICE.

DEPARTMENT OF STATE SHOULD INFORM PAN AM OF THIS DECISION TO HAVE EXTRA FLIGHTS AVAILABLE FOR JANUARY 1 AND SUBSEQUENT DAYS. UNTIL WE MEET WITH BUSINESS COMMUNITY WE WILL NOT HAVE SOLID IDEA OF TOTAL NUMBERS OF AMCITS WANTING TO DEPART BUT ASSUME THAT AMCITS AND OTHERS WILL PROVIDE FULL PASSENGER LOAD FOR PLANES IN FIRST FEW DAYS.

ARMISH/MAAG CHIEF BELIEVES THAT USE OF MAC AIRCRAFT FOR DOD PERSONNEL WOULD BE USEFUL TO RELIEVE PRESSURE ON CIVILIAN AIRLINES. HE WILL BE IN COMMUNICATION WITH USCINCEUR TO ARRANGE SCHEDULE WHICH WILL NOT GIVE IMPRESSION THAT SPECIAL TREATMENT BEING AFFORDED DOD DEPENDENTS.

AMBASSADOR MET WITH AMBASSADORS OF EC PLUS CANADA THIS EVENING AND INFORMED THEM OF OUR DECISION. GROUP WAS NOT RPT NOT IN UNANIMOUS AGREEMENT WITH OUR POSITION. CANADIANS, WHO OBVIOUSLY HAVE BEEN IN CONTACT WITH WASHINGTON THINKING, WERE SUPPORTIVE. FRENCH, AND GERMANS PROFESSED GREAT CONSTERNATION AND FEARED PANIC WOULD HIT FOREIGN COMMUNITY; THEY SAID THEY PREFERRED TO HANG TOUGH AND CONTINUE BUSINESS AS USUAL TO EXTENT POSSIBLE. DANES AND DUTCH WERE RELIEVED AND WILL TAKE SAME DECISION TOMORROW RE THEIR DEPENDENTS. UK WAS EQUABLE, AND BRITISH AMBASSADOR LATER INFORMED US HE WOULD CONFORM.

AMBASSADOR EMPHASIZED REPEATEDLY FOLLOWING POINTS: RECOMMENDATION TO LEAVE WAS TO DEPENDENTS ONLY; WE WANT EMPLOYEES TO REMAIN AND WORK; WE EXPECT TO USE REGULAR AIRLINE FLIGHTS PLUS EXTRA SECTIONS AND CHARTERS BY THE PRIVATE COMPANIES; DEPARTURES SHOULD BE PHASED ORDERLY OVER NEXT WEEK; EACH COUNTRY WITH A NATIONAL AIRLINE WITH CONNECTION TO TEHRAN SHOULD ARRANGE ADDITIONAL FLIGHTS; IN VIEW OF SEVERE GASOLINE SHORTAGE PEOPLE SHOULD BE ADVISED TO RETAIN ENOUGH GASOLINE TO MOVE DEPENDENTS TO AIRPORT AND RETURN TO CITY. AMBASSADOR ALSO STRESSED THAT OUR DESIRE TO LESSEN BURDEN ON IRANIAN COMMUNITY BECUASE OF SEVERE SHORTAGES OF GAS,GASOLINE AND HEATING OIL WAS IMPORTANT FACTOR IN OUR DECISION.
IN VIEW OF THESE CONSULTATIONS WE INTEND TO MOVE AHEAD DEC 31 PER PARA ONE ABOVE.

RADIO IRAN HAS MADE CLEAR THAT FUEL SHORTAGES WILL MAKE IT DIFFICULT FOR AREA MILLS TO PRODUCE ENOUGH FLOUR TO PROVIDE BREAD FOR TEHRAN AND THAT THE PROBLEM WILL BE COMPOUNDED BY THE LACK OF FUEL TO OPERATE BAKERIES AND TO TRANSPORT SUCH FLOUR AS IS MILLED FROM THE MILLS TO THE BAKERIES. EMBASSY ESTIMATES SUGGEST THAT SUFFICIENT FUEL IS STILL REACHING TEHRAN VIA PIPELINE FROM THE ABADAN REFINERY TO RUN ESSENTIAL SERVICES SUCH AS HOSPITALS, BAKERIES, FOOD TRANSPORT, ETC. HOWEVER, PROPER USE OF THESE LIMITED FUEL RESOURCES WOULD REQUIRE A RATIONAL PROCESS OF ALLOCATION.
WE ARE UNABLE TO DETERMINE WHAT PROCESS OF ALLOCATION IS PRESENTLY USED BUT TO SAY THAT THE GOI IS, IN PRESENT CIRCUMSTANCES, DISORGANIZED WOULD BE VERY GENEROUS.

PROBABLY REACTING TO THE RADIO ANNOUNCEMENT, LINES AT TEHRAN BAKERIES HAVE BEEN SOMEWHAT LONGER, BUT NOT EXCESSIVELY SO. HOWEVER, IF REAL BREAD SHORTAGE DEVELOPS, AND THIS IS QUITE POSSIBLE, NATIONAL FRONT AND OTHER OPPOSITION ELEMENTS ARE LIKELY TO SEIZE UPON THE ISSUE AS ANOTHER INSTANCE OF GOVERNMENT MISUSE OF RESOURCES TO PRESSURE THE PEOPLE TO REDUCE THEIR OPPOSITION.

COMMENT: WE HAVE NO INDICATION THAT THIS IS IN FACT THE GOI INTENT, AND IN ANY CASE WE DOUBT THAT A BREAD SHORTAGE WOULD REDUCE THE IRE OF THE PEOPLE OR DIRECT IT AWAY FROM THE GOVERNMENT IN ANY SIGNIFICANT DEGREE. TO DATE THE COMMON FOLK HAVE SEEMED WILLING TO CONTINUE TO ENDURE SHORTAGES AND INCONVENIENCE FOR THE SAKE OF THEIR OPPOSITION TO THE SHAH AND WE SEE NO REASON TO BELIEVE THAT THIS VIEW WILL NOT CONTINUE. IN 1912 THE PEOPLE OF TEHRAN RIOTED AND THE GOVERNMENT FELL OVER A SHORTAGE OF BREAD.
HOWEVER, UNDER PREVAILING CONDITIONS, A DEMONSTRATION CAUSED BY A BREAD SHORTAGE WOULD BE RATHER DIFFICULT TO DISTINGUISH FROM THOSE WHICH ALREADY PLAGUE THE CAPITAL ON A DAILY BASIS. SULLIVAN
AS REQUESTED REFTEL, I HAVE EXCHANGED VIEWS WITH BRITISH, FRENCH, GERMAN AND JAPANESE COLLEAGUES. SAUDI IS NOT CURRENTLY IN TEHRAN.

YOU ALREADY HAVE BRITISH AMBASSADOR'S VIEWS FROM UK FONOFF VIA LUCAS. THE ONLY ADDITION I WOULD MAKE TO THAT REPORT WAS PARSONS' COMMENT EVENING DECEMBER 30 THAT IT LOOKED AS THOUGH SHAH'S "VACATION" WAS IMMINENT AND WOULD LAST A LONG TIME.

FRENCH POSITION IS AND HAS BEEN FOR SOME TIME THAT "SHAH IS FINISHED." THEY BELIEVE THE SOONER HE LEAVES, THE BETTER. WHILE THEY FEEL IT WOULD BE BEST FOR HIM TO NAME A REGENCY COUNCIL AND DEPART IN SOME DEGREE OF ORDER, THEY THINK THAT ASPECT IS NOT SERIOUSLY RELEVANT.

GERMAN AMBASSADOR SEEMS SOMEWHAT MORE OPTIMISTIC. HE FEELS IT IS POSSIBLE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT MIGHT SUCCEED IF SHAH TEMPORARILY WITHDRAWS AND NAMES REGENCY COUNCIL. HE THINKS IT IS EVEN POSSIBLE SHAH MIGHT BE ABLE AT A LATER DATE TO RETURN AS A CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCH.

MY JAPANESE COLLEAGUE HAS JUST ARRIVED AND PRESENTED HIS CREDENTIALS DECEMBER 26. HE AND I HAVE CONSULTED TWICE, BUT HE HAS BEEN UNDERSTANDABLY RELUCTANT TO EXPRESS ANY DEFINITIVE VIEWS ON BASIS SUCH SHORT EXPOSURE TO THIS CONFUSING SCENE.

COMMON VIEW AMONG ALL COLLEAGUES IS THAT LAW AND ORDER SITUATION IS OUT OF EVERYONE'S CONTROL AND THAT PRIMITIVE VANDALISM IS ON THE RISE THROUGHOUT COUNTRY, WITH VERY HEAVY OVERTONES OF XENOPHOBIA. THERE IS THEREFORE GENERAL CONSENSUS THAT SITUATION IS FAST APPROACHING ANARCHY.

ON MORNING DECEMBER 31, AFTER I RECEIVED REPORT OF CONVERSATION WITH BAKHTIAR CONTAINED REFTEL, I TELEPHONED ARDESHIR ZAHEDI TO GET HIS UNDERSTANDING OF THE SITUATION. ZAHEDI HAD TAKEN PUBLIC ISSUE DECEMBER 30 WITH STATEMENTS BAKHTIAR HAD MADE TO PRESS ABOUT SHAH'S WILLINGNESS TO LEAVE COUNTRY TEMPORARILY AND FORM A REGENCY COUNCIL.

FROM ZAHEDI'S RATHER RAMBLING REPLY, I GATHERED THAT HE IS ENGAGED IN TUG OF WAR WITH BAKHTIAR AND OTHERS OVER ISSUE OF SHAH'S DEPARTURE. HE ADMITTED SHAH HAD "LOST HIS COURAGE" AND AGREED TO DEPART, BUT THAT HE, ZAHEDI, HAD "PICKED HIM UP AGAIN."

ZAHEDI EXPRESSED OPTIMISM THAT BAKHTIAR WOULD BE ABLE TO FORM GOVERNMENT,BUT WAS SHARPLY CRITICAL OF "SABOTAGE EFFORTS BY SANJABI AND OTHERS." HE DOUBTED BAKHTIAR COULD MEET RATHER OPTIMISTIC TIME SCHEDULE CONTAINED REFTEL, BUT THOUGHT HE MIGHT HAVE A CABINET IN FOUR OR FIVE DAYS.

HE SAID EMISSARIES WERE BEING SENT TO QOM FOR TALKS WITH SHARIAT-MADARI AND ALSO TO TALEGANI HERE IN TEHRAN "WHO IS KHOMEINI'S MAN." THEY WERE BEING ASKED TO GIVE BAKHTIAR A CHANCE. (HE DID NOT SPECIFY WHO HAD SENT THE EMISSARIES OR WHO THEY WERE.)

WHEN I STRESSED IMPORTANCE OF GETTING OIL PRODUCTION UP TO LEVELS NEEDED TO PREVENT FURTHER HARDSHIPS ON CIVIL POPULATION, ZAHEDI SAID HE FELT NIOC WOULD BE ABLE TO DO THAT IN NEXT DAY OR SO, BUT ONLY THROUGH CONCESSIONS TO KHOMEINI DEMAND THAT NO OIL BE EXPORTED. HE SAID HE DID NOT AGREE WITH THIS TACTIC AND WOULD HAVE PREFERRED USE OF FORCE TO GET ENTIRE PRODUCTION GOING AGAIN, WITH FULL EXPORT LEVELS.

COMMENT: IT APPEARS FROM HIS COMMENTS THAT ZAHEDI IS STILL PLAYING THE ROLE OF HAWK AT THE IMPERIAL COURT. HOWEVER, ALL OTHER SOUNDINGS INDICATE THAT THERE ARE VERY FEW OTHERS OF THIS SPECIES IN DIRECT CONTACT WITH THE

1978TEHRAN12790.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT, DEC 31 SUMMARY: CONTINUED DEMONSTRATIONS IN MANY CITIES. MUCH DISORDER FOCUSED AT EXPATRIATES. STRIKES PARALYZE

segments.text: SUMMARY: CONTINUED DEMONSTRATIONS IN MANY CITIES. MUCH DISORDER FOCUSED AT EXPATRIATES. STRIKES PARALYZE COUNTRY. EMBASSY RECOMMENDING DEPATURE OF DEPENDENTS. POLITICAL MANEUVERS REVOLVE AROUND POSSIBLE BAKHTIAR GOVT. END SUMMARY

YESTERDAY CONTINUED IRAN'S SLIDE INTO ANARCHY. SAME STUDENT-AGE GANGS ROAMED STREETS -- BUILDING BONFIRES, BURNING CARS, AND FURTHER PARALYZING AN ALREADY STRAIGHTJACKETED CAPITAL. GANGS HAVE ALSO BEGUN SMASHING THEIR WAY INTO SHOPS AND SIMPLY TAKING WHAT THEY WANT; THIS HAPPENED EXTENSIVELY YESTERDAY IN TEHRAN PARS AREA. MOTORISTS WHO COULD FIND GASOLINE HAD TO RUN GAUNTLET OF FIRES AND BULLYING CROWDS TO REACH THEIR DESTINATIONS. TROOPS FIRED INTO THE AIR WITH USUAL INEFFECTIVE RESULT.

DEMONSTRATIONS HIT NEARLY EVERY PROVINCIAL TOWN AS WELL, ALTHOUGH NOT ALL HAD TEHRAN-STYLE ROVING GANGS. IN MASHAD, PROBABLY WORST-HIT OF PROVINCIAL CITIES, MOBS REPORTEDLY DAMAGED IRAN AMERICA SOCIETY BUILDING AND TWO POLICE PRECINCT STATIONS. SOME PRESS SOURCES CLAIM AS MANY AS 41 KILLED IN MASHAD. IN MANY OTHER TOWNS MOBS DESTROYED BUILDINGS AND AUTOMOBILES. WE HAVE REPORTS OF HEAVY CASUALTIES IN AHWAZ.
STRIKES AND SHORTAGES CONTINUE. SMALL AMOUNTS OF HEATING OIL WERE GOING FOR 5 TIMES REGULAR PRICE, BUT MANY FOUND IT UNOBTAINABLE AT ANY PRICE.

MORE AMERICANS HAVE FOUND OPPOSITION ANGER DIRECTED AT THEM. ONE EMBASSY OFFICER HAD TO TAKE EMERGENCY ACTION WHEN MOB TRAPPED HIS CAR AT INTERSECTION OF SALTANATABAD AND DOWLAT. HE SUCCEEDED IN ESCAPING. ANOTHER EMBOFF BARELY AVOIDED SIMILAR EXPERIENCE NEAR FUNCTION OF FARMANIEH AND NIAVARAN. THESE TWO INTERSECTIONS ARE IN THE HEART OF NORTH TEHRAN RESIDENTIAL AREA HEAVILY POPULATED BY AMERICANS. IF THEY CANNOT TRAVEL THERE IN SAFETY, THEY CANNOT DO SO ANYWHERE. BUSSES CARRYING WORKERS FROM DOWSHAN TAPPEH AIRBASE WERE STONED. EMBASSY TODAY MOVED TO PHASE I OF E/E PLAN, RECOMMENDING DEPARTURE OF DEPENDENTS.
ACTION WILL PROBABLY INCREASE RATE OF DEPARTURES EXCEPT IN PERSIAN GULF REGION, WHICH IS ALREADY AT FLOOD TIDE.

POLITICAL MANEUVERS HINGE ON PROPOSED GOVT OF SHAPOUR BAKHTIAR WHICH IS NOT YET CONSTITUTED BUT IS OPENLY DISCUSSED. NIRT TODAY ANNOUNCED THAT BAKHTIAR WOULD SOON ORGANIZE A CABINET AND TAKE IT TO PARLIAMENT FOR APPROVAL. GOVT RADIO ALSO ANNOUNCED SHAH WOULD LEAVE IRAN (NOT SAYING WHEN) FOR AN EXTENDED PERIOD OF MEDICAL TREATMENT. NOW ALL WILL WATCH TO SEE WHETHER BAKHTIAR, WHOM HIS RIVAL SANJABI HAS ALREADY READ OUT OF THE NATIONAL FRONT, CAN IN FACT FORM A VIABLE GOVT, OR WHETHER HE WILL GO THE WAY OF SADIQI. PARLIAMENT WILL HOLD SEPARATE CLOSED SESSIONS AT A DATE TO BE ANNOUNCED LATER.
MEANWHILE THE NEXT FEW DAYS WILL SHOW WHETHER BAKHTIAR'S CAMPAIGN WILL LEAD TO COALITION GOVT.
THIS MORNING'S ANNOUNCEMENT HAS NOT APPRECIABLY CHANGED PATTERN OF FAST-MOVING MOBS. AGAIN THERE IS GUNFIRE AROUND CITY AND CARS SET ABLAZE.
