WE APPRECIATE DIFFICULTIES WHICH WASHINGTON EXPERIENCES IN ATTEMPTING TO MAKE INDEPENDENT JUDGMENT ABOUT PROSPECTS FOR FORMING A CIVILIAN GOVERNMENT WITHOUT HAVING VIEWS OF ALL KEY ACTORS INVOLVED. REFTEL BEARS SOME SIGNS THAT IT WAS DRAFTED PRIOR TO THE FAILURE OF THE SADIQI INITIATIVE AND THEREFORE PRIOR TO OUR CABLES REPORTING ON DISCUSSIONS WITH BAKHTIAR.

NEVERTHELESS, WE ARE MOVING TO UNDERTAKE DIRECT CONTACTS WITH THE VARIOUS INDIVIDUALS MENTIONED IN REFTEL AND WITH OTHERS WHOM WE CONSIDER IMPORTANT TO THE PROCESS CURRENTLY IN MOTION. I HAVE SENTWORD TO THE SHAH THROUGH ZAHEDI ON WHAT WE ARE DOING AND WHY.

IN THIS CONNECTION, THE SUGGESTION THAT WE MEET DIRECTLY WITH SANJABI AT THIS TIME IS SOMEWHAT RISKY. IF WE WERE KNOWN TO BE CONSULTING WITH SANJABI IMMEDIATELY AFTER LATTER'S ATTACK ON BAKHTIAR, THIS COULD BE INTERPRETED AS AN ACTION ON OUR PART WHICH COULD UNDERMINE BAKHTIAR. WE WILL THEREFORE TRIANGULATE ON SANJABI INITIALLY THROUGH TWO OF HIS CLOSE ASSOCIATES WITH WHOM WE ARE IN TOUCH. (I FEEL SANJABI WOULD PROBABLY TELL THE PRESS IF WE SAW HIM. THEREFORE, I HAVE TOLD ZAHEDI WE HAD BEEN ASKED TO SEE SANJABI BUT WILL DEFER ACTION FOR FOREGOING REASON.)

THE MOST IMPORTANT PERSPECTIVE WHICH WE LACK IS THAT FROM THE MODERATE AYATOLLAHS, PARTICULARLY THOSE AT QOM. WE HAVE MET WITH SOME OF THE AYATOLLAHS IN OTHER CITIES AND HAVE REPORTED THOSE CONTACTS, BUT HAVE UNTIL NOW REFRAINED FROM DISCUSSIONS IN QOM, EVEN THOUGH SHARIATMADARI HAS INDICATED WILLINGNESS TO MEET.

THE DELICATE PROBLEM IS THAT, AT THIS JUNCTURE, A MEETING WITH SHARIAT-MADARI COULD ONLY BE PERCEIVED AS AN "INTERVENTION" OF THE TYPE REFTEL ASKS US TO AVOID. WE SHALL THEREFORE KEEP THIS OPTION ON THE BACK BURNER FOR AWHILE AND REVIEW WHEN IT MIGHT BE PROPITIOUS TO

1978TEHRAN12794.subject: MINATCHI VIEWS ON BAKHTIAR EFFORT TO FORM GOVT SUMMARY: MINATCHI BELIEVES BAKHTIAR WILL SUCCEED IN FORM- ING GOVT BECAUSE MODERATE RELIGIOUS LEADERS WILL N

segments.text: SUMMARY: MINATCHI BELIEVES BAKHTIAR WILL SUCCEED IN FORMING GOVT BECAUSE MODERATE RELIGIOUS LEADERS WILL NOT OPPOSE HIM AND SOME WILL WORK TO HELP. SANJABI OUTBURST AGAINST BAKHTIAR SEEN AS UNFORTUNATE, BUT IRRELEVANT. BAZARGAN WILL NOT OPPOSE BAKHTIAR, BUT WILL PROBABLY REFRAIN FROM FINAL COMMITMENT UNTIL HE RETURNS FROM SOUTH, WHERE HIS INITIATIVE TO END OIL STRIKE IS PROGRESSING WELL. AYATOLLAH SHARIAT-MADARI CONSIDERING PUBLIC CALL OPPOSING VIOLENCE AGAINST FOREIGNERS. SHAHAB FERDOWZ EXPECTED TO BE BAKHTIAR'S JUSTICE MINISTER. END SUMMARY

EMBOFF STEMPEL REVIEWED PRESENT POLITICAL DEVELOPMENTS WITH DR. MINATCHI AT HIS HOSSEINIYEH ERSHAD (RELIGIOUS SCHOOL) OFFICE AFTERNOON DEC 31. MINATCHI THOUGHT BAKHTIAR WOULD SURELY SUCCEED IN FORMING NEW GOVT, SINCE MODERATE CLERGY FAVORED HIS EFFORTS ENOUGH TO REFRAIN FROM OPPOSING HIM. DR. KARIM SANJABI'S BLAST AT BAKHTIAR EVENING DEC 30 WAS UNFORTUNATE, BUT WOULD NOT MATTER IN FACE OF RELIGIOUS LEADERS' TACIT SUPPORT FOR BAKHTIAR.

ENGINEER MEHDI BAZARGAN, LIBERATION MOVEMENT (LMI) LEADER WILL ALSO ACQUIESCE IN BAKHTIAR TO EXTENT OF NOT OPPOSING HIM, ACCORDING TO MINATCHI, BUT WILL PROBABLY NOT MAKE HIS FINAL POSITION KNOWN UNTIL HE RETURNS FROM AHWAZ IN TWO OR THREE DAYS. MINATCHI SAID BAZARGAN HAD RECEIVED LETTERS FROM BOTH KHOMEINI AND SHARIAT-MADARI NAMING HIM PERSONALLY TO HEAD MISSION TO OIL FIELDS. OTHER MEMBERS OF FIVE-MAN COMMITTEE ARE AYATOLLAH HASHEMI RAFSANJANI, ENG. KATIRAHE (PHONETIC), ENG. HASIBI, AND ENG. SABAQIAN.

SIGNIFICANCE OF BAZARGAN BEING NAMED PERSONALLY IS THAT THIS GIVES HIM ECCLESIASTICAL NOD WHEN HE WANTS TO FORM GOVT -- PRESUMABLY, SAID MINATCHI, THE ONE WHICH WILL EVENTUALLY SUCCEED BAKHTIAR AFTER NEXT SPRING'S ELECTIONS. MINATCHI ADDED THAT ARDESHIR ZAHEDI HAD REPORTEDLY OFFERED TO SELL A BAZARGAN-LED CABINET TO THE SHAH, BUT THIS WOULD PRESUMABLY OCCUR ONLY IF BAKHTIAR'S INITIATIVE DID NOT WORK OUT AND RELIGIOUS LEADERS DID NOT QUITE TRUST ZAHEDI.

MINATCHI SAID COMMITTEE FOR THE DEFENSE OF HUMAN RIGHTS AND FREEDOM (CDHRF) WOULD BE MEETING AT 4 P.M. DEC 31 AND WOULD ALMOST CERTAINLY PUT WEIGHT OF ITS VARIOUS GROUPS BEHIND BAKHTIAR INITIATIVE. MINATCHI WOULD CALL SHARIATMADARI WHEN RESULTS OF THIS MEETING ARE KNOWN, AND VISIT HIM IN QOM ON JAN 3 FOR FINAL CEMENTING OF MODERATE SUPPORT OF BAKHTIAR CABINET. IN RESPONSE TO EMBOFF'S QUESTION WHETHER CONDITIONS IN STREETS WOULD ALLOW THAT MUCH DELAY, MINATCHI SAID CONDITIONS WERE MUCH BETTER DEC 31 SINCE IT BECAME KNOWN THAT SHAH WAS READY TO LEAVE (COMMENT: IF SO, IMPROVEMENT WAS VERY MARGINAL).

IN ANY EVENT, SHARIAT-MADARI WAS CONTEMPLATING ISSUANCE OF AN ELAMIEH (ANNOUNCEMENT) CALLING ON THE RELIGIOUS FAITHFUL NOT TO ATTACK FOREIGN "BROTHERS AND SISTERS" AND PRAISING STEPS TAKEN TOWARDS A POLITICAL SOLUTION WHICH WOULD AVOID BLOODSHED. IN REPLY TO QUESTION, EMBOFF AGREED THIS WOULD BE A VERY USEFUL WAY TO PERHAPS DEFUSE SOME OF THE ANTI-FOREIGN FEELING WHICH HAD BEEN GROWING IN RECENT DAYS.

COMMENT: THOUGH GENERALLY AN OPTIMIST, MINATCHI WAS ABLE TO TICK OFF SEVERAL SOLID REASONS FOR HIS BELIEF BAKHTIAR WOULD SUCCEED, AND HIS OWN ATTITUDE MADE IT CLEAR THAT HE VERY MUCH WANTED BAKHTIAR TO FORM GOVT AND THAT MANY OTHER MODERATE OPPOSITIONISTS WERE WILLING TO GRACEFULLY ACQUIESCE IN BAKHTIAR EFFORT FOR SAKE OF COUNTRY. IF SHARIAT-MADARI AND BAZARGAN POSITIONS COME CLOSE TO WHAT MINATCHI SAYS THEY ARE, THIS WOULD IMPROVE BAKHTIAR'S CHANCES. MINATCHI SAID HE HOPES TO LEARN OF CABINET NAMES LATER, BUT KNEW THAT JUSTICE MINISTERDESIGNATE IS SHAHAB FERDOWZ, FORMER JUDGE AND A LEADING

IN THE COURSE OF AN OCTOBER 22 MEETING MAINLY ON OTHER SUBJECTS, MFA DIRECTOR GENERAL CIECHANOVER DISCUSSED WITH ASSISTANT SECRETARY SAUNDERS ASSESSMENTS OF THE SITUATION IN IRAN. CIECHANOVER EXPLAINED THAT THE GOI FEELS THAT "THE SHAH IS IN BAD SHAPE." THE STRIKES ARE NOT CALMING DOWN AND THE SHAH HIMSELF IS IN A "HYSTERICAL" MOOD. IN CIECHANOVER'S OPINION, THE SHAH IS LOOKING FOR ENCOURAGEMENT FROM THE U.S. CIECHANOVER EXPLAINED THAT HE WANTED TO DRAW U.S. ATTENTION TO THIS SITUATION.

SAUNDERS GENERALLY AGREED WITH THE ISRAELI ASSESSMENT. HE NOTED THAT UP TO THREE WEEKS AGO THE U.S. HAD FELT THAT THE SHAH WAS GETTING A GRIP ON THINGS, ESPECIALLY THE STRIKES. BUT THE U.S. IS DISTURBED. WHILE THE SITUATION IS NOT BEYOND REPAIR, THE SHAH WILL HAVE TO WORK HARD TO PRODUCE THE LIBERALIZED REGIME HE HAS SET HIS SIGHTS ON. CIECHANOVER ASKED WHETHER THE SHAH COULD BRING THIS OFF. SAUNDERS STATED THAT IT IS A TOSS-UP. HE GAVE MUCH HIGHER ODDS, HOWEVER, TO THE SHAH'S SURVIVABILITY. SAUNDERS NOTED THAT THE U.S. DOES NOT SEE THE SHAH'S REGIME AS ABOUT TO TOPPLE.

CIECHANOVER REITERATED THAT IN THE ISRAELI VIEW THE SHAH IS IN A BAD POSITION. THE STRIKES ARE CONTINUING AND TOUCHING ALL ASPECTS OF LIFE. DISCUSSION CLOSED ON SAUNDERS' COMMENT THAT U.S. APPRAISAL WAS SOMEWHAT MORE UPBEAT THAN THIS.
THIS MESSAGE NOT CLEARED BY ASSISTANT SECRETARY SAUNDERS PRIOR TO HIS DEPARTURE. LEWIS

1978TOKYO13396.subject: PLANNED MIDDLE EAST VISIT BY PRIME MINISTER FUKUDA

segments.text: REFTEL A REPORTED THAT PRIME MINISTER FUKUDA TOLD JUNE PRESS CONFERENCE THAT HE WAS PLANNING VISIT TO EGYPT, IRAN AND SAUDI ARABIA IN SEPTEMBER. VISIT IS NOW SCHEDULED TO BEGIN SEPTEMBER 5. WE WILL REPORT FURTHER AS DETAILS

SANANDAJI'S TOUR IN TUNIS WAS RATHER BRIEF: JULY 1976 TO EARLY JANUARY 1978. HE CAME HERE HAPPILY FROM A MISERABLE TOUR IN WARSAW AND LEFT HERE UNHAPPILY AFTER COMING TO DISLIKE TUNISIA TOO, SOMETHING ALMOST ANYONE ELSE WOULD FIND HARD TO DO. HE LIVED UP TO HIS ADVANCE BILLING AS A MAN OF STRONG PREJUDICES.

HE IS A TALL, ARISTOCRATIC MAN, ALMOST NORDIC IN APPEARANCE, WHO DOES NOT KNOW YOU LONG BEFORE HE TELLS YOU HE IS A KURD AND NOT JUST AN ORDINARY IRANIAN. HE IS, HOWEVER, THOROUGHLY STEEPED IN THE IRANIAN CLASSICS, LITERATURE, LANGUAGE AND FOLKLORE, THE FREQUENT SUBJECT OF LONG (USUALLY BORING) DISQUISITIONS. AS THE RECORD INDICATES HE COMES TO DISLIKE ALL FOREIGN PEOPLES AMONG WHOM HE HAS BEEN POSTED, TENDING TO EMPHASIZE THEIR WORST TRAITS AND THE INVARIABLY ABOMINABLE CLIMATE.

HE AND HIS RATHER SICKLY WIFE FOUND TUNISIA MUCH TOOHUMID (ALTHOUGH WE EXPERIENCED A PROTRACTED DROUBHT DURING THE ONE FULL WINTER HE LIVED HERE) AND THE ARABS CONSTANTLY IN ERROR ABOUT THEIR CULTURAL HERITAGE, SINCE EVERYTHING THEY HAVE IS TRACEABLE TO PERSIAN ORIGINS INCLUDING THEIR ART, POETRY, MUSIC AND ARCHITECTURE. TUNIS, I BELIEVE, WAS HIS ONLY THIRD-WORLD POST AND HE FOUND THE PEOPLE HERE RATHER PRIMITIVE AS WELL AS DEVIOUS AND DISHONEST.

WHEN ONE OF THE LEADING TUNISIAN PAPERS MENTIONED THE "ARAB GULF" INSTEAD OF THE "PERSIAN GULF" IT DUTIFULLY PRINTED A LONG, PEDANTIC, PATRONIZING LETTER HE WROTE TO THE EDITOR CALLING ON 5,000 YEARS OF HISTORYLTO DEFEND THE "PERSIAN GULF".

FORTUNATELY, HE LIKES THE UNITED STATES AND AMERICANS. HE REMEMBERS HAPPILY HIS STUDENT DAYS AT GEORGETOWN, HAS ONE SON TRAINED AS A DOCTOR IN THE U.S., AS WELL AS ONE DAUGHTER MARRIED TO A U.S.-TRAINED IRANIAN SURGEON. THE ENTIRE FAMILY SPEAKS ENGLISH FLUENTLY AND PREFER ENGLISH TO FRENCH WHICH THEY ALL ALSO SPEAK. HE HAS A FAIR AMOUNT OF CLASSICAL ARABIC. SANANDAJI SPEAKS ALL LANGUAGES POMPOUSLY. HE TRIES TO DOMINATE ALL CONVERSATIONS AND HAS A FIRM OPINION ON EVERY SUBJECT. MY ONW RELATIONS WITH HIM WERE GENERALLY GOOD AND WE WERE PERSONALLY FRIENDLY AS FAMILIES.

SANANDAJI LEFT US WITH THE IMPRESSION THAT HE HAD ASKED FOR AN EARLY END TO HIS TOUR IN TUNIS AND THAT, WHILE HE WOULD WELCOME RETIREMENT, HE WAS "AT HIS IMPERIAL MAJESTY'S DISPOSITION". HE SAID HIS CHIEF AIM IN RETURNING TO TEHRAN WAS TO HELP SET HIS SON AND SON-IN-LAW UP IN MEDICAL PRACTICE IN TEHRAN. THIS DONE HE WOULD WRITE SOME BOOKS HE HAS IN MIND AND POSSIBLY DO SOME LECTURING AT IRANIAN UNIVERSITIES. FOR THESE REASONS WE ARE SURPRISED TO SEE HE HAS STAYED IN DIPLOMACY.

1978USUNN01683.subject: NEW SWEDISH AMBASSADOR ACCREDITED TO IRAN

segments.text: KAJ INGEMAR SUNDBERG, RECENTLY APPOINTED SWEDISH AMBASSADOR TO IRAN, ARRIVED IN NEW YORK AS DEPUTY PERMANENT REPRESENTATIVE TO THE UNITED NATIONS IN 1970. FROM 1965 TO 1970, AMBASSADOR SUNDBERG SERVED IN THE MFA AS COUNSELLOR IN CHARGE OF UN AFFAIRS AND DISARMAMENT ISSUES. HE JOINED THE FOREIGN SERVICE IN 1948 AND WAS ASSIGNED TO THE EMBASSY IN HELSINKI (1949 TO 1951) AND AT THE CONSULATE IN BOMBAY (1952 TO 1954). UNTIL 1961 HE WAS ASSIGNED IN THE MFA POLITICAL SECTION. FROM 1961 TO 1964 HE WAS FIRST SECRETARY AND LATER COMMERCIAL COUNSELLOR AT THE EMBASSY IN WASHINGTON, D.C.

AMBASSADOR SUNDBERG IS PLEASANT, QUIET, AND PROFESSIONAL. HE SHOWS A GENUINE DESIRE TO COOPERATE WITH THE U.S. WHENEVER POSSIBLE, PROBABLY DUE IN PART TO THE LENGTH OF TIME HE HAS SPENT IN THE U.S. AND THE FACT THAT HE HAS AN AMERICAN WIFE. HE IS AN INTERESTING CONVERSATIONALIST ON A WIDE RANGE OF TOPICS AND ENTERTAINS GRACIOUSLY.

SUNDBERG IS NOT AN ASSERTIVE PERSON, AND SEVERAL OF HIS JUNIOR OFFICERS HAVE BEEN PRIVATELY CRITICAL OF HIS UNWILLINGNESS TO STAND AGAINST COUNTER-ARGUMENTS OR DEFEND THEM TO HIGHER AUTHORITY. IN OUR DEALINGS WITH HIM WE HAVE FOUND HIM TO BE WELL-INFORMED ON THE SUBJECTS HE HAS BEEN INSTRUCTED TO FOLLOW. HE HAS FAITHFULLY MAINTAINED A PRIVATE CONSULTATIVE CHANNEL WITH OUR POLITICAL OFFICERS, PARTICULARLY ON SOUTHERN AFRICA AND NONALIGNED AFFAIRS. HE REPORTEDLY HAS HAD RESPONSIBILITY FOR ORCHESTRATING SWEDISH SOUNDINGS AND DISCUSSIONS IN NEW YORK OF THE SO-CALLED SWEDISH PROPOSAL AGAINST NEW INVESTMENTS IN SOUTH AFRICA. 1978USUNN04426.subject: IRANIAN STUDENT MARCH AND DEMONSTRATIONS IN NEW YORK CITY

segments.text: NEW YORK CITY
ON FRIDAY, OCT 20, 1978, APPROXIMATELY 300 "IRANIAN STUDENTS" CONDUCTED A MARCH AND HELD DEMONSTRATIONS AT VARIOUS LOCATIONS IN NEW YORK CITY PROTESTING GOVT OF SHAH OF IRAN.

GROUP, UNDER SPONSORSHIP OF UNION OF IRANIAN STUDENTS IN US, BEGAN PROTEST AT 9:00 AM AT WORLD TRADE CENTER. AFTER ONE HOUR, DEMONSTRATORS MARCHED UNDER POLICE ESCORT TO WASHINGTON SQUARE PARK, UNION SQUARE PARK, ISAIAH WALL (UN), IRANIAN AIRLINES, AND IRANIAN CONSULATE. MARCH TERMINATED WITHOUT INCIDENT OR ARREST AT 7:00 PM AT COLUMBUS CIRCLE. AMPLE POLICE PRESENT THROUGHOUT DEMONSTRATION.

1979ATHENS00234.subject: RETURN OF OIL PIPELINE TECHNICIANS TO IRAN

segments.text: SOLAR TURBINES, LTD., IRANIAN SUBSIDIARY OF AN AMERICAN COMPANY EMPLOYING AMERICAN AND THIRD COUNTRY PERSONNEL, PROVIDED CONTRACT SERVICE TO NIOC FOR THE MAIN FUEL PUMPS AT THE TEHRAN REFINERY, FOR SOME MAJOR EQUIPMENT ON THE AHWAG-REY PIPELINE, AND FOR MOST OF THE MAJOR EQUIPMENT ON THE REY-TABRIZ PIPELINE. THIS SERVICE REQUIRED THAT FIVE PEOPLE BE ON DUTY AT ANY ONE TIME, ROUND THE CLOCK. A TOTAL COMPLEMENT OF 14 TECHNICIANS MET THESE REQUIREMENTS. SOLAR TURBINE'S CONTRACT WITH NIOC EXPIRED DEC 31, 1978, PARTIALLY DUE TO LACK OF CONTACT WITH NIOC, AND PERSONNEL DEPARTED IRAN FOR ATHENS.

SOLAR TURBINE GENERAL MANAGER (SERVICE), DICK HAGMAN, WAS ASKED JAN 9 BY NIOC MANAGER OF OPERATIONS AND COMMUNICATIONS AT TEHRAN HQ (ABRAHAMIAN) TO FURNISH TWO TECHNICIANS FOR START-UP OF THE AHWAZ-REY PIPELINE AND POSSIBLE ALSO FOR REY-TABRIZ LINE. HAGMAN IS NOT WILLING TO RENEW CONTRACT UNDER PRESENT CIRCUMSTANCES, BUT HE IS PREPARED TO FURNISH ASSISTANCE ON A CASE BY CASE BASIS. SPECIFICALLY, HE IS WILLING TO FURNISH ONE OR TWO TEAMS OF TWO PEOPLE TO WORK ONLY IN PAIRS.

HAGMAN ESTIMATES THAT ONE TEAM WOULD BE NEEDED FOR ONE TO TWO WEEKS FOR START-UP OF ONE LINE AND A SECOND TEAM WOULD BE NEEDED FOR THE SAME AMOUNT OF TIME IF SECOND LINE IS TO BE RESTARTED. MEN WOULD NEED TO MOVE FROM ONE PUMPING STATION TO ANOTHER ALONG LINES AND WOULD USE LIVING QUARTERS AT EACH STATION. AS SOON AS THEY COME OFF THE LINE, HE WANTS THEM OUT OF THE COUNTRY.

HAGMAN IS PREPARED TO NEGOTIATE GROUND SECURITY AND SECURE TRANSPORTATION (HELICOPTER) WITH NIOC, BUT HE IS ONLY WILLING TO SEND IN TEAMS IF USG CAN PROVIDE ASSURANCES THAT, IN THE EVENT INTERNATIONAL AIR TRANSPORTATION IS NOT AVAILABLE, HIS CREWS (SOME OF WHOM MAY NOT BE AMCITS) WILL HAVE ACCESS TO USG TRANSPORTATION (MAC).
HAGMAN REQUESTS USG NOT CONTACT IRANIAN GOVT. OR NIOC CONCERNING HIS REQUEST FOR TRANSPORT ASSURANCES.

1979ATHENS00535.subject: RETURN OF OIL PIPELINE TECHNICIANS TO IRAN

segments.text: SOLAR TURBINE REPRESENTATIVE REPORTS HE IS STILL IN PRELIMINARY DISCUSSION STAGE WITH NOIC ABOUT RETURN OF PIPELINE TECHNICIANS TO IRAN. HE CLAIMS NIOC IS STILL VERY INTERESTED IN SOLAR'S RETURN AND URGED HIM ON JANUARY 16 TO SEND A REPRESENTATIVE TO TEHRAN TO BEGIN OFFICIAL NEGOTIATIONS. NEW DISRUPTIONS OCCASIONED BY SHAH'S DEPARTURE YESTERDAY HAVE MADE COMMUNICATION WITH NIOC DIFFICULT AND SOLAR REPRESENTATIVE FEELS THERE IS A GOOD CHANCE PIPELINES MIGHT CLOSE DOWN AGAIN IN A DAY OR TWO FOR A PERIOD OF A WEEK OR MORE. UNDER THESE CIRCUMSTANCES, HE IS HESITANT TO SEND A REPRESENTATIVE TO TEHRAN.

PRELIMINARY DISCUSSIONS INDICATE THERE WOULD BE NO DIFFICULTY IN REACHING ACCEPTABLE FINANCIAL AGREEMENT FOR SOLAR'S RETURN, ACCORDING TO REPRESENTATIVE. NIOC IS HAVING DIFFICULTY, HOWEVER, MEETING SOLAR'S CONDITION THAT HELICOPTER TRANSPORT BE PROVIDED FOR ALL MOVEMENTS. ACCORDING TO SOLAR'S NIOC CONTACTS, IRANIAN MILITARY IS NOT LONGER PERMITTING NIOC ITS FORMER CARTE BLANCHE IN AIR OPERATIONS.

QUESTIONED ABOUT NEED FOR SOLAR TECHNICIANS IN LIGHT OF SUCCESSFUL START-UP AND OPERATION OF PIPELINES IN THEIR ABSENCE, SOLAR REPRESENTATIVE REPLIED THAT FOLLOWING SHUT DOWN OF PIPELINES, THEY HAD ABOUT TEN DAYS FOR MAINTENANCE WORK BEFORE THEIR DEPARTURE FROM IRAN, AND THUS LEFT PIPELINE IN TOP CONDITION. THERE ARE THREE SOLAR UNITS PER PUMPING STATION AND, WHILE PRESENT FLOW CAN BE MAINTAINED USING ONLY ONE UNIT IN EVERY OTHER STATION, UNITS NEED FREQUENT SERVICE AND MAINTENANCE WHICH ONLY SOLAR IS ABLE TO PROVIDE.

SOLAR HAS A POOL OF TWENTY-SEVEN TECHNICIANS IN ATHENS SAFEHAVEN, THIRTEEN OF WHOM ARE AMCITS. FOURTEEN SERVICED TEHRAN AND TABRIZ PIPELINES, WHILE REMAINDER SERVICED OSCO PRODUCTION OPERATIONS AT GACH SARAN, AGHA JARI, ETC. BASED ON DISCUSSIONS IN LONDON JAN. 16, SOLAR REPRESENTATIVE EXPECTS POSSIBLE REQUEST FOR PARTIAL RESUMPTION OF SERVICES TO OSCO IN ABOUT A WEEK WHICH, COMBINED WITH NIOC PIPELINE SERVICES, WOULD REQUIRE MOST OF HIS TECHNICIANS, BOTH AMCIT AND TCN. IN SHORT RUN, HOWEVER, SOLAR COULD SEND ALL-AMCIT TEAM FOR PIPELINE DUTY BY JUGGLING PIPELINE AND OSCO PERSONNEL.
BUT TO VARYING LEVELS OF TRAINING AND EXPERTISE, THIS WOULD NOT BE POSSIBLE IF EVEN LIMITED SERVICE TO BOTH PIPELINES AND OSCO IS REQUIRED AT SAME TIME.
COMMENT: SOLAR REPRESENTATIVE APPEARS UNEXPECTEDLY OPTIMISTIC BOTH ABOUT SPEED WITH WHICH OIL INDUSTRY MIGHT RETURN TO NEAR-NORMAL AND ABOUT THE CRUCIAL NATURE OF SOLAR'S PRESENCE TO NIOC OPERATIONS.
(C-ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY: USINT POLCOUNS TOOK ADVANTAGE OF FAREWELL LUNCHEON WITH INFORMATION MINISTRY OFFICIAL TO STRONGLY STATE USG INTEREST IN GOOD RELATIONS BETWEEN IRAQ AND IRAN. GOI APPEARS TO WANT A RESUMPTION OF FORMER DETENTE BUT DOES NOT KNOW HOW TO OBTAIN IT. END SUMMARY.

MAZIN ZAHAWI, PRIVATE SECRETARY TO INFORMATION MINISTER, INVITED DEPARTING POLCOUNS TO TETE-A-TETE LUNCHEON DURING WHICH HE PRESSED FOR USG VIEW OF SITUATION IN IRAN. HE BAGAN BY SUGGESTING THAT USG IS PROBABLY PREPARED TO SUPPORT ISLAMIC FUNDAMENTALIST REGIME IF ONLY TO PREVENT SPREAD OF SOVIET INFLUENCE INTO IRAN. POLCOUNS REPLIED THAT WE CERTAINLY DID SEEK POLITICAL ENVIRONMENT WHICH WOULD BE RESISTANT TO IRANIAN COMMUNIST AND/OR SOVIET INFLUENCE. MORE IMPORTANTLY, WE HAD A STRONG INTEREST IN A STABLE AND UNITED IRAN.

CURRENT INSTABILITY NOT ONLY THREATENED TO INTERRUPT FLOW OF OIL FROM IRAN AT A TIME OF SHORT WORLD SUPPLIES, IT ALSO CARRIED LONGTERM THREAT OF DISRUPTING OIL PRODUCTION IN IRAQ AND OTHER STATES IN THE AREA.

ZAHAWI INTERJECTED THAT IRAQ WAS IMMUNE FROM SUCH PROBLEMS IN VIEW OF ITS STABLE GOVERNMENT AND MILITARY STRENGTH. POLCOUNS DEMURRED NOTING THAT IRAQ WAS BOTTLED UP AT THE HEAD OF THE GULF AND HAD ETHNIC PROBLEMS WITH KURDS AND SHIA THAT MIGHT BECOME LESS MANAGEABLE IF IRANIAN INL AND FOREIGN POLICY CONTINUED TO BE ERRATIC. POLCOUNS NOTED WITH REGRET RECENT EDITORIALS IN BAATH PARTY DAILY AL-THAWRA ALLEGING THAT U.S. INTERESTS WERE SERVED BOTH BY INSTABILITY IN IRAN AND BY DETERIORATION OF RELATIONS BETWEEN IRAQ AND IRAN. IN FACT, HE MAINTAINED, THE CONTRARY IS TRUE. TO THE EXTENT OF U.S.

INFLUENCE, VERY LIMITED THESE DAYS IN BOTH BAGHDAD AND TEHRAN, THE USG WOULD LIKE TO ENCOURAGE A LESSENING OF TENSION BETWEEN THE TWO COUNTRIES. U.S. AND IRAQ HAVE A SHARED INTEREST IN IRANIAN STABILITY.

ZAHAWI MAINTAINED THAT IRAQ HAD DONE EVERYTHING POSSIBLE TO BE FRIENDLY AND CONCILIATORY TOWARD NEW REGIME IN TEHRAN. NONETHELESS, IRANIANS WERE ENCOURAGING KURDISH SEPARATISM, LAYING CLAIM TO ARAB TERRITORIES LIKE BAHRAIN AND TRYING TO STIR UP TROUBLE AMONG IRAQI SHIA. ZAHAWI SAID THAT IRANIAN EXPERIMENT WAS PROVING UNWORKABILITY OF ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT IN MODERN AGE. IRAQI LEADERS RESPECTED ISLAMIC HERITAGE BUT WOULD NOT MOVE AWAY FROM SECULARISM TO APPEASE KHOMEINI.

COMMENT: WE BELIEVE OUR ASSURANCES OF USG SUPPORT FOR IRAQI-IRANIAN DETENTE WILL GET THROUGH TO SENIOR LEVELS OF GOI. ASIDE FROM THE FACT THAT ZAHAWI TOOK NOTES DURING THAT PORTION OF THE DISCUSSION, HE WAS PROBABLY RECORDING THE CONVERSATION. (IRAQI OFFICIALS DO NOT MEET WITH US IN PUBLIC UNLESS THEY ARE CONFIDENT THEY CAN AVOID CRITIDISM FOR SO DOING, AND ZAHAWI HAD A "TRANSISTOR RADIO" WITH HIM AT THE TABLE.) WE ARE IMPRESSED BY THIS FURTHER INDICATION THAT GOI IS BOTH WORRIED AND PUZZLED BY DEVELOPMENTS IN IRAN. DESPITE OFFICIAL PROTESTS OF SELF CONFIDENCE AND CHARGES THAT U.S.

IS THE ONLY GAINER FROM IRAQIIRANIAN DISPUTE, BAGHDAD REGIME NEEDS DETENTE WITH IRAN AND WOULD PROBABLY BE RELIEVED BY SOME SIGN THAT TEHRAN WAS PREPARED TO RETURN TO THE GENTLEMEN'S AGREEMENT WHICH PREVAILED FROM 1975-1978. PECK

(U) DURING THE COURSE OF A RECENT VISA INTERVIEW, USINT CONSOFF WAS INFORMED THAT A GROUP OF ABOUT 1,000 KURDS IS DURRENTLY AT THE IRAQI-IRANIAN BORDER WAITING TO RETURN TO IRAQ. THESE KURDS, WHICH INCLUDE FORMER PESH MERGA GUERRILLAS, ARE A SUB-FAMILY OF THE JAF GROUP, WHICH IS A PROMINENT, WEALTHY KURDISH CLAN.

(C) THE VISA APPLICANT IS A SON OF THE HEAD OF ONE OF THE JAF CLAN BRANCHES AND HAS LIVED IN IRAN OVER 20 YEARS. WITH THE CURRENT UNREST IN IRAQN, HE AND OTHER MEMBERS OF THE FAMILY HAVE DECIDED TO RETURN TO IRAQ. ABOUT 40 TO 45 PEOPLE CAME BACK AFTER THE KURDISH NEW YEAR IN MARCH TO MAKE ARRANGEMENTS. THE REST ARE WAITING AT THE BORDER AND WILL ENTER IRAQ AS SOON AS THEY RECEIVE WORD THAT THEY CAN RETURN WITHOUT GOI REPRISALS.

(C) COMMENT: DESPITE CONSTANT REPORTS OF "INCIDENTS" (APPARENTLY UNCOORDINATED, AT LEAST AT PRESENT) THROUGHOUT IRAQI KURDISTAN, GOI CONTINUES ON WITH PATIENT (IN THE IRAQI CONTEXT) EFFORTS TO PACIFY AND RESETTLE THE TRIBESMEN. DURING HIS MAJOR ADDRESS ON AUGUST 8, SADDAM HUSSEIN ANNOUNCED YET ANOTHER AMNESTY FOR ANY KURDS ABANDONING ARMED STRUGGLE AGAINST THE GOI; SQADDAM'S TIMING OF THE AMNESTY AMMOUNCEMENT MAY WELL BE RELATED TO A RETURN OF SOME JAF TRIBAL ELEMENTS. IF, IN FACT, ELEMENTS OF THE CLAN ARE RETURNING TO IRAQ, THE GOI CAN BE EXPECTED TO SQUEEZE MAXIMUM PUBLICITY OUT OF THE EVENT, PARTICULARLY IN VIEW OF RECENT RUMORS THAT MAS'UD BARZANI HAS RETURNED TO NORTHEASTERN IRAQ.
(C-ENTIRE TEXT)

AS FAR AS WE ARE AWARE, IRAQI MEDIA HAVE MADE NO REFERENCE TO THE TREATY IN RECENT DAYS, NEITHER TO THE AN NAHAR OR THE WP STORIES NOR TO ANY ABROGATION. HOLIDAYS HAVE CAUSED SOME DISRUPTION IN NEWS SERVICE, BUT AN EVENT OF THIS MAGNITUDE SHOULD HAVE GOTTEN THROUGH, IF IT TOOK PLACE.

WE CONCUR WITH ASSESSMENT PARA 3 REFTEL. IT WOULD BE AN UNLIKELY MOVE IN ANY EVENT, AND WOULD PROBABLY NOT BE ANNOUNCED BY THE IRAQI AMBASSADOR IN BEIRUT. RELATIONS WITH IRAN ARE NOT GOOD, BUT WE JUDGE THEY HAVE NOT REACHED THE STAGE WHERE ABROGATING THE TREATY IS REQUIRED.
GOI SECRECY PROVIDES AN INFINITE CAPACITY FOR SURPRISING MOVES, BUT WE THINK THE AMBASSADOR IS AHEAD OF HIS GOVERNMENT ON THIS ONE.

1979BRUSSE12925.subject: EC SAYS IT HAS NO CONTACTS WITH IRAN

segments.text: IN JANUARY THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT ADOPTED A RESOLUTION (OJ NO. C39, 12.2.1979, P. 52), ON WHICH I WAS RAPPORTEUR ON BEHALF OF THE POLITICAL AFFAIRS COMMITTEE, CONDEMNING THE VIOLATION OF HUMAN RIGHTS IN IRAN AND CALLING ON THE FOREIGN MINISTERS, THE COUNCIL AND THE COMMISSION TO MAKE REPRESENTATIONS TO ALL THE POLITICAL FORCES IN IRAN AND WITHIN THE INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS WITH A VIEW TO RESTORING A NORMAL SITUATION IN WHICH THE FUNDAMENTAL AND POLITICAL RIGHTS OF THE IRANIAN PEOPLE ARE RESPECTED.

SINCE THEN, POLITICAL DEVELOPMENTS HAVE LED TO INTENSIFIED AND MORE WIDESPREAD VIOLATIONS OF HUMAN RIGHTS IN IRAN, WITH THE RESULT THAT SUMMARY TRIALS AND EXECUTIONS HAVE NOW BEEN ADDED TO THE CONSTANT REPRESSION AND ARBITRARY ARRESTS. WHAT MEASURES DOES THE COMMISSION INTEND TO TAKE ALONG THE LINES PROPOSED BY THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT? ANSWER (31 MAY 1979): THE COMMISSION IS FOLLOWING THE HUMAN RIGHTS SITUATION IN IRAN WITH CONCERN. AS IT HAS ALREADY STATED,... THE COMMISSION CONDEMNS ANY INFRINGEMENT OF HUMAN RIGHTS IRRESPECTIVE OF WHERE IT OCCURS.

THE COMMISSION DOES NOT AT PRESENT HAVE ANY CONTACT WITH THE IRANIAN AUTHORITIES; THE TRADE NEGOTIATIONS WERE INTERRUPTED AT THE ONSET OF THE TROUBLES WHICH GAVE RISE TO THE CURRENT POLITICAL UPHEAVALS. THE COMMISSION WILL NOT FAIL TO EXPRESS ITS OPINION TO THE IRANIAN AUTHORITIES AS SOON AS CIRCUMSTANCES PERMIT. .

IN CONVERSATION WITH MISSION OFFICER, COMMISSION OFFICIAL RESPONSIBLE FOR RELATIONS WITH IRAN CONFIRMED THAT THE EC-IRAN NEGOTIATIONS ARE INACTIVE. HE EXPECTS THEY WILL REMAIN SO UNTIL THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT EXPRESSES AN INTERESTED IN RESUMING THEM. HINTON

1979CAIRO00008.subject: MESSAGE FOR THE SHAH FROM SADAT

segments.text: IN LONG TALK WITH SADAT LAST NIGHT, HE VOICED GLOOMY VIEW OF SHAH'S PROSPECTS OF STAYING ON. HE EXPECTS PRESENT REGIME TO COLLAPSE WITHIN "HOURS OR DAYS" AND SEES IRAN ENDING UP WITH EITHER AN EXTREME LEFT OR, MORE LIKELY, RIGHIST GOVERNMENT. HE CONSIDERS THE MULLAHS DANGEROUS AND WONDERS ABOUT FUTURE ORIENTATION OF IRANIAN MILITARY. HE IS DEEPLY TROUBLED ABOUT IRANIAN SITUATION AND IS PARTICULARLY CONCERNED ABOUT THE SHAH, WHOM HE CONSIDERS A GOOD FRIEND. SADAT THEN MENTIONED THAT HE HAD SENT WORD TO THE SHAH EARLIER IN THE DAY INVITING HIM TO COME TO ASWAN FOR REST AND RELAXATION. SADAT THEN ASKED IF THERE IS ANY WAY IN WHICH YOU MIGHT BE ABLE TO CONVEY TO THE SHAH HIS BEST WISHES AND HIS INVITATION TO COME TO ASWAN FOR REST, SHOULD THE SHAH WISH TO DO SO. HE IS ANXIOUS THAT THE SHAH KNOW OF SADAT'S SOLICITUDE.

YOU ARE IN BEST POSITION TO DECIDE WHETHER CONVEYING SADAT'S INVITATION AT THIS TIME MIGHT BE MISCONSTRUED. ACTION REQUESTED: WE BELIEVE IT WOULD BE A WORTHWHILE GESTURE ON OUR PART TO PROVIDE CALDERON BERTI WITH AS MUCH BACKGROUND INFORMATION AS POSSIBLE ON THE NEW OFFICIALS BEFORE HE LEAVES NOV. 1 OR 2. WE COULD PASS THIS INFORMATION TO HIM ORALLY OR IN A WRITTEN BIO SKETCH, DEPENDING ON ITS SENSITIVITY, AND BELIEVE THAT CALDERON BERTI CAN BE TRUSTED TO NOT CITE THE USG AS HIS SOURCE.

1979COPENH00544.subject: FRENCH FOREIGN MINISTER FRANCOIS-PONCET'S VISIT TO COPENHAGEN

segments.text: COPENHAGEN (C) ENTIRE TEXT.

SUMMARY: MFA OFFICE ON JANUARY 26 PROVIDED US WITH A REVIEW OF FRENCH FOREIGN MINISTER FRANCOIS-PONCET'S BRIEF JANUARY 23 VISIT TO COPENHAGEN. TOPICS DISCUSSED INCLUDED THE EUROPEAN MONETARY SYSTEM (EMS) AND EMS/MONETARY COMPENSATION AMOUNTS (MCA) LINKAGE, THE EC COUNCIL/PARLIAMENT BUDGET DISPUTE, DISARMAMENT, IRAN AND ITS IMPLICATIONS FOR A MIDDLE EAST SETTLEMENT, AND INDO-CHINA. END SUMMARY.

FRENCH FOREIGN MINISTER FRANCOIS-PONCET ARRIVED EARLY EVENING JANUARY 23 AND LEFT AT 10:00 PM THE SAME NIGHT. VISIT WAS ONE OF A SERIES HE IS UNDERTAKING FOLLOWING HIS APPOINTMENT. WHILE IN COPENHAGEN, HE HAD A HALF HOUR MEETING WITH DANISH FOREIGN MINISTER HENNING CHRISTOPHERSEN AND A VERY FEW OTHER OFFICIALS, FOLLOWED BY A WORKING DINNER HOSTED BY CHRISTOPHERSEN.

DURING THE PRE-DINNER MEETING THREE TOPICS WERE DISCUSSED: THE EMS, LINKAGE OF MONETARY COMPENSATION AMOUNTS TO INAUGURATION OF THE EMS, AND THE DISPUTE BETWEEN THE EC COUNCIL AND THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT OVER THE EC BUDGET. MFA OFFICER SAID THAT THE DANES SAW "EYE-TO-EYE" WITH THEIR VISITOR ON THESE ISSUES.

THE WORKING DINNER WAS "MORE DINNER THAN WORKING." THE NEW FRENCH FOREIGN MINISTER SPOKE OF HIS GOVERNMENT'S PROPOSED CONFERENCE ON DISARMAMENT IN EUROPE (CDE); THE DISUATION IN IRAN: THE LATTER'S IMPLICATIONS FOR A MID EAST SETTLEMENT: AND THE SITUATION IN SOUTHEAST ASIA.

ON THE CDE, FRANCOIS-PONCET PUT PRIMARY EMPHASIS ON PRINCIPLES UNDERLYING THE PROPOSAL--E.G., THE RIGHT OF EVERY COUNTRY TO ASSURE ITS OWN SECURITY. HE CONFIRMED THAT CONVENTIONAL FORCES WERE TO BE ADDRESSED FIRST AND EMPHASIZED THE IMPORTANCE OF SATISFACTORY PROVISION FOR VERIFICATION. HE INDICATED THAT THE FRENCH WERE PREPARED TO BE PATIENT ABOUT PROGRESS TOWARD CONVENING SUCH A CONFERENCE (HE DREW A PARALLEL TO THE 10-15 YEARS THAT THE USSR DEVOTED TO PURSUING THEIR PROPOSAL FOR A CSCE).

FRANCOIS-PONCET WAS PESSIMISTIC CONCERNING IRAN'S FUTURE AND SPOKE OF LIKELY "INSTABILITY AND ANARCHY". HE WAS CONCERNED THAT, AS A RESULT, EUROPE WOULD LATER IN THE YEAR EXPERIENCE DIFFICULTIES IN OIL SUPPLY.

THE FRENCH FOREIGN MINISTER BELIEVED THAT EVENTS IN IRAN SERVED TO INCREASE THE FEELINGS OF INSECURITY IN ISRAEL AND EGYPT. ISRAEL, CONCERNED INTER ALIA WITH FUTURE OIL SUPPLIES, WOULD BE LESS FLEXIBLE IN CONCLUDING THE BILATERAL AGREEMENT WITH EGYPT AND LESS WILLING TO YIELD TERRITORY IT PRESENTLY OCCUPIES. HEIGHTENED INSECURITY WOULD ALSO RENDER MORE DIFFICULT CONCLSUION OF THE BROADER MID EAST SETTLEMENT ENVISAGED AT CAMP DAVID. FRANCOIS-PONCET SAID THAT THESE CIRCUMSTANCES COMPLICATE DEFINITION OF AN EC POSTURE IF THE ISRAELI-EGYPTIAN AGREEMENT IS CONCLUDED. HE ADDED THAT FOUR MONTHS AGO THE EC COULD SIMPLY HAVE APPLAUDED CONCLUSION OF THEAT AGREEMENT BUT NOW THE APPROPRIATE EC RESPONSE WAS UNCLEAR.
(EMBASSY OFFICER PRESSED FOR ELABORATION OF THIS REMARK, BUT MFA OFFICER EXPLAINED THAT NONE WAS GIVEN AT THE DINNER.)

ON INDO-CHINA, THE FRENCH FOREIGN MINISTER TOOK A POSITION WHICH MFA OFFICER CHARACTERIZED AS THE SAME LINE AS THE U.S. AND DANES ARE TAKING: I.E., THE VIETNAMESE PRESENCE IN KAMPUCHEA WAS UNACCEPTABLE; SOME AID SANCTIONS ARE INDICATED, BUT THE DOOR SHOULD BE LEFT OPEN FOR THE VIETNAMESE IF THEY REPENT-- THE VIETNAMESE SHOULD UNDERSTAND THAT THE WEST REMAINED A "POTENTIAL PARTNER".

(U) IRAN'S NEW AMBASSADOR TO DENMARK, ABBAS AMIR ENTEZAM, WHO ISRESIDENT IN STOCKHOLM, PRESENTED HIS CREDENTIALS TO QUEEN MARGRETHE ON SEPTEMBER 6. HE ALSO HELD A PRESS CONFERENCE AND HAD A MEETING WITH THE FONMIN.

(C) AN MFA OFFICIAL GAVE THE FOLLOWING ACCOUNT OF ENTEZAM'S MEETING WITH FONMIN CHRISTOPHERSEN TO EMBOFF. ENTEZAM SAID THAT THREE WEEKS AGO THE IRANIAN GOVT HAD DECIDED TO CRACK DOWN ON COUNTER-REVOLUTIONARY ELEMENTS, FIRST AND FOREMOST THE KURDS. HE AVERRED THAT 6 TO 12 MONTHS WOULD BE NECESSARY FOR THE REVOLUTIONARY GOVT FULLY TO BRING THE COUNTRY UNDER CONTROL.

(C) DANISH FONMIN CHROSTOPHERSEN SAID THAT PRESS ACCOUNTS OF HUMAN RIGHTS VIOLATIONS IN IRAN HAD AWAKENED CONCERN IN THE DANISH PUBLIC. ENTEZAM DENIED THE ACCURACY OF THOSE ACCOUNTS AND SAID THAT THE SITUATION WOULD BE BACK TO NORMAL ONCE THE COUNTRY HAD BEEN BROUGHT UNDER CONTROL.

(C) ENTEZAM ADMITTED THAT BAZARGAN WAS NOT IN FAVOR OF THE HARSH MEASURES NOW BEING TAKEN AGAINST THE KURDS. HE WAS QUITE LIBERAL AND HAD EVEN TRIED TO STEP DOWN A COUPLE OF TIMES. ENTEZAM SAID KHOMEINI WOULD NOT LET HIMSELF BE NOMINATED FOR PRESIDENT BUT WOULD NOT REJECT THE POSSIBILITY THAT BAZARGAN MIGHT BE A CANDIDATE.
(C) ENTEZAM ACCUSED THE USSR OF BELONGING "TO THE GROUP OF COUNTRIES NEAR IRAN THAT SUPPORTED THE COUNTERREVOLUTIONARY FORCES (IN IRAN)."

(C) ENTEZAM WAS BETTER DISPOSED TOWARD THE US, SAYING THAT RELATIONS WERE STRAINED BY OUR FORMER SUPPORT OF THE SHAH, BUT THAT IRAN NEEDED OUR TECHNICAL KNOW-HOW, PARTICULARLY CONCERNING WEAPONS SYSTEMS. HIS KEY WORDS WERE,"IF THE US WAS SINCERE IN ITS PROMISE OF NOT INTERFERING IN IRAN'S INTERNAL AFFAIRS AND OF RESPECTING THE INDEPENDENCE OF IRAN, IT COULD BE POSSIBLE TO RE-ESTABLISH THE GOOD RELATIONSHIP (BETWEEN IRAN AND THE U.S.)."

(U) A MAJOR DANISH DAILY, BERLINGSKE TIDENDE (IND CONSERVATIVE), REPORTED THAT ENTEZAM HAS CLOSE LINKS WITH PREMIER BARZAGAN AND KHOMEINI'S REVOLUTIONARY GOVT, WHICH HE PLANS TO MAINTAIN BY FLYING HOME TO TEHRAN AT LEAST TWICE A MONTH.

(U) BERLINGSKE ALSOREPORTED THAT ENTEZAM HAD SAID THAT HE THOUGHT IRAN WOULD BE ABLE TO SUPPLY DENMARK'S FUTURE ENERGY NEEDS IF, LIKE OTHER COUNTRIES, IT REGISTERED WITH THE IRANIAN NATIONAL OIL COMPANY TO RECEIVE A SHARE OF THE TOTAL IRANIAN PRODUCTION. HE SAID IN GENERAL THAT DENMARK COULD BECOME A VERY GOOD TRADE PARTNER, ESPECIALLY BECAUSE IT HAD NO HISTORY OF COLONIAL EXPLOITATION OR OF MEDDLING IN IRANIAN AFFAIRS.
(D) SANA 3643

segments.text: NON-ALIGNED SUMMIT REFJI TEHRAN 10049 (C-ENTIRE TEXT.)

WE HAVE NO TEXT OF IRANIAN FOREIGN MINISTER YAZDI'S SPEECH AT THE NAM PLEANARY. CUBAN COMMUNIST CARTY DAILY "GRANMA" PUBLISHED EXCERPS OF THE YAZDI SPEECH BUT THIS CANNOT BE CONSIDERED BLANCED OR PERHAPS EVEN ACCURATE ACCOUNT. FOR WHAT THEY ARE WORTH, HOWEVER, HIGHLIGHTS OF "GRANMA"ACCOUNT FOLLOW.

CALLING THE FINAL VICTORY OF OPPRESSED PEOPLES "INEVITABLE," YAZDI BLASTED "U.S. IJPERIALISM" FOR HAVING SUPPORTED THE "BLOODY REGIME" OF THE SHAH. WHILE THE IMPERIALISTS SPEAK OF HUMAN RIGHTS, HE SAID, THE "TORTURORS OF THE PEOPLE" CONTINUE RECEIVING ARMS AND MILITARY ASSISTANCE FROM THE U.S.

YAZDI EXPRESSED HIS GOVERNMENT'S SUPPORT FOR THE PLO AND THE LIBERATION OF SOUTH AFRICA, AND SAID THAT IRAN'S POLICY IS BASED ON THE "EQUALITARIAN AND HUMANITARIAN CHARACTER OF ISLAM." WITH WHAT MUST HAVE BROUGHT A CHUCKLE FROM THE HOUSE, HE FOLLOWED THAT LINE BY SAYING THAT IN THIS RFAPECT, "FIDEL CASTRO IS MUCH CLOSER TO ISLAM THAN MANY MOSLEMS."

DESPITE THE APPARENTLY RADICAL TONE OF YADZI SPEECH, OTHER DIPLOMATIC OBSERVERS HERE HAVE OMMENTED THAT IRANIAN DELEGATION WAS BY NO MEANS AMONG "LEADING FIRE-EATERS" AT SUMMIT. ONE MEMBER IRANIAN DELEGATION MADE BEMUSED COMMENT TO USINT OFFIER THAT "THIS WHOLE THING IS SIMPLY A SOCIAL OCCASION; NOTHING WILL BE ACCOMPLISHED HERE, BUT EVERYONE WILL GO AWAY HAPPIER FOR HAVING BLOWN OFF STEAM."
(C-ENTIRE TEXT)

1979JIDDA03979.subject: (U) IRANIAN DENUNCIATION OF U.S. SENATE RESOLUTION

segments.text: (E - ENTIRE TEXT.)

EMBASSY POLITICAL OFFICER ON MAY 21 DISCUSSED IRANIAN REACTION TO U.S. SENATE RESOLUTION CONDEMNING EXECUTIONS BY REVOLUTIONARY COURTS WITH IRANIAN CHARGE SADEGHI. SADEGHI POINTED TO THE STATEMENTS OF FOREIGN MIISTER YAZDI AS A WELL-REASONED AND CALM EXPLANATION OF EVENTS. SADEGHI WAS VERY PLEASED TO SEE SUCH STATEMENTS FROM THE MINISTRY.

EMBASSY OFFICER POINTED OUT THAT YAZDI'S STATEMENTS WERE BITTERLY CONDEMNED BY TEHRAN RADIO COMMENTATOR LATER SAME DAY (MAY 21) WHO SAID THAT YAZDI, WHO HAD LIVED SO LONG IN THE UNITED STATES, "SHOULD KNOW THAT THE SENATE IS THE CENTER OF POWER IN THE UNITED STATES AND THAT SOME SENATORS HAVE MORE INFLUENCE THAN THE PRESIDENT HIMSELF." SADEGHI SAID HE HAD NOT HEARD THAT STATEMENT, BUT THAT IN ANY CASE NOW THAT THERE WAS FREEDOM OF SPEECH AND FREEDOM OF THE PRESS IN IRAN, ONE SHOULD EXPECT TO HEAR CONFLICTING OPINIONS ON SUCH MATTERS. HE AGREED, HOWEVER, THAT THE STRONG DENUNCIATIONS WERE AN OVER-REACTION TO THE SENATE RESOLUTION.
(THIS STATEMENT WAS MADE BEFORE THE U.S. FLAG WAS BURNED IN ASTARA.)

WITH SOME AMUSEMENT, SADEGHI POINTED OUT THAT NOW IRAN HAD MADE GREAT ADVANCES ON THE POLITICAL STAGE. HE SAID IT WAS A SIGN OF GREAT POLITICAL MATURITY THAT PASSIONATE DEBATE RAGES THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY ON THE ROLE AND RELATIVE IMPORTANCE OF THE SENATE IN MAKING AMERICAN FOREIGN POLICY. HE HOPED THAT IRANIAN POLITICAL DEBATES WOULD CONTINUE TO REVOLVE AROUND SUCH ESOTERIC SUBJECTS.

1979KABUL00771.subject: LEILA MAILIKYAR, DAUGHTER OF FORMER AMBASSADOR ABDULLAH MALIKYAR, OBTAINS AFGHAN PASSPORT

segments.text: LEILA MALIKYAR, A DAUGHTER OF FORMER AFGHAN AMBASSADOR ABDULLAH MALIKYAR, HAS OBTAINED A PASSPORT AND ON JANUARY 29 RECEIVED A VISA TO VISIT RELATIVES IN THE UNITED STATES. WE DO NOT KNOW HER EXACT TRAVEL PLANS, BUT SHE MUST USE HER U.S. VISA WITHIN THREE MONTHS.

AGHAI ABBAS MAKKI, IRANIAN CONSUL GENERAL IN LAHORE FOR PAST YEAR, TOLD ME IN CONFIDENCE MARCH 25 THAT ON EVE OF NAUROZE (IRANIAN NEW YEAR - MARCH 21) CIRCULAR CABLE RECEIVED BY MANY IRANIAN POSTS ABROAD ORDERING OVER 200 SENIOR AND MIDDLE-LEVEL DIPLOMATS HOME. THREE AMBASSADORS INCLUDED AND 14 CONSULS GENERAL. NO EXPLANATION GIVEN NOR HINT AS TO WHAT RECALLED DIPLOMATS MIGHT EXPECT ONCE BACK. THEY ARE TO REPORT TO TEHRAN WITHIN 25-30 DAYS.

MAKKI DEEPLY TROUBLED BY RECALL. PREVIOUS POST WAS DEPUTY CHIEF OF PROTOCOL, WITH EXTENSIVE CONTACT WITH COURT. BROTHER-IN-LAW WAS ONCE MINISTER OF JUSTICE UNDER SHAH. WHEN IRANIAN CONSULATE GENERAL LAHORE INVADED BY MILITANT ANTI-SHAH IRANIAN STUDENTS (LAHORE 89), LED BY THREE IRANIAN AGITATORS NEWLY ARRIVED FROM INDIA, MAKKI ULTIMATELY HAD PAK POLICE REMOVE LATTER AND THEY THREATENED VENGEANCE ON MAKKI "AFTER REVOLUTION". "OLD-BOYS CLUB" THAT FOREIGN MINISTRY USED TO BE NOW COMPLETELY CHANGED, MAKKI SAID, AND THE FEW CAREER PROFESSIONALS LEFT WITH WHOM MAKKI HAS BEEN IN CONTACT BY PHONE HAVE BEEN VERY GUARDED IN WILLINGNESS TO BE OF ANY HELP TO HIM ON RETURN.

MAKKI HOWEVER HAS NO OPTION BUT TO COMPLY WITH RECALL ORDER. HAS NO SIGNIFICANT FUNDS ABROAD; WIFE AND ONE CHILD IN TEHRAN; ONLY CAREER HE HAS, HAS BEEN WITH FOREIGN MINISTRY. WILL RETURN BUT HAS ASKED WHETHER LATER HE MIGHT BE CONSIDERED FOR VISA TO U.S. AS POSSIBLE REFUGEE. POOR PROSPECTS OF SUCH ACCOMMODATION HAVE BEEN EXPLAINED TO HIM.
C-ENTIRE TEXT
CONGEN COMMENT THIS SUBJECT PROVIDED IN LAHORE 402 OF MARCH 26, CONCERNING RECALL OF IRANIAN CONSUL GENERAL MAKKI.

MAKKI LEAVING APRIL 12 TO RETURN TO TEHRAN. HAS CONFIRMED PRESS ACCOUNT THAT TOTAL OF 241 IRANIAN DIPLOMATS BEING RECALLED. THIS WOULD LEAVE VERY FEW MID-LEVEL/SENIOR IRANIAN DIPLOMATS ABROAD, MAKKI HAS SAID.

AS YOU NO DOUBT KNOW, ALL IRANIAN AMBASSADORS HAVE BEEN SUMMONED HOME TO ARRIVE JUNE 5. DURING FAREWELL CALL ON ME MAY 11, AMBASSADOR TO GABON, HOSSEIN MONTAZEM, SAID THAT AFTER MUCH SOUL-SEARCHING AND CHECKING WITH NEARBY COLLEAGUES, HE HAD DECIDED TO OBEY SUMMONS, HOPE THAT HE WILL BE CLEARED AS ESSENTIALLY CIVIL SERVANT, AND EVENTUALLY BE OFFERED ANOTHER POST. HIS WIFE AND DAUGHTER WILL NOT ACCOMPANY HIM TO IRAN.

MONTAZEM IS STRONGLY ANTI-COMMUNIST AND PRO-AMERICAN. HE HOPES ONE DAY TO RETIRE IN STATES WHERE HE AND HIS WIFE HAVE RELATIVES. HE REMEMBERS WITH SONSIDERABLE PLEASURE BRIEFING GIVEN TO HIM ON GABON BY GEORGE LAMBRAKIS PRIOR TO HIS ARRIVAL HERE TWO YEARS AGO, AND HOPES TO BE ABLE GET IN TOUCH WITH LAMBRAKIS AFTER HE RETURNS IN AN EFFORT TO MAINTAIN AN AMERICAN CONNECTION. HE HOPES THAT THE EMBASSY WILL KEEP HIM IN MIND WHEN INVITATIONS TO AMBASSADORIAL RECEPTIONS ARE SENT OUT, AND ASKED THAT I PASS BOTH MESSAGES ON TO THE EMBASSY.

I TOLD HIM I HAD NO PROBLEM WITH PASSING THE MESSAGES ON WITHOUT FURTHER COMMITMENT, BUT I HAVE NO IDEA (NOR DOES HE) OF SITUATION IN TEHRAN, AND SUGGESTED IT MIGHT BE WISE FOR HIM TO TEST THE WATERS AFTER HE GETS THERE BEFORE TAKING ANY INITIATIVES( HE SAID HE PLANNED TO). I ALSO REALIZE, OF COURSE, THAT HE AND OTHERS LIKE HIM, AS FORMER AMBASSADORS OF THE SHAH, MAY POSE PROBLEMS FOR YOU. NOT KNOWING WHETHER LAMBRAKIS IS STILL THERE, I GAVE HIM YOUR NAME.

MONTAZEM IS NO GREAT FRIEND OF MINE ALTHOUGH I LIKE HIM AND FEEL SORRY FOR HIM, BUT HE IS A FRIEND OF THE UNITED STATES. HIS ENGLISH IS POOR. HE SPEAKS GRAMATICALLY REASONABLE FRENCH, BUT HIS MANNER OF DELIVERY IS ATROCIOUS. I FRANKLY DO NOT KNOW WHAT HIS PERSONAL CONNECTIONS MAY HAVE BEEN TO THE SHAH'S REGIME. HE HE VERY LIKELY WILL TRY TO GET IN TOUCH IF HE THINKS HE CAN DO SO WITHOUT CAUSING PROBLEMS FOR HIMSELF, AND MAY USE MY NAME. SHOULD HE DO SO, I SUGGEST THAT YOU OR LAMBRAKIS NONETHELESS HANDLE HIM LIKE ANYONE ELSE IN HIS POSITION.

MONTAZEM, INCIDENTALLY, WAS RECEIVED ON FAREWELL CALL BY GABONESE PRESIDENT BONGO AND TOLD ME BONGO WAS ESSENTIALLY SYMPATHETIC TO HIM AND VIEWED EVENTS IN IRAN WITH SADNESS. FACT THAT HE WAS RECEIVED AT ALL BY BONGO, WHO DOES NOT NECESSARILY SEE ALL DEPARTING AMBASSADORS, SAYS SOMETHING ABOUT HOW BONGO VIEWS HIS RELATIONS WITH IRAN.

(C) ARMY ATTACHE REPORTS THE FOLLOWING CONVERSATION WITH THE WIFE OF AN IRANIAN BUSINESSMAN WORKING IN LISBON. SHE SPENT TWO WEEKS IN TEHRAN AND SURROUNDING TERRITORY, RETURNING TO PORTUGAL ON SEPTEMBER 23. THE PURPOSE OF HER VISIT WAS TO DETERMINE THE STATUS OF HER FAMILY'S PROPERTY IN TEHRAN AND IN THE COUNTRYSIDE TO THE NORTH. DURING HER VISIT SHE MADE A POINT OF TALKINGTO AS MANY IRANIANS AS POSSIBLE FROM ALL WALKS OF LIFE, IN ORDER TO DEVELOP AN IDEA AS TO THE SUPPORT OF THE PEOPLE FOR THE AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI AND THE REGIME HE BACKS. THE FEELINGS SHE FOUND ARE SUMMARIZED BELOW.

(C) THE AVERAGE PEOPLE ARE FED UP IN THE EXTREME WITH THE CURRENT SITUATION AND IN PARTICUALR WITH THE MULLAHS. ONE TAXI DRIVER, WHO CLAIMED TO BE A MOSLEM, SAID: "ISLAM AND THE KORAN ARE RESPONSIBLE FOR THIS TERRIBLE SITUATION WE ARE IN." ANOTHER LOWER CLASS WORKING MAN -- ALSO CLAIMING TO BE A MOSLEM -- POINTED AT THE TREES ALONG A MAIN AVENUE AND SAID, "I WOULD LIKE TO SEE A MULLAH HANGING FROM EVERY ONE OF THESE."

(C) THE 30- YEAR OLD SON OF THE AYATOLLAH WHO HAS THE POWER IN THE TEHRAN AREA - MONTAREZI (PHONETIC) -- HAS BEEN BEHAVING VERY STRANGELY. AT LEAST TWICE HE HAS SHOWN UP AT TEHRAN INTERNATION AIRPORT AND TAKEN OVER AN IRAN AIR JET BY FORCE. (HE IS ALWAYS ARMED WITH A MACHINE GUN.) HE HAS LOADED A NUMBER OF LARGE CRATES IN THE AIRCRAFT12 THE SECOND TIME-- AND TAKEN OFF FOR LIBYA, ACCORDING TO THE FLIGHT PLAN. WHEN THE AIRCRAFT RETURNS EMPTY MONTAREZI DEBARKS ARMED, DISARMS THE AIRPORT GUARDS AND DISAPPEARS.

ACCORDING TO SOURCE, THE GENERALLY HELD BELIEF IN TEHRAN IS THAT THE CRATES ARE FULL OF MONEY AND JEWELS AND THAT THEY ARE BEING STASHED OUTSIDE THE COUNTRY IN HASTE, SINCE THE DAY OF THE MULLAHS IS ABOUT TO END.

(C) THE CONSENSUS AMONG SOURCE'S CONTACTS IN IRAN IS THAT THE MULLAHS WILL BE OVERTHROWN AND REPLACED BY A LEFTIST-COMMUNIST OR ULTRA-LEFT REGIME THAT COULD MAKE THE SHAH AND KHOMEINI GOVERMENTS LOOK LIKE SUNDAY SCHOOL PICNICS.

(C) SOURCE IS OF THE BAHAI FAITH. THE BAHAI CLAIM KHOMEINI IS SEEKING THEIR EXTINCTION. SOURCE CLAIMS MANY OF THEIR MONUMENTS, INCLUDING THE MAIN ONE AT SHIRAZ, HAVE BEEN DESTROYED, AND 120,000 MEMBERS OF THE SECT HAVE BEEN MARTYRED. COMMENT: SOURCE IS AREASONABLE, RATIONAL PERSON-PRESUMABLY NOT DISPOSED TO BE FRIENDLY TO THE NEW IRANIAN REGIME -- AND CAME TO SEE ARMA (WHO HAS KNOWN THE FAMILY SLIGHTLY IN THE PAST) ON A DIFFERENT TOPIC ALTOGETHER. THE ' ABOVE INFORMATION WAS ONLY PROVIDED UPON QUESTIONING BY ARMA (U) EMBASSY HAS NO MEANS OF EVALUATING THE ABOVE INFORMATION.

SUMMARY: SENIOR VICE PRESIDENT OF SANTE FE INTERNATIONAL, DURING VISIT TO AHWAZ IN EARLY APRIL, WAS UNSUCCESSFUL IN PERSUADING "OSCO-INOC" TO RESCIND CONTRACT CANCELLATION. SANTA FE WILL THEREFORE TERMINATE MOST OF ITS 450 IRANIAN EMPLOYEES, ATTEMPT TO DISMANTLE AND EXPORT RIGS AND SEEK ARBITRATED SETTLEMENT. WORKERS' COMMITTEES IN AHWAZ APPEAR TO BE UNDER CONTROL OF KHOMEINI KOMITEH AND NOT UNDER LEFTIST INFLUENCE. END SUMMARY.

AMCIT SENIOR VICE PRESIDENT OF SANTA FE INTERNATIONAL HAS GIVEN US FOLLOWING RUN-DOWN OF HIS VISIT TO AHWAZ DURING FIRST WEEK OF APRIL. SAID HIS FIVE-MAN EXPATRIATE TEAM HAD BEEN MET AND TAKEN CARE OF BY COMPANY EMPLOYEES WHO HAD FORMED A WORKERS' COMMITTEE LIKE EVERY OTHER ENTERPRISE IN THE CITY TO MAKE DECISIONS. WORKERS HAD BEEN PLEASED TO LEARN THAT SANTA FE WAS INTERESTED IN COMING BACK TO RESUME WORK UNDER ITS EXISTING CONTRACT WITH OSCO AND HAD ARRANGED FOR TEAM TO MEET WITH "OSCO-ENOC" GENERAL MANAGER RAOOFI THE FOLLOWING DAY. RAOOFI INFORMED THEM THAT TELEX WAS IN PROCESS OF BEING SENT CANCELLING THEIR CONTRACT.
WHEN HE HEARD THEIR PROPOSITION, HOWEVER, HE SAID HE WOULD CHECK WITH HIS WORKERS' COMMITTEE TO SEE WHETHER DECISION MIGHT BE RESCINDED.

TEAM THEN NEGOTIATED WITH ITS OWN WORKERS' COMMITTEE REGARDING EXPATRIATES WHICH WOULD BE NEEDED TO RESUME OPERATION OF THE SIX SANTA FE RIGS IN THE AHWAZ REGION. AGREEMENT WAS REACHED ON A SEVEN-MAN LIST OF EXPATRIATE MANAGERS AND TECHNICIANS WHO WOULD BE ALLOWED TO RETURN.

THE SIX SANTA FE RIGS IN AHWAZ AREA, VP SAID, REPRESENTED $30 MILLION INVESTMENT WHICH ADDED TO $3 MILLION SPARE PARTS AND OFFICES, MATERIALS AND EQUIPMENT REPRESENTED A TOTAL COMPANY INVESTMENT OF $50 MILLION. COMPANY HAD 450 IRANIAN EMPLOYEES AND WAS OWED $7.5 MILLION AT THE PRESENT TIME ON ITS CONTRACT. OSCO-INOC HAD BEEN MAKING PERIODIC PAYMENTS ON THE CONTRACT, HE SAID.

AT SECOND MEETING WITH RAOOFI AND HIS DRILLING MANAGER FAKHRAIE, BOTH OF WHOM WERE THE SENIOR IRANIAN EMPLOYEES UNDER AMERICAN SUPERVISORS IN PREREVOLUTIONARY OSCO, NO PROGRESS WAS MADE ON ISSUE OF WHETHER SANTA FE WOULD RESUME OPERATIONS. "OSCO-INOC" STATED, HOWEVER, THAT IT INTENDED TO MEET ITS CONTRACT OBLIGATIONS. SANTA FE TEAM POINTED OUT THAT CANCELLATION HAD NOT BEEN MADE IN ACCORDANCE WITH TERMS OF CONTRACT WHICH REQUIRED SIX MONTHS NOTICE. RAOOFI REPLIED THAT REQUISITE NOTICE HAD BEEN GIVEN TO COMPANY'S IRANIAN EMPLOYEES.

AT THIRD AND FINAL MEETING TWO DAYS LATER, RAOOFI INFORMED SANTA FE THAT "OSCO-INOC" WORKERS' COMMITTEE HAD NOT ACCEPTED HIS RECOMMENDATION THAT IT REVERSE ITS DECISION AND CONSEQUENTLY, THE CANCELLATION NOTICE WAS RECONFIRMED. TEAM RETURNED TO ITS OFFICES AND INFORMED EMPLOYEES THAT OWING TO CANCELLATION DECISION, EMPLOYMENT CONTRACTS WOULD HAVE TO BE TERMINATED. EVENTS THEN TOOK NASTY TURN WITH PART OF WORKERS' COMMITTEE DECIDING TO HOLD TEAM HOSTAGE UNTIL FULL TERMINATION PAYMENTS AMOUNTING TO $2.5 MILLION HAD BEEN PAID. HELP FINALLY ARRIVED IN FORM OF HEAD OF KHUZESTAN KOMITEH, FORTUNATELY BASED IN AHWAZ.

HIS AUTHORITY WAS IMMEDIATELY RECOGNIZED BY WORKERS AND HE ARRANGED COMPROMISE WHEREBY THE THREE AMERICANS AND LABE-00 ( ADS ) W ------------------108970 181657Z /15 FM AMEMBASSY MANAMA TO SECSTATE WASHDC 7320 AMEMBASSY TEHRAN INFO AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON SECTION 2 OF 2 MANAMA 0795 ONE ENGLISHMAN OF THE SANTA FE TEAM WOULD BE ALLOWED TO LEAVE BUT COMPANY'S PALESTINIAN PERSONNEL DIRECTOR WOULD STAY UNTIL TERMINATION QUESTIONS WERE RESOLVED. HE THEN ARRANGED FOR THE FOUR EXPATRIATES TO LEAVE IRAN VIA KHORRAMSHAHR.

VP SAID THAT IN HIS JUDGMENT KHOMEINI SUPPORTERS WERE FIRMLY IN CONTROL OF AHWAZ AND ENJOYED WORKERS' ALLEGIANCE. HE SAID HE SAW NO SIGNS OF FEDAYEEN OR COMMUNIST INFLUENCE DURING THIS STAY. RESTAURANTS WERE OPEN BUT NOT SERVING BEER OR WESTERN FOOD, ONLY IRANIAN FOOD. CITY'S MAIN HOUSE OF PLEASURE WAS ALSO OPEN AND CROWDED, BUT ONLY DURING DAYLIGHT HOURS. MANY TRUCKS WERE PARKED IDLE THROUGHOUT THE CITY AND MANY SHOPS REMAINED CLOSED.

THERE WAS SUFFICIENT ACTIVITY IN THE OIL FIELDS, HOWEVER, FOR HIM TO BELIEVE RAOOFI'S CLAIM THAT PRODUCTION WAS UP TO 3.5 MILLION LEVEL HE COULD REACH WITHOUT A MINIMUM OF THIRTY EXPATRIATES, RETURN OF WHOM HE HAD ASKED HIS COMMITTEE TO APPROVE. IT HAS NOT YET DONE SO. SANTA FE VP SAID VERY FEW EXPATRIATES WERE IN EVIDENCE IN AHWAZ OUTSIDE OF TEAM OF FRENCH HELICOPTER PILOTS WORKING FOR DUTCH HELICOPTER FIRM AND ONE ENGLISHMAN.

VP SAID HE EXPECTED SANTA FE WOULD INITIATE FORMAL ARBITRATION PROCEEDINGS IN LONDON UNDER ITS CONTRACT IN ORDER TO WORK OUT CANCELLATION SETTLEMENT. IN MEANTIME, HE HAD REASONABLE HOPE SANTA FE WOULD BE ABLE TO ARRANGE FOR DISASSEMBLY OF ITS SIX REGS BY A RESIDUAL TEAM OF LOCAL EMPLOYEES AND THEN RE-EXPORT BY TRUCK THROUGH KUWAIT. HE SAID IT WAS GENERALLY ACCEPTED THAT SANTA FE'S SOPHISTICATED RIGS COULD NOT BE OPERATED WITHOUT SOME EXPATRIATE ASSISTANCE.

FOR TEHRAN: SINCE MANAMA IS UNDERSTABDABLY NOT RECIPIENT OF ALL REPORTING ON IRAN, WOULD APPRECIATE TEHRAN'S ASSESSMENT OF VALUE OF THIS ACCOUNT AND WHETHER IT WOULD BE USEFUL FOR US TO TRY TO DEBRIEF OTHER U.S. BUSINESSMEN PASSING THROUGH BAHRAIN FROM IRAN.

1979NEWDE18566.subject: V.K. AHUJA NAMED INDIAN AMBASSADOR TO JAPAN

segments.text: (U) THE GOVERNMENT OF INDIA ANNOUNCED SEPTEMBER 22 THAT VISHNU KALYANDAS AHUJA, INDIAN AMBASSADOR TO IRAN, HAS BEEN REASSIGNED AS AMBASSADOR TO JAPAN, REPLACING AVTAR SINGH.

(C) AHUJA HOLDS AN M.A. DEGREE IN ECONOMICS FROM BOMBAY UNIVERSITY. HE JOINED THE INDIAN FOREIGN SERVICE IN AUGUST 1948 AND SOON WENT ON HIS FIRST TOUR IN MOSCOW (1949-52). HE BROKE HIS ASSIGNMENT THERE TO ATTEND THE SCHOOL OF ORIENTAL STUDIES AT LONDON UNVERSITY FOR SEVERAL MONTHS. IN ADDITION TO MOSCOW, AHUJA HAS SERVED ABROAD IN PARIS, BANGKOK, WELLINGTON, NEW YORK AND TEHRAN. HE HAS PARTICIPATED IN CONFERENCES OF UNCTAD, THE UNGA, THE UN ECONOMIC COUNCIL FOR ASIA AND THE FAR EAST AND THE NON-ALIGNED MOVEMENT.

(C) CAREER HIGHLIGHTS: 1958-59 CHARGE D'AFFAIRES, MOSCOW 1965-66 DIRECTOR OF FOREIGN TRADE, MINISTRY OF COMMERCE. 1966-68 JOINT SECRETARY, MINISTRY OF COMMERCE 1968-72 CONSUL GENERAL, NEW YORK; CONCURRENTLY ACCREDITED AS AMBASSADOR TO COSTA RICA 1972-75 AMBASSADOR TO ROMANIA 1975-76 ADDITIONAL SECRETARY FOR WEST ASIA, MINISTRY OF EXTERNAL AFFAIRS (MEA) 1976-78 SECRETARY FOR ECONOMIC RELATIONS, MEA 1978-79 AMBASSADOR TO IRAN

(C) AN EXPERIENCED DIPLOMAT, AHUJA IS A SOVIET AFFAIRS SPECIALIST WHO HAS HAD TWO THREE-YEAR TOURS IN MOSCOW AND IS ONE OF THE FEW OFFICERS IN THE MINISTRY WHO SPEAK RUSSIAN. LONG EXPOSURE TO SOVIET AFFAIRS AND CULTURE HAS GIVEN HIM A NOTICEABLE PRO-SOVIET BIAS, A SLANT HE READILY ADMITS. HE NEVERTHELESS APPEARS TO HOLD NO DEEP IDEOLOGICAL CONVICTIONS; DURING THE 1950'S AND 1960'S HIS VIEWS SHIFTED WITH THE PREVAILING POLITICAL WINDS IN INDIA. ALWAYS CORDIAL AND FRIENDLY TO AMERICANS, HE ADMIRES THE U.S., BUT CAN BE HIGHLY CRITICAL OF U.S. POLICIES.
AHUJA HAS A FLAIR FOR CLEAR AND INCISIVE ARGUMENT, BUT MAY REFUSE TO ADMIT ERROR EVEN WHEN CONFRONED BY OVERWHELMING EVIDENCE. HE IS INTELLIGENT, CAPABLE AND AMBITIOUS.

(C) AHUJA, 51, IS MARRIED TO THE FORMER AMEENA AHMAD, AN ANGO-INDIAN WHO WAS ONCE A RUSSIAN INTERPRETER IN MEA. THE COUPLE HAS ONE SON. IN ADDITION TO RUSSIAN AND SINDHI,HIS MOTHER TONGUE, AHUJA SPEAKS FRENCH, ENGLISH AND HINDI. GOHEEN

1979NEWDE18649.subject: A. M. KHALEELI APPOINTED AMBASSADOR TO IRAN

segments.text: (U) THE GOVERNMENT OF INDIA ANNOUNCED SEPTEMBER 20 THE APPOINTMENT OF AKBAR MIRZA KHALEELI, CHIEF OF PROTOCOL IN THE MINISTRY OF EXTERNAL AFFAIRS (MEA), AS AMBASSADOR TO IRAN. HE WILL SUCCEED V. K. AHUJA WHO HAS BEEN NAMED ENVOY TO JAPAN.

(C) KHALEELI, BORN SEPTEMBER 10,1936, JOINED THE INDIAN FOREIGN SERVICE IN 1959. HE HAS SERVED AS THIRD SECRETARY IN BAGHDAD (1960-62); SECOND SECRETARY AND THEN FIRST SECRETARY IN COLOMBO (1962-65); UNDER SECRETARY (NORTHERN DIVISION), MEA (1965-67); FIRST SECRETARY AT APRIS (1967-70); COUNSELOR AT AMMAN (1970-73); DIRECTOR (WEST ASIA AND NORTH AFRICA DIVISION, MEA (1973-76); AND JOINT SECRETARY (ADMINISTRATION DIVISION), MEA (1976-78). HE WAS CHIEF OF PROTOCOL, MEA FROM 1978 UNTIL HIS RECENT APPOINTMENT AS AMBASSADOR TO IRAN.

(C) CONFERENCE WORK: ATTENDED INDO-IRAQI TRADE HALKS IN 1961; DELEGATE TO PREPARATORY MEETING OF SECOND NON-ALIGNED CONFERENCE IN COLOMBO, MARCH 1964; PARTICIPATED IN INDO -SRI LANKAN OFFICIAL LEVEL NEGOTIATIONS ON PROBLEM OF STATELESS PERSONS OF INDIAN ORIGIN, 1964; DELEGATE TO INDO-NEPALESE BORDER TRADE TALKS, JULY 1970.
(C) KHALEELI AND HIS WIFE SHAKEREH HAVE THREE DAUGHTERS, THE OLDEST OF WHOM IS ABOUT 13. IN ADDITION TO ENGLISH, KHALEELI SPEAKS ARABIC, PERSIAN, U DU AND HINDI. HE ALSO KNOWS SOME FRENCH AND TAMIL.

(C) AMONG HIS MEA COLLEAGUES, KHALEELI HAS A REPUTATION OF BEING STRICTLY BY THE BOOK. AS JOINT SECRETARY OF ADMINISTRATION, HE IRRITATED SOME BY HIS RIGID, UNCOMPROMISING APPLICATION OF THE REGULATION. HE ALSO FOLLOWED A MORE INFLEXIBLE LINE THAN HIS PREDECESSOR AS CHIEF OF PROTOCOL IN DEALING WITH SUCH MATTERS AS IMPORT PRIVILEGES FOR THE DIPLOMATIC COMMUNITY. KHALEELI DOES, HOWEVER, POSSESS A SENSE OF HUMOR, ALBEIT A SOMEWHAT AUSTERE ONE. HE APPEARS TO BE A VERY ORTHODOX MUSLIM, WHICH IS PROBABLY ONE OF THE REASONS HE WAS SELECTED TO GO AS AMBASSADOR TO TEHRAN.
REPORTEDLY, HE HAD BEEN SLATED EARLIER TO BE AMBASSADOR TO SAUDI ARABIA, BUT WAS CHANGED INSTEAD TO IRAN. GOHEEN

1979PARIS02604.subject: MESSAGE TO PRESIDENT CARTER FROM KHOMEINI PASSED THROUGH TWO BUSINESSMEN

segments.text: PASSED THROUGH TWO BUSINESSMEN (S) ENTIRE TEXT.

SUMMARY. TWO BUSINESSMEN, ONE OF THEM AMERICAN, HAVE BEEN GIVEN A MESSAGE FOR PRESIDENT CARTER, APPARENTLY FROM KHOMEINI, ASKING THE PRESIDENT TO USE HIS INFLUENCE WITH THE IRANIAN MILITARY TO LET KHOMEINI LAND IN TEHRAN. END SUMMARY.
ON EVENING OF JANUARY 24, LEONARD FREEMAN AND

NOURBAKHSH (BOTH OF WHOM HAD TALKED WITH AN EMBOFF SEVERAL WEEKS AGO FOLLOWING AN EARLIER MEETING WITH KHOMEINI) CONTACTED EMBASSY AND REQUESTED URGENT MEETING. DURING INTERVIEW WITH EMBOFF, PAIR SAID THEY HAD SEEN AYOTOLLAH KHOMEINI FOR ONE HOUR THAT AFTERNOON AND THEN WENT BACK AGAIN WHEN THEY LEARNED TEHRAN AIRPORT CLOSED. DURING SECOND MEETING AT KHOMEINI'S RESIDENCE, KHOMEINI'S AIDE ESHRAGHI BROUGHT OUT MESSAGE WHICH HE DESIRED PASSED TO PRESIDENT CARTER ON MOST URGENT BASIS. MESSAGE, IDENTIFIED AS BEING FROM KHOMEINI HIMSELF, IS AS FOLLOWS: BEGIN TEXT . PLEASE TELL PRESIDENT CARTER THAT REGARDLESS WHAT WILL HAPPEN IN IRAN, THAT THE IRANIAN PEOPLE WILL UNDERSTAND THAT THE U.S.

POLICY BROUGHT THE SITUATION TO WHERE IT NOW STANDS. I GIVE MY WORD TO PRESIDENT CARTER THA IF HE USES HIS INFLUENCE TO QUIET DOWN THE MILITARY AND IF THEY ALLOW ME TO LAND SAFELY AND THERE ARE NO DEMONSTRATIONS OR VIOLENCE, I WILL PERSONALLY NEGOTIATE WITH THE IRANIAN GENERALS AND WILL SOLVE THE DIFFERENCES TO THE BEST INTEREST OF IRAN AND THE UNITED STATES GOVERNMENT. UNQUOTE. .

DURING HOUR LONG SESSION, ACCORDING TO TWO MEN, KHOMEINI INSISTED THAT HE WILL LEAVE FOR IRAN AS SCHEDULED ON EVENING JANUARY 25. KHOMEINI SAID THAT THE NEW GOVERNMENT WILL BE NON-COMMUNIST AND HE CAN ASSURE U.S. THAT IT WILL BE COMPOSED OF MEMBERS THE U.S. WILL APPROVE OF.

FREEMAN AND NOURBAKHSH SAID THAT KHOMEINI OBVIOUSLY VERY CONCERNED ABOUT THE DEVELOPING SITUATION BUT IS PREPARED TO GO FORWARD ON A CONFRONTATION WITH THE MILITARY IF HE MUST. HE WOULD PREFER A PEACEFUL NEGOTIATION WITH ALL FACES SAVED. IF KHOMEINI IS KILLED, THEY SAID, CHANCES FOR A CIVIL WAR IN IRAN ARE CERTAIN AND LIVES OF AMERICANS IN IRAN ARE IN JEOPARDY. KHOMEINI BELIEVES PRESIDENT CARTER HAS INFLUENCE OVER THE IRANIAN MILITARY AND CAN PLAY A ROLE TO OBTAIN A PEACEFUL SOLUTION IN THE INTEREST OF THE UNITED STATES AND IRAN.
FREEMAN'S CARD IDENTIFIES HIM AS PRESIDENT OF GLT INDUSTRIES, INC., 411 CLINTON AVE., NORTHVALE, N.J. NOUBAKHSH'CARD IDENTIFIES HIM AS CONNECTED WITH AMTRON INDUSTRIES, P.O. BOX 237, JERICHO, N.Y.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

AS REQUESTED REFTEL, WE DISCUSSED THE CURRENT IRANIAN SITUATION WITH FREDERIC BALEINE DE LAURENS, FOREIGN MINISTRY OFFICIAL RESPONSIBLE FOR IRAQ AND IRANIAN AFFAIRS. (HE IS PROBABLY THE FOREIGN MINISTRY OFFICIAL MOST KNOWLEDGEABLE OF IRANIAN DEVELOPMENTS.) FROM OUR DISCUSSION IT APPEARS THAT THE FRENCH CONFRONT THE SAME DIFFICULTY AS OTHER WESTERN COUNTRIES IN OBTAINING HARD INFORMATION ON WHAT IS HAPPENING IN IRAN. PERHAPS AS A RESULT OF FRENCH HOSPITALITY TO KHOMEINI THE FRENCH AMBASSADOR DOES, HOWEVER, APPEAR TO BE GETTING FAIRLY GOOD ACCESS TO NEW REGIME FIGURES.

LAURENS SAID THAT THE CURRENT IRANIAN SITUATION IS GENERALLY BADLY ANALYZED IN THE WESTERN PRESS BECAUSE OF A NATURAL WESTERN TENDENCY TO CONSIDER EVENTS IN FAMILIAR TERMS. THUS THE ERRONEOUS (IN HIS VIEW) ASSUMPTION OF A CONFLICT BETWEEN THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT AND KHOMEINI AND THE COMMITTEES. LAURENS SAID THAT DESPITE INSTANCES OF FRICTION THERE IS NO ESSENTIAL CONFLICT. THE GOVERNMENT HAS A RESPONSIBILITY FOR DAYTO-DAY MATTERS, UNDERSTANDS ITS FUNCTION, AND LOOKS TO KHOMEINI FOR DIRECTION ON POLICY MATTERS. LAURENS ALSO DISCOUNTED STORIES OF CONFLICT BETWEEN BAZARGAN AND KHOMEINI. BAZARGAN, HE SAID, TRAVELS TO QOM AT LEAST WEEKLY AND HAS DETAILED DISCUSSIONS WITH KHOMEINI.

HE FOUND IT SIGNIFICANT THAT ON A NUMBER OF OCCASIONS BAZARGAN HAS BEEN ABLE TO GET KHOMEINI TO DROP OR MODIFY PREVIOUS POSITIONS OR TO SPEAK OUT ON ISSUES WHICH NEED CLARIFICATION. IN THIS REGARD HE SAID THAT ONE OF THE PROBLEMS FACING THE GOVERNMENT AND THE REVOLUTIONARY REGIME IN GENERAL IS TO GET KHOMEINI TO FOCUS ON PRACTICAL MATTERS AND NOT JUST THE SPIRITUAL. HE SUGGESTED THAT THE DESIRE TO FORCE KHOMEINI TO FACE UP TO A SITUATION OF INDISCIPLINE AMONG THE COMMITTEES MIGHT HAVE BEEN AN IMPORTANT ASPECT OF TALEGHANI'S DECISION TO DROP OUT OF SIGHT FOR A TIME.
IN THIS CONNECTION, LAURENS ALSO DISCOUNTED FOR THE MOMENT SERIOUS DISCORD AMONGST THE SENIOR CLERGY.

LAURENS SAID THAT KHOMEINI WAS NOT LIVING AT QOM IN A RELIGIOUS-ORIENTED WORLD TOTALLY DETACHED FROM REALITY. IN ADDITION TO THE REGULAR VISITS OF BAZARGAN AND OTHER GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS LAURENS CITED AS ILLUSTRATIVE THE FACT THAT KHOMEINI'S TRANSLATOR AT HIS RECENT MEETING WITH THE FRENCH AMBASSADOR WAS A VERY BRIGHT YOUNG MAN WHO HAD DONE HIS UNDERGRADUATE STUDIES IN FRANCE AND GRADUATE WORK IN THE US. LAURENS DID NOT GIVE DETAILSOF THE FRENCH AMBASSADOR'S MEETING WITH KHOMEINI BUT SAID THAT KHOMEINI HAD MOSTLY TALKED IN AN UNEXCEPTIONAL WAY OF HIS VISION FOR AN ISLAMIC IRAN.

ON THE POSITION OF DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER YAZDI, LAURENS SAID THAT IT WAS UNIQUE. HE IS MORE THAN JUST A LINK BETWEEN KHOMEINI AND THE GOVERNMENT (AN UNNECESSARY FUNCTION GIVEN BARZAGAN'S ACCESS TO KHOMEINI) AND ALSO MORE THAN A DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER IN THE NORMAL SENSE OF A FUNCTIONARY CONCERNED WITH THE DETAILS OF GOVERNMENT.

(AT THE TIME OF OUR CONVERSATION YAZDI HAD NOT YET BEEN NAMED FOREIGN MINISTER.) IN LAURENS' VIEW YAZDI TYPIFIES THOSE PEOPLE ABOUT WHOM WE KNOW RELATIVELY LITTLE BUT WHO ARE SHAPING THE FUTURE IRAN AND ARE LIKELY TO EMERGE AS ITS TRUE RULERS WHEN THE NEW REGIME TAKES A MORE COHERENT FORM--WHICH COULD BE A MATTER OF MONTHS OR EVEN YEARS.

IN THIS SENSE, YAZDI SHOULD NOT BE SEEN AS A RIVAL TO BAZARGAN BUT HIS EQUAL. ------------------107511 280121Z /15 FM AMEMBASSY PARIS TO SECSTATE WASHDC 8680 INFO AMEMBASSY TEHRAN AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY BONN AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD SECTION 02 OF 02 PARIS 13410 REFERRING TO A RECENT CALL BY THE FRENCH AMBASSADOR ON YAZDI, LAURENS SAID THAT THE AMBASSADOR HAD BEEN STRUCK BY THE ATMOSPHERE OF PURPOSEFUL CALM AND SELF-ASSURANCE WHICH PREVAILED IN YAZDI'S OFFICE WHICH WAS IN SUCH MARKED CONTRAST TO THE INDISCIPLINE AND DISORDER FOUND IN MOST OTHER GOVERNMENT OFFICES.

YAZDI HAS GIVEN THE FRENCH AMBASSADOR THE IMPRESSION THAT HE IS PREOCCUPIED WITH QUESTIONS OF SECURITY; DURING THEIR LAST MEETING HE SPOKE OF REBUILDING THE ARMY MAKING EXTENSIVE USE OF THE NCO'S OF THE PRESENT ARMY AS CADRE. LAURENS SAID THAT THIS CONVERSATION ALSO TOUCHED ON THE NEW CONSTITUTION. YAZDI SAID THAT THE PLEBISCITE ON IT MIGHT NOT TAKE PLACE UNTIL JULY AND IMPLIED THAT THE PROCESS OF ESTABLISHING A NEW REGIME MIGHT SLIP OVER THE STAGE OF A CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY AS UNNECESSARY AND PROCEED DIRECTLY TO ELECTIONS FOR A PARLIAMENT UNDER THE NEW CONSTITUTION.

FRENCH INFORMATION ON DEVELOPMENTS OUTSIDE TEHRAN IS SKETCHY. ON THE SITUATION IN THE OIL INSTALLATIONS, LAURENS SAID THAT THE GOF HAS THE IMPRESSION THAT THE GOVERNMENT'S CONTROL OVER IRAN'S PETROLEUM POLICIES MAY BE SOMEWHAT TENUOUS. HE HAD NOTED SEVERAL INSTANCES WHERE SUPPOSEDLY RESPONSIBLE OFFICIALS HAD BEEN OBLIGED NOT ONLY TO MODIFY POSITIONS THEY HAD TAKEN BUT IN SOME INSTANCES EVEN TO DENY THEY HAD SAID ANYTHING AT ALL WHEN CONFRONTED WITH THE OPPOSITION OF THE STRONGLY LEFTIST-DOMINATED COMMITTEES CONTROLING OIL PRODUCTION. FROM THIS HE CONCLUDES THAT IRAN'S OIL POLICIES ARE LIKELY TO HAVE A RATHER LARGE IDEOLOGICAL CONTENT FOR THE FORESEEABLE FUTURE.

COMMENT AND ACTION REQUESTED: GIVEN THE PRESENT APPARENTLY RELATIVELY GOOD FRENCH ACCESS TO IRANIAN OFFICIALS THE FRENCH MIGHT BE ABLE TO PROVIDE SOME USEFUL INFORMATION OR INTERESTING ALTERNATIVE INTERPRETATIONS OF DEVELOPMENTS BOTH TO EMBASSY TEHRAN AND HERE IN PARIS. IN DISCUSSING THE QUESTION HERE WE WOULD FOR OBVIOUS REASONS LIKE TO MAKE IT A TWO-WAY STREET. WE HOPE THE DEPARTMENT WILL BE ABLE TO GIVE US MATERIALS WHICH WE CAN PASS TO THE FRENCH. IN THIS REGARD, WOULD THE DEPARTMENT AND EMBASSY TEHRAN AUTHORIZE US TO SHARE WITH THE FRENCH THE INTERESTING ANALYSIS CONTAINED TEHRAN 4302 (LOOKING AHEAD: THE BEDROCK PROBLEMS) SANITIZED AND CAVEATED AS NECESSARY?
THE FRENCH HAVE A VERY GOOD RECORD IN PROTECTING INFORMATION OF THIS SORT PASSED TO THEM ON A CONFIDENTIAL BASIS.

1979PARIS15005.subject: KHOMEINY ACCUSES U.S. OF BEING BEHIND ASSASSINA- TIONS OF GHARANI AND MOUHTARI IN INTERVIEW WITH LE MONDE CORRESPONDENT

segments.text: TIONS OF GHARANI AND MOUHTARI IN INTERVIEW WITH LE MONDE CORRESPONDENT

LE MONDE OF MAY 10 FRONT PAGES AN INTERVIEW ACCORDED BY AYATOLLAH KHOMEINY TO ITS MIDDLE EAST CORRESPONDENT, ERIC ROULEAU. ROULEAU DOES NOT GIVE A DATE FOR THE INTERVIEW WHICH TOOK PLACE AT KHOMEINY'S HOUSE IN QOM. IN THE INTERVIEW KHOMEINY ACCUSES "U.S. AGENTS" OF RESPONSIBILITY FOR THE ASSASSINATIONS OF GENERAL GHARANI AND AYATOLLAH MOUHTARI. ROULEAU DESCRIBES KHOMEINY AS ONE OF THE MOST DIFFICULT POLITICAL FIGURES TO INTERVIEW AND SOMEONE WHO WOULD RATHER LISTEN THAN TALK. THIS PROBABLY EXPLAINS WHY RELATIVELY LITTLE OF ROULEAU'S LENGTHY ARTICLE CONSISTS OF KHOMEINY'S REMARKS.

ROULEAU DESCRIBES KHOMEINY AS "PROFOUNDLY PREOCCUPIED" AND "WORN OUT FROM MONTHS OF EFFORT." THE DIRECT QUOTES FROM KHOMEINY ARE REPEATED IN PARAGRAPH TWO. COMPLETE TEXT OF ARTICLE BEING POUCHED TO DEPARTMENT AND TEHRAN.

BEGIN KHOMEINY QUOTES --"I ACCUSE AMERICAN AGENTS OF HAVING HAD ASSASSINATED GENERAL GHARANI AND AYATOLLAH MOUHTARI. THESE ARE THE SAME WHO SERVED THE SHAH AND WHO HIDE BEHIND FORGHAN, A PSEUDO-RELIGIOUS ORGANIZATION. WE HAVE NOTED THAT THE MEMBERS OF THIS ORGANIZATION WHO HAVE JUST BEEN ARRESTED KNOW NOTHING OF ISLAM." --IN REPLY TO A QUESTION WHY, IF THIS IS THE CASE, DEMONSTRATORS AT MOUHTARI'S FUNERAL ACCUSED THE COMMUNISTS OF RESPONSIBILITY. "THE LEFT, ONE OF THE POLITICAL TENDENCIES OF OUR COUNTRY IS A STRANGER TO THESE CRIMES.

AYATOLLAH RAFSANDJANI DID NOT ATTACK THE COMMUNISTS, BUT ONLY THOSE WHO HAVE PUT ON THE MASK OF THE LEFT IN ORDER BETTER TO SERVE AMERICAN IMPERIALISM." --ON THE MASS MEDIA. "WE ARE AWARE OF SERIOUS GAPS WHICH SHOW IN THE WRITTEN PRESS AND ON RADIO AND TELEVISION. THE CENSORSHIP WHICH CERTAIN UNCONTROLLED GROUPS EXERCISE IS NEITHER TOTAL NOR SYSTEMATIC. WE HAVE EXPRESSED THE DESIRE THAT THIS MATTER BE PROGRESSIVELY RESOLVED." --CONCERNING IRAN'S MINORITIES. "WE ARE PERSUADED THAT THE NATIONALIST MINORITIES OF OUR COUNTRY ARE NOT MOTIVATED BY AN INCLINATION TOWARDS SEPARATISM. THEIR ASPIRATIONS AND OBJECTIVES ARE OURS AND WE HOPE RAPIDLY TO REACH AGREEMENT...

WE HAVE NOT BEEN ABLE TO CONTROL COMPLETELY OUR FRONTIERS WHICH REMAIN SUSCEPTIBLE TO INFILTRATION FROM ABROAD OF FOREIGN AGENTS AND MASSIVE QUANTITIES OF ARMS." --AFTER SAYING THAT ECONOMIC PROBLEMS WERE A PREOCCUPATION BECAUSE THEY AROUSE POPULAR DISCONTENT. "I COUNT ON THE PATRIOTISM OF THE IRANIANS AND THEIR SOLIDARITY IN THE FACE OF THE INTRIQUES AND MALFEASANCE OF OUR ENEMIES INTERNALLY AND IN THE WEST TO GIVE THE GOVERNMENT TIME TO RESOLVE THE PROBLEMS." --ON RELATIONS WITH FRANCE. "I HOPE THAT FRANCE, FAITHFUL TO ITS WISH FOR INDEPENDENCE, WILL NOT ASSOCIATE ITSELF WITH THE PLOTS HATCHED BY OTHER POWERS AGAINST THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION.
IT IS AT THIS PRICE THAT GOOD RELATIONS BETWEEN OUR TWO COUNTRIES CAN BE MAINTAINED AND DEVELOPED."

FORMER IRANIAN PRIME MINISTER SHAPOUR BAKHTIAR HAS SURFACED IN PARIS, WHERE HE HELD A PRESS CONFERENCE ON JULY 31. AUTHORIZED FRENCH SOURCES TOLD THE PRESS THAT BAKHTIAR HAD ARRIVED IN PARIS WITHOUT A VISA (IRANIANS ARE NOT REQUIRED TO HAVE VISAS TO ENTER FRANCE) AND AS A PRIVATE VISITOR COULD STAY THREE MONTHS HERE, AFTER WHICH HE COULD APPLY FOR AN EXTENSION. UNDER FRENCH LAW AS LONG AS HE DOES NOT DISTURB THE PUBLIC ORDER, BAKHTIR CAN MAKE PUBLIC STATEMENTS.

HIGHLIGHTS OF BAKHTIAR'S PRESS CONFERENCE, AS CARRIED BY AP AND AFP, WERE AS FOLLOWS: (A) HE HAS NO PLANS TO RETURN TO IRAN, TO FORM A GOVERNMENT IN EXILE, OR TO FOUND AN OPPOSITION POLITICAL PARTY OUTSIDE IRAN. HE WILL RETURN TO IRAN "AS SOON AS POSSIBLE, AS SOON AS THERE IS A MINIMUM OF LIBERTY AND A MINIMUM GUARANTEE OF SECURITY." (B) BAKHTIAR SAID HE WAS FOR "POPULAR SOVEREIGNTY, WITH THE PEOPLE FREELY CHOOSING THEIR DESTINY.

WHAT WE ARE FIGHTING FOR IS LIBERTY, IN THE FULL SENSE OF THE WORD, AND INDEPENDENCE, IN THE TRUE SENSE OF THE WORD." (C) HE WOULD NOT PRESENT A LIST OF CANDIDATES IN THE COMING ELECTIONS. "I DON'T BELIEVE IN THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC," HE SAID, "SO WHY SHOULD I PRESENT CANDIDATES." (D) ADDRESSING THE "SAD PICTURE" OF THE PRESENT SITUATION IN IRAN, BAKHTIAR SAID, "THERE HAS BEEN A VERY GREAT MISUNDERSTANDING BETWEEN KHOMEINI AND THE LIVING FORCES OF THE NATION.

HE IS FIGHTING TO ESTABLISH AN ISLAMIC REGIME OF A VERY, VERY SPECIAL TYPE." "WHAT CAUSES THE PROBLEMS OF THE PRESENT IRANIAN GOVERNMENT IS THAT IT DOESN'T KNOW WHAT IT WANTS." BAKHTIAR ALSO REFERRED TO THE "FALLING APART OF THE COUNTRY," "THE NONEXISTENT AUTHORITY OF THE CENTRAL GOVERNMENT," AND SAID THE MULLAHS SHOULD GO "BACK TO THE MOSQUES." "WE DO NOT HAVE A STATE, NO CENTRAL IDEA ON WHAT COULD BE THE BASIS OF THE REVOLUTION." "NO RELIGIOUS PERSONALITY CAN PUT THE COUNTRY BACK ON ITS FEET.
WE HAVE NEITHER INDEPENDENCE NOR LIBERTY." (E) ON EXECUTION OF HOVEIDA, BAKHTIAR SAID, "EVEN THOUGH HE WAS A VERY GREAT CRIMINAL, HE WAS NOT KILLED AFTER A NORMAL JUDGMENT.

HE WAS PUT TO DEATH; THAT IS DIFFERENT." ------------------060697 311723Z /42 FM AMEMBASSY PARIS TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 3590 INFO AMEMBASSY TEHRAN IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY BONN AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW USINT BAGHDAD USMISSION USNATO (F) BAKHTIAR WOULD NOT DISCUSS HIS ACTIVITIES SINCE HIS DISAPPEARANCE, NOR WHERE HE HAS BEEN DURING THIS TIME "SO AS NOT TO COMPROMISE THOSE WHO HELPED ME." HE SAID ONLY THAT HE HAD "FOUGHT FOR MY COUNTRY AS I HAVE DONE FOR THIRTY YEARS." HE SAID HE HAD HAD NO CONTACT WITH THE SHAH, NOR WITH KARIM SANDJABI SINCE HIS DEPARTURE FROM IRAN.

HE DID SAY HE HAD BEEN IN TOUCH WITH HIS PARTISANS IN IRAN DURING THIS TIME. (G) BAKHTIAR SAID HE HAD NO PLANS TO SEE GISCARD OR FONMIN FRANCOIS-PONCET, UNLESS THEY WISHED TO SEE HIM. HE ADDED THAT FRENCH POLICY TOWARD IRAN HAD BEEN ONE OF NON-INTERFERENCE AND WAS THUS IRREPROACHABLE. (H) BAKHTIAR SUMMARIZED AS FOLLOWS: "THERE IS NO GOVERNMENT IN IRAN AT PRESENT IN THE REAL SENSE OF THE WORD, BUT MR. YAZDI IS STRONGER THAN THE OTHERS.

WHAT WE HAVE LOST DURING A YEAR OF DEMONSTRATIONS AND CHAOS IS FAR GREATER THAN EVERYTHING WHICH WAS WASTED DURING THE REIGN OF THE SHAH, AND TO MAKE THE COUNTRY WORK AGAIN WILL TAKE YEARS AND YEARS. DURING 25 YEARS WE FOUGHT FOR LIBERTY AND INDEPENDENCE. NOW WE HAVE NEITHER LIBERTY NOR INDEPENDENCE. THE REVOLUTION HAS BEEN TRANSFORMED INTO A SHAMBLES."

1979PARIS24739.subject: FORMER IRANIAN MINISTER FORESEES COUP ATTEMPT IN IRAN

segments.text: IN IRAN (S-ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY: FORMER IRANIAN MINISTER OF HOUSING AND DEVELOPMENT, HOUSHANG NAHAVANDI, TOLD US JULY 28 THAT RESENTMENT WAS BUILDING UP AGAINST THE PRESENT IRANIAN REGIME, AND WOULD GROW WORSE. HE CITED THE KURDS AS ONE OF THE ONLY MILITARY FORCES IN THE COUNTRY, WITH THE ARMED SERVICES IN GENERAL DECAY. HE FORESAW A COUP ATTEMPT "BY CERTAIN GENERALS" ABOUT SIX TO EIGHT WEEKS FROM NOW, WITH SUPPORT FROM THE KURDS. UNLESS THIS SUCCEEDS, NAHAVANDI FORESEES DEEPER CHAOS AND EVENTUALLY A COMMUNIST TAKEOVER. END SUMMARY.

HOUSHANG NAHAVANDI, FORMER MINISTER OF HOUSING AND DEVELOPMENT (ABOUT 1966) AND LATER CHANCELLOR OF TEHRAN UNIVERSITY (FROM 1971 UNTIL END OF THE SHAH'S REGIME) SAW EMBASSY'S CULTURAL AFFAIRS OFFICER, A PERSONAL FRIEND, ON JULY 28. NAHAVANDI, WHO WAS AWARE THAT HIS VIEWS WOULD BE REPORTED, GAVE A LENGTHY ANALYSIS OF THE SITUATION IN IRAN. HE EXPLAINED THAT FOLLOWING THE SHAH'S DOWNFALL HE WENT INTO HIDING AND LEFT IRAN THROUGH KURDISTAN, WHERE HE HAD BROAD CONTACTS WITH KURD LEADERS, AND TURKEY.

NAHAVANDI DESCRIBED THE SITUATION IN IRAN AS BAD AND DETERIORATING, AND THOUGHT NORMAL PERSIAN HABITS AND CONSUMER PRESSURES WOULD BE MAJOR FACTORS IN TOPPLING THE PRESENT GOVERNMENT, AFTER WHICH CHAOS COULD DEEPEN. HE DESCRIBED TUDEH AS TOO SMART TO LEAP INTO THE BREACH AT THIS TIME, BUT CAREFULLY BURROWING INTO KEY SECTORS, INCLUDING THE MILITARY, AND WATCHING FOR THE RIGHT TIME. THE RIGHT TIME FOR TUDEH IS NOT NOW BECAUSE OF A FAIRLY HEAVY ANTI-COMMUNIST TINGE AMONG THE POPULATION AT PRESENT. BUT A PERIOD OF FURTHER CHAOS COULD MAKE THE COMMUNISTS MORE APPEALING.

NAHAVANDI DESCRIBED THE KURDS AS HEAVILY ARMED (ABOUT 10,000 MEN UNDER ARMS, HE SAID), ORGANIZED, AND IN CONTROL OF A 100-150 KILOMETER WIDE STRIP OF LAND ALONG THE TURKISH AND IRAQUI BORDER. HE THOUGHT IT WOULD BE VIRTUALLY IMPOSSIBLE TO DISLODGE THEM, ESPECIALLY GIVEN THE GENERAL DECAY OF THE IRANIAN ARMED FORCES. HE ALSO SPECULATED ON WHERE THE KURDS WERE GETTING THEIR FINANCIAL SUPPORT (FROM ISRAEL AND SAUDI ARABIA, HE THOUGHT).

NAHAVANDI REFERRED TO A SPECIFIC MILITARY COUP IN PREPARATION, TIMED, HE BELIEVED FOR ABOUT SIX-EIGHT WEEKS FROM NOW. THIS IS TO BE LED BY "CERTAIN GENERALS" AND, IF SUCCESSFUL, COULD AVOID CHAOS AND EVENTUAL COMMUNIST TAKEOVER. NAHAVANDI SEEMED TO THINK THE KURDS WOULD PROVIDE MILITARY SUPPORT FOR THIS COUP, IN RETURN FOR WHICH THEY HOPE TO RECEIVE GREATER AUTONOMY (PRINCIPALLY EDUCATION IN KURDISH, AND NO POLICE OR MILITARY IN KURDISTAN WHO ARE NOT KURDS). NAHAVANDI ADMITTED THERE WERE DANGERS IN THIS SCENARIO, BUT HE THOUGHT IT WAS LESS DANGEROUS THAN ONE MIGHT THINK.
IN ANY CASE, HE SAID, THERE WAS NO OTHER ORGANIZED BODY HE KNEW OF (OTHER THAN THE KURDS) IN IRAN AT THE PRESENT TIME.

NAHAVANDI DESCRIBED HIMSELF AS A MONARCHIST BUT NOT A ROYALIST. HE SAID HE THOUGHT IT IMPOSSIBLE FOR THE SHAH TO RETURN, BUT THAT THE BEST FORM OF GOVERNMENT FOR IRAN WOULD BE BRITISH-STYLE PARLIAMENTARY MONARCHY. HE PLANS TO REMAIN IN PARIS AND EVIDENTLY HOPES TO RALLY AN OPPOSITION NUCLEUS AROUND HIMSELF HERE. FULL MEMCON BY POUCH TO NEA/IRN. CHAPMAN

1979PARIS26015.subject: IRANIAN OPPOSITION PAPER TO BE PUBLISHED IN PARIS

segments.text: IN PARIS

LE MONDE OF AUGUST 17 CARRIES ITEM ANNOUNCING THAT IRANIAN OPPOSITION GROUPS IN PARIS, LED BY BAKHTIAR, WILL BEGIN PUBLISHING ON AUGUST 20 A DAILY PAPER CALLED NAMEH RROUZ (THE DAILY LETTER) UNDER THE DIRECTION OF JOURNALIST DJANAD ALAMIR, AMONG OTHERS.

THE NEW PAPER WILL BE EIGHT MIMEOGRAPHED PAGES IN PERSIAN AND WILL BE SENT TO 2,000 SUBSCRIBERS IN IRAN AS WELL AS 5,000 EMIGRES ELSEWHERE IN EUROPE. AN ENGLISH-LANGUAGE EDITION IS FORESEEN FOR PUBLICATION IN THE US NEXT FALL.
THE EDITORS OF THE PAPER CLAIM SUPPORT FROM SEVERAL LAIC GROUPS IN IRAN, INCLUDING THE NATIONAL DEMOCRATIC FRONT LED BY MATINE DAFTARI.

FORMER IRANIAN PRIME MINISTER SHAPOUR BAKHTIAR, WHO SURFACED IN PARIS ON JULY 31 (REFTEL), HAS SINCE THAT TIME BEEN LIBERAL IN HIS MEDIA APPEARANCES HERE. HIS COMMENTS HAVE FOLLOWED A FAIRLY CONSISTENT LINE, AND WE HAVE GROUPED TOGETHER BELOW SOME HIGHLIGHTS FROM HIS RECENT STATEMENTS, AS REPORTED ON TICKERS AND IN THE PARIS PRESS.
ON IRAN TODAY
"A COUNTRY IN COMPLETE DISINTEGRATION, ECONOMICALLY HEADED FOR BANKRUPTCY, SOCIALLY IN A STATE OF PERPETUAL AGITATION."
"THE IRANIAN PEOPLE ARE REALIZING MORE AND MORE THAT I WAS RIGHT, WHEN ALL MY FRIENDS, INCLUDING THOSE OF THE NATIONAL FRONT, WERE DEEPLY MISTAKEN."
ON THE ARMY: --KHOMEINI "HAS MAD IT COMMIT MASSACRES EVEN MORE CRUEL THAN THOSE WHICH THE SHAH ORDERED LAST YEAR."

"THE ARMY HAS BEEN HUMILIATED AND SHAKEN IN A VERY UNJUST MANNER BY KHOMEINI, AND IF IT IS NOT ONE HUNDRED PERCENT FOR ME, IT IS ONE HUNDRED PERCENT AGAINS KHOMEINI." BAKHTIAR AS PRIME MINISTER "HAD MORE AUTHORITY OVER THE ARMY THAN PREVIOUS PRIME MINISTERS."
"I DON'T THINK THE ARMY WILL SEIZE POWER. IT HAS NEVER DONE SO IN IRAN, WHERE THERE HAS NEVER BEEN A SOUTH AMERICAN STYLE COUP D'ETAT." ON THE USSR

THE USSR "WILL VERY SOON NEED GAS AND OIL. WE WILL AGAIN HAVE COMPLICATIONS ON THIS SUBJECT AND I AM SAD TO SEE THAT THE AMERICANS DO NOT UNDERSTAND THAT, AND THAT THEY STILL TOLERATE AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI AT THE HEAD OF IRAN." ON BAZARGAN

"ALTHOUGH I HAVE ALWAYS EXPRESSED AND MAINTAIN A CERTAIN SYMPATHY FOR HIM, HE HAS NOTHING MORE TO DO IN HIS POST AND SHOULD LEAVE IT AS QUICKLY AS POSSIBLE IF HE DOES NOT WANT TO BE MIXED UP IN THIS KILLING AND IN THIS RIDICULOUS WAY THAT KHOMEINI HAS OF MAKING HIMSELF OUT AS A CHIEF OF STATE AND A CLAIRVOYANT." ON KHOMEINI

"LIKE THE SHAH HE TALKS ABOUT ORDERING AND INSISTING AND TRIES WITH BRUTALITY TO ELIMINATE ALL RESISTANCE AND ALL OPPOSITION." "LIKE THE SHAH KHOMEINI IS FOR A SINGLE PARTY; HE THINKS HE IS INSPIRED."

"IT IS REGRETTABLE THAT A RELIGIOUS MAN WHO TALKS ABOUT GOD AND CLEMENCY TAKES AS HIS MISSION THE EXTERMINATION OF EVERYONE WHO IS NOT ENTIRELY UNDER HIS ORDERS AND WHO DOES NOT SUBMIT TO HIM WITHOUT CONDITIONS."

"KHOMEINI LIVES ON HIS OWN IDEAS, COMPLETELY ENCLOSED WITHIN HIS OWN POLITICAL RELIGIOUS OR OTHER ------------------037168 020750Z /16 FM AMEMBASSY PARIS TO SECSTATE WASHDC 4720 INFO AMEMBASSY TEHRAN UNCLAS SECTION 02 OF 02 PARIS 27231 CONVICTIONS," WHILE THE AYATOLLAH MADARI "FAVORS COLLABORATION, A COLLEGIAL LEADERSHIP." ON KHOMEINI'S FUTURE

"KHOMEINI HAS THE SUPPORT OF A PART OF THE FORCES OF ORDER, BUT HE HAS NO OTHER SUPPORT IN THE PRESENT GOVERNMENT. HIS FALL IS THEREFORE ABSOLUTELY MATHEMATICALLY VISIBLE. ONLY THE EXACT DATE AND THE WAY IN WHICH SUCH AND SUCH FACTOR WILL DOMINATE OTHERS IS DIFFICULT TO FORESEE."

"I DON'T THINK AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI CAN STAY IN POWER BEYOND JANUARY. CERTAINLY THINGS CAN HAPPEN FASTER, BUT THAT IS A LIMIT WHICH I THINK IS ABSOLUTELY INDISPENSABLE IF THE COUNTRY IS TO REMAIN THE SAME NATION."
"THE WORK WILL BE DONE BY KHOMEINI HIMSELF, WHO WILL BRING ABOUT HIS FALL HIMSELF."

"RECENT EVENTS SHOW THAT KHOMEINI'S POPULARITY IS FALLING AND THAT HIS WAY OF GOVERNING THE COUNTRY DOES NOT CORRESPOND TO ANY CRITERIA WHICH THE CIVILIZED WORLD ACCEPTS." "AN EXPLOSION, AN EXTREMELY RAPID CHANGE, IS INEVITABLE."

"ONE HAS TO EXPECT THAT, VERY SOON, EITHER KHOMEINI LIGHTENS HIS BALLAST, WHICH SEEMS EXTREMELY DIFFICULT FOR HIM, OR HE TIGHTENS THE PRESSURE, WHICH IS STILL AT THE LIMIT OF WHAT IS POSSIBLE." ON BAKHTIAR'S CONTACTS
HE HAS HAD "NO CONTACT WITH THE SHAH, NOR WITH ANY IRANIAN GENERAL IN EXILE." ON BAKHTIAR'S PLANS

"WE SHOULD ORGANIZE POLITICAL PARTIES WITHIN THE COUNTRY WHICH HAVE A NATIONAL AND DEMOCRATIC SENSE. THERE ARE MINISCULE GROUPS WHICH CONSIDER THEMSELVES POLITICAL PARTIES, BUT THEY HAVE TO RESOLVE THEIR PROBLEMS SO THAT WE CAN HAVE A REFERENDUM, WHICH I AM PREPARED TO ORGANIZE WITH CALM, FACED WITH THREE OR FOUR POLITICAL PARTIES."

"WHAT WE SHOULD DO ON OUR RETURN IS TO REESTABLISH LEGALITY SO THAT A REALLY NEUTRAL GOVERNMENT IS INSTALLED AND WILL MAINTAIN ORDER SO THAT IT OCCUPIES ITSELF NEXT WITH REDRESSING THE ECONOMY AND ORGANIZES IN THIRD PLACE FREE ELECTIONS."
BAKHTIAR IS PREPARED "TO FORM A WORKING GROUP TO CONTACT IRANIANS OVERSEAS AND IN IRAN, ABOVE ALL IN THE INTELLECTUAL CLASS AND THE MIDDLE CLASS."
BAKHTIAR WANTS TO "CONTINUE THE FIGHT IN A DEMOCRATIC AND SOCIAL-DEMOCRATIC FRAMEWORK. DISORDER WILL NOT START WITH ME."

BAKHTIAR "WILL STAY IN FRANCE THE MAXIMUM TIME POSSIBLE AND WILL LEAVE THE DAY WHEN IT IS POSSIBLE TO HAVE A MINIMUM OF ORDER AND SECURITY IN IRAN." BAKHTIAR WILL GIVE ANOTHER PRESS CONFERENCE SOON "WITH MUCH MORE PRECISE DETAILS." ON THE KURDS
IF BAKHTIAR GAINED POWER AGAIN IN IRAN HE WOULD GIVE "THE MAXIMUM POSSIBLE LIBERTY AND SELF-MANAGEMENT TO THE IRANIAN MINORITIES, NOT ONLY TO THE KURDS BUT ALSO TO THE OTHERS, IF THEY ASK FOR IT."
THE KURDS "ARE BEING SUBJECTED TO A REAL EXTERMINATION . . . . IF ALL THE IRANIAN MILITARY FORCES ARE CONCENTRATED AGAINST THE KURDS THIS WOULD BE A GENOCIDE."
CONFIDENTIAL ENTIRE TEXT.

WE READ WITH INTEREST EMBASSY TEHRAN'S ANALYSIS (REF A) OF THE LIMITED ROLE POLITICAL EXILES IN FRANCE AND ELSEWHERE ARE LIKELY TO PLAY IN BRINGING ABOUT POLITICAL CHANGE IN IRAN. AS FOR FIROUZ SHARIFI (REF B), SHOULD HE ATTEMPT TO CONTACT THE EMBASSY WE WILL TREAT HIS APPROACH WITH EXTREME RESERVE IN VIEW OF HIS CLAIMS OF U.S. SUPPORT FOR HIS PLANS.

SINCE FRANCE HAS NOW BECOME A MAJOR CENTER OF IRANIAN ANTI-REGIME EXILE ACTIVITY (NO MATTER HOW INEFFECTIVE) WE WOULD APPRECIATE ANY GUIDANCE THE DEPARTMENT MAY HAVE TO OFFER ON HANDLING CONTACTS WITH EXILES. IN THIS REGARD, IT WOULD BE HELPFUL TO HAVE A RESPONSE TO THE SPECIFIC QUESTION POSED IN PARAGRAPH 7 OF REF C WHETHER WE SHOULD MAINTAIN CONTACT WITH NAHAVANDI.

1979PARIS28978.subject: FORMER IRANIAN MINISTER IN EXILE IN PARIS TRAVELLING TO MEXICO TO TALK WITH SHAH

segments.text: SECRET ENTIRE TEXT.

FORMER IRANIAN MINISTER OF HOUSING AND DEVELOPMENT HOUSHANG NAHAVANDI WHO IS ACTIVE IN IRANIAN EMIGRE CIRCLES INFORMED THE CAO THAT HE IS DEPARTING PARIS ON MONDAY SEPTEMBER 17 FOR MEXICO TO VISIT THE SHAH. HIS MISSION: TO INFORM THE SHAH ABOUT THE BUDDING GOVERNMENT IN EXILE. IT IS A POLITICAL COALITION, GROWING STEADILY CLOSER, BUILT AROUND BAKHTIAR, JAMSHID AMOUZEGAR AND HIMSELF, PLUS OTHERS WHO DO NOT YET WISH TO BE IDENTIFIED, AND WITH THE SUPPORT OF EMIGRE MILITARY FIGURES OVEISSI AND JAM.

HIS PURPOSE IS TO PERSUADE THE SHAH THAT HE MUST STAY OUT OF THIS, THAT THERE IS NO CHANCE OF HIS EVER RETURNING TO IRAN, THAT THE MOST HE CAN HOPE FOR IS A REASONABLE CHANCE FOR HIS SON TO PLAY SOME KIND OF ROLE IN THE FUTURE.

NAHAVANDI SAYS THEIR REPORTS INDICATE GROWING DISAFFECTION, ECONOMIC PENURY AND ADMINISTRATIVE CHAOS IN IRAN. THEY ARE IN TOUCH WITH IMPORTANT NAMES INSIDE IRAN. HE IS NOT DISCOURAGED BY THE CRUSHING OF THE KURDS AND SAYS THAT IMPORTANT MILITARY FIGURES HAVE DEFECTED OVER THE EPISODE. HE REFERS TO LARGE NUMBERS OF PLO MILITARY IN TEHRAN, MANY OF WHOM TOOK PART IN THE KURDISH REPRESSION, E.G. ONE KEY MAN ABOARD EVERY HELICOPTER GUNSHIP.
NAHAVANDI SAYS THE MOMENT IS APPROACHING WHEN COUNTER ACTION MUST BE TAKEN. IF NOT NOW, THINGS WILL DRAG ON FOR YEARS, OR AT LEAST UNTIL THE DEATH OF KHOMEINI.

NAHAVANDI TOLD THE CAO THAT HE WOULD BE WILLING TO TALK WITH AN APPROPRIATE USG OFFICIAL (PREFERABLY IN FRENCH) ON HIS WAY BACK FROM MEXICO EITHER IN WASHINGTON OR ELSEWHERE. NAHAVANDI SUGGESTED THAT IF A MEETING WAS DESIRED THAT HE BE CONTACTED AT THE HOME OF HIS DAUGHTER, MRS. AFSANEH MALEKZADEH IN SALT LAKE CITY WHERE HE WILL GO AFTER LEAVING MEXICO. MRS. MALEKZADEH'S TELEPHONE NUMBER: 801-261-2392. NAHAVANDI WAS NOT ENCOURAGED TO EXPECT MEETING WITH USG OFFICIALS.

LOU - ENTIRE TEXT. FOLLOWING IS BASE ON AN APRIL 15 TELCON OF USLO OFFICER ROBERT CAMPBELL (EX-CONSULATE TABRIZ OFFICER) WITH AN INSTRUCTOR AT ZANJAN AGRICULTURAL COLLEGE. IT IS OFFERED FOR WHATEVER LIGHT IT MAY SHED ON CURRENT IRANIAN SITUATION.

THE SITUATION IN ZANJAN, A SMALL CONSERVATIVE CITY NORTHWEST OF TEHRAN, IS RETURNING TO NORMAL. THREATS TO PERSONAL SAFETY HAVE BECOME A THING OF THE PAST. WOMEN WHO HAD BEEN THREATENED FOR NOT WEARING THE CHADOR NOW FEEL FREE TO DISCARD IT. THE COLLEGE IS STILL RUN BY "MEETINGS", DOMINATED BY STUDENTS. ALTHOUGH INSTRUCTORS AND THE DEAN HIMSELF ARE STILL INTIMIDATED BYSTANDERS AT THESE MEETINGS, THEY NO LONGER FEAR PHYSICAL REPRISALS FOR DISSENT AS WAS THE CASE TWO MONTHS AGO. FEMALE INSTRUCTORS HAVE BEEN ALLOWED TO REMAIN ON THE STAFF AND THE STUDENTS NOW SEEM MORE CONCERNED WITH PROTESTING LOW MARKS THAN RELIGIOUS POLITICS.

UNTIL RECENTLY THE TOWN WAS RUN BY A GROUP OF MULLAS OPERATING OUT OF A LOCAL MOSQUE. THE RULE BY MULLA WAS CONSIDERED MORE FAIR THAN THAT OF THE MINISTRY OF JUSTICE UNDER THE SHAH. IN ONE CASE THE MULLAS REVERSED AN UNCOMPENSATED EXPROPRIATION OF PRIVATE LAND BY THE MUNICIPALITY FOR "GREEN ZONES". LEGAL JURISDICTION HAS NOW BEEN RETURNED TO THE MINISTRY OF JUSTICE WHICH IN SOME WAYS HAS PROVED LESS EFFICIENT THAN THE MULLAS. WHILE BRIBE TAKING HAS BEEN EFFECTIVELY ABOLISHED, SO HAS THE MOTIVATION FOR EMPLOYEES IN THE JUSTICE OFFICE TO COME TO WORK.
THE GOVERNOR OF ZANJAN IS ALSO NOW TECHNICALLY IN CHARGE BUT CONFINES HIMSELF TO ISSUING PUBLIC STATEMENTS QUOTING VARIOUS PROMINENT MULLAS.

SALARIES ARE NOT BEING PAID AT THE COLLEGE EVEN THOUGH IT WAS REOPENED TWO MONTHS AGO. SPENDING MONEY IS BEING GIVEN TO COVER BASIC LIVING EXPENSES AND THE COLLEGE HAS ISSUED LETTERS CERTIFYING EMPLOYMENT WHICH WERE ACCEPTED BY BANKS AS JUSTIFICATION FOR DEFERRING MORTGAGE PAYMENTS. THE DEAN OF THE COLLEGE WAS NEGOTIATING WITH TEHRAN FOR FUNDS TO RESUME AT LEAST PARTIAL SALARY PAYMENTS. EMPLOYEES OF LARGER GOVERNMENT OFFICES WERE NOT AS HARD HIT SINCE THESE INSTITUTIONS IN MOST CASES HAD CARRIED OVER UNSPENT MONEY FROM THE PREVIOUS YEAR.
