1979SANA03643.subject: AGONY OF DEPARTING IRANIAN AMBASSADOR -- REQUEST FOR ASSESSMENT OF SITUATION AT IRANIAN FOREIGN MINISTRY

segments.text: (S - ENTIRE TEXT).

FORMER IRANIAN AMBASSADOR AMIREDDIN EFTEKHAR DEPARTED SANA ON APRIL 5, 1979 AFTER BEING RECALLED TO TEHRAN. HE SPENT FINAL MONTH IN SANA AGONIZING OVER WHETHER OR NOT TO RETURN TO IRAN. IN THE END HE DECIDED TO TAKE VACATION IN ATHENS ENROUTE. OUR LATEST REPORT FROM AMEMBASSY ROME IS THAT HE HAS DECIDED TO SEEK ENTRY TO THE UNITED STATES FEARING THAT IF HE RETURNS TO IRAN HE WILL BE ARRESTED AND PROSECUTED BY THE SPECIAL TRIBUNALS.

AMBASSADOR AMIREDDIN EFTEKHAR WAS A GOOD FRIEND TO MANY OFFICERS IN THIS EMBASSY. WHILE HE COMES FROM A PROMINENT IRANIAN FAMILY, WE ARE NOT AWARE THAT HE OR HIS FAMILY WERE THAT CLOSELY IDENTIFIED WITH INTERNAL POLITICS OF THE SHAH'S GOVERNMENT. WE BELIEVE AMBASSADOR EFTEKHAR MADE HIS DECISION NOT TO RETURN TO IRAN BASED PRIMARILY ON FEAR AND THE UNCERTAINTY OF HIS COUNTRY'S POLITICAL SITUATION AND NOT BECAUSE HE HAD SPECIFIC INFORMATION THAT HE WOULD BE ARRESTED.

(S - ENTIRE TEXT) DURING HIS MEETING WITH LORD CARRINGTON AND SENIOR FCO ADVISORS ON MAY 21, SECRETARY VANCE ASKED FORMER UK AMBASSADOR TO TEHRAN PARSONS FOR HIS THOUGHTS ON HOW TO ASSIST THE JEWISH COMMUNITY IN TEHRAN.

PARSONS RESPONDED THAT IN HIS VIEW, THE JEWS AND BAHAIS ARE AUTOMATICALLY SUSPECTED OF BEING AGENTS OF WESTERN IMPERIALISM. HIS ADVICE TO THEM IS TO SEEK HELP FROM RELIGIOUS FIGURES, WHO COULD COMMUNICATE WITH SENSIBLE AYATOLLAHS (SHARIAT-MADARI, FOR EXAMPLE, NOT KHOMEINI). INTERVENTION BY GOVERNMENTS WILL MAKE MATTERS WORSE. THE SECRETARY THANKED PARSONS FOR THIS OBSERVATION AND NOTED THAT HE WILL BE SEEING THE POPE ON HIS WAY TO THE HAGUE.

segments.text: THE AMBASSADOR SIGNED THE CONDOLENCE BOOK FOR AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI ON BEHALF OF THE EMBASSY SEPTEMBER 12.

(C) THE FORMAL GOVERNMENT APPARATUS IN SHIRAZ FOLLOWING LAST WEEK'S LIFTING OF MARTIAL LAW HAS WITH A FEW EXCEPTIONS ALMOST CEASED TO FUNCTION. A FEW MUNICIPAL EMPLOYEES (TRASH COLLECTORS, GARDENERS, ETC) ARE STILL ON THE JOB AND THE POLICE, AFTER HIDING OUT FOR SEVERAL DAYS IN THE WAKE OF LAST THURSDAY'S ATTACK ON SAVAK HEADQUARTERS, ARE AGAIN TO BE SEEN IN PUBLIC. THE MILITARY, TOO, IS STILL OPERATIONAL, ALTHOUGH THE ARMY IS MAINTAINING A CONSIDERABLY LOWER PROFILE THAN FORMERLY AND THE AIR FORCE IS STICKING TO ITS BASE JUST OUTSIDE TOWN.

ELSEWHERE, THOSE FEW GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES WHO DO SHOW UP FOR WORK ARE FOR THE MOST PART IN KAMKARI (SLOWDOWN) STATUS. SHIRAZ'S RELIGIOUS LEADERS HEADED BY BAHA-ED-DIN MAHALATI HAVE STEPPED IN TO ORGANIZE SOME ESSENTIAL SERVICES. VOLUNTEERS UNDER THEIR DIRECTION HAVE DISTRIBUTED BREAD AND SET UP "ISLAMIC COOPERATIVES" WHICH SELL STAPLE FOODS AT SUBSIDIZED PRICES MADE POSSIBLE BY CONTRIBUTIONS FROM WEALTHY BUSINESSMEN. THE SELF-STYLED ISLAMIC POLICE, MOSTLY TEEN-AGERS, DIRECT TRAFFIC AND PATROL NEIGHBORHOOD STREETS AFTER DARK.

WHILE I WAS IN THE OFFICE OF THE FARS PROVINCIAL GOVERNOR GENERAL JANUARY 16 HE TURNED FIRST TO THE RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP IN RESPONSE TO A PLEA FOR HELP FROM THE NIOC DISTRICT MANAGER IN MAINTAINING ORDER IN THE LONG LINES AT SHIRAZ'S SERVICE STATIONS AND ONLY AFTER THAT TO THE CHIEF OF POLICE.

(C) FOR THE MOMENT, HOWEVER, REVOLUTION IS TAKING PRECEDENCE OVER EVERYTHING ELSE. RALLIES AND SPEECHES ARE ALMOST CONSTANT FEATURES OF THE LOCAL SCENE. HARDLY A SQUARE INCH OF WALL SPACE REMAINS BARE OF POLITICAL SLOGANS WHICH RANGE FROM "DEATH TO THE SHAH (AND CARTER)" TO "USA NO, USSR NO, ISLAM YES." EVERYONE, FROM TODDLERS TO YOUNG MOTHERS WITH BABIES IN THEIR ARMS TO THE OLD AND INFIRM, IS PARTICIPATING.

THE BURNED OUT SHELL OF THE FORMER SAVAK COMPOUND HAS BEEN DEISIGNATED THE "MUSEUM OF PAHLAVI JUSTICE" AND A DEBATE IS RAGING AS TO WHETHER PAHLAVI UNIVERSITY SHOULD BE REDESIGNATED IMAM KHOMEINI UNIVERSITY (PROBABLY THE POPULAR FAVORITE) OR JUST SHIRAZ UNIVERSITY (THE PREFERENCE OF MODERATE FACULTY MEMBERS). THE RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP HAS TRIED TO TAKE THE HIGH GROUND, URGING THEIR FOLLOWERS TO REFRAIN FROM ATTACKS ON PROPERTY AND INDIVIDUALS, BUT THEY HAVE NOT ALWAYS BEEN SUCCESSFUL.

ULEMA ON THE SCENE REPORTEDLY SPOKE OUT AGAINST THURSDAY'S ATTACK ON SAVAK BUT TO LITTLE AVAIL, AND DESPITE THE URGING OF SENIOR MEMBERS OF THE CLERGY AT A LARGE RALLY JANUARY 15 THAT MEMBERS OF THE FOREIGN COMMUNITY BE RESPECTED, XENOPHOBIC SLOGANEERING AND THREATS AGAINST FOREIGNERS ARE PERHAPS AT AN ALL-TIME HIGH.

(C) THE IMPACT OF THE SHAH'S DEPARTURE JANUARY 16 MAY BE SEVERAL DAYS SINKING IN. IT WAS IMMEDIATELY GREETED BY HONKING OF HORNS, DANCING IN THE STREET AND A RALLY ON SHIRAZ'S MAIN THOROUGHFARE. MORE RALLIES ARE LIKELY TO FOLLOW IN THE NEXT FEW DAYS, BUT SOONER OR LATER SOMEONE IS GOING TO HAVE TO COME SERIOUSLY TO GRIPS WITH AN ECONOMY AND BUREAUCRACY IN ALMOST COMPLETE COLLAPSE.
(C-ENTIRE TEXT)

(C) SUMMARY: SHIRAZ AS OF JANUARY 29 WAS WAITING FOR WHAT WAS NOT ALTOGETHER CLEAR. MANY OBVIOUSLY WERE WAITING FOR KHOMEINI TO RETURN AND TELL THEM WHAT IS NEXT. A SMALL BUT PERHAPS GROWING NUMBER OF OTHERS, HOWEVER, WERE WAITING TO BE CONFIRMED IN THEIR ASSESSMENT THAT THE MOST IMPORTANT GOALS OF THE REVOLUTION HAVE BEEN ACHIEVED AND THAT THE TIME FOR AGITATION HAS NOW PASSED. END SUMMARY.

(C) THERE HAVE BEEN ALMOST DAILY DEMONSTRATIONS IN SHIRAZ SINCE THE DEPARTURE OF THE SHAH, INCLUDING ONE INVOLVING SEVERAL THOUSAND PEOPLE ON JANUARY 29 WHO SHOUTED "DEATH TO BAKHTAIR, GREETINGS TO KHOMEINI" AND "BAKHTIAR WILL CATCH HELL IF KHOMEINI COMES LATE" (THE LATTER A MODIFICATION OF A COMMON INJUNCTION IN FARSI TO CHILDREN GOING OUT NOT TO COME HOME LATE). FOR THE MOST PART, THESE DEMONSTRATIONS HAVE BEEN ORDERLY AFFAIRS, WITH THE DEMONSTRATORS THEMSELVES POLICING THEIR OWN ACTIVITIES. WHILE FEW PARTICIPANTS APPEAR PARTICULARLY TO WANT TROUBLE, HOWEVER, PASSIONS CLEARLY ARE NEVER FAR BENEATH THE SURFACE.

(C) EXEMPLARY OF THIS FACT WAS MY OWN EXPERIENCE WITH SOME OF THOSE WHO PARTICAPATED IN THE DEMONSTRATION ON THE 29TH. WHILE MAKING A ROUTINE TOUR OF THE BAZAAR AREA, THE CONSULATE VEHICLE I WAS RIDING IN WAS DIVERTED BY SO-CALLED "ISLAMIC POLICE" FROM THE MAIN STREET ONTO A NARROW SIDE STREET WHERE WE PROMPTLY WERE TRAPPED BY A STALLED PICK-UP TRUCK AND CONFRONTED BY A LARGE CROWD OF MARCHERS COMING FROM A NEARBY RELIGIOUS SCHOOL. OUR VEHICLE LONG SINCE HAD BEEN DISGUISED TO PREVENT ITS RECOGNITION AS AN OFFICIAL ONE, BUT I WAS NONETHELESS SOON SPOTTED AS A FOREIGNER.

AT FIRST, THE MARCHERS KEPT MOVING BY, CONTENTING THEMSELVES WITH A F EW "YANKEE GO HOMES" AND EXPRESSING THEIR SURPRISE THAT THERE WERE ANY FOREIGNERS LEFT IN SHIRAZ. SOON, HOWEVER, A GROUP OF YOUNG TOUGHS GATHERED AROUND US. SEVERAL BEGAN TO BANG THEIR FISTS ON THE HOOD, THEN CAME A BARRAGE OF ROCKS, AND FINALLY A BRICK AGAINST THE SIDE NEAREST TO WHERE I WAS SITTING TRYING TO LOOK AS UNCONCERNED AS POSSIBLE WITH WHAT WAS GOING ON OUTSIDE.

AT THAT POINT, OUR POLICE BODYGUARD, WITH GREAT CORAGE AND CONSIDERABLE SANGFROID, GOT OUT OF THE CAR AND BEGAN ORGANIZING THE ISLAMIC POLICE, WHO HAD CLEARLY LOST CONTROL OF THE SITUATION, TO PUSH THE PICK-UP OUT OF THE WAY AND TO SHEPHERD THE TOUGHS GATHERED AROUND OUR VEHICLE DOWN THE STREET WITH THE REST OF THE MARCHERS. THUS WE MADE OUR ESCAPE.

(C) ELSEWHERE, PAHLAVI UNIVERSITY (NOW VARIOUSLY CALLED SHIRAZ UNIVERSITY OR IMAM KHOMEINI UNIVERSITY) HAS REOPENED, BUT ASIDE FROM THE MEDICAL SCHOOL NO CLASSES HAVE BEEN HELD. ORDINARILY, LAST WEEK WOULD HAVE MARKED THE BEGINNING OF THE UNIVERSITY'S SECOND SEMESTER, BUT MOST OF THE STUDENT BODY, LONG SINCE HAVING DEPARTED SHIRAZ FOR HOME, HAS YET TO REAPPEAR. THE MAIN ACTIVITY ON CAMPUS IS POLITICAL RALLIES WHICH HAVE GENERALLY BEEN WELL-ATTENDED BY A FAR MORE VARIED ASSORTMENT OF INDIVIDUALS THAN WOULD ORDINARILY BE FOUND IN WHAT PASSES LOCALLY FOR HALLOWED HALLS OF IVY.

A DISPLAY OF PAHLAVI ATROCITIES AT THE COLLEGE OF ARTS AND SCIENCES HAS BEEN A POWERFUL DRAW FOR THE GENERAL PUBLIC AS HAS BEEN THE MUSEUM OF PAHLAVI JUSTICE (FORMERLY KNOWN AS SAVAK HEADQUARTERS). AMONG THE ITEMS FOR VIEWING AT THE LATTER ARE INSTRUMENTS OF TORTURE, INCCLUDING A JUICE SQUEEZER (ALLEGEDLY USED TO MANGLE PRISONERS' SEXUAL ORGANS) AND AN ELECTRIC IRON, AS WELL AS THE SPINAL COLUMN OF ONE VICTIM (WHO CLEARLY WAS FOURFOOTED IN LIFE AND MOST PROBABLY WAS EATEN AT A SAVAK BARBECUE). THE PATENT RIDICULOUSNESS OF SOME OF THIS IS OF LITTLE CONSEQUENCE FOR ALLEGATIONS OF PAHLAVI BRUTALITY ARE UNIVERSALLY ACCEPTED AS FACT.

INDEED, THEIR IMPORTANCE MAY LIE LESS IN THEIR VERITY THAN IN THEIR SYSBOLIC RELATIONSHIP TO POPULAR PERCEPTION OF THE NATURE OF THE PAHLAVI REGIME. ------------------126096 311231Z /15 FM AMCONSUL SHIRAZ TO SECSTATE WASHDC 0137 SECTION 2 OF 2 SHIRAZ 0033

(C) ECONOMICALLY, ONE WONDERS HOW MUCH LONGER THINGS CAN GO ON AS THEY HAVE BEEN. FEW PEOPLE ARE WORKING, AND MANY OF THOSE THAT ARE ARE ENGAGED IN ESSENTIALLY NONPRODUCTIVE JOBS. ONE OF THE INCONGRUITIES OF THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION WAS VIVIDLY ON DISPLAY A FEW DAYS AGO ON ZAND AVENUE, SHIRAZ'S MAIN THOROUGHFARE, WHERE MUNICIPAL WORKERS WERE BUSILY PLANTING SPRING FLOWERS ALONG THE MEDIAN STRIP WHILE VIRTUALLY EVERY BUSINESS ON EITHER SIDE OF THE STREET HAD ITS STEEL SHUTTERS DRAWN TIGHT. SO-CALLED ISLAMIC COOPERATIVES, HOWEVER, ARE OPEN FOR BUSINESS, AND THE DAST-FOROUSHI (STREETVENDORS) ARE HAVING A FIELD DAY.

INDEED, IT WOULD APPEAR THAT A SUBSTANTIAL NUMBER OF SHOPKEEPERS WHO ARE EITHER AFRAID TO OPEN OR WHO ARE MORE CONCERNED ABOUT THE APPEARANCE OF REVOLUTIONARY SOLIDARITY THAN ITS ACTUALITY HAVE FOUND A "SHIRAZI SOLUTION" TO PROTRACTED CLOSURES BY KEEPING THEIR SHUTTERS DOWN AND MOVING THEIR GOODS ONTO THE SIDEWALK. FOR THE MOMENT, PEOPLE STILL SEEM TO HAVE MONEY TO SPEND, BUT SHORTAGES ARE BEGINNING TO MAKE THEMSELVES FELT. ON JANUARY 29 THERE WERE REPORTS THAT SHOPS HAD RUN OUT OF VEGETABLE SHORTENING, THE MAIN IRANIAN COOKING MEDIUM, AND THE PANIC LATER OBSERVED AROUND AN ISLAMIC COOPERATIVE TRUCK DISPENSING THE PRODUCT TENDED TO CONFIRM ITS SCARCITY.
A FEW PUBLIC SECTIOR EMPLOYEES, SUCH AS POSTAL WORKERS, HAVE RETURNED TO THEIR JOBS, BUT MOST OFFICES REMAIN ON STRIKE. NIGHTLY POWER BLACKOUTS HAVE RESUMED AFTER A HIATUS OF MORE THAN A WEEK.

(C) THE AFTERMATH OF THE SHAH'S DEPARTURE HAS WITNESSED A MODEST DEGREE OF EROSION OF THE POPULAR UNITY WHICH PREVAILED WHILE HE WAS STILL AROUND. IT APPEARS THAT IT IS RELATIVELY HARDER FOR SOME TO MAINTAIN THEIR HATRED FOR THE MONARCH AT A WHIITE-HOT LEVEL FROM A DISTANCE OF SEVERAL THOUSAND MILES THAN IT WAS FROM 500.

MANY HAVE ALMOST EFFORTLESSLY SHIFTED THE FOCUS OF THEIR ANTIPATHY FROM THE SHAH TO THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT, BUT OTHERS, PARTICULARLY THOSE WHOSE OPPOSITION WAS LIMITED, BEING BASED ON DISLIKE FOR THE STYLE OF THE PAHLAVI REGINE AND/OR A DESIRE FOR A MORE HUMANE FORM OF GOVERNMENT, FIND IT HARD TO DESPISE A MAN WHO HAS GIVEN THEM MUCH OF WHAT THEY WANTED AND SEEMS SINCERE IN HIS PROMISE TO PROVIDE THE REST.

THE JACOBINIST TENDENCIES OF THE MORE ARDENT REVOLUTIONARIES, TOO, HAVE COME AS A SHOCK TO THOSE WHO ALSO OPPOSED THE SHAH BUT WHO NOW FIND FRIENDS OR EVEN THEMSELVES BEING VICTIMIZED BY ACCUSATIONS OF COLLABORATION WITH THE PAHLAVI REGIME BASED MORE FREQUENTLY THAN NOT ON WHIMSY RATHER THAN HARD EVIDENCE. THE POSSIBILITY THAT ONE FORM OF AUTHORITARIAN TERROR MAY SIMPLY BE REPLACED BY YET ANOTHER HAS BEGUN TO SINK HOME IN SOME QUARTERS AND THE FEAR IT INSPIRES IN PALPABLE.

AS YET, HOWEVER, THOSE WHO HAVE STARTED TO QUESTION THE ULTIMATE COURSE OF THE REVOLUTION APPEAR TO BE RELATIVELY FEW IN NUMBER, AND, MORE IMPORTANTLY, FOR THE MOMENT CONSTITUTE A HIGHLY INCHOATE BODY OF POLITICAL OPINION. THEY, TOO, ARE WAITING, IN THEIR CASE FOR A LEADER WHO CAN GALVANIZE THEM INTO PUTTING THEIR FOOT DOWN AND DEMANDING THAT THE GAINS OF THE REVOLUTION NOW BE CONSOLIDATED. THEY MAY WAIT IN VAIN.

1979SHIRAZ00042.subject: ANTI-AMERICAN SENTIMENT IN THE IRANIAN MILITARY

segments.text: THERE FOLLOW TWO ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLES OF ANTI-AMERICAN SENTIMENT WHICH IS BECOMING INCREASINGLY MANIFEST IN THE IRANIAN MILITARY. THIS SENTIMENT HAS BEEN MOST PRONOUNCED AMONG THE ENLISTED RANKS BUT HAS NOT BEEN LIMITED TO THEM.

ONE OF THE U.S. ARMY ADVISORS ASSIGNED HERE WAS GREETED BY A CHORUS OF "YANKEE GO HOME" WHEN HE ENTERED THE ENLISTED MEN'S MESS AT THE SHIRAZ INFANTRY CENTER A FEW DAYS AGO. LATER, HE MADE A ROUTINE REQUEST TO VISIT A CLASS AT THE CENTER. THE COMMANDANT'S ANSWER SOON CAME BACK THAT HE COULD NOT.

WHEN HE WENT TO THE COMMANDANT HIMSELF FOR AN EXPLANATION, HE WAS TOLD THAT IF HE WERE TO VISIT THE CLASS, HE MIGHT BE INSULTED BY ONE OF THE SOLDIERS, THAT IF HE WERE INSULTED, THE COMMANDANT WOULD HAVE TO DISCIPLINE THE MAN, AND THAT IF HE HAD TO DISCIPLINE THE MAN, IT WOULD CREATE BAD FEELING AMONG THE RANKS. THE ADVISOR THEN ASKED RHETORICALLY WHAT HE WAS SUPPOSED TO DO, SIT IN HIS OFFICE ALL DAY? YES, WAS THE COMMANDANT'S COOL REPLY.
BECUASE OF THE UNCERTAIN SECURITY SITUATION HERE, ABOUT 15 SOLDIERS HAVE BEEN ASSIGNED TO PROTECT THE CONSULATE. A RECENT CONVERSATION WITH ONE PRIVATE FIRST CLASS ELICITED THE FOLLOWING POINTS
THE SOLDIER ASKED WHY THE CONSULATE STAFF WAS STILL IN IRAN. WHEN ASKED IF THE FELT STAFF MEMBERS SHOULD LEAVE, HE GRINNED AND SAID THAT EVERYONE ELSE HAD LEFT.
WHEN QUIRED ABOUT DISTURBANCES INISFAHAN AND THE RELATIVE CALM IN SHIRAZ, THE SOLDIER, AND ISFAHANI, REPLIED THAT THE SHIRAZIS WERE TO COMPLACENT, WHILE THE ISFAHANIS UNDERSTOOD THE SITUATION WELL.

ASKED IF HE THOUGH IT WAS GOOD THAT THE SHAH HAD LEFT, HE RESPONDED, "WHY BAD?" AFTER A VERY SLIGHT HESITATION (PERHAPS HE THOUGH A SOLDIER SHOULD NOT BE TALKING SO MUCH), HE WENT ON TO COMPLAIN OF THE TREATMENT OF THE IRANIAN PEOPLE BY THE PAHLAVIS AND THE WAY IN WHICH THE REGIME WAS UNDER THE CONTROL OF FOREIGNERS. HE CLAIMED THAT THE U.S. HAD ROBBED IRAN OF ITS OIL AND HAD THEN USED THE MONEY GAINED THEREBY TO SET UP MILITARY BASES ON IRANIAN SOIL. HE SAID THAT THE BASES WERE RIGHTFULLY IRANIAN PROPERTY BUT WERE SERVING U.S. PURPOSES. LAUGHING OFFTHE SUGGESTION THAT THE U.S.
WAS ONLY RESPONDING TO GOI REQUESTS FOR SECURITY AID, THE SOLDIER SAID THAT THE U.S. WAS JUST USING IRAN TO WORK ITS WILL.
HE SAID THAT HE WAS NOT AFRAID OFTHE SOVIETS AND THAT IT WOULD BE BEST FOR IRAN IF IT BECAME COMMUNIST. THE PEOPLE WOULD THEN BE TAKEN CARE OF AND PROTECTED FROM REGIMES LIKE THE PAHLAVI'S.

PAN AMERICAN HAS CANCELLED ALL FLIGHTS FOR JANUARY 1 ON BASIS OF COMPANY'S JUDGMENT THAT OPERATIONS OUT OF TEHRAN MIGHT NOT BE COVERED BY EXISTING INSURANCE. PAN AMERICAN IS ATTEMPTING TO CLARIFY UNDERWRITER VIEWS.

PAN AMERICAN HAS THREE CONCERNS: (1) SECURITY OF PAN AMERICAN PERSONNEL IN TEHRAN; (2) SECURITY OF OPERATIONS AT MERABAD AIRPORT; AND (3) SAFETY OF AIRCRAFT IN IRANIAN AIR SPACE IF QUALIFIED AIR TRAFFIC CONTROLLERS ARE NOT WORKING OR WILL NOT PROVIDE SERVICES FOR AMERICAN PLANES.

ALTHOUGH STRIKING WORKERS TARGETTED ON PAN AMERICAN AND EL AL OPERATIONS, SOME OTHER AIRLINES ARE INTERPRETING STRIKE ACTION AS DIRECTED AGAINST ALL FOREIGN CARRIERS. ACCORDING TO OUR BEST INFORMATION, SWISS AIR WILL KEEP ITS REGULAR SCHEDULE JANUARY 1; AIR FRANCE IS CANCELLING ITS EARLY MORNING FLIGHT BUT THE SECOND FLIGHT IS STILL SCHEDULED; BA HAS CANCELLED ITS EARLY FLIGHT AND IS REROUTING A LATER FLIGHT KUWAIT-TEHRAN RATHER THAN TEHRANKUWAIT, AS SCHEDULED, AND WILL DECIDE LATER WHETHER TO GO ON TO TEHRAN; AND LUFTHANSA, KLM AND ALITALIA DO NOT HAVE SCHEDULED FLIGHTS.

AS WE DISCUSSED WITH YOU BY TELEPHONE, PAN AMERICAN IS WILLING TO OPERATE TO TEHRAN UNDER STATE DEPARTMENT CONTRACT FOR CHARTER, PROVIDED THERE IS GROUND SECURITY AND ASSURANCES OF ADEQUATE AIR TRAFFIC CONTROL BY MILITARY OR CIVILIAN STAFF. PAN AMERICAN STATES THAT GENERAL GAST EXPRESSED OPINION THAT WHILE CURRENT SECURITY SITUATION WAS ACCEPTABLE, HE WAS CONCERNED ABOUT AIRCRAFT IN FLIGHT SEPARATION SPACING. PRESUMABLY IF PAN AMERICAN AND INSURANCE UNDERWRITERS WERE THOROUGHLY ASSURED ON GROUND SECURITY AND AIR SAFETY IT WOULD NOT REQUIRE A STATE DEPARTMENT CONTRACT FOR OPERATIONS.

ABILITY OF IRANIAN AIR TRAFFIC CONTROLLERS (EITHER CIVILIAN OR MILITARY) TO MANAGE AIR SPACE OF AIRCRAFT EN ROUTE TO AND FROM TEHRAN. PAN AM SAID FAA CHIEF BURTON HAD EXPRESSED SOME DOUBTS ON THIS POINT. PAN AM IS SEEKING MORE INFORMATION.

UNDER SECRETARY NEWSOM CONVEYED SUBSTANCE OF REFTEL TO ROSS PEROT JANUARY 1.

PEROT SAID HE ASSUMED FROM THIS THAT EMBASSY COULD NOT DO ANYTHING MORE EITHER WITH RESPECT TO BAIL OR REMOVING THE CHARGES AGAINST THE COMPANY. NEWSOM SAID THIS SEEMED TO BE THE CASE ALTHOUGH THE EMBASSY WOULD CONTINUE TO PURSUE THE MATTER THROUGH THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS. IT DID LOOK LIKE THE MOST HOPEFUL AVENUE WOULD BE BY THE COMPANY'S LAWYERS IN THE COURTS.
PEROT ACCEPTED THIS AND SAID HE WOULD ADVISE HIS LAWYERS IN ADVANCE OF THE MEETING WITH EMBASSY AND COMPANY OFFICIALS TOMORROW.

HE AGAIN EXPRESSED HIS FEELING THAT THE MEN WERE BEING DETAINED SOLELY BECAUSE THEY WERE THE ENGINEERS FAMILIAR WITH THE EQUIPMENT AND INSISTED THAT THE COMPANY HAD COMMITTED NO IMPROPRIETY. HE SAID THE COMPANY OFFICIALS WHO HAD NEGOTIATED THE ORIGINAL CONTRACT WERE URGING HIM TO BE PERMITTED TO RETURN TO TEHRAN. HE CONTINUED TO ADVISE AGAINST IT BUT HE BELIEVED THAT THEIR PRESENCE MIGHT HELP TO CLARIFY THE LACK OF BASIS FOR THE CHARGES AGAINST THE COMPANY. NEWSOM SAID IT CONTINUED TO SEEM PRUDENT FOR THE NEGOTIATORS TO STAY OUT BUT THAT THIS WAS SOMETHING THAT THE LAWYERS COULD EXPLORE WITH THE EMBASSY OFFICIALS TOMORROW.
WE HAVE FURNISHED TO PEROT'S LAWYERS SUBSTANCE OF TEHRAN'S 14.

FOLLOWING GUIDANCE APPROVED FOR USE TODAY: QUESTION: WAS THERE AN IRAN TASK FORCE MEETING TODAY? ANSWER: YES THERE WAS. UNDERSECRETARIES DAVID NEWSOM AND BEN READ MET IN THE STATE DEPARTMENT THE MORNING OF JANUARY 1 WITH REPRESENTATIVES OF ALL CONCERNED U.S. AGENCIES. QUESTION: WHAT IS THE SITUATION IN IRAN? ANSWER: THERE ARE SOME INDICATIONS OF PROGRESS IN THE FORMATION OF THE CIVILIAN GOVERNMENT. THE INTERNAL SECURITY SITUATION APPEARS SOMEWHAT QUIETER AS OF JANUARY 1, BUT IS STILL UNSETTLED. QUESTION: WHAT ARE WE ADVISING U.S. CITIZENS IN IRAN AND ELSEWHERE? ANSWER: THE AMBASSADOR IS RECOMMENDING THE DEPARTURE OF AMERICAN OFFICIAL AND PRIVATE COMMUNITY DEPENDENTS.

THE STATE DEPARTMENT IS DISCOURAGING TRAVELERS FROM GOING TO IRAN AT THIS TIME UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE. AMERICANS IN IRAN WISHING UP-TO-DATE INFORMATION ON THE TRAVEL SITUATION SHOULD TELEPHONE THE MISSION INFORMATION CENTER AT THE U.S. EMBASSY IN TEHRAN. QUESTION: IS THE U.S. IN TOUCH WITH THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT? ANSWER: OUR AMBASSADOR IS IN FREQUENT CONTACT WITH IRANIAN AUTHORITIES INCLUDING THE SHAH. QUESTION: ARE WE CONSULTING WITH OTHER EMBASSIES? ANSWER: YES. QUESTION: ARE WE IN TOUCH WITH PRIVATE AMERICAN CITIZENS? ANSWER: YES. QUESTION: WHAT IS THE AIRPORT AND FLIGHT SITUATION? ANSWER: WESTERN AIRLINES ARE ATTEMPTING TO PLAN BOTH REGULAR AND SPECIAL FLIGHTS INTO TEHRAN'S AIRPORT JANUARY

TWO FOREIGN CARRIERS DEPARTED TEHRAN THIS MORNING. PAN AM DID NOT FLY TODAY. A MAC AIRCRAFT WAS SCHEDULED FOR TODAY (JANUARY 1) BUT WAS DELAYED IN EUROPE DUE TO ENGINE TROUBLE. QUESTION: IS THERE PANIC IN THE OFFICIAL U.S. COMMUNITY? ANSWER: NO.

WE HAVE MADE NO REFERENCE IN OFFICIAL STATEMENTS TO DEPARTURE OF NON-ESSENTIAL OFFICIAL AMERICANS. WE KNOW THAT THIS MEASURE IS COVERED IN PHASE 1 OF E&E PLAN AND THAT EMBASSY HAS PRIVATELY ADVISED SOME COMPANIES THAT IT WOULD BE ADVISABLE TO REMOVE NON-ESSENTIAL EMPLOYEES. THE PROSPECTIVE FORMATION OF A NEW CIVILIAN GOVERNMENT IN IRAN UNDER PRIME MINISTER-DESIGNATE BAKHTIAR APPEARS TO OFFER OPPORTUNITIES FOR ENDING VIOLENCE AND RESTORING STABILITY AND COHESION. THE FUNDAMENTAL CONCERNS OF THE UNITED STATES IN IRAN ARE FOR THAT COUNTRY'S STABILITY, INDEPENDENCE AND ORDERLY POLITICAL AND ECONOMIC EVOLUTION. WE LOOK FORWARD TO RELATIONS OF MUTUAL RESPECT AND COOPERATION WITH PRIME MINISTER-DESIGNATE BAKHTIAR'S GOVERNMENT.

segments.text: AMBASSADOR MEYER TELLS US AFTER SPEAKING BY TELEPHONE TO MASHAD THAT AMERICANSTHERE ARE SAFE. WE TOLD HIM IT WAS BEST TO LEAVE TO YOUR JUDGMENT WHETHER AMERICANS SHOULD ATTEMPT TO DEPART VIA TEHRAN OR BY CROSSING THE AFGHAN BORDER. WE SAID YOU WERE ALSO BEST JUDGE FOR
WE HAVE JUST RECEIVED WORD THROUGH MILITARY CHANNELS AND FROM PAN AM THAT MAC C-5 AIRCRAFT LANDED 0439 HRS ZULU AT TEHRAN. THIS CABLE REQUESTS EMBASSY ASSESMENT OF AIR TRAFFIC CONTROL AT TEHRAN.
INITIAL MILITARY REPORT INDICATED THAT AIRCRAFT WAS NOT GRANTED IFR ASSISTANCE BUT WAS CLEARED FOR VFR LANDING.

PAN AM VP FOR OPERATIONS JOHN KRIMSKY, BASED IN WASHINGTON, STATED THAT HE HAD BEEN ON AN OPEN TELEPHONE LINE TO TEHRAN THROUGHOUT MAC FLIGHT'S ARRIVAL AND LANDING. PAN AM, HE CONTINUED, HAD STATIONED AN OBSERVER ON TOP OF THE HYATT HOTEL AND HAD HAD MEMBERS OF ITS STAFF STANDING BY NEAR AIRPORT OPERATIONS CENTER. ACCORDING TO KRIMSKY, TOWER DID NOT INITIALLY RESPOND TO MAC C-5A, NOR EMBASSY TELEPHONE CALL.

KRIMSKY REPORTED THAT WHEN THE TOWER FINALLY DID ACKNOWLEDGE MAC AIRCRAFT'S COMMUNICATIONS, TOWER INSTRUCTED MAC FLIGHT TO DIVERT TO ITS ALTERNATE FIELD, WHICH, KRIMSKY BELIEVED, WAS ATHENS. KRIMSKY NOTED THAT PAN AM OBSERVER WATCHED AIRCRAFT CIRCLE FOR ABOUT TWENTY MINUTES AND THEN LAND.

KRIMSKY STATED THAT IT WAS PAN AMERICAN'S VIEW THAT "PAN AM DOES NOT CONSIDER THE TOWER AT TEHRAN TO BE CONTROLLED OR UNDER MILITARY CONTROL. PAN AM DOES NOT CONSIDER TEHRAN TO BE IN A CONTROLLED STATUS."

KRIMSKY CONTINUED THAT PAN AM ACTING CHIEF PILOT, WHEN BRIEFED, OPINED THAT HE WOULD NOT CONSIDER THE PROCEDURES APPARENTLY FOLLOWED BY TEHRAN TOWER TO MEET FAA NORMS AND WOULD NOT APPROVE HIS CORPORATION'S AIRCRAFT LANDING UNDER SUCH CIRCUMSTANCES.

AS POST AWARE, PAN AM HAS A 747 AIRCRAFT CURRENTLY AIRBORNE FROM KARACHI. KRIMSKY STATES THAT PAA AIRCRAFT UNCERTAIN WHETHER IT WILL LAND. IF AIRCRAFT DOES NOT RECEIVE INSTRUMENT FLIGHT RULES ASSISTANCE WHILE IN IRANIAN AIRSPACE, IT WILL DIVERT SOUTH TO BYPASS IRANIAN AIRSPACE AND PROCEED TO ISTANBUL. IF, UPON ARRIVAL OVER TEHRAN, IT DOES NOT GET IMMEDIATE CLEARANCE TO LAND, IT WILL OVERFLY TEHRAN AND PROCEED TO ISTANBUL.
PAN AM INTENDS TO TRY TO INTERVIEW MAC PILOT BY TELEPHONE TO GET HIS PROFESSIONAL ASSESSMENT.

JUSTICE DEPARTMENT RAISED AGAIN SUBJECT OF POSSIBLE EXTRADITION OR DEPORTATION OF SACOLICK. SACOLICK IS A MAJOR DEFENDANT IN ONE OF THE LARGEST MEDICAID FRAUD CASES IN U.S. HISTORY. DEPT. OF JUSTICE CONSIDERS SACOLICK A SERIOUS OFFENDER WHO SHOULD BE BROUGHT TO TRIAL AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

JUSTICE HAS REQUESTED DEPT. TO INFORM POST OF ITS INTEREST IN SACOLICK AND REQUEST THAT HE NOT BE PROVIDED CONSULAR SERVICES OR AIR TRANSPORTATION OUT OF IRAN UNLESS JUSTICE IS INFORMED IN ADVANCE IN ORDER THAT APPROPRIATE ACTION CAN BE TAKEN TO EFFECT HIS ARREST.

DEPT. OF JUSTICE WOULD ALSO APPRECIATE IF POST WOULD CONSULT WITH APPROPRIATE GOI AUTHORITIES ON POSSIBILITY OF SACOLICK'S EXTRADITION OR DEPORTATION TO THE U.S., KEEPING IN MIND THAT DEPT. OF JUSTICE WILL PROVIDE ALL NECESSARY FUNDS FOR HIS TRANSPORTATION (AND EXCORT OFFICERS IF NECESSARY).
PLEASE ADVISE ON ACTION TAKEN. WE FULLY APPRECIATE THE DIFFICULTIES THIS PRESENTS BUT WOULD APPRECIATE YOUR DOING YOUR BEST TO ASSIST JUSTICE WITH THE GOI. VANCE

DEMONSTRATION OF IRANIAN STUDENTS OUTSIDE RESIDENCE OF QUEEN MOTHER AND PRINCESS SHAMS TURNED VIOLENT THIS AFTERNOON. OUR REPORTS ARE STILL FRAGMENTARY AS TROUBLES ARE CONTINUING. DEMONSTRATION STARTED WITH 700 PERSONS BUT GREW RAPIDLY TO OVER 2,000 AND POLICE WERE NOT ABLE TO MAINTAIN CONTROL. MANY WINDOWS WERE BROKEN. HOUSE NEXT DOOR WAS SET ON FIRE. AUTOMOBILES WERE BURNED, POSSIBLY INCLUDING ONE POLICE CAR. A POLICE SHOTGUN MAY HAVE BEEN STOLEN AND THERE ARE REPORTS OF CASUALTIES.
IRANIANS INSIDE THE HOUSE ARE ALL SAFE AND THERE WERE NO INJURIES. QUEEN MOTHER AND PRINCESS SHAMS WILL BE MOVED TO A HOTEL. VANCE

WOULD YOU PLEASE CONVEY TO THE SHAH MY DEEP CONCERN AND REGRET AT THE ATTACK ON THE HOME OF HIS MOTHER AND SISTER. WE DEPLORE THIS ACT OF LAWLESSNESS. PLEASE ASK THE SHAH TO ACCEPT OUR APOLOGIES. ASSURE HIM THAT WE WILL MAKE EVERY EFFORT TO GUARANTEE THE SAFETY AND WELL-BEING OF HIS MOTHER AND SISTER. THE DEPARTMENT OF STATE AND LOCAL LAW ENFORCEMENT AUTHORITIES ARE INCREASING THEIR PROTECTION IMMEDIATELY. OFFICERS ARE BEING SENT FROM WASHINGTON AND OTHER STATIONS TO AUGMENT OUR SECURITY DETAIL IN LOS ANGELES. IN CLOSING, PLEASE CONVEY TO THE SHAH MY DEEP RESPECT AND PERSONAL REGARD.

KHOSROW GHASHGHAI CALLED ON NEA/IRN JANUARY 2 TO OFFER HIS VIEWS OF IRANIAN CRISIS. GHASHGHAI STATED FLATLY THAT NO SOLUTION WAS POSSIBLE WHILE THE SHAH REMAINED IN IRAN. HE URGED THE U.S. TO ESTABLISH CONTACT WITH KHOMEINI'S FORCES WHICH HE REGARDED AS THE MOST POTENT IN THE COUNTRY. HE INDICATED THERE WAS SOME DIFFERENCE OF OPINION BETWEEN HIMSELF AND OTHER MEMBERS OF HIS FAMILY AND THAT HIS FATHER WAS RETURNING TO IRAN IN THE HOPE THAT HE WOULD BE ARRESTED AND BECOME A SYMBOL OF GHASHGHAI OPPOSITION TO THE SHAH.
HE INDICATED ABSOLUTELY NO CONFIDENCE THAT BAKHTIAR WOULD BE ABLE TO FORM A VIABLE GOVERNMENT AND NO SYMPATHY FOR THE PRIME MINISTER-DESIGNATE'S EFFORTS.
GHASHGHAI LEFT WASHINGTON HEADED FOR MUNICH WHERE HE RESIDES.
WE REPORT THIS FOR THE RECORD, HAVING NO UNDERSTANDING OF ITS IMPORTANCE FOR IRANIAN OR TRIBAL POLITICS. VANCE

AS THE SITUATION IN IRAN PROGRESSES, WE BELIEVE THE ROLE OF THE IRANIAN ARMED FORCES (IAF) ASSUMES GREATER IMPORTANCE SINCE, ULTIMATELY, THEY WILL HAVE TO RESTORE ORDER NO MATTER WHAT CAST THE GOVERNMENT TAKES. CURRENTLY THE ARMED FORCES ARE NEGATIVELY PERCEIVED BY THE POPULACE AS THE ENFORCERS AND THEIR PUBLIC IMAGE IS BEING ERODED.

WE BELIEVE THAT ONE WAY TO CREATE A FAVORABLE PUBLIC IMAGE WOULD BE TO INVOLVE THE IAF IN A STRONG PUBLIC ASSISTANCE PROGRAM WHICH WOULD MEET CURRENT NEEDS OF POPULACE AND DEMONSTRATE MILITARY INTEREST IN THE PUBLIC WELFARE. ACTIONS WHICH IMMEDIATELY COME TO MIND ARE THE DISTRIBUTION OF SCARCE FUEL AND FOOD PRODUCTS, MEDICAL ASSISTANCE, TRANSPORTATION, ETC. WE PRESUME THERE ARE OTHER TASKS WHICH FALL WITHIN THIS TYPE OF HUMANITARIAN EFFORT AS WELL.

REQUEST YOUR COMMENTS ON THESE AND OTHER TASKS WHICH MIGHT BE APPROPRIATE FOR THE IAF TO UNDERTAKE. WE RECOGNIZE IN-COUNTRY SHORTAGES EXIST AND WOULD BE WILLING TO CONSIDER YOUR RECOMMENDATIONS FOR APPROPRIATE ASSISTANCE AS REQUIREMENTS ARE IDENTIFIED. DEPTOFF MET JANUARY 3 WITH BIJAN AMINI, NEPHEW OF ALI AMINI AND REPRESENTATIVE OF SEVERAL AMERICAN FIRMS IN IRAN. HIS PRESENTATION DID NOT DIFFER FROM THE PESSIMISTIC VIEW OF MOST OF OUR VISITORS. THE SHAH MUST GO AND GO QUICKLY. A MILITARY COUP WOULD BE A DISASTER. THERE WAS LITTLE HOPE THAT BAKHTIAR WOULD BE SUCCESSFUL. AND SO FORTH.

AMINI SAID HE UNDERSTOOD SENIOR MILITARY OFFICERS FROM AZERBAIJAN WERE FORMING A GROUP TO PURSUE THEIR OWN INTERESTS. IN THIS CONNECTION HE MENTIONED THAT GENERAL SHAFAGHAT, FORMER ADJUTANT TO THE SHAH AND TABRIZ'S MILITARY GOVERNOR, WAS A PARTICULARLY STRONG REPRESENTATIVE OF THE "IRON FIST" SCHOOL WITHIN MILITARY CIRCLES.

AMINI EMPHASIZED THAT THE BAZAAR MERCHANTS CONSTITUTED ONE OF THE STRONGEST FORCES FOR MODERATION IN THE PRESENT CRISIS. ONCE THEY WERE SATISFIED IN THEIR SINGLE AIM OF REMOVING THE SHAH THEY WOULD BE A USEFUL RESTRAINING FORCE AGAINST EXTREMISTS AMONG THE RELIGIOUS ELEMENTS OR THE MILITARY. BECAUSE OF THEIR ENORMOUS IMPACT ON THE DAY-TO-DAY ECONOMIC LIFE OF THE COUNTRY, THE BAZAAR MERCHANTS COULD BE A DECISIVE ELEMENT IN THE WEEKS AHEAD. HE URGED THAT THE EMBASSY BROADEN ITS CONTACTS WITHIN THE SECTOR SUGGESTING IN PARTICULAR THOSE EX-PAZAAREES WHO HAD MADE IT TO THE TOP LIKE BARKHODAR AND LAJVARDI.

CONCERNING YOUR REQUEST IN REFTEL FOR A NEW POST FOR VERNON ADLER, THERE ARE NO OPENINGS AT THIS POINT WITH REGARD TO SCIENCE ATTACHE POSTS BUT THERE MAY BE IN JUNE. IN THE INTERIM, I SUGGEST THAT ADLER BE TRANSFERRED BACK TO THE DEPARTMENT FOR TEMPORARY ASSIGNMENT IN OES. HAPPY TO HEAR THAT VERNON PERFORMED VERY WELL AND I WELCOME, AND CAN USE HIS SERVICES IN OES/NET. VANCE

DEP OFF CALLED COTTAM JANUARY 7 FOR REPORT TO SUPPLEMENT REFTEL. COTTAM STRESSED THAT GROUP AROUND KHOMEINI AND OPPOSITIONISTS IN TEHRAN WERE FEARFUL OF A MILITARY COUP WHICH WOULD LEAD TO BLOODY REPRESSION. HE SAID THAT IN HIS FINAL DAYS IN TEHRAN, JANUARY 2-3, OPPOSITIONISTS WERE QUITE DEFINITE IN THEIR INFORMATION ABOUT A COUP. THEY HAD NAMES OF SIX GENERALS, INCLUDING OVEISSI, RABII, AND KHOSROWDAD PLUS THREE OTHERS COTTAM COULDN'T REMEMBER WHO WERE THE PRINCIPAL MILITARY LEADERS. COUP PLANS BEING DRAWN UP IN A BUILDING OWNED BY "RESEARCH CORPORATION" ON SHAH ABBAS AVENUE. ACCORDING TO THE OPPOSITION, THE PLANNERS HAD DIVIDED TEHRAN INTO SIX DISTRICTS EACH UNDER A GENERAL OFFICER.
ARRESTS AND APPLICATION OF STRICT MILITARY CONTROLS WOULD BE SET IN MOTION AT A GIVEN SIGNAL. MANY IN THE OPPOSITION FEARED THE U.S. WOULD BACK SUCH A COUP.

DESPITE HATRED FOR U.S. AMONG THE GENERAL POPULATION, COTTAM FOUND KHOMEINI'S CIRCLE AND OPPOSITIONISTS IN TEHRAN READY TO THINK IN SOPHISTICATED TERMS ABOUT FUTURE RELATIONS WITH THE U.S. HE DESCRIBED THEM AS AFRAID OF THE SOVIET UNION AND DESIROUS OF RELYING ON THE U.S. FOR IRAN'S DEFENSE. THEY DID NOT WANT A FORMAL DEFENSIVE RELATIONSHIP BUT DID WANT U.S. BACKING AGAINST THE SOVIET THREAT. KHOMEINI'S FOLLOWERS THOUGHT MOSCOW WOULD BE GREATLY DISTURBED BY A GOVERNMENT IN IRAN UNDER THE INFLUENCE OF RELIGIOUS LEADERS WHO MIGHT EXERCISE INFLUENCE BEYOND IRAN'S BORDERS, INCLUDING AMONG SOVIET MOSLEMS.

COTTAM DESCRIBED AMIR AMIR-ENTEZAM, AN IRANIAN BUSINESSMAN, AS PROBABLY A VERY IMPORTANT LEADER AMONG THE KHOMEINI FACTION. AMIR-ENTEZAM TOLD COTTAM HE WISHED TO HAVE CONTACT WITH THE EMBASSY. COTTAM APPARENTLY ENCOURAGED HIM IN THAT DIRECTION.

MODERATE OPPOSITIONISTS, ACCORDING TO COTTAM, WOULD TOLERATE BAKHTIAR AS LONG AS ANTI-SHAH MOVEMENT DID NOT LOSE MOMENTUM. SHOULD THEY SENSE THAT SPIRITS WERE WANING AMONG DEMONSTRATORS THEY WOULD STEP UP ATTACKS ON BAKHTIAR. BAKHTIAR WAS REGARDED AS A WEAK PERSONALITY, UNABLE TO RESIST THE SHAH'S OFFER OF THE PRIME MINISTERSHIP NO MATTER WHAT THE COST TO IRAN.

COTTAM DESCRIBED IN SOMEWHAT GREATER DETAIL REGENCY COUNCIL IDEA MENTIONED PARA. 4 REFTEL. COUNCIL WOULD BE COMPOSED OF A GENERAL OFFICER SELECTED BY THE SHAH, ALI AMINI (WHOM THE SHAH BELIEVED WAS LOYAL BUT WHO REALLY SUPPORTED THE OPPOSITION), BEHESTI (KHOMEINI'S CHIEF LIEUTENANT IN IRAN), PROGRESSIVE LAWYER NAZIEH AND, TO BREAK TIE VOTES, EMPRESS FARAH. SANJABI WOULD BE PRIME MINISTER; PARLIAMENT WOULD BE DISSOLVED AND ELECTIONS CALLED, NEW MAJLIS WOULD PRESUMABLY REVISE THE CONSTITUTION TO ELIMINATE THE SHAH.

FINALLY, COTTAM DESCRIBED A CONVERSATION WITH A RETIRED COLONEL WHO SAID THAT ALL OF THE RETIRED COLONELS (MEN FIRED BY THE SHAH) WERE REVOLUTIONARY BECAUSE THEY WERE LITERATE. MOST OF THE GENERALS WERE ILLITERATE AND INDEED THAT WAS WHY THE SHAH HAD PROMOTED THEM. THE GENERALS WOULD REMAIN LOYAL BUT THE COLONELS COULD ONLY TAKE SO MUCH STRAIN. LARGE NUMBERS OF COLONELS AND LOWER RANKING OFFICERS WERE BELIEVED TIED IN TO THE KHOMEINI ORGANIZATION. KHOMEINI'S GROUP HAD RECENTLY BEEN GIVING THE MILITARY PRIORITY ADDITIONAL ATTENTION. VANCE

IN HIS CONVERSATION JANUARY 7 COTTAM TOLD ME THAT KAZEMI HAD TWICE BEEN OFFERED THE FOREIGN MINISTER POST BY BAKHTIAR. HE REFUSED DESPITE THE FACT THAT HE WAS A LONG-TIME FAMILY FRIEND OF BAKHTIAR. PERHAPS HE IS INFLUENCED BY HIS CLOSE PERSONAL FRIENDSHIP WITH KAZEMI, BUT COTTAM FEELS THAT KAZEMI WILL BE VERY INFLUENTIAL IN ANY FOREIGN MINISTRY WHICH OPERATES UNDER OPPOSITION CONTROL OR INFLUENCE.

KAZEMI SPOKE OF MAINTAINING CLOSE RELATIONS WITH THE U.S. BECAUSE OF FEARED PRESSURES FROM THE USSR. A NEW GOVERNMENT, HOWEVER, COULD NOT MAINTAIN FORMAL ALLIANCE TIES WITH THE U.S. OIL PRODUCTION WOULD BE REDUCED TO A LEVEL COMMENSURATE WITH IRAN'S REAL DEVELOPMENT NEEDS, I.E. EMPHASIS ON AGRICULTURE AND SOCIAL INFRASTRUCTURE.
KNOW THAT YOU HAVE A GOOD RELATIONSHIP WITH KAZEMI ND WANT YOU TO HAVE THESE NOTES FOR YOUR BACKGROUND IF YOU HAVE NOT HAD A CHANCE TO TALK WITH HIM RECENTLY.

1979STATE007862.subject: KASHFI CONTACTS I HAVE SPOKEN TWICE WITH KASHFI WHO IS IN GENEVA AND WHO PLANS TO RETURN TO TEHRAN SUNDAY. BELIEVE HE HAS

segments.text: I HAVE SPOKEN TWICE WITH KASHFI WHO IS IN GENEVA AND WHO PLANS TO RETURN TO TEHRAN SUNDAY. PLEASE UNDERSTAND THAT I AM NOT SUGGESTING THAT YOU ALL FOLLOW UP ON KASHFI'S IDEAS. THAT IS YOUR DECISION. I BELIEVE, HOWEVER, THAT HE DOES HAVE EXCELLENT CONTACTS AND IT MIGHT BE USEFUL TO EXPLORE HIS IDEAS A LITTLE
FOLLOWING IS THE STATEMENT ON IRAN GIVEN BY THE SECRETARY AT THE OPENING OF HIS PRESS CONFERENCE TODAY.

BEGIN TEXT: --THE UNITED STATES HAS A STRONG AND CONTINUING INTEREST IN A FREE, STABLE, AND INDEPENDENT IRAN IN THIS STRATEGIC REGION. THIS IS A POLICY WE HAVE CONSISTENTLY AND ACTIVELY PURSUED OVER THE PAST GENERATION. --IN THIS RECENT CRISIS, WE HAVE ENCOURAGED THE RESTORATION OF ORDER SO THAT THE BLOODSHED WOULD END AND THE PEOPLE OF IRAN COULD RETURN TO NORMAL LIFE.

ONLY IN SUCH CIRCUMSTANCES CAN THERE BE RATIONAL DISCUSSION OF A POLITICAL SOLUTION TO IRAN'S CURRENT PROBLE --IT HAS BEEN OUR OBJECTIVE THROUGHOUT THIS CURRENT CRISIS TO ENSURE THE MAXIMUM OF STABILITY IN A TIME OF CHANGE BY PRESERVING THE INSTITUTIONAL FRAMEWORK OF IRAN UNDER ITS CONSTITUTION. --THE SHAH HAS SAID THAT HE PLANS TO LEAVE IRAN ON VACATION. THAT HAS BEEN HIS DECISION WORKED OUT WITH HIS IRANIAN COLLEAGUES.

THE SHAH REMAINS THE CONSTITUTIONAL HEAD OF STATE AND WE CONTINUE TO WORK WITH HIM IN THAT CAPACITY. --THE SHAH HAS SAID THAT WHEN HE LEAVES HE WILL DO SO IN THE WAY PRESCRIBED BY THE IRANIAN CONSTITUTION BY APPOINTING A REGENCY COUNCIL TO SERVE IN HIS ABSENCE. AT THE SAME TIME, A NEW CIVILIAN GOVERNMENT UNDER PRIME MINISTER BAKHTIAR HAS BEEN NAMED. --WE BELIEVE THAT THE NEW GOVERNMENT SHOULD BE GIVEN EVERY CHANCE TO RECONCILE THE DIFFERENCES IN IRAN AND FIND A PEACEFUL POLITICAL SOLUTION. --IRAN'S ARMED FORCES REMAIN ESSENTIAL TO THE SECURITY AND INDEPENDENCE OF IRAN AND AS A NECESSARY COMPLEMENT TO A LEGITIMATE CIVILIAN GOVERNMENT.

WE HAVE URGED THAT EVERYTHING BE DONE TO INSURE THEIR INTEGRITY AND THEIR SUPPORT BY THE PEOPLE OF IRAN. --WE HAVE URGED THAT LEADERS OF ALL ELEMENTS IN IRAN FIND WAYS OF WORKING OUT TOGETHER A PEACEFUL SOLUTION TO THE PRESENT PROBLEMS. THE DECISIONS ON IRAN'S FUTURE MUST BE MADE BY THE IRANIANS THEMSELVES. NO OUTSIDE GOVERNMENT SHOULD SEEK TO INTERFERE. --WE HOPE FOR A RETURN TO PEACEFUL CONDITIONS AND A FUNCTIONING ECONOMY THAT WILL MAKE POSSIBLE AN ORDERLY AND CONSTRUCTIVE SOLUTION OF IRAN'S PROBLEMS.

FRENCH EMBOFF HERE TOLD DEPTOFF THAT DECISION TO ALLOW KHOMEINI TO CONTINUE TO STAY IN FRANCE ON AN INDEFINITE BASIS WAS MADE ONLY AFTER PONIATOWSKI VISIT TO IRAN. EMBOFF LEFT IMPRESSION THAT MAIN PURPOSE OF PONIATOWSKI VISIT TO IRAN WAS TO DISCUSS KHOMEINI QUESTION WITH GOI. VANCE

1979STATE010697.subject: KHOMEINI ON CBS' "FACE THE NATION" JANUARY 14

segments.text: KHOMEINI HAS BEEN INTERVIEWED BY GEORGE HERMAN AND BERT QUINT OF CBS, AND SCOTT SULLIVAN OF "NEWSWEEK", FOR "FACE THE NATION" JANUARY 14. EXCERPTS WERE CARRIED JANUARY 12 BY CBS, PRINCIPALLY A QUINT ITEM ON THE CRONKITE EVENING NEWS. PARAS BELOW, AFTER CRONKITE INTRODUCTION, COVER QUINT ITEM.
QUINT: "KHOMEINI SAID IT WOULD BE HE NOT THE RECENTLY FORMED BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT THAT WOULD RULE IRAN. HE SAID, 'I WILL APPOINT THE GOVERNMENT.' "
HERMAN: "DO YOU HAVE A FEELING FOR HOW LONG IT WILL BE BEFORE THERE IS AN ISLAMIC STATE IN IRAN?" KHOMEINI: "IT IS VERY CLOSE, VERY SOON WE WILL ANNOUNCE A NEW GOVERNMENT, PROBABLY IN A FEW DAYS."

QUINT: "THE MEN WHO WILL SERVE IN IT, KHOMEINI SAID, ARE IN IRAN NOW. KHOMEINI HAS CONTACTED THEM AND THEY HAVE AGREED TO SERVE. KHOMEINI INDICATED NATIONAL FRONT LEADER SANJABI WOULD BE ONE OF THOSE MEN. AS FOR HIS OWN ROLE, KHOMEINI SAID, 'I WILL SUPERVISE AND DIRECT THE GOVERNMENT.' ASKED IF, IN EFFECT, HE WOULD BE THE STRONG MAN OF IRAN, HE REPLIED, 'YOU MAY ASSUME SO.' "

QUINT: "KHOMEINI ALSO SAID THAT THE ARMY IS DIVIDED INTO FACTIONS FOR AND AGAINST THE SHAH. HE HOPED THIS WOULD NOT MEAN CIVIL WAR, BUT IF CIVIL WAR CAME THE MASSES OF IRANIANS WOULD FIGHT FOR THE INSTALLATION OF AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC."
WE EXPECT TO GET THE FULL TEXT OF "FACE THE NATION" SHORTLY PRIOR TO THE BROADCAST, AND WILL CABLE IT TO YOU.

1979STATE010735.subject: U.S. POSTURE IN COMING IRANIAN NEGOTIATIONS

segments.text: WE ASSUME YOU HAVE SEEN CABLE OF JANUARY 13 WHICH GENERAL HUYSER SENT TO HAROLD BROWN. PRESIDENT AND SECRETARY AGREE WITH ORDER OF PREFERENCE OF THESE OPTIONS AS GIVEN IN HUYSER CABLE.

AS WE REVIEW THE FIVE OPTIONS RELAYED BY GENERAL HUYSER, IT SEEMS TO US IMPORTANT TO DEFINE WHAT WE ENVISION AS POSSIBLE UNDER EITHER A BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT (A) OR A FOLLOW-ON (B). WHAT KIND OF AGREEMENT INVOLVING ALL MAJOR IRANIAN ELEMENTS MIGHT BE POSSIBLE THAT WOULD AVOID THE EXTREMES OF EITHER A MILITARY GOVERNMENT OR A "KHOMEINI GOVERNMENT"? DOES REGENCY COUNCIL HAVE ANY HOPE OF PLAYING A ROLE IN MAINTAINING GOVERNMENT STABILITY OR WOULD THIS REST ENTIRELY WITH MILITARY AND RELIGIOUS? WHAT IS THE LIKELY PROCESS OF CHANGE IF BAKHTIAR FAILS?

WE STRONGLY ENDORSE YOUR EFFORTS TO BRING THE MILITARY AND KHOMEINI FORCES TOGETHER IN A MEETING IN TEHRAN. WE ARE, ONCE MORE, THROUGH FRENCH CONTACTING KHOMEINI TO ASK HIM TO GIVE THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT A CHANCE TO RESTORE CALM, EMPHASIZING CONTINUING THREAT OF MILITARY COUP. IDEALLY, WE WOULD HOPE KHOMEINI WOULD BE PERSUADED AGAINST RETURNING NOW. ALTHOUGH WE APPRECIATE RISKS OF OUR ATTEMPTING TO DISCOURAGE HIM.
BEYOND THESE MEASURES, WE WOULD APPRECIATE YOUR THINKING ON HOW WE SHOULD CONDUCT OURSELVES IN THE DAYS AHEAD.

WE HAVE DECIDED THAT IT IS DESIRABLE TO ESTABLISH A DIRECT AMERICAN CHANNEL TO KHOMEINI'S ENTOURAGE. WE BELIEVE THE BEST WAY TO DO THIS WOULD BE FOR ZIMMERMAN TO ESTABLISH CONTACT AND A RELIABLE MEANS OF COMMUNICATION WITH IBRAHIM YAZDI.

IN PROCEEDING TO ESTABLISH THIS CONTACT YOU SHOULD INFORM THE FRENCH THROUGH THE CHANNEL YOU HAVE PREVIOUSLY USED WHAT WE ARE DOING. YOU SHOULD BE SURE THAT THEY DO NOT SEE THIS AS A DISSATISFACTION WITH THEIR PREVIOUS CONTACTS, BY EXPLAINING THAT AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN IS NOW ENGAGED IN ESTABLISHING DISCUSSIONS BETWEEN THE IRANIAN MILITARY AND KHOMEINI'S PEOPLE IN TEHRAN AND WE MAY NEED TO BE IN TOUCH WITH KHOMEINI'S GROUP IN PARIS QUICKLY FOR OPERATIONAL REASONS.

YOU SHOULD EMPHASIZE OUR APPRECIATION AND SATISFACTION WITH WHAT THE FRENCH HAVE DONE SO FAR AND THEN EXPLAIN THAT AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN HAS BEEN ASKED, JUST WITHIN THE LAST 24 HOURS, TO TRY TO ARRANGE FOR A MEETING AND HAS HAD DIFFICULTY GETTING BOTH SIDES TO AGREE ON THE PLACE FOR THE MEETING. WE WANT TO URGE KHOMEINI TO HAVE HIS PEOPLE BE MORE FLEXIBLE ON THIS POINT AND BE IN A POSITION TO DEAL RAPIDLY WITH FUTURE ISSUES ON THE MECHANICS OF THE MEETING.

AS A FIRST SUBJECT TO RAISE WITH YAZDI, ZIMMERMAN SHOULD TELL HIM THE FOLLOWING: AS YAZDI PROBABLY KNOWS, AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN HAS BEEN TRYING TO ARRANGE A MEETING BETWEEN IRANIAN MILITARY LEADERS AND MOHAMMED BEHESHTI, ONE OF KHOMEINI'S PRINCIPAL REPRESENTATIVES IN TEHRAN. BOTH SIDES SEEM TO WANT THIS MEETING BUT THEY HAVE HAD DIFFICULTY IN AGREEING WHERE IT SHOULD TAKE PLACE. WE WANT TO ASSURE THAT KHOMEINI UNDERSTANDS OUR DESIRE TO FACILITATE SUCH A MEETING AND WE WOULD HOPE THAT HE MIGHT URGE HIS COLLEAGUES IN TEHRAN TO BE AS FLEXIBLE AS POSSIBLE IN WORKING OUT A SITE FOR THE MEETING.

IN HIS OPENING COMMENTS TO YAZDI, ZIMMERMAN SHOULD SAY THAT WE WANT TO HAVE A CHANNEL TO HIM WHICH WE CAN USE IF THE OCCASION REQUIRES. IN ANY SUBSEQUENT CONVERSATION ZIMMERMAN SHOULD MAKE CLEAR THAT HE IS NOT PREPARED TO ENGAGE IN NEGOTIATIONS OF ANY KIND. HE WILL BE PREPARED TO LISTEN TO YAZDI'S VIEWS AND TO REPORT THEM AND PASS MESSAGES AS REQUIRED.

(S - ENTIRE TEXT) ZIMMERMANN MET WITH YAZDI AT 1300 LOCAL AT AN INN WHERE YAZDI IS STAYING NEAR KHOMEINI COMPOUND. SITE, WHICH IS HALF-HOUR DRIVE FROM PARIS, WAS CHOSEN BECAUSE IT OFFERS FAR GREATER SECURITY THAN COMPOUND; YAZDI SUGGESTED IT CONTINUE TO BE MEETING PLACE. YAZDI SEEMED TO UNDERSTAND AND AGREE WITH ZIMMERMANN'S REQUEST THAT CHANNEL SHOULD BE KEPT SECRET; A MECHANISM WAS SET UP FOR RAPID COMMUNICATION BETWEEN THE TWO. ZIMMERMANN EXPLAINED GROUND RULES AS PER PARAGRAPH 4 REFTEL; YAZDI SEEMED TO WELCOME ESTABLISHMENT OF CHANNEL.

ZIMMERMANN DELIVERED MESSAGE PER PARA 3 REFTEL, AND GAVE YAZDI A COPY OF HODDING CARTER'S JANUARY 12 STATEMENT UNDERLINING US OPPOSITION TO A MILITARY COUP. YAZDI SAID HE WOULD CONVEY THE MESSAGE TO KHOMEINI. HE DID NOT INDICATE THAT HE HAD HEARD ANY OF IT BEFORE. HE ASKED IF ZIMMERMANN HAD THE NAMES OF ANY OF THE MILITARY LEADERS WITH WHOM AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN WAS IN CONTACT AND WAS TOLD NO.
YAZDI THEN EXPLAINED WRITTEN STATEMENT KHOMEINI HAD ISSUED "TO IRANIAN PEOPLE" FOLLOWING TAPING OF HIS FACE THE NATION INTERVIEW NIGHT OF JANUARY

YAZDI SAID THE STATEMENT WAS ISSUED TO CLARIFY THE PRELIMINARY STAGE LEADING TO A TRANSITIONAL GOVERNMENT FOLLOWING THE DEPARTURE OF THE SHAH. DESCRIBING THE STATEMENT, YAZDI SAID THAT THE "REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL" WAS ALREADY IN PLACE TO PREPARE ARRANGEMENTS FOR THE TRANSITIONAL GOVERNMENT. THE TRANSITIONAL GOVERNMENT WOULD HAVE THREE AIMS: FIRST, TO HOLD AN ELECTION FOR A CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY, WHICH IS TO RATIFY A NEW CONSTITUTION; SECOND, TO HOLD NEW ELECTIONS, BASED ON THE NEW CONSTITUTION, FOR A REPRESENTATIVE ASSEMBLY; AND THIRD, TO TRANSFER POWER FROM THE TRANSITIONAL GOVERNMENT TO THE NEWLY ELECTED GOVERNMENT.

YAZDI THEN EXPRESSED CONCERN, WHICH HE ATTRIBUTED TO KHOMEINI, THAT, ALTHOUGH US OFFICIALS SAID THEY WOULD NOT SUPPORT A MILITARY COUP, THE MILITARY IS PREPARING A COUP. IT IS TO TAKE PLACE EITHER AT THE TIME OF THE SHAH'S DEPARTURE OR AFTER. YAZDI SAID IT WOULD BE HARD FOR THE IRANIAN PEOPLE TO ACCEPT THAT A MILITARY COUP COULD TAKE PLACE WITHOUT DIRECT OR INDIRECT US APPROVAL OR SUPPORT, PARTICULARLY CONSIDERING THE US INFLUENCE IN THE COUNTRY. YAZDI SAID A COUP WOULD ONLY INTENSIFY AND RADICALIZE THE SITUATION, AND, FOLLOWING THE SHAH'S DEPARTURE, THE VIOLENCE WOULD BE DIRECTED AGAINST AMERICANS.
THUS, HE CONCLUDED, STRESSING THAT HE SPOKE FOR KHOMEINI, THE AMERICANS SHOULD DO ALL THEY COULD TO PREVENT A COUP.

YAZDI ASKED WHO GENERAL HUYSER WAS. ZIMMERMANN EXPLAINED HIS POSITION, THEN SAID THAT THE US HAD STATED PUBLICLY THAT A MAJOR AIM OF HUYSER'S MISSION WAS TO TRY TO CONVINCE THE IRANIAN ARMY TO SUPPORT THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT. ZIMMERMANN ALSO RE-DIRECTED YAZDI'S ATTENTION TO THE HODDING CARTER STATEMENT, WHICH WENT IN THE SAME DIRECTION.

DURING THE MEETING YAZDI ASKED IF ZIMMERMANN HAD ANY INFORMATION ABOUT WHEN THE SHAH WAS LEAVING. ZIMMERMANN SAID HE DID NOT. THE MEETING ENDED AMICABLY AFTER ABOUT 20 MINUTES, WITH ZIMMERMANN TURNING DOWN AN INVITATION TO STAY TO LUNCH.

PRIOR TO CONTACTING YAZDI, ZIMMERMANN INFORMED HIS ELYSEE CONTACT, PER PARA 2 OF REFTEL, OF INTENDED MEETING. ELYSEE CONTACT WAS GRATEFUL FOR INFORMATION, APPEARED TO UNDERSTAND NEED FOR DIRECT US CONTACTS WITH KHOMEINI ENTOURAGE, AND SAID HE WOULD INFORM PRESIDENT GISCARD IMMEDIATELY. ZIMMERMANN WILL FOLLOW UP WITH ELYSEE TO SAY THAT CONTACT WAS MADE AND THAT YAZDI HAD AGREED TO TRANSMIT US VIEWS TO

1979STATE011036.subject: KHOMEINI AND IRANIAN SITUATION FOR UNDER SECRETARY NEWSOM (C-ENTIRE TEXT)

segments.text: FOR UNDER SECRETARY NEWSOM (C-ENTIRE TEXT)

FORMER AMBASSADOR ARIM MEYER REQUESTED THAT WE PASS THE FOLLOWING MESSAGE TO THE UNDER SECRETARY; PURPOSE OF MY ATTEMPT TO REACH YOU PRIOR TO LEAVING WASHINGTON WAS TO DRAW YOUR ATTENTION TO WHAT COULD BE REAL OPPORTUNITY TO GET KHOMEINI TO PLAY MORE HELPFUL ROLE IN IRAN. DR. MAHDI HAERI, RESPECTED ISLAMIC SCHOLAR WHO IS CURRENTLY AG GEROGETOWN'S KENNEDY INSTITUTE, IS RELATIVE OF KHOMEINI AND SUTUDIED UNDER HIM. HAERI'S FATHER TAUGHT KHOMEINI AT QUM. HAERI IS LOW KEY BUT VERY IMPRESSIVE. MIGHT EVEN BE VALUABLE MOSLEM FIGURE ON REGENCY COUNCIT.

A MONTH AGO HAERI WROTE KHOMEINI IN FRIENDLY VEIN POINTING OUT ISLAMIC REPUBLIC TOO IDEALISTIC AND KHOMEINI SHOULD BE MORE REALISTIC. LAST TUESDAY HAERI RECEIVED HANDWRITTEN KHOMEINI REPLY WHICH HAERI READ TO ME. KHOMEINI AGREED ON NEED FOR REALISM AND THAT ISLAMIC REPUBLIC "UNWORKABLE". INSITING HE PERSONALLY SEEKS NO POLITICAL POSITION, KHOMEINI SAID HIS ONLY OBJECTIVES ARE TO AMELIORATE OPPRESSION WHICH HAS PREVAILED IN IRAN AND TO STOP THE SINFUL FINANCIAL ENRICHMENT BY SO MANY IRANIANS AT THE EXPENSE OF THE POOR PEOPLE.

FROM OTHERS WHO HAVE RECENTLY SEEN KNOMEINI, HAERI HAS LEARNED THAT, WHILE KHOMEINI DID NOT DISCLOSE CONTENTS, HAERI'S ORIGINAL LETTER HAD SIGNIFICANT IMPACT ON KHOMEINI. COULD WELL HAVE PROMPTED OLIVE BRANCH KHOMEININ EXTENDED VIA WASHINGTON POST.

HAEIR IS ANXIOUS TO PROTECT CONFIDENCE WHICH EXISTS BETWEEN HIM AND KHOMEINI AND, THEREFORE, WANTS NO DISCLOSURE OF HIS CORRESPONDENCE. AT SAMT TIME HAERI WISHES TO BE HELPFUL IN REMEDYING IRANIAN TRAGEDY AND PRESERVING IRAN RELATIONS WITH USA. INCIDENTALLY, HE EMPHASIZED KHOMEINI IS BASICALLY ANTI-COMMUNIST AND NOT ANTI-SEMITIC.
PHIL STODDARD AND BILL MILLER HAVE BEEN ONLY ONES ADVISED OF FOREGOING. BILL KNEW HAERI IN IRAN AND COULD BE USEFUL CUTOUT.
BE SURE I HAVE NO DESIRE TO GET INVOLVED AT ALL BUT HONESTLY BELIEVE HAERI COULD BE AN ASSED.

THIS MESSAGE IS PROMPTED BY ENCOUNTER WITH IRANIAN AMBASSADOR HERE WHO RETURNED FROM TEHRAN THREE DAYS AGO. HE SAYS CENTRAL CURRENT EFFORT IS TO GET KHOMEINI OFF ISLAMIC REPUBLIC KICK WHICH IS UNREALISTIC AND UNWORKABLE AND COULD ONLY PROVE FIASCO AND LEAD UNTIMATELY TO INCREASED COMMUNIST INFLUENCE. REGARDS. ARMIN MEYER

YOU SHOULD ARRANGE TO CALL ON PRIME MINISTER BAKHTIAR SOON AFTER HE RECEIVES THE VOTE OF THE MAJLIS CONFIRMING HIM IN OFFICE. YOU SHOULD CONVEY TO HIM THE FOLLOWING PRIVATE ORAL MESSAGE FROM THE PRESIDENT: BEGIN : DEAR MR. PRIME MINISTER: I AM ASKING AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN TO CONVEY TO YOU MY VERY BEST WISHES AS YOU ASSUME YOUR DUTIES AS PRIME MINISTER AT THIS CRITICAL MOMENT IN IRAN'S HISTORY. IT IS A TIME THAT CALLS FOR STRONG, WISE AND COMPASSIONATE LEADERSHIP. I WANT YOU TO KNOW THAT THE UNITED STATES STANDS READY TO GIVE YOU OUR FULL SUPPORT AS YOU AND YOUR COLLEAGUES GUIDE IRAN THROUGH THE DIFFICULT WEEKS AHEAD.
SINCERELY YOURS, JIMMY CARTER. END .
WE DO NOT PLAN TO RELEASE TEXT OF THIS MESSAGE. VANCE
WE ARE REPEATING TO YOU TEHRAN 754.
ZIMMERMAN SHOULD SEE YAZDI AS SOON AS POSSIBLE AND DELIVER MESSAGE RECOMMENDED BY AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN.

(S) ENTIRE TEXT YOU WILL BE RECEIVING BY SEPTEL A COPY OF MY STATEMENT IN CONNECTION WITH TESTIMONY BEFORE THE MIDDLE EAST SUBCOMMITTEE OF THE HOUSE INTERNATIONAL RELATIONS COMMITTEE ON JANUARY 17. PLEASE ARRANGE AN EARLY MEETING TO PASS THIS TO YAZDI. YOU MAY SAY THAT, SINCE THERE MAY BE A NUMBER OF NEWS REPORTS ABOUT VARIOUS PUBLIC APPEARANCES OF AMERICAN OFFICIALS IN THE NEXT FEW DAYS, WE WANTED TO ASSURE THAT THEY HAD THE FULL TEXT OF A COMPREHENSIVE STATEMENT OF OUR CURRENT POSITION. YOU MAY ALSO SAY THAT THIS STATEMENT IS VIEWED AS FULLY CONSISTENT WITH PREVIOUS MESSAGES WHICH YOU HAVE PASSED. VANCE

IN OUR VIEW IRANIAN SITUATION IS AT THE MOMENT IN AN EXTREMELY DELICATE STATE. AS BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT SEEKS TO RESTORE ORDER WITH AT LEAST SOME SUPPORT FROM OPPOSITION ELEMENTS, IMMEDIATE RETURN OF KHOMEINI WOULD IN OUR VIEW RUN RISK OF FURTHER UNREST AND POSSIBLE MILITARY RESPONSE. WE BELIEVE THAT IT MIGHT HELP IRAN'S RETURN TO STABILITY IF HE WERE TO TIME HIS RETURN TO FOLLOW A BASIC AGREEMENT BETWEEN HIS SUPPORTERS AND THE MILITARY. TALKS BETWEEN THEM WILL START SHORTLY.
WE HAVE BEEN INDIRECTLY IN TOUCH WITH KHOMEINI AND UNDERSTAND THAT HE TOO HAS SOME APPREHENSION ABOUT RETURNING NOW BUT MAY BE PRESSED BY ADVISERS WHO TAKE A DIFFERENT VIEW.

REQUEST YOU SEE CROWN PRINCE FAHD ON URGENT BASIS TO SHARE OUR CONCERN AND TO SUGGEST THAT SAUDIS MAY ALSO WISH TO COUNSEL KHOMEINI ALONG THESE LINES THROUGH WHATEVER CHANNEL THEY REGARD AS MOST EFFECTIVE.
FYI. YOU SHOULD BE CAREFUL NOT TO APPEAR AS IF WE OPPOSE KHOMEINI'S RETURN. OUR POSTURE IS SIMPLY ONE OF WANTING TO AVOID SITUATION IN WHICH MILITARY REACTION

1979STATE012420.subject: WELFARE AND WHEREABOUTS HAWAIIAN AGRONOMICS PER- SONNEL

segments.text: SONNEL

HAWAIIAN AGRONOMICS HOME OFFICE IN HAWAII HAS BEEN UNABLE TO GET THROUGH TO THEIR OFFICE IN TEHRAN BY TELEX OR TELEPHONE, AND WOULD THEREFORE APPRECIATE YOUR ASSISTANCE IN FINDING OUT FOR THEM HOW MANY OF THEIR PEOPLE ARE STILL IN TEHRAN.

THE OFFICE NUMBERS FOR HAWAIIAN AGRONOMICS IN TEHRAN ARE 839-230, 833-579, OR 834-079. PEOPLE TO BE CONTACTED ARE MESSRS. YAMAMOTO (HOME PHONE 827-684), BOWMAN, OR SARIRI. WHEN WE RECEIVE INFORMATION FROM YOU WE WILL PASS IT ON TO HOME OFFICE. VANCE
(S - ENTIRE TEXT) ZIMMERMANN SAW YAZDI FOR 50 MINUTES AT 6:30 PM LOCAL JANUARY 16. ZIMMERMANN WENT THROUGH MESSAGE REFTEL B VERY SLOWLY, AND YAZDI TOOK NOTES, APPARENTLY WORD-FOR-WORD, IN FARSI.

FOLLOWING THIS, YAZDI SAID THAT, DURING TRANSITION LEADING UP TO SHAH'S DEPARTURE, KHOMEINI HAD EXPRESSED CONCERN THAT THE ARMY WAS PREPARING A TAKEOVER. YAZDI SAID HE HAD DEFINITE INFORMATION THAT THERE WAS COUP MOVEMENT WITHIN ARMY, AND THAT THIS ANALYSIS WAS NOW CONFIRMED BY WHAT ZIMMERMANN HAD JUST TOLD HIM. THE ARMY, HE SAID, HAS BEEN TRYING TO PROVOKE THE PEOPLE TO ATTACK THE SOLDIERS AND ARMY HEADQUARTERS. THIS WAS THE CONTEXT OF KHOMEINI'S STATEMENT URGING THE PEOPLE TO RESTRAIN THEMSELVES AND EXERCISE DISCIPLINE.
YAZDI SAID HE ALSO HAD DEFINITE INFORMATION THAT THE TUDEH ACTIVITIES TO WHICH ZIMMERMANN HAD REFERRED WERE PROVOKED AND ORGANIZED BY THE MILITARY, IN ORDER TO JUSTIFY A TAKEOVER.

YAZDI CONTINUED THAT THERE WAS AN "UNWRITTEN COALITION" BETWEEN THE ARMY AND THE COMMUNISTS. THE ARMY NEEDS JUSTIFICATION FOR A TAKEOVER AND THE COMMUNISTS WANT TO DISCREDIT THE WHOLE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT. THIS, SAID YAZDI, IS OUR ANALYSIS OF THE US VIEW OF THE TUDEH. HE SAID THAT THE US HAS TO GIVE ADVICE TO THE ARMY "TO STOP THIS GAME TOO."

YAZDI THEN ADDRESSED HIMSELF TO KHOMEINI'S RETURN TO IRAN. HE SAID KHOMEINI HAS NO PLAN FOR AN IMMINENT DEPARTURE FOR IRAN -- "AT LEAST HE HAS NOT MENTIONED IT TO ME YET." YAZDI SAID THAT KHOMEINI'S GROUP HAD ITS OWN ANALYSIS OF THE SITUATION, AN ANALYSIS WHICH HAD LED TO KHOMEINI'S ISSUANCE OF HIS STATEMENT REGARDING THE ARMY. THE TROOPS, SAID YAZDI, HAVE BEEN INDOCTRINATED TO BELIEVE THAT, AS SOON AS THE SHAH GOES, THE PEOPLE WILL ATTACK THEM. SOME TROOPS, HE SAID, WOULD OPEN FIRE AS A PROTECTIVE MEASURE. FOR THAT REASON KHOMEINI ISSUED HIS STATEMENT ON THE ARMY.

YAZDI THEN RAISED THREE QUESTIONS, WHICH HE ASKED ZIMMERMANN TO TRANSMIT TO WASHINGTON FOR REPLY. FIRST QUESTION: DOES THE REFERENCE IN THE US MESSAGE TO KHOMEINI'S "SUDDEN RETURN" MEAN THAT THE ARMY MIGHT BE PROVOKED TO A COUP BY KHOMEINI'S RETURN ITSELF OR THAT IT WOULD BE PROVOKED, NOT BY HIS RETURN ALONE, BUT BY "THE EXCITEMENT OF THE PEOPLE" WHICH FOLLOWED IT. ZIMMERMANN ANSWERED ON PERSONAL BASIS THAT GIST OF MESSAGE SEEMED TO BE THAT RETURN IN ITSELF MIGHT PROVOKE MILITARY TO ACTION IF THERE HAD BEEN NO MEETING BETWEEN MILITARY AND KHOMEINI REPRESENTATIVES AND NO BASIC AGREEMENTS WORKED OUT.

ZIMMERMANN SAID THAT THIS WAS WHY THERE WAS SUCH IMPORTANCE AND URGENCY TO SUCH A MEETING AND THE WORKING OUT OF AN AGREEMENT; AN AGREEMENT WOULD HELP TO MAKE KHOMEINI'S RETURN ORDERLY. ZIMMERMANN UNDERTOOK TO SEEK WASHINGTON'S GUIDANCE ON THE CORRECTNESS OF THIS INTERPRETATION.

SECOND QUESTION: WHAT DOES THE PHRASE "TO PROTECT THE CONSTITUTION" MEAN? ZIMMERMANN EXPLAINED THAT THIS MIGHT BE THE PRETEXT ON WHICH THE MILITARY MIGHT CLAIM THE RIGHT TO INTERVENTION IN THE EVENT OF KHOMEINI'S SUDDEN RETURN. YAZDI WENT ON: FOR THE ARMY, DOES "PROTECTING THE CONSTITUTION" MEAN SAVING THE MONARCHY OR MERELY PROTECTING THE INTEGRITY OF THE ARMY? IF THE FORMER, YAZDI SAID, THEN KHOMEINI WOULD HAVE A MAJOR PROBLEM. IF THE LATTER, THEN HE WOULD NOT HAVE A PROBLEM.

PUTTING IT ANOTHER WAY, YAZDI ASKED IF WE THINK THE ARMY IS CONVINCED THERE IS NO HOPE OF SAVING THE MONARCHY AND IS WILLING TO WORK WITHIN THE FRAMEWORK OF A NEW DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC. "WE DON'T WANT TO DESTROY THE ARMY," HE SAID.

THIRD QUESTION: KHOMEINI'S GROUP HAS HEARD THAT AMERICANS IN IRAN ARE DESTROYING OR DISMANTLING SOME OF THE SOPHISTICATED MILITARY EQUIPMENT THERE. KHOMEINI HAS SAID THAT, IF THIS IS SO, THEN ALL THREE BRANCHES OF THE IRANIAN MILITARY SHOULD DO EVERYTHING POSSIBLE TO PROTECT THIS EQUIPMENT AND PREVENT ITS DESTRUCTION. YAZDI ASKED WHAT IS US INFORMATION AND US POLICY ON THIS ISSUE?

AS YAZDI IS NORMALLY AT THE INN WHERE MEETINGS ARE HELD BETWEEN 7:30 AND 9:30 AM LOCAL TIME EACH MORNING, IF THERE IS A RESPONSE TO HIS QUESTIONS, WE WOULD APPRECIATE RECEIVING IT IN TIME TO TAKE IT TO HIM BEFORE HE LEAVES FOR THE MAELSTROM OF THE KHOMEINI COMPOUND. HARTMAN UNQUOTE VANCE
FOLLOWING POINTS WERE GIVEN TO GENERAL TWITCHELL FOR USE IN HIS MEETING WITH GENERAL DJAM ATTEMPT TO DRAW DJAM OUT IN A DISCUSSION OF RECENT EVENTS AND DEVELOPING TRENDS.
SEEK HIS VIEWS AS TO THE POLITICAL INGREDIENTS NECESSARY FOR THE RESTORATION OF STABILITY.

INFORM HIM THAT SENIOR MILITARY OFFICERS ARE ATTEMPTING TO WORK OUT AN ACCOMMODATION WITH KHOMEINI. ASK HIS VIEWS AS TO WHETHER THE PRESENT MILITARY LEADERSHIP WOULD BE ABLE TO MAKE A DEAL WITH KHOMEINI AND WHAT HE BELIEVES THE POSSIBLE TERMS OF SUCH A DEAL MIGHT BE.
ASK HIS VIEWS ON HOW HE SEES THE IRANIAN ARMED FORCES BEING RESTRUCTURED IN A TIME OF BUDGET STRINGENCY AND INCREASED PRIORITY ON CIVILIAN DEVELOPMENT.
WHAT ROLE DOES HE SEE THE U.S. PLAYING IN IRAN AND IN PARTICULAR VIS-A-VIS THE IRANIAN MILITARY IN THE MONTHS AHEAD.
HAS HE BEEN IN TOUCH WITH KHOMEINI? WOULD HE CONSIDER MAKING AN APPROACH TO KHOMEINI ON A PERSONAL BASIS TO URGE RESTRAINT AND CONSTITUTIONAL CHANGE IN IRAN. VANCE
