1979STATE013116.subject: EMBASSY'S ANALYSIS OF FIRST THREE MEETINGS WITH YAZDI SECRET

segments.text: (S - ENTIRE TEXT) BELOW WE SET OUT EMBASSY'S PRELIMINARY AND OBVIOUSLY NON-EXPERT ANALYSIS OF FIRST THREE MEETINGS BETWEEN YAZDI AND ZIMMERMANN (REFTELS).

YAZDI'S CONTACT WITH USG. YAZDI CLEARLY WELCOMES THE OPENING OF A CHANNEL OF COMMUNICATION. HE HAS MADE HIMSELF READILY AVAILABLE AT EACH OF THE THREE TIMES WE HAVE SOUGHT A MEETING WITH HIM, THOUGH HE HAS NOT INITIATED A MEETING HIMSELF. HE SEEMS HARDLY LESS INTERESTED THAN WE IN KEEPING THE CHANNEL SECRET; INDEED, HE HAS INDICATED TO US THAT NOT EVERYBODY IN THE KHOMEINI ENTOURAGE IS RELIABLE AS FAR AS HE IS CONCERNED. HE RESERVES THE 0730-0930 PERIOD EVERY DAY FOR THE APPARENT PURPOSE OF STAYING AT HIS INN (A MILE OR SO FROM THE KHOMEINI COMPOUND) WHERE HE CAN MAKE AND RECEIVE TELEPHONE CALLS PRIVATELY.

HE HAS GIVEN ZIMMERMANN ONLY ONE OTHER NAME OF A CONFIDANT AT THE COMPOUND (A MR. HASSAN), ALTHOUGH ZIMMERMANN WAS ABLE TO GET A MESSAGE THROUGH TO YAZDI AT THE COMPOUND THROUGH AN UNIDENTIFIED ENGLISH-SPEAKER OTHER THAN HASSAN. IN CONTACTS WITH ZIMMERMANN, YAZDI COMES ON VERY FRIENDLY, WITH A QUICK SMILE; HE CALLS ZIMMERMANN BY HIS FIRST NAME, WHICH MAY BE AS MUCH SECURITY CONSCIOUSNESS AS A DESIRE TO SHOW GOOD WILL.

YAZDI'S CLOUT. YAZDI UNDOUBTEDLY HAS SOME KIND OF PERSONAL RELATIONSHIP WITH KHOMEINI. AT YAZDI'S JANUARY 16 PRESS CONFERENCE HE SPOKE IN KHOMEINI'S NAME; IN THIS WAY, AT THAT TRIUMPHAL MOMENT (FOLLOWING THE SHAH'S DEPARTURE) KHOMEINI GAVE YAZDI A PUBLIC STATUS WHICH NO OTHER MEMBER OF KHOMEINI'S ENTOURAGE HERE IN FRANCE ENJOYS. YAZDI HAS ALSO SPOKEN IN KHOMEINI'S NAME TO ZIMMERMANN, THOUGH ONLY TO OUTLINE BACKGROUND OF KHOMEINI'S STATEMENTS AND TO DESCRIBE KHOMEINI'S ANALYSIS OF ISSUES (E.G., ARMY-COMMUNIST "COALITION"). HE HAS NOT ONCE TOLD ZIMMERMANN HE WAS SPEAKING PERSONALLY, BUT HAS ALWAYS CONVEYED THE CLEAR IMPRESSION THAT EVERYTHING HE SAYS IS ON BEHALF OF KHOMEINI.

HE APPEARS TO HAVE READY ACCESS TO KHOMEINI; ONCE, WHEN ZIMMERMANN CALLED, HE WAS TOLD THAT YAZDI WAS IN WITH KHOMEINI. ON THE OTHER HAND, SIGNIFICANTLY, YAZDI HAS NOT GIVEN US ANY RESPONSE TO OUR DEMARCHE -OADE ON TWO SEPARATE OCCASIONS -- URGING KHOMEINI'S USE OF HIS INFLUENCE TO FACILITATE MEETING BETWEEN ARMY AND KHOMEINI REPRESENTATIVES IN TEHRAN.

THERE IS NO EVIDENCE THAT YAZDI HAS ANY INFLUENCE OVER KHOMEINI; INDEED, THE ONE STATEMENT YAZDI HAS MADE TOUCHING THIS POINT -- THAT KHOMEINI HAD NOT REPEAT NOT SHARED WITH YAZDI HIS PRECISE PLANS FOR A RETURN TO IRAN -- WOULD SEEM TO INDICATE THAT ON THE MAJOR ISSUES KHOMEINI KEEPS HIS OWN COUNSEL.

ATTITUDE TOWARD THE US. YAZDI HAS NOT SAID ANYTHING DIRECTLY PRO OR CON ON THE US OR ON HIS RESIDENCE THERE. MUCH OF WHAT HE HAS SAID, HOWEVER, REFLECTS A DEEP-SEATED SUSPICION OF US ANALYSES, MOTIVATIONS, AND INTENTIONS VIS-A-VIS IRAN.

FOR EXAMPLE, HE CONTRADICTED OUR ANALYSIS THAT THE COMMUNISTS ARE PLAYING A MAJOR DESTABILIZING ROLE; WHILE SAYING THAT THE COMMUNISTS SHARE WITH THE MILITARY AN INTEREST IN DESTABILIZATION, HE DISMISSED COMMUNIST IMPORTANCE WITH THE REMARK THAT "THE USG KNOWS BETTER THAN WE THAT THE TUDEH IS NOT STRONG." HIS CONVOLUTED STATEMENT (REF A) THAT THE IRANIAN PEOPLE COULD NOT ACCEPT THAT A MILITARY COUP COULD TAKE PLACE WITHOUT US APPROVAL SEEMED MEANT TO CONVEY A BELIEF ON YAZDI'S (AND KHOMEINI'S) PART THAT THE US WAS INCLINED TO PROVOKE A COUP.

ATTITUDE TOWARD THE IRANIAN MILITARY. YAZDI'S REMARKS SHOW A STRONG SUSPICION REGARDING THE ORIENTATION AND INTENTIONS OF THE MILITARY. HIS REPEATED QUESTIONS REGARDING THE MILITARY'S ORIENTATION -- TWO OF THE THREE QUESTIONS HE ASKED ZIMMERMANN TO REFER TO WASHINGTON GET AT THIS POINT -MAY INDICATE THAT THE MILITARY'S ORIENTATION MIGHT BE A SIGNIFICANT GAP IN KHOMEINI'S INTELLIGENCE.
(S) ENTIRE TEXT
YOU SHOULD MEET YAZDI ASAP TO ANSWER THE QUESTIONS POSED TO YOU AS WELL AS TO MAKE SOME GENERAL COMMENTS IN RESPONSE TO HIS OPENING REMARKS IN YOUR TALK OF JANUARY 10.

TO BEGIN WITH, YOU SHOULD STATE THAT OUR FUNDAMENTAL CONCERN IS TO END THE BLOODSHED IN IRAN, BOTH FOR HUMANITARIAN REASONS AND TO CREATE AN ENVIRONMENT FOR PEACEFUL DELIBERATION AMONG IRANIANS ON IRAN'S FUTURE. APART FROM THE OVERRIDING HUMANITARIAN CONCERN, A VIOLENT CONFRONTATION BETWEEN THE MILITARY AND OTHER FORCES IN IRAN WILL MAKE IT EXCEEDINGLY DIFFICULT, IF NOT IMPOSSIBLE, IN THE MONTHS AHEAD TO BUILD A STABLE FOUNDATION FOR IRAN'S FUTURE.

ACCORDINGLY, WE ARE URGING RESTRAINT AND CONCILIATION ON ALL POLITICAL FORCES IN IRAN-INCLUDING THE MILITARY. 4 AMONG THOSE PEOPLE WHO CLAIM TO FOLLOW KHOMEINI'S BANNER THERE ARE THOSE--NOTABLY THE TUDEH PARTY--WHO WOULD USE RELIGION AS A RALLYING CRY ONLY AS LONG AS IT SUITS THEIR PURPOSES. WHEN OTHER TACTICS, I.E., THE TUDEH'S CALL FOR VIOLENCE, SEEM OPPORTUNE THEY WILL SHIFT GROUND. ALTHOUGH THE TUDEH AND OTHER EXTREMISTS ARE RELATIVELY SMALL, THEY ARE EXTREMELY DANGEROUS. ONLY THE CONTINUING EFFORTS OF MODERATE POLITICAL ELEMENTS CAN REIN THEM IN OR NEUTRALIZE THEIR EFFORTS.

IN RESPONSE TO YAZDI'S ASSERTION, WE WANT HIM TO KNOW THAT OUR OBSERVATIONS AND ANALYSIS PROVIDE NO RPT NO EVIDENCE THAT THERE IS AN "UNWRITTEN COALITION" BETWEEN THE ARMY AND THE COMMUNISTS. QUITE THE CONTRARY, THE ARMY FEARS NOTHING AS MUCH AS THE COMMUNISTS. SOME OF THOSE IN THE ARMY WHO OPPOSE KHOMEINI DO SO, WE BELIEVE, BECAUSE THEY FEAR HE IS INFLUENCED BY THE TUDEH OR OTHER EXTREMISTS. THUS, IT IS URGENT TO REASSURE THE RESPONSIBLE LEADERSHIP OF THE ARMY THAT THE AYATOLLAH OPPOSES THE TUDEH AND THE INTRODUCTION OF COMMUNISM IN IRAN. THE U.S.

CAN FACILITATE THE NECESSARY DIALOGUE BETWEEN KHOMEINI AND THE MILITARY AS WE HAVE BEEN TRYING TO DO, BUT WE CANNOT CREATE THE SENSE OF TRUST THAT MUST BE THE BASE FOR AN ORDERLY DEBATE ON IRAN'S FUTURE.

YOU SHOULD EMPHASIZE TO YAZDI OUR VIEW OF HOW IMPORTANT IT IS BOTH FOR THEM AND FOR IRAN THAT THE KHOMEINI GROUP MOVE QUICKLY TO OPEN A DIALOGUE WITH THE MILITARY. OUR INTELLIGENCE INDICATES THAT SUPPORT FOR EXTREMIST COMMUNIST ELEMENTS IN THE UNIVERSITIES AND AMONG THE WORKERS IS GROWING DAILY. TRENDS ARE DEVELOPING THAT COULD COMPLICATE EFFORTS TO ACHIEVE A PEACEFUL POLITICAL SOLUTION. FURTHER DETERIORATION COULD BE DESTRUCTIVE TO THE KIND OF STABLE, DEMOCRATIC AND JUST IRANIAN SOCIETY THAT ALL OF US WANT.
YOU SHOULD THEN PROVIDE YAZDI WITH OUR ANSWERS TO HIS THREE QUESTIONS
DOES THE ARMY FEAR KHOMEINI'S RETURN IN ITSELF OR RATHER THE EXCITEMENT THAT MIGHT BE PROVOKED BY A "SUDDEN RETURN"?

IN OUR VIEW, THE ARMY IS BASICALLY A CONSERVATIVE FORCE. THEY WANT ABOVE ALL TO SEE ORDER PRESERVED; THE DISORDER AND DRIFT OF THE PAST YEAR HAS BEEN ABHORRENT TO MOST OFFICERS. THESE OFFICERS FEAR THE UNKNOWN. THEY FEAR AN UNCHARTED FUTURE WHICH COULD LEAD TO A TUDEH TAKEOVER. THIS UNDERSCORES THE NEED FOR AN ADEQUATE DIALOGUE WITH THE MILITARY IN WHICH THE RESPECTIVE GROUPS CAN DISCUSS THE DEVELOPING SITUATION.
WHAT DOES THE PHRASE "TO PROTECT THE CONSTITUTION" MEAN?
THIS QUESTION, LIKE OTHERS YAZDI HAS ADDRESSED TO US, SHOULD REALLY BE ANSWERED BY THE MILITARY DIRECTLY. BOTH SIDES SHOULD SIT DOWN AND DIRECTLY AND FRANKLY ADDRESS THE OTHER'S FEARS AND CONCERNS.

IN OUR VIEW, PROTECTION OF THE CONSTITUTION UNDERSCORES THE IMPORTANCE OF ORDERLY, ESTABLISHED PROCEDURES FOR DETERMINING IRAN'S FUTURE. EVERYONE--MILITARY, OPPOSITION AND THE PUBLIC AT LARGE -- SHOULD KNOW IN ADVANCE THE RULES THAT WILL GOVERN LIFE IN IRAN. THE CONSTITUTION SETS FORTH THOSE RULES. WE DO NOT BELIEVE EITHER THE MILITARY OR THE OPPOSITION SHOULD SEEK TO OVERTURN CONSTITUTIONAL PROCEDURES. TO THAT END, WE HAVE STRONGLY COUNSELED THE MILITARY AGAINST TAKING MATTERS INTO THEIR OWN HANDS. WE TAKE THE SAME POSITION IN OUR DISCUSSIONS WITH THE OPPOSITION. IF THE CONSTITUTIONAL FRAMEWORK IS DESTROYED, THE WAY IS OPENED TO THE TUDEH.

WE DO NOT SAY THAT THE CONSTITUTION CANNOT BE CHANGED, BUT WE DO BELIEVE THAT THE ESTABLISHED, ORDERLY PROCEDURES FOR MAKING CHANGES SHOULD BE FOLLOWED. IF THE INTEGRITY OF THE ARMY CAN BE PRESERVED, WE BELIEVE THERE IS EVERY PROSPECT THE LEADERSHIP WILL SUPPORT WHATEVER POLITICAL FORM IS SELECTED FOR IRAN IN THE FUTURE.
ARE AMERICANS DESTROYING OR DISMANTLING SOPHISTICATED MILITARY EQUIPMENT WE HAVE SOLD TO IRAN?
ABSOLUTELY NOT. WE WANT TO PRESERVE THE STRENGTH AND INTEGRITY OF IRAN'S MILITARY. WE WANT THE ARMED FORCES TO HAVE THE EQUIPMENT THAT THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT BELIEVES IS NECESSARY FOR IRAN'S DEFENSE.
IN SUMMARY, YOU SHOULD EMPHASIZE FOR YAZDI DIRECT LINKAGE BETWEEN POINTS YOU HAVE MADE TO HIM AND STATEMENT OF U.S. POLICY CONTAINED IN SAUNDERS' JANUARY 17 TESTIMONY
IRANIANS THEMSELVES MUST DECIDE IRAN'S FUTURE. THUS, WE THINK IT IMPERATIVE THAT KHOMEINI GROUP AND THE MILITARY GET TOGETHER IN THE INTEREST OF PRESERVING IRAN FROM ANARCHY.
THE U.S. SUPPORTS THE CONSTITUTIONAL PROCESSES. IF CHANGES ARE TO COME, THEY MUST BE MADE IN AN ORDERLY MANNER THAT ALL IRANIANS WILL UNDERSTAND AND SUPPORT.

WE SUPPORT IRAN'S INDEPENDENCE. WE BELIEVE BOTH WE AND THE KHOMEINI GROUP HAVE A STRONG INTEREST IN BLOCKING THE MOVES OF THE TUDEH PARTY, A GROUP THAT WILL WISH TO BRING IRAN UNDER SOVIET DOMINATION.
YOU SHOULD ALSO ASK FOR A STATEMENT OF THEIR INTENTIONS REGARDING U.S. INVESTMENTS SALE OF OIL TO THE WEST POLITICAL/MILITARY RELATIONSHIP WITH THE U.S.
RELATIONS WITH THE USSR.

1979STATE013304.subject: PRESIDENT'S PRESS CONFERENCE, JANUARY 17, 1979, 4:00 P.M. EST

segments.text: 4:00 P.M. EST

FOLLOWING ARE FOREIGN AFFAIRS PORTIONS OF THE PRESIDENT'S PRESS CONFERENCE, JANUARY 17, 1979. BEGIN TEXT: - Q: MR. PRESIDENT, WHAT WILL THE POSTURE OF OUR GOVERNMENT BE NOW TOWARD THE VARIOUS CONTENDING FACTIONS IN IRAN THAT EVEN CONTINUE TO VIE FOR POWER OVER THERE? - P: WE HAVE VERY IMPORTANT RELATIONSHIPS WITH IRAN-PAST, PRESENT, AND I HOPE IN THE FUTURE. AND I EXPECT IN THE FUTURE. THEY HAVE BEEN GOOD ALLIES OF OURS AND I EXPECT THIS TO CONTINUE IN THE FUTURE. IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE PROVISIONS OF THE IRANIAN CONSTITUTION, A CHANGE IN GOVERNMENT HAS NOW BEEN ACCOMPLISHED. UNDER MR.

BAHKTIAR, WHOSE GOVERNMENT WE DO SUPPORT, THE MAJLIS, THE LOWER HOUSE OF PARLIAMENT, AND THE UPPER HOUSE, THE SENATE, HAVE APPROVED HIS GOVERNMENT AND HIS CABINET. WE HAVE ENCOURAGED TO THE LIMITED EXTENT OF OUR OWN ABILITY THE PUBLIC SUPPORT FOR THE BAHKTIAR GOVERNMENT, FOR THE RESTORATION OF STABILITY, FOR AN END OF BLOODSHED AND FOR THE RETURN OF NORMAL LIFE IN IRAN. AS YOU KNOW, THE SHAH HAS LEFT IRAN; HE SAYS FOR A VACATION. HOW LONG HE WILL BE OUT OF IRAN, WE HAVE NO WAY TO DETERMINE. FUTURE EVENTS AND HIS OWN DESIRES WILL DETERMINE THAT.

HE IS NOW IN EGYPT, AND HE WILL LATER COME TO OUR OWN COUNTRY. BUT WE WOULD ANTICIPATE AND WOULD CERTAINLY HOPE THAT OUR GOOD RELATIONSHIPS WITH IRAN WILL CONTINUE IN THE FUTURE. - Q: A MONTH AGO, AT A NEWS CONFERENCE, YOU SAID THE SHAH WOULD MAINTAIN POWER. HOW COULD YOU BE SO WRONG AND IS IT TYPICAL OF OUR INTELLIGENCE ELSEWHERE IN THE WORLD? AND ARE YOU IN TOUCH WITH KHOMEINI IN CASE HE WINDS UP AT THE TOP OF THE HEAP? - P: WELL, IT IS IMPOSSIBLE FOR ANYONE TO ANTICIPATE ALL FUTURE POLITICAL EVENTS.

I THINK THE RAPID CHANGE OF AFFAIRS IN IRAN HAS NOT BEEN PREDICTED BY ANYONE SO FAR AS I KNOW. OUR INTELLIGENCE IS THE BEST WE CAN DEVISE. WE SHARE INTELLIGENCE DATA AND DIPLOMATIC INFORMATION ON A ROUTINE BASIS WITH OTHER NATIONS. AND THIS IS A CONSTANT PROCESS WHENEVER A PROBLEM ARISES IN A COUNTRY THROUGHOUT THE WORLD. I HAVE CONFIDENCE IN THE IRANIAN PEOPLE TO RESTORE A STABLE GOVERNMENT AND TO RESTORE THEIR ECONOMIC CIRCUMSTANCES FOR THE FUTURE. NO, WE HAVE NOT COMMUNICATED DIRECTLY WITH MR. KHOMEINI. OUR VIEWS HAVE BEEN EXPRESSED PUBLICLY THAT HE SUPPORT STABILITY AND AN END TO BLOODSHED IN IRAN.

AND NO MATTER WHAT HIS DEEP RELIGIOUS CONVICTIONS MIGHT BE -- AND I DON'T DOUBT THEIR SINCERITY -- THAT HE PERMIT THE GOVERNMENT THAT HAS NOW BEEN ESTABLISHED BY THE LEGAL AUTHORITIES IN IRAN AND UNDER THE CONSTITUTION TO HAVE A CHANCE TO SUCCEED. WE DO KNOW THAT THE IRANIAN MILITARY AND MANY OF THE RELIGIOUS AND POLITICAL OPPONENTS TO THE SHAH HAVE GIVEN THEIR PLEDGE OF SUPPORT TO THE BAHKTIAR GOVERNMENT. AND THAT IS OUR HOPE. AND I WOULD LIKE TO ADD ONE OTHER THING.

WE HAVE NO INTENTION, NEITHER ABILITY NOR DESIRE, TO INTERFERE IN THE INTERNAL AFFAIRS OF IRAN, AND WE CERTAINLY HAVE NO INTENTION OF PERMITTING OTHER NATIONS TO INTERFERE IN THE INTERNAL AFFAIRS OF IRAN. - Q: IF WE HAD HAD BETTER INTELLIGENCE IN IRAN, IS THEIR ANYTHING WE COULD HAVE DONE TO SAVE THE SHAH? AND THERE IS A SECOND PART TO THAT QUESTION. YOU JUST REFERRED TO IRAN AS ALLIES.

WOULD YOU AUTHORIZE NEW WEAPONS SHIPMENTS TO THE BAHKTIAR REGIME. - P: EVEN IF WE HAD BEEN ABLE TO ANTICIPATE EVENTS THAT WERE GOING TO TAKE PLACE IN IRAN OR OTHER COUNTRIES, OBVIOUSLY OUR ABILITY TO DETERMINE THOSE EVENTS IS VERY LIMITED. THE SHAH'S ADVISERS, GREAT MILITARY CAPABILITIES, POLICE AND OTHERS, COULDN'T COMPLETELY PREVENT RIOTING AND DISTURBANCES IN IRAN. CERTAINLY WE HAVE NO DESIRE NOR ABILITY TO INTRUDE MASSIVE FORCES INTO IRAN OR ANY OTHER COUNTRY TO DETERMINE THE OUTCOME OF DOMESTIC POLITICAL ISSUES. THIS IS SOMETHING THAT WE HAVE NO INTENTION OF EVER DOING IN ANOTHER COUNTRY. WE HAVE TRIED THIS ONCE IN VIETNAM.

IT DIDN'T WORK WELL, AS YOU KNOW. WE HAVE SOME EXISTING CONTRACTS FOR DELIVERY OF WEAPONS TO IRAN SINCE SOMETIMES THE DELIVERIES TAKE AS LONG AS FIVE YEARS AFTER THE ORDERS ARE PLACED. OUR FOREIGN MILITARY SALES POLICY IS NOW BEING CONTINUED. WE HAVE NO WAY TO KNOW WHAT THE ATTITUDE OF THE BAHKTIAR GOVERNMENT IS. WE HAVE NOT DISCUSSED THIS WITH THEM. AFTER THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT IS STABLE, AFTER IT ASSUAGES THE PRESENT DISTURBANCES IN IRAN, THEN I AM SURE THEY WILL LET US KNOW HOW THEY WANT TO CARRY OUT FUTURE MILITARY NEEDS OF THEIR OWN COUNTRY.

IT IS IMPORTANT TO IRAN, FOR THEIR OWN SECURITY AND FOR THE INDEPENDENCE OF THE PEOPLE OF IRAN, THAT A STRONG AND STABLE MILITARY BE MAINTAINED, AND I BELIEVE THAT ALL THE LEADERS OF IRAN, WHOM I HAVE HEARD DISCUSS THIS MATTER, AGREE WITH THE STATEMENT THAT I HAVE JUST MADE. - Q: MR. PRESIDENT. STILL ON IRAN, PRESIDENT CARTER, THERE IS A SUGGESTION THAT IF IRANIAN OIL SUPPLIES DO NOT BEGIN FLOWING AGAIN, PERHAPS WITHIN TWO MONTHS, THERE MAY BE A SHORTAGE AND PERHAPS A PRICE INCREASE FOR US.

DOES OUR INTELLIGENCE INDICATE THAT MIGHT HAPPEN, OR IS THERE SUCH A PROSPECT AS YOU SEE IT? - P: WE DERIVED ABOUT FIVE PERCENT OF OUR OIL SUPPLIES FROM IRAN IN RECENT MONTHS -- MUCH LESS THAN MANY OTHER COUNTRIES, AS YOU KNOW, WHO ARE MORE HEAVILY DEPENDENT ON IRANIAN OIL. I THINK AN EXTENDED INTERRUPTION OF IRANIAN OIL SHIPMENTS WOULD CERTAINLY CREATE INCREASED SEVERE SHORTAGES ON THE INTERNATIONAL MARKET. SO FAR, OTHER OIL-PRODUCING NATIONS HAVE MOVED TO REPLACE THE LOST IRANIAN OIL SUPPLIES. IF THIS SHOULD CONTINUE, IT WOULD JUST RE-EMPHASIZE THE BASIC COMMITMENT THAT OUR NATION HAS TRIED TO CARRY OUT IN THE LAST TWO YEARS.

THAT IS, TO HAVE A PREDICTABLE ENERGY POLICY TO REDUCE CONSUMPTION OF ENERGY IN TOTO, CERTAINLY TO REDUCE DEPENDENCE ON FOREIGN OIL AND TO ELIMINATE WASTE OF OIL. I DON'T THINK THERE IS ANY DOUBT THAT WE CAN CUT BACK CONSUMPTION OF OIL BY FIVE PERCENT WITHOUT SERIOUSLY DAMAGING OUR OWN ECONOMY. AND I WOULD HOPE THAT ALL AMERICANS WHO LISTEN TO MY VOICE NOW WOULD DO EVERYTHING POSSIBLE WITHIN THEIR OWN CAPABILITIES TO CUT DOWN ON THE USE OF OIL AND THE WASTE OF ALL ENERGY SUPPLIES.

I THINK THAT THIS RESTORATION OF IRANIAN OIL SHIPMENTS IS A DESIRE BY ALL THE RELIGIOUS AND POLITICAL LEADERS IN IRAN WHO HAVE AN INFLUENCE OVER THE FUTURE. WE HAVE SEEN, SINCE THE OPEC PRICE INCREASES, EVEN BEFORE THE IRANIAN SUPPLIES WERE INTERRUPTED, SOME SHORTAGE, OF SPOT SHIPMENTS OF OIL THE PRESENT PRICE OF OIL EVEN WITH INCREASED PRODUCTION FROM OTHER SUPPLIERS IS NOW SLIGHTLY ABOVE THE ESTABLISHED OPEC PRICE. BUT OUR HOPE IS THAT OIL PRICES WILL GO DOWN AT LEAST TO SOME DEGREE AS IRANIAN SUPPLIES ARE REINTRODUCED. - Q: MR.

PRESIDENT, ON YOUR NEGOTIATIONS WITH CHINA OVER NORMALIZATION OF DIPLOMATIC RELATIONS, DID YOU AT ANY POINT ASK THE CHINESE TO PROVIDE A BINDING WRITTEN PLEDGE THAT THEY WOULD NOT TRY TO SEIZE TAIWAN BY FORCE? AND IF YOU DID REQUEST THAT, WHY DIDN'T YOU GET IT? AND IF YOU DIDN'T, WHY DIDN'T YOU ASK FOR IT? (LAUGHTER) - P: YES. ONE OF OUR GOALS IN THE NEGOTIATION WAS TO GET A PUBLIC COMMITMENT ON THE PART OF CHINA THAT THE DIFFERENCES WITH TAIWAN WOULD BE RESOLVED PEACEFULLY. THIS WAS NOT POSSIBLE TO ACHIEVE.

THE FINAL OUTCOME OF THAT WAS THAT WE WOULD MAKE A UNILATERAL STATEMENT THAT WE EXPECT ANY DIFFERENCES BETWEEN TAIWAN AND CHINA TO BE RESOLVED PEACEFULLY, AND THE AGREEMENT WAS THAT THE LEADERS IN CHINA WOULD NOT CONTRADICT THAT STATEMENT. SINCE THE ANNOUNCEMENT OF NORMALIZATION, VICE PREMIER DENG XIAOPING AND OTHERS HAVE MADE PUBLIC COMMENTS THAT SUBSTANTIATE THE STATEMENT THAT I HAVE MADE. IT IS A MATTER INTERNALLY FOR THE CHINESE TO RESOLVE, BUT I THINK MR. DENG HAS MADE SEVERAL STATEMENTS SAYING THAT IT OUGHT TO BE RESOLVED PEACEFULLY.

WE WERE ALSO INSISTENT UPON THE FACT THAT THE TREATY BETWEEN US AND TAIWAN WOULD NOT BE PEREMPTORILY OR IMMEDIATELY CANCELED OR ABROGATED. THE TREATY WILL BE TERMINATED IN ACCORDANCE WITH ITS OWN PROVISIONS WITH A ONE-YEAR'S NOTICE TO TAIWAN. THE CHINESE DID NOT AGREE WITH THIS ORIGINALLY BUT THEY FINALLY ACCEPTED THAT FACT. ANOTHER INSISTENCE THAT WE HAD, WHICH WAS FINALLY AGREED TO, WAS THAT WE WOULD GO AHEAD WITH NORMAL TRADE, CULTURAL RELATIONSHIPS WITH TAIWAN AND ALSO THAT EXISTING TREATIES OTHER THAN THE DEFENSE TREATY WOULD CONTINUE IN EFFECT.

ONE POINT ON WHICH WE DID NOT AGREE WITH THE CHINESE WAS THAT WE WILL, AFTER THIS YEAR, CONTINUE TO SELL DEFENSIVE WEAPONS TO TAIWAN, TO PROVIDE FOR THEIR SECURITY NEEDS. THE CHINESE LEADERS DO NOT AGREE WITH THIS POLICY, BUT THEY UNDERSTAND THAT IT IS OUR POLICY AND, KNOWING THAT, THEY WENT AHEAD WITH NORMALIZATION. SO THERE WERE SOME DIFFERENCES BETWEEN US, BUT I THINK THIS IS ONE OF THE MAJOR ACHIEVEMENTS FOR PEACE IN THE WORLD, AND PARTICULARLY TO CEMENT OUR RELATIONSHIP WITH THE NATIONS IN THE WESTERN PACIFIC. AND I THINK WE HAD A VERY GOOD OUTCOME FOR THE LONG NEGOTIATIONS. - Q: MR.

PRESIDENT, NEXT MONTH YOU ARE GOING TO MEET, SUPPOSEDLY, WITH THE PRIME MINISTER OF THAILAND, WHO IS THE HEAD OF A NATION THAT IS NOW THREATENED BY THE VIETNAMESE, AND I NEED TO KNOW TWO THINGS, IF YOU COULD. ONE, WHAT IS THE U.S. PREPARED TO OFFER THAILAND TO EASE THEIR CONCERNS ABOUT THE VIETNAMESE? WILL IT BE MONEY, ECONOMIC AID, MILITARY WEAPONS, OR AMERICAN-PILOTED AIRCRAFT?

NUMBER TWO, HAVE YOU PERSONALLY BEEN IN TOUCH WITH THE LEADERS OF CHINA AND THE SOVIET UNION TO SEE WHAT THEY PLAN TO DO TO HELP EASE THE SITUATION? - P: WE ARE VERY INTERESTED IN SEEING THE INTEGRITY OF THAILAND PROTECTED, THE BORDERS NOT ENDANGERED OR EVEN THREATENED BY THE INSURGENT TROOPS FROM VIETNAM IN CAMBODIA. WE HAVE JOINED IN WITH ALMOST ALL OTHER NATIONS OF THE WORLD AND THE UNITED NATIONS IN CONDEMNING THE INTRUSION INTO CAMBODIA BY VIETNAMESE FORCES. THIS OBVIOUSLY INVOLVES THE ADJACENT COUNTRY OF THAILAND. MR.

KRIANGSAK WILL BE COMING HERE TO VISIT WITH ME, AND DURING THAT TIME, WE WILL REASSURE HIM THAT OUR INTERESTS ARE IN A STABLE AND SECURE AND PEACEFUL THAILAND. WE HAVE CONTINUING TRADE RELATIONSHIPS WITH THAILAND. WE PROVIDE THEM WITH SOME MILITARY ARMS FOR DEFENSIVE PURPOSES, AS HAVE BEEN NEGOTIATED FOR A LONG PERIOD OF TIME. WE DON'T DETECT ANY IMMEDIATE THREAT TO THE BORDERS OF THAILAND. IN SOME INSTANCES, THE INVADING FORCES INTO CAMBODIA HAVE DELIBERATELY STAYED AWAY FROM THE BORDER ITSELF AND OF COURSE THE CHINESE GIVE THAILAND VERY STRONG SUPPORT. THE SOVIET UNION HAS EXPRESSED THEIR SUPPORT FOR VIETNAM, AS YOU KNOW.

AND IN OUR EFFORTS, ALONG WITH OTHERS IN THE UNITED NATIONS, WE HAVE WARNED BOTH THE VIETNAMESE AND ALSO THE SOVIETS WHO SUPPLY THEM AND SUPPORT THEM AGAINST ANY DANGER THEY MIGHT EXHIBIT TOWARD THAILAND. - Q: YOU HAVE INVITED FORMER PRESIDENT RICHARD NIXON TO THE WHITE HOUSE FOR THE DINNER FOR CHINESE LEADER DENG XIAOPING. DURING YOUR CAMPAIGN, YOU SAID MR. NIXON HAD DISGRACED THIS COUNTRY, AND ABOUT A YEAR AGO, YOU SAID YOU THOUGHT HE HAD INDEED COMMITTED IMPREACHABLE OFFENSES.

WHY ARE YOU HONORING HIM IN THIS WAY NOW? - P: AS YOU KNOW, THE CONSEQUENCES OF THE WATERGATE ACTIONS BY PRESIDENT NIXON HAVE ALREADY BEEN DETERMINED BY THE CONGRESS AND BY THE ACTIONS OF MR. NIXON HIMSELF, HAVING BEEN PARDONED BY PRESIDENT FORD. IN PREPARING FOR THE UPCOMING VISIT BY VICE PREMIER DENG XIAOPING, I FELT THAT IT WAS A FAIR THING AND A PROPER THING TO INVITE BOTH PRESIDENT NIXON AND PRESIDENT FORD TO THE WHITE HOUSE FOR THE BANQUET AT WHICH MR. DENG WILL BE HONORED.

AS YOU KNOW, AS PRESIDENT, ONE OF THE MAJOR ACHIEVEMENTS OF PRESIDENT NIXON WAS TO OPEN UP AN AVENUE OF COMMUNICATIONS AND CONSULTATION AND NEGOTIATION WITH THE CHINESE WHICH RESULTED ULTIMATELY IN NORMAL RELATIONSHIPS. I THINK IT IS ENTIRELY PROPER THAT HE BE THERE. IN ADDITION TO THAT, THE CHINESE OFFICIALS, INCLUDING VICE PREMIER DENG HIMSELF, HAD ASKED FOR AN OPPORTUNITY TO MEET WITH PRESIDENT NIXON AND TO EXPRESS THEIR THANKS PERSONALLY TO HIM FOR THE ROLE HE PLAYED IN OPENING UP CHINESE-UNITED STATES RELATIONSHIPS. SO I HAVE NO APOLOGY TO MAKE.

I THINK IT WAS A PROPER THING TO DO AND I AM VERY PLEASED PRESIDENT NIXON HAS ACCEPTED OUR INVITATION. - Q: MR. PRESIDENT, DO YOU SEE ANY DANGER OF OUR LOSING OUR INTELLIGENCE LISTENING POSTS IN IRAN? AND IF WE DO LOSE THOSE POSTS, DO WE HAVE ENOUGH BACK-UP CAPABILITY SO YOU CAN ASSURE CONGRESS WE CAN VERIFY A NEW SALT AGREEMENT IF YOU GET ONE? - P: THERE IS OBVIOUSLY, IN ANY COUNTRY WHERE WE HAVE INTELLIGENCE SOURCES, A DANGER FOR THOSE SOURCES TO BE MODIFIED OR LOST.

WE HAD THIS OCCUR, AS YOU KNOW, A FEW YEARS AGO IN TURKEY WHEN WE HAD AN EMBARGO AGAINST THE SALE OF MILITARY WEAPONS TO TURKEY. AND THIS HAS HAPPENED FROM TIME TO TIME IN AN EVOLUTIONARY WAY. WE HAVE CONSTANTLY BEEN ABLE AND DETERMINED TO PROVIDE INCREASING CAPABILITY FOR SURVEILLANCE WHICH WOULD ALLOW US TO COMPENSATE FOR THOSE CHANGES THAT ARE INEVITABLE IN ANY CHANGING SOCIETY.

SO I CAN ASSURE THE PUBLIC AND THE CONGRESS THAT NO MATTER WHAT HAPPENS TO THE SPECIFIC INTELLIGENCE SOURCES IN IRAN, WE CAN ADEQUATELY COMPENSATE FOR THEIR CHANGE AND PROVIDE ADEQUATE VERIFICATION FOR THE COMPLIANCE BY THE SOVIET UNION WITH SALT AGREEMENTS. - Q: THERE SEEM TO BE A LOT OF PEOPLE WHO THINK THAT THE SOVIETS NOW ARE GAINING A MILITARY EDGE OVER US. - P: YES - Q: NOW, ISN'T THIS PERCEPTION BASIC TO THE PROBLEM OF GETTING A SALT TREATY RATIFIED? - P: I DON'T THINK THE PERCEPTION IS ACCURATE.

I THINK THAT MILITARILY, WE ARE CERTAINLY EQUAL TO OR SUPERIOR TO THE SOVIET UNION IN OUR OWN CAPABILITY. CERTAINLY IN ADDITION TO THAT, WE HAVE HARMONY WITH OUR NEIGHBORS, WHICH THE SOVIET UNION LACKS. AND OUR ALLIES ARE FREE AND INDEPENDENT AND TIED TO US PHILISOPHICALLY, WITH A DEEP COMMITMENT, AS IS THE CASE WITH NATO AND OTHER ALLIANCES. THE SOVIETS CAN'T MATCH THAT DEPENDABILITY AND INDEPENDENCE AMONG THEIR ALLIES. ECONOMICALLY, POLITICALLY, I THINK OUR SYSTEMS ARE SUPERIOR TO THE SOVIET UNION.

THERE IS NO DOUBT, HOWEVER, THAT THE APPROVAL OF THE SALT TREATY BY THE AMERICAN PEOPLE AND BY THE CONGRESS WILL CERTAINLY BE INFLUENCED BY PERCEPTIONS THAT WE ARE INDEED NOW AND WE WILL INDEED IN THE FUTURE BE SECURE AND THAT OUR MILITARY STRENGTH AND CAPABILITY IN ITS TOTALITY WILL BE ADEQUATE TO MEET ANY SOVIET THREAT, AND THERE IS NO DOUBT THAT WE WILL BE ABLE TO MEET ANY SUCH THREAT NOW AND IN THE FUTURE. - Q: MR.

PRESIDENT, FOLLOWING UP AGAIN ON CHINA, SHORTLY AFTER YOUR ANNOUNCEMENT LAST MONTH, YOU SAID IN A TELEVISION INTERVIEW THAT PRESIDENT BREZHNEV'S RESPONSE IN A PRIVATE MESSAGE TO YOU HAD BEEN POSITIVE. - P: YES. - Q: TASS THEN TOOK ISSUE WITH YOU AND THIS WEEK IN AN INTERVIEW PUBLISHED IN TIME, MR. BREZHNEV SAID IT WAS LIKE PLAYING WITH FIRE TO ENCOURAGE CHINA'S MILITANCY.

IN VIEW OF THESE STATEMENTS, DO YOU STILL FEEL THE KREMLIN IS POSITIVE ABOUT YOUR CHINA POLICY? - P: I HAVE REREAD THE ORIGINAL DISPATCH I GOT FROM PRESIDENT BREZHNEV AND I HAVE ALSO READ THE TASS STATEMENTS AND HAPPENED TO HAVE READ LAST NIGHT THE INTERVIEW WITH PRESIDENT BREZHNEV IN TIME. I THINK MY INTERPRETATION OF BREZHNEV'S ORIGINAL STATEMENT WAS ACCURATE. HE DID POINT OUT THE FACT THAT THEY HAD RELATIONSHIPS WITH CHINA THAT COULD BE CONTRIBUTORY TO PEACE.

HE EXPRESSED IN HIS ORIGINAL STATEMENT A DESIRE OR AN INTENTION TO MONITOR FUTURE RELATIONSHIPS BETWEEN OURSELVES AND CHINA, AND EXPRESSED SOME CONCERN ABOUT A POSSIBILITY OF OUR USING THIS NEW RELATIONSHIP AGAINST THE SOVIET UNION. THIS IS NOT OUR INTENTION; WE NEVER INTEND TO USE OUR IMPROVED RELATIONSHIPS WITH CHINA AGAINST THE SOVIET UNION OR THE RELATIONSHIPS WITH THE SOVIET UNION, WHICH I HOPE TO IMPROVE, AS A FACTOR TO ENDANGER OR TO THREATEN CHINA. SO THAT WAS A PROVISO PUT IN HIS FIRST DISPATCH. BUT I THINK STILL IN BALANCE IT WAS CONSTRUCTIVE.

IT WAS CERTAINLY CONSTRUCTIVE AND POSITIVE COMPARED TO THE ANTICIPATION THAT I HAD FROM THE SOVIET UNION. - Q: MR. PRESIDENT, WITH IRAN OFF LINE NOW ON OIL PRODUCTION, AND YOUR WORRYING ABOUT SPOT SHORTAGES, THERE ARE A LOT OF SCIENTISTS WHO SEE SAUDI ARABIA DOWN THERE IN MEXICO. YET WE SEEM TO BE TURNING OUR BACK ON NATURAL GAS PRODUCTION IN MEXICO; SOME QUESTION ABOUT WHETHER THEY WANT TO HAVE SUBSTANTIAL GAS IN THE AMERICAN MARKET. HOW DO RECONCILE THAT? - P: WE ARE VERY INTERESTED IN MEXICAN OIL AND NATURAL GAS TO BE PURCHASED BY OUR OWN NATION.

THE DECISIONS, HOWEVER, ON HOW RAPIDLY TO PRODUCE AND TO MARKET THEIR OIL AND NATURAL GAS IS A DECISION TO BE MADE BY MEXICO. THEY ARE UNDERSTANDABLY VERY INDEPENDENT IN THIS RESPECT AND WE WOULD NOT TRY TO ENCROACH ON THEIR INDEPENDENCE NOR TRY TO ENCOURAGE THEM TO MORE RAPIDLY PRODUCE GAS AND OIL THAN THEY THEMSELVES DESIRE. WE HAVE IMMEDIATE NEEDS AND ALSO LONG-RANGE NEEDS, SOMETIMES NOT QUITE THE SAME. IN THE IMMEDIATE FUTURE, THE NEXT FEW MONTHS, THERE IS NO URGENCY ABOUT ACQUIRING MEXICAN NATURAL GAS.

WE HAVE AT THIS MOMENT A SURPLUS OF NATURAL GAS IN OUR OWN COUNTRY AND THE STATEMENTS MADE BY THE SECRETARY OF ENERGY WERE RELATED TO THAT FACT. HE HAS ECNOURAGED LARGE USERS OF OIL AND GAS TO USE GAS INSTEAD OF OIL, BUT, FOR INSTANCE, NEW POWER PLANTS TO BE BUILT IN THE FUTURE HAVE TO BE DESIGNED TO USE COAL. AND WE ALSO HAVE THE PROBLEM OF USING EFFICIENTLY GAS PRODUCED IN THE 48 STATES OF OUR COUNTRY AND IN THE FUTURE HOW TO BRING THE NATURAL GAS THAT IS AVAILABLE FROM ALASKA DOWN THROUGH CANADA TO OUR NATION. IT IS A VERY COMPLICATED THING.

AND WHEN I GO TO MEXICO NEXT FEBRUARY, THIS WILL OBVIOUSLY BE ONE OF THE MATTERS THAT I WILL DISCUSS. BUT I AM NOT GOING DOWN THERE TO NEGOTIATE THE PRICE OF NATURAL GAS. WE WILL BE TALKING, MYSELF AND PRESIDENT LOPEZ PORTILLO, MORE ON LONG-RANGE STRATEGIC APPROACHES ON HOW WE MIGHT BEST PROVIDE A GOOD MARKET FOR MEXICAN OIL AND GAS THAT THEY WANT TO SELL TO US. MR. FRANK CORMIER (AP): THANK YOU, MR. PRESIDENT. 4:34 P.M. EST. VANCE

1979STATE013737.subject: RESPONSE TO INQUIRIES ABOUT TRAVEL TO IRAN

segments.text: WOULD APPRECIATE ANY COMMENTS YOU MAY HAVE ON FOLLOWING GENERAL LINE WE ARE TAKING TO QUERIES RE MOVEMENT OF AMERICANS

WE HAVE BEEN DISCOURAGING ALL NON-ESSENTIAL TRAVEL TO IRAN SINCE THE EVENTS OF EARLY NOVEMBER LAST YEAR. ADDITIONALLY, WE ARE PASSING ON TO INQUIRIERS ANY AND ALL ADVICE THAT YOU DISSEMINATE TO THE AMERICAN COMMUNITY IN IRAN. AN EXAMPLE OF THIS IS YOUR ADVICE TO THE COMMUNITY TO REMAIN AT HOME JANUARY 19, AND IF FOR ANY REASON ONE MUST GO OUT YOUR UNDERSCORING OF THE NECESSITY TO EXERCISE UTMOST CAUTION.

IN EARLY DECEMBER WE APPRISED CALLERS ABOUT THE DECISION TO OFFER OFFICIAL DEPENDENTS WHO SO CHOSE THE OPPORTUNITY TO DEPART IRAN TEMPORARILY. AS OF DECEMBER 31 WE HAVE BEEN TELLING CALLERS OF THE ADVISORY THE EMBASSY ISSUED RECOMMENDING TO CIVILIAN AND MILITARY DEPENDENTS OF THE OFFICIAL COMMUNITY THAT THEY LEAVE TEMPORARILY, AND EMPHASIZING THAT YOU MADE THE SAME RECOMMENDATION TO PRIVATE AMERICAN DEPENDENTS. IN MOST CASES, HAVING SAID THAT, WE HAVE READ TO THE CALLER THE TEXT OF THE EMBASSY DECEMBER 31 ADVISORY.
IF A CALLER INDICATES A TRAVEL PURPOSE NOT RELATED TO TOURISM (OR SOMETHING COMPARABLE TO TOURISM) WE ASK QUESTIONS SEEKING TO DETERMINE

WHERE IN IRAN THE TRAVELER INTENDS TO GO? (FOR OTHER THAN TEHRAN LOCATIONS WE HAVE BEEN GENERALLY DISCOURAGING, PARTICULARLY SINCE IRAN AIR WENT ON STRIKE. EVEN FOR TEHRAN, UNLESS THE TRAVELER HAS A SUBSTANTIALLY SOLID BASIS FOR BELIEVING EFFECTIVE RESULTS MIGHT ACCRUE FROM THE TRIP, WE HAVE BEEN BEARISH, DESCRIBING THE LARGE DEGREE OF CHAOS AND GENERAL MEASURE OF PARALYSIS THAT EXISTS.)
THE EXACT BUSINESS? (BE IT ONE THAT RELIES ON, FOR EXAMPLE, BANKING SERVICES WITHIN IRAN, WE DESCRIBE THE VIRTUALLY SISYPHEAN HURDLES THAT CAN BE EXPECTED.); AND

WHETHER THE TRAVELER'S COMPANY HAS AN OFFICE OR REPRESENTATION IN IRAN? (IF SO, WHAT WORD THE COMPANY HAS FROM IRAN ABOUT CONDITIONS AND THE POSSIBILITY OF ACCOMPLISHING THE PURPOSE FOR WHICH THE PROPOSED TRAVEL IS INTENDED.)

A GENERAL POINT WE USUALLY MAKE IS THAT A REPORT FROM THE EMBASSY INDICATING CALM OR RELATIVE QUIET, IN WHATEVER RESPECT FOR A GIVEN REPORT, COULD (AS THE PAST MONTHS BEAR OUT) CHANGE VERY QUICKLY. THE ONLY CERTAINTY IS THE CONTINUING UNCERTAINTY AS TO THE TIMING FOR A RETURN OF SOME STABILITY AND NORMALCY. ALL THAT BEING SAID, WE CONCLUDE BY POINTING OUT THE BOTTOM LINE IS THAT THE DECISION IS ONE FOR THE INDIVIDUAL OR COMPANY PROPOSING TO TRAVEL TO MAKE. VANCE

(S - ENTIRE TEXT) FOLLOWING IS GEN. TWITCHELL'S REPORT ON HIS MEETINGS WITH GENERAL DJAM JANUARY 16 AND 17. A FURTHER MEETING IS SCHEDULED FOR JANUARY 18 OR 19 AT WHICH HE WILL SEEK DJAM'S VIEWS ON MATTERS RAISED IN REFTEL.

A. CURRENT EVENTS. IN DISCUSSING HOW PRESENT SITUATION CAME TO PASS, DJAM TOUCHED ON SUCH FACTORS AS: SHAH'S UNWILLINGNESS TO LISTEN TO ADVISERS AND TO DELEGATE AUTHORITY, CORRUPTION, WASTE, DISSERVICE OF SUCH AGENCIES AS SAVAK, LOSS OF TOUCH WITH THE PEOPLE, LACK OF SUPPORT WITHIN COUNTRY,AND BELATED RECOQNITION OF THE CRITICAL ROLE WHICH CLERGY HAVE HISTORICALLY PLAYED IN POLITICAL OPPOSITION.

DJAM FEELS THAT MILITARY LEADERSHIP WAS LACKING AND MILITARY SHOULD HAVE DEALT MORE FIRMLY AT OUTSET WITH DISORDERS. HE WAS CRITICAL OF MANNER IN WHICH TROOPS HANDLED DEMONSTRATIONS, PARTICULARLY THE RESORT TO FIRING INTO AND OVER THE HEAD OF THE MOBS. HE IS ESPECIALLY CONCERNED OVER THE IMPACT WHICH SHAH'S DEPARTURE WILL HAVE ON MORALE OF MILITARY. DJAM EXPLAINED THAT IN HIS OPINION IT WAS A MISTAKE FOR SHAH TO LEAVE AND, IF NECESSARY, HE SHOULD HAVE MOVED TO ANOTHER SECTION OF THE COUNTRY (E.G., KHUZISTAN) WHERE HE COULD HAVE ESTABLISHED A STRONG BASE AND ENSURED THE SECURITY OF THAT VITAL SECTION OF THE NATION.
SUCH A CONCEPT WOULD ALSO HAVE SERVED TO BE A "PIN IN THE SIDE" OF ANY OPPOSITION GOVERNMENT AND WOULD HAVE STRENGTHENED THE PROSPECTS FOR RESTORING THE SHAH TO POWER, ALBEIT IN A MODIFIED ROLE.

DJAM EXPLAINED THAT HE HAD NOT ACCEPTED THE POST OF MINISTER OF WAR FOR SEVERAL REASONS, PARTICULARLY THE POOR PROSPECTS FOR THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT, THE FACT THAT THE ROLE OF THE MOW IS ESSENTIALLY CONCERNED WITH ADMINISTRATIVE MATTERS AND NOT WITH DEFENSE MATTERS, AND THE EXTENT TO WHICH THE SHAH WOULD DELEGATE AUTHORITY FOR THE CONTROL OF THE MILITARY. ON THIS LATTER POINT, DJAM SAID THAT ALTHOUGH HE HAD ADVISED THE PALACE IN ADVANCE THAT HE CONSIDERED THE QUESTION OF CONTROL A BIG FACTOR, THE SHAH DID NOT RAISE THE SUBJECT WITH HIM.

DJAM WENT ON TO SAY THAT A NUMBER OF THE YOUNGER GENERAL OFFICERS (I.E., BGS) AND COLONELS HAD URGED HIM TO RETURN AND TAKE OVER A LEADERSHIP ROLE IN THE MILITARY. HOWEVER, HE FELT THAT WITHOUT THERE BEING ADEQUATE DELEGATION OF AUTHORITY, THE NECESSARY SUPPORT WOULD BE LACKING.

B. DEVELOPING TRENDS AND RESTORATION OF STABILITY. DJAM IS EXTREMELY PESSIMISTIC OVER THE PROSPECTS FOR RESTORATION OF STABILITY AND FEELS THAT IF THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT IS DEPOSED AND KHOMEINI'S ISLAMIC REPUBLIC IS INSTALLED, THE COMMUNISTS COULD TAKE OVER OR THE COUNTRY COULD BECOME EMBROILED IN A CIVIL WAR AND IRAN COULD BE "ANOTHER LEBANON." IN COMMENTING ON THE SITUATION, HE REFERRED TO IRAN'S 1907 TREATY WITH RUSSIA AND IS APPREHENSIVE THAT THE SOVIETS WILL USE SAME AS A JUSTIFICATION FOR ANY INTERVENTION.

DJAM EMPHASIZED THAT IN HIS OPINION THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT IS IN ACCORD WITH THE 1906 CONSTITUTION AND SHOULD BE GIVEN AN OPPORTUNITY TO SURVIVE. HE FEELS THAT BAKHTIAR IS CAPABLE AND HAS A MUCH BETTER UNDERSTANDING OF THE REALITIES INVOLVED THAN KHOMEINI. THE NATIONAL FRONT, WHILE NOT COMPLETELY IN ACCORD WITH KHOMEINI, RECOGNIZES ITS OWN WEAKNESS AND HAS TURNED TO THE LATTER BECAUSE OF HIS POPULAR SUPPORT WITH THE PEOPLE.

AS FOR A MILITARY TAKEOVER, DJAM REFERRED TO THE FAILURE OF THE AZHARI GOVERNMENT AND FELT THAT THERE WAS LITTLE TO BE GAINED. AS NOTED ABOVE, HE FELT THAT WITH THE DEPARTURE OF THE SHAH, THERE IS A VOID IN THE CONTROL OF THE MILITARY. IN THIS CONNECTION, IT IS IMPORTANT TO UNDERSTAND THAT EVERY SOLDIER WAS TAUGHT TO LOOK UPON THE SHAH AS HIS IMMEDIATE COMMANDER RATHER THAN A CONCEPT WHICH ENVISAGES A CHAIN OF COMMAND. THUS IN THE PRESENT ENVIRONMENT, AND GIVEN THE PERSONALITIES OF THE MILITARY, ONE COULD ENVISION A COUP IF THE SITUATION DETERIORATED.

GIVEN KHOMEINI'S POPULAR SUPPORT, THE BEST HOPE FOR THE RESTORATION OF STABILITY IS TO ACHIEVE SOME SORT OF AN UNDERSTANDING BETWEEN BAKHTIAR AND KHOMEINI WHEREBY THE TWO FACTIONS CAN AGREE ON A FORMULA WHICH WILL RESTORE ORDER AND BE CONDUCIVE TO THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A CLIMATE WHEREBY ELECTIONS CAN BE HELD AND A GOVERNMENT WHICH IS ACCEPTED BY THE MAJORITY AS BEING CONSTITUTIONAL CAN BE INSTALLED.

C. OPENING A DIALOGUE WITH KHOMEINI. IN COMMENTING ON MANNER OF OPENING A DIALOGUE WITH KHOMEINI, DJAM INDICATED THAT AT HIS SUGGESTION QUESTION OF MILITARY CONTACTING KHOMEINI HAD BEEN RAISED WITH SHAH. PROPOSAL ENVISIONED THAT DJAM AND A COLLEAGUE, AS RETIRED OFFICERS, COULD APPROACH KHOMEINI WITH VIEW TO ENCOURAGING HIM TO COOPERATE IN THE RESTORATION OF STABILITY AND BRINOING ABOUT CONSTITUTIONAL CHANGE. SHAH, IN DISAPPROVING SUGGESTION, INDICATED THAT HE WOULD CONSIDER ANY SUCH VISIT DISLOYAL.

DJAM WENT ON TO SAY THAT WITH SHAH OUT OF COUNTRY, QUESTION ARISES AS TO WHO COULD APPROACH KHOMEINI WITH ANY DEGREE OF AUTHORITY. AFTER EXPLORING MATTER, HE FELT THAT WITH THE ESTABLISHMENT OF THE REGENCY COUNCIL, IT WOULD BE NECESSARY (IN FIRST INSTANCE) FOR BAKHTIAR AND GARABAGHI TO AGREE THAT AN APPROACH BE MADE TO KHOMEINI. PRESUMABLY COUNCIL, IN ABSENCE OF SHAH, HAS AUTHORITY TO ACT AS NECESSARY; QUESTION IS WHETHER MEMBERS ARE PREPARED TO TAKE INITIATIVE. IF SO, AN APPROPRIATE REPRESENTATIVE COULD CONTACT KHOMEINI. IN VIEW OF SHAH'S VIEWS ON MATTER AND DJAM'S CLOSE ASSOCIATION WITH HIM OVER MANY YEARS, LATTER WOULD NOT WISH TO MAKE THE CONTACT.
(COMMENT: PRESUMABLY IF SHAH WERE TO INDICATE APPROVAL, DJAM WOULD RECONSIDER.)

DEFENSE POLICY. IN CONJUNCTION WITH HIS COMMENTS ON BAKHTIAR, DJAM OBSERVED THAT LATTER IS OVERWHELMED BY DAY-TO-DAY CRISES AND HE HAS NOT HAD CHANCE TO ADEQUATELY ADDRESS FOREIGN AND DEFENSE POLICY ISSUES. DURING A BRIEF CHAT WITH DJAM ON THESE MATTERS, FORMER SUGGESTED THAT PROTECTION OF SUCH AREAS AS THE STRAITS OF HORMUZ AND SEA APPROACHES, AND THE DETERRENCE OF SOVIET-INSPIRED REGIONAL AGGRESSION WERE MORE PROPERLY MATTERS OF CONCERN TO US AND IN LARGE MEASURE DEPENDENT UPON EFFECTIVENESS OF US DETERRENT CAPABILITY AND ABILITY TO MEET CONTINGENCY SITUATIONS. DJAM REPLIED THAT IRAN TOO HAS A DIRECT INTEREST IN THE SECURITY OF CONTIGUOUS AREAS.
THE IMPLICATIONS OF IRAN'S SECURITY POLICY UNDER A KHOMEINI-INSTALLED REGIME WOULD BE FAR GRAVER AS THE COUNTRY WOULD BE FOCUSED INWARD.

OF IMMEDIATE CONCERN TO DJAM IS THE QUESTION OF ENSURING THE PROPER SECURITY AND MAINTENANCE OF THE MILITARY EQUIPMENT. HE FEELS THAT IF MEASURES ARE NOT CURRENTLY UNDERWAY, IT IS IMPORTANT TO MAKE CERTAIN STEPS ARE TAKEN TO SITUATE WEAPONS AND EQUIPMENT IN SECURE AND STRATEGICALLY LOCATED AREAS -EMPHASIS SHOULD ALSO BE PLACED ON IMPROVED MAINTENANCE OF THE EQUIPMENT ON HAND AND ON THE ABILITY TO CARE FOR THE MATERIAL IN THE PIPELINE IN ORDER THADER THAT IT BE

THE COMPANY VIEWED HIM AS UNSAVORY AND WOULD NOT TOUCH THE DEAL.

(S) ENTIRE TEXT
WHEN YOU SEE YAZDI TO RECEIVE RESPONSES TO OUR QUESTIONS, REQUEST YOU MAKE THE FOLLOWING APPROACH.

WE HAVE NOTED FROM YAZDI'S CONVERSATION WITH YOU THAT THE AYATOLLAH PLANS TO ANNOUNCE VERY SOON WHAT HE HAS REFERRED TO AS HIS PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT. YOUR DISCUSSIONS WITH YAZDI HAVE BEEN BASED ON AN ASSUMPTION THAT THE AYATOLLAH SHARES WITH US A DESIRE TO AVOID ACTIONS WHICH COULD POSE THE THREAT OF FURTHER VIOLENCE OR EVEN CIVIL WAR. WE ARE CONCERNED THAT THE ANNOUNCEMENT OF A PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT UNQUOTE AT THIS TIME AND BEFORE THE DIALOGUE HAS BEEN PURSUED WITH THE MILITARY AND OTHER SIGNIFICANT ELEMENTS IN TEHRAN COULD RUN EXACTLY THAT RISK. WE WOULD WELCOME THE AYATOLLAH'S COMMENTS.

FYI: WE WISH TO EXPRESS THIS AS A MEASURE OF OUR CONCERN WITHOUT SUGGESTING THAT WE WOULD AT ANY TIME SUPPORT A TRANSITION TO A PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT. IN THE CONVERSATION, HOWEVER, WE WOULD BE INTERESTED IN ANY INDICATIONS YAZDI MAY PROVIDE OF THE MANNER IN WHICH KHOMEINI THINKS THAT THIS TRANSITION WOULD TAKE PLACE. WE FEAR THAT THE AYATOLLAH MAY BELIEVE THAT THE MERE ANNOUNCEMENT OF THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT UNQUOTE WOULD CAUSE THE COLLAPSE OF THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT. WE BELIEVE THIS TO BE VERY DANGEROUS THINKING. END FYI.

(S-ENTIRE TEXT) SUMMARY. YAZDI TOLD ZIMMERMANN THAT KHOMEINI HAD SENT WORD TO BEHESHTI TO GET IN TOUCH WITH ARMY. YAZDI SAID THAT KHOMEINI WANTS TO KNOW IF ARMY IS INTERESTED IN PRESERVING MONARCHY OR SIMPLY IN PROTECTING ITS OWN INTEGRITY. END SUMMARY.
ZIMMERMANN SAW YAZDI FOR AN HOUR AT 0945 JANUARY

ZIMMERMANN WENT THROUGH INSTRUCTION REF A CAREFULLY WITH YAZDI, WHO, AS BEFORE, TOOK COPIOUS NOTES. ZIMMERMANN ALSO PROVIDED YAZDI A TRANSCRIPT OF PRESIDENT'S JANUARY 17 PRESS CONFERENCE. IN HIS PRESENTATION, WHICH FOLLOWED CLOSELY LINES OF REFTEL A, ZIMMERMANN HIGHLIGHTED (A) US CONCERN ABOUT TUDEH PARTY AND (B) URGENCY AND IMPORTANCE OF DIRECT CONTACTS BETWEEN KHOMEINI'S PEOPLE AND ARMY.

ON POINT A, ZIMMERMANN ADDED A PERSONAL NOTE THAT, AS A FORMER TEACHER OF RUSSIAN HISTORY AND AS A DIPLOMAT WHO HAD SPENT MUCH OF HIS CAREER DEALING WITH SOVIET UNION, HE WAS IMPRESSED WITH THE DEGREE TO WHICH A WELLORGANIZED COMMUNIST PARTY, EVEN IF RELATIVELY WEAK, CAN TAKE ADVANTAGE OF CIVIL STRIFE OR INSTABILITY TO INCREASE ITS INFLUENCE; THAT WAS THE LESSON OF 1917.

YAZDI SAID HE WELL UNDERSTOOD THE TACTICS OF THE TUDEH, HAVING FOUGHT AGAINST IT AS A STUDENT ACTIVITIST FOR THE NATIONAL MOVEMENT IN IRAN IN THE POSTWAR PERIOD; BUT HE DISAGREED WITH THE BOLSHEVIK ANALOGY, CLAIMING THAT THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT WAS TOO STRONG TO LET ITSELF BE OVERTURNED BY THE TUDEH. ON PARA 7B, UNFORTUNATELY, AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN'S CABLE (REF B) ARRIVED AFTER ZIMMERMANN HAD LEFT FOR MEETING WITH YAZDI. WHILE ZIMMERMANN DID CITE THE POINTS ON THE CONSTITUTION IN THAT PARAGRAPH, HE CALLED YAZDI'S PRIMARY ATTENTION TO THE LAST TWO SENTENCES OF IT, WHICH, HOPEFULLY, CONVEYED TO YAZDI A SENSE OF US FLEXIBILITY ON THE CONSTITUTION.

AFTER ZIMMERMANN'S PRESENTATION, YAZDI REPEATED A POINT MADE PREVIOUSLY--THAT IF THE ARMY'S PRIMARY CONCERN IS FOR ITS OWN INTEGRITY RATHER THAN FOR THE PRESERVATION OF THE MONARCHY, THEN THE ISSUE COULD BE NEGOTIATED. HE THEN REVEALED THAT KHOMEINI HAD GIVEN WORD TO HIS PEOPLE IN IRAN TO GET IN TOUCH WITH THE ARMY. ZIMMERMANN ASKED IF THAT MEANT BEHESHTI; YAZDI SAID YES. HE DID NOT ELABORATE ON BEHESHTI'S MANDATE. HE SAID ONLY THAT "WE WANT TO KNOW IF THE ARMY IS INTERESTED IN THE PRESERVATION OF THE MONARCHY."

YAZDI THEN OFFERED SOME COMMENTS ON THE POLITICAL PROGRAM FOR THE TRANSITIONAL PERIOD. HE REPEATED THAT THE AYATOLLAH HAS SET UP A REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL "INSIDE" AND ADDED THAT HE HAS COMMISSIONED IT TO DO VARIOUS JOBS. YAZDI CITED TWO EXAMPLES. FIRST, KHOMEINI APPOINTED A COMMISSION TO GO SOUTH AND PREPARE THE GROUND FOR THE PRODUCTION OF OIL FOR DOMESTIC USE. THIS COMMISSION WAS MAINLY ARRANGED THROUGH THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL, WHICH SUGGESTED IT TO KHOMEINI, WHO APPROVED IT AND NAMED IT UNDER BAZARGAN'S LEADERSHIP. THE COMMISSION WAS SUCCESSFUL IN PRODUCING OIL FOR DOMESTIC CONSUMPTION AND HAS THUS STAVED OFF A CHAOTIC SITUATION.
ACCORDING TO YAZDI, EXTREMIST ELEMENTS (IN PARTICULAR THE TUDEH) OPPOSED THE RESUMPTION OF PRODUCTION; THEY WERE COMPLETELY DEFEATED.

THE SECOND OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL'S JOBS CITED BY YAZDI WAS TO PREPARE THE GROUND FOR THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT. THE COUNCIL WILL STUDY AND RECOMMEND INDIVIDUALS FOR THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT AND THE AYATOLLAH WILL ANNOUNCE THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT VERY SOON. HOPEFULLY, SAID YAZDI, THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT WILL TAKE OVER. THE ROLE OF THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT WAS DESCRIBED BY YAZDI IN FAMILIAR TERMS: FIRST, TO HOLD A NEW ELECTION FOR A CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY TO RATIFY A NEW CONSTITUTION; SECOND, TO HOLD AN ELECTION BASED ON THE NEW CONSTITUTION AND TO CREATE A NEW REPRESENTATIVE GOVERNMENT; THIRD, TO TRANSFER POWER TO THE NEWLY ELECTED REPRESENTATIVES.
YAZDI SAID THAT KHOMEINI SEES THE TRANSITION AS PROPER AND HOPEFULLY PEACEFUL.

YAZDI EXPANDED ON KHOMEINI'S VIEW OF THE CONSTITUTION. THERE MUST BE A NEW CONSTITUTION. NOT JUST A MODIFIED ONE; THE PAHLAVI DYNASTY HAS BEEN CHANGING THE 1906 CONSTITUTION FOR 50 YEARS. BUT MANY CLAUSES FROM THE OLD CONSTITUTION WILL BE KEPT. YAZDI CITED ONE EXAMPLE. HE SAID THAT THE CLAUSE IN THE PRESENT CONSTITUTION PERMITTING RELIGIOUS MINORITIES TO HAVE THEIR OWN REPRESENTATIVES IN PARLIAMENT WOULD BE RETAINED AS THE BEST WAY FOR THE RELIGIOUS MINORITIES TO HAVE THEIR OWN INDEPENDENT VOICE WITHIN THE ASSEMBLY. IN THIS WAY CHRISTIANS AND JEWS WILL BE GIVEN A CHANCE TO BE HEARD.
YAZDI SAID THAT, THOUGH THE 1906 CONSTITUTION PROVIDES FOR THIS, HE DOUBTED THAT IT HAD BEEN IMPLEMENTED SINCE.

YAZDI SAID THAT KHOMEINI'S POLICY OF RETAINING THE CONSTITUTIONAL CLAUSE ON RELIGIOUS MINORITIES HAD BEEN DISCUSSED WITH REPRESENTATIVES OF JEWISH GROUPS BOTH INSIDE IRAN AND WITH KHOMEINI DIRECTLY. KHOMEINI ASSURED THE RIGHTS OF THE JEWISH MINORITY; THE JEWISH REPRESENTATIVES TAPED HIS ASSURANCES AND CIRCULATED THEM IN IRAN. ON THE EVENING OF JANUARY 17 THEY CAME BACK TO KHOMEINI AND EXPRESSED SATISFACTION. ZIMMERMANN ASKED ABOUT THE CHRISTIANS, WHO HAD FALLEN BY THE WAYSIDE IN THIS DISCUSSION. KHOMEINI SAID THAT THE ARMENIAN DIOCESE HAD ASKED THE CHRISTIANS IN IRAN TO OBSERVE NATIONAL MOURNING OVER CHRISTMAS AND NEW YEAR'S, THUS ASSOCIATING THE CHRISTIANS WITH KHOMEINI.
THE CHRISTIANS HAVE ALSO PLEDGED FULL SUPPORT TO KHOMEINI IN MEMORANDA.

ZIMMERMANN ASKED IF THERE WERE ANY OTHER EXAMPLES YAZDI COULD CITE OF CLAUSES IN THE CURRENT CONSTITUTION THAT WOULD BE RETAINED. YAZDI SAID HE DIDN'T KNOW YET. HE THEN MADE HIS OBJECTIVE CLEAR BY SAYING THAT "YOU CAN TELL THE AMERICAN JEWS NOT TO WORRY ABOUT THE JEWISH FUTURE IN IRAN." ZIMMERMANN ASKED IF THE SAME APPROACH APPLIED TO THE STATE OF ISRAEL. YAZDI SAID, "NO, WE DIFFERENTIATE BETWEEN THE TWO QUESTIONS."

AT THE END OF THE MEETING YAZDI ASKED ON A PERSONAL BASIS IF ZIMMERMANN COULD PROVIDE ANY INFORMATION ABOUT FORMER PRESIDENT FORD'S POSSIBLE MEETING WITH THE SHAH IN EGYPT. ZIMMERMANN SAID ALL HE HAD SEEN WAS PRESS ITEMS. YAZDI THEN ASKED IF THERE WAS ANY CONNECTION BETWEEN FORD'S VISIT TO EGYPT AND KISSINGER'S RECENT STATEMENT ON IRAN. ZIMMERMANN SAID HE COULDN'T RECALL A MORE RECENT KISSINGER STATEMENT THAN MID-DECEMBER (THE NEWSWEEK INTERVIEW); YAZDI SAID HE WAS THINKING OF SOMETHING IN THE LAST FEW DAYS.

IN ANY CASE, ZIMMERMANN SAID ON A PERSONAL BASIS THAT KISSINGER AND FORD WERE CURRENTLY QUITE INDEPENDENT OF EACH OTHER AND THAT IN ANY CASE YAZDI WOULD APPRECIATE THAT THE CARTER ADMINISTRATION'S POLICY TOWARD THE SHAH WAS MORE NUANCED THAN THAT OF EITHER KISSINGER OR FORD.

ZIMMERMANN ASKED YAZDI WHEN HE COULD EXPECT A RESPONSE TO THE FOUR QUESTIONS POSED IN PARA 9 OF REFTEL A. YAZDI SAID THAT KHOMEINI'S POSITION ON ON ALL FOUR ISSUES WAS WELL KNOWN AND THAT YAZDI COULD GIVE THE ANSWERS RIGHT AWAY, BUT HE PREFERRED TO CHECK WITH KHOMEINI BEFORE HE DID SO. HE ASKED ZIMMERMAN TO TELEPHONE HIM EARLY IN THE MORNING OF JANUARY 19 AND HE WOULD PROBABLY HAVE THE ANSWERS. HARTMAN

(S - ENTIRE TEXT) ZIMMERMANN CONVEYED US CONCERN REFTEL TO YAZDI IN MEETING JANUARY 19 AT 0945 LOCAL, AND SAID WE WOULD WELCOME KHOMEINI'S COMMENTS. YAZDI SAID THAT, BEFORE HE COULD GIVE US A RESPONSE, HE NEEDED TO KNOW WHAT WE MEANT BY "OTHER SIGNIFICANT ELEMENTS IN TEHRAN" (REFTEL PARA 2). ZIMMERMANN SAID HE WOULD REFER QUESTION TO WASHINGTON.
READ-OUT ON YAZDI'S ANSWERS TO FOUR QUESTIONS WE HAD POSED JANUARY 18 FOLLOWS SEPTEL.

(S - ENTIRE TEXT) AS YAZDI HAD REQUESTED AT PREVIOUS MEETING, ZIMMERMANN TELEPHONED HIM EARLY AM JANUARY 19. YAZDI SAID HE WAS READY WITH ANSWERS TO OUR FOUR QUESTIONS REFTEL, SO ZIMMERMANN MET HIM FOR AN HOUR AT 0945 LOCAL. YAZDI READ ANSWERS CAREFULLY FROM A SET OF NOTES; HE CONFIRMED THAT ANSWERS REPRESENTED KHOMEINI'S VIEWS. ANSWERS FOLLOW.

US INVESTMENT IN IRAN. YAZDI SAID THAT AT THE MOMENT THEY DID NOT HAVE ENOUGH INFORMATION ON NATURE AND INTENSITY OF US INVESTMENT INVOLVEMENT IN IRAN TO MAKE A POLICY STATEMENT COVERING ALL OF US ACTIVITIES. PRINCIPLES OF POLICY WILL BE BASED ON IRANIAN NATIONAL INTEREST AND DEVELOPMENT, AND ON PROGRESS OF COUNTRY WITH REGARD TO PLANS FUTURE GOVERNMENT MIGHT HAVE. FOR EXAMPLE, YAZDI SAID, ONE PRIORITY OF THE FUTURE GOVERNMENT'S DEVELOPMENT PLAN WILL BE TO RENOVATE AND REVITALIZE THE AGRICULTURAL SYSTEM, WHICH IS COMPLETELY DESTROYED, SO THAT THE COUNTRY CAN PRODUCE FOOD PRODUCTS FOR ITS INTERNAL NEEDS.

FOR THE IMPLEMENTATION OF SUCH A POLICY, THE FUTURE GOVERNMENT MAY HAVE PLANS WHICH WILL INVOLVE FOREIGN (INCLUDING AMERICAN) INVESTMENT AND COOPERATION. YAZDI MADE AN ILLUSTRATIVE POINT: AN ASIAN FARMER PRODUCES FOOD FOR FIVE PEOPLE, A EUROPEAN FARMER FOOD FOR 10-11 PEOPLE, AND AN AMERICAN FARMER FOOD FOR 59-60 PEOPLE; THIS SHOWS THAT THE US HAS A HIGHLY DEVELOPED AGRICULTURAL SYSTEM, WHICH HOPEFULLY THE FUTURE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT WILL CONSIDER IN ITS PLANS.

SALE OF OIL TO THE WEST. YAZDI SAID, "WE NEED INCOME FROM OUR OIL FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF THE COUNTRY. WE DON' T WANT TO DIE FROM HUNGER OVER THE OIL WELLS. WE WILL SELL OUR OIL TO WHOEVER WILL PURCHASE IT AT A JUST PRICE." HOWEVER, HE ADDED, THEY WOULD ACCEPT ONLY FOREIGN EXCHANGE, NOT OTHER TYPES OF PAYMENT (E.G., ARMS IN EXCHANGE FOR OIL). THE OIL FLOW WILL CONTINUE AFTER THE ESTABLISHMENT OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC, EXCEPT FOR TWO COUNTRIES: SOUTH AFRICA AND ISRAEL.
POLITICAL/MILITARY RELATIONSHIP WITHE THE US. HERE YAZDI ENUMERATED AND SET OUT SIX POINTS
THEY ARE NOT REPEAT NOT AGAINST ANY COUNTRY OR ANY NATION. BUT THEY ARE AGAINST OPPRESSIVE POLICIES THAT OTHER COUNTRIES HAVE ADOPTED TOWARD THE IRANIAN PEOPLE AND COUNTRY.

(HERE YAZDI EXPLAINED, WHEN ASKED, THAT HE WAS NOT SPEAKING ONLY OF THE US BUT ALSO, FOR EXAMPLE, OF ISRAEL'S OPPRESSIVE POLICY, WHICH HAS DEPRIVED THE PALESTINIANS OF THEIR RIGHTS.) IF THE USG -- INSTEAD OF CONTINUING TO SUPPORT A GROUP OF CORRUPT POLITICIANS OR ARMY PERSONNEL WITHOUT SUPPORT AMONG THE MASSES -- DECIDES TO CHANGE ITS POLICY, AS PRESIDENT CARTER AND OTHER OFFICIALS HAVE INDICATED, AND STOPS INTERFERING IN IRAN'S INTERNAL AFFAIRS, THEN "WE SEE A FRIENDLY FUTURE RELATIONSHIP." FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF THE COUNTRY (E.G. ECONOMIC, AGRICULTURAL, SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY) IRAN NEEDS THE HELP OF OTHER COUNTRIES, "IN PARTICULAR THE AMERICANS,".
THROUGH FRIENDLY RELATIONS BASED ON MUTUAL RESPECT IRAN CAN REACH ITS GOALS.

THE USG SHOULD KNOW ("THEY KNOW IT WELL") THAT, BECAUSE OF US POLICY IN IRAN, PARTICULARLY SINCE 1953, THERE IS DEEP-ROOTED RESENTMENT AND HATE TOWARDS THE AMERICAN GOVERNMENT, OFFICIALS, AND POLICIES. BECAUSE OF THEIR UNCONDITIONAL SUPPORT OF THE SHAH DURING THOSE YEARS IT IS NOT EASY TO CHANGE SUCH ATTITUDES IN A SHORT TIME. "HOWEVER, WE BELIEVE THE USG CAN CORRECT THE SITUATION" BY CHANGING ITS POLICIES AND SHOWING THIS CHANGE IN A PRACTICAL SENSE.

THAT MEANS A COMPLETE SHIFT FROM SUPPORTING THE ESTABLISHMENT, CORRUPT MILITARY OFFICERS, AND A CORRUPT AND INCAPABLE RULING CLASS (EITHER MILITARY OR CIVILIAN); IT MEANS SHOWING INTEREST IN COOPERATING WITH THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT AND THE NEW GOVERNMENT.
"WE DON'T APPROVE OF HUGE MILITARY ARMAMENTS FROM ANY SOURCEZ, INCLUDING THE US. WE DO NOT BELIEVE THEY ARE NECESSARY OR USEFUL."

THE STABILITY OF IRAN AND (AS A RESULT) OF THE REGION DOES NOT COME FROM A LARGE ARMY AND SOPHISTICATED WEAPONS, BUT RATHER FROM DEVELOPMENT AND FROM THE PROGRESS OF DEMOCRACY, SOCIAL JUSTICE, AND TRUE INDEPENDENCE OF THE COUNTRY, AND IN PARTICULAR FROM THE FULL PARTICIPATION OF THE PEOPLE IN DEVELOPING THE COUNTRY.
FOREIGN POLICY WILL BE BASED ON "POSITIVE NONALIGHMENT." THEREFORE IRAN WILL NOT PARTICIPATE IN ANY MILITARY PACT SUCH AS CENTO, NOR IN THE THE COLD WAR BETWEEN THE SUPER-POWERS.

"WE WILL NOT ACT AS POLICEMAN OF THE GULF OF REGION, NOR WILL WE ACT AS AN EXPORTER OF REVOLUTION TO OTHER COUNTRIES IN THE REGION. WE WON'T ASK THE PEOPLE OF SAUDI ARABIA, KUWAIT, THE SHEIKHDOMS OF THE PERSIAN GULF, OR IRAQ TO KICK THE FOREIGNERS OUT. OUR POLICY IS NOT TO INTERFERE IN OTHER PEOPLE'S AFFAIRS."

POLICY TOWARD THE SOVIET UNION. " OUR POLICY TOWARD THE RUSSIANS WILL BE THE SAME AS TOWARD THE AMERICANS. WE DON'T HAVE ANY PARTICULAR AFFINITY WITH THE RUSSIANS OR ANY BETTER MEMORIES OF THEM. IF THEY WANT TO INTERVENE IN OUR AFFAIRS DIRECTLY OR INDIRECTLY, WE WILL DEFINITELY RESIST. IF THEY DECIDE TO RESPECT OUR INDEPENDENCE AND OUR NATIONAL INTEREST, WE WILL HAVE MUTUAL RESPECT AND FRIENDLY RELATIONS WITH THEM." THEN YAZDI MADE AN ADDITIONAL POINT: THAT THERE IS A BASIC DIFFERENCE BETWEEN THE RUSSIANS AND THE WESTERN COUNTRIES, "WHICH WILL INFLUENCE OUR FOREIGN POLICY. THE RUSSIAN GOVERNMENT IS ATHEISTIC AND ANTIRELIGIOUS.

WE WILL DEFINITELY FIND IT MORE DIFFICULT TO HAVE A DEEP UNDERSTANDING WITH THE RUSSIANS. YOU ARE CHRISTIANS (SEC) AND BELIEVE IN GOD AND THEY DON'T. WE FEEL IT EASIER TO BE CLOSER TO YOU THAN TO RUSSIANS."
FOLLOWING THESE ANSWERS TO OUR QUESTIONS, YAZDI SAID HE WANTED TO MAKE THREE ADDITIONAL POINTS

KHOMEINI AND HIS PEOPLE ARE RECEIVING A COUNTRY ALMOST COMPLETELY DESTROYED, WAR-TORN EVEN. THE FIRST AND MOST IMPORTANT TASK IS TO RESTORE LAW AND ORDER, TO BRING PEACE, AND TO DEVELOP THE COUNTRY. THEREFORE IRAN WILL NOT PARTICIPATE IN ANY COLD WAR BETWEEN THE SUPER-POWERS, ANY REGIONAL GROUPING, OR ANY PROVOCATIVE POLICIES IN THE AREA. YAZDI DESCRIBED FUTURE IRANIAN POLICIES AS SOMETHING AMERICAN ISOLATIONISM; IRAN WOULD TURN INWARD AND CONCENTRATE ON ITS INTERNAL AFFAIRS. HE CONTRASTED THIS APPROACH WITH NASSER'S WHO MADE A BIG GAMBLE, AND -INSTEAD OF CONCENTRATING ON THE DEVELOPEMNT OF EGYPT -HAD MADE EXTERNAL PROPAGANDA. "WE CON'T AGREE WITH THAT.

IT'S NOT OUR JOB TO TELL THE SAUDI ARABIAN OR THE TURKISH PEOPLE TO REVOLT AGAINST THEIR GOVERNMENTS. IF THEY WANT TO GET RID OF THEIR OWN CORRUPTION, THEY MUST DO IT THEMSELVES."& BM IN FOREIGN POLICY, "WE'RE FOR DETENTE TO REDUCE AND EVENTUALLY ELIMINATE TO THE EXTENT POSSIBLE THE INTERNATIONAL COLD WAR AND TENSIONS AMONG NATIONS."
FOREIGN POLICY WILL BE BASED ON SEEKING SOLUTIONS FOR REGIONAL OR INTERNATIONAL CONFLICTS THROUGH NEGOTIATIONS AND THROUGH THE UNITED NATIONS.

AFTER CONCLUDING HIS ANSWERS TO OUR FOUR QUESTIONS, YAZDI ASKED ZIMMERMANN TO CONVEY TO USG YAZDI'S WILLINGNESS TO PROVIDE ANY ELABORATION, CLARIFICATION, OR EXTRA DETAIL THAT THE USG WANTED. IN ADDITION, YAZDI SAID TO LET HIM KNOW IF THERE WERE ANY OTHER AREAS WE WANTED COVERED.

ZIMMERMANN THEN MADE THE EXPRESSION OF CONCERN AS PER STATE 14490: YAZDI'S RESPONSE IS CONTAINED IN PARIS 1993. YAZDI THEN REMARKED THAT, IN THE CONTEXT OF CONTACTS WITH THE ARMY, OUR ANSWER CONCERNING THE IRANIAN MILITARY'S ORIENTAIION (REFTEL, PARA 7B) HAD "PAVED THE WAY A LITTLE." ZIMMERMANN ASKED HIM WHAT HE MEANT. HE SAID THAT USG ANSWER HAD "MADE IT CLEAR TO US" THAT THE ARMY SEES THAT IT CANNOT RESTORE THE SHAH OR HIS SON OR HIS MONARCHY, THAT IT HAS ACCEPTED THAT FACT, AND THAT ITS INTEREST IS IN PRESERVING ITS OWN INTEGRITY.

ZIMMERMANN RESPONDED THAT THOSE CONCLUSIONS HAD NOT OF COURSE BEEN SET OUT IN THE ANSWER WE HAD GIVEN HIM. YAZDI SAID HE UNDERSTOOD THAT, BUT FELT THAT HIS CONCLUSIONS WERE JUSTIFIED ON THE BASIS OF WHAT WE HAD TOLD HIM.

AFTER HAVING SENT US A NOTE JANUARY 18 STATING THAT AMBASSADOR HAD RESIGNED AND HIS RESIGNATION ACCEPTED BY FOREIGN MINISTRY, IRANIAN EMBASSY (HOMAYOUN) TELEPHONED URGENTLY THIS MORNING TO SAY THAT PRIME MINISTER HAD TOLD HIM THAT ZAHEDI'S RESIGNATION WAS NOT REPEAT NOT ACCEPTED. HOMAYOUN UNDERSTOOD THAT ZAHEDI WOULD BE RETAINED AS AMBASSADOR FOR AT LEAST ONE MONTH.
ANY CLARIFICATION YOU CAN PROVIDE WOULD BE APPRECIATED.

WE HAVE BEEN CONCERNED AT THE APPARENT WILLINGNESS/ ABILITY OF BOTH THE PUBLIC AND PRIVATE SECTORS TO CONTINUE TO PAY EMPLOYEES THROUGHOUT ALL THE STRIKES AND SHUT-DOWNS. WOULD APPRECIATE YOUR ANALYSIS OF THE ECONOMIC AND, ESPECIALLY, THE POLITICAL IMPACT OF A WIDESPREAD BREAKDOWN IN PAYROLL DISBURSEMENTS. WHAT IS THE LIKELIHOOD OF SUCH AN EVENT? WHAT IS THE TYPICAL TIMING AND FREQUENCY OF PAYDAYS? FOR EXAMPLE, WHEN MIGHT THE FIRST NON-PAYDAY OCCUR FOR GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES NOW THAT OIL RECEIPTS HAVE DRIED UP? VANCE

1.KNOWLEDGEABLE DEFENSE CONTRACTOR REP WHO RECENTLY RETURNED FROM IRAN DESCRIBED FOR DEPOFFS SUBSTANTIAL DEGREE OF DISCORD AMONG SENIOR IIAF OFFICERS. REP THOUGHT THERE WAS GROWING FEELING THAT GENERAL RABII DID NOT MEASURE UP TO HIS JOB. MANY OFFICERS WHO WERE AGGRIEVED WHEN HE WAS JUMPED OVER THEM FOR COMMANDER'S JOB, SEEMED TO BE REINFORCED IN THEIR OPINIONS THAT HE WAS A POOR CHOICE. GENERAL AZERBAIZIN , NOTORIOUSLY A RIVAL OF RABII'SAND OTHER GENERALS RESENT HIS HIGH-HANDEDNESS, ESPECIALLY OFFICERS WHOSE CAREERS PARALLELED HIS UNTIL HIS RECENT PROMOTION. ONE CLOSE FRIEND OF RABII, GENERAL MERMAND, TAC COMMANDER AT SHIRAZ,WAS LIKELY TO LOSE HIS JOB BECAUSE OF INCOMPETENCE.

CONTRACTOR REP ALSO NOTED INCREASE IN ANTI-AMERICANISM AMONG SOME OFFICERS. HE THOUGHT THAT HOMAFARS AND OTHERS WHO HAD LITTLE DIRECT CONTACT WITH AMERICANS TENDED TO BE MORE ANTI-AMERICAN THAN OTHERS WHO WORKED CLOSELY WITH U.S. PERSONNEL.

ACCORDING TO REPRESENTATIVE, GENERAL TOUFANIAN'S FUTURE IS VERY UNCERTAIN AND HE IS OPERATING UNDER A HEAVY CLOUD OF CHARGES OF CORRUPTION. IN REP'S OPINION, GENERAL TAVAKOLI WAS ASSUMING MORE AND MORE AUTHORITY IN TOUFANIAN'S OFFICE AND WAS, IN EFFECT, RUNNING THE OPERATION.

REP SAID HIS FIRM CONTINUED TO BE PAID BY GOI BECAUSE IIAF HAD HAD THE FORESIGHT TO PREPOSITION A LARGE SUM OF MONEY FOR DIRECT COMMERCIAL CONTRACT PAYMENTS OUTSIDE OF IRAN PRIOR TO DIFFICULTIES WITH THE CENTRAL BANK. VANCE

(S) ENTIRE TEXT
WE DO NOT URGE YOU TO RESPOND TO HIS QUESTION IN REFTEL. HOWEVER, IF YOU FEEL IT IS NECESSARY TO KEEP THE DIALOGUE GOING, YOU MAY RESPOND AS FOLLOWS.

IN USING THE PHRASE "OTHER SIGNIFICANT ELEMENTS IN TEHRAN" OUR CONCERN IS THAT DECISIONS ABOUT IRAN'S POLITICAL PROCESS BE AS BROADLY BASED AS POSSIBLE SO AS TO ASSURE THE MAXIMUM STABILITY. IT WILL BE UP TO IRANIANS THEMSELVES TO IDENTIFY KEY PARTICIPANTS IN THIS PROCESS.

IN VIEW OF CURRENT ECONOMIC AND POLITICAL CONDITIONS, EXIMBANK, WITH THE DEPARTMENT OF STATE'S CONCURRENCE, HAS TAKEN THE FOLLOWING ACTIONS WITH REGARD TO ITS PROGRAMS IN IRAN. THESE ACTIONS ARE NOT INTENDED AS DISAPPROVAL OF THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT, BUT RATHER TO MINIMIZE POTENTIAL LOSSES BY EXIMBANK AND U.S. EXPORTERS. NEW REQUESTS FOR ASSISTANCE UNDER BOTH DIRECT CREDIT AND SUPPLIER CREDIT PROGRAMS WILL BE DISCOURAGED AT THIS TIME. IN ADDITION, EXIMBANK WILL BE TAKING THE FOLLOWING ACTIONS WITH REGARD TO EXISTING COMMITMENTS. THEY ARE EXPECTED TO HAVE THEIR GREATEST IMPACT ON SUPPLIER CREDIT PROGRAMS WHICH ARE ALMOST EXCLUSIVELY CONCENTRATED IN IRAN.S PRIVATE SECTOR.

WITH REGARD TO THE SUPPLIER CREDIT PROGRAMS, EXIMBANK HAS WITHDRAWN ALL AUTHORITY PREVIOUSLY DELEGATED TO COMMERCIAL BANKS, U.S. EXPORTERS AND THE FOREIGN CREDIT INSURANCE ASSOCIATION (FCIA) TO COMMIT EXIMBANK COVERAGE ON SHORT- AND MEDIUM-TERM TRANSACTIONS IN IRAN. THIS MEANS THAT ALL TRANSACTIONS MUST BE SUBMITTED TO EXIMBANK YOR ITS CONSIDERATION. AT PRESENT, GUARANTEE AND INSURANCE COMMITMENTS WITH POTENTIAL EXIMBANK EXPOSURE OF $48.7 MILLION ARE AVAILABLE TO COVER NEW SHIPMENTS TO IRAN. EXIMBANK WILL REVIEW EACH INSURANCE POLICY OR GUARANTEE WITH THE U.S. EXPORTER, AND, ON A CASEBY-CASE BASIS, MAY WITHDRAW COVERAGE. EXPORTERS WILL BE ENCOURAGED NOT TO SHIP, AS WELL AS TO TAKE OTHER ACTIONS TO MINIMIZE LOSSES.
WITH REGARD TO THE DIRECT LENDING PROGRAM, EXIMBANK HAS TAKEN THE FOLLOWING ACTIONS

THE PRELIMINARY COMMITMENTS (PCS) OUTSTANDING ON SIX PROJECTS IN IRAN WITH TOTAL POTENTIAL NEW BANK EXPOSURE OF TOTAL $599.0 MILLION WILL BE ALLOWED TO EXPIRE. REQUESTS FOR EXTENSIONS WILL BE DISCOURAGED.
NO ACTION WILL BE TAKEN ON THE PENDING LOAN APPLICATION FROM IRAN AIR YOR FIVE BOEING 747 AIRCRAFT. IRAN AIR SHOULD APPROACH EXIMBANK WHEN COUNTRY CONDITIONS HAVE IMPROVED.

NO ACTION WILL BE TAKEN ON EXIMBANK CREDIT NO. 6559 WHICH WAS AUTHORIZED ON SEPTEMBER 20, 1978 FOR THE NATIONAL IRANIAN STEEL INDUSTRIES CORPORATION (NISIC). A DRAFT CREDIT AGREEMENT WAS SUBMITTED IN OCTOBER TO NISIC AND THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT FOR REVIEW. COMMENTS HAVE NOT BEEN RECEIVED BY EXIMBANK.

THE ONLY EXIMBANK CREDIT NOT FULLY DISBURSED AT THIS TIME IS EXIMBANK CREDIT NO. 6818 FOR HOLYACRYL IRAN CORPORATION. IF REQUESTED, EXIMBANK WILL DISBURSE THE REMAINING BALANCE OF $1.5 MILLION IN ACCORDANCE WITH NORMAL PROCEDURES.
EXIMBANK WILL CONTINUE TO MONITOR CLOSELY THE SITUATION IN IRAN AND AS CONDITIONS WARRANT RE-EVALUATE THE ACTIONS DESCRIBED ABOVE.

IF REQUESTED, EXIMBANK AND THE DEPT. OF STATE WILL PROVIDE THE FOLLOWING EXPLANATION OF EXIMBANK'S POLICY ON IRAN: "IN VIEW OF CURRENT CONDITIONS IN IRAN, WITH RELIABILITY OF DELIVERIES UNCERTAIN AND FOREIGN EXCHANGE TRANSACTIONS DIFFICULT, THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS HAS WITHDRAWN DELEGATED AND DISCRETIONARY AUTHORITIES HELD BY U.S. COMMERCIAL BANKS, U.S. EXPORTERS, AND THE FOREIGN CREDIT INSURANCE ASSOCIATION TO PRECOMMIT EXIMBANK SUPPORT ON SALES TO IRAN FOR THE PRESENT TIME. ALL FUTURE APPLICATIONS WILL BE SUBJECT TO EXIMBANK REVIEW ON A CASE-BY-CASE BASIS. "THIS INTERIM POLICY IS OCCASIONED SOLELY BY THE PRESENT UNSETTLED ECONOMIC SITUATION IN IRAN. IT WILL BE KEPT UNDER CONSTANT REVIEW.

IT SHOULD NOT BE INTERPRETED AS REFLECTING UPON EITHER THE EXPORT-IMPORT BANK'S ANALYSIS OF IRAN'S LONG-TERM CREDITWORTHINESS OR THE CONTINUING U.S. SUPPORT OF THE (IRANIAN GOVERNMENT'S) EFFORTS TO BRING ECONOMIC AND POLITICAL STABILITY TO THE COUNTRY."

WE UNDERSTAND THAT KHOMEINI'S AIDE, SADIGH GHOTBZADEH, WILL VISIT THE U.S. NEXT WEEK ARRIVING MONDAY OR TUESDAY. WE BELIEVE HE HAS BEEN INVITED TO A SESSION AT THE NATIONAL PRESS CLUB. ONE OF THE NETWORK SUNDAY NEWS INTERVIEW SHOWS ALSO MAY BE CONSIDERING AN INVITATION TO HIM. WE BELIEVE HIRC MEMBERS WILL INVITE HIM TO A PRIVATE MEETING WITH MEMBERS AND STAFF.
WOULD APPRECIATE YOUR VIEWS, SHOULD GHOTBZADEH REQUEST A MEETING WITH THE EXECUTIVE BRANCH, AS TO ADVISABILITY OF RECEIVING HIM AND APPROPRIATE LEVEL FOR RECEIVING HIM.
(C) ENTIRE TEXT.
DOES EMBASSY HAVE ANY INFORMATION ON THIS INDIVIDUAL WHO IS SAID TO BE THE PRINCIPAL OF SEVERAL RELIGIOUS SCHOOLS AND A KEY FIGURE IN THE ORGANIZATION OF RELIGIOUS
GIVEN REPORTS THAT KHOMEINI NOW PLANS TO RETURN "WITHIN A FEW DAYS," WE WISH YOUR ASSESSMENT OF LIKELY DEVELOPMENTS AND OUR ROLE IN THEM IN CASE THE AYATOLLAH SHOULD, IN FACT, GO BACK.

MANY APPARENTLY EXPECT THAT, IF HE DECIDES TO RETURN, HE WILL DECLARE A "REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL" AND POSSIBLY A PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT. SOME OF HIS ADVISERS MAY ASSUME THAT BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT AND REGENCY COUNCIL WILL COLLAPSE UPON SUCH A DECLARATION. WHILE COOLER HEADS MAY PREVAIL, WE REALIZE WE CANNOT ELIMINATE THIS POSSIBILITY FROM OUR THINKING.
WHAT IS YOUR BEST ESTIMATE AT THE MOMENT OF LIKELIHOOD THAT KHOMEINI WILL RETURN AND STEPS HE IS LIKELY TO TAKE?
POSSIBILITY THAT BAKHTIAR CAN AVOID CONFRONTATION WITH KHOMEINI?
POSSIBILITY THAT OTHERS, UNENTHUSIASTIC ABOUT KHOMEINI, SUCH AS ALI AMINI AND POSSIBLY SANJABI, MIGHT ASSIST BAKHTIAR IN ANY WAY IN PREVENTING CONFRONTATION?
REACTION OF MILITARY IN EVENT OF POLITICAL CONFRONTATION? (WE REALIZE FROM YOUR 1016 THAT THIS IS DIFFICULT TO PREDICT. WE WOULD LIKE YOUR BEST GUESS.)
WE TAKE NOTE OF PRIME MINISTER'S SUGGESTION WE APPROACH KHOMEINI DIRECTLY. WE ARE DOUBTFUL HERE THAT DIRECT APPROACH WOULD EITHER CHANGE HIS INTENTIONS OR MAKE HIM MORE AMENABLE TO OUR INTERESTS.

WE ARE ALSO CONSCIOUS OF WEAKNESS OF BOTH BAKHTIAR AND MILITARY, BUT IT SEEMS CLEAR FROM VARIOUS REPORTS THAT THERE ARE A NUMBER OF PROMINENT IRANIANS WHO SHARE OUR FEELING THAT BOTH BAKHTIAR AND MILITARY SHOULD CONTINUE IN THEIR CURRENT ROLES AS LONG AS POSSIBLE.

AS FOR STATEMENTS, YOU REALIZE THAT, WITH INTENSE PUBLIC AND CONGRESSIONAL INTEREST IN IRAN, WE CANNOT AVOID COMMENT. WE ARE CERTAINLY AWARE OF THE FRAGILITY OF THE SITUATION, BUT WE WISH, AT SAME TIME, TO AVOID SIGNALS WHICH COULD IMMEDIATELY BE INTERPRETED HERE AND IN TEHRAN, (PARTICULARLY BY MILITARY) AS WITHDRAWAL OF SUPPORT. VANCE

AMERICAN PROFESSOR WHO HAS KNOWN GHOTBZADEH FOR YEARS TELLS US THAT IN THE PAST TWO YEARS HIS POSITION IN KHOMEINI ENTOURAGE APPEARS TO HAVE CHANGED. FORMERLY, GHOTBZADEH WAS CLEARLY THE DOMINANT PERSONALITY, TO WHOM YAZDI SHOWED DEFERENCE. DURING THE PAST TWO YEARS, HOWEVER, THE TWO MEN HAVE SEEMED ABOUT EQUAL IN RANK AND STATURE.

PROFESSOR DESCRIBED GHOTBZADEH'S POLITICAL PHILOSOPHY AS LEFT OF CENTER, STRONGLY ANTI-COMMUNIST. SINCE HIS STUDENT DAYS IN THE US, GHOTBZADEH HAS HAD A CONSPIRATORAL/ REVOLUTIONARY OUTLOOK. OVER THE PAST TWO YEARS, THOUGH, HE HAS APPEARED MORE DISCIPLINED AND LESS PRONE TO SHOOT FROM THE HIP WITH WILD IDEAS.

GHOTBZADEH HAD GOOD RELATIONS WITH BOUMEDIENNE AND ARAFAT. HE ALLEGEDLY DESPISES THE IRAQIS AND ADMIRES ASSAD. HE WAS CLOSE TO MUSA SADR AND INVOLVED IN SHIA AFFAIRS IN LEBANON. HIS RELATIONS WITH QADAFFI HAVE BEEN AN ON-AND-OFF AFFAIR.
GHOTBZADEH APPEARS TO BE GENERALLY RESPECTED BY THE KHOMEINI GROUP (BEHESHTI AND BARZARGAN) IN TEHRAN.
FINALLY, DEPARTMENT HAS RECEIVED SEVERAL CALLS FROM NASIR AFSHAR REGARDING GHOTBZADEH'S PROSPECTIVE VISIT TO THE U.S. WE ARE DECLINING TO DEAL THROUGH INTERMEDIARIES.

BELL HELICOPTER OFFICIAL DESCRIBED FOR US TODAY "DISINTEGRATING" SITUATION IN ISFAHAN AND TEHRAN HELICOPTER UNITS. HE CHARACTERIZED DISCIPLINE AMONG MILITARY ENLISTED MEN AS "ONLY FAIR." ABSENTEEISM AMONG LOW-RATED ENLISTED MEN AT ISFAHAN IS RUNNING 30-50 PERCENT, HE ESTIMATED. GENERAL KHOSROWDAD VISITED ISFAHAN 2 DAYS AGO TO APPEAL TO SOLDIERS TO URGE THEIR BUDDIES TO RETURN TO THEIR JOBS. HIS APPEAL HAD LITTLE EFFECT. BELL OFFICIAL SAID ANTI-AMERICAN SENTIMENT AMONG MILITARY PERSONNEL APPEARS TO BE INCREASING DAILY.
THE TEHRAN LOGISTICS DEPOT WORKERS HAVE GONE ON STRIKE, MAKING FOUR DEMANDS REPLACEMENT OF THE GENERAL OFFICER WHO SERVES AS MANAGING DIRECTOR
CONVERSION OF THE DEPOT TO A COMMERCIAL FIRM WITH NO LINKS TO THE MILITARY INDUSTRIES ORGANIZATION THE DEPARTURE OF ALL US TECHNICIANS

CANCELLATION OF THE 5-YEAR CONTRACT UNDER WHICH IRANIAN EMPLOYEES ARE HIRED. BELL OFFICIAL SAID HE WAS UNABLE TO ASSESS EXTENT OF EMPLOYEE PARTICIPATION IN THE STRIKE, BUT IT APPEARED TO BE VERY WIDESPREAD IN THE DEPOT.
THERE ARE PERVASIVE RUMORS THAT THERE WILL BE INSUFFICIENT FUNDS TO MEET THE NEXT MONTHLY PAY FOR SOLDIERS AND CIVILIANS ASSIGNED TO HELICOPTER UNITS.

BELL CURRENTLY HAS 2718 EMPLOYEES AND 1300 DEPENDENTS IN IRAN. THEY PLAN TO REDUCE OPERATIONS TO 2000 EMPLOYEES BY THE END OF FEBRUARY. PRESENTLY, THERE ARE FULL-SCALE OPERATIONS AT KERMANSHAH, 50 PERCENT OPERATIONS IN ISFAHAN, AND ONLY 20 PERCENT OPERATIONS IN TEHRAN. THE LOW LEVEL OF ACTIVITY IN TEHRAN IS EXPLAINED BY THE STRIKE OF IRANIAN WORKERS AND THE FAILURE OF THE MANAGING DIRECTOR TO PROVIDE TRANSPORTATION FOR BELL EMPLOYEES. VANCE

A PROFESSOR ARMANJANI (RETIRED IRANIAN-AMERICAN LIVING IN CALIFORNIA) HAS BEEN IN TOUCH WITH HOSSEIN GOLI SHAMLU, AN IRANIAN WHO IN TURN IS IN TOUCH WITH SECULAR OPPOSITION PEOPLE WORKING WITH THE KHOMEINI ORGANIZATION. WORD FROM SHAMLU IS THAT KHOMEINI'S REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL WILL INCLUDE BARZAGAN AND EX-GENERAL GHARANI. GENERAL GHARANI WAS COURT-MARTIALLED 22 YEARS AGO ON A "TRUMPED UP" CHARGE OF COUP PLOTTING. APPARENTLY HE WAS REHABILITATED AND ONLY 2 MONTHS AGO THE SHAH SENT A PRIVATE MESSAGE TO HIM TO TAKE OVER THE ARMED FORCES. HE REFUSED.

GHARANI WHO IS MOVING FROM HOUSE TO HOUSE, FEARFUL OF SAVAK, WISHES TO BE IN TOUCH WITH THE EMBASSY. HE CAN BE REACHED THROUGH A CONTACT AT TELEPHONE NUMBER 626999. WE GAVE ARMANJANI NAME OF GEORGE LAMBRAKIS AS PERSON WHO MIGHT MEET WITH GHARANI. WE LEAVE TO EMBASSY'S DISCRETION WHETHER IT IS DESIRABLE TO PURSUE THIS APPROACH. GHARANI ALLEGEDLY WISHES TO ASSURE THE EMBASSY THAT HE AND HIS MOVEMENT ARE PRO-WEST AND ANTI-SOVIET. VANCE
