1979STATE018152.subject: (U) SITUATION IN IRAN - IMPLICATION FOR THE UAE

segments.text: (S-ENTIRE TEXT)

BEGIN SUMMARY: AMBASSADOR MET JANUARY 20 WITH UAE FORMIN SUWAIDI TO REVIEW OUR ASSESSMENT OF CURRENT SITUATION IN IRAN. DRAWING ON SAUNDERS' STATEMENT TO HIRC AND OTHER PUBLIC USG STATEMENTS, AMBASSADOR STRESSED USG IN CONTACT WITH PRINCIPAL ELEMENTS IN IRAN TO TRY FIND WAYS OF WORKING OUT PEACEFUL SOLUTION THAT WILL ALLOW RESUMPTION OF NORMAL LIFE AND PROMOTE MOVEMENT TOWARD NEW NATIONAL CONSENSUS. DECISIONS ON IRAN'S FUTURE HAVE TO BE MADE BY IRANIANS AND NO OUTSIDE GOVERNMENT SHOULD SEEK TO INTERFERE.

AMBASSADOR THEN SUMMED UP AS BEST HE UNDERSTOOD THEM STRENGTHS AND WEAKNESSES OF EACH OF NON-COMMUNIST POLITICAL GROUPINGS ACTIVE IN IRAN -- ARMY, NATIONAL FRONT, RELIGIOUS LEADERS, AND BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT -AND NOTED THAT NO ONE OF THESE WILL HAVE EASY TIME ESTABLISHING ITS AUTHORITY.

IN UNUSUALLY CANDID RESPONSE SUWAIDI COMMENTED THAT WHAT IS HAPPENING IN IRAN IS OBJECT LESSON TO UAE SHAIKHS AND TO OTHER TRADITIONAL LEADERS IN GULF. TIMES AND PEOPLES' ASPRIATIONS HAVE CHANGED BUT SOME RULERS ARE CONTINUING TO RULE AS THEY DID 20 YEARS AGO. HE STRESSED THAT NOW IS TIME TO BE VERY FRANK WITH UAE RULERS, TELLING THEM THEY MUST COME TO AN AGREEMENT ON FEDERATION ISSUES, TAKE THEIR DUTIES MORE SERIOUSLY, AND BEGIN TO REGARD UAE'S OIL INCOME AS "PATRIMONY OF THEIR PEOPLE" RATHER THAN PERSONAL REVENUES. SUWAIDI SAID THAT HE IS TRYING TO TELL THIS TO RULERS HIMSELF AND HE HOPED USG WILL DO SO AS WELL.
AMBASSADOR SAID HE WOULD REPORT MINISTER'S REMARKS TO USG AND WOULD AGAIN SEEK MAKE KNOWN HERE AS FORCEFULLY AS POSSIBLE OUR SUPPORT FOR FEDERATION. END SUMMARY.

AS HE HAD REQUESTED (REF A), I MET WITH UAE FOREIGN MINISTER AHMAD SUWAIDI ON JANUARY 20 FOR A LENGTHY REVIEW OF EVENTS IN IRAN. BEFORE MAKING MY REMARKS, I GAVE SUWAIDI THE TEXT OF ASSISTANT SECRETARY SAUNDERS' STATEMENT OF JANUARY 17 (REF B), PRESIDENT CARTER'S PRESS CONFERENCE OF JANUARY 17 DEALING WITH IRAN, AND COPY OF JANUARY 14 ARTICLE THAT APPEARED IN NEW YORK TIMES WRITTEN BY MARVIN ZONIS OF UNIVERSITY OF CHICAGO (TRANSMITTED AS USINFO 151917Z JAN 79).
LATTER STRUCK ME AS EXCELLENT REVIEW OF UNFOLDING OF CRISIS AND SEEMED RESPONSIVE TO SUWAIDI'S EARLIER QUESTION TO ME OF WHY SUCH DISSATISFACTION HAD EMERGED IN SUCH AN ORGANIZED WAY SO RAPIDLY.

AFTER NOTING THAT EVENTS WERE STILL MOVING VERY RAPIDLY IN IRAN, THAT WIDESPREAD STRIKES AND DEMONSTRATIONS HAD BROUGHT THE IRANIAN ECONOMY TO A HALT, AND THAT MANY PEOPLE WERE NOW UNEMPLOYED AND SUFFERING FROM SHORTAGES, I SAID USG'S TWO MOST IMMEDIATE OBJECTIVES WERE A RESTORATION OF ORDER TO ALLOW A RESUMPTION OF NORMAL ECONOMIC LIFE AND MOVEMENT TOWARD A NEW NATIONAL CONSENSUS. I SAID USG HAD BEEN IN CONTACT WITH LEADERS OF FOUR PRINCIPAL ELEMENTS IN IRAN -- MILITARY, NATIONAL FRONT, SUPPORTERS OF KHOMEINI, AND BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT -- TO TRY AND FIND WAYS OF WORKING OUT PEACEFUL SOLUTION. US HAD STRONG AND CONTINUING INTEREST IN FREE, STABLE AND INDEPENDENT IRAN.
DECISIONS ON IRAN'S FUTURE HAVE TO BE MADE BY IRANIANS THEMSELVES AND NO OUTSIDE GOVERNMENT SHOULD SEEK TO INTERFERE.

WHETHER IRAN SHOULD REMAIN A CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCHY WAS UP TO IRANIANS TO DECIDE. OUR OBJECTIVE THROUGHOUT THE CRISIS HAD BEEN TO ENSURE THE MAXIMUM OF STABILITY IN A TIME OF CHANGE BY PRESERVING THE INSTITUTIONAL FRAMEWORK OF IRAN UNDER ITS CONSTITUTION. SINCE A NEW CIVILIAN GOVERNMENT UNDER PRIME MINISTER BAKHTIAR HAD BEEN NAMED ALONG WITH A REGENCY COUNCIL, US BELIEVED NEW GOVERNMENT SHOULD BE GIVEN EVERY CHANCE TO RECONCILE THE DIFFERENCES IN IRAN AND WORK OUT PEACEFUL SOLUTION. WE HOPED UAE WOULD USE ITS INFLUENCE TO SUPPORT A RETURN TO ORDER IN IRAN.
TO SUWADI'S QUESTION WHETHER THE TUDEH WAS ASSOCIATED WITH KHOMEINI, I SAID THAT WE BELIEVED RELIGIOUS INSTITUTIONS AND THE MILITARY REMAINED FIRMLY ANTICOMMUNIST.

TURNING TO SUWAID'S QUESTION ABOUT EXISTING POLITICAL GROUPINGS IN IRAN, I SAID I DID NOT HAVE SPECIFIC RESPONSE FOR HIM FROM THE DEPARTMENT BUT WOULD GIVE HIM MY PERSONAL IMPRESSIONS. WITH THE SHAH HAVING LEFT IRAN AS WELL AS MOST FOREIGNERS, THERE WERE REMOVED THOSE ASPECTS WHICH MOST UNITED IRANIANS OPPOSED TO PAHLEVI RULE. DIVISIONS WERE BOUND TO ARISE AGAIN AS WE HAD SEEN DURING THE JANUARY 17 RIOTS IN AHWAZ, SKIRMISHES WITH KURDISH REBELS ON IRAN'S BORDERS WITH IRAQ, AND THE APPARENT POLITIZATION OF LABORERS WHO WERE SEEKING HIGHER WAGES (OR EMPLOYMENT).

FOR EACH OF PRESENT POLITICAL GROUPINGS (OUTSIDE OF TUDEH) THERE SEEMED TO BE AT LEAST ONE MAJOR WEAKNESS. THE NATIONAL FRONT LACKED A MASS FOLLOWING AND A SYMBOLIC LEADER. THE ARMY APPEARS TO BE WEAKENED BY THE DEPARTTURE OF SOME OF ITS LEADERS AND SEEMED TO BE FINDING IT MORE DIFFICULT TO MAINTAIN DISCIPLINE AMONG ITS LARGELY CONSCRIPT TROOPS. THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT IS FACED WITH THE OPPOSITION OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI AND HIS FOLLOWERS. FINALLY, WHILE RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP APPEARS FOR THE MOMENT TO BE STRONGEST ELEMENT IN IRANIAN POLITICAL FABRIC, IT HAS NO KNOWLEDGE OF STATECRAFT OR HOW TO RUN A COUNTRY.

BASED ON 10 POINTS ISSUED PREVIOUS DAY BY KHOMEINI'S FOLLOWERS AT END OF MASS DEMOSTRATIONS IN TEHRAN, I SAID IT APPEARED THAT KHOMEINI WOULD CONTINUE TO SUPPORT DEMONSTRATIONS AND STRIKES TO REPLACE THE REGENCY COUNCIL WITH HIS ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL AND TO TRY AND UNDERMINE MORALE AND UNITY OF ARMY TO BRING IT UNDER HIS INFLUENCE. RESTORING NORMAL LIFE IN IRAN WOULD BE VERY DIFFICULT UNDER THESE CIRCUMSTANCES AND IRAN'S ETHNIC MINORITIES COULD BECOME MORE ASSERTIVE.

TO SUWAIDI'S QUESTION HOW EVENTS COULD HAVE COME ABOUT SO QUICKLY AND BE SO WELL ORGANIZED, I REFERRED TO CAUSES OUTLINED IN ASSISTANT SECRETARY SAUNDERS' STATEMENT. ALSO FELT HE NEEDED RECALL EVENTS SURROUNDING KHOMEINI EXILE. FOLLOWING 1962/63 DEMONSTRATIONS ARISING FROM SHAH DISTRIBUTION OF LAND HELD BY ABSENTEE LANDLORDS AS WELL AS BY WAQFS, SHIA CLERGY HAD FELT THREATENED. KHOMEINI HAD BEEN FORCED TO LEAVE FOR TURKEY AND LATER TO IRAQ WHERE HE MAINTAINED HIS OPPOSITION. RELIGIOUS ESTABLISHMENT WAS ONLY ORGANIZED OPPOSTION APPARATUS WITH WHICH OTHER ELEMENTS OPPOSING SHAH COULD ASSOCIATE.

WHEN AFTER 16 YEARS OF EXILE IN IRAQ, KHOMEINI HAD BECOME A POLITICAL EMBARRASSMENT TO BAATHI AND LARGELY SUNNI REGIME IN BAGHDAD FEARFUL THAT GROWING RELIGIOUS OPPOSITION IN IRAN COULD SPILL OVER INTO LARGE SHIA POPULATION OF IRAQ, KHOMEINI HAD BEEN EXPELLED. BY FORCING KHOMEINI TO LEAVE LAST OCTOBER TO FRANCE, IRAQIS HAD ONLY MADE MATTERS WORSE. KHOMEINI NOW HAD ACCESS TO WESTERN MEDIA AND OVERNIGHT HAD BECOME A HOUSEHOLD WORD THROUGHOUT THE WORLD.

SUWAIDI RESPONDEDTHAT FROM HIS VANTAGE POINT, IT APPEARED THAT NO ONE IN IRAN COULD COMPETE AGAINST KHOMEINI. ONLY FEASIBLE OPPOSITION WAS THE MILITARY. HE DOUBTED THAT KHOMEINI AND THE ARMY COULD REACH ACCOMMODATION. TURNING TO WHAT HE SAW TO BE IMPLICATIONS OF SITUATION IN IRAN FOR UAE, HE PROCEEDED MAKING FOLLOWING INSIGHTFUL OBSERVATIONS: --A) WHAT WAS HAPPENING IN IRAN AFFECTED ALL THE GULF AREA. HE VERY MUCH AGREED WITH MR. SAUNDERS' STATEMENT THAT IRAN HAD BEEN THROUGH A RAPID PERIOD OF GROWTH AND SOCIAL CHANGE IN LAST 15 YEARS AND PEOPLE MOST AFFECTED ARE DEMANDING A GREATER VOICE. THE SAME APPLIED TO UAE.

INHABITANTS OF UAE AND GULF REGION GENERALLY ARE NOT SAME PEOPLE THAT LIVED HERE 50 YEARS AGO, EVEN 10 YEARS AGO. THEY HAVE SEEN A GREAT CHANGE IN THEIR ECONOMY FROM BEING VERY POOR TO SUDEENLY BEING VERY RICH. ONCE UNEDUCATED, MANY ARE BECOMING EDUCATED AND THEY ARE ASKING TO PARTICIPATE. "THEY WILL NOT REMAIN QUIET TO SEE THEIR AFFAIRS HANDLED BY INDIVIDUAL LEADERS." Z --B) UNFORTUNATELY, MANY OF THE RULERS IN UAE DO NOT RECOGNIZE THIS. THEY BELIEVE THEY ARE RULING EMIRATES STILL LIKE THOSE THEY RULED 20 YEARS AGO.

WHAT IS GOING ON IN IRAN WILL IMPACT ON THEM REGARDLESS OF WHO COME TO POWER THERE -- RIGHT OR LEFT. HE THOUGHT IT WAS VERY IMPORTANT TO BE VERY FRANK WITH THE RULERS, PARTICULARLY WITH UAE PRESIDENT SHAIKH ZAYID AND DUBAI'S RULER SHAIKH RASHID. THEY HAD TO COME TO AN AGREEMENT ON FEDERATION ISSUES, OTHERWISE THE POWER THEY NOW HOLD COULD BE TAKEN AWAY FROM THEM BY UAE'S INHABITANTS. HE FELT THAT HE AND SEVERAL OF OTHER MINISTERS HAD PERSONAL RESPONSIBILITY TO TELL THEM THIS.

HE DID NOT WANT RULERS SOME DAY TO BLAME THEIR MINISTERS, AS SHAH HAD DONE, FOR NOT HAVING TOLD THEM WHAT PEOPLE THINK. --C) SUWAIDI SAID HE HAD PREVIOUSLY TOLD THE SHAIKHS THAT IT WAS WRONG TO LEAVE THE COUNTRY TO INDULGE IN SPORTS ESPECIALLY AT THIS TIME. WORLD WAS CHANGING AND THEY HAD TO PROVE THAT THEY COULD LEAD AND TAKE ON RESPONSIBILITIES. ALSO IT WAS NO LONGER ACCEPTABLE FOR EACH RULER TO CONSIDER THAT INCOME FROM HIS PARTICULAR EMIRATE WAS HIS OWN.

IT WAS "PATRIMONY OF PEOPLE." WHILE IN CASE OF EMIRATE OF ABU DHABI, 95 PERCENT OF EARNINGS COME TO GOVERNMENT AND GOOD PORTION OF THIS IS DISTRIBUTED THROUGH THE FEDERAL BUDGET OR ABU DHABI BUDGET, IT WAS NOT "IDYLLIC." ALL INCOME RECEIVED BY FEDERATION SHOULD BE THE "PATRIMONY OF THE PEOPLE." --D) AS FOREIGN MINISTER AND SCION OF AN OLD ABU DHABI FAMILY, HE MET WITH PEOPLEFROM ALL WALKS OF LIFE IN UAE EVERY DAY. HE THOUGHT UAE PUBLIC TRULY WANTS FEDERATION TO WORK.

AT SAME TIME, PEOPLE WANT TO KNOW HOW THEIR NATIONAL INCOME IS SPENT AND WANT TO ESTABLISH PERMANENT REPRESENTATIVE INSTITUTIONS. "THEY WANT A GREATER OPPORTUNITY TO PARTICIPATE." --E) SUWAIDI THOUGHT TIME HAD COME TO WARN THE SHAIKHS. OTHERWISE THEY COULD NOT REMAIN AS LEADERS.

THINKING OUT LOUD, HE SAID "NOW IS THE TIME TO TELL THE RULERS THAT IF THE SHAH WAS THE STRONGEST LEADER IN THE GULF REGION AND HE COULD NOT HOLD ON, HOW DO THEY EXPECT TO REMAIN." IF THEY DO NOT ACT TO RESOLVE DIFFERENCES OVER FEDERAL INSTITUTIONS, UNFRIENDLY OUTSIDE ELEMENTS WILL TAKE ADVANTAGE OF THESE WEAKNESSESS. "THEY ARE LEADERS BUT NOT ACTING AS LEADERS AND WE WANT THIS ADVICE TO REACH THEM BEFORE IT IS TOO LATE."

AT END OF HIS COMMENTS, SUWAIDI HOPED THAT USG WOULD BE EQUALLY FRANK IN CONVERSATIONS WITH RULERS. US HAS VITAL INTERESTS IN ARABIAN PENINSULA AND PERSIAN GULF AND THIS MESSAGE HAS TO BE CONVEYED NOT ONLY TO RULERS IN UAE BUT ALSO TO RULERS IN OTHER STATES IN PENINSULA. "STRONG ADVICE IS NEEDED NOW, OTHERWISE BOTH OF US WILL SUFFER." I TOLD SUWAIDI THAT I WOULD REPORT HIS COMMENTS AND WOULD AGAIN SEEK TO MAKE KNOWN OUR VIEWS IN SUPPORT OF UAE FEDERATION AS FORCEFULLY AS POSSIBLE WHEN I SEE ZAYID AND RASHID.

COMMENT: I HOPE MY PERSONAL COMMENTS ON IRAN WERE NOT TOO FAR OFF MARK BUT BELIEVE SOME RESPONSE TO QUESTIONS EARLIER POSED BY SUWAIDI WAS NECESSARY. I FOUND HIS COMMENTS ABOUT UAE MOST FRANK I HAVE EVERY HEARD. SUWAIDI IN PAST HAS BEEN ACCUSED BY SAUDIS AND BY CONSERVATIVE LOCAL SHAIKHS OF BEING A "BAATHI UNDER THE SKIN," BUT BELIEVE HE WAS REFLECTING HIS GENUINE FEELING OF NEED FOR GREATER UNITY IN FEDERATION AND FOR RULERS TO GIVE GREATER HEED TO WHAT ASPRIATIONS OF YOUNGER UAE GENERATION ARE LIKELY TO BE.
SUWAIDI INCIDENTALLY SAID THAT HE EXPECTED TO BE MAKING SOME OF THESE SAME POINTS WHEN PRESIDENT FORD VISITS NEXT WEEK.
DEPARTMENT: REPEAT TO EMBASSY TEHRAN AND OTHER NON-ADDRESSEE POSTS AS DESIRED. DICKMAN
GRUMMAN REPRESENTATIVE HAS PROVIDED US FOLLOWING UPDATE ON SUBJECT, WHICH WE ASSUME MIRRORS INFORMATION YOU HAVE. WOULD APPRECIATE ANY ADDITIONAL INFORMATION AS YOU GET IT.

WHEN GRUMMAN WORK BUSES ARRIVED AT KHATAMI AT 10 AM LOCAL TIME, JANUARY 23 THEY FOUND APPROXIMATELY 2 TO 5,000 DEMONSTRATORS ON THE BASE, LED BY HOMOFARS, DEMANDING TO SEE THE BASE COMMANDER. WHILE THE GRUMMAN WORKERS WAITED TO ENTER THE BASE THE COMMANDER MET WITH THE DEMONSTRATORS. THE GRUMMAN PERSONNEL COULD NOT HEAR THE EXCHANGE, BUT HEARD FREQUENT SHOUTS OF THE "YANKEE GO HOME" VARIETY.

GRUMMAN WORKERS WERE NOT THREATENED OR IN ANY WAY MISTREATED, BUT WERE NOT ALLOWED TO ENTER THE BASE AND RETURNED TO THEIR OFF-BASE HOUSING AREA. LOCAL GRUMMAN MANAGER REPORTS THAT THERE NOW SEEMS TO BE LITTLE POSSIBILITY OF AMERICAN WORKERS RETURNING TO THEIR JOBS. GRUMMAN NOW PLANS TO MOVE ITS PEOPLE OUT OF IRAN. THEY ARE HOPING TO TAKE ADVANTAGE OT "INTERNATIONAL SCHOOLS" FLIGHT IN THE NEXT DAY OR SO.

AS TO CONDITIONS ON THE BASE, THE GRUMMAN EMPLOYEES IN CHARGE OF PILOT TRAINING AT KHATAMI WERE TOLD BY A HOMOFAR FRIEND THAT WORD HAD COME FROM KHOMEINI THAT NO AIRCRAFT SHOULD BE ALLOWED TO BE REMOVED FROM THE BASE BUT THAT NO SABOTAGE SHOULD OCCUR OR PROPERTY BE DAMAGED. THIS SOURCE INDICATED THAT DISCONTENT AT KHATAMI IS BEING FED BY REFUSAL OF BANKS TO RELEASE FUNDS TO THE BASE FOR SALARIES AND OTHER EXPENSES.

GRUMMAN REPRESENTATIVE INDICATED THAT A MAJOR COMPANY CONCERN WAS FOR THE STATUS OF CLASSIFIED DOCUMENTS, FILES, AND MANUALS (MOST AT THE CONFIDENTIAL OR SECRET LEVEL). MANY AREAS ON THE BASE USED BY GRUMMAN NOW HAVE SIGNS READING "NO AMERICANS ADMITTED." VAULTS CONTAINING THESE FILES AND MANUALS ARE IN ONE SUCH AREA AND GRUMMAN PERSONNEL NO LONGER HAVE ACCESS TO THAT AREA OR THE VAULTS. THEY HAVE NO INDICATION THAT VAULTS HAVE IN ANY WAY BEEN TAMPERED WITH,BUT HAVE NO WAY OF CHECKING ON THEIR STATUS.
REFERENCE: TEHRAN 1118
WE HAVE INSTRUCTED ZIMMERMAN TO PASS MESSAGE AS AMENDED BY PRIME MINISTER IN TEHRAN 1119.

THERE IS NO DECISION ONE WAY OR THE OTHER AT THIS POINT ON OUR POSITION WITH RESPECT TO BAKHTIAR'S PLAN OF ACTION. THERE SHOULD BE NO REACTION OR COMMENT UNTIL FURTHER INSTRUCTIONS ARE RECEIVED. WE ANTICIPATE YOU WILL RECEIVE FURTHER GUIDANCE TOMORROW (JANUARY 24).
WE ARE THROUGH OUR OWN CHANNELS DISCOURAGING THE SHAH'S RETURN. YOU MAY SO INFORM BAKHTIAR. VANCE
REPRESENTATIVES OF THE AMERICAN JEWISH COMMUNITY HAVE EXPRESSED SERIOUS CONCERN TO DEPARTMENT OVER THE FUTURE OF THE JEWS OF IRAN.

IN VIEW OF THE POSSIBILITY THAT AN EMERGENCY SITUATION COULD DEVELOP SUDDENLY WITH RESPECT TO THE IRANIAN JEWISH COMMUNITY, AS WELL AS FOR OTHER MINORITIES, POST IS REQUESTED TO FOLLOW DEVELOPMENTS IN THIS AREA CLOSELY, AND KEEP US INFORMED. VANCE

1979STATE019260.subject: (LOU) FINANCE MINISTRY APPARENTLY ASKED FOR DEBT RELIEF WITHOUT INTERMINISTERIAL CLEARANCES

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY: THE FINANCE MINISTER RECENTLY SENT A CIRCULAR NOTE REQUESTING DEBT RELIEF TO A NUMBER OF DONORS, INCLUDING MULTILATERAL FINANCIAL BODIES AND THE USSR, BUT REPORTEDLY WITHOUT INFORMING THE FOREIGN MINISTRY (OR CENTRAL BANK). THIS MAY BE AN EXAMPLE OF NAIVETE ON THE FINANCE MINISTRY'S PART, OR IT COULD BE A SUBTLE WAY OF RAISING THE ISSUE WITHOUT "OFFICIALLY" DOING SO. ASIDE FROM THE DRA'S CONCERN THAT PAST "ROTTEN " REGIMES HAVE SADDLED THE NOW "SCIENTIFICALLY PURE" AFGHAN GOVERNMENT WITH A HUGE FOREIGN DEBT SERVICING BURDEN, WHAT SEEMS TO HAVE PROMPTED THE FIN MIN'S NOTE NOW WAS AN INQUIRY FROM THE WEST GERMAN EMBASSY.

THE LATTER HAD INDICATED TO THE DRA A WILLINGNESS TO FORGIVE PAST DEBTS BUT WANTED TO KNOW CERTAIN OTHER DONORS' ATTITUDE TOWARD DEBT RELIEF. UNCTAD RESOLUTIONS CALLING FOR DEBT RELIEF FOR LDC'S MAY HAVE BEEN ANOTHER FACTOR. END SUMMARY.

ON JAN. 17, EMBOFF CALLED ON MOHAMMED NAZIR HOBAB, DEPUTY DIRECTOR, BILATERAL ECONOMIC RELATIONS DIVISION, MFA, TO INQUIRE INFORMALLY AS TO THE BACKGROUND OF THE FINANCE MINISTER'S RECENT NOTE REQUESTING DEBT RELIEF (REFTEL). HOBAB INDICATED THAT HE HAD NOT HEARD OF SUCH A NOTE AND COMMENTED THAT THE FINANCE MINISTRY APPEARED TO HAVE GONE OFF HALF-COCKED AGAIN. (HABOB EXPLAINED THAT THAT MINISTRY HAD PREVIOUSLY SENT AN UNFORTUNATE NOTE TO SOME OTHER UNNAMED EMBASSY WHICH CAUSED THE MFA CONSIDERABLE EMBARRASSMENT.)

ASKED WHETHER OUR EMBASSY WOULD CONSIDER THE FIN MIN'S NOTE AS "OFFICIAL," HABOB REPLIED THAT WE DID NOT HAVE TO BUT THAT WE COULD IF WE WANTED TO. O (COMMENT: HABOB'S BOSS, DEPUTY FONMIN DOST, HAD EARLIER ALERTED EMBOFF THAT SUCH A NOTE FROM THE FINANCE MINISTRY WAS EN ROUTE. HABOB'S DISCLAIMER OF KNOWLEDGE OF THE NOTE MAY BE TRUE, BUT IT MAY ALSO DISGUISE A DRA EFFORT TO SOULD OUT CREDITOR NATIONS ABOUT DEBT RELIEF WITHOUT "OFFICIALLY" BROACHING THE SUBJECT.)

HABOB OPINED THAT WHAT MAY HAVE PROMPTED THE FIN MIN NOTE WAS THE LATTER'S HOPE THAT FRIENDLY CREDITOR NATIONS, SUCH AS THE U.S., WOULD GO ALONG WITH UNCTAD RESOLUTIONS CALLING FOR THE CONVERSION OF LDC'S PAST DEBTS INTO GRANTY. HABOB NOTED THAT BOTH THE U.K. AND CANADA HAD INFORMED THE MFA THAT THEY WOULD UNILATERALLY FORGIVE AFGHANISTAN'S PAST DEBT. MOREOVER, HE CONTINUED, WEST GERMANY HAD INDICATED THAT IT WAS INCLINED TO CHANGE ITS PAST LOANS TO GRANTS, BUT THAT THE GERMANS HAD ALSO INQUIRED AS TO WHAT THE USG PLANNED TO DO IN THIS REGARD. IN ANY CASE, HABOB PROMISED TO RAISE THE FINMIN NOTE WITH HIS DEPUTY MINISTER.

EMBOFF ASKED HABOB ALSO TO INQUIRE ABOUT WHETHER ALL DONOR COUNTRIES RECEIVED SUCH A NOTE. HABOB UNDERTOOK TO DO SO. EMBOFF COMMENTED THAT HE COULD NOT GIVE AN OFFICIAL USG REACTION TO THE FINMIN'S REQUEST, BUT OPINED THAT THE EXIMBANK'S RECENT AGREEMENT TO FINANCE A DC-10 PURCHASE MIGHT NOT HAVE BEEN GRANTED ON THE FINAL TERMS REACHED IF THE EMBASSY HAD RECEIVED SUCH A REQUEST EARLIER.

ON JAN. 21, RAINER SCHLAGETER, ATTACHE, WEST GERMAN EMBASSY, CALLED ON EMBOFF TO INQUIRE WHETHER WE HAD RECEIVED A COMMUNICATION FROM THE FINANCE MINISTRY ABOUT DEBT RELIEF. EMBOFF TOLDLIM OF MOST OF THE FOREGOING. SCHLAGETER COMMENTED THAT BONN HAD INSTRUCTED HIS EMBASSY TO INFORM THE DRA THAT THE FRG WOULD CONSIDER FORGIVING AFGHANISTAN'S PAST DEBT (ABOUT DM 240 MILLION), BUT THAT BONN WISHED TO KNOW FROM THE DRA THE ATTITUDE OF OTHER DONORS, SPECIFICALLY INCLUDING THE US AND THE USSR, ON THE FORGIVENESS OF AFGHANISTAN'S DEBTS TO THOSE NATIONS. SCHLAGETER SAID HE WOULD ALSO INQUIRE OF THE SOVIETS ABOUT THIS MATTER. EMBOFF ASKED TO BE INFORMED OF THE SOVIETS' RESPONSE.
SCHLAGETER SUBSEQUENTLY REPORTED THAT HE WOULD INFORM BONN RE THE REPERCUSSIONS THAT THE WEST GERMAN INQUIRY CAUSE.

DURING THE COURSE OF A JAN. 20 CONVERSATION WITH THE BRITISH AMBASSADOR AND DCM, AMBASSADOR DUBS INQUIRED WHETHER THE BRITISH HAD RECEIVED SUCH A NOTE. THEY REPLIED THAT THEY HAD NOT, BUT NOTED THAT THE UK HAD INFORMED AFGHANISTAN A YEAR AGO THAT IT WOULD FORGIVE PAST DEBTS (AMOUNTING TO ABOUT ONE MILLION POUNDS). CURRENT BRITISH AID, WHICH THEY SAID AMOUNTS TO SIX MILLION POUNDS OVER THE NEXT TWO YEARS OR SO, IS ON A GRANT BASIS.

ON JAN. 21, THE DCM RAISED THIS QUESTION WITH DR. HAKIM, PRESIDENT OF DA AFGHANISTAN BANK, THE CENTRAL BANK. HAKIM SAID THAT THE DCM WAS THE FIRST TO TELL HIM OF THE FONMIN NOTE. DCM COMMENTED THAT, HAD THIS NOTE BEEN RECEIVED EARLIER, IT MIGHT HAVE TORPEDOED THE AFOREMENTIONED EXIMBANK LOAN.

THE DCM ALSO LEARNED FROM HIS JAPANESE COUNTERPART, NAKASAGA, THAT UPON RECEIPT OF THE FINMIN NOTE, NAKASAGA HAD ASKED THE DEPUTY MINISTER OF FINANCE WHO ELSE HAD RECEIVED THE FINMIN NOTE. THE LATTER REPLIED: IBRD, ADB, OPEC FUND, USSR, CZECHOSLOVAKIA, BULGARIA, YUGOSLAVIA, CHINA, USA, UK, DENMARK, IRAN, SAUDI ARABIA, IRAQ AND KUWAIT. (COMMENT: THE CHINESE CHARGE TOLD DCM, HOWEVER, THAT HIS EMBASSY HAS NOT YET RECEIVED THE FINMIN NOTE, AND AS NOTED ABOVE, THE BRITISH SAY THEY HAVE NOT RECEIVED THAT NOTE.)

WE UNDERSTAND THAT THE LOCAL WORLD BANK REPRESENTATIVE, JAMES THEODORES, RETURNED HIS COPY OF THE NOTE TO THE FINMIN SAYING THAT THE IBRD IS A BANK WHO LENDS MONEY PROVIDED BY VARIOUS MEMBER COUNTRIES AND CANNOT, AS SUCH, FORGIVE PAST LOANS.

COMMENT: PENDING RECEIPT OF INSTRUCTIONS (REQUESTED REFTEL), WE HAVE NOT APPROACHED THE FINANCE MINISTRY DIRECTLY REGARDING ITS NOTE. ON THE BASIS OF THE COMMENTS WE HAVE RECEIVED FROM THE ABOVE-LISTED SOURCES, WE BELIEVE THAT THE FINANCE MINISTRY HAS PROBABLY ACTED PRECIPITOUSLY OUT OF A NOT UNNATURAL DESIRE TO AVOID PUTTING OUT MONEY TO SERVICE PAST DEBTS WHEN SUCH DEBTS MIGHT SOON BE FORGIVEN. MOREOEVER, AS NOTED IN 78 KABUL 7059, PRIMIN TARAKI HAD CRITICIZED THE PREVIOUS REGIME LAST JULY FOR HAVING BUILD UP A HUGE DEBT WHICH THE PRESENT KHALQI REGIME MUST SERVICE.

(SEE ALSO 78 KABUL 7384 FOR FONMIN AMIN'S VIEWS.) THERE HAS BEEN NO SUGGESTION, HOWEVER, THAT THE DRA IS INCAPABLE OF SERVICING ITS FOREIGN DEBTS. THE FINMIN PRESUMABLY HOPES THAT ALL CREDITOR NATIONS WILL ABIDE BY THOSE UNCTAD RESOLUTIONS WHICH CALL FOR SUCH DEBT RELIEF. IT IS OUR VIEW THAT WE NEED NOT RESPOND FOR THE TIME BEING TO THE FINMIN'S NOTE IF IT WOULD BE MORE CONVENIENT FROM THE USG'S VIEWPOINT NOT TO DO SO. HOWEVER, THE USG SHOULD BALUY XNX GLOO RESPOND IN THE EVENT THAT THERE IS A FOLLOWUP FROM THE DRA ON THIS MATTER. BDUBS

WHEN YOU NEXT SEE YAZDI, PLEASE TELL HIM THAT CONTRARY TO THE STATEMENT HE MADE TO THE PRESS, U.S. HAS NOT RPT NOT TAKEN ANY STEPS WHATSOEVER TO REMOVE F-14S FROM IRAN. WE HAVE NOT WITHDRAWN ANY OF THE MILITARY EQUIPMENT PREVIOUSLY

WITH REFERENCE TO YOUR TELEGRAM, WE REAFFIRM OUR CONFIDENCE IN BAKHTIAR AND HIS ASSOCIATES. WE WILL DO OUR BEST TO KEEP THE SHAH AWAY. REGARDING KHOMEINI'S RETURN, WE HAVE URGED HIM NOT TO DO SO. HOWEVER, THE MATTER IS UP TO THE IRANIANS, ALTHOUGH WE BELIEVE IT IS BEST FOR KHOMEINI NOT TO RETURN TO IRAN AND THEREFORE TO AVOID A CONFRONTATION.

AMERICAN INTERNATIONAL COMPANIES U.S. OFFICE HAS BEEN UNABLE TO GET THROUGH TO MESSRS. KEN NOTTINGHAM AND JACK KEOGH OF THEIR AFFILIATE IN IRAN, THE IRAN-AMERICA INTERNATIONAL INSURANCE CO. THESE GENTLEMEN ARE STAYING AT THE HOLIDAY INN IN TEHRAN AND REPORTEDLY MET WITH AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN RECENTLY.
AMERICAN INTERNATIONAL WOULD APPRECIATE EMBASSY ASSISTANCE IN CONTACTING NOTTINGHAM AND KEOGH AND ARRANGING FOR THEIR USE OF MAC TRANSPORTATION IF COMMERCIAL TRANSPORTATION

PLS ASCERTAIN FROM GOF WHETHER AN AIR FRANCE CHARTER FLIGHT WILL BE AVAILABLE FOR AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI TO TRAVEL TO TEHRAN. IF A CHARTER WILL BE AVAILABLE, PLS PROVIDE ESTIMATED TIME OF DEPARTURE AND ARRIVAL. SHOULD OTHER MEANS OF TRAVEL BECOME KNOWN, PLS ADVISE. WE NEED THIS INFORMATION BY OOB JANUARY 25. PLEASE USE FLASH PRECEDENCE.
FOR ZIMMERMAN: PLS ADVISE US WHETHER MESSAGE TRANSMITTED THROUGH FREEMAN IS CONSIDERED A BONA FIDE MESSAGE
S--ENTIRE TEXT.

ZIMMERMANN DELIVERED MESSAGE TO YAZDI AT 1100 AM LOCAL JANUARY 24. ZIMMERMANN WENT THROUGH MESSAGE WORDFOR-WORD AND YAZDI TOOK IT DOWN VERBATIM IN FARSI. YAZDI HAD ONLY ONE QUESTION: AFTER ZIMMERMANN HAD READ FIRST SENTENCE OF PARA (C), YAZDI ASKED WHAT WE MEANT BY THAT. ZIMMERMANN SAID HE COULD NOT GO BEYOND THE TEXT.
YAZDI THEN EXPRESSED THE FOLLOWING VIEWS, WHICH HE CHARACTERIZED AS PERSONAL VIEWS, BUT BASED ON VIEWS KHOMEINI HAD EXPRESSED IN PREVIOUS MESSAGES.
YAZDI SAID THAT KHOMEINI STILL PLANS TO RETURN TO IRAN FRIDAY MORNING, THAT IT IS NOT UNCONSTITUTIONAL FOR KHOMEINI TO GO BACK, AND THAT BAKHTIAR HAD SAID HE COULD GO BACK.

YAZDI CONTINUED THAT, IF ANYTHING HAPPENS, THE KHOMEINI CAMP IS NOT CONCERNED ABOUT THE TUDEH, WHICH YAZDI DESCRIBED AS "INCONSIDERABLE." THE MAIN CONCERN IS THE MILITARY. YAZDI SAID: "IT IS INCONCEIVABLE FOR US THAT ANY MILITARY MOVE OR ACTION AGAINST THE PEOPLE COULD BE TAKEN WITHOUT AMERICAN APPROVAL OR AN AMERICAN GREEN LIGHT. ANY ACTIONS BY THE ARMY AGAINST THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT WILL BE SEEN IN THE EYES OF IRANIANS AS ACTIONS BY THE USG AGAINST THE MOVEMENT."

AS FOR THE CONSTITUTION, YAZDI CONTINUED, WHAT KHOMEINI HAS SAID REGARDING HIS PLANS TO ANNOUNCE A PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT IS NOT AGAINST THE PRESENT CONSITUTION, WHICH PROVIDES THAT AUTHORITY COMES FROM THE NATION; THE NATION IS SOVEREIGN. THE CONSTITUTION IS CLEAR THAT AUTHORITY IS FROM THE PEOPLE; IT IS THROUGH A DELEGATION PROCESS THAT DIFFERENT BRANCHES OF GOVERNMENT, INCLUDING THE MONARCHY, CAN FUNCTION. THE WHOLE NATION HAS EXPRESSED ITS OPINIONS AND ITS VOTES AGAINST THE SHAH AND HAS FORCED HIS DEPARTURE.

THE WHOLE NATION HAS EXPRESSED ITS VIEW THAT THE REGENCY COUNCIL IS ILLEGAL, THE PARLIAMENT IS ILLEGAL, SO THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT IS ILLEGAL." YAZDI SAID THAT, "AS YOU KNOW," THE CHAIRMAN OF THE REGENCY COUNCIL, TEHRANI, HAS RESIGNED FROM THE COUNCIL AND FROM THE PRESIDENCY OF THE COUNCIL AND HAS STATED THAT HE REGENCY COUNCIL IS ILLEGAL.

FURTHERMORE, YAZDI WENT ON, "OUR PEOPLE" HAVE GIVEN A VOET OF CONFIDENCE TO KHOMEINI AND TO HIS POLITICAL PLAN TO END THE TURMOIL. SO, BASED ON THIS AUTHORITY, WHICH IS WITHIN THE CONSTITUTION, KHOMEINI IS APPOINTING A PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT IN ORDER TO END THE PRESENT TURMOIL AND CRISIS AND TO NORMALIZE THE LIFE OF THE NATION THROUGH HOLDING NEW ELECTIONS AND THEN TRANSFERRING POWER TO THE ELECTED MEMBERS. WHEN ASKED, YAZDI SAID THAT THRERE WAS NO TIME-FRAME FOR THE "PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT," BUT THAT KHOMEINI WOULD PROBABLY ANNOUNCE THE PRIME MINISTER AT THE TIME OF HIS ARRIVAL IN TEHRAN.
YAZDI SAID THAT ONE REASON WHY KHOMEINI HAS SCHEDULED HIS RETURN AS SOON AS POSSIBLE IS THE "CONVICTION WE HAVE THAT HE AND ONLY HE CAN END THE TURMOIL AND BRING BACK NORMAL LIFE TO THE COUNTRY."

YAZDI CONCLUDED BY SAYING THAT, AS PRESIDENT CARTER HAS SAID AND THE USG MESSAGE TODAY CONFIRMS, THE USG IS SUPPORTING THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT, WHICH IS ILLEGAL AND UNPOPULAR. "WE HOPE, BASED ON THE CONTENT OF YOUR MESSAGE, THAT YOU WILL CEASE TO SUPPORT THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT.: HARTMAN

1979STATE020161.subject: (S) SADAT ON THE SHAH AND IRANIAN SITUATION

segments.text: (S - ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY. SADAT SAYS SHAH IS OFFENDED AND BITTER AT TREATMENT FROM U.S. ADMINISTRATION. HE HAS INVITED SHAH AND SHAHBANOU TO RETURN TO EGYPT, WHICH THEY PLAN TO DO. SHAH DID NOT CONTACT IRANIAN MILITARY OR SECURITY FORCES FROM ASWAN, BUT WILL BE ABLE MONITOR IRANIAN SITUATION MORE CLOSELY FROM CAIRO AND ASSESS HOW IT IS EVOLVING. SADAT URGES THAT USG ALLOW SHAH TO KEEP ALL HIS OPTIONS OPEN. HE ALSO EXPRESSES CONCERN OVER STORY TOLD HIM BY THE SHAH THAT USG HAS ASKED IRANIAN AIR FORCE CHIEF BLOW UP ANY SOPHISTICATED U.S. MILITARY EQUIPMENT THAT MAY BE ENDANGERED IF INTERNAL SECURITY SITUATION DETERIORATES.

HE RECALLED HIS EARLIER OFFER TO PROVIDE STORAGE FACILITIES IN EGYPT FOR ANY SUCH EQUIPMENT. HE VIEWS IRANIAN MILITARY MACHINE AS MAJOR FACTOR FOR STABILITY IN AREA AND URGES THAT WE MAINTAIN CLOSE CONNECTION WITH IT. HE ALSO WANTS A LINK TO IRANIAN ARMY THROUGH US. END SUMMARY.
MOST OF MY TWO HOUR MEETING OF TODAY WITH SADAT AND VP MUBARAK DEALT WITH THE SHAH AND THE IRANIAN SITUATION AND ITS IMPLICATIONS. WITH FREQUENT REPETITIONS, SADAT MADE FOLLOWING POINTS

IN HIS MANY TALKS WITH THE SHAH IN ASWAN, THE PRESIDENT HAD GAINED THE CLEAR IMPRESSION THAT THE SHAH BELIEVES HE WAS BADLY TREATED BY THE ADMINISTRATION. VARIOUS THINGS SAID AND DONE BY PRESIDENT CARTER AND SENIOR ADMINISTRATION SPOKESMEN HAD DEEPLY OFFENDED THE SHAH. SHAH IS BITTER. I SAID THAT THIS WAS SURPRISING SINCE THE CARTER ADMINISTRATION, LIKE ITS PREDECESSORS, HAS STRONGLY SUPPORTED THE SHAH AND LOOKS UPON HIM AS THE CONSTITUTIONAL LEADER OF THE COUNTRY. THE ADMINISTRATION HAS, IN FACT, RECEIVED SOME CRITICISM FROM CRITICS OF THE SHAH IN THE U.S. FOR THE DEGREE OF ITS SUPPORT. ADMINISTRATION SPOKESMEN HAVE REPEATEDLY STATED THAT SHAH IS WELCOME IN U.S.
SADAT INDICATED AWARENESS OF THIS FACT, BUT REITERATED THAT THE SHAH FEELS HE HAS BEEN ILL-TREATED BY THE ADMINISTRATION. HE GAVE NO DETAILS.

SADAT NOTED THAT HE HAS INVITED THE SHAH AND SHAHBANOU TO RETURN TO EGYPT AND REMAIN HERE FOR AS LONG AS THEY WOULD LIKE. HE UNDERSTANDS THAT, RATHER THAN PROCEED TO U.S., THEY WILL RETURN TO EGYPT IN THE NEXT DAY OR TWO. WHILE IN ASWAN, DESPITE THE URGINGS OF THE SHAHBANOU THAT THE SHAH SEEK TO RESUME CONTACTS WITH THE IRANIAN MILITARY AND SECURITY FORCES, THE SHAH HAD NOT ATTEMPTED TO MAKE ANY SUCH CONTACTS. THE SHAH HAD SAID THAT HE HAD GIVEN HIS WORD NOT TO DO SO AND HE INTENDED TO HONOR IT.

THE SHAH'S RETURN TO CAIRO, SADAT COMMENTED, WILL ENABLE HIM TO BE CLOSER TO IRAN AND TO ASSESS MORE ACCURATELY HOW THE IRANIAN SITUATION IS EVOLVING. SADAT AVOIDED ANY SUGGESTION OF GOE ASSISTANCE TO THE SHAH TO REGAIN HIS POSITION. IN FACT, THE PRESIDENT EMPHASIZED THAT HE PERSONALLY DID NOT KNOW WHETHER OR NOT THE SHAH WILL BE ABLE TO RETURN TO IRAN. HE CONSIDERED IT IMPORTANT, HOWEVER, THAT THE USG ALLOW THE SHAH TO KEEP ALL OF HIS OPTIONS OPEN AND, AS SADAT PUT IT, "NOT SLAM THE DOOR IN HIS FACE."

RECALLING HIS EARLIER OFFER TO PROVIDE STORAGE FACILITIES IN EGYPT FOR ANY MILITARY EQUIPMENT WHICH WE MIGHT WISH TO TAKE OUT OF IRAN (CAIRO'S 394), SADAT SAID THAT HE HAD BEEN DISTURBED TO HEAR FROM THE SHAH THAT CONSIDERATION IS BEING GIVEN TO DESTROYING SOME SUCH EQUIPMENT. THE SHAH HAD TOLD HIM IN CONFIDENCE THAT THE USG HAS A VERY CLOSE RELATIONSHIP WITH THE IRANIAN ARMED FORCES, AND ESPECIALLY WITH THE IRANIAN AIR FORCE. HE EXPRESSED FULL CONFIDENCE IN THE COMMANDER OF THE IRANIAN AIR FORCE.

ACCORDING TO THE SHAH, THE USG HAS ASKED (GIVEN ORDERS) TO THE COMMANDER OF THE IRANIAN AIR FORCE TO BLOW UP ANY SOPHISTICATED MILITARY EQUIPMENT THAT MAY BE ENDANGERED IF THE INTERNAL SECURITY SITUATION DETERIORATES STILL MORE. IF IT IS TRUE THAT USG WANTS SUCH EQUIPMENT DESTROYED, SADAT SAID THIS MAKES LITTLE SENSE. HE HAD OFFERED TO STORE ANY SUCH EQUIPMENT AND THAT OFFER STILL STANDS. SUCH EQUIPMENT WOULD BE USEFUL HERE. IF USG IS NOT IN A POSITION TO MAKE IT AVAILABLE TO GOE AT THIS TIME, IT COULD BE HELD FOR A MORE PROPITIOUS MOMENT.

SADAT THEN ALLUDED TO THE IRANIAN MILITARY MACHINE. IT HAD BEEN BUILT UP AND TRAINED LARGELY BY THE USG. IT HAS BEEN A FORCE FOR STABILITY IN THE AREA. IT IS ESSENTIAL, HE CONTENDED, THAT A WAY BE FOUND TO KEEP IT IN THAT CAPACITY. THE CLOSE USG CONNECTION WITH THE IRANIAN MILITARY SHOULD BE MAINTAINED AND HE, SADAT, ALSO WANTS A LINK TO THE IRANIAN ARMY THROUGH US. HE HAD NOT TOLD THIS TO THE SHAH.

HE EMPHASIZED THAT HE WAS NOT PLOTTING ANYTHING, BUT HOPED THAT WE MIGHT PUT ACROSS TO THE IRANIAN MILITARY LEADERSHIP THAT SADAT BELIEVES THE DESTINY OF IRAN AND EGYPT, AS FACTORS FOR STABILITY IN THE AREA, REQUIRES COOPERATION AND MUTUAL UNDERSTANDING.

I TOLD SADAT THAT HE COULD BE SURE THAT WE SHARE HIS CONCERN OVER THE IRANIAN SITUATION. WE ARE FOLLOWING IT CLOSELY AND AT THE HIGHEST LEVELS. I WAS SORRY THAT THE SHAH FEELS THAT HE HAS BEEN ILL-TREATED, BUT SADAT SHOULD KNOW THAT WE CONTINUE TO REGARD THE SHAH AS THE CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCH. I ACKNOWLEDGED THAT WE HAVE LONG HAD CLOSE RELATIONS WITH IRANIAN MILITARY LEADERS. WHILE I HAD NO DETAILS, I THOUGHT HE COULD BE SURE THAT WE SHARE HIS VIEW THAT EVERYTHING POSSIBLE SHOULD BE DONE TO INSURE THAT THE IRANIAN MILITARY REMAINS A STABILIZING ELEMENT IN THE AREA.

AS FOR THE SHAH, I REITERATED THAT WE REGARD HIM AS CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCH OF IRAN AND THOUGHT THAT NO ONE IS SEEKING TO FORECLOSE HIS OPTIONS. THE MATTER IS ONE FOR THE IRANIAN PEOPLE TO DECIDE. I EXPRESSED SOME SKEPTICISM OVER THE STORY THAT ORDERS HAD BEEN GIVEN FOR THE IRANIAN AIR FORCE TO DESTROY U.S. MILITARY EQUIPMENT. I WOULD OF COURSE REPORT HIS COMMENTS AND LET HIM KNOW WASHINGTON'S REACTIONS.
SADAT WILL EXPECT SOME KIND OF A RESPONSE TO HIS DEMARCHE. PLEASE ADVISE WHAT THE DEPT WISHES ME TO TELL HIM.
DEPT MAY WISH REPEAT THIS MESSAGE TO TO TEHRAN. EILTS

THIS MORNING DEPARTMENT RECEIVED A NOTE FROM IRANIAN EMBASSY WITHDRAWING DIPLOMATIC STATUS FOR FOLLOWING STAFF MEMBERS: DJAFAR FAGHIH, BAGHER MOUSSAVI, MOHAMMAD AMERI-NAZARI, AND ALI KIOMARS AFZALI TAFRESHI. NOTE WAS FOLLOWED BY TELEPHONE CALL FROM AMBASSADOR ZAHEDI TO NEA/IRN (PRECHT). ZAHEDI ASKED DEPARTMENT'S ASSISTANCE IN ASSURING THAT 4 INDIVIDUALS DID NOT CREATE A PROBLEM FOR THE EMBASSY SHOULD THEY ATTEMPT TO ENTER THE PREMISES.

ZAHEDI'S CALL WAS FOLLOWED BY CALL FROM DCM HOMAYOUN WHO SAID THAT FOREIGN MINISTER MIRFENDERSKI HAD INSTRUCTED HIM BY TELEPHONE NOT TO KEEP THE 4 EMPLOYEES AWAY FROM THE EMBASSY AND NOT TO SEND A NOTE TO THE DEPARTMENT WITHDRAWING THEIR DIPLOMATIC STATUS. HOMAYOUN CONFESSED HE WAS IN A QUANDRY IN AS MUCH AS ZAHEDI REMAINS IN WASHINGTON UNTIL LATE TONIGHT.
WE TOLD HOMAYOUN TO LET THE MATTER REST AWHILE. WE WOULD APPRECIATE ANY LIGHT THE EMBASSY CAN PROVIDE. VANCE

PLEASE CONTACT YAZDI JANUARY 27. TELL HIM THAT INDIVIDUALS IN THE UNITED STATES, BOTH IN GOVERNMENT AND PRIVATE BUSINESS ARE BEING APPROACHED BY PERSONS CLAIMING TO REPRESENT THE AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI IN AMERICA. IN SOME CASES THEY ARE SEEKING TO EXAMINE THE BOOKS OF AMERICAN COMPANIES. IN OTHERS, THEY ARE CLAIMING TO REPRESENT THE AYATOLLAH ON OFFICIAL MATTERS. WE FEEL THE AYATOLLAH SHOULD KNOW THIS. WE WOULD BE GLAD TO HAVE HIS ADVICE ON HOW WE SHOULD DEAL WITH THOSE WHO CLAIM TO BE SPEAKING FOR HIM.

FYI: THE FOREGOING APPROACH HAS THREE PURPOSES: (1) TO KEEP THE CHANNEL OPEN; (2) TO LEARN WHETHER THERE IS ANYONE REPRESENTING THE AYATOLLAH HERE; AND (3) TO GIVE YOU A CHANCE TO GET ANY FURTHER ASSESSMENT FROM YAZDI OF HOW THEY SEE THE CURRENT SITUATION. WE DO NOT WISH TO GIVE THE KHOMEINI GROUP THE IMPRESSION, HOWEVER, THAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR OR PREPARED TO RECEIVE ON ANY OFFICIAL BASIS HIS REPRESENTATIVE HERE. END FYI.

YAZDI GAVE ZIMMERMANN AT 1015 AM PARIS TIME JANUARY 27 A PERSONAL MESSAGE FROM KHOMEINI TO THE USG. IT IS THE FIRST FIRST-PERSON MESSAGE FROM KHOMEINI PASSED IN THE YAZDI-ZIMMERMANN CHANNEL. ZIMMERMANN HAD PROPOSED A MEETING WITH YAZDI ON THE BASIS OF REFTEL (WE REPORT YAZDI'S REACTION TO REFTEL IN SEPTEL); WHILE ZIMMERMANN WAS DRIVING OUT TO MEETING PLACE, YAZDI WENT TO SEE KHOMEINI; WHEN ZIMMERMANN ARRIVED, YAZDI GAVE HIM THE MESSAGE. YAZDI HAD APPARENTLY TAKEN IT DOWN VERBATIM IN FARSI FROM KHOMEINI; HE TRANSLATED IT WHILE READING IT TO ZIMMERMANN. KHOMEINI MESSAGE IS QUOTED BELOW; INTERPOLATIONS IN - ARE YAZDI'S RESPONSES TO ZIMMERMANN'S REQUESTS FOR CLARIFICATION.

BEGIN TEXT OF KHOMEINI MESSAGE. THE ACTIVITIES AND WORKS OF BAKHTIAR AND THE PRESENT LEADERS OF THE ARMY ARE NOT ONLY HARMFUL FOR IRANIANS BUT ALSO ARE VERY HARMFUL FOR THE AMERICAN GOVERNMENT, AND ESPECIALLY FOR THE FUTURE OF THE AMERICANS (YAZDI: THAT MEANS THE AMERICANS IN IRAN). THOSE ACTIVITIES MAY FORCE ME TO ISSUE NEW ORDERS IN IRAN. IT IS ADVISABLE THAT YOU RECOMMEND TO THE ARMY (YAZDI: THE ARMY AS A WHOLE, NOT JUST THE LEADERSHIP; WE DRAW A DISTINCTION BETWEEN THE TWO) NOT TO FOLLOW BAKHTIAR AND TO CEASE THESE ACTIVITIES. THE CONTINUATION OF THESE ACTIVITIES BY BAKHTIAR AND THE ARMY LEADERSHIP MAY BRING A GREAT DISASTER.

IF BAKHTIAR AND THE PRESENT ARMY LEADERSHIP STOP INTERVENING IN THE AFFAIRS (YAZDI: OF IRANIANS), WE WILL QUIET DOWN THE PEOPLE, AND THIS WILL NOT CREATE ANY HARM FOR THE AMERICANS. THESE KINDS OF ACTIVITIES AND BEHAVIOR (YAZDI: BY BAKHTIAR AND THE ARMY LEADERSHIP) WILL NOT BRING CALM OR STABILITY TO THE REGION. THE NATION WILL LISTEN TO ME AND, THROUGH MY COMMAND AND IMPLEMENTATION OF MY PLAN, STABILITY WILL COME.

WHEN I ANNOUNCE THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT, YOU WILL SEE THAT MANY OF THE POINTS WHICH ARE VAGUE WILL DISAPPEAR (YAZDI: KHOMEINI MEANS AREAS WHICH ARE FUZZY TO THE USG) AND YOU WILL SEE THAT WE ARE NOT REPEAT NOT IN ANY PARTICULAR ANIMOSITY WITH THE AMERICANS, AND YOU WILL SEE THAT THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC, WHICH IS BASED ON ISLAMIC PHILOSOPHY AND LAWS, IS NOTHING BUT A HUMANITARIAN ONE WHICH WILL BENEFIT THE CAUSE OF PEACE AND TRANQUILITY FOR ALL MANKIND. CLOSING DOWN THE AIRPORTS AND PREVENTING ME FROM GOING BACK TO IRAN WILL DISTURB FURTHER THE STABILITY, NOT ONLY FAILING TO STABLIZE THE SITUATION BUT EVEN DESTABILIZING IT FURTHER.

I HAVE BEEN ASKED BY FORCES FOLLOWING ME TO GIVE THEM PERMISSION TO GO AND OPEN THE AIRPORTS FOR MY RETURN (YAZDI: BY FORCE). HOWEVER, I HAVE NOT GIVEN SUCH PERMISSION. ALSO, ARMED FORCES FROM WITHIN THE MILITARY, AS WELL AS NON-MILITARY ARMED FORCES (YAZDI: FOR EXAMPLE, MILITIAS AND UNDERGROUND ARMED FORCES, ALL OF THEM WITHIN THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT), INCLUDING THE TRIBES, HAVE REQUESTED PERMISSION TO ACT AND END THE PRESENT SITUATION (YAZDI: THAT IS, TO FORCE BAKHTIAR AND THE MILITARY LEADERS OUT OF POWER). HOWEVER, I HAVE NOT GIVEN THEM THE PERMISSION YET.
I PREFER THAT THE PROBLEM BE SOLVED IN PEACE AND WITHOUT VIOLENCE OR BLOODSHED AND THAT THE DESTINY OF THE COUNTRY BE GIVEN TO THE NATION TO DECIDE. OF KHOMEINI MESSAGE.

ZIMMERMANN REQUESTED FURTHER CLARIFICATIONS. WHAT DID KHOMEINI MEAN BY THE "ACTIVITIES AND WORKS" OF BAKHTIAR AND THE ARMY LEADERSHIP? YAZDI SAID THAT THEY HAD CLOSED DOWN THE AIRPORTS FOR THREE DAYS AND NIGHTS. YESTERDAY THEY OPENED FIRE ON THE PEOPLE; AT LEAST 16 WERE KILLED IN TEHRAN, AND IN SANANDASH (PHONETIC) IN KURDISTAN, POLICE FORCES AND TROOPS HAVE ATTACKED CIVILIANS AND BURNED DOWN MANY HOUSES AND SHOPS. ALSO YESTERDAY AT LEAST A DOZEN DAILY PRESS JOURNALISTS WERE ARRESTED. THESE, SAID YAZDI, ARE EXAMPLES OF THE "ACTIVITIES AND WORKS" REFERRED TO.

ZIMMERMANN ASKED ABOUT THE DISTINCTION BETWEEN THE ARMY LEADERSHIP AND THE ARMY AS A WHOLE. YAZDI SAID THAT THE PRESENT ARMY LEADERSHIP IS ASSOCIATED WITH THE SHAH AND RESPONSIBLE FOR MANY OF THE MASSACRES, WHILE THE REST OF THE ARMY IS DIFFERENT AND IS EVEN SYMPATHETIC TO THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT.

ZIMMERMANN ASKED ABOUT THE REFERENCE TO THE APPOINTMENT OF THE "PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT"; WHAT "VAGUE" POINTS WOULD BE CLEARED UP? YAZDI SAID THAT, WHEN KHOMEINI ANNOUNCES THE MEMBERS OF THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT, "YOU WILL KNOW WHAT KIND OF PEOPLE YOU ARE DEALING WITH AND CAN TALK TO THEM IN AN OFFICIAL CAPACITY." YAZDI WENT ON: "IF KHOMEINI ANNOUNCES THAT ENGINEER BAZARGAN IS HEAD OF THE GOVERNMENT, YOU CAN TALK TO HIM OFFICIALLY AND BAZARGAN WOULD MAKE CLEAR WHAT IS VAGUE TO YOU. YOU HAVE IN MIND THAT COMMUNISTS OR SOME OTHERS WILL TAKE OVER THE COUNTRY. WHEN THE GOVERNMENT IS ANNOUNCED, YOU WILL SEE THAT NONE OF THIS IS CORRECT.
YOU WILL SEE THAT THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT IS CAPABLE OF BRINGING STABILITY. "

YAZDI THEN SAID THAT THE CLOSING DOWN OF THE AIRPORTS REPRESENTED A VERY SENSITIVE SITUATION. MILLIONS OF PEOPLE HAVE COME TO TEHRAN TO WELCOME THE AYATOLLAH. SINCE BAKHTIAR HAS SAID IN THE PAST THAT THE AYATOLLAH CAN COME TO IRAN ANYTIME HE WISHES AND SINCE THERE ARE PROBLEMS INSIDE WHICH COULD BE SOLVED ONLY IF HE GOES BACK, PREVENTING HIS RETURN TO IRAN HAS CREATED A "VERY EXPLOSIVE SITUATION; WE MAY HAVE A PROBLEM IN CONTROLLING THE TEMPER OF THE MILLIONS WHO HAVE POURED INTO TEHRAN."

ZIMMERMANN WKED YAZDI ABOUT KHOMEINI'S TRAVEL PLANS. YAZDI SAID THAT THE THREE-DAY AIRPORT CLOSURE ENDS SATURDAY AT MIDNIGHT, AND KHOMEINI HAD PLANNED TO DEPART PARIS AT 11:00 PM PARIS TIME SATURDAY NIGHT. HOWEVER, THE IRANIAN AUTHORITIES HAVE REFUSED LANDING PERMISSION SUNDAY MORNINGFOR THE AIR FRANCE CHARTER FLIGHT; APPARENTLY THEY WANT TO EXTEND THE CLOSING DOWN OF THE AIRPORTS. "WE WILL THEREFORE SUSPEND OUR PLAN. I DON'T KNOW YET WHAT THE AYATOLLAH WILL DECIDE.

IF THE GOVERNMENT SAYS THAT THE AIRPORTS ARE CLOSED FOR ANOTHER THREE DAYS WE WILL WAIT FOR ANOTHER THREE DAYS." (COMMENT: ZIMMERMANN WAS STRUCK BY THE CONTRAST BETWEEN YAZDI'S RELATIVELY RELAXED TONE HERE AND THE MORE OMINOUS TONE OF THE KHOMEINI MESSAGE.)

YAZDI THEN VOLUNTEERED THAT KHOMEINI'S PEOPLE ARE IN CONTACT WITH BAKHTIAR AND THE ARMY LEADERSHIP. BAKHTIAR SENT A LETTER WITH HIS ENVOY TO PARIS; THE AYATOLLAH DID NOT ACCEPT THE ENVOY BUT DID RECEIVE THE LETTER. IT DOES NOT CONTAIN ANYTHING NEW, ASKING ONLY THAT THE AYATOLLAH DELAY HIS RETURN TO IRAN. ZIMMERMAN ASKED: HOW LONG A DELAY? YAZDI SAID THE DELAY WAS UNSPECIFIED.

YAZDI THEN WENT ON THAT "OUR PEOPLE" HAVE TO SOLVE THE PROBLEM IN THE PRESENT CRISIS AND HAVE SUGGESTED A FORMULA TO BAKHTIAR. THIS FORMULA IS THAT BAKHTIAR EITHER COME TO PARIS OR BE PRESENT AT AIRPORT WHEN KOHEMEINI RETURNS AND SUBMIT HIS RESIGNATION TO KOHMEINI. KOMEINI WILL THEN AGREE TO RE-APPOINT HIM AS A MEMBER OF THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT IMMEDIATELY. "THIS, WE BELIEVE, WILL BE OF BENEFIT TO ALL PARTIES INVOLVED AND WILL ALSO GIVE A CHANCE TO BAKHTIAR TO GAIN BACK HIS POPULARITY AND POLITICAL DIGNITY AND BRING ALSO THE UNITY NECESSARY FOR THE FUTURE STABILITY OF IRAN.

WE THINK THAT THIS IS A TREMENDOUS CONCESSION THAT OUR PEOPLE IN IRAN HAVE MADE." YAZDI ADDED THAT BAZARGAN AND BEHESHTI HAVE BEEN INVOLVED IN THE NEGOTIATIONS AND ARE KHOMEINI'S AUTHORIZED REPRESENTATIVES TO CONDUCT THE NEGOTIATIONS.

BEFORE YAZDI GAVE THE KHOMEINI MESSAGE TO ZIMMERMANN, ZIMMERMANN GAVE YAZDI A TEXT OF PRESIDENT CARTER'S PRESS CONFERENCE STATEMENT JANUARY 26 THAT POLITICAL CHANGE SHOULD BE CONDUCTED IN AN ORDERLY FASHION AND IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE IRANIAN CONSTITUTION. YAZDI ASKED IF WE COULD CONFIRM THAT 200,000 BARRELS OF OIL WERE BEING SHIPPED TO IRAN. ZIMMERMANN CONFIRMED IT, THEN NOTED THAT PRESIDENT CARTER HAD MADE CLEAR THAT THE SHIPMENT WAS INTENDED TO ENSURE ENERGY SUPPLIES FOR THE IRANIAN PEOPLE. CHAPMAN UNQUOTE VANCE
CONFIDENTIAL - ENTIRE TEXT.

A MEETING WITH BANK MELLI OFFICIALS TO DISCUSS A LETTER OF CREDIT ARRANGEMENT UNDER WHICH THE DOLS 12.7 MILLION BOND MIGHT BE PAID

EDS DOES NOT RPT NOT WISH THE EMBASSY TO MAKE ANY APPROACH WHATSOEVER TO THE GOI ON ITS BEHALF AT THIS
REFERENCE: PARIS 2949
WE ARE REPEATING TO YOU REFTEL. WE WOULD LIKE YOUR COMMENTS ON THE FOLLOWING PROPOSED REPLY AND BELIEVE IT DESIRABLE YOU SHOULD INFORM BAKHTIAR AND DISCUSS REPLY WITH HIM.
FOLLOWING IS PROPOSED RESPONSE TO KHOMEINI.
KHOMEINI'S MESSAGE HAS BEEN RECEIVED IN WASHINGTON.
THE CLOSURE OF THE AIRPORT IS A DECISION OF THE CONSTITUTIONAL GOVERNMENT IN WHICH THE US IS NOT INVOLVED.
WE SHARE WITH ALL ELNTS CONCERNED ABOUT IRAN THE REGRET THAT CONTINUING STRIFE LEADS TO DEATH AND BLOODSHED.

WE ARE PLEASED TO HEAR THAT IS THE AYATOLLAH'S PREFERENCE THAT THE CURRENT PROBLEMS BE SOLVED IN PEACE AND HOPE THAT HE WILL CONTINUE TO EXERCISE RESTRAINT TO THIS END. WE ARE ALSO PLEASED TO HEAR FROM YAZDI THAT KHOMEINI IS IN CONTACT WITH VARIOUS ELEMENTS IN TEHRAN.

WE NEVERTHELESS CONTINUE TO FEEL THAT THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A GOVERNMENT OUTSIDE THE CONSTITUTIONAL FRAMWORK PRESENTS DANGERS TO THE REESTABLISHMENT OF A PEACEFUL, STABLE AND INDEPENDENT IRAN. IN OUR VIEW THERE WOULD BE AN ENHANCED RISK OF DIVISION WITHIN THE SOCIETY AS A WHOLE AND THE MILITARY IN PARTICULAR. WE BELIEVE RESOLUTION OF THE CURRENT CRISIS NEEDS TO BE WORKED OUT IN FULL DIALOGUE TH THE CONSTITUTIONAL GOVERNMENT AND THE MILITARY.
WE ASSUME THAT NO IMPLICATION OF THREAT TO AMERICANS WAS INTENDED IN THE AYATOLLAH'S MESSAGE. ANY SUCH THREAT WOULD BE VERY GRAVELY VIEWED HERE.
WE REMAIN PLEASED THAT THE AYATOLLAH HAS AGREED TO THIS METHOD OF COMMUNICATING WITH US AND WISH TO CONTINUE TO EXCHANGE VIEWS. END VANCE

IN A MEETING JANUARY 27 FACILITATED BY SENATOR EAGLETON, DEPTOFF (PRECHT) HAD 90-MIN DISCUSSION WITH SHAHRIAR RUHANI, SON-IN-LAW OF YAZDI AND ONE OF FIVE MEMBERS OF COMMITTEE KHOMEINI HAS DESIGNATED TO LOOK AFTER IRANIAN EMBASSY. RUHANI HAD SPOKEN EARLIER IN THE MORNING TO YAZDI ABOUT THE MEETING.

DISCUSSION FOLLOWED STANDARD LINES. RUHANI'S MAIN PITCH WAS TO URGE U.S. TO RESTRAIN IRANIAN MILITARY AND PARTICULARLY THE IMPERIAL GUARD FROM ATTEMPTING TO PREVENT KHOMEINI'S RETURN TO TEHRAN. RUHANI DESCRIBED IN DETAIL MILITARY DEFECTIT: THE DIVISION AT MASHAD, 3,000 NAVAL PERSONNEL AT BANDER ABBAS, 4,000 AIR FORCE TECHNICIANS AT ISFAHAN, 4,000 AIR FORCE CADETS AT OTHER BASES--ALL HAD SWORN ALLEGIANCE TO KHOMEINI. ACTIVE TALKS WERE GOING ON WITH MIDDLE-RANK OFFICERS SO AS TO PREVENT GROUND FORCE AND AIR FORCE SUPPORT FOR A COUP WHICH MIGHT BE LED BY SENIOR GENERALS.

RUHANI EMPHASIZED IT WAS URGENT KHOMEINI RETURN SOON TO TEHRAN BECAUSE THE AYATOLLAH WAS FINDING IT DIFFICULT TO RESTRAIN HIS SUPPORTERS BOTH IN THE MILITARY AND IN ARMED REVOLUTIONARY CELLS WHO WANTED TO LAUNCH VIOLENT ATTACKS ON LOYALIST TROOPS.

HE CLAIMED ANTI-AMERICANISM HAD INCREASED SUBSTANTIALLY WITHIN IRANIAN ARMY RECENTLY BASED ON LONGSTANDING BUT MUTED HOSTILITY TOWARDS AMERICAN MILITARY COUNTERPARTS--THEIR SUPERIOR PAY AND ARROGANCE, THEIR FAILURE TO LEARN FARSI AND THEIR HUMILIATING TREATMENT OF IRANIAN OFFICERS IN IRAN AND IN THE U.S.

IN ADDITION TO TALKS WITH MIDDLE-GRADE OFFICERS, RUHANI SAID NMEINI'S PEOPLE WERE CONDUCTING SECRET DISCUSSIONS WITH BAKHTIAR. THEY WERE PREPARED TO DEAL WITH BAKHTIAR WHO HAD NOT BEEN ASSOCIATED WITH SAVAK DURING THE PAST TWO OR THREE YEARS. PRECISELY AT THIS POINT DEPTOFF RECEIVED WORD THAT BAKHTIAR WOULD FLY TO PARIS WITHIN 48 HOURS. RUHANI SAID YAZDI HAD TOLD HIM OF THIS PLAN EARLIER BUT ORDERED HIM NOT TO DIVULGE IT. YAZDI HAD ALSO TOLD HIM SUBSTANCE OF PLAN FOR NEGOTIATIONS WITH BAKHTIAR BUT RUHANI WAS NOT AUTHORIZED TO DISCUSS THE PLAN WITH US. HE MELY SAID WE WOULD BE VERY PLEASED WITH THE PROJECTED OUTCOME.

DEPTOFF MADE STRONG PLEA FOR ADHERENCE TO CONSTITUTIONAL FORMS IN WORKING OUT IRAN'S POLITICAL PROBLEMS. RUHANI WAS FIRM IN THE ESSENTIAL NEED TO MAKE A BREAK WITH THE SHAH'S REGIME. THEREFORE, THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL COULD NOT BE ESTABLISHED UNDER THE AUTHORITY OF THE REGENCY COUNCIL. THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL WOULD, HOWEVER, ADHERE TO THE PROCEDURES SET DOWN IN THE 1906 CONSTITION IN ITS EFFORTS TO MODIFY THE CONSTITUTION. THERE WAS SLIGHT PROSPECT, RUHANI SAID, THAT THE KHOMEINI GROUP WOULD BE SATISFIED WITH THE ABDICATION OF THE SHAH AND THE CONTINUATION OF THE MONARCHY WITH THE CROWN PRINCE AS SHAH. THE MONARCHY, HE SAID, HAD BEEN TRIED AND PROVED A FAILURE.

THERE WERE THREE REASONS, RUHANI SAID, WHY DEMOCRACY WOULD WORK IN IRAN. FIRST, THE REVOLUTION WAS LED BY A CHARISMATIC FIGURE WHO WOULD NOT, HOWEVER, TAKE POWER AND AS LENIN AND MAO TSE-TUNG ALTER THE DEMOCRATIC NATURE OF THE STRUGGLE. SECOND, THE RELIGIOUS LEADERS WOULD CONTINUE TO PLAY A ROLE AS A BRIDGE BETWEEN THE GOVERNMENT AND THE HOPULATION EXPLAINING THE POLICIES OF THE FORMER AND THE WISHES OF THE LATTER SO THAT THERE WOULD BE NO BREAKDOWN IN COMMUNICATIONS. THIRD, THE DEMOCRATIC QUALITYOF THE REVOLUTION WAS TOO PROFOUND, TOO WIDELY ESTABLISHED IN IRANIAN SOCIETY TO BE ALTERED BY MILITARY FORCE OR ANY OTHER COUNTER-ACTION. VANCE

MAJOR BUSINESS OF THIS MEETING IS REPORTED SEPTEL. ZIMMERMANN BEGAN MEETING BY CONVEYING INFORMATION CONTAINED IN REFTEL A. YAZDI ASKED IF WE COULD NAME ANY INDIVIDUALS WHO HAD CLAIMED TO REPRESENT KHOMEINI IN US. ZIMMERMANN SAID HE COULD NAME ONE: M. NOURBAKHSH, WHO WAS ONE OF THE BUSINESSMEN WHO HAD GIVEN THE EMBASSY A MESSAGE FOR THE PRESIDENT PURPORTEDLY FROM KHOMEINI (REFTEL B). YAZDI SAID FORCEFULLY THAT NOURBAKHSH IS NOT A REPRESENTATIVE OF KHOMEINI. HE HAD COME TO SEE KHOMEINI SEVERAL TIMES ALONG WITH FREEMAN; FREEMAN HAD TOLD KHOMEINI THAT HE WANTED TO DO SOME THINGS ON KHOMEINI'S BEHALF.

YAZDI SAID THAT KHOMEINI, AS HE OFTEN DID, HAD EXPLAINED THE KINDS OF RELATIONS HE ENVISAGED WITH THE UNITED STATES. THERE WAS NO QUESTION OF EITHER FREEMAN OR NOURBAKHSH REPRESENTING KHOMEINI IN ANY WAY.

YAZDI SAID THAT, FOLLOWING THE TWO MEETINGS WITH KHOMEINI DESCRIBED IN REFTEL B, FREEMAN AND NOURBAKHSH HAD RETURNED TO THE KHOMEINI COMPOUND AND HAD TOLD YAZDI THAT THEIR "MESSAGE" HAD BEEN FORWARDED TO PRESIDENT CARTER. ZIMMERMANN TOLD YAZDI WHAT IN FACT HAD HAPPENED: THAT ZIMMERMANN HAD CABLED WASHINGTON THAT THE PURPORTED "MESSAGE" WAS NOT A MESSAGE FROM KHOMEINI (PER YAZDI'S STATEMENT THAT WE SHOULD DISREGARD IT) AND THAT THE EMBASSY HAD THEN TOLD FREEMAN THAT HIS COMMUNICATION HAD BEEN FORWARDED TO THE "APPROPRIATE AUTHORITIES," WITH NO FURTHER SPECIFICATION. YAZDI SEEMED SATISFIED. CHAPMAN

1979STATE026042.subject: SHULMAN-DOBRYNIN MEETING JANUARY 31: DEMARCHE ON IRAN

segments.text: ON IRAN SECRET ENTIRE TEXT
AT SECRETARY S REQUEST, MARSHALL SHULMAN CALLED IN AMBASSADOR DOBRYNIN ON JANUARY 31 AND PRESENTED FOLLOWING NON-PAPER ON IRAN.

BEGIN TEXT. SOVIET PRESS AND BROADCAST MEDIA CONTINUE TO GIVE THE MOST TENDENTIOUS AND DISTORTED ACCOUNTS OF US ACTIONS AND INTENTIONS IN IRAN. IN PARTICULAR WE OBJECT TO A MALICIOUS AND UNTRUE ARTICLE IN THE JANUARY 30 ISSUE OF PRAVDA AUTHORED BY ONE

PETROV, WHICH ATTEMPTS TO BLAME THE UNITED STATES AND US GENERAL HUYSER PERSONALLY FOR CREATING CONDITIONS LEADING TO CONTINUED BLOODSHED IN IRAN. MORE GENERALLY, THE CONTENT, VOLUME AND FREQUENCY OF SOVIET MEDIA COMMENT APPEAR DESIGNED TO EXACERBATE TENSIONS AND TURMOIL IN IRAN AND EXPLOIT A POTENTIAL CRISIS SITUATION IN AN EFFORT TO GAIN UNILATERAL ADVANTAGE. AT THE SAME TIME, THE SO-CALLED NATIONAL VOICE OF IRAN, BROADCASTING FROM SOVIET TERRITORY, CARRIES MORE DIRECT CALLS FOR ACTION WHICH CAN ONLY LEAD TO A WORSENING OF THE INTERNAL SITUATION IN THAT COUNTRY.

FOR ITS PART THE UNITED STATES HAS REPEATEDLY MADE CLEAR ITS INTENTION TO RESPECT THE RIGHT OF THE IRANIAN PEOPLE TO DETERMINE ITS OWN FATE, FREE FROM INTERFERENCE FROM OUTSIDE. THEY ARE NOW ATTEMPTING TO RESOLVE TH-IR PROBLEMS IN THE CONTEXT OF THEIR OWN CONSTITUTIONAL PROCESS, AND THE UNITED STATES STRONGLY BELIEVES THAT THE US AND THE USSR SHOULD SHARE AN INTEREST IN ENCOURAGING THIS PROCESS. NEITHER SIDE--NOR, MORE IMPORTANTLY, THE IRANIAN PEOPLE THEMSELVES--STAND TO BENEFIT FROM A SITUATION IN WHICH US-SOVIET COMPETITION BECOME ENTANGLED IN A COMPLEX AND DESTRUCTIVE INTERNAL STRUGGLE.

WE STAND READY TO CONSULT CONSTRUCTIVELY WITH THE SOVIET GOVERNMENT ABOUT THE SITUATION IN ANY AREA OF TENSIONS, INCLUDING IRAN. WE LIKEWISE EXPECT RESTRAINT AND RESPONSIBLE CONDUCT FROM THE SOVIET UNION IN RESPONDING TO A POTENTIALLY EXPLOSIVE SITUATION THREATENING GLOBAL AND REGIONAL STABILITY AND SECURITY, AND URGE AVOIDANCE OF ANY STEP WHICH COULD LEAD TO A SITUATION CAPABLE OF CAUSING A DANGEROUS EXACERBATION OF US-USSR RELATIONS. IN THIS REGARD, IT IS MOST DISTURBING THAT SOVIET MEDIA HAVE REPEATEDLY FOCUSED ON THE PRESENCE OF US ELECTRONIC MONITORING EQUIPMENT IN IRAN, WHICH WE BOTH REALIZE IS NECESSARY FOR VERIFICATION OF SALT II.

WE ARE PARTICULARLY STRUCK THAT THESE PROPAGANDISTIC ACCOUNTS WERE GIVEN OFFICIAL SUBSTANCE BY DEPUTY FOREIGN MINISTER KORNIYENKO'S PRESS CONFERENCE STATEMENT. IF THE SOVIET UNION CONTINUES TO DWELL ON THIS SUBJECT, THE RESULT CAN ONLY BE A HEIGHTENED PUBLIC CONTROVERSY THAT WOULD SERVE THE INTERESTS OF NEITHER SIDE. .

DOBRYNIN ACCEPTED NON-PAPER, MAKING POINT THAT WHATEVER GENERAL HUYSER'S ROLE WAS IN IRAN, IT COULD STILL BE SEEN AS INVOLVEMENT IN IRAN'S INTERNAL AFFAIRS. DOBRYNIN JUSTIFIED KORNIYENKO'S PRESS CONFERENCE COMMENTS ON ELECTRONIC EQUIPMENT BY NOTING THAT HE HAD BEEN ASKED A VERY LEADING QUESTION. DESPITE THESE DEBATING POINTS, DOBRYNIN INDICATED HIS AWARENESS OF POTENTIAL EFFECT OF SOVIET STATEMENTS ON CONGRESSIONAL AND PUBLIC OPINION AND SAID HE WOULD ADD HIS OWN READING OF THE US MOOD ON IRAN WHEN HE REPORTED THE CONVERSATION TO MOSCOW. VANCE

REGRET THAT CABLE DID NOT ACCURATELY DESCRIBE STATUS OF TALKS BETWEEN THE OPPOSITION AND THE GOVERNMENT. IN MY REMARKS I SOUGHT TO CONVEY TO THE JAPANESE A FLUID SITUATION IN WHICH ALL THE ELEMENTS AT PLAY WERE TALKING TO EACH OTHER RATHER THAN SUGGESTING THAT A COALITION GOVERNMENT MIGHT BE WORKED OUT. 1979STATE028807.subject: EXCHANGE OF VIEWS WITH SOVIETS ON IRAN

segments.text: SOVIET EMBASSY THIRD SECRETARY, MAGOMED OSMANOV, AT HIS REQUEST AGAIN CALLED ON NEA/IRN OFFICER FEBRUARY 1 TO EXCHANGE VIEWS ON SITUATION IN IRAN. DEPOFF DECLINED OSMANOV'S REQUEST TO SPECULATE ON POSSIBLE HYPOTHETICAL OUTCOMES OF THE PRESENT CRISIS IN IRAN. HE EXPLAINED TO OSMANOV THAT THE U.S., WITHOUT INTERFERING IN THE INTERNAL AFFAIRS OF IRAN, HAD TRIED TO ENCOURAGE ALL PARTIES INVOLVED TO ESTABLISH CONTACT WITH EACH OTHER FOR THE PURPOSE OF ACHIEVING A SOLUTION ACCEPTABLE TO THE PEOPLE OF IRAN THROUGH DELIBERATIONS AND NEGOTIATIONS RATHER THAN IN THE STREETS. DEPOFF ADDED THAT U.S.
HAD ALSO ATTEMPTED TO IMPRESS UPON ALL PARTIES THE NEED FOR RESTRAINT AND AVOIDANCE OF PROVOCATIONS SO THAT SOLUTIONS COULD BE SOUGHT THROUGH A LEGAL CONSTITUTIONAL PROCEDURE.

IN RESPONSE TO A QUESTION CONCERNING APPARENT SOVIET MEDIA TILT IN FAVOR OF KHOMEINI, OSMANOV MAINTAINED THAT SOVIET MEDIA WAS NOW BEING MORE "OBJECTIVE" IN ITS TREATMENT OF DEVELOPMENTS IN IRAN. HE SAID THAT SOVIETS HAD COME TO THE CONCLUSION THAT KHOMEINI REPRESENTS "PROGRESSIVE" TENDENCIES, ON THE BASIS OF HIS OVERWHELMING SUPPORT AMONG THE PEOPLE OF IRAN. OSMANOV ADDED, HOWEVER, THAT THE USSR WAS ATTEMPTING TO STEER A "NEUTRAL" COURSE VIS-A-VIS KHOMEINI, ABOUT WHOM THE SOVIETS STILL HAD MANY DOUBTS AND RESERVATIONS.

THE SOVIETS WERE HOPEFUL THAT ONCE KHOMEINI WAS EXPOSED TO THE THINKING OF HIS TOP FOLLOWERS AND RELATIVES IN IRAN, HE WOULD MODERATE SOME OF HIS VIEWS AND POSITIONS. AT THE SAME TIME, THE SOVIETS ARE VERY CONCERNED ABOUT DEVELOPMENTS IN IRAN AND ARE FEARFUL THAT THE SITUATION COULD TURN INTO ARMED STRUGGLE OR CIVIL WAR. DESPITE THEIR CONCERN, WHICH OSMANOV LABELED AS "LEGITIMATE," GIVEN THE FACT THAT IRAN BORDERS ON THE SOVIET UNION, THE SOVIETS DO NOT FEEL THAT THEY HAVE ANY OTHER CHOICE BUT TO WAIT AND OBSERVE DEVELOPMENTS. OSMANOV VOLUNTEERED THAT THE SOVIETS ALSO CONSIDER THAT THE U.S. HAS IMPORTANT LEGITIMATE INTERESTS IN IRAN.

OSMANOV RAISED QUESTIONS ABOUT PRESENT SITUATION OF U.S. INTELLIGENCE LISTENING DEVICES IN IRAN AND NEXT POSSIBLE LOCATION FOR THEM. DEPOFF PROFESSED IGNORANCE CONCERNING BOTH SUBJECTS. OSMANOV THEN SUGGESTED THAT PERHAPS THESE FACILITIES SHOULD BE MOVED TO THE SOVIET UNION. WHEN DEPOFF TOLD HIM THAT WHILE HE WAS NO EXPERT ON SUCH MATTERS, SUGGESTION MIGHT WELL HAVE SOME MERIT, OSMANOV QUICKLY SAID THAT HE HAD ONLY BEEN JOKING.

DEPOFF TOLD OSMANOV THAT WHILE USG CONCERN OVER SOVIET MEDIA ATTACKS AGAINST US ROLE IN IRAN HAD BEEN BROUGHT TO ATTENTION OF SOVIETS AT HIGH LEVELS, HE ALSO WANTED TO UNDERSCORE POSSIBLY DANGEROUS NEGATIVE EFFECT ON SAFETY OF AMERICANS IN IRAN OF SUCH ATTACKS. OSMANOV CLAIMED TO APPRECIATE OUR CONCERN IN THIS REGARD AND PROMISED TO CONVEY SAME TO HIS SUPERIORS. HE SAID THAT ALL SOVIET DEPENDENTS HAD BEEN EVACUATED, MOST SOVIET ADVISORS OF VARIOUS KINDS HAD LEFT IRAN, AND THE SOVIET OFFICIAL FAMILY IN IRAN HAD BEEN REDUCED.

DEPOFF REITERATED TO OSMANOV THAT IT WAS IMPORTANT TO AVOID ANY MISUNDERSTANDINGS CONCERNING THE POLICIES AND ACTIONS OF OUR TWO GOVERNMENTS. CONTINUING CONTACT AND AIRING OF POSSIBLE CONCERNS WAS THEREFORE IN INTEREST OF BOTH. OSMANOV AGREED AND ASKED THAT CONTACT BE

WE KNOW THAT YOU HAVE YOUR CONTACTS WITH KHOMEINI'S SUPPORTERS IN TEHRAN. IF AT ANY POINT IN YOUR JUDGMENT IT WOULD BE USEFUL TO SUPPLEMENT THEM BY PICKING UP THE ZIMMERMAN CONTACT WITH YAZDI, YOU ARE AUTHORIZED TO DO SO AND TO ASSOCIATE WHOEVER MAKES THE CONTACT FROM THE EMBASSY AS PICKING UP THAT DIALOGUE IN PARIS.

1979STATE030715.subject: LEGAL ASPECTS OF ATTACHMENT OF IRANIAN ACCOUNTS IN THE U.S.

segments.text: (C ENTIRE TEXT)

EMBASSY ASSUMPTION CORRECT THAT LEGAL RECOURSE BY A PRIVATE PARTY AGAINST A PRIVATE COMMERCIAL BANK IS OUTSIDE USG'S CONTROL. GOI CENTRAL BANK ASSETS ARE FULLY PROTECTED AND A GOOD DEAL OF PROTECTION IS AVAILABLE FOR OTHER GOI ASSETS, INCLUDING THOSE OF GOI-OWNED BANKS AND OTHER GOI-OWNED CORPORATIONS PURSUANT TO THE FOREIGN SOVEREIGN IMMUNITIES ACT OF 1976, 28 USC SECTIONS 1602-1611. ON BASIS OF INFORMATION IN THIS CABLE, EMBASSY SHOULD REASSURE GOI OFFICIALS OF SECURITY OF THEIR ASSETS HERE.

OFFICIALS SHOULD BE INFORMED, HOWEVER, THAT UNDER CURRENT LAW AND PRACTICE, IT IS UP TO THE GOI TO PROTECT ITS INTERESTS IN U.S. COURTS AND FOR THE COURTS TO DECIDE ON ANY QUESTIONS OF IMMUNITY. THE STATE DEPARTMENT NO LONGER RULES ON THESE ISSUES OR ENTERS SUGGESTIONS OF IMMUNITY IN COURT CASES ON BEHALF OF FOREIGN GOVERNMENTS.

FOREIGN SOVEREIGN IMMUNITIES ACT, SECTION 1611(B)(1), PROVIDES COMPLETE IMMUNITY FROM ATTACHMENT AND FROM EXECUTION FOR "THE PROPERTY OF A FOREIGN CENTRAL BANK OR MONETARY AUTHORITY FOR ITS OWN ACCOUNT, UNLESS SUCH BANK OR AUTHORITY OR ITS PARENT GOVERNMENT HAS EXPLICITLY WAIVED ITS IMMUNITY FROM ATTACHMENT." SECTION 1611(B)(2) PROVIDES COMPLETE IMMUNITY FROM ATTACHMENT AND FROM EXECUTION FOR PROPERTY INTENDED FOR USE "IN CONNECTION WITH A MILITARY ACTIVITY AND...UNDER THE CONTROL OF A MILITARY AUTHORITY OR DEFENSE AGENCY."

PROPERTY OF OTHER IRANIAN GOVERNMENT AGENCIES AND INSTRUMENTALITIES, INCLUDING ASSETS OF IRANIAN CORPORATIONS IN WHICH THE GOI HAS A MAJORITY OWNERSHIP INTEREST, IS ALSO PROTECTED HERE, ALTHOUGH WITH CERTAIN LIMITED EXCEPTIONS. THE MOST RELEVANT EXCEPTIONS ARE FOR PROPERTY WHICH "IS OR WAS USED FOR THE COMMERCIAL ACTIVITY UPON WHICH THE CLAIM IS BASED," AND FOR OTHER PROPERTY OF CORPORATIONS DOING BUSINESS WITH THE U.S. IN LEGAL CASES ARISING OUT OF COMMERCIAL ACTIVITY CARRIED OUT IN WHOLE OR IN PART IN THE UNITED STATES OR WHICH "CAUSES A DIRECT EFFECT" IN THE UNITED STATES.

IN THESE CASES, THE PROPERTY CAN BE ATTACHED IN EXECUTION OF A JUDGMENT, BUT IS IMMUNE FROM ATTACHMENT IN PRELIMINARY STAGES OF PROCEEDINGS, "UNTIL A REASONABLY PERIOD OF TIME HAS ELAPSED FOLLOWING ENTRY OF JUDGMENT." ONLY IF THE FOREIGN STATE HAS "EXPLICITLY WAIVED" ITS IMMUNITY CAN SUCH PROPERTY BE ATTACHED PRIOR TO THE ENTRY OF JUDGMENT AND, EVEN THEN, IT CAN BE ATTACHED ONLY FOR PURPOSES OF SECURING SATISFACTION OF AN ULTIMATE JUDGMENT, NOT TO OBTAIN JURISDICTION. THAT MEANS AN IRANIAN GOVERNMENT AGENCY OR GOVERNMENT CORPORATION CAN'T BE BROUGHT INTO A U.S. COURT SIMPLY BECAUSE IT HAS ASSETS IN THE U.S. VANCE

FORMAL OWEN/VANCE CONVERSATIONS OF FEBRUARY 2 AND 3 DEALT ALMOST EXCLUSIVELY WITH AFRICAN QUESTIONS. THERE WAS NO DISCUSSION OF IRAN IN THESE SESSIONS.

UNDER SECRETARY NEWSOM SAW AMBASSADOR PARSONS FEBRUARY 2. CONVERSATION PRIMARILY INVOLVED BRINGING PARSONS UP TO DATE ON EVENTS IN IRAN. HE EXPRESSED VIEW THAT TREMENDOUS EMOTION BUILT UP ON BEHALF OF KHOMEINI NEEDED TO BE ACKNOWLEDGED IN ANY POLITICAL SOLUTION TO CURRENT PROBLEM. WHILE KHOMEINI'S VIEWS MAY NOT PREVAIL IN THE LONG RUN, IT WOULD IN HIS VIEW BE A MISTAKE TO TRY TO SUPPRESS THEM IN THE PRESENT CIRCUMSTANCES. HE THEREFORE SAW LITTLE ALTERNATIVE TO ACCEPTANCE OF A KHOMEINIDESIGNATED GOVERNMENT.

HE ACKNOWLEDGED THAT THIS WAS RISKY BECAUSE OF MILITARY ATTITUDES AND SHARED OUR HOPE THAT ARRANGEMENTS COULD BE WORKED OUT THAT COULD PREVENT CONFRONTATION. HE WAS SPEAKING PERSONALLY AND DID NOT REPRESENT FOREGOING AS HMG POSITION.

IN A LUNCH WITH SAUNDERS, PARSONS SAID HE THOUGHT AN EARLY KHOMEINI-DESIGNATED GOVERNMENT WAS IRAN'S BEST HOPE OF ACHIEVING STABILITY. HE THOUGHT THERE WAS A FAIR CHANCE THAT REPUTABLE AND QUALIFIED IRANIANS WOULD JOIN AND SUPPORT SUCH A GOVERNMENT. HE THOUGHT THE GREATEST DANGER WAS CONTINUED DRIFT WHICH WOULD PROVIDE AN OPPORTUNITY FOR LEFTISTS, TERRORISTS AND OTHER EXTREME GROUPS. HE SAID HE THOUGHT THAT BAKHTIAR HAD LITTLE HOPE FOR SUCCESS AND THAT A MILITARY GOVERNMENT WAS NOT A REASONABLE ALTERNATIVE.
HE AND SECRETARY MET INFORMALLY AT DINNER AT BRITISH EMBASSY WHERE THERE WAS DISCUSSION OF IRAN ALONG SIMILAR

1979STATE035754.subject: MESSAGE OF APPRECIATION PLEASE CONVEY TO GENERAL RABI'I AND HIS IIAF OFFICERS OUR APPRECIATION FOR THEIR ASSISTANCE IN ARRANGING FOR

segments.text: PLEASE CONVEY TO GENERAL RABI'I AND HIS IIAF OFFICERS OUR APPRECIATION FOR THEIR ASSISTANCE IN ARRANGING FOR HELICOPTERS TO MOVE AMERICANS OUT OF DOWSHEN TAPPEH AIR
1.A. (SECRET) ENTIRE TEXT.

CYRUS GHANI TELEPHONED FROM LONDON TO REPORT LENGTHY CONVERSATION HE HAD FEB. 10 WITH ALI AMINI. BURDEN OF AMINI'S REMARKS WAS THAT ONLY WAY TO REDUCE EMOTIONALISM AND NULLIFY THE THREAT OF AN ARMY CRACKDOWN WAS FOR SHAH TO ABDICATE. KHOMEINI MUST HAVE SOME ASSURANCE THAT THE SHAH WILL NOT RETURN TO IRAN BEFORE OPPOSITION REDUCES PRESSURE. TALEGHANI IN A CONVERSATION WITH AMINI EMPHASIZED THAT KHOMEINI GROUPS PRIME OBJECTIVE IS A GUARANTEE THAT THE SHAH WILL NOT RETURN. AMINI WONDERED IF SOMEONE LIKE THE KING OF MOROCCO MIGHT NOT BE HELPFUL IN PERSUADING THE SHAH TO TAKE THIS STEP.
AMINI WAS TERRIBLY WORRIED ABOUT THE OUTLOOK FOR IRAN'S ECONOMY. HE FORESAW FOOD SHORTAGES AND LOOTING OF HOMES IF A POLITICAL ACCOMMODATION WERE NOT REACHED VERY SOON.

AMINI WAS GRATIFIED THERE WAS SOME DIALOGUE BETWEEN THE OPPOSITION AND THE MILITARY, BUT HE DID NOT RULE OUT THE POSSIBILITY OF A MILITARY COUP. HE WAS CONVINCED THAT AN ATTEMPT AT MILITARY RULE WOULD FAIL.

TWICE DURING THE MEETING WITH GHANI, AMINI WAS TELEPHONED BY BAKHTIAR.CONVERSATION TOOK PLACE IN ANOTHER ROOM BUT APPARENTLY BAKHTIAR ATTEMPTED TO PERSUADE AMINI TO RETURN TO TEHRAN TO ACT AS AN INTERMEDIARY WITH BAGARZAN. AMINI MADE NO DECISION.

FOR HIS OWN PART GHANI COMMENTED THAT IT WAS ESSENTIAL KHOMEINI GROUP TAKE POWER AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.ONLY IN THAT WAY WOULD IT BE POSSIBLE TO PUT THE OPPOSITION'S IDEAS AND PROGRAMS TO THE TEST OF PUBLIC DEBATE. GHANI WAS CONFIDENT THAT PROCESS WOULD EVENTUALLY

WE ARE CONSIDERING POSSIBLE PRE-POSITION OF A DETACHMENT OF ABOUT 50 MARINES IN DHAHRAN WITH THE INTENTION OF HOLDING THEM THERE UNTIL THEY MAY BE NEEDED TO ASSIST IN THE EVACUATION OF AMERICANS FROM IRAN.WE EMPHASIZE THAT AT THIS STAGE WE ARE ONLY PLANNING FOR CONTINGENCIES.

WE WOULD LIKE YOUR VIEWS WITHOUT REPEAT WITHOUT APPROACHING SAUDIS AS TO HOW THE SAG MIGHT REACT TO A PROPOSAL THAT WE FLY A CONTINGENT OF MARINES TO DHAHRAN ON SHORT NOTICE. FOR YOUR INFORMATION THE TURKISH GOVERNMENT HAS NOT GRANTED PERMISSION FOR OUR MARINES TO BE HELD AT INCIRLIK. CHRISTOPHER

PLEASE INFORM PORTUGUESE GOVERNMENT AS SOON AS POSSIBLE THAT WE ARE TAKING CERTAIN PRECAUTIONARY STEPS TO PROTECT AMERICAN LIVES IN IRAN. ONE OF THE MEASURES WE ARE TAKING IS TO MOVE A SMALL CONTINGENT OF ABOUT 50 MARINES TO A FORWARD POSITION. WHILE WE HAVE NOT YET DETERMINED LOCATION WHERE MARINES WILL BE PRE-POSITIONED, WE WISH TO INFORM PORTUGUESE GOVERNMENT THAT THIS DETACHMENT WILL LAND AT THE AZORES WITHIN A SHORT TIME AND WE WOULD APPRECIATE PORTUGUESE CLEARANCES.
FYI. WE DO NOT KNOW WHETHER MARINES WILL BE HELD AT LAJES FOR A PERIOD WHILE WE DETERMINE WHETHER THEY ARE NEEDED IN IRAN. END FYI.
PLEASE EMPHASIZE TO THE PORTUGUESE THAT THIS MEASURE IS TAKEN ON A CONTINGENCY BASIS ONLY. IF ASKED, YOU MAY SAY THAT THE MARINES WILL CARRY ARMS. CHRISTOPHER

WOULD APPRECIATE YOUR COMMENTS BY OOB FEBRUARY 12 ON FOLLOWING, WHICH WE HAVE DEVELOPED IN NEA AS A SUGGESTION FOR THE PRESIDENT'S PRESS CONFERENCE TOMORROW MORNING. DRAFT HAS NO STATUS WITHIN THE DEPARTMENT.
BEGIN TEXT: QUESTION: WHAT IS THE US ATTITUDE TOWARD THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT, WHICH IS APPARENTLY IN CONTROL IN TEHRAN?

ANSWER: WE HAVE REPEATEDLY SAID THAT DECISION ON IRAN'S POLITICAL FUTURE MUST BE MADE BY THE IRANIAN PEOPLE THEMSELVES. CLEARLY, THE ONLY WAY FOR STABILITY TO RETURN TO IRAN IS FOR IRAN TO HAVE A GOVERNMENT THAT REFLECTS THE WILL OF A MAJORITY OF THE IRANIAN PEOPLE.

WE HAVE SUPPORTED AND COOPERATED WITH IRAN'S ESTABLISHED GOVERNMENTS FOR MANY YEARS. WE WILL CONTINUE TO DO SO. AS SOON AS IRANIAN LEADERS HAVE CLARIFIED THE SITUATION, AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN WILL BE PREPARED TO COOPERATE FULLY WITH THEM. ( -- MANY IRANIANS HAVE PROPOSED A POPULAR VOTE TO ALLOW THE IRANIAN PEOPLE TO EXPRESS THEIR POLITICAL PREFERENCES. WE, OF COURSE, ENDORSE DEMOCRATIC PROCEDURES AS MEANS OF TESTING THE WILL OF THE PEOPLE.)

WE DEEPLY REGRET THE LOSS OF LIFE THAT HAS OCCURRED DURING THE LAST TWO DAYS OF FIGHTING IN TEHRAN. WE HOPE THAT THE DIFFERENCES THAT HAVE TRAGICALLY DIVIDED IRANIANS FOR SO MANY MONTHS CAN NOW BE ENDED AND THAT ALL IRANIANS WILL JOIN TOGETHER IN REBUILDING THE COUNTRY'S ECONOMY AND ITS POLITICAL INSTITUTIONS. WE ARE READY TO COOPERATE IN ANY WAY THAT THE GOVERNMENT WISHES. .
CLEARLY, WE WILL WANT TO REFLECT ANY DEVELOPMENTS TOMORROW IN MODIFYING OUR GUIDANCE. VANCE

ACCORDING TO HOMAYOUN OF IRANIAN EMBASSY, COL. TAVVAKOLI WHO SIGNED FIRST COMMUNIQUE FROM PROVISIONALOPERATIONAL STAFF OF ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY MOVEMENT, RETIRED FROM IRANIAN ARMY ABOUT 7 YEARS AGO. TAVVAKOLI WAS, IN HOMAYOUN'S VIEW, ONE OF THE ARMY'S BEST PLANNERS AND WAS ASSIGNED UNDER GENERAL BAKHSHIAZAR IN J-3. HE IS DESCRIBED AS "VERY MODERATE AND PRO WEST." WHEN HE VISITED HOMAYOUN FOR 3 OR 4 DAYS SOME MONTHS AGO, TAVVAKOLI SAID HE WAS QUITE ACTIVE IN OPPOSITION POLITICS.
BAKHSHIAZAR IS A RELATIVE OF HOMAYOUN'S WIFE, WE BELIEVE AND ARRANGED FOR HIS MARRIAGE. VANCE

PEROT AND HART HAVE APPOINTMENT WITH UNDERSECRETARY NEWSOM TOMORROW (MONDAY) AT 0900 EST. 1979STATE036854.subject: FIRST MEETING WITH ISLAMIC MOVEMENT'S YAZDI

segments.text: PLEASE CONVEY TO GEORGE LAMBRAKIS OUR APPRECIATION FOR HIS EXCELLENT CABLE REPORTING HIS CONVERSATION WITH YAZDI. CLEARLY, GEORGE IS OFF TO A GOOD START WITH THIS IMPORTANT CONTACT. PLEASE ALSO CONVEY TO THE POLITICAL SECTION OUR THANKS FOR THEIR FINE REPORTING ON A WIDE RANGE OF POLITICAL
(C) ENTIRE TEXT

WE ARE AWARE OF THREE POCKETS OF AMERICANS WHO DESIRE TO BE EVACUATED: BANDARABBAS, SHIRAZ, KERMAN SHAH. IN BANDARABBAS BRITISH ARE APPARENTLY BRINGING IN TWO SURVEY SHIPS TO TAKE OUT THEIR CITIZENS AND ARE WILLING TO TAKE OURS ON BOARD (INCLUDING AMERICANS AT KERMAN). COMIDEASTFOR HAS APPARENTLY OFFERED TO HELP. TO OUR KNOWLEDGE THIS WOULD BE THE FIRST TIME MILITARY VESSELS WERE USED TO MOVE FOREIGNERS FROM THAT PORT. IN SHIRAZ WE UNDERSTAND AIRPORT IS CLOSED TO AIR TRAFFIC. WE HAVE GIVEN SOME THOUGHT TO ASKING BRITISH TO MOVE AMERICANS VIA AIR SHUTTLE FROM BAHRAIN ONCE AIRPORT IS OPEN.
IN KERMAN SHAH WE HAVE CONFLICTING REPORTS AS TO WHETHER HELICOPTER EMPLOYEES WISH TO LEAVE. AIRPORT IS SAID TO BE AVAILABLE TO THEM FOR DEPARTURE.

WE THINK DETAILS ON THESE MOVEMENTS ARE BEST WORKED OUT IN TEHRAN. WE LEAVE IT TO YOUR DISCRETION WHETHER YOU SHOULD APPROACH GOI FOR PERMISSION TO MOVE CITIZENS FROM EACH OF THESE CENTERS AND DETAILS OF ARRANGEMENTS FOR DOING SO -- ASSUMING NEW GOVERNMENT INTERPOSES NO OBJECTIONS.
PLEASE LET US KNOW WHAT YOU ARE ABLE TO ARRANGE WITH RESPECT TO THESE THREE GROUPS.

IN CONVERSATION WITH JAPANESE EMBASSY OFFICER DEPTOFF URGED THAT GOJ URGENTLY CONSIDER MEANS FOR EVACUATING ITS CITIZENS FROM BANDAR SHAPUR IF THAT SEEMED PRUDENT MOVE. DEPTOFF POINTED OUT THAT BANDAR SHAPUR WAS A REMOTE LOCATION AND PERHAPS JAPANESE WERE IN NO DANGER. HE SAID HE FELT SURE THAT AMERICAN EMBASSY TEHRAN WOULD BE HAPPY TO CONSULT WITH JAPANESE ON NEXT E AND E STEPS. VANCE
(S) ENTIRE TEXT
YOU MAY UNDER PRESENT CIRCUMSTANCES CONTINUE CONTACTS WITH OFFICIALS OF NEW GOVERNMENT ON MATTERS OF SAFETY OF AMERICAN CITIZENS AND OTHER EMERGENCY SUBJECTS.
WE FEEL ALSO DURING THIS PERIOD IT IS IMPORTANT TO MAINTAIN CONTACT WITH THOSE WITH WHOM YOU ARE ALREADY ACQUAINTED AND TO SEIZE OPPORTUNITIES TO MEET NEW CIVIL AND MILITARY OFFICIALS.
WE ARE CONSULTING WITH THE UNITED KINGDOM, THE FEDERAL REPUBLIC OF GERMANY, JAPAN AND FRANCE ON THEIR POSTURE TOWARD THE NEW GOVERNMENT AS A PRELUDE TO RESUMING NORMAL DIPLOMATIC RELATIONS.
YOU WILL BE RECEIVING RELEVANT PORTIONS OF THE PRESIDENT'S PRESS CONFERENCE BY SEPTEL. VANCE
SECRET ENTIRE TEXT.

ISRAELI EMBASSY HAS ASKED US IF YOU COULD PROVIDE REFUGE IF IT BECOMES NECESSARY FOR APPROXIMATELY TWO DOZEN ISRAELI OFFICIALS RESIDENT IN TEHRAN. INFORMATION AVAILABLE TO ISRAELIS HERE IS SKETCHY BUT THEY HAVE THE IMPRESSION THAT ISRAELI STAFF IN TEHRAN MAY SOON FIND THEMSELVES IN PHYSICAL DANGER. IF SO THEY WOULD LIKE TO MOVE TO EMBASSY COMPOUND. LOCAL ISRAELIS BELIEVE THERE IS SOME AGREEMENT ALREADY TO THIS EFFECT. 2.IN ADDITION ISRAELIS WOULD LIKE TO MOVE OUT OF IRAN WITH AMERICANS WHEN AIRPORT REOPENS AND DEPARTURES ARE POSSIBLE. CLEARLY IT WILL BE NECESSARY FOR THE GOI TO AUTHORIZE SUCH DEPARTURE. ISRAELIS APPEAR RELUCTANT TO APPROACH FOREIGN MINISTRY.

SUGGEST THAT AFTER COORDINATION LOCALLY WITH ISRAELIS, YOU CONSIDER MAKING A REQUEST ON THEIR BEHALF WITH THE FOREIGN MINISTRY.YOU SHOULD EXPLAIN HUMANITARIAN NATURE OF OUR REQUEST AND INDICATE OUR WILLINGNESS TO TRANSPORT ISRAELIS ON WHATEVER US AIRCRAFT(I.E., CHARTER OR COMMERCIAL FLIGHTS) WE MAY ARRANGE FOR AMERICANS WHO WISH TO LEAVE IRAN.
PLEASE LET US KNOW RESULT OF YOUR CONSULTATION WITH ISRAELIS IN TEHRAN AND YOUR JUDGMENT AS TO HOW PROTECTION FOR THEM CAN MOST EFFECTIVELY BE HANDLED.
WE HAVE LEARNED THAT THE CANADIANS HAVE AGREED TO THE ISRAELI REQUEST THAT CANADA REPRESENT ISRAELI INTERESTS IN IRAN.
(S) ENTIRE TEXT

IN A MANNER YOU DEEM MOST APPROPRIATE PLEASE CONVEY TO THE GOI ON FEBRUARY 14 OUR READINESS TO CONTINUE NORMAL DIPLOMATIC RELATIONS. YOU SHOULD DISCUSS WITH THE IRANIANS WHETHER THEY BELIEVE A DIPLOMATIC NOTE SIGNIFYING OUR INTENTION IS DESIRABLE. IN THE EVENT YOU DECIDE THAT A NOTE IS APPROPRIATE, YOU MAY USE THE FOLLOWING TEXT.

THE EMBASSY OF THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA PRESENTS ITS COMPLIMENTS TO THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN, AND HAS THE HONOR TO STATE THAT T'E GOVERNMENT OF THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA INTENDS TO CONTINUE ITS DIPLOMATIC RELATIONS WITH IRAN AND LOOKS FORWARD TO COOPERATIVE AND FRIENDLY RELATIONS WITH THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT OF IRAN. THE AMBASSADOR OF THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA HOPES THAT IT WILL BE POSSIBLE, AT AN EARLY OPPORTUNITY, TO RECEIVE BRIEFINGS ON THE POLICIES AND PLANS OF THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN.

THE EMBASSY OF THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA AVAILS ITSELF OF THIS OPPORTUNITY TO RENEW TO THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN THE ASSURANCES OF ITS HIGHEST CONSIDERATION. END .
IN ADDITION, WOULD YOU ARRANGE TO CALL ON FOREIGN MINISTER SANJABI TO CONVEY THE FOLLOWING MESSAGE FROM THE SECRETARY.

DEAR DR. SANJABI: I HAVE LEARNED WITH PLEASURE OF YOUR APPOINTMENT AS FOREIGN MINISTER AND WISH TO EXTEND TO YOU MY VERY BEST WISHES FOR SUCCESS IN YOUR NEW POSITION. RELATIONS BETWEEN THE UNITED STATES AND IRAN HAVE BEEN STRONG FOR MANY, MANY YEARS. I HAVE EVERY HOPE THAT WE WILL CONTINUE A CLOSE AND PRODUCTIVE RELATIONSHIP THAT WILL REINFORCE THOSE TIES. I WANT YOU TO KNOW OF OUR READINESS TO COOPERATE WITH YOU AND TO DISCUSS FRANKLY AND FULLY ISSUES OF MUTUAL CONCERN. WITH BEST PERSONAL REGARDS, SINCERELY, CYRUS VANCE. END .
WE ARE UNCERTAIN AS TO PROPER REFERENCE TO THE GOVERNMENT OR PROPER FORM OF ADDRESS FOR SANJABI. PLEASE ADJUST NOTE AND LETTER AS NECESSARY.
WE PLAN ANNOUNCEMENT AT NOON BRIEFING TOMORROW. WE WOULD HOPE THAT IRANIANS COULD DELAY THE ANNOUNCEMENT IN TEHRAN UNTIL LATE IN THE DAY
PLEASE PASS FOLLOWING TO MRS. ADOLPH DUBS, CONGRESSIONAL QUARTERLY

ALL OF US IN COLOMBO SEND WARM GREETINGS AND WHAT THOUGHTS OF COMFORT YOU CAN RECEIVE. WE ARE ANGERED BY THOUGHTLESS ACTIONS BY BOTH PARTIES IN KABUL. AND WE HAVE SOME SENSE OF YOUR GREAT LOSS. I FELT PARTICULARLY CLOSE TO SPIKE WHO ALWAYS WELCOMED MY KIBBITZING WITH SUCH GRACE. AND HIS QUIET WISDOM AT THE CHIEFS OF MISSION CONFERENCE WILL ALWAYS BE REMEMBERED BY THE PARTICIPANTS. SECRETARY VANCE SAID THE REST. AFFECTIONATELY, HOWARD WRIGGINS, UNQUOTE. WRIGGINS

ISRAELI DIPLOMATS. CHIEF OF FOREIGN MINISTER'S CABINET INFORMED CHIEF OF ISRAELI MISSION THAT BAZARGAN HAS APPROVED DEPARTURE OF ALL ISRAELI DIPLOMATS ON SATURDAY, FEBRUARY 17. FOREIGN MINISTRY REFUSED PERMISSION FOR EL AL PLANE TO COME IN AND SUGGESTED ISRAELIS LEAVE WITH U.S. EVACUEES. ON SATURDAY THERE WILL BE A REPRESENTATIVE OF THE GOVERNMENT AT THE AIRPORT WHO WILL BE AWARE OF THE GOVERNMENT'S DECISION AND WILL TAKE CARE OF THE TWO DIPLOMATS WHO WILL NOT HAVE PASSPORTS. ASSUMING THAT THESE ARRANGEMENTS ARE FIRM, PLEASE ASSURE THAT THE FULL ISRAELI OFFICIAL GROUP IS EVACUATED ON PAN AM SATURDAY.

TABRIZ: IN VIEW OF DANGEROUS SITUATION AT TABRIZ, PLEASE ASK ENTEZAM OR YAZDI FOR GOVERNMENT ASSISTANCE IN MOVING AMERICANS FROM TABRIZ, PREFERABLY TO TEHRAN OR ALTERNATIVELY TO THE TURKISH BORDER. WE WOULD PREFER MOVEMENT BY AIR IF THAT IS FEASIBLE. AMERICANS WILL NEED ADEQUATE ARMED ESCORT FOR THEIR GROUND MOVEMENTS. PLEASE ADVISE.

COMMUNICATIONS EQUIPMENT: PER YOUR REQUEST, WE ARE NOT SENDING COMMUNICATIONS PACKAGE FOR THE EMBASSY ON PAN AM FLIGHT. THERE HAS BEEN SOME CONFUSION ON THE C-141 CARGO AND IT WILL NOT CARRY MILITARY COMMUNICATIONS PACKAGE.

WOULD IT BE ADVISABLE TO CHECK THIS OUT WITH GOI BEFORE PROCEEDING? COULD YOU PLEASE GIVE US YOUR ANSWER VIA KUWAIT BEFORE NOON WASHINGTON TIME FEBRUARY 17. VANCE
