1979STATE045242.subject: POSSIBLE THREAT TO AP OFFICE PARVIS RAIN HAS TOLD AP THAT HE HAS BEEN INFORMED BY TASS REPRESENTATIVE THAT THE AP BUREAU AND RAIN ARE ON

segments.text: PARVIS RAIN HAS TOLD AP THAT HE HAS BEEN INFORMED BY TASS REPRESENTATIVE THAT THE AP BUREAU AND RAIN ARE ON A FEDAYEEN HIT LIST BECAUSE OF THEIR ALLEGED TIES TO THE CIA. THE TASS REPRESENTATIVE MAY HAVE BEEN DRUNK. PLEASE TAKE APPROPRIATE ACTION.
FOR AMBASSADOR IF YOU ARE ASKED BY AMBASSADOR SEPAHBODI, YOU MAY SAY THAT OUR READINESS TO RECEIVE THE SHAH STILL STANDS AND THAT WE ARE STUDYING AND WILL REPLY SHORTLY TO THE SHAH'S SPECIFIC

FOR AMBASSADOR ASSUME YOU ARE AWARE OF REPORTS OF TROUBLE AT TACKSMAN II AND HAVE OR SOON WILL CONTACT ENTEZAM OR OTHER APPROPRIATE AUTHORITY. IT APPEARS THAT VILLAGERS ARE UPSET BECAUSE THEY ARE LOSING THEIR JOBS. ARE THERE ASSURANCES (E.G., TERMINATION BONUS) WE COULD OFFER TO CALM THEM? ON THE OTHER HAND, IIAF TROOPS ALL DRUNK AND MAY BE ANTIKHOMEINI. IT IS DOUBTFUL THAT THE MULLAH NOW ENROUTE COULD CALM THEM DOWN. WOULD GOI BE WILLING TO SEND TROOPS FROM NEARBY BASES TO RESTORE SECURITY AND PROTECT AMERICANS? PLEASE REPORT THROUGH THIS CHANNEL RESULTS OF YOUR APPROACH AND YOUR UNDERSTANDING OF PRESENT STATUS OF THE SITE.
GREATLY APPRECIATE REFTEL. WE CONCUR WITH YOUR RECOMMENDATIONS WITH FOLLOWING SUGGESTED CHANGES.
EXECUTIVE: PLEASE WORK OUT PRECISE DATES FOR LAMBRAKIS ARRIVAL DIRECTLY WITH HIM IN PARIS. WE TARGET FOR MARCH 7.

POLITICAL: WE CONCUR IN STAFFING DURING MARCH OF LAMBRAKIS, TOMSETH AND METRINKO SUPPLEMENTED BY WORK OF BOYCE AND, WE SUGGEST, FARRELL. WHEN CONDITIONS PERMIT, IT WOULD BE USEFUL TO HAVE OFFICERS MAKE VISITS OF SHORT DURATION TO EACH OF THE CONSULATES. WE WILL NOT ATTEMPT TO ADDRESS LONG-TERM STAFFING FOR SECTION UNTIL AFTER SEVERAL WEEKS.

ECONOMIC: AGREE SCHELL SHOULD SERVE AS UTILITY INFIELDER FOR ECON/COMM AND CONSULAR SECTION. WE ALSO WISH CLYDE TAYLOR TO RETURN ABOUT MARCH 7 TO HANDLE SENIOR CONTACTS AND COMPLEX ECONOMIC PROBLEMS THAT WILL INEVITABLY ARISE. BASH HAS BEEN STUCK IN ROME AND WILL NEED LEAVE BEFORE RETURNING.

POL/MIL: BELIEVE WE WILL WANT TO STAFF THIS POSITION AS SOON AS CONDITIONS PERMIT. THERE ARE MANY COMPLEX TANGLES TO SORT OUT WITH MILITARY AND CIVILIAN AGENCIES AND WE WILL WANT AS MUCH CONTINUITY AS POSSIBLE. FILLING POSITION WILL BE PARTICULARLY IMPORTANT IF MILITARY CONTACTS CONTINUE TO BE RESTRICTED. GREEN IS STILL IN FRANKFURT AND WILL NEED LEAVE, WE ASSUME.
CONSULAR: GOELZ, SORENSON AND FARRELL TO BE REPLACED BY RICHARDSON, SCUD AND LEMONT. TDY PERSONNEL WILL PROBABLY NOT BE AVAILABLE, BUT WE MAY BREAK NEW PERSONNEL OUT OF LANGUAGE TRAINING.
ADMINISTRATIVE: ARRANGEMENTS LOOK SATISFACTORY. WILL ADVISE ON TDY REPLACEMENT FOR MILLS. SEPTEL ON GIACOBBI TRAVEL.
SEPTEL FOLLOWS WITH PERSONNEL RECAP AND TRAVEL ORDER

1979STATE046420.subject: DISPOSITION OF IRANIAN MILITARY EQUIPMENT UNDER ORDER FROM THE U.S.

segments.text: UNDER ORDER FROM THE U.S.
(S - ENTIRE TEXT)

WE ANTICIPATE THAT, AS WE BEGIN TO ARRANGE FOR THE REASSIGNMENT OF MILITARY ITEMS DESTINED FOR IRAN, INCLUDING NECESSARY CONGRESSIONAL CONSULTATIONS, THESE CHANGES WILL BEGIN TO COME TO PUBLIC ATTENTION. AS YOU KNOW, WE ARE PROCEEDING ON THE BASIS OF THE MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING TO TERMINATE ORDERS AND TO INITIATE TRANSFER ARRANGEMENTS WHICH WOULD MINIMIZE LOSSES TO IRAN. WE CONSIDER THAT MOU PROVIDES US WITH APPROPRIATE AUTHORITY TO TAKE THESE ACTIONS.

WE WOULD LIKE YOUR JUDGMENT WITHOUT REFERENCE TO THE GOI WHETHER YOU SHOULD NOW ATTEMPT TO BRIEF APPROPRIATE IRANIAN OFFICIALS ON THE MOU, THE GENERAL OUTLINE OF STEPS WE ARE TAKING PURSUANT TO THAT DOCUMENT AND OUR BEST ESTIMATE OF FINANCIAL IMPLICATIONS FOR IRAN. WE ARE CONCERNED THAT IF WE DO NOT BRIEF GOI, IRANIAN LEADERS WILL LEARN OF OUR CONGRESSIONAL DISCUSSIONS FROM PRESS REPORTS WHICH MAY BE SUBJECT TO DAMAGING MISINTERPRETATIONS. SHOULD YOU AGREE THAT AN APPROACH TO GOI LEADERS IS FEASIBLE, WE WOULD PROVIDE YOU WITH SUGGESTED TALKING POINTS AND BACKGROUND INFORMATION. LET US KNOW YOUR VIEWS BY RETURN IMMEDIATE CABLE.
NEWSOM *** Current Handling Restrictions *** EXDIS, STADIS *** Current Classification *** SECRET

1979STATE047052.subject: MINORITY GROUPS AND OTHER HUMAN RIGHTS ISSUES

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT)

WE SUGGEST THAT AS SOON AS CONDITIONS PERMIT EMBASSY BROADEN AND REGULARIZE ITS CONTACTS WITH GOI ON HUMAN RIGHTS QUESTIONS. YOU WILL BE ABLE TO BUILD ON DISCUSSIONS WE HAD OVER PAST MONTHS WITH BAZARGAN, MINACHI AND OTHERS WHO NOW OCCUPY KEY POSITIONS IN THE GOVERNMENT. A CONTINUING DIALOGUE ON THESE QUESTIONS WILL MAKE IT EASIER FOR US TO DEAL WITH SPECIFIC INCIDENTS AS THEY ARISE.

YOU HAVE ALREADY CONVEYED OUR CONCERNS ON THE QUESTION OF SUMMARY EXECUTIONS. WE LEAVE TO YOUR DISCRETION WHETHER IT WOULD BE USEFUL TO REINFORCE YOUR EARLIER APPROACH WITH FOLLOW-UP CONVERSATIONS WITH OTHER OFFICIALS.

AS YOU ARE AWARE, THE STATUS OF MINORITY GROUPS IS A QUESTION THAT IS RECEIVING GREAT ATTENTION OUTSIDE OF IRAN. YOU SHOULD CONTINUE TO MONITOR DEVELOPMENTS AFFECTING THE MINORITIES AND TO DISCUSS THESE FRANKLY WITH THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT AT APPROPRIATE LEVELS. IT WOULD BE USEFUL WE BELIEVE TO BROACH THE GENERAL QUESTION WITH PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN IN ORDER TO ESTABLISH A BASIS FOR FOLLOW-UP CONVERSATIONS WITH OTHER OFFICIALS.

AT THE MOMENT WE HAVE NO SPECIFIC EVIDENCE OF ABUSES OF MINORITY RIGHTS BY THE GOVERNMENT AND WE ARE AWARE OF THE GOVERNMENT'S LIMITATIONS IN PROTECTING MINORITIES UNDER PREVAILING DISTURBED CONDITIONS. BECAUSE OF THE CONTINUING CONGRESSIONAL AND PUBLIC INTEREST HERE, WE WILL APPRECIATE YOUR KEEPING US CURRENT ON REPORTS OF INCIDENTS AFFECTING MINORITIES.

ROUHANI IS SPOKESMAN FOR INTERIM COMMITTEE FOR OVERSEEING THE IRANIAN DIPLOMATIC CORPS IN THE U.S. UNQUOTE APPOINTED BY THE AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI. HE IS 29-YEAR OLD YALE PHD CANDIDATE AND SON-IN-LAW OF YAZDI WITH WHOM HE SPEAKS DAILY WHEN PHONES ARE WORKING. ROUHANI HAS MET WITH MANY KEY AMERICANS IN THE PRESS, CONGRESS, MINORITY GROUPS AND APPEARED ON TV. HE HAS BEEN VERY WILLING TO BE HELPFUL TO US IN PASSING MESSAGES ON SUCH MATTERS AS SGT. KRAUS, CASSIBA AND, IN VAIN ATTEMPT, DURING ATTACK

WE HAVE ASKED ROUHANI TO ASCERTAIN WHETHER BELL HELICOPTER VISIT IS IN FACT DESIRED BY GOI AND, IF SO, WHETHER WE WOULD HAVE ASSURANCE THAT BELL OFFICIALS WOULD NOT BE ARRESTED IN CONNECTION WITH POSSIBLE BRIBERY CHARGES. ROUHANI AGREED TO PROVIDE US AN ANSWER. WE HAVE ALSO INFORMED GENERAL WILLIAMS OF BHI THAT EMBASSY CONSIDERED IT PREMATURE FOR BELL TO VISIT IRAN AND THAT COMPANY SHOULD AWAIT FURTHER WORD BEFORE PLANNING TRIP. WILLIAMS READILY AGREED.
PLEASE CABLE RELEVANT PORTIONS OF TEXT OF PRESS ARTICLE DESCRIBING HELICOPTER BRIBERY DEALS. VANCE
REF : STATE 032718 (NOTAL) S - ENTIRE TEXT

SINCE OUR LAST TELEGRAM ON THIS SUBJECT, BARZANI'S ENTOURAGE HAS INFORMED US THAT HIS HEALTH HAS DETERIORATED RAPIDLY. HE IS CURRENTLY HOSPITALIZED AND IT IS THE GROUPS'S HOPE THAT THE DOCTORS WILL BE ABLE TO ARREST HIS CONDITION SUFFICIENTLY TO PERMIT HIM TO TRAVEL TO TEHRAN TO SEE HIS FAMILY A FINAL TIME. IT IS OUR UNDERSTANDING THAT BARZANI AND HIS ENTOURAGE PLAN TO RETURN TO TEHRAN, EVEN IN THE ABSENCE OF ANY PRIOR ARRANGEMENTS, AS LONG AS THE GENERAL'S HEALTH CAN STAND THE TRIP.

WE HAVE FRANKLY EXPLAINED TO THE GROUP THAT CURRENT CONDITIONS HAVE SEVERELY CURTAILED OUR ABILITY TO AFFECT THE DAY TO DAY SITUATION AND THAT WE ARE IN NO POSITION TO BRING INFLUENCE TO BEAR ON IRANIAN ACTIONS. WE HAVE ALSO MADE CLEAR THE RECENT GOVERNMENT RULINGPROHIBITING THE DEPARTURE OF IRANIAN CITIZENS, WHICH COULD WELL EFFECT FUTURE TRAVEL PLANS OF THOSE IN THE GROUP DOCUMENTED WITH IRANIAN PASSPORTS.

WE HAVE ALSO CLEARLY EXPLAINED TO MOHAMMED DOSKY THAT, AS AN AMERICAN CITIZEN, WE MUST OFFICIALLY DISCOURAGE HIS TRAVEL TO THE COUNTRY, AS WE ARE IN NO POSITION TO ASSURE THAT HIS WELFARE COULD BE PROVIDED FOR IN THE EVENT THAT SOMETHING UNTOWARD MIGHT OCCUR.

WE ARE RELAYING THE FOREGOING ON AN INFORMATIONAL BASIS ONLY, SO THAT YOU WILL BE AWARE OF THE CURRENT PLANS OF THE GROUP. WE HAVE ASKED THAT THEY PROVIDE US WITH A FULL ITINERARY, WHICH WE WILL PASS ALONG TO YOU, IF AND WHEN IT BECOMES AVAILABLE. VANCE

1979STATE050174.subject: HOSPITAL PERSONNEL FOR THE AMBASSADOR OR DCM FROM WORKING GROUP

segments.text: FOR THE AMBASSADOR OR DCM FROM WORKING GROUP (C - ENTIRE TEXT)

WE ARE CONTINUING TO RECEIVE A DAILY STREAM OF CONGRESSIONAL, PRESS AND FAMILY INQUIRIES ON BEHALF OF HOSPITAL PERSONNEL. THE ARGUMENT IS THAT THESE PERSONNEL ARE NOT PERFORMING ANY NECESSARY FUNCTIONS IN TEHRAN. THEY ARE BEING HELD IN IRAN AGAINST THEIR STRONG PERSONAL DESIRE AND THEY ARE IN DANGER. WE HAVE REPLIED THAT IT IS IN OUR INTEREST TO KEEP THE HOSPITAL OPEN AND THAT THESE FEW PERSONNEL ARE ESSENTIAL FOR THAT PURPOSE. WE HAVE ADDED THAT WE ANTICIPATE REPLACEMENT PERSONNEL WILL BE SENT IN DUE COURSE. OUR ARGUMENTS HAVE NOT RESOLVED THE PUBLIC CONCERN.

IS THERE ANYTHING OF A MORE DEFINITE NATURE THAT WE CAN SAY -- E.G., WHEN PERSONNEL PRESENTLY AT THE HOSPITAL MIGHT BE TRANSFERRED, CURRENT USE OF THE HOSPITAL OR ANY OTHER COMMENT YOU THINK IT WOULD BE DESIRABLE TO MAKE IN THE PRESENT CIRCUMSTANCE. WE SEE A MAJOR PUBLIC RELATIONS PROBLEM DEVELOPING UNLESS WE CAN DEVELOP AN EFFECTIVE RATIONALE TO HEAD IT OFF. APPRECIATE YOUR ASSISTANCE.

DEPARTMENT APPRECIATES REPORT ON CONSULAR SERVICES EMBASSY ABLE PERFORM UNDER CURRENT ADVERSE CIRCUMSTANCES. HOWEVER, WE CONTINUE RECEIVE CONGRESSIONAL AND PUBLIC INQUIRIES RE W/W AMCITS REMAINING IN IRAN, ESPECIALLY AMCIT WIVES OF IRANIAN HUSBANDS.

RE PARA 3, A: ARE AMCIT WIVES (WHO MAY BE DUAL NATIONALS)OF IRANIAN HUSBANDS INCLUDED IN ADULT GROUP NOT ALLOWED TO DEPART IRAN? HAS THERE BEEN ANY CHANGE IN EXIT DOCUMENTATION REQUIRED FOR AMCIT WIVES?

RE PARA 3, C: DEPARTMENT IS CHECKING PASSENGER MANIFESTS OF EVACUEES PRIOR TO SENDING W/W CABLES TO TEHRAN. WE ARE ALSO ATTEMPTING LIMIT W/W INQUIRIES TO THOSE THAT PROVIDE INFORMATION REQUIRED BY EMBASSY IN ORDER MAKE INQUIRY IN IRAN. IN THIS REGARD, WOULD IT BE MORE HELPFUL TO EMBASSY TO SEND INQUIRIES THAT DO NOT CONTAIN SUFFICIENT INFORMATION IN SEPARATE CABLE FOR FUTURE PROCESSING WHEN YOU ABLE TAKE ACTION OR HOLD HERE FILE YOU INFORM DEPARTMENT YOU PREPARED PROCESS THEM? BENEFIT OF HAVING THIS CATAGORY W/W INQUIRY ON HAND IS ASSISTANCE CAN BE PROVIDED OR INFORMATION PASSED ON IN EVENT INDIVIDUAL AMCIT ABLE VISIT OR CONTACT EMBASSY.
WE AWARE PROBLEM YOU FACE, BUT WOULD APPRECIATE YOUR EFFORTS IN PROVIDING AN IMMEDIATE REPLY SO WE CAN PREPARE GUIDANCE FOR WEEKEND WORKING GROUP STAFF.

1979STATE050223.subject: BARZANI'S DEATH (C) BARZANI DIED IN A WASHINGTON HOSPITAL AFTERNOON OF MARCH 1. HIS ASSOCIATES AND SON INTEND TO SHIP BO

segments.text: (C) BARZANI DIED IN A WASHINGTON HOSPITAL AFTERNOON OF MARCH 1. HIS ASSOCIATES AND SON INTEND TO SHIP BODY TO TEHRAN FOR FUNERAL ATTENDED BY HIS FAMILY AND ASSOCIATES
REF : STATE 50223 C - ENTIRE TEXT

THIS IS TO INFORM YOU THAT ARRANGEMENTS HAVE BEEN MADE TO SHIP THE REMAINS SAT MARCH THREE NATIONAL AIRLINE NO. NINE SIX AT 1000 HOURS, CONNECTING WITH IRAN AIR 776 AT JFKIA, DEPARTING SAME DAY AT 2030 HOURS, ARRIVING TEHRAN APPROXIMATELY 1900 HOURS SUN MARCH FOUR. ACCOMPANYING THE BODY WILL BE MOHAMED DOSKY, IDRIS BARZANI, MUHASIN DEZASHIBI, AND A MEMBER OF BARZANI'S HOUSEHOLD STAFF. VANCE
REFTEL IS A FIRST CLASS EXAMPLE OF THE KIND OF GRAPHIC REPORTING WHICH GIVES WASHINGTON READERS THE FLAVOR OF LIFE IN TODAY'S TEHRAN. CONGRATULATIONS TO THE DRAFTING

EMBASSY TEHRAN POL COUNSELOR LAMBRAKIS AND EMBOFF CALLED FEBRUARY 28 ON QUAI DEPUTY DIRECTOR FOR THE MIDDLE EAST, SERVANT, AND IRAN DESK OFFICER LAURENS. DISCUSSION OF IRAN SITUATION PRODUCED NO SIGNIFICANT NEW INFORMATION ON LATEST DEVELOPMENTS ON THE GROUND BUT DID REVEAL FRENCH CONCERN ABOUT ROLE IRAN WOULD HENCEFORTH PLAY IN MULTILATERAL AFFAIRS. SERVANT NOTED THAT THE CHANGE OF GOVERNMENT IN IRAN COULD GIVE CONSIDERABLE ADDED CLOUT TO THE GROUP OF 77 AND TO THE NONALIGNED MOVEMENT. WITH IRAN PLAYING AN ACTIVE ROLE, THE NONALIGNED MEETING IN HAVANA IN SEPTEMBER FOR INSTANCE, COULD TAKE ON A NEW--AND OMINOUS-SIGNIFICANCE FOR THE WEST.

SERVANT (WHO SPENT FIVE YEARS WITH THE FRENCH UN MISSION IN NEW YORK) SAID THAT BY CHOICE AND FORCE OF CIRCUMSTANCES IRAN HAS BEEN A RELATIVE LIGHTWEIGHT IN MULTILATERAL AFFAIRS IN VIEW OF ITS WEALTH, POPULATION, AND GEOPOLITICAL SITUATION. THIS NOW SEEMS CERTAIN TO CHANGE.

SERVANT DESCRIBED CURRENT FRENCH POLICY TOWARDS IRAN--FOR LACK OF ANY EVIDENT ALTERNATIVE--AS ESSENTIALLY WAIT AND SEE. AS THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT EXTENDS ITS AUTHORITY AND RESTORES ORDER THE GOF WILL PICK UP THE PACE OF ITS RELATIONS AS POSSIBLE.

IN REPLY TO A QUESTION, SERVANT SAID HE THOUGHT IT UNLIKELY THAT FRENCH TECHNICIANS WOULD BE AVAILABLE IN SIGNIFICANT NUMBERS TO REPLACE AMERICANS ON VARIOUS PROJECTS THROUGHOUT IRAN. THE FRENCH POPULATION IN IRAN OF SOME 8000 LAST FALL HAS NOW BEEN REDUCED TO ABOUT 1500. NOT MANY OF THOSE WHO LEFT WILL BE IN A HURRY TO GO BACK IN VIEW OF THE CURRENT INSECURE SITUATION AND THEIR TALES OF THE DANGERS OF LIFE IN IRAN WILL DISCOURAGE OTHERS FROM CONSIDERING WORK THERE.

MOREOVER, THOUGH AMERICANS MAY FOR THE MOMENT BE LOOKED ON WITH LESS FAVOR THAN OTHER WESTERNERS, A BASIC OBJECTIVE OF THE NEW REGIME WILL BE TO REDUCE RELIANCE ON ALL FOREIGN TECHNICIANS, NOT JUST AMERICANS.

COMMENTING ON PRESS REPORTS THAT BAKHTIAR MAY HAVE COME TO FRANCE, SERVANT SAID THAT TO THE BEST OF HIS KNOWLEDGE HE HAD NOT. EVEN THOUGH IRANIANS DO NOT NEED VISAS TO ENTER FRANCE HE THOUGHT IT EXTREMELY UNLIKELY THAT BAKHTIAR COULD ENTER WITHOUT THE FACT COMING TO THE ATTENTION OF THE GOF. SERVANT HAD NO IDEA WHERE BAKHTIAR MIGHT BE BUT SAID IT MORE LIKELY HE NOW OUT OF IRAN THAN STILL IN THE COUNTRY.
DEPARTMENT REPEAT TEHRAN AS DESIRED. HARTMAN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)
AS TIME AND CONDITIONS PERMIT, WE WOULD APPRECIATE EMBASSY RESPONSES OR COMMENTS ON FOLLOWING POINTS THAT WILL HELP US BETTER UNDERSTAND PRESENT CONDITIONS

WE NEED A BETTER IDEA OF TALEGHANI'S PLACE IN THE POLITICAL FIRMAMENT, INCLUDING SOME INSIGHT INTO HIS PERSONALITY, IDEOLOGY OR POLITICAL ORIENTATION AND RELATIONSHIP WITH OTHER RELIGIOUS AND SECULAR LEADERS. WE UNDERSTAND PATTERSON SUPPED AT HIS TABLE AND WOULD APPRECIATE WHATEVER CRUMBS CAN BE SWEPT UP.

WHAT IS THE POLICE PRESENCE IN TEHRAN? TO WHAT EXTENT ARE PRECINCT HOUSES MANNED BY UNIFORMED PERSONNEL? DO THEY APPEAR ON STREETS FOR TRAFFIC CONTROL? IS THERE ANY EVIDENCE OF A REDUCTION IN NUMBER OF NON-POLICE PERSONNEL (MILITARY OR GUERRILLAS) BEING USED FOR LAW ENFORCEMENT PURPOSES? DO OTHER EMBASSIES HAVE A GUARD SIMILAR TO OURS?

WHAT IS HAPPENING AT THE UNIVERSITIES CAMPUSES AND IN THE HIGH SCHOOLS? WE HEARD FROM THE BRITISH THAT GUERRILLA GROUPS WERE BEING WITHDRAWN FROM TEHRAN UNIVERSITY AND THAT PLANS WERE IN MOTION TO RESUME CLASSES.
WE APPRECIATE EXCELLENT, DETAILED ECONOMIC SITREPS AND WILL WELCOME CONTINUING REPORTING ON ACTIVITIES AND TRENDS THAT INDICATE EXTENT OF RESUMPTION OF ECONOMIC ACTIVITY, PARTICULARLY OIL.
WE UNDERSTAND PATTERSON HAD DRAFTED REPORT ON WORKER GROUPS WHICH WAS NOT TRANSMITTED WHEN THE TROUBLES BEGAN. IF A DRAFT CAN BE FOUND, PLEASE CABLE.

QUESTION HAS BEEN RAISED RECENTLY WHETHER IT WOULD BE DESIRABLE FOR YOU TO PAY A CALL ON AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI. A CALL BECOMES MORE COMPLICATED IN POLITICAL TERMS WITH THE TRANSFER OF KHOMEINI TO QOM. WE WOULD APPRECIATE YOUR VIEWS ON THE VALUE OF SUCH AN INITIATIVE, AS WELL AS YOUR JUDGMENT AS TO THE BEST TIMING SHOULD A CALL BE APPROVED. WE HAVE IN MIND PROBLEM THAT MIGHT BE POSED FOR BAZARGAN SHOULD WE APPEAR TO BE BOOSTING THE REVOLUTIONARY APPARATUS OUTSIDE OF THE GOVERNMENT STRUCTURE.

1979STATE053019.subject: BELL HELICOPTER VISIT IRANIAN EMBASSY HAS CONFIRMED THAT GOI WISHES TO MEET WITH BELL HELICOPTER REPS IN TEHRAN. MCKINNON AND TWO

segments.text: IRANIAN EMBASSY HAS CONFIRMED THAT GOI WISHES TO MEET WITH BELL HELICOPTER REPS IN TEHRAN. MCKINNON AND TWO OTHERS ARE PLANNING TO ARRIVE FROM ATHENS ON MARCH 5. VANCE

1979STATE055210.subject: STARRETT CO. OPERATIONS HENRY BENECH OF STARRETT CALLED DEPTOFF TODAY TO REQUEST EMBASSY'S JUDGEMENT ON WHETHER HIS STAFF SHOULD RE

segments.text: HENRY BENECH OF STARRETT CALLED DEPTOFF TODAY TO REQUEST EMBASSY'S JUDGEMENT ON WHETHER HIS STAFF SHOULD RESPOND POSITIVELY TO IRANIAN KOMITE (NOT FURTHER IDENIIFIED) INVITATION TO RETURN. BENECH BELIEVES ARTHUR RADICE AND THREE OTHERS WOULD BE WILLING TO RETURN IF EMBASSY PERCEIVES NO OBJECTION. BENECH SAYS STARRETT HAS ESTABLISHED EFFECTIVE RELATIONSHIP WITH GOI OFFICIAL NOW SUPERVISING

ON MARCH 6, EX-SENATOR GOODELL AND DON AGGER OF DGA, INC. CALLED ON UNDERSECRETARY NEWSOM. GOODELL AND AGGER ARE LEAVING FOR MARAKECH MARCH 7 AT REQUEST OF KING HASSAN AND PRINCESS ASHRAF TO MEET WITH THE SHAH, POSSIBLY TO ADVISE HIM ON ESTABLISHING HIMSELF IN THE U.S. DGA WOULD PROVIDE SERVICES SUCH AS REAL ESTATE, PROTECTIVE SERVICES, LEGAL ADVICE, ETC. AGGER ASKED FOR NEWSOM'S GUIDANCE.

NEWSOM STATED THAT PRESIDENT HAD INDICATED TO THE SHAH HE WILL BE WELCOME IF HE CHOSE TO VISIT THE U.S. BUT, NEWSOM ADDED, THE PRESIDENT AND OTHERS IN THE USG WANT TO BE SURE THAT THE SHAH FULLY UNDERSTANDS THE DIMENSIONS OF THE CONCERNS WE HAVE REGARDING A POSSIBLE VISIT TO THE U.S. FOR US IT WOULD BE A VERY,VERY DIFFICULT PROPOSITION. WE ARE PARTICULARLY CONCERNED WITH THE SAFETY OF OUR PEOPLE IN IRAN. WE ARE AWARE OF THE ATTITUDE OF THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT AND GUERRILLAS TOWARDS THE MOROCCANS AND EGYPTIANS.
THE SECURITY SITUATION IN TEHRAN IS A CAUSE FOR REAL CONCERN UNDER THE PRESENT CHAOTIC CONDITIONS AND THERE IS A REAL DANGER THAT ARMED GANGS MIGHT SEEK TO TAKE AMERICANS HOSTAGE.

AGGER ASKED IF WE WOULD PROVIDE THE SHAH WITH OFFICIAL PROTECTION. NEWSOM REPLIED WE WOULD FOR A CERTAIN TIME. WE WOULD RECEIVE HIM WITH APPROPRIATE RESPECT AS A PERSON ON A PRIVATE VISIT. WE WOULD EXPECT TO END OFFICIAL PROTECTION SOONER RATHER THAN LATER AND THE SHAH WOULD NEED TO PROVIDE PROTECTIVE SERVICES. HE EMPHASIZED THAT THE SECURITY DIMENSION COULD BE SUBSTANTIAL -HE RECALLED THE MOB ACTION THAT OCCURRED IN JANUARY AT BEVERLY HILLS.

AGGER ASKED WHEN THE SHAH MIGHT BE EXPECTED. NEWSOM REPLIED THAT HE APPEARED TO BE THINKING OF ARRIVING WITHIN A WEEK TO 10 DAYS. AGGER SAID THAT DGA HAD NOT DECIDED WHETHER TO BECOME INVOLVED WITH THE SHAH'S PLANNING. GOODELL ADDED THAT HE UNDERSTOOD THE SHAH HAD TURNED AGAINST ZAHEDI AND WAS, THEREFORE, LOOKING TO DGA TO ASSIST HIM.
NEWSOM OUTLINED BRIEFLY THE CONCERNS WE HAD THAT THE SHAH MIGHT FACE LEGAL ACTIONS OR CONGRESSIONAL SUBPOENAS OR A MOVE TO ATTACH HIS ASSETS.

AGGER ASKED WEHTHER IT MIGHT BE EASIER FOR THE SHAH IF HE DEFERRED HIS VISIT TO THE U.S. FOR SOME MONTHS, POSSIBLY UP TO A YEAR. NEWSOM ANSWERED THAT IT COULD NOT BE MORE DIFFICULT NOW. HE COULD NOT PREDICT WHAT THE SITUATION WOULD BE IN THE FUTURE.

AGGER ASKED IF THERE WERE ANOTHER COUNTRY THAT MIGHT BE MORE FAVORABLE TOWARDS RECEIVING THE SHAH. NEWSOM REPLIED SOUTH AFRICA WOULD SEEM TO HAVE BETTER SECURITY AND FEWER POLITICAL PROBLEMS AND MIGHT WELL BE WILLING TO RECEIVE HIM.
YOU SHOULD DRAW ON THE FOREGOING IN CONVERSATIONS YOU HAVE WITH IRANIAN OR MOROCCAN REPRESENTATIVES. VANCE

1979STATE057224.subject: VARIOUS IRANIANS WOULD APPRECIATE IT IF YOU COULD TELL US SOMETHING ABOUT THE STATUS OF THE FOLLOWING IRANIANS IN WHOM IMPOR

segments.text: WOULD APPRECIATE IT IF YOU COULD TELL US SOMETHING ABOUT THE STATUS OF THE FOLLOWING IRANIANS IN WHOM IMPORTANT AMERICANS HAVE AN INTEREST. - MANUCHER GANGII - ABDULLA AND NASRATOLLA ENTEZAM - ALI SHAPURIAN - HE IS A SAVAK GENERAL WHO ONCE SERVED AS A HIGH OFFICIAL IN THE MINISTRY OF INFORMATION AND WAS MOST RECENTLY A DIRECTOR OF FAIRCHILD PUBLICATIONS, A SUBSIDIARY OF THE PAHLAVI FOUNDATION. SHAPURIAN IS THE FATHER-IN-LAW OF RICHARD SALES WHO IS WRITING A BOOK ON IRAN. WE HAVE SUGGESTED THAT SALES CONTACT THE IRANIAN EMBASSY TO CONVEY HIS CONCERN FOR HIS FATHER-IN-LAW'S

FOR SECURITY REASONS WE HAVE ARRANGED FOR THE CROWN PRINCE TO LEAVE THE UNITED STATES VIA A MAC AIRCRAFT. THIS AIRCRAFT IS A REGULARLY SCHEDULED MAC FLIGHT WHICH WILL BE DIVERTED FROM ITS MEDITERRANEAN DESTINATION TO DISEMBARK THE CROWN PRINCE IN MOROCCO. THE FLIGHT WILL CONTINUE ON ITS NORMAL SCHEDULE TO OFF-LOAD USAF CARGO. THERE WILL BE NO REPEAT NO IRANIAN PASSENGERS ON THE FLIGHT WHEN IT LEAVES MOROCCO.

MOROCCAN AMBASSADOR HAS ASKED HERE FOR STATEMENT OF U.S. POLICY WITH REGARD TO THE SHAH'S POSSIBLE TRAVEL PLANS. WE HAVE TOLD THE AMBASSADOR THAT WE WILL BE IN TOUCH DIRECTLY WITH THE SHAH AND KING HASSAN ON THIS SUBJECT.
EMBASSY RABAT, IF IT HAS NOT ALREADY DONE SO, SHOULD PROCEED TO REQUEST CLEARANCE PER STATE 57993.

DEPARTMENT IS RECEIVING INCREASING NUMBER OF QUERIES FROM U.S. FIRMS ABOUT STATUS OF PAYMENTS, CONTRACTS, AND OTHER FINANCIAL OBLIGATIONS INVOLVING PUBLIC AND PRIVATE IRANIAN ENTITIES. MANY ARE CONSIDERING LEGAL ACTION IN ATTEMPT TO SECURE PAYMENTS OR ASSETS. THESE ACTIONS, AS WELL AS OTHERS NOW CONTEMPLATED, COULD SERIOUSLY DISRUPT COMMERCE, COMPLICATE ATTEMPTS AT ECONOMIC RECOVERY, AND CREATE IMPRESSION IN MIND OF NEW GOVERNMENT THAT USG MIGHT SOMEHOW BE BEHIND THESE ACTIONS.

DURING PAST SEVERAL WEEKS, A NUMBER OF ATTACHMENT ACTIONS--AT LEAST FIVE--HAVE BEEN FILED IN U.S. COURTS. THE CASE CITED REFTELS INVOLVING SUIT BY BEHRING CO. IS AN EXAMPLE OF HOW THESE ACTIONS CAN EFFECTIVELY BLOCK IRANIAN FUNDS OR FREEZE ASSETS WHILE COURT DECIDES MERITS OF CASE. ACCORDING TO SURVEY OF MAJOR U.S. BANKS, A NUMBER OF SIMILAR ATTACHMENTS ARE UNDER CONSIDERATION.

ANOTHER MORE IMMEDIATE PROBLEM INVOLVES CALLING OF PERFORMANCE BONDS BY IRANIANS. UNITED TECHNOLOGY (UT) ADVISED DEPARTMENT MARCH 9 THAT IRANIANS BANK HAS CALLED $1.2 MILLION PERFORMANCE BOND WHICH WAS POSTED BY UT FOR $12 MILLION CONTRACT ITS SUBSIDIARY, ESSEX, HAD WITH TELECOMMUNICATIONS COMPANY OF IRAN (TCI) FOR SUPPLY OF CABLE. UNITED STATES THAT IT HAD MADE ALL DELIVERIES AND HAD BEEN PAID FULLY BY TCI. ACTION WAS TAKEN MARCH 2 BY CITIBANK, IRANIANS BANK'S AGENT, AFTER UNITED FAILED TO HONOR REQUEST BY IRANIANS BANK TO EXTEND BOND; UNITED FELT THEY HAD LIVED UP TO THEIR END OF THE CONTRACT AND THAT EXTENSION WAS NO LONGER NECESSARY.

UNITED FILED INJUNCTION ON MARCH 3 TO BLOCK ACTION BUT CITIBANK SUED IN FEDERAL COURT TO GET INJUNCTION LIFTED. UNITED FEELS CITIBANK'S LATEST SUIT WILL SUCCEED AND UNITED WILL BE FORCED TO PAY IN ABOUT TEN DAYS.

PERHAPS COINCIDENTALLY, THREE OTHER RESTRAINING ORDER REQUESTS WERE FILED TODAY BY U.S. CLIENTS TO BLOCK ANY SIMILAR ATTEMPTS AT CALLING BONDS (TWO WITH CHASE AND ONE WITH MORGAN). OTHER COMPANIES HAVE RECENTLY TAKEN SIMILAR ACTION IN FEAR OF UNJUSTIFIED CALLS BEING MADE ON THEIR STAND-BY LETTERS OF CREDIT.

ACTION REQUESTED: ON UNITED TECHNOLOGIES CASE, EMBASSY IS REQUESTED TO APPROACH IRANIANS BANK AND/OR TCI MANAGEMENT TO INDICATE UNITED'S WILLINGNESS TO DISCUSS THIS MATTER FURTHER. UNITED WOULD BE WILLING TO AGREE TO EXTENSION OF BOND IF THIS IS THE MAIN STICKING POINT. PERHAPS TCI COULD RETURN COMPLETED PERFORMANCE GUARANTEE TO IRANIANS BANK AS PROOF UNITED HAS BEEN ACTING IN GOOD FAITH. COMPANY CONTACT IS BOB BURGESS, PRESIDENT UNITED TECHNOLOGIES INTERNATIONAL (203-728-7000 OR TELEX 99-212 UNITED TECH.)

ON LARGER ISSUE, EMBASSY SHOULD ALERT APPROPRIATE OFFICIALS IN MINISTRIES OF FINANCE, COMMERCE, AND POSSIBLY CBI TO PROBLEM GROWING OUT OF BREAKDOWN IN COMMUNICATIONS BETWEEN U.S. FIRMS AND THEIR TRADING PARTNERS IN IRAN AND THE UNCERTAINTIES ARISING OUT OF INTERRUPTIONS IN PAYMENTS AND PERFORMANCE SCHEDULES. THESE ACTIONS COULD HAVE UNDESIRABLE REPERCUSSIONS ON U.S.-IRAN PRIVATE COMMERCIAL RELATIONSHIPS. USG WANTS TO BE HELPFUL BUT WE ARE OFFICIALLY OUTSIDE THESE INVESTMENT AND TRADE PROBLEMS. WE FEEL IT WOULD BE IN GOI'S BEST INTEREST TO RECOGNIZE DANGERS POSED BY THIS SITUATION AND BY THE LEGAL ACTIONS IT STIMULATES, WHICH COULD SNOWBALL.

IT WOULD BE USEFUL IF GOI COULD ESTABLISH SOME POINT OF CONTACT AT WASHINGTON EMBASSY OR IN U.S. THAT COMPANIES COULD APPROACH, WHO COULD HELP THEM IN COMMUNICATING WITH RIGHT PEOPLE IN IRAN. WE MIGHT ALSO SUGGEST THAT GOI CONSIDER PROPOSING TO COMPANIES SOME FORM OF NON-BINDING CONCILIATION WHICH OFFERS ALTERNATIVE TO FORMAL LEGAL ACTION. CHRISTOPHER
WE HAVE BEEN TOLD THAT NEWSPAPERS IN TEHRAN ON FRIDAY, MARCH 2, CONTAINED A LIST OF ALLEGED SAVAK AGENTS IN THE U.S.
IF SUCH LIST WAS IN FACT PUBLISHED, WE WOULD APPRECIATE SEEING IT. YOUR EVALUATION OF THE CREDENCE BEING ACCORDED SUCH LIST WOULD BE VALUABLE. CHRISTOPHER

DURING DEPSEC CONSULTATIONS IN ISLAMABAD LAST WEEK, IT BECAME CLEAR THAT GOP IS PROBABLY PLANNING TO ANNOUNCE ITS WITHDRAWAL FROM CENTO AS SOON AS THE PRESENT IRANIAN GOVERNMENT REITERATES PREVIOUS BAHKTIAR GOVERNMENT'S POSITION ON TERMINATION OF MEMBERSHIP. PAKISTANIS INDICATED THEY ARE GIVING SOME THOUGHT TO POSSIBILITY OF SUGGESTING A LARGE REGIONAL ASEAN-TYPE GROUPING FOR THE PURPOSES OF ECONOMIC COOPERATION AND POLITICAL CONSULTATION. DEPSEC SAID THAT IF CENTO IS TO BE TERMINATED, WE ARE VERY PLEASED THAT A SUBSTITUTE ORGANIZATION IS BEING CONSIDERED.

THERE COULD BE CLEAR BENEFITS TO US FROM A NEW REGIONAL COOPERATIVE ORGANIZATION RANGING FROM SOUTH ASIA TO JORDAN AND EGYPT, ALTHOUGH THERE MAY BE SOME POTENTIAL PITFALLS AS WELL. ONE OF THE PRINCIPAL BENEFITS IS THAT SUCH AN ORGANIZATION WOULD PROVIDE A SUBSTITUTE FOR CENTO AND HELP TEMPER THE POSSIBLY ADVERSE PUBLIC REACTION TO THE TERMINATION OF CENTO. MODERATE WEST AND SOUTH ASIAN STATES BROUGHT TOGETHER UNDER A SINGLE UMBRELLA FOR POLITICAL AND ECONOMIC COOPERATION AND CONSULTATION COULD PROVIDE ONE ANOTHER MUTUAL REASSURANCE AND POLITICAL SUPPORT AND HELP BULWARK THEM AGAINST OUTSIDE PRESSURES. INDIAN PARTICIPATION WOULD BE AN IMPORTANT QUESTION.
PAKISTANIS MAY SEEK TO EXCLUDE INDIA, AND THERE ARE POSSIBLE RISKS IN AN ORGANIZATION OF ISLAMIC COUNTRIES ALONE. ON THE OTHER HAND, CENTO ITSELF HAS NOT INCLUDED INDIA.

WE WOULD LIKE ADDRESSES' ASSESSMENTS NO LATER THAN COB MARCH 12 OF MOST LIKELY RESPONSE OF HOST GOVERNMENTS TO PROPOSAL FOR BROAD ASEAN-TYPE ORGANIZATION. WOULD ARAB STATES BE INTERESTED IN NON-ARAB PARTICIPATION OR IN JOINING ORGANIZATION WHICH WOULD NOT INCLUDE ALL ARAB STATES (E.G. THOSE IN NORTH AFRICA)? WOULD FACT THAT INITIATIVE CAME FROM PAKISTAN AND IRAN AND IN CONTEXT OF WITHDRAWAL FROM CENTO EFFECT HOST GOVERNMENT REACTION?
FOR MOSCOW: WE WOULD BE INTERESTED IN YOUR JUDGMENT OF SOVIET REACTIONS.
YOU SHOULD NOT AT THIS TIME APPROACH HOST GOVERNMENTS ON THIS SUBJECT. CHRISTOPHER H

1979STATE069550.subject: SECURITY OF EMBASSY PERSONNEL AND COMPOUND

segments.text: (CONFIDENTIAL - ENTIRE TEXT)

WE WELCOME ASSURANCES THAT PRIME MINISTER AND MINISTER OF DEFENSE HAVE GIVEN WITH RESPECT TO EMBASSY SECURITY. WE ALSO NOTE FROM REPORT OF SECURITY OFFICER COUGHLIN THAT SITUATION AT THE EMBASSY HAS IMPROVED OVER THE LAST MONTH. NEVERTHELESS, WE SHARE YOUR CONCERN THAT REACTION TO EGYPT-ISRAEL TREATY COULD PROVIDE OCCASION FOR ANOTHER ASSAULT BY ARMED RADICALS ON THE EMBASSY OR ITS PERSONNEL.

WE WOULD APPRECIATE YOUR VIEWS ON THE FOLLOWING POINTS: (1) ARE THERE ANY MILITARY OR CIVILIAN PERSONNEL ON THE EMBASSY ROLLS WHO MIGHT BE REMOVED EITHER PERMANENTLY OR TEMPORARILY FROM TEHRAN IN ORDER TO REDUCE THE NUMBER TO A BARE MINIMUM? COULD THIS BE DONE BY THE END OF THE WEEK? PERHAPS SOME PERSONNEL NOT ENGAGED IN ESSENTIAL TASKS COULD BE SENT TO ATHENS AND HELD THERE ON TDY BASIS UNTIL SITUATION SEEMED IMPROVED. (2) HAVE THERE BEEN ANY PRACTICAL MEASURES TAKEN TO IMPLEMENT GOI ASSURANCES OF IMPROVED PROTECTION? IF NOT, SHOULD WE MAKE A RENEWED APPEAL TO PRIME MINISTER AND MINISTER OF DEFENSE?

ARE THERE OTHER SECURITY MEASURES WE SHOULD TAKE TO ENHANCE PROTECTION FOR THE EMBASSY? SPECIFICALLY, ARE YOU CONFIDENT THAT PRESENT NUMBER OF MARINES IS SUFFICIENT TO HANDLE THEIR RESPONSIBILITIES? WOULD IT BE POSSIBLE OR USEFUL TO OBTAIN GOI AGREEMENT TO ARMING MARINES ON GUARD DUTY? (4) WE WONDER IF IT WOULD NOT BE ADVISABLE TO WITHDRAW SENSITIVE KG-13 CRYPTO EQUIPMENT COMPONENTS UNTIL AFTER IMMINENT DANGER HAS PASSED. THIS WOULD SLOW DOWN TRAFFIC HANDLING SOMEWHAT BUT SHOULD NOT SERIOUSLY INTERFERE WITH YOUR OPERATIONS. NEWSOM

1979STATE070530.subject: SECURITY OF EMBASSY PERSONNEL AND COMPOUND

segments.text: (C-ENTIRE TEXT).

APPRECIATE POINTS MADE REFTEL. SAUNDERS TODAY SPOKE WITH ROUHANI AND BELIEVE HE WILL PASS MESSAGE TO YAZDI THAT EMBASSY AND ITS PERSONNEL MUST BE PROTECTED. FROM ROUHANI'S REMARKS, HOWEVER, WE DOUBT YAZDI WILL MAKE ANY ATTEMPT TO PREVENT PEACEFUL DEMONSTRATIONS IN THE VICINITY OF THE EMBASSY. THESE COULD OBVIOUSLY GET OUT OF HAND, ENDANGERING AMERICAN PERSONNEL.

ACCORDINGLY, WE BELIEVE YOU SHOULD TAKE STEPS TO REDUCE NUMBER OF LESS ESSENTIAL MISSION PERSONNEL. OUR IMPRESSION IS THAT THERE MAY BE SOME MEMBERS OF THE MILITARY CONTINGENT WHOARE NOT ACTIVELY ENGAGED IN ON-GOING TASKS. DOD IS ADDRESSINGTHIS SUBJECT SEPARATELY. WE WOULD LIKEYOU AND GENERAL GAST TO CONSIDER WHETHERTHESE AND POSSIBLY OTHER LESS ESSENTIAL PERSONNEL MTGHT (A) BE REASSIGNED, OR (B) WITHDRAWN TO ATHENS OR ANOTHER NEARBY POINT AND HELD IN TDY STATUS PENDING A REQUIREMENT FOR THEIR SERVICES IN TEHRAN. IF POSSIBLE, WE WOULD HOPE THAT SOME OF THESE PERSONNEL COULD BEGIN TO MOVE OUT OF TEHRAN DURING THE NEXT FEW DAYS.

WE SUGGEST IT WOULD BE PRUDENT TO MOVE PERSONNEL WHO RESIDE OUT;IDE OF PROTECTED AREAS (EMBASSY COMPOUND OR HILTON HOTEL) TO ONE OF THOSE AREAS DURING THIS PERIOD WHEN ATTACKS ON AMERICANS ARE CONSIDERED MOST
ASSTSEC SAUNDERS MET WITH SHAHRYAR ROUHANI MARCH 21. CHARGE FAGHIH ARRIVED MIDWAY IN CONVERSATION. PRECHT SAT IN.

AFTER EXCHANGE OF PLEASANTRIES AT FIRST MEETING WITH ROUHANI, SAUNDERS TURNED DISCUSSION TO EGYPTIAN-ISRAELI TREATY AND US RELATIONS WITH THE PALESTINIANS. HE SAID WE WERE AWARE OF CLOSE PLO-GOI TIES AND WANTED IRANIANS TO UNDERSTAND THAT US WAS NOT OPPOSED TO PALESTINIAN ASPIRATIONS. WE HAD DIFFERENCES WITH PLO AS TO HOW TO PROCEED. WE BELIEVED TREATY WAS PART OF A NEGOTIATING PROCESS THAT REPRESENTED BEST MEANS OF GETTING BOTH SIDES TO THE POINT OF DEALING WITH ISSUES THAT WERE CENTRAL TO PALESTINIAN CONCERNS.

THIS WAS A CRUCIAL MOMENT FOR THE MIDDLE EAST AND WE WERE CONCERNED THAT JUST AT THE TIME WHEN WE WOULD BE TURNING ATTENTION TO PALESTINIAN ISSUES THE US COULD BECOME THE TARGET OF ATTACKS BY THE PLO THROUGHOUT THE REGION. THERE WERE REPORTS THAT THERE WOULD BE DEMONSTRATIONS AGAINST US EMBASSIES THROUGHOUT THE AREA.

WE HOPE THAT THE GOI WOULD UNDERSTAND THAT, ALTHOUGH WE MIGHT DIFFER ON DETAILS AND PROCEDURES RELATING TO THE PALESTINIAN QUESTIONS, WE BELIEVED WE SHARED WITH GOI COMMON OBJECTIVES FOR THE PALESTINIAN PEOPLE. PRESIDENT CARTER INTENDED TO PUT FULL WEIGHT OF THE US BEHIND NEGOTIATIONS WHICH COULD MAKE PROGRESS IN ACHIEVING THOSE OBJECTIVES.

AGAINST THIS BACKGROUND SAUNDERS ASKED THAT ROUHANI CONVEY TO COLLEAGUES IN TEHRAN OUR CONCERN THAT AMERICAN EMBASSY AND ITS PERSONNEL BE ADEQUATELY PROTECTED. WE THOUGHT THERE WOULD BE A SPECIAL PROBLEM OVER THE COMING WEEKEND AND THE DAYS THEREAFTER AND HOPED THAT IT WOULD BE POSSIBLE TO PROVIDE AUGMENTED SECURITY FOR OUR COMPOUND.

ROUHANI NOTED THAT HE WAS NOT SPEAKING ON BEHALF OF GOI BUT BELIEVED THAT HE CONVEYED THE SENTIMENTS OF GOVERNMENT LEADERS. HE QUESTIONED WHETHER THE EGYPTIAN-ISRAELI TREATY WOULD INDEED HELP SECURE PALESTINIAN RIGHTS. GOI BELIEVED THAT THE US APPROACHED THE PROBLEM WITH GOOD WILL BUT IRANIANS WERE SKEPTICAL AS TO THE EFFECTS OF THE TREATY. THE CURRENT PROCESS SEEMED TO LEAVE ISRAEL WITH A VETO OVER PALESTINIAN RIGHTS.

FURTHER, ROUHANI INDICATED THAT IRANIANS WERE SUSPICIOUS OF DEFENSE AGREEMENTS THE US WAS WORKING OUT WITH SAUDI ARABIA, ISRAEL, AND EGYPT, AND THE "US BASE AT OMAN." (HE NOTED ALSO THAT IRAN WAS NOT HAPPY WITH ALLEGATIONS BEING MADE BY AFGHANISTAN AND THE USSR AGAINST IRANIAN ACTIONS AFFECTING AFGHANISTAN.) ROUHANI WENT ON TO SAY THAT THE PERCEIVED ANTI-IRANIAN ATTITUDE IN THE US, TREATMENT OF STUDENTS HERE, AND DEPICTION OF IRAN IN US NEWSPAPERS WERE CONTINUING TO FUEL ANTI-AMERICANISM IN IRAN. NEVERTHELESS, HE SAID HE WAS CONFIDENT THE GOVERNMENT WOULD TAKE THE NECESSARY MEASURES TO PROTECT AMERICANS.
THERE WERE OBVIOUS PROBLEMS THE GOVERNMENT FACED IN EXERTING ITS WILL, BUT IT WOULD DO EVERYTHING POSSIBLE. GOI WOULD NOT, HOWEVER, BLOCK PEACEFUL DEMONSTRATIONS WHICH IT TOLERATED AGAINST ITSELF.

SAUNDERS EMPHASIZED THAT THE US WAS DOING NOTHING IN THE MIDDLE EAST AGAINST IRANIAN INTERESTS. NONE OF THE RECENT HIGH-LEVEL US VISITORS HAD HAD ANY CONVERSATIONS WITH ANY OF THE COUNTRIES THEY VISITED WHICH WAS DIRECTED AGAINST IRAN. OUR MILITARY ASSISTANCE TO SAUDI ARABIA AND NORTH YEMEN WAS DESIGNED TO HELP THEM MEET THEIR LEGITIMATE NEEDS AND DEFENSE REQUIREMENTS. WE WOULD DO THE SAME FOR IRAN SHOULD THE IRANIANS MAKE A REQUEST. WE ASKED NOTHING FOR OURSELVES IN THIS REGARD.

SAUNDERS AGREED THAT BEGIN'S RECENT STATEMENTS ON THE WEST BANK DID NOT HELP THE PROCESS. NEVERTHELESS, WE BELIEVED IT WAS ESSENTIAL TO POSE SPECIFIC ISSUES AND QUESTIONS FOR THE GOVERNMENT OF ISRAEL TO DEAL WITH. ONLY IN THAT WAY WOULD ISRAELI POLICIES BE ALTERED. WE HAD ALREADY SEEN IN THE EGYPTIAN-ISRAELI AGREEMENT A WILLINGNESS ON THE PART OF THE ISRAELIS TO BACK AWAY FROM POSITIONS FIRMLY HELD AS RECENTLY AS A YEAR AND A HALF AGO. FOR THE FIRST TIME IN THIRTY YEARS PALESTINIAN ISSUES WERE NOW AT THE TOP OF THE ARAB-ISRAELI AGENDA.
WE WERE LATE IN TURNING TO THE PALESTINIANS, BUT NO PREVIOUS ADMINISTRATION HAD ACHIEVED AS MUCH AS PRESIDENT CARTER HAD IN FOCUSING ATTENTION ON THE PALESTINIANS.

TURNING TO IRAN'S CURRENT PROBLEMS, SAUNDERS SAID WE WERE CONCERNED WITH THE PROBLEMS IRAN FACED IN DEALING WITH THE KURDS AND WE WANTED TO DO ANYTHING APPROPRIATE TO ASSIST THAT THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT MIGHT WISH. HE NOTED THAT THE PROBLEM IN SANANDAJ MIGHT HAVE HAD ITS ORIGIN IN A SHORTAGE OF WHEAT. IF THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT NEEDED OUR ASSISTANCE IN EXPEDITING GRAIN SHIPMENTS WE WOULD BE GLAD TO SEE WHAT WE COULD DO.

ROUHANI INDICATED THAT SOME IRANIANS IN TEHRAN BELIEVE THAT FOREIGN HANDS MIGHT BE BEHIND THE PROBLEMS WITH THE KURDS. SAUNDERS EMPHASIZED THAT "HARD, COLD US NATIONAL INTERESTS" DICTATED THAT WE SUPPORT THE TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY OF IRAN. THERE HAD BEEN A US CONNECTION WITH THE KURDS, BUT THAT ENDED COMPLETELY IN 1975; THE US HAD NOTHING TO DO WITH THE KURDS AT THIS TIME. ROUHANI SPECULATED THAT POSSIBLY PRIVATE AMERICANS WERE INVOLVED WITH THE KURDS OR BALUCHIS. POSSIBLY THESE AMERICANS WERE WORKING WITH INTEREST GROUPS NOT LINKED TO THE US GOVERNMENT.

SAUNDERS SAID THAT IF THE GOI HAD ANY NAMES OR EVIDENCE WE WOULD LIKE TO HAVE IT IMMEDIATELY SO THAT WE COULD CHECK OUT THE FACTS. WE HAD NO INFORMATION THAT ANY AMERICANS WHATSOEVER WERE IN THEKURDISH OR BALUCHI AREAS.

CONTINUING ON THIS THEME, ROUHANI SAID THAT REZA BARAHENI WAS BACK IN AZERBAIJAN. DOCUMENTS HAD BEEN FOUND THAT PROVED HE WAS A SAVAK AGENT. HE AND HIS COMMITTEE FOR ARTISTIC AND INTELLECTUAL FREEDOM FOR IRAN HAD INVITED KATE MILLET TO IRAN. ROUHANI IMPLIED THERE WAS A CONSPIRACY, POSSIBLY WITH OFFICIAL CONNECTIONS. PRECHT SAID HE HAD CHECKED THIS OUT EARLIER AND WE COULD ASSURE ROUHANI CATEGORICALLY THAT THERE WAS NO USG CONNECTION WITH ANY OF THE RECENT PRIVATE AMERICAN VISITORS WHO HAVE BEEN INVOLVED IN IRAN'S INTERNAL POLITICS.
MEETING ENDED CORDIALLY WITH ROUHANI STATING HE WOULD SEND A CABLE TO TEHRAN TO URGE INCREASED PROTECTION FOR EMBASSY PERSONNEL.

1979STATE074905.subject: SOVIET ACTIVITIES IN NEAR EAST/SOUTH ASIA

segments.text: SECRET (ENTIRE TEXT)

WE BELIEVE THAT PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN'S INQUIRY ABOUT REPORTS OF SOVIET PURCHASE OF LARGE QUANTITIES OF RIALS REFLECTS A PREOCCUPATION THAT MIGHT BE USED TO OPEN A DIALOGUE WITH HIM ON OUR MUTUAL CONCERNS ABOUT SOVIET ACTIVITIES IN THE AREA.

WITH THIS POSSIBILITY IN MIND, WE HAVE PREPARED THE RESUME WHICH FOLLOWS OF RECENT SOVIET ACTION IN AFGHANISTAN, IRAQ, AND PDRY WHICH YOU MIGHT USE IN SUCH A DIALOGUE. WE WILL SEND OTHER INFORMATION--ESPECIALLY ON SOVIET TIES WITH ETHIOPIA, SYRIA, AND PALESTINIAN ORGANIZATIONS--SHORTLY, IF YOU THINK IT WOULD BE HELPFUL.

WE HAVE NOT ATTEMPTED TO PACKAGE THE INFORMATION IN THE FORM OF TALKING POINTS, CONSIDERING THAT YOU ARE IN A BETTER POSITION TO SHAPE THE CONTENT AND STYLE OF THE APPROACH. YOU AND YOUR STAFF MAY ALSO WANT TO SPREAD THE DIALOGUE OVER A PERIOD OF TIME AND TO TALK TO OTHER IRANIAN OFFICIALS. THE OBJECTIVE SHOULD BE TO STRESS THE MUTUALITY OF OUR CONCERNS ABOUT SOVIET ACTIVITIES AND TO MAKE BAZARGAN AWARE OF THE FACT THAT WE MAY BE USEFUL TO HIM ON THIS SCORE.
AFGHANISTAN

SINCE 1955, THE SOVIETS HAVE BEEN THE LARGEST CONTRIBUTORS OF FOREIGN AID TO AFGHANISTAN AND PROVIDED OVER 95 PERCENT OF ITS MILITARY RECEIPTS. TO DATE THEY HAVE DELIVERED OVER DOLS 600 MILLION IN MILITARY AND OVER ONE BILLION IN ECONOMIC AID. OVER 1,500 AFGHANS HAVE RECEIVED ECONOMIC TRAINING IN THE USSR; ANOTHER 4,000, MILITARY TRAINING.

THE SOVIETS HAD DEVELOPED GENERALLY GOOD RELATIONS WITH THE DAOUD GOVERNMENT, AND THERE IS NO EVIDENCE THAT THEY WERE BEHIND THE COUP OF APRIL 27 WHICH BROUGHT TARAKI TO POWER. HOWEVER, THEY WELCOMED THIS CHANGE AND MOVED QUICKLY TO TURN IT TO THEIR ADVANTAGE. BY EARLY JUNE, THE USSR HAD (AT THE REQUEST OF THE TARAKI REGIME): (A)--NEARLY DOUBLED THE NUMBER OF ITS MILITARY ADVISORS IN AFGHANISTAN; (B)--PLACED SOVIET PERSONNEL IN VIRTUALLY EVERY AFGHAN MINISTRY, ESPECIALLY DEFENSE AND INTERIOR; (C)--TAKEN OVER THE TRAINING OF AFGHAN POLICE AND SECURITY FORCES; (D)--SIGNED OVER 30 ECONOMIC DEALS NEGOTIATED UNDER THE DAOUD REGIME.

SINCE THEN, KABUL AND MOSCOW HAVE REPORTEDLY SIGNED A NEW ARMS AGREEMENT, AND, DURING TARAKI'S VISIT TO MOSCOW IN DECEMBER, AGREED ON SEVERAL MULTI-MILLION DOLLAR AID PROJECTS. THE SOVIET PRESENCE IN AFGHANISTAN HAS ALSO GROWN. THERE ARE NOW ABOUT 2,000 SOVIET ECONOMIC ADVISORS AND 600-1,000 MILITARY ADVISORS IN THE COUNTRY; SOME OF THE LATTER ACCOMPANY AFGHAN PATROLS OPERATING AGAINST THE MOUNTAIN TRIBES. MOSCOW IS ALSO PROVIDING SOME LOGISTICAL SUPPORT, AND IN THE RECENT FIGHTING AROUND HERAT MAY HAVE FLOWN IN SUPPLIES AND EVEN COMBAT SORTIES AGAINST REBEL TARGETS.

DURING TAKARI'S VISIT TO MOSCOW IN DECEMBER, THE SOVIETS AND AFGHANS CAPPED THEIR GROWING RELATIONSHIP WITH A FRIENDSHIP AND COOPERATION TREATY. THE TREATY UNDERSCORED WHAT BREZHNEV CALLED "THE QUALITATIVELY NEW CHARACTER" OF AFGHAN-SOVIET RELATIONS. FROM MOSCOW'S PERSPECTIVE, IT LEGITIMIZED THE SOVIET ROLE IN AFGHANISTAN AND PROVIDED A LEGAL BASIS FOR HELPING THE TARAKI GOVERNMENT SURVIVE. THE KABUL REGIME PROBABLY SAW THE TREATY AS A MEANS OF BOLSTERING ITS OWN POSITION AND DISCOURAGING OPPONENTS AT HOME AND ABROAD.

UNLIKE THE OTHER EIGHT FRIENDSHIP AND COOPERATION TREATIES THE USSR HAS SIGNED WITH THIRD WORLD COUNTRIES, THE AFGHAN ACCORD DOES NOT PLEDGE MUTUAL CONSULTATION SHOULD EITHER PARTY BE THREATENED. THE TREATY DOES NOT EVEN MENTION THE WORD "THREAT." THIS FORMULATION ALLOWS THE SOVIETS TO JUSTIFY THEIR PRESENCE IN AFGHANISTAN EVEN IN TIMES OF PEACE, BUT DOES NOT NECESSARILY TIE THEM TO KABUL'S DEFENSE.

THE SOVIETS WERE RATHER SILENT ABOUT THE TRIBAL UNREST IN AFGHANISTAN UNTIL LAST WEEKEND, PERHAPS OUT OF A BELIEF THAT THE LESS SAID THE BETTER; DRAWING TOO MUCH ATTENTION TO THE REVOLT WOULD ONLY SPOTLIGHT THE SOVIET INVOLVEMENT IN ITS SUPPRESSION. ON MARCH 19, HOWEVER, PRAVDA BROKE THE SILENCE WITH AN AUTHORITATIVE COMMENTARY BY I. ALEKSANDROV ACCUSING PAKISTAN, EGYPT, AND CHINA OF SUPPORTING COUNTER-REVOLUTIONARY CONSERVATIVE MUSLIM GROUPS IN AFGHANISTAN. ALTHOUGH A PRAVDA EDITOR SUBSEQUENTLY CLAIMED THAT THIS ATTACK WAS MAINLY DIRECTED AT CHINA, THE PRESS LATER IN THE WEEK ACCUSED THE US, UK, AND IRAN OF MEDDLING IN INTERNAL AFGHAN AFFAIRS.

THE APPEARANCE OF THESE ACCUSATIONS INDICATES THAT MOSCOW IS INCREASINGLY CONCERNED ABOUT THE RELIGIOUS AND TRIBAL THREAT TO THE NEW AFGHAN GOVERNMENT. THE "LOSS" OF AFGHANISTAN WOULD BE A SEVERE STRATEGIC AND PSYCHOLOGICAL BLOW AND THE SOVIETS CAN THUS BE EXPECTED TO INCREASE THEIR MILITARY AID AND ADVISORY FORCE TO INSURE THAT THE PDP REMAINS IN POWER.
IRAQ

SINCE THE MID-1950S, IRAQ HAS RECEIVED NEARLY DOLS 5 BILLION IN SOVIET MILITARY AID AND OVER DOLS 700 MILLION IN ECONOMIC ASSISTANCE, WHILE NEARLY 3,000 IRAQIS HAVE RECEIVED TECHNICAL TRAINING IN THE USSR AND EAST EUROPE, AND 4,000 OR MORE MILITARY TRAINING. AT PRESENT THERE ARE APPROXIMATELY 1,000 SOVIET MILITARY ADVISORS AND 4,000 ECONOMIC ADVISORS IN IRAQ, PLUS NEARLY 2,500 EAST EUROPEAN ECONOMIC ADVISORS.

SINCE THE 1967 ARAB-ISRAELI WAR, SOVIET-IRAQI RELATIONS HAVE REMAINED RELATIVELY GOOD. A FRIENDSHIP AND COOPERATION TREATY WAS SIGNED IN 1972, AN ACCORD GENERALLY PARALLEL TO THE EGYPTIAN TREATY OF 1971. THE TREATY'S REFERENCE TO IMPROVED RELATIONS AT ALL LEVELS AND TO THE IMPORTANCE OF "POLITICAL COOPERATION" WOULD INDICATE THAT MOSCOW INTENDS TO DEVELOP A CLOSE WORKING RELATIONSHIP WITH THE IRAQIS.

IN GENERAL, THIS HOPE HAS BORNE FRUIT. SINCE THE USSR'S EXPULSION FROM EGYPT IN 1972, SOVIET POLICY IN THE MIDDLE EAST HAS INCREASINGLY CENTERED ON IRAQ, APPARENTLY ON THE ASSUMPTION THAT BAGHDAD IS A KEY TO EXPANDED SOVIET INFLUENCE THROUGHOUT THE REGION. SINCE THE SADAT PEACE INITIATIVE IN 1977 AND THE CAMP DAVID MEETING LAST FALL, MOSCOW HAS INCREASED ITS SUPPORT FOR IRAQ BOTH IN TERMS OF PROPAGANDA AND MILITARY HARDWARE. BAGHDAD NOW RECEIVES SOME OF THE MOST SOPHISTICATED SOVIET MILITARY EQUIPMENT AVAILABLE--OFTEN BEFORE SOME OF THE USSR'S EAST EUROPEAN ALLIES DO.
AT THE SAME TIME, DURING SADDAM HUSSAYN'S VISIT TO MOSCOW IN DECEMBER, THE SOVIETS PROMISED MORE ASSISTANCE FOR AGRICULTURAL AND HYDROELECTRIC PROJECTS IN THE EUPHRATES RIVER VALLEY.

IN RETURN, THE IRAQIS HAVE HELPED SMOOTH DIFFERENCES BETWEEN SYRIA AND THE USSR, AND GENERALLY ESPOUSED SOVIETSUPPORTED POSITIONS IN THE MIDDLE EAST AND IN INTERNATIONAL FORUMS. WHILE THERE HAVE BEEN SOME DISAGREEMENTS OVER BAGHDAD'S OFTEN HARSH TREATMENT OF NATIVE IRAQI COMMUNISTS, THE SOVIETS FOR THE MOST PART HAVE EMPHASIZED STATE-TOSTATE RELATIONS AND IGNORED THE PERSECUTION AND, OFTEN, EXECUTIONS OF THEIR MARXIST BRETHERN. IN THE PAST, THE IRAQI COMMUNIST PARTY MEMBERSHIP HAS BEEN HEAVILY DRAWN FROM IRAQI KURDISH RANKS, AND THE KURDS IN IRAQ MAINTAIN CONTACTS WITH MOSCOW. THERE IS NO EVIDENCE, HOWEVER, THAT MOSCOW IS CURRENTLY INCITING THE KURDS IN IRAQ (OR IRAN).
PDRY

FOLLOWING THE COUP LAST JUNE THAT BROUGHT ISMAIL TO POWER IN THE PDRY, THE SOVIETS MOVED QUICKLY TO CONSOLIDATE AND EXPAND THEIR ALREADY SIZABLE PRESENCE IN SOUTH YEMEN. THE NUMBER OF SOVIET MILITARY ADVISORS NEARLY DOUBLED, AND BY FALL, SOVIET ADVISORS WERE ENSCONCED IN VIRTUALLY ALL OF THE GOVERNMENT MINISTRIES. AT PRESENT THERE ARE AT LEAST 500 SOVIET MILITARY AND 600 ECONOMIC ADVISORS IN THE PDRY. IN ADDITION, THERE ARE SOME 475 EAST EUROPEAN ECONOMIC ADVISORS AND OVER 1,000 CUBANS. (THERE MAY ALSO BE SOME ETHIOPIANS BUT THEIR NUMBERS ARE UNKNOWN.) SINCE 1968, THE SOVIETS HAVE SUPPLIED THE PDRY WITH OVER DOLS 400 MILLION IN ECONOMIC AND MILITARY AID.

MOSCOW'S INTEREST IN THE PDRY APPEARS TO BE MAINLY STRATEGIC. EVEN BEFORE THEIR EXPULSION FROM SOMALIA, THE SOVIETS HAD SOUGHT ACCESS TO SOUTH YEMENI NAVAL AND AIR FACILITIES. THE LOSS OF THE SOVIET BASE IN BERBERA ADDED AN ELEMENT OF URGENCY. THE SOVIETS HAVE YET TO GAIN THE KIND OF ACCESS IN ADEN THAT THEY ENJOYED IN BERBERA, BUT AN ETHIOPIAN PORT MAY BE DESTINED FOR THAT ROLE.

IN ADDITION TO STRATEGIC INTERESTS, THE SOVIETS ALSO VIEW THEIR PRESENCE IN THE PDRY AS A MEANS OF EXPANDING THEIR INFLUENCE IN THE GENERAL AREA OF THE ARABIAN PENINSULA AND THE RED SEA, THUS PRESSURING THE STATES IN THAT REGION TO BE MORE ACCOMMODATING TO SOVIET INTERESTS AND POLICY.

WHATEVER THE REASONS, THE SOVIETS HAVE INCREASED THEIR MILITARY DELIVERIES TO THE PDRY OVER THE LAST NINE MONTHS. THIS EVIDENTLY EMBOLDENED THE SOUTH YEMENIS TO INCREASE THEIR PRESSURE ON THE YAR WHICH IN TURN LED TO THE RECENT CLASHES ALONG THE YAR-PDRY BORDER.

THE OUTBREAK IN FIGHTING LAST MONTH PRESENTED THE SOVIETS WITH A TICKLISH IF NOT UNWELCOME SITUATION. WHILE THEY SUPPORTED THE PDRY, THEY HAD ALSO BEEN TRYING TO IMPROVE RELATIONS WITH BOTH THE YAR AND SAUDI ARABIA. THEY CLAIMED REPEATEDLY THAT THEY WERE NOT INVOLVED IN THE FIGHTING AND FAVORED A NEGOTIATED PEACE. IT IS LIKELY, HOWEVER, THAT ADEN HAD SOVIET AND CUBAN LOGISTICAL SUPPORT AND ASSISTANCE IN PLANNING OPERATIONS. VANCE UNQUOTE VANCE ORIGINAL DISTRIBUTION: INR/SSBL,INTE,DODE,SMS,EUR,TRSE,AID,ACDA,NEA

KING HASSAN HAS DECIDED THAT THE SHAH MUST LEAVE MOROCCO BY FRIDAY, MARCH 30. HASSAN IS PREPARED TO PROVIDE A MOROCCAN AIRCRAFT TO TRANSPORT THE SHAH AND HIS PARTY TO THEIR NEXT DESTINATION. THE SHAH IS RESIGNED TO THIS DECISION AS WELL AS TO THE FACT THAT SECURITY CONSIDERATIONS PRECLUDE HIS COMING TO THE UNITED STATES.

THE BAHAMAS IS THE MOST LIKELY IMMEDIATE DESTINATION FOR THE SHAH. WHILE THE GOB HAS NOT YET SAID IT WOULD RECEIVE HIM, IT HAS ALSO NOT CLOSED THE DOOR IN TWO RECENT SOUNDINGS AND IS BEING INFORMED TODAY OF THE FRIDAY TIMING. IF THE GOB ALLOWS HIM TO COME, WE BELIEVE HIS STAY WILL BE TEMPORARY, WHILE ARRANGEMENTS ARE MADE BY HIS REPRESENTATIVES FOR ONWARD TRAVEL TO MEXICO. TRAVEL TO THE BAHAMAS, IF IT TAKES PLACE, WILL BE BY MOROCCAN OR CHARTERED AIRCRAFT.
SHOULD THESE PLANS NOT WORK OUT, OTHER COUNTRIES WHICH MIGHT RECEIVE THE SHAH ARE ARGENTINA, PARAGUAY AND SOUTH AFRICA.

OUR ROLE HAS BEEN TO ASSIST THE SHAH IN FINDING A COUNTRY WILLING TO RECEIVE HIM. WE HAVE MADE DISCREET SOUNDINGS WITH A NUMBER OF GOVERNMENTS AND HAVE BEEN WORKING WITH THE MOROCCANS AND SEVERAL PRIVATE AMERICANS ACTING AS INTERMEDIARIES IN TRYING TO ARRANGE HIS RELOCATION.
WE WILL KEEP YOU INFORMED AS HIS MOVES PROGRESS.

UNDERLYING LEGAL DISPUTE DIRECTLY AFFECTS INTEGRITY OF IRREVOCABLE LETTERS OF CREDIT ISSUED BY AMERICAN BANKS (IN THIS CASE CHASE MANHATTAN) IN CONNECTION WITH INTERNATIONAL COMMERCIAL TRANSACTIONS. A PERFORMANCE BOND IN THE FORM OF AN IRREVOCABLE LETTER OF CREDIT (LOC) HAS BEEN ISSUED IN FAVOR OF THE KWPA.

THE AMERICAN SUPPLIER, THE KMW COMPANY, FEARS THAT KWPA OR A HOLDER IN DUE COURSE OF THE PERFORMANCE BOND ACTING IN BAD FAITH WILL ORDER PAYMENT OF THAT BOND BY THE BANK ETEBARATE, WHICH IN TURN COULD DEMAND PAYMENT FROM CHASE MANHATTAN, EVEN THOUGH THERE HAS BEEN NO BREACH OF CONTRACT BY THE AMERICAN SUPPLIER, WHICH IS THE PRE-CONDITION CONTEMPLATED FOR PAYMENT OF THE PERFORMANCE BOND. THE FAILURE OF THE CONTRACT TO BE CONSUMMATED TO DATE IS CLEARLY D THE BREAKDOWN OF CHANNELS OF COMMUNICATION AND THE UNSETTLED STATE OF COMMERCIAL AND GOVERNMENTAL AFFAIRS IN IRAN FOLLOWING THE RECENT REVOLUTION.

CHASE MANHATTAN AND A NUMBER OF OTHER US. BANKS ARE BEING SUED BY US. SUPPLIERS TO IRAN TO ENJOIN PAYMENT BY THESE BANKS ON OUTSTANDING PERFORMANCE BONDS. THE BANKS CLAIM THAT BECAUSE THESE BONDS ARE IRREVOCABLE, THEY MUST BE PAID ON DEMAND AND THAT NEITHER THE BANKS NOR THE COURTS ARE FREE TO PIERCE BENEATH A DEMAND FOR PAYMENT TO DETERMINE ITS BONA FIDES. OTHERWISE, THE BANKS ARGUE, IF PAYMENT OF IRREVOCABLE LETTERS OF CREDIT ISSUED BY AMERICAN BANKS CAN BE ENJOINED OR QUESTIONED BY US. COURTS, SUCH LETTERS WILL BE CONSIDERED UNRELIABLE AND THIS WILL LEAD TO MAJOR ADVERSE CONSEQUENCES FOR AMERICAN INTERNATIONAL TRADE AND FINANCE.

THE COURT IN THE KMW V. CHASE MANHATTAN BANK CASE HAS ISSUED A TEMPORARY INJUNCTION AGAINST CHASE PROHIBITING IT FROM PAYMENT OF THE LETTER OF CREDIT IN QUESTION. CHASE INFORMED ITS CORRESPONDENT BANK IN TEHRAN, BANK ETEBARATE, OF THE N.Y. DISTRICT COURT ACTION.

IN RESPONSE TO THAT INFORMATION, THE TEHRAN BANK REPLIED THAT IT CONSIDERED THE LOC TO BE IRREVOCABLE, THAT DUE TO SUSPENSION OF THE COUNTER INDEMNITY UNQUOTE IT IS NOW UNDER AN OBLIGATION TO PAY KWPA EVEN IN THE ABSENCE OF A DEMAND FOR PAYMENT BY KWPA, AND, FURTHER, THAT IF CHASE REFUSED TO PAY, BANK ETEBARATE WOULD CONTACT THE FINANCEMINISTRY AND THE CENTRAL BANK OF IRAN ABOUT THIS MATTER. MOREOVER, CHASE CONTENDS THAT THE INJUNCTION MAY NOT BE ENFORCED IN A FOREIGN COURT SHOULD ONE OF CHASE'S FOREIGN BRANCHES BE SUED FOR PAYMENT OF LOC.

HENCE, IN VIEW OF THE SIGNIFICANT DEVELOPMENTS WHICH COULD FLOW FROM THIS INJUNCTION, DEPT CONSIDERS IT CRUCIAL THAT KMW CORP. AND KWPA AUTHORITIES OPEN CHANNELS OF COMMUNICATION TO RESOLVE THE UNDERLYING LAWSUIT.

FOLLOWING IS TEXT OF LETTER SENT MARCH 28 VIA IRANIAN EMBASSY TO PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN: BEGIN TEXT. THE PEOPLE OF IRAN AND THE UNITED STATES SHARE A HERITAGE OF RELIGIOUS CONVICTION AND REVOLUTIONARY CHANGE. OUR OWN FOREBEARS SETTLED IN THIS COUNTRY SEEKING REFUGE FROM POLITICAL PERSECUTION ON ACCOUNT OF RELIGIOUS BELIEFS. THIS DEEP HISTORICAL EXPERIENCE HAS GENERATED CONCERN AMONG AMERICANS WHEN IT APPEARS THAT THE FREEDOM TO WORSHIP IS THREATENED IN THIS COUNTRY OR ELSEWHERE. FOR THIS REASON, ANXIETY HAS BEEN EXPRESSED BY MANY OF OUR CONSTITUENTS OVER HOW RECENT EVENTS IN IRAN WILL AFFECT RELIGIOUS AND ETHNIC MINORITIES LIVING THERE.

SPECIFICALLY, THE COMMUNITIES OF BAHA'IS, ZOROASTRIANS, JEWS AND CHRISTIANS APPEAR PARTICULARLY VULNERABLE TO MISTREATMENT BY SOME GROUPS CLAIMING TO ACT WITH THE AUTHORITY OF YOUR GOVERNMENT. MR. PRIME MINISTER, WE RECOGNIZE AND APPRECIATE THE EFFORTS YOUR GOVERNMENT HAS MADE HERE IN WASHINGTON IN RECEIVING REPRESENTATIVES FROM THE AMERICAN JEWISH COMMUNITY TO DISCUSS THE FUTURE OF THAT RELIGIOUS MINORITY IN IRAN. MOREOVER, THE STATEMENT OF THE AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI CONCERNING RELIGIOUS FREEDOM MADE PRIOR TO HIS RETURN TO IRAN PROVIDES US WITH A MOST IMPORTANT SOURCE OF ASSURANCE ON THIS MATTER.

HOWEVER, WE REMAIN AWARE OF, AND MUST COMMUNICATE TO YOU, THE CONCERNS EXPRESSED TO US ABOUT THE POTENTIAL FOR HARASSMENT OF THESE RELIGIOUS GROUPS. WE WOULD WELCOME ANY COMMENT OR MESSAGE OF REASSURANCE CONCERNING YOUR GOVERNMENT'S POLICY IN THIS AREA SINCE IT WOULD ADDRESS A FUNDAMENTAL AND GENUINE CONCERN FELT BY THOSE WE REPRESENT. THANK YOU FOR TAKING THESE CONCERNS INTO ACCOUNT. .

LEGITIMATIZED THE SOVIET ROLE IN AFGHANISTAN AND PROVIDED LEGAL BASIS FOR HELPING THE DRA SURVIVE

GAVE KABUT A MEANS OF BOLSTERING ITS OWN POSITION AND DISCOURAGING OPPOSITION AT HOME AND ABROAD -- ALBEIT UNSUCCESSFULLY SO FAR. DOES NOT NECESSARILY TIE THEM TO KABUL'S DEFENSE. (E) THE SOVIETS WERE RATHER SILENT ABOUT THE TRIBAL UNREST IN AFGHANISTAN UNTIL PRAVDA CARRIED AN AUTHORITATIVE PIECE BY I9 ALEXANDROV ON MARCH 19. ALEXANDROV ACCUSED PAKISTAN, EGYPT, AND CHINA OF SUPPORT FOR THE REBELS

1979STATE084653.subject: (S) PRIME MINISTER'S CONCERNS ON KURDISH ISSUE

segments.text: (S - ENTIRE MESSAGE)

THE MOST SURPRISING THING ABOUT MY MARCH 24 CONVERSATION WITH PRIME MINISTER ECEVIT WAS THE DEPTH OF THE CONCERN HE REVEALED REGARDING THE KURDISH PROBLEM. FULLY HALF OF THE CONVERSATION, INITIALLY DEVOTED TO MAJOR TOPICS SUCH AS ECONOMIC ASSISTANCE FOR TURKEY, WAS ABOUT THE KURDS. ECEVIT RAMBLED SLIGHTLY AND WAS NOT VERY CLEAR. AT TIMES HE SEEMED TO BE TALKING ABOUT IRAN AND AT OTHER TIMES ABOUT TURKEY. THE MESSAGE, HOWEVER, WAS THAT HE SOMEHOW BELIEVES THAT WESTERN POWERS, INCLUDING THE U.S., ARE INVOLVED WITH TURKEY'S KURDS.

TO UNDERSTAND EVEVIT'S CONVERN ONE MUST REALIZE THAT SINCE THE 1922 DEFEAT OF THE GREEK ARMY IN ANATOLIA, THERE HAS BEEN ONLY ONE GENUINE THREAT TO THE INTEGRITY OF THE TURKISH REPUBLIC: THE KURDS. IN 1925, 1931, 1936 AND 1939 THERE WERE ARMED KURDISH REVOLTS IN EASTERN TURKEY. IN 1925 THE KURDISH FLAG WAS RAISED OVER DIYARBAKIR (IN TURKISH TERMS A MAJOR CITY) AND IT WAS DECLARED THE CAPITAL OF KURDISTAN. THE REVOLT WAS CRUSHED AND 54 LEADERS WERE PUBLICLY HANGED. MORE RECENTLY, INDIVIDUAL KURDS HAVE BEEN DEEPLY INVOLVED IN TURKISH VIOLENCE BEGINNING IN 1969. MANY OF TODAY'S REVOLUTIONARY HEROES CELEBRATED BY TURKISH EXTREME LEFTISTS, E.G., MAHIR CAYAN, ARE KURDS.
THE KURDS ARE TURKEY'S LARGEST MINORITY, AND THERE ARE MORE KURDS IN THIS COUNTRY THAN IN IRAN OAND IRAQ COMBINED.

THE TURKISH GOVERNMENT AND PEOPLE WERE SHOCKED WITH THE PUBLIC ADMISSION IN 1975 OR 1976 THAT THE U.S. HAD BEEN DIRECTLY INVOLVED ALONG WITH THE SHAH AND THE ISRAELIS IN THE BARZANI REVOLT IN IRAQ. THIS WAS PARTICULARLY SO BECAUSE AGAIN AND AGAIN DURING THE SIXTIES AMERICAN AMBASSADORS GAVE CONCRETE AND CATEGORICAL ASSURANCES TO TURKISH GOVERNMENT THAT WE WERE NOT INVOLVED WITH KURDS ANYWHERE.

OUR SURMISE IS THAT ECEVIT'S LATEST FEARS HAVE BEEN TRIGGERED BY EVENTS IN IRAN WHERE THERE CLEARLY EXISTS NOW THE POSSIBILITY OF KURDISH AUTONOMY OR (IN THE TURKISH VIEW) WORSE. I BELIEVE THAT THE BEST WAY TO DEAL WITH THIS PROBLEM IS FOR ME TO BE ARMED WITH FACTS CONCERNING OUR INVOLVEMENT, WHICH BEGAN (AS FAR AS I KNOW) IN 1970. I WOULD LIKE TO BE ABLE TO SAY, IF IT IS ACCURATE, THAT AMERICAN PLEDGES OF NON-INVOLVEMENT WERE TRUE UNTIL PRESIDENT NIXON MADE HIS AGREEMENT WITH THE SHAH. I WOULD LIKE THEN TO BE ABLE TO TELL ECEVIT WHAT WE DID AND DID NOT DO.

IN SHORT, IT IS IMPORTANT THAT I SPEAK FULLY HONESTLY AND FRANKLY WITH HIM ON THIS SUBJECT. MY DOING SO MAY NOT FULLY ALLAY HIS SUSPICIONS, BUT I AM CONVINCED THAT IT IS THE BEST WAY TO DEAL WITH HIM.

I BELIEVE ALSO THAT WE MUST RESPOND TO ECEVIT'S REQUEST THAT WE TRY TO INFLUENCE "OTHER WESTERN COUNTRIES" NOT TO TRY TO TAKE ADVANTAGE OF KURDISH NATIONALISM. WHAT IS CALLED FOR IS A FRANK DISCUSSION OF WHAT WE KNOW ABOUT FOREIGN INVOLVEMENT WITH THE KURDS. IF, AS I SUSPECT, THE MAIN FOREIGN PLAYERS ARE THE SOVIETS AND IRAQIS, I WOULD WISH TO SAY SO. I WOULD LIKE TO KNOW ABOUT THE OTHERS. ARE THE ISRAELIS, FOR EXAMPLE, STILL IN THIS GAME?
FOR MAXIMUM EFFECTIVENESS, I BELIEVE I SHOULD RESPOND TO ECEVIT WITHIN ABOUT TEN DAYS. SPIERS

1979STATE086106.subject: IRANIAN CHARGE'S CALL ON THE SECRETARY

segments.text: CHARGE ETESSAM CALLED ON THE SECRETARY APRIL 6 TO PRESENT LETTERS OF CREDENCE. UNDER SECRETARY NEWSOM AND DEPTOFF PRECHT PARTICIPATED IN MEETING.

SECRETARY CORDIALLY WELCOMED ETESSAM TO WASHINGTON AND AFTER INITIAL EXCHANGE OF PLEASANTRIES EMPHASIZED U.S. DESIRE FOR GOOD AND STRONG RELATIONSHIP WITH IRAN. WE DID NOT WISH TO DO ANYTHING THAT MIGHT EMBARRASS THE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN AND WANTED OUR RELATIONS TO DEVELOP AT A PACE THAT THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT CONSIDERED APPROPRIATE. HE ASKED THAT ETESSAM CONVEY HIS PERSONAL RESPECT AND BEST WISHES TO IRAN'S NEW LEADERS, INCLUDING PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN, FOREIGN MINISTER SANJABI AND AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI. ETESSAM SAID ON BASIS OF HIS CONVERSATIONS IN TEHRAN HE COULD RECIPROCATE DESIRE FOR A GOOD RELATIONSHIP REFLECTING THE REALITIES OF THE REVOLUTION.

THE SECRETARY URGED THAT ETESSAM BRING QUICKLY AND FRANKLY TO OUR ATTENTION ANY QUESTIONS OR DOUBTS THAT IRAN MIGHT HAVE CONCERNING U.S. ACTIVITIES. WE DID NOT WISH TO LET SUSPICIONS FESTER BUT WANTED TO PUT ALL DIFFICULT QUESTIONS ON THE TABLE FOR FRANK DISCUSSIONS.

THE SECRETARY SAID THAT IN THE NOT-TOO-DISTANT FUTURE WE WOULD SEEK AGREMENT FOR A NEW AMBASSADOR. HE ASKED ETESSAM TO ASSURE THE GOI THAT THE NEW AMBASSADOR WOULD COME WITH THE FULL AND COMPLETE CONFIDENCE OF THE PRESIDENT AND THE SECRETARY.

IN CLOSING, THE SECRETARY REITERATED THAT WE DID NOT WISH TO PUSH ANY NEW PROGRAMS ON THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT BUT WE DID WISH TO PROCEED TOWARDS A NORMALIZATION OF OUR RELATIONSHIP. HE ASKED ETESSAM TO PROVIDE US WITH ANY ADVICE OR ASSISTANCE THAT HE CONSIDERED USEFUL TO HELP US ACHIEVE A MORE NORMAL RELATIONSHIP WITH IRAN.

IN A SHORT FOLLOW-ON MEETING UNDER SECRETARY NEWSOM PLACED A SPECIAL EMPHASIS ON OUR DESIRE FOR A MORE NORMAL RELATIONSHIP. HE TOLD ETESSAM THAT WE WOULD WELCOME HIS ADVICE ON STEPS THAT MIGHT BE TAKEN TO ADVANCE THAT OBJECTIVE. IN ADDITION WE WOULD WELCOME HIS PERCEPTIONS AND THOUGHTS THAT WOULD HELP US TO BETTER UNDERSTAND THE EVOLVING SITUATION IN IRAN. ETESSAM REPLIED THAT THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT HAD CONSIDERED IT VERY HELPFUL FOR THE U.S. TO PRESENT INFORMATION ON PENDING FMS CONTRACTS. THE IRANIANS PARTICULARLY APPRECIATED THE ADVICE GIVEN IN WASHINGTON AND TEHRAN ON URGENT MATTERS THAT REQUIRED THE PGOI'S ATTENTION.

IN RESPONSE TO MR. NEWSOM'S INQUIRY ABOUT BUSINESS TRAVEL TO IRAN, ETESSAM SAID THAT HE THOUGHT IT WAS STILL TOO EARLY FOR THE UNRESTRICTED TRAVEL OF AMERICAN COMMERCIAL REPRESENTATIVES TO TEHRAN, EXCEPT WHERE THERE WERE INVITATIONS FROM THE GOVERNMENT. HE DESCRIBED THE GRADUALLY IMPROVING SECURITY SITUATION AND THE PGOI'S DESIRES TO STRENGTHEN THE POLICE FORCE.

NEWSOM BRIEFED ETESSAM ON THE PENDING FBI AND HOUSE ETHICS COMMITTEE INQUIRY INTO ALLEGATIONS OF IMPROPER ACTIVITIES MADE SOME WEEKS AGO BY MR. ROUHANI. ETESSAM SAID THAT HE HAD SOUGHT INSTRUCTIONS FROM THE MINISTRY AS TO HOW HE SHOULD DEAL WITH APPROACHES FROM EITHER GROUP.

CHARGE SHOULD DRAW ON FOREGOING POINTS IN HIS DISCUSSIONS WITH SENIOR IRANIAN OFFICIALS. YOU SHOULD EMPHASIZE TO THEM OUR DESIRE TO PROCEED AS RAPIDLY AS POSSIBLE TO A NORMAL POSITION IN IRAN AND SEEK ANY SUGGESTIONS THAT IRANIAN OFFICIALS MAY HAVE AS TO ACTIONS WE MIGHT TAKE THAT WOULD ACCELERATE THAT PROCESS. VANCE
(S) ENTIRE TEXT.

FIRST NATIONAL CITY BANK (FNCB) TELLS US THAT MEMBERS OF THE SHAH'S ENTOURAGE WROTE TWO CHECKS FOR DOLS 300 THOUSAND AND DOLS 150 THOUSAND ON BANK OMRAN ACCOUNT. CHECKS WERE PRESENTED BY A MOROCCAN BANK TO FNCB WHICH WAS UNABLE TO DRAW FUNDS FROM BANK OMRAN. BANK OMRAN HAS NO OVERDRAFT FACILITIES. FNCB SAYS IT HAS REASON TO EXPECT BANK OMRAN WILL AGAIN MAKE FUNDS AVAILABLE IN ABOUT 10 DAYS AND FNCB SHOULD BE ABLE TO COVER SHAH'S CHECKS AT THAT TIME.
DEPTOFF EXPRESSED DOUBT THAT NEW IRANIAN GOVERNMENT WOULD PERMIT PAYMENT TO BE MADE BY BANK OMRAN TO THE SHAH BUT FNCB OFFICIAL APPEARED CONFIDENT THAT CHECKS WOULD BE HONORED.

FNCB OFFICIAL TOLD US SEPARATELY THAT A LOAN TO PRINCESS SHAMS WAS APPARENTLY GOING SOUR. HE MADE THIS COMMENT WHEN WE TOLD HIM IRANIAN EMBASSY HERE TOLD US THAT BANK SHOULD NOT USE PAHLVAI FAMILY PROPERTY IN IRAN (PAK DAIRY, PARS ALUMINUM, VARIOUS PALACES) AS COLLATERAL FOR ROYAL FAMILY LOANS.

FOREGOING IS FYI. WHEN WE EXPLAINED TO FNCB THAT GOM HAD QUERIED US ABOUT CHECKS, BANK REP SAID THEY HAD HAD NO QUESTIONS FROM MOROCCO. FNCB BRANCH IN MOROCCO WILL BE INSTRUCTED TO CONVEY INFO IN PARA 1 TO MOROCCAN BANK. IF GOM AGAIN APPROACHES YOU ON THIS SUBJECT, YOU MAY SAY THAT YOU UNDERSTAND MATTER IS BEING WORKED OUT BETWEEN TWO BANKS AND BRIEFLY DESCRIBE PROBLEM WITH BANK OMRAN. VANCE

1979STATE092311.subject: VISIT OF B.F. GOODRICH EXECUTIVES MESSRS. HARRY BOLAND AND KENT H. LEE OF B.F. GOODRICH COMPANY PLAN TO TRAVEL TO TEHRAN AND WILL CONTACT

segments.text: MESSRS. HARRY BOLAND AND KENT H. LEE OF B.F. GOODRICH COMPANY PLAN TO TRAVEL TO TEHRAN AND WILL CONTACT EMBASSY ON THEIR ARRIVAL. THEY WILL ARRIVE ON THE EVENING OF MONDAY, APRIL 16, VIA PAN AM AIRLINES AT 1850 HOURS AND WILL DEPART TEHRAN ON WEDNESDAY, APRIL 18.

ON APRIL 12, DEPTOFF (PRECHT) MET WITH MEHDI HAERI-YAZDI WHO HAS BEEN APPOINTED AS PERSONAL REPRESENTATIVE OF KHOMEINI AND SANJABI IN THE U.S. HAERI, A VISITING SCHOLAR OF ISLAMIC PHILOSOPHY AT GEORGETOWN UNIVERSITY, WAS A LONGTIME STUDENT OF KHOMEINI AND HAERI'S FATHER WAS KHOMEINI'S TEACHER. HAERI APPARENTLY KNEW SANJABI AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY. SANJABI, IT APPEARS, ARRANGED HAERI APPOINTMENT IN ORDER TO ECLIPSE ROUHANI; AT SAME TIME SANJABI ASSIGNED A STRONGER DIPLOMAT, HASSAN ETESSAM, AS CHARGE. ETESSAM HAS RETURNED TO TEHRAN, ACCORDING TO EMBASSY OFFICERS, IN DISGUST AT CONTINUING CONFUSION HERE. HE MAY REMAIN THERE.

HAERI TOLD US HE HAD RECENTLY TELEPHONED AND CABLED TEHRAN TO REPORT THAT SITUATION AT THE EMBASSY WAS INTOLERABLE AND DAMAGING TO IRAN'S INTERESTS. HE HIMSELF COULD NOT CONTINUE TO SERVE KHOMEINI AND PGOI UNDER THESE CIRCUMSTANCES. HE HAD TOLD "TEHRAN" THAT KHOMEINI, BAZARGAN AND SANJABI, ACTING LONE AND WITHOUT ANY OTHER ADVICE (READ FROM YAZDI), SHOULD SELECT ONE MAN TO SERVE AS AMBASSADOR. AMBASSADOR MEYER, WHO ARRANGED MEETING, SUGGESTED HAERI MIGHT BE THE MAN. HAERI DID NOT DEMUR BUT FROM OTHER REMARKS HE CLEARLY PREFERS SCHOLARLY PURSUITS.

HAERI IS A STRONG SUPPORTER OF BAZARGAN, SEEING HIM AS VIRTUALLY INDISPENSIBLE IN THE PRESENT CIRCUMSTANCES. HE BELIEVES THAT KHOMEINI'S THOUGHTS ARE BEING MISINTERPRETED BY THOSE AROUND HIM WITH UNFORTUNATE RESULTS. HAERI SAID HE (HAERI) WAS "100 PER CENT OPPOSED" TO SYSTEM OF SUMMARY TRIALS AND EXECUTIONS.

DEPTOFF REITERATED POINTS MADE BY THE SECRETARYTO CHARGE ETESSAM CONCERNING OUR DESIRE FOR NORMAL, COOPERATIVE RELATIONS WITH IRAN AND OUR RECOGNITION OF NEEDTO PROCEED CAUTIOUSLY IN ESTABLISHING NEW TIES. HAERI SAID HE WAS CONFIDENT PGOI LEADERSHIP ALSO WISHEDTO MAKE A NEW BEGINNING. THERE WAS A LOT OF HISTORY TO OVERCOME, BUT HE THOUGHT KHOMEINI HELD NO GRUDGE AGAINST PRESENT ADMINISTRATION. BOTH SIDES SHOULD MOVE GRADUALLY TOWARDS NORMALIZATION, BUT IT WAS IMPORTANT TO BEAR IN MIND THAT THERE WAS A "FEVER" STILL RUNNING IN IRAN.

HAERI SAID HE PLANNED TENTATIVELY TO VISIT IRAN TOWARDS EARLY MAY IN ORDER TO DISCUSS FRANKLY WITH KHOMEINI HARD REALITIES FACING NEW GOVERNMENT. HE WAS PARTICULARLY CONCERNED ABOUT ECONOMIC SITUATION AND THE EFFECT TRIALS AND EXECUTIONS WERE HAVING ON NATIONAL REPUTATION AND FOREIGN RELATIONS.

HAERI IS A SOFT SPOKEN, INTELLIGENT PERSON WITH A SCHOLAR'S INCLINATION TO DIGRESS AND DEVELOP THEORETICAL POINTS. HE IS, HOWEVER, KEENLY ALERT TO POLITICAL DEVELOPMENTS, VERY LOYAL TO KHOMEINI/BAZARGAN GROUP, HOSTILE TO THE SHAH'S REGIME AND ITS SUPPORTERS, SEEMINGLY A PROGRESSIVE AND PRAGMATIST IN HIS RELIGIOUS ORIENTATION, BUT NOT AT ALL CUT OUT TO DIRECT THE WORK OF THE IRANIAN EMBASSY. WE HAVE HEARD OF SEVERAL DECISIONS WHICH HAVE BEEN REFERRED TO HIM AND WHICH ARE STILL PENDING. CHRISTOPHER

FNCB (MAGHREB) DIRECTOR HENRY BATCHELDER CALLED E/C COUNSELOR EVENING APRIL 11 TO ADVISE THAT HE HAD JUST RECEIVED INTRIGUING TELEX FROM CITIBANK HEADQUARTERS. AS ANTICIPATED REF A TELEX BROUGHT TO BATCHELDER'S ATTENTION FACT THAT NEW YORK HEADQUARTERS HAD BEEN SEPARATELY APPRISED BY STATE DEPARTMENT AND ABDELLATIF BENNANI, MOROCCAN (PUPPET) CHAIRMAN OF FNCB MAGHREB, THAT CITIBANK BEING ACCUSED OF NOT HONORING TWO SUBSTANTIAL CHECKS CASHED AT SIGHT BY BANQUE DU MAROC (BM - MOROCCAN CENTRAL BANK) AND SUBSEQUENTLY PRESENTED FOR PAYMENT BY BM'S PRINCIPAL CORRESPONDENT BANK IN NEW YORK, THE FRENCH AND AMERICAN BANKING CORPORATION.

ALTHOUGH IDENTITY OF PERSON CASHING CHECKS AND AMOUNTS INVOLVED APPARENTLY NOT COMMUNICATED TO BATCHELDER, HE HAD SUSPICION THAT PROBLEM RELATED SOMEHOW TO SHAH OR PERSON CLOSE TO SHAH. THIS WAS BECAUSE ABDELLATIF BENNANI HAD MENTIONED VAGUELY TO HIM SOME DAYS AGO THAT BM HAD BEEN COMPLAINING ABOUT SHAH'S SPENDING HABITS.

BATCHELDER TOOK HIS HEADQUARTERS' REFERENCE TO FACT THAT THERE WERE TWO SEPARATE SOURCES OF SAME INFORMATION TO MEAN THAT BM VICE GOVERNOR AHMED BENNANI HAD TOLD HIS CHAIRMAN (ABDELLATIF BENNANI) ABOUT SHAH'S BAD CHECKS AND HAD PROBABLY ASKED HIM TO TRANSMIT THIS INFORMATION PRIVATELY TO CITIBANK FOR AN EXPLANATION.

BATCHELDER ALSO WENT ON TO SAY THAT, ACCORDING TO MESSAGE JUST RECEIVED - CITIBANK WANTED APPROPRIATE GOM AUTHORITIES TO KNOW SPECIFICALLY THAT IT HAD NOT RPT NOT BLOCKED ANY FUNDS OR ACCOUNTS INVOLVED IN THE TWO CHECKS PRESENTED TO IT - FACT THAT PAYMENT NOT MADE ON CHECKS PRESENTED TO IT WAS SIMPLY BECAUSE BANK OMRAN'S ACCOUNT WITH CITIBANK (ON WHICH PRESUMABLY SHAH DREW CHECKS) HAD INSUFFICIENT FUNDS TO COVER CHECKS PRESENTED - BANK OMRAN'S ACCOUNT HAD SINCE BEEN REFUELED TO COVER ONE CHECK WHICH HAD NOW BEEN PAID, AND CITIBANK EXPECTED ACCOUNT TO RECEIVE SECOND REFUELING TO COVER SECOND CHECK - CITIBANK WAS READY TO PROVIDE FURTHER EXPLANATIONS OF EXACTLY WHAT HAPPENED IF THIS NECESSARY TO CLARIFY ANY CONTINUING MISCONCEPTION OF ITS OWN INVOLVEMENT IN TRANSACTION (APPARENTLY THERE WAS A SUBSIDIARY PAYMENT PROBLEM: CITIBANK HAD RECEIVED INSTRUCTIONS TO TRANSFER PROCEEDS OF CHECKS TO OTHER BANK OR BANKS THAN FRENCH AND AMERICAN BANK FOR WHICH IT HAD NO STANDING AUTHORITY AND THEREFORE FELT IT COULD NOT EXECUTE).
BATCHELDER CONCLUDED THAT HE WOULD BE PASSING TELEX INFORMATION TO HIS CHAIRMAN WHO WOULD THEN RELAY TO BM VICE CHAIRMAN.
PROBLEM APPEARS TO BE RESOLVING ITSELF WITHIN BANKING CHANNELS, AGAIN AS ANTICIPATED REFTEL. PARKER

ANY INFORMATION THAT EMBASSY MAY HAVE OR MAY BE ABLE TO DEVELOP ON THIS MATTER WOULD BE APPRECIATED. ISTHERE ANY USEFUL ACTION, IN EMBASSY'S OPINION, THAT U.S. COULD TAKE? CHRISTOPHER
(C) ENTIRE TEXT

WE ARE VERY MUCH AWARE OF AND CONCERNED ABOUT THE INCREASED VULNERABILITY OF THE EMBASSY AS A RESULT OF INCREASING ANTI-AMERICAN SENTIMENT AND THE REDUCTION OF THE PROTECTIVE GUARD FORCE. WE WILL DO EVERYTHING WE CAN TO MEET YOUR SPECIFIC REQUESTS FOR ASSISTANCE EXPEDITIOUSLY.

FROM THE WASHINGTON PERSPECTIVE, IT SEEMS TO US THAT YOU SHOULD TRY TO PREVAIL ON YAZDI, OR WHOEVER MAY BE APPROPRIATE, TO HAVE THE PROTECTIVE GUARD FORCE INCREASED IN SIZE TO THE EXTENT YOU CONSIDER NECESSARY FOR SUFFICIENT SECURITY FOR THE EMBASSY COMPOUND. IT WOULD ALSO SEEM PREFERABLE AS SOON AS FEASIBLE TO HAVE A DISCIPLINED GUARD UNIT UNDER A SINGLE COMMAND, BUT YOU ARE IN THE BEST POSITION TO EVALUATE THE PROS AND CONS OF THE COMPOSITION OF THE PROTECTIVE FORCE AND THE ADVISABILITY OF EMPHASIZING THAT ASPECT OF THE ISSUE AT THIS TIME.

RECOGNIZING THAT YOU HAVE TO FIND THE MOST EFFECTIVE WAY TO PRODUCE THE DESIRED RESULTS WITH IRANIAN AUTHORITIES, WE URGE YOU TO MAKE AN EARLY OPPORTUNITY TO DISCUSS WITH APPROPRIATE OFFICIAL INCREASING SIZE OF GUARD FORCE.

1979STATE100340.subject: PROTEST TO PGOI ABOUT KHOMEINI ANTI-US ALLEGATIONS

segments.text: PLEASE SEEK EARLIEST REASONABLE APPOINTMENT WITH DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER YAZDI OR ENTEZAM TO LODGE VERBAL PROTEST WITH PGOI CONCERNING REPEATED ASSERTIONS BY AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI THAT AMERICAN AGENTS ARE INVOLVED IN INTERNAL IRANIAN AFFAIRS.
YOU SHOULD DRAW ON THE FOLLOWING POINTS
CHARGES THAT THE UNITED STATES IS PLOTTING AGAINST THE NEW GOVERNMENT IN IRAN ARE TOTALLY FALSE AND WE CATEGORICALLY DENY AND REJECT THEM.

WE HAVE REPEATEDLY STATED OUR POSITION THAT IRAN'S POLITICAL FUTURE IS FOR THE IRANIANS THEMSELVES TO DECIDE WITHOUT ANY INTERFERENCE FROM ANY OUTSIDE POWER. THIS CONTINUES TO BE OUR POSITION AND WE HAVE SCRUPULOUSLY ADHERED TO IT.

CHARGES OF U.S. INVOLVEMENT OF THE NATURE MADE REPEATEDLY BY AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI MISLEAD THE PEOPLE OF IRAN AND CREATE UNNECESSARY STRAINS IN THE RELATIONS BETWEEN OUR TWO COUNTRIES. SUCH CHARGES ALSO COMPLICATE THE ALREADY DIFFICULT PROCESS OF ESTABLISHING GOOD AND CONSTRUCTIVE RELATIONS BASED ON MUTUAL RESPECT AND TRUST.
AS WE HAVE POINTED OUT BEFORE, IF THE PGOI BELIEVES THAT THERE IS ANY EVIDENCE TO SUBSTANTIATE SUCH CHARGES, WE WOULD WELCOME THE OPPORTUNITY TO ADDRESS THIS IN A FRANK AND STRAIGHTFORWARD MANNER.
DEPARTMENT WILL MAKE PARALLEL APPROACH WITH IRANIAN CHARGE IN WASHINGTON.

FYI - FOLLOWING IS PRESS GUIDANCE PREPARED AND USED ON APRIL 18: QUESTION: WHAT COMMENT DOES THE DEPARTMENT HAVE ON AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI'S ASSERTION THAT AMERICAN AGENTS ARE BEHIND IRAN'S TROUBLES? ANSWER: -- I CATEGORICALLY DENY THAT THE U.S. IS INVOLVED IN ANY WAY IN IRAN'S INTERNAL AFFAIRS. WE HAVE REPEATEDLY SAID THAT WE BELIEVE THAT IRAN'S POLITICAL FUTURE SHOULD BE LEFT TO THE IRANIANS THEMSELVES TO DECIDE AND THAT OUTSIDERS SHOULD KEEP THEIR HANDS OFF.

WE HAVE BEEN AWARE FOR SOME TIME OF CHARGES IN THE IRANIAN PRESS THAT THE U.S. WAS PLOTTING AGAINST THE NEW GOVERNMENT. THESE CHARGES ARE TOTALLY FALSE. WE HAVE TOLD THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT SEVERAL TIMES THAT WE WOULD LIKE TO SEE ANY EVIDENCE BEHIND SUCH CHARGES. NO SUCH EVIDENCE HAS BEEN PRESENTED. CHRISTOPHER
(C) ENTIRE TEXT.

YOUR "SNAPSHOT" OF THE PRESENT SITUATION IN IRAN WAS MOST HELPFUL. A GROUP OF US WILL BE SITTING DOWN THIS WEEK TO DISCUSS A SHORT PAPER ANALYZING THE FORCES WORKING FOR US AND AGAINST US IN CURRENT IRAN AND LEADING TO A SUGGESTED SENSE OF DIRECTION BOTH FOR ESTABLISHING OUR NEW AMBASSADOR AND FOR SETTING OURSELVES OBJECTIVES OVER THE COMING YEAR.

AS WE DEVELOP AN OUTLINE FOR THIS PAPER, WE WILL WANT TO SEND IT TO YOU AND THEN WILL WANT TO TELL YOU THE ISSUES WE ARE STRUGGLING WITH SO THAT THIS CAN BE A COMBINED EFFORT BETWEEN A SMALL GROUP HERE IN WASHINGTON AND THOSE OF YOU WHO ARE ON THE SPOT. I HAVE FOUND THAT THIS KIND OF INTERACTION DURING THE FORMULATION OF POLICY IS A MOST USEFUL WAY TO BRING US ALL TOGETHER, AND WE LOOK FORWARD TO WORKING CLOSELY WITH YOU IN THIS EXERCISE. MEANWHILE, WE DO NOT WANT TO DETER YOU FROM YOUR PLAN OF REPORTING MENTIONED IN REFTEL. GOOD WORK. VANCE

1979STATE106426.subject: REPORTING SUBJECTS AS YOU REQUESTED AND AS OPPORTUNITIES DEVELOP IN THE WEEKS AHEAD, HERE ARE SOME OF THE TOPICS ON WHICH WE COU

segments.text: AS YOU REQUESTED AND AS OPPORTUNITIES DEVELOP IN THE WEEKS AHEAD, HERE ARE SOME OF THE TOPICS ON WHICH WE COULD USE ADDITIONAL OR CONTINUING INFORMATION POLITICAL RELATIONSHIPS WITHIN THE REVOLUTIONARY LEADERSHIP.
WHO ARE THE POTENT FIGURES WITH AND WITHOUT OFFICIAL POSITIONS? WHOM SHOULD WE WATCH AS COMERS? NEED BIOS.
WHAT ARE THE POLITICAL ALLIANCES AND STRENGTHS OF AMIR ENTEZAM AND SABAGHIAN? WE KNOW RELATIVELY LITTLE OF EITHER.
WHERE DOES YAZDI STAND IN THE HIERARCHY AFTER HIS SHIFT TO MFA? DID HEGAIN OR LOSE POWER? HOW HAVE MFA PERSONNEL REACTED TO HIM AND ARE THERE ANY PREDICTABLE EFFECTS ON POLICY?

WE DO NOT HAVE A VERY GOOD FIX ON TALEGHANI, HIS ENTOURAGE AND LINKS TO OTHERS IN THE RELIGIOUS AND SECULAR ESTABLISHMENTS.

WE NEED SOME FAIRLY SYSTEMATIC APPROACH TO THE DEPICTION OF TRENDS, INCLUDING A DESIGNATION OF SPECIFIC POLITICAL AND ECONOMIC AREAS TO WATCH AND PERIODIC REPORTING. SEVERAL CATEGORIES WERE MENTIONED IN OUR EARLIER CABLE.
HOW IS THE US PERCEIVED? WHAT ACTIONS OR INACTIONS SINCE MID-FEBRUARY HAVE HELPED OR HURT US? WHAT COULD WE DO BETTER?
REPORTS OF MILITARY CONVERSATIONS ARE MOST HELPFUL. FROM TIME TO TIME IT WOULD BE USEFUL TO SUMMARIZE, DEPICTING TRENDS, FOR EACH OF THE SERVICES. POLICE AND GENDARMERIE INFO ALSO VALUABLE.

WE APPRECIATE EXTREMELY VALUABLE ECON REPORTING. WE COULD USE (AS PART OF NO. 4 ABOVE) REGULAR COVERAGE OF MARKET BASKET PRICES AND SHORTAGES, EMPLOYMENT, GRIPES. HOW ARE THE UNEMPLOYED MAKING ENDS MEET?
WHAT ARE THE ACTIVITIES, STRENGTHS, PLANS OF LIBERAL DEMOCRATS (MATIN-DAFTARY), NATIONAL FRONT (SANJABI), LEFT GUERRILLAS (FADEYEEN), VARIOUS MUJAHEDIN GROUPS, PRO-SHAH ELEMENTS?
HOW FARE THE PROVINCES, PARTICULARLY HARVESTS, FOOD AVAILABILITY?
WHAT IS STATUS OF EFFORTS TO CLOSE DOWN, SELL OFF OR SHIP OUT MILITARY FACILITIES AND EQUIPMENT?
WHAT CAN YOU GATHER OF PERCEPTIONS OF KEY EMBASSIES? WHAT ARE THE SOVIETS UP TO?
WHAT IS THE SITUATION WITH THE UNIVERSITIES, NIRT, OTHER MEDIA?
STATUS OF PLANNING FOR THE CONSTITUTION AND ELECTIONS. 14.WHAT HAVEPGOI/KHOMRNI DONE ON AMENSTY FOR MILITARY POLICE, OTHERS?

DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE HAS INQUIRED WHETHER PGOI HAS RESPONDED TO THE EMBASSY'S REQUEST FOR DOCUMENTS DESCRIBED REFTEL. EMBASSY IS REQUESTED TO APPROACH THE FOREIGN MINISTRY TO ASCERTAIN WHEN A REPLY TO ITS NOTE MAY BE
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)

CHARGE FAGHIH CALLED AT HIS REQUEST ON NEA/IRN ON APRIL 27. FAGHIH'S PRINCIPAL BUSINESS WAS TWOFOLD: (A) TO INDICATE PGOI SUPPORT FOR NASR AFSHAR'S FREEDOM OF INFORMATION REQUEST. FAGHIH SAID ROUHANI AND OTHERS HAD ASKED HIM TO MAKE CLEAR THAT PGOI SUPPORTED RELEASE OF PAHLAVI DOCUMENTS; (B) TO REITERATE MESSAGE IN A RECENT NOTE THAT IRAN WOULD CONSIDER IT AN UNFRIENDLY ACT IF THE US WERE TO ISSUE VISAS TO THE PAHLAVI FAMILY. IN RESPONSE DEPTOFF COUNSELLED FAGHIH THAT HE SHOULD BE CAREFUL NOT TO STEP OVER THE LINE INTO INTERNAL USG AFFAIRS.

NASR AFSHAR'S CASE WAS PENDING BEFORE THE COURTS AND HIS FOI REQUEST WOULD BE ADDRESSED ON ITS MERITS IN ACCORD WITH US LAW AND REGULATIONS. SIMILARLY, VISA ISSUANCE WAS A MATTER OF US LAW AND REGULATIONS. WE WERE WELL AWARE OF THE STRONG FEELINGS OF THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT AND IRANIAN PEOPLE TOWARDS THE SHAH. CLEARLY, PRESS REPORTING INDICATED THE DIFFICULT ISSUE THIS HAD POSED FOR THE USG. IRAN SHOULD BE AWARE THAT THE US HAD A TRADITIONAL POLICY OF ACCEPTING FOREIGNERS IN TROUBLE NO MATTER WHAT . THEIR BACKGROUND HAD BEEN.

WE HOPED THAT OUR RELATIONS WITH IRAN WOULD GRADUALLY BE STRENGTHENED SO THAT THEY WOULD REST ON A FIRMER BASIS THAN QUESTION OF VISA ISSUANCE. AT THE MOMENT, QUESTION OF THE PAHLAVI FAMILY'S COMING TO THE US DID NOT ARISE AS THEY APPEARED TO BE HEADED FOR OTHER DESTINATION. DEPTOFF SAID THAT VISAS HAD BEEN ISSUED TO THE PAHLAVIS SOME MONTHS AGO IN TEHRAN.

IN CONNECTION WITH EXAMINATION OF US-IRANIAN RELATIONS, DEPTOFF REITERATED POINTS MADE BY THE SECRETARY THAT WE WISH TO DEVELOP CLOSE, PRODUCTIVE RELATIONS BUT DID NOT WISH TO PUSH IRAN TOO FAST. WE WOULD EARNESTLY WELCOME ANY SUGGESTIONS GOI MIGHT HAVE FOR ACTIONS BY THE US WHICH WOULD ASSIST THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT IN STRENGTHENING ITS ECONOMY AND POLITICAL STABILITY. WE PARTICULARLY WANTED TO PUT ON THE TABLE ANY SUSPICIONS OR DOUBTS THAT IRAN MIGHT HAVE ABOUT US ACTIONS IN IRAN.

DEPTOFF CONTINUED THAT WE HAD BEEN DISTURBED BY RECENT STATEMENTS BY KHOMEINI THAT US WAS SOMEHOW WORKING AGAINST STABILITY IN IRAN. THIS WAS MOST CERTAINLY NOT THE CASE FOR WE STRONGLY SUPPORTED INCREASED STRENGTH FOR THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT. WE HOPED THAT THOSE PERSONS WHO WERE ADVISING THE AYATOLLAH WOULD SPEAK TO HIM FRANKLY AND HONESTLY ABOUT THE US POSITION SINCE THE REVOLUTION. IF THEY HAD DOUBTS OR SUSPICIONS TO CONVEY TO THE AYATOLLAH, WE HOPED THEY WOULD FIRST CONVEY THEM TO US.

DEPTOFF CONTINUED THAT ONE OF THE MOST DIFFICULT PROBLEMS IMPEDING A RETURN TO NORMAL CONDITIONS WAS THE SECURITY SITUATION ON OUR COMPOUND. UNTIL WE HAD IMPROVED PROTECTION WE WOULD NOT BE IN A POSITION TO ISSUE VISAS ON A NORMAL BASIS AS WE WOULD LIKE TO DO.

WITH REFERENCE TO VISAS, DEPTOFF NOTED THAT CERTAIN IRANIAN CONSULATES WERE DEVIATING FROM STANDARD PRACTICE IN THE ISSUANCE OF VISAS, E.G., SOME VISAS WERE VALID FOR ONE ENTRY AND A PERIOD OF TEN DAYS. SOME CONSULAR OFFICERS WERE REQUIRING A LETTER OF INTRODUCTION FROM THE USG. AS THE CHARGE KNEW, OUR LAW REQUIRED RECIPROCITY ON VISA ISSUANCE. WE DID NOT WISH TO MAKE THIS A FORMAL MATTER, BUT WOULD BE OBLIGED TO DO SO IF THE SITUATION WERE NOT CORRECTED. FAGHIH SAID HE WOULD IMMEDIATELY LOOK INTO THE QUESTION AND SUGGESTED THAT SOME KOMITEH MEMBERS WERE DEVIATING FROM NORMAL PRACTICE. HE WOULD BE IN TOUCH WITH DR.
YAZDI TO CORRECT THIS SITUATION. WE ASKED FOR A REPORT ON HIS FINDINGS BEFORE ASKING EMBASSY TEHRAN TO TAKE THIS MATTER UP OFFICIALLY WITH THE PGOI.

FINALLY, DEPTOFF RAISED THE CASE OF REZA AMINI, STATING PERSONALLY THAT IT DID NOT SEEM CREDIBLE THAT REZA AMINI WAS ENGAGED IN PLOTTING AGAINST THE NEW GOVERNMENT. NO CHARGES HAD BEEN ANNOUNCED AND THE NET EFFECT OF AMINI'S CONTINUED INCARCERATION WAS DAMAGE TO OUR EFFORTS TO STRENGTHEN US-IRANIAN RELATIONS. FAGHIH MADE NOTE AND INDICATED HE WOULD BE IN TOUCH WITH TEHRAN. VANCE

THE ETHICS IN GOVERNMENT ACT OF 1978 (PUBLIC LAW 95-521 (92 STAT. 1824)), APPROVED OCTOBER 26, 1978, REQUIRES CERTAIN EMPLOYEES OF THE DEPARTMENT AND FOREIGN SERVICE TO PREPARE COMPREHENSIVE REPORTS ON THEIR FINANCIAL SITUATION. THESE REPORTS ARE REVIEWED BY THE DEPARTMENT, AND IN CERTAIN CASES BY A NEW OFFICE OF GOVERNMENT ETHICS, FOR POSSIBLE CONFLICTS OF INTEREST. ACCORDING TO THE ACT, THE REPORTS WILL BE AVAILABLE FOR PUBLIC INSPECTION AND COPIES MUST BE PROVIDED TO ANYONE WHO REQUESTS THEM. THE DISCLOSURE PROVISIONS OF THE ACT BECOME EFFECTIVE ON JANUARY 1, 2979.

A COVERED EMPLOYEE ON THE ROLLS OF THE DEPARTMENT ON JANUARY 1, 1979, MUST FILE A REPORT BY MAY 15, 1979 COVERING 1978. AN EMPLOYEE WHO IS SEPARATED AFTER JANUARY ,,979, MUST ALSO REPORT ON THE EMPLOYEE'S FINANCIAL SITU1, 1979, MUST ALSO REPORT ON THE EMPLOYEE'S FINANCIAL SITUATION IN 1979 PRIOR TO SEPARATION. "COVERED EMPLOYEE" MEANS AN EMPLOYEE WHOSE POSITION IS CLASSIFIED AT GS-16 OR HIGHER, AND AN EMPLOYEE OF THE FOREIGN SERVICE WHOSE CLASS IS FSO-2, FSR-2, FSRU-2, OR ABOVE.

IT ALSO INCLUDES INDIVIDUALS (FOR EXAMPLE, ASSISTANT SECRETARIES AND AMBASSADORS) APPOINTED TO POSITIONS BY THE PRESIDENT BY AND WITH THE ADVICE AND CONSENT OF THE SENATE; EMPLOYEES IN THE EXCEPTED SERVICE (BOTH CIVIL SERVICE AND FOREIGN SERVICE) IN POSITIONS WHICH ARE OF A CONFIDENTIAL OR POLICY-MAKING CHARACTER, UNLESS THEIR POSITIONS HAVE BEEN EXCLUDED.

AN INDIVIDUAL WHO SERVES IN A COVERED CLASS OR POSITION AND PERFORMS THE DUTIES OF THAT CLASS OR POSITION FOR MORE THAN 60 DAYS DURING ANY CALENDAR YEAR MUST FILE A COMPLETED SF-278 ON OR BEFORE MAY 15 OF THE FOLLOWING CALENDAR YEAR. THE REPORTS FILED ON OR BEFORE MAY 15 ARE TO INCLUDE INFORMATION FOR THE PRECEDING CALENDAR YEAR. (NOTE:--A COVERED EMPLOYEE ON THE ROLLS JANUARY 1, 1979, MUST FILE A REPORT BY MAY 15, 1979, COVERING 1978.) AN INDIVIDUAL, WHOSE EMPLOYMENT IN A COVERED CATEGORY TERMINATES, MUST FILE A COMPLETED SF-278 NO LATER THAN 30 DAYS AFTER TERMINATION UNLESS THE INDIVIDUAL HAS ACCEPTED EMPLOYMENT IN ANOTHER COVERED CATEGORY.

THE REPORT REQUIRED BY THIS SUBPARAGRAPH COVERS THE PRECEDING CALENDAR YEAR, UNLESS THE MAY 15 REPORT COVERING THAT YEAR HAS BEEN FILED, PLUS THE PERIOD OF THE CURRENT YEAR UP TO THE INDIVIDUAL'S TERMINATION FROM EMPLOYMENT.

THE FOLLOWING INTERIM PROCEDURES WILL BE FOLLOWED UNTIL POSTS AND BUREAUS CAN REQUISITION SF-278 AND SF-278A THROUGH NORMAL REQUISITIONING CHANNELS WITH THE GENERAL SERVICES ADMINISTRATION AND MAKE THE FORMS AVAILABLE DIRECTLY TO COVERED EMPLOYEES (AFTER WHICH THE REGULAR PROCEDURES IN PARAGRAPH 11 WILL BE FOLLOWED)

THE BUREAU OF PERSONNEL, OFFICE OF MANAGEMENT (PER/MGT) DIRECTLY OR THROUGH OTHER OFFICES IN THE BUREAU, ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICERS AT POSTS, AND EXECUTIVE DIRECTORS AT WASHINGTON, WILL SEND (1) AN SF-278 OR SF-278A, AS APPROPRIATE, TO THOSE INDIVIDUALS WHO, SINCE JANUARY 1, 1979, HAVE EITHER ENTERED A COVERED CATEGORY OR HAVE TERMINATED EMPLOYMENT FROM A COVERED CATEGORY (SEE PARAGRAPH 4A); AND
AN SF-278 TO THOSE EMPLOYEES WHO ARE REQUIRED BY LAW TO FILE AN SF-278 BY MAY 15, 1979, FOR CALENDAR YEAR 1978 (SEE PARAGRAPH 7C).
INDIVIDUALS SO CONTACTED WILL RETURN THE COMPLETED SF-278 OR SF-278A TO THE OFFICE FROM WHICH THEY RECEIVED IT.

THAT RECEIVING OFFICE SHALL MAKE SURE THAT FORMS ARE COMPLETED AND TRANSMIT THEM EXPEDITIOUSLY TO THE FOREIGN AFFAIRS DOCUMENT AND REFERENCE CENTER, DOCUMENT AND REFERENCE DIVISION (O/FADRC/DR), ROOM 1239, DEPARTMENT OF STATE, WASHINGTON, D.C. 20520.

IN FEBRUARY AUDIT COMMITTEE, WHICH IS INQUIRING INTO ALLEGED PAYMENTS BY GRUMMAN TO AGENTS IN IRAN AS WELL AS POSSIBLE BENEFIT BY GRUMMAN OFFICIALS FROM SUCH PAYMENTS, ASKED NEA/IRN WHETHER IT WOULD BE APPROPRIATE TO ATTEMPT TO INTERVIEW PRESENT AND FORMER IRANIAN OFFICIALS REGARDING SUCH PAYMENTS. AT THAT TIME WE REPLIED THAT WE DID NOT AOVISE SUCH AN APPROACH TO IRANIAN OFFICIALS WHICH COULD JEOPARDIZE THEIR WELL BEING. IN ADDITION, IRANIAN AFFAIRS WERE IN SUCH DISARRAY THAT WE WERE NOT CERTAIN THAT A REQUEST FROM THE AUDIT COMMITTEE WOULD BE ANSWERED.

IN SUBSEQUENT CONVERSATION MAY 3, AUDIT COMMITTEE REPRESENTATIVE SAID THEY REMAINED INTERESTED IN TALKING WITH IRANIANS. WE REPLIED THAT WE CONSIDERED IT MIGHT WELL BE POSSIBLE NOW FOR THEM TO INTERVIEW RETIRED GENERAL MASSOUMI, RETIRED ADMIRAL ARDALAN, AND MR. BARAMI. WE SAID THAT WE DID NOT KNOW WHETHER THOSE OR OTHER INDIVIDUALS WOULD BE WILLING TO TALK TO THE AUDIT COMMITTEE, WHETHER THE PGOI WOULD AUTHORIZE SUCH CONTACTS, OR WHETHER THE EMBASSY WOULD RECOMMEND THAT AN APPROACH BE MADE.

WE WOULD APPRECIATE YOUR VIEWS WITHOUT CONTACTING IRANIAN GOVERNMENT AS TO WHETHER IT WOULD BE FEASIBLE FOR AUDIT COMMITTEE TO SEEK INTERVIEWS WITH IRANIANS HAVING KNOWLEDGE OF THE GRUMMAN CONTRACTS. IF THE EMBASSY AGREES SUCH CONVERSATIONS MIGHT BE ARRANGED, WOULD IT WISH TO TRANSMIT THE COMMITTEE'S REQUEST TO THE PGOI BEFORE APPROACHING INDIVIDUALS?

IN ADDITION, WOULD APPRECIATE EMBASSY'S VIEWS ON APPROPRIATENESS, UNDER PRESENT CIRCUMSTANCES, OF APPROACHING MINISTRY OF JUSTICE OR MINISTRY OF DEFENSE TO OBTAIN ANY EXISTING RECORDS BEARING ON GRUMMAN ACTIVITIES. VANCE
