WHEN YOU SEE KHOMEINI YOU SHOULD USE THE FOLLOWING TALKING POINTS IN YOUR PRESENTATION: (IF YOU FEEL IT NECESSARY TO EXPLAIN REASON FOR DELAY IN SEEING KHOMEINI YOU MAY SAY THAT WE HAD PLANNED ORIGINALLY THAT THE NEW AMBASSADOR WOULD BE THE FIRST TO CALL ON THE AYATOLLAH, SYMBOLIZING A NEW START IN U.S.-IRANIAN RELATIONS. YOU ARE CALLING BECAUSE PRIMIN BAZARGAN AND OTHERS HAVE SUGGESTED THAT WE DO NOT DELAY UNTIL AMBASSADOR CUTLER'S ARRIVAL.)
YOU BRING GREETINGS ON BEHALF OF THE PRESIDENT AND THE AMERICAN GOVERNMENT TO THE AYATOLLAH.
THE IRANIAN PEOPLE HAVE NOW EXPRESSED THEMSELVES IN FAVOR OF AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. WE WISH THE COUNTRY WELL DURING THE NEXT STAGES OF ITS POLITICAL EVOLUTION.
THERE HAS BEEN MUCH MISUNDERSTANDING AND SUSPICION IN THE PAST. WE WANT TO PUT THAT BEHIND US AND TO MAKE A NEW BEGINNING.
THE U.S. AND IRAN SHARE MANY COMMON INTERESTS. THE HISTORY OF FRIENDSHIP BETWEEN OUR PEOPLES IS A LONG ONE AND EACH HAS BENEFITTED FROM THE SPECIAL CONTRIBUTIONS THAT THE OTHER CAN MAKE.

ONE OF THE MOST IMPORTANT INTERESTS WE SHARE IS A CONCERN FOR THE INDEPENDENCE AND TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY OF IRAN. THE STRENGTH, SECURITY AND WELL-BEING OF IRAN AS A FREE NATION IS A MATTER WHICH DIRECTLY AFFECTS OUR OWN SECURITY. FOR THAT REASON, IT IS A FUNDAMENTAL PRINCIPLE OF OUR POLICY THAT THE PEOPLE OF IRAN MUST BE FREE TO CHOOSE THEIR OWN FORM OF GOVERNMENT IN THE CONTEXT OF THEIR OWN HISTORICAL EXPERIENCE, WITHOUT THE IMPOSITION OF FOREIGN PRESSURES OR ALIEN IDEOLOGIES.

OUR NATIONS ALSO SHARE A DEEP RESPECT FOR RELIGIOUS VALUES. OUR OWN NATION WAS BUILT ON A FOUNDATION OF SPIRITUAL VALUES GROWING OUT OF THE BELIEF THAT ALL MEN SHOULD BE FREE TO WORSHIP ACCORDING TO THEIR OWN CONSCIENCE. THERE IS A LARGE AND VIGOROUS ISLAMIC COMMUNITY IN THE UNITED STATES (MORE THAN 2 MILLION MOSLEMS) AND THEIR NUMBER IS GROWING.

WE BELIEVE THAT OUR NATIONS HAVE MUCH TO LEARN FROM EACH OTHER, AND WE ARE CONVINCED THAT THE INTERESTS AND VALUES THAT WE SHARE PROVIDE THE BASIS FOR A STRONG RELATIONSHIP BASED ON MUTUAL RESPECT AND UNDERSTANDING.

WE EXPRESS OUR CONDOLENCES AT THE ASSASSINATION OF GENERAL GHARANI AND AYATOLLAH MOTAHERI. THEIR LOSS TO IRAN IS FELT IN HUMAN TERMS AND ALSO AS AN IMPEDIMENT TO THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PEACEFUL, DEMOCRATIC CONDITIONS.

IT IS OUR FIRM INTENTION NOT TO BECOME INVOLVED IN ANY WAY IN IRAN'S INTERNAL AFFAIRS. WE HOPE THAT OTHER COUNTRIES WILL BE EQUALLY SCRUPULOUS IN THIS REGARD. IF AT ANY TIME THERE IS CONCERN ABOUT THE ACTIVITIES OF AMERICANS IN IRAN OR IF THE AYATOLLAH OR HIS ASSOCIATES HAVE ANY QUESTIONS ABOUT UNITED STATES POLICY, WE URGE THAT THESE BE RAISED WITH US AT ONCE. WE DO NOT BELIEVE THAT DOUBTS SHOULD BE ALLOWED TO FESTER. WE SHOULD CLEAR THE RECORD FRANKLY AND WITHOUT DELAY WHEN THERE ARE UNRESOLVED PROBLEMS.

AN IMPORTANT PROBLEM THAT AFFECTS OUR EFFORTS TO NORMALIZE OUR RELATIONS IN IRAN IS THE DIFFICULT SECURITY PROBLEM THAT OUR EMBASSY PERSONNEL FACE. WE APPRECIATE THE PROTECTION THAT HAS BEEN PROVIDED, BUT WE BELIEVE THAT STRONGER ASSISTANCE MAY BE NECESSARY DURING THIS PERIOD WHEN CONDITIONS ARE STILL SOMEWHAT UNSETTLED. WE VIEW THE DOUBTS AND SUSPICIONS WHICH HAVE ARISEN BETWEEN OUR TWO NATIONS AS A TEMPORARY SITUATION, AND WE WELCOME THE OPPORTUNITY TO DISCUSS THOSE ISSUES WHICH COULD STRENGTHEN SECURITY FOR OUR PEOPLE AND WHICH COULD PROVIDE A SOUNDER BASE FOR THE NEW RELATIONSHIP WHICH WE SEEK WITH THE GOVERNMENT AND PEOPLE OF IRAN.

WE HOPE THAT THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION CAN BE SEEN AS BASED ON RESPECT FOR BASIC HUMAN RIGHTS. IN OUR VIEW, THIS IS AN ISSUE OF UNIVERSAL CONCERN WHICH GOES BEYOND IMMEDIATE QUESTIONS OF OUR BILATERAL RELATIONS. SPECIFICALLY, WE ARE CONCERNED ABOUT THE REPORTS OF RECENT SUMMARY TRIALS AND EXECUTIONS. WE DO NOT ATTEMPT TO JUDGE THE GUILT OR INNOCENCE OF THE ACCUSED, BUT WE BELIEVE STRONGLY THAT THEY -- NO MATTER WHAT THE CHARGE -- SHOULD BE AFFORDED THE RIGHT TO AN OPEN TRIAL WITH FULL OPPORTUNITY TO DEFEND THEMSELVES.

THE U.S. WISHES IRAN WELL IN THE GREAT TASKS WHICH LIE AHEAD. WE HOPE THAT EVERYTHING POSSIBLE CAN BE DONE TO STRENGTHEN THE GOVERNMENT'S ABILITY TO RESTORE NORMAL LIFE AND ORDERLY PROGRESS. THE GOVERNMENT IS FACED WITH MANY PROBLEMS, PARTICULARLY IN THE ECONOMIC SECTOR, WHICH ARE COMPLEX AND WILL TAKE TIME TO RESOLVE. WE BELIEVE THE UNITED STATES CAN HELP IRAN IN THE FIELDS OF AGRICULTURE AND ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT SHOULD IRAN SO WISH. WE ARE READY TO ASSIST THE PEOPLE OF IRAN, AND WE WOULD WELCOME CONSULTATIONS WITH MEMBERS OF THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT ON THESE AND OTHER AREAS OF POSSIBLE COOPERATION.

IN CLOSING, ALTHOUGH THERE MAY BE DIFFERENCES OF OPINION IN THE FUTURE WE HOPE THESE CAN BE ADDRESSED FRANKLY AND WITH MUTUAL UNDERSTANDING WITHOUT EXCITING EMOTIONS. WE WANT TO BE CONSIDERED AS A FRIEND OF IRAN AS THE COUNTRY WORKS OUT THE MANY PROBLEMS WHICH IT WILL FACE IN SHAPING ITS FUTURE.

AS YOU WILL RECALL, THE SEC ORIGINALLY BROUGHT SUIT AGAINST GRUMMAN CHARGING THAT THE COMPANY HAD FILED MISLEADING REPORTS WITH THE COMMISSION. AS PART OF THE SETTLEMENT OF THAT LITIGATION, GRUMMAN AGREED TO HAVE ITS AUDIT COMMITTEE CONDUCT TWO INVESTIGATIONS AND REPORT TO THE DISTRICT COURT IN WASHINGTON. THE AUDIT COMMITTEE IS COMPOSED OF FIVE NON-EMPLOYEE MEMBERS OF THE GRUMMAN BOARD. ONE INVESTIGATION CONCERNS COMMERCIAL SALES AND HAS BEEN COMPLETED. THE SECOND INVESTIGATION RELATES TO IRAN. INVESTIGATORY WORK IS BEING PERFORMED ON BEHALF OF THE AUDIT COMMITTEE BY THE NEW YORK LAW FIRM ALEXANDER AND GREENE. THE LAWYER IN CHARGE OF THE WORK, MR.

CAROLL, DESCRIBES HIS FIRM AS "ACTING UNDER THE SUPERVISION OF THE DISTRICT COURT." THE SEC AND DISTRICT COURT WILL EACH RECEIVE A COPY OF THE INVESTIGATION REPORT AND, SUBSEQUENTLY, THE JUDGE WILL DECIDE WHAT ACTION, IF ANY, TO TAKE AGAINST GRUMMAN.

MR. CAROLL HAS A FAIR LIST OF PEOPLE HE WOULD LIKE TO TALK WITH IN IRAN INCLUDING MASSUMI, ARDALAN (RETIRED AT HOME WHEN WE LAST HEARD OF HIM) AND BARAMI. HE WOULD TALK ONLY TO THOSE PERSONS WHO WISH TO SEE HIM. HE WOULD BE PLEASED IF THE EMBASSY WOULD DELIVER HIS LETTERS OF INVITATION TO A PRIVATE MEETING IN TEHRAN TO THE INDIVIDUALS CONCERNED. THERE WOULD BE NO PROBLEM WITH YOUR QUIETLY SOUNDING OUT MASSUM, BARAMI, AND ANYONE YOU THINK COULD PROVIDE SOUND ADVICE. AS NOTED IN PREVIOUS CABLE, CAROLL WOULD ALSO LIKE TO INSPECT ANY RECORDS AVAILABLE AT MINISTRIES OF JUSTICE OR DEFENSE.
YOU MIGHT WISH TO RAISE THIS QUESTION WITH MINISTER OF JUSTICE SHOULD YOU CALL ON HIM.
CAROLL UNDERSTANDS FULLY SENSITIVE CONDITIONS THAT PREVAIL IN IRAN AND IS PERFECTLY HAPPY TO ACCEPT YOUR JUDGMENT AS TO HOW WE SHOULD PROCEED, IF AT ALL. VANCE

IN HOUR-LONG MEETING MAY 10, DEPASSTSEC COHEN AND DEPTOFF PRECHT REVIEWED WITH IRANIAN CHARGE AGAH REPERCUSSIONS OF TRIALS AND EXECUTIONS. PRINCIPAL THEMES AND CONCEPTS DISCUSSED INCLUDED THE FOLLOWING

FAVORABLE US PUBLIC REACTION TO IRANIAN REVOLUTION WAS BEING SERIOUSLY ERODED BY DISMAY AMONG FRIENDS OF REVOLUTION AT SUMMARY TRIALS AND EXECUTIONS. ACCORDING TO POST-REVOLUTION POLL, MAJORITY OF AMERICANS BELIEVED SHAH'S FALL WAS RESULT OF HIS REPRESSIVE REGIME. THIS KIND OF SYMPATHY FOR REVOLUTION AMONG WELL-INFORMED, LIBERAL AMERICANS WAS NOW DISAPPEARING. AMERICANS COULD NOT UNDERSTAND CLOSED NATURE OF TRIALS AND LACK OF PERMISSION FOR EFFECTIVE DEFENSE.

PGOI'S TREATMENT OF ITS ENEMIES WAS KILLING RESPECT AND ISOLATING IRAN FROM COUNTRIES THAT WANTED TO BE FRIENDLY. CONTINUATION OF TRIALS AND EXECUTIONS WAS SINGLE LARGEST IMPEDIMENT IN US EFFORT TO BUILD NEW RELATIONSHIP WITH PGOI. US EARNESTLY WANTED TO SEE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT BECOME STRONGER AND MORE STABLE. EXECUTIONS WERE WORKING AGAINST THAT TREND. MANY IRANIANS WHO HAD MUCH TO CONTRIBUTE TO PROSPERITY AND DEMOCRACY OF A NEW IRAN WERE NOW FEARFUL TO RETURN AND, IF THERE, WERE ANXIOUS TO LEAVE.

IT WOULD BE PREFERABLE IF PGOI COULD PUT THE PAST BEHIND IT AND FORGIVE THOSE WHO HAD NOT COMMITTED DEADLY SINS. IF SOME TRIALS HAD TO CONTINUE, IT WOULD BE DESIRABLE FOR PGOI TO INVITE AMNESTY INTERNATIONAL OR SOME OTHER INTERNATIONAL GROUP TO OBSERVE AND REPORT. AGAH AGREED AND SAID HE WOULD PURSUE THIS IDEA.

WITH RESPECT TO MR. ELGHANIAN, IT APPEARED FROM TEHRAN RADIO BROADCAST THAT HE WAS EXECUTED BECAUSE OF HIS POLITICAL BELIEF; I.E., ZIONISM. THAT WAS NOT TRUE, AGAH SAID. HE WAS ACCUSED AS AN INDIVIDUAL FOR SPECIFIC OFFENSES (E.G., ESPIONAGE FOR ISRAEL).

EXECUTION OF ELGHANIAN HAD MADE JEWISH COMMUNITIES IN IRAN AND ABROAD VERY NERVOUS, FOR MANY PEOPLE COULD MEET SAME FATE THROUGH THEIRASSOCIATION WITH ZIONISM AND ISRAEL. WE WERE AWARE THAT AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI AND OTHER LEADERS HAD MADE SPECIAL EFFORTS TO REASSURE MINORITY COMMUNITIES THAT THEIR RIGHTS WOULD BE PROTECTED. PGOI NEEDED TO GIVE RENEWED ATTENTION TO THAT ASPECT IN WAKE OF ELGHANIAN KILLING.

AGAH CLAIMED MANY FROM FORMER REGIME WERE PLOTTING AGAINST PGOI IN IRAN, THE US AND ELSEWHERE. RESUMPTION OF EXECUTIONS WAS DESIGNED TO MEET THAT THREAT FOLLOWING ASSASSINATIONS IN TEHRAN. PRECHT SAID WE HAD HEARD VARIETY OF STORIES ABOUT COUNTER-REVOLUTIONARY PLOTTING IN THE US. IN ONE CASE WHERE WE HAD SOME HARD DETAIL, WE HAD REFERRED MATTER TO DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE FOR INQUIRY WHETHER A US LAW HAD BEEN VIOLATED. WE WOULD DO SAME WITH ANY OTHER SIMILAR EVIDENCE THAT CAME TO OUR ATTENTION. IRANIANS COULD ALSO SUE FORMER REGIME OFFICIALS IN US CIVIL COURTS IF PERSONAL DAMAGES HAD BEEN INFLICTED IN IRAN.

AGAH TOOK FULL NOTES THROUGHOUT CONVERSATION. HE SEEMED SYMPATHETIC TO VIEWS EXPRESSED AND SAID HE AND ROUHANI HAD BEEN WORKING HARD ON PROBLEM. ALTHOUGH HE OFFERED STANDARD DEFENSE OF EXECUTIONS, HE SAID HE THOUGHT HIS COLLEAGUES IN TEHRAN, KNOWING HIS LONG SUPPORT FOR REVOLUTION, WOULD LISTEN TO HIS PRESENTATION OF US POSI
(C) ENTIRE TEXT.

1979STATE120164.subject: REQUEST FOR INFORMATION ON AFGHANISTAN AND PDRY

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT)

EMBASSY SHOULD ALREADY HAVE RECEIVED A NUMBER OF TELEGRAMS WHICH BEAR ON SUBJECT (STATE 83740, STATE 93724, KABUL 3626) OF SOVIET ROLE IN AFGHANISTAN AND HAS ALREADY BEEN AUTHORIZED TO SHARE MUCH OF THIS INFORMATION WITH PGOI. IN ADDITION YOU MAY USE FOLLOWING INR UPDATE OF STATE 94905 (PREPARED FOR AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN IN LATE MARCH), WHICH CONTAINS INFORMATION LARGELY DRAWN FROM OPEN SOURCES.

AFGHANISTAN: SOVIET COMMENTARY ON AFGHANISTAN HAS DECLINED OVER THE LAST TWO TO THREE WEEKS. WHILE THE SOVIET PRESS CONTINUES TO IMPLY THAT THE US AND PAKISTAN ARE BEHIND DISTURBANCES IN AFGHANISTAN, THE FREQUENCY, TONE AND AUTHORITATIVE LEVEL OF THESE INSINUATIONS HAVE DECREASED. MOSCOW STILL ATTACKS THE CHINESE VEHEMENTLY, HOWEVER. TO COUNTER SOME OF THE ANTI-SOVIET SENTIMENT IN THE MUSLIM WORLD ENGENDERED BY MOSCOW'S SUPPORT FOR KABUL, ATTEMPTS ARE BEING MADE TO IMPROVE THE IMAGE OF THE MUSLIM MINORITIES IN THE USSR.

ON TWO OCCASIONS IN THE LAST MONTH, SOVIET RADIO HAS CARRIED MESSAGES BY THE MUFTI OF TASHKENT EXTOLLING THE SOVIET POLICY OF RELIGIOUS FREEDOM AND THE STATE OF ISLAM IN THE USSR. ATSAME TIME, THE SOVIETS HAVE BEEN CAREFUL TO EMPHASIZE STATE-TO-STATE RELATIONS AND DOWNPLAY THE MARXIST ORIENTATION OF THE PEOPLE'S DEMOCRATIC PARTY OF AFGHANISTAN (PDPA).

SOVIET MEDIA COVERAGE OF THE FIRST ANNIVERSARY OF THE AFGHAN REVOLUTION ON APRIL 27 WAS UNEXCEPTIONAL. BOTH BREZHNEV ND KOSYGIN SENT THEIR CONGRATULATIONS WHILE COMMENTARY STRESSED THE PROGRESS MADE IN THE LAST 12 MONTHS, BUT ADDED THAT THERE WAS STILL A LONG WAY TO GO. DESPITE REPEATED PLEDGES OF SUPPORT, THE SOVIETS WERE CAREFUL TO STRESS THE DRA'S NON-ALIGNED STATUS. MOSCOW HAS STILL NOT RECOGNIZED THE PDPA AS A COMMUNIST PARTY, AND IS UNLIKELY TO DO SO UNTIL THE SITUATION IN AFGHANISTAN AND THE DRA'S HOLD ON THE COUNTRY STABILIZES.

INDEED, THERE ARE INDICATIONS THAT THE SOVIETS REGRET THEIR CLOSE ASSOCIATION WITH THE TARAKI REGIME, BUT THEIR COMMITMENT TO ITS SURVIVAL REMAINS FIRM. THE SOVIETS HAVE REFERRED TO THE PDPA AS A "VANGUARD PARTY" AND THE REVOLUTION IN AFGHANISTAN AS IN THE SPIRIT OF "PROLETARIAN INTERNATIONALISM," HOWEVER. POLITBURO MEMBER SUSLOV RECENTLY CLAIMED AFGHANISTAN WAS ON THE ROAD OF "SOCIALIST ORIENTATION" MUCH LIKE ETHIOPIA AND MOZAMBIQUE. THAT IS, IT IS PROGRESSIVE BUT HAS A LONG WAY TO GO BEFORE IT CAN START TO BUILD "GENUINE SOCIALISM."

THE FIGHTING IN AFGHANISTAN SEEMS TO HAVE INTENSIFIED AND SPREAD DESPITE KABUL'S EFFORTS TO SUPPRESS REBEL ACTIVITY. GOVERNMENT CONTROL OVER RURAL AREAS OF KONARHA, NANGAHAR AND PAKTIA PROVINCES SEEMS TENUOUS AND FIGHTING THERE HAS BEEN HEAVY. DISTURBANCES HAVE OCCURED ON THE OUTSKIRTS OF KABUL. THERE WERE NO SERIOUS DISTURBANCES DURING THE ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATIONS--LARGELY DUE TO SOVIET COORDINATION OF THE SECURITY PREPARATIONS-BUT REPORTS OF ASSASINATIONS OF HIGH AFGHAN OFFICIALS AND SOVIET ADVISORS PERSIST. REPORTEDLY, A NUMBER OF SOVIETS HAVE BEEN KILLED THUS FART RECENTLY IN AN APPARENT ARMY MUTINY IN JALALABAD.

IN RESPONSE TO KABUL'S NEEDS, MOSCOW HAS APPARENTLY STEPPED UP ITS MILITARY AID. MUCH OF THIS WAS ALREADY ON THE BOOKS, BUT DELIVERY DATES HAVE BEEN ADVANCED. ACCORDING TO RELIABLE PRESS ACCOUNTS, THERE ARE NOW OVER 3,000 SOVIET ADVISORS IN AFGHANISTAN; ABOUT 1000 OF THEM ARE MILITARY PERSONNEL. THE USSR HAS RECENTLY DELIVERED ABOUT A DOZEN MI-24 COMBAT HELICOPTERS; SINCE THERE ARE NO AFGHAN PILOTS CHECKED OUT ON THESE AIRCRAFT, SOVIET PILOTS MAY BE OPERATING THEM UNTIL AFGHAN PILOTS ARE TRAINED.

IN EARLY APRIL, GENERAL YEPISHEV, CHIEF OF THE MAIN POLITICAL DIRECTORATE OF THE ARMY AND NAVY, HEADED A DELEGATION TO KABUL, PRESUMABLY TO DISCUSS ARMY LOYALTY AND INDOCTRINATION BUT ALSO PROBABLY TO SURVEY THE SITUATION FOR MOSCOW AND JUDGE THE TARAKI REGIME'S CHANCES OF SURVIVAL.

PDRY: WHILE VISITING ETHIOPIA IN EARLY MAY, PDRY STRONGMAN ISMAIL PUBLICLY THANKED THE USSR AND CUBA FOR THEIR AID IN THE RECENT FIGHTING WITH THE YAR AND PLACED THE PDRY IN THE VAN OF THE "GREAT OCTOBER REVOLUTION" AND WORLD REVOLUTIONARY STRUGGLE. MOSCOW STOOD BY ADEN THROUGHOUT THE CONFLICT. WHILE THERE WAS NO SIGNIFICANT INCREASE IN ARMS DELIVERIES DURING THE FIGHTING, SOVIET SHIPMENTS TO THE PDRY HAD BEEN HIGH SINCE LAST SUMMER, AND THE PDRY PROBABLY HAD WHAT IT NEEDED.

MOSCOW ALSO APPEARED TO FAVOR A MEDIATED SETTLEMENT AND PUBLICLY PRAISED ARAB EFFORTS TO BRING AN END TO THE CONFLICT. BEFORE THE FIGHTING BROKE-OUT, THE USSR HAD BEEN TRYING TO IMPROVE RELATIONS WITH BOTH THE YAR AND THE SAUDIS. FOR ITS PART, IRAQ MAY HAVE BEEN INSTRUMENTAL IN THE MEDIATION EFFORT IN ORDER TO COUNTER A GROWTH IN SOVIET INFLUENCE IN THE ARABIAN PENNINSULA.

DURING THE LAST WEEK OF APRIL, THE SOVIET AFRO-ASIAN SOLIDARITY COMMITTEE HOSTED A DELEGATION FROM THE POPULAR FRONT FOR THERATION OF OMAN. SINCE JANUARY, THE SOVIET PRESS HAS CARRIED SEVERAL CRITICAL COMMENTARIES ON OMAN AND THE SULTAN'S GOVERNMENT, HINTING THAT THE IRAN THE DHOFAR REBELLION--NOW THAT IRAN IS NO LONGER PROVIDING TROOPS TO UPHOLD THE GOVERNMENT--MAY REVIVE. MOSCOW IS PARTICULARLY DISPLEASED WITH OMAN'S REFUSAL TO SUPPORT THE BAGHDAD SANCTIONS AND BREAK TIES WITH EGYPT OVER THE MIDDLE EAST PEACE PROCESS.
WE WILL BE RESPONDING TO PARA 5 REFTEL SEPARATELY.
(S) ENTIRE TEXT.

PLEASE DELIVER FOLLOWING LETTER FROM THE SECRETARY TO FOREIGN MINISTER YAZDI. "DEAR MR. MINISTER: I WISH TO CONVEY TO YOU MY WARM CONGRATULATIONS ON YOUR RECENT APPOINTMENT AS IRAN'S FOREIGN MINISTER AND TO EXPRESS MY BEST WISHES AS YOU TAKE UP YOUR IMPORTANT NEW RESPONSIBILITIES. YOU MAY BE SURE THAT YOU WILL HAVE MY FULL COOPERATION AS WE ADDRESS COMMON PROBLEMS AND THE MANY INTERESTS THAT WE SHARE. IN A FEW WEEKS WE WILL SEND A NEW AMBASSADOR, WALTER CUTLER, TO TEHRAN. AMBASSADOR CUTLER IS ONE OF OUR MOST ABLE PROFESSIONAL DIPLOMATS AND ENJOYS THE FULL CONFIDENCE OF THE PRESIDENT AND MYSELF.

HIS APPOINTMENT SIGNIFIES OUR DESIRE TO MAKE A NEW BEGINNING AND TO ESTABLISH THE CLOSEST POSSIBLE RELATIONSHIP WITH YOUR GOVERNMENT AND TO PURSUE PROGRAMS OF COOPERATION WHEREVER THAT IS POSSIBLE. IN THE MONTHS AHEAD I HOPE THAT WE CAN MAINTAIN, EITHER DIRECTLY OR THROUGH OUR REPRESENTATIVES, A FULL AND FRANK EXCHANGE OF VIEWS. THERE IS MUCH BUSINESS ON OUR MUTUAL AGENDA AND I BELIEVE WE HAVE A SHARED INTEREST IN SEEKING TO BUILD A COMMON UNDERSTANDING AND BASIS FOR COOPERATION OF MUTUAL BENEFIT.

WE ARE READY TO ASSIST IRAN IN WAYS THAT YOU CONSIDER APPROPRIATE ON ECONOMIC MATTERS AND AS YOU KNOW WE HAVE INDICATED OUR READINESS TO WORK CLOSELY WITH YOUR MILITARY LEADERSHIP IN RESOLVING ANY PAST PROBLEMS AND DISCUSSING ANY FUTURE COOPERATION. WE HAVE HAD SEVERAL CONVERSATIONS ON HUMAN RIGHTS QUESTIONS AND I AM SURE YOU ARE AWARE OF THE IMPORTANCE THIS ADMINISTRATION ATTACHES TO THOSE CONCERNS. AS MY ASSOCIATES AND I HAVE ASSURED YOUR GOVERNMENT, THE UNITED STATES HAS NO INTENTION WHATSOEVER TO BECOME INVOLVED IN IRAN'S INTERNAL AFFAIRS.

YOUR INDEPENDENCE AND TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY ARE IMPORTANT TO US AND WE TRUST THAT OTHER NATIONS WILL HAVE THE SAME SCRUPULOUS REGARD FOR THE STANDARD OF NON-INVOLVEMENT. AT SOME POINT IN THE FUTURE, I HOPE IT WILL BE POSSIBLE FOR US TO MEET AND IN THE MEANTIME I WANT YOU TO FEEL FREE TO COMMUNICATE WITH US ON MATTERS OF COMMON CONCERN. SINCERELY, CYRUS VANCE."

APPRECIATE SERIOUS CONSTRAINTS AFFECTING YOUR OPERATIONS BUT HOPE THAT YOU WILL BE ABLE TO GIVE US AN INTERIM REPORT OF FINDINGS AND ANY CONVERSATIONS YOU MAY HAVE FOR OUR USE WITH INTERESTED MEMBERS OF CONGRESS AND THE PUBLIC TOMORROW MORNING. WE ARE ALSO INTERESTED IN IRANIAN PRESS AND RADIO/TV COVERAGE OF THIS ISSUE. VANCE

FOLLOWING EXCERPT ON IRAN IS TAKEN FROM THE SECRETARY'S APPEARANCE BEFORE THE HOUSE FOREIGN AFF8IRS COMMITTEE ON MAY 8: "MR. WOLPE: COULD YOU, MR. SECRETARY, PROVIDE AN ASSESSMENT AS TO THE DEVELOPMENT OF THE SITUATION IN IRAN AS OF THIS MOMENT? MR. VANCE: YES, LET ME DO IT VERY BRIEFLY. THE SITUATION IS A FRAGILE ONE AT THIS POINT AS IS EVIDENT FROM OUR DAILY NEWSPAPERS. THE NEW GOVERNMENT IS IN THE PROCESS OF ESTABLISHING ITSELF AND EXTENDING ITS AUTHORITY THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY. THIS IS A VERY DIFFICULT TASK AS IS TRUE WITH ANY REVOLUTIONARY SITUATION. THERE ARE DIFFERENCES THAT ARE APPARENT.

I WOULD SAY THE PRIME MINISTER AND HIS GOVERNMENT ARE MOVING IN WHAT I THINK IS A CONSTRUCTIVE WAY TO SEIZE HOLD AND GOVERN THE COUNTRY UNDER EXTREMELY DIFFICULT CIRCUMSTANCES. THE PRIME MINISTER IS AN EXTREMELY ABLE MAN. ALL OF US WISH HIM WELL IN WHAT HE IS DOING." PGOI AND OTHER INTERESTED PARTIES. VANCE

1979STATE122586.subject: YOUR MEETING WITH FOREIGN MINISTER YAZDI

segments.text: (C-ENTIRE TEXT)

WHEN YOU SEE YAZDI, PLEASE MENTION TO HIM THAT AMBASSADOR CUTLER WILL-HAVE HIS CONFIRMATION HEARINGS AT 10 A.M. WASHINGTON TIME MAY 15. WE WOULD APPRECIATE ANY WORD YAZDI MIGHT GIVE US ON THE FOLLOWING TWO SUBJECTS. YOU MAY SAY THAT WE ANTICIPATE STRONG CONGRESSIONAL INTERESTS IN THESE TWO SUBJECTS AND WOULD BE GLAD TO REPEAT ANY WORD OF EXPLANATION OR STATEMENT OF PGOI POLICY THAT YAZDI MIGHT LIKE TO PROVIDE. (A) STATUS OF JEWS AND OTHER MINORITY GROUPS.

THERE IS CONCERN HERE THAT EXECUTION OF ELGHANIAN MAY LEAD TO PRESSURE AGAINST JEWISH COMMUNITY BECAUSE OF TIES WITH ISRAEL AND "ZIONISM." THERE ARE MANY STORIES THAT NUMBERS OF PROMINENT JEWS HAVE RECENTLY BEEN ARRESTED. WE WOULD APPRECIATE CLARIFICATION AS TO FACTS AND POLICY. (B) LEGAL STATUS OF ARMISH-MAAG PERSONNEL. IN CURRENT IRANIAN CONDITIONS OF REVOLUTIONARY COURTS IN OPERATION, SOME AMERICANS FEAR THAT DEPRIVING AMERICAN MILITARY ADVISERS OF THEIR IMMUNITY MAY PLACE THEM IN JEOPARDY. PLEASE NOTE THAT U.S.-IRANIAN BILATERAL AGREEMENTS ON THIS SUBJECT REMAIN IN EFFECT. IF IRAN IS TO SEEK U.S.

MILITARY ADVISORY EFFORT IN THE FUTURE, WE WILL NATURALLY HAVE TO MAKE ADEQUATE ARRANGEMENTS TO PROVIDE FORPROTECTION OF PERSONNEL. WOULD APPRECIATE ANY CLARIFICATION YAZDI CAN PROVIDE ON THIS SUBJECT. VANCE
FOR YOUR INFORMATION AND GUIDANCE FOLLOWING ARE EXCERPTS FROM DEPARTMENT PRESS BRIEFING FOR MAY 14, 1979. SPOKESMAN WAS HODDING CARTER III.

DO YOU HAVE ANY COMMENT ON THE AYATOLLAH'S ANNOUNCEMENT, FIRST, THAT ONLY MURDER OR SOMETHING LIKE IT WILL BE PUNISHED BY DEATH IN THE FUTURE, AND THE OTHER AYATOLLAH'S STATEMENT THAT KILLING THE SHAH AND MEMBERS OF HIS FAMILY WOULD NOT BE AN ACT OF TERRORISM?

THAT IS TWO SEPARATE NOTIONS HERE. INSOFAR AS THE STATEMENT THAT THERE WOULD BE A MORE TIGHTLY RESTRICTED SET OF CRITERIA FOR THE ACTION OF REVOLUTIONARY EXECUTIONS, WE WELCOME ANY DEVELOPMENT WHICH FURTHERS THE CAUSE OF FAIRNESS AND JUSTICE IN IRAN. IN THAT REGARD, WE HAVE ALSO NOTED PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN'S APPEAL FOR IRANIANS TO FOREGO VENGENCE AND TO PUT THE PAST BEHIND THEM SO THAT THE WORK OF RECONSTRUCTION CAN PROCEED. WE CONTINUE TO SUPPORT DUE PROCESS AND ORDERLY PROCEDURES IN IRAN'S COURTS. THAT IS A MATTER OF STRONG AMERICAN POLICY WHICH WE HAVE REITERATED ON SEVERAL COUNTS.

THEREFORE, I WOULD SAY IN REGARD TO THE SECOND QUESTION, WHICH IS THE ANNOUNCEMENT OF AN ATTITUDE TOWARD THE SHAH AND MEMBERS OF HIS FAMILY AND CERTAIN CLOSE ASSOCIATES, THAT WE DEPLORE ANY INVITATION TO INDISCRIMINATE VIOLENT ACTS OF THIS KIND. AS WE HAVE REPEATEDLY SAID, JUDGMENTS ON THE ACTIONS, CONDUCT OF OTHERS, CAN ONLY PROPERLY BE MADE THROUGH THE PROCESS OF LAW.
WOULD THIS "CONTRACT" ON THE SHAH AND HIS FAMILY MAKE ANY DIFFERENCE IN THE DECISION OF WHETHER THE SHAH WOULD BE PERMITTED OR INVITED TO COME LIVE IN THE UNITED STATES?

THE GOVERNMENT'S BASIC POSITION ON THAT HAS BEEN STATED AND THERE IS NO CHANGE IN IT. I WOULD SAY ON BACKGROUND THAT IT HAS BEEN NOTED TO YOU BEFORE THAT CONSIDERATIONS OF SAFETY HAVE PLAYED A PART IN DISCUSSION WE HAVE HAD WITH VARIOUS REPRESENTATIVES OF THE SHAH AND THE SHAH. BUT THERE IS NO CHANGE IN WHAT OUR ATTITUDE IS BASED ON THIS PARTICULAR ANNOUNCEMENT.
OTHER THAN MAKING THIS STATEMENT HERE, DOES THE UNITED STATES INTEND TO DO ANYTHING ABOUT THAT SECOND ATTITUDE OF THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT?
I DONT HAVE ANY KNOWLEDGE OF ANYTHING. THAT SIMPLY CANT BE TAKEN AS ANYTHING EXCEPT WHAT IT IS. I AM NOT AWARE OF ANY OTHER STEPS AT THIS TIME.

I ASSURE THAT OR WHOEVER IT WAS WHO MADE THAT BACKGROUND REMARK ON THE CONVERSATIONS WITH THE SHAH AND HIS REPRESENTATIVE, IN RESPECT TO THE INABILITY OF THE UNITED STATES TO PROTECT HIM. WAS IT IN THAT CONTEXT?

IT WAS. THE SAME OFFICIAL SPEAKING ON THE SAME BASIS, WHICH IS STILL BACKGROUND. WHAT WE HAVE NOTED BEFORE HAS BEEN, AMONG OTHER THINGS, A LARGE NUMBER OF IRANIANS HERE IN THIS COUNTRY, THE RELATIVE FREEDOM OF MOVEMENT AND WHAT HAVE YOU THAT EXISTS HERE. AND, THEREFORE, WHAT WE HAVE TO REGARD AS A SECURITY PROBLEM. THE SHAH WOULD NOT BE HERE, AS YOU KNOW, AS A MEMBER, A HEAD OF GOVERNMENT, A HEAD OF STATE, AND THERE WOULD BE PROBLEMS. THIS HAS ALL BEEN SAID BEFORE. I AM JUST REPEATING IT HERE JUST TO PUT THIS IN SOME CONTEXT.
IS IT STATUTORY THAT THE STATE DEPARTMENT OR THE SECRET SERVICE CAN ONLY SUPPLY SUCH PROTECTION TO A HEAD OF STATE OR A HEAD OF GOVERNMENT?
YOU GET INTO THAT GREAT VAST AREA OF MY IGNORANCE HERE. I WILL HAVE TO TAKE THE QUESTION. VANCE
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)
WE CONSIDER IT MATTER OF GREAT URGENCY, AFTER CANCELLATION OF 1964 LAW MENTIONED BELOW, THAT ARMISH/MAAG PERSONNEL BE GIVEN DIPLOMATIC PROTECTION.

IN THAT CONNECTION, YOU SHOULD DELIVER AT ONCE NOTE BELOW TO APPROPRIATELY HIGH MFA LEVEL. AT SAME TIME, SUGGEST YOU INFORM YOUR MILITARY CONTACTS OF IMPORTANCE WE GIVE TO THIS SUBJECT AND ACTION WE ARE TAKING.

. THE EMBASSY OF THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA (COMPLIMENTARY OPENING) AND TAKES NOTE OF THE RECENT STATEMENT OF THE FOREIGN MINISTRY OF THE PROVISIONAL ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT OF IRAN ANNOUNCING THE GOVERNMENT'S DECISION TO ABOLISH THE LAW GRANTING AMERICAN MILITARY ADVISERS IN IRAN THE ENJOYMENT OF THE PRIVILEGES AND IMMUNITIES OF THE VIENNA CONVENTION, ENACTED 13 OCTOBER 1964.

. BECAUSE OF THIS ACTION, ALL REMAINING AMERICAN MILITARY ADVISORY PERSONNEL CURRENTLY IN IRAN, UNDER AGREEMENTS AND ARRANGEMENTS MADE BETWEEN THE TWO GOVERNMENTS, HAVE BEEN ASSIGNED BY THE GOVERNMENT OF THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA TO THE UNITED STATES EMBASSY AS MEMBERS OF ITS ADMINISTRATIVE AND TECHNICAL STAFF. THE DEPARTMENT OF STATE WILL ISSUE DIPLOMATIC PASSPORTS TO SUCH PERSONNEL AND REQUESTS THAT SUCH PERSONNEL BE DULY ACCREDITED IN THAT CAPACITY TO THE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN BY THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS. ATTACHED IS A LIST OF THE NAMES OF THOSE PERSONNEL.

. IN VIEW OF THE NEED TO CLARIFY THE STATUS OF SUCH PERSONNEL FOR THE DURATION OF THEIR STAY IN IRAN, THE EMBASSY OF THE UNITED STATES REQUESTS THE URGENT ATTENTION OF THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS TO THIS MATTER AND THE ISSUANCE TO THESE INDIVIDUALS OF DIPLOMATIC IDENTIFICATION DOCUMENTS.
. COMPLIMENTARY CLOSING. UNQUOTE.
FYI: IF GOI DOES NOT GRANT ACCREDITATION URGENTLY, WE WILL HAVE TO GIVE SERIOUS CONSIDERATION TO WITHDRAWING ALL ARMISH/MAAG PERSONNEL. VANCE

FOLLOWING IS TEXT OF RESOLUTION INTRODUCED BY SENATOR JAVITS AND OTHERS AND APPROVED BY THE SENATE MAY 17.
"WHEREAS THE PEOPLE OF IRAN REPRESENT ONE OF THE OLDEST AND MOST DISTINGUISHED CIVILIZATIONS IN THE WORLD, AND HAVE A HISTORY OF CLOSE AND FRIENDLY RELATIONS WITH THE PEOPLE OF THE UNITED STATES
"WHEREAS THERE HAVE BEEN REPORTS OF WIDESPREAD RESORT TO SECRET TRIALS AND SUMMARY EXECUTIONS WHICH OFFEND BASIC PRINCIPLES OF JUSTICE AND HUMANITY AND DUE PROCESS OF LAW

"WHEREAS THE CHIEF OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS IN IRAN IS REPORTED TO HAVE CALLED FOR THE ASSASSINATION OF THE SHAH OF IRAN, MEMBERS OF HIS FAMILY AND OTHERS LOYAL TO HIM IN ANY COUNTRY WHERE FOUND, NOTWITHSTANDING THAT INTERNATIONAL LAW STRICTLY FORBIDS THE CARRYING OUT OF EVEN CRIMINAL PUNISHMENTS OR OF TERRORISM BY ONE COUNTRY WITHIN THE TERRITORY OF ANOTHER; AND

"WHEREAS THE PROSPECTS FOR THE CONTINUATION OF CLOSE AND FRIENDLY RELATIONS BETWEEN THE PEOPLE OF IRAN AND THE PEOPLE OF THE UNITED STATES AND THE REST OF THE WORLD WOULD BE SERIOUSLY HARMED BY THE PROLONGATION OF THESE VIOLENT AND OFFENSIVE ACTIONS "THEREFORE, BE IT "RESOLVED, THAT IT IS THE SENSE OF THE SENATE THAT THE UNITED STATES

"(1) EXPRESSES IT ABHORENCE OF SUMMARY EXECUTIONS WITHOUT DUE PROCESS, AND WELCOMESRECENT STATEMENT OF THE AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI THAT EXECUTIONS FOR CRIME IN IRAN SHALL HEREAFTER BE LIMITED TO THE CRIME OF MURDER AND BE BASED UPON PROOF OF GUILT; AND

" (2) WILL ACT TO PREVENT AND TO PUNISH ANY ATTEMPTS TO CARRY OUT CRIMINAL OR TERRORIST ACTIONS AGAINST PERSONS IN THE UNITED STATES WHATEVER THEIR ALLEGED OFFENSES IN OTHER COUNTRIES." VANCE UNQUOTE CHRISTOPHER NOTE BY OC/T: ORIGINAL DIST: NEA/ADS,SSO,NSCE,ICAE,INRE,NSC-$, ICA-$,POLI,HA,IO.

1979STATE126791.subject: PRESS COVERAGE PLEASE CABLE TRANSLATIONS OF RECENT IRANIAN PRESS ARTICLES RELATING TO AMBASSADOR CUTLER'S APPOINTMENT. VAN

segments.text: PLEASE CABLE TRANSLATIONS OF RECENT IRANIAN PRESS ARTICLES RELATING TO AMBASSADOR CUTLER'S APPOINTMENT. VANCE
(U - ENTIRE TEXT) FOLLOWING ARE EXCERPTS FROM TESTIMONY OF AMBASSADOR CUTLER ON MAY 15.

BEGIN TEXT. SENATOR PERCY: HOW DO YOU ASSESSTHE STRENGTH OF MARXIST FORCES IN IRAN, AND WHAT SHOULD BE THE UNITED STATES POLICY? SHOULD WE ENCOURAGE AND SUPPORT THE MORE MODERATE FORCES IN IRAN OR SHOULD WE ADOPT A STRICTLY HANDS-OFF POLICY, NO MATTER WHAT THE TRENDS?

AMBASSADOR CUTLER: SENATOR, I THINK IT IS FAIRLY DIFFICULT TO MAKE AN ASSESSMENT AT THIS POINTOF RELATIVE STRENGTHS AND WEAKNESSES OF THE VARIOUS FACTIONS, BECAUSE AT THIS POINT THERE ARE SO MANY GROUPSANDTHE SITUATION IS SO FLUID. CERTAINLY THERE ARE THOSE GROUPS THAT YOU MENTIONED AND CERTAINLY THEY WOULDBE OF CONCERN. I THINK IT IS QUITE EVIDENT THAT THE STRONGEST FORCE RIGHT NOW IS RELATED TO THE NATIONAL RELIGION, ISLAM. THERE IS NO QUESTION THAT THE AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI IS CERTAINLY THEMOST INFLUENTIAL PERSONALITY AND LEADER IN THAT COUNTRY. I THINK THAT IS VERY EVIDENT BY THE STRENGTH OF THE REACTION AND THE RESPONSE TO HIM.

I CANNOT IMAGINE THAT IRANWOULD WANT TO TOLERATE ANY OUTSIDE INTERFERENCE IN THE REVOLUTION AS THE IRANIANS GO THROUGH THE PROCESS OF CONSOLIDATING IT, BE IT FROM WEST OR EAST. I THINK THAT THERE IS A GREAT STRENGTH OF OPINION ON THAT SCORE. I THINK WE WILL HAVE TO WATCH THE SITUATION TO SEE HOW IT SORTS ITSELF OUT. MUCH WILL DEPEND ON THE ABILITY OF THE PRESENT PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT TO EXTEND ITS AUTHORITY, ITS EFFECTIVE AUTHORITY, THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY AND TO DEVELOP AN ADMINISTRATION THAT IS WORKING AGAIN AND TO MOVE TOWARD A MORE PERMANENT GOVERNMENT AND ADMINISTRATION IN THE COUNTRY.

AS YOU KNOW, THE PRESENT GOVERNMENT UNDER PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN IS A PROVISIONAL ONE. WE EXPECT TO SEE A MOVE TOWARD ELECTIONS AND A CONSTITUTION, AND THIS WILL BE A FAIRLY DELICATE PERIOD, ONE WHICH WILL BE OF CONCERN NOT ONLY TO FRIENDS OF IRAN, BUT ALSO TO THE PRESENT GOVERNMENT AND TO THE RELIGIOUS LEADERS THERE.
SENATOR PERCY: I HAVE BEEN DEEPLY CONCERNED ABOUT THE SHAH.

AMBASSADOR CUTLER: SENATOR, I AM AWARE OF THE STRONG FEELINGS ON THIS ISSUE. BECAUSE OF THE NATURE OF THE ISSUE, AND I THINK IT IS A RATHER DELICATE ONE, I THINK IT DESERVES VERY CAREFUL STUDY. MY ANSWER TO YOUR QUESTION AS TO WHAT I WOULD RECOMMEND IS A VERY HONEST ONE AND IT IS THIS: I HAVE VERY RECENTLY RETURNED FROM ZAIRE. I WOULD REGARD IT AS MY RESPONSIBILITYTO LOOK AT THIS MATTER VERY CAREFULLY BEFORE I ACTUALLY MAKE ANY RECOMMENDATIONS. I THINK A QUESTION SUCH AS THIS HAS TO BE VIEWED IN A BROAD CONTEXT, CERTAINLY ONE THAT INCLUDES OUR BROADER NATIONAL INTERESTS.

THERE ARE A NUMBEROF COMPLICATING FACTORS WITH RESPECT TO A DECISION BY THE SHAH TO COME INTO THIS COUNTRY. THE BEST I CAN TELL YOU AT THIS POINT, SENATOR, IS THAT I THINK THIS DESERVES CAREFUL STUDY AND THAT IS WHAT I INTEND TO GIVE IT.
SENATOR PERCY: HAVE YOU ENGAGED IN ANY CONVERSATIONS WITH THE ADMINISTRATION AND ISA POLICY BEING FORMULATED ON THIS WITHIN THE ADMINISTRATION, TO THE BEST OF YOUR KNOWLEDGE?

AMBASSADOR CUTLER: I THINK THE ADMINISTRATION HAS ALREADY STATED THAT, IN PRINCIPLE, -THE SHAH IS CERTAINLY NOT UNWELCOME HERE AND WOULD BE WELCOME, BUT THAT THERE ARE QUESTIONS OF TIMING AND SECURITY WHICH HAVE TO BE CAREFULLY CONSIDERED. I AM NOT AWARETHAT IT HASGONE BEYOND THAT. I THINK THERE IS A VERY REAL QUESTION OF SECURITY FOR THE SHAH AND HIS FAMILY. I THINK THAT POSES PROBLEMS, OBVIOUSLY, TO ANY COUNTRY WHERE HE MAYRESIDE. BUT I AM NOT ONE TO SAY THAT THIS CANNOT BE WORKED OUT, SENATOR.

MY INITIAL REACTION TO THE PROBLEM -- WHICH I ADMIT I HAVE NOT HAD A CHANCE TO STUDY IN DEPTH -- IS WHILE THERE ARE QUESTIONS OF CREDIBILITY AND OF OLD FRIENDSHIPS, I DO THINK WE SHOULD ALSO LOOK AT THE QUESTION IN THE BROAD CONTEXT OF HOW THIS WOULD IMPACT UPON OUR NATIONAL INTERESTS AND WHAT WE ARE TRYING TO DO IN IRAN ITSELF. I THINK A DECISION SHOULD NOT BE TAKEN SOLELY IN THE ABSTRACT.
SENATOR STONE: WHAT WILL BE THE POSITION OF YOUR EMBASSY AND WHAT WILL BE THE UNITED STATES POSITION WITH REGARD TO THAT TYPE OF ARREST AND EXECUTION, WITH OR WITHOUT TRIALS?

AMBASSADOR CUTLER: SENATOR, LET ME FIRST SAY THAT THE EXECUTIONS HAVE BEEN A SOURCE OF CONTINUING AND DEEP CONCERN TO THE ADMINISTRATION, OF CONCERN PARTICULARLY WITH RESPECT TO PROCEDURES. IT IS OUR HOPE THAT JUSTICE CAN BE ACCORDED IN ACCORDANCE WITH INTERNATIONALLYACCEPTED STANDARDS. THIS HAS NOT BEEN THE CASE AND WE HAVE CONTINUED TO MAKE OUR VIEWS KNOWN, BOTH PUBLICLY AND PRIVATELY. WITH REGARD TO THE SPECIFIC CASE THAT YOU MENTIONED, CERTAINLY I WOULD SHARE YOUR CONCERN AS TO THE POSSIBLE IMPLICATIONS OF THIS. I WOULD SAY AT THIS POINT THE IMPLICATIONS ARE NOT ENTIRELY CLEAR.

THE INDIVIDUAL WAS, AS FAR AS WE HAVE BEEN ABLE TO DETERMINE FROM REPORTS, CHARGED WITH SEVERAL CRIMES, AS VIEWED BY THE AUTHORITIES. IT IS NOT CLEAR THAT THE EXECUTION WASTHE RESULT OF ANY SPECIFIC ONE -- THAT IS, BEING A MEMBER OF A MINORITY GROUP OR HAVING SUPPORTED ZIONISM, FOR EXAMPLE. HOWEVER, I THINK THERE ARE GROUNDS FOR CONCERN THAT THIS MIGHT NOT BE JUST AN INDIVIDUAL CASE, THAT IT MIGHT EXTEND TO OTHERS. -WE ARE FOLLOWING THIS VERY CLOSELY.

WE ARE CONTINUING TO MAKE OUR VIEWS KNOWN THROUGH A VARIETY OF CHANNELS, WHICH I THINK WOULD BE INAPPROPRIATE TO DISCUSS IN DETAIL AT THIS PARTICULAR POINT, ALTHOUGH I WOULD BE VERY HAPPY TO DO SO LATER. AT THE SAME TIME, THERE ARE SOME ENCOURAGING INDICATORS. THE GOVERNMENT HAS ALL ALONG TAKEN-THE POSITION THAT ITWOULD PROTECT THE STATUS OF MINORITIES IN IRAN, AND, AS FAR AS WE ARE CONCERNED, THAT POSITION-HAS NOT BEEN ALTERED. AS A MATTER OF FACT, IT HAS BEEN REPEATED TO US WITHIN THE PAST DAY BY THE GOVERNMENT IN RESPONSE TO OUR QUERY.

THERE HAVE ALSO BEEN STATEMENTS FROM THE AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI WHICH WOULD SEEM TO INDICATE A MOVE TOWARD RESTRICTING THE BASIS FOR EXECUTIONS, THAT IS, THOSE WHO ARE GUILTY OF KILLING OR GIVING ORDERS TO KILL OR TORTURE TO THE POINT OF DEATH.
SENATOR JAVITS: MR. CUTLER, WHAT I WOULD LIKE TO ASK YOU IS THIS. WHAT INFLUENCE DOES THE UNITED STATES REALLY HAVE IN IRAN NOW? WHAT CAN WE DO?

AMBASSADOR CUTLER: SENATOR, THAT IS A VERY GOOD QUESTION AT THIS PARTICULAR POINT, GIVEN THE CHANGE IN OUR OVERALL RELATIONSHIP THAT HAS OCCURRED IN RECENT MONTHS. IT IS A SOURCE OF CONCERN AND SOME FRUSTRATION WITH RESPECT TO PRACTICAL STEPS ONE CAN TAKE. I DON'T THINK THAT WE SHOULD EVER MINIMIZE THE IMPACT OF OUR OWN POSITIONS IN THE WORLD AND THE MORAL WEIGHT THAT WE, TOGETHER WITH INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS AND OTHER GOVERNMENTS, CAN BRING TO BEAR ON SUCH SITUATIONS. I THINK, WHEN IT COMES TO-THE AREA OF HUMAN RIGHTS, ONE HAS TO ASSESS VERY-CAREFULLY THE PROBLEM AT HAND AND DECIDE HOW BEST TO APPROACH IT.

I THINK THERE IS A PLACE FOR PUBLIC STATEMENTS; BUT I ALSO THINK THERE IS A PLACE FOR QUIET DIPLOMACY. I THINK ONE HAS TO LOOK AT THE PROBLEM AND DETERMINE, AS BEST WE CAN, WHICH APPROACH OR WHICH COMBINATION OF APPROACHES CAN BE MOST EFFECTIVE. I WOULD AGREE, I THINK WITH THE PREMISE THAT RIGHT NOW, IN PRACTICAL TERMS, OUR ABILITY TO INFLUENCE EVENTS IS MORE RESTRICTED THAN IT HAS BEEN, SIR.
SENATOR JAVITS: DO WE HAVE ANY TRADE WITH IRAN NOW OF ANY KIND? THEIR ECONOMY IS SAID TO BE IN A SHAMBLES? WHAT ABOUT FOOD? -ARE WE SHIPPING THEM ANY FOOD?

AMBASSADOR CUTLER: WE HAVE BEEN, SENATOR. AS A MATTER OF FACT, FOOD IS A MAJOR PROBLEM IN IRAN FROM THE STANDPOINT OF THEIR NOT BEING SELF-SUFFICIENT IN FOOD. WE HAVE BEEN SHIPPING STAPLES, SUCH AS WHEAT AND RICE. WE STILL DO HAVE TRADE, BUT IT IS DIMINISHED, OBVIOUSLY, BECAUSE A GOOD DEAL OF THAT TRADE WAS MADE UP OF HEAVY MACHINERY AND MILITARY ITEMS. GIVEN THE STATE OF THE ECONOMY, OBVIOUSLY EXPORTS ARE OFF. WE ARE BUYING A PORTION OF IRANIAN OIL AT THIS POINT, AND TRADE IS THEREFORE A TWO-WAY STREET. BUT TRADE IS DIMINISHED.

THIS IS CERTAINLY AN AREA THAT COULD BE EXAMINED IF, IN FACT, A TREND IS ESTABLISHED AND CONTINUED-THERE. LET ME SAY IN THIS RESPECT THAT WHILE WE MAY BE CONCERNED-RIGHT NOW WITH EVENTS, I AM NOT PESSIMISTIC WITH RESPECT TO HOW LONG EXECUTIONS MAY CONTINUE. I THINK WE OBVIOUSLY HAVE TO FOLLOW EVENTS AS CLOSELY AS WE CAN. BUT IRAN IS IN THE IMMEDIATE -POST-REVOLUTIONARY THROES. IT IS A PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT, AS I HAVE SAID. REPORTS THAT I HAVE SEEN, BUT-WHICH I CANNOT CONFIRM, INDICATE THAT PROTECTION OF MINORITIES MAY BE INCORPORATED INTO A NEW CONSTITUTION.
I THINK WE SHOULD LOOK FOR OTHER INDICATORS THAT THIS MAY NOT BE A LONG-TERM TREND.

SENATOR JAVITS: HAS THE UNITED STATES IN ANY FORMAL WAY GIVEN NOTICE TO THE IRANIAN AUTHORITIES, INCLUDING THE AYATOLLAH, THAT IN RESPECT OF THE CONTINUING RELATIONS BETWEEN THE UNITED STATES AND IRAN THIS ISAVERY IMPORTANT FACTOR TO US AND THAT THEY SHOULD BE VERY IMPRUDENT TO PROCEED WITH IMPUNITY ON THE THEORY THAT THEY ARE THROUGH WITH THE UNITED STATES AND THE UNITED STATES IS THROUGH WITH THEM?

AMBASSADOR CUTLER: YES, SENATOR. I THINK THERE IS NO QUESTION THAT IN SEVERAL DIFFERENT WAYS OUR VIEWS, OUR VERYSTRONG VIEWS, ON THIS HUMANITARIAN QUESTION HAVE BEEN VERY CLEARLY CONVEYED TO THE AUTHORITIES, AND THAT WOULD INCLUDE, AT LEAST INDIRECTLY RELIGIOUS AUTHORITIES AS WELL ...SENATOR, LET ME ACKNOWLEDGE YOUR SUGGESTION THAT SOME OF THESE ACTIONS OF THE UNITED STATES GOVERNMENT SHOULD BE EXPLORED TO A GREATER DEPTH. I AM SURE THAT THE DEPARTMENT WOULD BE VERY HAPPY TO COOPERATE FULLY WITH YOU AND WITH OTHER MEMBERS OF THE COMMITTEE, REALIZING YOUR VERY DEEP CONCERN ON THIS ISSUE.

CERTAINLY YOU CAN COUNT ON ME, SENATOR, TO UPHOLD THE PRINCIPLES FOR WHICH WE ALL STAND AND ABOUT WHICH WE ARE CONCERNED. I WOULD ONLY REPEAT WHAT I SAID BEFORE, AND THAT IS THIS: IN ASSESSING A SITUATION WHERE HUMAN WELFAREIS AT STAKE, OUR TACTICS SHOULD BE VERY CAREFULLY ASSESSED IN ORDER TO ACHIEVE POSITIVE RESULTS.

SENATOR BIDEN: WOULD YOU COMMENT ON THE USEFULNESS OF EITHER OF THESE MOVES, WHETHER OR NOT THEY ARE ACTIVELY BEING CONTEMPLATED? I AM REFERRING TO A MOBILE FORCE OF 100,000 FOLKS WE CAN MOVE INTO THE PERSIAN GULF AREA AND AS A MINIMUM, BEEFING UP OUR PRESENCE IN THE INDIAN OCEAN AND AS IT RELATES TO THE MIDDLE EAST, ITS STABILITY, AND YOUR JOB, PARTICULARLY IN IRAN.

AMBASSADOR CUTLER: IT IS RATHER DIFFICULT TO ANSWER THAT IN ANY SPECIFIC TERMS. I THINK OBVIOUSLY THERE IS A PLACE IN OURGLOBAL DIPLOMACY FOR A PRESENCE, A MILITARY PRESENCE. I THINK-SOMETIMES THIS CAN BE QUITE REASSURING TO COUNTRIES THAT FEEL THREATENED. SOMETIMES SUCH A PRESENCE CAN CONTRIBUTE TO STABILITY IN A FAIRLYWIDE AREA. OBVIOUSLY A DECISION TO MOVE IN THAT DIRECTION IS ONE THAT HAS TO BE VERY CAREFULLY CONSIDERED, TAKING ALL OF THE POLLITICAL AND OTHER ELEMENTS INTO CONSIDERATION.

I AM NOT SURE THAT I CAN COMMENT BEYOND THAT, SENATOR, WITH RESPECT TO EITHER OUR PLANS, IF THEY DO EXIST, FOR SUCH A FORCE OR HOW THIS MIGHT IMPACT ON THE PART OF THE WORLD TO WHICH I AM GOING. CERTAINLY I THINK IT WOULD DEPEND IN PART ON THE EXTENT OF THE PRESENCE OF OTHER SUPER POWERS IN THE AREA. I THINK CERTAINLY IT WOULD NOT BEHOOVE US TO CREATE AN IMBALANCE. .
EMPHASIZE FOREGOING ARE EXERPTS FROM TESTIMONY, ALTHOUGH SUBSTANTIALLY ALL OF AMBASSADOR CUTLER'S PRESENTATION IS PROVIDED. ENTIRE TRANSCRIPT WILL BE HAND-CARRIED TO THE EMBASSY. VANCE

DUE TO A SNAFU IN WASHINGTON PA DEPUTY ASSISTANT SECRETARY RESTON'S RESIDENCE WAS CALLED BY REPORTER FOR THE LONDON DAILY TELEGRAPH QUERYING RESTON AS SPOKESMAN FOR THE DEPT ABOUT STATE'S REACTION TO THE IRANIAN REFUSAL TO GIVE AGREMENT TO AMB. WALTER CUTLER. BY CONFUSION, THE DAILY TELEGRAPH REPORTER REACHED RESTON'S FATHER, JAMES RESTON, WHO DELIVERED AN OPINION ABOUT THE IRANIAN LACK OF AGREMENT. THIS IS OBVIOUSLY IN ERROR SINCE DAILY TELEGRAPH REPORTER NEVER TALKED TO DEPUTY SPOKESMAN RESTON. PA DEPUTY ASSISTANT SECRETARY REGRETS THE ERROR ON THE PART OF DAILY TELEGRAPH REPORTER AND HAS TALKED WITH HENRY PRECHT ON THE IRANIAN DESK WHO SAYS THAT HE HOPES WE CAN CLARIFY THE MISUNDERSTANDING TOMORROW. segments.text: FOR TOMSETH FROM PRECHT IN A DISCUSSION OF SHARIATI AND ISLAMIC MOVEMENT DURING AMBASSADOR CUTLER'S CALL ON CHARGE AGAH, LATTER MENTIONED THAT A DR. MOHAMMED DERAKHSHESH, HEAD OF THE TEACHERS' UNION, TOLD LAMBRAKIS HE HAS AN IMPORTANT MESSAGE FROM GENERAL GHARANI BUT COULD NOT FIND WAY OF GETTING IT TO US PRIOR TO LAMBRAKIS' DEPARTURE ON LEAVE APRIL 12. HE WAS EXPECTING LAMBRAKIS TO RETURN SO THAT CONTACT WOULD BE MADE AND THE PAPER OR PAPERS TURNED OVER. IN VIEW OF GHARANI'S SOMEWHAT MYSTERIOUS ASSASSINATION, THAT PAPER MIGHT PROVE INTERESTING.

DERAKHSHESH HIMSELF IS IMPORTANT LEADER OF NON-LEFTIST NON-RELIGIOUS STAMP WITH WHOM CONTACT SHOULD NOT BE LOST. PROBLEM IS MAINTAINING IT INCONSPICUOUSLY. AT THAT TIME LAMBRAKIS' MOVEMENTS WERE HAMPERED BY REPUTED THREAT, WHICH HAS SINCE BEEN CLARIFIED AS A FRAUD. SAME APPLIES TO THREAT ON STEMPEL. THEREFORE SUGGEST STEMPEL OR TOMSETH GET IN TOUCH WITH DERAKHSHESH AND GO TO SEE HIM IN HIS ELAHIEH HOME (NEAR JORDAN) DRIVING OWN CAR WITHOUT GUARDS. ALTERNATIVELY A HOTEL MEETING MIGHT BE ARRANGED. HIS TELEPHONE NUMBER IS BY HIS NAME IN ONE OF LAMBRAKIS' TWO METAL TELEPHONE/ADDRESS NOTEBOOKS. (FYI ONLY: DERAKHSHESH IS ALSO FRIEND OF REZA AMINI'S. DUE CARE SHOULD BE EXERCISED.)

ANOTHER GOOD CONTACT CONNECTED WITH GHARANI IS "MOJY" TAHERZADEH. HE WAS GHARANI'S INTERPRETER IN ALL OF LAMBRAKIS' MEETINGS WITH GHARANI BEFORE THE REVOLUTION. HE HAS LONG RESIDENCE IN U.S. AND HEADED NUCLEAR RESEARCH INSTITUTE LAST FEW YEARS BEFORE REVOLUTION. HE TOOK OVER GENERAL TOUFANIAN'S OLD OFFICE WHEN REVOLUTION TRIUMPHED BUT WE HAVE NOT HEARD IF HE REMAINS THERE. HE CAN BE CONTACTED THROUGH HOME PHONE: 638370. HIS WIFE SPEAKS FLUENT AMERICAN. HE TOO WILL WISH FUTURE CONTACT TO BE DISCREET, BUT MAY HAVE MANY INTERESTING THINGS TO TELL US.
(U - ENTIRE TEXT.)

AS THE DEPARTMENT KNOWS, ZIA NASSERY, AN AFGHAN-BORN AMCIT LIVING IN NEW YORK, HAS BEEN ACTIVE THESE LAST SEVERAL MONTHS IN PAKISTAN SUPPORTING THE ANLF. ON APRIL 11, HE XUWSHT FURTHER ATTENTION TO HIMSELF BY HOLDING A PRESS CONFERENCE IN ISLAMABAD ON BEHALF OF THE FRONT. THIS WAS REPORTED BY ROBERT TRUMBULL IN A NEW YORK TIMES ARTICLE, DATELINED ISLAMABAD, APRIL 12, INCLUDING THE FACT THAT NASSERY IS AN AMERICAN.

AT A TIME WHEN WE HAVE BEEN TAKING THE POLICY LINE THAT WE ARE NOT AIDING OR ABETTING AFGHAN OPPOSITION GROUPS IN PAKISTAN, AND AT A TIME WHEN THE SOVIETS ARE TRYING TO PIN THE LABEL OF COVERT SUPPORTER ON US, I FIND MR. NEASERY'S ACTIVITIES AND PRESENCE IN PAKISTAN AN EMBARRASSMENT. WHEN I TELL AFGHAN OFFICIALS THAT WE ARE NOT MEDDING IN THEIR AFFAIRS, THEY (AND THE SOVIETS) COULD WELL RETORT, "WHAT ABOUT NASSERY".

IF I REMEMBER CORRECTLY, THE AMERICAN CONSTITUTION, AS INTERPRETED BY THE SUPREME COURT, MAKES IT A VIRTUAL RIGHT FOR AN AMCIT TO RECEIVE A POASSPORT. I APPRECIATE, TOO, THAT OUR ABILITY TO CONTROL THE ACTIVITIES OF PRIVATE AMCITS ABROAD IS LIMITED. NEVERTHELESS, I WOULD LIKE TO EMPHASIZE TO THE DEPARTMENT THAT WITH NASSERY BEING AN AMCIT AND SO ACTIVE IN PAKISTAN, IT MAKES IT AWKWARD FOR US IN KABUL TRYING TO CONVINCE PEOPLE HERE THAT THE US GOVERNMENT IS NOT INTERFERING IN AFGHANISTAN. NOBODY HERE WILL BELIEVE US.

REQUEST: I WOULD APPRECIATE THE DEPARTMENT FOCUSING ON THIS PROBLEM AND EXAMINING WHETHER THERE IS ANYTHING WE CAN DO TO INDUCE NASSERY MODIGY HIS ACTIVITIES. I APPRECIATE THIS IS A DELICATE MATTER. BUT TH LONGER HE IS DOING HIS THING IN PAKISTAN AND DRAWING WORLD ATTENTION TO IT, THE MORE AWKWARD IT IS FOR US IN KABUL -- IF IN FACT, WE STILL HAVE A HANDS-OFF POLICY TOWARDS AFGHAN INTERNAL AFFAIRS. AMSTUTZ
EF: TEHRAN 5435 (S - ENTIRE TEXT) YOU SHOULD SEE ENTEZAM URGENTLY TO MAKE FOLLOWING POINTS WE REGRET THE ACTION OF THE PGOI.

WE DO NOT ACCEPT THE PGOI'S CHARACTERIZATION OF AMBASSADOR CUTLER'S CAREER. HE IS A DISTINGUISHED FOREIGN SERVICE OFFICER OF GREAT ABILITY, WELL-QUALIFIED FOR HIS ASSIGNMENT, WHO WAS PERSONALLY SELECTED BY AND ENJOYS THE COMPLETE CONFIDENCE OF THE SECRETARY AND THE PRESIDENT.

AMBASSADOR CUTLER IS FAMILIAR WITH IRAN FROM HIS PREVIOUS EXPERIENCE IN TABRIZ, BUT HE HAD NO ASSOCIATION WITH THE FORMER REGIME. HE IS A MAN OF INDEPENDENT JUDGMENT WHO COULD UNDERSTAND AND ACCURATELY INTERPRET TO WASHINGTON CURRENT DEVELOPMENTS IN IRAN. HE WAS SPECIFICALLY CHOSEN BY THE PRESIDENT FOR HIS UNIQUE QUALIFICATIONS AND SENSITIVITY.

WE REITERATE OUR DESIRE FOR A NORMAL, MUTUALLYBENEFICIAL RELATIONSHIP WITH THE PGOI. T;EIR OBJECTIVE WOULD BE TO ATTEMPT TO HEAD OFF THE DETERIORATION IN US-IRANIAN RELATIONS. THE REPRESENTATIVES WOULD NOT BE COMING UNDER KHOMEINI'S AEGIS BUT HE WOULD BE AWARE OF THEIR TRAVEL. WE UNDERSTOOD THAT EFFORT WOULD BE MADE TO KEEP THE TRIP CONFIDENTIAL. OUR SOURCE SAID THAT THE TWO AYATOLLAHS WERE VERY CONCERNED BY INFLUENCES, INCLUDING PLO, NOW SURROUNDING KHOMEINI.
THEY VALUE A RELATIONSHIP WITH THE U.S., ALTHOUGH THEY HAVE BEEN CRITICAL OF OUR TIES WITH THE SHAH. WOULD APPRECIATE YOUR THOUGHTS AS TO HOW WE RESPOND TO THIS SUGGESTION.

WE DISCUSSED WITH OUR SOURCE THE IDEA OF AN EMISSARY TO TEHRAN AND HE SAID THAT IRANIANS WERE RELUCTANT TO GO IN THAT DIRECTION BECAUSE A VISIT WOULD IMMEDIATELY BECOME AN INTENSE POLITICAL ISSUE. WE WISH, NEVERTHELESS, TO PROCEED WITH INSTRUCTIONS IN SEPTEL AS A FURTHER INDICATION OF OUR CONCERN OVER THE CURRENT STATE OF RELATIONS AND LEAVING TO THE COURSE OF THE CONVERATION AND YOUR DISCRETION WHETHER THE EMISSARY IDEA IS RAISED.

HAERI IS RETURNING TO IRAN FOR THE SUMMER AND ILL BE SEEING KHOMEINI AND OTHER RELIGIOUS AND SECULAR LEADERS. HE HAS A SYMPATHETIC UNDERSTANDING OF THE POSITION OF THE US TOWARDS IRAN. HAERI BELIEVES THAT THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT NEEDS TO STRENGTHEN ITS AUTHORITY AND IS STRONGLY OPPOSED TO THE SUMMARY TRIALS AND EXECUTIONS. HE ALSO BELIEVES THAT KHOMEINI SHOULD DROP THE IDEA OF A NEW CONSTITUTION AND INSTEAD SEEK TO AMEND THE 1906 DOCUMENT.
SAUNDERS DEVELOPED THREE IDEAS WHICH HE ASKED HAERI TO CONVEY TO IRANIAN LEADERS

THE USG AND AMERICAN PEOPLE ARE VERY SYMPATHETIC TO THE DIFFICULT EXPERIENCES OF THE IRANIANS OVER THE PAST YEAR AND SUPPORT THE OBJECTIVES OF THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION FOR IMPROVED WELL BEING AND INSTITUTIONS FOR THE PARTICIPATION OF THE IRANIAN PEOPLE.
WE ARE ABSOLUTELY NOT INVOLVED IN IRAN'S INTERNAL AFFAIRS AND HOPE THAT KHOMEINI AND HIS ASSOCIATES WILL BRING TO US DIRECTLY ANY SUSPICIONS ON THIS SCORE.
WE STRONGLY SUPPORT THE INDEPENDENCE OF IRAN. WE HAVE NO AMBITIONS FOR A "US POSITION; IN IRAN AND WE DO NOT WISH TO SEE IRAN FALL UNDER THE INFLUENCE OF THE SOVIET UNION.
SAUNDERS AGREED WITH HAERI THAT WE WANTED TO SEE A STRONG AND EFFECTIVE GOVERN;ENT UNDER BAZARGAN LEADERSHIP. HAERI SAID HE WOULD CONVEY SAUNDERS' MESSAGES IN HIS MEETINGS IN IRAN.

I CALLED CHARGE AGAH AND TOLD HIM WE WERE MAKING AN EFFORT IN THE DEPARTMENT TO MINIMIZE THE POLITICAL FALLOUT FROM ANNOUNCEMENT OF IRANIAN REQUEST TO WITHDRAW AMBASSADOR CUTLER'S NOMINATION. I ASKED IF HE COULD PASS ON TO TEHRAN OUR INTEREST IN SEEING THAT THERE WAS ALSO RESTRAINT IN THEIR OFFICIAL COMMUNICATIONS TO THE PUBLIC. HE UNDERSTOOD THE IMPORTANCE OF CONTAINING THE ISSUE AND AGREED TO BE IN TOUCH WITH TEHRAN. VANCE
(CONFIDENTIAL -- ENTIRE TEXT) WE WOULD APPRECIATE EMBASSY COMMENTS/REVISION OF FOLLOWING DRAFT PREPARED IN NEA/IRN FROM STATESIDE SOURCES.

IRAN'S CURRENT POLITICAL PROBLEMS COME AT A TIME WHEN SERIOUS DIFFICULTIES COULD BE DEVELOPING IN IRAN'S AGRICULTURAL SECTOR. THE IMPORTANT WHEAT HARVEST IS NOW UNDERWAY AND PLANTING FOR THE FALL RICE-CROP HAS BEGUN. PRELIMINARY REPORTS FROM TRADE SOURCES INDICATE THAT THE OUTLOOK FOR BOTH CROPS MAY NOT BE ENCOURAGING. FURTHERMORE, THE TURMOIL IN KHORRAMSHAHR,IRAN'S LARGEST PORT, COULD BLOCK FOOD IMPORTS WHICH SHOULD BE ARRIVING NOW TO SUPPLEMENT ANY SUBSTANDARDHARVESTS. THIS MEANS THAT IRAN'S FOOD SUPPLY SITUATION MIGHT BECOME TIGHT LATER THIS SUMMER.

IRAN IS PRESENTLY HARVESTING ITS WHEAT CROP, THE COUNTRY'S MOSTIMPORTANT AGRICULTURAL COMMODITY (ABOUT 75 PERCENT OF TOTAL GRAINS). A NORMAL HARVEST IS ON THE ORDER OF MORE THAN FIVE MILLION TONS. THIS HAS TO BE SUPPLEMENTED BY IMPORTS OF 1.2 MILLION TONS. THERE ARE SKETCHY REPORTS THAT THIS YEAR'S SEEDING WAS SERIOUSLY AFFECTED BY POLITICAL UNREST, LABOR SHORTAGES, AND REDUCED SUPPLIES OF FUEL. THE SAME PROBLEMS ARE APPARENTLY HAMPERING THE HARVEST CURRENTLY UNDERWAY.

THE RICE CROP, ALSO AN IMPORTANT STAPLE, MAY SUFFER FROM THE ABOVE PROBLEMS PLUS THE LACK OF ANY INSECTICIDE APPLICATION THIS YEAR. BECAUSE OF THIS, INSECT INFESTATION, AN ENDEMIC PROBLEM, COULD GREATLY REDUCE THE HARVEST. NORMALLY, IRAN REAPS ABOUT 850,000 MT OF RICE WITH ABOUT 500,000 MT IMPORTED SO THE DEPENDENCY ON IMPORTS IS EVEN MORE CRUCIAL.

WE HAVE NO RELIABLE INFORMATION ON CURRENT FOOD STOCKS. IRAN WEATHERED THEPOLITICAL DIFFICULTIES OF THE PREVIOUS EIGHT MONTHS WITH FEW FOOD SHORTAGES THANKS TO AN OLD IRANIAN HABIT OF KEEPING LARGE STOCKS ON HAND. THESE SUPPLIES HAVE BEEN DRAWN DOWN CONSIDERABLY IN RECENT WEEKS.

THE SUPPLY PROBLEM IS EXACERBATED BY THE DIFFICULTIES AT KHORRAMSHAHR THROUGH WHICH ALL-OF IRAN'S FOOD IMPORTS MUST MOVE. ALTHOUGH IRAN HAS ORDERED RICE, WHEAT, AND OTHER COMMODITIES, IT IS QUESTIONABLE THAT THESE ITEMS CAN BE DELIVERED, OFFLOADED, AND DISTRIBUTED IN A TIMELY FASHION. IMPORTERS REMAIN CHARY OF BOOKING NEW ORDERS UNLESS THERE IS AN IRREVOCABLE LETTER OF CREDIT FOR THE COMMODITY AND PREPAYMENT ON FREIGHT CHARGES. WE UNDERSTAND SHIPPING COSTS TO IRAN HAVE NEARLY DOUBLED SINCE JANUARY.

THE COMBINATION OF THESE FACTORS SUGGESTS THAT FOOD SHORTAGES MAY BE A REAL POSSIBILITY BY LATE SUMMER. IRANIANS MAY HAVE DIFFICULTIES BUYING RICE IN WHAT IS EXPECTED TO BE A TIGHT INTERNATIONAL MARKET. CONTINUOUS POLITICAL UNREST COULD IMPEDE INTERNAL DISTRIBUTION, ASSUMING IMPORTED GRAIN CAN BE DELIVERED TO THE PORTS. URBAN AREAS WILL SUFFER THE MOST SINCE FARMERS AND PEASANTS WILL PROBABLY HOARD A GREATER AMOUNT THAN USUAL TO MEET THEIR NEEDS.
IF SERIOUS SHORTAGES DEVELOP, WE COULD HAVE A REPITITIONOF THE KURDISH INCIDENT AT SANANDAJ WHICH WAS TRIGGERED IN PART BY FEARS OF FOOD SHORTAGES. VANCE
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)

OUR IRANIAN-AMERICAN SOURCE HAS BEEN IN TOUCH WITH HIS IRANIAN FRIENDS AND TOLD THEM OF OUR CONCERN NOT TO CREATE ANY GROUNDS FOR SUSPICION OF PLOTTING AGAINST BARZARGAN GOVERNMENT. SOURCE SUGGESTED THAT HIS FRIENDS DISCUSS TRIP WITH BAZARGAN, WITH WHOM THEY ARE ALREADY IN CONTACT, AND ASK PGOI QUIETLY TO INFORM EMBASSY THAT IT HAS NO OBJECTION TO TRIP. THUS, IF THIS INITIATIVE PROSPERS, YOU MAY HEAR FROM ENTEZAM OR SOMEONE IN THE PGOI.

SOURCE SAID HIS FRIENDS WANTED TO REASSURE US THAT THEY DID NOT WISH TO ASK USG "TO DO ANYTHING" OR TO MAKE ANY SPECIFIC AGREEMENTS WITH THEM. RATHER, THEY AND LIKE-MINDED MODERATES THEY ARE IN TOUCH WITH (TALAGHANI AND SHARIATMADARI AND MATIN-DRAFTARY WERE NAMED) ARE DEEPLY CONCERNED WITH SITUATION IN KHUZISTAN. THEY FEAR THE SUBSTANTIAL INFLUENCE OF THE PLO WHICH THEY SEE REPLICATING IN IRAN THE IDEOLOGICAL AND FUNCTIONAL STRUGGLES THAT EXIST IN THE PALESTINIAN MOVEMENT. THEY BELIEVE THE PLO IS A DOMINANT INFLUENCE WITH KHOMEINI AND NOW PROVIDES HIM WITH PHYSICAL PROTECTION IN QOM. THE FRIENDS SEE IRAQ, WITH USSR BACKING, AS WORKING WITH THE PLO TO DETACH KHUZISTAN.
THIS IS THE "CENTER OF THEIR FEAR", BUT THEY ARE ALSO DEEPLY CONCERNED WITH THE INTERNAL SITUATION GENERALLY AND THE GROWING INTRANSIGENCE OF KHOMEINI.
THE FRIENDS WANT TO"CONSULT" WITH US ABOUT THESE CONCERNS AND TO LEARN HOW WE PERCEIVE THE SITUATION.

FOR EMBASSY'S INFORMATION, IN RECENT WEEKS, THERE HAVE BEEN SIGNIFICANT DEVELOPMENTS IN TWO LAW SUITS IN WHICH THE GOI OR ITS ENTITIES ARE PARTIES.

BEHRING LITIGATION: IN THE CASE OF BEHRING INTERNATIONAL, INC., V. IMPERIAL IRANIAN AIR FORCE ET. AL., WHICH IS PENDING IN THE FEDERAL DISTRICT COURT OF NEW JERSEY, THE COURT RECENTLY RULED THAT, UNDER SECTION 1609 OF THE FOREIGN SOVEREIGN IMMUNITIES ACT (FSIA) AND THE 1955 U.S.IRAN TREATY OF AMITY, ECONOMIC RELATIONS AND CONSULAR RIGHTS, BEHRING MAY, PRIOR TO THE ENTRY OF THE COURT'S JUDGMENT, ATTACH THE PROPERTY OF THE IMPERIAL IRANIAN AIR FORCE AND ITS SUCCESSOR, THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN AIR FORCE (IRIAF).

THE DISPOSITIVE CONSIDERATION IN THE COURT'S DECISION WAS ARTICLE XI, PARAGRAPH 4 OF THE TREATY, THE RELEVANT PORTION OF WHICH PROVIDES THAT: "NO ENTERPRISE OF EITHER HIGH CONTRACTING PARTY, INCLUDING CORPORATIONS, ASSOCIATIONS, AND GOVERNMENT AGENCIES AND INSTRUMENTALITIES, WHICH IS PUBLICLY OWNED OR CONTROLLED SHALL, IF IT ENGAGES IN COMMERICAL, INDUSTRIAL, SHIPPING OR OTHER BUSINESS ACTIVITIES WITHIN THE TERRITORIES OF THE OTHER HIGH CONTRACTING PARTY, CLAIM OR ENJOY, EITHER FOR ITSELF OR ITS PROPERTY, IMMUNITY THEREIN FROM TAXATION, SUIT, EXECUTION OF JUDGMENT OR OTHER LIABILITY TO WHICH PRIVATELY OWNED AND CONTROLLED ENTERPRISES ARE SUBJECT THEREIN."

THE COURT CONSTRUED THIS PROVISION AS REFLECTING AN INTENT ON THE PART OF THE U.S. AND IRAN TO PUT THEMSELVES AND THEIR GOVERNMENTAL ENTITIES IN THE SAME POSITION AS ANY OTHER PRIVATE PARTY SUBJECT TO SUIT IN THE OTHER COUNTRY'S COURTS, IN CASES INVOLVING COMMERCIAL ACTIVITIES SUCH AS PURCHASING AND SHIPPING. HENCE, THE COURT CONCLUDED THAT PRE-JUDGMENT ATTACHMENTS OF THE IRIAF'S PROPERTY WAS PERMISSIBLE UNDER THE TREATY AND THE FSIA. THE U.S. ATTORNEY WHO IS REPRESENTING THE IRANIAN AIR FORCE, RICHARD P. BROWN, JR.

OF MORGAN, LEWIS AND BOCKIUS, HAS INFORMED THE DEPARTMENT THAT A PETITION FOR LEAVE TO FILE AN APPEAL HAS BEEN FILED WITH THE THIRD CIRCUIT COURT OF APPEALS. HE HAS ASKED THE DEPARTMENT TO MAKE ITS VIEWS KNOWN TO THE THIRD CIRCUIT CONCERNING THE DISTRICT COURT'S INTERPRETATION OF THE TREATY. THE COURT'S DECISION DOES HAVE A SOVEREIGN IMMUNITY ISSUE WHICH THE DEPARTMENT'S LAWYERS ARE STUDYING BEFORE RESPONDING TO BROWN'S REQUEST. IT IS CONCEIVABLE, THOUGH NOT LIKELY, THAT THE COURT OF APPEALS MAY ON ITS OWN MOTION REQUEST THE DEPARTMENT'S VIEWS ON THE TREATY INTERPRETATION.

EDS LITIGATION: ON MARCH 12, IN THE CASE OF ELECTRONIC DATA SYSTEMS V. THE SOCIAL SECURITY ORGANIZATION OF THE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN, ET. AL., THE FEDERAL DISTRICT COURT FOR THE NORTHERN DISTRICT OF TEXAS ISSUED A PRELIMINARY INJUNCTION RESTRAINING THE SOCIAL SECURITY ORGANIZATION AND THE MINISTRY OF HEALTH AND WELFARE FROM REMOVING FROM THE UNITED STATES OR CAUSING OR PERMITTING REMOVAL THEREFROM OF ANY OF THEIR PROPERTY OR ASSETS, UNLESS A $20 MILLION BOND IS POSTED BY THESE TWO GOI ENTITIES. THE COURT NOTED THAT EVIDENCE HAS BEEN PRESENTED THAT SSO AND THE MINISTRY HAVE ENGAGED IN COMMERCIAL ACTIVITY IN THE U.S.

AND THEREFORE WOULD NOT APPEAR ENTITLED TO IMMUNITY UNDER THE FSIA, WERE THEY TO APPEAR AND PLEAD SUCH IMMUNITY. THE DEPARTMENT DOES NOT KNOW WHETHER THIS DECISION WILL BE APPEALED, BUT HA- RECEIVED INFORMATION, WHICH WE ARE ATTEMPTING TO CONFIRM, THAT BOTH PARTIES HAVE AGREED TO TAKE THE MATTER TO ARBITRATION.

THE ACTING SECRETARY HAS APPROVED THE FOLLOWING POINTS FOR YOUR GENERAL GUIDANCE IN DIRECTING THE WORK OF THE EMBASSY DURING THE COMING WEEKS.

WE ARE UNDER NO ILLUSIONS ABOUT THE DIFFICULTY OF DEVELOPING A BETTER RELATIONSHIP WITH THE GOI. UNTIL THE PGOI HAS A BETTER GRIP ON THE POLITICAL AND ECONOMIC SYSTEMS, THERE IS LITTLE PROSPECT THAT WE CAN DEAL EFFECTIVELY WITH THE LEADERSHIP ON T;E MANY PROBLEMS ON OUR AGENDA.

IN THESE CIRCUMSTANCES, IT WOULD NOT BE PRODUCTIVE TO TRY TO PUSH THE IRANIANS FASTER THAN T;EY WISH TO MOVE WITH US. OUR ATTITUDE OUGHT TO BE CORRECT AND READY TO RESPOND, INTERESTED AND FRIENDLY, BUT ALSO FIRM IN DEFENDING U.S. POSITIONS, E.G., ON HUMAN RIGHTS OR AMBASSADORIAL APPOINTMENT. IRANIANS MUST CLEARLY UNDERSTAND THAT A BETTER RELATIONSHIP CAN COME ONLY THROUGH RECIPROCAL PROCESS IN WHICH BOTH SIDES DEMONSTRATE AN INTEREST IN COOPERATION AND IN WHICH THERE IS RESPECT ON BOTH SIDES.

WHILE TAKING NO ACTION TO ENDANGER U.S. PERSONNEL, WE SHOULD NOT FEEL INHIBITED ABOUT SEEKING CONTACTS OR MAKING OUR VIEWS KNOWN. WE SHOULD TAKE CARE NOT TO BE RESPONSIBLE FOR PROBLEMS THAT INTRODUCE NEW AGGRAVATIONS AND, WHERE POSSIBLE, WE SHOULD ATTEMPT TO RESOLVE DIFFICULT ISSUES BETWEEN OUR TWO COUNTRIES. TO THE EXTENT PRACTICAL, WE SHOULD ENCOURAGE STRENGTHENED COMMERCIAL AND OTHER PRIVATE CONTACTS.

ALTHOUGH YOUR ASSIGNMENT IN IRAN WILL BE QUITE LIMITED IN DURATION, YOU SHOULD VIEW IT AS A STAGE TOWARD OUR GOAL OF ACHIEVING A BETTER RELATIONSHIP. YOU SHOULD DIRECT THE EMBASSY'S WORK TO THAT END, TAKING ACTIONS OR MAKING RECOMMENDATIONS TO WASHINGTON THAT WILL ADVANCE THE CAUSE OF IMPROVED RELATIONS.
WITH RESPECT TO SPECIFIC MEASURES YOU SHOULD ADDRESS DURING YOUR STAY IN IRAN, WE HAVE THE FOLLOWING SUGGESTIONS

EMBASSY SECURITY. THE PRESENT ARRANGEMENT FOR PROTECTION OF THE EMBASSY IS CLEARLY INTOLERABLE ON A PROLONGED BASIS. AFTER CONSULTING WITH YOUR COLLEAGUES AND SURVEYING THE LOCAL SCENE, WE BELIEVE YOU SHOULD TAKE STEPS TO REGULARIZE THE PROTECTION FOR THE EMBASSY BY REPLACING THE PRESENT MUJAHEDIN GUARDS WITH A UNIFORMED FORCE.

DIFFICULT PROBLEMS. WE SUGGEST YOU GIVE SOME THOUGHT TO A COMPREHENSIVE ATTEMPT TO REMOVE THE THORNY ISSUES THAT WE HAVE BEEN UNABLE TO RESOLVE, E.G., DETENTION OF ICA EMPLOYEE, CLOSING OUT OF MILITARY FACILITIES, OBTAINING PAYMENT FOR TEHRAN-AMERICAN SCHOOL, SECURING EXIT VISAS FOR CERTAIN U.S. CITIZENS PREVENTED FROM LEAVING IRAN.

MILITARY SUPPLY. AFTER A SHORT TIME, WE WOULD WELCOME YOUR ASSESSMENT AS TO WHETHER WE SHOULD INITIATE A LIMITED SUPPLY OF SPARE PARTS FOR THE IRANIAN AIR FORCE AND POSSIBLY OTHER SERVICES. WE WILL WELCOME YOUR ASSESSMENT OF THE STATUS OF THE ARMED FORCES AND WHETHER IT IS PRACTICAL TO ENCOURAGE THE DEVELOPMENT OF CLOSER MILITARY TIES.

CONSULAR OPERATIONS. WE WILL WANT YOUR RECOMMENDATIONS FOR MOVING FORWARD WITH VISA OPERATIONS. IN OUR JUDGMENT, TO THE EXTENT ADEQUATE SECURITY CAN BE PROVIDED, W- SHOULD ATTEMPT TO RESUME NORMAL NIV OPERATIONS IN TEHRAN. SIMILARLY, YOU MAY WISH TO CONSIDER REGULAR PERIODICAL VISITS BY CONSULAR OFFICERS TO OUR THREE CONSULAR POSTS.
PERSONNEL. WE WILL WANT YOUR RECOMMENDATIONS ON THE ASSIGNMENT OF DEPENDENTS AND ANY PERSONNEL CHANGES YOU THINK PRUDENT FOR THE EMBASSY.
MINORITIES. PLEASE CONTINUE TO REPORT FREQUENTLY ON THE SITUATION OF JEWS AND OTHER MINORITIES.
PUBLIC AFFAIRS. PLEASE GIVE US YOUR RECOMMENDATIONS FOR AN IMPROVED PUBLIC AFFAIRS PROGRAM, INCLUDING EXPANDED USE OF FARSI VOA BROADCASTS, WHICH MIGHT HELP TO STRENGTHEN THE U.S. POSITION.

DEPOFFS MET AS SCHEDULED ON JUNE 18 WITH CONGRESSMAN BARNES AND HIS GROUP AND ON JUNE 19 WITH CONGRESSMEN HOLLENBECK AND GILMAN. IN BOTH MEETINGS WE PRESENTED FRANK BRIEFING ON STATUS OF JEWS IN IRAN, DRAWING ON EMBASSY REPORTING. IT WAS AGREED BOTH MEETINGS WOULD BE CONSIDERED PRIVATE AND OFF-THE-RECORD. ALTHOUGH THE POSSIBILITY OF A HOUSE RESOLUTION ON THE CONDITION OF IRANIAN JEWS WAS DISCUSSED, IT WAS OUR IMPRESSION THAT THERE WAS NO MOVEMENT AT THIS TIME TO PUSH FORWARD SUCH A RESOLUTION. CONGRESSMEN UNDERSTOOD THE NEGATIVE EFFECT SUCH A RESOLUTION COULD HAVE ON THE CONDITION OF IRANIAN JEWS.

THERE WAS MUCH DISCUSSION OF QUESTIONS RELATING TO VISAS FOR JEWS AND OTHER MINORITIES. IF YOU PERCEIVE NO OBJECTION, WE SUGGEST YOU CALL ON NEW JUSTICE MINISTER JAVADI TO UNDERSCORE OUR CONTINUING INTEREST IN IMPROVEMENT IN ADMINISTRATION OF JUSTICE IN IRAN. YOU MAY WISH TO ADJUST FOLLOWING SUGGESTED TALKING POINTS IN LIGHT OF CIRCUMSTANCES AT TIME OF YOUR CALL.
WE WELCOME AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI'S DECLARATION OF A GENERAL AMNESTY FOR WE BELIEVE THIS MOVE CAN CONTRIBUTE IN A SIGNIFICANT WAY TO THE PGOI EFFORTS TO ESTABLISH POLITICAL AND ECONOMIC STABILITY.

WE WONDER HOW THE PGOI INTENDS TO IMPLEMENT THE AMNESTY AND WOULD APPRECIATE AN INDICATION OF THE STEPS CONTEMPLATED. WHAT PLANS ARE BEING MADE FOR THE RELEASE OF PERSONS PRESENTLY IN DETENTION FOR NON-CAPITAL CRIMES? HOW WILL THE AMNESTY AFFECT THE LIST OF PERSONS CURRENTLY PREVENTED FROM LEAVING IRAN?

JAMES SHERRY, WHO HAS BEEN PREVENTED FROM LEAVING IRAN FOR SOME WEEKS THOUGH THERE ARE NO CHARGES AGAINT HIM AND WE UNDERSTAND HE IS MERELY WANTED FOR QUESTIONING. DAVE NEWSOM HAS TOLD ME OF YOUR WILLINGNESS TO REMAIN IN TEHRAN UNTIL WE HAVE RESOLVED THE QUESTION OF A NEW AMBASSADOR. I AM AWARE OF THE PERSONAL CONSIDERATIONS THAT MAKE THIS A DIFFICULT DECISION FOR YOU AND I DEEPLY APPRECIATE THIS AND COMMEND YOU FOR THIS PROFESSIONAL RESPONSE TO A VERY REAL NEED. ALL OF US ARE WATCHING EVENTS IN IRAN VERY CLOSELY AND ARE IMPRESSED WITH THE SPLENDID WAY IN WHICH YOU HAVE TAKEN CHARGE OF OUR AFFAIRS IN THAT VERY SENSITIVE SITUATION.

IF CONVENIENT WITH YOU, WE WOULD LIKE FOR YOU TO PLAN ON CONSULTATIONS IN WASHINGTON IN LATE AUGUST OR EARLY SEPTEMBER IN ORDER THAT WE MIGHT HAVE AT FIRST HAND YOUR PERSONAL ASSESSMENT OF THE SITUATION AT THAT TIME. VANCE
(S - ENTIRE TEXT)

AS THE SECRETARY HAS TOLD YOU, ALL OF US DEEPLY APPRECIATE YOUR WILLINGNESS TO REMAIN IN TEHRAN A REASONABLE TIME LONGER IN ORDER THAT WE MAY MAKE AN ORDERLY TRANSITION TO THE APPOINTMENT OF AN AMBASSADOR. WE WILL BE MONITORING THE SITUATION IN TEHRAN CLOSELY DURING THE COMING WEEKS IN PREPARATION FOR ADDRESSING THIS QUESTION. WE WILL BE LOOKING FOR SIGNS THAT THE PGOI SINCERELY WISHES TO IMPROVE ITS RELATIONS WITH US AND THAT WE WILL NOT EXPERIENCE A REPETITION OF THE REJECTION OF WALTER CUTLER. WE WILL HAVE TO HAVE ABSOLUTE CERTAINTY ON THE LATTER POINT.

IN ADDITION, WE WILL WANT TO BE SURE THAT WHEN WE SEND A NEW AMBASSADOR, HE WILL BE ABLE TO FUNCTION EFFECTIVELY. THUS, WE WILL BE CONCERNED THAT CONDITIONS SHOULD NOT DETERIORATE FURTHER IN THE COMING WEEKS AND THAT EMBASSY'S SECURITY SITUATION SHOULD IMPROVE.

THE ATTITUDE OF THE AYATOLLAH TOWARDS US WILL BE AN IMPORTANT CONSIDERATION. IN THIS CONNECTION IT SEEMS THAT HIS RHETORIC HAS BEEN RELATIVELY FREE IN THE LAST FEW WEEKS OF THE ATTACKS ON THE U.S. THAT CHARACTERIZED HIS REMARKS IN THE SPRING. FINALLY, IT WILL SIMPLY BE NECESSARY TO ALLOW A SUFFICIENT PASSAGE OF TIME BEFORE WE ARE IN A POSITION TO PUT FORWARD THE NOMINATION OF A NEW AMBASSADOR TO THE SENATE.

ASSUMING THAT OUR CONDITIONS ARE MET AND NO UNTOWARD PROBLEMS DEVELOP, WE THINK IT MIGHT BE APPROPRIATE TO BEGIN PRIVATE CONSULTATIONS WITH KEY MEMBERS OF THE SENATE AFTER THE AUGUST RECESS. IF OUR SOUNDS ARE FAVORABLE AND AGAIN ASSUMING THAT THERE ARE NO SERIOUS DISRUPTIVE EVENTS IN IRAN THAT WOULD MAKE INAPPROPRIATE THE NOMINATION OF AN AMBASSADOR, WE COULD BE IN A POSITION TO SEND RECOMMENDATIONS TO THE PRESIDENT IN SEPTEMBER WITH A VIEW TO COMPLETING THE NOMINATION PROCESS WITH THE SENATE BY THE END OF OCTOBER.

WE WOULD APPRECIATE YOUR GIVING US YOUR VIEWS ON THIS QUESTION, INCLUDING YOUR ASSESSMENT OF THE UTILITY AND THE IMPORTANCE FOR OUR RELATIONSHIP WITH IRAN OF ASSIGNING AN AMBASSADOR IN THE TIMEFRAME SUGGESTED. VANCE

1979STATE190999.subject: PRECAUTIONARY EVACUATION OF DEPENDENTS AND NON-ESSENTIAL PERSONNEL FROM KABUL

segments.text: NON-ESSENTIAL PERSONNEL FROM KABUL (C - ENTIRE TEXT)

ADDRESSEES MAY WISH TO BRIEF HOST GOVERNMENTS ON JULY 21 USG DECISION TO EVACUATE DEPENDENTS AND NONESSENTIAL PERSONNEL FROM KABUL. WE ARE REPEATING FYI CONTINGENCY PRESS GUIDANCE FROM WHICH POSTS MAY DRAW IN ANSWERING PRESS QUERIES ON AN IF ASKED ONLY BASIS.
IN ADDITIOH, POSTS MAY DRAW FROM FOLLOWING TALKING POINTSISCUSSIONS WITH HOST GOVERNMENTS WE HAVE DECIDED TO WITHDRAW DEPENDENTS AND NON-ESSENTIAL USG PERSONNEL FROM KABUL.

OUR DECISION IS BASED ON A NUMBER OF FACTORS, BUT HAS BEEN TAKEN PRIMARILY BECAUSE OF CONCERN THAT THE ONLY FEASIBLE SURFACE ROUTE OUT OF THE COUNTRY, THE KABULPESHAWAR (PAKISTAN) ROAD IS NO LONGER FULLY SECURE FOLLOWING A RECENT INCREASE IN INCIDENTS ALONG THE ROAD. IN ADDITION, WE HAVE NOTED AN INCREASE IN VIOLENT INCIDENTS IN AND AROUND KABUL ITSELF. WE ARE ALSO CONCERNED ABOUT THE STABILITY OF THE AFGHAN REGIME IN THE PERIOD IMMEDIATELY AHEAD.
WE DO NOT PERCEIVE A DIRECT OR IMMINENT THREAT TO THE SECURITY OF FOREIGN NATIONALS IN KABUL. OUR ACTION IS PRECAUTIONARY.
ABOUT 100 INDIVIDUALS WILL BE INVOLVED, AND THEY WILL DEPART ON REGULARLY SCHEDULED AIRLINES OVER THE NEXT COUPLE OF WEEKS.

WE HAVE INFORMED THE AFGHAN GOVERNMENT AND THE SOVIET UNION OF OUR ACTION, MAKING CLEAR THAT WE DO NOT INTEND THIS ACTION AS A POLITICAL JUDGMENT AND WE ARE ACTING SOLELY OUT OF CONCERN FOR THE SAFETY OF AMERICAN CITIZENS.
WE WILL RETAIN AN ADEQUATE STAFF AT OUR EMBASSY IN KABUL AND WE HOPE THAT THE WITHDRAWAL OF OUR DEPENDENTS WILL BE ONLY TEMPORARY. CHRISTOPHER
(CONFIDENTIAL - ENTIRE TEXT)
WHEN YOU ARE ABLE TO SEE MINISTER OF JUSTICE (REFTEL) YOU MAY WISH TO DRAW ON FOLLOWING INFORMATION WHICH WE HAVE JUST RECEIVED FROM AIU REPS REGARDING SHEBANI CASE.

MR. SHEBANI HAS BEEN RECENTLY TRANSFERRED FROM QASR TO EVIN PRISON. WE UNDERSTAND ALSO THAT HIS FILE IS BEING TRANSFERRED FROM THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS TO THE MINISTRY OF JUSTICE. THERE ARE STILL NO CHARGES FILED AGAINST HIM ALTHOUGH PERSONS WHO HAVE SEEN HIS FILE SAY THAT IT REFERS VAGUELY TO SAVAK AFFILIATION. THOSE PERSONS SAY THAT APPARENTLY THE CHARGES OF ASSOCIATION WITH SAVAK ARE NOT SERIOUS. THE EARLIER RUMORS THAT SHEBANI ATTEMPTED TO LEAVE IRAN WITH SUBSTANTIAL CASH, CHECKS OR WAS IN POSSESSION OF HASHISH HAVE APPARENTLY BEEN DISPROVED.

AIU CHAIRMAN GREENBERG FEELS STRONGLY THAT MORE EFFECTIVE ACTION SHOULD BE TAKEN TO OBTAIN SHEBANI'S RELEASE. AS YOU MAY BE AWARE MR. LEVINE, A LAW PARTNER OF RAMSEY CLARK, WAS RECENTLY IN IRAN TO LOOK INTO THIS CASE. CLARK AND LEVINE ARE CONTINUING THEIR CONTACT WITH YAZDI THROUGH AGAH TO OBTAIN SHEBANI'S RELEASE. WE LEAVE TO YOUR DISCRETION WHETHER YOU MAY WISH ALSO TO RAISE THIS MATTER WITH FONMIN YAZDI. VANCE

1979STATE194675.subject: FOREIGN POLITICAL MATTER-IRAN FOLLOWING REPEAT DIRECTOR FBI R 241452Z JUL 79 ACTION DIRECTOR CIA SECRETARY OF STATE JUL 24.

segments.text: FOLLOWING REPEAT DIRECTOR FBI R 241452Z JUL 79 ACTION DIRECTOR CIA SECRETARY OF STATE JUL 24. UNCLAS FOREIGN POLITICAL MATTER-IRAN. ON JULY 20, 1979, MR. HARREL TILLMAN, 3815 MONTROSE, SUITE 116, HOUSTON, TEXAS, AN ATTORNEY WHO ADVISED HE REPRESENTS THE IRANIAN CONSULATE IN HOUSTON, TEXAS, TELEPHONICALLY CONTACTED THE HOUSTON OFFICE OF THE FBI TO REPORT THE OCCURRENCE IN IRAN OF CERTAIN DEMONSTRATIONS AGAINST A PERCEIVED LACK OF LEGAL ACTION BEING TAKEN AT HOUSTON IN A MATTER INVOLVING THE RECENT SHOOTING DEATHS OF TWO IRANIAN STUDENTS. ACCORDING TO MR.

TILLMAN AND NEWSPAPER ACCOUNTS, THE DECEASED IRANIANS WERE SHOT BY THE MANAGER OF A HOUSTON TOPLESS LOUNGE, THE STONE FOX, WHILE ENGAGED IN AN ALTERCATION WITH THE MANAGER. IT WAS REPORTED BY HOUSTON POLICE, ACCORDING TO PAGE TWO DE RUEHFB 0039 UNCLAS TILLMAN, THAT THE IRANIANS PAID A TOPLESS DANCER TO PERFORM AT THEIR TABLE, BUT WERE DISSATISFIED WITH THE LENGTH OF HER PERFORMANCE AND ARGUED WITH THE DANCER, AND, ALLEGEDLY, THREATENED THEN ATTACKED THE BAR MANAGER. MR. TILLMAN SAID IBRAHIM YAZDI, IRANIAN PRIME MINISTER AND FORMER HOUSTON RESIDENT, TELEPHONICALLY CONTACTED THE HOUSTON IRANIAN CONSULATE TO DETERMINE THE CIRCUMSTANCES SURROUNDING THE DEATHS.

NEWS ARTICLES IN IRAN REPORTEDLY INDICATED THE STUDENTS' DEATHS WERE NOT BEING PROPERLY INVESTIGATED AND THAT THE CLUB MANAGER HAD BEEN RELEASED WITH NO ACTION BEING TAKEN AGAINST HIM. ACCORDING TO TILLMAN, HIS (TILLMAN'S) CHECKS WITH THE HOUSTON POLICE DEPARTMENT, AND HIS REVIEW OF THE FILE, INDICATE THE MATTER IS BEING REFERRED TO THE LOCAL GRAND JURY. THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT HAS REPORTEDLY SENT A LETTER TO POLICE CHIEF HARRY CALDWELL REQUESTING INFORMATION ABOUT THE INCIDENT. MR. TILLMAN RECOGNIZES THIS INCIDENT IS NOT A MATTER OF INVESTIGATIVE INTEREST TO THE FBI; HOWEVER, HE HAS REPORTED THE INCIDENT TO ALERT U. S.
GOVERNMENT AUTHORITIES TO THE SOURCE OF SOME CURRENT UNREST IN IRAN.

EMBASSY'S PROPOSED POLITICAL REPORTING SCHEDULE FOR THE COMING YEAR COVERS ALMOST ALL SUBJECTS THAT SHOULD BE EXAMINED BEYOND DAY-TO-DAY, SPOT REPORTING. TWO OTHERS OCCUR TO US: --NEW CONSTITUTION AND RELATED ISSUES: OVER THE COMING WEEKS, THIS SHOULD BE THE FOCUS OF WHATEVER MAY DEVELOP ON THE MORE STRUCTURED SIDE OF IRANIAN AFFAIRS. IT IS IMPORTANT THAT WE KEEP UP WITH FACTS, INVOLVEMENT OF KEY PERSONALITIES AND SCHEDULES ON A CURRENT BASIS, AS WELL AS SIGNIFICANT TRENDS ON LONGER TERM BASIS. --THL LEFT: BASIC NEEDS HERE ARE THE COMPOSITION OF LEFT, ITS GOALS, POTENTIALITIES, FOREIGN CONNECTIONS, AND STRENGTH.
IT IS POSSIBLE THAT THE EMBASSY PLANS TO COVER THIS SUBJECT UNDER ITS PROPOSAL ABOUT POLITICAL PARTIES AND MOVEMENTS. WE BELIEVE IT IS IMPORTANT ENOUGH TO DESERVE SEPARATE REPORTING.

WE FULLY UNDERSTAND THE EXCEPTIONALLY DIFFICULT CIRCUMSTANCES INVOLVED IN POLITICAL REPORTING FROM IRAN AND APPRECIATE THE EMBASSY'S EFFORTS TO BE AS SPECIFIC AND FACTUAL IN MAJOR REPORTS AS POSSIBLE. VANCE
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)

IRANIAN CHARGE AGAH CALLED DEPOFF JULY 30 TO INQUIRE URGENTLY WHETHER THE SHAH WAS COMING TO THE US. AGAH SAID HE HAD SUCH A REPORT FROM A VERY RELIABLE SOURCE AND DR. YAZDI HAD ASKED HIM TO GET IN TOUCH WITH THE DEPARTMENT TO EXPRESS THE PGOI'S CONCERN. DEPOFF DESCRIBED US POSITION AND SAID THAT AGAH WAS SURELY AWARE OF INTENSE PRESSURES ON THE EXECUTIVE BRANCH FROM CONGRESS AND OTHER QUARTERS FOR A CHANGE IN THE USG POSITION. DEPOFF SAID HE COULD ASSURE AGAH THAT THERE HAD BEEN NO CHANGE IN THE US POSITION AND HE KNEW OF NO PLANS FOR THE SHAH TO COME TO THE US.
DEPOFF ADDED THAT HE ASSUMED THAT AGAH WAS AWARE THAT THE THREE PAHLAVI CHILDREN WERE IN THE US; AGAH SAID HE KNEW THAT. VANCE
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)

THE REGULATIONS PERMIT YOU TO DESIGNATE ANY OFFICER REGARDLESS OF RANK AS ACTING DCM IN CHARGE OF THE EMBASSY IN YOUR ABSENCE. segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT)

WHEN YOU SEE PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN AUGUST 11, WE BELIEVE IT WOULD BE WORTH REVIEWING WITH HIM AS YOU HAVE WITH OTHER SENIOR PGOI OFFICIALS STEPS WE HAVE TAKEN TO IMPROVE AND NORMALIZE RELATIONS WITH IRAN. WITHOUT OVERBURDENING HIM ON THIS INITIAL CALL AND RECOGNIZING SPECIAL DIFFICULTIES THAT PGOI CONFRONTS, YOU MIGHT, AT YOUR DISCRETION, SUGGEST TO BAZARGAN THAT WE WOULD LIKE TO SEE SOME PROGRESS ON IRANIAN SIDE IN CLEARING UP DAMAGING PROBLEMS SUCH TAS CHECK, SHERRY AND SHEBANI CASES AND REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS ON EMBASSY COMPOUND. WE WOULD BE DEEPLY GRATEFUL FOR HIS PERSONAL ASSISTANCE IN HELPING TO DISPOSE OF THESE TROUBLESOME BILATERAL PROBLEMS.
IF THE COURSE OF YOUR CONVERSATION DOES NOT MAKE IT OPPORTUNE TO RAISE THESE ISSUES, PLEASE DEFER DISCUSSIONS FOR ANOTHER OCCASION.

YOU MIGHT TELL BAZARGAN OF YOUR PLANS FOR CONSULTATIONS AT THE END OF THIS MONTH AND SUGGEST THAT HE REFLECT ON ANY MESSAGE THAT HE WOULD LIKE YOU TO CONVEY ON YOUR RETURN TO WASHINGTON. YOU MIGHT SUGGEST THAT HE TAKE SOME TIME TO THINK THIS OVER AND GIVE YOU A FURTHER REPLY IF HE DESIRES PRIOR TO YOUR DEPARTURE. WE WOULD BE PARTICULARLY INTERESTED IN ANY PRACTICAL MEASURES HE THINKS THE U.S. MIGHT TAKE TO ASSIST THE PGOI IN ITS EFFORTS TO ENHANCE STABILITY AND PROVIDE FOR BETTER LIVES FOR IRANIAN CITIZENS. THERE ARE OBVIOUS LIMITS TO WHAT THE U.S.
CAN DO, BUT WHERE APPROPRIATE WE WANT TO BE AS HELPFUL AS WE CAN TO PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN AND HIS GOVERNMENT. COOPER
PLEASE CALL ME AT HOME (202) 229-1812. VANCE
(C) ENTIRE TEXT.

segments.text: CANADIAN DEFENSE MINISTER ALLAN MCKINNON TELEPHONED UNDER SECRETARY BENSON'S OFFICE AUGUST 15 TO OBTAIN INFORMATION ABOUT POSSIBLE U.S. RESALE TO CANADA OF F-14 AIRCRAFT "BOUGHT BACK" FROM IRAN. MCKINNON SOUGHT RESPONSES TO FOUR SPECIFIC QUESTIONS WHAT WAS THE EXTENT OF U.S. INTEREST IN RESELLING THE F-14S TO CANADA?
WHAT THE PRICE AND AVAILABILITY SCHEDULES WOULD BE WHAT INDUSTRIAL BENEFITS OR OFFSETS MIGHT ACCOMPANY SUCH RESALE
WHAT PROBLEMS, IF ANY, MIGHT ARISE WITHIN THE CONTEXT OF NATO FORCE STRUCTURE WERE CANADA TO ACQUIRE THE F-14S?

DEPARTMENT OFFICER RESPONDED THAT DISCUSSIONS WITH THE IRANIAN AUTHORITIES WERE STILL IN VERY PRELIMINARY STAGES, THUS IT WAS NOT YET POSSIBLE TO PROVIDE DEFINITIVE RESPONSES TO THE MINISTER'S QUERIES. MCKINNON WAS ASSURED THAT WE HAVE TAKEN CAREFUL NOTE OF HIS INDICATION OF INTEREST AND HIS REMINDER THAT HE REQUIRED INFORMATION PROMPTLY SO THAT THE GOC MIGHT MAKE A DETERMINATION ON FIGHTER AIRCRAFT ACQUISITION BY THE END OF CALENDAR 1979.
MCKINNON EXPRESSED APPRECIATION FOR THIS AND FUTURE CONSIDERATION, AND AGREED THAT WE WOULD CONVEY SUBSEQUENT INFORMATION TO HIM VIA EMBASSY OTTAWA. CHRISTOPHER
(S) ENTIRE TEXT.

REZA CAME TO THE U.S. LAST WEEKEND FOR A BRIEF STAY IN ORDER TO TAKE THE REQUIRED TOEFL ENGLISH LANGUAGE PROFICIENCY EXAMINATION. REZA DID NOT INQUIRE OR MAKE AN APPLICATION FOR A VISA FOR HIS PARENTS. (FYI: WHILE WE SUGGEST YOU NOT INFORM THE PGOI OF THIS FACT, YOU SHOULD KNOW THAT THE SHAH ACQUIRED A VISA BEFORE HE LEFT IRAN AND IT IS STILL VALID. END FYI.)

DEPTOFF CALLED IRANIAN CHARGE AGAH AUGUST 29 TO RAISE ISSUES WHICH APPEARED LIKELY TO CAUSE CONCERN ON HUMAN RIGHTS GROUNDS AMONG IRAN'S FRIENDS IN THIS COUNTRY.

FIRST CONCERNED RECENT MOVES BY UNIDENTIFIED ARMED GROUPS TO SEIZE RECORDS OR PROPERTY OF CHRISTIAN CHURCHES IN ISFAHAN AND TEHRAN AND ALSO CERTAIN CHURCH-OPERATED HOSPITALS. 1979STATE239089.subject: JUSTICE INVESTIGATION OF ALLEGED PAYOFFS BY GOI

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT.)

ON SEPTEMBER 11 DEPTOFF (PRECHT) TELEPHONED IRANIAN CHARGE TO INFORM HIM THAT MFA IN TEHRAN HAD STATED IT HAD NO DOCUMENTS OR EVIDENCE IT COULD SUPPLY TO DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE FOR INVESTIGATION OF ALLEGED ILLEGAL PAYMENTS TO US OFFICIALS. MINISTRY HAD REFERRED US TO LOCAL EMBASSY AS POSSIBLE SOURCE OF INFORMATION. DEPTOFF SAID IT WAS PROBABLE INVESTIGATION WOULD BE TERMINATED OR SUSPENDED IF INFORMATION WERE NOT PRODUCED BY IRANIANS.

CHARGE SAID HE HAD FOUND NOTHING IN EMBASSY FILES WHICH WOULD BE USEFUL TO JUSTICE. HE HAD NOT, HOWEVER, GONE THROUGH ALL MATERIAL IN EMBASSY FILES AND MANY DOCUMENTS HAD BEEN REMOVED (PRESUMABLY BY AMBASSADOR ZAHEDI). DEPTOFF ASKED IF SHAHRYAR ROUHANI WAS IN WASHINGTON. CHARGE SAID ROUHANI HAD RETURNED TO THE US, BUT WAS NOT IN TOUCH WITH THE EMBASSY. HE MIGHT BE COMPLETING HIS STUDIES AT YALE.

DEPTOFF THEN RELAYED FOREGOING INFORMATION TO JUSTICE (RICHTER), ADDING THAT IT SEEMED UNLIKELY THAT FURTHER GENERAL APPROACHES TO THE PGOI ON THIS SUBJECT WOULD BE USEFUL. IF JUSTICE HAD SPECIFIC QUESTIONS ABOUT INDIVIDUALS OR TRANSACTIONS, WE WOULD BE PLEASED TO ATTEMPT TO SEEK ANSWERS. RICHTER SAID HE MIGHT AGAIN BE IN TOUCH WITH US
(S - ENTIRE TEXT)

FOR SOME TIME WE HAVE HAD AN EXTENSIVE EXCHANGE OF INFORMATION AND ASSESSMENTS OF THE AFGHAN SITUATION AND SOVIET INVOLVEMENT THERE WITH THE PAKISTANIS. WE THINK IT WOULD BE USEFUL TO HAVE A SIMILAR DIALOGUE WITH THE IRANIANS WITH SPECIAL ATTENTION TO THE SOVIET ROLE IN AFGHANISTAN. THIS DIALOGUE SHOULD FLOW NATURALLY FROM PREVIOUS DISCUSSIONS EMBASSY HAS HAD WITH PGOI.

TWO RECENT KABUL WRAPUPS (KABUL 6672 ON SOVIET INFLUENCE AND INVOLVEMENT IN AFGHANISTAN AND KABUL 6697 ON THE STATE OF THE INSURGENCY) PROVIDE MATERIAL FROM WHICH YOU MAY DRAW IN DISCUSSING THE SITUATION IN AFGHANISTAN WITH PGOI. IN ADDITION YOU SHOULD MAKE THE FOLLOWING POINTS
WE ARE DEEPLY TROUBLED BY THE SUFFERING OF THE AFGHAN PEOPLE AND THE LOSS OF LIFE AS THE FIGHTING IN AFGHANISTAN CONTINUES.

WE ARE VERY CONCERNED ABOUT INCREASING SOVIET INVOLVEMENT IN AFGHANISTAN. THE NUMBER OF SOVIET MILITARY ADVISERS HAS RECENTLY GROWN AND DELIVERIES OF EQUIPMENT AND SUPPLIES HAVE BEEN STEPPED UP. YOU MAY DRAW FROM FIGURES IN KABUL 6697 BUT SHOULD STRESS THEY ARE ROUGH ESTIMATES.
WE WOULD REGARD USE OF SOVIET COMBAT TROOPS IN AFGHANISTAN AS A VERY SERIOUS MATTER WHICH COULD HAVE ADVERSE REPERCUSSIONS THROUGHOUT THE REGION AND FOR EAST-WEST RELATIONS.
PLEASE KEEP US ADVISED OF PGOI VIEWS ON THESE
(C - ENTIRE TEXT.)

AS AGREED, I CALLED ON AGAH TO GIVE HIM A RUNDOWN ON YOUR BACKGROUND DISCUSSIONS WITH CONGRESS AND THE PRESS. IN GENERAL, I SAID YOU HAD PRESENTED A PICTURE OF IRANIAN SITUATION THAT WAS SHADED RATHER THAN ALL BLACK AS FREQUENTLY DEPICTED BY THE PRESS. MEMBERS OF CONGRESS HAD LISTENED VERY CAREFULLY AND SEEMED SYMPATHETIC TO BALANCED APPROACH ADMINISTRATION WAS TAKING IN SEEKING TO BUILD A NEW RELATIONSHIP WITH IRAN. MEMBERS WERE INTERESTED IN MEETING WITH REPRESENTATIVES OF NEW IRANIAN LEADERSHIP TO OBTAIN FIRSTHAND IMPRESSIONS. AS A FIRST STEP IN THAT DIRECTION, BELIEVE WE HAVE ARRANGED A LUNCH WITH MIKE VAN DUSEN AND AGAH AND FARHANG.

FARHANG IS HERE IN A TYPICALLY NEBULOUS CULTURAL AFFAIRS/STUDENT ADVISOR POSITION AND, IT SEEMS, WILL ALSO HAVE SOME SPOKESMAN RESPONSIBILITIES. CONSTABLE AND I ARE TO LUNCH WITH THE TWO IRANIANS NEXT WEEK.

AGAH SAID YAZDI DEFINITELY PLANS TO ATTEND UNGA BUT DATES HAVE NOT BEEN SET. I TOLD HIM SECRETARY WOULD WANT TO MEET WITH HIM IF CONVENIENT. (TENTATIVE APPOINTMENT HAS BEEN SET FOR OCTOBER 3, WE UNDERSTAND.) AGAH ASKED IF ANYONE ELSE WOULD WANT TO SEE YAZDI. I SAID THAT WOULD DEPEND ON YAZDI'S INTERESTS. IF, FOR EXAMPLE, YAZDI WANTED A BRIEFING ON FMS TRUST FUND OR MILITARY MATTERS, SOMEONE COULD GO TO NEW YORK FOR THAT PURPOSE. I REMINDED AGAH AGAIN THAT INITIATIVE ON SPARE PARTS RESTED WITH IRANIANS; WE HAD BEEN TOLD OF NAVY FREIGHT FORWARDER, BUT HAD NO WORD ON AIR FORCE OR ARMY.
PLEASE LET US KNOW OF ANY ISSUES YAZDI MIGHT RAISE IN NEW YORK.
INFORMED AGAH ABOUT AYATOLLAH SHIRAZI'S HOSPITALIZATION IN CHICAGO AND OFFERED TO ASSIST WITH CUSTOMS, ETC. IF HELP NEEDED. HE SEEMED VAGUELY AWARE OF SHIRAZI TRIP.

AGAH ASKED ABOUT NEWSWEEK STORY ON AMBASSADORIAL APPOINTMENT. I EXPLAINED PROBABLE ORIGINS OF RUMOR AND TOLD HIM IT SEEMED NUMBER OF PEOPLE THOUGHT AN AMBASSADOR SHOULD BE NAMED. NO DECISION HAD BEEN TAKEN. AGAH SAID HE WAS FAVORABLY IMPRESSED BY YOU.

IN ADDITION TO FARHANG, EMBASSY HAS SEVERAL NEW STAFF MEMBERS, INCLUDING A NEW -- MUCH NEEDED -- ECONOMIC OFFICER. AGAH SAID TEHRAN HAD ASKED HIM FOR INVENTORY OF HIS PERSONNEL NEEDS AND HE WAS WORKING ON A REPLY. VANCE
6962; (D) KABUL 6965; (E) WARSAW 9171 (ALL NOTAL) (C-ENTIRE TEXT)

WE INFORMED EMBASSY THERE WOULD BE NO OBJECTION. WE ASKED THAT EMBASSY GIVE US A DIPLOMATIC NOTE CONFIRMING
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)
FOR PURPOSES OF ANALYSIS HERE, WE WOULD APPRECIATE FURTHER EMBASSY VIEWS AND INFORMATION ON PERCEIVED GROWING INFLUENCE OF CLERGY.

IF POSITION OF CLERGY IS BECOMING STRONGER, WHAT SPECIFIC POLICY EFFECTS MAY WE EXPECT? THAT IS, WHAT DIFFERENCES IN PGOI POLICIES (WHETHER ENUNCIATED OR DE FACTO) DO YOU EXPECT IN FOREIGN AFFAIRS, ECONOMIC/ COMMERCIAL DECISIONS, OR MILITARY PROGRAMS?

WHICH RECENT PGOI DECISIONS DOES THE EMBASSY ATTRIBUTE TO PRESENTLY ENLARGED INFLUENCE OF THE CLERGY? IS THERE EVIDENCE THAT NEW CLERICAL INFLUENCE IS BEING EXPRESSED THROUGH NEW FORMS OR INSTITUTIONS RATHER THAN THROUGH REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL AND KOMITEHS -- AS HAS BEEN THE CASE SINCE FEBRUARY? FOR EXAMPLE, THE EMBASSY APPEARS TO BELIEVE THAT THE HESITATION ON RESALE OF F-14'S CAN BE ATTRIBUTED TO CLERICAL INFLUENCE. IS THERE FIRM EVIDENCE FOR THIS VIEW? IS IT NOT POSSIBLE THAT THERE IS STRONG DIFFERENCE OF OPINION BETWEEN IAF, MFA FACTIONS ITH CLERGY JOINING THE SIDE FOR RETENTION OR POSSIBLY URGING ANY IMPLEMENTING ACTION BE DELAYED?

ARE NOT KOMITEHS--WHERE CLERICAL INFLUENCE HAS BEEN EXPRESSED IN THE PAST--NOW WEAKER IN THE MILITARY THAN LAST SPRING? DOES EMBASSY HAVE EVIDENCE THAT CLERGY IS BEHIND RECENT DECISIONS TO RESTART MAJOR FOREIGN CONTRACTS AND MAKE LARGE PAYMENTS TO US FIRMS?

THE EMBASSY'S FINE CABLES ON EDUCATION PROBLEMS SUGGEST THAT CLERICAL INFLUENCE MIGHT BE SHORT OF DECISIVE IN THAT SECTOR. YOUR DESCRIPTION SUGGESTS THAT THE CLERICS MAY BE COMBATTED BOTH ON THE PGOI LEVEL AND AT THE LEVEL OF IMPLEMENTATION WHERE MANY IRANIANS WILL SIMPLY DO AS THEY PLEASE. HOW STRONG IS THE TENDENCY TO GIVE LIP SERVICE TO CLERICAL DIRECTIONS, BUT PRAGMATICALLY TO CONTINUE TO FOLLOW PAST PRACTICES, E.G., THE PRACTICE OF PLAYING MUSIC ON RADIO/TV AFTER THE KHOMEINI "BAN"?

WE ARE THOROUGHLY CONFUSED BY THE PRESS DESCRIPTION OF CONSTITUTIONAL REVISIONS. THE NEW ARTICLE FIVE, FOR EXAMPLE, DOES NOT MATCH WITH ARTICLE FIVE IN THE DRAFT CONSTITUTION. IS THE DOCUMENT BEING COMPLETELY REWRITTEN? IT IS ESPECIALLY UNCLEAR HOW THE RELIGIOUS LEADER AND COUNCIL DESCRIBED IN THE NEW ARTICLE FIVE RELATE TO THE DRAFT DOCUMENT'S COUNCIL OF GUARDIANS, THE PRESIDENT AND THE MAJLIS.

WE FULLY APPRECIATE DIFFICULTIES OF GROPING THROUGH MURKY POLITICAL ENVIRONMENT IN TODAY'S IRAN AND COMMEND EMBASSY FOR EXCELLENCE OF ITS POLITICAL REPORTING UNDER ADVERSE CIRCUMSTANCES. IT IS IMPORTANT THAT WE TRY TO DEPICT TRENDS WITH AS MUCH SPECIFIC DETAIL AS POSSIBLE. WE ARE ALSO DEEPLY INTERESTED IN THE INSIGHTS AND JUDGMENTS OF ASTUTE IRANIAN OBSERVERS WHO ARE CLOSE TO THE ACTION; KEEP RINGING THE DOORBELLS. VANCE
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)

ZIA'S DEPARTURE FOR NY AND HAVANA SEPT 1. GOP AMB IN MEXICO IS CONCURRENTLY ACCREDITED TO HAVANAAT
