1979STATE247571.subject: (LOU) PRESENCE OF CUBAN MILITARY IN AFGHANISTAN CANNOT BE CONFIRMED

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT)

WE HAVE NO INFORMATION WHICH WOULD CONFIRM VARIOUS MEDIA AND OTHER REPORTS THAT CUBAN MILITARY PERSONNEL ARE OR SOON WILL BE IN AFGHANISTAN. SUCH A DEVELOPMENT CANNOT BE DISCARDED COMPLETELY, HOWEVER, BUT AT THE MOMENT WE BELIEVE THAT DISCUSSION OF "CUBANS IN AFGHANISTAN" IS PURE SPECULATION.

NONETHELESS, SINCE SHORTLY AFTER THE REVOLUTION, PERIODIC REPORTS (ALL UNCONFIRMED) HAVE SURFACED THAT "SPANISH-SPEAKING NON-AFGHANS" IN AFGHAN MILITARY UNIFORMS HAVE BEEN SEEN AT VARIOUS POINTS IN AND AROUND KABUL. FOR EXAMPLE, ONE EMBASSY EMPLOYEE CLAIMED TO HAVE EXCHANGED A FEW WORDS IN SPANISH WITH "AN OBVIOUS CUBAN." NOTHING ALONG THESE LINES HAS EVER BEEN PINNED DOWN, BUT WE CONTINUE TO INVESTIGATE SUCH STORIES, AND WE WILL, OF COURSE, REPORT IMMEDIATELY SHOULD WE OBTAIN INFORMATION WHICH GOES BEYOND RUMOR. AMSTUTZ
(C - ENTIRE TEXT.)
WE HAVE NEVER HEARD OF A ,BERNARD LEWIS PLAN.- WE HAVE NEITHER READ ANY ARTICLE NOR HEARD ANY REMARKS BY LEWIS ON IRAN IN RECENT MONTHS.

THE IMPORTANCE OF IRAN'S TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY FOR US NATIONAL INTERESTS HAS BEEN A CONSISTENT ELEMENT OF OUR POLICY TOWARDS IRAN AND IS REGULARLY STATED PUBLICLY. YOU MAY REFER THE FOREIGN MINISTER TO YOUR PARS NEWS INTERVIEW AND TO OUR ANSWERS TO PRESS QUESTIONS DURING THE KURDISH
(C - ENTIRE TEXT.)
IN THE AWKWARD AUTUMNAL MOMENT BETWEEN TENNIS AND SKIING SEASONS, EMBASSY OFFICERS MIGHT WISH TO LOOK INTO FOLLOWING THREE SUBJECTS OF INTEREST TO US

RECONSTRUCTION BRIGADE. AT A LUNCH WITH DEPTOFFS YESTERDAY, IRANIAN EMBASSY OFFICERS CITED THIS ACTIVITY AS ONE OF THE POSITIVE POST-REVOLUTION PROGRAMS THAT ARE VIRTUALLY UNKNOWN IN THE US. AN INQUIRY INTO THIS SUBJECT WITH VISITS TO WORKS IN PROGRESS WOULD BE OF INTEREST ITSELF, AND A SHOW OF INTEREST IN THE BENEFITS OF THE REVOLUTION MIGHT BE HELPFUL IN OUR CONTACTS WITH THE PGOI. ARE THERE OTHER SUCH "GOOD NEWS" PROGRAMS?

AGRICULTURE. IN AN INTER-AGENCY BRIEFING MARVIN ZONIS, RECENTLY RETURNED FROM TWO-WEEK VISIT, DESCRIBED IRAN AS A "MINI-CAMBODIA." ONE EXAMPLE HE CITED WAS DISASTROUS SITUATION IN AGRICULTURE WHICH HAD BEEN POISED FOR A TAKEOFF WHEN THE REVOLUTION BROKE. NOW CONDITIONS WERE CHAOTIC AND WHEN FARM WORK SLOWED NEXT MONTH AND MILLION YOUNG MEN MOVED TO THE CITIES, THERE UOULD BE SERIOUS PROBLEM OF DESTABILIZATION. OUR IMPRESSION HAS BEEN THAT RURAL AREAS HAVE COME THROUGH THE REVOLUTION RELATIVELY UNSCATHED AND THAT CROP PRODUCTION HAS GENERALLY HELD UP VERY WELL. WE WOULD APPRECIATE YOUR OVERALL ASSESSMENT.

MANAGEMENT. ZONIS ALSO SAID THAT THE COUNTRY WAS FACING 'ECONOMIC CHAOS" AS A RESULT OF THE EXODUS OF SKILLED MANAGERS AND TECHNOCRATS. YET, WE NOTE FROM EMBASSY REPORTING THAT VENTURES LIKE THE GENERAL MOTORS PLANT COULD BEGIN TO SHOW A PROFIT, SOMETHING THAT REMAINED ELUSIVE UNDER THE PREVIOUS REGIME. REQUEST EMBASSY'S ASSESSMENT ON COMPETENCY OF THE NEW MANAGERIAL CORPS. HOW SERIOUS HAS THE FLIGHT OF TECHNOCRATS ACTUALLY BEEN? VANCE

segments.text: WE ARE CONSIDERING TAKING UP WITH YAZDI AS PART OF "CLEANUP-THE-PAST" CAMPAIGN AN APPROACH ON(1) COMPENSATION OWED US FOR DAMAGE TO EMBASSY COMPOUND AND USICA BUILDING, AND

RESTORATION OF IRAN-AMERICAN SOCIETY BUILDING IN SHIRAZ TO SOCIETY'S CONTROL. COULD YOU PLEASE PROVIDE US WITH DETAILS OF APPROACHES MADE, AMOUNTS CLAIMED, STATUS OF DISCUSSIONS AND ANY RECOMMENDATIONS YOU MAY HAVE FOR HANDLING

WE BELIEVE YOU SHOULD CONVEY TO THE PGOI OUR DEEP REGRET AT THE EXECUTIONS OF SENATORS MATBUI, KHAWJANURI AND ALAM. WE ARE DISTURBED THAT THESE ELDERLY MEN WERE VICTIMS OF SUMMARY JUSTICE BY THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS AFTER WE HAVE BEEN LED TO BELIEVE THAT (1) KHOMEINI'S AMNESTY WOULD PREVENT EXECUTIONS OF SUCH "OFFENDERS;" (2) MINISTRY OF JUSTICE WAS GRADUALLY ASSERTING ITS CONTROL OVER REVOLUTIONARY COURTS; AND (3) RELIGIOUS LEADERS SUCH AS KHOMEINI'S SON HAVE EXPRESSED OPPOSITION TO CONTINUING EXECUTIONS.

WE AGREE WITH THE EMBASSY'S ASSESSMENT THAT SUCH SENSELESS ACTS WILL DIMINISH THE PGOI'S BASE OF SUPPORT AMONG THE KEY GROUP OF MODERATE, EDUCATED IRANIANS WHOSE PARTICIPATION IS CRUCIAL TO DEVELOPING A NEW SOCIETY.

ON THE SAME OCCASION, REQUEST EMBASSY ALSO RAISE THE CASE OF CONTINUED INCARCERATION AND POSSIBLE DANGER TO FORMER SENATOR MOHSEN FOROUGHI. FOROUGHI COMES FROM A DISTINGUISHED IRANIAN FAMILY OF GREAT CULTURE. (FOROUGHI'S PRIMARY SIN SEEMS TO HAVE BEEN TO BECOME MINISTER OF CULTURE UNDER SHERIF-EMAMI.) HIS FATHER WAS PRIME MINISTER UNDER REZA SHAH AND MADE A FAMOUS APPEAL FOR FREEDOM IN IRAN IN 1941. FOROUGHI'S BROTHER, MAHMOUD, WAS AMBASSADOR TO THE US AND AFGHANISTAN BEFORE RESIGNING FROM THE MINISTRY IN DISGUST AT CONDITIONS IN IRAN. MAHMOUD, CONCERNED BY THE EXECUTION OF THREE SENATORS, HAS ASKED US TO INTERVENE ON HIS BROTHER'S BEHALF.
EMBASSY MAY WISH TO COORDINATE WITH FRENCH EMBASSY AS WE UNDERSTAND MOHSEN WAS A MEMBER OF THE
(S - ENTIRE TEXT)

DEPTOFF LUNCHED WITH HAERI WHO RETURNED FROM IRAN TWO WEEKS AGO. HAERI SAID HE PREFERRED PEACE AND QUIET OF GEORGETOWN TO CONFUSION PREVAILING IN IRAN. HE DISAGREED STRONGLY WITH POLICIES AND ACTIONS OF PRESENT LEADERSHIP AND DID NOT WISH TO REMAIN IN IRAN WHERE IT WOULD BE IMPOSSIBLE FOR HIM PERSONALLY EITHER TO SUPPORT OR OPPOSE KHOMEINI. ALTHOUGH HAERI SAW NO PGOI OFFICIALS HE DID MEET WITH RELIGIOUS LEADERS, INCLUDING KHOMEINI.

DURING FIRST TWO MEETINGS WITH KHOMEINI, HIS SON AND GRANDSON (SON-IN-LAW OF HAERI'S BROTHER) WERE PRESENT. HAERI SOUGHT A THIRD, PRIVATE MEETING IN JULY IN WHICH HE VERY CAREFULLY DELIVERED THREE POINTS SET FORTH BY SAUNDERS IN REF A.
SUPPORT FOR IRAN'S INDEPENCENCE.

NON-INVOLVEMENT IN IRAN'S INTERNAL AFFAIRS. HAERI ADDED HIS INTERPRETATION THAT U.S. WOULD REMAIN UNINVOLVED ONLY AS LONG AS SOVIETS STAYED OUT. WE COULD BE EXPECTED TO PROTECT OUR INTERESTS IF SOVIETS BEGAN TO SEEK INFLUENCE BY COVERT MEANS.
SUPPORT FOR THE OBJECTIVES OF THE REVOLUTION. HAERI ADDED HIS VIEW THAT THIS ADM,NISTRATION WISHES TO DISASSOCIATE ITSELF FROM RECORD OF PREVIOUS ADMINISTRATIONS AND TURN A NEW PAGE WITH IRAN.

HAERI SAID KHOMEINI MADE NO SUBSTANTIVE COMMENT, BUT CLEARLY SEEMED PLEASED WITH THE MESSAGE. IN GENERAL; HAERI FOUND KHOMEINI HEAVILY INFLUENCED BY QOM CLERICS, MOST OF WHOM WERE DEPLORABLE. KHOMEINI SEEMED MUCH AGED SINCE HAERI LAST SAW HIM IN 1963 AND LESS FLEXIBLE IN DISCUSSION. OFTEN WHEN HAERI WOULD PRESS HIM ON A POINT KHOMEINI WOULD REMAIN SILENT. HAERI IS WORRIED ABOUT KHOMEINI'S AGE AND WEAKNESS, BUT HE DID NOT DESCRIBE A SERIOUS PHYSICAL DETERIORATION.

ON OTHER CLERICS, HAERI WAS UPBEAT ON SHARIATMADARI, SAYING HE HAD RECENTLY GAINED SIGNIFICANT SUPPORT. MONTASERI WAS DISMISSED AS INTELLECTUALLY SECOND RATE. TALEGHANI, HE THOUGHT, HAD NOT HAD THE MORAL AND PHYSICAL TOUGHNESS TO CARRY OUT LEADING ROLE HE HAD ACQUIRED. ROUHANI WAS A "CHICKEN-HEARTED AND NOT VERY SMART MULLAH." HAERI'S BROTHER WAS THE LEADING VOTE GETTER IN THE COUNCIL OF EXPERTS ELECTION IN QOM AND THE ONLY ONE KHOMEINI VOTED FOR.
HAERI INDICATED HE IS DOING FAIRLY WELL FINANCIALLY WITH A PARTIAL GRANT AND HIS OWN RESOURCES FROM IRAN. HE DID NOT MENTION US ASSISTANCE OR EXCHANGE OF RELIGIOUS
S - ENTIRE TEXT

JOE REED OF DAVID ROCKEFELLER'S OFFICE ADVISED UNDER SECRETARY NEWSOM SEPTEMBER 28 THAT SHAH WAS ILL IN MEXICO AND THAT ROCKEFELLER HAD SENT HIS PERSONAL PHYSICIAN TO EXAMINE SHAH. REED SAID THAT IF SHAH'S CONDITION WAS SERIOUS, THIS MIGHT BE FOLLOWED BY A REQUEST THAT HE BE ADMITTED TO THE UNITED STATES FOR MEDICAL PURPOSES.

WE WILL OF COURSE DETERMINE WHETHER SUCH A STEP IS ABSOLUTELY NECESSARY. WE WOULD LIKE YOUR ASSESSMENT OF POSSIBLE IRANIAN REACTION UNDER PRESENT CIRCUMSTANCES. WE WOULD PLAN, IN SUCH CIRCUMSTANCES,TO INFORM IRANIAN GOVERNMENT. WE WOULD PARTICULARLY LEAVE OPEN THE QUESTION OF THE DURATION OF HIS STAY.

1979STATE258496.subject: BILATERAL WITH IRANIAN FOREIGN MINISTER, OCTOBER 3

segments.text: OCTOBER 3 (CONFIDENTIAL-ENTIRE TEXT.)

YOU MEET WITH YAZDI AT A TIME THAT MAY MARK A SIGNIFICANT WATERSHED IN IRANIAN INTERNAL AFFAIRS. WHILE IT IS IMPORTANT FOR ANY OBSERVER TO AVOID HASTY JUDGMENTS ABOUT THIS PLACE, IT IS HARD TO AVOID THE CONCLUSION THAT THE CLERICS ARE NOW IN THE MOOD TO STEAMROLLER VIRTUALLY ANY AND ALL OPPOSITION TO THEIR DESIGNS FOR AN ESSENTIALLY THEOCRATIC STATE, WITH ISLAM AS THE IDEOLOGY AND THE ISLAMIC REPUBLICAN PARTY POSSIBLY PROVIDING CONTROLLING PARTY APPARATUS. ITEMS: - A. THE KURDISH "REBELLION" HAS BEEN PUT DOWN IN A - WAY INTENDED TO SERVE AN OBJECT LESSON FOR - OTHER MINORITIES. - B.

THE NATIONAL DEMOCRATIC FRONT AND ITS LEADERSHIP - HAVE BEEN BRANDED COUNTER-REVOLUTIONARIES AND - OTHER OPPOSITION ELEMENTS SIMILARLY WARNED. - C. A CLERIC-DOMINATED COUNCIL IS RAMRODDING THROUGH - A CONSTITUTIONAL REVIEW PROCESS THAT WOULD SEEM TO - INSTITUTIONALIZE AN IRON-CLAD SHIA ISLAMIC - CONTROL OF THE GOVERNMENTAL APPARATUS. - D. EXECUTIONS ARE CONTINUING, EVEN OF COMMON - CRIMINALS, DESPITE TALK OF AMNESTY. QUM SEEMS - DETERMINED TO AVOID ANY SHOW OF JUDICIAL MERCY - OR COMPASSION. - E. THE HEAD OF THE REVOLUTION-BORN PASDARANS - ("GUARDIANS OF THE REVOLUTION") HAS JUST TAKEN OVER - AS MINISTER OF DEFENSE. - F.

NAZEH'S OUSTER AT NIOC IS A FORCEFUL AND VERY - PUBLIC REMINDER TO THE SECULARISTS OF QUM'S - DETERMINATION TO PREVENT ANY LESSENING OF ITS - CONTROL OVER WHAT MATTERS, INCLUDING THE OIL - SECTOR. - G. A KIND OF PARANOIA PERSISTS OVER AN ALLEGED - CONSPIRACY BY THE WESTERN PRESS AGAINST THE - IRANIAN REVOLUTION. (THERE ARE NO AMERICAN - JOURNALISTS NOW RESIDENT HERE.) - H. THE U.S.

CONTINUES TO BE DENOUNCED BY KHOMEINI - AS MASSIVELY INVOLVED WITH INTERNATIONAL ZIONISM - IN FRUSTRATING THE HOPES OF THE PALESTINIANS; - INDEED KHOMEINI SEEMS TO SEE HIMSELF AND THE - REVOLUTION AS BECOMING THE REAL UNIFYING FORCE - THROUGHOUT THE AREA IN THE STRUGGLE FOR PALESTINIAN - RIGHTS.

THERE IS MORE, BUT THIS IS ENOUGH TO UNDERSCORE THE POINT THAT FOR THE MOMENT THE CLERICS ARE IN A FLOOD TIDE OF ASCENDANCY. THERE WOULD SEEM TO BE NOTHING THAT WILL PREVENT THEIR SOLIDIFYING THEIR POLITICAL CONTROL IN THE EVOLVING CONSTITUTIONAL STRUCTURE -- NOT THE MILITARY, NOT BAKHTIAR FROM PARIS, NOT POPULAR DISILLUSIONMENT OVER THE LACK OF MUCH BREAD AND BUTTER RETURNS FROM THE REVOLUTION, NOT BAZARGAN AND OTHER MODERATES IN THE PGOI. (BAZARGAN IS QUOTED IN AN INTERVIEW IN TODAY'S PRESS WITH ORIANA FALLACI AS SAYING "...
FROM AN OFFICIAL POINT OF VIEW THE GOVERNMENT RUNS THE COUNTRY BUT IN AN IDEOLOGICAL AND REVOLUTIONARY SENSE KHOMEINI AND HIS COUNCILS CONTROL." TRUE INDEED.)

WHAT COULD ARREST THE TREND PERHAPS, BUT ONLY WITH TIME, WOULD BE A GREATER APPRECIATION THAN NOW EXISTS OF THE PROBLEMS OF GOVERNING A PLURALISTIC BODY POLITIC AND A PARTIALLY MODERNIZED ECONOMY SUCH AS IRAN'S WITH RELIGIOUS PRECEPTS THAT SEEM TO PROVIDE SO LITTLE ROOM FOR PARTICIPATION BY THE SECULAR ELEMENTS OF THIS COUNTRY.

THE QUESTION IS WHETHER KHOMEINI APPRECIATES THIS AT ALL, AND THERE THE RETURNS ARE NOT ENCOURAGING. EVEN IF HE DOES THERE IS A REAL QUESTION WHETHER EVEN HE COULD PREVAIL AGAINST A SUBSTANTIAL TIDE NOW RUNNING AND AN ENTOURAGE IN QUM THAT BY ALL ACCOUNTS IS EVEN MORE OBDURATE THAN KHOMEINI.
THE EASY ANSWER IS THAT AN INEXORABLE PROCESS IS UNDERWAY THAT WILL SWEEP ASIDE THE MODERATE FORCES AND THAT WILL EVENTUALLY ALSO SEE BAZARGAN OUSTED, IN THE MANNER OF NAZEH AT NIOC.

I AM NOT SO SURE. I FIND MUCH LESS GROUND FOR OPTIMISM THAN A MONTH AGO, BUT KHOMEINI IS NO FOOL POLITICALLY AND MAY YET APPRECIATE THE NEED FOR SOME ACCOMMODATION TO THE MODERATES (WHICH BAZARGAN WEAKLY BUT STILL GAMELY REPRESENTS) TO ASSURE CONTINUED POLITICAL STABILITY AS HE SEEKS TO ASSURE WHAT MATTERS TO HIM, AND THAT IS PRIMACY OF ISLAM IN THE SOCIAL AND POLITICAL FABRIC OF FUTURE IRAN.

YOU MAY WISH TO PROBE WITH YAZDI HOW HE SEES FUTURE TRENDS IN THIS AREA. HE IS A DEEP BELIEVER, A REVOLUTIONARY WHO IS AS CLOSE AS ANY IN THE PGOI TO KHOMEINI BUT WHO MAY APPRECIATE THE NEED TO BALANCE HIS IDEALISM WITH REALISM. HE HAS SAID AS MUCH TO ME, AND I AM PREPARED TO BELIEVE HIM. YOUR CONVERSATION WITH HIM, THE FIRST HIGH LEVEL CONTACT WE HAVE HAD WITH THE REVOLUTIONARY LEADERSHIP, IS CRUCIAL TO OUR PURPOSES HERE.

IN AFFIRMING TO HIM THAT WE ACCEPT THE NEW REALITIES IN IRAN, AND INDEED THAT WE WISH IRAN WELL IN DEVELOPING ITS NEW INSTITUTIONS OF GOVERNMENT, YAZDI SHOULD ALSO KNOW THAT WE ARE TROUBLED BY A RIGIDITY AND AN ABSENCE OF A HUMAN FACE IN THE REVOLUTION THAT SEEMS TO LEAVE SO LITTLE SCOPE FOR THE RIGHTS OR INTERESTS OF MORE MODERATE ELEMENTS IN TODAY'S IRAN. KHOMEINI CARES LITTLE ABOUT IRAN'S IMAGE IN THE UNITED STATES BUT THERE ARE OTHERS, LIKE YAZDI, WHO DO.

1979STATE259727.subject: POSSIBLE TRANSFER OF F-14'S TO SYRIA

segments.text: (S - ENTIRE TEXT)

IN VIEW OF GENERAL GAST'S MEETING WITH MILITARY LEADERSHIP, AGREE WITH YOUR RECOMMENDATION THAT YOU NOT RAISE THIRD COUNTRY TRANSFER ISSUE WITH MINISTER CHAMRAN. WE WILL DISCUSS WITH YAZDI IN NEW YORK.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)
IN THE COURSE OF MEETINGS IN NEW YORK, FOREIGN MINISTER YAZDI HAD FOLLOWING TO SAY ABOUT IRANIAN/SOVIET RELATIONS

THE IRANIANS HAD HAD TOUGH NEGOTIATIONS WITH THE SOVIETS OVER THEIR ECONOMIC RELATIONS. THE IRANIANS SAID THEY WOULD NOT GO AHEAD WITH IGAT II, BUT FINALLY THEY HAD REACHED AGREEMENT ON THE SECOND STAGE ON THE ISFAHAN STEEL MILL.

YAZDI HAD TOLD TARAKI AT HAVANA THAT THE PRESENCE OF SOVIET ADVISORS IN AFGHANISTAN WAS A MATTER OF DIRECT CONCERN TO THE IRANIANS. IN RESPONSE TO YAZDI'S QUESTION TARAKI SAID THERE WERE 3600 SOVIET ADVISORS NOW IN AFGHANI
(S - ENTIRE TEXT.)

IRAN'S FOREIGN MINISTER WAS PLAINLY DETERMINED TO CREATE A STRONG IMPRESSION OF THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY AS A NEW BREED OF MAN. LIKE IRAN'S STUDENT DEMONSTRATORS WHOSE RANKS HE RECENTLY LED, HE DID NOT SEEM INTERESTED IN WINNING FRIENDS AS MUCH AS DEMANDING ATTENTION TO HIS CAUSE AND PROCLAIMING ITS JUSTICE. WHATEVER INTERESTS THE NEW GOVERNMENT MAY HAVE IN THE UN OR THE US SEEMED OF SECONDARY IMPORTANCE TO YAZDI'S DESIRE FOR PSYCHIC SATISFACTION AND THE PROMOTION OR PROTECTION OF HIS OWN POLITICAL FUTURE IN IRAN.

IT WAS, AFTER ALL, THE RETURN IN TRIUMPH OF ONE WHO HAD BEEN SCORNED IN EXILE. THUS, AS A STREET FIGHTER LECTURING THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF THE ESTABLISHMENT, HE TOLD THE COUNCIL ON FOREIGN RELATIONS OF 25 YEARS OF MISTAKES IN US FOREIGN RELATIONS RANGING FROM CHINA, VIETNAM TO IRAN AND AFRICA. HE TOLD THE UNGA OF HIS SATISFACTION AFTER "SCREAMING THE OUTRAGE OF MY PEOPLE...

FROM THE SIDEWALKS" TO "HAVE PENETRATED THE WALLS AND YOU ARE HEARING ME LOUD AND CLEAR." SIMILARLY, HE USED HIS FIRST MEETING WITH THE SECRETARY TO RELIEVE HIMSELF OF THE BROODING PAIN OF 25 YEARS OF US SUPPORT FOR THE SHAH AND 7 MONTHS OF DOUBTS HE HAS HAD ABOUT OUR FRIENDSHIP.

YAZDI ON THIS VISIT WAS MORE AGGRESSIVELY SURE OF HIMSELF AND YET ALSO VERY INSECURE. THUS, HE AFFECTS A MODIFIE1-MAO DRESS CODE AND ORNAMENTS HIS DISCOURSE WITH SOCIOLOGICAL CONCEPTS LIKE ALIENATION THAT WE BELIEVE MANSOUR FARHANG MAY DEVISE FOR HIM. HIS REMARKS ARE NOT QUALIFIED BY UNCERTAINTY OR BY SENSITIVITY TO THE PERCEPTIONS OF HIS LISTENERS. HIS ORIENTATION IS STRONGLY IDEOLOGICAL AND IDEALISTIC, BUT THERE IS LITTLE IN HIS THOUGHT THAT IS DEEP, SUBTLE OR ORIGINAL. HE DOES NOT APPEAR TO HAVE A POLITICIAN'S TALENT FOR INFLUENCING HIS AUDIENCE NOR IS THERE MUCH SIGN OF A POLITICIAN'S FLEXIBILITY IN HIS APPROACH.

POLITICS, HOWEVER, ARE A CONTINUING PREOCCUPATION. HIS EVERY WORD IN A MEETING IS RECORDED BY ONE OR MORE NOTETAKERS. IN FACT, THE NOTETAKERS MAY BE THE PRINCIPAL AUDIENCE ON THESE OCCASIONS. HE INSISTED ON HAVING THE VIDEOTAPE OF HIS WETA INTERVIEW BEFORE LEAVING THE STUDIO. HE TOLD A DEPTOFF PRIVATELY THAT HE FELT THREATENED SOMEHOW BECAUSE HE HAD BEEN IN THE US WHEN THE TEHRAN PRESS REPORTED OUR CHARGE'S "DEMARCHE" ON EXECUTIONS. THE APPROACH SHOULD HAVE BEEN MADE, HE SAID, TO THE MFA WHERE HE HAD INSTRUCTED HIS OFFICERS NEVER TO SPEAK TO THE PRESS.

HE MADE CLEAR IN THE SAME PRIVATE CONVERSATION THAT HE VERY MUCH HOPED FOR THE APPOINTMENT OF A NEW US AMBASSADOR WHO WOULD BE SYMPATHETIC TO THE REVOLUTION. WE SUSPECT THAT YAZDI SINCERELY FEARS THE US MAY SEEK TO OVERTHROW THE ISLAMIC REGIME AND IS INTENT ON PERSONALLY MANAGING THE US-IRAN RELATIONSHIP HIMSELF TO PROTECT THE REVOLUTION.

YAZDI MAY FEEL VULNERABLE TO ATTACK BY POLITICAL FACTIONS IN TEHRAN. HE TOLD ONE IRANIAN CONTACT OF INTENSE IN-FIGHTING AND THE NEED TO CONTINUE PURGES UNTIL "WE FEEL SECURE WITH OUR OWN PEOPLE." HE SAID TO ANOTHER CONTACT THAT HE TOLD KHOMEINI HE SHOULD STAY OUT OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS AND CITED THE APPOINTMENT OF AN AMBASSADOR TO BAHRAIN AS A VICTORY HE ACHIEVED OVER THE RELIGIOUS ESTABLISHMENT. THUS, IF YAZDI IS TO HAVE ANY INFLUENCE AND POLITICAL FUTURE IN IRAN, HE MUST PROTECT HIMSELF AGAINST THE CHARGE THAT HE IS AMERICA'S NO. 1 AGENT. HE SUCCESSFULLY DEMONSTRATED THE ABSURDITY OF THAT CHARGE THIS WEEK.
UNFORTUNATELY FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF OUR RELATIONS, HE CLEARLY BELIEVES MUCH OF WHAT HE SAYS TO ENDEAR HIMSELF
(S - ENTIRE TEXT) DCM AND EMBOFF CALLED OCTOBER 4 ON GENERAL DJAM WHO OFFERED FOLLOWING VIEWS ON IRANIAN ISSUES (SEE ALSO OE6-74, 175.Y NOFORN/NO CONTRACT/ORCON FOR DJAM'S VIEWS IN EARLY SEPTEMBER)

BAKHTIAR'S INTENTIONS: BAKHTIAR CALLED DJAM BEFORE TRAVELING TO LONDON AND THE TWO MET DURING HIS VISIT. DJAM TOLD BAKHTIAR THAT HE MUST FASHION A SPECIFIC PROGRAM IF HE WISHES TO PRESENT A BELIEVABLE ALTERNATIVE TO IRANIAN MODERATES. DJAM ADDED THAT HE UNDERSTANDS BAKHTIAR HAS FORMED A STUDY GROUP AND HOPES TO ISSUE A "MANIFESTO" WHICH WOULD COVER ALL ASPECTS OF FOREIGN AND DOMESTIC POLICY INCLUDING ECONOMICS, INDUSTRIAL AND AGRICULTURAL DEVELOPMENT, EDUCATION AND EVEN CULTURE. BAKHTIAR, HOWEVER, FACES SERIOUS PROBLEMS, NOT THE LEAST OF WHICH IS FINANCE.
THERE ARE SOME EXILES WHO HAVE THE MONEY AND INCLINATION TO HELP, BUT MOST HAVE GIVEN UP HOPE OF EVER RETURNING AND MANY NEED THE FUNDS THEY HAVE TO PAY THEIR OWN FAMILIES' EXPENSES.

MOST IMPORTANT, IN DJAM'S VIEW, IS THAT IT APPEARS MORE AND MORE THAT THE ONLY REAL CHOICE IS BETWEEN THE MULLAHS AND THE "COMMUNISTS." DJAM HIMSELF, WHILE EMPHASIZING HIS ANTI-COMMUNIST CREDENTIALS, IS RELUCTANTLY CONCLUDING THAT ONLY THE COMMUNISTS CAN GET RID OF THE MULLAHS. ASKED WHICH "COMMUNISTS" HE HAD IN MIND, HE REPLIED THAT HE WAS NOT REPEAT NOT REFERRING TO THE TUDEH.

THE TRIBES: THE REBELLION AMONGST THE KURDS WILL REMAIN A FESTERING SORE AND DIFFICULTIES ELSEWHERE -HE MENTIONED PARTICULARLY THE TRIBES OF FARS, KHUZISTAN, AND THE BELUCH -- WILL CONTINUE. LACK OF MAINTENANCE IN THE AIR FORCE WILL SEVERELY HAMPER THE MILITARY RESPONSE; FOR EXAMPLE, ONLY TWO DOZEN HELICOPTERS ARE STILL FLYING AND THE F-4S WHICH WERE "SHOT DOWN" HAD IN FACT SUCCUMBED TO LACK OF CARE. ABOUT 70 PERCENT OF THE ARMY IS AWOL.

WITH SO MANY YOUNG OFFICERS JUMPED UP TO COMMAND POSITIONS, DJAM SAID THAT DESPITE HIS UNUSUALLY LARGE ACQUAINTANCE WITH THE OFFICER CORPS (STEMMING FROM HIS YEARS ASSOCIATED WITH MILITARY TRANING FACLITIES), HE SIMPLY DOES NOT KNOW IF HE STILL HAS MANY "FRIENDS," AN UNCERTAINTY WHICH HE HAD EXPRESSED TO BAKHTIAR.

THE CITIES: WITH COMMERCE AT A VIRTUAL STANDSTILL, IT MAY BE THAT THE BAZAARIS ARE BECOMING FED UP. IF THAT HAPPENS, AS IT DID WHEN THE SHAH MADE HIS FIRST FLIGHT FROM IRAN, IT WILL BE IMPOSSIBLE TO PREDICT THE OUTCOME.

THE MULLAHS: NO ONE SHOULD UNDERESTIMATE THE GRIP OF THE MULLAHS ON THE LOWER CLASSES OR THE IGNORANCE OF THE RELIGIOUS LEADERS ABOUT THE PRACTICAL ISSUES OF GOVERNMENT. WITH KHOMEINI AND HIS SUPPORTERS IGNORANT OF AND INDIFFERENT TO ECONOMICS, AND THEIR BELIEF THAT IRAN CAN PROSPER BOTH AS A SELF-SUFFICIENT ENTITY AND AS A MILITANT PROSELYTIZING CENTER, THE DOMESTIC SITUATION WILL CONTINUE TO "BOIL" FOR THE INDEFINITE FUTURE, WHILE IRAN'S NEIGHBORS REACT WITH INCREASING HOSTILITY TO INTERFERENCE IN THEIR INTERNAL AFFAIRS. IRAQ, IN PARTICULAR, MUST BE VIEWED AS A POTENTIAL CENTER FOR OPERATIONS AGAINST KHOMEINI, GIVEN SADDAM'S ANTAGONISM TOWARD EITHER A MILITANT SHI'A OR A COMMUNIST REGIME ON HIS DOORSTEP.
THERE IS NO ONE, HOWEVER, IN THE RELIGIOUS HIERARCHY WHO UNDERSTANDS THESE DANGERS. EVEN SHARIAT-MADERI IS A MAN OF RELIGION WHO IS GENUINELY NOT INTERESTED IN POLITICS OR ECONOMICS.

THE SUPERPOWERS: GIVEN HIS PREMISE THAT NO COUNTRY IN THE MODERN WORLD CAN SUCCESSFULLY EXIST AS AN ISLAND (DJAM CITED CHINA AS AN EXAMPLE), THE IRANIAN PROBLEM CANNOT BE RESOLVED UNTIL THE SUPERPOWERS DECIDE ON A SOLUTION. DJAM EXPLAINED HE WAS NOT REFERRING TO INTERVENTION, ALTHOUGH IN ANOTHER CONTEXT HE SUGGESTED THAT IF A BASE FOR REBELLION COULD BE ESTABLISHED "IN THE AREA" -- PERHAPS IRAQ, HE THOUGHT IT LIKELY THAT MANY OFFICERS AND NCOS WOULD RALLY TO THE CAUSE. HE RECALLED THAT THOUSANDS HAVE BEEN TRAINED IN THE WEST AND ARE FAVORABLY DISPOSED TO WESTERN WAYS.
THE SHAH: DJAM SAID HE UNDERSTOOD THAT THE SHAH HAD BEEN INTERESTED IN CONTACTING BAKHTIAR, BUT THAT THE LATTER DID NOT REGARD HIM AS AN ASSET.
COMMENT: WE INTEND TO SHARE DJAM'S VIEWS WITH THE FCO (REFTEL, PARA 3).
SUGGEST DEPARTMENT REPEAT TO TEHRAN.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT.)
THERE WAS VIRTUALLY NO OPPORTUNITY TO TALK TO YAZDI 'OFF THE RECORD" DURING HIS STAY IN NEW YORK. TWO ITEMS OF INTEREST

AS NOTETAKERS SCRIBBLED, HE TOLD US THAT THE NEW CONSTITUTION'S FIFTH ARTICLE ESTABLISHING A RELIGIOUS FIGURE AS SUPREME LEADER WOULD HAVE "NO EFFECT" ON THE REPRESENTATIVE CHARACTER OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. THERE WOULD STILL BE A POPULARLY ELECTED PRESIDENT AND MAJLIS WHICH, HE IMPLIED, WOULD EXERCISE REAL POLITICAL POWER. AN AMERICAN CONFIDENT OF MANY RADICAL IRANIANS UNDERSTANDS THAT YAZDI ASPIRES TO THE PRESIDENCY.

BILL BUTLER OF THE INTERNATIONAL COMMISSION OF JURISTS EXPRESSED PRIVATELY TO YAZDI HIS CONCERN FOR THE WELL-BEING OF MATIN-DAFTARY. YAZDI ASSURED BUTLER THAT MATIN-DAFTARY WOULD NOT BE HARMED. BUTLER HAD THE IMPRESSION THAT THE PGOI WAS NOT SERIOUSLY TRYING TO APPREHEND MATIN-DAFTARY. YAZDI INVITED BUTLER TO VISIT IRAN. WE ENCOURAGED BUTLER TO ACCEPT. HE SAID THE ICJ WOULD NEED AN "EVENT" OF SOME KIND, E.G. THE REPLACEMENT OF REVOLUTIONARY COURTS BY CIVILIAN TRIBUNALS, TO JUSTIFY A VISIT. IN THAT CONTEXT THE ICJ WOULD SEE A VISIT AS LENDING SUPPORT TO GOVERNMENT EFFORTS TO STABILIZE THE ADMINISTRATION OF JUSTICE. VANCE

1979STATE264264.subject: ACCESS TO FORMER US MILITARY FACILITIES

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT)

WE TELEPHONED BAYANDOR IN NEW YORK TO ASK STATUS OF JOINT COMMITTEE MENTIONED BY FORMIN YAZDI TO CLOSE OUT US FACILITIES. WE SAID EMBASSY WAS UNINFORMED ON ORGANIZATION OF COMMITTEE AND WE WONDERED HOW WE SHOULD PROCEED. BAYANDOR SAID THAT SEVERAL EFFORTS HAD BEEN MADE IN RECENT PAST TO ESTABLISH A COMMITTEE, BUT THERE HAD BEEN SERIES OF FRUSTRATIONS. HE DID NOT KNOW WHERE MATTER NOW STOOD. HE SUGGESTED THAT EMBASSY GET IN TOUCH WITH HIS DEPUTY, PARSARKIA, AND ASK HIM TO LOOK INTO MATTER. IF, AFTER A FEW DAYS, THERE WAS NO PROGRESS, CHARGE' MIGHT RAISE SUBJECT WITH FOREIGN MINISTER.
WE INVITED BAYANDOR TO WASHINGTON FOR A REVIEW OF BILATERAL ISSUES AS SEEN FROM THIS PERSPECTIVE. HE SAID HE
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)

PLEASE CONVEY TO DRAFTER OF REFTELS OUR APPRECIATION FOR THIS FINE REPORTING. THESE DESPATCHES GIVE ARMCHAIR ANALYSTS HERE AN EXCELLENT PERSPECTIVE OF IRANIAN LIFE AND POLITICS OUTSIDE OF THE CAPITAL CITY. REFTELS ARE BUT ANOTHER EXAMPLE OF THE EXCELLENT REPORTING WE HAVE COME TO EXPECT FROM YOUR POLITICAL SECTION. VANCE
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)

ASSERTION IN REFTEL THAT CIA HAS ESTABLISHED "COMMISSION OF THREE FORMER US AMBASSADORS TO IRAN"...IS FALSE. WE HAVE CONTACTED AMBASSADOR HELMS AND MEYER WHO ARE IN WASHINGTON AND AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN WHO IS IN NEW YORK. NONE HAVE BEEN OUT OF COUNTRY EXCEPT AMBASSADOR MEYER WHO WAS RECENTLY FOR BRIEF PERIOD ON BUSINESS TRIP TO ARABIAN PENINSULA STATES. OTHER THREE FORMER AMBASSADORS ARE EITHER AILING OR FULLY OCCUPIED IN PRIVATE PURSUITS. ARAFAT STORY IS A COMPLETE FABRICATION. YOU MAY INFORM PGOI OF FOREGOING.

WASHINGTON STAR TODAY CARRIES STORY ON FUEL OIL SUPPLY WHICH CONTAINS ASSERTION THAT THE PRESIDENT IN BRIEFING COMMUNITY LEADERS IN THE WHITE HOUSE SAID "IN DISCUSSING IRAN, AS OTHER FEDERAL OFFICIALS HAVE FOR WEEKS, THAT CRUDE OIL PRODUCTION THERE COULD BE SHUT DOWN BECAUSE OF POLITICAL TURMOIL." CHARGE AGAH CALLED US ABOUT THIS STORY. WE HAVE OBTAINED INFORMAL TRANSCRIPT OF PRESIDENT'S BRIEF REMARKS (NOT FOR PUBLICATION) WHCIH WE ARE GIVING TO AGAH. THERE IS NO MENTION OF IRAN.

CONFUSION COULD HAVE ARISEN FROM FOLLOWING PASSAGE FOLLOWING DISCUSSION OF OPEC, SAUDI ARABIA, LIBYA: ..."OTHER COUNTRIES, OF COURSE, HAVE UNCERTAIN POLITICAL CIRCUMSTANCES WITHIN THEIR OWN BORDERS, AND THERE IS A CONSTANT THREAT OF INTERRUPTION OF THEIR SUPPLY TO THE WORLD MARKET. EARLIER THIS YEAR WE LOST ABOUT 400 MILLION BARRELS OF OIL WHICH WE WOULD HAVE ORDINARILY IMPORTED FROM IRAN BECAUSE OF THE REVOLUTION THERE"...
IF THIS QUESTION IS RAISED WITH YOU, YOU MAY SAY THAT THE PRESIDENT WAS MISQUOTED. VANCE
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)

OUR REFERENCE TO GRADUAL ASSERTION OF MIN/JUSTICE CONTROL OVER COURT SYSTEM WAS BASED ON CHARGE'S CONVERSATION WITH MINISTER OF JUSTICE (TEHRAN 8126) ON JULY 31. WE THOUGHT IT WOULD BE A GOOD PLOY TO TOSS BACK AT IRANIANS THEIR STATED INTENTION TO SHIFT TRIALS FROM REVOLUTIONARY TO REGULAR GOVERNMENT COURTS.
GREATLY APPRECIATE DESCRIPTION OF JUDICIAL SYSTEM CONTAINED TEHRAN 10856. VANCE
(S - ENTIRE TEXT)
EGYPTIAN EMBASSY OFFICERS ZANT AND HAREDY CALLED ON NEA/IRN OCTOBER 10 FOR A BRIEFING ON IRAN. IN GENERAL EGYPTIANS APPEARED TO SHARE GENERAL LINES OF OUR ASSESSMENT SUMMARIZED BELOW.

THE ECONOMY: INDUSTRIAL PRODUCTION STILL DOWN 50 PER CENT. OIL PRODUCTION HOLDING 3.5 - 4.0 MILLION B/D WITH REVENUES PROBABLY EXCEEDING 1978. GREATEST DEFICIENCY IS LOSS OF EXPERIENCED MANAGERS. UNEMPLOYMENT ESTIMATED 20 - 40 PERCENT; INFLATION 20 PERCENT. GOOD AGRICULTURAL YEAR. SPOTTY SHORTAGES SOME MERCHANDISE. GENERALLY SLOW MOVEMENT TOWARDS RECOVERY. ENCOURAGING THAT INCREASING NUMBER OF US FIRMS BEING PAID AND SOME AGREEING TO RESUME WORK (FLUOR ON ISFAHAN REFINERY, AMC TO ASSEMBLE JEEPS).

KURDS AND ARABS: RECENT OUTBREAK OF BOMBINGS AND ARMED ATTACKS CONSIDERED SERIOUS. DIFFICULT TO EVALUATE IMPLICATIONS FOR REGIME, HOWEVER, AS THERE HAVE BEEN MOMENTS OF SERIOUS DIFFICULTY FOR PGOI IN THE PAST.
ARMED FORCES: SLOW MOVEMENT TO REGROUP. NEW COMMANDER OF IAF APPEARS STRONG AND DETERMINED. OUR CONTACTS WITH IRANIAN MILITARY GENERALLY BUSINESSLIKE AND POSITIVE IN TONE.

LEFT AND MIDDLE CLASS: LYING LOW. SMALL IN NUMBER, NO MASS APPEAL, FRAGMENTED, LACK OF STRONG, CHARISMATIC LEADERS. POTENTIAL AUGMENTATION OF STRENGTH SHOULD PRESENT REGIME STUMBLE BADLY. TUDEH PARTY SMALL AND DISCREDITED BY SOVIET LINKAGE.

CLERICAL ASCENDANCY: KHOMEINI--DESPITE MIDDLE CLASS, LEFT-WING AND ETHNIC DEFECTIONS--COMMANDS STRONG MAJORITY SUPPORT OF THE MASSES. HE AND OTHER HARD-LINE MULLAHS APPEAR DETERMINED TO ASSERT THEIR DOMINANCE OVER NEW CONSTITUTION AND ELECTIONS FOR MAJLIS AND PRESIDENT. NEVERTHELESS, THERE SOME RESISTANCE WITHIN THE PGOI (BAZARGAN, YAZDI) AND AMONG CLERICS (SHARIATMADARI).

FOREIGN RELATIONS: REGIME DEEPLY SUSPICIOUS OF SHAHSUPPORTERS THOUGHT TO BE BACKED IN KURDISH AND ARAB AREAS BY ISRAEL AND IRAQ. VAGUE FEAR OF A SAUDI-IRAQ ALLIANCE BACKED BY US AGAINST IRAN. SOMEWHAT LESS FEAR OF SOVIET THREAT. SOVIET HAND IN IRAN NOT NOW APPARENT. EMBARRASSED DESIRE BY PGOI TO REASSURE GULF STATES AFTER CLAIMS AND THREATS ASSERTED BY VARIOUS AYATOLLAHS AGAINST BAHRAIN AND KUWAIT. ABIDING FEAR OF US MILITARY PRESENCE IN THE GULF AND OF US AS MANIPULATOR OF OMANI INITIATIVE FOR STRAIT OF HORMOZ. RESTRAINT ON AFGHANISTAN DESPITE CONCERN FOR INCREASED SOVIET ROLE.

COOLING PRIVATE ATTITUDES TOWARD RADICAL PALESTINIANS OUT OF CONCERN FOR THEIR INFLUENCE IN TEHRAN AND POSSIBLE MEDDLING WITH OIL FIELD ARAB WORKERS. EQUAL HOSTILITY TOWARDS ISRAEL AND EGYPT. CONTINUING STRONG SUPPORT FOR PLO.

U.S.-IRAN RELATIONS: DESIRE ON OUR PART TO FASHION A NEW RELATIONSHIP, COOPERATING WHERE FEASIBLE, MOVING AT A PACE COMFORTABLE FOR IRANIANS IN LIGHT OF STILL STRONG SUSPICIONS AND ANTI-AMERICAN FEELINGS. LIMITED RESUMPTION IN SHIPMENT OF PREVIOUSLY-PURCHASED MILITARY SPARE PARTS AND SALE OF NEW SPARES. ONE-SHOT SALE OF KEROSENE AND HEATING FUEL. EXTENSIVE EFFORTS TO SETTLE COMMERCIAL AND MILITARY CONTRACT DISPUTES. INTEREST IN NAMING AN AMBASSADOR AMONG EXECUTIVE BRANCH OFFICIALS BUT DIFFICULTY OF MAKING FRIENDLY GESTURE WHEN ATMOSPHERE IN IRAN SO FREQUENTLY UNFRIENDLY.
SCENARIOS

HOPEFUL: MODERATE PRAGMATISTS MAINTAIN OR AUGMENT INFLUENCE WITHOUT CAUSING RUPTURE WITH CLERICS AND REVOLUTIONARY IDEOLOGUES. --GLOOMY: PGOI CONTROL SLIPS FURTHER. KURDS, ARABS AND OTHERS SUSTAIN REVOLT IN PROVINCES. ECONOMY UNRAVELS. --MIDDLE GROUND: THERE A FAIR CHANCE, HOWEVER, THAT PRESENT POLITICAL CONDITIONS WOULD PERSIST WITHOUT CLEAR RESOLUTION FOR SOME TIME TO COME. IF CLERICS ESTABLISHED FIRM CONTROL, AND THIS NOT YET ASSURED, IT SEEMED MATTER OF TIME BEFORE COMPLEXITIES OF GOVERNMENT WOULD OVERWHELM THEM. REPLACEMENT POLITICAL FORCE IMPOSSIBLE TO VISUALIZE
OVER A MONTH HAS PASSED SINCE HIJACKING. WOULD APPRECIATE STATUS REPORT FROM ACTION ADDRESSEES REGARDING RESPECTIVE HOST GOVERNMENTS' PLANS FOR PROSECUTION OR
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)
DEPARTMENT INFORMED 20 OCTOBER OF POSSIBLE PGOI PRESSURES BEING APPLIED TO AMERICAN INSTITUTE OF IRANIAN STUDIES IN TEHRAN.

INSTITUTE ASSOCIATE, ALLEN LUTHER, CALLED FROM ANN ARBOR TO INDICATE THAT YAZDI'S OFFICE HAD CALLED INSTITUTE'S LOCAL NATIONAL ACTING DIRECTOR, ABDULLAH SAFARI, IN TEHRAN DEMANDING INFORMATION ON INSTITUTE GRANTEE, MARVIN ZONIS. ZONIS WHO RAN SERIES OF INTERVIEWS IN TEHRAN SEVERAL MONTHS AGO, IS NO LONGER IN TEHRAN. LUTHER BELIEVES THAT SAFARI IS BEING/WILL BE SUBJECTED TO PRESSURES REGARDING ZONIS' RESEARCH CONCERNING WHICH FORMER HAS NO KNOWLEDGE. LUTHER ALSO CONCERNED OVER FUTURE OF INSTITUTE.
WE LEAVE IT TO YOU HOW BEST TO ADDRESS SITUATION, IF AT ALL, BUT WOULD APPRECIATE EMBASSY VIEWS. CHRISTOPHER
SECRET - ENTIRE TEXT.

WE HAVE RECEIVED YOUR REFTEL REPORTING GOI REACTION TO YOUR APPROACH REGARDING SHAH'S MEDICAL TREATMENT IN U.S. WE HAVE TAKEN NOTE OF GOI CONCERNS IN REFTEL BUT BELIEVE THAT IMMEDIATE MEDICAL TREATMENT IN U.S. REMAINS PREFERABLE COURSE AND WE ARE NOW ARRANGING FOR SHAH'S TRAVEL HERE AS SOON AS POSSIBLE (PROBABLY MONDAY P.M.).
WITH REGARD TO GOI'S SPECIFIC CONCERNS

WE RECOGNIZE THAT OTHER ALTERNATIVES FOR TREATMENT ARE AVAILABLE OUTSIDE AS WELL AS INSIDE THE U.S. HOWEVER, THE NEW YORK FACILITY WAS THAT RECOMMENDED BY SHAH'S PHYSICIAN, AND WE HAVE FOLLOWED HIS RECOMMENDATION. NO U.S. GOVERNMENT FACILITIES ARE INVOLVED.

REGARDING YAZDI REQUEST FOR AN IRANIAN DOCTOR TO BE ALLOWED TO CONFIRM THE VALIDITY OF THE MEDICAL FINDINGS, WE ARE WILLING TO HAVE YOU SHARE ORALLY THEBASIC DETAILS OF THE PRELIMINARY DIAGNOSIS WHICH WILL BE SENT BY SEPTEL.

WITH REGARD TO PRIOR ASSURANCES FROM SHAH THAT HE WILL NOT ENGAGE IN POLITICAL ACTIVITIES, WE HAVE PREPARED PRESS GUIDANCE WHICH MEETS GOI DESIRES AND HAVE INFORMED SHAH'S REPRESENTATIVES IN THIS REGARD. YOU SHOULD SHARE PRESS GUIDANCE WITH GOI AS SOON AS POSSIBLE STRESSING ITS INTENTION TO MAKE EXTREMELY CLEAR THAT FORMER SHAH'S VISIT HAS NO RPT NO POLITICAL SIGNIFICANCE. (FYI: WE DO NOT PLAN TO PUBLICIZE VISIT, AND GUIDANCE WILL BE USED ONLY IF VISIT BECOMES KNOWN PUBLICLY.)

CONTINGENCY PRESS GUIDANCE: THE FOLLOWING IS ONLY FOR REPLIES TO QUESTIONS: QUESTION: IS THE SHAH OF IRAN COMING TO THE UNITED STATES? ANSWER: YES. ON THE RECOMMENDATION OF EUROPEAN AND AMERICAN DOCTORS TREATING THE FORMER SHAH OF IRAN, THE USG ON HUMANITARIAN GROUNDS HAS AGREED TO HIS COMING TO THE UNITED STATES FOR DIAGNOSIS AND EVALUATION OF HIS MEDICAL CONDITION. QUESTION: WHAT IS THE NATURE OF THE SHAH'S ILLNESS?

ANSWER: I AM NOT IN A POSITION TO GO INTO THIS, OTHER THAN TO SAY THAT THERE HAS BEEN A SIGNIFICANT DETERIORATION IN HIS HEALTH IN RECENT DAYS AND THE JUDGMENT OF DOCTORS WHO HAVE EXAMINED HIM IS THAT HE REQUIRES IMMEDIATE HOSPITALIZATION IN THE U.S. WHERE SPECIAL DIAGNOSTIC AND TREATMENT FACILITIES ARE AVAILABLE. QUESTION: HAVE YOU BEEN IN TOUCH WITH THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT TO INFORM THEM OF HIS TRAVEL HERE? ANSWER: YES. I AM NOT IN A POSITION TO REVEAL THE CONTENT OF OUR DIPLOMATIC DISCUSSIONS. QUESTION: HAVE YOU BEEN IN TOUCH WITH THE MEXICAN GOVERNMENT? ANSWER: YES. I HAVE NOTHING FURTHER ON THAT.

QUESTION: WHY DOES HE HAVE TO COME TO THE U.S.? ISN'T TREATMENT AVAILABLE ELSEWHERE? ANSWER: THE MEDICAL JUDGMENT IS THAT HE REQUIRES THE MEDICAL FACILITIES AVAILABLE HERE. QUESTION: HOW LONG UILL HE STAY HERE? ANSWER: THAT DEPENDS ON THE EVALUATION OF HIS MEDICAL CONDITION. QUESTION: WHAT DOES "HUMANITARIAN GROUNDS" MEAN? ANSWER: HIS TRIP TO THE U.S. IS BASED ON HIS MEDICAL NEEDS. IT HAS NO POLITICAL SIGNIFICANCE. QUESTION: YOU CALLED HIM THE FORMER SHAH. WHAT DOES THAT MEAN? ANSWER: HE IS COMING HERE AS A PRIVATE CITIZEN. AS WE HAVE PREVIOUSLY STATED, THE U.S. POSITION IS THAT HE NO LONGER HAS A CLAIM TO AUTHORITY IN IRAN.

WE MAINTAIN RELATIONS WITH THE NEW GOVERNMENT IN IRAN, FULLY ACKNOWLEDGE ITS AUTHORITY AND SUPPORT ITS EFFORTS TO MAINTAIN IRAN'S INDEPENDENCE AND INTEGRITY. QUESTION: DO YOU ANTICIPATE THAT THE SHAH WILL SEEK TO ENGAGE IN ANY POLITICAL ACTIVITY WHILE IN THE U.S.? ANSWER: IT IS CLEARLY UNDERSTOOD HE IS COMING HERE FOR MEDICAL PURPOSES. WE WOULD EXPECT THAT HE WOULD NOT ENGAGE IN ANY POLITICAL ACTIVITIES WHILE IN THE UNITED STATES. QUESTION: IS THE SHAHBANU COMING WITH HIM? ANSWER: YES. QUESTION: CAN YOU GIVE ME ANY DETAILS ON THE TRAVEL ARRANGEMENTS? ANSWER: NO.
FYI: WE CURRENTLY ANTICIPATE THAT SHAH WILL BE ARRIVING IN U.S. AS EARLY AS TOMORROW AFTERNOON, OCTOBER 22. EMBASSY SHOULD PLAN ON THIS BASIS WITH REGARD TO ITS SECURITY ARRANGEMENTS.

WE WILL BE INFORMING THE IRANIAN EMBASSY HERE, OCTOBER 26, OF THE ABOVE AND OFFERING TO SET UP A MEETING AS SOON AS THEY DESIRE BETWEEN OUR DEPARTMENT OF STATE MEDICAL AUTHORITIES AND THE TUO IRANIAN DOCTORS TO SET THESE ARRANGEMENTS IN MOTION.

IRANIAN EMBASSY REPS DR. FARHANG AND AVA (PRESS OFFICER) MET WITH DEPTOFF OCTOBER 26 TO PURSUE QUESTION OF TWO IRANIAN DOCTORS RESIDENT IN U.S. PROPOSED BY GOI OBTAINING INFORMATION CONCERNING THE STATE OF HEALTH OF THE SHAH.

DEPTOFF INFORMED FARHANG AND AVA THAT USG WILLING TO DEAL WITH DOCTORS PROPOSED BY GOI AND HANDED FARHANG SEALED ENVELOPES FOR THE TWO DOCTORS (CONTAINING INFO PREVIOUSLY PASSED TO YAZDI AND NEW YORK HOSPITAL OCTOBER 25 MEDICAL BULLETIN). DEPTOFF TOLD FARHANG THAT IF DOCTORS HAD ANY FURTHER QUESTIONS THEY COULD CONTACT DEPT. MEDICAL DIRECTOR, WHO WOULD ACT AS CHANNEL FOR TRANSMISSION OF QUESTIONS AND ANSWERS BETWEEN THEM AND DOCTORS IN NEW YORK.

MEETING WITH FARHANG WAS FRIENDLY IN TONE. FARHANG MADE NO SPECIFIC COMMENT ON WHETHER PROCEDURE WOULD FULFILL GOI NEEDS, BUT HIS GENERAL REMARKS WERE POSITIVE AND CENTERED ON THE NECESSITY FOR THE GOI TO BE SEEN TO BE DOING SOMETHING ABOUT THE SHAH BEING IN THE U.S. FARHANG ASKED WHETHER GOI HAD BEEN INFORMED IN TEHRAN AND WAS TOLD EMBASSY HAD INSTRUCTIONS TO INFORM MFA AND WOULD AT THE LATEST DISCUSS MATTER WITH FONMIN YAZDI OCTOBER 27.

FARHANG MADE POINT THAT EMOTIONS RUN HIGH AMONG IRANIANS CONCERNING THE SHAH, AND CITED AS EXAMPLE DEMAND BY IRANIAN EMBASSY STAFF HERE THAT EMBASSY BE CLOSED OCTOBER 26 SO THEY COULD DEMONSTRATE IN FRONT OF EMBASSY AGAINST THE SHAH'S PRESENCE IN THE U.S.

FARHANG AND AVA RAISED PRESS STORIES INDICATING THAT THE SHAH WOULD NEED TREATMENT IN THE U.S. FOR A YEAR. DEPTOFF URGED THAT THEY NOT JUMP TO CONCLUSIONS ON BASIS OF PRESS STORIES. LENGTH OF SHAH'S STAY WOULD BE BASED ON MEDICAL NEEDS, TO BE DETERMINED IN DUE COURSE BY COMPETENT MEDICAL EXPERTS. DEPTOFF TOLD FARHANG THAT IT WAS HIS UNDERSTANDING THAT MEDICAL EXPERTS WERE NOT YET IN A POSITION TO MAKE SUCH DETERMINATION, AND THAT FURTHER TESTS WOULD BE REQUIRED.
AVA ASKED ABOUT SHAH'S PASSPORT AND WAS INFORMED THAT PASSPORT REQUIREMENT HAD BEEN WAIVED IN ACCORDANCE WITH PROVISIONS OF U.S. IMMIGRATION LAWS. DEPTOFF EXPLAINED THAT SUCH WAIVER WAS NOT UNUSUAL.

THE TWO U.S. RESIDENT IRANIAN DOCTORS CONTACTED DEPARTMENT'S MEDICAL DIRECTOR LATER ON OCTOBER 26. THEY REQUESTED TO (A) EXAMINE SHAH, AND (B) REVIEW RELEVANT MEDICAL RECORDS AND PATHOLOGICAL MATERIAL IN ORDER TO MAKE AN AUTHORITATIVE REPORT. IN PARALLEL DISCUSSION WITH DEPTOFF, HOWEVER, IRANIAN EMBASSY OFFICER DID NOT REPEAT NOT REQUEST EXAMINATION OF SHAH, ONLY REVIEW OF MEDICAL RECORDS BY THE DOCTOR;.

FYI: MEDICAL DIRECTOR IS FORARDING REQUEST FOR MATERIALS IN (B) TO SHAH'S DOCTORS IN NEW YORK BUT, IS NOT REPEAT NOT FORUARDING REQUEST TO EXAMINE THE SHAH, SINCE THAT IS OBVIOUSLY INAPPROPRIATE AS WELL AS BEING WELL BEYOND OUR PROPOSAL IN REFTEL. END FYI.

ALTHOUGH WE RECOGNIZE THE IMPORTANCE OF DOING WHAT WE CAN TO MODERATE THE PGOI REACTION TO THE SHAH'S HOSPITALIZATION IN U.S., WE ARE ALSO DETERMINED TO AVOID ACTION WHICH WOULD IN ANY WAY INFRINGE ON THE MEDICAL OR PERSONAL RIGHTS OF THE SHAH AND HIS FAMILY. WE CANNOT ENTERTAIN THE POSSIBILITY OF AN EXAMINATION OF THE SHAH BY IRANIAN DOCTORS UNLESS REQUESTED BY SHAH OR HIS FAMILY. WE BELIEVE THE BEST APPROACH IS THE ONE WE HAVE FOLLOWED THUS FAR, I.E. FACTUAL BRIEFINGS OF IRANIAN OFFICIALS TO INSURE THAT THEY RECOGNIZE THE SERIOUSNESS OF THE CASE.

BECAUSE OF THE SERIOUS POLITICAL IMPLICATIONS, THE PRIVATE U.S. MEDICAL AUTHORITIES IN CHARGE OF THE CASE HAVE AGREED TO MEET DIRECTLY WITH THE TWO IRANIAN PHYSICIANS NOMINATED BY THE PGOI. THIS MEETING WILL TAKE PLACE ON AFTERNOON OF OCTOBER 30 IN NEW YORK. AT SPECIFIC REQUEST OF THE U.S. PRIVATE MEDICAL AUTHORITIES, WE ARE HOLDING THE MEETING UNDER USG AUSPICES AT THE USUN BUILDING WITH THE DEPARTMENT'S MEDICAL ADVISOR PRESENT.

WE WISH TO ALERT YOU TO THIS MEETING AND TO ASK YOU TO CONVEY FOLLOWING POINTS TO YAZDI. WE BELIEVE IT IMPORTANT FOR YOU TO MAKE THESE POINTS PRIOR TO THE DOCTORS' MEETING IN ORDER TO MAKE OUR VIEWS KNOWN TO GOI AND TRY TO ACHIEVE THEIR UNDERSTANDING ON THIS ISSUE. WE BELIEVE IT IMPORTANT TO CONVEY OUR VIEWS DIRECTLY TO GOI, SINCE WE CANNOT PREDICT THE IRANIAN DOCTORS' ATTITUDES OR ACTIONS FOLLOWING THEIR OCTOBER 30 MEETING. WE ALSO HAVE RECEIVED NOTE TODAY FROM IRANIAN EMBASSY HERE SUGGESTING THAT U.S.

EMBASSY TEHRAN HAS AGREED THAT IRANIAN DOCTORS WOULD BE ALLOWED TO EXAMINE THE SHAH, WHICH IS CONTRARY TO OUR POSITION AND THEREFORE UNDOUBTEDLY A MISINTERPRETATION OF INSTRUCTIONS YOU CONVEYED TO GOI.
REQUEST YOU CONVEY FOLLOWING TO YAZDI AS SOON AS POSSIBLE AND PRIOR TO DOCTORS' MEETING

MEETING IS TAKING PLACE OCTOBER 30 BETWEEN THE TWO U.S. RESIDENT IRANIAN DOCTORS SUGGESTED BY GOI AND THE PRIVATE AMERICAN MEDICAL AUTHORITIES TREATING THE FORMER SHAH. DEPARTMENT'S MEDICAL ADVISER WILL ALSO BE PRESENT AT MEETING.

GIVEN FACT THAT SHAH IS HERE UNDER PRIVATE NON-USG AUSPICES USG IS GOING TO UNUSUAL LENGTHS TO MEET THE GOI REQUESTS REGARDING THIS MATTER. GOI SHOULD RECOGNIZE THAT, UNDER U.S. MEDICAL PRACTICE AND LAW THE PATIENT AND FAMILY ARE THE ARBITERS OF THE RELEASE OF MEDICAL INFORMATION. WE HAVE NEVERTHELESS PERSUADED PHYSICIANS TO BE FORTHCOMING WITH REGARD TO SHARING FINDINGS ON A PROFESSIONAL BASIS WITH THE TWO IRANIAN PHYSICIANS BUT GOI SHOULD RECOGNIZE THERE ARE LIMITS TO WHAT WE CAN DO. FOR INSTANCE, IT MUST BE UNDERSTOOD THAT WE ARE OBLIGED TO HONOR THE REQUEST OF THE FAMILY THAT THERE NOT BE A DIRECT EXAMINATION OF THE PATIENT.

SHORT OF THAT,WE ARE ENCOURAGING THE EMINENT AMERICAN DOCTORS RESPONSIBLE FOR THE TREATMENT TO BE FRANK AND FORTHCOMING IN SHARING ON A PROFESSIONAL BASIS WITH THE IRANIAN DOCTORS THE NATURE OF THE MEDICAL CONDITION AND TREATMENT.
WE BELIEVE THIS IS AN IMPORTANT GESTURE OF GOOD WILL ON OUR PART AND WE HOPE THAT GOI WILL RECOGNIZE IT AS SUCH AND RECIPROCATE OUR ATTITUDE IN HANDLING THIS MATTER.

SHAH'S PHYSICIANS HAVE INFORMED US THAT OCTO0ER 29 NEWS LEAK OF PLANNED OCTOBER 30 MEETING BETWEEN SHAH'S PHYSICIANS AND IRANIAN DOCTORS HAS CAUSED SHAH'S FAMILY TO WITHDRAW EARLIER OFFER AS OUTLINED REFTEL TO MEET WITH IRANIAN DOCTORS IN PRESENCE OF DEPARTMENT'S MEDICAL DIRECTOR. SHAH'S DOCTORS WERE WILLING TO HAVE DEPARTMENT'S MEDICAL DIRECTOR SERVE AS GO-BETUEEN IN PROXIMITY TALKS BUT IRANIAN DOCTORS DID NOT ACCEPT THIS OFFER AND ARE INSISTING ON DIRECT CONTACT UITH SHAH'S DOCTORS.

WE HAVE NOT LOCATED PRECISE STORY YET BUT ASSUME THAT U.S. PRESS INFORMED SHAH'S PARTY OF LEAK FROM IRANIAN EMBASSY.
IN MEETING WITH IRANIAN CHARGE ON OCTOBER 30, UNDER SECRETARY NEWSOM MADE THE FOLLOWING POINTS, WHICH YOU SHOULD ALSO MAKE TO PGOI FOREIGN MINISTRY

WE HAD HOPED TO BE ABLE TO FACILITATE PLANNED OCTOBER 30 MEETING BETWEEN SHAH'S PHYSICIANS AND IRANIAN DOCTORS IN PRESENCE OF DEPARTMENT'S MEDICAL ADVISOR. HOWEVER, WE NOW UNDERSTAND THAT THIS MATTER WAS REVEALED TO THE PRESS. AS A RESULT, WE HAVE BEEN INFORMED BY THE SHAH'S PHYSICIANS THAT THIS HAS CAUSED SHAH'S FAMILY TO CANCEL EARLIER OFFER TO HAVE ABOVE-MENTIONED MEETING AND THAT IRANIAN PHYSICIANS WERE UNWILLING, AS AN ALTERNATIVE, TO SEEK RELEVANT MEDICAL INFORMATION BY TRANSMITTAL THROUGH THE DEPARTMENT OF STATE MEDICAL AUTHORITIES.

WE REMAIN NEVERTHELESS WILLING TO TRANSMIT WRITTEN QUESTIONS FROM THE IRANIAN DOCTORS TO SHAH'S PHYSICIANS FOR THEIR REPLY OR HAVE DEPARTMENT'S MEDICAL AUTHORITIES SERVE AS GO-BETWEEN SHOULD PGOI DESIRE TO PURSUE THIS COURSE.

SHAH IS HERE AS A PRIVATE CITIZEN, IS IN PRIVATE MEDICAL HANDS, AND THERE ARE NO U.S. GOVERNMENTAL FACILITIES INVOLVED. WE ARE WILLING TO FACILITATE TRANSMITTAL OF APPROPRIATE MEDICAL INFORMATION BUT THERE ARE LIMITATIONS IN LAW AND PRACTICE AS TO WHAT U.S. CAN DO IN THIS MATTER.

FYI: WE RECOGNIZE THAT ALTERNATIVE OF SUBMITTING WRITTEN QUESTIONS MAY BE UNACCEPTABLE TO THE IRANIANS BUT WE WISH TO MAINTAIN THE POSSIBILITY OF KEEPING OPEN A MEDICAL DIALOGUE BETWEEN THE TWO PARTIES, SHOULD THAT BE THEIR DESIRE. END FYI.

segments.text: THE FOLLOWING IS A WHITE HOUSE PRESS RELEASE: THE SEIZURE OF MORE THAN 60 AMERICANS IN OUR EMBASSY IN TEHRAN HAS PROVOKED STRONG FEELINGS HERE AT HOME. THERE IS OUTRAGE. THERE IS FRUSTRATION. AND THERE IS DEEP ANGER. THERE IS ALSO PRIDE IN THE COURAGE OF THOSE WHO ARE IN DANGER AND SYMPATHY FOR THEM AND FOR THEIR FAMILIES. BUT THE MOST IMPORTANT CONCERN FOR ALL AMERICANS AT THIS MOMENT IS SAFETY OF OUR FELLOW CITIZENS HELD IN TEHRAN. THE PRESIDENT SHARES THESE FEELINGS. HE IS PURSUING EVERY POSSIBLE AVENUE IN A SITUATION THAT IS EXTREMELY VOLATILE AND DIFFICULT. HIS EFFORTS INVOLVE MANY COUNTRIES AND INDIVIDUALS.

MANY OF THESE EFFORTS MUST OF NECESSITY BE CONDUCTED WITHOUT PUBLICITY, AND ALL REQUIRE THE CALMEST POSSIBLE ATMOSPHERE. THE PRESIDENT KNOWS THAT NO MATTER HOW DEEPLY WE MAY FEEL, NONE OF US WOULD WANT TO DO ANYTHING THAT WOULD WORSEN THE DANGER IN WHICH OUR FELLOW AMERICANS HAVE BEEN PLACED. HE CALLS ON ALL AMERICANS, PUBLIC OFFICIALS AND PRIVATE CITIZENS ALIKE, TO EXERCISE RESTRAINT, AND TO KEEP THE SAFETY OF THEIR COUNTRYMEN UPPERMOST IN THEIR MINDS AND HEARTS. MEMBERS OF THE FAMILIES OF THE AMERICAN HOSTAGES WITH WHOM THE PRESIDENT MET THIS MORNING HAVE ASKED TO JOIN WITH HIM IN THIS APPEAL.
THE PRESIDENT EXPECTS EVERY AMERICAN TO REFRAIN FROM ANY ACTION THAT MIGHT INCREASE THE DANGER TO THE AMERICAN HOSTAGES IN

segments.text: THE FOLLOWING IS STATEMENT OF FAMILIES OF HOSTAGES: WE ARE A NUMBER OF THE FAMILIES OF THE HOSTAGES WHO ARE CURRENTLY BEING HELD AT THE AMERICAN EMBASSY IN TEHRAN. THIS MORNING WE MET WITH PRESIDENT CARTER AND SECRETARY VANCE, WHO ASSURED US THAT EVERYTHING POSSIBLE IS BEING DONE TO SECURE THE RELEASE OF OUR LOVED ONES. WE FULLY SUPPORT THEIR CALM AND FIRM DIPLOMATIC EFFORTS. MEMBERS OF THE FAMILIES HAVE BEEN RECEIVING CALLS FROM RELATIVES AND CONCERNED FRIENDS FROM ALL OVER THE WORLD. FROM THEM, WE HAVE LEARNED THAT THIS HAS BECOME AN AMERICAN CRISIS WHICH TOUCHES US ALL. THEREFORE, LET'S SOLVE THIS CRISIS THE AMERICAN WAY.

DESPITE THE FRUSTRATIONS AND ANGER WE ALL NOW SHARE, WE STRONGLY URGE THAT YOU COMMIT NO ACT THAT MIGHT LOWER AMERICAN DIGNITY. WE WANT NOTHING DONE WHICH WILL JEOPARDIZE THE SAFETY OF THE HOSTAGES. THE GREATEST SUPPORT YOU CAN GIVE THE HOSTAGES AND US, THEIR FAMILIES IS YOUR PRAYERS. WE BELIEVE THAT THE POWER OF PRAYER IS THE TREMENDOUS FORCE THAT UNITES THE WORLD. 1979STATE294955.subject: PRESIDENT CARTER STATEMENT ANNOUNCING OF REMOVING OIL AS AN ISSUE IN OUR EFFORTS TO FREE AMERICAN HOSTAGES

segments.text: TO: U.S. CHARGE BRUCE LAINGEN FROM: IRAN WORKING GROUP YOU MAY INFORM IRANIAN FOREIGN MINISTRY OFFICIALS NO EARLIER THAN 1800 GMT OF FOLLOWING.

AT 1400 EST TODAY, PRESIDENT CARTER WILL MAKE A STATEMENT, ANNOUNCING THAT, IN THE INTEREST OF REMOVING OIL AS AN ISSUE IN OUR EFFORTS TO FREE THE AMERICAN HOSTAGES HELD IN IRAN, HE IS ORDERING THAT WE DISCONTINUE PURCHASING OIL FROM IRAN FOR IMPORTATION INTO THE UNITED STATES. THIS IS INTENDED TO EMPHASIZE THAT THE ISSUES AT STAKE ARE THE FUNDAMENTAL INTERNATIONAL PRINCIPLES OF THE SAFETY OF OUR CITIZENS ABROAD, THE PREVENTION OF THE USE OF HOSTAGES FOR POLITICAL PURPOSES AND RESPECT FOR DIPLOMATIC PERSONNEL.

THE PRESIDENT WILL ALSO STRESS THAT, BY THIS MEASURE, WE WILL DEMONSTRATE THE READINESS OF THE UNITED STATES TO MAKE SACRIFICES IN RESPONDING TO SITUATIONS OF THE KIND WE CURRENTLY FACE IN IRAN. HE WILL POINT OUT THAT THIS, ONCE AGAIN, SHOWS THE NEED FOR THE UNITEDSTATESTO REDUCE ITS DEPENDENCE ON FOREIGN OIL SUPPLIES.

THE STATEMENT SPEAKS FOR ITSELF. AT A TIME WHEN SERIOUS PROBLEMS EXIST BETWEEN US AND WHEN EFFORTS TO RESOLVE THOSE PROBLEMS HAVE NOT, SO FAR, SUCCEEDED IT IS IMPORTANT THAT THE ISSUES TO BE RESOLVED ARE CLEAR. THIS STEP IN NO WAY DIMINISHES OUR DESIRE TO RESOLVE THE ISSUES BETWEEN US IN A MANNER CONSISTENT WITH EQUALITY, MUTUAL RESPECT, AND INDEPENDENCE OF BOTH COUNTRIES.

OUR PURPOSE IS TO REMOVE OIL FROM THE US-IRANIAN AGENDA TO MAKE CLEAR THAT THE SOLE ISSUES TO BE ADDRESSED IN THE CURRENT SITUATION ARE THE PRACTICE OF HOLDING INNOCENT PEOPLE HOSTAGE, THEIR SAFE AND PROMPT RELEASE, AND RESPECT FOR THE PRINCIPLES OF DIPLOMATIC IMMUNITY AND INTERNATIONAL ORDER.

TO: U.S. CHARGE BRUCE LAINGEN FROM: IRAN WORKING GROUP WE HAVE INFORMED THE RELATIVES OF THE HOSTAGES THAT LETTERS FROM THEM WOULD BE PASSED ON TO THE COMPOUND THROUGH THE FOREIGN MINISTRY. LETTERS WILL BE ADDRESSED AS FOLLOWS NAME OF HOSTAGE IWG - TEHRAN P.O. BOX 2976

WASHINGTON, D.C. 20013 OUR INTENTION IS TO HAVE THE LETTERS FLOWN OUT BY THE BEST AVAILABLE MEANS TO TEHRAN EACH DAY (PRESUMABLY SWISSAIR AND LUFTHANSA). WE ARE UNSURE ON BEST METHOD OF GETTING THE BAG CONTAINING THESE LETTERS TO THE FOREIGN MINISTRY FROM THE AIRPORT. OUR THINKING AT THIS TIME IS TO PLACE THE BAG IN CHARGE OF THE AIRLINE CAPTAIN AND ASK HIM TO TURN IT OVER TO THE AIRLINE REPRESENTATIVE IN TEHRAN. WOULD APPRECIATE YOUR ADVICE ON WHETHER IT WOULD BE POSSIBLE FOR THE AIRLINE REPRESENTATIVE TO BRING IT TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF OF PROTOCOL FOR IMMEDIATE FORWARDING TO THE HOSTAGES ON THE COMPOUND.
IF FOREIGN MINISTRY WOULD PREFER TO HAVE ONE ITS PEOPLE RECEIVE THE BAG DIRECTLY AT THE AIRPORT WE COULD SO NOTIFY THE CARRIER. PLEASE ADVISE. VANCE

segments.text: TO: U.S. CHARGE BRUCE LAINGEN FROM: IRAN WORKING GROUP THIS IS DEPARTMENT MESSAGE NUMBER TWO. PLEASE ACKNOWLEDGE RECEIPT.

MR. CLARK EXPECTS TO DEPART INSTANBUL SOMETIME THURSDAY MORNING. WE DO NOT YET HAVE EXACT PARTICULARS OF HIS DEPARTURE OR ARRIVAL TIMES. THERE IS STRONG MEDIA INTEREST.

WE ARE TRYING TO REESTABLISH CONTACT BY PHONE WITH YOU. PLEASE CALL US IF YOU CAN. VANCE
(C) ENTIRE TEXT.

WE ANTICIPATE THERE WILL BE A NUMBER OF JOURNALISTS AT ANDREWS TO MEET YOU ON ARRIVAL. WE SUGGEST THAT YOU TAKE THE FOLLOWING LINE IN YOUR REMARKS TO THEM: : I AM RETURNING TO THE U.S. TO REVIEW DEVELOPMENTS SINCE MY DEPARTURE OVER A WEEK AGO. WE NATURALLY REGRET THAT THE AUTHORITIES IN IRAN CHANGED THEIR POSITION ON RECEIVING US. I REMAIN READY AND EAGER TO DO WHAT I CAN TO ASSIST IN THIS CONTINUING EFFORT. segments.text: TO: U.S. CHARGE BRUCE LAINGEN FROM: IRAN WORKING GROUP THIS IS MESSAGE NO. 5. PLEASE ACKNOWLEDGE RECEIPT.

WE UNDERSTAND THEY WILL BE TURNED OVER TO THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS FOR ARRANGEMENTS TO BE MADE FOR THEIR TRAVEL OUTSIDE OF IRAN. WE NEED URGENTLY TO KNOW THE NUMBERS OF PEOPLE INVOLVED AND PREFERABLY THEIR NAMES. WE ALSO NEED TO KNOW WHAT ARRANGEMENTS FOR ONWARD TRAVEL THE FOREIGN MINISTRY WOULD FIND SUITABLE. THIS IS AN ENCOURAGING DEVELOPMENT. WE HOPE THAT IT WILL BE FOLLOWED SOON BY OTHER STEPS WHICH WILL LEAD TO THE RELEASE OF ALL OF THE HOSTAGES. WE HAVE BEEN TRYING TO TELEPHONE THE FOREIGN MINISTRY BUT HAVE BEEN UNABLE TO GET THROUGH OWING TO DIFFICULTIES WITH THE LINE. WE WILL CONTINUE TO TRY TO REACH THEM IN ORDER TO WORK OUT DETAILED ARRANGEMENTS FOR DEPARTURE OF THE HOSTAGES. VANCE

1979STATE300259.subject: STATEMENT BY THE WHITE HOUSE OF RELEASE OF THREE HOSTAGES

segments.text: TO .S. CHARGE BRUCE LAINGEN FROM: IRAN WORKING GROUP
THE FOLLOWING STATEMENT WAS RELEASED BY THE WHITE HOUSE AT 07:15 A.M. (EST), NOVEMBER 19, 1979
THREE OF OUR HOSTAGES IN TEHRAN HAVE BEEN RELEASED AND HAVE LEFT IRAN. AFTER A BRIEF PERIOD OF REST AND CARE, THEY WILL BE REUNITED WITH THEIR FAMILIES HERE IN THE UNITED STATES.

THE RELEASE OF THE REMAINING HOSTAGES REMAINS OF CRITICAL IMPORTANCE. THEIR DETENTION IS WITHOUT JUSTIFICATION. THE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN IS RESPONSIBLE FOR ACHIEVING THEIR IMMEDIATE SAFE RELEASE AND THE UNITED STATES HAS THE RIGHT TO EXPECT THAT IRAN WILL DO SO.

THE SPECTOR HAS BEEN RAISED OF OTHER AMERICAN DIPLOMATIC HOSTAGES BEING PLACED ON TRIAL. SUCH A STEP WOULD BE A FLAGRANT VIOLATION OF ELEMENTARY HUMAN RIGHTS, RELIGIOUS PRECEPTS AND INTERNATIONAL LAW AND PRACTICE.
WORLDWIDE OUTRAGE AT THE DETENTION OF THE HOSTAGES WOULD BE GREATLY HEIGHTENED BY ANY ATTEMPT TO PUT DIPLOMATIC PERSONNEL ON TRIAL.
THIS IS MESSAGE NO. 10. VANCE

segments.text: THIS IS MESSAGE NUMBER 9. PLEASE CONFIRM RECEIPT.

OUR EMBASSY IN ISLAMABAD HAS BEEN TAKEN OVER BY A MOB WHICH MAY HAVE BEEN SPARKED BY FALSE REPEAT FALSE REPORTS OF U.S. INVOLVEMENT IN AN INCIDENT YESTERDAY IN MECCA. IN THAT INCIDENT A GROUP OF MUSLIMS TOOK OVER THE GRAND MOSQUE AND BARRICADED THEMSELVES INSIDE. IT IS ABSOLUTELY ESSENTIAL THAT IRANIAN AUTHORITIES PERMIT NO REPEAT NO FURTHER SUCH FALSE REPORTS TO BE BROADCAST OR PUBLISHED IN IRAN. THE U.S. HAD NO REPEAT NO INVOLVEMENT IN THAT INCIDENT IN ANY WAY AND ANY REPORT TO THE CONTRARY COULD DANGEROUSLY INFLAME ALREADY DIFFICULT SITUATION IN TEHRAN. FOR YOUR INFORMATION, TEHRAN RADIO QUOTES STATEMENT ISSUED BY IMAM KHOMEINI'S OFFICE IN QOM TODAY WHICH INCLUDES FOLLOWING SENTENCE: "IT IS NOT FARFETCHED TO ASSUME THAT THIS ACT HAS BEEN PERPETRATED BY THE CRIMINAL AMERICAN IMPERIALISM SO THAT IT CAN INFILTRATE THE SOLID RANKS OF MUSLIMS BY SUCH INTRIGUES."

1979STATE302160.subject: TEXT OF STATEMENT ISSUED BY SAUDI GOVERNMENT ON 20 NOVEMBER

segments.text: TO: U.S. CHARGE BRUCE LAINGEN FROM; IRAN WORKING GROUP
THIS IS MESSAGE NO. 10. YOUR MESSAGES NUMBERS 32 AND 33 RECEIVED MORNING OF 21 NOVEMBER.

FOLLOWING IS TEXT OF STATEMENT ISSUED BY SAUDI GOVERNMENT ON 20 NOVEMBER: A BAND OF RENEGADES TO THE ISLAMIC RELIGION SEIZED THE OPPORTUNITY OF THE DAWN PRAYERS ON TUESDAY, THE FIRST OF MUHARRAM 1400 TO INFILTRATE THE AL-HARAM MOSQUE. THEY HAD WITH THEM WEAPONS AND AMMUNITION. THEY PRESENTED ONE OF THEIR MEMBERS TO THE CROWDS OF MUSLIMS INSIDE THE AL-HARAM MOSQUE IN THE HOLY CITY OF MECCA TO LEAD THE DOWN PRAYERS CLAIMING THAT HE WAS THE PROMISED MAHDI (MESSIAH). THEY CALLED ON THE MUSLIMS IN THE AL-HARAM MOSQUE TO ACKNOWLEDGE HIM IN THIS CAPACITY UNDER THE THREAT OF THE ARMS THEY WERE CARRYING.

HOWEVER, THE AUTHORITIES HAVE TAKEN ALL NECESSARY MEASURES AND HAVE BROUGHT THE SITUATION UNDER CONTROL IN ACCORDANCE WITH A FATEWA (RELIGIOUS DEGREE) BY THE ULEMA. MEASURES HAVE BEEN TAKEN TO PROTECT THE LIVES OF THE MUSLIMS WHO ARE INSIDE THE AL-HARAM MOSQUE. THE MINISTRY OF INTERIOR WILL, GOD WILLING, ISSUE A SUBSEQUENT STATEMENT EXPLAINING THE DEVELOPMENT OF THIS SITUATION.
WE WILL PROVIDE TEXT OF LATER STATEMENT AS SOON AS WE RECEIVE IT.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT) PLEASE PASS FOLLOWING MESSAGE TO YOUR TEHRAN EMBASSY.

IN RESPONSE TO YOUR QUERY, OUTGOING CALLS ARE INDICATED ON THE EMBASSY'S CENTRAL SWITCHBOARD. INDICATOR LIGHTS ARE LABELLED BY EXTENSION NUMBER INSOME CASES. HOWEVER, MONITORING A CALL WOULD REQUIRE A SOPHISTICATED KNOWLEDGE OF OUR EMBASSY SWITCHBOARD WHICH WE WOULD NOT EXPECT STUDENT OPERATORS TO HAVE. TRACING THE CALL TO THE RECIPIENT WOULD NOT BE POSSIBLE FROM THE ENBASSY; IT IS POSSIBLE WE UNDERSTAND FROM THE LOCAL PTT EXCHANGE.

GIVEN THE PERSONAL DANGER TO SUBIC, AND VIRTUAL CERTAINTY OF DISTORTION IN THE EVENT HIS CALLS ARE MONITORED, WE BELIEVE FURTHER CALLS SHOULD BE STRONGLY DISCOURAGED. IF HE IS ABLE TO CALL AGAIN WE WOULD APPRECIATE YOUR ASKING HIM WHERE HE IS AND IF HE KNOWS WHERE ANY OF THE OTHERS ARE. THEN WE SUGGEST YOU EXPLAIN THAT THE RISKS TO HIM DO NOT JUSTIFY FURTHER CALLS EXCEPT IN AN EXTREME EMERGENCY (A HOSTAGE IS KILLED, FOR EXAMPLE).
IF LINE ON WHICH SUBIC TELEPHONED IS NOT MONITORED MORE OR LESS CONTINUOUSLY, COULD YOU GIVE HIM A NUMBER TO CALL IN EXTREMIS?

1979STATE304140.subject: STATEMENT BY SAUDI MINISTER OF INTERIOR THAT NEITHER THE UNITED STATES, IRAN NOR ANY OTHER COUNTRIES HAVE HAD ANYTHING TO DO WITH THE ATTACK ON THE HOLY KABBA

segments.text: TO : BRUCE LAINGEN FROM: IRAN WORKING GROUP THIS IS MESSAGE NO. 14. ACKNOWLEDGE RECEIPT.

THE SAUDI MINISTER OF INTERIOR ISSUED A STATEMENT NOVEMBER 22 THAT "NEITHER THE UNITED STATES, IRAN, NOR ANY OTHER COUNTRIES HAVE HAD ANYTHING TO DO WITH THE ATTACK ON THE HOLY KABBA. NEWS REPORTS ALLEGING U. S. INVOLVEMENT IN THE INCIDENT WERE ABSOLUTELY UNTRUE AND BASELESS. THERE ARE NO SUCH INDICATIONS OF U. S. INVOLVEMENT." THE MINISTER ALSO SAID, "NEWS AGENCY REPORTS CLAIMING THAT THE ASSAILANTS WERE IRANIAN WERE ALSO ABSOLUTELY FALSE. THE ATTACKERS WERE NEITHER PRO-IRANIAN NOR FROM ANY OTHER NATIONALITY. NOR WERE THEY A POLITICALLY MOTIVATED GROUP. IT IS ALL A MATTER OF A CRIMINAL DEVIATION FROM THE CORRECT PATH OF ISLAM FAR FROM ANY POLITICS." CHRISTOPHER

1979STATE308433.subject: TEXTS OF PRESIDENT PRESS CONFERENCES HOSTAGES

segments.text: TO: U.S. CHARGE BRUCE LAINGEN FROM: IRAN WORKING GROUP

THIS IS OUR MESSAGE NO. 21. YOUR MESSAGE NO. 49 RECEIVED. FOLLOWING IS TEXT OF STATEMENT PRESIDENT CARTER READ TO NEWSMEN LAST EVENING TO OPEN HIS PRESS CONFERENCE: BEGIN : FOR THE LAST 24 DAYS OUR NATION'S CONCERN HAS BEEN FOCUSSED ON OUR FELLOW AMERICANS BEING HELD HOSTAGE IN IRAN. WE HAVE WELCOMED SOME OF THEM HOME TO THEIR FAMILIES AND THEIR FRIENDS. BUT WE WILL NOT REST NOR DEVIATE FROM OUR EFFORTS UNTIL ALL HAVE BEEN FREED FROM THEIR IMPRISONMENT AND THEIR ABUSE. WE HOLD THE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN FULLY RESPONSIBLE FOR THE WELL-BEING AND THE SAFE RETURN OF EVERY SINGLE PERSON.

I WANT THE AMERICAN PEOPLE TO UNDERSTAND THE SITUATION AS MUCH AS POSSIBLE, BUT THERE MAY BE SOME QUESTIONS TONIGHT WHICH I CANNOT ANSWER FULLY BECAUSE OF MY CONCERN FOR THE WELL-BEING OF THE HOSTAGES. FIRST OF ALL, I WOULD LIKE TO SAY THAT I AM PROUD OF THIS GREAT NATION, AND I WANT TO THANK ALL AMERICANS FOR THEIR PRAYERS, THEIR COURAGE, THEI, PERSISTENCE, THEIR ST0ONG SUPPORT AND PATIENCE. DURING THESE PAST DAYS OUR NATIONAL WILL, OUR COURAGE, AND OUR MATURITY HAVE ALL BEEN SEVERELY TESTED AND HISTORY WILL SHOW THAT THE 'EOPLE OF THE UNITED STATES HAVE MET EVERY TEST.

IN THE DAYS TO COME OUR DETERMINATION MAY BE EVEN MORE SORELY TRIED BUT WE WILL CONTINUE TO DEFEND THE SECURITY, THE HONOR, AND THE FREEDOM OF AMERICAS EVERYWHERE. THIS NATION WILL NEVER YIELD TO BLACKMAIL. FOR ALL AMERICANS OUR CONSTANT CONCERN IS T;E WELL-BEING AND THE SAFETY OF OUR FELLOW CITIZENS WHO ARE BEING HELD ILLEGALLY AND IRRESPONSIBLY HOSTAGE IN IRAN. THE ACTIONS OF IRAN HAVE -HOCKED THE CIVILIZED WORLD. FOR A GOVERNMENT TO APPLAUD MOB VIOLENCE AND TERRORISM, FOR A GOVERNMENT ACTUALLY TO SUPPORT AND IN EFFECT PARTICIPATE IN THE TAKING AND THE HOLDING OF HOSTAGES IS UNPRECEDENTED IN HUMAN HISTORY.

THIS VIOLATES NOT ONLY THE MOST FUNDAMENTAL PRECEPTS OF INTERNATIONAL LAW, BUT THE COMMON ETHICAL AND RELIGIOUS HERITAGE OF HUMANITY. THERE IS NO RECOGNIZED RELIGIOUS FAITH ON EARTH WHICH CONDONES KIDNAPPING. THERE IS NO RECOGNIZED RELIGIOUS FAITH ON EARTH WHICH CONDONES BLACKMAIL. THERE IS CERTAINLY NO RELIGIOUS FAITH ON EARTH WHICH CONDONES THE SUSTAINED ABUSE OF INNOCENT PEOPLE. WE ARE DEEPLY CONCERNED ABOUT THE INHUMAN AND DEGRADING CONDITIONS IMPOSED ON THE HOSTAGES. FROM EVERY CORNER OF THE WORLD NATIONS AND PEOPLE HAVE VOICED THEIR STRONG REVULSION AND CONDEMNATION OF IRAN, AND HAVE JOINED US IN CALLING FOR THE RELEASE OF THE HOSTAGES.

LAST NIGHT A STATEMENT OF SUPPORT WAS RELEASED AND WAS ISSUED BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE UNITED NATIONS GENERAL ASSEMBLY, THE SECURITY COUNCIL, ON BEHALF OF ALL OF ITS MEMBERS. WE EXPECT A FURTHER SECURITY COUNCIL MEETING ON SATURDAY NIGHT, AT WHICH MORE FIRM AND OFFICIAL ACTION MAY BE TAKEN TO HELP IN OBTAINING THE RELEASE OF THE AMERICAN HOSTAGES. ANY CLAIMS RAISED BY GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS OF IRAN WILL RING HOLLOW WHILE THEY KEEP INNOCENT PEOPLE BOUND, AND ABUSED, AND THREATENED.

WE HOPE THAT THIS EXERCISE OF DIPLOMACY AND INTERNATIONAL LAW WILL BRING A PEACEFUL SOLUTION, BECAUSE A PEACEFUL SOLUTION IS PREFERABLE TO THE OTHER REMEDIES AVAILABLE TO THE UNITED STATES. AT THE SAME TIME, WE PURSUE SUCH A SOLUTION WITH GRIM DETERMINATION. THE GOVERNMENT OF I,AN MUST RECOGNIZE THE GRAVITY OF THE SITUATION WHIC; IT HAS ITSELF CREATED, AND THE GRAVE CONSEQUENCES WHICH UILL RESULT IF HARM COMES TO ANY OF THE HOSTAGES. I WANT THE AMERICAN PEOPLE TO KNOW, AND I WANT THE WORLD TO KNOW, THAT WE WILL PERSIST IN OUR EFFORTS, THROUGH EVERY MEANS AVAILABLE, UNTIL EVERY SINGLE AMERICAN HAS BEEN FREED.

WE MUST ALSO RECOGNIZE NOW, AS WE NEVER HAVE BEFORE, THAT IT IS OUR ENTIRE NATION WHICH IS VULNERABLE BECAUSE OF OUR OVERWHELMING AND EXCESSIVE DEPENDENCE ON OIL FROM FOREIGN COUNTRIES. WE HAVE GOT TO ACCEPT THE FACT THAT THIS DEPENDENCE IS A DIRECT, PHYSICAL THREAT TO OUR NATIONAL SECURITY. AND WE MUST JOIN TOGETHER TO FIGHT FOR OUR NATION'S ENERGY FREEDOM. WE KNOU THE WAYS TO WIN THIS WAR: MORE AMERICAN ENERGY, AND THE MORE EFFICIENT USE OF WHAT WE HAVE. THE UNITED STATES CONGRESS IS NOW STRUGGLING WITH THIS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT DECISION.

THE WAY TO VICTORY IS LONG AND DIFFICULT, BUT WE HAVE THE WILL, AND WE HAVE THE HUMAN AND THE NATURAL RESOURCES OF OUR GREAT NATION. HOWEVER HARD IT MIGHT BE TO SEE INTO THE FUTURE, ONE THING TONIGHT IS CLEAR: WE STAND TOGETHER. WE STAND AS A NATION UNIFIED, A PEOPLE DETERMI'ED TO PROTECT THE LIFE AND THE HONOR OF EVERY AMERICAN. AND WE ARE DETERMINED TO MAKE AMERICA AN ENERGY SECURE NATION ONCE AGAIN. IT IS UNTHINKABLE THAT WE WILL ALLOW OURSELVES TO BE DOMINATED BY ANY FORM OF OVER DEPENDENCE AT HOME, OR ANY BRAND OF TERRORISM ABROAD.
WE ARE DETERMINED THAT THE FREEST NATION ON EARTH SHALL PROTECT AND ENHANCE ITS FREEDOM. END .

IN YOUR CONVERSATIONS IN TEHRAN YOU SHOULD MAKE CLEAR THAT THE CONTENT AND TONE OF THE STATEMENT MIRRORED THE MOOD OF THE AMERICAN PEOPLE. AMERICANS EVERYW'HEREARE UNITED IN THEIR OUTRAGE AT THE CONTINUED DETENTION UNDER CONDITIONS WHICH DO NOT MEET ANY WORLD STANDARDS. THE INITIAL FEELING OF BEWILDERMENT AS TO WHY IRANIANS WOULD SEIZE INNOCENT PEOPLE AS HOSTAGES HAS GIVEN WAYTO ANGER AT THE CONTINUED UNWILLINGNESS OF IRANIAN AUTHORITIESTO RECOGNIZE THE ELEMENTARY FEELINGS OF PEOPLE INTHISCOUNTRY AND AROUND THE WORLD. FURTHER, AMERICANSAREDEEPLY FRUSTRATED BY THE APPARE;T UNWILLINGNESS OF THE IRANIANS EVEN TO DISCUSS A MUTUALLY ACCEPTABLEWAYOUT OF THE PRESENT IMPASSE.
WE HOPE THAT THE IRANIANAUTHORITIES RECOGNIZE THAT THE PRESIDENT FACES AN AMERICAN PUBLIC THAT IS PERHAPS EVEN MORE EMOTIONALLY AROUSED TAHN THE IRANIAN PUBLIC.

THAT BEING SAID, WE TRUST THE IRANIANS WILL APPRECIATE THE RESTRAINT THAT THE PRESIDENT HIMSELF EXHIBITED AND URGED ON HIS FELLOW CITIZENS. THE PRESIDENT WAS PARTICULARLY FIRM IN SAYING IRANIAN STUDENTS HERE WOULD BE TREATED WITH FAIRNESS AND IN ACCORD WITH U.S. LAW AND THE CONSTITUTION. THE PRESIDENT IS DETERMINED TO PURSUE EVERY AVENUE THROUGH DIPLOMATIC AND POLITICAL CHANNELS TO FIND A PEACEFUL RESOLUTION FOR THIS CRISIS. OUR PRINCIPAL DIFFICULTY, OF COURSE, HAS BEEN IN OUR INABILITY TO ENGAGE THE IRANIANS IN SUBSTANTIVE EXCHANGES.

WE HOPE THE IRANIANS WILL NOTICE THAT THE PRESIDENT DID NOT CLOSE OFF ANY OPENINGS THAT COULD BE DISCUSSED AND POSSIBLY LEAD TO A SATISFACTORY SOLUTION ONCE THE HOSTAGE ISSUE IS RESOLVED. FOR EXAMPLE, ON THE QUESTION OF AN INTERNATIONAL INQUIRY INTO THE IRANIAN COMPLAINTS AGAINST THE SHAH, HE NOTED THAT SUCH A PROCEDURE HAD NO PRECEDENT BUT HE HELD OPEN THE POSSIBILITY THAT THE CONCEPT COULD BE PURSUED.
WE WOULD APPRECIATE ANY REACTION YOU RECETVE TO THE

1979STATE309022.subject: VIGIL AT WASHINGTON CATHEDRAL FOR HOSTAGES

segments.text: TO: U.S. CHARGE BRUCE LAINGEN FROM: IRAN WORKING GROUP THIS IS MESSAGE NO. TWENTY TWO. YOUR MESSAGE NO. FORTY NINE RECEIVED.

THE REVEREND CANON CHARLES A. PERRY, PROVOST OF WASHINGTON CATHEDRAL, ANNOUNCED YESTERDAY (NOVEMBER 29) THAT A VIGIL WILL BE HELD AT THE CATHEDRAL FOR THE HOSTAGES HELD AT THE AMERICAN EMBASSY IN TEHRAN. PRAYERS WILL BE SAID EVERY HOUR ON THE HOUR DURING THE DAY. THE CATHEDRAL BELLS ARE RUNG AT NOON EACH DAY AS THEY ARE ACROSS UNITED STATES UNTIL THE HOSTAGES ARE RELEASED. THE VIGIL WILL TAKE PLACE DURING THE CATHEDRAL'S USUAL HOURS 10:00 TO 4:30 DAILY IN ONE OF CHAPELS; AFTER CLOSING HOURS THE VIGIL WILL CONTINUE IN THE CHAPEL OF THE GOOD SHEPARD ON THE NORTH SIDE OF THE CATHEDRAL.
GOOD SHEPARD IS OPEN TWENTY-FOUR HOURS A DAY FOR PRAYER AND MEDITATION.

PRAYER FOR HOSTAGES AT WASHINGTON CATHEDRAL:"O GOD OF MERCY AND POWER, LOOK WITH COMPASSION UPON THE HOSTAGES HELD IN TEHRAN. STAND BY THEM BY DAY AND BY NIGHT, GRANT THEM STRENGTH IN BODY AND MIND, AND GIVE THEM PATIENCE TO THE TIME OF THEIR RELEASE. SUSTAIN THEIR RELATIVES AND ALL WHO LOVE THEM IN THEIR PLIGHT; GUIDE OUR PRESIDENT IN HIS DECISIONS AND PRESERVE PEACE IN THE WORLD. FINALLY, O LORD, WE PRAY FOR THE PEOPLE OF IRAN AND AMERICA, THAT LOOKING TO THE WELFARE OF EACH OTHER WE COME THROUGH ANGER AND STRIFE TO RECONCILIATION AND FRIENDSHIP. AMEN." VANCE

1979STATE310454.subject: AMBASSADOR MCHENRY MADE THE FOLLOWING STATEMENT IN THE SECURITY COUNCIL MEETING

segments.text: TO: U.S. CHARGE BRUCE LAINGEN FROM: IRAN WORKING GROUP
THIS IS MESSAGE NO. 25 AMBASSADOR MCHENRY MADE THE FOLLOWING STATEMENT FOR THE U.S. IN THE SECURITY COUNCIL MEETING THIS EVENING (DECEMBER 1).

BEGIN TEXT: MR. PRESIDENT TWENTY-SEVEN DAYS AGO, 63 AMERICANS AS WELL AS PERSONNEL OF OTHER NATIONALITIES WERE SEIZED WHEN AN ARMED, DISCIPLINED GROUP OF DEMONSTRATORS INVADED THE UNITED STATES EMBASSY IN TEHRAN. EIGHTEEN OF THOSE CAPTURED HAVE BEEN RELEASED. AT LEAST 50 AMERICANS REMAIN CAPTIVE. AS WITH DIPLOMATS EVERYWHERE, THE INDIVIDUALS WHO WERE TAKEN HOSTAGE ARE ENTITLED TO THE PROTECTION OF THE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN BY THE MOST SOLEMN COMMITMENT NATIONS CAN GIVE -- THE SOVEREIGN PLEDGE OF GOVERNMENTS BY TREATY AND INTERNATIONAL OBLIGATION. GOVERNMENTS RETAIN THE RIGHT TO REQUIRE THAT FOREIGN DIPLOMATIC PERSONNEL LEAVE THEIR SOIL.

BUT EVERY STANDARD OF INTERNATIONAL BEHAVIOR, WHETHER ESTABLISHED BY PRACTICE, BY ETHICS, BY TREATY OR BY COMMON HUMANITY SUPPORTS THE PRINCIPLE THAT THE PERSONNEL OF A DIPLOMATIC MISSION AND DIPLOMATIC PROPERTY ARE INVIOLATE. EVEN IN THE DARKEST MOMENTS OF RELATIONSHIPS BETWEEN COUNTRIES, THE SECURITY AND WELL-BEING OF DIPLOMATIC PERSONNEL HAVE BEEN RESPECTED. IRAN ASKS THAT ITS GRIEVANCES BE HEARD AND ACTED UPON. YET IRAN, AND THE AUTHORITIES WHO SPEAK FOR IT, ARE VIOLATING THE MOST BASIC OBLIGATION OF NATIONS. THEY HOSTAGE THE VERY PEOPLE WHO FACILITATE THOSE COMMUNICATIONS THAT CAN RESOLVE DIFFERENCES AND LEAD TO UNDERSTANDING AND AGREEMENT AMONG NATIONS.

NONE OF US, WHATEVER OUR DIFFERENCES ON OTHER ISSUES, CAN IGNORE THE IMPLICATIONS FOR ALL OF US OF THIS EVENT. NOR CAN THE WORLD IGNORE THAT THESE DIPLOMATIC REPRESENTATIVES ARE BEING HELD UNDER DEGRADING CONDITIONS. THEY ARE THREATENED, KEPT BOUND, ISOLATED, NOT ALLOWED TO SPEAK, DENIED MAIL. EVEN THEIR WHEREABOUTS ARE UNCERTAIN. ALL OF US AT THIS TABLE ARE ALSO DIPLOMATIC REPRESENTATIVES OF OUR COUNTRIES, CHARGED WITH THE SAME DUTIES AND PROTECTED BY THE SAME LAWS AND RULES OF CONDUCT AS THOSE NOW HELD CAPTIVE IN TEHRAN.

IT IS FOR ALL OF US TO SPEAK UP TO DEMAND THEIR RELEASE AND TO INSIST UPON BASIC CONDITIONS OF HUMANITY FOR THEIR CARE PENDING THAT RELEASE, INCLUDING DAILY VISITATION BY IMPARTIAL OBSERVERS. MANY MEMBERS OF THE UNITED NATIONS, INCLUDING SOME MEMBERS OF THIS COUNCIL, HAVE HAD AMBASSADORS MURDERED, DIPLOMATIC PERSONNEL INJURED, EMBASSY FACILITIES DESTROYED. ON EACH OCCASION THE DELICATE FRAMEWORK OF OUR INTERNATIONAL COMMUNITY HAS BEEN HARMED, BUT EFFORTS WERE MADE TO HEAL THE WOUNDS. THE SITUATION IN TEHRAN HAS A FEATURE UNLIKE OTHER ASSAULTS ON THE DIPLOMATIC TIES THAT BINDOUR WORLD. IN IRAN, THE GOVERNMENT ITSELF DEFENDS THE VIOLENCEWHICH HOLDS DIPLOMATS HOSTAGE. SUCHA SITUATION IS INTOLERABLE.

THE UNITED STATES INSISTS THAT ITS DIPLOMATIC PERSONNEL BE RELEASED AND ITS DIPLOMATIC PREMISES BE RESTORED. THESE ARE NOT NEGOTIABLE MATTERS. THE UNITED STATES WILL HOLD THE AUTHORITIES IN IRAN FULLY RESPONSIBLE FOR THE SAFETY OF THE AMERICANS NOW HELD CAPTIVE. I SPEAK TODAY FOR HOSTAGES WHO ARE ENDANGERED BY THE FRENZY AND UNCERTAINTY OF EVENTS; BYTHE INHUMANE CONDITIONS UNDER WHICHTHEYARE HELD; AND BY THE THREAT OF THE AUTHORITIES IN TO COMPOUND UNJUST ACTS THROUGH TRIALS. AROUND THE WORLD, NATIONS EAST AND WEST, NORTH AND SOUTH, IN INDIVIDUAL AND COLLECTIVESTATEMENTS, HAVE EXPRESSED THEIR OPPOSITION TO THIS VIOLATION OF INTERNATIONAL LAW AND CALLED FOR THE IMMEDIATE RELEASE OF THE HOSTAGES.

WE EXPRESS OUR APPRECIATION FOR THIS OVERWHELMING EXPRESSION OF INTERNATIONAL CONCERN AND SUPPORT IN BEHALFOFPRINCIPLES THAT LIE AT THE HEART OF CIVILIZED INTERNATIONAL BEHAVIOR. IN THIS SPIRIT, THE PRESIDENT OF THE SECURITY COUNCIL, SPEAKING FOR THE MEMBERS OF THIS BODY,HAS TWICE URGENTLY APPEALED FOR THE RELEASEOF THE HOSTAGES. THE PRESIDENT OF THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY HAS TWICE SPOKEN ELOQUENTLY IN SUPPORT OFTHIS PLEA. THE SECRETARY GENERAL OF THE UNITED NATIONS HAS WORKED UNCEASINGLY TO RESOLVE THIS CRISIS. THERE HAS NOT BEEN A SATISFACTORY RESPONSE AND THE HOSTAGES ARE STILL NOT FREE. WE GATHER HERE TO DETERMINE WHAT MORE CAN BE DONE.

NONE OF US IS DEAF TO THE PASSIONATE VOICES THAT SPEAK OF INJUSTICE, THAT CRY OUT AGAINSTPAST WRONGS AND THAT ASK FOR UNDERSTANDING.THERE IS NOT A SINGLE GRIEVANCE ALLEGED OR SPOKEN IN THIS SITUATION THAT COULD NOT BE HEARD IN AN APPROPRIATE FORUM. IN ADDITION, AS WE HAVE SAID FROM THE BEGINNING, THE UNITED STATES REMAINS READY, UPON THE RELEASE OF THE HOSTAGES, TO DISCUSS WITH THE IRANIAN AUTHORITIES THE DIFFERENCES WHICH EXIST BETWEEN US AND TO SEEK THEIR RESOLUTION.

BUT NO COUNTRY CAN CALL FOR JUSTICE WHILE AT THE SAME TIME DENYING IT TO THE DEFENSELESS.NO COUNTRY CAN BREACH THE MOST FUNDAMENTAL RULES OF THE COMMUNITY OF NATIONS AND AT THE SAME TIMEEXPECT THAT COMMUNITY TO BE HELPFUL IN THEPROBLEMS WHICH IT PERCEIVES FOR ITSELF. IN THE SIMPLEST TERMS, NO COUNTRY CAN BREAK, AND IGNORE THE LAW WHILE SEEKING ITS BENEFITS. T IS IT THAT THE WORLD CAN AGREE UPON IF NOT THE PROTECTION AND RESPECTFORTHOSE WHOM WE APPOINT TO REPRESENT OUR SOVEREIGNTYAND RESOLVE OUR DIFFERENCES? HOW TRAGIC FOR IRAN, HOW TRAGIC FOR THE WORLD THAT THREATS TO PEACE ARE BEING DRIVENTO ANEW CRESCENDO.

THE MOST POWERFUL VOICESINIRAN HAVE ENCOURAGED VIOLENCE IN NEIGHBORINGCOUNTRIES ANDCONDONED BLOODSHED RATHER THAN CONDEMNING IT. IN ADDITION, TOTALLY UNFOUNDED CHARGES WHICHCAN ONLY INFLAME THE SITUATION ARE BEING MADE AGAINSTTHE UNITED STATES WITH RESPECT TO THE CURRENTCRISIS. THE UNITED STATES IN ALL THE YEARS OF ITS HISTORY HAS HAD AS A FUNDAMENTAL PRINCIPLE THEFREEDOM OF ALL PEOPLE TO WORSHIP AS THEY CHOOSE. OUTOF THIS HISTORY AND LONG ASSOCIATION, WEHONOR AND RESPECT THE LEADERS AND THE NATION OF ISLAM.

THE PRINCIPLE OF NON-INTERFERENCE IN THE INTERNAL AFFAIRS OF OTHER NATIONS IS BOTH A TENET OF THE UNITED NATIONS AND OF THE FOREIGN POLICY OF THE UNITED STATES, AND THAT INCLUDES, OF COURSE, RESPECT FOR THE TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY, POLITICAL INDEPENDENCE AND SOVEREIGNTY OF IRAN. WE RESPECT THE RIGHT OF THE PEOPLE OF IRAN TO DETERMINE THEIR OWN FUTURE THROUGH INSTITUTIONS OF THEIR OWN CHOOSING. ALL OF US MUST ACCEPT THEIR DECISIONS. THE PRESIDENT OF THE UNITED STATES, SPEAKING FOR A UNIFIED AND DETERMINED NATION, HAS MADE IT CLEAR THAT WE ARE SEEKING A PEACEFUL RESOLUTION TO THIS CONFLICT SO THAT THE WOUNDS OF THE PAST CAN BE HEALED.

IN THIS SPIRIT, THE UNITED STATES HAS TURNED TO THE SECURITY COUNCIL AND THE SECRETARYGENERAL IN THE SEARCH FOR A PEACEFUL SOLUTION. IN THIS SPIRIT, THE UNITED STATESHASBEGUNPROCEEDINGS IN THE INTERNATIONAL COURT OF JUSTICE. 1979STATE310570.subject: MESSAGE FOR THE FOREIGN MINISTERS ON THE HEALTH OF THE SHAH

segments.text: TO: U.S. CHARGE BRUCE LAINGEN FROM: IRAN WORKING GROUP THIS IS MESSAGE NUMBER TWENTY-SEVEN.

PLEASE INFORM FOREIGN MINISTER GHOTBZADEH OF THE FOLLOWING: AS THE FOREIGN MINISTER IS AWARE, THE DOCTORS AT THE CORNELL MEDICAL FACILITY HAVE TOLD THE FORMER SHAH THAT HIS SURGERY AND INITIAL TREATMENT HAVE BEEN COMPLETED AND HE IS NOW ABLE TO LEAVE THE HOSPITAL. AS THE MINISTER IS ALSO AWARE, THE MEXICAN GOVERNMENT HASSAIDTHAT IT IS UNWILLING TO GIVE THE SHAH PERMISSION TO RETURN. THE DOCTORS HAVE INDICATED THAT THE SHAH SHOULD NOT UNDERTAKE A PROLONGED TRIP AT THIS STAGE IN HIS RECOVERY AND THAT HE SHOULD HAVE A FURTHER PERIOD OF RECUPERATION UNDER MEDICAL SUPERVISION.

FOR THIS TEMPORARY PERIOD, THE UNITED STATES GOVERNMENT HAS AGREED TO PROVIDE A SECURE CONVALESCENT FACILITY WHERE THE SHAH CAN RECUPERATE PENDING ARRANGEMENTS FOR HIS ONWARD TRAVEL. THIS MEDICAL FACILITY IS AT WILFORD HALL AIR FORCE HOSPITAL NEAR SAN ANTONIO, TEXAS.
AT THE FORMER SHAH'S REQUEST, THE UNITED STATES IS ASSISTING HIM IN LOCATING A PLACE OF RESIDENCE ABROAD.
THE FORMER SHAH'S STATUS IN THE UNITED STATES REMAINS THAT OF A PRIVATE CITIZEN ADMITTED FOR MEDICAL AND HUMANITARIAN REASONS.
TO; U.S. CHARGE BRUCE LAINGEN FROM: IRAN WORKING GROUP THIS IS MESSAGE NO. 23.

ON THE MCNEIL LEHRER SHOW NOVEMBER 29 FOREIGN MINISTER GHOTBZADEH WAS INTERVIEWED. HE WAS ASKED QUESTIONS ABOUT THE CONDITIONS OF THE HOSTAGES WHICH MAY REFLECT AN INACCURATE UNDERSTANDING OF THE FACTS AS CONVEYED TO US BY THE RELEASED HOSTAGES AND ALL THOSE PERSONS WHO HAVE BEEN ABLE TO VISIT THE COMPOUND. WE WOULD LIKE YOU TO ATTEMPT TO CONVEY THE FOLLOWING CLARIFICATIONS TO THE FOREIGN MINISTER.
MR. GHOTBZADEH SAID THE HOSTAGES WERE NOT BOUND EXCEPT WHEN THEY WERE MOVED FROM PLACE TO PLACE, WERE NOT FORCED TO REMAIN SILENT AND WERE ALLOWED A FULL RANGE OF FOOD, INCLUDING FRUIT.

OUR UNDERSTANDING FROM THE HOSTAGES THEMSELVES, PERSONS WHO HAVE BEEN IN DIRECT CONTACT WITH THE HOSTAGES AND OUR CONVERSATIONS WITH STUDENTS ON THE COMPOUND INDICATE QUITE DIFFERENT CONDITIONS. THE HOSTAGES' HANDS ARE BOUND EXCEPT WHEN THEY ARE EATING OR ALLOWED TO GO TO THE BATHROOM. THE FEET OF SOME HOSTAGES ARE ALSO BOUND, INCLUDING WHEN THEY ARE SLEEPING. NO HOSTAGE IS ALLOWED TO SPEAK FREELY TO HIS FELLOW CAPTIVES OR TO EVEN THE GUARDS WITHOUT PERMISSION. THOSE WHO VIOLATE THIS PROHIBITION ARE PUNISHED BY BEING FORCED TO FACE THE WALL OR HAVING HANDCUFFS PLACED ON THEM IN LIEU OF THE CLOTH ROPES FOR BINDING.

WHEN THE HOSTAGES WERE RELEASED, NONE OF THEM HAD RECEIVED ANY FRUIT IN TWO WEEKS. EACH OF THE WOMEN HAD BEEN ALLOWED TWO BATHS DURING THAT PERIOD. THREE OF THE WOMEN WERE THREATENED WITH PISTOLS WHEN THEY WERE QUESTIONED.

IT IS CLEAR TO US FROM TESTIMONY OF THE RELEASED HOSTAGES PLUS THE STATEMENTS OF VISITORS THAT SEVERAL OF THE PERSONS BEING HELD CAPTIVE ARE TAKING THEIR IMPRISONMENT VERY HARD. WE ARE SERIOUSLY CONCERNED FOR THE WELL BEING OF THESE PEOPLE WHO ARE NOT PREPARED EMOTIONALLY TO WITHSTAND THIS CONTINUOUS PRESSURE.

WE FEEL STRONGLY THAT THE BEST COURSE OF ACTION WOULD BE TO ALLOW NEUTRAL OBSERVERS TO VISIT THE HOSTAGES. WE HAVE HAD NO WORD OF ANY VISITOR IN ABOUT ONE WEEK (CONGR. HANSEN SAW 19 MEN). THE ICRC REP HAS BEEN CONSISTENTLY REFUSED ENTRY INTO THE COMPOUND AND HAS NOT BEEN ABLE TO OBTAIN EVEN BASIC INFORMATION ON THE HOSTAGES' NAMES OR THEIR PHYSICAL CONDITION. THIS IS NOT THE KIND OF TREATMENT THAT IS ACCORDED EVEN TO PRISONERS OF WAR.

1979STATE312894.subject: TEXTS OF UN SECURITY COUNCIL RESOLUTION CONCERNING THE SITUATION IN IRAN ADOPTED UNANIMOUSLY

segments.text: TO: U.S. CHARGE L. BRUCE LAINGEN FROM: IRAN WORKING GROUP THIS IS OUR MESSAGE NO. THIRTY.
FOLLOWING IS THE TEXT OF THE UN SECURITY COUNCIL RESOLUTION CONCERNING THE SITUATION IN IRAN ADOPTED UNANIMOUSLY ON DECEMBER 4, 1979.

1. URGENTLY CALLS ON THE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN TO RELEASE IMMEDIATELY THE PERSONNEL OF THE EMBASSY OF THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA BEING HELD IN TEHERAN, TO PROVIDE THEM PROTECTION AND ALLOW THEM TO LEAVE THE COUNTRY

2. FURTHER CALLS ON THE GOVERNMENTS OF IRAN AND OF THE UNITED STATES TO TAKE STEPS TO RESOLVE PEACEFULLY THE REMAINING ISSUES BETWEEN THEM TO THEIR MUTUAL SATISFACTION IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE PURPOSES AND PRINCIPLES OF THE UNITED NATIONS

1979STATE312986.subject: STATEMENT BY AMBASSADOR MCHENRY DECEMBER 4TH AT THE UN SECURITY COUNCIL

segments.text: TO: U.S. CHARGE L. BRUCE LAINGEN; FROM: IRAN WORKING GROUP THIS IS MESSAGE NO. 31. FOLLOWING IS STATEMENT BY AMBASSADOR MCHENRY DECEMBER 4 AT THE UN SECURITY COUNCIL. BEGIN TEXT: MR. PRESIDENT

THE FIFTEEN MEMBERS OF THE SECURITY COUNCIL IN THEIR ACTION TODAY HAVE GIVEN UNANIMOUS EXPRESSION ONCE MORE TO THEIR URGENT CALL ON THE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN FOR THE IMMEDIATE AND UNCONDITIONAL RELEASE OF THE AMERICAN EMBASSY PERSONNEL BEING HELD AT OUR EMBASSY IN TEHRAN. THEY HAVE CALLED ON THE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN TO PROVIDE THE HOSTAGES PROTECTION AND TO ALLOW THEM TO LEAVE THE COUNTRY. IT IS CLEAR FROM THIS VOTE AND FROM THE DEBATE OF THE LAST FOUR DAYS, IN WHICH REPRESENTATIVES FROM ALL PARTS OF THE WORLD HAVE PARTICIPATED, THAT THE FAMILY OF NATIONS SPEAKS WITH ONE VOICE IN CALLING FOR THE IMMEDIATE RELEASE OF THE HOSTAGES.
WE ARE DEEPLY APPRECIATIVE.

WE HOPE THAT THIS CALL BY THE SECURITY COUNCIL WILL BE HEEDED AND CARRIED OUT BY THE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN IN A MATTER OF HOURS. WHATEVER THE TIME REQUIRED, WE URGE THE SECRETARY-GENERAL, IN THE EXERCISE OF HIS GOOD OFFICES, TO PROVIDE ALL HUMANITARIAN SUPPORT POSSIBLE TO THOSE BEING DETAINED AGAINST THEIR WILL. WE REMAIN DEEPLY CONCERNED FOR THEIR SAFETY, THEIR WELL BEING AND THEIR HEALTH ON THIS, THEIR THIRTIETH DAY OF SUFFERING AND ISOLATION.

THE UNITED STATES WISHES TO PLACE ON THE RECORD THAT THE ADOPTION OF THIS RESOLUTION BY THE SECURITY COUNCIL CLEARLY IS NOT INTENDED TO DISPLACE PEACEFUL EFFORTS IN OTHER ORGANS OF THE UNITED NATIONS. NEITHER THE UNITED STATES NOR I BELIEVE ANY OTHER MEMBER INTENDS THAT THE ADOPTION OF THIS RESOLUTION SHOULD HAVE ANY PREJUDICIAL IMPACT WHATEVER ON THE REQUEST OF THE UNITED STATES FOR THE INDICATION OF PROVISIONAL MEASURES OF PROTECTION BY THE INTERNATIONAL COURT OF JUSTICE.

WITH THE HOSTAGES RELEASED, THE RESOLUTION CALLS ON THE GOVERNMENTS OF IRAN AND THE UNITED STATES TO TAKE URGENT MEASURES TO RESOLVE PEACEFULLY THE REMAINING ISSUES BETWEEN THEM IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE PURPOSES AND PRINCIPLES OF THE CHARTER OF THE UNITED NATIONS. THE UN ITED STATES IS FULLY PREPARED TO COOPERATE WITH THIS CALL.

MANY SPEAKERS IN THIS DEBATE HAVE ALSO REFERRED TO THE GRIEVANCES OF THE PEOPLE OF IRAN. I MYSELF DID SO WHEN I REMARKED THAT: "NONE OF US IS DEAF TO THE PASSIONATE VOICES THAT SPEAK OF INJUSTICE, THAT CRY OUT AGAINST PAST WRONGS AND THAT ASK FOR UNDERSTANDING. THERE IS NOT A SINGLE GRIEVANCE ALLEGED OR SPOKEN IN THIS SITUATION THAT COULD NOT BE HEARD IN AN APPROPRIATE FORUM." THE SECURITY COUNCIL HAS NOW ALSO NOTED THOSE GRIEVANCES IN ITS ACKNOWLEDGEMENT OF THE IRANIAN LETTER OF NOVEMBER 13, 1979.

NEITHER THE UNITED STATES NOR THE OTHER MEMBERS OF THE COMMUNITY OF NATIONS HAS A DESIRE TO ISOLATE IRAN, NOR TO INTERVENE IN ITS INTERNAL AFFAIRS. WE ARE ALL MEMBERS OF THE UNITED NATIONS AND OF THE COMMUNITY OF NATIONS. LET US THEN, ALL OF US, BE TRUE TO THE PURPOSES AND PRINCIPLES OF THE CHARTER WHICH WE HAVE PLEDGED OURSELVES TO HONOR.

1979STATE312987.subject: PRESS INTERVIEW FOREIGN MINISTER GHOTBZADEH ON REPORTS DEATHS AND REPE OF IRANIANS IN THE U.S.

segments.text: TO: U.S. CHARGE L. BRUCE LAINGEN FROM: IRAN WORKING GROUP
THIS IS OUR MESSAGE NO. TWENTY EIGHT. WE ACKNOWLEDGE YOUR MESSAGES FIFTY FIVE AND FIFTY SIX AND HEAR YOU LOUD AND CLEAR.

IN A RECENT PRESS INTERVIEW FOREIGN MINISTER GHOTBZADEH IS QUOTED AS SAYING: BEGIN WE HAVE FORMAL REPORTS THAT THERE WERE SEVERAL DEATHS (IN THE U.S.). YOUNG IRANIANS HAVE BEEN KILLED AND IRANIAN GIRLS HAVE BEEN RAPED THERE, AND ALL IN THE NAME OF HUMANITY. END .

PLEASE INFORM THE FOREIGN MINISTER THAT THERE APPEARS TO BE SOME MISUNDERSTANDING. WE HAVE BEEN IN DAILY TOUCH WITH THE IRANIAN EMBASSY HERE TO DO WHAT WE CAN TO PROTECT IRANIANS AND TO SEE THAT THEY RECEIVE FAIR TREATMENT. FOR EXAMPLE, A FEW DAYS AGO THE IRANIAN EMBASSY PROTESTED THAT SIX STUDENTS HAD BEEN ARRESTED WITHOUT REASONABLE GROUNDS IN A SMALL TOWN IN TEXAS. WE IMMEDIATELY CALLED THE CHIEF OF POLICE AND THE SIX STUDENTS WERE FORTHWITH RELEASED.
EARLIER THE IRANIAN CHARGE MENTIONED A RUMOR THAT FOUR IRANIAN GIRLS HAD BEEN RAPED IN OKLAHOMA. WE ASKED HIM TO GIVE US NAMES AND PLACES SO THAT WE COULD CHECK OUT THE REPORT. HE HAS NEVER DONE SO.
TWO IRANIANS WERE KILLED RECENTLY IN NEVADA IN AN AUTOMOBILE ACCIDENT. THEIR CAR RAN OFF THE ROAD. WE INVESTIGATED THIS REPORT IN GREAT DETAIL AND FOUND THERE WAS NO EVIDENCE OF FOUL PLAY.

IN ADDITION, THE IRANIAN CHARGE HAS EXPRESSED TO US CONCERN ON SEVERAL OCCASIONS THAT IRANIANS WERE SUFFERING BECAUSE OF THE FREEZE ON ASSETS. WE HAVE BEEN TAKING STEPS TO ALLEVIATE THE BURDEN ON INDIVIDUAL IRANIANS AND WILL CONTINUE TO DO SO AS WE ARE MADE AWARE OF THEIR PROBLEMS HERE.

PLEASE CONVEY THE FOREGOING TO THE FOREIGN MINISTER AND ASSURE HIM THAT THE UNITED STATES GOVERNMENT IS CARRYING OUT THE PRESIDENT'S PUBLICLY STATED DIRECTIVE THAT ALL IRANIANS BE TREATED FAIRLY AND IN ACCORD WITH U.S. LAW AND THE CONSTITUTION. IF THE FOREIGN MINISTER HAS ANY SPECIFIC INFORMATION ON MISTREATMENT OF IRANIANS WE WOULD APPRECIATE BEING INFORMED IMMEDIATELY OF NAMES AND PLACES SO THAT WE CAN BE RESPONSIVE. WE CANNOT, OF COURSE, DEAL WITH GENERALITIES BUT WE WILL TRY TO BE HELPFUL WHEN SPECIFIC CASES ARE BROUGHT TO OUR ATTENTION.

IN RESPONSE TO YOUR QUESTION, AS YOU KNOW THE INS IS ASKING IRANIAN STUDENTS TO REGISTER SO THAT RECORDS MAY BE BROUGHT UP TO DATE. THE PRESS REPORTED RECENTLY THAT ONE REPEAT ONE STUDENT HAD BEEN DEPORTED BECAUSE OF A VIOLATION OF U.S. LAW. VANCE
