TO: U.S. CHARGE BRUCE LAINGEN FROM: IRAN WORKING GROUP THIS IS MESSAGE NO. 35.
WE HAVE RECEIVED YOUR MESSAGES NO. 60, 61 AND 62.

WITH RESPECT PARA 8 OF OUR MESSAGE 28 WE HAVE THE FOLLOWING TENTATIVE FIGURES FROM INS. AS OF DECEMBER 6, 46,362 IRANIAN REGISTRATIONS HAD BEEN PROCESSED. 5,614 WERE FOUND TO BE OUT OF STATUS. 51 PERSONS HAVE LEFT THE UNITED STATES. EIGHT OF THESE WERE DEPORTED AND 43 LEFT VOLUNTARILY.

THE MEETING WITH THE FAMILIES WAS EXTREMELY SUCCESSFUL. IT BEGAN ABOUT 10 O'CLOCK AND LASTED UNTIL ABOUT 4:30. ABOUT 100 FAMILY MEMBERS CAME FROM ALL PARTS OF THE COUNTRY. THEY MET IN THE BENJAMIN FRANKLIN ROOM WHERE THEY WERE ADDRESSED BY THE SECRETARY, DAVID NEWSOM, HODDING CARTER, DR. HAYNES AND HAL SAUNDERS.INADDITION TO A BRIEFING ON THE CURRENT SITUATION THERE WAS A DISCUSSION OF HOW TO DEAL WITH THE PRESS. IN AN UNSCHEDULED APPEARANCE THE PRESIDENT SPOKE TO THEM IN THE AFTERNOON AND HE AND THE SECRETARY WERE PHOTOGRAPHED WITH EACH OF THE FAMILY GROUPS.

THE REACTION TO THE MEETING WAS VERY POSITIVE. THE FAMILY MEMBERS APPEARED TO APPRECIATE THE FRANKNESS AND DETAIL OF THE BRIEFINGS. THERE WAS STRONG SUPPORT FOR THE PRESIDENT'S POLICY OF RESTRAINT AND REPEATED STATEMENTS FOR UNITY THROUGHOUT THE DAY-LONG SESSION. FOLLOWING THE BRIEFING THERE WAS AMPLE COVERAGE BY TELEVISION AND THE PRESS WITH INTERVIEWS WITH MANY PARTICIPANTS. VANCE UNQUOTE. VANCE NOTE BY OC/T: DIST. ORIG. NEA/ADS,SS,SSO,CCO

1979STATE320933.subject: TEXT OF DIPLOMATIC NOTE REGARDING STAFFING AT THE U.S. EMBASSY IN IRAN

segments.text: TO: U.S. CHARGE L. BRUCE LAINGEN FROM: IRAN WORKING GROUP THIS IS OUR MESAGE NUMBER 37. WE HAVE RECEIVED YOUR MESSAGE NUMBER 66.
UNDER SECRETARY NEWSOM CALLED IN IRANIAN CHARGE AGAH TODA TO HAND HIM A DIPLOMATIC NOTE. TEXT FOLLOWS BEGIN TEXT.

SIR: I WISH TO INFORM YOU THAT, HAVING REGARD FOR THE PRESENT CIRCUMSTANCES, THE UNITED STATES GOVERNMENT IS PRESCRIBING THE MAXIMUM LEVELS FOR THE NUMBER OF PERSONNEL WHO MAY BE ASSIGNED TO THE EMBASSY OF IRAN AND TOTHE CONSULAR POSTS OF IRAN IN THE UNITED STATES. THE NUMBER OF PERSONNEL ASSIGNED TO THE EMBASSY MAY NOT EXCEED15PERSONS. THE NUMBER OF PERSONNEL ASSIGNED TO THE CONSULATES MAY NOT EXCEED FIVE PERSONS AT EACH POST. THE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN MAY SELECT THOSE PERSONS THAT IT WISHES TO RETAIN WITHIN THE ESTABLISHED MAXIMUM LIMITATIONS. THE UNITED STATES WISHES IRAN TO COMPLETE THESE ARRANGEMENTS WITHIN THE NEXT FIVE DAYS.

THOSE PERSONNEL WHO ARE REMOVED FROM THE DIPLOMATIC AND CONSULAR LISTS OR WHOSE DIPLOMATIC OR OFFICIAL VISAS ARE AFFECTED BY THIS LIMITATION AND WHO REQUIRE ADDITIONAL TIME IN THE UNITED STATES SHOULD REPORT TO THE NEAREST OFFICE OF THE IMMIGRATION AND NATURALIZATION SERVICE. THE EMBASSY IS REQUESTED TO PROVIDE, AT THE EARLIEST OPPORTUNITY, A LIST OF NAMES OF THE PERSONS WHO WILL REMAIN AT THE EMBASSY AND THE CONSULAR POSTS. THE LIMITATIONS PRESCRIBED IN THIS NOTE WILL BE EFFECTIVE AS LONG AS AMERICANS ARE HELD HOSTAGE IN IRAN. ACCEPT, SIR, THE RENEWED ASSURANCES OF MY HIGH CONSIDERATION. FOR THE SECRETARY OF STATE: SIGNED DAVID NEWSOM .
THE FOLLOWING PRESS GUIDANCE IS BEING USED TODAY.
BEGIN TEXT.

STATEMENT THE DEPARTMENT OF STATE HAS INFORMED THE CHARGE OF THE IRAN EMBASSY THAT THE STAFFING LEVEL OF THE EMBASSY SHOULD BE REDUCED TO 15 PERSONS. THE CHARGE WAS ALSO INFORMED THAT THE IRANIAN CONSULATES GENERAL IN NEW YORK, SAN FRANCISCO, CHICAGO AND HOUSTON ARE EXPECTED TO REDUCE THEIR PERSONNEL TO FIVE AT EACH POST. THESE STEPS HAVE BEEN TAKEN IN VIEW OF THE CONTINUED ILLEGAL DETENTION OF AMERICAN PERSONNEL AND HOLDING OF THE AMERICAN EMBASSY COMPOUND IN TEHRAN AS WELL AS U.S. GOVERNMENT PROPERTY IN TABRIZ AND SHIRAZ. QUESTIONS AND ANSWERS Q: WHY HAVE YOU NOT CLOSED THE EMBASSY AND THE CONSULATES?

A: WE BELIEVE WE HAVE TAKEN A MEASURED STEP TO DEMONSTRATE TO THE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN OUR CONTINUING CONCERN OVER THE ILLEGAL HOLDING OF HOSTAGES AND AMERICAN PROPERTY IN IRAN. WE HAVE PERMITTED CONTINUED OPERATIONS OF THE EMBASSY AND THE CONSULATES HERE SO THAT E CAN MAINTAIN REQUIRED COMMUNICATIONS AND CONTINUED FACILITIES CAN BE PROVIDED TO THE LARGE NUMBER OF IRANIANS WHO REMAIN IN THIS COUNTRY. Q: HOW MANY PERSONNEL ARE PRESENTLY EMPLOYED IN THE EMBASSY AND THE CONSULATES? A: THE EMBASSY OF IRAN HAS REGISTERED 57 EMPLOYEES WITH THE DEPARTMENT OF STATE. THERE ARE 161 REGISTERED FOR THE FOUR CONSULATES.

THE FIGURES MAY BE OUT OF DATE AND NOT REFLECT RECENT CHANGES IN ASSIGNMENTS. Q: ARE YOU DECLARING DIPLOMATIC PERSONNEL PERSONA NON GRATA? A: WE HAVE INFORMED THE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN OF THE NUMBER OF OFFICIAL PERSONNEL THAT THEY MAYRETAIN IN THEIR EMBASSY AND CONSULATES. WE HAVE NOT IDENTIFIED SPECIFIC EMPLOYEES FOR THE REDUCTION AND LEAVE THAT UP TO THE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN. Q: WILL SOME IRANIAN OFFICIALS BE FORCED TO LEAVE THE COUNTRY? A: THOSE WHO ARE HERE ON DIPLOMATIC VISAS WHO WILL NOT REMAIN AT THE EMBASSY AND CONSULATES WILL NO LONGER HAVE A VALID DIPLOMATIC VISA. THEIR STATUS WILL BE SUBJECT TO DETERMINATION BY INS.

Q: HAVE YOU SET A DEADLINE ON THE IRANIAN REDUCTION IN STAFFING LEVELS? A: WE WOULD EXPECT THE CHANGES TO GO INTO EFFECT IN THE NEXT FEW DAYS. Q: WILL THE IRANIAN CHARGE REMAIN HERE? A: WE ASSUME THAT HE WILL. THE DECISION AS TO WHO WILL BE RETAINED ON THE EMBASSY'S ROLLS IS A CHOICE THE IRANIANS MUST MAKE.

YOU SHOULD CONVEY THE PRESS INFORMATION TO THE IRANIAN FOREIGN MINISTER. IN DOING SO, YOU SHOULD EMPHASIZE FOR HIM THAT WE HAVE TAKEN THIS STEP RELUCTANTLY AFTER WAITING IN VAIN FOR SOME SIGN FROM THE IRANIAN SIDE THAT IT INTENDED TO TAKE STEPS TOWARDS THE RELEASE OF THE HOSTAGES. WE HAD HOPED FOR CONCRETE MOVEMENT TOWARDS A RESOLUTION OF THIS CRISIS IN THE PERIOD FOLLOWING ASHURA AND THE REFERENDUM. ALTHOUGH THE HOSTILITY IN THE IRANIAN MEDIA APPEARS TO HAVE ABATED SOMEWHAT, THERE HAS BEEN NO CONCRETE INDICATION THAT IRAN WANTS TO RESOLVE THIS CRISIS. THE IRANIAN AUTHORITIES SHOULD RECOGNIZE THAT THE ANGER OF THE AMERICAN PEOPLE IS RISING EACH DAY.

THE ADMINISTRATION HAS ACTED WITH RESTRAINT BUT FEELS COMPELLED, IN THE ABSENCE OF ANY POSITIVE SIGN FROM THE IRANIAN SIDE, TO TAKE ACTION WHICH DEMONSTRATES OUR GROWING CONCERN OVER CONTINUED DELAY BY THE IRAN AUTHORITIES IN RELEASING THE HOSTAGES.
ADDITIONAL Q AND A (ACCIDENTALLY OMITTED ABOVE) FOLLOWS: Q: HOW LONG WILL THIS REDUCTION BE IN EFFECT? A: AS LONG AS THE PRESENT CRISIS LASTS. CHRISTOPHER

1979STATE321917.subject: REPORTS FROM IRAN TODAY THAT INTERNATIONAL OBSERVERS WOULD BE ALLOWED TO SEE OUR PEOPLE WHO ARE BEING HELD HOSTAGES

segments.text: TO: U.S. CHARGE L. BRUCE LAINGEN FROM: IRAN WORKING GROUP THIS IS OUR MESSAGE NO. THIRTY EIGHT.

FOLLOWING IS TEXT OF STATEMENT DELIVERED TODAY AT NOON BRIEFING. WE HAVE READ REPORTS FROM IRAN TODAY THAT INTERNATIONAL OBSERVERS WOULD BE ALLOWED TO SEE OUR PEOPLE WHO ARE BEING HELD HOSTAGE. WE WOULD EXPECT THAT ANY SUCH OBSERVERS ALLOWED ON THE EMBASSY COMPOUND WOULD BE QUALIFIED, INTERNATIONALLY RECOGNIZED, IMPARTIAL NEUTRAL OBSERVERS AND WOULD INCLUDE A QUALIFIED MEDICAL DOCTOR. WE WOULD ALSO EXPECT THAT THERE WOULD BE REGULAR VISITS BY THESE OBSERVERS UNTIL THE HOSTAGES ARE RELEASED.

FOR ANY SUCH VISITS TO THE HOSTAGES TO ACCOMPLISH THEIR HUMANITARIAN OBJECTIVE, IT IS IMPORTANT THAT THOSE PERSONS WHO SEE THE HOSTAGES BE ALLOWED TO SEE ALL OF THEM, TO TALK WITH THEM, AND TO REPORT TO THEIR FAMILIES AND TO THE WORLD ON THE CONDITION OF EACH ONE OF THEM. IF THIS CAN BE ARRANGED, WE WOULD WELCOME IT. UNQUOTE.
WE HAVE RECEIVED YOUR DICTATED SUGGESTIONS. YOUR IDEAS ARE EXCELLENT AND WE ARE ALREADY PURSUING SOME OF THEM. WE READ YOU LOUD AND CLEAR.

IN ADDITION TO ABOVE STATEMENT, THE FOLLOWING GUIDANCE WAS ALSO PREPARED. QUESTION: WHAT ARE YOUR COMMENTS ON THE KHOMEINI ANNOUNCEMENT TO ESTABLISH AN INTERNATIONAL TRIBUNAL TO LOOK INTO U.S. CRIMES AGAINST IRAN? ANSWER: -- NOTHING SHOULD BE ALLOWED TO DELAY THE RELEASE OF ALL OF THE HOSTAGES. IT WOULD BE UNACCEPTABLE FOR THEM TO CONTINUE TO BE HELD IN IRAN WHILE SOME KIND OF TRIBUNAL TAKES PLACE. -- WE HAVE STATED REPEATEDLY THAT IRANIAN COMPLAINTS CAN BE HEARD AND WILL BE LISTENED TO--ONCE THE HOSTAGES ARE FREED.

THIS IS MESSAGE NUMBER 39.
THE FOLLOWING STATEMENT WILL BE MADE IN WASHINGTON APPROXIMATELY NOON EST SATURDAY, DECEMBER 15.

ANNOUNCEMENT (BEGIN TEXT): THE SHAH DEPARTED LACKLAND AIR FORCE BASE THIS MORNING FOR PANAMA. HE WILL ESTABLISH RESIDENCE THERE IN RESPONSE TO A LONGSTANDING INVITATION FROM THE GOVERNMENT OF PANAMA. THE GOVERNMENT OF PANAMA HAS STATED ITS HOPE THAT THE PROVISION OF A PLACE OF RESIDENCE FOR THE SHAH IN PANAMA WILL HELP TO BRING ABOUT A PEACEFUL RESOLUTION OF THE PRESENT CRISIS. PRESIDENT CARTER HAS EXPRESSED TO PRESIDENT ROYO THE APPRECIATION OF THE AMERICAN PEOPLE FOR THE HUMANITARIAN AND STATESMANLIKE ATTITUDE OF THE GOVERNMENT OF PANAMA. THE SHAH ENTERED THE US ON OCTOBER 22 FOR DIAGNOSIS AND EVALUATION OF HIS MEDICAL CONDITION AT CORNELL MEDICAL FACILITY IN NEW YORK.

ON DECEMBER 2, HE ENTERED WILFORD HALL AIR FORCE HOSPITAL AT LACKLAND AIR FORCE BASE TO CONTINUE HIS RECUPERATION. AFTER AN EXAMINATION AND CONSULTATION YESTERDAY, HIS PHYSICIANS, HEADED BY DR. BEN KEANE, ADVISED THE SHAH THAT HIS MEDICAL CONDITION DOES NOT PRECLUDE HIS TAKING UP RESIDENCE IN PANAMA. ( ) PLEASE NOTIFY FOREIGN MINISTER OF FOREGOING AND OF THE FOLLOWING USG VIEWS
WE REGARD THE DEPARTURE OF THE FORMER SHAH AS A POSITIVE STEP WHICH SHOULD ENHANCE THE CLIMATE FOR THE EARLY RELEASE OF THE HOSTAGES.
WE HAVE NOTED FAVORABLY THE DECISION OF THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT TO PERMIT INTERNATIONAL OBSERVERS TO VISIT THE HOSTAGES AND HOPE THAT THIS DECISION WILL BE SPEEDILY IMPLEMENTED.
THESE STEPS BY EACH SIDE WILL HOPEFULLY PRODUCE AN ENVIRONMENT CONDUCIVE TO AN EARLY RELEASE OF THE HOSTAGES.
THIS MESSAGE IS NUMBER 41. MESSAGE REGARDING DEPARTURE OF SHAH SHOULD HAVE BEEN NUMBER 40.

1979STATE330246.subject: TEXT OF U.S. SENATE RESOLUTION NO.318 ON GAINING THE RELEASE OF AMERICAN HIOSTAGES

segments.text: TO: U.S. CHARGE BRUCE L. LAINGEN FROM: IRAN WORKING GROUP THIS IS MESSAGE NUMBER 48.
THE FOLLOWING IS TEXT OF U.S. SENATE RESOLUTION NO. 318 PASSED ON DECEMBER 20, 1979.

WHEREAS SINCE NOVEMBER 4, UNITED STATES PERSONNEL HAVE BEEN HELD HOSTAGE IN IRAN, IN VIOLATION OF FUNDAMENTAL PRINCIPLES OF HUMAN RIGHTS AND INTERNATIONAL LAW; AND WHEREAS NUMEROUS NATIONAL GOVERNMENTS, INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS AND INSTITUTIONS, INCLUDING THE UNITED NATIONS SECURITY COUNCIL, HAVE CALLED FOR THE IMMEDIATE RELEASE OF THOSE BEING HELD HOSTAGE; AND WHEREAS THE INTERNATIONAL COURT OF JUSTICE, IN A UNANIMOUS OPINION, ORDERED THE IMMEDIATE RELEASE OF THE HOSTAGES, CITING THE HISTORIC INVIOLABILITY OF DIPLOMATIC ENVOYS AND EMBASSIES; AND WHEREAS THE CONGRESS AND PEOPLE OF THE UNITED STATES REMAIN FIRM, RESOLUTE, AND UNITED IN THEIR DETERMINATION TO OBTAIN THE IMMEDIATE, SAFE, AND UNCONDITIONAL RELEASE OF THE UNITED STATES PERSONNEL BEING HELD ILLEGALLY IN IRAN; AND WHEREAS IN THE FACE OF EXTRADORINARY PROVOCATIONS, THE UNITED STATES HAS CONSISTENTLY DEMONSTRATED ITS DESIRE TO RESOLVE THIS ISSUE BY PEACEFUL MEANS; AND WHEREAS THE LEADERS OF IRAN CONTINUE TO ACT IN CONTRAVENTION OF THE BASIC PRINCIPLES OF CIVILIZED SOCIETY AND IN DEFIANCE OF INTERNATIONAL LAW AND OF THE ACTIONS OF DULY CONSTITUTED INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS: NOW, THEREFORE BE IT RESOLVED, THAT THE SENATE EXPRESSES ITS FULL SUPPORT FOR THE PRESIDENT'S EFFORTS AND FOR THE COOPERATIVE EFFORTS WITH OTHER NATIONS AND INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS, TO WIN THE FREEDOM OF AMERICANS BEING HELD CAPTIVE IN IRAN; THAT THE SENATE CALLS ON ALL NATIONS TO JOIN WITH THE UNITED STATES IN COOPERATIVE EFFORTS TO SEVERELY RESTRICT ECONOMIC, DIPLOMATIC, AND COMMERCIAL RELATIONS WITH IRAN; THAT ANY TRIAL OR PUBLIC EXPLOITATION OF THE AMERICAN HOSTAGES WOULD BE REVIEWED BY THIS NATION AS ADDED PROVOCATION OF THE GRAVEST CHARACTER; THAT THE HOLDING OF THE HOSTAGES IN IRAN REMAINS THE CENTRAL AND PRIMARY ISSUE AND THAT THE AMERICAN PEOPLE WILL NOT BE DIVERTED FROM THEIR DETERMINATION TO OBTAIN THEIR IMMEDIATE RELEASE AND SAFE RETURN TO THE UNITED STATES; AND THAT THE SENATE WILL CONVENE AT THE CALL OF THE SENATE LEADERSHIP, AND IS PREPARED EXPEDITIOUSLY TO CONSIDER ANY RECOMMENDATION OF THE PRESIDENT AND ANY LAW OR MEASURE TO AID IN THE TASK OF GAINING THE FREEDOM OF THE HOSTAGES.
ATTEST: J.S. KIMMITT, SECRETARY OF THE UNITED STATES
TO: U.S. CHARGE L. BRUCE LAINGEN FROM IRAN WORKING GROUP THIS IS OUR MESSAGE NUMBER FORTY NINE. WE HAVE RECEIVED YOUR MESSAGE SEVENTY.
THE FOLLOWING IS TEXT FROM DECEMBER 23 HAYNES JOHNSON ARTICLE IN WASHINGTON POST. THOUGHT YOU WOULD APPRECIATE IT.

. KHOMEINI SUCCEEDS WHERE U.S. POLITICIANS FAILED --IN UNITING AMERICA. ON A BILLBOARD IN HOUSTON THE OTHER DAY A GROUP OF CITIZENS PUT UP THEIR CHRISTMAS MESSAGE FOR ALL THE SHOPPERS TO SEE. "THE PERFECT PRESENT," IT SAID. "SEND THE HOSTAGES HOME FOR CHRISTMAS." IT WAS, IN A WAY, THE MOST APPROPRIATE KIND OF MESSAGE FOR THIS SEASON. FOR THIS LAST CHRISTMAS OF THE 1970S IS SURELY ONE OF THE MOST SUBDUED IN YEARS. AFTER A DECADE OF SHOCKS TO THE NATION POLITICALLY AND ECONOMICALLY, A TRAVELER AROUND THE COUNTRY FINDS THE MOOD SOMBER, THE TONE QUIET, THE DISCOURSE SERIOUS.

IN OTHER TIMES, THE CALL FOR A "NATIONAL UNITY DAY" WOULD HAVE BROUGHT A CYNICAL CURL TO MANY LIPS. THE NAME ITSELF WAS REMINISCENT OF THOSE "HONOR AMERICA" DAYS THAT WE SAW SO OFTEN DURING THE DECADE. THEY WERE STAGED LARGELY FOR POLITICAL BENEFIT AND TO QUELL DISSENT, TO MAKE A PRESIDENT LOOK GOOD IN A TIME OF TROUBLE. BUT THIS TIME, THE NATION REALLY DOES SEEM UNITED. THOSE FLAGS THAT WERE WAVED FROM BRIDGES AND BUILDINGS AND PASSING CARS ACCURATELY REFLECTED THE SPIRIT OF THE COUNTRY. IRAN, IT APPEARS, HAS ACHIEVED SOMETHING BEYOND THE REACH OF OUR POLITICAL FIGURES IN YEARS.

IN A SUPPOSEDLY SELFINDULGENT-IF NOT SELFISH-SOCIETY, THE TAKING OF THOSE HOSTAGES HAS FORCED A STATE OF NATIONAL SELFLESSNESS AND INSTROSPECTION. MATERIALISTIC AMERICA, THE CELLOPHANE CIVILIZATION, AWASH IN CONSUMER GOODS, COMPLACENT, PREOCCUPIED WITH LOOKING OUT FOR NUMBER ONE-TO HEAR MANY OF THE CRITICS TELL ITIS EXHIBITING OTHER TRAITS OF CHARACTER, AND ADMIRABLY SO. ABOUT THIS TIME EVERY YEAR, THE USUAL SERMON GETS PREACHED BOTH FROM THE PULPIT AND BY THE ORACLES OF THE PRESS: "THE REAL MEANING OF CHRISTMAS." WHILE WE LISTEN AND GUILTILY NOD OUR AGREEMENT ABOUT OUR EXCESSES OF COMMERCIALISM AND ACQUISITIVENESS AND OUR GLUTTONOUS APPETITES, WE VIGOROUSLY TRAMPLE EACH OTHER IN OUR RUSH TO GET MORE.

BUT THIS YEAR, IF WHAT ONE SEES AND HEARS REFLECTS THE NATION AT LARGE, AMERICANS REALLY ARE THINKING ABOUT SOME OF THE VALUES IMPLICIT IN CHRISTMAS. AND THERE IS A CERTAIN IRONY IN THIS. WHAT HAS MOVED AMERICANS GOES BEYOND THE PROSPECT OF VIOLENCE OR AN INSULT TO SOME AMORPHOUS NATIONAL PRIDE. VIOLENCE HAS BECOME SO COMMON A STAPLE OF AMERICAN AND WORLD LIFE THAT WE ARE ALMOST INURED TO IT. PRESIDENTS AND PUBLIC LEADERS ARE MURDERED, AIRPLANES ARE HIJACKED, AND BRUTAL ACTS OF INDIVIDUAL PASSION COMMITTED DAILY. WE SEE IT ALL, LIVE AND IN COLOR, AND MOVE ON TO THE NEXT ACT.

NATIONAL HONOR NO LONGER HAS QUITE THE RING OF THE MORE INNOCENT PAST. WE KNOW TOO MUCH ABOUT OUR OWN MISTAKES TO BE TOO JINGOISTIC. WHAT STIRS SUCH EMOTIONS IS THE KNOWLEDGE THAT THESE ARE INNOCENT VICTIMS. EACH OF US CAN IDENTIFY WITH THEM, WITH THEIR FEARS AND DEPRIVATIONS AND HUMILIATIONS, THEIR SENSE OF HELPLESSNESS AND ISOLATION. WE ARE ALL HOSTAGES WITH THEM. A PEOPLE THAT CAN CARE SO DEEPLY ABOUT OTHER INDIVIDUALS THREATENED, ABUSED, AND TRAPPED IN FORCES BEYOND THEIR CONTROL CAN HARDLY BE CONSUMED WITH SELFISHNESS. THAT THIS COMES AT CHRISTMAS PROVIDES FITTING SYMBOLISM.

ONCE AGAIN WE ARE SEEING A DRAMA OF SUFFERING PLAYED OUT IN THE MIDDLE EAST AND CAST BY PEOPLE WHO COULD STEP OUT OF THE PAGES OF BIBLICAL CONFLICT. THE HUMAN REACTIONS OF SYMPATHY, ANGER AND THE DESIRE FOR REVENGE COLLIDE WITH OTHER EMOTIONS -WITH LOVE AND AFFECTION AND THE SPIRIT OF GOOD WILL-THAT ARE SUPPOSED TO BE THE HALLMARKS OF THE SEASON. THE THREAT OF WAR IN THE MOST COMBUSTIBLE AND ECONOMICALLY CRITICAL REGION OF THE WORLD MOCKS THE ANCIENT TIDINGS OF PEACE ON EARTH.

YET IF WE ARE LOOKING MORE INTO OUR OWN HEARTS THESE DAYS, WISHING TO SHARE THE PAIN OF THE HOSTAGES AND RELIEVE THEIR SUFFERING, THE EXPERIENCE CANNOT BE ALL BAD. IT MIGHT EVEN BRING MORE AWARENESS OF THE TIMELESS CHRISTMAS MESSAGE OF HOPE. FOR MANY, THE WORDS IN THE CAROL HAVE SPECIAL MEANING THIS YEAR: THE HOPES AND FEARS OF ALL THE YEARS ARE MET IN THEE
TO: U.S. CHARGE BRUCE LAINGEN FROM: IRAN WORKING GROUP
THIS IS OUR MESSAGE NO. FIFTY-TWO. WE HAVE RECEIVED YOUR MESSAGES NOS. SEVENTY-FOUR AND SEVENTY-FIVE.

DAS CONSTABLE CALLED IN IRANIAN CHARGE AGAH TO INFORM HIM OF DEVELOPMENTS IN AFGHANISTAN. CONSTABLE NOTED THAT WE HAVE REPORTS OF A LARGE-SCALE SOVIET AIRLIFT INTO KABUL ON DECEMBER 25-26 SUGGESTING THAT THE SOVIETS HAVE BEGUN TO MOVE ADDITIONAL COMBAT UNITS WITH FIELD EQUIPMENT, E.G., FIELD KITCHENS, AMBULANCES, ETC., INTO AFGHANISTAN. THE AIRLIFT, POSSIBLY INVOLVING SEVERAL HUNDRED AIRCRAFT TO KABUL AND ELSEWHERE, IS APPARENTLY CONTINUING. CONTINUED MOBILIZATION OF SOVIET FORCES NORTH OF THE AFGHAN BORDER SUGGESTS THAT THISAIRLIFT MAY BE A PRECURSOR TO THE MOVEMENT OF EVEN LARGER UNITS ACROSS THE BORDER.

THE BUILD-UP OF GROUND FORCESAND THE MASSING OF AIRBORNE UNITS IN AREA ADJACENT TO AFGHANISTAN PROBABLY AMOUNTS TO AT LEAST FIVE DIVISIONS AND THERE ARE INDICATIONS OF FURTHER MOBILIZATION BEYONDTHISLEVEL.

CONSTABLE TOLD AGAH THAT HE SPECIFICALLY WANTED TO NOTE THE SUBSTANTIAL INCREASE IN SOVIET TROOPS IN AFGHANISTAN AND ASSUMED IT WOULD BE A MATTER OF CONCERN TO IRAN. HE SAID THAT THE USG HOPED IRAN WOULD NOW CONSIDER SERIOUSLY WHETHER THE CONTINUING CONFRONTATION WITH THE U.S. IS IN IRAN'S INTEREST. HE ADDED THAT BEFORE THE SEIZURE OF THE HOSTAGES WE WERE PREPARED TO SEEK SATISFACTORY RELATIONS WITH THE REVOLUTIONARY GOVERNMENT AND THAT IT IS NOW IN THE WIDER INTERESTS OF IRAN AND OF ISLAM FOR THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT TO RECONSIDER ITS ATTITUDE TOWARD THE U.S. IN THE FACE OF NEW SOVIET MOVES.
PLEASE SHARE THE FOREGOING WITH FOREIGN MINISTER

1979STATE334169.subject: TEXT OF STATEMENT ON IRAN DELIVERED BY SECRETARY VANCE IN THE UN SECURITY COUNCIL DECEMBER 29, 1979

segments.text: TO: US CHARGE BRUCE LAINGEN FROM: IRAN WORKING GROUP THIS IS MESSAGE NO. 53

FOLLOWING IS TEXT OF STATEMENT ON IRAN DELIVERED BY SECRETARY VANCE IN THE UN SECURITY COUNCIL DECEMBER 29, 1979. BEGIN TEXT: MR. PRESIDENT: WE MEET TODAY AT A MOMENT WHEN THE PRINCIPLES UPON WHICH THIS GREAT INTERNATIONAL BODY RESTS ARE BEING SHARPLY CHALLENGED IN IRAN. MORE THAN EIGHT WEEKS HAVE PASSED SINCE OUR EMBASSY WAS SEIZED AND OUR PEOPLE AND THOSE FROM OTHER NATIONS WERE TAKEN HOSTAGE IN TEHRAN. ON THREE SEPARATE OCCASIONS, THIS COUNCIL HAS UNANIMOUSLY EXPRESSED THE WILL OF THE INTERNATIONAL COMMUNITY THAT THE HOSTAGES BE RELEASED IMMEDIATELY. FROM THE OUTSET, THE SECRETARY-GENERAL, WITH THE FULL COOPERATION OF THE UNITED STATES, HAS LABORED UNCEASINGLY FOR A PEACEFUL SOLUTION.

THE PRESIDENT OF THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY HAS TWICE URGED IRAN TO RELEASE THE HOSTAGES. THE INTERNATIONAL COURT OF JUSTICE HAS SPOKEN CLEARLY AND UNANIMOUSLY. GOVERNMENTS AND WORLD LEADERS, OF VARYING POLITICAL AND RELIGIOUS FAITHS, HAVE APPEALED FOR THE RELEASE OF OUR PEOPLE. AND THE UNITED STATES GOVERNMENT HAS, WITH DETERMINATION, PERSISTENCE AND PATIENCE, PURSUED EVERY PEACEFUL CHANNEL AVAILABLE TO US. THE RESPONSE OF THOSE WHO PERPETUATE THIS CRISIS -- THE TERRORISTS WHO HAVE INVADED OUR EMBASSY AND THE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN WHICH SUPPORTS THEM -- HAS BEEN DEFIANCE AND CONTEMPT.

THEY HAVE PLACED THEMSELVES BEYOND THE WORLD'S LAW AND BEYOND THE MORAL IMPERATIVES THAT ARE COMMON TO THE WORLD'S CULTURES AND RELIGIONS. AT THE HEART OF THIS MATTER ARE FIFTY MEN AND WOMEN -STILL CAPTIVE, STILL ISOLATED, STILL SUBJECT TO THE MOST SEVERE STRAINS. THE WORLD COURT IN ITS UNANIMOUS DECISION EXPRESSED CONCERN THAT CONTINUATION OF THESE CONDITIONS OF IMPRISONMENT "EXPOSES THE HUMAN BEINGS CONCERNED TO PRIVATION, HARDSHIP, ANGUISH, AND EVEN DANGER TO LIFE AND HEALTH, AND THUS TO A SERIOUS POSSIBILITY OF IRREPARABLE HARM." CLAIMS THAT THE HOSTAGES ARE WELL RING HOLLOW, FOR THE INTERNATIONAL COMMUNITY HAS BEEN DENIED EITHER CONSISTENT OR COMPREHENSIVE ACCESS TO THEM.

BUT LET US BE CLEAR: IT IS NOT ONLY FIFTY AMERICAN MEN AND WOMEN WHO ARE HELD HOSTAGE IN IRAN. IT IS THE INTERNATIONAL COMMUNITY. THIS IS FAR MORE THAN A CONFLICT BETWEEN THE UNITED STATES AND IRAN. IRAN HAS PLACED ITSELF IN CONFLICT WITH THE STRUCTURE OF LAW AND WITH THE MACHINERY OF PEACE ALL OF US HAVE PAINSTAKINGLY BUILT. THE TIME HAS COME FOR THE WORLD COMMUNITY TO ACT, FIRMLY AND COLLECTIVELY, TO UPHOLD INTERNATIONAL LAW AND PRESERVE INTERNATIONAL PEACE. WE MUST GIVE PRACTICAL MEANING TO THE PRINCIPLES AND PURPOSES OF OUR CHARTER.

AS LONG AS IRAN REMAINS INDIFFERENT TO THE VOICES OF REASON AND MERCY THAT HAVE BEEN RAISED FROM EVERY CORNER OF THE WORLD, AS LONG AS IT REFUSES TO RECOGNIZE THE COMMON RULES OF INTERNATIONAL BEHAVIOR, IT MUST ACCEPT THE CONSEQUENCES OF ITS DELIBERATE ACTIONS. MR.

PRESIDENT, ON NOVEMBER 25 THE SECRETARY-GENERAL ACTING UNDER ARTICLE 99 OF THE CHARTER, TOOK THE EXTRAORDINARY STEP OF REQUESTING AN URGENT MEETING OF THE COUNCIL TO DEAL WITH THIS CRISIS, STATING THAT "THE PRESENT CRISIS POSES A SERIOUS THREAT TO INTERNATIONAL PEACE AND SECURITY." THE COUNCIL'S RESOLUTION OF DECEMBER 4, ADOPTED UNANIMOUSLY, EXPRESSED THE COUNCIL'S DEEP CONCERN AT THE DANGEROUS LEVEL OF TENSION AND SPOKE OF POSSIBLE GRAVE CONSEQUENCES FOR INTERNATIONAL PEACE AND SECURITY.

THESE STATEMENTS, ALONG WITH THE MANY STATEMENTS OF CONCERN BY MEMBER STATES, MAKE CLEAR THE JUDGMENT OF THE INTERNATIONAL COMMUNITY THAT IRAN'S ACT OF TAKING AND HOLDING HOSTAGES REPRESENTS A VIOLATION OF THE LAW OF NATIONS AND THREATENS INTERNATIONAL PEACE AND SECURITY. IF IRAN CONTINUES TO HOLD THE HOSTAGES, AFTER THE COUNCIL AND THE WORLD COMMUNITY HAVE UNANIMOUSLY CALLED FOR THEIR RELEASE, ACTION AGAINST IRAN UNDER CHAPTER VII OF THE CHARTER IS NOT ONLY JUSTIFIED, BUT REQUIRED TO PROMOTE A PEACEFUL SOLUTION OF THE CRISIS.

IT IS THEREFORE INCUMBENT UPON ALL OF US AS MEMBERS OF THIS COUNCIL TO TAKE THE STEPS NECESSARY TO ENSURE THAT THE COUNCIL'S EARLIER UNANIMOUS DECISION IS IMPLEMENTED. MY GOVERNMENT THEREFORE SEEKS A RESOLUTION WHICH WOULD CONDEMN IRAN'S FAILURE TO COMPLY WITH EARLIER ACTIONS OF THE SECURITY COUNCIL AND OF THE INTERNATIONAL COURT CALLING FOR THE IMMEDIATE RELEASE OF ALL THE HOSTAGES.

THE RESOLUTION WOULD FURTHER PROVIDE FOR TWO ADDITIONAL STEPS: FIRST, REQUEST THE SECRETARY-GENERAL TO INTENSIFY HIS GOOD OFFICES' EFFORTS, NOTING HIS READINESS TO GO PERSONALLY TO TEHRAN AND TO REPORT BACK TO THE COUNCIL BY A SPECIFIED DATE; SECOND, DECIDE THAT, IF THE HOSTAGES HAVE NOT BEEN RELEASED WHEN THE COUNCIL MEETS AGAIN AT THE SPECIFIED EARLY DATE, THE COUNCIL WILL AT THAT TIME ADOPT SPECIFIC SANCTIONS UNDER ARTICLE 41 OF THE CHARTER. WE BELIEVE THAT THE CONTINUED SOLIDARITY OF THE INTERNATIONAL COMMUNITY WILL SERVE TO DEMONSTRATE THAN AN EARLY RESOLUTION OF THE PROBLEM IS TO THE BENEFIT OF ALL, INCLUDING THE PEOPLE AND LEADERS OF IRAN.

THE PROLONGATION OF THIS CRISIS IS IN NO ONE'S INTEREST. WE ARE NOT UNMINDFUL OF THE GRIEVANCES OF THE IRANIAN PEOPLE. WE RESPECT IRAN'S SOVEREIGNTY AND INDEPENDENCE AND THE RIGHT OF THE IRANIAN PEOPLE TO DECIDE THEIR OWN FORM OF GOVERNMENT. AS WE HAVE REPEATEDLY EMPHASIZED, ONCE THE HOSTAGES ARE RELEASED UNHARMED, WE ARE PREPARED, IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE UNITED NATIONS CHARTER, TO SEEK A RESOLUTION OF THE ISSUES BETWEEN US. WITH THE HOSTAGES' RELEASE, THE WAY WILL BE CLEAR FOR IRAN TO PRESENT ITS GRIEVANCES IN ANY APPROPRIATE FORUM.

THE UNITED STATES, HOWEVER, CANNOT RESPOND TO CLAIMS OF INJUSTICE WHILE OUR CITIZENS ARE HELD IN UNJUST CAPTIVITY, IN VIOLATION OF THE RESOLUTIONS AND ORDERS OF THE WORLD'S PRIMARY PEACEKEEPING INSTITUTIONS. AS A GREAT AMERICAN PRESIDENT, ABRAHAM LINCOLN -- A MAN OF DEEP COMPASSION AND UNDERSTANDING -- ONCE DECLARED: "THERE IS NO GRIEVANCE THAT IS A FIT OBJECT OF REDRESS BY MOB LAW." - MR. PRESIDENT, OUR PATIENCE AND FOREBEARANCE HAVE BEEN SEVERELY TESTED IN THESE PAST WEEKS. THEY ARE NOT UNLIMITED. WE HAVE MADE CLEAR FROM THE BEGINNING THAT WE PREFER A PEACEFUL SOLUTION TO THE OTHER REMEDIES THAT ARE AVAILABLE TO US UNDER INTERNATIONAL LAW.

IT IS IN THE INTEREST OF SUCH A PEACEFUL SOLUTION THAT TODAY WE CALL UPON THIS BODY TO ACT. " LET US ACT NOW TO PRESERVE THE WEB OF MUTUAL OBLIGATION WHICH BINDS US TOGETHER, AND SHIELDS US FROM CHAOS AND DISORDER. FOR THERE CAN BE NO EVASION OF THIS CENTRAL POINT: IF THE INTERNATIONAL COMMUNITY FAILS TO ACT WHEN ITS LAW IS FLOUTED AND ITS AUTHORITY DEFIED, WE NOT ONLY DIMINISH THE POSSIBILITY FOR PEACE IN THIS CRISIS; WE BELITTLE THIS INSTITUTION OF PEACE, ITSELF. EFFECTIVE ACTION BY THE SECURITY COUNCIL CAN BREATHE NEW LIFE INTO THE PROVISIONS OF THE CHARTER AND THE DECISIONS OF THIS COUNCIL.

IT CAN REMIND ALL OF US, NOW AND IN THE FUTURE, OF OUR SOLEMN OBLIGATION TO HEED THE JUDGMENTS OF THIS BODY AND TO PRESERVE ITS CENTRAL PLACE IN THE MAINTENANCE OF INTERNATIONAL PEACE AND SECURITY. LET US MOVE TOGETHER, IN A MANNER THAT IS CLEAR AND CONVINCING, TO DEMONSTRATE THAT THE RULE OF LAW HAS MEANING, AND THAT OUR MACHINERY OF PEACE HAS PRACTICAL RELEVANCE. LET US PROTECT, AS WE MUST, THE BASIC PROCESS THAT PERMIT NATIONS TO MAINTAIN CIVILIZED RELATIONS WITH ONE ANOTHER. THROUGH THE DECISIONS WE URGE ON THIS COUNCIL, TOGETHER WE CAN HASTEN THE DAY WHEN THIS ORDEAL IS RESOLVED.
AND THROUGH OUR DEMONSTRATED COMMITMENT TO THE PURPOSES OF OUR CHARTER, WE WILL STRENGTHEN BOTH THE PRINCIPLES AND THE INSTITUTIONS THAT SERVE WORLD PEACE AND PROTECT US ALL. .

1979TEHRAN00005.subject: COMMENTS OF JAMSHID HORMOZ, FORMER PRESIDENT, - IRANIAN STUDENTS FEDERATION IN AUSTRIA

segments.text: IRANIAN STUDENTS FEDERATION IN AUSTRIA

JAMSHID HORMOZ IS AUSTRIAN-EDUCATED ARCHITECT WHO WAS PRESIDENT OF ANTI-SHAH IRANIAN STUDENTS FEDERATION DURING HIS STUDENT DAYS IN VIENNA. HE WAS IDENTIFIED BY SAVAK WHILE ATTENDING A MEETING OF THE WORLD FEDERATION OF UNIVERSITY STUDENTS IN EAST GERMANY AND WAS ARRESTED UPON HIS RETURN TO IRAN IN 1971 ALTHOUGH HORMOZ CLAIMS THAT MEMBERSHIP IN THE FEDERATION WAS NOT AT THAT TIME ILLEGAL. ACCORDING TO HORMOZ HE WAS INTERROGATED, TORTURED (INCLUDING BEING THROWN DOWN A STAIRCASE, WHICH LATER REQUIRED AN OPERATION FOR A RUPTURED DISC) AND KEPT IN SOLITARY CONFINEMENT FOR 14 MONTHS WITHOUT EVER BEING FORMALLY CHARGED.

AFTER 18 MONTHS IN PRISON HE WAS BROUGHT TO TRIAL, WITH 20 MINUTES' NOTICE AND NO PRIOR PREPARATION, FOUND GUILTY AND SENTENCED TO 19 MONTHS IMPRISONMENT, WHICH INCLUDED THE 18 MONTHS HE HAD ALREADY SERVED. DURING DECEMBER 31 LUNCH AT HOME OF DR. HORMOZ MIRBABA'I, HORMOZ MADE FOLLOWING COMMENTS TO EMBOFF.

CLAIMING THAT HIS VIEWS ARE SIMILAR TO THOSE OF A MAJORITY OF IRANIAN STUDENTS AND THE UNIVERSITY COMMUNITY, HORMOZ STATED THAT THE IDEAL OUTCOME OF THE PRESENT POLITICAL STRIFE WOULD BE NOT ONLY THE ABDICATION OF THE SHAH BUT THE FORMATION OF A PEOPLE'S COURT TO TRY HIM FOR HIS CRIMES. THE COURT SHOULD BE HELD IN STRICT ACCORDANCE WITH IRANIAN LAW AND SHOULD PERMIT THE SHAH THE BEST LEGAL COUNSEL IN IRAN OR FROM ANY OTHER COUNTRY WHICH WOULD BE WILLING TO DEFEND HIM.

HORMOZ WAS CONFIDENT THAT THE RESULT OF ANY FAIR LEGAL PROCESS AGAINST THE SHAH WOULD BE TO "NAIL THAT SUCKER TO THE WALL" (LIBERAL TRANSLATION WHICH CONVEYS THE FEELING ACCURATELY). HOWEVER, HORMOZ FEELS THAT THE EVENTUAL OUTCOME OF THE POLITICAL STRUGGLE IN IRAN AND THE FORM OF ANY FUTURE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT SHOULD BE DECIDED BY VOTE OF THE PEOPLE. HIS ONLY CONDITION WOULD BE THAT ANY IRANIAN GOVERNMENT SHOULD PERMIT FREE EXPRESSION OF POLITICAL VIEWS.

ALTHOUGH HE CLAIMS NOT TO BE ANTI-AMERICAN AND INSISTS THAT THE IRANIAN PEOPLE HAVE NO QUARREL WITH THE U.S. PEOPLE, HORMOZ IS ADAMANTLY OPPOSED TO U.S. POLICY IN IRAN. THE U.S., HE SAID, HAS LEARNED NO LESSONS FROM ITS SUPPORT OF DICTATORS IN SOUTH KOREA, CHILE AND VIET NAM AND HAS REPEATED THE SAME MISTAKES IN IRAN. U.S. POLICYMAKERS HAVE RESTRICTED THEIR CIRCLE OF CONTACTS TO THOSE CLOSE TO THE SHAH AND CONSEQUENTLY THEY VIEWED IRAN THROUGH AN IMPERIAL PRISM. MOREOVER, THE USG HAS FOUND THE SHAH ALWAYS WILLING TO GIVE WHAT IT WANTED AND CONSEQUENTLY THE U.S. OVERLOOKED THE MANY CRIMES AND EXCESSES OF THE SHAH AND HIS FAMILY.

THE IRANIAN PEOPLE ARE NOT YET COMPLETELY OPPOSED TO THE U.S. BUT CONTINUED U.S. PUBLIC SUPPORT FOR THE SHAH NOT ONLY ALIENATES THE PEOPLE BUT WILL MAKE IT MUCH MORE DIFFICULT FOR ANY FUTURE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT TO WORK CLOSELY WITH THE USG.

GOI CAN BE EXPECTED TO BE WILLING ASSURE SAFETY OF DEPARTING AMERICANS. IN CURRENT CIRCUMSTANCES, TRAVELLING AT CAREFULLY SELECTED NOURS BY CONTROLLED ROUTES, SAFETY CAN PROBABLY BE ASSURED. CURRENT PLAN IS FOR INDINIDUAL TRAVEL, WITH SOME CONSOLIDATION BY COMPANIES FOR PRIVATE SECTOR. OFFICIAL DEPENDENTS WILL, AS BEFORE, TRAVEL BY CONVOY.
MAC FLIGHT SCHEDULED JAN 1 ABORTED WITH ENGINE TROUBLE AT TORREJON. THREE FLIGHTS SCHEDULED JAN 2.
WE WILL HAVE ASSESSMENT GERMAN, FRENCH, UK, JAPANESE PLANS AT 1630.
IF EUCOM/MAC ROLE BECOMES NECESSARY, I BELIEVE MULTILATERAL PARTICIPATION WOULD BE HELPFUL.
OUR BEST ESTIMATE IS THAT BAKHTIAR WILL FORM GOVERNMENT IN NEXT FEW DAYS. AZHARI HAS RESIGNED.

TRANSPORTATION SITUATION IN CITY HAS EASED SOMEWHAT JAN 1. THERE IS THEREFORE POSSIBILITY MINISTRIES MAY BE IN PARTIAL OPERATION. CONGEN HAS APPOINTMENT WITH MAGISTRATE LATE MORNING JANUARY 1 RE ROSS PEROT MEN. MAGISTRATE IS, HOWEVER, BEING STUBBORN DESPITE PERSONAL ASSURANCES RE PLAN FOR RELEASE WHICH I OBTAINED FROM PRIME MINISTER SHORTLY BEFORE HIS RESIGNATION. IT APPEARS PROBABLE THAT PEROT MAY HAVE TO POST THE BONDS REQUIRED BY THE MAGISTRATE IF HIS MEN ARE TO BE RELEASED. WE SHOULD KNOW MORE AT 1630. SULLIVAN

segments.text: AMBASSADOR OFFICIALLY DECLARED PHASE ONE OF IRAN E&E PLAN TO BE OPERATIVE DEC 31.

IN ADDITION TO VOLUNTARY DEPARTURE OF DEPENDENTS AMBASSADOR WILL ALSO ORDER TEMPORARY DEPARTURE TO CONUS OR SAFEHAVEN POSTS OF SOME OFFICIALS WHO BECAUSE OF CURRENT SITUATION ARE UNABLE TO FULFILL THEIR OFFICIAL RESPONSIBILITIES. AMBASSADOR MAY ALSO ORDER EMPLOYEES WHO ARE PRESENTLY OUT OF COUNTRY ON BUSINESS OR LEAVE NOT TO RETURN AT THIS TIME. SULLIVAN

AS POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT WILL MAKE CLEAR, WORD HAS ALREADY SPREAD AMONG AMERICAN REPORTERS, MANY LOCAL REPORTERS, AND THE TOP MILITARY THAT SHAH REALLY PLANS TO LEAVE THE COUNTRY FOR REST AND MEDICAL TREATMENT BUT INTENDS TO RETURN. TIMING IS INTENTIONALLY BEING LEFT VAGUE. WE HAVE NO REASON TO DOUBT ALL THIS.

SHAH'S DECISION TO YIELD ON QUESTION OF LEAVING THE COUNTRY IS PART OF HIS CONTINUING SYNDROME OF TOO LITTLE, TOO LATE. THERE IS A PSYCHOLOGICAL FACTOR WORKING ON THE OPPOSITION TOO, HOWEVER. MODERATES (INCLUDING WE UNDERSTAND THE IMPORTANT AYATOLLAHS IN COUNTRY) ARE BECOMING INCREASINGLY ANXIOUS ABOUT INTERNAL CHAOTIC SITUATION. THIS MIGHT RPT MIGHT INDUCE THEM TO ACCEPT BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT IN SILENCE, AND BY EXTENSION EVEN INFLUENCE SOME OF THE OPPOSITION LEADERS CLOSEST TO THEM (E.G. BAZARGAN) TO DO THE SAME. THEY ARE PRESUMABLY MAKING UP THEIR MINDS.

MEANWHILE, BAKHTIAR SEEMS TO BE PUTTING TOGETHER CABINET NAMES WITH CONSIDERABLE SUCCESS. (WE ARE GETTING SOME MORE OF THEM AND WILL REPORT WHEN THEY ARE MORE DEFINITE.) THAT WOULD INDICATE THAT SO FAR AT LEAST OPPOSITION HAS NOT TURNED THE HEAT ON THEM TO REFUSE PARTICIPATION, AS HAPPENED IN THE END TO SADIQI. APART FROM ALL THESE CONSIDERATIONS, SADIQI WAS 73 AND AILING; BAKHTIAR IS 64 AND IN GOOD HEALTH. UNDER PRESENT CONDITIONS HERE, GOOD HEALTH AND ENERGY ARE A DEFINITE PLUS. THUS TIMING, AGE, AND HEALTH COMBINE TO MAKE BAKHTIAR IN THE FINAL ANALYSIS A STRONGER CANDIDATE THAN SADIQI.
WHETHER THIS MEANS HE WILL SUCCEED WITH THE OPPOSITION REMAINS OF COURSE TO BE SEEN.

AS ALWAYS IN IRANIAN POLITICS, THERE IS ALSO A MORE SINISTER INTERPRETATION OF REASONS SHAH HAS MADE CONCESSIONS TO BAKHTIAR THAT HE APPARENTLY REFUSED TO SADIQI. THIS SCHOOL OF THOUGHT HOLDS THAT SADIQI WAS GENUINELY INDEPENDENT AND THAT SHAH COULD FEEL NO RPT NO CONFIDENCE THAT A DEPARTURE WITH SADIQI IN PLACE MIGHT NOT BE FINAL AND DEFINITIVE. IN CASE OF BAKHTIAR, THERE IS SOME WHISPERED SUGGESTION THAT HE IS IN THE SHAH'S PAY AND WOULD BE PREPARED TO ASSURE THE SHAH'S RETURN FROM A FOREIGN VISIT IF HE COULD ACTUALLY GAIN CONTROL OF THE COUNTRY THROUGH HIS GOVERNMENT.

PM AZHARI HAS SUBMITTED HIS RESIGNATION AND THE SHAH HAS ACCEPTED IT ORALLY, ASKING AZHARI TO CONTINUE HIS FUNCTIONS UNTIL A NEW GOVERNMENT CAN TAKE OVER. DUE TO AZHARI'S POOR STATE OF HEALTH (HIS HEART TROUBLE WAS SURFACED ON IRANIAN RADIO AND TV A COUPLE OF DAYS AGO) AZHARI'S FUNCTIONS WILL BE PERFORMED BY "HIS DEPUTY" (NO NAME GIVEN). AMBASSADOR ZAHEDI MEANWHILE HAD A PARTY LAST NIGHT FOR AMERICAN REPORTERS IN TOWN. HE WAXED CONFIDENT. HE TOLD THEM BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT ALL SET TO ROLL AND CONTAINED SUCH GOOD PEOPLE THAT OPPOSITTON WOULD NOT DARE OPPOSE THEM. HE THEN INTRODUCED GEN.

KHOSRODAD (PARATRROOP COMMANDER) WHO ASSURED THEM THE MILITARY WOULD BE VERY HAPPY TO SERVE UNDER GENERAL JAM (AS DEFENSE MINISTER, A NEW POSITION). HE SAID THE SHAH WOULD DEPART COUNTRY FOR MEDICAL TREATMENT AND A REST ONCE SITUATION ON THE GROUND IS STABILIZED (SAME SORT OF REPORT MADE OVER IRANIAN RADIO AND TV).

MAJLES IS CONSULTING URGENTLY ON BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT TODAY WITH APPROVAL VIRTUALLY CERTAIN. PRESS SOURCE WAS TOLD BY ZAHEDI THAT HIGH MILITARY OFFICERS CALLED ON SHAH YESTERDAY AND WERE TOLD HE WOULD LEAVE COUNTRY BUT RETURN, AND NOT TO WORRY. THEY ACCEPTED THAT. MEANWHILE, BAKHTIAR CALLED IN PUBLISHERS, EDITORS, AND REPRESENTATIVES OF IRANIAN PRESS WRITERS THIS MORNING AND TOLD THEM HE HAD COMPLETED HIS CABINET, EXPECTED MAJLES APPROVAL TUESDAY, SENATE AND ROYAL APPROVAL WEDNESDAY, AND WOULD INTRODUCE NEW GOVERNMENT THURSDAY OR SATURDAY. ON BASIS HIS 25 YEARS EXPERIENCE IN POLITICS HE PLEDGED FREEDOM OF THE PRESS, BUT ASKED THEY ACT RESPONSIBLY IN THE COUNTRY'S INTERESTS (I.E. SOME SELF-CENSORSHIP).

HE OFFERED TO ASK MILITARY GOVERNOR REMOVE TROOPS FROM NEWSPAPER PLANTS IMMEDIATELY SO THEY COULD AGAIN APPEAR. PRESS PEOPLE ACCEPTED THIS OFFER AND SAID THEY NEEDED ABOUT 24 HOURS TO GET READY TO START PUBLISHING AGAIN -I.E. BY WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 3.

MORNING WAS QUIET IN TEHRAN, EXCEPT THAT SOME HOUSES IN THE NORTH (NEAR TAJRISH) APPARENTLY SET ON FIRE IN EARLY MORNING HOURS. UNCONFIRMED REPORTS HAVE SHOOTING IN SEVERAL OTHER SECTIONS OF THE CITY, WITH POLICE RADIO SOUNDING AS IF POLICE STATION UNDER ATTACK IN FERDOWSI AREA. AMERICAN FULLBRIGHT GRANTEE TRAVELING ON BUS FROM ISFAHAN YESTERDAY REPORTS MOBS ENTIRELY IN CONTROL OF SOUTHERN TEHRAN, INSPECTING CARS ON ROAD UP FROM QOM, AND HE HAD CLOSE SHAVE AVOIDING IDENTIFICATION AS AN AMERICAN. NO MILITARY OR POLICE WERE IN SIGHT. (EMBASSY IS WARNING OTHER AMERICANS IN ISFAHAN OF THESE CONDITIONS)

STORIES FROM MASHAD YESTERDAY AND PRECEDING DAYS TOO MACABRE TO DETAIL. IN WIDESPREAD CLASHES, MOBS SEIZED SEVERAL POLICE STATIONS AND LYNCHED NUMBERS OF POLICEMEN, OFTEN IN GRUESOME MANNER. WIDESPREAD BURNINGS AND CLASHES, WITH NUMBERS KILLED GOING INTO HUNDREDS (OPPOSITION CLAIMING 500-700). NUMBERS OF SOLDIERS ALSO KILLED. TODAY SITUATION APPEARS TO BE QUIETER (THOUGH ONE OPPOSITION SOURCE SAYS KILLING CONTINUING) FOLLOWING ISSUANCE OF CALMING STATEMENTS BY AYATOLLAHS SHIRAZI AND QOMI.

UPI HAS REPORT 61 KILLED IN TABRIZ DURIN 48 HOURS ENDING YESTERDAY. HE ALSO REPORTED (AS DID BUSINESS SOURCE) THAT IT WAS BAD DAY IN KERMANSHAH YESTERDAY, WITH NUMEROUS DEAD, WIDESPREAD BURNING (INCLUDING GOVERNORGENERAL'S HOUSE), ETC. PRESS SOURCES HAVE REPORTS OF VIOLENCE IN ARDEBIL AND NUMBER OF OTHER TOWNS IN TABRIZ AREA.
EMBOFF SCHEDULED TO SEE PROF. RICHARD COTTAM LATER TODAY. COTTAM SAYS HE TALKED WITH KHOMEINI IN PARIS.

WITH THE RESIGNATION OF PRIME MINISTER AZHARI, IRAN IS EFFECTIVELY WITHOUT A GOVERNMENT AS IT ENTERS 1979. THE ANNOUNCEMENT OF AZHARI'S RESIGNATION INDICATED VAGUELY THAT "HIS DEPUTY" -- PRESUMABLY FOREIGN MINISTER AFSHAR -- IS IN CHARGE. BUT, IN ACTUAL FACT, ALL MINISTERS ARE AT HOME AND NO MINISTRY IS REALLY FUNCTIONING.

THE PARLIAMENT IS DEBATING THE ACCEPTABILITY OF BAKHTIAR AS THE NEW PRIME MINISTER AND BAKHTIAR IS CONFIDENTLY PREDICTING THAT HE WILL BE SWORN INTO OFFICE IN THE NEXT FEW DAYS. IN THE MEANTIME, THE PALACE HAS CONFIRMED, IN A DELIBERATELY CONFUSED FASHION, THAT THE SHAH EXPECTS TO LEAVE THE COUNTRY "FOR MEDICAL REASONS" AT "A CONVENIENT TIME".

THESE DEVELOPMENTS HAVE PRODUCED A SENSE OF CONSIDERABLE POLITICAL EXPECTATION IN IRAN. FROM REPORTS TO MID-AFTERNOON TEHRAN TIME, THE VIOLENCE OF STREET DEMONSTRATIONS HAS BEEN SOMEWHAT LESS INTENSE THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY. ALTHOUGH SEVERAL BONFIRES ARE BEING LIT AMONG THE UNCOLLECTED GARBAGE, THERE SEEM TO BE FEWER CONFRONTATIONS WITH TROOPS AND LESS SHOTS HAVE BEEN FIRED IN TEHRAN. THE SPARSE TRAFFIC MOVES LARGELY UNHINDERED. SIMILAR REPORTS CAME FROM OTHER CITIES.

DESPITE NATIONAL FRONT DENUNCIATIONS OF THE BAKHTIAR INITIATIVE, THERE APPEARS TO BE A WIDESPREAD ASSUMPTION THAT THE ARTICULATE OPPOSITION WILL PERMIT HIM TO FORM HIS GOVERNMENT. THERE ARE TWO REASONS FOR THIS ASSUMPTION, EACH SOMEWHAT AT ODDS WITH THE OTHER. THE FIRST REASON IS THE FEAR THAT THE ALTERNATE TO BAKHTIAR IS A HARSH MILITARY REACTION, WHICH WOULD RESULT IN ENORMOUS BLOODSHED. THE SECOND REASON IS THAT INSTALLATION OF THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT WILL BE THE VEHICLE WHICH WILL RESULT IN THE DEPARTURE OF THE SHAH FROM IRAN.

THE MODERATE OPPOSITIONISTS SEE THE DEPARTURE OF THE SHAH AS AN EVENT WHICH WILL PULL SUPPORT OUT FROM UNDER KHOMEINI, WHOM THEY REGARD MERELY AS A SYMBOL OF THE ANTI-SHAH FEELING WHICH HAS HELD ALL THE OPPOSITION GROUPS TOGETHER. THEY CONSEQUENTLY BELIEVE THAT, IF KHOMEINI'S CENTRAL RAISON D'ETRE DISAPPEARS, MORE RATIONAL POLITICAL LEADERS AND MORE MODERATE CLERGY CAN RALLY AROUND A POLITICAL SOLUTION WHICH WILL PRESERVE THE ESSENCE OF THE CONSTITUTIONAL STRUCTURE, BUT WITH A REGENCY COUNCIL IN LIEU OF THE SHAH. THEY WOULD NOT RPT NOT BE AVERSE, HOWEVER, TO AN ORDERLY REFERENDUM AT SOME LATER DATE ON THE QUESTION OF A MONARCHY VS. A REPUBLIC.

THE MORE EXTREME OPPOSITIONISTS, ON THE OTHER HAND, SEE THE DEPARTURE OF THE SHAH AS AN EVENT WHICH WILL CAUSE THE COLLAPSE OF BAKHTIAR'S GOVERNMENT, AN OBJECTIVE WHICH THEY WISH TO HASTEN ALONG BY CONTINUATION OF STRIKES, BY DEMONSTRATIONS, AND BY VIOLENCE AS NECESSARY. THEY WOULD THEN EXPECT KHOMEINI TO RETURN, THE ARMED FORCES TO COLLAPSE, AND THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC TO BE FORMED.

AS WILL BE NOTED, THE DEPARTURE OF THE SHAH "FOR MEDICAL REASONS" IS BY NOW ACCEPTED AS A FOREGONE CONCLUSION BY ALL RPT ALL POLITICAL FACTIONS. ONLY THE QUESTION OF TIMING IS DEBATED. THE GENERAL CONCLUSION IS THAT HE IS GIVING THE IMPRESSION OF A LEISURELY MOVE, WHILE, IN ACTUALITY, HE WILL BE PREPARED TO DEPART QUIETLY AND HASTILY AS SOON AS HE HAS INSTALLED BAKHTIAR, NAMED THE REGENCY COUNCIL, AND TIDIED UP THE LINES OF COMMAND FOR THE ARMED FORCES.

THE CENTRAL QUESTION, THEREFORE, IS WHETHER BAKHTIAR WILL BE ABLE TO FUNCTION EFFECTIVELY ONCE THE SHAH HAS GONE AND, IF SO, FOR HOW LONG. THERE ARE SOME WHO FEEL THE COUNTRY LONGS FOR A SURCEASE OF VIOLENCE AND WOULD ACCEPT A BAKHTIAR INTERLUDE, ESPECIALLY IF A SHARP CHALLENGE TO IT WOULD MEAN BLOODY MILITARY REACTION. THERE ARE OTHERS WHO FEEL THE EMOTIONS WHICH WILL BE RELEASED AT THE SHAH'S DEPARTURE WILL BE TOO GREAT TO BE CONTROLLED, EVEN BY HARSH MILITARY ACTION.

GIVEN THESE OPTIONS AND ASSUMPTIONS, THE UNITED STATES MUST OBVIOUSLY HOPE FOR THE SUCCESS OF BAKHTIAR AND THE MAINTENANCE OF INTEGRITY AMONG THE ARMED FORCES. WE SHOULD ALSO BE PREPARED TO RECOGNIZE THAT, IF THE SHAH LEAVES, HE MAY NEVER BE ALLOWED TO RETURN. THEREFORE, WASHINGTON SHOULD BEGIN TO POSITION ITSELF FOR THESE CONTINGENCIES AND SHOULD GIVE SPECIAL CARE AND ATTENTION ------------------050919 011502Z /41 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 2583 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 00017 EXDIS (DISTRIBUTE AS NODIS) TO THE PUBLIC STATEMENTS TO BE MADE BY AUTHORITATIVE U.S. SPOKESMEN AS THE NEXT FEW DAYS UNFOLD. SULLIVAN

I AM CONCERNED THAT FIRST PARAGRAPH OF DEPT'S PROPOSED PRESS STATEMENT FOR JANUARY 2 COULD GIVE KISS OF DEATH TO BAKHTIAR. IT IS IMPORTANT TO REMEMBER THAT HE IS NOT RPT NOT YET FORMALLY DESIGNATED AS PRIME MINISTER. I THINK IT IS IMPRUDENT TO NAME HIM IN FIRST PARAGRAPH OF STATEMENT. THEREFORE, RECOMMEND FIRST SUB-PARAGRAPH OF PARA 3 REFTEL SHOULD BE REVISED AS FOLLOWS: - : THE FUNDAMENTAL CONCERNS OF THE UNITED STATES IN IRAN ARE FOR THAT COUNTRY'S STABILITY, INDEPENDENCE AND ORDERLY POLITICAL AND ECONOMIC EVOLUTION. FRIENDSHIP AND CLOSE TIES WITH THE IRANIAN PEOPLE AND THEIR GOVERNMENTS HAVE BEEN A CONSTANT POLICY OF THE U.S. GOVERNMENT.

FOR SEVERAL WEEKS EFFORTS HAVE BEEN UNDERWAY IN IRAN TO ESTABLISH A NEW GOVERNMENT OF NATIONAL CONCILIATION AND THE IMPLEMENTATION OF ALL ASPECTS OF THE IRANIAN CONSTITUTION. WE HOPE THESE EFFORTS WILL SUCCEED IN ENDING THE VIOLENCE AND RESTORING STABILITY AND COHESION TO THE IRANIAN NATION. UNQUOTE.

MY SUGGESTION IS THAT IT WOULD BE TIMELY FOR US TO BEGIN SUCH DISCREET CONTACTS. COTTAM SUGGESTS YAZDI MAY BE MOST IMPORTANT AND MOST RATIONAL IN THE GROUP I PRESUME YOU HAVE IN MIND. I KNOW PRECHT HAS ALREADY MET HIM. IF HE IS BACK IN PARIS, PERHAPS CHAPMAN COULD PICK HIM UP. IF HE IS IN TEXAS, HE COULD PERHAPS BE INDUCED TO VISIT WASHINGTON QUIETLY AND BE ASKED TO GIVE NO RPT NO PUBLICITY TO HIS MEETINGS.

1979TEHRAN00058.subject: PHONE CAL FROM A CLARK TODD OF NBC NEWS ON POLITICAL SITUATION

segments.text: 081972 051749Z /50 FM MINISTRY FOREIGN AFFAIRS TEHRAN/IRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 0000 UNCLAS TEHRAN 0058 TO: DEPARTMENT OF STATE WASHINGTON DC IRAN WORKING GROUP FROM: LAINGEN THIS IS MESSAGE 58.
I TOOK A PHONE CALL TODAY THAT TURNED OUT TO BE FROM A CLARK TODD OF NBC NEWS. HE SAID HE HAD DEEN GIVEN A GOAHEAD BY M.F.A. TO CALL US.
HE SAID HE CALLED TO ASK WHAT OUR EXACT STATUS WAS IN LIGHT OF WHAT HE SAID HAD BEEN STATEMENT FROM OCCUPIERS AT EMBASSY YESTERDAY THAT WE WERE NOW HOSTAGES IN SAME SENSE AS THOSE AT COMPOUND.
I SAID I DID NOT WANT TO GET INVOLVED IN PRESS INTERVIEWS AT THIS TIME SINCE IF I DID SO IT WOULD TRIGGER NUMBEROUS SUCH REQUESTS AND I DID NOT THINK THIS WOULD BE HELPFUL.

I SAID I DID NOT WISH TO ENGAGE IN ANY DISCUSSION OF OUR STATUS, REFERRING HIM INSTEAD TO WHAT FOREIGN MINISTER HAS SAID ON THE RECORD, I SAID HE MIGHT ALSO CHECK WITH DEPARTMENT. I SAID WE WERE WELL AND I APPRECIATED HIS INTEREST.

FOR YOUR INFORMATION, FOREIGN MINISTER QUOTED IN PARIS NEWS AGENCY INTERVIEW IN TEHRAN TIMES TODAY AS SAYING THAT WE HAD BEEN GRANTED ASYLUM AT MINISTRY AND THAT SO LONG AS THEY REMAIN AT MINISTRY, I PLEDGE THAT NO HARM WILL BE DONE TO THEM. BUT THESE MEN, WITHOUT DOUBT, HAVE COMMITTED CRIMES TOO. THEREFORE, AS SOON AS THEY LEAVE THE MINISTRY COMPOUND, THEY WILL FALL IN THE HANDS OF JUSTICE AND I WOULD BE THE FIRST TO DEMAND THEIR ARREST AND TRAIL. END . END 5TH DECEMBER 1979.

WITH PERMISSION OF THE AMBASSADOR, CONSUL METRINKO ANNOUNCED TODAY THAT CONSULATE TABRIZ WILL BE CLOSED "FOR RENOVATIONS FOR ONE WEEK." DECISION WHETHER CONSULATE WILL OPEN NEXT WEEK WILL BE TAKEN AFTER REVIEW OF SECURITY SITUATION IN TABRIZ. METRINKO INFORMED US THAT LARGE CROWDS HAVE PUSHED TOWARDS HIS CONSULATE FOR SEVERAL DAYS IN A ROW AND THAT HIS LOCAL EMPLOYEES ARE NOW GREATLY CONCERNED ABOUT THEIR SECURITY. METRINKO WILL REMAIN AT CONSULATE IN ORDER TO PROVIDE WHATEVER ASSISTANCE IS POSSIBLE TO AMERICAN CITIZENS BUT ALL VISA ACTIVITIES WILL BE ENDED. HE ALSO HOPES TO HAVE SOME TIME AVAILABLE TO BE ABLE TO REPORT TO US ON THE SITUATION IN THAT CITY.

THE ICA ACADEMIC CENTER IN DOWNTOWN TEHRAN HAS ALSO CLOSED ITS DOORS FOR ONE WEEK. IN VIEW OF ADDITIONAL THREATS TO THE ICA BUILDING (DEMONSTRATORS ARE NOW WIDELY CALLING IT THE CIA HEADQUARTERS AND GIVE THE ADDRESS OF THE BUILDING TO OTHER DEMONSTRATORS), ALL EMPLOYEES EXCEPT SHELLENBERGER, ROSEN AND ONE SECRETARY WILL NOT COME TO THE OFFICE FOR REMAINDER OF THIS WEEK. THOSE ICA EMPLOYEES WHO HAVE BEEN RELEASED FROM THEIR ICA DUTIES WILL HELP THE EMB IN THE CONSULAR SECTION OR MISSION

SUMMARY: PM-DESIGNATE BAKHTIAR HAS ENCOUNTERED SOME POLITICAL CROSS-CURRENTS IN PREPARING CABINET. HE NOW CLAIMS THREE-FOURTHS OF MINISTERS HAVE BEEN CHOSEN AND PRESENTATION TO SHAH WILL COME JAN 4, WITH GOVERNMENT TO GO BEFORE MAJLES JAN 6, SENATE TWO DAYS LATER. AT THAT TIME, SHAH WILL PUBLICLY STATE HE IS READY TO LEAVE IRAN. SOME SLIPPAGE IN CABINET SELECTIONS SUGGESTS BAKHTIAR IS ENCOUNTERING DIFFICULTY GETTING MEN ACCEPTABLE TO PARTS OF OPPOSITION TO SERVE IN TOP JOBS. BAKHTIAR SAYS HIS MAN IN OIL FIELDS TELLS HIM WORKERS ARE SPLIT BETWEEN ISLAMIC TYPES WHO WANT TO SETTLE ON BAZARGAN'S TERMS AND HARD-CORE TUDEH-LED LEFTISTS WHO WANT TO KEEP STRIKE GOING. END SUMMARY.

DURING BRIEF CALL BY EMBOFF STEMPEL, PM-DESIGNATE BAKHTIAR SAID HE HAS NOW SELECTED THREE-FOURTHS OF HIS CABINET, BUT PRESENTATION TO SHAH HAS BEEN PUT BACK TO JAN 4. BAKHTIAR DESCRIBED THIS AS NATURAL VAGARIES OF POLITICAL PROCESS, SAYING IT COUNTERBALANCED BY VERY POSITIVE REACTION TO HIS REMARKS OVER IRANIAN RADIO JAN 1. AFTER PRESENTATION TO SHAH, GOVERNMENT WILL GO BEFORE MAJLES FOR FORMAL CONFIRMATION JAN 6 WITH PRESENTATION TO THE SENATE TWO DAYS LATER.

AT PRESENTATION TO MAJLES, BAKHTIAR SAYS SHAH WILL MAKE SPEECH IN WHICH HE WILL AFFIRM HE IS CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCH WHO WILL REIGN, NOT RULE. HE WILL THEN PUBLICLY STATE THAT HE IS READY TO LEAVE COUNTRY FOR HEALTH REASONS. BAKHTIAR DESCRIBED EXACT TIMING OF DEPARTURE AS "EXTREMELY DELICATE" QUESTION.

WHILE ABOVE IS CLEARLY POSITIVE DEVELOPMENT, BAKHTIAR HAS HAD SOME DIFFICULTY IN PAST TWO DAYS LINING UP CABINET. ONE SIGN IS HIS UNWILLINGNESS TO DISCUSS NAMES FURTHER WITH EMBOFF. ANOTHER IS A SEEMING RETREAT BY HIS FOREIGN MINISTER NOMINEE, KAZEMI (SEE REFTEL). NOW BAKHTIAR SAYS HE HIMSELF WILL HANDLE MINISTRY, BUT KAZEMI WILL RUN IT AS DEPUTY MINISTER (THIS WOULD FIT WITH REPORT FROM ANOTHER SOURCE THAT KAZEMI HAD RULED OUT SERVING AS MINISTER UNDER BAKHTIAR). BAKHTIAR ALSO SAID GEN. JAM WAS THINKING OVER WAR MINISTRY POST BECSE OF HIS SON'S ILLNESS IN LONDON.

(COMMENT: JAM IS LYNCH PIN FOR HOLDING MILITARY IN LINE, AND SON'S ILLNESS SOUNRDLIKE LAME EXCUSE TO US, SINCE SON HAS BEEN ILL FOR SEVERAL YEARS ACCORDING TO ANOTHER SOURCE.) PM-DESIGNATE SAID HE WOULD ALSO HANDLE INTERIOR MINISTRY HIMSELF AND WOULD PROBABLY DELAY NAMING FINANCE MINISTER UNTIL REST OF GOVERNMENT SWORN IN. HE ADDED ONLY FOLLOWING NAMES AS DEFINITELY SET: EDUCATION, MOHAMMAD MAYESHERI; HEALTH, DR. RAZMARA; AND COMMUNICATIONS, DR. SAMIMI. DESPITE PROBLEMS, HE SAID CABINET WOULD BE READY BY JAN 4.

ONE OTHER GLITCH WAS REPORT FROM BAKHTIAR'S MAN ON BAZARGAN'S OIL PEACE COMMITTEE, ENG. HASIBI (NOTE NAME CORRECTION FROM REFTEL) WHO SAID OIL WORKERS ARE SPLIT INTO TWO GROUPS--THOSE WHO ARE READY TO SETTLE ON ORIGINAL KHOMEINI TERMS--ARMY OUT, DOMESTIC PRODUCTION ONLY, NO ARRESTS--AND A HARD-CORE GROUP OF TUDEH (COMMUNIST) LED LEFTISTS WHO ARE HOLDING OUT FOR CONTINUED STRIKE EFFORT TO RUIN BAKHTIAR'S INITIATIVE IN HOPE THAT MORE RADICAL SOLUTION WILL DEVELOP.

BAKHTIAR BELIEVES KHOMEINI AND ONE OF HIS IN-COUNTRY AYATOLLAHS, ROUHANI, MAY HAVE EVEN BEEN SUPPORTING COUNTER-SETTLEMENT EFFORTS UNDER THE TABLE (COMMENT: WHILE THIS SOUNDS A BIT TORTUOUS TO US, SITUATION IS GA-GA ENOUGH THAT IT CAN'T BE RULED OUT.).

GENERAL COMMENT: BAKHTIAR HAS DEFINITELY ENCOUNTERED SOME HEAVY SLEDDING IN PIECING TOGETHER HIS CABINET, BUT PROCESS IS GOING FORWARD. AS EMBOFF WAS LEAVING, SEVERAL "NOTABLES" WERE WAITING TO ENTER AND WERE ATTRACTING ATTENTION OF BBC CAMERA CREW WHICH HAS STAKED OUT BAKHTIAR'S HOME. MAJOR PROBLEM IS POTENTIAL DIFFICULTY WITH JAM; WITHOUT HIM, IT WOULD BE EXTREMELY DIFFICULT IF NOT IMPOSSIBLE FOR BAKHTIAR TO HOLD MILITARY IN LINE, UNLESS ANOTHER GENERAL ACCEPTABLE TO DISSIDENTS CAN BE FOUND, AND FRANKLY, THIS SEEMS UNLIKELY TO US. SULLIVAN

segments.text: SUMMARY: CONTINUED DEMONSTRATIONS AND ECONOMIC PARALYSIS. INCREASED MOB ACTION AGAINST SECURITY FORCES. MAJOR VIOLENCE IN MASHAD. BAKHTIAR ADDRESSED NATION LAST NIGHT IN MIDST OF 10 HOUR POWER BLACKOUT. END SUMMARY

PARALYSIS OF IRAN CONTINUES AND EVEN INCREASES, AS DWINDLING SUPPLIES OF PETROLEUM PRODUCTS DRY UP. TEHRAN STREETS, USUALLY CLOGGED WITH WORLD'S WORST TRAFFIC, ARE RELATIVELY EMPTY EVEN DURING PEAK RUSH HOUR. THE ONLY PLACE WHERE TRAFFIC JAMS DO OCCUR IS IN THE LINES OF GAS STATIONS, MANY OF WHICH ARE CLOSED WHILE AWAITING DELIVERY. SOME MOTORISTS SLEEP IN THEIR CARS IN ORDER TO REMAIN IN LINE. MANY SHOPS ARE CLOSED.

STUDENT GROUPS WERE ON THE MOVE AGAIN YESTERDAY IN TEHRAN, OPERATING IN SAME CENTRAL AREA, PLUS A GROUP IN AUTOMOBILES IN THE NORTH WHO PASSED THROUGH RESIDENTIAL DISTRICT, SHOUTING THREATS. ON THE WHOLE, HOWEVER, GANG ACTIVITY WAS LIGHTER THAN PREVIOUSLY. POST-CURFEW ROOFTOP RALLIES WERE EVIDENT IN SEVERAL AREAS, REMINISCENT OF FIRST DAYS OF MOHARRAM. IN ADDITION, DISSIDENTS SOCKED TEHRAN WITH ITS WORST POWER BLACKOUT OF THIS SERIES -NEARLY TEN HOURS. PAST TWO DAYS HAVE ALSO BROUGHT INCREASE IN TELEPHONED DEATH THREATS TO AMERICANS. SHORTAGE OF FUEL MAY ALSO BE RESPONSIBLE IN PART FOR LENGTH OF BLACKOUT.

CONSULATES SHIRAZ AND ISFAHAN REPORT SITUATION QUIET ON JAN 1. CONSULATE TABRIZ REPORTS MORE DEMONSTRATIONS YESTERDAY. WE HAVE UNCONFIRMED REPORTS OF VIOLENCE IN DEZFUL AND QAZVIN. MOBS HAVE ATTACKED ITALIAN GUEST HOUSES IN BANDAR ABBAS AND KAZERUN, CAUSING EVACUATION OF PREMISES. MOB VIOLENCE HAS INCREASINGLY TURNED ON SECURITY FORCES OF PRO-SHAH SYMPATHIZERS, AND WE ARE GETTING REPORTS, MOST OF THEM UNCONFIRMED, OF CROWDS DRAGGING SOLDIER OR PRO-SHAH FIGURE FROM HIS HOUSE AND KILLING HIM. FAMILY OF ARMY COLONEL WHO WAS KILLED IN TEHRAN RECENTLY BY MOB WERE AFRAID TO TRY TO BURY HIM IN BEHESHT-E-ZARA.

MASHAD HAS BEEN MAIN ARENA FOR THIS LAST ACTIVITY AND FOR VIOLENCE IN GENERAL. WE HAVE MANY SOMEWHAT CONFLICTING REPORTS OF CLASH THERE DEC 31. WHILE SOME DETAILS ARE UNCLEAR, THERE IS NO DOUBT TROOPS FIRED INTO CROWD. SOME REPORTS INDICATE MOB WENT ON RAMPAGE, TOOK OVER CITY STREETS (COMMENT: THEY HAVE CERTAINLY DONE SO IN THE PAST), THEN HEADED FOR AIRPORT TO DESTROY MILITARY AIRCRAFT. TROOPS ALLEGEDLY BLOCKED THEIR PATH AND, WHEN THEY COULD NOT STOP THEM, OPENED FIRE. GOVT ACKNOWLEDGES 106 DEAD, BUT OTHER REPORTS CLAIM MORE THAN 400.

WE ALSO HAVE TWO SEPARATE REPORTS THAT TROOPS STORMED HOUSE OF AYATOLLAH SHIRAZI, ALLEGEDLY TO FREE THREE OFFICERS WHO WERE HELD HOSTAGE AND WHOM MOB THREATENED TO EXECUTE. SHIRAZI AND AYATOLLAH GHOMI ARE BOTH REPORTEDLY NOW IN HIDING. MASHAD WAS QUIET YESTERDAY, WITH CROWD APPARENTLY COWED BY TOUGH MILITARY ACTION. (COMMENT: MASHAD HAS BEEN CITY WHERE, MORE THAN ANY OTHER, MOB HAS CONTROLLED STREETS AND DEFIED TROOPS. HYATT HOTEL, FOR EXAMPLE, HAS BEEN TURNED INTO HOSPITAL AT CROWD'S INSISTENCE. CROWD ALSO BROKE OPEN WOMEN'S PRISON, REPORTEDLY WITH HELP OF SOME POLICE AND TROOPS, AND FREED INMATES.)

HE OFFERED A LIST OF CONCILIATORY PLEDGES, INCLUDING POSSIBILITY THAT HERETOFORE ILLEGAL PARTIES MAY PARTICIPATE IF IT CAN BE SHOWN THEY HAVE NO FOREIGN CONNECTION. BAKHTIAR DID NOT MENTION PREVIOUS NIRT ANNOUNCEMENT THAT THE SHAH HAS AGREED TO GO ABROAD "TEMPORARILY" FOR HEALTH REASONS.

BAKHTIAR'S SPEECH HAS, NOT SURPRISINGLY, FAILED TO DETER TEHRAN STREET GANGS. THIS MORNING LARGE CROWD HAS ASSEMBLED NEAR TEHRAN UNIVERSITY, AND SMALLER GROUPS HAVE RECEIVED WARNING SHOTS AT SEVERAL LOCATIONS IN CENTRAL AND NORTH TEHRAN. TRUCK HAS BEEN SET AFIRE ON TAKHTE JAMSHID AND HAFEZ, NOT FAR FROM EMBASSY. CONSULATE TABRIZ REPORTS FURTHER TROUBLE AND DEMONSTRATIONS. CONSUL HAS LEARNED THAT PILOTS AT LOCAL AIR FORCE BASE HAVE BEEN ISSUED SIDEARMS TO ASSIST IN DEFENSE OF THE BASE.

CONSUL TABRIZ ALSO REPORTS TURKISH CONSUL HAD TO LEAP FROM ROOF TO ROOF TO ESCAPE WHEN MOB BURNED CONSULATE. THERE IS MUCH LOCAL SUSPICION THAT TUDEH PARTY, UNDER SOVIET GUIDANCE, SPEARHEADED ATTACK ON TURKISH CONSULATE IN ORDER TO COMPLICATE TURKISH-IRANIAN RELATIONS.
TODAY PRINCESS SHAHNAZ, (SHAH'S DAUGHTER BY HIS FIRST WIFE FAWZIA) AND HER DAUGHTER RECEIVED VISAS'S TO VISIT UNITED STATES.

LATE ITEM: AMCIT DIRECTOR OF MASHAD IAS HAS TELEPHONED REPORTING MILITARY ARE ASSERTING CONTROL THERE IN VERY HEAVY HANDED WAY. HOWEVER, WHEN MILITARY ARE OUT OF SIGHT STREET CROWDS GATHER RAPIDLY AND HAVE BEEN BURNING VEHICLES INDISCRIMINATELY. MOST CARS ARE OUT OF GAS AND THEREFORE SITTING TARGETS. SOURCE REPORTS BULK OF MASHAD POPULATION ISHUDDLING IN HOMES, LEAVING ONLY TO PURCHASE BREAD.

1979TEHRAN00063.subject: MOHAMMAD HOSSAIN KHAN QASHQAI COMMENTS ON BAKHTIAR CANDIDACY AND GENERAL FEREIDUN JAM

segments.text: BAKHTIAR CANDIDACY AND GENERAL FEREIDUN JAM

DURING JAN 1 DISCUSSION WITH MOHAMMAD HOSSAIN KHAN (MHK) QASHQAI IN LATTER'S APARTMENT, QASHQAI IL-KHAN COMMENTED TO EMBOFF THAT QASHQAI FAMILY WOULD BE PREPARED TO SUPPORT SHAHPOUR BAKHTIAR AS PRIME MINISTER UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS. FRIENDSHIP BETWEEN THE TWO GOES BACK TO TIME OF REZA SHAH, AND THE BAKHTIAR AND QASHQAI FAMILIES HAVE FREQUENTLY INTERMARRIED FOR THE PAST150 YEARS.

HOWEVER, MHK EMPHASIZED THAT QASHQAI SUPPORT FOR BAKHTIAR'S GOVERNMENT, SHOULD ONE BE FORMED, WOULD BE MUCH GREATER "IF SHAHPOUR DOES NOT COME WITH EMPTY HANDS." MHK BELIEVES THAT, SHOULD BAKHTIAR ASSUME THE PRIME MINISTRY JAN 3 WITHOUT ANNOUNCING THE SHAH'S IMMINENT DEPARTURE, FOR MEDICAL TREATMENT OR WHATEVER, THE PEOPLE WILL BE DEMONSTRATING IN THE STREETS AGAINST BAKHTIAR BY JAN 6. DURING CONVERSATION MHK RECEIVED PHONE CALL FROM GATCHSARAN DESCRIBING DEMONSTRAION THERE BY 3000 BAKHTIARIS AND QASHQAIS AND NOTING THAT SHOULD BAKHTIAR ACCEPT THE PRIME MINISTRY WITHOUT WRINGING CONCESSIONS FROM THE SHAH, THIS WOULD BRING SHAME TO THE BAKHTIARIS AND HIS SUPPORT AMONG THE TRIBE WOULD WANE.

ACCORDING TO MHK, THE PEOPLE WILL BE LESS CONCERNED ABOUT THE KEROSENE AND GASOLINE SHORTAGES AND MORE INTERESTED IN BAKHTIAR'S ACTIONS REGARDING SAVAK AND THE ARMY. THE SECURITY ORGANIZATION SHOULD BE DISBANDED AND, IF SOME SIMILAR ORGANIZATION MUST EXIST, ITS NAME MUST BE CHANGED. MARTIAL LAW MUST SOON BE ENDED AND MANY OF THE TOP GENERALS RELIEVED OF THEIR POSITIONS. MHK, WHO IS NOT FOND OF IRAN'S MILITARY LEADERSHIP, PARTICULARLY GEN. OVEISSI, CAUTIONED EMBOFF NOT TO THINK OF IRANIAN GENERALS IN SAME TERMS AS ALLIED WWII COMMANDERS BUT RATHER AS SYCOPHANTS IN UNIFORM WHO OBTAINED THEIR POSITIONS THROUGH LOYALTY RATHER THAN MILITARY ABILITY. EXCEPTION IS GEN.

FEREIDUN JAM, WHO MHK EXPECTS TO SEE JAN 2, WHOSE FALL FROM GRACE RESULTED FROM THREE FACTORS: --JAM'S DESCRIPTION OF ORDER TO FIRE ON 1971 DEMONSTRATORS MARCHING TO TEHRAN FROM KARAJ AS "STUPID". JAM HAD NOT REALIZED THAT THEN SAVAK CHIEF NASSIRI HAD CONSULTED SHAH, WHO WAS THEN IN PAKISTAN,AND OBTAINED IMPERIAL PERMISSION TO FIRE; --JAM'S OPPOSITION TO PURCHASE OF NEW MILITARY SYSTEMS BEFORE IRANIAN PERSONNEL FULLY TRAINED TO CARE AND MAINTAIN SYSTEMS ALREADY IN HAND. HIS OPPOSITION WAS REPORTED TO SHAH BY GEN. TOUFANIAN AND DR. AYADI; --JAM'S REMARK, IN PAKISTAN, THAT HE LOVED SHAH LIKE A BROTHER, WHICH THE SHAH FOUND PRESUMPTUOUS.

MHK, WHO MET WITH BAKHTIAR THIS MORNING AND EXPECTS TO SEE HIM AGAIN JAN 2, DESCRIBED HIM AS SOMEWHAT TOO PLAIN-SPEAKINGFOR A SUCCESSFUL POLITICIAN. ESPECIALLY IN THE AREA OF RELIGION, WHERE BAKHTIAR MAKES CLEAR HIS DISTASTE FOR KHOMEINI, MHK FEELS BAKHTIAR WOULD DO BETTER TO REMAIN SILENT.

IT IS STILL NOT CLEAR TO MHK IF BAKHTIAR WILL SUCCEED IN FORMING A CABINET. SANJABI'S DECISION TO READ HIM OUT OF THE NATIONAL FRONT AND FEELINGS AMONG MEMBERS OF BAKHTIAR'S IRAN PARTY THAT HE HAS TOO GREAT A TENDENCY TOWARD UNILATERAL, UNCOORDINATED ACTION WILL EAT INTO HIS SUPPORT.

HOMAN KHAN QASHQAI, MHK'S SON, WHO WAS ALSO PRESENT, EXPRESSED THE VIEW THAT THERE IS LITTLE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN BAKHTIAR'S PROGRAM AND THE ONE WHICH SANJABI PUT FORWARD. THEREFORE, WHY SHOULD THE SHAH NOT CHOOSE SANJABI, WHO ENJOYS WIDER SUPPORT, AS PRIME MINISTER? HIS FATHER REPLIED THAT, FIRST OF ALL, BAKHTIAR IS NOT A KHOMEINI MAN. SECONDLY, BAKHTIAR APPROACHED THE QUESTION OF THE SHAH'S DEPARTURE DELICATELY WHEREAS SANJABI RAISED IT IMMEDIATELY AND FORCEFULLY IN HIS TALK WITH THE MONTDOEH. THE MOMENT HE DID SO THE SHAH ENDED THEIR CONVERSATION SAYING THAT THERE WAS NOTHING FURTHER TO DISCUSS.

HOMAN ALSO NOTED THE INCREASING REPETITION AMONG TEHRAN'S GOSSIP MILL OF THE VIEW THAT FOREIGNERS SHOULD NOT BE PERMITTED TO LEAVE IRAN AS THEY WILL BE NEEDED TO HELP RUN THE COUNTRY'S ESSENTIAL UTILITIES AND INDUSTRIES AFTER THE SHAH LEAVES. AT THE SAME TIME HOMAN FULLY EXPECTS THAT, SHOULD THE SHAH REMAIN, LATER RETURN, OR SHOULD A CIVILIAN GOVT NOT WORK OUT, FOREIGNERS AND ESPECIALLY AMERICANS WILL BECOME THE TARGETS OF VIOLENT PHYSICAL ATTACK BY GUERILLA GROUPS.

BOTH HOMAN AND HIS FATHER BELIEVE THAT THE SHAH IS CLEVER ENOUGH TO ENGINEER ------------------054613 021635Z /42 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 2614 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 00063 HIS RETURN TO IRAN ON THE HEELS OF A MILITARY COUP ONCE A CIVILIAN GOVT HAS BEEN IN OFFICE LONG ENOUGH TO SHOW ITSELF INEPT. MHK DESCRIBED THE SHAH AS THE MOST INTELLIGENT RULER IRAN HAS HAD FOR TWO CENTURIES BUT UNDONE BY TWO FLAWS: HIS INABILITY TO KEEP HIS WORD AND HIS GREED FOR MONEY AND POWER. SULLIVAN

SUMMARY: IN LONG, DOLEFUL AUDIENCE WITH SHAH JANUARY 2, HE TOLD ME HE WOULD PRESS AHEAD TO INSTALL BAKHTIAR CABINET EVEN IF ALL PORTFOLIOS NOT RPT NOT DISTRIBUTED. HE CONTINUES TO EQUIVOCATE ON DATE FOR AND CONDITIONS UNDER WHICH HE WOULD LEAVE THE COUNTRY. HE SEES LITTLE PROSPECT OF AN "IRON FIST" SOLUTION, BUT WILL PROBABLY APPOINT GEN. GHARABAGHI AS CHAIRMAN OF SUPREME COMMANDER'S STAFF. END SUMMARY.

I MET WITH SHAH AFTERNOON JANUARY 2. HE REVIEWED ONCE AGAIN WITH ME THE THREE OPTIONS YOU DISCUSSED WITH PRESIDENT. HE DESCRIBED THEM AS (A) CIVILIAN GOVERNMENT, (B) MILITARY SOLUTION, AND (C) REGENCY COUNCIL. HE SAID HE WANTED PRESIDENT TO KNOW HE WAS PUSHING AHEAD FAST ON (A). HE SAID BAKHTIAR HAD NOT RPT NOT BEEN ABLE TO GET ACCEPTABLE CANDIDATES FOR ALL THE MINISTRIES, BUT HE HAD ENCOURAGED HIM TO COME IN WITH AN INCOMPLETE LIST AND TO TRY TO FILL OTHER MINISTRIES LATER. HE SAID HE HOPED SWEAR HIM IN JANUARY 4 AND NO LATER THAN JANUARY 6.

HE CONFIRMED THAT GENERAL DJAM HAD DECLINED WAR PORTFOLIO. WHEN I CHARACTERIZED THIS AS SERIOUS SETBACK BECAUSE DJAM COULD HAVE PROVIDED THE LINK TO THE MILITARY, HE SEEMED LESS THAN CONCERNED. HE SAID HE WOULD PROBABLY NAME GEN. GHARABAGHI AS CHAIRMAN OF SUPREME COMMANDER'S STAFF SINCE IT WAS CLEAR AZHARI'S HEALTH WOULD NOT PERMIT HIS RETURN TO THAT POST.

I SAID BAKHTIAR HAD INDICATED TO US THAT SHAH WOULD ANNOUNCE, AFTER SWEARING IN THE CABINET, THAT HE WOULD LEAVE THE COUNTRY FOR A REST. IT WAS NOT RPT NOT CLEAR TO ME WHETHER THAT REPRESENTS SHAH'S INTENTIONS. SHAH SAID HE WOULD MAKE SUCH A STATEMENT, BUT WOULD NOT RPT NOT INDICATE WHEN HE WOULD GO. HE PREFERRED TO WAIT UNTIL LAW AND ORDER RESTORED.

THIS LED TO LONG DISCUSSION OF BAKHTIAR'S CAPABILITY TO RESTORE LAW AND ORDER AS WELL AS PRODUCTION. IT WAS CLEAR THE SHAH THOUGHT BAKHTIAR'S CHANCES WERE PRETTY DIM, BECAUSE HE EXPECTED RADICAL OPPOSITION TO CONTINUE STRIKES. HE SAID THAT, ONCE BAKHTIAR FAILED, HE WOULD BE FACED WITH CHOICES (B) AND (C).

ON CHOICE (C), HE SAID THAT IN LAST TWO DAYS, PALACE HAD RECEIVED STREAM OF EMOTIONAL TELEPHONE CALLS, FROM ALL LEVELS OF SOCIETY, PROTESTING AGAINST THE RUMOR THAT HE WOULD APPOINT REGENCY COUNCIL AND DEPART. (THIS SOUNDS LIKE A ZAHEDI ORCHESTRATION.) HE HAD THEREFORE BEEN GIVING FAR MORE THOUGHT TO OPTION (B), THE IRON FIST.

WE THEN AGONIZED OURWAY THROUGH THIS ONE, WHILE I PRODDED HIM TO DESCRIBE HOW HE EXPECTED TO TURN THE COUNTRY OVER TO THE MILITARY, WHILE HE ABSENTED HIMSELF FOR A "MEDICAL REST." WE TALKED ABOUT APPOINTING GHARABAGHI AS PRIME MINISTER, ABOUT A CONTRIVED COUP D'ETAT TO WHICH HE WOLPSOLWTO S ET#TO HAVE GIVEN HIS CONSENT, AND ABOUT A JUNTA WITH EXTRA-CONSTITUTIONAL STATUS. HE SAID FINALLY THAT HE WOULD NEVER SHARE RESPONSIBILITY FOR THE IRON FIST AND, ANYWAY, THAT IT PROBABLY WOULDN'T WORK BECAUSE THE STRIKERS WOULD SABOTAGE INDUSTRY.

THIS BROUGHT US ONCE AGAIN TO THE REGENCY COUNCIL. HE SAID HE COULD CONSIDER IT HIS PATRIOTIC DUTY TO LEAVE IN ORDER TO SAVE THE COUNTRY. BUT HE WONDERED WHAT A REGENCY COUNCIL COULD DO. WE THEN DISCUSSED THE POSSIBILITY THAT HE MIGHT FORM A REGENCY COUNCIL AND LEAVE, WITH BAKHTIAR ATTEMPTING TO RUN THINGS AND THE ARMY WORKING ALONGSIDE HIM. HE SAID THIS WAS MORE OR LESS WHAT HE AGREED WITH BAKHTIAR, BUT THE QUESTION OF TIMING WAS IMPORTANT. HE COULD LEAVE ONLY IF THINGS WERE QUIET.

I THEN CONVEYED YOUR PERSONAL ASSURANCE THAT HE AND FAMILY WOULD BE WELCOME VISIT U.S. ANY TIME AND THAT U.S. WOULD PROVIDE SECURITY AS NEEDED. I ALSO CONVEYED SADAT'S INVITATION (CAIRO 00008). HE EXPRESSED APPRECIATION FOR BOTH.

COMMENT: IT IS CLEAR THAT SHAH HOPES INSTALL BAKHTIAR MERELY TO END CURRENT ANOMALY IN WHICH THERE IS NO GOVERNMENT. IT IS EQUALLY CLEAR HE EXPECTS BAKHTIAR TO FAIL. NOTE BY OC/T: TEHRAN 65 (SEC 1 OF 2). #AS RECEIVED PARA 7 LINE 6. CORRECTION TO FOLLOW. ------------------054651 021548Z /43 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 2617 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 00065 EXDIS (HANDLE AS NODIS CHEROKEE) WHILE HE HAS AGREED IN PRINCIPLE WITH BAKHTIAR TO LEAVE COUNTRY TEMPORARILY, TIMING IS NOT RPT NOT AS CLEARCUT AS BAKHTIAR SEEMS TO ASSUME.

THEREFORE, ONCE BAKHTIAR BECOMES PRIME MINISTER, HE WILL HAVE TO LEAN FAIRLY HARD ON SHAH TO DEPART IF HE EXPECTS TO CARRY OUT HIS SCENARIO. THE SHAH'S MUDDLED THINKING ON A MILITARY APPLICATION OF THE IRON FIST INDICATES THAT IS NOT TRULY A VIABLE OPTION IN HIS JUDGMENT. HE IS THEREFORE IN DANGER OF LETTING HIMSELF BE BOXED INTO A SITUATION WHERE OPTION (C) IS HIS ONLY CHOICE. CLEARLY, IF HE IS GOING TO END UP IN THIS CORNER, IT WOULD BE BETTER FOR THE CHANCES OF A MODERATE POLITICAL SOLUTION IF HE WOULD ACCEPT THE COMBINATION OF OPTIONS (A) AND (C) AS BAKHTIAR PROPOSES.
SHAH CURRENTLY SEEMS PREPARED CROSS THAT BRIDGE ONLY WHEN HE COMES TO IT. ON BASIS HIS PAST PERFORMANCE, MOST SUCH BRIDGES COLLAPSE BEFORE HE ARRIVES AT THEIR EDGE. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00066.subject: COTTAM ON KHOMEINI, LIBERATION MOVEMENT (LMI) AND NATIONAL FRONT (INF) SUMMARY: PROF RICHARD COTTAM REVIEWED HIS DEC 28

segments.text: AND NATIONAL FRONT (INF) SUMMARY: PROF RICHARD COTTAM REVIEWED HIS DEC 28 MEETING WITH AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI FOR EMBASSY AND OFFERED HIS IMPRESSIONS OF OPPOSITION AFTER SHORT VISIT TO IRAN. HE BELIEVES LIBERATION MOVEMENT (LMI) AND OTHERS WILL RELUCTANTLY ACQUIESCE IN BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT BUT HOPE FOR EVENTUAL SHIFT TO LMI-BACKED "ADVISORY" COUNCIL PLUS SHAH'S PERMANENT DEPARTURE. COTTAM DESCRIBED KHOMEINI ORGANIZATION AND SAID HE BELIEVES GROUP HAS GOOD CONTROL OF STREET MOBS. ALL OPPOSITIONISTS AGREE THAT CONTINUED DISORDER WILL OPEN WAY FOR COMMUNIST ORGANIZATIONS TO PLAY GREATER ROLE. END SUMMARY.

PROF COTTAM MET WITH EMBOFF STEMPEL JAN 1 FOR TWO-HOUR REVIEW OF PRESENT POLITICAL SITUATION, INCLUDING REPORT ON HIS MEETING WITH AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI DEC 28. COTTAM SPENT DAY WITH KHOMEINI ENTOURAGE AND BELIEVES EBRAHIM YAZDI TO BE LEADING TACTICIAN IN KHOMEINI CAMP. COTTAM FOUND KHOMEINI TO BE VERY MUCH A GENERALIST WHO DISLIKES TO GET INTO DETAIL. KHOMEINI IS THE BOUNDARY-SETTING, CHARISMATIC LEADER OF THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT WITH YAZDI AS HIS CHIEF OF STAFF. COTTAM DESCRIBED SADEQ GOBZADEH'S MAIN CONTACTS AS WITH THE MUSA SADR GROUP IN LEBANON (COTTAM HAD NOTHING TO OFFER ON THAT PUZZLE) AND WITH BOUMEDIENNE IN ALGERIA.
GOBZEDEH'S RELATIONSHIP WITH QADDAFI BLOWS HOT AND COLD, "SINCE BOTH ARE A LITTLE SCREWY."

KHOMEINI DID STATE THAT HE WAS NOT INTERESTED IN MULLAHS TAKING OVER GOVERNMENT AND LEFT IMPRESSION THAT PRESENT SUCCESS OF MOVEMENT WAS GOD-ORDAINED AND INEVITABLE. COTTAM WAS STRUCK BY HOW LITTLE KHOMEINI'S EGO APPEARED TO BE INVOLVED IN MOVEMENT AND BY ABSENCE OF DEFERENCE PATTERNS AMONG THOSE AROUND KHOMEINI. COTTAM NOTES THIS IS EXTREMELY UNUSUAL, AND PROBABLY REFLECTS EGALITARIAN DOMINANCE OF ISLAMIC SOCIALIST IDEOLOGY EXPOUNDED BY ALI SHARIATI, WHICH IS DOMINANT INTELLECTUAL CURRENT IN KHOMEINI MOVEMENT. ENTOURAGE AROUND KHOMEINI WAS DESCRIBED AS HALF GRADUATE STUDENTS WHO HAVE DROPPED OUT TO WORK FOR MOVEMENT AND HALF YOUNG MULLAHS LEARNING AT THE FEET OF THE MASTER.

COTTAM OFFERED OBSERVATION THAT BECAUSE OF ACCEPTANCE OF SHARIATI'S ISLAMIC SOCIALISM IN KHOMEINI MOVEMENT, CONSERVATIVE MULLAHS IN IRAN (READ: SHARIATMADARI GROUP) DISTRUST HIM; COTTAM HEARD ONE AYATOLLAH REFER TO KHOMEINI AS "PRACTICALLY A SUNNI." OVERWHELMING MAJORITY OF COTTAM'S EDUCATED CONTACTS IN IRAN REGARD KHOMEINI AS REACTIONARY, "LITTLE BETTER THAN A SAUDI WAHABI." THIS MISREPRESENTS KHOMEINI VIEW, WHICH COTTAM FEELS IS MUCH MORE LIBERAL. COTTAM FELT PART OF THIS FALSE PERCEPTION WAS DUE TO CONSCIOUS DECISION BY YAZDI AND KHOMEINI NOT TO EMPHASIZE LINKS WITH MOSSADEQ. PURPOSE OF THIS WAS TO SHOW THAT "NEW" ISLAMIC MOVEMENT IS RELIGIOUS AS WELL AS POLITICAL, WITH SOLID IDEOLOGICAL BASE IN KHOMEINI'S AND SHARIATI'S WRITINGS.

TURNING TO KHOMEINI ORGANIZATION WITHIN IRAN, COTTAM SAID REAL ORGANIZATION LEADER IS SEYED MOHAMMAD BEHESTI, A GHOLHAK MULLAH WHO PILOTS MOVEMENT AND IS MAIN CONTACT WITH PARIS. AYATOLLAHS TALEQANI, RAFSANJANI, AND MONTAZERI ARE KEY TITULAR LEADERS, BUT THERE IS NO RPT NO DOUBTTHAT BEHESHTI AND HIS GROUP OF YOUNGER MULLAHS AND SECULAR ASSOCIATES, INCLUDING HOSSEIN NAZIEH, THE PROGRESSIVE HEAD OF BAR ASSOCIATION ARE DOING THE MAIN WORK. BAZARGAN IS IMPORTANT TITULAR LEADER BUT NOT A REAL ORGANIZER.

COTTAM SAID LMI WILL "TOLERATE" A BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT. THIS CAME FROM LEADING LMI FRIEND OF COTTAM, BAHRAM BAHRAMIAN,AND TWO OTHER MEMBERS OF WHAT COTTOM DESCRIBED AS "INNER GROUP" OF LMI. ACQUIESCENCE IN BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT WILL NOT STOP OPPOSITION TO SHAH, AND LMI HOPES EVENTUALLY FOR "ADJUSTMENT" OF SHAH'S DEPARTURE ON VACATION TO SOMETHING ALONG LINES OF FOUR-MAN "ADVISORY COUNCIL" WHICH LMI TRIED TO SELL SHAH. INTERESTINGLY, COTTAM SAID BAHRAMIAN CLAIMS SHAH WAS ON VERGE OF BUYING THIS ARRANGEMENT IN EARLY NOVEMBER BUT DECIDED AGAINST IT AFTER "DISCUSSION WITH U.S. AMBASSADOR." (COMMENT" WE UNDERSTAND INITIATIVE FOUNDERED ON SHAH'S UNWILLINGNESS TO LEAVE COUNTRY.)

IN LONGER TERM, COTTAM SAYS KHOMEINI MOVEMENT DEFINITELY PLANS TO ORGANIZE A POLITICAL PARTY TO DRAW ON KHOMEINI CHARISMA. COTTAM THINKS SUCH A PARTY WOULD WIN ALL MAJLES SEATS IT CONTESTS (COMMENT: WE DON'T QUITE SEE IT THAT WAY). IT IS NOT CLEAR HOW SUCH A PARTY WOULD ------------------054728 021523Z /43 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 2619 NPT I A L SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 00066 BE LINKED, IF AT ALL, WITH REST OF NATIONAL FRONT (INF).

COTTAM SAID KHOMEINI PEOPLE ARE VERY PROUD OF THEIR ORGANIZATIONAL ABILITY TO GET THE PEOPLE OUT IN THE STREETS. THEY HAVE A SMALL PROBLEM WITH THE INF, BUT RESOLVED IT ON DEC 10-11 BY GIVING THE INF ITS OWN "SECTION" WITH ITS OWN SLOGANS. COTTAM THOUGHT LMI COULD FIND ENOUGH GOOD MEN TO GOVERN AND DISAGREED WITH VIEW THAT ONLY TWO OR THREE OF PRESENT VISIBLE LEADERSHIP IN LMI SEEMED TO HAVE EXPERIENCE AND SENSE NECESSARY TO RUN MODERN MINISTRIES. COTTAM AGREED THIS WAS KEY QUESTION, HOWEVER, AND SAID THERE REMAINS SUBSTANTIAL ROOM FOR DOUBT.

ALL OPPOSITIONISTS COTTAM HAD SEEN AGREED THAT FURTHER TROUBLE WOULD LEAD TO POLARIZATION BETWEEN ISLAMIC MOVEMENT AND TUDEH. TUDEH WOULD BE THE MAJOR GAINER IN SUCH A POLARIZATION, SINCE ITS ORGANIZATION HAS NOT YET REALLY "GONE PUBLIC" AND MANY OF ITS FORMER LEADERS ARE ONLY JUST RECENTLY OUT OF JAIL. COTTAM NOTED THIS PUT SOME PRESSURE ON LMI TO WORK OUT A SETTLEMENT, BUT NOT ENOUGH TO OVERCOME ANY KHOMEINI HARD-LINE. SULLIVAN

WE WOULD LIKE BARBARA SCHELL AND RALPH BOYCE TO RETURN AS SCHEDULED. MICKIE KLEIBER SHOULD BE HELD BACK FOR THE TIME BEING. WE SHALL PUT HER ON SCOLA AS OF JANUARY 5. UNDERSTAND FROM TELECON THAT CUSACK HAS DELAYED RETURN BECAUSE OF ILL HEALTH OF MOTHER. HE SHOULD CHECK WITH US BEFORE HE RETURNS.
