HE HAS PERFORMED EXCEEDINGLY WELL HERE.
CLYDE TAYLOR, WHO IS IN FRANKFURT, WILL BE INFORMED SEPARATELY TO RETURN AS SCHEDULE ON JAN 5.
WITH RESPECT TO NEWLY ASSIGNED PERSONNEL, PLEASE CHECK WITH US ON A CASE BY CASE BASIS BEFORE THEY COMMENCE TRAVEL.
WE ARE REVIEWING URGENTLY STAFFING PATTERN OF EMBASSY AND ALL AFFILIATED AGENCIES. SHELLENBERGER WILL DISCUSS HIS THOUGHTS (CLEARED WITH ME) BY TELECON WITH CURRAN.

1979TEHRAN00068.subject: MESSAGE FOR THE SHAH FROM SADAT

segments.text: I CONVEYED SADAT'S MESSAGE TO SHAH AFTERNOON JANUARY 2. SHAH IMMEDIATELY ASKED WHETHER I THOUGHT SADAT WAS TRYING TO TELL HIM SOMETHING.
I SAID YOU THOUGHT IT WAS MERELY AN EXPRESSION OF SOLICITUDE BY A MAN WHO CONSIDERED THE SHAH A GOOD FRIEND.
SHAH ASKED ME TO PASS HIS APPRECIATION TO SADAT. HE HAD NO RPT NO COMMENT ON THE ASWAN INVITATION.
FILE; TELEGRAM TEXT FOR THIS MRN IS UNAVAILABLE
FILE; TELEGRAM TEXT FOR THIS MRN IS UNAVAILABLE
WE HAVE ESTABLISHED A PANAM RESERVATION AND TICKET OFFICE AT THE CARAVANSARAI AND HAVE INFORMED ALL COMPANIES ON OUR PYRAMID NET. THIS SHOULD INSURE LARGER LOADS FOR PANAM.

JAN 2 WAS A DAY OF TOTAL CONFUSION HERE IN TEHRAN, BOTH AT THE AIRPORT AND WITHIN PANAM. PANAM, AS YOU KNOW, WAS ON-AGAIN-OFF-AGAIN WITH ITS FLIGHTS AND THERE WAS SIMPLY NOT SUFFICIENT TIME ONCE THE PLANES LANDED FOR PASSENGERS TO GET TO THE AIRPORT. SECONDLY, IRANIAN AUTHORITIES HAVE BEEN RESTRICTING ENTRY TO THE AIRPORT BUILDING TO THOSE WHO HOLD TICKETS. HOWEVER, PANAM HAD BEEN UNABLE TO ORGANIZE ITSELF IN A SUFFICIENT MANNER TO ISSUE TICKETS. CATCH 22. ALSO, AT VARIOUS TIMES DURING THE DAY THE RUMORS SPREAD THAT THE AIRPORT WAS CLOSED OR THAT THE CONTROLLERS WERE ON STRIKE, ETC. ETC.

THE TEHRAN PANAM MANAGER, KIRKJIAN, RETURNED YESTERDAY FROM LONDON AND WE HOPE FOR BETTER ORGANIZATION TODAY. LET ME ALSO ADD THAT PANAM PHONES DID NOT ANSWER DURING MUCH OF THE DAY YESTERDAY. AS AN ADDITIONAL EFFORT TO COORDINATE WITH THE AIRLINE, WE HAVE PUT THEM ON OUR RADIO NET BOTH AT THE AIRPORT AND AT THE HYATT HOTEL FROM WHENCE PANAM OFFICIALS ARE WORKING.

ON JAN 23 WE PROVIDED GASOLINE AND DIESEL TO ASSIST PANAM IN GROUND TRANSPORTATION. WE CAN PROBABLY, IF ABSOLUTELY NECESSARY, DO THE SAME TODAY OR TOMORROW BUT OUR OWN SUPPLY WILL BE VERY LIMITED AFTER THAT. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00086.subject: PERSONNEL, E & E: BROOKS RYNO BROOKS RYNO AND FAMILY SHOULD NOT RETURN TO TEHRAN. CULVER IS COMPLETING INVENTORY IN PREPARATION FOR CLOSURE

segments.text: BROOKS RYNO AND FAMILY SHOULD NOT RETURN TO TEHRAN. CULVER IS COMPLETING INVENTORY IN PREPARATION FOR CLOSURE AND WE BELIEVE HE CAN COMPLETE THE JOB. RYNO, THEREFORE, SHOULD BE REASSIGNED. CULVER WILL BE IN DIRECT TOUCH WITH RYNO RE PACKING AND SHIPPING OF HOUSEHOLD EFFECTS ONCE TRANSFER ORDERS ARE RECEIVED. SULLIVAN

THE MOMENT OF TRUTH FOR THE UNITED STATES HAS NOW ARRIVED IN IRAN. AS YOU WILL HAVE SEEN FROM REFTEL, ONLY REAL QUESTION REMAINING BEFORE SHAH IS TIMING AND CIRCUMSTANCES OF HIS DEPARTURE. IF HE FORMS BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT, SETS UP REGENCY COUNCIL, AND DEPARTS PROMPTLY AFTER BAKHTIAR TAKES OVER, THERE IS AT LEAST A CHANCE THAT THE CONSTITUTIONAL FORMS MAY BE PRESERVED AND THAT BAKHTIAR MIGHT GET SOME COOPERATION FROM OPPOSITIONISTS IN RESTORING LAW AND ORDER.

WITHIN LAST FEW DAYS, ENTEZAM, ALI AMINI, HUSHANG RAM, THE CHIEF OF NATIONAL POLICE AND A SCORE OF LESSER LUMINARIES HAVE ALL URGED ME TO ASK THE PRESIDENT TO SEND THE SHAH A STRONG RECOMMENDATION THAT HE TAKE THIS COURSE OF ACTION IN ORDER TO PRESERVE THE INTEGRITY OF THE COUNTRY.

ON THE OTHER HAND, ARDESHIR ZAHEDI, GENERAL KHOSROWDAD, AND A GROUP OF OTHER HAWKS ARE ATTEMPTING PERSUADE SHAH TO FORGET THE BAKHTIAR EFFORT AND NAME A GROUP WHO WOULD APPLY THE IRON FIST TREATMENT. YOU ALREADY KNOW, FROM REFTEL, THAT SHAH WOULD LEAVE THE COUNTRY RATHER THAN SHARE RESPONSIBILITY FOR THIS. IN CONVERSATION WITH ME MORNING JANUARY 3, ZAHEDI, FOR THE FIRST TIME, WAS SHARPLY CRITICAL OF THE SHAH'S VACILLATION AND USED PEJORATIVE LANGUAGE IN DESCRIBING HIM. HE SAID HE PERSONALLY WAS RESIGNING AS SOON AS BAKHTIAR IS SWORN IN.

IN FURTHERANCE OF THIS TENDENCY, MY MAAG CHIEF HAS BEEN TOLD JAN 2 IN STRICTEST CONFIDENCE BY A SENIOR IRANIAN MILITARY OFFICER THAT A "BOARD" HAS BEEN FORMED IN THE MILITARY WHICH WILL DEPOSE THE SHAH IF HE DOES NOT RPT NOT MOVE DECISIVELY ONE WAY OR ANOTHER IN THE NEXT SEVERAL DAYS.

GIVEN THESE CIRCUMSTANCES, I THINK WASHINGTON NEEDS TO EXAMINE U.S. RPT U.S. INTERESTS IN STARKEST TERMS. WE NEED TO START FROM THE PREMISE THAT, WHATEVER HAPPENS, THE SHAH WILL DEPART, AT LEAST TEMPORARILY, FROM THE LOCAL SCENE. IN LIGHT OF THAT CENTRAL FACT, WE SHOULD FOCUS ON THE MANNER OF HIS DEPARTURE. MY OWN VIEW IS THAT IRAN'S INTERESTS, THE SHAH'S INTERESTS, AND U.S. INTERESTS WOULD BE BEST SERVED IF HE TOOK THE ADVICE BEING OFFERED BY ENTEZAM ET AL. THE TROUBLE IS THAT ALL THESE NOTABLES EXPECT THAT ONLY THE U.S. CAN BE PERSUASIVE WITH THE SHAH AND IT THEREFORE REQUIRES A MESSAGE FROM THE PRESIDENT.

IF YOU AGREE WITH THIS ANALYSIS AND IF THE PRESIDENT IS PREPARED TO OFFER THIS ADVICE TO THE SHAH, WASHINGTON WILL HAVE TO ACT IMMEDIATELY. IT IS POSSIBLE BAKHTIAR MAY BE SWORN IN JANUARY 4. IF SO, THE SHAH WOULD HAVE TO DEPART JANUARY 5 OR 6 IN ORDER FOR BAKHTIAR TO HAVE A CHANCE. IF THIS DOES NOT RPT NOT HAPPEN, OUR INDICATIONS ARE THAT THE MILITARY COUP MAY TAKE PLACE JANUARY 12.

IF THE PRESIDENT SENDS SUCH A MESSAGE, IT SHOULD BE COUCHED IN TERMS OF PATRIOTIC DUTY, BEST CHANCE TO PRESERVE THE MONARCHY, AND PROTECTION OF CONSTITUTIONAL SYSTEM. IT SHOULD ALSO, OF COURSE, MAKE CLEAR THAT IT IS SUGGESTION FOR SHORT VISIT IN ORDER GET NEEDED REST AND A MEDICAL EXAMINATION. AFTER EVENTS IN BEVERLY HILLS, A MORE FIRM INDICATION OF OUR WILLINGNESS TO PROVIDE NECESSARY SECURITY WOULD BE PRUDENT.
PLEASE LET ME HAVE YOUR REACTION SOONEST. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00092.subject: BAKHTIAR WILL ANNOUNCE NEW GOVERNMENT JAN 3

segments.text: COURT AND PRESS SOURCES STATE PRIME MINISTER-DESIGNATE BAKHTIAR WILL HOLD PRESS CONFERENCE FOR FOREIGN AND IRANIAN JOURNALISTS AT HIS HOME JAN 3 AT 1730 TEHRAN TIME (0900 WASHINGTON TIME). PURPOSE OF CONFERENCE IS TO ANNOUNCE NEW CABINET AND BRIEFLY REVIEW GOVERNMENT PROGRAM.
WE UNDERSTAND FROM COURT SOURCE THAT SHAH IS TO SWEAR IN GOVERNMENT JAN 4 WITH PRESENTATION OF GOI TO JOINT SESSION OF PARLIAMENT JAN 6. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00094.subject: BAZAARI VIEWS ON BAKHTIAR CANDIDACY AND ON CONTINUING CONFRONTATION SUMMARY: PROMINENT BAZAARI REFLECTS EXTREMELY EMO

segments.text: CONTINUING CONFRONTATION SUMMARY: PROMINENT BAZAARI REFLECTS EXTREMELY EMOTIONAL HATRED OF REGIME AND ITS (BELIEVED) CRUELTIES. ADVICE TO AMERICANS IS THAT WE SHALL SUFFER FOR OUR SUPPORT OF THE SHAH. END SUMMARY.

EMBOFF MET JAN 2 WITH INFLUENTIAL BAZAARI MERCHANT HAJI ALI ASGHAR KASHANI, WHO STATED THAT, AFTER SOME DISCUSSION, BAZAARIS HAVE DECIDED NOT RPT NOT TO SUPPORT SHAHPOUR BAKHTIAR AS PRIME MINISTER. THEY REGARD HIM AS TOO CLOSE TO THE SHAH AND TOO MUCH AN OPPORTUNIST TO SUPPORT HIM EVEN IF BAKHTIAR PROVES ABLE TO ENGINEER THE SHAH'S DEPARTURE. SHOULD BAKHTIAR BECOME PRIME MINISTER THE BAZAAR WOULD CONTINUE TO BE CLOSED IN HOPES OF BRINGING HIM DOWN AND REPLACING HIM WITH THE ONE MAN WHO, KASHANI FEELS, IS TRULY THE PEOPLE'S CHOICE - KARIM SANJABI.

WHEN EMBOFF OPINED THAT CONTINUED OPPOSITION TO A CIVILIAN GOVERNMENT WHICH IS TRYING TO SATISFY THE DEMANDS OF THE PEOPLE COULD LEAD TO THE COMMISSION IN TEHRAN OF ATROCITIES SUCH AS THOSE RECENTLY PERPETRATED IN MASHAD, KASHANI REPLIED HEATEDLY THAT SUCH THINGS ARE ALREADY TAKING PLACE IN THE CAPITAL. ON DEC 31 A MOB ATTACKED THE HOME OF A SAVAK COLONEL WHO LIVED ON BAHAR STREET. COLONEL WAS TAKEN ALIVE AND DISMEMBERED BY THE CROWD WHILE HIS WIFE AND CHILDREN WERE BURNED IN THE FIRE WHICH LEVELED THEIR THREE-STORY HOUSE.

KASHANI CLAIMS TO HAVE SEEN THE WRECK OF THE HOUSE AND THE PORTIONS OF THE DEAD MAN'S BODY WHICH WERE DISPLAYED OUTSIDE IT ON JAN 1. IN THE ASHES IN THE BASEMENT, KASHANI SAID INSTRUMENTS OF TORTURE WERE DISCOVERED. WHEN EMBOFF DEPLORED SAVAGERY OF THIS SORT BY EITHER SIDE, KASHANI BECAME EVEN MORE ANGRY. HE RELATED AN INCIDENT IN QAZVIN IN WHICH A CHILD WAS CRUSHED UNDER THE TREADS OF A TANK AND ITS MOTHER SHOT WHEN SHE RUSHED TO ATTEMPT A RESCUE. ALSO HE DESCRIBED THE JAN 2 FUNERAL, WHICH HE ATTENDED, IN BEHEST-E-ZAHRA OF THREE YOUNG IRANIANS WHO ALLEGEDLY DIED DEC 30 UNDER TORTURE IN EVIN PRISON.

THE BODIES WERE CARRIED UNWRAPPED ON BIERS AROUND THE CEMETARY SO THAT THE CROWDS THERE COULD SEE THE EXTENSIVE BURNS AND HANDS WITHOUT FINGERNAILS. IT IS PERFECTLY REASONABLE, KASHANI SHOUTED, FOR THE PEOPLE TO ATTACK THE SERVANTS OF A REGIME WHICH IS CAPABLE OF SUCH THINGS. (COMMENT: BY THIS POINT KASHANI WAS VERY ANGRY INDEED. ONE OF THESE DAYS EMBOFF EXPECTS TO SEE HIM FOAM AT THE MOUTH. END COMMENT.)

WHEN UNDER CONTROL AGAIN, KASHANI LAUNCHED A LONG PERORATION ON HOW THE BAZAARIS LAY ULTIMATE RESPONSIBILITY FOR ALL THESE CRIMES AT FEET OF U.S. FOR OUR LONG-TERM SUPPORT OF OUR PUPPET SHAH (SIC). KASHANI THEN REMARKED THAT GROWING ANGER OF THE PEOPLE AGAINST U.S. COULD LEAD TO ATTACKS ON INDIVIDUAL AMERICANS IN TEHRAN. IN THIS REGARD, HE CAUTIONED EMBOFF TO BE EXTREMELY CAREFUL AND TO SCALE DOWN HIS ACTIVITIES OUTSIDE OF EMBASSY COMPOUND.

EMBASSY COMMENT: UNFORTUNATELY THE VOICE OF THIS BAZAARI ACCURATELY REFLECTS THE FEELINGS OF EVER LARGER SECTIONS OF IRAN'S POPULATION. EMBASSY IS INUNDATED DAILY BY REQUESTS/ADVICE THAT WE DO SOMETHING ABOUT THE SHAH WHO IS DRAGGING AMERICANS DOWN LIKE AN ANCHOR. SULLIVAN

INTERMEDIARY WHO HAS BEEN ACTIVE IN POLITICS HERE RECENTLY TOLD POL COUNSELOR HE WAS ASKED INDIRECTLY BY THE SHAH TO CONTACT GENERAL JAM, WHO REMAINS IN LONDON, AND HELP GET HIM TO RETURN. HE TELEPHONED JAM YESTERDAY, JAN 2. JAM TOLD HIM HE HAD REFUSED TWO TELEPHONE CALLS FROM MOINIAN BUT WOULD SEE GENERAL NAZEMI, WHO IS FLYING TO LONDON AS SHAH'S EMISSARY TO SEE HIM TODAY.

JAM CONFIDED TO INTERMEDIARY THAT HE HAS NO FAITH IN SHAH'S PROMISES (I.E., TO LEAVE THE COUNTRY). NEVERTHELESS, INTERMEDIARY (WHO MAY BE OVERLY OPTIMISTIC) FEELS QUITE SURE JAM WILL YIELD EVENTUALLY AND RETURN TO SERVE HIS COUNTRY. INTERMEDIARY CONFIDED THAT THE REASON HE PUT TO JAM IS THE NEED TO HAVE SOMEONE OF HIS STATURE ON THE SPOT TO CONTROL THE ARMY WHEN THE SHAH LEAVES THE COUNTRY, SINCE THERE IS A GENERAL FEAR THAT THE ARMY (WITH THE SHAH'S CONVIVANCE) MIGHT PULL A COUP D'ETAT IN HIS ABSENCE.

COMMENT: INTERMEDIARY IS ONE OF CURRENT BREED OF MIDDLEMEN WHO OPPOSE MANNER OF SHAH'S RULE IN THE PAST BUT BELIEVE THEY NEED HIS SUPPORT IN SOME SORT OF CONTINUING ROLE (EVEN IF THIS IS SHORT-LIVED AND TRANSITORY) TO MOVE TO A MORE DEMOCRATIC REGIME IN AN ORDERLY MANNER.

1979TEHRAN00119.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT, JAN 3, 1979 SUMMARY: TEHRAN SOMEWHAT QUIETER, AS WERE MOST MAJOR CITIES. KERMANSHAH AND QAZVIN HAD MAJOR VIOLENCE.

segments.text: SUMMARY: TEHRAN SOMEWHAT QUIETER, AS WERE MOST MAJOR CITIES. KERMANSHAH AND QAZVIN HAD MAJOR VIOLENCE. IIAF FORCED DOWN IRAN AIR PLANE AT TABRIZ. BAKHTIAR CONTINUES CABINET-BUILDING. KHOMEINI HAS REPORTEDLY ISSUED HIS OWN CABINET LIST. SECURITY FORCES EXPECT MAJOR DEMONSTRATIONS IN SOUTH TEHRAN TODAY. END SUMMARY.

CROWD ACTIVITY WAS RELATIVELY MODEST IN TEHRAN YESTERDAY, AND THIS MORNING HAS BROUGHT ONLY A FEW REPORTS OF DEMONSTRATORS IN THE CAPITAL. WE LEARN FROM POLICE CONTACT, HOWEVER, THAT SECURITY FORCES EXPECT LARGE-SCALE DEMONSTRATIONS NEAR BAZAAR TODAY. PRECINCT STATION FOR THAT AREA HAS RECEIVED REINFORCEMENTS. TELEPHONE THREAT CAMPAIGN CONTINUES. CONSULATE SHIRAZ REPORTS CONSIDERABLE DISTURBANCES YESTERDAY WITH DEMONSTRATIONS AND SHOOTING. SHOPS ARE CLOSED, BUT AIRPORT IS FUNCTIONING FOR GULFAIR FLIGHTS. CONSULATE TABRIZ REPORTS CITY QUIET TODAY, BUT CITY RECEIVED SOME EXCITEMENT YESTERDAY MORNING WHEN IIAF FIGHTERS INTERCEPTED AN IRAN AIR 707 WHICH WAS HEADED OUT OF THE COUNTRY.

INTERCEPTORS FORCED AIRCRAFT TO LAND AT TABRIZ AIR FORCE BASE, AFTER WHICH IT RETURNED TO TEHRAN, ITS POINT OF ORIGIN. SPECULATION IMMEDIATELY DEVELOPED THAT FORMER PRIMIN HOVEYDA OR OTHER PROMINENT PEOPLE WERE ABOARD. PLANE IN FACT BELONGED TO IRISH NATIONAL WHO HAD LEASED IT TO IRAN AIR. WITH PAYMENT IN ARREARS, HE ARRANGED FOR PLANE TO LEAVE WITH AMERICAN PILOT AND A NUMBER OF STAFF. AIR FORCE NONETHELESS FORCED IT DOWN. INCIDENT HAS LED TO DAMAGING RUMORS THAT AIR FORCE INTERCEPTED CHARTER AIRCRAFT TRANSPORTING FOREIGNERS.

ALTHOUGH VIOLENCE APPEARED TO BE LESS WIDESPREAD YESTERDAY AND TODAY THAN IN PREVIOUS DAYS, IT CAME FULL FORCE IN QAZVIN AND KERMANSHAH. IN QAZVIN A NUMBER OF HOUSES WERE DESTROYED. WE HAVE NO ESTIMATE OF CASUALTIES AS YET. KERMANSHAH HAD A VIRTUAL EXPLOSION, AS TWO LARGE BANKS, THE DARIUSH HOTEL, AND OTHER BUILDINGS WERE TOTALLY DESTROYED. PRESS REPORTS ABOUT 100 KILLED BUT THAT IS ONLY AN ESTIMATE. BHI HAS EVACUATED ALL BUT 350 EMPLOYEES.

BAKHTIAR'S CABINET BUILDING CONTINUES, AND HE IS EXPECTED TO ANNOUNCE MINISTERS AT PRESS CONFERENCE TONIGHT. EMBOFF UNDERSTANDS CDHRF (MINATCHI GROUP) MET YESTERDAY AFTERNOON AND TENTATIVELY AGREED NOT TO OPPOSE THE BAKHTIAR INITIATIVE. MINATCHI IS IN QOM TODAY TO CONSULT WITH RELIGIOUS LEADERS. AYATOLLAH YAHYA NOURI SENT WORD TO EMBOFF THROUGH INTERMEDIARY THAT AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI HAS ISSUED LETTER CONTAINING NAMES OF THOSE HE BELIEVES SHOULD CONSTITUTE IRANIAN CABINET. INTERMEDIARY DID NOT HAVE COPY OF LETTER AND PROFESSED TO KNOW NOTHING OF LIST OF NAMES. UNDER SUCH CIRCUMSTANCES NOURI BELIEVES ANY SUPPORT WHICH ISLAMIC ESTABLISHMENT MIGHT BE ABLE TO GIVE TO BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT WILL BE LIMITED.
MEANWHILE, BOTH HOUSES OF PARLIAMENT ARE MEETING IN CLOSED SESSION TODAY, PROBABLY TO DISCUSS (AND APPROVE) THE NEW GOVT.

PERSIAN PRESS REPORTS 30 MEMBERS OF SECURITY FORCES HAVE BEEN KILLED BY OPPOSITION IN THE LAST FEW DAYS. MOST RECENT REPORTED INCIDENT OCCURRED IN MASHAD LAST NIGHT, WHERE CROWD ALLEGEDLY DRAGGED GENDARMERIE SERGEANT FROM HIS HOUSE, BEAT HIM, THEN BURNED HIM ALIVE.

1979TEHRAN00121.subject: PRO-SHAH EFFORTS WITH RELIGIOUS LEADERS SUMMARY: THERE ARE SEVERAL INTERMEDIARIES WORKING ON BEHALF OF SHAH WITH RELGIOUS LEADERS. ONE TOLD US

segments.text: SUMMARY: THERE ARE SEVERAL INTERMEDIARIES WORKING ON BEHALF OF SHAH WITH RELGIOUS LEADERS. ONE TOLD US THESE LEADERS DEFINITELY WANT SHAH TO STAY. ON BASIS OF RECORD SUCH EFFORTS TO DATE, HOWEVER, WE CANNOT HELP BEING PESSIMISTIC. END SUMMARY

YOUNGER REPRESENTATIVE OF A PROMINENT FAMILY HERE HAS BEEN IN TOUCH WITH POL COUNSELOR OFF AND ON FOR PAST COUPLE OF MONTHS. A FEW DAYS AGO HE CONFIDED HE HAD HAD LONG MEETING WITH THE EMPRESS. YESTERDAY HE ANNOUNCED HE HAS JOINED ZAHEDI'S TEAM AND WILL BE WORKING OUT OF ZAHEDI'S HOUSE. HPS (AILING) FATHER IS THE FORMAL CUSTODIAN OF THE MAIN SHRINE IN QOM.

HIS ROLE IS TO WIN OVER THE TOP RELIGIOUS LEADERS, ESPECIALLY IN QOM. HE REFUSED TO CREDIT POL COUNSELOR'S SUGGESTION THAT THERE ARE A NUMBER OF OTHER INTERMEDIARIES APPARELLY WORKING ON THE RELIGIOUS LEADERS, SAYING ZAHEDI HAD BEEN TOLD POINT BLANK BY DR. HEJAZI (A TEHRAN LEADER WHO, WE KNOW, IS IN TOUCH WITH KHOMEINI'S GROUP IN PARIS, AS WELL AS WITH THE LOCAL RELIGIOUS LEADERS) THAT THIS INTERMEDIARY WAS THEIR ONLY RECOGNIZED REPRESENTATIVE IN DEALING WITH THE COURT. THE INTERMEDIARY IS CONTINUING THE BUSY ROUND OF CONSULTATIONS WITH VARIOUS LEADERS, REPORTING BACK TO THE EMPRESS FROM TIME TO TIME.

INTERMEDIARY INSISTS THE IN-COUNTRY LEADERS WANT SHAH TO STAY, IN A CONSTITUTIONAL CAPACITY, FOR THEY FEAR EVEN A "TEMPORARY" ABSENCE WOULD LEAD TO PERMANENT DEPARTURE, AND THIS WOULD BE FOLLOWED BY MILITARY COUPS AND COUNTERCOUPS. HE EXPRESSED THE OPINION THAT SHAH MADE BAD MISTAKE IN ANNOUNCING HE WOULD DEPART THE COUNTRY AFTER BAKHTIAR IS INSTALLED AS PRIME MINISTER. (COMMENT: THIS SOUNDS LIKE A CONCLUSION SHARED -- OR INSPIRED -- BY ZAHEDI AND MIGHT CAUSE SHAH TO BACK-PEDAL A BIT ON CARRYING OUT HIS PUBLIC PROMISE.) HE AGREED, HOWEVER, THAT OPPOSITION WOULD FEEL MORE COMFORTABLE IF GENERAL JAM RETURNED TO HEAD THE ARMED FORCES (SEE SEPTEL ON JAM).
INTERMEDIARY SAID HE HAD LEFT SHAH, THROUGH THE EMPRESS, A LIST OF THE RELIGIOUS LEADERS' REQUIREMENTS, IN WRITING. POL COUNSELOR DREW OUT THAT THESE INCLUDED

A. A "COMMITTEE" TO EXERCISE GOVERNMENTAL POWER ON WHICH NOMINEES OF RELIGIOUS LEADERS WOULD SERVE. THIS COMMITTEE SHOULD SERVE UNDER THE SHAH BUT NOT BE APPOINTED BY HIM. INTERMEDIARY WAS NOT CLEAR, WHO WOULD APPOINT IT BUT SAID ONE MAJOR OPPOSITION OBJECTION TO BAKHITAR WAS THAT HE HAD ACCEPTED A MANDATE FROM THE SHAH RATIFIED BY THE PRESENT PARLIAMENT.
B. PARLIAMENT TO BE DISSOLVED AND FREE ELECTIONS HELD TO NEW PARLIAMENT, UNDER SUPERVISION OF THE COMMITTEE.
C. SERIOUS PUNISHMENT FOR MALEFACTORS SUCH AS HOVEYDA AND GENERAL NASSIRI. LIFE IMPRISONMENT WAS SUGGESTED AND CONFISCATION OF THEIR PROPERTY.

D. SOME SORT OF "REFERENDUM". WHEN POL COUNSELOR OBSERVED THAT SEEMED INCONSISTENT WITH THE REST, INTERMEDIARY SAID RELIGIOUS LEADERS WERE WILLING TO NEGOTIATE ON THIS. IN FACT THEY ARE WILLING TO NEGOTIATE ON EVERYTHING, BUT INSIST ON KEEPING THE SHAH.

MEANWHILE EMBASSY POLITICAL ADVISER HAS HEARD FROM SENATE SOURCE THAT ONE OF THE PROMINENT AYATOLLAHS IN QOM (MARASCHI-NAJAFI) IS READY TO COOPERATE WITH PRO-SHAH FORCES IN URGING MODERATION ON SHARIAT-MADARI AND HIS OTHER COLLEAGUES.

ANOTHER INTERMEDIARY REPORTS CONVERSATION YESTERDAY WITH MULLAH HASSAN, KHOMEINI'S BROTHER-IN-LAW, IN WHICH INTERMEDIARY THINKS HE HAS CONVINCED HASSAN OF NEED FOR MODERATION AND HOPES TO GET SIGNAL THAT HE CAN GO TO KHOMEINI IN PARIS AND TRY TO TALK HIM OVER BY THE END OF THIS WEEK. (SAME SOURCE CONFIRMED REPORT WE HAVE HAD IN OTHER CHANNELS THAT KHOMEINI REFUSED TO TALK WITH KING HUSSEIN IN PARIS, SENDING HIM MESSAGE ASSURING KING OF HIS PERSONAL RESPECT FOR HIM BUT SAYING HE WAS UNWILLING TO DISCUSS ANYTHING RELATING TO THE SHAH.) ------------------061399 031427Z /42 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 2658 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 00121 EXDIS

STILL ANOTHER INTERMEDIARY TOLD EMBOFF THAT GOVT (WE THINK THROUGH SAVAK CHIEF GENERAL MOGHADAM) HAD BOUGHT OFF AYATOLLAH SHIRAZI IN MASHAD BUT THROUGH INEFFICIENCY HAD STILL NOT DELIVERED THE MONEY WHEN AYATOLLAH'S HOUSE WAS INVADED BY MLA'S TROOPS A COUPLE OF DAYS AGO AND THE WHOLE DEAL WAS QUEERED.

COMMENT: WE KNOW ZAHEDI, MOGHADAM, SENATOR MOUSSAVI, AND OTHERS ARE BUSY CONTACTING RELIGIOUS PEOPLE OR BAZAARIS AND TRYING TO WIN OR BUY THEIR SUPPORT FOR A MODERATE SOLUTION WITH THE SHAH REMAINING AS CONSTITUTIONAL RULER. HOWEVER, WE HAVE SEEN SUCH EFFORTS BEFORE, AS EARLY AS LAST SPRING AND SUMMER WHEN SHARIAT-MADARI WAS SECRETLY TALKING TO REPRESENTATIVES OF THE COURT. DESPITE FREQUENT EXPRESSIONS OF OPTIMISM BY THE INTERMEDIARIES INVOLVED, HOWEVER, WE SAW ALL THIS UNRAVEL WHEN SHARIAT-MADARI BOWED TO KHOMEINI'S PRESSURE AND WENT ON THE WARPATH. OF COURSE THE SHAH IS PREPARED TO CONCEDE MORE NOW THAN HE WAS THEN. BUT THE OPPOSITION NEEDS TO GET MORE TOO.

AND THE IN-COUNTRY RELGIOUS LEADERS FEAR THE DEMANDS OF THE MOB WHICH IS SEEN AS DEMANDING NOTHING LESS THAN IMMEDIATE ABDICATION OF THE SHAH. THUS WE CANNOT HELP BEING PESSIMISTIC ABOUT THE CHANCES OF SUCCESS FOR ALL

1979TEHRAN00122.subject: PARLIAMENT APPROVES BAKHTIAR AS PRIME MINISTER

segments.text: MAJLES APPROVED BAKHTIAR MANDATE AS PRIME MINISTER, 140-0 WITH 25 ABSTENTIONS (REGULAR OPPOSITIONISTS) EARLY AFTERNOON JAN 3. SENATE APPROVED AT SAME TIME BY UNRECORDED VOICE VOTE.

THIS FULFILLS BAKHTIAR PLEDGE TO FOLLOW THE "MOSSADEQ PRECEDENT" AND RECEIVE PARLIAMENTARY APPROVAL BEFORE TAKING MANDATE FROM SHAH. SPEAKERS OF TWO HOUSES ARE REPORTEDLY CALLING ON SHAH LATER TODAY, THUS PAVING WAY FOR TOMORROW'S EXPECTED SWEARING IN OF BAHKTIAR GOVERNMENT (WHICH WILL BE ANNOUNCED THIS EVENING). SULLIVAN

ACCORDING TO ONE INTERMEDIARY (WHOSE RELIABILITY HAS NOT BEEN ESTABLISHED) KHOMEINI'S NOMINEE TO HEAD "ISLAMIC" GOVERNMENT WHEN HE RETURNS IN TRIUMPH IS DR. SEYED ALI SHAYEGAN, A PROMINENT MOSSADEQH SUPPORTER. HE WILL BE SUPPORTED BY DR. YAZDI AND BANI-SADR, BOTH ALSO LEFTISTS.

EMBASSY FILES INDICATE THAT SHAYEGAN (WHO IS APPROXIMATELY KHOMEINI'S AGE) WAS ONE OF THE LAST LINKS BETWEEN MOSSADEGH AND AYATOLLAH KASHANI (THE KHOMEINI OF THAT DAY) JUST AS KASHANI WAS BREAKING AWAY FROM MOSSADEGH (A BREAK WHICH CONTRIBUTED SIGNIFICANTLY TO MOSSADEGH'S ULTIMATE DOWNFALL). WHEN THIS REPORT WAS RECENTLY TRIED OUT ON A VISITING AMERICAN PROFESSOR WHO HAS GOOD TIES WITH THE OPPOSITION HE EXPRESSED HORROR AT THE THOUGHT, DESCRIBING SHAYEGAN AS AN EXTREMELY NARROW-MINDED, INFLEXIBLE PERSON.

SAME INTERMEDIARY ALSO TOLD POL COUNSELOR THAT KHOMEINI HAS A LIST OF NO LESS THAN 61,000 IRANIANS WHOM HE ACCUSES OF CORRUPTION OR OTHER MALFEASANCE. STRONG IMPLICATION IS THESE PEOPLE WOULD BE ROUNDED UP IF KHOMEINI'S PEOPLE TOOK OVER. (COMMENT: THIS IS FIRST TIME WE HAVE HEARD OF SUCH A LIST, AND IT COULD BE FABRICATION OF THE ZAHEDI CAMP -- BUT NOT NECESSARILY.)

1979TEHRAN00166.subject: GENERAL JAM TO JOIN BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT

segments.text: MORNING JAN 4 POL COUNSELOR HELD TELEPHONE WHILE INTERMEDIARY SPOKE ON OTHER LINE WITH GENERAL JAM IN LONDON. JAM SAID HE WILL BE RETURNING TEHRAN SATURDAY NIGHT AND WILL JOIN BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT. INTERMEDIARY THEN UNDERTOOK TO INFORM BAKHTIAR.

INTERMEDIARY SAID JAM EXPRESSED GREAT CONCERN OVER WHERE KHOMEINI IS LEADING IRANIAN NATION. INTERMEDIARY HIMSELF STILL EXPECTS TO SET UP MEETING WITH KHOMEINI AND HAS MADE RESERVATION TO FLY TO PARIS MONDAY (SEE PARA 6, TEHRAN 121). HIS BASIC POINT IS THAT ONCE SHAH LEAVES THE COUNTRY, THE SITUATION WILL HAVE CHANGED SUFFICIENTLY SO HE WILL HAVE CHANCE TO TALK USEFULLY

1979TEHRAN00182.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT, JAN 4, 1979 SUMMARY: CONTINUED SLIDE INTO ANARCHY, PARTICULARLY IN ISFAHAN. DEMONSTRATIONS, STRIKES AND SHORTAGES AB

segments.text: SUMMARY: CONTINUED SLIDE INTO ANARCHY, PARTICULARLY IN ISFAHAN. DEMONSTRATIONS, STRIKES AND SHORTAGES ABOUND. END SUMMARY

TEHRAN HAD ANOTHER DAY OF SMALL DEMONSTRATIONS WITHOUT SERIOUS CLASHES. THIS MORNING GROUPS HAVE ASSEMBLED AGAIN, INCLUDING NORTH TEHRAN THIS TIME, BUT RUMORS OF HEAVY DEMONSTRATIONS HAVE SO FAR NOT PROVED VALID. THERE IS ACTUALLY A REDUCTION IN THE SUDDEN RAIDS ON INTERSECTIONS WHICH MADE TRAVEL SO DIFFICULT. THERE IS SO LITTLE TRAFFIC IN ANY CASE THAT IT IS NOT WORTH TRYING TO BLOCK A STREET. RUMOR MILL TODAY PREDICTS LARGE DISTURBANCES ON SATURDAY. THESE ALMOST ALWAYS PROVE GROUNDLESS, AND WE HAVE NO INDEPENDENT RELIABLE EVIDENCE BUT WILL OF COURSE BE PARTICULARLY WATCHFUL.

CONSULATE TABRIZ REPORTS DEMONSTRATIONS AND SHOOTING YESTERDAY AND AGAIN THIS MORNING IN BAZAAR AREA. KERMANSHAH REMAINS QUIET BUT GOV-GEN HAS BEEN RECALLED TO TEHRAN, REPORTEDLY DUE TO HIS STERN RESPONSE TO EARLIER DEMONSTRATIONS. AFTER CONSULTATION WITH RELIGIOUS HEADS, 81ST ARMORED DIV TROOPS HAVE WITHDRAWN FROM CITY.

SOME CITIES HAVE SHOWN BREAKDOWN OF LAW AND ORDER. EVEN IN TEHRAN, WHICH REMAINS BASICALLY MANAGEABLE, POLICEMEN ARE HALTING KEROSENE TRUCKS ENROUTE TO GAS STATIONS AND STEALING THE FUEL. IN RASHT AND BANDAR PAHLAVI, WHERE SEVERAL HUNDRED FOREIGNERS, MOSTLY CANADIANS ARE BEING EVACUATED IN CANADIAN AIRLIFT, PARTICIPANTS TOLD DEFENSE ATTACHE THAT LOOTERS INSTANTLY ENTERED THEIR HOMES AND RAMSACKED THEM. TROOPS WERE NOWHERE AROUND; REGULAR POLICE TRIED TO STOP LOOTERS BUT WERE POWERLESS. LARGEST GROUP OF EVACUEES WAS 350 CANADIANS WITH STATLER HURTER WORLDWIDE, BUT OTHERS HAVE JOINED AIRLIFT. FIRST GROUP OF 20O LEFT YESTERDAY. CONSULATE ISFAHAN REPORTS DANGEROUS EROSION OF ORDER.

AMCITS HAVE BEEN AMONG THE TARGETS, BUT SO HAVE IRANIANS. CARS ARE BEING STOPPED AND THE GASOLINE STOLEN, AND PURSE SNATCHING, MUGGING, AND OTHER INCIDENTAL VIOLENCE HAS STRUCK CITY. TWO AMERICAN HOMES WERE TARGETS OF PIPE BOMBS YESTERDAY, AND CROWDS FORCIBLY ENTERED TWO OTHERS (APPARENTLY AFTER SHOOTING MATCHES WITH OCCUPANTS) DRAGGED OUT FURNITURE AND BURNED IT. NO AMCITS WERE INJURED IN ANY OF THESE INCIDENTS. CONSUL SAYS YESTERDAY'S POTENTIAL EVACUATION FIGURE OF 5,063 HAS NOW BEEN REDUCED BY ABOUT 300. MASSIVE EXODUS IS UNDERWAY. HANDGUNS, ONCE DIFFICULT AND EXPENSIVE TO OBTAIN IN IRAN, ARE WIDELY AVAILABLE CHEAP.

TOWNS ARE COVERED WITH INFLAMMATORY POSTERS. ONE OF THEM GIVES A LONG LIST OF "SAVAK AGENTS" WITH WHOM ACCOUNTS MUST BE SETTLED. NAMES INCLUDE JAMSHID AMOUZEGAR, HUSHANG NAHAVANDI, AND HOST OF SIMILAR FORMER STATESMEN. OTHER POSTERS SHOW STRIKINGLY LEFTIST STANCE WITH NO DEFERENCE TO ISLAM. EXAMPLES: (A) THE FARMERS SICKLE AND THE WORKERS HAMMER ARE THE SYMBOLS OF OUR REVOLUTION; (B) SALUTE TO THE PEOPLE'S SACRIFICE GUERRILLAS (THE CHARIKS; (C) SALUTE TO THE HEROIC WORKER--THE LEADER OF TOILERS; AND (D) THE STRIKES ARE A PRELUDE TO REVOLUTION.
PRESS REPORTS QUEEN OF ENGLAND AND DUKE OF EDINBURGH HAVE CANCELLED THEIR PROPOSED VISIT TO IRAN ON THE ADVICE OF THE SHAH. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00183.subject: BAKHTIAR MOMENTUM SLOWS, BUT MODERATE CLERGY COMING AROUND

segments.text: SUMMARY: DESPITE PARLIAMENTARY APPROVAL OF HIS MANDATE, PRIME MINISTER DESIGNATE BAKHTIAR WAS UNABLE TO ANNOUNCE HIS CABINET CHOICES AT JAN 3 PRESS CONFERENCE. MINATCHI INFORMS US MODERATE RELIGIOUS LEADERS ARE READY TO BACK BAKHTIAR. OTHER NATIONAL FRONT (INF) AND LIBERATION MOVEMENT (LMI) LEADERS ARE DRAGGING THEIR FEET BUT WILL GO ALONG AFTER APPROPRIATE CONSULTATIONS WITH BAKHTIAR. AYATOLLAH MONTAZARI IS EXPECTED TO RETURN FROM PARIS WITHIN NEXT TWO OR THREE DAYS WITH "SOLUTION" TO KHOMEINI SUPPORT PROBLEM. GROWING CONCERN IN OPPOSITION IS THAT MILITARY COUP WILL RUIN DEVELOPING POLITICAL PROCESS. LOCAL MOSQUE WANTS TO IMPORT U.S. RICE. END SUMMARY.

DESPITE RECEIVING PARLIAMENTARY APPROVAL FOR HIS MANDATE (REF A), BAKHTIAR DID NOT RPT NOT ANNOUNCE HIS CABINET AT JAN 3 PRESS CONFERENCE AS EXPECTED. EMBOFF UNABLE TO CONTACT BAKHTIAR DIRECTLY BUT LEARNED FROM DR. NASSER MINATCHI, WHO HAS BEEN WORKING LONG HOURS WITH RELIGIOUS LEADERS OVER PAST FEW DAYS THAT BASIC PROBLEM HAS BEEN BAKHTIAR DESIRE TO BRING ALONG KEY OPPOSITION GROUPS, PARTICULARLY ENG MEHDI BAZARGAN, WHO WILL BE RETURNING TO TEHRAN PROBABLY JAN 6 FOR IMMEDIATE CONSULTATIONS.

HIS RETURN MUST AWAIT FINAL TOUCHES ON OIL SETTLEMENT WHICH WAS SIGNED LATE EVENING JAN 3, ACCORDING TO MINATCHI, AND INCLUDES AGREEMENT OF LEFTISTS TO RESUME PRODUCTION FOR DOMESTIC USE (SEPTEL WILL UPDATE DETAILS AND COMMENT). BAKHTIAR SAID HE WOULD ANNOUNCE HIS CABINET IN "3 OR 4 DAYS"; MINATCHI SAYS THIS WILL COME AFTER FINAL POWWOW WITH BAZARGAN AND OTHERS JAN 6 (SOONER IF BAZARGAN CAN GET BACK EARLIER).

MINATCHI SAID LACK OF FUEL PREVENTED HIM FROM GOING TO QOM, BUT HE HAS HAD EXTENSIVE CONSULTATIONS OVER PAST FEW DAYS WITH AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI BY TELEPHONE AND WITH OTHER MAJOR AYATOLLAHS, INCLUDING TALEQANI, IN PERSON. GIST OF THEIR VIEW IS THAT THEY ARE READY TO COOPERATE TACITLY WITH BAKHTIAR (MINATCHI THOUGHT THAT ONE OR TWO MIGHT EVEN BE WILLING TO SUPPORT HIM MORE OPENLY) TO PRESERVE COUNTRY FROM THREAT OF MILITARY TAKEOVER AND GET REAL POLITICAL PROCESS STARTED. TALEQANI HAS ALREADY MADE PUBLIC SPEECH URGING NO RPT NO ATTACKS AGAINST FOREIGN "BROTHERS," AND SHARIATMADARI WILL BE IN PRINT WITHIN A DAY OR SO ALONG SAME LINES.

MINATCHI SAID CLERGY ARE REALLY CONCERNED ABOUT THREAT OF MILITARY TAKEOVER AND DETERIORATION OF ARMY-PEOPLE LINKS. CITING QAZVIN AS AN EXAMPLE, MINATCHI SAID ARMY COMMANDER NOT ONLY ORDERED TANKS TO FIRE ON AND BULLDOZE HOUSES, BUT HE HAS ORDERED TROOPS TO SEIZE ALL ARRIVING MEDICAL AND FOOD RELIEF SUPPLIES, INCLUDING SEVERAL TRUCKLOADS FROM HOSSEINIYEH ERSHAD, MINATCHI"S RELIGIOUS SCHOOL. (MINATCHI SAID HE CALLED BAKHTIAR ON THIS MATTER, AND PMDESIGNATE HAS TALKED WITH MILITARY COMMANDERS TO PERMIT RELIEF SUPPLIES TO FLOW.)

GUT ISSUE FOR EVERYBODY REMAINS WILLINGNESS OF SHAH TO LEAVE COUNTRY, EVEN IF ONLY TEMPORARILY. MINATCHI SAID IF SHAH DOESN'T AGREE TO GO, OR IF HE SAYS HE WILL AND THEN DELAYS DEPARTURE, COUNTRY WILL DEGENERATE INTO CHAOS AND MODERATE RELIGIOUS LEADERS WHO ARE WILLING TO GO OUT ON A LIMB WITH BAKHTIAR WILL BE DESTROYED AS ACTIVE POLITICAL FORCE. HE ASKED EMBOFF POINT BLANK IF U.S. THOUGHT PRESENT SCENARIO WOULD WORK. EMBOFF SAID U.S. POLICY FAVORED ANY CONSTITUTIONAL SOLUTION, AND BAKHTIAR EFFORT FIT THIS CATEGORY. TIME WAS RUNNING SHORT, HOWEVER, AND IT WAS NECESSARY TO GET MOVING.

MINATCHI ACKNOWLEDGED THE POINT, AND SAID HE WAS TRYING TO PUSH THINGS ALONG. PROBLEM WAS BAKHTIAR DESIRE TO HAVE "BEST" CABINET POSSIBLE; EMBOFF OPINED THAT BEST WAS SOMETIMES ENEMY OF GOOD. MINATCHI ADDED CABINET WOULD BE ALL RIGHT; BAZARGAN AND LMI WERE WILLING TO LET SECOND ECHELON FIGURES IN THEIR MOVEMENT SERVE IN CABINET. (MINATCHI HAD ONLY TWO ADDITIONS TO CABINET LIST: MOHAMMAD DERAKSHESH FOR CULTURE MINISTER, AND AHMAD BANIAHMAD, TABRIZ MP, FOR MINISTER OF STATE FOR EXECUTIVE AFFAIRS.)

AYATOLLAH MONTAZERI IS DUE BACK IN IRAN FROM PARIS IN TWO OR THREE DAYS. HE HAD TRIED TO FLY IN JAN 3, BUT PLANE HAD BEEN DIVERTED TO SYRIA. HE WAS NOW COMING OVERLAND, AND REPORTEDLY HAD A "SOLUTION" TO SITUATION. MINATCHI ------------------069098 041234Z /12 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 2684 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 00183 EXDIS DID NOT KNOW WHAT THIS WAS BUT THOUGHT IT MIGHT BE KHOMEINI'S AGREEMENT NOT TO OPPOSE BAKHTIAR VIGOROUSLY UNTIL HIS GOVERNMENT HAD A CHANCE TO SHOW WHAT IT COULD DO-I.E., GET THE SHAH TO LEAVE.

MINATCHI EXPRESSED PERSONAL OPINION THAT SOME HARDLINING ARMY COMMANDERS AND RECALCITRANT SAVAK TYPES MIGHT BE TRYING TO MUDDY THE WATERS. HE SAID HE HAD RECEIVED CRUDE PERSONAL TELEPHONE THREAT NIGHT OF JAN 3. MINATCHI THOUGHT AT FIRST IT MIGHT HAVE BEEN TUDEH OR OTHER THUGS BUT EVENTUALLY DECIDED IT WAS TOO MUCH LIKE EARLIER, KNOWN SAVAK THREATS. MINATCHI CALLED BAKHTIAR ON THIS, TOO, AND LATTER SAID HE WOULD WEIGH IN WITH SAVAK LEADERSHIP TO GET ITS MUNCHKINSUNDER BETTER CONTROL.

AT CLOSE OF MEETING, MINATCHI SAID GOBA MOSQUE HAD ALLOCATED MONEY TO BUY 10,000 TONS OF U.S. RICE TO BE SHIPPED TO IRAN TO ALLEVIATE FOOD SHORTAGES. EMBOFF SUGGESTED MINATCHI TELEPHONE ECON COUNSELOR MILLS FOR BEST VENUE (SEPTEL WILL FOLLOW UP).

COMMENT: NEWS ON MODERATE RELIGIOUS LEADERS IS HEARTENING BUT FURTHER DELAY IS DANGEROUS. EARLIEST WE COULD EXPECT CABINET ANNOUNCEMENT IF MINATCHI IS CORRECT (AND WE HAVE NO REASON TO DOUBT HIM) IS LATE JAN 6 OR JAN 7. IT DOES APPEAR THAT EVENTS ARE CONSPIRING TO PUT SOME PRESSURE ON PLAYERS TO GET CIVILIAN GOVERNMENT STARTED. SPECTRE OF MILITARY COUP IS ENCOURAGING THIS.
GENERAL HYSER IS SEPARATELY REQUESTING COMPLETE CHANGE IN PRESS GUIDANCE TO BE USED BY OSD/PA ON IF ASKED BASIS. PLEASE WEIGH IN WITH DOD DEFSEC DUNCAN TO HAVE APPROPRIATE

1979TEHRAN00236.subject: COMMENTS OF HEDAYAT MATIN-DAFTARI ON BAKHTIAR ADMINISTRATION AND U.S. POSITION IN IRAN

segments.text: ADMINISTRATION AND U.S. POSITION IN IRAN

MATIN-DAFTARI RECEIVED EMBOFF JAN 5 FOR DISCUSSION OF IRANIAN POLITICAL SITUATION. MATIN-DAFTARI FEELS THAT, BY AGREEING TO FORM A GOVERNMENT WHICH WOULD BE ASSOCIATED WITH THE SHAH, BAKHTIAR HAS SEVERELY DAMAGED HIS CREDIBILITY AND HIS POPULARITY HAS PLUMMETED IN THE FACE OF THE ASSUMPTION THAT HE HAS SOLD OUT. IN ACCORDING A BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT ABOUT A 20 PERCENT CHANCE OF SUCCESS, MATINDAFTARI FEELS HE IS BEING OPTIMISTIC.

THE PROBLEM, MATIN-DAFTARI WAS QUICK TO POINT OUT, IS NOT SO MUCH WITH BAKHTIAR AS IT IS WITH THE SHAH. HIS YEARS OF REPRESSION, CORRUPTION, LIES, AND SHAM DEVELOPMENT HAVE PUSHED THE PEOPLE BEYOND THE LIMITS OF MORTAL ENDURANCE AND THE MONARCH MUST QUIT IRAN SOON, OR THE SAVAGERY WHICH HAS BEEN VISITED UPON MASHAD AND QAZVIN WILL RECUR IN OTHER CITIES. THE SHAH HAS BEEN TRANSMOGRIFIED INTO MORE THAN JUST A HATED RULER; HE HAS BECOME A SYMBOL FOR THE DISUNITY AND STRIFE THAT PLAGUES IRAN. THE ONLY SYMBOL OF NATIONAL UNITY AT PRESENT IS IMAM (SIC) KHOMEINI.

WHILE THE REVERED AYATOLLAH (MAY GOD EXTEND HIS SHADOW) SHOULD BE SEEN AS MORE OF A SOCIO-RELIGIOUS GUIDE THAN A POTENTIAL POLTIICAL LEADER, NO GOVERNMENT WILL SUCCEED IN PRESENT-DAY IRAN WHICH DOES NOT HAVE HIS STAMP OF APPROVAL.

THE GOVERNMENT WHICH FINALLY SUCCEEDS IN IRAN WILL BE ONE WHICH BASES ITS ACTIONS ON THE BELIEF THAT THE IRANIAN PEOPLE ARE WORTHWHILE AND TAKES THEIR VIEWS INTO ACCOUNT. THE UNITED STATES, THROUGH ITS STUBBORN, AND IN PRESENT CIRCUMSTANCES INCOMPREHENSIBLE, SUPPORT OF A REGIME WHICH DESPISED THE PEOPLE, HAS SHATTERED ITS REPUTATION IN IRAN.

MANY PEOPLE (PROBABLY INCLUDING MATINDAFTARI) REGARD THE SALE TO IRAN OF MASSIVE AMOUNTS OF UNNEEDEDMILITARY EQUIPMENT AT INFLATED PRICES AND THE PRESENCE IN IRAN OF THOUSANDS OF PAMPERED, HIGHLY PAID FOREIGN TECHNICIANS TO HANDLE THIS EQUIPMENT AS A REESTABLISHMENT IN ALTERED FORM OF THE CONCESSIONS AND CAPITULATIONS WHICH CHARACTERIZED THE LAST THREE-FOUR DECADES OF THE QAJAR DYNASTY AND CONTRIBUTED SIGNIFICANTLY TO THE CONSTITUTIONAL REVOLUTION. THE PRESENT IRANIAN REVOLUTION WILL RESULT IN THE CANCELLATION OF ANY CONTRACT WITH AMERICAN OR OTHER FOREIGN FIRMS WHICH APPEARS TO BE UNEQUAL OR EXPLOITATIVE AND MANY CONTRACTS WHICH WERE REACHED ON A BASIS OF EQUALITY WILL BE ENDANGERED IF THEY INVOLVE U.S. COMPANIES.

IT MATTERS LITTLE THAT THE WEAPONS WERE PURCHASED AND CONTRACTS SIGNED AT THE REQUEST OF THE GOI BECAUSE THE SHAH'S REGIME IS SEEN AS IN COLLUSION WITH THE U.S. IN OPPOSITION TO THE TRUE INTERESTS OF THE IRANIAN PEOPLE. IF THE U.S. HAS ANY HOPE FOR A FAVORABLE RELATIONSHIP WITH THE NEW IRAN, IT MUST REALIZE THAT SUCH A RELATIONSHIP MUST BE BASED ON EQUALITY.

COMMENT: MATIN-DAFTARI'S COMMENTS CONTAINED LITTLE THAT WAS NEW OR DIFFERENT FROM WHAT EMBOFF HAS HEARD FROM ANY NUMBER OF IRANIANS. HOWEVER, AS THE SON OF A FORMER PRIME MINISTER AND THE NEPHEW OF THE LATE MOHAMMAD MOSSADEGH, MATIN-DAFTARI OCCUPIES A RESPECTED POSITION AMONG THE RANKS OF THE OPPOSITION EVEN THOUGH HE IS NOT TERRIBLY ACTIVE POLITICALLY. PEOPLE FROM ALL ELEMENTS OF IRANIAN SOCIETY ARE FREQUENT CALLERS AT HIS OLD QAJAR MANSION TO REQUEST ASSISTANCE, ADVICE, OR JUST TO TALK.

CONSEQUENTLY, MATIN-DAFTARI'S VIEWS CONSTITUTE A DISTILLATION OF A VERY BROAD SPECTRUM IN IRAN AND MAY BE CONSIDERED MORE NEARLY REPRESENTATIVE THAN THOSE OF MANY OTHER IRANIAN OPPOSITIONISTS WHO LACK HIS TRADITIONAL BASE. END COMMENT SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00237.subject: VIEWS OF MASHAD UNIVERSITY CHANCELLOR PARVIZ AMOUZEGAR ON BAKHTIAR PRIME MINISTRY AND IRAN'S FUTURE

segments.text: AMOUZEGAR ON BAKHTIAR PRIME MINISTRY AND IRAN'S FUTURE

ACCORDING TO PARVIZ AMOUZEGAR, CHANCELLOR OF MASHAD UNIVERSITY, THE IRANIAN UNIVERSITY/INTELLECTUAL COMMUNITY, PERHAPS EXCLUDING MANY STUDENTS, IS WILLING TO GIVE A BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT A FAIR OPPORTUNITY TO PROVE ITSELF. HOWEVER, UNIVERSITY/INTELLECTUAL OPPOSITION WILL PRESENT ITSELF ALMOST IMMEDIATELY IF BAKHTIAR'S INAUGURATION IS NOT ACCOMPANIED BY A STATEMENT BY THE SHAH REGARDING HIS IMMINENT TRAVEL ABROAD FOR MEDICAL TREATMENT AND FOLLOWED VERY SHORTLY BY THE SHAH'S DEPARTURE. IT IS CLEAR THAT SOME ELEMENTS OF THE OPPOSITION HAVE ALREADY CONDEMNED BAKHTIAR, DESPITE HIS MUCH-WELCOMED STATEMENT DESCRIBING THE 28TH MORDAD RETURN OF THE SHAH AS A COUP AGAINST A NATIONALIST GOVERNMENT, AS A COLLABORATOR WITH THE PAHLAVI REGIME.
ANTI-BAKHTIAR SLOGANS AND BANNERS HAVE ALREADY BEEN SEEN IN MASHAD AND EMBOFF HAS OBSERVED TWO ANTI-BAKHTIAR SLOGANS WRITTEN ON TEHRAN WALLS.

AMOUZEGAR, HIS BROTHER-IN-LAW ALI ZIAI, AND HIS SISTER MOKHADDAREH ZIAI ARE IN AGREEMENT WITH THE PREVAILING IRANIAN SENTIMENT LAYING MUCH OF THE BLAME FOR THE PRESENT SITUATION IN IRAN AT THE FEET OF THE UNITED STATES. WHILE ADMITTING THAT THE U.S. HAD NO CHOICE BUT TO DEAL WITH THE SHAH IN THE PAST, THEY CATALOGUED A WHOLE SERIES OF U.S.

POLICY ERRORS GOING BACK TO THE DAYS OF POINT FOUR PROGRAM AND INCLUDING POOR TARGETING OF CULTURAL PROGRAMS AND EXCHANGES, LIMITATION OF EMBASSY CONTACTS TO PRO-SHAH IRANIANS, ASSIGNMENT OF FORMER CIA DIRECTOR HELMS AS AMBASSADOR, CHANGE OF USIA TO ICA (TOO MUCH LIKE CIA), LACK OF CONTINUITY AMONG AMERICAN OFFICIALS, AND PRESENT CONTINUING SUPPORT OF USG FOR SH AH WHEN IT IS ABUNDANTLY CLEAR THAT VAST MAJORITY OF IRANIANS DO NOT WANT HIM.

ALTHOUGH THEY ARE ALL AGREED THAT SHAH SHOULD LEAVE SOON, AMOUZEGAR ET.AL. INSIST THAT IRAN NEEDS THE INSTITUTION OF THE SHAH AND FEEL THAT PRESENT SHAH MIGHT BE ABLE TO RETURN TO IRAN IN A STRICTLY CONSTITUTIONAL CAPACITY (IF HE IS WILLING TO DO SO) ONCE A NATIONALIST GOVERNMENT HAS MANAGED TO GET MATTERS IN HAND. HOWEVER, SHAH HAS, THROUGHOUT PRESENT CRISIS, GIVEN TOO LITTLE TOOLATE AND HE RISKS WHATEVER OPPORTUNITY HE MAY HAVE TO RETURN, HIS PLACE IN HISTORY AND THE FUTURE OF THE PAHLAVI DYNASTY IF HE REFUSES TO LEAVE WITH DIGNITY BUT INSTEAD WAITS UNTIL HE IS THROWN OUT. SULLIVAN

MASHAD UNIVERSITY CHANCELLOR PARVIZ AMOUZEGAR, WHO LEFT MASHAD WITH HIS FAMILY JANARY 2, GAVE EMBOFF UPDATE ON CONDITIONS IN MASHAD. PEOPLE, HE SAID, HAD BECOME OUTRAGED AT ATTACK ON SHAH REZA HOSPITAL AND OTHER INCIDENTS AND BOTH ISLAMIC AND UNIVERSITY LEFTIST OPPOSITION LEADERS HAD LOST CONTROL OF THE MOB. TALES OF TORTURE AND BUTCHERY ARE ALLTOO ACCURATE HE SAID. POLICE HAVING WITHDRAWN FROM THE CITY, TOWN WAS GIVEN OVER TO THE MOB. APPARENTLY SPURRED ON BY AFGHAN WORKERS, MOBS BEGAN ATTACKING HOUSES WHERE THEY BELIEVED MONEY WAS KEPT AND LOOTING SHOPS.
OTHER HOUSES WERE ATTACKED BECAUSE AMERICANS LIVED THERE OR HAD ONCE LIVED THERE WHILE OTHER HOMES WERE TARGETTED BECAUSE THE RESIDENTS WERE BELIEVED TO BE MILITARY OR POLICE FAMILIES.

SOLDIERS BECAME ENRAGED WHEN THEY WERE SHOWN THE MUTILATED BODIES OF TWO COLONELS AND, ACCORDING TO MILITARY GOVERNOR, ALSO GOT OUT OF CONTROL. RESULT WAS 36 HOURS OF ALMOST UNINTERRUPTED GUNFIRE FROM BOTH SOLDIERS AND MOB. OVER 50,000 GATHERED AT WOMEN'S PRISON DEMANDING RELEASE OF PRISONERS. IN ENSUING CONFRONTATION THREE PEOPLE WERE CRUSHED UNDER TANK TRACKS BUT IN THE END THE PEOPLE HAD THEIR WAY AND ALL WOMEN PRISONERS WERE RELEASED. FOR 18 HOURS AN UNINTERRUPTED STREAM OF AMBULANCES AND PRIVATE VEHICLES BROUGHT 220 DEAD AND OVER 700 WOUNDED JUST INTO THE TWO UNIVERSITY HOSPITALS. OTHERS WERE UNDOUBTEDLY TREATED IN MASHAD'S GOVERNMENT HOSPITAL, PRIVATE CLINICS, OR AT HOME.
THOSE BRINGING CASUALTIES ALSO BROUGHT IN 18 MILITARY WEAPONS WHICH THE HOSPITAL RETURNED TO THE ARMY.

CARNAGE HAS PRODUCED AN UNEASY CALM IN WHICH FEW PEOPLE VENTURE OUTSIDE AND PEOPLE, NOTING THAT MUCH OF THE KILLING WAS DONE BY PEOPLE IN CIVILIAN CLOTHES, ARE AFRAID TO TALK TO ONE ANOTHER. MILITARY ARE TOO FEW TO CONTROL ALL OF CITY AND ARE DEVOTING MOST OF THEIR EFFORTS TO PROTECTION OF THEIR OWN HOMES AND OF OFFICIAL BUILDINGS ANDINSTALLATIONS. MILITARY GOVERNOR IS ACTING IN EXTREME SECRECY AND GOVERNOR-GENERAL APPEARS UNINFORMED OF ANY ACTION OR DECISIONS TAKEN BY THE ARMY. SAVAK IS ALSO GOING ITS OWN WAY AND THERE APPEARS TO BE LITTLE COORDINATION AMONG ANY OF THE ELEMENTS OF THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT IN MASHAD.
MORE VIOLENCE COULD BREAK OUT AT ANY TIME.

VIOLENCE HAS ALSO HAD DAMAGING EFFECT ON POSITIONS OF MASHAD'S TWO MOST PROMINENT AYATOLLAHS, SHIRAZI AND QOMI. FOLLOWING AN INCIDENT IN WHICH SEVERAL PEOPLE WERE KILLED INSIDE HIS HOME, SHIRAZI REFUSED TO ADMIT OPPOSITIONISTS AND RETURNED TO THE ARMY SOME 80 MILITARY WEAPONS WHICH HAD BEEN GIVEN TO HIM BY DESERTING SOLDIERS. BOTH HE AND QOMI ISSUED MODERATE STATEMENTS URGING THE PEOPLE TO ESCHEW VIOLENCE. THE MOB TURNED ON THE AYATOLLAHS AND REJECTED THEM. LEFTISTS MEETING AT THE UNIVERSITY REVILED THEM AS TRAITORS AND DRUNKARDS AND AMOUZEGAR BELIEVES THAT THE PEOPLE ARE NOW LOOKING FOR NEW LEADERS WHO WILL TELL THEM WHAT THEY WANT TO HEAR.
MEANWHILE, THE AYATOLLAH SHIRAZI, HAVING BEEN THREATENED, HAS FLED MASHAD AND TAKEN REFUGE IN ONE OF THE SMALLER OUTLYING VILLAGES.

COMMENT: VIOLENCE AND SAVAGERY HAVE BEEN WORSE IN MASHAD THAN ELSEWHERE IN IRAN AND THE SHRINE CITY SHOULD NOT RPT NOT BE VIEWED AS IRAN IN MICROCOSM. HOWEVER, DIFFERENCE BETWEEN MASHAD AND OTHER IRANIAN CITIES IS PRIMARILY ONE OF DEGREE. IT IS PARTICULARLY DISTURBING THAT XENOPHOBIA/ANTI-AMERICANISM CONTINUES TO GROW. NORMALLY MODERATE INF POLITICIAN HEDAYAT MATIN-DAFTARI RAILED AT EMBOFF JANUARY 3 THAT U.S. BEARS DIRECT RESPONSIBILITY FOR MANY DEATHS WHICH REPORTEDLY RESULTED FROM VIOLENCE IN QAZVIN. END COMMENT SULLIVAN

DETAILS OF THE AGREEMENT NEGOTIATED BY MEHDI BAZARGAN ARE, AS GIVEN TO US TODAY BY OSCO, SOMEWHAT DIFFERENT THAN WE REPORTED YESTERDAY. APPARENTLY THE AGREEMENT WHICH WAS SIGNED BY NIOC, MILITARY REPRESENTATIVES AND STRIKE LEADERS INVOLVES IN THE FIRST INSTANCE ONLY PRODUCTION WORKERS AND REFINERY WORKERS AT ABADAN. THE INITIAL INTENT IS TO BOOST PRODUCTION TO ABOUT 600,000 B/D, REFINE ALL OF IT IN ABADAN, AND DISTRIBUTE THE PRODUCTS COUNTRY-WIDE.

THE FIRST MAJOR PROBLEM WHICH HAS ARISEN IS THE REFUSAL OF PIPELINE OPERATORS TO RESUME WORK WHICH SOME MUST DO IN ORDER TO DISTRIBUTE THE PRODUCTS WHICH WILL BE AVAILABLE FROM ABADAN. REPORTEDLY THE PIPELINE WORKERS WILL NOT RESUME WORK UNTIL THEY HAVE SEEN THE FINAL SIGNED AGREEMENT NEGOTIATED BY BAZARGAN. EFFORTS ARE NOW UNDER WAY TO TAKE THE AGREEMENT AROUND TO DEMONSTRATE ITS EXISTENCE AND AUTHENTICITY.
THE NEXT STEP WILL PROBABLY BE FOR BAZARGAN TO COME TO TEHRAN AND ATTEMPT TO WORK HIS MAGIC ON THE WORKERS OF TEHRAN'S REY REFINERY.

1979TEHRAN00240.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT JAN 5 SUMMARY: BAKHTIAR RECEIVES IMPERIAL FIRMAN. CORRUPTION TRIALS START. OSCO CONFIRMS SETTLEMENT REACHED IN

segments.text: SUMMARY: BAKHTIAR RECEIVES IMPERIAL FIRMAN. CORRUPTION TRIALS START. OSCO CONFIRMS SETTLEMENT REACHED IN OIL FIELDS. RELIGIOUS CATERWAULERS AND TAPE RECORDS WERE ACTIVE EVENING JAN 4; SHOOTING WAS NOT HEAVY. IRAN GENERALLY QUIET MIDDAY JAN 5. END SUMMARY

DR. SHAPOUR BAKHTIAR RECEIVED IMPERIAL FIRMAN NAMING HIM PRIME MINISTER JAN 4. BAKHTIAR STILL HAS NOT ANNOUNCED HIS CABINET. SOURCES CLOSE TO HIM SAY THAT WILL NOT COME UNTIL FURTHER CONSULTATIONS HAVE TAKEN PLACE WITH NATIONAL FRONT (INF) AND LIBERATION MOVEMENT (LMI) LEADERS. WE UNDERSTAND SHAH SPENT JAN 4-5 VISITING 70 MILES EAST OF TEHRAN, BUT IS DUE BACK THIS AFTERNOON.

EMBOFF LEARNED IN CONFIDENCE FROM AMCIT WIFE OF OFFICIAL UNDER ARREST FOR CORRUPTIONTHAT MILITARY TRIALS OF SENIOR OFFICIALS BEGAN JAN 4 IN CAMERA AT JAMSHIDIYEH PRISON. SOURCE SAID HER HUSBAND DID NOT KNOW WHEN HE WOULD BE TRIED, BUT INDICATED DEFENDANTS WERE NOT ALLOWED THEIR OWN LAWYERS AND THAT TRIALS WERE EXPECTED TO BE OVER IN ABOUT A WEEK. (COMMENT: APPEARS GOI HAS GONE BACK TO HARD-LINE MILITARY TRIALS FOR THESE CASES TO GET LEGAL PROCESS MOVING AND GET PROMPT CONVICTIONS.

PUBLIC DEMAND FOR ACTION AGAINST CORRUPTION HAS BECOME SO INTENSE THAT QUESTIONS OF CIVIL RIGHTS ARE NOT LIKELY TO BE RAISED OR EVEN HEEDED BY TRADITIONAL OPPOSITIONIST EXPONENTS OF HUMAN RIGHTS. ONE PROMINENT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY LAW SCHOOL PROFESSOR WHO HAS EXPRESSED HUMAN RIGHTS CONCERN IN PAST TOLD EMBOFF "PEOPLE'S ANGER DEMANDS JUSTICE. THE REVOLUTION WILL HAVE NO TIME FOR LEGAL NICETIES." WE WOULD EXPECT THIS FROM REVOLUTIONARY OPPOSITIONISTS, BUT FACT THAT HERETOFORE MODERATE INTELLECTUALS ARE TAKING THIS LINE IS INDICATIVE OF SITUATION HERE.)

OSCO CONFIRMED TO AMBASSADOR JAN 5 THAT BAZARGAN HAS REACHED SETTLEMENT ALONG LINES REPORTED SEPTELS JAN 4. PUMPING OF CRUDE OIL TO OUTLYING REFINERIES EXPECTED TO BEGIN TODAY. OSCO OFFICIAL NOTED, HOWEVER, THAT REY PUMPING STATION PERSONNEL BALKED AT NEWS OF AGREEMENT AND ASKED TO SEE IT, WHICH MAY DELAY REACTIVATION OF REFINERY IN TEHRAN.

SECURITY SITUATION IN COUNTRY IS QUIET IN TEHRAN, TABRIZ, SHIRAZ AND ISFAHAN AS OF MIDDAY JAN 5. EVENING JAN 4 SAW RELIGIOUS GROUPS TAKE TO STREETS AFTER BEGINNING OF RITUAL 3-HOUR BLACKOUT THROUGHOUT VIRTUALLY EN TIRE CITY, SHOUTING AND PLAYING TAPE RECORDERS. SEASONED OBSERVERS IN NORTH SAID VOLUME WAS SIMILAR TO FIRST DAY OF MOHARRAM (DEC 2). SOME EMBASSY PERSONNEL SAW AND HEARD MARCHERS AFTER CURFEW, BUT SHOOTING WAS NOT AS HEAVY AS NIGHT BEFORE. THERE WERE NO DEATHS NIGHT JAN 4.
AS OF 1200 J AN 5, AIRPORT LOADING NORMALLY AND NOT
SHAH TOLD ME EVENING JAN 5 THAT HE HAD NOT RPT NOT BEEN ABLE TO REACH QUEEN MOTHER SINCE BEVERLY HILLS INCIDENT TO CONFIRM STATE OF HER HEALTH. (HE WAS OUT OF CITY FOR TWO DAYS.)
HE IS CONCERNED THAT TENSION AND FRIGHT ASSOCIATED WITH ASSULT ON HOUSE AND WITH PRECIPITOUS MOVES MAY HAVE AGGRAVATED HER HEART CONDITION.

I WOULD SUGGEST THAT DEPARTMENT ARRANGE, PRESUMABLY THROUGH IRANIAN EMBASSY, TO HAVE SOME RESPONSIBLE PERSON IN QUEEN MOTHER'S ENTOURAGE TELEPHONE THE SHAH WITH A STATUS REPORT ON HER HEALTH (IF THIS HAS NOT ALREADY BEEN DONE). SULLIVAN
SHAH TOLD ME EVENING JANUARY 5 THAT HE WAS SENDING ZAHEDI BACK TO THE U.S. "WITHIN THE NEXT COUPLE OF DAYS."

I SAID ZAHEDI TOLD ME HE WOULD RESIGN AS AMBASSADOR AS SOON AS BAKHTIAR WAS SWORN IN. SHAH SAID HE WOULD SEND HIM IN CAPACITY AS "ROVING AMBASSADOR" AND CHARGE HIM WITH LOOKING AFTER THE SAFETY OF THOSE MEMBERS OF THE ROYAL FAMILY IN THE U.S.

ZAHEDI TELEPHONED ME LATER THAT SAME EVENING AND SEEMED UNUSUALLY SUBDUED. HOWEVER, SINCE HE DID NOT RPT NOT MENTION ANY PLANS FOR RETURN TO U.S., I DID NOT RPT NOT INDICATE MY KNOWLEDGE OF THE SHAH'S PLANS FOR HIM.

COMMENT: IT IS MY ASSUMPTION THAT SHAH IS REMOVING ZAHEDI FROM THE LOCAL SCENE IN ORDER TO ELIMINATE A POTENTIAL OBSTACLE TO THE MANEUVERS WHICH HE WILL ATTEMPT IN THE NEAR FUTURE WITH RESPECT TO ASSURING THE SUCCESS OF THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT. SULLIVAN

CABINET ESSENTIALLY AS REPORTED BY WIRE SERVICES WAS PRESENTED THIS MORNING BY PM-DESIGNATE BAKHTIAR TO THE SHAH. APPOINTS ARE INTERIOR - BAKHTIAR HIMSELF, INCLUDING CONTROL OVER POLICE, GENDARMINE, AND PRESUMABLY SAVAK WAR - GEN. FEREIDUN JAM (WHO IS ON WAY BACK FROM LONDON)
FOREIGN AFFAIR AHMAD MIR-FENDERESKI, WHO WAS FIRED BY SHAH AS DEPUTY FOREIGN MINISTER IN 1973 REPORTEDLY FOR EXCEEDING SHAH'SLIMITS ON SOVIET OVERFLIGHTS PERMITTED DURING 1973 ARAB-ISRAELI WAR.
JUSTICE - YAHYA SADEQ-VAZIRI, A LAWYER AND CAREER JUDGE WHO IS KURDISH

INFORMATION AND TOURISM - CYRUS AMUZEGAR, FORMERLY SOMETHING OF A LEFTIST, WRITER AND JOURNALIST, NOT CONNECTED WITH FORMER PM AMOUZEGAR'S FAMILY ECONOMICS AND FINANCE - RUSTAM PIRASTEH, INTERNATIONAL BANKER, FORMER CHASE MANHATTEN REP HERE

MOHAMMAD MOSHIRI-YEZDI, DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER FOR ADMINISTRATION AND FINANCIAL AFFAIRS, HIGH CIVIL SERVANT IN MINISTRY OF LABOR (INCLUDING PERMANENT DEPUTY) WHO SOUNDS LIKE AN OLD FRIEND OF BAKHTIAR'S
AGRICULTURE -- MANUCHEHR KAZEMI, EXPERIENCED IN PBO, BANK MELLI, GRADUATE OF HARVARD IN 1920S, FRIENDLY TO AMERICANS BUT CRITICAL OF THE REGIME.

INDUSTRY AND MINES -- ABBAS QOLI BAKHTIAR, A COUSIN OF PM'S WHO IS HIGH CIVIL SERVANT WITH NIOC BACKGROUND, HAVING SERVED IN FAIRLY RECENT POST AS UNDERSECY OF THIS MINISTRY, PERHAPS SENSITIVE ABOUT AMERICANS EDUCATION - DR. MOHAMMAD AMIN RIAHI, PROMINENT EDUCATIONALIST AND JOURNALIST

LABOR AND SOCIAL WELFARE -- MANUCHEHR ARIANA, CAREER CIVIL SERVANT IN LABOR DEPT WHO IS REPORTEDLY COUSIN OF RETIRED GENERAL ARIANA (ONE OF THOSE GENERALS MENTIONED AS ACCEPTABLE BY SOME OPPOSITIONISTS) PPT LUTF-ALI SAMIMI, CAREER OFFICIAL HEALTH - MANUCHEHR RAZMARA, U.S. EDUCATED PHYSICIAN HOUSING - JAVAD KHADEM, VERY ACTIVE CONTRACTOR, CONSTRUCTION BUSINESS, REPORTEDLY EMOTIONAL AND PERHAPS ANTI-AMERICAN.

NONE OF APPOINTEES HAS SERVED AS MINISTER BEFORE. JAM AND MIR-FENDERESKI HAVE BOTH BEEN AMBASSADORS. APART FROM OVERTONES OF SOME ANTI-REGIME POLITICAL ACTIVITY IN ONE OR TWO CASES (AMUZEGAR, KAZEMI) CABINET IS COMPOSED OF TECHNOCRATS WITH LONG EXPERIENCE IN AREAS OF EXPERTISE AND (WE GATHER) CLEAN RECORDS ON CORRUPTION ISSUE.

CABINET CONTAINS NONE OF THE MORE POLITICAL OPPOSITIONISTS WHO WERE AT ONE POINT RUMORED TO BE JOINING. THESE INCLUDED PEOPLE SUCH AS HEAD OF TEACHER'S UNION MOHAMMAD DERAKHSHESH (FOR ARTS AND CULTURE), ENG. AHMAD MOSSADEGH, MOSSADEGH'S SON (FOR ROADS), AND EVEN PROMINENT CIVIL RIGHTS AND RELIGIOUS SPOKESMAN NASSER MINATCHI, ACCORDING TO RECENT RUMORS.

NUMBER OF MINISTERS REMAIN VACANT: COMMERCE, CULTURE, PLAN AND BUDGET (IF NOT ABOLISHED), ROADS, ENERGY, SCIENCE AND HIGHER EDUCATION, AS WELL AS TRADITIONAL MINISTERS OF STATE FOR THINGS SUCH AS PARLIAMENTARY AFFAIRS AND EXECUTIVE AFFAIRS. THERE IS ALSO NO MINISTER OF ENDOWMENT AFFAIRS, AN AREA THAT MIGHT BE TURNED OVER TO THE RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP ACCORDING TO SOME REPORTS WE HAVE HAD.
MORE SPECIFIC BIO DATA AS WE DEVELOP IT. SULLIVAN

UNREST CONTINUES, ALTHOUGH NO MAJOR NEW VIOLENCE IS REPORTED. SMALL CROWDS ARE MOVING THROUGH CENTRAL TEHRAN. TODAY WAS ONE OF THOSE DAYS WHICH RUMOR MILL PREDICTED TO BE VIOLENT, BUT AS OF MID-AFTERNOON THIS HAS NOT DEVELOPED. DWELLING OF AMERICAN EMPLOYEE OF GTE WAS FIREBOMBED LAST NIGHT, DOING CONSIDERABLE DAMAGE TO LANDLORD'S APT (AND SLIGHTLY INJURING HIM). AMCIT'S APT RECEIVED SMOKE DAMAGE, BUT HE WAS NOT INJURED. STONES WERE THROWN THROUGH WINDOW OF ASST AIR ATTACH'S APT.

CONSULATE ISFAHAN REPORTS SITUATION QUIET. DEMONSTRATION OF 15-20,000 TOOK PLACE YESTERDAY AT A MOSQUE IN RESPONSE TO RELIGIOUS LEADERS' CALL FOR GATHERING. MEETING, WHICH WAS PEACEFUL, WAS PROBABLY SMALLER THAN MULLAHS HOPED TO SUMMON. SOME TROUBLE ERUPTED EVENING OF JAN 4 IN BHI HOUSING AREA WHERE DEPARTING EMPLOYEES WERE SELLING FURNITURE. CROWD OF 3-4,000 IRANIANS GATHERED AS PROSPECTIVE BUYERS, BUT EVENTUALLY BECAME UNRULY AND WERE EVICTED, REPORTEDLY DOING SOME DAMAGE AND STEALING ARTICLES BEFORE THEY LEFT. THE SALE DID NOT TAKE PLACE YESTERDAY FOR FEAR OF FURTHER TROUBLE. A CLUB FREQUENTED BY BHI EMPLOYEES WAS BOMBED BUT WAS EMPTY AT THE TIME.

THERE WAS SOME DESTRUCTION IN KERMANSHAH YESTERDAY WITH CARS BURNED AND BROKEN WINDOWS, BUT APPARENTLY NO INJURIES. WE WERE UNABLE TO CONTACT CONSULATE SHIRAZ. CONSUL TABRIZ WAS OUT OF OFFICE, BUT TABRIZ OPERATOR THOUGHT SITUATION WAS QUIET. STATE RADIO REPORTS ONLY A FEW PEACEFUL DEMONSTRATIONS THROUGHOUT IRAN YESTERDAY (COMMENT: NIRT COVERAGE OF DEMONSTRATIONS HAS BEEN STRAIGHTFORWARD IN RECENT DAYS).

SIGNIFICANTLY MORE COMMERICAL ACTIVITY IS TAKING PLACE TODAY IN TEHRAN AND ISFAHAN THAN PREVIOUSLY -- MORE TRAFFIC AND MORE SHOPS OPEN. ONE BANK MANAGER TOLD CONSULATE ISFAHAN THAT HE PLANNED TO OPEN TOMORROW. MAJOR PRESS RESUMES PUBLICATION THIS AFTERNOON AFTER LONG LAYOFF. ACCORDING TO STATE RADIO, GOVT HAS ACCEPTED CONDITION OF TOTAL FREEDOM FROM CENSORSHIP. (COMMENT: PRESS WILL UNDOUBTEDLY COME OUT SWINGING.) THERE ARE ALSO SIGNS OF IMPRONT IN OIL SITUATION (BEING REPORTED SEPTEL) ALTHOUGH LINES AT GASOLINE STATIONS HAVE, IF ANYTHING, BECOME LONQR.

EARLY THIS AFTERNOON A MOB OF ABOUT 200 ENTERED PAN AM OFFICES AND ORDERED STAFF TO CLOSE DOWN OR THEY WOULD BURN BUILDING. PAN AM DISMISSED STAFF AND CLOSED OFFICE UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE. EMBASSY HAS OFFERED TO MAKE OUR LOUNGE, PHONES, AND OTHER FACILITIES AVAILABLE TO PAN AM TO ASSIST IN RELOCATION OF AMERICANS. WE WILL MEET WITH THEM THIS AFTERNOON.

PRESS REPORTS ARMY HAS PERMITTED SOME OUTSIDERS TO ENTER TEHRAN UNIVERSITY, WHERE 70 TEACHERS ARE HOLDING SIT-IN. PRESS ALSO REPORTS GEN. MEHDI RAHIMI REPLACED GEN OVEISI AS MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR. RAHIMI WAS OVEISI'S DEPUTY.

TOMORROW HAS BEEN DECLARED NATIONAL DAY OF MOURNING AND GENERAL STRIKE BY NATIONAL FRONT. WE HAVE RUMORS OF DEMONSTRATIONS PLANNED FOR TOMORROW, BUT ACCORDING TO STATEMENT FROM SANJABI SPOKESMAN SALAMATIAN, INF DOES NOT CALL FOR DEMONSTRATIONS. LMI SOURCE SAYS NEITHER RELIGIOUS HEADS NOR LMI ARE ASSOCIATED WITH INF APPEAL.

PRIMIN BAKHTIAR ANNOUNCED CABINET TODAY (BEING REPORTED SEPTEL).

SHAH APPEARED ON IRANIAN RADIO EARLY AFTERNOON NEWS TIME TO ANNOUNCE NEW GOVT AND REPORTEDLY SAID HE IS TIRED AND PLANS TO TAKE A VACATION TO REST. IF THE VACATION IS OUTSIDE THE COUNTRY, PROVISIONS OF THE CONSTITUTION REMAIN IN FORCE. LAST PHRASE IS REFERENCE TO REGENCY COUNCIL. (WE DO NOT HAVE EXACT TRANSLATION OF REMARKS FROM RELIABLE SOURCE AND WILL CORRECT IF ANY IMPORTANT POINT POS ERRONEOUS.) SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00279.subject: TELECON AMBASSADOR WOULD LIKE SECURE TELECON WITH UNDER SECRETARY NEWSON AND ASSISTANT SECRETARY SAUNDERS

segments.text: AMBASSADOR WOULD LIKE SECURE TELECON WITH UNDER SECRETARY NEWSON AND ASSISTANT SECRETARY SAUNDERS ONLY RPT ONLY AT 0930 WASHINGTON TIME ON SUNDAY, JAN 7. PLEASE CONFIRM AS SOON AS IT IS SET FROM YOUR END.

HEAD OF TEACHERS UNION AND MODERATE OPPOSITION POLITICIAN MOHAMMAD DERAKHSHESH EXPRESSED TOTAL OPPOSITION TO BAKHTIAR GOVT IN BRIEF PHONE CONVERSATION WITH POL COUNSELOR TODAY, JAN 7. HE DENIED HE HAD EVER BEEN CANDIDATE FOR A POSITION (CONTRARY TO REPORTS EMBASSY HAD RECEIVED FROM OTHER SOURCES LAST WEEK) AND DENIGRATED QUALITY OF MINISTERS. SEVERAL OF HIS GROUP HAD TURNED DOWN OFFERS FROM BAKHTIAR.

IF ANY (SUCH AS SAMIMI) ARE MEMBERS OF OPPOSITION PARTIES, DERAKHSHESH SAID, THEY WERE FORTH RANK UNKNOWNS. HE KNEW FOR A FACT THAT NEW MINISTER OF EDUCATION (RIAHI) WAS AN ACTIVE SAVAK AGENT; DERAKHSHESH HAD GOTTEN HIM A JOB YEARS AGO WHEN HE WAS AN UNEMPLOYED TEACHER. OTHERS IN THIS SUPPOSEDLY "NEW" GOVT WERE WORKING OFFICIALS UP TO RECENTLY AND MEMBERS OF RASTAKHIZ PARTY. THEIR APPOINTMENTS ARE A JOKE.

WHEN POL COUNSELOR ASKED WHAT DERAKHSHESH THOUGHT OF SHAH'S PLANS TO TAKE A VACATION, DERAKSHSHESH SAID HE WAS NOT IMPRESSED. SHAH HAS TAKEN VACATIONS BEFORE, AND COME BACK. THAT IS NOT THE PERMANENTDEPARTURE THAT IS NECESSARY.

DERAKHSHESH SAID SHAH IS ALWAYS LATE WITH HIS DECISIONS. BAKHTIAR GOVT WOULD HAVE BEEN ANSWER A YEAR AGO, BUT TOO LATE NOW. COUNTRY'S SICKNESS REQUIRES REAL MEDICINE, NOT ROUND WHITE PILLS. HE AGAIN PUSHED HIS GROUP'S POSITION: SHAH MUST LEAVE SO THAT KHOMEINI LOSES MUCH OF HIS POWER, ALLOWING MODERATES OF THE CENTER TO COME INTO THEIR OWN.
DERAKHSHESH'S WEEKLY (ON ITS THIRD ISSUE) ATTACKED

1979TEHRAN00300.subject: POLITICAL BROKER IS DISCOURAGED; YET ANOTHER MODERATE POLITICAL GROUP FORMED. SUMMARY: LONG-TIME POLITICAL BROKER IS DISCOURAGE

segments.text: MODERATE POLITICAL GROUP FORMED. SUMMARY: LONG-TIME POLITICAL BROKER IS DISCOURAGED BY GOI'S CONTINUED INEPTITUDE. HE SEES TUDEH (COMMUNIST) PARTY BECOMING VERY ACTIVE. HIS CURRENT EFFORTS ARE DIRECTED TO MOLDING A MODERATE GROUP BEHIND ALI AMINI WHICH WILL BE VEHICLE FOR SUPPORT OF BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT UNTIL ELECTIONS. END SUMMARY.

EMBOFF MET JAN 4 WITH HEDAYAT ESLAMINIA, POLITICAL BROKER OF SOME YEARS' STANDING WITH WHOM EMBASSY HAS BEEN COMMUNICATING REGULARLY FOR BETTER PART OF A YEAR. HE WAS FRANKLY DISCOURAGED AT TURN OF EVENTS; GOI HAD REMAINED SURPRISINGLY INEPT AT HANDLING CRISIS AND AS A RESULT, TUDEH PARTY ACTIVITY WAS BECOMING MORE WIDESPREAD. HE SAID SEVERAL OF HIS FRIENDS FROM THE SOUTH HAD NOTED OLDLINE TUDEH ORGANIZERS INVOLVED IN RECENT LABOR DISTURBANCES (COMMENT: THIS SQUARES WITH WHAT WE'VE HEARD FROM OTHER SOURCES, AS WELL).

ESLAMINIA THEN SAID HE HAD GATHERED A NUMBER OF FRIENDS IN VARIOUS POSITIONS TOGETHER TO FORM A GROUP BEHIND ALI AMINI. THIS GROUP WOULD SUPPORT THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT, BUT PREPARE ITSELF FOR ELECTIONS. HE LISTED THE FOLLOWING AS INITIAL MEMBERS OF THE GROUP: MR. (FNU) FAZAELI, EX-MARDOM PARTY LEADER; ABDUL HOSSEIN TABATABATAI, FORMER SHIRAZ MAJLES DEPUTY; NASSER ZEHTABFARD, DIRECTOR OF ASNAF (PRICE MONITORING GROUP); MANUCHEHR SAED-VAZIRI, FORMER MAJLES DEPUTY PRESENTLY A NEWSPAPER COLUMINIST; MR. HEKMAT YAZDI, A BUSINESSMAN; MR. TEYMOUR AND MR. REZAN, FROM ASNAF; HAJ KARIM HOSSEINI, A BAZAARI WHO SUPPORTS AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI; AND HASSAN KHAN BAYAT, HEAD OF THE FARMER'S GUILD.
GROUP WAS MERELY WAITING GO AHEAD SIGNAL FROM ALI AMINI TO FORMALLY ORGANIZE.
COMMENT: GROUP IS SIMILAR TO MANY NOW FORMING, AND IF IT TRULY GETS ORGANIZED, EMBASSY WILL REPORT FURTHER. MOST SUCH MODERATE GROUPS, AS OF JAN 7, ARE GIVING SUPPORT

1979TEHRAN00309.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT, JAN 7, 1979 SUMMARY: DAY OF MOURNING, FOLLOWED BY KHOMEINI'S OWN DAY OF MOURNING TOMORROW. MAJOR PRESS RETURNS WITH GR

segments.text: SUMMARY: DAY OF MOURNING, FOLLOWED BY KHOMEINI'S OWN DAY OF MOURNING TOMORROW. MAJOR PRESS RETURNS WITH GREAT FANFARE. BAKHTIAR GOES TO WORK AS KHOMEINI BRANDS HIS GOVT "ILLEGAL." DEMONSTRATIONS UNDERWAY IN TEHRAN.

TEHRAN AND OTHER CITIES REMAINED QUIET LAST NIGHT. CONSULATES SHIRAZ, TABRIZ, AND ISFAHAN ALL REPORTED QUIET EVENINGS AND NO TROUBLE AS OF THIS MORNING. MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES HAVE ROLLED BACK START OF CURFEW IN TEHRAN TO 2300. SMALL GROUP SHOUTING "YANKEE GO HOME" ENTERED SHERATON BAR LAST NIGHT AND SCUFFLED WITH OTHER IRANIANS THERE, BUT NO AMERICANS WERE INJURED.

MAJOR PRESS RETURNED LAST EVENING AND THIS MORNING WITH APPROPRIATE FANFARE AND PICTURES OF KHOMEINI. ONE JOURNAL HAS CAPTIONED OVER LARGE PHOTO OF THE AYATOLLAH: "WELL DONE, SAYS KHOMEINI." TONE OF PRESS HAS INDEED CHANGED, EVEN WHEN COMPARED TO THE FREEST DAYS OF THE SHARIF-EMAMI GOVT, E.G. "THE REVOLUTION DROWNED JAMSHID AMOUZEGAR'S CABINET IN THE BLOOD OF ITS CHILDREN." SHAH IS NO LONGER "SHAHANSHAH," AND KHOMEINI'S STATEMENTS RECEIVED HEAVY COVERAGE.

ONE JOURNAL WRITES "PEOPLE'S REVOLUTION IS ON THE THRESHOLD OF VICTORY." PRESS TALKS OF "DRAMATIC LOSS OF AMERICAN SUPPORT" FOR OLD RULING CLIQUE, AND PRINTS ARTICLES OF DUBIOUS ACCURACY, SUCH AS THE PEOPLE'S RAID ON A SAVAK "HOUSE OF TERROR," IN TEHRAN (ON BAHAR STREET, NEAR EMBASSY) WHICH WAS FOUND TO BE COVERED WITH "PILES OF HUMAN BONES," OR ANOTHER HEADLINE SAYING "ISRAELI, U.S. PLANES NOT TO BE ALLOWED." PRESS WISHES BAKHTAIR WELL, BUT FEATURES KHOMEINI AND NATIONAL FRONT CONDEMNATION OF NEW GOVT. PRESS INSISTS GENERALS RABII AND KHOSRODAD HAVE RESIGNED (COMMENT: PRESS IS INCORRECT AND BOTH OFFICERS ARE CARRYING OUT THEIR REGULAR DUTIES.).

PRESS REPORTS PARIS INDICATE KHOMEINI HAS DASHED HOPES OF AT LEAST REMAINING SILENT ON BAKHTIAR GOVT. CALLING IT "A DANGEROUS PLOT," HE HAS INSTRUCTED IRANIANS TO DISOBEY NEW GOVT AND PREVENT NEW MINISTERS FROM TAKING THEIR POSTS. PEOPLE SHOULD ALSO REFUSE TO PAY TAXES FOR UTILITIES AND SHOULD CONTINUE STRIKES.

DESPITE MUCH CONFUSION REGARDING WHO HAS CALLED FOR WHICH MOURNING DAY, SEQUENCE APPEARS TO BE AS FOLLOWS: KHOMEINI DECLARED TODAY A DAY OF MOURNING. SANJABI'S NATIONAL FRONT ASSOCIATED ITSELF WITH THE APPEAL. PRIMIN BAKHTIAR OBLIGINGLY ADDED HIS VOICE, SO THAT TODAY IS OFFICIALLY A MOURNING DAY FOR VICTIMS OF RECENT DEMONSTRATIONS. NATIONAL FRONT STATED, HOWEVER, THAT NO DEMONSTRATIONS ARE PLANNED. THEN KHOMEINI, DISDAINING NATIONAL FRONT, CALLED INDEPENDENTLY FOR DAY OF MOURNING TOMORROW. BAZARGAN'S LMI IS ASSOCIATING ITSELF WITH THAT. THIS MAY OR MAY NOT INCLUDE DEMONSTRATIONS. OTHER DIPLOMATIC MISSIONS ARE NERVOUS ABOUT NUMBERS OF DEMONSTRATORS THAT MIGHT TURN UP IN MANNER OF ASHURA.
SOME PROFESSORS ARE CLAIMING TEHRAN UNIVERSITY WILL REOPEN JAN 9. SOME HAVE LONG DEMANDED THAT UNIVERSITIES REOPEN, BUT WE DOUBT THIS WILL OCCUR IN NEAR FUTURE.

HARASSMENT OF NATIONAL EMPLOYEES TOOK NEW TWIST LAST NIGHT WHEN DCM'S DRIVER HAD BOMB THROWN INTO HIS YARD. SIGN OF THE TIMES IS FACT THAT POLICE GATE GUARDS AT MAC ENTRANCE TO MEHRABAD AIRPORT ARE DEMANDING 1,000 RIALS PER BUS BEFORE ALLOWING ENTRY.

GENERAL STRIKE APPEARS EFFECTIVE IN TEHRAN, ALTHOUGH CITY HAS BEEN PARTIALLY SHUT DOWN FOR SO LONG THAT A GENERAL STRIKE IS NOT VERY NOTICEABLE. CITY HAS NOT, HOWEVER, REMAINED QUIET. AROUND NOON THERE WAS HEAVY GUNFIRE THROUGHOUT CITY. DEMONSTRATORS ON NEARBY SHAH REZA HAVE MOVED SOUTH. WE HAD UNCONFIRMED REPORT EARLY TODAY THAT SANJABI WILL ADDRESS MASSIVE DEMONSTRATION IN SOUTH TEHRAN. THIS WOULD VIOLATE HIS SPOKESMAN'S PREVIOUS ASSURANCE THAT NO DEMONSTRATIONS WOULD TAKE PLACE TODAY, BUT MARCHING CROWDS HAVE OBVIOUSLY ALREADY FAILED TO FOLLOW THAT RULE.
ON THE OTHER HAND, SANJABI HAS APPOINTMENT WITH ANOTHER OPPOSITION LEADER AT 1500 TODAY, SO HIS ADDRESS WILL BE EARLIER IN DAY, IF AT ALL.

WE HAVE UNCONFIRMED REPORT FROM SHIRAZ THAT IRANIAN AIR BASE COMMANDER HAS WARNED OF MASSIVE DEMONSTRATIONS AND ASKED AMERICANS TO COME TO THE BASE FOR PROTECTION. WE HAVE BEEN UNABLE TO CONTACT CONSULATE SHIRAZ SINCE THAT REPORT.

A ONE-MAN NATIONAL FRONT COMMISSION INQUIRING INTO RECENT TROUBLE IN QAZVIN REPORTED ABOUT 40 PEOPLE HAVE BEEN KILLED THERE, MANY OF THEM WHEN ARMY LAUNCHED RETALIATORY "INVASION" OF THE TOWN. PRESS PLAYS HIS ACCOUNT AGAINST GOVT VERSION, MUCH TO DETRIMENT OF THE LATTER.

AMERICAN PRESS SOURCE SAYS IRANIAN MILITARY RECENTLY TOOK SEVERAL REPORTERS TO MASHAD AND SHOWED THEM EVIDENCE OF BRUTAL ATTACKS ON SECURITY FORCES. REPORTER SAID EXCURSION, WHICH WAS VERY SMOOTHLY HANDLED, INCLUDED PITCURES OF THE WORST MUTILATION HE HAS EVER SEEN. GOVT STATED THE PERPRETRATORS WERE UZBEKS AND AFGHANIS RATHER THAN TRUE PERSIANS. DEPT WILL HAVE SEEN VARIOUS PRESS STORIES FILED AFTER THAT VISIT.

CENTRAL BANK OFFICIALS WILL NOT SPECULATE AS TO WHETHER OR NOT CBI WILL OPEN JAN 11, AFTER THE TWO DAYS OF NATIONAL STRIKE. CBI'S MINIMAL OPERATION IS A REQUISITE FOR ANY RESUMPTION OF COMMERCIAL BANKING. CALLS TODAY TO U.S. BANK REPRESENTATIVE OFFICES WERE UNANSWERED EXCEPT FOR CITIBANK, WHICH HAD AN IRANIAN OFFICER ON DUTY. CALLS TO THE MEAF WERE UNANSWERED.

OPPOSITION MAJLES DEPUTY AHMAD BANI-AHMAD'S UNITY FOR LIBERTY PARTY HAS CALLED FOR ABDICATION OF THE SHAH AND ESTABLISHMENT OF A RULING COUNCIL. THIS INTERIM GOVT WOULD DISSOLVE PARLIAMENT, END MARTIAL LAW, ABOLISH SAVAK AND RELEASE ALL POLITICAL PRISONERS. ALL THOSE WHO HAVE INFRINGED ON THE NATION'S RIGHTS WILL BE ARRESTED AND TRIED, AND ALL LAWS WHICH CONTRADICT NATIONAL SOVEREIGNTY WILL COME UNDER REVIEW.

LATE REPORT FROM CONSULATE SHIRAZ INDICATES LARGE DEMONSTRATION DID TAKE PLACE BUT WAS PEACEFUL. WHEN CROWD BROKE UP, ONE BUSLOAD PASSED BACK AND FORTH IN FRONT OF CONSULATE, SHOUTING DEATH TO THE SHAH AND YANKEE GO HOME. CROWD MOOD WAS FESTIVE, HOWEVER, AND DEMONSTRATORS DID NOT THREATEN CONSULATE. PARTICIPANTS GAVE FLOWERS TO TROOPS, WHO APPEARED TO EMPATHIZE WITH THEM. SULLIVAN
