INTERMEDIARY EQBAL CONFIRMED TO POL COUNSELOR MORNING JAN 8 THAT GENERAL JAM HAS REFUSED TO JOIN BAKHTIAR GOVT AND WILL RETURN TO LONDON AS SOON AS HE GETS A SEAT ON A PLANE.

JAM WAS IN AUDIENCE WITH SHAH UNTIL MIDNIGHT. SHAH EXPRESSED HIS OWN WORRIES ABOUT LEAVING THE COUNTRY IN TERMS OF A POSSIBLE MOVE BY ARMY OFFICERS. JAM HAS DECIDED BAKHTIAR GOVT IS HOPELESS PROPOSITION, AND HE CANNOT GO CONTRARY TO KHOMEINI'S WISHES. HE HAD TOLD EQBAL HE WOULD ACCEPT THAT POSITION (MINISTER OF WAR) IF KHOMEINI ASKED HIM TO TAKE IT.
IN LIGHT THIS IMPORTANT DEVELOPMENT EQBAL HAS REVISED HIS EXPECTATIONS FROM TRIP TO SEE KHOMEINI. HE MERELY HOPES TO GET SOME IDEA OF KHOMEINI'S STRATEGY AND PERHAPS BE HELPFUL TO JAM.

COMMENT: SEPTEL REPORTS BAZARGAN (LMI) STRATEGY TO RIDE WITH BAKHTIAR GOVT ONLY FOR A FEW DAYS, TO SEE IF HE CAN GET SHAH TO LEAVE. IF SHAH LEAVES, PLAN IS FOR KHOMEINI TO RETURN IN TRIUMPH. WE NOTE KHOMEINI IS MAKING CONCILIATORY STATEMENTS ABOUT THE ARMY FROM PARIS. ALL THIS SUGGESTS HE IS GETTING READY TO RETURN -- IF SHAH DEPARTS -- AND MAKE THE DEPARTURE PERMANENT. IF SHAH SHOULD DECIDE AT LAST MINUTE NOT TO GO, THE STRUGGLE PRESUMABLY WILL CONTINUE, WITH BAKHTIAR BEING BROUGHT TUMBLING DOWN AS THE FIRST STEP. STULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00341.subject: INTERMEDIARY SEES BAKHTIAR AND GOES TO MEET KHOMEINI SUMMARY: OPTIMISTIC INTERMEDIARY IS ON HIS WAY TO

segments.text: KHOMEINI SUMMARY: OPTIMISTIC INTERMEDIARY IS ON HIS WAY TO TRY REASONING WITH KHOMEINI, AFTER HAVING AN INTERESTING EXCHANGE WITH NEW P.M. BAKHTIAR WHICH HIGHLIGHTS THE NAKED WEAKNESS OF BAKHTIAR'S NEW GOVERNMENT. END SUMMARY

WITH CONFIDENCE IN THE FORCE OF SWEET, PATRIOTIC REASON, KHOSROW EQBAL, ONE TIME NEWSPAPER EDITOR AND LONGTIME LAWYER WHO HAS GOOD CONNECTIONS IN FRANCE, IS FLYING TODAY, JANUARY 8, TO SEE KHOMEINI. EQBAL HOPES TO DESCRIBE THE CHAOTIC SITUATION HE SEES DEVELOPING IN IRAN TO KHOMEINI, INCLUDING THE THREAT OF A COMMUNIST TAKEOVER IN A FEW MONTHS.

HE WILL URGE KHOMEINI TO BE LESS OBSTINATE AND RETURN TO IRAN WHEN THE SHAH LEAVES "ON VACATION." THERE WILL BE TIME "OVER THE NEXT YEAR OR TWO," WITH A REGENCY COUNCIL IN CHARGE, TO TRY TO SETTLE THE ECONOMIC SITUATION AND, ONCE QUIET RETURNS, THINK OF THE LONG TERM FUTURE OF THE MONARCHY. HE WILL ARGUE AGAINST A HURRY-UP REFERENDUM AND THE REST OF KHOMEINI'S CURRENT PROGRAM.

EQBAL DOES NOT KNOW KHOMEINI AND IS RELYING ON HIS OWN DISINTERESTED STATE TO GAIN HIM INFLUENCE. (HE THINKS SANJABI OR BAZARGAN WERE TOO INTERESTED IN WHAT KHOMEINI COULD DO FOR THEM TO PRESS THE OLD MAN WITH THE RIGHT ARGUMENTS.) HE SAYS HE HAS AN UNDERSTANDING THAT KHOMEINI WILL SEE HIM ENTIRELY ALONE, WITH NONE OF HIS LEFT-WING RETINUE (E.G., YAZDI) TAGGING ALONG.
EQBAL SAW BAKHTIAR YESTERDAY. BAKHTIAR TOLD HIM THAT

A. AS OF THAT SAME DAY, ALL PRISONERS BEING HELD (INCLUDING HOVEYDA) COULD NO LONGER SEE VISITORS AND WERE ACTIVELY UNDER INVESTIGATION. (HE APPARENTLY SAID NOTHING ABOUT ANY OF THEM BEING TRIED IN CAMERA BY MILITARY COURT, AS WE HAVE HEARD FROM A GOOD SOURCE, TEHRAN 240.)
B. GEN. TOUFANIAN HAD RESIGNED AND REQUESTED PERMISSION TO LEAVE THE COUNTRY "FOR MEDICAL REASONS." BAKHTIAR HAD REFUSED.

C. BAKHTIAR HAD RIDDEN ON A TRAIN TO FRANCE (TO ATTEND ST. CYR) WITH GEN. JAM WHEN THEY WERE BOTH YOUNG MEN BUT NEVER SEEN HIM SINCE THEN. HOWEVER, HE HAD CHOSEN HIM AS WAR MINISTER ON BASIS OF ALL THE GOOD THINGS BEING SAID ABOUT HIM BY EVERYONE. BAKHTIAR WAS GOING TO LET JAM CHOOSE CHIEFS OF POLICE, GENDARMERIE, ETC. SO AS TO CENTRALIZE IN HIM THE CONTROL OF LAW AND ORDER FORCES.

BAKHTIAR WAS INTERESTED WHEN EQBAL REMINDED HIM THAT ON ONE OF HIS VACATION TRIPS OUT OF THE COUNTRY (WHILE JAM WAS CHIEF OF SUPEREME COMMANDER'S STAFF) SHAH HAD APPOINTED JAM "ASSISTANT SUPREME COMMANDER,"TO ACT IN SHAH'S STEAD. THIS WAS A USEFUL PRECEDENT. (JAM ARRIVED IN TEHRAN MORNING JAN 7 AND HAD AUDIENCE WITH SHAH THAT AFTERNOON.)

D. BAKHTIAR HAS GIVEN ARMY AND POLICE ORDERS NOT TO INTERFERE WITH PEACEFUL DEMONSTRATIONS. IF DEMONSTRATIONS ARE NOT PEACEFUL THEY ARE TO USE TEARGAS, WATER CANNON, SHOOT INTO THE AIR, BUT NOT SHOOT AT DEMONSTRATORS BEFORE GETTING PERMISSION FROM BAKHTIAR PERSONALLY.
EQBAL SUGGESTED TO BAKHTIAR THAT

A. NO ONE IS SUPPORTING HIM AMONG THE OPPOSITION, BUT IF HE DOES SOME GOOD THINGS HE MIGHT START TO GET SUPPORT OF THE PEOPLE. BAKHTIAR SAID HE WOULD DO A VERY GREAT DEAL IF PEOPLE WOULD JUST ALLOW HIM 2 1/2 MONTHS. (COMMENT: EQBAL AGREED THAT WAS ALMOST LIKE ASKING FOR THE MOON IN PRESENT CIRCUMSTANCES.)
B. BAKHTIAR SHOULD GET SHAH TO RETURN HIS PROPERTIES, AND THOSE OF HIS FAMILY, TO THE NATION. BAKHTIAR REPLIED HE HAD DISCUSSED SOME SUCH STEP WITH THE SHAH.

C. MAJORITY OF REGENCY COUNCIL SHOULD HAVE WELL KNOWN NATIONAL FIGURES, TO MAKE UP FOR THEIR DEARTH ON BAKHTIAR'S GOVT. EQBAL TOLD BAKHTIAR THAT, FOR EXAMPLE, HIS NEW MINISTER OF EDUCATION WAS SAVAK AGENT IN CHARGE OF STUDENTS IN IRANIAN EMBASSY IN ANKARA WHEN KHOMEINI WAS JUST EXILED THERE IN 1963-64 AND IT BECAME HIS JOB TO KEEP KHOMEINI UNDER SURVEILLANCE. BAKHTIAR REPLIED HE WAS UNAWARE OF THIS AND WOULD INVESTIGATE. (SEE ALSO DERAKHSHESH'S CHARGE AGAINST SAME MINISTER, THAT HE WAS ACTIVE WITH SAVAK, TEHRAN 295.) ------------------093625 081053Z /16 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 2778 INFO AMEMBASSY PARIS SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 00341 LIMDIS
D. BAKHTIAR SHOULD CHANGE IRANIAN NATIONAL ANTHEM AWAY FROM ITS PRESENT PAEAN TO PAHLAVIS TOWARD SOMETHING MORE FIGHTING AND NATIONALIST, LIKE THE MARSEILLAISE.
E. BAKHTIAR SHOULD GET GOOD MEN TO HELP WITH HIS SPEECH WRITING AND RADIO/TV APPEARANCES. (HE RECOMMENDED SEPEHR OF "THE DIPLOMAT" AND RETIRED "ETELAAT" EDITOR KEYVANI.)

F. BAKHTIAR SHOULD CONTACT THE SOVIETS TO HELP TAKE THE PRESSURE OFF HIMSELF. BAKHTIAR READILY AGREED THAT THE SHAH HAD UNNECESSARILY SPOILED RELATIONS WITH THE SOVIETS. ONE COULD KEEP GOOD RELATIONS WITH THE AMERICANS AND THE SOVIETS TOO. (COMMENT: THIS LAST WAS THE ONLY POTENTIALLY DANGEROUS PIECE OF ADVICE WE COULD DETECT IN WHAT EQBAL TOLD BAKHTIAR.)

WHILE EQBAL WAS THERE, IN COMPANY OF SAVAK CHIEF MOGHADAM, TOP POLICE OFFICIALS, AND OTHERS, THE SHAH CALLED MOGHADAM ON THE TELEPHONE TO COMPLAIN ABOUT THE TENOR OF THE PRESS, PARTICUARLY THE OPPOSITIONIST CONTENT OF KAYHAN AND ETELAAT, WHICH HAD JUST REAPPEARED. MOGHADAM HAD TO ADMIT THAT A PROJECT TO IMPROVE THE GOVERNMENT'S HANDLING OF PUBLIC INFORMATION WHICH HAD BEEN PRESENTED AND APPROVED UNDER SHARIF-EMAMI GOVT A FEW MONTHS AGO HAD NEVER BEEN IMPLEMENTED.
FINALLY, PRESENCE OF GARABAGHI WAS DUE TO CALL FOR HELP ISSUED TO ARMY BY GENDARMERIE BECAUSE THEY WERE UNDER ATTACK BY ARMED KURDS IN THE TOWN OF BANEH IN KURDISTAN SINCE EARLY MORNING JAN 6.

COMMENT: THE LIFE OF A NEW PRIME MINISTER IS NOT AN EASY ONE. ACCORDING TO ANOTHER INTERMEDIARY, BAKHTIAR WAS ON THE TELEPHONE TO DR. HEJAZI MORNING JAN 7, PLEADING FOR SUPPORT FROM THE RELIGIOUS LEADERS IN THE COUNTRY. WE HAVE NOW HAD THREE SEPARATE REPORTS, HOWEVER, DENIGRATING WITH SPECIFICS DIFFERENT INDIVIDUALS CHOSEN BY BAKHTIAR FOR HIS CABINET. EQBAL AND DERAKHSHESH AGREED ON THE MINISTER OF EDUCATION BEING SAVAK. EQBAL'S NEPHEW (WHO WORKS SEPARATELY) TOLD POL COUNSELOR EVENING DEC 7 THAT HE PERSONALLY KNEW TWO OTHER MINISTERS WHO WERE NOT CLEAN IN THEIR BACKGROUNDS.

ONE WAS ABBAS GHALI BAKHTIAR (INDUSTRY AND MINES), THE OTHER JAVAD KHADEM (HOUSING AND URBAN PLANNING), WHO HAD BEEN EMPLOYEE OF HIS FOR A TIME. WITH ACCUSATIONS OF THAT SORT ALREADY COMING FROM PEOPLE (LIKE THE TWO EQBALS) WHO PROFESS TO SUPPORT BAKHTIAR, ONE CAN HARDLY EVEN IMAGINE WHAT HIS OPPOSITION WILL HIT HIM WITH SHORTLY.
FOREGOING HAD BEEN TYPED BEFORE WE HAD BEEN INFORMED OF JAM'S REFUSAL TO JOING BAKHTIAR GOVT (SEPTEL FOLLOWS).

1979TEHRAN00346.subject: IRANIAN ARMED FORCES INVOLVEMENT IN PUBLIC - ASSISTANCE PROGRAMS

segments.text: GENERAL GAST, CHIEF, ARMISH/MAAG, HAS RAISED WITH SEVERAL SENIOR MILITARY OFFICERS QUESTION OF HOW TO CREATE FAVORABLE PUBLIC IMAGE OF ARMED FORCES. SO FAR VERY LITTLE ACTION HAS RESULTED. IRANIAN NAVY HAS MADE SOME EFFORT TO PUBLICIZE ITS WORK IN THE OIL FIELDS, AND WE HAVE HEARD SUGGESTION THAT ARMED FORCES MIGHT START THEIR OWN RADIO STATION SO CITIZENS WOULD BE BETTER INFORMED ABOUT PUBLIC ASSISTANCE PROGRAMS. WE AGREE SUBJECT IS AN IMPORTANT ONE AND WILL CONTINUE TO PUSH IT DURING ANY APPROPRIATE MEETINGS WITH SENIOR IRANIAN OFFICERS.

SINCE FOREIGN MINISTRY HAS BEEN MORE OR LESS OUT OF BUSINESS, WE HAD NOT BEEN ABLE TO GET MESSAGE THROUGH ASKING THAT ACTION BE SUSPENDED ON SURVEY TEAM REQUEST (REFTEL). NOW FOREIGN MINISTRY HAS CALLED TO EXPLAIN ONCE MORE THAT DELAY HAS BEEN IN MINISTRY OF WAR, WHERE DECISIONS ON SUCH MATTERS MUST BE MADE. WAR MINISTRY HAD FINALLY DECIDED THAT REQUESTED SURVEY MIGHT BE POSSIBLE IN SIX OR SEVEN MONTHS. FOREIGN MINISTRY OBJECTED AND WAR MINISTRY THEN SAID IT WOULD RECONSIDER THE U.S. REQUEST IN LATE FEBRUARY.
WE WILL LEAVE THE MATTER THAT WAY UNTIL TIME FOR SUCH A VISIT SEEMS MORE FAVORABLE. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00359.subject: MEETING WITH OPPOSITION; JOURNEY THROUGH NATIONAL FRONT WONDERLAND

segments.text: NATIONAL FRONT WONDERLAND

EMBOFFS ESCUDERO AND PERETT LUNCHED JAN 4 IN THE HOME OF DR. MIRBABAI, ARDENT NATIONAL FRONTER WHO IS ALSO LINKED TO BAZARGAN. ALSO PRESENT WERE HIS SON DR. HORMOZ MIRBABAI, DRS. (FATHER AND SON) ABEDI, AND A FEW YOUNG RELATIVES. POINT OF MEETING WAS TO ESTABLISH CONTACT, AS MIRBABAI IS WELL-CONNECTED IN OPPOSITION. IN COURSE OF MEETING, THESE HIGHLY-EDUCATED DISSIDENTS TREATED EMBOFFS TO THEIR ANALYSIS OF IRANIAN POLITICAL SITUATION. THE MAJOR POINTS

U.S. IS RESPONSIBLE FOR ALL OF IRAN'S TROUBLES, EVEN THE LUNCH, WHICH HAD TO BE A CATERED AFFAIR BECAUSE THE HOUSE RAN OUT OF BUTANE. THE STRIKES AND SHORTAGES HAVE ALL OCCURRED BECAUSE USG SUPPORTS THE SHAH.
THEY OPPOSE THE BAKHTIAR GOVT SIMPLY BECAUSE THE SHAH APPOINTED IT. THE PEOPLE WILL NOT ACCEPT ANY SHAH-APPOINTED PRIME MINISTER, EVEN IF SHAH WERE TO PICK KHOMEINI.

WHEN ASKED WHAT THEY WOULD LIKE TO SEE HAPPEN, THEY REPLIED THE SHAH MUST GO. AS TO WHO WOULD THEN TAKE OVER, IT IS NOTHING TO WORRY ABOUT NOW; ONCE THE SHAH IS GONE, THE PEOPLE WILL CHOOSE THEIR OWN LEADERS. IT IS SILLY TO WORRY ABOUT THE COMMUNISTS; THAT IS AN OLD AMERICAN HABIT (COMMENT: NUMEROUS OPPOSITIONISTS HAVE EXPRESSED CONCERN ABOUT EXTREME LEFTISTS TAKING CONTROL OF MOVEMENT). IT IS ALSO ABSURD TO WORRY ABOUT RELIGIOUS EXTREMISTS. CHADORS ARE BEING WORN MERELY AS A SYMBOL, AND BESIDES, THEY ARE PART OF IRAN'S NATIONAL DRESS JUST LIKE A SARI OR AN AMERICAN INDIAN BONNET.

WE SHOULD NOT THEREFORE CONSIDER THEM A SIGN OF BACKWARDNESS. (AT THE TIME, TWO YOUNG WOMEN, DEFINITELY WITHOUT CHADORS, WERE PRESENT AND WERE DRINKING BRANDY. IT WOULD HAVE UNROLLED A MULLAH'S TURBAN.)

COMMENT: THESE VIEWS-DETERMINATION THAT SHAH MUST DEPART, REFUSAL TO WORRY ABOUT EXTREMISTS GAINING CONTROL, AND INSISTENCE THAT WE ARE TO BLAME FOR IRAN'S PROBLEMSARE ENDEMIC IN IRAN TODAY AND EVEN APPEAR TO BE ACCENTUATED IN THIS PARTICULAR INF GROUP. ONE OF THEM SHOWED A PICTURE OF THEIR DOG, INSISTING THAT IRANIANS LOVE DOGS AND ARE NOT AFRAID OF THEM. NO FALSER STATEMENT COULD BE MADE ABOUT IRAN, BUT THIS IS CONSISTENT WITH THEIR OVERALL GRASP OF THE POLITICAL REALITIES FACING THEM. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00367.subject: CLERGY ORGANIZING TO HELP STABILIZE PUBLIC ORDER SUMMARY: DR. NASSER MINATCHI TOLD EMBOFF MORNING JAN 8 THAT NUMBER OF HIS SOURCES INDICATE SHAH'S D EPARTU

segments.text: SUMMARY: DR. NASSER MINATCHI TOLD EMBOFF MORNING JAN 8 THAT NUMBER OF HIS SOURCES INDICATE SHAH'S DEPARTURE IS IMMINENT. IN VIEW OF THIS, TEHRAN CLERGY HAVE FORMED ORGANIZATION TO HELP MAINTAIN ORDER THROUGH TRANSITION PERIOD TO NEW POLITICAL ARRANGEMENTS. STATEMENT HAS BEEN ISSUED CALLING FOR CALM. CONCERN REMAINS OVER MILITARY BEHAVIOR. END SUMMARY.

DR. NASSER MINATCHI INFORMED POLOFF STEMPEL MORNING JAN 8 THAT CLERICAL LEADERS IN TEHRAN HAVE FORMED A NEW GROUP WHICH TRANSLATES AS "CLERGY LEADERS ORGANIZATION (CLO)". PURPOSE OF GROUP WAS TO HELP MAINTAIN SOCIAL ORDER OVER NEXT FEW WEEKS. MINATCHI SAID HIS PARLIAMENTARY SOURCES SAID NEW GOI WOULD BE PRESENTED TO MAJLES AND CONFIRMED JAN 9, THEN TO SENATE AND CONFIRMED JAN 10. IT WAS STRONGLY RUMORED THAT THE SHAH WOULD LEAVE THE COUNTRY AT SOME POINT FOLLOWING FINAL CONFIRMATION. CLERGY WERE TO MEET AFTERNOON JAN 8 TO WORK OUT PLANS TO CONTROL EMOTIONAL OUTPOURINGWHICH WOULD FOLLOW AND CHANNEL IT CONSTRUCTIVELY IF POSSIBLE.

EMBOFF STRONGLY SUPPORTED IDEA, AND NOTED THAT IN EVENT OF SHAH'S DEPARTURE, MILITARY WILL BE VERY EDGY AND BEHAVIOR IN FIRST HOURS AND DAYS WILL BE CRITICAL. MINATCHI SAID HE COULDNREE MORE, AND COMMITTEE FOR DEFENSE OF HUMAN RIGHTS AND FREEDOM (CDHRF) WOULD ATTEMPT TO ORGANIZE ALL ITS FOLLOWERS FOR THIS PURPOSE. EMBOFF STRESSED AVOIDANCE OF PROVOCATION WHICH WOULD TRIGGER MILITARY BACKLASH SUCH AS OCCURRED IN QAZVIN AND MASHAD. MINATCHI SAID HE UNDERSTOOD PROBLEM VERY WELL.

CLERGY WAS ESPECIALLY KEY GROUP, AND CLO WOULD BE MAIN VEHICLE, ACCORDING TO MINATCHI. LEADER WAS HOJATOLLAH SEYED MOHAMMAD BEHESHTI (KNOWN TO EMBASSY AS CEY KHOMEINI LEADER), WITH FOLLOWING OTHER CLERICS AS SENIOR FIGURES: HOJATOLLAHS RAFSANJANI, ABDOLKARIM MOUSSAVI ARDEBILI, AND MOHAMMAD MOFATEH. THEY WERE HOPING TO WORK OUT PLANS JAN 8, THEN BE READY TO MEET WITH AYATOLLAH MONTAZERI, WHO WAS EXPECTED IN TEHRAN EVENING JAN 9 OR JAN 10 WITH LATEST SUBTLETIES OF KHOMEINI POSITION.

STATEMENT ISSUED IN TEHRAN BY AYATOLLAH TALEQANI JAN 8 WAS ALSO SIGNED BY CLO LEADERSHIP AS WELL AS "QOM TRIANGLE" OF SENIOR AYATOLLAHS. IT CALLED ON PEOPLE TO REMAIN CALM, AVOID INTERFERING WITH SECURITY FORCES, AND CEASE THREATS AND ATTACKS ON FOREIGNERS. NOTICE WAS PUBLISHED EXTENSIVELY IN PERSIAN PRESS JAN 8, AND WILL APPEAR IN FOREIGN LANGUAGE PRESS JAN 9. MINATCHI SAID BASIC CLO AND CDHRF LINE IS THAT WHEN SHAH DEPARTS, PEOPLE MUST PROVE THEY ARE DISCIPLINED AND PEACEFUL. MINATCHI HIMSELF IS NOT VERY CONCERNED ABOUT DISORDERLY MOBS, BUT CONCEDES THERE MAY BE PEOPLE ON THE STREETS STIRRING UP TROUBLE.

IF SO, RELIGIOUS LEADERS HOPE TO BE ABLE TO DEAL WITH THEM NON-VIOLENTLY AS WAS DONE DURING TESUA AND ASHURA MARCHES DEC 10-11. (COMMENT: EMBASSY IS NOT RPT NOT AS OPTIMISTIC THAT MOBS CAN BE SO EASILY CONTROLLED. HOWEVER, EMBOFF WISHED HIM MUCH LUCK IN EFFORT.)

MINATCHI EXPRESSED CONCERN OVER POSSIBILITY OF MILITARY INTERVENTION IF SECURITY SITUATION DETERIORATED, BUT SAID EFFORTS OF MODERATE OPPOSITION ARE BEIMED AT SEEING THIS DOES NOT OCCUR. WHEN EMBOFF ALLUDED TO STORY THAT GEN. JAM HAD RESIGNED HIS POST AS MINISTER OF WAR, MINATCHI SEEMED TROUBLED FOR A MOMENT (HE HAD NO INFORMATION ON MATTER), BUT SAID THERE WERE SEVERAL OTHER GENERALS WHO COULD FILL THE BILL, "AND THE PRIME MINISTER KNOWS THEM ALL". HE SPECIFICALLY CITED GENERALS NASSROLAHI, BATMANGELIDJ, REZVANI, AND AGHAVI. MINATCHI PERSONALLY THOUGHT NASSROLAHI WOULD BE BEST CHOICE TO REPLACE JAM, BUT ANY OF ABOVE WOULD BE ACCEPTABLE.

COMMENT: IT IS CLEAR AND ENCOURAGING THAT MINATCHI AND MODERATE OPPOSITIONISTS ARE GIVING CONSIDERABLE THOUGHT TO POSSIBLE TRANSITION PROBLEMS. WHILE MINATCHI SAYS SHAH MUST EVENTUALLY GO FOR GOOD, MODERATE RELIGIOUS LEADERS ARE NOT DISPOSED TO PUSH THE ISSUE NOW. SHAH'S DEPARTURE ON VACATION OR FOR MEDICAL TREATMENT WOULD BE SUFFICIENT. HE THOUGHT BAZARGAN GROUP (LIBERATION MOVEMENT) WOULD EVENTUALLY SEE IT THAT WAY AS REALITY OF SITUATION EVOLVED. EVEN EXCLUDING BAZARGAN FOR MOMENT (HE IS STILL IN SHIRAZ, BUT RETURNING TO TEHRAN EVENING JAN 8), SIZABLE SEGMENT OF OPPOSITION APPEARS COMMITTED TO PEACEFUL TRANSITION IF SHAH DEPARTS.

MINATCHI HAD NO RPT NO CLUES AS TO WHO MIGHT BE NAMED TO REGENCY ------------------097750 081954Z /43 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 2791 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 00367 LIMDIS COUNCIL.
WE HAVE JUST LEARNED NEXT MAJLES SESSION POSTPONED TO JANUARY 11, AND SENATE SESSION TO JANUARY 13. HOW THIS DELAY WILL AFFECT OPPOSITION CALCULATIONS, AND ACTIVITY, REMAINS TO BE SEEN. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00368.subject: LIBERATION MOVEMENT'S (LMI) NEAR-TERM POSTURE SUMMARY: LMI'S TAVASSOLI TOLD EMBOFF LMI PLANS MANY DEMONSTRATIONS JAN 8 TO ECLIPSE "FEEBLE" JAN 7 EFF

segments.text: SUMMARY: LMI'S TAVASSOLI TOLD EMBOFF LMI PLANS MANY DEMONSTRATIONS JAN 8 TO ECLIPSE "FEEBLE" JAN 7 EFFORTS. LMI WILL ISSUE NO RPT NO STRONG STATEMENT AGAINST BAKHTIAR GOVT FOR "A FEW DAYS, WAITING TO SEE IF AND HOW BAKHTIAR GETS SHAH TO LEAVE." STRIKES WILL CONTINUE, HOWEVER. SOURCE EXPLAINED LMI SOLUTION TO IRANIAN IMPASSE AND EXPRESSED CONCERN OVER GROWING TUDEH AND OTHER EXTREMIST STRENGTH. END SUMMARY.

LMI'S MOHAMMAD TAVASSOLI CALLED ON EMBOFF STEMPEL EVENING JAN 7 TO DISCUSS PRESENT SITUATION. TAVASSOLI MADE POINT OF SAYING SITUATION IN IRAN OVER PAST SIX MONTHS HAD UNFOLDED AS LMI HAD FEARED IT WOULD, AND SHAH WAS HANGING ON DESPITE OVERWHELMING PERCEPTION OF "THE PEOPLE" THAT HE HAD TO GO. HE GAVE EMBOFF COPY OF KHOMEINI ANNOUNCEMENT DISTRIBUTED IN TEHRAN JAN 7 WHICH CALLED BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT ILLEGAL, CALLED FOR CONTINUATION OF STRIKES IN ALLSECTORS, ASKED MINISTRY EMPLOYEES TO PREVENT NEW MINISTERS FROM COMING TO THEIR OFFICES,AND URGED ALL CITIZENS NOT RPT NOT TO PAY TAXES, INCLUDING WATER AND LIGHT BILLS.
TO THIS END, LMI WILL SPONSOR MANY SMALLER RALLIES JAN 8 WHICH WILL BE DESIGNED TO SHOW MOVEMENT'S STRENGTH. TAVASSOLI HOPED THESE WOULD BE PEACEFUL, BUT SAID LMI WAS READY FOR OTHER EVENTUALITIES.

DESCRIBING BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT AS VIRTUALLY INDISTINGUISHABLE FROM ANY NATIONAL FRONT (INF) GOVERNMENT, TAVASSOLI SAID LMI BELIEVES BAKHAND SANJABI ARE REALLY COLLUDING WITH SHAH AGAINST THE INTERESTS OF IRANIAN PEOPLE. IT IS IMPORTANT FOR THE U.S. TO DISCERN WHERE ITS TRUE INTERESTS LIE AND NOT BE FOOLED BY "FALSE" COALITION GOVERNMENT. EMBOFF OFFERED MILD REJOINDER THAT BAKHTIAR SEEMED TO BE ON VERGE OF ACHIEVING WHAT LMI HAD WANTED--DEPARTURE OF SHAH. SOURCE ACKNOWLEDGED THIS AND SAID LMI WOULD NOT BE ISSUING STRONG STATEMENT AGAINST BAKHTIAR BECAUSE MOVEMENT WOULD BE WAITING TO SEE IF AND HOW SHAH LEAVES COUNTRY.

IT WAS NOT ENOUGH FOR SHAH TO GO ON VACATION; PEOPLE OF IRAN WOULD NOT ACCEPT ANY SOLUTION WHICH DID NOT MEET WITH KHOMEINI APPROVAL (I.E. SHAH HAS TO GO). EMBOFF EXPLORED THIS POSITION. WHILE TAVASSOLI WAFFLED ON QUESTION OF WHETHER SHAH'S DEPARTURE ON VACATION WOULD BE CONSIDERED SATISFACTORY FIRST STEP, IT WAS CLEAR LMI HAS RETAINED HARD POSITION THAT SHAH MUST BE SEEN TO ABDICATE.

IF SHAH DOES NOT LEAVE, OR MAKE SUBSTANTIAL PLANS TO DO SO IN REASONABLE TIME (WHEN PRESSED, HE SAID "A FEW DAYS," OR "A WEEK."), THEN LMI WILL TAKE TO THE STREETS IN FORCE--HE DID NOT RULE OUT USE OF ARMS, BUT SAID LMI HOPED IT COULD BE AVOIDED.

IF SHAH LEAVES, HE SHOULD DO SO PROPERLY. FOR LMI, THIS MEANS BAKHTIAR SHOULD THEN MAKE PUBLIC SPEECH SAYING THAT WILL OF THE PEOPLE IS CLEAR AND OFFER TO TURN GOVERNMENT OVER TO A COUNCIL, OR COMMITTEE TO ACT AS REGENT. AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI SHOULD BE INVITED TO RETURN TO IRAN TO ANNOUNCE THIS COMMITTEE, WHICH WOULD HAVE THE POWER TO ORGANIZE TRULY FREE ELECTIONS, WHICH WOULD INCLUDE A REFERENDUM ON THE MONARCHY. LMI WOULD ORDER PRESENT STRIKES TO CONTINUE UNTIL FINAL BREAK WITH PRESENT SHAH WAS ACHIEVED. THIS WOULD INCLUDE LIMITATION OF OIL PRODUCTION TO DOMESTIC REQUIREMENTS FOR THE INDEFINITE FUTURE.

EMBOFF SUGGESTED IT MIGHT BE DIFFICULT TO GET BAKHTIAR TO AGREE TO GO UNDER THESE CONDITIONS,E PRESUMABLY NNDRSGD STILL HAVE PARLIAMENTARY MANDATE. TAVASSOLI BRUSHED THIS AWAY BY SAYING "ALL THE PEOPLE" REGARD ALL SUCH STRUCTURES OF GOVERNMENT AS ILLEGITIMATE. WHEN EMBOFF SUGGESTED IT WAS PRIMARILY HIS MOVEMENT WHICH DID SO, HE THEN BACKED OFF AND SAID LMI HAD CLEAR MAJORITY IN COUNTRY FOR ITS PROPOSED SOLUTION (COMMENT: IT WOULD BE HARD TO ARGUE WITH THAT NOW).

IN BRIEF DISCUSSION OF OIL SETTLEMENT, TAVASSOLI SAID FRANKLY BAZARGAN HAD ENCOUNTERED MORE TROUBLE THAN EXPECTED--PROBLEM, ACCORDING TO LMI, WAS THAT RECALCITRANT OIL WORKERS REFUSED TO BELIEVE BAZARGAN'S MANDATE WAS REALLY FROM KHOMEINI. TAVASSOLI ADMITTED TUDEH INFILTRATION PLAYED A PART IN THIS AND SAID LMI WAS FRANKLY CONCERNED THAT EXTREMISTS OF ALL STRIPES WOULD BE ONLY BENEFACTORS OF CONTINUED REFUSAL OF SHAH TO DEPART AND MOVE TOWARD KHOMEINI SOLUTION. TAVASSOLI NOTED NO RPT NO ------------------097438 081912Z /42 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 2793 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 00368 EXDIS STRIKE HAD BEEN SETTLED UNTIL KHOMEINI HAD GIVEN HIS PERMISSION.
NEWSPAPERMEN HAD WAITED UNTIL KHOMEINI PERSONALLY HAD OK'ED THEIR EFFORTS BEFORE AGREEING TO PUBLISH.

IN BRIEF DISCUSSION OF PROSPECT OF MILITARY TAKEOVER, TAVASSOLI EXPRESSED PLEASURE THAT U.S. HAD APPARENTLY ACTED TO RESTRAIN IRANIAN MILITARY, AND EMBOFF REPEATED THAT USG FAVORED CONSTITUTIONAL SOLUTION, NOT MILITARY COUP. TAVASSOLI SAID LMI WAS GREATLY RELIEVED THAT GEN. OVEISSI HAD DEPARTED AND CONFIRMED THAT IT WAS OVEISSI WHO HAD WORRIED LMI WHEN TAVASSOLI LAST SPOKE TO EMBOFF ABOUT PROSPECTS OF MILITARY COUP.

COMMENT: MEETING TOOK PLACE BEFORE NEWSOF GENERAL JAM'S RESIGNATION BECAME KNOWN EARLY JAN 8. IT IS OUR VIEW THAT, DEPENDING ON FALLOUT FROM JAM DEPARTURE, LMI MAY ADVANCE IT'S TIMETABLE FOR PRESSING BAKHTIAR GOVERN

1979TEHRAN00371.subject: DEPARTURE OF ALI AMINI AND PROPOSED DEPARTURE OF SHAH

segments.text: OF SHAH

ALI AMINI SENT ME MESSAGE JANUARY 8 THAT HE FELT THERE WAS NOTHING FURTHER HE COULD DO TO HELP SITUATION IN IRAN. CONSEQUENTLY, HE WAS PLANNING TO LEAVE THE COUNTRY (PRESUMABLY FOR FRANCE) THAT SAME AFTERNOON.
HE GAVE AS HIS OPINION THE PROBABILITY THAT THE SHAH WOULD LEAVE THE COUNTRY JANUARY 12. THIS WOULD PRESUMABLY BE AFTER BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT RECEIVES PARLIAMENTARY VOTE OF CONFIDENCE.

COMMENT: ALI AMINI HAS BEEN WIDELY CONSIDERED TO BE A CANDIDATE FOR REGENCY COUNCIL TO BE FORMED IF AND WHEN SHAH LEAVES COUNTRY. IN FACT, THERE HAS BEEN SOME SPECULATION HE MIGHT BE ITS CHAIRMAN. HIS DEPARTURE NOW MAY MEAN EITHER THAT HE HAS BEEN INFORMED HE WILL NOT RPT NOT BE ON COUNCIL OR ELSE THAT HE WISHES TO LEAVE BEFORE HE IS FORMALLY SADDLED WITH SUCH RESPONSIBILITY.

1979TEHRAN00374.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT, JAN 8 SUMMARY: DEMONSTRATIONS THORUGHOUT IRAN YESTERDAY -- MORE UNDERWAY TODAY. TODAY ANOTHER DAY OF MOURNING. B

segments.text: SUMMARY: DEMONSTRATIONS THORUGHOUT IRAN YESTERDAY -- MORE UNDERWAY TODAY. TODAY ANOTHER DAY OF MOURNING. BAKHTIAR TO PRESENT CABINET TO MAJLIS TOMORROW. TALEGHANI CALLS ON CROWD NOT TO PUNISH THE INNOCENT. END SUMMARY

YESTERDAY'S DAY OF MOURNING INCLUDED DEMONSTRATIONS THROUGHOUT IRAN. MOST VIOLENT CITY WAS KHORRAMSHAHR, WHERE RIOTERS BURNED FIVE BANKS, INCLUDING IRAN-JAPAN BANK, AND A NUMBER OF OTHER BUILDINGS. RIOTS ALSO OCCURRED IN ZANJAN, BEHBAHAN, AND BANEH (KURDESTAN PROVINCE). IN TEHRAN CROWDS FOCUSED ON AMIR ALAM HOSPITAL AT SAADI SHAH REZA TO VIEW FILMS AND PHOTOGRAPHS OF DEMONSTRATIONS. SANJABI DID NOT ADDRESS CROWD. YESTERDAY IN TEHRAN PASSED WITHOUT SERIOUS VIOLENCE BUT CROWDS DID BURN SOME AUTOMOBILES, SET MANY TRASH FIRES, AND DREW FUSILLADES OF WARNING SHOTS. IN ISFAHAN ONE AMERICAN HOME WAS FIREBOMBED AND TWO AUTOMOBILES BURNED. SHIRAZ AND TABRIZ HAD PEACEFUL DEMONSTRATIONS YESTERDAY.

TODAY IS ANOTHER DAY OF MOURNING. KHOMEINI CALLED FOR IT, BUT EVERYONE ELSE HAS CLIMBED ABOARD, INCLUDING THE GOVERNMENT, SO COMMERCIAL LIFE REMAINS HALTED EXCEPT FOR THE LINES AT GAS STATIONS. MARCHERS ARE ACTIVE IN VARIOUS PARTS OF THE CITY BUT HAVE NOT MASSED IN GREAT NUMBERS. THERE IS PROBABLY A LARGE CROWD OUTSIDE TOWN AT BEHESHT-EZARA CEMETARY WHERE A RALLY IS PLANNED FOR THIS AFTERNOON. THIS MORNING A CROWD OF 1500-2000 GATHERED OUTSIDE TALEGHANI'S HOUSE AT EAST END OF SHAH REZA. TROOPS DISPERSED MOST OF CROWD, BUT 3-400 SAT DOWN AND DARED SOLDIERS TO SHOOT. TROOPS WERE FINALLY ABLE TO BREAK THEM UP WITHOUT FIRING INTO THEM.
ANOTHER CROWD OF SEVERAL THOUSAND ASSEMBLED NEAR SHAHYAD MONUMENT, THEN DISPERSED WITHOUT INCIDENT.

CONSULATE TABRIZ REPORTS RIOTS TODAY. RADIO SAYS 100 STORES AND 8 OF 10 CINEMAS IN TOWN HAVE BEEN BURNED. TROOPS HAVE BLOCKED MAJOR STREETS BUT RIOTERS SEEM UNHINDERED WITHIN THE CORDONED AREAS. FIRES CAN BE SEEN ALL OVER TOWN. CONSULATE IS WELL PROTECTED BY TROOPS. WE ARE CHECKING ON IAS.

CONSULATE SHIRAZ REPORTS MEHDI BAZARGAN OF LMI SPOKE BRIEFLY AT MOSQUE YESTERDAY, THEN DELIVERED SPEECH TODAY BEFORE CROWD OF ABOUT 10,000. HE REVIEWED IRANIAN HISTORY, CASTIGATING FOREIGNERS AND THE PAHLAVI MONARCHS BUT OFFERED NO PROGRAM FOR THE FUTURE. PRIOR TO HIS SPEECH HE MET WITH WORKERS FROM SHIRAZ REFINERY AND REPORTEDLY PERSUADED THEM TO RETURN TO WORK. AFTER BAZARGAN'S SPEECH, AYATOLLAH DASTGAD EXHORTED CROWD TO DEMONSTRATE BUT NOT TO BURN OR DESTROY. HIS MESSAGE ECHOED SIMILAR INSTRUCTIONS PUBLISHED TODAY FROM AYATOLLAH TALEQANI IN TEHRAN.

WITH REFERENCE TO THE ANTI-SAVAK WITCH-HUNTING WHICH HAS OCCURRED IN RECENT DAYS, HE URGED CROWD NOT TO TAKE THE LAW INTO THEIR OWN HANDS OR PERSECUTE THE INNOCENT. THOSE ACCUSED SHOULD RECEIVE A FAIR ISLAMIC TRIAL. KHOMEINI HAS HIMSELF MELLOWED WITH REGARD TO MOB ACTION AND REPORTEDLY TOLD A REPORTER: "WE NEED THE ARMY. WE RESPECT THE ARMY AND ITS GENERALS."
NATIONAL FRONT, IN ITS NEWSLETTER, AGAIN ATTACKED GOVT OF PRIMIN BAKHTIAR, SAYING IT RESEMBLES THE KERENSKY GOVT OF RUSSIA.

JOURNAL WHICH APPEARED YESTERDAY SAID "THE FREEDOM FIGHTERS WILL NOT STOP UNTIL THEY HAVE DESTROYED ------------------096875 081818Z /43 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 2799 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY BONN AMCONSUL DHAHRAN IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY DOHA AMCONSUL FRANKFURT AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS USLO PEKING USLO RIYADH IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY TOKYO USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 00374 THE ENTIRE GOVT MACHINERY." BUT MOST INTERESTING PASSAGE WAS: "BRUTALITIES COMMITTED BY THE NAZIS HAD SOME JUSTIFICATION.
IRANIAN TROOPS KILLED THEIR OWN BROTHERS WITHOUT JUSTIFICATION."

BAKHTIAR WILL TAKE HIS CABINET AND PROGRAM TO THE MAJLES TOMORROW. DEBATE HAS TYPICALLY REQUIRED TWO DAYS, SO VOTE OF CONFIDENCE WILL PROBABLY NOT COME BEFORE WEDNESDAY. BAKHTIAR WILL GO WITHOUT GEN. JAM, THE BRIGHTEST STAR IN HIS CABINET, WHO HAS BACKED OUT (BEING REPORTED SEPTEL).

AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI, IN INTERVIEW WITH LONDONBASED IRAN POST, PUBLICLY ACKNOWLEDGED HIS DIFFERENCES WITH KHOMEINI. WHEN ASKED WHY HE DOES NOT PATCH UP THE DISPUTE, HE ANSWERED: "I HAVE BEEN TRYING TO DO JUST THAT FOR THE LAST 15 YEARS." (COMMENT: IN THE PAST HE WOULD HAVE REPLIED THAT KHOMEINI'S STRUGGLE IS OUR STRUGGLE, ETC. THE DEEP RIVALRIES WHICH, WE KNOW, EXIST THROUGHOUT THE "NATIONAL MOVEMENT" ARE STARTING TO SURFACE ALL AROUND.) ACCORDING TO NIRT, ILLNESS PREVENTED SHARIATMADARI FROM JOINING MARCH YESTERDAY IN QOM.
WE HAVE UNCONFIRMED REPORTS THAT OPPOSITION HAS BEEN DISTRIBUTING FREE HEATING OIL, GAS, AND BREAD TO POPULACE IN TABRIZ.

TEHRAN RADIO HAS JUST (1400) ANNOUNCED THAT MAJLES SESSION FOR JAN 9 HAS BEEN CANCELLED AND THAT MAJLES WILL MEET ON NEW GOVERNMENT JAN 11 WITH SENATE TO HOLD OPEN SESSION JAN 13. THIS WOULD DELAY PARLIAMENTARY PRESENTATION OF NEW BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT TWO DAYS BEYOND SCHEDULE PROJECTED UP TO TODAY.

CONFUSION EXISTS AS TO KHOMEINI'S STANCE TOWARD NEW GOVT. HIS SUPPOSED RINGING DENUNCIATION STEMMED FROM AN INTERVIEW WITH A BEIRUT NEWSPAPER AND IS SO FAR UNSUPPORTED. MOST OBSERVERS FEEL BAKHTIAR INITIATIVE HAS NOT ACTUALLY RECEIVED KHOMEINI'S PUBLIC VETO, ALTHOUGH IT CERTAINLY HAS FROM SANJABI AND INF. SULLIVAN

TO BEST OF EMBASSY'S KNOWLEDGE THERE HAVE BEEN NO MORE RECENT SPECIFIC ATTACKS ON BAHAIS OR OTHER MINORITIES SIMILAR TO THE LOOTING AND DESTRUCTION OF BAHAI PROPERTIES THAT TOOK PLACE IN SHIRAZ ON DEC 13 (TEHRAN 12342). NOR HAVE BAHAI OWNED BANKS OR SIMILAR INSTITUTIONS BEEN TARGETS OF SPECIFIC ATTACK AS THEY HAD BEEN IN BEGINNING OF TROUBLES SOME MONTHS AGO. WE HAVE HEARD NO RECENT STORIES OF DESTRUCTION OF JEWISH SHOPS OR HOMES IN PROVINCIAL CITIES.

NEVERTHELESS, MINORITIES HAVE NOT BEEN EXEMPTED FROM TAKING THEIR KNOCKS ALONG WITH OTHER PORTIONS OF POPULATION, AND FOR A VARIETY OF REASONS THEY ARE SCARED. SOME (JEWS) HAVE HEARD DARK TALES OF HOW BAD THINGS WERE BEFORE THE PAHLAVIS. OTHERS (BAHAIS) FEAR A KHOMEINI VICTORY WILL MEAN PROGRAMSAIMED AT PEOPLE LIKE THEMSELVES. THE ARMENIANS ARE KEEPING A LOW PROFILE SINCE HAVING RECEIVED LEAFLETS THREATING DEATH TO PEOPLE WHO COOPERATE WITH SHAH'S REGIME. ATTENDANCE AT CHURCHES HAS DROPPED CONSIDERABLY. ZOROASTRIANS ARE ALSO WORRIED. ALL MINORITIES FEAR THE UNKNOWN IF THE SHAH DEPARTS -- AND MOST SEE HIS DEPARTURE HAND-WRITTEN ON THE WALL.

ACCORDING TO THE UNOFFICIAL ISRAELI MISSION HERE, SOME 8-10,000 JEWS HAVE LEFT THE COUNTRY, LEAVING A COMMUNITY OF 70,000 OR SO. SPOT CHECKS OF NIV ISSUANCE AT CONSULATE IN EARLY NOVEMBER FOUND MINORITY APPLICANTS RUNNING AT 37-47 PERCENT OF TOTAL, WITH JEWS MAKING UP LARGE MAJORITY OF THOSE MINORITY APPLICANTS. THESE PERCENTAGES APPEAR TO BE SUBSIDING SOMEWHAT IN JANUARY, AND OUR ASSUMPTION IS THAT MOST OF THOSE WHO WERE SCARED ENOUGH BY EVENTS LEADING UP TO ASHURA TO GO HAVE ALREADY AT LEAST GOTTEN THEIR VISAS. A NUMBER OF JEWS WITH BUSINESSES HERE ARE TRAVELING TO U.S.

OR ELSEWHERE TO SCOUT OUT THE POSSIBILITIES ON THE GROUND BUT RETURNING TO TEND THEIR BUSINESSES FOR THE TIME BEING. MANY OTHERS OF COURSE HAVE NOWHERE TO GO AND NO MOVABLE WEALTH TO RELOCATE ELSEWHERE WITH. THEIR ONLY OPTION IS TO KEEP THEIR HEADS DOWN.

FYI: WHEN A REPRESENTATIVE OF WORLD JEWRY FROM FRANCE VISITED THE AMBASSADOR ON QUICK FACT-FINDING TRIP A FEW WEEKS AGO, HE EMPHASIZED THE DESIRE OF JEWS TO STAY IN IRAN. REPRESENTATIVES OF ISRAELI MISSION HERE, ON THE OTHER HAND, TEND TO EMPHASIZE IN THEIR CONVERSATIONS THE ELEMENTS OF DANGER WHICH ARE LEADING JEWS TO EMIGRATE. SINCE A LOT OF JEWS GO FIRST TO ISRAEL AND THEN FIND IT DIFFICULT TO GET VISAS FOR THE U.S. OR GO ELSEWHERE, WE WONDER IF THERE MIGHT NOT BE AN ELEMENT OF POLICY INVOLVED IN THE ISRAELI MISSION'S RELATIVE ALARMISM ABOUT THE SITUATION HERE.

THIS IS ESPECIALLY TRUE IF ONE CONSIDERS THAT MOST OF THE JEWS WHO MANAGE TO LEAVE ARE MIDDLE-CLASS PEOPLE WITH SKILLS AND SOME FINANCIAL MEANS, THE TYPES OF IMMIGRANTS ISRAEL HAS LONG BEEN ATTEMPTING TO ATTRACT.

1979TEHRAN00389.subject: RESIGNATIONS OF ALL SEVEN DEPUTIES AS PROMPTED BY MINISTER'S REQUEST

segments.text: SCIATT MET 7 JANUARY WITH DR. KEYVAN SALEH WHO TOGETHER WETH HIS SIX COLLEAGUES, HAS RESIGNED AS VICE MINISTER OF SUBJECT MINISTRY. ACCORDING TO SALEH, NEW MINISTER, MANUCHEHR RAZMARA, FRENCH-TRAINED CARDIOLOGIST, SPOKE IN ANTI-WESTERN MANNER TO HIS DEPUTIES, WHICH(IN PART) RESULTED IN THEIR GROUP RESIGNATIONS.
TEHRAN JOURNAL OF 7 JANUARY REPORTED RESIGNATIONS OF ALL SEVEN DEPUTIES AS PROMPTED BY MINISTER'S REQUEST.

WITH SALEH'S DEPARTURE FROM MINISTRY, EMBASSY HAS LOST A GOOD FRIEND. IF ANTI-WESTERN, ANTI-TECHNOLOGY SENTIMENT REPORTED BY SALEH IS TO BE MINISTRY'S NEW POSTURE THE PROSPECT FOR NEAR-TERM PAYMENT OF UNIVERSITY OF PITTSBURGH AND OTHER U.S. OUTSTANDING INVOICES BY MINISTRY SEEMS REMOTE.

LT. GEN. TAVAKOLI, DEPUTY MINISTER OF WAR FOR ARMAMENT, HAS GIVEN US COPY QUOTED BELOW OF TELEX MESSAGE HE WILL SEND TO SMITH AND WESSON. DECEMBER 6 TELEX REFERRED TO IN TAVAKOLI MESSAGE IS LIST OF VARYING AMOUNTS OF 43 TYPES OF CROWD CONTROL EQUIPMENT WHICH SMITH AND WESSON WAS PREPARED TO SHIP. THAT SAME DECEMBER 6 MESSAGE REFERS TO "PHONE CALLS TO AND FROM US STATE DEPARTMENT THIS MORNING", THE IMPLICATION BEING THAT THE LIST HAS BEEN CHECKED WITH THE DEPARTMENT. ACTUALLY OF THE THREE ITEMS BEING ORDERED BY TAVAKOLI AT THIS TIME, ONLY ONE, MODEL 68 POLICE HELMETS, IS ON SMITH AND WESSON'S LONG LIST.

WE ARE REPEATING BELOW TAVAKOLI TELEX FOR YOUR INFORMATION AND IN CASE DEPARTMENT MUST ISSUE EXPORT LICENSE: - BEGIN : - 1. PLS PROVIDE US WITH THE FOLLOWING LINE ITEMS FOB - US AIRRORT STOP - A) RIOT SHIELD 20"X36" TRANSPARENT POLYCARBONATE, - 3176 UNITS - B) MODEL 81A WALNUT NIGHTSTICK AND HOLDER, - 3242 UNITS - C) MODEL 68 POLICE HELMET WITH FACE SHIELD, - 2944 UNITS - 2. AS YOU HAVE SUGGESTED IN YOUR TELEX DTD DEC 6, 1978 - THE PAYMENT WILL BE THROUGH IRANIAN EMBASSY UPON - SHIPMENT STOP - END .

EMBOFF PERETT MET DEC 28 WITH GEORGE NATHANSON AND HIS COLLEAGUE GREGORY LIMA. LIMA IS A JOURNALIST/PUBLICIST WHO FORMERLY WROTE FOR KAYHAN INTERNATIONAL. HE HAS A PUBLIC RELATIONS FIRM (AUDOVIS) AND CLAIMS A LIST OF PRESTIGIOUS CLIENTS. HE IS WELL-KNOWN AMONG THE PERMANENT EXPATRIATE COMMUNITY FOR HIS COLUMNS IN KAYHAN.

ALTHOUGH NATHANSON HAD PORTRAYED HIS GROUP AS A SAVETHE-SHAH PROGRAM, LIMA BEGAN BY SAYING THE SHAH COULD NOT REMAIN. AS SO MANY OTHERS ARE NOW ARGUING, HE SAID THE MODERATES, WHO HATE AND FEAR KHOMEINI, DO NOT DARE BREAK WITH HIM AS LONG AS SHAH REMAINS IN IRAN. IF THE SHAH LEAVES WITHOUT ABDICATING, A SETTLEMENT MIGHT BE WORKED OUT AND PERHAPS HE COULD EVENTUALLY RETURN, BUT EVEN THAT SCENARIO IS CHANCY. LIMA WENT ON TO SAY HE IS IN TOUCH WITH GROUP OF IRANIAN PROWESTERN MODERATES WHO WANT TO KEEP MARXISTS AND ISLAMIC EXTREMISTS OUT OF POWER. EMBOFF AGREED TO MAINTAIN CONTACT.

NATHANSON RETURNED JAN 2 TO SAY HE TOO NOW REALIZES SHAH CANNOT REMAIN. IMPORTANT THING IS TO SALVAGE IRAN'S PRO-WEST STANCE AND TO KEEP EXTREMISTS OUT OF POWER. HE STILL WANTS TO ESTABLISH A CRASH DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM, PREFERABLY IN THE FORM OF A NON-PROFIT CORP AND ANOTHER PROFITMAKING CORP. HE SAYS HE IS SCHEDULED TO SEE CHIEF DEPUTY OF GENERAL FARDUST, AND HE MAY TRY TO SEE ZAHEDI AS WELL. NATHANSON TALKED ABOUT THE GROUP OF MODERATES WITH WHOM GREGORY LIMA IS IN CONTACT. HE MENTIONED THE NAME OF JALAL ABDOL BUT WAS RELUCTANT TO PROVIDE FURTHER NAMES.
HE DID ADD THAT GREGORY LIMA WAS ACTING AS A KIND OF PRESS OFFICER FOR THEN PRIMIN DESIGNATE BAKHTIAR. LIMA PREPARED A LIST OF QUESTIONS AND POSSIBLE REPLIES FOR BAKHTIAR'S JAN 3 PRESS CONFERENCE.

NATHANSON IS EAGER TO GET HIS DEVELOPMENT PROJECT GOING, AND ASKED HOW HE COULD GET CLEARANCE TO REACTIVATE TWO OLD CORPORATIONS, LATIN AMERICAN TRADE CENTER (NONPROFIT) AND PAN AMERICAN CLEARRNG CORP (PROFIT). EMBOFF STRESSED AGAIN THAT EMBASSY WILL NOT BECOME EVEN INDIRECTLY INVOLVED. NAHANSON AGREED (COMMENT: HE ALWAYS AGREES BUT KEEPS COMING BACK FOR MORE "COORDINATION") AND SAID HE MIGHT BE ABLE TO ACT DIRECTLY WITH USG IN WASHINGTON. EMBOFF OFFERED NO ADVICE ON LEGALITY OF MOVING NATHANSON'S OLD CORPORATIONS TO IRAN BUT AGREED TO PUT HIM IN CONTACT WITH ECONOMIC SECTION IF HE WISHED ADVICE ON OPENING NEW PURELY PRIVATE BUSINESS.
HE WILL CONTACT EMB AFTER HE TAKES PROGRAM TO GOI.

COMMENT: NATHANSON IS A TRIFLE ECCENTRIC BUT NO FOOL. HE IS ALSO NOT A BLOWHARD, AND IF HE RECEIVES A FAVORABLE RECEIPTION ON THE IRANIAN SIDE, HE WILL UNDOUBTEDLY PROCEED WITH SCHEME TO FOSTER QUICK-ACTING SOCIAL DEVELOPMENT PROJECTS. HIS IDEAS ARE BY NO MEANS RIDICULOUS, AND THEY APPEAR MORE REASONABLE NOW THAT HE TOO HAS ACCEPTED NOTION THAT THE SHAH WILL GO. WHETHER HE CAN INTEREST THE IRANIANS IS ANOTHER MATTER, BUT HE HAS HANDLED BIG DEVELOPMENT PROJECTS IN THE PAST.
WHILE HE READILY ACCEPTS EMBASSY DECLARATION THAT USG IS NOT TO BECOME INVOLVED, HE CLEARLY WOULD PREFER TO HAVE SOME INVOLVEMENT AND WILL TRY AGAIN TO OBTAIN IT IF HIS PROJECT GETS OFF THE GROUND.

1979TEHRAN00398.subject: ANOTHER MODERATE POLITICAL GROUP SURFACES UNDER ADNAN MAZAREI

segments.text: HUMANIST RESURGENCE OF THE IRANIAN PEOPLE. HE HAS REPLACED THE NOW-DISCREDITED WORD, "RESURGENCE" (RASTAKHIZ) IN THE TITLE. THAT EFFORT QUICKLY ABORTED ONCE THE SHAH.S DISPLEASURE BECAME EVIDENT. IN PRACTICAL TERMS,THE GROUP IS APPARENTLY A MODERATE, PRO-WEST, REFORMIST PARTY. HE SAYS HE IS IN CONTACT WITH THE DERAKHSHESH GROUP, AND THAT EITHER WILL HELP THE OTHER IF ONE OF THEM APPEARS CLOSE TO SUCCESS. THE NATIONAL FRONT, HOWEVER, IS MERELY "A GROUP OF OLD MEN LIVING ON THE MEMORY OF MOSSADEGH." THEY LACK AN IDEOLOGY AND CANNOT THEREFORE INSPIRE THE PUBLIC. MAZAREI CLAIMS ABOUT 150 HARD-CORE MEMBERS, MOSTLY ACADEMICS AND LAWYERS, PLUS A THOUSAND OR SO SYMPATHIZERS.
GROUP ALLEGEDLY HAS CHAPTERS IN SEVERAL CITIES BESIDES TEHRAN. MAZAREI PLANS TO HOLD WEEKLY MEETINGS AND TO START A NEWSPAPER. HIS AMBITION IS TO ONE DAY HEAD A MAJOR POLITICAL PARTY.

REGARDING THE PRESENT POLITICAL SITUATION, MAZAREI ECHOED THE VIEWS OF MANY OTHER CONTACTS IN ARGUING THAT KHOMEINI IS IN COMMAND BECAUSE OF WIDESPREAD RESENTMENT OF THE SHAH. IF THE SHAH WERE GONE, DIVISIONS WOULD INSTANTLY APPEAR, AND RAMA, NATIONAL FRONT, AND OTHERS WOULD DECLARE INDEPENDENCE FROM KHOMEINI. NONE CAN DO SO NOW, HOWEVER, FOR ANYONE WHO OPPOSES KHOMEINI APPEARS TO SUPPORT THE SHAH, AND POPULAR SENTIMENT TURNS AGAINST HIM. HE THEREFORE STRONGLY URGED THAT THE SHAH LEAVE THE COUNTRY, EVEN IF UNDER CONDITIONS WHICH WOULD PERMIT A POSSIBLE RETURN. NO SETTLEMENT CAN COME AS LONG AS THE SHAH REMAINS.
MAZAREI IS IN NO HURRY FOR ELECTIONS, BECAUSE IF HELD NOW THEY WOULD BRING VICTORY TO RELIGIOUS FUNDAMENTALISTS.

MAZAREI WAS MADE TO UNDERSTAND THAT WHILE WE ARE INTERESTED IN DISCUSSING THESE ISSUES WITH PERSONS ACTIVE POLITICALLY, WE COULD NOT SUPPORT (IN THE OLD-FASHIONED SENSE) ANY OF THEM. HE DOES NOT EXPECT FINANCIAL SUPPORT, BUT DOES SEEK "MORAL SUPPORT." HE HOPES TO ESTABLISH REGULAR CONTACT WITH US TO EXCHANGE INFORMATION. WE AGREED TO MEET AGAIN AND TO KEEP ABREAST OF HIS POLITICAL EFFORTS.
COMMENT: MAZAREI IS INTELLIGENT AND ARTICULATE. OUR BIO FILES DEALING WITH HIS EMPLOYMENT WITH EMBASSY (1958

DWELL ON HIS ARROGANCE AND CONCEIT. HE CAME ACROSS REASONABLY WELL, HOWEVER, IN THIS MEETING. WE HAVE NO INDEPENDENT CONFIRMATION OF HIS POLITICAL STRENGTH, BUT ANY MODERATE, PRO-WEST GROUP WILLING TO CONTINUE DEFIANCE OF THE MULLAHS IS OF COURSE A PARTY WHOSE PROGRESS WE WILL MONITOR WITH INTEREST.

WE WILL HAVE 45 RPT 45 (2698 LBS) OR MORE POUCHES READY FOR SHIPMENT VIA ARFCOS ON 13 JAN. THESE INCLUDE SOME EIGHTY BOXES OF FILES AND OTHER ITEMS WE ARE GETTING OUT OF TEHRAN. ALL BOXES ARE MARKED FOR FADRC AND FOR SAFEKEEPING. MORE WILL FOLLOW. WE HAVE PACKED UP ALL 1976 AND 1977 CHRONS WHICH WILL ALSO BE IN THIS SHIPMENT. MOST OF THE ITEMS SHOULD HAVE BEEN RETIRED LONG AGC BUT WE HAVE A FEW PACK-RATS AND THIS CAUSED PROBLEMS. WE HAVE CLEANED OUT POL, POL/M, SECURITY, ADM AND SOME ECON FILES. I THINK WE ARE PROBABLY A LITTLE OVER HALF DONE.

DUE TO HEAVY INCOMING/OUTGOING TELEGRAPHIC TRAFFIC AND OTHER NECESSARY DUTIES TO PERFORM; OBTAINING, PACKING, LABELING AND SHIPPING OF OTHER FILES WILL SIMPLY TAKE TIME. WE ONLY HAVE ONE SLOW DAY A WEEK TO REALLY HIT THE FILES HARD AND THAT IS MONDAY. WE WILL DO OUR BEST.
ALL COMSEC PUBS ON INVENTORY BEING RETURNED EXCEPT FOR S/KAG 1B ON JANUARY 13 SHIPMENT.

WE ARE IN TELEPHONE CONTACT WITH ARFCOS IN GERMANY CONCERNING THE EXODUS OF BAGS HE WILL BE CARRYING. A TOTAL OF ABOUT TWO TONS WILL BE LEAVING HERE WHICH INCLUDES ITEMS FROM OTHER AGENCIES AMONG OUR OWN TRASH.

I HAVE ASKED ADMIN COUNSELOR TO SEND CABLE FOR TDY ASSISTANCE SINCE DCRO G. HARCUM MUST TAKE R AND R THIS MONTH. HE RETURNS LATE FEBRUARY THEN I MUST (SHOULD) TAKE HOME/LEAVE/RETURN. I WOULD APPRECIATE IT IF YOU CAN ASSIST US IN THIS MATTER. GIL AND I BOTH HAVE LOST TOO MUCH LEAVE LAST YEAR AND SHOULD BE ALLOWED TO USE SOME THIS YEAR.

WE ARE STILL NOT RECEIVING ANY PERSONAL MAIL AND SINCE DEPENDENTS ARE AWAY THIS IS A BIG MORALE FACTOR. PAN AM HAS BEEN OVERFLYING TEHRAN ON SOME FLIGHTS AND SOME OTHERS ARE JUST NOT CARRYING ANY. CUSTOMS IS ALSO GIVING US A DIFFICULT TIME. COORDINATION WITH MAC FLIGHTS TO BRING IN PERSONAL MAIL IS NOT GOOD SO FAR. YOU MAY WANT TO LOOK INTO THIS PROBLEM WITH IRAN WORKING GROUP.
XENOPHOBIA IS ON THE RISE BUT WE ARE KEEPING OUR HEADS DOWN--HOME TO WORK AND BACK HOME. NO MAJOR PROBLEMS.
PLEASE INFORM FADRC/RM AND OC/P OF THE 45 OR MORE POUCHES AND THE WEIGHT OF 2698 POUNDS. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00415.subject: TELECON AMBASSADOR WOULD LIKE TELECON WITH YOU AT 2000, JAN 9, TEHRAN TIME WHICH IS 11:30 WASHINGTON TIME. SULLI

segments.text: AMBASSADOR WOULD LIKE TELECON WITH YOU AT 2000, JAN 9, TEHRAN TIME WHICH IS 11:30 WASHINGTON TIME. SULLIVAN

WE HAVE COMPLETED ALL THREE CONVERSATIONS SPECIFIED IN FIRST THREE POINTS OF SECSTATE ITEM 6 YESTERDAY'S TELECON. INTERLOCUTORS IN FIRST AND THIRD POINTS AGREED WITH SOME ENTHUSIASM. INTERLOCUTOR IN SECOND POINT MADE NO RPT NO COMMENT WHATSOEVER, AND MOVED CONVERSATION TO OTHER ISSUES.
CONSEQUENTLY, I STRONGLY URGE YOU TO CONFORM TO SCHEDULE OUTLINED SECSTATE ITEM 9 OF YESTERDAY'S TELECON. TIME IS OF THE ESSENCE.

WE HAVE NOT RPT NOT YET BEEN ABLE ESTABLISH CONTACT WITH INDIVIDUAL NAMED IN FOURTH POINT TELECON ITEM 6. OUR BEST INTERMEDIARY HAS LEFT TEHRAN, AND INDIVIDUAL HIMSELF MAY ALSO HAVE LEFT WILL KEEP TRYING AND LET YOU KNOW.

WILL PROVIDE DETAILS OTHER ASPECTS OF OUR CONVERSATIONS BY SECURE TELECON, WHICH WE ARE REQUESTING FOR 1130 AM WASHINGTON TIME JANUARY 9. ALTHOUGH THEY ARE INTRINSICALLY INTERESTING, THEY DO NOT RPT NOT BEAR SIGNIFICANTLY ON STEPS TO BE TAKEN IN THIS EXERCISE EXCEPT TO UNDERLINE FACT THAT ACTION IS URGENT.

AMERICAN REPORTER BRIEFED US ON CONVERSATION HE AND TWO OTHERS HAD WITH AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI JAN 8 (AT THEIR INITIATIVE). KEY POINT WAS TALEGHANI PLEDGED TO WORK WITH AMERICANS IF THEY "STOP FIGHTING THE PEOPLE." HE SAID AS LONG AS U.S. AND WESTERN COUNTRIES SUPPORT THE SHAH OIL EXPORTS WILL NOT RESUME. IF U.S. AND OTHERS SUPPORT THE PEOPLE OIL EXPORTS WILL RESUME, SINCE IRAN NEEDS THE MONEY.
EMBOFFS ARE TRYING TO SEE TALEGHANI ASAP AND HOPE TO GET HIS VIEWS FIRST-HAND ON VARIOUS SUBJECTS. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00421.subject: PRIME MINISTER BAKHTIAR ON PRESENT POLITICAL SITUATION SUMMARY: BAKHTIAR WILL PRESENT HIS GOVERNMENT TO

segments.text: SITUATION SUMMARY: BAKHTIAR WILL PRESENT HIS GOVERNMENT TO MAJLES JAN 11 AND TO SENATE JAN 13. SHAH WILL PROBABLY WAIT UNTIL CONFIDENCE VOTE TO LEAVE IRAN. HE EXPECTS UP TO 30 DEPUTIES TO SPEAK AGAINST GOVERNMENT. ACCORDING TO BAKHTIAR, EFFORTS STILL BEING MADE TO GET GEN. JAM TO JOIN GOVERNMENT. BAKHTIAR WILL DISCUSS REGENCY COUNCIL WITH SHAH AFTERNOON JAN 9. ISFAHAN WILL BE NEXT CITY TO GO OFF MARITAL LAW. END SUMMARY

PRIME MINISTER RECEIVED POLOFF STEMPEL FOR BRIEF CALL JAN 9 AND SAID HE WILL BE PRESENTING HIS GOVERNMENT TO MAJLES JAN 11. TO SPEED UP APPROVAL PROCESS, PM WILL PRESENT NEW GOVERNMENT AND PROGRAM TO SENATE MORNING JAN 13, THEN RETURN TO MAJLES FOR DEBATE. HE SAID NUMBER OF DEPUTIES, PERHAPS 30, WISHED TO SPEAK AGAINST GOVERNMENT; "NOW THEY ALL WANT TO SHOW HOW PATRIOTIC THEY ARE." IN REPLY TO QUESTION, HE EXPECTED FINAL VOTE OF CONFIDENCE NEAR END OF NEXT IRANIAN WEEK, EITHER JAN 16 OR 17. (WE UNDERSTAND FROM OTHER SOURCES THAT PM HAS FACED MUCH HEAVIER SLEDDING THAN EXPECTED.)

BAKHTIAR SAID SHAH WILL PROBABLY WAIT UNTIL VOTE OF CONFIDENCE TO LEAVE COUNTRY, BUT WOULD DO SO "VERY QUICKLY" THEREAFTER. (SOME QUARTERS BELIEVE SHAH MAY DEPART AFTER GOVERNMENT IS PRESENTED TO BOTH MAJLES AND SENATE. SITUATION SEEMS VERY FLUID AT THE MOMENT.)

PRIME MINISTER SAID EFFORTS ARE STILL BEING MADE TO GET GEN. JAM TO JOIN THE CABINET, AND PRESSURE IS BEING BROUGHT TO BEAR. NEVERTHELESS, BAKHTIAR SAYS HE HAS ANOTHER CANDIDATE READY IF NECESSARY. HE PREFERRED NOT TO NAME HIM AT THIS TIME. (SHAH TOLD AMB HIS IMPRESSION WAS THAT JAM WAS DEFINITELY OUT.)

BAKHTIAR WILL DISCUSS REGENCY COUNCIL COMPOSITION WITH SHAH AFTERNOON JAN 9. BAKHTIAR SAID THAT,IN ADDITION TO STATUTORY MEMBERS (PRIME MINISTER, SPEAKERS OF TWO HOUSES OF PARLIAMENT AND SUPREME COURT CHIEF JUSTICE), HE WOULD SUGGEST NAMES OF ABDULLAH ENTEZAM (NIOC CHIEF), GHOLAM HOSSEIN SADIQI (EX-PM-DESIGNATE), AND "PERHAPS" KARIM SANJABI (NATIONAL FRONT LEADER WHO HAS ALREADY REFUSED BEFORE BEING ASKED). FOURTH POSITION WOULD BE FOR SHAH TO NAME. BAKHTIAR'S ATTITUDE SUGGESTED HE EXPECTED SOME HORSETRADING OVER COUNCIL'S COMPOSITION.

RESTORATION OF CIVIL ORDER IS TAKING UP MUCH OF PM'S TIME. HE SAID HE FELT "MUCH MORE CONFIDENT TODAY" ABOUT LOYALTY OF MILITARY AND SAID HE FELT HE WOULD BE ABLE TO WORK VERY SATISFACTORILY WITH NEW CHIEF OF STAFF, GEN. GHARABAGHI. DECISION TO TAKE SHIRAZ OFF MARTIAL LAW LIST SEEMED TO BE SUCCESSFUL. IF ALL GOES WELL, ISFAHAN WILL BE NEXT CITY TO HAVE MARTIAL LAW LIFTED, PROBABLY EARLY NEXT WEEK.

PRIME MINISTER SEEMS IN EXCELLENT HEALTH AND SPIRITS, AND HIS CHEF-DE CABINET (WITH SOME SURPRISE) TOLD POLOFF PRIME MINISTER HAD BEEN WORKING UNTIL 8 OR 9 P.M. DAILY WITHOUT SHOWING ANY ILL EFFECTS. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00423.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT, JAN 9 SUMMARY: DEMONSTRATIONS THROUGHOUT IRAN INCLUDING HEAVY VIOLENCE IN TABRIZ. MARTIAL LAW IN SHIRAZ IS LIFT

segments.text: SUMMARY: DEMONSTRATIONS THROUGHOUT IRAN INCLUDING HEAVY VIOLENCE IN TABRIZ. MARTIAL LAW IN SHIRAZ IS LIFTED. CLERGY TRYING TO CALM MOBS WITH MIXED SUCCESS. RUMORS OF MILITARY COUP. END SUMMARY.

DEMONSTRATIONS TOOK PLACE THROUGHOUT IRAN YESTERDAY. MAJOR TEHRAN CROWD NUMBERING MANY THOUSANDS ASSEMBLED AT BEHESHT-E-ZARA CEMETARY, BUT SMALLER GROUPS WERE ACTIVE IN VARIOUS PARTS OF TOWN. PRESS REPORTS TWO BANKS BURNED. GROUPS GENERALLY CONTINUED OLD TACTIC OF HIT AND RUN, SETTING FIRES IN STREETS. SNOW SINCE EARLY MORNING HAS BLANKETED CITY TODAY AND WE HAVE NO REPORTS OF ANY SIGNIFICANT INCIDENTS IN THE CITY AS OF NOON.

TABRIZ MEANWHILE HAD MANY FIRES AND HEAVY DESTRUCTION. TWO HOTELS, MANY SHOPS, SEVERAL THEATERS, THE CITY LIBRARY, AND EVEN PRIVATE HOMES WERE BURNED BY MOBS. CONSULATE REPORTS TROOPS HAD ORDERS NOT TO SHOOT. THE SCENE THEREFORE APPARENTLY RESEMBLED NOV 5 IN TEHRAN. CONSUL REPORTS SOME OLD SCORES ARE BEING SETTLED, SUCH AS TORCHING A SHOP WHICH WAS OPEN ON A GENERAL STRIKE DAY. FULL EXTENT OF DAMAGE WILL NOT BE KNOWN FOR SOMTLOQME. THERE ARE NO REPORTS OF INJURIES IN THE RIOT AND THERE MAY NOT HAVE BEEN MANY, SINCE TROOPS APPARENTLY DID NOT FIRE.

VIOLENT CLASHES OCCURRED IN SARI, YAZD, BABOL AND MANY OTHER CITIES, BUT PRESS REPORTS DIFFER WILDLY AS TO CASUALTIES. ONE PAPER SAYS AT LEAST 24 DIED, INCLUDING 12 IN SARI, BUT OTHER JOURNALS PUT FIGURE AT 6-9. ONE PRESS SOURCE CLAIMS 5 PEOPLE DIED IN TEHRAN, BUT THIS REPORT IS NOT SUBSTANTIATED BY OTHER SOURCES.

DESPITE ALL THESE CHALLENGES TO SECURITY FORCES, GOVT ANNOUNCED YESTERDAY MARTIAL LAW HAS BEEN REMOVED FROM SHIRAZ, AS FIRST STEP IN REMOVING MARTIAL LAW THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY. POLICE RATHER THAN TROOPS WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR MAINTAINING ORDER, AND CURFEW IS RESCINDED.

CLERGY ARE MAKING PUBLIC AS WELL AS PRIVATE EFFORTS TO BRING MOBS UNDER CONTROL. PRESS REPORTS 162 TEHRAN MULLAHS ISSUED COMMUNIQUE YESTERDAY URGING FOLLOWERS NOT TO ATTACK FOREIGNERS WHO WERE HERE TO AID IRANIAN DEVELOPMENT AND STAY CALM IN GENERAL. PRESS SHOWED PICTURES OF WELL-DRESSED YOUNG MEN LOADING GARBABE INTO A GARBAGE TRUCK AS EVIDENCE THAT MULLAHS' CALL WAS HEEDED. CLERGYMEN ALSO ECHOED AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI'S WARNING AGAINST MOB JUSTICE DURING LARGE RALLY AT CEMETARY YESTERDAY. ACCORDING TO PRESS, HOWEVER, A LARGE SECTION OF THE CROWD "WENT BESERK," CALLED THE MULLAHS GOVERNMENT INFILTRATORS, AND BEAT THEM UP. MOB JUSTICE MEANWHILE LED TO LYNCHING OF TWO AFGHANS JUST SOUTH OF TEHRAN YESTERDAY.
CROWD CLAIMED THESE WERE THIEVES WHOM POLICE REFUSED TO ARREST. (WHILE THE ACT WAS NOT DIRECTLY POLITICAL, IT ILLUSTRATES THE GENERAL CRUMBLING OF LAW AND ORDER IN IRAN.)

COUNTRY IS FULL OF RUMORS OF MILITARY COUP SPARKED BY ONE JOURNAL'S CLAIM (ECHOING RADIO MOSCOW) THAT OVEISSI WAS IN U.S. TO PERSUADE PRESIDENT CARTER THAT MILITARY COUP WAS ONLY SOLUTION. SOME JOURNALS HAVE HELPFULLY REPORTED THAT USG FLATLY DISAPPROVES OF MILITARY TAKEOVER.

HEAD OF UNIVERSITY PROFESSORS' GROUP TOLD EMBOFF THERE ARE MEETINGS SCHEDULED FOR TODAY AND TOMORROW TO DISCUSS REOPENING OF TEHRAN AND OTHER UNIVERSITIES BY SATURDAY.
WE UNDERSTAND THAT NASSER KHAN QASHQAI, IL-KHAN OF THE TRIBE, WHO HAS BEEN IN EXILE FOR ABOUT 25 YEARS, PLANS TO RETURN NEXT WEEK.

WE HAVE CONFIRMED THAT OPPOSITION IS DISTRIBUTING FREE KEROSENE TO SECTIONS OF THE POPULACE IN TEHRAN AND OTHER CITIES, AS WELL AS LOW-PRICED EGGS, BREAD, AND CHICKENS. A LITTLE MORE PETROL IS AVAILABLE AT STATIONS TODAY, AMID A RUMOR THAT GOVERNMENT MAY REDUCE ITS PRICE.

GENERAL JAM'S REFUSAL TO JOIN CABINET IS NOW PUBLIC. THE DELAY IN CONVENING MAJLES TO APPROVE NEW GOVT IS ATTRIBUTED HERE TO ONE OF TWO CAUSES: A) BAKHTIAR IS UNREADY, OR B) POLITICAL LEADERS HOPE TO ASSEMBLE MAJLES AFTER SHAH HAS DEPARTED--30 DEPUTIES HAVE ALREADY SIGNED UP TO SPEAK AGAINST THE GOVT.

YESTERDAY MORNING AN AMERICAN EMPLOYEE OF LOCKHEED WAS FIRED AT BY PASSING MOTORCYCLIST WHILE HE STOOD ON A SIDEWALK. ASSAILANT FIRED ONE SHOT WHICH MISSED AND KEPT ON GOING. MILITARY BUS CARRYING AMERICAN PERSONNEL ON WAY BACK FROM WORK FROM DOSHENTAPPEH AIR BASE YESTERDAY WAS STONED BY YOUNG MOB AND EXTRICATED ITSELF WITH TWO GUARDS FIRING NUMBER OF ROUNDS IN THE AIR TOWARD THE MOB.
THE CRISIS HAS HAD ITS FIRST BIRTHDAY. THE RIOTS IN QOM WERE ON JAN 9, 1978. SULLIVAN

SUMMARY: EMBOFF VISITED QAZVIN, TWO HOURS DRIVE FROM TEHRAN, JANUARY 8, IN COMPANY WITH NATIONAL FRONT (INF) ACTIVIST SHAMS-UD-DIN SADR. EMBOFF ATTENDED MOURNING CEREMONIES IN LOCAL MOSQUE, AS WELL AS MASSIVE PEACEFUL DEMONSTRATION.SZDOT FIRST-HAND LOOK AT RESULTS OF SERIOUS DISTURBANCES WHICH HAVE TAKEN PLACE IN QAZVIN IN PAST TWO WEEKS. SITUATION WAS NOT RPT NOT AS BAD AS DESCRIBED BY TEHRAN RUMOR MILL BUT, WITH 186 CONFIRMED DEAD, UNDETERMINED NUMBER OF WOUNDED AND SEVERAL SHOPS, HOMES, AND ONE HOTEL LOOTED AND BURNED, THINGS ARE BAD ENOUGH.

THE INTENSE FEELING OF HATRED WHICH EMBOFF FOUND IN MASHAD DOES NOT SEEM TO BE AS STRONG IN QAZVIN BUT THE PEOPLE EVINCED NO GLIMMER OF SUPPORT FOR THE SHAH, BAKHTIAR, OR ANYONE ELSE EXCEPT KHOMEINI. END SUMMARY.

TRAVELLING WITH NATIONAL FRONT MILITANT DR. SHAMS-UDDIN SADR, HIS BROTHER, DR. AHMAD SADR KHASE-JAVADI, (MEMBERS OF AN OLD AND POWERFUL QAZVIN FAMILY) AND LESSER NATIONAL FRONTER DR. (FNU) KHAVARI, EMBOFF VISITED QAZVIN JANUARY 8. PURPOSE WAS TO OBTAIN INFORMATION ON CONDITIONS FOLLOWING OUTBREAKS OF SERIOUS VIOLENCE WHICH TEHRAN RUMOR MONGERS WERE LIKENING TO SAVAGERY IN MASHAD. UPON ARRIVAL EMBOFF WENT DIRECTLY TO 500 YEAR OLD SAFAVID MOSQUE TO HEAR A SERIES OF AKHUNDS, MULLAHS, AND ONE MUJTAHED WHIPPING UP CROWD OF SEVERAL THOUSAND BOTH INSIDE MOSQUE AND IN COURTYARD IN PREPARATION FOR DEMONSTRATION COMMEMORATING KHOMEINI'S DAY OF MOURNING.

MOST INTERESTING STATEMENT WAS THAT DELIVERED BY AHMAD SADR KHASEJAVADI, WHO IS ONE OF MOST SKILLED FARSI ORATORS EMBOFF HAS EVER HEARD. WHEN INTRODUCED, NOT BY NAME BUT MERELY AS A REPORTER FROM TEHRAN, SADR WAS GREETED BY SCATTERED CRIES OF "SAVAK AGENT". YET WITHIN MOMENTS THE CROWD WAS HIS. HE PUSHED THEM ONE WAY, AND THEN ANOTHER, AND BY THE TIME HE DESCRIBED A SCENE WHERE THE CHIEF OF POLICE OF NAJAFABAD (NEAR ISFAHAN) FIRED HIS PISTOL INTO THE AIR TO DRIVE AWAY A CROWD OF POTENTIAL BLOOD DONORS SEEKING TO HELP THOSE WOUNDED IN LOCAL CLASHES, HALF THE AUDIENCE WAS OPENLY WEEPING.

DESPITE THEIR EMOTIONAL STATE, AUDIENCE NOTED AND LATER OBSERVED INSTRUCTIONS DELIVERED BY MUJTAHED WHICH FORBADE WINDOW BREAKING, BURNING, AND THROWING ROCKS AT OR OTHERWISE HARRASSING SOLDIERS DURING DEMONSTRATION.

DEMONSTRATION MOVED DIRECTLY OUT OF MOSQUE AND INTO STREET WHERE MARCHERS WERE JOINED BY OTHERS. EMBOFF WAS USHERED TO PLACE OF HONOR IMMEDIATELY BEHIND PHALANX OF MULLAHS, FLAGS, BANNERS, PICTURES OF KHOMEINI AND MARTYRED QAZVINIS, ETC., WHICH LED THE PARADE. GIVEN PROMINENT LOCATION AND LARGE NUMBERS OF FRENETIC DEMONSTRATORS, IT COULD HAVE BEEN PAINFULLY AWKWARD TO REFUSE TO TAKE PART AND EMBOFF OPTED FOR ROLE OF NON-PARTICIPATING MARCHER FOR SEVERAL BLOCKS, UNTIL COMFORTABLE OPPORTUNITY TO SLIP AWAY PRESENTED ITSELF. LIKE TESSURA/ASHURA MARCHES IN TEHRAN, QAZVIN DEMO WAS TIGHTLY ORGANIZED.

SOME 15,000 PEOPLE (BBC REPORTER DAVID LANE WHO WAS ALSO PRESENT ESTIMATES 50,000 BUT THIS IS ABSURD) WERE ORGANIZED IN CHANTING BATTALIONS OF ABOUT 500 EACH, SEPARATED FROM ONE ANOTHER BY LINES OF BANNER-CARRIERS WHO KEPT A CONSTANT DISTANCE FROM GROUP IN FRONT OF THEM. PROCESSION ALSO INCLUDED A CHADORED WOMEN'S CONTINGENT OF ABOUT 300. (COMMENT: PRESENCE OF SO MANY WOMEN IS STRONG INDICATION OF DEPTH OF ANTI-SHAH FEELINGS IN QAZVIN, WHERE WOMEN RARELY LEAVE THEIR HOMES FOR ANY PURPOSE.

END COMMENT.) YOUTHFUL MONITORS WITH RED ARMBANDS MAINTAINED MARCHING ORDER AND KEPT CROWD FROM PASSING TOO CLOSE TO POTENTIAL FLASHPOINTS, SUCH AS GATE TO MILITARY CANTONMENT, BY FORMING HUMAN CHAIN AROUND ENTRYWAY. DEMONSTRATION SEEMS TO HAVE BEEN ENTIRELY PEACEFUL; EMBOFF SAW NO VIOLENCE, HEARD NO SHOTS OR ANY RUMORS OF TROUBLE CONNECTED WITH THE PROCESSION.

EARLIER PROCESSIONS HAD NOT BEEN SO LUCKY. ON DEC 27, 5OME 300 MARCHERS WERE ALLEGEDLY FIRED ON WHEN PASSING GENDARMERIE STATION BY A GENDARME SERGEANT NAMED ZANJANI. THREE MEN WERE KILLED. LATER THAT SAME EVENING SIX PEOPLE FELL AFOUL OF SAME GENDARME (NOT CLEAR HOW THEY DID SO) AND THREE WERE KILLED OUTRIGHT, ONE DIED OF WOUNDS, ONE WAS SHOT IN FOOT AND REMAINING YOUTH GOT AWAY TO SPREAD THE WORD. PEOPLE ERUPTED INTO THE STREETS ON DEC 28 AND 96 MORE WERE SLAIN.

ON NIGHT OF JANUARY 1-2 MULLAHS CONDUCTED A SIT-IN AT ONE OF LOCAL HOSPITALS ON BEHALF OF FAMILIES OF THE DEAD, WHO HAD BEEN PREVENTED FROM TAKING CUSTODY OF THE BODIES OF THEIR RELATIVES FOR BURIAL. BY MORNING A LARGE CROWD, ESTIMATED AT 40,000-50,000 BY HOSPITAL DOCTORS, USSS-00 SAA-01 SES-01 ( ISO ) W ------------------109428 091854Z /44 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 2832 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 00430 HAD GATHERED IN SUPPORT. MEANWHILE, MILITARY HAD BEEN REINFORCED WITH 700-MAN CONTINGENT FROM ZANJAN.

SOLDIERS ATTACKED AND DISPERSED CROWD AND IN ENSUING VIOLENCE ON JANUARY 2-3, DURING WHICH MILITARY EVIDENTLY GOT OUT OF CONTROL, AT LEAST 83 MORE PEOPLE WERE KILLED. ONE GROUP OF DEMONSTRATORS WAS FIRED UPON BY SOLDIERS AS THEY EMERGED FROM BAZAAR AND REPORTEDLY SUFFERED 32 DEAD. (COMMENT: EMBOFF OBSERVED MANY BULLET HOLES IN WALLS AND DOORS AT THAT POINT, RANGING FROM KNEE HEIGHT TO WELL ABOVE HEAD LEVEL. BAZAAR, LIKE EVERYTHING ELSE IN TOWN, WAS CLOSED FOR DAY OF MOURNING SO IT WAS IMPOSSIBLE TO VERIFY ACCOUNTS OF INCIDENT BUT IT WAS CLEAR THAT FIRE DIRECTED AGAINST A CROWD IN THAT CONSTRICTED SPACE WOULD HAVE INFLICTED MANY CASUALTIES. END COMMENT.)

MILITARY ALLEGEDLY LOOTED AND THEN BURNED SEVERAL SHOPS. EMBOFF VISITED ONE BURNED-OUT SHOP WHERE SAFE HAD BEEN RIPPED OPEN LIKE SARDINE CAN. NEWEST AND LARGEST HOTEL IN QAZVIN, THE PASSAGE HOTEL, WHICH HAD CONTAINED 45 ROOMS AND 48 SHOPS, WAS COMPLETELY GUTTED AT A LOSS TO ITS PRO-KHOMEINI OWNER, ALI ZAHEDI, OF 35 MILLION TOMAN (ABOUT $5 MILLION). MILITARY ALSO ALLEGEDLY DROVE TANKS INTO FRONTS OF SEVERAL DRUGSTORES, LOOTED DRUGS, AND THEN BURNED THEM. SEVERAL DOCTORS HAVE COME FROM TEHRAN AND OTHER CITIES TO OFFER THEIR SERVICES IN HOSPITALS TO THE WOUNDED. OTHER LOCAL DOCTORS ANNOUNCED THAT THEY WOULD TREAT THE WOUNDED FREE OF CHARGE.

THE HOMES OF TWO SUCH DOCTORS WERE ATTACKED AND BURNED BY SOLDIERS. EMBOFF VISITED BURNED OUT HOME OF ONE OF THESE, A DR. (FNU) DAFTARI. AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI HAS CALLED FOR OTHER CITIES TO SEND FOOD AND OTHER ARTICLES OF ASSISTANCE TO QAZVIN BUT MILITARY HAS REPORTEDLY SEIZED THREE TRUCKLOADS OF SUCH SUPPLIES. OVER 700 AUTOMOBILES WERE SAID TO HAVE BEEN BURNED. THERE ARE UNCONFIRMED REPORTS THAT THE MILITARY HAULED OFF MANY DEAD AND WOUNDED, SOME OF WHOM WERE BURIED ALIVE IN A COMMON GRAVE AT A PLACE OUTSIDE OF QAZVIN CALLED AB-GILAKI.

COMMENT: ATMOSPHERE IN QAZVIN IS TENSE,BUT IN NO WAY COMPARABLE TO THE AIR OF UNMITIGATED VICIOUSNESS WHICH PERMEATED MASHAD DURING EMBOFF'S VISIT AND THEREAFTER. RUMOR MILL HAS, AS USUAL, EXAGGERATED THE INCIDENTS IN QAZVIN. FOR EXAMPLE, ALTHOUGH TWO CHILDREN WERE APPARENTLY INJURED WHEN STRUCK BY MILITARY VEHICLE, IT IS NOT RPT NOT TRUE THAT DEMONSTRATORS IN QAZVIN WERE CRUSHED UNDER TANKS OR THAT TANKS WERE USED TO CRUSH HOMES OF OPPOSITION ACTIVISTS. EFFECT OF CLASHES HAS BEEN TO FURTHER SOLIDIFY OPPOSITION OF QAZVINIS TO ANYTHING THE SHAH MIGHT DO. EMBOFF WAS UNABLE TO FIND ANYONE IN TOWN WHO HAD A GOOD WORD FOR EITHER THE SHAH OR BAKHTIAR.

GENERAL POPULAR VIEW WAS PERHAPS BEST EXPRESSED BY FORMER HOTELIER ZAHEDI WHO ARGUED THAT THE PEOPLE WOULD SUPPORT WHOEVER KHOMEINI WANTS AS PRIME MINISTER AND NO ONE ELSE. MANY QAZVINIS POINT TO SIMILAR DEPREDATIONS BY MILITARY IN MASHAD AND NAJAFABAD AND SUGGEST, IN TIME-HONORED PERSIAN FASHION, THAT MILITARY ACTIONS WERE COORDINATED AS PARTS OF SOME GREATER ARMY PLOT. DEPARTMENT SHOULD NOTE THAT, WHILE NUMBERS OF DEAD ARE CONFIRMED FROM HOSPITAL RECORDS, SOURCES OF REMAINDER OF ABOVE INFORMATION ARE NOT NEUTRAL. NO ONE IS NEUTRAL IN QAZVIN. HOWEVER, SO MANY DIFFERENT PEOPLE TOLD ESSENTIALLY THE SAME STORY THAT EMBOFF IS REASONABLY CERTAIN OF THE FACTS.

EMBOFF DID NOT CONTACT MILITARY, WHOSE STORY IS THAT ONLY 12 PEOPLE WERE KILLED IN CLASHES PROVOKED BY ASSAULT BY TOWNSPEOPLE ON SOLDIERS. DOCTORS INSIST THAT NO SOLDIER HAS BEEN INJURED IN QAZVIN SINCE DECEMBER 3, WHEN ONE WAS STABBED BUT SURVIVED FOLLOWING AN OPERATION.

MORE COMMENT: ORGANIZATION AND PEACEFUL NATURE OF DEMONSTRATION WERE IMPRESSIVE, PARTICULARLY IN VIEW OF RECENT EVENTS. WHILE THERE ARE INDICATIONS THAT ISLAMIC AND OTHER OPPOSITION LEADERS MAY NO LONGER HAVE FULL CONTROL OF SOME ELEMENTS OF THE MOB IN TEHRAN, THIS IS CLEARLY NOT THE CASE IN QAZVIN. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00448.subject: USE OF MAC BY THIRD COUNTRY NATIONALS

segments.text: IN REFTEL EMBASSY ATHENS REPORTED THAT SOLAR TURBINES, LTD, WANTED USG ASSURANCES THAT THEIR THIRD COUNTRY TECHNICIANS WOULD BE PERMITTED USE MAC AIRCRAFT IF INTERNATIONAL AIR TRANSPORTATION IS NOT AVAILABLE. THIS COMPANY HAS BEEN REQUESTED BY NIOC TO SEND IN TECHNICIANS TO ASSIST IN RESTORING TO OPERATION OIL PIPE LINES.
DEPARTMENT IS REQUESTED TO URGENTLY OBTAIN SUCH PERMISSION FROM DOD AND ADVISE ATHENS AND TEHRAN BY NIACT IMMEDIATE TELEGRAM.

SINCE OTHER SIMILAR CASES MAY DEVELOP IN COMING DAYS AND SINCE THERE IS ALWAYS POSSIBILITY NEED AUTHORITY USE MAC TO TRANSPORT TCN IN CASE OF AN EVACUATION, THE EMBASSY WOULD ALSO APPRECIATE RECEIVING GENERAL RULING AND GUIDELINES FROM DOD ON TRANSPORTING TCN'S. SULLIVAN
RECOMMEND DEPARTMENT REPEAT REFTEL TO TEL AVIV AS INFO APPEARING IN U.S. PRESS SEEMS ON FIRST GLANCE A BIT TOO SOPHISTICATED FOR SAVAK BUT MIGHT BE PRODUCT OF ISRAELI INTELLIGENCE SERVICES.

EMBASSY HAS JUST COME INTO POSSESSION OF LONG OPEN LETTER TO KHOMEINI IN PAMPHLET FORM, SIGNED BY PREVIOUSLY UNKNOWN INDIVIDUAL, WHICH MENTIONS, AMONG OTHER THINGS, KHOMEINI'S SILENCE ON EXPULSION OF 300,000 SHIITES FROM IRAQ IN 1969 (CITED LAST PARA OF LEDEEN ARTICLE IN WASHINGTON STAR SENT USINFO 8 JAN 1978). SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00451.subject: ANOTHER MODERATE OPPOSITIONIST GROUP GETS IN TOUCH

segments.text: TOUCH

ON JAN 4 MR. RAHIM SAFFARI VISITED POL COUNSELOR AT HIS OWN REQUEST. SAFFARI IS A LONG TIME OPPOSITONIST IN HIS EARLY 60S, WHO HAS WRITTEN MANY BOOKS AND SAYS HE WILL BE WRITING MORE BOOKS AND PAMPHLETS. HE IS ONE OF THE MILDER MODERATE OPPOSITIONIST MEMBERS (POL COUNSELOR MET HIM AT A THIRD COUNTRY EMBASSY COCKTAIL PARTY SOME MONTHS AGO).

SAFFARI EXPLAINED THAT HE IS PRESIDENT OF THE "UNITY FOR LIBERTY" PARTY OF WHICH MAJLIS DEPUTY BANI AHMAD IS SECRETARY GENERAL. HE CONFIDED THIS RESULTED FROM BANI AHMAD'S TACTICAL ERROR IN DECLARING HIMSELF FOR SHARIFEMAMI GOVT IN THE MAJLIS ON THE VERY FIRST DAY, AND THEN HAVING TO REVERSE HIMSELF THE NEXT DAY UNDER PRESSURE FROM THE OPPOSITION.. HIS FOLLOWERS, WHO ARE PERTURBED BY THIS ABSENCE OF SAGACIOUSNESS ACCORDING TO SAFFARI, CAME TO SAFFARI AND ASKED HIM TO BE THEIR TOP GUIDE.

SAFFARI DESCRIBED HIMSELF AS AN INTIMATE OF MOSSADEGH'S, MORE SO THAN SOME OF THE TOP NATIONAL FRONT LEADERS WHO ARE NOW USING MOSSADEGH'S NAME TO ADVANCE THEIR OWN CAREERS. HE PROTESTED HE WOULD NEVER DO THAT HIMSELF.

SAFFAIR MADE IT CLEAR HE IS WITHHOLDING SUPPORT FROM THE BAKHTIAR GOVT AND GAVE US A COPY OF A PAMPHLET IN ENGLISH, TRANSLATED FROM THE FARSI, WHICH SETS FORTH A PROGRAM VERY SIMILAR TO THOSE OF OTHER SUCH MODERATE GROUPS. ITS FIRST POINT IS RESIGNATION OF THE SHAH AND ESTABLISHMENT OF A COUNCIL OF LEARNED PEOPLE TRUSTED BY THE NATION. THEN SHOULD COME DISSOLUTION OF BOTH HOUSES OF PARLIAMENT AND SPEEDY PREPARATIONS FOR FREE ELECTIONS, ENDING OF MARTIAL LAW, DISSOLUTION OF SAVAK, ETC. ETC. SAFFARI SAID HE WOULD LIKE TO KEEP IN TOUCH.
COMMENT: WE REPORT ABOVE AS ONE MORE EXAMPLE OF DISPARATE MODERATE GROUPS WHICH HOPE TO GET A CHANCE TO REBUILD THEIR FOLLOWING IF EVENTS IN THE NEAR FUTURE

1979TEHRAN00471.subject: RELIGIOUS LEADERS FEAR DEPARTURE OF SHAH

segments.text: EMBASSY KEEPS GETTING REPORTS FROM VARIOUS SOURCES THAT MODERATE RELIGIOUS LEADERS ARE VERY CONCERNED BY SITUATION THAT IS LIKELY TO ARISE WHEN SHAH LEAVES THE COUNTRY. THESE ARE NOT VERY COHERENT OR WELL REASONED, AND THE MOTIVES INVOLVED ARE NOT ALWAYS CLEAR. GENERAL FEAR SEEMS TO BE, HOWEVER, THAT MODERATES' INFLUENCE WILL BE SWEPT AWAY EITHER BY MILITARY TAKEOVER OR BY VICTORY OF COMMUNIST AND LEFT-WING FORCES.

ONE SOURCE OF THESE REPORTS IS INTERMEDIARY MANSUR EQBAL, AN AMERICAN EDUCATED YOUNG BUSINESSMAN, SCION OF EQBAL FAMILY, WHO HAS IN RECENT WEEKS THRUST HIMSELF INTO THE ROLE OF MEDIATING BETWEEN DR. HEJAZI, A SPOKESMAN FOR THE RELIGIOUS MODERATES, AND THE QUEEN. HE TOLD POL COUNSELOR ABOUT A WEEK AGO THAT RELIGIOUS MODERATES HAD LISTED THEIR DEMANDS IN WRITING, WHICH DID NOT INCLUDE THE DEPARTURE OF THE SHAH, JUST CONSTITUTIONAL RULE. A FEW DAYS AGO HE SAID HE WAS GOING TO BE WORKING CLOSELY WITH ZAHEDI.

MOST RECENTLY HE HAS EXPRESSED FRUSTRATION THAT THE PALACE AND ZAHEDI HAVE BEEN "PLAYING WITH HIM." HE SAYS HE TRIED TO ARRANGE MEETING BETWEEN ZAHEDI AND HEJAZI OR SHARIAT-MADARI, BUT ZAHEDI POSTPONED IT AT LAST MOMENT (EQBAL SEEMS UNAWARE OF SHAH'S PLANS TO SHELVE ZAHEDI).

EQBAL INSISTS RELIGIOUS MODERATES ARE ANGRY AT KHOMEINI FOR PUTTING THEM IN PRESENT DIFFICULT POSITION BUT DO NOT KNOW WHAT TO DO ABOUT IT. HE SAYS HE HAS BEEN PRESSING THEM TO APPROACH AMERICANS MORE WARMLY, SINCE THEY CANNOT HOPE TO RUN THE COUNTRY WITHOUT SUPPORT FROM ONE OF THE TWO SUPER POWERS.

A FEW DAYS AGO SECRETARY OF THE SENATE ABTIN APPROACHED EMBASSY'S POLITICAL ADVISER WITH REPORT THAT AYATOLLAH MILANI (WHOSE STRENGTH LIES IN MASHAD AND WHO HAS BEEN INTERNALLY EXILED BY GOVT AT LEAST TWICE) HAD BEEN COMPLAINING TO HIM ABOUT DETERIORATION IN THE SITUATION AND EXPRESSING THE HOPE THAT THE SHAH WILL NOT LEAVE THE COUNTRY. ABTIN SAID MILANI WANTED CONTACT WITH AMERICAN EMBASSY (AND WE ARE TRYING TO WORK THIS OUT IN THE SLOW PERSIAN MANNER). ABTIN ALSO SAID "COMMUNIST MULLAHS" HAVE SURROUNDED HOMES OF SHARIAT-MADARI AND OTHER TWO QOM AYATOLLAHS, MAKING IT VERY DIFFICULT FOR PEOPLE TO SEE THEM.

COMMENT: THESE TWO REPORTS FIT IN WITH OTHER CONVERSATIONS AND REPORTS WE HAVE BEEN RECEIVING. THE MOST INTERESTING ELEMENT IN THEM SEEMS TO BE THAT RELIGIOUS MODERATES ARE NOW SCARED ENOUGH TO TALK MORE PUBLICLY ABOUT THEIR FEARS. WHILE IN THE PAST THEY GENERALLY PRESENTED THEIR VIEWS PRIVATELY AS FAVORING RETENTION OF THE SHAH IN A CONSTITUTIONAL CAPACITY, THESE MODERATES FOR TACTICAL OR OTHER REASONS HAVE PRETTY WELL HUED TO KHOMEINI'S LINE IN PUBLIC, DISCOURAGING ANY GOI SEPARATE DEAL WITH THEM. THEY NOW BLAME THE SHAH AND HIS GOVT FOR PAYING TOO LITTLE ATTENTION TO THEM.
WHILE THIS CHARGE IS JUSTIFIED FOR THE EARLY PERIOD (I.E., LAST SPRING AND SUMMER) THEY HAVE ONLY THEMSELVES TO BLAME FOR REFUSING TO RISK A SEPARATE COURSE SINCE THEN.

OF COURSE, ONE REASON FOR THE RELUCTANCE OF SUCH RELIGIOUS LEADERS TO CROSS KHOMEINI MIGHT BE THEIR FEAR OF PUBLIC EXPOSURE FOR ACCEPTING GOI FUNDS, AS MOST OF THEM DID FOR MANY YEARS UNDER HOVEYDA GOVTS. ON THE OTHER HAND, THERE ARE PROBABLY MULLAHS WORKING LOYALLY WITH KHOMEINI TODAY WHO WERE ALSO RECIPIENTS OF GOI FUNDS THEN. THUS EXPOSURE COULD CUT BOTH WAYS, REDUCING PRESTIGE OF ALL RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP WITH THE PEOPLE. THIS IS A FACTOR WE SHOULD KEEP IN MIND IN OUR OWN CALCULATIONS ON THE FUTURE OF IRAN.

COMMUNISTS OR OTHER LEFTISTS MIGHT FIND THIS WEAPON PARTICULARLY USEFUL IN THE IN-FIGHTING WHICH CAN BE EXPECTED TO FOLLOW ANY VICTORY OF THE OPPOSITION HERE. THEY WOULD SEEK TO DISCREDIT MOST RELIGIOUS LEADERS -- OR BLACKMAIL THEM INTO SILENCE. AFTER ALL SEVERAL OF KHOMEINI'S CLOSEST COLLABORATORS IN PARIS ARE LEFT-WINGERS AND, SINCE KHOMEINI IS PERSONALLY UNTAINTED BY SUCH PAYMENTS, WOULD NOT BE RISKING THEIR OWN LEVER TO POWER (KHOMEINI'S) BY INSPIRING SUCH "EXPOSURES." SULLIVAN

THE FOOD SUPPLY SITUATION IN IRAN IS CONSIDERED TO BE GENERALLY GOOD WITH THE GREATEST CURRENT PROBLEMS ARISING IN COMMODITY DISTRIBUTION BECAUSE OF FUEL SHORTAGES. THE FOLLOWING COMMENTS ARE PROVIDED AS BACKGROUND TO BE USED IN CONSIDERING POSSIBLE FOOD ASSISTANCE TO IRAN.

THE WHEAT SUPPLY IN IRAN, INCLUDING 5.3 MILLION TONS OF DOMESTIC PRODUCTION AND 1.5 MILLION TONS OF IMPORTS, SHOULD BE ADEQUATE TO SATISFY DEMAND UNTIL THE 1979 HARVEST. ALL BUT ABOUT 300,000 TONS OF THE IMPORTED WHEAT HAS BEEN DELIVERED, IS IN THE PORT OR ENROUTE TO IRAN. TWO HUNDRED THOUSAND TONS ARE TO BE SHIPPED IN JANUARY AND FEBRUARY AND 100,000 TONS MAY STILL BE HELD UP UNDER A TRADE DISPUTE.

MOST OF THE DOMESTIC WHEAT IS STORED IN DOMESTIC ELEVATORS NEAR THE AREA OF PRODUCTION AND NEEDS ONLY TO BE TRANSPORTED TO THE LARGE URBAN CENTERS. AT THIS TIME IT IS ESTIMATED THAT A THREE MONTH SUPPLY OF WHEAT IS STORED IN TEHRAN CITY.

IRAN PRODUCED 850,000 TONS OF RICE THIS YEAR AND IMPORTED AN ADDITIONAL 500,000 TONS OF WHICH ALL BUT 50,000 TONS HAS BEEN DELIVERED OR IS UNDER FIRM CONTRACT. THIS SHOULD BE ADEQUATE FOR IRAN'S NEEDS UNTIL RICE HARVEST.

FEED GRAINS AND PROTEIN MEALS FOR SUPPORT OF THE DAIRY AND POULTRY INDUSTRIES ARE IN RELATIVELY SHORT SUPPLY, AS NO SUBSTANTIAL STOCKS ARE MAINTAINED, AND MORE THAN 50 PERCENT OF REQUIREMENT MUST BE IMPORTED. CURRENT SUPPLIES AND CONFIRMED IMPORT CONTRACTS PROBABLY HAVE INDUSTRY NEEDS COVERED FOR ABOUT TWO OR THREE MONTHS.

IRAN CONSUMES ABOUT 390,000 TONS OF VEGETABLE OILS ANNUALLY OF WHICH ABOUT 80 PERCENT IS IMPORTED. OUR IMPRESSION IS THAT IRAN HAS ALREADY COVERED ITS REQUIREMENTS THROUGH MARCH AND PERHAPS A BIT MORE.

SHOULD AN ASSISTANCE PROGRAM SUCH AS THAT SUGGESTED IN REFTEL BE CONTEMPLATED, IT MAY BE WELL TO CONSIDER TYING IT TO THE ABOVE COMMODITIES, FOR WHICH THE U.S. IS ALREADY THE MAJOR SOURCE OF IRAN'S IMPORTS. AS IRAN WOULD NOT LIKELY QUALIFY AS A P.L. 480 RECIPIENT -COUNTRY, IT IS SUGGESTED THAT U.S. ASSISTANCE BE IN THE FORM OF TRANSPORTATION OR OTHER LOGISTICAL SUPPORT AND THAT IF ASSISTANCE WERE TO BE A JOINT ACTIVITY WITH SAUDI ARABIA, THE SAUDIS PAY FOR THE PURCHASE OF THE AGRICULTURAL COMMODITIES. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00484.subject: NEW DEFENSE MINISTER SUMMARY: LIBERATION MOVEMENT OF IRAN (LMI) HAS INDICATED LT.GEN. KHALIL BAKHSHI-AZAR, CURRENTLY CHIEF OF AR

segments.text: SUMMARY: LIBERATION MOVEMENT OF IRAN (LMI) HAS INDICATED LT.GEN. KHALIL BAKHSHI-AZAR, CURRENTLY CHIEF OF ARMY J-5 (PLANS),WILL BE A SATISFACTORY REPLACEMENT FOR GEN. JAM AS DEFENSE MINISTER. LMI BELIEVES BAKHTIAR WILL NOT RPT NOT WIN PARLIAMENTARY APPROVAL UNLESS SENIOR GENERAL ACCEPTABLE TO IT IS NAMED. ISLAMIC MOVEMENT WILL SEEK REFERENDUM ON MONARCHY. LMI HAS PROBLEMS WITH LEFTISTS. END SUMMARY.

AMIR ENTEZAM, LMI CENTRAL COMMITTEE MEMBER, ASKED FOR AN URGENT MEETING WITH POLOFF STEMPEL MORNING JAN 10. PURPOSE OF MEETING WAS TO INDICATE THAT LMI HAD AGREED TO PUT FORWARD NAME OF GEN. KHALIL BAKHSHI-AZAR TO REPLACE GEN. JAM AS DEFENSE MINISTER IN BAKHTIAR'S CABINET. ENTEZAM SAID NOMINATION WAS BEING DISCUSSED WITH BAKHTIAR MORNING JAN 10, AND BAKHTIAR WAS EXPECTED TO AGREE. ENTEZAM SAID LMI SURVEY OF PARLIAMENT INDICATED BAKHTIAR HAD NO RPT NO HOPE OF WINNING PARLIAMENTARY APPROVAL WITHOUT SUBSTANTIAL SENIOR GENERAL AS DEFENSE MINISTER. BAKHSHI-AZAR WAS ACCEPTABLE TO LMI AND NATIONAL FRONT, BOTH OF WHICH WERE HELPING BAKHTIAR GET HIS CABINET TOGETHER AT THIS POINT.

ENTEZAM WANTED U.S. TO KNOW BAKHSHI-AZAR WAS GOOD CANDIDATE FROM ITS POINT OF VIEW AND, ENTEZAM THOUGHT, SOME OTHERS AS WELL. ENTEZAM ASKED U.S. TO HELP CONVINCE ARMY TO ACCEPT BAKHSHI-AZAR, PARTICULARLY IN VIEW OF GEN. KHOSRODAD'S JAN 7 STATEMENT REPORTED IN TEHRAN PRESS MORNING JAN 10 THAT IT WAS OUT OF QUESTION FOR THE SHAH TO LEAVE THE COUNTRY; "WE WILL NOT APPROVE OF BAKHTIAR NOR ANY MEMBER OF THE NATIONAL FRONT TO TAKE THE REIGNS OF THE GOVERNMENT BECAUSE WE WANT THE SHAH." EMBOFF REPEATED U.S.
POLICY OF SUPPORTING CONSTITUTIONAL SOLUTION AND SAID HE WOULD REPORT ENTEZAM INITIATIVE TO AMBASSADOR WHO WOULD, OF COURSE, TAKE WHATEVER FINAL ACTION WAS DEEMED APPROPRIATE.

ENTEZAM SAID LIST OF KHOMEINI-APPROVED NAMES FOR REGENCY COUNCIL WOULD PROBABLY BE AVAILABLE WITHIN NEXT 24 HOURS. IN RESPONSE TO POLOFF'S QUESTION ABOUT ISLAMIC MOVEMENT'S RESPONSE TO REGENCY COUNCIL PICKED BY THE SHAH, ENTEZAM SAID THAT KHOMEINI FORCES HAD DEFINITELY DECIDED TO REMAIN QUIET AND "LET BAKHTIAR PLAY THE GAME." ENTEZAM THOUGHT BAKHTIAR WOULD WITHIN A MONTH CALL FOR A REFERENDUM ON THE MONARCHY WHICH WOULD "SOLVE PROBLEM DEFINITIVELY." HE ADDED ALMOST AS AN AFTERTHOUGHT THAT ISLAMIC MOVEMENT WOULD ASK UN COMMISSION ON HUMAN RIGHTS TO MONITOR REFERENDUM PROCESS.
IN REPLY TO QUESTION, ENTEZAM SAID THIS HAD BEEN DECIDED UPON TO SHOW WORLD THAT CHOICE WAS FREE; PROPONENTS OF MONARCHY WOULD, OF COURSE, BE FREE TO CAMPAIGN ALONG WITH OPPONENTS.

AT SEPARATE MEETING, LMI'S TAVASSOLI TOLD POLOFF THAT LMI'S BAZARGAN HAD CONSIDERABLE DIFFICULTY WITH LEFTISTS IN TRYING TO WORK OUT OIL SETTLEMENT (SAME SOURCE HAD DENIED THIS A WEEK AGO) AND THAT INVOKING NAME OF KHOMEINI WAS ONLY WAY BAZARGAN HAD SUCCEEDED. FOR THIS REASON, LMI THOUGHT KHOMEINI WAS KEY FIGURE IN ASSURING STABILITY OF BOTH TRANSITIONAL AND FINAL SOLUTION.

EMBASSY COMMENT: GEN. BAKHSHI-AZAR IS WELL ANDM FAVORABLY KNOWN TO EMBASSY. HE IS REGARDED AS ONE OF SMARTEST GENERAL OFFICERS, BUT UNFORTUNATELY FOR THIS REASON, MANY OF HIS COLLEAGUES WOULD LIKE TO CIRCUMSCRIBE HIM A BIT MORE. AS DEFENSE MINISTER, HE WOULD LIKELY ENCOUNTER SOME STRAIN IN HIS RELATIONSHIPS WITH SENIOR COLLEAGUES, PARTICULARLY THE SERVICE COMMANDERS. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00497.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT, JAN 10 SUMMARY: DEMONSTRATIONS IN ISFAHAN. SNOW DAMPENS TEHRAN DEMONSTRATION ACTIVITY. SHIRAZ QUIET. TABRIZ STI

segments.text: SUMMARY: DEMONSTRATIONS IN ISFAHAN. SNOW DAMPENS TEHRAN DEMONSTRATION ACTIVITY. SHIRAZ QUIET. TABRIZ STILL SMOLDERING BUT QUIET. MEDIA SITUATION CHAOTIC. EDITORIAL CONTROL WEAK IN SOME PAPERS. TOP NIRT OFFICIALS RESIGN. UNIVERSITY COUNCILS TALK OF OPENING. STREET VENDORS BECOMING KNOWN AS "KHOMEINI STORES." CONCERN REMAINS ON BAKHTIAR'S VOTE OF CONFIDENCE. SHAH DONATES ROYAL PROPERTY TO PAHLAVI FOUNDATION. MEDIA REPORTS 260 PRISONERS FREED. SANJABI PRESS CONFERENCE HAS NOTHING NEW. END SUMMARY.

A SERIES OF PROTEST DEMONSTRATIONS CONTINUE IN ISFAHAN TODAY PROTESTING AGAINST THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT AND REAFFIRMING THE PRIMACY OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI. ISFAHAN OTHERWISE QUIET THROUGH MIDDAY JAN 10 WITH SOME SHOPS OPENING ONLY TO KNOWN CUSTOMERS. PAST THREE DAYS HAVE SEEN THREE FIREBOMBING ATTEMPTS TO U.S. HOMES AND SERIES OF THREATS TO ISFAHAN-BASED AMERICANS. JAN 9 BELL HELICOPTER BUILDING IN ISFAHAN WAS THREATENED BY MOB, BUT MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITY REACTED PROMPTLY, AND MOB WAS CHASED AWAY.

SHIRAZ IS REPORTED TO BE QUIET THROUGH MIDDAY JAN 10 AND TABRIZ IS QUIET THOUGH EMBERS CONTINUE TO SMOLDER FROM PREVIOUS DAY'S BURNING ACTIVITIES. IN TEHRAN SNOWFALL RANGING FROM 15 INCHES IN THE NORTH TO 18 INCHES DOWNTOWN HAS PUT DAMPER ON DEMONSTRATION ACTIVITY THOUGH TWO OR THREE SMALL GROUPS WERE REPORTED IN CENTER CITY THROUGH MIDDAY JAN 10.

MEDIA SITUATION IS UNCLEAR AND CHAOTIC. NIRT DIRECTOR AND DEPUTY DIRECTOR ALL RESIGNED TOGETHER JAN 9 AND CHAOS REIGNS. WE HAVE LEARNED EDITORIAL CONTROL HAS ALMOST DISAPPEARED AT KAYHAN PRESS WHICH PUBLISHES BOTH ENGLISH AND PERSIAN EDITIONS. STORIES ARE BEING RUN WITHOUT CONFIRMATION AND REPORTERS ARE OVERRIDING EDITORIAL COMMENTS AND OBJECTIONS.

UNIVERSITY COUNCILS AT ARYAMEHR UNIVERSITY (RECENTLY RENAMED TECHNICAL UNIVERSITY) AND THE NATIONAL UNIVERSITY HAVE CALLED FOR REOPENING OF THEIR UNIVERSITIES WITHIN NEXT WEEK. FACULTY MEMBERS TOLD US PURPOSE OF REOPENING UNIVERSITIES IS NOT TO STUDY BUT TO PROVIDE A FORUM FOR POLITICAL ACTION.

SMALL STORES BEING OPERATED FROM JITNEY-SIZED TRUCKS REPORTED IN PREVIOUS SUMMARIES HAVE BEEN WIDELY DUBBED "KHOMEINI STORES." THEY HAVE BEEN SELLING EGGS, CHICKEN AND BREAD AT ABOUT HALF OF COMMERCIAL PRICES AND FREQUENTLY GIVING AWAY KEROSENE FREE. CONCERN REMAINS ABOUT PRIMIN BAKHTIAR'S VOTE OF CONFIDENCE. SOME OPPOSITION GROUPS HAVE INDICATED THAT THEY WILL PLAY BEHIND THE SCENES ROLE TO MOVE BAKHTIAR EFFORT FORWARD TO VOTE OF CONFIDENCE.

MEDIA TODAY COVERED ANNOUNCEMENT SHAH DECREED ON JAN 9 THAT ALL HIS AND OTHER ROYAL FAMILY MEMBERS' PERSONAL PROPERTY BE TURNED OVER TO THE PAHLAVI FOUNDATION. NO ESTIMATE WAS PLACED ON VALUE OF PROPERTY INVOLVED BUT COMMUNIQUE SPEAKS OF "HUNDREDS OF MILLIONS OF DOLLARS."
PRESS AND RADIO ANNOUNCED JAN 10 THAT SHAH HAD PARDONED 260 (SOME REPORTS SAID 266) PRISONERS WHO HAD BEEN SENTENCED BY MILITARY TRIBUNALS. NO NAMES WERE GIVEN.
