ECONOMIC ACTIVITY IN IRAN IS ALMOST COMPLETELY PARALYZED. THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT OR ANY SUCCESSOR WHICH MAY COME TO POWER WILL FACE A FORMIDABLE CHALLENGE IN THE LABOR FIELD AS A RESULT OF UNPRECEDENTED STRIKE ACTIVITY DURING THE PAST FOUR MONTHS. BOTH THE SHARIF-EMAMI GOVERNMENT AND QUASI-MILITARY GOVERNMENT OF GEN. AZHARI TRIED AND FAILED TO OVERCOME THE STRIKES WHICH HAVE BEEN THE DIRECT CAUSE OF THE CURRENT PARALYSIS. THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT, ALTHOUGH OF AN ENTIRELY DIFFERENT COMPLEXION, FACES MUCH THE SAME CHALLENGE. OPPONENTS HAVE ALREADY ANNOUNCED THEIR INTENTION TO CONTINUE THE PARALYZING PUBLIC SECTOR STRIKES.

STRIKES, WHICH BEGAN TO PLAGUE THE ECONOMY IN LATE SEPTEMBER AND OCTOBER, INITIALLY AFFECTED THE PRIVATE AS WELL AS THE PUBLIC SECTOR. BY MID-OCTOBER, HOWEVER, STRIKES AGAINST PRIVATE COMPANIES WERE MOSTLY SETTLED, AND EARLY DECEMBER WE ESTIMATED ON BASIS OF SURVEY THAT INDUSTRIAL ACTIVITY WAS 80-85 PERCENT NORMAL; ALL BANKS WERE OPEN. STRIKE ACTIVITY BEGAN BY MID-OCTOBER TO BE CONCENTRATED IN VITAL PUBLIC SECTOR SERVICE AREAS AND OIL PRODUCTION. THIS OCCURRED AS MOTIVATION FOR STRIKES SHIFTED FROM WORKER COMPENSATION TO POLITICAL ISSUES. THE GOI SUFFERED A PECULIAR PARALYSIS IN ITS EFFORTS TO DEAL WITH THE WIDESPREAD PUBLIC SECTOR STRIKES.

THE STRIKES WERE DEALT WITH IN AN UNCOORDINATED, AD HOC MANNER WHICH PERMITTED STRIKE ORGANIZERS TO ESCALATE THEIR DEMANDS TO TEST THE GOVERNMENT'S FIRMNESS. EVEN IN SUCH VITAL AREAS AS OIL PRODUCTION AND REFINING, THE GOI'S RESPONSE WAS WEAK AND INEPT.

STRIKE LEADERS APPEARED TO COME FROM THE RANK AND FILE OF MOST ENTITIES. NOMINAL LABOR UNIONS EXISTED IN SOME CASES, BUT THEIR LEADERSHIP WAS COMPLETELY DISCREDITED AND HAD LITTLE OR NO INFLUENCE. AS THE DEMANDS SHIFTED FROM THE ECONOMIC TO THE POLITICAL AREA, EVIDENCE OF INFORMAL COORDINATION AMONG THE STRIKING GROUPS BEGAN TO APPEAR. WORKERS' DEMANDS BEGAN INCREASINGLY TO REFLECT COMMON DEMANDS, INCLUDING THE DEPARTURE OF THE SHAH, DISMISSAL OF EXPATRIATE EMPLOYEES, AND OTHER XENOPHOBIC DEMANDS. THE INCREASING ECONOMIC PARALYSIS WAS A VERY EFFECTIVE INSTRUMENT IN BRINGING ABOUT THE RESIGNATION OF PRIME MINISTER AZHARI AND THE ANNOUNCEMENT THAT THE SHAH WOULD LEAVE THE COUNTRY FOR A WHILE.

HAVING BROUGHT THE COUNTRY TO ITS KNEES, THERE IS NO ASSURANCE THAT IRAN'S INCIPIENT LABOR "MOVEMENT" WILL CONTINUE TO ACT WITH MONOLITHIC PURPOSE. THERE IS ALREADY SOLID EVIDENCE, FOR EXAMPLE, OF A SPLIT AMONG THE OIL WORKERS. ONE FACTION, APPARENTLY THE MAJORITY, APPEARS TO FOLLOW THE URGINGS OF RELIGIOUS LEADERS AND READILY RESPONDED TO ORGANIZED EFFORTS BY ENGINEER BAZARGAN (APPROVED BY KHOMEINI) TO RESTORE OIL PRODUCTION TO SUPPLY PRODUCTS FOR DOMESTIC CONSUMPTION. ANOTHER MORE RADICAL GROUP, QUIESCENT FOR THE MOMENT, APPEARS MORE RESPONSIVE TO POLITICAL RADICALS. SOME OF OUR SOURCES HAVE IDENTIFIED EX-TUDEH SUPPORTERS AMONG THEIR NUMBER.

EVEN AFTER OBTAINING AGREEMENT OF THE OIL PRODUCTION WORKERS TO PRODUCE SUFFICIENT CRUDE OIL TO RELIEVE THE NATION'S CURRENT DISTRESS, BAZARGAN IS HAVING TO NEGOTIATE WITH WORKERS IN THE REFINERIES AND VARIOUS OTHER INSTALLATIONS TO RESTORE THE FLOW OF PETROLEUM PRODUCTS. A TRAIN BRINGING OIL PRODUCTS FROM THE SOUTH WAS DELAYED AT ARAK BY LOCAL STRIKING REILWAY WORKERS; WORKERS AT ONE PUMPING STATION ON THE PIPELINE BETWEEN THE OIL FIELDS AND TEHRAN DELAYED THE RESTORATION OF PIPELINE SERVICE. AS OF JANUARY 10, HOWEVER, SUBSTANTIAL NUMBERS OF WORKERS IN THE REY, TABRIZ AND SHIRAZ REFINERIES HAVE GONE BACK TO WORK; AND, THE PRODUCT PIPELINE IS DELIVERING PRODUCTS FROM ABADAN TO TEHRAN.

THE POINT IS THAT IRANIAN WORKERS HAVE NOW LEARNED TO USE THEIR POWER AND ARE INCLINED TO MAKE THE MOST OF IT WHETHER FOR POLITICAL PURPOSES OR TO ACHIEVE ECONOMIC ADVANTAGE. THIS COMES AT A TIME WHEN THE GOVERNMENT'S ABILITY TO SATISFY THEIR DEMANDS, POLITICAL OR ECONOMIC, HAS GREATLY DIMINISHED. WITHOUT POLITICAL GOODWILL FROM MAJOR RELIGIOUS LEADERS, THE NEW GOVERNMENT HAS VIRTUALLY NO HOPE OF PERSUADING WORKERS TO RETURN TO THEIR JOBS. WIDESPREAD THREATS OF RETALIATION ASSURE THAT "NONPOLITICAL" WORKERS WILL NOT BREAK THE STRIKES.

EVEN IF A SATISFACTORY POLITICAL SETTLEMENT CAN BE REALIZED, PROPSECTS FOR LABOR PEACE ARE SLIM, BOTH IN THE PUBLIC AND PRIVATE SECTORS. IRAN FACES A PERIOD OF SEVERE AUSTERITY. THE PUBLIC TREASURY IS EMPTY. PRIVATE FIRMS WILL NOT HAVE THE MEANS TO INCREASE WORKERS' WAGES TO KEEP UP WITH THEIR DEMANDS. LAYOFFS ARE ALREADY WIDESPREAD ------------------122395 101630Z /42 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 2875 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 00500 AND WILL RESULT IN SERIOUS UNEMPLOYMENT.

ACCORDING TO PRESS REPORTS, VARIOUS PUBLIC SECTOR WORKERS ARE NOW CONFERRING TO SET UP NEW UNIONS AND ORGANIZE WORKERS INTO SOME SORT OF LABOR CONFEDERATION. IF THIS CAN BE ACCOMPLISHED, IT WILL REPRESENT A POWERFUL NEW FORCE ON THE IRANIAN POLITICAL SCENE. THE REPORTS CITED INDICATE THAT RELIGIOUS ELEMENTS ARE MOST PROMINENT IN THE EFFORTS TO CONSOLIDATE THE LABOR MOVEMENT. IT IS VIRTUALLY CERTAIN, HOWEVER, THAT THE TUDEH PARTY AND OTHER RADICAL ELEMENTS WILL FOLLOW THESE DEVELOPMENTS CLOSELY IN ORDER TO TAKE ADVANTAGE OF ANY OPPORTUNITIES TO CONTROL IRAN'S LABOR MOVEMENT.

HINTS THAT RELIGIOUS LEADERS, ESPECIALLY AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, MAY CALL FOR AN END TO AT LEAST SOME STRIKES IF SHAH LEAVES COUNTRY ARE STILL NO GUARANTEE THAT NEW LABOR LEADERSHIP WILL NOT TRY TO PUSH ANY FUTURE GOVERNMENT TO THE WALL. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00502.subject: PROFESSOR'S GROUP TO MOVE FOR UNIVERSITY RE- OPENING SUMMARY: PROFESSOR'S GROUP WILL TRY TO REOPEN UNI

segments.text: OPENING SUMMARY: PROFESSOR'S GROUP WILL TRY TO REOPEN UNIVERSITIES JAN 13. THEY WERE SEEKING PROMISE OF GOVT NON-INTERFERENCE. EDUCATIONAL COMMUNITY QUITE RADICAL ABOUT CORRUPTION TRIALS AND BELIEVES BAKHTIAR GOVT MUST TAKE FIRM ACTION TO SURVIVE. END SUMMARY

POLOFF SPOKE AT LENGTH JAN 6 WITH PROFESSOR ALI MOHAMMADI, PROFESSOR OF BUSINESS ADMINISTRATOR AT FARABAD UNIVERSITY IN TEHRAN. MOHAMMADI IS A SENIOR OFFICIAL OF DR. NASSER PAKDAMAN'S SOLIDARITY GROUP WHICH HAS BEEN RUNNING 70 TO 100-MAN SIT IN AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY. MOHAMMADI IS IN HIS EARLY 40'S, RECEIVED HIS PH.D. FROM COLUMBIA UNIVERSITY AND WORKED FOR SOME TIME WITH NIRT (IRANIAN RADIO AND TELEVISION) BEFORE TURNING TO TEACHING A FEW YEARS AGO.

MOHAMMADI SAID THERE WILL BE MEETINGS JAN 9 AND 10 BETWEEN PAKDAMAN'S GROUP, UNIVERSITY ADMINISTRATORS AND GOVT OFFICIALS. PURPOSE OF MEETINGS IS TO SET GUIDELINES FOR UNIVERSITY REOPENINGS WHICH ARE EXPECTED TO TAKE PLACE JAN 13 IF ALL GOES WELL. MOHAMMADI SAID FRANKLY THAT UNIVERSITY GROUP DID NOT PARTICULARLY SUPPORT BAKHTIAR'S GOVERNMENT BUT FELT THIS WAS A CHANCE TO GET THE UNIVERSITIES REOPENED AND TURN STUDENTS ATTENTION IN MORE CONSTRUCTIVE DIRECTION. SOLIDARITY GROUPS BASIC GOALS WILL BE TO ESTABLISH A DEGREE OF UNIVERSITY AUTONOMY IN SELECTION OF DEPARTMENT HEADS AND SENIOR OFFICIALS.

MOHAMMADI SAID UNIVERSITY PROFESSORS WOULD PROBABLY NOT RPT NOT INSIST ON EXECUTIVE RIGHTS TO APPOINT CHANCELLORS AND VICE CHANCELLORS BUT DEFINITELY WANTED MORE SAY IN THIS PROCESS THAN IRANIAN GOVT HAS EVER PROVIDED BEFORE. (PRESS JAN 10 NOTED SOME UNIVERSITY FACULTY COUNCILS HAVE CALLED FOR UNIVERSITY REOPENING WITHIN A WEEK.)

MOST IMPORTANT ISSUE IN MOHAMMADI EYES IS QUESTION OF CORRUPTION. HE SAID UNIVERSITY PROFESSORS ARE A MAJOR FORCE BEHIND PRESSURE TO HOLD PUBLIC TRIALS IN ARYAMEHR STADIUM FOR "LIST OF FIFTEEN" MAJOR FIGURES. HE PERSONALLY HOPES JUDICIAL PROCESS WOULD BE FOLLOWED EVEN IN SUCH PUBLIC TRIALS, BUT THOUGHT THERE WOULD BE "PEOPLE HANGING FROM THE LAMP POST WITHIN TWO WEEKS."

WITH RESPECT TO BAKHTIAR GOVT, MOHAMMADI SAID SOLIDARITY GROUP THOUGHT SOMETHING USEFUL COULD COME ABOUT IF PRIME MINISTER COULD ACT ON ISSUES OF MAJOR PUBLIC CONCERN. HIS SOLIDARITY GROUP SEES BAKHTIAR GOVT AS TRANSITIONAL EFFORT LEADING TO FREE ELECTIONS. PROBLEM IN EYES OF MOHAMMADI IS THAT "CABINET NONENTITIES" DON'T HAVE THE BUREAUCRATIC KNOWLEDGE TO MAKE THEIR MINISTRIES EFFECTIVE. USUALLY INCOMING MINISTERS CAN DRAW ON A CADRE OF FRIENDS OR ACQUAINTANCES TO SUPPORT THEM THROUGH EARLY DAYS.

BIGGEST PROBLEM BAKHTIAR OR ANY SUBSEQUENT GOVT WILL FACE IS THAT BY ELIMINATING ALL THOSE WITH GOVERNMENTAL EXPERIENCE, THEY ARE CONDEMNING THEMSELVES TO A VERY LOW LEVEL OF EFFICIENCY JUST AT MOMENT WHEN COUNTRY DEMANDS ACTION. HE SAID BEST EXAMPLE OF THIS PROCESS IS NEW EDUCATION MINISTER MOHAMMAD RIAHI WHO HAS BEEN A HIGH SCHOOL AND COLLEGE TEACHER. RIAHI HAS NO ADMINISTRATIVE EXPERIENCE AND WAS NOT EVEN RESPECTED AS A TEACHER BY EITHER HIS STUDENTS OR THE FACULTY AT THE UNIVERSITY WHERE HE TAUGHT. MOHAMMADI, WHO KNOWS RIAHI, SAYS HE IS SOMEWHAT ARROGANT AND HONEST BUT NOT RPT NOT VERY EFFECTIVE.

COMMENT: IT IS INTERESTING THAT PAKDAMAN'S GROUP IS APPARENTLY MORE INTERESTED IN SQUARING AWAY UNIVERSITY SITUATION THAN DIRECT POLITICAL INVOLVEMENT. IN A PHILOSOPHICAL MOMENT, MOHAMMADI SAID IRAN NEEDS MORE GROUPS INTERESTED IN THEIR OWN AREAS OF EXPERTISE BECAUSE IF DEMOCRACY IS TO SUCCEED FOR LONG, PERSIAN AUTHORITARIAN BEHAVIOR PATTERNS WILL HAVE TO BE CHANGED. EMBASSY WOULD AGREE WITH THIS, AS WELL AS HIS COMMENTS ABOUT GOVERNMENTAL INEXPERIENCE AND RESULTANT PROBLEMS. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00505.subject: INTERNATIONAL SEMINAR ON MINERAL EXPLOITATION TECHNOLOGY - CENTO

segments.text: IN RESPONSE TO REFTEL QUERIES, CENTO IS NOT SPONSOR OF SUBJECT SEMINAR; HOWEVER, CENTO LENDS ITS TACIT SUPPORT TO THIS SEMINAR.
WE CONCUR IN DEPARTMENT VIEW THAT CENTO PROJECT FUNDS CANNOT BE USED REF GUIDELINES.
ALTHOUGH AGENDA IS INDEED TOO BROAD FOR SINGLE EXPERT TO PROVIDE SATISFACTORY REPRESENTATION, EMBASSY WOULD NOT AT THIS TIME RECOMMEND MORE THAN ONE U.S. ATTENDEE.
EMBASSY CONCURS IN DEPARTMENT RECOMMENDATION THAT SUB-COMMITTEE NARROW FOCUS OF SUBJECT MATTER IN PREVIOUSLY
FOLLOWING IS SUMMARY OF HIGHLIGHTS OF MEETING JANUARY 10 WITH AYATOLLAH SHARIAT-MADARI IN QOM. FULL REPORT WILL FOLLOW SEPTEL.

EMBOFFS PERETT AND ESCUDERO, ACCOMPANIED BY NATIONAL FRONT LEADER NASSER MINACHI, MET PRIVATELY WITH HAJI SEYYED MOHAMMAD KAZEM SHARIAT-MADARI, MOST IMPORTANT ISLAMIC LEADER PRESENTLY IN IRAN, IN QOM JANUARY 10. EMBOFF MADE PRESENTATION URGING MODERATE, NON-PROVOCATIVE BEHAVIOR TO AVOID INCREASING INEVITA BLE NERVOUSNESS ON PART OF MILITARY SHOULD SHAH LEAVE IRAN. EMBOFF FURTHER NOTED THAT US WOULD USE WHATEVER INFLUENCE IT MAY HAVE WITH MILITARY COMMANDERS TO URGE THAT MILITARY ALSO BEHAVE IN RESPONSIBLE FASHION.

SHARIAT-MADARI IMMEDIATELY AGREED WITH THRUST OF EMBOFF'S STATEMENT. HE EXPRESSED DEEP CONCERN THAT MILITARY WILL NOT ACCEPT SHAH'S DEPARTURE, NOTING RUMORS THAT THEY HAVE ALREADY CONSPIRED WITH THE SHAH TO INSTIGATE TROUBLES WHICH WOULD CAUSE A NATIONALIST GOVERNMENT TO FAIL AND MAKE POSSIBLE THE SHAH'S RETURN TO POWER. HE REPEATEDLY SUGGESTED THAT THE US DO ALL POSSIBLE TO PREVENT THIS.

HOWEVER, WHILE NOTING THAT LEFTISTS AND OTHER CONSPIRATORIAL ELEMENTS MIGHT NOT OBEY HIS DIRECTIONS, HE AGREED TO ISSUE ON JANUARY 11, AN INSTRUCTION ORDERING THE FAITHFUL TO REFRAIN FROM ANY FORM OF VIOLENCE OR ANY SORT OF PROVOCATIVE BEHAVIOR TOWARD THE MILITARY DURING THE PERIOD AFTER THE DEPARTURE OF THE SHAH. THE INSTRUCTION WOULD BE ISSUED UNDER HIS SEAL AS WELL AS THOSE OF THE AYATOLLAHS GOLPAYGANI AND MARASHI.

AYATOLLAH WAS VERY FORTHCOMING REGARDING FUTURE RELATIONS BETWEEN IRAN AND THE US. HE EXPRESSED APPRECIATION FOR PAST US ASSISTANCE AND NOTED THAT IRAN'S NEED TO SELL OIL IS AS GREAT AS THAT OF THE US TO BUY. HE REMARKED UPON IRAN'S NEED FOR US PROTECTION AGAINST THE USSR. PRESENT CRITICISM OF US STEMS FROM MISTAKEN BELIEF THAT US HAS INTERFERED IN INTERNAL IRANIAN AFFAIRS. THIS PROBLEM CAN BE CLEARED UP AND GOOD US-IRANIAN RELATIONS CAN BE RE-ESTABLISHED ON A BASIS OF MUTUAL RESPECT.

SHARIAT-MADARI STATED THAT HE HAS NEITHER APPROVED NOR DISAPPROVED BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT. SOME AMBIGUITIES IN BAKHTIAR'S PROGRAM REGARDING THE MEANING OF SOCIALISM IN THE PHRASE "SOCIAL DEMOCRACY" AND THE ATTITUDE OF THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT TOWARD OPERATION OF THE TUDEH PARTY IN IRAN (WHICH THE AYATOLLAH WOULD OPPOSE) NEED TO BE CLEARED UP. ALSO, PRIME MINISTER MUST ACT IN STRICT ACCORDANCE WITH THE CONSTITUTION.

COMMENT: SHARIAT-MADARI WAS CLEARLY PLEASED TO SEE SOMEONE FROM USG. HIS ATTITUDE WAS COMPLETELY REASONABLE AND COOPERATIVE. HOWEVER, IT IS DOUBTFUL THAT HE WOULD BE WILLING TO TAKE A POSITION TOO FAR OUT IN FRONT OF THAT OF KHOMEINI AND IT REMAINS BE BE SEEN HOW MUCH OF SHARIAT-MADARI'S COOPERATIVE ATTITUDE WILL BE TRANSLATED INTO THE BEHAVIOR OF IRAN'S TRADITIONALLY QUARRELSOME POLITICIANS ONCE THE SHAH HAS GONE AND THEY HAVE THE POWER.
(S) ENTIRE TEXT
GENERAL HUYSER AND I WILL SEE THE SHAH AT 1130 THURSDAY JAN 11 TO CARRY OUT INSTRUCTIONS CONTAINED REFTEL.

HOWEVER, YOU SHOULD KNOW THAT PRESIDENT HAS MADE GROSS AND PERHAPS IRRETRIEVABLE MISTAKE BY FAILING TO SEND EMISSARY TO PARIS TO SEE KHOMEINI AS PREVIOUSLY AGREED - I CAN NOT RPT NOT UNDERSTAND THE RATIONALE FOR THIS UNFORTUNATE DECISION.
GENERAL HUYSER HAS ALREADY ASKED SECRETARY BROWN TO ASK PRESIDENT TO RECONSIDER, IN VIEW OF URGENT APPEALS FROM IRANIAN MILITARY THAT WE ARRANGE RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN THEM AND KHOMEINI.

I URGE YOU IMMEDIATELY TO JOINT HAROLD BROWN IN THIS PLEA FOR SANITY. IT IS INCOMPREHENSIBLE TO ME AND GENERAL HUYSER TO UNDERSTAND WHY THIS DECISION HAS BEEN OVERTURNED. FAILURE TO ACT IMMEDIATELY COULD PERMANENTLY FRUSTRATE U.S. NATIONAL INTERESTS IN IRAN.

GISGARD MAY BE HELPFUL, BUT NO RPT NO IRANIAN TRUSTS FRANCE AND ONLY AN EFFORT FROM THE U.S. WILL CARRY WEIGHT. MOREOVER, THE U.S. OUGHT TO OBTAIN SOME CREDIT FOR BRINGING MILITARY AND RELIGIOUS TOGETHER IN IRAN TO SERVE OUR NATIONAL INTERESTS.

1979TEHRAN00522.subject: RETURN OF OIL PIPELINE TECHNICIANS TO IRAN

segments.text: PLEASE INFORM SOLAR TURBINE REPRESENTATIVE THAT ANY AMCIT NEEDING TO DO SO MAY USE USG TRANSPORATION (MAC FLIGHTS) FOR DEPARTURE FROM IRAN. WE HAVE REQUESTED AUTHORITY THROUGH THE DEPARTMENT TO PERMIT THIRD COUNTRY NATIONALS (TCN), TO BE ABLE TO USE MAC TRANSPORATION. IF AUTHORITY GRANTED, NON-AMCIT EMPLOYEES OF SOLAR TURBINE WOULD, IF THE NEED AROSE, BE PERMITTED TO USE MAC TRANSPORTATION.
PENDING RECEIPT OF AUTHORITY FOR TCN'S TO USE MAC FLIGHTS AND ASSUMING THAT REQUISITE ASSURANCES FOR INCOUNTRY SECURITY ARE PROVIDED BY NIOC, WE URGE SOLAR TO SEND SOONEST A TEAM OF ONLY AMCITS.
WE WILL ADVISE YOU SOONEST OF THE RESPONSE TO OUR REQUEST REGARDING ACCESS TO USG TRANSPORTATION BY TCN'S.

SUMMARY: IN JANUARY 10 MEETING EMBOFFS FOUND AYATOLLAH SHARIAT-MADARI REASONABLE, COOPERATIVE, AND PLEASED TO SEE REPRESENTATIVES OF USG. HE AGREED TO ISSUE LETTER INSTRUCTING THE FAITHFUL TO BEHAVE WITH MODERATION TOWARDS THE MILITARY AND TOWARD OTHER PERSONS AND PROPERTY IN GENERAL DURING IMMEDIATE POST-SHAH PERIOD TO AVOID PROVOKING MILITARY. HOWEVER, HE EXPRESSED DEEP CONCERN AT POSSIBILITY THAT SHAH AND GENERALS MIGHT HAVE CONSPIRED TO PROMOTE SHAH'S RETURN OR THAT GENERALS MIGHT SIMPLY SEIZE POWER THEMSELVES. HE STRONGLY URGED US TO USE ITS INFLUENCE TO ATTEMPT TO PREVENT SUCH ACTION BY THE MILITARY.

SHARIATMADARI WAS QUITE OPTIMISTIC ABOUT FUTURE RELATIONS BETWEEN IRAN AND THE UNITED STATES, EXPRESSING APPRECIATION FOR PAST US ASSISTANCE TO IRAN, NOTING OUR MUTUAL SECURITY INTERESTS AND OPINING THAT CURRENT CRITICISM OF THE US IS MERELY A MISUNDERSTANDING. REGARDING THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT, SHARIAT-MADARI EXPRESSED NEITHER APPROVAL NOR DISAPPROVAL. HOWEVER, HE DID REFER TO AMBIGUITIES IN BAKHTIAR'S PROGRAM AND STATEMENTS WHICH NEED TO BE CLEARED UP AND TO THE NEED FOR THE PRIME MINISTER TO BEHAVE IN STRICT ACCORDANCE WITH THE CONSTITUTION. END SUMMARY.

EMBOFFS PERETT AND ESCUDERO, ACCOMPANIED BY NATIONAL FRONT AND IRANIAN NATIONAL COMMITTEE FOR HUMAN RIGHTS LEADER NASSER MINACHI, MET PRIVAJANUARY 10 WITH AYATOLLAH HAJI SEYYED MOHAMMAD KAZEM SHARIAT-MADARI. THE AYATOLLAH'S SON, ENGINEER HASSAN SHARIAT-MADARI, AN ELECTRONICS ENGINEERING GRADUATE FROM ARYAMEHR UNIVERSITY WHO SPEAKS SOME ENGLISH, WAS PRESENT FOR PART OF THE MEETING. EMBOFF OPENED MEETING WITH BRIEF STATEMENT EMPHASIZING IMPORTANCE OF MODERATE BEHAVIOR ON ALL SIDES, IF SHAH SHOULD LEAVE, AND URGING SHARIAT-MADARI AND HIS QOM COLLEAGUES MARASHI AND GOLPAYGANI TO ISSUE INSTRUCTIONS TO THEIR FOLLOWERS TO DO NOTHING TO INCREASE THE EDGINESS WHICH THE MILITARY WOULD NATURALLY FEEL UNDER SUCH CIRCUMSTANCES.

SHARIAT-MADARI, WHOSE CONCERN FOR THE FUTURE ACTIVITY OF THE MILITARY WAS PROBABLY HEIGHTENED BY A LOCAL PRESS REPORT OF GEN. KHOSROWDAD'S INTERVIEW WITH FIGARO HEADLINED "IF THE SHAH LEAVES, BAKHTIAR HAS DUG HIS OWN GRAVE", RESPONDED IMMEDIATELY AND POSITIVELY. HE STATED THAT THE CLERGY FEARS THAT THE MILITARY MIGHT FOMENT TROUBLE THEMSELVES, EITHER TO ENSURE THE FAILURE OF A CIVILIAN GOVERNMENT AND PAVE THE WAY FOR THE SHAH'S RETURN OR TO SEIZE POWER FOR THEMSELVES.

THE CLERGY ARE NOT SO MUCH CONCERNED WITH THE IDENTITY OF THE CIVILIAN PRIME MINISTER BUT, AS BAKHTIAR HAS HELD NO PAST POLITICAL POSITIONS, SHARIAT-MADARI FEARS THAT THE GENERALS MAY DECIDE THAT THEY ARE BETTER FITTED TO RULE THAN HE.

EMBOFF MADE IT PLAIN THAT, SHOULD THE ISLAMIC LEADERSHIP URGE MODERATION, THE US WOULD USE WHATEVER INFLUENCE IT MIGHT HAVE WITH THE MILITARY TO ATTEMPT TO ENSURE THAT THE SOLDIERY ALSO BEHAVES RESPONSIBLY. SHARIAT-MADARI UNDERLINED THE IMPORTANCE OF CONTACTING AS MANY MILITARY COMMANDERS AS POSSIBLE IN THIS REGARD, NOT JUST THOSE AT THE TOP. HIS SON LATER URGED US TO MAKE THESE POINTS ESPECIALLY TO REGIONAL MILITARY COMMANDERS IN TABRIZ, SHIRAZ, ISFAHAN AND ELSEWHERE. AYATOLLAH ALSO ASKED THAT US MAKE CLEAR TO THE GEN THAT CLERGY DID NOT SET OUT TO ENGINEER THE FALL OF THE SHAH.
RATHER, THIS SOLUTION WAS ACCEPTED BY THE CLERGY AS THE WILL OF THE PEOPLE AND AS THE ONLY WAY TO RESOLVE THE COUNTRY'S PROBLEMS. (COMMENT: AYATOLLAHS ARE SOMETIMES DISINGENUOUS.)

SHARIAT-MADARI THEN AGREED TO MEET NIGHT OF JANUARY 10 WITH HIS TWO ISLAMIC COLLEAGUES AND, ON JANUARY 11, TO ISSUE AN INSTRUCTION UNDER ALL THREE SIGNATURES AND SEALS ALONG LINES PROPOSED BY EMBOFF. THIS WOULD SUPPLEMENT AN EARLIER LETTER, ISSUED THREE DAYS AGO BUT NOT TARGETED AT THE POST-SHAH PERIOD, WHICH POINTS OUT THE DUTY OF ALL MUSLIMS TO OBEY THE ISLAMIC LEADERSHIP. THE LETTER FORBIDS ATTACKS ON LIFE OR PROPERTY, RAPE, AND ASSAULTS ON TROOPS AND CIVILIAN GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS.

IT ALSO CAUTIONS THE PEOPLE AGAINST KANGAROO COURTS TO PUNISH THOSE WHO COLLABORATED WITH THE REGIME TO THE DETRIMENT OF THE PEOPLE, NOTING THAT THE CLERGY WILL RECOGNIZE WHO SHOULD BE PUNISHED AND THEN THEY WILL BE REMANDED FOR FAIR TRIAL. IN THIS REGARD THE AYATOLLAH STATED THAT THE NATION CAN FORGIVE THOSE WHO PARTICIPATED IN THE ------------------009804 111213Z /12 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 2905 SECTION 02 OF 03 TEHRAN 00553 EXDIS CRIMES OF THE SHAH'S REGIME, EXCEPT FOR THOSE WHO HAVE BEEN INVOLVED IN TORTURE. THESE SHOULD BE TRIED IN COURTS OF LAW.

OTHER AYATOLLAHS FEEL THE SAME WAY AND EVEN KHOMEINI DOES NOT WANT DRUMHEAD JUSTICE. THE CLERGY IS NOT OPPOSED TO THE ARMY PER SE, WHICH IS, AFTER ALL, A PART OF THE NATION AND IS NEEDED FOR NATIONAL DEFENSE. IF SOME OFFICERS ARE TRIED, IT WILL BE AS INDIVIDUALS, FOR CRIMES WHICH THEY COMMITTED AS INDIVIDUALS, AND NOT AS MILITARY OFFICERS. HOWEVER, THE ARMY IS A NATIONAL ORGANIZATION AND IT MUST BELONG TO THE NATION AND NEVER AGAIN BE SUBJECT TO THE WILL OF A SINGLE MAN.

RETURNING TO THE SUBJECT OF HIS NEW INSTRUCTION, SHARIAT-MADARI OPINED THAT THERE MIGHT BE SOME WHO WOULD NOT OBEY. THESE WOULD BE LEFTISTS, AGENTS OF SAVAK AND THE MILITARY, OR OTHERS WHO WANT TO INCITE TROUBLE TO FURTHER THEIR OWN ENDS. THE CLERGY CANNOT CONTROL THE BEHAVIOR OF SUCH PEOPLE BUT THE BULK OF THE POPULATION, WHO ARE GOOD MUSLIMS, WILL OBEY.

WITH RESPECT TO FUTURE RELATIONS WITH THE US, THE AYATOLLAH WAS QUITE OPTIMISTIC. HE EXPRESSED APPRECIATION FOR US ASSISTANCE TO IRAN THROUGH THE UN TO PREVENT A SOVIET TAKEOVER OF AZARBAIJAN AND NOTED THAT IRAN WOULD HAVE CONTINUED NEED OF US PROTECTION AGAINST THE SOVIETS. (COMMENT: AS SHARIAT-MADARI IS FROM TABRIZ, OUR ASSISTANCE ON AZARBAIJAN IS OF CONSIDERABLE PERSONAL IMPORTANCE TO HIM AND HIS ANTI-SOVIET PROTESTATIONS CAN PROBABLY BE ACCEPTED AT FACE VALUE.) US-IRANIAN RELATIONS HAD BEEN HELPED ALSO BY THE LICY OF AVOIDING DIRECT INTERFERENCE IN IRANIAN OIL MATTERS, ACTING INSTEAD THROUGH THE CONSORTIUM, WHICH INCLUDES OIL COMPANIES FROM SEVERAL NATIONS.

ALSO IRAN NEEDS THE US MARKET, BOTH AS A SOURCE OF IMPORTS AND AS A PURCHASER FOR IRANIAN OIL. THE ONLY DARK CLOUD ON OUR RELATIONSHIP STEMS FROM THE MISTAKEN PERCEPTION IN SOME QUARTERS THAT THE US HAS INTERVENED TO HELP CAUSE THE PRESENT VIOLENT SITUATION. SHARIATMADARI DOES NOT BELIEVE THIS AND FEELS THAT THE MISTAKEN VIEW CAN BE CORRECTED. THE USSR IS PROBABLY BEHIND MUCH OF THE CURRENT ANTI-US FEELING IN IRAN BUT THE CLERGY OPPOSE THIS AND ALL SOVIET ACTIVITY IN IRAN. FUTURE US-IRAN RELATIONS SHOULD BE BASED ON EQUALITY AND MUTUAL RESPECT.

IRAN WOULD EXPECT THE US TO GIVE CONSIDERATION TO IRAN AND TO TAKE NO REGIONAL DECISION COUNTER TO IRANIAN INTERESTS. (COMMENT: THE PRESENT DECLINE IN THE US REPUTATION IN THE MINDS OF IRANIANS IS REPARABLE, BUT IT WILL NOT RPT NOT BE AS SIMPLE A MATTER AS THE AYATOLLAH SUGGESTS.)

ACCORDING TO SHARIAT-MADARI, THE ISLAMIC LEADERSHIP HAVE NEITHER APPROVED NOR DISAPPROVED OF THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT. THEY HAVE ADOPTED A WAIT-AND-SEE ATTITUDE. HOWEVER, THEY HAVE NOTED CERTAIN AMBIGUITIES AND OMISSIONS IN HIS STATEMENTS WHICH MUST BE CLEARED UP. FOR EXAMPLE, HE HAS SAID NOTHING ABOUT THE DEPENDENCE OF HIS GOVERNMENT ON THE WILL OF THE IRANIAN PEOPLE AS EXPRESSED THROUGH THE REVOLUTION. THE CLERGY WILL PROTEST OMISSIONS OF THIS POINT IN THE FUTURE. IN ADDITION, IT IS NOT CLEAR WHAT BAKHTIAR MEANS WHEN HE SAYS HE WANTS TO MOVE THE COUNTRY TOWARD SOCIAL DEMOCRACY. THE CLERGY WANTS DEMOCRACY, BUT THE REMAINDER OF THE PHRASE IS UNCLEAR.

BAKHTIAR HAS ALSO SUGGESTED THAT THE TUDEH (COMMUNIST) PARTY MIGHT RESUME ITS OPERATIONS IN IRAN IF IT IS NOT CONTROLLED FROM ABROAD. THE CLERGY WOULD OPPOSE THIS ON GROUNDS THA TUDEH WILL NEVER BE ANYTHING BUT SOVIET-CONTROLLED. IN ANY CASE THE PRIME MINISTER ALONE HAS NO AUTHORITY TO DECIDE WHAT POLITICAL PARTIES CAN OR CANNOT FUNCTION IN IRAN. THE ISLAMIC LEADERSHIP EXPECTS BAKHTIAR OR ANY OTHER PRIME MINISTER TO COMPORT HIMSELF STRICTLY ACCORDING TO THE CONSTITUTION. IN ADDITION BAKHTIAR SHOULD GIVE THOUGHT TO ISLAMIC IDEOLOGY AND RECOGNIZE ITS INFLUENCE.
BAKHTIAR HAD REQUESTED A MEETING WITH SHARIAT-MADARI IN QOM BUT THE AYATOLLAH HAS REFUSED, FEELING THAT THE TIME IS NOT YET RIGHT FOR A MEETING.

THE CLERGY, SHARIAT-MADARI BELIEVES, WOULD ACCEPT ANY DEMOCRATIC FORM OF GOVERNMENT IN IRAN0 EVEN A CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCHY, SO LONG AS IT REFLECTS THE WILL OF THE PEOPLE. IF SUCH A GOVERNMENT IS FAITHFUL TO THE LAWS OF ISLAM, IT WILL BE GUARDED AGAINST TYRANNY. CONTRARY TO WESTERN OPINION, THE SHIA CLERGY ARE NOT REACTIONARY OR OBSCURANTIST. THERE IS NO DESIRE TO CUT OFF THE HANDS OF THIEVES OR TO DISCRIMINATE AGAINST WOMEN.

IF IRAN SHOULD HAVE AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC, US WILL SEE THAT ITS RELATIONS WITH IRAN WILL BE BETTER THAN THEY WERE UNDER THE SHAH BECAUSE A GOVERNMENT BASED UPON THE TENETS OF ISLAM WILL ACT VIRTUOUSLY AND STICK TO ITS AGREEMENTS WITH OTHER GOVERNMENTS. ------------------009567 111149Z /13 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 2906 SECTION 03 OF 03 TEHRAN 00553 EXDIS

BIO DATA: SHARIAT-MADARI WAS BORN IN TABRIZ, HIS GRANDFATHER HAVING MOVED THE FAMILY TO THAT CITY FROM BORUJERD. HIS FATHER WAS ALSO A CLERGYMAN, A STUDENT OF ISLAMIC JURISPRUDENCE, BUT HE DID NOT RISE TO THE SAME LEVEL OF LEARNING AND RESPECT AS HIS SON. THE AYATOLLAH HAS PUBLISHED FOUR VOLUMES ON ISLAMIC LAW AND PHILOSOPHY. HOWEVER, THE GREAT BULK OF HIS WRITINGS HAVE NEVER BEEN PUBLISHED -- THEY WERE PREPARED FOR USE AS INSTRUCTIONAL MATERIALS IN THE MADDRASEH WHICH HE RUNS IN QOM. SHARIAT-MADARI BEGAN HIS RELIGIOUS STUDIES IN TABRIZ, WHERE HE BECAME A MULLAH, AND THEN SPENT TEN YEARS IN QOM STUDYING UNDER AYATOLLAH ABDUL-KARIM HARVERI.

UPON THE LATTER'S DEATH, SHARIAT-MADARI WENT TO NAJAF WHERE HE STUDIED PHILOSOPHY, LAW, ASTRONOMY, AND OTHER SCIENCES. HE HAS ALSO DEVISED CERTAIN REFORMS OF ISLAMIC LAW OF GOVERNMENT WHICH ARE BASED ON ISLAMIC JURISPRUDENCE (FEQR) AND WHICH HE WILL MAKE AVAILABLE TO A FUTURE ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT. SHARIAT-MADARI GIVES THE IMPRESSION OF A GOOD-HUMORED OLD MAN IN FULL COMMAND OF HIS FACULTIES. HE WAS DESCRIBED AS ILL AND CONDUCTED THE MEETING SEATED ON AN UNROLLED BED MAT. BUT HE WALKED AND SPOKE WELL AND HIS ILLNESS DID NOT APPEAR SERIOUS.

COMMENT: SHARIAT-MADARI WAS CLEARLY PLEASED TO SEE REPRESENTATIVES OF THE USG, AND FREQUENTLY STATED THAT HE WAS SPEAKING FRANKLY AND ON A VERY CONFIDENTIAL BASIS. RESTRICTED NATURE OF THE MEETING (AYATOLLAHS ARE USUALLY SURROUNDED BY FOLLOWERS AND SUPPLICANTS) LENDS SOME WEIGHT TO HIS SENTS. ALTHOUGH NEUTRAL AT BEST ON BAKHTIAR, SHARIAT-MADARI SEEMED EAGER TO COOPERATE IN ALL OTHER AREAS DISCUSSED. HIS RELATIONSHIP WITH KHOMEINI DID NOT ARISE BUT IN THE PAST HE HAS BEEN UNWILLING TO BREAK WITH HIS EXILED COLLEAGUE AND HE IS UNLIKELY TO CARRY HIS COOPERATIVE ATTITUDE TO THAT POINT NOW.

HIS RATHER CASUAL OPTIMISM REGARDING THE SOLUTION OF IRAN'S PROBLEMS ONCE THE SHAH DEPARTS MAY ALSO PROVE UNFOUNDED GIVEN THE DIFFICULT CHALLENGES FACED BY THE ECONOMY AND THE HALLOWED TRADITION OF IRANIAN POLITICIANS OF REFUSING TO COOPERATE IN THE COMMON GOOD. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00559.subject: RECOMMENDATIONS TO DISCONTINUE ASSIGNMENT EPA OFFICER WALLEN

segments.text: THE EMBASSY SEES NO NEED FOR MR.WALLEN'S SERVICES UNDER PRESENT CIRCUMSTANCES AND RECOMMENDS THAT HE BE AUTHORIZED TO RETURN TO THE U.S. AND THE EPA PROGRAM SUSPENDED FOR THE PRESENT. SULLIVAN
DURING AUDIENCE GENERAL HUYSER AND I HAD WITH SHAH JANUARY 11, HE ASKED HOW OUR CONTACT WITH KHOMEINI IN PARIS HAD GONE. WHEN WE TOLD HIM IT HAD BEEN CANCELLED, HE BECAME QUITE AGITATED.
HE SAID, "DO YOU WANT THIS GOVERNMENT TO FAIL? IF NOT, WHY DO YOU NOT DO SOMETHING?" HE WENT ON TO SAY THAT, UNLESS KHOMEINI CALLS OFF STRIKE ACTIONS, BAKHTIAR DOES NOT HAVE A CHANCE.

I THEN TOLD HIM THAT PRESIDENT HAD TELEPHONED GISCARD D'ESTAING AND ASKED FRENCH TO MAKE DEMARCHE ON BEHALF BOTH OUR GOVERNMENTS. HE CLEARLY FOUND THIS UNSATISFACTORY AND ASKED RHETORICALLY HOW WE KNEW WHAT THE FRENCH WOULD SAY. BESIDES, HE ADDED, KHOMEINI WOULD ONLY PAY ATTENTION TO THE UNITED STATES, REPRESENTED BY AN AMERICAN.
I SAID, ON BASIS HIS REQUEST, I WOULD AGAIN URGE MATTER BE RECONSIDERED. HE ASKED WHAT REASON WAS GIVEN FOR CANCELLATION. I SAID NONE HAD BEEN GIVEN TO ME. HE SAID IT MUST BE RECONSIDERED.

COMMENT: UNEXPECTEDLY VEHEMENT NATURE OF SHAH'S OUTBURST CONTRASTS SHARPLY WITH HIS PASSIVE REACTION TO HIS FIRST RECEIPT OF INFORMATION ON THIS PROPOSED DEMARCHE. THIS SUGGESTS HE HAS GIVEN SOME REALISTIC ASSESSMENT TO THE NEED FOR COOPERATION FROM AND WITH KHOMEINI.

ACTION REQUESTED: DESPITE DEFINITIVE NATURE OF REPLY CONTAINED REFTEL AND DESPITE CONSTELLATION OF THOSE WHO AGREED IN DECISION, I EARNESTLY URGE YOU, ON BASIS EXPLICIT RT FROM THE SHAH, TO HAVE THIS DECISION REVERSED. I AM RESPECTFULLY CONVINCED THAT IT IS A WRONG DECISION. GENERAL HUYSER WILL SEND SEPARATE APPEALS TO SECRETARY BROWN AND GENERAL JONES FOR SAME

GENERAL HUYSER AND I SPENT NEARLY TWO HOURS WITH SHAH JANUARY 11. HE OPENED CONVERSATION BY SAYING HE HAD CONSULTED WITH PRIME MINISTER, ENTEZAM AND ALI AMINI, AS WELL AS SPEAKERS OF BOTH HOUSES ABOUT DATE FOR HIS DEPARTURE. HE WISHED TO ADVISE US OF SCENARIO THEY HAD AGREED UPON.

HE SAID BAKHTIAR WAS PRESENTING HIS CABINET TO MAJLES TODAY, JANUARY 11, AND WOULD DO SAME WITH SENATE JANUARY 13. ON JANUARY 12, SHAH WOULD FORM REGENCY COUNCIL AND ANNOUNCE IT ALSO ON JANUARY 13. DEBATE IN PARLIAMENT WOULD TAKE PLACE JANUARY 14 AND JANUARY 16, WITH VOTES HOPEFULLY TO BE TAKEN JANUARY 16. SHAH WOULD DEPART AFTER RPT AFTER VOTE OF CONFIDENCE TAKEN; BUT IN ORDER TO PRESS MEMBERS AGAINST FILIBUSTERS, WOULD LET THEM KNOW THAT IN ANY EVENT, HE WOULD DEPART NO LATER THAN JANUARY 17.

HE SAID REGENCY COUNCIL HE WOULD NAME WOULD BE COMPOSED OF BAKHTAIR, ARDALAN, ENTEZAM, SADIQI, ALI AMINI, GENERAL GHARABAGHI, THE SPEAKERS OF BOTH HOUSES, AND "A RELIGIOUS PERSON." HE SAID HE THOUGHT ALL THESE WOULD AGREE TO SERVE EXCEPT POSSIBLY AMINI, WHO DOES NOT RPT NOT WANT TWO SPEAKERS, AND MIGHT USE THEIR PRESENCE AS EXCUSE TO DECLINE. HE SAID HE HAD TO NAME THE TWO SPEAKERS BECAUSE BAKHTIAR WANTED THEM.

SHAH'S FIRM PLAN IS TO DEPART NO LATER THAN AFTERNOON OF JANUARY 17 AND TO HAVE HIS DEPARTURE ANNOUNCED AFTER HE HAS GONE. HE WILL FLY TO EITHER SPAINABAT, FOR REFUEL, THEN TO A SECLUDED U.S. BASE ON EAST COAST FOR SECOND REFUEL, AND ON TO EL TORO. GENERAL HUYSER WILL WORK OUT FLIGHT PLAN WITH GENERAL RABII. (IT APPEARS THAT SHAH HAS CANCELLED ANY IDEAS OF ATTEMPTING TO COME TO WASHINGTON TO SEE PRESIDENT AND WILL HEAD STRAIGHT FOR ANNENBERG ESTATE. THIS CHANGE WILL AVERT A PROBLEM FOR PRESIDENT WHICH COULD HAVE BEEN OF MAJOR PROPORTIONS.)

WHEN SHAH HAD FINISHED, I TOLD HIM MY INSTRUCTIONS WERE TO ADVISE HIM TO LEAVE "PROMPTLY." THERE FOLLOWED SOME DISCUSSION ABOUT WHETHER JANUARY 17 WAS "PROMPT" ENOUGH. WE DISCUSSED UNRULINESS RESULTING FROM ELECTRICITY CUTS, FUEL AND FOOD SHORTAGES. WE DISCUSSED OTHER TENSIONS AT WORK AND FINALLY LEFT IT THAT I WOULD CONSULT WASHINGTON ON SUBJECT. IF WASHINGTON FEELS HE SHOULD LEAVE SOONER, I WOULD SEE HIM JANUARY 12 AND GIVE HIM EXPLICIT RPT EXPLICIT REASONS FOR THIS FEELING. IF WASHINGTON FEELS JANUARY 17 IS "PROMPT" ENOUGH, I WILL TELEPHONE HIS AIDE MORNING JANUARY 12 TO SAY WASHINGTON ACCEPTS HIS SCHEDULE.

ACTION REQUESTED: - (A) PLEASE PROVIDE ME NO LATER THAN 0900 TEHRAN TIME JANUARY 12 AGREED WASHINGTON REACTION TO ISSUES POSED IN PARAGRAPH 5. - (B) PLEASE ALERT SECURITY FORCES AS NECESSARY FOR ARRANGEMENTS TO HANDLE MOVEMENTS OF SHAH AS INDICATED ABOVE. HE INDICATES EMPRESS AND TWO YOUNGEST CHILDREN WILL BE ABOARD HIS AIRCRAFT. (THE OTHER AIRCRAFT TO LUBBOCK, TEXAS, WILL CARRY SOME "POSSESSIONS" TO YORE# WITH CROWN PRINCE.) 1979TEHRAN00562.subject: BAKHTIAR PRESENTS HIS CABINET; SHAFAQAT IS DEFENSE MINISTER

segments.text: SUMMARY: PRIME MINISTER BAKHTIAR PRESENTED HIS CABINET TO MAJLES MORNING JAN 11. JAFFAR SHAFAQAT, FORMER DEPUTY SUPREME COMMANDER AND MOST RECENTLY GOVERNOR OF EAST AZARBIJAN PROVINCE WAS NAMED DEFENSE MINISTER. BAKHTIAR'S PROGRAM WAS SIMILAR TO PREVIOUS INDICATIONS. MAJLES WILL RECONVENE JAN 14 FOR BEGINNING OF DEBATE. SENATE PRESENTATION JAN 13. VOTE PROBABLY WILL COME JAN 16 OR 17. END SUMMARY.

PRIME MINISTER SHAHPOUR BAKHTIAR PRESENTED HIS CABINET TO PARLIAMERNING JAN 11 AND GAVE SHORT OUTLINE OF HIS GOVERNMENT'S PROGRAM. CABINET CHOICES WERE AS LISTED REF A, EXCEPT FOR REPLACEMENT OF JAM BY LT.GEN. JAAFAR SHAFAQAT FOR DEFENSE MINISTER. SHAFAQAT HAS BEEN GOVERNOR OF EAST AZARBAIJAN PROVINCE SINCE SHORTLY FOLLOWING TABRIZ RIOTS IN FEB 1978 (SEE REF B FOR BIO DATA).

REPLACEMENT FOR JAM WAS BIGGEST QUESTION MARK IN BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT, AND SHAFAQAT WAS REPORTEDLY CANDIDATE OF THE ACTIVE MILITARY. THOUGH PRINCIPAL OPPOSITIONIST CONTACTS UNAVAILABLE FOR COMMENT, IT IS KNOWN THAT OTHERS WERE THEIR PREFERRED CANDIDATES. SHAFAQAT IS BELIEVED BY EMBASSY TO BE A HARD-LINER ON QUESTION OF MAINTAINING CIVIL ORDER; THUS HIS NOMINATION COULD BE SEEN IN SOME QUARTERS AS CONFIRMATION OF RUMORS THAT BAKHTIAR IS UNDER SHAH'S AND MILITARY CONTROL. CONSUL TABRIZ, HOWEVER, REPORTS SHAFAQAT IS WELL RESPECTED AND WALKS THE STREETS OF TABRIZ WITHOUT LARGE ARMED RETINUE. THIS MAY BE BECAUSE HE IS A NATIVE TABRIZI WHO SPEAKS THE LOCAL LANGUAGE.
WE SHALL HAVE TO WITHHOLD JUDGEMENT FOR THE MOMENT.

BAKHTIAR GAVE BRIEF OUTLINE OF HIS PROGRAM, WHICH WAS SIMILAR TO THAT REPORTED PREVIOUSLY: CORRUPT WILL BE BROUGHT TO TRIAL AS SPEEDILY AS POSSIBLE, AND SPECIAL COURTS WILL BE USED IF JUDICIARY CANNOT MOVE RAPIDLY ENOUGH. SAVAK WILL BE ABOLISHED AND A "VERY SMALL" INTELLIGENCE UNIT WILL BE SET UP IN PRIME MINISTER'S OFFICE. SECURITY OF COUNTRY WILL BE MAINTAINED IN FACE OF SUBVERSIVE THREAT, BUT GOOD RELATIONS WILL BE MAINTAINED WITH ALL COUNTRIES. BETTER RELATIONS WILL BE SOUGHT WITH ARABS. ALL POLITICAL PRISONERS WILL BE RELEASED BUT NOT HARDENED CRIMINALS.

MINISTRY OF SCIENCE AND HIGHER EDUCATION WILL BE ABOLISHED AND SMALL LIAISON OFFICE WILL BE ESTABLISHED IN PRIME MINISTER'S OFFICE TO WORK WITH UNIVERSITY CHANCELLORS, WHO WILL HAVE VIRTUAL AUTONOMY. RELIGIOUS LEADERS WILL BESPECTED AND CONSULTED ON ALL IMPORTANT DECISIONS.

IN SOMEWHAT EMOTIONAL FINALE, BAKHTIAR PLEADED FOR NATION TO GIVE HIS GOVERNMENT REASONABLE TIME TO SHOW PROGRESS. HE SAID HE HAD BEEN OUT OF POLITICS FOR 25 YEARS, HAD BEEN ARRESTED AND IN PRISON, AND THUS KNEW WHAT THE PEOPLE WANTED. HE WAS READY TO GIVE IT TO THEM BUT NEEDED A LITTLE TIME.

MAJLES WILL RECONVENE SUNDAY, JAN 14 FOR BEGINNING OF DEBATE; MANY PARLIAMENTARIANS WILL STAND IN LINE AND SLEEP IN OVER WEEKEND TO PRESERVE THEIR PLACE ON LIST TO SPEAK. WE HAVE LEARNED, HOWEVER, THAT SENTIMENT IS GROWING AMONG LEGISLATORS TO INVOKE CLOTURE AFTER TEN SPEAKERS ON EACH SIDE. THIS COULD BRING VOTE AS EARLY AS EVENING JAN 14. OTHERWISE PROCESS COULD GO ON TO JAN 16 OR 17.

INITIAL COMMENT: APPOINTMENT OF SAFAQAT MEANS CABINET WILL PROBABLY BE APPROVED, BUT STREET SITUATION IS LIKELY TO BECOME MORE LIVELY UNLESS BAKHTIAR HAS GOTTEN AT LEAST TACIT NATIONAL FRONT AND LIBERATION MOVEMENT APPROVAL FOR SHAFAQAT TO TAKE OFFICE. OPPOSITIONISTS MIGHT BE WILLING TO REMAIN SILENT IF THEY BELIEVED SHAFAQAT APPOINTMENT WAS NECESSARY TO PREVENT MILITARY COUP. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00563.subject: KHOMEINI STATEMENT FOLLOWING STATEMENT BY AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI APPEARED IN IRANIAN PRESS OF JANUARY 11

segments.text: FOLLOWING STATEMENT BY AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI APPEARED IN IRANIAN PRESS OF JANUARY 11: - "GREETINGS TO THE ESTEEMED PEOPLE OF IRAN. REPORTS COMING FROM IRAN INDICATE THAT A DANGEROUS PLOT IS IN THE OFFING. THEY TELL OF UNSIGNED STATEMENTS PUT OUT IN TEHRAN AND PROVINCIAL CITIES AND TOWNS THREATENING VARIOUS PEOPLE TO DEATH FOR ALLEGEDLY BEING MEMBERS OF THE SAVAK OR AGENTS OF THE SHAH. HOUSES HAVE BEEN SET ON FIRE AND WOMEN AND CHILDREN HAVE BEEN INSULTED UNDER THE SAME PRETEXES. - "REPORTS FROM IRAN TELL OF ACTIONS THAT ARE CONTRARY TO THE TEACHINGS OF ISLAM AND TO THE PRINCIPLE OF FAIRNESS AND FAIRPLAY.

THESE ARE INDICATIONS THAT CERTAIN DIRTY HANDS ARE AT WORK IN ORDER TO SMEAR OUR SACRED ISLAMIC MOVEMENT BY CREATING CHAOS AND TERROR IN THE SOCIETY AND, GOD FORBID, DEFEAT OUR STRUGGLE. - "THE ESTEEMED PEOPLE OF IRAN SHOULD KNOW THAT THE SACRED RELIGION OF ISLAM CONSIDERS THE LIVES AND THE PROPERTY OF PEOPLE AS SACRED AND THE ATTACK ON THEM AS THE GREATEST SIN. PEOPLE WHO COMMIT SUCH CRIMES AND CREATE TERROR AND PANIC AMONG THE PUBLIC SEEM TO BELONG TO PERVERTED GROUPS WHO AIM TO EITHER PROTECT THE POSITION OF THE SHAH OR TO PREPARE THE COUNTRY FOR THE MILITARY COUP D'ETAT BY CREATING CHAOS AND DISORDER.

THE MOSLEM PEOPLE OF IRAN SHOULD NEVER RESORT TO SUCH INHUMAN METHODS AND ARE RELIGIOUSLY BOUND NOT TO HEE UNSIGNED STATEMENTS AND PROCLAMATIONS ENCOURAGING PEOPLE TO MURDER AND PLUNDER AND THEY SHOULD TRY TO PREVENT PEOPLE WHO MIGHT WANT TO SET FIRE ON HOMES AND TRY TO PREVENT THE CARRYING OUT OF THE PLOT THAT SEEMINGLY IS IN THE OFFING. - "NOBLE PEOPLE OF TEHRAN, PROVINCES AND VILLAGES| CONTINUE WITH YOUR MARCHES, DEMONSTRATIONS AND STRIKES UNTIL THE PLOT HAS BEEN NEUTRALIZED BY THE LEAVING OF THE SHAH. - "IT IS THE DUTY OF COUNTRY'S RELIGIOUS LEADERS TO ENLIGHTEN THE PEOPLE AND MAKE THEM AWRE OF THEIR RELIGIOUS DUTIES THAT PEOPLE ACCUSED OF CRIMINAL ACTS SHOULD BE PUNISHED ONLY AFTER THEIR GUILTS HAVE BEEN PROVED IN THE COURTS OF JUSTICE AND NOT BY LYNCH MOBS.
WE PRAY TO GOD TO PROTECT US FROM TRAITOR ELEMENTS."

1979TEHRAN00566.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT, JAN 11, 1979 SUMMARY: SCATTERED DEMONSTRATIONS. SERIOUS POWER OUTAGE IN TEHRAN. MAJLIS MEETING TO APPROVE BAKHTIAR GOV

segments.text: SUMMARY: SCATTERED DEMONSTRATIONS. SERIOUS POWER OUTAGE IN TEHRAN. MAJLIS MEETING TO APPROVE BAKHTIAR GOVT. "PEOPLE" TAKE CHARGE OF PUBLIC ORDER IN SEVERAL TOWNS. KHOMEINI WARNS AGAINST VIOLENCE. LITTLE CHANGE IN OIL SECTOR. END SUMMARY

SCATTERED DEMONSTRATIONS TOOK PLACE ACROSS IRAN YESTERDAY BUT REMAINED PEACEFUL. WE HAVE NO REPORTS OF VIOLENT CLASHES. TEHRAN IS QUIET AGAIN TODAY. CONSULATE SHIRAZ REPORTS A DEMONSTRATION OF SEVERAL THOUSAND APPROACHED CONSULATE. STAFF EVACUATED AS CROWD APPROACHED, BUT MARCHERS PASSED BY WITHOUT INCIDENT EXCEPT FOEW STONES WHICH DID NO DAMAGE. CONSULAR STAFF RETURNED TO BUILDING BUT DECIDED TO CLOSE FOR THE AFTERNOON. IRANIAN POLICE REMAINED POSTED DURING THE DEMONSTRATION AND SAID CROWD DID NOT TRY TO ENTER.

BAKHTIAR TOOK HIS CABINET AND PROGRAM TO MAJLIS TODAY. PRESS REPORTS A BAKHTIAR INTERVIEW IN WHICH HE DECLARED SHAH WOULD LEAVE "IN THE COMING DAYS" AND THAT THIS WAS A CONDITION OF HIS ACCEPTING THE PREMIERSHIP. BAKHTIAR ALSO CRITICIZED GENERALS WHO HINT AT MILITARY COUP AND SAID A COUP WOULD BE THE WORST THING FOR IRAN. HIS REMARKS WERE APPARENTLY AIMED AT GENERAL KHOSROWDAD, WHO IS QUOTED BY FRENCH REPORTER AS SAYING BAKHTIAR WOULD BE "DIGGING HIS OWN GRAVE" IF THE SHAH DEPARTED. KHOSROWDAD LATER DENIED MAKING THE STATEMENT. MEANWHILE PRESS REPORTS THE GENERAL HAS BEEN TRANSFERRED TO KERMAN, BUT THAT IS NOT CONFIRMED.

PRESS CARRIED IMPORTANT STATEMENT FROM KHOMEINI REGARDING MOB VIOLENCE. (THIS WAS APPARENTLY IN RESPONSE TO MODERATE IRANIANS WHO WENT TO PLEAD WITH HIM IN PARIS.) KHOMEINI URGED FOLLOWERS NOT TO ATTACK LIVES OR PROPERTY, EVEN IF SOMEONE CLAIMS THESE PEOPLE ARE AGENTS OF SAVAK AND THE SHAH. "THE SACRED RELIGION OF ISLAM CONSIDERS THE LIVES AND THE PROPERTY OF PEOPLE AS SACRED AND THE ATTACK ON THEM AS THE GREATEST SIN.

PEOPLE WHO COMMIT SUCH CRIMES AND CREATE TERROR AND PANIC AMONG THE PUBLIC APPEAR TO BELONG THE PERVERTED GROUPS WHO AIM EITHER TO PROTECT THE POSITION OF THE SHAH OR TO PREPARE THE COUNTRY FOR THE MILITARY COUP." HE CALLED FOR COURTS OF JUSTICE, NOT LYNCH MOBS.

STRIKES AND SHORTAGES CONTINUE. THE SHARIAT-MADARI CAMP SAYS BAZAARS WILL OPEN IMMEDIATELY ONCE SHAH HAS ANNOUNCED HIS DEPARTURE -- OR WHEN HE ACTUALLY DEPARTS, IF HE CHOOSES NOT TO ANNOUNCE IN ADVANCE. TEHRAN DWELLERS NOW FACE SERIOUS ELECTRICAL POWER PROBLEM IN ADDITION TO THE NIGHTLY CUTO THROUGH COMBINATION OF STRIKEINSPIRED WORKERS NEGLIGENCE AND WEATHER, THE 400 MEGAWATT TRANSMISSION LINE FROM HYDROELECTRIC PLANT AT REZA SHAH KEBIR DAM IS DOWN. LINE SUPPLIES ABOUT 80 PERCENT OF TEHRAN'S NEEDS UNDER PRESENT CONDITIONS (WITH MOST INDUSTRY SHUT DOWN). UTILITY EXECUTIVES TELL US THEY HOPE TO HAVE IT REPAIRED WITHIN 48 HOURS.

OTHER 20 PERCENT OF TEHRAN'S ELECTRICITY IS SUPPLIED BY FOSSIL FUEL POWER PLANTS WHICH ARE NOW LARGELY SHUT DOWN. EXECUTIVES HOPE FOR FUEL RESUPPLY WITHIN NEXT SEVERAL DAYS, PREDICATED UPON A CONTINUED RETURN TO OPERATION OF THE REY REFINERY.

AIR FORCE COMMANDER GENERAL RABII HAS ANNOUNCED THAT ------------------014225 111502Z /43 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 2917 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY BONN AMCONSUL DHAHRAN IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY DOHA AMCONSUL FRANKFURT AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS USLO PEKING USLO RIYADH IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY TOKYO USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 00566 AIRPORTS AND AIRSPACE IN IRAN WILL BE OPEN ONLY DURING DAYLIGHT HOURS.

BAKHTIAR'S CABINET WILL INCLUDE GOVERNOR-GENERAL SHAFAQAT OF EAST AZERBAIJAN AS MINISTER OF WAR. SOME OBSERVERS CONSIDER HIM A HARDLINER, BUT CONSUL TABRIZ REPORTS HE IS WELL RESPECTED, AS EVIDENCED BY THE FACT THAT HE STROLLS THROUGH STREETS OF TABRIZ WITHOUT LARGE ARMED RETINUE. OPPOSITION REACTION TO HIS APPOINTMENT NOT YET KNOWN.

SEVERAL MAJOR CITIES SHOW VIRTUAL REPLACEMENT OF REGULAR SECURITY FORCES BY "THE PEOPLES" SECURITY FORCE, PRESS REPORTS THAT IN KERMANSHAH, ARDEBIL, AND ILAM, POPULAR FORCES ARE MAINTAINING LAW AND ORDER. CONSULATE SHIRAZ REPORTS THESE NEW "POLICEMEN" ARE DIRECTING TRAFFIC. CONSULATE ISFAHANRE MARTIAL LAW IS NOMINALLY IN FORCE, REPORTS TROOPS AND POLICE HAVE LEFT THE STREETS, AND THE PEOPLES FORCES, WEARING SOME KIND OF ARMBAND AND INSIGNIA, ARE DIRECTING TRAFFIC AND OTHERWISE MAINTAINING ORDER.

THE SITUATION IN THE OIL SECTOR IS LITTLE CHANGED. PRODUCTION MAY HAVE INCREASED TO 340,000 B/D BUT WE ARE UNABLE TO CONFIRM. RE-COMMISSIONING OF ONE TRAIN OF THE REY REFINERY IS GOING WELL AND SOME PRODUCTS SHOULD BE AVAILABLE FOR DISTRIBUTION JAN 12.

CONTRARY TO OIL SECTOR REPORT OF JAN 10, THE OTHER TRAIN OF THE REY REFINERY WILL NOT BE RE-COMMISSIONED IN THE NEXT 3-10 DAYS. WE HAVE LEARNED FROM THE FLUOR ENGINEER IN CHARGE OF MAJOR WORKS NOW UNDERWAY AT THE REFINERY THAT CRITICAL PARTS ARE TIED UP IN CUSTOMS AND THAT EVEN AFTER THE PARTS ARE RELEASED IT WILL BE ANOTHER 45 DAYS MINIMUM BEFORE THE WORK IS COMPLETED. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00573.subject: MEETING WITH HEAD OF TEACHERS UNION

segments.text: DURING MEETING WITH HEAD OF IRAN'S TEACHER'S UNION MOHAMMAD DERAKHSHESH JAN 9, POL COUNSELOR REFERRED TO THE PROBABILITY THAT THE SHAH WOULD BE LEAVING THE COUNTRY IN THE NEXT FEW DAYS AND THE NEED FOR ALL PEOPLE OF GOOD WILL TO DO WHAT THEY CAN TO KEEP ANY PUBLIC REACTION RELATIVELY PEACEFUL. IN PARTICULAR, HE STRESSED TO DERAKHSHESH THE NEED TO ORGANIZE HIS FOLLOWERS IN ADVANCE SO THAT THEY THEMSELVES WILL DESIST FROM PROVOKING THE ARMY AND HELP PREVENT OTHERS FROM DOING SO TOO.
HE NOTED THE DEPARTURE MIGHT TAKE SOME MEMBERS OF THE ARMED FORCES BY SURPRISE AND IN ANY CASE THEY WERE LIKELY TO BE VERY NERVOUS FROM HEARING THESE NEWS, THUS EASILY PROVOKED.

DERAKHSHESH IMMEDIATELY SEIZED THESE POINTS AND AGREED WITH THEM. HE WAS ABOUT TO HAVE A MEETING IN HIS HOUSE WITH SOME COLLEAGUES AND EXPECTED ANOTHER MEETING OF 50 OR 60 TEACHERS UNION ACTIVISTSON JAN 10 OR 11. HE WOULD DO THE NECESSARY. HE AGREED THE WORD SHOULD BE GOTTEN TO SCHOOL CHILDREN AS WELL AS SCHOOL TEACHERS.

DERAKHSHESH THEN REPEATED THE ATTACK ON BAKHTIAR GOVT THAT HE HAD GIVEN TELEPHONICALLY TO POL COUNSELOR A COUPLE OF DAYS BEFORE. A GOVT SHOULD BE ABLE EITHER TO APPEAL TO THE PEOPLE OR TO CONTROL THEM. BAKHTIAR COULD DO NEITHER. A PRIME MINISTER SHOULD BE ABLE TO FACE THE NATION AND GO AMONG HIS PEOPLE AND TALK TO THEM. INSTEAD, BAKHTIAR IS PROTECTED BY LARGE NS OF ARMY AND HAS NO POPULAR FOLLOWING. HIS MINISTERS ARE NON-ENTITIES. HE REPEATED THE CHARGE THAT THE MINISTER OF EDUCATION USED TO WORK FOR SAVAK.

HE SAID THE MINISTER HAD TRIED TO CALL HIM SEVERAL TIMES, CALLS WHICH DERAKHSHESH AVOIDED UNTIL ONE TIME HE ANSWERED THE PHONE HIMSELF AND COULD NOT AVOID TALKING TO THE MINISTER. THE MINISTER ASKED DERAKHSHESH'S "PERMISSION" TO JOIN THE GOVT, BUT DERAKHSHESH UNDERSTOOD THAT WAS PERSIAN "TAAROF" AND MINISTER WOULD JOIN THE GOVT IN ANY CASE. HE IS NOT SOMEONE WHO CAN HAVE ANY EFFECT ON THE EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS OF THE NATION.

REST OF CONVERSATION RAN ALONG FAMILIAR LINES, WITH POL COUNSELOR EMPHASIZING THE NEED FOR MODERATES OF GOOD WILL TO STICK TO LEGAL CONSTITUTIONAL FORMS AND NOT LET OLD JEALOUSIES OR RIVALRIES IMPEDE THEIR ACTIVITY IN THE FUTURE. IN THE COURSE OF CONVERSATION, DERAKHSHESH STATED BATTLE BETWEEN ARMY AND DEMONSTRATORS IN MASHAD RECENTLY HAD TAKEN THE LIVES OF 11 TEACHERS AND 37 SCHOOL CHILDREN. TEACHERS HAD ALSO BEEN KILLED IN TEHRAN AND OTHER TOWNS. SOME 4,000 TEACHERS HAD BEEN PRESENT AT THE LARGE CELEBRATION IN TEHRAN'S CEMETERY DAY BEFORE. THEY REPORTED CONSIDERABLE SCUFFLING AMONG GROUPS THERE FOR A CHANCE TO ADDRESS THE CROWD OVER THE MICROPHONES.

FINALLY, DERAKHSHESH REPEATED HIS FEARS THAT THE COMMUNISTS ARE GAINING. HE CHARACTERIZED THE SMALL NEWSPAPER "NAVIID" AS COMMUNIST. IT HAD CARRIED AN ARTICLE ATTACKING DERAKHSHESH THE WEEK BEFORE. DERAKHSHESH HOPED BAKHTIAR GOVT WOULD NOT TURN AGAINST FREEDOM OF SPEECH AND PUBLICATION, ALLOWING HIM AND HIS PEOPLE TO CONTINUE TO PUBLISH THEIR OWN WEEKLY.
COMMENT: WHILE NOT ONE OF THE TOP OPPOSITIONISTS, DERAKHSHESH HAS BUILT-IN LEVERAGE THROUGH THE TEACHER'S UNION AND THE SCHOOL CHILDREN ALLIED WITH IT. HE IS AN ELEMENT IN THE TOTAL PICTURE. SULLIVAN
