1979TEHRAN00585.subject: SHAH SUPPORTERS READY TO SWITCH SIDES

segments.text: POL COUNSELOR WAS VISITED JAN 11 BY MR. ALI SHAPOURIAN AND DR. ANOUSHIRAVAN AFRASIABI. SHAPOURIAN SERVED SOME YEARS AGO AS IRANIAN EMBASSY PRESS COUNSELOR IN WASHINGTON, SUBSEQUENTLY IN LONDON,MOST RECENTLY AS UNDERSECY IN MINISTRY OF INFORMATION AND UP TO THREE MONTHS AGO AS PUBLIC RELATIONS MAN FOR PRINCESS ASHRAF. HE IS AT PRESENT MANAGING DIRECTOR OF "NOMARZ" PUBLICATIONS, A PUBLISHING HOUSE RUN BY FRANKLIN PUBLISHING HOUSE OF NEW YORK.

AFRASIABI IS A MEDICAL DOCTOR TRAINED IN TEHRAN AND ENGLAND, WHO RUNS A MATERNITY HOSPITAL IN DOWNTOWN TEHRAN, SERVED AS COLONEL IN THE ARMY UNTIL 5 YEARS AGO, WAS A MEMBER OF ALAM'S MARDOM PARTY, WROTE FOR RASTAKHIZ NEWSPAPER UNTIL HE HAD A FALLING OUT WITH HOVEYDA, AND HAS WRITTEN FOR ETELAAT AND KAYHAN SINCE. THESE MEN ARE OBVIOUSLY NOT OPPOSITIONISTS.

AFTER ASKING FOR AND GETTING A BRIEF REVIEW OF THE SITUATION AS USG SEES IT, SHAPOURIAN SAID THE SILENT MAJORITY OF THE IRANIAN PEOPLE SUPPORTS THE SHAH AND IS AFRAID OF HIS LEAVING. DWELLING ON THE IRRESPONSIBILITY OF THE PRESS AT PRESENT IN THE COUNTRY, HE ADDED THAT HE HAD OBTAINED GEN. AZHARI'S AGREEMENT A FEW WEEKS AGO TO ESTABLISH A NEW NEWSPAPER WHICH WOULD "REPORT ONLY THE FACTS" AND EVEN ATTACK AZHARI GOVT FROM TIME TO TIME. HOWEVER, THE GOVT FUNDS NEEDED TO SET THIS UP HAD NEVER COME THROUGH.

AFRASIABI THEN GAVE HIS OPINION THAT ONE OF TWO THINGS MUST BE DONE IMMEDIATELY. THE FIRST WOULD BE THAT THE SHAH REMAIN AND PRESIDE OVER A VERY HARD CRACKDOWN BY THE MILITARY WHICH MUST SUCCEED WITHIN 48 HOURS. THIS SHOULD BE ORGANIZED BY A CIVILIAN"THINK TANK" WHICH GIVES THE MILITARY THEIR INSTRUCTIONS AND CONTINUES TO RUN THE GOVT. WHOLE THING WILL BE BLOODY AND TIME MAY BE PAST FOR IT, BUT IT IS AN OPTION WORTH CONSIDERING.

OTHER OPTION, ACCORDING TO AFRASIABI, WOULD BE THAT USG RECOGNIZE CAUSE OF THE SHAH AS LOST AND MOVE QUICKLY TO PUT TOGETHER A COALITION OF ARMY, NATIONAL FRONT, RELIGIOUS FORCES AND ALL OTHERS EXCEPT THE COMMUNISTS SO AS TO ESTABLISH A VIABLE GOVT AND PREVENT A COMMUNIST TAKEOVER. TIME IS RUNNING SHORT FOR THIS OPTION TOO, HE FELT. USG SHOULD ACT WITHOUT HESITATION AS HESITATION WILL ONLY ENCOURAGE THE COMMUNISTS. TIME IS WORKING AGAINST A SOLUTION.

POL COUNSELOR LIMITED HIS COMMENTS TO AGREEING THAT SITUATION IS CRITICAL, AFRASIABI ANALYSIS IS COGENT BUT ROLE OF USG MUST BE UNDERSTOOD AS THAT OF AN OUTSIDER WHO IS NOT INTERVENING IN IRANIAN AFFAIRS. WE HAVE BEEN SUPPORTING A CONSTITUTIONAL GOVT AS REPRESENTED BY THE SHAH, AND WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT CONSTITUTIONAL PROCESSES IN IRAN FOLLOWING ANY DECISIONS THE SHAH CHOOSES TO TAKE ABOUT THE FUTURE.

COMMENT: THIS WAS ANOTHER EXAMPLE OF SHAH LOYALISTS COMING TO SNIFF THE AIR SO AS TO GUIDE THEMSELVES ACCORDINGLY. THEY GENERALLY AGREED WITH OUR POINT THAT IT IS IMPORTANT FOR PEOPLE LIKE THEMSELVES TO ORGANIZE MORE WIDELY SO AS TO PLAY A MORE EFFECTIVE ROLE AS PART OF ANY MODERATE BLOC OF IRANIAN OPINION WHICH MIGHT AWAKEN ITSELF AND WORK AGAINST THE POLARIZATION OF IRANIAN POLITICS BETWEEN EXTREMES. HOWEVER, THEY HAVE A LONG WAY TO GO. SULLIVAN

TRUST DEPARTMENT WILL UNDERSTAND OUR INABILITY TO FULFILL REFTEL INSTRUCTIONS ON COMMON FUND. APPROPRIATE MEAF OFFICIALS HAVE NOT BEEN AVAILABLE SINCE RECEIPT OF REFTEL. HAD THEY BEEN, WE SINCERELY DOUBT IF ANY GOI REPRESENTATION IS AT COLOMBO. WE WILL TRANSMIT DEPARTMENT'S VIEWS TO MEAF UNDERSECRETARY FOR INTERNATIONAL AFFAIRS BIJAN NOZARI WHEN CONDITIONS PERMIT. SULLIVAN

NOW THAT THE SHAH HAS DECIDED TO LEAVE IRAN, WE MUST HAVE A CLEAR VIEW OF THE RELATIONSHIP OF THAT FACT TO U.S. NATIONAL INTERESTS IN THIS COUNTRY. WE MUST REALIZE THAT HE WILL NO LONGER COMMAND ANY POWER IN THIS COUNTRY, EITHER THROUGH THE PROXY OF THE REGENCS COUNCIL OR THE SHADOW OF HIS ROLE AS COMMANDER-IN-CHIEF OF THE ARMED FORCES. WE MUST ACCEPT THE FACT THAT HE WILL PROBABLY NEVER BE ABLE TO RETURN TO THIS COUNTRY IN ANY CAPACITY EVEN IF, BY EXTRAORDINARY LUCK, ARRANGEMENTS CAN BE MADE TO PRESERVE THE FICTION OF THE MONARCHICAL INSTITUTION FOR SOME PERIOD OF TIME.

THE REAL INSTITUTIONS OF POWER IN IRAN ARE NOW THE SHI'A RELIGION, SYMBOLIZED BY AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, THE ARMED FORCES (IF THEIR INTEGRITY CAN BE PRESERVED), AND LEFTIST STUDENT GROUPS, WHO WILL PROBABLY INEVITABLY BE MOBILIZED BY THE TUDEH PARTY. (THE GOVERNMENT AND THE BUREAUCRACY, LIKE THE OIL COMPANY, ARE ESSENTIALLY SERVICE ORGANIZATIONS WITHOUT POLITICAL WEIGHT, ALTHOUGH BAKHTIAR MAY BE ABLE TO ACCRUE SOME STRENGTH, IF HE REMAINS IN OFFICE.) OUR NATIONAL INTERESTS DEMAND THAT WE ATTEMPT TO STRUCTURE A MODUS VIVENDI BETWEEN THE MILITARY AND THE RELIGIOUS, IN ORDER TO PRE-EMPT THE TUDEH. WE HAVE TO MOVE RAPIDLY IN SUCH AN EFFORT, AND AVOID FRICTION BETWEEN THESE TWO INSTITUTIONS.

IT IS HIGHLY IMPORTANT THAT WE RECOGNIZE THE FACT THAT OUR ASSOCIATION WITH THE SHAH IS AN ENORMOUS LIABILITY IN DEALING WITH THE RELIGIOUS. IT IS ALSO IMPORTANT TO RECOGNIZE THAT THE MILITARY HAVE BECOME AMBIGUOUS ABOUT THE SHAH. WHILE SENIOR OFFICERS CONTINUE TO PROFESS LOYALTY TO HIS SHADOW, THE RANK AND FILE HAVE COME TO LOOK AT THEIR OWN SITUATION VERY LARGELY IN TERMS OF SELF-PREYERVATION. THEREFORE, IF WE ARE TO ATTEMPT TO BROKER SOME ARRANGEMENT BETWEEN THE MILITARY AND THE RELIGIOUS, WE HAVE TO DEVELOP A VERY CAREFULLY CONSTRUED POSTURE WITH RESPECT TO THE SHAH.

THE SHAH IS GOING TO THE UNITED STATES AND MAY WISH TO MEET WITH THE PRESIDENT. IT IS PROBABLY IMPOSSIBLE TO REJECT SUCH A MEETING, AND THEREFORE WE MUST ASSUME IT WILL TAKE PLACE AND THAT SOME PUBLIC IMAGE WILL EMERGE FROM IT. IN MY JUDGMENT, IT WOULD BE DISASTROUS IF THE IMAGE THAT SHOULD EMERGE WOULD CONVEY THE IDEA THAT WE CONTINUE TO "SUPPORT" THE SHAH AND THAT WE EXPECT TO ASSIST HIM SOMEHOW TO RETURN TO POWER IN IRAN. DESPITE THE FACT THAT SUCH A STATEMENT WOULD, IN THE REAL WORLD, BE PURELY COSMETIC, IRANIANS WOULD SEE INTIMATIONS OF 1953 ALL OVER AGAIN.

THIS WOULD MEAN THAT THE RELIGIOUS WOULD BACK AWAY FROM ANY ACCOMMODATION WITH THE MILITARY; WHILE THE MILITARY, IN THEIR TURN, MIGHT BE PERSUADED TO CLING TO AN UNREALISTIC ILLUSION AND WOULD REFUSE TO FACE REALITIES. OUR POSTURE WOULD PREDICTABLY FRUSTRATE THE REALIZATION OF OUR NATIONAL INTERESTS, AND WOULD KEEP THESE TWO INSTITUTIONS IN CONFRONTATION.

MOREOVER, SUCH AN IMAGE WOULD BE HIGHLY IRRESPONSIBLE IN CONNECTION WITH THE 15,000 AMERICANS IN THIS COUNTRY, WHOSE LIVES WOULD BE PUT IN JEOPARDY BECAUSE THEY WOULD BE SEEN AS THE CADRE WHO ARE SOMEHOW OR OTHER GOING TO LAY THE GROUNDWORK FOR THE RETURN OF THE SHAH. THEREFORE, IDEALLY, WE SHOULD AVOID ANY PUBLIC STATEMENTS, ANY PHOTOS OF PRESIDENT AND SHAH TOGETHER, AND ANY COMMENTARY ON FUTURE WE FORESEE FOR SHAH.

THEREFORE, IF AND WHEN THE SHAH SEES THE PRESIDENT, I BELIEVE IT IS VERY IMPORTANT THAT THE PRESIDENT DISCUSS WITH HIM FRANKLY AND CANDIDLY OUR FEELING THAT THE INTEGRITY OF IRAN AND ITS PRESERVATION FROM THE COMMUNISTS DEMAND A RAPID RECONCILIATION BETWEEN THE MILITARY AND THE RELIGIOUS, WHO SHARE A COMMON ANTIPATHY TOWARDS COMMUNISM. IT SHOULD THEN BE MADE CLEAR TO HIM THAT WE MUST REFRAIN FROM ANY ENDORSING STATEMENTS WHICH WOULD INHIBIT SUCH A RECONCILIATION. IN FACT, WE SHOULD SOLICIT HIS QUIET ASSISTANCE IN URGING THE MILITARY TO MAKE SUCH AN ACCOMMODATION.

WE MUST FURTHER REALIZE THAT BEYOND THIS RATHER SIMPLISTIC OBJECTIVE WE CAN NOT RPT NOT MANIPULATE THE POLITICAL SCENE HERE IN TERMS OF SPECIFIC PERSONALITIES OR POLICIES. FOR THE SHORT AND MEDIUM TERM, OUR GOAL ------------------029175 121043Z /10 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 2933 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 00589 NODIS CHEROKEE SHOULD MERELY BE TO AVOID A SITUATION IN WHICH THE TWO MAJOR ANTI-SOVIET AND ANTI-COMMUNIST ELEMENTS ARE SET AT EACH OTHERS'THROATS AND TEAR THIS NATION APART. IF THAT WERE TO HAPPEN, THE SOVIETS WOULD CERTAINLY INHERIT THE RESULTS.

IT IS CLEAR THAT, IN ANY EFFORT TO ACHIEVE AN ACCOMMODATION BETWEEN THE FORCES OF KHOMEINI AND THE MILITARY, THE MAJOR AND PRIMARY STUMBLING BLOCK WOULD BE KHOMEINI'S INSISTENCE ON AN "ISLAMIC REPUBLIC," WHILE THE MILITARY REMAIN ROYALISTS. IN THE INTERESTS OF THE INTEGRITY OF THE NATION, WE SHOULD ATTEMPT TO PREVAIL UPON BOTH SIDES TO SET THIS ISSUE ASIDE BY AGREEING TO DISAGREE. THEY SHOULD THEN GO ON TO DEVELOP OTHER AREAS IN WHICH THEY CAN AGREE AND, THROUGH THAT PROCESS, BUILD UP MUTUAL TRUST. FROM THIS PREMISE, THEY SHOULD EVENTUALLY BE ABLE TO ADDRESS THE ULTIMATE ISSUE OF CONSTITUTIONAL FORMS.
IN THE MEANTIME, BOTH SIDES WOULD CONTINUE TO PERMIT THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT TO FUNCTION, EVEN THOUGH KHOMEINI CONTENDS IT IS "ILLEGAL."

FINALLY, LET ME ADDRESS THE QUESTION OF LOYALTY TO OUR FRIENDS. I BELIEVE THE U.S. GOVERNMENT, AND THE PRESIDENT PERSONALLY, HAVE MORE THAN ADEQUATELY DISCHARGED OUR OBLIGATIONS OF LOYALTY TO THE SHAH. WE HAVE EVEN DONE SO AT SOME SERIOUS RISKS TO U.S. NATIONAL INTERESTS. WE CANNOT RPT NOT BY CONTINUED AVOWAL OF THAT LOYALTY, DO FOR THE SHAH WHAT HE HAS BEEN UNABLE OR UNWILLING TO DO FOR HIMSELF. MOREOVER, THE PERSIAN CONCEPT OF LOYALTY IS NOT AS RIGID AS OUR OWN.

WE NEED ONLY EXAMINE THE FATE OF SUCH OF THE SHAH'S CLOSEST SUBORDINATES AS HOVEYDA AND NASSIRI TO UNDERSTAND THE RELATIVE QUALITY OF THIS VIRTUE IN THE IRANIAN CONTEXT. IN SHORT, WE MUST PUT THE SHAH BEHIND US AND LOOK TO OUR OWN NATIONAL INTERESTS AS FORE

TEHRAN AND MOST CITIES REMAINED QUIET YESTERDAY, BUT DEMONSTRATIONS IN SHIRAZ TURNED TO VIOLENCE LATE YESTERDAY AFTERNOON. AS REPORTED YESTERDAY, CROWDS DEMONSTRATED PEACEFULLY IN FRONT OF CONSULATE. WE NOTE PRESS REPORTS THAT POLICE HAULED DOWN THE FLAG AS CROWD APPROACHED. MOB (MAY NOT HAVE BEEN SAME GROUP) LATER ATTACKED SHIRAZ SAVAK HEADQUARTERS. DETAILS ARE STILL CONFUSED, BUT MOST SOURCES BELIEVE 8 RIOTERS WERE KILLED, PROBABLY BY SAVAK MEMBERS FIRING FROM THE BUILDING. BUILDING WAS REPORTEDLY GUARDED BY A DOZEN POLICEMEN WHO HAD ORDERS NOT TO FIRE INTO THE CROWD. MOB IN ANY CASE SUCCEEDED IN PENETRATING HEADQUARTERS AND BURNED IT TO THE GROUND.

WHILE GOVT HAS NOT RESTORED MARTIAL LAW IN SHIRAZ, THERE ARE TROOPS OUTSIDE THE REMAINS OF SAVAK HEADQUARTERS, AND ANOTHER CONTINGENT IS OUTSIDE CONSULATE. AUTHORITIES EXPECT FURTHER DEMONSTRATIONS TODAY. (COMMENT: SOMEONE SEEMS BENT ON SUBVERTING BAKHTIAR'S EFFORT TO REDUCE MARTIAL LAW. THIS ATTACK EXPLICITLY VIOLATES KHOMEINI'S LATEST COMMUNIQUE WHICH SAID SAVAK AGENTS AND ALL OTHER GUILTY PARTIES MUST BE BROUGHT TO TRIAL, NOT SUBJECTED TO MOB JUSTICE.)

IN ISFAHAN YESTERDAY, TROOPS DISPERSED DEMONSTRATIONS WITH TEAR GAS AND SHOTS IN THE AIR. TWO BOMBS WERE THROWN INTO HOME OF BHI EMPLOYEE. ONE FAILED TO EXPLODE; THE OTHER EXPLODED BUT CAUSED NO INJURIES.

PRIMIN BAKHTIAR PRESENTED CABINET TO MAJLES YESTERDAY. DEBATE WILL NOT BEGIN UNTIL JAN 14 AND MAY REQUIRE AS LONG AS TWO DAYS. VOTE OF CONFIDENCE COULD THEREFORE NOT COME BEFORE JAN 16 OR 17. MEANWHILE BAKHTIAR WILL INTRODUCE CABINET TO SENATE JAN 13 FOR WHAT SHOULD BE A QUICK VOTE OF CONFIDENCE. IN HIS PRESENTATION TO MAJLES, BAKHTIAR REAFFIRMED THAT IRAN WILL STOP SELLING CRUDE OIL TO ISRAEL AND SOUTH AFRICA. HE HAS APPOINTED LT GEN MASUMI SECRETARY OF STATE FOR PARLIAMENTARY AFFAIRS. SULLIVAN
REF STATE 008977 ZAHEDI TELEPHONED ME 1845 TEHRAN TIME TO SAY HE IS LEAVING MORNING JANUARY 13 FOR WASHINGTON.
HE HAD JUST TALKED WITH ANNERBERG ABOUT A THURSDAY (JANUARY 18) OR FRIDAY (JANUARY 19) ARRIVAL IN PALM SPRINGS.
HE WILL BE IN TOUCH WITH WHITE HOUSE ON ARRIVAL IN WASHINGTON.
HE WILL RESIGN SHORTLY AFTER HIS ARRIVAL IN WASHINGTON.

THE SCHEDULE IS STILL AS REPORTED IN MY PREVIOUS CABLES. EARLIEST ARRIVAL IN U.S. WOULD PROBABLY BE JANUARY 18. I THINK IT IS ESSENTIAL RPT ESSENTIAL THAT EAST COAST REFUELING STOP BE IN SOUTH CAROLINA OR FLORIDA AND NOT RPT NOT AT ANDREWS AIR FORCE BASE. PLS ENSURE THAT U.S. AIR FORCE PLANS IT THAT WAY.
I EXPECT TO HAVE SOME REASONABLE ADVANCE WARNING ON DEPARTURE.
(S) ENTIRE TEXT

WE HAVE MADE MAJOR EFFORT WITH RELIGIOUS LEADERS TO PRECLUDE PROSPECT OF VIOLENT RPT VIOLENT DEMONSTRATIONS UPON DEPARTURE OF SHAH . THEY HAVE BEEN RESPONSIVE, BUT, OF COURSE, THESE EFFORTS HAVE BEEN LIMITED BY UNCONSCIONABLE WASHINGTON REFUSAL TO CARRY SIMILAR MESSAGE TO KHOMEINI.

THERE WILL BE LARGE MARCH ON JANUARY 19, WHICH WE ARE ASSURED WILL BE PEACEFUL - I HOPE THESE ASSURANCES WILL BE MET, BUT WOULD FEEL COMFORTABLE ONLY IF WE SENT EMISSARY TO KHOMEINI TO OBTAIN AN ACCURATE READING.

MY FEELING IS THAT A PUBLIC STATEMENT ORDERING OUT DEPENDENTS OR NON-ESSENTIALS WOULD CAUSE AN ATMOSPHERE OF SUCH CONFUSION THAT IT COULD CONTRIBUTE TO A PANIC THAT MIGHT TOUCH OFF THE VERY CONFRONTATION WE WISH TO AVOID.

DO YOU HAVE ANY READING FROM FRENCH CONTACT WITH KHOMEINI WHICH WOULD GIVE ME SOME SENSE OF OBDURACY IN THAT QUARTER? IT IS VERY DIFFICULT FOR US TO MAKE INTELLIGENT JUDGMENTS HERE UNLESS WASHINGTON SHARES RELEVANT INFORMATION WITH US.

I MET FOR AN HOUR MORNING JANUARY 13 WITH ALI AMINI, WHO TOLD ME, AS ANTICIPATED, THAT HE HAD REFUSED POSITION ON REGENCY COUNCIL. HE SAID HE AND SADIQI AND AYATOLLAH QOMI HAD ALL DONE THIS IN ORDER TO "KEEP THEIR HANDS FREE" FOR THE POST-SHAH POLITICAL PROCESS. HE SAID THEIR PLACES ON THE COUNCIL WOULD BE TAKEN BY VARASTEH, TEHRANI, AND MOTAMEDI. THE COUNCIL WOULD BE ANNOUNCED AT 1500 JAN. 13.

AMINI SAID HE WAS GOING TO PARIS AS SOON AS POSSIBLE TO SEE KHOMEINI IN ORDER TO TRY TO AVERT CLASH BETWEEN RELIGIOUS AND MILITARY. HE SAID A DELEGATION FROM THE BAZAAR WAS ALSO GOING. THEY ALL FEAR THAT IN THE EUPHORIA OF THE SHAH'S DEPARTURE, KHOMEINI WILL INSTRUCT HIS FOLLOWERS TO TRY TO OVERTHROW THE CONSTITUTION AND THUS PRECIPITATE CIVIL WAR.

IN AMINI'S VIEW, KHOMEINI MUST BE PERSUADED TO TOLERATE THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT UNTIL THINGS CALM DOWN, MUST ASSIST THE CALMING PROCESS BY CALLING OFF STRIKES, AND MUST COME TO SOME UNDERSTANDING WITH MILITARY. IN THIS SITUATION, AMINI BELIEVES THAT HE AND OTHER PEOPLE OF GOOD SENSE MIGHT BE ABLE TO DEVELOP FORCES WHICH WOULD DEVELOP A RATIONAL POLITICAL PROCESS. HE SAID HE WOULD ALSO WORK ON SANJABI TO EASE UP ON BHKHTIAR. (SANJABI IS AT THIS MOMENT ADDRESSING A CROWD OF 80,000 AT THE UNIVERSITY.)

AS FOR THE SHAH, AMINI REGARDS HIM AS "PERSONALLY FINISHED," BUT THINKS THERE IS POSSIBILITY OF PRESERVING THE MONARCHY. HE SAYS PEOPLE MAY GET USED TO THE IDEA OF A "MONARCH ABROAD," AND, IN DUE COURSE, SHAH COULD ABDICATE IN FAVOR OF CROWN PRINCE. HE BELIEVES THE IDEA OF AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC WOULD BE DISASTROUS. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00645.subject: PROPOSED MEETING BETWEEN IRANIAN MILITARY AND KHOMEINI SUPPORTERS

segments.text: KHOMEINI SUPPORTERS

IN JANUARY 13 TELECON, I REPORTED THAT KHOMEINI SUPPORTERS HAD PROPOSED MEETING WITH SENIOR IRANIAN MILITARY MORNING JANUWRY 14. GENERAL HUYSER PUT THIS TO MILITARY, WHO RESPONDED WITH ALACRITY AND PROPOSED SESSION AT 1800 JANUARY 14. MILITARY PARTICIPANTS WOULD BE GHARABAGHI, BADERI, HABIBOLLAHI AND RABII. OTHER SIDE WOULD BE BARZAGAN AND BEHESHTI.

GHARABAGHI WILL REPORT THIS UNDERTAKING TO PRIME MINISTER BAKHTIAR EARLY THIS AFTERNOON AND IS CERTAIN LATTER WILL APPROVE IT. AFTER THAT SESSION, HE WILL MEET AGAIN WITH GENERAL HUYSER TO DISCUSS FURTHER SUBJECT MATTER FOR MEETING. I HAVE ALREADY CONVEYED MY VIEWS TO MILITARY THROUGH HUYSER.

UNFORTUNATELY, WHEN EMBOFF TELEPHONED DR. MINATCHI (WHO IS NOW OUR INTERMEDIARY AFTER DEPARTMENT PULLED ESCUDERO AWAY FROM US), LATTER SAID BARZAGAN HAD OTHER APPOINTMENTS (INCLUDING RAMSEY CLARK) WHICH WOULD PRECLUDE MEETINGS TODAY. I CALLED HIM BACK TO TELL HIM THIS WAS MORE IMPORTANT AND URGENT THAN OTHER APPOINTMENTS AND STRESSED NEED FOR POSITIVE REPLY. HE SAID HE UNDERSTOOD AND PROMISED TO CALL ME BACK BY 1430. I AM ALSO BRINGING PRESSURE OF URGENCY ON BARZAGAN AND BEHESHTI THROUGH OTHER INTERMEDIARIES.

AT 1200, MINATCHI CALLED ME BACK TO SAY BARZAGAN AND BEHESHTI WERE PREPARED MEET AT 1800, BUT DECLINED GO TO PALACE UNDER MILITARY CONTROL. HE PROPOSED BEHESHTI'S HOUSE INSTEAD. I WILL ASK HUYSER TO TRY TO WORK THIS

EMBOFFS ESCUDERO AND PERETT MET JAN 9 WITH PROFESSOR ALI MOHAMMADI AND TERRY GRAHAM. MOHAMMADI, A SENIOR MEMBER OF DR. NASSER PAKDAMAN'S SOLIDARITY GROUP, HAD SPOKEN RECENTLY WITH EMBOFF STEMPEL (REFTEL). GRAHAM IS A PERSIANIZED AMERICAN WHO IS PARTICULARLY KNOWLEDGEABLE ABOUT THE RELIGIOUS COMMUNITY. UPDATING THE UNIVERSITY SITUATION, MOHAMMADI SAID ARYAMEHR INDUSTRIAL UNIVERSITY HAS OPENED THAT VERY DAY, TEHRAN TECHNICAL UNIVERSITY WOULD OPEN THE FOLLOWING DAY, AND THE REST BY SATURDAY. WHEN ASKED WHAT "OPEN" MEANT, HE SAID MEETINGS WERE UNDERWAY TO DECIDE THIS.

MOHAMMADI SAID SOME OF HIS OPPOSITIONIST COLLEAGUES HAVE BECOME RELUCTANT TO TALK TO AMERICANS; USG HEARS "THE "TRUTH" FROM THEM BUT U.S. POLICY DOES NOT CHANGE. (THE LUNCHEON MEETING WAS SUPPOSED TO BE MUCH LARGER, BUT THE OTHERS WHOM WE EXPECTED DID NOT SHOW UP.) HE INCLUDED AMERICAN ACADEMICS IN THIS ACCUSATION, SAYING THE IRANIANS DO NOT APPRECIATE THE WAY THEY SWEEP INTO IRAN, SPEAK FROM THE MOUNTAINTOP, THEN RUN OFF TO WRITE THEIR NEXT ARTICLE. HE MENTIONED COTTOM, BINDER, BILL, AND ZONIS BY NAME AND SAID THAT BILL COMES AND TALKS TO THE QUEEN INSTEAD OF TO THE RIGHT PEOPLE.
HE AND HIS FRIENDS MET RECENTLY WITH COTTAM, AND HE HAD HAD TO CALM HIS COLLEAGUES AFTER THEY REACTED AGAINST COTTOM, WHO IS REPUTEDLY "A BREZINSKI MAN."

UNIVERSITY STUDENTS ARE NOT CONTROLLED BY RADICAL LEFTISTS. THERE ARE TWO MAJOR GROUPS ON CAMPUS; DOMINANT GROUP IS THE MUJAHADDIN-E-KHALQ WHICH IS MORE OR LESS RELIGIOUS, AND THE OTHER IS THE MARXIST GROUP, MOST OF WHOM ARE ACTUALLY TROTSKYIST RATHER THAN COMMUNIST. THE MARXISTS HAVE MADE VARIOUS ATTEMPTS TO SET THE TONE OF PROTEST MARCHES, ETC., BUT THE MAJORITY HAVE SQUEEZED THEM OUT. (COMMENT: FROM OUR PERSPECTIVE, THE MUJAHADDIN ARE MOST DEFINITELY RADICAL LEFTISTS ON THE ORDER OF LIBYA OR SOUTH YEMEN. HEARING THAT THEY ARE THE DOMINANT GROUP IS HARDLY AS COMFORTING AS IT WAS MEANT TO SOUND.)

BOTH MEN SAID THE RELIGIOUS HEADS CANNOT AND DO NOT WANT TO RUN THE COUNTRY BUT MERELY SEEK TO SET THE MORAL TONE. WITH THE SHAH GONE, THEIR INFLUENCE WILL SHARPLY DECLINE. RELIGIOUS LEADERS VIEW THEMSELVES, HOWEVER, IN DIFFERENT WAYS, AND SOME ARE MUCH MORE POLITICAL THAN OTHERS. AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI, FOR EXAMPLE, IS RELATIVELY UNIMPORTANT AMONG THE OTHER AYATOLLAHS AS A PURELY RELIGIOUS LEADER, BUT HE IS A POLITICAL ANIMAL. GRAHAM LISTED SIX AYATOLLAHS AS HOLDING FIRST RANK FROM THE PURELY RELIGIOUS PERSPECTIVE: KHOI, SHARIATMADARI, KHONSARI (FROM TEHRAN, NOT ACTIVE POLITICALLY), GOLPAYEGANI, MARASHINAJAFI, AND KHOMEINI.

MOHAMMADI SAID KHOI HAD LOST PRESTIGE BY RECEIVING THE SHAHBANOU RECENTLY IN NAJAF, BUT GRAHAM INSISTED THAT DID NOT AFFECT HIS STANDING IN THE RELIGIOUS COMMUNITY. MOHAMMADI'S REACTION WAS TRUE TO FORM, HOWEVER, SINCE HE AND MOST OF HIS ACADEMIC FRIENDS CLEARLY ARE GOOD MUSLIMS ONLY FOR THE DURATION OF THE ANTI-SHAH STRUGGLE.

EMBOFFS DELIVERED APPEAL FOR CONTROL OF CROWDS WHEN SHAH DEPARTS SO THAT MILITARY WILL NOT FEEL PROVOKED. THEY PREDICTED (SANGUINELY, IN OUR VIEW) THAT CONTROL OF THE MASSES WOULD BE NO GREAT PROBLEM. EMBOFFS POINTED TO RANDOM VIOLENCE WHICH HAS BEEN SO EVIDENT, BUT THEY REPLIED THAT THE ARSON WAS THE DOING OF SAVAK, THE MILITARY, OR SOME INDIVIDUAL SETTLING AN OLD SCORE. IT WILL NOT CONTINUE, BUT GOVT MUST PROVIDE INSPIRATION. BAKHTIAR OR WHOEVER RESTORES SECURITY TO THE COUNTRY WILL HAVE TO BE A HERO. IRANIANS ARE EMOTIONAL AND NEED A HERO (THEY ACCEPTED EMBOFF'S SUGGESTED TERMINOLOGY OF"MAN ON HORSEBACK.").

MOHAMMADI SAID IRANIANS ARE INCAPABLE OF RATIONAL THOUGHT, ALTHOUGH HE ATTRIBUTED THIS TO THE GOVT-CONTROLLED EDUCATIONAL SYSTEM. HE SAYS THAT THE PEOPLE WHO STAND ACCUSED OF CORRUPTION WERE MERELY PARTICIPANTS IN A SYSTEM WHICH ORIGINATED FROM THE TOP; BUT THE PEOPLE WANT BLOOD AND THE GOVT MUST PROVIDE IT. HE MENTIONED THE LIST OF SAVAK AGENTS WHICH IS GOING AROUND. OF COURSE IT IS A FAKE, HE SAID, BUT HE GAVE NO SIGN OF WILLINGNESS TO SAY THIS TO OTHER IRANIANS.
MOHAMMADI MADE LIGHT OF THE ANTI-AMERICAN THREAT CAMPAIGN. THIS WAS MERELY AN EMOTIONAL THING WITH THE PEOPLE. TELEPHONE CALLS, NOTES AND MARKING OF HOUSES WILL NOT LEAD TO REAL ACTION. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00660.subject: PROPOSED MEETING BETWEEN IRANIAN MILITARY AND KHOMEINI SUPPORTERS

segments.text: AS OF 1430, WE REMAIN AT IMPASSE ON MILITARY-RELIGIOUS MEETING. BOTH SIDES HAVE AGREED TO MEET AT 1800 JANUARY 14. HOWEVER, THEY CANNOT RPT NOT AGREE ON LOCATION.

BEHESHTI INSISTS, FOR HIS OWN SECURITY, THAT MEETING HAS TO BE AT HIS HOUSE. MILITARY HAVE THUS FAR REFUSED. BARZAGAN, WHO PREFERS BEHESHTI VENUE, IS, NEVERTHELESS, WILLING MEET AT HOME OF U.S. EMBASSY OFFICER WHICH WE ASSUME WOULD BE ACCEPTABLE TO MILITARY.

GENERALS HUYSER AND GAST ARE CURRENTLY WHACKING OUT WITH MILITARY WHETHER THEY WILL SWALLOW THEIR PRESTIGE AND GO TO BEHESHTI OR WHETHER THEY WOULD SETTLE FOR MEETING ONLY WITH BARZAGAN. LATTER IS MORE REASONABLE THAN BEHESHTI, BUT LESS DIRECTLY TIED TO KHOMEINI.
WE WILL REPORT FURTHER AS DECISIONS DEVELOP.

1979TEHRAN00668.subject: FIRST MEETING WITH NATIONAL FRONT LEADER KARIM SANJABI SUMMARY: IN FIRST MEETING WITH EMBASSY, SANJABI HA

segments.text: POLCOUNS PRESSED SANJABI A BIT ON HIS ATTITUDE TOWARD A REGENCY COUNCIL, INCLUDING SANJABI'S OWN WILLINGNESS TO SERVE ON IT. SANJABI WAS NEGATIVE ON ANY COUNCIL APPOINTED BY THE SHAH. HE SAID SHAH WAS NOT CAPABLE OF APPOINTING GOOD LEADERS TO SUCH A COUNCIL. REGENCY COUNCIL CANNOT, IN ANY CASE, EXERCISE MORE AUTHORITY UNDER THE CONSTITUTION THAN IS PERMITTED TO THE KING. THUS, WHO RUNS THE GOVT IS MORE IMPORTANT. SANJABI THEN DISCUSSED FOR A MOMENT THE IDEA OF A NATIONAL COMMITTEE TO SET POLICY FOR A GOVT (THOUGH INSISTING NO SUCH COMMITTEE SHOULD ACTUALLY TRY TO REPLACE AND CARRY OUT THE FUNCTIONS OF A GOVT).
HE REMINISCED ON THE UNOFFICIAL COMMITTEE OF 20-30 WHICH SERVED AS ADVISORS TO MOSSADEQ GOVT IN THE OLD DAYS. THEY USED TO MEET EVERY WEEK OR TWO, HE RECALLED.

FINALLY, SANJABI MADE THE POINT THAT THE OPPOSITION HAS NOTHING AGAINST RELIGIOUS MINORITIES. HE ADMITTED POL COUNSELOR'S REMARK THAT THE BAHAIS MIGHT HAVE SOMETHING TO FEAR, BUT HE SAID THIS WAS ONLY FROM LOW-LEVEL MOBS, NOT THE OPPOSITION LEADERSHIP (COMMENT NOT THAT THAT WOULD MAKE MUCH DIFFERENCE). JEWS LOSE SOMETHING BY ASSOCIATION WITH ISRAEL, BUT THE PEOPLE HAVE NOTHING AGAINST THEM OTHERWISE. HE REFERRED TO THE POLICY OF TOLERANCE DATING FROM SHAH ABBAS' DAY, AS HE ESCORTED POLCOUNS OUT, WITH MANY PLEDGES OF GOOD WILL AND HOPES FOR A BETTER FUTURE. HE SAID HE WAS OPTIMISTIC.

COMMENT: IN THIS FIRST MEETING WITH THE EMBASSY, SANJABI CLEARLY WANTED TO TRANSMIT WHAT HE CONSIDERS HIS OWN GOOD WILL, ENLIGHTENED IDEAS, AND PRO-WESTERN ATTITUDE FOR THE ATTENTION OF THE USG, BUT INDIRECTLY. THERE WAS NOTHING OF IMMEDIATE OPERATIONAL IMPORTANCE IN WHAT HE SAID, BEYOND HIS WILLINGNESS TO WORK FOR NON-PROVOCATION OF THE ARMY. WITHOUT OPENLY IMPORTUNING, HE HOPES USG WILL IDENTIFY HIM AND HIS PARTY AS NO DANGER TO ITS INTERESTS IN IRAN AND INDEED A POTENTIAL ALLY. SANJABI DID NOT GO SIGNIFICANTLY BEYOND THE POSITION HE HAS ALREADY TAKEN IN PUBLIC, HOWEVER, AND INDEED WE DOUBT HE HAS THAT MUCH TO TELL US AT THIS TIME.
HE WAS HOPING TO SET THE STAGE FOR

1979TEHRAN00669.subject: PROPOSED MEETING BETWEEN IRANIAN MILITARY AND KHOMEINI SUPPORTERS

segments.text: AFTER FRUSTRATING DAY OF INTERMEDIATION, OUR EFFORTS TO FOSTER A DIALOGUE BETWEEN MILITARY AND RELIGIOUS LEADERS COLLAPSED OVER THE ISSUE OF AN AGREED VENUE. NEITHER SIDE WAS WILLING TO GO TO PREMISES ASSOCIATED WITH THE OTHER, AND BEHESHTI REFUSED TO GO TO NEUTRAL GROUND. SINCE MILITARY DID NOT RPT NOT WISH TO TALK TO BARZAGAN ALONE, THE MEETING SCHEDULED FOR 1800 TODAY HAS BEEN ABORTED.

MINATCHI HAS UNDERTAKEN TO ASK BARZAGAN TO TRY TO PERSUADE BEHESHTI TO AGREE TO NEUTRAL MEETING PLACE SUCH AS U.S. EMBOFF RESIDENCE FOR RENEWED EFFORT JANUARY 15. IN MEANTIME, MILITARY HAVE UNDERTAKEN TO EXAMINE OTHER VENUES WHICH MIGHT MAKE A JANUARY 15 MEETING FEASIBLE.
THIS EPISODE DEMONSTRATES INTRACTABLE NATURE OF IRANIAN PERSONALITIES AS WELL AS ISSUES OF FORM INVOLVED, EVEN IN MATTERS WHERE BOTH SIDES ARE PALPABLY EAGER TO BEGIN TALKS WITH EACH OTHER. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00670.subject: LMI ON PRESENT EVENTS SUMMARY: ENTEZAM TOLD EMBOFF NAMING OF REGENCY COUNCIL GIVES LMI NO DIFFICULTY. LMI EXPECTS MAJLES WILL

segments.text: SUMMARY: ENTEZAM TOLD EMBOFF NAMING OF REGENCY COUNCIL GIVES LMI NO DIFFICULTY. LMI EXPECTS MAJLES WILL APPROVE BAKHTIAR. KHOMEINI'S PROJECTED RETURN TO IRAN NOT RPT NOT AS FIRM AS PRESS REPORTS INDICATE. SOME GROUPS WHICH HAVE BEEN TAKING OVER SECURITY ARE LMI UNITS, FULL INFO NOT AVAILABLE ON OTHERS. THERE WILL BE CONTINUED DEMONSTRATIONS THROUGH WEEKEND JAN 18-19. JAN 13 UNIVERSITY DEMONSTRATIONS WERE CONTROLLED BY LMI. LMI PLANS FOR POSTSHAH CALM ARE ADVANCING. END SUMMARY.

POLOFF STEMPEL MET WITH AMIR ENTEZAM, LMI CENTRAL COMMITTEE MEMBER, TO REVIEW RECENT DEVELOPMENTS. ENTEZAM SAID REGENCY COUNCIL WHICH WAS NAMED JAN 13 GIVES LMI NO PROBLEMS. VARASTEHAND TEHRANI WERE FORMER OPPOSITIONISTS WITH GOOD RECORDS, AND ALIABADI IS WELL THOUGHT OF. (MINATCHI OF MODERATE RELIGIOUS GROUPS OFFERED SAME VIEW.) REGENCY COUNCIL SHOULD UNDERSTAND IT WILL PROBABLY NOT BE AROUND LONG, ONCE KHOMEINI RETURNS TO IRAN. ENTEZAM SAID PROMINENT OPPOSITIONISTS WERE CONTACTED BY COURT TO SERVE, BUT ALL DECLINED. HE PERSONALLY KNEW THAT KARIM SANJABI, YADOLLAH SAHABI, AND MEHDI BAZARGAN HAD ALL TURNED SHAH DOWN.

ENTEZAM SAID HE BELIEVES MAJLES WILL FUSS AND MUSS AND FINALLY APPROVE BAKHTIAR. WHILE SOME OF MAJLESMEN MAY PREFER MILITARY TAKEOVER (WHICH ALL BELIEVE WOULD FOLLOW REJECTION OF BAKHTIAR), BULK WILL VOTE FOR GOOD OF COUNTRY. LMI WILL BE DOING SOME DISCREET LOBBYING, HOWEVER, SINCE VOTE IS NOT RPT NOT FOREGONE CONCLUSION.

ON QUESTION OF KHOMEINI'S RETURN TO IRAN, ENTEZAM SAID THAT CONTRARY TO PRESS REPORTS, KHOMEINI HAS NOT RPT NOT MADE DECISION WHEN TO RETURN. LMI GROUP HERE, INCLUDING SEYED MOHAMMAD BEHESHTI, WOULD PREFER HE DELAY HIS RETURN BEYOND FIRST OR SECOND DAY TO ALLOW MILITARY AND SECURITY SITUATION TO SETTLE. ENTEZAM SAID HE WAS FRANKLY AFRAID FOR KHOMEINI'S SAFETY, SINCE IT WAS OBVIOUS THAT THERE ARE GROUPS OUTSIDE THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT WHO DO NOT WISH KHOMEINI WELL. FANATICISM HAS DONE IN A NUMBER OF MAJOR NATIONAL LEADERS IN PAST FIFTY YEARS AND LMI DOES NOT WANT KHOMEINI TO BE NEXT ON THE LIST.
SECURITY SITUATION IN IRAN WOULD BE "TOO HORRIBLE TO THINK ABOUT" IF KHOMEINI WERE TO BE ASSASSINATED UPON HIS RETURN TO IRAN.

ENTEZAM SAID COUPLE OF LOCAL PERSIAN PAPERS, INCLUDING AYANDEGON WERE WRONG IN IMPLYING THAT KHOMEINI WOULD ATTACK ANY COUNTRY WHICH GIVES THE SHAH REFUGE. ENTEZAM SAID (AND WE HOPE HE SPEAKS ACCURATELY FOR KHOMEINI CAMP) THAT KHOMEINI UNDERSTANDS IT MAY BE NECESSARY TO OFFER SHAH ASYLUM IN U.S. OR EUROPE TO GET HIM OUT OF IRAN, AND COUNTRY THAT DOES SO WOULD NOT BE PENALIZED BY ISLAMIC MOVEMENT.

GROUPS WHICH HAVE BEEN REPORTEDLY TAKING OVER SECURITY FROM POLICE IN SEVERAL AREAS OF COUNTRY ARE "PROBABLY" LMI ACTION TEAMS. ENTEZAM SAID ALL THOSE WHO HAD TAKEN OVER IN THE NORTH, AROUND TABRIZ AND ELSEWHERE IN EAST AZARBAIJAN PROVINCE WERE DEFINITELY LMI. REPORTS WERE NOT IN FROM MORE SOUTHERN CITIES SUCH AS SHIRAZ. ALSO ON POSITIVE NOTE, ACCORDING TO ENTEZAM, MASS UNIVERSITY DEMONSTRATION JAN 13, WHICH HAD AT ITS PEAK 200,000 PEOPLE (ACCORDING TO LMI, MORE EXPERIENCED OBSERVERS SAY JUST UNDER 100,000) WAS "ONE HUNDRED PER CENT CONTROLLED BY ISLAMIC MOVEMENT." ENTEZAM SAID LMI WAS AGREEABLY SURPRISED BY THIS, SINCE TUDEH HAD BEEN STRONG IN UNIVERSITIES.

(COMMENT: ENTEZAM CLEARLY THOUGHT THIS OUTCOME HAD RESULTED FROM GOOD ORGANIZATIONAL WORK WHICH LMI HAD DONE. HOWEVER, HE WAS UNWILLING TO GIVE LMI EXCLUSIVE CREDIT FOR THIS, SINCE HE AND OTHERS THOUGHT MARXISTS MAY JUST HAVE BEEN A BIT OVERWHELMED ON THIS OCCASION.) LMI WILL HAVE SUBSTANTIAL DEMONSTRATIONS WEEKEND OF JAN 18-19, REGARDLESS OF WHETHER SHAH IS STILL IN IRAN OR NOT.

ENTEZAM NOTED THAT LMI HAD WELL-ADVANCED PLANNING FOR DAY OF SHAH'S DEPARTURE. AYATOLLAHS HAD MADE SOME CALMING STATEMENTS AND WOULD MAKE OTHERS. LMI HAD TEAMS OF ITS OWN PREPARED TO PROTECT STATUES AND PUBLIC BUILDINGS. WHEN POLOFF ASKED ABOUT THESE GROUPS AND THOSE WHO HAVE BEEN MAINTAINING SECURITY IN TOWNS, ENTEZAM SAID THEY CAME FROM VARIETY OF RELIGIOUS GROUPS. (COMMENT: WE SUSPECT AT LEAST SOME OF THEM AND MOST OF THEIR ORGANIZERS ARE MUJAHIDDIN OR MUJAHIDDIN RELATED.)

1979TEHRAN00671.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT, JAN 14, 1979 SUMMARY: NO SERIOUS VIOLENCE IN IRAN DESPITE LARGE DEMON- STRATION AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY YESTERDAY. GOI ANNO

segments.text: SUMMARY: NO SERIOUS VIOLENCE IN IRAN DESPITE LARGE DEMONSTRATION AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY YESTERDAY. GOI ANNOUNCES REGENCY COUNCIL AS KHOMEINI REVEALS HE HAS SELECTED AN ISLAMIC COUNCIL. PRESS SAYS SHAH OPPOSES MILITARY COUP. BAKHTIAR WARNS OF "ALIEN ELEMENT". MAJLIS BEGINS DEBATE TODAY ON BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT. VOTE MAY BE CLOSE. DEMONSTRATIONS UNDERWAY IN TEHRAN TODAY. CENTRAL BANK BACK AT WORK. END SUMMARY.

IRAN WAS FREE OF MAJOR VIOLENCE YESTERDAY. DEMONSTRATORS GATHERED IN SEVERAL CITIES BUT REMAINED PEACEFUL. LARGE THRONG ASSEMBLED AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY TO MARK REOPENING. RALLY ORGANIZERS APPEALED TO ENTIRE POPULATION TO TURN OUT, SO CROWD INCLUDED ALL CLASSES RATHER THAN JUST STUDENTS. OPPOSITION SOURCE SAID RELIGIOUS ELEMENTS CONTROLLED THE CROWD AND ARE QUITE PLEASED THAT THEY SUCCEEDED SO WELL.

GOI ANNOUNCED THE MAKEUP OF 9-MEMBER REGENCY COUNCIL LAST NIGHT. IT WILL CONSIST OF PRIMIN BAKHTIAR; MOHAMMAD SAJJADI, SENATE PRESIDENT: JAVAD SAYEED, MAJLIS SPEAKER: ALI-QOLI ARDALAN, COURT MINISTER: ABDOL HOSSEIN ALIABADI, FORMER PUBLIC-PROSECUTOR-GENERAL: MOHAMMAD ALI VARASTEH, FORMER FINANCE MINISTER: ABDOLLAH ENTEZAM, CHAIRMAN OF NIOC; SAYED JALA TEHRANI, FORMER PTT MINISTER AND SENATOR; AND GENERAL ABBAS QARABAGHI, CHIEF OF SUPREME COMMANDER'S STAFF. THE MOVE WILL BE ANALYZED IN SEPTEL.

KHOMEINI MEANWHILE REVEALED HE HAS CREATED AN ISLAMIC COUNCIL OF THE REVOLUTION WHICH WILL PREPARE A PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT. ACCORDING TO PRESS REPORTS FROM PARIS, KHOMEINI WILL ANNOUNCE THE NAMES OF MEMBERS "AT THE PROPER TIME". THE COUNCIL WILL INSTALL A TRANSITIONAL GOVERNMENT WHICH WILL THEN CALL A CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY, HOLD FREE ELECTIONS, AND TRANSFER POWER TO THIS ASSEMBLY. KHOMEINI REPORTEDLY WAS ASKED WHETHER HE WOULD BE THE "STRONG MAN" OF IRAN, AND HE REPLIED: "YOU MAY ASSUME SO. I SHALL SUPERVISE AND DIRECT THE GOVERNMENT."

MORNING PRESS FEATURES STORIES THAT SHAH HAS TOLD MILITARY LEADERS TO STAY LOYAL TO BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT, DECLARING THAT A MILITARY COUP IS OUT OF THE QUESTION. JOURNALS ALSO REPORT RECENT STATEMENTS BY SECRETARY VANCE AND HODDING CARTER, AND THEY DESCRIBE VISIT OF GENERAL HUYSER AS EFFORT TO ENCOURAGE COOPERATION ON THE MILITARY SIDE.
SAVAK EMPLOYEE IN ISFAHAN WAS ASSASSINATED AT HIS DOORSTEP FRIDAY.

POWER BLACKOUTS CONTINUE TO OCCUR, BUT THE REGULARLYSCHEDULED EVENING OUTAGES HAVE CEASED. DISSIDENT ELECTRICAL WORKERS HAVE ANNOUNCED THAT THEY WILL PERFORM NO MORE PROTEST BLACKOUTS UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, GIVEN THE SEVERE HARDSHIP CAUSED BY FUEL SHORTAGE. CUSTOMS WORKERS WILL ALSO EASE PROTEST ACTION, ALLOWING VITAL GOODS TO ENTER. HOWEVER, GOODS DESTINED FOR BRITISH OR AMERICAN EMBASSIES OR TO ISRAELI CITIZENS WILL NOT BE CLEARED.

GOODS BELONGING TO FRENCH EMBASSY OR NATIONALS WILL BE PERMITTED ENTRY. ------------------049608 141449Z /46 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 2976 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY BONN AMCONSUL DHAHRAN IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY DOHA AMCONSUL FRANKFURT AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS USLO PEKING USLO RIYADH IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY TOKYO USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC SECTION 02 OF 03 TEHRAN 00671

PRIMIN BAKHTIAR PRESENTED CABINET TO SENATE YESTERDAY. IN HIS ADDRESS HE WARNED THAT "AN ALIEN ELEMENT" OF PROFESSIONAL TERRORISTS IS SEEKING TO SABOTAGE HIS GOVERNMENT. SEVERAL MAJLIS DEPUTIES HAVE TOLD US PRIVATELY THEY EXPECT A CLOSE VOTE AND THAT VICTORY FOR BAKHTIAR IS NOT CERTAIN.

TODAY LARGE GROUPS HAVE ASSEMBLED IN SOUTH TEHRAN, BUT AS OF MIDAFTERNOON NO CLASHES HAVE TAKEN PLACE. CROWD OF 1-2000 PASSED BRITISH EMBASSY ABOUT NOON, SHOUTING TO TROOPS THAT KHOMEINI HAS SAID SOLDIERS ARE OUR BROTHERS. CROWD LEADERS KEPT DEMONSTRATION UNDER TIGHT CONTROL. AMERICAN REPORTER EYEWITNESS REPORTED THAT ONE MARCHER WALKED UP TO ARMY LIEUTENANT AND KISSED HIM. CROWD MARCHED NORTH ON FERDOWSI AND LEFT SEVERAL KHOMEINI PICTURES HANGING FROM POET'S STATUE AT FERDOWSI SQUARE. ANOTHER LARGER CROWD IS DEMONSTRATING ON SHAH REZA, BUT WE HAVE NO REPORTS OF VIOLENCE. EMBASSY NATIONAL OBSERVED TIGHT DISCIPLINE AMONG MARCHERS, WHO JOINED HANDS SO NO OUTSIDER COULD PARTICIPATE.
CROWDS WERE POLITE TOWARD TROOPS THEY ENCOUNTERED, ASKING PERMISSION TO FOLLOW A CERTAIN ROUTE AND KISSING SOLDIERS WHEN PERMISSION WAS GRANTED.

OPPOSITION SOURCE INFORMED EMBOFF THAT THE "PEOPLES POLICE" WHO CONTROL SEVERAL NORTHWESTERN CITIES ARE LMIORGANIZED. HE DID NOT KNOW WHO IS RUNNING THE SHOW IN SOUTHERN CITIES. CONSULATE SHIRAZ REPORTS THESE "POLICE" HAVE NOW ASSUMED CONTROL OF CITY, AND REGULAR POLICEMEN ARE HARD TO FIND. CONSUL TABRIZ CONFIRMS THAT SIMILAR VIGILANTES POLICE KERMANSHAH AT ALGAT, BUT HE HAS NOT SEEN THEM YET IN TABRIZ.

CONSULATE SHIRAZ REPORTS LARGE DEMONSTRATION OF ABOUT 15,000 THIS MORNING. THIS CROWD TOO WAS UNDER EFFECTIVE CONTROL OF ORGANIZERS, WHO PROVIDED MOTORCYCLE ESCORT AND EVEN SONG-LEADERS. AUTHORITIES BELIEVE CROWDS TOMORROW WILL FOCUS ON WATER WORKS BUILDING NEAR CONSULATE. CONSULATE TABRIZ REPORTS SITUATION QUIET AND EVEN SOME RETURN TO WORK. KERMANSHAH IS WIDE OPEN FOR BUSINESS TODAY INCLUDING THE BAZAAR.

LATE REPORT FROM MAJLIS INDICATES 8 DEPUTIES HAVE SPOKEN AS OF LUNCH BREAK, 4 FOR EACH SIDE. SESSION CONTINUES IN AFTERNOON AND EVENING. A TOTAL OF 40 ARE SIGNED UP TO SPEAK, BUT OBSERVERS BELIEVE DEBATE WILL END AHEAD OF SCHEDULE, PROBABLY PERMITTING A VOTE BY TUESDAY EVENING.

CENTRAL BANK EMPLOYEES MET JANUARY 13 AND, CONTRARY TO EXPECTATIONS, VOTED TO RESUME WORK ON THE SAME SAT/MON/WED WORKWEEK AS ADOPTED BY BANK MELLI EMPLOYEES. A CBI OFFICIAL ESTIMATED THAT ABOUT ONE-THIRD OF EMPLOYEES REPORTED BUT WORK DONE WAS CHIEFLY IN THE TRANSACTIONS DEPARTMENTS. WORK HAS NOT RESUMED IN THE HIGHLY POLITICIZED STATISTICAL DEPARTMENT. CBI EMPLOYEES SAID THEY WILL NOT TOUCH MILITARY TRANSACTIONS, AND EMBOFF WILL DISCUSS WITH CBI DIR. GEN. NADERI MEANS OF CONTINUING SUCH TRANSFERS. A NUMBER OF COMMERCIAL BANK BRANCHES WERE OPEN JAN. 13 AND THEY, AS AT LEAST ONE U.S. BANK REPRESENTATIVE OFFICE, ARE FOLLOWING THE MELLI/CBI WORKWEEK.

WE DO NOT KNOW WHETHER ANY OF BANK HEADQUARTERS OFFICES WERE OPEN. MEAF DIR. GEN. KHALEGHI-ROD TOLD EMBOFF HE WAS MEETING WITH CBI JAN. 14 TO FREE THE BACKLOG OF FOREIGN EXCHANGE PAYMENTS ON GOI EXTERNAL DEBT SERVICE.

HE SAID THE MINISTRY WILL DO ALL POSSIBLE TO MEET ITS FOREIGN OBLIGATIONS. ------------------049623 141449Z /46 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 2977 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY BONN AMCONSUL DHAHRAN IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY DOHA AMCONSUL FRANKFURT AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS USLO PEKING USLO RIYADH IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY TOKYO USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC SECTION 03 OF 03 TEHRAN 00671

1979TEHRAN00690.subject: DEPARTURE FOR U.S. OF ROYAL FAMILY CHILDREN AND QUEEN'S MOTHER

segments.text: QUEEN'S MOTHER

WE HAVE BEEN INFORMED BY IIAF THAT IIAF 747 WILL DEPART TEHRAN 1000 LOCAL TIME, MONDAY, JANUARY 15, FOR U.S. ROUTE IS TO MADRID (ARV 1300 LOCAL) AND MCGUIRE AF BASE (ARV 1700 LOCAL) IN NEW JERSEY. THEY WILL SWITCH TO IIAF 707 AND FLY ON TO REESE AF BASE, LUBBOCK, TEXAS (ARV 2030 LOCAL). PLANE WILL CARRY TWO ROYAL FAMILY CHILDREN AND MOTHER OF SHAHBANOU. THEY INTEND, SO WE ARE TOLD, TO STAY WITH CROWN PRICE FOR TIME BEING.
DEPARTMENT AND DOD SHOULD ALERT RELEVANT AUTHORITIES AND ASSURE FULL SECURITY MEASURES.
PLEASE REFRAIN FROM ADVANCE PUBLICITY AND IT WOULD BE NICE IF THIS TRAVEL DID NOT LEAK. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00691.subject: PROPOSED MEETING BETWEEN IRANIAN MILITARY AND KHOMEINI SUPPORTERS

segments.text: KHOMEINI SUPPORTERS

WE ARE RESUMING TODAY OUR FRUSTRATED EFFORTS OF YESTERDAY TO GET IRANIAN MILITARY AND RELIGIOUS LEADERS TOGETHER. GENERAL HUYSER WILL MEET WITH GHARABAGHI AND OTHERS LATER THIS MORNING TO URGE THEM TOWARDS MORE IMAGINATIVE APPROACH TO SUCH A MEETING. HE WILL GIVE THEM MINATCHI'S TELEPHONE NUMBER AND URGE THEM TO MAKE DIRECT CONTACT WITH HIM IN EFFORT AGREE UPON NEUTRAL VENUE.

EMBASSY OFFICERS, IN MEANTIME, ARE CALLING MINATCHI AND ENTEZAM IN ATTEMPT GET THEM TO PERSUADE BEHESHTI TO AGREE TO MEET ON NEUTRAL GROUND RATHER THAN TO INSIST THAT MEETING SHOULD BE IN HIS HOUSE. WE WILL REPORT

1979TEHRAN00713.subject: US POSTURE IN COMING IRANIAN NEGOTIATIONS

segments.text: YOU ARE CORRECT IN ASSUMING THAT I SAW CABLE OF JANUARY 13 WHICH HUYSER SENT TO BROWN. HE SHOWED IT TO ME BEFORE HE SENT IT AND I EXPRESSED NO RPT NO OBJECTION TO ITS TRANSMITTAL. HOWEVER, WE DID NOT RPT NOT DISCUSS ITS NUANCES, ESPECIALLY AS REGARDS OPTION (B) WHICH IS DEFINED AS "FOLLOW-ON" TO BAKHTIAR AND OPTION (D) WHICH IS DEFINED AS "ISLAMIC REPUBLIC." THEREFORE, I BELIEVE IT COULD BE CONTRARY TO OUR BEST INTERESTS TO BECOME LOCKED INTO AN ORDER OF PREFERENCE WHICH IS DEFINED BY SEMANTICS THAT LACK POLITICAL PRECISION.

IN REF B, WHICH I SENT LAST NOVEMBER, I INDICATED MANNER IN WHICH A SO-CALLED "ISLAMIC REPUBLIC" MIGHT EMERGE IN FORM MORE OR LESS ACCEPTABLE TO OUR INTERESTS. I BELIEVE, THEREFORE, THAT IT IS POSSIBLE A "FOLLOW-ON" GOVERNMENT COULD COME INTO BEING HERE WHICH WOULD HAVE THE SUPPORT OF THE MILITARY, BUT MIGHT CALL ITSELF AN "ISLAMIC REPUBLIC" AND WOULD ENJOY THE BLESSING OF KHOMEINI. THIS IS THE THOUGHT THAT LIES BEHIND MY URGENT EFFORTS TO HAVE THE MILITARY AND THE RELIGIOUS LEADERS REACH SOME UNDERSTANDING.

AS THE DEPARTURE OF THE SHAH DRAWS NEAR, THE MILITARY ARE DOING QUITE A BIT OF FREE THINKING. FOR EXAMPLE, THEY TOLD GENERAL HUYSER JANUARY 14 THAT THEY COULD ENVISAGE BARZARGAN BECOMING PRESIDENT OF IRAN AND ENJOYING THE SUPPORT OF THE ARMED FORCES.

CONSEQUENTLY, I THINK WE HAVE TO STAY PRETTY LOOSE AS THE MANEUVERS OF THE NEXT FEW WEEKS TAKE PLACE. WE MUST NOT RPT NOT BECOME SO FIXED ON SUPPORTING BAKHTIAR THAT WE WOULD BE PERCEIVED AS RESISTING HIS DEPARTURE IN THE SAME WAY AS WE HAVE BEEN PERCEIVED TO RESIST THE DEPARTURE OF THE SHAH.

IT IS POSSIBLE, FOR EXAMPLE, THAT BAKHTIAR WILL BE GIVEN A FEW WEEKS TO FUNCTION AT SOME REDUCED LEVEL OF EFFECTIVENESS, WHILE KHOMEINI SUPPORTERS IN THE FORM OF HIS ISLAMIC COUNCIL WORK OUT A DEAL WITH THE ARMED FORCES AND THE REGENCY COUNCIL TO LET BAKHTIAR QUIETLY SUBSIDE AND BE REPLACED BY A GOVERNMENT WHICH WOULD BE HEADED BY SOMEONE LIKE BAZARGAN. HE COULD, FOR EXAMPLE, BE THE JOINT SELECTION OF THE ISLAMIC COUNCIL AND THE REGENCY COUNCIL AND HIS FUNCTION COULD BE DEFINED AS ONE OF PREPARING NEW CONSTITUTIONAL FORMS THROUGH A REFERENDUM OR A CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY, OR BOTH.

IF THINGS DEVELOP IN THIS MORE OR LESS SYSTEMATIC WAY, WITH GENERAL CONSENSUS FROM RESPONSIBLE SECTORS OF THE BODY POLITIC, WE SHOULD NOT RPT NOT BE TOO ALARMED IF THE PRODUCT WHICH EMERGES IS CALLED AN "ISLAMIC REPUBLIC," PROVIDED IT IS CLEARLY ORIENTED AWAY FROM COMMUNISM AND HAS SOME RELEVANCE TO THE CURRENT STATE OF ECONOMIC AND SOCIAL DEVELOPMENT IN IRAN. THIS IS A PROCESS WHICH WE CAN ONLY OBSERVE AND NOT RPT NOT CONTROL.

THE REAL DANGER I FEAR IS THAT KHOMEINI, DAZZLED BY HIS SUCCESS IN ROUTING THE SHAH, WILL SWEEP BACK INTO TEHRAN IN THE NEXT FEW DAYS BEFORE ANY UNDERSTANDINGS ARE REACHED, WILL ANNOUNCE THAT HE HAS ALREADY RECEIVED HIS REFERENDUM IN THE MARCHES OF ASHURA, AND WILL DEMAND THAT BAKHTIAR, THE PARLIAMENT, AND THE REGENCY COUNCIL ALL DISAPPEAR. THIS SORT OF DRAMA COULD PRODUCE THE CONFRONTATION WITH THE MILITARY WHICH IT IS IN OUR INTERESTS TO AVOID. IRAN MIGHT THEN BECOME PLUNGED INTO A DESTRUCTIVE CIVIL WAR FROM WHICH ONLY THE SOVIETS WILL PROFIT.

IT SEEMS TO ME THAT ZIMMERMAN MUST MOVE FAST TO IMPRESS ON YAZDI THE NEED FOR A CAREFULLY WORKED OUT SCENARIO, WHICH WILL ENTAIL UNDERSTANDINGS AMONTHE VARIOUS POWER FACTORS ONCE THE SHAH PHYSICALLY DEPARTS THE COUNTRY. IT WOULD BE TRAGIC IF THE KHOMEINI PEOPLE LET THEIR EUPHORIA CARRY THEM TO NATIONAL DISASTER. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00725.subject: PROPOSED MEETING BETWEEN IRANIAN MILITARY AND KHOMEINI SUPPORTERS

segments.text: KHOMEINI SUPPORTERS
MILITARY AND RELIGIOUS LEADERS CONTINUE TO SPAR OVER PROTOCOLARY ASPECTS OF THE MEETING THEY BOTH WISH TO HOLD. ANOTHER DAY APPEARS TO HAVE BEEN WASTED.

IN EFFORT PROD THEM ALONG, WE HAVE ADVISED BOTH SIDES OF FACT THAT TUDEH PARTY HAS CALLED FOR ARMED ACTION AGAINST THE REGIME AND TIED THIS INTO KHOMEINI'S WARNING THAT PROVOCATEURS WILL SEEK TO ENCOURAGE MILITARY

CHINESE AMBASSADOR CAME TO SEE ME MORNING JANUARY 15 TO DISCUSS LOCAL SITUATION. HIS PERCEPTION IS VERY GLOOMY. HE FEARS KHOMEINI WILL RETURN, CONFLICT WILL BREAK OUT WITH ARMY, AND MAJOR CIVIL DISTURBANCES WILL ENSUE. IN THIS IMBROGLIO, HE EXPECTS SOVIETS TO INTRODUCE TUDEH ELEMENTS AND TURN THE WHOLE AFFAIR INTO AN ANTI-AMERICAN DIRECTION.

HE ASKED WHAT WE WERE DOING TO AVERT SUCH A DISASTER. HE SPECIFICALLY WANTED TO KNOW WHAT ARRANGEMENTS WE HAD MADE WITH KHOMEINI BEFORE WE AGREED TO "TELL THE SHAH TO GO." HE WANTED TO KNOW IF KHOMEINI WOULD AGREE TO MAINTAIN INTEGRITY OF ARMED FORCES OR WOULD HE TRY TO SPLIT THEM.

I TOLD HIM SHAH WAS LEAVING AS RESULT HIS OWN DECISION AND NOT ON OUR INSTRUCTION. WE HAD NO RPT NO UNDERSTANDINGS WITH KHOMEINI, BUT WERE URGING HIS PEOPLE AND LEADERS OF ARMED FORCES TO REACH UNDERSTANDINGS WHICH WOULD AVERT CONFLICT.

AMBASSADOR IS CONVINCED SOVIETS SEE GOLDEN OPPORTUNITY TO CAUSE MAJOR TURBULENCE HERE AND WILL EXPLOIT IT TO THE HILT. THEY WILL SEEK NOT ONLY TO CONTROL CENTRAL GOVERNMENT OF IRAN BUT ALSO TO SPLIT OFF NORTHERN PROVINCES AS "INDEPENDENT REPUBLICS." HE SAYS 1979 WILL BE FAR WORSE IN THIS COUNTRY THAN 1978. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00733.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT, JAN 15, 1979 SUMMARY: KHOMEINI URGES COOPERATION WITH ARMY AGAINST HOOLIGANS. HIS ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL MEMB

segments.text: SUMMARY: KHOMEINI URGES COOPERATION WITH ARMY AGAINST HOOLIGANS. HIS ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL MEMBERS ARE ANNOUNCED. GROUP CLAIMS CREDIT FOR GRIMM ASSASSINATION. WIDESPREAD DEMONSTRATIONS INCLUDE FRATERNIZATION WITH TROOPS. SENATE APPROVES BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT. MORE DEMONSTRATIONS UNDERWAY. END SUMMARY.

WIDESPREAD DEMONSTRATIONS OCCURRED YESTERDAY BUT WERE GENERALLY WELL-DISCIPLINED AND NONVIOLENT. EXCEPTION WAS KERMAN, WHERE CROWDS REPORTEDLY DAMAGED LIQUOR STORES AND CINEMAS. CONSULATE TABRIZ REPORTS TERRORISTS ASSASSINATED A POLICE MAJOR (COMMANDER OF FIRST PRECINCT) AND HIS TWO BODYGUARDS WITH AUTOMATIC WEAPONS FIRE THIS MORNING AS THEY LEFT MAJOR'S HOUSE.

NETWORK OF "PEOPLES' JUSTICE" CONTINUES TO GAIN MOMENTUM. AYATOLLAH QOMI HAS CALLED FOR THE PEOPLE TO TAKE OVER SECURITY IN MASHAD, PROVINCIAL COMMITTEE OF THE NATIONAL FRONT HAS MADE SIMILAR APPEAL IN TABRIZ, AND PRESS EVEN REPORTS A PEOPLES COURT ACTIVE IN SMALL TOWN OF AROUMIEH NEAR REZAYIEH. COURT REPORTEDLY FINED FOUR MEN FOR EXTORTION. PRESS ALSO REPORTS TWO POLICEMEN WERE WOUNDED BY GUNFIRE SATURDAY NIGHT IN BEHBAHAN.

SAYED JALALEDDIN TEHRANI HAS BEEN NAMED CHAIRMAN OF REGENCY COUNCIL. SINCE COUNCIL IS FORMED UNDER ARTICLE 42, THERE IS NO STATUTORY REQUIREMENT AS TO ITS MEMBERSHIP. THIS IS WHY SUPREME COURT JUSTICE, FOR EXAMPLE, IS NOT ON THE COUNCIL.

ELECTRICAL WORKERS HAVE ANNOUNCED RETURN TO NIGHTLY BLACKOUTS 2015-2145, AND TELEPHONE OPERATORS WILL HENCEFORTH ADD THEIR EFFORTS WITH WORK STOPPAGE 1000-1030 DAILY, PREVENTING LONG DISTANCE CALLS WITHIN THAT HALF HOUR.

AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI ISSUED COMMUNIQUE YESTERDAY, WARNING OF AN OUTSIDE PLOT BY VESTED INTERESTS WHICH TRIES TO SET THE PEOPLE AND THE ARMY AGAINST EACH OTHER. MERCENARIES ARE ATTACKING TROOPS AND GOVERNMENT INSTALLATIONS TO MAKE ARMY THINK THAT THE PEOPLE WISH TO DESTROY THEM. "THE PUBLIC IS DUTY BOUND TO TREAT MEMBERS OF THE SECURITY AND ARMED FORCES WITH BROTHERLY KINDNESS AND TO DEFEND THEM AGAINST ANY POSSIBLE ATTACK BY THE HOOLIGANS.

THE ARMY AND MEMBERS OF THE POLICE ARE ALSO DUTY BOUND TO ACT TOWARDS THE PUBLIC WITH KINDNESS AND IN BROTHERLY MANNER AND REALIZE THAT IF ATTACKED BY HOOLIGANS THE NATION IS NOT TO BLAME BUT THAT IT IS INSPIRED BY FOREIGN AGENTS AND ADVENTURERS WHO INTEND TO MAKE TROUBLE." AYATOLLAH DAST-GHEIB OF SHIRAZ ISSUED SIMILAR WARNING.

KHOMEINI'S ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL REPORTEDLY WILL INCLUDE DR. IBRAHIM YAZDI, ENG. MEHDI BAZARGAN, SADEGH QOTBZADEH, FAZLOLLAH BANI SADR, AND RETIRED REAR ADMIRAL AHMAD MADANI. KHOMEINI'S CAMP HAS NOT CONFIRMED THE LIST.
SENATE TODAY VOTED CONFIDENCE IN BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT. VOTE WAS 38-1, WITH 2 ABSTENTIONS. MAJLIS WILL RESUME DEBATE TOMORROW.
AYATOLLAH KHONSARI OF TEHRAN HAS ISSUED OPEN LETTER TO BAKHTIAR, ADMONISHING HIM FOR HIS SLANDER TOWARD KHOMEINI.

1979TEHRAN00752.subject: MEETING WITH DR ABDOL HOSEIN ETEBAR

segments.text: PRIME MINISTER BAKHTIAR SENT HIS CONFIDANT, DR. ABDOL HOSEIN ETEBAR, TO SEE ME EVENING DECEMBER 15. HE SAID HE CAME TO PLEAD WITH ME TO HAVE U.S. SEND ENVOY TO KHOMEINI TO DISSUADE HIM FROM EARLY RETURN TO IRAN. HE SAID U.K. AND FRANCE HAD AGREED TO MAKE SUCH DEMARCHES.

I TOLD ETEBAR THAT U.S. HAD DECIDED AGAINST SENDING EMISSARY DIRECTLY TO KHOMEINI. WE WERE DEALING WITH HIM INDIRECTLY THROUGH THE FRENCH AND THROUGH ONE OF HIS AIDES, DR. YAZDI. DR. ETEBAR SAID THIS WAS INADEQUATE; WE MUST ENGAGE KHOMEINI'S EGO BY DEALING WITH HIM DIRECTLY. MOREOVER, WE MUST DEAL WITH HIM FORCEFULLY AND MAKE HIM UNDERSTAND THAT THERE IS A MILITARY THREAT TO HIM. HE SAID THIS WOULD, OF COURSE, BE THE IRANIAN MILITARY,BUT IT WOULD ASSUME REAL PROPORTIONS IF THE THREAT WERE VOICED BY THE AMERICANS.

ETEBAR SAID THAT KHOMEINI HAD TO BE TREATED LIKE AN AIRPLANE HIJACKER. ALL OF US HAD TO KEEP TALKING TO HIM IN ORDER TO MAKE SURE HE STAYS AWAY FROM IRAN. IN A MONTH, BAKHTIAR WOULD BE ABLE TO TAKE AWAY ENOUGH OF KHOMEINI'S SUPPORT WITHIN COUNTRY SO THAT HE COULD AFFORD TO LET HIM RETURN WITHOUT FEAR. HOWEVER, IF HE CAME BACK IN THE IMMEDIATE FUTURE, THERE WOULD BE DISASTER.
I SAID I WOULD CONVEY BAKHTIAR'S VIEWS TO WASHINGTON, BUT GAVE HIM NO RPT NO ASSURANCE THEY WOULD RESULT IN POSITIVE ACTION WITH RESPECT TO DIRECT U.S. CONTACT WITH KHOMEINI.
ETEBAR SAID HE HIMSELF WOULD GO TO FRANCE WEDNESDAY TO MEET WITH SOME OF KHOMEINI'S ADVISERS. SULLIVAN

BELIEVE IT IS HIGHLY IMPORTANT THAT ZIMMERMAN SEE YAZDI AGAIN WITHOUT DELAY. YAZDI SHOULD BE TOLD CANDIDLY THAT IRANIAN MILITARY HAVE SERIOUSLY DISCUSSED COUP D'ETAT UPON SHAH'S DEPARTURE FROM IRAN. HE SHOULD ALSO BE TOLD THAT GENERAL HUYSER FEELS CONFIDENT HE HAS TALKED THEM OUT OF THIS ACTION AND THAT THEY WILL REMAIN CALM DURING THAT PERIOD, PROVIDED TROOPS ARE NOT RPT NOT PROVOKED.

IN THIS REGARD, ZIMMERMAN COULD TELL YAZDI THAT WE BELIEVE KHOMEINI STATEMENT CALLING ON HIS FOLLOWERS TO "PROTECT THE IRANIAN ARMY" WAS A VERY SALUTARY ACTION. IRANIAN ARMED FORCES, HOWEVER, ARE VERY MUCH AWARE OF TSTEH CALL FOR "ARMED ACTION" AND FEAR THERE WILL BE CALCULATED TUDEH EFFORT TO PRECIPITATE CLASHES BETWEEN MILITARY AND KHOMEINI FOLLOWERS. THEY SEE THIS AS POSSIBLY OCCURRING IF KHOMEINI SHOULD SUDDENLY RETURN TO IRAN AFTER SHAH'S DEPARTURE.

IN ANY EVENT, HUYSER IS LESS THAN CONFIDENT ABOUT POSSIBLE MILITARY REACTIONS TO SUDDEN RETURN OF KHOMEINI TO IRAN. MILITARY LEADERS GIVE SERIOUS INDICATIONS THEY MIGHT ACT IN THAT CONTEXT "TO PROTECT THE CONSTITUTION."

IT IS FOR THIS REASON THAT WE BELIEVE IT ESSENTIAL THAT AUTHORITATIVE REPRESENTATIVES OF KHOMEINI MEET WITH THE MILITARY TO REACH SOME BASIC UNDERSTANDINGS. IN OUR JUDGMENT, MILITARY AND RELIGIOUS HAVE MUCH IN COMMON WHICH SHOULD NOT RPT NOT BE OBSCURED OR DESTROYED BY TUDEH MACHINATIONS.

ZIMMERMAN COULD TELL YAZDI THAT MILITARY ARE PREPARED TO MEET WITH AUTHORITATIVE KHOMEINI REPRESENTATIVES. HE COULD INFORM HIM THAT THOSE MILITARY WHO WOULD BE INVOLVED ARE GENERAL GHARABAGHI AND THE CHIEFS OF THE THREE SERVICES. HE SHOULD EMPHASIZE URGENCY OF THIS COURSE OF ACTION. R

IN MEANTIME, YAZDI SHOULD URGE KHOMEINI TO DELAY ANY PLANS FOR RETURN TO IRAN UNTIL SOME BASIC AGREEMENTS CAN BE WORKED OUT WHICH WOULD PERMIT HIS ORDERLY ARRIVAL HERE. WE WOULD ALSO HOPE KHOMEINI WOULD REFRAIN FROM ACTIONS WHICH WOULD PRECIPITATE COLLAPSE OF BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT. SUCH AN EVENT MIGHT ALSO CAUSE NERVOUS MILITARY TO MOVE TO A TAKE-OVER. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00763.subject: PROPOSED MEETING BETWEEN IRANIAN MILITARY AND KHOMEINI SUPPORTERS

segments.text: KHOMEINI SUPPORTERS

THERE HAS BEEN MINOR BREAKTHROUGH IN THE EFFORT TO BRING MILITARY AND RELIGIOUS LEADERS TOGETHER. GENERAL MOGHADAM TELEPHONED MEHDI BAZARGAN EVENING JANUARY 15 AND AGREED MEET WITH BAZARGAN AND BEHESHTI AT BEHESHTI'S HOUSE IN ORDER DISCUSS FURTHER MODALITIES FOR MILITARYRELIGIOUS DIALOGUE.

AS OF NOON, JANUARY 16, WE HAVE NO RPT NO CONFIRMATION SUCH MEETING HAS ACTUALLY TAKEN PLACE AND THERE ARE SOME INDICATIONS THAT BEHESHTI IS HOLDING OUT FOR MORE SENIOR MILITARY REPRESENTATION. SULLIVAN
MAJLES VOTE APPROVED BAKHTIAR GOVT MORNING JAN 16 BY 149 FOR, 43 AGAINST, 13 ABSTAINING.

PRESS CONFERENCE AT AIRPORT AT WHICH SHAH WAS REPORTEDLY TO APPEAR MORNING JAN 16 WAS CANCELLED (SOME SAY POSTPONED) AT LAST MOMENT. SOME PRESSMEN ARE REPORTING SHAH LEFT THIS MORNING. OTHERS ARE SCURRYING AROUND TRYING TO ESTABLISH HIS WHEREABOUTS. SULLIVAN
BAKHTIAR COMPLETED THE PARLIAMENTARY PROCESS OF APPROVAL LATE MORNING JANUARY 16 AND THE SHAH LEFT THE COUNTRY TWO HOURS LATER. THE IRANIAN NATION WILL NOW ADDRESS BAKHTIAR'S CHANCES FOR SURVIVAL.

THESE CHANCES WILL BE DETERMINED BY THE ACTIONS OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI. IF, AS SOME OF HIS SUPPORTERS ARE URGING, HE DECIDES TO COME IMMEDIATELY TO IRAN, IT IS PREDICTABLE THAT BAKHTIAR WILL COLLAPSE RAPIDLY. IN FACT, WE HAVE ONE WELL SOURCED REPORT THAT HE WILL RESIGN. IF, ON THE OTHER HAND, KHOMEINI STAYS IN PARIS WHILE HIS FOLLOWERS WORK OUT SOME UNDERSTANDINGS HERE IN TEHRAN, IT IS POSSIBLE THAT BAKHTIAR MIGHT SURVIVE LONG ENOUGH TO PRESIDE OVER AN ORDERLY TRANSITION.

THE INCENTIVES FOR KHOMEINI TO COME IMMEDIATELY TO IRAN ARE HIGH. AS THE SYMBOL OF THE SHAH'S DEFEAT, AND AS THE CENTER OF POPULAR EMOTION, HE IS AT THE PEAK OF HIS POWER. IF HE COMES IMMEDIATELY IN THE WAKE OF THE SHAH'S DEPARTURE, HE WILL DOUBTLESS SWEEP AWAY ALL THE VESTIGES OF THE PAHLAVI REGIME AS WELL AS THE MONARCHY ITSELF. HOWEVER, IN SO DOING, THERE IS A GRAVE DANGER THAT HE MAY PROVOKE THE MILITARY TO COUNTERACTION AND PLUNGE THE COUNTRY INTO A BLOODBATH.

ON THE OTHER HAND, IF HE DELAYS HIS ARRIVAL UNTIL SOME BASIC UNDERSTANDINGS CAN BE WORKED OUT WITH THE MILITARY AND WITH OTHER ELEMENTS OF THE CURRENT CONSTITUTIONAL SYSTEM, THE PEAK OF HIS SYMBOLIC POWER WILL PASS RATHER RAPIDLY, AND THOSE WHO SUPPORTED HIM BECAUSE OF THEIR COMMON OPPOSITION TO THE SHAH WILL BEGIN TO ASSERT THEIR OWN INTERESTS, MANY OF WHICH DIVERGE SHARPLY FROM KHOMEINI'S IDEAS OF AN "ISLAMIC REPUBLIC."

IN THIS LATTER CIRCUMSTANCE, THERE MIGHT BE ENOUGH ELEMENTS IN IRANIAN SOCIETY, ESPECIALLY IN THE BAZAAR AND THE BUREAUCRACY, AS WELL AS IN THE MODERATE CLERGY, WHICH WOULD PREFER SOME INSTITUTIONAL FUTURE OTHER THAN KHOMEINI'S "ISLAMIC REPUBLIC." IF THESE PEOPLE, COMBINED WITH THE ARMED FORCES, HAVE THE COURAGE TO ASSERT THEIR VIEWS, THEY MIGHT GIVE ENOUGH TANGIBLE SUPPORT TO BAKHTIAR TO PERMIT HIM TO CREATE A CONSTRUCTIVE WAY OUT OF THE CURRENT CHAOS.

THEREFORE, THE FATE OF BAKHTIAR, AS WELL AS THE INTERESTS OF THE UNITED STATES AND OTHER NON-COMMUNIST COUNTRIES, RESTS UPON THE WHIMS AND AMBITIONS OF ONE OLD MAN IN PARIS. IF HE IS PREPARED TO RISK CIVIL WAR IN ORDER TO REALIZE HIS DREAM OF AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC, HIS EARLY RETURN COULD CONVERT HIS VICTORY INTO DISASTER. IF, ON THE OTHER HAND, HE IS PREPARED TO ACT RESPONSIBLY AND SEEK SOME POLITICAL CONSENSUS BEFORE HE MOVES, HE CAN PROBABLY ASSURE THE ABDICATION OF THE SHAH, BUT MAY HAVE TO SETTLE FOR CONSTITUTIONAL FORMS WHICH FALL SHORT OF HIS POLITICAL DREAMS.
IF HE OPTS FOR THE LATTER COURSE, BAKHTIAR MAY HAVE AN IMPORTANT ROLE TO PLAY IN A TRANSITION PERIOD WHICH COULD EXTEND FOR SEVERAL WEEKS.

AT EMBASSY'S REQUEST MR. YOUSSEF KHORASSANI-GHADIMI, A MEMBER OF THE BAHAI COMMUNITY ADMINISTRATION IN TEHRAN, BRIEFED POL COUNSELOR ON JAN 16. HE SAID IRAN IS THE CENTER OF THE BAHAI RELIGION, SPREAD OVER 3,000 LOCALITIES IN THE COUNTRY. WHENEVER THERE ARE OVER NINE BAHAI MEMBERS THEY ANNUALLY ELECT A 9-MEMBER SPIRITUAL ASSEMBLY BY SECRET UNIVERSAL BALLOT. THERE ARE SUCH ASSEMBLIES IN 18 THOUSAND LOCALITIES, IN 135 COUNTRIES. BAHAIS LIVE IN OVER 80 THOUSAND LOCALITIES THROUGHOUT THE WORLD. HE PUT THE TOTAL NUMBERS OF BAHAIS IN IRAN AS A FEW HUNDRED THOUSAND, ABOUT 70 THOUSAND IN TEHRAN.

THUS BAHAIS ARE THE LARGEST MINORITY IN IRAN. THEY ARE NOT OFFICIALLY RECOGNIZED BUT ARE TOLERATED. CONTRARY TO SHIA BELIEF THEY ARE NOT A SECRET RELIGION AND DO NOT PRACTICE THE DOCTRINE OF "CONCEALMENT" AS THE SHIAS DO. IN FACT, BAHAIS ARE OBLIGED TO DECLARE THEIR FAITH WHEN ASKED AND ARE CONSIDERED TO HAVE LEFT THE COMMUNITY IF THEY DENY IT. BAHAIS VIEW THEIR RELIGION AS HAVING SPRUNG OUT OF SHIA BRANCH OF ISLAM JUST AS CHRISTIANITY SPRANG OUT OF JUDAISM. THIS IS A UNIVERSAL DOCTRINE AND RECOGNIZES MOHAMMAD AS A PROPHET ALONG WITH OTHER PROPHETS OF OTHER RELIGIONS.

BAHAIS ARE SUFFERING SOME PERSECUTION IN IRAN, AT PRESENT, PARTLY BECAUSE THEY ARE ACCUSED OF BEING INVOLVED IN POLITICS. IN FACT, BAHAIS ARE NOT PERMITTED TO INVOLVE THEMSELVES IN POLITICS AND WILL BE EXPELLED IF THEY GO BEYOND LOYAL SERVICE TO THE LEGAL GOVT OF THE MOMENT.

FORMER PM HOVEYDA AND OTHER MINISTERS HAVE BEEN ACCUSED OF BEING BAHAI. THIS IS NOT TRUE. NONE OF THEM ARE BAHAI. THE PRESS HAS DONE THE BAHAIS A GREAT DISSERVICE BY FALSE ACCUSATIONS WHICH EXCITE THE PEOPLE. EVEN UNDER THE SHAH'S GOVT, BAHAIS ASKED TO BE EXCUSED FROM THE REQUIREMENT THE SHAH TRIED TO IMPOSE OF JOINING THE RASTAKHIZ PARTY. THE GOVT TOLERATED THEIR LACK OF ACTIVITY IN RASTAKHIZ. NEVERTHELESS, BAHAIS ARE BECOMING THE SCAPEGOAT OF RELIGIOUS SENTIMENT. THE TOP SHIA LEADERS CONSIDER BAHAISM SCHISMATIC AND A SECT, NEITHER ONE OF WHICH IS TRUE, BUT IT IS DAMAGING IN THE PRESENT CIRCUMSTANCES.

THE WORST INCIDENTS INVOLVING BAHAIS WERE IN SHIRAZ ABOUT A MONTH AGO (SEE 78 TEHRAN 12343) AND IN THE AZERBAIJAN TOWN OF MEINDOAB, NEAR REZAIEH, A COUPLE OF WEEKS AGO. SOME 80 BAHAI HOMES WERE LOOTED AND BURNED BY MOBS IN MEINDOAB. TWO BAHAI MEN WERE KILLED AS WELL AS TWO IN SHIRAZ, AND ONE ELSEWHERE. SUCH INCIDENTS HAVE ALSO OCCURRED IN VILLAGES AROUND HAMADAN. BAHAIS ARE DEEPLY CONCERNED FOR THEIR FUTURE, SINCE ONLY A FEW OF THE VERY WELL TO DO HAVE LEFT THE COUNTRY. THE REST REMAIN.

ONE RECENT DISTURBING FACTOR WAS THE STATEMENT BY NEW P.M. BAKHTIAR IN AN INTERVIEW TO THE PRESS THAT HIS GOVT WILL PROTECT THE THREE "LEGAL MINORITIES." THIS IS A REFERENCE TO THE SEATS RESERVED IN THE ELECTORAL LAW FOR CHRISTIANS, JEWS AND ZOROASTRIANS. HOWEVER, THE CONSTITUTION GUARANTEES THE RIGHTS OF EVERY IRANIAN CITIZEN. USING THE TERM "LEGAL" FOR ONLY THREE MINORITIES SUGGESTS THE BAHAIS ARE "ILLEGAL." THIS IS SOMETHING WHICH WORRIES THE BAHAI COMMUNITY.

FINALLY, KHORASSANI-GHADIMI NOTED THAT BAHAIS WORKED CLOSELY WITH THE UNITED NATIONS, AS ONE OF THE NON-GOVT ORGANIZATIONS (NGOS). THEY HAVE CONSULTATIVE STATUS IN ECOSOC AND UNICEF AND GENERALLY WORK ON MANY WORLD-WIDE CAUSES. THEY HAVE NOT BEEN ACTIVE IN IRAN BECAUSE THE GOVT HAS NOT PERMITTED SUCH INTERNATIONAL ACTIVITY HERE.
SOURCE WAS AWARE MUCH OF THIS INFORMATION MIGHT BE USED FOR PUBLIC PRESENTATION IN CONNECTION WITH CONGRESSIONAL TESTIMONY. SUGGEST SOURCE BE ANONYMOUS. SULLIVAN
