LARGEST COMMUNITIES ARE IN TEHRAN, YAZD, AND KERMAN, WITH SMALLER GROUPS (200-300) IN OTHER MAJOR CITIES SUCH AS SHIRAZ, ISFAHAN, AND ELSEWHERE.

SEVERAL ZOROASTRIAN CONTACTS, INCLUDING TEMPLE HEAD, SAY THERE HAS BEEN NO RPT NO PHYSICAL CAMPAIGN AGAINST ZOROASTRIANS, THOUGH SEVERAL ZOROASTRIANS HAVE BEEN DISMISSED FROM GOVERNMENT POSTS IN PAST SIX MONTHS. THUS COMMUNITY IS SOMEWHAT NERVOUS, BUT LESS SO THAN OTHERS.

GENERAL ESTIMATES FROM SEVERAL CHRISTIAN SOURCES PLACE CHRISTIANS AT OFFICIAL TOTAL OF 200,000. THIS INCLUDES ARMENIANS, ASSYRIANS, AND RESIDUAL NUMBER OF CATHOLICS AND PROTESTANTS, INCLUDING EXPATRIATE COMMUNITY. TO BEST OF OUR KNOWLEDGE, THERE HAVE BEEN NO RPT NO INCIDENTS DIRECTED AT ANY OF THE CHRISTIAN COMMUNITIES, THOUGH THERE HAVE BEEN SOME INDIVIDUAL PROBLEMS AND NERVOUSNESS HAS BEEN HIGH AMONG THE ASSYRIANS ON OCCASION.

RECENT CALMING ELAMIYEHS (ANNOUNCEMENTS) BY ISLAMIC CLERGY LEADERS ORGANIZATION (CLO) AS WELL AS STATEMENTS BY INDIVIDUAL MULLAHS AND AYATOLLAHS HAVE REDUCED GENERAL TENSENESS SOMEWHAT. CROWD BEHAVIOR IN WAKE OF SHAH'S DEPARTURE JAN 16 WILL OFFER NEXT MAJOR TEST OF IRANIAN

AMIR ENTEZAM, LIBERATION MOVEMENT OF IRAN (LMI) CENTRAL COMMITTEE MEMBER TELEPHONED POLOFF ABOUT AN HOUR AND A HALF AFTER SHAH'S PLANE LEFT TO INFORM EMBASSY AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI WILL NOT RPT NOT BE RETURNING TO IRAN "IN THE NEAR FUTURE." HE KEYED THIS DECISION TO POSSIBLE SECURITY PROBLEMS.

ABOVE REPRESENTS LMI'S BEST INFORMATION, BUT ADDRESSEES SHOULD NOTE THAT A) TIME FRAME IS UNSPECIFIED, AND B) LMI IN RECENT DAYS HAS COOLED ON IDEA OF IMMEDIATE KHOMEINI RETURN. KHOMEINI'S PARIS ENTOURAGE MAY HAVE OTHER IDEAS WHICH COULD CHANGE KHOMEINI'S INTENTION ON SHORT NOTICE.

1979TEHRAN00790.subject: SOME INFORMATION ON ALI SHARIATI, SHIA RELIGIOUS PHILOSOPHER

segments.text: THE FOLLOWING BRIEF INFORMATION ON THE WELL-KNOWN SHIITE MOSLEM PHILOSOPHER ALI SHARIATI, WHO DIED UNDER SOMEWHAT MYSTERIOUS CIRCUMSTANCES IN LONDON A COUPLE OF YEARS AGO, COMES MAINLY FROM DR. NASREDDIN SAHEBZAMANI. IT IS SUBMITTED IN PARTIAL CONTRIBUTION TO OUR ONGOING STUDY OF THE SHIA RELIGION'S ROLE IN POLITICS (ALSO DEPARTMENT REF AIRGRAM). DR. SAHEBZAMANI ISA RECOGNIZED AUTHORITY ON MOSLEM THOUGHT. HE HAS WRITTEN A VARIETY OF BOOKS INCLUDING SOME ON PSYCHOLOGY, HIS FIELD OF PRIMARY STUDY.

HE SERVED UNTIL A FEW MONTHS AGO AS CHIEF OF THE MENTAL HEALTH PROGRAM IN THE MINISTRY OF HEALTH, THEN "RETIRED HIMSELF." HE HAS TAUGHT RELIGION IN SHARIATMADARI'S SCHOOL IN QOM, AND CLAIMS CLOSE RELATIVES OF BOTH KHOMEINI AND SHARIAT-MADARI AS HIS FORMER STUDENTS. OF GERMANIC TRAINING, HE SPENT SOME TIME IN THE PRESENCE OF BERTRAND RUSSELL IN ENGLAND. HE HAS SOME AXES TO GRIND, SO EVERYTHING HE SAYS IS NOT NECESSARILY CONCLUSIVE. AT ANY RATE FOLLOWING IS WHAT HE TOLD POL COUNSELOR ABOUT ALI SHARIATI.

SHARIATI WAS THE SON OF A WELL-KNOWN MULLAH, MOHAMMAD TAGHI SHARIATI, WHO IS STILL ALIVE AND HAS WRITTEN A NUMBER OF SCHOLARLY WORKS, BUT HAS NOT ACHIEVED THE FAME OF HIS SON. SHARIATI EARLY IN LIFE FELL UNDER THE INFLUENCE OF THE FRENCH ISLAMIC SCHOLAR MASSINGNON. HE TRANSLATED A NUMBER OF MASSINGNON'S ARTICLES ON ISLAM INTO FARSI AND WAS CRITICIZED BY SOME FOR GOING TO A FOREIGN SOURCE TO GET INFORMATION ON HIS OWN RELIGION. IN TIME, SHARIATI SAW THAT ONE OF THE MAIN PROBLEMS OF HIS GENERATION OF YOUTH IS AN INFERIORITY COMPLEX VIS-A-VIS WESTERNERS AND WESTERN THINKING.

HE STUDIED MARXISM, AS DID MOST STUDENTS OF HIS GENERATION, AND CONCLUDED THAT ITS MAIN TEACHINGS WERE: 1) SPREADING ECONOMIC BENEFITS TO THE POOR AND 2) USING REVOLUTIONARY METHODS, INCLUDING VIOLENCE, AS NEEDED. HE THEN PREACHED THAT ISLAM ITSELF CONTAINED THESE DOCTRINES. ISLAM, PARTICULARLY SHIITE ISLAM, HAD OFTEN BEEN CRITICIZED BY CHRISTIAN SCHOLARS FOR ITS BELIEF IN SPREADING THE KORAN BY FIRE AND SWORD. THEREFORE, ALI SHARIATI SAID, MOSLEM YOUTH DO NOT HAVE TO LOOK TO MARXISM, BUT EXAMINE THEIR OWN RELIGION FOR ALL THE DOGMA NECESSARY TO IMPROVE THE WORLD.

THIS THESIS BECAME THE BASIS FOR ALI SHARIATI'S MANY WRITINGS, WHICH IN SOME CASES ATTACKED MARXISM DIRECTLY. IT ALSO BECAME A REVOLUTIONARY CALL TO ARMS FOR MANY YOUNG PEOPLE. IT WAS INSTITUTIONALIZED WITH THE CREATION OF THE HOSSEINIYEH ERSHAD IN TEHRAN, ABOUT 1969. THIS BECAME AS A MEETING PLACE FOR WHICH THE WELL KNOWN IRANIAN PHILANTHROPIST MR. HOMAYOUN (NO RELATION TO DARIUSH) PROVIDED THE FUNDS. DR. NASSER MINATCHI, WHOM SAHEBZAMANI HAS KNOWN SINCE CHILDHOOD, CONTRIBUTED THE LEGAL AND MANAGEMENT SKILLS SINCE HE IS AN EXCEEDINGLY AMBITIOUS MAN. ALI SHARIATI WAS THE STAR PERFORMER.

THIS INSTITUTION ATTRACTED MANY YOUNG PEOPLE, WHO WERE THUS GIVEN ARGUMENTS TO DEFEND THEIR MOSLEM RELIGION AGAINST COLLEAGUES IN THE UNIVERSITIES WHO PREACHED MARXISM. MINATCHI VOICED PLANS TO TURN THE ORGANIZATION INTO A UNIVERSITY. SAHEBZAMANI, WHO HIMSELF HAD BEEN A GUEST SPEAKER THERE, MADE THE SUGGESTION A RESEARCH INSTITUTE SE CREATED, WHERE FOREIGN SCHOLARS COULD BE GIVEN BOARD AND LODGING IN PROXIMITY TO A GOOD LIBRARY WHERE THEY COULD STUDY ABOUT ISLAM AND THUS RAISE ISLAM'S PRESTIGE IN THE WORLD. NONE OF THESE PLANS CAME TO FRUITION DUE TO SAVAK INTERVENTION.

A FEW YEARS AGO SAVAK ARRESTED HOMAYOUN, AN ELDERLY MAN WHO HAD MADE MUCH OF HIS FORTUNE IN BRITIAN, AND HELD HIM IN DETENTION OVERNIGHT. REPORTEDLY THEY PREVENTED HIM FROM GOING TO THE TOILET UNTIL HE HAD SIGNED OVER THE HOSSEINIYEH ERSHAD PROPERTY TO SAVAK. IT WAS THEN CLOSED DOWN. AS AN ASIDE, SAHEBZAMANI NOTED THAT MR. HOMAYOUN LATER PAID TO REPAIR THE WALLS OF THE HOSSEINIYEH ERSHAD, ALTHOUGH IT NO LONGER BELONGED TO HIM. HE REPLIED TO QUERIES ON THIS SCORE BY SAYING THE INSTITUTION WOULD REMAIN LONG AFTER HE AND SAVAK WERE GONE.

THE HOSSEINIYEH ERSHAD HAS BEEN REOPENED IN RECENT MONTHS AND MINATCHI PRESIDES OVER IT. SAHEBZAMANI (WHO OBVIOUSLY DISLIKES MINATCHI) SAYS THERE ARE OTHERS WHO HAD AS MUCH INFLUENCE AS ALI SHARIATI THROUGH THEIR WRITINGS. HE GAVE AS AN EXAMPLE THE LATE AYATOLLAH NASSER MAKAREM, EIDTOR OF THE RELIGIOUS PUBLICATION "MAKTAB ISLAM" WHICH WAS WIDELY READ (CIRCULATION OVER 60,000). NEVER------------------075349 161558Z /45 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 3052 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 00790 NOFORN THELESS, ALI SHARIATI'S DRAMATIC DEATH IN LONDON RAISED HIM IN THE ESTIMATE OF YOUTH. SHARIATI (IN HIS EARLY 40S) WAS A CHAIN SMOKER AND COULD HAVE DIED OF NATURAL CAUSES.

THE OFFICIAL CAUSE OF DEATH WAS GIVEN AS HEART ATTACK. (HOWEVER, ANOTHER SOURCE RECENTLY TOLD VISITING DEPT OFFICER ESCUDERO THAT ALI SHARIATI GOT TO LONDON ONLY BECAUSE IMMIGRATION OFFICIALS DID NOT CATCH THE NAME HE HAD BEEN BORN UNDER IN HIS PASSPORT--WHICH REPORTEDLY WAS NOT SHARIATI CONTRARY TO SAHEBZAMANI'S INFORMATION--BUT THEN ARRESTED HIS WIFE AND HELD HER HOSTAGE FOR HIS RETURN TO THE COUNTRY. RATHER THAN RETURN,SHARIATI ALLEGEDLY COMMITTED SUICIDE BY FALLING DOWN SOME STAIRS.

WE ARE UNABLE TO EVALUATE WHICH OF THESE STORIES IS TRUE, EXCEPT THAT WE HAVE HEARD OF SHARIATI AND OF HIS DEATH FROM A VARIETY OF SOURCES OVER THE PAST TWO YEARS WITHOUT THIS LATEST VERSION COMING TO OUR EARS.)

THE CONNECTION BETWEEN SHARIATI AND KHOMEINI IS NOT CLEAR, ANY MORE THAN BETWEEN SHARIATI AND THE MUJAHEDDIN MOVEMENT. SAHEBZAMANI TOLD US ON A PREVIOUS OCCASION THAT SHARIATI AND MINATCHI WERE NOT IN FAVOR WITH THE MORE CONSERVATIVE SHIA LEADERS BECAUSE OF THE REVOLUTIONARY DOCTRINE OF FIRE AND SWORD IN SHARIATI'S TEACHINGS.

INSOFAR AS SHARIATI HAD INFLUENCE AMONG UNIVERSITY AND OTHER YOUTH, THIS WOULD ACCOUNT FOR THE GOVT'S INVENTION OF THE TERM "ISLAMIC MARXISTS." SAHEBAZAMANI DESCRIPTION OF THE MUJAHEDDIN IS THAT THEY ARE REBELLIOUS YOUTH TO WHOM THEIR ELDERS HAVE NEVER BEEN ABLE TO TALK OPENLY BECAUSE OF THE STUPID INTERFERENCE OF SAVAK, WHICH HAS BEEN KNOWN TO IMPRISON PEOPLE FOR THE MERE POSSESSION OF A BOOK ON MARXISM EVEN WHEN THOSE PEOPLE WERE ANTI-MARXISTS. THUS REDUCED TO THEIR OWN RESOURCES, WITHOUT GUIDANCE FROM THEIR ELDERS, THESE YOUTHS HAVE ORGANIZED LITTLE CELLS FOR VIOLENT ACTION, DRAWING DOGMATIC INSPIRATION FROM MANY SOURCES. ALI SHARIATI'S TEACHINGS ARE AMONG THE MOST IMPORTANT OF THOSE SOURCES.

THOSE WHO HAVE VISITED KHOMEINI ENTOURAGE IN PARIS SAY SHARIATI'S WORKS ABOUND THERE, AND HE IS CLEARLY MOST IMPORTANT SOURCE OF INSPIRATION FOR POLITICS OF KHOMEINI MOVEMENT, ESPECIALLY SINCE KHOMEINI'S IDEAS ARE SO GENERAL. EMBOFFS HAVE NOTED FROM PERSONAL OBSERVATION THAT SHARIATI'S WORKS CURRENTLY MAKE UP OVERWHELMING MAJORITY OF MATERIAL ON SALE BY ISLAMIC MOVEMENT STREET VENDORS IN TEHRAN AND OTHER MAJOR CITIES. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00791.subject: PROPOSED MEETING BETWEEN IRANIAN MILITARY AND KHOMEINI SUPPORTERS

segments.text: IRANIAN MILITARY INFORM US THAT MEETING AMONG MOGHADAM, BAZARGAN AND BEHESHTI IS CURRENTLY SCHEDULED FOR THURSDAY, JANUARY 18, AT HOUSE OF BEHESHTI.

IT SHOULD BE UNDERSTOOD THAT THIS SESSION WILL BE PURELY PROCEDURAL, WITH PRIME PURPOSE BEING TO WORK OUT AGREED VENUE FOR SUBSTANTIVE MEETINGS TO FOLLOW. THIS LEISURELY PACE COULD BE RAPIDLY OVERTAKEN BY EVENTS IF KHOMEINI DECIDES UPON EARLY RETURN TO IRAN. SULLIVAN

AFTER NEWS OF SHAH'S DEPARTURE WAS BROADCAST BY NATIONAL RADIO, CITY OF TEHRAN HAS BURST INTO PAROXISM OF EMOTION. MOTORISTS ARE SURGING THROUGH THE STREETS WITH HORNS BLARING AND LIGHTS BLINKING. YOUNG PEOPLE ARE RUSHING ABOUT CARRYING THE NEWS ON JURY-MADE POSTERS, AND DEMONSTRATIONS ARE FORMING.

AS OF 1600, THE MOOD OF THE CELEBRANTS IS FESTIVE AND WE HAVE NO RPT NO REPORTS OF VIOLENCE. STREET IN FRONT OF EMBASSY IS JAMMED WITH HOOTING AUTOS, WHICH ARE EITHER STATIONARY OR MOVING AT SNAIL'S PACE BECAUSE OF CONGESTION FURTHER EAST. ALTHOUGH THEY ARE NOISY, NONE OF THEIR EMOTION SEEMS DIRECTED AT EMBASSY.

FULL CONTINGENT OF TROOPS ASSIGNED TO GUARD EMBASSY IS MAINTAINING GOOD DISCIPLINE, BUT SHOWING SOME SIGNS OF EDGINESS. NO RPT NO PROVOCATIVE ACTION BY CROWDS TOWARDS TROOPS. NO RPT NO WARNING SHOTS HAVE BEEN FIRED.
WE HAVE JUST RECEIVED REPORT OF SOME SHOOTING IN TAJRISH AREA. REPORTEDLY THERE HAVE BEEN CASUALTIES.

1979TEHRAN00794.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT, JAN 16, 1979 SUMMARY: SHAH DEPARTS; BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT APPROVED. QARABAGHI SAYS THERE WILL BE NO MILITARY COUP. AM

segments.text: SUMMARY: SHAH DEPARTS; BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT APPROVED. QARABAGHI SAYS THERE WILL BE NO MILITARY COUP. AMINI TO MEET WITH KHOMEINI. TUDEH PARTY CALLS FOR ARMED STRUGGLE. PEACEFUL DEMONSTRATIONS YESTERDAY AND TODAY. MAJLIS CONTINUES DEBATE OVER BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT. CROWDS FRATERNIZE WITH TROOPS. END SUMMARY.

LOCAL RADIO IS CARRYING SPECIAL ANNOUNCEMENT THAT SHAH DEPARTED TODAY (AT 1308 LOCAL) AFTER WISHING BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT AND IRANIAN PEOPLE ALL THE BEST CHEERING CROWDS ARE GATHERING IN THE STREETS. MAJLIS EARLIER APPROVED BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT BY VOTE 149-43-13. MEANWHILE GENERAL ABBAS QARABAGHI, CHIEF OF SUPREME COMMANDER'S STAFF, STATED IN PRESS CONFERENCE YESTERDAY THAT THERE WILL BE NO MILITARY COUP. HE DECLARED ALLEGIANCE TO THE CONSTITUTION AND SAID "WE WILL SUPPORT THE LEGAL GOVERNMENT". HE CALLED ON PEOPLE NOT TO PROVOKE THE ARMY, WHICH INTERVENED ONLY TO PRESERVE ORDER, AND WARNED OF ALIEN INSPIRED CONSPIRATORS WHO SEEK DISORDER.

HE LEFT OPEN THE POSSIBILITY, AS WELL, THAT SOME TROOPS MIGHT NOT OBEY ORDERS. "NO ONE CAN GUARANTEE THAT REVOLTS WILL NOT OCCUR IN THE ARMY, BUT ONE THING WE CAN SAY IS THAT WE WILL STRONGLY CRUSH ANY SUCH ATTEMPTS."

DEMONSTRATIONS TOOK PLACE THROUGHOUT IRAN YESTERDAY. THEY WERE GENERALLY PEACEFUL AND IN FACT CONCENTRATED UPON WINNING OVER THE TROOPS. IN ONE LOCATION AFTER ANOTHER, CROWDS WALKED UP TO TROOPS, SHOUTING "SOLDIERS ARE OUR BROTHERS". THEY PLACED FLOWERS IN GUN MUZZLES AND CALLED FOR THE TROOPS TO JOIN THE CHANTING. TO SOME EXTENT THEY SUCCEEDED. SOLDIERS PERMITTED MULLAHS TO CLIMB ON THEIR VEHICLES TO LEAD ANTI-SHAH CHEERS, WHILE OTHER TROOPS ACCEPTED PICTURES OF KHOMEINI, AND SOME EVEN RODE ON THE SHOULDERS OF THE CROWD. WHILE MANY OR MOST SOLDIERS MAY HAVE REFUSED THIS FRATERNIZATION, LOCAL PRESS IS HAVING A FIELD DAY WITH THOSE WHO WENT ALONG.

LARGEST TEHRAN GATHERING WAS IN BAZAAR. PRESS REPORTS ONE GROUP SHOUTED "THE ONLY PARTY IS THE COMMUNIST PARTY", BUT THAT THEY WERE OUTNUMBERED BY THE RELIGIOUS GROUP. A CASSETTE TAPE WHICH IS RECEIVING WIDE DISTRIBUTION PURPORTS TO CARRY A CALL FROM KHOMEINI FOR CIVIL WAR. ONLY NEW REPORTED VIOLENCE IN IRAN WAS ATTACK ON SAVAK HEADQUARTERS IN MASJED-E-SALEMAN, IN WHICH ONE PERSON DIED AND 8 WERE INJURED. AN AUTOMOBILE DEALERSHIP IN TEHRAN WAS DESTROYED LAST NIGHT.
ALI AMINI SAID YESTERDAY HE PLANS TO GO TO PARIS TO ASK KHOMEINI TO RETURN TO IRAN.

ACCORDING TO PRESS REPORTS FROM PARIS (AFP), TUDEH PARTY ISSUED COMMUNIQUE DATED JAN 13 WHICH APPEALED FOR "ARMED STRUGGLE" TO FINISH THE REGIME. COMMUNIQUE URGED OPPOSITION LEADERS TO JOIN "UNITED FRONT FOR NATIONAL LIBERATION". RANKING OFFICERS AND PATRIOTIC SOLDIERS ARE ALSO TO FORM CELLS OF THE UNITED FRONT.

WE STILL LACK FULL DETAILS ON THE DEATH OF RETIRED LT COL MARTIN BERKOVITZ OF PARSONS-JURDEN IN KERMAN. WE DO KNOW THAT IT WAS MURDER AND HIS CAR WAS STOLEN. LOCAL PRESS (FREE BUT UNRELIABLE) IS PLAYING IT AS ANTIAMERICAN AND ANTI-SEMITIC.

MURDERERS REPORTEDLY WROTE "YANKEE GO HOME" ON THE WALLS OF THE HOUSE. ------------------074160 161548Z /53 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 3058 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY BONN AMCONSUL DHAHRAN IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY DOHA AMCONSUL FRANKFURT AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS USLO PEKING USLO RIYADH IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY TOKYO USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 00794 AYATOLLAH ROUHANI WAS RELEASED FROM DETENTION SUNDAY EVENING.
PEOPLES SACRIFICE GUERRILLAS (CHARIKS) HAVE CLAIMED CREDIT FOR RECENT SERIES OF ATTACKS AGAINST SECURITY FORCES.

CONSULATE TABRIZ REPORTS SITUATION QUIET, BUT AUTHORITIES EXPECT LARGE RALLY NEAR CEMETERY TODAY. STRIKERS AT THE UNIVERSITY OF TABRIZ HAVE DECLARED ALL FOREIGN STUDENTS AND STAFF MUST BE EXPELLED. CONSULATE ISFAHAN REPORTS ALL QUIET. CONSULATE SHIRAZ REPORTS DEMONSTRATION OF 2-3000 AT COLLEGE OF ARTS AND SCIENCES THIS MORNING AND ANOTHER OF 1000-1500 ON ZAND AVE. GOV-GEN HAS TOLD CONSUL SECURITY FORCES CAN COPE WITH SITUATION BUT THAT HE EXPECTS DEMONSTRATIONS EVERY DAY UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE. TEHRAN MEANWHILE HAS HAD NUMEROUS MARCHING CROWDS TODAY, ALL UNDER GOOD DISCIPLINE.

ONE SUCH GROUP PASSED IN FRONT OF EMBASSY, SINGING AND SHOUTING "DEATH TO THE SHAH", BUT KEPT ON GOING AND DID NOT ATTACK COMPOUND. REMAINS TO BE SEEN WHAT SHAPE THIS WILL TAKE NOW THAT SHAH HAS DEPARTED.

MASSIVE MARCH, PROBABLY ON THE ORDER OF TASSUAASHURA SHOW, IS PLANNED FOR JAN 19 (ARBAEIN, MARKING 40TH DAY AFTER HUSSEIN'S DEATH). ROUTES ARE BEING PUBLISHED AND CLOSELY RESEMBLE ARRANGEMENTS FOR TASSUAASHURA. CROWDS WILL CONVERGE FOR MAIN MARCH DOWN SHAH REZA AND RALLY AT SHAHYAD (FARSI PRESS DOES NOT REFER TO SITE AS "SHAHYAD", MERELY AS "THE LAST BIG SQUARE BEFORE THE AIRPORT"). WE ARE ADVISING COMMUNITY TO REMAIN HOME THAT DAY.

PRESS (RATHER GLEEFULLY) REPORTS MANY ANTI-FOREIGN PRONOUNCEMENTS. REPRESENTATIVE OF BANK MELLI EMPLOYEES, FOR EXAMPLE, TOLD STRIKERS: "AMERICAN IMPERIALISM KNOWS WELL THAT THE VICTORY OF THE STRUGGLING IRANIAN MASSES MEANS THE END OF AMERICA'S AND ITS ALLIES' INTERESTS IN ASIA." AN EMPLOYEE'S GROUP AT FOREIGN MINISTRY DEMANDS WITHDRAWAL FROM CENTO, TERMINATION OF ALL TIES WITH ISRAEL, ANNULMENT OF MILITARY AGREEMENTS WITH U.S., INITIATION OF EFFORTS TO SIGN NONAGGRESSION PACT WITH USSR. SUCH STATEMENTS, PARTICULARLY FROM STRIKERS

1979TEHRAN00809.subject: SHARIATMADARI REPORTEDLY SEEKS U.S. SUPPORT SUMMARY: POLITICAL BROKER SAID AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI WOULD LIKE QUIET U.S. SUPPORT FOR MODERATE RELIGIO

segments.text: SUMMARY: POLITICAL BROKER SAID AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI WOULD LIKE QUIET U.S. SUPPORT FOR MODERATE RELIGIOUS CHALLENGE TO KHOMEINI. SOURCE PORTRAYED COMMUNISTS AND OTHER RADICALS AS GROWING STRONGER EVERY DAY AND SUGGESTED KHOMEINI GROUP COULD NOT REALLY CONTROL IRAN EVEN IF KHOMEINI RETURNED. SOURCE GAVE KHOMEINI GROUP ABOUT TWO TO THREE WEEKS BEFORE IT WAS SWAMPED BY COMBINATION OF PROBLEMS OF MODERN IRAN AND LEFTIST MILITANTS. THIS IS A COMMON VIEW, BUT ONE WHICH HAS NOT BEEN PROVED. END SUMMARY.

HEDAYAT ESLAMINIA CALLED ON POLOFFS STEMPEL AND PERETT MORNING JAN 15 TO DISCUSS PRESENT SITUATION AND PASS ALONG MESSAGE WHICH HE SAID CAME DIRECTLY FROM AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI. ESLAMINIA SET STAGE FOR SHARIATMADARI MESSAGE WITH FAMILIAR PITCH: GOI HAD PROVED ITSELF INCOMPETENT TO HANDLE RELIGIOUS LEADERS. IT COULDN'T EVEN BRIBE SUCCESSFULLY. PRESENT WAVE OF DEMONSTRATIONS HAD DISINTEGRATED TO CHAOS--TEHRAN ULEMA HAD RECENTLY CALLED FOR CALM AND WERE NOT BEING OBEYED (COMMENT: TRUE TO A POINT; BUT MOST OF DEMONSTRATIONS CURRENTLY GOING ON THIS WEEK ARE ORGANIZED BY THE LIBERATION MOVEMENT (LMI) AND FAIRLY-WELL DISCIPLINED.). COMMUNISTS AND RADICALS HAVE THE ORGANIZATION TO REALLY CAUSE TROUBLE, THEY ARE READY TO DO SO.
IN COMPARISON, MULLAHS ARE NOT WELL ORGANIZED.

BULK OF PEOPLE INCLUDING MAJOR RELIGIOUS LEADERS (HE INCLUDED EVERYBODY BUT KHOMEINI) DO NOT WANT CHAOS. STOREKEEPERS AND OTHERS HAVE BEEN INTIMIDATED INTO STAYING CLOSED BUT WOULD LIKE TO OPEN. IT WILL BE VERY HARD TO GET STRIKERS BACK TO WORK UNDER ANY GOVERNMENT SINCE AUTHORITY HAS VIRTUALLY COLLAPSED.

MODERATE IN-COUNTRY CLERGY GREATLY DISLIKE KHOMEINI, BUT THEY ARE AFRAID TO OPPOSE HIM PUBLICLY. NEVERTHELESS, SHARIATMADARI HAS SAID HE WILL TRY TO RALLY MODERATE ULEMA TO OPPOSE SUCH THINGS AS "ISLAMIC REPUBLIC" OF KHOMEINI. (COMMENT: IN-COUNTRY CLERGY WOULD PROBABLY PREFER SHAH REMAIN AS MONARCH, EVEN IF HE TAKES A VACATION. THEY SEE HIM AS BULWARK AGAINST BOLSHEVISM.) EMBOFF WONDERED WHAT HAD TAKEN MODERATES SO LONG TO REACT TO KHOMEINI. ESLAMINIA SAID THEY WERE SCARED; THAT WAS WHY IT WAS IMPORTANT THAT MODERATES KNEW THEY HAD "U.S. BACKING." EMBOFFS EXPLORED WHAT THIS MEANT.

ESLAMINIA FIRST SAID IT MEANT HELP WITH RESPECT TO FOREIGN PERCEPTIONS OF ANY ANTI-KHOMEINI EFFORT, THEN MOVED TO POSITION WHERE QUESTION OF U.S. SUPPORT WAS LARGELY TO BE PRO FORMA FOR PSYCHOLOGICAL REASONS TO BOLSTER AYATOLLAHS' SPIRITS. EMBOFFS PROFESSED TO BE AT A LOSS TO SEE WHAT U.S. COULD DO THAT WOULD NOT BE COUNTERPRODUCTIVE. THEY GENTLY CHIDED ESLAMINIA TO THE EFFECT THAT IF CLERGY WERE NOT STRONG ENOUGH TO DO THIS ON THEIR OWN, IT APPEARED TO BE OF LITTLE USE TO OBTAIN FOREIGN "BACKING" WHICH COULD BE DISASTROUS IF DISCOVERED. ESLAMINIA REITERATED THAT SUCH BACKING HAD TO BE DISCREET.

AT THIS POINT, MEETING WAS JOINED BRIEFLY BY POLCOUNS, WHO REVIEWED PREVIOUS POINTS AND NOTED THAT IT WAS VERY LATE IN THE DAY FOR MODERATE RELIGIOUS LEADERS TO FINALLY DECIDE TO GET STARTED ON SOMETHING. ESLAMINIA SIGHED AND AGREED, NOTING THAT GOI HAD BEEN SO COMPLETELY INEPT AT CORRALING RELIGIOUS SUPPORT THAT EVEN WHEN RELIGIOUS LEADERS HAD WANTED TO WORK FOR THE REGIME, THE GOI AND THE COURT MINISTRY HAD BEEN TOO SLOW TO ACT.

EMBOFFS SAID THEY WOULD PRESENT ABOVE THOUGHTS TO AMBASSADOR. ESLAMINIA NOTED THAT IF USG REALLY WANTED TO SHOW SUPPORT FOR MODERATES AND EVENTUALLY WORK WITH THEM AS KHOMEINI EFFORT COLLAPSED, NOW WAS THE TIME TO BEGIN. MOREOVER, LIKE ALL AYATOLLAHS, SHARIATMADARI WANTED SUPPORT OF OTHER ULEMA. ANY EFFORT TO GAIN RELIGIOUS SUPPORT MUST INVOLVE CONTACTING OTHER MULLAHS, HOJATOLLAHS, ETC. AS WELL SO THAT WHEN SENIOR AYATOLLAH CALLS FOR SOME ACTION, OTHERS WILL SAY, "HE'S RIGHT*" EMBOFFS SAID THIS SOUNDED LIKE MAJOR EFFORT FOR A GOVERNMENT, NOT AN EMBASSY. ESLAMINIA JUST SMILED IN AGREEMENT.

COMMENT: ESLAMINIA IS SADDENED BY THE GOI OVER THE PAST NINE MONTHS. HE AND OTHERS TRIED EARLY IN 1978 TO GET REGIME TO DEAL SENSIBLY WITH THE MODERATE RELIGIOUS LEADERS. HE ACCEPTS (WITH SOME HEARTBURN) THE FACT THAT KHOMEINI APPEARS TO HAVE "WON" THIS ROUND BUT IS LOOKING BEYOND, TO THE TIME WHEN HE (AND OTHERS) FEEL THE OPPOSITION WILL BICKER AMONG ITSELF. ESLAMINIA FEELS THE U.S. SHOULD QUIETLY SUPPORT THE RELIGIOUS MODERATES TO PREVENT ------------------102531 170843Z /14 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 3066 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 00809 LIMDIS OR EASE THE UNPLEASANT DEVELOPMENTS TO COME. ESLAMINIA HAS GOOD CONTACTS WITH PEOPLE LIKE SAVAK'S GEN. MOGHADAM.
WE ARE NOT SURE ON BEHALF OF WHOM, EXACTLY, ESLAMINIA IS WORKING AT THIS STAGE; THEREFORE SOME CAUTION IS IN ORDER.

1979TEHRAN00811.subject: RELIGIOUS ORGANIZER SEEKS U.S. SUPPORT FOR MODERATES

segments.text: SUMMARY: SHARIATMADARI ORGANIZER QUERIED POLOFF ON PROJECTED SITUATION FOR NEXT FEW DAYS. RELIGIOUS MODERATES WOULD LIKE TO ORGANIZE FOR EXPECTED COLLAPSE OF KHOMEINILED GOVERNMENTAL SOLUTION. HE URGED U.S. BACKING, HOWEVER DISCREET, FOR THIS EFFORT AND EXPRESSED REAL FEAR THAT "FOREIGN HAND" WAS BEHIND KHOMEINI. END SUMMARY.

POLOFF STEMPEL MET WITH HEDAYAT ESLAMINIA AND DR. JAVAD MANAGHEBI, PROFESSOR AT EL AHIAT RELIGIOUS COLLEGE, TEHRAN (SEE LIMDIS MEMCON DATED APRIL 30, 1978) AND A CONFIDANTE OF AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI MORNING JAN 16. MANAGHEBI IS HEAD OF "BRAIN-TRUST" GROUP OF RELIGIOUS FIGURES WHO SHARE VIEWS OF MODERATE RELIGIOUS LEADERS, BUT HAVE MAINTAINED GOOD LINKS WITH KHOMEINI CAMP.

IRANIAN PAIR WANTED U.S. VIEWS ON NUMBER OF HARD QUESTIONS: WILL KHOMEINI COME BACK AND WHEN? WILL HE MOVE VERY RAPIDLY TO DISCARD MONARCHY? EMBOFF SAID USG DID NOT HAVE DEFINITIVE ANSWERS TO THESE QUESTIONS, BUT IT LOOKED LIKE KHOMEINI WOULD RETURN AT SOME POINT, AND THAT THERE WOULD BE EFFORT TO CHANGE GOVERNMENT. QUESTION OF WHETHER KHOMEINI WOULD SUCCEED DEPENDED ON EXACTLY WHAT HE TRIED TO DO AND MILITARY REACTION. IN THIS CONNECTION, THERE WAS SOME ROOM, EMBOFF OPINED, FOR MODERATE RELIGIOUS PRESSURE ON KHOMEINI NOT TO MOVE TOO FAST.

MANAGHEBI SAID IT WAS SHARIATMADARI (AND HIS GROUP'S) VIEW THAT IT WAS USELESS TO TRY TO PROP UP BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT; THE SOONER KHOMEINI TOOK POWER AND "THE PEOPLE" SAW THAT HEAVEN WOULD NOT BE FORTHCOMING WITHIN THE MONTH, THE SOONER SERIOUS WORK COULD BE DONE IN "REBUILDING" IRAN. BIG PROBLEM WAS WHETHER KHOMEINI DRIVE FOR ISLAMIC REPUBLIC COULD BE MUTED OR SLOWED DOWN ENOUGH FOR STRAINS IN OPPOSITION TO DEVELOP. MANAGHEBI SAID KHOMEINI HIMSELF WAS STAUNCHLY ANTI-COMMUNIST. YAZDI,GHOTBAZADEH, BANISADR AND SOME OF THE YOUNGER MEN AROUND HIM IN PARIS WERE RADICAL MARXISTS BENT ON "DESTROYING THE IRANIAN NATION, AND MODERATE AYATOLLAHS KNOW THIS.

FOR "UNHOLY TRIO AROUND HOLY MAN" THE "ISLAMIC REPUBLIC" WAS A SHAM. MANAGHEBI RETURNED SEVERAL TIMES TO THE THEME THAT A "FOREIGN HAND" WAS BEHIND KHOMEINI. HE READILY ACCEPTED EMBOFFS ASSURANCES THAT IT WAS NOT RPT NOT USG, BUT THOUGHT IT WAS PROBABLY THE RUSSIANS AND MIGHT BE THE BRITISH. EMBOFF REPLIED USG THOUGHT THERE WAS NO MASSIVE SUPPORT FROM FOREIGN SOURCES, BUT IT WAS CLEAR USSR WAS "MEDDLING" IN TROUBLED WATERS.

GROUP WHICH MANAGHEBI LED WAS READY TO WORK FOR MODERATION AND REDUCTION IN INFLUENCE OF LEFTIST RADICALS IN MOVEMENT AS LONG AS IT COULD BE CERTAIN ATTEMPT WAS NOT FOREDOMED TO FAILURE. IDEALLY, GROUP WANTED U.S. SUPPORT, OR AT LEAST GUARANTEE AGAINST FOREIGN INTERVENTION AGAINST IT. EMBOFF REPLIED THAT USG FOLLOWED FOREIGN PROBLEM VERY CAREFULLY AND WOULD CONTINUE TO DO SO; QUESTION OF FURTHER U.S. "SUPPORT" WOULD HAVE TO BE CONSIDERED ELSEWHERE, BUT EMBOFF THOUGHT THIS MIGHT NOT RPT NOT BE HELPFUL, GIVEN CURRENT ANTI-FOREIGN FEELING IN IRAN. IRANIAN PAIR AGREED THAT ANY SUCH SUPPORT WOULD HAVE TO BE MORE SYMBOLIC THAN ACTUAL.
FOR NOW, SIMPLE ASSURANCE THAT USG THOUGHT ACTIVITY WAS WORTHWHILE WOULD BE HELPFUL. EMBOFF AVOIDED ANSWERING QUESTION, BUT NOTED USG FAVORED MODERATION AND CONSTITUTIONAL GOVERNMENT.

PAIR ASKED WHAT NEXT SIX MONTHS WOULD BRING. EMBOFF NOTED USG HAD SAME PROBLEM WITH CRYSTAL BALL THAT EVERYBODY ELSE HAD. MANAGHEBI THOUGHT IF REFERENDUM ON MONARCHY COULD BE PUT OFF FOR SIX MONTHS, IT COULD BE WON BY MONARCHY IF RELIGIOUS LEADERS COULD BECOME ACTIVE. PAIR WERE ABSOLUTELY CAUSTIC IN THEIR CRITICISM OF INEPTITUDE OF EVERYONE IN GOI FROM SHAH TO COURT MINISTER TO OTHER SENIOR OFFICIALS. ESLAMINIA SAID SITUATION HAD COME TO PRESENT STATE BECAUSE SHAH "LOST HIMSELF" AND GOT NO HELP FROM THOSE WHO SHOULD HAVE REALIZED THEY HAD MOST TO LOOSE.

COMMENT: IT IS TEMPTING TO TOLE ABOVE IN TOO-LITTLETOO-LATE BASKET, AND CERTAINLY IT WAS CLEAR THAT BOTH MEN REALIZE TIME FOR MODERATE SOLUTION TO NEUTRALIZE KHOMINI HAS PASSED. COMMENTS, ESPECIALLY BY MANAGHEBI, SUGGEST STRAINS ARE ALREADY BEGINNING TO BREAK THROUGH IN RELIGIOUS MOVEMENT, AND SHARIATMADARI FORCES ARE BEGINNING TO LOOK AT THE POST-SHAH PHASE IN TERMS OF ENHANCING THEIR ------------------111710 180043Z /61 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 3069 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 00811 EXDIS OWN POSITION VIS-A-VIS THOSE WHOM THEY VIEW AS ENDANGERING ISLAM.

MANAGHEBI IS AN IMPRESSIVELY INTELLIGENT PROFESSOR WHO HAS THE BEST GRASP OF PERSIAN POLITICS OF ANY OF THE RELIGIOUS FIGURES WITH WHOM REPORTING OFFICER HAS DEALT. HE IS IN HIS EARLY FIFTIES AND SPEAKS PERSIAN BUT VIRTUALLY NO ENGLISH. HE CLAIMS HIS NETWORK OF RELIGIOUS SUPPORTERS WAS IMPORTANT FACTOR IN INDUCING AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI TO MODERATE HIS STAND AGAINST ATTACKING FOREIGNERS (IT'S "UNISLAMIC", ACCORDING TO THE DR.). EMBASSY WILL

SOURCE WITH ACCESS, BUT NOT ESPECIALLY IMPRESSIVE TRACK RECORD, TOLD POL COUNSELOR JAN 17 THAT RELIGIOUS MOVEMENT'S DR. HEJAZI SAW SHARIAT-MADARI IN QOM A DAY OR TWO AGO. SHARIAT-MADARI TOLD HIM A. KHOMEINI WILL RETURN TO IRAN NEXT SATURDAY OR SUNDAY (JAN 20 OR 21).
B. DEMONSTRATORS ON JAN 19 WILL TAKE OVER THE PALACE.

C. KHOMEINI'S ORIGINAL PLAN TO RETURN THE DAY AFTER THE SHAH LEFT HAD BEEN CHANGED BECAUSE BAKHTIAR REFUSED TO RESIGN. HOWEVER, SHARIAT-MADARI DOUBTS BAKHTIAR CAN END THE STRIKES OR HOLD ON MUCH LONGER AGAINST KHOMEINI'S OPPOSITION.

ABOVE PUTS KHOMEINI'S RETURN SOMEWHAT EARLIER THAN LATEST INFORMATION FROM LMI SOURCES. ATTEMPT TO TAKE OVER PALACE WOULD PROVOKE DIRECT CONFRONTATION WITH IRANIAN MILITARY, WHICH WOULD BE CONTRADICTORY TO KHOMEINI'S PUBLICLY STATED POLICIES. THEREFORE, THIS REPORT MAY MERELY REFLECT SHARIAT-MADARI'S MOST DEEP-SEATED FEARS, OR, GIVEN OUR SOURCE'S RATHER EMOTIONAL VIEWPOINT, MAY ALSO CONTAIN SOME OF HIS OWN PERSONAL CONCERNS. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00820.subject: FAILURE OF A MISSION TO KHOMEINI

segments.text: KHOSROW EQBAL, WHO DEPARTED A WEEK AGO FULL OF HOPE TO CONVERT KHOMEINI TO HIS OWN VIEW OF MODERATION IN IRAN (SEE REFTEL) HAS SENT WORD BACK TO AN INTERMEDIARY THAT KHOMEINI IS AN "ARROGANT MONSTER." EQBAL APPARENTLY DID NOT GET THE PRIVATE TETE-A-TETE WITH KHOMEINI HE THOUGHT HE HAD BEEN PROMISED AND HAS REACHED THE (HASTY) CONCLUSION THAT KHOMEINI IS "SURROUNDED BY COMMUNISTS."

SOMEWHAT INCONSISTENTLY, EQBAL REFERRED TO WHAT HE SEES AS IRAN'S FATE (UNDER RIGID RELIGIOUS RULE) AS MOVING FROM LIFE UNDER A DICTATORSHIP OF THE BOOT TO LIFE UNDER A DICTATORSHIP OF THE SANDAL. A DISTRAUGHT BUT WISER MAN, OUR FRIEND EQBAL HAS REPORTEDLY EXTENDED HIS STAY IN FRANCE FOR THE FORESEEABLE FUTURE. SULLIVAN

WHEN BAKHTIAR WAS IN PROCESS SEEKING HIS CONFIDENCE VOTE, HE SENT WORD TO ME THAT HE WOULD PREFER NOT RPT NOT BE VIEWED AS U.S. PROTEGE. HE THEREFORE SUGGESTED I DELAY ANY CALL UPON HIM UNTIL HE HAD GOTTEN THROUGH THE PARLIAMENT.

MORNING JANUARY 17, AFTER PARLIAMENTARY PROCESS HAD BEEN COMPLETED, I SENT WORD TO HIS STAFF ASSISTANT THAT I WAS AT HIS DISPOSITION TO MEET HIM WHENEVER HE WISHED. SINCE HE HAS NOT RPT NOT CALLED BACK, I ASSUME BAKHTIAR MAY WISH POSTPONE MEETING A LITTLE LONGER. HE OBVIOUSLY HAS MORE URGENT AND CONSTRUCTIVE THINGS TO DO IN THE NEXT FEW DAYS THAN TO MEET WITH AMERICAN AMBASSADOR.

POLCOUNS AND EMBOFF PERETT MET WITH FOUR BAZAARIS JAN 14 IN HOME OF POLITICAL BROKER ESLAMINIA. THE BAZAARIS, MOST OF WHOM HAD MET PREVIOUSLY WITH EMBOFFS, EXPRESSED GREAT APPREHENSION ABOUT THE FUTURE OF IRAN BUT HAD LITTLE IDEA OF HOW TO PREVENT CHAOS. THEY REPEATEDLY ASKED EMBOFFS WHAT THEY SHOULD DO, AND OUR RESPONSE THAT THESE PROBLEMS MUST BE SOLVED BY IRANIANS THEMSELVES DID NOT SATISFY THEM. ALL FEARED A BREAKUP OF THE ARMY, AND A SUBSEQUENT WAVE OF ANARCHY WHICH THEY COULD NOT STOP. THIS WAVE CONSISTS OF THE MASSES, MOSTLY YOUNG PEOPLE, WHO KNOW NOTHING BUT HAVE THE POWER TO DISRUPT NORMAL BUSINESS LIFE.

THESE PEOPLE ARE NOW CONTROLLED BY COMMUNISTS, AND THE BUSINESS LEADERS CANNOT RESIST THEM. THEY FEAR GENUINE ANARCHY AND BELIEVE THINGS MIGHT GET SO BAD THAT TRIBAL LEADERS, FREE FROM CENTRAL CONTROL, WILL SIMPLY SEIZE ANCESTRAL QASHQAI AND BAKHTIARI LANDS.

IT ALL HAS TO STOP SOMEWHERE. AT SOME POINT THE GOVT MUST SAY: "NOW WE HAVE FULFILLED ALL YOUR DEMANDS. GET BACK TO WORK." THE BAZAARIS WERE NOT SURE, HOWEVER, HOW THIS COULD BE DONE. THEY SAID AT ONE POINT THAT THE BAKHTIAR GOVT MIGHT SUCCEED IN RESTORING ORDER IF BAKHTIAR LIVES UP TO HIS PROMISES, PARTICULARLY THAT OF PUNISHING THE GUILTY.

(THE BAZAARIS, LIKE MOST OTHER PEOPLE WE MEET, DEMAND TO SEE BODIES SWAYING AT THE END OF A ROPE BEFORE THEY WILL TRUST ANY GOVT.) THEY SAID, ON THE OTHER HAND, THAT ANY NEW GOVT MUST USE KHOMEINI'S INFLUENCE TO RESOLVE THE CRISIS, AND THEY ADDED THAT THEY WERE ALL 100 PERCENT BEHIND KHOMEINI. UNITED STATES SHOULD CONTACT KHOMEINI, BUT WE MUST DEAL WITH THE MAN HIMSELF; HIS ADVISORS MISREPRESENT HIS VIEWS. (THERE WAS DISCUSSION AND SOME DISAGREEMENT AS TO WHETHER KHOMEINI"S AIDES ARE OUTRIGHT COMMUNIST OR NOT.)

AS FOR THEIR OWN EXPECTATIONS FOR THE FUTURE, THE BAZAARIS HAD LITTLE TO SAY APART FROM THEIR APPREHENSION. THEY BELIEVED PEOPLE WOULD NOT ACCEPT A KING, UNLESS PERHAPS HE REIGNED LIKE THE KING OF ENGLAND. IF FREE ELECTIONS ARE HELD, THEY DO NOT PLAN TO VOTE, FEARING TO BECOME INVOLVED POLITICALLY, BUT THEIR EMPLOYEES WILL.

COMMENT: THESE TRADITIONAL BUSINESSMEN ARE FRIGHTENED AND CONFUSED. WHEN WE FIRST MET THEM TWO MONTHS AGO, THEY HAD A LIST OF SPECIFIC DEMANDS WHICH, IF SATISFIED, WOULD LEAD TO RESOLUTION OF THE CRISIS. NOW THEY SIMPLY WANT PEACE BUT DO NOT KNOW HOW TO OBTAIN IT. IN SEARCH OF AN ANSWER THEY, LIKE SO MANY IRANIANS OF EVERY POLITICAL PERSUASION, TURN TO USG. WHEN WE SAID WE WERE IN NO POSITION TO DO ANYTHING DIRECTLY, THEY NODDED BUT SHORTLY RETURNED TO THE SAME QUESTION. THEY WILL GLADLY RALLY TO ANY PROMISE OF RESTORED STABILITY--SUBJECT, AS IN ALL THINGS, TO THE APPROVAL OF KHOMEINI. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00833.subject: LIBERATION MOVEMENT OF IRAN (LMI) FORMS STRIKE COMMITTEE, OPPOSITIONISTS DISCUSSING NEXT STEPS SUMMARY: LMI BELIEVES SITUATION IN IRAN WILL STAB

segments.text: COMMITTEE, OPPOSITIONISTS DISCUSSING NEXT STEPS SUMMARY: LMI BELIEVES SITUATION IN IRAN WILL STABILIZE BY JAN 21. KHOMEINI HAS NO PLANS TO RETURN TO IRAN BEFORE JAN 21, BUT COULD DO SO "WITHIN FIVE DAYS TO A WEEK." LMI WANTS REGENCY COUNCIL AND MAJLES TO MELT AWAY, BUT MODERATE OPPOSITIONISTS IN SHARIAT-MADARI CAMP ARE SEEKING COMPROMISE WHICH WOULD INVOLVE EITHER JOINT OPERATION OF TWO COUNCILS OR MERGER. LMI SOURCE SAYS KHOMEINI HAS ESTABLISHED A COMMITTEE TO RESOLVE OUTSTANDING STRIKES; IT BEGAN WORK JAN 17. END SUMMARY

LMI CENTRAL COMMITTEE MEMBER AMIR ENTEZAM TOLD POLOFF STEMPEL THAT SITUATION AFTER SHAH'S DEPARTURE HAD DEVELOPED BETTER THAN ANYONE HAD HOPED. HE THANKED U.S. GRACIOUSLY AND EXTENSIVELY FOR WORKING WITH MILITARY TO PREVENT BLOWUP. ENTEZAM SAID LMI HAD CONTACTED KHOMEINI AND AYATOLLAH HAD DECIDED NOT RPT NOT TO RETURN TO IRAN IN IMMEDIATE FUTURE. WHEN PRESSED, ENTEZAM SAID NO FINAL DECISION HAD BEEN MADE, BUT LMI THOUGHT SITUATION WOULD STABLIZE FAIRLY WELL -- CROWD WOULD HAVE ONE BIG CHANCE FOR EMOTIONAL OUTPOURING AT JAN 19 MARCH -- BY JAN 21. KHOMEINI WOULD NOT COME BACK BEFORE THEN, BUT MIGHT DO SO WITHIN NEXT SEVEN DAYS.
DECISION STILL BEING CONSIDERED IN PARIS.

IN RESPONSE TO POLOFF'S QUESTION AS TO HOW POLITICAL SITUATIN WOULD DEVELOP, ENTEZAM SAID KHOMEINI WOULD "INVITE" MAJLES AND REGENCY COUNCIL TO MELT AWAY. IF THEY FAILED TO TAKE THE HINT, THEY WOULD BE PRESSED HARDER AND DUMPED BY FORCE IF NECESSARY. POLOFF GOT MORE CONCILIATORY VERSION FROM DR. NASSER MINATCHI, AYATOLLAH SHARIAT-MADARI SUPPORTER, WHO SAID THAT REPRESENTATIVES OF ALL OPPOSITION GROUPS WOULD BE MEETING WITHIN NEXT 24 HOURS TO SEE HOW PROBLEM OF DUAL GOVERNMENT -- REGENCY COUNCIL AND ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL COULD BE RESOLVED. MINATCHI'S PREFERRED SOLUTION IS TO MERGE THE TWO COUNCILS, AND THIS HAS SOME STRONG SUPPORT.

OTHER OPTIONS BEING CONSIDERED ARE JOINT MEETING OF TWO GROUPS, OR PARALLEL ACTIONS (SUCH AS BOTH GROUPS DESIGNATING SAME PRIME MINISTER). MINATCHI SAID AYATOLLAH MONTAZERI HAS NOW RETURNED FROM PARIS AND WOULD PARTICIPATEIN SERIES OF MEETINGS. MINATCHI PROFESSED NOT TO KNOW WHAT WORD MONTAZERI WAS BRINGING BACK FROM PARIS. (COMMENT: WHILE KHOMEINI'S POSITION MAY EVOLVE THROUGH DISCUSSION, ENTEZAM'S VIEW SUGGESTS LMI WILL GO INTO SUCH A MEETING ARGUING SIMPLY FOR "DISAPPEARANCE" OF PRESENT ARRANGEMENTS AND THEIR REPLACEMENT BY KHOMEINI-ESTABLISHED SOLUTION. THERE SEEMS TO BE ROOM FOR HORSE-TRADING, HOWEVER.)

ENTEZAM SAID KHOMEINI HAS JUST ESTABLISHED (JAN 17) COMMITTEE OF FIVE TO RESOLVE PRESENT STRIKES. BAZARGAN, WHO LED OIL COMMITTEE, WOULD BE EXCLUDED SO HE COULD MONITOR OIL SITUATION AND LMI'S ELDER STATEMAN DR. YADOLLAH SAHABI WOULD CHAIR NEW GROUP, OF WHICH ENTEZAM IS TO BE A MEMBER. ENTEZAM DECLINED TO NAME OTHER MEMBERS AT THIS TIME. COMMITTEE WAS JUST STARTING WORK THAT MORNING, AND IT SHOULD BE POSSIBLE TO RESOLVE MOST STRIKES WITHIN A FEW DAYS.

IN RESPONSE TO QUESTION ABOUT POSSIBLE TUDEH EFFORTS TO BLOCK STRIKE SETTLEMENT, ENTEZAM SAID OIL FIELDS WERE SPECIAL CASE, AND RADICAL LEFTISTS DID NOT RPT NOT SEEM TO POSE A MAJOR THREAT TO SETTLEMENTS ELSEWHERE. (COMMENT: AS LONG-TIME BELIEVERS IN MURPHY'S LAW, WE ARE NOT SO SURE PROCESS WILL GO THAT SMOOTHLY.) SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00836.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT, JAN 17 SUMMARY: NIGHT OF REVELRY TAPERED OFF TO QUIET MORNING IN OVERCAST TEHRAN. SCUFFLE IN TAJRISH PRODUCES WOUN

segments.text: SUMMARY: NIGHT OF REVELRY TAPERED OFF TO QUIET MORNING IN OVERCAST TEHRAN. SCUFFLE IN TAJRISH PRODUCES WOUNDED JAN 16. REST OF COUNTRY REPORTED VERY QUIET AS PREPARATIONS ARE UNDERWAY FOR MASSIVE PARADES ON JAN 19. TUDEH AND RADICALS DISCREETLY ENCOURAGING ANTI-AMERICAN SENTIMENT. MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR CHARGED WITH VIOLATING LAW. NATIONAL RADIO AND T.V. (NIRT) ORGANIZATION STILL IN INTENSE DISARRAY. KHOMEINI CALLS FOR CONTINUED PRESSURE ON REGIME. BUSINESS ACTIVITY IS PICKING UP SLIGHTLY. VIOLENCE IN AHWAZ AND AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY. END SUMMARY.

CELEBRATION OVER SHAH'S DEPARTURE SLOWLY DIED OUT AS EVENING JAN 16 WORE ON. SIX STATUES OF SHAH OR HIS FATHER WERE PULLED DOWN. TEHRAN WOKE UP TO GREY OVERCAST AND CALM. AS OF NOON, CITY WAS EXTREMELY QUIET. NUMBER OF OUR SOURCES SAY ALL SIDES ARE TAKING A DEEP BREATH AND THANKING ALLAH FOR RELATIVE CALM OF PAST 24 HOURS. ISLAMIC MOVEMENT AND NATIONAL FRONT (INF) ARE PLANNING MASSIVE RALLY JAN 19 TO CELEBRATE ARBAEIN, 40TH DAY AFTER THE ANNIVERSARY OF IMAM HOSSEIN'S DEATH. ON JAN 16TH, FIRING DID BREAK OUT IN TAJRISH AREA OF CITY. PRESS JAN 17 SAYS TWO WERE WOUNDED.

DAO DRIVER WAS COMMANDEERED TO CARRY ONE TO HOSPITAL WHO HAD BEEN SHOT IN LEG. ACCORDING TO LIBERATION MOVEMENT (LMI) SOURCE, INCIDENT WAS TRIGGERED BY AN IMPERIAL GUARD UNIT THAT BEGAN SHOOTING NEAR AN ISLAMIC COOPERATIVE ON TAJRISH SQUARE. SAME SOURCE SAID THERE HAD BEEN FIRING BY IMPERIAL GUARD ON STREET JUST EAST OF NIAVARAN PALACE EVENING JAN (15 AND FOUR PERSONS ON STREET WERE KILLED (WE HAVE NO FURTHER CONFIRMATION OF THIS.)

THOUGH TEHRAN PERSONAL SECURITY SITUATION WAS VERY GOOD EVENING JAN 16 CONSIDERING CROWDS AND SPIRIT, THERE WERE A FEW THREATS TO FOREIGNERS, AND IN ONE CASE A CAR WAS STOLEN. CELEBRATIONS OCCURRED IN MAJOR PROVINCIAL TOWNS JAN 16, BUT ALL WERE RELATIVELY PEACEFUL. ON JAN 17 ISFAHAN AND TABRIZ REPORT QUIET REIGNS, BUT IN SHIRAZ THERE WAS A LARGE, PEACEFUL DEMONSTRATION THIS MORNING. JAN 17 FARSI ETELAAT FEATURED ANTI-U.S. CARTOON, AND THERE ARE SOME INDICATIONS THAT TUDEH (COMMUNIST) AND OTHER RADICAL ELEMENTS ARE TRYING TO STIMULATE ANTIAMERICAN FEELING, FORTUNATELY WITH MINIMAL LUCK SO FAR.

MASS OF DEMONSTRATORS AFTER SHAH LEFT JAN 16 WERE FESTIVE AND CONCERNED WITH "DAWN OF FREEDOM." SOME, HOWEVER, WERE VOICING THE OCCASIONAL ANTI-AMERICAN SLOGAN. PERSIAN SOURCE REPORTED THAT "ABOUT 2,000 SMALL RUSSIAN FLAGS" WERE DISTRIBUTED TO GROUPS AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY AFTERNOON JAN 16, REPORTEDLY INTENDED AS A REPLY TO PRIME MINISTER BAKHTIAR'S STATEMENT TO MAJLES EARLIER IN DAY THAT ONLY FLAG THAT WOULD FLY IN IRAN IS THE RED, WHITE AND GREEN (TODAY'S IRANIAN FLAG). (COMMENT: THIS MAY BE A CANARD.).

MINISTRY OF JUSTICE LAWYER FILED CHARGES AGAINST QAZVIN MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR GENERAL NEMATOLLAH MOTAMEDI FOR VIOLATING IRAN'S CONSTITUTION AND MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS. MOTAMEDI WAS ACCUSED OF ALLOWING HIS TROOPS TO BEAT PEOPLE AND PERMITTING OR ENCOURAGING MARTIAL AUTHORITIES TO CARRY OUT ARSON AND THEFT. TIMETABLE OF HEARINGS OF CHARGES NOT RPT NOT KNOWN.
NIRT ORGANIZATION IS STILL IN INTENSE DISARRAY. ALL RADIO BROADCASTING STOPPED AFTERNOON JAN 16,RESUMED JAN 17. RUMORS PERSIST THAT INTERNATIONAL (ENGLISH) RADIO AND T.V. CHANNELS WILL BE SHUT DOWN.

PRESS JAN 17 REPORTED KHOMEINI CALL IN PARIS FOR CONTINUED PRESSURE ON REGIME, HIS ANNOUNCEMENT THAT HE WOULD NOT RPT NOT RETURN TO IRAN IMMEDIATELY, AND HIS CALL TO OPPOSE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT UNTIL KHOMEINI'S ISLAMIC COUNCIL IS READY TO FUNCTION. PERSIAN PRESS CARRIED FOLLOWING POINTS WHICH WERE NOT RPT NOT IN ENGLISH PRESS: A) MAJLES AND REGENCY COUNCIL "SHOULD LEAVE;" THEY ARE NOT LEGITIMATE; B) FARMERS SHOULD BE MORE ACTIVE POLITICALLY AND STOP WHEAT EXPORTS (SIC); C) THE IRANIAN MILITARY SHOULD PREVENT REMOVAL OF U.S.

ARMS FROM IRAN, WHICH BELONG TO IRAN; D) ISLAMIC (NO INTEREST) BANKS SHOULD BE ESTABLISHED; AND E) IRANIAN PEOPLE SHOULD TURN JAN 19 ARBAEIN CELEBRATION INTO "BIGGEST DEMONSTRATION EVER." (EMBASSY COMMENT: IRAN EXPORTS NO WHEAT, BUT IMPORTS 30 PERCENT OF ITS REQUIREMENTS. WE ASSUME THIS IS A MISTAKE BASED ON THE PROPAGANDA CHARGE THAT SHAH'S GOVERNMENT WAS EXPORTING IRANIAN WHEAT.)
COMMERCIAL BANKS ARE GENERALLY OPEN BUT WITH LIMITED SERVICES. MANY STORES ARE OPEN. BUSINESS ACTIVITY IS STILL LIMITED BUT SEEMS TO BE PICKING UP.

LATE REPORT: EMBASSY HAS JUST LEARNED FROM TWO SEPARATE SOURCES THAT ARMY AND CROWDS HAD SERIOUS CONFRONTATION IN AHWAZ JAN 16 WHEN MOB TRIED TO TURN OVER SHAH'S STATUE. ARMY ARRIVED IN TRUCKS AND BEGAN SHOOTING. SOME VIOLENCE REPORTED CONTINUING JAN 17. NIOC SOURCE SAYS 20 PEOPLE WERE KILLED JAN 16; DR. MINATCHI OF COMMITTEE FOR THE DEFENSE OF HUMAN RIGHTS AND FREEDOM TOLD POLOFF THAT TROOPS ATTACKED PEOPLE AT JONDI SHAHPUR UNIVERSITY AND VIOLENCE SPREAD TO TOWN. HE HAD NO FIGURES, BUT SAID "LOTS" OF PEOPLE WERE KILLED ON BOTH DAYS. ACCORDING TO MINATCHI, ONE ELEMENT IN VIOLENCE WAS PRO-SHAH MOB WHICH WAS CHANTING "SHAH MUST RETURN."

ACADEMIC SOURCE HAS INFORMED US THAT THERE WAS LIGHT SHOOTING AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY JUST AFTER NOON JAN 17 BETWEEN RELIGIOUS TYPES AND RADICAL LEFTISTS. ARMY WAS NOWHERE TO BE SEEN, BUT VIOLENCE REPORTEDLY DIED OUT AFTER A SHORT TIME.

POLOFF HAS JUST RETURNED FROM NOON MEETING ON SHAH REZA STREET, WHICH INCLUDED INADVERTENT PARTICIPATION IN PARADE LED BY TWO TANK RETRIEVERS DRIVEN BY MEN IN FATIGUES AND CARRYING ABOUT 100-250 PERSONS EACH. VEHICLES WERE JAMMING FERDOWSI SQUARE AND ANTI-SHAH SLOGANS WERE IN EVIDENCE, BUT MOOD WAS CHEERFUL EVEN THOUGH TRAFFIC IN CENTER CITY HAD COME TO COMPLETE STANDSTILL. NEVERTHELESS, WHEN "OFFERED" A CHANCE TO BUY A FULL-COLOR 14 BY 19 PICTURE OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI FOR 50 RIALS, POLOFF DECIDED THIS BARGAIN WAS BEST INSURANCE POLICY GOING FOR GOOD CROWD BEHAVIOR, AND SO IT TURNED OUT. REST OF TEHRAN REMAINS QUIET, BUT CHEERFUL.
HOWEVER, POLCOUNS WITNESSED TRASHING OF A RESTAURANT BAR BY INPROMPTU GANG OF YOUNGSTERS ON STREET FEW BLOCKS FROM EMBASSY (SEPTEL).

WIRE SERVICE HAS REPORTS OF MORE SHOOTING IN ELAM AND ARAK OVER BURNING SHAH'S PICTURES. 1979TEHRAN00847.subject: UPDATE TO ESTIMATED POTENTIAL EVACUEES - IRAN

segments.text: THE EMBASSY HAS NOW COMPLETED CONTACTING U.S. COMPANIES IN PYRAMID SYSTEM BUT NOT YET COMPILED FIGURES ON AMERICANS REMAINING IN IRAN. HOWEVER, PRELIMINARY ANALYSIS INDICATES THAT THERE IS ONLY A SLIGHT DECREASE FROM THE FIGURES REPORTED IN REFTEL.
DETAILED REPORT IN PRESCRIBED FORMAT WILL BE FORWARDED JANUARY 18, 1979. SULLIVAN

I AM CONCERNED THAT INSTRUCTIONS TO ZIMMERMAN FOR CONVERSATION WITH YAZDI INSERT TOO MUCH U.S. INTERPRETATION INTO QUESTION OF CONSTITUTIONAL PROCEDURES AND CONSTITUTIONAL CHANGE. YAZDI DID NOT RPT NOT ASK FOR U.S. VIEWS ON THIS SUBJECT, BUT MERELY FOR EXPLANATION OF IRANIAN MILITARY VIEWS.
SINCE WE DO NOT RPT NOT KNOW ULTIMATE IRANIAN MILITARY VIEWS, I FEEL STRONGLY WE SHOULD REFRAIN FROM GIVING OUR OWN IDEAS AS A SUBSTITUTE.

THE BASIC ANSWER TO YAZDI'S QUESTION SHOULD BE THAT THIS IS A MATTER WHICH SHOULD BE DISCUSSED BETWEEN KHOMEINI'S PEOPLE AND THE MILITARY. WE SHOULD BE IN THE POSITION OF ATTEMPTING TO FOSTER THE DIALOGUE BUT NOT RPT NOT TO DICTATE ITS SUBSTANCE.

BELIEVE ZIMMERMAN SHOULD NOT RPT NOT GO BEYOND FIRST POINT IN PARAGRAPH 7(B) DURING HIS DISCUSSION WITH YAZDI. WE MUST REMEMBER THAT YAZDI, KHOMEINI, ET AL. CONSIDER THEMSELVES REVOLUTIONARIES AND THAT THEY COULD INTERPRET OUR STATEMENT AS AN ATTEMPT TO FRUSTRATE THEIR GOALS. THAT IS SOMETHING FOR THE IRANIAN MILITARY TO DO RATHER
I WILL HAVE MY INITIAL APPOINTMENT WITH PRIME MINISTER BAKHTIAR AFTERNOON JANUARY 20.
IF EVENTS OF JANUARY 19 PASS PEACEFULLY, THIS SHOULD OFFER OPPORTUNITY TO OBTAIN HIS EVALUATION OF WAY IN WHICH HE EXPECTS IMMEDIATE FUTURE TO EVOLVE. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00892.subject: OPPOSITION VIEWS SUMMARY: ECLECTIC GROUP OF OPPOSITIONISTS DELIVERED 3- HOUR HARANGUE TO EMBOFFS, BLAMING USG VIA THE SHAH

segments.text: SUMMARY: ECLECTIC GROUP OF OPPOSITIONISTS DELIVERED 3HOUR HARANGUE TO EMBOFFS, BLAMING USG VIA THE SHAH FOR IRAN'S ILLS. END SUMMARY

EMBOFFS EOSSDE AND PERETT MET WITH ECLECTIC GROUP OF OPPOSITIONISTS JAN 12 IN HOME OF DR. HAVAI. COLLECTION OF ABOUT TWO DOZEN MEN INCLUDED WELL KNOWN DISSIDENT WRITER HAJ SAEED JAVADI, PHYSICIANS, LAWYERS, PROFESSORS, A BAZAARI AND AN AGRICULTURIST. (THERE WERE ALSO 3-4 SCARVED WOMEN HUDDLED IN A CORNER FOR THE LATTER PART OF THE MEETING. THEY SAID NOTHING UNTIL ONE FINALLY BECAME SO ANGRY SHE JOINED IN THE FRAY, BUT THE MEN IGNORED HER). SIZE OF THE GATHERING HINDERED INTIMATE CONVERSATION, BUT HAVAI WANTED TO ASSEMBLE A BROAD CROSS-SECTION OF DISSIDENTS SO THEY COULD HAVE A GO AT THE EMBASSY.
DESPITE THE VARIETY OF PROFESSIONS AND THE PRESENCE OF ONE BAZAARI, THIS WAS BASICALLY A NATIONAL FRONT CROWD, AND THEY SPOKE LITTLE ABOUT ISLAM OR THE AYATOLLAHS.

EXCEPT FOR THE PROBLEM OF FIGHTING FOR THE TURN TO SPEAK, THE GROUP HAD A GRAND TIME. THEY WERE POLITE BUT PITILESS IN ASSAILING USG POLICY AND OUR PUPPET SHAH. EMBOFF DELIVERED OUR SEMI-OFFICIAL EMBASSY MESSAGE THAT TROOPS WILL BE EDGY WHEN SHAH LEAVES, THEREFORE CROWDS SHOULD DO NOTHING TO PROVOKE THEM, AND MEANWHILE WE WILL USE WHATEVER INFLUENCE WE HAVE TO RESTRAIN ARMY. MODERATE RELIGIOUS LEADERS HAD PREVIOUSLY ACCEPTED THIS MESSAGE GRACIOUSLY, AS DID SEVERAL LEADING BAZAARIS. THIS GROUP, HOWEVER, REACTED SHARPLY. EVERYONE KNOWS THAT SAVAK HAS BEEN RESPONSIBLE FOR ALL BANK BURNINGS, ETC., SO WHY WERE WE BRINGING THIS MESSAGE TO THE OPPOSITION?

FURTHERMORE, EVERYONE KNOWS THAT USG CONTROLS THE ARMY, SO THE TROOPS WILL NOT FIRE UNLESS WE GIVE PERMISSION. EMBOFFS TRIED FOR TWO HOURS TO COMBAT THESE NOTIONS, ESPECIALLY THE SECOND, BUT HAD NO LUCK. THE STANDARD CHARGES WERE ALL BROUGHT FORTH -- USG INSTALLED THE SHAH, TRAINED SAVAK, COOPERATED WITH SHAH TO EXPLOIT IRANIAN OIL AT LOW PRICES, ETC.

WHEN THEY WERE NOT ATTACKING U.S. POLICY, THE GROUP INDICATED RELIGION (THEREFORE KHOMEINI) WAS NOT THE DOMINANT ELEMENT IN THE NATIONAL MOVEMENT. IN FACT, WITH THE SHAH GONE THEY DO NOT EXPECT ANY OF THE AYATOLLAHS TO EXERCISE GREAT INFLUENCE. EMBOFF ASKED IF FREE ELECTIONS WOULD NOT RETURN A BEVY OF KHOMEINI-APPROVED DEPUTIES. THEY THOUGHT NOT, EXCEPT IN SOME VILLAGES. ONE OPPOSITIONIST CLAIMED FOUR FIFTHS OF THE PEOPLE IN CITIES ARE EDUCATED AND WILL EXERCISE THEIR OWN CHOICE RATHER THAN BLINDLY FOLLOWING KHOMEINI.

COMMENT: IT WAS, IN SHORT, THE NATIONAL FRONT/UNIVERSITY LINE THAT THE RELIGIOUS PEOPLE WILL GET RID OF THE REGIME, THEN THEY (THE INF) WILL STEP IN AND RUN THE SHOW. THEY THINK (WITH JUSTICE) THAT THEY ARE THE ONLY TRAINED POLITICIANS IN TOWN, BUT THEIR SCENARIO BECOMES INEVITABLE ONLY IF ONE ASSUMES IRAN WILL MOVE QUICKLY TO PARLIAMENTARY DEMOCRACY. THAT IS AN OPEN QUESTION. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00901.subject: STATUS OF NUCLEAR POWER PROJECTS ALTHOUGH THE FUTURE OF IRAN'S NUCLEAR POWER PROGRAM IS SUB- JECT TO CONSIDERABLE FURTHER REVISION, WE HAVE LEA

segments.text: ALTHOUGH THE FUTURE OF IRAN'S NUCLEAR POWER PROGRAM IS SUBJECT TO CONSIDERABLE FURTHER REVISION, WE HAVE LEARNED FROM A KNOWLEDGEABLE SOURCE THAT FOR THE MOMENT CONSTRUCTION ACTIVITY AT THE BUSHEHR AND KARUN RIVER SITES CONTINUES. THE GERMAN PROJECT AT BUSHEHR, HOWEVER, IS REPORTED TO BE NOW ONLY 55-60 PERCENT COMPLETE (VICE 85 PERCENT WHICH IS THE OFFICIAL LINE), WITH SOME 80 PERCENT OF THE FUNDS HAVING BEEN ADVANCED. CONSTRUCTION AT BUSHEHR IS ABOUT ONE YEAR BEHIND SCHEDULE, FOR REASONS UNRELATED TO CURRENT POLITICAL CRISIS. CONSTRUCTION AT THE FRENCH KARUN SITE IS STILL IN THE PRELIMINARY STAGES WITH SUB FOUNDATIONS FOR NUCLEAR ISLAND BEING POURED BUT NO ABOVE-GROUND CONSTRUCTION YET INITIATED.
SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00924.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT, JAN 18, 1979 SUMMARY: JUSTICE MINISTER, 15 MAJLIS DEPUTIES RESIGN. VIOLENCE IN AHWAZ. RELIGIOUS HEADS TRYING TO MAKE

segments.text: SUMMARY: JUSTICE MINISTER, 15 MAJLIS DEPUTIES RESIGN. VIOLENCE IN AHWAZ. RELIGIOUS HEADS TRYING TO MAKE TOMORROW'S MARCH PURELY RELIGIOUS. KHOMEINI IS EXPECTED TO ANNOUNCE PROVISIONAL GOVT WITHIN A FEW DAYS. SITUATION QUIET TODAY. END SUMMARY

BAKHTIAR GOVT RECEIVED SERIOUS BLOW WHEN JUSTICE MINISTER SADEQ-VAZIRI RESIGNED YESTERDAY. VAZIRI STATED TO PRESS THAT MINISTRY LACKED TECHNICAL AND MANPOWER CAPACITY TO PROSECUTE ALL THOSE CHARGED WITH CORRUPTION. (HE IS ALSO SAID TO BE UPSET AFTER HIS EMPLOYEES EJECTED HIM FROM MINISTRY BUILDING.) IN ADDITION, FIFTEEN MAJLIS DEPUTIES, INCLUDING WELL-KNOWN OPPOSITIONIST MOHSEN PEZESHKPOUR, RESIGNED YESTERDAY, SAYING THEY WERE UNABLE TO PERFORM DUTIES UNDER PRESENT CONDITIONS. ACTION IS IN ACCORDANCE WITH KHOMEINI'S RECENT NINE-POINT MANIFESTO WHICH DEMANDED, AMONG OTHER THINGS, THAT THE MAJLIS DEPUTIES STAY AWAY FROM PARLIAMENT.

FOREIGN MINISTRY ANNOUNCED YESTERDAY THAT AMB. ZAHEDI HAS RESIGNED AND THAT 8 OTHER AMBASSADORS HAVE BEEN FIRED. THEY WERE ENVOYS TO UNITED NATIONS, U.K., BRAZIL, DENMARK, SYRIA, ITALY, INDIA, AND FRANCE. RADIO IRAN SAYS AMB. TO AUSTRALIA HAS ALSO BEEN RECALLED. (COMMENT: WE WOULD ASSUME EVEN MORE CHANGES WILL TAKE PLACE IN NOT-TOODISTANT FUTURE.)

AHWAZ WAS SCENE OF BLOODY CLASH YESTERDAY AS PRO-SHAH TROOPS ATTACKED CROWD. REPORTS CONFLICT WILDLY. GOVT ACKNOWLEDGES ONLY FIVE WOUNDED, FOUR OF WHOM WERE SOLDIERS. THIS IS CERTAINLY TOO FEW, BUT WE HAVE NO RELIABLE FIGURE AS YET. PRESS SOURCEHEARD FROM EYEWITNESS THAT SOME OFFICERS AND MEN REBELLED WHEN COMMANDER SAID THEY MUST SWEAR ALLEGIANCE TO THE BAKHTIAR GOVT. THERE WAS APPARENTLY SOME SHOOTING WITHIN THE BARRACKS, ALTHOUGH THAT IS NOT CERTAIN. WHAT WE DO KNOW IS THAT SOLDIERS APPEARED IN THE STREETS SHOUTING PRO-SHAH SLOGANS AND ATTACKING DEMONSTRATORS OR PEOPLE DISPLAYING KHOMEINI PICTURES. THERE ARE SOME REPORTS TANKS WERE USED TO CRUSH AUTOMOBILES.

CERTAINLY THE SOLDIERS KILLED AND WOUNDED SOME TOWNSPEOPLE AND DAMAGED SHOPS. OPPOSITION CLAIMS TROOPS FIRED ON CROWDS IN ARAK, KERMANSHAH, AND TEHRAN PARS, BUT PRESS MENTIONS ONLY ARAK WHERE TWO DAYS AGO THERE WERE TWO PEOPLE KILLED.

TEHRAN ITSELF REMAINED REASONABLY CALM. LEFTISTMUSLIM SPLIT IS FAST REVEALING ITSELF. SOME MARCHERS FOLLOWED BANNERS DEMANDING "SALARIES TO THE WORKERS." WE RECEIVED REPORT OF DEMONSTRATION NEAR DOWSHAN TAPPEH YESTERDAY IN WHICH MARXISTS WERE WRITING SLOGAN "KHOMEINI IS JUST ANOTHER LORD" ON WALLS AND CARS. PRESS REPORTS PROANTI-SHAH DEMONSTRATORS CLASHED NEAR JALEH SQUARE YESTERDAY EVENING. LEFTIST LEADER BEHAZIN WAS ADDRESSING CROWD IN NARMAK AREA OF TEHRAN ON TUESDAY WHEN IT WAS BROKEN UP BY ISLAMIC GROUP. IN SAME VEIN, PEOPLES' SACRIFICE GUERILLAS (CHARIK'S) HAVE PUBLISHED LETTER IN LOCAL PRESS SAYING THE REVOLUTION IS NOT THE MONOPOLY OF ANYONE. , AND THAT ALL MUST JOIN TOGETHER.
CONSULATE ISFAHAN REPORTS SMALL GROUPS DEMONSTRATING TODAY, BUT NO VIOLENCE. LARGE DEMONSTRATION IS EXPECTED THERE TOMORROW.

PRESS REPORTS FROM PARIS THAT NATIONAL FRONT SPOKESMAN DARIUSH FOROUHAR IS DISCUSSING "DIFFERENCES OF OPINION" BETWEEN INF AND KHOMEINI. KHOMEINI'S AIDE IBRAHIM YAZDI DENIED YESTERDAY THAT THERE WAS ANY SPLIT BETWEEN THE TWO GROUPS. THE PREVIOUS DAY YAZDI HAD SAID KHOMEINI RULED OUT ANY INF PARTICIPATION IN NEW GOVT. SADEGH GHOTBZADEH SAID THE PROVISIONAL GOVT WILL BE ANNOUNCED WITHIN THE NEXT FEW DAYS, "I HOPE WITHIN 48 HOURS."

AN ARTICLE IN KHOMEINI'S RECENT 9-POINT DICTUM WHICH WE DID NOT REPORT YESTERDAY IS THAT FOREIGN BANKS HOLDING ACCOUNTS OF THE SHAH "AND OTHER THIEVES" MUST NOT GIVE ANY MONEY TO THE DEPOSITORS, BUT SHOULD FREEZE THE ACCOUNTS AND AWAIT INSTRUCTIONS FROM THE NEW REGIME. ANOTHER PRONOUNCEMENT YESTERDAY, KHOMEINI CALLED ON NATION'S YOUTH TO PREVENT DESTRUCTION AND DISORDER, AND HE ASKED THEM TO ASSUME RESPONSIBILITY FOR SECURITY IN CITIES AND TOWNS.

TAFT TEAM AT VAHDATI (NEAR DEZFUL) REPORTS HEAVY FIRE IN AND AROUND DEZFUL LAST NIGHT, PLUS SPORADIC FIRE AROUND BASE PERIMETER, TRACKED VEHICLES ON THE MOVE, AND CASUALTIES BEING BROUGHT TO VAHDATI BASE HOSPITAL. PRESS CARRIES NO MENTION OF AFFAIR, WHICH MAY HAVE BEEN INTRAMURAL CLASH.

ANTI-AMERICANISM STILL FLOURISHES, ESPECIALLY IN PAGES OF MAJOR NEWS DAILY AYANDEGAN. LATEST ISSUE HAS HEADLINE ABOUT KHOMEINI STATEMENT, THEN SUB HEADLINE: "AMERICANS ARE ACCESSORY TO REGIME IN KILLING THE PEOPLE." THE KHOMEINI STATEMENT ITSELF CONTAINS NO SUCH COMMENT. NEW FINANCE MINISTER ROSTAM PIRASTEH IS UNDER ATTACK FROM MINISTRY EMPLOYEES WHO SAY HE HOLDS DUAL U.S.-IRANIAN CITIZENSHIP.
PRIMIN BAKHTIAR HAS PUBLICALLY APOLOGIZED TO NIRT EMPLOYEES FOR SAYING 9 OUT OF 10 TOP OFFICIALS WERE ASSOCIATED WITH SAVAK.

TEHRAN RELIGIOUS LEADERS HAVE ISSUED INSTRUCTIONS FOR TOMORROW'S GREAT DEMONSTRATION, STRESSING IT IS A RELIGIOUS EVENT. THEY WARNED AGAINST SHOUTING SLOGANS, CARRYING BANNERS WHICH DO NOT SUPPORT ISLAMIC PRINCIPLES, OR TAKING PART IN ACTIVITIES WHICH AID THE ENEMIES OF ISLAM.

LATE REPORT FROM RADIO IRAN GIVES DETAILS OF INCIDENT IN DEZFUL YESTERDAY. GOVT SAYS CROWD APPROACHED MILITARY BASE, THROWING STONES AND INSULTING TROOPS. MOB ALSO ATTACKED SEVERAL SOLDIERS' HOUSES AND ALLEGEDLY ASSAULTED THE WIFE OF AN NCO. TROOPS FIRED ON CROWD, KILLING 6 AND INJURING 20. GOVT CALLS ON POPULACE TO OBSERVE INSTRUCTIONS OF CLERGY NOT TO PROVOKE TROOPS.

RADIO IRAN REPORTS 60 KURDISH TRIBESMEN OF THE JALALE-TALEBANI GROUP ATTACKED GENDARMERIE POST OF GURISH NEAR WESTERN BORDER TODAY. GUERILLAS WOUNDED TWO GENDARMES, TOOK THREE OTHERS HOSTAGE, AND STILL SURROUND THE POST.

DCM MET WITH GEN HASSAN PAKRAVAN, FORMER HEAD OF SAVAK AND CURRENTLY ADVISOR TO THE COURT, EVENING JAN 17. THE GENERAL EMPHASIZED THAT HE REMAINS LOYAL TO THE SHAH AND SPENT THE FIRST 20 MINUTES BERATING THE SHAH AND U.S. POLICY OVER THE LAST TEN YEARS. HE REMARKED THAT REPRESSION, FAVORITISM AND CORRUPTION OF THE REGIME HAD BEEN BUILDING TO A BOIL FOR A LONG TIME. HE ALSO SAID THAT AMERICAN RAPACITY, PARTICULARLY IN THE SALE OF ARMS AND SERVICES, HAS MADE MANY IRANIANS STRONGLY ANTI-AMERICAN. HAVING GONE THROUGH THIS ALMOST OBLIGATORY CONDEMNATION IN THE CURRENT CIRCUMSTANCES, PAKRAVAN TURNED TO THE FUTURE.

THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT: FOR THE IMMEDIATE FUTURE GEN. PAKRAVAN STATED THAT IT WAS ABSOLUTELY ESSENTIAL FOR THE U.S. TO GIVE FULLEST SUPPORT BOTH DIRECTLY AND, ESPECIALLY, INDIRECTLY TO THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT. HE NOTED THAT, WHEN HE HAD BEEN CHIEF OF SAVAK, HE HAD ARRESTED BAKHTIAR AND HAD LONG CONVERSATIONS WITH HIM AT THAT TIME AND HAD CONTINUED TO FOLLOW BAKHTIAR'S CAREER. HE SAID THAT BAKHTIAR, ALTHOUGH NOT AS POPULAR AS OTHER POLITICIANS AT THAT TIME, WAS A CUT WAY ABOVE THE REST OF THE LOT--A MAN OF QUALITY.

BAKHTIAR HAS STEEL IN HIM, IS A BRILLIANT INTELLECTUAL, A STATESMAN, AND IN THESE TROUBLED TIMES, HIS WILLINGNESS TO ASSUME THE PRIME MINISTERSHIP MADE HIM ALMOST A HEROIC FIGURE. PAKRAVAN EXPRESSED GREAT CONCERN SHOULD THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT FAIL; THERE IS NOT, HE THOUGHT, AN ACCEPTABLE ALTERNATIVE. HE ONCE AGAIN URGED THE U.S. TO FIND INDIRECT WAYS TO SUPPORT BAKHTIAR.

KHOMEINI: PAKRAVAN HAD ARRESTED KHOMEINI IN 1963 AND HAD ALSO DINED WITH HIM ON SEVERAL OCCASIONS WHEN HE WAS IN JAIL. THE GENERAL SAID THAT HE HAD EMERGED FROM EACH OF THESE SESSIONS WITH A VERY UNSETTLED AND DISTURBED FEELING. THERE WAS NO DOUBT THAT KHOMEINI HAS GREAT CHARISMA AND IS A FORCEFUL SPEAKER. HOWEVER, KHOMEINI IS UNSCRUPULOUS, HAS OVERWEENING AMBITION, GIVES EVERY SIGN OF BEING SCHIZOID, AND IS OF ONLY AVERAGE INTELLIGENCE. AFTER SEARCHING FOR A FURTHER DESCRIPTION OF KHOMEINI, PAKRAVAN SAID THAT, IF HE DID NOT KNOW BETTER, HE WOULD THINK THE DEVIL HAD BEEN REINCARNATED AS KHOMEINI.
THE KHOMEINI ISLAMIC REPUBLIC WOULD BE AN INCREDIBLE DISASTER FOR THIS COUNTRY, HE CONCLUDED. KHOMEINI HAS ENORMOUS SUMS OF MONEY AVAILABLE TO CARRY OUT HIS DESIGNS.

OTHER PERSONALITIES: PAKRAVAN DISMISSED SANJABI QUICKLY AS AN OPPORTUNIST AND SENILE. FOROUHAR WAS CHARACTERIZED AS "THE VILLAGE IDIOT" SINCE HIS YOUTH. MEHDIBARZAGAN IS SINCERE, DEDICATED, ABLE BUT NOT BRILLIANT NOR A GREAT INTELLECT.

TUDEH: THE GENERAL SAID THAT IT WAS PERFECTLY CLEAR TO HIM THAT THE TUDEH PARTY HAD NOW REASSERTED ITSELF AND IS IN FACT AT THE CENTER OF THE ORGANIZATION OF MUCH OF THE TROUBLE IN THE COUNTRY. HOWEVER, WHEN HE HAD DISCUSSED THE TUDEH RECENTLY WITH GENERAL MOGHADAM, THE CURRENT HEAD OF SAVAK, THE LATTER HAD ADMITTED THAT HIS ORGANIZATION KNEW LITTLE ABOUT THE TUDEH OR ITS MEMBERSHIP. PAKRAVAN SADLY NOTED THAT HE WAS DISTRESSED AND ASTONISHED THAT SAVAK HAD COME TO THAT LOW STATE OF AFFAIRS.

HE ADDED THAT WHEN MEMBERS OF THE TUDEH WERE ROUNDED UP IN 1953 AND 1954 IT WAS CLEAR FROM THE FILES THAT THERE WERE OVER 1,000 TUDEH MEMBERS IN THE ARMED FORCES. HOWEVER, GEN. BAKHTIAR, THEN HEAD OF SAVAK, WAS ONLY ABLE TO FIND BETWEEN 6-700. WHAT HAPPENED TO THE REST? HE SAID WE COULD ASSUME THAT IN THE LAST 25 YEARS MANY OF THE REMAINING MEMBERS HAD RETIRED OR DIED BUT THAT IT WAS INCONCEIVABLE THAT TUDEH, AND THEREFORE THE SOVIETS, DID NOT HAVE DEEPLY PLACED AGENTS IN THE ARMED FORCES. HE ALSO FELT THAT THE TUDEH WAS PARTICULARLY STRONG IN THE CENTRAL

1979TEHRAN00935.subject: MESSAGE FOR COMMUNITY SCHOOL TEACHERS, TEHRAN FROM HEADMASTER

segments.text: MR. JOHN MAGAGNA, HEADMASTER OF COMMUNITY SCHOOL, TEHRAN, HAS REQUESTED THAT THE FOLLOWING INFORMATION BE PASSED TO COMMUNITY SCHOOL TEACHERS OVERSEAS.

ANY TEACHER OR ADMINISTRATOR WHO CHOOSES TO TERMINATE THE CURRENT YEAR'S CONTRACT WITH COMMUNITY SCHOOL UNDER PREVAILING CONDITIONS MAY DO SO WITHOUT FINE OR PREJUDICE AND WILL RECEIVE THE FOLLOWING BENEFITS. -A. ONE WAY ECONOMY AIR FARE TO POINT OF HIRE FOR EMPLOYEE AND DEPENDENTS. -B. BAGGAGE ALLOWANCE OF 400 DOLLARS FOR EMPLOYEES AND 100 DOLLARS FOR EACH DEPENDENT TO BE PAID IN DOLLARS. -C. AFTER 25 JANUARY, TEN DAYS NOTICE OF INTENT TO TERMINATE UNDER THESE CONDITIONS MUST BE GIVEN TO THE SCHOOL: FOR GOOD CAUSE, THIS CAN BE WAIVED AT THE HEADMASTER'S DISCRETION. NO NOTICE IS NECESSARY PRIOR TO 25 JANUARY. -D.

EXPATIRATE TEACHERS OR ADMINISTRATORS MUST AGREE NOT TO BEGIN OTHER EMPLOYMENT IN IRAN PRIOR TO SEPTEMBER 1979. -E. FOR TEACHERS RESIGNING WHILE OUTSIDE OF IRAN, AIR FARE WILL BE PAID IN DOLLARS AS SOON AS THE SCHOOL REPLENISHES ITS DOLLAR SUPPLY. -F. SALARIES WILL BE PRO-RATED (SEE FACULTY HANDBOOK) UP TO THE DAY OF TERMINATION. IN ADDITION, ONE MONTHS SALARY (NET AND NOT INCLUDING HOUSING OR OTHER BENEFITS WILL BE PAID. -G. THOSE RESIGNING OUTSIDE TEHRAN, WHO HAVE NOT RETURNED TO WORK SINCE 20 DECEMBER, WILL RECEIVE A PRO-RATED SALARY UP TO 20 DECEMBER, PLUS ONE MONTH'S SALARY.
THOSE WHO HAVE NOT CONTACTED THE SCHOOL WILL BE TERMINATED WITHOUT ANY BENEFITS.

JANUARY SALARIES ARE PAYABLE TO THOSE EMPLOYEES WHO ARE HERE TO RENDER SERVICES DURING THE MONTH OF JANUARY, OR WHO HAVE BEEN UNAVOIDABLY DELAYED AND RETURN TO COMPLETE THEIR CONTRACTS. FACULTY, WHO RETURN AND THEN RESIGN BEFORE THE MONTH OF JANUARY IS OVER, WILL RECEIVE A PRORATED JANUARY SALARY ACCORDING TO THE NUMBER OF DAYS WORKED IN JANUARY.

THE SCHOOL WILL ADVANCE TRANSPORTATION FUNDS TO THOSE WHO WERE UNABLE TO RETURN TO IRAN WITHOUT INCURRING EXTRA EXPENSE. IF IN THE JUDGEMENT OF THE BOARD, THE FINANCIAL CONDITION OF THE SCHOOL AT THE END OF THE ACADEMIC YEAR PERMITS, THE REPAYMENT OF THESE FUNDS TO THE SCHOOL WILL NOT BE REQUIRED. SULLIVAN

I MET FOR SOME TIME AFTERNOON JANUARY 18 WITH RAMSEY CLARK AND HIS COMPANIONS. THEY HAVE SPENT ENTIRE WEEK IN IRAN, MEETING WITH BAKHTIAR, BAZARGAN, SEVERAL AYATOLLAHS AND OTHERS KNOWLEDGEABLE OF LOCAL SCENE.
THEY ARE LEAVING MORNING JANUARY 20 FOR PARIS WHERE THEY WILL MEET WITH AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI.

SUGGEST DEPARTMENT AND EMBASSY PARIS SHOULD UNDERTAKE TO DEBRIEF CLARK AFTER HIS SESSION WITH KHOMEINI. WE WOULD PARTICULARLY LIKE TO KNOW HIS VIEWS ON REACHING SOME UNDERSTANDINGS WITH THE MILITARY FORCES IN WHAT IS BECOMING CALLED A MILITARY-MULLAH GOVERNMENT. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN00941.subject: SENIOR IRANIAN MILITARY OFFICERS MEET WITH PN

segments.text: DURING DAY JANUARY 18, SENIOR IRANIAN MILITARY OFFICERS HELD NATIONAL SECURITY COUNCIL MEETING WITH PRIME MINISTER BAKHTIAR. MEETING, WHICH LASTED THROUGH LUNCH, COVERED PERIOD OF NEARLY FIVE HOURS. IT ALSO COVERED WIDE RANGE OF SUBJECTS.

GENERAL HUYSER, TO WHOM MILITARY DEBRIEFED UPON THEIR RETURN TO SCS HEADQUARTERS, GAINED IMPRESSION THAT MILITARY WERE VERY PLEASED WITH BAKHTIAR'S DECISIONS AT MEETING AND THAT SESSION SOLIDIFIED THEIR SUPPORT FOR HIS LEADERSHIP.

AMONG SUBJECTS DISCUSSED WERE PLANS FOR MILITARY REACTION TO JANUARY 19 DEMONSTRATIONS (REACT ONLY IF PERSONALLY ATTACKED OR IF INSTALLATION BEING GUARDED IS ATTACKED); INTRODUCTION OF MOGAS AND DIESEL FUEL RESERVES FOR MILITARY (TO BE STORED AT BANDAR MAHSHAHR); OPENING OF CUSTOMS POSTS (TO BE OPERATED BY MILITARY IF NECESSARY).

PRESS REPORTS THAT MEETING ALSO DISCUSSED SITUATION AT AHWAZ, WHERE SOME ELEMENTS OF ARMORED DIVISION REPORTEDLY WENT BESERK AND HAD TO BE SUPPRESSED BY SENIOR DIVISION OFFICERS. IRANIAN MILITARY DID NOT RPT NOT DISCUSS THIS WITH HUYSER.

BAKHTIAR DID INFORM THEM OF HIS INTENTION TO SEND CHAIRMAN OF REGENCY COUNCIL TO PARIS TO SEE KHOMEINI. HE INDICATED THAT THERE WAS CLOSE PERSONAL RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN CHAIRMAN (TEHRANI) AND THE AYATOLLAH. MILITARY APPROVED OF THIS ACTION. IN MEANTIME, GENERAL MOGHADAM MET WITH BAZARGAN AND BEHESHTI AFTERNOON JANUARY 18. THUS FAR, WE HAVE ONLY BRIEF REPORT FROM DR. MINATCHI ON MEETING, WHICH HE TERMED ONLY PARTLY SUCCESSFUL, SINCE IT DID NOT RPT NOT RESULT IN ARRANGEMENT FOR DIRECT SESSION WITH MORE SENIOR MILITARY STAFF OFFICERS.

1979TEHRAN00944.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT AS OF 1500, JAN 19 SUMMARY: LARGE DEMONSTRATIONS IN TEHRAN, ISFAHAN, SHIRAZ, AND TABRIZ HAVE THUS FAR PASSED PEACEFULLY. T EHRA

segments.text: SUMMARY: LARGE DEMONSTRATIONS IN TEHRAN, ISFAHAN, SHIRAZ, AND TABRIZ HAVE THUS FAR PASSED PEACEFULLY. TEHRAN CROWD COUNT APPEARS DOWN FROM ASHURA FESTIVITIES. ISLAMIC MOVEMENT AND GOI OFFICIALS APPARENTLY COOPERATED SUCCESSFULLY TO MINIMIZE VIOLENCE AFTER DIRECT MEETING LATE AFTERNOON JAN 18. PRIME MINISTER HAS APPROVED RELEASE OF ALL REMAINING POLITICAL PRISONERS JAN 20 EXCEPT THOSE WHO HAVE COMMITTED MURDER. TALKS CONTINUE BETWEEN OPPOSITIONISTS AND BAKHTIAR REPRESENTATIVE ON POSSIBLE COMPROMISE SOLUTION FOR QUESTION OF REGENCY COUNCIL AND ISLAMIC COUNCIL. APPEARS DEZFUL INCIDENT JAN 17 WAS TRIGGERED BY MOB ATTACK WHICH KILLED SIX OR SEVEN MILITARY GUARDS AT DEZFUL ARMY GARRISON. END SUMMARY.

CITIES WITH WHICH WE HAVE DIRECT CONTACT ALL REPORT LARGE, WELL-ORGANIZED AND THUS FAR (1500 LOCAL TIME) ORDERLY DEMONSTRATIONS BY ISLAMIC MOVEMENT. IN TEHRAN, LOCAL CLERGY AND AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI PUT OUT SIMILAR ANNOUNCEMENTS JAN 17-18 SAYING THAT ONLY THOSE CARRYING ISLAMIC SLOGANS COULD MARCH JAN 19, AND THAT THOSE WHO TRIED TO DISRUPT PROCEEDINGS OR BE VIOLENT (READ: LEFTISTS) SHOULD BE TURNED OVER TO POLICE BY CROWDS. THUS FAR, MARCHERS HAVE BEEN WELL-ORGANIZED AND DISCIPLINED, MANY FORMATIONS SINGING POPULAR ISLAMIC SONGS AND CHANTS. MILITARY HELO SPOTTERS BELIEVE CROWD WILL BE SUBSTANTIALLY LESS THAN ON ASHURA, WHILE OTHER ENROUTE VIEWERS BELIEVE CROWDS ARE ONLY A LITTLE LESS THAN ASHURA.
ESTIMATES RANGE FROM A MILLION TO 1.8 MILLION, BUT WE SHOULD HAVE BETTER IDEA AFTER CHECKING WITH MEDIA LATER TONIGHT AND TOMORROW.
IN SHIRAZ, ISFAHAN, AND TABRIZ, SAME PHENOMENON HAS BEEN REPEATED. IN SHIRAZ AND ISFAHAN, CROWDS ARE ESTIMATED AT 100,000-PLUS; NO CROWD ESTIMATE FOR TABRIZ. ALL MARCHES ARE PEACEFUL.

DR. MINATCHI, SHARIAT-MADARI CONFIDANTE, TOLD POLOFF THAT JAN 18 AFTERNOON MEETING METWEEN SAVAK CHIEF MOGHADDAM, KHOMEINI LEADER SEYED MOHAMMAD BEHESHTI, AND LIBERATION MOVEMENT'S (LMI) MEHDI BAZARGAN WENT VERY WELL. OPPOSITION DISCUSSED PARADE AND CROWD CONTROL WITH MOGHADDAM, AND MINATCHI DESCRIBED RESULTS AS "VERY HELPFUL". MOGHADDAM DID NOT PROPOSE VENUE FOR MEETING OF OPPOSITIONISTS WITH GEN GHARABAGHI, HOWEVER, WHICH THEY HAD EXPECTED HIM TO DO. MINATCHI SAID BAZARGAN AND BEHESHTI WOULD PRESS FOR ANOTHER MEETING, TO INCLUDE GEN GHARABAGHI.

(COMMENT: IF THEY WANT ONE, THEY'LL HAVE TO BE MORE FLEXIBLE ON MEETING SITES; BEHESHTI INSISTED THAT THIS MEETING TAKE PLACE AT HIS OWN HOME AND, AS A RESULT, GEN GHARABAGHI DECLINED TO PARTICIPATE.)

TEHRAN RADIO CARRIED INFORMATION, CONFIRMED PRIVATELY BY MINATCHI, THAT PRIME MINISTER HAS APPROVED RELEASE OF ALL REMAINING PRISONERS TRIED BY MILITARY COURTS EXCEPT THOSE IN JAIL FOR MURDER. ABOUT 150 TO 200 OF TOTAL OF NEARLY 300 ARE EXPECTED TO BE RELEASED MORNING JAN 20.

WITH TIME OUT FOR GALA PARADE JAN 19, TALKS CONTINUE BETWEEN OPPOSITIONISTS AND BAKHTIAR CONFIDANTE (NAME NOT KNOWN) ON SUBJECT OF POSSIBLE COMPROMISE BETWEEN CONSTITUTIONAL AUTHORITY GIVEN TO REGENCY COUNCIL, AND IMPUTED LEGITIMACY OF KHOMEINI-APPOINTED (NAMES EXPECTED TODAY) ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL. BOTH ARE SUPPOSED TO BE REPOSITORIES OF SUPREME GOVERNMENTAL POWER.

JAN 18, SUPREME COMMANDER'S STAFF (SCS) ANNOUNCED THAT TROUBLE ON JAN 17 IN DEZFUL HAD BEEN TRIGGERED BY GROUP OF DEMONSTRATORS WHICH PROVOKED AND ATTACKED ARMY GARRISON WITH ROCKS. MILITARY TOLD AMBASSADOR THAT SEVEN GUARDS WERE KILLED, AND IN ENSUING CLASHES SIX PEOPLE WERE KILLED AND 20 INJURED, ACCORDING TO SCS ANNOUNCEMENT. LOCAL RADIO ANNOUNCEMENT CONTAINED UNUSUAL CONCLUDING SENTENCE: "FOR ITS PART, THE IMPERIAL ARMED FORCES EXPRESS REGRET AT THIS INCIDENT." SULLIVAN

AT CONCLUSION OF TODAY'S MARCH (WHICH PRESS OBSERVERS ARE PUTTING AT SOMEWHERE BETWEEN 1 AND 1.5 MILLION PEOPLE) FOLLOWING TEN POINTS WERE READ OFF TO THE CROWD AND DISTRIBUTED AS APPROVED BY THE DEMONSTRATION: - (1) PAHLAVI DYNASTY IS ILLEGAL AND THE SHAH OUSTED FROM THRONE WHICH HE AND HIS FATHER OCCUPIED BY FORCE. - (2) REACTIONARY ROYAL REGIME IS DENOUNCED AND ISLAMIC REPUBLIC DEMANDED.

THIS WILL BE A FREE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC COMING TO POWER BY THE NATION'S WILL BASED ON ISLAMIC TRADITIONS. - (3) IMAN KHOMEINI IS REQUESTED TO NAME AN ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL WHICH WILL FORM A TRANSITION GOVERNMENT TO ARRANGE FOR A PUBLIC VOTE ON THE FUTURE OF THE NATION. - (4) WE DO NOT RECOGNIZE THE GOVERNMENT OF BAKHTIAR APPOINTED BY AN ILLEGAL MONARCHY AND APPROVED BY AN ILLEGAL PARLIAMENT. - (5) THOSE SOLDIERS, OFFICERS, AND NON-COMMISSIONED OFFICERS WHO STAY ON THE SIDE OF THE PEOPLE AND OF THE REVOLUTION WILL BE RESPECTED BY THE NATION. - (6) ISLAMIC UPRISING OF THE PEOPLE HAS AN ISLAMIC BASE, IS COMPOSED OF ALL RANKS OF PEOPLE, AND HAS NO TIES WITH ANY FOREIGN ELEMENTS. - (7) WE DESIRE GOOD RELATIONS WITH ALL NATIONS IF THEIR GOVERNMENTS DO NOT CAUSE PROBLEMS FOR OUR PEOPLE.

ANY PLOTS BY THEM WILL HAVE ECONOMIC AND POLITICAL CONSEQUENCES FOR THEIR RELATIONS WITH IRAN. - (8) PEOPLE'S STRUGGLE WILL CONTINUE TO TAKE VARIOUS FORMS SUCH AS DEMONSTRATIONS AND STRIKES UNTIL FINAL VICTORY, THE ESTABLISHMENT OF AN ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT BASED ON JUSTICE. - (9) WE DEMAND THAT THE ILLEGAL DEPUTIES REFRAIN FROM GOING TO THE HOUSE OF THE NATION (I.E. PARLIAMENT) AND JOIN THE NATION'S FRONT. - (10) WE EXPECT THE MEMBERS OF THE ILLEGAL REGENCY COUNCIL TO ANNOUNCE THE ILLEGALITY OF THEIR POSITION AND RECOGNIZE THAT ALL RESPONSIBILITY FOR THE COUNTRY IS IN THE HANDS OF THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL.

ABOVE POINTS WERE TRANSLATED FOR US BY REPRESENTATIVE OF WIRE SERVICE. HIS PEOPLE HAD SEEN NO PROMINENT NATIONAL FRONT FIGURES AT THE DEMONSTRATION, NOR FOR THAT MATTER PROMINENT AYATOLLAH SUCH AS TALEGHANI (WHO REPORTEDLY MARCHED HALF THE WAY AND THEN RETURNED HOME).

COMMENT: POINTS EMPHASIZE ISLAMIC NATURE OF THE REVOLUTION AND LEAVE INTERESTING NUANCE BETWEEN TREATMENT OF PARLIAMENT AND REGENCY COUNCIL, WHICH ARE ASKED TO DISBAND THEMSELVES, AND BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT, WHICH IS MERELY TERMED ILLEGAL BECAUSE OF THE WAY IT WAS APPOINTED.

1979TEHRAN00948.subject: PORTRAIT OF REVOLUTION IN A SMALL TOWN

segments.text: LAST SENTENCES PARA 5 REFTEL GARBLED IN TYPING AND SHOULD READ: ...TROOPS PRETTY WELL CORDONED OFF THE WELL-KNOWN RESORT HOTEL-CASINO AT ONE END OF TOWN, WHICH BELONGS TO THE PAHLAVI FOUNDATION. MEANWHILE, REZA SHAH KABIR UNIVERSITY WAS RENAMED BY TEACHERS AND STUDENTS, "UNIVERSITY OF NORTHERN IRAN". REST OF PARA AS IN ORIGINAL TRANSMISSION. SULLIVAN

I MET FOR ONE HOUR MORNING JANUARY 20 WITH FORMER PRIME MINISTER ALI AMINI. HE WILL LEAVE FOR PARIS JANUARY 22 AND EXPECTS TO SEE KHOMEINI. IN MEANTIME, HE HAS BEEN SEEING VARIOUS POLITICAL AND RELIGIOUS FIGURES IN TEHRAN IN ORDER TO MAKE HIS OWN ESTIMATE OF THE SITUATION AND TO PREPARE HIMSELF FOR TALKS IN PARIS.

HE SAYS THAT HIS TALKS WITH BAZARGAN, BEHESHTI, AND EVEN AYATOLLAH TALEGANI CONVINCE HIM THAT KHOMEINI IS RECEIVING MODERATE COUNSEL AND WILL REFRAIN FROM ACTING PRECIPITATELY. HE REALIZES THAT KHOMEINI IS STUBBORN AND RIGID, BUT BELIEVES HE IS NO RPT NO FOOL AND WILL AVOID PLUNGING THE COUNTRY INTO A BLOODBATH.

AMINI HAS THE IMPRESSION, ABOVE ALL FROM BEHESHTI, THAT THE KHOMEINI FACTION WILL AVOID A DIRECT CONFRONTATION WITH BAKHTIAR AND WILL TOLERATE HIS EFFORTS, EVEN THOUGH THEY REGARD HIM AS "ILLEGAL". HE BELIEVES SAHABI AND HIS COMMITTEE WILL WORK TO SETTLE STRIKES, EVEN IN THE BUREAUCRACY, BECAUSE THEY REALIZE THAT THE COUNTRY HAS TO BEGIN TO FUNCTION NORMALLY AGAIN. HE SAYS HE HAS ADVISED BAKHTIAR TO HANG TOUGH AND HAS TOLD THE PARLIAMENT AND THE REGENCY COUNCIL TO REFUSE TO DISSOLVE THEMSELVES, AS KHOMEINI DEMANDS. HE BELIEVES ALL THREE WILL STAND FIRM, AND WILL INSIST THAT THEIR LEGITIMACY IS MORE VALID THAN KHOMEINI'S ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL.

AMINI BELIEVES THAT FORCES WITHIN THE COUNTRY SUCH AS THE QOM AYATOLLAHS, THE BAZAARIS, AND THE PEOPLE WHO ARE UNEMPLOYED ARE BEGINNING TO ASSERT THEMSELVES AND WILL ERODE KHOMEINI'S ABSOLUTE FREEDOM OF ACTION. HE THINKS THAT KHOMEINI, FACED WITH THESE FACTS, WILL MAKE TACTICAL CONCESSIONS, EVEN WHILE REFUSING TO RETRACT THE POSITIONS HE HAS PUBLICLY TAKEN.

COMMENT: ALI AMINI IS A SHREWD OBSERVER OF LOCAL POLITICS, AND, AS A WEALTHY INDIVIDUAL, HAS A GREAT STAKE IN AN ORDERLY RESOLUTION OF THE CURRENT IMPASSE. HIS CURRENT VIEWS ARE CONSIDERABLY MORE OPTIMISTIC THAN HIS VIEWS OF A WEEK AGO. HOWEVER, THEY ARE DERIVED FROM TALKING WITH KHOMEINI PEOPLE HERE IN TEHRAN WHO MAY HAVE A MORE REALISTIC UNDERSTANDING OF THE DANGERS INHERENT IN THE CURRENT SITUATION THAN DOES THE KHOMEINI

1979TEHRAN00952.subject: POLITICAL-SECURITY REPORT - JAN. 20 SUMMARY: TEHRAN AND OTHER CITIES GENERALLY QUIET TODAY AFTER MASSIVE, PEACEFUL DEMONSTRATIONS YESTE

segments.text: SUMMARY: TEHRAN AND OTHER CITIES GENERALLY QUIET TODAY AFTER MASSIVE, PEACEFUL DEMONSTRATIONS YESTERDAY. COMMUNISTS REPORTEDLY ORGANIZING THEIR OWN DEMONSTRATION IN TEHRAN FOR JAN. 21. END SUMMARY.

TEHRAN WAS QUIET THIS MORNING AFTER BIG DAY YESTERDAY. SOME MINOR, PEACEFUL MARCHES REPORTED IN SCATTERED LOCATIONS BY MIDDAY. (INCIDENTALLY, FRENCH EMBASSY SOURCE CONFIDED THAT SOME FRENCH REPORTERS, INCLUDING FRENCH RADIO CORRESPONDENT HERE, FILED THEIR REPORTS ON JAN. 19 DEMONSTRATION THE DAY BEFORE. THEY INCLUDED THEIR COUNT - TWO MILLION - WHICH RUNS SUBSTANTIALLY HIGHER THAN THAT OF ALL OTHER OBSERVERS HERE, WITH EXCEPTION OF OPPOSITION ORGANIZERS WHO CLAIM 2.5 MILLION. SUPREME COMMANDER'S STAFF, ON BASIS OF HELICOPTER OBSERVATION AND LATER MEASUREMENT OF AREAS OCCUPIED BY DEMONSTRATORS, ESTIMATE CROWD WAS 350,000.) CONSUL TABRIZ REPORTS THAT CITY ALMOST ENTIRELY CLOSED DOWN AND QUIET, AFTER MASSIVE DEMONSTRATION YESTERDAY.
ISFAHAN AND SHIRAZ QUIET, WITH MOST NON-FOOD STORES CLOSED. AHWAZ ALSO REPORTED QUIET.

ACCORDING TO PRESS SOURCES DEMONSTRATION IN MASHAD YESTERDAY WAS ALMOST AS BIG AS THE ONE IN TEHRAN, APPROACHING OR SURPASSING ONE MILLION. IT TOO WAS WELL ORGANIZED AND PEACEFUL. ONE PRESS SERVICE SOURCE REPORTED MINOR CLASHES BETWEEN RIVAL GROUPS OF DEMONSTRATORS IN ZAHEDAN AND PERHAPS ALSO IN KERMANSHAH. DEMONSTRATIONS TOOK PLACE IN ALMOST ALL IRANIAN TOWNS OF ANY SIZE AND OVERWHELMINGLY APPEAR TO HAVE BEEN PEACEFUL.
OPPOSITION SOURCE TOLD EMBASSY TODAY THAT COMMUNISTS ARE ORGANIZING THEIR OWN DEMONSTRATION TO TAKE PLACE IN SOUTHERN TEHRAN TOMORROW, JANUARY 21.

TEHRAN RADIO REPORTED YESTERDAY THAT GENDARMERIE POST WHICH HAD BEEN ATTACKED BY KURDS BELONGING TO (LEFTIST) TALAHANI GROUP WAS BACK IN GOVERNMENT HANDS AND ATTACKERS HAD BEEN DRIVEN OFF. ONE OF THE THREE WOUNDED GENDARMES HAD DIED. WE HAVE NOT CONFIRMED VERACITY OF THIS REPORT NOR FATHOMED WHAT MIGHT LIE BEHIND IT.

PRESS SOURCE TELLS US NATIONAL FRONT SPOKESMAN HAS DENIED REPORT APPEARING IN TEHRAN MORNING PRESS THAT SANJABI IS TEMPORARILY SUSPENDING HIS AFFILIATION WITH NATIONAL FRONT TO ACCEPT POSITION ON ISLAMIC REVOLU
SCS COMMANDER GHARABAGHI HAS INFORMED SERVICE CHIEFS, PRIMIN, AND SPEAKERS OF MAJLIS AND SENATE THAT HE INTENDS RESIGN.

IN CONVERSATION WITH GENERAL HUYSER, AFTERNOON JANUARY 20, GHARABAGHI INDICATED THAT HE WAS INTENSELY DISPLEASED BY PRIMIN BAKHTIAR'S PRESS STATEMENT JAN. 19 THAT, IF HE WERE OVERTHROWN, A MILITARY TAKE-OVER WOULD OCCUR. HE TOLD HUYSER THAT HE HAD NOT BEEN CONSULTED ON STATEMENT AND DID NOT WISH TO BE RESPONSIBLE FOR A BLOODBATH.

HE APPEARED LESS THAN CONVINCED BY ARGUMENTS OF HUYSER AND SERVICE CHIEFS THAT HIS RESIGNATION REMOVED PRINCIPAL SUPPORT FOR BAKHTIAR, COULD PRECIPITATE KHOMEINI RETURN AND INSTALLATION OF REVOLUTIONARY ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT, AND CAUSE DISINTEGRATION OF MILITARY. HUYSER ALSO EMPHASIZED THAT SHAH HAD BESTOWED GREAT CONFIDENCE IN HIM.
I AM SEEING BAKHTIAR SHORTLY AND WILL URGE THAT HE EXERT MAXIMUM EFFORT TO RETAIN GHARABAGHI.
AFTER TYPING OF ABOVE, ADMIRAL HABIBOLAHI TOLD GENERAL HUYSER THAT GENERAL GHARABAGHI IS STILL CONSIDERING HIS DECISION TO RESIGN AND THAT IT WILL BE DECIDED AT MEET
