1979TEHRAN00959.subject: OIL FOR TURKISH EMBASSY HEATING OIL WAS DELIVERED TO TURKISH EMBASSY BY ARMISH/ MAAG TODAY, JAN 20. SULLIVAN

segments.text: HEATING OIL WAS DELIVERED TO TURKISH EMBASSY BY ARMISH/ MAAG TODAY, JAN 20. SULLIVAN

WHEN MILITARY LEADERS HEARD THAT IRANIAN EMBASSY WAS TO BE CONTROLLED BY ANTI-SHAH GROUP, THEY BECAME CONCERNED OVER THE INTEGRITY OF THE FILES AND PREVAILED UPON PRIMIN BAKHTIAR NOT TO ACCEPT ZAHEDI'S RESIGNATION AT THIS TIME.
GENERAL HUYSER AND I UNDERSTAND AND WILL BE GUIDED BY INSTRUCTIONS CONTAINED REFTELS.

HOWEVER, WE BELIEVE THE EMPHASIS WHICH THE MESSAGE PLACES UPON EFFORTS TO "BROADEN" THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT IS A MISREADING OF THE LOCAL SITUATION. BAKHTIAR WILL, IT IS TRUE, HAVE TO BRING SOME ADDITIONAL MINISTERS INTO HIS CABINET MERELY BECAUSE HE HAS SEVERAL PORTFOLIOS WHICH ARE UNFILLED. DESPITE THIS FACT, THERE ARE NO RPT NO INDICATIONS THAT SUCH NEW MINISTERS WOULD BE DRAWN FROM SEGMENTS OF IRANIAN SOCIETY WHICH WOULD ACT AGAINST THE INTERESTS OF THE WEST OR TOWARDS A FRAGMENTATION OF THE MILITARY. IF BAKHTIAR CAN OBTAIN FURTHER COLLABORATORS, WE WOULD EXPECT THEM TO BE CUT FROM HIS OWN POLITICAL FABRIC.

THEREFORE, THE PURPOSE OF THE VARIOUS CONTACTS WE HAVE BEEN SPONSORING AMONG NON-COMMUNIST POLITICAL FORCES HAS BEEN NOT RPT NOT FOR THE PURPOSE OF "BROADENING" THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT BUT RATHER FOR THE PURPOSE OF ATTEMPTING TO DEVELOP A CONSENSUS ON PROCEDURE RPT PROCEDURE FOR AN ORDERLY TRANSITION. WE HOPE THERE WILL EMERGE A CONVERGENCE THAT WILL AVOID A CONFRONTATION AMONG NON-COMMUNIST FORCES WHICH COULD TEAR THIS COUNTRY APART. IN THIS PROCESS, WE WOULD EXPECT EACH OF THE FORCES TO PRESERVE ITS OWN INTEGRITY RATHER THAN FORMING INTO ANY SORT OF COALITION.

IDEALLY, WE WOULD LIKE TO SEE AGREEMENT REACHED THAT FREE ELECTIONS WOULD BE HELD IN THE NEAR FUTURE TO ELECT A NEW MAJLIS AND A NEW SENATE. THIS PARLIAMENT WOULD THEN HAVE TWO TASKS; (A) TO SELECT A GOVERNMENT WHICH EVERYONE COULD AGREE WAS "LEGAL," AND (B) TO MEET TOGETHER JOINTLY AS PROVIDED BY THE CONSTITUTION AS A CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY. THIS LATTER BODY WOULD EXAMINE THE CURRENT CONSTITUTION WITH A VIEW TO AMENDING IT, REPLACING IT WITH A NEW ONE, OR PRESERVING IT. THE OUTCOME OF THIS PROCESS WOULD DETERMINE WHETHER IRAN IN FUTURE WOULD BE A MONARCHY OR A REPUBLIC.

THE PROBLEM IN ACHIEVING THIS CONSENSUS, WHICH WOULD PROBABLY BE ACCEPTABLE TO ALL NON-COMMUNIST FORCES, IS THAT THE KHOMEINI CAMP INSISTS THE CURRENT GOVERNMENT IS "ILLEGAL," AND CANNOT RPT NOT BE THE INSTRUMENT TO CARRY OUT FREE ELECTIONS. THE DANGER IN THIS SITUATION IS THAT THE KHOMEINI PEOPLE, OR THE STRENGTH OF THE "REFERENDUM IN THE STREETS" MAY ATTEMPT TO SET UP A RIVAL GOVERNMENT IN IRAN TO CHALLENGE THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT. THIS COULD LEAD TO THE CONFRONTATION WE WISH TO AVOID AND TO THE MUTUAL DESTRUCTION OF THE NON-COMMUNIST FORCES.

IF, ON THE OTHER HAND, KHOMEINI LIMITS HIMSELF TO SETTING UP AN"ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL," AND IF THAT COUNCIL CONSISTS OF REASONABLE MEN, IT IS POSSIBLE THAT THEY COULD WORK OUT SOME ARRANGEMENT WITH BAKHTIAR UNDER WHICH, FOR EXAMPLE, BAKHTIAR IS PERMITTED TO ORGANIZE THE ELECTIONS, BUT THE COUNCIL WILL "SUPERVISE" THEM TO ASSURE THEY ARE FREE. THERE ARE OTHER VARIATIONS WHICH MIGHT ACHIEVE THE SAME RESULTS, AND PERSIANS ARE MORE IMAGINATIVE THAN AMERICANS IN DEVISING THEM.

AT THE PRESENT JUNCTURE, THEREFORE, THE ACTION WHICH MUST BE AVOIDED IS THE ACTUAL ESTABLISHMENT BY KHOMEINI OF A RIVAL "PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT". HE SHOULD BE TOLD THAT, IF HE WERE TO SET UP SUCH A GOVERNMENT, IT WOULD PROBABLY BE RECOGNIZED BY THE SOVIETS, THE EAST EUROPEANS, LIBYA AND ALGERIA, BUT BY NOBODY ELSE. THEREFORE, SUCH A GOVERNMENT WOULD BE PERCEIVED IN IRAN AS AN AGENT OF THE SOVIETS. TO AVOID THIS, HE MUST BE PREPARED TO WORK WITH BAKHTIAR AND THE MILITARY ON SOME PROCEDURAL CONSENSUS WHICH WOULD GET THEM IN AN ORDERLY, AGREED FASHION TO A CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY. THIS NEED NOT MEAN SUPPORTING, OR EVEN "LEGITIMIZING" BAKHTIAR.

BUT, IT WOULD MEAN WORKING IN PARALLEL WITH HIM EVEN AS THEY NOW SEEM ------------------015824 201610Z /50 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 3177 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 00962 NODIS CHEROKEE PREPARED TO DO IN ENDING VARIOUS STRIKE ACTIONS.

IN OPTIMUM CIRCUMSTANCES, FREE ELECTIONS SHOULD BE HELD ONLY AFTER THE COUNTRY RETURNS TO A CALM ATMOSPHERE WITH NORMAL ECONOMIC ACTIVITY. KHOMEINI SHOULD, THEREFORE, ALSO BE URGED TO ACCELERATE THE PROCESS OF ECONOMIC NORMALIZATION SO THAT THE POLITICAL FUTURE OF IRAN CAN BE DETERMINED. IF HE TRULY BELIEVES IN THE SUPPORT HE CLAIMS FOR AN "ISLAMIC REPUBLIC", HE SHOULD NOT RPT NOT HESITATE TO PUT HIS IDEAS TO THE TEST OF A POPULAR VOTE.

I WILL BE SEEING BAKHTIAR IN A FEW HOURS TO DETERMINE WHAT PLANS HE HAS FOR AN ORDERLY POLITICAL TRANSITION. FROM HIS PUBLIC STATEMENTS, HE WOULD APPEAR TO BE THINKING ALONG THE LINES EXPOSED IN THE PREVIOUS PARAGRAPHS. I WILL TRY TO DETERMINE WHAT HIS PRIVATE OPINIONS MAY BE.
GENERAL HUYSER CONCURS IN THIS MESSAGE. SULLIVAN

ACCORDING TO CONSUL ISFAHAN, THERE WAS SERIOUS VIOLENCE JAN 19 IN TOWNS OF NAJAFABAD AND TIRAN OUTSIDE OF ISFAHAN BETWEEN PRO- AND ANTI-SHAH GROUPS. AT LEAST 12 KILLED AND 55 INJURED IN FORMER TOWN. MILITARY FORCES WERE APPARENTLY NOT INVOLVED UNLESS THEY JOINED LOCAL PRO-SHAH FARMERS IN CIVILIAN CLOTHES.
PROBABLY 300,000 PERSONS GATHERED IN CENTRAL MAIDAN TODAY IN ISFAHAN TO LISTEN TO AYATOLLAH MONTAZERI WHO RETURNED RECENTLY FROM PARIS MEETING WITH KHOMEINI. NO VIOLENCE AS OF LATE AFTERNOON.
THREE ANTI-AMERICAN INCIDENTS OCCURRED LAST EVENING: ONE CAR WAS BURNED AND TWO PEOPLE WERE ASSAULTED IN THEIR HOMES. NO ONE SERIOUSLY INJURED. SULLIVAN
AFTER INTENSE AND AT TIMES EMOTIONAL DISCUSSION AMONG PRIMIN BAKHTIAR, GENERAL GHARABAGHI AND MYSELF, THE GENERAL AGREED THAT HE WOULD REMAIN AT HIS POST.
GENERAL GHARABAGHI JOINED US TOWARD END OF DISCUSSION BETWEEN PRIMIN AND ME ON OTHER MATTERS WHICH I WILL REPORT

IT IS MY VIEW THAT WE SHOULD MAKE AN EFFORT TO MEET AS MANY AS POSSIBLE OF THE PEOPLE AROUND KHOMEINI IN ORDER TO HAVE A BETTER IDEA OF THEIR VIEWS AND IN ORDER CONVINCE THEM U.S. DOES NOT REGARD THEM AS OUR ENEMIES.
ACCORDINGLY, I WOULD FAVOR CONTACT BETWEEN EXECUTIVE BRANCH AND GHOTBZADEH, PREFERABLY AT THE SAUNDERS LEVEL.
(C-PARA 2)

LAST EVENING AROUND 9:00 P.M. A SHOT WAS FIRED THROUGH THE WINDOW OF THE HOME OF OUR NAVAL ATTACHE, CAPTAIN ROY HOLLINGWORTH, NARROWLY MISSING HIM. CAPTAIN HOLLINGWORTH BELIEVES THAT HE HAS BEEN UNDER SOME SURVEILLANCE FOR TWO OR THREE DAYS. (OSI IS SUBMITTING FULL REPORT.) CAPTAIN HOLLINGWORTH IS MOVING FROM HIS HOUSE TODAY.

(U) IN RESPONSE TO QUERIES FROM PRESS OR OTHERS WE ARE RESPONDING AS FOLLOWS: ONE SHOT WAS FIRED THROUGH THE WINDOW OF CAPTAIN HOLLINGWORTH'S HOME ABOUT 9 P.M. ON JANUARY 20. HE WAS NOT INJURED. SULLIVAN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: SPECULATION KHOMEINI WILL RETURN FRIDAY. DEMONSTRATIONS CONTINUE, FEATURING LEFTIST DEMOS. TERRORIST FIRED SHOT AT EMBOFF LAST NIGHT, ANOTHER AMERICAN BEATEN. VAST MAJORITY OF MAJLIS DEPUTIES HANG ON DESPITE THREATS AND WARNINGS TO RESIGN. TWO MEMBERS OF RECENCY COUNCIL RUMORED RESIGNING. PRESS CARRIES STRONG KHOMEINI ATTACK ON PRESIDENT CARTER. END SUMMARY.

MORNING PRESS IS FULL OF SPECULATION KHOMEINI WILL RETURN TO IRAN ON FRIDAY. LMI SOURCE TOLD EMBOFF THE AYATOLLAH WILL INDEED RETURN ON THAT DAY. SOURCE SAID OPPOSITION STILL FEARS MILITARY COUP AND CLAIMED 60 OFFICERS ARE MEETING IN WESTERN IRAN TO PLOT SUCH ACTION. OTHERWISE, LITTLE MOVEMENT ON POLITICAL FRONT. ISLAMIC COUNCIL IS STILL UNANNOUNCED, BUT PRESS, CLAIMING WORD FROM AUTHORITATIVE SOURCES, SAYS SANJABI AND FOROUHAR MAY BE INCLUDED, SERVING ON THEIR OWN RATHER THAN AS REPRESENTATIVES OF INF. (COMMENT: TWO OUT OF FIVE SEEMS ON THE HIGH SIDE FOR A PARTY WHICH SEEMS TO TRAIL HELPLESSLY IN KHOMEINI'S WAKE.)

DAILY DEMONSTRATIONS CONTINUE, AS DO THE STRIKES. UPON APPEAL FROM SHARIATMADARI, CUSTOMS OFFICIALS WILL CLEAR ESSENTIAL GOODS, SUCH AS FOODSTUFFS. RUFFIANS HAVE CLOUDED THE DEMONSTRATION PICTURE. TWO IRANIAN DRIVERS FOR FORD AEROSPACE WERE BEATEN BY SOLDIERS YESTERDAY ON ROAD FROM QOM TO ISFAHAN BECAUSE THEY HAD POSTED PICTURES OF KHOMEINI WHICH THEY OBTAINED IN QOM. ON SALEH ROAD SOUTHWEST OF TEHRAN, GROUPS LAST NIGHT SMASHED WINDOWS WHICH DISPLAYED KHOMEINI'S PICTURE. THERE WAS VIOLENCE ON SHAH REZA LAST NIGHT WHERE A LINE OF PUMPS AT A GAS STATION WAS BLOWN UP BY A GRENADE AND TWO AUTOMOBILES DESTROYED.

MEANWHILE FARTHER WEST, WHERE THE STREET BECOMES EISENHOWER, FORD AEROSPACE AMERICAN WAS ATTACKED BY CROWD AS HE WAS CAUGHT IN HEAVY TRAFFIC BESIDE A GAS STATION. CROWDS HAVE MENACED AMERICANS IN THEIR CARS BEFORE, BUT THIS TIME THE MOB DRAGGED HIM FROM THE CAR AND BEAT HIM, CAUSING MINOR BUT PAINFUL INJURIES.

CONSULATE SHIRAZ REPORTS DEMONSTRATIONS YESTERDAY AND THIS MORNING, BUT THAT ENTHUSIASM SEEMS TO BE WANING. CROWDS ARE NUMBERING LESS THAN 1,000 THESE DAYS. FURTHERMORE, THE YOUTHFUL "ISLAMIC POLICE" HAVE RETIRED FROM THE STREETS, PROBABLY AS RESULT OF THEIR THRILLING ASSIGNMENT TURNING INTO DAILY DRUDGERY. CONSULATE ISFAHAN REPORTS THREE LARGE GATHERINGS YESTERDAY TO HEAR AYATOLLAH MONTAZERI . HE SPOKE AT NIOC REFINERY, TEHRAN CIRCLE, AND SHAH SQUARE (FROM ALI GAPU PALACE PORCH). THIS LAST CROWD NUMBERED ABOUT 150,000, BUT TOWNSPEOPLE ARE UPSET THAT MONTAZERI SAID VIRTUALLY NOTHING BEYOND PLATITUDES IN HIS THREE BRIEF SPEECHES. THEY HAD EXPECTED HE WOULD ANNOUNCE THE ISLAMIC COUNCIL OR SOMETHING OF EQUAL IMPORT.

WE KNOW FROM OUR OWN SOURCES THAT HE COULD NOT HAVE ANNOUNCED THE COUNCIL SINCE NEGOTIATIONS ARE STILL UNDERWAY REGARDING RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN REGENCY COUNCIL AND KHOMEINI GROUP. SPECULATION IS HE RECEIVED PHONE CALL AT LAST MINUTE CHANGING HIS PLANS. THE TRAFFIC POLICE AND MARTIAL LAW TROOPS ARE ALSO BACK ON THE STREETS OF ISFAHAN, ISLAMIC POLICE APPARENTLY TIRING OF THEIR TASK.

REFLECTING GENERAL BREAKDOWN OF PUBLIC ORDER, RURAL BANDITS NEAR KHOI HAVE ATTACKED PRIVATE CARS ON THE TABRIZREZAYIEH HIGHWAY. FURTHERMORE, IRANIAN GENDARMERIE CLAIMS ABOUT 500 AFGHANS WERE OBSERVED NEAR BORDER, APPARENTLY PLANNING TO RAID AND LOOT.
IRAN'S KURDISH DEMOCRATIC PARTY, THE OLD LEFTIST SEPARATIST ORGANIZATION, YESTERDAY ANNOUNCED ITS RETURN TO PUBLIC ARENA, SAYING ITS DEMANDS CAN NOW BE MET WITHIN THE NATIONAL FRAMEWORK.

CONSULATE ISFAHAN REPORTS KERMAN ARMY AVIATION GROUP IS SHOWING UNREST. ABOUT 70 HOMOFARS WENT ON HUNGER STRIKE YESTERDAY AND WORK STRIKE TODAY. THEY HAVE NOT GIVEN DEMANDS, BUT IT IS ASSUMED ACTION IS PRO-KHOMEINI.
GOV-GEN OF KHUZISTAN HAS BEEN RECALLED IN WAKE OF RECENT VIOLENCE IN AHWAZ.

ABOUT 100 MUSLIM STUDENTS INVADED OFFICES OF KAYHAN YESTERDAY, PROTESTING THAT PAPER WAS TOO LEFTIST AND DEMANDING THAT 20-PAGE ARTICLE BE PRINTED IN TOTO. EDITORS AGREED TO GRANT SPACE EQUAL TO THE ARTICLE WHICH OFFENDED THEM, AND WHEN THE MUSLIMS REJECTED PROPOSAL, EDITORS REFUSED ALTOGETHER, CALLING IT CENSORSHIP. STUDENTS THEN SAT IN ALL NIGHT AND WERE STILL THERE THIS MORNING.

LEFTIST PROTESTORS HAVE COMPLAINED IN OPEN LETTER TO KHOMEINI ABOUT GROUPS "WHO USE ISLAM AS A PRETEXT TO REVIVE THE INQUISITION." ORGANIZATION OF PEOPLE'S FEDAYEENS, WHICH SENT THE LETTER, STAGED MARCH ALONG SHAH REZA YESTERDAY. SLOGANS WERE MORE LEFTIST THAN PRO-KHOMEINI, ALTHOUGH KHOMEINI PLACARDS WERE ALSO EVIDENT. ANOTHER GROUP COMING UP PAHLAVI AVE WAS REPORTEDLY ATTACKED BY MUSLIMS, WHO SUCCEEDED IN BREAKING UP THE MARCH.

AS ADVERTISED TODAY THE LEFT IS AGAIN ON THE MARCH, WITH DEMONSTRATORS IN EISENHOWER AVE AREA CONVERGING ON TEHRAN TECHNICAL UNIVERSITY. PRESS REPORTS PUT SIZE OF RALLY AT UP TO 10,000. LATE REPORT INDICATES MUSLIM GROUP ATTACKED LEFTISTS AS THEY WERE RETURNING FROM UNIVERSITY RALLY. AS OF MID AFTERNOON, SOME FIGHTING IS REPORTEDLY UNDERWAY ON SHAHREZA.
FOREIGN MINISTRY ANNOUNCED RECALL OF AMBASSADORS FROM USSR AND SAUDI ARABIA AND CONSULS-GENERAL FROM SAN FRANCISCO, NEW YORK AND KARACHI.

NAVAL ATTACHE HAD ONE SHOT FIRED AT HIM THROUGH A WINDOW WHILE HE WAS AT HOME LAST NIGHT. INTRUDER FLED AFTER FIRING ONE ROUND, WHICH MISSED NAVAL ATTACHE BUT NOT BY MUCH. HE MOVED TO NEW RESIDENCE TODAY.

WE HAVE LATE REPORT THAT REGENCY COUNCIL MEMBERS ALIABADI AND VARASTEH ARE ABOUT TO RESIGN, AND OTHERS ARE CONSIDERING DOING SO. ATTEMPTS ARE BEING MADE TO PERSUADE THEM TO REMAIN. WE ALSO LEARN THAT GOI SECURITY COUNCIL MET TODAY TO REVIEW THE SITUATION.
GOVERNMENT YESTERDAY RELEASED 162 POLITICAL PRISONERS. GOI SAYS ONLY EIGHT REMAIN IN CUSTODY, ALL OF THEM ACTIVE

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: FORMER NIOC AIDE AND FORMER MINCOMMERCE DIR GENERAL COMMENTED ON RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN GENERALS NAZEM AND JAM,ON"CHARACTER ASSASSINATION CAMPAIGN" AGAINST GENERAL KHOSROWDAD,ON MIN JUSTICE VAZIRI'S RESIGNATION, ON MARXIST INFLUENCE ONEVENTS, ON SANJABI, ON MFA UNDERSECY ZELLI'S ALLEGED PARTICIPATION IN DEMONSTRATIONS OF JAN 19 AND ON ASSORTED OTHER MATTERS. END SUMMARY

FOLLOWING ARE NOTES FROM NINE-HOUR JAN 20 CONVERSATION WITH BAHRAM CHUBIN, FORMER AIDE TO DR. PARVIZ MINA AT NIOC. CHUBIN IS GENERALLY FAITHFUL BUT UNDISCRIMINATING TRANSMISSION BELT OF WHAT HE HEARS, BE IT TRUE OR FALSE. DURING PART OF THIS TIME, TWO EMBOFFS AND CHUBIN WERE ALSO JOINED BY MOSTAFA ANSARY, FORMERLY A DIRECTOR GENERAL IN THE MINISTRY OFCOMMERCE.

GENERALS NAZEM AND JAM: GENERAL NAZEM WAS RETIRED A FEW MONTHS AGO, IS "A BIT CRAZY" AND "VERY TOUGH." CHUBIN SAID NAZEM WROTE TWO LETTERS OF RESIGNATION TO THE SHAH, THE FIRST OF WHICH WAS TURNED DOWN. IN RESPONSE TO THE SECOND LETTER, WHICH WAS ABUSIVE AND THREATENING, THE SHAH AGREED SIMPLY TO RETIRE NAZEM. NAZEM AND JAM ARE RELATED AND JAM HAS GREAT RESPECT FOR NAZEM'S JUDGMENT. IT WAS NAZEM, CHUBIN CLAIMED, WHO CONVINCED JAM NOT TO ACCEPT THE MINISTRY OF WAR PORTFOLIO.

GEN. KHOSROWDAD: CHUBIN SAID "SOMETHING" MUST BE DONE TO STOP THE CONCERTED MARXIST-LED CAMPAIGN OF CHARACTER ASSASSINATION AGAINST GENERAL KHOSROWDAD, WHO IS TOUGH AND ABLE AND WHOSE 12 OR 16,000 RANGERS ARE STILL PERFECTLY "COULD TAKE OVER THE COUNTRY IN 24 HOURS."

SHARIF-EMAMI'S MEMOIRS - THE FORMER PM WILL SEVERELY CRITICIZE AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN IN HIS MEMORIS. HE IS TELLING HIS FRIENDS THAT EVERYTIME HE TALKED TO THE AMBASSADOR, NO MATTER WHAT WAS HAPPENING, SULLIVAN URGED HIM TO "LOOSEN UP MORE." (CHUBIN'S FATHER AND SHARIF-EMAMI HAVE BEEN INTIMATES SINCE THEIR SCHOOL DAYS.)
MINISTER OF JUSTICE VAZIRI - CHUBIN CLAIMED THAT VAZIRI IN FACT RESIGNED TO FORM A SOCIAL DEMOCRATIC PARTY, WHICH PM BAKHTIAR WOULD EVENTAULLY JOIN. (COMMENT: BALONEY.)

CHUBIN HAS "JOINED" A GROUP CALLED THE "COMMITTEE OF 28," FORMED TO SUPPORT THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT. EACH RECRUIT IS SUPPOSED TO RECRUIT FIVE ADDITIONAL NEW MEMBERS. THIS SUBJECT WAS LOST IN TIDE OF CONVERSATIONS AND EMBOFF DID NOT LEARN WHO "THE 28" ARE.

MARXISTS - CHUBIN ASSERTED THAT DISCIPLINED MARXIST MINORITIES ARE IN FACT CONTROLLING MANY OF THE STRIKES AND WILL, UNLESS STOPPED SOON, EFFECTIVELY TAKE OVER THE RELIGIOUS MOVEMENT. CHUBIN IS NOW A PARTNER IN DELTA ENGINEERING, A CONTRACTOR THAT HAS JOBS (NOW INACTIVE) AT TEHRAN REFINERY, ON IGAT-II AND ON NGL PLANTS IN THE KHUZESTAN OIL FIELDS. ONE OF HIS EMPLOYEES IS A YOUNG MARXIST NAMED SAVARAKI, WHO IS FOND OF DESCRIBING HOW HIS GROUP ARE DIRECTING THE COURSE OF EVENTS.

SAVARAKI, ACCORDING TO CHUBIN, SAYS "KHOMEINI WILL NEVER RETURN; WE WON'T LET HIM." CHUBIN OFFERED TO PROVIDE MARXIST PAMPHLETS GIVEN HIM BY SAVARAKI IN WHICH SAVARAKI HAS UNDERLINED "THE REAL FACTS," TERMING THE REST "CLAPTRAP FOR RELIGIOUS CONSUMPTION." CHUBIN ALSO SAID THEREIS A RUMOR THAT IN A JOINT RAID A FEW WEEKS AGO THE CIA AND SAVAK SIC FOUND A "30-PAGE PLAN FOR A SEVEN-STAGE COMMUNIST TAKEOVER, ESTIMATED TO TAKE 4-5 YEARS."

SANJABI - SANJABI HAS LONG BEEN ON THE NIOC PAYROLL AT A SALARY OF 21,000OR 24,000 TOMANS/MONTH (ABOUT $3,000/ MONTH). ABOUT 10-12 YEARS AGO SANJABI WORKED WITH SAVAKIN IDENTIFYING LEFTISTS IN THE UNIVERSITIES. FURTHERMORE, CHUBINCLAIMED, SANJABI IS NOT IRANIAN BORN. (OUR BIO DATA INDICATES HE WAS BORN IN SANJABI TRIBAL AREA NEAR KERMANSHAH.) IN TRYING TO GET HIM TO FORM GOVERNMENT, CHUBIN SAID, SHAH CONFRONTED SANJABI WITH THESE "FACTS" AND THREATENED TO RELEASE HIS DOSSIER IF SANJABI WOULD NOT COOPERATE. (COMMENT: OF COURSE SANJABI REFUSED -- AND NO "FACTS" WEERE RELEASED. THIS SOUNDS LIKE CHARACTER ASSASSINATION BY SOMEONE.)

MFA UNDERSECRETARY ZELLI - MOSTAFA ANSARY SAID THAT ON JAN 19, FOLLOWING A ROW IN THE MFA BETWEEN THOSE WHO WANTED TO SHOW "SOLIDARITY WITH THE PEOPLE" AND OTHERS WHO FELT ------------------022776 211536Z /43 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 3210 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 01015 LIMDIS MFA SHOULD REMAIN OUTSIDE THE STRUGGLE, ZELLI ALLEGEDLY LED A GROUP TO JOIN THE MARCHERS.

SPEAKER OF MAJLES ALLEGEDLY WILL RESIGN, FOLLOWED BY LARGE NUMBER OF OTHER DEPUTIES, "TO GIVE BAKHTIAR A FREE HAND" TO GOVERN BY DECREE. (COMMENT: THIS STRANGE VERSION OF THE MASS-RESIGNATION RUMOR HAS ONE THING TO COMMEND IT: RESIGNING DEPUTIES WOULD PRESUMABLY APPEAR TO BE OBEYING KHOMEINI WHILE ASSISTING BAKHTIAR -- AND BY THE WAY ESCAPING RESPONSIBILITY. WHAT MAKES IT SEEM UNLIKELY IS THAT IN MOST EYES THIS WOULD FURTHER IMPAIR IF NOT DESTROY ANY CHANCE OF BAKHTIAR'S ACHIEVING ANY MORAL AUTHORITY. RULE BY DECREE WOULD BE QUESTONED UNDER SUCH CIRCUMSTANCES.) FORMER MIN ECON AND FINANCE MEHRAN HAS DEPARTED AND IS NOW IN LONDON.

HOVEYDA: CHUBIN REPEATED STORY, WHICH HAS APPEARED IN PRESS, OF "MICROPHONE BEHIND HOVEYDA'S CARNATION." HE ADDED THAT HOVEYDA'S INCRIMINATING RECORDINGS OF CONVERSATION WITH SHAH AND OTHERS WERE STORED AT GOI MISSION TO UN BY HOVEYDA'S BROTHER AND HAVE NOW BEEN REMOVED FROM

1979TEHRAN01016.subject: (S) COMMENTS ON MEETING WITH PRIMIN BAKHTIAR

segments.text: (S - ENTIRE TEXT).
I AM SENDING THIS MESSAGE IN STADIS CHANNELS SO THAT DISTRIBUTION CAN BE CONTROLLED. HOWEVER, I TRUST ITS CONTENTS WILL BE SHARED WITH ALL THOSE IN EXECUTIVE BRANCH WHO HAVE NEED TO KNOW.

MY MEETING JANUARY 20 WITH BAKHTIAR AND GHARABAGHI LEAVES ME WITH CLEAR IMPRESSION THAT FUTURE EVENTS HERE ARE THOROUGHLY UNPREDICTABLE AND THAT U.S. CAN DO VERY LITTLE TO CONTROL DIRECTION IN WHICH THEY MAY MOVE.

BAKHTIAR IS OBVIOUSLY A COURAGEOUS MAN. HOWEVER, HE COMES CLOSE TO BEING QUIXOTIC. FOR EXAMPLE, HIS INTENTION TO ARREST THE MEMBERS OF KHOMEINI'S "ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL" IF THEY PRETEND TO EXERT AUTHORITY IN THE COUNTRY IS A SUICIDAL PRESCRIPTION. I AM NOT SURE WHO WOULD CARRY OUT THIS ARREST ORDER, BUT, IF IT WERE DONE, BAKHTIAR WOULD BE LITERALLY OVERWHELMED BY THE MOB AND HIS GOVERNMENT WOULD CEASE TO FUNCTION AT ALL.

BAKHTIAR'S ESTIMATE OF HIS POTENTIAL STRENGTH VIS-A-VIS KHOMEINI APPEARS UNREALISTIC. WHILE IT IS TRUE KHOMEINI MAY LOSE SOME SUPPORT AS TIME GOES BY, IT IS NOT CONCEIVABLE THAT IN ONE MONTH'S TIME, ENOUGH OF HIS POWER WOULD EBB AWAY THAT BAKHTIAR WOULD OUTWEIGH HIM. HE WILL CONTINUE TO BE A TOWERING FIGURE EVEN IF HE DELAYS HIS RETURN.

THE IDEA THAT EVENTS CAN STAND STILL UNTIL NEXT JUNE BEFORE ELECTIONS ARE HELD ALSO SEEMS HIGHLY QUESTIONABLE. THE CURRENT MOMENTUM CAN NOT RPT NOT BE CONTAINED BY A PERIOD OF NORMAL ECONOMIC ACTIVITY, EVEN IF ALL THE STRIKES ARE SOON SETTLED.

IT IS MY OPINION THAT BAKHTIAR IS NOT RPT NOT THE SORT OF MAN WHO WILL TAKE "GUIDANCE" FROM U.S. OR ANYONE ELSE. HE IS VERY MUCH HIS OWN MAN AND IS PLAYING FOR HIGH STAKES. HIS PAST EXPERIENCE WITH THE U.S. DOES NOT RPT NOT CONDITION HIM TO BE RESPONSIVE TO OUR VIEWS OR OUR JUDGMENTS ABOUT IRAN. THEREFORE, IT IS QUESTIONABLE WE WOULD HAVE MUCH INFLUENCE ON HIM.

HIS RELATIONSHIP WITH THE MILITARY, AS YESTERDAY'S INCIDENT SHOWS, IS TENUOUS. THE MILITARY LEADERS DO NOT RPT NOT UNDERSTAND HIS POLITICS AND RESENT BEING USED AS POLITICAL PAWNS IN CURRENT SITUATION. THEY HAVE NO RPT NO DESIRE TO BE PLACED IN A POSITION OF CONFRONTATION WITH THE RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP AND WILL WISH AVERT CLASH WITH KHOMEINI.

THIS RAISES FOR EARLY DECISION THE QUESTION OF WHAT THE MILITARY WILL OR SHOULD DO IF KHOMEINI DECIDES TO RETURN HERE IN THE NEAR FUTURE. THEY HAVE ALREADY INDICATED IN DISCUSSIONS WITH HUYSER THAT KHOMEINI, AS A RELIGIOUS LEADER, HAS THE RIGHT TO RETURN TO IRAN AND THAT THEY WOULD NOT RPT NOT CHALLENGE HIM. THEY WOULD PROBABLY BEHAVE AS THEY DID ON JANUARY 19, GUARDING SENSITIVE INSTALLATIONS AND AVOIDING CONTACT WITH DEMONSTRATORS.

ON BALANCE, WE FEEL THAT IS A PRUDENT COURSE OF ACTION BECAUSE IT IS IMPORTANT FOR THEM TO MAINTAIN THEIR INTEGRITY. IT WILL THEN BECOME IMPORTANT FOR THE MILITARY TO KNOW WHAT THE NEXT MOVES WILL BE IN THE KHOMEINI-BAKHTIAR MINUET. THEY ARE CONTINUING THEIR MEETINGS WITH BEHESHTI, BUT HAVE BEEN VERY RETICENT TO SHARE DETAILS WITH US. IF THE MODERATES CAN WORK OUT SOME SYSTEM IN WHICH PROCEDURES CAN BE AGREED WHICH WILL PRECLUDE A KHOMEINI "COUP D'ETAT" AGAINST BAKHTIAR, THE MILITARY WOULD DOUBTLESS GO ALONG. HOWEVER, IF THERE IS A DIRECT EXTRA-CONSTITUTIONAL EFFORT BY KHOMEINI TO REPLACE BAKHTIAR, THE RESULTS ARE LESS PREDICTABLE.

IN ANY EVENT, OUR BEST HOPES WOULD SEEM TO LIE IN THE CAREFUL PRESERVATION OF THE INTEGRITY OF THE ARMED FORCES. WHATEVER KIND OF GOVERNMENT EMERGES, AN IRANIAN MILITARY ESTABLISHMENT, ACTING IN PARTNERSHIP WITH IT, WOULD SEEM THE BEST GUARANTEE THAT THERE WOULD BE SIGNIFICANT ATTEN------------------022873 211605Z /42 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 3212 SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 01016 NODIS CHEROKEE STADIS///////////////////////////// EYES ONLY FOR SECRETARY TION GIVEN TO VIEWS WHICH ARE CONGENIAL TO U.S. INTERESTS.
(S - ENTIRE TEXT).

FOLLOWING ARE ANSWERS TO QUESTIONS RAISED PARAGRAPH 3 OF REFTEL: - (A) IT SEEMS INCREASINGLY FIRM THAT KHOMEINI WILL, INDEED, RETURN TO IRAN WITHIN THE NEXT FEW DAYS. I ASSUME WE WILL GET MORE AUTHORITATIVE READING WHEN ZIMMERMAN NEXT MEETS YAZDI. IT ALSO SEEMS LIKELY THAT HE WILL NAME HIS "ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL" AFTER HIS ARRIVAL. MUCH WILL THEN DEPEND UPON TYPE OF PERSONS WHO ARE ON THAT COUNCIL. IF THEY ARE MODERATE MEN LIKE BAZARGAN, THEY MAY SEEK TO REACH SOME PROCEDURAL COMPROMISE WHICH WILL AVERT DIRECT CONFRONTATION WITH BAKHTIAG AND THE MILITARY.

IF THEY ARE EXTREMISTS, THEY MAY MOVE RAPIDLY TO ESTABLISH THEIR PROVISIONAL ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT IN A DIRECT CHALLENGE TO BAKHTIAR. - (B) DESPITE HIS WEAKNESS, WHICH WILL BE AGGRAVATED IF AND WHEN KHOMEINI RETURNS, BAKHTIAR SEEMS PREPARED TO ACCEPT DIRECT CONFRONTATION WITH KHOMEINI IF LATTER NAMES RIVAL GOVERNMENT. SINCE HE HIMSELF HAS NO RPT NO RESOURCES, THIS MEANS THAT HE SEEMS PREPARED TO THROW THE ARMED FORCES AT KHOMEINI. IT IS NOT CLEAR TO ME WHETHER HE HAS ANY FLEXIBILITY IN HIS POSITION, BUT, FOR WHAT IT IS WORTH, HE SEEMS TO BE CONSTANTLY IN TOUCH WITH BAZARGAN.

AT CURRENT MOMENT, DECISION RE CONFRONTATION APPEARS TO REST EXCLUSIVELY WITH KHOMEINI FORCES. IF THEY BELIEVE THEY HAVE "REFERENDUM" FROM THE STREETS AND HAVE NEUTRALIZED THE ARMED FORCES, THEY MAY GO FOR BROKE. - (C) ALI AMINI CERTAINLY IS DOING HIS BEST TO HELP AVOID CONFRONTATION, BUT IT IS DOUBTFUL HE HAS MUCH INFLUENCE WITH KHOMEINI. SANJABI IS AN OPPORTUNIST WHO WILL AVOID CROSSING KHOMEINI IN ANY WAY, BECAUSE HE HOPES FOR A FEW CRUMBS FROM KHOMEINI VICTORY.

UNFORTUNATELY, OFFSETTING ANY FORCES FOR MODERATION, THERE ARE COMMUNIST AND PRO-SHAH FORCES WHICH WILL WISH TO PROVOKE A CONFRONTATION. - (D) IN EVENT OF POLITICAL CONFRONTATION, MY BEST GUESS IS THAT ARMED FORCES WILL BE SHARPLY DIVIDED. IF BAKHTIAR ORDERS THE ARMED FORCES TO ARREST A RIVAL KHOMEINI GOVERNMENT, I HAVE DOUBTS ABOUT GHARABAGHI REACTION. HOWEVER, GENERALS HUYSER AND GAST BELIEVE HE AND THE THREE SERVICE CHIEFS WOULD OBEY THE ORDER. WE ALL AGREE THAT THERE WOULD BE EXTENSIVE BREAKDOWN IN DISCIPLINE AND INTEGRITY OF ARMED FORCES, POSSIBLY TO THE EXTENT OF CIVIL WAR.

THE ELEMENTS MOST LIKELY TO REBEL WOULD BE EDUCATED YOUNG MEN, SUCH AS AIR FORCE HOMOFARS, WHO CONTROL MOST SOPHISTICATED EQUIPMENT, SUCH AS F-14 AIRCRAFT AND PHOENIX MISSILES. WE ALSO ALL AGREE THAT, IF BAKHTIAR COLLAPSES UNDER THE KHOMEINI CHALLENGE, THE CONSEQUENCES WOULD BE UNPREDICTABLE, BUT PROBABLY DISASTROUS. GHARABAGHI WOULD QUIT, BUT THE SERVICE CHIEFS MIGHT ACT INDEPENDENTLY. THE SAME DISINTEGRATION BORDERING ON CIVIL WAR WOULD TAKE PLACE, BUT THE CHIEFS WOULD PROBABLY BE ABLE TO COMMAND ENOUGH FORCE TO CARRY THEIR INITIAL OBJECTIVES. ALTHOUGH THEY COULD INFLICT ENORMOUS DAMAGE, THEY WOULD NOT RPT NOT HAVE THE CAPACITY TO TAKE OVER AND RUN THE COUNTRY.
IN FACT, THEY SEEM PREPARED TO ABANDON MUCH OF NORTHERN IRAN AND CONCENTRATE IN A SOUTHERN REDOUBT WHICH WOULD ENCOMPASS THE OIL FIELDS.
(S - ENTIRE TEXT).
YOU WILL HAVE READ THE VERY SOMBER ASSESSMENT CONTAINED REFTEL. IN THE LIGHT OF THOSE FACTS, GENERAL HUYSER AND I FEEL THERE SHOULD BE REEXAMINATION OF U.S. POLICY.

IT IS CLEAR THAT, UNLESS A KHOMEINI-BAKHTIAR CONFRONTATION IS AVERTED, WE ARE HEADING FOR THE WORST POSSIBLE OUTCOME AS FAR AS U.S. INTERESTS ARE INVOLVED. THE TWO MAJOR ANTI-COMMUNIST FORCES IN THE COUNTRY ARE POISED TO TEAR EACH OTHER APART.

THE OBVIOUS OBJECTIVE OF OUR POLICY SHOULD BE TO AVOID THIS, PREFERABLY THROUGH SOME COMPROMISE IN WHICH THE TWO OPPOSING FORCES AGREE ON A PROCESS THAT WOULD LEAD TO AN ORDERLY AND SYSTEMATIC TRANSITION, WHICH ALL SIDES COULD AGREE TO BE LEGAL AND WHICH WOULD ENTAIL GENUINELY FREE ELECTIONS AS THE FOUNDATION FOR A NATIONAL CONSENSUS.

IN A MODEST WAY, WE ARE ATTEMPTING TO ENCOURAGE SUCH A COMPROMISE THROUGH OUR CONTACTS IN BOTH CAMPS HERE IN TEHRAN. WE CAN AND WILL CONTINUE SUCH EFFORTS, BUT HAVE NO RPT NO ILLUSION THAT WE HAVE A CENTRAL INFLUENCE ON THE PROCESS.

IF SUCH COMPROMISE FAILS AND BAKHTIAR COLLAPSES, WE DOUBT U.S. INTERESTS WOULD BE BEST SERVED BY INDEPENDENT MILITARY ACTION. WE THINK, INSTEAD, THAT IT WOULD BE IN OUR INTERESTS TO SEE A NEGOTIATED PARTNERSHIP BETWEEN THE MILITARY AND THE KHOMEINI FORCES. IN ORDER FOR MILITARY TO HAVE A CONSTRUCTIVE VALENCE IN SUCH ARRANGEMENT, THEY WOULD HAVE TO MAINTAIN THEIR INTEGRITY. THIS, IN TURN, WOULD MEAN NO RPT NO INDEPENDENT ACTION BY THE MILITARY. AS GENERAL HUYSER'S INSTRUCTIONS ARE NOW WRITTEN, HE INTERPRETS THEM AS PLEDGING U.S. SUPPORT TO ANY ACTION THE MILITARY MIGHT DECIDE TO TAKE SHOULD THE CIVILIAN CONSTITUTIONAL GOVERNMENT COLLAPSE.

HE AND I BOTH FEEL THAT HE SHOULD BE INSTRUCTED TO COUNSEL THE MILITARY, IN THE EVENT OF SUCH COLLAPSE, TO MAINTAIN THEIR INTEGRITY AND NEGOTIATE A SATISFACTORY UNDERSTANDING WITH THE KHOMEINI FORCES.

FINALLY, THERE IS THE QUESTION OF SEEKING TO INFLUENCE KHOMEINI. HE AND HIS PEOPLE STILL SEEM TO BELIEVE THAT WE ARE SCHEMING TO RESTORE THE SHAH AND FRUSTRATE HIS "REVOLUTION." IT MIGHT HELP IN THE CURRENT CIRCUMSTANCES IF WE WERE TO GET AUTHORITATIVE WORD TO KHOMEINI THAT WE WOULD ACCEPT AND SUPPORT A PROCESS IN WHICH THE FUTURE FORM OF GOVERNMENT IN IRAN COULD BE DETERMINED THROUGH GENUINELY FREE ELECTIONS. WE ALSO BELIEVE THE ARMED FORCES COULD EVENTUALLY ACCEPT SUCH A PROCESS IF IT IS DONE IN AN ORDERLY, LEGAL WAY.

HOWEVER, HE SHOULD UNDERSTAND THAT A DIRECT, EXTRA-CONSTITUTIONAL CONFRONTATION WITH BAKHTIAR AND THE ARMED FORCES WOULD, IN OUR JUDGMENT, LEAD TO A DISASTROUS BLOODBATH, IN WHICH THE KHOMEINI FORCES AND THE ARMED FORCES WOULD BOTH BE ULTIMATE LOSERS.
GENERAL HUYSER AND I SUBMIT THESE VIEWS FOR MOST
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: IRAN WAITS FOR KHOMEINI. BAKHTIAR VOWS TO STAND FAST. PRO,ANTI-REGIME VIOLENCE. LEFTISTS DEMONSTRATE OPENLY. MODERATE AYATOLLAHS DISTANCE THEMSELVES FROM BAKHTIAR. BATTLE BETWEEN SHARIAT-MADARI AND KHOMEINI SUPPORTERS RUMORED IN TABRIZ WITH SHARIAT-MADARI BEING CALLED A SAVAK AGENT. ATTACK ON BAHAI HOUSES IN WEST IRAN. END SUMMARY.

KOHMEINI IS EXPECTED TO ARRIVE LATE FRIDAY MORNING, ALTHOUGH SOURCES DIFFER AS TO THE TIME AND THE AIR LINE (SOME SAY AIR FRANCE: OTHERS SAY IRAN AIR WILL RETURN TO WORK IN ORDER TO BRING BACK THE AYATOLLAH). KHOMEINI MEANWHILE REPORTEDLY STATED AGAIN THAT THE MAJLIS DEPUTIES MUST LEAVE THEIR POSTS, AS WELL AS THE REGENCY COUNCIL, AND CALLED ON THE ARMY TO COOPERATE WITH THE SOON-TO-BE-FORMED GOVT. WE LEARN SECONDHAND OF AN INTERVIEW WITH BRITISH MEDIA LAST NIGHT IN WHICH KHOMEINI ALLEGEDLY REVEALED HE HAS WORKED OUT A DEAL WITH THE MILITARY.

PRIMIN BAKHTIAR ADDRESSED THE NATION LAST NIGHT, DECLARING HE WILL NOT RESIGN BUT WILL REMAIN TO DEFEND THE CONSTITUTION. HE FURTHER CALLED FOR AN END TO DEMONSTRATIONS AND STRIKES, AND HE CRITICIZED THE PRESS FOR PUTTING OUT "POISONOUS MESSAGES". HE ADDED HE WOULD NOT TOLERATE ANY FURTHER "INSULTS AGAINST THE ARMY". HE ADMITTED, HOWEVER, THAT DIFFERENCES HAVE ARISEN IN THE ARMED FORCES BETWEEN RELIGIOUS AND NON-RELIGIOUS GROUPS. BAKHTIAR CLAIMED TO BE THE MOST POWERFUL OF ALL IRANIAN PRIME MINISTERS BECAUSE HE TRULY GOVERNED. THE STRIKERS, HE CLAIMED, ARE GETTING ORDERS FROM OUTSIDE ENEMIES TO PUT PRESSURE ON THE GOVERNMENT, EVEN THOUGH GOVERNMENT HAS ALREADY FULFILLED ALL THE WORKERS' DEMANDS.
FIVE OF 21 MAJLIS DEPUTIES WHO RESIGNED HAVE WITHDRAWN THEIR RESIGNATIONS, SO MAJLIS IS HOLDING FIRM. IRANIAN NATIONAL SECURITY COUNCIL MET LAST NIGHT, BUT WE DO NOT KNOW WHAT WAS DECIDED.

LEFTISTS HAVE INCREASINGLY GONE PUBLIC. MARXISTS MUSTERED SEVERAL THOUSAND YESTERDAY FOR RALLY AT TEHRAN TECHNICAL UNIVERSITY. MUSLIM STUDENTS HARRASSED MARCHERS, AND WHILE THERE WAS APPARENTLY NO MAJOR STREET WAR, THERE WAS PLENTY OF TENSION AND A NUMBER OF SCUFFLES. PRESS REPORTED ONE MUSLIM ADHERENT WHO DELIBERATELY PLOWED INTO CROWD WITH HIS AUTOMOBILE, AND WAS IN TURN BEATEN BY MARXIST SECURITY FORCES. IN PARIS MEANWHILE THE TUDEH PARTY ANNOUNCED APPROVAL OF KHOMEINI'S ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL. TUDEH ESPECIALLY APPROVES KHOMEINI'S DECLARATIONS AGAINST U.S. INTERFERENCE IN IRAN. ALL ANTI-IMPERIALIST FORCES SHOULD UNITE; TUDEH WILL THEREFORE SUPPORT A PRO-KHOMEINI GOVERNMENT.
MARXISTISLAMIC ISSUE, LONG DENIED BY MANY OPPOSITIONISTS, IS NOW TOO OBVIOUS TO BE IGNORED.

IN PROVINCES, VIOLENCE ERUPTED BUT APPARENTLY BETWEEN PRO AND ANTI REGIME GROUPS RATHER THAN LEFT VS. RIGHT. TEN PEOPLE WERE KILLED YESTERDAY FROM CLASHES IN SHIRVAN AND QUCHAN (NORTHEASTERN IRAN). MORE DIED IN MESKINSHAHR, NEAR TABRIZ, ON SATURDAY; GOVERNMENT SAYS ONE WAS KILLED BUT LOCAL RESIDENT SAYS UP TO 40 DIED. THERE WAS ALSO VIOLENCE AND AT LEAST ONE DEATH IN HARSEEN, NEAR KERMANSHAH.

CLUBWIELDERS ALSO STOPPED TRAFFIC ON PAHLAVI AVENUE IN TEHRAN LAST NIGHT.

STRIKES CONTINUE UNABATED. DISSIDENT WORKERS PULLED THE PLUG ON BAKHTIAR LAST NIGHT RIGHT AFTER HE HAD BEGUN HIS SPEECH, REDUCING THE TELECAST/BROADCAST TO BATTERYPOWERED RADIOS. NIRT WORKERS HAVE FORMALLY REJECTED THEIR NEW DIRECTOR, AMIR MASSOUD BARZIN. JUSTICE MINISTRY EMPLOYEES, TOO, HAVE STATED THEY WILL NOT ACCEPT ANY MINISTER WHO IS APPOINTED BY BAKHTIAR.

RELIGIOUS INFIGHTING HAS BECOME MORE EVIDENT. IN ANSWER TO A BAKHTIAR STATEMENT THAT AYATOLLAHS' SILENCE ON HIS GOVERNMENT IMPLIED CONSENT, AYATOLLAHS SHARIATMADARI, GOLPAYGANI, MARASHI-NAJAFI, AND ROUHANI ISSUED SEPARATE PUBLIC STATEMENTS REPUDIATING NOTION THAT THEY SUPPORT THE PRIMIN. PRESS SPECULATES THIS CAME AFTER KHOMEINI ATTACKED SHARIAT-MADARI FOR SECRETLY BACKING BAKHTIAR. IRANIAN PRESS SOURCE WHO HAS PROVIDED RELIABLE INFORMATION IN THE PAST TOLD EMBOFF THAT KHOMEINI PRIVATELY ACCUSED SHARIAT-MADARI OF BEING PRO-AMERICAN AND TOOL OF CIA, WHEREUPON SHARIAT-MADARI SAID SUCH A STATEMENT COULD BE EXPECTED FROM A COMMUNIST.

CONSUL TABRIZ REPORTS MANY RUMORS THAT SHARIATMADARI SUPPORTERS ARE FIGHTING AGAINST KHOMEINI SUPPORTERS IN THE STREETS. (TABRIZ IS SHARIAT-MADARI'S HOME.) ALSO RUMORS BEING SPREAD THAT SHARIAT-MADARI IS A SAVAK AGENT.

PRESS IS FULL OF REPORTS OF MILITARY DISSENSION, IN PARTICULAR A HUNGER STRIKE BY NEARLY 4000 AIR FORCE MEN AT SHAHROKHI AND VAHDATI AIRBASES. ABOUT 1000 MEN AT BANDAR ABBAS AIR BASE ALSO REPORTEDLY STAGED PEACEFUL DEMONSTRATION SATURDAY NIGHT. THERE APPEARS TO BE SOME SUBSTANCE TO ALL THESE REPORTS, BUT WE LACK CONFIRMATION AS TO DETAILS.

CONSUL TABRIZ WAS WITNESS TO TELEPHONE CALLS TO TEHRAN BY TWO SOLDIERS (ONE A CONSCRIPT, ONE A PROFESSIONAL) WHO EXPRESSED WORRY ABOUT SITUATION WHEN KHOMEINI RETURNS ON FRIDAY AND WERE GIVEN ADDRESSES TO GO TO, BY THEIR FAMILIES IN TEHRAN, IF THEY WISH TO DESERT. TABRIZ REMAINS SHUT DOWN, AS MOST TOWNS. NO GOVERNOR, NO MAYOR, AND POLICE HAVE BEEN PULLED OFF THE STREETS AND CONCENTRATED IN OLD PRISON. RELIGIOUS AND "LEFTIST" GROUPS HAD A CLASH IN THE UNIVERSITY TWO DAYS AGO.
WE HAVE LEARNED THAT ABOUT 10 DAYS AGO IN THE SMALL TOWN OF MIANDOB (WESTERN IRAN) 2000 BAHAIS WERE RENDERED HOMELESS WHEN SOME 80 HOUSES WERE BURNED.
SHIRAZ REPORTS QUIET TODAY EXCEPT FOR ONE SMALL (PEACEFUL) DEMONSTRATION NEAR CONSULATE AIMED AT ONE OF SHAH'S PALACES THERE, BUT ALSO INCLUDING SHOUTS OF "YONKEE GO HOME". SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN01077.subject: LMI WANTS U.S. TO PUSH; CONFLICT WITH MODERATES SHAPING UP

segments.text: (C. ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: LMI'S ENTEZAM TOLD EMBOFF THAT LMI URGENTLY WANTS MEETING WITH SENIOR MILITARY OFFICERS TO ARRANGE FOR PEACEFUL ARRIVAL OF KHOMEINI. LMI WANTS U.S. TO PUSH PRIME MINISTER, MAJLES, AND REGENCY COUNCIL TO RESIGN. POLOFF STATED SUCCINCTLY THAT THIS WAS NOT RPT NOT SOMETING U.S. COULD DO AND EVEN ATTEMPTING IT WOULD UNDOUBTEDLY BE HARMFUL. COMPROMISE ON BOTH SIDES SEEMS NECESSARY. KHOMEINI ATTEMPT TO SET UP RIVAL GOVERNMENT ON HIS RETURN COULD BE VERY DANGEROUS. SOURCE SAID LMI STILL WISHED TO DISCUSS U.S. INTERESTS IN IRAN TO AVOID FUTURE CONFLICT. MEANWHILE, MODERATE RELIGIOUS SOURCE INDICATE OPPOSITION MEETING WITH MILITARY WAS CRITICAL, AND OBLIQUELY CONFIRMED REPORTS OF RIFT WITHIN RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP.
END SUMMARY

THIS TYPE OF MOSLEM POPULISM HAS SOME AFFINITIES WITH THE COMMUNIST APPROACH, BUT SHOULD IN THEORY AT LEAST, RUN UP AGAINST THE VERY REAL IMPEDIMENT OF STRICT RESPECT FOR PRIVATE PROPERTY THAT IS IMBEDED IN MOSLEM LAW. I EXPLAINED LATEST PLANS OF SHAH, INCLUDING GATHERING OF FAMILY IN MOROCCO. THAT SEEMED TO DISTURB HIM, AND I AM SURE HE FEELS GEN.

HE THEN SAID THE KISH ISLAND PLAN WAS KNOWN ONLY TO THE NSC MEMBERS (WHICH INCLUDES THE FOREIGN MINISTER) AND MYSELF. HE ASKED ME TO HOLD IT CLOSELY. I SAID I FELT COMPELLED TO TELL YOU, AND HE AGREED. I WENT ON, HOWEVER, TO SAY THAT THERE WERE VERY FEW SECRETS IN IRAN AND THAT I SUSPECTED KHOMEINI WOULD KNOW THE PLAN SOON. HE SAID IF THAT PERSUADES HIM TO STAY AWAY, IT MIGHT BE ALL RIGHT.
COMMENT: BAKHTIAR HAS OBVIOUSLY CHOSEN TO BITE THE BULLET IF KHOMEINI DECIDES TO DO THE SAME. THIS GAME OF "CHICKEN" PROBABLY HAS A FEW MORE ROUNDS TO GO.

(S - ENTIRE TEXT).
I MET WITH PRIME MINISTER BAKHTIAR AT NOON JANUARY 23, AND READ IN TRANSLATION THE SUBSTANCE OF THE MESSAGE ZIMMERMAN WOULD BE INSTRUCTED TO PASS TO KHOMEINI THROUGH YAZDI.

BAKHTIAR REACTED FIRST BY SAYING THERE IS INCONSISTENCY BETWEEN POINTS (A) AND (B). IF U.S. WISHES NO RPT NO OUTSIDE INTERFERENCE, IT SHOULD NOT TAKE POSITION OF "SUPPORT" FOR CONSTITUTIONAL PROCESSES, WHICH ARE STRICTLY INTERNAL IRANIAN AFFAIR. HE SUGGESTED POINT (B) SHOULD READ: "WE BELIEVE THERE ARE ADEQUATE CONSTITUTIONAL PROCESSES, ETC."

HE THEN ALSO SUGGESTED ZIMMERMAN CALL TO YAZDI'S ATTENTION THE TUDEH STATEMENT SUPPORTING THE IDEA OF REVOLUTIONARY COUNCILS AND A PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT. HE SHOULD CITE THIS STATEMENT AS AN EXAMPLE OF THE WAY IN WHICH THE SOVIETS HOPE TO EXPLOIT KHOMEINI'S MOVEMENT AND PLANS.

GENERAL HUYSER HAS NOT RPT NOT YET SEEN MILITARY ON THIS SUBJECT, BUT I AM SURE THEY WILL HAVE NO RPT NO OBJECTION TO THE MESSAGE. AS SOON AS HE HAS HAD CHANCE TO DISCUSS IT WITH THEM, HE WILL INFORM SEC. BROWN, PROBABLY BY SECURE PHONE EVENING JANUARY 23. SULLIVAN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: VIOLENCE IN REZAIYEH AND OTHER TOWNS. TEHRANI RESIGNS. QARABAGHI DECLARES MILITARY WILL SUPPORT BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT. KHOMEINI'S AIDES DESCRIBE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. PRO-GOVERNMENT RALLIES SCHEDULED FOR TEHRAN. END SUMMARY.

PRO AND ANTI REGIME VIOLENCE RECURRED YESTERDAY, PARTICULARLY IN REZAIYEH. PRESS REPORTS VARY, ONE SAYING THE TROUBLE STARTED WHEN CROWDS ATTACKED A SMALL PRO-SHAH DEMONSTRATION, ANOTHER SAYING IT STARTED WHEN A SMALL GROUP OF ARMED CIVILIANS ATTACKED A MILITARY GARRISON. IN ANY CASE, TROOPS RETALIATED, SMASHING SHOP WINDOWS WHICH DISPLAYED KHOMEINI'S PICTURE AND ASSAULTING SUSPECTED KHOMEINI SYMPATHIZERS.) ONE JOURNAL SAYS EIGHT DIED, INCLUDING 4 SOLDIERS, BUT PRECISE FIGURES ARE UNAVAILABLE. WE UNDERSTAND GENERAL BADRAI, COMMANDER OF IRANIAN GROUND FORCES, FLEW TO REZAIYEH YESTERDAY, INDICATING THAT THE SITUATION MAY HAVE BEEN WORSE THAN REPORTED. VIOLENCE IS ALSO REPORTED FROM KERMANSHAH, KHORRAMABAD, AND THE BORUJERD-DOROUD ROAD.

PATTERN IS USUALLY GANGS OF STRONG-ARMED PRO-SHAH GROUPS WHO ASSAULT PEOPLE DISPLAYING SUPPORT FOR KHOMEINI. THIS MEANS THAT THEY CAN ASSAULT ALMOST EVERYBODY, BECAUSE MOST PEOPLE, OFTEN AS THE RESULT OF PHYSICAL COERCION, HAVE KHOMEINI'S PICTURE ON PROMINENT DISPLAY. TEHRAN WAS CALM YESTERDAY. SEVERAL THOUSAND MARXISTS MARCHED AGAIN, BUT NO CLASHES WERE REPORTED. SHIRAZ STILL HAS DAILY DEMONSTRATIONS BUT THEY TOO HAVE BEEN PEACEFUL.

JALAL TEHRANI, CHAIRMAN OF THE REGENCY COUNCIL, RESIGNED IN PARIS YESTERDAY IN ORDER TO MEET WITH KHOMEINI. AS MERELY RESIGNING WAS INSUFFICIENT, TEHRANI HAD TO MAKE WRITTEN STATEMENT THAT THE COUNCIL WAS ILLEGAL. AFTER THESE HUMILIATIONS, HE REPORTEDLY SAW KHOMEINI FOR TEN MINUTES.

AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI APPARENTLY REPEATED TO REPORTER YESTERDAY THAT THE SHAH MUST BE BROUGHT TO TRIAL. ABDOL HASSAN BANI-SADR STATED SOME PRECEPTS OF "ISLAMIC REPUBLIC" YESTERDAY. IN THIS REPUBLIC, THE ONE-NESS OF GOD MEANS THE ONE-NESS OF MAN AND THIS IMPLIES TOTAL EQUALITY. THERE WILL BE NO BUREAUCRATIC COERCION, BUT THE REPUBLIC WILL MOTIVATE PEOPLE WITHIN THE ISLAMIC FRAMEWORK. EACH MAN MUST BE HIS OWN IMAM, I.E. BOTH LEADER AND FOLLOWER. FINALLY, JUSTICE IS THE KEYSTONE OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC.

ASKED WHAT ECONOMIC SYSTEM IRAN WILL ADOPT, BANI-SADR SAID: "CAPITALISM AND MARXISM SURVIVE BECAUSE OF THE UTILIZATION OF NATURAL RESOURCES, BUT ISLAM SURVIVES BECAUSE NATURAL RESOURCES ARE EVERLASTING IN ISLAMIC ECONOMIES." HIS COLLEAGUE SADEGH GHOTBZADEH SAID YESTERDAY THAT ALL POLITICAL IDEOLOGIES, INCLUDING MARXISM, MAY BE DEBATED IN AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC PROVIDED THEY ARE NOT DICTATED FROM ABROAD. HE DESCRIBED A FREE DIALOGUE AMONG POLITICAL GROUPS. NEWSPAPERS, FOR EXAMPLE, WILL BE FREE TO PUBLISH ANYTHING SO LONG AS IT DOES NOT GO AGAINST PUBLIC MORALS. MARXISTS AND LENINISTS MAY HOLD ASSEMBLIES AND PROPAGATE THEIR VIEWS. (COMMENT: THIS IS NOT PROCEDURE SO FAR BEING FOLLOWED BY MOSLEM MOBS HERE.)

A GROUP OF 12 TROTSKYITE DISSIDENTS ARRIVED FROM THE U.S. YESTERDAY AND CALLED A PRESS CONFERENCE TO ANNOUNCE FORMATION OF THE SOCIALIST WORKERS' PARTY OF IRAN. CHAIRMAN OF PRESS CONFERENCE WAS REZA BARAHENI. THE SOCIALIST WORKERS MADE THEIR ANNOUNCEMENT IN THE LOBBY OF THE (LUXURIOUS) INTERCONTINENTAL HOTEL, WHERE MOST FOREIGN PRESSMEN STAY.

CHIEF OF STAFF ABBAS QARABAGHI DECLARED AGAIN AT PRESS CONFERENCE YESTERDAY THAT THE MILITARY STAND BEHIND BAKHTIAR. THEY WILL NEVER STAGE A COUP AND WILL INSTEAD SUPPORT THE CONSTITUTION AND THE LEGAL GOVERNMENT. QARABAGHI SAID HE HAD TAKEN STEPS TO PREVENT PRO-SHAH GROUPS FROM ATTACKING PEOPLE, BUT HE WARNED AGAINST PROVOKING THE ARMED FORCES; PAST INCIDENTS HAD AROUSED THE ANGER OF SOLDIERS. WE HAVE LEARNED THAT AIR FORCE GENERAL NADERI, CHIEF OF LOGISTICS, MADE SPEECH TO HIS SUBORDINATES CALLING FOR FULL SUPPORT OF THE GOVERNMENT. HE WAS BOOED INITIALLY BUT CONTINUED WITH HIS SPEECH.

HE DECLARED THAT ANYONE WHO COULD NOT CARRY OUT HIS DUTY HAD 48 HOURS IN WHICH TO RESIGN. THOSE REMAINING IN SERVICE AFTER THAT TIME WILL BE SEVERELY PUNISHED IF THEY FAIL TO CARRY OUT THEIR ORDERS. MEANWHILE, KHATAMI AIR BASE, ISFAHAN, IS COMPLETELY SHUT DOWN DUE TO NCO (HOMOFARS) STRIKE. STRIKERS DEMAND THAT FOREIGN ADVISORS GET OUT. GRUMMAN HAS WITHDRAWN ALL PERSONNEL FROM THE BASE, BUT NORTHRUP STILL HAS SOME THERE.

GENERAL MEHDI RAHIMI, TEHRAN'S MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR, HAS BEEN NAMED TEHRAN POLICE CHIEF. HE REPLACES GEN. JAFARI, WHO HELD HIS POST FOR ONLY TWO WEEKS. THE APPOINTMENT PASSES OVER GEN. MOHAMMAD ALI NOROUZI, WHO WAS NEXT IN LINE.

IRAN'S BAR ASSOCIATION HAS DEMANDED RELEASE OF 18 PRISONERS WHOM GOVERNMENT CLAIMS ARE NONPOLITICAL. NASSER MINATCHI OF THE COMMITTEE FOR DEFENSE OF HUMAN RIGHTS AND FREEDOM TOLD EMBOFF TODAY THAT THE CDHRF PLANS TO SELECT 100-200 TORTURE VICTIMS TO GO TO THE UNITED STATES, BOTH TO POINT OUT THE BRUTALITIES OF THE REGIME AND TO INDICATE THE HELPFUL IMPACT OF U.S. HUMAN RIGHTS POLICY.
PRINT SHOP WORKERS HAVE DECLARED THEY WILL PRINT NO GOVERNMENT DOCUMENTS, INCLUDING PASSPORTS.
AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI HAS ASKED NIRT INTERNATIONAL EMPLOYEES TO RETURN TO WORK, SAYING CONTINUANCE OF THE STRIKE WORKS A HARDSHIP ON THE FOREIGN COMMUNITY.

TODAY IS WET, SNOWY, AND QUIET IN TEHRAN, BUT PROGOVERNMENT SUPPORTERS ARE PLANNING TO HOLD A RALLY IN STADIUM NEAR EMBASSY AT 1400. WEATHER WILL PROBABLY DAMPEN EVERYONE'S SPIRITS, BUT PRO-GOVERNMENT DEMONSTRATIONS ARE OFTEN INVITATIONS TO PRO-ANTI CLASHES. LARGER PRO-GOVERNMENT MARCH BEING PREPARED FOR TOMORROW. 1979TEHRAN01127.subject: (C)RELIGIOUS MODERATES AIMING TO LEAN ON KHOMEINI

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY: MINATCHI TOLD POLOFF THAT ISLAMIC MOVEMENT WILL PRESS FOR ADDITIONAL MEETINGS WITH MILITARY TO TRY TO MAKE KHOMEINI RETURN TO IRAN JAN 26 PEACEFUL. IN THIS CONNECTION, RELIGIOUS MODERATES INCLUDING SHARIATMADARI AND THOSE AROUND HIM BELIEVE THEY HAVE CONVINCED KHOMEINI TO WAIT UNTIL HE CONSULTS WITH IN-COUNTRY LEADERSHIP BEFORE MAKING FINAL PRONOUNCEMENTS ON SUCH ITEMS AS REGENCY COUNCIL AND BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT. COMPROMISE EFFORT NOW DIRECTED AT SOME SORT OF MANEUVER TO COMBINE REGENCY COUNCIL AND KHOMEINI'S ISLAMIC COUNCIL. MODERATE RELIGIOUS LEADERS STRONGLY BELIEVE CONSTITUTIONAL FORMS SHOULD BE FOLLOWED. THERE ARE FEARS FOR KHOMEINI'S SAFETY. END SUMMARY.

DR. NASSER MINATCHI, SHARIATMADARI CONFIDANTE, MET WITH POLOFF STEMPEL MORNING JAN 23 AFTER SPENDING MOST OF DAY IN QOM JAN 22 WITH SHARIATMADARI AND OTHER MAJOR QOM AYATOLLAHS. MINATCHI SAID GROUP ENTIRELY AGQEED WITH KHOMEINI'S LIBERATION MOVEMENT (LMI) BACKERS THAT TALKS SHOULD GO FORWARD WITH MILITARY. MINATCHI HAD PRESSED GENERAL MOGHADDAM TO GO FORWARD WITH THIS, AND LATTER HAD DEMURRED, SAYING THIS WAS NOT HIS UNDERSTANDING WITH BAZARGAN. MINATCHI TOLD MOGHADDAM TO GO AHEAD AND CALL BAZARGAN ANYWAY. BY MID-MORNING MOGHADDAM HAD NOT DONE SO, SO BAZARGAN WAS GOING TO CONTACT MOGHADDAM OR GENERAL GHARABAGHI'S STAFF DIRECTLY.

(COMMENT: WE'RE NOT QUITE SURE WHY MOGHADDAM IS PLAYING SPOKE-IN-WHEEL AT THIS POINT, BUT WE HAVE STRONGLY ADVISED BOTH SIDES TO GET TOGETHER, AND IF LMI SHOWS FLEXIBILITY WITH MOGHADDAM THAT THEY ARE CLAIMING WITH US, MEETING SHOULD TAKE PLACE WITHIN NEXT 24 HOURS.) MINATCHI WAS OPTIMISTIC MEETING WOULD OCCUR "SOON," IN GOOD TIME TO ARRANGE THINGS FOR JAN 26.

ON MORE IMPORTANT QUESTION OF KHOMEINI BEHAVIOR UPON HIS RETURN, MINATCHI TOLD US IN STRICTEST CONFIDENCE (MOST MEMBERS OF EITHER CAMP DO NOT KNOW) THAT KHOMEINI HAD WRITTEN SHARIATMADARI ASKING HIS VIEWS ON NAMING THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL. SHARIATMADARI HAD REPLIED IN GOOD AYATOLLAHIC TRADITION THAT SUBJECT SHOULD BE DISCUSSED BY MAJOR AYATOLLAHS IN COUNTRY, AND KHOMEINI HAD AGREED. THEREFORE, PLANNING FOR KHOMEINI RETURN SEES HIM ARRIVING MORNING JAN 26 (MINATCHI PROMISED ETA LATER), PROCEEDING TO BEHESHT-E-ZARA CEMETARY (OUTSIDE TEHRAN CENTER), SPEAKING, THEN RETIRING TO A PREDETERMINED LOCATION TO AWAIT THE HOMAGE OF THE ULEMA. KHOMEINI WOULD REMAIN IN TEHRAN FOR TWO OR THREE DAYS, THEN SOJOURN TO QOM.

MINATCHI WAS CONFIDENT THAT KHOMEINI WOULD NOT OFFER "FINAL SOLUTIONS" TO COUNTRY'S PROBLEMS NOR PROVOKE MILITARY TO REACTION. POLOFF SAID OUR VIEW WAS THAT, IF HE ANNOUNCED RIVAL GOVERNMENT ON ARRIVAL, MILITARY MIGHT MOVE AGAINST HIM. MINATCHI SAID ALL HIS IN-COUNTRY FOLLOWERS UNDERSTOOD THIS AND WERE PRESSING HIM NOT TO PUSH MATTERS TO DISASTER.

DISCUSSIONS OF COMPROMISE BETWEEN KHOMEINI AND GOI NOW DIRECTED TO FINDING SOME MEANS OF COMBINING REGENCY COUNCIL AND KHOMEINI'S ISLAMIC COUNCIL. MINATCHI SAID OPPOSITIONISTS HAD HEARD RUMOR THAT PRIME MINISTER BAKHTIAR WAS GOING TO DECLARE IRAN A REPUBLIC BEFORE KHOMEINI ARRIVED AND ASKED POLOFF IF THAT WERE TRUE. POLOFF OPINED THAT SOUNDED A BIT FAR-FETCHED EVEN IN PRESENT OZ-LIKE STATE OF IRANIAN POLITICS. MINATCHI AGREED AND SAID THAT WOULD BE A DISASTER; MODERATE RELIGIOUS LEADERS, ESPECIALLY SHARIATMADARI, STRONGLY BELIEVED IT WAS NECESSARY TO FOLLOW CONSTITUTIONAL FORMS. IF THIS WERE NOT DONE, MODERATES SAW REAL DANGER OF MILITARY COUP AND CONSEQUENT UNRAVELLING OF ARMED FORCES, OR CIVIL WAR.

THEREFORE, IN-COUNTRY AYATOLLAHS WOULD PRESS KHOMEINI TO MODERATE HIS VIEWS ON ILLEGALITY OF INSTITUTIONS IN INTERESTS OF NATION AND ISLAM. KEY ELEMENT WOULD BE COMPROMISE ON SOME FORM OF REGENCY COUNCIL APPROVAL FOR NEXT "NATIONALIST" GOVERNMENT.

MINATCHI SAID BOTH RELIGIOUS LEADERS AND SECULAR POLITICIANS WERE DEEPLY CONCERNED AT THREATS TO KHOMEINI'S SAFETY SHOULD HE RETURN. MINATCHI HAD HEARD THAT THERE WERE PRO-SHAH SOLDIERS WHO HAD SWORN TO KILL KHOMEINI. LMI AND OTHERS KNEW THERE WERE COMMUNIST GROUPS WITH SAME ASPIRATION. FOR ALL MINATCHI KNEW, THERE MIGHT EVEN BE FOREIGN POWERS WHO WANTED KHOMEINI KILLED. 1979TEHRAN01130.subject: SOME THOUGHTS ON THE FUTURE OF A RELIGIOUS STATE

segments.text: (C ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY: ACCORDING TO ONE RELIGIOUS SCHOLAR ANY FUTURE ISLAMIC GOVT IN IRAN COULD ACHIEVE A FAIRLY EXTENSIVE REDISTRIBUTION OF WEALTH TO HELP THE POOR SIMPLY BY REVERTING TO STRICT APPLICATION OF TRADITIONAL ISLMAMIC LAND AND TAXATION PRACTICES. END SUMMARY

IN A BRIEF MEETING JAN 22, A PROMINENT ISLAMIC AUTHORITY, DR. SAHEBZAMANI, THREW OUT A FEW THOUGHTS FOR POL COUNSELOR ON HOW AN ISLAMIC STATE MIGHT HANDLE THE REDISTRIBUTION OF PROPERTY TO THE POOR. THIS CAME IN THE CONTEXT OF BEING ASKED HOW THINKERS SUCH AS ALI SHARIATI RECONCILED THEIR IDEA THAT ISLAM COULD DO AS MUCH FOR THE POOR AS MARXISM PROMISES WITH THE BASIC ISLAMIC DOCTRINE OF RESPECT FOR PRIVATE PROPERTY. AFTER SOME THOUGHT, SAHEBZAMANI SAID THIS WOULD BE DONE THROUGH THE VAQF LANDS AND TAXATION.

ISLAMIC LAW PERMITS ONE TO WILL ONE-THIRD OF HIS PROPERTY AFTER HIS DEATH, BUT HE CANNOT TOUCH THE OTHER TWO-THIRDS WHOSE DISTRIBUTION IS MINUTELY PROVIDED FOR IN THE LAW. MANY, IF NOT MOST, RELIGIOUS PEOPLE WILL THAT ONE-THIRD TO RELIGIOUS CAUSES, PRINCIPALLY THE VAQF. IN THE PRESENT SITUATION, HE COULD FORESEE A GREAT MANY OTHERS MAKING VOLUNTARY CONTRIBUTIONS OF LAND TO THE VAQF, ONCE THAT INSTITUTION IS RETURNED BY THE GOI TO ITS RIGHTFUL RELIGIOUS CUSTODIANS.

VAQF LANDS WERE RENTED OUT TO PEOPLE AT A VERY LOW ANNUAL RENT, BUT WITHOUT THE RIGHT TO SELL THEM, ONLY TO BUILD ON THEM. HE HIMSELF HAD SOLD A HOUSE HE HAD INHERITED FROM HIS FATHER IN DOWNTOWN TEHRAN 12 YEARS AGO FOR A FRACTION OF ITS REAL VALUE BECAUSE THE LAND IT WAS BUILT ON BELONGED TO THE VAQF. THE SHAH'S "GANG" TOOK OVER THESE LANDS AND PASSED OUT 99- YEAR LEASES TO THEIR FAVORITES. THESE PEOPLE THEN SOLD THEIR RIGHTS AT MUCH HIGHER PRICE, AMASSING FORTUNES IN THE PROCESS. MANUCHEHR AZMOUN WAS A PRIME OFFENDER WHEN HE WAS IN CHARGE OF THE VAQF.

HISTORICALLY, THIS OPERATION WAS ONE OF THE REASONS THAT EUROPEAN FEUDALISM DID NOT DEVELOP IN MOSLEM COUNTRIES. EVERY CHILD GETS HIS SHARE, THE BOY TWICE AS MUCH AS THE GIRL, BECAUSE HE WILL PAY A BRIDE PRICE. THIS REDISTRIBUTED WEALTH WIDELY. IN ADDITION, THERE IS A STANDARD REQUIREMENT TO CONTRIBUTE ONE-FIFTH OF ONE'S INCOME, PLUS A SECOND TAX ("ZAGHAT") WHICH IS APPLIED PROGRESSIVELY ON HIGH-INCOME PEOPLE. ALL ISLAMIC CHILDREN LEARN THIS IN THEIR RELIGIOUS STUDIES, AND IT WILL BE NO MAJOR PROBLEM TO APPLY THESE RULES MORE STRICTLY IN THE CONTEXT OF AN ISLAMIC GOVT ONCE AGAIN.

IN ADDITION, HE FORESAW A GOOD CHANCE THAT MANY BASIC DECISIONS ABOUT STATE POLICY COULD BE TAKEN BY THE "COUNCIL OF FATWA." THE QOM TOP ("MOJTAHED OZMA") AYATOLLAHS IN THE COUNTRY WOULD GET TOGETHER TO MAKE GENERAL DECISIONS, WHICH THE TWO THOUSAND OR SO LESSER AYATOLLAHS ("MOJTAHEDS") BELOW THEM, AND OTHERS FURTHER DOWN, WOULD ELABORATE AND CARRY OUT. AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI HAD CALLED FOR SUCH A "FATWA" COUNCIL YEARS AGO.

WE HAVE BEEN PROMISED MORE SUCH SPECULATIVE THINKING IN THE FUTURE. IT SHOULD BE REMEMBERED, HOWEVER, THAT THIS SOURCE IS NOT PARTICULARLY WELL CONNECTED WITH KHOMEINI AT PRESENT (THOUGH HE SUPPORTS HIM ALL THE WAY) AND DOES NOT KNOW KHOMEINI'S PLANS. WE INVITE COMMENTS (OR CORRECTIONS) FROM ISLAMIC SCHOLARS WHO READ THIS
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)

INFORMATION FROM COUSIN OF GHOTBZADEH HERE GENERALLY CONFIRMS INFORMATION REFTEL. COUSIN IS ALAGHEBAND (FNU), WHOSE SISTER IS SECRETARY IN IRANIAN CONSULAR SECTION IN WASHINGTON. ALAGHEBAND OWNS MID-SIZE FACTORY IN QAZVIN AND IS FORMER ASSISTANT MANAGING DIRECTOR OF IMDBI.

ALAGHEBAND SAYS GHOTBZADEH WAS YOUNGEST OF THREE BROTHERS, ALWAYS KNOWN AS MOST RELIGIOUS OF FAMILY. FURTHER DESCRIBES HIM AS STUDENT RADICAL WHEN HE WAS AT UNIV. OF CALIFORNIA AT BERKELEY, WHERE HE WAS CLOSE FRIEND OF FATEMI (FNU), SON OF A MOSSADEQ MINISTER. ALAGHEBAND SAYS GHOTBZADEH HAD BRIEF FLIRTATION WITH MARXISM BUT SOON RECONVERTED TO RADICAL ISLAM. CLAIMS GHOTBZADEH PRESENTLY HOLDS SYRIAN PASSPORT. SULLIVAN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: TEHRAN AIRPORT CLOSED INDEFINITELY AND APPROACHES SEALED OFF BY TROOPS. LMI LEADER BAZARGAN IN PRESS CONFERENCE SAID BAKHTIAR CANNOT RULE AND PREDICTED HE WILL RESIGN. PM FIRM; CONFRONTATION CONTINUES. BILLS INTRODUCED IN MAJLES TO ABOLISH SAVAK AND CREATE SPECIAL COURTS FOR CORRUPTION TRIALS. SEVERAL MID-SIZE TO SMALL PRO-AND ANTI-GOVERNMENT DEMONSTRATIONS AT MIDDAY NEAR EMBASSY. ELITE BRIGADE OF IMPERIAL GUARD GAVE DEMONSTRATION OF DISCIPLINE AND LOYALTY TO SHAH FOR FOREIGN JOURNALISTS. ETTELE'AT EDITOR COMPLAINS TO EMB PRESS ATTACHE ABOUT KHOMEINI GROUP CENSORSHIP. PM APPEARS TO BE WORKING TO BUILD SUPPORT AMONG BAZAARIS, TRIBAL LEADERS. END OF POSTAL STRIKE ANNOUNCED.

ISFAHAN REPORTS ALL AIRFIELDS CLOSED TO CHARTERS, SOME ANTI-GOVT DEMONSTRATIONS AND RUMORS OF OTHERS BACKING GOVT. GRUMANN READY TO LEAVE. AIRBASE NOW CLOSED TO ALL AMERICANS. TABRIZ REPORTS QUIET. END SUMMARY

BIG NEWS TODAY IS THAT GOVT HAS CLOSED MEHRABAD AIRPORT. INITIAL REPORTS INDICATED IT WAS CLOSED "FOR TODAY," LATER ONES "FOR FORTY-EIGHT HOURS." CIVAIR AUTHORITIES TOLD FAA REP THAT CLOSURE IS FOR INDEFINITE PERIOD "UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE." TROOPS HAVE COMPLETELY SEALED OFF AIRPORT AREA, AND WE UNDERSTAND NO FLIGHTS ARE LEAVING OR ARRIVING. IMMEDIATE REASON FOR CLOSING APPARENTLY WAS PERSIAN-LANGUAGE PRESS ARTICLE REPORTING THAT IRAN AIR STRIKE COMMITTEE HAD INVITED PUBLIC TO AIR PORT FOR 10 A.M. DEPARTURE OF PLANE GOING TO PARIS FOR KHOMEINI AND HAD ANNOUNCED THAT AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI WOULD BE AT AIRPORT TO SEE OFF THE PLANE.

GOI INTENTIONS REGARDING KHOMEINI ARRIVAL -- WHETHER THEY WOULD ALLOW HIM TO LAND, DIRECT HIM TO ANOTHER IRANIAN AIRPORT OR WHAT -REMAIN UNCLEAR. ACCORDING TO PRESS SOURCE, TALEGHANI DID ADDRESS A CROWD OF SEVERAL THOUSAND OUTSIDE IRAN AIR BUILDING THIS MORNING (THIS WAS OUTSIDE THE PERIMETER OF TROOPS WHO HAD SEALED OFF THE AIRPORT). THE SPEECH REPORTEDLY ENDED ABRUPTLY WHEN AN OFFICER WITH ABOUT 400 TROOPS ORDERED THE CROWD TO DISPERSE OR BE FIRED UPON. SOME SHOTS WERE FIRED IN AIR.WE UNDERSTAND PERIMETER HAS SINCE BEEN EXTENDED TO INCLUDE AIRPORT APPROACHES.

REPORTS ON PRESS CONFERENCE BY LMI LEADER MEHDI BAZARGAN WERE LEAD ARTICLES IN ENGLISH-LANGUAGE DAILIES TODAY. BAZARGAN REPORTEDLY EXPRESSED WISH THAT KHOMEINI HAD DELAYED ARRIVAL UNTIL "PROVISIONAL REVOLUTIONARY GOVT" HAD BEEN ESTABLISHED, ASSERTED PM BAKHTIAR CANNOT RULE BECAUSE STRIKES WILL CONTINUE UNTIL HIS GOVT RESIGNS AND PREDICTED BAKHTIAR WILL RESIGN BECAUSE "IN THE 34 YEARS I HAVE KNOWN HIM I HAVE ALWAYS FOUND HIM A REASONABLE, LOGICAL AND PATRIOTIC MAN." (COMMENT: BAKHTIAR OF COURSE CONTINUES TO STAND FIRM. SITUATION REMAINS ONE OF CONFRONTATION. NO DEAL HAS BEEN MADE.)

MAJLES - PRESS REPORTS BILLS HAVE BEEN INTRODUCED TO ABOLISH SAVAK AND TO ESTABLISH SPECIAL COURTS TO TRY THE FORMER POLITICAL FIGURES AND BUSINESSMEN ACCUSED OF CORRUPTION. THE LETTERS OF RESIGNATION OF DEPUTIES WHO HAVE RESIGNED ARE TO BE READIN THE MAJLES TODAY.

ORGANIZERS (WHOEVER THEY WERE) WERE APPARENTLY UNABLE TO CONVINCE THE CROWD TO CHANT "FREEDOM, INDEPENDENCE AND CONSTITUTION" RATHER THAN "JAVID SHAH." SMALL GROUPS OF KHOMEINI SUPPORTERS SCUFFLED WITH GOVT SUPPORTERS AS THEY EMERGED FROM STADIUM. FORMER WERE ARRESTED BY POLICE AND TAKEN AWAY IN PADDY WAGONS. ANOTHER RALLY,VERY SLIGHTLY SMALLER, WAS HELD IN THE STADIUM THIS MORNING. AROUND 11:30 A.M. SEVERAL HUNDRED OF THE ATTENDEES MARCHED SOUTH ON ROOSEVELT CHANTING "JAVID SHAH." AT CORNER OF ROOSEVELT AND TAKHTE-JAMSHID NEAR EMBASSY GATE, THEY ENCOUNTERED A GROUP OF ANTI-GOVT MARCHERS THAT HAD COME DOWN IRANSHAHR (IN FRONT OF THE CONSULATE) AND TURNED EAST ON TAKHTE-JAMSHID.

LATTER WERE CHANTING "FREEDOM AND THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC" AND "DEATH TO THE SHAH." FIGHTS BROKE OUT BETWEEN THE TWO COLUMNS WHICH WERE BROKEN UP BY TROOPS STATIONED AT CORNER OF EMBASSY COMPOUND, WHO FIRED SEVERAL TEAR GAS SHELLS. SINCE THEN SEVERAL GROUPS OF 100-200 HAVE PASSED IN FRONT OF CHANCERY, SOME PRO-GOVT AND SOME ANTI.

BOTH ENGLISH-LANGUAGE DAILIES CARRIED FRONT PAGE ARTICLES WITH PICTURES ON DEMONSTRATION GIVEN BY ELITE "IMMORTALS" BRIGADE OF IMPERIAL GUARD FOR FOREIGN JOURNALISTS. DEMONSTRATION INCLUDED PRECISION MARCHING, AN OBSTACLE COURSE, A RIOT-CONTROL EXERCISE AND SHOWS OF HEAVY WEAPONRY. BRIGADE COMMANDER MAJ. GEN. ALI NESHAT TOLD THE PRESS THAT THESE LOYAL TROOPS CONSIDER THAT SHAH AND QUEEN SIMPLY ON VACATION AND WILL RETURN, AND THAT THEY STAND READY TO "SHED LAST DROP OF BLOOD FOR THEIR MAJESTIES." THROUGHOUT EXERCISE TROOPS LOUDLY CHANTED "JAVID SHAH" EVEN WHILE CLAMBERING OVER OBSTACLES.
EDITOR-IN-CHIEF OF ETTELE'AT TOLD EMB PRESS ATTACHE THAT IT IS "HARD TO PUBLISH A NEWSPAPER THESE DAYS IN THE FACE OF ALL THE THREATS FROM KHOMEINI SUPPORTERS."

WHEN AMBASSADOR SAW PM YESTERDAY HE NOTED THAT OUTER OFFICE WAS FILLED WITH UNACCUSTOMED CLIENTELE INCLUDING PEOPLE WHO APPEARED TO BE BAZAARIS AND TRIBAL LEADERS. APPARENTLY PM IS AGGRESSIVELY ATTEMPTING TO BROADEN HIS BASE OF SUPPORT.

PRESS ANNOUNCED TODAY THAT POSTAL WORKERS HAD AGREED IMMEDIATELY TO END THEIR STRIKE BECAUSE GOVERNMENT AGREED TO THEIR WELFARE DEMANDS. TEHRAN JOURNAL QUOTED POSTAL WORKERS STATEMENT AS SAYING THEIR STRIKE HAD HAD NO POLITICAL MOTIVES. KAYHAN INTERNATIONAL CLAIMED ENDING OF STRIKE FOLLOWED PERMISSION TO DO SO GRANTED BY KHOMEINI'S STRIKE COORDINATION COMMITTEE.

ISFAHAN: CONSUL REPORTS LARGE CROWD BLOCKING SEVERAL STREETS AT MIDDAY TODAY, LISTENING TO SPEECH BY SHEIKHTAHERI, NOTED DEMAGOGIC MULLAH ASSOCIATED WITH KHOMEINI BUT THOUGHT TO BE HIS OWN MAN. THERE ARE NUMEROUS RUMORS IN TOWN OF MAJOR PRO-GOVERNMENT DEMONSTRATIONS TODAY THAT ALLEGEDLY WILL ENJOY MILITARY SUPPORT/PARTICIPATION. REPORTEDLY THERE ARE A NUMBER OF SMALL GROUPS OF PRO-SHAH "CLUB-WIELDERS" ROAMING ABOUT. GRUMMAN HAS VIRTUALLY DECIDED ON FINAL PULLOUT AND IS HOLDING DC-10 IN FRANKFURT TO EVACUATE ITS PEOPLE. COMMANDER OF LOCAL AIRBASE TOLD OUR CONSUL THAT NO RPT NO CHARTERS WILL BE ALLOWED TO LAND AT ANY ISFAHAN AIRPORT, INCLUDINO THE CIVILIAN AIRPORT ("WHICH IS ALSO UNDER MY JURISDICTION") UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE.
COMMANDER ALSO SAID HE WANTS NO AMERICANS ON BASE AT PRESENT, FURTHER TOLD CONSUL THAT HE HAD ORDERED STRIKING HOMAFARS BACK TO WORK AND THEY HAD COMPLIED.

ON MORNING JANUARY 24, MEHDI BAZARGAN SENT WORD THAT HE AND SEYYED BEHESHTI WANTED TO MEET WITH ME THAT SAME EVENING. ACCORDINGLY, I WENT, ALONG WITH EMBOFF STEMPEL, TO THE DESIGNATED RENDEZVOUS AT 1730 JAN 24.

UPON ARRIVAL, WE DISCOVERED BAZARGAN AND A MULLAH NAMED MOUSSAVI, WHO WAS INTRODUCED AS SUBSTITUTE FOR BEHESHTI AND A CLOSE MEMBER OF KHOMEINI ENTOURAGE. SINCE MOUSSAVI SPOKE ONLY FARSI AND ARABIC, THE CONVERSATION WAS CONDUCTED IN FRENCH WITH BAZARGAN, WHO IN TURN TRANSLATED INTO FARSI FOR THE MULLAH. BAZARGAN THUS HAD VERY LITTLE TO SAY ON HIS OWN, BUT RATHER ACTED AS THE VERY DEFERENTIAL INTERMEDIARY FOR THE RELIGIOUS AUTHORITY.

IN TWO HOURS OF RATHER CIRCULAR ARGUMENTATION, WE WENT THROUGH VARIOUS ASPECTS OF THE CURRENT IMPASSE. MOUSSAVI'S PERCEPTIONS WERE THE FAMILIAR KHOMEINI CONTENTIONS ABOUT BAKHTIAR'S ILLEGALITY, THE NEED FOR A "PROVISIONAL ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT," THE DESIRE TO HOLD SOME SORT OF REFERENDUM AND TO REGULARIZE THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC BY A NEW CONSTITUTION.

DESPITE THESE CONTENTIONS, MOUSSAVI DID ADMIT THAT CURRENT CONSTITUTION IS STILL VALID, THAT ARMED FORCES ARE LEGAL, THAT PROCESSIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS DID NOT RPT NOT CONSTITUTE LEGAL BASIS FOR KHOMEINI GOVERNMENT, THAT IT WAS NECESSARY TO AVOID CONFLICT BETWEEN ARMED FORCES AND RELIGIOUS FORCES, THAT THERE WAS DANGER SOVIETS WOULD EXPLOIT "PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT" SCHEME AND THAT KHOMEINI FORCES COULD AGREE IN PRINCIPLE WITH BAKHTIAR'S DESIRE TO HOLD FREE ELECTIONS.

I SUGGESTED THERE WAS ENOUGH COMMON GROUND BETWEEN THEIR OBJECTIVES AND BAKHTIAR'S THAT THE TWO SHOULD SEEK COMPROMISE RATHER THAN CONFRONTATION. I TOLD THEM THAT KHOMEINI'S PLAN TO CONFRONT BAKHTIAR WOULD INEVITABLY MEAN CONFRONTATION WITH MILITARY, WHICH WOULD TEAR THE COUNTRY APART. THEY SEEMED FULLY AWARE OF THIS POINT AND SAID THEY WISHED TO AVOID CONFLICT.

COMMENT: BAZARGAN, OF COURSE, IS WELL KNOWN AS MODERATE, WHO HAS BEEN URGING COMPROMISE ON KHOMEINI. MOUSSAVI IS OBVIOUSLY A MORE FORCEFUL TYPE, WHO APPEARS TO BE FAITHFUL FOLLOWER OF KHOMEINI. HE IS, NEVERTHELESS, NO FANATIC AND SEEMED AMENABLE TO REASON. HE SAID HE AND HIS COLLEAGUES WOULD MEET JANUARY 25 AND CONVEY THEIR VIEWS TO KHOMEINI. SUMMARY: ALL IRAN AIRPORTS ARE OFFICIALLY CLOSED UNTIL JAN 28. LARGE PRO-CONSTITUTION RALLY IN TEHRAN THIS MORNING. GOVT SUBMITS BILLS RFGARDING SAVAK AND SPECIAL COURTS TO TRY EX-MINISTERS. END SUMMARY

AIRPORT FLIPFLOPS - NIRT ANNOUNCED AROUND 10 P.M. LAST NIGHT THAT PRESS REPORTS OF AIRPORT CLOSURE WERE WRONG, THAT AIRPORT HAD BEEN CLOSED FOR ONLY TWO HOURS AND 40 MINUTES "TO PREVENT AN ILLEGAL FLIGHT," BECAUSE OF "BAD WEATHER," AND "TO WARD OFF A POSSIBLE ATTACK BY UNRULY CROWDS ON AIRPORT FACILITIES," AND THAT THE AIRPORT WAS OPEN. MORNING PRESS REPORTED THAT AT 11:30 P.M. THE MILITARY GOVERNATE OF TEHRAN ISSUED ITS COMMUNIQUE NO.

33, STATING: "BECAUSE OF THE STRIKE BY THE FLIGHT CONTROL STAFF OF THE CIVIL AVIATION DEPT ON A NATIONWIDE SCALE OF THE FAILURE OF CERTAIN COMPANIES SUCH AS LUFTHANSA AND AIR FRANCE TO OPERATE FLIGHTS, ALL THE COUNTRY'S AIRPORTS WILL BE DECLARED CLOSED FOR A PERIOD OF THREE DAYS AS FROM MIDNIGHT (LOCAL) WEDNESDAY UNTIL THEY ARE PROPERLY EQUIPPED." CONFLICTING REPORTS THIS MORNING INDICATED ALTERNATELY THAT FLIGHTS WERE FUNCTIONING AND THAT THEY WERE NOT.

CIV AIR AUTHORITIES, DAO CONTACTS WITH HIGH-RANKING IRANIAN MILITARY OFFICERS AND ONE AIRLINE WE HAVE BEEN ABLE TO CONTACT (AIR FRANCE) NOW ALL CONFIRM THAT AIRPORT INDEED CLOSED FOR THREE DAYS AND THAT ONE SWISSAIR FLIGHT AND ONE MAC C-130 WERE ALLOWED TO LAND EARLY THIS MORNING BECAUSE THEY HAD NOT RECEIVED WORD OF THE CLOSING. DAO SAYS PROBLEM WAS THAT FINAL WORD OF CLOSING DID NOT GET OUT QUICKLY ENOUGH, SO THAT EVEN EARLY THIS MORNING OFFICIALS WERE GIVING CONFLICTING INFORMATION. ENGLISH LANGUAGE PRESS REPORTS PM BAKHTIAR SAID YESTERDAY THAT HE KNEW NOTHING ABOUT CLOSING, BUT CLAIMS OTHER SOURCES SAY HE HIMSELF ORDERED IT.

KAYHAN INTERNATIONAL QUOTES BAKHTIAR AS FOLLOWS: "NOBODY ASKED ME FOR ANY AIRPLANE. IF I AM ASKED BY KHOMEINI OR TALEGHANI, I WILL SEND THEM 10 PLANES. I DON'T WANT TO SEND ANY PLANE ON MY OWN. IF IT EXPLODED IN THE AIR, I WOULD GET THE BLAME." KHOMEINI AIDES OF COURSE CONTINUE TO INDICATE HE WILL RETURN TO IRAN ON FRIDAY COME WHAT MAY, WHILE THE BBC REPORTS BAKHTIAR HAS ASKED KHOMEINI IN A LETTER TO DELAY HIS RETURN BY THREE WEEKS. COMMENT: AMIDST ALL THIS CONFUSION, THERE ARE INDICATIONS THAT DEAL ON KHOMEINI ARRIVAL IS IN WORKS. FURTHER REPORT SEPTEL.

TEHRAN AND OTHER CITIES HAD QUIET NIGHT LAST NIGHT AFTER THE PRO-ANTI REGIME CLASHES REPORTED IN YESTERDAY'S SITREP. STREET VIOLENCE IS LIKELY TO RECUR ON LARGER SCALE TODAY AS PRO-CONSTITUTION MARCHERS HEAD FOR RALLY AT BAHARESTAN SQUARE (NEXT TO THE MAJLIS). PRESS REPORTS THAT EMPLOYEES OF THE MILITARY ARE FORCED TO JOIN MARCH. ALTHOUGH AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI HAS INSTRUCTED MUSLIMS TO STAY AWAY FROM THE AREA OF THE MARCH, THERE WILL ALMOST CERTAINLY BE COUNTERDEMONSTRATIONS, WITH THE THREAT OF LARGE-SCALE BRAWLS.

PRIMIN BAKHTIAR APPEARED IN MAJLIS YESTERDAY TO SUBMIT TWO KEY BILLS -- ONE TO DISSOLVE SAVAK AND REPLACE IT WITH A PURELY INFORMATION-GATHERING ORGANIZATION, AND THE OTHER TO ESTABLISH SPECIAL COURTS TO TRY FORMER MINISTERS. UNDER THE FIRST BILL, THE PRIME MINISTER WILL ASSUME DIRECT CONTROL OF SAVAK FOR THE PURPOSE OF DISTRIBUTING ITS HUMAN AND MATERIAL RESOURCES TO OTHER AGENCIES.

IF A GUILTY VERDICT IS REACHED, THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY OF THE SUPREME COURT WILL DETERMINE SENTENCE WITH MINIMUM PENALTY OF 5 YEARS IMPRISONMENT AND MAXIMUM OF DEATH. ACCORDING TO AFP REPORT, FORMER SAVAK HEAD NASSIRI WAS CALLED FOR QUESTIONING JAN 22 BY COURT AUTHORITIES.

WHILE PRESENTING THE TWO BILLS, BAKHTIAR REITERATED HIS DETERMINATION TO DEFEND "THE FORTRESS OF THE CONSTITUTION." HE SAID "WE SHOULD NOT GO TOWARD A PERIOD OF SUFFOCATION FROM A PERIOD OF DICTATORSHIP," BUT COMPLAINED: "I HAVE LIFTED CENSORSHIP FROM THE NEWSPAPERS, AND THEY HAVE EXPLOITED THAT FREEDOM BY CONTINUOUSLY ATTACKING THE NEW GOVT ON UNRELATED GROUNDS." HE POINTED TO THE END OF THE POST STRIKE AS THE FIRST OF A NUMBER OF STRIKE SETTLEMENTS.

HE HOPED EVERYONE WOULD BEGIN TO EXPRESS THEIR VIEWS, "SUPPORTERS AS WELL AS OPPONENTS." (GOVT HAD PREVIOUSLY ESTABLISHED A BUREAU FOR EVALUATION OF NATIONAL VIEWS TO RECEIVE TELEPHONE OPINIONS FROM ALL IRANIANS.) BAKHTIAR STATED: "I HOPE WE CAN DEVELOP TOLERANCE FOR OTHERS."

ELSEWHERE ON THE TOLERANCE FRONT, A MUSLIM GROUP CALLING ITSELF MUJAHEDIN GHAEM ALE MUHAMMAD (STRUGGLERS FOR THE GREAT PROPHET) HELD A RALLY IN FRONT OF ETTELA'AT BUILDING IN TABRIZ, DEMANDED THE SOURCE OF A REPORT THAT KHOMEINI'S ASSOCIATES HAD CALLED SHARIAT-MADARI "A MODERATE ON THE AMERICAN MODEL." THEY ALSO DEMANDED AN APOLOGY. BOTH WERE PROVIDED.
AYATOLLAH SHIRAZI OF MASHAD YESTERDAY DENOUNCED THE BAKHTIAR GOVT AS ILLEGAL.
HEALTH MINISTRY EMPLOYEES HAVE ANNOUNCED REJECTION OF THEIR MINISTER.
GROUP OF HIGH SCHOOL STUDENTS INFORMED PERSIAN JOURNAL THAT THEY INTEND TO OPEN SCHOOLS BEGINNING JAN 28.
