1979TEHRAN01260.subject: POLITICAL/SECURITY SITREP SUPPLEMENT JAN 25 SUMMARY: NEWS FROM PARIS THAT KHOMEINI WILL POSTPONE TRIP TO IRAN HAS CREATED PANDEMONIMUM IN OPPOSITION CIR

segments.text: SUMMARY: NEWS FROM PARIS THAT KHOMEINI WILL POSTPONE TRIP TO IRAN HAS CREATED PANDEMONIMUM IN OPPOSITION CIRCLES. TODAY'S PRO-GOVERNMENT DEMONSTRATIONS IN TEHRAN DREW LARGE CROWDS, BUT WERE OPPOSED WITH LOW LEVEL VIOLENCE IN SEVERAL QUARTERS. DEMONSTRATIONS OCCURED IN OTHER TOWNS, BUT IN TABRIZ THERE HAS BEEN QUITE A BIT OF FIGHTING BETWEEN GROUPS OF PRO-AND ANTI-GOVERNMENT FORCES WHICH HAVE LEFT SOME DEAD. PRIME MINISTER VISITED MOSSADEQ'S GRAVE AND RELEASED SUBSTANCE OF LETTER TO KHOMEINI. END SUMMARY.

NEWS SERVICE TICKER REPORTS THAT KHOMEINI CAMP HAS ANNOUNCED THE AYATOLLAH WILL NOT RETURN TO IRAN UNTIL SUNDAY JAN 28 CAUGHT OPPOSITION BY SURPRISE. PANDEMONIUM REIGNS IN LIBERATION MOVEMENT (LMI) AND OTHER GROUPS. MOST ARE UNAVAILABLE FOR CONTACT, AND PRESS CONFERENCE SCHEDULED FOR 4 P.M. IS UP IN THE AIR. GOI CONFIRMED TO OPPOSITIONISTS AT 3:35 LOCAL TIME THAT ARRIVAL HAS BEEN DELAYED. EMBASSY WILL REPORT FURTHER IF AND WHEN CONFUSION CLEARS.

EYEWITNESS REPORTS OF TEHRAN PRO-GOVERNMENT RALLY INDICATE ABOUT 100,000 TURNED OUT FOR DEMONSTRATION AT MAJLES BUILDING IN SUPPORT OF FULL IMPLEMENTATION OF CONSTITUTION. PRIME MINISTER MADE BRIEF APPEARANCE FROM BALCONY OF HIS OFFICE, BUT DID NOT SPEAK; CROWD CHEERED. AFTERNOON NEWS REPORTS CONFIRM OUR WITNESSES REPORTS THAT GROUPS OF ANTI-GOVERNMENT DEMONSTRATORS ATTACKED PARADE AT SEVERAL POINTS WITH ROCKS. THERE WAS SOME FIRING BY ARMY TO SEPARATE FRACTIOUS FACTIONS, BUT NO RPT NO SERIOUS VIOLENCE IN TEHRAN. CROWD ESTIMATES RANGED FROM 60,000 TO OFFICIAL 300,000. IN TABRIZ, HOWEVER, CONSUL METRINKO REPORTS DEMONSTRATIONS THERE DEGENERATED INTO FIGHTING BETWEEN PRO- AND ANTI-GOVERNMENT FACTIONS IN WHICH WEAPONS WERE USED ON BOTH SIDES.

FIGHTING HAS GONE ON ALL DAY AND SOME HAVE BEEN KILLED. DEMONSTRATIONS IN TABRIZ WERE CITY-WIDE. LOCAL RADIO ALSO REPORTS SIZABLE PROCONSTITUTION DEMONSTRATIONS IN AHWAZ, ZAHEDAN, BIRJAND, KERMANSHAH, AND GORGAN. SHIRAZ CONSULATE SAYS FOR FIRST TIME IN DAYS THERE WERE NO RPT NO DEMONSTRATIONS IN THAT CITY.

PRIME MINISTER BAKHTIAR VISITED EX-PRIME MINISTER MOSSADEQ'S GRAVE AND MADE BRIEF SPEECH SAYING MOSSADEQ'S IDEALS WERE NOW BEING IMPLEMENTED AND PROMISED REBURIAL OF MOSSADEQ'S BODY WHERE HE ORIGINALLY WANTED TO BE BURIED, NEAR REY WITH OTHERS WHO WERE KILLED DURING MOSSADEQ ERA. PRIME MINISTER ALSO RELEASED LETTER HE SENT KHOMEINI JAN 23. MAIN POINTS WERE: 1) PRESENT GOVERNMENT IS MOVING TO FULFILL KHOMEINI PROGRAM; 2) ALTHOUGH ALL IRAN AND MYSELF PERSONALLY WANT TO SEE YOU, YOUR RETURN TO IRAN AT PRESENT TIME MIGHT CREATE OR INTENSIFY INSTABILITY AND HURT COUNTRY

AFTER YOUR ARRIVAL, IF YOU ISSUE A LETTER OR MAKE ANY STATEMENTS AGAINST CONSTITUTION, I CANNOT BE RESPONSIBLE FOR WAHT MIGHT HAPPEN; AND 4) WE URGE YOU TO RETURN AND HELP IMPLEMENT DEMOCRATIC GOVERNMENT WHICH WE ALL SEEK.

BRITISH EMBASSY HAS PICKED UP REPORT FROM WHAT IT CONSIDERS KNOWLEDGEABLE SOURCE THAT LATEST MESSAGE FROM BAKHTIAR TO KHOMEINI SUGGESTED ELECTIONS IN ONE TO THREE MONTHS BE HELD FOR A CONSTITUTENT ASSEMBLY. THAT ASSEMBLY COULD MAKE NECESSARY CHANGES IN THE CONSTITUION. MEANWHILE, BAKHTIAR WOULD RESIGN AND STAY ON AS CARETAKER GOVT TO RUN THOSE ELECTIONS. WE HAVE NO OTHER CONFIRMATION.

EMBOFF PERETT MET JAN 22 WITH DR. ALI KHAJAVI, NATIONAL FRONT SUPPORTOR WHO HAD PREVIOUSLY ORGANIZED MEETING OF OPPOSITIONISTS WITH EMBOFFS (HIS NAME WAS SPELLED INCORRECTLY IN REFTEL.). SEPARATED FROM HIS COLLEAGUES, KHAJAVI EXPRESSED MIXED SATISFACTION AND APPREHENSION AT THE PROSPECT OF KHOMEINI'S RETURN. HE WAS GLAD TO SEAL THE VICTORY OVER THE REGIME, BUT NOW HE WORRIED ABOUT THE DANGER FROM THE LEFT. IN CONTRAST TO THE GENERAL TONE OF THE EARLIER MEETING, WHERE AMERICAN CONCERN ABOUT THE FAR LEFT WAS LARGELY DERIDED, KHAJAVI SAID HE VIEWED KHOMEINI AS THE LAST BARRIER AGAINST A COMMUNIST IRAN. IF KHOMEINI FALLS, THE COMMUNISTS, WHO ARE WELL-PLACED, WILL MOVE IN.
HE THEREFORE FEARED AN ASSASSINATION OR MILITARY TAKEOVER.

EMBOFF SAID USG SHARES SOME OF THESE FEARS, AND THIS WAS WHY WE HOPED OPPOSITION WOULD SUPPORT BAKHTIAR. KHAJAVI SAID BAKHTIAR HAS SHOWN SPUNK, BUT HE CANNOT GAIN PUBLIC SUPPORT AFTER ALLOWING THE ILLEGAL MAJLIS TO CONFIRM HIM. KHAJAVI THEREFORE FELT BAKHTIAR SHOULD STAND ASIDE. HE HOPED FOR EARLY FREE ELECTIONS, INAUGURATING A SOCIAL DEMOCRACY ON THE ORDER OF SWEDEN OR FINLAND. HE WORRIES TOO ABOUT EXCESSIVE RELIGIOUS INFLUENCE, SAYING HE AND HIS FRIENDS RESPECT ISLAM BUT DO NOT WANT IT TO RUN THEIR LIVES.

KHAJAVI DESCRIBED THE PURPOSE OF THE NEW POLITICAL GROUP OF HIS FRIEND HAJ SEYED JAVADI, "THE POLITICAL MOVEMENT," AS A SECULAR BATTLE AGAINST COMMUNISM. HE SAID ONE CANNOT USE RELIGION TO COMBAT COMMUNIST IDEAS IF THE LISTENERS ARE NOT RELIGIOUS. THE GROUP WHICH SHOULD BE VIEWED AS A MOVEMENT WITHIN THE NATIONAL FRONT RATHER THAN A NEW POLITICAL PARTY, WILL ARGUE THAT THE SOCIAL BENEFITS OF COMMUNISM ARE OBTAINABLE WITHOUT THE TYRANNY WHICH EXISTS UNDER COMMUNIST RULE.

COMMENT: KHAJAVI, A SENSITIVE, INTELLIGENT MAN, IS WORRIED AND CONFUSED. HE AND MANY, PERHAPS EVEN MOST, NATIONAL FRONTERS INCREASINGLY SENSE THE POWER OF THE RELIGIOUS AND LEFTIST GROUPS AND THEIR OWN WEAKNESS. HE HOPES KHOMEINI CAN KEEP OUT THE LEFTISTS, BUT HE PLAINLY DISLIKES THE IDEA OF AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC; HE WANTS A LIBERAL, PARLIAMENTARY DEMOCRACY. HIS GROUP HAS ALWAYS REPRESENTED A SMALL MINORITY WITHIN THE NATIONAL MOVEMENT, AND NOW, FOR THE FIRST TIME, HE AND HIS COLLEAGUES ARE BEGINNING TO REALIZE THAT. SULLIVAN
REGRET THERE IS NOT RPT NOT SUFFICIENT TIME TO APPLY FOR REF A CLEARANCE REQUESTS, AND FLIGHTS AS REQUESTED CANNOT BE GRANTED CLEARANCES.

PLEASE SEE REF A, ESPECIALLY PARA FOUR. REF A REQUESTS WERE SENT BY DEPT ON 26 JAN, A FRIDAY, WHEN ALL GOI OFFICES ARE CLOSED. AS DEPT AWARE, 27 JAN IS RELIGIOUS AND GOI HOLIDAY WITH GOI OFFICES AGAIN BEING CLOSED. THEREFORE, EARLIEST POSSIBLE DATE EMBASSY CAN SUBMIT REQUESTS FOR CLEARANCE IS SUNDAY, 28 JAN. THAT DATE, OF COURSE, WILL NOT BE SUFFICIENT TO MEET 72 HOUR REQUIREMENT.

THEREFORE, PLEASE RESUBMIT NEW REQUESTS FOR CLEARANCES, KEEPING IN MIND REF B LIMITATIONS -- EMBASSY CAN APPLY FOR CLEARANCES ONLY DURING IIAF NORMAL OFFICE HOURS, 07001445 SATURDAYS THROUGH WEDNESDAYS, LESS REPEAT LESS HOLIDAYS.
SUGGEST DEPT ENOURAGE THOSE ASKING FOR CHARTER CLEARANCES TO GIVE EMBASSY FOUR DAYS: THIS WILL INCLUDE THE DAY REQUIRED TO OBTAIN CLEARANCES AND 72 HOURS FROM TIME CLEARANCES GRANTED.
LOCAL PANAM REP AND GRUMMAN REP HAVE BEEN ADVISED REF A FLIGHTS CANNOT MEET REF B REQUIRMENTS, AND TO EXPECT RESUBMISSION OF NEWLCLEARANCE REQUESTS.

REQUEST DEPT BRING THIS EMBTEL,REF B AND OTHER RELEVANT EMBTELS SAME SUBJECT TO ATTENTION ALL PERSONNEL WHO INVOLVED CIVAIR MATTERS, AND TO ALL AIRLINES WHO LIKELY SEND CHARTERS TO IRAN. SULLIVAN *** Current Handling Restrictions *** n/a *** Current Classification *** LIMITED OFFICIAL USE

IN AN EFFORT TO UNDERSTAND THE DECISIONS WHICH GOI HAS TAKEN WITH RESPECT TO CLOSURE OF AIRPORTS, WE HAVE ATTEMPTED TO RECONSTRUCT EVENTS OF PAST FEW DAYS. OUR INFORMATION ON INTENTIONS WITH RESPECT STATUS OF AIRPORTS ON SUNDAY, JANUARY 28, IS STILL INCOMPLETE, BUT WE HOPE TO HAVE SOME CLARIFICATION LATER TODAY.

SENIOR WASHINGTON OFFICIALS ARE INFORMED OF PLANS FOR KHOMEINI'S RETURN WHICH PRIME MINISTER DISCUSSED WITH ME EARLIER THIS WEEK. THOSE PLANS APPARENTLY WERE STILL VALID UNTIL JANUARY 24. ON THAT DATE, THE COMMANDER OF THE AIR FORCE BASE ON SOUTH SIDE OF MEHRABAD AIRPORT WAS INSTRUCTED TO TAKE NECESSARY ACTION TO PREVENT DEPARTURE OF IRAN AIR 747 WHICH WAS REPORTEDLY GOING TO PARIS TO PICK UP KHOMEINI. HIS METHOD OF COMPLYING WITH THAT INSTRUCTION WAS TO CLOSE THE AIRPORT, AND PLACE VEHICLES ON RUNWAYS AND TAXI-WAYS.

WHEN SENIOR MILITARY OFFICERS LEARNED OF THAT ACTION, THEY FELT BASE COMMANDER HAD OVER-REACTED AND ORDERED THE AIRPORT OPENED AGAIN. A FEW FLIGHTS DID TAKE PLACE, BUT NO RPT NO INTERNATIONAL FLIGHTS. AT SUNSET, JANUARY 24, THE GENERAL ASSUMPTION WAS THAT AIRPORTS WOULD BE OPEN JANUARY 25. IT WAS ALSO ASSUMED THAT KHOMEINI WOULD FLY TO TEHRAN BY AIR FRANCE CHARTER, ARRIVING MORNING JANUARY 26.

EVENING JANUARY 24, IRANIAN AIR FORCE BEGAN RECEIVING NOTICE OF FLIGHT PLANS BEING FILED FOR SEVERAL IRAN AIR PLANES WHICH HAD BEEN STRANDED IN EUROPE BECAUSE OF STRIKE. THEY ALSO BEGAN TO GET RUMORS FROM ATHENS THAT KHOMEINI WOULD GO THERE AND MAKE HIS FINAL APPROACH FROM THAT DIRECTION. A MEETING OF THE NATIONAL SECURITY COUNCIL WAS SUMMONED EVENING JANUARY 24 PRESIDED OVER BY THE PRIME MINISTER.

BECAUSE THE COUNCIL FELT THERE WERE SEVERAL DECEPTION PLANS AFOOT AND THAT KHOMEINI WOULD PROBABLY NOT ARRIVE ON THE AIR FRANCE CHARTER, THEY DECIDED TO EMPLOY THE "OVER-REACTION" DEVICE OF THE MEHRABAD BASE COMMANDER AND CLOSE ALL RPT ALL AIRFIELDS ON JANUARY 25, 26, AND 27. AN ANNOUNCEMENT TO THIS EFFECT WAS MADE AT 2230 JANUARY 24.

ON JANUARY 25, THE MEHRABAD AIRPORT WAS EFFECTIVELY CLOSED. HOWEVER, AIR FORCE TOWER OPERATORS PERMITTED CERTAIN PLANES TO LAND ON GROUNDS THEY HAD ENTERED IRAN AIR SPACE PRIOR TO LEARNING OF CLOSURE. SWISSAIR AND ONE USAF C-130 ENTERED UNDER THESE RULES. THEREAFTER, THE AIRPORT REMAINED CLOSED FOR THE REST OF THE DAY. ON JANUARY 26, WHEN KHOMEINI HAD ORIGINALLY INTENDED TO LAND, THE AIRPORT WAS COMPLETELY SHUT DOWN EXCEPT FOR MILITARY OPERATIONS.

IT IS NOT KNOWN EXACTLY WHAT INGREDIENTS WENT INTO THE JANUARY 24 DECISION TO ANNOUNCE THE AIRPORT CLOSURES. HOWEVER, IT IS INTERESTING TO NOTE THAT, ONCE THE ANNOUNCEMENT WAS MADE, AIR FRANCE SUBSEQUENTLY ANNOUNCED FROM PARIS THAT IT WOULD NOT BE ABLE TO FLY ITS CHARTER FOR KHOMEINI. THIS STATEMENT SEEMS TO HAVE FORCED THE HAND OF KHOMEINI TO ANNOUNCE HIS CHANGE IN PLANS. WHEN WE ASKED FRENCH EMBASSY HERE IF AIR FRANCE OR FRENCH GOVERNMENT HAD PLAYED ROLE IN GOI DECISION, EMBASSY PLEADED IGNORANCE. HOWEVER, POLICY ATTITUDES ATTRIBUTED TO SENIOR FRENCH GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS SINCE THAT ACTION MAKE US WONDER.

ON JANUARY 26, SENIOR MILITARY STAFF DISCUSSED AT LENGTH ACTIONS THEY WOULD RECOMMEND WITH RESPECT TO STATUS OF AIRPORT ON SUNDAY, JANUARY 28, WHEN KHOMEINI AND AIR FRANCE ARE RESCHEDULED TO ARRIVE. AT THE END OF THE DAY, THEY HAD NO RPT NO FIRM RECOMMENDATION, BUT A SERIES OF OPTIONS TO OFFER THE PRIME MINISTER. THERE WAS ANOTHER NSC MEETING EVENING JANUARY 26 IN WHICH DECISION WAS TO HAVE BEEN TAKEN. AS OF MORNING JANUARY 27, DECISION APPARENTLY NOT RPT NOT TAKEN, AND NEW NSC MEETING CURRENTLY IN PROGRESS. WE HOPE TO HAVE NEWS LATER IN THE DAY.

IN THE MEANTIME, WE HAVE NO RPT NO INDICATIONS THAT DISCUSSIONS BETWEEN THE MILITARY AND THE LOCAL KHOMEINI REPRESENTATIVES ARE PROCEEDING. BAZARGAN TOLD ME HE HAS BEEN UNSUCCESSFUL IN GETTING TO GHARABAGHI, WHO, IN TURN, TOLD HUYSER THAT HE WAS STALLING UNDER INSTRUCTIONS FROM ------------------092054 271055Z /10 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 3413 INFO AMEMBASSY PARIS IMMEDIATE SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 01322 EXDIS (DISTRIBUTE AS NODIS) BAKHTIAR. WHETHER BAKHTIAR HAS ANYTHING GOING ALONG THESE LINES IS DOUBTFUL, ALTHOUGH HE IS IN TOUCH WITH BAZARGAN AND OTHERS HERE.

IN PARIS, HOWEVER, ALL HIS EMISSARIES SEEM TO HAVE BEEN REBUFFED BY THE AYATOLLAH PERSONALLY, UNLESS TEHRANI HAS MANAGED TO MAKE ANY HEADWAY. THEREFORE, ON THE POLITICAL SIDE, WE MUST ASSUME THAT THE IMPASSE CONTINUES.

IN THE STREETS OF TEHRAN, THE SAME THING IS TRUE. HUNDREDS OF THOUSANDS ARE MARCHING AT THIS TIME. THE OVERWHELMING RANKS ARE PRO-KHOMEINI, BUT SURPRISINGLY, A FEW PRO-BAKHTIAR GROUPS ARE ALSO EVIDENT. MARSHALLS ARE CONTROLLING BOTH GROUPS AND THE TROOPS ARE REMAINING ALOOF. WE WILL SEE IN THE NEXT TWO OR THREE HOURS WHETHER THIS SEMBLANCE OF ORDER WILL BREAK DOWN INTO
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: VERY LARGE DEMONSTRATION MOVING TO SHAHYAD SQUARE IN TEHRAN, APPARENTLY PEACEFUL SO FAR. REPORTS OF NEW ARRESTS OF JOURNALISTS, OF SUBSTANTIAL NUMBER OF RELIGIOUS LEADERS AND OF SOME POLITICAL LEADERS. REPORT OF RUMORS AMONG RELIGIOUS LEADERS THAT THERE HAS BEEN COUP IN FACT IF NOT IN NAME. EL AL TO FLY IN SUNDAY TO TAKE OUT ISRAELI/IRANIAN JEWS. LARGE DEMONSTRATION SO FAR PEACEFUL IN ISFAHAN. SHIRAZ QUIET WITH GATHERINGS AT SEVERAL MOSQUES BUT NO PARADES. TABRIZ REPORTS TROOPS EVERYWHERE WITH APPARENTLY SOME FIGHTING BETWEEN TROOPS AND SMALL GROUPS, BUT NO GUNFIRE WITHIN EARSHOT. END SUMMARY.

TEHRAN POLICE REPORTS CROWD OF 800,000 TO ONE MILLION GATHERED IN OR APPROACHING SHAHYAD SQUARE TODAY, WITH NO NOTEWORTHY VIOLENCE THUS FAR. AMCIT WHO LIVES NEARBY REPORTS COLUMN OF ABOUT 20,000 MARCHERS MOVED DOWN OLD SHEMIRAN ROAD FROM BLUE MOSQUE. ANOTHER WHO LIVES NEAR EISENHOUR REPORTED WATCHING FOR TWO HOURS AS WALL-TO-WALL CROWD MOVED ALONG THAT AVENUE. SLOGANS REPORTED BY SEVERAL SOURCES INCLUDE: "IF KHOMEINI COMES LATE, DEATH TO BAKHTIAR"; "THE ARMY BELONGS TO US, NOT TO AMERICA"; AND "TO PROTECT THE KORAN, THE ARMY MUST FOLLOW US". SMALL RETURNING GROUPS OF DEMONSTRATORS NOW PASSING IN FRONT OF CHANCERY SHOUTING SLOGANS, INCLUDING "YANKEE GO HOME".

AMERICAN JOURNALISTS REPORT CROWDS NOT HOSTILE, EVEN FRIENDLY TO THEM. FURTHER REPORTS ABOUT CLASH YESTERDAY INDICATE TROOPS ENTERED UNIVERSITY LATE IN AFTERNOON, FIRED ON DEMONSTRATORS, WITH 10-15 DEAD. LOCAL RADIO REPORTED THIS MORNING THAT YESTERDAY AT SOME POINT ALONG SHAHREZA, GROUP IN ARMY UNIFORMS CARRYING AK-47'S ATTACKED TROOPS, KILLING SEVERAL SOLDIERS. SOLDIERS THEN ALLEGEDLY FIRED INTO CROWD TRYING TO GET ATTACKERS. (WE ARE SKEPTICAL.)

WE HAVE HAD SEVERAL REPORTS OF NEW ARRESTS OF JOURNALISTS, RANGING TO NEARLY 20 IN ALL. ALSO HAVE REPORTS THAT AS MANY AS 200 RELIGIOUS LEADERS, AND SOME POLITICAL LEADERS, HAVE BEEN ARRESTED. ONE SOURCE CLOSE TO RELIGIOUS LEADERS TELLS US RUMOR NOW RIFE AMONG THEM THAT "THERE HAS BEEN MILITARY COUP IN FACT IF NOT IN NAME".

EL AL MANAGER TOLD LONG-TIME AMERICAN RESIDENT THAT "THE JEWS ARE FINISHED IN THIS COUNTRY" AND SAID THAT EL AL IS BRINGING IN AIRCRAFT TOMORROW TO TAKE OUT ISRAELIS AND IRANIAN JEWS. HE FURTHER REPORTED THAT EL AL ISRAELI PERSONNEL (ABOUT 12) HAD MOVED TO HILTON A FEW DAYS AGO AFTER RECEIVING THREATS. ON THURSDAY MANAGER OF HILTON INFORMED THEM THEY WERE NO LONGER WELCOME AND GAVE THEM ONE HOUR TO MOVE OUT.

ISFAHAN REPORTS LARGE CROWDSTILL GATHERING, MARCHING PEACEFULLY AS OF NOON LOCAL TIME. ARMISH-MAAG HAS ORDERED ALL TAFT PERSONNEL OUT OF ISFAHAN TO NEARBY DEVELOPMENT SHAHINSHAHR AND IRANIAN AIRBASE COMMANDER HAS TOLD BHI PERSONNEL TO STAY OFF BASE FOR NEXT FEW DAYS.

SHIRAZ REPORTS GATHERINGS AT SEVERAL MOSQUES, BUT ------------------092974 271308Z /44 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 3416 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY BONN AMEMBASSY CAIRO AMCONSUL DHAHRAN IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY DOHA AMCONSUL FRANKFURT AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS USLO PEKING AMEMBASSY RABAT USLO RIYADH IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY TOKYO USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 01327 EXPECTED PARADES DID NOT MATERIALIZE. CONSUL HAS HEARD NO GUNFIRE TODAY.

TABRIZ REPORTS MUCH GUNFIRE FROM ABOUT LUNCHTIME UNTIL EARLY EVENING YESTERDAY. CONSUL SAID TROOPS IN TABRIZ YESTERDAY WERE GIVEN "RIGHT TO FIRE" INTO CROWDS, AND HE WAS GIVEN TO UNDERSTAND THIS ORDER MIGHT HAVE BEEN COUNTRYWIDE. NEW DEVELOPMENT YESTERDAY WAS THAT CROWDS FOUGHT BACK, THROWING MOLOTOV COCKTAILS. SOME IN CROWDS REPORTEDLY HAD GUNS. CONSUL ESTIMATES ABOUT 20 KILLED. RADIO REPORTED SOME 600 ARRESTED YESTERDAY. CONSUL HAS HEARD NO RPT NO FIRING TODAY BUT HAS RECEIVED REPORTS THAT TROOPS -- WHO ARE ALL OVER CITY -- HAVE BEEN FIGHTING WITH SCATTERED SMALL BANDS. ALSO REPORTS THAT NUMEROUS IRANIANS, "FROM WORKERS TO A MILLIONAIRE", HAVE EXPRESSED PLEASURE AT MILITARY CRACKDOWN.
STRONGLY ANTI-CLERICAL SLOGANS AND POEMS HAVE BEGUN CIRCULATING WIDELY, THOUGH REGARD FOR SHARIATMADARI IS UNDIMINISHED.

WE HAVE LEARNED, FROM BOTH MILIAARY AND KHOMEINI SOURCES, THAT BAKHTIAR HAS BEEN MEETING INTENSIVELY OVER PAST TWO DAYS WITH KHOMEINI LIEUTENANT SEYYED BEHESHTI. THIS CHANNEL HAS SUPERSEDED THE MEETING WHICH BAZARGAN HAD ATTEMPTED TO OPEN WITH GENERAL GHARABAGHI.

TONIGHT ONE OF OUR KHOMEINI SOURCES HAS JUST TOLD US THAT AN ARRANGEMENT HAS BEEN WORKED OUT UNDER WHICH KHOMEINI WILL DEFER HIS PLAN TO RETURN TO IRAN AND BAKHTIAR WILL, INSTEAD, FLY TO PARIS TOMORROW, JANUARY 28, TO MEET WITH KHOMEINI.

IF THIS IS TRUE, I PRESUME MY DEAL HAS BEEN STRUCK WHICH WOULD PROVIDE FOR A MUTUALLY SATISFACTORY WAY IN WHICH TO HOLD ELECTIONS OR A REFERENDUM ON THE FUTURE FORM OF GOVERNMENT HERE. BAKHTIAR'S PREFERRED FORMULA IS THAT HE HOLD GENERAL ELECTIONS FOR A PARLIAMENT, WHICH WOULD THEN RESOLVE ITSELF INTO A CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY AND REVIEW THE CONSTITUTION. IT IS PRESUMED HE WOULD GET SOME SORT OF KHOMEINI SANCTION FOR HIS ROLE AS ORGANIZER OF THE ELECTIONS, ROPSHER AS CARETAKER PRIME MINISTER, OR AS A "LEGALIZED" INTERIM PRIME MINISTER, BY VIRTUE OF HIS PILGRIMAGE TO PARIS.

WE HAVE NO WAY TO CHECK THIS STORY WITH BAKHTIAR AND THE MILITARY AT THIS HOUR, BECAUSE OF CURFEW-HOWEVER, IT HAS ENOUGH INGREDIENTS OF PROBABILITY THAT I REPORT IT WITH SOME CAUTIOUS PROSPECT THAT IT MAY BE TRUE. IT COMES VERY CLOSE TO THE SORT OF COMPROMISE WHICH I DISCUSSED THE OTHER EVENING WITH BAZARGAN AND MOUSSAIR.

IF THIS STORY IS TRUE AND IF A DEAL HAS BEEN STRUCK, THE PRIMARY MOTIVATION FOR IT COULD BE THE MUTUALLY SHARED SUSPICION BY BAKHTIAR AND KHOMEINI THAT A CONFRONTATION WON BY THE MILITARY WOULD PAVE THE WAY FOR THE RETURN OF THE SHAH TO IRAN. BOTH BAKHTIAR AND KHOMEINI FEAR THIS OUTCOME MORE THAN ANY OTHER POSSIBLE VICTORY BY THE COMMUNISTS.

I AM NOT RPT NOT CERTAIN THE MILITARY WILL REACT TO SUCH A DEAL IF IT IS CONSUMATED-HOWEVER, AS THEY HAVE BEEN FORCED OVER THE PAST FEW DAYS TO CONFRONT THE OPTIONS AVAILABLE TO THEM, THEY HAVE BEGUN INCREASINGLY TO ACCEPT THE IDEA OF A COMPROMISE WHICH WOULD EXCLUDE THE SHAH. THERE MAY BE A FEW DIEHARD TROOP COMMANDERS, PARTICULARLY IN THE IMPERIAL GUARD, WHO WILL REVOLT AGAINST THE CONCEPT, BUT THE SENIOR GENERALS ARE PROBABLY PREPARED TO GO ALONG. WE WILL KNOW MORE ABOUT THEIR VIEWS WHEN GENERAL HUYSER CONSULTS WITH THEM TOMORROW.

REF B, WHICH WAS SENT FLASH PRECEDENCE, BUT IS STILL BEING SERVICED BY DEPT COMMUNICATIONS FIVE HOURS AFTER IT WAS SENT, REPORTED PROSPECT THAT BAKHTIAR WOULD GO TO PARIS LATER TODAY TO MEET WITH KHOMEINI.

IF THIS REPORT PROVES TRUE, I BELIEVE WE SHOULD REFRAIN FROM ATTEMPTING TO CONVEY ANY MESSAGE TO KHOMEINI AT THIS TIME. IF IT PROVES UNTRUE, I WILL ATTEMPT EARLY APPOINTMENT WITH BAKHTIAR TO DISCUSS REF A WITH HIM.
IF WE ARE TO SEND SUBSTANCE OF REF A, I BELIEVE WE WILL HAVE TO REWORK SECOND SENTENCE OF PARAGRAPH 7. MY COMMENTS ON THIS WILL HAVE TO AWAIT NEWS ABOUT BAKHTIAR.
(S - ENTIRE TEXT).

NOW THAT BAKHTIAR HAS PUBLICLY CONFIRMED THAT HE WILL GO TO PARIS AND KHOMEINI HAS CONFIRMED THAT HE WILL MEET WITH HIM, WE SHOULD SUSPEND OUR DIALOGUE WITH THE KHOMEINI CAMP AND LEAVE THE NEGOTIATING EFFORTS EXCLUSIVELY TO THE IRANIANS. SIMILARLY, I SHOULD NOT RPT NOT BE INSTRUCTED TO CONVEY ANY U.S. VIEWS TO BAKHTIAR AT THIS TIME. WE DO NOT RPT NOT KNOW THE GROUND RULES WHICH WILL GUIDE THE BAKHTIAR-KHOMEINI ENCOUNTER, BUT SHOULD DO ABSOLUTELY NOTHING TO INTERFERE WITH THEM. THEREFORE, ACTION HELD IN SUSPENSION BY REFTEL SHOULD REMAIN THAT WAY INDEFINITELY.
OUR PUBLIC STANCE SHOULD ALSO REFLECT OUR OFFICIAL POSTURE. THE STATEMENT MADE BY PRESIDENT CARTER AT HIS PRESS CONFERENCE WAS A PARADIGM WHICH SHOULD BE FOLLOWED BY ALL OTHER GOVERNMENT SPOKESMEN.

WE MUST, HOWEVER, HAVE TWO OTHER CONCERNS WHICH WILL NEED OUR CONSTANT ATTENTION. THE FIRST IS THE ATTITUDE OF THE ARMED FORCES. WE DO NOT YET KNOW HOW THOROUGHLY THEIR LEADERSHIP HAS ASSOCIATED ITSELF WITH THIS BAKHTIAR INITIATIVE OR HOW MUCH DETAIL THEY KNOW ABOUT HIS INTENTIONS. HE HAS TAKEN GREAT PAINS TO ESTABLISH THEIR CONFIDENCE IN HIM AND MET WITH THEM IN THREE INTENSIVE SESSIONS OF THE NATIONAL SECURITY COUNCIL PRIOR TO MAKING HIS DRAMATIC ANNOUNCEMENT. THE MILITARY LEADERSHIP HAS BEEN AWARE OF HIS DISCUSSIONS WITH BEHESHTI, BUT WE DO NOT KNOW HOW MUCH HE HAS SHARED THEIR CONTENT.

ACCORDINGLY, I HAVE ASKED GENERAL HUYSER TO SPEND THE DAY IN CLOSEST CONTACT WITH GENERAL GHARABAGHI AND THE SERVICE CHIEFS IN ORDER TO EXPLORE THEIR REACTIONS TO THIS DEVELOPMENT AND IN ORDER TO ASSESS THE MANNER IN WHICH THEY ARE HANDLING IT WITH THE MORE LOYALIST OF THE ROYALIST TROOPS. HE WILL REPORT TO ME AS REGULARLY AS HE CAN DURING THE DAY ON AN OPEN TELEPHONE CIRCUIT.

THE OTHER AREA OF CONCERN IS THE SHAH. HE MAY VIEW THIS BAKHTIAR-KHOMEINI MEETING AS A LONG STEP TOWARDS THE ABOLITION OF THE PAHLAVI DYNASTY. IF BAKHTIAR REMAINS OUT OF THE COUNTRY FOR THREE DAYS, THERE WILL BE NO RPT NO POLITICAL LEADER WHO CAN GIVE GUIDANCE AND MODERATION TO THE MILITARY LEADERSHIP. THE FOREIGN MINISTER, WHOM THE MILITARY DISTRUST, WILL PRESUMABLY BE NOMINALLY IN CHARGE. INTO THIS SITUATION, THE SHAH MIGHT BE TEMPTED TO SEND INSTRUCTIONS OR ENCOURAGEMENT FOR INDEPENDENT MILITARY ACTION THROUGH SOME FAITHFUL OFFICER SUCH AS GENERAL BADERI. THIS COULD PRODUCE DISASTROUS TURMOIL.

IT IS, OF COURSE, ENCOURAGING THAT KHOMEINI SEEMS TO BE SHOWING, AT LONG LAST, SOME OF THE FLEXIBILITY WHICH HIS FOLLOWERS INSIDE IRAN HAVE BEEN URGING ON HIM. IT IS UNCLEAR WHETHER THAT FLEXIBILITY WILL ENDURE THE INSISTENCE OF HIS PARIS ENTOURAGE THAT HE SHOULD GO IMMEDIATELY FOR THE JUGULAR. SINCE WE KNOW NOTHING DIRECTLY ABOUT KHOMEINI'S PERSONAL VIEWS, IT IS IMPOSSIBLE TO JUDGE WHETHER BAKHTIAR WILL BE ABLE TO PERSUADE HIM TO ACCEPT A CONSTITUTIONALLY VALID PROCEDURE FOR DETERMINING THE POLITICAL FUTURE OF IRAN IN A MANNER WHICH WILL BE ACCEPTABLE TO THE ARMED FORCES.
HOWEVER, IT IS CERTAIN THAT THE FUTURE OF IRAN AND OF OUR INTERESTS HERE LIE IN THE HANDS OF BAKHTIAR, AND THAT HE IS A MAN WHO DESERVES OUR CONTINUING CONFIDENCE.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

ACCORDING TO LOCAL PRESS SOURCES, PRIME MINISTER BAKHTIAR HAS SCHEDULED PRESS CONFERENCE FOR MORNING JANUARY 29. THIS HAS GIVEN RISE TO MUCH SPECULATION CONCERNING ANNOUNCEMENTS HE WILL MAKE AT THAT TIME. THEY RANGE FROM RUMORS OF HIS RESIGNATION TO CANCELLATION OF HIS PARIS TRIP.

IN ANY EVENT, ASSUMING THE TIMING OF THE PRESS CONFERENCE IS CORRECTLY REPORTED, IT SEEMS CLEAR BAKHTIAR WILL NOT RPT NOT ARRIVE IN PARIS JANUARY 28 AS WE HAD EARLIER BEEN LED TO BELIEVE POSSIBLE. SULLIVAN

IN SEPARATE CONVERSATIONS WITH FOUR RESPONSIBLE IRANIANS JANUARY 24, PAO WAS URGED TO CONVEY MESSAGE TO HIGHEST USG LEVELS THAT IN ANY BAKHTIAR/KHOMEINI CONFRONTATION THE FORMER COULD NOT PREVAIL AND IF THE MILITARY INTERVENED, THE BLOODSHED WOULD BE INDISCRIMINATE, WIDESPREAD, BUT ESPECIALLY DIRECTED AT AMERICANS. THOSE SHARING THIS ASSESSMENT INCLUDED THE SENIOR PUBLIC AFFAIRS ADVISOR FOR ICA, AN ECONOMIC CONSULTANT WHO ONCE SERVED ON THE SHAH'S INSPECTORATE, AN ACADEMIC INTELLECTUAL, AND A UNIVERSITY VICE CHANCELLOR. THEY WENT ON TO SAY, IN EFFECT, THAT SECURITY WOULD BE NEGLIGIBLE ONCE THE MILITARY BEGINS TO SPLINTER AS IT MOST CERTAINLY WOULD.

ALL FOUR SAW THE ONLY ROUTE TO STABILITY WAS THROUGH SOME ACCOMMODATION BY BAKHTIAR SANCTIONED BY THE MILITARY (HOWEVER GRUDGINGLY) WITH THE KHOMEINI GROUP. THE ACCOMMODATION IS ESSENTIAL IF ONLY TO BUY SUFFICIENT TIME TO ENGENDER REALISM ON THE PART OF THE AYATOLLAH CIRCLE AS TO THE NEED FOR THE COUNTRY TO GET BACK TO WORK. THEY CITED BAZARGAN'S HINT THAT BAKHTIAR MIGHT PARTICIPATE IN A PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT TO PAVE THE WAY FOR A REFERENDUM ON THE QUESTION OF A REPUBLIC OR ISLAMIC STATE.

THE RAMSEY CLARK STATEMENT CALLING ON THE USG TO DROP ITS SUPPORT FOR THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT (WIDELY CARRIED IN THE PRESS) CORRECTLY OR NOT IS BEING INTERPRETED AS EVIDENT OR EVENTUAL U.S. POLICY. ALL FOUR THOUGHT IT SALUTARY FOR THE SAFETY OF AMERICANS IN IRAN WHICH THEY FEEL WOULD BE IN GRAVE JEOPARDY SHOULD BAKHTIAR AND THE MILITARY FIND IT NECESSARY TO REACT WITH FORCE AGAINST KHOMEINI ADHERENTS.
THE SHAH'S DECISION TO DELAY INDEFINITELY HIS U.S. VISIT WAS ALSO CITED AS A PLUS IN TIMES WHERE THE MINUSES

1979TEHRAN01379.subject: POLITICAL POT BOILING VIGOROUSLY, THREAT OF VIOLENCE GROWS

segments.text: VIOLENCE GROWS (C-ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY: BAKHTIAR'S ANNOUNCEMENT THAT HE WILL GO TO PARIS HAS TRIGGERED FRANTIC MEETINGS AND NEGOTIATIONS IN TEHRAN AND BETWEEN TEHRAN AND PARIS. MODERATE RELIGIOUS LEADERS REPORTEDLY WANT HIM TO NEGOTIATE KHOMEINI RETURN AS QUICKLY AS POSSIBLE FOR FEAR OF VIOLENCE, WHILE LIBERATION MOVEMENT (LMI) APPEARS TO BE MORE CONCERNED FOR A COMPLETE POLITICAL DEAL. CROWDS WHICH HAVE GATHERED (SOME FROM PROVINCES) TO WELCOME AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI ARE RESTIVE. TEHRAN CLERGY HAVE CALLED FOR CALM FOR 48 MORE HOURS, BUT POTENTIAL FOR VIOLENCE IS SUBSTANTIAL. END SUMMARY.

IN DISCUSSIONS WITH MODERATE POLITICAL BROKER MINATCHI AND LMI'S ENTEZAM OVER PAST 24 HOURS, IT APPEARS THAT BAKHTIAR'S DECISION TO GO TO PARIS WAS WORKED OUT WITH CHIEF KHOMEINI LIEUTENANT IN TEHRAN BEHESHTI AND NUMBER OF OTHER PARTICIPANTS. IT ALSO INVOLVED CONSIDERABLE TELEPHONE WORK WITH PARIS. APPARENTLY DEAL AGREED TO LATE EVENING JAN 27 JUST INCLUDED BAKHTIAR-KHOMEINI MEETING; LEADERS ARE MEETING VIRTUALLY CONTINUOUSLY THROUGH DAY OF JAN 28 TO WORK OUT ADDITIONAL DETAILS, AND UNCERTAINTY LEVEL IS HIGH ALL AROUND.

MINATCHI BELIEVES CRITICAL POINT IS TO GET BAKHTIAR AND KHOMEINI TOGETHER TO SET TIME FOR KHOMEINI'S RETURN AS QUICKLY AS POSSIBLE. CROWDS WHICH HAVE ASSEMBLED IN TEHRAN OVER PAST FEW DAYS TO WELCOME AYATOLLAH ARE BECOMING RESTIVE. SPEAKERS AT MOURNING RALLY JAN 27 EXPLICITLY STATED THAT IF KHOMEINI DID NOT RETURN JAN 28, ARMED STRUGGLE SHOULD BEGIN JAN 30. BOTH MODERATE TYPES AND LMI ARE VERY MUCH CONCERNED THAT UNDUE DELAY IN PROGRESS TOWARD POLITICAL DEAL THAT WILL BRING KHOMEINI BACK WILL MEAN VIOLENCE WITHIN NEXT FEW DAYS. POTENTIAL FOR UNCONTROLLED REACTIONS BY GANGS OF PROVINCIAL VISITORS IS GROWING.

THERE HAVE BEEN SCATTERED REPORTS OF SOME LOOTING IN SOUTH TEHRAN AND OTHER INCIDENTS ELSEWHERE. SEVERAL OF OUR UNIVERSITY SOURCES SAY RADICAL FACTIONS TO LEFT OF RELIGIOUS MOVEMENT ARE CALLING FOR "MORE ACTIVE" STRUGGLE. HOWEVER, SITUATION REMAINS UNDER CONTROL FOR NOW.

LMI'S ENTEZAM BELIEVES BAKHTIAR SHOULD WORK OUT FULL POLITICAL DEAL IN PARIS BECAUSE, UNLESS HE DOES SO, HE WILL BE HOSTAGE TO ARMY WHEN IT COMES TIME TO IMPLEMENT ANY AGREEMENT IN TEHRAN. ONE SCENARIO HAS BAKHTIAR MAKING SOME SORT OF OBEISANCE TO KHOMEINI, GETTING THE AYATOLLAH'S NOD TO BE PRIME MINISTER UNTIL ELECTIONS ARE HELD (THREEFOUR MONTHS), AND RETURNING ON SAME PLANE WITH AYATOLLAH. ANOTHER SCENARIO HAS BAKHTIAR WORKING OUT AGREEMENT, RETURNING TO PACIFY ARMY AND THEN WELCOMING KHOMEINI.

IN EFFORT TO GIVE POLITICAL PROCESS TIME TO WORK, TEHRAN CLERGY HAVE ISSUED ANNOUNCEMENT MORNING JAN 28 UNDER SIGNATURE OF AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI CALLING FOR 48 MORE HOURS CALM WHILE PRIME MINISTER "ARRANGES RETURN" OF KHOMEINI. BOTH ENTEZAM, AND MINATCHI THINK SOLUTION AT LEAST TO ARRIVAL PROBLEM MUST BE SET BY THAT TIME, OR LMI AND OTHERS WILL HAVE TROUBLE CONTROLLING CROWD REACTION.

COMMENT: MINATCHI IS NOT USUALLY GIVEN TO CONCERN OVER VIOLENCE, AND HE IS CLEARLY WORRIED. NUMBER OF U.S. JOURNALISTS WHO HAVE BEEN ABOUT IN CITY OVER PAST THREE DAYS REPORT MOOD BOTH OF CROWDS AND OF ARMY IS GENERALLY TOUGHER. GUT QUESTION AT THIS POINT IS WHETHER POLITICAL PROCESS CAN CREAK THROUGH TO ENOUGH OF A SOLUTION TO HEAD OFF A CRUNCH BEFORE HOT HEADS TAKE MATTERS INTO THEIR OWN

1979TEHRAN01380.subject: MILITARY REACTION BAKHTIAR'S PLAN TO VISIT

segments.text: (S - ENTIRE TEXT).

GENERAL HUYSER AND OTHER U.S. MILITARY OFFICERS WHO HAVE VISITED SCS HEADQUARTERS DURING COURSE OF DAY JAN 28 REPORT THAT THERE IS LIMITED DISCUSSION AMONG STAFF OFFICERS ABOUT BAKHTIAR'S PLANS TO VISIT KHOMEINI IN PARIS.

IT IS CLEAR THAT THE SENIOR OFFICERS WERE FULLY AWARE OF BAKHTIAR'S PLANS BEFORE HE ANNOUNCED THEM AND HAS GIVEN THEIR GENERAL APPROVAL. HOWEVER, THERE SEEMS LESS CERTAINTY THAT THEY KNOW WHAT PRECISELY BAKHTIAR MAY HAVE ON HIS AGENDA FOR SUCH DISCUSSIONS.

HUYSER REPORTS THAT STATEMENTS EMANATING FROM KHOMEINI HEADQUARTERS DURING MORNING JANUARY 28 HAVE GIVEN RISE TO CONSIDERABLE CONCERN AT SCS. THE KHOMEINI INSISTENCE THAT HE WOULD RECEIVE BAKHTIAR AS A PRIVATE IRANIAN RATHER THAN AS PRIME MINISTER HAS CAUSED GENERAL GHARABAGHI TO WRITE OUT SOME "CONDITIONS" WHICH HE WISHED TO DISCUSS WITH PRIME MINISTER THIS EVENING. FOREMOST AMONG THESE IS STIPULATION THAT TRIP TO KHOMEINI MUST BE CONDUCTED "WITH DIGNITY."

THE TRANSITION WHICH THE ARMED FORCES HAVE ALREADY MADE IN REVISING THE LOCUS OF THEIR LOYALTY FROM THE SHAH TO BAKHTIAR WAS NOT WITHOUT STRAIN. THERE ARE LIMITS TO WHICH BAKHTIAR CAN LEAD THAT NEW ALLEGIANCE IN HIS EFFORTS TO REACH SOME CIVILIZED UNDERSTANDING WITH KHOMEINI.

1979TEHRAN01382.subject: AN ELDERLY SHAH LOYALIST CONGRATULATES USG ON ITS POLICY -- AND PRESSES FOR SHAH'S ABDICATION

segments.text: ITS POLICY -- AND PRESSES FOR SHAH'S ABDICATION (C-ENTIRE TEXT.)

SUMMARY: ELDERLY PRO-SHAH LOYALIST BELIEVES KHOMEINI IS UNSTOPPABLE AND PRESSES FOR SHAH'S EARLY ABDICATION TO KEEP SITUATION FROM DETERIORATING FURTHER, TO FAVOR THE COMMUNISTS. HE THINKS USG HAS PLAYED ITS CARDS JUST RIGHT IN PUBLIC SUPPORT FOR SHAH, WHICH HAS LULLED THE SOVIETS AND PAVED THE WAY FOR PEACEFUL TRANSITION TO KHOMEINI-INSPIRED GOVT. HE BELIEVES CROWN PRINCE COULD EVENTUALLY RETURN. MEANWHILE, QUIET, NOT PUBLIC, SUPPORT FOR BAKHTIAR IS INDICATED. END SUMMARY

ELDER STATESMAN EX-SENATOR EBRAHIM KHAJENURI ASKED THROUGH AN INTERMEDIARY TO MEET POL COUNSELOR AND PASSED ON HIS VIEWS TO HIM JAN 25. KHAJENURI, AT PRESENT RETIRED BUT ACTIVE, HAS A LONG POLITICAL HISTORY, THE HIGH POINT OF WHICH WAS HIS ROLE IN INTRODUCING GENERAL ZAHEDI TO THE AMERICAN AMBASSADOR AT A KEY MOMENT IN 1953. SPEAKING FROM THIS LOYALIST BACKGROUND, KHAJENURI'S MESSAGE NEVERTHELESS WAS THAT THE SHAH'S DAY HAS PASSED, DUE IN LARGE MEASURE TO HIS OWN EFFORTS AND INABILITY TO KEEP UP WITH THE CHANGING TIMES. ONLY HIS SPEEDY ABDICATION COULD SAVE THE MONARCHY AND KEEP THE SITUATION FROM DETERIORATING FURTHER, TO FAVOR THE COMMUNISTS.

LIKE MOST OTHER THINKING IRANIANS, KHAJENURI HAS REACHED THE CONCLUSION THAT KNOMEINI IS UNSTOPPABLE. THE SOONER ADEQUATE ACCOMMODATION IS MADE WITH WHAT KHOMEINI REPRESENTS, THE SOONER WILL IRAN MOVE TO A NEW NORMALITY, AND PREVENT A FURTHER SLIDE INTO CHAOS FROM WHICH ONLY THE COMMUNISTS CAN PROFIT. THE USG SHOULD DO WHAT IT CAN TO ENCOURAGE THE SHAH TOWARD ABDICATION. HE REALIZES A DIRECT APPROACH IS PROBABLY NOT THE BEST, BUT THERE ARE PEOPLE TO WHOSE COUNSEL THE SHAH WILL LISTEN (HEADS OF OTHER STATES, BOTH EUROPEAN AND ARAB), AND THEY SHOULD BE ENERGIZED IN THE RIGHT DIRECTION.

THE CROWN PRINCE WOULD PROBABLY BE ACCEPTABLE AFTER PASSIONS OF THE MOMENT HAVE SUBSIDED. AND THOSE PASSIONS CAN ONLY SUBSIDE ONCE THE SHAH HAS DEFINITELY REMOVED HIMSELF FROM THE POSSIBILITY OF ANY RETURN, THUS ALLOWING OPPOSITION FACTIONS TO EXPRESS THEIR OWN VIEWS ABOUT THE FUTURE, WHICH OFTEN DIFFER FROM KHOMEINI'S.

THE SENATOR THOUGHT HE READ RECENT USG POLICY IN TERMS OF ITS REALITY, NOT ITS SURFACE APPEARANCES. HE CONGRATULATED USG ON APPEARING TO SUPPORT THE SHAH -- A PUBLIC SUPPORT WHICH KHAJENURI THOUGHT ACTUALLY HELPED TO SINK HIM. BY APPEARING TO BE LOSING IRAN USG HAS EFFECTIVELY LULLED THE RUSSIANS, WHO MIGHT OTHERWISE HAVE INTERVENED. IT WAS ONLY UNFORTUNATE THAT THE USG HAD PUBLICLY ALSO SUPPORTED BAKHTIAR, THUS PLANTING A KISS OF DEATH ON HIM TOO. BAKHTIAR, WHOM KHAJENURI DOES NOT KNOW PERSONALLY, IMPRESSES AS COURAGEOUS AND A USEFUL TRANSITION FIGURE. HE COULD HELP SMOOTH THE WAY FOR THE KHOMEINI TAKEOVER AND IS THEREFORE WORTH SUPPORTING QUIETLY.

SINCE THE IMPORTANT THING IS TO KEEP THE SOVIET UNION FROM MEDDLING, U.S. POLICY SHOULD CONTINUE TO WORK INDIRECTLY AND AS EFFECTIVELY AS IT HAS. KHAJENURI WAS NOT TO BE DIVERTED BY POL COUNSELOR'S ASSERTIONS THAT WE DO NOT INTERVENE IN THE INTERNAL AFFAIRS OF OTHER NATIONS, AND THAT AMERICAN POLICY WAS WHAT IT APPEARED TO BE. HE SMILED WISELY AND SAID ALL NATIONS IN TODAY'S WORLD INTERVENE IN SOME INTERNAL AFFAIRS OF OTHERS.

KHAJENURI, WHO DESCRIBES HIMSELF AS A SOCIOLOGIST THE HAS WRITTEN SEVERAL BOOKS) AND "LAY PSYCHOLOGIST," NOTED THAT THE SHAH IS A "NARCISSUS INDIVIDUAL." SUCH PEOPLE OFTEN ACCOMPLISH GREATER THINGS THAN REALISTIC MINDS, BUT THEY ARE ALSO PRONE TO MORE WISHFUL THINKING. HE IS SURE THAT THE SHAH STILL THINKS OF RETURNING TO HIS THRONE, AND THEREFORE WILL NOT TAKE THE CRUCIAL STEP OF ABDICATING WITHOUT CONSIDERABLE PUSHING FROM ADVISORS WHOSE COUNCIL HE TRUSTS.

COMMENT: THE IMPORTANT FACT TO BE DRAWN FROM THIS MEETING IS THAT AN OLD WAR HORSE WHO PLAYED AN IMPORTANT ROLE IN THE SHAH'S RETURN IN 1953 HAS REACHED THE CONCLUSION THAT THE SHAH HAS TO GO AND AN ACCOMMODATION MUST BE MADE WITH KHOMEINI TO PREVENT COMMUNISTS FROM CAPITALIZING
(C-ENTIRE TEXT.)

SUMMARY: BAKHTIAR TO MEET WITH KHOMEINI IN PARIS. AIRPORT CLOSED UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE. JOURNALISTS REMAIN IN CUSTODY. LARGE DEMOS CONCLUDE PEACEFULLY. SOME VIOLENCE IN PROVINCES. TERRORIST ATTACK ON GERMAN RESIDENCE. CROWDS GATHERING AGAIN TODAY. END SUMMARY

MASSIVE PRO-KHOMEINI DEMONSTRATION YESTERDAY CONCLUDED PEACEFULLY. CLASHES OCCURRED IN AT LEAST THREE PROVINCIAL CITIES -- GORGAN, RASHT, AND ABADAN -- AND PRESS PUTS DEATH TOLL AT UP TO 11. IN ADDITION, WE HAVE FURTHER REPORTS OF VIOLENCE ON FRIDAY. TERRORISTS WEARING MILITARY UNIFORMS ATTACKED AN ARMY TRUCK IN TEHRAN, FIRING KALASHNIKOV SUBMACHINE GUNS. EIGHT SOLDIERS WERE WOUNDED, THREE OF THEM SERIOUSLY. NO ONE HAS YET CLAIMED CREDIT FOR THE ATTACK, BUT IT BEARS THE TRADEMARK OF THE PEOPLE'S SACRIFICE GUERRILLAS. GUNMEN ALSO ATTACKED A HOUSE IN FARANIEH AREA OF TEHRAN INHABITED BY THREE GERMANS FRIDAY NIGHT, WOUNDING ONE OF THEM. EMBASSY IS INVESTIGATING.
AMERICAN OWNED AUTOMOBILE WAS DESTROYED IN GOLESTAN AREA OF TEHRAN FRIDAY NIGHT.

BIG NEWS IS ANNOUNCEMENT LAST NIGHT THAT PRIMIN BAKHTIAR WILL GO TO PARIS WITHIN 48 HOURS TO MEET WITH KHOMEINI. THE AYATOLLAH IS REPORTEDLY WILLING TO SEE HIM, BUT LATE MORNING JOURNAL (AYANDEGAN) REPORTS KHOMEINI STATEMENT, DATED YESTERDAY, THAT HE WILL NOT RECEIVE BAKHTIAR UNLESS PRIMIN RESIGNS, SINCE HIS GOVT IS ILLEGAL. HIGHLY PLACED GOI SOURCE TOLD EMBASSY BAKHTIAR PLANNING DEPART EARLY MORNING JAN 29, PERHAPS AFTER PRESS CONFERENCE. KHOMEINI CALLS ON FOLLOWERS TO STAND FIRM IN OPPOSITION. BAKHTIAR SAYS HE WILL REMAIN IN PARIS MAXIMUM OF THREE DAYS.

IN ANY CASE KHOMEINI'S ARRIVAL IN IRAN IS DELAYED, BUT EVEN THOUGH PUBLIC CANNOT EXPECT TO SEE KHOMEINI FOR AT LEAST A FEW DAYS, MEHRABAD AIRPORT REMAINS CLOSED. COMMITTEE ORGANIZING THE RETURN FESTIVITIES ANNOUNCED THE DELAY IN THE BIG EVENT AND CALLED UPON "THE WARRIORS OF ISLAM" TO OBSERVE A 48 HOUR RESPITE UNTIL RESULTS OF BAKHTIAR'S TRIP BECOME CLEAR.

PRESS REPORTS FIVE JOURNALISTS ARE STILL IN CUSTODY AFTER FRIDAY NIGHT ARREST UNDER MARTIAL LAW. THOSE CONFIRMED ARRESTED INCLUDE TWO FROM AYANDEGAN, ONE FROM KAYHAN, AND TWO FROM ETTELA'AT. OTHER REPORTS INDICATE SEVEN ARE UNDER ARREST, WHILE POLICE SOURCES TELL US THEY ARRESTED 17. APPARENTLY SOME OF THESE HAVE NOT BEEN MISSED. BAKHTIAR SAID LAST NIGHT THAT THE JOURNALISTS WOULD BE FREED SOON, BUT DID NOT SAY WHEN. MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR SAYS ARRESTS HAD NOTHING TO DO WITH THEIR PRESS WORK, BUT NO ONE BELIEVES THAT.

TEHRAN'S IRANZAMIN SCHOOL ANNOUNCED IT WILL REOPEN AT 1600 THIS AFTERNOON. THERE IS IN FACT A NOTICEABLE TREND TOWARD NORMALCY IN THE CAPITAL TODAY. LAST EVENING WAS THE FIRST IN A VERY LONG TIME WITHOUT ANY POWER OUTAGE. GASOLINE LINES ARE SHORTER, ALTHOUGH STILL PRESENT. STRIKE SITUATION, ON THE OTHER HAND, HAS NOT IMPROVED. CONSULATES ISFAHAN AND TABRIZ REPORT ALL QUIET LAST NIGHT AND THIS MORNING. TEHRAN IS, HOWEVER, FAR FROM QUIET.

WE HAVE REPORT OF BANK ON UPPER JORDAN BOMBED AND DESTROYED, AND ONE REPORT OF AUTOMATIC WEAPONS FIRE IN NORTHWEST TEHRAN. OTHERWISE, THE CROWDS DO NOT SEEM TO HAVE CLASHED WITH SECURITY FORCES.

CBI VICE-GOVERNOR SHIRAZI TOLD EMBOFF JAN 28 THAT PROBLEM OF SIGNING AUTHORITY (PREVIOUSLY REPORTED) IS MORE A POLICY THAN A LEGAL MATTER. SIGNING POWERS TECHNICALLY SHOULD BE IN FORCE AS DELEGATED UNTIL RESCINDED. SHIRAZI SAID HE INTENDS TO AUTHORIZE ROUTINE TRANSACTIONS WHEN THE BANK OPENS JAN 29 AND THAT THE NOTE ISSUE OPERATION SHOULD NOT BE IMPEDED. HE UNDERSTANDS THAT FORMER CPI DEP. GOV. MEMARZADEH'S NOMINATION FOR THE DEPUTYSHIP HAS BEEN FORWARDED TO THE COUNCIL OF MINISTERS FOR APPROVAL AND BELIEVES THAT WHEN THIS POSITION IS FILLED THE UNCERTAINTY IN APPROVING MAJOR TRANSACTIONS WILL DECREASE. FOREIGN EXCHANGE DEALERS, WHO ARE ALMOST ALL JEWISH, ARE CLOSED TODAY.

CONSUL IN ISFAHAN HAS JUST INFORMED US THAT, IN RESPONSE TO YESTERDAY'S THREAT BY HOMAFARS THAT THEY WOULD MARCH ON THE TRAINING CENTER, THE AUTHORITIES AT THE TRAINING CENTER TODAY DENIED ROUGHLY 2,000 HOMAFARS ENTRANCE TO THE BASE WHEN THE WORKDAY BEGAN. HOMAFARS TRIED TO ENTER BY ANOTHER GATE AND WERE AGAIN DENIED ENTRY. SOME SHOTS WERE FIRED, APPARENTLY IN THE AIR. HOMAFARS BROKE UP INTO GROUPS AND RETURNED TO THE CITY. THERE ARE REPORTS OF SOME SHOOTING AND FIRES IN PARTSOF ISFAHAN. REPORTEDLY, SOME OFFICERS WERE INVOLVED IN THE PROTEST AS WELL. (ABOVE BASED ON INCOMPLETE INFORMATION AND SHOULD BE HANDLED WITH CAUTION.)

LAST MINUTE REPORT FROM CONSUIL SHIRAZ IS THAT CONTRARY TO REPORT YESTERDAY, LARGE BUT PEACEFUL CROWD ASSEMBLED NEAR SHAH CHERAQ MOSQUE. ANOTHER SUCH CROWD APPARENTLY ASSEMBLING TODAY. SHOPS, EXCEPT FOOD STORES, REMAIN CLOSED, BUT STREET VENDORS HAVE THEIR WARES SPREAD EVERYWHERE AND SOME OF THEM APPEAR TO BE SHOPKEEPERS WHO HAVE SIMPLY CHANGED VENUE. TRAFIC IS ABYSMAL. THERE ARE NO LINES AT GAS STATIONS. UNIVERSITY IS OFFICIALLY OPEN, BUT WITHOUT STUDENTS.

TEHRAN RADIO ANNOUNCED TODAY THAT MAJLES DEPUTY DANESHI FROM ABADAN, A MULLAH, WAS SHOT AS HE LEFT HIS HOME THIS MORNING ON WAY TO PARLIAMENT. HE IS IN CRITICAL CONDITION AT THE HOSPITAL WITH SEVERAL BULLETS IN HIS CHEST. (COMMENT: THIS HAS ALL THE MARKINGS OF A TERRORIST EXECUTION. DANESHI WAS A LOYALIST.) SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN01386.subject: (C) SUPPLEMENT TO POLITICAL/SECURITY REPORT - JANUARY 28: SITUATION SERIOUS IN ISFAHAN

segments.text: JANUARY 28: SITUATION SERIOUS IN ISFAHAN (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

CONSUL ISFAHAN HAS JUST INFORMED US THAT IN LATE AFTERNOON VIOLENCE OCCURRED BETWEEN THE HOMOFARS AND THE MARTIAL LAW TROOPS. A NUMBER OF HOMOFARS WERE ARRESTED AND PLACED IN AN ARMORED PERSONNEL CARRIER WHICH HAD TANK PROTECTION. SUBSEQUENTLY, OTHER HOMOFARS WITH A LARGE CROWD SURROUNDED TROOP TRUCKS AND TOOK THE WEAPONS OF THE SOLDIERS AND "ARRESTED" THE TROOPS. WITH THE ARMS THAT THEY HAD, THE HOMOFARS THEN INVADED A POLICE STATION AND SEIZED OTHER WEAPONS. THE TANKS AND THE APC WHICH IS HOLDING THE HOMOFARS PRISONER HAVEBEEN CUT OFF BY FELLED TREES ON ONE SIDE AND A MASS OF DEMONSTRATORS ON THE OTHER.

THE HOMOFARS ARE DEMANDING THE EXCHANGE OF PRISONERS, I.E., THE ARRESTED HOMOFARS FOR THE TROOPS WHO HAVE BEEN SEIZED. THE MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES ARE SEEKING REINFORCEMENTS, BUT CLEARLY THE MASS OF PEOPLE SURROUNDING THE BESEIGED APC AND TANKS HAS AUTHORITIES GREATLY CONCERNED.
ABOVE INFORMATION HAS NOT YET BEEN CONFIRMED BY OTHER

WE CAN PROVIDE LIGHT BUT NO SOLUTION. BELIEVE THIS MOVE MUST BE INSTIGATED BY ZAHEDI TO BLOCK TROUBLEMAKERS IN HIS EMBASSY WHO WISHED TO REMOVE HIM. SITUATION PARTLY REFLECTS MFA ITSELF WHERE MINISTER MIRFENDERESKI'S DEPUTY ZELLI APPEARS TO LEAD LOYALISTS IN CONTRAST TO AD HOC COMMITTEE OF NATIONAL FRONT SYMPATHIZERS A LEVEL JUST BELOW HIM. MIRFENDERESKI HIMSELF IS PROBABLY TRYING TO BALANCE THE TWO TRENDS TO KEEP HIS MINISTRY IN ONE

1979TEHRAN01398.subject: IRANIAN MILITARY THREATS TO EMBASSY LOCALS AS EVIDENCE OF DEGREE TO WHICH SITUATION HAS DETERIORATED HERE, POLOFF WAS APPROACHED IN CONFIDENCE BY SE NIO

segments.text: AS EVIDENCE OF DEGREE TO WHICH SITUATION HAS DETERIORATED HERE, POLOFF WAS APPROACHED IN CONFIDENCE BY SENIOR EMBASSY LOCAL MORNING JAN 29 AND ASKED IF IT WERE POSSIBLE TO HAVE IRANIAN ARMY UNITS GUARDING EMBASSY REMOVED FROM GROUNDS. WHEN ASKED WHY, POLOFF WAS TOLD THAT FOR PAST FEW DAYS, IRANIAN TROOPS WHO WERE STATIONED IN TRUCKS WITHIN COMPOUND HAD BEEN QUIETLY ASKING OUR LOCALS WHY THEY WERE WORKING FOR EMBASSY AND OBLIQUELY THREATENING THEM IF THEY CONTINUE TO DO SO. LOCAL, WHO IS EXTREMELY STABLE AND COOL, ASKED RHETORICAL QUESTION ARE THEY HERE TO PROTECT US OR NOT? WE DO NOT RPT NOT WANT THIS ITEM INCLUDED IN ANY SITREPS.
(S-ENTIRE TEXT.)

DEPT WILL HAVE ALREADY SEEN ESSENCE OF PRIME MINISTER' PRESS CONFERENCE THIS MORNING WHERE HE ANNOUNCED HE WOULD NOT BE GOING TO PARIS, WOULD NEVER RESIGN AND WOULD OPEN THE AIRPORT AND ALLOW KHOMEINI TO RETURN.

DR. MINATCHI INFORMS US THAT MEETING AT MILITARY'S REQUEST IS SET FOR THIS EVENING BETWEEN GENERAL MOGAHDDAM AND GENERAL GHARABAGHI ON GOI SIDE AND ENG. MEHDI BAZARGAN, SEYED MOHAMMAD BEHESHTI, AYATOLLAH RAFSANJANI AND DR. SAHABI ON OPPOSITION SIDE. MEETING WILL DISCUSS CONDITIONS FOR HANDLING KHOMEINI RETURN AND MAINTAINING PUBLIC ORDER.
PM HAS ASKED TO SEE ME THIS EVENING AT 6:00 P.M. LOCAL TIME TO DISCUSS HIS PLANS AND INTENTIONS. SULLIVAN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).
ALTHOUGH WE HAVE RECEIVED TEXT OF HOAGLAND ARTICLE, WE HAVE NOT RPT NOT YET SEEN BURT TEXT.

AS FAR AS HOAGLAND ARTICLE IS CONCERNED, I DO NOT RPT NOT INTEND ENTER INTO CONTROVERSY WITH FALK, WHO IS ANTAGONISTIC, OPPORTUNISTIC AND UNRELIABLE. MY STRONG PREFERENCE THEREFORE IS THAT SPOKESMAN STAND ON "NO COMMENT" IN THIS REGARD.

FYI BUT NOT RPT NOT FOR USE, MY MEETING WITH CLARK, ET AL., WAS ON BACKGROUND BASIS ONLY. AN EXAMPLE OF FALK'S DISTORTION WAS HIS USE OF MY STATEMENT THAT BAKHTIAR WOULD HAVE HAD GREATER STRENGTH IF SHAH HAD LEFT AND INSTALLED HIM LAST SEPTEMBER. FALK HAS TWISTED THIS TO SAY THAT I RECOMMENDED DEPARTURE OF SHAH IN SEPTEMBER. END FYI.
AS DEPT SHOULD BE AWARE, FALK IS PUBLICITY SEEKER. LESS PUBLICITY WE GIVE HIM THE BETTER. SULLIVAN
(S - ENTIRE TEXT).

ALTHOUGH BAKHTIAR-KHOMEINI MEETING HAS APPARENTLY COLLAPSED, I BELIEVE WE SHOULD CONTINUE TO SUSPEND ANY FURTHER DIALOGUE WITH YAZDI UNTIL SITUATION CLARIFIES. AS DEPARTMENT IS AWARE, I HAVE MEETING WITH PRIME MINISTER BAKHTIAR AT 1800 THIS EVENING AND SHOULD HAVE CLEARER VIEW OF HIS INTENTIONS AFTER THAT EVENT.

TEHRAN IS EXTREMELY TENSE AFTER BLOODY CLASHES WHICH TOOK PLACE AT UNIVERSITY YESTERDAY AFTERNOON. THERE SEEM TO BE MANY WEAPONS IN HANDS OF OPPOSITION FORCES WITHIN THE CITY AND THERE IS DANGER OF FURTHER EXPLOSIONS UNLESS EXTREME CAUTION IS EXERCISED.

IF EVENTS DEVELOP SO THAT A NEW U.S. MEETING WITH YAZDI IS INDICATED, I BELIEVE ENTIRELY NEW TEXT WILL HAVE TO BE DRAFTED TO REFLECT EVENTS OF PAST FEW DAYS AND ESPECIALLY THOSE PRESSURES IN PARIS WHICH PERSUADED KHOMEINI, IN EFFECT, TO ABORT THE OPPORTUNITY FOR COMPROMISE THROUGH A MEETING WITH BAKHTIAR. SULLIVAN
BODY OF COLONEL ARTHUR FINEHOUT REPEAT FINEHOUT, ARMISH/ MAAG CHIEF OF STAFF, WAS FOUND IN HIS APARTMENT MORNING JANUARY 16. DEATH HAS BEEN RULED ACCIDENTAL. SULLIVAN
(C-ENTIRE TEXT)

WE HAVE HAD A RATHER DICEY MORNING CONCERNING SECURITY AT THE EMBASSY COMPOUND. THE FIRST CADRE OF TROOPS TO ARRIVE IN THE MORNING TO TAKE OVER FROM THE SMALLER NIGHT TIME FORCE WAS A UNIT FROM KARAJ--PROBABLY SIXTEENTH DIVISION. THE TROOPS, NUMBERING APPROXIMATELY 200, WERE SURLY, ILL-DISCIPLINED AND CLEARLY ANTI-AMERICAN. IN THREE SEPARATE INSTANCES AMERICAN EMPLOYEES WERE TOLD "YANKE, GO HOME" (ONE HAD THE BARREL OF A G-3 SHOVED INTO HIS STOMACH TO EMPHASIZE THE POINT), AND OUR NATIONAL EMPLOYEES WERE PESTERED AND INSULTED BECAUSE THEY WORK FOR AMERICANS. MANY TROOPS WENT TO THE CARAVANSARAI RESTAURANT FOR TEA AND COFFEE AND WERE BELLIGERENT WHEN CALLED UPON TO PAY.
(WE HAVE LONG HAD ARRANGEMENTS TO PROVIDE TEA AND CIGARETTES TO THE TROOPS TO SUPPLEMENT THEIR OWN RATIONS.)

THE ARMY ATTACHE, COL HOLLAND, WHO HAS BEEN OUR LIAISON WITH THE IRANIAN SECURITY FORCE, INFORMED MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES OF THE ATTITUDE OF THE KARAJ GROUP AND IN DUE COURSE THE TROOPS WERE REPLACED BY APPROXIMATELY 200 TROOPS WHO ARE FROM A UNIT RECENTLY MOVED TO TEHRAN FROM KHORAMABAD. THIS CADRE IS BETTER DISCIPLINED BUT IS EDGY BECAUSE OF ITS INVOLVEMENT IN THE SERIOUS SHOOTING AROUND TEHRAN UNIVERSITY YESTERDAY.

AN IMPERIAL GUARD UNIT WHICH ALSO ARRIVED EARLY TO PROVIDE SECURITY--APPARENTLY AS A RESULT OF A MIX UP IN ORDERS--WAS SENT ON TO THE UNIVERSITY AREA BECAUSE OF THE UNIT'S REPUTATION FOR DISCIPLINE. (WITH UNITS ROTATING IN AND OUT WE HAD NEARLY 1000 TROOPS PILED UP AT ONE TIME IN THE COMPOUND.)

WE WILL ATTEMPT DELICATELY TO OBTAIN THE ASSIGNMENT OF DISCIPLINED TROOPS IN THE FUTURE BUT ARE SOMEWHAT ON A CLEFT STICK: WE NEED TROOP PROTECTION FROM OUTSIDE ATTACK AND CANNOT BE SO DEMANDING IN OUR IDENTIFICATION OF THE TROOPS WE PREFER THAT MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES, OUT OF IRRITATION, REDUCE OUR PROTECTION TO INSIGNIFICANCE.
THIS IS OUR FIRST DIRECT EXPERIENCE WITH TROOPS THAT APPEAR TO BE ON THE EDGE OF REBELLION. IT IS IN MICROCOSM A SITUATION PREVAILING IN MANY UNITS OF THE ARMY.
(C-ENTIRE TEXT)

JOHN ORANGE, CONSORTIUM REPRESENTATIVE IN TEHRAN, INFORMED E/C COUNSELOR JANUARY 29 THAT HE IS ADVISING CONSORTIUM HEADQUARTERS IN LONDON THAT THE SECURITY SITUATION IN IRAN IS DETERIORATING AND WILL PROBABLY GET WORSE. IN VIEW OF THIS, HE IS RECOMMENDING THAT CONSORTIUM MAKE TENTATIVE PLANS FOR AIR CHARTER IF NECESSARY TO EVACUATE REMAINING EXPATRIATE EMPLOYEES AND DEPENDENTS OF CONSORTIUM, OSCO, AND CONSORTIUM MEMBER COMPANIES (ABOUT 20 IN ALL). ORANGE BELIEVES THAT MOST OF THE REMAINING 20 WILL DEPART IRAN BY NEXT WEEK.

ORANGE COMMENTED FURTHER THAT HE HAD RECENTLY CONTACTED ALI NABEGH (WHO APPEARS TO BE EFFECTIVELY IN CHARGE OF NIOC), TO DISCUSS NIOC'S RECENT REQUEST FOR THE RETURN OF 109 EXPATRIATE EMPLOYEES. CONSORTIUM OFFICE IN LONDON HAD RESPONDED TO THE REQUEST, SUGGESTING MINOR CHANGES WHICH WOULD INCREASE THE NUMBER OF EXPATRIATES RETURNING TO ABOUT 120. NABEGH ACKNOWLEDGED NIOC'S INTEREST, BUT SAID NO ONE IN NIOC WILL BE IN A POSITION TO TALK UNTIL THEY GET GUIDANCE FROM THE GOI.

IN VIEW OF THESE DEVELOPMENTS ORANGE SAID THERE APPEARS TO BE NO COMPELLING REASON FOR REMAINING EXPATRIATE EMPLOYEES TO STAY IN TEHRAN. ORANGE SAID OSCO EMPLOYEES WHO ARE NOW IN ATHENS WILL SOON BE DISPERSED TO THEIR PARENT COMPANIES OR TO OTHER EMPLOYEMNT, WITH THE POSSIBLE EXCEPTION OF ANY EMPLOYEES INCLUDED AMONG THE 120 WHICH NIOC AND THE CONSORTIUM HAVE TENTATIVELY IDENTIFIED AS ESSENTIAL TO ANY
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: SERIOUS VIOLENCE IN TEHRAN AND SEVERAL OTHER CITIES YESTERDAY. BAKHTIAR TELLS PRESS HE IS NOT GOING TO PARIS; KHOMEINI IS FREE TO RETURN BUT SECURITY SHOULD FIRST BE ARRANGED. AIRPORTS WILL OPEN WITHIN A FEW HOURS. TERRORISTS WOUNDED MAJLIS DEPUTY FOR DISOBEYING KHOMEINI'S ORDER TO RESIGN. USAF MAJOR WAS WOUNDED LAST NIGHT IN NEAR-SUCCESSFUL ASSASSINATION ATTEMPT. CROWDS AGAIN TODAY AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY -- SITUATION EXPLOSIVE BUT HAS NOT DETONATED BY MIDAFTERNOON. END SUMMARY.

YESTERDAY'S DEMONSTRATION ERUPTED INTO SERIOUS VIOLENCE, PARTICULARLY AT 24TH ESFAND SQUARE ON SHAHREZA. TROOPS, WHICH WERE NOT UNDER FIRM DISCIPLINE AND FACED A TAUNTING, ROCK-THROWING MOB OF PERHAPS 3,000, OPENED FIRE AND KILLED ABOUT 30 AND WOUNDED MANY MORE -- ESTIMATES RUN UPWARDS OF 300. SCENE REPORTED BY A NUMBER OF EYEWITNESS CORRESPONDENTS (AND FILMED BY TV NETWORKS) WAS APPARENTLY CONFUSED AS WELL AS VIOLENT. GOVERNMENT SAYS GENDARMERIE HEADQUARTERS WAS ATTACKED WITH RIFLE FIRE, BUT SOME PRESS REPORTS DISAGREE. LMI SOURCE SAYS MAIN LINE RELIGIOUS OPPOSITION HAD NOTHING TO DO WITH PROVOCATIVE MOB, AND EVEN THEY BLAME TUDEH OR SOME VAGUE FORCE WHICH THEY CANNOT CONTROL.
OVER ONE HUNDRED CLERGY ARE HOLDING SIT-IN AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY TO PROTEST THE KILLING AND GOI'S BARRIERS TO KHOMEINI'S RETURN.

THE PROVINCES WERE ACTIVE AS WELL. CONSULATES TABRIZ AND SHIRAZ HAD QUIET DAYS, WHILE ISFAHAN HAD SERIOUS INTRASERVICE PROBLEM WHICH WE REPORTED SEPARATELY. IN ABADAN, GORGAN, AND RASHT, VIOLENCE LED TO ABOUT 10 REPORTED DEATHS.

PRIMIN BAKHTIAR STATED AT NEWS CONFERENCE TODAY THAT HE WILL NOT GO TO PARIS TODAY OR TOMORROW, "BUT THE DOOR IS OPEN". HE REPEATED HE WILL NOT RESIGN: "I DO NOT INTEND TO LET ONE FORM OF DICTATORSHIP REPLACE ANOTHER. ONCE I HAVE PREVENTED THIS, I SHALL BE ABLE TO LEAVE THE GOVERNMENT WITH MY HEAD HELD HIGH." AIRPORTS WILL REOPEN IN A FEW HOURS, AND KHOMEINI IS FREE TO RETURN, BUT THE AYATOLLAH'S RETURN WILL POSE "CERTAIN QUESTIONS OF SECURITY". EITHER THE GOVERNMENT OR KHOMEINI'S ENTOURAGE MUST TAKE RESPONSIBILITY FOR HIS SAFETY, AND THIS SHOULD BE WORKED OUT IN ADVANCE OF HIS ARRIVAL.
BAKHTIAR SAID HE WILL WORK FOR A PERMANENT CHANGE IN THE REGIME: "THE CONSTITUTION LEAVES THE DOOR OPEN TO ALL SORTS OF CHANGE. IT IS THE PEOPLE WHO DECIDE."

MUSLIM TERRORISTS (MOVAHEDIN) HAVE TAKEN CREDIT FOR ATTACK ON MAJLIS DEPUTY FOR ABADAN, CLERGYMAN GHOLAMHOSSEIN DANESHI YESTERDAY AS HE WAS ON HIS WAY TO PARLIAMENT (YESTERDAY'S SITREP). THE MOVAHEDDIN, WHO HAD PREVIOUSLY CLAIMED CREDIT FOR KILLING OSCO'S PAUL GRIMM, TELEPHONED TO AYANDEGAN THAT THEY SHOT DANESHI FOR FAILING TO OBEY KHOMEINI'S ORDER TO RESIGN.

HE, A CLERGYMAN, HAD A SPECIAL RESPONSIBILITY TO FOLLOW THE AYATOLLAH. ------------------104332 291426Z /47 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 3495 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY BONN AMEMBASSY CAIRO AMCONSUL DHAHRAN IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY DOHA AMCONSUL FRANKFURT AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS USLO PEKING AMEMBASSY RABAT USLO RIYADH IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY TOKYO USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC SECTION 02 OF 03 TEHRAN 01446

MAJOR LARRY R. DAVIS, USAF, OF ARMISH/MAAG, SURVIVED ASSASSINATION ATTEMPT LAST NIGHT AS HE WAS OPENING HIS FRONT GATE. HE WALKED HOME FROM A FRIEND'S HOUSE, PASSING A GROUP OF YOUNG MEN LOITERING ON THE STREET. AS HE BEGAN TO OPEN THE DOOR, ONE OF THEM STEPPED AWAY FROM THE OTHERS AND FIRED WITH A SMALL CALIBER PISTOL. DAVIS WAS HIT ON THE ARM AS HE RAISED IT. A SECOND SHOT GRAZED THE BACK OF HIS NECK. HE THEN EMPTIED HIS OWN PISTOL AT THE ATTACKER BUT APPARENTLY MISSED. ATTACKER FLED IN A NEARBY AUTOMOBILE. SECURITY SECTION CONSIDERS ATTACK TO BE A TARGET OF OPPORTUNITY RATHER THAN CAREFULLY-PLOTTED ASSASSINATION.
DAVIS IS IN STABLE CONDITION AT ARMISH/MAAG HOSPITAL.

SITUATION IS TENSE IN TEHRAN TODAY, AS ANOTHER CROWD GATHERED IN TEHRAN UNIVERSITY AREA, BUT WE HAVE NO REPORTS OF SHOOTING THERE AS OF MID-AFTERNOON. CONSULATE TABRIZ REPORTS SITUATION QUIET, ALTHOUGH TOWNSPEOPLE ARE WORRIED ABOUT MARKED RISE IN PETTY CRIME AND ALMOST TOTAL ABSENCE OF POLICE PROTECTION. POLICE ANSWER VIRTUALLY EVERY CALL FOR HELP WITH: "GO ASK KHOMEINI". RURAL BANDITS ARE ALSO ACTIVE, STOPPING CARS AND ROBBING THE OCCUPANTS. GUNS ARE PLENTIFUL AND CHEAP IN TABRIZ. CONSULATE SHIRAZ REPORTS DEMONSTRATION WHICH FOR A WHILE HAD CONSUL HIMSELF TRAPPED IN AN AUTOMOBILE.

MOST OF CROWD WAS NONVIOLENT, BUT PARADE MARSHALS COULD NOT CONTROL A BAND OF THUGS WHO BEAT ON CONSUL'S CAR AND THREATENED HIM. BODYGUARD GOT OUT AND HELPED MARSHALS TO CLEAR AN ESCAPE ROUTE INTO AN ALLEY. NO ONE WAS INJURED.

HAVE NOT BEEN ABLE TO GET THROUGH TO ISFAHAN TODAY. HOWEVER, LATE LAST NIGHT CONSUL REPORTED CROWD WHICH HAD SURROUNDED AND SEIZED TROOPS IN RETALIATION FOR ARREST OF HOMOFARS (TEHRAN 1386 NOTAL), HAD BEEN CALMED BY NEWS THAT TWO AYATOLLAHS HAD NEGOTIATED RELEASE OF HOMOFARS. CROWD HAD MOVED ON BUT WAS STILL IN DANGEROUS MOOD SHOULD RELEASE FALL THROUGH.

RADIO IRAN YESTERDAY BROADCAST AN ARMY COMMUNIQUE FROM SANANDAJ, URGING CITIZENS TO COOPERATE WITH ARMY TO IDENTIFY KURDISH NATIONALISTS WHO DISPLAYED FLAG OF AUTONOMOUS REPUBLIC OF KURDESTAN THERE TWO DAYS AGO. STRONGLY-WORDED COMMUNIQUE WARNS THAT ARMY WILL CONSIDER SEPARATISTS AS "NON-IRANIAN AGGRESSORS" WHO WILL BE CRUSHED. GOI IS GETTING NERVOUS ABOUT KURDISH UNREST, BUT CONSUL TABRIZ COMMENTS THAT KURDS HABITUALLY SEIZE ANY GOOD OPPORTUNITY, LIKE THE PRESENT ONE, FOR LOOTING AND RAIDING WHICH DOES NOT NECESSARILY CONSTITUTE REBELLION.

AUTOMOBILE CONTAINING ONE AMERICAN, TWO AUSTRALIANS, AND ONE FILIPINO WAS TRAPPED BY MOB IN FRONT OF INTERCONTINENTAL HOTEL YESTERDAY. OCCUPANTS WERE ROUGHLY HANDLED ALTHOUGH NOT REALLY BEATEN, AND CAR WAS DESTROYED BY BURNING. OPPOSITION TODAY IS COOPERATING IN RETURNING LARGE SUM OF MONEY (ABOUT $20,000) BELONGING TO AMERICAN FIRM WHICH WAS LEFT BEHIND IN BRIEFCASE BY FLEEING OCCUPANTS.
FIVE JOURNALISTS ARE STILL IN CUSTODY.

AMERICAN REPORTER CONFIDED TO US THAT A GOOD SOURCE AT UNIVERSITY TOLD HIM ARMS ARE BEING PASSED OUT ON A SELECTIVE BASIS TO OPPOSITION PEOPLE WHO ARE TRAINED IN THEIR USE. THIS IS THE FIRST SUCH REPORT WE HAVE AND IS NOT CONFIRMED. SOME ARMS WERE CAPTURED AS RECENTLY AS YESTERDAY IN MELEE NEAR UNIVERSITY WHEN AMERICAN CAMERAMEN FILMED A SOLDIER BEING SHOT BY ANOTHER SOLDIER, WHO THEN DESERTED TO THE DEMONSTRATORS. CIVILIAN RAN OFF WITH FIRST SOLDIER'S AUTOMATIC RIFLE. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN01447.subject: LIBERATION MOVEMENT (LMI) WILL TRY AGAIN FOR - DEAL WITH GOI

segments.text: DEAL WITH GOI (S - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: SENIOR LMI OFFICIAL SAYS DESPITE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT ANGER OVER ARMY SHOOTINGS OF PAST TWO DAYS, MOVEMENT WILL ATTEMPT AT EVENING MEETING JAN 29 TO WORK OUT SUCCESSFUL DEAL WITH MILITARY TO ALLOW KHOMEINI TO RETURN TO IRAN. TWO PREVIOUS ATTEMPTS AT AGREEMENT WERE FRUSTRATED BY SHOOTINGS AND, SOURCE THOUGHT, PERHAPS BY "CONFUSION" IN PARIS. LMI HOPES KHOMEINI CAN BE BROUGHT TO IRAN WHERE MODERATING ELEMENTS OF LOCAL RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP AND IN-COUNTRY LMI ORGANIZATION CAN BE BROUGHT TO BEAR. BIGGEST STUMBLING BLOCK IS PUBLIC REJECTION OF BAKHTIAR BY KHOMEINI AND GREATER LEVEL OF EXASPERATION ON BOTH SIDES THAN EXISTED FIVE DAYS AGO. END SUMMARY.

LMI'S AMIR ENTEZAM ASKED FOR MEETING WITH POLOFF STEMPEL (AND TO UNDERLINE URGENCY, EVEN OFFERED TO COME TO EMBASSY'S CARAVANSARI RESTAURANT IN VIEW OF DIFFICULT SECURITY SITUATION) LATE MORNING JAN 29. HE BEGAN BY EXPRESSING LMI ANGER AT ARMY'S SHOOTING OF DEMONSTRATORS OVER PAST TWO DAYS, AND SAID LMI FIGURES FOR JAN 27 UNIVERSITY SHOOT-OUT WERE 43 DEAD, 300 INJURED. HE NOTED POLICE IN SANANDAJ HAD "RUN WILD" ON JAN 28, AFTER KILLING OF POLICEMAN DAY BEFORE, AND SHOT DOWN 200.

(COMMENT: THESE FIGURES ARE PROBABLY HIGH.) ENTEZAM SAID HE PERSONALLY HEARD PRIME MINISTER GIVE ORDERS TO ARMY TO ARREST ENTIRE SANANDAJ POLICE FORCE DURING MEETING JAN 28 AFTER READING SAVAK REPORT WHICH BLAMED POLICE FOR INCIDENT.

EMBOFF NOTED ARMY SEEMED UPSET WITH VIOLENCE OF PAST TWO DAYS, BUT OUR INFORMATION INDICATED BOTH DAYS' ACTIVITIES WERE STARTED BY THOSE OTHER THAN LMI-ASSOCIATED FORCES. ENTEZAM SAID HIS MOVEMENT WAS ALSO CERTAIN TUDEH ELEMENTS HAD BEGUN JAN 27 SHOOTING AT UNIVERSITY, AND THAT PERHAPS GOI PROVOCATEUR HAD STARTED ROCK-THROWING JAN 29. ENTEZAM SAID VIOLENCE WAS STILL GOI'S FAULT, AND HAD DISRUPTED DEAL WITH KHOMEINI. EMBOFF SAID PERHAPS THIRD PARTIES WERE TRYING TO DISRUPT DEAL. LONG BACK-AND-FORTH DISCUSSION FOLLOWED ON CAUSES OF VIOLENCE AND FACT IT HAD INCREASED ANGER ON ALL SIDES AND INHIBITED POLITICAL SOLUTION.

ENTEZAM SAID BASIC PROBLEM NOW WAS KHOMEINI REJECTION OF BAKHTIAR BECAUSE OF THE BLOODLETTING. DESPITE THIS, LMI WAS GOING TO MEET WITH GENERALS MOGHADDAM AND GHARABAGHI EVENING JAN 29 TO TRY AND WORK OUT SAFE ARRIVAL OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI. BAKHTIAR PRESS CONFERENCE MORNING JAN 29 HAD NOT IMPROVED MATTERS, BUT AT LEAST AIRPORT WAS GOING TO BE OPEN. ENTEZAM URGED USG IN STRONGEST TERMS TO PRESS MILITARY FORCES NOT RPT NOT TO FIRE WEAPONS AT CROWD BUT TO USE ANY OTHER METHODS OF CROWD CONTROL WHENEVER POSSIBLE. THIS WOULD MAXIMIZE POSSIBILITY SITUATION COULD BE RETRIEVED. EVEN SO, ENTEZAM WAS NOT OPTIMISTIC.

EMBOFF BLUNTLY TOLD ENTEZAM THAT IN VIEW OF USG, RELIGIOUS MOVEMENT HAD TO WORK OUT ACCOMMODATION WITH MILITARY OR ELSE IT WOULD FALL PREY TO DEPREDATIONS OF OTHERS WHO WANTED VIOLENCE AND ANARCHY, NOT SETTLEMENT. ENTEZAM SAID IT WAS DIFFICULT TO TRUST BAKHTIAR; HE HAD NOT KEPT HIS WORD TO KEEP THE ARMY QUIET. EMBOFF SAID GOI FELT LMI HAD NOT KEPT ITS WORD, SINCE VIOLENCE HAD STARTED. EMBOFF AND ENTEZAM AGREED THIRD PARTY INVOLVEMENT COMPLICATED PROBLEM OF TRUST; SITUATION WAS TOO CRITICAL TO STAND ON BYGONES, HOWEVER, AND BOTH SIDES HAD TO WORK FOR SOME KIND OF ARRANGEMENT TO PERMIT KHOMEINI TO ARRIVE SAFELY.

ENTEZAM SAID IT WAS PARTICULARLY IMPORTANT TO GET KHOMEINI INTO COUNTRY AND "CUT OUT THE MIDDLE MEN". EMBOFF ASKED IF THIS MEANT PARIS STAFF. ENTEZAM REPLIED VERY CAREFULLY: YAZDI WAS ALL RIGHT; HE (ENTEZAM) HAD KNOWN HIM A LONG TIME. EMBOFF PRODDED HIM ON REST OF ENTOURAGE, AND IT WAS CLEAR THAT HE WOULD NOT SAY ANYTHING UNLESS HE COULD SAY SOMETHING GOOD AND WAS "THEREFORE SAYING NOTHING". IN-COUNTRY RELIGIOUS LEADERS AND LMI LOCAL ORGANIZATION WERE MUCH MORE MODERATE THAN PARIS GROUP, UNDERSTOOD COUNTRY BETTER, AND HAD HEALTHIER RESPECT FOR RADICAL LEFTIST CAPABILITIES THAN "PARIS BUNCH". EMBOFF ENCOURAGED LMI TO WORK OUT ARRANGEMENT.

ENTEZAM SAID HE HIMSELF WAS LMI OFFICIAL WHO HAD NEGOTIATED WITH BAKHTIAR AND WAS WILLING TO DO SO AGAIN IF NECESSARY; RIGHT NOW, LMI WAS FOCUSING ON UNDERSTAND------------------104625 291433Z /50 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 3498 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 01447 EXDIS ING WITH SECURITY FORCES. CONVERSATION ENDED ON NOTE THAT LMI WOULD REDOUBLE EFFORTS TO WORK OUT AGREEMENT AND IDENTIFY THOSE WHO WILL DISRUPT ONE, AND USG WOULD URGE NON-VIOLENT RESPONSE TO CONFRONTATIONS.

COMMENT: EVENTS OF PAST 24 HOURS HAVE CLEARLY RAISED HACKLES ON BOTH SIDES, BUT ENCOURAGING FACTOR IS THEIR WILLINGNESS TO TRY AGAIN. ACCORDING TO MODERATE POLITICAL BROKER, DR. NASSER MINATCHI, MILITARY INDICATED THEY VERY MUCH WANT MEETING WHEREAS THEY HAVE BEEN STANDOFFISH FOR PAST WEEK. ENTEZAM WAS PLEASED THAT SECURITY MEETING WOULD GO FORWARD, BUT PREOCCUPIED WITH PROBLEM OF GETTING LINES OF POLITICAL SETTLEMENT BACK ON RAILS. HE SHED SOME LIGHT ON EARLIER EFFORTS WHEN HE NOTED THAT IN FIRST AGREEMENT HE HAD WORKED OUT WITH BAKHTIAR, PRIME MINISTER HAD AGREED WELCOME KHOMEINI, THEN RESIGN. KHOMEINI HAD AGREED TO REAPPOINT BAKHTIAR AND FINALLY TO LET HIM PICK HIS OWN CABINET.

IN SECOND AGREEMENT, BAKHTIAR HAD PROPOSED TRIP TO PARIS WITHOUT CONDITIONS; THIS HAD EVENTUALLY BEEN FOUND UNACCEPTABLE. SCENARIO ABOVE SEEMS REASONABLE, EXCEPT THAT KHOMEINI APPEARS TO HAVE BEEN CONVINCED TO AT LEAST TENTATIVELY DECIDE TO CANCEL ORIGINAL (FIRST) AGREEMENT BEFORE JAN 29 VIOLENCE GOT UNDERWAY. IT WAS CLEAR FROM DISCUSSION THAT ENTEZAM THINKS PARIS ENTOURAGE PROBABLY SPIKED FIRST AGREEMENT AFTER THE FACT. ACCORDING TO ONE JOURNALIST WHO WAS AT BAKHTIAR PRESS CONFERENCE MORNING JAN 29, PRIME MINISTER DEFINITELY BELIEVED HE HAD HAD AN AGREEMENT FROM KHOMEINI SIDE THAT WAS RENEGED UPON.

MINATCHI FEELS ORIGINAL AGREEMENT IS PROBABLY STILL WORKABLE IN SOME FORM IF BAKHTIAR CAN SAY A FEW NICE WORDS ABOUT KHOMEINI PUBLICLY. APPEARS FROM HERE THAT WE ARE BACK WHERE WE WERE FIVE DAYS AGO, BUT WITH POSITIONS A LITTLE STIFFER AND MORE
I MET FOR ONE HOUR WITH PRIME MINISTER BAKHTIAR AT 1800 JANUARY
HE BEGAN BY REVIEWING FOR ME THE EVENTS OF THE PAST THREE DAYS WITH WHICH YOU ARE ALREADY FAMILIAR.

IN ANSWER TO MY QUESTIONS, HE SAID HE DID NOT RPT NOT HAVE ANY POLITICAL UNDERSTANDINGS WITH KHOMEINI WORKED OUT THROUGH INTERMEDIARIES. HE WOULD HAVE HOPED TO ARRANGE ALL THAT WITH KHOMEINI WHEN HE ARRIVED IN PARIS. HE ALSO SAID THAT HE HAD CLEARED ALL ARRANGEMENTS HE HAD MADE WITH THE MILITARY.

HIS CHANGE OF PLANS, ANNOUNCED IN PRESS CONFERENCE MORNING JANUARY 29, HAD ALSO BEEN CLEARED WITH MILITARY. HE SAID THEY AGREED WITH HIS PLAN TO OPEN THE AIRPORTS AND TO PERMIT KHOMEINI TO RETURN TO IRAN. HE HAD GIVEN NO RPT NO GUIDANCE TO MILITARY ABOUT THEIR MEETING WITH BAZARGAN AND BEHESHTI BEYOND SAYING THAT SECURITY ARRANGEMENTS FOR RETURN OF KHOMEINI SHOULD EITHER BE IN HANDS OF MILITARY OR OF KHOMEINI'S PEOPLE, BUT NOT RPT NOT DIVIDED.

HE THEN WENT ON TO SAY THAT HE HAD CONCLUDED THAT KHOMEINI SHOULD RETURN, THAT MILITARY SHOULD STAY OUT OF HIS WAY, AND THAT KHOMEINI SHOULD BECOME "DROWNED IN MULLAHS". THIS MIGHT MAKE HIM MORE REASONABLE, OR AT LEAST LESS INVOLVED IN POLITICAL AFFAIRS. HE SAID THE LOCAL KHOMEINI PEOPLE UNDERSTOOD THE SITUATION BETTER THAN THOSE IN PARIS AND MIGHT BE ABLE TO BRING A LITTLE SENSE INTO KHOMEINI'S SCHEME OF THINGS. HOWEVER, HE HAD GRAVE DOUBTS, ON THE BASIS OF HIS RECENT EXPERIENCE, THAT HE COULD EVER REACH ANY AGREEMENT WITH KHOMEINI.

BAKHTIAR SAID THAT HE EXPECTED KHOMEINI'S RETURN COULD BE KEPT PEACEFUL AND THAT EVERYTHING WOULD BE QUIET FOR A FEW DAYS WHILE THE CROWD WENT THROUGH THEIR ADULATION. THEN, HE FELT, THE CRUNCH WOULD COME WHEN KHOMEINI NAMED HIS REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL. IF THE COUNCIL WAS COMPOSED OF REASONABLE MEN HE MIGHT BE ABLE TO NEGOTIATE WITH THE "OFFICIEUSEMENT." BUT, IF THEY WERE MEN WHO TRIED TO TAKE OVER THE GOVERNEMENT, BAKHTIAR THOUGHT THEY WOULD HAVE TO BE ARRESTED. THIS ACTION WOULD CAUSE "PANDEMONIUM."

HE SAID THAT HE WAS TROUBLED BY THE SITUATION WHICH WOULD ARISE IF KHOMEINI PROCLAIMED A RIVAL GOVERNMENT. HE SAID HE NOW FELT THE SOVIETS AND THE OTHER COMMUNIST STATES WOULD RECOGNIZE THAT RIVAL GOVERNMENT. HE WAS ALSO WORRIED ABOUT THE ATTITUDE OF THE BRITISH. HE ASKED ABOUT U.S. STAND, AND I ASSURED HIM WE WOULD STAND BY HIM. I SAID I THOUGHT ALL EUROPEAN GOVERNMENTS INCLUDEING THE BRITISH, WOULD DO THE SAME. HE ASKED IF WE COULD SPEAK TO THE SOVIETS TO GET THEM TO DO THE SAME. I SAID I WOULD ASK WASHINGTON TO CONSIDER IT.

HE THEN SAID HE WAS UNSURE OF WHAT COURSE TO TAKE IF KHOMEINI CAME BACK AND PROCLAIMED A RIVAL GOVERNEMENT. HIS "PERSONAL" PREFERENCE WAS TO DEFY HIM, AND HE WAS SURE THE MILITARY FELT THE SAME WAY. HOWEVER, HE HAD DOUBTS THE MILITARY COULD PREVAIL AGAINST "THE MASSES." HE WOULD THEREFORE DISCUSS THE SUBJECT WITH THE REGENCY COUNCIL MORNING JANUARY 30 AND LATER THAT SAME DAY WITH NATIONAL SECURITY COUNCIL. HE WOULD LET ME KNOW FEBRUARY 1 WHAT THEY HAD DECIDED. IN MEANTIME, HIS GREATEST FEAR WAS THAT EVERYBODY, ON BOTH SIDES, WOULD LOSE CONTROL AND "MADMEN" WOULD RULE THE STREETS.
HE THOOUGHT THERE WAS REAL CHANCE CHAOS WOULD BE THE ONLY RULER IN IRAN IN THE NEXT FEWDAYS.

COMMENT: BAKHTIAR WAS FAR LESS COCKY THAN HE HAS BEEN IN PREVIOUS DISCUSSIONS. HE SAT WITH HIS HEAD DOWN AND WRUNG HIS HANDS A LOT. IT IS MAY IMPRESSION THAT, FACED WITH THE AWESOME PROSPECT OF ORDERING A MASS SLAUGHTER OF HIS FELLOW CITIZENS, HE IS PREPARED TO FLINCH FROM HIS PREVIOUS POSITION OF STAUNCH RESISTANCE. HIS PLAN TO DISCUSS THE FUTURE WITH THE REGENCY COUNCIL BEARS OUT THIS CONCLUSION. IT IS MY EXTIMATE THAT THE MAJORITY OF THE MEMBERS OF THE REGENCY COUNCIL WOULD ADVISE HIM TO RESIGN RATHER THAN CONFRONT KHOMEINI WITH FORCE. THE MOMENT OF TRUTH COMES CLOSER.

1979TEHRAN01457.subject: SITUATION IN ISFAHAN: BHI EMPLOYEE WOUNDS IRANIAN TAXI DRIVER

segments.text: DRIVER

SUMMARY: LARGE CROWD HAS SURROUNDED KORUSH HOTEL IN ISFAHAN FOLLOWING SHOOTING OF IRANIAN TAXI DRIVER BY BHI EMPLOYEE EARLY THIS EVENING. CONSUL MC GAFFEY IS INSIDE HOTEL WITH BHI OFFICIALS. END SUMMARY.

ACCORDING TO BHI AND CONSULATE, AN ALTERCATION BETWEEN BHI EMPLOYEE AND IRANIAN TAXI DRIVER OCCURRED EARLIER THIS EVENING IN LOBBY OF KORUSH HOTEL IN ISFAHAN. BHI EMPLOYEE DREW GUN, AFTER TAXI DRIVER WIELDED KNIFE (ACCORDING TO BHI EMPLOYEE INVOLVED; NO OTHER WITNESSES) AND SHOT IRANIAN THROUGH CHEEK. IRANIAN IS NOT SERIOUSLY WOUNDED.

BHI EXECUTIVES AND CONSUL MC GAFFEY HAVE GONE TO HOTEL. MLA, LOCAL POLICE AND OTHER AUTHORITIES HAVE BEEN INFORMED. CROWD HAS ASSEMBLED AROUND HOTEL AND SMALLER GROUP IS ATTEMPTING TO BREAK INTO ROOM WHERE BHI OFFICIALS AND MC GAFFEY ARE GATHERED. SO FAR, MLA HAS NOT SENT SUFFICIENT FORCES TO BREAK UP MOB. WE ARE ATTEMPTING FROM TEHRAN END TO GET IMMEDIATE AND EFFECTIVE MLA RESPONSE.
ABOVE, AT THIS POINT, NOT TO BE USED IN SITREPS.
AFTER ABOVE DRAFTED, WE HAVE BEEN INFORMED THAT MC GAFFEY AND BHI EMPLOYEE HAVE BEEN SAFELY REMOVED TO NEARBY HOUSE OF AYATOLLAH.

1979TEHRAN01466.subject: (C) SITUATION IN ISFAHAN: CONSUL MCGAFFEY AND BHI EMPLOYEE SAFE

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT)
CONSUL MCGAFFEY HAS INFORMED US THAT HE AND BELL EMPLOYEE (REFTEL) WERE GIVEN SANCTUARY IN HOME OF AYATOLLAH KHADEMI AND ARE SAFE BUT BADLY BRUISED.

MLA AUTHORITIES PROVED UNABLE TO SEND SUFFICIENT MILITARY FORCE TO BREAK UP CROWD OF 10,000 OR MORE WHICH HAD SURROUNDED KORUSH HOTEL. INSIDE HOTEL PART OF CROWD HAD TORN DOWN DOOR OF ROOM IN WHICH MCGAFFEY AND BELL OFFICIALS HAD TAKEN REFUGE. MOB HAD BROUGHT GASOLINE AND KEROSENE IN ORDER TO SET FIRE TO THE HOTEL WHICH AT THAT TIME HAD APPROXIMATELY 200 AMERICANS IN RESIDENCE. MCGAFFEY ASKED REPRESENTATIVES OF AYATOLLAH KHADEMI, WHO WERE ATTEMPTING TO CALM THE CROWD, FOR SANCTUARY IN THE HOME OF THE AYATOLLAH. THESE REPRESENTATIVES LEAD THE BELL EMPLOYEE, WITH MCGAFFEY PROTECTING THE BACK OF THE EMPLOYEE, THROUGH THE CROWD.
THEY WERE BOTH BADLY BEATEN AND MCGAFFEY NARROWLY ESCAPED BEING KNIFED. EIGHT STICHES WERE REQUIRED FOR VARIOUS WOUNDS.
MCGAFFEY IS CURRENTLY TRYING TO WORK OUT "REZIYAT" (FORGIVENESS) BETWEEN BHI AND THE WOUNDED TAXI DRIVER.

EFFECTIVENESS IN THIS MESSY SITUATION IF I AM GIVEN TO UNDERSTAND THAT THE WHITE HOUSE PUTS MORE FAITH IN THE STATEMENTS OF A TROUBLE-MAKING PROFESSOR THAN IN MY REPORTS AS THE U.S. AMBASSADOR. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN01477.subject: (C) FOREIGN PRESS JUDGES ARMY UNDISCIPLINED AND BLOODTHIRSTY

segments.text: BLOODTHIRSTY (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY (BEGIN SUMMARY). U.S. AND OTHER FOREIGN PRESSMEN ARE ACQUIRING A DEMONSTRATORS' -EYE-VIEW OF UNREST IN IRAN WHICH MIGHT LEAD TO MORE DIRECT CRITICISM OF USG POLICY, AS IT IS PERCEIVED BACKING THE ARMY. END SUMMARY

MORNING JAN 29 ABC NEWSMEN INVITED ICA CPAO AND POL COUNSELOR TO VIEW FOOTAGE TAKEN DAY BEFORE OF DEMONSTRATORS CLASHING WITH ARMY AT "24 ESFAND" SQUARE NEAR TEHRAN UNIVERSITY. FOOTAGE (WHICH WAS PROBABLY SHOWN IN EDITED VERSION IN U.S.) INCLUDED FOLLOWING
HALF DOZEN SOLDIERS SHOOTING ALMOST CONTINUOUSLY AND IN MANY DIFFERENT DIRECTIONS, WITH A GOOD DEAL OF AIMED SHOOTING AS WELL AS SHOOTING OVER HEADS OF DEMONSTRATORS.

SOLDIER BEATING A CIVILIAN WHO WAS WAITING IN A CAR. OTHER SOLDIER SHOOTING FIRST SOLDIER IN THE LEG AND RUNNING TO THE DEMONSTRATORS. THAT SOLDIER BEING BEATEN UP BY DEMONSTRATORS UNTIL THEY REALIZED HE WAS DESERTING, AND WELCOMED HIM. MEANWHILE CIVILIAN BEING BEATEN UP GRABBED WOUNDED SOLDIER'S RIFLE AND RAN TO DEMONSTRATORS WITH IT. OTHER CIVILIANS CAME TO ASSIST WOUNDED SOLDIER WHO RESISTED ASSISTANCE BUT WAS FINALLY PACKED INTO AMBULANCE TO BE TAKEN TO HOSPITAL.
WOUNDED ARRIVING AT HOSPITAL, SOME OF THEM CONTINUING TO SHOUT SLOGANS. EXTREME EMOTION OF ON-LOOKERS WHO AFTER 20 MINUTES TURNED ON CAMERA CREW, WHICH THEN LEFT.
ROCK THROWING BY DEMONSTRATORS CLEARLY GETTING NOWHERE NEAR TROOPS, BUT MARKING THEIR DETERMINATION TO CONTINUE RESISTANCE.

CORRESPONDENTS, WHO INCLUDED BRITISH AND OTHER NATIONALITIES AS WELL AS AMERICANS, RELATED WHAT OTHER EYEWITNESSES HAD SEEN OF TROOP BRUTALITY. THIS INCLUDED TROOPS SHOOTING DEMONSTRATORS WHO HAD THEIR HANDS UP IN COLD BLOOD. SEVERAL OF THE AMERICANS AND OTHERS PRESENT, INCLUDING THE PROGRAM PRODUCER, EXPRESSED THE OPINION THAT THE TROOPS HAD GONE "BERSERK" AND THAT THEY WERE BLOODTHIRSTY.

CORRESPONDENTS EXPLAINED HOW THEY HAD COME UNDER FIRE FROM TROOPS IN SEVERAL INSTANCES. THEY HAD SEEN UNIDENTIFIED CIVILIAN WITH PISTOL ON ROOFTOP SHOOT ITALIAN PHOTOGRAPHER WHO WAS WOUNDED AND THEN PREVENT OTHERS FROM CARRYING HIM AWAY BY CONTINUING TO SHOOT FOR SOMETIME. THEY HAD HEARD TROOPS WERE "INSTRUCTED" TO SHOOT AT CAMERAMEN.

REPORTERS WERE IMPRESSED BY STRONG ANTI-AMERICAN AND ANTI-FOREIGN FEELINGS AMONG DEMONSTRATORS. MAIN FOCUS OF DEMONSTRATORS' OPPROBRIUM WAS PRESIDENT CARTER, WHOM THEY BLAMED FOR THE WHOLE SITUATION. REPORTERS CLEARLY DID NOT BLAME DEMONSTRATORS FOR TAKING THIS VIEW.

COMMENT: IT IS OBVIOUS THAT NEWSMEN COVERING DISTURBANCES IN TEHRAN THESE DAYS IDENTIFY WITH THE DEMONSTRATORS. THEIR IDENTIFICATION IS PROBABLY GIVEN AN EMOTIONAL DIMENSION BY THEIR BEING SHOT AT. THEY ARE VERY PROUD OF FOOTAGE THEY GET UNDER THESE CONDITIONS (ONE BRITISH CORRESPONDENT THOUGHT ABC SHOULD GET AN AWARD) AND ARE ANXIOUS THAT USG OFFICIALS SEE WHAT THEY ARE SEEING AND REPORT IT TO WASHINGTON. WE BELIEVE THIS IS A FACTOR TO BE RECKONED WITH IN THE PERCEPTIONS OF THE SITUATION THAT ARE TRANSMITTED TO THE AMERICAN TV VIEWER. IT COULD TAKE ON A COLORATION OF CRITICISM OF U.S. POLICY BY THE PRESS. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN01478.subject: MODERATES CONTINUE TO ORGANIZE, BUT FEAR COMMUNISTS AND KHOMEINI

segments.text: COMMUNISTS AND KHOMEINI (C-ENTIRE TEXT.)

SUMMARY: MODERATE OPPOSITIONISTS HELD FIRST LARGE ORGANIZATIONAL MEETING RECENTLY AND STOOD OFF COMMUNIST EFFORTS TO DISRUPT IT. THEY FEAR COMMUNIST TAKEOVER OF DICTATORSHIP TO BE SET UP BY KHOMEINI BUT SEE LITTLE ALTERNATIVE TO COOPERATING WITH KHOMEINI FOR THE MOMENT. THEY DO NOT THINK BAKHTIAR HAS ANY CHANCE AS LONG AS HE HAS NOT DENOUNCED THE SHAH. END SUMMARY

OPPOSITIONIST HEAD OF IRAN'S TEACHERS UNION MOHAMMAD DERAKHSHESH TOLD POL COUNSELOR JAN 28 THAT HIS POLITICAL GROUP HAD ORGANIZED A MEETING OF 4 OR 5 THOUSAND PEOPLE FIVE DAYS BEFORE (JAN 23) TO DISCUSS COMMON INTERESTS IN POLITICAL SITUATION. THEY HAD ADVERTISED IN THREE NEWSPAPERS AND USED TEACHERS' CLUB WHICH IS CONTROLLED BY MINISTRY OF EDUCATION. THIS HAD BEEN OPEN TO THEM EVEN THOUGH THEY NEVER REQUESTED PERMISSION FROM MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES.

PROMINENT OPPOSITIONISTS SPOKE, APART FROM A SPEAKER REPRESENTING TEACHERS UNION. THESE INCLUDED LAWYER MATINDAFTARI ON BEHALF OF BAR ASSOCIATION, LAWYER LAHIDJI ON BEHALF OF LAWYERS GROUP, RAHIM SAFFARI OF BANI-AHMAD'S "UNITY FOR LIBERTY" PARTY (SEE TEHRAN 451), DR. (FNU) ESHRAGHI OF A DOCTORS ORGANIZATION AND A MR. (FNU) MOAMENI OF WRITERS ORGANIZATION. MEETING AGREED ON COOPERATING TO RENT PREMISES FOR A CLUB, AND THEY ARE NOW LOOKING. THEY ARE ALSO SEEKING PERMISSION TO CONTINUE PUBLICATION OF DERAKHSHESH'S WEEKLY (OF WHICH A FEW COPIES HAVE APPEARED FROM TIME TO TIME OVER PAST FEW MONTHS).

TOWARD THE END OF THE MEETING SOME COMMUNISTS CAME IN AND TRIED TO BREAK IT UP BY SHOUTING. ABOUT 100 STEWARDS WITH BADGES PREVENTED THEM FROM COMING UP TO THE SPEAKERS PLATFORM, AND SINCE THE MEETING WAS NEARLY OVER, THEY DID NOT DISRUPT IT. THIS BROUGHT DERAKHSHESH TO EXPRESS CONCERN THAT THE COMMUNISTS ARE GETTING STRONGER. THE CITY IS FULL OF THEIR BOOKS, WHICH ARE PLENTIFUL AND CHEAP. MRS. DERAKHSHESH SAID THEY WERE ALL OVER THE PLACE IN "VALIAD" (CROWN PRINCE) SQUARE AND SHE HAD BOUGHT THREE HERSELF. COMMUNISTS ARE GETTING READY TO TAKE OVER ONCE THE MULLAHS FAIL.

AS HE HAS DONE ON PREVIOUS OCCASIONS DERAKHSHESH AGAIN EXPRESSED OPPOSITION TO REPLACEMENT OF SHAH'S DICTATORSHIP BY A DICTATORSHIP OF THE MOSLEM CLERGY. IN HIS BOOKS KHOMEINI CLAIMS TO BE REPRESENTATIVE OF GOD AND HOW CAN ANYONE ARGUE WITH THE WORD OF GOD? GOVT BASED ON THE KORAN IS BOUND TO BE BACKWARD AND NOT AT ALL HELPFUL IN BRINGING TRUE EDUCATION TO THE PEOPLE OF IRAN.

DERAKHSHESH BLAMED THE SHAH FOR SUPPORTING A VERY LIMITED TYPE OF EDUCATION FOR HIS PEOPLE, WHICH NARROWED THEIR HORIZONS INSTEAD OF BROADENING THEM AS GOOD EDUCATION SHOULD. HE SAID BAKHTIAR PROBABLY COULD HOLD HIS OWN IF HE TOOK A POSITION AGAINST THE SHAH. AS IT IS, PEOPLE THINK HE WANTS THE SHAH TO RETURN. MOREOVER, BAKHTIAR AS PRIME MINISTER UNDER THE CONSTITUTION DOES NOT CONTROL THE ARMY, THE SHAH DOES. BAKHTIAR WAS WELL RECEIVED AT FIRST, FOR HE DID SOME OF THE THINGS HE SAID HE WOULD.

HE FREED POLITICAL PRISONERS, ALLOWED RELATIVELY FREE PRESS, ALLOWED FREE DEMONSTRATIONS, BUT IN LAST FEW DAYS ARMY HAS BEEN SHOOTING AT THE PEOPLE EVEN THOUGH BAKHTIAR SAID HE WOULD NOT SHOOT AT THEM. THIS SUGGESTS BAKHTIAR DOES NOT REALLY CONTROL THE ARMY AS HE SAYS HE DOES.

DESPITE ALL OF THE ABOVE, DERAKHSHESH RECOGNIZED HIS OPTIONS ARE LIMITED. HE HOPED FOR THE BEST IN THE CONTINUING CONFRONTATION BETWEEN KHOMEINI AND THE ARMY, WITH BAKHTIAR AS BUFFER. HE SAID HE WAS MOST CONCERNED WITH COMMUNIST THREAT, AS IT WAS PARTICULARLY DANGEROUS FOR A TEACHERS ORGANIZATION SINCE THAT IS ONE OF THE FIRST PLACES THE COMMUNISTS TRY TO RECRUIT. DERAKHSHESH HIMSELF HAS BEEN UNDER COMMUNIST FIRE IN THE PAST AND HAS RETURNED THE FIRE. HE SEEMED PERSUADED THAT, WHILE HIS ULTIMATE AIM IS A DEMOCRATIC SOCIETY FREE OF RELIGIOUSCLERICAL PREJUDICES, TACTICALLY HE PROBABLY HAS NO CHOICE BUT TO ALLY HIMSELF WITH THE KHOMEINI FORCES.

HE COULD THUS HOPE TO HAVE SOME INFLUENCE ON THE NATURE OF ANY RELIGIOUS GOVT WHICH FOLLOWS AND NOT LEAVE THE RELIGIOUS PEOPLE TO THE COMMUNISTS. POL COUNSELOR SUGGESTED DERAKHSHESH AND OTHER MODERATES WOULD BE WELL ADVISED TO CONSULT MORE CLOSELY WITH FELLOW MODERATES SUCH AS ------------------112545 301011Z /12 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 3514 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 01478 BAZARGAN, WHO AFTER ALL MAINTAINS THE BEST CONTACTS WITH MAINSTREAM OF RELIGIOUS MOVEMENT.
COMMENT: DERAKHSHESH CLEARLY DISTRUSTS STAYING POWER OF KHOMEINI'S MOVEMENT AND IS AFRAID IT WILL IMPOSE A DICTATORSHIP WHICH COMMUNITS WILL IN TIME SEIZE CONTROL

(U) FOLLOWING ADVISORY WAS ISSUED THIS MORNING TO AMERICANS CITIZENS. "ALL DEPENDENTS OF U.S. GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS HAVE BEEN ORDERED TO DEPART IRAN TEMPORARILY AT THE EARLIEST FEASIBLE DATE. "ALL DEPENDENTS OF AMERICAN CITIZENS ARE URGED TO DEPART IRAN TEMPORARILY AS SOON AS POSSIBLE AND IT IS RECOMMENDED THAT ALL AMERICAN COMPANIES SEND NON-ESSENTIAL AMERICAN PERSONNEL TEMPORARILY OUT OF THE COUNTRY."
(LOU) BOTH PRIME MINISTER AND SENIOR IRANIAN MILITARY OFFICERS HAVE BEEN INFORMED. WE ARE ALSO INFORMING
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

1979TEHRAN01514.subject: (U) KHOMEINI RETURN AWAITS AIR FRANCE OK

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SENIOR LIBERATION MOVEMENT (LMI) OFFICIAL ENTEZAM TELEPHONED POLOFF AT 1330 LOCAL TIME TO SAY THAT AGREEMENT WITH GOVERNMENT HAD BEEN WORKED OUT. ONLY THING PREVENTING KHOMEINI'S ARRIVAL PLANS GOING FORWARD WAS AIR FRANCE APPROVAL FOR CHARTER. ENTEZAM NOTED (CORRECTLY) THAT TEHRAN AIRPORT IS OPEN, AND PRESUMABLY GOI IS GIVING ITS FINAL APPROVAL TO AIR FRANCE NOW. LMI HOPED TO HAVE FINAL APPROVAL BY MIDAFTERNOON OR EARLY EVENING. ASSUMING APPROVAL, KHOMEINI WOULD DEPART PARIS LATE EVENING JAN 30 FOR ARRIVAL TEHRAN JAN 31 ABOUT 0830 TEHRAN TIME.

PLANS FOR HIS ARRIVAL ARE ESSENTIALLY THOSE WORKED OUT EARLIER (SEE REFTEL): KHOMEINI WILL ARRIVE, BE MET BY SELECT COMMITTEE THEN TAKEN TO BEHESHT-E-ZARA CEMETERY VIA SHAHYAD MONUMENT (SPEECH THERE). AFTER SPEECH AT CEMETERY, HE WOULD RETIRE TO HIS QUARTERS TO RECEIVE VISITS FROM IRAN'S ULEMA AND PERHAPS PRIME MINISTER BAKHTIAR AND CABINET. HE WOULD REMAIN IN TEHRAN TWO OR THREE DAYS BEFORE DEPARTING FROM QOM.

AT JAN 30 MEETING WITH POLOFF, DR. MINATCHI PROVIDED FILL-IN ON DEAL WITH GOI WHICH LED TO RETURN PLANS. GENERAL MOGHADDAM (SAVAK) AND GHARABAGHI (CHIEF OF STAFF) MET WITH ENG. MEDHI BAZARGAN AND DR. YADOLLAH SAHABI, TOP LMI LEADERS, EVENING JAN 29. UNFORTUNATELY, HOJATOLLAH BEHESHTI AND AYATOLLAH RAFSANJANI (WHO HAD BEEN SCHEDULED TO ATTEND) WERE NOT THERE; THEY EXCUSED THEIR NONATTENDANCE BY SENDING WORD THEY WERE PARTICIPATING IN TEHRAN UNIVERSITY SIT-IN PROTESTING ARMY KILLINGS JAN 28

(COMMENT: THIS IS SECOND TIME THAT BEHESHTI HAS IN EFFECT DUCKED FACE-TO-FACE MEETING WITH KEY MILITARY LEADERS, BUT APPARENTLY GHARABAGHI WAS UNDER INSTRUCTION TO MAKE A DEAL, BECAUSE THIS CAUSED NO DIFFICULTY.) BOTH MOGHADDAM AND BAZARGAN TOLD MINATCHI AFTERWARDS MEETING WAS VERY USEFUL, DESPITE RELIGIOUS LEADERS' ABSENCHU ARMY AND LMI MEN AGREED TO DIVISION OF LABOR FOR KHOMEINI RETURN (MILITARY TO PROTECT AIRPORT AND ROAD TO SHAHYAD MONUMENT, LMI TO HANDLE SECURITY FROM THERE), AND GROUP AGREED TO ADDITIONAL MEETINGS OVER COMING DAYS AS DESIRABLE. ACCORDING TO MINATCHI, MILITARY MEN SAID THEY AGREED POLITICAL CHANGES WERE NECESSARY AND MILITARY WOULD ACCEPT THESE WF CARRIED OUT UNDER CONSTITUTIONAL LAW.

COMMENT AND ANALYSIS: BOTH MINATCHI AND ENTEZAM FELT CONFIDENT INITIAL DANGER OF MILITARY-ISLAMIC MOVEMENT CONFRONTATION HAS BEEN SIGNIFICANTLY REDUCED. NEITHER COULD GIVE ANY ASSURANCES THAT KHOMEINI WILL NOT ANNOUNCE ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT AND THUS PROVOKE POLITICAL CONFRONTATION, BUT MINATCHI THOUGHT KHOMEINI HAD PRETTY WELL COMMITTED HIMSELF TO CONSULTATIONS WITH OTHER ULEMA BEFORE MAKING DEFINITIVE PRONOUNCEMENTS. ENTEZAM SAID KHOMEINI HAD DECIDED TO RETURN TO IRAN AGAINST ADVICE OF LMI.

MAJOR FACTORS IN THAT DECISION AS KHOMEINI EXPLAINED PERSONALLY BY PHONE TO BAZARGAN AND ENTEZAM WERE: (A) FEELING THAT KHOMEINI'S PRESENCE WAS NECESSARY TO CONTROL BURGEONING COMMUNIST THREAT (WHICH LMI IS TAKING VERY RPT VERY SERIOUSLY NOW); (B) NEED FOR PERSONAL LEADERSHIP TO PROMOTE PROPER SOLUTION AND MINIMIZE CONFRONTATION WITH MILITARY; AND (C) BELIEF THAT IF CONFRONTATION DEVELOPED, HIS PRESENCE WOULD INSURE THAT TROOPS WOULD DESERT GOVERNMENT EN MASSE AND MINIMIZE VIOLENT PHASE OF REVOLUTION. LOOKS TO US AS IF KHOMEINI WILL THUS COME INTO IRAN PREPARED TO TAKE SITUATION AS HE FINDS IT AND DEAL WITH MATTERS ACCORDING TO "FEEL" HE GETS ON ARRIVAL.

ACCORDING TO ENTEZAM, HE DOES NOT WANT VIOLENCE, BUT ALSO WANTS VICTORY. THIS SUGGESTS THAT, IN THE ABSENCE OF STRONG COUNTERVAILING PRESSURES ON HIM, TEMPTATION TO ANNOUNCE ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT AND "SWEEP AWAY CLAPTRAP OF THE OLD REGIME" MIGHT BE ALMOST IRRESISTIBLE. BEST HOPE FOR MINIMIZING VIOLENCE THEREFORE SEEMS TO REST ON LMI AND MODERATE RELIGIOUS LEADERS PERSUADING KHOMEINI TO TAKE IT EASY ON ARRIVAL. THIS COULD BE A SHORT-ODDS
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY: AIRPORTS REPORTEDLY TO REOPEN TODAY, BUT COMMERCIAL FLIGHTS (EXCEPT ONE JAL FLIGHT THAT LANDED THIS MORNING) NOT EXPECTED EVEN TOMORROW. AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI ADDRESSES LETTER TO AZARBAIJANI TRIBES CALLING FOR LOYALTY TO IRAN, SUPPORT OF ISLAMIC MOVEMENT.

MFA OFFICIAL WROTE TO FONMIN MIRFENDERESKI ASKING THAT HE RESIGN. SIX MORE MAJLES DEPUTIES RESIGNED. TELEPHONE SYSTEM TO BE SHUT DOWN 10-10:30 A.M. EACH THURSDAY MORNING. BANK WORKERS BACK ON FULL STRIKE FOR A WEEK. MFA REPORTEDLY CLOSED MONDAY THROUGH SATURDAY. ENGLISH DAILY CARRIES PRO/CON DEBATE ON ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. TEHRAN DAILIES AND RADIO REPORT IRANIAN AIRPORTS WILL BE REOPENED TODAY BUT THAT MEHRABAD PROBABLY WILL NOT BEGIN RECEIVING COMMERCIAL FLIGHTS UNTIL TOMORROW. HOWEVER ONE JAPAN AIR LINES FLIGHT CAME IN THIS MORNING. NO OTHER COMMERCIAL FLIGHTS ARE EXPECTED TODAY. U.S. MILITARY FLIGHTS ARE CONTINUING. LMI SOURCE WHO HAD JUST SPOKEN TO KHOMEINI AIDE YAZDI TELLS US AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI IS AWAITING AIR FRANCE CONFIRMATION AND EXPECTS TO DEPART PARIS MIDNIGHT TONIGHT, ARRIVE TEHRAN AROUND 8:30 TOMORROW (WEDNESDAY).

HEADLINES WERE "BAKHTIAR UNMOVED" AND "THERE'S A TIME TO SAY NO" (KI) AND IN TEHRAN JOURNAL "BAKHTIAR REJECTS RESIGNATION DEMAND, SCRAPS PARIS VISIT" AND "PREMIER BLAMES KHOMEINI AIDES FOR TALKS DEADLOCK."

ANGRY MOBS LAST NIGHT RANSACKED AND SET ABLAZE TEHRAN'S RED-LIGHT DISTRICT (SHAHR-E-NOW), ADJACENT NIGHT CLUBS, LIQUOR STORES AND A CINEMA. THEY ALSO ATTACKED A NEARBY SHAMS BREWERY DEPOT AND BURNED FIVE BEER TRUCKS. THE MOBS SHOUTED "ON THIS STREET THERE ARE HOUSES WHERE WOMEN SELL THEMSELVES" AND "PURIFICATION BY FIRE".
