TEHRAN JOURNAL CARRIED ARTICLE ON SAZEMAN-E-MOVAHEDDIN ("UNITY ORGANIZATION") THAT CLAIMED CREDIT FOR SHOOTING OF MAJLES DEPUTY DANESHI (NOW REPORTED IN STABLE CONDITION) AND KILLING OF PAUL GRIMM. MOVAHEDDIN ALSO CLAIM THEY KILLED SAVAK CHIEF AT KERMAN AND ARE RESPONSIBLE FOR ATTACK ON HEADQUARTERS OF MILITARY GOVERNOR AT AHWAZ. MOVAHEDDIN ARE DESCRIBED AS MUSLIM EXTREMIST GROUP WHO CLAIM CONTINUITY WITH GROUP THAT KILLED PM MANSOUR IN 1963, PM RAZMARA IN 1950 AND PM HAJIR IN 1946. JOURNAL SAYS THEY HAD BEEN "DORMANT" SINCE MOVEMENT CRUSHED BY SAVAK FOLLOWING MANSOUR ASSASSINATION.

AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI, REPLYING TO A LETTER FROM TRIBAL CHIEFS, CALLED ON AZARBAIJANI TRIBES TO SUPPORT THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT AND TOLD THEM IT WAS THEIR DUTY TO "PROTECT THE PEOPLE, PREVENT DISORDER AND TURMOIL AND SAFEGUARD THE COUNTRY'S BORDERS." AYATOLLAH GOLPAYEGANI, IN A MESSAGE TO THE ARMED FORCES, ASKED ALL RANKS NOT TO SHOOT THEIR OWN BROTHERS AND SISTERS AND SAID THAT DOING SO WAS THE SAME AS SHOOTING "AT THE HOLY KORAN AND ISLAM."

A GROWING NUMBER OF CLERGY, WHICH PRESS NOW PUTS AT "OVER 1,000 FROM ALL CORNERS OF IRAN" TODAY CONTINUED A SIT-IN AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY MOSQUE. THEY SAY THEY WILL REMAIN UNTIL AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI'S RETURN. THEY ARE REPORTEDLY LED BY AYATOLLAHS TALEGHANI, MONTAZERI, NURI MOTAHARI,RABBANI-SHIRAZI AND SADUQI.

PERSIAN AND FRENCH-LANGUAGE PRESS REPORT THAT FEREIDOUN FARROKH, ONE OF THE DIRECTOR-GENERALS FOR POLITICAL AFFAIRS AT THE MFA, HAS WRITTEN A LETTER TO FONMIN MIR-FENDERESKI CALLING ON HIM TO RESIGN. THIS MOVE BY FARROKH APPARENTLY SEEN BY OTHER MFA OPPOSITIONISTS AS INSINCERE, SELF-SERVING GESTURE.

SIX MORE DEPUTIES HAVE RESIGNED FROM THE MAJLES. MAJLES SOURCE PUTS TOTAL AT 28, BUT SOME ARE ALREADY HAVING SECOND THOUGHTS. REPORTEDLY, SOME OF THEM SAY THEY WILL STAY ON TO RESIST TERRORISTS RESPONSIBLE FOR ATTEMPTED ASSASSINATION OF ONE OF THEIR NUMBER.

TELEPHONE WORKERS HAVE ANNOUNCED HALF-HOUR PER WEEK INTERRUPTION OF SERVICE: SYSTEM TO BE CLOSED DOWN THURSDAYS FROM 10 TO 10:30 A.M. MFA "OFFICIALLY" CLOSED BY EMPLOYEES' GROUP UNTIL NEXT SATURDAY, THOUGH SOME OFFICIALS ARE AT THEIR DESKS. BANK EMPLOYEES HAVE ANNOUNCED TOTAL CLOSURE "FOR ONE WEEK" TO PROTEST DELAY IN KHOMEINI'S ARRIVAL AND "BLOODY SUNDAY" (JAN 28).
KAYHAN INTERNATIONAL YESTERDAY CARRIED LONG ARTICLE BY AYATOLLAH NOURI IN FAVOR OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC AND TODAY CARRIED LONG ARTICLE AGAINST IT BY A LAWYER, ESSAYIST AND TRANSLATOR, MOSTAFA RAHIMI.

NOURI SAID REPUBLIC WOULD HAVE "ISLAMIC CONSULTATIVE ASSEMBLY" TO PASS SUCH NEW LAWS AS ARE NEEDED TO ADAPT TO MODERN NEEDS ------------------114654 301434Z /43 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 3540 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY BONN AMEMBASSY CAIRO AMCONSUL DHAHRAN IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY DOHA AMCONSUL FRANKFURT AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS USLO PEKING AMEMBASSY RABAT USLO RIYADH IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY TOKYO USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC SECTION 03 OF 03 TEHRAN 01517 AND AN ASSEMBLY OF FATVAS ("A FATVA IS AN OPINION ON A LEGAL, RELIGIOUS OR OTHER MATTER DELIVERED BY A RECOGNIZED RELIGIOUS AUTHORITY") COMPOSED OF RELIGIOUS LEADERS, THEOLOGIANS, AND SPECIALISTS IN ISLAMIC LAW, WHICH WOULD INTERPRET LAWS AND ASSURE NEW LAWS ARE ACCEPTABLE FROM AN ISLAMIC STANDPOINT.
RAHIMI ARGUES FOR A "PURE" REPUBLIC WITH SAFEGUARDS AGAINST USURPATION OF POWER BY ANY GROUP AND SEPARATION OF RELIGION AND GOVT.

AMERICAN, TWO AUSTRALIANS AND FILIPINO WHOSE CAR WAS ATTACKED BY CROWD YESTERDAY WERE EMPLOYEES OF MORRISONKNUDSEN. MONEY RETRIEVED FROM CAR LAST NIGHT WAS DELIVERED TO HOME OF AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI, WHOSE AIDES INFORMED EMBASSY. EMBOFF, AUSTRALIAN CONSUL AND MORRISON-KNUDSEN REPRESENTATIVES WENT YESTERDAY TO TALEGHANI'S HOUSE WHERE MONEY (TOTAL OF ABOUT 1.8 MILLION RIALS AND $11,700 U.S. DOLLARS) WAS RETURNED.

FIVE JOURNALISTS WHOSE ARREST WE REPORTED PREVIOUSLY WERE FREED WITHOUT EXPLANATION YESTERDAY. ACCORDING TO KAYHAN INTERNATIONAL, THE JOURNALISTS WERE NOT INTERROGATED NOR GIVEN ANY REASON FOR THEIR ARREST.

YESTERDAY WE REPORTED DIFFICULTIES DUE EXPRESSION OF ANTI-AMERICAN SENTIMENTS BY IRANIAN TROOPS ASSIGNED TO PROTECT COMPOUND AND SUBSEQUENT CHANGE OF TROOPS. TWO IRANIAN GENERALS CALLED DAO THIS MORNING TO ASSURE ATTACHE OF THEIR "GREAT PERSONAL CONCERN" AND TO ASK THAT HE IMMEDIATELY REPORT THE SLIGHTEST DIFFICULTY TO THEM.

LAST MINUTE - DEMONSTRATIONS IN VICINITY OF TEHRAN UNIVERSITY CONTINUE TODAY. WE HAVE ONE IRANIAN EYEWITNESS REPORT THAT HOMOFARS AND SOLDIERS ARE PARTICIPATING. BAKHTIAR HAS PRESENTED HIS LONG-RANGE PROGRAM TO PARLIAMENT. PERSIAN RADIO REPORTS MAJOR AIRLINES DO NOT PLAN TO LAND AT MEHRABAD FOR ANOTHER 24 HOURS AS THEY DO NOT YET HAVE FIRM FIX ON AIRPORT STATUS. GROUP OF 35 MARTIAL LAW DETAINEES REPORTED RELEASED TODAY. UNDER EMBASSY INSTRUCTIONS, ISFAHAN CONSUL MCGAFFEY ATTEMPTING TO MOVE ALL REMAINING AMERICANS OUT OF CITY TO NEARBY SATELLITE
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

GENERAL KHOSROWDAD DID MAKE SOME VERY STRONG ANTI-US STATEMENTS TO A BHI OFFICIAL ON JANUARY 29, BUT HE IS BACK IN A FULLY COOPERATIVE MOOD ON JANUARY 30. ACCORDING TO BHI MANAGER FOR IRAN, JANUARY 29 STATEMENTS WERE NOT REPEAT NOT DIRECTED AT BHI. MANAGER TALKED WITH KHOSROWDAD ON SEVERAL BUSINESS MATTERS EARLY JANUARY 30 AND FOUND THE GENERAL IN HIS NORMAL HELPFUL FRAME OF MIND.

GENERAL STONE, CHIEF ARMISH/MAAG ARMY SECTION, SPENT 90 MINUTES WITH KHOSROWDAD LATER JANUARY 30. HE, LIKE BHI MANAGER, FOUND KHOSROWDAD FULLY COOPERATIVE ON QUESTIONS AT HAND. KHOSROWDAD AGREED TO PROPOSED CUT TO 1,000 BHI PERSONNEL IN IRAN AND SAID HE COULD EVEN ACCEPT LOWER FIGURE. HE ALSO AGREED TO ONE-THIRD PERSONNEL CUT FOR ARMY AVIATION TAFT ASSIGNED TO ISFAHAN.

BOTH STONE AND BHI MANAGER DID NOTE KHOSROWDAD'S EXTREME PESSIMISM ABOUT IRAN'S CURRENT AND FUTURE SITUATION. HE IS DEEPLY CONCERNED ABOUT INVOLVEMENT OF FAR LEFT IN CURRENT POLITICAL ACTIVITIES, ABOUT GROWING TROOP DISCIPLINE PROBLEMS AND ABOUT THE NATION IN GENERAL. HE THINKS MAJOR DECISIONS ABOUT IRAN'S FUTURE MUST BE MADE OVER NEXT TWO OR THREE WEEKS. SULLIVAN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)

EMBOFFS PERETT AND PATTERSON MET JAN 25 WITH GROUP OF OPPOSITIONISTS IN HOME OF DR. KHAJAVI. PRIMARY PURPOSE WAS TO GET BAZAARI VIEWS OF POLITICAL SITUATION AND FIVE BAZAARIS WERE PRESENT--MESSRS. ALIBABAI, ALINASSABI, ALAGHE-DIN, NAJIBABAI AND ESPAHBODI. SEVERAL OF DR. KHAJAVI'S HUMAN RIGHTS COMMITTEE FRIENDS ALSO ATTENDED, AS DID MANOUCHEHR DAVOUDI, A FOREIGN SERVICE OFFICER, WHO IS CONSUL GENERAL IN HONG KONG. (DAVOUDI APPEARED DISTINCTLY UNCOMFORTABLE AT ATTENDING WHAT WAS SO PLAINLY AN OPPOSITION GATHERING--SEE TEHRAN 1375.)

EMBOFFS' EFFORTS TO DRAW OUT OPPOSITIONISTS REGARDING THE POLITICAL SCENE GENERALLY PRODUCED A CHORUS OF SUPPORT FOR KHOMEINI AND INVECTIVE AGAINST THE REGIME. WE SUSPECT THE SIZE OF THE GROUP WORKED AGAINST CANDOR (WE HAD REQUESTED A MUCH SMALLER GATHERING). THESE MEN ECHOED OTHER OPPOSITION CONTACTS IN DECLARING THAT BAKHTIAR IS UNACCEPTABLE BECAUSE HE WAS APPOINTED BY THE SHAH AND CONFIRMED BY AN ILLEGAL PARLIAMENT. FROM THAT FACT ALONE HE CANNOT BE TRUSTED: HE MAY BE PART OF A PLOT TO BUY TIME IN WHICH TO MAKE IT POSSIBLE FOR THE SHAH TO RETURN. USG SHARED IN MUCH OF THE CRITICISM DIRECTED AT THE SHAH.

ONE BAZAARI (WHOSE ELOQUENCE WAS MUCH ADMIRED BY OTHERS) SAID REPEATEDLY THAT HE WOULD GIVE US ONE MORE CHANCE; THE BRITISH, ON THE OTHER HAND, HE WOULD NEVER FORGIVE. ("I WILL GO ON SACRIFICING MY WEALTH UNTIL WE HAVE WON. MY SPIRIT HAS BEEN TRAMPLED IN THE DUST.") BAD FEELING TOWARD THE U.S. WAS MITIGATED BY THE VIEW THAT AMERICAN ERRORS RESULTED FROM BLUNDERS, WHILE THE BRITISH AND SOVIET MACHINATIONS WERE OUTRIGHT SCHEMES TO RULE THE COUNTRY.

OLDEST AND APPARENTLY MOST RESPECTED BAZAARI, ALINASSABI, GAVE A SHORT SPEECH, A MIXTURE OF SOPHISTICATION AND NAIVETE, IN WHICH HE DESCRIBED HOW FOLLOWING HUGE INCREASE IN OIL REVENUES IMPORTS CLIMBED SWIFTLY TO AROUND $15 BILLION, WITH MUCH OF THIS BEING WASTEFUL EXPENDITURE ON LUXURY GOODS AND INAPPAROPRIATE TECHNOLOGY. HE ARGUED THAT GIVEN IRAN'S POOR LAND, DRY CLIMATE AND AND HIGH COST OF IRRIGATION, THE COUNTRY SHOULD INVEST ENOUGH IN AGRICULTURE "TO FEED ITSELF" BUT NO MORE AND PUT REST OF EARNINGS INTO "APPROPRIATE" INDUSTRY, WHICH COULD EXPORT AND EVENTUALLY REPLACE OIL REVENUES.

HE EMPHASIZED NEED FOR INDUSTRY IN RURAL AREAS TO END "HIDDEN UNEMPLOYMENT." TO EMBOFF'S QUESTION ON HOW ISLAMIC REPUBLIC (WHICH ALL BAZAARIS PRESSED USG TO SUPPORT) WOULD BE ORGANIZED, ALINASSABI REPLIED THAT HE KNEW NOTHING OF POLITICS BUT WOULD OFFER ECONOMIC ADVICE TO KHOMEINI: "I WOULD SUGGEST TO HIM, FOR EXAMPLE, THAT WE TIE OIL EXPORTS TO DEVELOPMENT OF OTHER EXPORTS, THAT WE SAY TO OTHER COUNTRIES THAT FOR EACH 10,000 BARRELS OF OIL WE SELL THEM, THEY MUST ALSO BUY SO MANY CARPETS." EMBOFFS EXPRESSED POLITE SKEPTICISM AS TO FEASIBILITY OF SUCH A SCHEME.
SEVERAL PARTICIPANTS MADE THE POINT THAT THEY WANTED IRANUS TRADE TO CONTINUE; THEY EVEN EXPECTED IT WOULD INCREASE UNDER THE NEW REGIME.

COMMENT: AGAIN THIS GROUP SHOWS ITS CONFUSION. THEY MAINTAIN, AT LEAST IN FRONT OF ONE ANOTHER, THAT THEY ARE ALL FOR KHOMEINI, BUT IT IS DIFFICULT TO EXTRACT A REASON WHY. THEY SIMPLY EXPECT THE FUTURE TO BE BRIGHTER UNDER THE AYATOLLAH, AND IF IT IS NOT, THEIR ANTI-REGIME ANGER WILL HAVE TO FIND A NEW FOCAL POINT. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN01547.subject: (C) KHOMEINI RETURN SET; CONFRONTATION APPARENTLY DEFERRED

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY--KHOMEINI ARRIVAL SET. AYATOLLAH HAS AGREED TO CONSULT BEFORE CONFRONTING BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT. SECURITY PROVISIONS FOR ARRIVAL HAVE BEEN AGREED TO, BUT THERE REMAIN DETAILS TO BE WORKED OUT ON CONTINUING SECURITY FOR KHOMEINI AND ENTOURAGE. END SUMMARY.

DR. MINATCHI INFORMED POLOFF EARLY MORNING JAN 31 THAT ARRANGEMENTS FOR KHOMEINI ARRIVAL (REFTEL) WERE SET. SECOND MEETING HAD BEEN HELD BETWEEN LIBERATION MOVEMENT (LMI) LEADERSHIP AND GENERALS GHARABAGHI AND MOGHADDAM EVENING JAN 30 TO WORK OUT ADDITIONAL SECURITY PROBLEMS. THIS HAD GONE WELL (MINATCHI PROMISED FURTHER DETAILS AT NOON MEETING.).

DURING TELEPHONE CALL LATE EVENING JAN 30, AT WHICH MINATCHI WAS PRESENT, AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI HIMSELF TOOK PHONE TO ASSURE HIS TEHRAN FOLLOWERS THAT HE WOULD CONSULT WITH THEM BEFORE MAKING ANY ANNOUNCEMENTS ABOUT THE ISLAMIC COUNCIL OR MAKING ANY MAJOR STATEMENTS ABOUT GOVERNMENT. BOTH RELIGIOUS LEADERS HERE AND LMI (ENTEZAM) SAY THIS WILL AVOID ARRIVAL CONFRONTATION WITH BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT. (COMMENT: THEIR EVIDENT RELIEF REGARDING THE IMMEDIATE ARRIVAL MASKED THEIR CONCERNS OVER THE LONGER TERM. BOTH MINATCHI AND ENTEZAM, AS WELL AS OTHERS, SEEM VERY CONFIDENT THAT THE CONSENSUS BUILDING PROCESS WILL PRODUCE MODERATION ENOUGH TO CREATE A WORKABLE DEAL WITH THE PRIME MINISTER AND THE ARMY.
WE WOULD RAISE MORE CAVEATS, BUT CLEARLY KHOMEINI'S DECISION TO CONSULT BEFORE CONFRONTING IS AN IMPORTANT STEP IN THE RIGHT DIRECTION.)

BOTH MINATCHI AND SEPARATE SOURCE AROUND BAZARGAN WHO SPOKE TO BRITISH EVENING JAN 30 INDICATED THAT THERE REMAIN DETAILS OF ONGOING SECURITY FOR KHOMEINI PARTY WHICH HAVE NOT BEEN WORKED OUT. THESE ARE EXPECTED TO BE SUBJECT OF ADDITIONAL MEETINGS BETWEEN ARMY AND LMI DURING COURSE OF NEXT TWO DAYS. SULLIVAN
(C ENTIRE TEXT).

INTERMEDIARY KHOSRO EQBAL RETURNED LAMBRAKIS' CALL FROM PARIS MORNING JAN 31. HE SAID REPORT THAT JAM SAW KHOMEINI WAS FALSE. JAM HAD TRIED TO GET INTO TELEPHONE CONVERSATION WITH THE AYATOLLAH, BUT ARRANGEMENTS BROKE DOWN AT LAST MINUTE A COUPLE DAYS AGO, AND HE WAS NOT AWARE OF ANY NEW ARRANGEMENTS. THIS NEED NOT, OF COURSE, PREVENT CONTACT BETWEEN EMBASSY LONDON AND GENERAL JAM WHICH IS USEFUL IN ITSELF FOR THE LONG RUN.

EQBAL SAYS GENERAL TWITCHELL INVITED HIM TO COME IN FOR A TALK WHENEVER HE WAS IN WASHINGTON. EQBAL WOULD LIKE TWITCHELL TO KNOW THAT HE PLANS TO ARRIVE IN WASHINGTON EVENING FEB 9, STAYING AT WATERGATE HOTEL. HE HOPES FOR AN APPOINTMENT WITH TWITCHELL MONDAY, FEBRUARY 12. SULLIVAN

1.ON THE MORNING OF JANUARY 30, PRESS ATTACHE VISITED TEHRAN UNIVERSITY AND SURROUNDING ENVIRONS OF THE 24TH OF ESFAND SQUARE. THE IMPRESSION IS ONE OF GLOOM MIXED WITH A CARNIVAL LIKE ATMOSPHERE. THE UNIVERSITY, KNOWN AS THE FIRST CENTER OF HIGHER LEARNING IN IRAN WITH ITS ATTRACTIVE AMBIANCE OF LUSH GREEN GARDENS IN THE MIDST OF THE CITY, HAS TURNED INTO A BAZAAR, WITH HAWKERS AND VENDORS OF VARIOUS GOODS AND FOOD PRODUCTS, AS WELL AS THE POLITICAL FORUM FOR THE OPPOSITION.

2.BEFORE ONE REACHES THE UNIVERSITY THE WALLS ON SHAH REZA STREET ARE PAINTED AND DISFIGURED WITH PICTURES RIDICULING THE SHAH, CURSING HIS "STOOGE" BAKHTIAR, AND FILLED WITH ANNOUNCEMENTS DECLARING THE PREEMINENCE OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, CALLING FOR HIS RETURN AND ESTABLISHMENT OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. CLOSE TO THE UNIVERSITY PLACARDS ARE DISPLAYED WITH INSTRUCTIONS ON HOW TO CONSTRUCT AND USE THE "G-3" RIFLE AND MOLOTOV COCKTAIL. GROUPS OF PEOPLE ASSEMBLE IN FRONT OF THE POSTERS CAREFULLY READING THE INSTRUCTIONS CALLING ON THEM TO ORGANIZE CORES OF "RAZMANDEH", I.E. GUERILLAS TO ATTACK THE REGIME.
OTHER SIGNS INVITE AUDIENCES TO ATTEND LECTURES OF FORMER POLITICAL PRISONERS WHO WERE RECENTLY RELEASED OR THOSE OF THE RELATIVES OF EXECUTED POLITICAL PRISONERS.

ON ENTERING THE MAIN GATE OF THE UNIVERSITY THE CROWDS BECOME IMPASSABLE, THE KHOMEINI SIGNS MORE BLATANT AND LARGE, WITH VOLUNTARY GUIDES DIRECTING PEOPLE INTO THE UNIVERSITY WHILE CLEARING OUT FOOD VENDORS. BOOKS DISPLAYED ALONG THE FLOOR LEADING TO THE ENTRANCE ARE A VARIETY OF EITHER THE LEFTIST OR THE RADICAL RELIGIOUS GENRE.

THE CAMPUS IS A FULL BLOWN VAUDEVILLE ACT WITH CLERGY LEADING SMALL PACKS OF RAG-TAG MEN AND WOMEN COMING AT YOU AND SIMULTANEOUSLY CROWDS MILLING IN AND ABOUT THE UNIVERSITY MOSQUE, ONCE A FINE EXAMPLE OF MODERN IRANIAN ARCHITECTURE, PAINTED OVER WITH SIGNS ANTIREGIME SIGNS, LISTENING TO A RECORDED TAPE OF A FORMER ISFAHANI TEACHER RAILING AGAINST THE BRUTALITY OF SAVAK. TREES SURROUNDING THE VARIOUS FACULTIES ARE USED AS A FORUM FOR THE ENTIRE SPECTRUM OF ANTI-REGIME ORGANIZATIONS, SUCH AS THE TUDEH THE MUJAHEDDIN THE NATIONAL ORGANIZATION OF UNIVERSITY PROFESSORS AND THE IRANIAN ISLAMIC PROFESSORS COUNCIL.

THE WALLS OF THE FACULTIES ARE COVERED WITH LARGER THAN LIFE PICTURES OF KHOMEINI AND MILITANT SLOGANS, ESPECIALLY THOSE OF THE UNIVERSITY AND RELIGIOUS LEADERS STAGING THEIR SITIN UNTIL THE RETURN OF THE AYATOLLAH.

ADJACENT TO THE UNIVERSITY IS THE 24TH OF ESFAND SQUARE, THE WALLS OF WHICH ARE COVERED WITH BLOODIED NEWSPAPERS, MAKESHIFT SHRINES OF ROSES AND BITS OF CLOTHING, EVIDENCE OF THE TERROR AND FEROCITY WHICH PREVAILED IN THE RECENT CLASHES. STORES AND BUILDINGS SURROUNDING THE SQUARE ARE BLACKENED WITH SMOKE, RIDDLED WITH BULLET HOLES.BUT LIFE GOES ON WITH STREET HAWKERS SELLING BLUE JEANS ON THE SIDEWALK IN FRONT OF CLOSED SHOPS, ONE OF WHICH WAS A LIQUOR STORE, BROKEN INTO AND WREAKING OF ALCOHOL. THE SQUARE NO LONGER HAS THE STATUE OF SHAH BUT A LARGE COLORED PHOTO OF KHOMEINI DOMINATING THE HORIZON.
THE AREA CONTINUES TO LOOK LIKE A FIRE LOOKING FOR A MATCH.
ALTHOUGH PRESS ATTACHE COULD BE PERCEIVED AS A FOREIGNER HE WAS NOT SUBJECT TO PERSONAL ABUSE OR ATTRACTED NO SPECIAL ATTENTION. SHELLENBERGER
01445, (D) TEHRAN 01521, (E) STATE 025573 (C-ENTIRE TEXT.)

EMBASSY IS MOST GRATEFUL FOR PROMPT JAN. 30 TELCON RESPONSE TO REF D. IMMEDIATELY THEREAFTER EMBOFF CALLED MINISTER PIRASTEH OUT OF CABINET MEETING AND CONVEYED THE PRELIMINARY DENIAL OF THE RUMOR THAT THE FEDERAL RESERVE HAD TAKEN ACTION AGAINST IRANIAN ACCOUNTS. HE WAS MOST APPRECIATIVE. WE MAY HAVE AVERTED GOI CONCERN WHICH COULD HAVE PROVIDED GRIST LOCAL MEDIA.

ASAP JAN. 31, EMBOFF RELAYED REF E TO PIRASTEH. HE EXPRESSED DEEP APPRECIATION FOR DR. VOLKER'S CALL THE PREVIOUS NIGHT AND AGREED WITH HIS JUDGMENT THAT ANY PRESS RELEASE BY THE USG WOULD BE INADVISABLE. WHILE MOLIFIED CONCERNING ANY USG ACTION, HE SAID HE TOLD DR. VOLKER U.S. BANKS, PARTICULARLY CHASE AND CITIBANK, WERE STILL MAKING IT IMPOSSIBLE FOR IRAN'S COMMERCIAL BANKS TO OPERATE. WHEN ASKED CONCERNING EFFORTS TO FIND SOME MECHANISM FOR MEETING AT LEAST THE GOI'S EXTERNAL DEBT SERVICE, HE SAID HE WAS WORKING ON IT BUT THAT IT WOULD TAKE A MINIMUM OF 7 TO 10 DAYS.

EMBOFF MENTIONED HAVING LEARNED THAT CBI'S NADERI MISSION TO FOREIGN COMMERCIAL BANKS WAS SCRAPPED JAN. 31 AND PIRASTEH SAID NADERI WAS NEEDED AT THE CBI BUT MELLI PRESIDENT SHORAKA WOULD LEAVE ASAP, PRESUMABLY WITH THE ORIGINAL ITINERARY OF FRANKFURT, LONDON AND NEW YORK. EMBOFF REFERRED TO AN ARTICLE IN THE JAN. 31 PRESS SAYING THAT THE STRIKE COMMITTEE HAD AUTHORIZED THE REOPENING OF BANK MELLI FOR LIMITED SERVICES AND ASKED IF IT WERE SO (BY THAT TIME WE COULD FINE NOONE WORKING AT THE MAIN MELLI BRANCH).
PIRASTEH SAID IT WAS HIS DOING, THAT HE HAD ASKED THE COMMITTEE TO RESCIND THE STRIKE SO AT LEAST PAYROLLING THROUGH MELLI COULD OCCUR AND PERSONAL HARDSHIPS AVERTED.

COMMENT: (A) PIRASTEH'S CONCERN OVER FEDERAL RESERVE ATTACHMENTS: AS FURTHER BACKGROUND TO CONVERSATION REPORTED IN REF D, EMBOFF TRIED TO DISSUADE PIRASTEH FROM ANY CREDENCE IN THE RUMOR OF FED ATTACHMENTS BY ARGUING THE LEGAL REALITIES CONFIRMED IN REF E. WE ARE FRANKLY AMAZED THAT HAVING BEEN A SR. V.P. WITH CHASE IN NY HE COULD BE IGNORANT OF BASIC U.S. BANKING LAWS. WE ARE INCLINED TO BELIEVE THAT A COMBINATION OF THE STRESSES HE IS FACING PLUS SOME CONVENIENT POSTURING (REFLECTING ALSO HIS CHASE/IBI PROBLEMS) EXPLAIN HIS IMPASSIONED QUERY AND PROTEST, PARTICULARLY SINCE A CHASE REP HAD DENIED THE RUMOR TO HIM ON JAN. 29 (REF C).

(B) CRITICISM OF U.S. BANKS BY PIRASTEH REFLECTS IN LARGE PART HIS TENSIONS WITH CHASE DUE TO HIS RELATIONSHIP WITH THE INTERNATIONAL BANK OF IRAN, OF WHICH HE IS STILL PRESIDENT. AS REPORTED IN REF B, PARA 3, HE IS SOMEWHAT COMPROMISED AS MINISTER BY THAT CONTINUING RESPONSIBILITY AS WELL AS LONG-STANDING DIFFERENCES WITH CHASE. CHASE REPS HERE REPORTED HIS ANGER WHEN IBI COULD NOT MAKE GOOD ON MORRISON-KNUDSEN AND GTE WITHDRAWAL REQUESTS TO MEET LOCAL RIAL OBLIGATIONS OWING TO INADEQUATE FUNDS, AGAINST WHICH THESE WITHDRAWALS WOULD BE MADE, IN ITS ACCOUNT WITH CHASE IN NY.

(BOTH FIRMS HAD MADE DEPOSITS TO THE IBI/ CHASE ACCOUNT IN NY BUT SINCE THEY DID NOT PROVIDE INSTRUCTIONS THAT THE DEPOSITS WERE SPECIFICALLY TO MEET IMMINENT WITHDRAWAL NEEDS IN IRAN, CHASE MERELY APPLIED THEM TO THE ACCOUNT AND THE $4.25 MILLION DEPOSITED BROUGHT THE ACCOUNT INTO A $0.3 MILLION POSITIVE BALANCE). (C) EXTERNALIZING THE CBI'S PAYMENTS: CHASE REPS IN EARLY DECEMBER (SEE REF A) URGED MEAF AND CBI TO CREATE A MECHANISM FOR MEETING EXTERNAL OBLIGATIONS. THE RESPONSE WAS THAT NOTHING AS DRASTIC AS EXTERNALIZING THE TEST KEYS WAS THEN JUSTIFIED AND AN ALTERNATIVE METHOD OF OPEN TELEX AND TELEPHONE CONFIRMATION WAS INSTITUTED.

SINCE THEN WE HAVE REPORTED THAT FIRST THE CBI STRIKES, INCLUDING THOSE POSSESSING THE TEST KEY, BLOCKED ANY GOI TRANSACTIONS AND THEN, AFTER THE CBI MOVED FUNDS THROUGH BANK MELLI AS AN ALTERNATIVE, BANK MELLI EMPLOYEES STOPPED WHAT WAS A CIRCUMVENTION OF THEIR CBI COLLEAGUES STRIKE. NOW IT WOULD SEEM VIRTUALLY IMPOSSIBLE TO EXTERNALIZE THE TEST KEY, IF FOR NO OTHER REASON THAN THE OFFICIALS INVOLVED WOULD BE HIGHLY VULNERABLE TO THE THREATS OF THE STRIKERS. A SENIOR CBI OFFICIAL AGREED THAT A MORE PROBABLE SOLUTION WOULD BE TO AUTHORIZE A TEAM OF CBI OFFICIALS TO GO, E.G.

TO NEW YORK WITH A SPECIFIED PAYMENTS PACKAGE AND MAKE DISBURSEMENTS FROM CBI ACCOUNTS WITH THE MAJOR CLEARING BANKS. ------------------126894 311331Z /50 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 3566 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 01562 (D) MEDIATION WITH STRIKE COMMITTEE: WE HAVE LEARNED THAT KHERADJOU AND MEHDI SAMI'I MET WITH SAHABI, KHOMEINI'S REPRESENTATIVE AND HEAD OF THE STRIKE COMMITTEE, JAN. 30 AND TRIED TO CONVINCE HIM OF THE CRISIS PROPORTIONS OF THE BANK STRIKE, BOTH DOMESTIC AND FOREIGN. THERE IS HOPE THE STRIKE WILL MELT, BUT ALL BETS ARE STILL ON WITH IRAN ON THE EVE OF KHOMEINI'S RETURN.
THE CENTRAL BRANCH OF BANK MELLI DID GET ENOUGH WORKERS IN BY MID MORNING JAN. 31 TO RESUME LIMITED OPERATIONS. WE HAVE CONFIRMATION THAT EVEN A FEW FOREIGN EXCHANGE TRANSACTIONS ARE BEING DONE.
SEPTELS WILL PROVIDE MONETARY SIT-REP FOR JANUARY 31 AND RAISE QUESTIONS CONCERNING THE POTENTIAL FOR LEGAL ACTIONS AGAINST COMMERCIAL AND CBI ACCOUNTS IN THE U.S.

1979TEHRAN01563.subject: CONTACT WITH OPPOSITION GENERAL VALIOLLAH QARANI

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: LEADING OPPOSITIONIST, WHO HAS JUST SURFACED, PRESENTS PROPOSS FOR COMPROMISE BETWEEN KHOMEINI AND BAKHTIAR WHICH APPEAR TO US TO BE NON-STARTERS. HE IS WILLING TO DISCUSS FURTHER, AND MEANWHILE SAYS HE AND THE OTHERS ARE COUNSELING MODERATION ON KHOMEINI. END SUMMARY

AT GENERAL QARANI'S REQUEST, POL COUNSELOR MET WITH HIM LATE AFTERNOON JAN 30. HE BEGAN WITH CLAIM HE IS ONE OF THE SEVEN MEMBERS OF KHOMEINI'S ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL. THE OTHERS ARE BAZARGAN, DR. SAHABI, AHMAD SEHJAVADI, RETIRED GENERAL MASSOUDI, ENG. (FNU) KATIRAI (WHO WAS ON OIL STRIKE COMMITTEE WITH BAZARGAN), AND PERHAPS DR. ABBAS SHEYBANI (AN OLD OPPOSITIONIST) WHO IS AT THE MOMENT OUTSIDE THE COUNTRY. QARANI, WHO WORKED PARTLY WITH THE HELP OF AN INTERPRETER, MR.

MOHSEN TAHERPOUR, RECOUNTED HIS ROLE IN HELPING ROOT OUT TUDEH RING IN ARMED FORCES IN THE 1950S AND HIS PARTICIPATION IN TWO COUPS D'ETAT IN THE 1950S AND AGAIN IN 1964, WHEN HE SAID HE WAS SAVED FROM EXECUTION BY AMERICAN INTERVENTION. (COMMENT: SOURCE CLOSE TO QARANI HAS SUBSEQUENTLY TOLD US QARANI PLOTTED AGAINST THE SHAH BUT HAD NO TROOPS AT HIS COMMAND. THEREFORE, THESE WERE HARDLY COUPS D'ETAT. HE WAS SENTENCED TO THREE YEARS IN PRISON ON EACH OCCASION AND SERVED THEM. OUR FILES TEND TO BEAR THIS OUT.) QARANI TALKED AT LENGTH ABOUT THE STRENGTH OF THE MOSLEM MOVEMENT, WHICH HAS THE SUPPORT OF THE PEOPLE.
WITH THE DOCTRINE OF ALI SHARIATI THEY ARE STRONGER TODAY THAN THE COMMUNISTS. THEY CAN "CUT THE COMMUNIST ROOTS IN IRAN."

IN RESPONSE TO A VARIETY OF QUESTIONS, HE DESCRIBED THE MOVEMENT, AS INVOLVING SOME 15 TO 20 THOUSAND FOLLOWERS AT PRESENT, MOST OF THEM WELL GROUNDED IN THE PHILISOPHY OF SHI'IA RELIGION, WHO CAN SPREAD IT TO MANY MORE ONCE THEY ARE IN CHARGE OF THE GOVT. KHOMEINI DOES NOT INTEND TO BE A DICTATOR. THE MOVEMENT BELIEVES IN FREEDOM AND EQUALITY. THE GOVT OF THE NEW ISLAMIC REPUBLIC WILL BE RUN BY CIVILIANS NOT MULLAHS. IT AIMS TO CREATE A PEOPLE WHO UNDERSTAND RELIGION AND DEMOCRACY. IT WILL HAVE A PARLIAMENT ELECTED IN FREE ELECTIONS AFTER ADEQUATE TIME FOR PROPAGANDA ON RELIGION.

REASON FOR TERMING THE REPUBLIC "ISLAMIC" IS BOTH TO SATISFY THE BELIEVERS IN THE MOVEMENT AND TO PREVENT THE COMMUNISTS FROM COMING INTO THE COUNTRY. THE SEVEN MAN COUNCIL WILL APPOINT A GOVT. SOME OF THE COUNCIL MEMBERS MIGHT MOVE OVER TO THE GOVT, IN WHICH CASE THEY WILL BE REPLACED BY OTHERS. THE COUNCIL WILL THEN CONTINUE TO SERVE IN AN ADVISORY CAPACITY. KHOMEINI WILL REMAIN IN THE BACKGROUND TO BE CONSULTED ONLY ON THE MOST IMPORTANT QUESTIONS. THE OTHER MULLAHS WILL GO BACK TO THEIR NORMAL WORK, NOT BE INVOLVED IN THE GOVT.

QARANI SAID THAT, WITH IRAN'S LONG BORDER ON THE SOVIET UNION, ANY GOVT WOULD HAVE TO BE CRAZY NOT TO REALIZE IT NEEDS THE SUPPORT OF THE WEST. THE MOVEMENT IN FACT NEEDS THE WEST'S SUPPORT TO HELP IN MAKING A PEACEFUL TRANSITION TO AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. HE CLAIMED THAT IN EARLY 1960S, WHEN THE SHAH WANTED SOMEONE TO RUN LAND REFORM, QARANI, BAGHAI, AND ALI AMINI WERE THREE CANDIDATES TO LEAD THE GOVT. SHAH CHOSE AMINI. SHAH HAD CALLED HIM TWICE IN RECENT MONTHS TO ASK HIS ASSISTANCE IN THE POLITICAL ARENA BUT QARANI REFUSED. NOW, HE HAD TWO PROPOSALS TO OFFER.

THE FIRST IS THAT AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI WILL RETURN. HE WILL NAME THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL AFTER ARRIVAL. BAKHTIAR WILL RESIGN AND BE GIVEN A VERY HIGH POSITION BY THE AYATOLLAH. U.S. WILL ASSIST IN GETTING 4 OR 5 GENERALS TO RESIGN AND LEAVE THE COUNTRY. THESE ARE GENERALS WHO ARE IN CONSTANT TOUCH WITH THE SHAH AND COULD DECIDE ON AN INTERVENTION ON THEIR OWN AUTHORITY NEVER ASKING GHARABAGHI OR THE GOVT. HE MENTIONED KHOSROWDAD, RABII, BADREI, JAFARIAN AND NESHAT. THE MOVEMENT WILL FIND MONEY TO COMPENSATE THE GENERALS FOR ANY PROPERTY THEY LEAVE BEHIND.

SECOND ALTERNATIVE PROPOSAL QARANI MADE WAS THAT AFTER "SUBJECT TEL REISSUED WITH REMOVAL/DOWNGRADED STADIS CAPTION, PER STATE 027196. ------------------029580 020207Z /70 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 3568 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 01563 EXDIS RETURN OF KHOMEINI AND APPOINTMENT OF A COUNCIL, THE COUNCIL WILL CALL FOR A REFERENDUM ON THE FUTURE OF THE COUNTRY AND ADMINISTER IT. BAKHTIAR GOVT CAN SEND OBSERVERS. THE KEY GENERALS MUST LEAVE, AND THE MOVEMENT WILL COMPENSATE THEM FINANCIALLY TO GET THEM TO LEAVE IF NECESSARY. BAKHTIAR MAY LATER GET A GOOD JOB.

POL COUNSELOR EXPLAINED THE PROBLEM WITH BOTH PROPOSALS IS THAT IT SEEMS TO WORRY PRIMARILY ABOUT FINDING A JOB FOR BAKHTIAR AND NEGLECTS THE IMPORTANCE OF THE ARMY AND CONSTITUTIONAL PROCESS IN MAKING ANY CHANGES. QARANI SEIZED THIS POINT, BUT ARGUED FOR SOME FACESAVING GESTURE IN VIEW OF KHOMEINI HAVING SAID BAKHTIAR IS ILLEGAL. AFTER SOME DISCUSSION HE AGREED THAT BAKHTIAR COULD NOT ALLOW A REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL TO RUN A REFERENDUM, SINCE BY THAT ACT HE WOULD BE ABDICATING HIS GOVERNMENTAL AUTHORITY. HIS READINESS TO CONSENT TO A REFERENDUM WAS A CONCESSION IN ITSELF. INSTEAD OF ARGUING WHO SHOULD RUN THE REFERENDUM, THE TWO SIDES SHOULD CONSIDER RUNNING IT JOINTLY.

WHEN QARANI RAISED SOME PROCEDURAL PROBLEMS TO THE HONESTY OF ANY REFERENDUM, AND THE PROBLEMS OF CLASHES BETWEEN GOVT AND OPPOSITION SUPPORTERS IN THE PROVINCES, POL COUNSELOR SUGGESTED THIS WAS SOMETHING THAT COULD BE WORKED OUT BETWEEN KHOMEINI'S AND BAKHTIAR'S PEOPLE ONCE THE MAIN PRINCIPLES WERE AGREED ON. QARANI AGREED.

QARANI STRESSED NEED FOR SPEED, SUGGESTING A REFERENDUM MIGHT BE HELD IN ONE OR TWO WEEKS AFTER KHOMEINI'S RETURN. KHOMEINI'S MAIN LEVER IS THE STRIKES. HE WOULD LIKE TO GET THE COUNTRY BACK TO WORK IMMEDIATELY AFTER HE RETURNS, BUT DOES NOT WANT TO WAIT FOR MONTHS TO DECLARE THE REPUBLIC. HE DID NOT QUARREL WITH POL COUNSELOR'S REPETITION THAT THE ARMY WILL NOT STAND FOR A NON-CONSTITUTIONAL APPROACH TO A CHANGE IN IRAN'S CONSTITUTION, BUT WOULD HAVE NO CHOICE BUT TO TOLERATE A CONSTITUTIONAL CHANGE BASED ON THE VOTE OF THE PEOPLE. MOREOVER, USG COULD NOT BE PUT INTO A POSITION OF DICTATING SUCH A CHANGE.

THEREFORE THE CONSTITUTIONAL APPROACH HAD TO BE FOLLOWED. QUARANI MADE SOME COMMENTS ABOUT DIVISIONS IN THE ARMY, BUT READILY AGREED THAT THE ARMY HIGH COMMAND MAINTAINED SUFFICIENT STRENGTH TO MAKE ANY CIVIL WAR A VERY BLOODY BUSINESS. HE TOOK IN THE POINT THAT NO ONE COULD GUARANTEE THE ARMY WOULD FALL APART IF IT TRIED TO MOVE AGAINST KHOMEINI'S PEOPLE. THEREFORE IT IS INCUMBENT ON KHOMEINI'S PEOPLE TO BE A LITTLE PATIENT. QARANI RETURNED TO THE PROBLEM OF THE "4 GENERALS" (ALTHOUGH HE HAD MENTIONED 5) WHO MIGHT INTERVENE AT ANY TIME AND SHOULD THEREFORE BE GOTTEN OUT ASAP.
POL COUNSELOR SAID THIS WAS A PROBLEM WE WOULD HAVE TO THINK ABOUT.

QARANI'S EXPLANATION FOR THE EPISODE OVER BAKHTIAR'S ANNOUNCEMENT OF A VISIT TO KHOMEINI WAS THAT THE LETTER FROM BAKHTIAR PROPOSING THIS VISIT HAD DROPPED A WORD INVOLVING BAKHTIAR'S RESIGNATION, DESPITE AN AGREEMENT BAKHTIAR HAD MADE WITH MORTAZA MOTAHARI, ONE OF BEHESHTI'S PEOPLE, THAT THE LETTER WOULD INCLUDE THAT WORD. BESIDES, KHOMEINI HAD BEEN DELUGED WITH PHONE CALLS FROM PROMINENT MULLAHS HERE WHO OBJECTED TO HIS RECEIVING THE "ILLEGAL" PRIME MINISTER. (COMMENT: THIS IS NOT TOTALLY CONVINCING AND MAY BE A COVER-UP FOR WHATEVER HAPPENED.)

FINALLY, POL COUNSELOR REPEATED THE NEED FOR CALM AFTER KHOMEINI'S RETURN. IT WAS ESSENTIAL THAT KHOMEINI REFRAIN FOR A FEW DAYS FROM MAKING ANY ANNOUNCEMENTS UNTIL HE HAD HEARD THE MODERATE COUNSEL OF OTHERS IN THE COUNTRY. QARANI SAID SUCH MODERATE COUNSEL HAD BEEN GIVEN TO KHOMEINI, AND KHOMEINI HAD AGREED TO IT, BUT KHOMEINI MIGHT GET EMOTIONAL AFTER HIS ARRIVAL AND THE VISIT TO THE CEMETERY. HE ACCEPTED THE SUGGESTION THAT KHOMEINI'S SUPPORTERS IN THE COUNTRY SHOULD SURROUND HIM AND REMIND HIM OF THE NEED FOR CONSULTATION BEFORE HE MAKES PRONOUNCEMENTS.

HE WAS NOT VERY SPECIFIC ABOUT THE PARIS GROUP OF ADVISORS, ALTHOUGH HE SAID YAZDI WAS CLOSER TO KHOMEINI THAN GHOBZADEH. QARANI WAS GOING TO DISCUSS THINGS WITH BAZARGAN AND BEHESHTI AND GET BACK TO US. SULLIVAN "SUBJECT TEL REISSUED WITH REMOVAL/DOWNGRADED STADIS CAPTION" PER STATE 027196.

1979TEHRAN01576.subject: KHOMEINI ARRIVAL: MILITARY TALKS GOING WELL, FINAL ARRANGEMENTS SOLIDIFYING

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

DR. MINATCHI TOLD POLOFF AT NOON JAN 31 THAT TALKS BETWEEN GEN GHARABAGHI AND ENG. MEHDI BAZARGAN EVENING JAN 30 HAD BEEN VERY PRODUCTIVE. SOME SECURITY DETAILS FOR KHOMEINI PRESENCE IN TEHRAN FOR NEXT FEW DAYS REMAIN TO BE WORKED OUT, BUT THESE ARE CONSIDERED MINOR. MAJOR POINT WAS SPECIFIC GHARABAGHI ASSURANCE TO BAZARGAN THAT MILITARY WOULD NOT RPT NOT OPPOSE CHANGE, "EVEN CHANGES IN CABINET" AS LONG AS THEY WERE CARRIED OUT UNDER CONSTITUTIONAL LAW.

ACCORDING TO MINATCHI, WHO HAD LONG SESSION WITH BAZARGAN MORNING JAN 31, GHARABAGHI TOLD BAZARGAN THAT EVEN CHANGES IN CONSTITUTION WOULD BE ACCEPTABLE IF DONE IN ACCORDANCE WITH CONSTITUTIONAL LAW; ARMY WAS SWORN TO KEEP COUNTRY'S INDEPENDENCE AND RESPECT CONSTITUTION AND WANTS TO KEEP OUT OF POLITICS. GHARABAGHI REPORTEDLY SAID FORMER PRIME MINISTER SHARIF-EMAMI'S BIGGEST MISTAKE WAS TRYING TO INTERPOSE ARMY INTO POLITICS. (COMMENT: GRANTED OUR SOURCE HAS HIS OWN AXE TO GRIND AND MAY HAVE PUT BEST POSSIBLE LIGHT ON GHARABAGHI COMMENTS, IT SOUNDS LIKE MILITARY HAVE COME AROUND TO ACCEPTING KHOMEINI ARRIVAL AND ARE PREPARED TO COOPERATE WITH ISLAMIC MOVEMENT AS LONG AS CONSTITUTIONAL NORMS BE RESPECTED.

WE'RE NOT SURE IF GHARABAGHI'S APPARENT PASSING OVER OF ARMY'S OATH TO SHAH WAS MERELY EDITING BY OUR SOURCE OR SIMPLY NEW EMPHASIS SENIOR MILITARY ARE PUTTING ON ARMY'S MISSION. NET EFFECT ON POLITICAL SITUATION, HOWEVER, SEEMS TO BE POSITIVE.)

KHOMEINI ARRIVAL IS SET PER REFTELS. BOTH MINATCHI AND LIBERATION MOVEMENT SOURCE CONFIRMED PLANS ARE SET. MINATCHI SAID MILITARY WILL MAINTAIN AIRPORT SECURITY AND DELIVER KHOMEINI MOTORCADE TO SHAHYAD SQUARE, WHERE LIBERATION MOVEMENT SECURITY MARSHALLS WILL TAKEOVER. ARMY WILL APPARENTLY BE STANDING BY ROUTE ON MARCH TO BEHESHT-E-ZARAH CEMETARY, BUT NOT VERY VISIBLY. MINOR GLITCH HAS DEVELOPED WITH RESPECT TO THOSE WHO ARE TO GREET THE AYATOLLAH. APPARENTLY 1200 CARDS HAD BEEN ISSUED TO ALLOW ENTRANCE TO AIRPORT. MILITARY BALKED AT THIS, AND SAID GREETING HALL COULD HOLD AT MOST 50. ALL CARDS WILL BE CANCELLED, AND MASTER LIST DRAWN UP.

MINATCHI SAID VARIOUS OPPOSITIONISTS PARTICIPATED IN DRAWING UP LIST OF HUNDRED-PLUS NAMES FROM WHICH PRIME MINISTER WILL SELECT 50 TO GREET AYATOLLAH. WHEN QUESTIONED WHY BAKHTIAR WAS GIVEN SELECTION TASK, MINATCHI INTIMATED THAT KHOMEINI FOLLOWERS HAD HAD DIFFICULTY PARING LIST DOWN. THIS WAY, BAKHTIAR TAKES ONUS OF EXCLUDING SOME PEOPLE. (COMMENT: A BREAUTIFUL PERSIAN SOLUTION TO PROBLEM. THERE COULD, HOWEVER, BE SOME DIFFICULTY FROM THOSE EXCLUDED WHO DO NOT GET WORD. MINATCHI FELT THIS WOULD BE MANAGEABLE BY COMBINED OPPOSITIONIST-MILITARY COMMITTEE AT AIRPORT ENTRANCE.)
MINATCHI SAID KHOMEINI'S FAMILY WILL COME IN ON SAME PLANE AS AYATOLLAH AND LIVE IN HOUSE ON DOWLAT, AS
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY: KHOMEINI EXPECTED TO ARRIVE TOMORROW MORNING. OIL WORKERS DEMAND PLACE ON ISLAMIC COUNCIL. LARGE-SCALE UNREST CONTINUES. MILITARY SHOW OF FORCE IN TEHRAN. MOTLEY CROWD AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY CHEERS REPORT OF ATTACK ON MAJ. DAVIS. END SUMMARY.

SPECIAL COMMITTEE ARRANGING RETURN OF KHOMEINI ANNOUNCED HE WILL ARRIVE 9 A.M. TOMORROW. THIS IS CONFIRMED BY OTHER SOURCES. ACCORDING TO AN ARRANGEMENT WORKED OUT BY RELIGIOUS LEADERS AND THE MILITARY, TROOPS WILL PROVIDE SECURITY BETWEEN AIRPORT AND SHAHYAD MONUMENT. KHOMEINI'S OWN PEOPLE WILL PROVIDE SECURITY AFTER THAT. AS PREVIOUSLY INDICATED, KHOMEINI WILL GO TO BEHESHT-EZARA CEMETARY FOR HIS GREETING SPEECH, THEN SETTLE TEMPORARILY IN HIS HEADQUARTERS NEAR THE MAJLIS BUILDING. HE WILL IN THE NEAR FUTURE GO TO QOM, HIS FORMER HOME. WHILE THE SPECIFIC ISSUE OF HIS ARRIVAL APPEARS SETTLED, THE POLITICAL FUTURE REMAINS TROUBLED.

IF KHOMEINI MERELY BASKS IN THE AFFECTION OF THE MASSES FOR A TIME, HIS ARRIVAL MAY DEFUSE SITUATION. BUT IF HE SETS UP A RIVAL GOVT, THEN BAKHTIAR AND THE ARMY WILL HAVE TO MAKE A DECISION. UNDER THE ARRIVAL-DAY ARRANGEMENT, CROWDS ARE TO APPROACH NO CLOSER THAN SHAHYAD TO AIRPORT, AND WELCOMING GROUP WILL ATTEND BY INVITATION ONLY. WE UNDERSTAND AIRPORT WILL BE CLOSED FROM SUNRISE TO NOON, DISRUPTING TOMORROW'S EVACUATION FLIGHTS.

MEANWHILE MASSIVE PROTEST CONTINUES, AS KHOMEINI HAS ISSUED NO ORDER TO HALT OPERATIONS. YESTERDAY IN TEHRAN WORKERS FROM THREE MUNITIONS FACTORIES MARCHED IN SUPPORT OF ISLAMIC REPUBLIC AND TO PROCLAIM THEY HAD NOT INTENDED THEIR BULLETS TO BE USED AGAINST THE PEOPLE. CROWD, JOINED BY OTHERS FROM TEHRAN UNIVERSITY, CONFRONTED TROOPS AT SHAHREZA AND PAHLAVI, BUT TROOPS DID NOT FIRE AND CROWD DISPERSED. A LITTLE TO THE WEST, HOWEVER, MOBS "SEIZED" EISENHOWER AVE FOR THE SECOND DAY, ERECTING BURNING BARRICADES OF AUTOMOBILES AND RUBBISH.

MOTORCYCLE POLICEMAN WHO WAS PASSING BY NARROWLY ESCAPED PROBABLY FATAL ATTACK, AS CROWD BURNED HIS CYCLE, TOOK HIS PISTOL AND RADIO BUT FAILED TO GET HIM AFTER HE RAN INTO NEARBY SHOP, THEN ESCAPED VIA THE ROOFTOPS. MOB ALSO BURNED A BREWERY. CROWDS INCLUDING HOMAFARS MARCHED IN KERMANSHAH AND ZANJAN.

CAPITAL IS STILL A BIT SHAKEN BY THE ALMOST TOTAL DESTRUCTION OF SHAHR-E-NOW RED LIGHT DISTRICT MONDAY NIGHT. AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI IN A STATEMENT ISSUED YESTERDAY CALLED THE INCIDENT ANOTHER CONSPIRACY AGAINST THE ISLAMIC LIBERATION MOVEMENT, BLAMING GOVT AGENTS AND LOCAL HOOLIGANS FOR THE ATTACK' SO FAR WE HAVE NO REPORTS OF COLLISION WITH MOBS.

SIT-IN AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY GREW TO ABOUT 2,000 PEOPLE YESTERDAY. CLERGYMEN REPORTEDLY CONDEMNED THE NEAR-FATAL MOB ATTACK ON GENDARMERIE MAJ. GEN. ON MONDAY. ON THE OTHER HAND, TWO SEPARATE UNIVERSITY SOURCES HAVE TOLD EMBOFFS THAT SPEAKER AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY RALLY MORNING JAN 30 MENTIONED WOUNDING OF U.S. MAJOR DAVIS, WHICH WAS GREETED WITH CHEERS. SPEAKER THEN WENT ON TO CALL FOR REMOVAL OF ALL U.S.

MILITARY PERSONNEL BY FEB 27 (REASON ------------------128502 311507Z /50 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 3581 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY BONN AMEMBASSY CAIRO AMCONSUL DHAHRAN IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY DOHA AMCONSUL FRANKFURT AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS USLO PEKING AMEMBASSY RABAT USLO RIYADH IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY TOKYO USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 01580 FOR THIS DATE IS NOT KNOWN), AFTER WHICH THEY WOULD BE KILLED.

COMMENT WAS GREETED WITH APPROVAL BY CROWD, WHICH PASSED QUICKLY ON TO OTHER BUSINESS. (COMMENT: WHILE "LOVE NOTES" THREATENING DEATH OF AMERICANS AND AMERICAN MILITARY HAVE BEEN FEATURE OF IRANIAN SCENE FOR SOME TIME, TO EMBASSY'S KNOWLEDGE, THIS IS FIRST PUBLIC CALL FOR KILLING OF AMERICANS.) SOURCES DID NOT RPT NOT KNOW WHAT POLITICAL VIEWS SPEAKER REPRESENTED BUT NOTED THERE WERE RELIGIOUS MOVEMENT TYPES AS WELL AS RADICAL LEFTISTS ATTENDING MASS MEETING, WHICH DREW CROWD FROM MANY SECTORS INCLUDING UNEMPLOYED AND BAZAARIS, MANY OF THEM PROBABLY OUT-OF-TOWNERS COME TO GREET KHOMEINI ON HIS RETURN.
TODAY IN TEHRAN, DEMONSTRATORS ARE OUT AGAIN, BUT THE ARMY HAS PUT ON MASSIVE SHOW OF FORCE. LONG COLUMN INCLUDING EVERY KIND OF MOBILE WEAPON PARADED THROUGH TEHRAN FROM NORTH TO SOUTH.

RADIO MOSCOW HAS BROADCAST RATHER DETAILED ACCOUNT OF PROBLEMS MONDAY INVOLVING IRANIAN TROOPS GUARDING EMBASSY COMPOUND. KAYHAN PERSIAN CONTRIBUTES TO THE ANTI-AMERICAN WAVE THIS MORNING WITH CARTOON SHOWING AMERICAN FLAG WHICH HAS SKULLS INSTEAD OF STARS.

PEOPLE'S SACRIFICE GUERRILLAS (CHERIKS) HAVE CLAIMED CREDIT FOR AN ATTACK ON GENDARMERIE HDQ MONDAY NIGHT, SAYING A FEW TROOPS WERE KILLED AND INJURED. BUT PRESS REPORTS ATTACKERS MAY HAVE BEEN ONLY TWO IN NUMBER AND FIRED WHILE PASSING ON A MOTORBIKE.

EIGHT MORE MAJLES DEPUTIES HAVE SUBMITTED RESIGNATIONS TO MAJLIS SECRETARY, ALTHOUGH FOUR OF THESE TOLD SECRETARY TO HOLD RESIGNATIONS IN ABBEYANCE. TWENTY-THREE DEPUTIES HAD PREVIOUSLY RESIGNED, AND SOME OTHERS MAY HAVE INFORMED THE PRESS THEY WERE DOING SO WITHOUT ACTUALLY SUBMITTING LETTERS TO MAJLES SECRETARY.

PRESS REPORTS 50 HOMAFARS WHO REFUSED WORK DETAILS AT MEHRABAD AIRPORT LAST THURSDAY HAVE BEEN DISMISSED FROM THE FORCE. A GROUP OF OFFICERS AT SHAHROKI AIR BASE (THE NUMBER IS NOT GIVEN) HAVE ANNOUNCED THEY WILL PLAY NO PART IN A COUP D'ETAT.
IRAN AIR EMPLOYEHAVE INSTRUCTIONS FROM STRIKE COMMITTEE TO REPORT TO WORK TODAY, BUT THERE IS NO WORD ON RETURN OF THE AIRLINE TO SERVICE.
OIL FIELD WORKERS IN AN OPEN LETTER TO KHOMEINI HAVE ASKED TO BE REPRESENTED ON ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL, NOTING THAT PEOPLE FROM ALL WALKS OF LIFE HAVE CONTRIBUTED TO THE NATIONAL MOVEMENT.
CONSULATE TABRIZ REPORTS SITUATION QUIET. WE HAVE NOT REACHED SHIRAZ OR ISFAHAN. SULLIVAN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).
REFTEL, WHICH REPORTS BRIEFING SAUNDERS GAVE JAPANESE JANUARY 26, SPEAKS OF POSSIBILITY BAKHTIAR MAY "WORK OUT MATTERS WITH OPPOSITION, PERHAPS BY FURTHER BROADENING GOVERNMENT."

WE KNOW OF NO RPT NO MOVES BY BAKHTIAR IN DIRECTION OF BROADENING GOVERNMENT AND SEE NO RPT NO POSSIBILITY THAT KHOMEINI OPPOSITION WOULD ACCEDE TO SUCH IDEA. WOULD APPRECIATE CLARIFICATION OF WASHINGTON INFORMATION
KHOMEINI ARRIVAL (C - ENTIRE TEXT)

AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI ARRIVED ON SCHEDULE AT 0900 VIA AIR FRANCE CHARTER AT TEHRAN'S MEHRABAD AIRPORT. HE WAS MET BY SWOLLEN GROUP OF DIGNITARIES WELL EXCEEDING PLANNED NUMBER OF FIFTY WHICH SECURITY OFFICIALS HAD SOUGHT, BUT GROUP WAS QUIET AND WELL-ORGANIZED. LIVE T.V. COVERAGE OF DEBARKATION WAS PROVIDED,THOUGH NIRT WAS UNABLE TO BROADCAST SOUND FROM THE AIRPORT. ANNOUNCER, SPEAKING FROM NIRT STATION, SAID TOTAL OF 1,000 PEOPLE WERE INSIDE AIRPORT. TEHRAN RADIO CARRIED NO RPT NO WORD OF ARRIVAL AND WAS PLAYING ONLY MUSIC AS OF 11:00 A.M.

PROGRAM CAME ON SHORTLY BEFORE AYATOLLAHS' ARRIVAL WITH NORMAL LOGO. MOTTO AT BOTTOM, WHICH HAD HERETOFORE SAID "NATIONAL IRANIAN RADIO AND TELEVISION," WAS REPLACED WITH SENTENCE SAYING "THE SPRING BLOOMING OF IRAN." ANNOUNCER NOTED NIRT HAD SET UP COVERAGE AT AIRPORT, IN FRONT OF TEHRAN UNIVERSITY AND AT BEHESHT-E-ZARAH CEMETARY, WHERE KHOMEINI IS SCHEDULED TO SPEAK. TECHNICAL DIFFICULTIES PLAGUED ENTIRE 30-MINUTE BROADCAST, AND PROGRAM WAS PULLED OFF AIR JUST AS KHOMEINI ARRIVED AT TERMINAL AFTER DEPLANING. ANNOUNCER SAID LIVE COVERAGE WAS ENDING DUE TO TECHNICAL DIFFICULTIES, BUT ENTIRE PROGRAM WOULD BE FILMED AND SHOWN LATER (NO TIME GIVEN).

PROGRAM WAS THEN REPLACED WITH PICTURE OF SHAH AND USUAL CLOSING NATIONAL ANTHEM. QUICK CHECK OF SOURCES CLOSE TO MEDIA SUGGESTS PART OF "TECHNICAL DIFFICULTIES" MAY HAVE BEEN DUE TO TUSSLE BETWEEN OPPOSING GROUPS WITHIN NIRT, THE "SPRING BLOOMERS" VS SHAH LOYALISTS. WE UNDERSTAND GEN QARABAGHI AND OTHER TOP MILITARY COMMAND WERE FURIOUS AT WHAT HAPPENED, SUSPECTING SABOTAGE OF ARRANGEMENTS WORKED OUT BETWEEN ARMY/BAKHTIAR AND KHOMEINI PEOPLE.

INTERESTING SIDELIGHT TO TV COVERAGE WAS REPORTED BY EMBASSY LOCALS, WHO OBSERVED THAT WITHIN FIVE MINUTES OF ENDING OF TV COVERAGE, TRAFFIC IN DIRECTION OF PARADE ROUTE INCREASED DRAMATICALLY ON NORTH-SOUTH STREETS NEAR EMBASSY. CARS CONTINUE TO DRIVE BACK AND FORTH FLASHING THEIR LIGHTS AND HONKING.
AS OF 1100 HOURS TEHRAN TIME, THERE HAVE BEEN NO RPT NO REPORTS OF VIOLENCE. NIRT INTERNATIONAL STATION RESUMED NORMAL PROGRAMMING WITH POP MUSIC FOLLOWING

1979TEHRAN01617.subject: POSITION OF MILITARY IN CURRENT CRISIS

segments.text: (S - ENTIRE TEXT).

GENERALS HUYSER AND GAST HAVE SPENT CONSIDERABLE PERIODS OF TIME OVER THE PAST SEVERAL DAYS WITH THE SENIOR MILITARY OFFICERS COMMANDING THE IRANIAN ARMED FORCES. THEY HAVE SEEN THE VIEWS OF THESE OFFICERS EVOLVE RAPIDLY SINCE THE DEPARTURE OF THE SHAH.
IN DISCUSSIONS WITH THE LEADERSHIP JANUARY 31, HUYSER AND GAST WERE GIVEN A SYSTEMATIC SUMMARY OF THE MILITARY POSITION BY GENERAL GHARABAGHI.

THAT POSITION CAN BE SUMMARIZED AS FOLLOWS: - (A) THE MILITARY SUPPORT BAKHTIAR AND WILL FOLLOW HIS INSTRUCTIONS IN THE CURRENT CRISIS. - (B) IF BAKHTIAR WORKS OUT A POLITICAL DEAL WITH KHOMEINI, THE MILITARY WILL ALSO SUPPORT THAT, ON THE ASSUMPTION THAT IT WILL PROVIDE FOR SOME PEACEFUL WAY OUT OF THE CURRENT IMPASSE. - (C) IF KHOMEINI REFUSES TO WORK OUT A DEAL WITH BAKHTIAR AND SETS UP A RIVAL GOVERNMENT, THE MILITARY WILL TAKE UP DEFENSIVE POSITIONS TO PROTECT GOVERNMENT BUILDINGS AND INSTALLATIONS AND TO PREVENT THEIR TAKEOVER BY USURPERS. - (D) BEYOND THIS POINT, THE MILITARY HAVE NOT RPT NOT FORMULATED ANY DECISIONS.
THEY HAVE, OF COURSE, REVIEWED AND REFINED THEIR PLANS TO TAKE OVER ESSENTIAL OPERATIONS IF ORDERED, BUT INSIST THEY HAVE NO RPT NO THOUGHTS OF A SELF-GENERATED COUP.

FROM THIS DESCRIPTION OF THE MILITARY POSITION AND FROM THE ARRANGEMENTS THEY HAVE MADE WITH RESPECT TO TODAY'S RECEPTION OF KHOMEINI, IT IS CLEAR THAT THE MILITARY WISH TO POSTURE THEMSELVES DEFENSIVELY IN THE COMING POLITICAL CONFRONTATION. THEY WISH TO BE SEEN AS THE PROFESSIONAL DEFENDERS OF LAW AND ORDER RATHER THAN THE ENFORCERS. IN THIS WAY, THEY HOPE TO DEMONSTRATE THAT, IF THERE IS A BREAKDOWN, THEY WILL BE THE ONES WHO ARE ATTACKED RATHER THAN BEING THE ATTACKING FORCE.

ALTHOUGH THIS IS A SOUND POSITION, IT MAY BE DIFFICULT FOR THE MILITARY TO MAINTAIN IT AND FOR THE OUTSIDE WORLD TO PERCEIVE IT. SOVIET PROPAGANDA, WHICH IS INSISTENTLY BOMBARDING THE MILITARY (AND THE U.S.) IS MORE AND MORE BEING REFLECTED IN IRAN MEDIA AND IN THE MOOD OF THE GENERAL PUBLIC TOWARDS THE MILITARY. THIS, IN TURN, IS HAVING ITS EFFECT UPON THE MIDDLE AND LOWER LEVELS OF SERVICEMEN SO THAT THE PRIMORDIAL TASK OF PRESERVING THE INTEGRITY OF THE ARMED FORCES MAY SOON BECOME THE PARAMOUNT CONCERN OF THE MILITARY LEADERSHIP. SULLIVAN
(S - ENTIRE TEXT).

NOW THAT KHOMEINI HAS RETURNED TO TEHRAN AND ALL THE MAJOR IRANIAN PLAYERS IN THE CURRENT DRAMA ARE IN TOUCH WITH EACH OTHER, THIS CRISIS HAS ENTERED A NEW PHASE. IN THIS PHASE, THERE WILL BE PRECIOUS LITTLE THAT ANY FOREIGN ELEMENTS CAN DO TO INFLUENCE THE SITUATION. IN FACT, EFFORTS BY FOREIGNERS ARE VERY LIKELY TO BE COUNTERPRODUCTIVE.

ACCORDINGLY, I BELIEVE BEST POSTURE FOR U.S. TO ASSUME IS ONE THAT IS BENIGN AND RELATIVELY PASSIVE, IN WHICH WE MAINTAIN OUR CONTACTS WITH ALL ELEMENTS, CONTINUE TO COUNSEL MODERATION AND THE AVOIDANCE OF BLOODY CONFRONTATIONS, BUT RESIST THE TEMPTATION TO TRY TO MANIPULATE IRANIAN PASSIONS AND PERSONALITIES WHICH WE DO NOT FULLY COMPREHEND.

OUR CONTACTS WITH THE MILITARY SHOULD CONTINUE UNABATED, SINCE OUR SENIOR MILITARY OFFICERS ARE COLOCATED WITH THEIRS. INSOFAR AS THERE IS A GOVERNMENT, WE SHOULD ALSO BE ABLE TO CONTINUE REGULAR CONTACTS WITH THOSE OFFICIALS WHO ARE ABLE TO FUNCTION. WE SHOULD BEAR IN MIND, HOWEVER, THAT BAKHTIAR PERSONALLY MAY WISH TO PUT A LITTLE DISTANCE BETWEEN US AND HIS OWN EFFORTS TO NEGOTIATE SOME SORT OF MODUS VIVENDI WITH THE KHOMEINI FORCES.

THE MODERATE OPPOSITION FORCES WILL REMAIN OPEN TO US, BUT WILL INCREASINGLY BE EXTRUDED FROM POSITIONS OF SIGNIFICANCE IN THE LOCAL POLITICAL SCENE. THEY, TOO, MAY, AT A CERTAIN POINT, WISH TO MINIMIZE OVERT ASSOCIATION WITH US IF THE LOCAL SITUATION GETS MORE NASTY THAN IT IS.

THIS LEAVES US THE ISSUE OF THE KHOMEINI CAMP. WE WILL CONTINUE OUR ASSOCIATIONS WITH THOSE LOCAL KHOMEINI FOLLOWERS WHO HAVE BEEN POSITIVELY DISPOSED TOWARDS DEALING WITH US. WE WILL ALSO ATTEMPT TO HAVE OUR POLITICAL COUNSELOR PICK UP THE YAZDI CONTACT FROM PARIS, ON THE ASSUMPTION THAT YAZDI HAS ACCOMPANIED THE AYATOLLAH TO IRAN.

HOWEVER, THIS WILL LEAVE THREE QUESTIONS ON WHICH WE WILL EVENTUALLY NEED WASHINGTON GUIDANCE: - (A) THE FIRST CONCERNS KHOMEINI HIMSELF. IF HE ASKS TO SEE ME, OR IF, CONCEIVABLY, BAKHTIAR ASKS ME TO SEE HIM, I NEED TO KNOW WHAT MY REPLY SHOULD BE. - (B) THE SECOND CONCERNS THE PUTATIVE "ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL" WHICH KHOMEINI HAS VOWED TO ESTABLISH. BAKHTIAR HAS SAID HE WOULD REGARD THIS COUNCIL AS A "SORT OF POLITICAL PARTY" UNLESS IT ATTEMPTS TO USURP HIS EXECUTIVE AUTHORITY.

SINCE IT WILL PROBABLY CONTAIN A NUMBER OF OPPOSITIONISTS SUCH AS BAZARGAN WITH WHOM WE ARE ALREADY IN TOUCH, I WOULD ASSUME WE COULD HANDLE IT IN THE SAME VEIN BAKHTIAR PROPOSES. - (C) THE THIRD, WHICH NEED NOT RPT NOT BE ADDRESSED AT THIS TIME, CONCERNS ANY "PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT OF AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC" WHICH MAY BE ESTABLISHED BY THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL. SINCE THIS WOULD BE A RIVAL REGIME TO THE GOVERNMENT WHICH WE RECOGNIZE, I ASSUME WE WILL WISH TO AVOID ANY DEALINGS WITH IT WHICH COULD CARRY THE IMPLICATION OF RECOGNITION.

ONCE AGAIN, HOWEVER, WE MAY FACE THE SITUATION IN WHICH SUCH A "GOVERNMENT" WOULD CONTAIN PERSONS WITH WHOM WE HAVE REGULARLY BEEN IN CONTACT. I WOULD HOPE THIS PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT MAY NEVER COME INTO BEING AND WOULD SUGGEST WASHINGTON DEFER GUIDANCE ON THIS POINT UNTIL OR UNLESS WE SEE SUCH AN

1979TEHRAN01631.subject: (C) SECOND MEETING WITH GEN. VALIOLLAH QARANI

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: KHOMEINI SUPPORTER CONFIRMS REPORT THAT KHOMEINI HAS AGREED TO MAKE NO ANNOUNCEMENT OF AN ISLAMIC COUNCIL ON DAY OF ARRIVAL AND WILL WAIT TO CONSULT WITH HIS IN-COUNTRY FOLLOWERS. HE COMPLAINS ABOUT INFLEXIBILITY ON BAKHTIAR'S PART AND DWELLS ON THE NEED TO GET RID OF A HALF DOZEN TOP GENERALS TO ASSURE THAT THE ARMY DOES NOT PULL A COUP IN THE NEAR FUTURE OR AT THE TIME OF A REFERENDUM. END SUMMARY

IN A SECOND MEETING WITH POL COUNSELOR AFTERNOON JAN 31, GENERAL QARANI ANNOUNCED THAT THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL HAD MET NIGHT BEFORE AND THAT MORNING. HE COULD ASSURE US KHOMEINI HAS AGREED TO MAKE NO ANNOUNCEMENTS ON THE FIRST DAY, NOT EVEN AN ANNOUNCEMENT OF THE COUNCIL. HE WISHED TO TAKE SOUNDINGS FROM HIS FOLLOWERS IN THE COUNTRY FOR A COUPLE OF DAYS. (COMMENT: WE HAD ALREADY HEARD THIS FROM LMI SOURCES.) QARANI SAID THE COUNCIL HAD ALSO DISCUSSED THE BASIC PROPOSITION OF A CONSTITUTIONAL PROCESS TO ACHIEVE THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC AS OPPOSED TO ITS INSTITUTION BY KHOMEINI PRONOUNCEMENT.

HE CLAIMED 4 OUT OF THE 7 MEMBERS OF THE COUNCIL AGREED ON THE IMPORTANCE OF THE CONSTITUTIONAL APPROACH. THE OTHER THREE AND A MULLAH REPRESENTATIVE DISAGREED. THE FINAL DECISION WILL OF COURSE BE UP TO THE AYATOLLAH HIMSELF BUT THE QUESTION WILL BE CONTINUED TO BE DISCUSSED AT FUTURE MEETINGS INCLUDING ONE LATER THAT DAY -- OF THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL TOGETHER WITH A COUNCIL OF MULLAHS.

QARANI COMPLAINED ABOUT STUBBORNESS AND INFLEXIBILITY ON BAKHTIAR'S PART IN HIS DISCUSSIONS WITH KHOMEINI'S PEOPLE. HE IS NOT LISTENING. SIX OF HIS MINISTERS HAVE TOLD KHOMEINI'S PEOPLE THAT THEY ARE WILLING TO RESIGN, BUT IN A MEETING OF THE CABINET BAKHTIAR THREATENED THEM SO THEY ARE AFRAID TO. QARANI ASKED IF THERE WAS ANYTHING USG COULD DO TO MAKE BAKHTIAR MORE FLEXIBLE. FOR ONE THING, PRESIDENT CARTER'S PUBLIC REQUEST THAT KHOMEINI SUPPORT BAKHTIAR WAS A GOOD EXAMPLE OF U.S. BOLSTERING BAKHTIAR'S STUBBORNESS. IT MIGHT HAVE BEEN A GOOD IDEA THEN, BUT THE PRESENT SITUATION SHOULD BE REEXAMINED AS TO WHETHER THAT KIND OF SUPPORT FOR BAKHTIAR IS STILL INDICATED.

POL COUNSELOR REPLIED THAT AS FAR AS WE ARE AWARE BAKHTIAR IS STICKING TO THE CONSTITUTION. THIS IS AN APPROACH WE SUPPORT. IF BAKHTIAR'S "INFLEXIBILITY" EXTENDED TO MATTERS NOT HAVING TO DO WITH THE CONSTITUTION WE WOULD OF COURSE BE HAPPY TO KNOW ABOUT THEM.

QARANI DWELT ON THE SITUATION IN THE ARMY. HE WONDERED WHY THERE HAS BEEN THE SHOW OF FORCE THAT DAY IN TEHRAN, WITH MANY SOLDIERS SHOUTING "LONG LIVE THE KING." HE SAID MOST OF THE RELIGIOUS PEOPLE AND EVEN POLITICIAN MEMBERS OF THE COUNCIL HAVE HAD LITTLE TO DO WITH THE ARMY AND DO NOT APPRECIATE ITS POWER. THEY THINK THEY CAN HANDLE ALL OF IT ONCE KHOMEINI RETURNS, EXCEPT FOR THE IMPERIAL GUARD. QARANI IS TRYING TO EXPLAIN REALITIES TO THEM, HE SAID.

HE CLAIMED THAT SOME 40 OR 50 HIGH ARMY OFFICIALS HAVE QUIETLY APPROACHED THE MOVEMENT TO EXPLAIN THAT THEY WILL NOT RESIST KHOMEINI AND ARE NOT KILLERS. THEY COMPLAIN ABOUT A SMALL GROUP OF TOP OFFICERS WHO ARE SUSPECTED OF SECRETLY PLOTTING. TOUFANIAN, GHARABHAGHI,THE HEADS OF THE THREE SERVICES AND MOGHADDAM MEET SECRETLY EVERY DAY. THIS WORRIES THE OTHERS. POL COUNSELOR REPLIED THAT IT IS WISE TO REMAIN AWARE OF THE POWER AND DEDICATION OF THE ARMY.

THESE DAILY MEETINGS ARE PROBABLY POLICY DECISIONS CONNECTED WITH THE TALKS GHARABHAGHI AND MOGHADDAM ARE HAVING WITH THE KHOMEINI PEOPLE, JUST AS THE KHOMEINI REPRESENTATIVES IN THOSE TALKS COME BACK TO REPORT TO PEOPLE LIKE QARANI.

QARANI PURSUED THIS LINE. HE ASKED IF USG COULD NOT BE USEFUL IN BRINGING BACK GENERAL JAM IN SOME CAPACITY. QARANI KNEW THE TOP OFFICERS SINCE MANY OF THEM HAD SERVED UNDER HIM IN THE PAST. MOST OF THEM HAD BEEN INTRODUCED TO THE KING BY GENERAL FARDUST. HE SAID KHOMEINI'S PEOPLE FELT BAKHTIAR WAS NOT IN CONTROL OF THEM BUT HE CALLED THE SHOTS AND BAKHTIAR FOLLOWED. OTHERWISE WHY WAS GENERAL JAFFARIAN REINSTATED IN KHUZESTAN AFTER BEING PUBLICLY REMOVED BY BAKHTIAR?

(COMMENT: HE WAS REMOVED ONLY FROM HIS MILITARY COMMAND NOT AS MILITARY GOVERNOR.) KHOMEINI PEOPLE ARE AFRAID THE SHAH HAS TOLD THE ARMY TO SUPPORT BAKHTIAR ONLY AS LONG AS HE DOES NOT MOVE TOWARD A REFEREN------------------020640 011307Z /41 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 3612 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 01631 EXDIS DUM OR SOME OTHER MEANS OF REMOVING THE MONARCHY. BESIDES, NOW THAT THE SHAH APPEARS TO BE ANGRY WITH THE U.S., WHAT IS TO PREVENT HIM FROM SENDING ORDERS FOR A MILITARY COUP NOW OR AT THE TIME OF THE REFERENDUM? MIGHT NOT THE IMPERIAL GUARD MOVE EVEN IF THE OTHERS DO NOT?

POL COUNSELOR REPEATED THAT HE WAS OPERATING UNDER THE INSTRUCTIONS THAT AS LONG AS CHANGES WERE KEPT WITHIN CONSTITUTIONAL PROCESSES THE ARMY, INCLUDING THE IMPERIAL GUARD, WOULD NOT MOVE. QARANI AGAIN ASKED THAT POL COUNSELOR INVESTIGATE WHAT MIGHT BE DONE ABOUT THESE TOP GENERALS. POL COUNSELOR ACCEPTED THE TASK, NOTING HOWEVER, THAT THIS WAS A SENSITIVE AREA; BESIDES, TIMING WOULD BE IMPORTANT SO AS NOT TO PRECIPITATE THE VERY MOVE KHOMEINI'S PEOPLE ARE SEEKING TO PREVENT.

AT POL COUNSELOR'S REQUEST QARANI NAMED THE MEMBERS OF A SEPARATE "MULLAH'S COUNCIL" WHICH HE SAID EXISTED SIDE-BY-SIDE WITH THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL. IT CONSISTS OF TALEGHANI, BEHESTI, MOUSSAVI, RAFSHANJANI, MOTAHARI, AND TWO OTHERS WE HAVE NEVER HEARD OF: BAHONAR AND HAMENEI. HE ASKED THAT THE NAMES BE KEPT IN STRICT CONFIDENCE SINCE HE WAS NOT SUPPOSED TO REVEAL THEM.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT.)

SUMMARY: WE KNOW OF NO MISSED PAYROLLS FOR DOMESTIC PUBLIC SECTOR PERSONNEL THROUGHOUT IRAN'S STRIKE-PLAGUED LAST FIVE MONTHS. THE PAY-REGARDLESS POLICY OF THE GOI HAS REFLECTED CHIEFLY THE CONCILIATORY POSTURES OF THE SHARIF-EMAMI AND AZHARI GOVERNMENTS. PRIVATE SECTOR COMPENSATION PRACTICE HAS VARIED GREATLY. WE BELIEVE A MAJORITY OF CONSTRUCTION AND OTHER DAY LABORERS HAVE BEEN LAID OFF, BUT MANY FIRMS HAVE FOLLOWED THE GOI'S POLICY, AT LEAST AS LONG AS FUNDS LASTED. THE LACK OF STRIKE EXPERIENCE AND STRIKE FUNDS ALSO ACCOUNT FOR THE GENERAL PAY-REGARDLESS PRACTICE. WE DOUBT THAT PM BAKHTIAR'S THREAT JAN.

20 THAT STRIKING EMPLOYEES WILL NOT HENCEFORTH BE PAID WILL BE CARRIED OUT, IF FOR NO OTHER REASON THAN THE FLUIDITY OF THE POLITICAL SITUATION. ANY OTHER POLICY BY THE GOI AND WIDESPREAD NON-PAYMENT TO STRIKERS IN THE PRIVATE SECTOR WOULD SERIOUSLY AGGRAVATE WHATEVER POLITICAL BALANCE OR ARRANGEMENT EXISTS IN TWO WEEKS. THE GOI, ON A STRICTLY CASH FLOW BASIS, WOULD NOT BE EXPECTED TO BE ABLE TO MEET THE FEB. 19 PAYROLL (END OF BAHMAN), BUT WE ASSUME IT WILL GAP THE SHORTFALL BY BORROWING FROM THE CENTRAL BANK. END SUMMARY.

IN-COUNTRY EMPLOYEES OF IRAN'S PUBLIC SECTOR HAVE NOT TO BEST KNOWLEDGE MISSED A PAYDAY DURING THIS PROLONGED ECONOMIC CRISIS AND DESPITE INTERMITTENT TO EXTENSIVE STRIKE ACTIONS. THE PUBLIC PAYROLL WAS SEVERAL DAYS LATE FOR THE MONTH OF DEY, WHICH ENDED JAN. 20, DUE TO BUREAUCRATIC STRIKES. WE UNDERSTAND THAT MFA OVERSEAS STAFF, WHO ARE CUSTOMARILY PAID FOR A THREE MONTHS PERIOD IN ADVANCE, HAVE NOT RECEIVED FIRST QUARTER 1979 (4TH QUARTER 1357) CHECKS. PRIVATE SECTOR PRACTICES ON WORKER COMPENSATION DURING STRIKES HAVE REFLECTED AN ELEMENT OF PATERNALISM BUT ALSO FACTORS OF FINANCIAL AND OTHER CONSTRAINTS.

INDICATIONS ARE THAT A LARGE MAJORITY OF PRIVATE SECTOR DAILY-PAID CONSTRUCTION AND OTHER LABORERS HAVE BEEN LAID OFF. (EMPLOYEE REPRESENTATION IN CONSTRUCTION AND AGRICULTURE IS VIRTUALLY NONEXISTENT; HENCE, THESE SECTORS HAVE BEEN IN ALMOST STRIKE FREE). WHILE STRIKING WORKERS WERE PAID IN SOME INSTANCES, MANY WORKERS HAVE BEEN DISMISSED OR PAID AT LOWER RATES; THE LATTER HAS OCCURRED OFTEN AT WORKERS REQUEST, RATHER THAN BE LAID OFF.

UNTIL THE ANNOUNCEMENT BY PM BAKHTIAR ON JAN. 20 THAT STRIKING GOVERNMENT WORKERS WOULD HENCEFORTH NOT BE PAID, THE PUBLIC SECTOR HAD INFLUENCED PRIVATE MANAGEMENT POLICY WITH ITS CONCILIATORY, PAY-REGARDLESS POLICY. WE QUESTION THE VALUE OF ANY ANSWER TO THE QUESTION OF THE LIKELIHOOD AND CONSEQUENCES OF THE GOI NOT MEETING ITS NEXT PAYROLL, WHICH, FOR THE VAST NUMBERS OF PUBLIC SECTOR EMPLOYEES WHO ARE PAID BUT MONTHLY, IS DUE BETWEEN FEBRUARY 17 AND 19 (28 TO 30 OF BAHMAN). FIRST IS THE QUESTION OF WHETHER BAKHTIAR WILL BE THE PM AT THAT TIME, AND IF SO UNDER WHAT CONDITIONS.

IF NOT, THEN PRESUMABLY THE PLEDGE AGAINST PAY TO STRIKERS DIES WITH HIS GOVERNMENT. SHOULD HIS GOVERNMENT STILL BE IN POWER, WE THINK IT DOUBTFUL THAT HE WILL CARRY OUT HIS PLEDGE, CHIEFLY BECAUSE, EXCEPT IN SOME CLEARCUT CASES, SITUATIONS OF NO-WORK ARE CLOUDED BY THE VARIOUS CAUSES FOR ABSENTEEISM. WORKERS WHO SHOW UP CAN ALWAYS MAINTAIN THEY WERE WORKING OR IF NOT POINT TO SOME INHIBITING FACTORS. THOSE NOT REPORTING FOR WORK CAN AND HAVE JUSTIFIED THEIR ABSENCE WITH THE "FACTS OF LIFE"--NO TRANSPORT, NO GASOLINE, DEMONSTRATIONS, CALLS OF MOURNING, ETC. ADDITIONALLY, WORKERS COULD FORCE A CONFRONTATION BY TRYING TO PROCESS THE PAYROLL DESPITE AN EMBARGO BY BAKHTIAR.

ENFORCEMENT OF THE NO-PAY THREAT IN THE GOVERNMENT AND/OR WIDESPREAD NON-PAYMENT FOR THE FEW CLEARCUT STRIKES IN THE PRIVATE SECTOR, WOULD SERIOUSLY AGGRAVATE WHATEVER POLITICAL BALANCE OR ARRANGEMENT EXISTS WITH THE GOI AROUND FEB. 19.

FINANCIAL ABILITY TO PAY: WE HAVE REPORTED THE FOREBODINGS OF SENIOR FINANCIAL OFFICIALS THAT THE GOI MAY NOT BE ABLE TO MEET ITS PAYROLL FOR BAHMAN. FROM A STRICT GOI CASH FLOW ANALYSIS THESE VIEWS HAVE MERIT, SINCE GOI RECEIPTS FROM OIL AND TAXES ARE SUCH THAT THE CASH FLOW DEFICIT IS ASSUMED TO EXCEED NORMAL DOMESTIC BORROWING CAPABILITIES. BUT, AS WE HAVE ALSO REPORTED, THE GOI WILL IF NECESSARY DO AS MANY GOVERNMENTS HAVE DONE, BORROW AS REQUIRED FROM THE CENTRAL BANK IN ORDER TO MEET PERCEIVED OBLIGATIONS. THE PRIVATE SECTOR PRESENTLY DOES NOT HAVE SIMILAR RECOURSE.

TO THE CONTRARY, WITH BANKS MORE CLOSED THAN OPEN AND WITH RIAL NOTE SHORTAGES, EVEN FIRMS WITH ------------------020999 011400Z /47 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 3615 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 01633 FUNDS ON ACCOUNT AND WILLING TO SUPPORT STRIKING EMPLOYEES WILL INCREASINGLY BE INCAPABLE. MANY COMPANIES SURVEYED HAVE ALREADY REACHED THE POINT OF INABILITY TO MEET A PAYROLL. THE WILLINGNESS TO PAY WILL BE GREATER IN THOSE CASES WHERE THE SHUTDOWN HAS BEEN FOR CAUSES EXTERNAL TO THE WORKERS AND WHERE MANAGEMENT HAS INVESTED SKILLS IN THE WORKFORCE.
AS STATED, IN MANY CASES WORKERS HAVE VOLUNTEERED OR AGREED TO GO ON REDUCED PAY DURING PERIODS WHEN WORK WAS NOT POSSIBLE.

AN ABERATION IN THE PUBLIC SECTOR: A BIZARRE DEVELOPMENT HAS COME TO OUR ATTENTION IN THE MINISTRY OF ROADS AND TRANSPORT IN WHICH THE WORKERS' REPRESENTATIVES REVERSED ROLES WITH MANAGEMENT AND DEMANDED THAT PAY NOT, REPEAT NOT BE GIVEN THIS MONTH. THEY SAID THAT UNDER KHOMEINI'S INSTRUCTION THEY WERE TOLD NOT TO RECEIVE ANY PAY FROM THE "DIRTY BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT". MANAGEMENT, I.E. THE PAYMASTER, REPLIED TO THIS DELEGATION SEVERAL DAYS AGO ON LINES REFLECTING REVERSED ROLES AND CONTRARY TO THE BAKHTIAR NO WORK/NO PAY ULTIMATUM.

IN AN IMPASSIONED REPLY TO THIS DEMAND HE POINTED OUT THAT IF PAY WAS NOT GIVEN THERE WOULD BE CONSIDERABLE SUFFERING, PARTICULARLY BY THE LOWER INCOME EMPLOYEES, AND, ADDRESSING THE WORKERS' ARGUMENT THAT THEY SHOULD NOT BE PAID BECAUSE THEY HAD NOT BEEN WORKING, HE SAID IT WAS NOT THEIR FAULT SINCE THE MINISTRY LACKED A MINISTER. COMMENT: THIS OCCURRENCE IS REPORTED ON GOOD AUTHORITY, BUT WE HAVE NOT OTHERWISE HEARD OF SUCH A DICTUM BY THE KHOMEINI OR OTHER OPPOSITIONIST CAMP AGAINST RECEIVING COMPENSATION FROM THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT. THUS, WE DO NOT TAKE IT AS SYMPTOMATIC EXCEPT IN THE SENSE THAT LITTLE MAKES SENSE THESE DAYS.

WHY PAYMENTS TO STRIKERS?" THE REASONING BEHIND THE PAY-REGARDLESS PRACTICE IS NOT ALWAYS CLEAR OR VARIES. PUBLIC SECTOR STRIKES, AS WELL AS IN GENERAL PRIVATE SECTOR, HAVE LITTLE TRADITION IN IRAN AND CERTAINLY NONE IN THE MEMORY OF THE VAST MAJORITY OF TODAY'S MANAGERS. THE DIFFICULTY IN DEALING WITH STRIKERS, OWING IN PART TO THEIR LACK OF ORGANIZATION BUT AS WELL AS TO THE COORDINATED RESPONSE BY THE GOI, MADE ANY RESPONSIVE DECISION MAKING DIFFICULT. PERHAPS IT SEEMED THE RIGHT THING TO DO TO PAY STRIKERS WHEN SENIOR OFFICIALS COULD GET LITTLE OR NO GUIDANCE ON HOW TO RESPOND TO STRIKERS.

THE GOI'S GENERAL CONCILIATORY POLICY UNDER SHARIF-EMAMI AND AZHARI IN DEALING WITH OPPOSITIONIST ACTIVITIES SUPPORT AN ENVIRONMENT WHICH MADE IT DIFFICULT TO "GET TOUGH" ON THE WORKERS. TYPICAL OF EXPLANATIONS WERE THOSE OF SENIOR CBI OFFICIALS, WHO SAID "HOW CAN WE GET IN FRONT OF OTHER PUBLIC INSTITUTIONS IN DEALING HARSHLY WITH STRIKERS . . .IT'S UP TO THE MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES." SOME PUBLIC SECTOR WORKERS WHO REPORTED BUT DID NOT WORK WOULD JUSTIFY CONTINUED PAYMENTS ON THE GROUNDS THAT PROMISED WELFARE CONCESSIONS BY MANAGEMENT HAD NOT MATERIALIZED; THE REASON WAS OFTEN THE PARALYSIS OF THE BUREAUCRACY ITSELF.

THE LACK OF STRIKE FUNDS, AN OBVIOUS BY-PRODUCT OF THE LACK OF ORGANIZED LABOR, MUST ALSO BE CONSIDERED IN THE PAY QUESTION. LASTLY, IN AT LEAST ONE SPECIFIC CASE IN WHICH A PRIVATE COMPANY REFUSED TO CONCEDE TO EMPLOYEES' DEMANDS AND SAID IT WOULD CLOSE UNTIL DEMANDS MODERATED, THE MINISTRY OF LABOR TOLD THE FIRM IT WAS VIOLATING MARTIAL LAW. IT WAS "LOCKING" ITS EMPLOYEES OUT OF THE BUILDING AND THUS CREATING AN ASSEMBLY ON THE STREETS. CLEARLY, SO THE REASONING FOLLOWS, ONCE THE EMPLOYEES REPORT, EVEN THOUGH THEY ARE NOT WORKING, THEY MUST BE PAID. SULLIVAN
(U - ENTIRE TEXT)

NEWS AT 2 P.M. LOCAL ON NIRT INTERNATIONAL RADIO REPORTED THAT OPENING WORDS OF KHOMEINI'S SPEECH WERE "THE DAYS OF THE MONARCHY ARE OVER," THAT HE MADE NO DIRECT REFERENCE TO ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL, BUT THAT AN AIDE (PERHAPS GHOTBZADEH IN PARIS) HAD SAID THAT A PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT WOULD BE NAMED WITHIN TWO DAYS, WITH ELECTIONS FOR A CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY TO COME LATER. PERSIAN LANGUAGE NEWS AT SAME HOUR, HOWEVER, REPORTED ONLY THAT KHOMEINI HAD CANCELLED PLANNED SHORT SPEECH IN FRONT OF UNIVERSITY DUE TO THE CRUSH OF CROWDS AND CONTINUED TO CEMETERY WHERE HE WOULD FIRST LEAD NOON PRAYERS, THEN SPEAK.

LOCAL NEWS ALSO INTERVIEWED NIRT DIRECTOR BARZIN WHO SAID A DEAL HAD BEEN WORKED OUT TO PERMIT TV BROADCAST OF CEREMONIES, BUT THAT WORKERS "HAD NOT LIVED UP TO THE BARGAIN," HE SAID THAT TECHNICAL PROBLEMS, ALLEGED REASON FOR FAILURE TO CARRY THROUGH WITH LIVE BROADCAST, HAD NOT BEEN MAJOR. "THE EXTREME LEFTISTS WERE ALSO ACTIVE," HE

SUMMARY: KHOMEINI ON WAY TO TEHRAN CEMETERY, MAKING SLOW PROGRESS. U.S. MILITARY C-12 CRASH NEAR ISFAHAN BEING INVESTIGATED. DEMONSTRATIONSTO BE ALLOWED FOR NEXT THREE DAYS. TERRORIST ATTACKS IN SANANDAJ AND KERMAN. PHONE CALL TO AP ISSUED DIRE WARNINGS FROM CONSTITUTIONALIST COMMANDOS. MAJLES SUSPENDS SESSIONS. JUDICIAL COMMITTEE AMENDS CORRUPTION TRIAL BILL. GOI RELEASED 355 PREVIOUSLY SENTENCED BY MILITARY COURTS. AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI'S DELEGATION COMPLETES REPORT ON JAN 17 VIOLENCE AT AHWAZ, ANDIMESHK AND DEZFUL.

NIRT INTERNATIONAL NOON RADIO BROADCAST REPORTED KHOMEINI MOTORCADE ON WAY TO BEHESHT-E-FAHRA CEMETERY; ROUTE LINED BY HUGE CROWDS. (FARSI RADIO AND TV IS STILL OUT, REPORTEDLY AFTER CLASH BETWEEN KHOMEINI SUPPORTERS WHO TRIED TO SEIZE NIRT AND MLA TROOPS WHO PREVENTED THIS)
U.S. MILITARY C-12 AIRCRAFT CRASHED YESTERDAY AFTERNOON ENROUTE FROM ISFAHAN TO TEHRAN. OF EIGHT PERSONNEL ABOARD ONLY TWO SURVIVED. INVESTIGATION OF CRASH UNDERWAY.
TEHRAN MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR ANNOUNCED THAT FOR NEXT THREE DAYS PEACEFUL DEMONSTRATIONS WILL BE ALLOWED.

TERRORIST YESTERDAY ATTACKED A SANANDAJ POLICE STATION INJURING TWO. IN KERMAN, MEN ARMED WITH A MACHINE GUN ATTACKED THE CAR OF POLICE CHIEF COL. REZA MOTAMEDI, KILLING HIS DRIVER AND BODYGUARD AND SEVERELY WOUNDING COL. MOTAMEDI. AP OFFICE RECEIVED CALL STATING THAT "COMMANDO ORGANIZATION OF THE WARRIORS OF THE CONSTITUTION" GAVE WARNING TO OPPONENTS OF CONSTITUTION OF "UNPRECEDENTED SLAUGHTER"AND DESTRUCTION OF KHOMEINI'S CHARTERED AIRCRAFT. CALLER CLAIMED TO HAVE "CAPABILITY OF LAUNCHING WAR FROM THE AIR AND GUERRILLA WARFARE." WE SUSPECT THIS WAS A CRANK CALL.
MAJLES SESSION TODAY CANCELLED AND SPEAKER ANNOUNCED NO SESSIONS UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE.

JUDICIAL COMMITTEE MADE SEVERAL CHANGES IN BILL ON PROSECUTION OF EX-MINISTERS: (A) IT REMOVED SPECIFICATION OF CRIMES FOR WHICH THEY WERE TO BE TRIED (WHICH WOULD APPARENTLY FORCE PROSECUTION TO PROVE VIOLATION OF REGULAR CRIMINAL STATUTES); (B) IT REDUCED REPRESENTATIONS OF SOME ORGANIZATIONS ON JURY, AND ADDED NEW ORGANIZATIONS DECREASING TOTAL SIZE OF JURY; (C) IT CHANGED JURY QUORUM FROM TWO-THIRDS TO ONE-HALF; (D) IT AUTHORIZES THE CHIEF OF THE SUPREME COURT TO REPLACE JURY MEMBERS WHO REFUSE TO REPRESENT THEIR PROFESSIONS, INSTEAD OF OBLIGING ORGANIZATIONS TO NAME NEW REPRESENTATIVES; (E) IT EXTENDS THE PERIOD UNDER INVESTIGATION UP TO THE PRESENT TO INCLUDE THE SHARIFEMAMI AND AZHARI GOVERNMENTS; AND (F) SPECIFICALLY RESTRICTS JURY TO FINDING GUILT OR INNOCENCE, LEAVING SUPREME COURT JUDGES FREE TO DETERMINE WHETHER TO GRANT LENIENCY IN SENTENCING.

GOI YESTERDAY RELEASED 355 PRISONERS WHO HAD BEEN SENTENCED BY MILITARY COURTS "FOR ACTS OTHER THAN THOSE INVOLVING ATTACKS ON STATE SECURITY." SUMMARY: KURDISH SITUATION IN IRAN HAS UNDOUBTEDLY BEEN AFFECTED NEGATIVELY BY PRESENT DISORDERS. KURDISH REPRESENTATIVE RECENTLY PASSED US COPY OF LETTER TO UNHCR URGING GREATER EFFORT ON BEHALF OF KURDISH REFUGEES. NOTWITHSTANDING ABOVE, IT DOES NOT SEEM TO US THAT KURDS HAVE BEEN ANY MORE ADVERSELY AFFECTED THAN OTHER MINORITIES, SUCH AS JEWS AND BAHAIS AND PROBABLY LESS. GIVEN RECENT ARRIVAL OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, WE THINK IT MIGHT BE USEFUL FOR UNHCR REPRESENTATIVE TO COME TO TEHRAN TO LOOK NOT ONLY AT KURDISH PROBLEM BUT INTO POTENTIAL REFUGEE PROBLEMS AMONG OTHER GROUPS. END SUMMARY.

KURDS, ALONG WITH OTHERS, HAVE DEFINITELY BEEN AFFECTED NEGATIVELY BY RECENT UNREST IN IRAN. KURDS HAVE PARTICIPATED IN BOTH PRO- AND ANTI-GOVERNMENT RALLIES IN WESTERN IRAN AND HAVE SUFFERED VIOLENCE ALONG WITH OTHERS. KURDISH REPRESENTATIVE ALI-SULIAMAN VISITED WITH CONSUL GENERAL RECENTLY AND PROVIDED COPY OF LETTER SENT BY BARZANI GROUP TO UNHCR (BEING POUCHED HA AND IRN) CALLING FOR MORE ASSISTANCE FOR KURDISH REFUGEES IN BOTH IRAN AND IRAQ.

IMPORTANT POINT IS THAT KURDS HAVE SUFFERED ALONG WITH OTHERS AND HAVE PROBABLY NOT RPT NOT BEEN AS BADLY AFFECTED AS SOME OTHER MINORITY GROUPS, NOTABLY BAHAIS AND JEWS. WHILE NOT WISHING TO MINIMIZE DIFFICULTIES OF REFUGEES IN COUNTRY UNDERGOING POLITICAL UNREST, IT SEEMS FAIR TO SAY THAT KURDS ARE PROBABLY NOT RPT NOT IN AS GREAT A DANGER AS OTHERS. THEY ALSO HAVE EXISTING KURDISH DEMOCRATIC PARTY ORGANIZATION TO HELP THEM, WHICH HAS BEEN WORKING ON REFUGEE PROBLEMS FOR FOUR YEARS AND IS UNDOUBTEDLY BEHIND CAMPAIGN IN U.S. AND ELSEWHERE TO DO MORE FOR KURDS. POLITICAL UNREST IN IRAN THUS BECOMES NATURAL OPPORTUNITY TO RENEW KURDISH LOBBYING EFFORT.

HAVING SAID ABOVE, HOWEVER, WE BELIEVE IT WOULD BE POTENTIALLY VERY USEFUL FOR UNHCR TO GET A MAN OUT HERE ON THE SCENE. TODAY'S ARRIVAL OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI MAY WELL USHER IN A PERIOD OF DECREASED TOLERATION FOR ALL MINORITIES, INCLUDING KURDS AND FOREIGNERS. PRESENCE OF UNHCR REPRESENTATIVE COULD PROVIDE REMINDER TO IRANIANS OF WORLD CONCERN OVER MINORITIES (INCLUDING KURDISH REFUGEES) AND EXERCISE GENTLE PRESSURE ON POLITICAL SYSTEM TO MITIGATE EXCESSES. AT MOMENT, U.S. IS ILL-PLACED TO LOBBY FOR KURDISH REFUGEES AND, FRANKLY, WE THINK OUR LIMITED POLITICAL CAPITAL MIGHT BE BETTER USED FOR OTHER GROUPS.
SUCH CONSTRAINTS WOULD NOT RPT NOT APPLY TO UNHCR VISITOR,WHO COULD MAKE GENERAL ASSESSMENT OF WIDERANGE OF POTENTIAL PROBLEMS. WE WOULD, OF COURSE, BE HAPPY TO COOPERATE WITH SUCH A VISIT.
EMBASSY IS ATTEMPTING TO RECONTACT ALI-SULAIMAN AND WILL PROVIDE ADDITIONAL INFORMATION LATER. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN01684.subject: DISCUSSION WITH FORMER COLONEL NOW IN OPPOSITION

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: MODERATE OPPOSITIONIST WHO LEFT ARMY AFTER BEING DENIED PROMOTION TO GENERAL OVER 20 YEARS AGO SAYS HIS GROUP SUPPORTS BAKHTIAR AS A USEFUL TRANSITION GOVERNMENT AND BROKE WITH OPPOSITIONIST GENERAL QARANI OVER THAT ISSUE. MODERATES HAVE BEEN IN PARIS PUSHING THAT LINE WITH KHOMEINI AND ENJOYED SOME (TEMPORARY) SUCCESS. HE SUPPORTS A CONSTITUTIONAL TRANSITION TO THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC BUT FEELS THE ARMY WILL NEED PURGING. HE SAYS KHOMEINI IS GOING TO STRAIGHTEN OUT THE CORRUPT MULLAHS OF QOM AND MASHAD. END SUMMARY

MORNING JAN 31 OPPOSITIONIST MANUCHEHR ZARRABI, A RETIRED ARMY COLONEL NOW 70 YEARS OLD, CALLED POL COUNSELOR TO ARRANGE A MEETING LATER THAT MORNING. HE HAS BEEN CONNECTED WITH GENERAL QARANI (REFTEL) AND IS PART OF A GROUP HE DESCRIBED AS WORKING FOR THE KHOMEINI MOVEMENT THOUGH NOT ORGANIZED AS ANY PARTY. ONE OF THE PERSONS HE WORKS WITH IS HOSSEIN GOHLI SHAMLU, AN IRANIAN BUSINESSMAN WHO LIVES IN LONDON AND PAID A VISIT TO POL COUNSELOR ON A TRIP TO IRAN A FEW MONTHS AGO.

ZARRABI BRIEFLY DESCRIBED HIS MILITARY CAREER. IN THE 1940S AND 1950S HE HAD MUCH CONTACT WITH AMERICAN ADVISORS (HE MENTIONED LT. COL. MCDONALD, LT. COL. KIRKBRIDE, LT. COL. FREYDA) BOTH AS A STUDENT AT INFANTRY STAFF COLLEGE IN THE U.S. AND ON THE JOB IN ARMY G-1 STAFF. THE END OF HIS CAREER CAME ABRUPTLY WHEN HE GOT CAUGHT BETWEEN U.S. GENERAL SEITZ AND GENERAL NASSIRI, WHO WAS THEN COMMANDER OF THE IMPERIAL GUARD. SEITZ INSISTED THAT AN OFFICER WHO HAD RETURNED FROM SPECIALIZED TRAINING IN THE U.S. BE SENT TO SISTAN, WHILE NASSIRI (A SCHOOLMATE OF ZARRABIS) INSISTED THE OFFICER JOIN THE IMPERIAL GUARD.

SINCE ZARRABI HAD ALREADY GIVEN HIS WORD TO THE AMERICANS THAT HE WOULD ACCEPT THEIR RECOMMENDATIONS IN PLACING ALL PEOPLE RETURNING FROM U.S. TRAINING, HE ORDERED THE LIEUTENANT TRANSFERRED UNDER GUARD BY NIGHT TO SISTAN. THIS BROUGHT AN ARGUMENT FROM NASSIRI TO WHICH ZARRABI REPLIED IN ANGER. WHEN THE LIST OF COLONELS TO BE PROMOTED TO GENERALS WENT TO THE SHAH 10 DAYS LATER, ZARRABI'S NAME WAS STRICKEN OFF IT. ZARRABI IMMEDIATELY RESIGNED, EXPLAINING TO U.S. LT. COL. PAGE THAT, AS LONG AS THE SHAH AND NASSIRI WERE AROUND, HE WOULD HAVE NO MORE CAREER.
HE THEN WENT TO WORK FOR VARIOUS PRIVATE COMPANIES AND HAS SPENT THE LAST 13 YEARS AS A MINISTRY OF JUSTICE INVESTIGATIVE SPECIALIST ON MOTOR VEHICLE ACCIDENTS.

ZARRABI SAID HE HAD HAD A LOT OF EXPERIENCE IN HOW TO FIGHT THE COMMUNISTS. HE HAD SPENT 4 YEARS AS MILITARY GOVERNOR IN IRAN'S OIL PRODUCING AREAS, ABADAN AND ELSEWHERE. AT THAT TIME HE HAD WRITTEN A LETTER TO THE SHAH ARGUING THAT PUTTING COMMUNISTS INTO PRISON WAS THE WRONG APPROACH TO THE PROBLEM. ("IF THE JEWS HAD NOT CRUCIFIED JESUS HIS RELIGION WOULD NOT HAVE SPREAD.") ZARRABI HAD PRACTICED WHAT HE PREACHED AND THROUGH ARGUMENT PERSUADED MANY COMMUNISTS IN THE OIL PRODUCING AREAS TO SWITCH THEIR BELIEFS. HE HAD BEEN PRIVATELY ATTACKED BY THE COMMUNISTS FOR HIS EFFICACY WITH HIS TONGUE.

NO IRANIAN IS A COMMUNIST BY IDEOLOGY, ZARRABI SAID. COMMUNISTS IN THIS COUNTRY ARE NOT OF THE HEAD BUT OF THE STOMACH. THEY BECOME COMMUNISTS BECAUSE SOMEONE HURTS THEM, OR DESTROYS THEIR LIFE. IN A LECTURE GIVEN AT FT. BENNING IN 1957, HE HAD EXPLAINED THAT THE ANSWER TO COMMUNISM IN IRAN LIES IN THE PROVISION OF BREAD.

ZARRABI MADE MUCH OF HIS PRO-AMERICANISM. HE HAD STUDIED AT THE AMERICAN COLLEGE IN TEHRAN FOUNDED BY DR. JORDAN. ("DR. JORDAN IS STILL A PROPHET FOR US.") PEOPLE ON THE STREET ARE INSULTING PRESIDENT CARTER THESE DAYS, BUT HE IS THE ONE THAT SAVED IRAN. THE OPPOSITION WOULD HAVE BEEN UNABLE TO KICK THE KING OUT ALONE. IT WAS CARTER WHO STARTED THE PROCESS THAT ENDED THERE. DEFINITELY NOT KISSINGER, HE ADDED IN AN ASIDE.

WHEN ASKED BY POL COUNSELOR WHY THERE WAS STILL SO MUCH ANTI-AMERICANISM IN THE STREETS, ZARRABI SAID THE MOVEMENT HAD BEEN TOO BUSY FIGHTING THE SHAH TO TAKE TIME TO EDUCATE ITS FOLLOWERS ON THE AMERICAN QUESTION. (COMMENT: A LAME EXCUSE.) ANY SIGN OF FRIENSHIP BY CARTER FOR THE SHAH MAKES IRANIANS QUAKE IN APPREHENSION. IF CARTER KEEPS THE SHAH FROM RETURNING, HE WILL BE APPRECIATED AND LOVED. THE BRIGHT YOUNG MEN IN OPPOSITION PRIVATELY RECOGNIZE THAT CARTER ------------------036363 021313Z /50 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 3652 SECTION 02 OF 03 TEHRAN 01684 EXDIS SAVED IRAN.

ZARRABI SAID TWO REPRESENTATIVES SENT BY HIS GROUP TO PARIS WERE ON THEIR WAY BACK AT THAT MOMENT. THEY WERE AYATOLLAH NAZARI FROM SARI AND HAJI LATIFI, A VERY INFLUENTIAL AND PRESTIGIOUS MAN WITH THE CLERGY. (LATIFI HAD ESTABLISHED TWO RELIGIOUS SCHOOLS WHICH WERE TAKEN OVER BY THE GOVT FROM HIM 5 YEARS AGO, AND HE NOW LIVES ON THE RENT FROM THEM.) THESE TWO SPOKE WITH KHOMEINI AND URGED HIM NOT TO BE SO OBSTINATE. THEY HAD BROUGHT BACK THE REPORT THAT KHOMEINI WILL BE MODERATE IN DEALING WITH BAKHTIAR.

IF BAKHTIAR "COMES AND STANDS BESIDE ME," KHOMEINI HAD SAID HE WOULD FORGET ABOUT THE ISSUE OF RESIGNATION. "IF BAKHTIAR COMES TO ME I WILL OFFER HIM ANY JOB HE WANTS. I LIKE TO HAVE RIGHTEOUS PEOPLE LIKE HIM. PROBLEM OF RESIGNATION IS NOT IMPORTANT NOW." (COMMENT: THIS IS AN UNUSUALLY SANGUINE RENDITION OF KHOMEINI"S ATTITUDE TOWARD BAKHTIAR, AND IN CONTEXT APPEARS TO DATE FROM THE MOMENT WHEN BAKHTIAR OFFERED TO FLY TO PARIS AND SEE KHOMEINI. IT TENDS TO CONFIRM INFORMATION THAT KHOMEINI HAD AGREED TO SEE BAKHTIAR WITHOUT REFERENCE TO RESIGNATION BUT LATER CHANGED HIS MIND.)

ZARRABI SAID HE HAD BEEN WORKING WITH GENERAL QARANI FOR MANY YEARS (QARANI WAS HEAD OF G-2 WHEN ZARRABI WAS IN G-1) BUT QARANI OBJECTED TO ZARRABI'S SUPPORT OF BAKHTIAR AND AS A RESULT ZARRABI HAD DECIDED TO BREAK WITH QARANI. IN RESPONSE TO POL COUNSELOR'S QUESTIONS ABOUT QARANI, ZARRABI SAID THAT QARANI BELIEVES HE WAS TRIED TWICE FOR ATTEMPTING A COUP D'ETAT AGAINST THE SHAH. ZARRABI HAD TOLD HIM THAT HE COULD NOT HAVE BEEN ATTEMPTING A COUP D'ETAT SINCE HE HAD NO TROOPS AT HIS DISPOSAL. RATHER, QARANI WAS JAILED TWICE FOR TALKING AGAINST THE SHAH.

THE FIRST TIME WAS WITH SECRETARY OF STATE JOHN FOSTER DULLES AND THE SHAH HEARD ABOUT IT. THE SECOND TIME QARANI WAS BETRAYED WHEN VISITING AYATOLLAH MILANI IN 1964. THE SAVAK INFORMER WAS THE AYATOLLAH'S OLDER SON, WHO IS NOW AN AYATOLLAH IN MASHAD, BUT STILL WORKS FOR SAVAK. MILANI'S SECOND SON (NOUREDIN) IS IN REY AND FAITHFUL TO THE MOVEMENT. INFORMER DID NOT KNOW ZARRABI'S NAME FOR HE WAS WITH QARANI AT THE TIME. THUS SAVAK ARRESTED QARANI AND THE OTHER COLONEL (COL. GHAFFARI) AND BECAUSE THEY WERE NOT TORTURED ZARRABI ESCAPED ARREST. QARANI WAS SENTENCED AND SERVED THREE YEARS IN PRISON ON EACH OCCASION.
ZARRABI SAID HE KNEW MOST OF THE TOP ARMY GENERALS (GENERALS AZHARI, OVEISSI, BADRAI, GHARABAGHI) SINCE THEY HAD SERVED UNDER HIM IN THE PAST. THEY ARE LIKE BIG DRUMS

EMPTY INSIDE. SWITCHING METAPHORS HE SAID THEY WERE MADE OR RUBBER AND MEN OF RUBBER ARE NOT PATTONS OR EISENHOWERS. THEY ARE STANDING FIRM NOW BECAUSE THEY BELIEVE THE SHAH WILL RETURN. IF THEY CAME TO BELIEVE HE WOULD NOT RETURN, THEY WOULD SCUTTLE TO SAVE THEMSELVES MAKING ARRANGEMENTS WITH THE KHOMEINI MOVEMENT TO SAVE THEIR LIVES AND POSITIONS. IF AMERICAN ADVISORS INDICATE DISAPPROVAL OF WHAT THESE GENERALS ARE DOING HE IS SURE THEY WILL CHANGE THEIR POLICIES. HE ADDED IT WOULD BE USEFUL IF BAKHTIAR APPOINTED GENERAL JAM TO REPLACE GHARABAGHI AT SCS. HE WAS NOT PERTURBED BY THE SUGGESTION THIS WAS NOT ACCORDING TO THE CONSTITUTION.

ZARRABI KNEW FROM PERSONAL EXPERIENCE HOW THE SHAH PICKED UP ONLY CORRUPT OFFICERS FOR PROMOTION SO THAT HE COULD CONTROL THEM. IN ANY CASE THE DISHONEST OFFICERS NEED TO BE REMOVED.WIT THE ARMY AS IT IS, THE ARMY WOULD FALL APART IF FACED WITH ANY CHALLENGE FROM THE SOVIETS. WITH HONEST OFFICERS LEADING,IT WOULD HOLD FAST.

ZARRABI RECOUNTED A MILITARY TRIAL 17 YEARS AGO IN WHICH AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI, BAZARGAN, DR. SAHABI AND HIS SON, DR. ABBAS SHEYBANI, AND NATIONAL FRONTER BABAI WERE CO-DEFENDANTS. ZARRABI WAS AMONG THE DEFENSE ATTORNEYS. GHARABAGHI WAS CHAIRMAN OF THAT COURT, WHICH CONDEMNED THEM TO 10 YEARS IN JAIL.

WHEN POL COUNSELOR STRESSED THE NEED FOR MODERATION IN KHOMEINI'S STATEMENT AND STRICT ADHERENCE TO CONSTITUTIONAL PROCESS IN MAKING CHANGES IN THE CONSTITUTION, ZARRABI IMMEDIATELY AGREED THIS WAS WHAT HE AND HIS PEOPLE WANT. HE SAID HIS PEOPLE WOULD CONTINUE TO TALK TO KHOMEINI TO CALM HIM DOWN. HE DESCRIBED KHOMEINI AS EXCEEDINGLY SMART. HE DID NOT THINK KHOMEINI WOULD GET CARRIED AWAY ON ARRIVAL. BEYOND THAT, ZARRABI OPINED THAT THE "ISLAMIC REPUBLIC" HAS NO SUBSTANTIVE MEANING. IT IS A WAY OF GETTING RID OF THE PAHLAVI MONARCHY. IRAN WILL HAVE A GOVT LIKE TURKEY OR IRAQ.

(COMMENT: IT WAS AN INDICATION OF THE EXTENT OF ZARRABI'S SOPHISTICATION IN FOREIGN AFFAIRS THAT HE LIKENED IRAQ TO TURKEY WHEN SPEAKING TO AN AMERICAN EMBOFF.) IRAN NEEDS A PRESIDENT LIKE IN THE U.S., WHO TAKES OFFICE FOR A LIMITED PERIOD OF TIME AND THEN ------------------036406 021315Z /50 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 3653 SECTION 03 OF 03 TEHRAN 01684 EXDIS GOES BACK TO PRIVATE LIFE. HE WILL HAVE AN INCENTIVE TO STAY HONEST AND MAINTAIN A GOOD REPUTATION THEN.

IRAN HAS MANY BRIGHT PEOPLE WHO ARE ANTI-COMMUNIST BUT ALSO KNOW THAT MANY MULLAHS ARE CORRUPT, ZARRABI CONTINUED. KHOMEINI HIMSELF HAS WRITTEN THAT ONE OF HIS FIRST DECISIONS WILL BE TO "CLEAN UP THE MULLAHS OF QOM AND MASHAD." THIS APPEARS IN A BOOK (WHICH HE GAVE POL COUNSELOR) ENTITLED "THE LETTERS OF IMAM MOUSSAVI." IT WAS WRITTEN BY KHOMEINI A FEW YEARS AGO AND APPEARS UNDER THE TITLE TO AVOID SAVAK CENSORSHIP. ZARRABI AND HIS FRIENDS HAVE COMPILED A LIST OF HONEST OFFICIALS IN VARIOUS MINISTRIES WHO WILL BE PUT IN CHARGE OF THINGS WHEN THE NEW REGIME TAKES POWER.
HIS OWN AREA, HE SAID, WAS THE MINISTRY OF FINANCE.
INCIDENTALLY, ZARRABI SAID HIS GRANDFATHER CAME FROM KASHAN WHERE HE RAN THE LOCAL GOVT MINT. ZARRABI HIMSELF WAS BORN IN TEHRAN. SULLIVAN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: KHOMEINI ON LIGHT SCHEDULE TODAY AS HE IS EXTREMELY TIRED. LMI-BAKHTIAR NEGOTIATIONS TO BEGIN. NEGOTIATIONS LARGE DEMONSTRATION AT ISFAHAN CEMETERY. EX-BOXER FEREIDOUN ZAND "EXECUTED" IN TEHRAN BY GUERRILLA GROUP. "DEATH TO HUYSER" WAS PROMINENT SLOGAN IN LARGE GATHERING IN SOUTH TEHRAN TODAY. TEHRAN GENERALLY QUIET. END SUMMARY

LMI SOURCE SAYS KHOMEINI VERY TIRED TODAY, WILL DO LITTLE. HE WILL BEGIN INTENSIVE POLITICAL DISCUSSIONS TOMORROW. IN LMI VIEW PM BAKHTIAR STILL BEING OBSTINATE, BUT LMI-BAKHTIAR NEGOTIATIONS WILL BEGIN TONIGHT. LMI EXPECTS THESE TALKS TO CENTER ON THE ROLE OF THE ISLAMIC COUNCIL AND BAKHTIAR'S ROLE IN THE TRANSITION GOVT. A KEY ISSUE IS THAT OF WHO WILL CONTROL UPCOMING ELECTIONS.

MINATCHI TOLD POLOFF STEMPEL THAT SECURITY YESTERDAY HAD GENERALLY WORKED VERY WELL, THOUGH AT A FEW POINTS FERVENT CROWDS PRESSED SO HARD ON KHOMEINI THAT IT WAS FEARED HE MIGHT BE ENGULFED. MINATCHI ANTICIPATES 4-7 DAYS OF DISCUSSIONS WILL BE NEEDED TO FIND SOLUTION.
TEHRAN GENERALLY APPEARS QUIET, WITH LIGHT TRAFFIC AND NO UNTOWARD NOISE.

WE ARE STILL TRYING TO GET CLEAR READING OF WHAT KHOMEINI SAID IN SPEECH AT BEHESHT-E-ZAHRA YESTERDAY. REPORTS CONFLICT, BUT TONE SEEMS TO HAVE BEEN STRONGLY ANTI-FOREIGN, AND ANTI-AMERICAN. TWO IRANIAN SOURCES DENY THIS, HOWEVER.

AMERICAN PRESS SOURCE TELLS US KHOMEINI DIDNOT GIVE SCHEDULED SPEECH TODAY TO GROUP OF MEN ASSEMBLED AT A SOUTH TEHRAN SCHOOL NEAR HIS HEADQUARTERS. THOUSANDS WERE PRESENT, SOURCE SAID, AND PROMINENT AMONG SLOGANS WAS "DEATH TO HUYSER." SOURCE COMMENTED THAT MUCH HOSTILITY BEING FOCUSSED ON GEN. HUYSER WHO IS BEING PAINTED AS AN "ASSISTANT AMBASSADOR" OPERATING OUT OF AMBASSADOR'S SULLIVAN'S OFFICE. SOURCE NOTED HARSH SOVIET RADIO ATTACKS ON HUYSER. KHOMEINI IS SCHEDULED TO ADDRESS GROUP OF WOMEN LATER THIS AFTERNOON.

ISFAHAN REPORTS MAJOR DEMONSTRATION TODAY, WITH THOUSANDS OF MARCHERS CONVERGING ON CEMETERY. NUMEROUS LARGE TRUCKLOADS OF MARCHERS HAVE PASSED CONSULATE SHOUTING ANTI-AMERICAN AND ANTI-BAKHTIAR SLOGANS. MARCHERS GENERALLY SHOUTING PRO-KHOMEINI SLOGANS, HOWEVER, AND SWITCHING TO "DEATH TO FOREIGNERS" WHEN THEY SPOT FOREIGN ONLOOKERS. BELL EMPLOYEE WHO SHOT TAXI DRIVER CONTINUES UNDER PROTECTION OF ISFAHAN AYATOLLAH KHADAMI.
