1979TEHRAN01691.subject: (U) IRAN: UNDERSTANDING THE SHI'ITE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT

segments.text: MOVEMENT (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: THOUGH BASED ON INCOMPLETE EVIDENCE, OUR BEST ASSESSMENT TO DATE IS THAT THE SHIA ISLAMIC MOVEMENT DOMINATED BY AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI IS FAR BETTER ORGANIZED, ENLIGHTENED AND ABLE TO RESIST COMMUNISM THAN ITS DETRACTORS WOULD LEAD US TO BELIEVE. IT IS ROOTED IN THE IRANIAN PEOPLE MORE THAN ANY WESTERN IDEOLOGY, INCLUDING COMMUNISM. HOWEVER, ITS GOVERNING PROCEDURES ARE NOT CLEAR, AND PROBABLY HAVE NOT BEEN TOTALLY WORKED OUT. IT IS POSSIBLE THAT THE PROCESS OF GOVERNING MIGHT PRODUCE ACCOMMODATIONS WITH THE ANTI-CLERICAL, INTELLECTUAL STRAINS WHICH EXIST IN THE OPPOSITION TO PRODUCE SOMETHING MORE CLOSELY APPROACHING WESTERNIZED DEMOCRATIC PROCESSES THAN MIGHT AT FIRST BE APPARENT. END SUMMARY

AS DEPT AND OTHER ADDRESSEES ARE AWARE, WE HAVE FOR SOMETIME BEEN LABORING WITH THE PROBLEM OF UNDERSTANDING THE BREADTH AND DEPTH OF THE RENASCENT SHI'ITE RELIGIOUS MOVEMENT IN IRAN BOTH FOR ANALYTICAL AND POLICY PURPOSES. WHILE OUR STUDY IS FAR FROM CONCLUDED, IT WOULD BE USEFUL TO MAKE SOME TENTATIVE JUDGMENTS AT THIS CRITICAL STAGE IN IRAN'S ONGOING REVOLUTION.

FIRST, WE HAVE AMASSED ENOUGH EVIDENCE TO DATE TO BE REASONABLY SURE THAT THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT HEADS THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION BOTH IN THE PERSON OF THE SYMBOLIC LEADER, AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, AND IN THE ORGANIZATION, OR PERHAPS MORE ACCURATELY INTERLOCKING ORGANIZATIONS, WHICH SUPPORT HIM. IRANIAN GOVT SPOKESMEN HAVE FOR A LONG TIME PEDDLED THE CHARGE THAT KHOMEINI'S FOLLOWERS ARE FOR THE MOST PART CRYPTO COMMUNISTS OR LEFTISTS OF MARXIST STRIPE. THIS BELIEF IS SHARED QUITE WIDELY BY OTHERWISE WELL-INFORMED IRANIANS, INCLUDING JOURNALISTS AND BUSINESSMEN AS WELL AS GOVT SERVANTS.

TO A CONSIDERABLE EXTENT IT IS BASED ON A FABLE THAT COMMUNISTS HAVE BEEN INFILTRATED AS YOUTHS INTO THE RELIGIOUS SCHOOLS AND NOW CONSTITUTE THE MULLAHS AND OTHER ORGANIZERS OF THE RELIGIOUS MOVEMENT. "PROOF" OF THIS IS DEDUCED FROM THE ASSUMPTION MADE GLIBLY BY MANY IRANIANS THAT THE RELIGIOUS PEOPLE, INDEED IRANIANS IN GENERAL, ARE TOO DISORGANIZED AND INCAPABLE OF PUTTING TOGETHER AN EFFICIENT MOVEMENT UNLESS THIS IS DONE FOR THEM BY "THE ONLY ORGANIZED GROUP IN IRAN" -- THE TUDEH PARTY.

THESE DETRACTORS APPEAR TO BE LABORING IN AN IGNORANCE OF THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT WHICH IS IN SOME CASES GREATER THAN THAT OF WESTERN OBSERVERS. WESTERNIZATION IN IRAN ACHIEVED A STATUS AND LEGITIMACY UNDER THE TWO PAHLAVI MONARCHS WHICH HAS PRACTICALLY WIPED OUT MEMORIES OF THE ISLAMIC PAST FOR LARGE NUMBERS OF PEOPLE WHO WENT TO SCHOOL IN THE WESTERNIZED IRANIAN SCHOOL SYSTEM AND DID THEIR HIGHER STUDIES FOR THE MOST PART ABROAD.

FOLLOWING THE MODEL OF KEMAL ATATURK IN TURKEY AND CONTINUING INTO THE POST WORLD WAR II PERIOD, THE PAHLAVI SHAHS HAVE SOUGHT TO BRAND THE ISLAMIC ESTABLISHMENT AS AN IGNORANT REACTIONARY REMNANT OF THE PAST WHICH IS FAST BECOMING OBSOLETE. STEPS WERE TAKEN TO RENDER THIS A SELF-FULFILLING PROPHECY. THE GOVT HAS MADE EFFORTS TO CUT OFF THE MULLAHS FROM DIRECT FINANCIAL SUPPORT BY THE PEOPLE AND TO MAKE THEM DEPEND ON GOVT SALARIES.

BY KEEPING THE MULLAHS AS FAR OUT OF PUBLIC SIGHT AS POSSIBLE, SEEKING TO RIDICULE THEM, LOCKING UP MANY OF THE LEADERS IN SAVAK PRISONS, AND ------------------050890 031137Z /23 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 3660 INFO AMEMBASSY AMMAN USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY CAIRO AMEMBASSY DAMASCUS AMCONSUL DHAHRAN AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS AMEMBASSY RABAT AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY SANA AMEMBASSY TEL AVIV AMEMBASSY TRIPOLI AMEMBASSY TUNIS SECTION 02 OF 04 TEHRAN 01691 INSISTING ON NON-RELIGIOUS MODELS OF THE FUTURE FOR IRAN, THE SHAHS HAVE ATTEMPTED TO PUSH IRAN THROUGH A PERIOD OF WESTERNIZATION INVOLVING A SEPARATION OF CHURCH AND STATE WHICH TOOK CENTURIES TO DEVELOP IN EUROPE.

NEVERTHELESS, IT HAS BECOME OBVIOUS THAT ISLAM IS DEEPLY IMBEDDED IN THE LIVES OF THE VAST MAJORITY OF THE IRANIAN PEOPLE. IN ITS SHIMITE FORMAT, IT HAS OVER THE CENTURIES BECOME STRONGLY IDENTIFIED WITH IRANIAN NATIONALISM, EVEN BEFORE THE AGE OF MODERN NATIONALISM PENETRATED THE EAST. THE PAHLAVIS ATTEMPTED TO SUPPLANT THIS ANCIENT NATIONALISM WITH A MODERN VERSION BASED ON A RETURN TO TRADITIONS, LEGENDS AND GLORIES OF THE PRE-ISLAMIC PAST. THAT EFFORT MIGHT HAVE BEEN SUCCESSFUL IF ALLOWED TO CONTINUE UNCHALLENGED FOR MANY MORE DECADES OR CENTURIES. ITS SUCCESS DEPENDED ON CREATION OF INSTITUTIONS WITH ROOTS AMONG THE PEOPLE TO COMPETE WITH THAT OF SHI'ITE ISLAM.

HOWEVER, THE REFORMING PAHLAVI MONARCHY WAS CHALLENGED EARLY ON BY ANOTHER WESTERN IDEOLOGY -- COMMUNISM. ITS INFANT PARLIAMENTARY AND OTHER GOVERNMENTAL INSTITUTIONS CAME CLOSE TO BEING TAKEN OVER IN THE LATE 1940S AND EARLY 1905S BY THE COMMUNIST METHOD OF WESTERNIZATION. THE PRESENT SHAH'S SUCCESSFUL DEFENSE AGAINST THE CHALLENGE AND HISABSORPTION IN THE CREATION OF A MODERN, SECULAR AND INDUSTRIALIZED IRAN BLINDED HIM TO THE MORE ANCIENT CHALLENGE OF ISLAM AND ITS HOLD ON THE PEOPLE.

WHILE HIS EFFORTS TO CREATE A NEW IRANIAN IDEOLOGY BASED ON "2500 YEARS OF IRANIAN KINGSHIP" AND DEVELOPMENT OF THE "GREAT CIVILIZATION" WERE DIRECTED PERSONALLY AND APPEARED TO BE MAKING SOME HEADWAY, IT IS CLEAR TODAY THAT THEY DEEPENED THE RESENTMENT OF SHI'ITE ISLAM AND BROADENED THE OPPOSITION TO HIS REGIME AMONG MORE AND MORE CLASSES OF PEOPLE WELL BEYOND THOSE STRICTLY PRACTICING RELIGION. TODAY, EVEN THE SHAH'S USE OF THE PERSIAN LANGUAGE IS RIDICULED. IT SEEMS THE SHAH REGULARLY MAKES ERRORS IN HIS USE OF THE LANGUAGE, WHICH ONLY REINFORCES THE CHARGE THAT HE IS AN IMPLANT OF FOREIGN INTERESTS SERVING FOREIGNERS RATHER THAN HIS OWN PEOPLE.

HISTORICALLY, ISLAMIC SCHOLARS HERE TRACE THE DEVELOPMENT OF SHI'ISM IN TERMS OF ITS RESISTANCE TO AUTHORITY AT SEVERAL STAGES. ORIGINALLY A MARK OF PERSIAN RESISTANCE TO ARAB AND MONGOL INVADERS, IRANIAN SHI'ISM SPLIT AND THE MAJOR DIVISION IN A SENSE "WENT UNDERGROUND" AFTER THE SAFAVID RULERS ADOPTED IT AS THE OFFICIAL COURT RELIGION. THESE POWERFUL PERSIAN RULERS TRANSFORMED SHI'ISM INTO A TYPE OF SUNNISM, PERSIAN SCHOLARS TELL US. THAT IS, THEY DEMANDED AND GOT SUBSERVIENCE OF A PART OF THE SHI'A ESTABLISHMENT TO THE KING. ACQUIESCENCE WAS GIVEN TO THE PRINCIPLE THAT, IN THE ABSENCE OF THE "HIDDEN 12TH IMAM," THE KING COULD MAKE NECESSARY TEMPORAL DECISIONS.

CONCURRENT WITH THIS OFFICIAL ("SAFAVI") STRAIN, HOWEVER, WAS THE UNOFFICIAL STRAIN OF SHI'ISM ("ALAVI") WHICH BELIEVED AND PREACHED RESISTANCE TO UNJUST AND CORRUPT RULERS AND HID BEHIND THE ANCIENT SHI'ITE DOCTRINE OF CONCEALMENT.

THE EXISTENCE OF BOTH STRAINS IN SHI'ISM IS MARKED BY PARALLEL SYSTEMS OF MOSQUES, DATING ESPECIALLY FROM THE TIME OF FATHI ALI SHAH QAJAR, IN MANY IRANIAN CITIES -THOSE BUILT BY THE SHAH ANDSUPPORTED BY HIM, THOSE BUILT BY THE PEOPLE AND PRAYED IN BY THEM. THE "IMAM JOM'EHS" APPOINTED BY THE GOVT TO PRESIDE OVER THE SHAH MOSQUES WERE NOT RESPECTED BY THE BELIEVERS WHO SOUGHT OUT THEIR OWN MULLAHS AND MOJTAHEDS, TO WHOM THEY RENDERED OBEDIENCE AND PAID THEIR TITHES.

THIS UNDERGROUND "ALAVITE" STRAIN CAME TO THE SURFACE IN THE 19TH CENTURY WITH THE TOBACCO ------------------050813 031138Z /23 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 3661 INFO AMEMBASSY AMMAN USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY CAIRO AMEMBASSY DAMASCUS AMCONSUL DHAHRAN AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS AMEMBASSY RABAT AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY SANA AMEMBASSY TEL AVIV AMEMBASSY TRIPOLI AMEMBASSY TUNIS SECTION 03 OF 04 TEHRAN 01691 REBELLION, WHEN THE CLERGY SUCCESSFULLY LED A BOYCOTT AGAINST THE KING'S GRANT OF A TOBACCO MONOPOLY TO THE BRITISH.

IT WAS THE KEY FORCE BEHIND THE REVOLUTION AT THE TURN OF THIS CENTURY WHICH PRODUCED THE CURRENT CONSTITUTION IN 1906 AND 1907. FORCED AGAIN INTO AN INACTIVE ROLE BY THE PAHLAVI SHAHS, THE ALAVITE STRAIN IS THE HEART OF THE SUCCESSFUL REVOLUTION TODAY.

IF ONE EXAMINES IRAN FOR POLITICAL STRUCTURES TODAY, ONE IS STRUCK BY THE APPEARANCE OF A WASTELAND. MODERN PARLIAMENTARY DEMOCRACY HAS HAD LITTLE SUCCESS IN THE SHORT PERIOD WHEN IT HAS BEEN TRIED, AND IT IS AN ADAGE HERE THAT THE ONLY RELATIVELY EFFECTIVE POLITICAL PARTY IN THE PAST HAS BEEN THE COMMUNIST, OR TUDEH, PARTY. NOTABLES AND OTHER POWERFUL PERSONS, INCLUDING MANY MULLAHS, HAVE BEEN REPRESENTED IN THE PARLIAMENT AS INDIVIDUALS WITH PERSONAL FOLLOWINGS, WHO MAKE TEMPORARY ALLIANCES WITH EACH OTHER BUT HAVE DONE PRECIOUS LITTLE TO ADVANCE THE INSTITUTION OF DEMOCRATIC GOVT AS UNDERSTOOD IN THE WEST.

THE ONE PRIME MINISTER WHO ACHIEVED A DEGREE OF POWER TO CHALLENGE THAT OF THE SHAH, MOSSADEQ, OPERATED IN A PERSONALIZED AUTHORITARIAN WAY WHICH LEFT A MEMORY AND A POLITICAL LEGACY IN IRAN, BUT NO POLITICAL ORGANIZATION OR PROMISE OF FUTURE INSTITUTIONALIZATION. IN SHORT, A CENTRAL POWER WITH A GRIP ON THE PEOPLE HAS ALWAYS BEEN NECESSARY TO RULE IRAN.

THE ISLAMIC ESTABLISHMENT HAS DRAWN RENEWED VIGOR FROM THE LITERACY AND EDUCATION DRIVES WHICH HAVE TRANSFORMED SO MUCH OF THE IRANIAN POPULATION OVER THE PAST FOUR OR FIVE DECADES. MOSLEM LEADERS CAN CALL ON EDUCATED MOSLEM YOUTH, MANY OF WHOM HAVE LEARNED WESTERN ARTS OF PROPAGANDA AND ORGANIZATION IN THEIR U.S. OR EUROPEAN SCHOOLS AND UNIVERSITIES. THE ISLAMIC ESTABLISHMENT ITSELF, WHICH WAS ORIGINALLY TAKEN BY SURPRISE BY THE ONSLAUGHT OF MARXIST IDEOLOGY, HAS OVER THE PAST TWO OR THREE DECADES DIGESTED AND APPARENTLY GONE FAR TO IMMUNIZE ITSELF AGAINST THIS WESTERN IDEOLOGY.
MEANWHILE, IT HAS MOVED TO MODERNIZE ITS OWN PERCEPTIONS OF THE WORLD AND OF THE ROLE SHI'ISM CAN PLAY IN GOVERNING IRAN.

AS EXPLAINED BY SCHOLARS HERE, SHIA ISLAM TEACHERS NOT ONLY ADHERENCE TO THE UNCHANGING VALUES EMBODIED IN THE KORAN AND IN THE SUNNA (TRADITIONS OF THE DEEDS AND SAYINGS OF THE PROPHET) BUT ALSO THE NEED FOR REINTERPRETATION TO KEEP UP WITH CHANGING TIMES. THE PRINCIPLES OF ISLAMIC LAW THAT ARE CONCEIVED AS DYNAMIC IN THIS SENSE ARE "EJTEHAD," OR PHILOSOPHICAL REINTERPRETATION OF THE ETERNAL VERITIES, AND "EJMA" OR "CONSENSUS," I.E., AGREEMENT BY RELIGIOUS LEADERS THAT CERTAIN NEW INTERPRETATIONS ARE SANCTIFIED AND HAVE THE FORCE OF THE LAW.

WHAT THIS AMOUNTS TO IS A CONTINUING GRIP ON THE IRANIAN POPULATION BY A CLERICAL ORDER WHICH IS NUMEROUS, AT LEAST PARTIALLY MODERNIZING, SUPPORTED BY ITS OWN SOURCES OF FUNDS, AND ORGANIZING ITS OWN CHANNELS OF COMMUNICATION AMONG THE FAITHFUL. IT HAS BECOME CLEAR BEYOND ANY DOUBT THAT MOST OF THE BAZAAR MERCHANTS CONTINUE TO SUPPORT THE RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP WITH LARGE AND REGULAR CONTRIBUTIONS. MILLIONS OF DOLLARS PASS THROUGH THE HANDS OF THE TOP AYATOLLAHS EVERY DAY OR WEEK. THESE GO FOR A VARIETY OF GOOD WORKS AND SUPPORT THE "MOVEMENT."
AN EXAMPLE OF ORGANIZATION IN THIS REGARD IS A RELIGIOUS SCHOOL SYSTEM BEGUN 32 YEARS AGO BY AN AYATOLLAH WHO IS STILL ALIVE, WHICH HAS GROWN TO 1500 SCHOOLS SPREAD ALL OVER IRAN.

THE SCHOOL SYSTEM IS ENTIRELY SUPPORTED BY BAZAARI FUNDS, AND STUDENTS FROM PROMINENT RELIGIOUS, BAZAARI AND OTHER FAMILIES TAKE NOT ONLY THE ------------------051332 031219Z /10 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 3662 INFO AMEMBASSY AMMAN USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY CAIRO AMEMBASSY DAMASCUS AMCONSUL DHAHRAN AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS AMEMBASSY RABAT AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY SANA AMEMBASSY TEL AVIV AMEMBASSY TRIPOLI AMEMBASSY TUNIS SECTION 04 OF 04 TEHRAN 01691 REQUIRED GOVT COURSES, TAUGHT IN GOVT SCHOOLS, BUT ALSO SOME RELIGIOUS COURSES WHICH THE GOVT HAS BANNED IN ITS SCHOOLS.

AN EFFORT BY THE GOVT TO TAKE THESE SCHOOLS OVER A FEW YEARS AGO WAS SUCCESSFULLY RESISTED BY THE RELIGIOUS/ BAZAARI ESTABLISHMENT. ENOUGH UNIVERSITY PROFESSORS AND OTHER LEARNED PERSONS VOLUNTEER THEIR SERVICES TO SUCH SCHOOLS SO THAT THE STUDENTS GRADUATE WITH SUFFICIENTLY RESPECTABLE KNOWLEDGE AND CREDENTIALS TO ASSURE THEIR SUCCESS IN THE UNIVERSITIES. WE HAVE SEEN A WIDE VARIETY OF PAMPHLETS AND BOOKS PRODUCED FOR USE IN SUCH SCHOOLS WHICH INDICATE THE EXTENT OF ORGANIZATION IN THE MOSLEM COMMUNITY.

THERE IS LITTLE REASON TO BELIEVE THAT THE PROMINENT RELIGIOUS MILITANTS MUCH IN EVIDENCE ARE CRYPTO-COMMUNISTS, ALTHOUGH SUCH ILK MAY WELL HAVE INFILTRATED THE KHOMEINI CAMP FURTHER DOWN. THE ISLAMIC ESTABLISHMENT IS NEITHER AS WEAK NOR AS IGNORANT AS THE SHAH'S GOVT AND SOME WESTERN OBSERVERS WOULD PORTRAY IT. IT HAS A FAR BETTER GRIP ON THE EMOTIONS OF THE PEOPLE AND ON THE MONEY OF THE BAZAAR THAN ANY OTHER GROUP. IN MANY WAYS IT SUPPORTS A REFORMIST/TRADITIONALIST VIEW OF IRAN WHICH IS FAR MORE ATTRACTIVE TO MOST IRANIANS AT THIS TIME THAN THE MODELS OF COMMUNISM REPRESENTED BY THE SOVIET UNION OR MAINLAND CHINA.

ON THE OTHER HAND, IT IS NOT GUARANTEED TO OPERATE IN PARLIAMENTARY DEMOCRATIC FASHION AS WE UNDERSTAND IT IN THE WEST. IN FACT THE IDEA OF MERITOCRACY ("TAQVASALARI") IS SAID TO BE IMBEDDED DEEPLY IN ITS APPROACH. ELEMENTS OF AUTHORITY APPEAR TO BE COLLECTIVE (AS SUGGESTED BY THE PRINCIPLE OF "EJMA"), RATHER THAN REPOSING IN A SINGLE INDIVIDUAL, EVEN ONE MORE EQUAL THAT THE OTHERS, SUCH AS "IMAM" KHOMEINI. A GOOD DEAL OF AUTHORITY IS LIKELY TO BE EXERCISED BY AN "ISLAMIC COUNCIL," THOUGH THE MAKE-UP OF SUCH A COUNCIL IS STILL NOT CLEAR.

UNDER THE MOVEMENT'S PROGRAM, POLITICAL LEADERS RATHER THAN MULLAHS WOULD APPEAR DESTINED TO PLAY THE PREPONDERANT ROLE IN MAKING AND EXECUTING GOVT POLICY. THE IDEA THAT EXPERTS SHOULD BE JUDGED BY THE RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP AND THEN REINFORCED IN APPLYING THEIR EXPERTISE TO VARIOUS AREAS OF THE ECONOMY IS PART OF THE PROPOSED GOVERNING PROCESS, AS WE UNDERSTAND IT. THUS, ON THE SURFACE, IT WOULD APPEAR THAT THE WESTERNIZED PROCESS OF POLITICAL PARTIES VYING IN PARLIAMENT TO SET POLICY WOULD BE SUPPLEMENTED BY A MORE INFORMAL AND TRADITIONAL PROCESS TO DECISION-MAKING THROUGH VARIOUS GROUPS ACHIEVING CONSENSUS.

ALL THIS IS VAGUE AT THIS STAGE, HOWEVER, AND WE SUSPECT THE MOSLEM ESTABLISHMENT WOULD PROBABLY NOT BE ABLE TO AVOID MAKING SOME ACCOMMODATIONS WITH WESTERNIZED IDEAS OF GOVT HELD BY MANY IN THE OPPOSITION MOVEMENT. THIS WOULD BE LIKELY TO APPEAR OVER A PERIOD OF TIME RATHER THAN IMMEDIATELY. MEANWHILE, WE CAN EXPECT THAT THE ROLE OF A POST REVOLUTIONARY SHI'A ISLAMIC MOVEMENT WOULD HAVE BROAD POPULAR SUPPORT. IT WOULD PROBABLY RESIST COMMUNISM AS AN ALIEN IMPORT TO THE BEST OF ITS ABILITY, AS WELL AS RESISTING MANY OTHER ASPECTS OF WESTERNIZATION. ACCORDING TO PROMINENT LAWYER MATIN-DAFTARI, REVISED CONSTITUTION OF WHICH KHOMEINI IS SPEAKING IS NOT IN FINAL DRAFT AS SOME REPORTS HAVE IT. MATIN-DAFTARI BELIEVES IT IS SIMPLY A COLLECTION OF PRINCIPLES, WHICH HE HOPES WILL BE DISCUSSED FURTHER. HE NOTES BAR ASSOCIATION HEAD, NAZIEH, WHO IS STILL IN PARIS, HAS MADE SOME SUGGESTIONS. HOWEVER, NEITHER NAZIEH NOR MATIN-DAFTARI ARE VERY CENTRAL TO THE PROCESS (NEITHER IS THAT CLOSELY TIED TO THE RELIGIOUS MOVEMENT).

MATIN-DAFTARI REMAINS VERY BUSY ON BEHALF OF THE COMMITTEE FOR THE RELEASE OF POLITICAL PRISONERS, THE ASSOCIATION OF FREE IRANIAN JURISTS, AND THE BAR ASSOCIATION. HE CLAIMS TO HAVE AT LEAST 20 NAMES OF RELATIVELY MINOR POLITICAL PRISONERS WHO HAVE NOT YET BEEN RELEASED. HE SAYS ONE REASON IS THAT THEY ARE NOT BEING ACCORDED THE STATUS OF POLITICAL PRISONERS, ANY MORE THAN WERE MANY OF THOSE RELEASED.

IN FACT SOME OF THOSE RELEASED WERE RELEASED ON "TECHNICALITIES" AND THOSE BEING HELD ARE SIMILARLY BEING HELD ON "TECHNICALITIES." HE NOTES THE REMAINING ONES ARE FACING RELATIVELY LIGHT SENTENCES "2, 5, 10 YEARS" AND THEREFORE THEY ARE UNLIKELY TO BE HARD CORE TERRORISTS OR MURDERERS (AS PRIME MINISTER BAKHTIAR HAS CLAIMED REMAINDER ARE).

MATIN-DAFTARI SAID NEWEST PROJECT IS TRYING TO GET INFORMATION ON AIR FORCE HOMOFARS WHO HAVE BEEN ARRESTED ALL OVER THE COUNTRY. HE HAS NO INFORMATION THAT ANY OF THEM HAVE BEEN EXECUTED (AS OPPOSITION HAS CHARGED) AND AGREED WITH POL COUNSELOR THAT THIS WAS UNLIKELY. HOWEVER, THEIR FAMILIES, ON BEHALF OF WHOM MATIN-DAFTARI IS INQUIRING, ARE VERY ANXIOUS TO LEARN WHAT IS HAPPENING TO THEM. SITUATION IS GENERALLY QUIET, WITH NO REPORTS OF SIGNIFICANT DEMONSTRATIONS. CONSULATE ISFAHAN REPORTS SMALL MARCHING GROUPS BUT IN TEHRAN WE DO NOT EVEN HAVE LIGHT ACTIVITY. TRAFFIC IS RELATIVELY HEAVY IN BOTH TEHRAN AND ISFAHAN, AND ATMOSPHERE IS CALM. PRESS REPORTS, HOWEVER, THAT TWO PEOPLE DIED IN SEMNAN (PROVINCIAL CAPITAL EAST OF TEHRAN) YESTERDAY WHEN SECURITY FORCES OPENED FIRE FOLLOWING SOME KIND OF EXPLOSION.

AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI GAVE PRESS CONFERENCE TO FOREIGN NEWSMAN THIS MORNING, REPEATING MUCH THE SAME MESSAGE WHICH HE HAS SAID IN THE PAST BUT OFFERING UNCOMPROMISING POSITION ON THE TRANSITION TO ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. HE SAID THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL, WHICH WILL BE ANNOUNCED SOON (HE STILL GAVE NO NAMES) WILL SOON IN TURN APPOINT A PROVISIONAL GOVT. REFERENDUM WILL THEN TAKE PLACE TO APPROVE CONSTITUTION FOR AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC WHICH IS ALREADY PREPARED. WHILE KHOMEINI HIMSELF WAS INAUDIBLE AND EVEN FARSI-SPEAKING REPORTERS HAD TO DEPEND ON THE TRANSLATION, IT SEEMS CLEAR KHOMEINI CAMP HAS DISPENSED WITH PRIOR NOTION OF A CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY.

THEY HAVE APPARENTLY WRITTEN A CONSTITUTION (OR AT LEAST ITS MAIN PRINCIPLES) AND WILL SIMPLY PRESENT FOR A PLEBISCITE. IF THIS IS TO BE THE PROCEDURE, THERE IS LITTLE ROOM FOR COMPROMISE OR THE MODERATING INFLUENCE OF OTHERS. KHOMEINI ALSO SPOKE OF JIHAD BUT IN QUALIFIED TERMS: "WE WILL TRY TO SOLVE THE PROBLEM THROUGH NONVIOLENT MEANS, BUT IF THE ILLEGAL GOVT OF BAKHTIAR, SUPPORTED BY THE AMERICANS, CONTINUES TO DEFY THE WILL OF THE PEOPLE AND BRING IN FORCES FROM ISRAEL, THEN WE WILL TAKE OTHER MEASURES TO BRING IT DOWN." HE SAID THERE HAVE BEEN CONTACTS WITH THE MILITARY, WHO ARE BEING ASKED TO SUPPORT THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC.
WE UNDERSTAND THE QOM AYATOLLAHS ARE UNHAPPY WITH KHOMEINI'S CEMETARY SPEECH ON THURSDAY, IN PARTICULAR THE ANTI-FOREIGN AND INFLAMMATORY LANGUAGE REGARDING BAKHTIAR GOVT.

PRIMIN BAKHTIAR INVITED PARLIAMENTARIANS TO MEET WITH HIM TODAY. WE DO NOT KNOW THE SUBJECT, BUT IT LIKELY INVOLVES THE HEAVY PRESSURE FROM KHOMEINI FORCES FOR DEPUTIES TO RESIGN. ALL HAVE RECEIVED DEATH THREATS AND ONE, AS PREVIOUSLY REPORTED, HASBEEN SHOT. WE LEARN THAT A BLOCK OF 40 DEPUTIES IS CONSIDERING RESIGNING AS A GROUP, AND THERE MUST BE OTHERS AS WELL. ONE JOURNAL REPORTS THAT REGENCY COUNCIL MEMBER ALIABADI RESIGNED JAN 14. WE KNEW AT THAT TIME THAT HE ALONG WITH TEHRANI WAS CONSIDERING RESIGNATION, BUT TO OUR KNOWLEDGE ONLY TEHRANI ACTUALLY FOLLOWED THROUGH. WE CONSIDER THIS LAST REPORT TENTATIVE UNTIL CONFIRMED ELSEWHERE.

1979TEHRAN01701.subject: KHOMEINI REJECTS COMPROMISE; CONFRONTATION SET FOR TONIGHT

segments.text: FOR TONIGHT (S - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: IN INTENSIVE MEETING FEB 2, AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI REJECTED TWO COMPROMISE SOLUTIONS AND SAID HE WOULD ANNOUNCE "TEMPORARY" ISLAMIC GOVT UNDER PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN EVENING FEB 3. LIBERATION MOVEMENT (LMI) MAKING LAST-DITCH EFFORT TO GET BAKHTIAR TO ACCEPT POST OF WAR MINISTER AND TO CONVINCE ARMY TO GO ALONG. UNLESS SOMEBODY BLINKS, PROGNOSIS IS GRIM. END SUMMARY

AMIR ENTEZAM, SENIOR LMI OFFICIAL ASKED URGENTLY TO SEE POLOFF STEMPEL AFTERNOON FEB 3. ENTEZAM OPENED MEETING BY ANNOUNCING THAT HE HAD MET WITH BAKHTIAR FOR TWO HOURS EVENING FEB 2 AND HAD SECURED HIS AGREEMENT TO TWO ALTERNATIVE COMPROMISE PROPOSALS TO RESOLVE PRESENT IMPASSE BETWEEN GOI AND KHOMEINI. ONE CALLED FOR BAKHTIAR TO REMAIN AS PRIME MINISTER AND CALL FOR IMMEDIATE REFERENDUM ON WHETHER COUNTRY WANTED MONARCHY OR ISLAMIC REPUBLIC: SECOND CALLED FOR BAKHTIAR TO RESIGN AND REMAIN AS CARETAKER WHILE SAME REFERENDUM CARRIED OUT.

AT LATER 10 P.M. MEETING WITH KHOMEINI AND HIS MAJOR SUPPORTERS, ENG. BAZARGAN AS LMI LEADER ARGUED FOR ACCEPTANCE OF EITHER COMPROMISE. AFTER LONG AND STRIDENT MEETING (ENTEZAM WAS PRESENT), KHOMEINI SAID HE COULD ACCEPT NEITHER COMPROMISE. BAKHTIAR AS PM WAS OUT BECAUSE HE HAD RECEIVED MANDATE FROM SHAH; GOI HAD TO GO, ALONG WITH REGENCY COUNCIL BECAUSE THEY WERE "ILLEGAL." ONLY ALTERNATIVE, THEREFORE, WAS TO PROCEED TO NAME "TEMPORARY" ISLAMIC GOVT TO SUPERVISE REFERENDUM. ANNOUNCEMENT WOULD COME EVENING FEB 3 AND INCLUDE ONLY NAME OF BAZARGAN AS PRIME MINISTER; ANNOUNCEMENT OF OTHER CABINET MEMBERS WOULD BE DELAYED UNTIL BAZARGAN "CONSULTED" HIS COLLEAGUES. MILITARY WOULD HAVE TO GO ALONG.

EMBOFF REACTED STRONGLY, BUT CALMLY, NOTING THAT THIS WOULD PROBABLY MEAN CIVIL WAR, OR AT MINIMUM, MILITARY MOVE AGAINST KHOMEINI. ENTEZAM REPLIED, "THAT'S RIGHT, BUT WHAT CAN WE DO?" IN REPLY TO QUESTION, ENTEZAM SAID DECISION APPEARED TO BE KHOMEINI'S ALONE; HE KNEW AT LEAST ONE ADVISOR (YAZDI) WAS FOR COMPROMISE. OTHER RELIGIOUS LEADERS PRESENT ARGUED AGAINST CONFRONTATION, BUT FORCE OF KHOMEINI PERSONALITY AND "JUST PLAIN STUBBORNESS" PREVAILED IN THE END. (COMMENT: KHOMEINI IS MAJOR CHARISMATIC FIGURE IN ISLAMIC MOVEMENT, AND WHILE MANY HAVE DIFFERED WITH HIM, NONE HAVE AS YET STOOD UP TO HIM.)

ENTEZAM ASKED WHAT COULD BE DONE. EMBOFF REPLIED ONLY WAY OUT SEEMED TO BE TO GET KHOMEINI TO UNDERSTAND NATURE OF FORCE THIS MOVE WOULD PULL IN AGAINST HIM AND GET HIM TO COMPROMISE. THERE WAS ALWAYS POSSIBILITY BAKHTIAR AND GENERALS COULD BE CONVINCED TO GO ALONG WITH THIS, BUT EMBOFF TOLD ENTEZAM BLUNTLY THAT THIS APPEARED TO BE A NON-STARTER, SINCE RESIGNATION OF PRIME MINISTER WOULD END CONSTITUTIONAL GOVT AND OPEN WAY FOR INDEPENDENT MILITARY ACTION.

WHEN ASKED IF LMI HAD HAD FURTHER MEETINGS WITH CHIEF OF STAFF GHARABAGHI, ENTEZAM SAID LMI WAS TRYING TO SCHEDULE ONE "TODAY OR TOMORROW." EMBOFF REPLIED TOMORROW WOULD BE TOO LATE IF ANNOUNCEMENT WERE IN FACT BEING MADE TONIGHT. ENTEZAM SAID HE WAS MEETING WITH BAKHTIAR IN LATE AFTERNOON AND WOULD BE CONTACTING ARMY WITH BAZARGAN IN ATTEMPT TO GET BOTH ARMY AND PRIME MINISTER TO GO ALONG. ENTEZAM PROMISED TO BE IN TOUCH FURTHER AS SITUATION UNFOLDED.

COMMENT AND ANALYSIS: ABOVE GOES CONTRARY TO ALL PREDICTIONS THAT COMPROMISE WOULD SUCCESSFULLY EMERGE, AND SUGGESTS THAT WHATEVER CONSULTATIONS KHOMEINI HAS HAD WITH SO CALLED MODERATE MULLAHS HAVE EITHER FAILED TO CONVINCE HIM OF NECESSITY OF CONSTITUTIONAL SOLUTION, OR ELSE HE HAS SIMPLY DUG IN HIS HEELS (WHICH WOULD BE VERY MUCH IN CHARACTER). ENTEZAM LEFT IMPRESSION THAT FURTHER APPEAL TO KHOMEINI WAS USELESS. THERE IS CHANCE, THOUGH REPORTING OFFICER WOULD RATE IT VERY SMALL, THAT ENTEZAM WAS JUST TRYING OUT THIS SOLUTION ON USG TO SEE WHAT OUR REACTION WAS. IF SO, HE RETAINED SOLID IMPRESSION THAT WE THOUGHT MILITARY WOULD MOVE IF ALTERNATIVE GOVT WAS DECLARED.

ENTEZAM APPEARED GRIM AND RESIGNED. EMBOFF URGED HIM IN STRONGEST TERMS TO SEE IF ANNOUNCEMENT OF "TEMPORARY" ISLAMIC GOVT COULD NOT BE POSTPONED AND SITUATION TALKED OUT FURTHER. HE WAS NONCOMMITTAL BUT CLEARLY PESSIMISTIC. WE SHARE HIS PESSIMISM; IF ANNOUNCEMENT GOES FORWARD AND IF ARMY REACTS BY ARRESTING THOSE ------------------051796 031336Z /50 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 3669 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 01701 EXDIS INVOLVED IN "TEMPORARY" GOVT, WE COULD BE INTO CIVIL VIOLENCE SCENARIO VERY QUICKLY. IF BAKHTIAR IGNORES ANNOUNCEMENT, CONFRONTATION SCENARIO IS STILL LIKELY TO CREEP UP ON US INCREMENTALLY IF "TEMPORARY" ISLAMIC GOVT TRIES TO TAKE CONTROL OF KEY INSTALLATIONS AND EXERCISE AUTHORITY.

1979TEHRAN01728.subject: ZOROASTRIAN SIZES UP THINGS DR. BAUZARJAMEHR MEHR, MEMBER OF PARLIAMENT IN HIS CAPACITY AS REPRESENTATIVE OF THE ZOROASTRIAN COMMUNITY IN

segments.text: DR. BAUZARJAMEHR MEHR, MEMBER OF PARLIAMENT IN HIS CAPACITY AS REPRESENTATIVE OF THE ZOROASTRIAN COMMUNITY IN IRAN, MET WITH ICA RESOURCE CENTER DIRECTOR AND PAO DECEMBER 30, AFTER HAVING RECEIVED THEIR ASSISTANCE ON A STUDENT MATTER. IN DISCUSSING HIS OWN SITUATION AND THAT OF THE COMMUNITY HE REPRESENTS, DR. MEHR MADE THE FOLLOWING POINTS: --THERE ARE SOME 40,000 ZOROASTRIANS IN IRAN, MAINLY IN TEHRAN WHERE THERE ARE THREE TEMPLES. ALTHOUGH LOCATED IN DISTURBED PARTS OF THE CITY, THESE HAVE NOT BEEN DESECRATED IN ANY WAY AND ATTENDANCE AT WEEKLY SERVICES HAS BEEN HIGH.

THE COMMUNITY IS, HOWEVER, VERY NERVOUS AND ANTICIPATES HARRASSMENT AND GREATER DISCRIMINATION THAN HERETOFORE SHOULD AN ISLAMIC STATE BE DECLARED. --MEHR SAID HE HAD RECEIVED A TELEPHONE CALL THAT MORNING FROM AN UNIDENTIFIED PERSON WHO URGED HIM TO RESIGN IN RESPONSE TO KHOMEINI. NO EXPLICIT THREAT WAS MADE, BUT THE IMPLICATION WAS THAT HE, MEHR AND HIS COMMUNITY, WOULD BE IN JEOPARDY IF HE DIDN'T. MEHR'S PLAN IS TO DISCUSS THE MATTER WITH THE MAJLIS SPEAKER AND DETERMINE WHETHER THERE WAS TO BE A UNIFORM RESPONSE.

HE ADDED THAT MAJLIS DEPUTIES DO NOT HAVE SECURITY GUARDS. --WHILE ADMIRING BAKHTIAR'S SPUNK, MEHR SEES LITTLE HOPE FOR HIM OR FOR THE COUNTRY IN FACT. HE SPOKE NOSTALGICALLY OF THE DAYS OF THE SHAH WHEN AT LEAST THERE WAS SOME SENSE
(S - ENTIRE TEXT).

JOHNNY GRAHAM, NEWLY ARRIVED BRITISH AMBASSADOR, CALLED ON ME MORNING FEBRUARY 4. HE DESCRIBED HIS LETTERS OF CREDENCE AS BEING WITHOUT ADDRESSEE, AND SAID HE HOPED HE HAD PERSUADED FOREIGN MINISTER TO LET HIM FUNCTION WITHOUT A PRESENTATION CEREMONY.

HE THEN SAID HE EXPECTED TO MAKE CALLS ON BOTH BAKHTIAR AND BAZARGAN, AND, IN THAT WAY, TO KEEP A FOOT IN BOTH CAMPS. I ALERTED HIM TO FACT BAKHTIAR WOULD PROBABLY PRESS HIM TO KNOW WHICH GOVERNMENT UK WOULD RECOGNIZE, IN EVENT THERE WERE TWO RIVAL GOVERNMENTS ESTABLISHED HERE IN NEAR FUTURE.

GRAHAM WAS CURIOUSLY VAGUE IN ANSWERING THIS, CITING THE STANDARD BRITISH CRITERION OF "EFFECTIVE CONTROL" IN DETERMINING THE GOVERNMENT TO BE CONSIDERED LEGITIMATE. I SAID EFFECTIVE CONTROL MIGHT BE HARD TO DEFINE IF ONE GOVERNMENT, IN A NEGATIVE SENSE, CONTROLLED SECURITY AND ANOTHER GOVERNMENT, IN A NEGATIVE SENSE, CONTROLLED THE ECONOMY. GRAHAM AGREED AND SAID HE SUPPOSED UK WOULD SUPPORT BAKHTIAR, BUT WOULD NOT RPT NOT GO DOWN WITH THE SHIP.

GRAHAM THEN TOLD ME THAT IRAN WAS CENTRAL ITEM ON AGENDA DAVID OWEN WAS DISCUSSING IN WASHINGTON. HE SAID TONY PARSONS WAS ALONG FOR THAT PURPOSE AND HE ASSUMED LONDON CONSIDERED THESE TALKS QUITE IMPORTANT. WE DISCOVERED THAT NEITHER HE NOR I HAD ANY READOUT FROM WASHINGTON DISCUSSIONS.
COMMENT: I GATHER FROM GRAHAM'S AMBIVALENCE THAT LONDON HAS DECIDED TO PUT SOME DISTANCE BETWEEN UK POSITION AND BAKHTIAR, IN ANTICIPATION OF LATTER'S COLLAPSE.
ACTION REQUESTED: PLEASE PROVIDE SOONEST ESSENTIAL POINTS IN DISCUSSIONS OWEN AND PARSONS HAVE HELD WITH

1979TEHRAN01744.subject: (S) KHOMEINI AND LIBERATION MOVEMENT (LMI) PULL BACK

segments.text: (S - ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY: KHOMEINI HELD UP ANNOUNCEMENT OF "TEMPORARY" GOVERNMENT. LMI WORKING OUT NEW STRATEGY WHICH IT WILL TRY AND SELL BAKHTIAR AND MILITARY OVER NEXT TWO DAYS. LMI WANTS MORE MEETINGS WITH U.S. "SPIRIT OF PALAVER" MAY HAVE FINALLY TAKEN HOLD. END SUMMARY.

LMI'S AMIR ENTEZAM, FEELING MUCH PERKIER THAN YESTERDAY TOLD POLOFF STEMPEL THAT EXPECTED ANNOUNCEMENT OF "TEMPORARY" ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT EVENING FEB 3 WAS POSTPONED FOR "TWO OR THREE DAYS," AS A RESULT OF INTENSIVE DISCUSSIONS FEB 3, INCLUDING ENTEZAM'S MEETING WITH EMBOFF. ENTEZAM SAID KHOMEINI AND BAZARGAN LATE EVENING FEB 3 AGREED TO HIS SUGGESTION THAT ANNOUNCEMENT, WHEN MADE, INCLUDE NAMES OF AT LEAST SOME (AND PROBABLY ALL) PROJECTED MINISTERS. WITHIN A DAY OR TWO AFTER MINISTERS ARE ANNOUNCED, REAR ADMIRAL MADANI, KHOMEINI NOMINEE FOR MINISTER OF INTERIOR (WHO WAS BAKHTIAR'S FIRST CHOICE, UNTIL HE HIMSELF REFUSED) WOULD GO TO MINISTRY AND BEGIN TO PREPARE FOR REFERENDUM ON MONARCHY.
NO OTHER MINISTERS WOULD ATTEMPT TO TAKE OFFICE.

IN RESPONSE TO QUESTION, ENTEZAM SAID HE WAS MEETING WITH PRIME MINISTER BAKHTIAR EVENING FEB 4 AT 8 P.M. TO CONVINCE HIM TO GO ALONG WITH THE MOVE AT LEAST BY "IGNORING" MADANI'S ASSUMPTION OF DUTIES RELATED TO REFERENDUM. WHETHER THIS WAS SUCCESSFUL OR NOT, LMI HAD BEEN ABLE TO SCHEDULE A MEETING BETWEEN KHOMEINI RELIGIOUS LEADER SEYED MOHAMMAD BEHESHTI AND BAZARGAN ON LMI SIDE AND CHIEF OF STAFF GENERAL GHARABAGHI AND SAVAK CHIEF GEN MOGHADDAM FOR 6 P.M. FEB 5.

IN THAT MOST PANGLOSSIAN OF ALL WORLDS, ALL WOULD AGREE TO LET MADANI FUNCTION, AND MINISTRY OF INTERIOR WOULD THEN SCHEDULE REFERENDUM "7 TO 10 DAYS LATER" IN WHICH QUESTION WOULD BE "DO YOU FAVOR MONARCHY OR ISLAMIC REPUBLIC?" GOI WOULD CALL FOR INTERNATIONAL OBSERVERS, PROBABLY FROM U.N. HUMAN RIGHTS COMMISSION. AFTER REFERENDUM WAS HELD (WITH EXPECTED OVERWHELMING VICTORY FOR ISLAMIC REPUBLIC), INTERIOR MINISTRY WOULD SCHEDULE NEW PARLIAMENTARY ELECTIONS IN ONE TO TWO MONTHS. NEW SENATE AND MAJLES WOULD THEN CONVENE IMMEDIATELY AS CONSTITUTIONAL ASSEMBLY TO REWRITE CONSTITUTION ALONG LINES OF REFERENDUM VOTE.

IF BAKHTIAR REFUSES TO ALLOW MADANI TO OPERATE AS MINISTER (ENTEZAM STRESSED HE NEED NOT TAKE POSITIVE ACTION, JUST NOT TAKE NEGATIVE ACTION), THEN LMI WOULD GRADUALLY SEND ALL MINISTERS TO THEIR MINISTRIES TO "GO TO THE WORKERS AND SOLICIT THEIR SUPPORT." REPLYING TO QUESTION, ENTEZAM THOUGHT THIS STOOD A GOOD CHANCE OF LIMITING POTENTIAL VIOLENCE AND THOUGHT MILITARY MIGHT EVEN DECIDE TO GO ALONG WITH LMI EVEN IF BAKHTIAR DID NOT.

BRAINSTORMING POTENTIAL PROBLEMS, ENTEZAM SAID LMI WAS PREPARED TO GO AHEAD WITH THIS IDEA WITHOUT EVEN CONSULTING KHOMEINI. EMBOFF EXPRESSED SKEPTICISM THAT THIS WOULD WORK, BUT ENTEZAM SAID TOP LMI LEADERSHIP WAS SURE THAT KHOMEINI WOULD NOT OBJECT TO "DETAILS" AFTER HE HAD ANNOUNCED "TEMPORARY" ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT. ASKED WHETHER PM MIGHT INSIST ON NOMINATING MADANI AS HIS INTERIOR MINISTER, ENTEZAM SAID THIS MIGHT CAUSE PROBLEMS WITH KHOMEINI BUT WOULD BE FINESSABLE IF BAKHTIAR DELAYED ANNOUNCEMENT FOR A COUPLE OF DAYS. (COMMENT: WHILE THINGS MIGHT WORK OUT AS LMI PLANS THEM IN THIS STRANGEST OF WORLDS, WE SEE SEVERAL OPPORTUNITIES (ABOVE) FOR GLITCHES TO OCCUR.
ENTEZAM SEEMED CONFIDENT, HOWEVER, THAT "MANY THINGS" WERE ACHIEVABLE IF CARRIED OUT IN SLOW AND MEASURED MANNER.)

ENTEZAM THEN REFERRED TO EARLIER EMBOFF OFFER TO INTRODUCE ENTEZAM TO ECONOFF TAYLOR AND SUGGESTED FOURWAY LUNCH WITH TWO EMBOFFS, HIMSELF AND ABDUL BANISADR, WHOM HE CONFIRMED AS ONE OF LEADING ECONOMIC SPOKESMEN FOR KHOMEINI (PRESS HAD CARRIED STATEMENT TO THIS EFFECT MORNING FEB 3). ENTEZAM THEN SAID ENG BAZARGAN DESIRED MEETING WITH AMB SULLIVAN EVENING FEB 6 TO FOLLOW UP ON EARLIER DISCUSSION.

EMBOFF ASKED WHEN ANNOUNCEMENT WAS GOING TO BE MADE ON "TEMPORARY" ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT AND THOUGHT, SPEAKING PERSONALLY, THAT AMBASSADOR MIGHT HAVE SOME DIFFICULTY MEETING WITH PUTATIVE PM-DESIGNATE ------------------057194 041531Z /42 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 3698 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 01744 EXDIS BAZARGAN, WHILE MEETING WITH PRIVATE CITIZEN BAZARGAN WOULD PROBABLY POSE NO REAL PROBLEM. ENTEZAM GOT THE POINT AND SAID ANNOUNCEMENT OF "TEMPORARY" GOVERNMENT COULD CERTAINLY BE DELAYED UNTIL MORNING FEB 7. EMBOFF AGREED TO PASS REQUEST ON TO AMBASSADOR.

COMMENT AND ANALYSIS: MEETINGS PAST TWO DAYS WITH LMI OFFICIALS TRULY REFLECT ROLLER COASTER AIR OF POLITICS HERE. MANIC DEPRESSIVE CYCLE NOT RPT NOT LIMITED TO LMI ALONE, HOWEVER, AND CONFUSION OVER LINES OF AUTHORITY IN KHOMEINI CAMP REMAINS INTENSE. BOTH ENTEZAM AND MINATCHI (IN SEPARATE DISCUSSION FEB 4) REFLECTED FACT CONFUSION WAS ACTUALLY AIDING INTEGRATION OF PARIS AND LOCAL STAFFS. BOTH WERE ALSO MUCH MORE CONFIDENT TODAY THAT "SPIRIT OF PALAVER" RATHER THAN SPIRIT OF CONFRONTATION WAS BEGINNING TO TAKE HOLD. ABOUT 24 HOURS AGO, ENTEZAM WAS NOT RPT NOT SO SURE THIS WOULD BE THE CASE.
NEXT STEP IN LATEST LMI INITIATIVE WILL AWAIT OUTCOME OF LMI'S CONSULTATIONS WITH PRIME MINISTER AND LATER LMI TALKS WITH MILITARY. SULLIVAN
(S - ENTIRE TEXT).

PRIOR TO HIS DEPARTURE FROM TEHRAN, ERICH VON MARBOD HAD LONG, CANDID CONVERSATION WITH GENERAL TOUFANIAN, WHO, AS OLDEST OFFICER ON ACTIVE SERVICE, IS SOMETHING OF EMINENCE GRISE TO IRANIAN OFFICER ESTABLISHMENT.

TOUFANIAN MADE CLEAR TO VON MARBOD THAT HE WAS VERY NERVOUS IN CURRENT SITUATION AND WANTED TO LEAVE THE COUNTRY. HE SAID HE SAW NO RPT NO CHANCE FOR BAKHTIAR TO SURVIVE, AND SAID OTHER SENIOR OFFICERS SHARED HIS VIEW.
TOUFANIAN SAID MOST IMPORTANT THING WAS TO AVERT COLLISION BETWEEN ARMED FORCES AND KHOMEINI. HE SAID THAT SOME NEGOTIATED COMPROMISE TO THE CURRENT IMPASSE WAS ESSENTIAL.

IF COMPROMISE FAILED AND KHOMEINI CALLED FOR JEHAD, TOUFANIAN SAID, ALL SENIOR OFFICERS WOULD "LEAVE IN THE SAME PLANE." HE POINTED OUT THAT ALL OF THEM ALREADY HAD THEIR FAMILIES OUT OF THE COUNTRY AND COULD LEAVE RAPIDLY. "OTHERS" WOULD THEN TAKE OVER THE ARMED FORCES AND MAKE PEACE WITH KHOMEINI.

WHEN VON MARBOD PRESSED FOR DETAILS, TOUFANIAN SAID GENERAL GARABAGHI WAS NOT RPT NOT PREPARED TO CONFRONT KHOMEINI. GENERAL AZERBIZIN OF AIR FORCE HAD ALREADY WORKED OUT PRIVATE DEAL WITH KHOMEINI TO TAKE OVER FROM RABII, ETC.

IN ELABORATING ON ALL THIS, TOUFANIAN SAID VON MARBOD SHOULD REALIZE THAT EVENTS OF RECENT WEEKS HAVE RADICALLY CHANGED SENIOR GOI MILITARY OFFICERS. "THEY ARE NO LONGER THE SAME MEN. THEY CAN'T BE TRUSTED. THEY WILL TELL YOU ONE THING AND DO SOMETHING ELSE."

IN SEPARATE CONVERSATION WITH GENERAL GAST FEBRUARY 4, TOUFANIAN ALSO SPOKE OF "EVACUATION PLANS" FOR SENIOR MILITARY LEADERS. HOWEVER, GAST UNDERSTOOD THIS TO MEAN THAT, IN ACCORDANCE WITH AN OLD IRANIAN DEKENSE PLAN (PRESUMABLY AGAINST INVASION), THE GENERALS WOULD SHIFT THEIR HEADQUARTERS TO THE SOUTHERN REDOUBT AND FIGHT ON FROM THERE.

COMMENT: TOUFANIAN, WHOSE HANDS ARE PROBABLY NOT ENTIRELY CLEAN ON CORRUPTION, IS OBVIOUSLY FRIGHTENED OF THE NEAR FUTURE. IT IS THEREFORE POSSIBLE THAT HE TRANSFERS HIS OWN MOTIVES AND ATTITUDES TO HIS MILITARY COLLEAGUES. HOWEVER, BECAUSE OF HIS SENIORITY AND HIS CLOSE ASSOCIATIONS WITH THE CURRENT MILITARY LEADERSHIP, HIS OBSERVATIONS DESERVE WEIGHT, ESPECIALLY WHEN GIVEN IN CONFIDENCE TO AN OLD FRIEND LIKE VON MARBOD.

1979TEHRAN01748.subject: OPPOSITION LEADER SANJABI COMMENTS ON CURRENT SITUATION

segments.text: SITUATION (C ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: IN CAGEY CONVERSATION SANJABI EXPRESSED OPINION THAT KHOMEINI HAS GIVE UP IDEA OF AN ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL OR OF LARGE CONSTITUTIONAL CONVENTION. HE SEEMS TO BE BACK ON THE INSIDE TRACK WITH KHOMEINI, THOUGH NOT REVEALING THIS TO US. HE OPINED NEW REPUBLIC WOULD HAVE STRONG PRESIDENT AND CONVENTIONAL PARLIAMENT (NOT SPECIAL ISLAMIC COUNCIL). END SUMMARY

AT MEETING REQUESTED BY SANJABI FEB 3 HE COMMENTED IN GUARDED FASHION TO POL COUNSELOR ON CURRENT SITUATION. HE SAID HE THOUGHT KHOMEINI HAD WANTED SANJABI ON HIS ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL. SANJABI HAD NEVER CATEGORICALLY TURNED DOWN THIS INVITATION, BUT THOUGHT THERE WAS NO NEED FOR A COUNCIL. APPARENTLY KHOMEINI HAS HEEDED THIS ADVISE AND WILL NOT ANNOUNCE ANY ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL. SANJABI CLAIMED NOT TO KNOW WHO MIGHT BE ON THE ISLAMIC GOVT TO BE ANNOUNCED BY KHOMEINI.

FOROUHAR HAD HAD QUITE A FEW MEETINGS WITH KHOMEINI IN PARIS INCLUDING SOME ALONE WITHOUT ADVISORS. KHOMEINI HAD SPOKEN OF A DESIRE TO CALL A SORT OF CONSTITUTIONAL CONVENTION FROM REPRESENTATIVES OF ALL PARTS OF THE COUNTRY AND ALL WALKS OF LIFE, BUT FOROUHAR HAD DESCRIBED THE PROBLEMS INVOLVED AND HE THOUGHT KHOMEINI HAD GIVEN UP THAT IDEA.

COMMENTING ON THE CONSTITUTION, SANJABI SAID HE THOUGHT LAWYER NAZIEH IS WRITING IT IN PARIS. HE WAS NOT PUT OFF BY A SUGGESTION FROM POL COUNSELOR THAT A FRIEND OF NAZIEH'S HAD OPINED NAZIEH'S ROLE IS PERIPHERAL NOT CENTRAL (MATIN-DAFTARI, SEE TEHRAN 1698). WHEN ASKED WHETHER KHOMEINI ENVISAGES PRESIDENTIAL TYPE OF REPUBLIC OR ONE IN WHICH PRIME MINISTER HOLDS THE POWER, SANJABI SAID HE HAD THE FEELING IT WAS THE PRESIDENTIAL TYPE. AS AN EXAMPLE HE MENTIONED THE U.S. SYSTEM ALTHOUGH POL COUNSELOR HAD ACTUALLY BEEN THINKING OF THE FRENCH FIFTH REPUBLIC SYSTEM.

SANJABI TALKED OF A FUTURE PARLIAMENT AS QUITE SIMILAR TO PAST ONES. IN FACT, HE OPINED THE PRESENT PARLIAMENT IS NOT SO DIFFERENT FROM MANY WHICH HAVE TAKEN OFFICE SINCE MOSSADEQ'S DAY. THE FIRST PARLIAMENT AFTER THE CREATION OF A REPUBLIC IS LIKELY TO HAVE A LARGE PERCENTAGE OF MULLAHS ELECTED BUT OTHERWISE HE THOUGHT THE ELECTIONS WOULD NOT BE SO DIFFERENT FROM THE PAST. SANJABI SAID THAT IN HIS MEETING A FEW MONTHS AGO IN PARIS HE HAD REMINDED KHOMEINI THAT AS RECENTLY AS 1963 KHOMEINI HAD NOT BEEN CALLING FOR THE DEPARTURE OF THE SHAH BUT SIMPLY ASKING THE SHAH TO ACT AS A CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCH.

THIS WAS WHAT MOSSADEQ TOO WANTED. HE HAD ALSO REMINDED KHOMEINI THAT RELIGIOUS PEOPLE WERE VERY PROMINENT IN THE ESTABLISHMENT OF THE 1906-07 CONSTITUTION. THIS BUSINESS ABOUT CHANGING THE CONSTITUTION AND TERMING ALL THE REST ILLEGAL WAS FAIRLY NEW WITH KHOMEINI. (COMMENT: SANJABI WAS SILENT ON KHOMEINI'S REACTION.)

SANJABI REITERATED WHAT HE HAD TOLD US BEFORE THAT AS FAR AS THE NATIONAL FRONT AND HE HIMSELF ARE CONCERNED HE HAD ALWAYS FAVORED MOSSADEQ'S IDEA THAT A MONARCHY IS MORE SUITABLE FOR IRAN IN ITS GEOGRAPHIC AND HISTORICAL CONTEXT THAN A REPUBLIC. WHEN ASKED, HE SAID HE HAD NOT YET HAD A CHANCE TO TALK WITH THE AYATOLLAH. (COMMENT: SEE BELOW.) IN RESPONSE TO ANOTHER QUESTION HE SAID THE AYATOLLAH SEEMED TO BE IN GOOD HEALTH, WELL PRESERVED FOR A MAN OF 78 YEARS OR SO. HE LAUGHED AT POL COUNSELOR'S COMMENT THAT HE TOO IS WELL PRESERVED AT 74.

SANJABI DWELT ON THE POPULARITY OF THE NATIONAL FRONT IDEA AMONG INTELLECTUALS, TEACHERS, ETC. WHO ARE NOT VERY TAKEN WITH THE IDEA OF AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. HE SAID HE HAD BEEN CARRIED ON THE SHOULDERS OF SOME DEMONSTRATORS ON THE DAY KHOMEINI ARRIVED. HE WAS VAGUE ABOUT CONTACTS WITH BAZARGAN AND THE LMI GROUP, BUT SAID THESE WERE CONTINUING.

COMMENT: WE HAVE PRETTY GOOD INFORMATION FROM ANOTHER SOURCE THAT SANJABI HAS BEEN INVOLVED IN SECRET, VERY CLOSE CONSULTATIONS WITH KHOMEINI ALONG WITH BAZARGAN AND A FEW OTHER TOP KHOMEINI LEADERS. HE WAS NOT WILLING TO REVEAL THIS TO US. PERHAPS HE IS STILL FEELING HIS WAY CAUTIOUSLY NOW THAT HE APPEARS TO BE ACCEPTED,ALBEIT AS A NEW MEMBER, IN KHOMEINI'S INNER GROUP.

IF INDEED THIS IS THE REASON FOR HIS PLAYING IT SO CAGEY WITH US, IT ------------------057226 041540Z /50 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 3703 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 01748 WOULD SUGGEST HIS OPINIONS ON THE SHAPE OF INSTITUTIONS UNDER THE NEW ISLAMIC REPUBLIC ARE REASONABLY AUTHORITATIVE. AT THE SAME TIME HE CLEARLY WANTS TO PLAY A SEPARATE GAME WITH THE EMBASSY, AS WITNESS HIS ASSERTING A PREFERENCE FOR A CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCHY RATHER THAN A REPUBLIC.

YESTERDAY CALLED ON DOCK WORKERS TO HALT THEIR STRIKE IN ORDER TO PREVENT GRAVE LOSSES TO THE NATION. DECISION CAME IN LIGHT OF FACT THAT, AFTER TWO MONTHS, SUCH SUPPLIES MAY BE SOLD AT AUCTION IN NON-IRANIAN PORTS.

STRIKE SUPERVISION COMMITTEE ALSO CALLED ON CUSTOMS TO CLEAR AGRICULTURAL PRODUCTS, ESPECIALLY GRAINS, AND SPECIFICALLY ------------------057268 041610Z /42 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 3706 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY BONN AMEMBASSY CAIRO AMCONSUL DHAHRAN IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY DOHA AMCONSUL FRANKFURT AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS USLO PEKING AMEMBASSY RABAT USLO RIYADH IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY TOKYO USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC SECTION 03 OF 03 TEHRAN 01749 INSTRUCTED AGENTS TO CLEAR APPROXIMATELY 1000 TRUCKS WHICH ARE STRANDED AT THE TURKISH BORDER.
WE DO NOT YET KNOW WHETHER ANY OF THESE APPEALS WILL BE HEEDED BY STRIKERS.

ABDUL BANI SADR IS APPARENTLY EMERGING AS AN ECONOMIC SPOKESMAN FOR KHOMEINI. HIS PLANS FOR NATIONALIZATION OF BANKS, EMPHASIS ON PETROCHEMICAL INDUSTRY, CANCELLATION OF FOREIGN DEBT, HEAVY TAXES ON IMPORTED SPARE PARTS, AND OTHER MEASURES, ALL REPORTED IN RECENT INTERVIEW WITH FRENCH JOURNAL, RECEIVED UNFAVORABLE EDITORIAL COMMENT HERE. BANI SADR IS ADDRESSING A GATHERING AT TECHNICAL UNIV TODAY.

NEW TERRORIST GROUP CALLING ITSELF "SUICIDE COMMANDO OF THE IRANIAN CONSTITUTION" ISSUED COMMUNIQUE YESTERDAY VOWING EXECUTION OF THOSE, STARTING WITH KARIM SANJABI, WHO ARE "IN THE PAY OF MOSCOW". CLAIMING 15,000 MEMBERS WITHIN IRAN AND MANY MORE ABROAD, THE COMMANDO WILL FIGHT ALL FORMS OF DICTATORSHIP, EVEN IF THESE COME FROM THE GOVT OF BAKHTIAR. AS FOR THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC, IT HAS BEEN RECOMMENDED TO KHOMEINI "BY MEMBERS OF HIS ENTOURAGE WHO ARE MOTIVATED BY MERCANTILE INTERESTS AND WHO ACT ON ORDERS THEY RECEIVE FROM MOSCOW." THUS FAR THIS GROUP OF "15,000" HAS NOT CARRIED OUT ITS THREATS.
RADIO IRAN ANNOUNCED ARREST OF TWO FORMER MINISTERS, HOUSHANG NAHAVANDI (SCIENCE AND HIGHER EDUCATION) AND ABDOL-MAJID MAJIDI (PBO) LAST NIGHT. THEY ARE CHARGED WITH ABUSE OF POWER AND CORRUPTION.
ABOUT MIDDAY TODAY EMBOFF WITNESSED ORDERLY DEMONSTRATION OF ABOUT 300 PEOPLE AGAINST BAKHTIAR IN FRONT OF INTERCONTINENTAL HOTEL (WHERE MOST FOREIGN PRESSMEN STAY).

CONSULATE TABRIZ REPORTS SOME FIGHTING NEAR UNIVERSITY BETWEEN ISLAMIC AND LEFTIST GROUPS. AUTHORITIES HAD ADVANCE NOTICE OF THE CONFRONTATION AND EXPECTED WORSE CLASH THAN ACTUALLY DEVELOPED. CONSUL REPORTS MARXISTS FEEL INCREASINGLY LEFT OUT IN THE COLD, AND THEIR FRUSTRATION IS LIKELY TO CAUSE FURTHER TROUBLE. SULLIVAN

RSO HAS REQUIREMENT FOR 20 LARGE SHEETS OF STEEL PLATING TO BE SHIPPED TO TEHRAN EARLIEST. DIMENSIONS OF THESE SHEETS SHOULD BE APPROXIMATELY FOUR (4) FOOT WIDE AND EIGHT (8) FEET LONG. THICKNESS SHOULD BE NO MORE THAN 3MM (OR LESS THAN 1/4-INCH).

PROJECT INVOLVES COVERING TWO LARGE GRILLED METAL GATES CONTROLLING COMPOUND ACCESS. ONCE COMPLETED, STREET VISIBILITY OF COMPOUND WILL BE NEGLIGIBLE. AT SAME TIME PLATING WILL FOIL ROCKS, MISSILES, AND OTHER OBJECTS THROWN FROM OUTSIDE.
SUCH MATERIAL IS NORMALLY AVAILABLE THROUGH IRANIAN CHANNELS. HOWEVER, DUE TO ECONOMIC SITUATION (STRIKES, SHUTDOWNS, ETC.) AND ANTI-AMERICAN FEELINGS, PLATING NOT PROCURABLE.
REQUEST INFORMATION CONCERNING (A) AVAILABILITY OF STEEL PLATING AT YOUR POST (B) FEASIBILITY OF SHIPPING THESE STEEL SHEETS VIA MAC FLIGHT CHANNELS. REPLY SOONEST.
(S - ENTIRE TEXT).
I SPENT OVER AN HOUR WITH PRIME MINISTER BAKHTIAR AT NOON FEBRUARY 5. HE BEGAN WITH A FEW JOCULAR REMARKS AND I CONGRATULATED HIM ON HIS RADIO INTERVIEW OF PREVIOUS EVENING.

HE THEN TURNED TO TELLING ME OF HIS CONTACTS WITH THE KHOMEINI CAMP. HE SAID THAT SO MANY PEOPLE HAD BEEN COMING TO HIM THAT IT HAD GROWN CONFUSING. FINALLY, WHEN BEHESHTI CALLED HIM LAST EVENING, HE ASKED THAT THERE BE A SINGLE POINT OF CONTACT. WHEN BEHESHTI ASKED WHOM HE PREFERRED, BAKHTIAR SAID BAZARGAN. BEHESHTI PROMISED HIM BAZARGAN WOULD COME TO SEE HIM THIS EVENING.

AT THIS POINT, I SAID I HAD JUST LEARNED THAT KHOMEINI INTENDED TO NAME BAZARGAN "PROVISIONAL PRIME MINISTER" AT 1700 HOURS THIS AFTERNOON. BAKHTIAR SAID THAT WOULD CAUSE DIFFICULTIES. HE COULD NOT RPT NOT SEE BAZARGAN AS A RIVAL PRIME MINISTER, EVEN THOUGH HE WOULD ALWAYS SEE HIM AS AN OLD FRIEND. THE TELEPHONE RANG WITH GENERAL GARABAGHI ON THE OTHER END SAYING THAT HE UNDERSTOOD BAZARGAN WOULD BE NAMED PRIME MINISTER AT 1700 AND THAT THE MILITARY WOULD THEREFORE HAVE TO CANCEL THE SESSION WITH HIM THAT WAS SCHEDULED FOR 1800.

I SAID THIS WOULD ALSO POSE PROBLEM FOR ME. BAZARGAN HAD ASKED TO SEE ME AT 1900 FEBRUARY 6. I HAD SENT WORD I WOULD ALWAYS BE PLEASED TO SEE HIM AS PRIVATE IRANIAN CITIZEN, BUT THAT, IF HE WERE NAMED "PRIME MINISTER" BY KHOMEINI, I WOULD HAVE TO SEEK WASHINGTON GUIDANCE. (I DID NOT RPT NOT KNOW AT THIS TIME THAT BAZARGAN HAD WITHDRAWN FROM THIS MEETING.) BAKHTIAR SAID HE WOULD ENCOURAGE ME TO MEET WITH BAZARGAN AS A PRIVATE CITIZEN, BUT, IF HE CLAIMS TO BE A PRIME MINISTER, HE HOPED I WOULD SEND ONE OF MY OFFICERS.

THIS THEN LED TO A DISCUSSION OF WHAT BAZARGAN WANTED TO SEE ME ABOUT. WE EXAMINED POSSIBILITY HE WANTED TO LEAD ME TO KHOMEINI. BAKHTIAR DIDN'T THINK MUCH OF THAT. HE FINALLY CONCLUDED BAZARGAN WANTED ME TO PRESSURE BAKHTIAR TO RESIGN AND THE MILITARY TO CAPITULATE. HE SAID HE WOULD NEVER RESIGN AND HE HOPED WE WOULD NOT RPT NOT PRESSURE MILITARY TO CAPITULATE. I ASSURED HIM WE WOULD NOT.

BAKHTIAR THEN DISCUSSED THE TACTICS HE INTENDS TO PURSUE IF KHOMEINI PROCLAIMS A BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT. HE SAID THAT IF BAZARGAN ALONE IS NAMED AND KHOMEINI THEN WITHDRAWS TO QOM, HE FEELS THERE IS REASONABLE CHANCE THE TWO OF THEM CAN WORK OUT COMPROMISE WITHOUT CONFRONTATION. IF, ON OTHER HAND, A WHOLE CABINET IS NAMED, IT COULD BE MORE COMPLEX.

IN ANY EVENT, AFTER HE SEES RESULT OF KHOMEINI'S PRESS CONFERENCE, HE MAY GO ON THE RADIO TO ANNOUNCE HIS INTENTIONS. BASICALLY, HE PROPOSES TO IGNORE THE "PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT" UNLESS IT SEEKS TO CHALLENGE HIM IN AN EXECUTIVE SENSE. IF, FOR EXAMPLE, IT UNDERTAKES TO SETTLE THE CUSTOMS STRIKE, OR GET THE BANKS WORKING AGAIN, HE WILL CONSIDER THAT A CONSTRUCTIVE EFFORT AND NOT RPT NOT A CHALLENGE, BECAUSE THE PEOPLE AND HIS OWN GOVERNMENT WILL PROFIT BY SUCH ACTIONS. HOWEVER, IF A MINISTER SEEKS TO TAKE OVER A MINISTRY, HE WILL BE ARRESTED.

IN ANY CASE, HOWEVER, HE HAD DECIDED NEVER TO ARREST BAZARGAN. THIS WAS NOT ONLY OUT OF PERSONAL RESPECT AND 25 YEARS FRIENDSHIP FOR BAZARGAN, BUT ALSO BECAUSE HE DID NOT WISH TO CREATE A MARTYR FOR KHOMEINI. HE KNEW THAT BAZARGAN DID NOT RPT NOT WISH TO MAKE THIS CHALLENGE AND WAS A RELUCTANT OPPONENT.

HE SAID, IN FACT, THAT MOST OF THE SO-CALLED KHOMEINI CAMP WITHIN IRAN HAD BECOME STRONGLY ANTI-KHOMEINI AFTER THEIR DISCUSSIONS WITH HIM SINCE HIS RETURN FROM PARIS. THEY FOUND HIM INFLEXIBLE, DICTATORIAL, AND UNREALISTIC. FOR EXAMPLE, SAHABI HAD COME TO HIM YESTERDAY AND WEPT IN FRUSTRATION.

ADMIRAL MADANI, WHO IS SLATED TO BE KHOMEINI'S MINISTER OF INTERIOR AND RUN THE ELECTIONS, CAME TO HIM IN NERVOUS FEAR AND BEGGED BAKHTIAR NOT RPT NOT TO ARREST HIM. ------------------060962 051435Z /41 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 3744 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 01799 NODIS/CHEROKEE EYES ONLY FOR THE SECRETARY BAKHTIAR ASSURED HIM HE WOULD BE ARRESTED IF HE TRIED TO ENTER THE MINISTRY.

BAKHTIAR ALSO INSISTS HIS SUPPORT IS GROWING DAILY AS MORE AND MORE PEOPLE BECOME EXPOSED TO KHOMEINI. HE SAID THAT INTELLECTUALS, MULLAHS AND MANY OTHERS WERE BEGINNING TO SPEAK OUT. HE ENCOURAGED KHOMEINI TO HOLD MORE PRESS CONFERENCES, BECAUSE HE WOULD SOON DO HIMSELF IN. BAKHTIAR HAS SCHEDULED PRESS CONFERENCE FOR HIMSELFFEBRUARY 8 IN WHICH HE INTENDS TO USE A "LOT OF IRONY" IN HANDLING THE KHOMEINI PERFORMANCE.

COMMENT: THIS PROGNOSIS SUGGESTS WE WILL BE SOON ENTERING AN EPISODE OF TWO RIVAL GOVERNMENTS, HEADED BY TWO CLOSE PERSONAL FRIENDS WHO WOULD LIKE TO FIND A COMPROMISE, BUT WHO WILL BE IMPEDED FROM THEIR INSTINCTS UNTIL KHOMEINI WITHDRAWS FROM THE SCENE. THE MAJOR ISSUE WILL BE TO AVOID ARMED ACTION BETWEEN THEIR RESPECTIVE SUPPORTERS WHILE THIS GAME IS PLAYED OUT. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN01800.subject: KHOMEINI TO ANNOUNCE ISLAMIC GOVT TODAY

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: LIBERATION MOVEMENT (LMI) OFFICIAL SAYS KHOMEINI WILL ANNOUNCE "TEMPORARY" ISLAMIC GOVT THIS EVENING (FEB 5) AT 5 P.M. (TEHRAN TIME) SCHEDULED PRESS CONFERENCE. LMI CHIEF AND LEADING KHOMEINI RELIGIOUS FIGURE ARE SCHEDULED TO MEET WITH TOP MILITARY LEADERSHIP AT SIX P.M. FEB 6, MAJLES IS EXPECTED TO CALL FOR VOTE OF NO CONFIDENCE IN BAKHTIAR. SOURCE SAID LMI IS PREPARED FOR MILITARY REACTION, BUT HOLDING ITS BREATH THAT MILITARY WILL RESPOND BY EITHER IGNORING ANNOUNCEMENT OR MERELY ARRESTING ONE OR TWO TOP FIGURES. END SUMMARY

AMIR ENTEZAM, SENIOR LMI OFFICIAL WHO HAS BEEN ENGAGED IN NEGOTIATIONS WITH PRIME MINISTER BAKHTIAR, SAID TWOHOUR MEETING WITH PRIME MINISTER EVENING FEB 4 HAD BEEN "COMPLETELY NEGATIVE." BAKHTIAR HAD REJECTED ALL OF KHOMEINI CAMP'S "COMPROMISE" IDEAS (SEE REFTELS), LEAVING AYATOLLAH WITH "NO CHOICE BUT TO PROCEED" WITH ANNOUNCEMENT OF "TEMPORARY" ISLAMIC GOVT AT FEB 5 SCHEDULED PRESS CONFERENCE AT 5 P.M. ANNOUNCEMENT WILL INCLUDE MEHDI BAZARGAN AS PRIME MINISTER, AND "AT LEAST SOME" OF MINISTERS.

ISLAMIC MOVEMENT IS PREPARED TO SUFFER CONSEQUENCES OF THIS STEP, BUT HOPES THEY WILL NOT BE TOO GRAVE. ENG. MEHDI BAZARGAN AND KHOMEINI RELIGIOUS LEADER HOJATOLLAH SEYED MOHAMMAD BEHESHTI ARE TO MEET WITH GENERAL GHARABAGHI AND GENERAL MOGHADDAM AT 6 P.M., FOLLOWING PRESS CONFERENCE, AND ENTEZAM EXPRESSED STRONG LMI HOPE THAT THEY WILL BE ABLE TO INDUCE MILITARY NOT RPT NOT TO TAKE VIOLENT ACTION.

ASSUMING MILITARY AND PRIME MINISTER FOLLOW THEIR STATED POLICY AND MERELY IGNORE ANNOUNCEMENT, BAZARGAN AND KEY MINISTERS WILL CALL ON MINISTRY EMPLOYEES MORNING FEB 6 TO EXPELL OLD MINISTERS AND LET NEW ONES COME TO WORK. ENTEZAM INTIMATED NEW "GOVT" IS PREPARED TO OPERATE BY TELEPHONE FOR AWHILE TO MINIMIZE CONFRONTATION.

MAJLES IS SCHEDULED TO MEET FEB 6, AND INTENTION OF HOUSE IS TO PASS BILLS ABOLISHING SAVAK AND SETTING UP CORRUPTION COURTS. LMI THEN PLANS TO HAVE ITS SUPPORTERS CALL FOR A DEBATE AND VOTE OF NO CONFIDENCE IN BAKHTIAR GOVT. MAJLES SPEAKER HAS SAID HE WILL COOPERATE, AND EXPECTS SAFE, BUT NOT OVERWHELMING, MAJORITY TO UNSEAT GOVT. NEXT MOVE, IF THERE IS NO MILITARY REACTION, IS TO HAVE MAJLES VOTE IN BAZARGAN. THIS WILL BE PRECEDED BY TALKS WITH REGENCY COUNCIL, IN HOPES THAT COUNCIL WILL AGREE TO GO ALONG WITH BAZARGAN OR ELSE FOLD ITSELF UP.

COMMENT AND ANALYSIS: ENTEZAM WAS SO CONFIDENT ANNOUNCEMENT WOULD TAKE PLACE, HE SAID BAZARGAN WOULD NOT ATTEND MEETING SOUGHT WITH AMBASSADOR FOR EVENING FEB 6. HE INDICATED LMI WOULD BE REPRESENTED BY MULLAH MOUSAVI, HOJATOLLAH BEHESHTI, AND HIMSELF, IN DEFERENCE TO AMBASSADOR'S WISHES NOT RPT NOT TO MEET WITH BAZARGAN IF HE HAD BEEN NAMED PRIME MINISTER. ENTEZAM MADE RITUALURGING FOR EMBASSY TO URGE GOI MILITARY TO REMAIN CALM, BUT HIS OWN SELF-CONFIDENCE, UP A GOOD 70 PERCENT FROM PAST TWO DAYS, SUGGESTS INDIRECTLY THAT LMI THINKS IT HAS, OR CAN GET, A DEAL WITH THE MILITARY. SULLIVAN

EMBASSY HAS NOTHING ON FILE, BUT IT STRIKES US THAT THIS LATIFI MAY BE THE SAME AS HAJI LATIFI, MENTIONED BY NEW SOURCE COL. ZARRABI (SEE TEHRAN 1684). WE HAVE INDEPENDENTLY HEARD OF HIM AS AN INFLUENTIAL FIGURE WITH THE RELIGIOUS PEOPLE. ACCORDING TO ZARRABI, THE GOVT TOOK OVER THREE RELIGIOUS SCHOOLS HE HAD, AND HE NOW LIVES ON THE RENT PAID HIM FOR THEM. SULLIVAN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SOURCE (COL. ZARRABI) CALLED FEB 5 TO TELL POL COUNSELOR THAT HAJI LATIFI SENT MULLAH NASSER MAKAREM TO TALK WITH SHARIAT-MADARI AND OTHER QOM AYATOLLAHS A COUPLE OF DAYS AGO. HE BROUGHT BACK THE MESSAGE THAT THEY BELIEVE KHOMEINI WILL INVITE THEM TO COME TO TEHRAN BECAUSE "HE FINDS HIMSELF ALONE THERE." THEY WILL COME VERY SOON AND HOPE TO ASSIST IN KHOMEINI'S NEGOTIATIONS WITH BAKHTIAR. REPORTEDLY, THEY WILL INVITE PRIME MINISTER TO COOPERATE WITH THEM, ADDRESSING HIM AS "OUR DEAR SON." ZARRABI EXPRESSED THE HOPE (PRESUMABLY ON THEIR BEHALF) THAT IT WOULD BE USEFUL IF THE PRIME MINISTER CEASED MAKING PUBLIC STATEMENTS IN THE MEANWHILE.

POL COUNSELOR THANKED ZARRABI FOR THIS INFORMATION, THOUGH NOTING THAT EVENTS SEEM TO BE MOVING PRETTY FAST IN THE KHOMEINI CAMP WITH PUBLIC PROMISES THAT A KHOMEINI SHADOW GOVT MIGHT BE ANNOUNCED AS EARLY AS TODAY. HE SAID NOTHING IN REPLY TO THE "HOPE" THAT BAKHTIAR STAY SILENT. POL COUNSELOR ALSO NOTED SHARIAT-MADARI'S INTERVIEW PUBLISHED IN KAYHAN INTERNATIONAL TODAY, WHICH SEEMED TO BE TAKING A SOMEWHAT INDEPENDENT LINE. ZARRABI SAID THAT INTERVIEW WOULD BE BEST FORGOTTEN.

COMMENT: WE TAKE THIS REPORT WITH A GRAIN OF SALT AS WE DO ALL REPORTS WHICH PURPORT TO COME FROM SHARIATMADARI AND THE QOM AYATOLLAHS. WE DO NOT DOUBT THEY ARE SCARED AND HOPE TO MODERATE KHOMEINI. ZARRABI IS TRYING TO TELL US THAT THEY WILL BE MODERATING KHOMEINI. PAST EXPERIENCE INDICATES THEY ARE FAR MORE LIKELY TO DO

(C) SUMMARY: COLLISION COURSE CONTINUES WITH BAKHTIAR STANDING PAT AND KHOMEINI FORCES PLANNING NAME THEIR OWN SHADOW GOVERNMENT AND SEEK OBTAIN MAJLIS NO-CONFIDENCE VOTE ON BAKHTIAR'S. RENEWED ANTI-GOVERNMENT TERRORIST VIOLENCE AND NEW PRO-GOVERNMENT TERRORIST GROUP ANNOUNCED. END SUMMARY.

(C) KHOMEINI SOURCES HAVE INDICATED THE AYATOLLAH MAY ANNOUNCE SHADOW CABINET AT PRESS CONFERENCE CALLED FOR LATE THIS AFTERNOON. LMI SOURCE HAS CONFIRMED THIS TO EMBASSY. MEANWHILE, LMI TOLD US PM EARLY THIS MORNING REJECTED FORMULA INVOLVING JOINT APPOINTMENT OF MINISTERS. THUS SHOWDOWN CONTINUES. LATEST LMI PLOY ACCORDING TO EMBASSY SOURCE REPORTEDLY IS TO HAVE PARLIAMENT INITIATE DEBATE TOMORROW AND VOTE NO CONFIDENCE IN BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT IN DUE COURSE.

(U) KAYHAN INTERNATIONAL (KI) AND TEHRAN JOURNAL (TJ) REPORT PM BAKHTIAR INTERVIEW WITH TEHRAN RADIO IN WHICH PM DECLARED THAT HE IS "AS LEGAL AS MOSSADEGH" AND SAID THAT WHILE HE WOULD TOLERATE "SHADOW CABINET" OF SORT THAT IS COMMON IN PARLIAMENTARY SYSTEMS HE WOULD NOT TOLERATE MORE THAN ONE GOVERNMENT IN IRAN.

(U) KI TODAY CARRIED FRONT-PAGE INTERVIEW WITH AYATOLLAH SHARIAT-MADARI. PROMINENT PHOTOGRAPH OF AYATOLLAH IS CAPTIONED "IT'S EASY TO BE A RADICAL OUTSIDE A DICTATORIAL REGIME, BUT UNDER THREATS FROM GUNS ONE HAS TO RESORT TO DIFFERENT TACTICS." ACCORDING TO KI, SHARIAT-MADARI DECLARED THAT THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC HAS BEEN MISUNDERSTOOD AND "WILL BE LIKE ANY OTHER REPUBLIC. BUT SINCE THE MAJORITY OF OUR PEOPLE ARE MUSLIMS, IT IS NATURAL THAT OUR REPUBLIC WOULD HAVE AN ISLAMIC ORIENTATION. BUT OF COURSE THERE WOULD BE LIMITS TO HOW FAR EVEN SUCH AN ORIENTATION CAN GO." THOSE WHO CALL HIM A MODERATE AND KHOMEINI A RADICAL, SAID THE AYATOLLAH, MISTAKE TACTICS FOR PRINCIPLES.
AIMS ARE IDENTICAL BUT HE HAS HAD TO USE TACTICS SUITABLE UNDER A "REPRESSIVE, DICTATORIAL REGIME".

A MODERN ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT, SHOULD IT COME TO POWER IN IRAN, WOULD BE VERY DIFFERENT FROM THAT OF THE PROPHET OR OF IMAM ALI: "THEY WERE GOD'S APPOINTED REPRESENTATIVES, WHEREAS NOW, WHEN NO PROPHET OR IMAM EXISTS, THE LEADERS OF SUCH A GOVERNMENT WILL BE ORDINARY MEN ELECTED AND DISMISSED BY OTHER MEN." HE REJECTED CLAIMS BY SOME THAT THEY REPRESENT THE TRUE SPIRIT OF ISLAM, SAYING THAT HE BELIEVES NO ONE HAS THE RIGHT TO CLAIM SUCH A MONOPOLY ON THE TRUE INTERPRETATION OF ISLAM. "IN REGARD TO IMPLEMENTATION OF ISLAMIC TENETS INTO SOCIAL AND POLITICAL REALITY," HE ADDED, "THE IRANIAN PEOPLE SHOULD BE CONSULTED THROUGH A REFERENDUM AND FREE ELECTIONS." HE CALLED THE QUESTION OF REPRESENTATION OF RELIGIOUS MINORITIES IN AN ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT "AN EXTREMELY COMPLICATED AND IMPORTANT ISSUE ON WHICH ONLY EXPERTS COULD PRONOUNCE JUDGMENTS," BUT ADDED THAT "EVERYONE, MUSLIM OR CHRISTIAN" WOULD HAVE A SAY IN RUNNING SUCH A GOVERNMENT.
HE DENIED RUMORS THAT HE WOULD MOVE TO TABRIZ, BUT INDICATED HE MIGHT VISIT BECAUSE HE HAS NOT DONE SO FOR SOME TIME.

(U) RADIO AND PRESS REPORT ARREST OF GHOLAM REZA KIANPOUR, MIN INFORMATION AND TOURISM UNDER HOVEYDA AND MIN JUSTICE UNDER HOVEYDA AND AMOUZEGAR, TO ADD TO ARRESTS OF NAHAVANDI AND MAJIDI REPORTED YESTERDAY. THE THREE FORMER MINISTERS WERE CHARGED UNDER ARTICLE 5 OF THE MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS. PM BAKHTIAR DISCLOSED THAT TEHRAN MAYOR SHAHRESTANI, WHO SUBMITTED HIS RESIGNATION TO KHOMEINI, WAS AWARE THAT HE HAS LONG BEEN UNDER INVESTIGATION FOR CORRUPTION, AND MAY SOON BE ARRESTED. THERE ARE RUMORS OF MORE ARRESTS TO COME.

(C) LAST NIGHT MOLOTOV COCKTAILS WERE TOSSED INTO COURTYARD OF BUILDING IN WHICH UPI OFFICE IS LOCATED, BUT CAUSED NO RPT NO INJURY OR SERIOUS DAMAGE. A MAN CALLED UPI FIVE MINUTES LATER TO SAY THIS WAS WORK OF TOUHID GROUP OF MUJAHEDDIN-E-KHALQ. A FEW DAYS EARLIER UPI HAD BEEN WARNED OF REPRISALS BECAUSE OF THEIR "LOW ESTIMATE" OF NUMBER KILLED ON BLOODY SUNDAY (JAN. 28). UPI HAS MOVED OUT TO INTERCON HOTEL TO AVOID UPSETTING COOCCUPANTS OF BUILDING BUT IS IN QUANDARY OVER WHAT IT CAN DO TO OVERCOME "LOSS" OF DIRECT OVERSEAS LINE IN ITS OFFICE.

(COMMENT: EITHER THIS SLOPPY BIT OF WORK WAS NOT DONE BY MUJAHEDDIN'S FIRST TEAM, OR INTENT WAS JUST TO FRIGHTEN. WE SUSPECT LATTER FACTOR IS MOST IMPORTANT AS RELIGIOUS MOVEMENT HAS NOT BEEN IN HABIT OF MANHANDLING PRESS.)

(U) SELF-IDENTIFIED REPRESENTATIVE OF "COMMANDO ORGANIZATION OF WARRIORS OF THE CONSTITUTION" AGAIN CALLED AP TO WARN IT WOULD ASSASSINATE ANYONE WHO JOINS KHOMEINI'S PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT OR REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL AS WELL AS MAJLIS MEMBERS WHO RESIGNED IN RESPONSE TO KHOMEINI'S CALL. ON OTHER SIDE KI REPORTS THAT "RADICAL REVOLUTIONARY GROUPS" SET FIRE TO HOUSE OF MAJLIS DEPUTY MOHAMMAD HASSAN ABBAS MIRZA'I AND THAT CAMPAIGN OF THREATENING PHONE CALLS TO DEPUTIES WHO HAVE NOT RESIGNED HAS INTENSIFIED.

1979TEHRAN01867.subject: SITUATION AT THE IRANIAN EMBASSY IN WASHINGTON

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT)

DEPUTY FOREIGN MINISTER ZELLI INFORMED MINISTERCOUNSELOR ON FEB 6 THAT AMBASSADOR ZAHEDI'S ASSIGNMENT IN WASHINGTON WILL BE TERMINATED ON THE 17TH OF FEBRUARY AND THAT A SENIOR DIPLOMATIC OFFICIAL WILL BE ASSIGNED AS CHARGE D'AFFAIRES. THAT OFFICIAL WILL BE ASSAD HOMAYOUN.

WHEN THE MINISTER-COUNSELOR INFORMED ZELLI OF THE ANTICIPATED ACTION BY AMBASSADOR ZAHEDI TO REMOVE HOMAYOUN AND AT LEAST TWO OTHER OFFICERS FROM THE DIPLOMATIC LIST, ZELLI STATED THAT "FOR THE TIME BEING THE CHANNEL OF COMMUNICATIONS WITH THE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN IS THROUGH THE AMERICAN EMBASSY IN TERHRAN." HE THEN CHECKED DIRECTLY WITH THE FOREIGN MINISTER AND STATED THAT ANY NOTE FROM THE IRANIAN EMBASSY IN WASHINGTON REMOVING OFFICERS FROM THE DIPLOMATIC LIST IS "NOT VALID." HE SUGGESTED THAT THOSE OFFICERS WHO WERE INVOLVED COULD STAY HOME UNTIL THE 18TH OF FEBRUARY AND AT THAT TIME RESUME THEIR OFFICIAL FUNCTIONS.

TO EMPHASIZE, HE SAID, AS FAR AS THE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN IS CONCERNED THESE OFFICERS ARE ON THE DIPLOMATIC STAFF OF THE EMBASSY AND HAVE DIPLOMATIC PRIVILEGES. HE SAID THAT THE DEPARTMENT COULD INFORM MR. HOMAYOUN THAT THE GOVERNMENT CONSIDERS HIM AND THE OTHERS AS PART OF IRAN'S DIPLOMATIC ESTABLISHMENT IN WASHINGTON. INSTRUCTIONS WILL BE SENT SEPARATELY TO HOMAYOUN BY THE
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)

MINISTER-COUNSELOR CALLED ON DEPUTY FOREIGN MINISTER ZELLI FEB 6 AT THE REQUEST OF THE LATTER. ZELLI STATED THAT FOREIGN MINISTER HAD ANNOUNCED IN PRESS CONFERENCE THAT IRAN WILL LEAVE CENTO. HE THEN CLARIFIED THAT THE FOREIGN MINISTER WILL PROPOSE TO THE CABINET THAT IRAN END ITS CENTO TIES AND THAT HE EXPECTED THE GOVERNMENT TO ACCEPT THIS RECOMMENDATION. THE CESSATION OF TIES WITH CENTO WOULD BE CARRIED OUT ACCORDING TO THE TERMS OF THE TREATY.

QUOTING FROM THE FOREIGN MINISTER, ZELLI SAID "IRAN IN THE FUTURE WILL NOT BE AN APPENDIX OF WEST OR EAST." IRAN WILL WANT, HE CONTINUED, FRIENDLY, CLOSE AND HEALTHY RELATIONSHIP WITH THE UNITED STATES, BUT THEY WILL NOT BE AS FULL AS BEFORE. PERSONALLY HE THOUGHT THAT A NATIONALISTIC AND INDEPENDENT IRAN COULD HAVE VERY VERY SATISFACTORY TIES WITH THE UNITED STATES.

ZELLI THEN POINTED OUT THAT THE FOREIGN MINISTER "HAD NOT MENTIONED" THE 1959 BILATERAL AGREEMENT AND THAT HE ASSUMED, THEREFORE, THAT IRAN'S ACTION IN ANNOUNCING ITS WITHDRAWAL FROM CENTO WOULD NOT AFFECT THAT AGREEMENT. THE MINISTER-COUNSELOR REVIEWED FOR DR. ZELLI THE RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN CENTO TREATY, THE EISENHOWER MIDDLE EAST RESOLUTION, THE LONDON DECLARATION AND THE 1959 BILATERAL, BUT ADDED THAT WE COULD DISCUSS THIS MATTER FURTHER AFTER THE EMBASSY HAD RECEIVED INSTRUCTIONS. SULLIVAN

SUMMARY: KURDISH DEMOCRATIC PARTY (KDP) REPRESENTATIVE ALI-SULAIMAN CONFIRMED OBSERVATIONS (REF A) THAT KURDS WERE SUFFERING ALONG WITH OTHERS FROM RECENT IRANIAN VIOLENCE. HE ALSO DESCRIBED ATTEMPTED ASSASSINATION OF MASSOUD BARZANI IN VIENNA 15 DAYS AGO AND PUSHED HARD FOR AFFIRMATIVE U.S. RESPONSE ON NEW KURDISH REFUGEE PROGRAM. ALI-SULAIMAN SAID TALABANI FACTION WAS GROWING STRONGER AND MADE USUAL PLEA FOR U.S. HELP ON BEHALF OF BARZANI GROUP. ACTION REQUESTED: REPLY TO SULAIMAN'S QUERY ON ANY NEW KURDISH REFUGEE PROGRAM THAT WASHINGTON MIGHT CONTEMPLATE (PARA 6 BELOW). ALSO, REPLY TO OUR SUGGESTION THAT UNHCR AND MORE ACTIVE ICRC REPRESENTATION HERE WOULD BE HELPFUL.

KDP REPRESENTATIVE ALI-SULAIMAN CALLED ON POLOFF FEB 3 TO REVIEW KURDISH SITUATION, WHICH HE HAD PARTIALLY DISCUSSED WITH CONSUL-GENERAL SEVERAL DAYS EARLIER. ALISULAIMAN CONFIRMED THAT KURDS ARE SUFFERING AS A RESULT OF RECENT VIOLENCE AND POLITICAL UNREST WHICH HAS GRIPPED IRAN. AS FUEL OIL SUPPLIES HAVE GONE DOWN AND FACTORIES CLOSED, KURDISH WORKERS, ALONG WITH OTHERS, HAVE BECOME UNEMPLOYED. THERE HAS BEEN NO DIRECT DISCRIMINATION IN THIS PROCESS, BUT AS MANY KURDS WERE "LAST-HIRED", THEY HAVE ALSO BEEN "FIRST-FIRED." GOI RELIEF PAYMENTS TO KURDS VIRTUALLY CEASED AT BEGINNING OF MOHARRAM (DEC 2, 1978), AND RESULTANT CONFUSION HAS LEFT MANY KURDISH REFUGEES WITHOUT USUAL HANDOUT.
KDP HAS TRIED TO HELP OUT, BUT IT CANNOT DO EVERYTHING.

IN RESPONSE TO QUESTION WHETHER KURDS HAD BEEN DISCRIMINATED AGAINST MORE THAN OTHERS, ALI-SULAIMAN SAID THEY, AS ALL FOREIGNERS, HAD FELT WARM BREATH OF IRANIAN XENOPHOBIA. IT DEPENDED VERY MUCH ON LOCAL CONDITIONS AND LOCAL OFFICIALS. MANY WERE TOLERANT AND HELPFUL; SOME WERE NOT.

IN PASSING, ALI-SULAIMAN DESCRIBED ATTEMPTED ASSASSINATION OF MASSOUD BARZANI, SON OF GENERAL BARZANI, IN VIENNA JUST OVER TWO WEEKS AGO. MASSOUD AND TWO FRIENDS WERE RIDING IN A CAR WHEN MEN IN ANOTHER VEHICLE ATTACKED THEM WITH GUNS. MASSOUD ESCAPED HARM, BUT TWO FRIENDS WERE WOUNDED. AFTER THEY RECOVERED, AUSTRIAN POLICE FOILED SECOND ATTEMPT AT AIRPORT WHILE MASSOUD AND HIS FRIENDS WERE LEAVING. ALI-SULAIMAN SAID KDP SOURCES BELIEVED BOTH ATTEMPTS WERE WORK OF IRAQI INTELLIGENCE.

CITING ABOVE PROBLEMS, ALI-SULAIMAN SAID HE HAD HEARD NO MORE ABOUT POSSIBLE NEW KURDISH REFUGEE PROGRAM BY U.S. WAS THERE GOING TO BE A NEW PROGRAM OR NOT? EMBOFF REPLIED HE HAD HEARD NOTHING BUT WOULD QUERY WASHINGTON. (DEPT-HA: PLEASE CONSIDER YOURSELF QUERIED.. WOULD APPRECIATE STATUS REPORT ON KURDISH REFUGEE PROGRAM.) ALI-SULAIMAN SAID MANY KURDS WISHED TO GO TO U.S., EVEN THOSE WHO HAD BEEN SETTLED. EMBOFF EXPRESSED SYMPATHY WITH THEIR POSITION AND NOTED OTHER MINORITIES WERE HAVING PROBLEMS, TOO. ALI-SULAIMAN SAID HE WISHED KURDISH LOBBY IN U.S. WAS AS EFFECTIVE AS SOME OTHERS. EMBOFF REPLIED DRYLY IT HAD NOTHING TO BE ASHAMED OF.

ALI-SULAIMAN REPEATED HIS USUAL COMMENTS ABOUT THE JALAL TALABANI FACTION GROWING STRONGER AT BARZANI'S EXPENSE AND SAID IRAQI-TURKISH FRONTIER IS NOW PRETTY WELL POPULATED BY BARZANI GROUPS, WHILE TALABANI HAD SHIFTED AROUND TO THE IRAN-IRAQ BORDER, WHERE KDP SOURCES INSIST HE IS GETTING HELP FROM IRANIAN TUDEH GROUPS. (COMMENT: FIRST TIME WE HAVE HEARD THIS, BUT WOULD WELCOME COMMENTS FROM OTHERS. TALABANI FORCES WERE BLAMED FOR ONE CURIOUS KURDISH ATTACK ON A GENDARMERIE POST A COUPLE OF WEEKS AGO, BUT THAT INCIDENT HAS NEVER BEEN EXPLAINED.)

FOR STATE: REF C SUGGESTS PERHAPS EXTENT OF DISORGANIZATION IN IRAN NOT FULLY APPRECIATED BY ALL ------------------074794 061730Z /50 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 3794 INFO AMCONSUL TABRIZ USMISSION GENEVA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY DAMASCUS AMEMBASSY VIENNA SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 01869 OFFICES IN DEPARTMENT. REGRET WE HAVE NOT REPORTED MORE SPECIFICALLY ON THIS BEFORE. HOWEVER, UNDP, WHICH HANDLES ADMINISTRATION FOR UNHCR, HAS VIRTUALLY CLOSED DOWN AND SENT MOST OF ITS STAFF OUT OF THE COUNTRY; UNHCR OFFICE ITSELF DOES NOT ANSWER ITS TELEPHONES AND UNHCR HAS NO REPRESENTATIVE HERE NOW.

WE HAVE NOT MADE CONTACT WITH ICRC REPS HERE IN CHAOS OF PAST THREE-FOUR MONTHS BUT ARE PLEASED TO HEAR (REF C) THAT THEY STILL RETAIN A PRESENCE. THEY HAVE NOT SOUGHT US OUT (GENEVA MIGHT WISH TO DO SOMETHING ABOUT THIS IF IT WOULD BE USEFUL.). A FEW DAYS AGO, I REPORTED MY VIEW THAT EVENTS IN IRAN HAD BECOME UNPREDICTABLE. WHILE THAT IS STILL MY VIEW, I SHALL ATTEMPT, IN THIS CABLE, TO SET OUT SOME OF THE CONTINGENT POSSIBILITIES INHERENT IN THE CURRENT SITUATION.

FIRST, WE SHOULD DESCRIBE THE SITUATION. IRAN HAS TWO RIVAL "GOVERNMENTS." THAT WHICH IS HEADED BY DR. BAKHTIAR HAS THE FIRMAN OF THE SHAH, THE SANCTION OF A REGENCY COUNCIL AND THE APPROVAL OF PARLIAMENT. IT COMMANDS THE SUPPORT OF THE ARMED FORCES AND IS DEALT WITH BY ALL FOREIGN GOVERNMENTS AS THE LEGITIMATE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN.

HOWEVER, THE BUREAUCRACY DOES NOT WORK FOR IT, THE NATIONAL IRANIAN OIL COMPANY OPERATES (IN A LIMITED WAY) INDEPENDENT OF IT, AND IT HAS NO REVENUES. THE PRIVATE ECONOMIC SECTOR, WHICH IS AT A STANDSTILL, IGNORES IT AND OCCASIONALLY DEFIES IT.

THERE IS AN INCREASING NUMBER OF IRANIANS, PARTICULARLY AMONG THE INTELLECTUALS, WHO ADMIRE BAKHTIAR'S SPUNK, WHO SHARE HIS LIBERAL DEMOCRATIC HOPES FOR IRAN'S FUTURE, AND WHO WISH HIM WELL. BUT THEY ARE TIMID, POORLY ORGANIZED AND UNWILLING TO RISK THEIR LIVES OR FORTUNES TO SUPPORT BAKHTIAR.

THE SECOND "GOVERNMENT," HEADED BY BAKHTIAR'S CLOSE FRIEND MEHDI BAZARGAN, HAS YET TO TAKE SHAPE. BAZARGAN FINDS HIMSELF RELUCTANTLY IN THE POSITION OF CHALLENGING BAKHTIAR, FEARS AN OPEN CONFLICT WITH THE ARMED FORCES, AND WOULD DEARLY LOVE TO FIND SOME POLITICAL COMPROMISE WITH BAKHTIAR WHICH WOULD PERMIT A PEACEFUL RESOLUTION OF THE IMPASSE.

HOWEVER, AS A DEVOUT SHI'ITE, WHO SHOWS TOTAL DEFERENCE TO THE AUTHORITY OF THE SHI'A CLERGY,BAZARGAN HAS ACCEPTED THE DUTY THRUST ON HIM BY AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI AND WILL DOUBTLESS GO THROUGH WITH HIS ASSIGNMENT OF FORMING A GOVERNMENT AND ATTEMPTING TO MOVE IRAN TOWARDS THE GOAL OF BECOMING AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC.

BAZARGAN, IN CONTRAST TO BAKHTIAR, CAN PROBABLY INDUCE THE BUREAUCRACY TO FUNCTION, THE NIOC TO PRODUCE, AND PRIVATE BUSINESS ENTERPRISE TO RESUME MORE OR LESS NORMAL ACTIVITY. HE CAN DO ALL THIS IN THE NAME OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI AND HIS "MOVEMENT." BUT, HE CANNOT RPT NOT GET HIS MINISTERS TO ENTER A GOVERNMENT BUILDING WITHOUT BEING CHALLENGED AND PROBABLY ARRESTED BY THE ARMED FORCES, ACTING UNDER ORDERS FROM BAKHTIAR.

THE LEADERS OF THESE TWO "GOVERNMENTS" HAVE MUCH IN COMMON BESIDES THEIR PERSONAL FRIENDSHIP. THEY BOTH ARE PREPARED TO PLACE THE DECISIONS ABOUT THE FUTURE OF IRAN IN THE HANDS OF A DEMOCRATIC DECISION BY THE IRANIAN PEOPLE,PREFERABLY THROUGH FREE ELECTIONS TO A PARLIAMENTARY BODY WHICH WOULD FUNCTION AS A CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY. NEITHER ONE WILL ACCEPT THE OTHER AS THE LEGITIMATE AGENCY TO ORGANIZE AND SUPERVISE THOSE ELECTIONS, BUT, LEFT TO THEIR OWN DEVICES THE TWO OLD FRIENDS COULD PROBABLY AGREE UPON A NEUTRAL, AUTONOMOUS ORGAN WHICH WOULD BE ACCORDED THAT TASK BY BOTH "GOVERNMENTS."

THEREFORE, IN THE BEST OF ALL POSSIBLE WORLDS, THERE WOULD BE REASON TO HOPE THAT A CIVILIZED POLITICAL SOLUTION TO THE CURRENT IMPASSE WILL BE FOUND AND THAT IRAN WILL MOVE AWAY FROM THE BRINK OF CIVIL WAR. ALL OF US LIVING IN THIS COUNTRY HAVE TO NOURISH OUR DAILY EXISTENCE WITH THE ENHANCEMENT OF THIS HOPE.

ON THE OTHER HAND, THERE ARE SIGNIFICANT FORCES WORKING AGAINST SUCH A PEACEFUL DENOUEMENT. THE FIRST OF THESE IS AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI AND THE MORE AMBITIOUS MEMBERS OF HIS ENTOURAGE. THEY REALIZE THAT THE "REVOLUTION" THEY HAVE WON IN THE STREETS COULD BE LOST UNLESS THEY MOVE TO CAPITALIZE ON THEIR SUCCESSES IMMEDIATELY. THEY THEREFORE SEEM PREPARED TO PRESS MORE VIGOROUSLY THAN BAZARGAN DEEMS PRUDENT IN ORDER TO STAMPEDE THE NATION TOWARDS AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC WITHOUT BENEFIT OF DEMOCRATIC PROCESSES.

MORE STRIDENT, AND MORE DANGEROUS, THAN THE AYATOLLAH'S MEN ARE THE ARMED RADICALS AND TERRORISTS WHO SUPPORT THEM AND WHO EXERT GREAT PRESSURE ON THEIR LEADERSHIP. THESE MUJAHEDIN ARE TRAINED BY PLO AND OTHER RADICAL ISLAMIC GROUPS WHO ARE FANATICALLY DEVOTED TO THE GOALS OF CONVERTING IRAN INTO A LEADING STATE IN THE CAUSE OF DARUL ISLAM. THEY CAN LEAD AND STIR UP THE STREET MOBS, WHO, IN THEIR MOST EXTREME FORM, ARE A FORMIDABLE CHALLENGE TO THE ARMED FORCES.

BEYOND THEM ARE THE MARXIST FORCES, PARTICULARLY THE TUDEH PARTY, WHICH OPERATES UNDER MOSCOW'S CONTROL, AND WHICH FUNCTION TO GOAD THE RELIGIOUS AND ARMED FORCES INTO CONFLICT WITH EACH OTHER. THESE PEOPLE ARE ALSO ARMED BUT OPERATE WITH MORE SOPHISTICATION AND LESS FANATICISM THAN THE MUJAHEDIN.

ON THE OTHER SIDE OF THE EQUATION, THERE ARE ALSO FORCES OPERATING AGAINST THE RATIONAL SOLUTIONS FAVORED BY BAKHTIAR AND BARZAGAN. THESE CONSIST PRIMARILY OF DIEHARD SUPPORTERS OF THE SHAH, AS WELL AS SOME OPPORTUNISTS IN THE ARMED FORCES. ARDESHIR ZAHEDI IS AN EXAMPLE OF THIS BREED, AS WELL AS MILITARY OFFICERS SUCH AS MANOUCHER KHOSROWDAD. THEIR LOYALTY TO BAKHTIAR IS MINIMAL AND THEY WOULD RATHER DESTROY HIM THAN SEE HIM REACH AN ACCOMMODATION WHICH MIGHT RESULT IN THE ABOLITION OF THE MONARCHY.

HENCE, THE HOPES FOR A PEACEFUL SETTLEMENT ARE FRAGILE AND COULD BE DESTROYED BY ANY NUMBER OF FORCES WHICH ARE ANTAGONISTIC TO SUCH A SETTLEMENT. IF THESE FORCES SUCCEED IN FRUSTRATING THOSE HOPES, THE CONSEQUENCES AGAIN ARE UNPREDICTABLE. HOWEVER, IT SEEMS PROBABLE THEY WOULD BE VIOLENT AND COULD ENTAIL EVERYTHING FROM INCREASED TERRORISM TO OUTRIGHT CIVIL WAR.

IN ASSESSING THE ACTIONS WHICH KHOMEINI TOOK FEBRUARY 5, THERE ARE SOME FAINT REASONS TO SUSTAIN THE HOPE. FIRST, HE NAMED BAZARGAN, A KNOWN MODERATE, TO BE "PROVISIONAL PRIME MINISTER." SECOND, HE REFRAINED FROM NAMING OTHER MEMBERS OF A "GOVERNMENT." THIRD, HE ASSERTED THAT THE 1906 CONSTITUTION REMAINS VALID. FOURTH, HE INDICATED SOME VAGUE ACCEPTANCE OF DEMOCRATIC METHODS TO ESTABLISH THE LEGITIMACY OF ANY CONSTITUTIONAL CHANGE.

IT NOW REMAINS TO BE SEEN WHETHER BAZARGAN AND BAKHTIAR WILL BE GIVEN A CHANCE TO FOLLOW THEIR NATURAL INSTINCTS OR WHETHER THEY WILL BE MANEUVERED BY OTHERS INTO A CONFLICT EACH OF THEM WISHES TO AVOID. SULLIVAN

AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI YESTERDAY APPOINTED MEHDI BAZARGAN PRIMIN OF PROVISIONAL GOVT. HIS SPEECH, HIS WRITTEN DECREE, AND THE TRANSLATION BY IBRAHIM YAZDI DO NOT QUITE JIBE. BAZARGAN IS TO FORM A GOVT, CONDUCT A REFERENDUM ON AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC, ESTABLISH A CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY, AND THEN CONDUCT ELECTIONS TO A NEW NATIONAL ASSEMBLY IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE NEW CONSTITUTION. IT REMAINS UNCLEAR, HOWEVER, JUST WHAT THE REFERENDUM BALLOT WILL LOOK LIKE, AND WHAT THE CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY WILL DO.

YAZDI INDICATED AGAIN YESTERDAY THAT A NEW CONSTITUTION ALREADY EXISTS. IF THE REFERENDUM IS TO DECIDE ON THIS CONSTITUTION, OR EVEN IF NOT, WHAT WILL THE CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY DO, EXCEPT MERELY TO RATIFY AN ALREADY DRAFTED CONSTITUTION? WHAT IS CLEAR IS THE NATURE OF THE CHALLENGE TO BAKHTIAR. FAR FROM ESTABLISHING A SHADOW GOVT, KHOMEINI DECLARED: "I HAVE APPOINTED THE PRIME MINISTER ON THE BASIS OF THE MISSION I HAVE BEEN GIVEN BY THE HOLY EXPONENT OF DIVINE TRUTH. OBEDIENCE TO ENGINEER BAZARGAN IS COMPULSORY. THE NATION MUST OBEY HIM. THIS IS NOT A NORMAL GOVT; THIS IS A CANNONICAL GOVT.

REBELLION AGAINST THIS GOVT IS REBELLION AGAINST THE FAITH, A CRIME FOR WHICH ISLAM PROVIDES A TOUGH PENALTY. I SHOULD WARN ALL THOSE WHO MIGHT TRY TO SABOTAGE THIS GOVT, OR WHO MIGHT CONSPIRE AGAINST IT, THAT THEIR PUNISHMENT SHALL BE SEVERE INDEED." HIS THREATS WERE SO DIRE THAT ONE OF HIS LIEUTENANTS, AYATOLLAH RAFSANJANI, HASTENED TO REMIND THE PRESS THAT OF COURSE THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC WILL GUARANTEE FREEDOM OF EXPRESSION AND THE RIGHT TO CRITICIZE THE GOVT. QARANI ASKED WHO WOULD ANNOUNCE THE REFERENDUM. POL COUNSELOR SAID THIS WOULD OBVIOUSLY BE VIEWED BY BAKHTIAR AS A PREROGATIVE OF THE GOVT. HOWEVER THIS WOULD NOT PREVENT INFORMAL ARRANGEMENTS IN ADVANCE ENCOMPASSING A PARALLEL ANNOUNCEMENT BY BAZARGAN SEPARATELY. QARANI ASKED IF BAZARGAN COULD MAKE HIS ANNOUNCEMENT FIRST. POL COUNSELOR SAID HE COULD VISUALIZE A PUBLIC REQUEST FROM THE OPPOSITION FOR A REFERENDUM WHICH WOULD BE GRANTED BY THE GOVT.

QARANI ASKED WHAT WOULD HAPPEN WHEN BAZARGAN ANNOUNCES HIS CABINET, WILL BAKHTIAR ARREST HIM? POL COUNSELOR SAID HE UNDERSTOOD BAKHTIAR HAD MADE IT CLEAR THAT HE WOULD CONSIDER SUCH A GOVT IN THE TRADITION OF SHADOW GOVTS IN WESTERN DEMOCRACIES AND NOT MOVE AGAINST IT UNLESS IT PHYSICALLY TRIED TO TAKE OVER. IN THAT CASE BAKHTIAR AND THE ARMY SAID THEY WOULD ARREST THE MINISTERS.

QARANI SAID THE HEAD OF THE MAJLES HAD COME TO AHMAD SEHJAVADI WITH THE SUGGESTION THAT QUESTIONS AGAINST BAKHTIAR'S GOVT WOULD BE INITIATED IN THE MAJLIS SESSION NEXT DAY (FEB 6) LEADING EVENTUALLY TO A VOTE OF NO CONFIDENCE. THEY THOUGHT THIS WOULD TAKE "A FEW WEEKS." POL COUNSELOR MADE NO DIRECT REPLY EXCEPT TO NOTE THAT TIME AND ADHERENCE TO CONSTITUTIONAL PROCEDURES SHOULD HAVE GOOD CHANCE OF HEALING IRAN'S PRESENT ILLS.

SUMMING UP, QARANI SAID THEY HAD AGREED TO CARRY SUGGESTION TO BAZARGAN THAT HE EXPLAIN THE NATURE OF AN ISLAMIC GOVT TO BAKHTIAR. POL COUNSELOR HAD AGREED TO CONSIDER ASSISTING WITH BAKHTIAR IF HE WAS UNREASONABLE, BEYOND HIS DEFENSE OF THE CONSTITUTION. HE ALSO SAID USG HAD AGREED TO USE ITS INFLUENCE THAT THE MILITARY STAY OUT OF THE POLITICAL ARENA, INCLUDING ANY REFERENDUM AND ELECTIONS. POL COUNSELOR SAID THAT WAS TRUE PROVIDED LEGAL CONSTITUTIONAL PROCESS WERE FOLLOWED.

IN PASSING, QARANI AGAIN AVERTED TO HIS ROLE IN WEEDING OUT COMMUNIST OFFICERS FROM THE ARMED FORCES IN THE 1950S. IN REPLY TO POL COUNSELOR'S QUESTION, HE SAID SOME 680 MEMBERS OF THE PARTY HAD BEEN REMOVED AND PUNISHED. SOME 500 OTHERS WERE SYMPATHIZERS OR HANGERS ON WHO HAD PERSONAL OR OTHER GRIEVANCES. AFTER CONSULTATIONS WITH THE SHAH IT HAD BEEN DECIDED TO TALK WITH THESE OFFICERS, AND THEY WERE ALLOWED TO STAY ON. MOST HAVE RETIRED BY NOW. HOWEVER, WE DO NOT KNOW HOW MANY OTHER ORGANIZATIONS OF THIS SORT MAY EXIST IN THE PRESENT ARMY. THE PRESENT MILITARY LEADERSHIP WOULD HAVE TROUBLE DISCOVERING THEM.

THIS WOULD NOT BE THE CASE WITH A NEW ARMY INTO WHICH A SYSTEM OF JUSTICE WOULD BE INSTILLED. ------------------075367 061721Z /43 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 3802 SECTION 03 OF 03 TEHRAN 01873 EXDIS

IT IS MY UNDERSTANDING THAT THERE HAS BEEN CONSIDERABLE DISCUSSION AT POLICY LEVELS IN WASHINGTON ABOUT THE SOLIDARITY OF THE IRANIAN MILITARY AND THE COHESION OF ITS SENIOR LEADERSHIP. I HAVE BEEN RATHER BEARISH ON THIS SUBJECT, BECAUSE MY READING OF MANY SENIOR MILITARY INDICATES THEY ARE TAINTED BY CORRUPTION AND UNCERTAIN ABOUT THEIR FUTURES.

I HAVE ALSO NOTED SOME TENDENCIES, PARTICULARLY WITH RESPECT TO GENERAL GHARABAGHI, TO PREFER AN ACCOMMODATION WITH THE FORCES OF KHOMEINI RATHER THAN TAKE INDEPENDENT MILITARY ACTION WHICH MIGHT RESULT IN A WIDESPREAD SLAUGHTER OF KHOMEINI'S FOLLOWERS.

MAAG CHIEF GENERAL GAST HAD AN INTERESTING CONVERSATION WITH THE J-5 OF THE IRANIAN ARMED FORCES, WHOM GAST HAS OFTEN DESCRIBED AS THE MOST INTELLIGENT OFFICER ON THE GENERAL STAFF. HE HAS RELAYED THE ESSENCE OF THIS CONVERSATION BY TELEPHONE TO HAROLD BROWN AND DAVEY JONES. IN ORDER TO GIVE YOU THE FULL FLAVOR OF IT, I HAVE ASKED HIM TO PROVIDE ME A MEMORANDUM WHICH FOLLOWS: - (A) ON FEBRUARY 6, LT. GENERAL BAKHSHIAZAR, J-5 SUPREME COMMANDER'S STAFF, DISCUSSED SEVERAL TOPICS WITH GEN. GAST, CHIEF ARMISH-MAAG.

THE MEETING WAS CALLED BY BAKHSHIAZAR OSTENSIBLY TO DISCUSS FUTURE STRUCTURE AND MANPOWER REQUIREMENTS FOR THE MAAG. - (B) BAKHSHIAZAR BROUGHT UP THE SUBJECT OF GENERAL HUYSER'S VISIT. HE SAID HE HAD A "FRIEND" WHO MET FREQUENTLY WITH KHOMEINI. HIS "FRIEND" SAID HUYSER WAS STANDING IN THE WAY OF WINNING THE ARMED FORCES OVER TO THEIR SIDE. BAKHSHIAZAR SAID HE REPLIED THAT HUYSER WAS SENT HERE TO PREVENT A COUP AND HAD SUCCEEDED.

THIS HAD GOTTEN TO KHOMEINI AS EVIDENCED BY KHOMEINI NOT REFERRING PUBLICLY TO HUYSER OR AMERICAN MILITARY IN THE PAST DAY OR SO. - (C) BAKHSHIAZAR SAID HE ALSO TOLD HIS FRIEND THAT THE ARMED FORCES WERE STRONG, WELL EQUIPPED WITH 1,000 AIRCRAFT, 4,000 TANKS AND HEAVY ARTILLERY. THEY SHOULD NOT BE PROVOKED, CITING THAT THEY COULD LEVEL QOM TO A PASTURE IN TEN MINUTES. BAKHSHIAZAR TOOK CREDIT FOR THE MESSAGE GETTING TO KHOMEINI. - (D) BAKHSHIAZAR SAYS THAT BAKHTIAR SHOULD REMAIN P.M. AND BAZARGAN IN HIS ROLE AS HEAD OF THE "SHADOW GOVERNMENT" SHOULD WORK UP A REVISED CONSTITUTION.

THE CONSTITUTION WRITTEN BY KHOMEINI GROUP, HE SAID, WAS TOO RELIGIOUS. BAZARGAN SHOULD ALSO DRAW UP THE PLANS FOR THE ELECTION AND A JOINT COMMITTEE COMPOSED OF BOTH SIDES SHOULD SUPERVISE THE ELECTIONS. ELECTIONS SHOULD NOT TAKE PLACE UNTIL THE STRIKES ARE OVER AND EVERYONE WAS BACK AT WORK. HE WENT ON TO SAY THE MILITARY SHOULD BE REQUIRED TO VOTE AS WELL AS ALL PEOPLE. - (E) BAKHSHIAZAR SAID THE SENIOR MILITARY SHOULD TALK DIRECTLY TO KHOMEINI.

WHEN GAST CHALLENGED THE STATEMENT, BAKHSHIAZAR RETRACTED AND SAID ONLY THROUGH BAKHTIAR BUT MIGHT HAVE TO EVENTUALLY DO SO. - (F) BAKHSHIAZAR SAID THAT BAKHTIAR WOULD SOONER OR LATER (IMPLIED SOONER) RECEIVE A DEMAND FROM THE OPPOSITION THAT SPECIFIC SENIOR OFFICERS BE RELIEVED. THEY ARE LT. GEN. RABII, COMMANDER IIAF, LT. GEN. BADRAI, COMMANDER IIGF, ADMIRAL HABIBOLLAHI, COMMANDER AND CHIEF IIN AND GEN. TOUFANIAN, VMOW, REASON BEING THEY HAVE BEEN TOO CLOSE TO THE SHAH. GEN. GARABAGHI COULD REMAIN BECAUSE HE WAS ONLY RECENTLY APPOINTED AS CHIEF SCS AND IS A RELIGIOUS MAN. LT. GEN. AZARBARZIN WOULD SUCCEED RABII AND LT. GEN. NAJIMI, WHO WAS GEN.

OVEISI'S DEPUTY COMMANDER, NOW ASSIGNED TO SCS, WOULD SUCCEED BADRAI. - (G) COMMENT: BAKHSHIAZAR IS NOT LOVED BY TOUFANIAN, RABII AND HABIBOLLAHI, WHO A MONTH AGO CALLED HIM A COMMUNIST. HOW CLOSE BAKHSHIAZAR IS TO THE OPPOSITION IS UNCLEAR, BUT HE SEEMED CONFIDENT OF HIS INFORMATION. HIS PITCH TO GAST IS INCONSISTENT. UNDOUBTEDLY, IT WAS A FISHING EXPEDITION.

segments.text: THE AMBASSADOR AND I HAVE REVIEWED REFTEL. WE FIND THE THEMES PROPOSED A LITTLE TOO GENERAL, BLAND AND RHETORICAL. THE HOSTILE INFORMATION REACHING THE EYES AND EARS OF IRANIANS ABOUT THE UNITED STATES HAS LITTLE TO DO WITH AMERICAN VALUES PER SE. THE KHOMEINI FORCES AND THE LEFT SIMPLY PERCEIVE OUR POLICY AS OPPOSED TO THEIR AIMS AND SEE US AS THE PRINCIPAL FORCE SUPPORTING THE MILITARY AND BAKHTIAR, IF NOT PLOTTING THE RETURN OF THE SHAH. THE ANTIU.S.

ELEMENTS PLAY HARDBALL ON VERY SPECIFIC ISSUES: E.G., GENERAL HUYSER HAS BEEN MASTERMINDING A MILITARY COUP TO PAVE THE WAY FOR THE SHAH'S RETURN; LARGE CONTINGENTS OF CIA OPERATIVES HAVE ARRIVED IN IRAN TO ORGANIZE ANTI-ISLAMIC TERRORIST GROUPS; THE U.S. SPONSORED AND PAID FOR RECENT PRO-GOVERNMENT DEMONSTRATIONS; F-15S (SIC) ARE BEING FLOWN OUT OF IRAN AND THE U.S. IS DISMANTLING SENSITIVE EQUIPMENT; THERE ARE 25,000 AMERICAN MILITARY PERSONNEL IN IRAN ALONG WITH LARGE U.S. MILITARY BASES; THE NIOC IS HOSTAGE TO WESTERN OIL MONOPOLIES; IMPORTED WESTERN CULTURE HAS BEEN RUINOUS TO OUR YOUTH.

COUNTERING THIS SORT OF INFORMATION THROUGH A CREDIBLE MEDIUM IS THE PROBLEM. GETTING ATTITUDINAL MODIFICATIONS ON THE PART OF KHOMEINI WOULD BE MOST SALUTARY BUT GIVEN HIS TRACK RECORD NOT VERY LIKELY. GETTING THE TRUTH ABOUT THE U.S. AND ITS INTENTIONS RESPECTING THE FUTURE OF THE U.S.. IRAN RELATIONSHIP IN PRAGMATIC TERMS TO KHOMEINI'S ADVISORS IS DESIRABLE, AND IS BEING DONE REGULARLY.
HAVING THE EMBASSY STEP TO STAGE CENTER ON THESE ISSUES AT THIS TIME WOULD BE HAZARDOUS AT BEST.

FURTHER DISCLOSURE IN WASHINGTON OF THE DRAWDOWN IN U.S. MILITARY SALES AND TRAINING PROGRAMS COUCHED IN TERMS OF THE FOURTH THEME IN REFTEL, "AMERICANS AND IRANIANS WANT TO SEE AN IRAN THAT IS TRULY INDEPENDENT.." (THIS THEME IS DELICATE BECAUSE WE DO NOT WISH TO CAUSE UNDUE CONCERN WITHIN THE IRANIAN MILITARY.) B. LOCAL PREPARATION IN FARSI FOR SELECTED DISTRIBUTION OF A RATHER DEADPAN FACT SHEET WHICH KNOCKS DOWN THE MORE FANCIFUL MYTHS ABOUT THE U.S. SECURITY RELATIONSHIP WITH IRAN. C.
