1979TEHRAN01918.subject: IRANIAN CHAMBER OF COMMERCE MEETING WITH KHOMEINI

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT)

A. M. BONAKDARPOUR, SECRETARY GENERAL OF THE IRAN CHAMBER OF COMMERCE INDUSTRIES AND MINES, TOLD E/C COUNSELOR FEB. 7 THAT A CHAMBER DELEGATION OF TWELVE PERSONS IS SCHEDULED TO MEET WITH AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI ON FEB. 8 TO DISCUSS PROBLEMS OF THE PRIVATE BUSINESS COMMUNITY AND THEIR DEVASTATING EFFECT ON THE ECONOMY. THE DELEGATION WILL INCLUDE INDUSTRIALISTS, BANKERS AND MERCHANTS, WHO WILL ATTEMPT TO IMPRESS THE AYATOLLAH WITH THE SERIOUSNESS OF THE SITUATION AND SUGGEST THAT THE INTEREST OF THE COUNTRY AS A WHOLE REQUIRES AN IMMEDIATE SOLUTION.

BONAKDARPOUR SAID THE MOST DISTURBING SITUATION IS THE INROADS BEING MADE IN THE INDUSTRIAL LABOR FORCE BY COMMUNIST ORGANIZERS WHO, HE SAID, WERE BEING SENT FROM THE UNIVERSITIES. MOST INDUSTRIAL WORKERS ARE IDLE AND MANY ARE NOT BEING PAID. WITHIN A FEW WEEKS, EVEN THOSE INDUSTRIES NOW PAYING IDLE WORKERS WILL BE FORCED TO STOP. THE CHAMBER FEARS THAT THE DESPERATE SITUATION OF WORKERS WILL CAUSE THEM TO TURN IN LARGE NUMBERS TO COMMUNIST LEADERSHIP.

BONAKDARPOUR SAID HE BELIEVES THAT AFTER ABOUT TWO OR THREE WEEKS KHOMEINI WILL NO LONGER BE ABLE TO INFLUENCE THE WORKERS. IN FACT, HE BELIEVES KHOMEINI'S INFLUENCE MAY ALREADY HAVE PASSED ITS PEAK. BONAKDARPOUR SAID THE PRINCIPAL OBJECTIVE OF THE CHAMBER DELEGATION WILL BE TO DESCRIBE THE SITUATION RATHER THAN TO SUGGEST SPECIFIC SOLUTIONS. OBVIOUSLY, HOWEVER, ANY RELIEF WOULD REQUIRE FACILITATING THE RELEASE OF SOME $10 BILLION WORTH OF MERCHANDISE NOW IN THE CUSTOMS OR ENROUTE TO IRAN. IT WOULD ALSO BE ESSENTIAL TO RESTORE THE BANKING SYSTEM. BONAKDARPOUR SAID THE PLIGHT OF THE MERCHANTS, INCLUDING SOME 200,000 SHOP OWNERS IN TEHRAN ALONE, IS GETTING DESPERATE.

ASKED WHO KHOMEINI'S PRINCIPAL ECONOMIC ADVISERS ARE, BONAKDARPOUR MENTIONED IBRAHIM YAZDI, ABOLHASSAN BANISADR, AND SADEGH QOTBZADEH, WHOSE NAMES HAVE BEEN MENTIONED PROMINENTLY IN THE PRESS. BONAKDARPOUR SPECULATED THAT YADOLLAH SHAHABI, KHOMEINI'S STRIKE COORDINATOR, IS ALSO INFLUENTIAL.

COMMENT: THE CHAMBER'S EFFORTS TO INFLUENCE KHOMEINI IN PARIS (REPORTED REFTEL) MET WITH NO SUCCESS. CHAMBER REPRESENTATIVES BELIEVE THAT KHOMEINI HAS ALMOST NO APPRECIATION FOR ECONOMIC MATTERS AND IS UNAWARE HOW SERIOUS IRAN'S ECONOMIC SITUATION HAS NOW BEOME. THEY OBVIOUSLY WISH TO STRESS THAT RELIEF IS REQUIRED NOT FOR THE BENEFIT OF PRIVATE BUSINESSMEN, BUT FOR THE SALVATION OF THE COUNTRY.

THE ATTITUDE OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI AND HIS LIEUTENANTS TOWARD THE PRIVATE BUSINESS SECTOR IS NOT YET CLEAR. THERE HAS BEEN CONSIDERABLE CRITICISM OF BUSINESS LEADERS FOR COOPERATING WITH THE SHAH AND FOR HAVING CREATED AN ARTIFICIAL BUSINESS STRUCTURE OVERLY DEPENDENT ON PROTECTION AND IMPORTS OF RAW MATERIALS AND INTERMEDIATE GOODS.

SYMPTOMATIC OF THE CHAMBER'S PROBLEM IS THE ABSENCE OF ITS PRESIDENT -- SENATOR TAHER ZIAI. ZIAI, ALSO DEPUTY DIRECTOR OF THE PAHLAVI FOUNDATION, HAS BEEN HEAVILY INVOLVED IN THE ROYAL FAMILY'S BUSINESS AFFAIRS. ZIAI IS NO LONGER ACTIVE IN CHAMBER AFFAIRS AND IS RUMORED TO HAVE LEFT THE COUNTRY. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN01922.subject: FARDUST REPORTEDLY SWIMMING WITH THE TIDE

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

GEORGE NATHANSON, AMERICAN BUSINESSMAN AND SELF-STYLED INTERNATIONAL INTRIGUER, CAME WITH FRANK BURROUGHS, EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR OF IRAN-AMERICA CHAMBER OF COMMERCE, TO SEE EMBOFF PERETT FEB 5. EMBASSY HAS FOR SOME TIME PARRIED NATHANSON'S ATTEMPTS TO ESTABLISH "ACTION PROGRAMS" WITH SOME USG INVOLVEMENT (REFTEL). EMBOFF HAD TO EXPLAIN AGAIN THAT USG WILL NOT INTERVENE TO SAVE THE REGIME, BUT THIS TIME NATHANSON SAID HE HAD A MESSAGE FROM GENERAL HOSSEIN FARDUST. THE TWO HAD MET THE PREVIOUS EVENING.

ACCORDING TO NATHANSON, FARDUST SEEKS AN ACCOMMODATION AMONG KHOMEINI, USG, AND PRO-WESTERN ELEMENTS SUCH AS HIMSELF. BAKHTIAR HAS LITTLE FOLLOWING OUTSIDE THE ARMY, AND IT IS TIME TO CONCENTRATE UPON MODERATING KHOMEINI. IT IS IN FACT ESSENTIAL TO ENSURE THAT KHOMEINI'S NEW GOVT WILL BE SUCCESSFUL, BECAUSE IF HE FAILS, THE COMMUNISTS ARE SURE TO SEIZE POWER. IF, ON THE OTHER HAND, USG APPROACHESTHE KHOMEINI FORCES AND DEMONSTRATES THE VALUE OF A PRO-WESTERN STANCE, THE ISLAMIC PARTY WILL WITHER AWAY.

IF WE ESTABLISH CLOSE TIES WITH THE MEMBERS OF THE NEW GOVT, AND KHOMEINI ACCEPTS THE CONSTITUTION, PERHAPS ONE DAY THE SHAH WILL EVEN BE ABLE TO RETURN, PROVIDED HE AGREES TO REIGN, NOT RULE. FARDUST BELIEVES BRITISH AND RUSSIANS ARE COOPERATING IN FOMENTING THIS CRISIS (COMMENT: WE OFTEN HEAR THIS FANTASTIC CHARGE), AND USG MUST TAKE ACTION TO SAVE THE SITUATION. IN PARTICULAR, WE MUST ENSURE THAT THE ARMY STAYS OUT OF THE POLITICAL ARENA. ARMY SHOULD SUPPORT NEITHER BAKHTIAR NOR KHOMEINI. FARDUST EXPECTS EMBASSY REPLY REGARDING USG POSITION.

COMMENT: ALTHOUGH NATHANSON IS NOT A WHOLLY RELIABLE CONTACT, WE HAVE NO REASON TO DOUBT THE MEETING WITH FARDUST OR THE THRUST OF FARDUST'S MESSAGE. THIS APPEARS TO BE A STRIKING DEMARCHE FROM ONE OF SHAH'S CLOSEST COLLEAGUES (WITH WHOM THE EMBASSY HAS HAD PRACTICALLY NO CONTACT IN RECENT YEARS) -- FLATLY OPPOSING A COUP, AND PLACING HIS HOPES FOR PRO-WESTERN GOVT AND EVEN FOR THE SHAH'S RETURN UPON KHOMEINI'S SUCCESS. WE CANNOT OVERLOOK THE STRONG POSSIBILITY THIS IS A PROVOCATION.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)
SUMMARY: BAKHTIAR-BAZARGAN STILL A STANDOFF. LARGE DEMONSTRATIONS WILL INVOLVE THREE FACTIONS. PRO-CONSTITUTION PARTY FORMED. SENATE TO PASS TWO MAJOR BILLS TODAY. END SUMMARY.

MEHDI BAZARGAN'S ONE-MAN GOVT AND BAKHTIAR'S GOVT STILL STAND IN CONFRONTATION. BAZARGAN SAYS HIS CABINET IS FORMED, BUT HE HAS ANNOUNCED NO NAMES. ONE JOURNAL DESIGNATES EZEDDIN KAZEMI AS MINISTER OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS; REZA SHAYIAN, MINISTER OF LABOR; DR. NASSER MINACHI, MINISTER OF INDUSTRY AND MINES; ALI ASGHAR HAJ SAYED JAVADI, MINISTER OF INFORMATION; GEN FEREYDOUN JAM, MINISTER OF WAR; ADMIRAL MADANI, MINISTER OF INTERIOR; ABDOL HASSAN GANI SADR, MINISTER OF ECONOMIC AFFAIRS; AND DR. IBRAHIM YAZDI, MINISTER OF HEALTH. OPPOSITION SOURCES TELL US THAT THIS LIST IS INCORRECT BUT DO NOT PROVIDE THE CORRECT NAMES.

PRESS QUOTES GEN JAM, WITHOUT SAYING TO WHOM HE WAS TALKING, AS SAYING HE SWORE AN OATH TO DEFEND THE CONSTITUTION AND CANNOT BREAK HIS WORD AS LONG AS THE CONSTITUTION STILL EXISTS. BAKHTIAR MEANWHILE DELIVERED ANOTHER OF HIS SPUNKY SPEECHES BEFORE THE MAJLES YESTERDAY: "I HAVE NOTHING TO SAY ABOUT GOVERNMENTS EXISTING IN THE PUBLIC IMAGINATION AS LONG AS THEY REMAIN A JOKE AND A MERE PRONOUNCEMENT, BUT IF THEY TAKE ACTION I WILL RESPOND WITH COUNTERACTION." HE SAID EVEN IF ALL MAJLES DEPUTIES RESIGNED, HE WILL NOT. HE CALLED FOR CHANGE THROUGH THE EXISTING CONSTITUTION, TO WHICH PARLIAMENT IS FREE TO OFFER AMENDMENTS.
AND IF PARLIAMENT DECIDES IT NO LONGER WANTS BAKHTIAR, HE WILL STEP ASIDE.

LARGE PRO-KHOMEINI MARCHES YESTERDAY ENDED PEACEFULLY BUT APPEARED HEADED FOR TROUBLE WHEN CROWDS APPROACHED MAJLES BUILDING. COMBINATION OF TROOPS AND CLERGYMEN KEPT CROWD FROM FORCING THE ISSUE AT MAJLES BUILDING, WHERE "ILLEGAL" PARLIAMENT WAS IN SESSION. THERE WERE DEMONSTRATIONS IN MANY CITIES YESTERDAY, LEADING TO PRO/ ANTI-VIOLENCE IN ZAHEDAN WHERE THREE DIED. MARCHERS ARE AGAIN ACTIVE IN TEHRAN TODAY, AND MASSIVE RALLY IS PLANNED FOR TOMORROW TO SUPPORT BAZARGAN. PARADE WILL FOLLOW FAMILIAR ROUTE TOWARD SHAHYAD. FORGOTTEN IN THE PLANNING IS A PREVIOUS CHARIK APPEAL FOR THE MAJOR LEFTIST MARCH ON SHAHREZA FROM WEST TO EAST.

IF THEY GO AHEAD, THEY WILL MEET THE KHOMEINI THRONG MOVING FROM EAST TO WEST. A THIRD FORCE MAY PLAY A ROLE, BECAUSE YESTERDAY A GROUP OF CONSTITUTIONALISTS ANNOUNCED FORMATION OF THE NATIONAL UNITY FRONT, A COALITION OF PARTIES. REZA MOAVEN ISSUED STATEMENT AS MEMBER OF GROUP'S INTERIM EXECUTIVE COUNCIL. MOAVEN ALSO SAID THAT A MEMBER PARTY, THE IRANIAN SOLIDARITY PARTY, WILL HOLD GENERAL MEETING AT AMJADIEH STADIUM (NEAR EMBASSY) AT 1500 TODAY. THIS MEETING OFFERS POTENTIAL FOR CLASH WITH KHOMEINI PEOPLE, EITHER TODAY OR TOMORROW, IF GROUP PLANS DEMONSTRATION FOR THEN.
RELATIVES AND SUPPORTERS OF ARRESTED HOMAFARS ARE STILL SITTING-IN AT MINISTRY OF JUSTICE. PRESS ANNOUNCES 28 HOMAFARS HAVE BEEN RELEASED,AND THERE IS SPECULATION ON THE NUMBERS STILL IN CUSTODY.

RESIGNATIONS OF 24 MAJLES DEPS HAVE BECOME FINAL. WE UNDERSTAND A GROUP OF 11 TRIED TO SEE KHOMEINI RECENTLY BUT WERE RUDELY TREATED. THE AYATOLLAH FINALLY RECEIVED THEM BUT MADE THEM STAND AND ASSAILED THEM FOR HAVING BELONGED TO RESURGENCE PARTY. CONSULATES REPORT QUIET IN TABRIZ, SMALL DEMONSTRATIONS IN SHIRAZ, AND A MAJOR DEMO IN ISFAHAN, WHICH WILL BE ADDRESSED BY AYATOLLAHS KHADAMI AND TAHERI. CONSUL ISFAHAN REPORTS MILITARY AUTHORITIES HAVE ASKED BHI EMPLOYEES TO RETURN TO WORK ON SATURDAY. THE 62 WHO WERE PLANNING TO REMAIN WILL GO TO WORK, BUT THE EVACUATION OTHERWISE PROCEEDS. SUMMARY: MAJLES DEPUTY UNBURDENED HIMSELF ON RECENT PARLIAMENTARY MANEUVERS, INCLUDING ATTEMPTS TO RALLY BLOC OF SUPPORTERS TO PRIME MINISTER. SPEAKER OF MAJLES IS DEFINITELY SYMPATHETIC TO KHOMEINI MOVEMENT. MAJLESMEN HAVE BEEN THREATENED AND ARE JUST NOW IMPROVING THEIR OWN SECURITY, BUT 55 MEMBERS HAVE ALREADY FLED COUNTRY. BAHADORI ALSO WON A CONFLICT WITH A LEADING AYATOLLAH. END SUMMARY.

POLOFF STEMPEL SPENT FOUR-HOUR COCKTAIL-DINNER EVENING FEB 6 WITH OLD FRIEND, DR. AKBAR BAHADORI, MAJLES DEPUTY FOR NORTHWEST TEHRAN. BAHADORI (SEE PREVIOUS BIO REPORTING) HAS NOT BEEN A CENTRAL FIGURE IN MAJLES ACTIVITY THOUGH A GOVERNMENT SUPPORTER. HE UNBURDENED HIMSELF ABOUT ACTIVITIES OF RECENT WEEKS AND OFFERED SOME VERY INTERESTING INSIGHTS INTO INTERNAL MAJLES POLITICS OF PAST WEEK, INCLUDING CRESCENDO OF THREATS NOW BEING BEAMED AT THE DEPUTIES. HE AND HIS FRIENDS BELIEVE THEY THWARTED, FOR THE TIME BEING, SPEAKER JAAVAD SAEED'S ATTEMPTS TO CALL FOR A NO-CONFIDENCE VOTE ON PRIME MINISTER BAKHTIAR FEB 6, BUT SITUATION STILL REMAINS VERY TOUCH AND GO.

BAHADORI OFFERED FOLLOWING BACKGROUND ON MEETING BETWEEN BAKHTIAR AND ABOUT 100 MAJLES DEPUTIES FEB 3: MEETING HAD BEEN SUGGESTED BY BAHADORI AND ANOTHER DEPUTY TO HEAD OFF SPEAKER SAEED'S EFFORTS TO UNDERCUT PRIME MINISTER WEEK OF JAN 31. CANCELLATION OF MAJLES SESSION FEB 1 WHICH WAS TO HAVE PASSED TWO KEY BILLS CONVINCED GOI SUPPORTERS THAT BAKHTIAR HAD BETTER RALLY HIS FORCES IF SAEED'S EFFORT WAS NOT TO RESULT IN A VOTE OF NO CONFIDENCE. FEB 3 MEETING (REPORTED IN DAILY SITREP FOR FEB 4) WAS EMOTIONAL, BUT LED TO REAFFIRMATION OF LOYALTY BY MANY WHO UNTIL THAT MOMENT WERE WAVERING, ACCORDING TO BAHADORI.

BAHADORI'S HOME AND OFFICE HAVE ALWAYS BEEN OPEN TO VISITORS (HE IS THE MANAGING DIRECTOR OF GROUP PEZESHKE, THE LARGEST PRIVATE HEALTH INSURANCE OPERATION IN IRAN.). EVENING OF MEETING, HOWEVER, SECURITY WAS VERY TIGHT WHEN EMBOFF ARRIVED AT HIS OFFICE TO RIDE HOME WITH HIM. DRIVE HOME WAS INSTRUCTIVE--TWO FOLLOW CARS AND SIX BODYGUARDS. BAHADORI CALMLY MENTIONED HE HAD BEEN THREATENED WITH DEATH AT LEAST FIVE TIMES, AS HAD MOST MAJLES DEPUTIES. BY HIS COUNT 55 HAD LEFT THE COUNTRY; 22 MORE HAD RESIGNED OFFICIALLY AND FINALLY THAT DAY. AS OF TWO DAYS PREVIOUSLY, MOST DEPUTIES WERE NOW CARRYING REVOLVERS, SOMETHING THEY HAD NOT DONE SINCE MOSSADEQ'S TIME.

AFTER FIRST SHOCK OF THREATS, TOUGHER DEPUTIES WERE REACTING WITH ANGER TO THIS VIOLATION OF NORMAL PARLIAMENTARY PRACTICE. GIVEN ABSENTEES AND RESIGNATIONS, GOI LOYALISTS THOUGHT THEY COULD NOW COMMAND A CERTAIN MAJORITY OF VOTES, PROBABLY JUST OVER ONE HUNDRED, WITH OTHERS READY TO JOIN AS THEY SHOOK OFFINTIMIDATION. BAHADORI SAID HIS COLLEAGUES CONSIDER IT ABSOLUTELY CRITICAL TO MAINTAIN BAKHTIAR IN POWER SO THAT A COMPROMISE CAN BE WORKED OUT. IF BAKHTIAR FALLS, THE RESULT WILL BE THE ARMY OR THE COMMUNISTS. BAHADORI SAID THERE WERE SEVERAL KNOWN EXTUDEH MEN WORKING AROUND THE PARLIAMENT, BUT THE PROGOVERNMENT DEPUTIES WERE JUST BEGINNING TO IDENTIFY THEIR ATTEMPTS TO INFLUENCE VOTES.

(COMMENT: BAHADORI WAS FOR MANY YEARS CHIEF MEDICAL OFFICER OF THE ARMY. IN RESPONSE TO A QUESTION AS TO WHETHER THE ARMY WOULD BE BETTER THAN THE PRESENT CONFUSION, HE SIGHED AND SAID NO; THE ARMY WAS A GOOD ARMY,BUT IT COULDN'T RUN THE COUNTRY--JUST LOOK AT NIRT AND THE ARMY'S FUMBLING WITH THE OIL STRIKE. A POLITICAL SOLUTION HAD TO BE FOUND, OR THE COUNTRY WOULD CRUMBLE. HE SHOWED REMARKABLE INSIGHT INTO THE NATURE OF THE PRESENT SITUATION AND EXPRESSED A VIEW WHICH IS BECOMING FAIRLY COMMON AMONG MIDDLE AND UPPER MIDDLE CLASS MODERATES: BAKHTIAR IS THE LAST HOPE IRAN HAS FOR HOLDING OUT AGAINST A REACTIONARY MOSLEM DICTATORSHIP.)

BAHADORI TOLD OF HIS PERSONAL RUN-IN WITH AYATOLLAH NOURI, A NOTED ANTI-SEMITIC POWER IN EAST TEHRAN. ONE OF GROUP PESESHKE'S HOSPITALS, THE BAHADORI HOSPITAL, IS LOCATED NEAR JALEH SQUARE. ON SEPT 8, IT TREATED 85 PATIENTS FROM THE SHOOTINGS (FIVE LATER DIED). BAHADORI ORDERED THE HOSPITAL TO REFUSE PAYMENT BOTH FROM THE RELIGIOUS GROUPS AND FROM THE GOVERNMENT. THE HOSPITAL'S PROMINENT AND HELPFUL REPUTATION,HOWEVER, ATTRACTED THE ATTENTION OF NOURI WHO TRIED TO TAKE IT OVER. HE FIRST SAID, OK, THE HOSPITAL IS YOURS; YOU HAVE TO MEET THE DEBT TO THE BANK, HOWEVER. THE NEXT FEW WEEKS WERE SPENT TRYING TO HELP NOURI UNTANGLE HIMSELF FROM THE MESS. THE AYATOLLAH FINALLY QUIETLY WITHDREW HIS PEOPLE AND TURNED THE HOSPITAL BACK TO THE MEDICAL GROUP. BAHADORI WAS PARTICULARLY PLEASED THAT THEY HAD KEPT NOURI'S CROWD VIRTUALLY IMMOBILIZED FOR A MONTH. NOW HE AND SOME OF THE OTHER "QUIET ONES," ARE MOVING INTO MORE ACTIVITIST ROLES. EMBASSY WILL ATTEMPT TO IDENTIFY OTHER LEADERS OF FACTIONS WHICH ARE APPARENTLY DEVELOPING IN PARLIAMENT.

PROMINENT RELIGIOUS INTELLECTUAL WHOM EMBOFF QUERIED FEB 6 HAS OPINED THAT KHOMEINI'S STATEMENT TO EFFECT THAT "BAZARGAN GOVT" IS CANONICAL AND OPPOSITION TO IT IS SACRILEGE IS PRIMARILY POLITICAL-PSYCHOLOGICAL TACTIC, WELL-CALCULATED SEVERELY TO SHAKE INDIVIDUAL SOLDIERS, NON-COMS, AND EVEN OFFICERS. SOURCE EMPHATICALLY DENIED KHOMEINI IS CLAIMING MANTLE OF IMAM ALI IN SENSE OF HAVING AUTHORITY TO CONFER "APPOINTMENT OF GOD" ON A THEOCRATIC GOVERNOR (WHICH WOULD BE HERESY).

MEANING OF WHAT KHOMEINI SAID, SOURCE ASSERTED, IS THAT "BY THE GRACE OF GOD THE MASSES OF THE FAITHFUL HAVE SHOWN THEIR DECISION TO FOLLOW ME; THEREFORE I HAVE A GREAT RESPONSIBILITY, TO THEM AND TO GOD, TO CHOOSE A GOOD GOVT FOR THEM. I AND THIS GOVT THUS CARRY A SACRED TRUST AND THE FAITHFUL, ON THEIR SIDE, HAVE A GREAT RESPONSIBILITY NOT TO WORK AGAINST THE FULFILLING OF THIS TRUST."

THERE IS A FINE BUT FIRM LINE BETWEEN THIS EMPHASIS ON MUTUAL RESPONSIBILITY AND CLAIM THAT GOVT MUST BE OBEYED NO MATTER WHAT. LATTER WOULD BE DIRECTLY CONTRARY TO ALAVI SHI'ITE DOCTRINE THAT RULE MUST BELONG ONLY TO THE MOST PIOUS AND VIRTUOUS. SOURCE ALSO DENIED THAT THIS COULD IN ANY WAY BE CONSIDERED THREAT OF EXCOMMUNICATION, AN IDEA ALIEN TO SHI'ITE DOCTRINE, AND ALLEGED THAT "PUNISHMENT FOR SACRILEGE" REFERRED TO WAS "NOT OF THIS WORLD BUT OF THE NEXT." FINALLY, KHOMEINI'S DECLARATION, SOURCE SAID, APPLIES ONLY TO THIS GOVT, AND NOT TO SUBSEQUENT ONES THAT WOULD INDEED BE, IN AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI'S WORDS, "CHOSEN AND DISMISSED BY ORDINARY MEN."

SUMMARY: EMBOFF USED OCCASION OF LUNCH WITH LONGTIME SOVIET EMBASSY CONTACT TO EXPRESS EXTREME DISPLEASURE AT RECENT SOVIET PROPAGANDA CHARGES AGAINST U.S. IN IRAN AND TO SUGGEST THAT SUCH ACTIVITY MIGHT REBOUND TO SERIOUS SOVIET DISADVANTAGE. SOVIET SUGGESTED MOST LIKELY OUTCOME OF PRESENT IRANIAN POLITICAL SITUATION WAS COMPROMISE BETWEEN KHOMEINI AND BAKHTIAR, SAID SOVIETS DID NOT WANT VIOLENCE EITHER, AND REACTED MILDL TO EMBOFF'S CRITICISM. END SUMMARY.

POLOFF STEMPEL MET FOR LUNCH FEB 7 WITH LONGTIME SOVIET EMBASSY CONTACT, FIRST SECRETARY GUNNADY KAZANKIN (AND KNOWN KGB OFFICER), WHOM HE HAS SEEN ON SEMI-REGULAR BASIS FOR ABOUT THREE AND A HALF YEARS. KAZANKIN HAD BEEN TRYING TO SET UP LUNCH BY PHONE FOR TEN DAYS, BUT EMBOFF HAD NOT RETURNED CALLS UNTIL FEB 5.

KAZANKIN OPENED WITH USUAL JIBE ABOUT EMBOFF FINALLY GETTING PERMISSION TO SEE HIM, AND EMBOFF REPLIED CURTLY THAT THERE DIDN'T SEEM ANYTHING TO TALK ABOUT UNTIL NOW, BUT SINCE HE HAD ASKED, EMBOFF HAD SOME COMMENTS ON RECENT SOVIET PROPAGANDA BARRAGE WHICH WAS OUTRAGEOUS EVEN BY RECENT SOVIET STANDARDS. KAZANKIN GULPED AND OFFERED HIS NOW-WHATEVER-DO-YOU-MEAN LOOK. EMBOFF, DRAWING ON REPORTING OF PAST TWO WEEKS, DID A LITTLE CHAPTER-AND-VERSE ILLUSTRATIVE SERIES, CLOSING WITH COMMENT THAT THIS SORT OF THING INCREASED BOTH U.S. AND IRANIAN SUSPICIONS ABOUT SOVIET INTENTIONS. KAZANKIN MADE USUAL PROTESTATIONS OF INNOCENCE, AND EMBOFF NOTED THAT CHARGES THAT U.S.

WAS FOMENTING COUP WERE NOT TRUE BUT, MORE IMPORTANTLY, MIGHT HAVE EVEN MORE SERIOUS CONSEQUENCES FOR U.S.S.R. IF IRANIAN MILITARY DID DECIDE TO CRACK DOWN. U.S. HAD BEEN PRETTY RESTRAINED IN COMMENTS ON SOVIET ACTIVITY, BUT THIS MIGHT HAVE TO CHANGE. IF SOVIETS CONTINUED PROPAGANDA BARRAGE, AND MILITARY DID FEEL CONSTRAINED TO MOVE DESPITE U.S. "ADVICE" TO ALL PARTIES URGING NONVIOLENT SOLUTIONS, NOT ONLY TUDEH, BUT PERHAPS SOVIET EMBASSY MIGHT FEEL THE CRUNCH AS WELL. EMBOFF THEN BACKED OFF A BIT, NOTING U.S. EMBASSY HAD COME UNDER ATTACK A COUPLE OF TIMES AND U.S. CERTAINLY DIDN'T WANT TO SEE SIMILAR ACTIVITIES DIRECTED AGAINST OUR SOVIET BRETHREN.
THIS WAS REASON WE WERE CONCERNED ABOUT SOVIET HAM-HANDEDNESS.

KAZANKIN RESPONDED RATHER MILDLY, GIVEN LEVEL OF THRUST, AND ASKED WHY U.S. WAS SO CONCERNED. EMBOFF REPLIED IT WAS MERELY THAT WE DID NOT WANT VIOLENCE, AND IT SEEMED TO US THAT SOVIETS WERE PLAYING INTO EXTREMISTS HANDS WITH PROVOCATIVE CHARGES AGAINST U.S. AND CIA. KAZANKIN SAID MOST OF INFO CAME FROM WESTERN PRESS; EMBOFF CITED SEVERAL EXAMPLES TO SHOW THAT MUCH DID NOT AND URGED KAZANKIN TO "COME OFF IT." KAZANKIN MADE NO FURTHER COMMENT AND DISCUSSION PASSED ON TO OTHER THINGS.

IN RESPONSE TO QUESTION, KAZANKIN SAID HE THOUGHT BEST SOLUTION TO PRESENT IMPASSE, AND ONE TO WHICH PARTIES WERE HEADING, WAS COMPROMISE BETWEEN BAKHTIAR AND KHOMEINI. WHEN ASKED WHAT THIS MEANT IN PRACTICE, KAZANKIN SAID, LAUGHINGLY "BAKTIAR'S SURRENDER." HE SAID HE HAD HEARD BAKHTIAR AND BAZARGAN HAD BEEN TALKING. EMBOFF PARRIED BY SAYING HE HAD HEARD SAME RUMOR. KAZANKIN GAVE RITUAL GARBAGE RESPONSES TO QUESTIONS ABOUT TUDEH (COMMUNIST) PARTY ACTIVITY: SOVIET EMBASSY HAS NO IN-COUNTRY CONTACTS WITH TUDEH; THIS IS CARRIED OUT IN PARIS OR ELSEWHERE. HE NOTED THAT NEW "IRANIAN COMMUNIST PARTY" HAD MADE ITS APPEARANCE (SEE FEB 6 TEHRAN POL/SECURITY REPORT) BUT CLAIMED TO KNOW NOTHING ABOUT IT.

SOVIETS DID NOT WANT VIOLENCE EITHER, AND HAD EVACUATED THEIR DEPENDENTS TO AVOID ANY UNPLEASANT POSSIBILITIES. HE DESCRIBED SOVIET POSTURE AS WATCHFUL WAITING AND DISCOUNTED POSSIBILITY THAT HARD-LINE KHOMEINI-SPONSORED GOVERNMENT WOULD POSE ANY ATTRACTION FOR SOVIET MOSLEMS.

COMMENT: KAZANKIN WAS ON THE DEFENSIVE EARLY ON AND ASIDE FROM ASKING WHETHER GEN HUYSER HAD LEFT (EMBOFF REPLIED AFFIRMATIVELY) AND SEEKING GENERAL U.S. VIEW ON ------------------110618 090035Z /75 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 3863 INFO AMEMBASSY MOSCOW SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 01965 SITUATION (ANSWER: WE FAVOR REAL COMPROMISE), HE DID NOT PRESS SPECIFIC QUESTIONS. HE INVITED EMBOFF TO SOVIET TRADE MISSION SAUNA IN TWO WEEKS TIME, AND GENERALLY DISPLAYED MILD REACTION TO EMBOFF'S CRITICISM, WHICH IS AS CLOSE AS HE EVER COMES TO ADMITTING ANY VALIDITY TO U.S. COMMENTS.

BIO NOTE: KAZANKIN EXPECTED HIS WIFE TO RETURN TO IRAN IN TWO TO THREE WEEKS TIME, WHEN CHILDREN ARE SETTLEDIN SCHOOL (SHE IS A TRANSLATOR IN THE SOVIET EMBASSY HERE.). HE ALSO SAID HE HAD SUFFERED A VERY MILD HEART ATTACK ABOUT TWO WEEKS PREVIOUSLY WHICH HAD KEPT HIM IN BED FOR THREE DAYS. HE THOUGHT IT WAS UPSET STOMACH, BUT DOCTORS CONFIRMED IT HAD BEEN A MILD HEART ATTACK. HE CLAIMED TO FEEL FINE BUT TOOK BEER INSTEAD OF HIS USUAL VODKA AT LUNCH. EMBOFF CHIDED HIM ABOUT NOT GETTING ENOUGH EXERCISE, AND HE ASCRIBED HEART PROBLEM TO TENSION AND ABSENCE OF FAMILY. SULLIVAN

SUMMARY: INDIVIDUAL RECOMMENDED TO US BY FOREIGN MINISTER'S OFFICE TOLD EMBOFF SUPPORTERS OF GOVERNMENT WERE FORMING CONSTITUTIONAL PARTY. HE DESCRIBED GROUP'S CONTACTS AND ASKED FOR EMBASSY AID, PARTICULARLY IN MANAGEMENT AREA. END SUMMARY.

AT REQUEST OF FOREIGN MINISTER'S OFFICE, POLOFF RECEIVED VISIT BY FIROOZ SHARIFI, WHO DESCRIBED HIMSELF AS A PROJECT MANAGER FOR ISIRAN. SHARIFI OPENED THE CONVERSATION BY SAYING HE AND OTHER FRIENDS HAD JOINED TOGETHER TO FIGHT THE RELIGIOUS MOVEMENT AND PARTICULARLY AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI'S INSISTENCE UPON AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. HIS GROUP CALLS ITSELF THE HESBEH TA'AVOM (UNITY PARTY). INDIVIDUAL NAMED (FNU) MAHORAM HAD STARTED THE PARTY ABOUT TWO MONTHS AGO. SHARIFI DESCRIBED HIMSELF AS A CENTRAL COMMITTEE MEMBER AND SAID HIS GROUP AND OTHER GROUPS HAVE JOINED TOGETHER IN THE NATIONAL UNITY FRONT (JEBEYEH VADAH MELLI--NOT TO BE CONFUSED WITH THE NATIONAL FRONT OF KARIM SANJABI).

SHARIFI SAID HIS GROUP WAS ORGANIZING MIDDLE AND UPPER CLASS AS WELL AS WORKERS TO OPPOSE THE RELIGIOUS MEMBERS WITHIN THE NATIONAL FRONT. THERE WERE GROUPS "OF VERY TOUGH PEOPLE" WHO WERE PERFECTLY WILLING TO PROTECT THEIR OWN FORCES FROM THE THUGS OF THE KHOMEINI CAMP. HE SAID THE GROUP HAS CONNECTIONS IN SEVERAL CITIES AND SPECIFICALLY MENTIONED GORGAN AND RASHT. SHARIFI HIMSELF HAS CLOSE TIES TO DR. GHOLAM REZA SADIQI (WHO WAS PM DESIGNATE BRIEFLY IN DEC 1978) AND SAID HE HAD MET WITH COURT MINISTER ARDALAN AND GENERAL BADR'EI WITHIN THE PAST FEW DAYS.

THE UNITY PARTY ALSO HAD CONTACTS WITH RELIGIOUS MINORITY GROUPS, PARTICULARLY A MILITANT ARMENIAN GROUP WHICH WAS WILLING TO PROTECT ITSELF WITH WEAPONS. MANY OF HIS PEOPLE HAD ARMED THEMSELVES AND MANY MORE WERE DOING SO. SHARIFI SAID HE WISHED TO ESTABLISH CONTACT WITH THE EMBASSY AND AFTER SOME HEMMING AND HAWING SUGGESTED THE EMBASSY MIGHT WANT TO AID HIS GROUP. EMBOFF REPLIED WITH STANDARD STATEMENT OF U.S. NON-INTERVENTION BUT EXPRESSED INTEREST IN CONTINUING TO TALK ABOUT THE GROUP.

UNDETERRED BY THIS NEGATIVE STATEMENT, SHARIFI SAID HIS GROUP DID NOT REALLY NEED MONEY BUT NEEDED MANAGEMENT HELP FROM"SPECIALISTS TO HELP TRAIN OUR PEOPLE." SHARIFI SAID HE AND ONE OR TWO OTHERS HAD BEEN DOING ALL THE MANAGEMENT WORK. EMBOFF REPLIED THAT THIS SORT OF AID COULD HARDLY BE GIVEN BY THE AMERICAN EMBASSY WITHOUT SERIOUSLY COMPROMISING THE MOVEMENT. SHARIFI BACKED OFF THEN AND MERELY ASKED FOR "ADVICE." EMBOFF WAS NONCOMMITTAL BUT AGREED TO MEET AGAIN EARLY NEXT WEEK.

COMMENT: SHARIFI IS A BRIGHT , MID-30S U.S. EDUCATED (BUSINESS ADMINISTRATION, SYRACUSE UNIVERSITY), PROFESSIONAL WHO CLAIMS TO HAVE HAD EIGHT YEARS EXPERIENCE IN POLITICS. HE DID NOT DESCRIBE THIS EXPERIENCE, HOWEVER, AND EMBOFF BELIEVES HE HAS PROBABLY BEEN A SAVAK AGENT AT SOME POINT IN THE PAST. HE SEEMED THOROUGHLY CONVERSANT WITH HIS GROUP AND THEIR PROBLEMS AND SEEMED TO EXPECT THE EMBASSY TO LEAP AT THE CHANCE TO GIVE HIS GROUP SOME ASSISTANCE. EMBASSY WILL ATTEMPT TO ESTABLISH HIS BONA FIDES AND MAINTAIN CONTACT.

ON SUBSTANCE OF HIS PRESENTATION, MENTION OF SADIQI AS BACKING THIS MOVEMENT SEEMS VERY STRANGE TO US--UNLESS THE MOVEMENT HAS BEEN MISREPRESENTED TO HIM OR HE SEES IT AS A NECESSARY BALANCING PALLIATIVE TO HEAVY EMPHASIS ON RELIGION IN KHOMEINI MOVEMENT. SHARIFI COULD, OF COURSE, MERELY BE STALKING HORSE FOR GOI, BUT THIS SEEMS UNLIKELY.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: DISSIDENT WORKERS IN SEVERAL MINISTRIES SUPPORT BAZARGAN. TALEGHANI ADMONISHES AGAINST THREATENING ALLEGED REGIME SUPPORTERS. BAKHTIAR IN PRESS CONFERENCE SAYS HE WILL ACCEPT RESULTS OF A REFERENDUM. 4-5000CONSTITUTIONALISTS DEMONSTRATED YESTERDAY. UNPAID WORKERS SIT-IN, DEMANDING SALARY. ISFAHAN AND SHIRAZ FALSELY REPORTED TO BE UNDER ISLAMIC GOVT. GRAND MARCH TODAY INCLUDED UNIFORMED SOLDIERS. END SUMMARY

DISSIDENT WORKERS OF NINE MINISTRIES -- FINANCE, JUSTICE, HEALTH, HOUSING, ENERGY, INFORMATION, PTT, PRIMIN'S OFFICE, AND FOREIGN AFFAIRS -- YESTERDAY PLEDGED ALLEGIANCE TO THE BAZARGAN GOVT. WORKERS OF OTHER OFFICIAL ORGANIZATIONS SUCH AS PARS NEWS AGENCY, IRAN AIR, CIVIL AVIATION, AND THE ARYA SHIPPING COMPANY DID THE SAME. MOST OF THESE WORKERS WERE HARDLY COOPERATING WITH BAKHTIAR IN ANY CASE, BUT THEIR ACTIONS ASSUME SYMBOLIC SIGNIFICANCE. THE NUMBER OF MAJLIS DEPUTIES WHO HAVE ACTUALLY RESIGNED OR SUBMITTED THEIR RESIGNATIONS HAS CLIMBED TO 42 BUT QUORUM IS NOT THREATENED. SOME MAY STILL RETRACT THE RESIGNATIONS.
BAZARGAN WILL ADDRESS A RALLY TOMORROW AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY AND WE HAVE GOOD REPORT THAT HE WILL UNVEIL THE CABINET AT THAT TIME.

PRIMIN BAKHTIAR KEPT THE UPPER LIP STIFF DURING PRESS CONFERENCE THIS MORNING, REPEATING THAT HE DOES NOT CARE IF BAZARGAN NAMES A CABINET, BUT IF THE PROVISIONAL GOVT TRIES TO ACT, BAKHTIAR TOO WILL ACT. HE SAID IN FOUR WEEKS HE HAD DONE ALL THAT THE OPPOSITION WANTED. WHEN ASKED WHY THE PRESS DID NOT SUPPORT HIM, HE REPLIED IT WAS BECAUSE THE PRESS WAS NOT FREE. HE DID, HOWEVER, ADMIT THE POSSIBILITY OF A REFERENDUM, PROVIDED IT WAS DEMOCRATIC AND PEACEFUL, AND SAID HE WOULD ABIDE BY ITS RESULTS.

ELECTIONS SHOULD BE HELD IN 5-6 MONTHS, BUT HE DECLARED HIMSELF AMENABLE TO HOLDING THEM SOONER IF THIS COULD BE DONE PEACEFULLY. HE HAD HAD NO CONTACT WITH THE SHAH, AND IF THE PEOPLE DECIDE THE SHAH SHOULD ABDICATE, BAKHTIAR WILL ACCEPT THAT DECISION. HE CALLED ON THE OPPOSITION TO FORM REGULAR POLITICAL PARTY OR PARTIES RATHER THAN DOING THEIR POLITICS ON THE STREETS.

FOUR TO FIVE THOUSAND OF BAKHTIAR'S SUPPORTERS HELD RALLY YESTERDAY AFTERNOON. DEMONSTRATION WAS MARRED BY FACT THAT POWER COINCIDENTALLY WENT OFF AT HIGH POINT OF RALLY (SILENCING LOUDSPEAKERS). PRESS REPORTS THERE WERE NO CLASHES BETWEEN KHOMEINI SUPPORTERS AND CONSTITUTIONALISTS, BUT EMBOFF WITNESSED SCUFFLES BETWEEN THE TWO GROUPS AS RALLY WAS BREAKING UP. CONSTITUTIONAL GROUP PLANS ANOTHER MEETING TOMORROW AT 0900. THIS MAY TURN INTO A MARCH, BRINGING CLASHES.
ABOUT 5,000 TEHRAN FACTORY WORKERS LAUNCHED SIT-IN YESTERDAY AT GENERAL TIRE FACTORY, DEMANDING THEIR BACK SALARIES. MANAGEMENT SAYS BANK CLOSURES HAD PREVENTED PAYMENT.

AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI ADMONISHED PEOPLE NOT TO THREATEN PEOPLE SUSPECTED OF COLLABORATING WITH THE REGIME. IN A COMMUNIQUE RELEASED YESTERDAY, HE SAID THREATS AND UNAUTHORIZED PUNISHMENTS RESULT FROM A PLOT BY THE REGIME WITH ITS AMERICAN AND ISRAELI ALLIES. HE ADVISES THOSE WHO RECEIVE SUCH THREATS TO IGNORE THEM, AND TO STAND AND FIGHT IF ACTION GOES BEYOND VERBAL THREATS.

TERRORISTS SERIOUSLY WOUNDED AN ARMY COLONEL YESTERDAY IN REZAYIEH AS HE LEFT HIS HOME FOR WORK. RADIO IRAN ALSO REPORTS TERRORISTS ATTACKED NIRT BUILDING IN SANANDAJ THE NIGHT OF FEB 6-7, KILLING A GENDARMERIE GUARD.

PRESS AND AIRWAVES ARE FULL OF REPORTS THAT ISFAHAN AND SHIRAZ ARE IN THE HANDS OF ISLAMIC GOVT. CONSULS IN THOSE TWO CITIES REFUTE THIS CLAIM. CONSUL ISFAHAN SPOKE WITH AYATOLLAH KHADAMI ON THIS SUBJECT, AND KHADAMI DENIED THAT HE IS IN ANY WAY THE GOVERNOR OF ISFAHAN. THERE ARE ISLAMIC TRAFFIC POLICE IN BOTH CITIES, AS PREVIOUSLY REPORTED, ALTHOUGH IN SHIRAZ EVEN THESE HAVE DECLINED IN NUMBERS. THERE ARE ALSO PARADE MARSHALS AND ISLAMIC COOPERATIVES, BUT THESE ALSO ARE NOT NEW. RELIGIOUS AUTHORITIES DO PLAY AN ENHANCED ROLE, AS PEOPLE BRING COMPLAINTS TO THEM AND THEY COOPERATE WITH CIVIL AUTHORITIES TO SOLVE PROBLEMS.

BUT THEY DO NOT BYPASS CIVIL AUTHORITY, EVICT THEM FROM OFFICES, OR OTHERWISE RULE THEIR MUNICIPALITIES. CONSUL ISFAHAN HAS HIMSELF CALLED UPON KHADAMI, FOR EXAMPLE, TO PUT A HALT TO PTT WORKERS DISRUPTING TELEPHONE CALLS, BUT THE GOVERNORS AND (IN ISFAHAN) MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES ARE STILL IN PLACE AND FUNCTIONING, ALBEIT IN COORDINATION WITH LOCAL RELIGIOUS AUTHORITIES. CIVIL SERVANTS HAVE, OF COURSE, BEEN CONDUCTING THE SAME SLOWDOWNS OR SIT-DOWN STRIKES WHICH HAVE PARALYZED THE COUNTRY FOR WEEKS. PAO REPORTS FROM MASHAD CONTACT THAT THIS CITY HAS SIMILAR CONDITIONS. POLICE PATROL STREETS EXCEPT DURING DEMONSTRATIONS, WHEN ISLAMIC MARSHALS TAKE OVER.
RELIGIOUS GROUPS ISSUE KEROSENE AND FOOD, BUT DO NOT "RUN" THE CITY.

TODAY IS ANOTHER GRAND MARCH DAY IN TEHRAN AND OTHER CITIES. MASSIVE KHOMEINI-BAZARGAN RALLY (WITHOUT THE AYATOLLAH, WHO IS RESTING) CAME OFF PEACEFULLY. AS RALLY BROKE UP, QUITE A FEW TRUCKLOADS OF DEMONSTRATORS HAVE PASSED EMBASSY, SHOUTING "GO HOME," BUT THEY HAVE KEPT ON GOING AND HAVE NOT THREATENED COMPOUND. SIMILAR DEMONSTRATIONS TOOK PLACE IN TABRIZ, ISFAHAN, AND SHIRAZ TODAY, ALL WITHOUT INCIDENT. TEHRAN DEMONSTRATION INCLUDED SIGNIFICANT NUMBERS OF UNIFORMED MILITARY PERSONNEL. RADIO IRAN SAYS TOTAL REACHED OVER ONE MILLION AND 1,000 OFFICERS PARTICIPATED. EMBASSY EYEWITNESS SAW ABOUT 200 UNIFORMED AIR FORCE PERSONNEL. WE HAVE LEARNED THAT 1-2000 UNIFORMED TROOPS WENT TO KHOMEINI'S HEADQUARTERS THIS MORNING TO PAY HOMAGE.

TEHRAN CROWD TODAY "APPROVED" A COMMUNIQUE WITH FOLLOWING POINTS: (A) THE PEOPLE HAIL THE DEPARTURE OF THE SHAH AND ARRIVAL OF IMAM KHOMEINI; (B) THE PEOPLE APPROVE THE PROVISIONAL GOVT OF MEHDI BAZARGAN; (C) ALL SECURITY FORCES -- MILITARY, POLICE AND GENDARMERIE

ARE INSTRUCTED TO OBEY THE PROVISIONAL GOVT; (D) PRIME MINISTER'S OFFICE AND ALL OTHER MINISTRIES ARE TO TAKE ORDERS ONLY FROM BAZARGAN, NOT THE ILLEGAL GOVT OF BAKHTIAR; (E) MEMBERS OF THE ILLEGAL GOVT ARE ------------------104832 081449Z /43 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 3884 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY BONN AMEMBASSY CAIRO AMCONSUL DHAHRAN IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY DOHA AMCONSUL FRANKFURT AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS USLO PEKING AMEMBASSY RABAT USLO RIYADH IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY TOKYO USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC SECTION 03 OF 03 TEHRAN 01994 WARNED NOT TO STAND IN FRONT OF THE PEOPLE BUT TO ANNOUNCE THEIR RESIGNATION; (F) SENATORS AND DEPUTIES MUST DEPART FROM SENATE AND MAJLIS; AND (G) ALL GOVTS OF THE WORLD ARE INFORMED THAT AS OF THIS DATE, ALL CONTRACTS AND AGREEMENTS APPROVED BY BAZARGAN WILL BE APPROVED BY THE PEOPLE OF IRAN.

SUMMARY: LIBERATION MOVEMENT (LMI) SOURCE SAYS BAZARGAN WILL NAME HIS CABINET AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY MEETING MORNING FEB. 9. "TAKEOVER" OF GOI WILL PROCEED VERY SLOWLY BEGINNING NEXT WEEK, TO AVOID CLASH WITH ARMY. LMI SOURCE SAYS HE IS MEETING WITH PRIME MINISTER BAKHTIAR EVERY DAY, BUT PRIME MINISTER HAS THUS FAR REJECTED MEETING WITH BAZARGAN. ISLAMIC MOVEMENT STRATEGY IS STILL TO CALL FOR VOTE OF NO CONFIDENCE, BUT AS OF NOW, THEY DON'T HAVE THE VOTES. HIGH-LEVEL MEETING BETWEEN LMI AND MILITARY SET FOR LATE FEB. 8 OR EARLY FEB. 9. CABINET CHOICES STILL BEING CONSIDERED. END SUMMARY.

SENIOR LMI CONTACT WHO MEETS REGULARLY WITH POLOFF STEMPEL SAID AT NOON MEETING FEB. 8 THAT KHOMEINI'S PREMIER-DESIGNATE, MEHDI BAZARGAN, WILL ANNOUNCE HIS "GOVERNMENT'S" PROGRAM AND HIS CABINET CHOICES AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY MEETING SCHEDULED FOR MORNING FEB. 9. LMI HOPING FOR MINIMAL MILITARY REACTION, AND SOURCE INDICATED NEW "MINISTERS" WILL ATTEMPT TO TAKE OVER MINISTRIES ONE BY ONE, BEGINNING EITHER FEB. 10 OR 11.

WHEN ASKED WHETHER LMI EXPECTED MILITARY TO BLOCK EFFORTS OF NEW MINISTERS TO ENTER BUILDINGS, SOURCE SAID HE WAS NOT CERTAIN, BUT MOVEMENT HAD CONTINGENCY PLANS: IF ARMY DOES NOT RPT NOT ALLOW BAZARGAN MEN TO ENTER MINISTRIES, THEN NEW "MINISTERS" WILL ORDER MINISTRY EMPLOYEES TO OTHER LOCATIONS. SOURCE SAID HIS OFFICE WOULD BE REPOSITORY OF ONE MINISTRY, "PERHAPS FOR A COUPLE OF DAYS". SOURCE EMPHASIZED THAT BAZARGAN WANTED TO MOVE VERY CAUTIOUSLY, AND TAKEOVER PROCEDURE WOULD BE STRETCHED OUT AT LEAST A WEEK OR TWO TO AVOID OVERT CONFLICT THAT MIGHT ESCALATE INTO VIOLENCE. KEY WEAPON IN KHOMEINI ARSENAL WILL BE ITS CONTROL OVER MINISTRY STAFFS.

(COMMENT: VERY FINE-TUNED WAY LMI EXPECTS TO RUN MINISTRY TAKEOVER IS EXAMPLE OF CAREFUL DEPLOYMENT OF KHOMEINI FORCES TO AVOID CONFLICT WITH MILITARY. KEY ISSUE IS WHETHER STAFFS WILL FOLLOW "ORDERS" OF NEW QUASI-MINISTERS AND ACTUALLY DEPART PREMISES -- IN THIS REVOLUTION EVEN THE TEA BOYS ARE BEING GIVEN A CHANCE TO CHOOSE SIDES. OUR INITIAL PREDICTION IS THAT RESULTS WILL BE MIXED, LEADING TO EVEN GREATER CHAOS IN GOI OPERATIONS, IF THIS IS POSSIBLE.)

BECAUSE PROCESS WILL BE STRETCHED OUT, IT WILL KEEP PRESSURE ON BAKHTIAR TO "GIVE UP", ACCORDING TO LMI SOURCE, WHO SAYS HE IS SEEING BAKHTIAR EVERY DAY. BAKHTIAR HAS BEEN "VERY CHILDISH" IN HIS ANGRY REACTION TO BAZARGAN'S MANDATE (SOURCE SEEMED TO HAVE DIFFICULTY ACCEPTING THAT IT WAS NOT PRIMA FACIE UNREASONABLE FOR SOMEONE TO SHOW A BIT OF ANGER AT AN OLD FRIEND WHO WAS TRYING TO STEAL HIS JOB), AND HAS REFUSED TO MEET BAZARGAN. SOURCE THOUGHT AS TEMPERS COOLED AND GOI GREW WEAKER, BAKHTIAR MIGHT BECOME "MORE REASONABLE".

EVEN IF BAKHTIAR REMAINS OBDURATE, LMI PLANS TO CONTINUE TO TRY TO PLAY CARD OF PARLIAMENTARY DISMISSAL. LMI SUPPORTERS IN MAJLES DID NOT CALL FOR NO-CONFIDENCE DEBATE AND VOTE FEB. 6 BECAUSE THEY DISCOVERED AT LAST MINUTE THAT THEY DIDN'T HAVE THE VOTES (THEY WERE RIGHT; SEE REF B). KHOMEINI SUPPORTERS PLAN EXTENSIVE "LOBBYING" CAMPAIGN TO SWITCH VOTES (FOR MAJLESMAN'S VIEW OF THIS PROCESS, SEE PARA FIVE, REF B), AND ENTEZAM WAS HOPEFUL THAT PROCESS WOULD BE UNDER WAY BY END OF NEXT PERSIAN WEEK (FEB. 14 OR 15). IF DISMISSAL VOTE CAN NOT BE ROUNDED UP, ALTERNATIVE SCHEME IS TO HAVE LMI SUPPORTERS RESIGN UNTIL QUORUM IS NOT POSSIBLE.
THIS WOULD ALLOW REGENCY COUNCIL TO DISMISS BAKHTIAR AND APPOINT BAZARGAN AS "PROVISIONAL" PRIME MINISTER TO SUPERVISE NEW ELECTIONS.

ANOTHER ELEMENT OF LMI STRATEGY IS MISSIONARY WORK WITH MILITARY. LMI HAS HIGH-LEVEL MEETING ARRANGED BETWEEN HOJATOLLAH BEHESHTI AND DR. SAHABI ON LMI SIDE, AND GENERALS GHARABAGHI AND MOGHADDAM ON ARMED FORCES SIDE. MEETING WILL TAKE PLACE EVENING FEB. 8 OR MORNING FEB. 9 (OR PERHAPS BOTH). SOURCE COULD NOT BE DRAWN OUT ON LMI STRATEGY, BUT INTIMATED IT WOULD INVOLVE TRYING TO GET MILITARY TO GO ALONG WITH "KHOMEINI WAVE" AND ACCEPT INEVITABLE. (COMMENT: THIS MIGHT BE EASIER IF KHOMEINI GROUP IS PRIVATELY NOT AS HARD-LINE AS IN PUBLIC STATEMENTS CALLING FOR REMOVAL OF TOP MILITARY LEADERS.

SOURCE IS CLEARLY VERY COY ABOUT DISCUSSING LMI STRATEGY ------------------104980 081514Z /42 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 3886 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 01995 LIMDIS TOWARD MILITARY WITH USG NOW THAT EMBASSY HAS "DONE ITS WORK" IN LMI EYES AND KEPT THE MILITARY FROM GOING FOR AN IMMEDIATE TAKEOVER.)

SOURCE DID NOT RPT NOT KNOW WHO WOULD BE IN CABINET; FINAL LIST WAS STILL BEING SET (NEWSPAPER REPORTS TO CONTRARY WERE WRONG) AND WOULD PROBABLY NOT BE AVAILABLE UNTIL EARLY EVENING. (SOURCE SAID HE WOULD TRY AND GET IT TO US.) HE DID WANT TO ASSURE US OF ONE THING: KHOMEINI ADVISER BANISADR WOULD NOT RPT NOT BE ECONOMICS MINISTER. WITH EVIDENT PAIN, HE SAID BANISADR'S SPEECHES OF PAST FEW DAYS HAVE BEEN SEVERE EMBARRASSMENT TO ISLAMIC MOVEMENT. SPEAKING CONFIDENTIALLY, SOURCE SAID LEADERSHIP INTENDED TO CONVINCE BANISADR TO RETURN TO PARIS WHERE HIS "INTELLECTUAL" APPROACH WAS "MORE APPROPRIATE".

segments.text: ON ISLAMIC MATTERS (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: PASTOR OF COMMUNITY CHURCH COMMENTS ON AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI, ON THE SHI'AH IDEA OF MARTYRDOM, ON MATTERS OF SHI'AH BELIEF AND PRACTICE WITH REGARD TO RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP, AND ON THE "FREEMASONRY CONSPIRACY" THEORIES CURRENT IN CERTAIN CIRCLES. END SUMMARY.

COMMUNITY CHURCH PASTOR ROBERT PRYOR, WHO HAS LIVED IN IRAN 20 YEARS, SERVED AS ONE OF SEVERAL INTERPRETERS AT JAN. 22 MEETING OF FOREIGN REPORTERS WITH AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI. PRYOR FOUND TALEGHANI A CHARMING, INTELLIGENT MAN, BUT SAID THE AYATOLLAH WAS ANGERED AT ONE POINT BY "RUDE, AGGRESSIVE QUESTIONING" BY WASHINGTON POST'S JONATHAN RANDALL, WHO INSTRUCTED THE IRANIAN INTERPRETER: "WOULD YOU ASK THE AYATOLLAH IF HE IS CONFUSED." TALEGHANI SAT STRAIGHT UP AND REPLIED, "IF HE IS BRUSQUE WITH ME, I WILL BE BRUSQUE WITH HIM. THE TROUBLE WITH YOU AMERICANS IS THAT YOU ARE STUPID. YOU DO NOT UNDERSTAND SHI'AH ISLAM AND THE WAY WE IRANIAN MOSLEMS CHOOSE OUR LEADERS.

KHOMEINI CAN BE THE LEADER THIS MONTH AND SOMEONE ELSE NEXT MONTH. THE BOOKS THAT ARE PUBLISHED IN THE WEST ABOUT ISLAM ARE MOSTLY ABOUT THE SUNNIS AND MOST ARE BLASPHEMOUS". IN RESPONSE TO QUESTION, TALEGHANI ALSO REPEATED CLAIM THAT RELIGIOUS MOVEMENT HAS WEAPONS AND WILL DISTRIBUTE AND USE THEM IF NECESSARY.

DURING THE PRESS CONFERENCE AN IRANIAN WOMAN ENTERED, SAT DOWN BESIDE THE AYATOLLAH, AND BEGAN ASSISTING WITH TRANSLATION. AFTER THE PRESS CONFERENCE PRYOR SPOKE TO HER. SHE PROVED TO BE A YOUNG WOMAN WITH AN M.A. IN MATHEMATICS FROM UCLA AND EXCELLENT ENGLISH. PRYOR ARRANGED FOR HER TO HAVE A PRIVATE CHAT WITH WIFE OF WALL STREET JOURNAL CORRESPONDENT RAY VICKERS. MRS. VICKERS REPORTEDLY CAME AWAY MUCH IMPRESSED WITH THIS WESTERNTRAINED WOMAN'S DEDICATION TO THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT AND WILLINGNESS TO ACCEPT WOMAN'S ROLE IN ISLAMIC CULTURE. (COMMENT: NOTEWORTHY IN THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT IS THE GREAT PARTICIPATION, IN BOTH NUMBERS AND FERVOR, OF WOMEN. END COMMENT.)

PRYOR NOTED THAT AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI HAS A SPECIAL MYSTIQUE DUE TO HIS HAVING BEEN ONLY AYATOLLAH SUBJECTED TO SAVAK TORTURE AND TO HIS HAVING BEEN A UNIVERSITY TEACHER WHO MADE ISLAMIC SOCIAL AND POLITICAL PHILOSOPHY INTELLECTUALLY RESPECTABLE FOR MANY STUDENTS.

TALEGHANI'S TORTURES (WHICH WE BELIEVE HAVE BEEN REPORTED BUT SHOULD BE BORNE IN MIND, AS CONSTANT CIRCULATION OF SUCH STORIES ABOUT HIM AND MANY OTHERS CONTRIBUTES ENORMOUSLY TO MAINTAINING INFLAMED ATMOSPHERE) ALLEGEDLY INCLUDED BEING FORCED TO WATCH THE RAPE OF HIS DAUGHTER, BEING URINATED ON BY SAVAK AGENTS AS HE PRAYED (ONE SOURCE SAYS IT WAS SABETI PERSONALLY), AND BEING FORCED TO LISTEN TO THE SCREAMS OF YOUNG PEOPLE BEING TORTURED IN AN ADJOINING ROOM. ANOTHER SOURCE (DR. SAHEBZAMANI) SAYS TALEGAHNI WAS ACTIVE IN FIGHTING OFF COMMUNISTS AS EARLY AS THE 1940S, BEFORE MOST OTHER LEADERS OF TODAY'S ISLAMIC MOVEMENT -- INCLUDING KHOMEINI.

PRYOR COMMENTED ON THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN THE CHRISTIAN AND ISLAMIC (AT LEAST SHI'AH) IDEAS OF MARTYRDOM: THE CHRISTIAN MARTYR DIES WITHOUT RESISTANCE, AT THE HANDS OF ENEMIES OF HIS FAITH AND BECAUSE OF HIS FAITH; THE MUSLIM CAN BECOME A MARTYR (SHAHEED) AT THE HANDS OF ANOTHER MUSLIM, FIGHTING IN ALMOST ANY CAUSE IDENTIFIED BY HIS RELIGIOUS LEADER AS DEFENSE OF THE FAITH -- AND THE ISLAMIC FAITH IS CONCEIVED AS A COMPLETE PRESCRIPTION (MORAL, SOCIAL, POLITICAL) OF A WAY OF LIFE.

(COMMENT: WE ARE UNCERTAIN WHETHER THIS MAY TO SOME EXTENT BE A SHI'AH BARGAIN BASEMENT VERSION OF ISLAMIC MARTYRDOM.) TO ILLUSTRATE THE FLEXIBILITY OF THIS IDEA, PRYOR TOLD THE STORY OF DR. NEJAD-ELAHI, THE PROFESSOR WHO WAS SHOT A COUPLE OF MONTHS AGO WHEN HE WALKED OUT ON A BALCONY OF THE MINISTRY OF SCIENCE AND HIGHER EDUCATION. NEJADELAHI WAS IMMEDIATELY PROCLAIMED A MARTYR. WHAT WAS UNKNOWN TO THOSE WHO SO HONORED HIM WAS THAT HE WAS JEWISH. OVERCOMING THEIR TREPIDATION, THE PROFESSOR'S PARENTS WENT TO AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI TO EXPLAIN THAT THE PROFESSOR HAD BEEN JEWISH AND TO ASK IF THEY MIGHT HAVE THE BODY.

TALEGHANI IMMEDIATELY AGREED, SENT LIEUTENANTS TO FIND WHERE THE BODY WAS HELD AND THEN SENT A REPRESENTATIVE TO THE PRINCIPAL RABBI TO ARRANGE THE RETURN. THE RABBI REPLIED "NO, TAKE HIM. HE IS OUR CONTRIBUTION TO THE CAUSE." TALEGHANI REPORTED THIS TO KHOMEINI, WHO WAS DEEPLY MOVED AND HAD "A HOUSEFUL OF FLOWERS" SENT TO ------------------105748 081634Z /42 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 3888 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 01996 NIJAD-ELAHI'S FAMILY. THUS NIJAD-ELAHI REMAINED A MARTYR, AND THE MOVEMENT IS CONSIDERING RENAMING THE ARYAMEHR TECHNICAL UNIVERSITY FOR HIM AFTER VICTORY IS ATTAINED.

(WE HAVE SINCE CONFIRMED THIS STORY WITH RELIGIOUS MOVEMENT SOURCES.) PRYOR ADDED THAT HE KNOWS OF AT LEAST TWO ARMENIAN "ISLAMIC MARTYRS", AND NOTED THAT THE DAILY PUBLICATION BY THE MAJOR NEWSPAPERS OF DOZENS OF BRIEF, PASSIONATE OBITUARIES ALSO CONTRIBUTES TO MAINTAINING THE EMOTIONAL MOMENTUM OF THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT. IN MANY PARTS OF TOWN, WALLS ARE PLASTERED WITH POSTERS HONORING THOUSANDS OF INDIVIDUAL MARTYRS.

PRYOR OBSERVED THAT THE QUALITIES REQUIRED IN AN AYATOLLAH ARE PERSONAL AUSTERITY, INTELLECTUALITY, AND SPIRITUALITY. THESE ARE THE QUALITIES THAT EARN A RELIGIOUS LEADER RESPECT AND LEAD PEOPLE TO TAKE THEIR PROBLEMS TO HIM. (NOTE: A PROMINENT BAZAARI EXPLAINED TO EMBOFF IN SEPARATE CONVERSATION THAT AS A RELIGIOUS LEADER ACQUIRES FAME FOR SUCH QUALITIES, MORE AND MORE MERCHANTS AND OTHERS OF "THE PEOPLE" TAKE HIM AS THEIR LEADER AND CONTRIBUTE MONEY TO HIM. THE RELIGIOUS LEADER USES THE MONEY FOR GOOD CAUSES AND TO SUPPORT STUDENTS IN THEOLOGICAL SCHOOLS. WHEN HIS INCOME FROM CONTRIBUTIONS ALLOWS HIM TO SUPPORT A SUFFICIENTLY LARGE NUMBER OF STUDENTS, HE MAY BECOME AN AYATOLLAH.

THIS PROCEDURE THE BAZAARI CALLED "THE ONLY HONEST VOTING IN IRAN". ONE MAY QUESTION THE HONESTY AND FREEDOM, HOWEVER: WE HAVE HEARD REPEATED STORIES OF KHOMEINI "COLLECTORS" FUNNELLING EXTREMELY LARGE AMOUNTS OF MONEY TO KHOMEINI FROM MAJOR BAZAARS OVER THE LAST SEVERAL YEARS. THEY GIVE RECEIPTS FOR FUNDS COLLECTED AND THESE RECEIPTS ARE SAID TO BE MOST USEFUL TO THE HOLDERS. COULD THIS FORESHADOW THE TAX SYSTEM OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC?)

PRYOR OBSERVED THAT WHILE ALL OR NEARLY ALL AYATOLLAHS ARE SEEN AS AND ARE IN FACT EXEMPLARS OF THESE QUALITIES, ORDINARY MULLAHS ARE NOT. ON THE CONTRARY, THE GENERAL FOLK VIEW IS THAT THEY ARE SUMPTUARY, IGNORANT AND DECIDEDLY MATERIALISTIC. IN THE PAST, OF COURSE, A LARGE PERCENTAGE OF VILLAGE HEADMEN (KATKHODAS) WERE MULLAHS, AND THESE HEADMEN HAVE TRADITIONALLY HAD THE AUTHORITY TO ADJUDICATE CIVIL DISPUTES AMONG PEASANTS. IN PRYOR'S VIEW ONE OF THE MOST IMPORTANT AND POPULAR OF THE SHAH'S REFORMS WAS THE CREATION OF LOCAL COURTS ("HOUSES OF EQUITY") TO ASSUME (THE MULLAHS WOULD SAY "USURP") THIS FUNCTION. (OPPOSITION LAWYERS TOO ATTACK THIS REFORM.)

THE FREEMASONRY CONSPIRACY THEORIES: EMBOFFS HAVE HEARD A SURPRISING AMOUNT OF THIS FROM SOME CONTACTS WHO ENJOY FAIRLY POWERFUL CONNECTIONS AND A MODERATE DEGREE OF INTELLECTUAL RESPECTABILITY HERE. EXTREME VERSION OF THEORY GOES AS FOLLOWS: FREEMASONS ARE BRITISH AGENTS WHO HAVE LARGELY RUN THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT SINCE THE CLOSE OF WORLD WAR II. THEY INCLUDE HOVEYDA, SHARIFEMAMI, ALAM AND MOST OTHER IMPORTANT IRANIAN "POLITICIANS" OF LAST 25 YEARS. SOME SAY SHAH IS THE CHIEF FREEMASON; OTHERS EMPHATICALLY EXCLUDE HIM. THOSE WHO EXCLUDE HIM PAINT PRESENT CRISIS AS CONSPIRACY OF BRITISH-AGENT FREEMASONS AND RUSSIAN-AGENT TUDEH TO DESTROY U.S. INFLUENCE IN IRAN.

BIBLE OF THESE POLITICAL PHILOSOPHERS IS 3-VOLUME EXPOSE BY BROTHER OF AP'S PARVIZ RAEIN ON FREEMASONRY IN IRAN. EMBOFF EXPRESSED SOME ASTONISHMENT TO PRYOR AND TO IRANIAN CONTACTS THAT SUCH IDEAS COULD BE TAKEN SERIOUSLY. PRYOR NOTED THAT WHILE THESE CONSPIRACY THEORIES ARE ABSURD, THE BASIS FOR THEM IS THAT THERE IS A SUBSTANTIAL MASONIC MOVEMENT THAT NUMBERS MANY PROMINENT PEOPLE AMONG ITS MEMBERS. AN AMERICAN MISSIONARY WAS INSTRUMENTAL IN A RENAISSANCE OF FREEMASONRY IN THE 1930S, BUT BRITISH RESIDENTS WERE INVOLVED IN GETTING IT STARTED AGAIN AFTER WORLD WAR II.

HE SAID THAT A COMMON VIEW IS THAT THE SHAH AND PRESIDENT ANWAR SADAT ARE BOTH FREEMASONS AND THAT THIS IS BASIS OF THEIR WARM BUT UNHOLY FRIENDSHIP. IRANIAN SOURCE CLOSE TO SHARIF-EMAMI CONFIRMED THAT SHARIF-EMAMI IS INDEED A LEADING FREEMASON AND THAT THERE ARE SEVEN LARGE LODGES IN TEHRAN WITH MANY PROMINENT PEOPLE AMONG MEMBERS. RAEIN'S BOOK, HE SAID, LEFT MANY OUT AND WRONGLY IDENTIFIED OTHERS AS FREEMASONS. THEORY COMMON AMONG FREEMASONS, SOURCE SAID, IS THAT CURRENT CRISIS IS PLOT BY AMERICANS TO GET RID OF SHAH AND SUBSTITUTE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT AS BULWARK AGAINST COMMUNISM.

THIS FOOTNOTE ON FREEMASONRY IS REPORTED AS IT RELATES IN SOME OPPOSITIONISTS' MINDS TO THEORIES OF FOREIGN INTERFERENCE THROUGH ALIEN RELIGIOUS OR PARA-RELIGIOUS GROUPS (AS FREEMASONS WOULD BE VIEWED). SULLIVAN

SUMMARY: IN LENGTHY TALK WITH POLOFF, NON-RELIGIOUS OPPOSITIONIST BANAFTI EXPLAINED HOW U.S. HAS BROUGHT IRAN TO ITS PRESENT PASS AND ASKED THAT U.S. SAVE ITS FUTURE IN IRAN BY QUICK SHIFT TO FORCES OF LIGHT. BANAFTI EXPRESSED VIEW THAT FOOLISHNESS BY ARMY IS NOW ONLY THING THAT COULD DELAY OR DISRUPT VICTORY OF KHOMEINI FORCES. EMBOFF ASSERTED, MOSTLY IN VAIN, THAT ARMY NOT UNDER USG CONTROL BUT IS IRANIAN POLITICAL FORCE THAT OPPOSITION HAD BEST DEAL WITH WISELY. END SUMMARY.

POLOFF MET ENG SALEH BANAFTI FOR WHAT TURNED OUT TO BE THREE-HOUR LUNCH ON FEB 6. POLOFF INITIALLY TREATED TO LONG LECTURE ON POST-WWII HISTORY OF IRAN. BANAFTI'S SPEECH WAS FAR MORE REASONED, BALANCED AND OBJECTIVE THAN MOST OF LITERALLY DOZENS OF SUCH PRESENTATIONS THAT EMBOFFS HAVE HEARD OVER LAST FEW MONTHS. WHILE HIS VERSION LACKS FIERY OBJECTIVES, EPITHETS AND SLOGANS THAT ARE USUAL, BASIC OUTLINE AND SUBSTANCE ARE STANDARD AND BEAR REPEATING IF ONLY BECAUSE THEY REPRESENT A POWERFUL MYTHOLOGY THAT HAS BEEN CREATED AND WIDELY INCULCATED AND WHICH WILL HAUNT US IN GREATER OR LESSER DEGREE FOR YEARS TO COME.

IN OUTLINE, LECTURE IS AS FOLLOWS: REZA SHAH WAS TOUGH, IGNORANT, CRUEL DICTATOR BUT AT LEAST NOT A THIEF. STILL, HIS SON WAS SEEN AS TRAINED TO ROYALTY IN WEST, PERHAPS CAPABLE OF LEARNING FROM MISTAKES OF HIS FATHER, APPARENTLY INCLINED TO BE DEMOCRATIC, CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCH. IN EARLY YEARS, IN FACE OF TRAUMA OF BRITISH/ RUSSIAN OCCUPATION, HIS CAR WAS GREETED BY ENTHUSIASTIC CROWDS, JUST AS KHOMEINI'S WAS ON HIS RIDE FROM THE AIRPORT. IN LATE 40'S, EARLY 50'S,HOWEVER, WHEN FACED WITH RISE OF TRULY POPULAR AND DEMOCRATIC LEADER IN MOSSADEQ, SHAH'S TRUE COLORS BEGAN TO EMERGE. U.S.

AT FIRST SUPPORTED, THEN REJECTED MOSSADEQ, ENGINEERED COUP AGAINST MOSSADEQ AND THUS CREATED THE SHAH AND HAS EVER SINCE BEEN HIS MAIN SUPPORT. FROM THAT TIME, IT BECAME INCREASINGLY CLEAR THAT HE WAS NOT ONLY AS CRUEL AND RIGID AS HIS FATHER BUT THAT HIS INTELLECT WAS ALSO VERY COMMONPLACE, AND HE AND HIS FAMILY EXHIBITED A LIMITLESS GREED IN LOOTING THE COUNTRY AND A SICK TASTE FOR EVERY FORM OF FINANCIAL AND SEXUAL CORRUPTION.

PRESIDENT KENNEDY FORCED THE SHAH TO MOVE TOWARD DEMOCRACY, BUT IN THE END THE SHAH PULLED THE WOOL OVER U.S. EYES AGAIN, MANAGED TO PAINT OPPOSITION AS MERELY BUNCH OF REACTIONARY RELIGIOUS FANATICS AND THUS GOT U.S. BLESSING TO CRUSH THE REVOLT. UNDER JOHNSON AND ESPECIALLY NIXON AND FORD ADMINISTRATION, SHAH WAS GIVEN A FREE HAND TO USE THE MASSIVE SECURITY FORCES THE U.S. CREATED AND NURTURED FOR HIM TO SOLIDIFY HIS REPRESSIVE HOLD ON THE COUNTRY. IN FACT U.S. EVEN EGGED ON SHAH TO WASTE VAST PORTION OF OIL REVENUES ON USELESS, FRIVOLOUS, SOPHISTICATED WEAPONRY.

SHAH USED THIS FREE HAND WITH A VENGEANCE THROUGHOUT THE SEVENTIES, ARRESTING, IMPRISONING, TORTURING AND MURDERING HUNDREDS IF NOT THOUSANDS OF IRANIANS. OPPOSITION WENT DEEP UNDERGROUND, INCREASED IN NUMBERS, FRUSTRATION, ANGER AND BITTERNESS.

CARTER ADMINISTRATION'S RECORD IS THE GOOD, THE BAD, AND THE UGLY. IT BEGAN WELL AND DESERVES CREDIT FOR PRESSURING SHAH TO OPEN UP AND THUS GIVE MOVEMENT A CHANCE TO GET UNDERWAY. AS INEVITABLE EXPLOSION OCCURRED, HOWEVER, ADMINISTRATION STUBBORNLY AND STUPIDLY PERSISTED BEYOND ALL REASONABLE LIMITS IN BACKING FIRST THE SHAH, THEN BAKHTIAR. NOW ONLY WAY U.S. CAN RECOVER ANY AFFECTION AND PRESTIGE AMONG MASS OF IRANIANS IS BY STOPPING NONSENSE AND BACKING KHOMEINI FORCES. PREFERABLY U.S. SHOULD BE VERY FIRST GOVERNMENT TO RECOGNIZE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT.
(EMBOFF OBSERVED THAT IF THERE IS TRANSITION THAT OBSERVES CONSTITUTIONAL FORMS, QUESTION WILL NOT ARISE, BUT IF NOT, IT IS DOUBTFUL THAT MANY GOVERNMENTS WILL RUSH TO RECOGNIZE BAZARGAN.)

INVARIABLY INTERWOVEN (UNSURPRISINGLY) WITH SUCH ACCOUNTS IS THE "TWO AMERICAS" THEORY. ONE AMERICA IS PRIMARILY DOMESTIC BUT OCCASIONALLY, AS IN THE KENNEDY YEARS AND AT THE BEGINNING OF THE CARTER ADMINISTRATION, LAPS OVER INTO FOREIGN POLICY. THIS AMERICA IS LIBERAL ------------------113855 090920Z /10 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 3890 INFO USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY PARIS SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 01997 AND DEMOCRATIC AND CHERISHES HUMAN RIGHTS. THE PEOPLE OF AMERICA ("I KNOW AND LOVE THEM.") ARE GENEROUS, SIMPLE, KIND AND HONEST.

ITS SYMBOLIC REPRESENTATIVES IN IRAN ARE JIM BILL, RICHARD COTTAM AND (ON ALL LIPS OF LATE) RAMSAY CLARK, RICHARD FALK AND DON LUCE. THE PREEMINENT AND DARK SYMBOL OF THE OTHER AMERICA IS KISSINGER. THIS IS THE AMERICA THAT IS ALMOST ALWAYS SEEN ABROAD. IT IS PRESIDENTIAL--THE CHECKS AND BALANCES OF AMERICA'S DOMESTIC POLITICS ARE ABSENT. IT IS CHARACTERIZED BY IMPERIALISM IN THE NAME OF GEOPOLITICAL STRATEGY. IT IS AUTOCRATIC, ZIONIST, SUPPORTIVE OF MNC'S AND THEIR EXPLOITATION OF LDC'S.

TURNING AT LAST TO CURRENT MOMENT, BANAFTI SAID OPPOSITION VICTORY NOW ACHIEVED AS LONG AS USG ENSURES THAT ARMY REFRAINS FROM DOING SOMETHING STUPID WHICH WOULD SPLIT ITS RANKS AND PLUNGE IRAN INTO CIVIL WAR. EMBOFF AGREED THAT ARMY IS THE CONTRARY FORCE BUT EMPHASIZED THAT WHILE USG HAS LIMITED AND POSSIBLY DECREASING INFLUENCE WITH ARMY, IT DEFINITELY DOES NOT HAVE CONTROL. EMBOFF NOTED THAT ATTACKS ON GENERALS IN PRESS AND ELSEWHERE (SUCH AS HAJ-SEYYED JAVADI ARTICLE REPORTED SEPTEL) COULD HARDLY LEAVE GENERALS IN RELAXED AND FRIENDLY STATE OF MIND.

BANAFTI COMMENTED THAT "THERE IS NO TELLING WHAT GENERALS LIKE OVEISSI, RABII AND KHOSROWDAD MIGHT DO." EMBOFF SUGGESTED THAT THIS BE KEPT IN MIND AS POLITICAL FACT OF LIFE, IN DEALING WITH WHICH OPPOSITION SHOULD EXPEND SOME CARE AND SKILL. BANAFTI ACKNOWLEDGED THIS SOMEWHAT HALF-HEARTEDLY AND INSISTED USG SHOULD GET THESE "CRIMINAL GENERALS" TO DEPART FOR COMFORTABLE RETIREMENT IN THE U.S. EMBOFF SAID HE HAD HEARD OF NO INCLINATION ON THEIR PART TO LEAVE JUST NOW AND SUGGESTED THAT OPPOSITION MIGHT FIND USEFUL SOME OF SPIRIT OF LINCOLN'S SECOND INAUGURAL AT THIS POINT.

BANAFTI IMMEDIATELY CAUGHT REFERENCE AND REPLIED "YOU KNOW, KHOMEINI IS THE LEADER, BUT THERE ARE LIMITS HIS FOLLOWERS WOULD NOT LET HIM PASS. HE CANNOT AT THIS TIME SHOW CHARITY AND NO MALICE TO THOSE PEOPLE." (COMMENT: HOW LONG AND TO WHAT EXTENT LEADERS OF "MOVEMENT" WILL BE TRAPPED BY THEIR OWN PASSIONATE RHETORIC IS A KEY QUESTION WITH NO CLEAR ANSWER.) ECONOMIC AND LABOR MATTERS DISCUSSED WITH BANAFTI BEING REPORTED SEPTEL.

COMMENT: BANAFTI IS ACTIVIST IN RAHMATOLLAH MOGHADDAM-MARAGHEH'S RADICAL MOVEMENT, A SECULAR, BARELYLEFT-OF-CENTER GROUP. HE IS SELF-DESCRIBED SECULAR POLITICIAN, WHO SAYS HE IS WITH THE RELIGIOUS MOVEMENT BECAUSE HE BELIEVES WITHOUT QUALIFICATION THAT IT IS THE RIGHT THING FOR IRAN AT THIS TIME. HE IS CONFIDENT THAT THE APPOINTMENT OF BAZARGAN SHOWS THAT ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT WILL BE DEMOCRATIC AND TOLERANT "EVEN OF THE MARXIST LEFT, THOUGH THEY WILL BE UNIMPORTANT." HE IS INTELLIGENT, ARTICULATE AND AGREEABLE OPPOSITION SPOKESMAN WHO GIVES EVERY EVIDENCE OF SINCERE BELIEF THAT U.S.

CAN HAVE BENEFICENT IMPACT ON COURSE OF EVENTS IN IRAN IF IT WILL ONLY SIDE "WITH PEOPLE AND NOT WITH ARMY." HIS IDEA OF POTENTIAL IMPACT, OBVIOUSLY, IS EXAGGERATED. HE CLEARLY DID NOT WHOLLY BUY EMBOFF'S ARGUMENT THAT MILITARY IS REAL AND INDEPENDENT POLITICAL FORCE. REASONS FOR HIS SKEPTICISM ARE EXAGGERATED VIEW OF OUR INFLUENCE COMBINED WITH BELIEF THAT MILITARY IS FALLING APART AND CANNOT DO ANYTHING WITHOUT ACTIVE U.S.SUPPORT. LIKE OTHER MAINSTREAM OPPOSITIONISTS, HE IS EXCITED BY THE TASTE OF VICTORY AND BELIEVES THAT IF VICTORY IS NOW LOST, THIS CAN ONLY BE FAULT OF USG. SULLIVAN

SUMMARY: LARGE CROWD AT UNIVERSITY HEARD BAZARGAN SPEAK ONLY IN GENERALITIES WITH ALLUSION TO DIFFICULTIES WITH ARMY. CONSTITUTIONALIST RALLY AT AMJADIEH STADIUM BROKE UP NOISILY BUT WITHOUT SIGNIFICANT VIOLENCE, AS CONSTITUTIONALISTS EXCHANGED TAUNTS WITH KHOMEINI FOLLOWERS IN VICINITY OF EMBASSY. PROVINCES MOSTLY QUIET. END SUMMARY.

HUGE CROWD AT UNIVERSITY THIS MORNING TO HEAR SPEECH BY BAZARGAN, WHO ORIGINALLY SCHEDULED TO ANNOUNCE GOVERNMENT AT 11:00 A.M. (EMBASSY CONTACTS, HOWEVER, INFORMED US THAT BAZARGAN WOULD NOT IN FACT NAME CABINET.) SPEECH APPARENTLY SOMEWHAT DELAYED BECAUSE BAZARGAN HAD DIFFICULTY ENTERING THROUGH PRESS OF CROWD. QUICK SUMMARY PROVIDED BY UPI, WHO SAID BAZARGAN SAID NOTHING SPECIFIC ABOUT PROGRAM OR GOVERNMENT, ALLUDED TO DIFFICULTIES WITH ARMY. ORDERLY, SLOGAN-CHANTING GROUPS NOW PASSING EMBASSY ON WAY HOME.

EARLIER THIS MORNING ABOUT 20,000 CONSTITUTIONALISTS (AP PHOTOGRAPHERS ESTIMATED) HELD PRO-BAKHTIAR RALLY AT AMJADIEH STADIUM NEXT TO EMBASSY. AS RALLY BROKE UP, DISPERSING CROWD EXCHANGED TAUNTS WITH PRO-KHOMEINI GROUPS. NOISE LEVEL WAS HIGH FOR SOME TIME BUT DETACHMENTS OF IRANIAN TROOPS (SOME WITH FIXED BAYONETS) AND RIOT POLICE WITH SHIELDS AND NIGHTSTICKS HAD SITUATION IN HAND. ONE PRO-KHOMEINI DEMONSTRATOR HARASSED POLICE EXCESSIVELY, WAS WORKED OVER WITH NIGHTSTICK AND ARRESTED. THIS ACTIVITY DIED DOWN BEFORE UNIVERSITY MEETING BROKE UP.

TABRIZ REPORTS QUIET AS OF MID-MORNING WITH NO SIGN AS YET OF ANNOUNCED CONSTITUTIONALIST MARCH. ISFAHAN AND SHIRAZ REPORT PEACEFUL PRO-BAZARGAN DEMONSTRATIONS, MUCH SMALLER THAN YESTERDAY. ISFAHAN FURTHER REPORTS BHI EMPLOYEE DORELLO (WHO WOUNDED TAXI DRIVER) HAD BEEN PROTECTED BY ISFAHAN RELIGIOUS LEADERS UNTIL SITUATION QUIETED DOWN, THEN A FEW DAYS AGO HANDED HIM OVER TO POLICE. PRELIMINARY HEARING HELD, WITH FORMAL HEARING NOT YET SCHEDULED. WIRE SERVICES REPORT CLASH OF PRO- AND ANTI-SHAH DEMONSTRATORS YESTERDAY IN GORGAN, WITH TWO DEMONSTRATORS KILLED, ONE POLICEMAN CAUGHT AND HANGED BY CROWD. ALSO REPORT ONE DEMONSTRATOR KILLED IN CASPIAN TOWN OF MAZIL.

LAST MINUTE: UPI REPORTS THAT BAZARGAN TOLD 100,000 SUPPORTERS THAT HIS FIRST PRIORITIES ARE TO GET POWER, TO REBUILD THE OIL INDUSTRY AND THE ECONOMY, TO HOLD A REFERENDUM ON THE SYSTEM OF GOVERNMENT AND TO STAGE PARLIAMENTARY ELECTIONS. UPI GAVE FOLLOWING QUOTATION FROM BAZARGAN SPEECH: "WHEN WE ASKED THE GENERALS TO COOPERATE, THEY SAID THEY WOULD NOT, THAT THEY ARE STICKING TO THE CONSTITUTION. DO NOT EXPECT MIRACLES FROM ME TOO SOON. THIS IS A VERY WEAK DONKEY I AM RIDING AND WE HAVE A LONG WAY TO GO. THE SHAH'S DEPARTURE WAS ONLY THE BEGINNING.
TODAY IS THE BEGINNING OF PHASE II OF THE REVOLUTION." ON THE ECONOMY, BAZARGAN REPORTEDLY SAID "WE HAVE GONE ON STRIKE TOGETHER AND WE WILL GO BACK TO WORK TOGETHER.

WE WILL CHOOSE A DAY ON WHICH ALL SHOPS WILL OPEN AND LIGHT UP THEIR SHOP FRONTS TO SHOW THE WORLD OUR UNITY." SUMMARY; AN IMPRESSIVE SELF-CONFIDENT EBRAHIM YAZDI PROVIDED DETAILS ON KHOMEINI'S STRATEGY AND TACTICS. OF SPECIAL INTEREST WAS THAT: 1) BAZARGAN WILL PUT OFF NAMING HIS CABINET STILL LONGER, 2) STRATEGY REMAINS TO HAVE MINISTERS TRY TO TAKE OVER MINISTRIES AND GO TO JAIL IF THEY HAVE TO, IN EXPECTATION THAT BAKHTIAR AND ARMY WILL HAVE NO ALTERNATIVE BUT TO RELEASE THEM EVENTUALLY, 3) REFERENDUM AND SUBSEQUENT ELECTIONS MUST BE RUN BY BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT WITH NO PARTICIPATION BY BAKHTIAR, 4) MOVEMENT IS CONTENT TO LET ARMY GRADUALLY WORK ITS WAY OVER TO MOVEMENT'S SIDE, PROVIDED PROVOCATIVE MOVES ARE AVOIDED BY ARMY AS THEY WILL BE BY MOVEMENT

MOVEMENT WORRIES ABOUT ARMY COUP POSSIBILITIES EVEN IN THE LONG RUN, UNDER A REPUBLIC, IN VIEW OF CONTINUING USG INFLUENCE ON ARMY, AND 6) NEW CONSTITUTION IS VISUALIZED AS CLOSER TO U.S. MODEL THAN CONTINENTAL, WITH AN ISLAMIC-STYLE "SUPREME COURT." END SUMMARY.
EVENING FEB 8 LAMBRAKIS TALKED FOR OVER TWO HOURS WITH EBRAHIM YAZDI IN HIS BROTHER'S HOUSE. BIOGRAPHIC INFORMATION ON YAZDI AND KHOMEINI BEING REPORTED SEPTEL.

YAZDI STRUCK US IN SOME WAYS AS JUNIOR VERSION OF KHOMEINI; CALM, SPEAKING SOFTLY AND VERY, VERY BRIGHT. HE DISPLAYED UTTER CONFIDENCE IN HIS BASIC STRATEGY THOUGH OBVIOUSLY WILLING TO MODIFY TACTICS. HE SAID BAZARGAN WILL NOT NAME HIS CABINET FEB 9 (AS HAD BEEN REPORTED TO US BY AN LMI SOUCE). COMMENT: THIS IS A CONCESSION TO MODERATION.

WHEN MINISTERS ARE NAMED A FEW DAYS LATER, HOWEVER, THEY WILL GO TO MINISTRIES TO TRY TO TAKE OFFICE. EMPLOYEES WILL COME OUT TO GREET THEM AND ESCORT THEM IN. IF ARMY ARRESTS THEM, IT WILL BE A USELESS MOVE, LIKE CLOSING OF AIRPORT. WHAT COULD ARMY DO NEXT? IN TIME IT WILL HAVE TO RELEASE THEM. COMMENT: THIS COURSE IMPLIES MOBS WILL BECOME UNRULY ON THE STREETS UNTIL MINISTERS ARE RELEASED.

ONCE BAZARGAN PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT IS INSTALLED, IT WILL RUN A REFERENDUM ON ISLAMIC REPUBLIC VS MONARCHY. THEN THERE WILL BE ELECTIONS TO CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY WHICH WILL DEBATE DRAFT CONSTITUTION, AMEND IT, AND RATIFY IT. THEN WILL COME ELECTIONS FOR PARLIAMENT, WHICH WILL APPOINT NEW GOVERNMENT,AND PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT WILL GO OUT OF EXISTENCE.

YAZDI ARGUED THAT PRESENT CONSTITUTION DOES NOT PROVIDE FOR ORDERLY AMENDMENT TO ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. ARTICLE ADDED MAY 8, 1949 WHICH PROVIDES FOR CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY TO REVISE THE CONSTITUTION ALSO PROVIDES THAT THE "CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCHY OF IRAN" (LIKE THE SHIA RELIGION) IS "UNCHANGEABLE FOR ETERNITY." THUS THE ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE OF DECLARING A REVOLUTION AND PROCEEDING TO REFERENDUM, CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY, AND PARLIAMENTORY ELECTIONS UNDER A PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT IS PERFECTLY PROPER UNDER INTERNATIONAL PRECEDENTS. LAWYERS SUCH AS NAZIEH (HEAD OF BAR ASSOCIATION) HAD ASSURED THE MOVEMENT THIS WAS SO. THUS THE PROBLEM BOILS DOWN NOT TO THE CONSTITUTION BUT TO THE ATTITUDE OF THE ARMY.

UNLIKE SOME OTHER OPPOSITION LEADERS WE HAVE BEEN TALKING TO, YAZDI RECOGNIZED THAT THE MAIN PROBLEM IS NOT BAKHTIAR BUT THE ARMY. HE ALSO RECOGNIZED ROLE USG HAS PLAYED TO DATE IN RESTRAINING IT. NEVERTHELESS, ARMY REMAINS LONG-TERM THREAT, NOT JUST AS MEANS OF SHAH RETURNING BUT EVEN UNDER A REPUBLIC. IT MUST BE BROUGHT UNDER CONTROL OF THE NATION. OFFICERS BELOW THE GENERALS AT THE TOP HAVE COME TO KHOMEINI MOVEMENT WITH PROPOSALS TO REVOLT AGAINST THE GENERALS. YAZDI SAID HE ALSO KNEW (AS LAMBRAKIS REMINDED HIM) THAT THERE WERE MANY SUCH OFFICERS ANXIOUS TO MOVE AGAINST KHOMEINI MOVEMENT. NEVERTHELESS, EVENTS ARE MOVING IN A SINGLE DIRECTION.

HE AGREED WITH LAMBRAKIS' STATEMENT THAT ARMED FORCES TOP COMMAND IS UNLIKELY TO LOSE CONTROL FOR SEVERAL MONTHS AT LEAST (COMMENT: THUS TACITLY ADMITTED TO A LONGER-TERM TIMETABLE FOR GRADUAL TAKEOVER.) HOWEVER, THE GENERALS MUST RECOGNIZE THEY HAVE "LOST THE GAME." THE MOVEMENT DID NOT WANT TO PROVOKE FURTHER BLOODSHED, AND IT ACCEPTED THEIR ASSURANCES THAT THE GENERALS WISHED TO AVOID IT TOO.

THEY WOULD RENDER A SALUTARY SERVICE TO THEIR COUNTRY, BEFORE THEY PACK UP AND LEAVE, IF THEY ASSURED THE ARMY KEEPING OUT OF POLITICS DURING THIS ------------------117155 091400Z /41 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 3897 INFO AMEMBASSY PARIS SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 02003 EXDIS TRANSITION PERIOD. HE NODDED AGREEMENT TO LAMBRAKIS' REMARK THAT THIS HAD TO BE WORKED OUT DIRECTLY IN CONVERSATIONS WITH THE ARMY AND BAKHTIAR (THOUGH HE IMPLIED THAT USG COULD BE HELPFUL IN REINFORCING THIS MESSAGE WITH THE GENERALS CONCERNED).

HE ALSO ADDED POINT THAT THE ARMED FORCES WOULD REMAIN SUBJECT TO USG INFLUENCE FOR A LONG TIME, IN VIEW OF US TRAINING AND EQUIPMENT. HE HOPED FOR US SUPPORT IN CHANGING IT FROM THE "TRIBE OWING ALLEGIANCE TO THE SHAH" IT NOW WAS. HE ALSO EXPRESSED CONCERN LEST USG USE ARMY AS LEVER TO INFLUENCE "AS IN 1953" BUT DID NOT PRESS THAT ARGUMENT.

IN COURSE OF DISCUSSION YAZDI INDICATED THAT THE INSTITUTIONS OF AN "ISLAMIC REPUBLIC" WILL NOT BE SO DIFFERENT THAN THOSE OF A "REPUBLIC" PLAIN AND SIMPLE. ONE EXCEPTION SEEMS TO BE CREATION OF SOMETHING RESEMBLING US SUPREME COURT--A COUNCIL OF LEARNED MULLAHS, PERHAPS ALSO INCLUDING LAY JUDGES, WHICH WOULD BE AVAILABLE FOR APPEAL BY CITIZENS CHALLENGING LEGALITY OF LAWS PASSED BY PARLIAMENT, AS WELL AS ADJUDICATING DISPUTES WHICH MAY ARISE BETWEEN THE PARLIAMENT AND THE EXECUTIVE BRANCH.

YAZDI ALSO REVEALED THAT UNNAMED "PEOPLE" HAD DRAFTED THE NEW CONSTITUTION (PROBABLY IN THE US) AND LAWYER NAZIEH HAD SIMPLY BEEN GIVEN A COPY FOR HIS COMMENTS (WHICH FITS IN WITH WHAT FELLOW LAWYER MATIN-DAFTARY TOLD US A FEW DAYS AGO). FROM GENERAL TENOR OF YAZDI'S REMARKS AND DEPRECATING COMMENTS HE HAD TO MAKE ABOUT THE INSUFFICIENCY OF THE BELGIAN CONSTITUTION, IT SEEMS LIKELY THAT NEW DRAFT CONSTITUTION IS MODELED MORE CLOSELY AFTER US CONSTITUTION THAN AFTER FRENCH ONE.

FINALLY, YAZDI SHOWED KEEN APPRECIATION OF THE URGENT NEED TO GET STRIKERS BACK TO WORK AND ECONOMY MOVING. BUT HE SUBORDINATED THIS NEED TO ASSUMPTION OF POWER BY THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT. HE SAID STRIKES WERE AN IMPORTANT WEAPON IN THE MOVEMENT'S ARSENAL WHICH COULD NOT BE PUT ASIDE UNTIL VICTORY IS IN THE MOVEMENT'S GRASP.

COMMENT: AT THIS FIRST MEETING WITH EMBASSY IN IRAN, YAZDI WAS IMPRESSIVE. HE GAVE BOTH GOOD AND BAD NEWS. THE GOOD--AN OBVIOUS RECOGNITION OF THE NEED FOR MODERATION AND STRINGING OUT THE PROCESS OF TAKEOVER FROM BAKHTIAR. THE BAD--A CLEAR UNWILLINGNESS TO COMPROMISE WITH BAKHTIAR ON ANY JOINT PLAN FOR SUPERVISION OF REFERENDUM AND ELECTIONS. ("THE PEOPLE WILL NOT ACCEPT BAKHTIAR EVEN AS A PARTICIPANT IN THE REFERENDUM," HE SAID.) YAZDI'S FEARS ABOUT REMAINING US INFLUENCE WITH ARMED FORCES EVEN UNDER THE NEW REPUBLIC CLEARLY SUGGEST MOVEMENT'S DESIRE FOR A CONTINUING FRIENDLY RELATIONSHIP WITH THE US, ALBEIT ONE LIKELY TO BE FRAUGHT WITH RECURRING SUSPICIONS ABOUT TRUE US INTENTIONS. SULLIVAN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)

FOLLOWING REPORT BASED ON TELCON WITH GEN KERTESZ, COMMANDER AIR FORCE SECTION ARMISH/MAAG, WHO IS AT DOWSHEN TAPPEH. HIS INFORMATION LARGELY BASED ON SECOND-HAND REPORTS AND SOME PERSONAL OBSERVATIONS.

LAST EVENING,FOLLOWING RERUN OF KHOMEINI ARRIVAL TV PROGRAM, PRO-KHOMEINI AIRMEN FROM THE AIR TRAINING COMMAND (ATC) DEMONSTRATED AT DOWSHAN TAPPEH AIR FORCE BASE IN EAST TEHRAN. THESE GROUPS HAD ALTERCATIONS WITH ARMY FORCES AND, REPORTEDLY, SOME ATC PERSONS WERE KILLED. WHEN THE FAMILIES AND OTHERS HEARD OF THE SHOOTING AT THE BASE, A DEMONSTRATION OF 10 TO 20,000 PEOPLE WAS HELD OUTSIDE THE BASE AND A NUMBER OF FIRES WERE STARTED. SPORADIC GUN FIRE CONTINUED ON THE BASE UNTIL 5 A.M., AT WHICH TIME THERE WAS ROUGHLY A THREE-HOUR PAUSE. THE FAMILIES AGAIN TRIED TO ENTER THE BASE THIS MORNING,AND THERE WAS ADDITIONAL SHOOTING AND SOME CIVILIANS REPORTEDLY WERE KILLED.

THIS SPARKED OFF PRO-KHOMEINI DEMONSTRATIONS AGAIN ON THE BASE AND SEVERAL BUILDINGS WERE RANSACKED. THERE HAS BEEN HEAVY FIRING FOR OVER TWO HOURS AND, ACCORDING TO ONE SENIOR IIAF GENERAL, A LARGE NUMBER OF AIR FORCE PERSONNEL HAS BEEN KILLED.

WE ARE NOT CERTAIN OF THE NUMBER OF AMERICAN MILITARY AND CIVILIANS CURRENTLY ON THE BASE, BUT ONE ESTIMATE IS 75 TO 100. GEN KERTESZ AND THOSE PERSONS WITH HIM HAD BEEN ADVISED BY SENIOR IIAF OFFICER, WHO EXPECTS SITUATION TO BECOME MORE SERIOUS AS DAY GOES ON, TO ATTEMPT TO GET OUT THE REAR GATE. THE FIRST SORTIE OF PEOPLE WHO WILL BE IN RADIO CONTACT WITH THOSE REMAINING ON BASE, IS TO START OUT WITHIN A FEW MINUTES. WE SHALL KEEP THE DEPT INFORMED.

WE HAVE BEEN INFORMED BY L.A. TIMES CORRESPONDENT THAT JOE ALEX MORRIS, WELL KNOWN AND HIGHLY RESPECTED CORRESPONDENT OF L.A. TIMES,WAS WOUNDED AND THAT HE SUBSEQUENTLY DIED OF HIS WOUNDS ABOUT 9 A.M. WE HAVE NOT BEEN ABLE TO CONFIRM THIS INFORMATION FROM IRANIAN
