IT HAS BEEN THE POSITION OF THE U.S. GOVERNMENT, IN SUPPORT OF VIEWS EXPRESSED BY THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT AND THE IRANIAN ARMED FORCES, THAT ANY CHANGE IN THE FUNDAMENTAL POLITICAL FORMS IN IRAN SHOULD BE ACCOMPLISHED THROUGH THE CONSTITUTIONAL PROCESS. IN THIS CONNECTION, WE AND THEY HAVE ASSERTED THAT THE IRANIAN CONSTITUTION CONTAINS PROVISIONS WHICH PERMIT THE REVISION OF THE FUNDAMENTAL LAW THROUGH THE ACTION OF A CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY.

MEMBERS OF THE KHOMEINI ENTOURAGE CHALLENGE THIS ASSERTION BY STATING THAT THE ADDITIONAL ARTICLE OF MAY 8, 1949 AMENDING THE SUPPLEMENTARY CONSTITUTIONAL LAW STIPULATES THAT CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLIES MAY ALTER ALL ASPECTS OF THE CONSTITUTION EXCEPT THOSE WHICH HAVE REFERENCE TO THE SHI'A RELIGION AND TO THE MONARCHY, "WHICH ARE UNCHANGEABLE FOR ETERNITY."

THEREFORE, THEY CONTEND, IN ORDER TO ACHIEVE A REPUBLIC, THEY HAVE TO RESORT TO EXTRA-CONSTITUTIONAL MEANS BECAUSE THEIR OBJECTIVE IS FRUSTRATED BY THE CONSTITUTION ITSELF. THEY CONSEQUENTLY JUSTIFY THE CALLING OF A PLEBISCITE AS THE ONLY SORT OF "LEGAL" METHOD WHICH WOULD ENABLE THEM TO ACCOMPLISH THEIR REPUBLICAN OBJECTIVE.

FOR DEBATING PURPOSES, THE EMBASSY TAKES THE POSITION THAT THE MAY 8, 1949 ARTICLE WAS ITSELF THE RESULT OF AN AMENDMENT PROCESS AND CAN THEREFORE BE FURTHER AMENDED OR NULLIFIED BY A CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY. IT IS STRESSED THAT THIS POSITION IS TAKEN FOR DEBATING PURPOSES BECAUSE BAKHTIAR HIMSELF HAS AGREED THAT HE WOULD ACCEPT THE RESULTS OF A REFERENDUM PROVIDED IT WERE CONDUCTED BY HIS GOVERNMENT, RATHER THAN THE "USURPING" GOVERNMENT OF BAZARGAN. THE ISSUE IS THUS LESS ONE OF CONSTITUTIONAL MERIT THAN IT IS A CONTEST BETWEEN THE TWO RIVAL GOVERNMENTS OVER THE QUESTION OF LEGITIMACY.

HOWEVER, JUST TO KEEP OUR DEBATING POINTS HONEST, WE WOULD APPRECIATE A QUICK CONFIRMATION BY DEPARTMENT LEGAL EXPERTS THAT OUR ARGUMENTS HAVE MERIT, AND THAT THE APPARENTLY INHIBITING ARTICLE WOULD, IN NORMAL LEGAL PRACTICE, BE SUBJECT TO REVISION BY A CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY DESPITE ITS INHERENT PROVISIONS TO THE CONTRARY.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)

UPON ADVICE OF GEN RABI'I, COMMANDER IIAF, AMERICANS DID NOT ATTEMPT TO LEAVE DOWSHAN TAPPEH. BOTH OFFICIAL AND CONTRACTOR PERSONNEL ARE HOLED UP IN VARIOUS BUILDINGS ON THE BASE. TO THE BEST OF OUR KNOWLEDGE NONE HAVE BEEN INJURED, BUT GROUPS ARE NOT FULLY IN COMMUNICATION WITH EACH OTHER.

ACCORDING TO GEN KERTESZ, SITUATION HAD SOMEWHAT EASED BY 1200 LOCAL TIME, BUT TROUBLE COULD ESCALATE AT ANY MOMENT. APPARENTLY, LARGE CROWDS HAVE GATHERED OUTSIDE THE BASE AND OTHERS ARE MARCHING TOWARD IT.
THE SITUATION REMAINS VERY CONFUSED AND WE UNDERSTAND THAT A SUBSTANTIAL GROUND FORCES DETACHMENT EITHER HAS REACHED THE BASE OR IS ON ITS WAY.
WE STILL HAVE NOT BEEN ABLE TO GET INDEPENDENT CONFIRMATION OF THE DEATH OF JOE ALEX MOORIS.

SINCE ABOVE WAS DRAFTED, WE HAVE LEARNED THAT FIRING HAS AGAIN ESCALATED AT DOWSHAN TAPPEH. THOUSANDS OF PEOPLE HAD BEEN STREAMING TOWARD THE BASE AND SOME PEOPLE ARE DRESSED IN WHITE SHROUDS INDICATING THAT THEY ARE PREPARED FOR MARTYRDOM. THE MOBS ARE BUILDING SAND BAG BARRICADES AND PILLBOXES. CIVILIANS WITH GUNS HAVE BEEN SEEN ON THE ROOF TOPS OF BUILDINGS OVERLOOKING THE BASE.
DISTURBANCES ARE NOW SPREADING THROUGH THE CITY AND WE ARE ISSUING ADVISORY THAT ALL AMERICANSSHOULD STAY WITH
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)

AT 1530 LOCAL DOWSHAN TAPPEH BASE WAS FAIRLY QUIET WITH ONLY INTERMITTENT SHOTS. FAHRABAD AVENUE (SOUTHERN PERIMETER OF BASE) IS FILLED WITH DEMONSTRATORS; THERE IS SOME SHOOTING IN GENERAL AREA OF BASE.
AMERICANS ON BASE CONTINUE TO BE SAFE ACCORDING TO OUR LIMITED INFORMATION. GENERAL RABII HAS ORDERED HELICOPTER EVAUCUATION FOR AMERICANS ON BASE.
WE STILL DO NOT HAVE FULL INFORMATION ON INCIDENT, BUT IT MORE AND MORE APPEARS TO BE GROUND FORCES VERSUS PRO-KHOMEINI AIR FORCE HOMOFARS WHO WERE SUPPORTED BY CIVILIANS.
NEXT CRUNCH POINT COULD COME LATER IF MOBS DECIDE TO CHALLENGE NEWLY SET 1630 CURFEW. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN02017.subject: (S) ATTEMPT TO MEDIATE AT DOWSHEN TAPPEH

segments.text: (S - ENTIRE TEXT).

WHEN SITUATION AT DOWSHEN TAPPEH AIR BASE REACHED ITS MOST EMOTIONAL STAGE LATE MORNING FEBRUARY 10 AND TENS OF THOUSANDS OF FRENETIC CIVILIANS WERE STREAMING TOWARDS THE BASE, I PASSED WORD THROUGH DR. MINATCHI THAT KHOMEINI SHOULD BE MADE AWARE OF THE VOLATILE POSSIBILITIES AND TRY TO RESTRAIN THE CIVILIANS FROM BECOMING ENGAGED IN THE FIREFIGHT.

WITHIN TWO HOURS, MINATCHI ISFORMED US THAT KHOMEINI HAD SENT A GROUP OF SENIOR MULLAHS TO THE GENERAL AREA TO INSTRUCT THE CROWD TO DISPERSE AND HAD APPOINTED A COMMITTEE OF THREE TO MEET WITH PRIME MINISTER BAKHTIAR TO WORK OUT ARRANGEMENTS FOR A MORE LASTING DISENGAGEMENT. QLVHSIER,#MINATCHI INFORMED US THAT, BECAUSE OF THE STRIKE OF PERSONNEL AT THE PRIME MINISTER'S OFFICE, THE PERSONNEL AT HIS TELEPHONE SWITCHBOARD REFUSED TO CONNECT THEIR TELEPHONE CALLS.

I HAVE SUBSEQUENTLY GIVEN MINATCHI THE NUMBER FOR THE DIRECT LINE TO GENERAL GHARABAGHI'S OFFICE IN AN EFFORT TO PUT HIM IN TOUCH WITH SOMEONE RESPONSIBLE. IN THE MEANTIME, STREETS CROWDS HAVE SET UP ROAD BLOCKS, BARRICADES AND ARE BURNING DEBRIS IN THE STREETS AROUND DOWSHEN TAPPEH. THE POSSIBILITY FOR FURTHER CONFRONTATION EXISTS IF THE MILITARY ATTEMPT TO ENFORCE THE NEWLY INSTALLED 1630 CURFEW INTHAT VICINITY. SULLIVAN NOTE BY OC/T: TEHRAN 2017. #PARA 3 AS RECEIVED.

1979TEHRAN02018.subject: AMERICANS SAFELY EVACUATED FROM DOWSHAN TAPPEH

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

GENERAL KERTESZ HAS INFORMED US THAT ALL AMERICANS, OFFICIAL AND CONTRACTOR PERSONNEL, HAVE BEEN SAFELY EVACUATED BY HELICOPTER FROM DOWSHAN TAPPEH TO GULF DISTRICT WHERE THEY WILL REMAIN FOR THE NIGHT. NO RPT NO INJURIES TO AMERICANS ON BASE HAVE BEEN REPORTED.

1979TEHRAN02019.subject: (S) ATTEMPT TO MEDIATE AT DOWSHEN TAPPEH

segments.text: (S - ENTIRE TEXT)

ENTEZAM INFORMS US HE HAS TALKED WITH GENERAL GHARABAGHI AND THEY HAVE BEGUN DISCUSSION OF MODALITIES AIMED AT EASING CONFRONTATION IN VICINITY DOWSHEN TAPPEH AIR BASE. BASICALLY, ENTEZAM IS ASKING FOR GRACE PERIOD IN APPLICATION OF CURFEW IN THAT AREA. IF IT CAN BE SET BACK ABOUT FOUR HOURS, KHOMEINI IS WILLINGRTO TAPE A SPEECH ASKING THE CIVILIANS TO LEAVE THEIR BARRICADES AND RETURN HOME. HE ESTIMATES 500,000 REMAIN IN STREETS AND ARE PREPARED TO CHALLENGE CURFEW.
GHARABAGHI REPORTEDLY AGREED PASS THIS PROPOSAL ALONG TO BAKHTIAR, BUT MADE NO RPT NO PROMISES RE CURFEW. GENERAL GAST IS CURRENTLY MEETING WITH GHARABAGHI AND WILL REPORT TO ME IN ABOUT ONE HOUR.

INCIDENTALLY, I WAS MISTAKEN IN IDENTITIES OF THREE MAN COMMITTEE, WHICH CONSISTS OF ENTEZAM, SAHABI AND EX-GENERAL QARANI (RATHER THAN MINATCHI). THEY ARE ALL REPORTEDLY VERY NERVOUS THAT DOWSHEN TAPPEH INCIDENT MAY TOUCH OFF MILITARY COUP TONIGT. SULLIVAN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY: CURFEW TO BEGIN AT 4:30 THIS AFTERNOON. MAJOR CLASH AT DOWSHAN TAPPEH AIRBASE BEGAN AT 10:30 LAST NIGHT AND CONTINUES AS OF 2:30 P.M. LOCAL. AIR FORCE CADETS FIGHTING IMPERIAL GUARD. HEAVY FIRING IN VICINITY OF BASE MUCH OF LAST NIGHT AND THIS MORNING. AMBULANCES AND ALL SORTS OF VEHICLES PACKED WITH DEMONSTRATORS CONTINUE TO SPEED PAST EMBASSY HEADING FOR AIRBASE. MEETING OF PM, GENERAL QARABAGHI AND OPPOSITIONISTS YESTERDAY DESCRIBED AS USEFUL. SOURCES SAID SUCH MEETING WILL CONTINUE, BUT THIS WAS BEFORE AIRBASE CLASH BEGAN. BAKHTIAR GAVE INTERVIEW TO KAYHAN IN WHICH HE CONTINUED FIRM AND UNFLAPPABLE.

LARGE DEMONSTRATION HELD BY PEOPLE'S SACRIFICE GUERRILLAS (INDEPENDENT MARXIST-LENINISTS) AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY LAST THURSDAY. KHOMEINI CALLS FOR SHAH TO BE TRIED AND HIS WEALTH "DISTRIBUTED TO PEOPLE." PROVINCES MOSTLY QUIET.

MAJOR CLASH AT DOWSHAN TAPPEH AIRBASE IN SOUTHEAST TEHRAN APPARENTLY ERUPTED ABOUT 10:30 LAST NIGHT WHEN IMPERIAL GUARD TROOPS MOVED TO ARREST GROUP OF WARRANT OFFICERS (HOMOFARS) WHO STARTED DEMONSTRATING FOR KHOMEINI, AFTER SEEING TV SPECTACULAR ON HIM. HEAVY FIRING BROKE OUT WITH AIR FORCE PEOPLE HOLDING OFF IMPERIAL GUARD. LARGE CROWDS BEGAN GATHERING, SETTING UP BURNING BARRICADES IN STREETS, SHOUTING "ALLAH-AKBAR" FROM ROOFTOPS. SOME ARMS WERE PASSED TO CROWDS BY AIR FORCE PEOPLE. ROOFTOP SHOUTING SPREAD OVER LARGE PART OF CITY. CROWDS APPARENTLY ATTEMPTED TO ENTER AIRBASE, FIRED ON BY TROOPS. CLASHES CONTINUED UNTIL AROUND 5 A.M. THIS MORNING.
SOME REPORTS INDICATE TROOPS FIRED ON CROWDS IN VICINITY OF KHOMEINI HEADQUARTERS, IN ATTEMPTS TO ENFORCE CURFEW.

CLASHES RENEWED AROUND 8 A.M. THIS MORNING AS CROWDS AGAIN GATHERED AROUND AIRBASE. ALL MORNING TRAFFIC HAS BEEN RUSHING EAST ON TAKHTE JAMSHID AVENUE IN FRONT OF EMBASSY--HONKING CARS AND TRUCKS PACKED WITH DEMONSTRATORS (MANY WEARING THE WHITE SHROUDS OF MARTYRDOM-TOBE) AND DOZENS OF AMBULANCES. OCCASIONAL GROUPS OF CHANTING DEMONSTRATORS HAVE ALSO MARCHED PAST. HEAVY FIRING REPORTEDLY CONTINUES AS OF 1:30 P.M. LOCAL. 4:30 CURFEW HAS BEEN DECLARED. MOST EXTREME RUMORS ARE THAT HELICOPTER GUNSHIPS HAVE BEEN FIRING ON "CADETS" (HOMOFARS) AND CROWDS AROUND AIRBASE AND THAT HUNDREDS HAVE BEEN KILLED OR WOUNDED. WE HAVE NO RESPONSIBLE CORROBORATION OF THESE RUMORS.
AP CONFIRMS DEATH OF LA TIMES CORRESPONDENT JOE ALEX MORRIS. HE WAS HIT BY BULLET IN THE CHEST WHILE IN HOUSE WATCHING THE BATTLE.

LMI SOURCE INFORMED EMBOFF THAT PM BAKHTIAR, GEN QARABAGHI, AND TWO REPRESENTATIVES OF OPPOSITION (REPORTEDLY ENTEZAM AND SAHABI) HAD "VERY USEFUL" MEETING YESTERDAY AND THAT SUCH MEETINGS WILL CONTINUE. SAME REPORT REACHED EMBASSY FROM ARMY SIDE.

KAYHAN INTERNATIONAL PROMINENTLY REPORT BAKHTIAR INTERVIEW. PM WAS EVEN FEISTIER THAN USUAL, MAKING FOLLOWING POINTS: (A) HE CAN TALK TO LIFE-LONG FRIEND BAZARGAN THROUGH FRIENDS BUT NOT OFFICIALLY, SINCE HE WAS "ORDAINED PM BY SO-CALLED FARMAN FROM MR.

KHOMEINI," ------------------128824 101454Z /12 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 3914 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY BONN AMEMBASSY CAIRO AMCONSUL DHAHRAN IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY DOHA AMCONSUL FRANKFURT AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS USLO PEKING AMEMBASSY RABAT USLO RIYADH IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY TOKYO USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 02020 (B) HE IS PREPARED TO HAVE BAZARGAN MINISTERS IN HIS CABINET, BUT WILL NOT RESIGN; (C) HE IS MOST FREE OF ANY PRIME MINISTER BUT BAZARGAN DOES NOT HAVE FREEDOM OF EXPRESSION; (D) KHOMEINI IS TO BLAME FOR ECONOMIC TROUBLES, CLOSURE OF COMMERCE, CUSTOMS, SCHOOLS; (E) HOWEVER STRIKES ARE NOT UNDER KHOMEINI'S CONTROL BUT THAT OF TUDEH; (F) WHY DID MR.
KHOMEINI RETURN AT ALL--TO BRING GOVERNMENT OF THEOLOGIANS? BREAD? LOWEST SUBSISTENCE LIVING?

SHAH IS GONE, AND IF NOW PAHLAVI DYNASTY ABDICATES, KHOMEINI WILL SIMPLY UP THE ANTE AGAIN; (G) IF THEY DO NOT ACCEPT PAHLAVI DYNASTY, WE HAVE ONLY ONE COURSE--TO BRING BACK SON OR GRANDSON OF AHMAD SHAH QAJAR; (H) HE TOOK OVER, AFTER 30 YEARS OF BEING HOUNDED TO DO WHAT PEOPLE WANTED; IN THE END THEY WILL SEE THE LIGHT; "TIME IS NOT AGAINST US." (I) BAZAAR CLOSED BECAUSE OF INTIMIDATION AND BANKRUPTCIES; (J) CHANGE OF THE CONSTITUTION MUST BE WITHIN THE CONSTITUTION AND IF IT IS, THE ARMY WILL ACCEPT IT; (K) MAJLES WILL NOT VOTE NO CONFIDENCE IN HIM AND THERE IS NO REASON TO DISSOLVE IT--ELECTIONS WILL BE CALLED IN LESS THAN A MONTH, THREE MONTHS WILL BE NEEDED TO PREPARE, AND ELECTIONS WILL BE HELD IF THERE IS PEACE AND QUIET; (L) SANJABI, INSTEAD OF REACTIVATING NATIONAL FRONT, DOES NOTHING BUT KISS AYATOLLAH'S HAND.

BRITISH EMBASSY HAS RUMOR THAT KHOMEINI'S PEOPLE HAVE HIDDEN HIM AWAY IN LIGHT OF REPORTS PEOPLE WERE AFTER HIM. ALSO EYEWITNESS STORY THAT OPPOSITION'S BANI-SADR WAS LECTURING SOME PEOPLE ON ECONOMICS ON SHAH REZA AVENUE BUT THEN BROKE OFF, TELLING HIS LISTENERS TO JOIN THE STRUGGLE AT DOWSHEN TAPPEH.

MEANWHILE, AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI CALLED FOR CALM. HE ACCUSED "IRRESPONSIBLE JUNIOR AUTHORITIES" OF FOMENTING "FIGHTS BETWEEN BROTHERS". HE ASKED THAT ALL SOLDIERS RETURN TO THEIR BARRACKS AND AUTHORITIES ARREST THOSE RESPONSIBLE FOR "FRIDAY NIGHT'S ATTACK ON THE AIR BASE".

KAYHAN INTERNATIONAL REPORTS THAT MARXIST-LENINIST GUERILLA GROUP HELD 20,000 STRONG RALLY AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY THURSDAY WHILE KHOMEINI FORCES MARCHED OUTSIDE. GROUP WAS CELEBRATING INITIATION OF ARMED STRUGGLE IN 1970 AND CLAIMS TO HAVE BROKEN WITH TUDEH BECAUSE OF LATTER'S "BLIND DEDICATION TO SOVIET MARXISM".

KHOMEINI CALLED ON IRANIAN LAWYERS TO INITIATE PROCEDURES TO BRING BACK SHAH AND TRY HIM, BUT ADDED THAT HE SHOULD BE TRIED IN ABSENTIA IF NECESSARY, AND HIS WEALTH DISTRIBUTED AMONG THE PEOPLE. KHOMEINI ADDED THAT MUCH WEALTH HAD BEEN SECRETED IN U.S. BRITISH AND SWISS BANKS.

ISFAHAN, TABRIZ, SHIRAZ REPORT ALL QUIET. LOCAL AYATOLLAH HAS BEEN ASSISTING CONSUL ISFAHAN IN GETTING BAGGAGE OF AMERICANS WHO HAVE DEPARTED CLEARED THROUGH CUSTOMS. TABRIZ REPORTS AZARBAIJANIS ARE INCREASINGLY SICK OF POLITICS, AND MANY SAY THEY SUPPORT BAKHTIAR. KI REPORTS TWO DAYS OF VIOLENCE IN GORGAN WEDNESDAY AND THURSDAY, WITH 12 VICTIMS BURIED YESTERDAY, FUNERAL ATTENDED BY 50,000. REPORTS OF SMALL INCIDENTS IN A FEW OTHER PROVINCIAL TOWNS. SULLIVAN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

AS OF 1700 LOCAL LARGE CROWDS ARE DEFYING CURFEW AND DOZENS OF FIRES ARE BURNING IN THE CITY. SO FAR, IT APPEARS THAT MOST OF THE FIRES ARE FROM BURNING TIRES, CARS AND RUBBISH. LOOKING NORTH FROM EMBASSY SKY IS BLACK WITH SMOKE, AND WE UNDERSTAND THAT THERE IS SERIOUS TROUBLE IN THE NORTHERN PART OF CITY. ACCORDING TO ONE REPORT, THE NIAVARAN POLICE STATION IS UNDER SIEGE AND ITS REQUEST FOR HELICOPTER-BORNE REINFORCEMENTS HAS BEEN TURNED DOWN BECAUSE HELICOPTERS CANNOT SAFELY GO INTO THE AREA BECAUSE OF THE SMOKE. LARGE CROWD IS CURRENTLY ASSEMBLED NEAR IAS AND IS THREATENING TO BURN IT DOWN. EMBASSY HAS REQUESTED POLICE REINFORCEMENTS.
MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES HAVE INFORMED GENERAL GAST THAT IT IS TOTALLY UNSAFE TO BE IN THE STREETS AT THIS TIME.
EARLIER IN AFTERNOON WE ADVISED ALL AMERICANS TO STAY AT HOME AND HAVE NOW INFORMED EMBASSY STAFF TO REMAIN AT HOME TOMORROW MORNING UNTIL WE HAVE A CLEAR PICTURE OF SECURITY SITUATION. SULLIVAN
(S - ENTIRE TEXT).

AS DEPARTMENT WILL LEARN FROM OTHER REPORTING, SITUATION IN TEHRAN IS RAPIDLY DETERIORATING. EIGHT OUT OF SEVENTEEN POLICE PRECINCTS ARE NOW IN REBEL HANDS. SEVERAL ARMY UNITS WHICH WERE SENT INTO SOUTHERN PART OF CITY DURING FIGHTING NIGHT FEBRUARY 10 HAVE LOST CONTACT WITH HEADQUARTERS. REBELS CLAIM UNITS HAVE DEFECTED AND THAT TANKS AND OTHER ARMORED VEHICLES ARE CURRENTLY IN REBEL HANDS. GENERAL TOUFANIAN REPORTS THAT AN AMMUNITION DEPOT IN SEPAH SQUARE HAS BEEN TAKEN OVER BY OPPOSITION.

ALTHOUGH SUPREME COMMANDER'S STAFF IS IN SESSION AT THIS MOMENT, IT SEEMS QUESTIONABLE THAT THEY HAVE ANY VIABLE PLAN TO RETAKE INSTALLATIONS AND AREAS THEY HAVE LOST. A MAJOR FIRE-FIGHT HAS BEEN GOING ON FOR THE PAST HOUR JUST EAST OF THE EMBASSY, BUT IT IS NOT CLEAR WHAT OBJECTIVE IS UNDER CONTENTION. THE POLICE PRECINCT CONTROLLING EMBASSY AREA FELL TO REBEL CONTROL ABOUT AN HOUR AGO.

GIVEN CURRENT CIRCUMSTANCES, IT MAY PROVE PHYSICALLY IMPOSSIBLE FOR EMBASSY TO IMPLEMENT FURTHER EVACUATION OF AMERICANS AT THIS TIME. WE HAVE ADVISED STANDFAST WITH ALL AMERICANS STAYING IN THEIR HOUSES. SINCE MOST OF THEM LIVE IN PORTIONS OF CITY NOT YET HEAVILY AFFECTED BY STREET FIGHTING, I CONSIDER THIS THE SAFEST COURSE OF ACTION FOR THE TIME BEING.

THERE IS REPORTEDLY SOME DISCUSSION IN PROGRESS BETWEEN AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI AND THE MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES IN AN EFFORT TO ARRANGE A TRUCE. IF THIS SUCCEEDS AND IF THE STREETS AND AIRPORT BECOME USABLE, WE WILL PROBABLY WISH TO SHIFT TO PHASE III OF OUR EVACUATION PLAN. I HAVE BEGUN CONSULTATIONS WITH EC AMBASSADORS TO THIS END.

IN THAT EVENT, WE WILL SEEK TO OBTAIN SAME IMAGINATIVE LOGISTICS SUPPORT FOR THE RAPID AIR MOVEMENT OF OUR PEOPLE. IN ADDITION TO MAC FLIGHTS, THIS MAY HAVE TO INVOLVE STATE-FUNDED CHARTERS OF AIRCRAFT FROM SUCH CARRIERS AS OLYMPIC AIRWAYS, SWISSAIR, AND OTHERS WHICH WILL BE MORE RELIABLY WILLING TO MAKE SHUTTLE FLIGHTS BETWEEN ATHENS AND TEHRAN THAN PAN AMERICAN.

IF, ON THE OTHER HAND, NO RPT NO TRUCE CAN BE ARRANGED AND THE FIGHTING CONTINUES IN CURRENT VEIN, WE SHALL HAVE TO PLAY IT ON A DAY-BY-DAY BASIS TO DETERMINE WHAT AIRLIFT IS FEASIBLE AND WHAT MOVEMENT OF AMERICANS IN THE STREETS IS CONSIDERED SAFE.

ONE OF DISTURBING FEATURES OF CURRENT REBEL ACTION IS THAT SIGNIFICANT AMOUNT OF IT SEEMS TO BE CARRIED OUT BY COMMUNIST ELEMENTS WHICH ARE NOT RPT NOT UNDER KHOMEINI CONTROL. THIS COULD IMPEDE POSSIBILITY FOR ACHIEVING ANY GENUINE TRUCE IN THE CITY. SULLIVAN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

POL COUNSELOR WAS VISITED MORNING FEBRUARY 11 BY GOLAM HOSSEIN ROWGHANI, PROMINENT BUSINESSMAN (FORD MOTOR PRODUCTS REPRESENTATIVE FOR 27 YEARS), WHO APPEARS TO BE VERY CLOSE TO KHOMEINI. HIS SON, MEHDI ROWGHANI, DID THE INTERPRETING. ROWGHANI SAID KHOMEINI HAD LIVED IN HIS HOUSE WITH HIM FOUR OR FIVE MONTHS AFTER BEING RELEASED FROM JAIL 15 YEARS AGO, PRIOR TO EXILE. HE ALSO APPEARED IN RECENT PICTURE OF KHOMEINI GREETING THE CROWD, STANDING AT KHOMEINI'S SHOULDER. HIS VISIT, HOWEVER, WAS AT HIS OWN INITIATIVE, NOT AS AN EMISSARY.

HIS BASIC MESSAGE WAS A PLEA FOR USG SUPPORT FOR KHOMEINI. HE ASSURED US FROM INTIMATE KNOWLEDGE THAT KHOMEINI IS "NOT A POLITICIAN, NOT A LIAR". HE IS A TRUE MOSLEM. HE HAS BEEN EMOTIONALLY WOUNDED BY PAHLAVI REGIME AND IS MORE AWARE THAN ANYBODY ELSE IN IRAN OF THE EXTENT OF CORRUPTION THAT TOOK PLACE UNDER THE PAHLAVIS. HE HAD DEDICATED REPRESENTATIVES FROM ALL SECTORS OF THE POPULATION AND IS ABSOLUTELY UNCOMPROMISING ABOUT ERADICATING ALL TRACES OF PAHLAVI INFLUENCE.

MUCH OF THE DISCUSSION CONSISTED OF ROWGHANI INDICATING THE VIRTUOUSNESS OF KHOMEINI, WHICH POL COUNSELOR READILY ACKNOWLEDGED. POL COUNSELOR KEPT MAKING THE POINT IN MANY WAYS THAT AN UNCOMPROMISING CRUSADE MIGHT CARRY THINGS TO EXTREMES WHICH WOULD ENDANGER LASTING EFFECTS OF HIS CRUSADE. POL COUNSELOR ARGUED THAT PERHAPS KHOMEINI OUGHT TO LEAVE POLITICS TO HIS OWN POLITICIANS, SUCH AS BAZARGAN, ALL OF WHOM HAVE DEMONSTRATED MORE MODERATION THAN KHOMEINI HIMSELF. THIS POINT WAS ACCEPTED EVENTUALLY BY ROWGHANI, WHO SEEMED AWARE OF THIS ASPECT OF KHOMEINI'S CHARACTER.

ROWGHANI MADE THE POINT (AS OTHERS HAVE) THAT THE RUSSIAN BEAR IS LOOKING AT IRAN WITH OPEN MOUTH. MOSLEM MOVEMENT IS STRONG ENOUGH TO SMOTHER COMMUNISTS AT PRESENT, BUT WHO CAN TELL WHETHER THIS WILL BE THE CASE IN LONG RUN? USG ASSISTANCE IS NECESSARY FOR KHOMEINI AT THIS TIME. ROWGHANI SAID THE RUSSIANS WERE FISHING IN TROUBLED WATERS, AND THEIR ANTI-AMERICAN PROPAGANDA WAS CATCHING ON, WITHOUT US FINDING ANY DEFENDERS. POL COUNSELOR COUNTERED THAT KHOMEINI LEADERSHIP ITSELF IS ALLOWING ANTI-AMERICAN STRAIN WHEN LEADERS THEMSELVES KNOW TRUE CHARACTER OF US ROLE. FOR EXAMPLE, THEY KNOW ROLE OF CARTER HUMAN RIGHTS POLICY IN THEIR OWN ASSUMPTION OF POWER.

THEY KNOW REAL ROLE GENERAL HUYSER WAS PLAYING WITH THE MILITARY, YET THEY ALLOW AND EVEN ENCOURAGE DIAMETRICALLY OPPOSITE INTERPRETATION BY THEIR FOLLOWERS. PERHAPS THIS IS TACTICAL ONLY, BUT IT AMOUNTS TO KICKING THE US GOVERNMENT WHILE SIMULTANEOUSLY ASKING FOR ITS ASSISTANCE. BESIDES, KHOMEINI SHOULD KNOW THAT IF HIS PEOPLE EVER TAKE POWER THEY WILL NEED THE US -- UNLESS THEY WISH TO DEAL MORE CLOSELY WITH THE SOVIET UNION.

ROWGHANI WENT ALONG WITH MOST OF THESE ARGUMENTS, STATING HE AGREED THAT US ROLE WAS MISINTERPRETED. HE TRIED TO ABSOLVE KHOMEINI FROM ANY PERSONAL RESPONSIBILITY, TOLD OF RECALLING AN OCCASION WHEN HE WAS SITTING NEXT TO KHOMEINI WHILE ANTI-AMERICAN SLOGANS WERE BEING CHANTED, AND TELLING KHOMEINI THIS WAS NOT RIGHT -- APPARENTLY WITH NO REACTION FROM KHOMEINI.
ROWGHANI AGREED TO TALK TO KHOMEINI AND COME BACK FOR ANOTHER MEETING WHENEVER HE WISHED. SULLIVAN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

AFTER LONG MEETING MORNING FEBRUARY 11, SENIOR OFFICERS OF IRANIAN ARMED FORCES DECIDED IN EFFECT TO CONCEDE TO KHOMEINI AND TO RECOGNIZE BAZARGAN AS EFFECTIVE PRIME MINISTER. THEY AGREED TO ANNOUNCE THIS DECISION PUBLICLY IN THE FORM OF A STATEMENT THAT THE MILITARY HAD CHOSEN TO REMAIN NEUTRAL IN THE CURRENT STRUGGLE AND TO RETURN THE TROOPS TO THE BARRACKS.

THIS STATEMENT WAS BROADCAST AT APPROXIMATELY 1345 LOCAL AND HAS PRODUCED A NEW WAVE OF HORN-TOOTING, AS WELL AS A STREAM OF AUTOMOBILES PASSING THIS EMBASSY WITH PASSENGERS WAVING RIFLES AND OTHER WEAPONS.

THERE IS STILL SPORADIC FIGHTING GOING ON TO THE EAST OF THE EMBASSY, WITH OCCASIONAL SPENT ROUNDS ENTERING THE COMPOUND. ONE DRIVER HAS BEEN SLIGHTLY WOUNDED. THERE DOES NOT RPT NOT APPEAR TO BE ANY FURTHER SNIPER FIRE SPECIFICALLY DIRECTED AGAINST EMBASSY.

ARMY UNIT GUARDING COMPOUND HAS RECEIVED ORDERS TO RETURN TO BARRACKS. I HAVE SUGGESTED TO THEM THAT THEY PULL BACK FROM VISIBLE POSITIONS AND REMAIN IN COMPOUND UNTIL THE STREETS ARE MORE QUIET. THEY SEEM TO HAVE ACCEPTED THIS SUGGESTION. I MADE IT BASED ON EXPERIENCE AT BRITISH EMBASSY COMPOUND EARLIER TODAY WHERE ARMED CROWD CAME TO GATES AND DEMANDED ARMY UNIT SURRENDER ITS WEAPONS OR BE SLAUGHTERED. UNIT SURRENDERED WEAPONS AND CURRENTLY REMAINS IN COMPOUND DISARMED.

I DO NOT RPT NOT KNOW WHETHER KHOMEINI OR BAZARGAN HAVE ISSUED ANY ORDERS TO THEIR FOLLOWERS ABOUT CESSATION OF ARMED ATTACKS. I DO NOT RPT NOT KNOW WHETHER THERE HAS BEEN ANY EFFECTIVE CONTACT BETWEEN OPPOSING FORCES. IF NOT, THERE EXISTS THE POSSIBILITY THIS COMPOUND MAY BE ATTACKED AND OVERRUN. IF, ON THE OTHER HAND, SOME UNDERSTANDING ABOUT ARMED TRUCE HAS BEEN REACHED, WE MAY BE SPARED.

AS OF THIS WRITING, MANY DEMONSTRATORS PASSING THE EMBASSY ARE FIRING WEAPONS INTO THE AIR, BUT NOT RPT NOT ATTEMPTING TO MENACE THE COMPOUND. WE HAVE THINNED DOWN OUR PRESENCE HERE TO LESS THAN FIFTY, INCLUDING MARINES.

SINCE THIS MESSAGE WAS PREPARED, THE MILITARY UNIT GUARDING THE COMPOUND HAS RECEIVED FIRM ORDERS TO RETURN TO BARRACKS AND HAS LEFT THE AREA. WE ARE NOW GUARDED BY 22 MARINES AND 10 IRANIAN POLICE, WHICH WE HAVE DISPERSED INCONSPICUOUSLY AND TO WHOM WE WILL ISSUE PRAYER
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

IN VIEW UNFORTUNATE PUBLICITY ATTACHED TO MOVEMENT OF U.S. MARINES, I BELIEVE IT WOULD BE BETTER AT THIS STAGE TO HOLD THEM IN CONUS. SITUATION HERE IS SUCH THAT WE COULD NOT RPT NOT USE THEM, IN ANY EVENT. CIRCUMSTANCES FOR WHICH THEY WERE ENVISAGED HAVE PASSED US BY.
IF THEY HAVE ALREADY BEEN MOVED TO LAJES, I STRONGLY RECOMMEND THEY BE HELD THERE AND NOT RPT NOT BE BROUGHT FORWARD.

THEIR NUMBERS AND MISSION ARE ALREADY RECEIVING EXAGGERATED CIRCULATION IN IRAN, WHERE THEY ARE DOING US NO RPT NO GOOD. COMMUNISTS SEEM TO BE IN CONTROL OF LOCAL RADIO STATION AND THIS SORT OF REPORT CAN BE USED AGAINST RPT AGAINST SECURITY OF AMERICANS HERE. SULLIVAN *** Current Handling Restrictions *** n/a *** Current Classification *** CONFIDENTIAL
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

ON FIRST DAY FOLLOWING SUCCESSFUL TAKEOVER OF GOVERNMENT BY REVOLUTIONARY FORCES UNDER AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI SHOOTING AND A DEGREE OF INSECURITY CONTINUE IN TEHRAN. WE HAVE NO NEWS AS OF 11 A.M. OF WHAT MAY HAVE HAPPENED AT DOWSHEN TAPPEH AIR FORCE BASE FOLLOWING REPORTS LATE LAST NIGHT THAT IMPERIAL GUARDS WERE ON THEIR WAY TO RENEW THE BATTLE WITH AIR FORCE THERE. HOWEVER, THAT APPEARS CALM TODAY AND MAIN AREA OF FIGHTING IS AROUND IMPERIAL GUARD BARRACKS IN LAVISAN. LARGE NUMBERS OF ARMS HAVE BEEN PASSED OUT INDISCRIMINATELY TO CIVILIANS, AND MANY ARE HEADING NORTH TO ASSIST IN THE SIEGE OF THE IMPERIAL GUARD.

EMBASSY HAS SUCCEEDED IN GETTING NIRT TO DENY ITS EARLIER FALSE REPORT THAT AMERICAN ADVISERS WERE STILL IN LAVISAN WITH IMPERIAL GUARD. REST OF THE CITY APPEARS TO BE IN THE HANDS OF THE REVOLUTIONARY GOVERNMENT WITH ROAD BLOCKS IN MANY PLACES MANNED BY "PEOPLE'S POLICE", WHO APPEAR TO BE MUJAHEDDIN TIED TO THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT.

IT IS DIFFICULT TO PREDICT EXACTLY WHAT TO EXPECT IN IRAN DURING THE NEXT FEW DAYS. RIGHT NOW, THE VICTORIOUS LEADERS OF THE KHOMEINI REVOLUTION ARE STILL BATHED IN THE EMPHORIA OF THEIR SUDDEN SUCCESS. THEY ARE ONLY BEGINNING TO THINK IN TERMS OF CONSOLIDATING THE RESULTS OF THE PAST FEW DAYS INTO A PATTERN OF ATTEMPTING TO RUN THE COUNTRY. HOWEVER, A FEW OBSERVATIONS MAY BE HELPFUL.

FEBRUARY 13 HAS GENERALLY BEEN A QUIET DAY. A FEW OUTBURSTS OF FIRING HAVE TAKEN PLACE IN VARIOUS PARTS OF THE CITY OF TEHRAN, BUT, IN GENERAL, THERE HAS BEEN LITTLE VIOLENCE. ROADBLOCKS HAVE GENERALLY BEEN REMOVED TO PERMIT FREE CIRCULATION OF TRAFFIC, BUT THE STREETS ARE SPOTTILY STREWN WITH RUBBISH AND SMALL GROUPS OF HEAVILY-ARMED CIVILIANS ARE GATHERED ALL OVER TOWN.

THERE ARE NO RPT NO REGULAR POLICE IN EVIDENCE, BUT THE "KHOMEINI POLICE" VIGOROUSLY DIRECT TRAFFIC AT MAJOR INTERSECTIONS. ROVING PATROLS OF ARMED "COMMITTEE MEMBERS," DRIVING IN SMALL CARS AND BRANDISHING THEIR WEAPONS, STREAK THROUGH THE CITY FROM TIME TO TIME. SHOPS ARE GENERALLY CLOSED AND THERE IS AS YET NO RPT NO INDICATION THAT THE BAZAAR IS OPEN.

VINDICATION AND THE SEARCH FOR SCAPEGOATS CONTINUES. HOUSE TO HOUSE SEARCHES BY ARMED MEN ARE TAKING PLACE IN VARIOUS PARTS OF THE CITY. WE ARE RECEIVING A STEADY STREAM OF REPORTS ABOUT THE ARREST FOR INTERROGATION OF SENIOR IRANIAN MILITARY OFFICIALS. SEVERAL IN CUSTODY HAVE THEIR PICTURES PROMINENTLY DISPLAYED IN THE MORNING PRESS. THE NATION WAS TREATED TO THE MACABRE SPECTACLE OF A TWO HOUR LONG INTERROGATION OF FORMER SAVAK CHIEF NASSERI (WITH BLOOD TRICKLING DOWN HIS FACE FROM SCALP SOUNDS AND HIS VOICE CROAKING THROUGH AN OBVIOUSLY CRUSHED THORAX), AND MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATER RAHIIM ON TELEVISION EVENING OF FEBRUARY 12. PRICIPAL JACOBIN INTERROGATER WAS OUR FRIEND IBRAHIM YAZDI.

FRICTIONS BETWEEN MUJAHEDIN AND CHARIK ARMED BANDS SPILL OVER INTO OCCASIONAL BRIEF FIRE-FIGHTS. SINCE BOTH ARE HEAVILY ARMED, THIS PATTERN COULD SPREAD AS THE DAYS GO BY. MORE SPECIFIC TARGETTING, ESPECIALLY OF FOREIGNERS, MAY FOLLOW.

THE FIRST ATTEMPTS OF BAZARGAN'S GOVERNMENT TO ESTABLISH ORDER ARE ONLY PARTLY SUCCESSFUL. FOR EXAMPLE, ALTHOUGH SOME SENIOR POLICE OFFICIALS HAVE, BY DIRECTION, RESUMED THEIR FUNCTIONS, THEY HAVE NO RPT NO PRECINCT STATIONS TO USE, NO COMMUNICATIONS INTACT, AND NO SUBORDINATES EXCEPT THE "HOMEINI" VOLUNTEERS. ONE POLICE COLONEL IN TOUCH WITH THIS EMBASSY SAID HE WOULD BE SENDING SUCH VOLUNTEERS TO TAKE POSITION OUTSIDE OUR COMPOUND IN THE EVENING, BUT COULD NOT RPT NOT PROVIDE THEM WITH IDENTITY CARDS OR OTHER MEANS TO DISINGUISH THEM FROM BRIGANDS.

OUR REPORTS FROM THE MILITARY INDICATE CONSIDERABLE CONFUSION. ALTHOUGH BAZARGAN HAS APPOINTED A SENIOR AIR FORCE OFFICER TO COMMAND THE IIAF, WE UNDERSTAND THAT SUBORDINATES, ESPECIALLY THE HOMOFARS, ARE REFUSING TO ACCEPT HIS ORDERS AND WANT TO TAKE OVER THE AIR BASES THEMSELVES. THE ARMY AS YET HAS NO RPT NO COMMANDER SINCE BADEII WAS KILLED AND MAJOR UNITS ARE WITHOUT LEADERSHIP. SENIOR OFFICERS OF THE NAVY HAVE NOT AS YET BEEN ARRESTED OR KILLED, BUT ARE PASSIVELY AWAITING WORD THAT THEY WILL BE SOON TAKEN INTO CUSTODY.

ALL CIVIL SERVANTS HAVE BEEN ORDERED TO REPORT TO WORK AND TO BEGIN TO FUNCTION IN MINISTRIES UNDER CONTROL OF UNDERSECRETARIES, UNTIL MINISTERS CAN BE NAMED. HOWEVER, THE STRIKE HABIT DIES HARD AND, WITH HOLIDAYS ON THURSDAY AND FRIDAY, IT IS DOUBTFUL MUCH WORK WILL TAKE PLACE BEFORE SATURDAY.
AT THE AIRPORT, CIVIL AVIATION EMPLOYEES ARE BEGINNING TO TRICKLE BACK TO WORK AND TO CALIBRATE THEIR EQUIPMENT. IT MAY TAKE ANOTHER TWO DAYS BEFORE THE AIRPORT IS OPERATIONAL.

MISCELLANY: RADIO AND TV REPORTED ENTHUSIASTIC MESSAGES "RECOGNIZING" BAZARGAN GOVT FROM PLO AND SEVERAL NATIONS, INCLUDING SOVIET UNION. IRAN HAS EMERGED FROM VICTORY OF THE KHOMEINI REVOLUTION INTO A STATE OF TOTAL CHAOS. AUTHORITY IS BEING EXERCISED AT THIS TIME BY GROUPS OF HEAVILY ARMED YOUNG MEN, WHO ARE FORMED INTO VARIOUS "COMMITTEES"AND WHO CONSTITUTE A SORT OF VIGILANTE PRESENCE THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY. IN TEHRAN, THESE COMMITTEES HAVE DRAWN UP A ROUGH DIVISION OF TERRITORY, WITH SECTORS OF AUTHORITY BASED ON A MOSQUE OR A GROUP OF MOSQUES. IN PRINCIPLE, THESE LOCAL COMMITTES REPORT INTO THE "KHOMEINI COMMITTEE", WHHICH IS LOCATED AT KHOMEINI'S HEADQUARTERS AND SEEMS TO CENTER ON THE "ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL", WHICH ACTS AS A SORT OF SHADOW CENTRAL AUTHORITY.

IN PRACTICE, THESE VARIOUS LOCAL COMMITTEES HAVE DIFFERING ORGANIZATIONAL AND IDEOLOGICAL LOYALTIES. EVEN THOUGH THEY DECLARE THEMSELVES SUBORDINATE TO KHOMEINI, MOST OF THEM MAKE THEIR OWN DECISIONS AND ACT ON THEIR OWN INAITIATIVES. THE MAJORITY OF THOSE WE HAVE ENCOUNTERED ARE LED BY MUYAHEDIN. THE MOSLEM TERRORIST GROUP WHICH WAS RESPONSIBLE FOR THE ASSASSINATION OF SIX AMERICANS A FEW YEARS AGO. OTHERS ARE LED BY THE TUDEB, BY "FEDAYEEN" TRAINED IN THE CAMPS OF GEORGE HABBASH, ETC. STILL OTHERS ARE RATHER RECENTLY FORMED GROUPS, MADE UP OF HOMAFARS WHO HAVE DEFECTED FROM THE AIR FORCE, AND OTHER DISSIDENTS FOF THIS TYPE.

THESE SEVERAL COMMUNITTEES AND GROUPS ARE BUSY INSTITUTING ISLAMIC JUSTICE IN THEIR NEIGHBORHOODS. THIS SYSTEM OF JUSTICE STARTS WITH SYSTEMATIC SEARCHES OF SURRUPTIONS HOUSES, (ACCOMPAINED BY MUCH LOOTING) BY ARRESTS, EXAMINATIONS BY THE COMMITTEE, AND OCCASIONALLY BY EXECUTIONS. DURING THE PROCESS OF THESE OPERATIONS THERE IS CONSIDERABLE FIRING OF THE WEAPONS IN THE HANDS OF THE YOUNG PARTISANS, ESPECIATLLY DURING THE NIGHT. OCCASIONAL FIREFIGHTS BREAK OUT BETWEEN RIVAL GANGS, SOMETIMES WHILE BOTH ARE PURSUING THE SAME SUSPECT.

THE COMMUNIST-CONTROLLED CHARIKS, WHO ARE CLEARLY BEING GUIDED FROM MOSCOW, HAVE SOME SOPHISTICATED OBJECTIVES IN MIND. BY AND LARGE, THEY SEEM TO DOMINATE THE RADIO AND TELEVISION SYSTEM (NIRT) WHICH SPEWS A STEADY STREAM OF ANTI-AMERICAN PROPAGANDA. THEY ALSO REPORTEDLY CONTROL THE CAMPUS OF TEHRAN UNIVERSITY, WHICH THEY HAVE OPPOINTED AS THEIR HEADQUARTERS. THEY DO NOT YET SEEM TO CONTROL THE PRESS, WHICH IS LARGELY UNDER THE PRESSURE AND INFLUENCE OF THE MUJAHEDIN.

THE ARMED FORCES ARE IN DISARRAY. ALTHOUGH GENERAL GARANI HAS BEEN NAMED CHAIRMAN OF THE CHIEFS OF STAFF AND GENERAL AZARBAJIN HAS BEEN NAMED CHIEF OF STAFF OF THE AIR FORCE, THERE ARE NO RPT NO OFFICIAL DESIGNEES AS YET FOR THE ARMY AND THE NAVY. REVOLTS LED BY NON-COMMISSIONED OFFICERS HAVE BROKEN OUT IN ALL SERVICES AND DISCIPLINE IS PRACTICALLY NON-EXISTENT. NEVERTHELESS, SAME AIR FORCE PLANES HAVE ASSISTED IN THE EVACUATION OF U.S. PERSONNEL FOUR PROVINICAL CITIES.

SOMEWHERE IN THE MIDDLE OF THIS CHAOS IS BURIED THE "GOVERNMENT" OF MEHDI BAZARGAN. SINCE HE AND YAZDI AND ENTEZAMHYRE ALSO MEMBERS OF THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL, THESE THREE TOP LEADERS OF THE "GOVERNMENT" HAVE HAD LITTLE TIME TO DEVOTE TO THEIR MINISTERIAL TASKS. INSTEAD, THEY HAVE SPENT MOST OF THE PAST WEEK ENGAGED IN AD HOC MEETINGS OF "THE COMMITTEE" AND DEALING WITH SUCH CRISES AS THE ATTACK ON THE AMERICAN EMBASSY, THE EVACUATION OF FOREIGNERS AND THE UNEXPECTED VISIT OF YASSER ARAFAT.

ECONOMIC LIFE, HOWEVER, HAS REVIVED. THE AYATOLLALI HAS ORDERED THE OPENING OF THE BAZAARS AND THE RESUMPTION OF NORMAL ACTIVITY. THIS FIAT COULD ONLY PARTLY BE CARRIED INTO EFFECT, BECAUSE THERE HAS BEEN SUCH GENERAL STULTIFICATION IN THE WHOLE COMMERICAL AND FINANCIAL SYSTEM. IT WILL TAKE WEEKS TO CLEAR THE BACKLOG OF CARGO THAT HAS BEEN HELD UP IN THE PORTS AND AT THE BORDERS BECAUSE OF CUSTOMS STRIKES.

THE CONFUSION IN THE BANKING SYSTEM MAY NEVER TOTALLY BE RESOLVED, AND, IN THE MEANTIME, THE SIMPLEST SORT OF TRANSACTIONS WILL BE CONFUSED ------------------099170 192058Z /61 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 0013 SECTION 2 OF 3 TEHRAN 0011 NODIS FOR THE SECRETARY FROM SULLIVAN DUE TO LOSS OF RECORDS, ETC. THE BUREAUCUARY, WHICH WENT BACK TO WORK IN THE LAST TWO DAYS, IS WAITING MINISTERIAL DIRECTION, BEFORE IT TRULY FUNCTIONS. MANY OF THE SENIOR FUNCTIONARIES WILL BE FIRED, IF NOT ARRESTED.

OIL PRODUCTION CAN BE EXPECTED TO RESUME. WITH GOOD LUCK NIOC, EVEN WITHOUT EXPATRIATE HELP, MAY BE ABLE TO GET UP TO ABOUT 3.5 MILLION BARRELS A DAY BY EARLY MARCH*; WITH NIOC HANDLING ITS SALES OIRECTLY ON THE SPOT MARKET. IT IS DOUBTFUL THAT PRODUCTION AND EXPORTS WILL RISE MUCH ABOVE THIS LEVEL IN THE NEXT FEW MONTHS, WHILE POLICY CONSIDERATIONS ARE BEING SORTED OUT.

CENTRAL AMONG THESE CONSIDERATIONS IS THE QUESTION WHETHER THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT WILL EVER BE ABLE TO FUNCTION, OR WHETHER IT WILL MERELY BE DROWNED IN THE WAVES OF INTERNECINE WARFARE WHICH I EXPECT TO BE CONDUCTED AMONG THE REVOLUTIONARY ARMED GANGS. CERTAINLY, IF THE CHARIH COMMUNISTS WIN THESE BATTLES IN THE STREETS, BAZARGAN WILL DISAPPEAR WITHOUT A TRACE. EVEN IF THE CHARIHS ARE EVENTUALLY BROUGHT UNDER CONTROL, IT IS NOT CERTAIN THAT BAZARGAN WILL EVER GATHER UP THE LEVERS OF CONTROL.

HE HAS TOLD THE "NEW YORK TIMES" THAT HE EXPECTS THE KHOMEINI COMMITTEE TO CEASE FUNCTIONING IN "ONE OR TWO WEEKS", AND THAT HIS GOVERNMENT WILL BEGIN TO TAKE CONTROL AT THAT TIME. THIS WAS IN THE SAME INTERVIEW (WITH A NOTORIOUSLY INACCURATE JOURNALIST) IN WHICH HE SAID HE'D HAD TWO LONG TELEPHONE CONVERSATIONS WITH ME. SINCE I HAVE DELIBERATELY REFRAINED FROM CALLING HIM, I WONDER WHOM HE WAS TALKING TO.

ALL THIS ADDS UP TO A VERY UNCERTAIN IMMEDIATE FUTURE FOR IRAN. UNTIL THE STRENGTH OF THE STREET GANGS IS TESTED AND RESOLVED, IS IS NOT RPT NOT CERTAIN WHO IS GOING TO RULE THIS COUNTRY IN THE NAME OF THE KHOMEINI REVOLUTION. IF THE CHARIKS FEEL THEY HAVE THE STRENGTH, THEY WILL DOUBTLESS CHALLENGE THE MUJAHEDIM AND SEEK A QUICK VICTORY- IF THEY DO NOT, THEY MAY CHOSE TO HOLD THE HIGH POINTS (SUCH AS NIRT), CONSOLIDATE THEIR STRENGTH, AND WAIT FOR A MORE OPPORTUINE MOMENT. THIS WILL EXTEND THE LIMBO EVEN FURTHER.

WHAT DOES ALL THIS MEANS FOR U.S. POLICY AND U.S. INTERESTS? IN THE FIRST PLACE, IT MEANS THAT WE SHOULD CONTINUE TO GET AS MANY AMERICANS AS POSSIBLE OUT OF IRAN. NOT ONLY WILL AMERICANS BE CAUGHT IN THE CROSSFIRE, BUT THEY WILL, IN THE NEAR FUTURE, BECOME TARGETS THEMSELVES. THE NIRT PROPAGANDA, SUPPLEMENTIVE RADIO MOSCOW AND OTHER SURET ORGANS, PLAYS UPON A LATENT ANTI-AMERICANISM RESENTMENT AND HOSTILITY ARE ENDEMIC-MORE ATTACKS, SUCH AS THAT WE RECEIVED AT THE EMBASSY ON FEBRUARY 14, CAN BE EXPECTED.

SECONDLY, IT MEANS THAT OUR AMBITIONS IN IRAN HAVE TO BE TAILORED TO REALITIES. WE CAN NOT RPT NOT EXPECT ANY FUTUREIRANIAN GOVERNMENT TO DESIRE THE SAME INTIMATE ASSOCIATIONS WITH THE U.S. AS IN THE PAST, ESPECIALLY IN THE SECURITY AND INTELLIGENCE FIELDS. WE WILL HAVE TO ADOPT A LOW PROFILE.

AS FOR POLICY, I CONTINUE TO RECOMMEND THE SAME GENERAL LINE WHICH I FIRST SET FORTH ON NOVEMBER 11, 1978, AND WHICH WASHINGTON HAS CONSISTENTLY REJECTED. THAT IS THE EFFORT TO CONVINCE THE KHOMEINI (BAZARGAN) GROUP AND THE ARMED FORCES THAT THEY SHARE A BROAD COMMUNITY OF INTERESTS AND SHOULD WORK TOGETHER TO ELIMINATE THE COMMUNISTS. IN REJECTING THIS POLICY RECOMMENDATION, WASHINGTON DIRECTED A SERIES OF TACTICAL ACTIONS WHICH SUCCEEDED IN PLACING THE RELIGIOUS AND THE MILITARY IN ANTAGONISM TO EACH OTHER.

THIS RESULTED IN THE CONSEQUENCE WE CONSISTENTLY WARNED ABOUTTHE DISINTEGRATION OF THE MILITARY AND THE SPEWING OF PERHAPS ONE HUNDRED THOUSAND WEAPONS INTO THE HANDS OF THE STREET GANGS. THIS, IN TURN, HAS MEANT THAT THE U.S. NO LONGER HAS AN INTEGRATED MILITARY ESTABLISHMENT WHICH IS RESPONSIVE TO OUR INFLUENCE AND INTERESTS. IT HAS ALSO MEANT THAT THOSE WHO HAVE GAINED CONTROL OF THESE WEAPONS ARE FILLED WITH RESENTMENT FOR THE UNITED STATES BECAUSE WE WERE THE ONES WHO ENCOURAGED MILITARY RESISTANCE TO THE REVOLUTION RATHER THAN COLLABORATION.

I SHALL PROBABLY NEVER UNDERSTAND THE RATIONALE-IF INDEED THERE WAS ANY, FOR PURSUING THESE TACTICS, WHICH SEEMED DEVOID OF ANY STRATEGIC POLICY OBJECTIVES WHATSOEVER. ------------------099188 192058Z /12 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 0012 SECTION 3 OF 3 TEHRAN 0011 NODIS FOR THE SECRETARY FROM SULLIVAN

IT IS, HOWEVER, IMPORTANT FOR US TO UNDERSTAND WHERE WE FIND OURSELVES AT THIS CURRENT JUNCTURE. WE HAVE VERY LIMITED ASSETS WITH WHICH TO DEALAND ARE WORKING IN AN ENVIRONMENT OF GREAT HOSTILITY. ANY EMOTIONAL SPARK COULD TRIGGER ANOTHER OUTBREAK OF VIOLENCE AGAINST THIS EMBASSY WHICH WOULD ELIMINATE IT. NEVERTHELESS, THE LONG-TERM STRATEGIC INTERESTS OF IRAN DICTATE THAT IRAN WILL WISH TO MAINTAIN DECENT RELATIONS WITH THE UNITED STATES. THE MILITARY HARDWAREIRAN HAS BROUGHT FROM THE UNITED STATES WILL NEED TO BE SERVICED IT THE ARMED FORCES ARE TO BE REVIVED. THERE ARE THE SEEDS OF A NEW RELATIONSHIP THERE, BUT THEY ARE GOINGTO HAVE TO BE NURTURED VERY SLOWLY.

IN THE MEANTIME, I HAVE ONLY THE CRUDIST SORT OF AN EMBASSY HERE. OUR CHANCERY BUILDING IS A SHAMBLES AND WE WILL PROBABLY NOT BE ABLE TO OCCUPY IT FOR ANOTHER FEW DAYS-EVEN THEN WITHOUT WINDOW GLASS. OUR COMMUNICATIONS ARE LIMITED. OUR PERSONAL SECURITY IS MARGINAL, AND DEPENDENT UPON A GROUP WHICH HAD BEEN TRAINED TO ASSASSINATE US. MY STAFF IS EXHAUSTED FROM THE ENORMOUS TASK OF GETTING AMERICAN EVACUEES THROUGH THE HAZARDOUS PROCESS OF EXODUS.

FOR ALL THESE REASONS, I INTEND TO WORK VERY SLOWLY IN THE EFFORT TO ESTABLISH SOME SORT OF NEW BASIS FOR U.S.IRANIAN RELATIONS. I SEE NO RPT NO REASON TO RUSH HAT IN HAND TO THIS NEW GROUP. I WILL MOVE INSTEAD WITH A LITTLE RESERVE AND MAKE CLEAR THAT WE DO NOT RPT NOT WISH TO FORCE OURSELVES ON IRAN. THE ANODYNE INSTRUCTIONS I HAVE RECEIVED ARE QUITE ADEQUATE TO THIS PROCESS, AND I SHALL PROCEED TO IMPLEMENT THEM. I HAVE AN APPOINTMENT WITH THE PRIME MINISTER ON THE AFTERNOON OF WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 21.
I WILL AWAIT THE RESULTS OF THAT MEETING BEFORE SEEKING AN APPOINTMENT WITH THE FOREIGN MINISTER. SULLIVAN NOTE: RECATEGORIZED TO NODIS PER STATE 043122.
(CONFIDENTIAL ENTIRE TEXT)

WE ARE CONTINUING OUR EFFORTS ON SEVERAL FRONTS TO SECURE THE RETURN OF SGT KRAUS. MORNING FEB 21, AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI SENT A HIGH-RANKING MULLAH NAMED ROOHANI TO TALK WITH ME ABOUT THIS CASE AND ANY OTHER PROBLEMS WHICH WE HAVE. I GAVE HIM COPY OF DRAUS PASSPORT PICTURE AND SUCH INFORMATION AS WE HAD ABOUT BACKGROUND OF CASE. ROUHANI UNDERTOOK TO REPORT DIRECTLY TO KHOMEINI AND SAID HE WOULD TRY RETURN KRAUS TO EMBASSY THIS AFTERNOON. HE SAID HE PERSONALLY HAD NO KNOWLEDGE OF CASE.

FRENCH AMBASSADOR, ACTING UNDER INSTRUCTIONS FROM PARIS, ALSO TELEPHONED ME TO ASK WHAT HE COULD DO TO HELP. I SUGGESTED HE CALL WHATEVER HE CONSIDERED HIS BEST CONTACTS IN KHOMEINI CAMP AND SEEK IMMEDIATE RELEASE OF KRAUS TO EMBASSY. HE UNDERTOOK TO DO SO.

ASIDE FROM KRAUS CASD, I ASKED ROUHANI TO TAKE ACTION TO CLEAR OCCUPYING FORCE FROM ICA BUILDING. I EXPLAINED THAT FORCE SEEMED TO BE FEDAYEEN RATHER THAN MUJAHEDIN AND WE HAD REPORTS THEY WERE USING ICA PRINTING PRESS TO PRINT PROPAGANDA.

I ALSO ASKED ROUHANI TO LOOK INTO CASE OF U.S. ARMY HOSPITAL, WHICH IRAN MEDICAL ASSOCIATION ALLEGEDLY WISHES TO CONFISCATE BY SATURDAY. (THIS MATTER IS SOMEWHAT COMPLICATED BY FACT THAT AT LEAST ONE OF U.S. DOCTORS IN HOSPITAL IS EAGERLY ATTEMPTING TO GET IRANIANS TO TAKE OVER THE FACILITY SOTHAT HE CAN GET OUT OF COUNTRY. I UNDERSTAND HE HAS GIVEN INTERVIEW TO ABC BROADCASTING.)
FINALLY, I ASKED ROUHANI TO ARRANGE FOR OUR U.S. MILITARY PERSONNEL TO HAVE ACCESS TO GULF DISTRICT COMPOUND, WHERE ALL THEIR UNCLASSIFIED PERSONNEL RECORDS ARE PRESUMABLY STILL INTACT.

ROUHANI CONVEYED WARM PERSONAL GREETING TO ME FROM KHOMEINI, SAID HE WISHED FORGET ALL PAST EVENTS, AND LOOKED FORWARD TO GOOD RELATIONS WITH UNITED STATES IN FUTURE. I THANKED ROUHANI FOR THESE SENTIMENTS, SENT MY RESPECTS TO KHOMEINI, AND GAVE HIM MY ADVICE TO BE VERY CAREFUL BECAUSE THERE ARE SO MANY COMMUNIST GUNS IN THE STREETS.

I WILL MAKE ALL ABOVE POINTS TO PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN WHEN I SEE HIM THIS AFTERNOON, AS WELL AS OTHER POINTS CONTAINED IN MY INSTRUCTIONS. I WILL ALSO, AT THAT TIME, ATTEMPT TO ARRANGE INTERVIEW FOR GENERAL GAST WITH
CONFIDENTIAL-ENTIRE TEXT)

YOU SHOULD KNOW THAT ROSS PEROT'S BRAGGING OF HIS ARRANGING THE RELEASE OF HIS TWO EDS OFFICIALS THROUGH A JAIL BREAK HAS GRAVELY COMPLICATED OUR EVACUATION PROCESSING AT THE AIRPORT. AIRPORT OFFICIALS HAVE MADE IT POINTEDLY CLEAR THAT THEY ARE HIGHLY ANNOYED AND ARE NOT SHOWING THE COOPERATION WHICH WE HAD LABORIOUSLY DEVELOPED OVER THE LAST SEVERAL DAYS. WE CAN EXPECT FURTHER REVERBERATIONS THROUGHOUT THE GOVERNMENT, PARTICULARLY IN FUTURE CASES WHEN AMERICANS ARE ARRESTED.
THE BARN DOOR HAS ALREADY BEEN OPEN BUT AN ADMOTION FROM TOP U.S. OFFICIALS TO PEROT TO AVOID FURTHER PUBLICITY WOULD BE DESIRABLE.

I MET FOR AN HOUR ON AFTERNOON FEB 21 WITH PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN. VICE PRIME MINISTER ENTEZAM WAS ALSO PRESENT. AS I ENTERED THE OFFICE, AIR FORCE CHIEF OF STAFF AZABARZIN WAS JUST LEAVING. AS I LEFT, SOVIET AMBASSADOR VINOGRADOV WAS WAITING TO ENTER.

BAZARGAN BEGAN THE CONVERSATION BY EXPRESSING REGRETS THAT OUR LAST SCHEDULED MEETING HAD BEEN ABORTED BY HIS DESIGNATION AS AS PRIME MINISTER. HE ALSO EXPRESSED DEEPEST REGRETS OVER ATTACK ON EMBASSY AND HIS RELIEF THAT WE HAD ALL SURVIVED.

I SAID I WAS CURIOUS ABOUT PRESS STATEMENTS THAT HE HAD TALKED WITH ME ON THE TELEPHONE. ENTEZAM INTERRUPTED TO SAY THAT NEW YORK TIMES REPORTER HAD MISUNDERSTOOD. HE HAD ACTED AS INTERPRETER FOR REPORTER AND IT WAS HE, ENTEZAM, WHO HAD THE TELEPHONE CONVERSATIONS WITH ME.

AS FIRST ITEM OF BUSINESS, I CONVEYED PRESIDENT CARTER'S ORAL MESSAGE. BAZARGAN SAID HE APPECIATED SENTIMENTS AND PRAYERS. HE SAID HIS KNOWLEDGE OF PRESIDENT'S VIEWS ON HUMAN RIGHTS GAVE HIM GREAT RESPECT FOR MR. CARTER NOT ONLY AS A LEADER BUT AS A HUMAN BEING.

I THEN TURNED TO QUESTION OF SERGEANT KRAUS. BAZARGAN SAID "HE IS FREE." ENTEZAM EXPLAINED THIS MEANT HE WAS BEING TRANSFERRED FROM "COMMITTEE" TO PRIME MINISTRY, WHERE EMBASSY OFFICER WILL PICK HIM UP AND BRING HIM TO RESIDENCE (PLEASE AVOID ALL RPT ALL PUBLIC COMMENT ON THIS TRANSACTION UNTIL I CAN GET KRAUS SAFELY OUT OF COUNTRY ON TOMORROW'S PAN AM FLIGHT.)

I THEN ASKED FOR ACTION TO RETURN ICA BUILDING TO OUR CONTROL--BAZARGAN WAS FULLY INFORMED AND SAID ACTION WAS IN PROGRESS. HE POINTED OUT THAT BUILDING WAS IN HANDS OF FEDAYEEN, WHICH HE DID NOT RPT NOT CONTROL.

THIS LED TO DISCUSSION OF DIFFICULTIES GOVERNMENT FACED IN DEALING WITH VARIOUS ARMED LEFTIST GROUPS. I ASKED HIM HOW HE VIEWED BALANCE AMONG THESE GROUPS. HE SAID ANTI-COMMUNIST FORCES WERE OVERWHELMINGLY GREATER BUT COMMUNISTS WERE BETTER ORGANIZED. THEY HELD THE NIRT ORGANIZATION, THE UNIVERSITY AND MOST OF THE PRESS. HOWEVER, WHEN FACED WITH A DIRECT CHALLENGE FROM KHOMEINI ON THEIR INTENDED MARCH AND DEMONSTRATION TOMORROW, THEY BACKED DOWN AND CANCELLED THE EVENT.

WE DISCUSSED AT SOME LENGTH THE PROBLEM HE WAS HAVING IN RECONSTITUTING THE MILITARY. HE SPOKE OF THE "NATIONAL GUARD" WHICH HE WAS IN THE PROCESS OF CREATING. HE SAID IT WOULD BE GIVEN THE TASK OF LAW AND ORDER, THEREBY PRESERVING ARMED FORCES FOR NATIONAL DEFENSE PURPOSES ONLY.

THIS LED TO DISCUSSION OF U.S.-IRAN MILITARY RELATIONSHIP. HE SAID SOME SORT OF ARRANGEMENT WOULD BE NECESSARY, BUT NOT RPT NOT THE SAME AS HAD PREVAILED IN THE PAST. HE HAD NOT YET NAMED A MINISTER OF DEFENSE AND THEREFORE HAD NO REAL POLICY NEWS AS YET. HE PREFERRED THAT GENERAL GAST WAIT FOR AWHILE UNTIL A MINISTER IS FUNCTIONING AND THEN WE COULD WORK OUT FUTURE ARRANGEMENTS. HE DID NOT RPT NOT CONSIDER THIS A FUNCTION FOR GENERAL GHARANI TO PERFORM.

I TOOK UP THE QUESTION OF THE SPRUANCES AND EXPLAINED NEED FOR A DECISION. HE SAID HE KNEW VERY LITTLE ABOUT THIS BUT IT SEEMED CANCELLATION ALL FOUR SHIPS SEEMED THE ONLY COURSE TO TAKE. HE HOPED U.S. NAVY WOULD BE PREPARED TO BUY THEM AND SAVE IRAN THE TERMINATION COSTS.

AS INSTRUCTED, I TOLD HIM WE WERE WILLING TO COLLABORATE WITH HIS GOVERNMENT IN WORKING OUT THEIR FINANCIAL AND ECONOMIC TANGLES. HE EXPRESSED GREAT APPRECIATION. HE SAID HE HAD NOT YET NAMED A GOVERNOR FOR THE CENTRAL BANK BUT HOPED TO HAVE ONE SOON.

AFTER DISCUSSING ONE OR TWO LESS PRESSING MATTERS, SUCH AS OUR MILITARY HOSPITAL, EVACUATION OF BANDAR ABBAS, ETC., I ASKED IF HE WISHED TO DISCUSS ANY ASPECT OF OUR INTELLIGENCE COLLABORATION. HE SAID HE HAD NOT YET HAD CHANCE TO STUDY QUESTION AND WOULD THEREFORE PREFER NOT RPT NOT TO DISCUSS MATTERS PENDING FURTHER EXAMINATION. HE EXPLAINED THAT MOST OF THOSE ASSOCIATED WITH INTELLIGENCE MATTERS HAD DISAPPEARED.

AT THIS POINT, I SAID I HAD BEEN INSTRUCTED TO EXPRESS MY GOVERNMENT'S SHOCK AND CHAGRIN AT THE SUMMARY EXECUTIONS WHICH HAD TAKEN PLACE, APPARENTLY WITHOUT TRIAL OR OTHER DUE PROCESS. I SAID THIS WAS PARTICULARLY SURPRISING TO US BECAUSE OF BAZARGAN'S REPUTATION AS A HUMAN RIGHTS ADVOCATE. BAZARGAN LOOKED VERY PAINED AND SAID HE TOO REGRETTED THE WAY THE EXECUTIONS HAD BEEN CARRIED OUT. HE HAD INSTITUTED A NEW COURT PROCEDURE, WITH JURIES, DEFENSE ATTORNEYS, ETC. TO HANDLE THESE CASES FROM NOW ON.

FINALLY, BAZARGAN TOLD ME THAT I WOULD SOON RECEIVE A LETTER, THROUGH THE FOREIGN MINISTRY, EXPRESSING OFFICIAL REGRET OVER ATTACK ON EMBASSY AND OFFERING FULL COMPENSATION FOR DAMAGE AND LOSS. WE THEN TERMINATED THE CONVERSATION BY EXPRESSIONS OF MUTUAL DESIRE TO MAINTAIN GOOD RELATIONS BETWEEN OUR TWO GOVERNMENTS AND PEOPLE. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN02137.subject: CONSTITUTIONAL TIMETABLE, GOI PERFORMANCE SUMMARY: NEW CONSTITUTION EXPECTED READY 10-20 DAYS FROM NOW. NEW GOI SOMEWHAT CHAOTIC. REFERENDUM ON ISLA MIC RE

segments.text: SUMMARY: NEW CONSTITUTION EXPECTED READY 10-20 DAYS FROM NOW. NEW GOI SOMEWHAT CHAOTIC. REFERENDUM ON ISLAMIC REPUBLIC TO BE IN 15 DAYS. END SUMMARY.

GOI HAS HINTED THAT THE NEW ISLAMIC CONSTITUTION WILL BE READY SHORTLY. LOCAL PRESS ACCOUNTS HERE SUGGEST IT WILL EMBODY A SPECIAL COUNCIL TO GUARD THE CONSTITUTION, A PRESIDENT ELECTED EVERY FOUR OR FIVE YEARS WITH TWO-TERM MAXIMUM, AND INDEPENDENCE OF THE JUDICIARY AND THE LEGISLATURE. DR. NASSER MINATCHI, A MEMBER OF THE DRAFTING COMMITTEE, TOLD POLOFF THAT DRAFT WOULD BE READY IN 20 DAYS AND SAID PRESS REPORTS OF GENERAL NATURE OF CONSTITUTION WERE NOT TOO WIDE OF MARK.

GOI ANNOUNCED TO PRESS LATE EVENING FEB. 22, THAT IT WILL HOLD A REFERENDUM IN 15 DAYS ON THE ISSUE OF CHANGING IRAN FROM A MONARCHY TO AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. "YES" VOTE ON ISLAMIC REPUBLIC WOULD BE CONSIDERED TO LEGITIMIZE KHOMEINI REVOLUTION, AND PAVE WAY FOR ELECTIONS TO CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY, WHICH WOULD READY DRAFT CONSTITUTION FOR FINAL APPROVAL (ANOTHER REFERENDUM) AFTER WHICH PARLIAMENTARY ELECTIONS WOULD BE HELD AND A NEW GOVERNMENT INSTALLED TO REPLACE BAZARGAN'S PROVISIONAL ADMINISTRATION. TWO IRANIANS WHO HAVE DEALT WITH ELECTIONS IN PAST ARE DOUBTFUL PROCESS CAN BE ORGANIZED AS QUICKLY AS NEW GOI SEEMS TO THINK IT CAN, AND THERE ARE SOME DOUBTS WITHIN GOI ITSELF.
NEVERTHELESS, GOI IS NOW ON RECORD WITH ROUGH TIMETABLE OF EVENTS.

IN PROCESS OF SECURING RELEASE OF MARINE KEN KRAUS, POLOFF STEMPEL HAD THREE-HOUR WAIT AT PM'S OFFICE WHICH PROVIDED EXCELLENT OBSERVATION OF NEW GOVERNMENT IN ACTION. AFTER TEN DAYS IN OFFICEE PRIME MINISTRY HAS ITS BASIC OFFICE ASSIGNMENTS SET, PROJECTS ARE GIVEN OUT ON AN AD HOC BASIS IN OFFICE OF DEPUTY PM ENTEZAM. NUMBER OF PEOPLE FROM OLD REGIME REMAIN IN PLACE, WITH LAYERING OF ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARIES. THE BOND STREET SUITS OF THE OLD CLASH RATHER SEVERLY WITH THE GI "FLACK JACKET" OF THE NEW, AND THIS EXTENDS TO TEMPERMENTS AS WELL. THERE WERE NO FISTFIGHTS DURING THIS PERIOD OF OBSERVATION, BUT TWO NEAR-MISSES AND SEVERAL THREATS.

SHAKEDOWN IS PERHAPS PROCEEDING FASTER THAN MIGHT BE EXPECTED. EMBASSY PROCESSING OFFICERS AT TEHRAN'S MEHRABAD AIRPORT REPORT SIGNIFICANT IMPROVEMENT IN COORDINATION OVER PAST FOUR OR FIVE DAYS. MANY PROFESSIONALS, SUITABLY CLEARED BY NEW REGIME, ARE RETURNING TO DUTY AT AIRPORT AND ELSEWHERE. PRIME MINISTRY IS ABLE TO ASSERT ITS AUTHORITY MORE CONSISTENTLY AND FURTHER DOWN GOVERNMENTAL CHAIN THAN A WEEK AGO. PROCESS HAS A LONG WAY TO GO, HOWEVER, AND SYSTEM IS STILL CLOSER TO CHAOS THAN TO ORDER. SULLIVAN

MINISTER COUNSELOR WAS REQUESTED TO CALL ON GOODARZNIA, DIRECTOR OF 4TH DEPARTMENT, AFTERNOON OF FEB 22. THE LATTER REFERRED TO THE PROPOSAL OF THE U.S. GOVERNMENT CONCERNING ITS "CONTROL OVER" FUNDS FOR THE RELEASE OF THE EDS EMPLOYEES AND ASKED WHAT THE STATUS WAS OF THAT PROPOSAL. (IN VIEW OF DESTRUCTION OF FILES WE DO NOT HAVE REFERENCES). GOODARZNIA THEN QUERIED WHETHER THERE HAD BEEN ANY EMBASSY ASSISTANCE TO THE TWO ESCAPEES. HE HAD BEFORE HIM A FILE WITH ALL STATEMENTS MADE BY ROSS PEROT FOLLOWING THE ESCAPE OF HIS TWO EMPLOYEES.

THE MINISTER COUNSELOR ASSURED GOODARZNIA THAT THE EMBASSY HAD PLAYED NO ROLE WHATSOEVER IN THE ESCAPE AND THAT IN FACT THE PASSPORTS OF THE TWO INDIVIDUALS ARE STILL IN OUR POSSESSION. GOODARZNIA WAS ALSO ASSURED THAT THE EMBASSY HAD NOT ISSUED NEW PASSPORTS. TURNING TO THE U.S.

PROPOSAL OF EARLY FEBRUARY, THE MINISTER COUNSELOR STATED THAT HE WAS, OF COURSE, WITHOUT INSTRUCTIONS BUT NOTED THAT THE GOI HAD NOT RESPONDED TO OUR PROPOSAL AND THAT THE EDS HAD BEEN FOLLOWING A SECOND PATH (I.E., THE LETTER OF CREDIT THROUGH BANK OMRAN) AND HAD NEARLY REACHED AN AGREEMENT WHEN THE LAST PHASE OF THE REVOLUTION HAD OCCURRED AND THE JAIL BREAK HAD TAKEN PLACE. THEREFORE, IT SEEMS LIKELY, THE MINISTER COUNSELOR SAID, THAT THE USG WOULD NOT CONSIDER ITS PROPOSAL EXTANT.

WE WOULD APPRECIATE FURTHER GUIDANCE ON THE LINE TO TAKE IN RESPONSE TO THIS APPROACH. AT THE SAME TIME IT WOULD BE HELPFUL IF PEROT MAINTAINED PUBLIC SILENCE AND THROUGH THE EMBASSY OFFERED TO MEET WITH GOI OFFICIALS SOME PLACE IN EUROPE TO HOLD NEGOTIATIONS ON THE ENTIRE CONTRACT ISSUE. SULLIVAN NOTE BY OC/T: DISSEMINATION COORDINATED WITH MR. FISHER, S/S-O.
BASED ON TELECONS WE INTEND TO PROCEED AS FOLLOWS ON EMBASSY STAFFING OVER NEXT FEW MONTHS.

FRONT OFFICE: MINISTER-COUNSELOR WILL RETURN TO U.S. IN EARLY MARCH FOR CONSULTATION AND LEAVE AND RETURN TEHRAN IN LATE MARCH OR EARLY APRIL. MS. MCKEOWN AND MS. HILL WILL REMAIN HERE BUT MAY LATER WISH TO TAKE SOME LEAVE. SKIP BOYCE WILL STAY HERE FOR SEVERAL MORE WEEKS DOING INVALUABLE LIAISON WITH LOCAL SECURITY FORCES. HE THEN SHOULD RECEIVE PCS ORDERS.

POLITICAL SECTION: LAMBRAKIS WILL RETURN IN EARLY MARCH. STEMPEL WILL TAKE VISITATION LEAVE AND RETURN TO TEHRAN IN EARLY APRIL (PLEASE ISSUE ORDERS). TOMSETH IS IN PLACE. PATTERSON'S TDY CAN BE CONCLUDED IN EARLY MARCH. PERETT SHOULD RECEIVE PCS ORDERS. METRINKO WOULD PREFER TO REMAIN IN IRAN FOR INDEFINITE FUTURE. WE WILL USE HIM IN POLITICAL SECTION AND, IN VIEW OF HIS LANGUAGE SKILLS, AS PINCH-HITTER IN LIAISON WITH SECURITY FORCES AND DAILY PROBLEM SOLVING. LOOKING FURTHER AHEAD, DEPARTMENT MAY WISH TO CONSIDER HAVING POLITICAL SECTION COMPOSED OF TOMSETH, METRINKO, AND LIMBERT. WE CAN KEEP OPEN FOR TIME BEING FOURTH POSITION.
AT PRESENT TIME WE DO NOT SEE NEED FOR EVANS ON TDY FOR POLITICAL SECTION BUT WOULD LIKE TO KEEP THAT OPTION OPEN.

ECONOMIC SECTION: BARBARA SCHELL IS WILLING TO STAY UNTIL HER NORMAL TOUR IS OVER. WE WILL WANT YOUR HELP IN FACILITATING CONE CHANGE TO ECON/COMMERCIAL. SHE CAN, WITH FSN ASSISTANCE, GET STARTED ON VARIOUS ECON/COMMERCIAL TASKS. AT SAME TIME, WE WILL WANT TO BE FLEXIBLE AND USE HER EXPERIENCE IN CONSULAR AND POLITICAL SECTIONS. ABOUT TWO WEEKS FROM NOW WE CAN DECIDE ON RETURN OF CLYDE TAYLOR AND RICHARD BASH AND DECIDE LATER ON JOHN MILLS AND JOE HARARY.

CONSULAR SECTION: LOU GOELZ, R. SORENSON, AND TOM FARRELL WILL REMAIN TEHRAN UNTIL LATE MARCH. AT THAT TIME GOELZ SHOULD RECEIVE PCS ORDERS; THE LATTER TWO SHOULD RECEIVE ORDERS FOR LEAVE AND RETURN TO TEHRAN IN LATE APRIL. IN MEANTIME, RICHARDSON SHOULD HAVE 3-4 WEEKS LEAVE WITH RETURN TO TEHRAN WHEN GOELZ DEPARTS. BELSITO, MARSHALL AND DE TOMAS WILL DEPART WITHIN NEXT DAY OR SO AND SHOULD RECEIVE PCS ORDERS. THE TDY OF O'NEILL AND MILLER WILL BE CONCLUDED. KLEIBER WILL REMAIN FOR MONTH OR SO TO PROCESS ARMISH/MAAG FSN TERMINATIONS AND THEN SHOULD RECEIVE PCS ORDERS.

SKUD FROM SHIRAZ IS EXPECTED ARRIVE TEHRAN SHORTLY AND WILL BE SENT OUT OF COUNTRY. AT END OF MARCH HE SHOULD RETURN TO EMBASSY CONSULAR SECTION TO WORK WITH RICHARDSON. WE MAY NEED ONE OR TWO TDY'ERS IN CONSULAR SECTION AT THAT TIME. ROBERT LE MONT FROM ISFAHAN HAS BEEN EVACUATED. DEPARTMENT SHOULD DISCUSS WITH HIM POSSIBILITY OF RETURN TO CONSULAR SECTION TEHRAN. HOWEVER, WE WANT YOUR UNDERSTANDING IF HE WOULD PREFER NOT TO RETURN AND WANTS PCS.

ADMINISTRATIVE SECTION: WE HAVE PREVIOUSLY GIVEN YOU OUR THOUGHTS BUT, TO RECAPITULATE: WE WANT TDY RELIEF FOR MILLS, WHO WILL RETURN TO TEHRAN UNTIL JUNE RETIREMENT AFTER A FEW WEEKS LEAVE. MS BINKLEY IS WILLING STAY ON FOR TIME BEING. WE WILL ADDRESS HER TRANSFER OR TDY RELIEF LATER. STEPHEN SMITH WILL ACCOMPANY AIR FREIGHT SHIPMENT TO FRANKFURT AND ANTWERP, TAKE A SHORT LEAVE AND THEN RETURN TO TEHRAN UNTIL MAY WHEN HE SHOULD RECEIVE PCS ORDERS. GIACOBBI SHOULD BE GRANTED LEAVE/TRAVEL ORDERS TO MANILA (HIS WIFE IS THERE) AND THEN RETURN TO TEHRAN FOR INDEFINITE PERIOD.

MCLAUGHLIN, STEWART, AND MATTHEWS WILL STAY HERE TO CLEAN UP DEBRIS AND GET HOUSEHOLD EFFECTS MOVING. AFTER 4-6 WEEKS, THEY SHOULD RECEIVE PCS ORDERS AND BE REPLACED PCS OR TDY. CRU HAS BEEN TAKEN CARE OF. TONY BART WILL BE GIVEN ORDERS FOR FEW WEEKS LEAVE AND HE WILL RETURN HERE FOR BRIEF PERIOD BEFORE TRANSFER TO KARACHI. HE IS SUPERB AND NEEDED HERE TO ENSURE OUR COMMUNICATIONS ARE IN ORDER.
IN PREVIOUS MESSAGE, WE COVERED ALLIED AGENCY PERSONNEL. NO CHANGES.
SEPTEL COVERS SY RECOMMENDATIONS.
(S - ENTIRE TEXT)

WE HAVE FINALLY REACHED ENTEZAM, WHO CONFIRMS THAT HE HAS INSTRUCTED DELEGATION WHICH HE SENT TO KAPKAN TO GUARANTEE ALL PAYMENTS OF LEGITIMATE CLAIMS BY IRANIANS. HE UNDERTOOK TO PASS ALONG OUR SUGGESTION THAT REPRESENTATIVES FROM KAPKAN COME TO TEHRAN TO COLLECT FUNDS WHEN U.S. PERSONNEL ARE RETURNED TO EMBASSY.
FROM OTHER COMMUNICATIONS, IT APPEARS THAT ENTEZAM'S PARTY FROM MASHAD HAS ARRIVED AT KAPKAN AND IS NEGOTIATING WITH LOCAL REPRESENTATIVES. REPORTS INDICATE THAT SITUATION SETTLING DOWN.
(S - ENTIRE TEXT)

I TALKED WITH ENTEZAM FEB 23 ABOUT PROBLEMS AT TACKSMAN II AND REPORTED THROUGH OTHER CHANNELS. ESSENTIALLY, HE AGREED HAVE MASHAD COMMITTEE ASSUME REESPONSIBILITY FOR SAFETY OF U.S. PERSONNEL. AIRCRAFT WHICH STANDING BY AT MASHAD WAS TO FLY TO KAPKAN WHEN WEATHER CLEARED AND BRING PERSONNEL DIRECTLY TO TEHRAN. THEY WOULD THEN BE DELIVERED TO EMBASSY, WHERE AIR ATTACHE WILL RECEIPT FOR THEM.

SINCE THIS CONVERSATION, PROBLEM OVER MONEY HAS DEVELOPED AT TACKSMAN II. IN RESPONSE TO THIS QUESTION, I HAVE SUGGESTED CHIEF OF PROJECT ARRANGE WITH LOCAL EMPLOYEES TO SELECT AT LEAST TWO IRANIAN PERSONNEL WHO ENJOY GENERAL TRUST OF OTHERS AND HAVE THEM ACCOMPANY U.S. PERSONNEL ON TRIP TO TEHRAN. UPON THEIR ARRIVAL HERE, THEY WILL BE GIVEN APPROXIMATELY 15 MILLION RIALS TO SATISFY ALL CLAIMS AND WILL RETURN TO KAPKAN WITH FUNDS.

I HAVE BEEN TRYING WITHOUT SUCCESS ALL MORNING FEB 24 TO REACH ENTEZAM IN ORDER RATIFY ARRANGEMENTS PROPOSED IN PARA 2. IN ABSENCE SUCH CONTACT I AM SENDING OFFICER TO ENTEZAM'S OFFICE TO TRY TO BREAK THROUGH BARRIER OF MUJAHEDINS AND TRACK HIM DOWN. BASIC PURPOSE WILL BE TO ASSURE HIM THAT FUNDS WILL BE PAID UPON DELIVERY OF U.S. PERSONNEL TO EMBASSY COMPOUND. AT SAME TIME, I SHALL SEEK HIS AGREEMENT TO SEND IRANIAN EMPLOYEES WITH FUNDS BACK TO KAPKAN BY IAF PLANE.

ACCORDING LATEST REPORTS FROM KAPKAN, VFR CONDITIONS PREVAIL AT LANDING STRIP AND PLANE SHOULD BE ABLE LAND THERE AT THIS TIME. IN ABSENCE COMMUNICATIONS WITH IAF, WE HAVE NO RPT NO INFO WHETHER PLANE HAS LEFT MASHAD.
(S-ENTIRE TEXT).

THE FIRST MAJOR CRISIS FOR THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT (AND FOR THE FORCES OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI) IS SHAPING UP AROUND ISSUES WHICH WILL DETERMINE THE FUTURE OF THE ARMED FORCES. SINCE THE INTEGRITY OF THOSE FORCES WAS NOT PRESERVED AND SINCE THEY DID NOT REACH A COMPROMISE AGREEMENT WITH KHOMEINI PRIOR TO THE DEBACLE, VARIOUS "COMMITTEES" AT ALL LEVELS OF THE SERVICES ARE ATTEMPTING TO MAKE DECISIONS AND VOTE ON FUTURE LEADERSHIP. THEIR POSITION IS EXTREMELY VULNERABLE.

BAZARGAN HAS ATTEMPTED TO RECONSTITUTE THE ARMED FORCES UNDER SOME SORT OF PROFESSIONAL LEADERSHIP. HIS CHOICE OF MADANI AS MINISTER OF DEFENSE AND GHARANI AS CHIEF OF STAFF INDICATED THE DIRECTION HE HAS TRIED TO PURSUE. HIS DESIGNATION OF AZARBARZIN AS CHIEF OF THE AIR FORCE WAS AN EVEN MORE CONVENTIONAL STEP. HOWEVER, OUR REPORTS INDICATE THAT AZARBARZIN MAY BE REJECTED BY THE AIR FORCE AND MAY BE REQUIRED TO RETIRE.

THE COMMUNISTS, ACTING THROUGH THE FEDAYEEN AND OTHER LEFTIST GROUPS, ATTEMPTING TO FRUSTRATE BAZARGAN'S EFFORTS TO RESTORE AND RECONSTITUTE PROFESSIONAL ARMED FORCES. THEIR CALL IS FOR THE COMPLETE DISSOLUTION OF THE ARMED FORCES UNITS AND THE CONSTRUCTION OF A "PEOPLE'S ARMY." IN THIS CALL, THEY SEEM TO HAVE THE SUPPORT OF SOME OF THE MUJAHEDIN, WHO ARE NORMALLY LOYAL TO KHOMEINI AND SHOULD, THEREFORE, BE BAZARGAN'S PRINCIPAL SUPPORTERS. THEY HAVE USED A VARIETY OF TACTICS IN THEIR APPROACH. ONE OF THE MOST BIZARRE EVENTS HAS BEEN AN ATTACK BY U.S. CITIZEN RALPH SCHOENMAN ON COLONEL TAVAKOLI, ALLEGEDLY KHOMEINI'S PRINCIPAL MILITARY ADVISER.

ON THE OUTCOME OF THE STRUGGLE OVER THE NATURE OF THE ARMED FORCES MAY HINGE THE ENTIRE FUTURE OF IRAN, AND CERTAINLY THE FUTURE OF THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT. IF THE COMMUNISTS, WHOSE TACTICS ARE ALMOST CERTAINLY BEING DIRECTED BY THE SOVIETS, SUCCEED IN THIS MATTER, THEY WILL HAVE SCORED A MAJOR VICTORY.

IT WOULD SEEM THAT THIS STRUGGLE HAS BECOME THE CENTERPIECE OF COMMUNIST STRATEGY. BY DROPPING THE PRIMACY OF THE TUDEH PARTY AND OPTING FOR A BORADER BASE THROUGH THE FEDAYEEN, THE COMMUNISTS HAVE ACHIEVED A MORE POTENT INSTRUMENT. BY CONCENTRATION ON THE ISSUE OF THE UNPOPULAR ARMED FORCES RATHER THAN RESORTING STREET WARFARE BY THE CHARIKS, THEY HAVE CHOSEN A MORE SOPHISTICATED COURSE OF ACTION.

THE OUTCOME OF THE STRUGGLE MAY HINGE ON THE DEGREE OF ORGANIZATION WHICH THE COMMUNISTS HAVE DONE IN VARIOUS SECTIONS OF THE ARMED FORCES. IF THEIR ORGANIZATION IS SO WELL ADVANCED THAT THEY CAN FOMENT REBELLION AGAINST ANY PROFESSIONAL LEADERSHIP, THEY CAN DOUBTLESS SUCCEED BECAUSE THE PROFESSIONAL LEADERSHIP IS SO DEMORALIZED. FOR BAZARGAN, THIS IS GOING TO BE AN UPHILL STRUGGLE
C - ENTIRE TEXT

SUMMARY: MUJAHEDIN SUPPORT LEFTIST DEMANDS. AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI WILL GO TO QOM FEB. 27; HIS COMMITTEE IS REPORTEDLY DISBANDING, WITH GOI PROBABLY TO TAKE OVER FUNCTIONS. CURRENT LIST OF SENIOR APPOINTMENTS BY NEW GOI. LEFTISTS TRYING TO CLAIM ICA SUBSCRIPTION LISTS IS CIA MEMBERSHIP ROSTER. UNIVERSITIES STILL IN CHAOS. RELIGIOUS MINORITIES STILL FRIGHTENED. END SUMMARY.

IN WAKE OF PEOPLE'S FEDAYEEN (PF) RALLY AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY FEB. 23 (REFTEL), MJUAHEDIN GROUP MADE SIMILAR DEMANDS OF NEW GOI IN FEB 24 RALLY AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY. MUJAHEDIN LEADER MASSOUD RAJAVI DEMANDED NEW "PEOPLE'S ARMY" BE FORMED, NO RESTRICTIONS BE APPLIED AGAINST "FREEDOM FIGHTERS," TRIAL OF SHAH'S SUPPORTERS IN PULIC COURT, AND CALLED FOR "PEOPLE'S COUNCILS" TO RUN FACTORIES, UNIVERSITIES, BUSINESSES, GOVERNMENT OFFICES, AND MILITARY GARRISONS. SPEAKER CRITICIZED REVOLUTIONARY CHIEF OF STAFF COL. NASROLLAH TAVAHOLI, WHO RESIGNED FEB 21 AFTER AMERICAN ACTIVIST RALPH SCHOEN MANN ACCUSED HIM OF PLOTTING A CIASTYLE TAKEOVR.

WHILE MUJAHEDIN POSITION ABOVE MAY NOT PRESSAGE MAJOR CHALLENGE TO THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT'S AUTHORITY, IT IS WORTH NOTHING THAT THE GOI'S MAIN MILITARY FORCE IS THE MJAHEDIN. (PRIME MINISTER'S HOME WAS REPORTEDLY ATTACKED EVENING FEB. 23 BY FOUR EX-IMPERIAL GUARDSMEN, WHO WERE CAPTURED BY REVOLUTIONARY MILITIAMEN GUARDING HOME.) THESE AND OTHER INCIDENTS SUGGEST THAT RECONSTRUCTION OF ARMY AND POLICE HAS NOT PROCEEDED FAR ENOUGH TO INCREASE SECURITY AGAINST ARMED RAIDS VERY MUCH.

SOURCE CLOSE TO KHOMEINI CONFIRMED TO POLOFF EVENING FEB. 24 THAT KHOMEINI WOULD RETURN TO QOM FEB. 27. PRESS MORNING FEB. 25 INDICATES HE WILL RETURN "SOON". IN REPLY TO QUESTION, SOURCE SAID KHOMEINI COMMITTEE ACTIVITIES WERE BEING TERMINATED. (COMMENT: THIS MAY BE THE CASE AS FAR AS SOME ACTIVITIES OF THE CENTRAL COMMITTEE ARE CONCERNED, BUT THE LOCAL COMMITTEES ARE AS ACTIVE AS EVER MORNING FEB. 25. IN VIEW OF CONTINUING THREATS FROM LEFT, IT WOULD SURPRISE US VERY MUCH IF FULL COMMITTEE STRUCTURE WERE TO DISBAND, THOUGH IT IS PROJECTED TO COME UNDER TIGHTER GOVERNMENT CONTROL.

FOLLOWING IS AS COMPLETE A LIST OF NEW APPOINTMENTS IN GOI AS WE CAN PIECE TOGETHER FROM SOURCES AVAILABLE TO US: PRIME MINISTER--MEHDI BAZARGAN. DEPUTY PRIME MINISTERS: IBRAHIM YAZDI (REVOLUTIONARY AFFAIRS), AMIR ENTEZAM (PUBLIC RELATIONS), AND HASHEM SABAGHIAN. FOREIGN MINISTER-KARIM SANJABI.- INTERIOR MINISTER--AHMAD SADR HAJ-SEYEDJAVADI. MINLABOR AND SOCIAL WELFARE--DARIUSH FOROUHAR. MINFINANCE AND ECONOMIC AFFAIRS--ALI ARDALAN. MINDEFENSE-ADMIRAL MOHAMMAD HUSSEIN MADANI. MINJUSTICE--DR. ASSADOLLAH MOBASHERI. MIN ENERGY--ABBAS TAJ. MINAGRICULTURE--DR. MOHAMMAD IZZADI. MINCOMMERCE--DR. REZA SADR. MINEDUCATION-GHOLAM HOSSEIN XNKUHI. MININFO, PUBLICITY, AND CHARITY-DR.

NASSER MINATCHI (THIS PORTFOLIO NOW INCLUDES THE ENDOWMENT ORGANIZATION). MINSCIENCE, CULTURE, AND ARTS--DR. ALI SHARIAT-MADARI. MINISTER OF POSTS AND TELEGRAPH-HASSAN ESLAMI. KHUZESTAN PROVINCIAL GOVERNOR---SAYYED MOHAMMAD KIAVAS.. GILAN PROVINCE GOVERNOR--DR. HABIB DAVARAN. EAST AZERBAIJAN PROVINCE GOVERNOR--DR. RAHMATOLLAH MOGHADAMMARAGHEI. ACTING MAYOR OF TEHRAN--KHOSROW ARDAGHI. ------------------037829 251306Z /46 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 0065 SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 2519

FOLLOWING ARE OTHER SIGNIFICANT APPOINTMENTS: PROVISIONAL HEAD OF IRAN AIR--HUSHANG TAJADOD. CHIEF OF STAFF- GEN. MOHAMMAD VALI QARANI. HEAD OF NATIONAL IRANIAN OIL CO.-HASSAN NAZIH (BAR ASSOCIATION HEAD). HEAD OF NATIONAL IRANIAN RADIO AND TELEVISION--SADEQ QOTBZADEH. CHIEF OF GENDARMERIE--COL. EZZATOLLAH MOMTAZ. ACTING CHIEF OF POLICE--GEN (FNU) NOWROUZI. CHIEF OF DEFENSE INDUSTRIES (REPLACING TOUFANIAN)--COL SEYED MOKTEBI TAHERZADEH. OTHER LOWER LEVEL MILITARY APPOINTMENTS BEING REPORTED THROUGH DAO CHANNELS.

WHEN TEAR GAS LEVEL IN CHANCERY BECOMES ACCEPTABLE, WILL ATTEMPT TO SEE WHAT BIODATA IS AVAILABLE ON ABOVE APPOINTMENTS; INR/OIL/B MAY WISH TO PREPARE PRELIMINARY REPORTS, HOWEVER, SINCE IT MAY HAVE AT LEAST AS UP-TO-DATE MATERIAL ON MANY OF THESE APPOINTMENTS AS WE DO.

NUMBER OF OUR UNIVERSITY SOURCES, BOTH DIRECTLY AND INDIRECTLY, SAY THAT PF HAVE TAKEN ICA SUBSCRIPTION LISTS FROM ICA BUILDING WHICH THEY OCCUPY AND HAVE BEEN USING THEM AT RALLIES AND WITH LOCAL KHOMEINI COMMITTEES TO TRY AND CONVINCE REVOLUTIONARIES THAT THOSE ON THE LISTS ARE "CIA COLLABORATORS." THIS HAS CAUSED QUANTUM JUMP IN TOUCHINESS AMONG MANY OF OUR NORMAL UNIVERSITY CONTACTS, BUT WE HAVE HEARD OF NO RPT NO ARRESTS TO DATE BASED ON THIS SORT OF THING. IT IS A MARK OF THE POLITICAL CLIMATE HERE, HOWEVER, THAT THIS TYPE OF ACTIVITY IS BEING TAKEN SERIOUSLY BY BOTH SIDES.

TWO CLOSE PERSONAL FRIENDS OF POLOFF HAVE DESCRIBED "CENSUS" WHICH HAS BEEN UNDERWAY FOR TWO OR THREE DAYS BY LOCAL KHOMEINI COMMITTEES. ACCORDING TO THOSE CONDUCTING CENSUS, PURPOSE IS TO FIND OUT WHAT TALENTS PEOPLE IN EACH AREA HAVE TO OFFER TO THE REVOLUTION. QUESTIONS RANGE FROM THE USUAL BIRTH AND VITAL DATA TO "WHERE WERE YOU EDUCATED? HOW OFTEN HAVE YOU TRAVELED ABROAD?" AND OTHERS WHICH LEAD OUR SOURCES TO WONDER IF WHOLE EFFORT WILL NOT BECOME BASIS FOR ISLAMIC-BASED REGIMENTATION OF LOCAL LIFE.

ASIDE FROM KILLING OF PERSIAN PRIEST FOR SHIRAZ IRANIAN EPISCOPAL CONGREGATION FEB. 19, WE HAVE HEARD OF NO OTHER INCIDENTS OF VIOLENCE DIRECTED AGAINST RELIGIOUS MINORITIES. WE DO HAVE SOME REPORTS OF BULLYING BY LOCAL KHOMEINI COMMITTEES, AND MOST 'FOREIGN' CHURCHES OR OFFICES HAVE BEEN PLACED UNDER GUARD AND ARE BEING INSPECTED IN TURN; FREQUENTLY THEIR RECORDS ARE BEING IMPOUNDED. ARMENIAN BISHOP ARTAK MANOKIAN CALLED UPON PM BAZARGAN FEB. 23, AND RECEIVED ASSURANCES THAT MINORITY RIGHTS WOULD BE RESPECTED.

THIS, IN EFFECT, MADE ARMENIAN "PEACE" WITH NEW REGIME, BUT MOST MINORITIES, INCLUDING ARMENIANS, REMAIN VERY FRIGHTENED AND WARY OF NEW REGIME (MOSTLY BECAUSE THEY REALIZE IT IS NOT GOI, BUT COMMITTEES OF KHOMEINI THAT HAVE BEEN CAUSING TROUBLE.)

FACULTY MEMBERS HAVE TOLD US THAT SEVERAL UNIVERSITY MEETINGS IN PAST TWO WEEKS HAVE DEGENERATED INTO CHAOS. EVERYONE ARGUES WITH EVERYONE ELSE, AND POLICY IS HAMSTRUNG. VETERAN OF 25 YEARS OF ACADEMIC WARS IN IRAN'S UNIVERSITIES BELIEVE IT WILL AUTUMN BEFORE COHERENT ACADEMIC SITUATION CAN BE REESTABLISHED, AND FORECE MAY BE NECESSARY THEN.

1979TEHRAN02520.subject: ACCOUNT OF BANK MARKAZI IRAN AT NEW YORK FEDERAL RESERVE BANK

segments.text: (C-ENTIRE TEXT)

GOI FOR MOMENT SAYS ALL PAYMENT ORDERS ISSUED BY BANK MARKAZI ARE "ILLEGAL" AND ASKS THAT NY FED CONTINUE TO REFUSE TO EXECUTE SUCH ORDERS. DIR GEN KHALEGHIRAD, AFTER CONSULTING WITH MEAF ARDALAN, ASKED EMBASSY TO PASS THIS TO NY FED, AND ASKED FOR LETTER FROM EMBASSY TO ARDALAN ON THIS SUBJECT.

TEXT OF LETTER FROM AMBASSADOR TO ARDALAN FOLLOWS: : HIS EXCELLENCY, DR. ALI ARDALAN, MINISTER OF FINANCE AND ECONOMIC AFFAIRS. DEAR MR. MINISTER: PURSUANT TO THE TELEPHONE CONVERSATION BETWEEN MR. KHALEGHIRAD OF YOUR STAFF AND DAVID PATTERSON OF THIS EMBASSY, WE ARE INFORMING THE FEDERAL RESERVE BANK OF NEW YORK THAT IT SHOULD CONTINUE TO REFUSE TO EXECUTE PAYMENT ORDERS ISSUED BY THE BANK MARKAZI OF IRAN.

THE FEDERAL RESERVE BANK OF NEW YORK, BEFORE EXECUTING SUCH PAYMENT ORDERS, WILL AWAIT OFFICIAL NOTIFICATION FROM THE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN 1) THAT BANK MARKAZI HAS AUTHORITY TO ISSUE PAYMENT INSTRUCTIONS TO THE NEW YORK FEDERAL RESERVE BANK, 2) OF THE NAMES OF INDIVIDUALS AUTHORIZED TO ISSUE SUCH INSTRUCTIONS, AND 3) OF WHETHER THE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN IS SATISFIED WITH EXISTING TEST NUMBER ARRANGEMENTS OR WOULD LIKE TO ALTER THEM. YOU MAY MAKE SUCH NOTIFICATION, IF YOU WISH, BY LETTER TO ME, AND I WILL BE GLAD TO FORWARD YOUR INSTRUCTIONS TO THE FEDERAL RESERVE BANK OF NEW YORK VIA THE US DEPARTMENT OF STATE.
PLEASE LET ME KNOW IF I CAN BE OF ANY FURTHER ASSISTANCE TO YOU IN THIS OR ANY OTHER MATTER. SINCERLY YOURS.
(S-ENTIRE TEXT)

ALTHOUGH WE OBVIOUSLY HAVE A CONTINUING OBLIGATION TO HONOR OUR EARLIER INVITATION TO THE SHAH TO SPEND HIS EXILE IN THE UNITED STATES, WASHINGTON SHOULD VERY CAREFULLY CONSIDER THE IMPLICATIONS OF A PRESIDENTIAL OR SECRETARIAL MESSAGE TO THE SHAH. IF SUCH ACTION WERE TAKEN, IT WOULD CONFIRM WORST SUSPUCIONS OF THOSE IRANIAN REVOLUTIONARIES ILHO ASSUME U.S. IS PLOTTING TO RESTORE SHAH TO POWER.

THERE WILL BE NO RPT NO SUCH THING AS GRATITUDE FROM THE SHAH FOR ANY GENEROUS GESTURES WE MAY MAKE TOWARDS HIM. HIS OWN PARANOIA, AS WELL AS TRADITIONAL PERSIAN TENDENCY TO BLAME OTHERS FOR MISFORTUNE, WILL IMPELL HIM TO CRITICIZE U.S. GOVERNMENT AND PRESIDENT PERSONALLY FOR SITUATION IN WHICH HE FINDS HIMSELF. HE WILL DO THIS WHETHER HE IS IN RABAT, ST. MORITZ, OR PALM SPRINGS.

IF WE WISH TO MAINTAIN ANY CREDIBLE RELATIONSHIP WITH CURRENT IRANIAN GOVERNMENT, WE SHOULD LEAVE OUR ASSOCIATION WITH THE SHAH ON THE "LACONIC, IMPERSONAL" BASIS WHICH CURRENTLY OBTAINS. IF HE DOES GO TO THE UNITED STATES, AND ESPECIALLY IF HE IS PERSONALLY RECEIVED THERE BY SENIOR U.S. OFFICIALS, WE WILL ENTER A PERIOD OF INTERMINABLE CONFRONTATION WITH GOVERNMENT OF IRAN WHICH WILL ELIMINATE ANY POSSIBILITY OF CONSTRUCTIVE U.S. INFLUENCE HERE.

FROM POINT OF VIEW OF ANY HOPE FOR ESTABLISHING COOPERATIVE WORKING ARRANGEMENTS WITH IRAN, IT WOULD BE CLEARLY IN OUR INTEREST THAH CHOOSE SOME OTHER LOCATION FOR HIS EXILE AND IT WOULD BE COUNTER TO OUR INTERESTS IN IRAN TO OFFER HIM WARM ENCOURAGEMENT TO GO TO THE UNITED STATES. SULLIVAN
(C-ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY: KHOMEINI TO QOM MARCH 1: TELLS SOVIET AMBASSADOR NOT TO MEDDLE IN IRAN'S INTERNAL AFFAIRS. KHOMEINI CONFIDATE TELLS EMBASSY MANY PRISONERS WILL BE FREED NEXT WEEKEND, MAJOR KHOMEINI COMMITTEE HAS CEASED WORK; LOCAL COMMITTEES ARE BEING INTEGRATED INTO REFORMED POLIC/JUDICIAL CENTERS, NEW AIR FORCE CHIEF NAMED. END SUMMARY

PRESS ANNOUNCED MORNING FEB 26 THAT KHOMEINI HAD DELAYED HIS RETURN TO QOM UNTIL MARCH 1. (SUBSEQUENTLY CONFIRMED BY CLOSE ASSOCIATE, WHO SAID THIS WAS PRETTY FIRM.) PRESS ALSO CARRIED STORY OF KHOMEINI MEETING WITH SOVIET AMBASSADOR VINOGRADOV FEB. 24 DURING WHICH KHOMEINI TOLD HIM THAT IRAN WILL NOT TOLERATE ANY INTERFERENCE IN IRAN'S DOMESTIC AFFAIRS. PRESS PLAYED THIS AS VEILED WARNING TO SOVIETS. IN OTHER DIPLOMATICCONTACTS, KHOMEINI TOLD LEBANESE AND KUWAITI DELEGATIONS THAT HE WOULD HUNT DOWN FORMER PRIME MINISTER BAKHTIAR, WHO HE CLAIMED HAD LEFT IRAN.

KHOMEINI CONFIDANTE TOLD EMBASSY FEB 26 THAT KHOMEINI COMMITTEE HAD QUIETLY RELEASED 303 PRISONERS AND WAS SCHEDULED TO RELEASE ANOTHER 900 MORNING MARCH 3. THESE ARE MEN WHO WERE THROWN IN JAIL BECAUSE THEY HAD PROMINENT NAMES BUT AGAINST WHOM THERE HAD BEEN NO EVIDENCE OF WRONGDOING. SAME SOURCE SAID THERE WOULD PROBABLY BE THREE OR FOUR MORE EXECUTIONS. HE CLAIMED NO RPT NO KNOWLEDGE OF LOWER LEVEL EXECUTIONS WHICH HAVE BEEN REPORTED BY OTHER SOURCES.

SAME SOURCE SAID FULL KHOMEINI COMMITTEE HAD VIRTUALLY DISBANDED. "REVOLUTIONARY ASSEMBLY" ELEMENT REMAINED IN FORCE TO HANDLE SECURITY PROBLEMS. IT WAS OPERATING OUT OF FORMER MILITARY BASE BAGH-E-SHAH I SOUTHWESTERN TEHRAN. LOCAL COMMITTEES ARE STILL IN OPERATION FOR SECURITY PURPOSES, BUT GOI HAD ACTIVATED SEVERAL KALANTARIS (POLIC STATIONS) AND LOCAL MOSQUE COMMITTEE MEMBERS WERE GRAVITATING TO THESE STATIONS TO PARTICIPATE IN NEW LOCAL ADMINISTRATION UNDER NEW GOI CONTROL. (COMMENT: THERE IS UNDOUBEDLY FRICTION BETWEEN ONL OFFICIALS AND NEW REVOLUTIONARIES, BUT IMPRESSION ANOTHER SOURCE GAVE US IS THAAT MUNICIPAL UNITS ARE BEING REHABILITATED ONLY UNDER FIRM GOI CONTROL AS WAY OF CIVILIZING THE REVOLUTION.

COMMENT: IF OPEN BREAK BETWEEN ELEMENTS OF "SECURITY" FORCES CAN BE AVOIDED, NEXT FEW DAYS AND WEEKS ARE LIKELY TO SEE GREAT DEAL MORE OF ADMINISTRATIVE NUTS AND BOLTS ORGANIZATIONAL WORK AS GOI CONTINUES TO ATTEMPT TO CONSOLIDATE ITS HOLD ON CITY AND COUNTRY. SCENE IS LIKELY TO BE PUNCTUATED, AS IT HAS BEEN FOR PAST TEN DAYS, BY OCCASIONAL GUN BATTLES AND ROBBERIES.

LATE ITEM: AFTERNOON NEWS ANNOUNCED APPOINTMENT OF BRIG GEN EMAMI AS NEW AIR FORCE CHIEF. (COMMENT: THIS FOLLOWS CRITICISM OF APPOINTMENT OF GEN AZARBAZIN WHO WAS CONSIDERED "NOT REVOLUTIONARY ENOUGH" BY LOWER-LEVEL AIR FORCE PERSONNEL. GOI BACKDOWN ON ORIGINAL APPOINTMENT SUGGESTS GOI'S WRIT IS NOT RPT NOT RUNNING TOO FAR IN ARMED FORCES AT MOMENT.
(S-ENTIRE TEXT)

PURSUANT ARRANGEMENTS PROPOSED BY DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER ENTEZAM, TWO REPRESENTATIVES OF HIS OFFICE CAME TO MY RESIDENCE MORNING FEBRUARY 27, ARMED WITH A LETTER FOR AUTHROITIES IN MASHAD AND KAPKAN. LETTER STATES THAT ENTEZAM ASKS SAFE CONDUCT FOR TWO AMERICANS CARRYING MONEY TO PAY OFF IRANIAN EMPLOYEES AT KAPKAN AND TO ARRANGE FOR RETURN OF AMERICAN EMPLOYEES THERE TO AMERICAN EMBASSY TEHRAN. 3.TWO AMERICANS MAKING TRIP ARE DAO COL. SCHAEFFER AND ASSISTANT AIRA CAPTAIN JOHNSON. THEY HAVE WITH THEM 30 MILLION RIALS IN CASH, ALTHOUGH WE UNDERSTAND TOTAL VALID OBLIGATION IS CLOSER TO 15 MILLION.

OUR MUJAHEDIN GUARDS AT RESIDENCE DETAILED ONE OF THEIR ENGLISH-SPEAKING MEMBERS TO ACCOMPANY GROUP, ARMED WITH FORMIDABLE ARRAY OF WEAPONS. THEY LEFT EMBASSY COMPOUND AT 0830 FOR MEHRABAD AIRPORT AND ARE PREPARED, IF NECESSARY, OVERNIGHT AT MASHAD OR KAPAN.
IF TRANSACTION GOES WELL, WE MAY EXPECT KAPKAN GROUP TO RETURN TEHRAN EVENING FEBRUARY 27. IF WEATHER OR OTHER DELAYS OCCUR, THIS COULD GO ON ANOTHER DAY OR
(S-ENTIRE TEXT)

OPERATION DESIGNED EVACUATE OUR KAPKAN GROUP HAS HIT SNAG AT MEHRABAD AIRPORT. ARRANGEMENTS FOR AIRCRAFT TO FLY TEHRAN TEAM TO KAPKAN WERE MADE WITH FORMER AIR FORCE CHIEF OF STAFF AZERBARZIN, WHO HAS SINCE BEEN REPLACED. AIR FORCE BASE COMMANDER AT MEHRABAD HAS, CONSEQUENTLY, REFUSED LET AIRCRAFT DEPART UNTIL HE HAS CLEARANCE FROM NEW AIR FORCE CHIEF OF STAFF.
TWO REPRESENTATIVES FROM PRIME MINISTER'S OFFICE ARE ATTEMPTING RESOLVE PROBLEM THROUGH ENTEZAM. IN MEANTIME, I HAVE ASKED COL SHAEFFER AND CAPT JOHNSON TO REMAIN AT AIRPORT PENDING CLEARANCE.
AT THIS RATE, IT SEEMS IMPROBABLE KAPKAN GROUP WILL ARRIVE TEHRAN TODAY.
(S - ENTIRE TEXT.)
PROBLEM AT MEHRABAD AIRPORT APPARENTLY RESOLVED. COL SCHAEFFER TELEPHONED TO ADVISE THT HE AND HIS PARTY EXPECT DEPART 1330 LOCAL VIA C-130 TO MASHAD, WHERE HE ASSUMES THEY WILL REMAIN OVERNIGHT.
IF NEGOTIATIONS PROCEED AS PLANNED, WE SHOULD HAVE KAPKAN GROUP IN EMBASSY DURING COURSE OF DAY FEBRUARY 28. SULLIVAN NOTE BY OC/T: NODIS CAPTION ADDED PER SSO-VALERGO.

OF THIS FIGURE, WE ARE ESTIMATING THAT APPROXIMATELY 2100 ARE AMERICAN CITIZEN WIVES AND CHILDREN OF IRANIAN NATIONALS AND AMERICAN CITIZEN CHILDREN BORN IN THE UNITED STATES OF IRANIAN PARENTAGE. WE HAVE HAD NUMEROUS CALLS FROM THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY INQUIRING ABOUT THE EVACUATION AND, IN RESPONSE TO OUR QUESTIONS, MANY WIVES DECLINED TO DEPART SINCE THEIR LIFE TIES ARE HERE.
