SUMMARY: NIOC HEAD ATTACKS CONSORTIUM AGREEMENTS AS "COLONIAL PACTS," SUGGESTS NIOC IS NOT INTERESTED IN NEW CONSORTIUM PACT BUT IN DIRECT SALES. BAKHTIAR OUT OF COUNTRY, PROBABLY IN FRANCE. EX-PLO SOLDIER TOUTED AS NEW HEAD OF "REVOLUTIONARY GUARDIAN CORPS," WHOCK WOULD SUPPLEMENT ARMY. MOWLAVI NAMED CENTRAL BANK HEAD. SIX EX-MINISTERS ARE STILL FUGITIVES AND BEING SOUGHT FOR TRIAL. KHOMEINI CALLS FOR COURT REFORM; KHOMEINI SEES FOREIGN DELEGATIONS. END SUMMARY.

PRESS MORNING FEB 27 HEADLINED NEW NIOC HEAD HASSAN NAZIH'S REMARKS TO OIL WORKERS IN ABADAN IN WHICH HE STATED IRAN'S NEW POLICY WILL BE BASED ENTIRELY ON NATIONAL INTEREST AND WOULD NOT ACCEPT "COLONIALLY IMPOSED" AGREEMENTS. PRESS COMMENT SUGGESTED NIOC WAS READY TO DROP IDEA OF AGREEMENT WITH CONSORTIUM AND GO TO DIRECT SALES. NAZIH ALSO SAID HE WOULD HAVE TO FIRE ABOUT 400 WHO HAD NO JOBS AND STATED NIOC HAD PAID $4.28 MILLION SALARY PER MONTH TO EMPRESS FARAH. HE REITERATED GOI'S INTENTION TO PRODUCE ABOUT THREE MILLION BARRELS PER DAY, WITH 2.4 MILLION GOING TO EXPORT.
PRESS STORIES DENY FORMER PRIME MINISTER BAKHTIAR IS IN FRANCE, BUT CLOSE FAMILY SOURCE CONFIDED TO EMBOFF FEB 27 THAT HE IS ALMOST CERTAINLY IN HIDING THERE (PROTECT THIS ITEM).

TEHRAN JOURNAL MORNING FEB 27 HEADLINED NEWS THAT IRANIAN WHO FOUGHT WITH PLO BATTALION AGAINST ISRAEL, JALALEDDIN FARSI, IS BEING TOUTED AS THE NEW HEAD OF THE PROPOSED REVOLUTIONARY GUARDIANS CORPS. ANOTHER MUJAHIDDIN LEADER, MEHDI TAQAVI, IN SPEECH AT TEACHER TRAINING COLLEGE, SAID ARMED FORCES COULD NOT BE TRUSTED. REITERATING A LEFTIST THEME OF PAST FEW DAYS, TAQAVI SAID ARMED FORCES WERE STILL IMPERIALISTIC AND CONSTITUTED A THREAT TO THE REVOLUTION. (PRESS ALSO GAVE FULL NAME AND CORRECT ENGLISH SPELLING OF NEW AIR FORCE HEAD, BRIG GENERAL ASGHAR IMAYAN, INCORRECTLY REPORTED YESTERDAY AS EMANI.)

GOI NAMED VETERAN ECONOMIST MAHAMMAD ALI MOWLAVI HEAD OF THE CENTRAL BANK FEB 26. MOWLAVI WAS A FORMER IRANIAN AMBASSADOR TO THE EUROPEAN ECONOMIC COMMUNITY, A FORMER UNDERSECRETARY OF COMMERCE, HAS BEEN A PROFESSOR OF ECONOMICS AT NATIONAL UNIVERSITY AND A WRITER ON ECONOMIC SUBJECTS FOR SEVERAL YEARS.

PRESS CARRIES ACCOUNTS OF CONTINUING SEARCH FOR 15 EX-OFFICIALS OF OLD REGIME WHO HAVE ESCAPED INCARCERATION. THEY INCLUDE SIX FORMER MINISTERS: MANUCHEHR TASLIMI, FEREIDOUN MAHDAVI, ABDOL AZIM VALIAN, REZA SADAQUIANI, HOUSHANG NAHAVANDI, AND ABDOL MAJID MAJIDI. WELL-KNOWN BUSINESSMEN HOJABR YAZDANI, RAHIM ALI KHORRAM, AND ALI REZA'I ARE ALSO ON THE LAM. ALSO AT LARGE AFTER FEB 10 PRISON RELEASE ARE FORMER HEALTH MINISTER UNDERSECRETARIES NEQABAT AND NILI ARAM, WHO AMCIT WIFE HELEN LEFT COUNTRY FOR U.S. IN JANUARY.

IN TALK WITH MINISTER OF JUSTICE MOBASHERI, AYATOOOAH KHOMEINI SAID EUROPEAN-STYLE SYSTEM OF COURTS MUST GO, AND ISLAMIC CANONS MUST RULE. HE PARTICULARLY CRITICIZED MULTIPLE HEARING PROCEDURES, NOTING THAT "EVERY HEARING MUST END IN A FINAL, ABSOLUTE DECISION IN A SINGLE PHASE." GOI HAS ALSO ANNOUNCED THAT FAMILY PROTECTION ACT HAS BEEN ABOLISHED ON KHOMEINI'S ORDERS. THIS LAW PROVIDED PROTECTION FOR WOMEN IN DIVORCE AND SEPARATION SITUATIONS. IT WAS DISCARDED AS "UNISLAMIC."

AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI HAS SEEN POLASARIO DELEGATION AND PLEDGED SUPPORT FOR ITS STRUGGLE FOR INDEPENDENCE IN THE WESTERN SAHARA. RUMORS CONTINUE TO ABOUND THAT LIBYA'S QADDAFI WILL VISIT TEHRAN, BUT FOREIGN MINISTRY SOURCE FEB 26 DENIED THAT INVITATION HAD BEEN EXTENDED OR DATE FOR VISIT HAS BEEN SET.
C - ENTIRE TEXT.

THE BROADSPREAD SENSE OF UNITY IN OPPOSITION TO THE PAHLAVI REGIME TENDED TO MASK THE REALITY OF THE IRANIAN POLICY. WITH THE COLLAPSE OF THE PAHLAVI SYSTEM, THAT REALITY-A PRONOUNCED PROCLIVITY FOR POLITICAL FRACTIONALIZATION-HAS RAPIDLY REASSERTED ITSELF. THIS FRACTIONALIZATION IS NOT SIMPLY VERTICAL, I.E., AN IDEOLOGICAL DIVISION BETWEEN THE MARXIST LEFT AND THE ISLAMIC RIGHT, BUT, RATHER, MULTIDIRECTIONAL.

THIS ACCOUNTS BOTH FOR ODD ALLIANCES SUCH AS THAT BETWEEN SOME MEMBERS OF THE ISLAMIC MOJAHEDIN-E-KHALQ AND THE MARXIST FEDAYIN-E-KHALQ ON THE ISSUE OF THE DISSOLUTION OF THE REGULAR ARMED SERVICES AND THEIR REPLACEMENT BY A "PEOPLE'S ARMY" AND THE APPARENT ANOMALY OF THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMEN'S SLOW PROGRESS IN ASSERTING ITS AUTHORITY IN THE WAKE OF THE REVOLUTION'S LIGHTNING VICTORY OVER THE OLD REGIME.
THE TYPES OF DIVISIONS WHICH HAVE EMERGED IN THE LAST TWO WEEKS INCLUDE THE FOLLOWING

IDEOLOGICAL, WITH THE MOST SIGNIFICANT GROUPS BEING SECULAR MARXISTS AND PROPONENTS OF A GOVERNMENT BASED ON FUNDEMENTALIST INTERPRETATION OF ISLAMIC TENETS. HOWEVER, IMMEDIATELY PRIOR TO THE FALL OF THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT, NON-MARXIST BUT CLEARLY SECULARIST, MODERNIST POLITICAL SENTIMENT WAS BEGINNING TO COALESCE INTO A SIGNIFICANT POLITICAL FORCE.

THE SUDDEN AND ALMOST UNIVERSALLY UNEXPECTED COLLAPSE OF THE FORMER REGIME THREW THE ELEMENTS WHICH COMPOSED THIS POLITICAL MIDDLE GROUND INTO TOTAL DISARRAY. "MAJORITY" HAS LITTLE MEANING IN THE CURRENT ATMOSPHERE OF FLUIDITY WHERE THE VERY UNCERTAINTY OF THE POLITICAL FUTURE CAN RESULT IN RAPID SHIFTS OF ALLEGIANCE, BUT THE TERM HAS AT LEAST POTENTIAL SIGNIFICANCE FOR THOSE IRANIANS (FOR THE MOMENT LARGELY SILENT) WHO HAVE SERIOUS RESERVATIONS ABOUT EXTREMISM OF EITHER THE RIGHT OR LEFT.

CHRONOLOGICAL, RANGING FROM THE DIFFERENCES IN OUTLOOK BETWEEN KHOMEINI AND BAZARGAN IN THEIR SEVENTIES AND THE TEEN-AGED GUERRILLA FIGHTERS. UNDER THE BEST OF CIRCUMSTANCES, IT IS DIFFICULT FOR THE GENERATIONS TO COMMUNICATE WITH ONE ANOTHER. IN THIS INSTANCE, THERE ARE SIGNS OF GROWING RESENTMENT AMONG THE YOUTHFUL STREET FIGHTERS THAT OLDER MEMBERS OF THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT TEND TO LOOK IN THE FIRST INSTANCE TO INDIVIDUALS IN THE ARMED FORCES AND THE CIVILIAN BUREAUCRACY OF THE FORMER REGIME FOR THE TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE REQUIRED IN PUTTING IRAN BACK ON ITS FEET.

THEY VIEW THEMSELVES AS THE ONES WHO MADE THE REVOLUTION A SUCCESS, WHO WERE PREPARED TO GIVE UP THEIR LIVES FOR THE MOVEMENT, AND, AS A CONSEQUENCE, THEY WANT A GREATER VOICE IN CONSOLIDATING THE REVOLUTION'S GAINS THAN THEY BELIEVE THEY ARE BEING GIVEN. AS FOR THE MEMBERS OF THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT IN THEIR THIRTIES AND FORTIES WHO HAVE BEEN CHARGED WITH PUTTING THE BUREAUCRACY BACK TO WORK, RESTORING LAW AND ORDER, AND REVITALIZING THE ECONOMY, IT IS OFTEN DIFFICULT FOR THEM NOTTO BE CONTEMPTUOUS OF THE NAIVETE AND INDISCIPLINE OF THE YOUNG IRREGULARS AND IMPATIENT WITH THE DOGMATISM AND INFLEXIBILITY OF THE SENIOR LEADERSHIP.

SOCIOLOGICAL, EITHER ON THE BASIS OF MODERNIST VERSUS TRADIONALIST SENTIMENTS OR ECONOMIC CLASS. THE EMBASSY, SINCE THE FEBRUARY 14 ATTACK, HAS HAD AN OPPORTUNITY TO VIEW IN MICROCOSM DIVISIONS OF THIS SORT IN OPERATION WITHOUT EVEN HAVING TO LEAVE THE COMPOUND. THE LATTER IS CURRENTLY PROTECTED BY A MIXED FORCE OF MOJAHEDIN AND AIR FORCE NONCOMMISSIONED PERSONNEL TERMED HOMOFARS IN FARSI. THE FORMER GROUP IS COMPOSED OF TWO FACTIONS, ONE DRAWN PRIMARILY FROM BAZAAR BACKGROUNDS AND THE OTHER FOR THE MOST PART FROM THE MODERNIST MIDDLE CLASS.

THE LATER, WHOSE MEMBERS ARE OVERWHELMINGLY FROM LOWER CLASS BACKGROUNDS BUT POSSESS BY IRANIAN STANDARDS A HIGH LEVEL OF TECHNICAL TRAINING (OFTEN RECEIVED IN THE U.S.), WAS RECRUITED BY THE BAZAARI FACTION OF THE MOJAHEDIN TO PROVIDE ADDITIONAL SECURITY FOR THE COMPOUND. THE RIVALRIES AMONG THESE THREE ELEMENTS HAVE BECOME INTENSE IN THE SPACE OF LESS THAN TWO WEEKS.

THE MIDDLE CLASS MOJAHEDIN VIEW THE GROSS MATERIALISM OF THE BAZAARI MOJAHEDIN AND THE HOMOFARS AS REPRESENTED BY THEIR PROCLIVITY FOR THEIVERY AS A BETRAYAL OF THE REVOLUTION'S PRINCIPLES, WHILE THE HOMOFARS ARE CONTEMPTUOUS OF BOTH MOJAHEDIN FACTIONS, THEIR CONTEMPT APPARENTLY DIRECTLY RELATED TO THEIR POSSESSION OF MODERN SKILLS INCLUDING AN ABILITY TO SPEAK ENGLISH. ------------------065048 271457Z /43 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 0113 SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 2583

ETHNIC, MOST IMMEDIATELY EVIDENT IN THE DEMANDS FOR AUTONOMY EMANATING FROM KURDESTAN. THERE ARE A VARIETY OF DISTINCT GROUPS, WHETHER BASED ON LINGUISTIC DIFFERENCES (THE TURKI SPEAKERS OF AZARBAIJAN AND THE ARABIC SPEAKERS OF KHUZESTAN) AND/OR CONFESSIONAL DIFFERENCES (THE SUNNI KURDS AND BALUCHIS), WHICH HAVE TRADITIONALLY VIEWED THEMSELVES AS APART FROM MAINSTREAM PERSIAN CULTURE, AND DURING PERIODS OF WEAKNESS AT THE CENTER HAVE SOUGHT TO ASSERT VARYING DEGREES OF INDEPENDENCE FROM IT. THE RELATIVE IMPOTENCE OF THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT IN AREAS SUCH AS KURDESTAN HAS CREATED OPPORTUNITIES FOR PARTICULARIST SENTIMENTS TO SURFACE ONCE AGAIN.
SO LONG AS THE WRIT OF THE CENTRAL GOVERNMENT REMAINS AS INEFFECTUAL AS IT PRESENTLY IS, THE PHENOMENON IS LIKELY TO GROW IN INTENSITY.

ADMINISTRATIVE, AS CHARACTERIZED BY THE DUA SYSTEM OF THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT AND THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES. WHILE AN EMBASSY SOURCE SAID ON FEBRUARY 26 THAT PROGRESS WAS BEING MADE IN DISBANDING THE LATTER AND TURNING ALL ADMINISTRATIVE FUNCTIONS OVER TO THE FORMER, THE SAME SOURCE INDICATED THAT SOME PERSONNEL FROM THE COMMITTEES ARE BEING INTEGRATED WITH THE STAFFS MANNING GOVERNMENT OFFICES. RATHER THAN ELIMINATING A SOURCE OF FRACTIONALIZATION, THIS MOVE MAY SIMPLY EXACERBATE THE RIVALRIES BETWEEN MEMBERS OF THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT, PARTICULARLY THOSE WHO ALSO WLRKED FOR PREVIOUS GOVERNMENTS BUT WHO HAVE NOW JOINED THE REVOLUTION, AND THOSE WHO HAVE SERVED ON THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES.
THESE RIVALRIES HAVE BEEN A MAJOR FACTOR IN THE ADMINISTRATIVE CONFUSION OF THE PAST TWO WEEKS.

THIS FRACTIONALIZATION POSES AN OBVIOUS DANGER TO THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT, BUT IT IS A PHENOMENON IT HAS ONLY MARGINAL ABILITY TO CONTROL. INDEED, THE VERY ACTIONS IT MUST TAKE TO CONSOLIDATE ITS AUTHORITY ARE APT INITIALLY TO WORSEN THE DIVISIONS NOW OPENING IN THE IRANIAN BODY POLITIC. THE MARXISTS, WHO HAVE BEEN EXCLUDED FOR THE MOST PART FROM POSITIONS IN THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT, STAND TO BENEFIT SUBSTANTIALLY FROM THE FISSIPAROUS PRESSURES NOW BECOMING MANIFEST. THEY STILL ENJOY THE LUXURY OF NOT BEING RESPONSIBLE FOR GOVERNING, AND THUS ARE FREE TO GIVE THEIR FULL SUPPORT TO A VARIETY OF SPECIAL INTEREST ISSUES AND DEMANDS THAT MAY WELL BE CONTRADICTORY.
THEY CAN, IN SUM, BE EXPECTED TO TAKE FULL ADVANTAGE OF THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT'S INABILITY TO PLEASE ALL OF THE PEOPLE ALL OF THE TIME.

SINCE WE WILL BE UNABLE GET KAPKAN CONTINGENT OUT OF COUNTRY UNTIL FRIDAY, MARCH 2 I CONSIDER IT HIGHLY IMPORTANT NO RPT NO STATEMENTS CONCERNING THEIR PRESENCE IN TEHRAN BE MADE FROM WASHINGTON UNTIL THEY ARE ACTUALLY AIRBORNE.

STATEMENT BY SENATOR GARY HART WILL FOCUS ATTENTION ON KAPKAN AND ITS CREW. WASHINGTON SPOKESMEN SHOULD USE UTMOST DISCRETION IN REPLYING TO INQUIRIES ABOUT HART STATEMENT UNTIL ALL U.S. PERSONNEL HAVE SAFELY DEPARTED.

segments.text: MEAF DIRECTOR GENERAL KHALEGHIRAD FULLY CONFIRMS AUTHENTICITY OF BANK MARKAZI TELEX SIGNED BY MIN ECON AFFAIRS AND FINANCE AL ARDALAN. KHALEGHIRAD ALSO ASSURES US THAT MOWLAVI HAS INDEED TAKEN OVER AS GOVERNOROF BANK MARKAZI.
MEAF TELLS US WRITTEN CONFIRMATION OF VALIDITY OF BANK MARKAZI TELEX TO NY FED, IN FORM OF LETTER FROM MINISTER ARDALAN TO AMBASSADOR, HAS BEEN SIGNED AND IS NOW ON ITS WAY TO EMBASSY.

COMMENT: WHILE WE CANNOT SAY WITH FULL CONFIDENCE THAT PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT HAS ESTABLISHED FULL AND PERFECT CONTROL IN ANY PART OF THIS SOCIETY, EMBASSY CONSIDERS BANK MARKAZI TELEX A FULLY OFFICIAL ACT OF THE PROVISIONAL REVOLUTIONARY GOVERNMENT OF IRAN AND RECOMMENDS THAT NY FED PROCEED BASIS OF INSTRUCTIONS IN THAT TELEX. SULLIVAN NOTE BY OC/T: NOT PASSED NYFRB.
(C-ENTIRE TEXT.)

SUMMARY: NIOC HEAD ANNOUNCES OIL EXPORTS TO RESUME MARCH 5, WITH ESTIMATED INCREASE OF PRICE. KHOMEINI MEETS WITH AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI, AND LATTER NOW BEING TOUTED TO BECOME TEHRAN'S "VOICE FOR THE REVOLUTION" AFTER KHOMEINI'S PROPOSED DEPARTURE FOR QOM ON MARCH 1. NEW TEHRAN MAYOR NAMED. NIRT HEAD QOTBZADEH UNDER INCREASING PUBLIC AND STAFF PRESSURE. ARREST AND EXECUTIONS CONTINUE. END SUMMARY.

PRESS MORNING OF FEB 28 HEADLINED NIOC HEAD NAZIH'S CLAIMS IN SPEECH TO OIL WORKERS AT AHWAZ THAT EXPORTS WILL RESUME ON 5 MARCH, THE 12TH ANNIVERSARY OF DR. MOSSADEQ'S DEATH. NAZIH CLAIMED THE PRICE OF THE OIL,TO BE AUCTIONED DIRECTLY USING A SYSTEM OF SPOT SELLING, COULD BE SOLD AT AN AVERAGE OF $18 TO $20 A BARREL. NAZIH REAFFIRMED THAT EXISTING CONSORTIUM AGREEMENTS WERE UNDER REVIEW, AND CLAIMED THAT THE EXISTING DISCOUNT SYSTEM WOULD NO LONGER APPLY. THE NIOC HEAD SAID THAT NO RPT NO OIL WOULD BE BARTERED FOR WEAPONS PURCHASES, AND THAT EXCEPT FOR AGRICULTURE BARTER, OIL SALES WILL BE ON A CASH BASIS.

KAYHAN HAD A FRONT PAGE STORY ON MONDAY'S MEETING BETWEEN KHOMEINI AND TEHRAN-BASED AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI, COMMENTING THAT TALEGHANI SEEMS CERTAIN TO BE "VOICE FOR THE REVOLUTION" AFTER KHOMEINI'S PROPOSED DEPARTURE FOR QOM ON MARCH 1. PRIVATE TALKS BETWEEN THE TWO AYATOLLAHS LASTED 2 1/2 HOURS, BUT NO STATEMENT OF CONTENT HAS BEEN MADE. ACCORDING TO THE PRESS, SPECULATION THAT THE TWO HAVE DIFFERENCES WERE DENIED BY SOURCES CLOSE TO KHOMEINI.

PRESS ALSO REPORTS THT THE NIRT STAFF HAS DEMANDED THE RESIGNATION OF NEWLY APPOINTED HEAD SADEGH QOTBZADEH. EMPLOYEES OF NIRT CLAIM THE NEW HEAD HAS INSTITUTED "DICTATORIAL PRACTICES." INCREASING COMPLAINTS ARE BEING MADE BY THE PUBLIC CONCERNING THE EMPHASIS ON PALESTINIAN EVENTS, REVOLUTIONARY (AND REPETITIVE) MUSIC AND SLIDES, AND THE TOTAL LACK OF BASIC ENTERTAINMENT ON TV.
TEHRAN JOURNAL ANNOUNCED THAT MOHAMMAD TAVAKOLI HAS BEEN APPOINTED MAYOR OF TEHRAN. PREVIOUSLY A MEMBER OF THE MUNICIPAL TECHNICAL COMMITTEE, TAVAKOLI ASSUMED HIS DUTIES ON 27 FEB.

BILLED AS THE 11TH EXECUTION OF A FORMER GOVT OFFICIAL SINCE THE REVOLUTION, THE KHONSAR (ISFAHAN AREA) GENDARMERIE COMMANDER FACED A FIRING SQUAD ON 27 FEB. THE TEHRAN JOURNAL CLAIMS THAT ACCORDING TO UNOFFICIAL COUNT, ABOUT 3,000 FORMER OFFICIALS AND BUSINESSMEN ARE STILL BEING HELD PENDING INVESTIGATIONS. THE FORMER COMMANDER OF TTHE GENDARMERIE IN SISTAN AND BALUCHISTAN PROVINCE WAS REPORTED TO HAVE BEEN ARRESTED.
TEHRAN JOURNAL REPORTED THAT KADDAFI VISIT TO IRAN HAS BEEN POSTPONED.

1979TEHRAN02601.subject: STATUS OF SHAHRYAR ROUHANI DURING CALL BY MINISTER-COUNSELOR ON FEB 28 ON GOODARZNIA, HEAD OF 4TH DEPARTMENT, MINISTRY OF

segments.text: DURING CALL BY MINISTER-COUNSELOR ON FEB 28 ON GOODARZNIA, HEAD OF 4TH DEPARTMENT, MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS, THE MINISTER-COUNSELOR ASKED FOR A CLARIFICATION OF THE STATUS OF SHAHRYAR ROUHANI, WHO CLAIMED TO BE THE REPRESENTATIVE OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI IN THE UNITED STATES. GOODARZNIA CLEARLY HAD NEVER HEARD OF ROUHANI BUT SAID HE WOULD INQUIRE AND INFORM US LATER.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)

DURING CALL BY MINISTER-COUNSELOR ON GOODARZNIA, DIRECTOR 4TH DEPARTMENT, MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS, ON FEB 28, THE LATTER RAISED THE QUESTION OF THE TREATMENT OF IRANIANS IN THE U.S. APPARENTLY A SENIOR OFFICIAL IN MFA HAD BEEN INFORMED THAT IRANIANS HAVE BEEN THE VICTIMS OF ILLEGAL SEARCHES AND IMPOSITION OF EXCESSIVE BAIL IN LOS ANGELES, SAN ANTONIO AND NEW JERSEY.

THE MINISTER-COUNSELOR ASSURED GOODARZNIA THAT IRANIANS WHO WERE IN LEGAL STATUS IN THE U.S. AND WHO WERE NOT CHARGED WITH CRIMES, HAD NOTHING TO WORRY ABOUT. HOWEVER, THOSE PERSONS WHOSE STATUS WAS NOT LEGAL OR HAD ENGAGED IN CRIMES MIGHT VERY WELL BE DEPORTED. MINISTER-CONSELOR ALSO NOTED THAT THE USG WOULD NOT COUNTENANCE A PUNITIVE POLICY AGAINST IRANIANS BUT THAT THE EVENTS OF A FEW WEEKS AGO IN IRAN AGAINST AMERICANS MIGHT INDUCE LOCAL AUTHORITIES TO CARRY OUT THEIR RESPONSIBILITIES IN A MORE VIGOROUS MANNER.
COMMENT: WE ASSUME THAT DEPARTMENT WILL IMPRESS UPON INS AND OTHER AUTHORITIES THE DESIRABILITY OF NOT CARRYING OUT A VENDETTA AGAINST IRANIANS WHO ARE LEGALLY IN THE UNITED STATES.

1979TEHRAN02606.subject: VIEWS ON POLITICAL SITUATION: THE HOMOFARS

segments.text: (C-ENTIRE TEXT)

TOWARDS THE LATTER DAYS OF THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION, THE AIR FORCE, AND IN PARTICULAR THE "HOMOFAR" SEGMENT, EMERGED AS A COMPARATIVELY DISCIPLINED POWER UNIT AND HAS STOOD OUT SHARPLY IN CONTRAST TO THE OTHER TRADITIONAL, BUT NOW SEVERLY DISILLUSIONED AND UNDISCIPLINED SERVICES. THE IRANIAN AIR FORCE HAS UNDERTAKEN MANY NORMALLY POLICE-TYPE ACTIVITIES, INCLUDING, AMONG OTHERS PARTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES FOR GUARDING THE EMBASSY AND TABRIZ CONSULATE COMPOUNDS. DESPITE CONTINUING CHANGES AT THE TOP LEVELS OF THE AIR FORCE HIERARCHY, THE MIDDLE AND LOWER RANKS SEEM TO HAVE RETAINED A FAIR AMOUNT OF COHESION. PARTICULARLY NOTEWORTHY IS THE ROLE THE AIR FORCE HOMOFARS NOW PLAY.
EMBOFF HAS HAD OPPORTUNITY DURING PAST WEEK TO HAVE SEVERAL LONG CONVERSATIONS WITH VARIOUS HOMOFAR GROUPS AND THE FOLLOWING VIEWS HAVE BEEN EXPRESSED.

RE AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI: EVEN THE MOST RELIGIOUS OF THE HOMOFARS, INCLUDING SOME WHO HAVE BEEN COLLECTING HIS TAPES AND LETTERS FOR MANY YEARS IN SECRET, CLAIM THAT THEY WILL FOLLOW KHOMEINI'S LEAD ONLY INSOFAR AS THEY PERCEIVE HIS PRONOUNCENTS TO BE BENEFICIAL TO IRAN AS AN INDEPENDENT COUNTRY. THERE SEEMS TO BE NO CONCEPT WHATSOEVER OF KHOMEINI AS INFALLIBLE, AND INDEED, FREE DISCUSSION WAS HELD AS TO ALTERNATIVES TO KHOMEINI.

IN ONE LONG CONVERSATION WITH SEVERAL TEHRAN-BASED HOMOFARS, THE COMMENT WAS MADE BY THE GROUP'S SPOKESMAN THAT WITHIN THE NEXT YEAR OR TWO WHEN CONDITIONS SETTLED DOWN, THE TYPE OF GOVERNMENT WHICH SEEMED BEST FOR IRAN RANGING FROM COMMUNISM THROUGH DEMOCRACY TO EVEN A RETURN OF THE MONARCHY, BE SUPPORTED BY THE HOMOFARS. THEIR PRESENT SUPPORT OF THE KHOMEINI-DESIGNATED GOVERNMENT IS A TEMPORARY ONE, BASED ON THEIR PERCEPTION OF THE COUNTRY'S FIRST STEP TOWARDS PROGRESS BEING TO GET RID OF THE SHAH.

RE AMERICA: LIKE MANY IRANIANS, THE HOMOFARS REGARD PRESIDENT CARTER AS THE MAJOR SCAPEGOAT FOR ALL THE TROUBLE IN IRAN DURING THIS PAST YEAR, BUT REASSERTED THEIR INTEREST IN AND REGARD FOR AMERICANS AS SUCH. WHETHER OR NOT THEY CARE TO ADMIT IT, THEIR CONTACT WITH THE USA THROUGH TRAINING COURSES BOTH IN IRAN AND IN AMERICA HAS MOST DEFINITELY HAD A SERIOUS EFFECT ON THEIR VALUE SYSTEM AND OUTLOOK. DESPITE THEIR SEEMING CONTEMPT FOR THE U.S. AIR FORCE TEAM HOUSE SYSTEM THEY OBSERVED ON THEIR OWN BASES IN IRAN, AND THEIR PROFESSED BITTERNESS OVER THE ACTUAL COST TO IRAN VIS-A-VIS THE RETURN, THE HOMOFAR/AIR FORCE GROUPS SAID THAT U.S.

MILITARY ADVISERS SHOULD PROBABLY RETURN TO IRAN, ALBEIT UNDER A FAR MORE LIMITED AND IRANIAN-CONTROLLED PROGRAM. THEIR VIEW OF THE US VIS-A-VIS IRAN, AND IN PARTICULAR, THEIR PRECEIVED NEED FOR CONTINUING TECHNICAL AND BUSINESS COOPERATION, SEEMS TO BE WELL THOUGH OUT. THEIR INTEREST IN AND PERSONAL TIES TO THE US (IE, EDUCATION, FAMILY AND FRIENDS PRESENTLY IN THE US, ETC.) ARE OBVIOUS, AND SOMEWHAT ENCOURAGING FOR THE FUTURE IF THE HOMOFAR GROUP ITSELF CONTINUES TO EXIST AS AN ENTITY IN THE NEW IRANIAN MILITARY SYSTEM.

SUMMARY: AT A TIME WHEN THE TRADITIONAL IRANIAN SERVICE GROUPS (THE POLICE, GENDARMERIE, IMPERIAL GUARDS, AND THE ARMY AS SUCH) ARE TOTALLY DEMORALIZED AND DISUNIFIED, THE AIR FORCE IN GENERAL AND THE HOMOFAR GROUP IN PARTICULAR HAVE ACHIEVED AND IMPORTANCE WELL OUT OF PROPORTION TO THEIR PREVIOUS ROLE IN THE ARMED FORCES. THEIR PRESENT COHESION AND THE ROLE THEY NOW PLAY MAY WELL WORK AGAINST THEM IN THENOT-TOO-DISTANT FUTURE, HOWEVEVER, MANY IRANIANS, AND IN PARTICULAR THOSE WHO WERE PART OF THE OLD ARMY AND POLICE FORCES BELIEVE THE AIR FORCE AND THE HOMOFARS WERE A VERY PAMPERED GROUP UNDER THE PAHLAVI REGIME.

WHILE OTHER GROUPS WERE BEARING THE BRUNT OF THE VIOLENCE THROUGHOUT IRAN, THE AIR FORCE WAS ABLE TO SIT BACK AND NOT GET INVOLVED, AND ONLY TOWARDS THE VERY END DID THEY MAKE AN ACTUAL PUBLICIZED ENTRY INTO THE REVOLUTIONARY MOVEMENT ON THE KHOMEINI SIDE, LEADING MANY OF THE CIVILIANS WHO FOUGHT THROUGHOUT THE YEAR, AS WELL AS OTHER MILITARY GROUPS, TO REGARD THEM AS OPPORTUNISTS WHOSE LOYALTY IS INDEED
AT THIS TIME, EXPERIENCING KWM2A PROBLEMS. TCU TECH IS OVERWORKED REPAIRING TCU EQUIPMENT. HOWEVER, TCU TECH STATES HE WILL DO HIS BEST TO ASSIST US.

VHF RADIOS ARE STILL BEING CONFISCATED BY IRANIAN GUARDS. THE NET IS OPERATIONAL WITH ROUGHLY 30 HAND HELD UNITS BEING USED BY MARINE SECURITY GUARDS AND OTHER AMERICAN PERSONNEL. WE HAVE A FEW SPARES. THE VHF RADIO NET IS USED AROUND THE CLOCK AND IT IS ESSENTIAL THAT IT REMAIN OPERATIONAL TO PROVIDE ADEQUATE SECURITY FOR ALL RPT ALL REMAINING PERSONNEL.

STILL FEEL THE SITUATION IN TEHRAN WARRANTS HAVING A TECH ON BOARD. I'M DISAPPOINTED THAT THE RCO AND OC FEELS ADDITIONAL JUSTIFICATIONS REQUIRED TO WARRANT TECH SUPPORT. FOR EXAMPLE, BEFORE THE CRISIS SITUATION TEHRAN HAD A CEO-C AND CEO-R AND NOW THAT TEHRAN IS IN CRISIS SITUATION THE POST CAN'T JUSTIFY TECH SUPPORT. BELIEVE THAT UNDER THE PRESENT CONDITIONS ALL A CRO SHOULD BE REQUIRED TO DO IS REQUEST TECH SUPPORT AND RCO KARACHI OR DEPARTMENT SHOULD PROVIDE IT WITHOUT FURTHER JUSTIFICATION.
FOR DEPARTMENT: PLEASE SEE SY CHANNEL MESSAGES TEHRAN 2534, 2545, 2595, 2610 AND 2611. THIS MAY SHED SOME LIGHT ON OUR PRESENT SITUATION.
SEND KEYERS AND VHF RADIOS HELD IN FRANKFURT. OCR PARTS NOT REQUIRED BECAUSE 90 PERCENT OF TELEGRAMS ARE HAND WRITTEN.
HOPE WE DON'T HAVE TO CONTINUE HASSLING TO OBTAIN CEO-R SUPPORT. BELIEVE TEHRAN SITUATION SHOULD OVERRIDE OTHER REQUIREMENTS IN AREA. RECOMMEND RCO VISIT POST SOONEST

THERE FOLLOWS THE TEXT OF SHIRAZ'S A-5 OF FEBRUARY 8, 1979, DRAFTED BY PRINCIPAL OFFICER TOMSETH WHICH WAS NEVER POUCHED DUE TO THE RECENT EVENTS IN IRAN

BEGIN TEXT INTRODUCTION THE UNITED STATES, OR ANY OTHER COUNTRY FOR THAT MATTER, ALWAYS STANDS IN DANGER OF LETTING ITS POLICY ASPIRATIONS CLOUD ITS PERCEPTION OF REALITY. THT WOULD APPEAR TO BE WHAT WE ALLOWED TO HAPPEN IN THE CASE OF IRAN. WE WANTED THIS COUNTRY TO BE STRONG AND STABLE, WE SAW IN THE SHAH SOMEONE WHO SEEMED TO POSSESS THE VISION AND DETERMINATION TO ACHIEVE THOSE GOALS, AND, OVER TIME, WE CAME TO BELIEVE THAT HE WAS SUCCEEDING. WE DID SO LESS BECAUSE OF THE EMPIRICAL EVIDENCE TO SUPPORT SUCH A CONCLUSION THAT BECAUSE WE WANTED TO BELIEVE IT.

PROOF THAT IRAN WAS IN REALITY NOT WHAT WE WISHED IT TO BE WAS NEVER HARD TO FIND, BUT WE DOGGEDLY PERSISTED IN IGNORING IT. SEVERAL MONTHS AFTER MY ARRIVAL IN SHIRAZ I RECORDED MY "INITIAL IMPRESSIONS OF IRAN" (REFAIR) WHICH WERE GENERALLY PESSIMISTIC ABOUT IRAN'S PROSPECTS. SHORTLY THEREAFTER, I HAD A DISCUSSION OF THESE IMPRESSIONS WITH ONE MISSION OFFICER WHO HAD DEALT WITH IRAN ON AND OFF FOR A NUMBER OF YEARS.

WHERE I SAW ILLITERACY STILL AT MORE THAN 50 PERCENT, HE SAW IT CONSIDERABLY REDUCED FROM THE 90 PERCENT OF TWO DECADES EARLIER: WHERE I WAS TROUBLED BY THE HOLLOWNESS OF OFFICIAL RHETORIC ABOUT GOVERNMENT DECENTRALIZATION, HE WAS CHEERED BY THE INCREASED NUMBER OF CAPABLE BUREAUCRATS SERVING IN THE PROVINCES; WHERE I SAW AN ECONOMY WITH THE VALUE OF IMPORTS EXCEEDING THE VALUE OF EXPORTS (ASIDE FROM OIL) BY MORE THAN 20 TIMES, HE WAS ENCOURAGED BY THE RECORD GROWTH OF IRANIAN GROSS NATIONAL PRODUCT AND PER CAPITA INCOME; WHERE I WORRIED ABOUT THE IMPLICATIONS OF A GOVERNMENT SO DEPENDENT ON A SINGLE INDIVIDUAL AND THE ARTIFICIALITY AND FRAGILITY OF THE SINGLE OFFICIAL POLITICAL PARTY, HE WAS CONFIDENT THAT THE SHAH'S EFFORTS TO DEVELOP GRADUALLY POLITICAL AND BUREAUCRATIC INSTITUTIONS AND THE EDUCATION HE WAS PROVIDING THE CROWN PRINCE WOULD PAVE THE WAY FOR A RELATIVELY SMOOTH TRANSITION OF POWER AT A SUFFICIENTLY FAR-REMOVED FUTURE DATEE IN THE END, HE SUGGESTED THAT WE WERE NOT SO MUCH IN DISAGREEMENT ABOUT THE ACTUAL STATE OF IRANIAN AFFAIRS THAN WE WERE AS TO WHETHER THE IRANIAN GLASS WAS HALF FULL OF HALF EMPTY.

THAT MAY HAVE BEEN TRUE, BUT THE IMPORTANT POINT WAS NOT WHERE HE AND I WERE STARTING FROM BUT RATHER THAT IRAN DID NOT YET POSSESS ALL THE ATTRIBUTES NEEDED TO CONFORM TO THE PREMISES ABOUT IRAN UPON WHICH OUR POLICY OBJECTIVES WERE BUILT. UNDER THE CIRCUMSTANCES, WHAT HAD BEEN ACCOMPLISHED WAS FAR LESS RELEVANT THAN WHAT REMAINED TO BE ACCOMPLISHED. HAD WE BEEN ABLE TO FOCUS MORE ATTENTION ON CONTINUING IRANIAN DEFICIENCIES THAN WE IN FACT DID, THE SUBSEQUENT COLLAPSE OF THE PAHLAVI POLITICAL SYSTEM MIGHT HAVE COME AS LESS OF A SHOCK TO US. THAT, HOWEVER, IS SPILT MILK.

TODAY, WE ARE CONFRONTED WITH A NEW POLITICAL REALITY IN IRAN, A REALITY WHICH IS DISTURBING BOTH BECAUSE IT IS CONSIDERABLY MORE COMPLEX THAN WHAT WE USED TO THINK OF AS POLITICAL REALITY HERE AND BECAUSE THE COURSE OF FUTURE DEVELOPMENTS SEEMS UNCERTAIN. ACCORDINGLY, THE IMPRESSIONS I RECORD AS I LEAVE SHIRAZ ARE KEYED TO THOSE AREAS WHICH I SEE AS IMPINGING ON THE COURSE OF THESE DEVELOPMENS AND HOW OUR INTERESTS IN IRAN ARE LIKELY TO BE AFFECTED THEREBY.

THE PULL OF TRADITION AND THE LURE OF MODERNIZATION THE EVENTS OF THE LAST YEAR HAVE PALPABLY DEMONISTRATED THE POWER OF TRADITIONAL VALUES AND THE APPEAL OF ISLAM IN IRAN THE REACTION AGAINST THE INROADS OF MODERNIZATION IN IRANIAN SOCIETY HAS EXHIBITED AN INTENSITY THAT WOULD HAVE BEEN DIFFICULT TO IMAGINE ONLY A RELATIVELY SHORT TIME AGO IN VIEW OF WHAT WAS PERCEIVED AS FIRM COMMITMENT TO MODERNIZATION AMONG THE SO-CALLED KEY ELEMENTS OF THE POPULATION.

IT WAS PERHAPS CONCEDED THAT RELIGION STILL EXECISED A HOLD ON THE RURAL PEASANTRY, THE URBAN PROLETARIAT, AND THE BAZAAR MERCHANTS, BUT THE INFLUENCE OF THESE GROUPS, AONG WITH THAT OF THE ISLAMIC CLEARGY ITSELF, WAS GENERALLY DISCOUNTED; THE WESTERN-EDUCATED ELITES IN THE VANGUARD OF THE DRIVE FOR MODERNIZATION SEEMED THOROUGHLY SECULARIZED. THUS, IT HAS COME AS A CONSIDERABLE SURPRISE THAT SUBSTANTIAL NUMBERS OF THE IRANIAN YOUNG AND EVEN THE WESTERN-EDUCATED, IN ADDITION TO THOSE ELEMENTS OF IRANIAN SOCIETY MORE OBVIOUSLY TRADITIONALIST IN OUTLOOK, HAVE TURNED TO RELIGION FOR SOMETHING THEY CLEARLY FOUND MISSING IN THE ETHOS OF THE MODERN STAFF THE SHAH WAS ATTEMPTING TO CREATE.

THE EXPLANATION FOR THIS APPEARS TO LIE IN THE SHALLOWNESS OF SECULAR CULTURE IN IRAN, EVEN AMONG THE SEEMINGLY MODERNIZED ELITES, AND THE UTOPIAN PROMISE THAT A RETURN TO THE RELIGION OF THE PROPHET AND THE IMAMS WILL GIVE IRANIANS EVERYTHING THE SHAH OFFERED--PROSPERITY, POWER, THE MATERIAL ADVANTAGES OF THE MODERN WORLD--PLUS A SENSE OF IDENTITY AND CULTURAL CONTINUITY WHICH THE SHAH'S COMMITMENT TO SECULARIZED MODERNIZATION SEEMED TO EXCLUDE.

ACDA-12 ( ISO ) W ------------------092028 091716Z /44 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 0205 SECTION 2 OF 4 TEHRAN 2615 THE ISLAMIC CLERGY VIEWED THAT COMMITMENT AS AN ATTEMPT TO DRIVE A WEDGE BETWEEN GOD AND THE COMMUNITY OF BELIEVERS; THE IRANIAN MAN (AND WOMAN) IN THE STREET SIMPLY FOUND IT PSYCHOLOGICALLY UNACCEPTABLE. CLERICS, BAZAAR MERCHANTS, STUDENTS, EVEN THE MOST HIGHLY EDUCATED IRANIANS, STOUTLY MAINTAIN THAT AN IRANIAN ISLAMIC STATE WILL BE ABLE TO BORROW SELECTIVELY FROM THE MODERN, INDUSTRIALIZED WORLD, I.E., THAT IT WILL BE POSSIBLE TO HAVE MATERIAL PROGRESS ON IRANIAN TERMS WITHOUT THE MORAL AND SPIRITUAL DECAY THEY VIEW AS HAVING CHARACTERIZED THE PAHLAVI REGIME.

THE DILEMMA FOR IRAN, HOWEVER, IS THAT WHILE THE THEOLOGIANS AND THEORETICIANS OF THE ISLAMIC STATE CAN ENVISION NO HUMAN ACTIVITY AS OUTSIDE THE PALE OF RELIGION, THERE IS NO PRECEDENT FOR A SOCIETY SUCCESSFULLY MODERNIZING WITHOUT CONSIDERABLE CON-COMITANT SECULARIZATION. IN OTHER WORDS, IT APPEARS HIGHLY IMPROBABLE THAT IRANIANS WILL BE ABLE TO HAVE THEIR ISLAMIC CAKE AND EAT IT TOO. AND, DESPITE THE CURRENT RIVIVALIST MOOD, THE ATTRACTION OF MODERNIZATION IS BOUND TO CONTINUE TO EXERCISE CONSIDERABLE PULL ON IRANIANS, EVEN THOSE DEEPLY COMMITTED TO THE IDEALS OF ISLAM.

THE FREQUENCY OF SEVERE CULTURAL SCHIZOPHRENIA, ALREADY A PROMINENT FEATURE OF IRANIAN SOCIETY AND UNDOUBTEDLY DIRECTLY RELATED TO THE VIRULENCE OF THE XENOPHOBIC OUTBURSTS OF RECENT MONTHS, WILL ALMOST CERTAIN INCREASE AS IRANIANS ARE TORN BETWEEN THE PRECEPTS OF RELIGION AND THE EXIGENCIES OF THE MODERN WORLD. MOREOVER, THERE ARE IRANIANS WHO ARE QUITE PREPARED, EVEN ANXIOUS TO SUBLIMINATE ISLAM FOR THE SAKE OF MODERNIZATION. WHILE THIS GROUP HAS RECENTLY BEEN THROWN INTO CONSIDERABLE DISARRAY AND MANY MEMBERS HAVE ACTUALLY FLED IRAN, THE EXISTENCE OF A HARDCORE OF DEDICATED MODERNIZERS WOULD APPEAR TO MAKE AN ULTIMATE CONFRONTATION WITH THE RELIGIOUS FUNDAMENTALISTS ALMOST INEVITABLE.

INDEED, INDIVIDUALS HAVE ALREADY BEGUN TO QUESTION THE ADVISABILITY OF THEOCRATIC GOVERNMENT AND TO SPEAK UP FOR SEPARATION OF STATE AND ECCLESIASTICAL AFFAIRS. IT IS DOUBTFUL THAT THE FUNDAMENTALISTS WILL BE PREPARED TO TOLERATE SUCH HERESY, AND THE LOOMING STRUGGLE PROMISES TO BE A BITTER ONE. MODERATION IS LIKELY TO BE AN EARLY CASUALTY, WITH ONLY THE RUTHLESS HAVING MUCH PROSPECT OF PREVAILING IN A CONTEST WHERE COMPROMISE SEEMS OUT OF THE QUESTION.

ECONOMIC PROSPECTS IN MY "INITIAL IMPRESSIONS OF IRAN" I WROTE THAT "IRAN IS NOT WEST GERMANY...IT IS NOT EVEN TAIWAN OF SOUTH KOREAM" THE OBVIOUS TRUTH OF THAT ASSESSMENT, FROM THE POINT OF VIEW OF ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT, HAS LONG SINCE BECOME INESCAPABLE. INDEED, THE DISCREPENCY BETWEEN THE SHAH'S BOAST TO MAKE IRAN THE WORLD'S FIFTH LEADING INDUSTRIAL POWER BY THE YEAR 2000 AND THE REALITY OF IRAN'S FALTERING ECONOMIC PERFORMANCE WAS UNDOUBTEDLY A SIGNIFICANT FACT IN HIS ULTIMATE DOWNFALL. WERE IT NOT FOR OIL AND GAS, THE REAL ECONOMIC FUTURE OF THE COUNTRY MIGHT MORE APPROPRIATELY BE COMPARED WITH ALBANIA THAN THE LEADING INDUSTRIALIZED NATIONS.

IN TERMS OF HUMAN RESOURCES, IRAN REMAINS POORLY EQUIPPED FOR THE RAPID DEVELOPMENT OF MODERN INDUSTRY. EVEN DURING THE LAST FIVE YEARS, RELATIVELY TO THE AMOUNT OF CAPITAL INVESTED, LITTLE WAS ACCOMPLISHED TO IMPROVE THE ULTIMATE PROSPECTS FOR SUCCESS. ON THE CONTRARY, THE TENDENCY TO THINK THAT MONEY ALONE WULD BUY THE INFRASTRQLTURAL AND TECHNOLOGICAL PREREQUISITES FOR MODERN INDUSTRY MEANT THAT MANY OPPORTUNITIES FOR GAINING THE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE THAT IRAN NEEDS BEFORE IT WILL BE COMPETITIVE WITH EVEN THE LIKES OF MEXICO AND THE PHILIPPINES WERE NEEDLESSLY LOST.

GIVEN THE DAMAGE WHICH RECENT POLITICAL TURMOIL HAS INFLICTED UPON THE IRANIAN ECONOMY, THE FUTURE WOULD BE GRIM INDEED WITHOUT THE COUNTRY'S ENERGY RESOURCES. INTERNATIONAL DEMAND FOR THESE GIVES IRAN A POTENTIAL SOURCE OF INCOME THAT SHOULD SAVE THE ECONOMY FROM DEGENERATING TOTALLY INTO ONE WHERE CARPERT WEAVING AND HERDING GOATS ARE THE MAIN ACTIVITIES. HOWEVER, SEVERE ECONOMIC READJUSTMENT WITH A CONCOMITANT DROP IN REAL INCOME SEEMS UNAVOIDABLE OVER THE NEAR TERM. THE PROSPECT FOR POLITICAL INSTABILITY WILL BE CONSIDERABLY ENHANCED BY THIS EVENTUALITY. FURTHER, THERE WOULD APEAR TO BE LITTLE LIKELIHOOD FOR AN EARLY RETURN TO THE GROWTH OF THE RECENT PAST.

BUSINESS CONFIDENCE HAS BEEN PROFOUNDLY SHAKEN, LARGE AMOUNTS OF CAPITAL HAVE BEEN EXPATRIATED, PERHAPS IRREVOCABLY, AND MUCH OF IRAN'S LIMITED POOL OF ENTREPRENEURIAL TALENT HAS FLED THE COUNTRY. THE STRUCTURAL OBSTACLES TO INDUSTRIALIZATION--ILLITERACY, LACK OF MANAGERIAL AND TECHNICAL SKILLS, CULTURAL BIAS AGAINST MANUAL LABOR--REMAIN FORMIDABLE. THESE HANDICAPS CAN ONLY BE EXACERBATED BY THE WAVE OF ISLAMIC FUNDAMENTALIST SENTIMENT NOW IN THE ASCENDANT. THE PROSPECT, THEN, IS FOR ECONOMIC STAGNATION IN THE MIDST OF POLITICAL INSTABILITY. IRAN'S NEW RULERS, WHOEVER THEY MAY EVENTUALLY BE, ARE APT TO FIND IT NO EASIER TO INDUSTRIALIZE THEIR COUNTRY IN THE ABSENCE OF A BASIC SOCIAL TRANSFORMATION THAN WAS THE SHAH.

AS SUGGESTED ABOVE, ISLAMIC FUNDAMENTALISM IS LIKELY TO VIEW SUCH CHANGE CRITICALLY ON THE GROUNDS THAT IT IMPLIES A RETURN TO A SECULARIZATION OF IRANIAN SCIETY, SECULARIZATION WHICH IT UNCOMPROMISINGLY OPPOSES. EXPECTATIONS, HOWEVER, INFLATE DURING THE YEARS OF HEADY ECONOMIC GROWTH, CANNOT BE SUPPRESSED WITHOUT ULTIMATE RESPRT TO BRUTAL OPPRESSION, AND THEY, ALONG WITH THE EXIGENCIES TO RAISE NATIONAL INCOME. REALISITICALLY, THIS CAN ONLY BE ACCOMPLISHED TO ANY MEANINGFUL EXTENT THROUGH INCREASING OIL REVENUES, AT LEAST AS LONG AS THE PRESENT OBSTACLES TO RAPID INDUSTRIALIZATION REMAIN.

IRAN IS THEREFORE LIKELY TO BECOME EVEN MORE HAWKISH ON OIL PRICING THAN IT HAS BEEN IN THE PAST, BUT EVEN CHARGING THE MAXIMUM THE MARKET WILL BEAR WILL NOT ULTIMATELY RESOLVE THE DILEMMA POSED BY THE NEED FOR DRASTIC SOCIAL CHANGE IF IRAN IS EVER TO ESCAPE ITS DEPENDENCY ON OIL AND THE INCLINATION TO RESIST SUCH CHANGE INHERENT IN THE TENETS OF ISLAMIC FUNDAMENTALISM.

THE IRANIAN PERSONALITY DILEMMA ACDA-12 ( ISO ) W ------------------094413 092021Z /44 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 0206 SECTION 3 OF 4 TEHRAN 2615 PERHAPS AS CENTRAL TO THE FUTURE OF IRAN AS EITHER THE CLASH OF TRADITION AND THE MODERNIZATION PROCESS OR THE REQUIREMENT FOR FUNDAMENTAL SOCIAL CHANGE BEFORE GENUINE ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT CAN OCCUR IS THE CONUNDRUM POSED BY THE LDATURE OF PERSIAN PSYCHOLOGICAL MAKEUP.

TWO IMPRESSIONS ABOUT IRANIANS STAND OUT IN THIS REGARD: FIRST, DESPITE THE PRESENT REVOLUTIONARY EUPHORIA AND SEEMING SENSE OF PURPOSE THE MOVEMENT TO OVERTHROW PAHLAVI TYRANNY HAS GIVEN THE IRANIAN PEOPLE, THEY REMAIN AT HEART A HIGHLY FRACTIOUS RACE WHOSE WELL-DEVELOPED EGOISM MAKES SUSTAINED VOLUNTARY COOPERATION AN ALMOST UNTHINKABLE PROPOSITION. AND, SECOND, IRANIAN FATALISM IS THE VERY ANTITHESIS OF THE FAITH IN FREE WILL WHICH HAS BEEN A HALLMARK OF THE KIND OF SOCIETY MANY IRANIANS ARE PRESENTLY SAYING THEY WANT THEIR NATION TO BECOME THE DEVELOPMENT OF DEMOCRATIC GOVERNMENT PRESUPPOSES A GIVEN AND TAKE AND A WILLINGNESS TO COMPROMISE THAT ARE UNCHARACTERISTIC OF THE IRANIAN PERSONALITY.

IN AN INTERVIEW SEVERAL YEARS AGO THE SHAH WAS ASKED, IN EFFECT, WHY HE FOUND IT NECESSARY TO RULE SO AUTOCRATICALLY. HIS RESPONSE INDICATED THAT HE PERPHAPS UNDERSTOOD HIS SUBJECTS BETTER THAN HIS SUBSEQUENT BEHAVIOR WOULD OTHERWISE SUGGEST. HE REPLIED, "WHEN THE IRANIAN PEOPLE BEGIN TO BEHAVE LIKE SWEDES, I WILL BEGIN TO ACT LIKE THE KING OF SWEDEN." KHOMEINI'S RECENT REMARK, "I WILL PUNCH THE GOVERNMENT IN THE MOUTH," TOO, REFLECTS THE ARROGANCE (IT IS OFTEN DIFFICULT TO TELL WHERE GOD'S WILL STOPS AND THE AYATOLLAH'S BEGINS) AND DISTAIN FOR CONTRARY OPINION THAT IRANIANS SO FREQUENTLY MANIFEST.

THAT KHOMEINI'S INTRANSIGENCE AND SELF-RIGHTEOUSNESS ARE NOT IN KEEPING WITH THE DEMOCRATIC IDEALS THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION WAS SUPPOSEDLY FOUNDED UPON, BUT RATHER ARE MORE COSELY AKIN TO THE DESPOTIC TYRANNY KHOMEINI HAS DECLARED HIMSELF AGAINST, SEEMS TO HAVE BEEN MISSED BY ALMOST ALL IRANIANS SAVE THE MARXIST STUDENTS WHOSE COUNTERPARTS ELSEWHERE HAVE HARDLY BEEN NOTED FOR THEIR ADHERENCE TO DEMOCRATIC PRINCIPLES. OFTEN, AS I HAVE TRAVELLED ABOUT SOUTHERN IRAN, I HAVE BEEN STRUCK BY THE SEEMINGLY UNNECESSARY UGLINESS OF THE LIVES OF MANY IRANIANS.

IN RURAL AREAS, THE WONDER OF ENGINEERING FEATS INVOLVED IN BRINGING WATER TO FIELDS, OFTEN OVER GREAT DISTANCES AND DIFFICULT TERRAIN, IS OVERSHADOWED BY THE FREQUENT RUDENESS OF VILLAGERS' HOMES SET IN THE MIDST OF THEIR OWN FILTH. IT IS AS IF, THE EFFORT OF CONSTRUCTING THE IRRIGATION WORKS HAVING SAPPED THEM OF THEIR FULL MEASURE OF CREATIVE ENERGY, THEY SEE NO PURPOSE IN EXPENDING FURTHER LABOR TO IMPROVE THEIR LIVES, PREFERRING INSTEAD TO SIT IDLY STACKING STONES INTO THE NON-UTILITARIAN HEAPS OF FIVE OR SIX THAT DOT THE MRGINS OF RURAL ROADS.

THE SAME LACK OF ENTHUSIASM FOR PUTTING FREE TIME TO GOOD USE IS PRESENT IN IRANIAN CITIES AND TOWNS AS WELL MERCHANTS THERE OFTEN SIT VACANT-EYED OR PERHAPS ENGROSSED IN FINGERING THEIR WORRY BEADS IN DINGY SHOPS WITH FLY-SPECKED WINDOWS, APPARENTLY OBLIVIOUS TO THE POSSIBILITY OF INCREASING BUSINESS THROUGH THE APPLICATION F A LITTLE ELBOW GREASE.

THE SENSE OF RESIGNATION, THAT NOTHING ONE INDIVIDUAL CAN DO TO IMPROVE THE SURROUNDINGS HE LIVES OR WORKS IN WILL MATTER IN THE ULTIMATE SCHEME OF THINGS, THIS NON-PRODUCTIVE IDLENESS IMPLIES STANDS IN STARK CONTRAST TO THE CONFIDENCE THAT LIFE CAN BE BETTER WHICH PRESUMABLY MOTIVATED THE OLD CHINESE SHOPKEEPER I ONCE OBSERVED USING A FREE MOMENT TO PICK THROUGH A BIN OF GARLIC TO REMOVE THE LOSE HUSKS. THESE TWO ASPECTS OF THE IRANIAN PERSONALITY, EGOISM AND PERVASIVE FATALISM, WOULD APPEAR TO BE CONTRADICTORY QUALITIES. INDEED, THEIR COEXISTENCE IN IRANIAN SCIETY CREATES A LATENT TENSION THAT CAN EXPLODE IN THE KIND OF UPHEAVAL WITNESSED DURING THE LST YEAR.

AS IT WAS PERCEIVED THAT THE SHAH WAS NOT ADHERING TO HIS OWN MAXIM, I.E.N TO FOREBEAR CONDUCTING HIMSELF LIKE THE KING OF SWEDEN, FATALISTIC ACCEPTANCE OF HIS RULE WAS INCREASINGLY SUBLIMINATED BY CHALLENGE TO IT. THE DEGREE OF PERSONALIZATION OF THIS CHALLENGE, AS EVIDENCED BY THE BITTERNESS OF THE CONDEMNATION OF SHAH HIMSELF, REFLECTED ITS EGOISTIC CORE, HOWEVER, AND THE APPARENT UNITY OF THE IRANIAN PEOPLE IS APT TO PROVE HIGHLY EPHEMERAL AS THE CHALLENGE TO THE PAHLAVI REGIME IS TRANSFORMED INTO A NEW STRUGGLE OF INDIVIDUAL WILLS FOR PREDOMINANCE.

UNDER THE CIRCUMSTANCES, THAT THE SHAH'S DESPOTISM WILL ULTIMTELY BE REPLACED BY YET ANOTHER FOM OF DESPOTISM SEEMS NOT ONLY POSSIBLE, BUT PROBABLE. SUCH AN EVENTUALITY, IF THE WILL TO DOMINATE IS SUFFICIENTLY STRONG, WOULD MOST LIKELY BE ACCOMPANIED BY A RE-EMERGENCE OF THE IRANIAN INCLINATION TO ACCEPT SUCH DOMINATION AS BEYOND INDIVIDUAL ABILITIES TO CONTROL. ------------------017631 051644Z /44 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 0207 SECTION 4 OF 4 TEHRAN 2615 THE IMPLICATIONS FOR U.S. INTERESTS WHAT ARE OUR INTERESTS IN IRAN? ABOVE ALL ELSE, WE WISH TO SEE THE SOVEREIGN INTEGRITY OF IRAN REMAIN INTACT AND THE COUNTRY TO REMAIN FREE FROM SOVIET DOMINATION.

ITS OIL, TOO, IS OF IMMENSE IMPORTANCE, IF NOT TO OURSELVES DIRECTLY, THEN AT LEAST TO OUR WESTERN EUROPEAN AND JAPANESE ALLIES. AND IRAN'S STRATEGIC POSITION ATHWART THE STRAITS OF HORMOZ THROUGH WHICH 70 PERCENT OF THE OIL PRODUCED BY MEMBERS OF THE ORGANIZATION OF PETROLEUM EXPORTING COUNTRIES AND FIFTY PERCENT OF THAT CONSUMED BY THE NON-COMMUNIST WORLD MUST PASS CERTAINLY COMMANDS ATTENTION. IRAN HAS ALSO BEEN A MAJOR CUSTOMER OF AMERICAN MANUFACTURE AND AGRICULTURAL PRODUCTS, AND FACILITIES ON IRANIAN TERRITORY HAVE HAD AN IMPORTANT ROLE IN OUR ABILITY TO MONITOR SUCH THINGS AS SOVIET COMPLIANCE WITH THE NUCLEAR TEST BAN TREATY.

FINALLY, WE HAVE SEEN IRANIAN POWER AS A FORCE FOR STABILITY IN THE REGION. HOW ARE THOSE INTERESTS LIKELY TO BE AFFECTED BY THE NEW POLITICAL REALITIES IN IRAN? UNDOUBTEDLY, POLITICAL TURMOIL IN IRAN PRESENTS A TEMPTATION TO THE SOVIETS TO FISH IN TROUBLED WATERS. WHETHER OR NOT IT ALSO PRESENTS THEM WITH AN OPPORTUNITY FOR POLITICAL GAIN IS LESS CERTAIN, THE XENOPHOBIA NEVER FAR BENEATH THE SURFACE OF IRANIAN SOCIETY CAN BE DIRECTED AGAINST THE SOVIETS AS EASILY AS IT HAS BEEN AGAINST US IN RECENT MONTHS, AND, INDEED, THERE IS GREATER HISTORICAL PRECENDENT FOR SUSPICION OF RUSSIAN MOTIVES IN IRAN THAN THERE IS OF OURS.

THE FUNDAMENTAL CONSERVATISM OR IRANIAN SOCIETY AND THE HOLD OF ISLAM ON MUCH OF THE POPULATION, TOO, ARE FACTORS WHICH SHOULD WORK AGAINST RAPID GROWTH OF SOVIET INFLUENCE HERE. THE SOVIETS MIGHT TRY TO GAIN A FOOTHOLD THROUGH SUPPORT OF DISSIDENT ETHNIC MINORITIES, BUT NOTHING COULD BE BETTER CALCULATED TO UNITE THE PERSIAN MAJORITY AGAINST THEM. DETACHMENT FROM THE VICISSITUDES OF IRANIAN INTERNAL POLITICS, COUPLED WITH REGULAR AND POINTED REMINDERS TO THE SOVIETS THAT WE WILL NOT TOLERATE THEIR INTERFERENCE IN IRANIAN INTERNAL AFFAIRS, WOULD APPEAR TO BE THE POLICY WE MIGHT ADOPT WHICH WOULD BEST COMPLEMENT THE ANTI-SOVIET BIAS INHERENT IN VIGOROUS IRANIAN NATIONALISM.

AS FOR IRAN'S OIL, THERE WILL BE POWERFUL INCENTIVES FOR ANDY GOVERNMENT IN TEHRAN TO SELL TO THE HIGHEST BIDDER. THAT SHOULD ASSURE WESTERN EUROPE AND JAPAN AT LEAST THE OPPORTUNITY TO MAKE AN OFFER. SIMILARLY, IRAN SHOULD REMAIN NO LESS ANXIOUS THAN IT WAS UNDER THE SHAH TO KEEP THE STRAITS OF HORMOZ OPEN.

IRAN'S ABILITY TO ACT AS THE GENDARME OF THE PERSIAN GULF WAS ALWAYS QUESTIONABLE, BUT THAT IT WILL USE WHATEVER POWER IT DOES POSSESS TO PROTECT ITS OWN VITAL INTERESTS--WHICH IN THE CASE OF OIL ARE GENERALLY COMPLEMENTARY TO THOSE OF THE OTHER PRODUCING STATES OF THE GULF, THE PRIMARY CONSUMING COUNTRIES AND OURSELVES-CANNOT BE DOUBTED. MOREOVER, IT IS HIGHLY IMPROBABLE THAT IRAN WILL REFUSE TO DEAL COMMERCIALLY WITH US, PARTICULARLY WHEN IT COMES TO THE SOPHISTICATED TECHNOLOGY IT MUST HAVE TO KEEP THE OIL THAT IS LIKELY TO REMAIN FOR THE FORESEEABLE FUTURE ITS ONLY SIGNIFICANT SOURCE OF FOREIGN EXCHANGE FLOWING.

IN THE CASE OF FOOD, THE LIKELIHOOD THAT THE MASSIVE GAP BETWEEN IRANIAN PRODUCTION AND CONSUMPTION WILL SHRINK ONLY SLOWLY IF AT ALL SUGGESTS THT IRAN'S NEED FOR ACCESS TO AMERICAN SOURCES OF SUPPLY WILL BE SO URGENT AS TO OVERRIDE POLITICAL CONSIDERATIONS. ARMS TRADE IS BOUND TO DECLINE, ALTHOUGH IT SHOULD NOT FALL INTO TOTAL ECLIPSE IN VIEW OF THE VERY CONSIDERABLE INVESTMENT ALREADY MADE IN AMERICAN WEAPONS SYSTEMS. RESURGENT IRANIAN CHAUVINISM PROBABLY WILL NOT PERMIT CONTINUATION OF MONITORING ACTIVITIES FROM LOCAL INSTALLATIONS, BUT ARE THERE NOT ALTERNATIVE MEANS OF COLLECTING THE SAME DATA?

FOR THE SAME CHAUVINISTIC REASONS, IRAN IS NOT LIKELY TO BE WILLING TO BE VIEWED ANY LONGER IN THE EYES OF THE WRLD PARTICULARLY THE THIRD WORLD, AS OUR CLOSE ALLY SINCE THE OBVIOUS INEQUALITY OF THE RELATIONSHIP INEVITABLY INVITES CRITICISM. THE MOST IMMEDIATE CONSEQUENCE OF THIS IS APT TO BE THE WITHDRAWAL OF IRAN FROM THE CENTRAL TREATY ORGANIZATION AND THE ALLIANCE'S DEMISE., BUT IT WAS ESSENTIALLY MORIBUND IN ANY EVENT. AS FOR IRAN'S ROLE AS A GUARANTOR OF REGIONAL STABILITY, HOW COULD ANY NATION THAT IS INHERENTLY UNSTABLE ITSELF PERFORM SUCH A FUNCTION? THEREIN LIES THE PRINCIPAL LESSON OF THE PST YEAR.

THERE SIMPLY EXISTS NO HISTORICAL, SOCIOLOGICAL OR INSTITUTIONAL BASIS FOR GENUINE STABILITY IN IRAN AND THAT SITUATIN IS APT TO PERTAIN FOR THE FORESEEABLE FUTURE. IT IS, HOWEVER, A SITUATION WE SHOULD BE ABLE TO CPE WITH, PERHAPS QUITE SATISFACTORILY, SO LONG AS WE KEEP SIGHT OF THE LIMITATIONS IT IMPLIES. IMPORTANT AMONG THESE IS THE EXTREME IMPERMANENCE OF POLITICAL POWER.

THUS, OUR CLOSE IDENTIFICATION WITH ANY REGIME ALWAYS CARRIES WITH IT THE RISK THAT WHEN IT FALLS WE WILL SUFFER FROM THE POPULAR REACTION AGAINST IT WE MUST, OF COURSE, MAINTAIN A RELATIONSHIP WITH THE GOVERNMENT OF THE MOMENT, BUT IN VIEW OF THE ERRATIC FORTUNES OF POLITICAL LEADERS IN SUCH UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENTS AS THAT OF IRAN, IT WOULD BEHOOVE US TO KEEP THAT RELATIONSHIP FIRMLY ROOTED IN OOLITICAL REAGHKTY. FOR THE REAL THREAT TO OUR INTERES HERE OR ANYWHERE LIES LESS IN INSTABILITY PER SE THAN IN THE TEMPTATION TO PURSUEHYOLICIBWFBASED ON A VIEW OF THE WORLD AS WE WOULD LIKE IT TO BE, NOT AS IT ACTUALLY IS.
TOMSETH UNQUOTE. SULLIVAN
