1979TEHRAN02619.subject: LIMITED CONSULAR SERVICES ARE AVAILABLE IN IRAN AT THIS TIME

segments.text: 093751 011256Z /50 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 0138

AS THE DEPARTMENT IS AWARE, ONLY VERY LIMITED CONSULAR SERVICES ARE AVAILABLE IN IRAN AT THIS TIME. THE THREE CONSTITUENT POSTS AT TABRIZ, ISFAHAN, AND SHIRAZ HAVE BEEN CLOSED AND ONLY AT THE EMBASSY ARE CONSULAR SERVICES OF ANY KIND AVAILABLE.

THE BUILDING WHICH HAS HOUSED THE CONSULAR SECTION ALTHOUGH UNTOUCHED TO DATE IS NOT SECURE, AND THERE IS NO WAY TO INSURE THE SAFETY OF EITHER OFFICERS, LOCAL EMPLOYEES OR VISITORS AT THAT LOCATION. THEREFORE, A SMALL CONSULAR SECTION HAS BEEN ESTABLISHED ON THE EMBASSY COMPOUND, WHICH IS BEING STAFFED BY ONLY THREE CONSULAR OFFICERS. SINCE THE FORCES PROTECTING THE EMBASSY COMPOUND WILL ALLOW ONLY AMERICANS AND LOCAL EMPLOYEES ONTO THE COMPOUND AND HAVE NOT TO DATE ALLOWED ANY OTHER IRANIANS TO ENTER, THE EMBASSY IS LIMITED IN THE SERVICES WE ARE ABLE TO OFFER THE PUBLIC.
THE FOLLOWING ARE THE TYPES OF CONSULAR SERVICES WE CAN OFFER IN TEHRAN NOW AND FOR THE FORESEEABLE FUTURE

NIV: NO NIVS ARE BEING ISSUED SINCE IRANIANS CANNOT ENTER THE COMPOUND AT THIS TIME. IN ADDITION IRANIAN GOVERNMENT HAS LIMITED FOR THE TIME BEING THOSE WHO MAY LEAVE THE COUNTRY. RETURNING STUDENTS, AND PERSONS UNDER 18 YEARS OF AGE MAY LEAVE IRAN, AS WELL AS SERIOUSLY ILL PERSONS WHO HAVE MINISTRY OF HEALTH APPROVAL TO SEEK TREATMENT OUTSIDE OF IRAN. AT THE MOMENT NO IRANIAN ADULT, MALE OR FEMALE, IS BEING ALLOWED TO LEAVE IRAN AND WHO NEED VISAS ARE BEING ADVISED TO APPLY FOR VISAS AT AMERICAN POSTS IN OTHER COUNTRIES PRIOR TO GOING TO THE U.S.
IV: WE ARE LIMITING IV ISSUANCES AT THIS TIME TO IR CASES UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE. PROCESSING OF OTHER PREFERENCE CASES WILL BE CONSIDERED WHEN IRANIANS ARE ALLOWED ON COMPOUND.

AMER.SER.: WE ARE ISSUING PASSPORTS TO AMERICANS NEEDING THEM, PROCESSING NOTARIAL SERVICES FOR AMERICANS AS REQUESTED, AND, IN GENERAL, ASSISTING THOSE AMERICAN CITIZENS STILL HERE AS BEST WE ARE ABLE. EMBASSY ESTIMATES THAT THERE ARE ONLY ABOUT 3200 AMERICANS LEFT IN IRAN, OF WHICH 2400 ARE BELIEVED TO BE RESIDING IN THE TEHRAN AREA. WE ARE ALSO ATTEMPTING TO ANSWER DEPARTMENT'S MANY WELFARE/WHEREABOUT REQUESTS, AGAIN AS BEST WE ARE ABLE. IN THIS REGARD POST IS UNABLE TO CHECK MANIFEST OFAMERICANS EVACUATED FROM IRAN AND PRESUMES THAT DEPARTMENT IS DOING SO PRIOR TO SENDING REQUESTS TO POST.

DEPARTMENT SHOULD BE AWARE THAT LOCAL TELEPHONE NUMBERS ARE ESSENTIAL AS WE ARE NOT ABLE AT THIS TIME TO SEND PERSONNEL TO CHECK INDIVIDUAL ADDRESSES IN TEHRAN. POST IS ALSO HAVING A VERY DIFFICULT TIME TRYING TO REACH AMERICANS OUTSIDE OF TEHRAN AREA BY TELEPHONE AS INTRA-COUNTRY COMMUNICATION IS PRESENTLY VERY POOR AND IT IS ALMOST IMPOSSIBLE TO GET THROUGH TO ANY OTHER CITY FROM TEHRAN BY TELEPHONE.
POST WILL KEEP DEPARTMENT INFORMED OF ANY CHANGES IN ITS ABILITY TO PERFORM CONSULAR SERVICES. SULLIVAN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT.)

SUMMARY: SINCE THE ATTACK ON THE EMBASSY, TWO GROUPS OF MOJAHEDDIN HAVE BEEN PROVIDING FOR THE COMPOUND'S SECURITY. ONE GROUP'S AUTHORITY DERIVES FROM THE KHOMEINI COMMITTEE, THE OTHER FROM THE PRIME MINISTRY. EARLY COOPERATION HAS STEADILY DEGENERATED TO THE POINT WHERE WE NOW HAVE OPEN AND BITTER HOSTILITY BETWEEN THE TWO, THUS PROVIDING THE EMBASSY WITH A UNIQUE MICROCOSM OF THE POLITICAL STRUGGLE NOW BEING WAGED ON THE NATIONAL LEVEL. END SUMMARY.

IN THE IMMEDIATE AFTERMATH OF THE ST. VALENTINE'S DAY ATTACK, TWO GROUPS OF MOJAHEDDIN WERE SENT TO THE EMBASSY TO PROVIDE SECURITY FOR THE COMPOUND. ONE GROUP, DESPATCHED BY THE KHOMEINI COMMITTEE, WAS CHARGED WITH GENERAL DEFENSE OF THE COMPOUND. ANOTHER GROUP WAS PERSONALLY ASSIGNED BY DR. YAZDI TO PROTECT THE AMBASSADOR'S RESIDENCE. IN ESSENCE, THE TWO GROUPS PROVIDE A MICROCOSM OF THE CURRENT TENSION THAT EXISTS BETWEEN THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES AND THE GOVERNMENT, A PROBLEM DIRECTLY ADDRESSED BY PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN IN HIS FEBRUARY 28 SPEECH.

THE COOPERATION AND UNITY BETWEEN THE TWO GROUPS APPARENT IN THE HEADY FIRST FEW DAYS AFTER THEIR INITIAL ASSUMPTION OF SECURITY RESPONSIBILITIES HAS STEADILY DISAPPEARED AS MORE NATURAL FISSIPAROUS TENDENCIES HAVE RISEN TO THE SURFACE. THIS FACT PROVIDES A SECOND MICROCOSM OF THE LARGER NATIONAL SCENE, WHICH HAS ALSO SEEN ALLIANCES OF OPPOSITION TO A COMMON ENEMY BREAK DOWN IN THE FACE OF THE COMPLEX RESPONSIBILITIES OF POWER. (NOTE: THIS TELEGRAM DOES NOT ADDRESS THE PRESENCE OF THE HOMAFARS ON THE COMPOUND, A SUBJECT COVERED BY SEPARATE CABLE.

THE "COMMITTEE'S MOJAHEDDIN" ARE LED BY A SQUAT, FAT FELLOW BY THE NAME OF MASHALLAH KASHANI. MASHALLAH CAN BE SEEN STANDING BESIDE AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN ON THE COVER OF NEWSWEEK. HE ALSO FIGURED PROMINENTLY IN NEWS COVERAGE OF SERGEANT KRAUS' DEPARTURE FROM MEHRABAD AIRPORT. MASHALLAH WAS DISPATCHED TO THE EMBASSY ON FEBRUARY 14 BY HANDWRITTEN NOTE FROM THE CENTRAL COMMITTEE OF THE REVOLUTION. HIS POSSESSION OF THIS PIECE OF PAPER, PLUS HIS OWN RATHER INGRATIATING MACHO STYLE, MAKES HIM A POWERFUL FIGURE BOTH ON AND OFF THE COMPOUND.
HE AND HIS BROTHERS HASSAN AND HUSSEIN HAVE ESTABLISHED THEIR HEADQUARTERS AT THE MOTOR POOL GATEHOUSE, FROM WHICH THEY AND THEIR COMPANIONS CONTROL VIRTUALLY ALL ACCESS TO AND FROM THE COMPOUND.

MASHALLAH, A PROFESSIONAL BUTCHER BY TRADE, CLAIMS TO HAVE BEEN "IN PRISON" WITH KHOMEINI FIFTEEN YEARS AGO. UPON QUESTIONING, IT TURNS OUT THAT HE WAS A GUARD AT THE PRISON WHERE KHOMEINI WAS HELD. WHEN IT BECAME KNOWN TO THE PRISON AUTHORITIES THAT MASHALLAH WAS CONSORTING WITH THE AYATOLLAH, HE WAS TRANSFERRED TO ANOTHER PRISON. IRONICALLY, KHOMEINI HIMSELF WAS LATER MOVED TO THIS SAME PRISON. MASHALLAH CLAMS TO HAVE A CONTINUING CLOSE RELATIONSHIP WITH THE AYATOLLAH AND HAS ON SEVERAL OCCASIONS OFFERED TO TAKE EMBASSY OFFICERS TO MEET HIM.

MASHALLAH'S GROUP QUICKLY EARNED ITSELF A REPUTATION FOR CRUDE, ROUGH BEHAVIOR. MOST OF THE TWELVE OR SO MOJAHEDDIN HE SURROUNDS HIMSELF WITH ARE POORLY EDUCATED BAZAARIS WHO PREFER ACTION TO WORDS. THEY ARE LOATHE TO ENGAGE IN POLITICAL DISCUSSIONS OF ANY KIND AND DO NOT SEEM COMFORTABLE WHEN PRESSED TO DO SO. ONCE HAVING ACQUIRED A FEEL FOR THE DYNAMICS OF THE EMBASSY, THEY BACAME MUCH MORE INTERESTED IN THE MATERIAL POSSIBILITIES DERIVING FROM THEIR PRESENCE ON THE COMPOUND.

IN THE FIRST FEW DAYS AFTER THE ATTACK, A NUMBER OF AUTOMOBILES DISAPPEARED FROM THE COMPOUND, LOCKED ROOM CONTAINING AMERICAN EMPLOYEES' AIR FREIGHT WAS BROKEN INTO AND LOOTED, AND MANY OF THE ARTICLES CONFISCATED FROM DEPARTING EVACUEES (FIREARMS, LIQUOR, ETC.) WERE SPIRITED FROM THE COMPOUND. THE "GOVERNMENT'S MOJAHEDDIN" STATIONED AT THE AMBASSADOR'S RESIDENCE ARE CONVINCED THAT MASHALLAH IS THE MASTERMIND OF A BOOMING RIP-OFF RING.

THIS DISTURBS THEM NO END, BECAUSE THIS OTHER GROUP, SENT BY YAZDI AND THE PRIME MINISTRY, IS BY ITS COMPOSITION A STARTLING CONTRAST WITH THE THUGS AND PIRATES OF THE MOTOR POOL GATE. THIS "HEADQUARTERS GROUP" IS MADE UP OF SEVERAL BOURGEOIS, IDEALISTIC, UNIVERSITY-EDUCATED YOUNGSTER WHO TAKE THEIR REVOLUTION MUCH MORE SERIOUSLY THAN DOES MASHALLAH'S GROUP. THE LEADER OF THIS GROUP, REZA FARAHANI, WAS HANDPICKED BY YAZDI ON FEBRUARY 14 TO PROVIDE SECURITY FOR THE AMBASSADOR'S RESIDENCE. REZA IN TURN SELECTED A GROUP OF SOME TEN OR SO ASSOCIATES, MANY OF WHOM HE HIMSELF HAD NOT PREVIOUSLY MET.

THEY RANGE IN BACKGROUNDS FROM A MASTER'S DEGREE IN ARCHITECTURE TO AN IRAN AIR TECHNICAL TRAINEE TO A P.L.O. TRAINED TERRORIST TO A FORMER DISC JOCKEY FROM NIRT. ------------------112455 021114Z /11 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORTY 151 SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 2640

REZA HIMSELF IS EASILY THE MOST INTERESTING OF ALL THE MOJAHEDDIN ON THE COMPOUND. HE IS A THIRTY-SIX YEAR OLD TEHRANI, ALTHOUGH HIS FAMILY IS FROM FRAAHAN, A VILLAGE SOME HUNDRED KILOMETERS OUTSIDE TEHRAN AND FAMOUS FOR ITS POLITICIANS. THE ASSASSINATED PRIME MINISTER MANSOUR WAS FROM THIS AREA. ONE OF REZA'S ANCESTORS, AMIR NEZAM FARAHANI, THE "AMIR KABIR," WAS PRIME MINISTER UNDER NASIR AL-DIN SHAH, MARRIED ONE OF THE SHAH'S DAUGHTERS AND WAS THE FIRST MINISTER TO SEND IRANIAN STUDENTS ABROAD.

REZA'S FATHER IS A WEALTHY CARPET SALESMAN WITH BUSINESS IN SEVERAL EUROPEAN COUNTRIES. REZA AND HIS BROTHER HAVE BEEN WORKING IN THE FAMILY BUSINESS SINCE REACHING ADULTHOOD. WHEN ASKED WHY HE BECAME OPPOSED TO THE SHAH'S REGIME, HE RESPONDS THAT HIS FATHER, THOUGH HIMSELF A SELF-MADE RICH MAN, REMEMBERS WHAT IT WAS LIKE TO BE POOR AND THUS BECAME COMMITTED TO OPPOSING A SYSTEM WHICH PERPETUATED THE GROSS INEQUALITIES OF PERSIAN SOCIETY. THIS TRADITIONAL FAMILY GRAVITATED NATURALLY TO THE KHOMEINI-INSPIRED MOVEMENT.

KHOMEINI'S ARREST FIFTEEN YEARS AGO BUT ESCAPED BEFORE REACHING PRISON##IN THE PERIOD FOLLOWING THIS, HE BECAME MORE INVOLVED IN THE MOJAHEDDIN, NOT AS A TERRORIST BUT AS A PROPAGANDIST OF SORTS. IN THE COURSE OF HIS MANY TRAVELS ABROAD ON FAMILY BUSINESS, HE WAS RESPONSIBLE FOR BRINGING ILLEGAL POLITICAL LITERATURE INTO IRAN VIA AN ARRANGEMENT WITH A FRIEND IN CUSTOMS.

IN EARLY 1978, HE BECAME AWARE THAT SAVAK WAS AFTER HIM. HE FLED BY LAND TO THE TURKISH BORDER, THEN MADE A FOUR A.M. CROSSING WHILE THE BORDER GUARDS CHANGED THEIR SHIFT. HE WENT ON TO THE U.S. ON A TOURIST VISA AND INVOLVED HIMSELF FOR SEVEN OR EIGHT MONTHS IN BUYING OLD PERSIAN CARPETS IN NEW YORK AND SELLING THEM IN FRANCE AND ITALY. IN LATE 1978, HE WENT TO PARIS AND GOT IN TOUCH WITH YAZDI AT KHOMEINI HEADQUARTERS. HE WAS IMPRESSIVE ENOUGH TO BE SELECTED AS ONE OF THE FIFTY COMPANIONS WHO ACCOMPANIED KHOMEINI TO TEHRAN ON FEBRUARY 1.

OF ALL THE MOJAHEDDIN, REZA SEEMS TO BE THE MOST SPIRITUALLY AKIN TO THE AYATOLLAH HIMSELF. A SOMBER AND SERIOUS PERSON OF SLIGHT BUILD, HIS FACE APPEARS TO HAVE THE WORRIES OF THE WORLD WRINKLED INTO IT. HE MOVES SLOWLY AND DELIBERATELY, CAREFULLY WEIGHING EACH WORD BEFORE HE SPEAKS. HE IS COMPLETELY COMMITTED TO KHOMEINI'S TEACHINGS AND IS A FERVENT AND DEVOUT MOSLEM. HE DOES NOT DRINK LIQUOR AND APPEARS TO HAVE NONE OF THE STREAK OF MATERIALISM THAT RUNS THROUGH MANY OF THE OTHER MOJAHEDDIN. LIKE MOST OF THE OTHERS IN THE "HEADQUARTERS GROUP," HE ENJOYS POLITICAL DISCUSSION.

HE IS FERVENTLY OPPOSED TO ZIONISM AND IS QUITE CONVINCED THAT SAVAK AND THE CIA WERE BEHIND MOST OF IRAN'S PAST PROBLEMS. HE WOULD HAVE US BELIEVE THAT SAVAK AGENTS ATTACKED THE EMBASSY ON FEBRUARY 14 AND INDEED HAS CLAIMED THT SAVAK WAS RESPONSIBLE FOR THE ASSASSINATIONS OF AMERICANS, IN TURN BLAMING THE KILLINGS OF THE MOJAHEDDIN.## IT IS DOUBTFUL THAT HE REALLY BELIEVES THIS, BUT HE CANNOT BE SHAKEN FROM PROPOSING IT.

AS MENTIONED EARLIER, THERE IS A GREAT DEAL OF TENSION BETWEEN THE TWO GROUPS OF MOJAHEDDIN. THIS TENSION SURFACED WHEN THE "HEADQUARTERS GROUP" OPENLY ACCUSED THE MASHALLAH GROUP OF CAR THIEVERY AND A HOST OF LESSER ATROCITIES. REZA SECRETLY COMPLAINED TO THE COMMITTEE AND THE PRIME MINISTRY THAT THE MASHALLAH GROUP WAS BETRAYING THEIR REVOLUTIONARY PRINCIPLES. IN DUE COURSE, A REPRESENTATIVE FROM THE COMMITTEE APPEARED AND THE LEADERSHIP OF BOTH GROUPS WAS BROUGHT TOGETHER BEFORE THE AMBASSADOR TO HASH IT OUT.

THIS PROVIDED THE AMERICANS PRESENT WITH A UNIQUE PERSPECTIVE ON THE HARSH FEELINGS BETWEEN THE TWO GROUPS, BUT ACTUALLY DID NOTHING TO ALLEVIATE THE SITUATION (ALTHOUGH THREE CARS MYSTERIOUSLY REAPPEARED ON THE COMPOUND THE SAME DAY).

THIS EFFORT BY THE HEADQUARTERS GROUP TO BLOW THE WHISTLE ON MASHALLAH WAS COUNTERED A FEW DAYS LATER BY MASHALLAH'S OWN VERSION OF A END-AROUND. CAPITALIZING ON AN OBVIOUS FRUSTRATION BY THE EMBASSY IN TRYING TO DEAL WITH THE VARIOUS GROUPS ASSIGNED TO PROTECT US, MASHALLAH CALLED A SECRET MEETING TO PROPOSE TO THE RELEVANT OFFICERS THAT THE EMBASSY BRING BACK ITS UNARMED FORCE OF GATE GUARDS, RELEASE THE HOMAFARS AND PUT A MUCH SMALLER MOJAHEDDIN FORCE UNDER THE DIRECTION OF HIMSELF. THE SUGGESTION WAS ALLOWED TO DIE A NATURAL DEATH.

THUS TO DATE WE CONTINUE TO OVERSEE AN UNEASY PEACE BETWEEN THE GROUPS. THE EMBASSY HAS BEEN TRYING TO AVOID TAKING SIDES IN THE EFFORT TO BECOME THE ONLY GROUP ON THE COMPOUND, HOPING INSTEAD THAT THE DAY-TO-DAY PERSIAN COMPROMISE CAN CONTINUE OR PERHAPS DEVELOP ON ITS OWN INTO A PERSIAN SOLUTION THAT WILL LEAVE BOTH GROUPS' "AB RU" INTACT. OF COURSE, THE JOINT EFFORT TO PROVIDE FOR THE EMBASSY'S SECURITY MENAWHILE REMAINS MUCH LESS SUCCESSFUL THAN IT MIGHT OTHERWISE BE IF THE GROUPS WERE ABLE TO COOPERATE.

ON THE NATIONAL LEVEL, THIS SAME PROBLEM CONTINUES TO BEDEVIL THE MANY GROUPS THAT WERE ABLE TO WORK TOGETHER ONLY SO LONG AS THEY HAD THE COMMON OBJECTIVE OF DEFEATING A MUTUAL FOE. IN THE AFTERMATH OF COMPLETE AND RAPID VICTORY, THIS FRAGILE UNITY IS NOW SPLITTING ASUNDER. SULLIVAN NOTE BY OC/T: ##SENTENCE AS RECEIVED.

AMCIT WIVES MARRIED TO IRANIANS WHO ENTERED IRAN AS IRANIANS ON IRANIAN PASSPORTS ARE NOW INCLUDED AMONG ADULT IRANIANS WHO ARE NOT PERMITTED TO LEAVE IRAN AT THIS TIME. GOI DID ALLOW AMCIT WIVES TO LEAVE ON EVACUATION FLIGHTS EVEN THOUGH THEY ENTERED IRAN ON IRANIAN PASSPORTS BUT HAS NOW REIMPOSED BAN ON THEIR TRAVELING AT THIS TIME. ACCORDING TO NEWSPAPER ARTICLE ON MARCH FIRST BAN ON TRAVEL BY ADULT IRANIANS IS EXPECTED TO BE LIFTED WITHIN NEXT SEVERAL WEEKS.

EMBASSY WOULD APPRECIATE DEPARTMENT SENDING W/W CASES NOT HAVING TELEPHONE NUMBERS IN SEPARATE CABLES. WE HOPE, SHORTLY, TO BE ABLE TO SEND LOCAL EMPLOYEES TO ADDRESSES IN TEHRAN AREA AND WE CAN THEN TRY TO CONTACT THESE CASES. EMBASSY IS ALSO ATTEMPTING TO ESTABLISH CONTACTS IN TABRIZ, SHIRAZ, ISFAHAN, MESHED, ABADAN AND SOME OTHER AREAS WHERE AMERICANS MIGHT BE LOCATED BUT SINCE INTRACOUNTRY TELEPHONE COMMUNICATION IS STILL EXTREMELY POOR IT WILL PROBABLY BE SOME TIME BEFORE WE CAN EFFECTIVELY CONTACT AMCITS IN AREAS OUTSIDE MF TEHRAN.
EMBASSY WILL KEEP DEPARTMENT INFORMED OF CHANGES IN ITS ABILITY TO PROVIDE CONSULAR SERVICES.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT.)

U.S. ARMY HOSPITAL IN TEHRAN IS CURRENTLY CARING FOR ONE IRANIAN CIVILIAN GUARD FROM EMBASSY COMPOUND WHO SUFFERED GUNSHOT WOUND WHEN HIS POSITION WAS SPRAYED BY AUTOMATIC WEAPONS FIRE DURING NIGHT OF FEBRUARY 28-MARCH 1.

THERE ARE CURRENTLY NEARLY THREE HUNDRED AMERICAN AND IRANIAN PERSONNEL LIVING AND WORKING IN EMBASSY COMPOUND, ALL OF WHOM ARE VULNERABLE TO ATTACK BY SNIPER FIRE OR BY PROVOCATIVE ATTACKS. THE HOSPITAL WHICH IS IN A SAFE, QUIET SUBURBAN AREA, IS NEEDED IN THE EVENT WE SUFFER MORE CASUALTIES IN THE NEAR FUTURE.

ALL OFFICIAL AMERICANS IN IRAN (THERE ARE ABOUT 100) ARE IN AN AWKWARD POSITION AND, FOR ONE REASON OR ANOTHER, UNABLE TO PERFORM FUNCTIONS IN A NORMAL MANNER. IN THE CASE OF THE EMBASSY, BASIC HANDICAP IS PHYSICAL DESTRUCTION OF CHANCERY, WHICH IS STILL SEVERAL DAYS AWAY FROM OCCUPANCY. IN THE CASE OF ARMISH-MAAG, HANDICAP IS ABSENCE OF GOI POLICY DECISION ON FUTURE MILITARY RELATIONSHIP WITH U.S.

HOSPITAL IS, INDEED, ONLY U.S. FACILITY IN IRAN WHICH HAS NOT RPT NOT UNDERGONE TRAUMATIC CHANGE. ITS ONLY HANDICAP IS THAT ITS FORMER MILITARY GUARDS HAVE BEEN REPLACED BY REPRESENTATIVES OF KHOMEINI COMMITTEE. HOSPITAL STAFF IS ABLE TO MOVE AROUND AND SOME HAVE VISITED EMBASSY COMPOUFD. THEY ARE COMFORTABLY HOUSED, WELL-FED, AND HAVE ADEQUATE MEDICAL SUPPLIES EITHER ON HAND OR EN ROUTE.

IN SHORT, OF ALL THE OFFICIAL AMERICANS IN IRAN, THIS SMALL GROUP HAS THE LEAST BASIS FOR COMPLAINT. WE HOPE WE WILL NOT RPT NOT REQUIRE THEIR ACTIVE PROFESSIONAL SERVICES TO REPAIR BATTLE DAMAGE TO THE REST OF US. HOWEVER, WE FEEL THE MINIMUM THEY COULD DO IS TO QUIT BELLY-ACHING AND PRESERVE THEIR CAPABILITY TO ASSIST US IF WE REQUIRE SUCH ASSISTANCE. PERHAPS THE FOREGOING, PLUS A RENDITION OF THE HIPPOCRATIC OATH AND SOME REFERENCE TO THE FACT THESE PEOPLE PRETEND TO BE ARMY OFFICERS ON OFFICIAL DUTY WILL HELP PUT THESE MICE FROM MASH IN PERSPECTIVE.

1979TEHRAN02647.subject: MEETING WITH FOREIGN MINISTER SANJABI, MARCH 1

segments.text: (S) - ENTIRE TEXT.
I SPENT AN HOUR WITH FOREIGN MINISTER SANJABI MORNING MARCH

HE WAS ACCOMPANIED BY HIS ACTING DEPUTY LEBASTCHI (FROM BERKELEY, CALIFORNIA) AND SAYEED GOODARZNIA, HEAD OF THE AMERICAN SECTION. IT WAS A SATISFACTORY INTERVIEW, BUT LACKING THE PERSONAL WARMTH OF MY MEETINGS WITH BAZARGAN AND ENTEZAM.

SANJABI MADE A RATHER FEEBLE APOLOGY FOR THE FEBRUARY 14 ATTACK ON THE EMBASSY. I THEN GAVE HIM A NON-PAPER WITH THE LANGUAGE THE DEPARTMENT HAD PROVIDED TO ME ON COMPENSATION AND CLAIMS. HE SAID THERE WOULD BE NO PROBLEM ON COMPENSATION, SINCE GOI ACCEPTED IT LIABILITY. I TOLD HIM THAT SNIPER ATTACKS WERE CONTINUING. THE PREVIOUS NIGHT, MY HOUSE HAD BEEN HIT, THE CHANCERY HAD TAKEN THREE NEW BULLET HOLES IN ITS WINDOWS, AND ONE OF OUR MUJAHEDIN GUARDS HAD RECEIVED A FLESH WOUND WHEN THE GATE TO MY RESIDENCE HAD BEEN SPRAYED BY AUTOMATIC WEAPONS FIRED FROM A PASSING CAR.

SANJABI ASKED IF I HAD NOTIFIED THE PROPER AUTHORITIES. I ASKED WHO WERE THE PROPER AUTHORITIES. THIS LED TO A DISCUSSION OF BAZARGAN'S SPEECH COMPLAINING OF THE VARIOUS GROUPS ATTEMPTING TO ASSERT CONTROL AT THIS TIME. I ASKED HOW SERIOUSLY I SHOULD REGARD BAZARGAN'S THREAT TO RESIGN. HE SAID IT WAS NOT TO BE CONSIDERED SERIOUS, SINCE BAZARGAN HAD AN OBLIGATION TO FULFILL.

WE THEN TALKED ABOUT COMMUNIST EFFORTS TO DEIMANTLE THE ARMED FORCES. SANJABI SAID THOSE WOULD BE DEFEATED AND PROFESSIONAL DEFENSE FORCES WOULD BE PRESERVED. HE SAID THAT QOVERNMENT REALIZED THE GREAT DANGER OF LOSING ALL SEMBLANCE OF NATIONAL DEFENSE, BUT HAD A HARD TIME GETTING ITS YOUNG REVOLUTIONARIES TO ACCEPT THE "OLD ARMY."

I THEN REVIEWED THE STATUS OF THE RESIDUAL ARMISH/MAAG GROUP AND SAID BAZARGAN HAD ASKED ME TO KEEP A SMALL NUCLEUS INTACT UNTIL ARRANGEMENTS COULD BE MADE FOR THEM TO TALK WITH THE MINISTRY OF DEFENSE. I DISCUSSED THE SUGGESTION I HAD MADE TO ENTEZAM ABOUT UTILIZING GENERAL MASSUMI AS A POINT OF CONTACT. SANJABI SAID THE SUBJECT HAD BEEN DISCUSSED IN A CABINET MEETING THAT MORNING AND HE WAS SURE IT WOULD SOON BE RESOLVED. HE ASKED ME TO KEEP THE GROUP HERE UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE.

AS WITH BAZARGAN, I RAISED THE QUESTION OF FUTURE INTELLIGENCE COLLABORATION, PARTICULARLY AS IT INVOLVED THE TWO TACHSMAN SITES. LIKE BAZARGAN, SANJABI SAID THIS ISSUE HAD YET TO BE STUDIED, BUT THAT THE DECISION HAD BEEN MADE TO PROTECT THE INSTALLATIONS AT THE TWO SITES.

WE THEN TURNED TO THE ACTIONS BEING TAKEN BY THE U.S. GOVERNMENT WITH RESPECT TO FMS CONTRACTS. I SAID THESE WERE BEING HANDLED IN SUCH A WAY AS TO MINIMIZE THE IMPACT ON IRAN'S OBLIGATIONS. HOWEVER, I SAID THAT IRAN WOULD CONTINUE TO NEED SOME SPARE PARTS AND OTHER LOGISTICS IF ITS WEAPONS WERE NOT TO BECOME MUSEUM PIECES. SANJABI SAID HE UNDERSTOOD THAT AND THEY WOULD NEED TO TALK TO US FURTHER. ONCE AGAIN, I SUGGESTED MASSUMI AS A VALUABLE INTERLOCUTOR.

NEXT, I RAISED THE QUESTION OF THE ICA BUILDING. SANJABI SAID CABINET HAD DECIDED THAT MORNING TO RETURN IT TO US. I SAID THEY MIGHT HAVE TO SHOOT THEIR WAY IN SINCE IT WAS OCCUPIED BY FEDAYEEN. HE SAID THEY WERE PREPARED ACCEPT THAT RESPONSIBILITY.

I SPOKE ABOUT OUR NEED FOR ACCESS TO GULF DISTRICT IN ORDER OBTAIN FILES WHICH HAD RECORDS OF IRANIAN EMPLOYEES WE WISHED TO PAY OFF. HE SAID THAT, IN PRINCIPLE, HE AGREED AND WOULD SEEK TO ARRANGE ACCESS.

IN DISCUSSION DAMAGE TO OUR COMPOUND, I SAID WE WOULD SHORTLY NEED TO BRING IN COMMUNICATIONS EQUIPMENT (TO RESTORE OUR EARTH SATELLITE TERMINAL). I POINTED OUT RECIPROCITY WITH IRANIAN EMBASSY RADIO COMMUNICATIONS IN WASHINGTON. HE AGREED WE COULD BRING IN EQUIPMENT AND INSTRUCTED GOODARZNIA TO ARRANGE IT.

I TOLD HIM WE HAD SUSPENDED CONSULAR ACTIVITY UNTIL WE COULD MAKE REPAIRS TO OUR OFFICE BUILDINGS. WHEN WE RESUMED, I EXPECTED OUR WORK TO BE AT A REDUCED LEVEL. I ASKED WHETHER GOI HAD A POLICY ON VISITORS AND TRAVELLERS TO THE U.S. HE SAID IT WOULD BE THE SAME AS BEFORE, AND THAT IRANIAN STUDENTS WOULD BE ENCOURAGED TO STUDY IN THE U.S. (THIS MAY REQUIRE A LARGER CONSULAR SECTION THAN PLANNED.)

FINALLY, I ASKED WHETHER HE WANTED TO SAY ANYTHING IN GENERAL ABOUT IRANIAN FOREIGN POOLICY AS IT AFFECTED THE U.S. HE FIRST MUTTERED SOMETHING ABOUT DIFFICULTY OF FORGETTING OUR CLOSE TIES TO THE SHAH, BUT THEN WENT ON TO SAY THAT NEW GOVERNMENT RECOGNIZED OUR "MUTUAL INTERESTS" AND ALSO IRAN'S "SENSITIVE GEOPOLITICAL SITUATIN." THEY HOPED TO HAVE CLOSE RELATIONS WITH US IN ALL FIELDS, EXCEPT THAT THE NATURE OF OUR SECURITY ASSOCIATIONS WOULD HAVE TO CHANGE. I DECIDED NOT RPT NOT TO PRESS HIM FOR MORE DETAILS AND CLOSED THE INTERVIEW AT THAT POINT.

AS I WAS LEAVING, SANJABI SPOKE TO ME RATHER QUICKLY IN FRENCH, WHICH NEITHER OF HIS COLLEAGUES UNDERSTAND. HE SAID HE WAS NOT PARTICULARLY PLEASED TO BE FOREIGN MINISTER, THE JOB DIDN'T ESPECIALLY INTEREST HIM AND HE FELT LEFT OUT OF THE CENTRAL POLITICAL PROCESS. HE SAID HE WOULD TRY TO RETAIN AS MANY AS POSSIBLE OF THE NON-POLITICAL PROFESSIONALS, "ALL OF WHOM ARE GOOD FRIENDS OF THE U.S." AND WOULD LET THE MINISTRY BE RUN BY THOSE WHO KNOW SOMETHING ABOUT THE BUSINESS OF DIPLOMACY.

COMMENT: SANJABI IS TIRED AND DISPIRITED, BORDERING ON THE VERGE OF SENILITY. HE OBVIOUSLY WILL GIVE NO STRONG DIRECTION TO HIS MINISTRY. IF THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT SURVIVES AND HE REMAINS AS FOREIGN MINISTER, WE SHOULD HAVE FAIRLY SMOOTH SAILING WITH THE PROFESSIONALS. SULLIVAN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT.)

SUMMARY: IN A LONG TELEVISED SPEECH TO THE NATION ON 28 FEB, PM BAZARGAN TOOK A FIRM STAND AGAINST MANY OF THE ACTS BEING PERFORMED BY LOCAL "COMMITTEE" AND RADICAL POLITICAL GROUPS, CLAIMING THAT SOME COMMITTEE MEMBERS WERE TRYING TO RUN A PARALLEL GOVERNMENT WHICH THREATENED HIS OWN AND THAT THE ACTIVITIES OF CERTAIN OTHER RADICAL GROUPS COULD TURN IRAN INTO ANOTHER LEBANON. END. SUMMARY.

IN HIS SEVER INDICTMENT OF CERTAIN COMMITTEE ACTIVITIES, BAZARGAN REFERRED TO THE ATTACK ON A "FOREIGN EMBASSY" AS AN EXAMPLE OF COMMITTEE MEMBERS' TAKING POLITICAL ACTION INTO THEIR OWN HANDS, AND EXPLAINED AT LENGTH THE PEPERCUSSIONS THAT MIGHT HAVE FOLLOWED, INCLUDING INTERVENTION BY THE FOREIGN POWER INVOLVED. THE PM EXPLAINED AT SOME LENGTH THAT SUCH ATTACKXNON FOREIGN EMBASSIES, AND ON FOREIGNERS RESIDENT IN IRAN WERE DAMAGING IRAN'S REPUTATION AND THAT OF KHOMEINI THROUGHOUT THE WORLD. BARZAGAN ATTACKED COMMITTEE GROUPS FOR TRYING TO RUN A GOVERNMENT PARALLEL BUT OPPOSED TO HIS OWN, CITING THE EXAMPLES OF COMMITTEE MEMXBERS MAKING ARRESTS, ISSUING ORDERS, AND REFUSING TO ACKNOWLEDGE NEW GOVERNMENT APPOINTMENTS.

ADDRESSING OTHER COMMENTS AT THE "LEFTIST" GROUPS, THE PM STRONGLY ATTACKED THEIR CALLING FOR THE DISSOLUTION OF THE ARMY, AND RADICAL ATTEMPTS TO DISRUPT THE OIL INDUSTRY. IN WHAT WAS A VERY STRONG PLEA OF SUPPORT FOR THE MILITARY, THE PM EXPLAINED AT LENGTH THAT IRAN AS A NSVION WOULD BE HELPLESS UNLESS THE ARMY WAS NOT BROUGHT BACK TOGETHER IMMEDIATELY. HE CLAIMED THAT THE YOUNG REVOLUTIONARIES COULD SIMPLY NOT COPE EFFECTIVELY WITH SECURITY IN THE CITIES OR NEAR THE BORDERS BECAUSE OF THEIR LACK OF TRAINING AND DISCIPLINE.

REFERRING TO THOSE WHO CLAIMED THE OLD ARMY WAS NOT LOYAL TO THE "REVOLUTION," THE PM REMINDED EVERYONE THAT UP UNTIL A SHORT TIME AGO, ALL IRANIANS HAD BEEN CONNTECTD WITH THE SHAH'S REGIME. HE SAID THE ARMY SHOULD NOT BE SINGLED OUT AS COUNTER REVOLUTIONARIES NOW FOR WHAT ALMOST EVERYONE IN IRAN HAD BEEN DOIHH.

IN A SEPARATE REFERENCE TO THE TROUBLES IN RESTAN, BAZARGAN SAID THAT THE KURDS SHOULD BE PATIENT, SINCE NOT ONLY THE KURDS, BUT THE WHOLE COUNTRY HAD "CHAFED UNDER REPRESSION," AND THAT ALL THE PROBLEMS OF YEARS PAST COULD NOT BE SOLVED IMMEDIATELY.

COMMENT: BAZARGAN'S INDICTMENT OF SOME COMMITTEE MEMBERS' ACTIONS HAS ALREADY BEEN EXPRESSED COUNTLESS TIMES IN PROVATE CONVERSATIONS BY OTHER IRANIAN OFFICIALS TO SEVERAL EMBOFFS, WITH HIS OPENDECLARATION ON TV THAT COMMITTEE MEMBERS OFTEN ACT OF THEIR OWN ACCORD WITHOUT THE KNOWLEDGE OF KHOMEINI OR THE GOVERNMENT, HIS CLAIM THAT THE GREAT MAJORITY OF THE PEOPLE WERE BEHIND THE GOVERNMENT, AND HIS CALL TO "COME KRWARD, DEFEND THE GOVERNMENT BECAUSE IT'S YOUR OWN GOVERNMENT," THE PM IS PUBLICLY DECLARING A SOMEWHAT INDEPENDENT POSTURE FROM THE MANY FACTIONS WHICH CIRCLE KHOMEINI AND THEORETICALLY, AT LEAST, ACT IN HIS NAME.
(C-ENTIRE TEXT)

WHEN I SPOKE WITH FOREIGN MINISTER SANJABI MORNING MARCH 1, HE MENTIONED FACT THAT SHARIAR ROUHANI HAD SPOKEN WITH SECRETARY VANCE. HE WANTED US TO KNOW THAT ROUHANI DID NOT RPT NOT REPRESENT IRANIAN GOVERNMENT. HE SAID HE WAS NICE YOUNG MAN WHO WAS SON-IN-LAW OF YAZDI, BUT HAD NO RPT NO OFFICIAL POSITION. U.S. COULD DEAL WITH HIM "OFFICIEUSEMENT" BUT OFFICIAL REPRESENTATIVE WAS CHARGE WHOSE NAME I CAUGHT AS FAGHEH. HE SAID MORE SENIOR REPRESENTATIVE WOULD SOON BE NAMED.
I THEN ASKED ABOUT STATUS OF EX-SENATOR ABOURIEZK WHO SAID HE WAS LEGAL COUNSEL OF GOI. SANJABI SAID THEY KNEW THE MAN'S NAME, BUT HE HAD NO RPT NO CONNECTION WITH GOI.

COMMENT: AS DEPARTMENT WILL GATHER FROM BAZARGAN'S SPEECH LAST NIGHT, HE AND HIS GOVERNMENT ARE VERY SENSITIVE TO WHAT THEY REGARD AS USURPATIONS OF AUTHORITY BY ALL SORTS OF SELF-APPOINTED IRANIAN "AUTHORITIES." I REALIZE THAT YOUNG ROUHANI MAY APPEAR TO BE HELPFUL, BUT DEPT SHOULD UNDERSTAND THAT BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT REGARDS HIS ILK WITH SUSPICION AND RESENTMENT. THIS GOVERNMENT MAY NOT REPRESENT VERY MUCH AT THIS TIME BUT, IF WE WISH IT TO PERSEVERE, WE WILL HAVE TO RESPECT ITS INTEGRITY AND AUTHORITY. SULLIVAN NOTE: RECATEGORIZED TO EXDIS - PER STATE 051779

(U) THE FOLLOWING IS THE RELEVANT PORTION OF MINISTER MINACHI'S REMARKS REGARDING CORRUPT PRACTICES INVOLVING A HELICOPTER DEAL: A TOTAL OF 7,000 MILLION RIALS ($100 MILLION) WAS PAID IN BRIBES RELATED TO THE PURCHASE OF HELICOPTERS FOR IRAN, MINISTER OF INFORMTION NASSER MINACHI REVEALED YESTERDAY. SPEAKING TO EMPLOYEES OF PARS NEWS AGENCY YESTERDAY, MINACHI SAID IT WAS IMPOSSIBLE TO ENUMERATE THE CORRUPT PRACTICES OF THE SHAH'S REGIME, BUT THE EXTENT OF THE CORRUPTION COULD BE JUDGED FROM THE SIZE OF THE BRIBE INVOLVED IN JUST ONE HELICOPTER DEAL. END .

(C) IN MEETING WITH POLOFFS STEMPEL AND TOMSETH MARCH 1, MINACHI SAID THAT HIS REMARKS TO PARS NEWS AGENCY EMPLOYEES WERE INTENDED TO ILLUSTRATE THE DEGREE OF CORRUPTION IN PAHLAVI REGIME. HE SAID THAT HE DID NOT MEAN TO IMPLY THAT BHI WAS ITSELF INVOLVED IN CORRUPT PRACTICES. HE THEN WENT ON TO DESCRIBE NUMEROUS KICK BACK ARRANGEMENTS BETWEEN ABOL FAHT MAHVI AND VARIOUS IRANIAN GOVERNMENT AGENCIES WHICH COME TO LIGHT THROUGH FILES DISCOVERED IN THE PUBLIC PROSECUTOR'S OFFICE AT THE MINISTRY OF JUSTICE. (SEPTEL).

(C) IN VIEW OF MINACHI'S ASSURANCE THAT HE WAS SPEAKING ABOUT AN ESSENTIALLY INTERNAL MATTER THERE MAY BE LESS PROSPECT THAT BHI OFFICIALS COULD BE ARRESTED BY THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT IN CONNECTION WITH BRIBERY CHARGES. THEY COULD STILL BE ARRESTED BY SOME "COMMITTEE" HOWEVER, WE STILL BELIEVE THAT THIS IS A POTENTIALLY EXPLOSIVE POLITICAL ISSUE, THE SERIOUSNESS OF WHICH THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT ITSELF MAY NOT APPRECIATE. THE MINISTER-COUNSELOR CONVEYED OUR CONCERNS TO BHI'S PENNINGTON ON MARCH 1. REITERATED OUR VIEW THAT A MEETING NOW WOULD BE PREMATURE, AND THAT THE EMBASSY WOULD NOT BE PREPARED TO PARTICIPATE IN IT.

PENNINGTON CONCEDED THAT THE PROPOSED VISIT OF A SEVEN-MEMBER BHI DELEGATION HEADED BY WILLIAMS MIGHT BE PROVOCATIVE AT THIS TIME, AND SAID HE WOULD CONTACT BHI IN THE U.S. TO SUGGEST THAT MCKINNON COME ALONE. HOWEVER, HE DID NOT APPEAR INCLINED TO RECOMMEND THAT BHI SEEK TO POSTPONE THE MEETING SCHEDULED FOR MARCH 4.
(C) FYI: BHI NOW HAS EIGHT AMERIANS REMAINING IN IRAN. ALL OF WHOM EXCEPT PENNINGTON ARE INVOLVED IN WICJING UP THE AFFAIRS OF BHI PERSONNEL WHO WERE EVACUATED. SULLIVAN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)

IN RESPONSE TO A QUESTION FROM POLOFFS STEMPEL AND TOMSETH ON MARCH 1 REGARDING A STATEMENT ATTRIBUTED TO MINISTER OF INFORMATION, TOURISM AND CHARITIES DR. NASSER MINACHI (STRONGLY PROTECT THAT A $100 MILLION DOLLAR BRIBE HAD BEEN PAID IN CONJUCTION WITH A HELICOPTER DEAL. MINACHI SAID THAT HIS GOVERNMENT HAD PROOF OF WIDE SCALE CORRUPTION AT THE HIGHEST LEVELS OF THE PAHLAVI REGIME, UPTO AND INCLUDING THE SHAH'S FAMILY. HE THEN PRODUCED A FILE WHICH HE SAID HAD BEEN DISCOVERED AT THE MINISTRY OF JUSTICE AND WAS THE RECORD OF AN INVESTIGATION CONDUCTED SEVERAL YEARS AGO BY THE PUBLIC PROSECUTOR.

ACCORDING TO MINACHI, THE FINDINGS OF THE PUBLIC PROSECUTOR HAD BEEN SQUELCHED UPON THE SHAH'S PERSONAL ORDER. HE THEN READ EXCERPTS FROM THE FILE, MOST OF WHICH CONCERNED THE ACTIVITIES OF ABOL FAHT MAHVI WHO, MANACHI SAID, HAD BEEN GIVEN EXCLUSIVE AGENCY RIGHTS IN A NUMBER OF AREAS RANGING FROM HELICOPTERS TO COMPUTERS. ACCORDING TO THE FILE, MAHVI RECEIVED KICK BACKS ON NUMEROUS DEALS HE ARRANGED WITH FOREIGN CONTRACTORS--NOT FROM THE CONTRACTORS, BUT FROM THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT ITSELF--WHICH RAN TO TENS OF MILLION DOLLARS.

MINACHI INTIMATED THAT MAHVI HAD BEEN FAVORED IN THIS WAY BECAUSE OF HIS ROLE AS BAG MAN FOR NUMEROUS MEMBERS OF THE ROYAL FAMILY (H CITED REFERENCES TO SEVERAL PAHLAVIS FROM THE FILE TO SUBSTANTIATE THIS) AND AS THE SHAH'S OWN PIMP. MINACHI INDICATED THAT EVERY EFFORT WOULD BE MADE TO BRING THOSE IMPLICATED TO BAR BEFORE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS, BUT THIS MAY PROVE DIFFICULT SINCE MANY OF THE BIGGEST FISH, INCLUDING MAHVI HIMSELF, HAVE LONG SINCE ABSCONDED.

THE SIGNIFICANCE OF MINACHI'S FILE IS NOT THE CASE THAT IT MAKES AGAINST THOSE CHARGED WITH CORRUPTION (INDEED, MUCH OF THE MATERIAL WAS HAND-WRITTEN, INDICATING THAT IT MIGHT BE NO MORE THAN THE RESULTS OF A PRELIMINARY INVESTIGATION), BUT, RATHER, ITS LIKELY PSYCHOLOGICAL IMPACT ON THE IRANIAN PUBLIC. AS WITH SENATOR JOSEPH MC CARTHY'S LISTS OF COMMUNISTS, THE FILE IS APT TO BE BROADLY ACCEPTED AS INCONTROVERTIBLE EVIDENCE OF CORRUPTION IN HIGH PLACES IN THE PAHLAVI REGIME, AN ACCEPTANCE THAT MAY NOT BE WARRANTED IN SPECIFIC INSTANCES BY ACTUAL FACT.

THE SIGNIFICANCE (AND DANGER) FOR US IS THAT MUCH OF THE WHEELING AND DEALING DOCUMENTED IN THE FILE INVOLVED FOREIGN CONCERNS, OFTEN AMERICAN. AS IN THE CASE OF BHI, THOSE CONCERNS AND HENCE THE U.S. MAY BE CAUGHT UP WILL-NILLY IN ACCUSATION AND ACRIMONY IRRESPECTIVE OF GUILT OR INNOCENCE.

DR. RAHIM ABEDI WAS APPOINTED CHAIRMAN OF THE BOARD AND MANAGING DIRECTOR OF THE NATIONAL PETROCHEMICALS INDUSTRIES COMPANY. DR. ABEDI IS 64 YEARS OLD AND WAS EDUCATED IN FRANCE AND GERMANY. HE WAS FORMERLY A PROFESSOR AND HEAD OF TEHRAN POLYTECHNIC.

NEWSPAPERS REPORT THAT MARXIST AGITATION CONTINUES WITHIN THE NATIONAL IRANIAN OIL COMPANY. WORKERS HAVE DEMANDED REDISTRIBUTION OF INCOME, AN END TO FOREIGN CONTROL OF THE INDUSTRY AND THE RIGHT TO REJECT MANAGEMENT APPOINTEES. THEY ALSO EXPECT IRAN TO PUSH FOR FURTHER BOOSTS IN OIL PRICES, AND THREATEN TO RESUME THEIR STRIKE IF THEIR DEMANDS ARE NOT MET. THE TEHRAN JOURNAL ALSO INCLUDED A REPORT OF AN ATTEMPT, ON OR ABOUT FEBRUARY 25TH, TO TURN OF A MAJOR PIPELINE NEAR AHWAZ. THE PLOT WAS NEUTRALIZED WITH NO MAJOR DAMAGE.
TWO THIRDS OF THE JAPANESE WORKFORCE IS BEING REMOVED FROM THE PETROCHEMICAL PLANT SITE AT BANDAR SHAPOUR, BUT, SAY MITSUI OFFICIALS THIS DOES NOT MEAN THE CANCELLATION OF THE PROJECT.
(C) ENTIRE TEXT.

SUMMARY: GOI ANNOUNCES REFERENDUM FOR 30 MARCH. BAZARGAN ATTACKS SOME COMMITTEE AND OTHER POLITICAL GROUP ACTIVITIES ON NATION-WIDE TV BROADCAST. KHOMEINI GIVES MESSAGE TO NATION BEFORE RETURNING TO QOM. SHAKEUPS CONTINUE IN GOVERNMENT MINISTRIES. EVACUATION OF USAF PERSONNEL FROM KAPCAN RECEIVES COVERAGE. FACT FINDING MISSION GIVES REPORT ON KURDISH SITUATION. NEW APPOINTMENTS. END SUMMARY.

THE GOI HAS ANNOUNCED A REFERENDUM FOR 30 MARCH, TO BE LIMITED TO A SINGLE PROPOSAL, THE APPROVAL OF THE REPLACEMENT OF THE FORMER REGIME WITH AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. THE CONSTITUTION FOR THE REPUBLIC WOULD BE APPROVED SUBSEQUENTLY BY CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY. VOTING RIGHTS HAVE BEEN EXTENDED TO ALL IRANIANS OVER SIXTEEN YEARS OF AGE. KHOMEINI HAS ALREADY URGED EVERYONE TO VOTE "YES." GIVEN MECHANICS OF BALLOTING. A RESOUNDING YES VOTE IS EXPECTED.
BAZARGAN'S SPEECH REPORTED SEPTEL.

IN A 14 POINT MESSAGE TO THE NATION BEFORE DEPARTING FOR QOM, KHOMEINI SPOKE AGAINST "COLONIALISM" IN IRAN, AND URGED IRANIANS TO ELIMINATE ALL ASPECTS OF AMERICAN MILITARY, ECONOMIC, CULTURAL AND POLITICAL INFLUENCE FROM IRAN "AS SOON AS POSSIBLE." WITH OTHER BARBS AIMED AT THE SOVIET UNION, THE UK, ZIONISM, AND LEFTIST ELEMENTS, KHOMEINI ALSO AGAIN ASKED THAT NO ONE ATTACK POLICE AND ARMY POSTS, PRIVATE HOMES, ETC., AND RECOMMENDED THAT WATER AND ELECTRICITY BE FREE TO THE POOR UNDER THE NEW GOVERNMENT.

THE MINISTRY OF ECONOMICS AND FINANCE HAS ANNOUNCED ORGANIZATIONAL CHANGES WHICH WILL ELIMINATE 237 POSITIONS, INCLUDING STAFFS AT 10 FOREIGN CENTERS. NIRT HEAD QOTBZADEH HAS ANNOUNCED DISMISSAL OF FIFTY PERSONNEL DESCRIBED AS " TOP DIRECTORS."

BOTH KAYHAN AND TEHRAN JOURNAL GAVE FRONT PAGE COVERAGE TO EVACUATION OF U.S. PERSONNEL FROM KAPCAN, DESCRIBED AS A "US SPY STATION," ON 27 FEB. IN CONFUSING ACCOUNTS, THE PAPERS CLAIM THT THE EVACUATION CAME AFTER A GUN BATTELE OF SEVERAL DAYS, WHEN THE STATION WAS FIRST ATTACKED BY MILITIAMEN, WHO SEIZED TOP-SECRET DEVICES, AND THEN RECAPTURED BY IRAN AIR FORCE PERSONNEL.

MIN. OF LABOUR AND SOCIAL AFFAIRS FOROUHAR HAS RETURNED FROM A FACT FINDING MISSION TO KURDESTAN, CLAIMING THE UNREST IS "SERIOUS, BUT NOT EXPLOSIVE." ACCORDING TO GOVERNMENT SPOKESMEN, THE KURDS WANT AUTONOMY, BUT NOT A SEPARATION FROM IRAN.
THE IRANIAN PRESS HAS ANNOUNCED THE APPOINTMENTS OF NOSRATOLLAH AMINI AS GOVERNOR GENERAL OF FARS PROVINCE, AND OF NOSRATOLLAH GORJI AS GOVERNOR GENERAL TO HORMOZGAN
(S - ENTIRE TEXT.)
I STRONGLY RECOMMEND AGAINST THE IDEA OF A CALL ON AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI. THERE ARE SEVERAL FACTORS WHICH MILITATE AGAINST SUCH AN IDEA.

FIRST IS THE FACT THAT KHOMEINI HAS DELIBERATELY WITHDRAWN FROM THE SECULAR SCENE IN TEHRAN AND GONE INTO A RELIGIOUS MILIEU IN QOM. THIS ACTION HAS BEEN TAKEN IN PART TO PROVE THE POINT THAT THE FUNCTIONING OF GOVERNMENT IS IN THE HANDS OF BAZARGAN AND THAT HE IS MERELY A SPIRITUAL SUPERVISOR.

SECOND IS THE FACT THAT BAZARGAN IS DESPERATELY TRYING TO ESTABLISH HIS OWN AUTHORITY AND THAT ANY CALL BY THE AMERICAN AMBASSADOR ON KHOMEINI WOULD BE PUBLICLY SEEN AS UNDERCUTTING THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT. I BELIEVE BAZARGAN AND HIS ASSOCIATES IN GOVERNMENT WOULD DEEPLY RESENT IT.
THIRD IS THE FACT THAT THE AYATOLLAH SENT A SENIOR MULLZH TO SEE ME AND THAT WE HAVE HAD AN EXCHANGE OF SATISFACTORY SENTIMENTS THROUGH THAT CHANNEL.

FOURTH IS THE FACT THAT NO RPT NO OTHER AMBASSADOR EXCEPT THE SOVIET HAS CALLED ON THE AYATOLLAH. HIS CALL IS GENERALLY VIEWED HERE AS A HEAVY-HANDED GAFFE. HE WAS TREATED TO A PUBLIC LECTURE ON IRAN'S INDEPENDENCE AND ACCUSED OF INTERFERENCE IN IRAN'S AFFAIRS. IT IS WISE TO LEAVE THAT INCIDENT SINGLED OUT IN IRANIAN MINDS.

FOR YOUR INFORMATION, I WAS APPROACHED BY A REPRESENTATIVE OF THE COMMITTEE A FEW DAYS AFTER THE SOVIET AMBASSADOR'S VISIT TO THE AYATOLLAH, AND ASKED IF I WISHED TO HAVE A MEETING ARRANGED. I ASKED WHETHER THE AYATOLLAH HAD EXPRESSED INTEREST IN MEETING ME AND WAS TOLD THAT HE HAD NOT. I REPLIED THAT, IN THAT CASE, I PREFERRED TO LEAVE MATTERS WHERE THEY STOOD WITH THE INDIRECT EXCHANGE WHICH I HAD ALREADY HAD THROUGH THE MULLAH ROUHANI.

MY BASIC REASON FOR THIS POSITION IS MY CONVICTION THAT, IF I HAD MADE A CALL ON THE AYATOLLAH, HE WOULD HAVE BEEN COMPELLED TO MAKE A BLAST AT ME PARALLEL TO THAT WHICH HE HAD MADE AT THE SOVIET. MY COMMITTEE INTERLOCUTOR AGREED THAT WAS PROBABLY SO.

THEREFORE, PLEASE ABANDON ANY THOUGHTS OF HAVING ME CALL ON KHOMEINI. A CALL BY A U.S. REPRESENTATIVE IN PARIS IN JANUARY SHOULD HAVE BEEN MADE. A CALL BY MY SUCCESSOR OR BY A SPECIAL EMISSARY AFTER I AM GONE MIGHT BE CONSIDERED, BUT, AGAIN, AT SOME RISK. A CALL IN THE CURRENT CIRCUMSTANCES AND THE CURRENT TIME-FRAME WOULD BE AN ERROR.

1979TEHRAN02681.subject: THE IRANIAN LEFT: MARXIST, NOT ISLAMIC, AND GROWING

segments.text: (C) ENTIRE TEXT.

SUMMARY: PEOPLE'S FEDAYEEN (PF), MIOITANT WING OF LEFTIST OPPOSITION TO ISLAMIC REVOLUTION, APPEARS WELL ORGANIZED, BUT STILL SUFFERS LEADERSHIP WEAKNESS. STRONG PALESTTINIAN FLAVOR TO PF ORGANIZATION. SMALLER COMMUNIST GROUPS WARRING WITH EACH OTHER. ANTI-AMERICANISM IS DOMINANT THEME OF IDEOLOGY, CLOSELY FOLLOWED BY CALL FOR "PURE" DEMOCRACY. MAJOR LEFT PUSH NOT FORESEEN BY SOME UNTIL CONSTITUTIONAL ASSEMBLY ELECTIONS, BUT PF WILL KEEP STEADY PRESSURE ON GOI.

IN DISCUSSION WITH SEVERAL KNOWLEDGEABLE IRANIANS AND ONE WESTERN JOURNALIST WHO HAD A TOUR OF PF HEADQUARTERS, POLOFF DEVELOPED FOLLOWING IMPRESSIONS OF PF AND OTHER MARXIST GROUPS WHO HAVE SURFACED ON IRANIAN SCENE.

LARGEST AND MOST IMPORTANT GROUP, NUMBERING SOME 5,000 INDIVIDUALS IN SEVERAL UNITS (BY THEIR OWN COUNT GIVEN TO JOURNALIST) IS THE PF (FORMERLY IDENTIFIED IN EMBASSY REPORTING AS CHARIK-E-FEDAYE-KHALQ). IT HAS ESTABLISHED A CENTRAL OFFICE JUST NORTH OF TEHRAN UNIVERSITY WHICH HAS PRESS SECTION AND DIFFERENT DIVISIONS TO HANDLE ORGANIZATION'S ADMINISTRATIVE BUSINESS. JOURNALIST WHO VISITED OFFICE WAS IMPRESSED WITH ADMINISTRATIVE ORGANIZATION, BUT SAID LEADERSHIP REMAINS A PROBLEM. THERE IS NO SINGLE LEADER OR SET OF LEADERS WHO HAVE SURFACED TO TAKE RECOGNIZED COMMAND OF ORGANIZATION. THERE ARE "MANY INDIANS BUT NO CHIEFS" (OR MANY CHIEFS AND NO INDIANS, ACCORDING TO OTHERS WITH CONTACTS TO GROUP).

BASIC STRENGTH OF FEDAYEEN IS CADRE OF THOSE WHO HAVE RECEIVED SUBSTANTIAL TRAINING AT PLO HANDS. THIS IS REFLECTED IN PLO BIAS--IN ITS PUBLIC STATEMENTS AND ITS ORGANIZATIONAL TECHNIQUES. SEVERAL BELIEVE IT HAS SUCCESSFULLY INFILTRATED PARTS OF ISLAMIC MOVEMENT. IN PAST WEEK, TWO THEMES HAVE STOOD OUT AS PF ATTEMPTS TO ESTABLISH ITSELF AS IMPORTANT POLITICAL ORGANIZATION: FIRST IS ANTI-MAERICANISM (MIXED WITH ANTI-IMPERIALISM AND ANTI-ZIONISM) KEYED TO REMOVAL OF REMANTS OF U.S. AND C.I.A. INFLUENCE FROM IRAN. AT LEAST TWO SOURCES BELIEVE AMERICAN EMBASSY REMAINS AT LEAST SYMBOLIC TARGET OF GROUP FOR THIS REASON. FURTHER ATTACK ON EMBASSY NOT RPT NOT RULED OUT.
PF HAS STARTED TO ESTABLISH (OR SURFACE) BRANCHES ELSEWHERE IN COUNTRY--PRESS MARCH 4 ANNOUNCED PF HEADQUARTERS HAS BEEN SET UP IN ABADAN.

SECOND THEME IS NECESSITY TO CONTINUE REVOLUTION TO ITS NATURAL CONCLUSION, INCLUDING ESTABLISHMENT OF "PURE" DEMOCRACY (I.E., ONE NOT "RESTRICTED" BY ISLAMIC IDEALS-SEE SEPTEL ON THIS AS BASIC POLITICAL ISSUE). IN THIS CATEGORY ARE CALLS FOR REVOLUTIONARY NATIONAL GUARD TO REPLACE ARMY; CONTROL OF INDUSTRIES, BANKS, ETC., BY "PEOPLE'S COMMITTEES," AND ATTACKS ON GOVERNMENT ADHERENCE TO ISLAMIC IDEOLOGY AS TOO NARROW.

PF AND OTHER LEFTIST GROUPS HAVE ALSO MADE SPECIAL EFFORT AMONG UNIVERSITY STUDENTS. DESPITE CLAIMS OF FORMAL REMOVAL OF PF FROM TEHRAN UNIVERSITY, IRANIAN UNIVERSITY CONTACTS REPORT THEIR PRESENCE IS CONSTANT AND SUBSTANTIAL, THOUGH TENDING TO CHANNEL ITSELF INTO IDEOLOGICAL DEBATE RATHER THAN AN ARMED PRESENCE.

THERE ARE AT LEAST THREE OTHER IDENTIFIABLE MARXIST GROUPS CURRENTLY ON IRANIAN SCENE, BUT NONE HAVE ARMED WINGS (AT LEAST NONE THAT HAVE GONE PUBLIC). FIRST IS OLD LINE TUDEH ORGANIZATION, WHICH HAS NOT BEEN ESPECIALLY ACTIVE INSIDE IRAN--APPARENTLY MANY OF ITS MEMBERS WENT OVER TO THE PF IN THE DYNAMIC UNFOLDING OF THE REVOLUTION. SECOND IS COMMUNIST PARTY OF IRAN (CPI), WHICH CLAIMS TO BE SEPARATE FROM TUDEH, HAS BEEN ACTIVE ON THE UNIVERSITY CAMPUSES, AND IS APPARENTLY MORE CLOSELY TIED TO MOSCOW THAN OLD TUDEH ORGANIZATION.

PF WERE ANNOYED ENOUGH BY THIS GROUP TO ISSUE STATEMENT MARCH 3 SAYING THEY HAD NO TIES TO CPI AND CASTIGATING IT FOR BEING "TOOL OF FOREIGN INTERESTS." INTERLEFT STRUGGLE ALSO SAW SECOND OPEN CONFLICT MARCH 3 WHEN MEMBERS OF CPI OR FEDAYEEN (SOME CONFUSION HERE) ATTACKED MEETING OF THIRD MARXIST GROUP, IRANIAN SOCIALIST WORKERS'S PARTY (ISWP), ONE OF WHOSE FOUNDERS IS REZA BARAHENI. PARTY WAS ATTACKED BY GROUP WAVING "YANKEE GO HOME" SIGNS AND POSTERS SAYING "BARAHENI MUST GO." ISWP IS CONSIDERED "TROTSKYITE" FACTION OF MARXIST MOVEMENT BY OTHERS.

MORE RADICAL LEFTISTS HAVE CLEARLY ESTABLISHED THEMSELVES AS FORCE IN IRANIAN POLITICS. THEY HAVE EVEN DRAWN FIRE FROM DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER YAZDI, WHO WARNED THEM TO REMEMBER THAT IRAN'S REVOLUTION IS ISLAMIC, AND THAT EVEN THOUGH MARXISTS ENJOY FREEDOM OF POLITICAL ACTIVITY, THEY MUST NOT ATTACK ISLAMIC BASE OF REVOLUTION. FROM PRACTICAL PERSPECTIVE, SUCH ATTACKS HAVE BEEN GOING ON RIGHT ALONG, AND PF UNITS HAVE BEEN HITTING POLICE STATIONS, AND OTHER INSTALLATIONS ON REGULAR BASIS FOR PAST TWO WEEKS. OPINION IS SOMEWHAT SPLIT ON QUESTION WHETHER PF WILL TRY MAJOR TAKEOVER IN NEAR FUTURE.

SEVERAL KNOWLEDGEABLE OBSERVERS BELIEVE PF WILL MERELY KEEP UP PRESSURE ON NEW GOI AS BOTH RECRUITING DEVICE AND EFFORT TO KEEP GOI OFF BALANCE, SCORING WHAT SUCCESSES IT CAN. IN THIS VIEW, MAJOR LEFTIST PUSH WOULD COME AFTER REFERENDUM AT TIME OF ELECTION FOR CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY, UNLESS ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT DISINTEGRATED UNDER "PINPRICK" BLOWS.

1979TEHRAN02682.subject: POLITICAL ISSUES: THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC AND THE MILITARY

segments.text: (D) TEHRAN 2624 (C - ENTIRE TEXT.)

SUMMARY: MAJOR POLITICAL ISSUE OVER NEXT MONTH OR SIX WEEKS IS LIKELY TO BE TYPE OF REPUBLIC IRAN WILL HAVE. LEFTISTS AND MANY MODERATES ARE UNHAPPY WITH KHOMEINI STATEMENTS ON NARROW ISLAMIC BASE OF REPUBLIC. SOME AYATOLLAHS AND MANY ISLAMIC MOVEMENT POLITICIANS ARE NOT COMFORTABLE, EITHER. QUESTION OF DISPOSITION OF ARMED FORCES AND RELATIONSHIP OF REVOLUTIONARY GUARD TO ARMY IS SECOND MAJOR UNSOLVED PROBLEM FACING IRAN'S NEW RULERS AND THOSE WHO WISH TO PURSUE REVOLUTION FURTHER. END SUMMARY.

OVER PAST FEW DAYS, NUMBER OF GROUPS IN IRAN HAVE COMPLAINED THAT NEW REPUBLICAN CONSTITUTION PROJECTED FOR IRAN WILL BE TOO NARROWLY BASED ON ISLAMIC LAW AND NOT PROVIDE "FREEDOM" WHICH DEMOCRACY SHOULD PROVIDE. FACT THAT KHOMEINI SAID CONSTITUTION WOULD NOT BE MADE PUBLIC UNTIL AFTER REFERENDUM ON ISLAMIC REPUBLIC HAS DRAWN FIRE FROM MANY QUARTERS. PEOPLES' FEDAYEEN (PF), LARGEST AND MOST MILITANT COMMUNIST GROUP, HAS MADE THIS ONE OF ITS THEMES (SEE REF A), AS HAVE OTHER GROUPS.

SOME SUPPORTERS OF OLD REGIME HAVE ALSO TAKEN UP THIS LINE, LEADING AYATOLLAH TALEQANI TO WARN NATION THAT THERE ARE "7 OR 8 THOUSAND" EX-SAVAK MEN (PRESS NEXT DAY ADDED "AND CIA") AGENTS READY TO SUBVERT REVOLUTION.

EMBOFFS' CONTACTS OVER PAST FEW DAYS HAVE ALSO UNCOVERED SUBSTANTIAL UNEASINESS AMONG MODERNIZED IRANIANS WHO HAVE SUPPORTED ISLAMIC REVOLUTION (REF B), BUT WHO UNTIL RECENTLY DID NOT BELIEVE IN THEIR HEARTS THAT KHOMEINI WOULD GO BACK TO STRICT MOSLEM ORTHODOXY. NOW THEY FEAR HE MAY DO SO.

PARTICULARLY POIGNANT ARE CASES OF MODERATE POLITICAL LEADERS IN ISLAMIC MOVEMENT, SUCH AS BAZARGAN AND HIS IMMEDIATE DEPUTIES, WHO HAVE BEEN TELLING EMBOFFS FOR MONTHS THAT "ISLAMIC REPUBLIC" WOULD REALLY LOOK A LOT LIKE A MODERN WESTERN DEMOCRACY. EVEN MODERATE AYATOLLAH SHARIAT-MADARI WENT ON PUBLIC RECORD MARCH 2 WITH STATEMENT SAYING THAT ISLAMIC REPUBLIC WOULD NOT BE 1,000 YEAR THROWBACK. PROBLEM IS COMPLICATED BY FACT THAT REGIME IS HAVING TO DEFEND ITS ISLAMIC BASE FROM LEFTIST ATTACKS WHILE AT SAME TIME TRYING TO MOLLIFY TRADITITIONAL CLERGY AND OTHERS.

THIS IS CLEAREST CURRENT ILLUSTRATION OF PROBLEM KHOMEINI AND BAZARGAN FACE IN TRYING TO INSTALL A NEW POLITICAL SYSTEM ON SUCH A FRAGMENTED BASISCGKSEE REF C). DISCUSSION IS CURRENTLY CENTERING ON WHETHER CONSTITUTION SHOULD BE MADE PUBLIC AFTER REVIEW BY KHOMEINI (BASIC ELEMENTS OF DRAFT CONSTITUTION PROVIDED REF D). OUR INITIAL SOUNDINGS INDICATE CONSTITUTION WILL BE AT LEAST DISCUSSED, IF NOT FULLY REVEALED, AND THAT THE HARD CORE POLITICAL STRUGGLE MANY WELL COME AT THE TIME OF ELECTIONS TO THE CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY WHICH MUST REVIEW AND APPROVE IT.

ONCE MOVE TO ISLAMIC REPUBLIC HAS BEEN APPROVED IN PRINCIPLE (EVEN FEDAYEEN HAVE GONE ON RECORD AS SUPPORTING "YES" VOTE TO DISPOSE OF MONARCH), GOI WILL FACE SAME PROBLEM VICTORIOUS ISLAMIC FORCES FACED AFTER FEB 11-12 "VICTORY" OVER OLD GOVERNMENT: HOW TO KEEP REVOLUTIONARY COALITION TOGETHER. EVERY SMALLER GROUP WHICH HAS ITS OWN IDEAS FOR CONSTITUTION WILL BE LOBBYING FOR ELECTION TO ASSEMBLY, AND FULL FRAGMENTATION OF IRANIAN POLITICAL SCENE WILL BE PAINFULLY OBVIOUS TO ALL. DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER ENTEZAM SAYS STEADFASTLY THAT ISLAMIC MOVWVENT WILL HAVE "OVERWHELMING" MAJORITY OF DELEGATES (MININFO MINATCHI ESTIMATES 85-90 PERCENT), BUT DOES NOT DO SO WITH SAME FIRM CONVICTION HE HAD A WEEK AGO.
CONSTITUTIONAL QUESTION WILL CLEARLY REMAIN FOCUS OF POLITICAL DISCUSSIONSFOR FORESEEABLE FUTURE.

SECOND MAJOR POLITICAL STRUGGLE UNDERWAY CONCERNS FUTURE OF ARMED FORCES AND THEIR RELATIONSHIP TO REVOLUTIONARY GUARD NOW BEING FORMED UNDER DIRECTION OF DEPUTY PM YAZDI. RADICALS IN BOTH FEDAYEEN AND MUJAHIDIN CAMPS SEE REVOLUTIONARY GUARD AS MAJOR ARMED FORCE AND ONLY WAY TO INSURE PURITY OF REVOLUTION. EVEN YAZDI HIMSELF DOES NOT AGREE WITH THIS, AND MANY OTHER POLITICIANS, INCLUDING EX-MILITARY MEN, SEE REVITALIZED ARMED FORCES AS NECESSARY FOR SECURITY OF REVOLUTION AS WELL AS NATION. CURRENT DIALOGUE CENTERS AROUND HOW DEEP PURGES SHOULD GO IN ARMY, AND HOW ARMED FORCES CAN BE RECONSTITUTED ON REVOLUTIONARY BASE IF OFFICERS OF FORMER REGIME ARE USED.

RESULT TO DATE HAS BEEN SHOOTING OF EIGHT TOP MILITARY MEN, AND RETIREMENTS OF ALL THREE AND FOR-STAR GENERALS, PLUS ARRESTS OF OTHERS DOWN TO LEVEL OF LIEUTENANT COLONEL ON A CASE-BY-CASE BASIS. RAPID TURNOVER IN TOP COMMAND JOB IN AIR FORCE, PLUS LACK OF NEW TOP APPOINTMENTS IN OTHER SERVICES, PLUS INSISTENCE OF MANY ENLISTED MEN IN SELECTING THEIR OWN OFICERS HAS FORCED NEW GOI TO GO MORE SLOWLY THAN IT WOULD WISH. IT HAS ALSO HAD CONCOMITANT EFFECT OF POSTPONING GOI DECISION ON SCOPE OF FUTURE U.S.

MILITARY PRESENCE, IF ANY, SINCE THOSE PRESSING FOR COMPLETE REFORM ARE DOING SO AT LEAST IN PART BECAUSE THEY WANT TO ROOT OUT STRONG RESIDUAL U.S. INFLUENCE IN ARMED FORCES (AS YAZDI HAS COMMENTED TO JOURNALISTS AND OTHERS).

STRUGGLE WITHIN AND ABOUT MILITARY MEANS THAT QUESTIONS OF AUTHORITY AND USE OF FORCE (GENDARMERIE AND POLICE ARE AFFECTED BY THIS ARGUMENT, BUT TO A LESSER DEGREE) WILL REMAIN UNSOLVED LONGER THAN GOI WOULD LIKE. RESULT, AT LEAST IN SHORT TERM, IS LIKELY TO BE CONTINUING UNSTABLE SECURITY
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY: KHOMEININ CALLS FOR COMPLETE ISLAMICIZATION OF IRAN. VIOLENCE, EXECUTIONS CONTINUE. SANJABI WARNS AGAINST GIVING SHAH ASYLUM QARANI SAYS IRAN IS A "CONFRONTATION STATE" WITH ISRAEL, SEES REDUCED MILITARY ROLE IN GULF. PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT STILL TRYING TO CURB FREE WHEELING COMMITTEE ACTIVITIES. END SUMMARY.

IN A SPEECH IN QOM MARCH 1 KHOMEINI URGED THAT IRAN BE THOROUGHLY ISLAMICIZED AND BE PURGED OF ALL CORRUPT WESTERN INFLUENCES. HE SAID THAT THE STATE BUREAUCRACY, THE JUDICIARY, EDUCATION, CULTURE AND THE MASS MEDIA WOULD ALL GO THROUGH AN ISLAMIC METAMORPHOSIS. HE URGED THE CREATION OF A MINISTRY FOR "RIGHTEOUS BEHAVIOR AND PREVENTION OF SIN" TO SUPERVISE THE ACHIEVEMENT OF THIS OBJECTIVE.

HE ALSO EQUATED ATTACKS AGAINST THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT WITH A WEAKENING OF ISLAM, AND SAID THAT THE INHERITORS OF THE REVOLUTION SHOULD NOT BE THOSE WHO HAD REMAINED AT ITS FRINGES (USUALLY ABROAD), BUT THOSE WHO HAD LOST THEIR CHILDREN OR OTHER LOVED ONES IN THE STRUGGLE AGAINST THE SHAH. AS USUAL, KHOMEINI SPOKE IN GENERALITIES, PROMISING COMPLETE FREEDOM UNDER AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC, BUT IN EFFECT SAYING THAT THE IRANIAN PEOPLE HAVE NO CHOICE BUT TO ACCEPT THE FORM OF GOVERNMENT HE HAS DECREED FOR THEM.

SPORATIC VIOLENCE CONTINUES BOTH IN TEHRAN AND ELSEWHERE AROUND IRAN. IN THE CAPITAL, ACCORDING TO KAYHAN INTERNATIONAL, THREE PEOPLE WERE KILLED AND SIX OTHERS INJURED IN A SERIES OF GUN BATTLES FRIDAY AND SATURDAY. TEHRAN UNIVERSITY HAS BEEN THE SCENE OF CONTINUING CLASHES BETWEEN RIVAL GROUPS CONTENDING FOR POWER ON CAMPUS AND BETWEEN THEM AND FORCES AT LEAST NOMINALLY ALLIED WITH THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT.

ELSEWHERE, FIGHTING BETWEEN MUSLIM GUNMEN AND "COUNTER-REVOLUTIONARIES" BROKE OUT AGAIN IN TABRIZ ON MARCH 3, AND THE SAME DAY THE MARXIST FEDAYIN-EKHALQ BLAMED RELIGIOUS LEADERS FOR FAILING TO PREVENT AN ATTACK BY SEVERAL HUNDRED PEOPLE ARMED WITH RIFLES AND CLUBS ON AN EXHIBITION STAGED BY THE FEDAYIN IN THE NORTHERN TOWN OF LANGARUD.

TWO POLICE WARRANT OFFICERS WERE EXECUTED BY A REVOLUTIONARY MILITIA FIRING SQUAD IN ABADAN ON MARCH 1, AND AN ARMY SARGEANT WAS EXECUTED IN THE SAME MANNER IN QAZVIN, ALSO ON MARCH 1. ON MARCH 3 ANOTHER POLICE WARRANT OFFICER WAS EXECUTED IN RAFSANJAN. THESE EXECUTIONS BRING THE TOTAL TO DATE TO 15. IN ANOTHER INCIDENT, THREE POLICE WARRANT OFFICERS BEING TRANSFERRED FROM THE NAJAFABAD REVOLUTIONARY HEADQUARTERS TO A NEARBY PRISON WERE SET UPON BY AN ANGRY MOB ON MARCH 2 AND HACKED TO DEATH.

A CALL MARCH 1 BY THE EGYPTIAN AMBASSADOR PROMPTED A STERN WARNING BY FOREIGN MINISTER SANJABI BROADCAST MARCH 3 THAT "THE GRANTING OF ASYLUM TO THE SHAH BY ANY GOVERNMENT UNDER ANY PRETEXT IS CONDEMNED BY THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT, AND WILL HAVE A NEGATIVE EFFECT ON IRAN'S FUTURE RELATIONS WITH THOSE COUNTRIES (SIC)." SANJABI SAID THAT HE REJECTED SADAT'S REASONING THAT HE ACCEPTED THE SHAH "AS A PERSONAL FRIEND" WHEN HE WENT TO EGYPT FOLLOWING HIS JANUARY 16 DEPARTURE FROM IRAN.

ACCORDING TO THE KUWAITI DAILY, AL WATAN, ON MARCH 3 IRANIAN ARMY CHIEF OF STAFF QARANI SAID THAT HE CONSIDERS IRAN A "CONFRONTATION STATE" WITH ISRAEL WHICH IS A FACTOR IN IRAN'S DECISION TO PULL OUT ITS FORCES FROM THE U.N. PEACEKEEPING MISSION IN SOUTHERN LEBANON. QARANI REPORTEDLY ALSO TOLD THE PAPER THAT IRAN WOULD PULL ITS REMAINING FORCES OUT OF OMAN AS WELL, AND WOULD NO LONGER ACT AS "POLICEMAN" IN THE PERSIAN GULF.

THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT CONTINUES ITS EFFORTS TO BRING THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES WHICH OFTEN ACT IN TOTAL INDEPENDENCE OF THE GOVERNMENT UNDER CONTROL. PM BAZARGAN ANNOUNCED THAT THE COMMITTEES WOULD BE ABSORBED BY VARIOUS GOVERNMENT AGENCIES, AND KHOMEINI APPOINTED MOHAMMAD REZA MAHDAVI-KANI TO CO-ORDINATE COMMITTEE FUNCTIONS. IT REMAINS TO BE SEEN, HOWEVER, WHETHER EITHER BAZARGAN'S ANNOUNCEMENT OR MAHDAVI-KANI'S APPOINTMENT HAS MUCH PRACTICAL EFFECT ON COMMITTEE OPERATIONS.

OTHER ITEMS OF INTEREST: THE SOVIET AMBASSADOR MET FOR TWO HOURS WITH THE LOCAL PLO REPRESENTATIVE ON MARCH 3. A GROUP OF ISLAMIC STUDENTS AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY HAS STRONGLY CRITICIZED MARXIST STUDENTS. KHOMEINI HAS APPOINTED MEHDI MADAVI AS PROSECUTOR GENERAL WITH UNDEFINED DUTIES.
(C-ENTIRE TEXT)

EMBASSY PLANS TO SUBMIT A BILL TO THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT FOR PROPERTY DAMAGED OR DESTROYED DURING THE ATTACK ON THE EMOASSY FEBRUARY 14TH. REQUEST OC PROVIDE COST OF COMMUNICATIONS EQUIPMENT DESTROYED DURING ATTACK. ITEMS DESTROYED ARE LISTED IN REFTEL. THANKS. SULLIVAN

CENTRAL BANK OF IRAN (CBI) GOVERNOR MOWLAVI ANNOUNCED ON MARCH 3 THAT IRAN WOULD MEET ALL FOREIGN COMMITMENTS. HE PLACED IRAN'S ASSETS ABROAD AT $15 BILLION AND LIABILITIES AT 5 BILLION DOLLARS. (NOTE: PREVIOUS EMBASSY ESTIMATES OF IRAN'S FOREIGN RESERVES WERE BETWEEN $10 AND $11 BILLION. WE DO NOT KNOW WHERE THE EXTRA $5 BILLION ARE COMING FROM.) ALTHOUGH HE WAS CRITICAL OF SOME PAST CBI PRACTICES, HE DID NOT LAY OUT IN ANY DETAIL FUTURE CBI POLICIES.

AMONG THE CRITICISMS WERE THE CBI'S INABILITY TO CONTROL INFLATION, INVESTMENTS ON THE PART OF COMMERCIAL BANKS AND PRIVATE COMPANIES IN REAL ESTATE; FINANCIAL DECISIONS BASED ON INACCURATE AND SUPERFICIAL STATISTICS; AND, THE FAILURE OF THE CBI TO ENCOURAGE THE FORMATION OF SPECIALIZED BANKS.

PRESUMABLY UNDER PRESSURE FROM CONSERVATIVE RELIGIOUS FACTIONS, MOWLAVI ANNOUNCED THAT A DECISION ON WHETHER OR NOT TO DISPENSE WITH THE PAYMENT OF INTEREST WOULD BE MADE AFTER CONSULTATION WITH IRANIAN RELIGIOUS LEADERS AND AFTER STUDYING THE BANKING SYSTEMS OF KUWAIT AND SAUDI ARABIA.
HE REITERATED HIS PREVIOUS STATEMENT THAT BANKS WOULD NOT BE NATIONALIZED.

FOREIGN INVESTMENTS IN IRAN SHOULD BE CONSIDERED SAFE, HE SAID, AND THE NEW REGIME WILL ENCOURAGE FOREIGN INVESTMENT IN IRAN. FOREIGN BANKS WILL CONTINUE TO BE ALLOWED TO OPERATE, ALTHOUGH UNDER CLOSER SUPERVISION THAN PREVIOUSLY.
CURRENCY RESTRICTIONS WILL REMAIN IN FORCE, ATHOUGH SOME OF THESE REGULATIONS MAY BE CHANGED. A COMMITTEE HAS BEEN APPOINTED TO STUDY THE PARITY OF THE RIAL WITH OTHER CURRENCIES.
MOWLAVI ALSO PREDICTED STRICT AUSTERITY MEASURES IN ORDER TO STRENGTHEN THE MONETARY SYSTEM.

AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI HAS DECLARED IMPORTED FROZEN MEAT UNCLEAN AND HENCE FORBIDDEN SINCE MOST OF IT IS NOT BUTCHERED IN ACCORDANCE WITH ISLAMIC LAW. HE HAS INSTRUCTED UNQUOTE PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN TO BAN ALL IMPORTS AND TO DESTROY EXISTING STOCKS.

THE NEW MINISTER OF AGRICULTURE, DR ALI MOHAMMAD IZADI MADE A STATEMENT REGARDING FUTURE AGRICULTURAL POLICY. ALTHOUGH LITTLE IN TERMS OF CONCRETE PROPOSALS WAS REPORTED. HE DID INDICATE THAT INTEREST FREE LOANS WOULD BE PROVIDED TO FARMERS, AND THAT EMPHASIS WOULD BE PLACED ON INFRASTRUCTURE PROJECTS IN AN EFFORT TO IMPROVE THE QUALITY OF LIFE IN IRAN'S RURAL AREAS. NOTE: MANY OF THE MARGINAL VILLAGERS WILL NO DOUBT NEED INTEREST FREE LOANS. PREVIOUSLY, MANY HAD TRAVELED TO URBAN AREAS TO ACCEPT CONSTRUCTION JOBS DURING THE WINTER MONTHS AND THIS SOURCE OF CASH ALMOST TOTALLY DRIED UP THIS YEAR.
OIL SALES TO ASHLAND OIL WERE PROMINENTLY HEADLINED IN BOTH ENGLISH LANGUAGE PAPERS.

ECONOMIC ACTIVITY, AS OBSERVED BY TWO EMOFFS IN THE CENTRAL TEHRAN AREA THE EVENING OF MARCH 3, APPEARED TOTALLY NORMAL. SURPRISINGLY, BUSINESS IN A PICTURE FRAMING SHOP WAS BOOMING, WITH CUSTOMERS SPENDING AS MUCH AS $100 TO HAVE MIRRORS FRAMED, ETC. APPARENTLY THERE ARE SOME OPTIMISTS IN TEHRAN WHO EXPECT LIFE TO RETURN TO SOME SEMBLANCE OF

MOROCCAN AMBASSADOR IN TEHRAN, WHOSE EMBASSY WAS TWICE INVADED BY FEDAYEEN FORCES PROTESTING PRESENCE OF SHAH IN MOROCCO, HAS QUIETLY LEFT THE COUNTRY. HE TOLD COLLEAGUES THAT FEDAYEEN HAD THREATENED TO KIDNAP HIM AND HOLD HIM UNTIL SHAH WAS RETURNED TO IRAN TO FACE ISLAMIC JUSTICE.

THERE HAVE BEEN REPORTS APPEARING IN LOCAL PRESS THAT PLO AND POLISARIO HAVE OFFERED TO KIDNAP SHAH IN RABAT AND RETURN HIM TO IRAN FR TRIAL. IT IS PRESUMED, UNDER THESE CIRCUMSTANCES, THAT MOROCCO MAY FIND THEIR GUEST INCREASINGLY

SUMMARY: THIS TELEGRAM ATTEMPTS TO RECORD THE EVENTS OF FEBRUARY 14, 1979, WHEN EMBASSY TEHRAN WAS ATTACKED AND SACKED BY A LARGE NUMBER OF HEAVILY-ARMED IRANIAN GUERILLAS. THE NARATIVE IS BASED ON INTERVIEWS HELD BY DRAFTING OFFICER WITH MARINE GUARDS, AMERICAN EMPLOYEES, IRANIAN EMPLOYEES AND VARIOUS IRANIAN MEMBERS OF THE COMMITTEE AND PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT. THIS MESSAGE DOES NOT ADDRESS THE QUESTION OF WHO PLANNED AND EXECUTED THE ATTACK OR WHY. IT IS SIMPLY AN EFFORT TO RECORD THE EVENTS AS THEY UNFOLDED SO AS TO PROVIDE SOME FORMAL RECORD FROM WHICH ANY FUTURE SUCH ANALYTICAL EFFORT MIGHT DRAW. END SUMMARY.

BACKGROUND. (A) ON THE AFTERNOON OF FEBRUARY 11, IN THE WAKE OF THE IRANIAN MILITARY'S DECISION TO WITHDRAW ITS TROOPS TO BARRACKS, THE EMBASSY FOUND ITSELF WITHOUT LOCAL MILITARY SECURITY SUPPORT. AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN HELD A MEETING THAT AFTERNOON WITH THE DCM, ADMINISTRATIVE COUNSELOR, ARMY ATTACHE AND OFFICERS OF THE SECURITY OFFICE TO DISCUSS THE EMBASSY'S ABILITY TO DEFEND ITSELF AGAINST AN ARMED ATTACK. IT WAS DECIDED THAT THE FORCE OF TWENTY MARINE SECURITY GUARDS WOULD NOT BE ABLE TO ADEQUATELY DEFEND AGAINST A MAJOR ATTACK AND THAT, THEREFORE, IN THE EVENT OF SUCH AN ATTACK, WE SHOULD SEEK SURRENDER ARRANGEMENTS WHICH WOULD MINIMIZE LOSS OF LIFE.

THE RSO WAS DIRECTED TO COLLECT ALL M-16 RIFLES FROM THE MARINES AND TO ORDER THEM TO LOAD THEIR SHOTGUNS ONLY WITH NON-LETHAL NUMBER 9 BIRDSHOT SO AS TO PROVIDE A DETERRENT TO ANY INDIVIDUAL INTRUDERS WHO MIGHT ATTEMPT TO PENETRATE THE COMPOUND. THE MARINES WERE ALSO PERMITTED TO KEEP THEIR PERSONAL SIDEARMS FOR THEIR INDIVIDUAL PROTECTION. IN THE EVENT OF A MAJOR ATTACK, THEY WERE NOT TO ATTEMPT A DEFENSE, BUT RATHER TO USE TEAR GAS AND, UNDER THE AMBASSADOR'S DIRECTION, SHOTGUNS LOADED WITH BIRDSHOT. (B) THE FOLLOWING DAY, FEBRUARY 12, MOJAHEDDIN GUERILLAS CAPTURED THE MILITARY BASE BEHIND THE EMBASSY.

SOON THEREAFTER, ARMED ISLAMIC GUERILLAS APPEARED IN VARIOUS SPOTS AROUND THE OUTSIDE OF THE EMBASSY WALLS. EMBOFFS LEARNED THROUGH CONVERSATIONS WITH VARIOUS PEOPLE CLOSE TO THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES THAT AT LEAST SOME OF THESE MOJAHEDDIN HAD BEEN SPECIFICALLY INSTRUCTED TO GUARD THE EMBASSY. (C) AT SOME TIME ON FEBRUARY 13, THESE GUARDS DEPARTED THE AREA. THAT EVENING, JOHN STEMPEL CALLED AMIR ENTEZAM TO REQUEST THAT THEY BE RETURNED. ENTEZAM PROMISED THAT THEY WOULD BE BACK THE NEXT DAY.

INITIAL PENETRATION OF THE COMPOUND. (A) THE ATTACK ON THE EMBASSY BEGAN ON WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 14, AT 1030 A.M. TWO ARMED MEN, DRESSED IN FULL COMBAT GEAR, CLIMED ON TOP OF THE ROOSEVELT GATE GUARDHOUSE. THREE MARINES WERE ON DUTY IN THE AREA--SGT. DUFRESNE, SGT. DOWNEY AND SGT. NOBLE. FOR THE MOMENT, THE KURDISH LEADERSHIP IS PROCEEDING CAUTIOUSLY, INSISTING THAT ITS DEMANDS ARE ONLY FOR AUTONOMY WITHIN THE IRANIAN NATION. HOWEVER, THE LEADSHIP HAS INDICATED THAT IT IS SERIOUS IN ITS OBJECTIVES AND THAT IRANIAN KURDS WILL FIGHT, IF NECESSARY, TO REALIZE THEM. THE GOVERNMENT HAS FOLLOWED A POLICY OF VACILLATION WHICH REFLECTS BOTH ITS PRESENT INABILITY TO ASSERT ITS AUTHORITY IN KURDESTAN AND ITS FEAR THAT THE MOVEMENT MAY HAVE FAR-REACHING CONSEQUENCES.
