REPORTS OF UNREST IN THE REGION PROMPTED BOTH THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT OF MEHDIA BAZARGAN AND AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI TO DISPATCH DELEGATIONS TO THE KURDS, HEADED BY MINISTER OF LABOR AND SOCIAL AFFAIRS DARIOUSH FOROUHAR AND DR. MEHDI MOHAMMAD MOKRI, RESPECTIVELY, TO DETERMINE THE SOURCES OF THE UNREST AND TO DO WHATEVER POSSIBLE TO NIP IT IN THE BUD.

THE PROBLEM FOR BOTH THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT AND KHOMEINI, HOWEVER, IS THAT THE KURDS HAVE SHREWDLY SEEN THAT THE COLLAPSE OF THE MILITARY AND THE EMASCULATION OF LAW ENFORCEMENT AGENCIES MEAN THAT FOR THE MOMENT TEHRAN CAN DO LITTLE TO CHECK KURDISH DEMANDS FOR AUTONOMY OR TO PREVENT DE FACTO IMPLEMENTATION OF SOME ASPECTS OF THEIR PROGRAM.

BUT DESPITE THE RELATIVE STRENGTH OF THEIR CURRENT POSITION, KURDISH LEADERS SEEM INCLINED TO PROCEDE CAUTIOUSLY. THE MAIN GROUP, CONSISTING OF THE KURDISH DEMOCRATIC PARTY (KDP) AND THE FOLLOWERS OF SHEIKH EZZEDIN HOSSEINI, THE IMAM JOMEH OF MAHABAD, HAS BEEN TAKING THE LINE THAT THE KURDS WANT ONLY AUTONOMY WITHIN THE IRANIAN STATE. ON MARCH 1, ABDUL RAHMAN QASSEMLOU, SECRETARY-GENERAL OF THE KDP, CLAIMED THAT TALK OF A SEPARATIST MOVEMENT HAD BEEN STARTED BY ELEMENTS WISHING TO TAKE ADVANTAGE OF THE CURRENT CONFUSED STATE IN IRAN AND WHICH HAVE CONTACTS WITH CERTAIN UNSPECIFIED FOREIGN NATIONS.

QASSEMLOU SAID THAT THE KDP BELIEVES THAT FOREIGN RELATIONS, NATIONAL DEFENSE, FINANCIAL AFFAIRS AND LONGTERM ECONOMIC PROJECTS MUST RELSIN UNDER THE DIRECTION OF THE NATIONAL GOVERNMENT. HE ADDED THAT PROVINCIAL AFFAIRS, HOWEVER, SHOULD BE LEJT TO THE PROVINCES, AND SPECIFICALLY CITED POLICIES RELATING TO LOCAL ADMINISTRATION, CULTURE, AND EDUCATION IN THIS REGARD. ------------------029836 060827Z /11 FM AMEMBSSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 213 SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 2727

HOSSEINI HAS TAKEN A SIMILAR LINE ON MARCH 4 HE SAID THAT HE BELIEVED THAT IF THE KURDS WERE GIVEN THE AUTONOMY THEY ARE SEEKING, IRAN'S INDEPENDENCE WOULD IN FACT BE STRENGTHENED SINCE "THE ENEMIES OF THE NATION WOULD NOT BE ABLE TO CONSPIRE IN THE NAME OF THE KURDISH PEOPLE." ON SEVERAL OCCASIONS, HOWEVER, HOSSEINI HAS EXPRESSED DOUBTS THAT THE CENTRAL GOVERNMENT WILL SHOW THE STATESMANSHIP REQUIRED TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE. ON MARCH 4 HE EXPRESSED FEARS THAT PEOPLE AROUND KHOMEINI MAY NOT BE KEEPING HIM FULLY INFORMED OF EVENTS IN KURDESTAN.

HE SAID THAT HE WAS CONFIDENT THAT THE AYATOLLAH WOULD BE PREPARED TO RECOGNIZE THE RIGHTS OF THE KURDS, BUT WENT ON TO WARN THAT IF THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT OR ANY OTHER GOVERNMENT WHICH MIGHT SUCEED IT DID NOT HEED THE DEMANDS OF THE KURDISH PEOPLE, THAT THERE WOULD BE TROUBLE. HE PROMISED THAT HIS FOLLOWERS WOULD ATTEMPT TO REALIZE THEIR GOALS THROUGH PEACEFUL MEANS, BUT DID NOT RULE OUT THE POSSIBILITY OF ARMED STRUGGLE. AS AN INCENTIVE TO THE GOVERNMENT TO BE FORTHCOMING, THE KDP, TOO, HAS HELD OUT THE POSSIBILITY THAT INTRANSIGENCE ON TEHRAN'S PART WOULD ONLY RESULT IN LEADERSHIP OF THE KURDISH MOVEMENT DEVOLVING UPON YOUNG RADICALS.

IN MAJOR DEMONSTRATION IN MAHABAD ON MARCH 2 THE KDP ISSUED A STATEMENT THAT SUMMED UP THE KURDISH POSITION. THE STATEMENT INCLUDED THE FOLLOWING POINTS: THE BOUNDARIES OF KURDESTAN SHOULD BE DETERMINED BY THE KURDISH PEOPLE AND SHOULD TAKE INTO CONSIDERATION HISTORICAL, ECONOMIC AND GEOGRAPHICAL CONDITIONS. COMMENT: THE LATTER MEANS THAT THE KURDS ARE LAYING CLAIM TO A MUCH LARGER AREA THAN THE PROVINCE OF KURDESTAN ITSELF. THE KURDISH HOMELAND WOULD INCLUDE THAT PROVINCE, KERMANSHAHAN, ILAM AND THE SOUTHERN PORTION OF WEST AZARBAIJAN, AN AREA OF 140,000 SQUARE KILOMETERS AND A POPULATION OF APPROXIMATELY 3,000,000. END COMMENT.

THERE SHOULD BE A KURDIY PARLIAMENT, POLULARLY ELECTED, WHICH WOULD BE THE HIGHEST LEGISLATIVE POWER IN THE PROVINCE. ALL GOVERNMENT DEPARTMENTS IN THE PROVINCE SHOULD BE LOCALLY DIRECTED. THERE SHOULD BE A PEOPLE'S ARMY, BUT THE POLICE AND GENDARMERIE SHOULD BE ABOLISHED AND REPLACED BY A NATIONAL GUARD. LAW ENFORCEMENT ELEMENTS IN KURDESTAN SHOULD BE UNDER LOCAL CONTROL. KURDISH SHOULD BE THE OFFICIAL LANGUAGE OF THE PROVINCIAL GOVERNMENT AND THE MEDIUM OF INSTRUCTION IN SCHOOLS. PERSIAN COULD CONTINUE AS A SECOND OFFICIAL LANGUAGE.

FREEDOM OF SPEECH AND OF THE PRESS, AND RIGHTS OF ASSOCIATION AND TRADE UNION ORGANIZATION SHOULD BE GUARANTEED, AND THE KURDISH PEOPLE SHOULD BE ABLE TO TRAVEL FREELY AND CHOOSE THEIR OWN OCCUPATIONS. APPROXIMATELY 200,000 PEOPLE TURNED OUT FOR THE DEMONSTRATION, AND AS IF TO ADD EMPHASIS TO THEIR DETERMINATION TO REALIZE THEIR DEMANDS, MANY WERE CONSPICUOUSLY ARMED.

THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT IS CAUGHT ON THE HORNS OF A VERY DIFFICULT DILEMMA: ON THE ONE HAND, SEVERAL SPOKENSMEN HAVE MADE CONCILIATING STATEMENTS AIMED AT PLACATING THE KURDS WHOM THEY KNOW CANNOT BE REINED IN AS LONG AS THE PRESENT NEAR PARALYSIS PREVAILS AT THE CENTER. ON THE OTHER, THESE SAME SPOKESMEN HAVE TALKED TOUGH ABOUT THE INVIOLABILITY OF THE IRANIAN NATION, TALK THAT MAKES THE KURDISH LEADERSHIP PESSIMISTIC ABOUT THE GOVERNMENT'S WILLINGNESS TO MEET ITS DEMANDS IN FULL BUT WHICH THE GOVERNMENT CLEARLY HOPES WILL CHECK THE GROWTH OF PARTICULARLIST TENDENCIES AMONG OTHER MINORITIES AS WELL AS THOSE AMONG THE KURDS THEMSELVES.

THE EXECUTION OF SALAR JAF, A KURDISH MEMBER OF THE LAST MAJLES, ON MARCH 5, WHILE OSTENSIBLY FOR JAF'S EFFORTS ON BEHALF OF THE SHAH, IS APT TO BE VIEWED IN KURDESTAN AS HAVING ANOTHER, MORE SINISTER MOTIVE. THE END RESULT MAY WELL BE A PROGRESSIVE RADICALIZATION OF THE KURDISH MOVEMENT AND ULTIMATELY VIOLENT CONFRONTATION WITH THE CENTRAL GOVERNMENT.
(S-ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY: GROUP LED BY MEHDI ROWGHANI IS PLANNING TO ESTABLISH LARGE COMMITTEE TO MEDIATE BETWEEN BAZARGAN'S GOI AND KHOMEINI COMMITTEE STRUCTURE. HOPE IS TO MAKE FINAL ARRANGEMENTS BY MARCH 10. END SUMMARY.

MEHDI ROWGHANI, KHOMEINI CONFIDANTE, TOLD POLOFF STEMPEL MORNING MARCH 5 THAT HE HAD SPENT PREVIOUS WEEKEND IN QOM WORKING ON ESTABLISHMENT OF A COORDINATING COMMITTEE TO MEDIATE BETWEEN GOI STRUCTURE AND KHOMEINI COMMITTEE ORGANIZATION. HE ADMITTED THAT AS OF MARCH 4, COORDINATION BETWEEN QOM AND TEHRAN WAS "A MESS," AND SAID COMMITTEE STRUCTURE IS STILL NOT OBEYING GOI IN MANY PLACES.

ROWGHANI SEEKS TO FORM GROUP OF 100 IN UNITS OF 8 TO TEN TO DEAL WITH SPECIFIC PROBLEM AREAS. ROWGHANI WOULD NOT GIVE NAMES, BUT SAID HEY WERE PRESTIGIOUS FIGURES FROM ALL SIDES OF THE REVOLUTIONARY MOVEMENT. COMMITTEE WOULD BE BASED IN TEHRAN, AND ROWGHANI INFERRED THAT ITS MAIN PURPOSE WOULD BE TO MAKE KHOMEINI COMMITTEES TOE THE LINE A BIT MORE AS THEY WORK OUT THEIR RELATIONS WITH GOI. ROWGHANI HOPES TO TRAVEL TO QOM MARCH 9 AND 10 TO MAKE FINAL ARRANGEMENTS. KHOMEINI HAS ALREADY APPROVED IDEA, AND WORK IS NOW GOING ON WITH GOI.

WHEN ASKED WHETHER HE THOUGHT ONE MORE COMMITTEE WAS THE ANSWER, ROWGHANI (WHO IS CLEARLY DISGUSTED WITH LACK OF ORDER THREE WEEKS AFTER REVOLUTION) SAID HE HOPED SO, "SOMETHING HAS TO BE DONE." COMMENT: PERHAPS BETTER INDICATOR OF ROWGHANI'S PERSONAL ASSESSMENT FOR THE LONGER TERM IS HIS APPLICATION MARCH 5 FOR AN INVESTOR'S VISA FOR THE U.S.)

1979TEHRAN02737.subject: REVOLUTIONARY JUSTICE AND THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT

segments.text: C- ENTIRE TEXT.

SUMMARY: A SPATE OF RECENT EXECUTIONS AND THE ARREST OF FORMER MAJLES MEMBER AHMAD BANI-AHMAD DEMONSTRATE THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT'S CONTINUING INABILITY TO ESTABLISH ITS AUTHORITY EVEN ON THE VERY DOORSTEP OF THE PRIME MINISTER'S OFFICE. END SUMMARY.

REFTEL WAS IN ERROR IN REPORTING THAT GEN. ABDULLAH KHAJENOURI AND GEN. FAKHR MODARES, EXECUTED MARCH 5, WERE ATTACHED TO THE IMPERIAL COURT. IN FACT, THEY WERE ASSOCIATED WITH THE MILITARY TRIBUNAL SYSTEM WHICH FORMERLY TRIED THOSE CHARGED WITH AN ASTATE CRIMES, THE FORMER SERVING AS ITS HEAD AND THE LATTER AS ITS CHIEF PROSECUTOR.

THE SEVEN EXECUTIONS IN TEHRAN, ALONG WITH ANOTHER IN ABADAN THE SAME DAY (MARCH 5) AND TWO MORE IN RASHT MARCH 6, DEMONSTRATE THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT'S CONTINUING INABILITY TO ASSERT ITSAUTHORITY OVER THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES WHICH HAVE BEEN RESPONSIBLE FOR THE TRIALS AND EXECUTIONS (THE LATTER TOTAL 2 BY OUR COUNT, NOT 19 AS REPORTED IN THE MARCH 6 KAYHAN INTERNATIONAL).

WE HAVE FEW DETAILS ABOUT THE CONDUCT OF THE TRIALS CARRIED OUT BY PROVINICAL COMMITTEES, BUT FROM THE SCANT INFORMANTION AVAILABLE IT APPEARS THAT THEY HAVE CONFORMED ESSENTIALLY WITH THE PATTERN IN TEHRAN, I.E., HEARINGS CONDUCTED IN CAMERA OVER THE SPACE OF A FEW HOURS BEFORE TRIBUNALS WHOSE MEMBERS REMAIN UNIDENTIFIED, NO APPEAL PROCEDURE, AND EXECUTION FOLLOWING ALMOST IMMEDIATELY THE HANDING DOWN OF A VERDICT.

AS IF TO ILLUSTRATE THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT'S IMPOTENCE IN MATTERS OF REVOLUTIONARY JUSTICE, FORMER MAJLES MEMBER AHMAD BANI-AHMAD, ONE OF THE PAHLAVI REGIME'S MOST PERSISTENT CRITICS WHEN THE MAJLES WAS STILL IN SESSION, WAS ARRESTED BY COMMITTEE GUNMEN MARCH 3 AS HE WAS ABOUT TO ENTER PM BAZARGAN'S OFFICE FOR A MEETING AND WAS CHARGED WITH BEING A CIA AGENT. ACCORDING TO A BANI-AHMAD AIDE, EFFORTS BY THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT TO INTERVENE IN THE MATTER HAVE BEEN SPURNED BY THE COMMITTEE RESPONSIBLE FOR THE ARREST. TRUE TO HIS FORM, BANI-AHMAD IS REPORTED TO HAVE GONE ON ANHUNGER STRIKE AT QASR PRISON WHERE HE IS BEING HELD.
(S - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: SHARIFI, ONE OF LEADERS OF CONSTITUTIONALIST PARADES IN EARLY FEB (SEE REF A), ASKED EMBOFFS TO SUPPORT A MOVEMENT AIMED AT MODERATING EXCESSES OF ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT. HE TOLD EMBOFFS POPULAR RUMOR HAS IT THAT U.S. ENGINEERED KHOMEINI TAKEOVER BY HAVING GEN. HUYSER NEUTRALIZE THE ARMY. HIS NEW SCHEME IS TO RUN A POPULAR CANDIDATE FOR THE PRESIDENCY OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC WITH U.S. HELP IN "MARKETING AND ADVERTISING." EMBOFFS FIRMLY DISCOURAGED HIM IN EXPECTING U.S. SUPPORT FOR HIS SCHEMES. END SUMMARY.

POLOFFS STEMPEL, PATTERSON AND TOMSETH SPENT OVER FOUR HOURS AT COCKTAILS AND DINNER EVENING MAR 4 WITH FIROOZ SHARIFI, ISERAN PROJECT EXECUTIVE WHO HAD COME TO STEMPEL'S ATTENTION ON REFERENCE FROM BAKHTIAR'S FOREIGN MINISTER AS ONE OF LEADERS OF PRO-CONSTITUTIONALIST MARCHES JUST BEFORE FALL OF BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT. SHARIFI HAD ASKED FOR MEETING TO LAY OUT HIS IDEAS ON WHERE IRAN SHOULD BE GOING.

AN ARTICULATE MODERNIST, SHARIFI SAID PROBLEM WITH ISLAMIC MOVEMENT IS THAT IT WILL DISCOURAGE TALENTED PEOPLE IRAN NEEDS TO RUN A MODERN COUNTRY. THOSE WHO ARE INTELLIGENT AND TRUE PATRIOTS COULD MOBILIZE POPULAR SUPPORT --IT IS THERE FOR THE TAKING (OR BUYING) AMONG TRIBESMEN AS WELL AS THOSE, EVEN IN KHOMEINI'S ENTOURAGE, WHO HAVE BECOME DISILLUSIONED WITH NARROW ISLAMICISM ESPOUSED BY KHOMEINI. HE ALLUDED TO SEVERAL EUROPEAN-TRAINED INDIVIDUALS WHO HAD HIGH SUB-CABINET POSITIONS WHO WERE ALREADY DISCOURAGED AND VOCAL ABOUT IT. SHARIFI SAID MANY WHO DID NOT SUPPORT FEDAYEEN (COMMUNIST GUERILLAS) WERE TURNING TO FEDAYEEN BECAUSE IT OFFERED ONLY CHANCE TO COMBAT ISLAMIC RESTRICTIONS ESPOUSED BY KHOMEINI.

SHARIFI SAID U.S. SHOULD BE "IN THE MARKET" FOR THOSE WHO COULD RUN A GOVERNMENT MORE ATUNED TO U.S. VALUES. EMBOFFS INTERJECTED (AND REPEATED THIS THROUGHOUT CONVERSATION) THAT U.S. WAS NOT IN BUSINESS OF BACKING ANYBODY, BUT WAS INTERESTED IN HEARING ALL POINTS OF VIEW. U.S. WOULD WORK WITH GOI TO DEGREE GOI ITSELF WISHED. UNDETERRED, SHARIFI SAID U.S. WAS BEING BLAMED FOR IRAN'S PROBLEMS. "THOSE WHO KNEW" SAID U.S. HAD DELIBERATELY SABOTAGED SHAH'S ATTEMPTS TO FIND WORKABLE GOVERNMENT IN ORDER TO SEE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT COME TO POWER. WHEN ASKED WHY BY ASTOUNDED EMBOFFS, SHARIFI SAID THIS WAS CLEVER CARTER SCHEME TO CREATE "ISLAMIC BELT" ACROSS MIDEAST TO CONTAIN COMMUNISM.

IN THIS SCHEME, GEN. HUYSER'S DEC-JAN VISIT TO IRAN WAS DESIGNED TO SAP WILL OF IRANIAN MILITARY AND INDUCE IT NOT TO FIGHT. HE ADDUCED EVIDENCE FOR THIS VIEW IN FACT THAT SEVERAL BARRACKS WERE EVACUATED BY IRANIAN TROOPS BEFORE MUJAHIDIN ATTACKS BEGAN. EMBOFFS SUGGESTED OTHER REASONS FOR THIS, INCLUDING DEMORALIZATION OF TROOPS. SHARIFI REMAINED CONVINCED THAT U.S. HAD SOMEHOW CONNIVED TO DESTROY IRANIAN MILITARY BEFORE IT COULD GO INTO BATTLE. SHARIFI ALSO SAID SHAH HAD TOLD HIS GOOD FRIEND, DR. SADIQI, (SEE BELOW) THAT "AMERICANS HAD ADVISED HIM (SHAH) TO LEAVE THE COUNTRY." POLOFF SAID THAT WAS CANARD, BUT SHARIFI PERSISTED.

(COMMENT: ABOVE RECOUNTED IN SOME DETAIL BECAUSE GENERAL THEME ADVANCED IS NOW BECOMING VERY POPULAR AMONG FAIRLY SIGNIFICANT PORTION OF IRAN'S MODERNIZED ELITE INCLUDING SOME MILITARY MEN. ELEMENTS OF SELF-DELUSION MAY SEEM OBVIOUS TO WESTERN OBSERVER, BUT SURFACE ELEMENT OF PLAUSIBILITY AND PERSIAN PENCHANT FOR SEEKING EXTERNAL VILLAINS HAS GIVEN STORY MUCH CREDENCE HERE.)

SHARIFI THEN UNVEILED HIS SOLUTION: IRAN NEEDED A GOVERNMENT THAT WOULD KEEP THE 20 PERCENT OF THE IRANIAN POPULATION WHICH COMPRISES THE MODERNIST ELITE HAPPY, YET HAVE MAJORITY SUPPORT. WAY TO DO THIS WAS TO ENLIST HELP OF TRIBES AND BUY POLITICIANS "IN SAME OLD WAY." SHARIFI SAID HE WAS VERY CLOSE TO DR. GHOLAM HOSSEIN SADIQI, WHO HAD BEEN PRIME MINISTER-DESIGNATE BRIEFLY IN DECEMBER (REF B). SADIQI WAS RESPECTED BY ALL CURRENTS IN IRANIAN POLITICS EXCEPT THE COMMUNISTS.

WHEN ASKED POINT BLANK IF HE WAS PUSHING SADIQI FOR THE TOP JOB, SHARIFI REPLIED "PERHAPS, YES," AND WENT ON TO SOLILOQUY ON NECESSITY OF ELECTING A SOLID PERSON TO BE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC'S FIRST PRESIDENT (SHARIFI CONCEDES THAT IRAN WILL VOTE OVERWHELMINGLY FOR AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC).

BASIC PROBLEM WAS THAT NEW MOVEMENT NEEDED HELP ORGANIZING. IRAN'S INTELLIGENTSIA COULD EASILY MANIPULATE MASSES USING MODERN U.S. ADVERTISING METHODS AND MARKETING PRACTICES. U.S. SHOULD BE INTERESTED IN THIS. EMBOFFS AGAIN POLITELY AND FIRMLY TOLD SHARIFI THAT U.S. WAS NOT IN BUSINESS OF MEDDLING IN INTERNAL POLITICS. WHILE WE WERE ALWAYS INTERESTED IN GETTING POLITICAL VIEWS OF MANY FACTIONS, WE WERE NOT GOING TO GET INVOLVED. SHARIFI COULD NOT UNDERSTAND HOW U.S. COULD DO SO LITTLE--WOULDN'T CIA WANT TO DO ANYTHING TO PROTECT U.S. INTERESTS? EMBOFFS REITERATED THAT U.S. WAS PLAYING IT STRAIGHT, AND AFTER AGREEING TO KEEP IN TOUCH, MARATHON MEETING ENDED.

COMMENT: SHARIFI SOUNDS LIKE HE IS EITHER CRAZY OR A GOOD CANDIDATE TO BE IRAN'S NEXT SHAH. CLEARLY EMBUED WITH HIS SYRACUSE-ACQUIRED FAITH IN U.S. MANAGERIAL METHODS, HE IS A FIRST-RANK ELITIST, WHICH MAKES HIS ESPOUSAL OF VIRTUES OF WESTERN DEMOCRACY SUSPECT. HE CLAIMS TO BE CLOSE TO DR. SADIQI AND PROBABLY IS, THOUGH IT WAS NOT CLEAR WHETHER SADIQI WAS AWARE OF HIS DEMARCHE TO US (WE TEND TO THINK NOT). WHILE HE LACKS UNDERSTANDING OF DEGREE TO WHICH ISLAMIC MOVEMENT HAS CAPTURED MARKET ON MASS POLITICS IN TODAY'S IRAN, HE DOES BELIEVE THAT THERE IS A FUTURE IN NON- OR ANTI-ISLAMIC POLITICS.

IN THIS HE IS PROBABLY RIGHT, SUGGESTING THAT WHEN KHOMEINI FAILS TO FULFILL HIS PIE-IN-THE-SKY ECONOMIC PROMISES, THE MASS MAY TURN FROM HIM. THIS MAY BE TRUE, BUT IT IS NOT LIKELY TO HAPPEN FOR SOME TIME, AND THERE MAY BE MORE INTERESTING INTERVENING EVENTS TO INTERRUPT AND RECHANNEL THE PROCESS. SHARIFI ALLUDES TO FRIENDS AND SUPPORT IN THE MILITARY, BUT IS RELUCTANT TO COME FORTH WITH NAMES. WE WILL CONTINUE TO "KEEP IN TOUCH." TO SEE IF HIS EFFORTS DEVELOP EVEN THE MODEST HEAD OF STEAM THAT HIS PRO-BAKHTIAR FORCE MANAGED TO PRODUCE BEFORE BEING FLATTENED BY THE ISLAMIC STEAMROLLER.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: SECULARISTS HAVE ATTACKED CONCEPT OF ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. GROUP HAS BEEN FORMED TO ARGUE FOR "DEMOCRATIC" RATHER THAN "ISLAMIC" REPUBLIC'; PUBLIC DEBATE OVER CONTENTS OF CONSTITUTION. END SUMMARY.

WEEK OF DEBATE ON QUESTION OF REFERENDUM ON IRAN'S NEW CONSTITUTION CAME TO A HEAD MARCH 5 WHEN SECULAR FORCES CELEBRATING ANNIVERSARY OF DEATH OF EX-PRIME MINISTER MOHAMMAD MOSSADEQ FORMED NEW "NATIONAL DEMOCRATIC FRONT" IN BREAKAWAY MOVE FROM NATIONAL FRONT. NEW GROUPING WAS ANNOUNCED BY PROMINENT LAWYER HEDAYATOLLAH MATIN-DAFTARY, A MOSSADEQ GRANDSON WHO HAS BEEN ACTIVE IN PROGRESSIVE BAR ASSOCIATION. GROUP CALLED FOR PLEBICITE TO END MONARCHY, BUT SAID DETERMINATION OF TYPE OF REGIME SHOULD BE POSTPONED UNTIL PEOPLE HAD DEBATED THE ISSUE ADEQUATELY. MATIN-DAFTARY ATTACKED NATIONAL FRONT FOR ITS DEVIATING FROM DEMOCRATIC IDEALS AND ITS ATTACHMENT TO THEOCRATIC RATHER THAN DEMOCRATIC IDEAS.

ARGUMENT OVER CONSTITUTION BEGAN SEVERAL DAYS AGO WITH BAZARGAN ANNOUNCEMENT THAT REFERNDUM WOULD BE HELD MARCH 30 TO VOTE ON QUESTION OF DISBANDING MONARCHY AND ACCEPTING ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. CONSTITUTION DRAFTERS PASSED THEIR WORK TO AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, BUT WHEN IT WAS ANNOUNDED THAT CONSTITUTION WOULD NOT BEFUNVEILED BEFORE REFERNDUM, NUMBER OF JOURNALISTS AND MORE SECULAR-MINDED GROUPS, INCLUDING RADICAL LEFT (REF A?* ATTACKED IDEA OF ISLAMIC REPUBLIC AS BETRAYAL OF DEMOCRATIC IDEAS. BEST ILLUSTRATION WAS SERIES OF ARTICLES BY FARIBORZ ATAPOU, GIFTED UCITER BUT LIGHTWEIGHT INTELLECT WHO HAS FINELY HONED NOSE FOR DETECTING WHICH WAY WIND IS BLOWING. ATAPOUR LAID DOWN CHALLENGE: THEOCRACY OR DEMOCRACY?

AND REVIEWED HISTORY OF OTHER REVOLUTIONS--SPANISH, PORTUGUESE, GREEK--STRESSING DEMOCRATIC THEMES AS COUNTERPOCT TO PRONOUNCEMENTS OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI MARCH 1 UPON ARRIVING AT QOM WHICH CALLED FOR ISLAMIC REPUBLIC.

OTHER COMMENTARY HAS CRITICIZED KHOMEINI FOR TELLING PEOPLE HE WOULD VOTE FOR AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC, IMPLICITLY PUTTING RELIGIOUS PRESURE ON THEM TO DO SO AS WELL. KHOMEINI RIDICULED THOSE WHO WANT A DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC, NOT AN ISLAMIC ONE, AS IGNORANT OF THE MEANING OF ISLAM.

OTHER AYATOLLAHS HAVE TRIED TO SQUARE THE CIRCLE-TALEQANI SAID THERE WERE NO DIFFERENCES BETWEEN HINOGMXX# AND KHOMEINI , AND THAT IRAN'S REPUBLICCOULD BE BOTH DEMOCRATIC AND ISLAMIC. SHARIAT-MADARI CRITICIZED SENIOR STATESMAN ALI SHAYEGAN FOR RIDICULING ISLAMIC REPUBLIC AS A STEP BACKWARDS AND SAID ISLAMIC REPUBLIC WOULD BE BOTH PROGRESSIVE AND DEMOCRATIC. IN EARLIER TALK, SHARIATMADARI SAID THAT, GIVEN ISLAMIC CONCEPT OF JUSTICE, ISLAMIC REPUBLIC HAD TO BE DEMOCRATIC. HIS ARGUMENTS HARDLY CONVINCED SECULARISTS, HOWEVER, WHO HAVE WATCHED WITH SOME DISMAY CANCELLATION OF THE FAMILY PROTECTION ACTI, ANNOUNCEMENT OF THE END OF COEDUCATION, BANNING OF FROZEN MEATS AS UNHYGENIC, AND WARNINGS THAT THE PRESS HAD BETTER TOE THE ISLAMIC LINE.

OUTCOME OF THIS ARGUMENT OVER IRIF'S PROJECTED CONSTITUTION IS NOT LIKELY TO BE RESOLVED IN SHORT ORDER. IMMEDIATE EFFECT OF DEBATE AND FORMATION OF NATIONAL DEMOCRATIC FRONT WILL PROBABLYSBE SPEDUP WITH WHICH ISLAMIC DRAFT CONSTITUTION (SOME DETAILS GIVEN REF B) IS MADE PUBLIC AND BECOMES CENTER OF CONCRETE ARGUMENTS. WHILE KHOMEINI CAN PROBABLY RAM A REASONABLE ISLAMIC CONSTITUTION THROUGH REFERENDUM, BACKFIRE AGAINST IT TO DATE SUGGESTS OPPOSITION IN POST-REFERENDUM CONSTITUTIONAL CONVENTION WOULD TRY TO AMEND IT ALONG MORELSECULAR LINES. ARGUMENTS NOW BEING PUT FORTH MIGHT THUS BE SEEN AS OPEINING SALVOS IN STRUGGLE CENTERING ON CONSTITUTIONAL ASSEMBLY.
(C-EMIRE TEXT)
SUMMARY: IRANIAN EDUCATIONAL SCENE MARKED BY INTENSIVE AND DEEP-SEATED CHAOS. HIGH SCHOOLS ROUNDING INTO SHAPE FASTER THAN UNIVERSITIES. REVOLUTIONARY RHETORIC ABOUNDS. END SUMMARY.

NUMBER OF PROFESSORS WHO REMAIN WILLING TO TALK TO EMBOFFS (WHICH HAS SHRUNK SIGNIFICANTLY) HAVE COMMENTED ON CHOAS NOW REIGNING IN IRANIAN UNIVERSITY SCENE. AS OF MORNING MAR 6, ONLY FACULTIES FULLY OPEN AND TEACHING THAT WE KNOW OF ARE SCHOOL OF PUBLIC ADMINISTRATION AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY; SCHOOL OF MEDICINE AT PAHLAVI UNIVERSITY, SHIRAZ; AND RCD COLLEGE, TEHRAN (WHERE HALF OF STUDENT BODY IS TURKISH OR PAKISTANI). PARTS OF OTHER FACULTIES ARE OPEN; SOME ARE TEACHING, MOST ARE USING OCCASION FOR REVOLUTIONARY SPEECHES.

BATTLE FOR CONTROL OF UNIVERSITIES AND FOR LOYALTIES FOR STUDENTS CONTINUES BETWEEN FEDAYEEN AND SMALLER MARXIST GROUPS ON ONE HAND AND THE MUJAHIDIN AND THEIR ISLAMIC MOVEMENT ALLIES ON THE OTHER. MOST PARTIES HAVE SOME SORTS OF ORGANIZATION ACTIVE ON TEHRAN UNIVERSITY CAMPUS, WHICH IS REVOLUTIONARY STRONGHOLD. OTHER SCHOOLS--TEHRAN TECHNICAL COLLEGE, SCHOOL OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY, AND NATIONAL UNIVERSITY HAVE ONE OF MORE GROUPS WHO DOMINATE SCENE FOR A DAY OR TWO AT A TIME, THEN GIVE WAY TO OTHERS.

ONE FACULTY SIDE, NATIONAL ORGANIZATION OF UNIVERSITY PROFESSORS (NOUP) HAS CALLED FOR GREATER ACADEMIC PARTICIPATION IN CHOOSING DEANS AND SENIOR UNIVERSITY OFFICIALS. NOUP WANTS SPECIAL COUNCILS TO MAKE SELECTIONS, AND CRITICIZED PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN FOR NAMING MOHAMMAD MALEKI AS HEAD OF TEHRAN UNIVERSITY ON FEB 22 WITHOUT CONSULATIONS WITH FACULTY. SEVERAL FACULTY MEMBERS INDICATE FACULTY DISCUSSIONS DEGENERATE INTO CHAOS. PROFESSORS ARE, IF ANYTHING, LESS MATURE THAN STUDENTS. MEETING SELDOM REACH DECISIONS, AND FRACTIONALIZATION IS RULE OF THE DAY.

ONE PROFESSOR NOTED THAT A T MEETING OF NATIONAL UNIVERSITY FACULTY, THERE WERE NO LESS THAN FIVE MAJOR FACTIONS VIGOROUSLY ARGUING SEPARATE POINTS OF VIEW OVER MINOR ITEM REGARDING ADMINISTRATIVE ARRANGEMENTS.

MOST FACULTY MEMBERS PROFESS TO BE APPALLED AT STATE OF AFFAIRS, BUT SELDOM SHOW SPIRIT OF COMPROMISE. TWO MORE ASTUTE PROFESSORS WHO COMMENTS ON PROBLEM THOUGHT UNIVERSITY EDUCATION WOULD LIMP ALONG TO IRANIAN NEW YEAR (MAR 21) HOLIDAY, WHICH WOULD GIVE MORE ORGANIZED AMONG FACULTY CHANCE TO GET SYSTEM, OR WHATEVER EMERGES, AT LEAST PARTIALLY BACK ON RAILS.

IN MEANTIME, MANY FACULTY MEMBERS WILL NOT TEACH, BUT USE SCHEDULED CLASSES (WHERE THESE EXIST) FOR LECTURES ON REVOLUTIONARY PHILOSOPHY AND PROPOUNDING POINTS OF VIEW. WHAT IS STRIKING IS VIRTUALLY COMPLETE LOSS OF PROFESSIONALISM--DEBATES ARE OVER REVOLUTIONARY IDEOLOGY, NOT RESTORING APPROPRIATE ACADEMIC STANDARDS. OLDER ACADEMICS WHO MIGHT LEAVEN YOUTHFUL ENTHUSIASM ARE DISCREDITED FOR COOPERATION WITH FORMER REGIME. MANY YOUNGER, AMERICANTRAINED ACADEMICS WHO WISH RETURN TO PROFESSIONAL STANDARDS ARE HOUNDED FOR ALLEGED CIA CONNECTIONS--OTHERS, HAVING SEEN HANDWRITING ON THE WALL HAVE BECOME MORE REVOLUTIONARY THAN THE REVOLUTIONARIES. GOOD EXAMPLE IS ARDAMAN DAVARAN, PROFESSOR OF ENGLISH LITERATURE, AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY.

EDUCATED AT CAL BERKELEY, WHERE HE TAUGHT FOR SEVERAL YEARS, DAVARAN RETURNED TO IRAN ABOUT FOUR YEARS AGO. WITHIN PAST EIGHT-TEN MONTHS, HE HAS MOVED FROM RELATIVELY MODERATE INTELLECTUAL PREOCCUPIED WITH UNIVERSITY WORK TO LEADING MEMBER OF NOUP WITH EXTENSIVE TIES TO FEDAYEEN. THERE ARE OTHERS.

ONE STRIKING ELEMENT OF IRAN'S NEW EDUCATION ORDER IS THE VIRTUAL EXCLUSION OF FOREIGN PROFESSORS FROM UNIVERSITY TEACHING.NUMBER OF AMERICANS, INCLUDING USG-SPONSORED FULBRIGHTERS HAVE BEEN TOLD THEIR SERVICES ARE NO LONGER WANTED. AT SMALLER COLLEGES, EVEN AMCIT WIVES OR IRANIANS, WHO FORMED BACKBONE OF ENGLISH-LANGUAGE TEACHING DIVISIONS IN FIVE OR SIX TEHRAN SCHOOLS, HAVE BEEN DISMISSED. TWO EMBOFFS TEACHING PART-TIME AT RCD COLLEGE WERE QUIETLY REPLACED BY IRANIANS WITHOUT NOTICE. OUR GERMAN AND FRENCH DIPLOMATIC COLLEAGUES REPORT BANDWAGON EFFECT HAS HIT MANY OF THEIR NATIONALS WHO WERE TEACHING HERE. ONE NOTED THAT "REVOLUTIONARY PURITY SEEMS TO HAVE REPLACED COMPETENCE AS PRINCIPAL CRITERION FOR FACULTY HIRING."

HIGH SCHOOLS APPEAR TO BE RETURNING TO NORMAL MORE QUICKLY. WHILE TEACHING DOES EMPHASIZE REVOLUTIONARY IDEAS, AND ARGUMENTS CONTINUE ON HOW MUCH TEXTBOOKS WILL HAVE TO BE "ABRIDGED" TO MAKE UP FOR LOST TIME, OVERWHELMING MAJORITY OF SCHOOLS ARE AT LEAST BACK IN THE EDUCATIONAL BUSINESS, WITH FACULTY STRUCTURES NEARLY INTACT. BASIC REASON IS THAT TEACHERS UNION UNDER DERAKSHESH CONTROLS VIRTUALLY ALL TEACHING FACULTY, AND SMALL MINORITY OF LEFTISTS HHE NOT WANTED TO MAKE A CHALLENGE NOW. HIGH SCHOOLS AND ELEMENTARY STUDENTS, WHILE NOT ENTHUSIASTIC ABOUT GOING BACK TO SCHOOL, WERE BORED WITH LONG "HOLIDAY," AND HAVE SETTLED DOWN TO WHAT PASSES FOR SCHOOLWORK REMARKABLY WELL. SULLIVAN

segments.text: FOR YOUR EDIFICATION THERE FOLLOWS THE 11-POINT PROGRAM OF THE NATIONAL DEMOCRATIC FRONT, RSCRIBED BY KAYHAN AS "A NEW GROUPING OF PROGRESSIVE SECULAR FORCES FROM ALL STRATA OF SOCIETY," THE FORMATION OF WHICH WAS ANNOUNCED BY HEDAYATOLLAH MATINKJDAFTARI AT A RALLY COMMEMORATING THE ANNIVERSARY OF THE DEATH OF MOSSADEQ ON MARCH 5. WE SUSPECT SOMETHING MAY HAVE BEEN LOST IN THE TRANSLATION FROM FARSI AND WILL CAREFULLY CHECK OTHER VERSIONS OF THE ELEVEN POINT PROGRAM. BEGIN TEXT THE NATIONAL DEMOCRATIC FRONT OF IRAN, IN VIEW OF THE STRONG DEMANDS OF ALL PROGRESSIVE CLASSES, PROPOSES THE FOLLOWING PDOGRAMME.

IITHE COUASE OF THE RELENTLESS STRUGGLE OF THE PEOPLE AGAINST THE FORCES, ORGANISATIONS AND POLITICAL, MILITARY AND CULTURAL INSTITUTIONS OF THE DICTATORIAL REGIME DEPENDENT UPON IMPERIALISM, THE FOLLOWING IS NECESSARY.

TO LAUNCH AN IMMEDIATE REFERENDUM SOLELY FOR THE PURPOSE OF FURTHER STRENGTHENING THE LEGAL BASIS OF THE ABOLITION OF THE MONARCHY (SUCH A REFERENDUM SHOULD BEPSEPARATE FROM ANY PLEBISCITE WHICH SHALL DETERMINE THE TYPE AND CONTENTS OF GOVERNMENT). THE TYPE OF GOVERNMENT AND ITS CONTENTS MAY ONLY BE DETERMINED AFTER A REASONABLE TIME WITHIN WHICH THE POSSIBILITY OF EXPLAINING, DEBATING AND EXCHANGING OF OPINION IS GIVEN TO EVERYONE BELONGING TO ANY POLITICAL CREED OR PHILOSOPHY SO THAT A GOVERNMENT BEST SUITED TO THE STATE CAN BE FORMED.
ALL INSTITUTIONS AND ELEMENTS WHICH IN ANY WAY IMPEDE THE FREEDOM OF OPINION AND/OR INSTILL FEAR AND PRESSURE BY UNDEMOCRATIC MEANS MUST BE ELIMINATED AS COUNTER-REVOLUTIONARY.

TO ELECT URGENTLY A COUNCIL OF WORKERS, GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES, GUILDS AND OTHER PROGRESSIVE GROUPS TO BE CALLED THE REVOLUTIONARY COORDINATING COUNCIL AND TO ACCEPT THE RIGHT OF SUPERVISION BY THIS COUNCIL OVER THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT IN ALL MATTERS AND STAGES, PARTICULARLY THOSE CONCERNING A PLEBISCITE AND THE ORGANISATION OF A CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY. TO ACHIEVE COMPLETE COORDINATION BETWEEN THE GOVERNMENT AND ALL ORGANISATIONS AND NATIONAL POLITICAL PARTIES THROULO THIS COUNCIL.

TO INBSTIGATE URGENTLY ALL CRIMES OF THOSE RESPONSIBLE FOR PLUNDERING THE WEALTH OF THE NATION AND PERMITTING THE MURDER AND OPPRESSION OF THEIR COMPATRIOTS, FOR BEING THE AGENTS OF THE ANTI-NATIONAL AND ANTI-FREEDOM POLICIES OF FOREIGN POWERS AT ANY LEVEL AND WITHOUT EXCEPTION, EVEN IN ABSENTIA, AT THE PEOPLE'S COURTS, OPEN TO THE PUBLIC: AND THE IMMEDIATE ENFORCEMENT OF THE JUDGEMENTS.

THE COMMISSION PREPARING AND CODIFYING THE FUTURE CONSTITUTION MUST BE FREELY ELECTED UNDER THE SUPERVISION OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COORDINATING COUNCIL FROM AMONG QUALIFIED INDIVIDUALS OF ALL CLASSES. ALL IDEOLOGICAL TENDENCIES MUST BE ALLOCED TO EXPRESS THEIR OPINION ON THE CONSTITUTION.
TO RECOGNISE THE RIGHTS OF PARTICIPATION OFWORKERS AND EMPLOYEES IN THE ADMINISTRATION AND CONTROL OF FACTORIES AND OFFICES THROUGH THE ELECTION OF WORKERS AND EMPLOYEES INTO COUNCILS.

TO PRESERVE COMPLETE FREEDOM FOR UNIONS, SYNDICATES, ASSOCIATIONS, SOCIETIES AND POLITICAL PARTIES. TO ERADICATE THE COUNTER-REVOLUTIONARY FOUNDATIONS AND INSTITUTIONS OF THE ARMY AND RECONSTRUCT IT IN SUCH A MANNER THAT NO PLACE IS LEFT FOR PROFESSIONAL SOLDIERS IN THE REVOLUTIONARY CULTURE OF IRAN. TO PREVENT THE DISARMAMENT OF REVOLUTIONARY FORCES AND TO ESTABLISH A PEOPLE'S ARMY (IN THE PLACE OF ANY OTHER FORCE SUCH AS THE NATIONAL GUARDS AND THE CORPS OF THE GUARDIANS OF THE REVOLUTION) UNDER THE SUPERVISION OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COORDINATING COUNCIL BY ORGAINSING ALL ARMED MEMBERS OF THE REVOLUTIONARY FORCES AND OTHER VOLUNTEERS.

TO STRUGGLE FOR THE ABOLITION OF ANY DISCRIMINATION IN SOCIETY, TO ABOLISH ANY DISCRIMINATION AGAINST WOMEN FOR THEIR ENJOYMENT OF EQUAL RIGHTS WITH MEN, AND TO ABOLISH ANY DISCRIMINATION OF LABOUR IN ANY FORM, AND TO REPEAL INSTANTLY ALL LAWS LIMITING THE RIGHTS OF INDIVIDUAL CITIZENS.

TO ACCEPT AND TO AFFIRM THE CULTURAL RIGHTS AND THE RIGHT OF HOME RULE FOR ALL PEOPLES OF IRAN WITH THE VIEW TO PRESERVE THE NATIONAL UNITY AND INTEGRITY OF THE STATE. TO PROTECT THE CULTURAL, RELIGIOUS AND TRADITIONAL RIGHTS OF THE MINORITIES AND TO ESTABLISH SANCONS FOR PRESERVING THESE RIGHTS

TO ABOLISH CENSORSHIP COMPLETELY AND FINALLY, AND TO PRESERVE COMPLETE FREEDOMCND INDEPENDENCE FOR THE PRESS, RADIO AND TELEVISION; TO PREVENT ANY INTERVENTION BY ELEMENTS AND AGENCIES LIMITING E FREEDOMS UNDER ANY PRETEXT, EVEN TEMPORARILY; TO ENSURE THE PARTICIPATION OF ALL POLITICAL FORCES IN COMMUNICATING WITH THE MASSES WITHOUT ANY LIMITATION AND EXCEPTION; TO ECSURE THE FREEDOM OF RADIO AND TELEVISION BY ESTABLISHING SUPERVISION BY THE REVOLUTIONARY COORDINATING COUNCIL WITH THE COOPERATION OF THE REPRESENTATIVES OF THESE ORGANISATIONS.
TO ABOLISH THE ECONOMIC OPPRESSION OF ALL PEASANTS AND WORKERS OF THE LAND. . SULLIVAN

SUMMARY: ONE MILLION COMMENORATE ANNIVERSARY OF MOSSADEQ'S DEATH. EXECUTIONS CONTINUE. SHAYEGAN DISAVOWS POLITICAL AMBITIONS. KHOMEINI CONTINUES TO URGE ESTABLISHMENT OF ISLAMIC REPUBLIC, SAYS WOMEN'S RIGHTS WILL BE PROTECT UNDER IT. END SUMMARY.

APPROXIMATELY 1,000,000 MILLION PEOPLE GATHERED AT AHMADABAD, THE BURIAL PLACE OF MOSSADEQ, TO COMMEMORATE THE ANNIVERSARY OF HIS DEATH 12 YEARS AGO. THOSE IN ATTENDANCE RANGED FROM MEMBERS OF THE ISLAMIC MOJAHEDIN-E-KAHALQ TO REPRESENTATIVES OF THE COMMUNIST (AND TECHNICALLY STILL ILLEGAL) TUDEH PARTY AND INCLUDED SUCH DIPARATE ELEMENTS AS MEMBERS OF BAZARGAN'S PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT, ASSORTED NATIONAL FRONT TYPES, FOLLOWERS OF AYATOLLAH TALAGHANI, AND THE MARXIST FEDAYINE-KHALQ IN BETWEEN. THE RALLY'S SPONSOR AND MOSSADEQ'S GRANDSON, HEDAYATOLLAH MATIN-DAFTARI, USED THE OCCASION TO ANNOUNCE THE FORMATION OF NEW POLITICAL ORGANIZATION, THE NATIONAL DEMOCRATIC FRONT, AND ITS 11-POINT PROGRAM (SEPTEL).

OTHER SPEAKERS INCLUDED TALAGHANI WHO ATTACKED EXTREMISTS OF BOTH THE RIGHT AND THE LEFT, AND URGED UNITY LEST AGENTS OF IMPERIALSIM TAKE ADVANTAGE OF DISCORD TO UNDUE ALL THAT THE REVOLUTION HAS ACCOMPLISHED.

SEVEN MAJOR MILITARY, INTELLIGENCE, AND POLITICAL FIGURES WERE EXECUTED MARCH 5 (REPORTED SEPTEL). IN ADDITION, THREE OTHER LESSER RANKING MEN ACCUSED OF CRIMES AGAINST THE IRANIAN PEOPLE WERE EXECUTED IN ABADAN AND RASHT ON MARCH 5 AND 6, RESPECTIVELY. FINALLLY, FOUR MEN CHARGED WITH HOMOSEXUAL RAPE WERE REPORTED IN THE MARCH 6 PRESS TO HAVE BEEN EXECUTED AS WELL. A REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE SPOKESMAN, HOWEVER, COULD NOT CONFIRM THIS.

DR. ALI SHAYEGAN, WHO RETURNED TO TEHRAN RECENTLY ADMIDST PRESS REPORTS THAT HE WAS SLATED TO BECOME THE IRANIAN REPUBLIC'S FIRST PRESIDENT (STORIES SHAYEGAN HIMSELF MAY HAVE PLANTED), HAS BECOME THE LATEST IRANIAN POLITICAL FIGURE TO ACKNOWLEDGE KHOMEINI AS THE LEADER OF THE REVOLUTION HE ALSO DISAVOWED AMBITIONS TO BECOME IRAN'S PRESIDENT.

KHOMEINI IN RECENT PRONOUNCEMENTS FROM QOM HAS URGED THAT RELIGIOUS LEADERS USE THEIR INFLUENCE TO URGE THE PEOPLE TO THAT THE RIGHTS OF WOMEN WILL BE FULLY PROTECTED UNDER THE REPUBLIC. HE TOLD A CROWD OF CHEERING WOMEN AT THE FEYZIEH THEOLOGICAL SCHOOL THAT THEY HAVE THE RIGHT OF DIVORCE UNDER ISLAM, AND THAT INDEED THEY ENJOY A PLACE HIGHER THAN THAT OF MEN. HE ADDED, HOWEVER, THAT THEIR DIVORCE RIGHTS REQUIRED "CERTAIN CONDITIONS." ALSO RAISING DOUBTS ABOUT THE FUTURE OF WOMEN IN IRAN WAS THE ANNOUNCEMENT IN TEHRAN THAT COEDUCATION WILL BE TOTALLY ABOLISHED UNDER THE NEW ISLAMIC STRUCTURE.
THE GOOD NEWS, HOWEVER, WAS THAT THE PILL IS APPARENTLY OKAY WITH "AGHA".

SUMMARY: SOME POLICE HAVE RESUMED NORMAL DUTIES, BUT SEVERE AND LONG TERM PROBLEMS WITH POLICE ORGANIZATIONS STILL EXIST. END SUMMARY.

PRESENCE OF TRAFFIC POLICE ON TEHRAN STREETS HAS GRADUALLY RETURNED TO A SEMI-NORMAL STATE, ALTHOUGH TRAFFIC OFFICERS NO LONGER CARRY WEAPONS. AS OF LAST REPORT, THE POLICE ACADEMY HAD STILL NOT RESUMED ITS TRAINING FUNCTIONS, AND THE ACADEMY COMPOUND WAS UNDER THE "PROTECTION" OF REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS. MANY PRECINCT HOUSES WERE SUBJECT TO ATTACK AND THRASHING DURING THE LATTER DAYS OF THE REVOLUTION. THE CRIMINAL INVESTIGATIONS SECTION SEEMS TO HAVE SIMPLY DISAPPEARED. ATTEMPTS BY LOCAL CITIZENS TO REPORT THEFTS, ROBBERIES, ETC. TO PRECINCT HOUSES HAVE BEEN UNSUCCESSFUL, AND NORMAL INVESTIGATIONS ARE BEING HANDLED BY "COMMITTEE" BRANCHES.

WHILE TRAFFIC CONTROL (OR LACK OF) HAS GRADUALLY RETURNED TO HANDS OF UNIFORMED POLICE IN TEHRAN, THERE HAS BEEN LITTLE EVIDENCE THUS FAR THAT OTHER LAW ENFORCEMENT ACTIVITIES HAVE BEEN RESUMED BY PRE-REVOLUTION POLICE. RECENT STATEMENT BY ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY CENTRAL COMMITTEE CLAIMS THAT MAINTENANCE OF LAW AND ORDER ARE STILL FUNCTIONS OF "COMMITTEE" FORCES BUT THAT SUCH DUTIES ARE TEMPORARY AND WILL BE HANDED OVER TO GOVERNMENT AGENCIES AS SOON AS LAW ENFORCEMENT DEPARTMENTS ARE AGAIN ESTABLISHED.

"REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS" REMAIN AT MANY GOVERNMENT BUILDINGS, INCLUDING GOVERNMENT-OWNED HOUSING OF PRE-REVOLUTION OFFICIALS. STATUS OF EMBASSY COMPOUND UNDER JOINT MUJAHEDDIN AND AIR FORCE GUARD, REMAINS UNCHANGED. THOSE PRECINCT STATIONS WHICH HAVE REOPENED ARE ALSO STILL OCCUPIED BY KHOMEINI GUARDS, AND DURING VISIT BY EMBOFF STEMPEL TO TEHRAN'S 7TH PRECINCT HEADQUARTERS TODAY THERE WAS NO EVIDENCE OF POLICE PRESENCE TO OFFSET REVOLUTIONARY GUARD OCCUPANCY.

EMBOFF METRINKO HAD OPPORTUNITY TO SPEAK AT LENGTH WITH SOME POLICE OFFICERS H W OQYV,#AND FOUND THEM TO BE COMPLETELY DISSPIRITED. ACCORDING TO POLICE COLONEL WHO HAD BEEN PARTICIPATING IN SENIOR SEMINAR AT TEHRAN ACADEMY, THE BUILDINGS HAVE BEEN THOROUGHLY LOOTED, AND POLICE PRESENCE WAS LIMITED TO A FEW OFFICERS STOPPING BY TO SIP TEA AND LEAVE ASAP. TWO LIEUTENANTS (TRAFFIC POLICE) ALSO PRESENT WERE IN STATE BEST DESCRIBED AS BLACK DEPRESSION.

THIS ATTITUDE IS UNDERSTANDABLE, SINCE POLICE OFFICERS AND LOCAL PATROLMEN THROUGHOUT IRAN WERE SUBJECT TO ASSASSINATION AND HEAVY ATTACK DURING LATTER MONTHS OF REVOLUTION; E.G., THE COLONEL CLAIMED THAT IN HIS HOME TOWN (SONGHOR, KERMANSHAH PROVINCE) ALL THE TOWN POLICE WERE KILLED BY LOCAL MOBS IN CHAOTIC WITCH HUNT IMMEDIATELY FOLLOWING COLLAPSE OF BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT. THE THREE OFFICERS PRESENT SPENT CONSIDERABLE TIME REVIEWING LIST OF FRIENDS AND COWORKERS WHO HAD BEEN KILLED, ARRESTED OR HAD SIMPLY DISAPPEARED DURING WITCH HUNT PERIOD.

GIVEN ANTIPATHY OF REVOLUTIONARY FORCES TOWARDS POLICE IN GENERAL, CONTINUING PUBLICIZED EXECUTIONS OF EX-POLICE OFFICIALS (LARGE PHOTO OF POLICE LIEUTENANT AT MOMENT OF DEATH IN FRONT OF QOM REVOLUTIONARY COURT FIRING SQUAD GRACES KAYHAN'S FRONT PAGE TODAY), LACK OF OFFICE BUILDINGS AND BASIC EQUIPMENT (POLICE RADIOS, GUNS, ETC. WERE SEIZED BY MOBS DURING POST-BAKTHIAR CHAOS, AND MANY PRECINCT HOUSES THROUGHOUT COUNTRY WERE DAMAGED OR DESTROYED), ASSUMPTION IS THAT CONSIDERABLE TIME WILL PASS BEFORE POLICE REGAIN CONFIDENCE IN THEMSELVES, OR BEFORE POLICE ORGANIZATION WILL BE ABLE TO FUNCTION AT PRE-REVOLUTION LEVEL. SULLIVAN NOTE BY OC/T: #PARA 6 AS RECEIVED.
C-ENTIRE TEXT.

SUMMARY: RUMORS THAT BAZARGAN HAS RESIGNED DENIED BY PM'S OFFICE. SHAH TO BE TRIED IN ABSENTIA. EXECUTIONS, ADMINISTRATION OF REVOLUTIONARY JUSTICE CONTINUE. MADANI SAYS U.S. PLOTTED PRO-SHAH COUP. SHARIAT-MADARI CONDEMNS ATTACKS ON THE PRESS, BUT ENDORSES "INTELLECTUAL" CENSORSHIP WHICH NIRT HAS ALREADY PUT INTO PRACTICE. END SUMMARY.

THE MARCH 7 TEHRAN JOURNAL CARRIED A REPORT OF RUMORS THAT PM BAZARGAN, FED UP WITH HIS GOVERNMENT'S INABILITY TO BRING THE REVOLUTIONARYCOMMITTEE SYSTEM UNDER EVEN NOMINAL CONTROL, HAD TRAVELLED TO QOM TO SUBMIT HIS RESIGNATION TO KHOMEINI. THE PM'S OFFICE HAS DENIED THESE RUMORS AS ABSOLUTELY GROUNDLESS. BAZARGAN HAD THREATENED TO RESIGN EARLIER IF THE PRESENT SYSTEM OF PARALLEL GOVERNMENTS WAS NOT ELIMINATED. WHILE FM SANJABI TOLD THE AMBASSADOR THAT BAZARGAN ACTUALLY HAD NO INTENTION OF RESIGNING, IT IS A FACT THAT THE COMMITTEES CONTINUE TO OPERATE AS INDEPENDENT ENTITIES.

THEIR ADMINISTRATION OF REVOLUTIONARY JUSTICE, IN PARTICULAR, HAS BEEN AN ACUTE EMBARRASSMENT FOR BAZARGAN, AND THERE IS AS YET NO INDICATION THAT THE GOVERNMENT IS BEGINNING TO WREST CONTROL OF THIS IMPORTANT FUNCTION (OR ANY OTHER, FOR THAT MATTER) FROM THE COMMITTEES.

DEPUTY PM ENTEZAM AT A PRESS BRIEFING MARCH 6 ANNOUNCED THAT THE SHAH AND HIS FAMILY WOULD BE TRIED IN ABSENTIA. HE DID NOT SPECIFY THE PROPOSED CHARGES, BUT IT APPEARS THAT A MAJOR OBJECTIVE OF THE TRIAL WOULD BE TO CONVINCE FOREIGN GOVERNMENTS TO COOPERATE IN REPATRIATION OF PAHLAVI ASSETS WHICH THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT CLAIMS BELONG TO IRAN. ENTEZAM SAID THAT HE HOPED SWITZERLAND WOULD FREEZE THE SHAH'S FORTUNE ALLEGEDLY ACCUMULATED IN SECRET ACCOUNTS IN THAT COUNTRY, ONCE THE TRIAL PROVED HIS GUILT. "IF A PERSON IS CONVICTED OF CRIMES IN HIS OWN COUNTRY," HE SUGGESTED, "THEN ALL NATIONS WOULD HONOR THE COURT'S RULING AND WOULD ACT ACCORDINGLY."

THE EXECUTIONS IN TEHRAN MARCH 4 OF FOUR INDIVIDUALS CONVICTED OF HOMOSEXUAL RAPE (REPORTED IN THE MARCH 6 SITREP) HAVE BEEN CONFIRMED. IN ADDITION, THREE AFGHANS WERE EXECUTED MARCH 4 IN SHIRAZ, ALSO FOR HOMOSEXUAL RAPE. ON MARCH 6 A POLICE LIEUTENANT, YADOLLAH MOFTIZADEH, CONVICTED OF MURDERING FIVE AND INJURING 103 OTHER, WAS EXECUTED IN QOM. MOFTIZADEH'S TRIAL, WHICH LASTED TWO DAYS, WAS THE FIRST BY A REVOLUTIONARY COURT THT HAS BEEN OPEN TO THE PUBLIC. MOFTIZADEH WAS REPRESENTED BY CIVILIAN COUNSEL, BUT HIS JUDGES WERE SIX MUSLIM CLERGYMEN.

IN KEEPING WITH KHOMEINI'S RECENT PRONOUNCEMENT THAT ISLAMIC JUSTICE BE SWIFT AND UNENCUMBERED BY TIME-CONSUMING APPELATE PROCEDURES, THE COURT'S VERDICT WAS FINAL AND MOFTIZADEH WAS EXECUTED ALMOST IMMEDIATELY AFTER IT WAS HANDED DOWN. ELSEWHERE, A MARRIED WOMAN AND HER PARAMOUR, CAUGHT IN AN ADULTEROUS ACT, WERE PUBLICLY SHIPPED IN KELARABAD. IN HIS MARCH 5 PRESS BRIEFING ENTEZAM CONCEDED THAT THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS HAVE BEEN ACTING IN TOTAL INDEPENDENCE OF THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT IN ADMINISTERING ISLAMIC JUSTICE. THE MARCH 6 TEHRAN JOURNAL INDICATED THAT AS MANY AS 200 DEATH SENTENCES MAY HAVE BEEN PASSED DOWN TO DATE, AND THAT MORE THAN 25 EXECUTIONS HAVE BEEN CARRIED OUT.
OUR UNOFFICIAL COUNT NOW STANDS AT 29.

DEFENSE MINISTER AHMAD MADANI IN A TELEVISION INTERVIEW ACCUSED THE U.S. OF PLOTTING A COUP EARLIER THIS YEAR. HE SAID THAT THE VISIT OF GEN. HUYSER IN JAN WAS "TO ORGANIZE A COUP D'ETAT IN FAVOR OF THE SHAH AND THE WEST." WE INTEND TO MAKE NO COMMENT IF QUERIED ON THIS MATTER.

ELSEWHERE ON THE MEDIA FRONT, SHARIAT-MADARI HAS CONDEMNED ATTACKS ON THE PRESS. HE SAID THAT THE PRESS HAS A DUTY TO ARTICULATE NATIONAL GOALS, ADDING THAT THE ISLAMIC GOAL, OF COURSE, IS THE BEST. HE SAID THAT JOURNALISTS MUST REFRAIN FROM INTRODUCING SUBJECTS WHICH WEAKEN OR DESTROY THE FUNDAMENTAL PRINCIPLES OF ISLAM. SUCH RESTRAINT, HE CONCEDED, IS A KIND OF CENSORSHIP, WHICH IS JUSTIFIABLE IN THE INTERESTS OF NATION. PERHAPS REFLECTING SHARIAT-MADARI'S VIEW, NUREDDIN GHARAVI, THE NEW HEAD OF NIRT'S NEWS DEPARTMENT, SAID MARCH 6 THAT PROGRAMMING WILL BE RESHAPED TO ELIMINATE EVERYTHING THAT VIOLATES THE TENETS OF ISLAM.

ACCORDINGLY, POPULAR PVJFORMERS SUCH AS GOUGOUSH, MAHASTI AND HAIDEH WILL NOT LONGER APPEAR BECAUSE THEY ARE ASSOCIATED WITH OLD, CORRUPT REGIME. SIMILARLY, GHARAVI SAID THAT EVEN THOUGH HE HIMSELF HAD BEEN A FAN OF MUSCIAN ABDOL VAHAB SHAHIDI, THE LATTER HAS NO PLACE AT NIRT BECAUSE OF HIS SAVAK CONNECTIONS. EXEMPLARY OF SELF-CENSORSHIP IN THE MEDIA IN THE INTERESTS OF ISLAM, ON THE EVENING OF MARCH 6 NIRT BROADCAST IN FULL THE REMARKS OF AYATOLLAH TALAGHANI AND A MOJAHEDIN SPOKESMAN AT AHMADABAB THE PREVIOUS DAY BUT NOT THOSE OF HEDAYATOLLAH MATIN-DAFTARI WHO USED THE OCCASION TO ANNOUNCE THE FORMATION OF A NEW, SECULARIST POLITICAL GROUPING.
NIRT PLEADED THE LATENESS OF THE HOUR FOR CUTTING THE PROGRAM SHORT, AND PROMISED THAT THE REMAINDER WOULD BE BRODCAST AAT A LATER BUT UNSPECIFIED TIME. SULLIVAN

IN VIEW OF THIS FACT, I HAVE DROPPED THE PARAGRAPH FROM THE NOTE TO THE FOREIGN MINISTRY (REFTEL) WHICH ASKS FOR A BRIEFING ON "POLICIES AND PLANS" OF PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT, SINCE I WOULD MUCH RATHER DISCUSS THIS SUBJECT WITH BAZARGAN THAN SANJABI.

ACCORDINGLY, NOTE TO FOREIGN MINISTRY HAS BEEN REWRITTEN AS SET OUT BELOW. SINCE THE MINISTRY IS NOT YET WORKING, I HAVE SENT IT TO THE HOME OF UNDERSECRETARY ZELLI, WHO IS IN CHARGE OF THE MINISTRY. HE TOLD ME HE WOULD PASS ITS CONTENTS TO PRIME MINISTER. THE EMBASSY OF THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICAN PRESENTS ITS COMPLEMENTS TO THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS AND HAS THE HONOR TO STATE THAT THE GOVERNMENT OF THE UNITED STATES, IN CONTINUATION OF ITS DIPLOMATIC RELATIONS WITH IRAN, LOOKS FORWARD TO A COOPERATIVE AND FRIENDLY PURSUIT OF THOSE RELATIONS WITH THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT OF IRAN.

THE EMBASSY AVAILS ITSELF OF THIS OPPORTUNITY TO RENEW TO THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS THE ASSURANCES OF ITS HIGHTEST CONSIDERATION. IT WILL BE NOTED THAT I HAVE DROPPED ISLAMIC REPUBLIC JARGON BECAUSE I FEEL THAT TITLE WILL HAVE EFFECT ONLY AFTER NEW CONSTITUTION RATIFIED BY REFRENDUM. 5.NOTE TO SANJABI IS WRITTEN AS IT WAS PREPARED IN REFTEL AND IS BEING DELIVERED BY HAND BY POLITICAL COUNSELOR.

REFTEL WAS DRAFTED ON FEBRUARY 14 AND LOCKED UP IN SAFE AT TIME OF ATTACK ON EMBASSY. IT WAS SENT TO YOU TODAY FOR

REFTEL CONTRARY TO THE ASSESSMENT WE FIND LITTLE CAUSE FOR EVEN MODERATE OPTIMISM IN THE PRESENT IRANIAN SITUATION. ALL THE WEAKNESS IN PM BAZARGAN'S POSITION ENUMERATED IN REFTEL ARE VALID, BUT THE FACTORS LISTED IN HIS FAVOR SUGGEST STRENGTHTHAT SIMPLY DOES NOT EXIST.

FOR EXAMPLE, WHILE MANY IRANIANS ARE INDEED ANXIOUS FOR AN END TO THE TURMOIL WHICH HAS GRIPPED IRAN, THEY ARE LARGELY POWERLESS TO BRING IT ABOUT. EVENTS HAVE MOVED BEYOND THE CONTROL OF ANY INDIVIDUAL OR GROUP AND ARE NOW PRECEEDING UNDER A MOMENTUM OF THEIR OWN TOWARD A DENOUEMENT THAT FEW MAY PRESENTLY ENVISION OR DESIRE.

FURTHER, THERE APPEARS TO BE A GROWING RIFT BETWEEN KHOMEINI, WHO HAS BECOME INCREASINGLY INTRANSIGENT IN HIS DEMANDS FOR A COMPLETE PURGE OF FOREIGN INFLUENCES FROM IRANIAN SOCIETY AND ITS TOTAL ISLAMICIZATION, AND BAZARGAN, WHO IS ATTEMPTING (EXTREMELY INEFFECTUALLY) TO BE ALL THINGSTO ALL IRANIANS. REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES, RESPONSIVE TO KHOMEINI AND CONTEMPTUOUS OF THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT, CONTINUE TO CONSTITUTE A LAW UNTO THEMSELVES, AND THEIR ACTIONS ARE REGULARLY AT CROSS-PURPOSES WITH THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT'S ATTEMPTS TO ASSERT IT AUTHORITY.

MILLION STILL HANG ON KHOMEINI'S WORDS, WHETHER OUT OF BLIND OBEDIENCE OR FEAR, BUT LATELY HIS PRONOUNCEMENTS HAVE TENDED TO EXACERBATE DIVISIONS WITHIN IRANIAN SOCIETY RATHER THAN TO BRING DISPARATE FACTIONS TOGETHER IN A COMMON SENSE OF PURPOSE. HIS ATTACK ON BAZARGAN'S GOVERNMENT MARCH 7 SUGGESTS THAT HIS OBSESSION WITH RIDDING IRAN OF NON-ISLAMIC INFLUENCES HAS TURNED HIM AGAINSTTHE PRIME MINISTER HE CHOSE HIMSELF.

WHILE OIL PRODUCTION HAS RESUMED AGAIN ON A LIMITED BASIS AND THE COMMERCIAL SECTOR OF THE ECONOMY SHOWS SOME SIGNS OF LIFE, THE ECONOMY AS A WHOLE MAY BE TEETERING ON THE VERGE OF TOTAL COLLAPSE. LITTERALLY MILLIONS ARE OUT OF WORK, FEW FACTORIES ARE OPERATING, AND INTERNATIONAL TRADE REMAINS IN TOTAL CHAOS.

RESUMPTION OF CLASSES AT THE HIGH SCHOOL LEVEL HAS LITTLE SIGNIFICANCE SINCE STUDENTS CAN TAKE TO THE STREETS AGAIN AT A MOMENT'S NOTICE. THE REOPENING OF THE UNIVERSITIES HAS SIMPLY PROVIDED A FORUM FOR ACTING OUT THE POLITICAL DIVISION IN IRANIAN SOCIETY WHICH ARE RAPIDLY WIDENING. THE DIALECTIC ON CAMPUS MORE OFTEN THAN NOT RESULTS IN A FOMENTATION OF POLITICAL EXTREMIS THAN IT DOES TO BRIDGE DIFFERENCES OF POLITICAL OPINION.
THE MILITARY AND LAW ENFORCEMENT AGENCIES REMAIN IN ALMOST TOTAL DISARRAY. THESE ORGANIZATIONS CANNOT BE COUNTED UPON AS A FORCE FOR STABILITY ANY TIME IN THE FORESEEABLE FUTURE.

GIVEN THE POLITICAL DIVISIONS THAT ARE SHAPING UP, THE DESIRE TO FIND FACE-SAVING COMPROMISES MAY NOT BE SUFFICIENT TO BRING THEM ABOUT. THE DIFFERENCES AMONG THE CONTENDING PARTIES MAY PROVE SO IRRECONCILABLE THAT NOTHINGSHORT OF VIOLENT CONFORNTATION WILL RESOLVE THEM.

IN SUM, BAZARGAN'S PROSPECTS FOR SEEING IRAN SUCCESSFULLY THROUGH THE POST-REVOLUTIONARY TRANSITION TO MODERATE, PRO-WESTERN REPBULICANISM ARE DUBIOUS IN THE EXTREME. SULLIVAN NOTE BY OC/T: NOT PASSED ALL NATO CAPITALS.

ON MARCH 8, 1979, TWENTY-TWO DAYS AFTER THE ARMED ATTACK WHICH RESULTED IN THE LOSS OF OUR COMPOUND, EMBASSY TEHRAN HAS BEGUN TO FUNCTION AGAIN FROM THE CHANCERY BUILDING, WHICH STILL RETAINS AN ANNOYING RESIDUE OF TEAR GAS. IT IS AN AUSTERE OPERATION, WITH ONLY LIMITED COMMUNICATIONS AND WILL ALL RUGS, CURTAIN AND OTHER POROUS MATERIAL REMOVED FROM THE BUIDLING IN AN EFFORT TO MINIMIZE THE RETENTIVITY OF THE GAS. APPROPRIATELY, IT IS SNOWING HEAVILY TODAY.

HOWEVER, ALL THE BROKEN WIDNOW PANES HAVE BEEN REPLACED THE DOORS HAVE EITHER BEEN WIRED SHUT OR BARRICADED, AND, EXCEPT FOR THE BULLET SCARS AND THE MISSING SHUTTERS,THE EXTERIOR OF THE BUILDING LOOKS MORE OR LESS NORMAL. IN THE INTERIOR, FURNITURE WHICH WAS NOT BROKEN HAS BEEN DECONTAMINATED AND PLACED IN OFFICE SPACE. BUT, ALMOST ANYTHING THAT WAS DESTRUCTIBLE, SUCH AS PAINTINGS, PHOTOS, MAPS, ETC., IS MISSING.

BECAUSE THE SIZE OF THE MISSION HAS SHRUNK DRASTICALLY, WE HAVE READICALLY REALLOCATED SPACE WITHIN THE CHANCERY, AND WITHIN THE COMPOUND AS A WHOLE. BY SO DOING, WE HAVE BROUGHT ALL OUR FUNCTIONS WITH THE EXCEPTION OF THE ICA AND THE HOSPITAL, INSIDE OUR COMPOUND. THIS MEANS THAT THE RESIDUAL ARMISH/MAAG GROUP AS WELL AS THE CONSULAR SECTION ARE BOTH FUNCTIONING HERE. IT MAKE FOR A MORE EASILY CONTROLLED OPERATION, BUT, AT THE SAME TIME, ALSO CONCENTRATES THE TARGET.

OUR IRANIAN STAFF IS MORE OR LESS INTACT.WE ARE DOING A NOSE COUNT TO DETERMINE HOW MANY WE MAY HAVE LOST, IF ANY. OUR EFFORTS TO BEHAVE LIKE A NORMAL EMBASSY WILL BEGIN TO TAKE ON SOME SUBSTANCE AFTER THE PASSAGE OF THE FRIDAY-SATURDAY WEEKEND. THEREFORE, AS OF SUNDAY, MARCH 11, WE SHOULD BE ABLE TO OPERATE RELATIVELY NORMALLY, EXCEPT FOR THE ABSENCE OF HIGH-SPEED COMMUNICATIONS. ONCE OUR SKY-LINK, FASTCAST PACKAGE ARRIVES AND IS INSTALLED, WE LOOK FORWARD TO LIFTING OUR COMMUNICATIONS RESTRICTIONS.

TODAY, THEREFORE, WOULD BE A USEFUL TIME TO REVIEW WHAT WE HAVE DONE IN THE PAST THREE WEEKS AND WHAT IMMEDIATE TASKS LIE AHEAD. A Z OF THIS HAS TO BE READ IN THE CONTEXT OF THE REVOLUTIONARY SITUATION IN IRAN, WHERE THERE IS NO RPT NO FIXED AUTHORITY AND WHERE GUNFIRE IS A CONSTANT OCCURRENCE. 7 IN REVIEWING OUR PAST ACTIVITIES, THE MOST PROMINENT AND CERTAINLY THE MOST TIME-CONSUMING, HAS BEEN THE EVACUATION OF THE AMERICAN COMMUNITY. THE PROCESSING AND MOVEMENT OF THIS GROUP CONSITUTED ONLY PART OF THE EFFORT. AFTER THEIR DEPARTURE, WE HAVE HAD TO SPEND A GREAT DEAL OF TIME MOPPING UP AFTER THEM.

IN THE CASE OF THE OFFICIAL AMERICAN COMMUNITY, THIS HAS MEANT GATHERING UP ALL THEIR HOUSEHOLD POSSESSIONS, PACKING THEM, STORING TEHEM TEMPORARILY, TRANSPORTING THEM TO THE AIRPORT AND SHIPPING THEM OUT ON CHARTERED AIRCRAFT. THIS PROCESS CONTINUES. A SPECIAL COMPLICATION HAS BEEN THE AUTOMOBILES THEY LEFT BEHIND. PROTECTING THEM AGAINST RAMPANT THEFT, MATCHING DOCUMENTS AGAINST KEYS, ETC., HAS RESULTED IN THE CONVERSION OF ONE OF THE EMBASSY GRASSY AREAS INTO A USED-CAR LOT.

THIS PROBLEM OF PACKING, SHIPPING, AND SORTING HAS BEEN PARTICULARLY COMPLICATED FOR THE ARMISH-MAAG GROUP. SOME OF THE PROPERTY IN THE MAAG HOUSES BELONGS TO THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT. SOME OF THE AUTOMOBILES USED BY THE MAAG PERSONNEL AS PRIVATE VEHICLES WERE ACTUALLY ON LOAN FROM THE IRANIAN ARMED SERVICES. SOME LEASES HAVE BEEN TERMINATED, OTHER ARE STILL RUNNING AND DOCUMENTATION IS STILL INACCESSIBLE WITHIN THE GULF DISTRICT MILITARY COMPOUND. THE ARMISH-MAAG OFFICIALS WHO ARE ATTEMPTING TO PURSUE THIS WORK ARE SPORADICALLY ARRESTED BY THE LOCAL "KOMITAYS" AND HAVE TO BE RELEASED BY HIGHER INTERCESSION-ALMOST ON A DAILY BASIS.

AS A RESULT OF THE EVACUATION, THE OFFICIAL AMERICAN COMMUNITY IN IRAN IS NOW JUST UNDER ONE HUNDRED. THE TOTAL EXPATRIATE RPT EXPATRIATE AMERICAN COMMUNITY IN IRAN IS ESTIMATED TO BE JUST UNDER ONE THOUSAND. THIS LATTER FIGURE DOES NOT RPT NOT TAKE INTO ACCOUNT ANOTHER 2,5003,000 PERSONS WHO HAVE A LEGAL CLAIM TO US CITIZENSHIP (AS DUAL NATIONALS, CHILDREN OF MIXED MARRIAGES, OR BY VIRTUE OF FORTUITOUS BIRTH IN THE UNITED STATES). WE DO NOT RPT NOT EXPECT THIS GROUP OF PERMANENT RESIDENTS TO SEEK EVACUATION, BUT THEY WILL CONTINUE TO REQUIRE OCCASIONAL CONSULAR SERVICES AND OTHER ATTENTION FROM THIS MISSION.

THE SECOND ACCOMPLISHMENT HAS BEEN THE PHYSICAL RESTORATION OF THE COMPOUND ITSELF. THE STATUS OF THE CHANCERY HAS ALREADY BEEN MENTIONED. THE AMBASSADOR'S RESIDENCE, WHICH SIMILARLY HAD ALMOST EVERY WINDOW SHATTERED BY GUNFIRE, HAS HAD NEW GLASS PANES INSTALLED AND DOORS AND LOCKS SECURED. INTERIORR DAMAGE TO PLASTER, TO MIRROS AND TO DOORS WHOSE LOCKS AND HANDLES WERE SHOT OFF HAS BEEN LEFT FOR TREATMENT AT A LATER DATE. REPAIRS OF A SUPERFICIAL SORT HAVE ALSO BEEN MADE TO OTHER BUILDINGS AND WE HAVE FOUGHT A CONSTANT BUT LOSING BATTLE AGAINST PILFERAGE BY OUR VARIOUS IRANIAN GUAD FORCES FROM SEVERAL INSTALLATIONS, ESPECIALLY THE WELL-STOCKED CO-OP.
SOME RELOCATION OF FUNCTIONS AND SERVICES HAS REULTED AS PART AND PARCEL OF THIS PROCESS.

THE THIRD ACCOMPLISHMENT HAS BEEN THE TEDIOUS PROCESS OF RECLAIMING THE ICA BUILDING, WHICH WE OWN, FORM THE FEDAYEEN GROUP WHICH OCCUPIED IT FOR OVER TWO WEEKS IN THE APPARENT BELIEF THAT IT WAS A CIA BUILDING. (THERE OUGHT TO BE SOME INSTRUCTIVE LESSON IN NOENCLATURE HERE FOR THE NITWITS WHO CHANGED THE NAME FOR USIS.) THE BUILDING IS A MERE SHELL, WITH ALL ITS EQUIPMENT EITHER STOLEN OR DESTORYED.

AT THE CURRENT MOMENT, THE PRIMARY CONCERN IS HOW TO ESTABLISH SOME SECURITY FOR THE PREMISES WHICH WILL PERMIT ITS FUTURE OPERATION. ------------------070681 081414Z /50 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 252 SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 2796 LIMDIS

THE FOURTH TASK WHICH WE HAVE JUST COMPLETED IS THE SATISFACTION OF PAY DEMANDS BY IRANIAN STAFF WHO WORKED AT ARMISH-MAAG, AT THE INTELLIGENCE GATHERING POSTS IN THE NORTH, AND IN THE SUPPORT GROUP FOR THOSE POSTS. THIS PAYMENT WILL KEEP THESE EMPLOYEES QUIESCENT FOR AWHILE, BUT WE STILL HAVE TO WORK OUT LONGER TERM SOLUTIONS.

A CONSTANT TASK HAS CONCERNED THE SECURITY OF THE EMBASSY COMPOUND. THE COMPOUND IS CURRENTLY " GUARDED" BY THREE SEPARATE GROUPS. THE FIRST IS A MUJAHEDIN UNIT ASSIGNED BY THE KOMITAY, WHICH CONSIDERS IT HAS OVER-ALL RESPONSIBILITY. THE SECOND IS A SMALL GROUP ASSIGNED BY DR. YAZDI TO GUARD THE AMBASSADOR AND HIS RESIDENCE. THE THIRD IS A MOTLEY AIR FORCE GROUP WHICH PATROLS THE EAST AND SOUTH WALLS OF THE COMPOUND. IN ADDITION TO THESE, THERE ARE OUR LONG-TIME IRANIAN GATE GUARDS AND A MARINE SECURITY GUARD. WE HAVE ALSO HAD THREE SY OFFICERS.

WE NEED THE IRANIANS TO RETALIATE AGAINST THE SNIPERS AND "FRANC-TIREURS" IN AUTOMOBILES WHO MAKE THE TEHRAN NIGHTS SO NOISY. THEREFORE, WE DO NOT RPT NOT WISH TO THROW THEM ALL OUT. HOWEVER, KEEPING THEM FROM FIGHTING WITH EACH OTHER, FROM LOOTING OUR PROPERTY, AND FROM SHOOTING UP THE PREMISES OCCUPIES A LOT OF OUR TIME.

WE HAVE A NUMBER OF OTHERPROBLEMS ASSOCIATED WITH THE PREVIOUS NATURE OF OUR PRESENCE. THERE IS THE SAGA OF OUR COMMISSARY, OUR A.P.O., OUR MEDICAL STORES, OUR RECORDS AND EQUIPMENT AT THE ACOM SITE, THE MAC TERMINAL, THE GULF DISTRICT, AND AT TEAM HOUSES. THESE PROBLEMS ARE BEING ATTACKED BY A CONSTANT SERIES OF FORAYS AGAINST THE FIEFS OF VARIOUS KOMITAYS, ISLAMIC PERSONALITIES, AND COMPETING ELEMENTS OF THE GOVERNMENT. WE HAVE OCCASIONAL ACCESS, SPORADIC ABILITY TO EXTRACT (AS FROM THE COMMISSARY) AND CONTINUAL REBUFF. DEVISING NEW AND INGENIOUS PRESSURE TACTICS IS A DAILY CHALLENGE.

LIQUIDATION OF OUR ENORMOUS CO-OP IS ALSO A SPECIAL PROBLEM. WE ARE ATTEMPTING TO SELL CONTAINERS STRANDED IN PORTS IN ORDER TO PAY OFF OUR CREDITORS. WE ARE TRYING TO INVENTORY AND PROTECT HIGH VALUE ITEMS FOR LATER SALES TO ASSURE ADEQUATE LIQUIDITY TO PAY A SMALLER CO-OP STAFF, AND WE ARE TRYING TO ORGANIZE A SMALLER, MORE RELEVANT OPERATION WHICH WILL SERVICE 100 PEOPLE RATHER THAN 8,000. OUR LIQUOR STOCKS, WHICH MAY BE UNSALEABLE IN AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC, WILL ASSURE US OF THE HIGHEST PER CAPITA LIQUOR LOCKER IN THE WORLD.

16 IN THE MIDST OF AL THIS WE HAVE TO ARRANGE, ON AN AD HOC BASIS, FOR THE BASIC NECESSITIES. THIS MEANS A CONSTANT ARGUMENT WITH AIRPORT AUTHORITIES TO GET POUCHES, WITH ROADBLOCK AUTHORITIES TO PERMIT PASSAGE, WITH VENDORS TO GET SUPPLIES, AND WITH CONTRACTORS TO GET SERVICES.

INCIDENTAL TO ALL THE ABOVE, WE ATTEMPT TO FUNCTION AS AN EMBASSY. THIS MEANS WE KEEP UP OUR POLITICAL CONTACTS, SEARCH FOR NEW ONES, GATHER INFORMATION, OPINION AND DATA. WE TRY TO ANALYZE A RATHER BEWILDERING SITUATION AND ANSWER THE OCCASIONAL INQUIRIES THAT COME FROM WASHINGTON.

AS WE LOOK AHEAD, OUR IMMEDIATE TASKS ARE CLEAR. WE SHALL HAVE TO CONTINUE THE TASK OF RE-ESTABLISHING OUR PHYSICAL PRESENCE. THIS WILL REQUIRE REPAIR WORK TO OUR BUILDINGS, REPLACEMENT OF ITEMS WHICH WERE DESTROYED, INSTALLATION OF ADEQUATE COMMUNICATIONS, AND THE ASSIGNMENT OF PERMANENT STAFF TO RUN A MORE LIMITED OPERATION THAN HERETOFORE. IF WE ARE GOING TO REOPEN CONSULAR ACTIVITY ON A REASONABLY BROAD BASIS, WE NEED FUNDS IMMEDIATELY TO REFURBISH THE IRAN GALLERIES BUILDING ACROSS FROM THE CHANCERY TO REPLACE THE OLD CONSULATE, ON WHICH THE LEASE IS EXPIRING AND WHICH WE ARE ABANDONING.

THE QUESTION OF FUTURE SECURITY IS A MAJOR PROBLEM. WE HOPE TO HAVE A MARINE SECURITY GUARD OF 24 MEN, BUT, IN THE ABSENCE OF EXTERNAL SECURITY BY IRANIANS, THEY WILL BE UNABLE TO PROTECT THE COMPOUND AGAINST THE SORT OF ATTACK WE SUFFERED ON FEBRUARY 14. IT IS NOT POSSIBLE TO PREDICT WHEN CONDITIONS IN THE CITY MIGHT MAKE SUCH SECURITY FEASIBLE, BUT IT IS POSSIBLE TO SAY THAT SOME EVENT, SUCH AS A VISIT BY THE SHAH TO THE UNITED STATES, COULD PROVIDE THE EXCUSE WHICH WOULD TRIGGER ANOTHER ASSAULT.

THE SCOPE OF OUR FUTURE OPERATIONS REMAINS TO BE DETERMINED. WE DO NOT RPT NOT KNOW WHEN IT MAY PROVE SAFE TO ATTEMPT FULL SCALE CONSULAR OPERATIONS. WE DO NOT RPT NOT KNOW WHETHER WE WILL HAVE ANY SORT OF MILITARY LOGISTICS RELATIONSHIP IN THE FUTURE. WE DOUBT WE WILL HAVE ANY INTELLIGENCE ASSOCIATION, BUT EVEN THAT WILL HAVE TO BE CONTEMPLATED.

ALL THESE MATTERS WILL TAKE TIME TO RESOLVE. THEIR RESOLUTION WILL, IN PART, BE DETERMINED BY THE RESOLUTION OF THE VARIOUS POLITICAL CONFLICTS WHICH CURRENTLY BESET IRAN. IF THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT, WITH ITS DEMOCRATIC, HUMANISTIC IDEALS, IS TO SURVIVE, WE MAY HAVE RELATIVELY BENIGN ATMOSPHERE IN WHICH TO OPERATE. IF EITHER THE ISLAMIC EXTREMISTS OR THE MARXISTS PREVAIL IN THE STRUGGLE, WE MAY FIND OUR FUTURE DIPLOMATIC PROSPECTS HERE EXTREMELY LIMITED. IT WILL BE WEEKS OR MONTHS BEFORE WE WILL KNOW.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY: KHOMEINI COMMITTEE HAS ORDERED ALL SENIOR OFFICIALS OF PAST 15 YEARS ARRESTED. ONE SOURCE ESTIMATES THIS COULD BE BETWEEN 16,000 AND 30,000. GOI PROVINCIAL GOVERNORS NOT ACCEPTED IN PROVINCES. SOURCES CLOSE TO COMMITTEE PRISON STRUCTURE SAY EXECUTIONS ARE MUCH MORE NUMEROUS THAN ADMITTED TO AND STRONGLY CRITICIZED U.S. ON HUMAN RIGHTS. REVOLUTIONARY RHETORIC BECOMING MORE PRONOUNCED. KHOMEINI BLAST AT GOVERNMENT OPENS WAY FOR FEDAYEEN (PF) TO OPERATE IN HIS NAME. DISSOLUTION, CHAOS, AND VIOLENCE ARE HALLMARKS OF TODAY'S POLITICS IN IRAN. END SUMMARY.

HEDAYAT ESLAMINIA (SEE PREVIOUS REPORTING ON THIS SOURCE) URGENTLY ASKED TO SEE POLOFF STEMPEL MORNING MAR 8. A FORMER MAJLES DEPUTY (1971-75) AND POLITICAL BROKER FOR PAST YEAR. HE SAID TWO OF HIS BEST RELIGIOUS SOURCES HAD CONFIRMED THAT KHOMEINI COMMITTEE DECIDED TWO OR THREE DAYS AGO TO ARREST ALL RPT ALL SENIOR OFFICIALS OF GOVERNMENT FOR PAST 15 YEARS. BAN ON THEIR TRAVEL (REPORTED EARLIER) WAS FIRST STEP, AND COMMITTEES ARE BEGINNING TO FAN OUT TO PICK PEOPLE UP. CLOSE FRIEND OF HIS, A DR.

MOUSSAVI, WHO HAD JUST RETURNED FROM QOM, SAID ATMOSPHERE AT COMMITTEE HEADQUARTERS RESEMBLED THAT OF THE FRENCH REVOLUTIONARY TERROR, ESPECIALLY IN WAKE OF KHOMEINI'S SPEECH TO THEOLOGICAL STUDENTS MARCH 7 (BEING REPORTED MARCH 8 SITREP) WHICH CALLED GOI "WEAK." ESLAMINIA SAID ARRESTS WOULD HAVE TO TOTAL BETWEEN 16,000 AND 30,000, IF COMMITTEE CARRIES THROUGH ITS INTENTION TO PICK UP SENIOR PROVINCIAL LEADERS AS WELL. ESLAMINA SAID FOUR OF HIS CONTACTS IN PROVINCIAL CAPITALS REPORT GOI-APPOINTED PROVINCIAL GOVERNORS HAVE BEEN TAKEN INTO CUSTODY BY LOCAL COMMITTEES AND REPLACED WITH LOCAL NOMINEES CHOSEN "BY THE PEOPLE."

ESLAMINIA AND ONE OTHER SOURCE CLOSE TO SEVERAL GROUPS OF RELIGIOUS STUDENTS AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY SAID NUMBER OF EXECUTIONS IS MUCH HIGHER THAN ANNOUNCED, PARTICULARLY INN PROVINCES WHERE OLD SCORES ARE BEING SETTLED. COMMITTEES WILL PICK ONE OR TWO PRINCIPAL OFFENDERS AND GIVE THEIR DEATHS MAXIMUM PUBLICITY, THEN QUIETLY SHOOT "UP TO DOZENS" OF OTHERS (MOSTLY LOWER LEVEL SAVAKEES ACCORDING TO UNIVERSITY SOURCE). ESLAMINIA AND MOUSSAVI MADE RATHER ACID COMMENTS ON U.S. HUMAN RIGHTS POLICY AND LACK OF VISIBLE COMMENT OUT OF WASHINGTON ON SUMMARY EXECUTIONS AND ARRESTS.

ESLAMINIA JOVIALLY ASKED IF DEATH PENALTY FOR SODOMY AND FLOGGING FOR RAPE (BOTH FEATURED IN PRESS IN RECENT DAYS) WERE PART OF U.S. ADMINISTRATION'S HUMAN RIGHTS PROGRAM FOR IRAN. BOTH MEN CONTINUED NOW FAMILIAR LITANY THAT U.S. HUMAN RIGHTS POLICY WEAKENED SHAH ONLY TO WIND UP WITH SOMETHING WORSE. IN SEPARATE CONVERSATION, POLOFF HEARD THAT FORMER SENATOR MRS. MANUCHERIAN LED WOMEN'S DELEGATION TO PRIME MINISTER'S OFFICE MAR 7 CALLING ON GOI NOT TO LET WOMEN SLIDE BACK INTO DARK AGES.

MEETING WAS HELD ON EVE OF MARCH 8 INTERNATIONAL WOMEN'S DAY, AND OCCURRED ABOUT SAME TIME KHOMENINI IN QOM WAS BLASTING "NAKED WOMEN" IN GOVERNMENT AND ORDERING ALL GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES TO COVER UP. IN AN ASIDE TO A THIRD PARTY, MANUCHERIAN SAID SHE WAS READY TO LEAD WOMEN'S LAWYERS GROUP INTO DEFACTOR ALLIANCE WITH FEDAYEEN RATHER THAN SEE GAINS OF PAST LOST.

IN PAST FEW DAYS, GOI FIGURES HAVE SOUNDED INCREASINGLY REVOLUTIONARY. THIS HAS INCLUDED GREATER CRITICISM OF U.S. ROLE IN IRAN THAN FIRST TWO WEEKS OF REVOLUTION PRODUCED. CAPSTONE WAS MAR 7 KHOMEINI BLAST AT HIS OWN GOVERNMENT AS WEAK AND NOT SUFFICIENTLY REVOLUTIONARY. UNIVERSITY GRADUATE STUDENTS WHO MET POLOFF EVENING MAR 7 WERE JUBILANT THAT KHOMEINI ATTACK ON GOI WOULD GIVE UNIVERSITY FEDAYEEN A CHANGE TO ATTACK GOI IN KHOMEINI'S NAME.

HOST, AND MIDLEVEL GOI OFFICIAL DESCRIBED KHOEMINI ATTACK ON GOI AS "INCREDIBLY STUPID," AND SAID IT WOULD OPEN WAY FOR FEDAYEEN TO BLEND THEMSELVES EVER CLOSER TO REVOLUTION AND TO COOPT TO THEIR REVOLUTIONARY CAUSE WITH SOME OF THE LEFTWING MUJAHIDIN WHO HAVE BEEN MAKING NOISES ALONG SAME LINES FOR PAST WEEK.

BRIEF CALLS TO PRIME MINISTER'S OFFICE THIS MORNING FOUND PRINCIPALS OUT AND STAFFS IN DISARRAY. KHOMEINI'S ATTEMPT, MAO-LIKE, TO PERPETUATE THE REVOLUTION BEFORE HE EVEN HAS FULL CONTROL HAS COME PREILOUSLY CLOSE TO UNRAVELLING WHAT REMAINS OF AUTHORITY IN IRAN, STIMULATED CHAOS AND, IN THE OPINION OF OVERWHELMING MAJORITY OF IRANIAN OBSERVERS, MADE FURTHER VIOLENCE IMPOSSIBLE TO AVOID. IN VIW OF MANY, MODERATE REVOLUTIONARY GOVERNMENT WILL NOT SURVIVE HAMMER BLOWS OF PAST FIVE DAYS, BECAUSE IT IS UNABLE TO EXTEND ITS CONTROL WHILE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES AND ARMED FEDAYEEN ARE MAKING THEIR WRITS FELT ONLY TOO EFFECTIVELY. GOOD EXAMPLE OF THIS OCCURRED WHEN POLOFF MADE SEVEN-MILE TRIP TO ESLAMINIA HOME.

ALTHOUGH PASSING UNOPPOSED THROUGH TWO MINI-BLOCKADES, POLOFF SAW THREE CARS WHICH HAD BEEN STOPPED BY SNIPER SHOTS THROUGH WINDSHIELD. OF TWO AT EXRESSWAY INTERSECTION WITH MIRDAMAND AVENUE, ONE STILL HAD BODY OF DRIVER SLUMPED OVER WHEEL.
(C- ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY: KOHEMINI ATTACKS BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT. SPLIT IN NATIONAL FRONT. EXECUTIONS AND ARRESTS CONTINUE. MORE GUBERNATORIAL APPOINTMENTSANNOUNCED. TEHRAN CITY COUNCIL DISSOLVED. EX-TABRIZ DEPUTY BANI-AHMAD RELEASED. PAKISTAN FONMIN DUE TO ARRIVE IN TEHRAN. END SUMMARY.

IN AN ADDRESS TO CLERGYMEN AND STUDENTS OF THE THEOLOGICAL COLLEGE AT QOM, KHOMEINI ATTACKED THE BAZARAGAN GOVERNMENT FOR ITS WEAKNESS IN BEING INFLUENCED BY "WESTERN" IDEAS AND ESPECIALLY BY A WESTERN CONCEPT OF DEMOCRACY. STRESSING THE ISLAMIC AS OPPOSED TO THE WESTERN DEMOCRATIC NATURE OF THE PROPOSED REPUBLIC, THE AYATOLLAH URGED THE SEMINARIANS AND OTHER CLERGYMEN OF QUOM TO SPREAD OUT THROUGHOUT IRAN AND PROMULGATE HIS VIEWS BEFORE THE NOMING REFERENDUM. SOUNDING MORE AND MORE LIKE SAVONAROLA, KHOMEINI ALSO CHASTIZED IRANIAN WOMEN FOR THEIR DRESS, SUGGESTING THAT FEMALE EMPLOYEES WEAR CHADORS TO THEIR OFFICES.

(NOTE: RECENT PERSIAN PRESS REPORTS CLAIM THAT SOME "UNVEILED" WOMENIN TEHRAN HAVE BEEN ATTACKED ON THE STREETS, THAT TENNIS CLUBS INSIST THEY BE FULLY DRESSED ON THE COURTS, ETC.) THE "LAVISH FURNISHINGS/ AND "LUXURIOUS" LIFE STYLE OF THE GOVERNMENT MINISTRIES ALSO CAME UNDER ATTACK.
DESCRIBED AS THE "SOCIALIST" SEGMENT, AN UNDISCLOSED NUMBER OF NATIONAL FRONT MEMBERS HAVE BROKEN AWAY TO JOIN MATIN-DAFTARY6S NEWLY FORMED NATIONAL DEMOCRATIC FRONT.

PRESS REPORTS DEATH SENTENCES FOR SHABAAN JAFFARI, FORMER "ZURKHANEH" (HOUSE OFSTRENGTH) LEADER IN TEHRAN AS WELL AS SPORTS HERO/ASIAN GAMES BOXING CAMPION PARVIZ BADPA. THE FORMER FOR "GANSTERISM" UNDER THE PREVIOUS REGIME AND THE LATTER FOR CRIMES COMMITTED WHILE "IMPERSONATING" A REVOLUTIONARY MILITIA MAN. ON MARCH 7 SIX OTHERS ACCUSED OF SEXUAL CRIMES (SODOMY) WERE SHOT, BRINING THE OFFICIAL REPORT NUMBER OF EXECUTED "SEXUAL OFFENDERS" TO THIRTEEN. PRESS ALSO REPORTS POLICE MAN IN AZARSHAHR (NEAR TABRIZ) WAS KILLED BY A LOCAL MOB, AND EVERY INDICATION IS THAT WIDESPREAD AND UNREPORTED ARRESTS AND EXECUTIONS ARE CONTINUING THROUGHOUT IRAN. (SEE SEPTEL)

MINISTRY OF INTERIOR HAS ANNOUNCED APPOINTMENTS OF TAHER AHMADZADEH AS GOV GEN OF KHORASSAN PROVINCE, NASSER AKHAVAN MALLAYERI AS GOV GEN OF THE CENTRAL PROVINCE, BAOHER SHAPOUR AS GOV GEN OF BUSHEHR PROVINCE AND HADI MOTEMENI AS GOV GEN OF SISTAN AND BALUCHISTAN PROVINCE. DISTRICT GOVERNORS (FARMANDA ) APPOINTMENTS INCLUDE MAHMOUD HASHEMI (QOM), SADRUDDIN RAHIMI ARDASTANI (DAMAVAND) AND MOHAMMAD HASSAN SADAQIAN (UMAMSHAHR, FORMERLY NAMED SHAHRUD).
PERSIAN PRESS ALSO REPORTS THAT THE TEHRAN CITY COUNCIL HAS BEEN DISSOLVED UNDER ORDERS OF THE MINISTRY OF INTERIOR.

EX-TABRIZ DEPUTY BANI-AHMAD HAS BEEN RELEASED FROM DETENTION AFTER FIVE DAYS OF MUCH PUBLICIZED EFFORT BY BAZARGAN TO SET HIM FREE. BANI-AHMAD'S ACCOUNT OF ARREST PROCEEDINGS (HE WAS PICKED UP IMMEDIATELY AFTER A TELEPHONE CONVERSATION WITH BAZARGAN, WAS ONLY SHOWN AN UNSIGNED WARRANT, AND WAS NOT ALLOWED TO INFORM ANYONE). EMPHASIZES HIGH-HANDED AND ARBITRARY NATURE OF CURRENT COMMITTEE ARREST PROCEDURES.
PRESS ALSO ANNOUNCED THAT PAKISTAN FONMIN AGHA SAHI IS DUE IN TEHRAN TODAY FOR A THREE DAY VISIT.
REFTEL REPORTS THAT USAF C-141 WILL TRANHQORT REZA PAHLAIR FROM US TO MOROCCO. ALTHOUGH THIS ACTION IS HIGHLY CLASSIFIED , THIRE IS LITTLE DOUBT THAT THIS WILL SOON BECOME PUBLIC KNOWLEDGE.

I BELIEVE YOU UNDERSTAND THE EXTREURE SEUSITURTY WHICH ATTACHES TO ARMY MOVENMENT OF THE FORMER IMPERIAL FAMILY. HOWEVER, IN THIS UNPREDICTABLE TEHRAN POLITICAL CLIMATE, IT IS HARD TO ESTIMATE IN ADVANCE EXACTLY WHAT CONSEQUENCES MIGHT RESULT FROM A TRIP SUCH AS THIS USAF FLIGHT.

IN ORDER PREPARE OURSELVES IN TEHRAN FOR WORST POSSIBLE CONSEQUENCES, PLEASE PROVIDE IMMEDIATELY BACKGROUND INFORMATION CORKURING THIS USAF RMISSION. SPECILICALLY, WE NEED TO KNOW WHETHER REZA WILL BE RETURNING TO U.S. WE ALSO NEED TO KNOW WHETHER C-141 WILL HAVE ANY PAHLAUI CARGO IN EITHER DIRECTION, ESPECIALLY FROM MOROCCO TO US.

I BELIEVE THERE IS GENUINE POSPECT ANY OR ALL OF US HERE MANY FIND OURSELVES IN HOSTAGE SITUATION IF SHAH HIMSELF WERE TO GO TO U.S. THEREFORE IF ANY ACTION IS CONTEMPLATED ALONG THOSE LIVES. I WILL PROBABLY WANT TO THIN OUT OUR NUMBERS HERE ESPECIALLY THE ARMISH-MAAG PERSONNEL WHO ARE STILL HERE. ACCORDINGLY, I WILL NEED LONGEST POSSIBLE LEAD TIME IN ANY PEITIUENT INFORMATION ON THIS SUBJECT. SULLIVAN
