SUMMARY: IN CONVERSATION WITH EMBOFFS, LONG-TIME OPPOSITIONIST WRITER HAKIM-ELAHI CRITICIZES KHOMEINI, MOSSADEQ, SHAH AND U.S., LAMENTS CURRENT STATE OF AFFAIRS IN IRAN, PREDICTS ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT WILL BE MORE REPRESSIVE THAN PAHLAVIS, DECLARES KINGSHIP NECESSARY FOR IRAN AND OPINES THAT ISLAMIC FORCES IN SCHOOLS AND UNIVERSITITES ARE BOTH MORE NUMEROUS AND BETTER ORGANIZED THAN OTHERS, INCLUDING EXTREME LEFT, AND ARE THEREFORE WINNING BATTLE FOR CONTROL OF EDUCATION. END SUMMARY.

EMBOFFS STEMPEL AND PATTERSON LUNCHED MARCH 5 AT HOME OF DR. HEDAYATOLLAH HAKIM-ELAHI, FORMERLY PROMINENT WRITER (HE STOPPED WRITING SOME YEARS AGO WHEN HE TRIED OF HAVING PAPERS AND MANUSCRIPTS SEIZED BY SAVAK) AND STILL PROMINENT TEACHER/ INTELLECTUAL. STEMPEL AND PATTERSON HAVE KNOWN HAKIM-ELAHI FOR ABOUT FOUR YEARS, HAVING MET HIM THROUGH PROF. JAMES BILL.

HAKIM-ELAHI, THOUGH LESS FRIGHTENED THAN HE APPEARED IN TELEPHONE CONVERSATIONS A FEW WEEKS AGO, SEES LITTLE HOPEFUL IN IRAN'S FUTURE. KOHMEINI IN HIS VIEW IS A RIGID, FANATIC OLD CLERIC WHOSE MEDIEVAL IDEAS CAN NOT BE ADAPATED TO CONTEMPORARY IRAN. HE SEES BOTH SHI'EH ISLAM AND THE MONARCHY AS NECESSARY TO THE STABILITY OF IRAN, THE FORMER BEING AN IDEA AND A VALUE SYSTEM THAT BELONGS TO ALMOST ALL IRANIANS, WHILE THE KING SHOULD BE A FIGURE WHO IS SEEN BY EVERYONE AS BELONGING TO THE WHOLE NATION. FOR THIS TO OCCUR, HAKIMELAHI BELIEVES, THE MONARCH MUST BE CONSTITUTIONAL, MUST REIGN AND NOT RULE.

THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT ALONE, HE SAID, WILL BE ABLE TO HOLD IRAN TOGETHER AND EXERCISE POWER ONLY THROUGH AN ORGANIZED REPRESSION MORE INTOLERANT AND STRINGENT THAN THAT OF THE PAHLAVIS. HAKIM-ELAHI RECALLED THAT IN HIS DECADES OF "OPPOSITION" TO THE SHAH HIS AIM HAD NOT BEEN TO GET RID OF THE SHAH, BUT TO URGE HIM TO BE A KING INSTEAD OF A MERCHANT AND TYRANT. "I HATE THE MAN", HE SAID, "BUT BELIEVE IN THE NECESSITY OF THE KINGSHIP".

LIKE EVERY OTHER PERSIAN WE KNOW, HAKIM-ELAHI APPORTIONS THE LION'S SHARE OF THE BLAME FOR "WHAT HAS HAPPENED TO IRAN" TO ERRORS IN U.S. POLICY, ESPECIALLY TO THE NIXON/FORD ADMINISTRATION'S POLICIES OF "GIVING THE SHAH EVERYTHING HE WANTS". UNLIKE ANY OTHER PERSIAN WE KNOW, HE ASSIGNS A LARGE SHARE OF BLAME TO ALL IRANIANS: "NONE OF US DID ALL HE COULD HAVE DONE TO SET THINGS RIGHT WHILE THERE WAS STILL TIME".

HE NOTED, HOWEVER, THAT DUE TO THE "CIA-AIDED COUP" IN 1953 AND THE VAST INFLUX OF AMERICANS AND AMERICAN WEAPONS FOLLOWING NIXON'S DECISION TO LET THE SHAH DECIDE WHAT HE WANTED TO BUY, AMERICAN IS FIRMLY ASSOCIATED IN THE IRANIAN POPULAR IMAGINATION WITH ALL THE TORTURES, KILLINGS AND LOOTING OF THE NATION--NOW BLOATED TO HEROIC PROPORTIONS BY INFLAMED IMAGINATIONS--UNDER THE SHAH'S REGIME. THIS, HE NOTED, WILL DIE HARD, IN SPITE OF THE FACT THAT AMERICA, UNLIKE PERSIA, "HAS NEVER TAKEN ANYTHING FROM IRAN".

EMBOFF'S LUNCH WITH HAKIM-ELAHI WAS SAME DAY AS MASSIVE MOASSADEQ RALLY AT AHMADABAD. THUS EMBOFFS ASKED WHETHER HAKIM-ELAHI HAD NOT BEEN INTERESTED IN ATTENDING RALLY. NOT IN THE LEAST, HE REPLIED: "I HATED HIM AND WROTE ARTICLES AGAINST HIM AT THE TIME, AND I STILL BELIEVE HE WAS A REACTIONARY OLD DEMAGOGUE". ASKED WHAT WAS HAPPENING IN UNIVERSITIES, HAKIM-ELAHI SIMPLY REPLIED THAT WHILE NO EDUCATION IS BEING PROVIDED, ISLAMIC MOVEMENT IS WINNING BATTLE FOR CONTROL OF SCHOOLS, NOT ONLY BECAUSE OF ITS MUCH GREATER NUMBERS, BUT BECAUSE IT IS BETTER ORGANIZED AS WELL.

HAKIM-ELAHI IS A DEEPLY TRADITIONAL PERSIAN INTELLECTUAL WHO IS VIRTUALLY UNTOUCHED BY SUPERFICIAL MODERNIZATION YET HAS DEEPLY INTERNALIZED A GOOD MANY WESTERN DEMOCRATIC VALUES. HE IS ISLAMIC BUT ANTICLERICAL. HE HAS SEEN HIS OWN GOOD VISION OF IRANIAN SOCIETY BLOSSOM WITH PROMISE FOR A BRIEF PERIOD AND THEN WITHER AND DIE OVER THE LAST SEVERAL MONTHS. HE NOW SEES LITTLE HOPE OF ESCAPING A LENGTHY PERIOD OF ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT WHICH HE BELIEVES WILL BE HARSH AND RETROGRADE. SULLIVAN NOTE BY OC/T: MESSAGE DELAYED IN TRANSMISSION

THERE EJE NO NEWSPAPERS, FARSI OR FOREIGN LANGUAGE, PUBLISHED IN IRAN ON FRIDAYS. THERE HAVE BEEN NUMEROUS REFERENCES TO ALLEGED SAVAK INFLILTRATION OF VARIOUS ORGAINZATIONS, INCLUDING IRANIAN DIPLOMATIC MISSIONS ABROAD, IN THE PRESS OVER THE PAST TWO WEEKS. WE RECALL ONE REFERENCE TO ALLEGED AGENTS IN THE U.S. A WEEK TO TEN DAYS AGO (A CHECK OF OUR INCOMPLETE FILE OF NEWSPAPERS DID NOT TURN UP THE SPECIFIC ITEM) WHICH INCLUDED A NUMBER (ABOUT 160) BUT NO NAMES.
C - ENTIRE TEXT.

SUMMARY: KHOMEINI REAFFIRMS SUPPORT FOR BAZARGAN BUT CONTINUES TO HIT OUT AT OPPONENTS OF HIS ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. WOMEN PROTEST PRESSURES ON THEM TO WEAR THE VEIL. THREE MORE EXECUTIONS ANNOUNCED. END SUMMARY.

CONTRARY TO REPORTS CARRIED BY AT LEAST ONE OF THE WIRE SERVICES (AP), THE BARZARGAN GOVERNMENT HAS NOT RESIGNED. THE PM AND SEVERAL MEMBERS OF HIS CABINET DID GO TO QOM OVER THE WEEKEND, WHERE THEY WERE ABLE TO WRING A REAFFIRMATION OF SUPPORT OUT OF KHOMEINI. GIVEN BARZARGAN'S PREVIOUS PUBLIC THREAT TO RESIGN AND HIS KNOWN UNHAPPINESS WITH BOTH THE PARALLEL SYSTEM OF GOVERNMENT REPRESENTED BY THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE STRUCTURE AND WHAT HE REGARDS AS PRONOUNCEMENTS OUT OF QOM WHICH UNDERCUT HIS AUTHORITY, IT IS CONCEIVABLE THAT HE USED THE POSSIBILITY OF QUITTING AS A STICK TO GAIN KHOMEINI'S MOST RECENT ENDORSEMENT OF HIS GOVERNMENT.

DESPITE HIS KIND WORDS FOR BARZARGAN, HOWEVER, KHOMEINI SEEMS NO MORE INCLINED THAN HE HAS EVER BEEN TO MODERATE HIS POSITION ON THE PROPOSED ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. ON MARCH 9 AT A SPEECH IN A RELIGIOUS SCHOOL IN QOM (WHICH WAS TELEVISED) HE AGAIN HIT OUT AT THOSE WHO HAVE OBJECTED TO THE NATURE OF THE REPUBLIC HAVING BEEN DECIDED FOR THEM IN ADVANCE BY KHOMEINI. HE WARNED HIS (YOUNG) AUDIENCE TO "IGNORE THOSE WHO HAVE BEEN WATCHING YOUR REVOLUTION FROM THE OUTSIDE AND HAVE NOW COME FORWARD WITH THEIR POISON PENS, WRITING ABOUT TERMS SUCH AS DEMOCRATIC, NATIONAL AND SON ON".

AMONG THE GROUPS WHICH HAVE NOT TAKEN KINDLY TO THE IMAN'S VIEWS ARE THOSE WOMEN WHO SEE SECOND CLASS CITIZENSHIP IN STORE FOR THEIR SEX UNDER AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC KHOMEINI-STYLE. FIFTEEN THOUSAND OBSERVED INTERNATIONAL WOMEN'D DAY ON MARCH 8 BY MARCHING TO THE PM'S OFFICE TO PRETEST PRESSURES (EXEMPLIFIED BY KHOMEINI'S REMARK THE DAY BEFORE ABOUT "NAKED" WOMEN IN GOVERNMENT OFFICES) ON THEM TO WEAR THE TRADITIONAL VEIL. (SEPTEL COVERS THIS ISSUE IN MORE DETAIL).

THREE MORE EXECUTIONS, IN THIS INSTANCE OF THREE SENIOR POLICE OFFICIALS, HAVE BEEN ANNOUNCED. THEY WERE FOUND GUILTY OF MASS MURDER, TORTURE AND IMPRISONMENT OF PROTESTORS AGAINST THE FORMER REGIME BY A REVOLUTIONARY COURT AND WERE SHOT EARLY MARCH 9. ACCORDING TO KAYHAN INTERNATIONAL, THESE EXECUTIONS BRING THE OFFICIAL TOTAL TO 40. THIS FIGURE IS SLIGHTLY HIGHER THAN OUR UNOFFICIAL COUNT OF 37, BUT WE HAVE HAD INCREASING INDICATIONS THAT THE ACTUAL COUNT MAY BE CONSIDERABLY HIGHER THAN EITHER NUMBER.
AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI'S WIFE DIED YESTERDAY, MARCH 9. EMBASSY IS SENDING SUITABLE CONDOLENCES.

1979TEHRAN02824.subject: ECON SITREP: BASED ON NEWS REPORTS

segments.text: NIOC CHAIRMAN NAZIH TERMED STATEMENTS BY IRANIAN EMBASSY WASHINGTON D.C. SPOKESMAN ROUHANI TO THE EFFECT THAT OIL PRODUCTION WOULD RISE TO BETWEEN 3 AND 4 MBPD AS PREMATURE. ANNOUNCED PRODUCTION LEVELS AS OF MARCH 8 WEERE 2 MBPD AND THEY ARE EXPECTED TO PEAK AT 3 MBPD. AS YET, NO FINAL DECISION HAS BEEN REACHED AS TO OPTIMAL LEVELS, BUT NIOC IS BEGINNING NEGOTIATIONS FOR LONG TERM CONTRACT WITH OIL IMPORTERS. NAZIH CONDEMNED THE USE OF OIL EXPORTS FOR BARTER SAYING THAT THIS PROCEDURE WILL STOP. HE SAID IRAN WILL REMAIN A MILITANT UNQUOTE MEMBER OF OPEC.
DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER AMIR ENTEZAN ANNOUNCED THAT IRAN WILL IMPPOSE FINANCIAL PENALITIES ON ANY OIL COMPANY THAT SELLS IRANIAN CRUDE OIL TO ISRAEL.

PRODUCTION AT THE ABADAN REFINERY REACHED 450,000 MBPD AS OF MARCH 8 AND EXPORTS VIA BANDAR MAHSHAHR HAVE RESUMED. NIOC ALSO ANNOUNCED THAT FOR THE FIRST TIME THE COMPANY HAD SUCCESSFULLY CONDUCTED A DRILLING OPERATION WITHOUT THE ASSISTANCE OF EXPATRIATES. THE DRILLING OCCURRED AT GACHSARAN, BUT NOT FURTHER DETAILS WERE OFFERED.

NATURAL GAS EXPORTS TO THE SOVIET UNION ARE TO RESUME IN THE NEAR FUTURE, AS SOON AS OIL PRODUCTION IN THE SOUTHERN FIELDS IS RAISED AND THE BID-E-BOLAND GAS FIELD IS BACK IN FULL OPERATION. NO DATE WAS SPECIFIED.

ON THE ORGANIZATIONAL FRONT, NIOC CHAIRMAN NAZIH ANNOUNCED THAT ALL AFFILIATED COMPANIES I.E., THE NATIONAL PETROCHEMICAL COMPANY (NPC), THE OIL SERVICES COMPANY (OSCO) AND THE NATIONAL IRANIAN GAS COMPANY (NIGC) WOULD HENCEFORTH BE DIRECTLY CONTROLLED BY THE NIOC CHAIRMAN AND MANAGING DIRECTOR. A CO-ORDINATING COMMITTEE HAS BEEN SET UP TO MANAGE THE DETAILS.

AS REPORTED IN PREVIOUS CABLES, ADDITIONAL AID IS TO BE SOUGHT FROM THE JAPANESE TO COMPLETE THE PETRO CHEMICAL COMPLEX AT BANDAR SHAPOUR. IN ADDITION, THE JAPANESE HAVE SUGGESTED THAT IMPORT DUTIES ON PETROCHEMICAL DERRIVATIVES BE CHANED IN ORDER TO PROTECT THE INVESTMENT. SOME DUTIES ARE VIEWED AS TOO LOW, WHILE OTHER PRODUCTS ENTER DUTY FREE. THE PROJECT NOW 85-PERCENT COMPLETE, WAS INITIALLY TO BOST DOLS 1.8 BILLION, BUT COST OVERRUNS ARE PUSHING THE TOTAL TO THE $4 BILLION LEVELS. REPORTS INDICATE THAT AN ADDITIONAL DOLS 500 MILLION MIGHT BE REQUIRED FROM THE JAPANESE.

DEBATE CONTINUES ON THE FUTURE OF THE BANKING SYSTEM. DURING THE LAST THREE DAYS TWO AYATOLLAHS, TALEGHANI AND ZANJANI, MADE STRONG STATEMENTS OPPOSING INTEREST PAYMENTS. TALEGHANI CONTENED THAT BANKS IN IRAN WERE ESTABLISHED BY FOREIGN POWERS TO FURTHER THEIR OWN INTERESTS. THE CURRENT SITUATION, HE SAID WAS WORSE THAN IMPERALISM, INCREASED THE POVERTY OF MOST, BENEFITED ONLY A FEW WEALTHY INDIVIDUALS, AND PROMOTED CORRUPTION. RATHER THAN BENEFIT FOREIGNERS, IRAN'S BANKS SHOULD HELP IMPROVE IRANIAN AGRICULTURE. DEPUTY GOVERNOR OF THE CENTRAL BANK FOR INTERNATIONAL AFFAIRS, ON THE OTHER HAND, WELCOMES THE RETURN OF FOREIGN BANKERS.
HE ADMITTED THAT SOME IRANIAN BANKS WERE DELIQUENT ON THEIR FOREIGN LOAN PAYMENTS, BUT THAT NOEN WAS IN DEFAULT. DELAYED PAYMENTS ARE PURPORTEDLY AN ADMINISTRATIVE RATHER THAN FINANCIAL PROBLEM.

THE CENTRAL BANK ANNOUNCED THAT IN THE FUTURE FOREIGN TECHNICIANS WOULD BE PERMITTED TO TRANSFER OUT OF IRAN UP TO 60-PERCENT OF THE SALARIES EARNED IN IRAN. AT THE END OF THEIR CONTRACTS THEY, LIKE IRANIAN TRAVELERS, WOULD BE PERMITTED TO TAKE OUT "3,000" UPON PRESENTATION OF PASSPORTS AND EXIT VISAS.
IRAN WILL SEEK REPAYMENT OF APPROXIMATELY $4 BILLION IN LOANS MADE PRIMARILY TO BRITAIN, FRANCE, PAKISTAN, EGYPT AND SENEGAL SINCE 1974.

THE MINISTRY OF ECONOMIC AFFAIRS AND FINANCE (MEAF) ANNOUNCED THAT ONLY 50-PERCENT OF CUSTOMS STORAGE CHARGES ACCUMULATED DURING THE STRIKE WILL BE COLLECTED. NOTE: AN EARLIER SITREP INDICATED THAT THESE STORAGE CHARGES MIGHT BE WAIVED COMPLETELY. COMMENT: EVAN A 50-PERCENT REDUCTION IN CHARGES IS LIKELY TO IMPEDE THE CLEARANCE OF ITEMS NOW HELD IN CUSTOMS. MOST IMPORTERS DO NOT HAVE THE CASH WITH WHICH TO PAY THESE CHARGES AND CREDIT IS SO TIGHT AS TO BE ALMOST NON-EXISTANT.

CONTRACTS: AGUSTA SPA OF ITALY ANNOUNCED IN ROME THAT ITS $425 MILLION CONTRACT TO SUPPLY IRAN WITH 50 CHINOOK HELICOPTERS AND SPARE PARTS WAS STILL VALID. 12 HELICOPTERS AND PARTS, ABOUT ONE THIRD OF THE TOTAL VALUE OF THE CONTRACT HAVE ALREADY BEEN DELIVERED WITH THE BALANCE TO FOLLOW. ON THE OTHER HAND, THE GOI STATED THAT IT WOULD SELL 1,000 HELICOPTERS PURCHASED FROM BELL HELICOPTER TO THE HIGHEST BIDDER, AND THAT THE ENTIRE BELL CONTRACT WOULD BE CANCELLED.

NOTE: COVERAGE WAS ACCORDED STATEMENTS MADE BY DR ABBAS AMERIE, EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR OF THE INSTITUTE OF INTERNATIONAL POLITICAL AND ECONOMIC STUDIES OF TEHRAN AT A WORLD AFFAIRS COUNCIL MEETING IN CINCINNATI THAT THE UNITED STATES HAD DONE ITSELF A DISFAVOR BY SENDING THE SOCIAL REJECTS UNQUOTE WHICH CONSTITUTED THE BULK OF THE BELL STAFF IN IRAN.

PRESS COVERAGE ALSO INCLUDED AN ITEM REGARDING THE SEIZURE OF $3.8 MILLION IN IRANIAN PROPERTY IN NEW ORLEANS BY MORGAN EQUIPMENT COMPANY OF SAN FRANCISCO. MORGAN HAS RECEIVED PAYMENT FOR $4.9 MILLION OF AN $8.8 MILLION EQUIPMENT ORDER PLACED BY THE MINISTRY OF ROADS AND TRANSPORTATION.
THE NUCLEAR PROGRAM IS UNDER REVIEW, AND A STRONG POSSIBILITY EXISTS THAT THE CONTRACT FOR TWO REACTORS WITH THE GERMAN FIRM KRAFTWERK MIGHT BE CANCELLED. CONTRACT VALUE: 1.2 BILLION.
A SMALL FRONT PAGE ITEM IN ONE OF THE ENGLISH LANGUAGE PAPERS NOTED THE PURCHASE OF 40,000 TONS OF AMERICAN RICE BY THE STATE TRADING ORGANIZATION.

1979TEHRAN02846.subject: ACCEPTANCE OF RESPONSIBILITY FOR DAMAGES SUSTAINED (#) KATTACK ON EMBASSY

segments.text: (#) KATTACK ON EMBASSY WE RECEIVED ON MARCH 11 A LETTER FROM PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN DATED MARCH 1 EXPRESSING REGRETS FOR THE FEB 14 ATTACK ON THE EMBASSY AND GOI WILLINGNESS TO REIMBURSE US FOR THE DAMAGES SUSTAINED. THE FULL TEXT OF THE LETTER, COMPLETE WITH SPELLING AND OTHER ERRORS, FOLLOWS: THE PROVISIONAL REVOLUTIONARY GOVERNMENT OF IRAN PRESENT THEIR COMPLIMENTS TO THE EMBASSY OF THE UNITED SATES OF AMERICA, AND WHILE EXPRESSING THEIR DEEP REGRET AT THE INCIDENT WHICH OCCURRED ON FEB 14, 1979, WOULD LIKE TO STATE THAT THE SAID REGRETTABLE OCCURRENCE WAS INSTIGATED BY ANTI-REVOLUTIONARY ELEMENTS.

THE GOVERNMENT HAVE MADE ARRANGEMENTS TO PREVENT SERIOUSLY THE REPETITION OF SUCH INCIDENTS. IT IS REQUESTED THAT THE REGRETS OF THIS GOVERNMENT BE COMMUNICATED TO THE UNITED STATES GOVERNMENT. FURTHERMORE, THIS GOVERNMENT WOULD LIKE TO DECLARE THEIR READINESS TO INDEMNIFY THE DAMAGES CAUSED BY THE ABOVE INCIDENT. THE PROVISIONAL REVOLUTIONARY GOVERNMENT OF IRAN AVAIL THEMSELVES OF THIS OPPORTUNITY TO RENEW THE ASSURANCES OF THEIR HIGHEST CONSIDERATION. END . (SIGNED) MEHDI BAZARGAN, PRIME MINISTER.
DEFENDING FEMAL DIGNITY AND RIGHTS, THE SPEECH WAS STILL INCONCLUSIVE ON THE SUBJECT OF THE VEIL ITSELF.

MARCH 11 PAPERS CARRY REUTERS REPORT OF FONMIN SANJABI SAYING THAT WHILE IRAN WILL WITHDRAW FROM CENTO, IT WILL STAY IN THE RCD. THE WITHDRAWAL FROM CENTO APPARENTLY WAS DISCUSSED BY BARZARGAN, SANJABI AND PAKISTAN FONMIN AGHA SHAHI IN THEIR MEETING MARCH 10. PRESS ALSO REPORTS SANJABI'S STATEMENT THAT IRAN WILL WITHDRAW TROOPS FROM OMAN, BUT NOT FROM THREE STRATEGICALLY IMPORTANT ISLANDS AT STRAITS OF HORMOZ ENTRY.

PRESS REPORTS ONE SOVIET ENGINEER (OLEG SUKHOV) WAS KILLED AND ANOTHER (VLADIMIR MANOKHIN) WOUNDED IN TEHRAN LAST FRIDAY AT 1:00 A.M. WHEN REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS FIRED ON THEIR CAR. NO STATEMENT HAS BEEN ISSUED BY THE SOVIET EMBASSY, BUT NEWSPAPER ACCOUNTS SAY THE SOVIETS FAILED TO STOP AT A ROAD CHECKPOINT. (NOTE: AUTOMOBILE TRAVEL IN TEHRAN IS STRICTLY CONTROLLED FROM ABOUT 10:00 P.M. UNTIL EARLY MORNING, WITH "REVOLUTIONARY" GUARDS MANNING POSTS ON THE CITY STREETS. WHILE NOT FORBIDDEN, DRIVING AT NIGHT INVOLVES STOPPING CONSTANTLY AT SUCH CHECKPOINTS FOR SEARCHES AND CHECKING OF PAPERS.

BECAUSE OF THE DARKNESS, AND THE FACT THAT CAR WINDOWS ARE NORMALLY CLOSED AGAINST THE COLD WEATHER, MOTORISTS OFTEN MISS THE CHECKPOINT AND ARE STOPPED BY GUARDS' FIRING INTO THE AIR. GIVEN THE ABOVE, AND ADDING LANGUAGE BARRIERS, TENSION ON THE GUARDS' PART, AND THEIR OFTEN-DISPLAYED INEPTITUDE WITH WEAPONS, IT IS NOT DIFFICULT TO IMAGINE HOW THE INCIDENT COULD HAVE OCCURRED.)

QUOTING PRESS REPORTS FROM KUWAIT, THE PERSIAN PREA TODAY MENTIONED A POSSIBLE BREAK IN IRANIAN-EGYPTIAN RELATIONS IF EGYPT SIGNS A TREATY WITH ISRAEL. NO DIRECT MENTION OF SUCH A POSSIBILITY HAS BEEN MADE BY GOVERNMENT SOURCES.

A LA RECENT EVENTS IN KURDESTAN, DEMONSTRATIONS HAVE BEEEN HELD IN KHUZISTAN PROVINCE BY IRANIANS OF ARABIC ORIGIN. THE DEMONSTRATORS DEMANDED RECOGNITION OF THEIR ARABIC HERITAGE, INCLUDING THEIR OWN NEWSPAPER, CHANGES IN CITY NAMES, AND PRIVILEGED STATUS IN OBTAINING OIL INDUSTRY EMPLOYMENT (KHUZISTAN IS THE CENTER OF THE IRANIAN OIL INDUSTRY).

MATINE-DAFTARY HAS ANNOUNCED THAT THE NEW NATIONAL DEMOCRATIC FRONT WILL HAVE A RALLY ON MARCH 20. THE PARTY'S POLICY AND PROGRAM WILL BE OFFICIALLY DECLARED ON THAT DAY. THE NATIONAL FRONT OF SANJABI, ET AL (NOT TO BE CONFUSED WITH MATINE-DAFTARY'S BREAK-AWAY ORGANIZATION) ALSO PLANS TO HOLD A RALLY ON THAT DAY (WHICH IS THE ANNIVERSARY OF MOSSADEQ'S ANNOUNCEMENT OF THE NATIONALIZATION OF THE IRANIAN OIL INDUSTRY).

1979TEHRAN02873.subject: WELFARE AND WHEREABOUTS OF VARIOUS IRANIAN CITIZENS

segments.text: C - ENTIRE TEXT.

ANTI-AMERICAN FEELING REMAINS A FACTOR TO BE RECKONED WITH IN IRAN DESPITE THE FRIENDLY SENTIMENTS TOWARD AMERICA EXPRESSED BY MANY GOI OFFICIALS IN PRIVATE. EMBOFFS HAVE FOUND IRANIAN CONTACTS RELUCTANT TO MEET WITH THEM, EXPECIALLY IN PUBLIC. FOR THE PRESENT, THEREFORE, WE BELIEVE IT WOULD BE COUNTERPRODUCTIVE FOR THE EMBASSY ACTIVELY TO INVESTIGAGE THE WELFARE AND WHEREABOUTS OF IRANIAN CITIZENS. IN THE PRESENT CLIMATE OF IRAN, SUCH INQUIRIES WOULD BE MISINTERPRETED BY MANY, AND THE INDIVIDUALS CONTACTED MIGHT BE ACCESED OF BEING "CIA AGENTS" OR WORSE. AT SUCH TIME AS THIS SITUATION CHANGES, WE SHOULD BE HAPPY TO ENTERTAIN REQUESTS FOR INFORMATION.

TO THE EXTENT EMBOFFS COME BY INFORMATION IN THE COURSE OF NORMAL ACTIVITY, THEY WILL OF COURSE REPORT IT. AMONG THE INDIVIDUALS MENTIONED IN REFTELS, WE WOULD EXPECT THE ABDULLA AND NASROLLA ENTEZAM WOULD BE REASONABLY SAFE, SINCE THEY ARE VERY ELDERLY, RESPECTED PERSONS WHO HAVE NOT PLAYED ACTIVE ROLES IN THE SHAH'S GOVERNMENT FOR SEVERAL YEARS. LIKE MANY PROMINENT IRANIANS, THEY DO NOT KNOW WHAT TO EXPECT FROM THE NEW GOVERNMENT IN THE FUTURE AND ARE PROBABLY MAKING THEMSELVES AS INCONSPICUOUS AS POSSIBLE. SUCH PEOPLE RARELY ANSWER TELEPHONES OR EVEN PERMIT OTHERS TO SPEAK OF THEIR WHEREABOUTS.

INCIDENTALLY, PROFESSOR JAMES BILL'S REMARKS IN TIME MAGAZINE REGARDING PRO-AMERICAN SENTIMENTS AMONG SENIOR MEMBERS OF CURRENT ISLAMIC LEADERSHIP IS GETTING WIDE COVERAGE IN LOCAL PRESS. UNFORTUNATELY, BILL NAMES YAZDI AND AMIR-ENTEZAM, BOTH PROMINENT IN BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT. IN CURRENT ATMOSPHERE THIS CAN ONLY DO THEM HARM--AND MIGHT RESULT IN THEIR TAKING STEPS TO "PROVE" THEY ARE NOT U.S. "AGENTS". SINCE EMBASSY DEPENDS ON THESE TWO, AMONT OTHERS, FOR A WIDE RANGE OF PRACTICAL ASSISTANCE, THIS INCIDENT ALONE MIGHT HAVE SIGNIFICANT REPERCUSSIONS. IT AGAIN ILLUSTRATES THE COUNTER-PRODUCTIVITY OF PUBLIC STATEMENTS ON IRAN BY ANY PROMINENT AMERICANS, OFFICIAL OR UNOFFICIAL,THE IRANIAN PUBLIC DOES NOT KNOW THE DIFFERENCE.
S - ENTIRE TEXT.

WE HAVE HEARD VERY LITTLE FROM IRAN'S NEW GOVERNMENT REGARDING CENTO BEYOND FONMIN SANJABI'S STATEMENT REPORTED IN THE PRESS YESTERDAY, MARCH 11, THAT IRAN WOULD HOPE TO CONTINUE RCD MEMBERSHIP EVEN AFTER WITHDRAWAL FROM CENTO. IT WOULD THEREFORE APPEAR PROBABLE IRANIANS WOULD BE INTERESTED IN BROADER ORGANIZATION CENTERING ON ECONOMIC AND SOCIAL CONCERNS, AND POSSIBLY HOLDING OUT PROMISE OF POLITICAL COOPERATION OF A NON-ALIGNER, NON-INTERVENTIONIST CHARACTER WITH IRAN'S NEIGHBORS.

SINCE REFTEL SUGGESTS THAT IRAN MIGHT BE ONE OF THE SPONSORS, HOWEVER, WE PREFER NOT TO SPECULATE FURTHER ON THIS QUESTION UNTIL WE HAVE HAD A CHANCE TO SOUND OUT MFA AND PAKISTAN EMBASSY HERE ON THE RESULTS OF AGHA SHAHI'S VISIT. POLITICAL COUNSELOR AND HIS DEPUTY HAVE APPOINTMENT AT MFA MORNING OF MARCH 13. 0.034 43*53), WE SHALL NOT APPROACH GOI DIRECTLY ON THIS SUBJECT.)

PRESS THIS MORNING ANNOUNCES FORTHCOMING VISIT OF A THREEMEMBER GOOD-WILL DELEGATION FROM INDIA, DUE TO ARRIVE IN TEHRAN TOMORROW, MARCH 13. IT IS TO BE HEADED BY ASOKA MEHTA, DESCRIBED AS A 68-YEAR OLD STATESMAN AND LEADING MEMBER OF THE RULING JANATA PARTY. DELEGATION WILL INCLUDE BADRUDDIN GYABJI, A WELL-KNOWN SCHOLAR, DIPLOMAT AND FORMER INDIAN AMBASSADOR TO IRAN, AND ALI NASIR SAEED ABQATI, A SHI'ITE LEADER. THE DELEGATION HOPES TO CALL ON AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI AS WELL AS PRIME MINISTER BARZARGAN AND FONMIN SANJABI. WE SUSPECT THIS VISIT IS AT LEAST IN PART INSPIRED BY AGHA SHAHI'S VISIT HERE.

IF PAKISTAN AND INDIA TURN OUT TO HAVE DIFFERING VIEWS AS TO ANY LARGER ORGANIZATION, WE WOULD EXPECT IRANIAN GOVERNMENT TO GIVE THE MATTER CONSIDERABLE THOUGHT BEFORE IT TAKES A POSITION ON IT, PARTICULAR ONE OF SPONSOR.
C - ENTIRE TEXT

SUMMARY: SHARIAT-MADARI WANTS BROADER BALLOT IN REFERENDUM. WOMEN'S DEMONSTRATIONS TO CONTINUE. FEDAYEEN WARN AGAINST DANGERS OF WEAK GOVERNMENT. ETHNIC TURKOMANS DEMAND MORE RECOGNITION. JUSTICE IN TODAY'S IRAN: ARRESTS AND EXECUTIONS CONTINUE. JAMES BILL STATEMENTS ON "PRO-U.S." AIDES IN THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT. END SUMMARY.

IN AN INTERVIEW WITH KAYHAN, SHARIAT-MADARI SAID THAT THE BALLOT QUESTION FOR THE COMING REFERENDUM SHOULD BE PHRASED TO ALLOW MORE CHOICE OF A FORM OF GOVERNMENT. HE CLAIMS THAT THE OVERWHELMING RESULT WOULD STILL BE AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC, BUT THAT DOUBT OVER THE FREEDOM OF THE ELECTION WOULD BE ELIMINATED. IN OTHER REFERENDUM NEWS, PERSIAN PRESS GAVE WIDE COVERAGE TO A STATEMENT BY DR. MUFTEH (DESCRIBED AS A MEMBER OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE) THAT THE BALLOT WILL ALLOW A CHOICE AMONG SEVERAL TYPES OF GOVERNMENTS. ACCORDING TO DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER ENTEZAM, HOWEVER, THE GOVERNMENT STILL PLANS TO USE SINGLE QUESTION BALLOTS IN RED AND GREEN COLORS.

WOMEN'S DEMONSTRATIONS WILL CONTINUE TODAY, AND THE PRESS GIVES WIDE COVERAGE TO THE "CHADOR OR NO CHADOR" ISSUE AS AN EXPRESSION OF THE WHOLE STATUS OF WOMEN UNDER THE PROPOSED ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. TODAY'S MARCH WILL START AT THE UNIVERSITY AND PROCEED TO FREEDOM CIRCLE (FORMERLY SHAYAD CIRCLE) AND MALE "LEFTIST" GROUPS ARE EXPECTED TO ACCOMPANY THE WOMEN. ABADAN AND TABRIZ HAVE ALSO REPORTED DEMONSTRATIONS AND PROTESTS AGAINST THE IMPOSITION OF THE "ISLAMIC"DRESS CODE.

THE PEOPLE'S FEDAYEEN ORGANIZATION HAS ANNOUNCED ITS WILLINGNESS TO COOPERATE WITH THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT, BUT ALSO WARNED THAT UNLESS THE GOVERNMENT ASSERTED ITS AUTHORITY AS SOON AS POSSIBLE, THERE WAS DANGER OF INCREASED VIOLENCE AND "UNWANTED CIVIL WAR".

CLASHES ERUPTED IN BANDAR SHAH ON THE CASPIAN AND TWELVE PERSONS WERE REPORTED WOUNDED AS A GROUP OF REPORTEDLY FIFTEEN THOUSAND ETHNIC TURKOMANS TRIED TO CHANGE THE NAME OF THE CITY TO BANDAR TURKOMAN AND WERE MET BY A RIVAL GROUP TRYING TO CHANGE IT TO BANDAR ISLAM. BESIDES THE CITY NAME CHANGE PROPOSAL, THE TURKOMAN (PREDOMINATELY SUNNI) GROUP IS ALSO DEMANDING MORE AUTONOMY AND RECOGNITION OF THEIR TURKOMAN LANGUAGE IN THE SCHOOL SYSTEM.

ARRESTS AND EXECUTIONS CONTINUE THROUGHOUT IRAN AND YESTERDAY'S OFFICIAL COUNT WAS SIX KILLED BY FIRING SQUADS. BESIDES THOSE FOR POLICE, GENDARMERIE AND OTHER OFFICIALS BEING SENTENCED TO DEATH FOR "ANTI-REVOLUTION" ACTS (I.E., SHOOTING DEMONSTRATORS DURING EARLIER ANTI-SHAH PROTESTS), A NUMBER OF DEATH SENTENCES HAVE BEEN PASSED ON "SEXUAL" OFFENDERS. GIVEN PRESENT SITUATION, WHERE "COMMITTEE" GROUPS STILL WIELD THE POWER TO MAKE ARRESTS AND TRY ALLEGED OFFENDERS, WHERE THE CIVIL POLICE ORGANIZATION IS STILL IN A SHAMBLES, AND WHERE THE MINISTRY OF JUSTICE IS BEING THOROUGHLY REORGANIZED, THERE IS NO CONSISTENCY IN IMPOSITION OF PENALTIES.

MANY AREAS ARE ADJUDICATING CASES ON THE BASIS OF "ISLAMIC" LAW, AND SENTENCES PASSED SEEM TO DEPEND ON THE LOCAL LEVEL OF FANATICISM. IN ASTARA TWO YOUTHS HAVE BEEN SENTENCED TO DEATH FOR RAPING A YOUNG GIRL, AND ONE OF THEM HAS BEEN CONDEMNED TO DEATH BY STONING. IN SHAHRE-KORD, ONE MAN WAS FORCED TO MARRY A PROSTITUTE HE HAD JUST HIRED, AND SEVEN OTHERS ACCUSED OF GAMBLING WERE PUBLICLY WHIPPED. PUBLIC FLOGGINGS FOR DRINKING ALCOHOL HAVE BEEN REPORTED FROM VARIOUS PARTS OF THE COUNTRY. THERE HAVE ALSO BEEN REPORTS OF AUTHORITIES REFUSING TO LET FAMILY MEMBERS VISIT THOSE ACCUSED OF CRIMES.

AMONG MANY PEOPLE THERE IS A GROWING OPINION THAT EXECUTIONS ARE REALLY FAR MORE WIDESPREAD THAN THE PAPERS REPORT. 8.BOTH PERSIAN AND ENGLISH PRESS REPORTED ON JAMES BILL'S COMMENTS IN "TIME" THAT THERE WERE SEVERAL "PRO-US" AIDES IN THE PRESENT GOVERNMENT. AT A TIME WHEN OVERT ASSOCIATION WITH EITHER THE EMBASSY OR THE AMERICAN GOVERNMENT AS A WHOLE IS CONSIDERED BY MANY IRANIANS TO BE THE EQUIVALENT OF LEPROSY, THE DESCRIPTION OF YAZDI AS "PRO-AMERICAN" AND EXTEZAM AS "ABOUT AS AMERICAN AS YOU CAN POSSIBLY GET" ARE NOT EXPECTED TO HELP THOSE GENTLEMEN.

1979TEHRAN02882.subject: A REVOLUTIONARY ALLIANCE WITH THE MARXISTS?

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY: JOURNALIST FARIBORZ ATAPOUR IS A SERIES OF ARTICLES FOR THE ENGLISH-LANGUAGE TEHRAN JOURNAL HAS BEEN ATTEMPTING TO RALLY MODERNIST AND SECULAR-MINDED IRANIANS AGAINST THE IMPOSITION OF A NARROWLY THEOCRATIC FORM OF GOVERNMENT. THWARD THE END, IN HIS MOST RECENT INSTALLMENT MARCH 12 HE ARGUED FOR THE INCLUSION OF THE MARXIST FEDAYIN-E-KHALQ IN AN ALLIANCE OF ALL DEMOCRATIC FORCES. END SUMMARY.

FARIBORZ ATAPOUR, A JOURNALIST WHO WRITES FOR THE ENGLISH-LANGUAGE TEHRAN JOURNAL, HAS BEEN DOING A SERIES OF ARTICLES FOR HIS PAPER WHICH HAVE BEEN OUTSPOKEN IN THEIR SUPPORT OF A SECULAR REPUBLIC, A POSITION THAT STANDS IN SHARP CONTRAST TO THE KIND OF STATE AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI APPEARS TO HAVE IN MIND FOR THE IRANIAN PEOPLE. ATAPOUR HIMSELF HAS LONG BEEN INTERESTED IN THE PALESTINIAN CAUSE, AND SEEMS PREDISPOSED TOWARD THE KIND OF SOCIALISTCUM-NATIONALIST POLITICS OF THE PALESTINIANS AND CERTAIN OTHER REVOLUTIONARY ARAB SOCIETIES SUCH AS ALGERIA.

IN HIS ANALYSES OF THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION, HE HAS BEEN FAIN TO DRAW PARALLELS WITH BOTH THE FRENCH AND RUSSIAN REVOLUTIONS, AS WELL AS EFFORTS IN THE MIDDLE EAST TO ESTABLISH SECULAR, SOCIALIST REGIMES THAT NONETHELESS RETAIN A BASIC ISLAMIC CHARACTER. IN DOING THIS, HE APPEARS TO DEMONSTRATE BOTH THE INEVITABILITY OF THE HISTORICAL PROCESS AS IT APPLIES TO IRAN AND THE FEASIBILITY OF SYNTHESIZING HERE THE NATION'S ISLAMIC HERITAGE AND THE REQUIREMENTS OF A MODERN DEMOCRATIC AND SECULARIZED STATE.

ATAPOUR'S MAIN TARGETS HAVE BEEN WHAT HE REFERS TO AS THE "THEOCRATS OF QOM" AND THE "JACOBINS OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES". THE FORMER, OF COURSE, ARE PERSONIFIED IN KHOMEINI HIMSELF, ALTHOUGH ATAPOUR HAS GENERALLY RESISTED THE TEMPTATION TO ATTACK THE AYATOLLAH FRONTALLY. THE LATTER CONSIST OF AN ODD ASSORTMENT OF INDIVIDUALS, PROMINENT AMONG THEM BEING THE EMIGRES WHO RETURNED TO IRAN ON KHOMEINI'S COATTAILS AND WHO, IN ATAPOUR'S VIEW, ARE NOW PURSUING THEIR OWN INDIVIDUAL POLITICAL AMBITIONS AND PERSONAL VENDETTAS.

ATAPOUR SEES RANGED AGAINST THE POLITICALLY ANACHRONISTIC THEOLOGIANS AND THE OPPORTUNISTS HIDING BEHIND RELIGION THE TRUE IRANIAN REVOLUTIONARIES, I.E., THOSE WHO FOUGHT AGAINST THE SHAH NOT ONLY TO OVERTHROW HIM, BUT TO BRING ABOUT A FUNDAMENTAL TRANSFORMATION OF IRANIAN SOCIETY. ATAPOUR HAS RECOGNIZED THAT THE MARXIST FEDAYIN-E-KHALQ, PRESENTLY RELATIVELY FEW IN NUMBERS (WITH A HARDCORE MEMBERSHIP OF PERHAPS NO MORE THAT 5,000) BUT WELL-ARMED, HIGHLY MOTIVATED AND TIGHTLY DISCIPLINED, ARE POTENTIALLY AN IMPORTANT COMPONENT OF A GENUINELY REVOLUTIONARY ALLIANCE AGAINST THOSE HE REGARDS AS ESSENTIALLY COUNTER-REVOLUTIONARY.

HIS PROBLEM, HOWEVER, HAS BEEN TO CONVINCE OVQER POTENTIAL COMPONENTS OF THE ALLIANCE--AND PERHAPS HIMSELF--THAT THE FEDAYIN WOULD NOT ULTIMATELY TURN ON THEM AFTER FIRST DESPOSING OF THEIR MORE OBVIOUS ENEMIES.

ATAPOUR'S MARCH 12 INSTALLMENT, ENTITLED "FINDING ROOM FOR OUR FEDAYEEN," IS HIS MOST RECENT ATTEMPT IN THIS DIRECTION. IN THE ARTICLE HE ARGUES THAT "IF OUR REVOLUTION TRIES IN THE NAME OF ISLAM OR FOR ANY REASON TO BAN OR EXCLUDE THE MARXISTS, WE WILL JUST BE REPEATING THE MISTAKES OF THE PAHLAVI REGIME". HE CONTINUES, "WE MUST RECOGNIZE THEIR RIGHT TO PARTICIPATE IN THE PLURALISTIC DEMOCRACY OF IRAN".

THEREAFTER, ATAPOUR ATTEMPTS TO DEMONSTRATE THAT IRANIAN MARXISTS HAVE PERHAPS TAKEN NO MORE FROM MARX THAN EUROPEAN SOCIAL DEMOCRATS, AND THAT THEY, LIKE MUSLIMS "FROM AFGHANISTAN TO THE PHILIPPINES, ARE TRYING TO SEEK A COMMON DENOMINATOR BETWEEN ALL ISLAM AND A SMALL PART OF MARX". HE THEN TRACES THE ORIGIN OF THE TERM "COMMUNIST", AND CONCLUDES THAT IT WAS AROUND LONG BEFORE MARX AND IN AN ISLAMIC CONTEXT. CITING THE EXISTENCE OF JEWISH AND CHRISTIAN COMMUNISTIC SOCIETIES IN ARABIA, HE CLAIMS THAT THEIR PHILOSOPHIES HAD AN INFLUENCE ON THE THINKING OF THE PROPHET MOHAMMAD, AND, FURTHER, THAT IRAN ITSELF HAS EXPERIENCED A NUMBER OF "REVOLUTIONARY AND LEVELING COMMUNIST MOVEMENTS".

TURNING TO ALI SHARIATIFOR MANY THE INTELLECTUAL INSPIRATION OF THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION--ATAPOUR CLAIMS THAT "HE TOOK THE REVOLUTIONARY AND SCIENTIFIC APPROACH WHICH THE MARXISTS TOOK TO ECONOMICS AND HE APPLIED IT TO THE REGENERATION AND RENAISSANCE OF ISLAM". FROM THIS EXAMINATION, ATAPOUR CONCLUDES THAT MARX, THE SPIRIT OF ISLAM AND DEMOCRATIC SOCIALISM ARE INSEPARABLY LINKED IN IRAN, AND THAY ANY ATTEMPT TO ISOLATE THE MARXIST FEDAYIN ON THE BASIS OF THEIR ADHERENCE TO AN ECONOMIC PHILOSOPHY IGNORES THEIR UNDERLYING ISLAMIC NATIONALIST CHARACTER WHICH THEY POSSESS IN COMMON WITH OTHER PROGRESSIVE REVOLUTIONARY GROUPS INCLUDING, ACCORDING TO ATAPOUR, THE ISLAMIC MOJAHEDIN-E-KHALQ.

WHETHER ATAPOUR IS A STALKING HORSE FOR THE MARXISTS, AN INCURABLE ROMANTIC OR JUST A FOOL IS ESSENTIALLY MOOT. THE IMPORTANT POINT IS THAT HE HAS CORRECTLY RECOGNIZED THAT THE FEDAYIN ALONE AMONG THE CLEARLY SECULARIST GROUPS CONTENDING FOR POLITICAL POWER POSSESS A SIGNIFICANT MEASURE OF COERCIVE CAPABILITY AS WELL. WHILE HE NEVER SAYS SO, ATAPOUR SEEMS TO SUBSCRIBE TO THE MOAIST DICTUM THAT POLITICAL POWER ULTIMATELY GROWS OUT OF THE BARREL OF A GUN. THUS, IF THE SECULARISTS ARE SUCCESSFULLY TO CHALLENGE THOSE FORCES ATABOUR SEES AS COUNTER-REVOLUTIONARY, THEY WILL NEED TO BE ABLE TO BACK UP THEIR DEMANDS WITH FIREPOWER SHOULD IT COME TO ARMED CONFRONTATION.

ATAPOUR SEEMS TO BE ARGUING THAT TO EXCLUDE THE FEDAYIN FROM AN ALLIANCE OF MODERNIST, DEMOCRATIC GROUPS NOW WILL RESULT IN THE NONMARXIST SECULARISTS BEING LEFT OUT IN THE COLD IF THE ISSUE IS ULTIMATELY DECIDED ON THE BASIS OF ARMED STRENGTH.

ATAPOUR IS LONG KNOWN TO EMBASSY OFFICERS AS A WELL INFORMED BUT ERRATIC JOURNALIST. SENSITIVE TO A VARIETY OF IDEAS, HE LACKS JUDGEMENT IN ORGANIZING THEIR PATTERNS. HEAVILY PRO-PALESTINIAFSFOR MANY YEARS, HE HAS ALSO BEEN ANAPOLOGIST FOR SOVIET POLICIES IN THE MIDDLE EAST. A SUPREME EGOTIST WHO IS SUBJECT TO FLATTERY AND LIKES TO PLAY THE ROLE OF MAVERICK, IT IS POSSIBLE THAT HE IS BEING PRODDED INTO HIS CURRENT ROLE BY SOME WELL-PLACED SOVIET CAJOLERY. IT IS MORE LIKELY, HOWEVER, THAT HIS POSITION AS SPOKESMAN FOR THE FEDAYIN IS A SELF-APPOINTED ONE, DESIGNED AS MUCH TO SHOCK HIS PEERS AS TO DISPLAY HIS ENGLISH-EDUCATED ERUDIJION.
(C) - ENTIRE TEXT.)
EMBASSY MOSCOW IS CORRECT IN ASSUMING THE VINOGRADOV WAS NO MORE PRESCIENT ABOUT RECENT EVENTS IN IRAN THAN WERE THE REST OF US.

WHEN I SUGGESTED, IN THE SPRING OF 1978, THAT THE RELIGIOUS MOVEMENT MIGHT BECOME THE SOURCE OF REAL TROUBLE FOR THE SHAH, VINOGRADOV RIDICULED THE IDEA, STATING THAT THE MULLAHS HAD BEEN CRUSHED ONCE AND FOR ALL IN 1963. RELIGION, HE SAID, WAS A THING OF THE PAST IN IRAN. THE PEOPLE HAD TASTED THE MATERIAL BENEFITS OF MODERN TECHNOLOGY AND WANTED NO RETURN TO THE DARK AGES OF ISLAM.

AGAIN, IN THE FALL OF 1978, VINGRADOV TOLD ME THAT THE SHAH COULD HANDLE THE PROBLEMS HE FACED, BUT WOULD HAVE TO MAKE SOME CONCESSIONS TO "DEMOCRACY." HE ALSO INDICATED THAT IT WOULD BE NECESSARY FOR THE SHAH TO SHOW A LITTLE INDEPENDENCE FROM U.S. POLICY IN THE MIDDLE EAST, WHICH VINOGRADOV CONSTANTLY DESCRIBES AS A "DISASTER."

IN SHORT, AS A SOVIET REPRESENTATIVE, HE FOUND IT INCREDIBLE THAT THE SHAH WOULD FLINCH FROM USING FORCE TO PRESERVE HIS REGIME. HE NEVER DOUBTED UNTIL ABOUT EARLY DECEMBER THAT THE SHAH WOULD PULL THROUGH. A REVIEW OF SOVIET PROPAGANDA DURING THIS SAME PERIOD WOULD INDICATE THAT MOSCOW ACCEPTED THIS ANALYSIS AND BEGAN TO CHANGE ITS VIEWPOINT ONLY WHEN THE SHAH'S CHANCES WERE CLEARLY LOST.

DESPITE THESE OBSERVATIONS, IT IS INTERESTING TO NOTE THAT VINOGRADOV (AND MOSCOW) HAVE SHOWN REMARKABLE FLEXIBILITY IN SHIFTING FROM THEIR PREVIOUS ASSOCIATIONS WITH THE SHAH TO AN EARLY ENDORSEMENT OF KHOMEINI, AND NOW SEEM TO BE MOVING RAPIDLY TOWARDS A CONFRONTATION WITH KHOMEINI THROUGH THE AGENCY OF THE FEDAYEEN. CONSTANCY, EVEN IN RETROSPECT, DOES NOT SEEM TO BE A HALLMARK OF SOVIET DIPLOMACY IN IRAN. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN02908.subject: SPECIAL IMMIGRANT STATUS FOR EMBASSY TEHRAN NATIONALS

segments.text: C - ENTIRE TEXT.

AS THE RESULT OF RECENT EVENTS IN IRAN, MANY IRANIANS WHO HAVE WORKED FOR THE UNITED STATES GOVERNMENT OVER THE YEARS FIND THEMSELVES IN A DIFFICULT SITUATION. THOSE WHO HAVE WORKED FOR ARMISH-MAAG HAVE, BY AND LARGE, BEEN GIVEN TERMINATION NOTICES AND EXPECT TO LOSE THEIR EMPLOYMENT WITHIN THE NEXT SIXTY DAYS. MANY OTHERS, WHO HAVE WORKED FOR VARIOUS ELEMENTS OF THE MISSION, FIND THAT THEY ARE BEING HARRASSED BECAUSE OF THE VIRULENT ANTI-AMERICAN ATTITUDES WHICH ARE CURRENTLY SO PREVALENT.

CONSEQUENTLY, IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE DISCRETION WHICH I HAVE AS CHIEF OF MISSION, I HAVE DIRECTED ALL ELEMENTS OF THE MISSION TO PURSUE A POLICY OF GENEROUS INTERPRETATION OF THE REQUIREMENTS INHERENT IN THE REGULATIONS GOVERNING THE GRANTING OF SPECIAL IMMIGRANT VISAS TO THOSE FOREIGN NATIONALS WHO HAVE WORKED FOR THE UNITED STATES GOVERNMENT FOR A PERIOD OF AT LEAST FIFTEEN YEARS.

THE MISSIONCOMMITTEE WHICH IS RESPONSIBLE FOR SCREENING THESE SPECIAL IMMIGRANT VISA LAWS HAS BEGUN SENDING THE NAMES TO ME IN SUBSTANTIAL NUMBERS AND I HAVE BEGUN SIGNING THE APPROPRIATE FORMS. I DO NOT KNOW HOW MANY OF THOSE ELIGIBLE WILL ACTUALLYTAKE ADVANTAGE OF THE OPPORTUNITY TO OBTAIN THEIR "GREEN CARDS",BUT I ASSUME THERE MAY BE AS MANY AS ONE HUNDRED WHO MAY APPLY. A GOOD NUMBER OF THESE ARE FROM MINORITY GROUPS AND MANY HAVE RELATIVES IN THE UNITED STATES. SULLIVAN

SUMMARY: WOMEN CONTINUE DEMONSTRATIONS. GOVERNMENT SAYS N CHANGES IN REFERENDUM. IRANIAN DIFFICULTIES AT HEATHROW AIRPORT. ICJ PROTESTS ACTIVITIES OF REVOLUTIONARY TRIBUNALS. ANTI-CARTER DEMONSTRATION PLANNED. END SUMMARY.

PRESS REPORTS THAT OVER 10,000 MEN AND WOMEN MARCHED FROM TEHRAN UNIVERSITY TO FREEDOM SQUARE (FORMERLY SHAHYAD) ON MARCH 12 TO HEAR WOMENS' RIGHTS SPEECHES. COMPARED TO PREVIOUS DEMONSTRATIONS, YESTERDAY'S RALLY WAS RELATIVELY PEACEFUL, ALTHOUGH CROWDS OF "MOSLEM FUNDAMENTALISTS" JEERED DEMONSTRATORS. U.S. FEMINIST KATE MILLETT ALSO PARTICIPATED IN YESTERDAY'S DEMONSTRATION. IN A RELATED INCIDENT, ANOTHER GROUP OF WOMEN ATTACKED NIRT HEAD GHOTBZADEH'S CAR AS HE ARRIVED AT NIRT HEADQUARTERS DURING A DEMONSRATION THERE. ONE SHOT WAS FIRED AT THOTBZADEH BY A FEMININE MILITANT, AND THE WOMEN, WHO HAD COME TO PROTEST WHAT THEY CLAIM IS NIRT'S BIASED COVERAGE OF WOMENS' FREEDOM DEMONSTRATIONS, WERE FINALLY DISPERSED BY REVOLUTIONARY MILITIA.

INTERIOR MINISTER AHMAD HAJ SEYYED JAVADI DENIED THAT ANY CHANGES HAD BEEN MADE IN THE FORM OF THE MARCH 30 REFERENDUM. MIN OF INFORMATION MINACHI ALSO REFUTED YESTERDAY'S DESCRIPTION BY DR. MOFFATEH OF THE PROPOSED BALLOT, AND MOFFATEH ADMITTED HE HAD BEEN EXPRESSING A PERSONAL RATHER THAN AN OFFICIAL VIEW.

BOTH PERSIAN AND ENGLISH LANGUAGE PRESS CARRIED STORIES OF ALLEGED HARRASSMENT AND INTERROGATION OF IRANIANS BY U.K. IMMIGRATION AUTHORITIES. WHILE THE BRITISH EMBASSY CLAIMS THAT ONLY ABOUT ONE PERCENT OF IRANIANS WHO HAVE ARRIVED AT HEATHROW (334 OUT OF 30 TO 40 THOUSAND) SINCE JANUARY 1 HAVE BEEN DENIED ENTRY FOR FAILURE TO PROVE THEIR NON-IMMIGRANT STATUS, DEP PRIME MIN ENTEZAM SAID THE GOI WAS NOT SATISFIED WITH THE EXPLANATION.

ACCORDING TO UPI/REUTER REPORTS CARRIED IN LOCAL PRESS, THE ICJ YESTERDAY PROTESTED PRISON CONDITIONS AND THE MANNER IN WHICH EXECUTIONS ARE BEING CARRIED OUT BY IRANIAN REVOLUTIONARY TRIBUNALS. ELEVEN MORE EXECUTIONS WERE ANNOUNCED TODAY.

IRANIAN STUDENTS HAVE SCHEDULED A DEMONSTRATION AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY TODAY TO PROTEST CARTER'S MID-EAST AND PERSIAN GULF POLICY. THE DEMONSTRATION IS THE FIRST SPECIFICALLY ANTI-U.S./ANTI-CARTER ONE SINCE THE REVOLUTION.
1.C - ENTIRE TEXT.

IRAN OFFICIALLY ANNOUNDED ITS WITHDRAWAL FROM CENTO ON MARCH 12. WE SHALL FORWARD COPY OF OFFICIAL ANNOUNCEMENT WHICH IS PRESENTLY BEING TRANSLATED. THIS ANNOUNCEMENT FOLLOWED PAKISTAN'S SIMILAR ANNOUNCEMENT BUT WAS SEPARATE.

IN MEETING WITH MFA AMERICAN DEPARTMENT HEAD GOODARZNIA MARCH 13, POLITICAL COUNSELOR AND HIS DEPUTY WERE TOLD THAT IRAN DOES INDEED WISH TO STRENGTHEN AND EXPAND MEMBERSHIP OF RCD (ORGANIZATION FOR REGIONAL COOPERATION AND DEVELOPMENT). HE CONFIRMED GOI VISUALIZES THIS AS AN ORGANIZATION DEDICATED TO ECONOMIC, SOCIAL, AND CULTURAL MATTERS, NOT RPT NOT POLITICAL AND MILITARY. GOODARZNIA SAID THAT PAKISTAN, IN THE PERSON OF AGHA SHAHI, AGREES WITH THIS CONCEPT. WHEN ASKED WHAT COUNTRIES IRAN AND PAKISTAN HAD IN MIND, GOODARZNIA SAID ALL THE NEIGHBORS, SUCH AS IRAQ, AFGHANISTAN, INDIA, BANGLADESH. HE DID NOT RULE OUT OTHER ARAB STATES IF THEY DESIRED TO JOIN.
(WE ARE SOMEWHTAT SKEPTICAL ABOUT PAKISTAN ENDOSEMENT OF INDIA)

GOODARZNIA EXPRESSED SOME DOUBT AS TO WHETHER THREEMAN INDIAN MISSION SCHEDULED TO ARRIVE TODAY WOULD ACTUALLY ARRIVE. HE NOTED FONMIN SANJABI HAS BEEN "SICK" SINCE YESTERDAY. (COMMENT: IT IS RUMORED SANJABI HANDED IN HIS RESIGNATION SOME DAYS AGO AND MAY BE WAITING FOR THE RESULTS.)

WE STILL HAVE TO TALK WITH PAKISTANI AND INDIAN EMBASSIES HERE ABOUT THEIR VISITORS TO IRAN. MEANWHILE, IT WOULD APPEAR THAT IDEA OF A BROADER REGIONAL ORGANIZATION FOR ECONOMIC, SOCIAL AND CULTURAL PURPOSES IS ACCEPTABLE, EVEN DESIRABLE, IN PRESENT IRANIAN GOVERNMENT'S EYES. PUTTING THIS IDEA INTO PRACTICE MIGHT TAKE CONSIDERABLY MORE TIME, HOWEVER, IF IRANIANS ARE EXPECTED TO CARRY THE BALL. THEIR FOREIGN MINISTRY IS STILL VERY DISORGANIZED AND ANY CHANGE OF FOREIGN MINISTERS MIGHT SET BACK THE PROJECT. WE CERTAINLY AGREE WITH OTHER POSTS COMMENTING ON THIS PROPOSAL IN THAT ANY SHOW OF INTEREST BY USG IN THIS PROJECT AT THIS STAGE WOULD BE KISS OF DEATH.

1979TEHRAN02915.subject: MARCH 13 ECONOMIC SITREP, FROM PRESS REPORTS A. OIL: NIOC HAS ANNOUNCED THAT IT WILL BEGIN SELLING OIL UNDER TERM CONTRACTS BEGINNING APRIL FIRST. M OST P

segments.text: OIL: NIOC HAS ANNOUNCED THAT IT WILL BEGIN SELLING OIL UNDER TERM CONTRACTS BEGINNING APRIL FIRST. MOST PURCHASERS ARE REGULAR CLIENTS WHO HAD BEEN BUYING FROM NIOC PRIOR TO THE STRIKE. ENI REPRESENTATIVES ARE IN TEHRAN NEGOTIATING THE PURCHASE OF CRUDE OIL. BETWEEN NOW AND APRIL FIRST, NIOC WILL CONTINUE TO MAKE SALES ON THE SPOT MARKET. PRODUCTION IS NOW 2.5 MBPD, 700,000 BARRELS OF WHICH IS RETAINED FOR DOMESTIC CONSUMPTION, THE BALANCE EXPORTED.

NUCLEAR PROJECTS: NO DECISION HAS YET BEEN REACHED REGARDING THE NUCLEAR REACTOR KRAFTWERK HAS UNDER CONSTRUCTION. ORGINALLY ESTIMATED TO COST 8 BILLION MARKS, THE PORJECT MAY NOWNNOST TWICE THAT DUE TO CONTRACT ESCALATION CLAUSES. ABOUT 400 GERMAN WORKERS ARE STILL AT THE CONSTRUCTION SITE, DOWN FROM A HIGH OF 1,200, BUT WORK IS AT A HALT. PAYMENTS FOR THE PROJECT WERE STOPPED SEVERAL MONTHS AGO.

IMPORTS: 450,000 TONS OF CARGO HELD IN THE EMIRATES IS TO BE SHIFTED TO IRAN'S SOUTHERN PORTS ACCORDING TO THE IRAN CHAMBER OF COMMERCE INDUSTRY AND MINES. TRANSFER COSTS WILL AMOUNT TO $4.00 PER TON.

BUDGET: ALI AKBAR MOINFAR, MINISTER OF STATE IN CHARGE OF THE PLAN AND BUDGET ORGANIZATION, REPORTEDLY SAID THAT THE BUDGET WILL BE PREPARED ON A MONTHLY BASIS UNTIL A COMPLETE REVIEW OF ANNUAL BUDGETARY NEEDS IS COMPLETED. THE CURRENT BUDGET WOULD BE DETERMINED ON A PRO RATA BASIS OF THE CURRRENT YEAR BUDGET. INDICATIONS ARE THAT SOME MINISTRIES WILL BE CUT IN SIZA AND THAT CAREFUL ATTENTION WILL BE PAID TO THE NUMBEROUS STATE COMPANIES, SOME 80 PERCENT OF WHICH ARE NOT PROFITABLE. THE DEFENSE BUDGET, CRITICIZED FOR ITS MANGITUDE, WILL COME UNDER CLOSE SCRUTINY. PRIOIRTY WILL BE GIVEN TO HOUSING.
SOME 200,000 LOW COST UNITS ARE TO BE BUILT IN IRAN, RP,000 OF WHICH WILL BE LOCATED IN TEHRAN. ALLOCATIONS FOR PROJECTS ALREADY BEGU WILL BE "CHECKED."

LABOR: WORKERS OF THE SAADI TILE INDUSTRIES NEAR REY HAVE TAKEN 40 MINISTRY OF LABOR EMPLOYEES HOSTAGE BECAUSE THEY HAVE NOT BEEN PAID FOR THE LAST FOUR MONTHS. PRESS ESTIMATES INDICATE THAT 3 TO 3.5 MILLION WORKERS ARE CURRENTLY UNEMPLOYED.

MEAT: THE PREVIOUSLY ANNOUNCED BAN ON IMPORTS OF FROZEN MEAT IS NOT TO BE PUT INTO EFFECT IMMEDIATELY, THE BAN, IT HAS BEEN DISCOVERED, WOULD CREATE A SVERE MEAT SHORTAGE IN ADDITION TO CAUSING SEVERE FINANCIAL DIFFICULTIES TO IMPORTERS. THE HEAD OF A COLD STORAGE AND SLAUGHTER COMPLEX IN OROUMEIH, FORMERLY REZAIHEH, APPEALED TO THE CENTRAL COMMITTEE BECAUSE HE RISKED LOSING 20 MILLION KILOS OF MEAT WORTH 2.4 BILLION RAILS. IN ADDITON, A PBULIC REALTIONS CAMPAIGN ON THE PART OF THE AUSTRIALIAN AND NEW ZEALANDERS DEMONSTRATING THAT THE MEAT WAS PROPERLY BUTCHERED IS HAVING AN EFFECT. FREEZING ITSELF DOES NOT MAKE THE MEAT FORBIDDEN PROVIDED THE BUTCHERING

ATTEMPTS ON THE PART OF THE REVOLUTIONARY GOVERNMENT TO IMPOSE ISLAMIC CIVIL LAW HAVE AROUSED THE IRE OF MANY OF THE WOMEN OF IRAN. MANY FELT UNEASY WHEN THE FAMILY PROTECTION ACT, WHICH PROVIDED SOME PROTECTION IN CASES OF DIVORCE AND ACCORDED WOMEN SOME PROPERTY RIGHTS, WAS ABROGATED. BUT AN ANNOUNCED BAN ON CO-EDUCATION AND AN ADMONITION ON THE PART OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI THAT WOMEN SHOULD ABIDE BY THE HEJAB, OR ISLAMIC DRESS CODES, VQOVED TO BE THE FINAL STRAW. BEGINNING SATURDAY, MARCH 8, FEMALE EMPLOYEES OF THE GOI WERE TOLD TO WEAR SCARVES OR CHADORS TO WORK.

FOR THE LAST FIVE DAYS, WOMEN OF ALL AGENES HAVE TAKEN TO THE STREETS TO PROTEST INFRINGEMENTS ON THEIR LIBERTY. GROUPS OF UP TO 15 TO 20 THOUSAND (PRESS ESTIMATES) HAVE CONVERGED AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY AND MARCHED TO THE MINISTRY OF JUSTICE AND TO FREEDOM SQUARE (FORMERLY SHAHYAD SQUARE). HIGH SCHOOL STUDENTS HAVE TAKEN TO THE STREET; FEMALE TEACHERS HAVE GONE ON STRIKE; NURSES HAVE REFUSED TO WORK, POINTING OUT THAT IT IS AGAINST ISLAMIC LAW FOR A WOMEN TO TOUCH A MAN, AND DEFYING THE GOVERNMENT TO FIND MALE REPLACEMENTS FOR THEM; FEMALE IRAN AIR EMPLOYEES HAVE MARCHED ON AIRLINE OFFICES AND GOI EMPLOYEES HAVE DEMONSTRATED OUTSIDE THEIR OFFICES.

THESE GROUPS HAVE MET WITH HARRASSMENT ON THE PART OF OPPOSING FACTIONS. CONSERVATIVE DELEMNTS HAVE BLOCKED THE WAY OF MARCHERS, TAUNTED THEM WITH CRISES OF "PROSTITUTE", PUSHED THEM INTO JUBES AND ATTACKED THEM WITH KNIVES. FOUR WOMEN WERE REPORTED INJURED BY KNIFE-WIELDING MEN WHO FAVORED HEJAB. NIRT HAS ALSO BEEN A TARGET OF THE DEMONSTRATIONS SINCE, ACCORDING TO THE DEMONSTRATORS, INSUFFICIENT MENTION WAS MADE OF THEIR ACTIVITIES. ON MARCH 12, SADEGH GHOTBZADEH, HEAD OF NIRT, WAS ATTACKED BY A WOMAN WHO FIRED SHOTS INTO THE AIR. GHOTBZADEH, WHO INITIALLY SAID THAT THE LACK OF COVERAGE WAS DUE TO TECHNICAL PROBLEMS, HAS SUBSEQUENTLY ALLOWED THE DEMONSTRATORS SOME TELEVISION COVERAGE.

PRESS COVERAGE IN THE ENGLISH PAPERS HAS BEEN CONSIDERABLE. FARSI COVERAGE HAS BEEN SOMEWHAT LESS, WITH THE NOTABLE EXCEPTION OF AYANDEGAN, WHICH REPORTED ON TELEPHONE INTERVIEWS WITH THE WIVES OF A NUMBER OF MINISTERS. NOT ONE ADVOCATED HEJAB, SAYING THAT THE INTEGRITY OF A WOMAN DID NOT DEPEND ON WHETHER OR NOT SHE WORE A VIEL.

AYATOLLAHS KHOMEINI AND TALEGHANI HAVE BOTH MADE PUBLIC STATEMENTS ON THE SUBJECT OF PROPER DRESS AND THE PROPER ROLE FOR WOMEN IN AN ISLAMIC SOCIETY, ALTHOUGH THEIR LATER STATEMENTS HAVE MELLOWED SOMEWHAT FROM THE INITIAL ONES. BOTH HAVE SAID THAT WOMEN MAY PARTICIPATE IN ALL BASIC AFFAIRS OF STATE ALONGSIDE THEIR BRETHEN, BUT THAT IT IS THEIR DUTY UNQUOTE TO BE PROPERLY DRESSED. ADHERING TO THE HEJAB, ACCORDING TO TALEGHANI, DOES NOT MEAN THAT WOMEN WILL NOT BE GIVEN THEIR RIGHTS. WOMEN, HE SAID, ARE MISTAKEN IF THEY THINK THAT HEJAB WILL MAKE THEM LOSE THEIR PERSONALITIES. IN FACT, IT MARKS THEIR INDEPENDENCE AS EASTERN WOMEN.

THE DEMONSTRATIONS OF THE LAST SEVERAL DAYS ARE A STRONG INDICATION THAT MANY WOMEN ARE UNCONVINCED BY THESE STATEMENTS. CO-EDUCATION HAS BEEN BANNED. A WOMEN CAN OBTAIN A DIVORCE, BUT ONLY AFTER THREE COMPLAINTS TO A LOCAL MULLAH, OR RELIGIOUS LEADER. AFTER THE FIRST COMPLAINT ABOUT MISTREATMENT THE HUSBAND GETS A WARNING, AFTER THE SECOND, A LIGHT PUNISHMENT, AND AFTER THE THIRD, THE MULLAH MAY, REPEAT MAY, ACCORD HER A DIVORCE. THERE HAVE ALREADY BEEN SEVERAL INSTANCES OF LASHINGS OF ADULTERERS AND THOSE ACCUSED OF PROMISCUOUS UNQUOTE BEHAVIOR.

KHOMEINI DID STATE THAT WHILE ABORTION WAS NOT ACCEPTABLE, CONTRACEPTIVE PILLS WERE, YET PILLS ARE APPARENTLY NOT TO BE FOUND IN ANY TEHRAN PHARMACY. FOLLOWING THE FIRST STATEMENT THAT WOMEN SHOULD RETURN TO HEJAB, ONE LOCAL TENNIS CLUB ANNOUNCED THAT MIXED DOUBLES WOULD BE PROHIBITED AND FEMALE PLAYERS WOULD HAVE TO WEAR SLACKSAND LONG-SLEEVED SHIRTS. ONE WAITS WITH BATED BREATH FOR GUIDANCE ON APPROPRIATE DRESS FOR THE BEACH AND SWIMMING POOLS.

EVEN PRIOR TO THE REVOLUTION, WOMEN IN IRAN WERE BY NO MEANS LIBERATED. THOSE WITH AN EDUCATION DID FIND EMPLYMENT, THERE WERE WOMEN IN THE MAJLIS AND, PRIOR TO THE FALL OF THE AMOUZEGAR GOVERNMENT, ONE, FOR WOMEN'S AFFAIRS, IN THE CABINET. ON THE OTHER HAND, PERMISSION FROM THE HUSBAND WAS STILL REQUIRED BEFORE THEY COULD LEAVE THE COUNTRY, AND CUSTODY OF CHILDREN WAS AWARED TO THE HUSBAND IN THE EVENT OF A DIVORCE. THOSE WOMEN WHO HAD ACHIEVED SOME DEGREE OF INDEPENDENCE ARE NOT ABOUT TO GIVE IT UP EASILY. MANY DID DON CHADORS AS A SYMBOL OF OPPOSITION TO THE FORMER REGIME, AND WERE ACTIVE IN THE REVOLUTION.

FOR THE MOST PART UNIVERSITY STUDENTS, THESE GIRLS DO NOT WISH TO GIVE UP THEIR EDUCATION AND RETURN TO THE ROLE OF A TRADITIONAL MOSLEM WOMAN, PARTICULARLY AFTER HAVING HAD A TAST OF POLITICAL ACTIVISM. OTHER DEMONSTRATORS, LIKE ONE MIDDLE-AGED EMBASSY EMPLOYEE, HAVE TAKEN TO THE STREETS FOR THE FIRST TIME IN THEIR LIVES. THEY ARE CONCERNED MORE ABOUT THE FUTURE OF THEIR DAUGHTERS THAN THEY ARE FOR THEMSELVES.

THE ISSUE OF HEJAB IS A SENSITIVE ONE, AND PASSIONS RUN HIGH ON BOTH SIDES, PERHAPS BECAUSE IT INVOLVED A HIGHLY VISIBLE SYMBOL. EVEN THE FORMER REGIME, FOR ALL ITS SUPPOSED POWER, WAS UNABLE TO PASS A STRONGER FAMILY PROTECTION ACT DUE TO CONSERVATIVE RELIGIOUS OPPOSITION. LIBERAL WOMEN, ON THE OTHER HAND, ARE ADAMANT.

ONE FEMALE EMPLOYEE OF THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS REPORTEDLY TELEPHONED THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE SHORTLY AFTER KHOMEINI'S STATEMENTS ON CONTRACEPTION, GAVE HER FULL NAME, THE NAME OF THE OFFICE IN WHICH SHE WORKED AND HER TELEPHONE NUMBER AND SAID, "ON BEHALF OF THE WOMEN AT THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS, WOULD YOU TELL THE IMAM TO STAY OUT OF OUR BEDROOMS". DURING THE COURSE OF ONE DEMONSTRATION, CONSERVATIVE CRISES OF "ONWARD WITH KHOMEINI" WERE COUNTERED WITH CHANTS OF "DEATH TO KHOMEINI".

THE END RESULT OF ALL OF THIS IS YET TO BE SEEN, BUT RELIGIOUS LEADERS HAVE ALREADY BACKED OFF, MODIFYING THEIR STATEMENTS ON DRESS TO RECOMMENDATONS, NOT ORDERS. THE MINISTER OF JUSTICE HAS ORDERED THAT DEMONSTRATING WOMEN SHOULD NOT BE ATTACKED AND THAT ATTACKERS WOULD BE PUNISHED. EVEN GHOTBZADEH HAS ACCORDED THEM TELEVISION TIME. MORE DIFFICULT WILL BE THE PROBLEM OF CONTROLLING THE SOCIETY. THE DEMONSTRATORS ARE A MINORITY, AND THE GOVERNMENT NOT IN CONTROL.

STREET HARRASSMENT, PARTICULARLY IN THE SOUTHERN PART OF THE CITY, CAN BE EXPECTED TO INCREASE, AND THERE ARE RUMORS OF FEMALE EMPLOYEES OF AT LEAST ONE MINISTRY BEING FIRED BECAUSE THEY DID NOT WEAR SCARVES, AND BEING REPLACED BY MALE EMPLOYEEES.

KATE MILLETT IS ON THE SCENE. THERE IS, THEREFORE, NO FEAR THAT THE MOVEMENT WILL LACK FOR EXPERIENCED LEADERSHIP. OF INTEREST, HOWEVER, IS HOW HER PRESENCE WILL BE VIEWED, SINCE WESTERN DRESS IS SEEN IN SOME CIRCLES AS PART OF AN AMERICAN IMPERALIST PLOT HATCHED BY THE CIA TO CORRUPT THE HONOR OF MOSLEM WOMANHOOD.

1979TEHRAN02919.subject: EFFECTS OF THE REVOLUTION ON THE BAHAI'S

segments.text: C - ENTIRE TEXT.

A RECENT PERSIAN PRESS REPORT CLAIMED ALL BAHAI TEMPLES AND EDUCATION CENTERS IN MASHAD HAVE BEEN TAKEN OVER BY "COMMITTEE" GROUPS AND WILL BE TURNED INTO ISLAMIC CENTERS AND/OR MOSQUES. IN A SUBSEQUENT ARTICLE, IT WAS STATED THAT DOCUMENTS FOUND IN THE BAHAI CENTERS PROVED THAT BAHAI GROUPS WERE SPYING ON IRAN ON BEHALF OF ISRAEL.

POLOFF HAD OPPORTUNITY TO DISCUSS SITUATION WITH BAHAI FRIENDS PROMINENT IN TABRIZ BAHAI COMMUNITY. THEY SAID THAT ORIGINAL ARTICLE ABOUT CONFISCATION OF PROPERTY WAS TRUE, AND THAT ALL BAHAI HOUSES OF WORSHIP IN TEHRAN, ALONG WITH PRIVATE HOMES OF SOME COMMUNITY LEADERS, HAD ALSO BEEN SEIZED BY COMMITTEE FORCES. THEY CLAIMED HOWEVER THAT THE CONFISCATIONS WERE NOT RPT NOT OFFICIAL ACTS BY THE NEW GOVERNMENT, BUT RATHER WERE DONE BY FANATIC MOSLEMS. THE SAME WAS TRUE FOR THE SERIES OF ATTACKS ON BAHAI BUSINES PLACES DURING AND AFTER THE REVOLUTION, WHICH THE TWO CLAIMED WERE CARRIED OUT BY MOSLEM BUSINESS RIVALS AND "FANATICS".

COMMENT: THE BAHAI COMMUNITY IN IRAN ENJOYED A SOMEWHAT PROTECTED STATUS UNDER THE SHAH, DESPITE THE DEFINITE ANTIPATHY WITH WHICH MANY PIOUS MOSLEMS REGARD BAHAISM. IN MANY CONVERSATIONS WITH "REVOLUTIONARIES" ABOUT THE FUTURE OF RELIGION IN IRAN, EMBOFFS HAVE HEARD "EXCEPT FOR THE BAHAI'S" TACKED ON TO STATEMENTS OF FREEDOM OF RELIGIOUS BELIEF. CONSIDERED HERETICS BY THE SHI'ITES, AND ESPECIALLY SUSPECT FOR THEIR CONNECTION TO ISRAEL, IT SEEMS UNLIKELY THAT THE PRESENT GOVERNMENT WILL DO MUCH TO PROTECT THE BAHAI COMMUNITY FROM PERSECUTION UNDER AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC.

1979TEHRAN02948.subject: DETERIORATION IN AMBIANCE AFFECTING WESTERN DIPLOMATIC MISSIONS IN TEHRAN

segments.text: MISSIONS IN TEHRAN (C - ENTIRE TEXT)

DURING THE PAST FEW DAYS, THERE HAS BEEN A MARKED DETERIORATION IN THE AMBIANCE AFFECTING WESTERN DIPLOMATIC MISSIONS IN TEHRAN. AS REPORTED IN SEPTELS, BOTH THE U.S. AND BRITISH EMBASSIES HAVE BEEN TARGETS OF DEMONSTRATIONS. U.S. EFFORTS TO ESTABLISH SOME STATUS FOR OUR MILITARY MISSION AND TO ARRANGE FOR THE REMOVAL OF BOTH OFFICIAL AND PERSONAL PROPERTY FROM IRAN HAVE HIT SNAGS. THE PROBLEM OF ENTRY INTO PREMISES PREVIOUSLY OCCUPIED BY U.S. MILITARY PERSONNEL HAS BECOME FURTHER COMPLICATED. AT THE SAME TIME, THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT HAS BECOME INCREASINGLY HARASSED AND FRUSTRATED.

THE DEMONSTRATION AGAINST THE U.S. EMBASSY, IN WHICH SEVERAL THOUSAND PARTICIPATED, WAS THE CULMINATION OF A LARGER MANIFESTATION AGAINST PRESIDENT CARTER'S MID-EAST POLICY, AND PARTICULARLY AGAINST U.S. RELUCTANCE TO RECOGNIZE THE PLO AS REPRESENTATIVES OF THE PALESTINIAN PEOPLE. THE RALLY AS ADDRESSED BY THE PLO "AMBASSADOR" AND WAS LED BY A PHALANX OF FEDAYEEN.

THE DEMONSTRATION AGAINST THE BRITISH EMBASSY WAS ALLEGEDLY A PROTEST AGAINST "HARASSMENT" OF IRANIAN IMMIGRANTS AT HEATHROW AIRPORT. HOWEVER, IT, TOO, HAD PLO AND FEDAYEEN PARTICIPATION, AS WELL AS A NUMBER OF PRO-PALESTINIAN POSTERS AND BANNERS IN ITS MIDST.

AT THE PRIME MINISTER'S OFFICE ON MARCH 14, THERE WAS A LARGE, MILLING CROWD OF PETITIONERS, OF APPARENTLY SPONTANEOUS ORIGIN, ALL SEEKING REDRESS FOR SOME PROBLEM, BUT EFFECTIVELY BLOCKING ACCESS TO THE BUILDINGS AND BY THEIR PRESENCE, EMPHASIZING THE INCAPACITY OF THE GOVERNMENT TO GOVERN EFFECTIVELY.

ALSO ON MARCH 14, THE EMBASSY SUFFERED SETBACKS IN ITS EFFORTS ON SEVERAL FRONTS TO ARRANGE FOR (A) USE OF OUR MILITARY HOSPITAL, (B) ACCESS TO THE ARMISH/MAAG FILES, (C) REMOVAL OF APO MAIL FROM VARIOUS LOCATIONS, (D) REMOVAL OF U.S.-OWNED COMMUNICATIONS EQUIPMENT FROM THE FORMER ACOM COMMUNICATIONS SITE, (E) CLEARANCE OF PERSONAL POSSESSIONS OF ARMISH PERSONNEL THROUGH THE AIRPORT FOR TRANSPORTATION TO THE UNITED STATES.

ALL THESE SIMULTANEOUS ACTIONS COULD CONCEIVABLY BE FORTUITOUS AND MERELY REFLECT RAMPANT XENOPHOBIA BY IRANIAN REVOLUTIONARIES. HOWEVER, THE FACT THAT MOST OF THEM SEEM TO INVOLVE THE PRESENCE OF THE FEDAYEEN AND THE FACT THAT THEY REPRESENT PARALLEL ATTACKS ON THE WESTERN POWERS AS WELL AS THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT SUGGEST THAT THEY MAY HAVE EXTERNAL INSPIRATION.

IT WOULD MAKE SENSE FOR THE SOVIETS, WHO HAVE NEVER CEASED THEIR ANTI-AMERICAN, ANTI-WESTERN PROPAGANDA IN IRAN, TO UTILIZE THEIR ASSETS IN THE PLO AS WELL AS THE FEDAYEEN TO INSTIGATE THESE MEASURES. THE TACTICS USED HAVE A FAMILIAR SOVIET CHARACTER.

WE HAVE A NUMBER OF PROBLEMS IN GRAPPLING WITH THESE MATTERS. IN THE FIRST PLACE, THE GOVERNMENT IS RELATIVELY IMPOTENT. BAZARGAN HAS REGULARLY COMPLAINED ABOUT THE "KOMITAYS" AND THE FEDAYEEN, BUT SEEMS POWERLESS TO HINDER THEIR ACTIVITIES. THE VERY SPECTACLE OF HIS OFFICE BEING BESIEGED BY SUPPLICANTS IS SYMBOLIC OF HIS FRUSTRATION.

IN THE SECOND PLACE, BOTH YAZDI AND ENTEZAM, WHO HAVE CONSISTENTLY BEEN OF ASSISTANCE OT US IN THE PAST, HAVE "GONE TO GROUND" AS A RESULT OF JIM BILL'S INDISCRETIONS IN LAST WEEK'S TIME MAGAZINE. YAZDI, IN PARTICULAR, NOW SEEMS TO BE BENDING OVER BACKWARD TO PROVE THAT HE IS NOT RPT NOT "PRO-AMERICAN" AND THEREFORE PERMITS A NUMBER OF HARASSMENTS TO OCCUR IN HIS NAME.

FINALLY, THE FOREIGN MINISTRY, WHICH MIGHT BE CALLED UPON TO HELP, IS PARALYZED BECAUSE THE FOREIGN MINISTER, KARIM SANJABI, IS STAYING AT HOME DUE TO "ILLNESS". HIS AILMENT SEEMS TO BE POLITICAL AND HAS TO DO WITH ALLOCATIONS OF POWER BETWEEN HIMSELF AND YAZDI.

GIVEN THESE CIRCUMSTANCES, THERE IS LITTLE OF PRACTICAL MERIT WHICH WE CAN DO TO IMPROVE OUR LOT. I AM ASKING FOR A MEETING WITH BAZARGAN, BUT EXPECT THAT IT WILL BE DELAYED SINCE HE DOES NOT WISH TO HAVE HIM IMPOTENCE FLAUNTED SO OBVIOUSLY. HOWEVER, IN THE ABSENCE OF SANJABI AND GIVEN THE COMPLICATIONS WITH YAZDI, HE IS THE ONLY PERSON TO WHOM WE CAN TURN.

THE CARDS WE HOLD IN THIS SORT OF GAME ARE VERY FEW. IF AND WHEN THE IRANIANS COME TO US FOR ASSISTANCE ON THEIR MILITARY LOGISTICS, WE WILL BE ABLE TO RAISE THE STATUS AND RIGHTS OF OUR MILITARY PERSONNEL. BUT IT REMAINS TO BE SEEN WHETHER THE GOVERNMENT HAS ADEQUATE AUTHORITY TO OVERRIDE THE FEDAYEEN, WHICH, IN ANY EVENT, WOULD LIKE TO FRUSTRATE THE RE-ESTABLISHMENT OF A U.S.IRANIAN SECURITY ARRANGEMENT.

ABOUT THE ONLY U.S. FAVOR WHICH IS UNIVERSALLY SOUGHT BY ALL POLITICAL ELEMENTS IS THE UBIQUITOUS U.S. VISA, ESPECIALLY THE STUDENT VARIETY. AS LONG AS WE REFRAIN FROM ISSUING THESE VISAS, WE HAVE SOMETHING OF A BARGAINING CHIP. HOWEVER, OUR ABILITY TO USE THIS SORT OF INSTRUMENT IS OF QUESTIONABLE QUALITY AND WILL HAVE TO BE MEASURED AS THE SITUATION MATURES.
FOR THE TIME BEING, THERE, WE SHALL PROBABLY HAVE TO CONTINUE TO SUFFER OUR PROBLEMS WHILE CONSTANTLY PUSHING OUR CAUSE ON ALL FRONTS. PROSPECTS FOR AN EARLY BREAKTHROUGH ARE DIM.

SUMMARY: ANTI-US:ANTI-CARTER DEMONSTRATION IN TEHRAN YESTERDAY. ANTI-BRITISH TODAY. TWELVE EXECUTIONS ANNOUNCED. DEP PRIME MINISTER ATTACKS "TIME/ MAGAZINE. AMNESTY SOUGHT FOR SHAHREGIME OFFICIALS. SEVENTY-FIVER MORE NIRT EMPLOYEES FIRED. ANTIKAYHAN DEMONSTRATION PRISON INSPECTIONS. ARRESTS CONTINUE. KURDISH RADIO PROGRAMS STOPPED.INDIAN DELEGATION VISITS IRAN. PLO TO OPEN OFFICE IN AHVAZ. MATINE-DAFTARY COMMENTS AT WOMEN'S RALLY. END SUMMARY.

A CROWD OF THOUSANDS JOINED THE RALLY AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY ON MARCH 13 TO PROTEST CARTER'S MID-EAST POLICY. HIGH-LIGHTS OF THE DEMONSTRATION INCLUDED A SPEECH BY HANI ALI-HASSAN, PLO REPRESENTATIIVE IN IRAN, AND A MARCH OF SUPPORT PAST THE PLO OFFICE WHICH TURNED INTO A MARCH OF PROTEST IN FRONT OF THE US EMBASSY. CROWDS ESTIMATED AT BETWEEN SEVEN AND TEN THOUSAND BY EYEWITNESSES (AND UP TO 20,000 IN NEWS ACCOUNTS) CARRYING BANNERS AND SHOUTING, "DEATH TO CARTER", "DOWN WITH DIRTY CARTER", AND "CARTER STAY HOME" PASSED IN FRONT OF THE EMBASSY FOR MORE THAN AN HOUR, STOPPING PERIODICALLY TO RAISE FISTS AND CHANT ANTI-US AND ANTI-CARTER SLOGANS.
THE RALLY AND MARCH WERE ORDERLY AND THRE WAS NO VIOLENCE. SOME SOURCES INDICATED THAT THE DEMONSTRATION WAS ORCHESTRATED BY THE PLO. WE CAN SPECULATE AS TO POSSIBLE SOVIET SUPPORT IN THE BACKGROUND.

MORNING MARCH 14 DEMONSTRATION OF ABOUT 2,000, MAINLY STUDENTS, BESIEGED BRITISH EMBASSY COMPOUND SHOUTING ANTIIMPERIALIST SLOGANS WHICH TURNED TO PROTESTS OF BRITISH IMMIGRATION POLICY WHICH, STUDENTS CLAIMED, DISCRIMINATES AGAINST IRANIANS. DEMONSTRATION DID NOT INVADE THE PREMISES AND WITHDREW PEACEFULLY AFTER AMBASSADOR TALKED WITH FEW OF ITS REPRESENTATIVES.

PRESS HEADLINED ANNOUNCEMENT OF TWELVE EXECUTIONS ON MARCH 13, INCLUDING FIRST OF THOSE ON "PURELY POLITICAL" BASIS. AMONG THOSE WHO FACED FIRING SQUADS FOR POLITICAL REASONS WERE: MAHMOUD JAAFARIAN, FORMER HEAD OF PARS NEWS AGENCY AND DEPUTY CHIEF OF NIRT; PARVIZ NIKKHAH, EX-NEWS DIRECTOR OF NIRT; BHOLAN HOSSIEN DANESHI, DEPUTY IN THE LAST MAJLES FROM ABADAN; AND LT. GEN. NADER JAHANBANI, EX-CHIEF OF THE IRANIAN SPORTS ORGANIZATION AND DEPUTY CHIEF OF STAFF FOR PLANS OF THE AIR FORCE. OTHERS EXECUTED INCLUDED GEN. VALIULLAH ZAND KARIMI, EX-CHIEF OF PRISONS AND EX-CHIEF OF THE TEHRAN INTELLIGENCE DEPARTMENT; LT.

MANUCHEHR VOSOUQI, FORMER IMPERIAL GUARD OFFICERS; MOHAMMAD NOVID, DESCRIBED AS A SAVAK "TORTURER"; MIR AHMAD KOUCHESFAHANI, SAVAK INTERROGATOR: 2ND LT. HOSSEIN SHAKAMAN, COUNTERINSURGENCY OFFICER; MAJOR MANUCHEHR QASHQAI, COMMANDER OF THE COUNTERINSRUGENCY FORCE; HOSSEIN FARZIN, LEADER OF THE "STICK-WIELDING" GANGS; AND QOM POLICE SERGEANT AGHA HOSSEINI. ACCORDING TO ONE ACCOUNT, YESTERDAY'S EXECUTIONS BRING THE TOTAL COUNT UP TO 63 FOR THE NUMBER OF KNOWN DEATH SENTENCES CARRIED OUT BY THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS. THE ACTUAL FIGURE IS PROBABLY HIGHER.

IN A PRESS CONFERENCE ON MARCH 13, DEP PRIME MINISTER ENTEZAM ATTACKED "TIME" MAGAZINE, WHICH HE SAID REGULARLY RECEIVED SECRET PAYMENTS FROM THE SHAH. ENTEZAM CLAIMED THAT HE WAS IN POSSESSION OF DOCUMENTS PROVING CHECKS WERE PAID TO TIME, INC., AND HE ACCUSED TIME OF BIASED REPORTING DURING THE REVOLUTION. ENTEZAM'S ATTACK ON TIME WAS CAUSED BY THE RECENT ARTICLE IN WHICH JAMES BILL CLAIMED ENTEZAM IS "AS AMERICAN AS CAN BE", AND THAT SEVERAL TOP IRANIAN OFFICIALS HAD CLOSE TIES TO THE U.S. ENTEZAM DENIED THE TIME-QUOTED DESCRIPTION. THE TIME REPORTER AT THE PRESS CONFERENCE CHALLENGED ENTEZAM TO PROVE HIS BRIBERY ACCUSATION, AND TIME, INC. SPOKESMAN DON M.
WILSON ISSUED A STATEMENT YESTERDAY CALLING ENTEZAM'S CHARGES OF PAHLAVI BRIBES TO TIME TOTALLY UNTRUE.

THE GOVERNMENT HAS DECIDED TO ASK KHOMEINI TO DECLARE AN AMNESTY FOR ALL PAHLAVI REGIME ASSOCIATES AGAINST WHOM CRIMINAL EVIDENCE DOES NOT EXIST. GIVING REASONS SIMILAR TO THOSE UUSED BY BAZARGAN IN HIS DEFENSE OF THE MILITARY IN HIS NATIONALLY TELEVISED SPEECH TWO WEEKS AGO, MIN OF DEFENSE MADANI ANNOUNCED THE CANINET'S DECISION TO APPEAL FOR AN AMNMESTY FOR THOSE WHO WORKED DURING THE PAHLAVI REGIME FOR THE CIVILIAN GOVERNMENT OR THE MILITARY.

7 SEVENTY-FIVE MORE EMPLOYEES OF NIRT WERE SACKED IN WHAT IS DESCRIBED AS A CONTINUATION OF THE PURGE AGAINST THOSE WHO "SERVED THE PREVIOUS REGIME OR WERE INVOLVED IN MISAPPROPRIATION OF PUBLIC FUNDS", BRINGING THE NUMBER OF EMPLOYEES FIRED FROM NIRT UP TO 125. NIRT HAS ALSO ANNOUNCED THE CANELLATION OF 160 GRANTS MADE TO EMPLOYEES TO STUDY ABROAD.

OVER ONE THOUSAND DEMONSTRATORS DESCRIBED AS "RELIGIOUS STUDENTS" PROTESTED AGAINST KAYHAN NEWSPAPER YESTERDAY, DEMAND THAT THE PAPER CLARIFY ITS POSITION VIS-A-VIS THE REVOLUTION. THE CROWD ESPECIALLY PROTESTED KAYHAN'S REPRINTING OF PART OF TIME MAGAZINE'S JAMES BILL ARTICLE ON "PRO-AMERICAN" MEMBERS OF THE NEW GOVERNMENT.

ACCORDING TO THE PERSIAN PRESS,THREE RED CROSS INSPECTORS FROM SWITZERLAND VISITED GHASR PRISON YESTERDAY AND RECEIVED APPROXIMATELY 200 LETTERS FROM PRISONERS INCARCERATED THERE FOR DELIVERY TO THEIR FAMILIES. THE INSPECTION TEAM WILL VISIT OTHER PRISONS IN TEHRAN AND THEN PROCEED TO PROVINCIAL CITIES. KARIM LAHIJI, PROMINENT LAWYER AND MEMBER OF THE COMMITTEE FOR THE DEFENSE OF HUMAN RIGHTS AND FREEDOM, IS EXPECTED TO VISIT QASR PRISON TODAY.
THE WELL-KNOWN EDITOR-IN-CHIEF OF KHANDANIHA MAGAZINE, ALI ASGHAR AMIRANI, WAS ARRESTED YESTERDAY. CHARGES HAVE NOT YET BEEN DISCLOSED.

ALL KURDISH PROGRAMS AIRED ON THE KERMANSHAB AND QASR SHIRIN RADIO STATIONS HAVE BEEN DISCONTINUED ON ORDERS FROM NIRT HEAD QOTBZADEH. THE RADIO PROGRAMS BEGAN ABOUT A YEAR AGO, AND BROADCASTS NORMALLY RAN ABOUT NINE HOURS A DAY.

A THREE-MEMBER INDIAN DELEGATION LED BY ASHOK MEHTA ARRIVED IN TEHRAN YESTERDAY AND PAID AN OFFICIAL GOOD-WILL CALL ON PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN. THE DELEGATION IS EXPECTED TO VISIT KHOMEINI IN QUOM TODAY.
ACCORDING TO PLO REPRESENTATIVE ABU JAFAR, WHO IS CURRENTLY ON A VISIT TO AHVAZ, THE PLO WILL OPEN AN OFFICE THERE SHORTLY.

PRESS REPORTS ON MATINE-DAFTARY'S MARCH 11 SPEECH AT A WOMEN'S RALLY AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY HIM AS CLAIMING THE 1906 CONSTITUTIONAL MOVEMENT WAS A FAILURE BECAUSE ITS SUPPORTERS WERE DISARMED TOO SOON, AND BECAUSE REACTIONARIES GAINED CONTROL. IN OTHER COMMENTS, THE NATIONAL DEMOCRATIC FRONT LEADER PROTESTED PROPOSALS TO SEPARATE MEN AND WOMEN IN SPORTS, THE UNFAIRNESS OF NIRT IN NOT LETTING THE OPPOSITION EXPRESS ITS VIEWS.

(U) THERE FOLLOWS BELOW OFFICIAL MFA PRESS RELEASE, WHICH HAS BEEN UNOFFICIALLY TRANSLATED BY EMBASSY FROM THE PERSIAN. THIS STATEMENT, THOUGH COUCHED ONLY IN TERMS OF IRANIAN MFA, WAS OFFICIALLY APPROVED BY GOI ACCORDING TO MFA AMERICA DEPT HEAD.

(C) ADDRESSEES SHOULD NOTE, HOWEVER, THAT FORMAL NOTICE OF SIX MONTHS IS REQUIRED PRIOR TO WITHDRAWAL BECOMING FINAL ACCORDING TO ARTICLE 7 OF THE TREATY. (AGHA SHAHI'S ANNOUNCEMENT MENTIONS THAT TECHNICALITY). MFA LEGAL DEPT HEAD TELLS US HE IS NOT AWARE THAT ANY ACTION HAS YET BEEN TAKEN TO INITIATE THIS NOTICE THROUGH DIPLOMATIC CHANNELS. IRANIAN ANNOUNCEMENT, UNLIKE THE PAKISTANI, DOES NOT SPECIFY THAT SIX MONTHS IS TO BEGIN ON SAME DAY, MARCH 13, NOR DOES IT STATE THAT IRAN'S PARTNERS HAVE BEEN NOTIFIED.

(C) REFERENCE IN MFA ANNOUNCEMENT TO "SAADABAD TREATY" CONCERNS JOINT DEFENSE AGREEMENT OF JULY 8, 1937, AMONG IRAN, IRAQ, TURKEY, AND AFGHANISTAN. IRANIANS REMEMBER THAT THEIR TREATY PARTNERS DID NOT COME TO THEIR ASSISTANCE WHEN IRAN WAS INVADED BY ALLIED FORCED IN 1941. THAT IS THE POLITICAL MESSAGE OF MFA ANNOUNCEMENT.

(U) MFA ANNOUNCEMENT ROUGHLY AS FOLLOWS: : THE PROVISIONAL ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY GOVERNMENT OF IRAN IN PRINCIPLE CONSIDERS THE CENTO A PACT COMPARABLE AND SIMILAR TO THE SAADABAD TREATY. IT IS COMMON KNOWLEDGE THAT THE SAADABAD TREATY PROVED IN ITS DAY THAT IT ONLY SERVED THE INTERESTS OF EMPIRES WHOSE SOLE INTENTION WAS THE COLONIZATION AND EXPLOITATION OF THE PEOPLES OF THE REGION AND THE RESOURCES OF THEIR COUNTRIES. HISTORY CAME TO PROVE THAT AT A TIME WHEN THE SAADABAD TREATY COULD HAVE TAKEN A STEP TOWARD THE PROTECTION OF THE ALLIED SIGNATORY GOVERNMENTS, IT STAYED SILENT AND INEFFECTIVE AND THE WORLD WITNESSED THE FATE THAT BEFELL ITS MEMBER COUNTRIES.

THE CENTO TOO, WHICH HAS BEEN DEVISED IN ITS OWN DAY FOR THE SAME PURPOSES AND MOTIVES, PROVED THAT IT HAS FAILED TO PROVIDE AN EFFECTIVE AND RELIABLE GUARANTEE FOR THE REGIONAL MEMBER COUNTRIES AND LIKE THE SAADABAD TREATY IT ONLY HAS REPRESENTED THE INTERESTS OF THE SUPER POWERS. IT IS FOR THIS REASON THAT IN THE VIEW OF THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS, THE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN CANNOT STAY COMMITTED TO THE PROVISIONS OF AN AGREEMENT WHICH DOES NOT SERVE AND PROTECT THE INTERESTS OF THE PEOPLE OF IRAN AND ITS CO-SIGNATORIES, BUT IS ORIENTED IN A DIRECTION TO THE DISADVANTAGE AND DETRIMENT OF THE PEOPLE OF THIS REGION.

OUR ESTEEMED CO-SIGNATORY PAKISTAN ALSO EXPRESSES VIEWS SIMILAR TO THE ABOVE AND IS RESOLUTELY OF THE OPINION THAT THE PROVISIONS OF THE CENTRAL TREATY HAVE BEEN UNABLE OR UNWILLING TO SOLVE THE PROBLEMS WHICH HAVE ARISEN FOR PAKISTAN EVER SINCE ITS INDEPENDENCE BUT HAVE CAUSED PAKISTAN TO FACE GRAVE INTERNATIONAL THREATS.

IN CONTRAST, HOWEVER, THE PROVISIONAL ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY GOVERNMENT OF IRAN WILL STAND BY ECONOMIC AND SOCIAL COOPERATION WITH THE OTHER ALLIES OF THE REGIONAL COOPERATION FOR DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT AND WILL WORK FOR JOINT ACTIVITIES WITH THEM IN ECONOMIC, CULTURAL AND SOCIAL AFFAIRS, FREE FROM ANY INTERVENTION BY THE SUPERPOWERS, AND EVEN GOING FURTHER IN PURSUING THIS IDEAL IT EXTENDS ITS HAND TO OTHER NEIGHBORING COUNTRIES OF THE REGION AND SINCERELY INVITES THEM TO JOIN IN THE COMMITMENT FOR THIS ECONOMIC-CULTURAL-SOCIAL COOPERATION.

THE REVOLUTIONARY GOVERNMENT OF IRAN BELIEVES IN TAKING EVERY STEP TOWARD THE EXPANSION OF THIS ECONOMIC-CULTURAL-SOCIAL COOPERATION AND SINCERELY MAINTAINS THAT IN THIS WAY IT CAN SERVE REGIONAL PEACE AND INTERNATIONAL EXCHANGES ALL THE BETTER. UNQUOTE.

1979TEHRAN02952.subject: IRANIAN REPRESENTATION IN THE UNITED STATES

segments.text: C - ENTIRE TEXT.

DURING CALL AT MFA MARCH 13 BY POL COUNSELOR AND HIS DEPUTY, FONMIN'S ASSISTANT DR. FARRAJ ARDALAN CONFIDED THAT ROUHANI WOULD BE RECALLED TO IRAN SOON. ROUHANI'S NAME CAME UP IN CONTEXT OF SHORT DISCUSSION WITH NEWLYNOMINATED IRANIAN CHARGE D'AFFAIRES FOR U.S., HASSAN ETESSAN. POL COUNSELOR SUGGESTED TO ETESSAM (WHO HAS HAD LONG SERVICE IN UK AND TOOK OVER THE FIRST POLITICAL DIVISION COVERING ARAB COUNTRIES OF THE GULF IN MFA A FEW MONTHS AGO) THAT HE WOULD BE WISE TO SEEK AN EARLY BRIEFING ON STATUS OF MILITARY PROPERTY AGREEMENTS AND IRANIAN TRUST FUND RELATED THERETO.

HE NOTED THAT SUCH A BRIEFING HAD BEEN PROVIDED A FEW DAYS AGO TO ROUHANI AND PRESENT CHARGE FAGHIH, BUT APPARENTLY NO REPORT HAD YET REACHED EITHER MINISTRY OF NATIONAL DEFENSE OR MFA HERE. ETESSAM EXPRESSED GRATITUDE FOR THIS TIP AND NOTED PRECHT'S NAME AS FIRST POINT OF CONTACT.

AS DEPARTMENT IS AWARE FROM OTHER REPORTS, SANJABI HAS REPORTEDLY SUBMITTED HIS RESIGNATION AND IS STAYING HOME "SICK". HE HAS NOT YET SEEN INDIAN MISSION WHICH ARRIVED AS SCHEDULEDD YESTERDAY, MARCH 13, AND VISITED BAZARGAN. ONE OF THE TWO MAIN REASONS FOR SANJABI'S RESIGNATION IS SUPPOSED TO BE HIS OBJECTION TO ROUHANI'S ACTIVITIES IN THE U.S. AS MORE OR LESS PERSONAL REPRESENTATIVE OF YAZDI (WHO WAS, HIMSELF, AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI'S PERSONAL REPRESENTATIVE IN THE U.S. DURING HIS YEARS OF EXILE). THUS, WHETHER OR NOT ROUHANI IS RECALLED PROBABLY DEPENDS ON THE OUTCOME OF THE MINI POWER STRUGGLE BETWEEN SANJABI AND YAZDI.
WHILE SANJABI HAS PRECEDENT AND NORMAL PRACTICE ON HIS SIDE, YAZDI IS FAR STRONGER IN THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT AND PRESENT GOVERNMENT. ROUHANI MAY THEREFORE NOT BE RECALLED FOR SOME TIME, IF AT ALL.
BIO DATA: ETESSAM WAS BORN IN BOJNURD, IRAN, IN 1926. DURING HIS TOUR OF DUTY IN THE UK, HE SERVED BOTH IN LONDON AND AS CONSUL GENERAL IN MANCHESTER.

SUMMARY: REVOLUTIONARY COURTS CONTINUE TO HAND DOWN DEATH SENTENCES, WITH THREE CARRIED OUT MARCH 13 BEING BASED WHOLLY ON POLITICAL GROUNDS. DENIAL TO DUE PROCESS HAS REACHED A PAR WITH THE WORST HUMAN RIGHTS VIOLATIONS UNDER THE SHAH. THE DESIRE FOR VENGEANCE AMONG THOSE WHO SUFFERED AT THE HANDS OF THE FORMER REGIME UNDERLIES, AT LEAST IN PART, THE CURRENT WAVE OF BARBARITY. BOTH THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT AND IRANIAN HUMAN RIGHTS ACTIVISTS ARE AWARE OF THE PROBLEM, BUT THERE IS LITTLE LIKELIHOOD OF A CHANGE FOR THE BETTER ANY TIME SOON. END SUMMARY.

ELEVEN FIGURES ASSOCIATED WITH THE SHAH'S RULE WERE EXECUTED IN TEHRAN MARCH 13. A TWELFTH MAN, A RELATIVELY LOW-RANKING POLICE OFFICER, WAS EXECUTED IN QOM THE SAME DAY. AMONG THE ELEVEN WHO FACED THE FIRING SQUAD IN TEHRAN WERE THREE INDIVIDUALS WHOSE "CRIMES" WERE WHOLLY POLITICAL. MAHMOUD JAFARIAN WAS THE HEAD OF THE PARS NEWS AGENCY AND DEPUTY DIRECTOR OF THE NATIONAL IRANIAN RADIO AND TELEVISION (NIRT) ORGANIZATION UNDER THE PAHLAVI REGIME. HE ALSO HELD AN IMPORTANT POSITION IN WHAT WAS ONCE THE SINGLE LEGAL POLITICAL PARTY, THE RASTAKHIZ, AND REPUTEDLY SERVED AS ITS CHIEF THEORITICIAN.

HE WAS ACCUSED OF RESPONSIBILITY FOR CENSORSHIP OF NEWS COVERAGE OF THE EVENTS THAT EVENTUALLY LED TO THE FALL OF THE PAHLAVI DYNASTY. PARVIZ NIKKAH'S CRIME WAS TO WRITE (WITH OFFICIAL ENCOURAGEMENT) AN ARTICLE CRITICAL OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI THAT, FOLLOWING ITS PUBLICATION EARLY LAST YEAR, LED TO A DEMONSTRATION IN QOM DURING WHICH SEVERAL PEOPLE WERE KILLED. GHOLAM HOSSEIN DANESHI WAS A MUSLIM CLERGYMAN WHO SERVED IN THE LAST MAJLES AND WAS AN OUTSPOKEN SUPPORT OF THE SHAH, THE LATTER BEING THE OFFENSE HE WAS REPORTEDLY CHARGED WITH AND OF WHICH HE WAS CONVICTED.

WITH THESE THREE EXECUTIONS IN PARTICULAR, REVOLUTIONARY JUSTICE HAS FALLEN TO A NEW LOW THAT RATES COMPARISON WITH THE WORST VIOLATIONS OF HUMAN RIGHTS UNDER THE SHAH. ACCORDING TO A SOURCE CLOSE TO THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE STRUCTURE, A PARTIAL EXPLANATION FOR THE CURRENT BARBARITY LIES IN THE FACT THAT ALMOST ALL THE CLERGYMEN RESPONSIBLE FOR THE TRIALS OF FORMER GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS AND MILITARY AND POLICE OFFICER WHICH HAVE TAKEN PLACE WERE ARRESTED AND ABUSED THEMSELVES AT ONE TIME OR ANOTHER. THUS, THEIR ATTITUDE NOW GENERALLY IS ONE OF VENGEANCE. THEY CARE NOT AT ALL--INDEED KNOW ALMOST NOTHING AT ALL--ABOUT INTERNATIONAL SENSITIVITIES TO MATTERS OF JUSTICE AND DUE PROCESS.
FOR THE SAME REASON, THEY ARE NOT CONCERNED ABOUT ARBITRARY ARRESTS AND DETENTION WITHOUT CHARGE OR ACCESS TO COUNSEL THAT ARE ROUTINELY CARRIED OUT BY REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTESS.

THERE ARE IRANIANS WHO CARE ABOUT LEGAL NICETIES, HOWEVER, INCLUDING PM BAZARGAN WHO IS A CHARTER MEMBER OF THE COMMITTEE FOR THE DEFENSE OF HUMAN RIGHTS AND FREEDOM (CDHRF), AND IS THUS ACUTELY EMBARRASSED BY THE MANNER IN WHICH REVOLUTIONARY JUSTICE HAS BEEN CARRIED OUT. THE MARCH 14 PRESS REPORTED THAT THE MINISTRY OF JUSTICE HAS BEEN INSTRUCTED TO CONDUCT AN INSPECTION OF PRISON CONDITIONS ALONG WITH MEMBERS OF THE CDHRF AND AN INTERNATIONAL RED CROSS TEAM NOW VISITING IRAN.

ACCORDING TO ONE FARSI-LANGUAGE PAPER, ON MARCH 13 A TEAM FROM THE ICRC VISITED THREE TEHRAN PENAL FACILITIES, INCLUDING QASR, WHERE THEY WERE GIVEN TWO HUNDRED LETTERS BY PRISONERS THAT THEY HAD THERETOFORE BEEN UNABLE TO MAIL. A LEADING LAWYER AND CDHRF MEMBER, KARIM LAHIJI, WAS REPUTEDLY SCHEDULED TO VISIT QASR MARCH 14.

DESPITE OFFICIAL CONCERN ABOUT THE ADMINISTRATION OF REVOLUTIONARY JUSTICE, HOWEVER, IT DOES NOT SEEM LIKELY THAT THERE WILL BE A CHANGE FOR THE BETTER ANY TIME SOON. THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT IS ALMOST POWERLESS TO PREVENT THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES FROM SETTLING OLD SCORES SINCE BOTH THE POLICE AND GENDARMERIE REMAIN IN A STATE OF ALMOST TOTAL PARALYSIS. WORSE YET, THE TREND IN EXECUTIONS IS PARTICULAR HAS GROWN PROGRESSIVELY MORE OMINOUS. AT FIRST, INDIVIDUALS WITH LARGELY SYMBOLIC SIGNIFICANCE SUCH AS FORMER SAVAK CHIEF NASSIRI WERE THE OBJECTS OF REVOLUTIONARY RETRIBUTION. BUT NOW, ANYONE TOWARD WHOM A REVOLUTIONARY MIGHT BEAR A GRUDGE MAY BECOME A VICTIM.

INDEED, WITH THE GROWING REALIZATION THAT THE FALL OF THE PAHLAVIS HAS NOT BROUGHT INSTANT MILLENIUM, DISAPPOINTED REVOLUTIONARIES ARE APT TO BE INCREASINGLY TEMPTED TO STRIKE OUT AT REAL OR IMAGINED ENEMIES AS BEING RESPONSIBLE FOR THEIR CONTINUED FRUSTRATION.

1979TEHRAN02974.subject: THE KURDS ARE COMING! THE KURDS ARE COMING! (AND SO ARE THE TURKOMEN!)

segments.text: ARE THE TURKOMEN*) C- ENTIRE TEXT

SUMMARY: POLOFF TOMSETH MET MARCH 13 WITH FORMER MAJLES MEMBER HEDAYATOLLAH ESLAMINIA WHO PROPOSED THAT THE U.S. BACK (AND PERHAPS FINANCE) A PROJECT TO ARM SEVERAL OF IRAN'S ETHNIC MINORITIES FOR THE PURPOSE OF ENCIRCLING AND ULTIMATELY CAPTURING THE CAPITAL. THIS, ESLIMINIA ARGUED, WOULD PAVE THE WAY FOR RESTORATION OF A STABLE AND FRIENDLY GOVERNMENT IN TEHRAN. END SUMMARY.

ESLAMINIA BEGAN THE CONVERSATION BY SAYING THAT TIME IS RAPIDLY RUNNING OUT FOR THOSE IRANIANS WHO DO NOT WANT THEIR COUNTRY TO FALL INTO THE HANDS OF THE COMMUNISTS. THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT IS ALMOST TOTALLY INEFFECTUAL, KHOMEINI IS OBSESSED WITH A DESIRE FOR REVENGE AND HIS VISION OF A NARROWLY THEOCRATIC ISLAMIC REPUBLIC, AND THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES ARE RESPONSIBLE TO NO ONE BUT THEMSELVES. A YEAR AGO THERE WERE PERHAPS 7,000 RADICALS IN IRANIAN JAILS, WITH ANOTHER 15,000 OR SO IN EXILE IN EUROPE AND THE SAVAK WAS FUNCTIONING, AS WERE THE MILITARY AND POLICE UNDERCOVER AGENCIES.

TODAY, THE LATTER HAVE COLLAPSED AND THE RADICALS HAVE BEEN FREED OR HAVE RETURNED HOME. EVEN SO, ESLAMINIA, SAID, THEIR NUMBERS WERE NOT GREAT. LIKE MICE STILL NIBBLING AT THE DOOR, THEY COULD BE CONTAINED. BUT, HE ADDED, IF THEY WERE TO GET INTO THE HOUSE, IT WOULD BE MUCH HARDER TO EXTERMINATE THEM.

THE U.S., HE CONTINUED, SHOULD NOT BELIEVE THAT ALL IRANIANS ARE BLIND FOLLOWERS OF KHOMEINI. YES, HE ADMITTED, HE HAD BEEN A FOCAL POINT AROUND WHICH ALL THOSE OPPOSED TO THE SHAH COULD RALLY, BUT, HE CLAIMED, MANY CLERGYMEN, INCLUDING AYATOLLAHS SHARIAT-MADARI, QOMI, AND SHIRAZI, ALL OF WHOM ESLAMINIA IS PERSONALLY WELL ACQUAINTED WITH, DISAGREE WITH KHOMEINI ON A WIDE VARIETY OF POLICY MATTERS. HOW, ESLAMINIA ASKED, CAN IRAN FUNCTION IF BANKS ARE NOT ALLOWED TO CHARGE INTEREST ON LOANS? WHAT THINKING WOMAN IS GOING TO RESUME THE VEIL JUST BECAUSE "AGHA" SAYS IT IS PROPER ISLAMIC DRESS?

HAD NOT THE PRICE OF MEAT TRIPLED IMMEDIATELY FOLLOWING THE IMAN'S DECLARATION THAT THE FROZEN VARIETY IS "HARAM?" KHOMEINI MAY NOT UNDERSTAND THESE MATTERS, BUT ESLAMINIA'S CLERGYMEN FRIENDS, AS WELL AS MANY OTHER IRANIANS, DO. EVEN MEMBERS OF THE GOVERNMENT KHOMEINI APPOINTED, ESLAMINIA CLAIMED, HAVE GRAVE RESERVATIONS ABOUT THE ROLE KHOMEINI HAS BEEN PLAYING DURING THE LAST FEW WEEKS.

CITING GHARANI, WITH WHOM HE HAD MET FOR THREE HOURS JUST THE PREVIOUS EVENING, ESLAMINIA INTIMATED THAT HE KNEW FROM THE GENERAL HIMSELF THAT HE WOULD BE PREPARED TO STAGE A COUP TO PUT AN END TO THE CURRENT NONSENSE IF HE COULD ONLY PUT ENOUGH TROOPS TOGETHER TO PULL IT OFF.

ESLAMINIA SAID THAT HE ANTICIPATED A MAJOR CRISIS WITHIN THE NEXT THREE WEEKS. HE BASED THIS ASSESSMENT ON THE FACT THAT THE IMPACT OF INDUSTRY STILL BEING LARGELY IDLE AND OVER THREE MILLION IRANIANS BEING OUT OF WORK WILL ONLY REALLY BEGIN TO BE FELT AFTER NOW RUZ WHEN IRANIANS START RUNNING OUT OF MONEY ON A MASSIVE SCALE.

THAT WILL IMMEDIATELY PUT TREMENDOUS PRESSURE ON THE GOVERNMENT, WHICH WILL BE INCAPABLE OF DOING ANYTHING ABOUT THE SITUATION, AND WILL PROVIDE AN OPPORTUNITY FOR THE RADICALS, WHO WILL BE ABLE ON THE BASIS OF PROMISES ALONE TO ENLIST BROAD SUPPORT AMONG THE URBAN MASSES WHICH THEY HAVE HERETOFORE LACKED, TO MAKE A BID FOR POWER.

ESLAMINIA CLAIMED TO KNOW A WAY TO FORESTALL THIS GLOOMY SCENARIO. HE NOTED THAT A NUMBER OF ETHNIC MINORITIES HAVE ALREADY GROWN RESTLESS. HE SAID THAT HE HIMSELF HAS GREAT INFLUENCE AMONG THE KURDS AND AZARBAIJANI TURKS. MOREOVER, HE WAS CONFIDENT THAT THE TURKOMEN OF NORTHEASTERN IRAN COULD QUITE EASILY BE ENLISTED TO SUPPORT HIS CAUSE. ALL THAT WOULD BE REQUIRED WOULD BE A LITTLE MONEY (1.5 MILLION DOLLARS, HE ESTIMATED) TO BUY WEAPONS AND FODDER FOR THE TRIBESMEN'S HORSES. ONCE ARMED AND PROVISIONED, THESE PEOPLE WOULD QUICKLY TAKE CONTROL OF KEY FRONTIER AREAS AND THEREAFTER ENCIRCLE THE CAPITAL.
WHEN IT BECAME APPARENT IN TEHRAN THAT THE RADICALS WOULD NOT BE ABLE TO DELIVER ON THEIR PROMISES, THE URBAN MASSES, TIRED OF REVOLUTION, WOULD QUICKLY RALLY TO ESLAMINIA'S STANDARD.

ESLAMINIA CONCLUDED BY SAYING THAT HIS PLAN WOULD LEAD TO A RESTORATION OF STABLE AND FRIENDLY GOVERNMENT IN IRAN. HE AND HIS FOLLOWERS WERE JUST WAITING FOR A SIGN FROM THE U.S. TO IMPLEMENT IT. HE COULD SEE NO REASON WHY WE SHOULD HESITATE TO GIVE IT. AFTER ALL, HE SAID, IT HAD BEEN THE PRESIDENT'S PRESSURE ON THE SHAH TO EXTEND A GREATER DEGREE OF HUMAN RIGHTS TO THE IRANIAN PEOPLE THAT HAD LED TO HIS ULTIMATE DOWNFALL. HAVING GOTTEN RID OF HIM, THE GOAL OF GREATER HUMAN RIGHTS REMAINED TO BE ACHIEVED.

ESLAMINIA COULD NOT RESIST ASKING IF WE WERE SATISFIED WITH THE CURRENT HUMAN RIGHTS SITUATION IN IRAN. HE WAS CONVINCED, HE SAID THAT IF HE COULD JUST PUT HIS PLAN TO AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN, HE WOULD SEE ITS MERIT AND GIVE THE SIGN THE IRANIAN PEOPLE ARE LOOKING FOR.

COMMENT: AS PREPOSTEROUS AS ESLAMINIA'S PROPOSAL SEEMS, IT REPRESENTS THE DESPERATE THINKING THAT MAY BECOME MORE PREVALENT IN THIS COUNTRY. IRAN DOES INDEED APPEAR TO BE TEETERING ON THE BRINK OF TOTAL COLLAPSE. FOR THE MOMENT, REAL POLITICAL POWER HAS BEEN REDUCED ALMOST EVERYWHERE TO ITS LOWEST COMMON DENOMINATOR, I.E., LOYALTIES BASED ON FAMILY, THE NEIGHBORHOOD MOSQUE, ETHNIC IDENTITY, ORGANIZATIONAL AFFILIATION, ETC. IT IS FROM THESE LOYALTIES THAT A NEW FRAMEWORK FOR NATIONAL GOVERNMENT WILL HAVE TO BE FORGED, WHETHER BY CONSENSUS OR FORCE OF ARMS.

THE KURDS AND TURKOMEN SWEEPING DOWN ON HORSEBACK ON TEHRAN MAY SOUND FARFETCHED, BUT, BECAUSE OF THE GENERAL DISINTEGRATION OF IRANIAN SOCIETY, MAY REPRESENT A SCENARIO THAT IS WITHIN THE REALM OF FUTURE REALITY. IF IT SHOULD OCCUR, HOWEVER, IT WOULD DOUBTLESS SIGNAL THE END OF IRAN AS AN INTEGRATED MODERN NATION-STATE.

1979TEHRAN02976.subject: POSSIBLE TRANSFER OF U.S. SUPPLIED ARMS TO PLO

segments.text: (S - ENTIRE TEXT.)

WE HAVE NO RPT NO REPORTS TO CONFIRM INFORMATION UNDER REFERENCE AND ARE INCLINED TO BE SKEPTICAL CONCERNING ITS ACCURACY. HOWEVER, IF AN EGYPTIAN-ISRAELI PEACE TREATY ACTUALLY MATERIALIZES, IT IS POSSIBLE THAT PLO PRESSURES FOR WEAPONS FROM IRAN WILL INCREASE.

ACCORDINGLY, WE SEE SOME MERIT IN REMINDING CURRENT GOVERNMENT OF AGREEMENTS WITH U.S. CONCERNING TRANSFER OF MILITARY EQUIPMENT. WE WILL SEEK OPPORTUNITY TO DO SO NOT ONLY WITH FOREIGN MINISTRY, BUT ALSO WITH MINISTRY OF DEFENCE, WHICH MAY HAVE GREATER INTRINSIC INTEREST IN PRESERVING INTEGRITY OF THESE AGREEMENTS.

1979TEHRAN02978.subject: CHARGE LINKING TIME MAGAZINE WITH PAHLAVIS, DANIALS

segments.text: AT PRESS CONFERENCE DAY AFTER REPORTS APPEARED OF JAMES BILL'S COMMENTS ON DEPUTY PMS ENTEZAM AND YAZDI AT SEMINAR SPONSORED BY TIME MAGAZINE, ENTEZAM ACCUSED TIME OF RECEIVING BRIBES FROM SHAH. ENTEZAM CHARACTERIZED SEMINAR AT WHICH BILL MADE REMARKS AS MORE OF THE SAME. TIME CORRESPONDENT PRESENT IMMEDIATELY REJECTED CHARGE AS BASELESS. FORMAL DENIAL BY TIME, INC. VICE PRESIDENT DON WILSON, DENYING TIME RECEIVED ANY SECRET PAYMENTS FROM SHAH OR GOI, APPEARED IN PRESS FOLLOWING DAY.

ALTHOUGH TIME MAGAZINE MAY NOT HAVE RECEIVED "SECRET" PAYMENTS FROM SHAH OR GOI, TIME LIFE BOOKS HAVE BEEN ACTIVE IN IRAN, HAVE BEEN INVOLVED IN PBULICATION OF SEVERAL BOOKS ON SHAH AND PAHLAVIS (PRESUMABLY FOR A CONSIDERATION), AND ARE INVOLVED IN IRANIAN TEXTBOOK PUBLISHING HOUSE "DANESH-E-NOW" WHICH HAD PAHLAVI BACKING. THERE MAY INDEED BE CANCELLED CHECKS SHOWING THAT TIME RECEIVED PAYMENTS FROMPAHLAVIS IN
