SUMMARY: KHOMEINI INTIMATE PROVIDES FASCINATING DETAILS ABOUT KHOMEINI'S ENTOURAGE, GOVERNMENT PLANS, AND OTHER MATTERS. END SUMMARY.

ON MARCH 13 EMBOFFS LAMBRAKIS, TOMSETH AND SCHELL HAD LUNCH WITH MEHDI ROWGHANI, SON OF THE MAN WHO ALLOWED KHOMEINI TO STAY AS HIS GUEST FOR ABOUT FIVE MONTHS JUST PRIOR TO EXILE FIFTEEN YEARS AGO. MEHDI HIMSELF HAS BEEN PLAYING AN INCREASINGLY ACTIVE ROLE MEDIATING TO SOME EXTENT BETWEEN THE COMMITTEES AND THE GOVERNMENT AND ALSO TRYING TO ADVISE THE AYATOLLAH DIRECTLY OR INDIRECTLY. THE FOLLOWING ITEMS ARE IN MOST CASES PRETTY RELIABLE, WE BELIEVE, AND TAINTED ONLY IN PART BY THE USUAL IRANIAN TENDENCY TO EXAGGERATE ONE'S OWN KNOWLEDGE.

ROWGHANI SAID HIS FATHER AND HE HAD RECENTLY HOSTED MRS. KHOMEINI FOR SEVERAL HOURS AND THOUGHT THEY HAD GOTTEN OVER THE POINT THAT KHOMEINI SHOULD MAKE FEWER UNILATERAL ANNOUNCEMENTS SUCH AS THE RECENT ONES REGARDING WOMEN WEARING THE VEIL OR THE BOYCOTT OF FROZEN MEATS, AND LEAVE SUCH MATTER TO THE GOVERNMENT. MEHDI SAID MRS. KHOMEINI IS AN EXTREMELY BRIGHT AND EFFECTIVE PERSON AND HAS GREAT INFLUENCE ON HER HUSBAND. SHE IS PROBABLY FIFTEEN OR MORE YEARS YOUNGER AND LOOKS NO OLDER THAN IN HER FIFTIES.

ROWGHANI HIMSELF IS GOING TO QOM IN A FEW DAYS TO SEE THE AYATOLLAH. HE HOPES TO PERSUADE THE AYATOLLAH TO DO TWO THINGS: ONE, APPOINT SEVERAL ADVISORS WHO WILL STAY WITH HIM AND WHOM HE WILL CONSULT ABOUT EVENTS BEFORE ISSUING STATEMENTS AND, TWO, RELEASE FORMER SAVAK CHIEF, GENERAL MOGHADDAM. ROWGHANI SAID MOGHADDAM IS A KEY PERSON TO HELP THE ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT COMBAT LEFTISTS. SAVAK FILES ARE LARGELY INTACT AND HAVE NOT YET BEEN GLEANED. MOGHADDAM WILL BE INVALUABLE IN GETTING THE RIGHT INFORMATION TO THE GOVERNMENT AND ISLAMIC MOVEMENT.

(COMMENT: ROWGHANI'S INFORMATION IS CONTRADICTED BY REPORTS WE HAVE HAD THROUGH OTHER CHANNELS THAT ISLAMIC COMMITTES ARE ALREADY GOING THROUGH SAVAK FILES VERY EARNESTLY.) ROWGHANI ADMITTED THAT RELEASE OF MOGHADDAM COULD CAUSE KHOMEINI PROBLEMS BUT HOPED THE AYATOLLAH COULD FIND A WAY TO DO THIS. RESPONDING TO EARLIER SUGGESTIONS FROM ROWGHANI'S FATHER, AYATOLLAH HAD ALREADY SENT MESSENGERS TO MOGHADDAM TO GET THIS INFORMATION, BUT MOGHADDAM REFUSED TO TALK TO ANYONE BUT KHOMEINI HIMSELF.

ROWGHANI THOUGHT MOGHADDAM WISE TO AVOID INTERMEDIARIES. EVEN KHOMEINI'S SON IS NOT CONSIDERED RELIABLE, AS OPPOSED TO THE GRANDSON (SON OF KHOMEINI'S FIRSTBORN, WHO DIED MYSTERIOUSLY A LITTLE OVER A YEAR AGO, THE AYATOLLAH BELIEVES, BY BEING POISONED ON SAVAK ORDERS). COMMUNISTS AND OTHER LEFTISTS HAVE INFILTRATED THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES, AND ROWGHANI ESTIMATED THERE ARE PROBABLY ABOUT ONE THOUSAND OF THEM AMONG THE MULLAHS. THEY HAVE BEEN SPECIALLY TRAINED AND ARE LYING LOW FOR THE MOMENT. POL COUNSELOR INTERJECTED THAT HE HAD HEARD SUCH CHARGES FREQUENTLY, BUT NEVER BEFORE FROM A SOURCE SO CLOSE TO KHOMEINI AND HAD THRREFORE TENDED TO DISCOUNT THEM. ROWTHANI INSISTED HIS INFORMATION WAS ACCURATE.
HE SAID THEY THEY EVEN HAD THE PAYMASTER (WHOM HE REFUSED TO IDENTIFY FURTHER) NOW IN PRISON. HE HAD NOT BEEN EXECUTED YET BECAUSE THEY HOPED TO EXTRACT MORE INFORMATION FROM HIM.

TURNING TO OTHER MATTERS, ROWGHANI SIAD THE TOP COMMANDD UNDER KHOMEINI CONSISTS OF THREE AYATOLLASHS: MONTAZERI, MOTAHARI AND RABANI-SHIRAZI. KHOMEINI SERIOUSLY DESIRES TO WITHDRAW FROM GOVERNMENT AND MOVE TO QOM, PRECISELY SO THAT PEOPLE WOULD COME LESS TO HIM FOR DECISIONS AND MORE TO THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT. HE HOPED TO SPEND HIS TIME SPREADING HIS TEACHING AS WIDELY AS POSSIBLE BEFORE HE DIES, AND IN PARTICULAR, IN PREPARING A SUCCESSOR TO ACT AS CHIEF OF THE SHI'A ISLAMIC WORLD. THIS SUCCESSOR FOR THE MOMENT APPEARS TO BE MONTAZERI. ONE HEARS LITTLE ABOUT HIM BECAUSE HE IS LYING LOW, BUT HE IS A VERY INTELLIGENT, ABLE AYATOLLAH.

ROWGHANI ALSO HAD WORDS OF GREAT PRAISE FOR MOHAMMAD BEHESHTI, WHO IS VERY CLOSE TO KHOMEINI. HE SAID BEHESHTI IS TRULY ENGLIGHTENED, LEVEL-HEADED, AND KNOWS HOW TO DEAL WITH TODAY'S IRAN BETTER THAN MOST OTHER AYATOLLAHS. HE OFFERED TO ARRANGE A MEETING OF EMBOFFS WITH BEHESHTI, IF THE LATTER WISHED IT, SINCE HE HAS NOW RETURNED TO TEHRAN FROM QOM.

ASKED ABOUT MEMBERSHIP IN KHOMEINI'S "REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL", ROGHANI REPORTED WHAT HE HAD TOLD THE AMBASSADOR ON AN EARLIER OCCASION, TO THE EFFECT THAT THIS WAS A FLUID BODY WITH A FLOATING MEMBERSHIP FOR THE MOST PART. HE ADDED, HOWEVER, THAT AT ONE POINT THIS COUNCIL CONSISTED OF AYATOLLAH RABANI-SHIRAZI, AYATOLLAH GHODOUSI, EBRAHIM YAZDI AND THREE LAY JUDGES. THE GROUP BROKEUP WHEN KHOMEINI PROPOSED TO ADD AYATOLLAH KHALHALI. THE OTHERS CONSIDERED KHALHALI AN EXTREMIST "WHO WANTED TO SHOOT EVERYBODY". ROWGHANI SAID KHALHALI IS EXTREMELY ANTI-AMERICAN. AT PRESENT HE IS IN CHARGE OF PRISONERS ARRESTED BY THE MOVEMENT AND PERSONALLY CONDUCTS CROSS-EXAMINATIONS OF THE MOST PROMINENT AMONG THEM.

ROWGHANI READILY ADMITS THIS WAS PROBABLY ONE OF THE MAIN REASONS WHY THOSE GUARDING THE PRISONERS IN QASR PRISON AND ELSEWHERE HAVE SEVERAL TIMES REFUSED TO RELEASE MANY OF THEIR PRISONERS DESPITE ORDERS FROM KHOMEINI.

REGARDING THE ARMY, ROWGHANI OPINED THAT A DEADLINE OF MARCH 26 OR 27 HAD BEEN SET, AFTER WHICH THOSE WHO DO NOT RETURN TO THEIR UNITS WILL BE REGISTERED AS ABSENTEES. THEY WILL NOT BENEFIT FROM THE SHORTER TOUR OF DUTY FORESEEN FOR DRAFTEES IN THE FUTURE, AND MAY EVEN BE PUNISHED.THE ARMY HOPES TOOPERATE WITH WHATEVER NUMBERS THEY HAVE BY THEN. THE PLAN IS TO ISOLATE THESE TROOPS FROM ALL POLITICS, INCLUDING RADIO AND TELEVISION. THEY WILL BE TRAINED VERY HARD AND KEPT APART FOR SEVERAL MONTHS SO AS TO BECOME USEFUL INSTRUMENTS OF THE STATEONCE AGAIN.

ROWGHANI SEEMED TO KNOW VERY LITTLE ABOUT THE FORMATION OF ANY NATIONAL GUARD. HE THOUGHT THE COMMITTEE SYSTEM WOULD REMAINFOR THE FORESEEABLE FUTURE BECAUSE KHOMEINI WOULD REALLY LIKE THAT TO BE THE CASE.

ROWGHANI SAID A LIST OF PERSONS WHO WILL NOT BE PERMITTED TO LEAVE THE COUNTRY WOULD BE READY IN THE NEXT FEW DAYS. IT APPROACHED 20,000. IT INCLUDED, IN GENRAL TERMS, ALL MILITARY ABOVE THE RANK OF COLONEL FOR THE PAST 25 YEARS, ALL MINISTERS AND THEIR DEPUTIES FOR THE PAST 25 YEARS, ALL HEADS OF STATE-RUN ENTERPRISES AND THEIR DEPUTIES FOR THE PAST 25 YEARS, AND SOME FROM PRIVATE BUSINESS SUSPECTED OF CORRUPTION. CERTAIN AMONG THEM WOULD BE MARKED FOR IMMEDIATE ARREST WHEN APPREHENDED.

THE OTHERS WOULD THEN BE PUT ON NOTICE THAT THEY HAVE TO APPEAR BEFORE THE APPROPRIATE JUDICIAL AUTHORITIES AND PROVE THEY WERE GUILTY OF NO WRONGDOING. THE LIST WOULD FIRST BE GIVEN TO TEHRAN MEHRABAD AIRPORT AUTHORITIES AND THEN TO OTHER AIRPORTS IN DUE COURSE. ALL NOT ON THE LIST WOULD BE FREE TO LEAVE.

ON SPECIFICA INDIVIDUALS, ROWGHANI SAID GENERAL NAJIMI HAD BEEN ARRESTED ON THE VERY PREMISES OF THE MINISTRY OF NATIONAL DEFENSE TWELVE DAYS AGO, AND THE GOVERNMENT CANNOT GET HIM OUT OF PRISON. AMONG COMMITTEE MEMBERS IN TEHRAN, THERE IS SOMEONE NAMED KARIMI. AS TO THE MYSTERIOUS BAZARGAN DEPUTY SABAGHIAN, ROWGHANI KNEW NOTHING EXCEPT THAT HE HAD BEEN INEFFECTIVE IN GETTING COMITTEES TO RELEASE PEOPLE.

COMMENT: ROWGHANI IS VERY MUCH OF THE INNER CIRCLE BUT SEEMS LESS WELL INFORMED ON SPECIFICS AMONG THE MILITARY AND PORTIONS OF THE GOVERNMENT THAN HE IS ABOUT THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT. HE REMAINS A VALUABLE CONTACT.
(C) ENTIRE TEXT.

SUMMARY: IN A SPECIAL NOW RUZ MESSAGE, BAZARGAN WARNS CRITICS, INCLUDING KHOMEINI, TO GET OFF HIS GOVERNMENT'S BACK. HE ALSO CRITICIZES CONDUCT OF REVOLUTIONARY JUSTICE. SHARIAT-MADARI URGES PEOPLE TO JOIN THE POLITICAL PARTY OF THEIR CHOICE. KHOMEINI LASHES OUT AT FOREIGN DEVILS. FIVE MORE EXECUTED. PROSECUTION AGAINST HOVEYDA BEGINS, HUMAN RIGHTS ACTIVIST VISITS HIM IN JAIL. FORMATION OF A PARAMILITARY NATIONAL GUARD GOES FORWARD. DEFAYEEN ISSUE STATEMENT OF SUPPORT FOR PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT. MINISTRY OF INTERIOR ANNOUNCES PLANS FOR REFERENDUM. WEARING OF THE VEIL CONTINUES TO STIR CONTROVERSY. END SUMMARY.
IN A SPECIAL NOW RUZ MESSAGE DELIVERED MARCH 14, PM BAZARGAN OUTLINED THE PROBLEMS HIS GOVERNMENT HAS FACED DURING ITS MONTH IN OFFICE.

HE HE DID NOT EXEMPT EVEN THE GREATE LEADER OF THE REVOLUTION, AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, FROM CRITICISM, REFERRING TO HIM AS A "SENSITIVE, KIND AND GOODHEARTED" MAN WHO "WANTS TO HELP THE BARE-FOOTED ONES" BUT WHO IS ALL TOO OFFTEN "PERSUADED TO ISSUE PROCLAMATIONS AND ORDERS THAT PUT US ON THE SPOT." "PEOPLE TELL HIM SOMETHING." HEW SAID, "AND THE GOVERNMENT IS ORDERED TO STOP THE SALE OF FROZEN MEAT OR HELP THE DOWNTRODDEN WITH THEIR WATER, ELECTRICITY AND BUS TRAVEL." BAZARGAN CLAIMED THAT WHEN HE AND SEVERAL CABINET MEMBER VISITED KHOMEINI IN QOM LAST WEEK THEY TOLD HIM THAT IF HE WANTED THEM TO BE EFFECTIVE, HE SHOULD CONSULT WITH THEM FIRST AND THEN ISSUE HIS ORDERS.

BAZARGAN SAID THAT CRITICISM OF THE GOVERNMENT IS ALSO MOST UNHELPFUL. PEOPLE COMPLAIN TO KHOMEINI ABOUT SUCH THINGS AS THE PM'S MERCEDES-BENZ AND INSINUATE THAT GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS ARE EATING OFF GOLD PLATES AND WORKING ALONGSIDE NAKED WOMEN, HE SAID, "BUT ALL THEY ACCOMPLISH BY DOING THIS IS CAUSING PETTY PROBLEMS."

BARARGAN ALSO HIT OUT AT REVOLUTIONARY JUSTICE, CHARGING THAT SUMMARY EXECUTIONS "HAD TAINTED THE GLORY OF THE REVOLUTIONARY VICTORY." HE EXPRESSED HIS AGREEMENT WITH A FOREIGN AMBASSADOR WHO HAD POINTED OUT THAT WHEN A REVOLTIONARY MOVEMENT WHICH CLAIMS TO BE RELIGIOUSLY INSPIRED CARRIES OUT TRIALS BEHIND CLOSED DOORS THIS SORT OF JUSTICE, TOO, IS PRESUMED TO BE REIGIOUSLY INSPIRED. HE NOTED THAT THE INTERNATIONAL BODIES WHICH REPORTED ON VIOLATIONS OF HUMAN RIGHTS UNDER THE OLD REGIME HAD BEEN INSTRUMENTAL IN ITS ULTIMATE DESTRUCTION, AND NOW THESE SAME BODIES ARE PROTESTING TO HIS GOVERNMENT ABOUT THE DISGRACEFUL WAY JUSTICE IS PRESENTLY BEING CARRIED OUT.

OTHER TOPICS TOUCHED ON WERE THE STATE OF THE ECONOMY (HE CLAIMED THAT THE COUNTRY WAS BROKE) AND UREASONABLE DEMANDS FROM A VARIETY OF SPECIAL INTEREST GROUPS RANGING FROM THE RURAL POOR TO LABOR. HE NOTED THAT HIS GOVERNMENT IS MERELY A PROVISIONAL ONE, BUT THAT IN ANY EVENT IT WOULD BE IMPOSSIBLE TO ANSWER EVERYONE'S DEMANDS OVERNIGHT.

HE CHASTIZED HIS COUNTRYMENT FOR SEEING A FOREIGN CONSPIRACY AT VERY TURN. "AT THE MOMENT," HE SAID, NO"EXTERNAL DANGER THEATENS US." OTHER NATIONS ARE ALL TOO BUSY WATCHING EACH OTHER, HE SUGGESTED, TO INTERFERE IN IN IRAN'S AFFAIRS. "IF THERE'S ANYTHING IT COMES FROM INSIDE BECAUSE THERE ARE SOME WHO WANT TO RESTORE THE OLD ORDER," HE SAID. BAZARGAN STRESSED THE NEED FOR NATIONAL UNITY LEST THE NATION BE TORN ASUNDER. HE CONCLUDED BY SAYING THAT HE DID SEE SOME HOPEFULL SIGNS SUCH AS THE ISLAMIC MOJAHEDINE-KHALQ'S WILLINGNESS TO MODERATE SOME OF ITS EARLY EXTREMIST DEMANDS AND THE MARXIST FEDAYEEN-E-KHALQ'S EXPRESSION OF SUPPORT FOR HIS GOVERNMENT.

COMMENT: BAZARGAN'S PERSONAL INTEGRITY AND HIS REASONABLENESS AS EXPRESSED IN HIS MESSAGE CANNOT HELP BUT CAUSE A SENSE OF DEJA VU. IT WAS ONLY A FEW WEEKS AGO THAT BAKHTIAR WAS DEOMONSTRATING THE SAME QUALITIES-ULTIMATELY, TO NO AVAIL. END COMMENT.

SHARIAT-MADARI, TOO, CONTINUES TO BE A VOICE OF REASON, ALTHOUGH IN HIS CASE AS WELL ONE WONDERS TO WHAT EFFECT. ON MARCH 14 HE SAID THAT ALL IRANIANS SHOULD TAKE AN ACTIVE PART IN THE NATION'S AFFAIRS BY JOINING A POLITICAL PARTY OF THEIR CHOSSING. HE TOLD THE PRESS THAT IRANISANS HAVE A "NATIONAL A RELIGIOUS DUTY" TO INVOLVE THEMSELVES IN POLITICS, AND THAT THEY SHOULD USE THEIR NEW-FOUND FREEDOM TO REVIEW THE PROGRAMS OF THE VARIOUS PARTIES AND CHOOSE THE ONE THAT BEST REPRESENTS THEIR VIEWS.

AS FOR KHOMEINI, HE WARNED TELECOMMUNICATIONS WORKERS THAT "THE TRAITORS AND MURDERERS HAVE LEFT THEIR SHADOWS THAT "FOREIGN CRIMINALS AND OIL PARASITES HAVE NOT GIVEN UP YET." HE SAID THAT "IMPERIALISTS WERE WOUNDED BY THEIR LOSS OF IRAN AND WERE MUCH MORE DANGEROUS THAT BEFORE." THEIR STRATEGY NOW IS "BASED ON FOMENTING TROUBLE BETWEEN DIFFERENT GROUPS," HE SAID, AND CAUTIONED HIS AUDIENCE TO "REMAIN ALERT AND STEER CLEAR OF THE MACHINATIONS OF THE ENEMY. THEY WANT TO CREATE A REPUBLIC WHICH IS NOT ISLAMIC, A DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC, OR AN ISLAMIC DEMOCRATIC REPBULIC WITH A WESTER COLORING," HE SAID.

ON THE REVOLUTIONARY JUSTICE FRONT, FIVE MORE EXECUTIONS INVOLVING POLICE PERSONNEL, INCLUDING ONE GNERAL, IN KHUZISTAN PROVINCE WERE CARRIED OUT MARCH 14. THE PRESS ALSO REPORTED THAT THE "PRELIMINARY PROSECUTION" OF FORMER PM HOVEYDA BEGAN MARCH 13 BY THE "REVOLUTIONARY A LAWYER AND MEMBER OF THE COMMITTEE FOR THE DEFESE OF HUMAN RIGHTS AND FREEDOM, VISITED QASR PRISON ON MARCH 14. HE INTERVIEWED HOVEYDA AND SEVERAL OTHER PRISONERS, INCLUDING BUSINESSMAN RAHIM ALI KHORRAM, FORMER MINISTER OF HEALTH SHOJAEDDIN SHEIKHOLESLAMZADEH, AND HASSAN PAKRAVAN, ONETIME HEAD OF SAVAK AND MORE RECENTLY DEPUTY MINISTER OF COURT. ACCORDING TO KAYHAN INTERNATIONAL, LAHIJI REPORTED THAT ALL THE PRISONERS SAID THAT THEY HAD NOT BEEN MISTREATED.
HAVEYDA REPUTEDLY EXPRESSED SATISFACTION WITH THEY WAY PROCEEDINGS AGAINST HIM WERE BEING HANDLED, BUT HE APPARENTLY HAS NOT YET HAD ACCESS TO COUNSEL.

CREATION OF A PARAMILITARY "NATIONAL GUARD" SEEMS TO BE MAKING SOME HEADWAY. ISSUANCE OF IDENTITY CARDS TO MEMBERS BEGAN MARCH 14. THE GUARDS REPORTEDLY WILL BE UNDER THE SUPERVISION OF A COUNCIL COMPOSED OF REPRESENTATIVES OF MINISTRIES OF INTERIOR AND JUSTICE, THE ARMY AND THE CLERGY. COMMAND FUNCTIONS WILL BE EXERCISED BY A STAFF RESPONSIBLE TO DEPUTY PM IBRAHIM YAZDI. YAZDI, WHO IS EMERGING AS PERHAPS THE MOST POWERFUL FIGURE IN THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT, PRESUMABLY INTENDS TO USE THE GUARDS AS HIS OWN PRIVATE MILITIA.
THE FEDAYEES-E-KHALQ IN A LENGTHY OPEN LETTER TO THE PM MARCH 14 REITERATED THEIR SUPPORT FOR THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT BUT WARNED THAT THE POWERS OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES MUST BE CURBED.

THE FADAYEEN, THE LETTER SAID, "ARE WELL AWARE THAT ...ANY WEAKENING OF THE CENTRAL GOVERNMENT AND GIVING THE CONTROL (SIC) TO VARIOUS COMMITTEES WILL ONLY RESULT IN DIRECT CONFRONTATIONS AMONG NATIONAL MOVEMENTS AND UNWANTED CIVIL WAR." THIS, IT CONTINUED, "WILL ONLY STRENGTHEN RIGHTIST DOMINATION." WHILE BARARGAN WELCOMED THIS EXPRESSION OF SUPPORT FOR HIS GOVERNMENT IN HIS MARCH 14 NOW RUZ MESSAGE, PERHAPS ITS MAJOR SIGNIFICANCE IS THAT IT PRESUMABLY REFLECTS A FEDAYEEN ASSESSMENT THAT IT HAS MORE TO FEAR FROM THE VIGOROUS REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES THAT IT DOES FROM A WEAK AND INDFFECTUAL PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT.

THE MINISTRY OF INTERIOR HAS ANNOUNCED THAT THE MINIMUM VOTING AGE FOR THE MARCH 30 REFERENDUM WILL BE 18, NOT 16. THE MINISTRY ALSO ANNOUNCED THAT IT HAS INSTRUCTED PROVINCIAL GOVERNORS GENERAL AND DISTTRICT GOVERNORS TO SET UP, IN COOPERATION WITH LOCAL REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES, LOCAL COUNCILS TO SUPERVISE THE BALLOTING. WITH ONLY TWO WEEKS REMAINING BEFORE THE REFERENDUM IS TO BE HELD, AND GIVEN THE FACT THAT MUCH OF THAT PERIOD WILL BE LOST TO NOW RUZ VACATIONS, WE SERIOUSLY DOUBT THAT THE GOVERNMENT WILL BE ABLE TO OVERCOME ALL THE LOGISITICS PROBLEMS INVOLVED.
THE PROSPECT, THEN, IS FOR EITHER A LAST MINUTE POSTPONEMENT OR A POLL SO POORLY RUN THAT IT WILL IMMEDIATELY BECOME THE SUBJECT OF CONTROVERSY.

KHOMEINI'S REMARKS ON THE WEARING OF THE VEIL CONTINUE TO STIR CONTROVERSY. THE MOJAHEDIN HAVE ISSUED A STATEMENT SAYING THAT THERE ARE MORE IMPORTANT THINGS TO WORRY ABOUT AT THE MOMENT, AND THAT ISSUE WILL ONLY SERVE THE INTERESTS OF COUNTER-REVOLUTIONARIES WHO WILL USE IT TO CREATE CHAOS. DIRECTOR OF NIRT, SADEGH GHOTBZADEH, HAS SAID MUCH THE SAME THING, CLAIMING THAT HKOMEINI'S REMARKS WERE MISINTERPRETED. MEANWHILE, WOMEN FAVORING THE CHADOR HAVE SCHEDULED A DEMONSTRATION IN FRONT NIRT HEADQUARTERS FOR MARCH 16. SULLIVAN

IRANINA CARTAKER OF RAYTHEON PREMISES IN TEHRAN INFORMED LAMBRAKIS MORNING MARCH 16 THAT ARMED MEM OCCUPIED HIS PREMISES EVENING MARCH 15 AND ARE PREVENTING HIS ACCESS TO THEM. HE IS CONCERNED THAT PACKAGE OF CHECKS FOR PAYMENT TO SOME FORTY NATIONAL EMPLOYEES AND SOME EIGHTY OR NINETY LANDLORDS AND OTHER VENDORS ARE WITHIN THE PREMISES AND HE CANNOT GET TO THEM. HE IS SURE THESE PEOPLE WILL COVERGE ON HIS RESIDENCE ASKING TO BE PAID SOON.

CARETAKE, NAMED VALDIMIR BET-ELIVAZI, ASKED WHAT AUTHORITIES HE MIGHT TRY TO APPEAL TO. LAMBRAKIS REPLIED THE MOST EFFECTIVE WOULD PROBABLY BE DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER YAZDI, IF HE COULD GET A MESSAGE THROUGH TO HIM. HE COULD ALSO TRY TO FIND OUT WHO THE ARMED MEN REPRESENT, AND IF IT WAS A LOCAL COMMITTEE, TRY EXPLAIN THE SITUATION TO THEM. BET-EIVAZI EXPRESSED OPPINION THAT HE WAS PERHAPS BEING FOOLHARDY IN COMING FORTH AS REPRESENTATIVE OF RAYTHEON BEFORE LOCAL AUTHORITIES, BUT SAID HE WOULD DO IT ANYWAY.
HE NOTED FIRM'S LOCAL LAWYERS (SOME OF WHOM ARE AMERICAN HAVE BEEN RELUCTANT TO APPROACH LOCAL AUTHORITIES EVEN IN CONNECTION WITH BURGLARIES OF SOME RAYTHEON PREMISES BY LOCAL COMMITTEES.

THIS IS SECOND CASE WE HAVE HAD BROUGHT TO OUR ATTENTION OF LOCAL FORCES SEIZING AMERICAN COMPANIES' PREMISES. THE OTHER, MORRISON KNUDSEN, WAS REPORTED TO THE MFA MARCH 15 (SEE SEPTEL) WE EXPECT THIS TO BECOME A PATTERN, AND WILL CONTINUE TO REPORT SUCH SEIZURES TO THE MFA. AMBASSADOR ALSO PLANS RAISE THIS QUESTION NEXT TIME HE SEES PRIME

1979TEHRAN03004.subject: REQUEST FOR ASSISTANCE FROM IRANIAN MFA AUTHORITIES

segments.text: C - ENTIRE TEXT.

ON MARCH 15, POL COUNSELOR CALLED ON MFA AMERICAS DEPARTMENT HEAD GOODARZNIA TO GIVE HIM (A) A CONFIDENTIAL LETTER FROM THE AMBASSADOR FOR DEPUTY PM AMIR EXTEZAM REGARDING SECURITY OF US INTELLIGENCE SITES, (B) A PACKAGE OF LETTERS FROM VARIOUS AMERICAN COMPANIES ADDRESSED TO FORMER OFFICIALS OF THE THE MINISTRY OF NATIONAL DEFENSE, (C) AN INFORMAL LIST OF REQUIREMENTS FROM ARMISH-MAAG REGARDING THE REMOVALOF HOUSEHOLD GOODS AND ACCESS TO VARIOUS FORMER ARMISH-MAAG FACILITIES, AND (D) A DESCRIPTION OF DIFFICULTIES BEING ENCOUNTERED BY MORRISON KNUDSEN COMPANY IN GAINING ACCESS TO ITS PREMISES, AS REPORTED TO THE COMMERCIAL SECTION. GOODARZNIA ACCEPTED ALL AND SAID HE WOULD DO WHAT HE COULD.
HE HAD NOTHING NEWER TO REPORT ON THE CASE OF AMERICAN CITIZEN GENEST, WHICH HAD BEEN BROUGHT TO HIS ATTENTION MARCH 13 (REPORTED SEPTEL).

BY WAY OF ASSISTING IN FURTHER PACKING OF HOUSEHOLD GOODS, GOODARZNIA BROUGHT IN TWO MEMBERS OF THE CENTRAL TEHRAN COMMITTEE, MESSRS. RAZEHI AND FATEHI, WHO HAVE AGREED TO BE PRESENT WHEN PACKING OF HOUSEHOLD GOODS TAKES PLACE IN PRIVATE HOMES AND FACILITATE THEIR ONWARD DEPARTURE FOR THE AIRPORT, AND INDEED CLEARANCE THROUGH CUSTOMS. THEY WILL COME TO THE EMBASSY READY TO START WORK ON THE MORNING OF MARCH 17

GOODARZNIA ALSO INTRUDCED ANOTHER YOUNG MEMBER OF THE FONMIN'S OFFICE, MEHRAN DADBEH, WHO HAS OFFERED TO ASSIST WITH OUR PRACTICAL PROBLEMS. GOODARZNIA REMAINS APOLOGETIC ABOUT OUR DIFFICULTIES AND ANXIOUS TO HELP. WE SHALL SEE HOW EFFECTIVELY HE CAN ROGANIZESUCH ASSISTANCE.
C - ENTIRE TEXT.

AT A MEETING AT THE MFA ON MARCH 15 WITH HEAD OF LEGAL DEPARTMENT, EZZEDINE KAZEMI, POL COUNSELOR WAS ASKED ABOUT THE EDS EMPLOYEES WHO FLED THE COUNTRY CLANDESTINELY AFTER BEING LIBERATED FROM PRISON. KAZEMI RECALLED EMBASSY HAD ONCE OFFERED TO MAKE THE MEN AVAILABLE FOR TRIAL IF THEY WOULD BE RELEASED INTO ITS CUSTODY AND BOND REQUIREMENTS WAIVED. HE ADMITTED THIS OFFER HAD NOT BEEN ACCEPTED AND AND THE MEN REMAINED IN JAIL. NEVERTHELESS, HE ASKED IF THE EMBASSY WOULD NOT, "FOR THE SAKE OF OUR FUTURE RELATIONS", OFFER ONCE AGAIN TO PRODUCE THE MEN WHEN IRANIAN COURT ASKS FOR THEM.
IF THE USG WANTS TO PLAY "COWBOYS" THAT IS ALL RIGHT, BUT IT DOES NOT HELP OUR RELATIONSHIP, HE ADDED.

POL COUNSELOR REPLIED THAT WE COULD NOT CONSIDER RETURNING AMERICANS INTO IRANIAN CUSTODY AS LONG AS THE SECURITY CONDITIONS IN THE COUNTRY ARE AS THEY ARE. HE NOTED DIFFICULTY IRANIAN GOVERNMENT HAS IN DELIVERING ON SIMPLE REQUIREMENTS SUCH AS THOSE ON THE ARMISH-MAAG LIST HE HAD JUST GIVEN KAZEMI, WHICH REPRESENTED GOVERNMENT COMMITMENTS FROM THE PAST. HE NOTED THE MEN HAD IN EFFECT BEEN HELD HOSTAGE AGAINST PAYMENT OF SUMS THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT AUTHORITIES BELIEVED DUE THEM, AND SAID WE HAD RECEIVED WORD THAT THE AMERICAN COMPANY CONCERNED WISHES TO NEGOTIATE THIS MATTER WITH THE IRANIAN AUTHROITIES.

KAZEMI ASKED IF THE USG OR THE COMPANY WOULD BE NEGOTIATING, TO WHICH THE POL COUNSELOR REPLIED HE THOUGHT THE COMPANY. IN THAT CASE, KAZEMI SAID, IT WOULD BE MORE APPROPRIATE FOR THE COMPANY TO DISCUSS THE MATTER WITH THE IRANIAN JUDICIAL AUTHORITIES. POL COUNSELOR SAID THAT WHO REPRESENTS THE AUTHORITIES INVOLVED IN THE ORIGINAL CONTRACT WAS NOT REALLY HIS BUSINESS TO SAY, BUT THE MATTER BASICALLY CONCERNS MONEY, AND THE PEOPLE INVOLVED WOULD, HE ASSUMED, BE ABLE TO SEND DEPOSITIONS ON FACTUAL MATTERS AS NEEDED. KAZEMI LEFT THE MATTER THERE.
C - ENTIRE TEXT.
THIS BEING FRIDAY, MFA AND OTHER GOI OFFICES ARE ALL SHUT DOWN. WE DOUBT WE CAN GET ANY RELIABLE INFORMATION ON AFGHAN SITUATION ON SUCH SHORT NOTICE ANYWAY. WILL TRY WHEN OFFICES OPEN TOMORROW.

1979TEHRAN03009.subject: HOVEYDA TRIAL AND SCHOENMAN DEPORTATION -- ANTI- AMERICANISN CONTINUES

AS WIRE SERVICES HAVE REPORTED, FORMER PM HOVEYDA WAS AWAKENED HALF HOUR AFTER MIDNIGHT MORNING MARCH 16 AND BROUGHT BEFORE ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COURT (PART OF THE COMMITTEE SYSTEM, NOT THE GOVERNMENT)., WHERE HE WAS CHARGED WITH PAST ACTIVITIES AS U.S., BRITISH AND ZIONIST AGENT. SINCE HE HAD ALREADY TAKEN SLEEPING PILLS, HE ASKED FOR EARLY RECESS AND ALSO FOR TIME TO PREPARE HIS DEFENSE, SINCE HE HAD NEVER SEEN THE INDICTMENT. TRIAL IS SCHEDULE D TO RESUME TONIGHT, AS HAS BECOME THE CUSTOM HERE (PRESUMABLY TO CUT DOWN ATTENDANCE AT WHAT ARE OFFICIALLY LABELLED AS "OPEN TRIALS"). ETTELAAT AND KAYHAN REPORTEDLY HAD REPRESENTATIVES PRESENT.

ACCORDING TO LOCAL WIRE SERVICE SOURCE, ENTEZAM ANNOUNCED THIS MORNING THAT GOVERNMENT WILL ASK AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI TO APPROVE PROCEDURE UNDER WHICH REMAINING TRAIALS AND EXECUTIONS WILL ALL BE COMPLETED BEFORE NOW RUZ (IRANIAN NEW YEAR). AFTER THAT, REMAINDER OF THOSE HELD WOULD BE AMNESTIED. (COMMENT: AS DEPARTMENT AWARE, GOVERNMENT HAS ASKED FOR AMNESTY BEFORE, AND KHOMEINI APPEARED TO AGREE, BUT IT HAS NOT WORKED. IT WOULD BE CONSIDERABLE STEP FORWARD IF AMNESTY WORKED THIS TIME, BUT WE HAVE SERIOUS DOUBTS.)

ACTIVIST AMERICAN RALPH SCHOENMAN WAS DEPPORTED THURSDAY AS A CIA AGENT. WOMAN ACTIVIST KATE MILLETT IS REPORTEDLY UNDER THREAT OF DEPORTATION, THOUGH SHE TOLD REPORTERS OUTSIDE HER HOTEL THIS MORNING THAT SHE HAD NOT RECEIVED OFFICIAL NOTICE TO LEAVE.

EMBASSY HAS REPORTED BY SEPTELS OCCUPATION BY ARMED MEN OF PREMISES OF TWO AMERICAN COMPANIES SO FAR, WITH NO REDRESS YET PROVIDED BY THE GOVERNMENT. ANTI-AMERICAN DEMONSTRATIONS, ORCHESTRATED PRIMARILY BY PLO ON ARABISRAEL ISSUE, HAVE ALSO HEATED UP ANTI-AMERICAN FEELING WHICH HAD APPEARED TO BE SUBSIDING, ACCORDING TO SOME OF OUR FELLOW WESTERN DIPLOMATS (WHO RE OFTEN MISTAKEN FOR AMERICANS). MAIN EFFECT SO FAR HAS BEEN INABILITY TO GET MUCH COOPERATION FROM GOVERNMENT AUTHORITIES ON A WHOLE RANGE OF PRACTICAL PROBLEMS WE FACE.

1979TEHRAN03016.subject: THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT ONE MONTH LATER AND PROSPECTS FOR THE FUTURE

segments.text: THE FUTURE C- ENTIRE TEXT.

SUMMARY: THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT, AFTER ONE MONTH IN OFFICE, REMAINS EXTREMELY INEFFECTUAL. THE UNEXPECTED SUDDENNESS WITH WHICH IT CAME TO POWER, LACK OF A POLICY ON HOW TO EMPLOY THE FORMER REGIME'S BUREAUCRATS, POLICE AND MILITARY OFFICERS, COLLAPSE OF THE MILITARY AND LAW ENFORCEMENT AGENCIES, AND KHOMEINI'S TENDENCY TO UNDERCUT BAZARGAN ARE AMONG THE FACTORS WHICH EXPLAIN THIS CONTINUED WEAKNESS. WE DOUBT THAT BAZARGAN-AS DISTINCT FROM THE LARGER ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY MOVEMENT-WILL BE ABLE TO ASSERT HIS GOVERNMENT'S AUTHORITY OR TO SEE ITS PROGRAM THROUGH TO SUCCESSFUL COMPLETION.
RATHER, IT SEEMS MORE LIKELY THAT THE COMING MONTHS WILL BE DOMINATED BY POTENTIAL CONTENDERS FOR POWER PREPARING THEMSELVES FOR THE POSSIBILITY OF EVENTUAL ARMED CONFRONTATION. END SUMMARY.

A MONTH AFTER DISPLACING THE LAST GOVERNMENT APPOINTED BY THE SHAH, THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT OF MEHDI BAZARGAN REMAINS EXCEEDINGLY INEFFECTUAL. DURING ITS TIME IN OFFICE IT HAS ACCOMPLISHED ALMOST NOTHING, NOT EVEN ESTABLISHMENT OF AN UNDISPUTED CLAIM TO PRIMACY IN ADMINISTERING THE MATION'S AFFAIRS. MORE OFTEN THAN NOT, IT IS THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES--WHICH DESPITE REPEATED ANNOUNCEMENTS THAT THEY ARE TO BE INTEGRATED WITH EXISTING GOVERNMENT AGENCIES, CONTINUE TO THRIVE AS INDEPENDENT POWER CENTERS--THAT ACTUALLY GOVERN, AT LEAST IN MATTERS OF LOCAL CONCERN.

THE POWER OF THIS PARALLEL SYSTEM OF GOVERNMENT HAS BEEN ESPECIALLY EVIDENT IN THE AREAS OF LAW ENFORCEMENT AND ADMINISTRATION OF JUSTICE, AREAS WHERE THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT HAS BEEN SHOWN IMPOTENT AND ACUTELY EMBARRASSED TIME AND AGAIN BY ARBITRARY ARRESTS, SUMMARY TRIALS AND GRISLY EXECUTIONS CARRIED OUT BY THE COMMITTEES WITHOUT REGARD TO THE GOVERNMENT'S JURISDICTIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES.

THERE ARE SEVERAL FACTORS INVOLVED IN THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENTS CONTINUING INABILITY TO FUNCTION EFFECTIVELY. THE FIRST RELATES TO THE UNEXPECTEDNESS WITH WHICH THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT FELL. DESPITE BRAVE PRONOUNCEMENTS FROM THE KHOMEINI CAMP EVEN BEFORE THE AYATOLLAH'S RETURN TO IRAN THAT AN ADMINISTRATIVE STRUCTURE HAD BEEN CREATED AND WAS READY TO REPLACE THE PAHLAVI REGIME., IT IS CLEAR THAT BAZARGAN WAS ALMOST TOTALLY UNPREPARED TO ASSUME COMMAND OF THE GOVERNMENT APPARATUS WHEN HE DID. SECOND, THERE HAS BEEN CONSIDERABLE VACILLATION REGARDING WHETHER OR NOT TO UTILIZE FULLY THE EXISTING CIVILIAN, LAW ENFORCEMENT, AND MILITARY STRUCTURES.

BAZARGAN IS CAUGHT ON THE HORNS OF A DILEMMA HERE: MANY SENIOR BUREAUCRATS, POLICE AND MILITARY OFFICER ARE ASSUMED TO BE TAINTED BY VIRTUE OF THEIR COLLABORATION WITH THE PAHLAVI REGIME, BUT OFTEN THEY ARE THE ONLY ONES WITH THE EXPERTISE NEEDED TO DO CERTAIN JOBS. THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT'S UNCERTAINTY IN HOW TO HANDLE THIS MATTER FREQUENTLY RESULTS IN A NO POLICY AT ALL. IN THE ABSENCE OF A CLEARLY DEFINED POSITION, THE COMMITTEES HAVE BEEN LEFT FREE TO DEAL WITH THESE INDIVIDUALS AS THEY SEE FIT. NEEDLESS TO SAY, COMMITTEE MEMBERS HAVE NOT HESITATED TO SETTLE OLD SCORES.
THIRD, THE DISINTEGRATION OF LAW ENFORCEMENT AGENCIES AND THE MILITARY HAS LEFT THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT WITH NO MEANS TO BRING FORCE TO BEAR WHEN ITS AUTHORITY IS CHALLENGED--AS IT REGULARLY IS.

THE BIGGEST HANDICAP OF ALL, HOWEVER, IS THE ROLE OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI. PRIOR TO THE COLLAPSE OF THE PAHLAVI REGIME, AMONG KHOMEINI'S STRENGTHS AS LEADER OF THE OPPOSITION WERE HIS PENCHANT FOR SPEAKING IN GENERALITIES AND, BEYOND A VAGUE INSISTENCE ON RETURNING TO THE POLITICAL IDEALS OF THE PROPHET AND THE IMAMS, HIS APPARENT LACK OF ANY WELL-THOUGH-OUT PHILOSOPHY OF GOVERNMENT. ACCORDINGLY, HIS PRONOUNCEMENTS WERE OPEN TO A WIDE VARIETY OF INTERPRETATIONS. AS THE ALMOST UNIVERSALLY RECOGNIZED LEADER OF THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION, KHOMEINI STILL HAS TO BE LISTENED TO, BUT THESE DAYS HIS FREQUENTLY DELPHIC UTTERANCES DELIVERED AD LIBITUM NO LONGER MEAN ALL THINGS TO ALL PEOPLE.

RATHER, THEY ARE A SOURCE OF CONSIDERABLE CONFUSION AND, ULTIMATELY, ADMINISTRATIVE PARALYSIS AS THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT IS FORCED TO SPEND AN INORDINATE AMOUNT OF TIME PUTTING OUT FIRES STARTED BY KHOMEINI'S OFF-THE-CUFF REMARKS ON SUBJECTS AS DIVERSE AS FROZEN MEAT AND THE WEARING OF THE VEIL. ------------------072519 171104Z /11 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 0381 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DAHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINTO BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY BONN AMEMBASSY CAIRO AMCONSUL DHAHRAN /AMEMBASSY DOHA 0002 AMCONSUL FRANKFURT AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS AMEMBASSY BEIJING AMEMBASSY RABAT USLO RIYADH AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY TOKYO USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE CINCPAC USCOCOSOUTH SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 3016

WE DOUBT THAT BAZARGAN WILL BE ABLE TO OVERCOME THE OBSTACLES BEFORE HIM. IT IS EXTREMELY UNLIKELY THAT KHOMEINI WILL REFRAIN FROM MAKING THE KIND OF STATEMENTS THAT HAVE BADLY UNDERCUT THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT TO DATE. ONE SOURCE CLOSE TO THE AYATOLLAH HAS MENTIONED EFFORTS TO PROVIDE HIM WITH BETTER COUNSEL IN THE HOPE THAT IT WILL REDUCE THE NUMBER OF ILL-ADVISED STATEMENTS HE MAKES, BUT KHOMEINI DOES NOT SEEM THE SORT TO HOLD HIS TONGUE FOR CONSIDERATIONS OF PRACTICAL POLITICS.

RATHER, HIS PERCEPTION OF HIMSELF AS THE CHOSEN MESSENGER OF GOD IN THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION CARRIES WITH IT A RESPONSIBILITY TO SPEAK OUT ON MATTERS OF DIVINE CONCERN, NOR DOES BAZARGAN HAVE MUCH PROSPECT OF BEING ABLE TO REVITALIZE LAW ENFORCEMENT AGENCIES AND THE ARMED FORCES, ORGANIZATIONS WHICH OTHERWISE MIGHT BE ABLE TO PUT SOME TEETH INTO HIS GOVERNMENT'S MANDATE TO RULE. THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE STRUCTURE, WHICH FOR THE MOMENT COMMANDS AN OVERWHELMING PREPONDERANCE OF FIREPOWER, HAS ALREADY DEMONSTRATED IT WILL RESIST ALL EFFORTS TO CURB ITS PRESENT PREROGATIVES. MOREOVER, ACCORDING TO THE SAME SOURCE WITH CONNECTIONS TO KHOMEINI MENTIONED ABOVE, KHOMEINI PREFERS THAT THE COMMITTEES CONTINUE IN EXISTENCE.

UNDER THE CIRCUMSTANCES, IT WILL BE MOST DIFFICULT FOR THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT TO SEE ITS MAIN TASKS--A REFERENDUM ON THE TYPE OF GOVERNMENT IRANIANS WANT FOR THEMSELVES, ELECTION OF A CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY TO DEBATE AND ADOPT A NEW CONSTITUTION, AND ELECTION OF A MAJLES AND FORMATION OF A NEW GOVERNMENT UNDER THE TERMS OF THAT CONSTITUTION--THROUGH TO SUCCESSFUL COMPLETION. ALREADY, A CONTROVERSY OVER THE FORMAT OF THE REFERENDUM HAS ARISEN, AND INDEEDTHERE ARE GROWING DOUBTS THAT THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT CAN EVEN SOLVE THE LOGISTICS PROBLEMS INVOLVED IN HOLDING THE BALLOT BEFORE THE DATE IT IS PRESENTLY SCHEDULED FOR--MARCH 30TH.

IN THE MEANTIME, ECONOMIC PROBLEMS ACCUMULATE, UNEMPLOYMENT GROWS, ETHNIC MINORITIES GRUMBLE, AND THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES DO THEIR OWN THING. THAT A POLITICAL PROGRAM SUCH AS THAT SET OUT FOR ITSELF BY THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT WILL BE POSSIBLE IN THE MIDST OF SUCH CONDITIONS STRETCHES CREDULITY TO THE BREAKING POINT.

MORE LIKELY, WE BELIEVE, WILL BE EFFORTS BY THOSE FORCES CONTENDING FOR POWER TO DEVELOP THE COERCIVE WHEREWITHAL TO PREVAIL IN A STRUGGLE IN WHICH ARMED STRENGTH ALMOST CERTAINLY WILL DETERMINE THE FINAL OUTCOME. THIS SEEMS TO BE WHAT IS BEHIND DEPUTY PM YAZDI'S PROGRAM TO CREATE A PARAMILITARY NATIONAL GUARD RESPONSIVE TO HIM. YAZDI, THE ONLY MEMBER OF THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT WHO ALSO HOLDS A SEAT ON THE SHADOWY CENTRAL REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE, APPEARS TO BE IN A RELATIVELY STRONG POSITION TO BID ULTIMATELY FOR POWER. HIS MAJOR POINT OF VULNERABILITY IS HIS "AMERICAN CONNECTION," SOMETHING POTENTIAL RIVALS HAVE ALREADY INDICATED A WILLINGNESS TO EXPLOIT.

THE ISLAMIC MOJAHEDIN-E-KHALQ AND THE MARXIST FEDAYIN-E-KHALQ ORGANIZATIONS, BOTH NOW WELL-ARMED, ARE CERTAINLY CONTENDERS. THE VARIOUS LOCAL REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTESS THEMSLEVES SEEM TOO FRAGMENTED AND THEIR LEADERSHIP TOO PREOCCUPIED WITH CARVING OUT PETTY FIEFDOMS TO BECOME A SERIOUS ALTERNATIVE TO THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT AS A NATIONAL GOVERNMENT. PERHAPS SOME PROVINCIAL COMMITTEES, HOWEVER, IN PLACES LIKE SHIRAZ (WHERE THE LOCAL COMMITTEE HAS A SIGNIFICANT MILITARY COMPONENT AND LOCAL MILITARY UNITS SURVIVED THE REVOLUTION VIRTUALLY INTACT) MAY POSSESS SUCH POTENTIAL.

ETHNIC MINORITIES, SUCH AS THE KURDS, COULD WELL BECOME INFLUENTIAL BY THROWING THEIR SUPPORT TO ONE CONTENDER FOR NATIONAL POWER OR ANOTHER, ALTHOUGH WE DOUBT THAT ANY GROUP ALONE COULD BE A SERIOUS CHALLENGER BY ITSELF.

IN SUM, THE COMING MONTHS ARE LIKELY TO SEE CONTINUING PARALYSIS AT THE CENTER WHILE THOSE GROUPS WHICH ARE APT TO BECOME THE REAL CONTENDERS FOR POWER ORGANIZE AND CONSOLIDATE THEIR POSITIONS IN ANTICIPATION OF WHAT COULD EASILY BECOME A BLOODY STRUGGLE FOR PREDOMINANCE.
C - ENTIRE TEX.

SUMMARY: HOVEYDA GOES ON TRIAL. BAZARGAN COVINCES KHOMEINI THAT REVOLUTIONARY JUSTICE MUST BE BROUGHT UNDER CONTROL. PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT SPOKESMEM MAKE CONFLICTING STATEMENTS ON PRESS CENSORSHIP. TUDEH SUUPORTS ESTABLISHMENT OF AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. DEMONSTRATORS SUPPORT NIRT'S QOTBZADEH. ENDSUMMARY.

AS REPORTED EARLIER, FORMER PM HOVEYDA WAS BROUGHT BEFORE THE TEHRAN "REVOLUTIONARY COURT" EARLY MARCH 15. ACCORDING TO PRESS ACCOUNTS, AT THAT SESSION HE WAS INDICTED" ON THE FOLLOWING 17 CHARGES CREATING CORRUPTION ON EARTH.
ENTERING INTO A BATTLE AGAINST GOD AND HIS PEOPLE.
CONSPIRING AGAINST IRAN'S SECURITY AND INDEPENDENCE BY FORMING CABINETS WHICH WERE SUGJECT TO AMERICAN AND BRITISH INFLUENCE AND IN SUPPORT OF IMPERIALIST INTERESTS IN IRAN.
CONSPIRACY AGAINST NATIONAL SOVEREIGNTY BY INTERFERING WITH PARLIAMENTARY ELECTIONS AND APPOINTING MINISTERS AND REMOVING THEM ON THE ORDERS OF FOREIGN EMBASSIES IN IRAN.
GIVING AWAY THE COUNTRY'S MINERAL RESOURCES SUCH AS COPPER AND URANIUM.
HELPING TO INTENSIFY IMPERIALIST ACTIVITIES IN IRAN, ESPECIALLY THOSE OF THE UNITED STATES AND ITS EUROPEAN ALLIES, AND MAKING THE COUNTRY A MARKET FOR THESE POWERS.
PAYING THE COUNTRY'S OIL REVENUES TO THE SHAH, FARAH AND COUNTRIES CONNECTED TO THE WEST AND THEN ASKING LOANS FROM THSES COUNTRIES AND PAYING HIGH INTEREST RATES ON THE LOANS.
DESTRUCTION OF THE COUNTRY'S AGRICULTURE AND FORESTS.
DIRECT PARTICIPATION IN ESPIONAGE ACTIVITIES ON BEHLF OF THE WEST AND ZIONISM.
PARTICIPATING IN CONSPIRACIES SUCH AS CENTO AND NATO TO WIPE OUT THE PEOPLE OF VIETNAM, PALESTINE AND IRAN.
MEMBERSHIP IN THE FREEMASON ORGANIZATION OF IRAN.
PARTICIPATION IN OPPRESSIVE POLICIES SUCH AS THE KILLING AND WOUNDING CONSPIRACIES TO LIMIT FREEDOM BY CENSORING NEWSPAPERS, MAGAZINES AND BOOKS.
ESTABLISHING AND THEN ACTING AS THE FIRST SECRETARY-GENERAL OF THE RASTAKHIZ PARTY.

SPREADING CULTURAL AND MORAL CORRUPTION, AND PARTICIPATING IN THE CONSOLIDATION OF THE PILLARS OF COLONIALISM, INCLUDING PARTICIPATION IN THE REVIVAL OF THE "CAPITULATIONS," MEANING THE RIGHT TO CONSULAR TRAILS FOR AMERICANS.
DIRECT COMPLICITY IN PEDDLING HEROIN IN COOPERATION WITH FORMER PM MANSUR IN FRANCE.

SUBMITTING ERRONEOUR REPORTS, SPREADING LIES THROUGH THE PUBLICATION OF SUBSERVIENT NEWSPAPERS AND THE APPOINTMENT OF LACKEY EDITORS, AND IMPOSING STRICT CENSORSHIP, ALL IN THE INTEREST OF KEEPING THE FOREIGN-LED SHSAH IN POWER. ACCORDING TO THE MARCH 17 PRESS, WHICH APPARENTLY HAD REPRESENTATIVES AT THE SESSION, HOVYDA OBEJCTED TO THE CONSTRAINTS HE WAS UNDER IN PREPARING HIS DEFENSE AND THE GENERALITY OF THE CHARGES AGAINST HIM.

THE HOVEYDA TRAL, THE MOST RECENT IN A STRING OF JUDICIARY EMBARRASSMENTS FOR THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT, ROMPTED PM BAZARGAN TO MAKE A HASTY TRIP TO QOM. LATTER THE SAME EVENING THERE HE WAS ABLE TO CONVINCE KHOMENIN THAT THE ACTIVITIES OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS HAD TO BE BROUGHT UNDER A DEGREE OF CONTROL. KHOMEINI ACCORDING LY ISSUED THE FOLLOWING STATEMENT: "THE TRIAL AND EXECUTION OF THEIR VERDICTS HANDED DOWN TO THE CRIMINALS ARE BEING CARRIED OUT WITH SUCH SPEED IT IS NECESSARY THAT HENCEFORTH ALL TRIALS BE NULL AND VOID.

THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL HAS BEEN INSTRUCTED TO PREPARE AND APPROVE NEW REGULATIONS." IF THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT IS INDEED ABLE TO WREST CONTROL OF THE ADMINISTRATION OF JUSTICE FROM THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE STRUCTURE, IT WOULD BE A MAJOR VICTORY FOR BAZARGAN. WHILE KHOMEINI'S STATEMENT APPEARS TO HAVE FORESTALLED, FOR THE MOMENT, A HASTILY RENDERED DEATH SENTENCE FOR HOVEYDA, IT REMAINS TO BE SEEN WHETHER OR NOT IT ALSO MEANS AND END TO REVOLUTIONARY JUSTICE.

EXEMPLARY OF THE PROBLEM FACING THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT IN THIS REGARD, DEPUTY PM ENTEZAM ON MARCH 15 ADMITTED THAT THE DID NOT KNOW HOW MANY PRISONERS ARE BEING HELD IN QASR PRISON BECAUSE REPRESENTATIVES OF THE GOVERNMENT HAD NOT BEEN ABLE TO GAIN ACCESS TO IT.

PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT SPOKESMEN HAVE MADE CONFLICTING STATEMENTS ON THE ISSUE OF CENSORSHIP OF THE NEWS. MINISTER OF INFORMATION NASSER MINACHI TOLD FOREIGN CORRESPONDENTS MARCH 15. THAT THEY WILL NOT BE SUBJECT TO ANY KIND OF CENSORSHIP AT ALMOST THE SAME TIME DEPUTY PM ENTEZAM WAS CONFIRMING THAT PHOTOS AND FILMS WOULD BE SUBJECT TO PRIOR SCREENING BEFORE THEY WOOULD BE ALLOWED OUT OF IRAN.
THE TUDED PARTY HAS URGED ITS MEMBERS TO VOTE "YES" IN THE REFERENDUM FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC.

A LARGE GROUP DEOMNSTRATED OUTSIDE NIRT ON MARCH 16, IN SUPPORT OF ITS DIRECTOR, SADEGH QOTBZADEH. MANY WERE WOMEN IN CHADORS. QOTBZADEH, IN REMARKS TO THE GATHERING, CRITICIZED THE FOREIGN PRESS FOR ONLY VISITING TEHRAN UNIVERSITY WHERE THEY COULD NOT MEET THE REAL IRANIAN MASSES AND CONVEYING A DISTROTED VIEW OF THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION. BANI SADR ALSO MADE A LONG TEVEVISED SPEECH AT A TEHRAN SCHOOL NIGHT OF MARCH 16 DISCUSSING THE CHADOR ISSUE AND GENERALLY DEFENDING ITS USE.

AS OF MORNING MARCH 17, BEST INFORMATION AVAILABLE TO MFA CAME NOT FROM IRANIAN REPRESENTATIVES BUT FROM SOME OTHER GOVERNMENT (PERHAPS AFGHANS THEMSELVES). AMERICAS DEPARTMENT HEAD GOODARZNIA TOLD POL COUNSELOR THAT FIGHTING MARCH 16 OCCURRED ALSO IN MEZAR-SHARIF, AS WELL AS HERAT. TO BEST OF OUR KNOWLEDGE, BORDER WAS NOT CLOSED, BUT COMMUNICATIONS BETWEEN HERAT AND KABUL WERE CUT OFF AND HERAT AIRPORT WAS CLOSED. HE WILL LET US KNOW IF HE GETS ANY FURTHER INFORMATION.
C - ENTRIE TEXT.

DURING CONVERSATION ON MARCH 15, MFA'S KAZEMI TOLD LAMBRAKIS VIRTUALLY EVERYBODY AROUND KHOMEINI HAD PRESSED THE AYATOLLAH LAST JANUARY TO MAKE A DEAL WITH BAKHTIJR WHICH WOULD PERMIT A PEACEFUL HANDOVER OF POWER, WITH THE ARMY INTACT. ACCORDING TO A SOURCE CLOSE TO THE AYATOLLAH, WHOM KAZEMI SAID HE COULD NOT RECALL, THE AYATOLLAH HAD AT FIRST AGREED TO THIS--AND AUTHORIZED A VISIT BY KAHTIAR TO SEEHIM IN PARIS. LATER HE CHANGED HIS MIND, HOWEVER. HE EXPLAINED TO HIS DECIPLE THAT WHAT THEY WANTED UNDOUBTEDLY WAS WISE IN A POLITICIAL SENSE.

HOWEVER, AS AN ISLAMIC FUNDAMENTALIST HE WAS BOUND BY THE S"SHARIA" (ISLAMIC LAW) WHICH SAYS ONE MUST COMBAT EVIL UNCOMPROMISINGLY UNTIL IT IS DESTORYED. THEREFORE HE COULD NOT AGREE TO A DEAL WITH BAKHTIAR. (COMMENT: THIS STORY MAY BE APOCRYPHAL, BUT IT WAS USED BY KAZEMI--WHO IS A NON-ISLAMIC NATIONAL FRONTER--TO ILLUSTRATE THE CAST OF KHOMEINI'S THINKING AND WHAT ONE CAN OR CANNOT EXPECT OF HIM IN TERMS OF POLITICAL REALISM.)

THIS WOULD APPEAR TO BE A GOOD PLACE TO RECALL AN EARLIES CONVERSATION LAMBRAKIS HAD WITH THE ELDER ROWGHANI, A KHOMEINI INTIMATE. ROWGHANI STRESSED AT THAT TIME THAT KHOMEINI HAD PLAYED AN ACTIVE ROLE ON, AND STILL FELT STRONGLY ABOUT, THREE ISSUES: THE SHAH'S LAND REFORM, THE NEED FOR A FREELY-ELECTED MAJLES, AND OPPOSITION TO THE LAW GRANTING THE U.S. MILITARY MISSION ITS "EXTRATERRITIORIAL" PRIVILEGES AND IMMUNITIES. IT MAY BE INSTRUCTIVE FOR US TO REMEMBER THESE ITEMS-PARTICULARLY THE LAST. IF ROWGHANI WAS ACCURATE WE SHOULD EXPECT NO QUICK END TO OUR PRESENT PRACTICAL PROBLEMS INVOLVING PROPERTIES OF
(C) ENTIRE TEXT.

IN ESTABLISHING A PROFILE FOR THE SENIOR REGIONAL SECURITY OFFICER, HEADQUARTERS MAY WISH TO CONSIDER THE FOLLOWING OBSERVATIONS: IT APPEARS UNLIKELY THAT TEHRAN WILL SOON RETURN TO THE SIZE OR COMPLEXITY OF THE PAST YEAR. OUR SECURITY PROGRAM WILL HAVE TO FOCUS EXTENSIVELY ON THE PROBLEMS OF PROTECTING A SMALL NUMBER OF OFFICIAL AMERICANS WITH REDUCED U.S. GOVERNMENT RESOURCES.

OUR EXPERIENCE SO FAR HAS SHOW THAT THE MOST SUCCESSFUL APPROACH IN DEALING WITH THE LOCAL SITUATION REQUIRES A LARGE MEASURE OF MATURITY, PATIENCE, AND FLEXIBILITY. IN MAY WAYS TEHRAN IS A REGRESSION TO THE OLD STYLE OF SECURITY WITH A DE-EMPHASIS ON THE PARAMILITARY POSSIBILITIES AND HARDWARE. THE EMPHASIS HERE FOR THE FORESEEABLE FUTURE MUST BE ON A MATURE EXPERIENCED OFFICER WHO CAN COMMAND THE RESPECT OF THE VARIOUS PARTIES INVOLVED AND STILL REPRESENT THE BOTTOM LINE IN GOOD SECURITY PRACTICES.

1979TEHRAN03034.subject: PROBABLE LOCAL REACTION TO EGYPTIAN-ISRAELI PEACE TREATY

segments.text: (S) ENTIRE TEXT

EGYPTIAN AMBASSADOR, WHOSE CHANCERY PREMISES HAVE BEEN TRASHED TWICE BY MOBS DEMONSTRATING AGAINST SADAT'S HOSPITALITY TO THE SHAH, EXPRESSED GREAT CONCERN TO ME MARCH 17 ABOUT PROBABLE LOCAL REACTION TO AN EGYPTIANISRAELI PEACE TREATY. HE FEARS PLO AND FEDAYEEN WILL LEAD MOBS AGAINST HIS OFFICE AND POSSIBLY HIS RESIDENCE IN MASSIVE RETALIATION FOR EGYPTIAN "PERFIDY" TO THE ARAB CAUSE. HE SAYS HE IS REPOSING TO CAIRO THAT HE BE PERMITTED TO CLOSE DOWN OPERATIONS AND LEAVE THE COUNTRY, AT LEAST TEMPORARILY.

I TOLD EGYPTIAN THAT I SHARED HIS CONCERN. THE DEMONSTRATION WHICH THE PLO AND FEDAYEEN MOUNTED IN FRONT OF OUR EMBASSY COMPOUND LASTWEEK IN PROTEST AGAINST PRESIDENT CARTER'S MID-EAST TRIP PROVED THEIR CAPABILITY OF BRINGING OUT SEVERAL THOUSAND ACTIVISTS TO AGITATE AGAINST US. WE WILL HAVE TO ANTICIPATE AT LEAST A REPETITION OF THAT EVENT.

SINCE THIS CONVERSATION, I HAVE READ ARAFAT'S THREAT TO CAUSE THE MIDDLE EAST TO "EXPLODE" AGAINST U.S. INTERESTS. IT IS OBVIOUS THAT THE EASIEST PLACE FOR HIM TO CARRY OUT THAT THREAT IS TEHRAN, WHERE THE CHAOTIC LAW AND ORDER SITUATION IS TAILOR-MADE FOR TERRORISM. CONSEQUENTLY, IF THE PLO WANTS A DRAMATIC TARGET FOR THEIR ACTION, THE U.S. EMBASSY COMPOUND IS THEIR ANSWER. IT HAS ALREADY BEEN PROVEN THAT IT CAN BE OVERRUN. IT WOULD BE EASY TO PROVE THAT IT CAN BE BURNED AND THAT IS OCCUPANTS CAN BE KILLED.

THERE IS ALSO A CERTAIN SYNERGISM AT WORK HERE. THE FEDAYEEN ARE LOOKING FOR AN OPPORTUNITY TO EMBARRASS THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT. THEREFORE, QUITE APART FROM THEIR PLO COLLEAGUES, THEY HAVE THEIR OWN REASONS TO MOUNT A VIOLENT ACTION. AN UNPOLULAR CAUSE, SUCH AS THE EGYPTAIN-ISRAELI TREATY, WOULD GIVE THEM AN OCCASION TO DO THIS WITH RELATIVE IMPUNITY FROM POPULAR (OR ISLAMIC) REACTION, CONSEQUENTLY, FEDAYEEN AND PLO TOGETHER COULD BE EXPECTED TO TAKE COMMON INITIATIVE.

IN ANTICIPATION OF THIS PROBLEM, I HAVE ASKED MY POLITICAL CONSELOR TO MEET MARCH 18 WITH SEYYED BEHESHTI, PROMINENT MULLAH WHO IS CLOSE TO KHOMEINI, TO ALERT HIM TO OUR CONCERN AND TO ASK FOR PREEMPTIVE ACTION BY THE AYATOLLAH. I AM ALSO SENDING WORD TO YAZDI THROUGH ENTEZAM, BACAUSE YAZDI SEEMS RELUCTANT TO HAVE DIRECT CONTACT WITH US SINCE THE JIM BILL STATEMENT IN TIME MAGAZINE. OUR PURPOSE IN THIS DEMARCHE IS TO TRY TO GET SOME ADDITIONAL PROTECTION FOR THE COMPOUND, PARTICULARLY IN THE FORM OF BLOCKING FORCES WHICH WOULD PRECLUDE MOBS FROM APPROACHING OUR IMMEDIATE AREA.
HOWEVER, WE HAVE LEARNED FROM PREVIOUS EXPERIENCE THAT SNIPER FIRE FROM THE SURROUNDING BUILDINGS CAN BE INTENSE AND EFFECTIVE AGAINST US.
I WILL ASLO RAISE THE PROBLEM WITH BAZARGAN IF I SUCCEED IN OBTAINING AN APPOINTMENT WITH HIM. IT IS NOT CLEAR, HOWEVER, THAT HE CAN PERSONALLY COMMAND ANY AUTHORITY THAT WOULD BE EFFECTIVE.

ACTION REQUESTED: IN ORDER TO SUPPLEMENT THESE ACTIONS, DEPT IS REQUESTED TO APPROACH ROUHANI AS SOON AS POSSIBLE TO ENGAGE HIS SERVICES IN THIS EFFORT. ALTHOUGH IRANIANS CANNOT RPT NOT BE EXPECTED TO SYMPATHIZE WITH OUR MID-EAST POLITICES, THEY MAY BE SENSITIVE TO THE IMAGE THEY WILL EARN IF THEY ATTACK AND DESTROY THIS EMBASSY A SECOND TIME AND, ESPECIALLY, IF AMERICANSARE KILLED IN THE PROCESS THIS TIME.

1979TEHRAN03039.subject: SOVIET TECHNICIANS REPORTEDLY OFFERED TO NIOC

segments.text: C - ENTIRE TEXT.
ACCORDING TO A SENIOR NIOC OFFICIAL (PROJECT MANAGER), SOVIETS RECENTLY OFFERED THE SERVICES OF RUSSIAN TECHNICIANS TO NIOC WITHOUT CHARGE. THE OFFER WAS REJECTED BY NIOC HEAD NAZIEH.

THIS REPORT IS NOT CONFIRMED FROM OTHER SOURCES, BUT SEEMS PLAUSIBLE. THE SOURCE HIMSELF TOLD A THIRD COUNTRY NATIONAL (WHO IN TURN TOLD POL COUNSELOR) THAT HE HIMSELF WOULD HAVE FAVORED ACCEPTANCE OF THE OFFER SINCE IT WAS FREE AND DID NOT INVOLVE WORK WITH ANY STATE SECRETS. THIRD COUNTRY NATIONAL (KOREAN) POINTED OUT THAT SOVIETS WERE INTERESTED IN PENETRATION FOR PURPOSES OF SUBVERSION, NOT JUST ESPIONAGE.
C - ENTIRE TEXT.

LATEST MFA INFORMATION COMES FROM IRANIAN CONSUL GENERAL IN HERAT LAST EVENING APPROX. 1830 HRS LOCAL. MOBS SHOUTING "ALLAH AKBAR" WERE MOVING ABOUT THE TOWN "JUST AS THEY DID BEFORE IN TEHRAN.", ACCORDING TO MFA SOURCE. THEY HAVE SET FIRE TO BUILDING AND SEIZED SOME ARMS. SOMETHINGALSO IS REPORTEDLY HAPPENING IN BALKH, ACCORDING TO MFA'S GOODARZNIA. NO MORE HEARD ABOUT MAZER SHARIF.

FIERY STATEMENT MARCH 16 BY AYATOLLAH SHARIAT-MADARI WAS CARRIED IN YESTERDAY'S PRESS HERE. HE ACCUSED TARAKI GOVERNMENT OF TORTURING AND KILLING MOSLEMS, ATTACKING THEIR VILLAGES AND SUPPRESSING THEIR RELIGION.

MARCH 17. PRESS ALSO CARRIED STATEMENT FROM AYATOLLAH SADEGH AL-HUSSEINI AL-ROUHANI WHICH REPEATED SHARIAT-MADARI'S CHARGES AGAINST AFGHAN REGIME AND WARNED THAT UNLESS THAT REGIME STOP ITS "DEVILISH" AND "INHUMAN" ACTS, IT WILL "FACE THE FATE OF THE EX-SHAH." HE THREATENED A DECLARATION OF HOLY WAR.
ACCORDING TO MARCH 17 PRESS, A GROUP OF MILITANT AFGHAN YOUTH ATTACKED THE AFGHAN AMBASSADOR'S RESIDENCE HERE LAST NIGHT AND PULLED DOWN THE FLAG. THE RESIDENCE DID NOT APPEAR OCCUPIED AT THE TIME.

COMMENT: THE FIERY STATEMENT ON AFGHANISTAN FROM RELATIVELY MODERATE AYATHOLLAH SHARIAT-MADARI SUGGESTS HE MIGHT SEE THIS AS A USEFUL ISSUE TO BUILD UP HIS OWN POSITION, INCIDENTALLY PUTTING AYATOLLAH KHOMEININ AND THE BARZARGAN GOVERNMENT SOMEWHAT ON THE SPOT. THE POSSIBILITY OF SPREADING THE SHIA-LED REVOLUTION BEYOND IRAN HAS BEEN IMPLICIT ALL ALONG, AND WAS EXPLICITLY MENTIONED BY ITS SPOKESMEN FROM TIME TO TIME IN PAST. THIS DOES NOT APPEAR TO BE KHOMEINI-BAZARGAN POLICY FOR THE MOMENT, BUT ONE CANNOT EXCLUDE ITS BECOMING SO IF THE REBELLION IN AFGHANISTAN APPEARS TO GROW.

IT COULD APPEAL TO SOME AS A USEFUL DIVERSION DURING PERIOD OF INTERNAL ECONOMIC AND POLITICAL PROBLEMS WHICH WILL AFFLICT IRAN FOR MONTHS, EVEN YEARS, TO COME. THE GOI WOULD NOT WANT IT TO TAKE THE FORM OF TROOP BORDER CROSSINGS, BUT MORAL, FINANCIAL AND MATERIAL SUPPORT MIGHT BE PROVIDED TO THE AFGHAN REBEL.
WE NOTE, AS A PERHAPS RELATED PHENOMENON, THAT FOREIGN MINISTER SANJABI RETURNED TO WORK IN HIS MFA OFFICE TODAY. THIS PRESUMABLY MEANS HIS REPUTED RESIGNATION HAS NOT BEEN
C - ENTIRE TEXT.

SUMMARY: KHOMEINI URGES PEOPLE TO ASSIST IRANIAN GOVERNMENT AND ECONOMY. BAZARGAN MAKES SIMILAR APPEAL. TALEGHANI COMMENTS ON ISLAMIC REPUBLIC AND ISLAMIC JUSTICE IN PRESS CONFERENCE. HOVEYDA TRIAL. PLO OPENS MISSION IN AHVAZ. NEW GOVERNOR OF KURDESTAN TO BE ELECTED BY PEOPLE. LAHIJI COMMENTS ON QASR PRISON VISIT. RALLYS/MARCHES ANNOUNCED. LEAST EXECUTION AFTER SUMMARY TRIAL. CHARGES OF HEAVY SALARIES TO BELL INTERNATIONAL EMPLOYEES. END SUMMARY.

KAYHAN HEADLINED WHAT IS DESCRIBED AS KHOMEINI'S FIRST MAJOR SPEECH ON THE FUTURE OF IRAN'S ECONOMY, AN ADDRESS WHICH THE AYATOLLAH GAVE TO MEMBERS OF THE SCOUTING ORGANIZATION IN QOM ON 15 MARCH. REFLECTING COMMENTS ALREADY MADE BY BAZARGAN, KHOMEINI ONCE AGAIN ASKED THAT PEOPLE COOPERATE WITH THE NEW GOVERNMENT AND WORK TOWARDS SAVING THE "BANKRUPT ECONOMY." ON 17 MARCH BAZARGAN MADE A SIMILAR APPEAL, ASKING ALL CIVIL SERVANTS AND INDUSTRIAL WORKERS TO RESUME WORK IN EARNEST. MUCH OF THE BLAME FOR NON-WORKING OFFICE STAFFS AND FACTORY EMPLOYEES IN BEING CAST ON OVER ZEALOUS REVOLUTIONARIES WHO CONTINUE TO DICTATE THEIR OWN TERMS ON HOW PLACES SHOULD BE RUN.

EMBOFFS HAVE SPOKEN TO A LARGE NUMBER OF PRIVATE ENTREPRENEURS AND GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES WHO CLAIM THAT THEIR WORK ROUTINE IS STILL BASICALLY ONE OF COMING IN LATE, SIPPING TEA, SMOKING A FEW CIGARETTES AND THEN DEPARTING. A VARIETY OF REASONS CAN BE GIVEN FOR THIS GENERAL FACTORY AND OFFICE MALAISE, WHICH SEEMS TO STAND SHARPLY IN CONTRAST TO BEEHIVES OF ACTIVITY LIKE THE PRIME MINISTRY OR COMMITTEE CENTERS.

REVOLUTIONARY GROUPS IN MANY FACTORIES CONTINUE TO REFUSE TO ALLOW MANAGERS AND OWNERS TO HAVE ANY FINAL SAY IN PROCEDURE, INSISTING THAT NEW MANAGERS MUST BE SELECTED BY THE WORKERS, AND OFTEN CLAIMING THAT OWNERSHIP HAS BEEN TURNED OVER TO THE "PEOPLE." OFFICE STAFFS SUFFER FROM A LACK OF DIRECTION, AND PURGES OF MANAGEMENT LEVEL PERSONNEL ARE HAVING AN EFFECT ON MORALE.

UNOFFICIAL STATEMENTS BY REVOLUTIONARY AND RELIGIOUS LEADERS ON A VARIETY OF SUBJECTS, PLUS LACK OF DIRECTION RE GOVERNMENT POLICY ALL CONTRIBUTE TO THE GENERAL SENSE OF OFFICE AND FACTORY CHAOS, AND THE CONTINUING ARRESTS AND INTERROGATIONS, WITH THE SUBJECTS SOMETIMES BEING TAKEN OUT DIRECTLY FROM THEIR PLACES OF WORK, ARE MOST DEFINITELY NOT ENCOURAGING PEOPLE TO SETTLE INTO THE PATTERN OF WORK DISCIPLINE BAZARGAN IS TRYING TO CREATE. ------------------084648 181446Z /43 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE NIACT IMMEDIATE 0400 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY BONN AMEMBASSY CAIRO AMCONSUL DHAHRAN IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY DOHA AMCONSUL FRANKFURT AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS AMEMBASSY BEIJING AMEMBASSY RABAT USLO RIYADH IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY TOKYO USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC HONOLU HI USDOCOSOUTH SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 3046

AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI ANSWERED CRITICS OF THE RECENT EXECUTIONS OF PAHLAVI REGIME OFFICIALS BY CLAIMING IN A NEWS CONFERENCE YESTERDAY THAT SUCH EXECUTIONS ARE JUSTIFIED BY ISLAMIC TENETS. DENYING THAT THE TRIALS WERE BEING HELD IN SECRECY, THE AYATOLLAH SAID THAT PEOPLE HAVE BEEN ALLOWED TO ATTEND, AND THAT NEWSPAPERS HAVE BEEN PRINTING TRIAL HIGHLIGHTS, ALTHOUGH FULL TRANSCRIPTS OF THE PROCEEDINGS HAVE NOT BEEN REVEALED FOR SECURITY REASONS.

IN A FURTHER EXPLANATION AS TO WHY AGENTS OF THE PREVIOUS REGIME WERE BEING EXECUTED, TALEGHANI SAID THAT ISLAMIC LAW DID NOT PROVDE FOR IMPRISONMENT OF THE GUILTY LIKE THE WESTERN PENAL CODE, BECAUSE MURDERES OR "SEDITIOUS" PEOPLE WERE INCORRIGIBLE AND THEREFORE DESERVED ONLY DEATH. COMMENTING ON THE PROPOSED REFERENDUM, HE EMPHASIZED THAT THE NEW REPUBLIC WOULD NECESSARILY BE AN ISLAMIC ONE, IN WHICH ISLAMIC LAW WOULD PREVAIL EVEN OVER THE VOTES OF AN ELECTED ASSEMBLY.

MIN OF JUSTIC MOBASHERI ANNOUNCED YESTERDAY THAT THE HOVEYDA TRIAL MIGHT CONTINUE IN EITHER THE SENATE OR THE MINISTRY OF JUSTICE ITSELF, AS SOON AS NEW PROCEDURES FOR THE REVOLUTIONARY TRIALS AND IMPLEMENTATION OF VERDICTS ARE WORKED OUT PER KHOMEINI'S ORDER OF 16 MARCH HALTING ALL THE SUMMARY TRIALS AND EXECUTIONS. NEW REGULATIONS GOVERNING SUCH TRIALS ARE TO BE FORMULATED BY THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT AND THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL. HOVEYDA IS FACING 17 CHARGES, RANGING FROM MASSACRES TO TREASON AND ESPIONAGE, AND APPARENTLY HAS NOT YET BEEN GRANTED A DEFENSE COUNSEL. PRIOR TO KHOMEINI'S ORDER, THE PROSECUTION HAD DEMANDED THE DEATH SENTENCE FOR HOVEYDA.

THE PLO ESTABLISHED ITS SECOND OFFICE IN IRAN BY INAUGURATING A BRANCH IN AHVAZ YESTERDAY. THE OPENING OF THE OFFICE IN OILRICH KHUZESTAN PROVINCE IS SEEN BY SOME TO INDICATE THAT PALESTINIANS MIGHT SOON BE REPLACING OTHER FOREIGNERS WHO HAVE LEFT THE OIL FIELDS DURING THE PAST SEVERAL MONTHS.

ACCORDING TO A REPORT IN KAYHAN, BAZARGAN HAS AGREED TO LET THE RESIDENTS OF KURDESTAN ELECT A NEW GOVERNOR, IN THE FIRST STEP THE PRIME MINISTER HAS TAKEN TO REALIZE KURDISH DEMANDS FOR SOME AUTONOMY IF THE REPORT IS TRUE, IT WOULD BE A SIGNIFICANT DEPARTURE FROM PAST PRACTICE WHERE GOVERNORS HAVE BEEN APPOINTED BY THE MIN OF INTERIOR.

COMMITTEE FOR PROTECTION OF HUMAN RIGHTS SPOKESMAN LAHIJI VISITED QASR PRISON AND SAYS THAT WHILE THE PRISONERS MADE FEW COMPLAINTS ABOUT CONDITIONS IN GENERAL, ALL CLAIMED THAT THEY HAD NO ACCESS TO DEFENSE COUNSEL AND WERE STILL NOT BEING ALLOWED CONTACT WITH THEIR FAMILIES. THE SAME COMPLAINT ABOUT LACK OF COUNSEL WAS VOICED BY EX-PRIME MINISTER HOVEYDA AND CARRIED IN A NEWSPAPER TRANSCRIPT OF PARTS OF HIS INTERROGATION.

A RALLY/MARCH IS PLANNED FOR MARCH 19 BY MEMBERS OF THE ARMY, GENDARMERIS AND POLICE THROUGHOUT IRAN. PARTICIPANTS ARE EXPECTED TO GROUP AT 10 A.M. AND PROCEED TO DESIGNATED PUBLIC SQUARES WHHERE SPEECHES WILL BE MADE BY REPRESENTATIVES OF THE CLERGY.
THE NATIONAL FRONT HAS ALSO REPEATED ITS ANNOUNCEMENT FOR A RALLY ON MARCH 20, THE SAME DAY AS THE RALLY PLANNED BY THE NEWLYFORMED NATIONAL DEMOCRATIC FRONT.

IN WHAT HOPEFULLY WAS THE LAST EXECUTION AFTER A SUMMARY TRIAL, ALI ASGBAR HADADI, DRIVER FOR THE QOM DEPUTY POLICE CHIEF, FACED A FIRING SQUAD ON MARCH 16. 12 PRESS GAVE COVERAGE TO CHARGES THAT 850 AMERICAN TELEPHONE EXPERTS AND EMPLOYEES OF BELL INTERNATIONAL WERE PAID MORE IN IRAN THAN ALL 28,500 IRANIAN EMPLOYEES OF THE NATIONAL IRANIAN TELECOMMUNICATIONS COMPANY. CLAIMING THAT THE CONTRACT ALLOWED AN AVERAGE OF 224,000 DOLLARS FOR EACH AMERICAN EMPLOYEE, THE PRESS ALSO SAYS THAT THE COSTLY PROJECT WAS MAINLY INTENDED TO IMPROVE IRANIAN ARMED FORCES COMMUNICATIONS.

THERE HAS BEEN NO CHANGE IN THE STATUS OF KHUZESTAN WATER AND POWER AUTHORITY. THE ONLY NOTABLE RECENT CHANGE IS THE NEW MANAGING DIRECTOR, MR. AHMAD-ALI SADEGH-VAZIRI, WHO REPLACED AHMAD ALLYASEEN. THE AUTHORITY IS FUNCTIONING AND THE ADDRESS AND TELEPHONE NUMBER OF ITS TEHRAN BRANCH IS UNCHANGED (KHUZESTAN WATER AND POWER AUTHORITY, ELIZABETH BLVD. AND MAIKADEH AVE., AMIR KABIR BLDG. TEL 656322). OUR SOURCE, ENGINEER SALOOR, IS THE TEHRAN REPRESENTATIVE AND HAS AS DIRECT TEL 657071. IN ANSWER TO OUR QUESTIONS CONCERNING THE STATUS OF FORMER CONTRACTS, HE SAID, "NOTHING HAS CHANGED" IN THAT REGARD. THE EMBASSY, INDEPENDENTLY OF THIS SOURCE, HAS NO CONTRARY INFORMATION.
WE MADE NO REFERENCE TO THE PENDING LAW SUIT IN OUR QUERY.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY: REFERENDUM FORMAT STILL A TOPIC OF DEBATE. IRAN TO JOIN NON-ALIGNED MOVEMENT. PRESS FILMS AND PHOTOGRAPHS WILL NOT BE SUBJECT TO PRIOR SCREENING. FORMER MAJLES SPEAKER, RIAZI, ARRESTED. IRAQI KURDS WILL NOT INTERFERE IN IRANIAN INTERNAL AFFAIRS, BUT ETHNIC MINORITIES STILL UNHAPPY. MILITARY, POLICE AND GENDARMERIE MARCH IN SUPPORT OF THE REVOLUTION. END SUMMARY.

THE ISLAMIC MJOAHEDIN-E-KHALQ ISSUED A STATEMENT MARCH 18 URGING THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT NOT TO PREJUDICE THE REFERENDUM ON THE TYPE OF GOVERNMENT IRAN IS TO HAVE BY LIMITING THE QUESTION TO APPROVAL OR DISAPPROVAL OF AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. WHILE EXPRESSING CONFIDENCE THAT AN OVER-WHELMING MAJORITY OF THE PEOPLE WOULD IN FACT VOTE FOR THE PROPOSED REPUBLIC, THE STATEMENT SAID THAT THE PRESENTLY CONTEMPLATED WORDING OF THE BALLOT WOULD NEEDLESSLY PRESENT THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT TO PUBLIC OPINION BOTH AT HOME AND ABROAD AS DICTATORIAL AND MONOPOLISTIC.

ELSEWHERE ON THE SAME SUBJECT, DEPUTY PM ANNOUNCED THAT THE MINISTRY OF INTERIOR HAS DECIDED NOT TO HAVE VOTERS WRITE THEIR NAMES AND ADDRESSES ON THEIR BALLOTS. THIS DECISION WAS MADE IN RESPONSE TO PUBLIC CRITICISM OF THE PROPOSED PROCEDURE. ENTEZAM SAID THAT AS AN ALTERNATE MEANS OF PREVENTING FRAUD, IDENTITY CARDS WOULD BE STAMPED AND VOTERS' FINGERS WOULD BE MARKED WITH INDELIBLE INK. EVEN THIS PROCEDURE SEEMS LIKELY TO STIR CONTROVERSY, HOWEVER, AS RUMORS ARE ALREADY CIRCULATING THAT ANYONE WHOSE IDENTITY CARD CARD IS NOT STAMPED WILL BE PREVENTED FROM LEAVING THE COUNTRY AFTER THE REFERENDUM.

ENTEZAM ALSO ANNOUNCED AT HIS MARCH 18 PRESS CONFERENCE THAT IRAN HAS FORMALLY APPLIED FOR MEMBERSHIP TO JOIN THE MOVEMENT OF NON-ALIGNED NATIONS. HE SAID THE DECISION TO DO THIS FOLLOWED THE DECISION TO WITHDRAW FROM CENTO.

FINALLY, ENTEZAM BACKED OFF OF AN EARLIER POSITION THAT ALL NEWS PHOTOGRAPHS AND FILMS LEAVING THE COUNTRY WOULD BE SUBJECT TO PRIOR SCREENING BY THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT. HE SAID THAT NEWS BUREAUS WITH PERMANENT REPRESENTATIVES HERE COULD AVOID THE REQUIREMENT BY HAVING THOSE REPRESENTATIVES ACCEPT IN WRITING RESPONSIBILITY FOR THE MATERIALS. HE DID NOT SAY WHAT THE CONSEQUENCES WOULD BE IF THE MATERIALS WERE SUBSEQUENTLY FOUND TO BE OBJECTIONABLE.

FORMER MAJLES SPEAKER ABDULLAH RIAZI WAS ARRESTED MARCH 17 AND IS PRESENTLY BEING HELD AT QASR PRISON. HIS ARREST, ALONG WITH THOSE OF TWO PROMINENT BUSINESSMEN, COMING TWO DAYS AFTER KHOMEINI APPEARED TO YIELD TO PM BAZARGAN ON THE MATTER OF REVOLUTIONARY JUSTICE, WOULD INDICATE THAT, DESPITE THE AYATOLLAH'S STATEMENT AND OFFICIAL MOJAHEDIN SUPPORT FOR A CURB ON THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS, THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE STRUCTURE HAS NOT YET RELINQUISHED ITS LAW ENFORCEMENT POWERS TO THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT. ON THE OTHER HAND, WE HAVE HEARD FROM ONE SOURCE CLOSE TO KHOMEINI THAT ALL BUT TWELVE ARRESTIES WILL BENEFIT FROM AMNESTY TO BE DECLARED FOR NEW YEAR.

THE IRAQI DEMOCRATIC PARTY OF KURDESTAN, IN A CONGRATULATORY MESSAGE TO THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT, HAS SAID THAT WHILE KURDS IN IRAQ WILL CONTINUE THEIR STRUGGLE FOR AUTONOMY WITHIN A FREE AND DEMOCRATIC IRAQ, IRAQI KURDS WILL NOT INTERFERE IN IRAN'S INTERNAL AFFAIRS. MEANWHILE, AN IRANIAN KURD, MAJID VOSOUGHI, HAS LEVELED A SCATHING ATTACK ON ISMAIL ARDALAN, APPOINTED BY THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT TO INVESTIGATE KURDISH UNREST. ACCORDING TO VOSOUGHI, ARDALAN WAS A HIGH-RANKING RASTAKHIZ PARTY SYCOPHANT RIGHT UP TO THE PARTY'S DISSOLUTION LAST YEAR.

FINALLY, ON THE ETHNIC MINORITY SCENE, A DELEGATION DISPATCHED BY KHOMEINI AND THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT TO INVESTIGATE UNREST AMONG THE TURKOMEN OF GORGAN PROVINCE WERE SET UPON BY ANGRY TURKOMEN AND BEATEN UP.

MILITARY, POLICE AND GENDARMERIE UNITS MARCHED IN TEHRAN AND, REPORTEDLY, ELSEWHERE AROUND THE COUNTRY MARCH 19. THE MARCHES WERE TO DEMONSTRATE THESE ORGANIZATIONS' SUPPORT FOR THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION AND THE CREATION OF AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. ONE PARADE WITNESSED BY AN EMBASSY OFFICER NEAR JAMSHIDIEH BARRACKS INDICATED THAT THE ARMY HAS HARDLY PULLED ITSELF BACK TOGETHER AS AN EFFECTIVE FORCE. FEW OFFICERS WERE IN EVIDENCE. INDEED, THE MARCHERS APPEARED TO BE LED BY AN ASSORTMENT OF NON-MILITARY PERSONNEL, PERHAPS MOJAHEDIN. THE TROOPS WERE DRESSED IN A VARIETY OF UNIFORMS, APPEARED NOT TO HAVE CUT THEIR HAIR SINCE THE REVOLUTION SUCCEEDED A MONTH AGO, AND FREQUENTLY HAD NOT SHAVED FOR SEVERAL DAYS.

MOST OF THE BANNERS CARRIED EXPRESSED RATHER INNOCUOUS SENTIMENTS ABOUT ISLAMIC SOLIDARITY, BUT A YOUNG MAN IN A SOUND TRUCK TREATED THE MARCHERS AND BY-STANDERS TO A VIRULENTLY ANTI-AMERICAN HARANGUE.
C - ENTIRE TEXT

CITING A RADIO AFGHANISTAN BROADCAST, REPORTEDLY MONITORED IN PAKISTAN, THE MARCH 19 KAYHAN INTERNATIONAL CALIMS AFGHANISTAN HAS ACCUSED IRAN OF "BLATANT AGRESSION." KAYHAN SAYS THE BROADCAST CHARGED IRAN WITH INFILTRATING 7,000 TROOPS ACROSS THE IRANO-AFGHAN BORDER INTO HERAT PROVINCE UNDER THE GUISE OF AFGHAN NATIONALS BEING REPATRIATED TO THEIR OWN COUNTRY. THE IRANIAN CONSULATE IN HERAT ALLEGEDLY ASSISTED IN THIS EFFORT. ACCORDING TO KAYHAN, THE BROADCAST SAID THAT THE PEOPLE OF HERAT WOULD NOT TOLERATE FOREIGN AGGRESSION, AND CALLED UPON THE AFGHAN PEOPLE TO PLEDGE THEIR SOLIDARITY AND INFLICT DEADLY BLOWS AGAINST THE AGGRESSORS AND LOOTERS.

DURING A PRESS CONFERENCE MARCH 18 DEPUTY PM ABBAS AMIR ENTEZAM SAID THAT THEPROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT HAD "NO OFFICIAL STATEMENT" TO MAKE ON THE MUSLIM REBEL MOVEMENT IN AFGHANISTAN, AND "IRAN DOES NOT INTERFERE IN THE DOMESTIC AFFAIRS OF ANY NATION." THIS FOLLOWED REPORTS OF SEVERE CRITICISM OF THE TARAKI GOVERNMENT BY LEADING IRANIAN CLERGYMEN OVER THE WEEKEND (REFTEL). LATER MARCH 18 KAYHAN SAYS IT ATTEMPTED TO GET AN OFFICIAL REACTION TO THE REPORT THAT IRAN HAD INFILTRATED TROOPS INTO AFGHNISTAN BUT "HIT A DEAD END."

WE HAVE BEEN AWARE OF A CONCERTED EFFORT BY THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENTBEGINNINGALMOST AS SOON AS IT COME TO POWER OVER A MONTH AGO TO ROUND UP AFGHANS, INCLUDING MANY WHO HAVE BEEN RESIDENT HERE FOR MANY YEARS, AND DEPORT THEM TO AFGHANISTAN. WE ARE TOLD THAT THE LOCAL AFGHAN EMBASSY HAS REFUSED TO COOPERATE WITH THIS ENDEAVOR, AND THAT AS A CONSEQUENCE THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT HAS PROCEDED UNILATERALLY TO SHIP THESE PEOPLE TO THE BORDER AND FORCE THEM ACROSS.

IN A MEETING WITH PM BAZARGAN TODAY, THE AMBASSADOR INQUIRED ABOUT THE AFGHAN REPORTS. BAZARGAN, AND HIS DEPUTY ENTEZAM, SAID A HOST OF REFUGEES HAD COME TO THE IRANIAN BORDER POST. THE IRANIANS HAD CONTACTED THE RED LION AND SUN SOCIETY AND PROVIDED ASSISTANCE (FOOD, CLOTHING) AS NEEDED. THEY REFUSED TO ADMIT THE REFUGEES, HOWEVER, AND CLOSED THE BORDER. PRESUMABLY, THESE REFUGEES, AND AFGHAN DEPORTEES MENTIONED ABOVE, FUELED THE CHARGES OF IRANIAN "INVASION." PM BAZARGAN HAD A NICE LAUGH ABOUT CHARGES THAT "7,000 IRANIAN TROOPS" ENTERED AFGHANISTAN. HE READILY ADMITTED THAT IT WOULD BE A MIRACLE IF THAT MANY IRANIAN TROOP STILL REMAINED AS A UNIT ANY PLACE IN IRAN.

ONE FINAL NOTE: ON MARCH 17 THE GOVERNMENT:CONTROLLED VOICE OF THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION BROADCAST A REPORT BASED ON "RELIABLE SOURCES IN AFGHANISTAN" THAT HERAT GARRISON FELL TO REBBELS FOLLOWING WIDESPREAD DEMONSTRATIONS AND

URGENTLY REQUIRE CLARIFICATION AS TO CURRENT U.S. POSTAL PRACTICES REGARDING MAIL FROM AND TO IRAN. IRANIAN PRESS HAS CARRIED PROMINENTLY THE REPORT THAT MAIL FROM IRAN TO U.S. WAS BEING HELD UP AT KENNEDY AIRPORT AND NOT DISTRIBUTED IN U.S. FOR SOME TIME. AMBASSADOR HAS DENIED HE IS AWARE THIS IS TRUE IN MEETING WITH PRIME MINISTER, AND ICA HAS SIMILARLY TOLD LOCAL PRESS THAT WE DO NOT BELIEVE THIS REPORT TO BE TRUE. WE SHOULD,THEREFORE, CHECK WITH U.S. POSTAL AUTHORITIES TO BE SURE. FURTHER RESPONSE HAS BEEN PROMISED TO DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER ON THIS QUESTION.
AMBASSADOR AND PRESS OFFICER HAVE ALSO ASSURED IRANIANS THAT MAIL SERVICES TO IRAN HAVE BEEN REINSTATED AS OF MARCH 15. WOULD APPRECIATE CONFIRMATION THIS IS HAPPENING IN PRACTICE.
THE MATTER HAS ASSUMED URGENCY BECAUSE IT IS BECOMING A POLITICAL ISSUE WHICH WE WISH TO SQUELCH BEFORE IT SPREADS TOO FAR. PLEASE RESPOND BY IMMEDIATE CABLE. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN03098.subject: POSSIBLE TRANSFER OF U.S. SUPPLIED ARMS TO PLO

segments.text: (S - ENTIRE TEXT.)

DURING MARCH 19 MEETING WITH BAZARGAN AND ENTEZAM, I REVIEWED THE LAWS, REGULATIONS AND AGREEMENTS WHICH GOVERN TRANSFER TO THIRD COUNTRIES OF ANY MILITARY EQUIPMENT SUPPLIED TO IRAN BY THE UNITED STATES. BAZARGAN ASKED WHETHER THERE WAS A SPECIFIC UNDERSTANDING BETWEEN USG AND PREVIOUS GOI ON SUBJECT.

WHEN I ASSURED HIM THERE WAS, HE SAID HE FOUND OUR POSITION TOTALLY UNDERSTANDABLE AND RESONABLE. HIS GOVERNMENT WOULD CONTINUE TO RESPECT THE OBLIGATIONS UNDERTAKEN IN THIS REGARD BY PREVIOUS GOVERNMENT AND WOULD SEEK U.S. CONCURRENCE IN ANY PROPOSALS TO TRANSFER MILITARY EQUIPMENT OUT IRAN. HE STRESSED THAT THEY HAD NOT YET STUDIED THE MATTER AND THEREFORE HAD NO SUCH PROPOSALS AT THIS TIME. SULLIVAN
(S - ENTIRE TEXT.)
I MET FOR MORE THAN AN HOUR AFTERNOON MARCH 19 WITH PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN. HE WAS ACCOMPANIED BY DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER ENTEZAM AND I BROUGHT ALONG POLITICAL CONSELOR LAMBRAKIS.

WE WERE SURPRISED ON OUR ARRIVAL TO FIND TWO PHOTOGRAPHERS AND AN NIRT TV CAMERAMAN IN ATTENDANCE. IN AN OBVIOUSLY PRE-STAGED MOVE, BAZARGAN GREETED ME EFFUSIVELY "ON CARMER" AND CLEARLY WENT OUT OF HIS WAY TO DEMONSTRATE WARM PERSONAL RELATIONS. WHILE THE CAMERAMEN WERE STILL IN THE ROOM, I CONGRATULATED HIM ON HIS SUCCESS IN STOPPING SUMMARY EXECUTIONS, BUT I DO NOT RPT NOT BELIEVE THERE WAS A SOUND RECORDING OF OUR CONVERSATION.

OUR DISCUSSION THEN RANGED OVER A NUMBER OF SUBJECTS WHICH WILL BE REPORTED BY SEPARATE TELEGRAMS. HOWEVER, ONEOF MY PRINCIPAL POINTSCONCERNED THE NEED FOR ASSISTANCE IN PHYSICAL SECURITY OF EMBASSY COMPOUND AGAINST ATTACKS GENERATED BY PLO AND FEDAYEEN IN THE WAKE OF AN EGYPTIAN-ISRAELI PEACE TREATY. BAZARGAN SAID HE WOULD PASS WORD "INDIRECTLY" TO LOCAL PLO REPRESENTATIVE THAT GOVERNMENT DID NOT WANT ANY DISTURBANCES AT AMERICAN EMBASSY. HE ALSO SAID THAT IRANIAN PROTECTIVE FORCES WERE UNDER INSTRUCTIONS TO REMAIN IN OUR COMPOUND AND PREVENT DIFFICULTIES.

AS OTHER REPORTING CABLES WILL INDICATE, CONVERSATION WAS FRIENDLY AND CONSTRUCTIVE THROUGHOUT, WITH BOTH BAZARGAN AND ENTEZAM DISPLAYING GREAT DISTRUST OF SOVIETS AND DESIRE TO MAINTAIN CLOSE RELATIONS WITH U.S. AT SAME TIME, DISCUSSIONS REVEALED HOW TENUOUS IS THE GOVERNMENT'S CONTROL OVER EVENT AND HOW UNPREDICTABLE
(C - EXTIRE TEXT)

DESPITE OUR NEGATIVE REACTION TO PAN AM SUMMER SCHEDULE FOR TEHRAN, LOCAL REPRESENTATIVE HAS REAFFIRMED IN WRITING MARCH 19 THAT PAN AM WISHES INSTITUTE SERVICE AS CITED REFTEL ON MARCH 28 AND HAS ASKED EMBASSY OBTAIN GOI APPROVAL.

IT IS MY STRONG FEELING THAT FLIGHTS ARRIVING AND DEPARTING TEHRAN DURING HOURS OF DARKNESS WHEN CITY PARTOLLED BY TRIGGER-HAPPY GUNNERS CONSTITUTE UNACCEPTABLE RISK TO PASSENGERS AND PAN AM SERVICE PERSONNEL. LOCAL PAN AM OFFICE SAYS NEW YORK IS AWARE OF THIS FACT, BUT DECLINES CHANGE SCHEDULE AND WOULD PREFER OVERFLY TEHRAN RATHER THAN CHANGE.

I AM DELAYING ANY APPROACH TO GOI UNTIL DEPT CAN APPROACH PAN AM HEADQUARTERS TO SEEK RECONSIDERATION OF SCHEDULE. PLEASE ADVISE SOONEST THE RESULTS OF THIS DISCUSSION. IF PAN AM DECLINES TO CHANGE, IT IS MY FEELING THAT OVERFLIGHT MAY BE PREFERABLE TO JEOPARIDIZING LIVES OF PAN AM EMPLOYEES.

AS FAR AS U.S. OFFICIAL TRAVEL IS CONCERNED, I WILL NOT RPT NOT PERMIT U.S. OFFICIALS TO TRAVEL TO AND FROM AIRPORT AT SCHEDULED FLIGHT TIMES. THEREFORE, IF PAN AM REFUSES TO CHANGE SCHEDULE OR OPTS TO OVERFLY, I WOULD APPRECIATE IMMEDIATE BLANKET AUTHORITY FOR OFFICIAL U.S. TRAVELLERS ORIGINATING OR TERMINATING IN TEHRAN TO USE FOREIGN FLAG AIR CARRIERS.
ARRANGEMENTS WILL ALSO HAVE TO BE MADE FOR COURIERS AND POUCHES TO TRAVEL ON FOREIGN FLAG CARRIERS WHICH ARRIVE AND DEPART TEHRAN IN DAYLIGHT HOURS.
PLEASE ADVISE ACTION TAKEN IMMEDIATELY.

1979TEHRAN03101.subject: DISCUSSION WITH PRIMIN RE FUTURE OF ARMISH/MAAG MISSION

segments.text: ARMISH/MAAG MISSION (S - ENTIRE TEXT)

ONE OF PRINCIPAL ITEMS WHICH I RAISED IN MARCH 19 MEETING WITH BAZARGAN AND ENTEZAM WAS STATUS AND FUTURE OF OUR ARMISH-MAAG MISSION. I REMINDED THEM THAT IN OUR LAST CONVERSATION BAZARGAN HAD ASKED ME TO RETAIN THE NUCLEUR OF THE MISSION HERE IN TEHRAN WHILE HIS GOVERNMENT CONSIDERED HOW IT WISHED TO PROCEED. NEARLY FOUR WEEKS HAD GONE BY WITHOUT ANY ACTION AND I SAID I WOULD APPRECIATE HIS CURRENT THOUGHTS.

I POINTED OUT THAT GENERAL GAST AND MR. LAMBRAKIS HAD MET WITH MINISTER OF DEFENSE AND HIS COLLEAGUES TO DISCUSS THIS SAME SUBJECT, BUT RECEIVED NO RPT NO CLEAR INDICATIONS OF GOI THINKING. I REVIEWED FRUSTRATIONA AND HARASSMENT MILITARY MISSION WAS UNDERGOING IN ITS EFFORTS TO OBTAIN ACCESS TO ITS RECORDS, U.S. GOVERNMENT PROPERTY AND PERSONAL POSSESSIONS, AND SAID THESE MATTERS NEEDED SPEEDY RESOLUTION.

BAZARGAN SAID HE REALIZED HE HAD BEEN SLOW IN GIVING ME SOME GUIDANCE ON THIS SUBJECT AND THANKED ME FOR OUR PATIENCE. HE PERSONALLY FELT THAT IRAN NEEDED TO HAVE SOME SORT OF CONTINUING MILITARY LOGISTICS RELATIONSHIP WITH THE UNITED STATES, BUT THAT HIS GOVERNMENT HAD NOT YET DECIDED WHAT FORM IT SHOULD TAKE. HE ASKED ME TO RETAIN OUR SMALL ARMISH-MAAG GROUP THROUGH THE NEW RUZ HOLIDAY PERIOD AND PROMISED TO HAVE SOME FURTHER DISCUSSIONS ON THE SUBJECT AFTER THAT PERIOD.

HE THEN EXPRESSED SURPRISE THAT ARMISH WAS STILL HAVING PROBLEMS ON ACCESS AND OTHER SIMILAR MATTERS. HE GAVE ENTEZAM SOME INSTRUCTIONS IN FARSI AND TOLE ME THAT HE HOPED TO HAVE AN EARLY RESOLUTION OF OUR PROBLEMS.

HE AND ENTEZAM THEN SAID THEY WERE HAVING GREAT DIFFICULTY GETTING A HANDLE ON OUTSTANDING CONTRACTUAL OBLIGATIONS BETWEEN IRAN AND THE U.S. ON MILITARY EQUIPMENT. THEY WERE PARTICULARLY INTERESTED IN THE TRUST FUND AND HOW IT WORKED. IT SEEMED THAT SOME "KOMITAY" HAD TAKEN ALL THE RECORDS FROM GENERAL TOUFANIAN'S OFFICE AND NOBODY IN THE GOVERNMENT KNEW WHERE THEY WERE.

I SAID THAT GENERAL GAST HAD DISCUSSED THESE SUBJECTS WITH MINISTER MADANI AND HAD LEFT HIM SOME DOCUMENTS. HOWEVER, UNTIL ARMISH COULD HAVE ACCESS TO ITS FILES, IT COULT NOT RPT NOT PROVIDE GREATER DETAILS.
C- ENTIRE TEXT.

DURING MEETING WITH PRIME MINISTER MARCH 19, AMBASSADOR ASKED IF TIMING AND FORM OF FORTHCOMING REFERENDUM WILL REMAIN AS ADVERTISED. BAZARGAN REPLIED AFFIRMATIVELY BUT NOTED HE HIMSELF IS NOT INVOLVED IN PREPARATIONS FOR THE REFERENDUM. THEY ARE BEING HANDLED BY INTERIOR MINISTER WITH THE ASSISTANCE OF A SPECIAL COMMISSION HE IMPLIED THAT HE COULD NOT BE ABSOLUTELY CATEGORIC BUT BELIEVED THE REFERENDUM WOULD GO THROUGH ON MARCH 30TH WITH A SINGLE QUESTION TO WHICH VOTERS WOULD BE ASKED TO REPLY YES OR NO.

BAZARGAN AGREED THERE WERE MANY PEOPLE SNIPING AT THE FORMAT OF THE REFERENDUM, BUT HE SAID AS FAR AS HE KNEW REFERENDA ARE ALWAYS YES OR NO PROPOSITIONS TO A SINGLE QUESTION. HE HOPED TO EXPLAIN ALL THIS TO THE CRITICS AND REDUCE THE POLITICAL CONTROVERSY ON THE QUESTION.

1979TEHRAN03104.subject: MEETING WITH ISLAMIC LEADER MOHAMMED BEHESHTI

segments.text: C- ENTIRE TEXT.

SUMMARY: IN HOUR'S MEETING WITH EMBASS REPRESENTATIVES, ONE OF KHOMEINI'S TOP LIEUTENANTS ASSERTED THAT THE IRANIAN PEOPLE ARE STRIVING PATIENTLY TO UNDERSTAND AND COOPERATE WITH AMERICANS, DESPITE THEIR BELIEF THAT AMERICANS KEPT THE SHAH IN OFFICE MUCH OONGER THAN HE COULD HAVE STAYED BY HIMSELF. HE SUGGESTED THE U.S. CUT ITS REMAINING TIES WITH THE DISCREDITED REGIME OF THE SHAH. HE ALSO AGREED TO DISCUSS WITH KHOMEINI SECURITY FOR AMERICANS AND MORE SATISFACTORY WORKING ARRANGEMENTS FOR AMERICANS IN IRAN. END SUMMARY.

ON MARCH 19, POL COUNSELOR LAMBRAKIS, WITH POLOFFS TOMSETH AND METRINKO, VISITED DR. MOHAMMED BEHESHTI AT HIS HOME IN TEHRAN. THE MEETING WAS ARRANGED BY MEHDI ROWGHANI, WHO ACCOMPANIED. IN ADDITION TO BEING ONE OF KHOMEINI'S TOP LIEUTENANTS, MULLAH BEHESHTI IS THE PRESIDENT OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLICAN PARTY, FORMED ABOUT THREE WEEKS AGO TO ORGANIZE AND CONTEST THE REFERENDUM, AND SUBSEQUENT PARLIAMENTARY ELECTIONS ON BEHALF OF THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT. BEHEHTI RECALLED HIS MEETING ABOUT TWO MONTHS AGO WITH TDY DEPARTMENT OFFICER ESCUDERO AND COMMENTED THAT ESCUDERO SEEMED TO UNDERSTAND THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT FASTER THAN MANY OTHERS.

AT LAMBRAKIS' INVITATION BEHESHTI BEGAN WITH AN EXPLANATION OF HOW HE SAW THE REVOLUTION AND WHERE IT WAS GOING. HE SAID THE CENTRAL EFFORT HAS BEEN TO REACH IRANIANS THAT THEIR PAST MISFORTUNES WERE NOT TO BE BLAMED ON FOREIGN INFLUENCES BUT DERIVE FROM THE IRANIANS THEMELVES. THE OBJECTIVE HAS BEEN AND CONTINUES TO BE CREATION OF A NEW IRANIAN WHO IS PREPARED TO FIGHT TO DEFEND HIMSELF BUT ONLY AFTER HIS LEADERSHIP HAS IDENTIFIED THE ENEMY. IRANIANS OF THIS GENERATION ARE SURPRISINGLY DISCIPLINED, BEHESHTI CONTINUED, AS THE SUCCESS OF THE REVOLUTION INDICATES.
THEY ARE BEING TAUGHT TIGHT SOLIDARITY WITH EACH OTHER AS PROTECTION AGAINST OUTSIDE THREATS WHICH COME FROM IRAN'S GEOGRAPHIC POSITION AND PAST HISTORY.

THEY ARE ALSO BEING TAUGHT TO BE PATIENT AND TRY TO UNDERSTAND THOSE WHOM PAST HISTORY HAS TAUGHT THEM TO MISTRUST. BEHESHTI MADE THIS STATEMENT IN THE CONTEXT OF A QUERY REGARDING US-IRANIAN RELATIONS. HE TOOK ISSUE WITH LAMBRAKIS' SUGGESTION THAT THE PEOPLE OF IRAN DO NOT DISLIKE THE AMERICAN PEOPLE BUT ONLY CERTAIN AMERICAN POLICIES. BEHESHTI SAID THE IRANIAN PEOPLE MAY NOT BE ABLE TO READ MUCH, BUT THEY HAVE HEARD MUCH AND UNDER STAND THE FACT THAT IT WAS AMERICAN WHICH KEPT THE SHAH IN POWER SO MANY YEARS. AMERICAN POLICIES CAUSED THE ISLAMIC OPPOSITION MUCH UNNECESSARY TROUBLE (FOR EXAMPLE, AT THE CLOSING STAGES OF THE REVOLUTION).

THINKING IRANIANS WERE AWARE OF THE NIXON POLICY, WHICH HE CLAIMED WAS DISLIKED BY PEOPLE ALL OVER THE WORLD. NEVERTHELESS, ISLAMIC MILITANTS HAVE BEEN TOLD TO BE PATIENT, AND THEY ARE CAPABLE OF APPRECIATING AMERICANS AND WORKING COOPERATIVELY WITH THEM PROVIDED IRAN'S INDEPENDENCE IS RESPECTED.

LAMBRAKIS MADE A NUMBER OF COMMENTS INDICATING RESPECT FOR IRANIAN INDEPENDENCE HAS TRADITIONALLY BEEN AN AMERICAN CONCERN AND POINTED OUT THAT AN UNDERLYING PRINCIPLE OF EVEN THE NIXON DOCTRINE WAS TO PROVIDE THE ASSISTANCE FOR FRIENDLY NATIONS TO BECOME STRONG ENOUGH SO THAT THEY CAN DEFEND THEMSELVES AND NOT REQUIRE AMERICAN INTERVENTION TO DEFEND THEM.

IN THE SUBSEQUENT DISCUSSION INTERSPERESED WITH GOODHUMORED WIT AND SOME CHUCKLES (A UNIQUE EXPERIENCE WITH BEHESHTI, ACCORDING TO ROWGHANI), A NUMBER OF OTHER TOPIC WERE DISCUSSED. BEHESHTI ASKED HOW AMERICANS FELT TOWARD THE NEW GOVERNMENT'S OIL POLICIES. LAMBRAKIS REPLIED THAT WE UNDERSTOOD ITS UNDERLYING PRINCIPLES AND HAVE NO SERIOUS PROBLEMS WITH IT. WE LIKE TO SEPARATE ECONOMIC FROM POLITICAL QUESTIONS IN ANY CASE. WE ARE AWARE OF THE FACT THAT IRAN DESIRS TO TAILOR ITS PRODUCTION AND EXPORTS TO ITS OWN NEEDS. WE EXPECT OIL PRICES TO BE GUIDED BY OPEC'S DECISION MAKING PROCESS WITH WHICH IRAN WILL CONTINUE TO BE ASSOCIATED.

HOWEVER, WE ALSO BELIEVE THAT IRANIAN PRODUCTION WILL NOT DROP MUCH BELOW WHAT IT HAS BEEN IN THE PAST BECAUSE THE NEW GOVERNMENT WILL NEED THE INCOME TO DO THE MANY THINGS THAT IT WISHES TO DO IN IRAN. LAMBRAKIS REVERTED TO THE MANY ECONOMIC PROBLEMS FACING THE NEW GOVERNMENT AND THE FOUR MILLION UNEMPLOYED. BEHESHTI AVOID ANY DIRECT RESPONSE AS TO GOVERNMENT PLANNING ON THESE ISSUES, BUT KEPT THE DISCUSSION ON THEORETICAL LEVELS.

WHEN ASKED, FOR EXAMPLE, HOW HE PERCEIVED THE INFLUENCE OF COMMUNISTS AND OTHER LEFT-WINGERS, HE REPLIED THAT ALL SUCH PEOPLE WOULD BE ALLOWED FULL FREEDOM, AS INDEED WAS SPELLED OUT IN THE FIRST ARTICLE OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLICAN PARTY'S NEW CONSTITUTION. SUCH FREEDOM WOULD BE ABRIDGED ONLY AS IT BECAME EVIDENT THAT IRANIAN GROUPS WERE DEPENDENT ON, AND ACTING ON BEHALF OF, OUTSIDE INFLUENCES, WHETHER OF THE RIGHT OR OF THE LEFT.

IN RESPONSE TO A SPECIFIC REQUEST FROM LAMBRAKIS REGARDING SECURITY FOR THE EMBASSY COMPOUND AND AMERICANS IN GENERAL IN THE COUNTRY, BEHESHTI IMMEDIATELY UNDERSTOOD AND SAID HE WOULD SPEAK WITH AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI ABOUT IT. AS REGARDS THE PALESTINIAN ISSUE AND THE POSSIBILITY OF ANTI-AMERICAN DEMONSTRATIONS IN CONNECTION WITH ANY SIGNING OF AN EGYPTIAN-ISRAELI PEACE AGREEMENT, BEHESHTI SUGGESTED THIS MIGHT BE DEFUSED IF PALESTINIAN SPOKESMEN, WHO HAVE A CONSIDERABLE INFLUENCE IN THE UNIVERSITY MILLIEU, MADE A POINT OF WARNING AGAINST ATTACKS UPON AMERICANS WHO ARE GUESTS IN IRAN. EMBOFF AGREED THIS WOULD BE AN EFFECTIVE APPROACH IF IT PROVED POSSIBLE.

BEHESHTI ALSO PROMISED TO MENTION TO THE AYATOLLAH THE LARGER QUESTION OF HARRASSMENT WHICH AFFECTS A NUMBER OF PRACTICAL REQUIREMENTS THAT THE EMBASSY AND ARMISH-MAAG HAVE IN THE PROCESS OF CLEARING OUT PERSONNEL, BELONGINGS, AND US PROPERTY.

COMMENT: BEHESHTI IS A VERY LARGE MAN WITHA FLOWING BEARD AND ROBES WHO FACIAL EXPRESSIONS AND MENTAL AGILITY REMIND ONE TO SOME EXTEND OF THE LATE ARCHBISHOP MAKARIOS. OBVIOUSLY A SKILLED POLITICIAN, HE KNOWS HOW TO AVOID SPECIFICS INTO WHICH HE DOES NOT WISH TO BE DRAGGED, WHILE MAKING HIS OWN POINTS. HIS ENGLISH IS QUITE GOOD, AND ONLY MILDLY PUNCTUATED BY LAPSES INTO GERMAN (HE HAVING SPENT SEVEN YEARS PRESIDING OVER A MOSQUE IN HAMBURG). OBVIOUSLY A STRONG, METHODICAL THINKER AND AN ORGANIZER, BEHESHTI DOES NOT SKIP AROUND IN HIS CONVERSAT ONS FROM TOPIC TO TOPIC AS DO MANY OTHER MULLAHS.

HIS RECEPTIVITY, READINESS TO ARGUE AND TO SMILE, AND SUGGESTION THAT THIS MEETING BE REPEATED IN TWO OR THREE WEEKS INDICATED HIS WILLINGNESS TO COOPERATE WITH US ON ISSUES OF MUTUAL INTEREST. HE SUGGESTED SPECIFICALLY THAT THE USG FIND WAYS TO DEMONSTRATE ITS FRIENDSHIP FOR THE NEW ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT OF IRAN BY CUTTING OFF TIES WITH THE REMNANTS OF THE SHAH'S REGIME. THAT WAY, HE PREDICTED, AMERICAN RELATIONS WITH IRAN WOULD IMPROVE RAPIDLY.

1979TEHRAN03111.subject: IRANIAN POSITION ON MIDDLE EAST NEGOTIATIONS

segments.text: C - ENTIRE TEXT.

DURING MEETING WITH PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN AND HIS DEPUTY AMIR ENTEZAM, MARCH 19, AMBASSADOR ADVERTED TO PRESIDENT CARTER'S EFFORTS IN THE MIDDLE EAST AND SAID HE HAD BEEN ASKED TO INFORM THE PRIME MINISTER THAT CHANCES WERE GOOD FOR SIGNING OF AN EGYPTIAN-ISRAELI PEACE TREATY IN THE COMING WEEK OR SO. BAZARGAN REPLIED THAT HE AND HIS GOVERNMENT HAVE BEEN TOO BUSY WITH INTERNAL AFFAIRS TO KEEP UP EVEN WITH THE NEWSPAPERS AND THEREFORE HAVE NOT REALLY TAKEN A POSITION ON THE TREATY.

AMIR ENTEZAM BROKE IN TO SAY HE HAD NOT YET HAD A CHANCE TO BRIEF THE PRIME MINISTER BECAUSE OF THE PRESS OF BUSINESS, BUT AMIR ENTEZAM, AS SPOKESMAN, HAD TOLD THE PRESS THIS MORNING THAT IRAN OPPOSES ANY TREATY OR OTHER MOVES WHICH ARE AGAINST THE INTERESTS OF THE PALESTINIANS.

THE AMBASSADOR THEN WENT OVER THE ARGUMENTS IN FAVOR OF THE PEACE PROCESS, NOTING THAT THE PLO AND SOME OTHERS DO NOT SEEM TO APPRECIATE THE VALUE OF AN AUTONOMOUS PALESTINIAN STATE ON THE WEST BANK AS A STEP TOWARD PERMANENT SOLUTION OF THE ARAB-ISRAELI PROBLEM. BAZARGAN DID NOT REPLY DIRECTLY, BUT ASKED WHAT PROVISIONS THIS TREATY PROCESS WOULD MAKE FOR THE PLIGHT OF THE SHIAS IN SOUTHERN LEBANON WHO FEEL THEMSELVES BETWEEN THE PALESTINIAN AND ISRAELI GUNS AND ARE GETTING HURT. THE AMBASSADOR NOTED THAT POL COUNSELOR LAMBRAKIS, WHO WAS ACCOMPANYING HIM, HAD SPENT TIME IN LEBANON AND WAS AWARE OF THE SHIA PROBLEM THERE.

THE AMBASSADOR AND LAMBRAKIS THEN NOTED THAT, WHILE THERE IS NOTHING SPECIFIC ABOUT THE SHIAS IN LEBANON IN THE PRESENT NEGOTIATIONS, A TREATY WILL HELP CREATE AN ENVIRONMENT WHICH SHOULD MINIMIZE FRICTION IN SOUTHERN LEBANON, WE HOPE. IN ANY CASE, WE ARE AWARE OF IRAN'S INTEREST IN THE SHIA SITUATION IN LEBANON.

BAZARGAN SAID IN PASSING THAT ANOTHER REASON GOI HAS NOT FOCUSED ON THE PROBLEM HAS BEEN THE ILLNESS OF FOREIGN MINISTER SANJABI. HE HAS A SLIPPED DISK IN HIS BACK AND TRIED COMING BACK TO WORK MARCH 18, BUT HAS HAD TO RETURN TO HIS BED, WHERE HE NEEDS A LONG REST. (THIS APPEARS TO CONFLICT WITH NEWSPAPER REPORTS THAT SANJABI DELIVERED A SPEECH AS PLANNED AT THE NIOC BUILDING IN TEHRAN MARCH 19, AND WITH A REPORT WE HAD FROM HEAD OF MFA AMERICAN DEPT THAT SANJABI WORKED A FULL DAY (UNTIL 2:00 PM) AT MFA MARCH 19 AND MAY BE DELIVERING A POLITICAL SPEECH MARCH 20.
IS BAZARGAN MISINFORMED, OR IS HE ANXIOUS TO SQUELCH REPOETFXF SANJABI'S TENDERED RESIGNATION?)

COMMENT: AWARENESS IN GOI OF LEBANESE SHIAS IS SOMETHING USG SHOULD KEEP IN MIND. IT IS POSSIBLE THIS WILL GIVE US A HANDLE TO INTEREST GOI IN THE MIDDLE EAST PROBLEM ON BEHALF OF THE ONGOING PEACE PROCESS, COUNTERING TO A CERTAIN DEGREE THE HOLD PALESTINIANS HAVE GAINED OVER THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT HERE.

DURING MEETING WITH PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN AND HIS DEPUTY AMIR ENTEZAM MARCH 19, THE AMBASSADOR BROUGHT UP WITH THE SOME URGENCY FLOUR'S SITUATION IN IRAN. BAZARGAN AND ENTEZAM WERE SURPRISED TO LEARN THAT HOHN CASSIBA AND TWO BRITISH EMPLOYEES ARE BEING HELD IN HOTEL ARREST AT THE ASTROIA HOTEL IN AHWAZ. THEY EXPRESSED WONDERMENT AS DETAILS OF THE NEGOTIATIONS BACK AND FORTH WERE GIVEN TO THEM AND ENTEZAM MADE COPIOUS NOTES INDICATING HE WILL TRY TO SOLVE THE PROBLEM.

AMBASSADOR ALSO TOUCHED ON RAYTHEON PROBLEM INVOLVING APPARENT SEIZURE BY UNIDENTIFIED ARMED MEN OF TAYTHEON PROPERTY IN TEHRAN, AND ENTEZAM NOTED THAT TOO. AMBASSADOR SAID MORRISON-KNUDSEN CASE APPEARED TO BE WORKING ITSELF OUT, BUT IT WAS SIMILAR TO THE OTHER.HE SAID THAT A GENERAL PROBLEM IS EVOLING IN CONNECTION WITH AMERICAN COMPANIES IN IRAN, AND HE HOPED PGOI WILL BE ABLE TO KEEP THE PROBLEMFROM SPREADING.

1979TEHRAN03133.subject: REPORT THAT COMMUNISTS ARE BUYING RIALS HEAVILY

segments.text: C - ENTIRE TEXT.

DURING MEETING MARCH 19, PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN TOLD THE AMBASSADOR THAT HE HAD RECEIVED REPORTS OF RIALS BEING BOUGHT UP, REPORTEDLY IN EASTERN EUROPEAN COUNTRIES AND/OR BY TUDEH PARTY. HE WONDERED IF USG COULD THROW ANY LIGHT ON THESE REPORTS. AMBASSADOR AND POL COUNSELOR REPLIED THAT THEY HAD NOTHING ON THIS, BUT WOULD ASK WASHINGTON AND OTHER POSTS. BAZARGAN INDICATED EASTERN EUROPEAN COUNTRY CONCERNED MAY BE ROMANIA.

ECONOMIC OFFICER WHO RECENTLY ATTENDED FINANCIAL ATTACHES' MEETING IN WASHINGTON REPORTS SIMILAR INFORMATION REACHED US IN BERN. LOCAL IRANIAN BANKERS ARE ALSO REPORTING SUCH MASSIVE PURCHASES, VARIOUSLY BY SOVIET EMBASSY AND/OR TUDEH PARTY HERE. WOULD APPRECIATE WASHINGTON ASSESSMENT.
C- ENTIRE TEXT.

SUMMARY: KURDS CLASH WITH REVOLUTIONARY UNITS. MILITARY AND POLICE HOLD PRO-REVOLUTION MARCH. OTHER RALLIES/MARCHIES PLANNED. IRAN DENIES KABUL'S INTERVENTION CHARGES. NATIONAL DEMOCRATIC FRONT AND FEDAYEEN COME OUT AGAINST REFERENDUM. PAN-IRANISTS DECLARE SUPPORT FOR AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. TROUBLE CONTINUES IN IRANIAN CITIES. NEW APPOINTMENTS ANNOUNCED. EXPULSION OF FOREIGN WORKERS. IRANIAN PASSPORT OFFICE REMAINS CLOSED DESPITE ANNOUNCEMENTS. END SUMMARY.
FIGHTING CONTINUES IN IRAN'S KURDISH AREA AND THE CEASEFIRE WHICH WAS ARRANGED AFTER 24 HOURS OF VIOLENCE HAS BEEN BROKEN. (SEPTEL)
