ON MARCH 19 RALLIES AND MARCHES WERE HELD THROUGHOUT IRAN BY MILITARY AND POLICE TO DEMONSTRATE THEIR SUPPORT OF THE REVOLUTION. WHILE NEWSPAPER REPORTS DESCRIBE "THOUSANDS" OF SOLIDERS AND POLICE BEING MET WITH AN "EMOTIONAL OUTBURST OF AFFECTION" BY SPECTATORS IN TEHRAN, OTHER SOURCES INDICATED THAT THE RALLY/MARCH MAY HAVE BEEN SOMEWHAT LESS MARKED BY ENTHUSIASM. POLOFF PASSED SEVERAL TRUCKS BEARING A MOTLEY GROUP OF SERVICEMEN ENROUTE TO RALLY, AND DESPITE MUCH DISPLAY OF KHOMEINI PICTURES AND FLOWERS ON THE VEHICLES, ALONG WITH SOMEWHAT FRENZIED HAND-WAVING AND CHANTING BY SOLDIERS, NO ONE ELSE ON THE STREET SEEMED VERY INTERESTED.

THIS AND OTHER MARCHES HAVE BEEN APTLY DESCRIBED AS "RIPPLES AFTER THE BIG WAVE." OTHER COMMEMORATIVE RALLIES HAVE BEEN PLANNED FOR MARCH 20 AT MARTYRS' SQUARE (FORMERLY JALEH SQUARE) AND ON MARCH 21 AT BEHESHTE-ZAHRA CEMETERY. AYATOLLAH NOURI WILL ADDRESS BOTH GROUPS. AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI, PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN AND MEMBERS OF HIS CABINET WILL ALSO ADDRESS THE LARGE GROUPS EXPECTED TO ATTEND NO RUZ CEREMONIES TOMORROW AT ARYA MEHR STADIUM (NEW NAME UNKNOWN). ON MARCH 22 A MARCH/RALLY IS ALSO BEING PLANNED THROUGHOUT IRAN BY THE ISLAMIC REPUBLICAN PARTY.

THE GOI LODGED A SHARP PROTEST AGAINST AFGHANISTAN'S CHARGE THAT IRANIAN MILITARY WERE INTERVENING IN THE AFGHAN CONFLICT. CLERGYMEN IN QOM IN THE MEANTIME HAVE LED A DEMONSTRATION OF 10,000 STUDENTS AND AFGHAN REFUGEES TO CONDEMN THE KILLINGS IN AFGHANISTAN. A SIMILAR MARCH HAS ALSO BEEN HELD IN THE CASPIAN COAST TOWN OF SARI. THE PERSIAN PRESS CONTINUES TO GIVE WIDE COVERAGE TO THE AFGHAN CONFLICT, INCLUDING REPORTING PRAVADA'S ATTACK ON IRAN AND ON AYATOLLAH SHARIAT-MADARI IN PARTICULAR. MEANWHILE, MFA DEPARTMENT HEAD NOTICED IZVESTIA CHARGE (BROASCAST BY BBC) THAT U.S. AND U.K. WERE INVOLVED IN AFGHAN UPRISING.
POL COUNSELOR TOLD MFA OFFICIAL THIS SEEMS TO PUT US AND PROVISIONAL ISLAMIC REPUBLIC IN THE SAME BOAT.

PRESS REPORTS THAT IN A STATEMENT TO BE RELEASED BY MATINEDAFTARY LATER TODAY, THE NATIONAL DEMOCRATIC FRONT (NDF) HAS DECIDED TO BOYCOTT THE COMING REFERENDUM. THE NDF WANTS THE REFERENDUM TO BE LIMITED TO THE QUESTION OF WHETHER THE MONARCH SHOULD BE REPLACED BY A REPUBLIC, AND DEMANDS THAT A REFERENDUM ON THE NATURE OF THE REPUBLIC BE HELD AT A LATER TIME.

THE POEPLE'S FEDAYEEN HAVE ALSO COME OUT AGAINST THE PROPOSED REFERENDUM, CLAIMING THAT THE VOTING ATMOSPHERE IS "BIASED AND UNDEMOCRATIC", THAT THE CONSTITUTION SHOULD BE MADE PUBLIC FIRST SO THAT PEOPLE WILL KNOW WHAT AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC IS, AND THAT MORE OF A CHOICE BE GIVEN TO THE VOTERS. THE FEDAYEEN HAVE ALSO ANNOUNCED THEIR OPPOSITION TO THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT'S AMNESTY FOR THOSE WHO WHORKED FOR THE PREVIOUS REGIME. NONETHELESS, BAZARGAN HAS TOLD US PRIVATELY HE EXPECTS THE REFERENDUM TO OCCUR AS PLANNED ON MARCH 30.

PAN-IRANIST PARTY LEADER MOHSEN PEZESHKPOUR HAS ASKED ALL PARTY MEMBERS TO VOTE FOR THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC IN THE UPCOMING REDREENDUM, AND ALL IRANIANS TO VOTE IN THE PLEBISCITE BECAUSE IT IS THEIR "NATIONAL" DUTY. PEZESHKPUR HAS JUST RETURNED TO IRAN AFTER AN ABSENCE FOR "MEDICAL TREATMENT" ABROAD.

PRESS REPORTS FOUR KILLED AND MANY INJURED ON THE PERSIAN GULF ISLAND OF QESHM (NEAR BANDAR ABBAS) DURING FIGHTING OVER A GENDARMERIE POST. THE POST WAS ATTACKED AND TAKEN BY A "COUNTERREVOLUTIONARY" FORCE AND LATER RECAPTURED BY REVOLUTIONARY MILITIA. THE PERSIAN PRESS ALSO REPORTS SOME FIGHTING IN BEHBAHAN (BETWEEN SHIRAZ AND AHVAZ). KURDESTAN STRIFE DESCRIBED IN SEPTEL.
THE MINISTRY OF THE INTERIOR HAS ANNOUNCED THE APPOINTMENTS OF SEYED AHMAD TABATABAII AS GOVERNOR GENERAL OF MAZANDARAN PROVINCE AND ALI ASGHAR MANAVI AS GOVERNOR GENERAL OF LURISTAN PROVINCE.

THE MINISTRY OF LABOR AND SOCIAL AFFAIRS ANNOUNCED THAT WORK PERMITS FOR FOREIGN NATIONALS AT THE LOWER SUPERVISORY AND UNSKILLED LEVEL (SUCH AS DRIVERS AND WORKERS) WILL BE VALID ONLY UNTIL APRIL 21. WORK PERMITS FOR HIGHER SUPERVISORY PERSONNEL (SUCH AS ENGINEERS, MANAGERS AND TEACHERS) WILL BE INVALID AFTER JUN

IN CASES WHERE THE FOREIGN EMPLOYEE IS ESSENTIAL., DECISIONS WILL BE MADE AFTER THESE DATES. WE ARE NOT SURE HOW THIS WILL AFFECT EMBASSY THIRD-COUNTRY NATIONALS OR DOMESTIC SERVANTS, BUT WILL INQUIRE FROM LABOR MINISTRY WHEN IT REOPENS.

DESPITE ANNOUNCEMENTS OVER THE NEWS MEDIA THAT THE PASSPORT OFFICE WOULD RESUME PROCESSING APPLICATIONS FOR EXIT PERMITS FOR IRANIAN MALES OVER 18 ON MARCH 19, LARGE CROWDS WERE TURNED WAY YESTERDAY WITH THE EXCUSE THAT THE NECESSARY FORMS HAD NOT YET BEEN RECEIVED.
WE SHALL BE SENDING SITREPS ONLY ON DAYS DURING NO RUZ WHEN VOLUME OF NEWS WARRANTS IT. SULLIVAN NOTE BY OC/T: PARAGRAPHS NUMBERED AS RECEIVED

WHILE THE STORY OF 3,000 AFGHANS BEING KILLED IN IRAN IS INDEED FANTASTIC, IT HAS SOME SMALL BASIS IN FACT. AS REPORTED IN TEHRAN 3095, THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT HAS BEEN ENGATED IN A CONCERTED EFFORT TO ROUND UP AND EXPEL THE NUMEROUS AFGHAN NATIONALS ILLEGALLY IN IRAN. A BASIC MOTIVATION FOR THIS APPEARS TO BE THE REPUTATION AFGHANS ENJOY HERE AS BEING WILD AND LAWLESS. AFGHANS HAVE UNQUESTIONABLY BEEN SUBJECT TO CONSIDERABLE HARASSMENT, INCLUDING OCCASIONAL PHYSICAL ABUSE BY ZEALOUS VIGILANTE GRUPS. A SMALL NUMBER (PROBABLY NO MORE THAN HALF A DOZEN) ACCUSED OF SEXUAL CRIMES HAVE ACTUALLY BEEN EXECUTED FOLLOWING TRIALS BY "REVOLUTIONARY" COURTS.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT.)
SUMMARY: ARMED KURDS IN SANANDAJ LAID SIEGE TO GOVERNMENT POSTS IN SANANDAJ MARCH 18. A CEASEFIRE MARCH 19 PROVED SHORT-LIVED. END SUMMARY.

SEVERE FIGHTING BROKE OUT IN SANANDAJ, THE CAPITAL OF KURDESTAN PROVINCE, ON THE AFTERNOON OF MARCH 18. IT IS STILL NOT CLEAR WHAT PRECIPITATED IT. THE GOVERNMENT-CONTROLED RADIO, THE VOCE OF THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION (VOIR), REPORTED THAT A NUMBER OF OTHERWISE UNIDENTIFIED ARMED PEOPLE WENT TO THE CITY GARRISON TO DEMAND AMMUNITION BUT WERE REFUSED BY THE IMAM JOMEH OFOF SANANDAJ. THEREAFTER, THE CITY'S SHOPS WERE CLOED AND RESIDENTS GATHERED OUTSIDE THE GOVERNOR GENERAL'S OFFICE. THE THAT POINT, ACCORDING TO VOIR, "ANTIREVOLUTIONARY ELEMENTS" BEGAN FIRING INTO THE CROWD, KILLING AND WOUNDING SEVERAL PEOPLE.

THE PRESS, PERHAPS LESS INHIBITED BY THE SELF-CENSORSHIP EXPRCISED AT THE NATIONAL IRANIAN RADIO AND TELEVISION KNIRT) ORGANIZATION, REPORTS EVENTS SLIGHTLY DIFFERENTLY. KAYHAN INTERNATIONAL MARCH 20 SAY THE ARMED GROUP WAS COMPOSED OF KURDS WHO WERE REFUSED AMMUNITION BY THE CLERGYMAN WHO HEADS THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE IN CHARGE OF THE SANADAJ GARRISON. WHEN A CROWD, WHICH INCLUDED THE KURDS WHO WERE DEMANDING AMMUNITION, MOVED TO THE GOVERNOR GENERAL'S OFFICE TO PROTEST THE CLERGYMAN'S ACTION, THE SHOOTING BEGAN. ACCORDING TO VOIR, "A NUMBER OF OPPORTUNISTS AND COUNTERREVOLUTIONARY ELEMENTS".

THEREAFTER CAPTURED THE LOCAL NIRT FACILITIES AND BEGAN TO BROADCAST FALSE CLAIMS IN THE NAME OF THE ARMY COMMANDER TO BE REPRESENTATIVES OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI AND SUPPORTERS OF THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT. THE PRESS SAYS THAT WHEN THE SHOOTING BEGAN THE KURDS CAPTURED THE SANANDAJ GARRISON COMMANDER, AS WELL AS THE NIRT FACILITIES AND SEVERAL POLICE, GENDARMERIE AND MILITARY INSTALLATIONS, AND LAID SIEGE TO THE GARRISON ITSELF.

IN ANY EVENT, FLIGHTING CONTINUED INTO THE AFTERNOON OF MARCH 19 WITH PERHAPS SCORES KILLED AND MAY MORE WOUNDED. (PGOI SPOKESMAN ENTEZAM TOLD PRESS KURDISH REPS TOLD HIM 82 WERE KILLED AND OVER 200 WOUNDED. ENTEZAM LAID THE ORIGINS OF THE INCIDENT TO A MISUNDERSTANDING ABOUT PGOI MOVEMENT OF WHEAT.) BY MID-DAY MARCH 19 KHOMEINI BROADCAST AN APPEAL THAT FIGHTING STOP. KHOMEINI'S STATEMENT CHARGED THAT THE OUTBREAK OF VIOLENCE HAD BEEN INSTIGATED BY A GROUP OF PEOPLE WHO DID NOT WISH TO LEAVE THE MUSLIMS IN PACE.

HE SAID THAT HIS MOVEMENT HAS NO DISPUTE WITH ITS SUNNI BROTHERS, THAT THEY WERE ALL MEMBERS OF A SINGLE NATION AND ADHERENTS TO A SINGLE KORAN. ANYONE WHO ATTACKED THE ARMY, POLICE AND GENDARMETIE, WHICH HE SAID HAD BECOME THE GUARDIANS OF THEMUSLIM PEOPLE'S INTERESTS AND INDEPENDENCE, WAS NOT PART OF THE MUSLIM PROPLE BUT RATHER AN AGENT OF FOREIGNERS.

LATE MARCH 19 THE VOIR ANNOUNCED A CESEFIRE HAD BEEN ARRANGED. APPARENTLY, HOWEVER, IT ALMOST IMMEDIATELY BROKE DOWN, AN IMPRESSION REINFORCED BY VOIR'S REPEATED BROADCAST OF KHOMEINI'S STATEMENT AND ANOTHER APPEAL TO STOP THE SHOOTING MADE BY SEVERAL KURDISH RELIGIOUS LEADERS FROM SAQQEZ DURING THE EARLY HOURS OF MARCH 20. AS NEAR AS WE CAN DETERMINE, THE FIGHTING CONTINUES AS OF 1300 HOURS LOCAL TIME MARCH 20. WE ARE HANDICAPPED IN GETTING INFORMATION BY OUR RELUCTANCE TO APPROACH OUR KURDISH CONTACTS AT THIS TIME, LEST WE GIVE THE IMPRESSION THAT WE SOMEHOW HAVE SOMETHING TO DO WITH THE UPRISING IN SANANDAJ.

WHILE THIS INCIDENT APPEARS TO HAVE BEEN A SPONTANEOUS ONE, AND ONE THAT MANY AMONG THE KURDISH LEADERSHIP MAY NOT HAVE WANTED AT THIS TIME, IT REPRESENTS TWO FACTS THAT WILL CONTINUE TO PLAGUE THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT. THE FIRST IS THAT ITS WRIT IN OUTLING AREAS SUCH AS KURDESTAN IS EXTREMELY TENUOUS. WE WERE RECENTLY TOLD BY AN INDIVIDUAL WHO HAD JUST RETURNED FROM THE REGION THAT THE KURDS FOR THE MOMENT ENJOY A CONSIDERABLE DEGREE OF DE DACTO AUTONOMY BY DEFAULT. SECOND, IRAN'S SUNNIS APPEAR TO BE LESS THATN ENCHANTED BY THE ESSENTIALLY SHIA REVOLUTION IN THIS COUNTRY.

IN ADDITION TO ITS CURRENT TROUBLES WITH THE OVERWHELMINGLY SUNNI JURDS, THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT HAS FACED CONSIDERABLE OPPOSITION FROM OTHER SUNNI STRONGHOLDS AS WELL. THE MOST RECENT INCIDENT (ASIDE FROM THE ONE IN SANANDAJ) OCCURRED ON QESHM ISLAND NEAR BANDAR ABBAS ON MARCH 17 WHEN "COUNTER-REVOLUTIONARY FORCES" (ALMOST CERTAINLY LOCAL SUNNIS) CAPTURED A GENDARMERIE POST. SULLIVAN
C - ENTIRE TEXT.

DURING CONVERSATION MARCH 19, AMBASSADOR ASKED PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN FOR HIS ASSESSMENT OF MUJAHIDDIN STRUCTURE AND LOYALTIES. BAZARGAN LAUNCHED INTO A COMPLICATED EXPLANATION IN FRENCH, WHICH WAS DIFFICULT FOR AMBASSADOR AND POL COUNSELOR TO FOLLOW, BUT APPEARED TO SAY THAT THERE HAD BEEN A SPLIT IN THE MUJAHIDDIN MOVEMENT THREE OR FOUR YEARS AGO, WITH SOME OF THEM FOLLOWING STRICT MARXIST LINE.

THERE WAS A FURTHER SPLIT OF THE MAIN ISLAMIC PARTY LATER ON, WHICH CAN BEST BE DESCRIBED AS HARDLINERS AND SOFTLINERS. THESE PEOPLE ARE DISTINCT FROM THE FEDAYEEN BUT GENERALLY REPRESENT EXTREMIST VIEWS AND HAVE NOT ALWAYS SYPPORTED BAZARGAN'S MOVEMENT. AT THE MOMENT, BOTH THE MUJAHIDDIN AND THE FEDAYEEN SAY THEY ARE SUPPORTING THE MOVEMENT BUT BAZARGAN INDICATED HE DID NOT PUT MUCH FAITH IN THAT.

BAZARGAN NOTED IN PASSING THAT THE ORIGINAL FEDAYEEN, WHO HAD BEEN INVOLVED IN THE SIAKHALH UPRISING, WERE PRACTICALLY WIPED OUT. OTHERS TOOK UP THEIR NAME AND TRADITION LATER JUST AS THE MUJAHIDDIN PICKED UP GLORIOUS NAMES FROM IRAN'S PAST.

COMMENT: UNLIKE YAZDI, TALEGHANI AND SOME OTHERS IT WOULD APPEAR BAZARGAN DOES NOT CONSIDER THE MUJAHIDDIN AS AN INTEGRAL PART OF HIS MOVEMENT. NEVERTHELESS, MUJAHIDDIN FORCES ARE INVOLVED IN PROTECTION OF THE EMBASSY, AMONG OTHER TASKS, AND BAZARGAN'S REACTION REINFORCES A QUESTION IN OUR MINDS AS TO THE EXACT ROLE AND ALLEGIANCES OF DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER YAZDI. AS A BRIDGE BETWEEN THE GOVERNMENT AND THE COMMITTEES, YAZDI IS CLEARLY VERY POWERFUL IN HIS OWN RIGHT AND APPEARS ABLE TO INFLUENCE, AND EVEN GIVE ORDERS TO THE

POL CONUNSELOR CONVEYED EDS' REFTEL MESSAGE TO MFS'S LEGAL ADVISOR KAZMI WHO REFERRED THE MATTER TO FOURTH POLITICAL DIVISION CHIEF GOUDABZNIA. ON MARCH 19, GOUNDARZNIA, AWARE OF OUR DISCUSSION WITH KAZEMI, SAID ANY RESPONSE SHOULD AWAIT RESUMPTION OF WORK AGTER NEW YEAR'S HOLIDAYS, I.E. MARCH 26, BY WHICH TIME KAZEMI SHOULD HAVE RETURNED FROM EUROPE.
(C- ENTIRE TEXT.)

THERE IS A CERTAIN SURREALISM IN IRAN THESE DAYS. IT IS THE SEASON OF NOW RUZ AND SPRING HAS COME GLORIOUSLY TO TEHRAN. THE SKIES ARE BLUE, NOW STILL CAPS THE ELBORZ RANGE, AND GARDENS HAVE BEGUN TO FLOWER. TRAFFIC IN THE STREET, IS DENSE, BUSINESS IN THE BAZAAR IS BRISK, AND THE CITY SEEMS ALMOST NORMAL.

IN THE COLUMNS OF THE PRESS, NEWS APPEARS TO BE REPORTED FREELY, AND BOTH THE FARSI AND DOREIGN LANGUAGE DAILIES FEATURE A LIVELY POLITICAL DEBATE. GOVERNMENT MINISTERS MAKE PRONOUNCEMENTS AND MAINTAIN THE PRESUMPTION THAT THEY ARE MOVING THE COUNTRY AHEAD POLITICALLY AND ECONOMICALLY. ATTENTION IS CENTERED UPON THE REFERENDUM WHICH IS SCHEDULED TO BE HELD MARCH 30 TO DETERMINE WHETHER IRAN WILL BECOME AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC.

ON RADIO AND TELEVISION, THE IRANIAN PUBLIC IS TREATED TO ENDLESS HARANGUES BY AYATOLLAHS AND MULLAHS, AS WELL AS BY POETS AND POLEMICISTS WHO EXTOL THE REVOLUTION AND THE TENETS OF ISLAM. THEIR MONOLOGUES ARE GIVEN IN SOLEMN TONES, BUT THE CONTENTS ARE GENERALIZED AND SOPORIFIC.

DIVERSION OCCUR WHICH ATTACT ACUTE INTEREST, SUCH AS THE FOUR DAY FUROR OVER THE CHADOR. THE WOMEN SEEM TO HAVE WON THAT SKIRMISH WITH THE AYATOLLAH, BUT THEIR FUTURE STATUS IS MUCH IN DOUBT. GUN BATTLES SUDDENLY ERUPT, AS WHEN A GROUP OF DETAINEES ATTEMPTED TO ESCAPE FROM A DOWNTOWN PRISON MARCH 18. THE NIGHTS ARE STILL FILLED WITH THE SOUNDS OF SPORADIC SHOOTING, AND ROADBLOCKS STILL DISRUPT TRAFFIC AFTER DARK.

FOR MOST RESIDENT OF IRAN, HOWEVER, THE MOST SIGNIFICANT FACT OF LIFE IS THE "KOMITAY", THE MOST NEIGHBORHOOD, EVERY MOSQUE, EVERY OFFICE, EVERY INDUSTRIAL PLANT HAS A "KOMITAY." IF IS NOT ENTIRELY CLEAR WHO OR WHAT AUTHORIZES THE EXISTENCE OF THESE GROUPS. HOWEVER, THEY GAIN THEIR STATUS FROM THE FACT THAT THEIR MEMBERS HAVE LETHAL WEAPONS--USUALLY THE UBIQUITOUS G-3 AUTOMATIC RIFLE. THESE GROUPS ATTEMPT TO REGULATE ALL FACETS OF LIFE THAT FALL WITHIN THEIR PURVIEW.

IN THE MINISTERIES, THE KOMITAYS DECIDE WHAT, IF ANYTHING, THE GOVERNMENT CAN DO. SINCE THEY DON'T USUALLY REACH A CONSENSUS, THIS GENERALLY MEANS THAT NOTHING GERS DONE. IN THE ARMED FORCES, THEY DECIDE ON WHO SHOULD BE THE COMMANDER AND WAHT THE DAILY ROUTINE SHOULD BE. IN THE NEIGHBORHOODS, THEY CONTROL MOVEMENT, INVESTIGATE REMANATS OF THE OLD REGIME, AND REGULATE MORALITY.

IF A PERSON LEADS A QUIET, SHELTERED LIFE AND HEEDS A FAMILIAR ROUTINE, IT IS POSSIBLE, PARTICULARLY IN THE NORTHERN SUBURBS OF TEHRAN, TO IGNORE THE FACT THAT A REVOLUTION HAS TAKEN PLACE. VERY LITTLE HAS CHANGED FROM THE BAD OLD DAYS. HOWEVER, IF ONE ATTEMPTS TO MOVE HIS HOUSEHOLD, UNDERTAKE A BANKING TRANSACTION, LEAVE THE COUNTRY, OR OTHERWISE BREAK THE ACCEPTED ROUTINE, THERE IS AN INEVITABLE TANGLE OF KOMITAYS TO CONTEND WITH. AS ONE KOMITAY BECOMES SATISFIED, USUALLY BY A LETTER FROM A MINISTER OR AN AYATOLLAH, ANOTHER KOMITAY WITH OVERLAPPING JURISDICTION AND A DIFFERENT POINT OF VIEW, RENEWS THE OBSTRUCTION.
ALMOST ANY ENDEAVOR CAN BE FRUSTRATED INDEFINITELY IN THIS MAZE.

IF, ON THE OTHER HAND, A PERSON OR A FAMILY IS ASSOCIATED IN THE MIND OF THE REVOLUTIONARIES WITH THE PAHLAVI DYNASTY, THE REVOLUTION IS A REIGN OF TERROR. A KOMITAY ARRESTS THE PERSON WHO IS REGARDED AS CULPRIT AND TAKES HIM TO PRISON, WHERE HE IS HELD INCOMMUNICADO.HE IS ALLOWED NO RPT NO CREATURE COMFORTS BEYOND WHAT THE KOMITAY PROVIDES. UP UNTIL LAST WEEK, HE WAS LIABLE, ALMOST AT RANDOM, TO FACE AN "ISLAMIC COURT" AND A SUMMARY EXCUTION BY FIRING SQUAD. THESE STAR CHAMBER PROCEDURES HAVE PRESUMABLY BEEN HALTED, BY AGREEMENT BETWEEN BAZARGAN AND KHOMEINI, BUT NOBODY IS QUITE SURE NOT DEFINITIVELY.

WHILE THE DESIGNATED CULPRIT LANGUISHES IN PRISON, HIS WHOUSE IS USUALLY INVADED BY OTHER LOMITAY GROUPS AND RATHER DISCRIMINATELY LOOTED. HIS FAMILY MAY BE PUT THROUGH INTERROGATIONS, HIS BUSINESS OR OTHER INTERESTS SEQUESTERED AND HIS LIFE GENERALLY REDUCED TO MISERY. AS A RESULT OF THIS SORT OF EXPERIENCE, MOST BUSINESS LEADERS WHO HAVE ENJOYED ANY SUCCESS UNDER THE OLD REGIME HAVE CHOSEN TO VLSO BROAD RATHER THAN RISK RETURN.

THE CONFUSION AMONG THE KOMITAYS REFLECTS THE LARGER CONFUSION IN THE NATION AS A WHOLE. THE REVOLUTION WHICH SWEPT AWAY T HE SHAH HAD SOLID POPULAR SUPPORT FOR THAT NEGATIVE OBJECTIVE, BUT NO RPT NO GENUINE CONSENSUS FOR THE FUTURE. KHOMEINI HAS EMERGED FROM THE PROCESS AS THE GENUINE LEADER OF THE REVOLUTIONARIES, BUT HIS GRIP UPON THEIR IDEOLOGIES AND ACTIOAKV HAS EVEN LESS SUCCESS IN ARTICULAT ING OR CONTROLLING A UNIFORM SET OF POLICIES.

THE REFERENDUM IS SHAPING UP AS SOMETHING OF A CATALYST FOR THESE VARYING REVOLUTIONARY INTERESTS. SOME GROUPS HAVE ANNOUNCED THEY WILL BOYCOTT IT, WHILE OTHERS ARE DEMANNDING THAT IT S FORM AND SUBSTANCE BE REVISED. ONBALANCE, HOWEVER, MOST PEOPLE ACCEPT THAT THE REFERENDUM WILL BE HELD AND THAT ITS RESULT WILL BE AN OVERWHELMING VOTE IN FAVOR OF AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. IT IS ONLY AFTER THAT TRANSACTION GETS OUT THE WAY THAT POLITICIAL ACTIVITY MAY TAKE ON A MORE COGENT COLORATION.

ONE FUTURE ISSUE WILL BE THE CONSTITUTION, AND WHETHER IT WILL BE THE PRODUCT OF A FORMATIVE PROCESS OR WHETHER IT WILL BE FORCED DOWN THE PUBLIC THROAT IN THE SAME WAY AS THE REFERENDUM. ANOTHER ISSUE WILL BE THE GENERAL ELECTIONS, IF AND WHEN THEY TAKE PLACE. IN THESE VARIOUS CONTESTS, IT WOOULD BE LOGICAL TO EXPECT THAT SOMEWHAT MORE FORMALIZED POLITICAL GROUPINGS WILL EMERGE TO CONTEND WITH EACH OTHER. SUCH GROUPINGS ARE BEING CREATED NOW, ALONG WITH OTHER ORGANS OF MORE SINISTER INTENT.

IT WOULD BE FOOLHARDY TO EXPECT, HOWEVER, THAT THESE FUTURE POLITICAL CONTESTS WILL BE FOUGHT OUT IN THE BEST HYDE PARK AND HUSTINGS MANNER. GROUPS WHICH POSSESS LARGE QUANTITIES OF WEAPONS AND WHICH HAVE BEEN USED TO BRANDISHING THEM TO GET THEIR WAY WILL BE RELUCTANT TO RELY UPON DEBATE AND SWEET REASON INORDER TO PRODUCE POLITICAL PERSUASION. INSTEAD, THESE ARMED GROUPS WILL BE AT A PREMIUM IN THE STRUGGLES AHEAD. THOSE WITH THE MOST FIREPORWER AND MOST RUTHLESS LEADERSHIP WILL BE SOUGHT OUT BY POLITICAL LEADERS FOR THEIR SUPPORT. A TYPE OF WARLORDISM CAN BE EXPECTED TO EMERGE.
SINCE THE NATIONAL SECUIRTY FORCES ARE SHATTERED AND WEAK, THEY CAN HARDLY BE EXPECTED TO RESTRAIN THE TENDENCY.
POLITICS IN IRAN SEEM LIKELY TO BE LIVELY IN THE NEAR FUTURE, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN A GRATIFYING SORT OF

CENTRAL BANK OF IRAN: THE PREDICTED NAMING OF THE NEW VICE GOVERNORS REPORTED REF A IS NOW FACT. ADDITIONALLY, ECONOMIC RADICAL ABOL HASSAN BENI-SADR AND MULLAH AKBAR HASHEMI RAFSANJANI WERE NAMED TO REPLACE TWO MAJLIS DEPUTIES ON THE NOTE RESERVE CONTROL BOARD, APPOINTMENTS DESCRIBED BY CONTACTS HARMLESS TO POLICY. TWO DIRECTORS GENERAL, CLOSE CONTACT FEREYDOUN FARHANS (EXCHANGE CONTROL) AND THAT FOR ACCOUNTING HAVE SUBMITTED RESIGNATIONS IN FACE OF EMPLOYEE COMPLAINTS BUT THEY HAVE NOT YET BEEN ACCEPTED BY MOWLAVI. THE CONFUSION AS TO THE AUTHORITY BEHIND THE CBI'S REPRESENTATIVE TO EACH DEPOSIT BANK'S HEADQUARTERS LIES IN FACT THAT THE ACTING DIR. GEN.

FOR BANK SUPERVISION, REJAII, IS ALSO A MEMBER OF THE FIVE-MAN REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE IN THE CBI. DIR. GEN. NADERI SAYS IN FACT THAT THE REPRESENTATIVE IS APPOINTED BY CBI MANAGEMENT. THE REPRESENTATIVE MUST APPROVE MATTERS REFERRED BY A BANK TO THE CBI, FOR EXAMPLE AN APPLICATION FOR FOREIGN EXCHANGE PURCHASE. NADERI SAYS THAT THE CBI'S REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTE'S ACTIVITY HAS REDUCRED TO CHIEFLY ACTING AS LIAISON ON ADMINISTRATIVE MATTERS BETWEEN THE GOVERNOR AND THE DEPARTMENTS. NADERI AFFIRMS THAT CBI, THOUGH HARDLY BACK TO NORMAL, HAS NOT CHANGED PROCEDURES, TEST KEYS OR REGULATIONS SUCH AS THOSE OF NOV. 15 APPLYING TO FOREIGN EXCHANGE.
FURTHER, THERE HAVE BEEN NO CHANGES IN INTEREST RATES, DISCOUNT FACILITIES ORATES.

IMPORT DOCUMENTATION: NADERI DOUBTS THERE HAVE BEEN MANY LETTERS OF CREDIT OPENED SINCE THE REVOLUTION FEB. 10. WE ARE TRYING TO ASCERTAIN MAGNITUDE OF IMPORT REGISTRATIONS. NADERI SAID THAT THE CBI HAS TOLD PRIVATE SECTOR IT CAN ONLY OPEN LCS ON FOOD STUFFS AND PHARMACEUTICALS. AN AMERICAN BANK REP KNEW OF THREE LCS OPENED, ONE FOR RICE (DOLS 10.8 MILLION TO U.S.' CONTINENTAL) AND TWO DAIRY ORDERS TO THE DUTCH. CBI BANKS REQUIRE 100 PERCENT PRIOR PAYMENT AND CONFIRMED LCS.

FOREIGN EXCHANGE: EMBASSY/USG FORECASTS OF IRAN'S FOREIGN EXCHANGE RESERVES ARE VIRTUALLY FOR NAUGHT OWNING TO THE REQUIREMENT THAT ALL FX PURCHASES BACKLOGGED BEFORE THE REVOLUTION MUST BE RESUBMITTED. THUS, WITH LESS THAN ANTICIPATED PAYMENTS AFTER CBI WORK RESUMPTION, NADERI'S REVELATION THAT FX RESERVES O/A MARCH 18 WERE AT DOLS 10.2 BILLION IS NOT TOO GREAT A SURPRISE. SEVERAL MAJOR US BANKS HAVE REPORTED SIGNIFICANT PAYMENTS BY IRAN, TO QUESTION AS TO HOW RESERVES COULD THEREFORE STILL BE SO HIGH NADERI RESPONDED THAT SOME UNEXPECTED OIL REVENUE HAS BEEN RECEIVED. EXPECTED TRICKLES HAVE COME AS 60-DAY PAYMENT LAGS FROM EXPORTS UP TO DEC 26 AND SUBSEQUENT BUNKER OIL SALES.

SINCE MARCH 5 RESUMPTION THERE HAVE BEEN SOME RECEIPTS DUE TO CASH SALES, BUT NADERI COMPLAINEDMILDLY THAT NIOC IS NOT NOTIFYING CBI CONCERNING TERMS OF ITS SALES, WHICH APPEAR TO RANGE FROM CASH TO 15, 25 OR 30 DAYS. THE POSSIBILITY OF UNEXPECTED REVENUES IS WITH PRECEDENT. EMBASSY HAS ALWAYS FOUND GAPS BETWEEN RECEIPTS ON BALANCE OF PAYMENTS AND RECEIPTS PROJECTED FROM ACTUAL OIL EXPORTS. SHORTLY AFTER ANSARY ASSUMED HEAD OF NIO HE ORDERED REPATRIATED RIALS 85 BILLION (SOME DOLS 1.2 BN). WE MAY HAVE SEEN NOW A SIMILAR THOUGH SMALLER REPATRIATION. EVEN WITH ASSUMED, CONSIDERABLE PRE-NO RUZ PAYMENTS,WE DOUBT THAT FX RESERVES WOULD DROP BELOW DOLS 9 BN.

ASSUMING NADERI'S INFORMATION IS CORRECT. THUS, WITH OFFICIAL FS RESERVES AT DOLS 11.5 BILLION MARCH 20, 1978, THE BASIC BALANCE DEFICIT SHOULD NOT EXCEED DOLS 2.6 BN AND MAY BE CLOSER TO DOLS 1.5 BN. THE VERY SLOW RESUMPTION IN IMPORT PAYMENTS, WITH FULLY CONFIRMED/PADID LCS BEING THE ORDER OF DAY, WE MAY STILL HAVE RESERVES IN THE DOLS 7 TO 8 BN LEVEL BY END JUNE.

GOI ARREARAGES ON FOREIGN DEBT: MEAF'S KHALEGHI-ROD MARCH 18 SAID IT WOULD NOT BE POSSIBLE TO CATCH UP ON LATE DEBT SERVICE BEFORENOW RUZ (MARCH 21), CHIEFLY OWNING TO THE DIFFICULTY IN REACHING OFFICIALS OF GOI AGENCIES. HE AND CBI CONTACT SAY SUCH ARREARAGES DO NOT EXCEED DOLS 40 MILLION. US BANKER SAYS A PAYMENT FROM THE INDUSTRIAL CREDIT BANK IS DUE MARCH 20 AND NONE IN THAT BANK CAN BE REACHED.

CBI RELIEF FOR EXTERNAL OBLIGATIONS: NADERI SAID THAT EX-MINISTER PIRASTEH'S PROPOSAL (AUTHORED BY NADERI) TO PROVDE UP TO 50 PERCENT CBI RELIEF FOR BANKS' EXTERNAL OUTSTANDING IS DEAD, BUT A COMMITTEE IS TO STUDY NEEDS, ESPECIALLY OF THOSE BANKS SO ILLIQUID THEY CANNOT BUY FOREIGN EXCHANGE(THE PROBLEM RAISED WITH THE GOVERNOR, REF B). IN ONLY ONE CASE HAS CBI RESCUED A BANK, THE IMDBI, AND THAT BECAUSE IMDBI WAS ABOUT TO ADVISE 45 FOREIGN BANKS OF A SIX MONTHS DEBT MORITORIUM O/A MARCH 12 OR 15, AT THE SAME TIME MOWLAVI WAS SAYING IRAN WOULD MEET ALL ITS FOREIGN DEBT OBLIGATIONS.

STATUS OF US BANK REPRESENTATIVE OFFICES: CITIBANK'S LAWRENCE, THE REPLACEMENT FOR KELLEY, MADE A ONE DAY MARCH 17 VISIT FROM ATHENS. HE AND TWO OTHERS PLAN TO RETURN O/A APRIL 15. FIRST NATIONAL OF CHICAGO'S VON PELSER JUST COMPLETED ALMOST THREE WEEKS HERE AND DESCRIBED THE TIME AS WELL SPENT FROM THE PUBLIC RELATIONS ASPECT AND MODERATELY SUCCESSFUL IN TERMS OF COLLECTIONS AND OTHER BANK BUSINESS. HE DID NOT EXPERIENCE ANY PERSONAL SECURITY PROBLEMS AND LIVED IN HIS USUAL HOME. BANK OF AMERICA AND CITIBANK DO HAVE IRANIAN OFFICERS IN THEIR REP OFFICES. CHASE DOES NOT. CHASE'S MAUTNER AND LAMPSHIRE PLAN TO RETURN O/A APRIL 5.

SEVERAL OTHER REPS PLAN SHORT TRIPS TO TEHRAN IN APRIL. NADERI'S STATEMENT TO WALL STREET JOURNAL THAT US REPS WERE, WITH BRITISH, LEAST FAITHFUL TO IRAN AND THAT FRENCH REPS HAD NEVER LEFT, STRAYED FROM FACT. FRENCH WERE AMONG LAST TO LEAVE BUT DID LEAVE AND ARE ONLY NOW RETURNING. JAPANESE APPEAR TO BE EVEN MORE RELUCTANT TO RETURN THAN US AND BANK CONTACTS SAY THAT JAPANESE ARE MOST INSISTENT, IMPATIENT ON ISSUE OF PAYMENTS.

1979TEHRAN03151.subject: SECURITY OF EMBASSY PERSONNEL AND COMPOUND

segments.text: (C - ENTRIE TEXT.)

REFTEL INDICATES SIGNIFICANT MISUNDERSTANDING OF NATURE SECURITY THREAT THIS COMPOUND WOULD FACE IF FEDAYEEN CHOSE TO ATTACK. THEY COULD BRING SEVERAL THOUSAND PERSONS TO SURROUND US, SEVERAL HUNDRED OF WHOM WOULD BE ARMED. THEY COULD POUR IN AUTOMATIC WEAPONS FIRE FROM SURROUNDING ROOFTOPS AND PIN DOWN ALL MOVEMENT WHILE THEY PROCEEDED METHODICALLY TO DESTROY EMBASSY BUILDINGS.
IN LIGHT OF THIS TYPE THREAT, MEASURES POSED PARA 3 REFTEL ARE LARGELY IRRELEVANT. OUR BEST DEFENSE IS TO HAVE AS MANY IRANIANS AS POSSIBLE INSIDE COMPOUND TO INHIBIT INDISCRIMINATE SHOOTING.

OUR BEST -PRE-EMPTIVE ACTION IS TO HAVE IRANIAN AUTHORITIES WARN PLO AND FEDAYEEN AGAINST ATTACKING US. WE HAVE SPOKEN TO AUTHORITIES HERE. WE WANT YOU TO SPEAK TO ROUHANI AND HAVE ASK YAZDI, WHO IS CLOSE TO PLO REPRESENTATIVE, TO DESIST FROM ANY PROVOCATIONS
(S - ENTIRE TEXT.)

A POLITICALLY ALERT IRANIAN, WHO HAS JUST RETURNED TO TEHRAN FROM A VISIT TO ARDABIL, TOLD ME EVENING MARCH 20 THAT HE WAS ALARMED BY SITUATION IN AZERBAIJAN. HE SAID "AUTONOMY" COMMITTEES ARE BEING FORMED IN EVERY TOWN AND VILLAGE TO PREPARE FOR AN UPRISING AGAINST THE AUTHORITY OF THE TERHRAN GOVERNMENT. IT WAS HIS VIEW THAT, ONCE THESE COMMITTEES HAVE DONE THEIR WORK, IT WILL ONLY BE "AN OVERNIGHT JOB" FOR AZERBAIJAN TO PROCLAIM AUTONOMY, INDEPENDENCE, OR A PEOPLE'S REPUBLIC.

IN HIS VIEW, SOVIETS WERE STAGE MANAGING THE ENTIRE OPERATION WITH ASSETS LEFT OVER FROM THE IMMEDIATE POSTWAKE PERIOD WHO HAVE BEEN RELEASED FROM PRISON IN THE WAKE OF THE RECENT REVOLUTION. HE FEARS THAT WE MAY SEE REPLAY OF 1946-47 EVENT IN AZERBAIJAN.

HE ALSO ATTRIBUTES CURRENT SOVIET PROPAGANDA OFFENSIVE AGAINST IRAN, U.S., AND U. K. WITH RESPECT TO AFGHANISTAN AS PREPARATORY SOMKESCREEN DESIGEND TO SET THE STAGE FOR A "BIG LIE" CAMPAIGN ABOUT SUBVERSIVE ACTIVITIES IN SOVIET AZERBAIJAN WHICH WILL PRECEDE "AUTONOMY" DRIVE
C - ENTIRE TEXT

THE GOVERNMENT-CONTROLLED VOICE OF THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION'S FAILURE TO CONFIRM A NEW CEASEFIRE IN SANANDAJ DURING EARLY MORNING NEWSCASTS LEADS US TO CONCLUDE THAT FIGHTING PROBABLY CONTINUES THERE. REPEATED BROADCASTS OF AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI'S APPEAL TO THE KURDS TO LAY DOWN THEIR ARMS, FIRST MADE EVENING MARCH 20 AND AGAIN THIS MORNING, WOULD ALSO INDICATE THIS. REFERRING TO THE KURDS AS FELLOW IRANIANS AND CO-RELIGIONISTS, TALEGHANI SAID THAT THEIR LEGITIMATE DEMANDS WOULD BE MET AND THAT AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI IS PREPARED TO SEND A PERSONAL REPRESENTATIVE TO KURDESTAN TO LOOK INTO THEIR GRIEVANCES.

WE DOUBT THAT SENDING A PERSONAL REPRESENTATIVE FROM KHOMEINI WILL HAVE MUCH EFFECT. KHOMEINI, BAZARGAN AND THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT HAVE ALREADY SENT PERSONAL REPRESENTATIVES TO KURDESTAN AS WELL AS OTHER AREAS WITH CONCENTRATIONS OF ETHNIC MINORITIES. RECEPTION OF THESE DELEGATIONS HAVE RANGED FROM COOL TO DOWNRIGHT HOSTILE.

WE HAVE BEEN HEARING MORE AND MORE REPORTS OF UNREST AMONG VARIOUS OF IRAN'S ETHNIC MINORITIES, INCLUDING THE AZARBAIJANI TURKS (BEING REPORTED SEPTEL). WE SUSPECT THIS PHONOMENON WILL INCREASE IN INTENSITY, AND POSES A VERY SERIOUS PROBLEM INDEED FOR THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT.

SUMMARY: UNREST CONTINUES IN KURDESTAN. SEVEN INDIVIDUALS ASSOCIATED WITH THE PAHLAVI REGIME ARRESTED. MEMBERS OF NEW SUPREME COURT NAMED. ENTEZAM DEFENDS REVOLUTIONARY JUSTICE. AFGHAN "REFUGEES" DEMAND OVERTHROW OF TARAKI GOVERNMENT. MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS CONDUCTS PURGE. LOUD FIRING IN TEHRAN PUT DOWN TO NEW YEAR'S EXUBERANCE. END SUMMARY.
FIGHTING IN KURDESTAN APPARENTLY IS CONTINUING (SEPTEL).

SEVEN PROMINENT INDIVIDUALS ASSOCIATED WITH THE PAHLAVI REGIME HAVE BEEN ARRESTED. THE SEVEN ARE ALI QOLI ARDALAN, THE LAST MINISTER OF COURT; GEN HOSSEIN FARDOUST, THE FORMER DIRECTOR OF THE INPERIAL INSPECTORATE; SAFE ASFIAN, FORMER ASSISTANT TO THE PRIME MINISTER FOR ECONOMIC MATTERS; GEN (RET) MOHAMMAD ALI SAFARI, FORMER DIRECTOR OF THE COMMITTEE FOR CONSUMER PROTECTION; FORMER SENATOR MOHSEN KHAJENOURI; NASSER YENAGEH, FORMER PRESIDENT OF THE SURPREME COURT; AND MANOUCHEHR ZELLI, FORMER DEPUTY FOREIGN MINISTER. IN ADDITION TO THESE INDIVIDUALS, GEN (RET) AMIR HOSSEIN ATAPOUR, FATHER OF JOURNALIST FARIBORZ ATAPOUR, WAS ALSO REPORTED TO HAVE BEEN ARRESTED ON UNDISCLOSED CHARGES.

THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT HAS ANNOUNCED THE NAMES OF FIVE NEW MEMBERS OF THE SUPREME COURT. THEY ARE MEHDI SAJADIAN, FATHOLLAH BANI-SADR, DR. HASSAN FAGHIN NAKHJIRI, NOUR SHAMS SHAHSHAHANI, AND SHEIKH HOSSEIN TABATABAIE. TWO INTERIM MEMBERS, MOHAMMAD HOD AND JAMAL TAJAMOLI, WERE ALSO NAMED.

DEPUTY PM AT HIS NEWS CONFERENCE MARCH 20 JUSTIFIED REVOLUTIONARY JUSTICE IN RESPONSE TO COMPLAINTS FROM A VARIETY OF QUARTERS ABOUT ITS CONDUCT. ENTEZAM SAID "THAT IN VIEW OF THE ATROCIOUS ACTS AND BARBAROUS AND HORRIBLE SLAYINGS PERPETRATED BY MOST OF THOSE EXECUTED AGAINST THE FREEDOM-SEEKING AND HONORABLE PEOPLE OF IRAN ON THE ONE HAND AND THE LEVEL OF THE KILLINGS, BLOODSHED AND THE DESTRUCTION THAT HAVE TAKEN PLACE IN OTHER POLITICAL AND SOCIAL REVOLUTIONS IN THE WORLD ON THE OTHER HAND, WHAT IS TAKING PLACE IN IRAN CAN BE OVERLOOKED AND IS EXTREMELY INSIGNIFICANT".

ENTEZAM SAID THAT IT HAD BEEN IMPOSSIBLE TO THWART ENTIRELY THE PEOPLE'S DESIRE FOR REVENGE, BUT THAT IN ANY EVENT THE WORK OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS HAD BEEN SUSPENDED AND THAT THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT IS ATTEMPTING TO WORK OUT PROCEDURES GOVERNING ARRESTS, INTERROGATION, TRIALS AND SENTENCING.

THE GOVERNMENT-CONTROLLED VOICE OF THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION ANNOUNCED MARCH 20 THAT ABOUT 5,000 AFGHAN "REFUGEES" AND A NUMBER OF SYMPATHETIC IRANIANS MARCHED ON THE AFGHAN EMBASSY IN TEHRAN EARLIER THE SAME DAY AND DEMANDED THE OVERTHROW OF THE TARAKI GOVERNMENT.

THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS IS REPORTEDLY CARRYING OUT A PURGE OF PERSONNEL. AN ANNOUNCEMENT MARCH 21 SAID THAT 21 AMBASSADORS, 14 CONSULS AND CONSULS-GENERAL, AND AN UNDISCLOSED NUMBER OF OTHER MFA OFFICIALS HAVE BEEN RECALLED FROM THEIR POSTS AND EITHER HAVE OR WILL BE RETIRED.
LOUD AUTOMATIC WEAPONS FIRE IN EARLY MORNING HOURS IN TEHRAN AND AROUND 9 A.M. ONCE AGAIN IS BEING EXPLAINED AS CELEBRATORY FOR ARRIVAL OF NEW YEAR.

1979TEHRAN03166.subject: SECURITY OF EMBASSY PERSONNEL AND COMPOUND

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

DURING MARCH 21 NOW RUZ RECEPTION AT PRIME MINISTRY, I SPOKE WITH YAZDI ABOUT DANGER TO OUR COMPOUND IF PLO AND FEDAYEEN DECIDE TO SPONSOR VIOLENT REACTION TO EGYPTIAN-ISRAELI PEACE TREATY. YAZDI SAID HE FELT THERE WAS NO RPT NO DANGER BECAUSE HE THOUGHT PLO REACTION IN TEHRAN WOULD BE VERY MILD. HE NEVERTHELESS AGREED TO DIRECT ADDITIONAL SECURITY PRECAUTIONS.

EGYPTIAN AMBASSADOR TELLS ME THAT ENTEZAM HAS PRIVATELY INDICATED TO FOREIGN JOURNALISTS THAT PGOI HAS NO RPT NO BASIC PROBLEMS WITH TREATY AND WILL REFRAIN FROM PUBLIC CRITICISM. AMBASSADOR FEELS THIS IS ENCOURAGING SIGN.

NEVERTHELESS, GENERAL GAST AND I, IN ACCORDANCE WITH YOUR SUGGESTION, ARE MOVING PERSONNEL DISCREETLY OUT OF COUNTRY. BY MARCH 27, HE WILL BE DOWN TO 25 PEOPLE AND POSSIBLY LESS. EMBASSY STAFF WILL BE SKELETAL FROM MARCH 27 UNTIL APPROXIMATELY APRIL 2, WHEN SEVERAL OFFICERS ARE SCHEDULED TO RETURN FROM VISITATION TRAVEL.
S - ENTIRE TEXT

ON MARCH 21, I MENTIONED TO DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER ENTEZAM FACT THAT I HAD LEARNED FROM AN IRANIAN FRIEND ABOUT "AUTONOMY" COMMITTEES BEING FORMED IN AZERBAIJAN. ENTEZAM SAID HE HAD SIMILAR INFORMATION AND WAS DISTURBED BY ITS IMPLICATIONS.

HOWEVER, WHEN I ASKED TURKISH AMBASSADOR IF HE HAD ANY SUCH REPORTS, HE EXPRESSED VIEW INFORMATION WAS EXAGGERATED. HE FELT AZERBAIJANIS SHOULD BE SATISFIED WITH BAZARGAN, BECAUSE "HE WAS ONE OF THEIR OWN".

1979TEHRAN03169.subject: POST REVOLUTION SOCIAL AFFAIRS IN TEHRAN

segments.text: (C- ENTIRE TEXT.)

ON MARCH 20 AND 21, I ATTENDED MY FIRST TWO REVOLUTIONARY RECEPTIONS IN TEHRAN. FIRST, ON MARCH 20, WAS SPONSORED BY NIOC TO CELEBRATE NATIONALIZATION OF IRANIAN OIL ON THAT DATE IN 1951. SECOND, ON MARCH 21, WAS TRADITIONAL NOW RUZ SALAAM, WHICH DIPLOMATIC CORPS UED TO MAKE TO SHAH. AT INVITIATIVE OF BULGARIN, WHO IS ACTING DOYEN, SALAAM WAS GIVEN TO PRIME MINISTER BZARGAN, WHO WAS SLOS GUEST OF HONOR AT NICO.

AT NIOC, I WAS SURPRISED TO FIND QUITE A NUMBER OF FAMILIAR FACES, INCLUDING THE YOUNGER FALLAH BROTHER AND SEVERAL BUSINESSMEN WHO WERE PROMINENT IN THE OLD REGIME. THEY ALL SEEMED A LITTLE NERVOUS. THE DIPLOMATIC CORPS WAS THERE IN FORCE.
THE RECEPTION WAS RATHER AUSTERE, WITH ORGANGE JUICE, COCA-COLA AND TEA BEING SERVED. TABLE WERE PILED WITH SWEET PASTRIES WHICH NOBODY ATE. A FEW BEARDED, REVOLUTIONARY TYPES STOOD AROUND THE EDGES.

I HAD A CHANCE FOR A FEW MINUTES CHAT WITH NIOC MANAGING DIRECTOR, DR. NAZIEH. I ASKED WHETHER IT WAS TRUE HE HAD DRAFTED THE NEW CONSTITUTION TO BE PRESENTED PUBLICLY IN THE NEAR FUTURE. HE SAID THAT, AS A CONSTITUTIONAL LAWYER, HE HAD BEEN INVITED TO PARIS TO "REVIEW" THE NEW CONSTITUTION BEFORE KHOMEINI'S RETURN TO TEHRAN. IN THE EVENT, HE WAITED SEVERAL DAYS IN HIS HOTEL TO RECEIVE A COPY OF THE DOCUMENT, AND THEN FINALLY GAVE UP AND LEFT WITHOUT EVER RECEIVING ONE. CONSEQUENTLY, HE HAS NO IDEA WHAT IS IN THE NEW CONSTITUTION.

THE CENTERPIECE ONF THE NIOC RECEPTION WAS THE ARRIVAL OF BAZARGAN, ENTEZAM, AND YAZDI. ON THEIR ARRIVAL, THREE SPEECHES WERE MADE; ONE BY NAZIEH, ONE BY BAZARGAN AND ONE BY A "WORKER". THE FIRST TWO WERE TEMPERATE STATEMENTS WHICH WERE TRANSLATED INTO ENGLISH BY AN NICO INTERPRETER. THE THIRD WAS A FIERY DECLAMATION, ORATED ALTO VOCE BY A YOUND MAN WITH BEARD AND NO TIE,WHO WAS OBVIOUSLY WELL EDUCATED. AN IRANIAN FRIEND STANDING NEXT TO ME TRANSLATED HIS EARNEST VOW TO DEFEND THE OIL INSTALLATIONS TO HIS LAST DROP OF BLOOD AGAINST THE IMPERIALISTS WHO WISHED TO RECAPTURE THEM. THERE WAS NO OFFICIAL TRANSLATION OF THIS ELEGY.

THE RECEPTION AT THE PRIME MINISTRY FEATURED A RECEIVING LINE OF BAZARGAN, SANJABI, SAHABI AND ENTEZAM. THE CHIEF OF PROTOCOL WAS IN ATTENDANCE. YAZDI ARRIVED LATER. IT WAS SLAO AUSTERE AND FEATURED THE SAME REFRESHMENTS AS THE NIOC RECEPTION. SANJABI LEFT AS SOON AS THE RECEIVING LINE DISSOLVED.

THE BULGARIAN GAVE A SHORT STATEMENT OF NEW YEAR'S GREETING ON BEHALF OF THE DIPLOMATIC CORPS9 BAZARGAN REPLIED GRACIOUSLY AND HIS REMARKS WERE TRANSLATED BY YAZDI. WHEN THIS CEREMONY WAS FINISHED, BAZAGAN MOVED INTO THE GROUP FOR INDIVIDUAL DISCUSSIONS, STARTING RATHER CONSPICUOUSLY WITH ME, AND THEN MOVING NEXT TO THE FRENCH AMBASSADOR.

THE SOVIET AMBASSADOR WAS MARKEDLY ABSENT, HAVING GONE TO QOM TO PRESENT NEW YEAR'S GREETINGS FROM THE SOVIET LEADERSHIP TO KHOMEINI, AND THEREBY ESTABLISHING HIS VIEW OF THE LOCAL PECKING ORDER. THE CHIEF OF PROTOCOL TOLD ME THIS RECEPTION, INCLUDING THE GUEST LIST, HAD BEEN TOTALLY ARRANGED BY THE BULGARIAN. IT WAS INTERESTING, CONSQUENTLY, TO NOTE THAT THE PLO RESPRESENTATIVE WAS NOT RPT NOT PRESENT. SULLIVAN
C - ENTIRE TEXT

IN THE FACE OF CONTINUING FIGHTING IN SANANDAJ, TWO HIGH-LEVEL DELEGATIONS WERE DISPATCHED TO THE CITY ON MARCH 21. ONE GROUP, COMPOSED OF AYATOLLAH TALAGHANI AND TWO OF KHOMEINI'S CLOSEST CONFIDANTS, REPORTEDLY MET WITH A GROUP OF KURDISH LEADERS HEADED BY AHMAD MOFTIZADEH LATE LAST NIGHT. THE GOVERNMENT-CONTROLLED VOICE OF THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION (VOIR) ANNOUNCED EARLY MARCH 22 THAT THE TALEGHANI AND MOFTIZADEH GROUPS WOULD NONTINUE THEIR DISCUSSIONS TODAY. THE SECOND DELEGATION WAS HEADED BY MINISTER OF INTERIOR JAVADI AND MINISTER ON DEFENSE MADANI.

AS OF 0800 LOCAL TIME MARCH 22, KURDISH REBELS APPEARED TO OCCUPY MOST OF THE CITY, ALTHOUGH THE GARRISON WAS STILL IN THE HANDS OF THE ARMY AND REPORTEDLY HAD BEEN REINFORCED BY HELICOPTER FROM URUMIEH (FORMERLY REZAYEH) AND TEHRAN. A STATEMENT CARRIED BY VOIR MARCH 21 CLAMIED THAT NO TROOPS HAD VENTURED OUTSIDE THE GARRISON, BUT BBC REPORTED MARCH 22 THAT TANKS HAD BEEN OBSERVED IN THE CITY'S STREETS.

WE ARE SCEPTICAL THAT ANY PEACE NEGOTIATED BETWEEN TALEGHANI AND MOFTIZADEH WILL HAVE MUCH LASTING EFFECT. MOFTIZADEH HAS BEEN PROMINENT AMONG THE MODERATE KURDISH LEADERSHIP IN RECENT WEEKS, BUT WE SUSPECT THAT THE FIGHTING IN SANANDAJ OVER THE LAST SEVERAL DAYS HAS SEVERELY WEAKENED THE MODERATES' POSITION AMONG THEIR PEOPLE. AFP HAS BEEN CARRYING REPORTS SUGGESTING THAT LEADERSHIP IN SANANDAJ HAS PASSED TO MORE RADICAL FORCES, PERHAPS INCLUDING FEDAYIN ELEMENTS. THE FIGHTING HAS PRESENTED THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT WITH THE STERNEST CHALLENGE IT HAS YET FACED.
IF THE SANANDAJ GARRISON IS FORCED TO SURRENDER OR EVACUATE, THE MILITARY'S WEAKNESS WILL BE BE CONFIRMED AND OTHER POTENTIAL DISSIDENT GROUPS WILL THEREBY BE ENCOURAGED TO PRESS THEIR DEMANDS.
C - ENTIRE TEXT.

AN AMERICAN WHO HAS TAUGHT IN THE ENGLISH DEPARTMENT OF PAHLAVI VNIVERSITY IN SHIRAZ FOR THE LAST THREE YEARS REPORTS THAT CLASSES RESUMED AT THE UNIVERSITY ABOUT THREE WEEKS AGO. FOREIGNERS ON THE FACULTY, ONCE MORE THAN A HUNDRED STRONG, HAVE BEEN REDUCED TO NO MORE THAN A DOZEN, MOSTLY SOUTH ASIANS. WHILE STUDENTS ARE OUTSPOKEN IN THEIR CITTICISM OF CARTER AND THE UDG, OUR INFORMANT HAS ENCOUNTERED NO HOSTILITY DIRECTED AT HIM FORM THE STUDENTS. HE SAID THAT LITTLE ATTENTION IS PAID TO THE CURRICULA, WITH MOST CLASSROOM SESSIONS DEGENERATING INTO POLITICAL DISCUSSIONS AFTER JUST A FEW MINUTES OF FORMAL INSTRUCTION.

STUDENTS AND FACULTY MEMBERS ALIKE ARE PREOCCUPIED WITH NATIONAL DEVELOPMENT, PARTICULARLY THE NEED TO PROVIDE SERVICES TO RURAL AREAS, TO BE AS SELF-RELIANT AS POSSIBLE, AND TO PREVENT THE NATION'S RESOURCES FROM BEING DRAINED ABROAD.

ADMINISTRATIVELY, THE UNIVERSITY'S LONG-TIME CHANCELLOR, FARHANG MEHR, RESIGNED ABOUT TWO WEEKS AGO. AMIR HOUSHANG MEHRYAR, APPOINTED DEPUTY CHANNCELLOR BY MEHR ABOUT FOUR MONTHS AGO, IS ACTING IN HIS STEAD FOR THE MOMEMNT. OUR INFORMAT SAID, HOWEVER, THAT THE UNIVESITY IS ACTUALLY BEING RUN BY COMMITTEES. EVERY COLLEGE HAS ONE, AND MANY DEPARTMENTS DO AS WELL. ALL DECISIONS MUST BE UNANIMOUS. THE RESULT IS THAT FEW DECISIONS ARE BEING MADE. SOMEWHAT SUPRISINGLY, THE UNIVERSITY HAS NOT YET ENCOUNTERED ANY DIFFICULTIES IN MEETING ITS PAYROLL, SOMETHING THAT WAS NOT ALWAYS TRUE EVEN IN THE HALCYON DAYS BEFORE THE REVOLUTION. SULLIVAN

AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI AND HIS PARTY CONTINUED THIER DISCUSSIONS WITH KURDISH LEADER IN SANANDAJ MARCH 22. APPARENTLY A NEW CEASEFIRE-THE THIRD IN FOUR DAYS-WAS ARRANGED SOMETIME YESTERDAY (MARCH 22) AFTERNOON. IT SEEMS TO BE HOLDING, AT LEAST FOR THE MOMENT. UNDER ITS TERMS, THE KURDS AGREED TO PULL BACK FROM THE SANANDAJ GARRISON IN RETURN FOR RELEASE OF PRISONERS TAKEN BY THE ARMY. THE VOICE OF THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION (VOIR) REPORTED MARCH 23 THAT TALEGHANI STRESSED HIS SYMPATHY WITH KURDISH ASPIRATIONS AND POINTED OUT THAT ISLAM GUARANTEES THE KURDS THEIR RIGHTS. VOIR SAID THAT TALKS WOULD CONTINUE.

TALEGHANI'S SON, WHO IS IN SANANDAJ WITH HIS FATHER'S PARTY, REPORTEDLY ENCOUNTERED LOCAL HOSTILITY WHILE PARTICIPATING IN AN EXPEDITION TO COLLECT BODIES. THE GROUP APPARENTLY WAS SET UPON, BUT SUFFERED NO INJURIES.

(C) IT WOULD APPEAR THAT THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT, THROUGH THE MEDIATION EFFORTS OF AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI, HAS WON A LITTLE TIME TO DEAL WITH ITS KURDISH PROBLEM. THE CEASEFIRE ACHIEVED MARCH 22 WAS STILL HOLDING EARLY MARCH 24. TENSIONS, HOWEVER, REMAIN HIGH. TALEGHANI AND OTHER MEMBERS OF HIS PARTY WHO ADDRESSED A LARGE CROWD IN SANANDAJ'S CENTRAL SQUARE MARCH 23 WERE HECKLED BY SOME AMONG THOSE PRESENT. AFP REPORTS ARMED KURDS ARE STILL MUCH IN EVIDENCE IN THE CITY.

(C) TALEGHANI WAS TO HAVE RETURNED TO TEHRAN LATE MARCH 23 WHERE HE WILL PRESENT KURDISH DEMANDS TO THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT. WHILE EXPRESSING SYMPATHY FOR KURDISH ASPIRATIONS, TALEGHANI WARNED BEFORE DEPARTING SANANDAJ THAT IT WOULD TAKE TIME TO RESOLVE THE PROBLEMS POSED BY DEMANDS FOR AUTONOMY. THAT IS A COMMODITY THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT MAY NOT HAVE AGREAT DEAL OF. THE GOVERNMENT IS PREDISPOSED TO RECOGNIZE ONLY RELATIVELY MODERATE KURDISH LEADERS SUCH AS AHMAD MOFTIZADEH OF SANANDAJ AND SHEIKH EZEDDIN HOSSEINI OF MAHABAD, WHEREAS THOSE FAVORING AMORE RADICAL SOLUTION APPEAR INCREASINGLY TO BE IN THE ASCENDANT.

IF THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT DOES NOT MOVE QUICKLY TO FORMALIZE THE CONSIDERABLE DEGREE OF DE FACTO AUTONOMY THAT ALREADY EXISTS IN MUCH OF DURDESTAN--WHICH WOULD PROBABLY SATISFY THE MODERATES AMONG THE KURDS--IT IS LIKELY TO BE SOON CONFRONTED WITH FAR MORE EXTREME DEMANDS THAN ARE NOW BEING MADE.

(U) MEANWHILE, IN A MOVE THAT IS ONLY GENERALLY RELATED TO THE KURDISH PROBLEM, THE CABINET HAS ANNOUNCED ITS DECISION THAT P.M. BAZARGAN, HIS DEPUTY AMIR ENTEZAM AND DEFENSE MINISTER MADANI WILL LEAVE TODAY, MARCH 24, FOR KHUZESTAN AND GO ON TO TABRIZ MARCH 25. BOTH AREAS HAVE BEEN THE SCENE OF ETHNIC GRUMBLINGS AS WELL, AND THE VISIT HAS BEEN ADVERTISED AS AN INVESTIGATION OF THE PEOPLE'S PROBLEMS.
C - ENTIRE TEXT.

IN HIS LAST CONVERSATION WITH THE AMBASSADOR, PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN ASKED THAT THE EMBASSY PASS FOREIGN MINISTRY COPIES OF THE RELEVANT TREATY DOCUMENTS SO THAT THEY COULD BE STUDIED. THERNA'S WIRELESS FILE EQUIPMENT WAS PUT OUT OF ACTION SOME TIME AGO, SO THAT WE HAVE NOT RECEIVED THE TEXTS TRANSMITTED TO OTHER POSTS. WE WONDER IF IT WOULD BE FEASIBLE FOR THE DEPARTMENT TO TRANSMIT THESE TEXTS TO US ASAP. IF THAT IS NOT POSSIBLE, REQUEST THEY BE PASSED EXPEDITIOUSLY TO IRANIAN EMBASSY IN WASHINGTON WITH REQUEST THAT THE EMBASSY GET THEM BACK TO THE MINISTRY. SULLIVAN
C - ENTIRE TEXT.

SULTAN MAHMUD-GHAZI, MEMBER OF AFGHAN ROYAL FAMILY, FORMER PRESIDENT OF AFGHAN CIVIL AVIATION AND TOURISM AUTHORITY, AND BROTHER OF FORMER AFGHAN AMBASSADOR TO IRAN, VISITED POL COUNSELOR MARCH 25 IN CONNECTION WITH VISA PROBLEM. HE SAID HE DOES NOT HAVE EXTENSIVE INFORMATION ON SITUATION IN AFGHANISTAN, BUT HAD TALKED WITH PEOPLE WHO HAVE COME FROM THERE AS RECENTLY AS THREE DAYS AGO.

HE SAID REBELLION IS WIDESPREAD AND AFFECTS AT LEAST EIGHT PROVINCES. AFGHAN GOVERNMENT HAS NO CONFIDENCE IN MOST OF ITS ARMY, PARTICULARLY THE CONSCRIPTS, AND THERE HAVE BEEN CASES OF MILITARY UNITS BEING BOMBED BY THE AIR FORCE BECAUSE THEY WERE BELIEVED TO BE UNTRUSTWORTHY. IN KABUL SECURITY AT NIGHT IS CARRIED OUT BY MANY CIVILIANS AND OTHER COMMUNISTS RATHER THAN THE MILITARY. INDEED, THE MILITARY ARE BEING KEPT OUT OF THE CITY TO A GREAT EXTENT.

IF THE AFGHAN GOVERNMENT HAD TO STAND ALONE, IT WOULD NOT LAST "FOR MORE THAN A WEEK", ACCORDING TO MAHMUD-GHAZI HOWEVER, HE IS SURE THE SOVIETS ARE BUCKING UP THE GOVERNMENT AND REINFORCING IT WITH RACIAL TADZHIKS, UZBEKS AND TURKOMANS FROM ACROSS THE FRONTIER. THIS IS SOMETHING WHICH AN OUTSIDER CAN NEVER PROVE, SINCE AFGHANISTAN GOVERNMENT CAN PROVIDE THE IDENTITY CARDS AT WILL.

UNFORTUNATELY, NEITHER U.S. NOR PAKISTANI NOR IRANIAN GOVERNMENTS APPEAR TO BE INTERESTED IN ASSISTING THE REVOLT. IRANIANS MIGHT POSSIBLY BE PROVIDING SOME FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE, BUT THEY HAVE NO MILITARY, AND THEIR WEAPONS ARE ALMOST ENTIRELY U.S. OR WESTERN STYLE. CHINESE WEAPONS IN THE HANDS OF THE PAKISTANI WOULD PROBABLY BE USEFUL IN AFGHANISTAN, ON THE OTHER HAND.

ABOVE SEEMS TO FIT WITH REPORTING FROM KABUL AND OTHER SOURCES. MAHMUD-GHAZI HIMSELF HAS REFUSED OFFER OF AN IRANIAN PASSPORT PROVIDED HE CHANGES HIS NATIONALITY AND HAS NOT LOST HOPE OF RETURNING TO AFGHANISTAN WHEN AND IF THE SITUATION CHANGES SOME TIME.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT.)

SUMMARY: KURDESTAN REMAINS QUIET. BAKHTIAR LIVES-ADN TALKS. PM VISITS KHUZESTAN. KHOMEINI URGES EVERYONE TO VOTE. NO NOW RUZ AMNESTY. PLO DELEGATION VISITS MASHAD. DEMONSTRATION TO PROTEST ISRAELI-EGYPTIAN PEACE TREATY; KHOMEINI CALLS IT "TREASON TO ISLAM." END SUMMARY.
THE TRUCE IN KURDESTAN CONTINUES TO HOLD (SEPTEL).

A TAPE-RECORDED MESSAGE, REPUTEDLY FROM FORMER PM BAKHTIAR, WAS DELIVERED TO THE AGENCE FRANCE PRESSE OFFICE IN TEHRAN MARCH 24. THE TAPE WAS ACCOMPANIED BY A HAND-WRITTEN NOTE ON PAPER BEARNING THE LETTERHEAD OF CLARIDGE'S HOTEL IN LONDON. AFP INDICATED THAT THE VOICE ON THE TAPE IS INDEED BAKHTIAR'S.

BAKHTIAR SAID IN HIS MESSAGE THAT "WHAT I SEE NOW ON THE HORIZON DOES NOT AT ALL RESEMBLE FREEDOM, DEMOCRACY, ECONOMIC PROGRESS AND DEVELOPMENT OF THE NATIONAL CULTURE". ON THE CONTRARY, "WE HAVE REPLACED AN AGED, CORRUPT DICTATORSHIP WITH DICTATORSHIP ACCOMPANIED BY ANARCHY -AND ALL THIS I THE HOPE OF SETTING UP AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC." BAKHTIAR SAID HE WOULD NOT VOTE FOR SUCH A REPUBLIC BECAUSE HE CONSIDERS "IT AN OBSTACLE TO THE PROGRESS OF SOCIETY, THE NATION'S GLORY, TO THE BLOSSOMING OF THE ECONOMY AND HUMAN RIGHTS".

HE URGED THAT THE POWER OF THE CORRUPT BE ELIMINATED, THAT INDIVIDUAL AND SOCIAL RIGHTS BE GUARANTEED, THAT ANTI-ISLAMIC LAWS BE REPEALED, AND THAT IRAN'S INDEPENDENT POLICY BE CONTINUED. "THAT," HE SAID, "IS A PROGRAM UPON WHICH UNITY CAN BE BUILT, UNLIKE THE CURRENT BEHAVIOR OF A GOVERNMENT THAT CONSIDERS ITSELF POWERLESS AND RIGHTLY SO."

THE CRITICISM OF THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT, AND, IMPLICITLY, KHOMEINI CONTAINED IN BAKHTIAR'S MESSAGE WILL FIND A SYMPATHETIC EAR AMONG THOSE WHO ARE PROFOUNDLY DISTURBED BY EVENTS IN POST-REVOLUTIONARY IRAN. KHOMEINI STILL COMMANDS THE LOYALTY OF THE MASSES, BUT AMONG THE MODERNIST ELITE MANY ARE LOOKING BACK WITH NOSTALGIA TO BAKHTIAR'S STEWARDSHIP AS A BRIEF DAWN OF POLITICAL PROMISE BEFORE THE DARKNESS OF DICTATORSHIP SETTLED ON IRAN ONCE AGAIN. HIS WORDS MUST CONVEY A SPECIAL NOTE OF IRONY FOR HIS FORMER COLLEAGUES IN THE NATIONAL FRONT WHO ARE NOW MEMBERS OF THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT AND THUS TECHNICALLY ACCOUNTABLE FOR THE ILLIBERALITY OF THE AYATOLLAH AND THE EXCESSES OF HIS FOLLOWERS.

AS IF THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT DID NOT HAVE ENOUGH TROUBLES, PM BAZARGAN, HIS DEPUTY ABBAS AMIR ENTEZAM, AND MINISTER OF DEFENSE MADANI GOT A MIXED RECEPTION DURING THEIR VISIT TO KHUZESTAN YESTERDAY, MARCH 24. OUTSIDE THE HOUSE OF AYATOLLAH MOHAMMAD TAHER KHAGHANI IN KHORRAMSHAHR A SULLEN CROWED HAD TO BE DISPERSED BY SHOTS IN THE AIR BEFORE BAZARGAN AND HIS PARTY COULD ENTER. IN INTERVIEWS BOTH BAZARGAN AND ENTEZAM EXPRESSED SYMPATHY WITH ETHNIC MINORITY ASPIRATIONS, INCLUDING THOSE OF THE ARABIC-SPEAKING PEOPLE OF KHUZESTAN.

IN KHORRAMSHAHR THE DELEGATION WAS CONFRONTED BY DEMANDS THAT A GREATER SHARE OF IRAN'S OIL REVENUES, WHICH FOR THE MOST PART DERIVE FROM KHUZESTAN, BE USED FOR LOCAL DEVELOPMENT. THE GROUP IS IN TABRIZ TODAY, MARCH 25.

KHOMEINI HAS ISSUED A STATEMENT URGING ALL IRANIANS, MEN AND WOMEN, TO EXERCISE THEIR RIGHT TO VOTE IN THE UPCOMING REFERENDUM ON WHETHER OR NOT IRAN IS TO BECOME AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. THE GOVERNMENT SEEMS DETERMINED TO GO THROUGH WITH THIS EXERCISE, CONTINUED SNIPING ABOUT ITS FORMAT AND QUESTIONS REGARDING IT FEASIBILITY AT SUCH AN EARLY DATE NOTWITHSTANDING. THE LATE NEWS MARCH 25 REASSURED POTENTIAL VOTERS THAT THEY NEED NOT WORRY ABOUT MEMBERSHIP IN THE DEFUNCT RASTAKHIZ PARTY, INFORMATION THAT IS CONTAINED IN THE IDENTITY CARDS OF ALL THOSE WHO JOINED, CARDS WHICH MUST BE PRESENTED AT THE POLLS IN THE UPCOMING REFERENDUM.
JUST TO CONFUSE MATTERS FURTHER, IT WAS ALSO ANNOUNCED THAT THE MINIMUM AGE FOR ELIGIBILITY HAS BEEN LOWERED TO 16 ONCE AGAIN.

DESPITE SPECULATION THAT THERE WOULD BE A NOW RUZ AMNESTY INVOLVING AT LEAST SEVERAL HUNDRED OF THOSE CURRENTLY BEING HELD IN JAIL ON ESSENTIALLY POLITICAL CHARGES, NONE WAS ANNOUNCED OVER THE NOW RUZ HOLIDAY PERIOD. THE PROPOSAL APPARENTLY ENCOUNTERED STIFF RESISTANCE FROM SEVERAL QUARTERS. HOWEVER, KHOMEINI DID AUTHORIZE VISITS FROM FAMILY MEMBERS FOR 250 PRISONERS (WE UNDERSTAND THAT EACH PRISONER WAS ALLOWED TO SEE ONE FAMILY MEMBER FOR A TOTAL OF FICE MINUTES). POLOFF METRINKO PASSED BY QASR PRISON OVER THE WEEKEND WHERE THE SCENE WAS MUCH AS IT FORMERLY WAS--LARGE NUMBERS OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN WAITING OUTSIDE TO GET IN TO SEE THEIR HUSBANDS, FATHERS, BROTHERS, ETC.
THE MAIN DIFFERENCE FROM THE PAST IS THAT THE CROWD IS NWO BETTER DRESSED THAN FORMERLY.

THE PLO CONTINUES TO BE ACTIVE. A DELEGATION, ACCOMPANIED BY SEVERAL MEMBERS OF THE CENTRAL REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE, VISITED MASHAD ON MARCH 22. IT WAS ANNOUNCED IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE VISIT THAT THE PLO WOULD PROVIDE TRAINING TO THE SO-CALLED GUARDIANS OF THE REVOLUTION, THE PARAMILITARY NATIONAL GUARD THAT IS BEING ESTABLISHED UNDER THE AEGIS OF DEPUTY PM IBRAHIM YAZDI.

ON THE AFTERNOON OF MARCH 25 A SMALL GROUP OF DEMONSTRATORS MARCHED FROM FREEDOM (FORMERLY SHAHYAD) MONUMENT TO THE EGYPTIAN EMBASSY TO PROTEST THE SIGNING OF THE ISRAELI-EGYPTIAN PEACE TREATY. KHOMEINI HAS CHARACTERIZED THE TREATY AS "TREASON TO ISLAM," A STATEMENT HARDLY DESIGNED TO CALM PASSIONS. WE REMAIN VIGILANT.
C - ENTIRE TEXT.

AYATOLLAH TALAGHANI AND HIS PARTY EXTENDED THEIR STAY IN SANANDAJ THROUGH MOST OF THE DAY MARCH 24 IN A CONTINUING EFFORT TO HAMMER OUT AN AGREEMENT WITH THE LOCAL COMMUNITY THAT WOULD ALSO BE ACCEPTABLE TO THE CENTRAL GOVERNMENT. A MAJOR FEATURE OF THE AGREEMENT REACHED APPEARS TO BE THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A FIVE-MEMBER PROVINCIAL COUNCIL, THE FIRST TASK OF WHICH WILL BE TO HOLD ELECTIONS FOR A CITY COUNCIL THAT WILL IN TURN BE RESPONSIBLE FOR ADMINISTRATION OF SANANDAJ'S AFFAIRS. THE PRECIES POWERS OF THE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL ARE NOT YET CLEAR, BUT IT WOULD APPEAR THAT A MAJOR CONCESSION HAS BEEN GRANTED TO THE KURDS IN THIS REGARD.
THE AGREEMENT ALSO PROVIDED FOR THE RELEASE OF THOSE PRISONERS HELD BY THE ARMY AT THE SANANDAJ GARRISON AND THE APPOINTMENT OF A NEW GOVERNOR GENERAL, A KURD, FOR JURDESTAN.

IT WOULD THUS SEEM THAT TALAGHANI HAS DEFUSED A MAJOR CRISIS FOR THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT. HOWEVER, HE MAY HAVE ALSO OPENED A PANDORA' BOX IN THAT IT IS DOUBTFUL THAT OTHER ETHNIC MINORITIES WILL BE SATISFIED WITH ANYTHING LESS THAN KURDS HAVE BEEN GRANTED. PM BAZARGAN WAS GREETED WITH DEMANDS FROM ETHNIC ARABS WHEN HE VISITED KHUZISTAN MARCH 24 AND IT IS LIKELY THAT HE WILL GET SIMILAR TREATMENT IN TABRIZ WHERE HE IS VISITING TODAY, MARCH 25.

ALSO, WE HAVE BEEN TOLD BY TALAGHANI'S SON, WHO ACCOMPANIED HIM TO SANANDAJ, THAT HE AND HIS FATHER WILL BE GOING TO GORGAN WITHIN THE NEXT FEW DAYS TO MEDIATE TURKOMAN DEMANDS FOR A GREATER SAY IN RUNNING THEIR OWN AFFAIRS. WE HAVE HEARD LITTLE FROM BALUCHISTAN OR THE TRIBAL AREAS OF SOUTHWESTERN IRAN, BUT THAT MAY BE MORE AN INDICATION OF POOR COMMUNICATIONS THAN ETHNIC QUIESCENCE IN THOSE QUARTERS. SULLIVAN
C - ENTIRE TEXT.

POL COUNSELOR CONTACTED MEHDI EHSASSI, HEAD OF MFA INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS DEPARTMENT, ON MARCH 26 IN REGARD TO QUESTIONS ASKED REFTEL. EHSASSI NOTED THAT IRAN HAS NO PERM REP AT PRESENT IN GENEVA AND PROBABLY WILL NOT HAVE ONE BY COMMENCEMENT OF PREP COM ON APRIL 17. IRANIAN CHARGE SAID VAZIRI WILL THEREFORE HEAD THE IRANIAN GROUP, WHICH WILL ALSO INCLUDE SOME OF THE IRANIANS (AMIRI, SHILATI) WHO ARE WORKING ON DISARMAMENT MATTERS IN GENEVA. TEHRAN WILL LEAVE TACTICS ON PROCEDURAL MATTERS TO THEM.

MORE GENERALLY IN REGARD TO MATTERS OF SUBSTANCE WHICH MIGHT COME UP DURING NPT REVIEW CONFERENCE IN 1980, EHSASSI SIMPLY STATED THE OBVIOUS, THAT IRAN WILL GENERALLY FOLLOW ITS PAST POLICY BUT CAN BE EXPECTED TO BE MORE ACTIVELY ENGAGED THAN IN THE PAST WITH THE OTHER NON-ALIGNED NATIONS.

COMMENT: IRANIAN MFA HAS OFFICIALLY STARTED TO FUNCTION AGAIN, BUT ITS SPAN OF INTEREST AND CONTROL ARE VERY LIMITED. THERE IS NO POINT IN TRYING TO SOUND THEM OUT ON DETAILS CONCERNING CONFERENCES OF THIS SORT WHICH ARE NOT OF PRIMARY INTEREST TO THE NEW GOVERNMENT. IF THERE IS A PARTICULAR ISSUE IN WHICH IRANIAN SUPPORT IS STRONGLY REQUIRED, HOWEVER, WE CAN ALWAYS MAKE AN EFFORT TO GIN UP MFA ACTIVITY HERE. IT IS A SIGN OF THE TIMES THAT EHSASSI HIMSELF COULD NOT LEAVE THE COUNTRY TO ATTEND ANOTHER OFFICIAL CONFERENCE, SINCE VERY FEW IRANIAN MEN ARE BEING ALLOWED TO LEAVE FOR THE MOMENT.

1979TEHRAN03245.subject: BIOGRAPHIC INFORMATION ON DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER EBRAHIM YAZDI

segments.text: EBRAHIM YAZDI C- ENTIRE TEXT.

THE FOLLOWING BIOGRAPHIC INFORMATION ON EBRAHIM YAZDI COMES FROM A CONVERSATION WITH YAZDI MORE THAN A MONTH AGO BUT WAS NOT REPORTED EARLIER BECAUSE THE EMBASSY WAS INVADED ON THE DAY IT WAS TO BE DRAFTED. SOME OF THE DETAILS HAVE FADED FROM MEMORY, BUT THE GENERAL OUTLINE CONTAINS SOME INFORMATION THAT WE BELIEVE IS NOT ON FILE IN WASHINGTON.

ACCORDING TO A FORM YAZDI FILLED IN ON HIS MOST RECENT ENTRY INTO IRAN, HE WAS BORN IN 1931. THIS FITS IN WITH HIS OWN ACCOUNT OF HIS LIFE AS GIVEN TO POL COUNSELOR AND CONTRASTS WITH PUBLISHED VERSIONS OF HIS AGE, WHICH ORIGINALLY HAD HIM AT 39 YEARS OLD, AND HAVE SINCE DESCRIBED HIM AS IN HIS EARLY FORTIES. YAZDI APPEARS TO BE IN FACT 47 OR 48 YEARS OLD, DESPITE A YOUTHFUL APPEARANCE UNDER A FULL BEARD.

YAZDI HAS THREE BROTHERS, ONE OR TWO OF THEM OLDER THAN HIMSELF. ALL FOUR APPEAR TO HAVE STUDIED TO BECOME PHARMACISTS, IN IRAN, WITH A YEAR OR TWO OF POST-GRADUATE STUDY ELSEWHERE. THE OLDEST IS A DOCTOR (PERHAPS AN OPTHAMALOGIST) WITH HIS OWN PRIVATE CLINIC IN TEHRAN. ANOTHER BROTHER IS LIVING HERE, AND A THIRD ONE REPORTEDLY IN BALTIMORE, AN AMERICAN CITIZEN.

YAZDI CLAIMS TO HAVE BEEN VERY ACTIVE AS A STUDENT IN TEHRAN IN HELPING TO FORM AN ISLAMIC MOVEMENT WITH SUCH NOTABLES OF TODAY AS AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI AND PRIME MINISTER MEHDI BAZARGAN. THIS WAS IN THE 1940'S AND EARLY 1950'S AND, ACCORDING TO YAZDI, WAS AIMED PRIMARILY AT COUNTERING THE APPEAL OF MARXISM AMONG IRANIAN YOUTH, ESPECIALLY THE STUDENTS. IN THIS HE CLAIMS A KINSHIP OF EFFORT WITH PEOPLE SUCH AS THE PHILOSOPHER ALI SHARIATE, WHO WAS A LITTLE YOUNGER.

YAZDI SAYS HE LEFT TEHRAN FOR THE UNITED STATES IN THE EARLY 1950'S AND DID SOME POST-GRADUATE STUDIES AND TEACHING IN NEW JERSEY AND ELSEWHERE, ENDING UP IN TEXAS. HIS FIELD HAD BECOME SCIENTIFIC, PARTICULARLY MEDICAL, RESEARCH. AFTER THE ANTI-SHAH DEMONSTRATIONS IN IRAN DURING 1962 AND 1963, AND THE SUBSEQUENT EXILE OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI TO TURKEY AND EVENTUALLY NAJAF, IRAQ, YAZDI SAID HE TOOK A JOB TEACHING AT THE AMERICAN UNIVERSITY OF BEIRUT TO BE CLOSER TO THE SCENE.

THE LEBANESE GOVERNMENT TURNED AGAINST IRANIANS SOME TIME IN 1966 OR 1967 (THE EXACT OCCASION ESCAPES US) AND YAZDI HAD TO LEAVE, ALONG WITH MANY OTHER IRANIANS. HE RETURNED TO THE U.S., AFTER HAVING VISITED KHOMEINI AND BEING APPOINTED BY KHOMEINI AS HIS PERSONAL REPRESENTATIVE FOR THE UNITED STATES, YAZDI SAYS. IN THE U.S. HE WAS ACTIVE ON KHOMEINI'S BEHALF.

WHEN KHOMEINI WAS THROWN OUT OF IRAQ LAST YEAR, YAZDI WENT TO PARIS, LONDON, AND BONN, BUT WAS TOLD BY OPPOSITIONISTS THERE NOT TO GO VISIT KHOMEINI IN NAJAF BECAUSE HE WOULD BE ARRESTED. AFTER SOME HESITATION, HE NEVERTHELESS FLEW TO BAGHDAD AND ARRIVED IN NAJAF THE VERY EVENING THAT KHOMEINI WAS PACKING UP TO LEAVE.

THE GUARDS REFUSED TO LET HIM SEE KHOMEINI, BUT BY USING SUBTERFUGE (ASKING TO PRAY IN A MOSQUE AND USING ANOTHER EXIT) HE GOT TO KHOMEINI AND ACCOMPANIED HIM, HIS SON AND TWO OTHER DISCIPLES ON THE DRIVE TO THE KUWAITI BORDER. THERE THE PARTY WAS REFUSED PERMISSION TO ENTER KUWAIT AND, AFTER A FEW HOURS, INSTRUCTIONS FROM BAGHDAD CAME TO LET KHOMEINI'S GROUP COME BACK TO BAGHDAD FOR DEPARTURE TO PARIS. YAZDI HIMSELF WAS REFUSED THE SAME PERMISSION AND KEPT PRISONER OVERNIGHT AT THE BORDER POST. THE NEXT DAY INSTRUCTIONS FROM BAGHDAD RELEASED HIM SO THAT HE COULD FOLLOW KHOMEINI.
HE WENT TO PARIS WITH KHOMEINI AND STAYED THERE AS AN INTIMATE MEMBER OF HIS ENTOURAGE.

THE ABOVE WAS VOLUNTEERED BY YAZDI WITHOUT MUCH PRODDING AND COULD CONVEIVABLY BE DOCTORED FOR YOUR EARS. IT FITS IN, HOWEVER, WITH WHAT WE HAVE HEARD ABOUT HIM FROM OTHER ISLAMIC SOURCES, NAMELY THAT HE IS NOT A MARXIST OR A COMMUNIST, ALTHOUGH LIKE MANY IRANIANS OF HIS GENERATION HE WAS EXPOSED TO MARXISM AND COMMUNISM DURING HIS UNIVERSITY YEARS AND WOULD HAVE HAD TO TAKE A POSITION FOR OR AGAINST IT. HIS EARLY ASSOCIATION WITH AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI AND BAZARGAN WOULD EXPLAIN HIS STATURE IN THE MOVEMENT, PARTICULARLY AS HE SEEMS TO HAVE BEEN DELEGATED OR PERHAPS SELF-SELECTED TO GET CLOSE TO KHOMEINI WHILE KHOMEINI WAS IN EXILE.

HE APPARENTLY SPENT SOME TIME WITH KHOMEINI BEFORE BEING APPOINTED KHOMEINI'S PERSONAL REPRESENTATIVE IN THE U.S. THIS PUT YAZDI EARLY ON IN THE ROLE OF A BRIDGE AMONG VARIOUS TOP LEADERS OF THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT, A ROLE HE APPARENTLY STILL PLAYS.
C- ENTIRE TEXT.
SUMMARY: BAZARGAN SPEAKS IN TABRIZ. KURDESTAN REMAINS QUIET. DEMONSTRATORS PROTEST EGYPT-ISRAEL TREATY. END SUMMARY.

PM BAZARGAN'S LONG AND RAMBLING SPEECH IN TABRIZ MARCH 25 WAS REMARKABLE IN ONE RESPECT ONLY--THE EVENHANDEDNESS WITH WHICH HE DEALT WITH THE SHAH. WHILE NOT EXCUSING HIS AUTOCRATIC WAYS, BAZARGAN SUGGESTED THAT HE WAS MOTIVATED BY WHAT WERE TO HIS LIGHTS GOOD INTENTIONS. "HE REALLY WANTED", BAZARGAN TOLD HIS AUDIENCE, "THE IRANIAN NATION TO ATTAIN THE HIGHEST POSITION AS A WORLD POWER AND POSSESS A GREAT CIVILIZATION". FURTHER, BAZARGAN SUGGESTED, THERE WERE MANY IRANIANS WHO WERE QUITE COMFORTABLE IN MARCHING ALONG WITH THE SHAH TOWARD HIS IMPOSSIBLE DREAM.

THIS PASSIVE ACCEPTANCE OF THE SHAH'S RIGHT TO LEAD WAS EQUALLY IMPORTANT AS THE SHAH'S CONVICTION THAT HE POSSESSED SUCH A RIGHT IN THE PERPETUATION OF DESPOTISM IN IRAN. "IF THE REVOLUTIONARY GOVERNMENT FOLLOWS THE SAME PAHT," BAZARGAN WARNED, "IT WILL HAVE BETRAYED THE NATION AND THE REVOLUTION. A NATION THAT BEGS WITH HAND AND MOUTH AND ASKS THE GOVERNMENT FOR EVERYTHING ADMITS AND PROVES ITS INABILITY AND HELPLESSNESS, WHICH MEANS BONDAGE AND ACCEPTANCE OF ALL MISERY AND POVERTY WHETHER ON ACCOUNT OF THE GOVERNMENT OR ON ACCOUNT OF NEIGHBORS AND ALIENS".

BAZARGAN WENT ON TO CONGRATULATE THE IRANIAN PEOPLE FOR THEIR ABILITY TO CAST OFF THEIR HABIT OF SUBMISSIVENESS ACQUIRED DURING 2,500 YEARS OF DESPOTISM AND AUTOCRACY AND TO ATTAIN AN UNPRECEDENTED DEGREE OF SELFRELIANCE WHICH "IS THE SOURCE AND GUARANTEE FOR VICTORY AND IMMORTALITY". HIS PERSONAL INTEGRITY HAS TO BE ADMIRED, AND HIS PERCEPTION THAT A REVOLUTION OF THE SELF IS BUNDAMENTAL FOR THE POLITICAL REVOLUTION WHICH HAS TAKEN PLACE TO BE TRULY SUCCESSFUL STRIKES HOME, BUT IT REMAINS TO BE SEEN WHETHER OR NOT THE IRANIAN PEOPLE CAN INDEED SHED OLD HABITS AS EASILY AS BAZARGAN SEEMS TO BELIEVE THEY HAVE.

KURDESTAN REMAINS QUIET. WE HAVE HEARD RUMORS THAT PROMINENT BALUCH LEADERS HAVE HAD COMMUNICATIONS WITH THE KURDS. WHETHER OR NOT THIS SIGNIFIES A POSSIBLE ALLIANCE OF IRAN'S TWO MOST SIGNIFICANT SUNNI COMMUNITIES REMAINS TO BE DEMONSTRATED. IN THE TURKOMAN SAHRAH AREA OF GORGAN, IRANIAN AIR FORCE JETS APPARENTLY MADE SEVERAL PASSES OVER LOCAL TOWNS IN A SHOW OF FORCE SEVERAL DAYS AGO. THE BROKEN WINDOWS CAUSED BY SONIC BOOMS, HOWEVER, PROBABLY DID MORE TO ANGER LOCAL RESIDENTS THAN IT DID TO IMPRESSTHEM.

THE EGYPTIAN EMBASSY WAS THE SCENE OF THREE SEPARATE DEMONSTRATIONS MARCH 25 PROTESTING THE PEACE TREATY TO BE SIGNED WITH ISRAEL. BY FAR THE LARGER ONE (WITH PERHAPS SEVERAL THOUSAND IN ATTENDANCE) TOOK PLACE YESTERDAY AFTERNOON. THE DEMONSTRATORS PASSED BY THE IRAN-AMERICA SOCIETY BUILDING ON THE WAY TO THE EMBASSY AND BY OUR OWN EMBASSY ON THE WAY BACK. THERE WERE NO INCIDENTS AT EITHER LOCATION, BUT SOME ANTI-CARTER RHETORIC WAS HEARD. THE EGYPTIAN EMBASSY WAS CLOSED TODAY, MARCH 26, BUT WE UNDERSTAND THAT A GROUP OF UNDETERMINED SIZE HAS OCCUPIED THE PREMISES WHERE A SIT-IN IS STILL IN PROGRESS. THEY ARE ARAB STUDENTS OF VARIOUS NATIONALITIES.

EGYPTIAN AMBASSADOR'S WIFE (WHO IS SAFE IN RESIDENCE) TOLD POL COUNSELOR THERE ARE NO EGYPTIANS AMONG THESE STUDENTS. SOME ARE ARMED WITH DAGGERS, BUT THERE HAS BEEN NO VIOLENCE. SEVERAL EGYPTIAN EMPLOYEES ARE IN CHANCERY, BEING HELD IN EFFECT AS HOSTAGES--ALTHOUGH NO DIPLOMATS. PGOI AUTHORITIES HAVE PROMISED TO GET THE SITTERS-IN OUT "SOON" BUT THEY ARE STILL THERE AS OF 1600 HRS LOCAL.

A GATHERING OUTSIDE OUR OWN FRONT GATE JUST BEFORE NOON PROVED TO BE A FALSE ALARM. THAT GROUP WAS DEMANDING RESUMPTION OF VISA OPERATIONS. WE HAVE A REPORT OF DEMONSTRATORS BEING BUSSED TOWARD AMERICAN EMBASSY AS WE GO TO PRESS. IF WE DO NOT REPORT FURTHER, NO NEWS IS GOOD NEWS.

1979TEHRAN03259.subject: IRANIAN REACTION TO THE ISRAELI-EGYPTIAN TREATY

segments.text: ENTIRE TEXT.
SUMMARY: THE IRANINA MFA, RELIGIOUS LEADERS AND "POPULACE" HAVE MARKED THE PROPOSED SIGNING OF THE ISRAELI-EGYPTIAN TREATY WITH A SERIES OF DENOUNCEMENTS AND PROTEST MARCHES. END SUMMARY.

THE IRANIAN MFA STRONGLY ATTACKED THE ISRAELI-EGYPTIAN TREATY TODAY IN AN OFFICIAL ANNOUNCMENT BROADCAST OVER NATIONAL RADIO. CLAIMING THAT ANY TREATY MUST ACKNOWLEDGE PALESTINIAN INTERESTS IN THE AREA, THE ANNOUNCEMENT ALSO PLEDGED FULL ASSURANCES OF SUPPORT TO THE PALESTINIAN CAUSE. FONMIN SANJABI HAS SENT A TELEGRAM TO ARAFAT RECOGNIZING HIM AS THE OFFICIAL REPRESENTATIVE OF THE PLAESTINIANS AND PLEDGING GOI SUPPORT TO HIM.

TEHRAN RADIO ALSO BROADCAST STATEMENTS STRONGLY ATTACKING THE TREATY WHICH WERE READ BY TWO ARAB STUDENTS. THE SPOKESMEN, PART OF THE GROUP STILL OCCUPYING THE EGYPTAIN EMBASSY, CALIMED THAT THEIR GROUP WAS COMPOSED OF "ARAB STUDENTS LIVING IN IRAN." THEY ALSO CLAIMED THAT THEY HAD NOT ATTACKED THE EMBASSY, BUT HAD BEEN GIVEN PREMISSION TO OCCUPY THE BUILDING BY AN EMBASSY "OFFICIAL" WHO TOLD THEM HE SUPPORTED THEIR CAUSE. THIS VARIES FROM EGYPTIAN EMBASSY VERSION (SEE SITREP).

A GROUP CALLING THEMSELVES THE "MOSLEM STUDENTS" OF THE TEHRAN ARMY OFFICERS COLLEGE HAS ISSUED A STATEMENT PROTESTING THE TREATY, AND THUS FAR RALLIES AGAINST THE TREATY HAVE BEEN DECRIBED IN TWO PROVINCIAL CITIES. IN RAFSANJAN, OVER FORTY THOUSAND PEOPLE DEMONSTRATED AGAINST THE PACT AND FOR AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC IN IRAN. IN TABRIZ, THE NUMBER OF DEMONSTRATORS AGAINST THE ISRAELI-EGYPTIAN TREATY IS DESCRIBED ON THE RADIO AS "HUNDREDS OF THOUSANDS" AND APPARENTLY STILL CONTINUING, IN ADDITION TO THE ANTI-TREATY SPEECH (SEPTEL) MADE BY KHOMEINI, AYATHOLLAH BORUJERDI HAS ALSO ATTACKED THE SIGNING.

DEMONSTRATIONS IN TEHRAN HAVE CONTINUED SPORADICALLY THROUGHOUT THE DAY. BESIDES THE OCCUPATION OF THE EGYPTIAN EMBASSY, A PROTEST MARCH WAS HELD ON SHAH REZA STREET EARLIER THIS MORING. ONE SMALL GROUP HAS ALREADY PASSED (WITHOUT STOPPING) BY THE AMERICAN EMBASSY THIS AFTERNOON AND OTHERS ARE EXPECTED. SULLIVAN
C - ENTIRE TEXT

SUMMARY: THREE MAJOR FOREIGN LANGUAGE PAPERS TO CEASE PUBLICATION IN IRAN. ARAB STUDENTS OCCUPYING EGYPTIAN EMBASSY LIST DEMANDS. ARRESTS CONTINUE. MFA AND TEHRAN UNIVERSITY RIF PERSONNEL. NEW PARTY FORMED. EXIT PROCEDURES FOR IRANIANS ANNOUNCED. KHOMEINI "SNUBS" INDIAN DELEGATE. END SUMMARY.

THE FIRST EDITIONS OF KAYHAN INTERNATIONAL AND TEHRAN JOURNAL TO BE PUBLISHED AFTER THE SIX-DAY NO RUZ HOLIDAY WILL ALSO BE THE LAST. ALONG WITH THE FRENCH-LANGUAGE JOURNAL DE TEHERAN, THE TWO ENGLISH LANGUAGE NEWSPAPERS HAVE ANNOUNCED THEY WILL CEASE PUBLICATION AS OF MARCH 27. ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL CONSIDERATIONS ARE BEING GIVEN AS REASONS FOR THE CLOSURES, INCLUDING UNAVAILABILITY OF RAW MATERIALS, INFLATED STAFFS, LOSS OF ADVERTISING REVENUE, AND THE DROP IN CIRCULATION FOLLOWING THE DEPARTURE OF EXPATRIATES. THE ETTELA'T-PUBLISHED TEHRAN JOURNAL ALSO MENTIONS THAT TWO OTHER ETELA'AT PUBLICATIONS, THE ARABIC LANGUAGE ALAKHA MAGAZINE AND THE AIR MAIL EDITION OF THE PERSIAN LANGUAGE NEWSPAPER, HAVE ALREADY CEASED.
A NUMBER OF OTHER ETTELA'AT MAGAZINES ALSO FACE POSSIBLE CLOSURE. REPORTS HAVE ALSO BEEN RECEIVED THAT THE PERSIAN LANGUAGE KAYHAN AND THE PERSIAN LANGUAGE AYANDEGAN MAY CEASE PUBLICATION.

THE NEARLY FIFTY ARAB STUDENTS WHO OCCUPIED THE EGYPTIAN EMBASSY IN TEHRAN ON MARCH 26 (SEE SEPTEL) RELEASED A STATEMENT CALIMING THAT: - THE PALESTINE LIBERATION ORGANIZATION IS THE ONLY LEGITIMATE REPRESENTATIVE OF THE PALESTINIAN PEOPLE AND HAS THE RIGHT TO DECIDE FOR THE PALESTINIANS. - THE EGYPTIAN-ISRAELI PEACE AGREEMENT RECOGNIZES ISRAELI RIGHTS OVER ARAB OCCUPIED LAND AND THEREFORE MUST BE REJECTED. - THE BILATERAL PEACE AGREEMENT ALSO ACCEPTS ZIONIST DOMINATION IN JERUSALEM AND SUBSEQUENTLY OVER THE IMPORTANT MOSQUES THERE. - AMERICAN IMPERALISM IS IMPORTED IN THE REGION VIS-A-VIS EGYPT AND THEREFORE THE MUSLIM COUNTRIES MUST CONTAIN ZIONIST AND IMPERIALIST FORCES USING SADAT AS THEIR TOOL. - THE PEACE AGREEMENT INVOLVING ISRAEL AND EGYPT IS BILATERAL AND THEREFORE WILL CAUSE A SPLIT IN THE ARAB WORLD.

NEWSPAPER REPORTS MENTION THAT ARMED MILITIAMEN OUTSIDE THE EMBASSY MADE NO ATTEMPT TO EVICT THE OCCUPIERS. ACCORDING TO TEHRAN RADIO, THE PLO OFFICE HAS DISCLAIMED ANY RESPONSIBILITY FOR THE OCCUPATION OF THE EMBASSY, ALTHOUGH THE PRESS REPORTS THAT THE 10,000-STRONG MARCH PRECEDING THE OCCUPATION WAS BACKED BY THE PLO. THE DEMONSTRATORS LEFT THE EMBASSY AT 8/00 A.M. TODAY, AS THEY HAD PROMISED IN NEGOTIATIONS WITH IRANIAN MFA OFFICIALS. EGYPTIAN AMBASSADOR TELLS US NO ONE WAS HURT.

PRESS REPORTS THAT MORE THAN 90 FORMER OFFICIALS AND BUSINESSMEN STILL VERY ACTIVE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE GROUPS. ONE FOREIGNER, ITALIAN RADICAL PARTY MEMBER FRANCONE VICENZO, WAS ALSO ARRESTED BY REVOLUTIONARY POLICE. VICENZO, WHO CLAIMED HE HAD COME TO IRAN TO DEFEND THE RIGHTS OF IRANIAN HOMOSEXUALS, WAS SEIZED WHILE HE WAS SPEAKING TO REPORTERS IN FRONT OF QASR PRISON.

THE MFA HAS RIFFED 241 EMPLOYEES, INCLUDING 36 AMBASSADORS AND FOURTEEN CHIEF CONSULS. AN MFA SPOKESMAN SAID THAT THE MINISTRY WILL CONTINUE THE PURGE OF PERSONNEL. EMBOFF HAD HEARD PREVIOUSLY THAT ALL FEMALE EMPLOYEES OF MFA WHO PARTICIPATED IN "WOMEN'S RIGHTS" PROTESTS WOULD BE RIFFED, AND TIE-IN IS POSSIBLE. TEHRAN UNIVERSITY ALSO TERMINATED THE SERVICES OF TWENTY PROFESSOR ON THE EVE OF NO RUZ, CLAIMING THAT THEY WERE "DEEPLY INVOLVED INTHE PREVIOUS REGIME'S ACTIVITIES." ACCORDING TO THE TEHRAN JOURNAL, THE PROFESSORS WERE DISMISSED WITHOUT BEING SERVED ROUTINE TERMINATION NOTICE AND WITHOUT COMPENSATION FOR THEIR PAST SERVICES.

THE FDERALIST REPUBLICAN PARTY HAS ANNOUNCED ITS EXISTENCE. IN ITS FIRST MANIFESTO, THE PARTY HAS CALLED FOR A BOYCOTT OF THE MARCH 30 REFERENDUM. THE FRP CLAIMS IT FAVORS CREATING A FEDERAL IRANIAN REPUBLIC COMPOSED OF AUTONOMOUS NATIONAL GOVERNMENTS.

THE GOI HAS ANNOUNCED NEWER AND MORE COMPLICATED REQUIREMENT FOR IRANIANS WHO PLAN TO DEPART THE COUNTRY. APPLICATIONS FOR PASSPORTS AND EXIT PERMITS WILL NOT BE PROCESSED UNTIL AFTER THE REFERENDUM, AND THE PROCEDURES INVOLVES A PASSPORT AND IDENTITY CARD CHECK WHICH WILL TAKE FIVE DAYS. THE PREVIOUS CHECK TOOK ONLY 48 HOURS. BECAUSE OF THE LARGE NUMBER OF PEOPLE APPLYING FOR PASSPORTS, THE PASSPORT OFFICE IS BEING MOVED TO THE INTERNATIONAL FAIR GROUNDS.

PRESS REPORTS TODAY THAT KHOMEINI REFUSED TO MEET ALI NASIR SAEED ABQATI, THE INDIAN SHI'ITE LEADER WHO ACCOMPANIED A GOODWILL DELEGATION TO QOM ON MARCH 14. ACCORDING TO THE REPORT, KHOMEINI IS SAIDTO HAVE CLAIMED HE DID NOT RECOGNIZE HIM AS LEADER OF THE INDIAN SHI'ITES. IN OTHER VISITORS-TO-KHOMEINI NEWS, REPORTS ARE CIRCULATING IN TEHRAN THAT KHOMEINI'S ATTACK ON THE ISRAELI-EGYPTIAN PEACE TREATY WAS THE RESULT OF THE SOVIET AMBASSADOR'S PERSUASION. AMB. VINOGRADOV WAS REPORTED TO HAVE VISITED THE AYATOLLAH TWICE IN QOM DURING THE NO RZ HOLIDAYS, THE SECOND TIME ONE DAY BEFORE KHOMEINI RELEASED HIS STATEMENT.
(COMMENT: WE ARE NOT DISMISSING THIS REPORT, ALTHOUGH WE NEED NOT LOOK FOR AN EXPLANATION BEYOND KHOMEINI'S WELL-KNOWN TIES TO THE PLO.)

SUMMARY: THE MINISTRY OF INTERIOR HAS FINALLY ANNOUNCED SOME OF THE PROCEDURES FOR THE REFERENDUM ON WHETHER THE IRANIAN PEOPLE WISH THEIR FORM OF GOVERNMENT TO BE AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OR TO CONTINUE AS A MONARCHY WHICH WILL BE HELD MARCH 30. DESPITE THE CONTROVERSY THE PROPOSED REFERENDUM HAS ENGENDERED, IT APPEARS THAT THE GOVERNMENT IS DETERMINED TO PUSH AHEAD. END SUMMARY.

THE FORM THE ACTUAL BALLOT WILL TAKE IS STILL UNCERTAIN. CBS OBTAINED A SAMPLE SOME DAYS AGO THAT WAS IN THREE PARTS WHICH COULD BE DETACHED FROM ONE ANOTHER. THE TOP PORTION WAS FOR ENTRY OF THE VOTER'S NAME AND ADDRESS.

THE SECOND PORTION WAS COLORED GREEN AND CONTAINED THE STATEMENT, "I AM IN FAVOR OF AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC." THE THIRD PORTION WAS RED WITH THE STATEMENT, "I AM IN FAVOR OF A MONARCHY." IT IS NOT CERTAIN, HOWEVER, THAT THIS IS THE BALLOT THAT WILL BE USED, SINCE VARIOUS GOVERNMENT SPOKESMEN, IN THE FACE OF SEVERE CRITICISM OF THE ORIGINAL FORMAT, INDICATED THAT THERE WOULD BE NO REQUIREMENT FOR VOTERS TO LIST THEIR NAMES AND ADDRESSES AND THAT THE LESS-THAN-SUBTLE SYMBOLISM OF THE GREEN AND RED COLOR SCHEME WOULD BE RECONSIDERED. ALSO, THEY HAVE INDICATED THE REPLIES WOULD BE SIMPLY YES OR NOT TO THE QUESTION OF AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC.

ACCORDING TO THE MINISTRY OF INTERIOR, THE PROCEDURE TO BE USED MARCH 30 WILL BE AS FOLLOWS: VOTERS' IDENTITY CARDS (SHENAS NAMEH) WILL BE STAMPED AT THE POLLS AND THEIR THUMBS MARKED WITH INDELIBLE INK (THESE MEASURES TO PREVENT ANYONE FROM VOTING MORE THAN ONCE). THE MINIMUM AGE WILL BE 16. EACH POLLING PLACE WILL BE SUPERVISED BY A SIX-MEMBER COUNCIL, FIVE OF WHOM SHALL BE SELECTED BY THE LOCAL REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE AND THE SIXTH A GOVERNMENT OFFICIAL. THERE ARE TO BE NEARLY 18,000 POLLING STATIONS THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY. IRANIANS LIVING OVERSEAS MAY VOTE AT THE NEAREST IRANIAN CONSULAR OFFICE.
COMPLAINTS ABOUT THE REFERENDUM MAY BE MADE FOR ONE WEEK FOLLOWING THE MARCH 30 BALLOTING. THE RESULTS OF THE REFERENDUM WILL BE ANNOUNCED FIFTEEN DAYS AFTER THE POLL.

IT IS CLEAR THAT THE GOVERNMENT IS DETERMINED TO GO AHEAD WITH THE REFERENDUM DESPITE THE CONTROVERSY IT CONTINUES TO STIR. THE NATIONAL FRONT AND MARXIST FEDAYIN-E-KHALQ HAVE BOTH INDICATED THAT THEY WILL BOYCOTT IT. NEITHER GROUP COMMANDS AN ESPECIALLY LARGE FOLLOWING (PROBABLY THE EASON THEY HAVE CHOSEN TO BOYCOTT THE REFERENDUM RATHER THAN TO DIRECT THEIR ADHERENTS TO VOTE FOR SOMETHING OTHER THAN THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OR MUTILATE THEIR BALLOTS), BUT THEIR VOCAL UNHAPPINESS DOES CONSTITUTE AN EMBARRASSMENT FOR THE GOVERNMENT.

MOREOVER, WE ARE INCLINED TO THINK THAT THE REFERENDUM WILL BE SOMETHING LESS THAN A WELL-OILED ADMINISTRATIVE OPERATION. THE GOVERNMENT HAS CHOSEN TO USE THE BAKHSH OR SUB-DISTRICT AS THE BASIC UNIT IN ESTABLISHING POLLING STATIONS. THERE ARE APPROXIMATELY 350 OF THESE THROUGHOUT IRAN. WHILE THERE WILL BE MORE THAN 2,000 POLLING STATIONS IN TEHRAN ALONE, THERE WILL BE NONE IN THE VAST MAJORITY OF IRAN'S APPROXIMATELY 66,000 SETTLEMENTS WITH LESS THAN 5,000 POPULATION. THE AVERAGE SIZE OF A BAKHSH IS 3,500 SQUARE KILOMETERS, BUT MANY ARE SO LARGE THAT IT TAKES A FULL DAY TO REACH THE ADMINISTRATIVE CENTER FROM OUTLYING AREAS.

THUS, IT SEEMS QUITE LIKELY THAT THE 52-PERCENT OF THE IRANIAN POPULATION LIVING IN RURAL AREAS IS GOING TO FIND IT CONSIDERABLY MORE DIFFICULT TO PARTICIPATE IN THE REFERENDUM THAN WILL PEOPLE LIVING IN TOWNS AND CITIES. IRONICALLY, THE FORMER WOULD PROBABLY VOTE OVERWHELMINGLY FOR KHOMEINI'S CHERISHED ISLAMIC REPUBLIC IF THEY COULD, BUT SHOULD SUBSTANTIAL NUMBERS OF THEM NOT BE ABLE TO GET TO THE PLLLS, IT COULD WELL BECOME AN ISSUE THOSE OPPOSED TO THE PROPOSITION WILL LATER TRY TO EXPLOIT.
C - ENTIRE TEXT.

SUMMARY: FIGHTING IN GORGAN BETWEEN TURKOMAN AND GOVERNMENT. ARABS IN KHUZESTAN DEMAND CONTROL OVER THE PROVINCE'S OIL. KURDS ARE URGED TO VOTE FOR THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC BY ONE MODERATE LEADER, BUT TO BOYCOTT THE REFERENDUM BY SEVEN OTHER KURDISH POLITICAL ORGANIZATIONS. THE ULEMA SPARE NO EFFORT TO GET OUT THE VOTE. REVOLUTIONARY PLACE NAMES TO REPLACE THOSE WITH ASSOCIATIONS WITH THE BAD OLD DAYS. END SUMMARY.

ETHNIC UNREST IN THE GONBAD KAVOUS AREA OF GORGAN PROVINCE (ALSO KNOWN AS TURKOMAN SAHRAH), WHICH HAS BEEN EVIDENT FOR SOME TIME NOW, RESULTED IN SEVERAL ARMED CLASHES BETWEEN THE LOCAL TURKOMAN POPULATION AND IRANIAN GOVERNMENT FORCES IN THE PAST SEVERAL DAYS. IT APPEARS THAT THE INITIAL INCIDENT OCCURRED MARCH 25 WHEN A 17 YEAR-OLD TURKOMAN YOUTH WAS KILLED AND SHOPS AND SCHOOLS IN GORBAD KAVOUS WERE CLOSED. A MEETING HELD MARCH 26 TO RESOLVE TURKOMAN GRIEVANCES DEGENERATED INTO FURTHER VIOLENCE. ON MARCH 27 THE TURKOMAN, REPORTEDLY AIDED BY MEMBERS OF THE MARXIST FEDAYIN-EKHALQ, CAPTURED AN UNDETERMINED NUMBER OF POLICE AND GENDARMERIE STATIONS IN THE VICINITY OF GONBAD KAVOUS.

EARLY MARCH 28, HOWEVER, THE GOVERNMENT-CONTROLLED VOICE OF THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTION OF IRAN KTHE ISLAMIC HAS BEEN ADDED WITHIN THE LAST SEVERAL DAYS) CLAIMED THAT THERE WERE NO POLICE OR GENDARMERIE FACILITIES IN THE GONBAD KAVOUS AREA THAT WERE NOT UNDER GOVERNMENT CONTROL (THE CONTORTED SYNTAX OF THE STATEMENT SUGGESTED THAT THE FACILITIES IN QUESTION HAD NOT BEEN UNDER GOVERNMENT CONTROL AT SOME POINT). THE EXACT DEGREE OF SEVERITY OF THE FIGHTING IS NOT YET CLEAR (THE NUMBER OF DEATHS HAS BEEN REPORTED VARIOUSLY AS BETWEEN 7 AND 50).

THE REACTION OF THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT HAS BEEN TO RECALL THE GOVERNOR GENERAL FROM GORGAN AND TO DISPATCH A THREE-MEMBER DELEGATION FROM THE MINISTRY OF INTERIOR TO GONBAD KAVOUS TO MEDIATE WITH THE TURKOMAN. IN ADDITION, AYATOLLAH TALAGHANI HAS ISSUED A STATEMENT LAYING RESPONSIBILITY FOR ETHNIC FRICTIONS IN IRAN ON THE PREVIOUS REGIME "WITH THE SUPPORT OF ITS COLONIALIST MASTERS", AND PROMISING THE TURKOMAN NO LESS THAN HAD BEEN GRANTED TO THE KURDS EARLIER. TALAGHANI SAID "THE ADMINISTRATION OF THE INTERNAL AFFAIRS OF THE PROVINCES SHOULD, AS FAR AS POSSIBLE, BE RUN BY THE PEOPLE THEMSELVES IN CONSULTATION WITH AND BY SETTING UP TOWN AND RURAL COUNCILS".

THE FEDAYIN HAVE DENIED ANY ROLE IN THE FIGHTING IN THE GONBAD KAVOUS AREA, BUT REPORTS THAT THEY SIDED WITH THE TURKOMAN THERE PROBABLY SHOULD NOT BE DISMISSED OUT OF HAND, PARTICULARLY IN LIGHT OF SIMILAR REPORTS FROM SANANDAJ LAST WEEK. RECOGNIZING THAT THEY ARE NOT YET STRONG ENOUGH TO ATTACK THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT FRONTALLY, THROWING THEIR SUPPORT TO THE ETHNIC MINORITIES IS A CONVENIENT MEANS OF KEEPING THE GOVERNMENT OFF BALANCE WHILE THE FEDAYIN CONTINUE TO BUILD THEIR STRENGTH.

ELSEWHERE, ARABS IN KHUZESTAN REPORTEDLY HAVE DEMANDED THAT THEY BE GIVEN THE SAME CONTROL OVER THE MINERAL WEALTH OF THEIR PROVINCE THAT KURDS HAVE BEEN GRANTED OVER THEIRS. (IN FACT, THE AGREEMENT MEDIATED BY AYATOLLAH TALAGHANI IN SANANDAJ LAST WEEK DID NOT ADDRESS THE QUESTION OF WHO WOULD CONTROL NATURAL RESOURCES, ALTHOUGH DEMANDS FOR SUCH CONTROL HAVE BEEN MADE BY VARIOUS KURDISH LEADERS ON SEVERAL OCCASIONS). IRANIAN ARABS, OF COURSE, SAY THEY WOULD BE PREPARED TO SELL THEIR OIL TO THE REST OF THE COUNTRY.

IN KURDESTAN, AHMAD MOFTIZADEH, A KURDISH MODERATE WHO PLAYED A PROMINENT ROLE IN THE SANANDAJ NEGOTIATIONS WITH TALAGHANI, URGED ALL KURDS TO VOTE FOR AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC IN THE REFERENDUM MARCH 30. SEVEN OTHER KURDISH POLITICAL ORGANIZATIONS. SOME OF WHICH APPEAR TO BE LEFTIST, HOWEVER, HAVE ISSUED A STATEMENT SAYING THAT THEY WILL BOYCOTT THE REFERENDUM AND URGING ALL KURDS TO DO LIKEWISE.

OVER THE LAST SEVERAL DAYS A NUMBER OF LEADING RELIGIOUS FIGURES, INCLUDING AYATOLLAHS SHARIAT-MADARI, ROUHANI, GOLPAYEGANI, MONTAZERI, AND SHIRAZI, HAVE URGED THE IRANIAN PEOPLE TO VOTE FOR AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. NUMEROUS CLERICS AND RELIGIOUS STUDENTS HAVE HEEDED THE WORD OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI TO SPREAD THE MESSAGE ABOUT THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC AND HAVE TAKEN TO THE COUNTRYSIDE. IT IS NOT CLEAR WHETHER THESE INDIVIDUALS ARE JUST URGING THE PEOPLE TO EXERCISE THEIR RIGHT TO VOTE OR HAVE ADMINISTRATIVE FUNCTIONS AS WELL. WE ARE TOLD THAT THE ULEMA (ALONG WITH NEW "GUARDIANS OF THE REVOLUTION" AND OTHER YOUTH) WILL BE AMONG THOSE WHO WILL SERVE AS POLL WATCHERS.
THE GOVERNMENT REPORTEDLY HAS INVITED A DELEGATION FROM THE INTERNATIONAL LAWYERS ASSOCIATION TO OBSERVE THE BALLOTING, WHO ARE REPORTEDLY ARRIVING TODAY FROM FRANCE.

GEN GHARANI, CHIEF OF THE SUPREME STAFF, HAS EITHER RESIGNED OR BEEN FIRED AND HAS BEEN REPLACED BY MAJ GEN NASER FARBOD. FARBOD APPARENTLY WAS FORCED TO RETIRE IN 1975 BECAUSE OF DEFFERENCES WITH THE PAHLAVI REGIME.

A COMMITTEE HAS BEEN ESTABLISHED TO RECOMMEND CHANGES FOR CERTAIN STREETS AND OTHER PUBLIC LANDMARKS. REPORTEDBIGOT PAHLAVI AVENUE WILL BECOME MOSSADEQ AVENUE AND SHAH AVENUE WILL BECOME REPUBLIC AVENUE.

THE EMBASSY IS RECEIVING AN INCREASING NUMBER OF QUERIES FROM THE U.S. AND IRANIAN OFFICES REPRESENTING U.S. FIRMS CONCERNING BUSINESS TRAVEL TO IRAN. GIVEN THE RECOGNIZED LACK OF ADEQUATE COMMUNICATIONS AND THE UNSETTLED MANAGEMENT SITUATION IN BOTH GOI AGENCIES AND IRANIAN FIRMS, IT IS CLEAR THAT A CASE EXISTS FOR THE PERSONAL TOUCH IF TRADE AND CONTRACT RELATIONSHIPS BETWEEN OUR TWO COUNTRIES ARE TO BE RESOLVED, WHERE NEEDED, AND RESUME.

WE HAVE MET WITH SOME AMERICAN BUSINESSMEN WHO RETURNED TO IRAN IN RECENT WEEKS AND JUDGE FROM THEIR EXPERIENCES THAT THEY HAVE IN GENERAL BEEN RECEIVED WELL, HAVE ACCOMPLISHED THEIR OBJECTIVES AND HAVE NOT MET WITH SECURITY DIFFICULTIES. IN EACH CASE THE INDIVIDUAL HAS OBSERVED GOOD PERSONAL SAFETY PRECAUTIONS, RESTRICTED ACTIVITY TO DAYTIME HOURS AND MOVED WITH IRANIAN ESCORT, ESPECIALLY IF OUTSIDE TEHRAN. IN SEVERAL CASES, THE RETURNEE HAS EXPERIENCED A MOST UNEXPECTED WELCOME FROM THE GOI AGENCY, WHICH IS FINDING ITS PATH IN RECONSTRUCTION OF PROGRAMS DIFFICULT WITH THE ABSENCE OF THE FORMER MANAGEMENT AND FOREIGN EXPERTISE.

THE EMBASSY SUGGESTS THEREFORE THAT THE DEPARTMENT, WHILE ADHERING TO THE GENERAL ADVISORY AGAINST TRAVEL TO IRAN, RESPOND TO BUSINESS QUERIES BY DRAWING UPON PARA TWO AND DIRECTING THE PERSONAL DECISION ON TRAVEL TO IRAN TO SUCH FACTORS AS THE EXPECTED RECEPTION IN IRAN (I.E. LITTLE CHANCE OF ARREST OWING TO A HEATED DISPUTE WITH HIS COMPANY), A WORTHWHILE AND LIMITED OBJECTIVE AND, MOST PERSUAVSIVE, AN INVITATION FROM IRAN TO COME. TRAVELERS SHOULD BE ENCOURAGED TO CONTACT THE EMBASSY UPON ARRIVAL IN TEHRAN.
