1979TEHRAN03362.subject: CONVERSATION WITH TEACHERS' UNION BOSS DERRAKSHESH

segments.text: C- ENTIRE TEXT.

SUMMARY: PROMINENT MODERATE LEADER WHO OPPOSED THE SHAH AND PRESENTLY OPPOSES ISLAMIC "DICTATORSHIP" ARGUES THAT EVERYTHING IS GETTING WORSE IN IRAN. POL COUNSELOR COUNTERS THAT SAFEST COURSE FOR PEOPLE SUCH AS THIS LEADER IS TO ASSIST BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT'S SURVIVAL LEST WORSE COME. END SUMMARY.

MOHAMMAD DERRAKSHESH, HEAD OF IRAN'S TEACHERS' UNION AND AMODERATE POLITICAN WHO HAS NOT JOINED THE REVOLUTIONARY GOVERNMENT, ASKED TO MEET WITH POL SOUNSELOR IN INTERMEDIARY'S HOUSE MARCH 28. DERAKSHESH HAS BEEN APPREHENSIVE ABOUT MEETING WITH POL COUNSELOR SINCE THE SUCCESS OF THE REVOLUTION AND EVEN NOW ASKS THAT MEETING BE DONE IN A WAY SO AS NOT TO BECOME KNOWN TO THE AUTHORITIES.

IN TELEPHONE CONVERSATIONS, HE HAD REVEALED THAT HE IS AN OLD PERSONAL AND POLITICAL FRIEND OF GENERAL GHARANI, WHO WAS UNTIL MARCH 27TH CHIEF OF THE ARMED FORCES STAFF. DERRAKSHESH SAID HE HAD MET WITH GHARANI SEVERAL TIMES IN THE LAST WEEKS AND HAD CALLED HIM UP UPON HEARING THE NEWS OF HIS REPLACEMENT AS CHIEF OF STAFF. GHARANI SAID IT IS NOT POSSIBLE TO WORK WITH THE PRESENT GOVERNMENT, AND PROMISED TO MEET WITH DERRAKSHESH IN A FEW DAYS TO DISCUSS THE MATTER. DERRAKSHESH WILL ALSO BE MEETING WITH MINISTER OF DEFENSE MADANI, WHO IS ALSO A POLITICAL ASSOCIATE.

IN REPLY TO POL COUNSELOR'S QUESTION, DERRAKSHESH SAID HE WAS UNAWARE OF ANY DIFFERENCES BETWEEN GHARANI AND MADANI, AND NOTED IT WAS GHARANI HIMSELF WHO FIRST APPOINTED MADANI TO A POSITION IN THE MINISTRY OF DEFENSE (AS HEAD OF THE NAVY).

DERRAKSHESH BEGAN WITH A LITANY OF COMPLAINTS AGAINST THE GOVERNMENT OF THE MULLAHS. HE THOUGHT THINGS WERE CONSTANTLY GETTING WORSE, AND THOSE IN CHARGE DID NOT KNOW WHAT THEY WERE DOING. HE SAID THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT WAS A "FAMILY GOVERNMENT". BAZARGAN HAD APPOINTED ALL FIVE OF HIS BUSINESS ASSOCIATES (INCLUDING SAHABI) TO GOVERNMENT POSITIONS. HIS BROTHER, WHO IS NOT PARTICULARLY EDUCATED, HAD BEEN NAMED CUSTODIAN OF THE SHAH'S PALACES. YAZDI'S SON-IN-LAW, ROUHANI, WAS REPRESENTATIVE IN THE UNITED STATES, WHILE HIS BROTHER, DENTIST ESMAILI YAZDI, WAS DEPUTY MINISTER OF HEALTH. BANI-SADR'S BROTHER HAS BEEN APPOINTED TO THE MINISTRY OF JUSTICE. THE FATHER OF SANJABI'S SON-IN-LAW IS CHIEF OF POLICE.
SANJABI'S BROTHER-IN-LAW IS MINISTER OF ECONOMICS AND FINANCE. ALL THIS REVOLTED DERRAKSHESH AND OTHER PEOPLE.

THERE HAS BEEN NO REVOLUTION, DERRAKSHESH SAID, JUST A TRANSFER OF POWER. THE SAME "CORRUPT" PEOPLE ARE RUNNING THINGS. BY CORRUPT HE DID NOT REALLY MEAN FINANCIALLY CORRUPT, BUT MENTALLY CORRUPT. HE CALLED SUCH OPPORTUNISTS MEMBERS OF THE "WIND PARTY", SINCE THEY HAVE NO IDEOLOGY AND ARE FULL OF WIND. A GOOD EXAMPLE IS CENTRAL BANK HEAD MOWLAVI, WHO USED TO BE A MEMBER OF DERRAKSHESH'S POLITICAL GROUPING BUT HAD ALSO BEEN A MEMBER OF ALI AMINI'S PARTY, AND HAD WORKED WITH THE SHAH, WRITTING MANY ARTICLES FOR TASTAKHIZ' NEWSPAPER.

WHAT PARTICULARLY WORRIED DERRAKSHESH WAS THE REACTIONARY, ANTI-WESTERN CAST OF THE RELIGIOUS PEOPLE. EVEN IN ALLIANCE WITH A STRONG POLITICAL LEADER SUCH AS MOSSADEGH, THE MULLAHS HAD NOT WON. THEY DID NOT KNOW THE SITUATION EITHER IN IRAN OR IN THE WORLD. THERE WAS A JOKE ABOUT KHOMEINI MAKING THE ROUNDS: WHEN TOLD PRESIDENT VARTER WOULD LKE TO MEET WITH HIM, KHOMEINI REPUTEDLY REPLIED, "CARTER SHOULD RESIGN FIRST AND THEN COME SEE ME." THIS ILLUSTRATED HOW PEOPLE FELT ABOUT KHOMEINI'S NARROW-MINDEDNESS AND HIS DICTATORIAL HABITS. DERRAKSHESH HAD HAD A MEETING WITH HIM WHEN KHOMEINI WAS IN TEHRAN, DURING WHICH KHOMEINI DID ALL THE TALKING.

HE HAD EXPRESSED GENERALITIES SUCH AS A DESIRE FOR A STRONG ARMY AND A GOOD EDUCATIONAL SYSTEM, BUT HE HAD NO GOOD, SPECIFIC IDEAS AND DID NOT LISTEN TO ADVICE. HE WAS ALSO EXTREMELY PROUD, ANS PROUD AS THE SHAH.
IN SHORT, DERRAKSHESH SAID, MAY OF HIS FRIENDS DISLIKED BOTH THE COMMUNISTS AND THE MULLAHS, BUT IF ASKED WHOM THEY WOULD CHOOSE, THE SAY THEY WOULD CHOOSE THE COMMUNISTS.

THE ABOVE WAS INTERSPERSED WITH COMMENTS FROM POL COUNSELOR. POL COUNSELOR CHALLENGED THE INTELLIGENCE AND SOPHISTICATION OF PEOPLE WHO SAY THAT THEY PREFER COMMU------------------122803 290835Z /11 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 0591 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 3362 EXDIS NISM TO THE MULLAH. IT SEEMED INCREDIBLE THAT SUCH PEOPLE DID NOT KNOW ENOUGH TO SHY AWAY FROM COMMUNISM JUST BECAUSE THEY HAD NEVER TASTED IT IN IRAN. POL COUNSELOR MADE THE POINT AT GREAT LENGTH AND WITH MANY EXAMPLES THAT MODERATE DEMOCRATIC POLITICIANS FROM THE MIDDLE CLASS, SUCH AS DERRAKSHESH HIMSELF OR MATINEDAFTARY OR EVEN SANJABI, COULD NOT HOPE TO CONTROL A POWERFUL MASS FOLLOWING IN TODAY'S IRAN.

THEREFORE, THEY ARE DEPENDENT FOR ANY INFLUENCE THEY MIGHT EXERT ON AN ALLIANCE WITH SOME ELEMENT WHICH CONTROLS THE GUNS IN THE STREETS. IT IS VERY DANGEROUS TO PLAY THE GAME THEY ARE BEGINNING TO PLAY, CRITICIZING BAZARGAN ANDKHOMEINI AND THUS ALLYING THEMSELVES WITH THE MARXIST-COMMUNIST LEFT AND THE FEDAYEEN.

POL COUNSELOR OPINED THAT PUTTING UP WITH SOME OF KHOMEINI'S IDEAS AND DECREEES WAS A PRICE SUCH MODERATES HAVE TO PAY FOR THE PROTECTION KHOMEINI AND THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT PROVIDES AT THIS JUNCTURE. THEIR HOPE LIES IN STRENGTHENING BAZARGAN AND THE PRESENT GOVERNMENT SO THAT IT WILL PLAY A MORE DETERMING ROLE IN THE FUTURE. BAZARGAN IS MUCH CLOSER TO THE MODERATE POLITICIANS THAN HE IS TO THE MULLAHS. IT IS NOT A MATTER OF INDIVIDUAL PERSONALITIES OR CAPABILITIES WITHIN THE GOVERNMENT, BUT THE SYSTEM ITSELF.
POL COUNSELOR DOUBTED THAT DERRAKSHESH HIMSELF COULD DO A BETTER JOB AS PRIME MINISTER THAN BAZARGAN IS DOING, GIVEN ALL THE VARIOUS FACTORS AGAINST A PRIME MINISTER IN THE PRESENT SITUATION.

DERRAKSHESH LISTENED ATTENTIVELY AND RESISTED THESE SUGGESTIONS WITH A NUMBER OF ARGUMENTS SUMMARIZED ABOVE. HE APPEARED AT THE END OF ONE AND HALF HOURS TO AGREE, HOWEVER, THAT HIS OWN BEST STRATEGY SHOULD BE NOT TO CRITICIZE THE GOVERNMENT BUT DO DO PRACTICAL THINGS WHICH WILL HELP IT SURVIVE. THIS NEED NOT MEAN JOINING THE GOVERNMENT (SINCE DERRAKSHESH WANTS TO STAKE OUT AN INDEPENDENT POSITION FOR HIS PARTY) BUT IT MEANS COUNSELING TEACHERS WHO ARE UNDER HIS INFLUENCE, FOR EXAMPLE, TO TEACH IN THEIR CLASSROOMS INSTEAD OF DISCUSSING ONLY POLITICS.

DERRAKSHESH SAID IT IS THE SCHOOL CHILDREN WHO ARE THE BOSSES IN THE SCHOOL AND DICTATE WHAT WILL BE DISCUSSED. POL COUNSELOR ASKED IF DERRAKSHESH WAS TELLING HIM THAT ALL IRANIAN TEACHERS ARE INCOMPETENT AND DO NOT TAKE CONTROL OF THE GROUPS OF YOUNGSTERS THROUGH MORAL SUASION AND AUTHORITY. HE POINTED OUT THIS IS A PROBLEM ENCOUNTERED IN AMERICAN BY MANY TEACHERS IN THE LARGER CITIES, AND THAY ARE NOT ALL SUCCESSFUL. HOWEVER, A GOOD NUMBER OF THEM ARE ABLE TO DOMINATE THE STUDENTS RATHER THAN THE OTHER WAY AROUND. DERRAKSHESH DID NOT ARGUE THIS POINT.

IN SUMMING UP, DERRAKSHESH NOTED THAT THE MASSES ARE GETTING TIRED OF THE PRESENT GOVERNMENT AND MAY SOON TURN AGAINST IT. POL COUNSELOR COUNTERED THAT THE ONLY HOPE FOR MODERATES IS THE CONTROL THE RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP CAN EXERT ON THE MASSES IN LIGHT OF THE GREAT ECONOMIC HARDSHIPS AHEAD. NO GOVERNMENT CAN OVERCOME THE HARD TIMES AWAITING IRAN. IF THE COMMUNISTS ARE ALLOWED TO HAVE THEIR WAY, THEY WILL PROMISE MORE HAPPINESS TO THE MASSES AND FEED THEM WITH THE LIVES AND PROPERTY OF THE MIDDLE CLASS.

THE RELIGIOUS PEOPLE AT LEAST OFFER A BETTER WAY OF CONTROLLING THE MASSES, AND THEIR REACTIONARY IDEAS (GOING BACK TO THE FOURTEENTH CENTRY, PER DERRAKSHESH) CANNOT SURVIVE FOR LONG IN TODAY'S IRAN. IRAN WILL REQUIRE FIRM AUTHORITY AT THE TOP FOR SOME TIME TO COME. AN ALLIANCE OF THE RIGHT, WHICH FEATURES MODERATES SUCH AS BAZARGAN AND DERRAKSHESH UNDER THE PROTECTION OF THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT, IS FAR SAFER AND HEALTHIER THAN THE ONLY LIKELY ALTERNATIVE --AN ALLIANCE OF THE LEFT WHICH FALLS TO COMMUNIST CONTROL AND EVENTUALLY IS "PROTECTED" BY THE SOVIET UNION, AS IS THE CASE AT PRESENT IN AFGHANISTAN. DERRAKSHESH APPEARED TO AGREE WITH ALL OF THIS.

INCIDENTALLY, DERRAKSHESH SAID EARLY IN THE MEETING THAT HE TENTATIVELY PLANS A TRIP TO THE CASPIAN SEA THIS COMING WEEKEND AND WILL NOT VOTE IN THE REFERENDUM--AND MANY OF HIS FRIENDS WILL NOT EITHER.

C-ENTIRE TEXT. THE FOLLOWING DIPLOMATIC NOTE WAS DELIVERED TO SAEED GOODARZNIA, HEAD OF THE FOURTH POLITICAL DEPARTMENT IN THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS, BY POL COUNSELOR LAMBTAKIS ON MARCH 29: BEGIN TEXT NO. 107 THE EMBASSY OF THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICAN PRESENTS ITS COMPLIMENTS TO THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS OF THE PROVISIONAL REVOUTIONARY AND ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT OF IRAN ANDHAS THE HONOR TO REFER TO ALLEGATIONS MADE BY MR. SHAHRIAR ROUHANI, WHOM THE EMBASSY OF THE UNITED STATES UNDERSTANDS TO BE THE PERONAL REPRESENTATIVE OF HAZRAT-EAYATOLLAY KHOMEINI IN THE UNITED STATES, CONCERNING WIDESPREAD AND SYSTEMATIC CORRUPTION INVOLVING THE FORMER AMBASSADOR OF IRAN TO THE UNITED STATES, MR.

ARDESHIR ZAHEDI, AND AMERICAN PUBLIC OFFICIALS, MEMBER OF THE PRESS, AND CORPORATE OFFICIALS. THESE ALLEGATIONS WERE MADE TO CONGRESSMAN MICHAEL BARNES AND TO THE UNITED STATES FEDERAL BUREAU OF INVESTIGATION. MR ROUHANI HAS CLAIMED THAT DOCUMENTATON FOR THE FILES OF THE IRANIAN EMBASSY IN WASHINGTON EXISTS WHEHC WOULD PROVE HIS ALLEGATIONS, BUT THAT THESE MATERIEALS (APPARENTLY TOTALLING 2,000 TO 3,000 PAGES) HAVE BEEN RETURNED TO TEHRAN. THE UNITED STATES DEPARTMENT OFJUSTICE WISHES TO INVESTIGATE MR ROUHANI'S ALLEGATIONS FURTHER IN ORDER TO DETERMINE WHETHER OR NOT THERE HAS BEEN A VIOLATION OF THE FEDRAL BRIBERY STATUTE, TITLE 18, UNITED STATES CODE, SECTION 201.

TOWARD THAT END, THE EMBASSY REQUESTS THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS TO PROVIDE THE DOICUMENTS REFERRED TO BY MR. ROUHANI, OR COPIES THEREOF, WHICH WILL BE TURNED OVER TO THE FEDERAL BUREAU OF INVESTIGATION. MOREOVER, THE EMBASSY WISHES TO INFORM THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS THAT THE THICS COMMITTEE OF THE UNITED STATES HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES HAS ALSO EXPRESSED AN INTEREST IN RECEIVING THE DOCUMENTS IN QUESTION OR COPIES THEREOF. THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS MAY BE ASSURED THAT IF THESE DOCUMENTS ARE MADE AVAILABLE, THEY WILL BE CAREFULLY SAFEGUARDED.
THE EMBASSY OF THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICAN AVAILS ITSELF OF THIS OPPORTUNITY TO RENEW TO THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS THE ASSURANCES OF ITS HIGHEST CONSIERATION. .

ON MARCH 29, POL COUNSELOR LAMBRAKIS CALLED ON HEAD OF MFA'S AMERICAS DEPARTMENT GOODARZNIA TO DISCUSS A NUMBER OF QUESTIONS. HE DELIVERED A SERIES OF LETTERS FOR THE MINISTRY OF NATIONAL DEFENSE, AND GOODARZNIA SEEMED RECEPTIVE TO THEM, COPIES OF WHICH ARE BEING POUCHED NEA/IRN.

LAMBRAKIS DELIVERED A CONFIDENTIAL NOTE REGARDING AN ISSUE RAISED BY MR. ROUHANI IN WASHINGTON, WHICH IS BEING REPORTED SEPTEL. GOODARZNIA CONFIDED UNOFFICIALLY THAT THERE IS ABOUT TO BE A CHANGE IN AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI'S REPRESENTATIVE FOR THE U.S. CHARGE ETESSAM IS LIKELY TO ANNOUNCE IT SOON. ROUHANI WILL PROBABLY BE REPLACED BY ONE MEHDI HAYERI.

GOODARZNIA ALSO ACCEPTED A LETTER FROM CHIEF OF EMBASSY CONSULAR SECTION RICHARDSON SPELLING OUT THE MISSION ABOUT TO BE UNDERTAKEN IN AHWAZ BY CONSUL TIMOTHY SKUD IN SUPPORT OF FLUOR COMPANY REPRESENTATIVES. THE OBJECT OF THE LETTER IS TO ASSURE THAT MR. SKUD'S CONSULAR STATUS WILL BE RESPECTED BY IRANIANS WITH WHOM HE COMES IN CONTACT IN AHWAZ.

LAMBRAKIS ALSO DELIVERED A DIPLOMATIC NOTE COVERING COURT ACTIONS BROUGHT BY EDS COMPANY, POINTING OUT POSSIBLE CONSEQUENCES IF NO REPLY MADE BY DEFENDANTS IN THE CASE WITHIN SIXTY DAYS. DISCUSSING THE EDS SITUATION MORE GENERALLY, GOODARZNIA AND LAMBRAKIS TENTATIVELY AGREED IT WOULD BE BEST IF VENUE FOR DISCUSSIONS BETWEEN IRANIAN GOVERNMENT AND EDS REPRESENTATIVES WERE SWITCHED TO WASHINGTON. THIS WOULD AVOID COMPLICATING ISSUES WITH INVOLVEMENT OF EXTRANEOUS PEOPLE WHO HAVE ONLY PARTIAL KNOWLEDGE OF THE ISSUES. GOODARZNIA PROMISED TO FOLLOW UP AND LET US KNOW.

GOODARZNIA ACKNOWLEDGED MFA HAD RECEIVED NOTE SENT BY MESSENGER A COUPLE OF DAYS BEFORE IN WHICH EMBASSY REQUESTED THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT'S PROTECTION OVER EMBASSY AND CONSULAR PROPERTIES IN TEHRAN AS WELL AS TABRIZ, ISFAHAN AND SHIRAZ.

LAMBRAKIS INQUIRED ABOUT THE STATUS OF MFA'S EFFORTS TO LOCATE TABRIZ' CONSULAR SEAL AND OTHER OFFICIAL AND PERSONAL DOCUMENTS LOST DURING THE ATTACK ON THE CONSULATE THERE. GOODARZNIA TRIED TO CONTACT ASSISTANT TO FM ARDALAN, WHO WAS NOT THERE. HE WILL GIVE US A FULL REPORT.
C-ENTIRE TEXT.

MFA DEPARTMENT HEAD BRIEFED POL COUNSELOR MARCH 29 ON SOME OF THE IMPRESSIONS GIVEN TO HIM BY THE FORMER IRANIAN CONSUL IN HERAT, MR. JAVAD HASHEMIAN. THESE COMMENTS WERE NECESSARILY BRIEF AND SECOND HAND. 3.CONSUL DESCRIBED SITUATION IN HERAT ON FIRST DAY OF REVOLUTION AS VERY SIMILAR TO LAST DAYS OF REVOLUTION IN IRANIAN CITIES. SOLDIERS FRATERNIZED AND MIXED WIDELY WITH OTHER PEOPLE, AFTER HAVING SURRENDERED THEIR ARMS TO THE CIVILIANS. THIS CHANGED RAPIDLY THE NEXT DAY, HOWEVER, WHEN NEW AFGHAN TROOP UNITS ARRIVED AND RETOOK THE CITY. CONSUL ASSOCIATED HIMSELF WITH REPORTS THAT THE NEW UNITS MAY NOT HAVE BEEN ETHNIC AFGHANS.
THEY WERE UZBEKS AND TADHJIKS, BUT MANY POEPLE SAID THEY WERE NOT MOSLEMS AND WERE ATHEISTS, THEREFORE PROBABLY FROM THE SOVIET UNION.

COMMENT: WE WOULD BE LOATHE TO ATTRIBUTE MUCH ACCURACY TO THESE CHARGES THAT AFGHAN TROOPS WERE REALLY SOVIET CITIZENS. CHARGES OF THIS NATURE HAVE BECOME COMMONPLACE IN IRAN AND MOST OFTEN PROVE UNFOUNDED RUMORS. THERE IS NOTHING TO INDICATE CONSUL HAD MORE SPECIFIC PROOF.

SUMMARY: TURKOMAN PROBLEMS CONTINUE. TWO DAYS TO BE ALLOWED FOR REFERENDUM, AND PRO-CON ACTIVITY GETS HOTTER; ALCOHOL IMPORTS TO BE BANNED; CHARTER FOR REVOLUTIONARY COURTS SUMBITTED TO COUNCIL; 106 HIGH RANKING CIVIL POLICE RETIRED; MORE ON QARANI RESIGNATION; COUNTER-REVOLUTIONARY "PLOTTERS" NAMED. 304 ACCUSED PRISONERS RELEASED. END SUMMARY.

PRESS REPORTS SAY THAT AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI IS NOW IN GONBAD KAVOUS IN NORTHEAST IRAN. TALEGHANI IS SAID TO HAVE DEPARTED ON A PEACE-MAKING EXPEDITION TO THE TROUBLED TURKOMAN AREA ON 28 MARCH. NEWSPAPER AND RADIO ACCOUNTS OF THE TURKOMAN FIGHTING DIFFER, AND A NUMBER OF CONFLICTING STORIES HAVE EMERGED. RADIO REPORTS CLAIM THAT A CEASEFIRE WAS DECLARED IN GONBAD KAVOUS EARLY ON 28 MARCH. PRESS ACCOUNTS SAY THAT THE FIGHTING CONTINUES. ESTIMATES OF DEAD RANGE FROM 20 TO 80 AND CLAIM UP TO 200 WOUNDED. REPORTS ALSO INDICATE THAT COMMITTEE FORCES ARE BUSILY ARRESTING INSTIGATORS.

ESTIMATES OF 50 TO 70 MEMBERS OF THE TURKOMAN CULTURAL AND POLITICAL SOCIETY UNDER COMMITTEE ARREST ARE GIVEN. THE TURKOMANS, ON THE OTHER HAND, ARE SAID TO HAVE ARRESTED A NUMBER OF THE COMMITTEE FORCES, TWO TRUCKLOADS OF ARMY REINFORCEMENTS AND THE LOCAL POLICE CHIEF.

THE REFERENDUM WILL EXTEND FOR TWO DAYS, AND THE POSSIBILITY OF A THIRD DAY HAS ALSO BEEN VOICED. ORIGINALLY LIMITED TO 30 MARCH, VOTERS MAY NOW CAST BALLOTS THROUGH 31 MARCH. AN ESTIMATED 10 TO 12 MILLION PEOPLE ARE EXPECTED TO PARTICIPATE IN THE REFERENDUM. IN THE MEANTIME ACTIVITIES PRO AND CON THE REFERENDUM CONTINUE. EXTENSIVE TELEVISION COVERAGE IS DEVOTED TO THE NECESSITY OF CASTING A BALLOT. LAST NIGHT'S PROGRAMMING INCLUDED A SERIES OF INTERVIEWS WITH THE "PEOPLE," MOST OF WHOM CLAIMED THEY WERE IN FAVOR OF AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC.

ONE EXCEPTION WAS A FEDAYEEN SPOKESMAN WHO CLAIMED THAT, WHILE THE FEDAYEEN BELIEVED IN ISLAM, THEY WERE OPPOSED TO THE REFERENDUM FORMAT. LEADING FIGURES IN THE KURDISH AND TURKOMAN COMMUNITIES HAVE ALSO COME OUT IN OPPOSITION. SHEIKH EZZEDIN HOSSEINI, THE IMAM JOMEH OF MAHABAD AND A KEY KURDISH RELIGIOUS FIGURE HAS SAID HE WILL NOT VOTE. THE CENTRAL COMMITTEE OF TURKOMAN COUNCILS (WITH WHICH THE TURKOMAN CULTURAL AND POLITICAL SOCIETY IN GONBAD KAVOUS IS AFFILIATED) HAS ALSO DECIDED ON A BALLOT BOYCOTT. RUMORS AND REPORTS OF FOUL PLAY ABOUND.

KHOMEINI HAS WARNED THAT "AGENTS OF THE FORMER REGIME" ARE PLANNING TO SABOTAGE THE BALLOT BOXES, AND HAS ASKED THE YOUNG PEOPLE OF THE NATION TO SAFEGUARD THEM. ACCORDING TO MIN. OF THE INTERIOR UNDER SECRETARY FOR POL. AFFAIRS TABATABAI'I ON LAST NIGHT'S TELEVISION, MISLEADING RUMORS ARE BEING SPREAD AMONG THE LOWER CLASSES. ONE RUMOR HAS IT THAT SINCE THE RECENT REVOLUTION WAS A "RED" ONE, THE PEASANTS SHOULD CAST RED BALLOTS TO INSURE THE SUCCESS OF THE REVOLUTION (THE GOVERNMENT IS PUSHING GREEN BALLOTS.) WARNINGS HAVE ALSO BEEN ISSUED THAT CERTAINGROUPS ARE ATTEMPTING TO COLLECT VILLAGERS' ID CARDS TO ATTEMPT BLOC VOTING.

EMBOFF HAS ALSO HEARD RUMORS THAT UNLESS A PERSON'S ID CARD IS STAMPED TO SHOW HE HAS VOTED, FUTURE PERMISSION TO DEPART IRAN WILL BE DENIED. THIS RUMOR MAY HAVE SOME EFFECT ON PEOPLE WHO PLANNED TO ABSTAIN FROM VOTING. THE GOVT HAS ALSO ANNOUNCED THAT ORGANIZATIONAL ID CARDS MAY BE ACCEPTED IN LIEU OF GOVERNMENT ISSUED IDENTITY BOOKLETS ("SEJIL") FOR THOSE WHO HAVE LOST THE LATTER. IN THE MEANTIME, BANNERS GALORE CAN BE SEEN AND VEHICLES WITH LOUDSPEAKERS HEAR THROUGHOUT TEHRAN, ADDING MORE THAN A LITTLE OLD-FASHIONED WARD-POLITICS FEELING TO THE WHOLE QUESTION.

COMMERCE MINISTER REZA SADR HAS ANNOUNCED THAT IMPORT OF LIQUOR INTO IRAN WILL BE COMPLETELY BANNED. ALCOHOLIC STOCKS BEING HELD IN CUSTOMS WILL BE SENT BACK AND IMPORTERS WHO HAVE ALREADY PAID FOR SUCH STOCKS WILL BE REIMBURSED. LACK OF WHISKY ON MARKET SEEMS TO BE OVERWHELMING CONCERN OF MANY IRANIANS, OFTEN TAKING PRECEDENCE OVER POKITICAL CONDITIONS, AND STORIES OF DEATH CAUSED BY HOMEMADE BREW HAVE ALREADY RECEIVED PRESS COVERAGE. EMBOFF HAD OPPORTUNITY TO SAMPLE BATHTUB VODKA AT RECENT IRANIAN PARTY AND CAN WELL BELIEVE POSSIBLE EFFECTS.
GIVEN MUCH NOTED IRANIAN THIRST, PRESUMPTION IS THAT BOOTLEGGING AND SMUGGLING OF LIQUOR WILL SOON BE A PROFITABLE UNDERGROUND ACTIVITY, DESPITE MUCH-BRUITED FLOGGING PENALTY FOR CONSUMPTION.
ETTELA'AT REPORTS THAT CHIEF PUBLIC PROSECUTOR HADAVI HAS SUBMITTED A CHARTER FOR THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS TO THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL. THE TRIBUNALS HAD CEASED WORK AT KHOMEINI'.

PERSIAN PRESS REPORTED THAT 106 NATIONAL POLICE GENERALS AND COLONELS HAVE BEEN RETIRED. ALL POLICE OFFICERS WITH WHOM EMBOFF HAS SPOKEN CONTINUE TO BE PESSIMISTIC ABOUT THEIR FUTURES AND PROFESSION IN GENERAL. DURING PAST TWO WEEKS EMBOFF HAD OPPORTUNITY TO SPEAK AT LENGTH WITH SEVEN DIFFERENT OFFICERS RANKING FROM LIEUTENANT TO COLONEL, AND SIX VOLUNTERRED INFORMATION THAT THEY PLANNED TO RESIGN FROM POLICE FORCE AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. COMBINATION OF TRIALS FOR MANY POLICE ACCUSED OF ANTI-REVOLUTIONARY ACTS AND CONTINUING LACK OF ORGANIZATIONAL DISCIPLINE BODE ILL FOR GENERAL FUTURE OF IRAN'S POLICE FORCE.

KAYHAN GIVES COVERAGE TO POSSIBLE REASONS FOR CHIEF OF STAFF QARANI'S RESIGNATION EARLIER THIS WEEK. AMONG RUMORS MENTIONED ARE ALLEGATIONS OF TORTURE MADE AGAINST QARANI AND STORIES THAT A COUP INVOLVING THE NEW REVOLUTIONARY ARMY WAS IN THE OFFING. THE PAPER PUTS MOST CREDENCE, HOWEVER, ON STORIES OF BLAME BEING ATTACHED TO QARANI FOR THE OVERBEARING MILITARY RESPONSE TO UNREST IN SANANDAJ AND ON THE RUMOR THAT MIN OF DEFENSE MADANI FELT QARANI WAS GETTING "TOO BIG FOR HIS BOOTS." KAYHAN CLAIMS QARANI WAS RESPONSIBLE FOR ORDERING THE ARMY INTO ACTION AGAINST THE KURDS AND FOR SENDING FORMER MEMBERS OF THE "IMMORTAL" GUARDS TO THE AREA.

QARANI IS ALSO REPORTED TO HAVE DISOBEYED INTERIOR MINISTER DJAVADI'S INSTRUCTIONS BY NOT STOPPING PHANTOM AIRCRAFT FLIGHTS OVER THE KURDISH/KHOMEINI DELEGATION MEETING PLACE. SOURCES FROM SANANDAJ QUOTED IN KAYHAN CLAIM QARANI'S STATEMENTS AND ORDERS WERE THE CAUSE OF THE PROLONGED BLOODSHED.

ETTELA'AT OF 28 MARCH HEADLINED AN ACCOUNT OF A PLOT AGAINST THE REVOLUTION. ACCORDING TO THE REPORT, THE SHAH HAS GIVEN 2 BILLION DOLLARS TO A LONDON-BASED GROUP OF IRANIANS TO BE USED FOR ANTI-REVOLUTION ACTIVITIES. THE NAMES AND PHOTOS OF THE SEVEN CHIEF PLOTTERS WERE GIVEN, AND INCLUDE ARDESHIR ZAHEDI, GEN. HASHEMI NEJAD, EX-PRIMIN SHARIF-EMAMI, AGHA-KHAN BAKHTIAR, EX-GOV. GEN. OF EAST AZARBAIJAN ESKANDAR AZEMUDEH, EX-KISH ISLAND PROJECT DIRECTOR MAHMUD MONSEF, AND ALI ABDOH.

TEHRAN RADIO ANNOUNDED LATE TODAY THAT 304 ACCUSED PERSONS WERE RELEASED YESTERDAY FROM PRISON AFTER DUE CONSIDERATION BY THE IRANIAN ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COURT. THEIR NAMES WILL BE PUBLISHED IN THE PRESS.
THIS IS A TEMPORARY RESPONSE TO REFS B AND C, WHICH WERE RECEIVED MARCH 30, ON IRAN'S WEEKEND. WE WILL CONFIRM THE FOLLOWING MARCH 31, THE FIRST DAY OF IRAN'S WORKWEEK.

EMBASSY IS NOT SURPRISED THAT KMW COULD NOT MAKE TELEPHONIC CONTACT WITH KWPA OFFICE IN THAT MOST OF TIME SINCE SUBMISSION OF REF A HAS BEEN NO RUZ (NEW YEARS) HOLIDAY PERIOD IN IRAN, EFFECTIVELY MARCH 20 TO 27, BUT ABSENTEEISM IS HEAVY ON EITHER SIDE OF THOSE DATES.

EMBASSY CALLED KWPA OFFICES MARCH 30, A NON-WORKING DAY, AT 10 AM, AND SPOKE WITH A GUARD. HE SAID THAT THE OFFICE HOURS ARE 07:30 TO 14:30 SATURDAY THROUGH WEDNESDAY (APRIL 2 IS A HOLIDAY). WE OBTAINED TWO NAMES IN ADDITION TO THAT OF THE NEW MANAGING DIRECTOR PROVIDED IN REF A; PHONETICALLY THEY ARE AHMADI AND YAGHOB. THESE ARE IN THE AHWAZ MAIN OFFICE: TEL 30090 THROUGH 30094. THE GUARD SAID YAGHOB SPEAKS ENGLISH; WE BELIVE ENGINEER SALOOR IN TEHRAN IS FLUENT IN ENGLISH.
QUESTION WHETHER KWPA IS WORKING IS A BIT SPECIOUS SINCE IF IT WERE NOT, THE PROVINCE OF KHUZESTAN WOULD BE WITHOUT BOTH.
C - ENTIRE TEXT.
SUMMARY: IRAN VOTES. FIGHTING CONTINUES IN GONBAD KAVOUS. KURDISH DEMOCRATIC PARTY BOYCOTTS REFERENDUM. SOME ARRESTED, SOME RELEASED. END SUMMARY.

VOTING IN THE REFERENDUM TO DECIDE WHAT FORM OF GOVERNMENT IRAN IS TO HAVE IS UNDERWAY AS OF 1200 LOCAL TIME MARCH 30. THE TURNOUT IN TEHRAN APPEARS TO BE FAIRLY LARGE. A RANDOM SURVEY AROUND THE CITY EARLY TODAY INDICATED THAT THE POLLS ARE WELL-GUARDED BY IRREGULAR MILITIAMEN AND THAT VOTERS ARE CASTING THEIR BALLOTS IN AN ORDERLY FASHION.

CHANGES IN THE PROCEDURES CONTINUED TO BE ANNOUNCED UP TO THE VERY LAST MINUTE, WITH KHOMEINI STATING LATE MARCH 29 THAT ANYONE WHO DID NOT WANT TO VOTE FOR EITHER AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OR A MONARCHY COULD WRITE IN THE TYPE OF GOVERNMENT HE OR SHE WANTED ON THE RED PORTION (THE ONE OTHERWISE USED FOR VOTING FOR THE MONARCHY). ACTUAL PROCEDURES AT THE POLLS INDICATED LESS THAN TOTAL FREEDOM OF CHOICE.

AT SEVERAL LOCATIONS SURVEYED THIS MORNING VOTERS WERE BEING ASKED BY THE INDIVIDUALS DISPENSING THE BALLOT WHETHER THEY WISHED TO VOTE FOR AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC ("YES") OR THE MONARCHY ("NO") AND THEN BEING HANDED ONLY THE GREEN PORTION OF THE BALLOT. ASIDE FROM SEVERAL ARMENIAN CHURCHES WHICH ARE SERVING AS POLLING STATIONS AND WHERE LARGE NUMBERS OF BOTH MEN AND WOMEN WERE OBSERVED, MALE TURNOUT APPEARS TO BE MUCH HEAVIER THAN FEMALE PARTICIPATION. WE HAVE HEARD ONE REPORT OF A BOGUS (UNAUTHORIZED) POLLING STATION, COMPLETE WITH BALLOTS, HAVING BEEN DISCOVERED.

THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT ANNOUNCED YESTERDAY AFTERNOON, MARCH 29, THAT ARMY UNITS WERE BEING SENT TO GONBAD KAVOUS WHERE FIGHTING BETWEEN THE LOCAL TURKOMAN POPULATION AND GOVERNMENT FORCES HAS BEEN GOING ON FOR THE LAST SEVERAL DAYS.

THE VOICE OF THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTION OF IRAN (IRRI) ANNOUNCED THAT IN VIEW OF "THE DISARMING OF A NUMBER OF GENDARMERIE STATIONS, THE ARREST OF THE LOCAL POLICE CHIEF, THE OCCUPATION OF POLICE HEADQUARTERS AND SEVERAL GUARDPOSTS", IT HAD BEEN "DECIDED TO FILL THE VACUUM CAUSED BY THE ABSENCE OF SECURITY FORCES WITH ELEMENTS FROM THE NATIONAL ISLAMIC ARMY." DEPUT PM AMIR ENTEZAM AT A NEWS CONFERENCE SAID THAT THE TROOPS WERE BEING SENT "TO RESTORE PUBLIC ORDER SO THAT THE PEOPLE COULD TAKE PART IN THE FRIDAY-SATURDAY REFERENDUM*"

INDEPENDENT SOURCES REPORT THAT TROOPS ACTUALLY BEGAN TO ARRIVE IN GONBAD KAVOUS MARCH 28 AND THAT THE TOWN IS NOW UNDER VIRTUAL MARTIAL LAW. NEWS TEAMS WERE ROUGHLY TREATED BY THE LOCAL REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE, WHICH APPARENTLY IS HEADED BY A YOUNG SHIA MULLAH, WHILE TRYING TO COVER EVENTS THERE ON WEDNESDAY. NEWSMEN RETURNING TO TEHRAN REPORTED THAT THE SITUATION IN GONBAD KAVOUS WAS CHARACTERIZED BY SNIPER WARFARE BETWEEN TURKOMEN FORCES WHICH CONTROLLED THE NORTHERN HALF OF THE TOWN AND THE COMMITTEE MILITIAMEN WHO HELD THE REST AND ACCESS ROUTES INTO IT.

A LATER REPORT INDICATED THAT WITH THE ARRIVAL OF REGULAR MILITARY TROOPS FIGHTING INTENSIFIED, WITH AIR FORCE JETS SCREAMING OVERHEAD AND TURKOMAN POSITIONS BEING HIT BY GRENADES AND MOTAR FIRE. THERE WERE ALSO REPORTS THAT THE FIGHTING HAD SPREAD TO OTHER LOCATIONS OUTSIDE GONBAD KAVOUS.

MEDIATION EFFORTS BY AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI NEVER HAD A CHANCE TO GET STARTED. THE HELICOPTER CARRYING HIM TO GONBAD KAVOUS ON MARCH 28 WAS UNABLE TO LAND BECAUSE IT CAME UNDER FIRE AS IT APPROACED THE TOWN. AMIR ENTEZAM ANNOUNCED MARCH 29 THAT TALEGHANI MAY TRY AGAIN AT A LATER DATE. THE TURKOMAN FORCES HAVE SET EIGHT CONDITIONS FOR AN END OF THE HOSTILITIES WHICH INCLUDE THE RELEASE OF TURKOMANS ARRESTED, GOVERNMENT RECOGNITION OF TURKOMAN COUNCILS, AND FREEDOM FOR THE COUNCILS TO CONDUCT THEIR ACTIVITIES.

IN REFERENCE TO THE FIGHTING IN GONBAD KAVOUS, AMIR ENTEZAM CLAIMED THAT "THERE IS A CONSPIRACY IN VARIOUS PARTS OF THE COUNTRY" AMONG "PEOPLE WHOSE INTERESTS HAVE BEEN DAMAGED BY THE REVOLUTION..." A STATEMENT ISSUED BY KHOMEINI ON MARCH 29 CONFIRMED THE CONTINUATION OF ETHNIC UNREST ELSEWHERE, BUT UNLIKE AMIR ENTEZAM, KHOMEINI WAS QUITE SPECIFIC IN ASSIGNING THE BLAME FOR THIS ON THE U.S.

REFERRING TO "DISTRUBING REPORTS" FROM GONBAD KAVOUS, ZAHEDAN (THE PROVINCIAL CAPITAL OF SISTAN AND BALUCHISTAN) AND ARDEBIL (IN EAST AAZARBAIJAN PROVINCE), KHOMEINI SAID THAT "CERTAIN DECADENT FACTIONS ARE BUSY SPREADING POISON AND PROMOTING DIVISIVENESS," THAT "THESE FACTIONS HAVE SPREAD THE RUMOR THAT CLERGYMEN WILL DEPRIVE THE SUNNI BROTHERS OF THEIR RIGHTS." KHOMEINI CONTINUED THAT "THESE MISLED PEOPLE, WHO GET THEIR INSPIRATION FROM AMERICA AND APPEAR IN THE GUISE OF LEFTISTS, ARE PLANNING TO RESTORE THE PERIOD OF LOOTINGS OF THE PREVIOUS REGIME IN ANOTHER FORM IN OUR DEAR COUNTRY." AN INDIRECT CONFIRMATION THAT TROUBLE MAY BE BREWING IN BALUCHISTAN WAS THE ANNOUNCEMENT MARCH 29 THAT DEFENSE MINISTER MEDANI HAS BEEN DISPATCHED TO ZAHEDAN.

ELSEWHERE ON THE ETHNIC FRONT, THE KURDISH DEMOCRATIC PARTY HAS ANNOUNCED THAT IT WILL BOYCOTT THE REFERENDUM. PARTY SECRETARY GENERAL, ABDOL RAHMAN GHASEMLOU, CHARGED THE REFERENDUM WITH BEING "ANTI-DEMOCRATIC" BECAUSE IT OFFERS NO CHOICE TO VOTERS. HE ALSO DESCRIBED THE RECENT AGREEMENT NEGOTIATED IN SANANDAJ BY AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI AS "EMPTY WORDS." ACCORDING TO THE FARSI-LANGUAGE DAILY, ETTELA'AT, FIVE FORMER CABINET MINISTERS, A FORMER MAJLES MEMBER, AND A GENERAL HAVE BEEN ARRESTED BY REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES.

THE FORMER MINISTERS ARE AHMAN MIRFENDERESKI AND CYRUS AMOUZEGAR, WHO SERVED AS MINISTER OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS AND MINISTER OF INFORMATION, RESPECTIVELY, UNDER SHAPUR BAKHTIAR, AND KARIM MOTAMEDI, HOMAYUN JABAR ANSARI AND MORTEZA SALEHI WHO SERVED AS MINISTER OF POST, TELEGRAPH AND TELEPHONE, MINISTER OF HOUSING AND MINISTER OF TRANSPORTATION, RESPECTIVELY, UNDER EARLIER GOVERNMENTS. ELSEWHERE, MEHDI HADAVI, THE CHIEF PUBLIC PROSECUTOR, ANNOUNCED THAT IN ADDITION TO 304 PRISONERS WHO HAD BEEN RELEASED ON WEDNESDAY, THE FILES OF A NUMBER OF OTHER PRISONERS WERE BEING EXAMINED AND THEIR FATE WOULD BE DECIDED AS QUICKLY AS POSSIBLE.

AFP REPORTS UNCONFIRMED ESTIMATES AS PUTTING THE NUMBER CURRENTLY BEING HELD IN QASR PRISON AT 8,000 AND THE NUMBER THROUGHOUT IRAN AT 50,000. CITING PM BAZARGAN AS ITS SOURCE, VIRI REPORTED MARCH 29 AT 62 PEOPLE HAD BEEN EXECUTED SINCE MID-FEBRUARY.
C - ENTIRE TEXT.

SUMMARY: BALLOTING CONTINUESBM TURNOUT LARGE. SOME ADMINISTRATIVE PROBLEMS IN VARIOUS PROVINCIAL AREAS AND SOME EFFORTS TO DISRUPT VOTING IN KURDESTAN. FIGHTING CONT NUES IN GONBAD KAVOUS. DELEGATIONS DISPATCHED IN AN ATTEMPT TO MEDIATE A CEASEFIRE THERE AND TO INVESTIGATE ETHNIC UNREST IN BALUCHISTAN AND EAST AZARBAIJAN. DEFENSE MINISTER MADANI REPLACED OY ELDERLY RETIRED GENERAL WITH NATIONAL NRONT CONNECTIONS. IRAN WANTS THE SHAH BACK--TO STAND TRIAL. END SUMMARY.

IRAN'S REFERENDUM CONTINUES TODAY, MARCH 31. YESTERDAY'S BALLOTING IN TEHRAN PROCEEDED WITHOUT MAJOR DIFFICULTY AND THE TURNOUT APPEARED TO BE QUITE HEAVY. DESPITE A NOTABLE LACK OF FEMALE VOTERS IN EVIDENCE AT MOST OF THE POLLING STATIONS OBSERVED BY EMBASSY PERSONNEL, WE ARE AWARE OF NO CONSTRAINTS HAVING BEEN PLACED ON WOMEN GOING TO THE POLLS. INDEED, A NUMBER OF IRANIANS QUESTIONED BY EMBASSY OFFICERS INDICATED THAT FEMALE MEMBERS OF THEIR FAMILIES TURNED OUT EN MASSE. TELEVISION COVERAGE OF SEVERAL POLLING STATIONS GAVE THE IMPRESSION THAT MOST WOMEN WHO VOTED WERE CHADORIS, I.E., DRESSED IN THE TRADITIONAL VEIL.

INTERVIEWS WITH BOTH MALE AND FEMALE VOTERS AT THE POLLS REVEALED A GENERALLY UNSOPHISTICATED APPRECIATION OF WHAT IN FACT THEY WERE VOTING FOR. THERE WAS A HIGH INNIDENCE OF EQUATION OF THE PROPOSED ISLAMIC REPUBLIC WITH BEING A MUSLIM.

THERE WERE PROBLEMS. AS REPORTED YESTERDAY, AT SOME POLLING STATIONS VOTERS WERE UNDER CONSIDERABLE PRESSURE TO VOTE FOR THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. WE ARE INCLINED TO ATTRIBUTE THIS TO OVER-ZEALOUSNESS ON THE PART OF LOCAL ELECTION OFFICIALS RATHER THAN TO SOME CENTRALLY-DIRECTED EFFORT TO ENSURE AN OVERWHELMING VOTE FOR THE REPUBLIC. IN ADDITION, THERE WAS A LIMITED AMOUNT OF HANKY-PANKY. THE SO-CALLED 24-HOUR INDELIBLE INK WHITH WHICH VOTERS' INDEX FINGERS WERE MARKED TURNED OUT TO BE NOTHING MORE THAN ORDINARY PRINTER'S INK WHICH COULD BE EASILY REMOVED.

ONE YOUNG MAN INTERVIEWED BY AN EMBASSY OFFICER CLAIMED TO HAVE VOTED TWICE, TAKING ADVANTAGE OF THE FACT THAT THE INK COULD BE WASHED OFF AND THE FACT THAT POLLING OFFICIALS NEGLECTED TO STAMP HIS I.D. CARD THE FIRST TIME THROUGH.

OUTSIDE TEHRAN, THERE WERE FREQUENT BREAKDOWNS OF THE LOGISTICS SYSTEM. NUMBEROUS POLLING STATIONS RAN OUT OF BALLOTS. EARLY MARCH 31 IRANIAN AIR FORCE PLANES WERE REPORTEDLY RUSHING ADDITIONAL SUPPLIES TO POLLING STATIONS AS SCATTERED AS CHAH BAHAR AND ARDEBIL. IN ADDITION, VOTERS IN GONBAD KAVOUS WERE NOT ABLE TO VOTE AT ALL BECAUSE OF CONTINUING FIGHTING BETWEEN THE LOCAL TURKOMAN POPULATION AND GOVERNMENT FORCES. IN KURDESTAN, NUMEROUS INCIDENTS OF ATTEMPTS TO DISRUPT THE VOTING WERE REPORTED. IN SAQQEZ, A SCHOOL SERVING AS A POLLING STATION WAS SEIZED BY AN UNIDENTIFIED GROUP AND THE BALLOT BOX BURNED.
ELSEWHERE IN THE PROVINCE VOTERS WERE TOLD THAT IF THEY CAST THE GREEN BALLOT ("YES"), THEY WOULD BE VOTING TO GIVE AWAY THEIR LAND.

THERE IS LITTLE NEWS FROM GONBAD KAVOUS OTHER THAN THAT THE FIGHTING APPARENTLY IS STILL GOING ON. AS OF 0800 LOCAL TIME MARCH 31, ALL COMMUNICATIONS WITH THE TOWN REPORTEDLY HAD BEEN CUT. ETHNIC UNREST IN BALUCHISTAN MAY BE MORE SERIOUS THAN EARLIER SUSPECTED. IN ADDITION TO DEFENSE MINISTER MADANI'S MISSION TO ZAHEDAN REPORTED EARLIER, ANOTHER DELEGATION FROM KHOMEINI HAS BEEN DISPATCHED TO THE PROVINCE. MOREOVER, A TEAM HAS BEEN SENT TO ARDEBIL TO INVESTIGATE DISTRUBANCES BETWEEN THE SHIA AND SUNNI COMMUNITIES IN THE ARDEBILZANJAN AREA. FINALLY, THE MINISTERY OF INTERIOR HAS SENT A NEW TEAM TO GONBAD KAVOUS IN THE LATEST ATTEMPT TO NEGOTIATE A CEASEFIRE.

ADM. MADANI HAS BEEN REPLACED AS MINISTER OF DEFENSE BY BRIG. GEN. (RET.) TAGHI RIAHI. RIAHI, WHO IS 70, HAS CLOSE CONNECTIONS WITH THE NATIONAL FRONT BUT HAS NOT BEEN INVOLVED IN MILITARY MATTERS SINCE 1953. HIS APPOINTMENT REPRESENTS YET ANOTHER INCREMENT TO NATIONAL FRONT STRENGTH IN THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT, A TREND REPORTED EARLIER. THE OFFICIAL ANNOUNCEMENT ON MADANI INDICATED THAT HE HAD REQUESTED TO BE RELEASED FROM HIS RESPONSIBILITIES AS MINISSTER OF DEFENSE. IT IS NOT CLEAR WHETHER HE REMAINS IN CHARGE OF THE NAVY OR GAVE UP THAT POSITION AS WELL. ONE NAVY SOURCE SAYS HE DID NOT.

AMIDST NEWS THAT THE SHAH HAS MOVED FROM MOROCCO TO THE BAHAMAS, A FOREIGN MINISTRY SPOKESMAN SAID MARCH 30 THAT IRAN WOULD CONTINUE TO PRESS FOR THE SHAH'S EXTRADITION TO IRAN TO STAND TRIAL FOR HIS CRIMES AGAINST THE IRANIAN PEOPLE. THE GOVERNMENT-CONTROLLED VOICE OF THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTION OF IRAN ON MARCH 30 NOTED THE DEPARTMENT SPOKESMAN'S STATEMENT THAT THE U.S. NO LONGER CONSIDERS THE SHAH THE IRANIAN HEAD OF STATE.
(C) ENTIRE TEXT

SUMMARY: VOTING IN IRAN'S REFERENDUM ENDS ADMIST CONTINUING ADMINISTRATIVE CONFUSION. OVERWHELMING ENDORSEMENT OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC EXPECTED. FIGHTING CONTINUES IN TURKOMAN SAHRAH AREA OF GORGAN PROVINCE. TENSIONS HIGH IN TABRIZ AND SUNNI COMMUNITY ALONG PERSIAN GULF COAST GROWS RESTLESS. RIAHI SAYS IT WAS A MISTAKE TO RETIRE SO MANY SENIOR OFFICERS SO FAST. QADDAFI POSTPONED TRIP BECAUSE OF REFERENDUM ACCORDING TO AYENDAGAN. IRANIAN BUREAUCRACY IS ALIVE AND WELL. END SUMMARY.

VOTING IN IRAN'S REFERENDUM CAME TO AN END YESTERDAY, MARCH 31, BUT NOT BEFORE AN ELEVENTH HOUR EXTENSION OF THE POLLS' CLOSING TIME TO 10:00 PM TO ALLOW THOSE WHO HAD NOT YET VOTED TO DO SO. THIS, ALONG WITH INSTRUCTION ISSUED LATE YESTERDAY BY THE MINISTRY OF INTERIOR REGARDING LOCAL REPRODUCTION OF BALLOTS IN LOCATIONS WHERE THE SUPPLY OF REGULAR BALLOTS HAD BEEN EXHAUSTED, WAS THE LAST OF A SERIES OF AD HOC MEASURES TAKEN PRIOR TO AND DURING THE COURSE OF THE REFERENDUM WHICH QUITE LIKELY WILL MAKE THE CONDUCT OF THE REFERENDUM SUBJECT TO SUBSEQUENT CRITICISM.

TURNOUT WAS AGAIN HEAVY YESTERDAY, AT LEAST IN TEHRAN BUT REPORTEDLY IN OTHER URBAN AREAS AS WELL, WITH EARLY INTIMATIONS FROM THE GOVERNMENT THAT AS MANY AS 18 MILLION WENT TO THE POLLS OVER THE TWO-DAY PERIOD. IT APPEARS THAT THE VOTE WILL PROVE TO HAVE BEEN OVERWHELMINGLY IN FAVOR OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. ONE TEHRAN POLLING STATION LATE LAST NIGHT REPORTED THAT OF THE NEARLY 2,000 VOTES CAST THERE ONLY SIX WERE NEGATIVE.

UNREST CONTINUES IN THE TURKOMAN SAHRAH AREA OF GORGAN PROVINCE, WITH AFP REPORTING THAT TURKOMAN FORCES HAVE GAINED CONTROL OF THE ENTIRE REGION FROM GONBAD KAVOUS UP TO THE SOVIET BORDER. ACCORDING TO AFP, ONLY TWO BORDER POSTS REMAIN IN GOVERNMENT HANDS. GOVERNMENT EFFORTS TO FERRY IN MILITARY REINFORCEMENTS, APPARENTLY ELEMENTS OF THE (ONCE) CRACK 55TH AIRBORNE BRIGADE, WERE FRUSTRATED WHEN THE TRANSPORT PLANE CARRYING THEM WAS UNABLE TO LAND AT THE GONBAD KAVOUS AIR FIELD.

THE FARSI LANGUAGE PRESS IS ATTRIBUTING THE CANCELLATION LATE LAST WEEK OF AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI'S TRIP TO GONBAD KAVOUS TO MEDIATE THE DISPUTE TO THE LACK OF ANY LOCAL TURKOMAN LEADERS WITH WHOM HE COULD NEGOTIATE. IT DOES APPEAR THAT THERE IS NO ONE IN GONBAD KAVOUS WHO MIGHT PLAY AN IMPORTANT INTERMEDIARY ROLE AS DID MODERATE KURDISH LEADER AHMAD MOFTIZADEH IN SANANDAJ, BUT THE GOVERNMENT ITSELF ATTRIBUTED THE CANCELLATION TO THE HELICOPTER TALEGHANI WAS IN HAVING BEEN FIRED UPON AS IT APPROACHED THE TOWN.
THE GOVERNMENT-CONTROLLED VOICE OF THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTION OF IRAN CONTINUES TO MAINTAIN SILENCE ON EVENTS IN TURKOMAN SAHRAH, CLAIMING THAT COMMUNICATIONS WITH THE REGION HAVE BEEN CUT OFF.

CRYPTIC RADIO BROADCASTS FROM TABRIZ REGARDING DEMONSTRATIONS PLANNED FOR THE CITY OVER THE PAST WEEKEND SUGGEST TRANQUILITY THERE MAY BE MORE APPARENT THAN REAL. ONE TABRIZI WITH WHOM POLOFF METRINKO SPOKE ON MARCH 31 SAID THAT TENSIONS IN THE CITY REMAIN HIGH. WE HAVE ALSO RECEIVED A REPORT THAT THERE IS GROWING UNREST IN SOUTHEASTERN FARS PROVINCE AROUND THE CITY OF LAR AND THE REGION EASTWARD TO BANDAR ABBAS. THE LOCAL POPULATION IS OVERWHELMINGLY SUNNI, WITH MANY RESIDENTS TRACING THEIR FOREFATHERS' SETTLEMENT IN THIS INHOSPITABLE REGION BACK TO THE TIME OF SHAH ABBAS AND SHIA PERSECUTION OF THE SUNNI COMMUNITY.

NEWLY APPOINTED MINISTER OF DEFENSE RIAHI IS BEING QUOTED IN THE FARSI LANGUAGE PRESS AS SAYING THAT IT WAS A MISTAKE TO RETIRE SO MANY SENIOR OFFICERS FROM THE MILITARY SO FAST. HE IS PROBABLY RIGHT, BUT THE DAMAGE HAS BEEN DONE. REINSTATEMENT OF SENIOR OFFICERS, EVEN THOSE WITH INDISPUTABLY CLEAN HANDS, SEEMS OUT OF THE QUESTION AT THIS POINT. IT IS INTERESTING, HOWEVER, THAT HE (AN OLD MOSSADEGH MAN) WOULD MAKE SUCH A PUBLIC STATEMENT.
THE FARSI PRESS ALSO REPORTS THAT A TOTAL OF 22 MAJLES MEMBERS AND SEVEN SENATORS HAVE BEEN ARRESTED SINCE MIDFEBRUARY. SOME OF THEM ARE OLD EMBASSY CONTACTS.

ACCORDING TO AYENDAGAN, THE MOST LEFTIST OF IRAN'S THREE LEADING FARSI LANGUAGE DAILIES, COL. QADDAFI POSTPONED A SCHEDULED TRIP TO IRAN BECAUSE IT OTHERWISE WOULD HAVE INTERFERED WITH THE REFERENDUM. WE UNDERSTAND THAT QADDAFI WILL NOT BE WELCOME HERE UNTIL THE LEBANESE SHIA LEADER, IMAM SADAR, IS PRODUCED.

FINALLY, REMEMBER THE BAD OLD DAYS WHEN AN IRANIAN CITIZEN HAD TO TURN IN HIS PASSPORT TO IMMIGRATION 48 HOURS BEFORE HIS SCHEDULED DEPARTURE FROM THE COUNTRY? AS EVERYONE KNOWS, THAT EXERCISE WAS STRICTLY FOR THE PURPOSE OF ALLOWING SAVAK TO CHECK ITS RECORDS AGAINST THE INDIVIDUAL'S NAME. THE NEW GOVERNMENT HAS RECENTLY ANNOUNCED THAT PASSPORTS MUST NOW BE SUBMITTED FIVE DAYS IN ADVANCE SO THAT TRAVELERS' NAMES MAY BE CHECKED AGAINST A NEW LIST--THE ONE OF INDIVIDUALS WHO ARE PROHIBITED FROM LEAVING THE COUNTRY.
THAT IS IN ADDITION TO THE MINIMUM OF TWO WEEKS THE PASSPORT OFFICE IS SAYING IT WILL TAKE TO PROCESS APPLICATIONS FOR EXIT VISAS, SOMETHING THAT USED TO TAKE TWO OR THREE DAYS AT MOST.

EMBASSY HAS HAD NEARLY AS MUCH DIFFICULTY REACHING KWPA AS U.S. FIRM, KMW. MOREOVER, KWPA'S WORK REGIME IS OBVIOUSLY VERY ELASTIC, EMPLOYEE DISCIPLINE IS APPARENTLY SADLY LACKING, AND THE EMBASSY DESPAIRS OF BEING ABLE TO PREDICT EXACTLY WHEN KWPA OFFICE STAFF WILL BE WORKING. SIMILAR SITUATIONS EXIST IN MOST GOI MINISTRIES,OTHER GOI CORPORATIONS, AS WELL AS IN THE PRIVATE SECTOR. THE RETURN TO NORMALCY IN IRAN HAS THUS FAR BEEN DISAPPOINTING.

HOWEVER, WE HAVE DETERMINED THAT MR. FARZANEH IS THE KWPA DEPUTY MANAGING DIRECTOR FOR ADMINISTRATION AND FINANCE AND THAT MR. FARZANEH SPEAKS ENGLISH. HIS OFFICE NUMBER IS TEHRAN 656785, EXTENSION 415 OR AHWAZ 30090 THROUGH 30094. (THE TEHRAN NUMBER IS A SPECIAL LINE WHICH IS ANSWERED IN AHWAZ). HIS HOME NUMBER IS TEHRAN 656785, EXTENSION 359 OR AHWAZ 34009.
(C)ENTIRE TEXT

SUMMARY: STRIFE CONTINUES ON GONBAD KAVOUS AREA. DEPUTY PM SAYS KHUZESTAN MAY BE NEXT. BALUCHISTAN REPORTEDLY CALM BUT IS BEING WATCHED CLOSELY. VOTER TURNOUT PROBABLY SOMETHING LESS THAN THE 98 PERCENT CLAIMED BY THE GOVERNMENT. GOVERNMENT EFFORTS TO ASSUME AUTHORITY IN THE LAW ENFORCEMENT AREA CONTINUE TO BE STYMIED. CONSTITUTION TO BE PUBLICIZED SOON. ENTEZAM DESCRIBES RELATIONSHIP OF GUARDIANS OF THE REVOLUTION TO THE ARMED FORCES PRESENT COMMAND STRUCTURE. TEHRAN UNIVERSITY TO PURGE BAD ELEMENTS. IRAN MAY BREAK TIES WITH EGYPT. CAPUCHI COMES TO IRAN. END SUMMARY.

DESPITE THE ANNOUNCEMENT LATE YESTERDAY, APRIL 1, THAT A CEASEFIRE AGREEMENT HAD BEEN SIGNED GONBAD KAVOUS, IT APPEARS THAT AT LEAST SOME OF THE TURKOMAN REBELS ARE NOT HEEDING THE CEASEFIRE. BOTH LATE LAST NIGHT AND TODAY THE GOVERNMENT-CONTROLLED RADIO AND TELEVISION HAVE REPEATEDLY QUOTED MINISTRY OF INTERIOR THAT "IF THE SHOOTING, TROUBLE-MAKING AND OTHER OFFENSES HAVE NOT STOPPED BY 1500 ON 2 APRIL,... THE NECESSARY DECISIVE ACTIONS WILL BE TAKEN." GOVERNMENT SPOKESMAN AMIR ENTEZAM CLAIMED AT HIS PRESS CONFERENCE YESTERDAY THAT THE TOWN OF GONBAD KAVOUS IS UNDER GOVERNMENT CONTROL BUT THAT A SMALL NUMBER OF SNIPERS CONTINUES TO FIRE WHENEVER PEOPLE ENTER THE STREETS.

HE AGAIN ASSURED THE TURKOMAN POPULATION, AND ALL OTHER ETHNIC MINORITIES, THAT THEIR LEGITIMATE ASPIRATIONS WOULD BE RECOGNIZED IN IRAN'S NEW CONSTITUTION. HE CHARGED THAT A SMALL MINORITY OF ANTI-REVOLUTIONARIES, IN THE MISTAKEN BELIEF THAT THE GOVERNMENT AND THE ARMED FORCES WERE IN A WEAKENED STATE, HAD ATTEMPTED TO TAKE ADVANTAGE OF TURKOMAN DESIRES FOR A GREATER SAY IN RUNNING THEIR OWN AFFAIRS.

ENTEZAM ALSO INTIMATED THAT THE GOVERNMENT EXPECTS KHUZESTAN TO BE THE NEXT AREA WHERE ANTI-REVOLUTIONARY FORCES WILL ATTEMPT TO TAKE ADVANTAGE OF ETHNIC GRIEVANCES TO CAUSE TROUBLE. HE CLAIMED, HOWEVER, THAT THE NECESSARY PRECAUTIONS HAD BEEN TAKEN TO PREVENT BLOODSHED. HE SAID THAT HE EXPECTED UNREST TO CONTINUE IN THE PROVINCES FOR THE NEXT SEVERAL MONTHS.

IT APPEARS AN ATTEMPT TO ASSASSINATE A RELIGIOUS LEADER IN ZAHEDAN, THE CAPITAL OF SISTAN AND BALUCHISTAN PROVINCE, ON MARCH 28 RATHER ETHNIC DISTURBANCES AS SUCH MAY HAVE PROMPTED KHOMEINI TO DISPATCH A REPRESENTATIVE TO ZAHEDAN LATE LAST WEEK. NONETHELESS, THE SITUATION IN THE PROVINCE IS BEING WATCHED CLOSELY AND THERE ARE REPORTS OF BALUCHI RESTIVENESS DESPITE THE UNEASY CALM IN ZAHEDAN ITSELF.

DESPITE CLAIMS BY THE MINISTER OF INTERIOR THAT 98 PERCENT OF THE ELECTORATE VOTED IN IRAN'S REFERENDUM MARCH 30 AND 31, IT WOULD APPEAR THAT SIGNIFICANT NUMBERS OF PEOPLE DID NOT GO TO THE POLLS FOR ONE REASON OR ANOTHER. ATTEMPTS TO DISRUPT THE BALLOTING IN KURDESTAN WERE REPORTED EARLIER, AND THE FIGHTING IN THE TURKOMAN SAHRAH AREA OF GORGAN PROVINCE UNDOUBTEDLY RESTRICTED THE TURNOUT THERE.

IN ADDITION, THERE ARE REPORTS OF THE REFERENDUM HAVING BEEN BOYCOTTED IN PARTS OF BALUCHISTAN, WITH ONLY 60 PERCENT OF THE ELECTORATE TURNING OUT PROVINCE-WIDE. ------------------032486 021540Z /50 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 659 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY BONN AMEMBASSY CAIRO AMCONSUL DHAHRAN IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY DOHA AMCONSUL FRANKFURT AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS AMEMBASSY BEIJING AMEMBASSY RABAT USLO RIYADH IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY TOKYO USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE USCINCPAC HONOLULU HI USDOCOSOUTH SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 3481

THE GOVERNMENT HAS ANNOUNCED THAT REPRESENTATIVES OF OFFICE OF THE CHIEF PROSECUTOR HAVE BEEN ASSIGNED TO THE 14 REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE OFFICES NOMINALLY RESPONSIBLE FOR MUNICIPAL MATTERS IN TEHRAN AS WELL AS TO THE CENTRAL OFFICE OF THE PARAMILITARY GUARDIANS OF THE REVOLUTION AND PROVINCIAL REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES. THIS FOLLOWS AN EARLIER ANNOUNCEMENT THAT NO ARRESTS, SEARCHES, OR SEIZURES WILL BE MADE BY COMMITTEE MEMBERS WITHOUT A WRITTEN WARRANT. ACCORDING TO THE LATEST ANNOUNCEMENT, SUCH ACTIVITIES CONDUCTED BY COMMITTEE MEMBERS OR GUARDIANS MUST BE WITH THE APPROVAL AND PRESENCE OF THE CHIEF PROSECUTOR'S REPRESENTATIVES.

IT ADDS, HOWEVER, THAT "ANY MEMBER OF SOCIETY WHO COMES ACROSS A CONFIRMED CRIMINAL OR WHO WITNESSES A CRIME HAS THE RIGHT TO ARREST THE GUILTY PERSON, BUT HE MUST DELIVER THEM AS SOON AS POSSIBLE TO THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS, AND KEEP IN MIND THE ARREST OF THE INDIVIDUALS IN THEIR HOMES AND THE SEARCH OF HOUSES SHOULD TAKE PLACE ONLY WITH THE REVOLUTIONARY PROSECUTOR GENERAL..." WE UNDERSTAND THAT ARRESTS, SEARCHES, AND SEIZURES BY ALL MANNER OF SELFAPPOINTED LAW ENFORCEMENT PERSONNEL IN FACT CONTINUE UNCHECKED.

IT WOULD APPEAR, THEN, THAT THE GOVERNMENT'S EFFORTS TO ASSERT ITS AUTHORITY IN THE FIELD OF LAW ENFORCEMENT REMAIN SO FAR LARGELY INEFFECTUAL, SOMETHING THE CAVEAT IN THE MOST RECENT GOVERNMENT ANNOUNCEMENT QUOTED ABOVE TENDS TO CONFIRM.

COMMENTING ON IRAN'S NEW CONSTITUTION, SPOKESMAN ENTEZAM SAID THAT HE UNDERSTOOD THAT THE DRAFT WOULD BE MADE PUBLIC VERY SOON AND THAT THE IRANIAN PEOPLE WOULD HAVE ABOUT A MONTH TO STUDY IT. IT WAS NOT CLEAR WHAT HE MEANT BY THIS, I.E., WHETHER IT WOULD THEN GO TO A CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY FOR FURTHER CONSIDERATION AND POSSIBLE AMENDMENT AS THE GOVERNMENT HAS PREVIOUSLY INTIMATED OR BE PUT TO A VOTE IN A POPULAR REFERENDUM AS HAS MORE RECENTLY BEEN SUGGESTED.

ALTHOUGH THE CONTEXT OF ENTEZAM'S REMARKS INDICATED THAT HE HIMSELF HAD NOT YET SEEN THE TEXT OF THE NEW CONSTITUTION, HE CLAIMED THAT IT WOULD PROVIDE FOR COMPLETE FREEDOM OF SPEECH AND POLITICAL ACTIVITY.

ON THE SUBJECT OF THE MILITARY SERVICES, ENTEZAM SAID THAT THE PARAMILITARY GUARDIANS OF THE REVOLUTION WOULD ACT AS AN AUXILIARY TO THE REGULAR ARMED FORCES. THE EXISTENCE OF THIS FORCE WOULD PREVENT A MILITARY COUP D'ETAT OF THE SORT THAT OVERTHREW MOSSADEQ IN 1953, ENTEZAM SUGGESTED. HE SAID THAT MEMBERSHIP IN THE GUARDIANS WOULD BE OPEN TO BOTH MEN AND WOMEN.

ENTEZAM ALSO SAID THAT THE MILITARY COMMAND STRUCTURE IS AND WOULD CONTINUE TO BE IN THE HANDS OF COUNCILS OF THREE TO FIVE PEOPLE WHO WOULD "MAKE DECISIONS, GIVE ORDERS, AND EXECUTE THEM" THIS STATEMENT CONFIRMS WHAT WE HAVE BEEN ABLE TO DETERMINE BY LIMITED OBSERVATION OF EVEN REGULAR MILITARY UNITS IN THE TEHRAN AREA, I.E., THAT OFFICERS INDIVIDUALLY HAVE ALMOST NO AUTHORITY OVER THE GROUPS THEY OSTENSIBLY COMMAND.

THE TEHRAN UNIVERSITY COUNCIL, WHOSE SELF-APPOINTED LEFTIST MEMBERS ARE FACULTY, STUDENTS, AND NONTEACHING EMPLOYEES, HAS ANNOUNCED THAT EVERYONE AT THE UNIVERSITY WITH ALMOST ANY KIND OF CONNECTION IMAGINABLE TO THE FORMER REGIME WILL BE PURGED. CRITERIA FOR BEING CAST INTO THE NETHER REGIONS RANGE FROM SAVAK CONNECTIONS TO MEMBERSHIP IN ANY OF THE SHAH'S POLITICAL PARTIES. IF STRICTLY APPLIED, THEY WOULD LEAVE FEW UNTOUCHED, SOMETHING THE COUNCIL SEEMS TO HAVE RECOGNIZED.

THE ANNOUNCEMENT SAID THAT THE COUNCIL HAD DECIDED "TO ALLOW THOSE WHO HAVE MANIFESTED ANTIREVOLUTIONARY OR ANTI-PEOPLE BEHAVIOR CONTRARY TO UNIVERSITY ETHICS TO CONTINUE THEIR WORK, PROVIDED THEY ARE REFOREMED AND CORRECT THEIR ATTETUDE." THEY WOULD NOT, HOWEVER, BE ALLOWED TO HOLD EXECUTIVE POSITIONS. IN WHAT, THE ANNOUNCEMENT DID NOT SAY.

ACCORDING TOKAYHAN, IRAN IS CONSIDERING BREAKING DIPLOMATIC TIES WITH EGYPT. "AN INFORMED POLITICAL SOURCE" CLAIMED THAT DISCUSSIONS CONCERNING THIS ISSUE WERE HELD BETWEEN PM BAZARGAN AND FM SANJABI FOLLOWING KHOMEINI'S CONDEMNATION OF THE ISRAEL-EGYPT PEACE TREATY AND THE DECISIONS TAKEN BY ARAB COUNTRIES MEETING IN BAGHDAD LAST WEEK.

ARCHBISHOP VALARIAN CAPUCHI, REPORTEDLY A MEMBER OF AL-FATAH WHO WAS ONCE JAILED BY THE ISRAELIS, IS IN TEHRAN WHERE HE IS BEING ESCORTED TO NUMBEROUS MEETINGS BY THE LOCAL PLO REPRESENTATIVE, HANI AL-HASSAN. CAPUCHI IS SCHEDULED TO VISIT QOM TOMORROW TO CALL ON KHOMEINI.

1979TEHRAN03507.subject: TAKEOVER OF BANK SEPHA'S NEW YORK OFFICE

segments.text: EMBOFF SPOKE APR 3, WITH BANK SEPAH OFFICIALS SAFE (OR SAIF), WHO UNTIL MAR 31 WAS CHIEF MANAGER OF THE INTERNATIONAL DIV (HE IS OFF TO LONDON AS MANAGER AND HIS SUCCESSOR, MOSHAR, WAS UNAVAILABLE), NAJAFI, DEPUTY MANAGER INTERNATIONAL AND MEHDI ABIBI-AMIN, MANAGER DESIGNATE OF SEPAH'S NEW YORK OFFICE CONCERNING THE REPORTED TAKEOVER OF SEPAH'S NEW YORK OFFICE.

ALL OFFICIALS CONTACTED SAID THAT THE PROBLEM REPORTED IN REFTEL HAS BEEN RESOLVED. DR. SETED MOHAMMAD RAJI IS STILL BANK SEPAH'S LEGAL MANAGER AT THE NEW YORK (OFFICE AND WILL REMAIN SO UNTIL HABIBIAMIN, WHO LEAVES FOR NEW YORK APR 7, HAS OBTAINED PROPER INS STATUS AND SUBSTITUTED HIS POWER OF ATTORNEY, WHICH HAS BEEN NOTIFIED TO THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS. DR. RAJI TELEPHONE BANK SEPAH EARLY APR 3 AND DISCUSSED HIS PROBLEM WITH THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE AND SEPAH SENT A TELEX CONFIRMING THE TELEPHONIC ASSURANCES TO RAJI THAT HE REMAINS THE LEGAL MANAGER. HE IS, HOWEVER, ASKED TO COOPERATE WITH REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE REPRESENTATIVE HASHEMI.

COMMENT: THE BACKGROUND TO THIS "TAKEOVER", AS TOLD BY THE AFORENAMED OFFICIALS, VARIES LITTLE FROM THE INTER-PLAY BETWEEN THE NORMS OF INSTITUTIONAL LEGALITIES AND REVOLUTIONARY PURIFICATION WITNESSED REPEATEDLY IN IRANIAN INSTITUTIONS. IT IS ALLEGED THAT DR. RAJ INVITED THE "COMMITTEE" PEOPLE UP FROM WASHINGTON (REASONS UNSTATED), THEY CAME AND THEY CONFLICTED. THE COMMITTEE PEOPLE THEN TRIED TO DISPOSE HIM AND ONLY LATER DID THE REALITIES OF "POWERS OF ATTORNEY" ETC. COMPLICATE A CHANGE IN MANAGEMENT. HABIBI-AMIN SAYS HE WILL KEEP DR. RAJI ON AS AN ADVISOR WHEN HE BECOMES MANAGER.
(C) ENTIRE TEXT

SUMMARY: CEASEFIRE CLAIMED IN TURKOMAN FIGHTING, THROUGH SOME SHOOTING CONTINUES; PRISON VISIT, HOUSE SEARCHES AND KHOMEINI AND HUMAN LEGAL RIGHTS OF PRISONERS; POSSIBLE EGYPT-IRAN BREAK; COMMENTS ON MINISTER OF DEFENSE RIAHI; AMB SULLIVAN STORIES CONTINUE; SHARIAT-MADARI ADDRESSES NATION; DER SPIEGEL RUMOR.

RADIO IRAN CLAIMED LATE YESTERDAY THAT A CEASEFIRE HAD GONE INTO EFFECT IN GONBAD KAVOUS, AND THAT AN AGREEMENT BETWEEN GOVERNMENT AND TURKOMAN FORCES HAD BEEN REACHED. THE AGREEMENT STATED THAT: 1) ALL WOUNDED WILL BE TAKEN TO HOSPITALS; 2) FORCES OF ALL SIDES WILL COMPLETELY WITHDRAW FROM BARRICADES AND DEFENSIVE POSITIONS AND THE CITY WILL BE CLEANED UP; 3) TALKS WILL START FOR THE IMMEDIATE RELEASE OF THE CAPTURED; AND 4) THE NATIONAL ARMY WILL GUARD LAW AND ORDER IN THE CITY UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE.

PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN HAD THREATENED TO ORDER THE ARMED FORCES TO TAKE "POSITIVE ACTION" IF FIRING IN THE CITY WAS NOT STOPPED BY 3:00 PM ON 2 APRIL. DAO HAS RECEIVED A REPORT THAT A HUNDRED TANKS DEPARTED TEHRAN RECENTLY AND WERE PROCEEDING "EAST," A POSSIBLE TIE IN TO EITHER THE ANNOUNCED AGREEMENT OR TO BAZARGAN'S THREAT. TOP BALUCHESTAN SUNNI RELIGIOUS LEADER MOWLAVI ABDUL AZIZ HAD ALSO SENT A MESSAGE TO THE (PREDOMINATELY SUNNI) PEOPLE OF GONBAD KAVOUS ASKING FOR PEACE. THE MESSAGE INDICATED HE WOULD BE GOING THERE HIMSELF IN THE NEAR FUTURE.

THE FEDAYEEN KHALQ HAS STRONGLY DENIED THAT ANY OF ITS MEMBERS ARE INVOLVED IN THE GONBAD KAVOUS FIGHTING, ALTHOUGH SOME MEMBERS HAVE BEEN ARRESTED BY COMMITTEE FORCES THERE. BBC'S PERSIAN BROADCAST LAST NIGHT CLAIMED THAT 200 PEOPLE IN GONBAD KAVOUS HAD BEEN KILLED THUS FAR: THE PRO-KHOMEINI FORCES LOSING 50 AND THE TURKOMAN FIGHTERS LOSING 150. AYANDEGAN NEWSPAPER ATTRIBUTES TO THE FEDAYEEN THE ACCUSATION THAT THE TURKOMAN AND OTHER TROUBLE IS PART OF A CIA PLOT TO START CIVIL WAR IN IRAN. AS OF MIDDAY TODAY SOME SHOOTING CONTINUED IN GONBAD KAVOUS ACCORDING TO WIRE SERVICE CORRESPONDENTS.
AP WAS HAPPY TO HAVE EXTRICATED SOME CORRESPONDENTS/PHOTOGRAPHERS WHO HAD BEEN HELD UNDER HOUSE DETENTION FOR A FEW DAYS. THE INCLUDED LIZ HURGOOD OF THE GUARDIAN.

THE DELEGATION OF FRENCH JURISTS HERE WILL BE VISITING QASR PRISON TODAY. THE DELEGATION WILL MAKE A REPORT TO THE GOVERNMENT AND PERHAPS THE PRESS HERE, AND ALSO HOLD A NEWS CONFERENCE NEXT WEEK IN PARIS ON THEIR FINDINGS. THE PRESS ALSO REPORTS THE ARREST OF EX-MIN OF CULTURE FOROUGHI ALONG WITH HIS SON (WE HAVE LEARNED FOROUGHI WAS PICKED UP AT LEAST ONCE BEFORE AND RELEASED). KHOMEINI MADE A TELEVISED SPEECH ON APRIL 1 (SEPTEL) AND IN IT ATTACHED HUMAN RIGHTS ACTIVISTS FOR BEING CONCERNED OVER THE FATE OF IRANIAN PRISONERS.

THE AYATOLLAH SAID HE OBJECTED TO PRISONERS' BEING TRIED AT ALL, AND THAT THEY SHOULD HAVE BEEN KILLED OUTRIGHT. HE ALSO ATTACKED HUMAN RIGHTS ORGANIZATIONS FOR ALLEGEDLY HAVING BEEN "SILENT" ON HUMAN RIGHTS DURING THE PAHLAVI ERA AND FOR NOT HAVING OBJECTED TO CARTER'S SUPPORT OF THE SHAH. (COMMENT: KHOMEINI WAS EITHER OUT OF TOUCH OR HAS A CONVENIENTLY SHORT MEMORY.)
PRESS REPORTS THAT DISCUSSION IS BEING HELD IN THE GOVERNMENT RE A POSSIBLE CUTOFF IN RELATIONS BETWEEN IRAN AND EGYPT.

THE NEW MINISTER OF DEFENSE GENERAL TAQI RIAHI IS ALREADY COMING IN FOR SOME UNFAVORABLE PUBLICITY. BESIDES THE STATEMENT BADE BY RIAHI THAT THE DECISION TO RETIRE ALL PAHLAVI TOP OFFICERS WAS A MISTAKE, HIS FAMILY CONNECTIONS ARE ALSO SUBJECT TO COMMENT. PUBLICIZED RUMORS CLAIM RIAHI IS RELATED TO THE ATABAI FAMILY, WHICH HAD CLOSE SOCIAL AND FINANCIAL TIES TO THE SHAH. OTHER RUMORS LINK RIAHI TO ARDESHIR ZAHEDI.

KAYHAN HAS PUBLISHED AN ARITICLE ON AMB SULLIVAN IMPLYING INVOLVEMENT WITH THE JALEH SQUARE MASSACRE AND OTHER EVENTS IN THE REVOLUTION. KAYHAN CLAIMS THE AMBASSADOR SAW THE SHAH JUST BEFORE THE JALEH INCIDENT AND AGAIN HAD A MEETING AFTER THE "BURNING OF TEHRAN" (NOVEMBER 5) PRIOR TO AZHARI'S APPOINTMENT AS PRI MIN.

AYATOLLAH SHARIAT-MADARI GAVE A 20-MINUTE SPEECH TO THE NATION ON 1 APRIL LISTING PRIORITIES FOR THE NEW ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. SHARIAT-MADARI SAID THE FIRST SHOULD BE TO STRENGTHEN THE NATIONAL ARMY, AS WELL AS THE POLICE AND GENDARMERIE. HE ALSO SAID ONCE AGAIN THAT PEOPLE SHOULD SUPPORT THE GOVERNMENT AND COOPERATE IN REBUILDING THE ECONOMY, ESPECIALLY THE AGRICULTURAL SECTOR.

RUMORS HAVE BEEN CIRCULATING IN THE CITY FOR SOME DAYS ABOUT A RECENT ISSUE OF DER SPIEGEL. STORIES CLAIM THAT THE COVER SHOWS DEP. MIN YAZDI SHAKING HANDS WITH PRINCE GHOLAMREZA, AND THAT A DER SPIEGEL ARTICLE LINKS YAZDI, NIRT HEAD GHOTBZADEH, AND KHOMEINI AID ABOLHASSAN BANI-SADR TO THE CIA. EMBOFF HAS HEARD ANOTHER VERSION CLAIMING THE COVER PHOTO SHOWS BAZARGAN KISSING THE SHAH'S HAND. THE MATTER SURFACED AT AN APRIL 1 PRESS CONFERENCE WITH BAZARGAN, AND MORE RUMORS EVEN SAY KHOMEINI HAS ORDERED AN INVESTIGATION. THUS FAR THE MUCH SPOKEN-OF MAGAZINE ISSUE HAS NOT SURFACED IN TEHRAN. WE UNDERSTAND THE FEDREP EMBASSY DENIES KNOWLEDGE OF ANY SUCH ISSUE.

1979TEHRAN03543.subject: IRAN'S REFERENDUM AND PROSPECTS FOR THE FUTURE

segments.text: (C) ENTIRE TEXT

SUMMARY: TURNOUT FOR IRAN'S REFERENDUM WAS LARGE AND THE VOTE WAS OVERWHELMINGLY IN FAVOR OF THE NATION'S FORM OF GOVERNMENT BECOMING AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. HOWEVER, THE WAY IN WHICH THE REFERENDUM WAS ORGANIZED AND CONDUCTED HAS LEFT SOME ELEMENTS OF IRANIAN SOCIETY DISGRUNTLED. WHETHER THIS DISGRUNTLEMENT CAN BE CONTAINED OR NOT WILL DEPEND ON WHETHER A SENSE OF POPULAR PARTICIPATION IN THE FORMULATION OF IRAN'S NEW CONSTITUTION IS ACHIEVED, AND WHETHER RAPID PROGRESS IS MADE TOWARDS ITS PROMULGATION.

THE PROSPECES IN THIS REGARD ARE NOT PARTICULARLY GOOD SINCE THE GOVERNMENT HERETOFORE HAS BEEN IN THE POSITION OF REACTING TO KHOMEINI'S PRONOUNCEMENTS ON THE SHAPE OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC RAHTER THAN TAKING THE LEAD IN DEFINING ITS PARAMETERS. THE GOVERNMENT MUST CAPUTE THE INITIATIVE ON THIS ISSUE IF IT IS TO PREVENT PRESENT GRUMBLING FROM BEING TRANSFORMED INTO ACTIVE, PERHAPS VIOLENT OPPOSITION. END SUMMARY.

IRAN'S REFERENDUM HAS BEEN COMPLETED AND THE NATION DECLARED AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC AS OF APRIL 1 BY THE GREAT LEADER OF THE REVOLUTION, AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI. THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT IS CLAIMING A TURNOUT OF 18 MILLION AND AN OVERWHELMING VOTE IN FAVOR OF THE REPUBLIC. WE HAVE NO REASON TO DOUBT THE LATTER, WHICH WAS A FOREGON CONCLUSION IN ANY EVENT. THE TURNOUT, TOO, WAS UNDOUBTEDLY LARGE, AT LEAST IN TEHRAN AND REPORTEDLY OTHER MAJOR URBAN AREAS.

HOWEVER, GIVEN WIDESPREAD ADMINISTRATIVE PROBLEMS SUCH AS SHORTAGES OF BALLOTS, THE LACK OF POLLING STATIONS IN REMOTE RURAL AREAS, CONCERTED EFFORTS TO DISRUPT THE VOTING IN MUCH OF KURDESTAN, AND FIGHTING IN THE GONBAD KAVOUS AREA OF GORAN PROVINCE WHICH PREVENTED MANY VOTERS THERE FROM GOING TO THE POLLS, WE DOUBT THAT THE TURNOUT WAS MUCH AS CLAIMED BY MINISTER OF INTERIOR JAVADI (98 PERCENT OF THE TOTAL ELECTORATE).

WITH THE REFERENDUM A SOMEWHAT SUPERFLUOUS POINT HAS BEEN MADE, I.E., THAT THE VAST MAJORITY OF IRANIANS FAVOR THE ABOLITION OF THE PAHLAVI MONARCHY. PERHAPS IT WAS POLITICALLY NECESSARY TO STATE THE OBVIOUS IN THIS REGARD, BUT THE MANNER IN WHICH THE REFERENDUM WAS ORGANIZED AND CARRIED OUT NEEDLESSLY CREATED CONTROVERSY AND PROVOKED UNHAPPINESS AMONG A NUMBER OF POLITICALLY AWARE IRANIANS. GRIEVANCES RANGED FROM THE WAY IN WHICH THE PORPOSITION THAT IRANIANS WERE ASKED TO VOTE ON WAS FORMULATED TO THE LACK OF CHOICE AVAILABLE ON THE BALLOT. FURTHER, THE ACTUAL CONDUCT OF THE VOTING WAS SO AD HOC AND OFTEN HAPHAZARD THAT CONTINUING CONTROVERSY IS ALMOST CERTAINLY ASSURED.
HOW THE GOVERMENT PROCEEDS HEREAFTER WILL IN LARGE MEASURE DETERMINE WHETHER OR NOT ITS RATHER HAM-HANDED HANDLING OF THE REFERENDUM WILL RESULT IN LASTING DAMAGE.

IF THE NEW DRAFT CONSTITUTION IS MADE PUBLIC IN THE NEAR FUTURE (AS GOVERNMENT SPOKESMAN AMIR ENTEZAM SAYS IT WILL BE), IF A PUBLIC DEBATE OF ITS CONTENTS IS ALLOWED (AS AGAIN ENTEZAM HAS ASSURED WILL HAPPEN), AND IF A FREELY ELECTED CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY IS EMPOWERED TO MAKE REVISIONS WHICH MIGHT BE DEEMED NECESSARY AS A RESULT OF THE PUBLIC DEBATE (AS PM BAZARGAN HAS INTIMATED), THEN THE ODDS THAT THE DISGRUNTLEMENT WHICH SURFACED ON THE ISSUE OF THE REFERENDUM CAN BE CONTAINED AND PERHAPS EVEN MUTED SHOULD BE REASONABLY GOOD.

HOWEVER, IF THE CONSTITUTION IS PRESENTED AS A DIVINELY-INSPIRED AND IMMUTABLE, IF IT DOES NOT PROVIDE THE KIND OF LIBERTIES AND LEGAL DUE PROCESS NEAR AND DEAR TO THE HEARTS OF THE MODERNIST, SECULARIZED ELEMENTS OF IRANIAN SOCIETY, AND IF THERE IS NO PROVISION FOR GENUINE AUTONOMY--PERHAPS UNDER A FEDERAL STRUCTURE--FOR IRAN'S ETHNIC MINORITIES, THERE WILL BE TROUBLE.

IN ADDITION, THE SPEED WITH WHICH THE GOVERNMENT MOVES WILL BE OF UTMOST IMPORTANCE.IT CANNOT AFFORD TO GET BOGGED DOWN IN AN INTERMINABLE DEBATE OVER THE FORM THE CONSTITUTION WILL TAKE OR THE ISSUE MAY VERY WELL BECOME MOOT. THERE ARE SEVERAL INCIPIENT POLITICAL MOVEMENTS WHICH ARE CLEARLY PREPARING FOR THE POSSIBILITY OF A SEIZURE OF POWER BY NAKED FORCE OR EVEN ARMED CONFLICT. SOME AMONG THESE MOVEMENTS, MOST NOTABLY THE MARXIST FEDAYIN-E-KHALQ, APPEAR TO BE DESIGNING THEIR STRATEGIES AT LEAST TENTATIVELY AROUND THE EXPECTATION THAT THE EVOLUTIONARY PROCESS TOWARD PROMULGATION OF A CONSTITUTION AND NATIONAL ELECTIONS PRESENTLY ENVISIONED BY THE GOVERNMENT WILL BREAK DOWN.

THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT'S TRACK RECORD TO DATE CREATES LITTLE SENSE OF CONFIDENCE IN THE FUTURE. DESPITE THE GOOD INTENTIONS OF THE PRIME MIISTER HIMSELF, THE GOVERNMENT HAS TOO OFTEN BEEN THE VICTIM OF ITS OWN LACK OF AUTHORITY, AND ABSENCE OF CAREFUL PLANNING, AND LAST (BUT NOT LEAST) KHOMEINI'S CONCEPT OF ANISLAMIC REPUBLIC.

THERE HAS BEEN A APPARENT ASSUMPTION ON THE AYATOLLAH'S PART THAT WHAT IS INSPIRED BY GOD AND REVEALED TO THE IRANIAN PEOPLE THROUGH THE MEDIUM OF HIS OWN PRONOUNCEMENTS WILL BE ACCEPTED UNIVERSALLY WITHOUT DEBATE.SUCH AN ASSUMPTION IS PROBABLY JUSTIFIED IN THE CASE OF MOST OF THE POLITICALLY UNSOPHISTICATED MULSIM FAITHFUL, BUT IT IS PATENTLY WRONG WHEN IT CMES TO THOSE ELEMENTS OF IRANIAN SOCIETY WHICH HAVE DEFINITE IDEAS OF THEIR OWN OR HOW THEY SHOULD BE GOVERNED.

GIVEN KHOMEINI'S RETENTION OF THE ALLEGIANCE OF THE SHIA MASSES AND ITS OWN WEAKNESS, THE GOVERNMENT HAS BEEN UNABLE TO TAKE THE LEAD IN DEFINING THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. RATHER, ITS ROLE IN THIS AREA HAS BEEN LARGELY LIMITED TO ATTEMPTS AT SOFTENING THEIMPACT OF KHOMEINI'S FREQUENTLY INTEMPERATE STATEMENTS AMONG THOSE WHO ARE PROFOUNDLY SCEPTICAL OF THE IMPLICATIONS OF AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC TO BEGIN WITH.

BUT UNLESS THE GOVERNMENT CAN SOMEHOW SEIZE THE INITIATIE FROM KHOMEINI ON THE ISSUE OF THE REPUBLIC AND INCORPORATE IN ITS PROVISIONS THAT WILL BE GENERALLY SATISFACTORY TO ALL IRANIANS, THOSE WHO NOW ONLY GRUMBLE ABOUT THE PROSPECT OF A RIGIDLY THEOCRATIC STATE WILL INCREASINGLY BE FORCED INTO ACTIVE, PERHAPS VIOLENT OPPOSITION TO IT.

1979TEHRAN03587.subject: ARREST OF FSN EMPLOYEE - REZA AMINI

segments.text: SENIOR PUBLIC AFFAIRS ADVISOR DR. REZA AMINI(31 YEARS SERVICE) WAS TAKEN FROM HIS HOME LAST MIDNIGHT BY GROUP OF ARMED MEN BRANDISHING DOCUMENT SIGNED BY PUBLIC PROSECUTOR. AMINI'S WHEREABOUTS AND REASON FOR ARREST REMAIN UNKNOWN.

AT 0700 THIS MORNING DR. AMINI'S WIFE TELEPHONED TO REPORT FOLLOWING: ABOUT 2130 LAST EVENING TWO ARMED MEN APPEARED AT AMINI HOUSE TO PRESENT HIM WITH PAPER SIGNED BY PUBLIC PROSECUTOR. MRS. AMINI SAID HER HUSBAND WAS NOT HOME AND THE MEN DEPARTED. DR. AMINI, WHO WAS IN FACT AT HOME, CALLED LOCAL COMMITTEE TO REPORT INCIDENT. COMMITTEE ADVISED HIM NOT TO OPEN DOOR IF MEN RETURNED BUT TO CALL THE LOCAL COMMITTEE IMMEDIATELY. AMINI THEN CALLED ME TO REPORT THE INCIDENT. AT 2230 THREE MEN RETURNED.

AMINI TRIED TO TELEPHONE LOCAL COMMITTEE BUT BEFORE HE COULD REACH THEM A GROUP OF ARMED MEN BURST INTO THE HOUSE AND SEIZED HIM. FTER THOROUGH SEARCH OF HOUSE, ALLEGEDLY FOR WEAPONS, THE INTRUDERS DEPARTED WITH DR. AMINI, TAKING ALSO AMINI FAMILY PERSONAL PAPERS INCLUDING GOI ID CARDS, MRS. AMINI'S PASSPORT, BOOKS, PHOTOGRAPHS AND TELEPHONE DIRECTORIES.
I NOTIFIED AMBASSADOR IMMEDIATELY. HE WILL RAISE MATTER WHEN HE CALLS ON NEW FON MIN UNDERSECRETARY THIS MORNING.

PRESS ATTACHE ROSEN MEANWHILLED MININFO MINACHI, AS AMINI HAD REQUESTED HIM TO DO IN THE EVENT OF HIS EVENTUAL ARREST. MINACHI SAID HE WOULD CALL DEPPRIMIN ENTEZAM AND SUGGESTED ROSEN DO THE SAME, WHICH ROSEN DID. ENTEZAM SAID SUCH MATTERS WERE IN YAZDI'S PROVINCE AND WE SHOULD CONTACT HIM, WHICH I HAVE JUST DONE. YAZDI SAID WE SHOULD SEND DIPLOMATIC NOTE TO FONMIN WHICH WOULD PASS IT TO PRIMIN'S OFFICE. ON RECEIPT OF NOTE, HE SAID, HE WOULD CALL PUBLIC PROSECUTOR AND ARRANGE FOR AMINI'S RELEASE. AT MY SUGGESTION HE AGREED TO CALL PUBLIC PROSECUTOR ABOUT AMINI BEFORE RECEIVING NOTE.
WILL REPORT FURTHER DEVELOPMENTS AS THEY OCCUR.
(C) ENTIRE TEXT.

SUMMARY: BAZARGAN DISCUSSES THE CAUSES OF POLITICAL UNREST IN IRAN IN A RADIO AND TELEVISION TALK TO THE NATION. THE GOVERNMENT ANNOUNCES NEW JUDICIAL PROCEDURES. THE PACE OF ARRESTS QUICKENS. UNREST CONTINUES IN KURDESTAN. GONBAD KAVOUS QUIET AS CHARGES AND COUNTERCHARGES FLY. KAYHAN UNCOVERS A PLOT TO ASSASSINATE REVOLUTIONARY LEADERS. STUDENTS PROTEST THE EXECUTION OF A REVOLUTIONARY FUND RAISER. END SUMMARY.

IN A RADIO AND TELEVISION ADDRESS TO THE NATION APRIL 4 PM BAZARGAN ENGAGED IN RATHER CONTORTED EXAMINATION OF POLITICAL UNREST IN IRAN. HE BEGAN BY SAYING THAT VARIOUS PRETEXTS, SUCH DIFFERENCES BETWEEN SHIAS AND SUNNIS, AMONG ARABS, PERSIANS, AND TURKOMANS, ARE GIVEN FOR THE TROUBLES, BUT THEN ADDED THAT IN ACTUALITY THEY ARE THE RESULT OF "WELL-PREPARED PLANS" OF CERTAIN GROUPS, "WHETHER PROTROTSKY OR PRO-MAO OR PRO-MARXIST," WHICH ARE TAKING ADVANTAGE OF THE LACK OF ADEQUATE BORDER GUARDS TO BRING WEAPONS INTO IRAN.

BAZARGAN WENT ON TO CLAIM THAT THE COMMAND OF "THESE SELF-SAME SUBVERSIVES AND COUNTERREVOLUTIONARIES" IN GONBAD KAVOUS WAS ENTRUSTED TO THE BROTHER OF ONE OF THE LEFTIST GUERRILLAS KILLED IN THE ABORTIVE SIAHKAL UPRISING SEVERAL YEARS AGO. THEREAFTER, BAZARGAN SEEMED TO SHIFT GEARS, LAYING THE BLAME FOR POLITICAL UNREST ON FORCES THAT ARE SEEKING A RESTORATION OF THE SHAH. HE SPECIFICALLY MENTIONED ISRAEL IN THIS REGARD. HE DID NOT APPEAR TO SEE ANY INCONGRUITY BETWEEN THESE STATEMENTS AND THOSE MADE EARLIER IN HIS SPEECH SUGGESTING THAT IRAN'S ENEMIES ARE ON THE LEFT.

WE CAN ONLY CONCLUDE THAT BAZARGAN IS NO MORE IMMUNE TO CONSPIRATORIAL THEORIES THAN MOST PERSIANS, AND IS QUITE PREPARED TO PUBLICIZE CONTRADICTORY PROPOSITIONS WHEN IT COMES TO EXPLAINING POLITICAL PHENOMENA IN HIS COUNTRY.

THE GOVERNMENT HAS ANNOUNCED NEW PROCEDURES FOR THE CONDUCT OF JUDICIAL PROCEEDINGS UNDER A SYSTEM OF REVOLUTIONARY ISLAMIC COURTS. WE HAVE FEW DETAILS YET, BUT WHAT INFORMATION IS AVAILABLE SUGGESTS THAT THE PROCEDURES ATTEMPT TO INJECT A DEGREE OF CENTRAL GOVERNMENT CONTROL OVER THE ACTIVITIES OF THE HIGHLY DECENTRALIZED REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES WHICH HAVE STOUTLY RESISTED GIVING UP THEIR JUDICIAL POWERS. PROMULGATION OF THE PROCEDURES RAISES AN INTERESTING QUESTION, I.E., HOW IS LAW MADE IN REVOLUTIONARY IRAN? AS NEAR AS WE CAN DETERMINE, PROPOSED LEGISLATION IS FIRST SUBMITTED TO KHOMEINI.

WHEN HE HAS SCRUTINIZED AND APPROVED IT, IT GOES TO THE SHADOWY REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL AND THE CABINET OF THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT FOR RATIFICATION. IT WOULD NOT APPEAR THAT EITHER OF THESE BODIES HAS VETO POWER.
IT MAY BE MORE THAN A COINCIDENCE THAT THE NEW JUDICIAL PROCEDURES HAVE BEEN MADE PUBLIC JUST AS THE PACE OF ARRESTS HAS QUICKENED.

WE HAVE HAD REPORTS OF NUMEROUS BUSINESSMEN HAVING DIFFICULTIES, AND YESTERDAY, APRIL 4, A USICA LOCAL EMPLOYEE, DR. REZA AMINI, WAS PICKED UP ON UNSPECIFIED CHARGES.

UNREST CONTINUES IN KURDESTAN. FOLLOWING THE INCIDENT IN MAHABAD REPORTED IN THE APRIL 4 SITREP, A GROUP OF KURDS IN THE SAME CITY SURROUNDED A POLICE STATION THERE ON APRIL 3 AND TOOK SEVERALPERSONNELHOSTAGES. THE INCIDENT REPORTEDLY WAS RESOLVED WITHOUT VIOLENCE. A DELEGATION FROM THE KURDISH DEMOCRATIC PARTY MET WITH PM BAZARGAN APRIL 3 AND ASKED THAT A KURDISH REPRESENTATIVE BE ALLOWED TO PARTICIPATE IN THE DRAFTING OF THE NEW CONSTITUTION IN ORDER TO ASSURE THAT THE DEMANDS OF THE KURDISH PEOPLE WILL BE ACCOUNTED FOR IN IT. THE PM SAID HIS GOVERNMENT WOULD STUDY THE PROPOSAL.

MEANWHILE, ETTELAAT CLAIMS THAT A CONSPIRACY INVOLVING RELATIVES OF EXECUTED MAJLESMAN SALAR JAF, GEN. PALIZBAN, THE FORMER GOVERNOR GENERAL OF KERMANSHAH, AND FORMER SAVAK AGENTS IS UNDERWAY IN KURDESTAN. THESE INDIVIDUALS REPUTEDLY HAVE HIRED IRAQI MERCENARIES WITH THE OBJECTIVE OF RESTORING THE SHAH TO POWER. ANOTHER PUBLICATION, THE IRAN POLITICAL DIGEST, REPORTS THAT KURDESTAN IS EFFECTIVELY UNDER THE CONTROL OF THE KURDISH DEMOCRATIC PARTY, WITH THE SHIA KURD WHO HEADED THE SANANDAJ REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE AND WHO ACTED AS KHOMEINI'S REPRESENTATIVES LOCALLY HAVING FLED THE PROVINCE AND MODERATE KURDISH LEADER AHMAD MOFTIZADEH HAVING BEEN STRIPPED OF INFLUENCE.

AN UNEASY CALM HAS RETURNED TO GONBAD KAVOUS WITH CHARGES AND COUNTERCHARGES OF CONSPIRACY FLYING HOT AND HEAVY. LOCAL MOJAHEDIN BLAME THE MARXIST FEDAYIN, THE ARMY CLAIMS THE SOVIETS SUPPORTED THE REBELS, MOSCOW SAYS THE HAND OF THE CIA IS CLEARLY TO BE SEEN IN THE FIGHTING IN GONBAD KAVOUS, AND AN UNNAMED MINISTRY OF INTERIOR OFFICIAL QUOTED IN THE LEFTISH AYENDAGAN CHARGED BBC WITH FOMENTING TURKOMAN UNREST.

KAYHAN CLAIMS THAT IT HAS UNCOVERED EVIDENCE OF A PLOT BY SAVAK, AIDED BY THE CIA AND TO BE EXECUTED BY THE IMPERIAL GUARDS, TO BLOW UP THE HOMES OF A NUMBER OF THE LEADERS OF THE REVOLUTION IN EARLY FEBRUARY. THE LEADERS THEMSELVES WERE TO HAVE BEEN EXECUTED. KAYHAN DOES NOT SAY WHY THE PLAN WAS NEVER CARRIED OUT. MANY AMONG THE ALLEGED TARGETS HAD CONNECTIONS WITH THE NATIONAL FRONT OR OTHER RELATIVELY LIBERAL GROUPS.

ABOUT 50 STUDENTS REPORTEDLY STAGED A SIT-IN AT THE MINISTRY OF JUSTICE APRIL 4 TO PROTEST THE EXECUTION OF MEMBER OF THE FEDAYIN-E-KHALQ, MAHMUD RIASI, IN RAFSANJAN SEVERAL WEEKS AGO. RIASI WAS APPRENHENDED FOLLOWING AN ATTEMPTED BANK ROBBERY IN WHICH A BANK EMPLOYEE WAS KILLED. HE WAS TRIED BEFORE A REVOLUTIONARY TRIBUNAL, FOUND GUILTY OF MURDER AND EXECUTED ON FEBRUARY 27. THE CASE HAS BECOME A MINOR CAUSE CELEBRE FOR THE LEFT WHICH CLAIMS THAT RIASI WAS ACTUALLY ENGAGED IN REVOLUTIONARY FUND RAISING (THE ATTEMPTED BANK ROBBERY OCCURRED JUST BEFORE THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT FELL) AND THAT HE WAS SUBSEQUENTLY VICTIMIZED BY ISLAMIC FANATICS. SULLIVAN

1979TEHRAN03600.subject: A VISIT TO PNA AND A PHONE CALL TO KAYHAN

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT.)

ON THURSDAY, APRIL 5, PRESS ATTACHE PAID COURTESY CALL ON NEW OUTFIT AT PARS NEWS AGENCY. APPOINTMENT SET UP WITH MUHAMMAD REZA SHARIF, ACTING MANAGING DIRECTOR, BUT HE WAS CALLED TO PRIME MINISTER'S OFFICE. IN SHARIF'S ABSENCE, ROSEN WAS MET BY THE NEW ASSISTANT MANAGING DIRECTOR, AND LATER LEARNED BY ROSEN, THE CENTRAL KOMITEH'S CHOICE AND SUPERVISOR OF REVOLUTIONARY AFFAIRS AT PARS. BASHI, WHO CLAIMS TO HAVE A LONG CAREER IN JOURNALISM, WAS MOST CONGENIAL AND ENGAGING. OVER TEA PORTRAYED PARS' NEW ROLE AS AN INDEPENDENT NEWS AGENCY CONCENTRATING ON DOMESTIC NEWS WHILE CUTTING ITS FOREIGN BASED OFFICES, THUS ECONOMIZING WHERE NECESSARY.

WHEN INTRODUCED TO PARVIZ ARBABI, PARS' DIRECTOR OF INTERNATIONAL AFFAIRS, AND QUERIED BY HIM CONCERNING DR. AMINI'S HEALTH, PRESS ATTACHE RELATED EVENTS OF WEDNESDAY EVENING'S ARREST OF THE SENIOR PUBLIC AFFAIRS ADVISOR. ARBABI, A FRIEND AND COLLEAGUE OF DR. AMINI WAS SHOCKED, DISMAYED AND CANDID ABOUT THE INSECURITY, ARBITRARY POWER AND INFLUENCE OF THE KOMITEH PHENOMENON.

HE SAID IT WAS NOT UNLIKELY THAT THE "PEOPLE" WOULD TURN AGAINST THOSE, SUCH AS GOTBZADEH, WHO USE THEIR POWER SIMILAR TO THAT OF THE SHAH. "WE," HE ADDED, "ARE FORCED TO LIVE UNDER HIM NOW," POINTING TO A PICTURE OF KHOMEINI, "BUT TIME WILL TELL." ARBABI SHOWED ROSEN AROUND BOTH DOMESTIC AND INTERNATIONAL NEWSROOMS, WHERE IT WAS QUITE EVIDENT THAT FEW IF ANY OF THE 400 STAFFERS WERE WORKING BUT RATHER WHILING THEIR TIME AWAY WITH CONVERSATIONS AND TEA. WITH ARBABI PRESS ATTACHE WAS INTRODUCED TO HUSSEIN SEMNANI, THE DIRECTOR OF PARS' NEW PRESS CENTER.

THE CENTER, ACCORDING TO ARBABI, WAS DESIGNED TO PROVIDE THE FOREIGN PRESS WITH AN OPERATIONS HEADQUARTERS WHILE IN IRAN. FULLY EQUIPPED WITH TELEXES, WIRE SERVICE TELETYPES AND LONG DISTANCE PHONES, CHARGED BY INTERNATIONAL CREDIT CARDS, THE PRESS CENTER WAS EMPTY BUT NOT UNIMPRESSIVE. ARBABI RELATED THE AMINI ARREST TO SEMNANI, WHO CONFESSED HE TOO WAS PICKED UP WEDNESDAY EVENING AND TAKEN TO AYATOLLAH TALAGHANI'S HEADQUARTERS AND QUESTIONED ABOUT PREVIOUS EMPLOYMENT WITH ROYAL COURT.

PRESS ATTACHE CONTACTED KAYHAN'S EDITOR-IN-CHIEF SAHABI RE ITEM 3 OF REFTEL 3556 WHEREIN U.S. ACCUSED OF SUPERVISING SAVAK PLOT TO KILL REVOLUTIONARY LEADERSHIP. SAHABI EXPLAINED HE WAS NOT PRIVY TO DOCUMENTS CITED AS PROOF, BUT WAS ONLY TOLD THEY EXISTED BY CENTRAL KOMITEH. PRESS ATTACHE ASKED WHETHER KAYHAN'S REPORT COULD BE DESCRIBED AS GOOD INVESTIGATIVE REPORTING AND EDITOR REPLIED, "WE ARE LIVING IN A REVOLUTIONARY NOT A DEMOCRATIC PERIOD." HE DID SAY HE WOULD ATTEMPT TO SOURCE SENSITIVE PIECES IN THE FUTURE AND AGREED TO A LUNCHEON ON SUNDAY.
C - ENTIRE TEXT

SUMMARY: FEDAYIN CLAIM NO RESPONSIBILITY FOR GONBAD KAVOUS FIGHTING, SUPPORT ANTONOMY FOR ETHNIC MINORITIES WITHIN THE FRAMEWORK OF A UNITED IRAN. PM DEFENDS USE OF MEMBERS OF THE FORMER REGIME'S CIVIL SERVICE AND MILITARY FORCES, URGES COCRDINATION OF REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE ACTIVITIES. GHOTBZADEH DEFENDS HIS POLICIES AT NIRT. ENTEZAM SAYS HE IS NOT A CIA AGENT DURING NEWS CONNERENCE; ALSO COVERS SEVERAL OTHER TOPICS. SANJABI CONDEMNS BHUTTO EXECUTION. END SUMMARY.

THE SITUATION ON GONBAD KAVOUS APPEARS TO BE RETURNING TO NORMAL. A PRISONER EXCHANGE REPORTEDLY TOOK PLACE LATE APRIL 4 INVOLVING ABOUT 160 PEOPLE. TALKS ARE CONTINUING ON THE RELEASE OF OTHER PRISONERS, PRESUMABLY INCLUDING FEDAYIN-E-KHALQ REPRESENTATIVE, ABBAS HASHEMI, WHO WAS ARRESTED BY MEMBERS OF THE SHIA-DOMINATED GONBAD KAVOUS REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE DURING THE EARLY STAGES OF THE FIGHTING THERE. A FEDAYIN SPOKESMAN HAS CONFIRMED THAT HASHEMI WAS TAKEN INTO CUSTODY ALONG WITH 20 TO 30 MEMBERS OF THE TURKOMAN CULTURAL AND POLITICAL SOCIETY, BUT HE STOUTLY DENIED THAT HIS ORGANIZATION WAS IN ANY WAY REPSONSIBLE FOR THE FIGHTING IN TURKOMAN SAHRAH.
HE WAS SUPPORTED IN THIS STATEMENT BY TWO TURKOMAN REPRESENTATIVES WHO ALSO SAID THAT REPORTS THAT THE TURKOMAN FORCES HAD RECEIVED AID FROM ACROSS THE SOVIET BORDER WERE ALSO FALSE.

THE FEDAYIN SPOKESMAN SAID THAT HIS ORGANIZATION BELIEVES IN AUTONOMY FOR ETHNIC MINORITIES WITHIN THE FRAMEWORX OF A UNITED IRAN, BUT CONDEMNED ATTEMPTS TO STIR UP SEEARATIST SENTIMENT WHICH, IF REALIZED, WOULD ONLY WEAKEN IRAN AND EXPOSE IT TO POSSIBLE IMPERIALIST EXPLOITATION. HE CHARGED THAT IT IS THESE SAME IMPERIALISTS WHO HAVE ATTEMPTED TO INFLAME "THE PURE RELIGIOUS FEELINGS" OF EXCITABLE YOUNGSTERS IN THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES AGAINST THE FEDAYIN. IN THIS REGARD, HE SAID THAT HIS ORGANIZATION HAD PROTESTED HARASSMENT OF ITS MEMBERS, INCLUDING THE ARREST AND BEATING OF ONE MEMBER BY THE MEHRABAD AIRPORT REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE.

THE GOVERNMENT HAD NOT REPLIED TO THIS PROTEST NOR TO ANOTHER PROTEST DIRECTED AGAINST THE NATIONAL IRANIAN RADIO AND TELEVISION ORGANIZATION (NIRT) WHICH, THE SPOKESMAN CLAIMED, HAD REFUSED TO CARRY A FEDAYIN APPEAL FOR AN END TO THE FIGHTING IN GONBAD KAVOUS.

THE FEDAYIN SPOKESMAN SAID THAT HE ANTICIPATED THAT PLOTS TO TURN THE IRANIAN PEOPLE AGAINST HIS ORGANIZATION WOULD INCREASE IN THE NEAR FUTURE. NONETHELESS, THE FEDAYIN WOULD CONTINUE THEIR EFFORTS TO DEVELOP RELATIONS WITH THE WORKING CLASS IN ANTICIPATION OF SETTING UP A POLITICAL PARTY AT A SUBSEQUENT DATE.

FINALLY, HE SAID THAT THE FEDAYIN REMAIN OPPOSED TO THE EMPLOYMENT OF FORMER HIGH-RANKING OFFICERS, EVEN THOSE WITH SUPPOSEDLY CLEAN RECORDS, BY THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT, SINCE "THESE PEOPLE WERE TRAINED BY THE SHAH IN REPRESSION" AND THUS "CANNOT SERVE THE INTERESTS OF THE PEOPLE." ------------------095010 061432Z /40 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 0733 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY BONN AMEMBASSY CAIRO AMCONSUL DHAHRAN IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY DOHA AMCONSUL FRANKFURT AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS AMEMBASSY BEIJING AMEMBASSY RABAT USLO RIYADH IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY TOKYO USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE CINCPAC HONOLULU HI USDOCOSOUTH NAPLES IT SECTION 02 OF 03 TEHRAN 03631

THE LATTER STANDS IN SHARP CONTRAST TO THE POSITION OF THE GOVERNMENT, AT LEAST AS FORMULATED BY PM BAZARGAN IN HIS APRIL 4 ADDRESS TO THE NATION. WHILE PROMISING THAT THOSE OFFICIALS FOUND GUILTY OF WRONG-DOING WOULD BE PUNISHED, HE SAID THAT IRAN CANNOT GET ALONG WITHOUT THE TECHNICAL SKILLS THAT ONLY THE CIVILIAN BUREAUCRACY AND THE REGULAR ARMED SERVICES CAN PROVIDE.

HE WARNED BOTH THE IRANIAN PEOPLE AND THE MEMBERS OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES THAT "THEY SHOULD TAKE CARE LEST THE COUNTRY DEGENERATE INTO A SITUATION LIKE THAT UNDER AHMAD SHAH AND MOZAFAR-ED-DIN SHAH, IN WHICH THERE WAS IN EVERY DISTRICT, IN EVERY MOUNTAIN PASS, ON EVERY STREET CORNER, OR IN EVERY TOWN A RULER, A GANG LEADER, A MASTER OR A BULLY--A SITUATION IN WHICH EVERYONE WAS A LAW UNTO HIMSELF."

BAAARGAN ALSO URGED GREATER COORDINATOON AMONG THE MULTITUDINOUS REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES. HE SAID THAT WHEN HE WAS IN TABRIZ TWO WEEKS AGO HE URGED THAT A CENTRAL COMMITEEE BE FORMED IN THE CITY, EVEN IF II MEANT THAT A LEADER WOULD HAVE TO BE CHOSEN BY DRAWING LOTS. HE SAID THAT IT WAS UNFORTUNATE THAT "NOW YOU HAVE A COMMITTEE HERE AND A COMMITTEE THERE, AND WE ALL END UP NEUTRALIZING ONE ANOTHER'S OPERATIONS."
SADEGH GHOTBZADEH, IRAN'S PROPAGANDA CZAR, TOOK TO THE AIR PERSONALLY APRIL 4 TO DEFEND HIS POLICIES AT NIRT.

HE EXPRESSED DISTAIN FOR A "MINORITY" OF COMPLAINERS, INCLUDING SOME MEMBERS OF HIS OWN ORGANIZATION, WHO HAVE ATTEMPTED TO DISRUPT NIRT'S OPERATIONS. "WE KNOW WELL WHAT THE VIEWS OF THE PUBLIC ARE," HE SAID, AND NIRT WOULD NOT BE STOPPED FROM DISCUSSING "HUMAN AND ISLAMIC PROBLEMS..." GHOTBZADEH SAID THAT IT IS HIS OBJECTIVE TO HAVE PROGRAMMING REFLECT AN "ANTI-IMPERIALIST AND ANTI-ZIONIST QUALITY" AND "TO DEFEND THE WEAK AND THE BAREFOOT PEOPLE." HE CLAIMED THAT THE RESPONSE OF MOST NIRT EMPLOYEES, PARTICULARLY AMONG THE LOWER ESCHELONS, HAD BEEN POSIIIVE AND THAT ONLY A FEW PEOPLE, MOSTLY IN THE FIELD OF PRODUCTION, HAD CONTINUED TO AGITATE AGAINST HIS POLICIES.
GHOTBZADEH HAD AN ANSWER TO EVEN THAT PROBLEM, HOWEVER. HE ANNOUNCED THAT THE NIRT EXECUTIVE BOARD HAD DECIDED TO DISSOLVE THE ENTIRE PRODUCTION DEPARTMENT.

DEPUTY PM ABBAS AMIR ENTEZAM USED THE OCCASION OF HIS REGULARLY SCHEDULED NEWS CONFERENCE APRIL 5 TO BLAST HIS ENEMIES AS WELL. HE BRANDED AS ABSOLUTELY FALSE RUMORS THAT HE (AND GHOTBZADEH AND DEPUTY PM IBRAHIM YAZDI) HAD CONNECTIONS WITH THE CIA. CLAIMING A LONG HISTORY OF ACTIVITY IN THE IRANIAN POLITICAL OPPOSITION, HE SAID THAT HE WISHED TO "STATE THAT IF KNOWING THE ENGLISH LANGUAGE OR HAVING HAD AN EDUCATION IN AMERICA COULD BE CONSTRUED AS BEING AMERICAN, THEN WHAT ABOUT THE 40,000 (SIC) IRANIANS WHO ARE LIVING IN AMERICA NOW?" HE HAD ALWAYS BEEN AN IRANIAN, HE SAID, AND WOULD REMAIN SO.
FURTHER, HE WOULD CONTINUE TO"STRUGGLE TOWARD THE ACHIEVEMENT OF THE GOALS OF THE REVOLUTION" AND HIS "RELIGIOUS, HUMANE AND SOCIAL DUTIES."
