AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN, ACCOMPANIED BY DCM NAAS, MADE CALL APRIL 5 ON FONMIN UNDERSECRETARY SALAMATIAN WHO WAS RECENTLY CONFIRMED AS THE SECOND RANKING MAN IN THE IRANIAN FOREIGN MINISTRY. THE AMB NOTED THAT HE WAS RETURNING TO THE UNITED STATES ON CONSULTATIONS AND WANTED TO KNOW WHAT MESSAGE THE PROVISIONAL ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY GOVERNMENT OF IRAN WISHED PASSED TO U.S. OFFICIALS. SALAMATIAN SAID THE AMB SHOULD IMPRESS UPON THOSE WITH WHOM HE CONSULTED THE SUCCESS OF THE REVOLUTION AND THE DESIRE OF CLOSE FREINDSHIP WITH THE U.S.

HE ADDED THAT HE HAD DISCUSSED THIS MATTER PRIOR TO THE MEETING WITH THE PRIME MINISTER AND THE FOREIGN MINISTER SO THAT HIS STATEMENT OF FRIENDSHIP WAS SHARED BY THE HIGHEST OFFICIALS IN THE GOVERNMENT. THE AMB REPLIED THAT HE HAD ALREADY TOLD THE U.S. GOVERNMENT THAT HE BELIEVES FREINDSHIP WITH IRAN WILL ENDURE AND THAT BASIC INTEREST WILL BE PRESERVED BUT IT WILL BE A DIFFERENT KIND OF RELATIONSHIP THAN WE HAD WITH THE SHAH'S GOVERNMENT. FOR MANY REASONS, THE UNITED STATES WISHES IRAN TO BE STRONG, FREE, INDEPENDENT AND TO MAINTAIN ITS NATIONAL INTEGRITY. WE LOOK FORWARD, HE SAID, TO A NORMAL RELATIONSHIP WITH IRAN.

SALAMATIAN, WHO SPEAKS SOFTLY BUT WITH SOME OVERTONES OF PASSION, SAID THAT AMERICANS SHOULD UNDERSTAND THAT THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION HAS HAD MANY OF THE SAME CHARACTERISTICS AS OUR OWN REVOLUTION IN 1776. THE GREAT AMERICAN PRESIDENTS--WASHINGTON, JEFFERSON, LINCOLN-ARE GREATLY RESPECTED HERE. MANY ASPECTS OF THE IRANIAN CONSTITUTION WERE INSPIRED BY THE U.S. CONSTITUTION. HE QUOTED LINCOLN: "YOU CAN DECIVE SOME OF THE PEOPLE SOME OF THE TIME..." AND ADDED THAT A BASIC ERROR OF THE SHAH WAS HIS BELIEF THAT YOU COULD DECEIVE ALL OF THE PEOPLE ALL OF THE TIME. HE WAS PLEASED, HE SAID, THAT THE UNITED STATES WANTS AN INDEPENDENT IRAN WHICH MAINTAINS ITS TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY.
THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION WAS, HE EMPHASIZED, PURELY IRANIAN AND DID NOT HAVE FOREIGN INSPIRATION.

THE AMB RESPONDED THAT THE USG UNDERSTANDS THAT THE REVOLUTION WAS PURELY INTERNAL BUT ONE OF THE REALITIES WE BOTH MUST FACE IS THE CONSTANT STREAM OF PROPAGANDA FROM THE SOVIET UNION TRYING TO DECEIVE IRANIANS RE THE U.S. ROLE HERE. WE ARE DISTURBED BY THE HEAVY FLOW OF LIES FROM MOSCOW AND THEN THE REPETITION OF THESE LIES HERE BY IRANIAN FRIENDS OF THE SOVIETS. HE NOTED THAT KAYHAN WAS GUILTY IN PARTICULAR OF CARRYING SOVIET PROPAGANDA AND HE HOPED THAT SENIOR GOI OFFICIALS WOULD RECOGNIZE THE LIES. HE ADDED THAT, ON THE BASIS OF CONVERSATIONS, PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN RECOGNIZED THE DANGER OF THIS PROPAGANDA.

IN RESPONSE SALAMATIAN SAID ONCE AGAIN THAT HE WAS PLEASED BY THE U.S. CONCERN OVER THE UNITY AND TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY OF HIS COUNTRY. TURNING TO THE IRANIAN PRESS, SALAMATIAN SAID THAT IT WAS NATURAL AFTER 25 YEARS OF SUPPRESSION THAT THE PRESS WOULD ON OCCASION GIVE VENT TO ITS EMOTIONS; THE FREEDOM OF THE PRESS IS VERY IMPORTANT TO THE REVOLUTIONAIRES.

THE AMB REFERRED TO A RECENT KAYHAN STORY THAT THE U.S. HAD CONSPIRED WITH SAVAK TO BLOW UP THE HOUSES OF A NUMBER OF PROMINENT IRANIAN REVOLUTIONARIES SUCH AS AYATOLLAH TALAGHANI. THE ARTICLE IS PURE FABRICATION BUT, THE AMB SAID, WE ARE CONCERNED THAT SUCH MATERIAL INCITES O1HERS AND THAT THIS CAN RESULT IN THE HARASSMENT OF PEOPLE ASSOCIATED WITH THE EMBASSY OR U.S. FIRMS. THE AMB THEN MENTIONED THE CASES OF REZA AMINI OF ICA, MR. SHEBANI OF AIU AND DOWLATSHAHI OF MOTOROLA (SEPTELS).

1979TEHRAN03662.subject: IRAN'S NEW SYSTEM OF ISLAMIC JUSTICE

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY AND INTRODUCTION: REGULATIONS PROMULGATED APRIL 5 PROVIDE FOR THE REPLACEMENT OF THE PREVIOUS IRANIAN SYSTEM OF JURISPRUDENCE WITH ONE BASED ON ISLAMIC AND "REVOLUTIONARY" CONCEPTS OF JUSTICE. THE REGULATIONS DELINIATE PROCEDURES FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF ISLAMIC COURTS RESPONSIBLE FOR THE CONDUCT OF TRIALS AND THE ORGANIZATION OF THE OFFICE OF THE PRSECUTOR GENERAL RESPONSIBLE FOR ARRESTS, INVESTIGATIONS, PROSECUTIONS AND CARRYING OUT OF SENTENCES HANDED DOWN BY THE COURTS. THE CREGULATIONS RAISE A NUMBER OF QUESTIONS WHICH WE WILL SEEK ANSWERS TO AS QUICKLY AS POSSIBLE. HOWEVER, THEY DO NOT LEAVE THE GENERAL THRUST OF JUSTICE AS IT IS TO BE ADMINISTERED IN REVOLUTIONARY IRAN IN MUCH DOUBT. HIGHLIGHTS FOLLOW.
END SUMMARY AND INTRODUCTION.

THE PROSECUTOR GENERAL WILL BE APPOINTED ON THE RECOMMENDATION OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL (THE SHADOWY ORGANIZATION WHICH CONSTITUTES AND INFORMAL SYSTEM OF GOVERNMENT OPERATING PARALLEL TO AND FREQUENTLY IT SEEMS, AT CROSS-PURPOSES WITH THE FORMAL PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT) AND WITH APPROVAL OF THE LEADER OF THE REVOLUTILN, AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, THUS, WHILE OSTENSIBLY AN OFFICIAL OF THE GOVERNMENT, HE WILL IN ALL LIKELIHOOD BE RESPONSIVE IN THE FIRST INSTANCE TO THE INFORMAL STRUCTURE OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL. THE PROSECUTOR GENERAL IS EMPOWERED TO CREATE BRANCES OF HIS OFFICE AT THE PROVINCIAL LEVEL AS MAY BE REQUIRED.
WE TAKE THIS TO MEAN THAT BUREAUCRATICALLY HIS ORGANIZATION WILL FOLLOW THE PATTERN OF THE MINISTRY OF JUSTICE.

THE PROSECUTOR GENERAL'S STAFF IS EMPOWERED TO INVESTIGAGE ACCUATIONS OF WRONG-DOING, TO ISSUE WARRANTS FOR ARREST, TO CONDUCT INTERROGATIONS OF THOSE ACCUSED OF CRIMES, TO REPRESENT THE PLAINTIFF IN COURT PROCEEDINGS, AND TO CARRY OUT THE SENTENCES HANDED DOWN. LAW ENFORCEMENT AGENCIES, THE ARMED FORCES, THE PARAMILITARY GUARDIANS OF THE REVOLUTION, AND MEMBERS OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES ARE TO BE RESPONSIVE TO THE PROSECUTOR GENERAL, AND THE GUARDIANS OF THE REVOLUTION AND COMMITTEE MEMBERS ARE SPECIFICALLY PROHIBITED FROM CARRYING OUT SEARCHES AND SEIZURES AND MAKING ARRESTS WITHOUT THE PRIOR AUTHORIZATION OF THE PROSECUTOR GENERAL.

THE PROSECUTOR GENERAL CAN ALSO ORDER THE IMPOUNDMENT OF THE PROPERTY OF ANY INDIVIDUAL UNDER INVESTIGATION AS WELL AS THE PROPERTY OF ANY HIS RELATIVES IF HE HAS REASON TO BELIEVE THAT THE INDIVIDUAL UNDER INVESTIGATION HAS TRANSFERRED HIS OWN PROPERTY TO THEM TO AVOID IMPOUNDMENT. THE PROSECUTOR GENERAL CAN SUBPOENA WITNESSES AS REQUIRED BY ADVERTISEMENT IN THE NEWSPAPERS AND CAN ORDER THE ARREST OF ANY WITNESS WHO DOES NOT APPEAR. INDIVIDUALS ARRESTED ON THE ORDER OF THE PROSECUTOR GENERAL CAN BE HELD INDEFINITELY PENDING INVESTIGATION; HOWEVER, ONLY THE COURT ADMINISTRATOR, A RELIGIOUS JUDGE, CAN ORDER INDIVIDUALS DETAINED RELEASED.

THE REGULATIONS ALSO PROVIDE FOR A CHIEF OF THE ISLAMIC COURT WHOSE EXACT MANNER OF APPOINTMENT IS NOT CLEAR. HE IS EMPOWERED, AT THE BEHEST OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL AND WITH THE APPROVAL OF KHOMEINI, TO CONVENE AND DISSOLVE ISLAMIC COURTS. THESE COURTS WILL BE COMPOSED OF FIVE PERSONS, THREE PERMANENT AND TWO ROTATING MEMBERS. THE SENIOR MEMBER, WHO SHALL SERVE AS THE COURT ADMINISTRATOR AND IS TO BE APPOINTED ON THE RECOMMENDATION OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL AND WITH KHOMEINI'S APPROVAL, MUST BE AN ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS JUDGE, A GHAZI.

THE SECOND PERMANENT MEMBER MUST BE A LAWYER AND IS TO BE ELECTED BY "THE JUDGES (WHICH JUDGES IS NOT CLEAR)." THE THIRD PERMANENT MEMBER MUST BE SOMEONE "WHO IS TRUSTED BY THE PEOPLE AND IS WELL AWARE OF THE PRINCIPLES OF THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTION." THESE LATTER CRITERIA WOULD SEEM TO ASSURE THAT POLITICAL CONSIDERATIONS WILL NOT BE NEGLECTED IN THE JUDICIAL PROCEEDINGS. FINALLY, THE TWO ROTATING MEMBERS WILL BE ELECTED (BY WHOM IT IS NOT CLEAR) "FROM THE HONEST GROUPS OF THE COMMUNITY." ALL MEMBERS MUST BE AT LEAST 30 YEARS OF AGE.

THE ACCUSED MUST BE APPRISED OF THE CHARGES AGAINST HIM PRIOR TO TRIAL BUT THE DEFINITION OF WHAT CONSTITUES A CRIME IS BOTH BROAD AND VAGUE. IT INCLUDES "ANTI-PEOPLE AND ANTI-REVOLUTIONARY" ACTIVITIES, ADVANCEMENT OF THE INTERESTS OF FOREIGNERS AND/OR THE PAHLAVI REGIME, AND PLUNDERING OF THE TREASURY AND RUINATION OF THE NATIONAL ECONOMY. TRIALS ARE TO BE OPEN EXCEPT WHEN THE COURT ADMINISTRATOR DETERMINES THAT THEY SHOULD BE OTHERWISE. TRIALS IN ABSENTIA ARE AUTHORIZED. SUBMISSION OF EVIDENCE WILL BE IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE RULES OF ISLAMIC JURISPRUDENCE.

THE COURT ADMINISTRATOR'S WORD SHALL BE FINAL ON QUESTIONS ------------------116275 081231Z /10 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 0747 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 03662 OF ADMISSABILITY OF EVIDENCE. SENTENCES WILL ALSO BE IN ACCORDANCE WITH ISLAMIC RULES AND WILL INCLUDE EXECUTION, RETRIBUTION (I.E., FLOGGING, STONING, AMPUTATION, ETC.), IMPRISONMENT, EXILE AND CONFISCATION OF PROPERTY.

THERE IS MUCH IN THESE REGULATIONS TO CAUSE CONCERN, NOT THE LEAST OF WHICH BEING TWO ARTICLES THAT IN ESSENCE EMPOWER BOTH THE PROSECUTOR GENERAL AND CHIEF OF THE ISLAMIC COURT TO DEVISE PROCEDURES AD HOC AS CIRCUMSTANCES WARRANT. FURTHER, THERE ARE NO PROVISIONS FOR HABEAS CORPUS, ACCESS TO COUNSEL, BAIL, THE CALLING OF DEFENSE WITNESSES OR APPEAL. GIVEN KHOMEINI'S PRONOUNCEMENTS ON ISLAMIC JUSTICE WE MUST ASSUME THAT THESE OMISSIONS WERE CONSCIOUSLY MADE. WITH PROMULGATION OF THE REGULATIONS, THE SUSPENSION OF JUDICIAL PROCEEDINGS WHICH WAS INITIATED SEVERAL WEEKS AGO WHEN PM BAZARGAN THREATENED TO RESIGN, IF THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS WERE NOT BROUGHT UNDER CONTROL, HAS ENDED.

ONE ARTICLE SPECIFICIALLY AUTHORIZED SENTENCES PASSED PRIOR TO THE SUSPENSION TO BE CARRIED OUT AND TWO ALLEGED SAVAK OFFICIALS AND A POLICE OFFICER WERE PROMPTLY EXECUTED IN ISFAHAN ON APRIL 6. DEATH SENTENCES WERE PASSED DOWN ON SIX MILITARY AND POLICE OFFICIALS AT 1:00 A.M. APRIL 7 BY A COURT CONVENED IN TEHRAN UNDER THE NEW REGULATIONS AND, IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE PROVISION IN THE REGULATIONS THAT SENTENCES BE CARRIED OUT WITHIN 24 HOURS, THE MEN WERE EXECUTED ALMOST IMMEDIATELY. LATER THE SAME DAY, THE TRIAL OF FORMER PM AMIR ABBAS HOVEYDA WAS RESUMED, A VERDICT WAS QUICKLY REACHED, AND HOVEYDA WAS DEAD BY THE AFTERNOON.

THE PROCEDURES APPEAR TO REPRESENT A MAJOR SETBACK FOR THOSE MEMBERS OF THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT SUCH AS PM BAZARGAN WHO CARE ABOUT SUCH THINGS AS DUE PROCESS AND IRAN'S INTERNATIONAL REPUTATION. IT IS LIKELY THAT THE GOVERNMENT'S PUBLIC STANCE WILL BE THAT THE JUCICIAL PROCESS HAS AT LEAST BEEN BROUGHT UNDER SOME KIND OF FORMALIZED STRUCTURE. HOWEVER, THE PROMULGATION OF THE NEW PROCEDURES CLEARLY DEMONSTRATES THAT KHOMEINI'S VIEWS ON JURISPRUDENCE HAVE PREVAILED.

FURTHER, WHILE THE PROCEDURES NOMINALLY GIVE THE GOVERNMENT A CENTRAL ROLE IN THE JUDICIAL PROCESS IN THE PERSON OF THE PROSECUTOR GENERAL, THE PROCEDURES ARE IN FACT AN ADMISSION BY THE GOVERNMENT THAT IT HAS BEEN UNABLE TO WREST CONTROL OF THE ADMINISTRATION OF JUSTICE FROM THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE STRUCTURE. THE ISLAMIC FUNDAMENTALISTS AND VENGEFUL REVOLUTIONARIES, IT SEEMS, ARE DETERMINED TO SETTLE SCORES AND LEGAL NICETIES AND INTERNATIONAL OPINION WILL HAVE LITTLE INFLUENCE.

SINCE THE ABOVE PARAGRAPHS WERE DRAFTED MINISTER OF JUSTICE MOBASHERI HAS SAID THAT THE VERSION OF THE NEW REGULATIONS ANNOUNCED OVER THE GOVERNMENT-CONTROLLED VOICE OF THE IRANIAN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC AND PUBLISHED IN THE PRESS APRIL 5 DIFFERS FROM THE TEXT OF THE REGULATIONS APPROVED BY THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL. HE DID NOT SAY, HOWEVER, WHAT THE DIFFERENCES ARE. WE WILL BE ATTEMPTING TO FIND OUT. MOBASHERI JUSTIFIED THE SYSTEM OF ISLAMIC COURTS ON THE GROUNDS THAT THE PRESENT SITUATION IN IRAN, LIKE WAR, REQUIRES FAST ACTION.
HE INTIMATED THAT THE SYSTEM OF ORDINARY COURTS WHICH HAS BEEN UNDER THE CONTROL OF HIS MINISTRY HERETOFORE WOULD PERHAPS CONTINUE, BUT SAID THAT THIS WOULD HAVE TO BE

IRANIAN NATIONAL WHO HEADED AP BUREAU HERE UNTIL RECENTLY RECOUNTED TO POL COUNSELOR APRIL 5 RUN-IN HE HAD IN RECENT WEEKS WITH SOVIET EMBASSY. SOURCE RECALLED THAT HE HAD CALLED KOMITAY AND PRIME MINISTER'S OFFICE DURING ATTACK ON U.S. EMBASSY FEB 15 AND WAS TOLD IN BOTH CASES THAT IT WAS AN ATTACK BY "THE COMMUNISTS." HE PRINTED THAT.

NEXT DAY HE GOT A LONG, EXTREMELY ABUSIVE TELEPHONE CALL FROM THE LOCAL TASS REPRESENTATIVE, ONE (FNU) KOROL. KOROL ACCUSED HIM OF BEING CONSISTENTLY PROAMERICAN AND ANTI-COMMUNIST (COMMENT: THAT IS TRUE) AND SAID "WE" ARE GOING TO RAID THE AP OFFICE SOON AND KILL SOURCE. KOROL WENT ON THIS WAY, EVEN AT ONE POINT LABELING AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI A "CIA AGENT."

SOURCE WAS PERTURBED. HE ATTACHED TAPE RECORDER TO PHONE AND CALLED KOROL BACK, LEADING HIM INTO REPETITION OF VARIETY OF THREATS, IN WHICH KOROL CLEARLY ASSOCIATED HIMSELF WITH ACTION OF VARIOUS LEFT-WING GROUPS IN IRAN. HE SAYS HE FORGOT TO GET KOROL TO REPEAT THE BIT ABOUT KHOMEINI BEING CIA AGENT. THIS TAPE IS STILL IN HIS POSSESSION. HE HAS TRANSCRIBED IT AND SENT TRANSSCRIPTION TO AP HEADQUARTERS IN NEW YORK. HE TOLD POL COUNSELOR HE WOULD BE HAPPY SEND A COPY TO DEPARTMENT (NEA/IRN) WHEN HE GETS TO NEW YORK SOON.

AP HEADQUARTERS COMPLAINED ABOUT THESE THREATS TO TASS REPS, AND TASS EXTENDED APOLOGIES. TEHRAN IZVESTIA CORRESPONDENT, ONE ASHRAF AHMADJANOV, THEN CALLED UP SOURCE TO APOLGIZE. APPARENTLY AHMADJANOV, WHO WAS IN TEHRAN ON AN EARLIER TOUR AS THE TASS CORRESPONDENT, PASSES AS A "NICE GUY" HERE. HE TOLD SOURCE THAT KOROL HAD NOT BEEN AUTHORIZED TO SAY WHAT HE DID AND WAS BEING SEVERELY REPRIMANDED. AMB VINOGRADOV INVITED SOURCE TO THE EMBASSY SO HE COULD TALK WITH HIM.

SOURCE SAID HE DID NOT BELIEVE KOROL WOULD MAKE SUCH STATEMENTS WITHOUT SOME AUTHORIZATION FROM SOMEONE IN SOVIET GOVERNMENT. HOWEVER, HE DID NOT WANT KOROL PUNISHED. NEITHER DID HE THINK IT APPROPRIATE TO SEE VINOGRADOV AT THE EMBASSY. SOURCE ALSO TURNED ASIDE POLITELY REPEATED INVITATIONS TO LUNCH OR DRINKS FROM AHMADJANOV--AS WELL AS AN INVITATION THAT SOURCE COME AND TAKE REFUGE IN AHMADJANOV'S HOUSE WHERE SOVIETS WILL "PROTECT" HIM.

COMMENT: THIS IS FIRST DETAILED CASE WE HAVE HAD RECOUNTED TO US OF SOVIET EMBASSY INVOLVEMENT IN COERCING AND/OR BRIBING LOCAL PRESS CORPS. WE BELIEVE THE PRACTICE HAS BEEN QUITE WIDESPREAD FOR A LONG TIME, HOWEVER, AT LEAST AS FAR AS ATTEMPTS TO BRIBE ARE CONCERNED. POL COUNSELOR RECALLS BEING TOLD BY AN IRANIAN CORRESPONDENT AT AN INDIAN EMBASSY PARTY ABOUT A YEAR AGO THAT SEVERAL SOVIET EMBASSY OFFICERS HAD VISITED HIM ON DIFFERENT OCCASIONS TO TRY WINNING HIM TO SOVIET SIDE, AND OPENLY OFFERING FINANCIAL SUPPORT.

WITH WIDE OPEN LAW AND ORDER SITUATION IMMEDIATELY FOLLOWING TRIUMPH OF THE REVOLUTION HERE, OBVIOUSLY SOME SOVIET (KGB) REPS HERE HAVE TRIED TO USE COERCION BRANDISHING THEIR PRESUMED INFLUENCE WITH LOCAL LEFTIST GROUPS. NAAS
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)

IN MEETING WITH DEPUTY PM AMIR ENTEZAM APRIL 7 CHARGE RAISED THE QUESTION OF REINSTITUTION OF REVOLUTIONARY COURTS AND IN PARTICULAR THE TRIAL OF FORMER PRIME MINISTER HOVEYDA. MAKING IT CLEAR HE WAS SPEAKING ON HUMANITARIAN GROUNDS WITHOUT GETTING INTO THE ISSUES OF GUILT OR INNOCENCE, HE POINTED OUT PROBLEMS SUCH EXECUTION COULD RAISE FOR IRANIAN GOVERNMENT IN ITS PUBLIC RELATIONS IMAGE, PARTICULARLY IN U.S. PUBLIC PERCEPTIONS OF IRAN. CHARGE NOTED THAT THESE PERCEPTIONS COULD COMPLICATE THE DESIRED PROCESS OF NORMALIZATION OF OUR RELATIONS AND REFERRED TO WORLD OUTCRY OVER BHUTTO EXECUTION.
AMIR ENTEZAM REACTED STRONGLY. HE SAID BHUTTO AND HOVEYDA ARE DIFFERENT CASES. A MORE APPROPRIATE CASE WOULD BE ZIA-UL-HUQ, IF HE WERE TRIED AND EXECUTED.

HOVEYDA WAS AT THE VERY CENTER OF PREVIOUS REGIME'S CORRUPTION, AMIR ENTEZAM SAID. NINETY PERCENT OF IRANIAN PEOPLE WANT HIM HUNG. WHAT WORLD PRESS WRITES IS OF LITTLE CONSEQUENCE, SINCE EVERYBODY KNOWS THE SHAH HAS "25 BILLION DOLLARS" OUTSIDE THE COUNTRY AND CAN BUY THE WORLD PRESS. THERE ARE COUNTER-REVOLUTIONARIES STILL TRYING TO STIR UP TROUBLE IN HOPE OF REVERSING REVOLUTION'S VICTORY (HE MENTIONED FORMER GOVERNOR GENERAL OF KURDISTAN AND KHORASAN AS EXAMPLES). BESIDES, AMIR ENTEZAM CONCLUDED, THE GOVERNMENT HAS NOTHING TO DO WITH THESE TRIALS--THEY ARE BEING CARRIED OUT IN OTHER REVOLUTIONARY CHANNELS.

COMMENT: AMIR ENTEZAM'S VEHEMENCE AGAINST HOVEYDA CAN BE EXPLAINED IN PART BY HIS PROBABLE KNOWLEDGE THAT HOVEYDA HAD BEEN FOUND GUILTY BY REVOLUTIONARY COURT THAT DAY. HIS EXECUTION IN THE LATE AFTERNOON (SHORTLY AFTER CHARGE'S MEETING WITH AMIR ENTEZAM) WAS ANNOUNCED ON EARLY EVENING RADIO AND TV HERE. THIS VEHEMENCE RUNS CONTRARY TO PM BAZARGAN'S STATEMENTS IN THE PAST CONDEMNING REVOLUTIONARY EXECUTIONS. AT THE SAME TIME, IT WAS INTERESTING THAT AMIR ENTEZAM ADMITTED GOVERNMENT'S POWERLESSNESS IN NEW PROCEDURES. DESPITE NOMINAL PRESENCE OF A GOVERNMENT REPRESENTATIVE AT COURT PROCEEDINGS, THE REVOLUTIONARY COURT IS QUITE CLEARLY BEING RUN BY THE MULLAHS. THIS SEEMS TO BE AN ARRANGEMENT IMPOSED BY KHOMEINI ON BAZARGAN.

COMMENT: THE MENTION OF ZIA-UL-HUQ AS DESERVING HOVEYDA'S FATE WAS PRETTY STRONG STATEMENT FROM AMIR ENTEZAM. IT SUGGESTS SOME STRONG FEELINGS IN PGOI BEHIND FONMIN SANJABI'S PUBLIC CONDEMNATION OF THAT EXECUTION.

FINALLY, WE ARE NOT SURE IF DEPT AWARE THAT CANADIAN PM TRUDEAU WAS CONSIDERING A REPRESENTATION HERE ON HOVEYDA'S BEHALF. WE BELIEVE THIS WAS STILL BEING DISCUSSED WITH CANADIAN AMBASSADOR IN TEHRAN WHEN OVER
(C-ENTIRE TEXT)

BRITISH EMBASSY CHARGE MIERS WILL CALL AT MFA (PANAHI) TOMORROW, APRIL 9, TO TURN OVER BRITISH PROPOSAL FOR HOUSEKEEPING PROCEDURES TO CLOSE OUT CENTO. HE IS GOING TO URGE THAT IRANIANS SEND REPRESENTATIVES TO ANKARA ASAP TO HELP WIND UP AFFAIRS. AS ADDRESSEES AWARE, IDEA IS TO CLOSE UP ALL ORGANS EXCEPT COUNCIL WHICH WILL REMAIN IN BEING UNTIL LOOSE ENDS WOUND UP.
POL COUNSELOR TOLD MIERS WE HAD NO INSTRUCTIONS BUT COULD SEE NO OBJECTION.

SUMMARY: TRIALS AND EXECUTIONS RESUME. MORE ARRESTED WHILE THE SEARCH FOR STILL OTHERS GOES ON. SANJABI SAYS IRAN WANTS GOOD RELATIONS WITH ALL COUNTRIES BUT KHOMEINI CLAIMS IRAN IS AT WAR WITH BOTH THE EAST AND THE WEST. NEW ISLAMIC PARAMILITARY ORGANIZATION FORMED AMIDST MARXIST PROTEST. FEDAYIN TAKE THEIR LICKS, TOO. HOSSEINIEH ERSHAD REOPENS AS A CENTER FOR ISLAMIC PROGRESSIVES. ELECTIONS TO CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY SCHEDULED FOR JUNE 1. GOVERNMENT MOVES TO CONFIRM LAND GRABS IN TURKOMAN SAHRAH, PROPOSES LEGISLATION TO PREVENT OTHERS. LOCAL PAKISTANIS PROTEST BHUTTO HANGING. END SUMMARY.

THE PROMULGATION OF REGULATIONS GOVERNING THE CONDUCT OF REVOLUTIONARY ISLAMIC COURTS ON APRIL 5 WAS QUICKLY FOLLOWED BY RESUMPTION OF TRIALS AND EXECUTIONS. ONE PROVISION IN THE NEW REGULATIONS PROVIDED FOR SENTENCES PREVIOUSLY PASSED DOWN TO BE CARRIED OUT AND TWO ALLEGED SAVAK OFFICIALS AND A POLICE OFFICER CONDEMNED EARLIER BY A REVOLUTIONARY TRIBUNAL IN ISFAHAN WERE PROMPTLY EXECUTED ON APRIL 6. THE THREE WERE IDENTIFIED AS MAHMOUD SHAHIDI, A SAVAK INTERROGATOR; KAMAL ADIB, A SAVAK INTERROGATOR AND TORTURER; AND POLICE OFFICER MAHMOUD ASGHARIZADEH.

LATER ON APRIL 6 A COURT WAS CONVENED IN TEHRAN WHICH AFTER 15 HOURS OF TESTIMONY CONDEMNED TO DEATH SIX MILITARY AND POLICE PERSONNEL WHO WERE PROMPTLY EXECUTED EARLY APRIL 7. THE SIX WERE MAJ. GEN. MOHAMMAD JAVAD MOULAVI-TALAGHANI, DESCRIBED AS THE HEAD OF THE ANTI-RIOT POLICE; BRIG. GEN. GHOLAM REZA IRAJ AMINI-AFSHAR, FORMER MILITARY GOVERNOR OF NAJAFABAD; LTC HADI GOLESTANI, COMMANDER OF THE 140TH BATTALION; LTC MASHALLAH EFTAKHARMANESH; 1ST LT. BAHADOR BAHADORI; AND ELISTED MAN MOSTAFA SADRI.

THE FOUR LATTER WERE CONVICTED OF INVOLVEMENT IN THE EVENTS OF BLACK FRIDAY, SEPTEMBER 8, IN WHICH A NUMBER OF PEOPLE WERE KILLED WHEN THEY FAILED TO OBSERVE MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS AGAINST ASSEMBLY. FINALLY THE TRIAL OF FORMER PM AMIR ABBAS HOVEYDA, WHICH HAD BEEN SUSPENDED SEVERAL WEEKS AGO AMIDST THREATS FROM PM BAZARGAN TO RESIGN IF THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS WERE NOT BROUGHT UNDER CONTROL, WAS RESUMED APRIL 7. BY 7:30 P.M. THE SAME DAY HE WAS DEAD.

THE PROSPECTS FOR THE FUTURE ARE NOT PROMISING. THE PRESS REPORTED APRIL 7 AND 8 THAT TRIALS OF FORMER AIR FORCE COMMANDER RABI'I, FORMER CHIEF OF SAVAK MOGHADAM, FORMER MAYOR OF TEHRAN NIKPAY, AND FORMER AIR FORCE CHIEF OF COUNTER-INTELLIGENCE BERENJIAN HAVE BEEN AUTHORIZED, AMONG OTHERS. THE BRITISH EMBASSY HAS INFORMATION THAT THESE TRIALS ARE UNDERWAY TODAY, APRIL 8. THE PRESS ALSO REPORTS THAT 35 INDIVIDUALS HAVE BEEN ARRESTED IN RECENT DAYS AND CHARGED WITH COUNTER-REVOLUTIONARY ACTIVITIES.

IN ADDITION TO USICA EMPLOYEE REZA AMINI WHO WAS AMONG THIS GROUP, THEY INCLUDE FORMER MINISTER OF JUSTICE AND INFORMATION GHOLAM REZA KIANPOUR, FORMER EDITOR OF THE DAILY RASTAKHIZ MEHDI SEMSAR, THE LAST PRE-REVOLUTIONARY HEAD OF NIRT MASSOUD BARZIN, FORMER MAJLES DEPUTIES SEYED ALI AKBAR FIROUSABADI, MOHAMMAD DEGHAN-NEJAD AND MOHAMMAD REZA SAADATFAR, UNIVERSITY PROFESSOR IBRAHIM SHIRAZI, AND FORMER MINISTER ------------------000656 091756Z /43 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 0756 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY BONN AMEMBASSY CAIRO AMCONSUL DHAHRAN IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY DOHA AMCONSUL FRANKFURT AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS AMEMBASSY BEIJING AMEMBASSY RABAT USLO RIYADH IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY TOKYO USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE CINCPAC HONOLULU HI USDOCOSOUTH NAPLES IT SECTION 02 OF 04 TEHRAN 03678 OF JUSTICE HOSSEIN NAJAFI.

THESE PEOPLE REPORTEDLY WERE AMONG 152 INDIVIDUALS WHO ARE BEING SOUGHT BY VARIOUS REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES. THE NAMES OF THOSE STILL AT LARGE HAVE NOT BEEN RELEASED BUT ALLEGEDLY INCLUDE 27 JOURNALISTS.

FM SANJABI IN A RECENT INTERVIEW WITH A HUNGARIAN JOURNALIST SAID THAT IRAN WANTS FRIENDLY RELATIONS WITH ALL COUNTRIES OF THE WORLD, INCLUDING THE SUPERPOWERS, ON THE BASIS OF MUTUAL RESPECT AND UNDERSTANDING. HE SAID THAT THE U.S. HAD BEEN EXTREMELY SHORTSIGHTED IN ITS PREVIOUS POLICY TOWARD IRAN, BUT HE EXPRESSED THE HOPE THAT WASHINGTON IS AWARE OF ITS PAST MISTAKES AND WOULD ATTEMPT TO RECTIFY THEM. SANJABI SAID THAT IRAN WOULD NOT ALLOW ANY COUNTRY TO USE ITS TERRITORY AGAINST THE SOVIET UNION. ON CHINA, HE SAID THAT IRAN HOPED FOR GOOD RELATIONS WITHOUT TAKING A STAND ON THE QUESTION OF SINO-SOVIET RELATIONS.

KHOMEINI APPARENTLY HAS OTHER IDEAS ABOUT IRAN'S RELATIONS WITH THE OUTSIDE WORLD. ON APRIL 6 HE TOLD A LARGE GATHERING IN QOM THAT IRAN IS "STILL AT WAR WITH THE SUPERPOWERS." "RIGHT NOW," HE SAID, "BOTH THE WEST AND THE EAST ARE AGAINST US." HE SPECIFICALLY BLAMED THE U.S. FOR RECENT POLITICAL UNREST IN IRAN, SAYING "THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA HAS CERTAIN INTERESTS (IN IRAN) WHICH IT IS NOT PREPARED TO GIVE UP."

A GROUP OF SEVEN OBSCURE ORGANIZATIONS PROFESSING ADHERENCE TO ISLAM ANNOUNCED THEIR AMALGAMATION APRIL 7 FOR THE PURPOSE OF SAFEGUARDING AND EXTENDING THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTION. MEMBERS OF THE NEW ORGANIZATION REPORTEDLY WERE ADDRESSED BY KHOMEINI CONFIDENT ABOL HASSAN BANI-SADR AND PLO REPRESENTATIVE HANI AL-HASSAN. THE GROUP HAS TAKEN THE NAME OF ORGANIZATION OF THE MOJAHEDIN OF THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTION (SAZMAN-E-MOJAHEDINE-ENGHELAB-ESLAMI).

COMBINING NO LESS THAN SEVEN SMALL GROUPS (INCLUDING TOWHID-E-SAF AND MOVAHEDDIN, WHICH TOOK RESPONSIBILITY FOR ATTACKS ON AMERICANS BEFORE THE TRIUMPH OF THE REVOLUTION) IT APPARENTLY HAS NO AFFILIETION WITH THE MOJAHEDIN-E-KHALQ, BUT LIKE IT WILL BE PRIMARILY A PARAMILITARY AS OPPOSED TO A POLITICAL ORGANIZATION. WE ARE NOT SURE HOW THIS NEW GROUP MAY RELATE TO DEPUTY PM YAZDI'S PARAMILITARY GUARDIANS OF THE REVOLUTION.

THE MARXIST FEDAYIN-E-KHALQ HAVE BLASTED THE NEW ORGANIZATION. A SPOKESMAN SAID THAT THE FEDAYIN REGARD THE MOJAHEDIN OF THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTION AS NOTHING MORE THAN A TERRORIST OUTFIT. HE CHARGED THAT ONE OF THE SEVEN COMPONENT ORGANIZATIONS, TOHID, IS SIMPLY A GROUP OF "COMMON CRIMINALS AND THUGS WHO PRACTICE INTIMIDATION FOR THEIR OWN ENDS" AND "WHO DON'T KNOW ISLAM FROM ADAM."

THE FEDAYIN THEMSELVES CAME IN FOR A FEW KNOCKS OVER THE WEEKEND. A GATHERING OF SEVERAL THOUSAND, MOSTLY YOUNG PEOPLE FROM THE SLUMS OF SOUTH TEHRAN, GATHERED AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY APRIL 5 AND 6 AND DENOUNCED THE FEDAYIN AS "OPPORTUNIST HYPOCRITES." LEADERS OF THE DEMONSTRATORS CLAIMED THAT THEY HAD DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE OF FEDAYIN INVOLVEMENT IN THE RECENT ETHNIC UNREST IN KURDESTAN AND THE GONBAD KAVOUS AREA. THE DEMONSTRATORS, WITH MANY FEMALES AMONG THEM WEARING CHADORS, REPORTEDLY CLASHED WITH MEMBERS OF THE FEDAYIN NEAR THE CAMPUS MOSQUE.

ELSEWHERE, THE HOSSEINIEH ERSHAD WHERE THE REVOLUTION'S INTELLECTUAL HERO, ALI SHARIATI, USED TO HOLD FORTH, WAS OFFICIALLY REOPENED APRIL 5. THE ERSHAD REPUTEDLY SERVES AS A CENTER FOR ISLAMIC PROGRESSIVES WHO, IN ACCORDANCE WITH SHARIATI'S TEACHINGS, OPPOSE LITERAL INTERPRETATION OF THE KORAN. REPORTEDLY, ONLY ONE MULLAH OTHER THAN AYATOLLAH TALAGHANI ATTENDED THE OPENING CEREMONIES. DEPUTY PM YAZDI WAS A FEATURED SPEAKER.

THE PRESS IS QUOTING MIN. OF INT. JAVADI AS SAYING THAT ELECTIONS TO THE CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY WILL BE HELD JUNE 1. ITS MEMBERSHIP IS LIKELY TO TOTAL 350-360. JAVADI REPUTEDLY SAID THAT ALL POLITICAL PARTIES OR GROUPS WILL BE ALLOWED TO FIELD CANDIDATES AND THAT MINORITIES COULD BE REPRESENTED. FURTHER, THE DRAFT CONSTITUTION WILL BE MADE PUBLIC SOON AND THE ASSEMBLY WILL BE EMPOWERED TO MAKE AMENDMENTS TO IT.

THERE HAVE BEEN INCREASING REPORTS OF LAND GRABS IN VARIOUS PARTS OF IRAN. IT APPEARS THAT SEIZURES OF LARGE HOLDINGS OWNED BY ABSENTEE LANDLORDS BY THE TURKOMAN POPULATION IN THE GONBAD KAVOUS AREA WAS A MAJOR FACTOR IN THE RECENT DISTURBANCES THERE.

1979TEHRAN03688.subject: MEETING WITH DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER AMIR ETEZAM

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT)

I MADE A COURTESY CALL ON DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER ETEZAM ON APRIL 7 AND INFORMED HIM THAT, ON THE BASIS OF A RECENT MEETING BETWEEN THE SECRETARY AND IRAN'S NEW CHARGE IN WASHINGTON, AS WELL AS MY OWN RECENT CONVERSATIONS IN THE DEPARTMENT, THE UNITED STATES DESIRES TO NORMALIZE ITS RELATIONS WTIH IRAN AT A STEADY PACE. I NOTED THAT, DESPITE THE REVOLUTIONARY CHANGES THAT HAVE TAKEN PLACE IN IRAN, SOME SHARED BASIC INTERESTS CAN BE THE FOUNDATION FOR GOOD RELATIONS IN THE FUTURE. IRAN'S INDEPENDENCE, STABILITY, TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY AND ECONOMIC PROGRESS ARE OF SIGNIFICANT INTEREST TO THE UNITED STATES.

I ALSO TOLD HIM THAT WE HAD BEEN MAINTAINING A LOW PROFILE SINCE THE REVOLUTION FOR A NUMBER OF REASONS, MOST IMPORTANT OF WHICH WAS NOT TO EMBARRASS OR TO COMPLICATE THE LIFE OF THE NEW GOVERNMENT. I SAID THAT I WOULD APPRECIATE ANY THOUGHTS HE AND OTHERS MIGHT HAVE DURING THE PERIOD I WOULD BE CHARGE ON STEPS THAT EITHER SIDE MIGHT TAKE TO PUSH THE NORMALIZATION PROCESS FURTHER AHEAD. I SUGGESTED THAT WE HAVE FRANK DISCUSSIONS HERE AND IN WASHINGTON AND NOT LET SUSPICIONS FESTER. FOR EXAMPLE, I NOTED, SOVIET PROPAGANDA IS COVERING IRAN WITH CHARGES OF U.S.

INVOLVEMENT IN SUCH PLACES AS KURDESTAN AND TURKESTAN AND THAT SOME PARTS OF THE IRANIAN PRESS WERE REPEATING THIS VERY PROPAGANDA. AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, HIMSELF, HAD RECENTLY SAID AMERICAN AGENTS WERE RESPONSIBLE FOR THE TROUBLES IN THESE TWO AREAS. I ASKED HIM TO ASSURE THE AYATOLLAH THAT THE AMERICAN GOVERNMENT'S CENTRAL INTEREST WAS THE INDEPENDENCE AND TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY OF IRAN AND THAT WE ARE CURRENTLY DOING NOTHING,AND IN THE FUTURE WE WOULD DO NOTHING, TO DESTABILIZE THE COUNTRY.

AMIR ENTEZAM REPLIED THAT HIS GOVERNMENT ALSO WANTED A GOOD RELATIONSHIP WITH THE UNITED STATES, IN THE SAME WAY IT DESIRED GOOD RELATIONS WITH ALL COUNTRIES; THE PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN, HE NOTED, HAD RECENTLY EXPRESSED THIS SENTIMENT PUBLICLY. AT THE SAME TIME, HE SAID, THE UNITED STATES HAD TO APPRECIATE THAT FOR 25 YEARS THE U.S. HAS BEEN VERY CLOSELY ASSOCIATED WITH THE PREVIOUS MONARCHICAL REGIME AND IN 1953 HAD HELPED REVERSE THE WILL OF THE PEOPLE BY RETURNING THE SHAH TO THE THRONE. IT WAS, THEREFORE, UNDERSTANDABLE THAT EMOTIONS AGAINST THE UNITED STATES WERE WIDESPREAD AND THAT NORMALIZATION MUST BE APPROACHED CAREFULLY.
HE WAS GRATEFUL FOR THE ASSURANCE THAT USG IS NOT INVOLVED IN TROUBLESOME EVENTS MENTIONED AND HOPED THAT WERE TRUE.
OTHER SUBJECTS RAISED WITH THE DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)

PRIOR TO DEPARTING HERE FOR EUROPE AND NEW YORK, FORMER AP AND TIME-LIFE BUREAU CHIEF PARVIZ RAEIN STOPPED IN FOR A CHAT WITH POL COUNSELOR. AMONG MISCELLANEOUS ITEMS OF INTEREST HE MENTIONED WERE FOLLOWING THREE
WEAPONS ARE BEING SMUGGLED BY BOAT INTO BUSHEHR IN LARGE QUANTITIES. THEY ARE BEING SOLD TO QASHQAI TRIBESMEN AND OTHERS AT HIGH PRICES.

AS AN EXAMPLE OF ECONOMIC SLUMP, SOME 423 FACTORIES IN CITY OF RASHT (ON THE CASPIAN SEA) ARE EITHER SHUT DOWN COMPLETELY OR BARELY FUNCTIONING. RASHT HAS SOMETHING OF AN INDUSTRIAL CENTER FOR VARIETY OF ITEMS INCLUDING SHOES, CABLE, ETC.

HIS OWN THEORY AS TO THE MAIN REASON FOR THE ATTACK ON THE AMERICAN EMBASSY FEB 14, WHICH HE IS CONVINCED WAS ORDERED BY THE CENTRAL KOMITAY, WAS TO SEE IF VARIOUS WANTED MEN SUCH AS DARIUSH HOMAYOUN, HOUSHANG NAHAVANDI, MAJID MAJIJI, ETC. WERE PERHAPS HIDING ON THE COMPOUND. (COMMENT: WE WOULD ACCEPT THIS AS ONE OF A SERIES OF POSSIBLE MOTIVES FOR THE ATTACK.) NAAS

1979TEHRAN03711.subject: THREATENING LETTER OF PROBABLE SOVIET INSTIGATION

segments.text: (S - ENTIRE TEXT)

ON APRIL 8 POL COUNSELOR RECEIVED LETTER CONTAINING NEATLY PRINTED WARNING ABOUT CHINESE-AMERICAN FRIENDSHIP AND "SEVERE PUNISHMENTS" TO BE METED OUT EVEN-HANDEDLY TO "AMERICAN AGGRESSORS" AND "CHINESE AGGRESSORS." THE LETTER HAD A BLACK BORDER AROUND IT CARRYING SOME THREE DOZEN WORLD CAPITALS, IN EUROPE, ASIA, AND LATIN AMERICA, AND WAS HEADED BY THE PURPORTED NAME OF THE THREATENING ORGANIZATION: THE "SECRET TRANS-WORLD ORGANIZATION FOR PUNISHMENT." THE LETTER CAME ADDRESSED TO POL COUNSELOR BY NAME (NOT POSITION) FROM VIENNA. IT WAS MAILED THERE MARCH 6 AND RECEIVED BY POST OFFICE HERE APRIL 6.

SINCE CHINESE RELATIONSHIP WITH U.S. IS OF NOT THE SLIGHTEST INTEREST TO ANY IRANIAN TERRORIST GROUPS, THE LETTER CAN ONLY BE OF SOVIET INSPIRATION. IT HAS BEEN FORWARDED TO WASHINGTON THROUGH OTHER CHANNELS FOR MORE SPECIFIC INVESTIGATION. THE FACT THAT IT WAS ADDRESSED BY NAME TO POL COUNSELOR HERE, AMONG OTHERS, RAISES MORE GENERAL QUESTION AS TO WHETHER LOCAL SOVIET EMB IN TEHRAN HAS NOT BEEN ORCHESTRATING, OR CONTRIBUTING TO, SELECTIVE ANTI-AMERICAN INTIMIDATION CAMPAIGN OVER SOME TIME--TO GO WITH ITS ATTEMPTED INTIMIDATION OF OTHERS, REPORTED SEPARATELY. NAAS
(C - ENTIRE TEST)

SUMMARY: TRIALS, EXECUTIONS CONTINUE. GROWING UNREST AMONG THE UNEMPLOYED. SHORTAGES AND PRICE INFLATION BECOME POLITICAL ISSUES. ACCIDENTS AND SHOOT-OUTS REMAIN PROMINENT FEATURES OF LIFE IN REVOLUTIONARY IRAN. TEHRAN UNIVERSITY CHANCELLOR ATTEMPTS TO END DEMONSTRATIONS ON CAMPUS. MADANI APPOINTED GOVERNOR GENERAL OF KHUZESTAN. ENTEZAM HOLDS PRESS CONFERENCE. END SUMMARY.

NINE MORE EXECUTIONS HAVE TAKEN PLACE. A COURT PASSED DOWN DEATH SENTENCES ON FORMER AIR FORCE COMMANDER AMIR HOSSEIN RABI'I, LT. GEN. ALI MOHAMMAD KHAJENOURI, FORMER CABINET MINISTER AND GOVERNOR GENERAL OF FARS PROVINCE MANOUCHEHR AZMOUN, AND A POLICEMAN,(FNU) BALALI, IN TEHRAN EARLY APRIL 9. THE LATTER WAS CHARGED WITH MURDERING A NUMBER OF PEOPLE IN A TEHRAN MOSQUE AND BATH, BUT THE CHARGES AGAINST THE OTHER THREE WERE NOT SPECIFIED. RABI'I REPORTEDLY TOLD THE COURT THAT HE WAS SORRY HE HAD UNWITTINGLY SERVED A MAN WHOSE "EMPTINESS" ONLY BECAME KNOWN TO HIM WHEN AN AMERICAN, GEN. HUYSER, THREW HIM OUT OF IRAN BY THE TAIL.

ELSEWHERE, A POLICEMAN, MOHAMMAD BAGHER ROSTAMI, WAS FOUND GUILTY OF KILLING AN UNSPECIFIED NUMBER OF PEOPLE BY A COURT IN QOM AND WAS EXECUTED LATE APRIL 7. IN DEZFUL, SEYED KAZEM ASHRAFZADEH AND RAHMAN ABDULLAHI, A POLICEMAN, WERE EXECUTED APRIL 8. ASHRAFZADEH WAS CONVICTED OF EXPROPRIATING LAND, COLLABORATING WITH THE PAHLAVI REGIME, AND VIOLATING OTHER PEOPLE'S RIGHTS. ABDULLAHI WAS CHARGED WITH KILLING A 16-YEAR OLD YOUTH DURING AN ANTISHAH DEMONSTRATION. IN SHIRAZ, LT. HOSSEIN MOKHTARIARDAKANI AND ABDOL RASOUL SHEIKHI, A POLICEMAN, WERE EXECUTED APRIL 8. NO CHARGES WERE SPECIFIED. FINALLY, A COL.
NASER GHOLI HOUSHMAND, DESCRIBED IN THE PRESS AS THE HEAD OF SAVAK IN ISFAHAN FOR 12 YEARS, WAS SHOT WHILE ALLEGEDLY TRYING TO ESCAPE FROM GUARDS TAKING HIM FROM QOM TO ISFAHAN ON APRIL 8.

THE GOVERNMENT HAS TRIED TO PUT THE BEST FACE POSSIBLE ON THE RESUMPTION OF THE TRIALS AND EXECUTIONS, BUT ITS CHIEF SPOKESMAN, DEPUTY PM ENTEZAM, ADMITTED APRIL 8 THAT THE ISLAMIC COURTS ARE INDEPENDENT OF GOVERNMENT CONTROL. ENTEZAM SAID THAT HE HAD NOT KNOWN IN ADVANCE THAT FORMER PM HOVEYDA'S TRIAL WAS TO BE RESUMED AND ONLY LEARNED OF HIS EXECUTION WHEN HE RETURNED HOME LATE SATURDAY EVENING. NONETHELESS, HE DEFENDED THE COURT'S ACTION, SAYING THAT HOVEYDA WAS A CRIMINAL WHO DESERVED TO DIE. HE DENIED THAT PM BAZARGAN WAS OPPOSED TO CAPITAL PUNISHMENT AS SUCH.

RATHER, HE HAD OBJECTED TO THE TRIALS ON THE GROUNDS THAT THEIR CONDUCT WAS NOT GOVERNED BY ESTABLISHED RULES. NOW THAT FORMAL REGULATIONS HAVE BEEN PROMULGATED, HE SAID, THE TRIALS COULD GO FORWARD. IN RESPONSE TO A QUESTION ABOUT THE LACK OF OPENNESS OF HOVEYDA'S TRIAL, ENTEZAM POINTED OUT THAT THE COURT ADMINISTRATOR HAS AUTHORITY TO DIRECT THAT TRIALS BE HELD IN CAMERA.

WHEN HE WAS TOLD THAT A REPORTER FROM THE NEWSPAPER ETTELAAT--WHO ALSO HAPPENED TO HAVE A COMMITTEE CARD--WAS PRESENT AT HOVEYDA'S TRIAL, ENTEZAM SAID, "THEREFORE IT WAS NOT CLOSED." 1979TEHRAN03775.subject: FORMER PM HOVEYDA'S TRIAL AND REVOLUTIONARY JUSTICE

segments.text: (C-ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY: FORMER PM HOVEYDA'S TRIAL AND EXECUTION CONFIRMED THE OUTSIDE WORLD'S WORST FEARS ABOUT JUSTICE IN REVOLUTIONALY IRAN. IN THE END HE WAS CONDEMNED MORE FOR THE FOREIGN -- ESPECIALLY AMERICAN -- INFLUENCE IN IRAN HE SYMBOLIZED AND WHICH IRANIAN XENOPHOBES AND RELIGIOUS FANATICS HATE THAN FOR ANY CRIMES HE MAY HAVE ACTUALLY COMMITTED. END SUMMARY.
THE CONTINUATION OF FORMER PM HOVEYDA'S TRIAL -- SUSPENDED IN MID-MARCH WHEN PM BAZARGAN THREATENED TO RESIGN IF THE REVOLUTIONALY COURTS WERE NOT BROUGHT UNDER CONTROL

CONFIRMED THE WORST FEARS ABOUT THE CONDUCT OF JUSTICE IN TODAY'S IRAN. HOVEYDA WAS CHARGED ON 16 COUNTS, RANGING FROM CORRUPTION OF THE EARTH UNQUOTE TO CENSORSHIP OF THE PRESS, BUT HIS REAL CRIME AS PERCEIVED BY THE COURT TRYING HIM WAS THAT HE SERVED AS THE SHAH'S CHIEF MINISTER FOR THIRTEEN YEARS DURING A PERIOD WHEN FOREIGN, ESPECIALLY AMERICAN, INFLUENCE ABOUNDED IN IRAN. THE SPECIFIC CHARGES WERE ALMOST INCIDENTAL.

INDEED, THE COURT ADMINISTRATOR, A MULLAH, BRUSHED ASIDE HOVEYDA'S DEFENSE OF HIS ACTIONS ON SUCH MATTERS AS RICE PURCHASES AND COPPER SALES BY SAYING THAT THE COURT HAD NO REASON TO DOUBT HIS WORD ON THESE MATTERS BUT THAT IT WOULD NOT BE DIVERTED FROM THE REAL ISSUES BY HOVEYDA'S RECITATION OF FACTUAL DETAILS.

HOVEYDA APPARENTLY RECOGNIZED THE SITUATION HE CONFRONTED. HE TOLD THE COURT THAT IF IT WAS LOOKING FOR A VICTIM, HE WOULD HAVE NOTHING FURTHER TO SAY. HE EXPRESSED HIS HOPE, HOWEVER, THAT ITS DECISION WOULD BE BASED UPON ISLAMIC JUSTICE, AND THAT IF THAT WERE THE CASE, HE WAS FULLY PREPARED TO ACCEPT ITS VERDICT.

HOVEYDA COMPLAINED ABOUT NOT BEING INFORMED OF THE CHARGES AGAINST HIM UNTIL HE WAS BROUGHT BEFORE THE COURT, OF NOT HAVING ACCESS TO COUNSEL, OF NOT HAVING AN OPPORTUNITY TO PREPARE HIS DEFENSE, OF HIS HAVING BEEN HELD INCOMMUNICADO, AND HE DID ATTEMPT TO DEAL WITH THE SPECIFICS OF SOME OF THE CHARGES AGAINST HIM, BUT HIS PRIMARY DEFENSE WAS IN MANY RESPECTS A BOLD PHILOSOPHICAL APPEAL TO THE COURT.

SCOFFING AT CHARGES THAT HE WAS SIMPLY A STOOGE PUT IN OFFICE BY THE AMERICAN EMBASSY AND DICTATED TO BY THE CIA, HOVEYDA ATTEMPTED TO PORTRAY HIMSELF AS JUST ONE ELEMENT -- ADMITTEDLY A VERY IMPORTANT ONE-- OF A SYSTEM THAT WAS CORRUPT. HE WAS NO MORE GUILTY OR INNOCENT, HE SUGGESTED,THAN ANY OTHER IRANIAN WHO HAD GONE ALONG WITH IT AND MOST IRANIANS, HE POINTED OUT, HAD GONE ALONG WITH IT. IT WAS AN EASY THING TO DO BECAUSE IT POSSESSED A FORMALIZED STRUCTURE. THERE WAS A CONSTITUTION, A PARLIAMENT,A CHIEF OF STATE, AND ALL PARTS SEEMED TO RELATE TO ONE ANOTHER.

IT POSSESSED A FATAL FLAW, HOWEVER, IN THAT IT DID NOT PROVIDE FOR ADEQUATE LINKS OF RESPONSIBILITY CONNECTING THE COMPONENT PARTS. WHILE NOMINALLY HIS ADVISOR, THE CHIEF OF SAVAK DID NOT ANSWER TO HIM. NEITHER DID THE MILITARY. EVEN HIS OWN MINISTERS WERE NOT FULLY ACCOUNTABLE TO HIM. HOVEYDA SAID HE WAS READY TO ACCEPT HIS RESPONSIBILITY FOR HIS OWN MISTAKES, BUT REGARDED IT UNJUST THAT HE BE BLAMED FOR ERRORS OVER WHICH HE HAD NO CONTROL.

THE COURT REJECTED HIS DEFENSE. IN ITS EYES THERE WAS NOTHING LUDICROUS IN FINDING HOVEYDA GUILTY OF BEING A MASON AND THE SECRETARY GENERAL OF THE RASTAKHIZ PARTY. THERE WAS NO NEED TO PROVE THAT HE HAD DESTROYED IRAN'S AGRICULTURE, THAT UNDER HIS DIRECTION IRAN HAD BORROWED MONEY FROM THE U.S.

1979TEHRAN03815.subject: IRANIAN AND BRITISH VIEWS ON CENTO

segments.text: (C-ENTIRE TEXT)
BRITISH EMBASSY CHARGE MIERS TALKED WITH MFA'S PANAHI APRIL 9. PANAHI INDICATED IRANIANS DIFFER SOMEWHAT WITH BRITISH AS TO WHAT SHOULD BE DONE NEXT.

ACCORDING TO MIERS, IRANIANS ARE AGAINST ANY FURTHER MEETINGS OF PERMANENT COUNCIL. INSTEAD THEY HAVE PROPOSED AN EARLY MEETING OF EXPERTS OF MEMBERS OF THE BAGHDAD PACT (I.E. EXCLUDING THE U.S.) TO DISCUSS LIQUIDATION OF THE SECRETARIAT. AS A CONCESSION TO THE TURKS, IRANIANS HAVE AGREED THIS COULD BE MEETING OF GOVERNMENT REPRESENTATIVESUNQUOTE RATHER THAN EXPERTS UNQUOTE. IRANIANS PROPOSE TO INCLUDE USG ONLY AFTER THIS FIRST MEETING.

MIERS RECOGNIZED POL COUNSELOR'SPOINT THAT U.S. HAS PERSONNEL IN CENTO ORGANIZATION AND SOME FINANCIAL RESPONSIBILITIES. HE WAS SURE IRANIANS ALSO AWARE OF THIS. HE THOUGHT MOST URGENT THING, HOWEVER, IS TO GET SOME SORT OF MEETING ORGANIZED, PROBABLY IN ANKARA, SO THAT ACTION GETS STARTED. HE WAS AFRAID THAT OTHERWISE PERSONS WHO WISH TO CONTINUE THEIR OWN JOBS AS LONG AS POSSIBLE (SUCH AS CENTO SYG) MIGHT DELAY WRAP-UP OF ORGANIZATION. MIERS HAS URGED SPEEDY ACTION ALSO ON ARDALAN OF FOREIGN MINISTER SANJABI'S OFFICE, WHO AGREES.
EMBASSY LONDON MAY WISH PASS ABOVE TO FCO. NAAS

1979TEHRAN03859.subject: MEETING WITH DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER YAZDI

segments.text: SUPJ: MEETING WITH DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER YAZDI (C-ENTIRE TEXT THIS IS A REPORTING MESSAGE.)

SUMMARY: CHARGE OUTLINED U.S. DESIRE TO NORMALIZE RELATIONS AND SPEAK FRANKLY ABOUT PROBLEMS. YAZDI, NOTING U.S. INVOLVEMENT WITH PAST REGIME, EMPHASIZED LETTING PAST GO, COOPERATING IN CERTAIN AREAS, AND HAVING NEW AMBASSADOR WHO UNDERSTOOD IRAN AND IRANIAN REVOLUTION. END SUMMARY.

CHARGE ACCOMPANIED BY ACTING POL CHIEF STEMPEL CALLED ON DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER YAZDI AT HIS OFFICE APRIL 12. THIS CABLE COVERS GENERAL PRESENTATION; SEPTELS (NOTAL) WILL DEAL WITH OTHER SPECIFIC MATTERS.

CHARGE OPENED BY NOTING HE HAD JUST RETURNED FROM CONSULTATIONS AND WOULD BE IN CHARGE UNTIL NEW AMBASSADOR ARRIVED. HE EXPRESSED USG DESIRE TO NORMALIZE RELATIONS AS CONDITIONS PERMIT AND NOTED THERE WERE SEVERAL SHARED INTERESTS WHICH OFFERED OPPORTUNITY FOR U.S. AND IRAN TO WORK TOGETHER. U.S. GOALS WERE SIMPLE: WE WANT TO SEE IRAN MAINTAIN ITS TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY, REMAIN INDEPENDENT OF FOREIGN POLITICAL DOMINATION AND DEVELOP ECONOMICALLY. TOUCHING ON PROBLEM OF PAST TIES TO OLD REGIME, CHARGE SAID U.S. HAS NO ULTERIOR MOTIVES AND DOES NOT WISH TO EMBARRASS NEW GOVERNMENT BYE PRESSING RECONCILIATION. USG WOULD BE RESPONSIBLE TO IRANIAN WISHES.

HE SOLICITED ANY SUGGESTIONS YAZDI MIGHT HAVE ON STEPS THAT MIGHT BE TAKEN IN THIS DIRECTION, AND URGED DEPUTY PM TO BRING TO HIS ATTENTION ANY PROBLEMS OR CHARGES AGAINST U.S. CHARGE EMPHASIZED IT IS BETTER TO DISCUSS FRANKLY THAN TO LET PROBLEMS FESTER.

YAZDI RESPONDED THAT ONE GREAT OBSTACLE TO NORMALIZING IRANO-US TIES WAS INDEED YOUR DEEP INVOLVEMENT WITH PREVIOUS REGIME UNQUOTE. HE MOVED SWIFTLY TO MORE POSITIVE TACK, NOTING THAT GOVERNMENT IS READY TO NORMALIZE WHEN U.S. DEGREE OF RESPONSIVENESS TO CORRECT PROBLEMS OF PAST UNQUOTE (UNSPECIFIED) WAS CLEAR. PAST IS PAST, HE SAID, AND IRANIANS ARE PRAGMATIC. THERE ARE MANY AREAS FOR COOPERATION. IRAN WILL IN DUE COURSE NEED U.S. TECHNOLOGY AND AGRICULTURAL PRODUCTS. NORMAL RELATIONS WOULD BE BASED ON MUTUAL RESPECT.

IN THIS CONNECTION, YAZDI SAID APPOINTMENT OF NEW AMBASSADOR WAS A VERY POSITIVE STEP, ESPECIALLY IF HE IS SOMEONE WHO UNDERSTANDS THE NEW GOVERNMENT AND THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION.UNQUOTE CHARGE ASSURED HIM NEW APPOINTEE WOULD BE THAT KIND OF PERSON. (COMMENT: IF YAZDI HAS BEEN INFORMED OF APRIL 11 REQUEST FOR AGREMENT, HE GAVE NO HINT OF IT.) YAZDI THEN ADDED THAT NEW APPOINTEE SHOULD HAVE HAD MINIMUM ANTIREVOLUTIONARY INVOLVEMENT IN OTHER COUNTRIES. UNQUOTE CABINET AND RELIGIOUS LEADERS, INCLUDING KHOMEINI, ARE READY FOR NORMALIZATION AS BASIC STEPS ARE TAKEN.
DISCUSSION THEN TURNED TO QUESTION OF REVOLUTIONARY COURTS AND OTHER SPECIFIC ITEMS (BEING REPORTED SEPTELS).

1979TEHRAN03873.subject: YAZDI MEETING: CASE OF REZA AMINI

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY: CHARGE RAISED MATTER OF ARRESTED USICA EMPLOYEE REZA AMINI. YAZDI REPLIED AMINI WAS UNDER SUSPICION OF HAVING HELD MEETINGS OF ANTI-REVOLUTIONARIES IN HIS HOUSE AT WHICH AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN WAS PRESENT. U.S. SIDE WAS VIRTUALLY CERTAIN THIS COULD NOT BE TRUE, AND BOTH YAZDI AND CHARGE AGREE TO GATHER MORE FACTS. END SUMMARY.
AT MEETING BETWEEN YAZDI, CHARGE AND ACTING POL CHIEF APRIL 12, CHARGE RAISED SUBJECT OF INCARCERATION OF REZA AMINI, USICA EMPLOYEE OF 31 YEARS WHO WAS ARRESTED LAST WEEK.

YAZDI SAID HE HAD REVIEWED CASE IN GENERAL WAY, AMINI WAS CHARGED WITH HOLDING MEETING IN HIS HOME SINCE REVOLUTION OCCURRED AT WHICH AMB SULLIVAN HAD BEEN PRESENT FOR TALKS WITH ANTI-REVOLUTIONARY FORCES. PERHAPS ONE OR TWO SUCH MEETINGS HAD TAKEN PLACE. CHARGE AND ACTING POL CHIEF IMMEDIATELY AND VIGOROUSLY SAID THIS WAS IMPOSSIBLE. AMB SULLIVAN HAD NOT TO BEST OUR KNOWLEDGE BEEN AT AMINI'S HOUSE SINCE SUCCESS OF REVOLUTION. YAZDI SAID HE WAS NOT VOUCHING FOR ACCURACY OF CHARGES.

IN RESPONSE TO QUESTION, HE SAID MATTER HAD BEEN RAISED BY MEHDI SIMSAR, EDITOR OF RASTAKHIZ, FORMER PAPER OF IRANS SINGLE PARTY, WHO CLAIMED TO HAVE BEEN AT MEETING ALONG WITH KARIM MOTAMEDI, EX-MINISTER OF POSTS, AND A FEW OTHERS. NAAS
(C-ENTIRE TEXT - THIS IS A REPORTING MESSAGE)

AT APRIL 12 MEETING WITH YAZDI, CHARGE RAISED MATTER OF EMBASSY COMPOUND SECURITY AND OCCASIONAL CONFLICTS BETWEEN ELEMENTS OF THREE PROTECTING UNITS. YAZDI, WHO WAS OBVIOUSLY ALREADY INFORMED OF PROBLEMS, SAID HE WAS IN PROCESS OF WORKING OUT NEW ARRANGEMENT WHICH WOULD PROVIDE FOR UNIT (PROBABLY ARMY) WITH SINGLE CHAIN OF COMMAND TO PROTECT COMPOUND. HE SAID FIRST STEP WAS TO HAVE TWO IRREGULAR FORCES LEAVE; HE INTENDED TO ORDER GROUP AT AMBASSADOR'S RESIDENCE TO DEPART SOONEST. IN RESPONSE TO CHARGE'S SUGGESTION THAT TRUSTED LIASON OFFICER BE APPOINTED FROM YAZDI'S OFFICE, DEPUTY PRIMIN SAID HE WOULD INTRODUCE LIASON OFFICIALS TO EMBASSY WITHIN NEXT FEW DAYS.
THEY WOULD WORK WITH EMBASSY ON SECURITY MATTERS AS WELL AS CONTINUING PROBLEMS WITH RECOVERY, PACKING, AND TRANSPORTATION OF HOUSEHOLD GOODS.
COMMENT: WE HOPE IT WORKS OUT* NAAS
(C - ENTIRE TEXT -- THIS IS A REPORTING MESSAGE)

SUMMARY: CHARGE EXPRESSED U.S. CONCERN WITH SUMMARY NATURE OF TRIALS AND EXECUTIONS. YAZDI ACCEPTED CRITICISM, SAID GOVERNMENT WAS TRYING TO IMPROVE SYSTEM OF JUSTICE, BUT PUBLIC ANGER WAS SUCH THAT NEW GOVERNMENT HAD DIFFICULTY KEEPING REVOLUTIONARIES FROM KILLING FORMER OFFICIALS IN STREETS. TO UNDERLINE HIS POINT, HE SHOWED CHARGE SET OF GRUESOME PHOTOS FROM "OLD SAVAK FILES" OF PERSONS TORTURED TO DEATH AS EVIDENCE OF WHAT PEOPLE WERE MAD ABOUT. THE GOVERNMENT'S PROBLEM WAS IN CONVINCING REVOLUTIONARIES TO MAKE EVIDENCE PUBLIC. YAZDI ALSO NOTED THAT COUNTER REVOLUTIONARIES WERE AT WORK, AND SAID GOVERNMENT HAD ALREADY GOT KHOMEINI ARGEEMENT TO HUMANITARIAN CLEMENCY AND SENTENCING POLICY. IMPLEMENTATION AWAITED RIGHT POLITICAL MOMENT.
END SUMMARY.

AFTER PRESENTATION OF U.S. VIEWS ON TIES WITH NEW REGIME (REF A), CHARGE TURNED TO DISCUSSION OF REVOLUTIONARY TRIALS IN SPIRIT OF FRANK AND FRIENDLY DISCUSSION OF PROBLEMS. DRAWING ON REF B GUIDANCE, CHARGE EXPRESSED CONCERN BEING FELT BY MANY IN U.S., PARTICULARLY THOSE WHO HAD SUPPORTED IRANIAN REVOLUTION, AT ACTION OF ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COURTS. THIS REACTION COULD SLOW DOWN PROCESS OF NORMALIZATION. JUST AS IRANIAN REVOLUTIONARIES SUSPECT U.S. OF CERTAIN THINGS, AMERICANS AND OTHER WESTERN NATIONS ARE DISHEARTED BY THIS APPARENT WARPING OF REVOLUTION AND THIS GENERATES QUESTIONS ABOUT REAL INTENTIONS OF REVOLUTIONARIES.

CHARGE EXPRESSED USG AND PERSONAL HOPE THAT REVOLUTIONARY TRIALS AND EXECUTIONS COULD STOP AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. U.S. INTEREST WAS HUMANITARIAN AND DID NOT REFLECT CONCLUSIONS OF GUILT OR INNOCENCE OF SPECIFIC INDIVIDUALS. RECALLING THAT DEPUTY PM HAD FLED IRAN BECAUSE OF HIS OPPOSITION TO THE SHAH'S REGIME AND LATER RETURNED TO SERVE HIS COUNTRY, CHARGE EXPRESSED HOPE THAT REVOLUTIONARY EXCESSES WOULD NOT BE ALLOWED TO ALIENATE ANOTHER GENERATION FROM PARTICIPATION IN NATIONAL LIFE. NOW IS THE TIME, HE SAID, FOR NATIONAL HEALING AND MERCY.

YAZDI WAS VERY FORTHCOMING. HE SAID HE UNDERSTOOD PROBLEM, MANY PEOPLE HAD EXPRESSED SAME THOUGHTS TO GOVERNMENT. AT THIS POINT HE WENT TO HIS DESK AND WITHDREW A FILE CONTAINING 50 OR 60 SHEETS OF PAPER WITH PICTURES ATTACHED. YAZDI SAID THESE WERE SAVAK FILES WHICH HAD BEEN CAPTURED BY REVOLUTION AND SHOWED BEFOREAND-AFTER RESULTS OF TORTURE ON MANY INDIVIDUALS. THESE, HE SAID, EXPLAIN WHY GOVERNMENT HAS SUCH DIFFICULTY KEEPING REVOLUTIONARIES FROM KILLING OLD REGIME'S OFFICIALS IN STREETS. (COMMENT: PHOTOS, WHICH SEEMED AUTHENTIC, WERE GRUESOME SET OF EVIDENCE SHOWING MANGLED AND TORTURED BODIES.

YAZDI CLEARLY HAS EFFECTIVE TACTIC HERE.) YAZDI SAID REVOLUTIONARY COURTS HAD SEEN SUCH PHOTOS AND IT WAS DIFFICULT TO COUNSEL LENIENCY IN WAKE OF SUCH EVIDENCE OF ATROCITIES BY OLD REGIME. GOVERNMENT WAS TRYING TO GET TRIALS INSTITUTIONALIZED TO PREVENT WORST EXCESSES OF REVENGE IN THE STREETS AND HOMES. YAZDI RECOUNTED ONE INCIDENT WHERE EX-SAVAK OFFICER IN ISFAHAN HAD BEEN TORTURED TO DEATH BY REVOLUTIONARY SOLDIERS. WHEN YAZDI SUMMONED SOLDIER TO HIS PRESENCE FOR EXPLANATION, SOLDIER SHOWED HIM HIS OWN MARRED BODY AND SAID HE HAD JUST DONE TO HIS TORMENTOR WHAT HAD BEEN DONE TO HIM.

ON QUESTION OF EVIDENCE, YAZDI SAID THERE WAS AMPLE EVIDENCE LINKING MANY FROM PAST, INCLUDING SOME WHO WERE THOUGHT TO BE "CLEAN"AND ABOVE REPROACH WITH EXCESSES. BAZARGAN, ETEZAM AND YAZDI PERSONALLY OBJECTED TO WAY KHOMEINI COMMITTEE WAS HANDLING MATTER OF SUMMARY JUSTICE. PGOI WAS WORKING TO TRY AND IMPROVE SITUATION. CHARGE EXPRESSED UNDERSTANDING OF PROBLEM, BUT SAID KILLING SOMEONE LIKE KHALATBARI WHO WAS MERELY TECHNICIAN WAS NOT ONLY EXCESSIVE BUT GAVE GOVERNMENT NEEDLESS BAD IMAGE ABROAD.

YAZDI READILY ADMITTED EXECUTIONS OF KHALATBARI, MAJLES SPEAKER RIAZI AND SENATOR VAHIDI "WERE PERHAPS EXCESSIVE," BUT ASKED "WHERE DO YOU DRAW THE LINE?" ACTING POL CHIEF SUGGESTED THAT PRESENTATION OF EVIDENCE IN PUBLIC TRIAL WAS PARTICULARLY CRITICAL IN CASES SUCH AS THESE. YAZDI SAID THIS WAS CRUX OF GOVERNMENT'S ARGUMENT WITH KHOMEINI HIMSELF.

DEPUTY PM THEN WENT ON TO NOTE THAT TRIALS WERE IN PART POLITICAL -- MANY AGENTS AND OFFICIALS OF OLD REGIME WERE STIRRING UP TROUBLE AND ACTIVELY ATTACKING REVOLUTIONARY FORCES. 1979TEHRAN03881.subject: THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT AND THE FUTURE

segments.text: (S-ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY: WE EXPECT THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT TO SLOG ALONG FOR SOME TIME YET, GRADUALLY GETTING MORE CONTROL OF THE COUNTRY'S AFFAIRS BUT WITH NO DRAMATIC IMPROVEMENTS. A MAJOR THREAT WILL ARISE IN THE FORM OF ECONOMIC DISAFFECTION, PARTICULARLY AMONG THE THREE TO FOUR MILLION UNEMPLOYED. THE GOVERNMENT WILL TRY TO CONTAIN THIS BY STRESSING THE VIRTUES OF THE ISLAMIC SIMPLE LIFE, CONTINUING TO BLAME THE SHAH AND FOREIGNERS FOR ECONOMIC PROBLEMS, BUT ALSO FINDING A MEANS OF GETTING MONEY TO WORKERS THROUGH UNEMPLOYMENT COMPENSATION, MAKE-WORK PROJECTS, AND START UP UNQUOTE CREDITS TO INDUSTRY.

KHOMEINI'S INFLUENCE (IF HE LIVES) SHOULD PREVENT THE OVERTHROW OF THE GOVERNMENT BY VIOLENCE OF LEFT OR RIGHT WHILE THE REVOLUTION RUNS ITS COURSE. IN TIME, A NEW AUTHORITARIAN GOVERNMENT MIGHT BE EXPECTED TO SEIZE THE REINS OF GOVERNMENT, BUT THAT IS FAR IN THE FUTURE, AFTER THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT HAS HAD ITS DAY IN THE SUN. THIS ESTIMATE IS CONSIDERED OPTIMISTIC IN SOME OF ITS JUDGEMENTS BY SOME OF THE REPORTING OFFICERS AT POST. IT MAY HAVE TO BE REVISED IN A FEW WEEKS TIME.

ITS MAIN PURPOSE AT THIS TIME, HOWEVER, IS TO TAKE ISSUE WITH CERTAIN WASHINGTON ESTIMATES WE HAVE SEEN WHICH SUGGEST THE HIGH PROBABILITY OF A LEFTIST OR COMMUNIST TAKEOVER OF POWER IN IRAN IN THE VERY NEAR FUTURE. WE DO NOT RATE THAT AS ANYTHING MORE THAN AN EXTREMELY UNLIKELY POSSIBILITY IF EVERYTHING REPEAT EVERYTHING GOES WRONG. END SUMMARY.

THE REFERENDUM CREATING AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC WAS HELD ON MARCH 30 - 31 AS SCHEDULED AND TOOK PLACE PEACEFULLY DESPITE DIRE PREDICTIONS THAT (A) IT WOULD BE FURTHER POSTPONED AND (B) THERE WOULD BE ARMED TROUBLE. WE HAVE HEARD FROM A FRENCH EMBASSY SOURCE THE REPORT THAT KHOMEINI INSISTED THE REFERENDUM BE HELD AS SCHEDULED, THREATENING TO CALL OUT THE PEOPLE FOR MARCHES IN THE MILLIONS AS A SUBSTITUTE, IF THE ELECTION OFFICIALS REFUSED TO HOLD IT THEN. THIS RINGS TRUE. IT MAY ALSO EXPLAIN THE PADDING OF FIGURES REGARDING TOTAL VOTER TURNOUT BY THE ELECTION OFFICIALS AFTERWARD. WE HAVE REPORTED ON THE REFERENDUM BY SEPTEL.
IN THIS CABLE WE PAUSE TO CONSIDER WHERE THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT STANDS AND WHERE IT MIGHT BE GOING.

IT IS BEST TO START WITH CERTAIN THINGS WE KNOW: --A. AS REVOLUTIONARIES, BAZARGAN AND HIS PEOPLE ARE BASICALLY CONSERVATIVES. AMONG BAZARGAN'S CLOSEST COWORKERS, YAZDI APPEARS THE MOST RADICAL, BUT THAT PROBABLY STEMS FROM THE ROLE HE IS PLAYING AS A BRIDGE BETWEEN THE GOVERNMENT AND THE COMMITTEES. --B. THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT HAS MANY OTHER CONSERVATIVE LEADERS (SHARIATMADARI ET AL) AS WELL AS SOME A SHADE LESS CONSERVATIVE (TALEGHANI) AND SOME QUITE RADICAL IN THEIR SOCIAL IDEAS WHILE FANATICAL IN THEIR RELIGION. (A PORTION OF THE MUJAHEDEEN -- THE COLLEGE EDUCATED ONES). KHOMEINI AND HIS CLOSEST AIDES SUCH AS DR.

BEHESHTI DESIRE PUNISHMENT OF PAST MALEFACTORS AND A RETURN TO ISLAMIC FUNDAMENTALISM, BUT ALSO SHARE MANY CONSERVATIVE AIMS. THEY CONTINUE TO APPEAL TO THE MORE RADICAL REVOLUTIONARIES EVEN WHILE PERMITTING THE GOVERNMENT TO CARRY OUT A FAIRLY CONSERVATIVE POLICY. AS A MEASURE OF THIS UNDERLYING CONSERVATISM, LET US RECALL THAT KHOMEINI, TALEGHANI, SHARIATMADARI, AND THE OTHERS ARE ALL (A) FIERCELY ANTI-COMMUNIST AND (B) FOR RECONSTRUCTION OF A NATIONAL ARMY, DEFINED AS ONE THAT WILL OBEY THEM, NOT THE SHAH. THERE IS UNDERLYING STRAIN BETWEEN BAZARGAN AND KHOMEINI -- WHICH NO DOUBT EXPLAINS BAZARGAN'S THREAT (TO NOUVEL OBSERVATEUR UNQUOTE) TO REFUSE CANDIDACY FOR PRESIDENT OF THE REPUBLIC UNDER THE NEW CONSTITUTION.

BUT KHOMEINI AND BAZARGAN NEED EACH OTHER, AND WE THINK DIFFERENCES WILL BE PATCHED UP TO PERMIT BAZARGAN TO RUN AND BE ELECTED PRESIDENT. --C. THE MULLAHS OVERWHELMINGLY CONTROL THE MASSES, AND THEY ARE IN TURN LARGELY CONTROLLED BY VARIOUS AYATOLLAHS. KHOMEINI HAS PARAMOUNT CONTROL FOR THE MOMENT, BUT OTHERS SUCH AS TALEGHANI OR SHARIATMADARI RETAIN CONSIDERABLE RESIDUAL INFLUENCE. --D. THE LEFT WING HAS NO MASS FOLLOWING.

THE LEFT WING HAS NO MASS FOLLOWING. THE TUDEH IS WEAK, OTHER COMMUNISTS AND MARXISTS ARE ANTI-SOVIET, AND THE CHARIK FEDAYEEN GUERRILLAS ARE ONLY BEGINNING TO ORGANIZE POLITICALLY; THEY ARE YOUNG, MOSTLY COLLEGE-EDUCATED, WELL-ORGANIZED, AND ARMED, BUT THEIR POLITICAL FOLLOWING IS MINISCULE COMPARED TO THE RELIGIOUS MOVEMENT. --E.

FINALLY, KHOMEINI BY HIS FRUGAL LIVING WITH LITTLE MATERIAL WEALTH AND HIS EMPHASIS ON MORAL VALUES IS SETTING AN EXAMPLE FOR THE GOVERNMENT AND COUNTRY TO FOLLOW. THE PRIME MINISTER, THE HEAD OF NIOC, AND VARIOUS OTHER HIGH CIVIL SERVANTS HAVE OR ARE IN THE PROCESS OF ANNOUNCING CUTS IN THEIR SALARIES. THIS IS A MOVE WHICH SEEMS INTENDED AS A PRECEDENT TO BE FOLLOWED BY MORE AND MORE OF THE FAITHFUL. IF IT CATCHES ON AS A POLICY IT SHOULD DO MUCH MORE TO DEFUSE THE POTENTIALLY EXPLOSIVE ECONOMIC SITUATION.

A GENERAL DEFLATION OF THE ECONOMY (LOWER RENTS, LOWER TAXES, PERHAPS EVENTUALLY LOWER PRICES) IS INTENDED AS A COMPANION MEASURE. ALSO, CALLS FOR CONTRIBUTIONS FROM THE WELL-TO-DO HAVE BEGUN WITH KHOMEINI'S REQUEST FOR SUCH HELP IN BUILDING HOUSING FOR THE POOR. ADDITIONAL CALLS CAN BE EXPECTED.

ON THE OTHER HAND THERE ARE SOME THINGS WE DO NOT YET KNOW: --A. WHEN WILL KHOMEINI DIE? IF THAT OCCURS SOON IT IS CONCEIVABLE THAT THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT WILL SUFFER SEVERE INTERNAL PANGS OF LEADERSHIP, WHICH ITS OPPONENTS OF THE LEFT -- BUT ALSO PERHAPS OF A RENASCENT MONARCHICAL RIGHT -- COULD EXPLOIT. --B. HOW DEEPLY ARE MARXISTS DUG IN AMONG SKILLED WORKERS IN THE OIL FIELDS AND ELSEWHERE? EVIDENCE TO DATE SUGGESTS A PROBLEM THERE. BUT NOT ONE THAT IS INSUPERABLE FOR THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT. ARE THE ROOTS SECRETLY MUCH DEEPER THAN WE THINK?

THAT IS A POSSIBILITY WE CANNOT DISMISS UNTIL WE HAVE MORE EVIDENCE ONE WAY OR THE OTHER. --C. WHAT ROLE WILL THE UNARMED BUT SKILLED BOURGEOISIE PLAY IN THE FRAMING OF THE CONSTITUTION AND THE PARLIAMENTARY ELECTIONS TO FOLLOW? SO FAR MANY OF THEM SYMPATHIZE WITH THE AIMS OF MAIIN DAFTARY'S NATIONAL DEMOCRATIC FRONT OR ARE MEMBERS OF LIKE MINDED GROUPS WHO FEAR LONG-TERM DOMINATION BY THE MULLAHS AS MUCH AS A COMMUNIST TAKEOVER.

IF THIS INFLUENTIAL CLASS IS NOT ------------------058272 131149Z /12 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 0855 INFO USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY CAIRO AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS AMEMBASSY RABAT AMEMBASSY TEL AVIV SECTION 03 OF 04 TEHRAN 03881 INTEGRATED INTO THE FRUITS OF THE REVOLUTION, THE COUNTRY'S ECONOMY WILL SUFFER EVEN MORE THAN OTHERWISE AND THE LEFTISTS WILL APPEAR STRONGER THROUGH A TACIT ALLIANCE WITH THESE MODERATES AGAINST THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT AND ITS (BAZARGAN'S) GOVERNMENT.

WHAT DO THESE FACTORS AMOUNT TO? --A. FIRST, THE PROBABILITY THAT BAZARGAN WILL SLOG ALONG MAKING SLOW PROGRESS TOWARD ONE GOAL AFTER ANOTHER (THE CONSTITUTION, A NEW PARLIAMENT, RECONSTRUCTION OF A VIABLE ARMY, ETC). THE REALITY OF KHOMEINI'S AND THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT'S POWER WILL SHEILD BAZARGAN FROM SERIOUS DAMAGE BY POTENTIAL LEFTIST OR RIGHTIST VIOLENCE. WE SHOULD NOT LOOK FOR ANY DRAMATIC BREAKTHROUGHS IN SECURITY, EFFICIENCY OR SOCIAL STABILITY AND HAPPINESS, HOWEVER. THIS PROCESS IS LIKELY TO CONTINUE FOR MANY MONTHS, PERHAPS EVEN YEARS. AS LONG AS HE REMAINS HEALTHY AND DOES NOT WEARY, THERE IS NO SUBSTITUTE FOR BAZARGAN AS P.M. --B.

WITH MANY PEOPLE STILL BELIEVING THAT THE REVOLUTION MUST CONTINUE, PRESSURE WILL REMAIN ON KHOMEINI AND INDEED BAZARGAN TO MAKE APPROPRIATE NOISES AND REVOLUTIONARY UNQUOTE DECLARATIONS (SOME OF THEM IN FOREIGN AFFAIRS, BUT MOST AT HOME) TO PREVENT TOO RAPID DISILLUSIONMENT OF THEIR ERSTWHILE FOLLOWERS. THE MOBS HAVE BEEN STIRRED UP TO SHAKE THE EDIFICE UNTIL THE SHAH TOPPLED; NOW THEY MUST BE COAXED SLOWLY, GRADUALLY TO GO BACK TO WHAT THEY WERE DOING. IN MANY CASES THIS WILL MEAN FINDING NEW THINGS FOR MANY TO DO -- SUCH AS ENROLLING THEM IN THE NEW ARMY OR REVOLUTIONARY GUARD. --C.

THE SHORTCOMINGS OF THE ECONOMY, AND LACK OF MATERIAL REWARDS FOR THE CHILDREN OF THE REVOLUTIOO, WILL UNDOUBTABLY KEEP POTENTIAL TROUBLE BREWING, PARTICULARLY IN AREAS OF THE ECONOMY (SOME STILL TO BE IDENTIFIED) WHERE A COMMUNIST OR OTHER LEFT WING ORGANIZATION IS ESTABLISHED AMONG THE WORKERS. THIS IS POTENTIALLY THE MOST DANGEROUS ISSUE, WHICH COULD BRING DOWN THE GOVERNMENT. WE SUSPECT, HOWEVER, THAT SUCH GRUMBLING WILL NOT REACH CRITICAL PROPORTIONS BECAUSE OF THE COUNTER-ACTION OF THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT, WHICH IS PREACHING A SIMPLER, PIOUS LIFE FREE FROM THE CORRUPTING EFFECTS OF WESTERN-INSPIRED MATERIALISM. --D. IT IS IMPORTANT IN THIS CONNECTION, THOUGH, THAT EVERY ABLE-BODIED MAN HAVE SOME SORT OF INCOME.

THE PROBLEM OF UNEMPLOYMENT WILL HAVE TO BE SOLVED -- PROBABLY BY JERRY-RIGGING AND AD HOC SOLUTIONS WHICH AMOUNT IN THE AGGREGATE TO LESS EFFICIENCY OF THE ECONOMY AS A WHOLE AND MORE UNDER-EMPLOYMENT. THIS REALITY WILL BE EXCUSED WITH THE GOVERNMENT'S ASSERTION THAT IT HAS PRODUCED GREATER ISLAMIC SOCIAL JUSTICE AND POPULAR HAPPINESS. ------------------058222 131150Z /14 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 0856 INFO USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY CAIRO AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS AMEMBASSY RABAT AMEMBASSY TEL AVIV SECTION 04 OF 04 TEHRAN 03881 --E.

AS PART OF THE PROCESS MENTIONED ABOVE, WE SHOULD EXPECT A GREAT DEAL OF EXPERIMENTATION, MUCH BACKING AND FILLING BOTH IN POLITICS AND IN ECONOMICS. THIS IS ONLY NATURAL IN A COUNTRY WHICH LACKS EXPERIENCE IN MODERN POLITICAL INSTITUTIONS, WITH A GOVERNMENT WHICH REJECTS THE VIRTUES OF MODERN ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AS PRACTICED IN THE WEST. THE SPECTRE OF A NEW AUTHORITARIANISM WILL REMAIN EVER PRESENT ON THE HORIZON, AS PEOPLE BATTLE WITH FRUSTRATION AND THE CROSS-CURRENTS OF COMPETING EASTERN AND WESTERN CULTURAL VALUES.
