1979TEHRAN03910.subject: REQUEST FOR AGREMENT FOR IRANIAN AMBASSADOR TO U.S.

segments.text: ACTING POL SECTION HEAD WAS CALLED TO MFA APRIL 14 TO RECEIVE PGOI DIPLOMATIC NOTE REQUESTING AGREMENT FOR REZA SADR, PRESENT MINISTER OF COMMERCE, TO BE AMBASSADOR TO U.S. NOTE INCLUDED FOLLOWING BIODATA (INFORMAL TRANSLATION FROM FARSI): DR. REZA SADR, 47 YEARS OLD. FINISHED HIGH SCHOOL IN KASHAN, STUDIED PHILOSOOHY AND RELIGION AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY WHERE HE RECEIVED HIS BA AND PHD. WAS IN U.S. 1963-72, STUDIED AT UNIVERSITY OF MIAMI, RECEIVED BA IN CHEMISTRY. RETURNED BRIEFLY TO IRAN IN 1972, THEN WENT BACK TO NEW YORK UNIVERSITY WHERE HE RECEIVED A MA IN MANAGEMENT STUDIES.
WHILE IN U.S., WORKED FOR MANIFOLD SUPPLIES FROM 1964-68, AND LATER FOR KEYSANZA (PHOENTIC FROM THE FARSI) COMPANY. NAMED MINISTER OF COMMERCE BY BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT, FEB 1979.

IN CONVERSATION, DEP HEAD OF 4TH POLITICAL DIVISION ALI PARSAKIA INDICATED PRIVATELY THAT PROFESSIONALS WERE JUBILANT OVER SADR APPOINTMENT. MFA SEES SADR AS LONGTIME KHOMEINI SUPPORTER WHO HAS CLOUT NECESSARY TO "BRING WASHINGTON EMBASSY UNDER CONTROL." OFFHANDEDLY NOTING THAT IT WAS "IMPOSSIBLE" FOR FOREIGN MINISTRY TO CONTROL ROUHANI NOW, HE SAID, SADR HAD BEEN NAMED SPECIFICALLY TO STRAIGHTEN OUT IRANIAN REPRESENTATION IN WASHINGTON. PARSAKIA ALSO NOTED THAT APPOINTMENT OF MAN VERY FAMILIAR WITH U.S. SCENE WAS DELIBERATE EFFORT TO SHOW NEW PGOI'S INTEREST IN IMPROVED RELATIONS. PARSAKIA URGED PROMPT U.S. ACCEPTANCE AND EXPRESSED HIS OWN APPROVAL AT U.S. CHOICE OF "GOOD CAREER" AMBASSADOR FOR IRAN.
WITHOUT LINKING IT WITH SADR NOMINATION, ACTING POLCHIEF INQUIRED ABOUT STATUS OF U.S. REQUEST; PARSAKIA SAID APPROVAL SHOULD BE FORTHCOMING SOON.

1979TEHRAN03942.subject: A VISIT TO POST REVOLUTION TABRIZ

segments.text: (C-ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY: POLITICAL OFFICER SPENT PERIOD OF 8 APRIL TO 12 APRIL IN TABRIZ. SHOPS, SCHOOLS AND OFFICES OPEN, BUT SEVERE UNEMPLOYMENT PROBLEM EXISTS. CITY NORMAL DURING DAY BUT SHOOTING CONTINUES AT NIGHT. ATTITUDE TOWARDS POL OFF FRIENDLY AND COOPERATIVE BUT CAUTIOUS. MUCH DISCONTENT EXPRESSED AT RESULTS OF REVOLUTION. END SUMMARY.

POL OFF METRINKO RETURNED TO TABRIZ ON 8 APRIL TO PACK HHE AND OFFICIALLY INTRODUCE CONSULATE EMPLOYEES TO CONSULATES' REVOLUTIONARY PROTECTORS. ARRANGEMENTS FOR RETURN OF FORMER CONSUL TO TABRIZ WERE MADE THROUGH MFA, AND POL OFF FOUND LOCAL OFFICIAL REACTION EXTREMELY COOPERATIVE. VISIT MARKED FIRST TIME SINCE MID-FEBRUARY THAT OFFICIAL AMERICAN HAS BEEN TO TABRIZ, AND FIRST TIME FSNS ALLOWED ACCESS TO CONSULATE COMPOUND.

DURING COURSE OF VISIT, POL OFF STAYED IN CONSULATE RESIDENCE WITH PROTECTING UNQUOTE FORCE OF TWO HOMOFARS AND EIGHT AIR FORCE CONSCRIPTS. ALL AF PERSONNEL ON COMPOUND PROVED EXTREMELY FRIENDLY AND COOPERATIVE DURING POL OFF'S STAY AND PRESSED ADDRESSES AND INVITATIONS ON HIM TO VISIT THEIR VARIOUS HOMES WHENEVER POSSIBLE. HOMOFAR CONCERNS AND ATTITUDES DIFFERED SHARPLY FROM CONSCRIPTS', FORMER BEING VERY POLITICALLY ACUTE WHILE LATTER CONCERNED WITH MUNDANE MATTERS OF GIRLFRIENDS AND FUTURE EMPLOYMENT.

GOVERNOR GENERAL WAS ABSENT FROM TABRIZ DURING WHOLE PERIOD OF POL OFF'S VISIT, BUT CHIEF OF HIS POLITICAL SECTION PROVED MOST HELPFUL. POL SECTION CHIEF IS HOLDOVER FROM PREVIOUS REGIME. HE HAD SAME JOB WITH EX-GOV GEN AZEMUDEH (NOW IN EXILE IN UK AND ACCUSED OF ACTIVE ANTIREVOLUTION PLOTTING) AND EX-GOV GEN SHAFAQAT (RECENTLY EXECUTED). DESPITE FACT THAT HE IS ON FORBIDDEN-TO-DEPART IRAN LIST, POL SECTION CHIEF HAS BEEN OFFERED POSITIONS AS DISTRICT GOVERNOR OF ARDEBIL AND ASST GOV GEN OF MAZANDERAN PROVINCE. POL SECTION CHIEF'S REACTION TO EVERY REQUEST FROM POL OFF WAS MOST POSITIVE AND EFFICIENT.

HE EXPRESSED HOPE THAT CONSULATE COULD RE-OPEN SOON AND CLAIMED HIS OFFICE WAS RECEIVING 15 TO 20 PHONE CALLS A DAY FROM LOCAL IRANIANS ASKING DATE SO THAT THEIR VISAS COULD BE PROCESSED. AF PERSONNEL ON GUARD DUTY AT CONSULATE SAID FLOW OF IRANIANS WITH VISA QUESTIONS WAS ALMOST CONSTANT.

CITY SHOPS ARE OPEN BUT BUSINESS APPEARS TO BE VERY SLOW. TWO SHOP-OWNERS TOLD POL OFF THEY HAD REMOVED MOST VALUABLE MERCHANDISE FROM STORES FOR SAFEKEEPING BECAUSE OF SHARPLY INCREASING THEFT IN CITY. UNEMPLOYMENT IN TABRIZ IS SEVERE AND MANY FACTORIES REMAIN CLOSED. GOV GEN ANNOUNCED EARLIER THAT ABOUT 150,000 WORKERS IN CITY WERE UNEMPLOYED. CONSIDERING LESS THAN ONE MILLION POPULATION, UNEMPLOYMENT PROBLEM ALMOST IMMEDIATELY AFFECTS OVERWHELMING PERCENTAGE OF INHABITANTS. EVEN SOME FACTORIES OPEN UNTIL FINAL DAYS OF REVOLUTION ARE NOW CLOSED, AND CONSTRUCTION AND MANUAL LABOR JOBS APPEAR NON-EXISTENT.

SECURITY SITUATION IN CITY HAS STILL NOT BEEN TOTALLY RESOLVED. POLICE ARE ONLY PARTIALLY BACK AT WORK, AND FEW TRAFFIC POLICE WERE VISIBLE ON STREETS. ACCORDING TO SEVERAL SOURCES, COMMITTEES WERE STILL INTERFERING IN POLICE WORK, ALTHOUGH ROLE OF COMMITTEES IN CITY WAS STEADILY DIMINISHING. OPEN RIVALRY AMONG COMMITTEE GROUPS AND REPORTED ABUSES BY SOME HAVE LED TO MUCH CRITICISM OF THE COMMITTEES AND THE MULLAHS ASSOCIATED WITH THEM. REVOLUTIONARY COURT IN TABRIZ RESIGNED ABOUT TWO WEEKS AGO AND NO TRIALS WERE BEING HELD. ABOUT 60 TO 70 PRISONERS ACCUSED OF POLITICAL AND ANTI-REVOLUTION CRIMES REMAIN IN LOCAL PRISON.

WITHOUT EXCEPTION, ALL TABRIZIS WITH WHOM POL OFF SPOKE EXPRESSED SHOCK AND DISMAY OVER TEHRAN EXECUTION OF GEN BIDABADI, EX-MARTIAL LAW COMMANDER OF TABRIZ. STREETS IN CITY ARE NORMAL DURING DAY BUT MOVEMENT IS RESTRICTED AT NIGHT AND IDENTITY CHECKS BY REVOLUTIONARY MILITIA COMMON. LIGHT SCATTERED SHOOTING WAS HEARD EVERY NIGHT DURING POL OFF'S VISIT.

MANY FRIENDS HEARD OF EX-CONSUL'S PRESENCE AT CONSULATE AND CALLED TO EXPRESS GREETINGS. ATTITUDE WAS VERY WARM, AND MANY ALSO APOLIGIZED FOR NOT BEING ABLE TO INVITE HIM TO THEIR HOMES BECAUSE OF PRESENT SITUATION UNQUOTE. ACCORDING TO OTHER SOURCES, SOCIAL LIFE IN CITY IS MINIMAL AND LIMITED TO FAMILY GATHERINGS. IN GENERAL, DESPITE FRIENDLINESS AND WARMTH OF CALLERS, ATTITUDE WAS ONE OF CAUTION ABOUT POSSIBLE REACTION TO VISIBLE CONTACT WITH ------------------083325 161013Z /14 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 0888 INFO AMEMBASSY ANKARA SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 03942 EX-CONSUL IN TABRIZ, LINKED TO DESIRE TO MEET WITH HIM IN TEHRAN AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

WITH ONLY TWO EXECPTIONS (THE HOMOFARS) EVERYONE WITH WHOM POL OFF SPOKE EXPRESSED DISCONTENT AT RESULTS OF REVOLUTION. UNEMPLOYMENT, DISMAY OVER COMMITTEE ACTS AND CONTINUING EXECUTIONS, AND FEAR OF POSSIBLE VIOLENCE WERE MOST OFTEN MENTIONED. MOST HEARD COMMENT WAS WE DIDN'T KNOW IT WOULD TURN OUT LIKE THIS UNQUOTE, AND NO ONE SEEMED TO HAVE ANY DEFINITE ANSWERS FOR THE FUTURE. NAAS
(S - ENTIRE TEXT)

CHARGE AND ACTING POL CHIEF CALLED UPON DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER AMIR ENTEZAM TO REVIEW A NUMBER OF OUR DAY-TODAY PROBLEMS. FOLLOWING SHORT DISCUSSION OF IRAN'S DESIRE FOR NON-INTERFERENCE BY OTHER POWERS, ENTEZAM RAISED QUESTION OF WHETHER U.S. INTELLIGENCE LISTENING POSTS AT KAPKAN AND BESHAHR WERE STILL OPERATING. CHARGE SAID THEY WERE NOT, REMINDING ENTEZAM THAT HE HIMSELF HAD HELPED US GET LAST OF AMERICANS OUT (AND THANKING HIM AGAIN FOR HIS HELP). CHARGE COMMENTED THAT THEY COULD RESUME ACTIVITIES QUICKLY IF PGOI WERE SOMEDAY INTERESTED IN REOPENING BASES. WE WOULD BE WILLING TO DISCUSS SUBJECT AT ANY TIME.

CHARGE THEN EXPLAINED THAT THESE LISTENING POSTS WERE NOT USUAL COMINT INTELLIGENCE POSTS, BUT AN IMPORTANT PART OF U.S. NATIONAL VERIFICATION FOR ANY SALT AGREEMENT, PAST OR FUTURE. IRANIAN LISTENING POSTS BENEFITED WHOLE WORLD BY SUBSTANTIALLY STRENGTHENING U.S. CAPABILITY TO MONITOR SOVIET COMPLIANCE WITH AGREEMENTS. CHARGE ALSO TOOK OPPORTUNITY TO MENTION THAT U.S. HAD COOPERATED WITH PREVIOUS GOVERNMENT TO DEVELOP AN IRANIAN SIGNALS INTELLIGENCE CAPABILITY (IBEX).
ENTEZAM LISTENED WITH INTEREST, MADE NOTES, BUT OFFERED NO FURTHER COMMENT. NAAS

1979TEHRAN03971.subject: MEETING WITH DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER ENTEZAM

segments.text: (C-ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY: ENTEZAM ADMITTED REGIME WAS HAVING INTERNAL PROBLEMS, URGED US AND OTHERS NOT TO INTERVENE. SAID REVIEW OF U.S. CONTRACTS WOULD HOPEFULLY BE COMPLETED WITHIN TWO WEEKS. NOTED PGOI HELICOPTER FORCE IS VIRTUALLY OUT OF SPARES. REPLACEMENTS ARE A PROBLEM DUE TO DIFFICULTIES IN U.S. HE MENTIONED PROJECTED 8 MILLION DOLLARS WORTH OF PGOI SPARES LODGED IN TEXAS. HE TOOK A DIM VIEW OF COMMITTEE HARRASSMENT OF IRAN AMERICAN SOCIETY (IAS). END SUMMARY.
CHARGE AND ACTIG POL CHIEF CALLED ON DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER ENTEZAM APRIL 15 TO DISCUSS NUMBER OF SMALL PROBLEMS. IN COURSE OF CONVERSATION, FOLLOWING POINTS OF INTEREST WERE DISCUSSED

ENTEZAM INDICATED ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL MAKES MAJOR POLICY DECISIONS, BUT REFUSED TO BE DRAWN OUT BY EMBOFFS' EFFORTS TO GET HIM TO NAME MEMBERS, NOTING THIS INFO IS STILL CONFIDENTIAL. WHEN CHARGE TRIED TO DRAW HIM OUT ON STATUS OF REVOLUTION, ENTEZAM DIVERTED DISCUSSION TO U.S. CONTRACTS, AND SAID MINISTER OF NATIONAL DEFENSE, GEN RIAHI IS HEADING COMMITTEE WHICH IS DRAWING UP NEW THREAT ASSESSMENT FOR PGOI ARMED FORCES AND REVIEWING ALL CONTRACTS. ENTEZAM SAID PROCESS SHOULD BE FINISHED, HOPEFULLY, IN ONE OR TWO WEEKS. THEN HE WOULD BE ABLE TO TALK MORE ABOUT U.S.-IRAN TIES AND FUTURE OF U.S. CONTRACTS.

MEANWHILE, PGOI WAS HAVING SOME INTERNAL DIFFICULTIES, UNQUOTE AND ENTEZAM SAID HE HOPED U.S. WAS NOT INVOLVED; PGOI DID NOT WANT ANY INTERVENTION FROM FOREIGN POWERS. CHARGE CUT SHORT WHAT SOUNDED LIKE CANNED REMARKS (PERHAPS FOR BENEFIT OF OTHER IRANIAN READING AT A DESK IN CORNER OF ROOM) WITH FLAT STATEMENT THAT U.S. WAS NOT INTERVENING AND HAD NOT INTERVENED IN RECENT IRANIAN EVENTS. AFTER CONVERSATION GRADUALLY EASED AWAY FROM EXPRESSIONS OF FORMAL POSITIONS, ENTEZAM VOLUNTEERED THAT HE AND PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN HAD MET WITH SOVIETS, BRITISH AND CHINESE REPRESENTATIVES TO STRESS IRAN'S INDEPENDENT POLICIES AND DESIRE TO MAKE ITS OWN DECISIONS.
EMBOFFS PLAYED LIGHTLY ON THEME OF THOSE WHO SPREAD DISINFORMATION TO DISTURB GOOD U.S.-IRAN RELATIONS, AND ENTEZAM NODDED APPRECIATION OF POINT.

ENTEZAM THEN SAID PGOI DII HAVE REAL PROBLEM: ITS HELICOPTERS WERE OUT OF SPARES, AND U.S. WOULD NOT GIVE MORE THAN ONE SIXTH OF IRAN'S NEEDS. CHARGE RESPONDED THAT THIS SOUNDED LIKE SOME PROBLEM CONNECTED WITH BEHRING FREIGHT FORWARDING INJUNCTION AGAINST SHIPPING GOODS TO IRAN. CHARGE NOTED PGOI HAD NOT BEEN REPRESENTED AT HEARING AND OPINED THAT IF IT HAD, INJUNCTION MIGHT NOT HAVE BEEN GRANTED. CHARGE THOUGHT COMPROMISE WAS BEING WORKED OUT, BUT ADVISED PGOI TO GET ITSELF A GOOD LAWYER TO ADVISE ON COMPLICATED PROBLEMS RELATED TO CONTRACTS TO AVOID SUCH DIFFICULITIES.

ENTEZAM THEN SAID PGOI HAD DISCOVERED IT HAD ABOUT EIGHT MILLION DOLLARS WORTH OF SPARE PARTS OF SOME KIND AT DALLAS AIRPORT; IRANIAN AIR FORCE HAD 11 747'S IT COULD SEND TO PICK THEM UP. CHARGE SUGGESTED IRANIAN MILITARY COORDINATE THIS WITH EMBASSY MAAG OFFICE IF PROBLEM DEVELOPED.

ENTEZAM CONFIRMED THAT PROBLEMS CONCERNING U.S. ARE STILL BASICALLY IN DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER YAZDI'S BAILIWICK, BUT VOLUNTEERED TO FOLLOW UP IN CASE OF AN INDIVIDUAL WHO APPROACHED IAS PURPORTEDLY FROM LOCAL KHOMEINI COMMITTEE, AND SAID STUDENTS HAD COMPLAINED THAT PRICES FOR ENGLISH COURSES NOW OPEN FOR ENROLLMENT WERE TOO HIGH AND DIRECTED THEM TO BE CUT. INDIVIDUAL HAD USED ENTEZAM'S NAME LIBERALLY. (WHICH OBVIOUSLY ANNOYED ENTEZAM GREATLY -- THEY DID NOT HAVE THE RIGHT TO DO THIS UNQUOTE.) HE ASKED IAS OFFICIALS TO GET NAME, ADDRESS AND TELEPHONE NUMBERS OF ANYONE WHO TRIED TO INTERFERE WITH IAS OPERATIONS, AND CALL HIS OFFICE IF THERE WERE FURTHER

1979TEHRAN04025.subject: ATMOSPHERICS: THE REVOLUTION AFTER TWO MONTHS RN: TEHRAN 3971 2. SUMMARY: ISLAMIC REVOLUTION'S POLITICO-ADMINI

segments.text: RN: TEHRAN 3971

SUMMARY: ISLAMIC REVOLUTION'S POLITICO-ADMINISTRATIVE PERFORMANCE HAS BEEN MIXED TO DATE. PARALLEL GOVERNMENTAL STRUCTURES CONTINUE TO CAUSE PROBLEMS AND GENERATE CONFLICTS. PALESTINIAN ROLE IN RVOLUTION MAY GROW. PUBLIC RACTION TO REVOLUTIONARY ACTIVITIES IS MIXED AND NO UNIFYING GROUNDSWELL HAS YET EMERGED. ECONOMIC PERFORMANCE WILL EXACERBATE BOTH EXISTING AND FUTURE POLITICAL PROBLEMS. END SUMMARY.
DRAWING ON SERIES OF CONVERSATIONS AND SEVERAL VISITS TO FRIENDS IN SOUTH AND EASTERN TEHRAN, ACTING POL CHIEF OFFERS FOLLOWING ATMOSPHERICS ON UNFOLDING OF ISLAMIC REVOLUTION OVER PAST TWO MONTHS.

ADMINISTRATIVE PERFORMANCE OF GOVERNMENT HAS CONTINUED TO DETERIORATE, EVEN WITH A GENROUS ALLOWANCE FOR REVOLUTIONARY DIFFICULTIES. MANY ARE SURPRISED THAT ANYTHING IS GETTING DONE, GIVEN PROBLEMS OF KHOMEINI COMMITTEE INTERVENTIONS IN DAY-TO-DAY ACTIVITY OF GOVERNMENT. THOUGH MOST EVIDENT IN SECURITY AFFAIRS, WHERE COMMITTEE FORCES OFTEN ARREST, TRY AND SHOOT PEOPLE WITHOUT PGOI'S KNOWLEDGE, DUAL STRUCTURE IS ALSO BOTHERSOME IN OTHER AREAS AS WELL. OFFICIALS IN GOVERNMENT DEPARTMENTS ARE UNWILLING TO MAKE DECISIONS OR TO PREPARE OCUMENTS UNLESS SUPPLICANT HAS SOME KINDS OF COMMITTEE CLEARANCE. SITUATIONS,WHICH MIGHT HAVE BEEN EXPECTED TO IMPROVE SOMEWHAT HAVE NOT YET DONE SO.

DIRECT REQUESTS FOR BRIBES HAVE TAPERED OFF SIGNIFICANTLY, BUT THOSE WHO HAVE HAD OCCASION TO SEEK GOVERNMENT DOCUMENTATION FOR SALE OF LANDS, BULDING APPROVAL, ETC. FEEL PERSIAN INGENUITY IS SWIFTLY FINDING NEW WAYS ARO ND ISLAMIC MORALITY. "DONATIONS" TO ONE'S FAVORITE MOSQUE SEEM TO BE THE MOST FAVORED CURRENT PLOY. IN ECONOMIC SECTOR, DECISION-MAKING IS STILL CONFUSED (SEE REFTEL) BUT HAS PROGRESSED FROM DEADLOCK POSED BY IMMEDIATE POST-REVOLUTIONARH PERIOD WHERE BANKING HAD COME TO A STANDSTILL. INDUSTRIAL PRODUCTION IS SPOTTY--SHIRAZ REPORTS NEARLY ALL PLANTS OPERATING; TABRIZ REPORTS NONE. ECONOMIC CONFIDENCE IS DOWN, AND UNEMPLOYMENT IS THE SPECTRE THAT STALKS ISLAMIC POLITICS.

IN PURELY POLITICAL SPHERE, REFERENDUM WAS TRIUMPH OF FORM OVER SUBSTANCE AND WIDELY RECOGNIZED AS SUCH, EVEN BY RELATIVELY UNSOPHISTICATED. MINISTRY OF INTERIOR, WHICH NORMALLY ADMINISTERS ELECTIONS, WAS ALMOST WHOLLY ON SIDELINES. MINISTRY OFFICIALS INDICATE THE KHOMEINI COMMITTEE AT NTERIOR RAN ENTIRE ELECTORAL PROCESS VIRTUALLY ALONE. ADMINISTRATIVE ARRANGEMENTS IN COUNTRY WERE HAPHAZARD, SECRECY OF BALLOT WAS ABSENT, AND VOTE COUNT WAS WIDELY REGARDED AS A JOKE AT ALL LEVELS OF SOCIETY. IN ONE WAY, ALL THIS HAS BEEN BENEFICIAL-IT HAS DISCOURAGED OR REALIGNED SOME EXCESSIVE EXPECTATIONS HELD BY MANY REGARDING GOVERNMENT. IT HAS NOT, HOWEVER, CONTRIBUTED TO THE RESTORATION OF AUTHORITY.
PGOI NEEDS TO ASSERT ITSELN MORE FIRMLY, AT LEAST IN THE MORE ROUTINE, VISIBLE ADMINISTRATIVE FUNCTIONS SUCH AS TRAFFIC CONTROL AND PROVISION OF SERVICES.

MAJOR SYSTEMIC CAUSE OF CONTINUED ADMINISTRATIVE AUTHORITY WEAKNESS IS INTENSIFICATION OF PARALLEL STRUCTURE OF GOVERNMENT--THE BAZARGAN ADMINISTRATION ON THE ONE HAND, AND THE KHOMEINI COMMITTEES ON THE OTHER. INSTEAD OF DISAPPEARING, THE COMMITTEES HAVE CONTINUED TO INTERVENE IN GOVERNMENTAL AND ADMINISTRATIVE LIFE WITH SIGNIFICANT NEGATIVE IMPACT ON THE PGOI'S ABILITY TO GET ITS ACT TOGETHER. FOREIGN MINISTER SANJABI'S RESIGNATION, AND THE HINTED RESIGNATIONS OF JUSTICE MINISTER MOBASHERI AND EVEN OF BAZARGAN HIMSELF ARE MANIFESTATIONS OF THIS, AND UNEVEN PERFORMANCES BYVARIOUS COMMITTEES HAVE BROUGHT SEVERAL UNDER PUBLIC CRITICISM.

MINISTERY OF INTERIOR CENTRAL COMMITTEE LAST WEEK GOT INTO SHOUTING MATCH WITH MINISTER HAJ JAVADI SADR WHEN HE REFUSED TO CLEAR SENIOR LEVEL APPOINTMENTS WITH GROUP. ON APRIL 11, COMMITTEE ORDERED MINISTRY STAFF TO GO ON STRIKE. OVER 80 PERCENT CAME TO WORK, ACCORDING TO TWO DIRECTORS GENERAL, BUT SITUATION IS FRAUGHT WITH INSTABILITY.

WHILE CONDITIONS HAVE NOT GOTTEN THAT BAD IN OTHER MINISTRIES, WE UNDERSTAND THERE HAVE BEEN SIGNIFICANT TENSIONS BETWEEN COMMITTEES AND GOVERNMENT MINISTERS IN AT LEAST THREE OTHER MINISTRIES--LABOR, EDUCATION AND JUSTICE--AND PERHAPS OTHERS AS WELL WHERE INFO IS NOT AS GOOD. ------------------106930 181537Z /43/41 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 0928 SECTION 02 OF 03 TEHRAN 04025 (OPENING PARA)

OSTENSIBLY OF THE SAME ISLAMIC MOVEMENT HAS BEEN TO AWAKEN HOPE IN THOSE OF ALL CLASSES WHO ARE GRADUALLY BEGINNING TO REJECT MUCH OF WHAT ISLAMIC MOVEMENT IS STANDING FOR. INSTEAD OF MOVING TOWARD MIDDLE AND COMPROMISE, KHOMEINI AND HIS COMMITTEES HAVE REMAINED REVOLUTIONARY PURISTS, ESPECIALLY ON DEALING WITH ELEMENTS OF OLD REGIME AND ON IMPOSITION OF ISLAMIC VALUES ON SOCIETY. FEDAYEEN AND MARXISTS PARTIES HAVE HAD A RECRUITING FIELD DAY. WHILE THEY REMAIN WEAK RELATIVE TO MOSQUE ORGANIZATION OF ISLAMICS, THEY ARE MAKING STRONG ORGANIZATIONAL EFFORT IN BOTH MILITARY AND POLITICAL FIELDS. THEIR LITERATURE IS WIDELY AVAILABLE THROUGHOUT CITY, AND NOTABLE NEW POSTER FACE CHE GUEVARA.

REPORTING OFFICER SPOKE WITH TWO ARANIANS, ONE AN OLD FRIEND, WHO HAVE BEEN ATTENDING FEDAYEEN-RUN POLITICAL CLASSES FOR PAST TWO WEEKS. AT RATHER LARGE DINNER, OF 15 "YOUNG PROFESSIONALS" PRESENT, ONLY TWO MAINTAINED THEY WOULD SIDE WITH ISLAMIC MOVEMENT AGAINST MARXISTS IN SHOWDOWN. THIS IS INDICATIVE, NOT DEFINITIVE; WHAT IS TROUBLESOME IS THAT MODERNISTS IN ISLAMIC MOVEMENT ARE ON DEFENSIVE, AND FEDAYEEN AND OTHER MARXISTS HAVE A GOOD HEADSTART ON BUILDING UP A VERY CREDIBLE BASE AMONG IRAN'S FUTURE MOVERS AND SHAKERS WHICH THEY DID NOT HAVE A MONTH AGO.
SEVERAL PERSIAN ACADEMICS ARE CONVINCED FEDAYEEN HAVE ALSO MOVED DISCREETLY TO FORCE USABLE ALLIANCES WITH IMPORTANT TRIBAL GROUPS (A VIEW DEPUTY PM YAZDI SHARES).

UNEXPECTED WINDFALL FOR REPORTING OFFICER PRODUCED CHANCE TO HEAR JALEH SQUARE MUJAHIDDIN CENTRAL COMMITTEEMAN EXPOUND ON MUJAHIDDIN PLANS FOR NEXT FEW MONTHS. REPORTING OFFICER WAS VISITING HOME OF OLD FRIEND NEAR JALEH SQUARE EVENING APRIL 13 WHEN FOUR GUESTS ARRIVED. EMBOFF WAS INTRODUCED AS SOMEONE WHO TAUGHT WITH HOST, AND GROUP REMAINED UNAWARE OF EMB CONNECTION. ASSEMBLY IMMEDIATELY BEGAN TO TALK POLITICS, AS MOST GROUPS DO IN IRAN THESE DAYS--VITALITY OF PERSIAN DISCOURSIVE LIFE IS SHOWN BY POPULAR APHORISM WHICH SAYS ANY FIVE IRANIANS WHO MEET WILL IMMEDIATELY PRODUCE SEVEN POLITICAL POSITIONS.

MUJAHIDDIN COMMITTEEMAN DESCRIBED EXTENSIVE PALESTINIAN ROLE IN PREPARATION FOR REVOLUTION, AND WHEN QUESTIONED BY OTHERS, INDICATED PLO WAS STILL PROVIDING EXTENSIVE SUPPORT IN MILITARY AREA FOR BOTH MUJAHIDDIN AND FEDAYEEN, PLUS SOME ADMINISTRATKZGYHELP FOR KHOMEINI MOVEMENT. COMMITTEEMAN LAUGHED WHEN IRANIAN PROFESSOR ASKED HIM WHAT HE THOUGHT OF PGOI SPOKESMAN ENTEZAM'S STATEMENT THAT THE PGOI WOULD GIVE NO MILITARY HELP TO PLO, AND SAID THIS WAS "NONSENSE FOR WESTERN CONSUMPTION; IRAN WILL HELP THE PLO WHEN IT IS TIME TO HELP." COMMITTEEMAN DREW PICTURE OF ISLAMIC MOVEMENT BUILDING ITS ORGANIZATION WITH PLO HELP, AND PAINTED ROSY PICTURE OF FUTURE AS COMMITTEES BEGAN TO COOPERATE BETTER WITH PGOI.

ONLY PROBLEM WAS COMMITTEEMAN'S INSISTENCE THAT "COOPERATION" WOULD BE ACHIEVED BY PGOI LEARNING TO FOLLOW COMMITTEE INSTRUCTIONS BETTER. ONE INTERLOCUTOR ASKED WHAT MADE MUJAHIDDIN SO SURE PLO GROUP WOULD NOT SECRETLY STRENGTHEN THEIR FEDAYEEN FRIENDS AT EXPENSE OF MUJAHIDDIN. COMMITTEEMAN EXUDED CONFIDENCE ON THIS POINT, BUT WAS THIN ON SPECIFICS. TWO OTHERS PRESENT THOUGHT PLO AND FEDAYEEN HAD MORE IN COMMON THAN PLO AND MUJAHIDDIN, BUT GROUP AGREED TO DISAGREE. (COMMENT: ACCORDING TO SOURCES WHO HAVE BEEN ATTENDING FEDAYEEN TRAINING SESSIONS, PLO BANNERS AND SLOGANS ARE PRESENT IN FORCE AT FEDAYEEN HEADQUARTERS, AND FEDAYEEN MILITARY TRAINING IS GIVEN EVERY WEEK DAY BY INSTRUCTORS WHO WERE TRAINED IN LEBANON.
TRAINING IS PROVIDED ON ALL AUTOMATIC WEAPONS, MACHINE GUNS AND MORTARS.

GENERAL PUBLIC REACTION TO REVOLUTION IS MIXED BUT GENERALLY ACCEPTING. MANY OUTSIDE CITIES ARE NOT AFFECTED AT ALL. LOWER AND LOWER MIDDLE CLASSES IN EAST TEHRAN SHOUT SLOGANS OF REVOLUTION, BUT SEE LITTLE CHANGES IN LIFE. MIDDLE CLASSES FEAR ISLAMIC JUSTICE, BUT IT DOES NOT AFFECT MANY ON THE LOW END OF THE SCALE. SHORTAGES HAVE PREVAILED FOR SO LONG THAT THEY ARE REGARDED AS MINOR INCONVENIENCES. LIFE IS MARGINALLY BETTER THAN IT WAS LAST WINTER, AND WHILE REVOLUTION GETS CREDIT FOR SOME IMPROVEMENT IN ECONOMIC SITUATION FOR LOWER CLASS GROUPS, COMING OF SPRING GETS MORE.

POLITICALLY, ORDINARY PEOPLE HAVE HAD THEIR FUN AND ARE READY TO GO ABOUT BUSINESS OF LIVING. NEITHER PGOI NOR KHOMEINI HAVE BEEN ABLE TO ESTABLISH GROUNDSWELL OF UNIFYING THEME. EVEN A FEW LESS-SOPHISTICATED PERSIANS, THE BACKBONE OF KHOMEINI'S SUPPORT, ARE HAVING PRIVATE SECOND THOUGHTS ABOUT A PURE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. LOOSENING OF POLITICAL CLIMATE COUPLED WITH PGOI'S INABILITY TO RESTORE FULL AUTHORITY TO ITSELF HAS SET FORCES IN MOTION WHICH NO ONE MAY FULLY BE ABLE TO CONTROL IN THE SHORT AND MEDIUM TERM.

THESE FORCES MAY, OVER THE NEXT 3-6 ------------------101552 180829Z /11/41 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 0929 SECTION 03 OF 03 TEHRAN 04025 TEXT (GARBLED THROUGHOUT) MONTHS, ERODE SUBSTANTIAL SUPPORT KHOMEINI ENJOYS AS CRACKS APPEAR IN THE ISLAMIC PICTURE OF PARADISE SOUGHT.

MIXED REACTION TO REVOLUTION BECOMES POSITIVELY SCHIZOPHRENIC WHEN QUESTION OF REVOLUTIONARY EXECUTIONS COMES UP. THOSE BELOW 30 ARE CONVINCED OF JUSTICE OF KILLING SUBSTANTIAL NUMBERS OF SHAH'S SUPPORTERS. THEIR PARENTS AND ELDERS ARE HORRIFIED, EVEN MANY OF THOSE WHO HAVE NOT AND WOULD NOT SUPPORT ANY FORM OF MONARCHICIAL RESTORATION. AT LEAST TWO EMBOFFS HAVE BEEN PRESENT AT "GENERATION GAP" DISCUSSIONS WHEN COMMITTEE YOUTH GOT INTO VIRTUAL SHOUTING MATCHES WITH PARENTS OVER QUESTION OF JUSTICE OF REVOLUTIONARY EXECUTIONS. TEHRAN OVER PAST SEVEN DAYS HAS SEEN ADDITIONAL PHENOMENA--GANGS OF YOUTHS WHOSE PARENTS HAVE BEEN EXECUTING BANDING TOGETHER TO EXACT REVENGE ON REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS.

NUMBER OF EYEWITNESSES HAVE SEEN REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS KILLED. PERSIAN WHO RUNS SMALL SHOPS AT SEVERAL SOUTH TEHRAN LOCATIONS SAYS UNPUBLICIZED NIGHT KILLINGS DID IN AN AVERAGE OF 30 REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS A NIGHT IN PERIOD APRIL 10-14 IN AREAS NEAR HIS STORES. SECURITY IMPLICATIONS ARE NOT GOOD, BUT POLITICAL IMPLICATIONS ARE WORSE--BLOOM IS OFF REVOLUTION FOR MANY IN SOUTH TEHRAN, ESPECIALLY THOSE WHO ARE BEING "VOLUNTEERED" FOR GUARD DUTY BY LOCAL COMMITTEES WHO ARE CONDUCTING HOUSE-TOHOUSE SEARCHES. THOUGH THIS SITUATION IS MANAGEABLE IN THE SHORT RUN, IF IT BECOMES WORSE, REVOLUTIONARY ZEAL COULD DEGENERATE EVEN FURTHER INTO INTRA-MOVEMENT DOGFIGHTING.

NUMBER OF PERSIAN OBSERVERS BELIEVE REACTION TO KILLINGS AS FORMER ELITE COMES OUT OF ITS SHOCK AND STARTS TO FIGHT BACK, HOWEVER FEEBLY, WILL EVENTUALLY COUPLE WITH DISILLUSION OVER ECONOMIC PROSPECTS TO PROMOTE REAL TROUBLE FOR PGOI AND ISLAMIC MOVEMENT ITSELF. THERE IS ALSO A FAINTLY IDSCERNABLE ANTI-PALESTINIAN BACKLASH, STEMMING FROM FAIRLY WILD PUBLIC STATEMENTS THAT THEY MAY BE COMING TO FILL VOIDS LEFT BY DEPARTING WESTERNS. REVOLUTION PROMISED A LOT AND BOOSTED EXPECTATIONS.

PERSIANS ARE MASTERS OF THE WHAT-HAVE-YOUDONE-FOR-ME LATELY SCHOOL OF POLITICS, AND THERE PRESENTLY EXIST ELEMENTS IN THE HURLY-BURLY OF CONTEMPORARY IRANIAN POLITICS WHO WILL ACTIVELY EXPLOIT DIVISIONS WITHIN ISLAMIC MOVEMENT AND BETWEEN ISLAMIC MOVEMENT AND PGOI. THERE HAS AS YET BEEN NO REAL UNIFICIATION OF EITHER IDEOLOGICAL THEME OR ADMINISTRATION, AND MANY ARE POSITIONING THEMSELVES TO EXPLOIT THE BREACH. ONLY THEIR ORGANIZATIONAL WEAKNESS HAS PREVENTED A SUBSTANTIAL CHALLENGE TO DATE. IN THIS CONNECTION, "DEFECTION" OF TALEGHANI FROM KHOMEINI CAMP, AND QUICKNESS OF FEDAYEEN TO RALLY HIS SUPPORT ARE TOURBLING.
DEMONSTRATIONS BEGINNING APRIL AND MARCH OF CHANTING STUDENTS AROUND TEHRAN OVER PAST THREE DAYS ARE VERY REMINISCENT OF THE NOVEMBER-JANUARY PERIOD JUST PAST. THE DEJA VU IS SOBERING. NAAS
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)

AT EMBASSY REQUEST A LOCAL AMERICAN PASTOR, REV. BOB PRYOR, CONTACTED THE RUSSIAN ORTHODOX CONGREGATION IN TEHRAN. PRYOR TOURED THE FACILITIES, SPENT SEVERAL HOURS AT THE COMBINED CHURCH/OLD AGE HOME COMPOUND AND ALSO HAD DINNER WITH SEVERAL MEMBERS OF THE CONGREGATION AT A DIFFERENT LOCATION. HIS CONCLUSION WAS THAT THE EMIGRE GROUP WAS SUFFERING NO HARDSHIPS WHATSOEVER. ACCORDING TO PRYOR, THE CONGREGATION IS VERY COMFORTABLE FINANCIALLY AND ALL CLAIMED THAT THEY HAVE HAD NO UNUSUAL PROBLEMS RESULTING FROM THE REVOLUTION.

MEMBERS OF THE LOCAL CHURCH COUNCIL WERE FRIENDLY AND HOSPITABLE TO PRYOR, BUT CLAIMED THERE WAS ABSOLUTELY NO REASON FOR HIM OR ANYONE ELSE TO BE CONCERNED. THEY SPECIFICALLY ASKED THAT NO EMB OFFICER CONTACT THEM.

FYI: THE RUSSIAN EMIGRE COMMUNITY CONSISTS OF 100 TO 120 FAMILIES, WITH MANY INTERMARRIAGES INTO PERSIAN SOCIETY. MANY OF ITS MEMBERS PLAN EVENTUAL IMMIGRATION, AND THE TOLSTOI FOUNDATION IN THE U.S. IS WORKING ALONG THESE LINES FOR THEM. NAAS
(C - ENTIRE TEXT. THIS IS A REPORTING MESSAGE; NO ACTION REQUIRED.)

SUMMARY: OVER PAST TWO WEEKS "THE ANTI-AMERICAN SYNDROME"(APOLOGIES TO JANE FONDA) HAS BECOME MORE PROMINENT, BOTH IN PRESS AND IN POLITICAL STATEMENTS. ROOT OF THIS IS KHOMEINI'S ANTI-WESTERN PARANOIA, FUELED BY ANIT-WESTERNISM OF PLO-INFLUENCED FEDAYEEN AND OTHERS. ANTI UNQUOTE VIRUS GOES BEYOND RITUAL REVOLUTIONARY STRAIN, AND WHILE MAJORITY OF IRANIANS IGNORE IT, PROPAGANDA EFFORT IS BEGINNING TO HAVE CUMULATIVE EFFECT, ESPECIALLY ON THE YOUNG. U.S. SHOULD FOREBEAR FOR NOW. END SUMMARY.

EMBASSY DOES NOT WISH TO BELABOR SUBJECT, BUT DOES WISH TO ACQUAINT ADDRESSEES WITH SIGNIFICANT INCREASE IN ANTI-AMERICANISM WHICH AS TAKEN PLACE BEGINNING ABOUT APRIL 1 AND INCREASING PARTICULARLY OVER PAST FOUR DAYS. THIS HEIGHTENED ANTI-YANKEE EFFORT HAS AN ALMOST THIRDWORLD QUALITY ABOUT IT STEMMING DIRECTLY FROM THE IDEOLOGY OF THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTION AND THE PERSONAL PREDELICTIONS OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI AND SOME OF HIS CLOSE SUPPORTERS ON ONE HAND, AND VARIOUS LEFTIST GROUPS, INCLUDING THE PLO INFLUENCED FEDAYEEN, ON THE OTHER.

VISIBLE MANIFESTATIONS HAVE BEEN GROWING ANTI-AMERICAN COMMENT IN PERSIAN PRESS (THE ONLY PRINT MEDIA LEFT SINCE CESSATION OF ALL FOREIGN LANGUAGE PAPERS MARCH 27), THE EXTENSIVE USE OF SOVIET AND OTHER BLOC MATERIALS ON TELEVISION, AND THE REVELATIONS AT RECENT TRIALS BY OFFICIALS WHO CLAIMED TO HAVE BEEN INVOLVED WITH THE CIA OR GENERAL HUYSER (DEPT. NEA/IRN SEE IRAN POOL REPORTS FOR APRIL 1417, BEING FORWARDED BY POUCH). GENERALS RABII AND BERENJIAN REFERRED TO U.S. GENERAL HUYSER'S MISSION AND U.S. SPY BASES UNQUOTE AT THEIR TRIALS. UNFLATTERING COVERAGE OF THEIR TESTIMONY APPEARED BOTH IN THE PRESS AND ON T.V.

EMBASSY'S SENIOR ECONOMIC LOCAL WAS KICKED OUT OF CENTRAL BANK DURING ROUTINE VISIT APRIL 9 AND SIGNS WERE QUICKLY POSTED, WE HAVE REMOVED THE IMPERIALIST AGENT. UNQUOTE. SENIOR ICA LOCAL REMAINS IN CUSTODY OF TEHRAN KHOMEINI COMMITTEE ON NEBULOUS CHARGES SUPPOSEDLY RELATING TO EMBASSY WORK. PRIVATE SECTOR AMCITS WHO REMAIN, AS WELL AS EUROPEANS, REPORT THEY ARE STARED AT (AND SHOUTED AT) ON STREETS WITH MUCH MORE HOSTILITY THAN A MONTH AGO.

KHOMEINI HIMSELF, IN ADDRESSING REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS IN QOM ON APRIL 16, CALLED AGAIN FOR CUTTING OFF THE HANDS OF THE AMERICANS WHO DO THE WORK OF THE DEVIL UNQUOTE (ETTELA'AT BANNER HEADLINE). THOSE WHO KNOW KHOMEINI, EVEN HIS MORE MODERNIZED ASSOCIATES, SAY HE IS VIRTUALLY PARANOID ABOUT THE U.S., BLAMING AMERICA FOR MOST OF THE ILLS OF THE SHAH YEARS. IT IS CLEAR FROM HIS PUBLIC PRONOUNCEMENTS AND ACTIONS THAT THE AYATOLLAH WANTS TO STAMP OUT THE LAST VESTIGES OF U.S. INFLUENCE IN IRAN.

ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COURT INTERROGATORS AND JUDGES CONTINUALLY PUSH WITNESSES TO DESCRIBE THEIR TIES TO WESTERN IMPERIALISM, UNQUOTE OR SEEK LINKAGES BETWEEN THE OLD REGIME AND THE CIA OR OTHER ORGANIZATIONS (ROTARY ------------------105586 181455Z /40 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 0950 SECDEF WASH DC IMMEDIATE USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE IMMEDIATE CINCPAC HONOLULU HI IMMEDIATE USICA WASHDC IMMEDIATE INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY BONN AMEMBASSY CAIRO AMCONSUL DHAHRAN IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY DOHA AMCONSUL FRANKFURT AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS AMEMBASSY BEIJING AMEMBASSY RABAT USLO RIYADH IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY TOKYO USDOCOSOUTH SECTION 02 OF 03 TEHRAN 04069 INTERNATIONAL, THE FREEMASONS, ETC) WHICH COULD BE USED TO TAR THE U.S.

SEVERAL UNIVERSITY SOURCES WHO WERE RELATIVELY RELAXED FIVE WEEKS AGO NOW REPORT THAT SEVERAL OF THEIR US EDUCATED COLLEGUES HAVE BEEN PICKED UP ON THE STREETS WITHOUT WARNING. IN SOME CASES, THEY HAVE BEEN BROUGHT BEFORE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES AND IN ONE CASE, A LOWER LEVEL COURT, ON CHARGES OF HELPING THE AMERICANS UNQUOTE (THIS IS APPARENTLY BECOMING A CRIME, OR AT LEASE A GREY ACT, IN REVOLUTIONARY IRAN).

ONE CONTACT AND CLOSE FRIEND OF RICHARD COTTAM INDICATED TO EMBOFF THAT NUMBER OF ACADEMICS ARE NOW IN JAIL WITHOUT CHARGES AND SAID IT WAS BETTER EMBOFFS NOT RPT NOT TRY TO CONTACT THEIR ACADEMIC FRIENDS DIRECTLY BECAUSE THIS COULD BE MISCONSTRUED UNQUOTE. NUMBER OF OTHER NON-ACADEMIC CONTACTS OF EMBOFFS HAVE BEEN SIMILARLY RELUCTANT TO MEET IN PUBLIC PLACES AND SEVERAL ARE RELUCTANT TO MEET AT ALL, UNTIL THINGS SETTLE DOWN UNQUOTE. PRESS OFFICER HAS ENCOUNTERED SIMILAR PROBLEMS WITH GREAT NUMBER OF JOURNALISTS. ATMOSPHERE IS SIGNIFICANTLY TIGHTER IN THIS REGARD THAN IT WAS TWO WEEKS AGO.

INDIVIDUALS WE KNOW WHO ARE CONNECTED IN ANY WAY WITH FEDAYEEN AND OTHER LEFTISTS GROUPS INDICATED THAT ANTIAMERICAN EFFORT HAS LEFT'S FULL BLESSING AND HELP AS WELL. PLO REPRESENTATIVE HERE HAS PUBLICLY ATTACKED MID EAST PEACE EFFORT AND U.S., AND HAVE PUSHED USE OF WORDS SUCH AS IMPERIALISM AND ANTI-COLONIALISM IN SPEECHES AND ELSEWHERE. IF ONE BELIEVES SOME ELEMENTS OF LEFT, IRANIAN REVOLUTION WAS CARRIED OUT SOLELY TO SHAKE OFF COLONIAL SHACKLES OF U.S. IMPERIALISM, WHICH HAS DEVIOUS PLOT FOR WHOLE AREA. SOVIET RADIO BROADCASTS ALSO TAKE SAME THEME, BUT WE BELIEVE IRANIAN RESPOND MORE TO PLO'S THIRD WORLD STYLE.

ABOVE IS AIDED BY PERSIAN PENCHANT FOR FINDING PLOTS IN EVERY POLITICAL SITUATION: A COMMON STORY MAKING ROUNDS OF EDUCATED CIRCLES IN IRAN GOES LIKE THIS: THE U.S. DECIDED TO BACK KHOMEINI AS THE BEST BULWARK AGAINST COMMUNISM. IF THIS IS NOT TRUE, WHY DIDN'T CIA ASSASSINATE KHOMEINI WHEN IT HAD A CHANCE? AMERICAN INFLUENCE IN IRAN IS THEREFORE BOTH STRONGER AND MORE SUBTILE THAN EVER BEFORE. CONCLUSION, DEPENDING ON ONE'S VIEWS, IS THAT ONE SHOULD (A) GO ALONG WITH SUPERPOWER EFFORT TO STABILIZE IRAN OR (B) WORK ALL THE HARDER TO ROOT OUT PERNICIOUS WESTERN VALUES AND U.S. IMPERIALISM.

ABOVE OFFERED TO SHOW LENGTHS EVEN ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARIES WILL OCCASIONALLY GO TO AVOID TAKING CREDIT FOR THEIR OWN ACHIEVEMENTS. BULK OF IRANIAN POPULACE, AT LEAST I TEHRAN HAS THUS FAR NOT BEEN REALLY AFFECTED BY CAMPAIGN BUT CUMULATIVE EFFECT OF THIS PROPAFANDA EFFORT CAN NOT BE IGNORED, ESPECIALLY ON HIGH SCHOOL AND COLLEGE STUDENTS WHO HAVE LITTLE TO COMPARE IT WITH, AND NO HISTORICAL RESIDUE OF POSITIVE EXPERIENCE. -. WHAT TO DO ABOUT IT? MISSION IS IN DAMNED-IF-WE-DODAMNED-IF-WE-DON'T POSITION AND TO SOME DEGREE, SO IS USG GENERALLY.

THE LOWER OUR PROFILE CAN BE KEPT, THE BETTER, AND A SUBSTANTIAL DOSE OF FOREBEARANCE WOULD SEEM TO BE THE ORDER OF THE DAY. THIS COUPLED WITH SOME PATIENT QUIET DIPLOMACY WITH INDIVIDUAL LEADERS, MAY OVER TIME REDUCE THE STRIDENCY.

IRANIANS ARE PRESSING GARMISH-MAAG FOR A DETAILED ACCOUNTING FOR EXPENDITURES FROM TRUST FUND AND DOD'S FOOT DRAGGING ON THIS MATTER IS CREATING AN UNFORTUNATE AIR OF SUSPICION HERE. IN MY VIEW IRANIANS FULLY DESERVE AN EXPLANATION OF HOW ITS MONEY IS BEING EXPENDED. GARMISH-MAAG DOES NOT HAVE THE INFORMATION HERE AND ONLY AN EXPERT TEAM FROM WASHINGTON CAN HANDLE IT. YET, REF SECDEF MESSAGE CURTLY FORBIDS US FROM MAKING SUCH A PROPOSAL. APPARENTLY, DOD/DSAA'S CONCERN IS THAT A SMALL AMOUNT OF EXPENDITURE WILL BE TAKEN FROM THE TRUST FUND.

I ADDRESSED MYSELF TO THE ISSUES INVOLVED IN REF TEHRAN MESSAGE. I CAN ONLY REPEAT THAT PROFESSIONS OF OUR DESIRES TO NORMALIZE RELATIONS WITH THIS GOVERNMENT WILL FALL ON DEAF EARS IF WE CANNOT BE RESPONSIVE IN CASES AS CLEAR CUT AS THIS ONE. NAAS

SUCH A UNIT WOULD BE A MAJOR STEP TOWARDS SOLVING THE UNEMPLOYMENT PROBLEMS OF THIS VOLATILE YOUNGER GROUP. PROBLEMS OF COMPOSITION, ORGANIZATION AND FNAL LOYALTY, HOWEVER, MIGHT VERY WELL PROVE INSURMOUNTABLE. IN A COUNTRY WHERE INTER-SERVICE RIVALRY REACHED TRAGIC PROPORTIONS, A TOTALLY NEW AND OFFICIAL ARMED FORCE MIGHT WELL EXACERBATE TRADITIONAL TENSIONS.

THE TRADITIONAL SECURITY FORCES: ACCURATE INFORMATION ON THE STATUS OF SECURITY AND ARMED FORCES IN THE PROVINCES IS DIFFICULT TO OBTAIN. WHAT IS APPARENT, HOWEVER, IS THAT THE POLICE AND ARMED FORCES HIERARCHIES HAVE.BEEN DEALT A NEAR FATAL BLOW. IN MANY AREAS THE TRADITIONAL POLICE FORCE SEEMS TO EXIST IN ONLY A SKELETON FORM. CONTINUING EXECUTIONS AND ARRESTS OF POLICE OFFICIALS FOLLOWING SEVERAL PRE-REVOLUTION MONTHS OF ANTI-POLICE PROPAGANDA AND PRECINCT HOUSE ASSAULTS HAVE TAKEN A HEAVY TOLL. EMBOFF HAS SPOKEN TO MANY TEHRAN POLICE OFFICERS DURING THE PAST TWO MONTHS, AND POLICE COMMENTS RANGE FROM OUTRIGHT HOSTILITY TOWARDS THE NEW REGIME TO QUIET DISTASTE.

POLICE OFFICERS SEEM UNWILLING TO ACCEPT NEW POSITIONS OF RESPONSIBILITY AND ALMOST ALL OF THE HIGHER RANKING OFFICERS SAY THAT THEY ARE WAITING FOR A POLITIC TIME TO RESIGN OR RETIRE.( POSSIBLE STIRRINGS OF REVOLUTIONARY INTELLIGENCE ARM TO REPLACE SAVAK BEING REPORTED SEPTEL. CONVERSATIONS WITH AIR FORCE PERSONNEL HAVE BEEN IN A SIMILAR VEIN. OF THE MORE THAN 60 PRE-REVOLUTION AF GENERALS,ALLHCART A HANDFUL HAVE BEEN RETIRED. SEVERAL AF OFFICERS HAVE BEEN EXECUTED AND OTHERS HAVE DISAPPEARED. ACCORDING TO A RECENTLY RETIRED AF GEN, FILES HAVE BEEN PREPARED ON 28 OTHER AF GENERALS AND THEIR ARRESTS ARE EXPECTED MOMENTARILY.

THE CONTINUING ARRESTS AND EXECUTIONS ARE HAVING THE EXPECTED EFFECT ON MORALE AND ABILITY OF THOSE STILL IN POWER TO EXERCISE AUTHORITY. POLITICAL AND PERSONAL MOTIVES OF SELF SURVIVAL HAVE ALSO RENT THIS ONCE HOMOGENEOUS BRANCH. FROM MANY CONVERSATIONS EMBOFF HAS HAD WITH ALL LEVELS OF AF PERSONNEL, IT IS CLEAR THAT ORDERS CAN STILL BE GIVEN, BUT OBEDIENCE IS QUESTIONABLE.

STATUS OF PROVINCIAL BASES: INFORMATION INDICATES THAT MANY ARMY AND AF BASES THROUGHOUT IRAN REMAINED INTACT EVEN THROUGH THE WORST DAYS OF THE REVOLUTION. EMBOFF HAS SPOKEN TO ARMY SOURCES FROM POINTS AS DIVERSE AS BIRJAND (KHORASSAN PROVINCE) AND MARAND (AZARBAIJAN) WHO CLAIM THAT THEIR BASES WERE NEVER TOUCHED AND CONTINUE TO FUNCTION. RETIRED AF GEN SAID THAT PRIOR TO THE FEBRUARY TROUBLES, HE HAD ORDERED THE REMOVAL OF ALL WEAPONS ON HIS NORTHERN BASE TO A SAFE END PLACE. IRREMOVABLE ITEMS WERE RENDERED UNUSABLE. HIS FORMER BASE, AND OTHERS ALONG IRAN'S NORTHERN TIER REMAIN INTACT.

WHILE ASSAULTS ON BASES IN TEHRAN AND ------------------002986 191603Z /50 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 0983 SECTION 03 OF 03 TEHRAN 04128 TABRIZ WERE WELL PUBLICIZED, MOST OTHERS WERE APPARENTLY NEVER TOUCHED AND PRESUMABLY CONTINUE TO FUNCTION AFTER A FASHION, WITH HIERARCHICAL MORALE AND LOGISTICAL SUPPLY THEIR MAJOR PROBLEMS.

CONCLUSION: BASED ON THE CONFUSION RAMPANT IN EVERY SEGMENT OF IRANIAN SOCIETY TODAY, THE INTENSE POLITICIZATION OF INDIVIDUAL IRANIANS, THE RIVALRY BETWEEN VARIOUS POWER GROUPS AND THE THREAT TO AND POOR MORALE OF THE TRADITIONAL SECURITY HIERARCHY, THE SHORT RUN PROGNOSIS IS SOBERING. SECURITY FORCE ORGANIZATIONS IN MANY PLACES ARE STILL A HODGE-PODGE OF DIVERSE COMMITTEE, AF, POLICE AND ARMY UNITS. THE STAR OF THE COMMITTEE MILITIA GROUPS IS ON THE WANE, BUT IT IS STILL NOT CLEAR WHETHER OTHER OFFICIAL UNITS ARE WILLING OR ABLE TO ASSUME SECURITY RESPONSIBILITIES.

GIVEN THE EXAMPLE OF DAILY EXECUTIONS OF POLICE AND MILITARY OF ALL RANKS WHO FIRED AT REVOLUTIONARY MOBS IN THE PAST, IT SEEMS DOUBTFUL THAT ANY ORGANIZED SECURITY FORCE WOULD EFFECTIVELY OBEY SUCH HARSH ORDERS TODAY. COMMITTEE MILITIA GROUPS ARE NOT SO RETICENT. FIRING HAS BEEN REPORTED IN SEVERAL CITIES. EARLIER THIS WEEK COMMITTEE MILITIA FIRED ON DEMONSTRATORS IN MASJED-E-SOLEIMAN, AND SIMILAR STORIES ARE CIRCULATING ABOUT COMMITTEE ATTEMPTS TO PUT DOWN OTHER DEMONSTRATING GROUPS. REVOLUTIONARY FORCES ALSO APPARENTLY FIRED ON AND KILLED SOME LABORERS IN ISFAHAN IN EARLY APRIL.

THE MULTIPLICATION OF ARMED AND DISCIPLINED POLITICAL GROUPS, THE POSSESSION OF STOLEN WEAPONS BY THOUSANDS OF INDIVIDUALS, AND ALL THE PROBLEMS INHERENT IN A COLLAPSING ECONOMY MAKE THE SECURITY PROSPECTS GRIM FOR THE FORESEEABLE FUTURE. NAAS

SUMMARY: ARREST OF AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI'S SONS AND THE AYATOLLAH'S SUBSEQUENT DISAPPEARANCE HAS BROUGHT OUT INTO THE OPEN TENSIONS AND SPLITS WITHIN THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT WHICH WERE NEVER FAR FROM THE SURFACE. IT HAS ALSO REVEALED SOME WEAKNESS OF KHOMEINI IN POLITICAL ARENA. GROUP ALLEGIANCES CHANGE FREQUENTLY AND REVERBERATIONS OF INCIDENT WILL CONTINUE TO AFFECT POLITICS. FOR MOMENT, MOST IMPORTANT GROUP, ACCORDING TO EXCELLENT SOURCE, IS LITTLE-KNOWN ISLAMIC FEDAYEEN (FEDAYAN-EISLAM), WHICH HAS OFTEN BEEN CONFUSED WITH BOTH MUJAHIDDIN AND LEFTIST FEDAYEEN. END SUMMARY.

PAST FIVE DAYS HAVE SEEN CONTINUED PROTEST MARCHES OVER TREATMENT METED OUT TO AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI'S SONS WHO WERE ARRESTED AND MANHANDLED APRIL 12. REFTEL GIVES STORY OF INCIDENT; THIS CABLE DISCUSSES IMPLICATIONS FOR THE GREATER POLITICAL ARENA.

MOST IMPORTANT RESULT HAS BEEN SURFACING OF SO-FAR WELL-DISGUISED SPLIT IN ISLAMIC RANKS BETWEEN KHOMEINI AND HIS BROTHER AYATOLLAHS SUCH AS TALEGHANI AND SHARIATMADARI, BOTH OF WHOM REMAINED IN-COUNTRY FOR PAST 16 YEARS (TALEGHANI SPENT TEN YEARS IN PRISON AS WELL). TALEGHANI HAS BECOME STEADILY MORE DISGUSTED WITH KHOMEINI RADICALISM AS COMMITTEE STRUCTURE FAILED TO DIE AWAY. TALEGHANI AND HIS CHILDREN, AT LEAST TWO OF WHOM HAVE SOLID LINKS WITH LEFTIST FEDAYEEN GROUPS, HAVE BEEN WORKHORSES OF REVOLUTION AND REPORTEDLY WERE SEEN AS POTENTIAL THREAT TO KHOMEINI, WHO, ON ONE ACCOUNT, ORDERED THE ARRESTS.

SOURCE VERY CLOSE TO KHOMEINI WHO HAS BEEN ON TARGET CONSISTENTLY TOLD ACTING POLCHIEF THAT TALEGHANI MET WITH KHOMEINI APRIL 18 AND 19 AND REOPENED HIS OFFICE AND COMMITTEE IN TEHRAN APRIL 19--BUT GUESSES TALEGHANI WILL EMERGE AS MODERATE CHALLENGER (WITH HELP OF AYATOLLAH SHARIAT-MADARI) AS ELECTIONS APPROACH. TALEGHANI'S DECAMPING FROM TEHRAN DREW SUPPORT FROM VIRTUALLY ALL LEFTIST GROUPS, SCHOOL CHILDREN (ORGANIZED BY TEACHER'S UNION), RADIO AND TV EMPLOYEES, AND OTHERS. PERHAPS POTENTIALLY MOST IMPORTANT OUTCOME WAS DE FACTO ALLIANCE BETWEEN MATIN-DAFTARI'S NATIONAL DEMOCRATIC FRONT (NDF) AND OTHER MARCHERS.
IF NDF AND NATIONAL FRONT (NF), NOW AGAIN BEING ACTIVELY LED BY SANJABI, CAN IN FACT LINK UP WITH TALEGHANI ORGANIZATION, THIS COULD POSE INTERESTING THREAT TO THE BAZARGAN-KHOMEINI AXIS.

ANOTHER MAJOR RESULT OF PUBLIC SPLIT BETWEEN TALEGHANI AND KHOMEINI HAS BEEN SHARP INCREASE IN CRITICISM PUBLICLY DIRECTED AGAINST GOVERNMENT. SOURCE CLOSE TO KHOMEINI SAID EVEN LOYALISTS ARE DESPAIRING OF ACTION FROM PGOI. YAZDI'S EFFORTS TO FORM LOYALIST ARMED GROUP CALLED REVOLUTIONARY GUARDIANS CORPS (SEPAH-YEPOSDARAN-INQUILAB) AS THE ELITE STRIKE FORCE OF THE REGIME HAVE EARNED HIM SERIOUS DISTRUST AMONG OTHER GROUPS. YAZDI IS ALSO COMING UNDER FIRE FROM MIDDLE CLASS FOR HIS ROLE AS COORDINATOR OF REVOLUTIONARY TRIALS. (NO-WIN DIVISION: GOSSIP HERE HAS IT THAT TRIALS AND EXECUTIONS ARE U.S. PLOT TO REMOVE EVIDENCE OF U.S. PRESENCE ORCHESTRATED BY ARCH-U.S.

CIA AGENT YAZDI....) FAMILIES WHO HAVE LOST BREADWINNERS AND OTHERS ARE DEVELOPING ACTIVE HATRED FOR YAZDI,KHOMEINI AND REVOLUTION. SEVERAL SOURCES CLOSE TO RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP REGARD EXECUTIONS AS SERIOUS KHOMEINI MISTAKE THAT WILL ULTIMATELY UNDERCUT REVOLUTION AND COULD EVEN LEAD TO "SLAUGHTER OF MULLAHS," AND CYCLE OF REVENGE ON REVENGE.

TALEGHANI INCIDENT ALSO BROUGHT TO LIGHT CONFUSION AMONG AND WITHIN MAJOR GROUPS. HARDLINE RIGHTIST GROUP CALLING ITSELF MUJAHIDDIN OF THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTION (ARUJAHIDDIN-E-INQUILAB-ISLAMI) CALLED UPON PEOPLE NOT TO MARCH FOR TALEGHANI; THIS WAS CONFUSED WITH "TRADITIONAL MUJAHIDDIN" (MUJAHIDDIN-KHALQ) WHO DENIED CALLING FOR MARCH. LATTER GROUP ON APRIL 18 SUGGESTED ALL ISLAMIC GUERRILLAS TO BE PLACED UNDER TALEGHANI CONTROL.

SOURCE VERY CLOSE TO KHOMEINI, WHEN ASKED TO DESCRIBE GROUPS, SPOKE OF BOTH MUJAHIDDIN GROUPS, LEFTIST ------------------014275 201002Z /10 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 0988 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 04138 FEDAYEEN, THEN SAID MOST IMPORTANT GROUP OF ALL IS VIRTUALLY UNKNOWN OUTSIDE RANKS OF MOVEMENT ITSELF: "ISLAMIC FEDAYEEN" (FEDAYAN-E-ESLAM), IS SMALL GROUP OF MEN, ALMOST ALL OF WHOM WERE IN PRISON AND TORTURED, WHO MAN KEY POSITIONS IN KHOMEINI ENTOURAGE AND REVOLUTIONARY COURT STRUCTURE. SOURCE DECLINED TO GO MUCH BEYOND THIS, BUT SAID EVERY MAJOR STRONGPOINT IN TEHRAN HAD AT LEAST ONE "FEDAYAN" SPRINKLED AMONG RANKS OF OTHER GROUPS.

ONLY IDENTIFIABLE LINK SOURCE WAS ENCOURAGE TO PRODUCE WAS NAME OF HOJATOLLAHISLAM (FNU) KHALKHALI, WHO IS KEY MAN AT KHOMEINI COURT. KHALKHALI WAS DESCRIBED AS RABIDLY ANTI-WEST RELIGIOUS FANATIC WHO BELIEVES THERE SHOULD BE SUBSTANTIAL MASSACRE OF OPPONENTS OF OLD REGIME FOR GLORY OF ALLAH. SOURCE, WHO DINED WITH KHOMEINI FAMILY ON TWO OCCASIONS LAST WEEKEND, FOUND KHOMEINI'S DAUGHTER AGREEING WITH KHALKHALI ON NEED FOR EXECUTIONS AND ARGUING THAT ALL WHO FAILED TO DENOUNCE SHAH'S REGIME WHILE LIVING IN IRAN BEFORE REVOLUTION SHOULD BE BARRED FROM SENIOR GOVERNMENT POSITIONS.

(COMMENT: MOST CURRENT MINISTERS DO HAVE SOME SORT OF PRISON RECORDS.) SOURCE WAS VERY MUCH SURPRISED AT FANATICISM WHICH ABOUNDS AT KHOMEINI "COURT" IN QOM, AND LIKENED ATTITUDES OF SYCOPHANCY TO THOSE PREVAILING AT PAHLAVI COURT IN LATTER 8-10 YEARS OF OLD REGIME.

SEVERAL INDIVIDUALS, INCLUDING SOURCE NAMED ABOVE AND MASHALLAH, EMBASSY'S SENIOR MUJAHIDDIN WHO VISITED KHOMEINI A WEEK AGO, HAVE SAID KHOMEINI'S HEALTH IS NOT GOOD. REPERCUSSIONS OF TALEGHANI INCIDENTS AND POLITICALLY JOCKEYING WHICH HAS EDGED INTO OPEN WILL CONTINUE. SHOULD GOD'S SPOKESMAN DEPART THIS MORTAL TOIL, ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY MOVEMENT WOULD LOSE ITS ONLY (THUS FAR) CHARISMATIC UNIFYING CEMENT. ONE SAGE SECULAR PERSIAN OBSERVER OF POLITICAL SCENE HAS SUGGESTED THAT WHAT WE ARE SEEING IS THE BEGINNING OF MANEUVERING FOR POSITION IN POST-KHOMEINI IRAN. HE MAY WELL BE RIGHT. NAAS

SUMMARY: IRANIANS' VIEWS OF U.S. HAVE TAKEN A DISTINCT NEGATIVE TURN. MANY OF OUR FRIENDS ARE DISILLUSIONED, MANY ARE AFRAID TO HAVE OPEN CONTACT WITH US. OUR ENEMIES ARE JUBILANT AND AGGRESSIVELY ANTI-AMERICAN. EVEN THOUGH APPOINTMENT OF NEW U.S. AMBASSADOR OFFERS A CHANCE TO PUT MUCH BEHIND US, U.S. - IRAN TIES ARE NOT LIKELY TO APPROACH THE INTIMACY OF THE PAST. WE SHOULD BEGIN OUR ADJUSTMENT TO THIS NOW TO MINIMIZE POLICY DISLOCATION AND MAXIMIZE WHAT WE MAY BE ABLE TO DO UNDER NEW, MORE LIMITED CIRCUMSTANCES. END SUMMARY.

EMBASSY IS EXTREMELY GRATEFUL FOR CONCERN EXPRESSED BY SECRETARIES VANCE AND NEWSOM AND ASST. SEC. SAUNDERS OVER CURRENT CONDITIONS IN IRAN. AT SAME TIME, HIGH LEVEL SURPRISE OVER ATTITUDES WHICH HAVE BEEN EVOLVING OVER SOME TIME HAVE MADE US ACUTELY AWARE HOW DIFFICULT IT IS TO COMMUNICATE ACCURATELY TO THOSE OUTSIDE THIS RATHER UNUSUAL AND SOMEWHAT ANARCHIC ENVIRONMENT WHAT IS EVOLVING HERE. WE OURSELVES HAVE HAD PROBLEMS ANALYZING AND FULLY COMPREHENDING CHANGES NOW UNDERWAY HERE. THOSE OF US WHO HAVE RECENTLY RETURNED FROM U.S. VISITATION LEAVE PROBABLY FEEL THIS MOST ACUTELY.

IN THE SPIRIT OF TAKING ANOTHER STEP FORWARD TOWARD UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND DRAWING APPROPRIATE CONCLUSIONS FROM IT, THE FOLLOWING IS OFFERED AS A SHORT SNAPSHOT UNQUOTE OF WHERE WE ARE. THIS VIEW IS SHARED BY ALL OUR REPORTING OFFICERS WHO HAVE CONTACT WITH IRANIANS (GOING BACK 3 TO 4 YEARS IN SOME CASES.

AS A RESULT OF EVENTS OF THE PAST EIGHT MONTHS, MANY OF OUR FRIENDS ARE VERY DISILLUSIONED BY RECENT EVENTS AND MANY ARE FRIGHTENED TO HAVE CONTACT WITH US. LONGSTANDING PERSONAL RELATIONSHIPS ARE STILL FRIENDLY, BUT ALMOST ALL IRANIANS SUBSCRIBE TO ONE OF THE WILDER CONSPIRACY THEORIES (OUR CLEVERNESS AT FOMENTING THE KHOMEINI REVOLUTION FOR ANTI-COMMUNIST PURPOSES). OUR ENEMIES AND THOSE HOSTILE TO US (A SOLID MAJORITY OF THE COUNTRY) ARE JUBILANT. EGGED ON BY THOSE WHO TRULY HATE US ON BOTH RIGHT AND LEFT, THEY ARE CREATING A CLIMATE WHERE ASSOCIATION WITH ANYTHING AMERICAN IS TRAITOROUS, ANTI-ISLAMIC, AND EVIL.

ISLAMIC ATTEMPTS TO PURIFY UNQUOTE IRAN FROM WESTERN CULTURAL, POLITICAL, ECONOMIC, AND SOCIAL INFULENCE ARE TURNING INTO A WITCH HUNT WHEREIN GUILT BY ASSOCIATION WITH AMERICANS IS ENOUGH TO CAST UNDER SUSPICION OR TO CONDEMN. WE ARE GENERALLY VIEWED, EVEN BY OUR FRIENDS, AS WEAK AND INEFFECTIVE. IT IS HEARTENING THAT THERE REMAIN PEOPLE WHO, DESPITE SUBSTANTIAL HOSTILE PRESSURE, WILL TAKE SIGNIFICANT PERSONAL RISKS TO TALK TO LONG-TIME AMERICAN FRIENDS. THEY DO NOT WISH TO RECEIVE AMERICANS IN THEIR OFFICES, OR HAVE EMBASSY CARS PARKED OUTSIDE THEIR HOMES; SOME WILL TAKE THE INITIATIVE TO MEET AT RESTAURANTS OR ON NEUTRAL GROUNDS.

IN MANY CASES SUCH PEOPLE ARE BEING EASED OUT OF INFLUENTIAL POSITIONS, AND INFORMATION WHICH WAS AVAILABLE TO US THROUGH A TELEPHONE CALL IS BECOMING UNAVAILABLE TO US BY ANY MEANS SHORT OF COVERT ACTION. OUR FEW REMAINING PRIVATE SECTOR COLLEAGUES HAVE EXPERIENCED MUCH THE SAME THING TO A DEGREE WHICH SUGGESTS THE PHENOMENON IS NEARLY UNIVERSAL AND SYSTEMATIC.

HISTORY IS LIKELY TO TREAT US MORE KINDLY THAN CONTEMPORARY OPINION, BUT THE REVOLUTIONARY TRAUMA, DISCRETELY AND ABLY ABETTED BY HOSTILE PROPAGANDA HAS EFFECTIVELY AND SUBSTANTIALLY DIMINISHED OUR HISTORIC INFLUENCE HERE FOR SOME TIME TO COME. WE WILL NEVER GET CREDIT FOR REMAINING UNINVOLVED IN DOMESTIC POLITICS. NO PERSIAN TRULY BELIEVES WE HAVE NOT BEEN, AND IF THEY SAY THEY DO, THEY THEN SAY THEY ARE APPALLED BY WHAT THEY VIEW AS OUR CAVALIER DISREGARD OF OUR (AND THEIR) VITAL INTERESTS. THERE IS ENOUGH CIRCUMSTANTIAL EVIDENCE (HUYSER VISIT, TRIAL TESTIMONY BY THOSE SEEKING TO SAVE THEIR OWN SKINS, ETC.) TO SUPPORT ALMOST ANY PROPOSITION.

EVEN THOSE WHO KNOW OF OUR FOREBEARANCE HAVE NO INTEREST IN CLARIFYING THE RECORD. THE SUCCESSFUL REVOLUTIONARIES -- YAZDI, ENTEZAM, BAZARGAN -- CERTAINLY DO NOT, AND THE KHOMEINI ENTOURAGE WOULD BE FANATICALLY OPPOSED TO IT. WE BELIEVE ONE OF THE MAIN REASONS FOR KHOMEINI'S VENGEFUL HOSTILITY IS THAT HE HAS, OVER THE PAST THREE MONTHS IN IRAN, DISCOVERED JUST HOW DEEP U.S. TIES WITH IRAN REALLY EXTEND -- HIS CARS ARE AMERICAN, HIS CLOSEST ASSOCIATES' CHILDREN ARE SCHOOLING IN THE U.S.; HE HAS PROBABLY EVEN BEEN APPROACHED BY CLOSE FRIENDS ASKING HIM TO INTERCEDE WITH THE U.S. EMBASSY FOR VISAS* ALL THIS MUST BE PARTICULARLY GALLING.
( ADS ) W ------------------080141 252345Z /15 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 0999 SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 04158

WHAT WE MUST DO IS ROLL WITH THE PUNCH FOR A WHILE. YAZDI AND ENTEZAM HAVE BOTH SPOKEN TO CHARGE ABOUT THE NEW BEGINNING UNQUOTE WHICH THE AMBASSADOR'S ARRIVAL WILL OFFER. OTHER CONTACTS IN THE RELIGIOUS COMMUNITY HAVE SIMILARLY HINTED TO OTHER EMBOFFS OF THE OPPORTUNITY THIS WILL PROVIDE. ALL HAVE URGED THAT IT OCCUR AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. IT WILL BE SEEN IN IRAN AS A WATERSHED FROM OLD TO NEW -- NEVER MIND THAT IT WILL BE PART COSMETIC; THAT IS EXACTLY WHAT IS REQUIRED TO BEGIN THE NORMALIZATION PROCESS.

WE WILL BE COMMENTING IN THE COMING WEEK ON FUNDAMENTAL PROBLEMS THIS REGIME OR ANY REGIME IN IRAN FACES. IT IS CLEAR, HOWEVER, THAT IRAN-U.S. RELATIONS HAVE CHANGED FROM INTIMATE TO CORRECT (IF THAT). THIS WILL ENTAIL CONCEPTUAL RETOOLING, AS WELL AS BUREAUCRATIC READJUSTMENT, TO MINIMIZE ADVERSE EFFECTS ON OUR POLICY HERE AND IN THE REGION AND TO MAXIMIZE WHAT WE MAY BE ABLE TO DO IN NEW, MORE (FOR RIGHT NOW, MUCH MORE) LIMITED CIRCUMSTANCES.

1979TEHRAN04191.subject: FOREIGN OFFICE THREAT RE SANCTUARY FOR SHAH

segments.text: FON OFFICE ISSUED FOLLOWING STATEMENT TODAY, ACCORDING TO TEHRAN RADIO: --THE IRANIAN FOREIGN MINISTRY HAS STRESSED TO THE MEXICAN AND U.S. GOVERNMENTS THAT THE PASSPORTS HELD BY THE FORMER SHAH, HIS FAMILY AND ENTOURAGE ARE NOT VALID. IT ADDED THAT ANY VISA OR ASYLUM GIVEN BY THE SAID GOVERNMENTS WOULD BE CONSTRUED AS AN UNFRIENDLY ACT BY THE IRANIAN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC AND WOULD ADVERSELY AFFECT IRAN'S RELATIONS WITH THOSE COUNTRIES.
MATTER HAS NOT BEEN RAISED WITH ME DURING MY FREQUENT VISITS TO FON OFFICE. NAAS

1979TEHRAN04230.subject: REZA SADR WILL NOT BE IRANIAN AMBASSADOR TO U.S.

segments.text: IN PRIVATE CONVERSATION WITH MINISTER OF COMMERCE REZA SADR ON APRIL 23 HE INFORMED ME THAT AT HIS REQUEST PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN HAD AGREED NOT TO SEND HIM AS AMBASSADOR TO U.S. THEREFORE, POTENTIAL CONFLICT WITH HIS STATUS IN U.S. DID NOT ARISE. HE APPEARED SURPRISED THAT I DID NOT KNOW OF THIS CHANGE IN PLANS AND SAID THAT HE WOULD HAVE FOREIGN MINISTRY INFORM US OFFICIALLY. HE SAID THAT ON REFLECTION, AFTER REQUEST FOR AGREMENT HAD BEEN SUBMITTED, HE BELIEVED HE COULD DO MORE FOR HIS COUNTRY BY REMAINING AS MINISTER OF COMMERCE. NAAS

1979TEHRAN04231.subject: KHOMEINI ANTI-AMERICAN STATEMENTS MEETING WITH COMMERCE MINISTER. IN PRIVATE SESSION WITH MINISTER OF COMMERCE REZA

segments.text: COMMERCE MINISTER. IN PRIVATE SESSION WITH MINISTER OF COMMERCE REZA SADR FOLLOWING COMPLETION OF OTHER MATTERS (SEPTELS) I AGAIN ADVERTED TO THE WIDESPREAD ANTI-AMERICAN PROPAGANDA IN THE COUNTRY AND SAID THAT MY GOVERNMENT WAS PARTICULARLY CONCERNED BY THE EXTREME STATEMENTS OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI. I ASKED THAT OUR FIRM DENIAL OF ANY INTERFERENCE IN IRAN'S INTERNAL AFFAIRS AND OUR DESIRE FOR NORMALIZATION OF RELATIONS BETWEEN OUR TWO COUNTRIES BE BROUGHT DIRECTLY TO THE AYATOLLAH. REZA SADR, WHO HAS BEEN CLOSE TO KHOMEINI IN THE PAST, SAID THAT HE WOULD PERSONALLY UNDERTAKE THIS TASK. NAAS
(C - ENTIRE TEXT, THIS IS A REPORTING TELEGRAM.)

A NON-IRANIAN WHO HAS LIVED IN IRAN SEVERAL YEARS AND SPEAKS FLUENT FARSI RECENTLY HAD OVER AN HOUR PRIVATELY WITH SHARIATMADERI. THE LATTER STATED VERY CANDIDLY THAT HE WAS HIGHLY DISAPPOINTED BY THE ACTIVITIES OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS. HE HOPES THAT THE WESTERN WORLD WILL NOT INTERPRET THESE ACTIONS AS THE REAL ESSENCE OF ISLAM. IN HIS VIEW THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS WERE ILLEGAL AND UN-ISLAMIC AND HE, THEREFORE, WAS NOT PARTICIPATING IN THE ACTIONS OF THE COURT NOR WAS HE PLAYING ANY ROLE IN THE GOVERNMENT.

IRAN TODAY, HE CONTINUED, IS NOT OPERATING ON THE BASIS OF THOUGHT BUT RATHER ON FEEL; THE CURRENT ANTIAMERICAN SENTIMENT WAS AN EXAMPLE OF THIS. HE EXPRESSED THE HOPE THAT THE UNITED STATES DOES NOT ACCEPT THE PRESENT WIDESPREAD ANTI-AMERICANISM AS REPRESENTING THE GENUINE FEELING OF IRAN. HE CAREFULLY NOTED THAT AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI'S STATEMENTS WERE TO A LARGE DEGREE RESPONSIBLE FOR THE ANTI-AMERICAN ATTITUDE. WHEN THE IRANIAN PEOPLE COME TO THEIR SENSES, THEY WILL WANT CLOSE U.S.-IRAN FRIENDSHIP TO CONTINUE, ALTHOUGH THE RELATIONSHIP WILL BE DIFFERENT THAN IT WAS IN THE PAST.

HE SAID THAT AMERICANS COULD HELP THEMSELVES IN THIS DIFFICULT PERIOD BY EMPHASIZING THAT THE ARMS PURCHASED BY IRAN WERE NOT FORCED ON IRAN: THE U.S. WAS ONLY RESPONDING TO THE REQUEST OF A SOVEREIGN GOVERNMENT. HE ADDED THAT WE SHOULD CAREFULLY LOOK FOR GESTURES WHICH COULD BE MADE TO STRENGTHEN AMERICA'S FRIENDS IN THE COUNTRY AND TO COUNTERACT THE PROPAGANDA. THE U.S. GOVERNMENT SHOULD GENERATE, HE THOUGHT, SOME POSITIVE PUBLICITY ABOUT CURRENT U.S. ATTITUDES TOWARD IRAN.

ONTHE DOMESTIC FRONT HE SAID THAT THE MASS OF PEOPLE WAS VERY UNHAPPY WITH THE WAY THE REVOLUTION HAD GONE AND THIS DISCONENT WAS WIDESPREAD. HE FEARD THAT THE LEFT WILL BE ABLE TO CAPITALIZE ON THE STATE OF MIND OF THE IRANIAN PEOPLE.

OUR SOURCE, FOR WHOM THIS WAS A FIRST MEETING WITH SHARIATMADERI, WAS DEEPLY IMPRESSES BY THE AYATOLLAH'S SERENITY, ALERTNESS AND QUICK WIT. AT NO POINT DID HE DIRECTLY ATTACK KHOMEINI BUT CAREFULLY MADE IT PERFECTLY CLEAR THAT HE HAS LITTLE SYMPATHY FOR HIM.

OUR SOURCE ALSO ADDED THE FOLLOWING PERSONAL OBSERVATIONS BASED ON HIS TIES TO THE SHARIATMADERI CAMP. HE BELIEVED THAT AYATOLLAHS MARASCHI AND GOLPAYEGANI WERE PARTICULARLY CLOSE TO SHARIATMADERI. THE RUMOR IN QOM WAS THAT AT ONE POINT SHARIATMADERI HAD THREATENED TO MOVE TO TABRIZ BUT KHOMEINI HAD ORDERED HIM TO STAY IN QOM OR GO TO NAJJAF. ACCORDING TO INFORMATION PICKED UP IN QOM AND TEHRAN, WHEN THE SON OF KHOMEINI AND GOLPAYEGANI CALED ON SHARIATMADERI LAST WEEK, A PROPOSAL FROM KHOMEINI WAS MADE THAT A SHORA (ASSEMBLY) WAS INTERPRETED AS A FURTHER SIGN OF WEAKNESS OF KHOMEINI AND SHARIATMADERI REJECTED ANY PARTICIPATION IN THE ASSEMBLY.

MOST OF THE IRANIANS WITH WHOM OUR SOURCE IS IN TOUCH BELIEVE THAT TALEGHANI LOST GROUND AND SOME OF HIS STATUS BECAUSE OF HIS RECENT TRIP TO QOM TO SEE KHOMEINI, FOLLOWING THE BRIEF DISAPPEARANCE OF TALEGHANI FROM TEHRAN AT THE TIME OF THE ABDUCTIUON OF HIS TWO SONS. THE STATEMENTS MADE BY TALEGHANI AND KHOMEINI FOLLOWING THE MEETING INDICATED THAT TALEGHANI HAD NOT MADE MUCH HEADWAY. AT THE SAME TIME, MOST SOURCES BELIEVE THAT THE RECONCILIATION BETWEEN THE TWO AYATOLLAHS IS SUPERFICIAL AND THAT A SPLIT WILL REAPPEAR BEFORE LONG. NAAS

1979TEHRAN04260.subject: MEETING WITH DEPUTY MINISTER OF INFORMATION, MEHDI MOMKEN

segments.text: MEHDI MOMKEN REFERENCE: TEHRAN 3600, TEHRAN 3968, TEHRAN 4093 SUMMARY: IN COURTESY CALL ON DEPUTY MININFO MOMKEN PRESS ATTACHE DISCUSSED NEW PRESS REGULATIONS AND FOUND HIM AND OTHERS ASSEMBLED AT MEET HOLDING STRONG ANTIPATHY FOR RECENT U.S. POLICY IN IRAN. MOMKEN ACCOMODATING RE HIS MINISTRY'S ROLE AS CLEARING HOUSE FOR COMPLAINTS ABOUT PERSIAN PRESS COVERAGE OF U.S.IRAN RELATIONSHIP. ALTHOUGH U.S. POLICY VIS A VIS IRAN UNFATHOMABLE TO MOMKEN ET AL BILATERAL IMPERATIVES MAY PROVE TO BE BRIDGE TO FUTURE RELATIONSHIP. END

ON MONDAY APRIL 23, PRESS ATTACHE ROSEN PAID COURTESY CALL ON DR. MEHDI MOMKEN, DEPUTY MININFO, LATER JOINED BY ABOLGHASSEM SADEGH, FORMER REGIME HOLDOVER IN CHARGE OF DOMESTIC NEWS DEPARTMENT, MUHAMMAD REZA SHARIF, ACTING MANAGING DIRECTOR OF PARS, AND MR. ALI MAHANI, CONSULTANT TO MINISTRY WHO HAS LIVED IN THE U.S. FOR MANY YEARS. THE MEETING COULD BE CHARACTERIZED AS FRIENDLY BUT CORRECT AND BUSINESSLIKE WITH THE IRANIANS VERY DEFINITELY PUSHING AN ASSERTIVE AND VINDICTIVE LINE VIS A VIS U.S. PRESS AND CARTER ADMINISTRATION POLICY IN IRAN.

THE MEETING BEGAN WITH DR. MOMKEN DESCRIBING THE MINISTRY'S INTENTIONS TO PROVIDE SOME ORDER IN THE BURGEONING PRESS INDUSTRY IN IRAN. HE MADE IT QUITE CLEAR THAT THE PGOI WAS IN NO POSITION TO ACT OR DID IT WANT TO CONTROL THE PRINT MEDIA. HOWEVER, HE ADDED WITH THE END OF AN ERA IN WHICH THE PRESS WAS UNDER THE HAMMER (ZIR-E CHUMAQ) WE ARE NOW LIVING THROUGH AN INTERREGNUM WHEREIN NEWSPAPERS AND REPORTERS ARE, IN SOME INSTANCES, GOING BEYOND WHAT IS CONSIDERED GOOD JUDGEMENT, WITNESS THE RECENT SPATE OF SCANDAL TABLOIDS ILLUSTRATING PAHLAVI EXCESSES.

THE DEPUTY MININFO SAID HE HAS PREPARED A BILL FOR THE PRIME MINISTER WHEREIN THE PRESS WILL BE ENCOURAGED TO FORM A PRESS ASSOCIATION (KANUN-E MATBUAT) MADE UP OF REPRESENTATIVES OF THE INDUSTRY ACTING AS A REGULATING BODY. IN THE EVENT THIS SELF-REGULATING SYSTEM FALTERS THE GOVERNMENT WILL TURN TO THE PUBLIC PROSECUTOR'S OFFICE AND THE MINISTRY OF JUSTICE ON A CASE BY CASE BASIS. AT THIS JUNCTURE MOMKEN DOES NOT INTEND TO BAR ANY NEWSPAPERS FROM PUBLISHING BUT WITH THE ADVENT OF THE NEW CONSTITUTION HE DOES FORESEE SOME LIMITATION OF GOVERNMENT PERMITS.

MOMKEN WAS QUITE CANDID RE THE VIRULENTLY ANTIAMERICAN COMPAIGN IN THE PERSIAN PRESS AND ASSURED THE PRESS ATTACHE THAT TIME, PATIENCE AND EDUCATION ARE INTEGRAL TO DEVELOPING AN "IMPARTIAL" (BITARAF) PRESS. WITH THAT GAMBIT PRESS ATTACHE BROUGHT UP THE UNSOURCED AND UNBYLINED ARTICLES APPEARING KAYHAN DURING THE FIRST HALF OF APRIL WHICH ACCUSED THE U.S. OF CONTRIVING EXTENSIVE PLOTS TO DESTROY THE IRANIAN POLITICAL AND RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP. AS SUGGESTED BY MR. SADEGH DR. MOMKEN SAID THE MINISTRY OF INFORMATION AND HE PERSONALLY CAN SERVE AS A CLEARING HOUSE FOR ANY LEGITIMATE COMPLAINTS RE PERSIAN PRESS COVERAGE AND ASKED ROSEN TO SEND A CARBON COPY OF ANY CORRESPONDENCE TO THE MFA.

DISCUSSING HIS OWN CAREER MOMKEN ADMITTED SPENDING SOME TIME IN JAIL AS A POLITICAL PRISONER. ALTHOUGH IT WAS THE PAHLAVI DYNASTY WHICH ACTUALLY IMPRISONED HIM HE BLAMES THE U.S. FOR THE RESERVOIR OF DISTRUST BETWEEN THE TWO COUNTRIES. HE CANNOT, HE SAID, AS AN INDIVIDUAL OR A MEMBER OF THE IRANIAN NATION UNDERSTAND THE FOREIGN POLICY OF A SUPERPOWER WHICH SUPPORTED THE SHAH, BAKHTIAR AND KHOMEINI ALL WITHIN A TWO MONTH PERIOD. MAHANI CHIMED IN ACCUSING THE U.S. PRESS OF WORKING IN TANDEM WITH THE CARTER ADMINISTRATION, WITNESS THEIR DUPLICITY RE HUMAN RIGHTS. SADEGH FELT THAT THE U.S.

1979TEHRAN04302.subject: LOOKING AHEAD: THE BEDROCK PROBLEMS;PART I

segments.text: TEHRAN 2681 NOTAL; D) TEHRAN 4138 NOTAL S-ENTIRE TEXT

SUMMARY: FIRST BLUSH OF ISLAMIC REVOLUTION IS OVER AND WE ARE IN A BETTER POSITION TO SUGGEST OUTLINE OF FUNDAMENTAL PROBLEMS TO BE CONTENDED WITH IN THE FUTURE. BASIC QUESTIONS OF LEGITIMACY, AUTHORITY, ALLOCATION OF SOCIAL AND ECONOMIC RESOURCES AND THE ORGANIZATION OF POWER ARE AT ISSUE. FROM A UNITARY MONARCHY WHICH MADE IRAN APPEAR MORE UNIFIED THAN IT WAS AND IS, THE COUNTRY IS NOW HIGHLY FRAGMENTED IN TERMS OF POWER SOCIAL, POLITICAL, AND ECONOMIC VALUES AND ORGANIZATION. THOSE SEEKING POWER WILL HAVE TO ESTABLISH LEGITIMACY, ORGANIZE THEMSELVES TO PULL INTERESTS TOGETHER FOR SOME UNITY OF PURPOSE, BUILD A POWER BASE.

THEY WILL HAVE TO EITHER DEVELOP AND CARRY OUT POLICIES TO FULFILL THE VALUE EXPECTATIONS OF PEOPLE WHO THEMSELVES ARE SHARPLY DIVIDED ABOUT WHAT THEY WANT, OR ATTEMPT TO ALTER EXPECTATIONS, PERHAPS WITH INTIMIDATION AND TERROR. END SUMMARY.

ANALYSING BASIC PROBLEMS IN THE MIDDLE OF A REVOLUTION RESEMBLES BUILDING ASKYSCRAPPER ON QUICKSAND. NEVERTHELESS, THE FIRST BLUSH OF IRAN'S ISLAMIC REVOLUTION IS PAST AND IT IS POSSIBLE TO IDENTIFY SOME VERY FUNDAMENTAL PROBLEMS WHICH ANY REGIME OR GROUP WHICH SEEKS POWER WILL HAVE TO DEAL WITH. THIS CABLE ATTEMPTS TO IDENTIFY THE MAJOR PROBLEMS AND EXPLORE THEIR PARAMETERS, OUTLINE THE PRESENT SITUATION IN THE COUNTRY, AND OFFER A FEW TENTATIVE OBSERVATIONS ON HOW THE MAJOR PIECES RELATE AT THE MOMENT.

IRAN'S REVOLUTION, STEMMING ROUGHLY FROM SEPTEMBER 1977 TO THE PRESENT, SAW THE PROGRESSIVE EROSION OF LEGITIMACY AND AUTHORITY TO A POINT WHICH IS UNBELIEVABLE TO THOSE WHO KNEW IRAN PREVIOUSLY. THE PAHLAVI DYNASTY ENFORCED A DECEPTIVE UNITY OF BOTH VALUES AND ORGANIZATIUON IN THE COUNTRY; IN THIS SENSE IT WAS NOT DISSIMILAR TO STRONG DYNASTIES IN THE PAST. THE PROGRESSIVE DISMANTLING OF PAHLAVI RULE, BEGINNING WITH DEMONSTRATIONS IN QOM IN JANUARY 1978 FOLLOWED BY LOW LEVEL UNREST LEADING TO THE SEPT. JALEH SQUARE SHOOTINGS AND TO THE CHALLENGES TO GENERAL STRIKES AND STREET MOBS IN NOV.

1978 - FEB 1979 HAS VIRTUALLY PUT AN END TO ANY UNIFIED SENSE OF LEOITIMATE AUTHORITY. THE VICTORY OF THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT HAS NOT CHANGED THIS SITUATION; IN ADDITION TO THE PARALLEL GOVERNMENTAL STRUCTURE (REF A) OF THE BAZARGAN ADMINISTRATION AND THE KHOMEINI COMMITTEES AND FRICTION WITHIN THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT, THERE IS SUBSTANTIAL DISAGREEMENT BETWEEN THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT AND OTHER GROUPS IN SOCIETY, ON ALL MAJOR ISSUES. THE SHAH'S DEPARTURE REMOVED THE ONE ELEMENT ON WHICH THERE WAS A GENERAL CONCENSUS BY LATE FALL OR EARLY WINTER OF 1978.

EROSION OF LEGITIMACY HAS BEEN ACCOMPANIED (AND PUSHED ALONG) BY THE PUBLIC SURFACING OF DEEP DIVISION OVER BASIC VALUES (REF B AND C). PERHAPS THE MOST IMPORTANT OF THESE VALUE SPLITS ARE THOSE BETWEEN SECULAR AND RELIGIOUS LEADERS.

THE PUBLIC EMERGENCE IN THE PAST SEVERAL WEEKS OF THE MARXIST FEDAYEEN AND THE FORMATION OF THE NATIONAL DEMOCRATIC FRONT (NDF) AS POTENTIALLY CONSEQUENTIAL FORCES ARE INDICATIONS OF THIS SPLIT.

THESE VALUE DIVISIONS CUT ACROSS POLITICAL,CLASS AND AGE GROUP LINES. ARGUEMENTS BETWEEN THOSE WHO FAVOR THE CONCEPT OF A MODERN, WESTERNIZED SOCIETY TAKE PLACE IN BOTH RELIGIOUS AND SECULAR CAMPS, THOUGH THE WEIGHT OF THE MODERNIST GROUP IS GENERALLY AMONG THE SECULARISTS, JUST AS THE BULK OF THE TRADITIONALISTS ARE SOLIDLY BEHIND KHOMEINI. THE YOUNG SEEK PARTICIPATION, SOMETIMES OPTING FOR THE LEFT, SOMETIMES FOR THE RELIGIOUS SIDE OF THE POLITICAL FENCE. THEIR ELDERS TEND TO BE WARY OF REVOLUTIONARY FERVOR AND EXCESS, WHILE THOSE IN THEIR 20'S SUPPORT SUMMARY EXECUTIONS IN THE NAME OF REVOLUTION.

SUBSTANTIAL NUMBERS OF SUPPORTERS OF THE OLD REGIME EXIST; FOR THE MOMENT THEY ARE COWED, BUT THEY MAY NOT REMAIN SO (GEN QARANI'S ASSASSINATION SUGGESTS THEY MAY HAVE STARTED). FOR EXAMPLE, IN THE PROVINCES WE UNDERSTAND THERE IS MUCH GREATER EVIDENCE OF ACTIVITY BY SHAH SUPPORTERS.

THE BASIC IMPACT ON THE BODY POLITIC TO THIS POINT HAS BEEN AN UPLIFTING AND WIDESPREAD SENSE OF FREEDOM -POLITICAL DEBATE RAGES ON EVERY STREETCORNER AND IN EVERY CLASSROOM. THE SCENE IS A DAZZLING ONE, THOROUGHLY ENJOYED BY EVERYONE. PROBLEMS CREEP IN WHEN EFFORTS ARE MADE, OR ARE SEEN TO BE NECESSARY, TO ESTABLISH LEGITIMATE AUTHORITY FOR THE PURPOSE OF DEALING WITH SERIOUS DIFFICULTIES. MOVEMENT OFF THE PRESENT CENTER OF LOOSE FREEDOM REQUIRES ACTION TAKEN IN THE NAME OF LEGITIMATE GOVERNMENT, WITH THE ULTIMATE SANCTION OF FORCE. NO ONE CAN YET DO THIS.

THE PRESENT GOVERNMENT'S DIFFICULTIES CAN BE SHOWN BY TWO EXAMPLES: IN THE CASE OF THE ARMED UNITS LOYAL TO THE REVOLUTION, THEIR WILLINGNESS TO OBEY ORDERS TO FIRE DEPENDS UPON THE SITUATION. THERE HAVE BEEN AT LEAST THREE SITUATIONS IN WHICH REVOLUTIONARY TROOPS (MUJAHIDDIN) HAVE BEEN ORDERED TO FIRE ON DEMONSTRATORS AND REFUSED. RECONSTRUCTION OF THE REGULAR ARMED FORCES HAS NOT PROCEEDED TO THE POINT WHERE THEY CAN BE USED FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT AND MAINTENANCE OF CIVIL ORDER, EXCEPT IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES SUCH AS THE KURDISH AND TURKOMAN MINI-REVOLTS. IN BOTH INSTANCES, THE SITUATION HAS BEEN TOUCH AND GO.
RECENT FIGHTING IN NAGHADEH, WHERE PGOI FORCES WERE UNABLE TO ENTER THE CITY UNTIL A VERY SHAKY CEASEFIRE HAD BEEN ARRANGED IS A CASE IN POINT.

EXAMPLE TWO: THE DRAFT CONSTITUTION ILLUSTRATES THE PGOI'S EFFORTS TO COPE WITH WIDE DIFFERENCES OVER VALUES. A CONSTITUTIONAL COMMITTEE IS NOW TRYING TO HARMONIZE A DRAFT WRITTEN BY SECULAR-MINDED LAWYERS WITH ONE WRITTEN BY A TEAM OF RELIGIOUS LEADERS. THE TWO ARE FAR APART ON SUCH CENTRAL POINTS AS WHO SHALL EXERCISE SUPREME EXECUTIVE POWER, RELATIONS BETWEEN BRANCHES OF GOVERNMENT, THE FUNDAMENTAL SOURCE FOR LAWS, AND WHAT KIND OF HUMAN RIGHTS ARE APPROPRIATE FOR AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. THESE QUESTIONS INVOLVE MAJOR DIFFERENCES IN SOCIAL AND POLITICAL VALUES. IT IS QUESTIONABLE WHETHER SUCH DEEP VALUE DIVERGENCES CAN BE RESOLVED IN A DEMOCRATIC CONTEXT OF COMPROMISE AND BROKERING.

ANY GOVERNMENT TRYING TO GOVERN IRAN WILL BE FACED WITH A SIMILIAR PROBLEM. ANY MOVEMENT WHICH WANTS TO PLAY A ROLE IN POLITICAL LIFE MUST COPE WITH THIS DEEPLY SEATED SPLIT OVER VALUES AND EITHER USE FORCE EFFECTIVELY, COMPROMISE, OR FAIL.

THE BRIDGE BETWEEN LEGITIMACY AND AUTHORITY IN IRAN TODAY IS FOUND IN THE CHARISMATIC LEADERSHIP OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, BUT SUPPORTS FOR THIS BRIDGE ARE ERODING AND THE REFERENDUM IS NOT VIEWED BY MOST ASSANCTIONING HIS LEGITIMACY. KHOMEINI'S CHARISMA AND UNCOMPROMISING HOSTILITY TOWARD THE SHAH MADE HIM THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT LEADER IN IRAN. BUT HE IS NOT UNIVERSALLY LOVED AND GROUPS EVEN NOW ARE STARTING TO MOVE AGAINST HIM, HOWEVER OBLIQUELY (SOME DIRECTLY -- WITH DEATH TO KHOMEINI UNQUOTE CHANTS). KHOMEINI'S PROBLEM IS AUTHORITY. BECAUSE THERE IS NO UNIVERSALLY AGREED INSTITUTIONAL FRAMEWORK OF LEGITIMACY IN IRAN, THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT (PGOI) IS NOT RPT NOT THE EXCLUSIVE REPOSITORY OF LEGITIMATE AUTHORITY.

IT SHARES THIS ROLE (AND IS THE VERY JUNIOR PARTNER ON IMPORTANT QUESTIONS) WITH THE COMMITTEE STRUCTURE CREATED BY KHOMEINI. KHOMEINI IN GOOD SHIITE ANTI-AUTHORITARIAN TRADITION, HAS ATTACKED HIS OWN GOVERNMENT ON MORE THAN ONE OCCASION. THE TENSION BETWEEN PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN AND THE GOVERNMENT AND THE COMMITTEE STRUCTURE IS SUBSTANTIAL AND VISIBLE. IT FREQUENTLY LEAVES THE IRANIAN PEOPLE MYSTIFIED ABOUT THE TRUE SOURCE OF AUTHORITY. THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT BELIEVED THE PROBLEM OF LEGITIMATE AUTHORITY WOULD DISAPPEAR ONCE IT HAD WON THE REVOLUTION. IT IS NOW CLEAR TO ALL IN IRAN THAT IT REMAINS CRUCIAL TO THE QUESTION OF WHO ULTIMATELY CONTROLS THE REVOLUTION.

NO OTHER GROUP BESIDES THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT CAN MAKE A CLAIM WHICH WILL BE ACCEPTABLE TO AS MANY PEOPLE, BUT THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT HAS NOT BEEN ABLE TO IMPOSE ITS WILL ON THE NATION IN WAYS THAT OFFER PROSPECTS OF LONG TERM STABILITY. IRANIAN WOMEN, FOR EXAMPLE, REBELLED SUCCESSFULLY IN THE STREETS AGAINST KHOMEINI'S INJUNCTIONS ON DRESS, ETC.

WHICH BRINGS UP THE QUESTION OF POWER--POWER TO INSURE OBEDIENCE, MILITARY POWER TO DEFEND THE COUNTRY AND THE GOVERNMENT, AND THE ABILITY TO ORDER THINGS DONE WITH A REASONABLE EXPECTATION THAT THEY WILL BE DONE. IF THERE IS NO VALUE CONSENSUS, THEN QUESTIONS OF FORCE BECOME DOUBLY IMPORTANT--CAN ONE OF THE CONTENDERS IMPOSE ITS WILL ON ALL OTHERS? THE UNIQUE FEATURE OF ISLAMIC REVOLUTION TO DATE HAS BEEN THAT IT ENCOMPASSED VIRTUALLY COMPLETE DESTRUCTION OF ALL EXISTING CENTERS OF POWER--ARMY, AIR FORCE, SAVAK, POLICE, GENDARMERIE-WITHOUT THUS FAR CREATING NEW NUCLEUS OF PHYSICAL POWER WHICH IS CENTRALLY CONTROLLED.

THE MUJAHIDDIN ARE PROBABLE THE MAJOR FORCE IN COUNTRY AT MOMENT, BUT EXTREMELY WEAK WHEN LAID OUT ON A NATIONAL-SIZE CANVAS, AND DEEPLY DIVIDED WITHIN BETWEEN FAVORED PRO-KHOMEINI FUNDAMENTALISTS AND THOSE WHO ARE WILLING TO WORK WITH THE FEDAYEEN TO CONTINUE THE REVOLUTION. MARXIST FEDAYEEN, AS RESULT OF WEAPONS ACQUISITION DURING FEB 10-14 DESTRUCTION OF OLD REGIME, HAVE COME UP FAST, BUT REMAIN SMALL GROUPS CENTERED IN CITIES. RANDOM GROUPS, INCLUDING SOME RIGHTIST OUTFITS, ALSO HAVE WEAPONS. NEW SCHEME WILL BE CREATED BY LEFT AND RIGHT IN AN EFFORT TO COUNTERBALANCE ONE ANOTHER. PHYSICAL POWER CONFIGURATION IS THUS EXTREMELY DIFFUSE.

POLITICAL POWER IS LESS DIFFUSE FOR THE PRESENT, AND HERE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT DOMINATES SCENE, WITH MOSQUE COMMITTEES IN VIRTUALLY EVERY LOCATIONS. LOYALTY OF ALL THESE UNITS IS THEORETICALLY TO KHOMEINI, BUT AS TALEGHANI INCIDENT (REF D) SHOWED CLEARLY, ATTACHMENTS MAY SHIFT AROUND, AND RELATIVELY MINOR INCIDENTS MAY HAVE SERIOUS ORGANIZATIONAL RAMIFICATIONS. POLITICAL ORGANIZATIONS ARE RELATIVELY WEAK IN ANY CASE. IT IS HARD TO UNDERESTIMATE THE BREAKDOWN IN SOCIAL ORGANIZATION OF ALL KINDS AND THE LACK OF INSTITUTIONAL BONDS OF ANY KIND. IRAN HAS NEVER HAD STRONG POLITICAL INSTITUTIONS; THE PGOI IS BENT ON ERASING THOSE WHICH HAVE EXISTED, AND NEW ONES HAVE NOT BEEN DEVELOPED.
WE ARE WATCHING THE BIRTH OF A NEW SYSTEM IN ITS TRUEST SENSE, FROM THE BANKS TO THE UNIVERSITIES. PURGE AND INEXPERIENCE ARE THE ORDER OF THE DAY.

FOR THE MOMENT, THE LEFT IS DOING A SLIGHTLY BETTER JOB, BUT IT WILL BE WEEKS, IF NOT MONTHS, UNTIL IT ACHIEVES ANYTHING LIKE COMPETITIVE PARITY (SIGNIFICANT NUMERICAL MINORITY POSITION) WITH THE RELIGIOUS FORCES (AND ONLY THEN IF THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT MAKES A HASH OF ITS OWN ORGANIZATIONAL TASK). JOKER IN THIS EQUATION, HOWEVER, MIGHT BE ALLIANCES BETWEEN MARXIST FEDAYEEN AND TRIBAL GROUPS SUCH AS KURDS OR TURKOMANS OR WITH DISENCHANTED CENTRISTS.

THIS COULD ADVANCE TIMETABLE A BIT AND, IN THE ABSENCE OF EFFECTIVE GOVERNMENT INTERNAL DIPLOMACY, COULD BRING IRAN TO THE POINT OF POLITICAL CONFLICT SOONER RATHER THAN LATER. IN THE ABSENCE OF A SOLIDLY LEGITIMATE GOVERNMENT ON A FIRM POWER BASE, SUCH CHALLENGE WILL SURELY COME. IN ADDITION TO THE TRADITIONAL IRANIAN ISSUES OF TRIBALISM, SEPARATISM AND RELIGIOUS CONFLICT BETWEEN SHIA AND SUINI, WHOEVER ATTEMPTS TO BUILD POWER IN IRAN WILL BE FACED WITH SUBSTANTIAL PROBLEM IN AREA OF ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT/VALUE EXPECTATIONS. REVOLUTION HAS RAISED PEOPLES' EXPECTATIONS TO VERY HIGH LEVELS, ESPECIALLY IN THE PUBLIC SECTOR.

POOR HAVE BEEN PROMISED JOBS, HOUSING, AMPLE FOOD BUT ISLAMIC MOVEMENT IS ALSO PREACHING AUSTERE LIVING. YET, HUNDREDS OF THOUSANDS OF IRANIANS ENJOYED THE ECONOMIC BOOM AND ARE HIGHLY CONSUMPTION ORIENTED. COUNTRY'S ECONOMIC SYSTEM IS LIMPING ALONG, GRADUALLY TRYING TO RECOVER PRODUCTION AMIDST WAGE CLAIMS, COMMITTEE ORDERS TO HALT, THEN RESUME PRODUCTION, AND DIFFICULTIES WITH BANKING SYSTEM AND LEGAL STRUCTURE COMPLICATED BY REVOLUTIONARY REDISTRIBUTION OF GOODS BY COURTS AND COMMITTEES. SUCCESSFUL POWER ASPIRANTS WILL HAVE TO DEVELOP AND CARRY OUT PROGRAMS TO MEET (OR REDUCE) VALUE EXPECTATIONS WHICH ARE WIDELY DIVERGENT.

THEY WILL HAVE TO ARTICULATE AND ORGANIZE INTERESTS AND COMBINE THESE INTO MEANINGFUL PROGRAM TO MEET NEEDS AND EXPECTATIONS. SHAH'S REGIME NEVER SUCCEEDED IN DOING THAT AT THE HEIGHT OF ITS ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM, AND IT HAD A GOOD DEAL MORE FORCE AT ITS DISPOSAL TO HANDLE RESULTANT UNREST WHICH WAS CREATED THAN ANY SUCCESSOR GOVERNMENT IS LIKELY TO HAVE FOR A LONG TIME TO COME. CONDITION OF THE ECONOMY THEN, IS THE POTENTIAL BOMB WHICH ANY REGIME THAT SEEKS POWER MUST DEFUSE.

FAILURE TO DEAL WITH THE SUBSTANTIAL UNEMPLOYMENT PROBLEM, ATTEMPTS TO RESTRICT CONSUMER SPENDING IN THE NAME OF ISLAM, OR COLLECTIVIST PROPOSALS WHICH GO AGAINST THE GRAIN OF ROUGHSHOD IRANIAN INDIVIDUALISM WILL BE INVITATIONS TO CONTINUED POLITICAL CHAOS. A GOVERNMENT WHICH CAN BRING ANY OF THESE PROBLEMS STEPS NEAR SOLUTION WILL ACQUIRE MORE VOLUNTARY SUPPORT AND NEED LESS COERCIVE MACHINERY. NAAS
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)

IN THE COURSE OF THE APRIL 23 CALL BY THE CHARGE ON MINISTER OF COMMERCE DR. RAZA SADR, REPORTED REF C, ACTING ECONOMIC COUNSELOR PRESENTED THE PROBLEM OF COMMERCIAL REPRESENTATION BY IRANIANS IN THE UNITED STATES, SPECIFICALLY BY MOHAMMED SOURI AND MR. HASHAMI (REFS A AND B). THE MINISTER HAD ALREADY REFERRED AT ONE POINT IN THE EXCHANGE TO "OUR AGENT SOURI". HE WAS TOTALLY LACKING ANY EMBARRASSMENT OVER THE ACTIVITIES OF THESE GENTLEMEN AS HE DESCRIBED THEIR PERFORMANCE FIRST FOR THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE IN THE UNITED STATES AND PRESENTLY FOR THE PGOI.
HE ADMITTED, HOWEVER, THAT A FEW DAYS MAY HAVE LAPSED DURING WHICH SOURI LACKED WRITTEN CREDENTIALS AND ACTED SOLELY ON TELEPHONIC INSTRUCTIONS.

MINISTER SADR SAID THAT KHOMEINI APPOINTED A REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE IN THE UNITED STATES BEFORE HE APPOINTED HIS PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT IN IRAN, BEFORE HE EVEN RETURNED TO IRAN FROM FRANCE. HE SAID THAT HE, MOHAMMED SOURI, AND MESSRS. ZARRABI AND ROUHANI WERE AMONG THE MEMBERS OF THAT INITIAL COMMITTEE. HE WONDERED WHY THE USG SHOULD QUESTION THE ACTIVITIES OF SOMEONE LIKE MOHAMMED SOURI WHEN THE DEPARTMENT OF STATE HAD GRANTED DEFACTO RECOGNITION TO THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE BY ITS DEALINGS WITH ROUHANI.

MOHAMMED SOURI, HE SAID, WAS INSTRUCTED BY KHOMEINI EARLY ON TO TAKE CONTROL OF THE NEW YORK CONSULATE GENERAL AND TO LOOK INTO CERTAIN OTHER ACTIVITIES IN WHICH THE SHAH WAS INVOLVED. ONE OF THESE, THE MINISTER SAID, WAS THE BANK SEPAH BRANCH IN NEW YORK. THE MINISTER SAID THAT THE PRESIDENT OF SEPAH ORDERED SOURI TO MAKE THE INSPECTION THAT HAS BEEN REPORTED IN DEPTELS.

MINISTER SADR SAID THAT SOURI PRESENTLY OPERATES ON BEHALF OF THE PGOI IN VARIOUS ACTIVITIES AND THAT HIS ROLE SHOULD NO LONGER BE A PROBLEM FOR US SINCE HE HAS LEGITIMATE INSTRUCTIONS AND CAN PRESENT APPROPRIATE CREDENTIALS, THIS SEEMS CONSISTANT WITH REF B. ONE ROLE THAT HE PERFORMS IS AS REPRESENTATIVE OF THE MINISTRY OF COMMERCE. BY TELEX FROM THE MINISTER HE HAS APPOINTMENT AS AUTHORIZED PURCHASER AND FORWARDED OF GRAINS AND OTHER COMMODITIES FOR MINCOM.

WHEN EMBOFF MENTIONED THAT SOURI HAD APPEARED AT ONE OF THE US GRAIN COMPANIES, OFFERING TO INTERCEDE IN THEIR PROBLEMS AND TO DISCUSS PURCHASES, HE DID NOT HAVE ADEQUATE CREDENTIALS, RESULTING IN CONFUSION TO THE COMPANY. THE MINISTER SAID ALL OF THIS WAS RESOLVED AT LEAST TEN DAYS AGO. THE MINISTER THEN REFERRED TO A COURT ACTION INVOLVING SOME $17 MILLION IN A BANK SUIT IN WHICH, AS HE PUT IT, THE JUDGE RECOGNIZED THE OFFICIAL FUNCTIONS OF MR. SOURI. (SINCE EMBASSY HAS NO INFORMATION ON THIS SUIT IT WOULD APPRECIATE ANY DETAILS THE DEPARTMENT MIGHT BE ABLE TO DEVELOP.)

A PRIVATE IRANIAN IMPORTER/EXPORTER, WHO IS CONTINENTAL GRAIN'S REPRESENTATIVE IN IRAN, TOLD EMBOFF HE IS NOT AWARE OF SOURI'S CALL ON HIS HOME OFFICE; NEITHER IS HE AWARE THAT SOURI HAS BEEN DESIGNATED AS THE MINISTRY'S PURCHASING AGENT IN THE US. HE IS, HOWEVER, FAIRLY CONFIDENT THAT MINISTER SADR WAS AND MAY STILL BE A PARTNER OF MOHAMMED SOURI IN SOURI'S FORWARDING COMPANY IN NEW YORK.
