segments.text: TERHAN 2682 NOTAL, D) TEHRAN 4253 NOTAL ISLAMABAD 4517 NOTAL (S-ENTIRE TEXT) THIS IS A REPORTING TELEGRAM

SUMMARY: FOR NOW, AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI'S ISLAMIC MOVEMENT, WHICH IS ITSELF ON THE VERGE OF FRAGMENTATION, HAS POSITION; THE MOST CHARISMATIC LEADER; AND THE BEST, THOUGH SPLIT AND CONFUSED,ORGANIZATION. ALL OTHER GROUPS HAVE LIABILITIES TOO, BUT SOME HAVE MORE POTENTIAL FOR EVENTUAL EFFECTIVE ACTION TO ESTABLISH THE BASIC PREREQUISITES FOR GAINING AND HOLDING POWER. BARRING A RANDOM CATASTROPHIC EVENT, SUCH AS ASSASSINATION OF KEY LEADERS, IRAN MAY HAVE AS MUCH AS TWO MONTHS BEFORE THE NEXT SERIOUS ARMED CONTEST FOR POWER OCCURS.

UNLESS ONE GROUP CAN CONSOLIDATE ITS POSITION WITHOUT SERIOUS CHALLENGE FROM OTHERS OR OVERCOME THE SERIOUS FRAGMENTATION OF VALUES WITH A UNIFYING PROGRAM, THE OUTLOOK WILL BE CHAOS AND THE EVENTUAL EMERGENCE OF AN AUTHORITARIAN LEADER IN THE MOLD OF IRAN'S STRONG MONARCHS OF THE TRADITIONAL PAST. END SUMMARY.

FROM A BROAD PERSPECTIVE, THE FIRST GROUP TO HAVE A SHOT AT CONSOLIDATING POWER IS THE PRESENT BIFURCATED ISLAMIC MOVEMENT/GOVERNMENT. KHOMEINI'S CHARISMA IS STRONG ENOUGH TO MAINTAIN A SEMBLANCE OF ORDER FOR AWHILE, AT LEAST UNTIL ONE OF THE CHALLENGERS BUILDS UP A BETTER ORGANIZATION. WHILE A VAST MAJORITY OF IRANIANS PROBABLY NOW SUPPORT KHOMEINI, GROUPS HAVE RETREATED FROM THEIR REVOLUTIONARY STANCE OF SUPPORT, AND MORE WILL DO SO AS KHOMEINI IS FORCED BY CIRCUMSTANCES TO CLARIFY HIS AIMS AND POLICIES.

BROAD GENERALIZATIONS ON THE NATURE OF AN ISLAMIC STATE AND THE RESPONSIBILITY OF FOREIGNERS OR REACTIONARIES FOR ALL THAT IS BAD WILL ONLY GO SO FAR; NEITHER PROVIDES A FIRM BASIS FOR AUTHORITATIVE DECISIONMAKING BY THE PGOI. MOST IMMEDIATE TASKS FACING ISLAMIC MOVEMENT ARE TO ORGANIZE POLITICAL AND MILITARY POWER BASE (AT LEAST AS FAST OR FASTER THAN THEIR COMPETITION); GET THE ECONOMY MOVING (AT LEAST BY REDUCING UNEMPLOYMENT); ESTABLISH A CONSTITUTION AND GOVERNMENTAL STRUCTURE THAT THE MAJORITY OF THE COUNTRY CAN LIVE WITH; AND BUILD UNITY AROUND A SET OF POLICIES THAT A MAJORITY WILL SUPPORT.

ISLAMIC MOVEMENT OCCUPIES THE POLITICAL HIGH GROUND -IT IS THE INCUMBENT GOVERNMENT AND POSSESSES WHAT LEGITIMACY THERE IS IN IRAN THROUGH ITS LEADER, KHOMEINI. IT HAS SUBSTANTIAL LIABILITIES, TOO, HOWEVER. THE DUAL STRUCTURE OF GOVERNMENT IS A SERIOUS HANDICAP TO DEVELOPING UNITY OF POLICY AND POWER. THE POLITICAL ORGANIZATIONS OF THE MOSQUES ARE STRONG IN THEIR ABILITY TO MOBILIZE PEOPLE FOR STREET ACTION, BUT THEY DO NOT HAVE THE INSTITUTIONAL BASE TO MESH WELL IN A GOVERNMENTAL STRUCTURE. THE MOSQUE COMMITTEES, THEREFORE, ARE NOT THE UNQUALIFIED ASSET MANY BELIEVE. FOR THE MOMENT, HOWEVER, NO ONE HAS ANY BETTER ORGANIZATION.

THE MOVEMENT ESPOUSES VALUES, INSOFAR AS THEY HAVE BEEN DEFINED, THAT ARE TACITLY ACCEPTED BY A MAJORITY OF THE PEOPLE, BUT CERTAINLY NOT EVEN A SUBSTANTIAL MINORITY OF THE MODERIZED ELITE, A KEY GROUP FOR CARRYING OUT BOTH ECONOMIC AND POLITICAL PROGRAMS OVER THE MEDIUM TERM.

THE NIGHTMARE OF THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT WOULD BE A SPLIT WITHIN RELIGIOUS RANKS, WITH AYATOLLAHS ON ------------------073982 251332Z /50 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1072 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY BONN AMEMBASSY CAIRO AMCONSUL DHAHRAN AMEMBASSY DOHA AMCONSUL FRANKFURT AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS AMEMBASSY BEIJING AMEMBASSY RABAT USLO RIYADH AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY TOKYO USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE CINCPAC HONOLULU HI USDOCOSOUTH NAPLES IT SECTION 02 OF 04 TEHRAN 04314 EACH SIDE.
THIS WOULD SHATTER KHOMEINI'S CHARISMA AND WEAKEN THE UNITY OF THE MOVEMENT, PERHAPS BEYOND REPAIR.

THE MARXIST FEDAYEEN HAVE THEIR ASSETS AND LIABILITIES AS WELL. ON THE ASSET SIDE, THE FEDAYEEN PROBABLY HAVE THE BEST TYPE OF ORGANIZATION FOR MOBILIZING PEOPLE AROUND A UNITY OF PURPOSE FOR DIRECT VIOLENT ACTION. THEIR VALUES APPEAL TO MANY OF THE MODERNIZED ELITE (REF A AND B), ESPECIALLY AS THE CONTRAST WITH KHOMEINI'S PROGRAMS BECOMES MORE CLEAR, TO THE ADVANTAGE OF THE FEDAYEEN. THE MOVEMENT IS WEAK IN ACTUAL NUMBERS AND ORGANIZATION AT THE NATIONAL LEVEL. IT CURRENTLY HAS NO FIRST-CLASS NATIONALLY RESPECTED LEADERS (THOUGH IT MAY DEVELOP SOME) AND IT IS THE TARGET OF IDEOLOGICAL SNIPING FROM MARXIST SPLINTER GROUPS.

TO BE A THREAT IN THE NEAR TERM, THE FEDAYEEN MUST ORGANIZE SUPERBLY WELL AND FORM THE RIGHT COALITION TO BE IN POSITION TO TAKE ADVANTAGE IF AND WHEN THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT STUMBLES BADLY OR SPLITS. WE HAVE LITTLE HARD INFORMATION ON THE FOREIGN CONNECTIONS OF THE FEDAYEEN, BUT THEIR ACCESSION TO POWER WOULD MOST PROBABLY OCCUR IN SUCH A WAY AS TO FORCE THEM RATHER SWIFTLY INTO DEPENDENCE ON EXTERNAL FORCES SYMPATHETIC TO THEM -- THE PLO, THE USSR, LIBYA.

NATIONAL DEMOCRATIC FRONT: MATIN-DAFTARI'S NDF IS A POTENTIAL CHALLENGER IN TERMS OF LIBERAL DEMOCRATIC IDEAS WHICH WOULD PROBABLY COMMAND A STRONG FOLLOWING AMONG REVOLUTIONARY URBAN SECULARISTS AND THE ESSENTIALLY NONPOLITICAL (UNTIL NOW) MODERNIZING ELITE. UNFORTUNATELY THE NDF IS SERIOUSLY DEFICIENT IN MILITARY POWER, AND EVEN WEAKER IN NATION-WIDE ORGANIZATION THAN THE MARXIST PARTIES. UNLESS IT ENTERED INTO AN ALLIANCE WITH SUBSTANTIAL ELEMENTS OF THE RELIGIOUS MOVEMENT WHO WERE WILLING TO ACCEPT A CHURCH-STATE SPLIT,.IT WILL NOT BE A FORCE IN EITHER THE SHORT OR LONG TERM. AS AN ALLY OF THE FEDAYEEN, IT WOULD BE SWALLOWED UP WITHOUT A TRACE ONCE THAT GROUP CAME TO POWER.

THE NATIONAL FRONT(NF): WITH THE RESIGNATION OF KARIM SANJABI AS FOREIGN MINISTER, THE NF REGAINS ITS PRINCIPAL LEADER. REAL QUESTION IS HOW MORIBUND IS THE NF? IT PLAYED A HANGER-ON ROLE IN THE FINAL DAYS OF THE REVOLUTION, HAS NO INDEPENDENT MILITARY STRENGTH, AND HAS EXHIBITED PRACTICALLY NO INDEPENDENT POLITICAL ACTIVITY SINCE LATE FEBRUARY. TWO SOURCES TELL US MANY FRONT SUPPORTERS DEFECTED TO THE NDF, AND THIS WAS ONE MOTIVATING FACTOR IN SANJABI'S RESIGNATION TO RETURN TO POLITICS. IF THE NF IS TO FIGURE AT ALL, IT MUST DO A REMARKABLE REBUILDING JOB AND/OR FORM AN ALLIANCE WITH THE IDEOLOGICALLY COMAPATIBLE NDF.

THE IRANIAN MILITARY: FOR THE MOMEMENT, THE IRANIAN ARMED FORCES ARE THE CURRENT PRIZE IN THE GAME OF POLITICS, NOT AN INDEPENDENT COUNTER. THOUGH VIRTUALLY BEREFIT OF LEADERSHIP, ARMED FORCES ARE THE ONLY GROUP WITH SOLID PROFESSIONAL TRAINING AND AN ACCUSTOMED COMMAND STRUCTURE (REF C). PGOI IS TRYING TO REBUILD THE ARMY IN AN ISLAMIC IMAGE WITH NEW OR PURE UNQUOTE OFFICERS. SHOULD IT FAIL TO SO DO, OR SHOULD MILITARY OFFICERS AND SENIOR ENLISTED MEN BECOME DISILLUSIONED WITH THE EMERGING VALUES AND POLICIES OF THE REGIME, IT IS NOT LIKELY THAT THE ARMED FORCES WILL EMERGE AS AN INDEPENDENT FORCE LATER.

SUCH A POINT IS PROBABLY AT LEAST SIX MONTHS AWAY. MANY MILITARY MEN HAVE QUIETLY EXPRESSED DISSATISFACTION WITH ONE FACET OR ANOTHER OF THE REVOLUTION. ------------------073916 251333Z /50 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1073 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY BONN AMEMBASSY CAIRO AMCONSUL DHAHRAN AMEMBASSY DOHA AMCONSUL FRANKFURT AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS AMEMBASSY BEIJING AMEMBASSY RABAT USLO RIYADH AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY TOKYO USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE CINCPAC HONOLULU HI USDOCOSOUTH NAPLES IT SECTION 03 OF 04 TEHRAN 04314

THE REST OF THE RIGHT: REVOLUTIONARY PROPAGANDA TO THE CONTRARY, THERE REMAINS A SIGNIFICANT, THOUGH CURRENTLY QUIET, RESEVOIR OF SUPPORT FOR THE MODERIZING POLITICS OF THE SHAH, IF NOT FOR THE MONARCHICAL SYSTEM. THESE ELEMENTS MAY FOLD THEMSELVES INTO ONE OF THE SECULAR ALTERNATIVES -- FEDAYEEN, NDF, NF -- BUT THEY COULD, IN A FEW WEEKS TIME, CAUSE SUBSTANTIAL AMOUNTS OF TROUBLE FOR ANY GROUP OR PERSON TRYING TO PUT A POLITICAL ACT TOGETHER (INDEED THE PGOI GRUDGINGLY AND PRIVATELY ADMITS THIS IS THE CASE IN AZARBAJANGAIHAN AND TURKESTAN NOW). THE MONARCHICAL RIGHT IS STILL IN SHOCK. IT MAY NEVER FULLY EMERGE.

FEW OF THIS STRIPE ENTERTAIN FOR A MINUTE ANY ILLUSIONS OF BRINGING BACK THE MONARCHY IN ITS PAST FORM. FACED WITH THE TRAPPINGS OF AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC, HOWEVER, THIS GROUP INCLUDING A SUBSTANTIAL NUMBER OF PEOPLE IN THE PROVINCES, COULD PROVIDE SUBSTANTIAL SUPPORT FOR SOME OTHER ALTERNATIVE. THERE ARE ALREADY HINTS THAT THOSE OF THIS PERSUASION HAVE PROVIDED MANPOWER FOR THE KILL-A-MULLAH TODAY GROUPS WHICH HAVE SURFACED ENOUGH TO DISTRIBUTE HANDBILLS IN SEVERAL AREAS, AND MAY HAVE BEEN INVOLVED IN THE KILLING OF GENERAL QARANI.

THERE IS ENOUGH ANTICLERICAL FEELING IN CERTAIN QUARTERS OF IRAN WHICH COULD, IF CONDITIONS BECOME RIGHT, BE TRANSLATED INTO VIOLENT REACTIONS TO AN ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT, ESPECIALLY IF SUMMARY EXECUTIONS AND OTHER ENEMY-CREATING ACTIVITIES OF THE KHOMEINI COMMITTEES CONTINUE. THE OCCASTIONAL STATEMENTS FROM THE PGOI THAT A GENERAL AMNESTY WILL BE PROCLAIMED HAVE FALLEN ON CYNICAL EARS. SUCH A DECISION TO DO AWAY WITH THE EXECUTIONS (IF NOT THE TRIALS) WOULD EASE THE SITUATION, BUT NOT REVERSE IT.

NEAR TERM PROJECTIONS: THE GIGANTIC ORGANIZATION PROBLEMS WHICH FACE ALL CONTENDERS FOR PLACE AND POWER IN THE SHATTERED IRANIAN POLITICAL SCENE PROBABLY MEAN THAT IN THE ABSENCE OF A SUBSTANTIAL TRIGGERING EVENT (KHOMEINI'S DEATH, FOR EXAMPLE) IRAN MAY LIMP ALONG FOR THE NEXT TWO TO FOUR MONTHS MARRED BY LOW-LEVEL VIOLENCE RESULTING FROM CURRENT DISORGANIZATION AND SHARP VALUE CONFLICE (REF D). WE WOULD RATE THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT;S CHANCES OF MUDDLING THROUGH UNQUOTE BEYOND THAT POINT SLIGHTLY LESS THAN 50-50, LARGELY BECAUSE OF ITS ORGANIZATIONAL DISARRAY. POSSESSED OF ALL THE ADVANTAGES OF GOVERNMENT AS A CHARISMATIC LEADER, KHOMEINI SOMETIMES SEEMS BENT ON SNATCHING DEFEAT FROM THE JAWS OF VICTORY.

HIS RECENT PUBLIC STATEMENTS IN SUPPORT OF THE ARMY AND HIS CRITICISM OF THOSE WHO HAVE ATTACKED CLERICS SOUND A BIT LIKE THE SHRILL NOTE OF A MAN WHO HAS BELATEDLY DISCOVERED THAT HIS GAME PLAN IS A MISHMASH. (WE DO NOT SHARE THE PAK VIEW OF IRAN'S CURRENT CHAOS AS KHOMEINIDESIRED AND INSPIRED (REF E)). VIRTUALLY ALL OUR SOURCES CLOSE TO THE RELIGIOUS MOVEMENT DESCRIBE KHOMEINI AS INCREDIBILY NAIVE ABOUT THE MECHANICS OF GOVERNING POLITICS, AND HIS TREATMENT OF THE PGOI AND BAZARGAN HAS PROVOKED ULCERS AND CHAGRIN THE WIDTH AND BREATH OF THE CABINET.

UNLESS THE PGOI CAN GET MORE CONTROL OF EVENTS AND START TO MOVE MORE RAPIDLY (WHICH BAZARGAN CLAIMS HE DOES NOT WISH TO DO), THEN THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT WILL SQUANDER THE POLITICAL HEADSTART IT ACHIEVED AS THE VANGUARD OF THE REVOLUTION. FOR NOW, THE BALL IS IN KHOMEINI'S COURT; FROM A LONG-TERM PERSPECTIVE HE HAS NOT PLAYED IT VERY SMARTLY SO FAR.

PROBABLY THE BEST INDICATOR OF WHETHER THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT WILL SURVIVE AS THE DOMINANT FORCE IN IRANIAN POLITICS WILL BE HOW ------------------074019 251333Z /50 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1074 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY BONN AMEMBASSY CAIRO AMCONSUL DHAHRAN AMEMBASSY DOHA AMCONSUL FRANKFURT AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS AMEMBASSY BEIJING AMEMBASSY RABAT USLO RIYADH AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY TOKYO USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE CINCPAC HONOLULU HI USDOCOSOUTH NAPLES IT SECTION 04 OF 04 TEHRAN 04314 WELL ALL HANDS CAN IMPROVE UPON THEIR PERFORMANCE TO DATE.

THERE WILL UNDOUBTEDLY BE AT LEAST ONE MORE CHALLENGE TO THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT, PERHAPS MORE IF IT REMAINS WEAK AND DIVIDED AND OTHERS GAIN IN STRENGTH. THE FEDAYEEN WILL ALMOST SURELY LEAD A MARXIST COALITION INTO BATTLE AFTER AN APPROPRIATE PERIOD OF ORGANIZATIONAL ACTIVITY. THIS STRUGGLE MAY BEGIN SLOWLY ON ISSUES WHERE THE FEDAYEEN HAVE BUILT-IN ADVANTAGE WITH GROUPS THEY ARE TRYING TO ORGANIZE -- ELECTORAL ARRANGEMENTS IN THE NEW CONSTITUTION, RIGHTS FOR WOMEN, AND ECONOMIC PROGRESS. THE FEDAYEEN STAND TO BE THE BIGGEST GAINERS IF THE PGOI FALLS ON ITS FACE IN REVIVING THE ECONOMY AND FULFILLING THE WANTS OF ITS FOLLOWERS.
THERE IS A REAL DANGER THAT IT WILL BE THE MAGNET FOR DISSIDENTS RATHER THAN THE MODERATE NDF, NF AND THE OTHERS WHICH WILL RISE AND FALL.

BECAUSE OF THE FRAGMENTATION OF VALUES, AUTHORITY AND POWER, POLITICS IN IRAN IS A MUCH MORE SITUATIONAL ACTIVITY THAN IN MANY DEVELOPING COUNTRIES. GIVEN EVENTS WILL HAVE DISPROPORTIONATE IMPACT ON LONG-TERM PROSPECTS. THE LATITUDE FOR CHANGE IS WIDER THAN MOST REVOLUTIONARY SITUATIONS. IN PRESENT CIRCUMSTANCES, KHOMEINI CAN SHEILD BAZARGAN FOR JUST SO LONG BEFORE THE SHEILD SHATTERS OR TATTERS. THE PGOI MUST SHOW RESULTS SOON TO SURVIVE. KHOMEINI'S OR BAZARGAN'S DEATH WOULD IMMEDIATELY FORESHORTEN THE PERIOD OF RELATIVE CALM AND PLUNGE IRAN'S POLITICAL GROUPS INTO AN ARMED STRUGGLE FOR POWER, READY OR NOT.

THE OUTCOME, IF IT OCCURS WITHIN THE NEXT SIX MONTHS WOULD BE CHAOS, FOLLOWED BY THE EMERGENCE OF AN AUTHORITATIAN FIGURE OF EITHER RIGHT OR LEFT, WHO WOULD BECOME BY SOME NAME, A NEW EDITION OF THE VERY AUTHORITARIAN REZA SHAH WITH AT LEAST SOME RELIGIOUS CREDENTIALS. IT IS AN EERIE FEELING INDEED TO HEAR LAST MONTH'S DEMOCRATS TALK OF THE GROWING NEED FOR STRONG LEADERSHIP.
(S - ENTIRE TEXT)

VERY MUCH APPRECIATE YOUR CONCERNS ABOUT OUR CONDITION HERE AS EXPRESSED REFTEL AND TELECONS. OUR SITUATION IS NOT GOOD AND SECURITY CONSIDERATIONS TAKE UP A LOT OF OUR TIME AND ENERGY. HOWEVER, KEY QUESTIONS ARE WHAT TO DO, WHEN, AND HOW TO GO ABOUT IT WITHOUT IN FACT INCREASING OUR INSECURITY.

ALL OF US HERE WHOLEHEARTEDLY AGREE THAT DESIRABLE SOLUTION IS LARGER DISCIPLINED FORCE UNDER SINGLE COMMAND AND THAT IS OUR OBJECTIVE OVER TIME. EMB SECURITY PROBLEMS REFLECT IN MICROCOSM THE LOCAL SITUATION. NO ONE POLITICAL OR PARAMILITARY GROUP AS YET HAS PREDOMINANT STRENGTH TO ASSERT ITS WILL ON OTHERS. BEING PROTECTED BY ANY OF THE PUTATIVE ALTERNATIVES HAS ITS DISADVANTAGES AND ADVANTAGES IF WE ASSUME THAT THE PROTECTIVE FORCE IS NOT MERELY A FALSE FRONT DETERRENT AND IN FACT MAY BE CALLED UPON TO SHOOT IN THE EVENT OF A TERRORIST ATTACK OR INTRUSION BY A MODERATELY SIZED ARMED FORCE.

THE ARMY FORCE THAT APPEARED BRIEFLY THE OTHER DAY LOOKED GOOD: ONE COULD EXPECT SOME DISCIPLINE AND AN ABILITY TO HANDLE WEAPONS. ON THE OTHER HAND, MILITARY MORALE HAS BEEN NEARLY DESTROYED BY THE REVOLUTION AND THE SUBSEQUENT EXECUTIONS OF NUMEROUS OFFICERS AND MEN OF ALL RANKS FOR ACTIONS THEY TOOK IN SUPPRESSING DEMONSTRATIONS. WE KNOW OF A COUPLE OF CASES WHERE MILITARY OFFICERS HAVE REFUSED TO MOVE TROOPS OUT OF CONCERN THAT THEY LATER COULD BE BROUGHT TO TRIAL IF THEY WERE FORCED TO OPEN FIRE.

IN THE INCIDENT ON THE COMPOUND, THE MILITARY THREATENED TO DISARM OUR FORCE OF IRREGULARS BUT LEFT WITH THEIR TAILS BETWEEN THEIR LEGS WHEN THE IRREGULAR LEADER REFUSED TO DEPART. IN SUM, I HAVE NO CONFIDENCE THAT AT THIS TIME RPT AT THIS TIME THE ARMY WOULD IN FACT TAKE THE RISK OF ARMED RESISTANCE SHOULD WE NEED IT. SECONDLY, THE ARMY IS STILL VIEWED WITH A HIGH DEGREE OF SUSPICION; KHOMEINI'S ARMED FORCES DAY WAS A SUCCESSFUL FIRST STEP IN REHABILITATION, BUT IT WAS ONLY THAT. THE PRESENCE OF UNIFORMED TROOPS ON THE COMPOUND COULD, I FEAR, ACTUALLY ATTRACT SNIPING AND DEMONSTRATIONS.

THE AIR FORCE HOMOFARS AND CADETS WE HAD WERE TERRIBLY UNDISCIPLINED, UNFAMILIAR WITH HANDLING OF WEAPONS, AND FAIRLY ONERY. I AM CONVINCED THAT THE HEAVY BARRAGES OF FIRING AT NIGHT ON THE COMPOUND WERE IN PART IMPUDENT HARRASSMENT. THEY CERTAINLY COULD NOT HAVE BEEN DEPENDED UPON TO RESIST SERIOUSLY AN ATTACK ON US. MORE LIKELY THEY WOULD HAVE JOINED IN*

THE POLICE FORCE IS VERY SLOWLY BEING REHABILITATED. TWO WEEKS AGO WE HEARD THE RUMOR THAT THE POLICE WOULD AGAIN RECEIVE THE RESPONSIBILITY TO DEFEND THE COMPOUND AND THAT THE OLD COMMANDER WOULD BE PUT IN CHARGE. NOTHING FURTHER HAD DEVELOPED ON THIS FRONT AND I HAVE MIXED VIEWS ON PUTTING OURSELVES UNDER THE PROTECTION OF A GROUP WHICH DESERTED IN THE PAST--ADMITTEDLY FOR PRETTY COMPELLING PERSONAL REASONS.

THE IRREGULARS UNDER MARSHALLAH ARE OFTEN A THORN IN OUR SIDE: THEY INTERFERE IN AREAS NOT OF THEIR CONCERN, HARRASS VISITORS, PROBABLY HAVE ENGAGED IN PETTY THIEVERY AND IN FACT TREAT US AS PEOPLE UNDER SURVEILLANCE (WHICH WE ARE). THE GROUP IS SERIOUSLY UNDERSTAFFED AS WELL, PARTICULARLY IN THE DAYLIGHT HOURS. HOWEVER, HIS REVOLUTIONARY CREDENTIALS ARE GOOD AND HE AND HIS GROUP ARE CARD CARRYING MEMBERS OF THE SEPAH-E-PASDARAN-E-INGELAB (GUARDIANS OF THE REVOLUTION).

IN SUM, HE HAS, AT LEAST FOR THE PRESENT PERIOD, THE POLITICAL BACKING WHICH WOULD PERMIT HIM SAFELY TO SHOOT. ALSO, HE CLAIMS THAT HE CAN GET HEAVY REINFORCEMENT FROM NEARBY MOSQUE COMMITTEES AT THE FIRST SIGN OF TROUBLE. WE SIMPLY DO NOT KNOW IF THIS IS TRUE. WHETHER HE AND HIS GROUP AND THE REINFORCEMENTS WOULD FEEL SUFFICIENTLY CONCERNED ABOUT US TO PUT UP A REAL DEFENSE, OR HAVE THE CAPABILITY IN THE FACE OF A TRAINED GROUP OF FEDAYAN OR PALESTINIAN EXTREMISTS, ARE OPEN TO QUESTION.

THERE IS, IN SUM, NO GOOD RESOLUTION, NEVER MIND AN IDEAL ------------------085777 261252Z /42 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1097 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 04359 EXDIS ONE, AND WE ARE GOING TO HAVE TO LIMP ALONG FOR THE NEXT FEW WEEKS WITH WHAT WE HAVE IN HAND BUT KEEPING ALERT TO THE RIGHT OCCASION AND CIRCUMSTANCES TO BETTER OUR POSITION.

IN THE MEANTIME WE ALSO MUST DO WHAT WE CAN OURSELVES TO IMPROVE SECURITY. WE ARE MOVING AS RAPIDLY AS LOCAL PRODUCTION WILL PERMIT TO REINFORCE THE CHANCERY: NEW AND IMPROVED STEEL DOORS ARE BEING INSTALLED; BARS ARE BEING IMPLACED ON ALL WINDOWS; WE HAVE BEEN EXPERIMENTING WITH A NUMBER OF ALTERNATIVES TO COVER LOWER WINDOWS AGAINST RIFLE FIRE (SO FAR A WINDOW BOX UNQUOTE FITTED WITH SAND BAGS BEHIND A STEEL PLATE LOOKS BEST): AND WE HAVE REARMED THE MARINES IN THE CONTROL BOOTH IN THE LOBBY. THE NIGHT MARINE GUARD AT MY RESIDENCE (TO MOVE TO THE AMBASSADOR'S RESIDENCE ON HIS ARRIVAL) IS ALSO ARMED.

THAT IS AS FAR AS I WANT TO GO AT THIS TIME IN ARMING MARINES. THESE VARIOUS STEPS COULD GIVE US VALUABLE TIME FOR THE ARRIVAL OF SOME FORCE IN THE EVENT OF AN ATTACK. ULTIMATELY, OF COURSE, THAT IS OUR ONLY REAL DEFENSE.
FINALLY, OUR EXCELLENT SECURITY OFFICERS ARE TRAINING FOUR MUJAHEEDIN IN FOLLOW CAR TECHNIQUES AND THEY ARE LEARNING FAST AS I HAVE WITNESSED IN MY TRAVELS AROUND

SUMMARY. THE MEAF IS STILL HIGHLY POLITICIZED WITH LITTLE WORK OCCURRING. UNDER SECRETARY DR. AHMAD KOOROS (ALSO KUROS) WAS SUMMARILY DISMISSED ON APRIL 24 AND REPLACED BY DR. IBRAHIM-ZADEH. THAT AND SEVERAL OTHER SEPARATIONS ADD TO THE SUBSTANTIAL NUMBER OF REFUGEES RETURNING TO THE CENTRAL BANK, WHERE THEY HAVE CAREER PROTECTION. A NEW SALARY SCALE WAS ANNOUNCED IN THE MEAF APRIL 24, WHICH REDUCES COMPENSATION CONSIDERABLY; IT IS ASSUMED TO APPLY TO THE ENTIRE CIVIL SERVICE. THE MEAF'S REVOLUTIONARY KOMITAY CONTINUES TO EXERCISE SUBSTANTIAL POWER. REVOLUTIONARY SUSPICION OF AUTHORITY EXTENDS EVEN TO THE DIRECTOR GENERAL LEVEL AND ERRODES EFFORTS TO REESTABLISH DISCIPLINE. END SUMMARY.

THE MEAF IS STILL HIGHLY POLITICIZED AND LITTLE WORK IS BEING ACCOMPLISHED. SOME IMPROVEMENT APPEARS TO HAVE DEVELOPED IN THE RESPECT FOR THE INFREQUENT INSTRUCTIONS FROM THE MINISTER. BEST INFORMATION IS THAT THE TAX AND CUSTOMS AREAS CONTINUE TO BE RATHER INEFFECTIVE, STILL PREOCCUPIED WITH ESTABLISHING ACCEPTABLE AUTHORITY AND REORDERING PERSONNEL PRIVILEGES AND STATUS. IN ONE KNOWN DIRECTORATE, THAT FOR INTERNATIONAL INVESTMENT AND CREDIT, THE WORK IS RATHER SELF-SUSTAINING. THE 110 EMPLOYEES ARE KEPT RATHER WELL OCCUPIED IN RECEIVING AND DISBURSING AGAINST IRAN'S CREDITS, INVESTMENTS AND CONTINUING OBLIGATIONS. LIKEWISE, THEY RECEIVE MANY FOREIGN VISITORS AND CORRESPONDENCE.

A HIGHLY RELIABLE SENIOR MEAF OFFICIAL INFORMED EMBOFF THAT UNDER SECRETARY DR. AHMAD KOOROS FOUND UPON ARRIVING AT WORK APRIL 24 A SEPARATION NOTICE. KOOROS, 51, AND UNDER SECRETARY AT THE MEAF SINCE 1974, HAS BEEN UNDER CONTINUOUS SEIGE BY REVOLUTIONARY EMPLOYEES SINCE HIS RETURN TO IRAN RIGHT AFTER THE REVOLUTION. HIS FAMILY, ALL AMERICAN CITIZENS,REMAINS IN THE US AND OUR SOURCE DOES NOT KNOW WHAT HIS PLANS MAY BE. AS A CENTRAL BANK OF IRAN (CBI) EMPLOYEE, HE HAS REEMPLOYMENT RIGHTS THERE. UP TO HIS SEPARATION, KOOROS HAD AUTHORITY OVER THE FORMER BUREAUS FOR ECONOMIC AFFAIRS, INTERNATIONAL AFFAIRS, AND THE ORGANIZATION FOR INVESTMENT AND ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE.

IN DR. KOOROS, THE EMBASSY HAD A SUBSTANTIAL FRIEND AND FOUND IN HIM CONSIDERABLE EXPERTISE CONCERNING IRAN'S ECONOMY. HE WAS, HOWEVER, FEARFUL OF ANY CONTACT WITH THE EMBASSY SINCE THE REVOLUTION. AS OF APRIL 24 HIS CHAIR IS OCCUPIED BY DR. IBRAHIM-ZADEH, A NEW ADVISOR TO MEAF MINISTER ARDALAN AND EX-PROFESSOR OF ECONOMIC AND MATHEMATICS AT THE UNIVERSITY OF TEHRAN (SEE REFTEL). WHETHER OR NOT HE HAS AS YET BEEN CONFIRMED AS UNDER SECRETARY IS NOT KNOWN. WE WILL ATTEMPT TO ESTABLISH CONTACT WITH HIM IN HIS NEW POSITION. DR. IBRAHIM-ZADEH SPEAKS ENGLISH WELL, IS WIDELY TRAVELED AND, AS REPORTED IN REFTEL, ACCOMPANIED MINISTER ARDALAN TO THE GENEVA OPEC MEETING.

DR. JAMSHID ASHRAFI, PRESIDENT OF THE ORGANIZATION FOR INVESTMENT AND ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE, AND UNDERSECRETARY FOR INTERNATIONAL INVESTMENT AND CREDITS HAS BEEN ABSENT SINCE THE REVOLUTION. HE, AS REPORTED, WAS IN LONDON ON OFFICIAL BUSINESS WHEN THE GOVERNMENT FELL AND WAS NOT ABLE TO RETURN BECAUSE OF SEVERE BURNS INCURRED IN A FIRE. HE IS NOW REPORTEDLY ON A NEW LIST ABOUT TO SURFACE WHICH SELF-INCRIMINATES THOSE LISTED FOR HAVING EXPATRIATED FUNDS FROM IRAN. HE WANTS TO RETURN TO IRAN, BUT FRIENDS IN THE MINISTRY, BY PHONE TO HIM, HAVE CONTINUOUSLY ADVISED HIM AGAINST RETURNING.

IN HIS ABSENCE, KOOROS PROVIDED LEGAL DIRECTION OF THAT ORGANIZATION/BUREAU, ALTHOUGH REZA KHALEGHI-ROD HAD BEEN DE FACTO IN CHARGE. NOW, EFFECTIVE APRIL 24, A MR. REZA SALIMI HAS BEEN NAMED SUPERVISOR FOR INTERNATIONAL INVESTMENTS AND CREDITS AND IS IN EFFECT ACTING UNDERSECRETARY FOR THAT ORGANIZATION. SALIMI, UNKNOWN TO THE EMBASSY, WAS EARLIER WITH THE MINISTRY OF FINANCE AND MOST RECENTLY WAS AN EMPLOYEE OF THE MAJLIS LIBRARY.

THE FOREIGN INVESTMENTS DEPARTMENT, WHICH IS STILL TO MANY PEOPLE KNOWN BY ITS FORMER NAME "THE CENTER FOR THE ATTRACTION AND PROTECTION OF FOREIGN INVESTMENT," IS ALSO WITHOUT A LEADER. DR. HASSEIN ZAIM, A MAN ASSOCIATED WITH THIS FUNCTION IN THE GOI SINCE 1963, WAS ALSO RELEASED FROM THE MEAF ON APRIL 24. ZAIM, 55, ALSO HOLDS REEMPLOYMENT RIGHTS AT THE CENTRAL BANK OF IRAN. WE DO NOT AS YET KNOW IF MR. MORTAZABI, ZAIM'S FORMER DEPUTY, IS DIRECTING THAT ------------------086626 261458Z /44 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1103 SECTION 02 OF 03 TEHRAN 04373 DEPARTMENT.

CENTRAL BANK OF IRAN REDUNDANCY WILL INCREASE WITH THE RATHER SUBSTANTIAL NUMBERS OF SENIOR OFFICIALS RETURNING FROM OTHER GOI POSITIONS TO WHICH THEY HAVE BEEN LOANED. AS IS THE CUSTOM IN MANY DEVELOPING COUNTRIES, THE CENTRAL BANK HAS ATTRACTED, TRAINED AND SUBSEQUENTLY SECONDED TO OTHER GOVERNMENT AGENCIES A SIZEABLE NUMBER OF PERSONNEL. THESE PEOPLE HAVE KEPT THEIR REEMPLOYMENT RIGHTS, PARTICULARLY SINCE THE CBI WAS THE FIRST TO HAVE A RETIREMENT PLAN AND FOR YEARS HAD A COMPENSATION SCHEDULE SECOND ONLY TO THE NIOC IN ATTRACTIVENESS. AMONG THOSE WHO HOLD SUCH ENTITLEMENTS ARE EX-CBI GOVERNOR AND MINISTER OF VARIOUS PORTFOLIOS HASSAN-ALI MEHRAN, CURRENTLY ON CONTRACT TO THE IMF; DR. KOOROS, DR.

ZAIM AND DR. AHMAD ASKARI YAZDI, WHO HAS BEEN ON LOAN FIRST AS DEPUTY MANAGING DIRECTOR AT THE FOREIGN TRADE BANK OF IRAN, THEN MANAGING DIRECTOR AT THE BANK DARUSH AND NOW OUT OF A JOB. IN ADDITION TO THESE, A NUMBER OF SENIOR OFFICERS WITHIN THE CBI, WHO HAVE BEEN RECENTLY REMOVED FROM THEIR JOBS BUT ARE NOT AS YET ELIGIBLE FOR RETIREMENT, WILL ALSO BE ADDING TO THE REDUNDANCY OF THE BANK. THERE SHOULD BE A RECORD NUMBER OF CBI "ADVISORS". IN SOME CASES, WE UNDERSTAND, THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE OF THE CENTRAL BANK IS REFUSING TO AUTHORIZE PAYMENT OF SALARY TO THESE REFUGEES, AN EXAMPLE BEING DR. ZAIM.

REDUCED CIVIL SERVICE COMPENSATION: OUR SOURCE SAID THAT A NEW SALARY SCHEDULE WAS ANNOUNCED IN THE MEAF ON APRIL 24. WE ASSUME IT IS THAT ANTICIPATED FOR THE ENTIRE CIVIL SERVICE. IT SUBSTANTIALLY REDUCES BENEFITS. SALARIES OF LOWER GRADE EMPLOYEES ARE INCRESED AND OUR SOURCE BELIEVES THAT THE BASIC WAGE OF TOP GRADES IS REDUCED. OVERTIME IS ELIMINATED AND VARIOUS BONUSES THAT WERE CUSTOMARY FOR OFFICERS THROUGHOUT THE CIVIL SERVICE HAVE LIKEWISE BEEN ELIMINATED. A BONUS PECULIAR TO THE MEAF, BASED IN THE TAX LAW AND WHICH PROVIDES FOR DISTRIBUTION OF A PERCENTAGE OF TAX RECEIPTS TO EMPLOYEES, IS LIKEWISE ELIMINATED.

SINCE BENEFITS ACCOUNT FOR 30 TO 40 PERCENT OF THE COMPENSATION PACKAGE OF EMPLOYEES, IT WILL SUBSTANTIALLY REDUCE OVERALL PUBLIC SERVICE INCOME. THE COMPOSITION OF THE PACKAGE IS SO COMPLICATED, OUR SOURCE WAS AS YET UNCLEAR OF THE NET EFFECT AT HIS DIRECTOR GENERAL LEVEL, BUT HE HAD IDENTIFIED A LOSS OF AT LEAST 500,000 RIALS ($7,100) IN BONUSES ALONE. HE SUSPECTS THAT EVEN HIS BASIC SALARY HAS ALSO BEEN REDUCED. THE OVERALL EFFECT OF SUCH A COMPENSATION SYSTEM ON GOVERNMENT FINANCE, OF COURSE, WILL BE SUBSTANTIAL.

THE MEAF'S REVOLUTIONARY KOMITAY STILL EXERCISES CONSIDERABLE AUTHORITY IN THE AREA OF PERSONNEL MANAGEMENT. EACH DIRECTOR GENERAL HAS A REPRESENTATIVE ON THE KOMITAY. IN THE CASE OF THE DIRECTORATE GENERAL OF OUR CONTACT, THE REPRESENTATIVE WAS CONSIDERED TOO CONSERVATIVE AND SO NOW THERE ARE TWO REPRESENTATIVES ON THE KOMITAY FROM HIS DIRECTORATE. THE KOMITARY MEETS PERIODICALLY WITH THE MINISTER AND ITS AUTHORITY IS FELT CONSTANTLY THROUGHOUT THE BUREAUCRACY. OUR SOURCE BELIEVES THAT THE PGOI AND REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES ARE FIRMLY LINKED AND IS THUS SUSPICIOUS OF SENIOR PGOI OFFICIALS' STATEMENTS CRITICIZING THE ROLE OF THE KOMITAYS.

AS AN EXAMPLE OF ITS EXERCISE OF AUTHORITY, IT RECENTLY WAS ABLE TO REDISTRIBUTE THE BONUS FROM THE TAX COLLECTIONS ALLOWED FOR YEAR 1357. PREVIOUSLY, THIS WAS THE PEROGATIVE, AND A VERY JEALOUSLY GUARDED ONE, OF THE UNDER SECRETARIES AND DIRECTORS GENERAL. THIS TIME IT WAS ALLOTTED EVENLY TO EVERY EMPLOYEE DOWN TO THE T BOY. IN A RECENT ATTEMPT, THE KOMITAY TRIED TO ELIMINATE THE RATHER AUTOMATIC IN-TOWN TRAVEL ALLOWANCE OF 2,8:0 RIALS PER MONTH FOR PROFESSIONAL EMPLOYEES. ON APRIL 24 THE KOMITAY RELIEVED OUR SOURCE OF HIS OFFICIAL CAR.

REVOLUTIONARY SUSPICION OF THOSE UNDER THE OLD REGIME IS APPARENTLY EXTENDING DOWN TO THE DIRECTOR GENERAL LEVEL. IT WAS PREVIOUSLY CONSIDERED THAT IT STOPPED AT THE UNDER SECRETARY LEVEL. OUR SOURCE BELIEVES THAT HE IS ON THE LIST OF "22,000" AND HE KNOWS OF AT LEAST TWO CARRY-OVER ------------------086055 261459Z /44 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1104 SECTION 03 OF 03 TEHRAN 04373 DIRECTORS GENERAL IN THE GOVERNMENT WHO UPON TRYING TO ACCOMPLISH SOMETHING AT A NOTARY PUBLIC WERE REFUSED SERVICE BECAUSE THEY ARE ON THE LIST. (THOSE BLACKLISTED ARE DENIED CIVIL TRANSACTIONS.) OUR SOURCE BELIEVES THAT HE WOULD NOT BE ALLOWED TO LEAVE THE COUNTRY.
IF THIS REPORT OF EXTENDED REVOLUTIONARY PURIFICATION IN THE CIVIL SERVICE IS TRUE, ATTEMPTS TO REESTABLISH EFFECTIVE DISCIPLINE IN THE GOVERNMENT BUREAUCRACY ARE FURTHER HAMPERED. NAAS
(C-ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY: YAZDI'S NOMINATION AS FOREIGN MINISTER RAISES MORE QUESTIONS THAN IT ANSWERS. MIXED SIGNALS ON YAZDI'S ROLE WITH PLO. BANI-ASADI WILL PROBABLY REPLACE YAZDI. YAZDI WILL EXPRESS HIS VIEWS INTELLIGENTLY BUT THEY WILL BE ANTI-WEST. END SUMMARY

PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN'S APRIL 24 ANNOUNCEMENT THAT YAZDI WOULD BE FOREIGN MINISTER POSES MOST INTERESTING QUESTION: WAS HE PROMOTED OR KICKED UPSTAIRS? BASIC BIODATA ON YAZDI SUBMITTED IN REFTELS; BELOW WE DEAL WITH SOME IMPONDERABLES IN THE YAZDI EQUATION.

SPECULATION IS RIFE THAT YAZDI WAS KICKED UPSTAIRS BECAUSE HE WAS EITHER GETTING IN BAZARGAN'S WAY, OR HAD LOST HIS UTILITY AS A GO-BETWEEN WITH THE PGOI AND THE COMMITTEE STRUCTURE. EVIDENCE FOR LATTER VIEW IS ADDUCED BY THOSE WHO SAW YAZDI GET INTO FURIOUS SHOUTING MATCH WITH COMMITTEE GROUP AT AIRPORT WHEN LIBYAN PRIME MINISTER DALLUD ARRIVED ON APRIL 22. EYEWITNESSES SAY YAZDI WANTED TO KEEP JALLUD ON PLANE UNTIL HE EXPLAINED WHERE LIBYANS HAD HIDDEN IMAN MUSA SADR. COMMITTEE WANTED TO LET PM LAND AND TAKE HIM TO QOM. KHOMEINI'S SON RUSHED TO SCENE AND CONVINCED YAZDI TO YIELD TO COMMITTEE VIEW.
TWO GOOD SOURCES SAY YAZDI'S DAYS AS DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER WERE NUMBERED FROM THAT MOMENT.

ALTERNATE VIEW (THERE'S ALWAYS ONE IN IRAN) SAYS THAT YAZDI ROLE AS MAN WHO BROUGHT PLO TO IRAN WAS CREATING PROBLEMS FOR BAZARGAN, AND PROMOTION TO FOREIGN MINISTER WAS CONSIDERED BEST WAY TO GIVE YAZDI MORE AUTHORITY FOR HANDLING PLO AND AT THE SAME TIME GET HIM AWAY FROM THE PM'S OFFICE. NON-IRANIAN NEWSPAPER CORRESPONDENT CLOSE TO PLO CHIEF HASSAN DISPUTES THIS VIEW, AND SAYS PLO HAS BEEN HAVING PROBLEMS WITH YAZDI.

(HE ALSO CONFIRMED INFORMATION REPORTED EARLIER THAT PLO ARE TRAINING MUJAHIDDIN AND FEDAYEEN AND JUST ABOUT EVERYONE WHO WANTS TO LEARN WEAPONRY.) SOURCE CLOSE TO YAZDI WHO HELPED ARRANGE ENTRY FOR PLO IN EARLY DAYS SAYS PLO BECAME ANNOYED WITH YAZDI WHEN HE WANTED TO RESTRICT PLO TO TRAINING NEW REVOLUTIONARY GUARDIANS CORP. THERE IS SOME LEEWAY IN VARIOUS STORIES, BUT IT SEEMS CLEAR THAT IN SOME WAY YAZDI ROLE WITH PLO, FOR GOOD OR BAD, WAS CONNECTED WITH HIS BEING NAMED FOREIGN MINISTER.

ANOTHER IRANIAN SOURCE INDICATES THAT EMBARRASSMENT OVER REVELATION THAT YAZDI HAS U.S. PASSPORT (HE ADMITTED THIS IN PERSIAN PRESS EVENING APRIL 24) AND CHARGES THAT HE WAS A CIA AGENT MEANT HE HAD TO BE GOTTEN OUT OF FM'S OFFICE. BAZARGAN'S PUBLIC STATEMENT THAT YAZDI'S DEPUTY FOR REVOLUTIONARY AFFAIRS PORTFOLIO WOULD BE GIVEN TO SOMEONE ELSE SUGGESTS SOME TRUTH TO THIS.

NAMING OF HOSSEIN BANI-ASADI (BAZARGAN SON-IN-LAW; INFLUENCE OF FAMILY AND DOWREH LIVES ON IN REVOLUTIONARY IRAN) TO DEPUTY PORTFOLIO FOR COOPERATION BETWEEN GOVERNMENT AND PEOPLE UNQUOTE IS NOT A DIRECT REPLACEMENT FOR YAZDI, BUT MOST OBSERVERS FEEL HE WILL EVENTUALLY GET HOLD OF YAZDI'S REVOLUTIONARY RESPONSIBILITIES, SINCE HE HAS BEEN DEPUTY TO THE MINISTER FOR REVOLUTIONARY PROGRAM, YADOLLAH SAHABI, AS WELL AS BAZARGAN RELATIVE.

ANOTHER POSSIBILITY, NOT INCONSISTENT WITH EITHER OF THE ABOVE, IS THAT YAZDI, WITH THE EGOI'S BEST CONNECTIONS TO THE COMMITTEE COMPLEX, WAS SEEN AS THE BEST MAN TO BEGIN TO START PULLING IRAN'S FOREIGN POLICY TOGETHER INTO A COHERENT WHOLE. HE HAS BEEN DEALING IN FOREIGN AFFAIRS EXTENSIVELY ANYWAY, AND HIS APPOINTMENT AS MINISTER NOW GIVES HIM A MANDATE OVER THE INSTITUTIONAL STRUCTURE AS WELL.

YAZDI THE MAN: US CORRESPONDENT WHO HAS FOLLOWED YAZDI PERSONALLY SINCE PARIS SAYS YAZDI IS CONSUMMATE MEDIA MANIPULATOR (VIEW THOSE OF US WHO HAVE DEALT WITH HIM SHARE) WHO IS REALLY DEVOUT BELIEVING MOSLEM. CORRESPONDENT DESCRIBES HIM, HOWEVER AS MAN WHO ALWAYS HAS HIS MASK ON; IN TEN MONTHS, ONLY TIMES HE SHOWED INNER PERSONALITY WERE ONCE IN PARIS IN DISCUSSION OVER KHOMEINI ROLE WHEN HIS RELIGIOUS SIDE CAME OUT, AND AT TIME OF US EMBASSY SACKING WHEN HE BLEW UP AT PHOTOGRAPHERS OF EVENT AND ORDERED THEIR CAMERAS BROKEN AND FILM EXPOSED.

EMBASSY DEALINGS WITH YAZDI: HE IS A HARD MAN TO REACH, BUT IN PERSON-TO-PERSON CONTACT, EITHER OVER RHONE OR IN NOTE BY OC/T: DISTRIBUTION COORDINATED WITH MS. KEKICH, S/S-O. ------------------087547 261828Z /47 S FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1107 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 04377 LIMDIS PERSON, HE IS VERY SMOOTH AND FRIENDLY. HE UNFOLDS UNPALATABLE NEWS WITH JUST A SHADE OF APOLOGY, AND HAS EXCELLENT UNDERSTANDING OF HOW TO MANIPULATE VALUE SYSTEM OF HIS LISTENERS TO PRODUCE REACTION HE WANTS TO ACHIEVE. HE HAS GOOD POLITICAL TOUCH, BUT VERY MUCH BELIEVES US IS CAUSE OF IRAN'S TROUBLES FOR PAST 26 YEARS.

HE IS NOT HARD-LINE OR STRIDENT ABOUT IT, BUT FIRMLY COMMITTED TO VIEW. AS FOREIGN MINISTER HE COULD TURN OUT TO BE PERSIAN REFLECTION OF STRAIN OF ANTI-US, ANTI-WESTERN THOUGHT IN THE TRADITION OF KRISHNA MENNON AND NUMEROUS YANKEE BAITING AFRICAN FOREIGN MINISTERS OF THE 60'S AND 70'S. IN TRUE PERSIAN FASHION, HE WILL PROBABLY BE MODERATELY ASSERTIVE IN PUBLIC AND MORE REASONABLE IN PRIVATE. UNLESS HE GETS CARRIED AWAY BY HIS NEW INCARNATION, HE WILL PROBABLY REMAIN SOMEONE WE CAN TALK TO WITH SOMEWHAT BETTER PROSPECTS OF GETTING RESULTS (ONCE HE AGREES TO A POSITION) THAN MANY OF HIS REVOLUTIONARY COLLEAGUES OFFER.
NAAS NOTE BY OC/T: DISTRIBUTION COORDINATED WITH MS. KEKICH, S/S-O.
FOLLOWING FEBRUARY 14 ATTACK ON EMBASSY, CHRON FILES MAINTAINED ONLY SINCE O/A MID MARCH AND POST UNABLE LOCATE STATE 066817, NOR HAS IT RECEIVED FAMC 785 OF MARCH 22.

IN ORDER TO COMPLY WITH ETHICS IN GOVERNMENT ACT REQUEST STATE 066817 BE RE-TRANSMITTED TO TEHRAN OR REQUEST SUMMARY OF PERTINENT DETAILS WHICH WILL ENABLE EMBASSY PROCEED TO IDENTIFY OFFICERS WHO ARE REQUIRED TO FILL OUT AND SUBMIT DISCLOSURE STATEMENTS. NAAS

BY REFTEL THE LOCAL REPRESENTATIVES OF ARMISH/MAAG REQUESTED OF CARMISH/MAAG, ALEX, VA. AN UPDATED ADJUSTMENT OF THE TEHRAN COLA. THEY STATED THAT THE EMBASSY TEHRAN MARINES WERE "ESPECIALLY HARD HIT --- AND SUBSIST ON ECONOMY." TWO THINGS ARE OBVIOUSLY WRONG WITH THIS MESSAGE THAT ORIGINATED WITH ARMISH/MAAG. FIRST, OF COURSE, THE MANAGEMENT OF THE MARINE DETACHMENT IS AN EMBASSY RESPONSIBILITY. WE HAVE ENLIGHTENED THE MILITARY ON THIS SUBJECT. SECONDLY, THE DEPARTMENT AND MILITARY AUTHORITIES SHOULD KNOW THAT THE U.S. MARINES AT EMBASSY TEHRAN DO NOT REPEAT NOT SUBSIST ON THE LOCAL ECONOMY. THEY ARE PROVIDED QUARTERS UNDER SHORT TERM LEASE, WHICH INCLUDES COMPLETE MAINTENANCE, PAYMENT OF UTILITIES, ETC.
IN ADDITION, THEY OBTAIN, AND WILL OBTAIN IN THE FUTURE, THE BULK OF THEIR FOOD SUPPLIES FROM U.S. GOVERNMENT SUBSIDIZED SOURCES.

NOT WITHSTANDING THE ABOVE, THE EMBASSY WILL BE PROVIDING THE DEPARTMENT AND THE U.S. MILITARY WITH INFORMATION ON THE COST OF LIVING AS SOON AS POSSIBLE FOR POSSIBLE ADJUSTMENT FOR TEHRAN AUTHORIZED COLA.
(C-ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY: DURING PAST FEW DAYS EMBOFF HAS SPOKEN SEPARATELY TO SEVERAL FRIENDS FROM TABRIZ WHO HAVE BEEN VISITING TEHRAN. ALL WERE DEPRESSED ABOUT EFFECTS OF REVOLUTION IN TABRIZ AND PESSIMISTIC ABOUT FUTURE OF THE CITY. END SUMMARY.

ONE SOURCE, AN AIR FORCE LIEUTENANT WHO FINISHED HIS MILITARY SERVICE THIS WEEK MADE FOLLOWING POINTS: DISCIPLINE AT TABRIZ AF BASE IS NEGLIGIBLE AND MOOD OF BASE IS COMBINATION OF HIERARCHICAL APATHY AND ANARCHY. PRESENT BASE COMMANDER IS COL. JAHANFAKH, WHO WAS CHOSEN BY POPULAR VOTE IN MID-FEBRUARY. JAHANFAKH HAD BEEN BASE COMMANDER DURING PREVIOUS REGIME AND DID NOT WANT TO RETAIN POSTION, BUT WAS FORCED BECAUSE OF LACK OF ALTERNATIVES FOR BASE. A MAJOR KHALILI WAS APPOINTED BY AF COMMAND IN TEHRAN TO TAKE OVER TABRIZ BASE BUT UPON ARRIVAL THERE WAS NOT ALLOWED TO ASSUME DUTIES.

KHALILI HAD ONCE BEEN PILOT FOR SHAH AND CROWN PRINCE AND SO THE HOMOFARS AND CONSCRIPTS AT TABRIZ RAISED OUTCRY VIS A VIS HIS TRUSTWORTHINESS. ACCORDING TO SOURCE, DAILY FLIGHTS FROM TABRIZ AF BASE ARE DOWN TO ABOUT 20 PERCENT OF PREREVOLUTION NUMBER.

AF LIEUTENANT WITNESSED DEMONSTRATION IN TABRIZ ON 23 APRIL WHEN THOUSANDS OF PEOPLE MARCHED TO SHOW SUPPORT FOR AYATOLLAH SHARIAT MADARI. ALL CITY BANKS, SCHOOLS, AND BUSINESSES WERE CLOSED DURING DAY OF MARCH. ACCORDING TO SOURCE, CLOSURES RESULTED FROM FEAR OF VIOLENCE AS MUCH AS FROM SHOW OF SUPPORT. CITY ATMOSPHERE WAS VERY TENSE, AND SHOUTS OF DEATH TO KHALKHALI DOMINATED SCENE. NOTE: AYATOLLAH KHALKHALI HAD WRITTEN ARTICLE SEEN AS ATTACKING TABRIZ'S HOME TOWN HERO SHARIAT MADARI. PICTURES OF SHARIAT MADARI WERE DOMINANT, WITH ONLY A VERY FEW SCATTERED KHOMEINI PORTRAITS.

SECOND SOURCE IS TABRIZ BUSINESSMAN, WHO CLAIMS ECONOMIC LIFE OF CITY IS AT VIRTUAL STANDSTILL. DURING PAST TWO MONTHS A WAVE OF STRIKES HAS HIT EVEN SMALLEST WORKSHOPS AND FACTORIES. WORKERS BELIEVED KHOMEINI'S IRAN WOULD BE BED OF ROSES AND IMMEDIATELY DEMANDED BETTER SALARIES AND OTHER BENEFITS WHICH EMPLOYERS COULD NOT MEET. FACED WITH STAGGERING NUMBER OF UNEMPLOYED ALREADY IN TABRIZ STREETS SOURCE'S WORKERS FINALLY RETURNED BUT ARE VERY RESTLESS. SEVERAL OTHER LOCAL TABRIZ BUSINESSMEN HAVE ECHOED SAME CLAIMS TO EMBOFF IN PAST WEEKS. MANY WORKSHOPS REMAIN CLOSED, AND SPENDING MONEY IS BEING TIGHTLY GRASPED BY CONSUMERS.

THIRD SOURCE TO DISCUSS TABRIZ'S PROBLEMS WITH EMBOFF WAS LOCAL PHYSICIAN, WHO PLAYED PROMINENT ROLE IN TABRIZ'S POST-REVOLUTION COMMITTEE RULE SYSTEM. SOURCE IS THOROUGHLY DISGUSTED WITH EFFECTS OF COMMITTEE ACTITIVIES IN TABRIZ. HE CLAIMS THAT MANY OF THE CITY'S PHYSICIANS AND NURSES HAVE BEEN SUBJECT TO ARREST AND INTERROGATION. HE SAID, FOR EXAMPLE, THAT THE DIRECTOR OF TABRIZ'S HEART HOSPITAL WAS PULLED OUT OF OPERATING ROOM AND ARRESTED WHILE PERFORMING HEART SURGERY LAST MONTH. PATIENT DIED AS A RESULT. THE HEART SPECIALIST WAS LATER RELEASED, BUT REFUSED TO RESUME DUTIES AND NOW PLANS TO DEPART IRAN ASAP WITH FAMILY.

DESPITE EVENTUAL RELEASES, EXPERIENCE HAS LEFT MANY WITH BITTER TASTE AND THERE IS MUCH TALK OF EMIGRATION IN MEDICAL CIRCLES. SOURCE PLANNED TO VISIT USA THIS MONTH BUT WAS TOLD NO RPT NO DOCTORS COULD DEPART IRAN FOR TIME BEING.

AN ARMENIAN FROM TABRIZ ACTIVE IN CULTURAL AND RELIGIOUS AFFAIRS THERE CLAIMS DISSENSION HAS RENT ALL ARMENIAN ORGANIZATIONS IN THE CITY. THE ARMENIAN ARCHBISHOP WAS TRANSFERRED TO BEIRUT IN JANUARY AND SINCE FEBRUARY THE ARMENIAN COMMUNITY HAS SPLIT INTO TWO PARTS. ONE YOUNGER GROUP, WHOM THE SOURCE CALLS COMMUNIST UNQUOTE REFUSES TO RECOGNIZE THE AUTHORITY OF THE EPISCOPAL COUNCIL, THE SOCIAL AND WELFARE ORGANIZATION AND THE ARMENIAN SCHOOL AUTHORITIES. THE SPLINTER GROUP CLAIMS THE OLD OFFICIALS MUST ALL RESIGN BECAUSE OF THEIR CONNECTION TO THE PAHLEVI ERA. FISTICUFFS AND VERBAL ATTACKS HAVE BECOME THE RULE IN LOCAL CHURCH RELATED AFFAIRS.

ALL SOURCES WITH WHOM EMBOFF HAS SPOKEN RECENTLY DESCRIBE MOOD OF INCREASING TENSION IN CITY. CITY MOOD IS EXACERBATED BY RIVAL COMMITTEE GROUPS AND RIVAL LOCAL RELIGIOUS LEADERS, MASSIVE UNEMPLOYMENT, AND LACK OF CITY ADMINISTRATIVE DISCIPLINE. ACCORDING TO SOURCES, ------------------125020 301403Z /46 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 1153 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 04486 CITY IS PSYCHOLOGICAL POWDER KEG WAITING TO BLOW UP.
(C-ENTIRE TEXT) THIS IS A REPORTING CABLE.

SUMMARY: MINATCHI RECEIVED AMERICANS WITH WARMTH AND APPRECIATION FOR CHARGE'S MESSAGE. MINATCHI WAS CONCERNED ABOUT CAMPAIGN UNQUOTE AGAINST IRAN IN U.S. MEDIA. HE SAID IRAN WANTED TO CONTINUE TIES WITH U.S. AND USG SHOULD DISREGARD MUCH OF COMMUNIST PROPAGANDA. MINATCHI MONITORS VOA PERSIAN SERVICE AND FOUND IT EXCELLENT. COMMUNISTS ARE NOT A THREAT TO IRAN; MORE DANGEROUS ARE EX-SAVAKEES WHO ARE ATTACKING REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS. DESPITE PROBLEMS GOI WILL MAKE IT. MINATCHI SUGGESTED THREE TIMES THAT HE ARRANGE MEETING FOR CHARGE WITH BAZARGAN AND LATER WITH KHOMEINI. END SUMMARY.

CHARGE, PAO SHELLENBERGER, AND ACTING POL CHIEF STEMPEL CALLED ON MININFO DR. NASSER MINATCHI APRIL 29 AS PART OF CHARGE'S CONTINUING ROUND OF CALLS. CHARGE OPENED DISCUSSION BY INDICATING U.S. WANTS FREE, PROSPEROUS IRAN AND IS WILLING TO WORK WITH PGOI AT PACE IT DESIRES. HE EXPRESSED CONCERN FOR INTENSE BARRAGE OF SOVIET PROPAGANDA IN RECENT DAYS AND WEEKS AND FLATLY STATED USG IS NOT RPT NOT INTERVENING IN IRAN. CHARGE SUGGESTED THAT MININFO AND HIS COLLEAGUES MIGHT BE HELPFUL IN GETTING THAT MESSAGE ACROSS TO AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI. CHARGE URGED FRANK DISCUSSIONS TO KEEP INEVITABLE IRRITANTS FROM BECOMING PROBLEMS.

MINATCHI RESPONDED IN VERY FRIENDLY AND WARM MANNER, NOTING PRESS IS FREE IN IRAN, AND MANY ARE MERELY MOUTHING SLOGANS. BAZARGAN CABINET, AYATOLLAH'S GOVERNMENT UNQUOTE WANTS TO KEEP TIES WITH U.S. HE SUGGESTED CHARGE ALLOW HIM TO ARRANGE MEETING WITH BAZARGAN AND LATER WITH KHOMEINI. CHARGE SAID HE HAD INTENDED TO MEET WITH BAZARGAN AFTER SEEING SEVERAL MINISTERS, BUT MADE NO COMMENT ON KHOMEINI MEETING. MINATCHI REPEATED OFFER TWO MORE TIMES DURING COURSE OF MEETING AND CHARGE REPLIED SIMILARLY (SEE COMMENT, PARA 9 BELOW).

MININFO SAID USG SHOULD DISREGARD COMMUNIST PROPAGANDA. PAST U.S. TIES WITH THE SHAH LED TO SUSPICIONS, BUT EVERYTHING IS WIPED CLEAN NOW. SITUATION IN IRAN WOULD BE IMPROVING IN NEXT ONE TO TWO MONTHS. U.S. RELATIONS WITH ISLAMIC MOVEMENT AT SENIOR LEVELS HAD BEEN GOOD AND UNDERSTANDING (HERE HE NODDED TOWARD ACTING POL CHIEF, WHO HAD MET WITH MINATCHI ON A NUMBER OF OCCASIONS BEFORE AND DURING CRITICAL DAYS OF REVOLUTION). U.S. UNDERSTANDING IN PAST MADE IT MORE DIFFICULT TO UNDERSTAND, MINATCHI SAID, PRESS CAMPAIGN UNQUOTE AGAINST NEW GOVERNMENT BY AMERICAN MEDIA. ALLUDING TO U.S.

CRITICISM OF TRIALS MINATCHI SAID PGOI WAS READY TO PRODUCE EVIDENCE, BUT IN MANY CASES REVOLUTIONARY COURT WITNESSES DID NOT WANT TESTIMONY ON RAPE AND ABUSE PARADED IN PUBLIC. CHARGE REPLIED THAT EXECUTIONS WERE A SHOCK TO MANY, ESPECIALLY SUPPORTERS OF IRANIAN REVOLUTION'S INSISTENCE ON HUMAN RIGHTS, BUT THAT THERE WAS NO MEDIA CAMPAIGN AGAINST IRAN. ACTING POL CHIEF REFERRED TO PREVIOUS DISCUSSIONS WITH MINATCHI ON PROBLEMS OF EVIDENCE AND INTERNATIONAL STANDARDS OF FAIR TRIAL. MINATCHI REPLIED THAT MINJUSTICE WOULD BE MAKING MORE MATERIAL AVAILABLE IN FUTURE. HE ALSO SAID ONLY 70-80 HAD BEEN EXECUTED. OUR COUNT IS 167.

AMERICANS PRESSED FOR CONTINUATION OF NEWLY-OPENED FOREIGN PRESS CENTER, AND MINATCHI SAID IT WOULD CONTINUE. (HIS DEPUTY, A PARTICULARLY NASTY REVOLUTIONARY NAMED BEZARHIN, HAD HINTED TO FOREIGN PRESS IT MIGHT BE CLOSED.)

MINATCHI SAID COMMUNISTS COULD NOT POSSIBLY SERIOUSLY THREATEN ISLAMIC REVOLUTION, SINCE THEY WERE SO FEW. THEY HAVE A GOOD ORGANIZATION IN SOME CITIES AND IN SOME MINORITY COMMUNITIES, BUT MASS SUPPORT FOR KHOMEINI WOULD KEEP THEM UNDER CONTROL. MINATCHI THEN WENT INTO DISCUSSION OF CORRUPTION AND BRUTALITY IN OLD REGIME, AND DEFENDED REVOLUTIONARY DECISION TO EXECUTE A FEW TO KEEP MOB VIOLENCE DOWN. HE ACKNOWLEDGED SOME DEFICIENCIES IN REVOLUTIONARY JUSTICE, AND INTIMATED THAT REVOLUTIONARY COURTS WOULD BE CLOSING UP. HE BORE DOWN ON COLLECTIVE RESPONSIBILITY OF MINISTERS UNDER ART. 61 OF SHAH'S CONSTITUTION UNQUOTE AS JUSTIFICATION FOR SOME EXECUTIONS.

HE SAID PGOI HAD FACED VERY DIFFICULT PROBLEMS WHEN IT CAME TO POWER, BUT WAS SLOWLY WORKING THINGS OUT. HE URGED HIS AMERICAN AUDIENCE OF THREE TO BE PATIENT; DESPITE ATTEMPTS OF OLD REGIME AND SHAH IN PARTICULAR TO BANKRUPT THE NEW, PGOI WOULD GET THE COUNTRY MOVING. HE RECITED NUMBERS OF PUBLIC BUILDINGS WHICH SHAH HAD ------------------125141 301417Z /47 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1156 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 04490 LIMDIS MORTGAGED UNQUOTE SENDING FUNDS TO ACCOUNTS IN SWITZERLAND. THIS BUILDING WAS MORTGAGED EVEN UNQUOTE HE SAID FOR 35 MILLION DOLLARS. UNQUOTE

SOME THREATS REMAIN -- GROUPS HE DESCRIBED AS EX-SAVAKEES HAVE BEEN ATTACKING REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS EACH NIGHT AND KILLING SOME. (NOTE: THIS IS FIRST AUTHORITATIVE ADMISSION BY SENIOR PGOI OFFICIAL THAT THIS IS HAPPENING, AND WAS OBVIOUSLY NOT FOR PUBLICATION.) MINATCHI POINTED TO SWIFT WAY KHOMEINI COMMITTEE IN ABADAN HAD ROUNDED UP AND ARRESTED 40 MARXIST FEDAYEN ABOUT FIVE DAYS EARLIER WHEN THEY BEGAN TO CAUSE TROUBLE.

IN REPLY TO COMMENT BY PAO ON VOA PERSIAN SERVICE, MINATCHI IMMEDIATELY SAID HE WAS VERY PLEASED WITH IT, THAT MINISTRY MONITORED IT REGULARLY, AND HE FOUND IT FACTUALLY EXCELLENT AND A MOST IMPORTANT BROADCAST. (HE DID LET POSITIVE COMPARISON WITH BBC REMAIN UNSAID, BUT HE HAS NEVER BEEN AS IN LOVE WITH BBC AS SOME OF HIS COLLAEGUES.)

COMMENT: MINATCHI IS ALWAYS AN OPTIMIST, BUT HE WAS CONFIDENT IN WHAT HE SAID. WAY HE KEPT RETURNING TO VISIT BY CHARGE UPON PRIME MINISTER AND KHOMEINI SUGGESTS TIME HAS COME FOR BAZARGAN VISIT; SEPTEL WILL TREAT OFFER OF KHOMEINI VISIT. MINATCHI APPEARS IN GOOD HEALTH AND IN BETTER COMMAND OF HIS NEW JOB THAN WHEN POLOFFS VISITED HIM IN EARLY MARCH. CLEARLY POWER AGREES WITH THE DR.

SUMMARY: THE PGOI HAS YET TO REVEAL ITS 1358 BUDGET OR ECONOMIC PLAN. OUR PRELIMINARY ESTIMATES, HOWEVER, SUGGEST A BUDGET OF $27.5 BILLION, WHICH COULD BE MET WITH LITTLE DIFFICULTY BY FORESEEN REVENUES. IRAN'S THREE MONTH PROVISIONAL BUDGET OF RIALS 600 BILLION FOR THE QUARTER ENDING JUNE 21, REFLECTS A LITERAL READOPTION OF THE RIALS 2,390 BILLION ($33.9 BILLION) 1356 BUDGET. OUR BEST ESTIMATE, HOWEVER, OF AN EXPENDITURE BUDGET FOR 1358, WHICH ENDS MARCH 20, 1980, IS RIALS 1940 BILLION, I.E., $27.5 BILLION, OF WHICH $19.0 BILLION WOULD MEET CURRENT NEEDS, $7 BILLION CAPITAL AND $1.5 BILLION DEBT SERVICE AND OTHER, E.G., FOREIGN, OBLIGATIONS.

ASSUMING A LOW AVERAGE OF 3.5 MMB/D OIL PRODUCTION, OR $18 BILLION FROM EXPORTS, THE BALANCE OF REVENUES MUST BE FROM STATE ENTERPRISES, TAXATION AND DOMESTIC BORROWINGS. MAJOR BUDGET PROBLEMS WILL BE BUREAUCRATIC, WHICH WILL FRUSTRATE EFFICIENT ALLOCATIONS. WE KNOW LITTLE REGARDING THE STATUS OF MUNICIPAL AND PROVINCIAL FINANCES. ECONOMIC PLANNING, TO THE EXTENT KNOWN TO BE PROGRESSING, SEEMS TO BE DONE MORE BY THE STAFF OF MINISTER OF STATE FOR REVOLUTIONARY AFFAIRS SAHABI THAN THE PLAN AND BUDGET ORGANIZATION. DECISIONS ON MAJOR PROJECTS ARE PROMISED BY JUNE.

INDICATIONS OF TILT IN ECONOMIC PRIORITIES, AS GENERALLY REPORTED, WILL FAVOR AGRICULTURE, AWAY FROM INDUSTRY (ESPECIALLY ASSEMBLY) AND SELF-HELP, AWAY FROM HEAVY RELIANCE ON FOREIGN TECHNOLOGY. WE EXPECT THE USE OF FOREIGN TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE TO BE LIMITED TO HARDWARE AND BY CONTRACTORS. END SUMMARY.

PBO MINISTER MONIFAR, AS REPORTED IN REF A, PREDICTED A 1358 BUDGET 70-75 PERCENT OF 1357, WHICH WOULD BE THE LEVEL OF YEAR 1356. THE APPROVAL, REPORTED REF B, BY THE COUNCIL OF MINISTERS AND THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL OF A RLS. 600 BILLION ($8.5 BILLION) BUDGET FOR THE FIRST QUARTER OF 1358 (ENDS JUNE 21) IN FACT REFLECTS A LITERAL READOPTION OF THE RIALS 2,390 BILLION ($33.9 BILLION) 1356 BUDGET. OUR SOURCE SAYS THAT THIS WAS DONE FOR CONVENIENCE SAKE, SINCE NO BUDGET PREPARATION WAS DONE FOR 1358 DUE TO THE PUBLIC SECTOR STRIKES AND THE PGOI'S ECONOMIC OBJECTIVES MARRIED BETTER WITH THE OLDER 1356 BUDGET.

(IN FACT, AS IT MAY BE RECALLED FROM EMBASSY REPORTING, THE GOI LAST FALL FORMALLY ADOPTED A SHADOW BUDGET THAT EFFECTIVELY LOWERED THE 1357 BUDGET TO THE LEVEL OF 1356.) A COMPLETE 1358 BUDGET IS PROMISED BEFORE JUNE 21. IF IT IS LATE, WE EXPECT ANOTHER EXTENTION AUTHORITY BASED ON THE 1356 BUDGET MODEL AND, IN ANY EVENT, THE FINAL BUDGET SHOULD BE CONSIDERABLY BELOW THE 1356 LEVEL, IF FOR NO OTHER REASON THAN THAT DELAYED RESUMPTION OF EXPENDITURES, PARTICULARLY CAPITAL, UNDER THE PGOI WILL OBTAIN SHORT-TERM FISCAL SAVINGS.

OUR BEST UNDERSTANDING OF THE CURRENT BUDGET AUTHORIZATION/ALLOCATION PROCEDURE SUGGESTS A CONTINUED USE OF A INTER-AGENCY COMMITTEE OF OFFICIALS, BUT WE ASSUME THAT THE REVOLUTIONARY TENTACLES, FORMALIZED IN THE NEW FUNCTION OF MINISTER FOR REVOLUTIONARY AFFAIRS DR. YADOLLAH SAHABI, EXERT INFLUENCE. THE INTER-AGENCY COMMITTEE, WHICH IS CHAIRED BY PBO AND INCLUDES TWO PBO OFFICERS, TWO FROM THE MEAF AND ONE FROM THE CBI, REPORTEDLY MEETS WEEKLY TO DETERMINE ALLOCATIONS AGAINST THE AUTHORIZED BUDGET. THIS COMMITTEE FORMERLY MET WEEKLY ON CAPITAL ITEMS AND MONTHLY ON CURRENT EXPENDITURES. WE HAVE NOT PURSUED, NOR HEARD, CONCERNING THE ALLOCATION FROM THE BUDGET TO LOCAL AND PROVINCIAL AUTHORITIES.
LOOKING THROUGH A DARK GLASS AT TOO MANY UNKNOWNS, WE NONETHELESS POSIT AS A REALISTIC AND ADEQUATE EXPENDITURE BUDGET FOR 1358 RIALS 1940 BILLION, $27.5 BILLION.

MAJOR BREAKDOWNS IN BILLIONS OF DOLLARS (AT 70.5 TO $) FOLLOW, WITH 1356 AND 1357 AUTHORIZED BUDGETS GIVEN AS COMPARISON: - 1358 1356 1357 CURRENT 19.0 18.8 22.8 CAPITAL 7.0 14.1 17.5 OTHER (A) 1.5 2.5 3.4 DEDUCTION (B) 0 1.5 2.0 TOTAL 27.5 33.9 41.6 (C) (A) INCLUDES DEBT SERVICE, FOREIGN INVESTMENT AND CREDIT AND MISC. ------------------125218 301444Z /46 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1163 SECTION 02 OF 04 TEHRAN 04495 (B) IRAN'S BUDGET'S HAVE INCLUDED A "PAYMENTS NOT REALIZED" ESTIMATE; 80-90 PERCENT CAN BE RELATED TO THE CAPITAL BUDGET. (C) ROUNDING

OUR "BEST ESTIMATE BUDGET" ASSUMES ON THE CURRENT EXPENDITURES LITTLE CHANGE IN NOMINAL TERMS FROM THE 1356 LEVEL. IMPACTING FACTORS ARE THE CIVIL SERVICE REFORM (SEE SEPTEL) WHICH ARE TO REDUCE OVERALL COSTS AND SHOULD OFFSET LARGELY THE COMPENSATION INCREASES AWARDED LAST SEPTEMBER AND MARCH. WE LACK ADEQUATE DETAILS CONCERNING THE SIZE AND PROFILE OF THE CIVIL SERVICE TO DETERMINE MORE PRECISELY THE NET EFFECT OF THE REFORMS. WE HAVE EVEN LESS INFORMATION CONCERNING CURRENT EXPENDITURE FORECASTS, PARTICULARLY IN PERSONNEL, OF NON-CIVIL SERVICE PUBLIC SECTOR INSTITUTIONS. IN THE CASE OF ONE UNIVERSITY, HOWEVER, WE ARE TOLD THAT A 40 PERCENT SAVINGS WAS ACHIEVED IN CURRENT EXPENDITURES WITHOUT AFFECTING SERVICES.

SERVICE CONTRACTS WERE RENEGOTIATED WITH A REASONABLE PROFIT MARGIN ALLOWED (TAKING ADVANTAGE OF THE ECONOMIC SLACK) AND FRILLS SUCH AS STAFF CARS AND PRIVATE SECRETARIES AND TELEPHONES WERE ELIMINATED. ON THE OTHER HAND, WE WOULD INCLUDE IN CURRENT EXPENDITURES THE INCREMENTAL COSTS OF UNEMPLOYMENT AND INDUSTRIAL RECOVERY LOANS, AT LEAST TO THE UNKNOWN EXTENT THEY ARE NOT FUNDED OUT OF, FOR EXAMPLE, THE SOCIAL SECURITY FUND. OFFSETTING SUCH LOANS OR TRANSFER PAYMENTS MAY BE THE BENEFITS FUNDED FROM THE VOLUNTARY CONTRIBUTIONS SOLICITED BY CIVIL AND RELIGIOUS LEADERS TO HELP THE UNEMPLOYED AND TO PAY FOR LOW COST HOUSING, BOTH OF WHICH ARE RECEIVED THROUGH WELL-PUBLICIZED ACCOUNTS AT BANK MELLI.

OTHER CURRENT EXPENDITURES WE WOULD EXPECT TO SEE REDUCED SUBSTANTIALLY INCLUDE RENTALS, COMPUTER SERVICES, CONTRACT SERVICES (ESPECIALLY FOREIGN), OFFICE EQUIPMENT AND SUPPLIES AND VEHICLES. IN ALL, WE BELIEVE THAT OUR $19 BILLION ESTIMATE IS ADEQUATE TO MEET NEEDS AND INTENTIONS ARTICULATED BY THE PGOI AND CONTAINS BUT A REASONABLE MARGIN OF ERROR.

THE BALANCE OF THE BUDGET, CAPITAL AND "OTHER" ARE PROJECTED DOWN CONSIDERABLY FROM THE 1356 LEVEL, BUT IT IS MORE DIFFICULT TO SUBSTANTIATE THESE FORECASTS. APART FROM ANY APPLICABLE DEFLATOR, THE CAPITAL BUDGET ESTIMATE OF $7 BILLION IS HALF THAT OF 1356. OUR BUDGET ESTIMATE OF $1.5 BILLION FOR THE BASKET OF EXPENDITURES WHICH INCLUDES DEBT SERVICE, FOREIGN CREDITS AND MISC. COMPARES WITH $4 AND $5.4 BILLIONS IN 1356 AND 1367, RESPECTIVELY. CONCERNING THE CAPITAL BUDGET, IT MUST BE NOTED THAT IN THE BUDGETS AUTHORIZED FOR 1356 AND 1367, THE SUMS OF RLS.

110 AND 150 BILLIONS WERE IDENTIFIED AS DEDUCTIONS FOR PAYMENTS NOT REALIZED, I.E., FUNDS AUTHORIZED BUT NOT EXPECTED TO BE UTILIZED. INVESTIGATION PREVIOUSLY OF THIS RATHER ODD BUDGET ITEM REVEALED THAT THE AMOUNT RELATED ALMOST SOLELY TO CAPITAL ITEMS. THUS, OUR $7 BILLION ESTIMATE REALISTICALLY COMPARES WITH $12.5 BILLION IN 1356. FURTHER, WE INCLUDE IN THE $7 BILLION ESTIMATE SAY $1.5 BILLION IN CAPITAL PAYMENT ARREARAGES FROM 1357. A PRINCIPAL CONTRIBUTOR TO THE DECLINE IN THIS BUDGET IS THE MILITARY, AND THE NET OF PAYMENTS OWED AND REFUNDS FOR CANCELLATIONS OR RESALES FOR EXAMPLE UNDER THE FMS IS YET UNDETERMINED.

ANOTHER DIFFICULT VARIABLE IS THE TIMING OF RESUMED CAPITAL DISBURSEMENT AGAINST MAJOR PROJECTS PUT INTO SUSPENSE BY THE REVOLUTION. DEPUTY PM AMIR-ENTEZAM ANNOUNCED APRIL 26 THE CONCLUSIONS OF A PGOI EXPERT COMMITTEE TO PROCEED WITH 43 DEVELOPMENTAL PROJECTS BEGUN UNDER THE PREVIOUS REGIME AND AUTHORIZE RLS. 123 BILLION ($1.7 BILLION) ACCORDINGLY. THIS ASIDE, DECISIONS CONCERNING THE CONTINUATION OF MANY PROJECTS ARE STILL NOT IN HAND, MUCH LESS INDICATIONS OF PAYMENT SCHEDULES OR MODIFICATIONS OF CONTRACTS. THESE DELAYS OR CURTAILMENTS OF PAYMENTS WILL BRING SHORT-TERM SAVINGS TO THE BUDGET, ALTHOUGH THE OVERALL COSTS OF PROJECTS MAY INCREASE. THUS, OUR $7 BILLION FIGURE IS BUT AN EDUCATED GUESS.

THE $1.5 BILLION ESTIMATE FOR OTHER EXPENDITURES TAKES INTO ACCOUNT: (A) A MUCH REDUCED LEVEL OF DISBURSEMENTS FOR FOREIGN CREDIT AND INVESTMENTS, IN FACT THE MINIMUM NECESSARY TO MEET CLEAR-CUT OBLIGATIONS; (B) A ROUGHLY $1 BILLION FOR DEBT SERVICE; AND (C) LITTLE MISC. EXPENDITURES, PARTICULARLY SINCE WE (FACETIOUSLY) HAVE EXPECTATIONS THAT A REVOLUTIONARY GOVERNMENT WILL NOT BE PRONE TO UNORTHODOX AND UNDECLARED EXPENDITURES.

THE REVENUE BUDGET, APART FROM THAT DERIVED FROM THE OIL SECTOR, IS MOST DIFFICULT TO FORECAST, BUT THE NON-OIL REVENUE GAP IS NOT INSURMOUNTABLE. USING A LOW ASSUMPTION OF 3.5 MMB/D OIL PRODUCTION, FOREIGN EXCHANGE REVENUES OF $18 BILLION ARE VISUALIZED (SEE REF C). THIS IS AN ELASTIC PRODUCTION FIGURE AND COULD BE INCREASED AS THE GOVERNMENT'S PERCEPTION OF REVENUE NEEDS CHANGES. RECEIPTS RATHER THAN THE VOLUME COULD INCREASE IF, AS IS PROBABLE, THE WORLD OIL MARKET TIGHTENS.

INDEED, AVERAGE PRODUCTION HAS BEEN ------------------125337 301444Z /46 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1164 SECTION 03 OF 04 TEHRAN 04495 CLOSER TO 4 MMB/D THE LAST MONTH AND, AS REPORTED BY SEPTEL, NIOC PROJECTS PRODUCTION AT THAT LEVEL WITH AN EXPORT SALES PROFILE PROVIDING SOME $20 BILLION (2.9 MMB/D TERM SALES, 250 MB/D SPOT AND 200 MB/D PRODUCT). (IN ANY EVENT, FOREIGN EXCHANGE RECEIPTS OF $18-20 BILLION WILL SUSTAIN MORE THAN SUFFICIENT FOREIGN EXCHANGE RESOURCES.) THE BALANCE OF REVENUES, AT MOST $9.5 BILLION, IS NOT AN INSURMOUNTABLE SUM TO OBTAIN FROM TAXES, PROFITS OF OTHER STATE ENTERPRISES AND A MODERATE LEVEL OF DOMESTIC DEBT FINANCING.

TAX REVENUES ARE MOST DIFFICULT TO ESTIMATE SINCE, AS REPORTED, THE GOVERNMENT IS TRYING WITH INCENTIVES TO COLLECT SOME PERCENTAGE OF TAXES OWED FOR YEARS PAST. ADDITIONALLY, THE PGOI RECENTLY INCREASED THE PERSONAL TAX EXEMPT INCOME FROM RLS. 12,000 TO 30,000 A MONTH. THE ANTICIPATED LOWER IMPORT VOLUME, WITH THE DECLINE PRINCIPALLY IN HIGH DUTY AND TAX NON-ESSENTIAL GOODS, SHOULD RESULT IN LOWER REVENUES FROM CUSTOMS AND COMMERCIAL BENEFITS TAXES; YET GOODS BACKLOGGED DURING LAST YEAR MAY PRODUCE SOME SIGNIFICANT REVENUES IN THIS YEAR. CORPORATE TAXES SHOULD BE LOW, GIVEN THE WIDESPREAD, DEPRESSED FINANCIAL CONDITION OF BUSINESS.

PROFITS FROM STATE ENTERPRISES WILL AUGMENT REVENUES; THOSE FROM THE CENTRAL BANK AND BANK MELLI WILL CONTRIBUTE OVER $1 BILLION. THE BALANCE NEEDED SHOULD NOT BE DIFFICULT TO RAISE FROM DOMESTIC BORROWING, WHICH WILL CONTINUE TO BE CHIEFLY THROUGH THE RESERVE REQUIREMENT IMPOSED ON BANKING AND INSURANCE.

PROBLEMS IN THE EXECUTION OF THE BUDGET WILL BE MORE MANAGERIAL AND POLITICAL THAN FINANCIAL. THE CIVIL SERVICE AND BUREAUCRACIES OF PUBLIC ENTERPRISES ARE STILL LARGELY NONFUNCTIONAL. SUSPICION AND PURIFICATION OF THE PAST REMAINS A GREATER PRIORITY THAN FORWARD MOVEMENT. PRESSURES TO ADDRESS A MILLION WRONGS WILL MAKE DECISIONS ON ALLOCATION OF THE BUDGET SENSITIVE AND ARDUOUS. POLITICALLY CHARGED ISSUES SUCH AS UNEMPLOYMENT, SPORATIC SHORTAGES AND HOUSING WILL ATTRACT THE ATTENTION OF THE GOVERNMENT'S PRINCIPALS, WHILE IMPORTANT THOUGH LESS POLITICALLY REWARDING ACTIVITIES WILL AWAIT STUDY AND APPROVAL FOR ALLOCATIONS.

WE FEAR THAT FUNCTIONS BLESSED BY THE REVOLUTIONARY PLATFORM, SUCH AS FEEDER ROADS, SELF-HELP AGRICULTURAL PROJECTS AND SELF-HELP LOW-COST HOUSING, WILL GET SCANT RATIONAL CONSIDERATION BUT PRIORITY ALLOCATIONS. THE FLIGHT OF EXPERTISE WILL NO DOUBT ALSO PLAGUE THE ANALYTICAL AND ALLOCATIVE FUNCTIONS OF THE PGOI. REVOLUTIONS ARE INEFFICIENT, AND ALTHOUGH THE PUBLIC SECTOR ARREARAGES BROUGHT INTO 1358 ARE PAID WITH INFLATED PETRODOLLARS AND SUSPENDED DISBURSEMENTS ON MANY ECONOMIC ACTIVITIES, SOUND AND UNSOUND, HAVE PERHAPS KEPT THE TREASURY FROM BEING IN DISASTEROUS CONDITION, THE LONGERTERM COSTS OF MANY PROJECTS WILL INCREASE.

ECONOMIC PLANNING, TO THE EXTENT IT IS OCCURRING, SEEMS TO BE DONE MORE BY THE STAFF OF THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR REVOLUTIONARY AFFAIRS, DR. YADOLLAH SAHADI, THAN BY PBO. (SAHADI AND HIS STAFF OBTAINED SUBSTANTIAL EXPOSURE TO IRAN'S ECONOMY WHEN COORDINATING THE REVOLUTIONARY STRIKE ACTIVITY.) QUESTIONS POSED BY EMBOFF TO PBO MINISTER MOINFAR CONCERNING PLANNING AND EVALUATION OF PROJECTS PRODUCED VAGUE REPLIES WHICH, WITH SUBSTANTIATION OF PBO CONTACTS, GAVE THE SENSE THAT LITTLE OR NOTHING IN THAT REGARD WAS OCCURRING IN PBO. HE SAID, APRIL 11, THAT DETERMINATIONS CONCERNING WHICH PROJECTS WOULD BE CONTINUED COULD BE EXPECTED WITHIN SIX TO EIGHT WEEKS.

OTHER PBO CONTACTS CANNOT VERIFY THAT ANY SUCH EVALUATION OR DECISIONS ARE TAKING PLACE WITHIN THE HIGHLY POLITICIZED PBO. CONCERNING NEW DEVELOPMENTAL PRIORITIES, MOINFAR PROVIDED ONLY OFT-REPEATED GENERALITIES, INTER ALIA,AGRICULTURAL PROGRAMS (UNSPECIFIED), SELF-HELP FEEDER ROADS AND SELF-HELP LOW-COST HOUSING. AS IN THE INTERVIEW REPORTED BY REF A, SHOW-CASE PROJECTS CAME UNDER ATTACK, AS DID UNNECESSARY FOREIGN TECHNICIANS. BUT ALL THIS WAS EXPRESSED IN A MILD MANNER, LACKING RANCOR. MOINFAR'S REVOLUTIONARY IDEALISM WAS REFLECTED IN HIS EXAMPLE OF HOW PRESENT PUBLIC SECTOR STAFF WOULD BE REORIENTED RATHER THAN DISMISSED FROM UNNECESSARY FUNCTIONS.

THE DESK-BOUND AGRICULTURAL ENGINEER IN TEHRAN WILL, HE SAID, BE OFFERED LAND, FERTILIZER AND OTHER NECESSITIES AND MOVED TO PRACTICE HIS PROFESSION ON THE FARM. WHEN EMBOFF SUGGESTED THAT THE OFFER MIGHT NOT BE TAKEN UP 100 PERCENT, MOINFAR REPEATED WHAT HE HAD SAID CONCERNING TAX COLLECTIONS, I.E., THAT THE PEOPLE AND GOVERN------------------125240 301445Z /46 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1165 SECTION 04 OF 04 TEHRAN 04495 MENT ARE ONE AND WILL NOW COOPERATE AS NEVER BEFORE. NONETHELESS, HE SAID NO ONE WOULD BE FORCED INTO NEW PROGRAMS.

WE ARE NOT WELL INFORMED CONCERNING THE MANDATE OF MINISTER SAHABIT, BUT VIRTUALLY ALL PUBLIC UTTERANCES ON PROJECTS AND EVAULATION OF ECONOMIC POLICY COME FROM HIM. ON APRIL 24, HE PUBLICLY CALLED FOR THE COOPERATION OF ALL ECONOMISTS AND FINANCIAL EXPERTS IN BANKING AND BUDGET TO ASSIST HIS STAFF IN ACHEIVING THE NECESSARY CHANGES IN THE COUNTRY'S ECONOMIC SYSTEM. HOSSEIN BANI-ASSADI, SAHABI'S FORMER DEPUTY AND NOW A DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER, WAS THE ONLY OTHER NAME PUBLICLY ASSOCIATED WITH SAHABI'S FUNCTIONS. WE DO NOT AS YET KNOW IF HE HAS FULLY SEPARATED HIMSELF FROM HIS FORMER FUNCTIONS.
PLANNED CALLS ON SAHABI HOPEFULLY WILL LEAD TO INTRODUCTIONS TO HIS STAFF AND AN UNDERSTANDING OF THE DIRECTIONS ECONOMIC POLICY MAY BE TAKING. NAAS

1979TEHRAN04496.subject: SOUTH AFRICA IN IRAN AND OTHER MIRACLES

segments.text: (C-ENTIRE TEXT) THIS IS A REPORTING CABLE

SUMMARY: SOUTH AFRICAN CONSULATE REMAINS IN IRAN. EXCEPT FOR OIL AND MILITARY HARDWARE, SAFRICANS STILL DOING BULK OF THEIR $200 MILLION A YEAR BUSINESS HERE. ISRAELIS SELLING EGGS AND CHICKEN TO IRAN WITH DIRECT DELIVERY BY AIR FRANCE. END SUMMARY.

ACTING POL CHIEF GOT STORY ON HOW SOUTH AFRICANS REMAINED IN IRAN FROM ACTING CONSUL GENERAL JOHN SUNDE OVER LUNCH 30 APRIL. WHEN IRAN ANNOUNCED BREAK WITH SOUTH AFRICA 5 MARCH, THEN-CONSUL FRASER THOUGHT IT WAS FULL BREAK. SUNDE RETURNED TO IRAN FROM LEAVE 6 MARCH AND WHEN HE CALLED MFA TWO DAYS LATER TO ASK HOW MUCH TIME HE HAD, WAS TOLD THAT BREAK WAS ONLY DIPLOMATIC RELATIONS. IRAN STILL WANTED TO CONTINUE CONSULAR TIES, AND THEREFORE SUNDE WAS ACTING CONSUL GENERAL. UNQUOTE PRETORIA HAD TROUBLE BUYING THAT TITLE, BUT DECIDED TO STAY.

SUNDE SAYS SOUTH AFRICAN BUSINESS, WITH EXCEPTION OF OIL AND MILITARY HARDWARE IS CONTINUING, AND SHOULD REMAIN AT EXISTING $200 MILLION PER YEAR FOR AT LEAST NEXT 12 MONTHS. MFA WAS FIRM ON NO DIRECT OIL SALES, BUT TOLD SUNDE WE KNOW YOU'RE BUYING OUR OIL AT SPOT PRICES, AND THAT'S OK UNQUOTE. (SUNDE SAID SA WAS INDEED BUYING SUCCESSFULLY ON SPOT MARKET.) MFA WAS FIRM THAT MILITARY RELATIONSHIP WAS OVER, BUT ADDED THAT COMMERCIAL TRANSACTIONS WERE FINE. SUNDE HAS ASKED SEVERAL TIMES WHAT IRAN WANTED OUT OF HIS REMAINING, BUT HAS RECEIVED NO RPT NO ANSWER YET.

IN PROCESS OF SORTING OUT SOUTH AFRICAN BUSINESS SUNDE LEARNED THAT ISRAELIS ARE SELLING EGGS AND POULTRY TO IRAN. FINANCES ARE HANDLED THROUGH SWITZERLAND, AND AIR FRANCE FLIES CARGO IN DIRECT FROM TEL AVIV ONCE A WEEK. SUNDE THOUGHTISRAELI BUSINESS WAS REALLY SUBSTANTIAL BUT COULD GIVE NO FIGURES.

FOR DEPT AF/S: FOR WHAT IT'S WORTH, SUNDE THOUGHT FONMIN BOTHA HOPED FOR DELAY OF U.S. REACTION TO RHODESIAN ELECTIONS UNTIL AFTER BRITISH ELECTIONS AND NEW CONSERVATIVE GOVERNMENT SETTLED IN. HE SAW POSSIBILITY OF CONSTRUCTIVE JOINT U.S.-U.K. ACTION, PERHAPS AS LEADIN TO COMMONWEALTH PM'S CONFERENCE, AND SAID SOUTH AFRICANS HOPED U.S. CONGRESS WOULD PUSH EXECUTIVE BRANCH TO MORE REASONABLE ATTITUDE. UNQUOTE. NAAS
THIS IS REPORTING MESSAGE.
PGOI FOREIGN OFFICE HAS OFFICIALLY INFORMED ME OF WITHDRAWAL OF REQUEST OF AGREMENT FOR REZA SADR.

I WAS ALSO INFORMED THAT ALI ASGHAR AGAH HAS BEEN APPOINTED AS CHARGE D'AFFAIRES OF EMBASSY IN WASHINGTON. AGAH WAS BORN ON JAN. 31, 1938, SPENT FOUR YEARS IN MINISTRY OF EDUCATION AND TWELVE YEARS AS OFFICIAL OF WORLD BANK. HE IS MARRIED WITH TWO CHILDREN. NAAS
(C-ENTIRE TEXT) THIS IS A REPORTING CABLE.
SUMMARY: CHARGE RAISED SEVERAL POINTS ON U.S. PRESENCE IN IRAN. YAZDI PROMISED TO LOOK INTO MATTERS. END SUMMARY.
ON MAY 1, CHARGE AND ACTING POL CHIEF PAID FIRST CALL ON YAZDI SINCE HE BECAME FOREIGN MINISTER. THIS CABLE COVERS MAIN POINTS U.S. RAISED AND REPLIES. SEPTELS WILL TREAT MORE SPECIALIZED ITEMS.

CHARGE RAISED QUESTIONS OF U.S. ACCESS TO GULF DISTRICT AND ARMY HOSPITAL, AND PERMISSION TO WITHDRAW U.S. DOCUMENTS FROM LAVISAN MILITARY COMPOUND, DOSHEN TAPPEH AIR BASE AND NAVY HEADQUARTERS. YAZDI APPEARED SURPRISED THAT HIS EARLIER EFFORTS TO ALLOW U.S. OFFICIALS TO GAIN ENTRY HAD NOT BORNE FRUIT AND SAID HE WOULD LOOK INTO MATTERS AND BE BACK TO US.

CHARGE RAISED MATTER OF PERMISSION TO SELL EXCESS COMMISSARY LIQUOR TO RELIGIOUS MINORITY BUYER WHO HAD KHOMEINI COMMITTEE PERMISSION TO PURCHASE LIQUOR FOR MINORITY USE. AFTER SHORT LECTURE ON HOW MINORITIES COULD HAVE LIQUOR, BUT NOT SELL IT, AND UPON LEARNING BUYER HAD COMMITTEE PERMISSION, PROVIDED HE PAID CUSTOMS DUTY, YAZDI SAID THIS WAS ALL RIGHT. POLOFF ASKED QUESTION AGAIN AND GOT A DEFINITE AFFIRMATIVE REPLY TO DIRECT QUESTION ON WHETHER SALE WAS ALLOWED. EMBOFFS CONFIRMED TO YAZDI THAT THIS WAS A ONE-TIME DEAL. YAZDI THEN MENTIONED THAT THERE WERE REPORTS THAT SOME DIPLOMATS HAVE BEEN SELLING LIQUOR ON THE BLACK MARKET.

CHARGE STATED THAT IF ANY OFFICIAL AMERICAN IS CAUGHT SELLING LIQUOR IN CONTRAVENTION OF IRANIAN LAW, CHARGE WOULD SEE VIOLATOR ON PLANE OUT OF TOWN WITHIN TWENTY FOUR HOURS. CHARGE URGED FONMIN TO BRING TO OUR ATTENTION ANY U.S. VIOLATION. YAZDI WAS APPRECIATIVE OF THIS ASSURANCE.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)

WE SHARE YOUR CONCERN MOST DEEPLY AND ARE IN REGULAR TOUCH WITH REZA'S WIFE WHO NOW SEES HIM ONCE A WEEK. AT OUR URGING, SHE HAS ASKED REZA IF HE WOULD HAVE SUGGESTIONS AS TO WHO MIGHT BE AN EFFECTIVE GO BETWEEN IN HIS BEHALF. TO DATE, NOTHING. AFTER NEARLY A MONTH OF DETENTION, HE HAS YET TO BE QUESTIONED WHICH HAS BOTH POSITIVE AND NEGATIVE IMPLICATIONS.

AS YOU KNOW AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN RAISED MATTER WITH DEPUTY MINISTER FOR FOREIGN AFFAIRS, AND I HAVE DONE THE SAME WITH DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER ENTEZAM AND THE FORMER DEPUTY PM YAZDI, NOW MINISTER FOR FOREIGN AFFAIRS. ACTING POLITICAL COUNSELOR HAS ALSO PURSUED THE ISSUE THROUGH HIS CONTACTS IN THE KOMITE STRUCTURE.

IN VIEW OF BOTH HIS POSITION AND HIS PREVIOUS ASSOCIATIONS IN TEHRAN, WE THINK A JOHN REINHARDT INITIATIVE COULD BE USEFUL, BUT WE WOULD RECOMMEND THAT IT BE DONE WITH THE NEWLY NAMED CHARGE AGAH WHOSE PIPELINE TO THE LEADERSHIP HERE PRESUMABLY IS MUCH LESS CLOGGED. NAAS
(S - ENTIRE TEXT; ACTION REQUIRED)

SUMMARY: YAZDI RAISED QUESTION OF PRESENCE OF AMCITS IN OR NEAR NAGHADEH AT TIME OF RECENT DISTURBANCES. FONMIN ASKED WHAT PROSPECTS WERE FOR GETTING JURISDICTION OVER CRIMINALS FROM OLD REGIME WHO HAD FLED TO U.S. UNDER ASSUMED NAMES, AND FOR BLOCKING ACTIVITIES OF PAHLAVI FOUNDATION IN U.S. CHARGE SAID WE WOULD LOOK INTO PROBLEMS AND AGAIN URGED GOI TO HIRE A GOOD LAWYER. END SUMMARY.

AT END OF DISCUSSION OF U.S. PRESENCE PROBLEMS (SEE REFTEL), YAZDI ASKED IF THERE WERE ANY PENNSYLVANIANS IN NORTHWESTERN IRAN. HE SAID PGOI HAD REPORTS OF "TWO OR THREE AMERICANS FROM PENNSYLVANIA" BEING PRESENT THERE JUST BEFORE TROUBLES. EFFORTS HAD BEEN MADE TO TRACE THEM LATER, BUT TO NO AVAIL. ALLEGED AMERICANS SPOKE GOOD KURDISH AND TOLD PEOPLE THEY WERE ORIENTALISTS ON A MISSION TO STUDY THE LANGUAGE AND CULTURE OF KURDISH PEOPLE. CHARGE AND ACTING POL CHIEF SAID WE HAD NO KNOWLEDGE OF AMCITS AND EXPRESSED DOUBT U.S. SCHOLARS WOULD BE WANDERING ABOUT IRAN AT THIS TIME.

CHARGE REQUESTED WHATEVER FURTHER INFO PGOI COULD PROVIDE AND SUGGESTED THAT STORY COULD BE RESULT OF DISINFORMATION CAMPAIGN, BUT PROMISED TO CHECK. (SUBSEQUENTLY, POLOFF LEARNED FROM LOCAL U.S. ACADEMIC THAT THERE HAD BEEN UNIVERSITY OF PENNSYLVANIA ARCHAEOLOGISTS AT HASSANLOO-A SHORT WALK FROM NAGHADEH--UP UNTIL TWO YEARS AGO, BUT NONE WERE THERE NOW. CHECK OF OUR BADLY TRUNCATED CONSULAR RECORDS SHOWS NO AMCITS IN REGION, EITHER, BUT THIS DOES NOT RULE OUT POSSIBILITY OF VISITORS. ABOVE BEING PASSED TO YAZDI IN SPIRIT OF HELPING DEFUSE ISSUE.) ACTION REQUESTED: PLEASE CHECK ASAP WITH UNIVERSITY OF PENNSYLVANIA AND LEARNED SOCIETIES TO ASCERTAIN WHETHER THERE ARE SCHOLARS IN AREA.

TWO DAYS AGO AMIR ENTEZAM TOLD PRESS THAT HE WOULD PROVIDE INFO TO PRESS ON SPY RING THURSDAY, MAY 3. WE HAD HOPED THIS WAS REFERENCE TO A SOVIET CAPER GONE SOUR (REPORTED ELSEWHERE) BUT YAZDI'S QUESTION RAISES POSSIBILITY WE WILL BE TARGET OF ATTACK OR THAT "FOR BALANCE" BOTH MATTERS WILL BE RELEASED AT SAME TIME.

FONMIN THEN RAISED QUESTION OF HOW IRAN COULD GO ABOUT TRYING TO GET CUSTODY OF "SEVERAL CRIMINALS" FROM OLD REGIME. YAZDI SAID GOI HAS TRACED SEVERAL WANTED EXSAVAK MEN TO U.S., INCLUDING ALLEGED PERPETRATOR OF ABIDAN REX CINEMA FIRE WHICH KILLED OVER 400 PEOPLE IN AUGUST 1978. CHARGE REPLIED THAT SINCE THERE WAS NO IRAN-U.S. EXTRADITION TREATY, PROBLEM WAS GOING TO BE DIFFICULT AND THAT HE WOULD SEEK ADVICE. CHARGE CONFIRMED THIS WAS QUESTION OF SMALL NUMBER OF PEOPLE WANTED ON SPECIFIC CHARGES. YAZDI SAID ALL HAD NEW PASSPORTS IN ASSUMED NAMES ISSUED BEFORE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT FELL. HE DID NOT PURSUE QUESTION OF HOW GROUP GOT VISAS TO U.S.

(AS MAJOR BENEFICIARY OF PAST LACK OF EXTRADICTION TREATY BETWEEN U.S. AND IRAN, YAZDI IS CERTAINLY MORE BLOODTHIRSTY ON THIS POINT THAN ONE MIGHT EXPECT.) COMMENT: PLEASE ADVISE ME WHETHER ANY ACTION CAN BE TAKEN IN U.S. COURTS BY PGOI FOR CRIMES COMMITTED ABROAD.

YAZDI THEN RAISED QUESTION OF HOW PGOI COULD STOP PAHLAVI FOUNDATION IN NEW YORK FROM SELLING OFF ITS ASSETS--BUILDING, ETC. IRAN'S CENTRAL BANK HAD LOANED FOUNDATION DOLS 39 MILLION, AND PGOI WANTED TO STOP WHAT WAS APPARENT ATTEMPT BY OLD REGIME LEADERS TO MILK OUT LOAN THROUGH SALE OF BUILDINGS. TWICE ALLUDING TO FACT THAT EX-SECSTATE WILLIAM ROGERS WAS CHAIRMAN OF PAHLAVI BOARD, YAZDI SAID IRANIAN PEOPLE HAD TROUBLE UNDERSTANDING NUANCES OF LAW, BUT UNDERSTOOD THEY HAD BEEN ROBBED. HE CONCLUDED THAT USG HAD OBLIGATION TO HELP PGOI STOP THIS. PGOI IS PREPARED TO SHOW PAHLAVI FOUNDATION ASSETS WERE IRANIAN TREASURY FUNDS ILLEGALLY CHANNELED TO FOUNDATION.

EMBOFFS SAID CENTRAL BANK COULD PROBABLY USE U.S. COURTS IF THERE WERE VIOLATIONS OF LAW WITHIN US JURISDICTION. AS EMBOFFS WERE NOT LEGAL SPECIALISTS, HOWEVER, CHARGE WOULD HAVE TO ASK DEPARTMENT FOR ITS VIEWS ON SUBJECT. YAZDI MADE CLEAR THAT HIS QUERY WAS NOT LIMITED TO CBI LOAN BUT COVERED ALL PAHLAVI FOUNDATION ASSETS. CHARGE URGED YAZDI (AS HE HAS URGED OTHERS) TO CONVINCE HIS COLLEAGUES TO HIRE A GOOD LAW FIRM TO FIGHT THE NUMBER OF CASES WHICH ARE COMING TO COURT.

HE CITED INSTANCES WHERE GOI MIGHT HAVE WON ITS POINT WITH ------------------008228 011603Z /46 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 1198 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 04542 LIMDIS SOVEIGN IMMUNITY ARGUMENT IF IT HAD BEEN REPRESENTED IN COURT. HE SPECIFICALLY MENTIONED U.S. TRADE UNION SUIT AGAINST OPEC COUNTRIES, NOTING MATERIAL WOULD BE TURNED OVER TO PGOI SHORTLY. YAZDI NOTED THAT USG COULD SAY PRIVATELY IT WISHED TO IMPROVE ITS TIES WITH ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN, BUT IF IT REALLY WANTED TO DO SO, IT MUST DO SOMETHING TO HELP.

COMMENT: WE HAVE BEEN WONDERING WHEN PGOI WOULD GET AROUND TO RAISING QUESTIONS SUCH AS THE ABOVE. YAZDI WAS VAGUE ENOUGH ON DETAILS OF EXTRADITION PROBLEM AND PAHLAVI FOUNDATION SITUATION THAT WE ARE UNABLE TO POSE SPECIFIC LEGAL QUESTIONS, BUT POLITICAL THRUST OF HIS APPROACH IS CLEAR: U.S. MUST AT LEAST TRY TO HELP. AS DEPT KNOWS, CORRUPTION WAS BIGGEST POLITICAL ISSUE IN REVOLUTION WHICH DREW SUPPORT FROM ALL REPEAT ALL CLASSES OF IRANIAN SOCIETY. I WOULD LIKE A STATEMENT FROM L ON STEPS PGOI COULD TAKE IN COURTS IF IT WISHED, TO RECOVER

COMMENT: IN VIEW OF DISARRAY OF THIS GOVERNMENT WE SHOULD BE PREPARED FOR NO ACTION OR, AS MINIMUM, A
(S - ENTIRE TEXT; REPORTING MESSAGE)

IN ALL MY RECENT CALLS, GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS HAVE HIT ME HARD WITH COMPLAINTS ABOUT THE CRITICAL MANNER IN WHICH THE WESTERN MEDIA, PARTICULARLY THE U.S., IS TREATING THE REVOLUTIONARY GOVERNMENT. THE FOLKS CURRENTLY IN THE SADDLE, NO LESS THAN THEIR PREDECESSOR, ARE PRETTY THIN SKINNED AND PRONE TO SEE A CONSPIRACY --USG, ZIONIST, OR OTHERWISE. ALSO, I HAVE BEEN REMINDED OF OUR DAILY STATEMENTS OF SUPPORT FOR BAKHTIAR IN JANUARY AND OUR OFFICIAL SILENCE (WHICH I HAVE STRONGLY SUPPORTED) ON THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT IN THE LAST MANY WEEKS.
THERE IS NO CURE, OF COURSE, FOR PERSIAN PARANOIA, BUT I BELIEVE WE SHOULD CONSIDER SOME EFFORT TO PRESENT A MORE POSITIVE U.S. VIEW OF THE GOVERNMENT.

OUR PAO TOLD ME THAT, WHEN HE WAS IN WASHINGTON IN LATE MARCH, VOA WAS TO APPROACH YOU RE AN INTERVIEW ON IRAN. THIS SEEMS TO ME TO BE AN EXCELLENT FORUM AND I HOPE YOU WILL BE ABLE TO TAKE ON THE TASK SOON. YOU ARE AN OLD HAND AT THIS AND CAN PLAY THE THEMES OF NORMALIZATION, HISTORICAL TIES, PARALLEL INTERESTS, THE DYNAMICS OF SOCIAL CHANGE, ETC. WITHOUT TOO CLOSE AN EMBRACE OF THE GOVERNMENT, EITHER TO ITS DISADVANTAGE OR OUR OWN.

MR. CHARLES W. NAAS, FSO-1, DEPUTY CHIEF OF MISSION, REQUIRED TO SUBMIT DISCLOSURE STATEMENT. DUE TO CIVIL DISORDER IN IRAN, MR. NAAS SENT ALL IMPORTANT PERSONAL PAPERS TO SAFEHAVEN IN WASHINGTON, D.C. SEVERAL MONTHS AGO.
MR. NAAS EXPECTS TO DEPART POST SOMETIME IN JUNE AND REQUESTS AN EXTENSION TO JULY 15, 1979, FOR SUBMITTING REQUIRED STATEMENT.
PLEASE ADVISE IF EXTENSION PERMISSIBLE AND IF NOT
BEST GUESS IS THAT IT IS SOMEONE CONNECTED TO OLD REGIME.

RESULT OF HEIGHTENED TENSIONS, ESPECIALLY IF FARGAN IDENTITY IS FINALLY ESTABLISHED OR ASSASSINS TURN OUT TO BE EX-SHAH MEN, IS LIKELY TO BE RENEWED SUSPICION OF U.S. SMALL INDICATOR OF THIS IS THAT MANY OF OUR RELIGIOUS CONTACTS HAVE BEEN VERY DIFFICULT TO FIND OVER PAST 36 HOURS (PART OF THIS IS NATURAL INVOLVEMENT WITH FUNERAL). LEFTISTS AND RADICAL MOSLEMS ARE LIKELY TO SEE THIS AS FURTHER EVIDENCE OF KHOMEINI THESIS ABOUT U.S. AND OTHERS ARE STILL MEDDLING IN IRAN. IF THIS VIEW GAINS WIDESPREAD CURRENCY (WHICH IT DOES NOT NOW HAVE), MISSION SECURITY SITUATION COULD AGAIN BE TIGHT. FOR MOMENT, HOWEVER, ATTENTION IS FOCUSED ON FINDING GROUP INVOLVED.

INCIDENT COMES AT A TIME WHEN PGOI IS CONCERNED ABOUT POSSIBLE PROBLEMS WITH GENERALS PALISBAND AND OVEISSI, BOTH OF WHOM ARE STILL AT LARGE. PALISBAND IS SUSPECTED OF BEING INVOLVED IN TURKOMAN MINI-REVOLT OF TWO WEEKS AGO. CROSS CURRENTS WITHIN ISLAMIC MOVEMENT ARE SUBSTANTIAL ENOUGH TO BOLSTER SUSPICIONS OF FOREIGN INTRIGUE WITH FACTIONS. ONE INTERESTING ACCOUNT INDICATES THAT THE REVOLUTIONARY GUARDIANS CORPS, FOUNDED BY YAZDI, IS NOW UNDER THE OPERATIONAL DIRECTION OF AYATOLLAH RAFSANJANI, AND IS BEING BROUGHT INTO THE ISLAMIC REPUBLICAN PARTY (KHOMEINI'S PARTY) AS THE PROTECTIVE ARM OF THE PARTY. SHARIAT-MADARI'S ISLAMIC PEOPLE'S REPUBLICAN PARTY HAS AS YET NO SIMILAR ARRANGE. MENT WITH ANY GROUP TO OUR KNOWLEDGE.
IF PARTIES PROCEED TO ORGANIZE IN COMPETITION THIS WILL UNDOUBTEDLY BRING MORE FORCE INTO PLAY IN ARMS-RICH IRAN. NAAS

(C) SUMMARY: THE CENTRAL BANK OF IRAN'S (CBI) POSTREVOLUTION REORGANIZATION IS ALMOST COMPLETE AND ACTING E/C COUNSELOR HAS CALLED ON ALMOST ALL THE NEW OFFICIALS IN POSITIONS PERTINENT TO US INTERESTS. RECEPTION HAS BEEN GOOD TO EXCELLENT AND BODES WELL FOR CONTINUED ACCESS FOR INFORMATION, PROBLEM SOLVING AND POLICY INFLUENCE AND CLARIFICATION. IN ALL CASES, THE NEW SENIOR OFFICIALS ARE FROM THE CBI'S STABLES AND IN MANY CASES HAVE THE CAPABILITY OVER TIME TO EQUAL IF NOT BEST THEIR PREDECESSORS. DESPITE THIS PROGRESS, THE CBI HAS FAR TO TRAVEL BEFORE AUTHORITY IS REESTABLISHED AND PRODUCTION RETURNS TO NORMAL SO THAT BACKLOGS ARE WORKED DOWN.
THE ROLE OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE CONTINUES TO RELATE ALMOST EXCLUSIVELY TO PERSONNEL MATTERS. BIOGRAPHIC NOTES ON KEY "IN" AND "OUT" OFFICIALS ARE REPORTED. END SUMMARY.

(C) DURING THE LAST THREE WEEKS, THE CBI HAS BEGUN TO TAKE ITS POST-REVOLUTION SHAPE. OUR INFORMATION IS NOT COMPLETE, AS INDEED IS THE CASE WITH THE REORGANIZATION, AND NAME DESIGNATIONS MAY SUFFER FROM TRANSLATIONS. THOSE DIRECTORS GENERAL WHOSE RESIGNATIONS WERE PENDING (REF C) WERE REMOVED FROM THEIR POSITIONS AND HAVE BECOME EXECUTIVE ASSISTANTS OR "ADVISORS." SEVERAL OF THE "ACTING" DG'S HAVE BEEN CONFIRMED AS HAVE SOME HERETOFORE UNCERTAIN CARRYOVERS. THE FOREIGN EXCHANGE TRANSACTIONS DEPARTMENT, FORMERLY UNDER DG FEREIDOUN NADERI, IS NOW UNDER A TRANSACTIONS AND ISSUE DIRECTORATE GENERAL.

THE TWO DEPARTMENTS FORMERLY UNDER DG FEREIDOUN FARHANG, FOREIGN EXCHANGE CONTROL AND ASIAN CLEARING UNION, ARE UNDER NADERI'S FORMER AREA, NOW CALLED FOREIGN EXCHANGE AND INTERNATIONAL RELATIONS. THE INTERNATIONAL RELATIONS AND STUDIES DEPARTMENT, FORMERLY UNDER THE LONG VACANT DG FOR RESEARCH, IS NOW UNDER FOREIGN EXCHANGE AND INTERNATIONAL RELATIONS. THE NOTE ISSUE FUNCTION, FORMERLY UNDER A DG (AZINFAR, NOW RETIRED), IS A DEPARTMENT UNDER TRANSACTIONS AND ISSUE. THE CREDIT DIRECTORATE, FORMERLY UNDER THE DEPUTY GOVERNOR, A POSITION WHICH WILL NOT BE FILLED, IS NOW UNDER VICE GOVERNOR GORGESTANI. NOT ALL THE DUST HAS SETTLED AND THERE COULD BE ADDITIONAL JURISDICTIONAL SHIFTS.
THE ORGANIZATION, AS PRESENTLY SEEN, AND INCUMBENTS OF INTEREST ARE AS FOLLOWS

SUMMARY: AYATOLLAH MAHMUD TALEGHANI HAS BECOME ONE OF IRAN'S CHIEF RELIGIOUS AND REVOLUTIONARY NOTABLES. WITH A POSITIVE APPROACH TO ALL THE TROUBLES CAUSED IN THE REVOLUTION'S AFTERMATH, HIS REPUTATION AND INFLUENCE SEEM TO BE INCREASING STRONGLY. END SUMMARY.

TALEGHANI -- THE POPULAR CONCEPTION: AYATOLLAH MAHMUD TALEGHANI HAS EMERGED AS ONE OF THE THREE RANKING RELIGIOUS LEADERS OF THE REVOLUTION. ON A PAR WITH AYYTOLLAH SHARIATMADARI' HIS NAME HAS LONG SINCE SPREAD BEYOND TEHRAN AND BECOME A HOUSEHOLD WORD. UNLIKE SHARIATMADARI, HOWEVER, TALEGHANI 'S DIRECT INFLUENCE SEEMS TO BE MORE THAN REGIONAL AND HE IS INVOLVED IN A NETWORK OF ACTITIVIES IN VARIOUS PARTS OF THE COUNTRY. THROUGH HIS WELL PUBLICIZED WELFARE ACTIVITIES, I.E., PROVISION OF AMBULANCES AND MEDICAL AID TO THE TURKOMAN AND KURDISH AREAS, TALEGHANI HAS GAINED THE REPUTATION OF A PUBLIC BENEFACTOR.

THROUGH HIS FAMOUS TRIP TO THE WAR-TROUBLED SANANDAJ, HE HAS ALSO COME TO BE KNOWN AS A TRUSTWORTHY ARBITRATOR, RESPECTED BY ALL RIVAL GROUPS. THE TWO ACTIVITIES ARE COMPLEMENTARY. WITH LARGE AMBULANCES BEARING TALEGHANI RELIEF COMMITTEE END SIGNS AND A CORPS OF DEDICATED RELIEF WORKERS, THE TALEGHANI NAME IS BEING WELL PUBLICIZED IN OUTLYING TROUBLED AREAS. TALEGHANI IS ANOTHER, PERHAPS LESS WELL DESERVED EPITHET, THAT OF COMMUNIST END . SEVERAL YEARS AGO, ONE OF HIS SONS WROTE THE NOW EFAMOUS LETTERS FROM A SON TO HIS FATHER, AN APOLOGIA FOR THE SON'S PROFESSION OF COMMUNISM. THE SON LEFT IRAN, AND DURING HIS TRAVELS SPENT SOME YEARS WITH THE PLO.
PERHAPS BECAUSE OF HIS BELIEF IN FREEDOM OF THOUGHT AND REFUSAL TO DISCIPLINE HIS SON PUBLICLY, THE AYATOLLAH HAS ALSO BECOME IDENTIFIED IN SOME MINDS WITH HIS SON'S ACTIVITIES.

THE AYATOLLAH'S REVOLUTIONARY CREDENTIALS ARE ALSO EXCELLENT AND IN A SENSE FAR BETTER THAN THOSE OF EITHER KHOMEINI OR SHARIATMADARI. IMPRISONED FOR MANY YEARS, THE POPULAR BELIEF IS THAT TALEGHANI WAS ALSO SEVERELY TORTURED AND PHYSICALLY HUMILIATED. THE STORY OF HIS DAUGHTER'S HAVING BEEN RAPED IN FRONT OF HIM BY SAVAK JAILERS IS OFTEN REPEATED.

TALEGHANI VS KHOMEINI: FRIEND OR ENEMY? RUMORS OF TALEGHANI'S ANTI-KHOMEINI STANCE BEGAN ALMOST IMMEDIATELY AFTER THE LATTER'S RETURN FROM PARIS. STORIES BEGAN TO CIRCULATE THEN THAT TALEGHANI HAD NOT GONE TO THE AIRPORT TO GREET KHOMEINI, AND THE TALES GAINED STRENGTH AS THE TWO REFRAINED FROM MEETING EACH OTHER UNTIL THE EVE OF KHOMEINI'S DEPARTURE FOR GOM. AFTER A SHORT MEETING, KHOMEINI FINALLY GAVE HIS OFFICIAL BLESSING TO TALEGHANI AS HIS MAN IN TEHRAN END .

THE 12 APRIL ARREST OF TALEGHANI'S SONS MOJTABA AND ABULHASSAN, ALONG WITH MOJTABA'S WIFE AZAM, BROUGHT THE LONG SIMMERING STORIES OF A KHOMEINITALEGHANI RIFT TO THE BOILING POINT. (REF B) THE THREE WERE ARRESTED BY COMMITTEE MILITIA AS THEY WERE DRIVING AWAY FROM TEHRAN'S PLO HEADQUARTERS. HELD OVERNIGHT AND FINALLY RELEASED THE NEXT DAY, THE ARREST PRECIPATED THE TEMPORARY CLOSURE OF TALEGHANI'S COMMITTEE HEADQUARTERS AND HIS OWN DEPARTURE FROM TEHRAN FOR SEVERAL DAYS. DURING TALEGHANI'S ABSENCE, LARGE DEMONSTRATIONS WERE HELD IN TEHRAN AND THE PROVINCES TO PROTEST THE ARRESTS. THE MOJAHEDIN KHALQ AND FEDAYAN-E-KHALQ ORGANIZATIONS ISSUED IMMEDIATE STATEMENTS CF PROTEST OVER THE ARRESTS AND EXPRESSED SUPPORT FOR TALEGHANI.

THE LATTER REPLIED THAT EVERY TIME I'VE CALLED YOU AND EVERY TIME ANY OF US HAVE COME HERE IT'S DISCUSSED PERSONALLY WITH THE AYATOLLAH FIRST. END .
