ON 3 MAY MEHDI TALEGHANI ARRANGED A GET-ACQUAINTED END LUNCH FOR POLOFF METRINKO WITH ABOUT THIRTY MEMBERS OF THE RELIEF COMMITTEE.

THE LUNCH WAS HELD IN THE AYATOLLAH'S NIECE'S HOME, AND SEVERAL OTHER FAMILY MEMBERS WERE PRESENT. THE RELAXED ATMOSPHERE, EXTREME FRIENDLINESS OF THE WHOLE GROUP, WESTERN MUSIC PLAYED DURING LUNCH (E.G., GREASE) AND A GENERAL NON-RELIGIOUS ATMOSPHERE WERE NOTEWORTHY. IN A WHISPERED ASIDE THE CO-HOST EVEN APOLOGIZED FOR NOT SERVING LIQUOR, BUT PROMISED TO HAVE IT AT ------------------081777 071508Z /46 R FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1301 SECTION 03 OF 03 TEHRAN 04726 A FUTURE, MORE PRIVATE DINNER.

THE TALEGHANI SECURITY FORCES -- BOTH THE MUJAHEDIN KHALQ AND THE FEDAYAN-E-KHALQ EXPRESSED ORGANIZATIONAL SUPPORT FOR TALEGHANI AT THE TIME OF HIS SONS' ARRESTS. THERE ARE ALSO STRONG INDICATIONS THAT THE AYATOLLAH CONTROLS A PRIVATE SECURITY FORCE COMPOSED OF COMBINED CIVILIAN AND ARMED FORCES UNITS. THE AIR FORCE AT THE COMMISSARY/APO COMPOUND TAKE ORDERS DIRECTLY FROM THE AYATOLLAH RATHER THAN THROUGH A MORE NORMAL MILITARY HIERARCHY. DURING A DISCUSSION BETWEEN MEHDI TALEGHANI AND ONE AF GUARD LEADER RE THE IMPENDING TRANSFER OF SECURITY DUTIES AT THE COMPOUND TO ARMY PERSONNEL, THE FORMER REMINDED HIM TO BE SURE THAT IT'S OUR PEOPLE FROM THE ARMY WHO TAKE OVER HERE END .

RELATICNS BETWEEN THE AYATOLLAH AND THE SUPREME STAFF ARE ALSO PRESUMABLY GOOD, SINCE THE SECURITY UNIT OF THE TALEGHANI COMMITTEE IS TAKING OVER THE EMPTY APO BUILDING AS THEIR NEW HEADQUARTERS. THE STRUCTURE IS, OF COURSE, THE PROPERTY OF THE IRANIAN ARMED FORCES.

CONCLUSION: YOUNGER THAN SHARIATMADARI AND IN APPARENT GOOD HEALTH, TALEGHANI HAS LAID ALL THE NECESSARY GROUNDWORK TO ACHIEVE PEAK POLITICAL AND RELIGIOUS STATUS. HIS LIBERAL, NON-AUTHORITARIAN APPROACH APPEALS TO A WESTERNIZED MIDDLE CLASS, AND HIS CREDENTIALS AS A REVOLUTIONARY ARE ALSO EXCELLENT. A CYNIC MIGHT EVEN CLAIM THAT HE IS MAKING EXCELLENT USE OF HIS OWN CHILDREN, KEEPING EVERY POSSIBLE IRON IN THE POLITICAL FIRE. IN THE LONG RUN, AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI HAS A FAIR CHANCE OF BECOMING KHOMEINI'S SUCCESSOR AS ORACLE OF THE CONTINUING REVOLUTION IN IRAN. NAAS
(S-ENTIRE TEXT)
SUMMARY: BAKHTIAR APPEARS TO BE IN SOUTHERN IRAN WITH BAKHTIARI TRIBE. ATTEMPTS BEING MADE TO GET HIM TOGETHER WITH JOURNALISTS. END SUMMARY.

AMCIT FREELANCE MEDIA TYPE FRIEND OF ACTING POLCOUNS HAS INFORMED HIM IN STRICTEST CONFIDENCE AND WITH TREPIDATION THAT SOURCE HAS BEEN APPROACHED BY OLD PERSIAN FRIENDS WHO WANT TO SET UP T.V. INTERVIEW WITH SHAPOUR BAKHTIAR. SOURCE'S OWN CLOSE PERSIAN FRIENDS INTRODUCED SOURCE TO EITHER FRIEND OR BUSINESS ASSOCIATE OF FORMER BAKHTIAR AG MINISTER KAZEMI WHO IS IN HIDING AND APPARENTLY ORGANIZING SUPPORT FOR SOME KIND OF SECULAR OR TRIBAL OPPOSITION TO ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT.

SOURCE FIRST WANTED TO HIRE CAMERAMAN AND DO INTERVIEW ALONE, BUT OBVIOUS DANGER OF ENTERPRISE, PLUS SOME SKITTISHNESS IN ARRANGEMENTS HAS LED TO ATTEMPT TO SET IT UP FOR A U.S. NETWORK. POLOFF COUNSELED SOURCE THAT THIS WAS DANGEROUS BUSINESS, AND QUESTIONED SOURCE CLOSELY ON SOURCES OF INFORMATION THAT BAKHTIAR WAS IN SOUTHERN IRAN. SOURCE WOULD NOT RPT NOT REVEAL OWN CONTACTS, AND CLAIMED DID NOT KNOW EXACT LOCATION IN SOUTH OF FORMER PM. SOURCE WAS REASONABLY CERTAIN OFFER OF INTERVIEW WAS GENUINE, AND SOURCE'S PERSIAN FRIENDS BELIEVE IT IS GENUINE.

SOURCE HAD NOT BEEN CONCERNED FOR PERSONAL SAFETY IN ENTERPRISE UNTIL SOURCE'S PHONE WAS TAPPED (PHONE WORK CREW WAS LET INTO HOME BY MAID) AND SOURCE WAS FOLLOWED ON AT LEAST TWO OCCASIONS. SOURCE THINKS IT MIGHT HAVE SECURITY OVERTONES.

COMMENT: STORY CHECKS WITH OTHERS WE HAVE HEARD, INCLUDING BRITISH BELIEF THAT BAKHTIAR IS INDEED IN SOUTHERN IRAN. FRENCH EMBOFF HERE IS REASONABLY CERTAIN BAKHTIAR NEVER ENTERED FRANCE, BUT CONCEDES FRENCH EMBASSY HERE MIGHT BE INADEQUATELY INFORMED. UNQUOTE (OUR SOURCE'S STORY NOT RPT NOT DISCUSSED WITH EMBOFFS OF OTHER NATIONALITIES.) SOURCE HAS PROMISED TO KEEP US ADVISED OF ANY FURTHER DEVELOPMENTS BUT IS NERVOUS AND MAY WELL RENEG. IF U.S. MEDIA GROUP ACTUALLY GETS INTERVIEW, CONFIRMS BAKHTIAR IS IN SOUTHERN IRAN, AND PASSED HIS MESSAGE UNQUOTE TO WORLD, BULK OF IRANIANS WILL BE CONVINCED THAT U.S. IS MEDDLING IN IRAN. AT LEAST WE WILL HAVE HAD A LITTLE WARNING. NAAS

SUMMARY: THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY GUARDIAN CORPS, AN ARMY UNDER THE NON-GOVERNMENTAL ISLAMIC COUNCIL, WAS ANNOUNCED MAY 5. SAID TO HAVE BOTH NATIONAL AND INTERNATIONAL DUTIES, ITS SIZE, MAKEUP AND PURPOSE ARE UNCLEAR. IT MAY ONLY BE AN UMBRELLA NAME FOR EXISTING COMMITTEE GOON SQUADS, AN ATTEMPT TO CONSOLIDATE THESE INTO A SINGLE FORCE RESPONSIBE TO AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, OR A SEPARATE, FOREIGN TRAINED ELITE CORPS, WITH THE LEFT AS A POSSIBLE TARGET. END SUMMARY.

ON SATURDAY, MAY 5, TEHRAN RADIO ANNOUNCED THE FORMATION OF THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY GUARDIANS CORPS, UNDER THE SUPERVISION OF THE ISLAMIC COUNCIL AND AT THE DISPOSAL OF THE ISLAMIC COURT. UNQUOTE. A MAY 6 ANNOUNCEMENT OF THE AIMS OF THE CORPS STATED THEM TO BE BOTH INTERNAL AND EXTERNAL,- CONTROL, ARREST, AND PROSECUTION OF, ... AND ARMED STRUGGLE AGAINST ANTI-ISLAMIC REVOLUTION ACTIVITIES INSIDE THE COUNTRY, (AND) SUPPORTING THE LIBERATION MOVEMENTS... OF THE OPPRESSED PEOPLE OF THE WORLD. UNQUOTE. IT SPECIFIED ITS INDEPENDENCE FROM THE GOVERNMENT, STATING IT WOULD OPERATE MERELY, IN CONSULTATION WITH THE GOVERNMENT. UNQUOTE.

VICE-PREMIER AMIR ENTEZAM, ASKED ABOUT THE GOVERNMENT FEELINGS ON THIS PRIVATE ARMY, STATED THAT IT WAS NECESSARY BECAUSE THE ARMY, POLICE, AND GENDARMARIE WERE UNABLE TO FULFILL THEIR LAW AND ORDER FUNCTIONS. UNQUOTE. HOWEVER, HE ASSERTED THAT AFTER THE DISSOLUTION OF THE (ISLAMIC) COURT, (THIS ARMY)...WILL BE HANDED OVER TO THE CONTROL OF THE GOVERNMENT. UNQUOTE.

NO SIZE, COMMAND STRUCTURE, OR ORGANIZATION FOR THE GUARD CORPS HAVE BEEN ANNOUNCED, BUT THERE ARE THREE PRIMARY RUMORS. SOME OBSERVERS, INCLUDING THE ENGLISH-LANGUAGE NEWPAPER, TEHRAN TIMES, HAVE TAKEN TO REFERRING TO ALL THE ARMED FORCES OF THE RELIGIOUSDOMINATED COMMITTEES AS REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS UNQUOTE. THIS VIEW HAS IT THAT THE CORPS IS NOTHING MORE THAN A FICTION, AN UMBRELLA NAME FOR THE UNCOORDINATED LOCAL RELIGIOUS FORCES, CREATED TO GIVE THEM A CERTAIN LEGITIMACY, WHILE DENYING THAT LEGITIMACY TO OTHER ARMED GROUPS, SUCH AS THE MARXIST FEDAYEN, POLITICAL FORCES, OR THE FORCES OF LCCAL STRONG-MEN.

OTHERS, HOWEVER, PARTICULARLY THE LEFTISTS, LINK THIS CORPS WITH THE OFT-RUMORED 3,000-MAN PLUS FORCE SAID TO BE IN TRAINING AT ALIABAD, NEAR QOM, UNDER LEBANESE GUERILLAS FROM FORCES ORGANIZED BY THE MISSING IMAM MUSA SADR. THE LEBANESE COMMANDER IS SAID TO BE DR. MUSTAFA CHAMRAN. THIS VIEW HAS IT THAT THE CORPS IS AN ELITE FORCE CREATED TO CONDUCT A MASSIVE PURGE OF KHOMEINI OPPONENTS AND LEFTISTS. THERE ARE ALSO RUMORS THAT THIS FORCE IS SOMEHOW ASSOCIATED WITH THE OLD IMPERIAL GUARD, THE IMMORTALS. UNQUOTE. WESTERN PRESS SOURCES STATE THAT, IN RESPONSE TO THIS THREAT OF A PURGE, MANY LEFTIST GUERILLAS HAVE BEGUN TO GO BACK UNDERGROUND.

A THIRD VIEW, PRINCIPALLY FROM A SOURCE IN THE PROVINCIAL CITY OF ISFAHAN, HOLDS THAT THE CORPS IS AN OFFICER CADRE, TRAINED IN THE IMPERIAL GUARD BARRACKS, WHICH WILL ATTEMPT TO INTEGRATE AND TAKE COMMAND OF THE SCATTERED LOCAL COMMITTEE FORCES THROUGHOUT IRAN. THEIR PURPOSE IS TO DESTROY THE INDEPENDENCE OF POSSIBLE RIVALS TO AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, PARTICULARLY SUCH RELIGIOUS FIGURES AS AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI OF TEHRAN OR SHARIATMADARI OF QOM. THE HEAD OF TALEGHANI'S SECURITY FORCES, HIS SON MUJTABA, TOLD AN EMBOFF HOWEVER THAT HE INTENDS T( RETAIN INDEPENDENT COMMAND OF HIS FATHER'S FORCES, NO MATTER WHO CHALLENGES US. UNQUOTE.

COMMENT: IT REMAINS TO BE SEEN WHETHER THE REVOLUTIONARY GUARDIANS CORPS ACTUALLY EXISTS OR NOT. THE ANNOUNCEMENT OBVIOUSLY RELATES TO THE HEIGHTENED FEAR AND SECURITY MEASURES IN THE WAKE OF THE ASSASSINATION OF AYATOLLAH MOTAHARI AND GEN. QARANI. IF IT IS NOTHING MORE THAN AN UMBRELLA NAME, IT CAN BE AN EFFECTIVE PROPAGANDA TOOL IN THE WAR OF WORDS BETWEEN THE RELIGIOUS FORCES AND THE LEFT. IF IT IS AN ATTEMPT TO ASSUME CONTROL OF LOCAL FORCES, IT FACES A DIFFICULT JOB, WHICH COULD EXACERBATE INTRA-RELIGIOUS RIVALRIES.

1979TEHRAN04853.subject: VISIT BY ALI REZA NURIZADEH OF OMID-E IRAN - MAGAZINE

segments.text: MAGAZINE

ON WEDNESDAY, MAY 9, PRESS ATTACHE ROSEN WAS VISITED BY ALI REZA NURIZADEH, THE EDITOR OF THE THREE MONTH OLD OMID-E IRAN (THE HOPE OF IRAN), IRAN'S "TIME" MAGAZINE, AT THE ICA OFFICE IN THE CHANCERY. NURIZADEH, FORMER DEPUTY EDITOR OF FERDOWSI MAGAZINE AND REPORTER WITH ETTELA'AT, REQUESTED THE MEETING, CLEARLY CONCERNED TO EXPRESS HIS ANXIETY AND FEAR OF AN EVENTUAL LEFTIST COUP, GIVEN THEIR CLANDESTINE ABILITY TO ORGANIZE AND THE REPRESSIVE, ANTI-INTELLECTUAL ATMOSPHERE OF THE RUHANNIYAT, THE CLERGY. THE THIRTY FIVE YEAR OLD EDITOR AND U.S.

PHD SAID THAT HE WAS SPEAKING FOR HIS "DOWREH", CIRCLE OF WRITERS, WHO BELIEVE IN A LIBERAL, DEMOCRATIC IRAN, CITING HIS CREDENTIALS AS AN ACTIVE MEMBER IN THE ETAHAD BARAYE AZADI, THE UNION FOR FREEDOM, THE ORGANIZATION FOUNDED BY AHMAD BANI AHMAD, AN OUTSPOKEN ANTIREGIME DELEGATE IN THE FORMER MAJLIS. HE STATED THAT HIS SOURCES PUT THE NUMBER OF WEAPONS IN THE HANDS OF THE CHERIKHAY-E FEDAYEEN-E KHALQ AT FORTY THOUSAND WITH TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE AND TRAINING BY GEORGE HABASH'S PFLP.

NURIZADEH SAID THAT HIS EXPRESSED LONG TERM POLICY AT THE MAGAZINE WAS TO PROVIDE A VENUE FOR THE LIBERAL IRANIAN, THUS THIS WEEK'S EDITORIAL DECRYING THE PERSONALITY CULT IN IRANIAN POLITICS AND CONCOMITANT SUPPORT FOR THE IDEA OF COLLECTIVE LEADERSHIP, AN OBVIOUS JIBE AT KHOMEINI. IN THE NEXT ISSUE NURIZADEH PLANS TO JUXTAPOSE THE THOUGHTS THE OUSTED STALINIST CENTRAL COMMITEE HEAD OF TUDEH, DR. KESHAVARZ, AND THAT OF THE PARTY'S PRESENT CHIEF, KIANURI, WITH AN ATTEMPT AT A SUBTLE PICTURE OF TUDEH DUPLICITY. DR.

NURIZADEH EXPLICITLY REQUESTED SUPPORT FROM THE PRESS AND CULTURE OFFICE TO PROVIDE THE VASETEH OR MODERATE CIRCLES WITH ACCESS TO, IN SPITE OF AND BECAUSE OF THE REVOLUTIONARY SITUATION, PROMINENT U.S. LECTURERS, POETS, ESPECIALLY BECAUSE THEY CAN SPEAK IN A GENRE FAMILIAR TO THE IRANIAN MIND SET, LITERATURE HIGHLIGHTING THE DEMOCRATIC PROCESS IN THE WEST, ESSAYS ON DISSENT AND DISSIDENTS SUCH AS SOLZHENITSYN AND OPPORTUNITIES FOR IRANIAN JOURNALISTS TO STUDY IN THE U.S., ALL AS A COUNTER TO THE HIGHLY POLITICIZED ANTI-DEMOCRATIC FORCES ON THE RIGHT AND LEFT.

PRESS ATTACHE TOLD NURIZADEH THAT WITH WIRELESS FILE INSTALLED IN NEAR FUTURE HE WILL BE ABLE TO PROVIDE SOME OF THE NECESSARY PLACEMENT MATERIAL REQUESTED. BOTH AGREED TO MEET AGAIN NEXT WEEK AND WORK OUT A MORE DETAILED RESPONSE TO THE EDITOR'S NEEDS. SHELLENBERGER
(C-ENTIRE TEXT)
SUMMARY: BELOW ARE COMMENTS ON POLITICAL DYNAMICS WHICH DO NOT THEMSELVES JUSTIFY SEPARATE TREATMENT. END SUMMARY.

OVER PAST MONTH, EMBOFFS HAVE GATHERED NUMBER OF SMALL ITEMS WHICH DO NOT LEND THEMSELVES TO SEPARATE TREATMENT, BUT WHICH REPOND TO GENERAL REPORTING REQUESTS CONTAINED REFTEL. THESE ARE OFFERED AS ATMOSPHERICS ON LOCAL SITUATION, NOT FINELY HONED ANALYSIS THAT WE ARE HOPEFULLY RESERVING FOR OUR MORE FORMAL TWELVE VOLUME RESPONSE TO REFTEL. PREVIOUS REPORTING THAT REMAINS RELEVANT TO SUBJECTS AT HAND IS ALSO NOTED. REFTEL PARAGRAPHS ARE SHOWN IN PARENTHESIS AFTER RELATED PARAGRAPH IN TEXT.

POLITICAL RELATIONSHIPS (PARA ONE). OF THE AYATOLLAHS CLEARLY KHOMEINI, SHARIAT-MADARI AND TALEGHANI DOMINATE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT FRONTLINE. IMPORTANT IN THEIR OWN RIGHT, BUT SECOND LEVEL LEADERS, ARE HASSAN TABATABAI, QOMI (MASHAD), HASHEM RAFSANJANI (DIRECTOR OF NEW REVOLUTIONARY GUARDIANS), MOHAMMAND MUSAVI GOLPAYGANI (QOM), AND MAHMOUD MONTAZERI. ISFAHAN'S MODERATE AYATOLLAH KHODOMI AND YOUNG FIRE-BREATHER TAHERI AS WELL AS ARAB LEADER AYATOLLAH KHAGANI HAVE REGIONAL IMPORTANCE WHICH COULD GROW. ENTEZAM'S POLITICAL STATURE WAS PARTIALLY COVERED IN TEHRAN'S 4679; HE CLEARLY DOMINATES SABAGHIAN, SINCE HE IS MUCH CLOSER TO BAZARGAN, WHO ACCEPTED SABAGHIAN ONLY TO PLACATE THE LIBERATION MOVEMENT OF IRAN (LMI) LEFT WING.

SABAGHIAN HAS A FULL-TIME JOB JUST KEEPING TABS ON THE REVOLUTIONARY TRANSFER OF ASSETS PROBLEM AND TO BEST OF OUR KNOWLEDGE HAS NOT BEEN ACTIVE ON POLITICAL SIDE EXCEPT PERIPHEFALLY. YAZDI WAS DISCUSSED IN TEHRAN 4377; JURY STILL OUT ON WHETHER HE HAS ULTIMATELY GAINED OR LOST, BUT IT DOES NOW SEEM THAT HE WILL LOOSE MUCH OF HIS INFLUENCE WITH REVOLUTIONARY GUARDIANS, WHO ARE FALLING INTO OTHER HANDS -- AYATOLLAH RAFSANJANI AND A SHIITE REVOLUTIONARY FROM LEBANON NAMED CHAMRAN. CHAMRAN'S ARRIVAL HAS SET OFF A WAVE OF CONCERN AMONG LEFT THAT KHOMEINI IS READYING NEW GUARDIANS FOR A PURGE OF THE LEFT.

YAZDI HAS THUS FAR MADE GENERALLY GOOD IMPRESSION ON SEVERAL MFA PROFESSIONALS WE HAVE TALKED TO, INCLUDING DIVISION CHIEF OF NORTH AMERICAN SECTION. FROM THEIR PERSPECTIVE, HE HAS BEHAVED WELL, SOUGHT ADVICE FROM HIS PROS AND OFTEN HEEDED IT.

BAZARGAN IS REGARDED WITH AFFECTION IF NOT WITH MUCH RESPECT (PARA TWO). RELIGIOUS TYPES APPRECIATE HIM BECAUSE HE IS KHOMEINI'S PRIME MINISTER, SECULARISTS BECAUSE THEY KNOW HE'S REALLY MORE OF A FRENCH-STYLE SOCIAL DEMOCRAT IN PERSONAL BELIEF. GENERAL PERCEPTION IS THAT THERE IS NO ONE ELSE AROUND WHO COULD DO THE JOB RIGHT NOW WITHOUT A MAJOR FIGHT FROM SOME SECTOR OR THE OTHER. MOST OF HIS SENIOR BUREAUCRATS WISH HE WOULDN'T TAKE THE PROVISIONALNATURE OF THE GOVERNMENT SO SERIOUSLY. BAZARGAN IS ALSO REPORTEDLY A CLOSE FRIEND OF TALEGHANI'S.
TEHRAN'S 4726 GIVES A THOROUGH VIEW OF PRESENT TALEGHANI ORGANIZATION (PARA THREE).
SEE TEHRAN 4302 AND 4314, ESPECIALLY LATTER, FOR OUR VIEW OF KEY AREAS TO WATCH (PARA FOUR).

WILL DO AN UPDATE ON PERCEPTIONS OF U.S. (PARA FIVE) IN A WEEK'S TIME. SITUATION REMAINS ESSENTIALLY SAME AS IN TEHRAN'S 4158 AND 4069. POINT TO REMEMBER HERE, IS THAT EACH FURTHER BREACH OF ISLAMIC MOVEMENT SECURITY INCREASES BELIEF THAT U.S. (AND PERHAPS SOVIETS TOO) IS MEDDLING.

ACTIVITIES AND PLANS OF VARIOUS GROUPS (PARA EIGHT) WERE COVERED TO DATE IN TEHRAN'S 4302 AND 4314. SUBSEQUENT ACTIVITIES OF GROUPS HAVE INVOLVED ORGANIZATION EFFORTS -SANJABI HAS HEADED FOR THE PROVINCES TO TRY AND GET THE NATIONAL FRONT BACK IN THE BALLGAME. MINLABOR FOROUHAR HAS SAID MAJOR FRONT MOVES WILL OCCUR SOON. NATIONAL DEMOCRATIC FRONT (MATIN-DAFTARY) HAS BEEN RELATIVELY QUIET PAST TWO WEEKS. OTHERS HAVE BEEN SUBJE(T OF SPOT REPORTS. WE HOPE TO TAKE MORE IN-DEPTH LOOK AT NDF AND NATIONAL FRONT IN COMING WEEKS.

WE WOULD AGREE NOW, BUT SUSPECT THAT MAY NOT BE TRUE IN TWO TO THREE WEEK'S TIME. WE WOULD ALSO RATE CHANCES OF AN UNTOWARD INCIDENT AND SELF-DESTRUCTION HIGHER THAN THE FRENCH DO. ECON HAS SENT IN TWO MEMCONS ON FRENCH ECON TIES AND PERCEPTICNS, AND TEHRAN 4117 ON OECD ECONOMIC RELATIONS. AT NUANCE LEVEL, BRITISH FEEL THAT POTENTIAL FOR TROUBLE IS GROWING AND TEND TO BE JUST A BIT MORE PESSIMISTIC ABOUT PROVINCES THAN WE DO, BASED ON COMMENTS FROM MANY OF THEIR LONGTIME RESIDENTS OUTSIDE TEHRAN.

SOVIETS ARE UNDOUBTEDLY TRYING TC MEDDLE; OUR DIPLOMATIC COLLEAGUES FEEL SOVIETS ARE SHOWING INCREASED ACTIVITY AND INTEREST IN EVENTS, BUT NO ONE CAN PUT FINGER ON ANY SPECIFIC INTERNAL PLOYS THEY ARE WORKING ON. SEVERAL OF OUR AFRICAN AND NORTH AFRICAN COLLEAGUES SUSCRIBE TO THE THESIS THAT SOVIETS HAVE BEEN PUSHING VISIT OF RADICAL LEADERS (JALLUD, ETC) TO TRY AND BREAK DOWN KHOMEINI RESISTANCE TO COMMUNIST IDEAS. SEEMS REASONABLE TO US, TOO.

FUTURE SEPTELS WILL COVER MEDIA AND UNIVERSITIES (PARA TWELVE). CHAOS IS STILL THE ORDER OF THE DAY, PER TEHRAN'S 2748. SOME ADMINISTRATIVE STABILIZATION HAS OCCURRED. FACULTY STRIKES HAVE HIT SEVERAL UNIVERSITIES, BUT MAJOR WALKOUTS HAVE THUS FAR BEEN AVERTED. NIRT REMAINS CHAOTIC AND SUB-PROFESSIONAL; ITS PRINCIPAL ACHIEVEMENT AFTER TWO MONTHS OF REVOLUTI(NARY FERVOR IS TO HAVE MADE DIRECTOR SADEQ GHOTBZADEH ONE OF IRAN'S MOST HATED FIGURES. RECENT USICA CABLES HAVE DEALT IN DETAIL WITH SOME ASPECTS OF PRESS AND MEDIA.

MOST TIMELY INFO WE HAVE ON CONSTITUTION AND ELECTIONS (PARA THIRTEEN) IS CONTAINED IN TEHRAN'S 4679. SITUATION IS STILL CONFUSED AND SOMEWHAT DISORGANIZED, AND TIME FRAME FOR ESTABLISHING ISLAMIC INSTITUTIONAL FRAMEWORK REMAINS TWO TO FOUR MONTHS.

1979TEHRAN04856.subject: FOREIGN POLICY OF THE PROVISIONAL ISLAMIC GOVERN- MENT

segments.text: TEHRAN 4302(NOTAL), (D) TEHRAN 4314(NOTAL), (E) TEHRAN 4679(NOTAL) (C-ENTIRE TEXT) THIS IS A REPORTING CABLE.

SUMMARY: JUST AS THE GOVERNANCE OF IRAN'S INTERNAL AFFAIRS IS DIVIDED BETWEEN THE FORMAL AND INFORMAL STRUCTURE, SO IS THE DIRECTION OF IRAN'S FOREIGN POLICY. THAT POLICY IS LIKELY TO OSCILLATE BETWEEN EXTREME ISLAMIC RHETORIC AND SUPPORT FOR RADICAL CAUSES AND MORE CONSERVATIVE, GEO-POLITICAL, NATIONAL INTERESTBASED BEHAVIOR. DISTINCTIVE HALLMARKS AS SEEN FROM THE INTERNATIONAL ARENA WILL BE A STRONG TILT TOWARD THE RADICAL AND AWAY FROM THE MODERATE ARABS, STEADY ATTACKS ON ISRAEL AND ZIONISM, CONTINUED SUSPICION OF THE GREAT POWERS ON A VERBAL FLANE, COUPLED WITH THE DESIRE TO DO DEALS ON GOVERNMENT-TO-GOVERNMENT BASIS, AND A MORE LDC-ORIENTATED LINE IN ECONOMIC AFFAIRS.

THESE DUAL PATTERNS WILL LAST AT LEAST UNTIL THE CONSTITUTIONAL FRAMEWORK IS ESTABLISHED OR THE PGOI IS REPLACED. OUR AEILITY TO MODERATE IRAN'S MORE RADICAL POLICY POSITIONS IS VERY LIMITED AT THIS TIME. END SUMMARY.

IRAN'S GOVERNMENTAL APPARATUS IS DIVIDED BETWEEN THE FORMAL PROVISIONAL ISLAMIC GOVERNNENT HEADED BY PRIME MINISTER MEHDI BAZARGAN, AND A STRUCTURE OF REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES LED BY AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI AND LEADING RELIGIOUS FIGURES (REFS C AND D). THE COMMITTEE STRUCTURE OPERATES LARGELY INDEPENDENTLY OF THE GOVERNMENT, AND KHOMEINI HIMSELF GIVES ORDERS TO BOTH. THERE ARE FREQUENT CONFLICTS BETWEEN THESE TWO PARALLEL STRUCTURES, AND THESE ARE REFLECTED IN IRAN'S FOREIGN POLICY. BAZARGAN AND MANY OF HIS OLDER GOVERNMENTAL COLLEAGUES TEND TO VIEW IRAN'S FOREIGN PCLICY AND SECURITY INTERESTS IN TRADITIONAL GEOPOLITICAL TERMS. THE HISTORY OF IRAN-RUSSIAN RELATIONS WEIGHS HEAVILY ON THEM.

THEY ARE GENERALLY CONSERVATIVE MEN WHOSE PRINCIPAL QUARRELS WITH THE SHAH ON SUCH MATTERS WERE THE HIGH EXPENDITURES ASSOCIATED WITH HIS POLICIES TO THE NEGLECT OF DOMESTIC NEEDS, AND IRAN'S INVOLVEMENT IN MATTERS FAR BEYOND ITS BORDERS IN SUPPORT OF WESTERN POLICIES. AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI AND SUPPORTERS SHARE TO A CONSIDERABLE DEGREE THE SUSPICION OF THE SOVIETS, BUT THEIR EXTERNAL VIEWS AT THIS TIME ARE PRIMARILY INFLUENCED BY HATRED FOR WHATEVER THE SHAH DID, MESSIANIC ISLAMIC FUNDAMENTALISM, AND THE REVOLUTIONARY PROCESS.
CONTINUED CONFLICT BETWEEN THESE TWO VIEWS WILL BE A FUNCTION OF THE REGIME'S INTERNAL STRUGGLES AND EVOLUTION.

AT THE SAME TIME, YAZDI IS A MAN OF THE MODERN WORLD AND CAN PROBABLY UNDERSTAND, AND RELATE TO, BAZARGAN'S CONCERNS BETTER THAN MOST OF KHOMEINI'S CLOSE ADVISORS.

IN THE MONTHS AHEAD WE AND OTHER GOVERNMENTS WILL BE DEALING IN THE FOREIGN POLICY AREA WITH A SCHIZ(PHRENIC AND UNSTABLE IRANIAN STRUCTURE. THE BASIC LINES OF POLICY, PARTICULARLY ON ISSUES WHICH ARE IN THE PUBLIC DOMAIN, WILL BE DOMINATED BY THE AYATOLLAH AND SUBJECT TO HIS INTERFERENCE AT WILL.

(FOR EXAMPLE, HE ISSUED THE ORDERS PUBLICLY TO BREAK WITH EGYPT, WITHOUT PRIOR CONSULTATION WITH THE GOVERNMENT; THE FOREIGN OFFICE HAD TO PLAY CATCH UP.) IRAN'S FOREIGN POLICY, THEREFORE, WILL BE MARKED BY: --STRONG APPEALS FOR ISLAMIC UNITY; --DEEP ANTIPATHY TO ISRAEL; --CLOSE TIES WITH THE PLO; --A STRONG TILT TOWARD THE RADICAL, CONFRONTATION ARAB STATES AND AWAY FROM IRAN'S TRADITIONAL SUPPORT OF THE MOCERATE ARABS; --VOCAL SUPPORT FOR REVOLUTIONARY RADICAL CAUSES THROUGHOUT THE THIRD WORLD, INCLUDING ZIMBABWE; --ESTABLISHMENT OF RELATIONS WITH COUNTRIES THE SHAH ABHORED, E.G., PDRY AND LIBYA; --CONTINUED DEEP SUSPICION OF, AND OCCASIONAL HARRANGUES AT THE U.S.

1979TEHRAN04860.subject: IRAN TO BE NON-ALIGNED AGAINST COMMUNISM?

segments.text: IN AN INTERVIEW PUBLISHED MAY 10, FOREIGN MINISTER DR. IBRAHIM YAZDI ANNOUNCED THAT IRAN HAD DECIDED TO JOIN THE NON-ALIGNED MOVEMENT AT THE FIRST AVAILABLE OPPORTUNITY.END . HE STATED THAT HE HAD DISCUSSED THIS WITH CUBAN REPRESENTATIVES IN TEHRAN, AND THAT IT WAS HIGHLY PROBABLE END THAT IRAN WOULD SEND A DELEGATION TO THE NON-ALIGNED CONFERENCE SCHEDULED FOR THIS AUGUST IN HAVANA.

ON MAY 8, ADMIRAL MADANI, CONCURRENTLY COMMANDER OF THE IRANIAN NAVY AND GOVERNOR-GENERAL OF KHUZISTAN PROVINCE, ON THE GULF, WAS ASKED IF IRAN WOULD HELP THOSE PERSIAN GULF SHIEKDOMS THAT ARE UNDER THREAT FROM COMMUNISTS. HE REPLIED, WE WILL TRY NOT TO INTERFERE IN OTHER COUNTRIES' AFFAIRS; HOWEVER IF A PEOPLE WHO ARE UNABLE TO DEFEND THEMSELVES ASK FOR OUR HELP, IT WOULD BE OUR DUTY TO EXTEND IT TO THEM. UNQUOTE.
COMMENT: IT SEEMS LIKELY THAT IRAN WILL CONTINUE TO PERCEIVE THREATS DIFFERENTLY ON ITS .BORDERS THAN IT

SUMMARY: TWENTY-ONE (21) PERSONS WERE EXECUTED MAY 8, AND EIGHT (8) MORE MAY 9. THE MAJORITY WERE SAVAK (16), OR MILITARY (7), BUT FIVE WERE CIVILIANS, ACCUSED ONLY OF CORRPUTION ON EARTH AND WARRING WITH THE EMISSARIES OF GOD. UNQUOTE. THESE HAVE ENGENDERED SOME NEGATIVE FEELING. EIGHT-SEVEN (87) OTHERS WERE REPORTED FREED BY THE COURT, BUT NAMES ARE NOT YET AVAILABLE. END SUMMARY.

IN CONTINUOUS SESSIONS STARTING MAY 7, THE ISLAMIC COURT IN TEHRAN TRIED AND EXECUTED 29 MORE PRISONERS. OF THESE 24 WERE ACCUSED OF SPECIFIC CRIMES RELATING TO SAVAK ACTIVITIES OR MILITARY ACTION AGAINST DEMONSTRATORS (SEVEN MILITARY OFFICERS, SIXTEEN SAVAK OFFICERS OR EMPLOYEES) OR AT LEAST TO MEMBERSHIP IN MILITARY OR SAVAK ORGANIZATIONS RESPONSIBLE FOR CRIMES. FIVE, HOWEVER, WERE CIVILIANS, WHO FACED ONLY GENERAL ACCUSATIONS OF CORRUPTION UNQUOTE, ETC. THERE HAS BEEN SOME SUBDUED COMMENT ON THESE FIVE, GENERALLY ALONG THE LINES THAT THEIR CASES WOULD SEEM TO FALL UNDER THE RANGE OF THE TALKED-ABOUT, BUT NOT YET DECLARED, AMNESTY FOR THOSE NOT CONVICTED OF SPECIFIC ACTS.

THE FIVE ARE: DR. JAVAD SAEED, LAST SPEAKER OF THE LOWER HOUSE OF THE MAJLIS, AND LAST SECRETARY-GENERAL OF THE RASTAKHIZ PARTY; DR. MOHAMMAD RAZA AMELI. TEHRANI, MINISTER OF INFORMATION IN THE SHARIF-EMAMI GOVERNMENT, AND SGAATION IN THE HOVEYDA GOVERNMENT, AND FORMER GOVERNOR-GENERAL OF AZARBAIJAN AND ISFAHAN PROVINCES; HABIB ELGHANIAN, A WEALTH JEWISH BUSINESSMAN (ACCUSED OF ZIONISM UNQUOTE) AND RAHIM ALI KHORRAM, A WEALTHY CONTRACTOR WHO REPUTEDLY DEALT EXTENSIVELY IN VICE.

IN ADDITION, THERE HAVE BEEN REPORTS OF MASSIVE ARRESTS, INCLUDING FORMER ISFAHAN GOVERNOR-GENERAL AND FORMER DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER OF EDUCATION DR. HAGH-DAN, OF FORMER OFFICIALS UNDER THE SHAH'S REGIME. CYNICS STATE THAT EVERYONE WHO HAD EVER MADE AN ENEMY WILL BE TRIED AND EXECUTED BEFORE THE RUMORED AMNESTY IS DECLARED. MANY BELIEVE RECENT ASSASSINATION OF AYATOLLAH MOTAHARI HAS CAUSED THE COURT TO DECIDE TO GET TOUGH AND MAKE EXAMPLES. UNQUOTE.
IT WAS ALSO ANNOUNCED THAT THE COURT HAD RELEASED 87 PRISONERS, BUT NO NAMES WERE GIVEN MAKING IT LIKELY THAT NO MAJOR FIGURES AMONG THAT NUMBER. NAAS

ABDUR RAHMAN QASEMLOU, SECRETARY-GENERAL OF THE KURDISH DEMOCRATIC PARTY (KDP) ACCUSED, AT A PRESS CONFERENCE MAY 9, PGOI PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN OF IGNORING KURDISH PROBLEMS. QASEMLOU REPORTED HE AND A DELEGATION OF "TOP KURDISH LEADERS" HAD BEEN WAITING FOR A WEEK FOR AN APPOINTMENT. HE CLAIMED SOME BETTER SUCCESS WITH AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, WHO HAD AGREED TO SEND A GROUP TO KURDISTAN TO INVESTIGATE COMPLAINTS. QASEMLOU RAISED NO NEW COMPLAINTS, BUT IS DEMANDING ACTION ON LOCAL AUTONOMY MEASURES WHICH HE STATES WERE AGREED TO, IN PRINCIPLE, DURING NEGOTIATIONS TO END FIGHTING IN SANANDAJ AND SAGADEH.
HE DID ADD, HOWEVER, THAT THE (UNOFFICIAL) DRAFT CONSTITUTION PUBLISHED IN KAYHAN DID NOT DO ENOUGH FOR THE COUNTRY'S MINORITIES.

THE KDP IS A PARTY WITH UNCERTAIN CLAIM TO SPEAK FOR THE KURDS. THERE ARE NO CURRENT ESTIMATES OF ITS MEMBERSHIP, BUT KURDISH CONTACTS SAY THAT IT IS SMALL. QASEMLOU TURNED ASIDE THE QUESTION OF HIS SUPPORT; STATING ONLY THAT "THERE WERE VERY FEW..(KURDS)...WHO DISAGREE WITH THE AIMS OF THE KDP. "

COMMENT: QASEMLOU APPARENTLY WISHES TO BECOME THE PRINCIPAL SPOKESMAN FOR KURDISH AUTONOMY, EXPECTING THIS POPULAR ISSUE TO INCREASE HIS PARTY'S POPULAR SUPPORT. THE PGOI, BY IGNORING HIM, PROBABLY IS INDICATING MORE A DESIRE TO CUT DOWN KDP PRESTIGE THAN TO IGNORE KURDISH COMPLAINTS. HOWEVER, THERE IS UNLIKELY TO BE ANY MOVEMENT ON LOCAL AUTONOMY UNTIL THE CONSTIN IS APPROVED, IF THEN. NAAS

1979TEHRAN04890.subject: HOW THE BIG ONES GET AWAY

segments.text: (S-ENTIRE TEXT) THIS IS A REPORTING CABLE.
SUMMARY: NUMBER OF HIGH RANKING FIGURES IN OLD REGIME HAVE ESCAPED JAIL; SOME HAVE FLED THE COUNTRY. THERE IS EVIDENCE OF KHOMEINI CENTRAL COMMITTEE COLLUSION IN THESE ESCAPES. END SUMMARY.

FROM TWO TO THREE VERY SENSITIVE AND RELIABLE SOURCES WE HAVE NOW HEARD ESSENTIALLY SAME STORY ON JAILBREAKS AND ESCAPES FROM COUNTRY. BASIC DETAILS ARE THESE: FOR PAST TEN DAYS--TWO WEEKS, SEVERAL KEY FIGURES FROM OLD REGIME HAVE ESCAPED JAIL, AND A FEW HAVE EVEN ESCAPED FROM IRAN. THESE ARE PLANNED ESCAPES. IN CASE WE KNOW MOST ABOUT, EX-VICE MINISTER OF WAR TOUFANIAN AND FORMER HEAD OF IMPERIAL INSPECTORATE HOSSEIN FARDUST ESCAPED FROM JAIL THROUGH RUSE OF PRISON FIRE. THEY WERE THEN TAKEN TO TURKISH BORDER BY MULE, FROM WHENCE THEY FLED IRAN.

STORY GOES THAT TOUFANIAN PAID 3.6 MILLION TOMANS (ABOUT $500,000 DOLLARS) TO DO THIS, AND TOOK ALL HIS PERSONAL PAPERS WITH HIM. OPERATION WAS SET UP BY EITHER CENTRAL KHOMEINI COMMITTEEMAN OR SOMEONE VERY CLOSE TO CENTRAL (OMMITTEE.

VIRTUALLY SAME ACCOUNT GIVEN ABOUT FORMER EDUCATION MINISTER HOUSING NAHAVANDI AND EX-PLAN DIRECTOR MAGIDI, WHOSE ESCAPE UNQUOTE FROM COMMITTEE HANDS WAS ALSO ARRANGED. NAHAVANDI IS SUPPOSED TO HAVE LEFT IRAN BY COMMERCIAL AIR (IN DISGUISE) WHILE MAGIDI REPORTEDLY REMAINS IN THE COUNTRY.

AT LEAST TWO OTHER SENIOR MILITARY OFFICERS ARE SAID TO HAVE GONE THE SAME ROUTE. BEST SOURCES SAY COMMITTEE OFFICIALS ARE ARRANGING THESE ESCAPES UNQUOTE FOR REASONS WHICH RANGE FROM DISGUST WITH EXECUTIONS TO MONEY. INTERESTINGLY ENOUGH, NAMES OF MAGIDI AND NAHAVANDI APPEAR ON LIST OF 18 OFFICIALS WHOM TEHRAN PROSECUTOR-GENERAL HAS ASKED PUBLIC TO HELP AUTHORITIES TO TRACE. OTHER NAMES ON LIST (SOME OF WHOM PRESUMABLY HAVE ALSO GONE THE ESCAPE ROUTE) ARE FCRMER KHORRASAN GOVERNOR DR.

VALIAN; FORMER MINISTERS MANUCHEHR TASLIMI, FREIDOUN MAHDAVI, DARIUSH HOMAYOUN; GENERALS MOHARRARI, KAMANGAR, PALIZBAN AND SAYADIAN; PLUS REZA SAID GHIANI,HOJABRYAZDANI (LEADING BAHAI) HASSAN RASSOULI, GHASEM SAREBANHA, HOUSSEIN FOULADI, AMIR SHEIKH BAHAI, MANOUCHEHR PARVIZ, DR. BAGHELI; AND FORMER HEALTH VICE MINISTERS NEGHABAT AND NILI ARAM. PALIZBAN AND KAMANGAR ARE FREQUENTLY MENTIONED AS GENERALS WHO MIGHT BE LEADING TFCOPS AGAINST ISLAMIC REPUBLIC IN REMOTER AREAS OF COUNTRY.

COMMENT: IF TRUE, AND WE BELIEVE AT LEAST SOME CASES ARE, SITUATION HAS SOME INTERESTING IMPLICATIONS FOR INTEGRITY OF KHOMEINI COMMITTEE STRUCTURE. IT SUGGESTS MORE DIFFERENCES AMONG THE COMMITTEE FAITHFUL THAN HAVE SURFACED TO DATE OR, ALTERNATIVELY, A RATHER SHARP DEGRADATION IN CRUCIAL AREA OF REGIME SURVIVAL FROM REVOLUTIONARY MORALITY TOWARD CORRUPT BEHAVIOR FOR WHICH OTHERS ARE NOT BEING SHOT. DEEPER ECONOMIC MOTIVE MAY BE PRESENT. THOUGH THERE MAY BE NO CONNECTION, ONE SOURCE SAID ASSETS OF LEADING BAHAI INDUSTRIALIST HOUSHANG SABET WERE SUDDENLY CONFISCATED RECENTLY BY A PEOPLE'S FOUNDATION, UNQUOTE WHICH TOOK THEM OVER IN THE NAME OF REVOLUTION.

1979TEHRAN04892.subject: CENTRAL BANK GOVERNOR MOHAMMAD ALI MOWLAVI AND - ABOL HASSAN BANI-SADR

segments.text: TEHRAN 3090 (C - ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY: A HIGHLY RELIABLE SOURCE, CLOSE TO CENTRAL BANK OF IRAN (CBI) GOVERNOR MOHAMMAD ALI MOWLAVI, REPORTS THAT MOWLAVI IS A POLICY PRISONER OF ABOLHASSAN BANI-SADR, HAS NO SUPPORT FROM KHOMEINI AND IS DEPENDENT POLITICALLY SOLELY ON AYATOLLAH SHARIAT MADERI. BANI-SADR, CONSIDERED A RADICAL ECONOMIST AND A FOOL BY MANY, IS NONETHELESS FEARED TO HAVE REASONABLE PROSPECTS FOR A HIGH ECONOMIC POSITION IN A FUTURE GOVERNMENT. END SUMMARY

MOWLAVI, SHORTLY AFTER HIS APPOINTMENT, REPORTEDLY VISITED KHOMEINI AND EXPRESSED HIS VIEWS ON BANKING, WHICH IN ESSENCE ARE MODERN. KHOMEINI WAS FURIOUS. IN EARLY MARCH, ABOLHASAN BANI-SADR, THE ONLY SELF-IDENTIFIED ECONOMIC SPOKESMAN FOR KHOMEINI IN THE PRE-COUP DAYS AND STILL GADFLY EXPONENT OF REVOLUTIONARY ECONOMIC DOGMA (REF A), AND AKBAR HASHEMI RAFSANJANI, A MULLAH, WERE APPOINTED TO THE "NOTE-RESERVE CONTROL BOARD" OF THE CBI, REPLACING TWO MAJLIS DEPUTIES. AT THE TIME, WE REPORTED LITTLE SIGNIFICANCE TO THIS, SINCE THE BOARD HAS LITTLE POLICY INFLUENCE AND EVEN LESS CHARACTER AS A PLATFORM FOR PUBLIC INFLUENCE.

OUR SOURCE SAYS THAT BANI-SADR AND THE MULLAH, OFFICED IN ADJACENT ROOMS TO THE GOVERNOR, NOW CONTROL HIM; HE DOES NOTHING OF CONSEQUENCE WITHOUT THEIR APPROVAL. MOWLAVI OWES HIS VERY CONTINUATION IN OFFICE TO HIS CLOSE RELATIONSHIP WITH AYATOLLAH SHARIAT MADERI.

BANI-SADR INITIALLY ESPOUSED LITTLE PROXIMATE TO TEXTBOOK ECONOMICS AND HIS VIEWS WERE CONSIDERED BY ECONOMISTS, EVEN THOSE COMMITTED TO THE REVOLUTION (REF A), AS A RECEIPE FOR ECONOMIC DISASTER--REPUDIATION OF ALL EXTERNAL DEBT, BANK NATIONALIZATION, NO-INTEREST BANKING, TERMINATION OF FOREIGN INFLUENCE IN BANKING, OTHER SERVICES AND EDUCATION AND LIMITATION OF OIL PRODUCTION TO 40 PERCENT OF PREVIOUS LEVELS. PERHAPS IT WAS PRESENCE AND INTER-ACTION WITH GROUPS IN TEHRAN THAT RESULTED IN SOME MODIFICATION IN HIS VIEWS IN A MARCH 13 SPEECH AT THE CBI, ENTITLED "THE BANKING SYSTEM IN AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC." WHILE ESPOUSING THE NEED FOR CHANGE, HE CAUTIONED AGAINST RADICAL, FAST CHANGE.

ON INTEREST RATES, HE SAID THAT ABOLISHING THEM WOULD MERELY MAKE THE BAZAARIS RICHER AND WOULD ONLY AGGRAVATE THE ECONOMY UNDER EXISTING CONDITIONS. NATIONALIZATION OF BANKS WOULD NOT ACCOMPLISH ANYTHING. HE STILL BLISTERED WESTERN INFLUENCE, ESPECIALLY IN BANKING AND ATTACKED SPECIFICALLY THE IMDBI (DEVELOPMENT BANK) AS THE POLICY MAKER AND EXECUTOR OF THE BANKRUPT INDUSTRIALIZATION POLICY (NOT A TOTALLY UNFAIR VIEW). HE CHARACTERIZED IRAN'S BANKING IN FIVE WAYS: (1) HIGH INTEREST RATES

SCARCITY OF FUNDS, ESPECIALLY TO THE POOR, (3) INADEQUATELY REGULATED BY CBI, WHICH CONSISTENTLY HAD A BANKRUPT MONETARY POLICY, (4) BY NON-REPAYMENT AND ROLLOVERS, AND (5) UNDER FOREIGN BANK INFLUENCE.

BANI-SADR CONTINUES TO GIVE SPEECHES (ALTHOUGH LESS THAN THE ONE OR MORE A DAY IN THE FIRST POST-COUP MONTH) AND WRITE IN THE PRESS. OUR CONTACTS ADMITTEDLY PROVIDE A BIAS, BUT ALL CONSIDER HIM A FOOL. ON THE OTHER HAND, MOST FORECAST A GROWING INFLUENCE BY HIM IN THE ECONOMIC ARENA WITH THE POST OF MINISTER OF ECONOMIC AFFAIRS IN A FUTURE GOVERNMENT MOST MENTIONED. UNTIL THIS INFORMATION CONCERNING A RATHER FULLTIME JOB AT THE CBI, WE HAD ATTRIBUTED HIS RELATIVELY LOWER PROFILE AS A DEMISE IN ECONOMIC INFLUENCE AND ACTIVITY, AN APPARENTLY MISTAKEN CONCLUSION.

BIOGRAPHIC: ABOLHASSAN BANI-SADR HAD BEEN OUTSIDE IRAN FOR AT LEAST THE 15 YEARS PRIOR TO KHOMEINI'S RETURN. TO BEST KNOWLEDGE HE WAS A STUDENT AND RESEARCHER IN ECONOMICS IN FRANCE. HE STATES THAT HE LEFT IRAN BECAUSE ITS CENSORSHIP MADE ACADEMIC WORK IMPOSSIBLE. HE REPORTEDLY WAS ONE OF KHOMEINI'S HOSTS IN FRANCE AND RETURNED TO IRAN WITH HIM. A SENIOR IRANIAN GOVERNMENT OFFICIAL EXPRESSED TO EMBOFF IN JANUARY HIS SURPRISE TO SEE BANI-SADR IN THE KHOMEINI CAMP. HE RECALLED HIM WELL AS A COLLEAGUE AT THE INSTITUTE OF SOCIAL STUDIES AND RESEARCH IN TEHRAN AND AS A DEDICATED NATIONAL FRONT ACTIVIST, NOT DEEPLY RELIGIOUS OR RADICALLY

AS PER TELCON REQUEST OF A/SY/CC THE FOLLOWING IS A REPORT ON SECURITY INCIDENTS DURING THE PAST 48 HOURS. (A) ON 5/9/79 MUJEHEDDIN GUARD FORCE UNDER THE COMMAND OF MASHALLAH WENT TO THE TEHRAN AMERICAN SCHOOL (NOW CLOSED) STATING THAT THEY WERE UNDER ORDERS FROM GOI TO INVESTIGATE AND INVENTORY THE PROPERTY STILL REMAINING AT THE SCHOOL. THE IRANIAN CARETAKER STATED THAT HE WAS PHYSICALLY AND MENTALLY ABUSED; HIS HOUSE SEARCHED; AND ACCUSTIONS MADE BY THE MUJEHEDDIN THAT HE WAS STEALING SUPPLIES, I.E., TYPEWRITERS, FURNITURE, ETC. FROM THE SCHOOL. HE WAS LATER RELEASED BY THIS GROUP.

AMERICAN EMBASSY DOES NOT KNOW AT THIS TIME WHAT OTHER ACTIVITIES (HARRASSMENTS) MAY BE TAKEN AGAINST THIS INDIVIDUAL. (B) ON MORNING OF 5/10/79 AN INCIDENT OCCURRED AT THE RESTAURANT OPERATED BY THE UNITED STATES EMPLOYEES ASSOCIATION AT THE AMERICAN EMBASSY COMPOUND, TWO OF THE MUJEHEDDIN GUARDS ASSIGNED BY THE GOI HERE ENTERED THE KITCHEN OF THE RESTAURANT DEMANDED TO BE FED, AND STATED THAT THEY HAD BEEN TOLD BY A COLONEL OF THE UNITED STATES ARMY (LELAND HOLLAND) THAT THEY WOULD NOT HAVE TO PAY FOR THEIR MEALS. RESTAURANT MANAGER INFORMED THE RSO OFFICE WHICH RESULTED IN THE TWO MUJEHEDDIN GUARDS BEING EXPELLED FROM THE RESTAURANT BY THEIR CHIEF, MASHALLAH.

MASHALLAH THEN PAID FOR THE FOOD EATEN BY HIS MEN AND CONFIRMED THAT COL. HOLLAND HAD NEVER AUTHORIZED FREE MEALS FOR THE MUJEHEDDIN GROUP. (C) AT 1535 THIS AFTERNOON ONE OF THE MUJEHEDDIN GUARDS WHO HAD BEEN EARLIER EXPELLED FROM THE RESTAURANT FIRED THREE SHOTS FROM HIS G-3 OUTSIDE OF THE OFFICES OF THE COMMISSARY/RESTAURANT INSIDE THE EMBASSY COMPOUND AREA. HE ALSO INFORMED COL. HOLLAND WHO WAS LEAVING THE COMMISSARY WITH GROCERIES THAT HE COULD NOT LEAVE THE COMMISSARY AREA UNLESS HE HAD A WRITTEN AUTHORIZATION ON HIS PERSON FROM MASHALLAH ALLOWING HIM TO DO SO.

OTHER MUJEHEDDIN GUARDS WERE NOTIFIED OF THE INCIDENT AND RESPONDED IMMEDIATELY TO HIS INCIDENT BY ARRIVING ON THE SCENE AND BEATING THE MUJEHEDDIN GUARD TO A STATE OF SEMICONSCIOUSNESS BEFORE DRAGGING HIM BACK TO FACE MASHALLAH FOR FURTHER DISCIPLINE. THE GUARD EMIR (PHONETIC) REAPPEARED TWO TO THREE HOURS LATER TO APOLOGIZE TO THE RSO AND ASSISTANT RSO, PLUS COL. HOLLAND, IN THE PRESENCE OF MASHALLAH. NO FURTHER EXPLANATION WAS GIVEN FOR HIS ACTIONS EXCEPT THAT HE WASN'T FEELING WELL AND WAS UPSET AT THE TIME OF THE SHOOTING INCIDENT BECAUSE OF HIS EXPLUSION EARLIER IN THE DAY FROM THE RESTAURANT.

SUMMARY: MOROCCAN MILITARY ATTACHE SHEDS LIGHT ON ALGERIAN/LIBYAN TIES WITH NEW PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT OF IRAN (PGOI) AND MISCELLANEOUS SUBJECTS. END SUMMARY.

AT REQUEST OF MOROCCAN MILITARY ATTACHE MAJOR AL ALAOUI M'HAMDI, WHO IS VIRTUALLY ONLY OFFICER OF ANY KIND IN MOROCCAN EMBASSY, ACTING POLCOUNS AND ACTING DEFATT DISCUSSED POLITICAL SITUATION IN IRAN. IN COURSE OF CONVERSATION, M'HAMDI OFFERED SOME INTERESTING INSIGHTS INTO FOREIGN RELATIONS OF NEW PGOI WHICH ARE NOTED BELOW.

MOROCCO'S MAIN PROBLEM WITH NEEW PGOI IS ITS EVOLVING ATTITUDE TOWARD POLISARIO. M'HAMDI'S EFFORTS HAVE BEEN CONCENTRATED IN EXPLORING THIS AREA. ALGERIANS HAVE BEEN PUSHING FOR OPENING OF POLISARIO OFFICE, WHICH HAS NOW TAKEN PLACE. ALGERIANS HAVE MANY GOOD FRIENDS IN UNQUOTE IN KHOMEINI ENTOURAGE, ESPECIALLY GROUP THAT WAS WITH KHOMEINI IN PARIS. ALGERIANS CONVINCED LIBYANS TO HELP THEM GET POLISARIO RECOGNIZED. KHOMEINI BASICALLY WANTS GOOD RELATIONS WITH LIBYA. HE CARES NOTHING FOR IMAN MUSA SADR, IS PROBABLY GLAD HE'S DEAD, BUT AS LEADER OF IRAN'S SHIAS, MUST INSIST ON SOME KIND OF EXPLANATION.
M'HAMDI COMMENTED DRYLY THAT IT PROBABLY WOULD NOT TAKE MUCH OF AN EXPLANATION OF MUSA SADR'S DISAPPEARANCE TO MOLLIFY KHOMEINI AND LEAD VERY SWIFTLY TO OPENING OF RELATIONS WITH LIBYA.

M'HANDI SAID IT APPEARED SOVIETS WERE PUSHING BOTH ALGERIAN AND LIBYAN INITIATIVES. FROM MOROCCAN POINT OF VIEW, SITUATION WAS NOT GOOD. AS SECURITY OF ISLAMIC MOVEMENT GETS WORSE, MOVEMENT WILL BECOME MORE RADICAL, AND THIS SUITS SOVIET PURPOSES. MOROCCANS KNOW THAT THERE HAVE BEEN SOME MEETINGS OF EXILE GROUPS IN LONDON WHO SUPPORT SHAH. HE WOULD NOT BE DRAWN OUT ON THIS, CLAIMING MOROCCAN INFORMATION WAS GOOD, BUT NOT VERY SPECIFIC.

M'HAMDI THOUGHT LEADING AYATOLLAHS AFTER KHOMEINI WERE SHARIATMADARI, GOLPAYGANI AND TALEGHANI. ALL THREE ARE JOCKEYING FOR POSITION AS ISLAMIC MOVEMENT UNFOLDS. UPSHOT OF THIS POLITICAL POTBOILING WITHIN ISLAMIC MOVEMENT IS LIKELY TO BE HEIGHTENED ANTIMARXIST PROPAGANDA, WHICH WILL PUSH MARXISTS INTO GREATER ACTIVITY THAN THEY WANT. (COMMENT: AN INTERESTING VIEW OF POTENTIAL DOMESTIC DEVELOPMENTS, TO WHICH THERE MAY BE SOME TRUTH.)

WITH RESPECT TO IRANIAN MILITARY, M'HAMDI THOUGHT ARMY HAD ABOUT 60 PER CENT OF ITS PERSONNEL BACK TO WORK, NAVY 80 PERCENT, AND AIR FORCE 95 PER CENT. ON QUESTIONS OF REVOLUTIONARY JUSTICE AND KILLING OF PROFESSIONAL OFFICERS, HE REPLIED WITH A GRIM SMILE THAT HE PERSONALLY FOUND IT MORALLY FASCINATING. UNQUOTE.

BIO NOTE: M'HAMDI IS IN HIS LATE 30'S--EARLY 40'S AND TAKES HIS JOB SERIOUSLY. HE HAD DONE HIS HOMEWORK WELL, AND HAS SOME GOOD CONTACTS. AN ARMORED OFFICER, HE WANTS TO RETURN TO TROOP COMMAND AT HOME FOR HIS NEXT ASSIGNMENT, BUT CONCEDES HE MUST DO SOMETHING ABOUT HIS CORPULENCE TO MAKE IT THROUGH A TANK HATCH AGAIN.
THIS IS A REPORTING MESSAGE.

(C) THE EXECUTION OF HABIB ELGHANIAN LAST WEEK CREATED A GREAT SENSE OF ANXIETY WITHIN IRANIAN JEWISH COMMUNITY AND RUMORS SPREAD LIKE WILDFIRE. A GENERAL FEELING WAS THAT, IF A PERSON OF ELGHANIAN'S STATURE WAS NOT SAFE, THEN ALL JEWS WERE IN JEOPARDY. THE ALLEGED CHARGES OF SUPPORTING ZIONISM AND SENDING MONEY TO ISRAEL, LOCAL JEWS FEEL, COULD BE LEVIED ON A LARGE NUMBER OF IRANIAN JEWS. THE FEARS OF THE COMMUNITY WERE THEN FURTHER HEIGHTENED BY THE ARREST AT ABOUT THE SAME TIME AS THE EXECUTION OF ADDITIONAL JEWISH BUSINESS FIGURES IN TEHRAN.

THE HIGHEST NUMBER OF ARRESTS THAT ANY OF OUR SOURCES HAS REPORTED SO FAR IS 26 AND THE LOWEST IS FIVE. ONE SOURCE HAS REPORTED AMONG THOSE ALLEGEDLY ARRESTED THE NAMES OF KHALIL NAHAI, THREE OR FOUR MEMBERS OF HAI FAMILY, A MR. (FNU) AGHAI (PROBABLY SAME NAMES PROVIDED STATE 119243) AND A MR. (FNU) BEROOKHIM.

AS YOU CAN APPRECIATE, OBTAINING SPECIFIC AND ACCURATE INFORMATION IS VERY SENSITIVE MATTER AS WE DO NOT WISH TO JEOPARDIZE FURTHER THE SAFETY OF OUR JEWISH CONTACTS BY HAVING EMBOFFS SUDDENLY APPEAR ON THE SCENE. ALSO WE CANNOT ASSUME OUR TELEPHONES ARE SECURE. HOWEVER, ONE SOURCE HAS PROMISED AN EMBOFF A LIST MAY 14 OF THE NAMES OF THOSE ARRESTED AND OTHER EMBASSY OFFICERS WILL BE TOUCHING BASE WITH ADDITIONAL SOURCES TONIGHT AND TOMORROW.
(C) MY APPOINTMENT FOR TODAY WITH MINISTER OF STATE SAHABI WAS CANCELED AT LAST MINUTE. I AM SCHEDULED TO SEE FONMIN YAZDI ON TUESDAY, MAY 15 AND WILL RAISE STATUS OF IRANIAN JEWS WITH HIM.

(C) THE IRANIAN PRESS HAS REACTED STRONGLY TO FOREIGN PRESS CRITICISM OF EXECUTION OF ELGHANIAN AS QUOTES BELOW INDICATE. KAYHAN MAY 10: COMMENTARY: ELGHANIAN'S CONNECTION WITH U.S. CONGRESS. SOURCES CLOSE TO HABIB ELGHANIAN, THE WELL-KNOWN CAPITALIST WHO WAS EXECUTED YESTERDAY, SAID THAT HE HAD A CLOSE AND SPECIAL AFFILIATION NOT ONLY WITH ISRAEL AND THEIR OFFICIALS BUT WITH SOME OF THE INFLUENTIAL AMERICANS ESPECIALLY CONGRESSMEN, TOO. HIS SIX BROTHERS ALSO HAD THE SAME AFFILIATION. THEY WERE MOSTLY ENGAGED IN TRADE AND REAL ESTATE BUSINESS, AND IN LAST FEW YEARS HAD TRANSFERRED ALMOST ALL THEIR CAPITAL TO U.S. AND ISRAEL. THEY HAVE INVESTED MOSTLY IN ISRAEL AND SOME IN U.S.

SEVERAL OF HIS BROTHERS HAVE BEEN LIVING IN U.S. FOR MANY YEARS AND ARE WELL KNOWN IN GOVERNMENT AND PRIVATE CIRCLES, ESPECIALLY AMONG INFLUENTIAL JEWS.... COMMENTARY: WHAT IS BEGIN UPSET ABOUT? MENACHIM BEGIN, THE PRIME MINISTER OF ISRAEL HAS PROTESTED ABOUT THE ELGHANIAN EXECUTION. ZIONIST AGENTS ALSO HAVE CONDEMNED IT. THEY HAVE PRAISED ELGHANIAN AS A SERVANT OF ISRAELI INTERESTS AND PERHAPS THEY ARE SURPRISED AT HOW HE COULD BE EXECUTED IN ANOTHER COUNTRY. IT IS VERY CLEAR, THIS VERY REASON, THAT IS, GLORIFYING ZIONISM WAS BEHIND THE REVOLUTIONARY COURT'S DECISION....

FOR SOME ZIONIST LEADERS, WHO ARE PROBABLY ON THE LIST OF CARTER'S "HUMAN RIGHTS PAYROLL," IT SEEMS STRANGE THAT A NATION DOESN'T WANT TO BE MILKED. BUT WE ARE NOT SURPRISED BECAUSE WE HAVE FELT THIS WITH OUR SKIN AND BLOOD FOR MANY YEARS. BEGIN'S PROTEST CONCERNING ELGHANIAN'S EXECUTION, IS REALLY A PROTEST TO THE MOVEMENT OF IRAN'S REVOLUTION, THE REVOLUTION OF A NATION WHICH DOESN'T WANT TO BE EXPLOITED. BEGIN IS A MASTER AT THIS SKILL. HIS PROTEXT IS NOT ONLY TO US. OUR PALESTINIAN BROTHERS IN OCCUPIED PALESTINE AND THE SUFFERING PEOPLE OF SOUTH LEBANON, ALMOST EVERY DAY ARE FACING BEGIN'S "HUMANISTIC*" REACTIONS AND THE USURPING ISRAELI FORCES.

WE ARE NOT SURPRISED AT BEGIN; WE ARE SURPRISED AT THE SPOKESMAN OF U.S. GOVERNMENT WHO ALSO HAS CONDEMNED ELGHANIAN'S EXECUTION. EXPRESSING THE U.S. GOVERNMENT'S "CONCERN" ABOUT THE EXECUTIONS IN IRAN, HE HAS REMARKED ------------------022762 131425Z /41 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 1389 INFO AMEMBASSY TEL AVIV PRIORITY SECTION 02 OF 03 TEHRAN 04935 FOR WHITE HOUSE AND D THAT THE U.S. GOVERNMENT DOES NOT INTEND TO GO INTO DETAILS CONCERNING THE RELATIONS OF THOSE EXECUTED WITH THAT OF THE FORMER REGIME.

THIS SHORT SENTENCE EXPLAINS THE ENTIRE PHILOSOPHY OF AMERICAN "HUMAN RIGHTS," JUST AS ZIONISM IGNORES THE DETAILS OF THE INTEREST OF A NATION OF 35 MILLION. IN THE CALCULATIONS OF THE PAID SUPPORTERS OF HUMAN RIGHTS, THEY IGNORE ONE SMALL POINT AND THAT IS "HUMAN." THE U.S. GOVERNMENT DOES NOT PAY ATTENTION TO DETAILS LIKE THE THOUSANDS MARTYRED BY THE PAHLAVIS. OBVIOUSLY THE HUMAN RIGHTS ADVOCATES DON'T SEE ANYTHING EXCEPT ARMS PURCHASE ORDERS, OIL DOLLARS AND GEOPOLITICS. FOR THEM IRAN MEANS AN OIL RICH AREA THAT IS LOCATED IN A STRATEGICALLY IMPORTANT POSITION, THAT INCIDENTALLY SOME PEOPLE LIVE IN, DUE TO THEIR HARD LUCK.

SOME OF THESE UNFORTUNATE PEOPLE HAVE ESCAPED AND SOME HAVE DIED OF A MYSTERIOUS DISEASE CALLED AN "ANTI-IMPERIALIST REVOLUTION." THE U.S. GOVERNMENT IS CONCERNED THAT THIS DISEASE MIGHT SPREAD. BUT WE ARE NOT CONCERNED AT ALL, WE ARE TRYING TO MAKE THIS DISEASE AS CONTAGIOUS AS POSSIBLE. ETTELA'AT MAY 10: COMMENTARY: ZIONISM SHEDS TEARS FOR ELGHANIAN. FOLLOWING THE EXECUTION OF THE JEWISH MULTIMILLIONAIRE HABIB ELGHANIAN, THE DOCUMENTS FOR WHOSE COLLABORATION WITH ISRAEL WERE OBTAINED, AS IT WAS EXPECTED, THE WORLD ZIONISTS AND OTHER ELEMENTS HAVE SHOWN VARIOUS REACTIONS.

AS USUAL THE ZIONISTS WHO CONTROL NUMEROUS ASPECTS OF MASS MEDIA THROUGHOUT THE WORLD, TRY TO INFLUENCE THE SUBSEQUENT DECISIONS.... ...MEANWHILE THE WORLD CONGRESS OF JEWS IN NEW YORK HAS EXPRESSED ITS SORROW OVER ELGHANIAN'S EXECUTION IN A COMMUNIQUE.

PHILIP CLUTZNIK SAYS IN THE COMMUNIQUE: "HABIB ELGHANIAN WAS SENTENCED TO DEATH IN A TRIAL WHICH WAS CONDUCTED TOO SPEEDILY." A STATE DEPARTMENT SPOKESMAN IN WASHINGTON SAID, "THE EXECUTION OF HABIB ELGHANIAN, THE FIRST IRANIAN JEW TO FACE THE FIRING SQUAD, IS REGARDED AS A NEW DISCONCERTING FACTOR BY THE AMERICAN GOVERNMENT." THE SPOKESMAN SAID, "WE HAVE INFORMED THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT ABOUT OUR STAND REGARDING BOTH THE EXECUTIONS AND THE TREATMENT OF MINORITIES, AND WE WILL CONTINUE TO DO SO." HE ADDED, HOWEVER, THAT THE UNITED STATES HAD NO INTENTION OF EXPRESSING ITS VIEWS ON THE CHARGES BROUGHT AGAINST THOSE WHO COOPERATED WITH THE SHAH'S REGIME, BUT THE UNITED STATES WISHED THAT IMPARTIAL AND OPEN TRIALS WERE CONDUCTED FOR THEM AND THEY WOULD BE GIVEN A REAL OPPORTUNITY TO DEFEND THEMSELVES.

THE SPOKESMAN ALSO SAID THAT PRESS REPORTS FROM TEHRAN INDICATE THAT ELGHANIAN WAS NOT TRIED AS A JEWISH LEADER BUT AS AN IRANIAN WHO WAS ACCUSED OF CERTAIN CHARGES. WE SHOULD MENTION THAT FOR MANY YEARS THE U.S. GOVERNMENT IS UNDER THE INFLUENCE OF THE FIVE MILLION STRONG JEWISH COMMUNITY IN AMERICA. THEY CONTROL MUCH OF THE MASS MEDIA, MANY OF THE ECONOMIC AND INDUSTRIAL CENTERS OF THE COUNTRY, AND ENJOY A POWERFUL BASE IN THE CONGRESS AND IN THE GOVERNMENT AGENCIES.... ETTELA'AT MAY 12: REPORT: AFTER ELGHANIAN'S EXECUTION ZIONISM IS MAKING - HARD EFFORTS.

SUBSEQUENT TO SHEDDING TEARS BY BEGIN THE OLD ZIONIST TERRORIST AND THE PRIME MINISTER OF ISRAEL OVER THE EXECUTION OF ELGHANIAN, THE IRANIAN MULTIMILLIONAIRE, AND THE LAMENTATION OF THE WORLD CONGRESS OF NEWS AND THE INTERNATIONAL JEWISH AGENCIES WHICH ARE ASSOCIATED WITH ZIONISM, THE ISRAELI PRESS JOINED THE LAMENTATION YESTERDAY AND THE DAY BEFORE. AMONG OTHERS THE NEWSPAPER DAVAR ASKS THE ISRAELI GOVERNMENT TO DEMAND THAT THE PEOPLE OF THE WORLD PREVENT THE EXECUTION OF THOSE WHO SPIED FOR AND ASSISTED ISRAEL IN IRAN.

MOSHE DAYAN, THE ISRAELI FOREIGN MINISTER WHO, AFTER A CONSPIRATORY VISIT TO SOUTHEAST ASIA, ARRIVED IN PARIS AND REQUESTED THE FRENCH GOVERNMENT YESTERDAY TO INTERVENE ------------------022775 131425Z /41 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC NIACT IMMEDIATE 1390 INFO AMEMBASSY TEL AVIV PRIORITY SECTION 03 OF 03 TEHRAN 04935 FOR WHITE HOUSE AND D ON BEHALF OF THE IRANIAN JEWISH COMMUNITY. HE MADE THIS REQUEST DURING HIS ONE-HOUR MEETING WITH THE FRENCH FOREIGN MINISTER.

MEANWHILE IN NEW YORK NATHAN PORTMAR, DIRECTOR OF THE JEWISH ORGANIZATION BENAI BERST, WROTE TO CARTER ASKING HIM TO TAKE NECESSARY STEPS TO SAVE THE LIVES OF THE IRANIAN JEWS AND TO REFER THE MATTER TO THE UN HUMAN RIGHTS COMMISSION. BUT THE IRANIAN DELEGATE TO THE UN REACTED IMMEDIATELY DENYING THE CLAIM OF AFORESAID ORGANIZATION THAT CASES OF VIOLATIONS OF HUMAN RIGHTS HAD BEEN OBSERVED IN IRAN. THE DELEGATE STRESSED THAT THERE HAD BEEN NO VIOLATION OF HUMAN RIGHTS IN IRAN. HOWEVER, SENATOR MOYNIHAN OF NEW YORK CONDEMNED THE EXECUTION. HE BELIEVED THAT ELGHANIAN WAS SENTENCED TO DEATH BECAUSE YEARS AGO HE HAD MET WITH ABBA EBAN.

THE AMERICAN JEWISH CONGRESS MET IN THE WALDORF ASTORIA. IN A SPEECH HOWARD SQUADRON, DIRECTOR OF THE CONGRESS ASKED THE U.S. AND ALL THE OTHER GOVERNMENTS TO DEFEND THE IRANIAN JEWS. HE SAID THE IRANIAN JEWS HAVE FRIENDS AND RELATIVES IN AMERICA AND ISRAEL WHO ARE DEEPLY CONCERNED OVER THEIR FATE. IN WEST BERLIN ALSO THE JEWISH COMMUNITY PRESIDENT MADE SIMILAR REQUESTS OF U.S. AND WEST GERMAN GOVERNMENTS. HE SAID THAT ELGHANIAN WAS EXECUTED FOR HIS FRIENDSHIP WITH ISRAEL AND NOW THE IRANIAN JEWS, FOLLOWING HIS EXECUTION, LIVE IN PROFOUND FEAR.

THESE LAMENTATIONS SPREAD WIDELY AND THE AMERICAN BAHAI, ASSEMBLING IN THEIR TEN-MILLION DOLLAR TEMPLE ON THE SHORE OF LAKE MICHIGAN, REVEALED THEIR DEEP CONCERN OVER THE SAFETY OF THEIR BAHAI BROTHERS IN IRAN. THE ASSEMBLY ANNOUNCED THAT IT WAS BITTERLY ANXIOUS ABOUT THE POSSIBLE DESTRUCTION OF THEIR SACRED PLACES AND THE MASSACRE OF THE BAHAIS IN IRAN. THIS IS NOT THE FIRST TIME THAT THE JEWS AND THE BAHAIS COOPERATE AGAINST AN IMAGINARY MATTER WHICH THEY USE AS A PRETEXT.

THE LAMENTATION OF THE JEWISH COMMUNITIES WILL NOT FRIGHTEN ANYBODY IN IRAN AND WILL NOT ALTER ANY DECISIONS SINCE THE ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT OF IRAN HAS TIME AND AGAIN EMPHASIZED THAT THE JEWS AND OTHER MINORITIES WILL BE SAFE. ELGHANIAN WHO WAS EXECUTED PLUNDERED IRANIAN PEOPLE FOR DECADES IN ORDER TO AID AND ABET THE AGGRESSIVE AIMS OF ISRAEL. HE WAS ONE OF THE AGENTS OF THE PROTECTORS OF THAT COUNTRY WHICH IS RECOGNIZED THROUGHOUT THE WORLD AS AN AGENT OF IMPERIALISM. THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COURT IN VIEW OF NUMEROUS DOCUMENTS EXECUTED HIM FOR THE CRIME OF SPYING ON BEHALF OF ISRAEL. BAMDAD MAY 12: REPORT: U.S. PROTESTS ELGHANIAN EXECUTION.

THE U.S. GOVERNMENT PROTESTED THE EXECUTION OF ELGHANIAN, A PROMINENT MEMBER OF THE JEWISH COMMUNITY IN TEHRAN AND AN ISRAELI SPY. . HODDING CARTER, THE U.S. STATE DEPARTMENT SPOKESMAN, REFERRING TO ELGHANIAN'S EXECUTION, SAID THAT THE U.S. HAS REPROACHED THE RECENT EXECUTIONS OF THE PERSONALITIES OF THE OLD REGIME AND A LEADER OF IRAN'S JEWISH COMMUNITY. THE U.S. GOVERNMENT IS CONCERNED ABOUT ELGHANIAN'S EXECUTION AND IS AFRAID THAT THIS MIGHT BE THE PRELUDE OF SUPPRESSING ETHNIC MINORITIES....

BUT HODDING CARTER HAS STRESSED THE POINT THAT ELGHANIAN HAS BEEN TRIED AS AN INDIVIDUAL AND NOT AS A LEADER OF AN ETHNIC MINORITY, AND THAT AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI AND BAZARGAN HAVE PROMISED TO RESPECT THE RIGHTS OF IRAN'S MINORITIES.

ASSETS OF LEADING BAHAI HAVE BEEN TAKEN OVER BY KHOMEINI COMMMTTEES AND AT LEAST TWO INDUSTRIES OWNED BY BAHAIS HAVE BEEN ACQUIRED BY NEWLY-CREATED ISLAMIC FOUNDATIONS. CONTACT OF ACTING ECON COUNS TOLD HIM OF ONE FAMILY WHO ON MAY 11 RECEIVED BACK BODY OF BAHAI ACCOUNTANT FOR LARGE FIRM IN SOMEWHAT DISMEMBERED AND BRUISED STATE. VICTIM HAS APPARENTLY DIED AFTER MISTREATMENT IN PRISON. PEPSI DISTRIBUTOR'S BAHAI ACCOUNTANT (PEPSI WAS BAHAI FIRM) REMAINS IN JAIL FOR SECOND WEEK. SUMMARY: EMBOFF VISITS SHIRAZ. CITY QUIET, ORDERLY. LOCAL GOVERNMENT ORDERLY. IAS STILL OCCUPIED BY MUJAHEDDIN. UNIVERSITY OPEN, ATMOSPHERE STUDIOUS. DISAPPOINTMENT WITH REVOLUTION. BELIEF THAT UNITED STATES INFLUENCE PERUASIVE. SHOPS OPEN, INDUSTRIES CLOSED. UNEMPLOYMENT HIGH. IEI OPEN. MILITARY BASES PEACEFUL, INACTIVE.

EMBASSY OFFICER VISITED SHIRAZ TO SUPERVISE PACKING OF HOUSEHOLD EFFECTS OF FORMER CONSULATE STAFF. HOMES AND EFFECTS, ABANDONED IN LATE FEBRUARY, WERE FOUND UNDISTURBED. CONSULATE WHICH REMAINS UNDER CARE OF LOCAL CONTRACT GUARD FORCE, AND HAS NOT BEEN DISTURBED OR EVEN APPROACHED BY LOCAL KOMITEH. ONLY VISITORS HAVE BEEN EVER-HOPEFUL VISA APPLICANTS.

CITY PEACEFUL: SHIRAZ WHICH HAD BEEN THE QUIETEST CITY IN IRAN THROUGHOUT THE REVOLUTION REMAINS SO. THERE ARE NO LATE EVENING ROADBLO(KS, NOR NIGHTTIME SHOOTING AS IN THE CASE OF OTHER IRANIAN CITIES. GUN TOTING YOUTHS ROAMING THE STREETS WERE NOT EVIDENT. THE ONLY PEOPLE OBVIOUSLY CARRYING WEAPONS WERE THOSE IN OFFICIAL CAPACITIES (POLICE, MILITARY COMMITTEE GUARDS) AND WERE USUALLY UNIFORMED. TRAFFIC CONTROL WAS HANDLED BY REGULARLY UNIFORMED POLICE AND THE PRESENCE OF IRREGULARS WAS NOT NOTICABLE, ALTHOUGH THEY WERE SAID TO BE ACTIVE AND PLANS WERE BEING MADE TO INCORPORATE THEM WITH THE REGULARS.

EMBASSY OFFICER WAS CORDIALLY IF NOT EFFUSIVELY WELCOMED BY THE DEPUTY GOV. GENERAL (AHMAD MAGHSOUDI, FORMER MIN. OF INTERIOR OFFICIAL). HIS OFFICE'S POLICY WAS TO TRY TO IGNORE THE KOMITEHS WITHIN FARS PROVINCE AND TO ACT INDEPENDENTLY OF THEM. SHIRAZ HAS ONLY ONE CITY KOMITEH AND IS APPARENTLY HEADED BY TWO LOCAL RELIGIOUS, THE AYATOLLAHSHIE AND DASTGHEIB. THE SHIRAZ KHOMITEH CERTAINLY IS ACTIVE BUT UNLIKE OTHER KOMITEHS SEEMS TO CONFINE ITSELF TO MATTERS OF GENUINE CIVIC INTEREST.

SHIRAZ'S IRAN-AMERICAN SOCIETY HAS BECOME LOCAL MOJAHEDDIN HEADQUARTERS. IN ADDITION TO BARB-WIRING AND SANDBAGGING, THEY HAVE REPAINTED AND REWIRED THE BUILDING WHICH HAD BEEN DAMAGED AND BURNED IN SEVERAL ATTACKS. BRITISH CONSUL HAD BEEN OCCUPIED BY ANOTHER GUERILLA GROUP HAS RECENTLY BEEN VACATED. PLANS TO REOPEN IN AUTUMN. FRENCH CULTURAL CENTER IS OPEN AND OPERATING.

SHIRAZ UNIVERSITY, FORMERLY PAHLAVI, HAS REOPENED AND APPARENTLY CONCENTRATING ONACADEMICS. STUDENTS MAY CARRY UP TO 21 HOURS (HALF AGAIN THE NORMAL SEMESTER LOAD) IN ORDER TO MAKE UP FOR TIME LOST TO REVOLUTIONARY ACTIVITIES. THE DEPARTURE OF FOREIGN FACULTY RESULTED IN A 25 PERCENT REDUCTION IN STAFF. CONSEQUENTLY THE TEACHING LOAD ON REMAINING FACULTY HAS NEARLY DOUBLED. THE AMERICAN FULBRIGHT SCHOLAR TEACHING AT THE UNIVERSITY SAID THAT THESE MUST BE THE MOST APOLITICAL STUDENTS IN THE COUNTRY. UNQUOTE. HE SAID POLITICAL DISCUSSION CERTAINLY WAS A BIG PART OF CAMPUS LIFE, BUT AFTER THE BELL RANG, IT WAS USUALLY FOUND ONLY IN THE POLITICAL SCIENCE CLASSES.
HE MENTIONED THAT THE IDEA OF SEPARATION BETWEEN CHURCH AND STATE HAD STARTED TO SPRING UP BUT WAS A REAL PROBLEM FOR THE MORE CONSERVATIVE RELIGIOUS STUDENTS.

HE HAD MET WITH ANTI-AMERICAN HOSTILITY AND ACCUSATIONS OF BEING A CIA AGENT THROUGH FEBRUARY BUT HAS NOT ENCOUNTERED SAME LATELY. THE UNIVERSITY RECENTLY DECIDED TO KEEP ENGLISH AS THE MEDIUM OF INSTRUCTION.

ACUTE DISAPPOINTMENT IS THE ATTITUDE AMONG THE YOUNG AND EDUCATED TOWARD THE REVOLUTION OR OUR ONEQUARTER REVOLUTION UNQUCTE AS ONE PHYSICIAN TERMED IT. MOST FEEL THAT THEIR HOPES FOR MORE LIBERAL LAWS AND INSTITUTIONS HAVE BEEN DASHED BY THE CONSERVATIVE RELIGIOUS GROUP IN POWER. MANY ALSO FEEL THAT IRAN'S REVOLUTION HAS BEEN NIPPED IN THE BUD BY WESTERN POWERS WHOM THEY BELIEVE CONTROL IRAN POLITICALLY AND ECONOMICALLY. THEY POINT TO IRAN'S INDUSTRIES AND DEVELOPMENT PROJECTS WHICH DEPEND UPON TECHNICAL AID FROM THE WEST AND TO THE LARGE NUMBER OF UNEMPLOYED WHO HAD WORKED FOR DEPARTED WESTERN FIRMS.

SOME BELIEVE THAT THE UNITED STATES IS SUPPORTING THE PRESENT PRO-AMERICAN REGIME IN ORDER TO PERPETUATE AN ARRANGEMENT THAT LEAVES IRAN AT THE MERCY OF U.S. IMPERIALISM ALLOWING AMERICA TO GROW RICH BY ROBBING THE IRANIAN WORKER. ------------------027219 140835Z /12 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 1399 SECTION 02 OF 03 TEHRAN 04954 UNQUOTE. LESS RADICAL OBSERVERS BELIEVE THAT THE UNITED STATES HAS INSTALLED THE CURRENT GOVERNMENT TO ALLOW THE U.S. TO DICTATE OIL AND RAW MATERIAL PRICES OR BECAUSE IT WAS SEEN AS THE STRONGEST AVAILABLE BULWARK AGAINST A SOVIET THREAT.

THE BELIEF THAT THE U.S. IS CALLING THE SHOTS IN IRAN IS WIDELY AND STRONGLY HELD -- ANY PROTESTATIONS OR REASONING TO THE CONTRARY IS IGNORED. TOP GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS (YAZDI, QOTBZADEH, BANI SADR, ENTEZAM) ARE THOUGHT TO BE OUR STOOGES WHILE SOME CONSIDER AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI HIMSELF AN UNWITTING ACCOMPLICE.

DISSATISFACTION WITH THE REVOLUTION CAN BE FOUND THROUGHOUT ALL GROUPS AND CLASSES. WHILE KHOMEINI IS STILL CONSIDERED BY MOST TO BE NEXT TO GOD, HIS STOCK HAS FALLEN CONSIDERABLY. PEOPLE EXPRESSED UNHAPPINESS WITH THE RESTRICTIVE ATMOSPHERE, THE SLANT OF THE PRESS (QOTBZADEH'S NIRT CAME IN FOR HEAVY CRITICISM) AND THE CONTINUED SUMMARY TRIALS AND EXECUTIONS. SEVERAL EXPRESSED SATISFACTION AT THE ASSASSINATION OF MOTAHARI WHO WAS THOUGHT TO HAVE REAPED WHAT HE HAD SOWED. THE JEWISH COMMUNITY IS INCREASINGLY NERVOUS. A LOCAL RABBI HAS ORGANIZED GROUP TOURS FOR VISA SHOPPING. THE AMERICAN EMBASSY IN ROME HAS BECOME A FAVORITE STOP.

ALWAYS FAMOUS FOR ITS RELAXED AND FUN-LOVING WAYS, SHIRAZ STREETS NOW EMPTY IN THE EARLY EVENING. ALTHOUGH THE ATMOSPHERE IS MORE PLEASANT THAN ELSEWHERE IN IRAN, SHIRAZIS MISS THEIR LATE EVENING PICNICS AND PARTIES. THE DISMAY OVER THE BAN OF ALCOHOL HAS BEEN AMPLIFIED BY A RECENT VINE KILLING COLD SPELL THAT THWARTED PLANS FOR HOME-BREWING.

ALL SHOPS AND THE BAZAAR WERE OPEN AND ACTIVE. SINCE SHIRAZ IS A HEAVILY AGRICULTURAL AREA, UNEMPLOYMENT IS NOT AT THE LEVELS OF MORE INDUSTRIALIZED AREAS. BUT ENOUGH PEOPLE ARE OUT OF WORK TO RESULT IN A LARGE CROWD SCRAMBLING FOR UNEMPLOYMENT BENEFITS AT THE LABOR OFFICE. SOME ATTEMPT HAS BEEN MADE, AT LEAST WITHIN THE OIL RELATED INDUSTRIES TO ORGANIZE THE UNEMPLOYED WORKERS INTO A UNION FOR THE PURPOSE OF ACHIEVING THEIR ECONOMIC DEMANDS. THE LEADERSHIP'S IDEOLOGICAL BENT IS SOCIALIST.

INDICATIVE OF THE PROBLEMS WHICH MANY FIRMS HAVE ARE THOSE OF A NEW PLASTICS PLANT OUTSIDE OF SHIRAZ. THE FOREIGN CONTRACTORS DEPARTED BEFORE COMPLETION OF THE PLANT. THE FOREIGN TECHNICIANS (ISRAELIS) WHO WOULD HAVE BEEN SUPERVISING THE PLANT WILL NOT BE RETURNING. RAW MATERIALS ARE NOT AVAILABLE. THE PLANT OWNER IS FACING LABOR PROBLEMS AND CASH FLOW PROBLEMS WHICH APPARENTLY HAVE BECOME A PROBLEM FOR INDIVIDUALS AS WELL AS FIRMS.

THE LOCAL FERTILIZER FACTORY, A PART OF THE NATIONAL PETROCHEMICAL COMPANY (NPC) IS ATTEMPTING TO PROCEED WITH AT LEAST PART OF ITS EXPANSION PROGRAM. PARTS OF THIS PROJECT WHICH HAD BEEN CONTRACTED TO BRITAINS DAVY POWER GAS IS BEING ATTEMPTED WITH LOCAL CONTRACTORS AND NPC ENGINEERS. PROGRESS HAS NOT BEEN GOOD.

IRAN ELECTRONICS INDUSTRIES (IEI) REMAINS OPEN AND EMPLOYEES ARE WORKING BUT NOT VERY HARD. MOST DEPARTMENTS ONLY WORK HALF DAYS WITH A GOOD PORTION OF THAT TIME DEVOTED TO CONVERSATION AND TEA-DRINKING. OLD BUSINESS SU(H AS ASSEMBLY OF TOW MISSLE COMPONENTS CONTINUES BUT ITS VALUE IN THE NEW IRAN HAS BEEN QUESTIONED. THERE IS TALK ABOUT FINDING MORE APPROPRIATE PROJECTS BUT SO FAR ONLY TALK. A FEW DIRECT HIRE FOREIGN EMPLOYEES REMAIN. OF THESE, THE WESTERNERS WILL BE DEPARTING WITHIN THE MONTH, SOME INDIAN EMPLOYEES WILL BE RETAINED.

A REPRESENTATIVE OF HERMAN BLUM WAS SAID TO HAVE RETURNED TO WORK WITH IEI, WHICH WAS ALSO ATTEMPTING TO GET CONTINENTAL MECHANICAL TO RETURN. BOTH FIRMS ARE BELIEVED TO HAVE MANAGEMENT CONTRACTS WITH IEI.
MILITARY INSTALLATIONS WITHIN SHIRAZ APPEARED SHIPSHAPE IF FAIRLY INACTIVE. TADAYON AFB F-14S WERE SEEN ON GROUND BUT NOT FLYING. F-14S WERE REPORTEDLY FLOWN WEEKLY.

EMBOFF SPOKE WITH LIEUTENANT FROM ARMORED CENTER. HE WAS NOTICIBLY NERVOUS ABOUT BEING SEEN TALKING TO A FOREIGNER. HE REPORTED THAT CHIEFTAIN TANKS WERE STARTED EVERY COUPLE OF DAYS BUT THAT WAS ABOUT IT. ARMORED CENTER APPARENTLY DESIRES THE RETURN OF SOME TECHNICIANS TO HELP WITH TANKS. EMBOFF RECEIVED IMPRESSION THAT MUCH OF THE RANKS HAVE RETURNED AND THAT SOME TRAINING CONTINUES. OFFICERS ARE UNHAPPY ABOUT WHAT HAS HAPPENED TO ARMY AND NERVOUS ABOUT THEIR OWN FORTUNES. ------------------027171 140835Z /12 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 1400 SECTION 03 OF 03 TEHRAN 04954

BOTH DISCIPLINE AND ORGANIZATION HAVE BROKEN DOWN. ARMY OFFICER SAID THAT ROUTINE ORDERS ARE FOLLOWED WITHIN A DAY OR TWO UNQUOTE BUT TO MOUNT ANY KIND OF OPERATION WOULD BE HOPELESS. SOME SHIRAZ UNITS WERE ORDERED TO SANANDAJ DURING THE DISTURBANCES THERE BUT REFUSED TO GO. THEIR ATTITUDE WAS BEFORE WE WERE TOLD TO DO THE SAME THING AND WERE ACCUSED OF MURDERING OUR BROTHERS. WHY SHOULD WE DO IT NOW? UNQUOTE. NAAS

SUMMARY: STREET VIOLENCE HAS DISAPPEARED FROM ISFAHAN, BUT THE IRANIAN POPULATION REMAINS TENSE DUE TO RELIGIO-POLITICAL RIVALRIES, MASS ARRESTS, AND DISCRIMINATION AGAINST MINORITIES. THE SMALL FOREIGN POPULATION IS IGNORED. THE SCHOOLS AND UNIVERSITIES ARE OPEN, BUT FUNCTIONING ERRATICALLY. A NUMBER OF INDIVIDUALS HAVE HAD MAJOR STATUS CHANGES. END SUMMARY.

SINCE MY RETURN TO IRAN, I HAVE BEEN IN DAILY TELEPHONE CONTACT WITH FRIENDS AND CONTACTS IN ISFAHAN. THEY ALL AGREE THAT THERE HAS BEEN NO STREET VIOLENCE IN RECENT WEEKS, AND MOST BELIEVE THERE IS LITTLE CHANCE OF IT RESUMING. THERE ARE CONTINUED ARRESTS, OFTEN CLANDESTINE MIDDLE-OF-THE-NIGHT ACTS, AND DISAPPEARANCES WHICH ARE PRESUMED TO BE ARRESTS. ESTIMATES VARY, UP TO A MAXIMUM OF 700 ARRESTS IN THE PAST MONTH.

MANY OF THE ARRESTS AND/OR DISAPPEARANCES ARE OF JEWS AND BAHA'IS, BUT MORE THAN HALF ARE, IN THE WORDS OF ONE CONTACT "SAVAKIS--THAT IS ANYONE WHO WAS RICH, WAS DISRESPECTFUL TO OR SUPPORTED THE WRONG PERSON, OR HAD ENEMIES, PLUS A FEW WHO WORKED FOR THE OLD REGIME." THUS THE GENERAL MOOD IN ISFAHAN IS SOMBER. THE ECONOMY IS AT A STANDSTILL. DESPITE PUBLIC REPORTS TO THE CONTRARY, NONE OF THE MAJOR INDUSTRIES ARE WORKING--THE STEEL MILL, THE REFINERY, THE TEXTILE FACTORIES--, THE BAZAAR IS OPEN BUT MERCHANTS REPORT NO BUSINESS, AND NO PUBLIC WORKS PROJECTS ARE ACTIVE OR EVEN CURRENTLY PLANNED.
MANY EMPLOYEES ARE RECEIVING SALARIES WITHOUT WORKING, BUT MOST EXPECT THAT TO STOP SHORTLY. ISFAHAN IS UNHAPPY.

A MAJOR REASON FOR THE UNHAPPINESS IS CONTINUED RIVALRY BETWEEN THE ELDER, RESPECTED AYATOLLAH KHADAMI, TO WHOM PEOPLE TURN TO FOR INTERCESSION WITH THE AUTHORITIES, AND THE YOUNG, RADICAL, NEWLY-PROCLAIMED AYATOLLAH TAHERI, WHO IS THE CHAMPION OF DIRECT ACTION. TAHERI'S INFLUENCE APPEARS TO BE ON THE RISE, PRIMARILY BECAUSE OF HIS SUPPORT AMONG THE SECURITY FORCES--THE ARMY, THE AIR FORCE AND ARMY AVIATION 'HOMOFARS', AND HIS OWN ENFORCERS.

HE HAS EFFECTIVE CONTROL OVER HALF THE CITY (SOUTH OF THE RIVER); HE IS REPORTED RESPONSIBLE FOR MOST OF THE ARRESTS; HE HAS REFUSED TO ALLOW POLICE TO BE ARMED; AND HE APPEARS TO HAVE GOOD CONNECTIONS WITH THE NEW GOVERNOR-GENERAL, WHILE THE OLD GOVERNOR-GENERAL WAS AN ALLY OF AYATOLLAH KHADAMI. REPORTEDLY, TAHERI'S RECENT INFLUENCE STEMS LARGELY FROM AN ARMED MARCH TO QOM LEADING SOME 2,000 TROOPS, WHERE HE OBTAINED THE ENDORSEMENT OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI. BECAUSE HE IS SO YOUNG AND RADICAL, AND THEREFORE UNPREDICTABLE, HIS INCREASING INFLUENCE INCREASES THE LEVEL OF TENSION IN THE CITY.

FOREIGNERS ARE BEING LARGELY IGNORED. THERE HAVE BEEN NO RECENT INCIDENTS DIRECTED AGAINST FOREIGNERS, AND BAZAARIS ARE EAGER TO HAVE FOREIGNERS RETURN (OBVIOUSLY), BUT THEIR PRESENCE OR ABSENCE IS NO LONGER AN ISSUE. IN ISFAHAN, THE POLICE AND LABOR OFFICE SOME MONTHS AGO INFORMED ALL EMPLOYERS THAT ALL RESIDENCE AND WORK PERMITS FOR FOREIGNERS WOULD BE CANCELED AT THE END OF KHORDAD (JUNE 21) UNLESS SPECIAL EXEMPTIONS WERE OBTAINED INDIVIDUALLY FROM TEHRAN. WHILE MOST EMPLOYERS ACCEPT THIS, THE IRAN-AMERICA SOCIETY (IAS) HAS REQUESTED A NUMBER OF EXEMPTIONS, AND WERE TOLD THAT, FOR TEACHERS, THEIR CHANCES ARE GOOD.

THE TWO MAJOR UNIVERSITIES (ISFAHAN AND SENATE SHARIF (HOLY SCIENCE, FORMERLY ARYA MEHR)) ARE OPEN, WITH SOME FACULTIES HARD AT WORK PREPARING FOR EXAAMS, BUT MOST STUDENTS DEVOTING THEIR TIME TO POLITICAL DISCUSSION. SENATE SHARIF HAS ANNOUNCED THAT ALL FOREIGN TEACHERS WILL LEAVE AT THE END OF THIS TERM, AND THAT THERE WOULD BE NO MORE INSTRUCTION IN ENGLISH, BUT HAS NOT DETERMINED HOW AND WHERE TO FIND FARSI TEXTS FOR ITS TECHNICAL CURRICULUM. MANY IN ISFAHAN EXPECT IT TO CLOSE.

THE HIGH SCHOOL STUDENTS ARE TAKING DOUBLE COURSE LOADS, ATTEMPTING TO MAKE UP TIME LOST IN THE REVOLUTION, EXCEPT IN SOME SCHOOLS WHERE TAHERI HAS PROMISED TO POST "OBSERVERS TO ENSURE THE EXAMS ARE FAIR." IN THOSE SCHOOLS, THE STUDENTS ARE BUSY PROVING THEIR REVOLUTIONARY CREDENTIALS.

THE FOLLOWING ARE BIO NOTES ON INDIVIDUALS NOTED IN PREVIOUS REPORTING: ------------------101866 191917Z /46/47 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 1405 SECTION 02 OF 03 TEHRAN 04969 (TEXT CORRECT AS RECEIVED) PER TEHRAN SERVICE MESSAGE RUQMHR 0000 1390431 "THERE IS NO TEXT MISSING. PLEASE ADVISE ACTION OFFICE. --EX-GOVERNOR GENERAL HAGH-DAN, WAS REMOVED IN EARLY MARCH, MET WITH AYATOLLAH KHADAMI, AND WAS PUBLICLY EXONERATED OF WRONG-DOING IN ISFAHAN. RETIRED QUIETLY TO TEHRAN, BUT REPORTED ARRESTED IN TEHRAN ON MAY 3. --EX-GOVERNOR-GENERAL DR. MOHAMMAD ALI VAEZI, PERSONAL PHYSICIAN TO AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, APPOINTED TO REPLACE DR.

HAGH-DAN, AN ELDERLY MAN, REPUTED ISLAMIC SCHOLAR, GOOD FRIEND OF AYATOLLAH KHADAMI, RESPECTED BY ISFAHANIS BUT IN POOR HEALTH. HE REQUESTED RETIREMENT FROM KHOMEINI, AND WAS REPLACED ON MAY 11 BY (#) --GOVERNOR-GENERAL MOHAMMAD KAZEM BOJNORDI, RELEASED FROM PRISON IN THE LAST MONTH BY THE ISLAMIC COURT AFTER THIRTEEN YEARS IN PRISON. HE WAS THE FOUNDER OF THE ISLAMIC NATIONS PARTY IN 1962, WHICH WAS BANNED AS A TERRORIST GROUP UNDER THE SHAH. BOJNORDI WAS ARRESTED IN '66, SENTENCED TO DEATH, AND THEN HAD HIS SENTENCE COMMUTED TO LIFE IMPRISONMENT (ISFAHAN RUMOR STATES, AFTER HE PROVIDED THE NAMES OF HIS ASSOCIATES). HIS FATHER WAS A WELL-KNOWN AYATOLLAH, NOW DECEASED.

ON ARRIVAL IN ISFAHAN, HE WAS INTRODUCED TO THE PEOPLE BY AYATOLLAH TAHERI. HE IS PRESUMED TO BE A RADICAL AND DISPOSED MORE TOWARD TAHERI THAN KHADAMI, SO IT IS EXPECTED THAT ARRESTS WILL CONTINUE AND INCREASE UNDER HIM. --ENGINEER MIR MOHAMMAD SADEGHI, WHO PROVIDED SANCTUARY TO ME AND THE BHI FUGITIVE IN JANUARY, AND LATER TO MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR GENERAL GHAFFARI FOLLOWING AN ASSASSINATION ATTEMPT, HAS REPORTEDLY LEFT THE COUNTRY. AT THE TIME OF THE REVOLUTION, HE WAS AYATOLLAH KHADAMI'S PRINCIPAL AIDE, FIRST PRESIDENT OF THE CENTRAL COMMITTEE, AND THE LEADING NON-RELIGIOUS FIGURE IN ISFAHAN.

HE WAS AN OPPONENT OF TAHERI, AND PUBLICLY OBJECTED TO HIS ASSUMING THE TITLE 'AYATOLLAH.' REPORTEDLY, HE ALSO GAVE SANCTUARY FROM A MOB TO ONE OF THE TWO SAVAK DEPUTIES IN ISFAHAN (BOTH LATER KILLED BY THE MOB), AND TAHERI BEGAN ACCUSING HIM OF SAVAK CONNECTIONS. HE BECAME AN EMBARRASSMENT TO KHADAMI, AND RESIGNED HIS POSITIONS IN LATE MARCH, AND HAS SUBSEQUENTLY BEEN REPORTED TO BE LEAVING IRAN FOR THE U.S. IN EARLY MAY.

(HE TRIED TO CONTACT ME, AND WAS INCORRECTLY TOLD I WAS IN WASHINGTON, SO HE MAY CONTACT THE IRAN DESK.) HE IS A CIVIL ENGINEER, SPEAKS FAIR ENGLISH, AND IS (WAS?) A DEDICATED REVOLUTIONARY, THOUGH A MODERATE. I DOUBT THAT HE WILL ACCEPT EASILY A PERMANENT DIVORCE FROM IRANIAN POLITICS. --MR. PARVARISH, A LOW-LEVEL AIDE TO KHADAMI AT THE TIME OF MY RESCUE BY KHADAMI, BECAME HEAD OF THE EDUCATION COMMITTEE OF THE CENTRAL COMMITTEE, AND IS NOW A MEMBER OF THE COMMITTEE EXECUTIVE. HE WAS A HIGH SCHOOL TEACHER, AND WAS CENTRAL IN INFLUENCING THE STUDENT STRIKE AND MILITANCY. --MR.

MOSHARAF, ANOTHER TEACHER AND COMPANION OF PARVARISH IN KHADAMI'S TRAIN, BECAME SPECIAL ASSISTANT TO GOVERNOR-GENERAL VAEZI--HIS PRINCIPAL LIAISON TO KHADAMI. HIS FUTURE UNDER GOVERNOR-GENERAL BAJNORDI IS UNCERTAIN. --DR. SERAJ-UL WAIZI (NO RELATION TO THE GOV-GEN), A MULLAH, TEACHER OF RELIGION AND PHILOSOPHY IN THE ISFAHAN MINISTRY OF EDUCATION, A WELL-RESPECTED RELIGIOUS FIGURE WHO CHALLENGED TAHERI AND PREACHED AGAINST VIOLENCE, HAS BEEN ARRESTED, TRIED FOR "COLLABORATING WITH THE SHAH," SENTENCED TO FOUR YEARS IN PRISON, AND DEFROCKED.

RUMOR HAS IT THAT FOURTEEN OTHER MULLAHS HAVE BEEN OR WILL BE SIMILARLY TREATED. --AMIR AMANNULLAH DAREHSHUIE, MAJLES DEPUTY FROM SEMIRON, SON AND HEIR OF THE CHIEF OF THE DARESHUIE BRANCH OF THE QASHQAIE TRIBE, IS MISSING AND BEING SOUGHT, ALONG WITH ALL OTHER FORMER MAJLES DEPUTIES, BUT NOT VERY HARD.

HE IS IN SEMIRON (ISFAHAN PROVINCE), AND WAS PRESENT LAST WEEK WHEN HIS FATHER HOSTED A FEAST FOR KHOSRU QASHQAIE, WHO WITH HIS BROTHER HEADS THE ENTIRE TRIBE, AND RETURNED FROM EXILE AT THE PEAK OF THE REVOLUTION. --JAMSHID IRANPOUR, A FRIEND OF THE CONSULATE, CONTRACTOR AND IMPORTER, WHO HAD A FINGER IN EVERY PIE WITH GOOD REVOLUTIONARY AND SAVAK CONTACTS, WAS BEING SOUGHT AS A CIA AGENT. HE REMAINED IN THE U.S.

UNTIL HE OBTAINED A LETTER FROM AYATOLLAH KHADAMI, AND HAS NOW RETURNED TO ISFAHAN, WHERE HE IS A MEMBER OF THE CENTRAL COMMITTEE. --ZINAT NILCHI, FORMER CONSULATE EMPLOYEE WHO LEFT TO WORK IN THE BHI SECURITY OFFICE, IS CURRENTLY BEING SOUGHT AS A CIA AGENT.

1979TEHRAN04970.subject: AYATOLLAH BEHESHTI ON THE REVOLUTION AND FOREIGN AFFAIRS

segments.text: AFFAIRS (C-ENTIRE TEXT) THIS IS A REPORTING CABLE.

SUMMARY: BEHESHTI SAYS IRANIAN REVOLUTION IS NOT FINISHED, REVOLUTIONARY COURTS ARE ONLY TEMPORARY. AYATOLLAH MONTAZERI TO REPLACE MOTAHARI ON REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL. YAZDI HAS LOST STEAM. IN FOREIGN POLICY, BEHESHI SAYS ISLAMIC REVOLUTION WANTS EVEN-HANDED NONINTERVENTION FROM BIG POWERS. END SUMMARY.

IN PROCESS OF TRYING TO SET UP MEETING WITH AYATOLLAH BEHESHTI, ACTING POL COUNS WAS ASKED TO SUBMIT LIST OF QUESTIONS FOR DISCUSSION. BEHESHTI BEGGED OFF MEETING, BUT GAVE WRITTEN ANSWERS BACK THROUGH OUR SOURCE, LONG-TIME KHOMEINI ASSOCIATE WHO WAS ACTING AS INTERMEDIARY. BEHESHTI'S COMMENTS ARE OF MORE THAN PASSING INTEREST, BECAUSE HE IS REPORTED TO BE HEAD OF REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL, WHICH IS CONSIDERED TOP RLLING ORGAN OF ISLAMIC REVOLUTION. INTERMEDIARY, WHOSE CONTACTS WITHIN KHOMEINI MOVEMENT ARE IMPECCABLE, SAID BEHESHTI IS NOW MAIN GO-BETWEEN IN PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT OF IRAN (PGOI)-- KHOMEINI RELATIONSHIP AND IS THUS MAN CHARGED WITH HARMONIZING RELATIONSHIPS BETWEEN PGOI AND COMMITTEE STRUCTURE.

INTERMEDIARY CONFIRMED THA1 AYATOLLAH MONTAZERI WILL REPLACE ASSASSINATED AYATOLLAH MOTAHARI ON THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL, AND SAID THIS WAS GOOD, BECAUSE IN TERMS OF RELATIONSHIPS AMONG AYATOLLAHS, MONTAZERI WAS PROBABLY MAN NEXT IN LINE TO TAKE KHOMEINI'S PLACE IN EVENT OF LATTER'S DEATH. WHEN ASKED WHY MANTLE WOULD NOT FALL TO SHARIATMADARI, SOURCE SAID HE IS NOT OF SAME IDEOLOGICAL SCHOOL AS KHOMEINI, AND ISLAMIC MOVEMENT LEADERSHIP WOULD NOT ALLOW HIM TO TAKE POSITION; MONTAZERI WAS BEST OF REST, AND MOST RESPECTED.

RESPONDING TO QUESTION OF WHAT WERE REVOLUTIONARY GOALS, AND WHERE WAS REVOLUTION HEADED, BEHESHTI COMMENTED AS FOLLOWS: OUR AIM IS TO CREATE HEALTHY ORDER AND HEALTHY RELATIONS BOTH INSIDE IRAN AND WITH OUTSIDE WORLD. UNQUOTE. REVOLUTION IS TRYING HARD TO KEEP ITS DIRECTION, BUT HAS NOT YET REACHED ITS GOALS END . BY NATURE, IRAN WANTS TO HAVE HEALTHY HUMAN TIES WITH ALL PEOPLES ON THE CONDITION THAT FOREIGNERS RESPECT IDEA OF FAIR HUMAN RELATIONS. END .

ON REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL: IT IS LIKE TWO HOUSES OF PARLIAMENT ROLLED INTO ONE. UNQUOTE. IT HAS SUPREME LEGISLATIVE AUTHORITY AND MONITORS THE EXECUTIVE BRANCH. ON QUESTION OF WHO WAS ON COUNCIL, BEHESHTI SAID IF WE WANTED IT KNOWN, WE WOULD HAVE ANNOUNCED IT. END .

ON REVOLUTIONARY ISLAMIC COURTS: REVOLUTIONARY COURTS ARE FUNCTIONING TO PUNISH ENEMIES OF THE PEOPLE IN THE PAST AND PEOPLE WHO ARE PRESENTLY ANTIREVOLUTIONARY. THESE ARE NOT NORMAL COURTS, THEY ARE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS; THEIR ACTION WILL BE TEMPORARY, AFTER WHICH THE JOB WILL BE TURNED OVER TO THE CIVILIAN COURTS. END . BEHESHTI REFUSED TO COMMENT ON TIME THIS WOULD HAPPEN, BUT INTERMEDIARY SAID HE THOUGHT PGOI'S PUBLICLY ANNOUNCED TIME OF ONE YEAR WAS CURRENT WORKING TIME FRAME. SOURCE, WHO STRONGLY DISAPPROVES OF SUMMARY EXECUTIONS, WAS FEARFUL THAT THERE WOULD BE MORE.

(COMMENT: BEHESHTI'S STRESS ON COURT'S ROLE IN DEALING WITH PRESENT REVOLUTIONAIRES HAD BEEN REFLECTED IN OTHER COMMENT ON COURTS, ESPECIALLY SINCE SECOND ASSASSINATION OF ISLAMIC MOVEMENT LEADER MOTAHARI.) BEHESHTI MADE POINT AT END OF HIS ANSWERS THAT REVOLUTION HAS NOT BEEN BLOODY, BUT IF THE REVOLUTION IS NOT BLOODY, THAT DOES NOT MEAN WE HAVE NOT HAD A THOROUGH REVOLUTION. IF THERE HAD BEEN NO REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL ALL PRISONERS NOW IN JAIL WOULD HAVE ALREADY BEEN KILLED BY THE PEOPLE. END . (COMMENT: HE MADE THIS POINT IN CONTEXT OF JUSTIFICATION FOR REVOLUTIONARY TRIALS.)

ON FOREIGN RELATIONS: BEHESHTI SIAD IRAN WANTS THE OUTSIDE WORLD NOT RPT NOT TO ASSIST ANTI-REVOLUTIONARY FORCES AND NOT TO INTERFERE WITH IRANIAN AFFAIRS. WE ARE NOT ASKING ANYTHING MORE, FROM EITHER THE U.S. OR THE U.S.S.R. OUR RELATIONS WITH THE USSR SHOULD BE LIKE TWO NORMAL NEIGHBORS. THEY MUST NOT INTERFERE AND THEY MUST NOT ASK SPECIAL FAVORS FROM US. END . RE U.S., BEHESHTI WENT ON, THE GOVERNMENT OF THE U.S. HAS ------------------028935 141335Z /50 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1408 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 04970 LIMDIS STATED IT IS NOT INTERFERING IN IRAN'S AFFAIRS; WHY NOT ANSWER QUESTIONS OF NON-INTERFERENCE?

MINORITY GROUPS ARE ATTACKING PGOI, REVOLUTIONARY COUNCILS, AND THE U.S. AS WELL. END . HE SAID HE WOULD BE SURPRIZED IF U.S. COULD NOT DEFEND ITSELF; ON THE OTHER HAND, IN AN OBVIOUS CONTRADICTION, HE CONCLUDED THAT FOR THE MOMENT THE MORE QUIET THE U.S. KEEPS, THE BETTERIT WILL BE FOR YOU AND FOR US. END . AT END OF QUESTIONS HE ADDED PENCILLED NOTE, THAT IF PROOF IS FOUND THAT THE U.S. IS ASSISTING ANTI-REVOLUTIONARY GROUPS, IT WILL BE EXTREMELY BAD FOR OUR TIES.

(COMMENT: BEHESHTI'S OBVIOUS CONCERN WITH ANTI-REVOLUTIONARY ACTIVITIES, AND HIS WORRY ABOUT POSSIBLE FOREIGN BACKING FOR THOSE ACTIVITIES IS EVIDENT AND IMPORTANT.) INTERMEDIARY SAID BEHESHTI AND OTHERS IN INNER RELIGIOUS CIRCLE ARE APPALLINGLY UNSOPHISTICATED ABOUT INTERNATIONAL AFFAIRS AND LIKELY TO SEE BUGBEARS WHERE THERE ARE ONLY SHADOWS. THIS WILL BE A CONTINUING PROBLEM, BOTH FOR IRAN AND ITS FOREIGN FRIENDS, AND FURTHER ANTI-REVOLUTIONARY ACTIVITIES WILL SPUR FURTHER TRIALS AND COULD LEAD TO SAME VICIOUS CIRCLE THAT DID SHAH IN. (COMMENT: SOBERING, BUT ALL WE WOULD ADD IS AMEN.) FACT THAT LEADING KHOEMINI SUPPORTER IS CONCERED ABOUT THIS, HOWEVER, COULD LEAD TO SOME COUNTER-PRESSURE IN QOM.

AT CONCLUDION OF MEETING, SOURCE SAID BEHESHTI AND OTHERS REGARD YAZDI'S PROMOTION UNQUOTE TO FOREIGN MINISTER AS DESIGNED TO GET HIM OUT OF THE WAY. AYATOLLAHS ARE ANNOYED AT WAY YAZDI BUNGLED THE QUESTIONS ON HIS AMERICAN CITIZENSHIP AND TIES. SOURCE SPECULATED THAT HE HAD BEEN GIVEN FOREIGN MINISTRY TO MAKE HIM CHIEF SPOKESMAN FOR REVOLUTION ABROAD AND THAT HE WOULD BE SHIPPED OUT TO A DIPLOMATIC POST OR QUIETLY DISMISSED AFTER A DISCREET AMOUNT OF TIME. (COMMENT: THIS IS MOST NEGATIVE COMMENT WE HAVE HEARD ON YAZDI APPOINTMENT, BUT IT COMES FROM A SOURCE WHO KNOWS WHAT THE RELIGIOUS BIG BOYS ARE THINKING.) NAAS
THIS IS A REPORTING CABLE.

(C) SUMMARY: LEADER OF REVOLUTIONARY COURTS EXPLAINS HOW THEY WORK, DECLARES SHAH AND ENTOURAGE HAVE BEEN TRIED IN ABSENTIA AND CAN BE KILLED BY ANYONE, ANYWHERE. KHOMEINI CALLS FOR DEATH PENALTY IN TRIBUNALS ONLY IN CERTAIN CASES INVOLVING KILLING. SHARIATMADARI SUGGESTS CHARGES BE DROPPED RATHER THAN AMNESTY BE GRANTED TO THOSE TOWARD WHOM MERCY IS TO BE SHOWN. SOME PRISONERS FREED, DR. AKBAR BAHADORI'SEXECUTION SHAKES MEDICAL MEN. END SUMMARY.

(U) TEHRAN MEDIA OF ALL LANGUAGES MORNING MAY 14 CARRIES AS LEAD STORY PRESS CONFERENCE OF AYATOLLAH SADEGH KHALKHALI, IDENTIFIED AS HEAD OF TEHRAN'S REVOLUTIONARY ISLAMIC COURTS. KHALKHALI ANNOUNCED THAT THE FORMER SHAH, HIS CLOSE FAMILY MEMBERS AND ASSOCIATES HAD BEEN SENTENCED TO DEATH IN ABSENTIA, AND HAD THEREFORE ACCORDING TO ISLAMIC PRINCIPLES BEEN CLASSIFIED AS MAHDURODAM--ONE WHOSE BLOOD CAN BE SHED WITH IMPUNITY. ANYONE WHO KILLS ONE OF THIRTEEN ON LIST WILL BE CONSIDERED COURT EXECUTIONER AND ABSOLVED OF THEIR BLOOD.

IN UNSIGNED EDITORIAL, ENGLISH LANGUAGE TEHRAN TIMES EXPANDED THIS TO NOTE: "THE ARRAIGNMENT (IN A FOREIGN COURT) OF SOMEONE WHO HAS KILLED...(ONE OF THE THIRTEEN) ...IN ANY FOREIGN COUNTRY WILL BE PROPERLY CONSIDERED AN ACT AFFECTING THE RELATIONS BETWEEN THAT COUNTRY AND IRAN." THOSE ON LIST ARE: MOHAMMAD REZA SHAH PAHLAVI, GHOLAMREZA PAHLAVI, FARAH PAHLAVI, ASHRAF PAHLAVI, JAFAR SHARIF EMAMI, GHOLAMREZA AZHARI, SHAHPOUR BAKHTIAR, GHOLAM ALI OVEISSI, AZIZULLAH PALIZBAN, SHABAN JAFARI, HOUSHANG NAHAVANDI, ARDESHIR ZAHEDI AND FARIDEH DIBA.

(U) KHALKHALI SAID HE HAD APPEARED BEFORE PRESS TO REFUTE "BLASPHEMOUS REPORTS" OF WESTERN PRESS ABOUT ISLAMIC JUSTICE. HE CLAIMED HE HIMSELF WAS OPPOSED TO SECRECY OF TRIALS AND JUDGES IDENTITIES BUT HAD GONE ALONG WITH MAJORITY OF HIS COLLEAGUES. HE JUSTIFIED NECESSITY FOR QUICK EXECUTIONS ON BASIS OF ISLAMIC LAW WHICH SAYS THAT NO MOSLEM CAN FEED OR GIVE WATER TO A CONDEMNED MAN. KHALKHALI DENIED REPORTS OF AMNESTY AND SAID THAT "UNTIL THE HANDS OF THE FBI, SAVAK, AND CIA AND VARIOUS IMPERIALISTS HAVE BEEN SEVERED, WE SHALL SHED OUR BLOOD AND WE SHALL NOT SUBMIT."

(U) KHALKHALI ALSO SAID FORMER PRIME MINISTER HOVEYDA HAD OFFERED $1 MILLION TO POSTPONE HIS EXECUTION FOR TWO MONTHS AND THAT JEWISH BUSINESSMAN ELGHANIAN, EXECUTED LAST WEEK, HAD OFFERED A BRIBE OF MORE THAN $70 MILLION FOR HIS FREEDOM. IN COMMENT ON WHY DEFENDANTS WERE NOT ALLOWED TO HAVE DEFENSE LAWYERS, KHALKHALI SAID THAT UNDER THE ISLAMIC JUDICIAL SYSTEM THERE WAS NO PROVISION FOR A LAWYER UNLESS A DEFENDANT WAS MUTE AND UNABLE TO SPEAK FOR HIMSELF.

(C) INITIAL REACTION TO KHALKHALI'S APPEARANCE IN LEGAL AND BUSINESS CIRCLES HERE IS ONE OF STUNNED DISGUST. TWO PERSIAN LAWYERS AND NUMBER OF OTHERS WE HAVE MENTIONED SUBJECT TO ARE APPALLED AND FEEL THEIR WORST FEARS ABOUT ISLAMIC JUSTICE HAVE BEEN CONFIRMED. ONE SOURCE SAID THIS WILL SURELY START THE STAMPDED OF THE MODERNISTS, COMING AS IT DOES ON TOP OF EXECUTIONS OF PAST WEEK AND MORE EXPECTED TO COME.

(U) IN A RELATED, IF CONFUSING, DEVELOPMENT, AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI EVENING MAY 12, BEFORE KHALKHALI PRESS CONFERENCE, ANNOUNCED THAT FROM HENCEFORTH NO ONE SHOULD BE EXECUTED UNLESS THEY HAVE EITHER BEEN FOUND GUILTY OF KILLING SOMEONE, HAVE ORDERED MASSACRES, OR HAVE BEEN GUILTY OF CARRYING OUT TORTURE RESULTING IN DEATH. ALL SUCH CHARGES MUST BE PROVED IN ISLAMIC COURTS, AND VIOLATIONS OF THIS ORDER WILL ENTAIL PENALTY OF DEATH AGAINST THOSE ORDERING EXECUTIONS OUTSIDE THIS DECREE. AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI HAS CALLED FOR DROPPING THE TERM AMNESTY IN CONNECTION WITH LENIENCY TO BE SHOWN BY PGOI AND CALLED INSTEAD FOR CHARGES TO BE DROPPED.

AMNESTY, SAID SHARIATMADARI, IMPLIES BEING EXEMPT FROM CHARGES AND HAVING COMMITTED CRIMES; IT WOULD BE BETTER UNDER ISLAMIC LAW TO DROP CHARGES. SHARIATMADARI ALSO SUGGESTED THAT QUESTION OF COMPETENCE OF COURTS TO TRY CRIME UNDER INTERNATIONAL STANDARDS SHOULD BE EXAMINED. ------------------029247 141408Z /44 R FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1412 INFO AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY ANKARA SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 04974

(C) CONFUSION OF MULTIPLE PRONOUNCEMENTS BY VARIOUS AYATOLLAHS HAS LEFT SITUATION IN A MEASURE OF CONFUSION. MORE ACUTE OBSERVERS OF THIS ISLAMIC RHETORICAL DISCHARGE HAVE NOTED THAT IF KHOMEINI'S EDICT REALLY PROVIDES FOR PENALTIES AGAINST THOSE WHO CONDEMN PEOPLE TO DEATH FOR LESS THAN MURDEROUS CRIMES, PRIVATE GROUPS LIKE FARGAN MAY DECIDE TO GO ALONG AND EXTEND THEIR ASSASSINATION PROGRAM TO TAKE OUT A FEW ISLAMIC JURISTS, STARTING WITH KHALKHALI.

(U) CONCURRENTLY WITH DISCUSSIONS OF ISLAMIC JUSTICE, PARS NEWS AGENCY ANNOUNCED THAT 27 PRISONERS HAD BEEN FREED, INCLUDING ALI GHOLI ARDALAN, THE SHAH'S LAST MINISTER OF THE IMPERIAL COURT. ARDALAN, WHO IS 78 WAS A CAREER DIPLOMAT WHO BECAME HEAD OF THE IMPERIAL COURT LAST YEAR.

(C) ONE WHO DID NOT GET AWAY WAS DR. AKBAR BAHADORI, MAJLES DEPUTY FROM ARAK, WHO WAS SHOT EVENING MAY 10 AFTER TRIAL BY ARAK ISLAMIC COURT AND REVIEW OF CASE IN TEHRAN. BAHADORI, WELL KNOWN TO SEVERAL EMBOFFS, WAS BACKBENCH RESURGENCE PARTY DEPUTY WHO EMERGED TO LEAD SUPPORT FOR BAKHTIAR IN EARLY FEB. PERIOD. HE WAS ALSO LEADER OF LARGEST PRIVATE HEALTH ORGANIZATION IN COUNTRY WHICH RAN SIX HOSPITALS AND WAS ON VERGE OF OPENING UP 400-BED HOSPITAL NEAR VANAK SQUARE IN TEHRAN. ASSOCIATE OF BAHADORI TOLD US KILLING WAS PROBABLY CRIME OF REVENGE BY LOCAL ARAK GROUPS WHO WANTED TO TAKE OVER SOME OF FAMILY RESOURCES.

SEVERAL IN MEDICAL PROFESSION IN TEHRAN HAVE BEEN VERY UPSET BY EXECUTION, SINCE BAHADORI WAS KNOWN AS CHIEF CRITIC OF INADEQUACY OF SHAH'S HEALTH POLICIES, AS WELL AS A MAN WHO HAD DONE A GREAT DEAL OF GOOD FOR MEDICAL CARE IN IRAN ON HIS OWN INITIATIVE. HIS ONLY CRIME, IN ABSENCE OF OTHER EVIDENCE, WOULD SEEM TO HAVE BEEN ENCOURAGING A PARLIAMENTARY MAJORITY FOR FORMER PRIME MINISTER BAKHTIAR. NAAS
(S - ENTIRE TEXT)
