1979TEHRAN05128.subject: A COMMITTEEMAN'S VIEW OF THE DUAL STRUCTURE OF - GOVERNMENT

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT.)

SUMMARY: NIAVARAN KHOMEINI COMMITTEEMAN BELIEVES COMMITTEE STRUCTURE MAY UNDERGO SIGNIFICANT MODIFICATION. MANY OF THOSE IN COMMITTEES ARE NOT SERIOUS BACKERS OF ISLAMIC REVOLUTION, BUT JOINED TO PROTECT THEIR INTERESTS. PROBLEM OF HANDLING ARMED COMMITTEE YOUTHS IN ANY REORGANIZATION WILL BE SEVERE AND PROBABLY REQUIRE VIOLENCE AT SOME POINT. SOURCE WAS PESSIMISTIC ON CHANCES OF INTERNAL PEACE. THERE IS REAL CONCERN FOR KHOMEINI'S HEALTH AND DISTRUST OF RADICALS AROUND HIM. END SUMMARY.

AT END OF EVENING DINNER PARTY, ACTING POLCOUNS SPENT ABOUT TWO HOURS DISCUSSING COMMITTEE STRUCTURE RECENTLY WITH KHOMEINI COMMITTEEMAN FROM NIAVARAN SUBURB OF TEHRAN. INDIVIDUAL ADMITTED FREELY THAT HE JOINED NIAVARAN COMMITTEE LATE IN THE GAME (NOVEMBER 1978) TO PROTECT HIS OWN HOME AND FAMILY AS WELL AS HIS BUSINESS INTERESTS. HE HAS SINCE SENT HIS FAMILY TO AUSTRIA, AND SAYS IF SITUATION DETERIORATES, HE WILL JOIN THEM PERMANENTLY SOMETIME IN THE LATER SUMMER OR FALL. HE NOTED THAT MANY OTHERS HAD JOINED COMMITTEES TO "GET IN ON THE GROUND FLOOR." PROBLEMS OF COMMITTEE REORGANIZATION WERE GOING TO BE CRUCIAL TO ISLAMIC MOVEMENT'S CHANCES OF SURVIVAL.

THIS WAS POLOFF'S FIRST SUBSTANTIAL CONVERSATION WITH SOURCE, THOUGH HE HAD MET SOURCE ON TWO OTHER OCCASIONS. SOURCE WAS MORE TALKATIVE THAN HE HAD INTENDED, AND BECAME RETICENT IN LATER STAGES OF CONVERSATION. SALIENT POINTS OF DISCUSSION GIVEN BELOW.

COMMITTEE MEMBERSHIP: MANY IN COMMITTEES JOINED LATE IN GAME TO PROTECT THEMSELVES AND POSITION THEMSELVES FOR LATER DEPARTURE FROM IRAN IF NECESSARY. SOURCE INDICATED THIS WAS PRIMARY REASON HE JOINED. HE SERVED 48 STRAIGHT NIGHTS ON THE BARRACADES FROM FEBRUARY THROUGH MARCH, TOOK A VACATION, AND HAS SERVED ONLY THREE OR FOUR TIMES IN PAST MONTH, AFTER STRUCTURE OF NIAVARAN COMMITTEE BECAME MORE REGULARIZED. BIGGEST PROBLEM NOW IS THAT "RESPONSIBLE MEMBERS" OF COMMITTEES ARE NOW BACK AT WORK ON THEIR FULL TIME JOBS, LEAVING COMMITTEES IN HANDS OF RELATIVELY CALLOW YOUTH.

THIS IS ALL RIGHT FOR ROUTINE PERIODS, BUT ILLUSTRATED ESSENTIAL PROBLEM OF COMMITTEE ORGANIZATION: GOOD MEN HAVE THEIR OWN JOBS AS WELL AS COMMITTEE WORK; OTHERS DO NOT, AND THE DAY-TO-DAY RUNNING OF MANY OF THE LOCAL COMMITTEES FALLS INTO THE HANDS OF THE UNQUALIFIED.

COMMITTEE REORGANIZATION: TO COPE WITH THIS PROBLEM, SOURCE SAID PLANS ARE UNDERWAY TO RESHAPE COMMITTEE STRUCTURE AND GRADUALLY BRING COMMITTEEMEN INTO GOVERNMENT, ARMED FORCES, AND POLICE (COMMENT: THIS IS CONSISTENT WITH WHAT FONMIN YAZDI TOLD CHARGE MAY 15). THIS MAY BE EASIER SAID THAN DONE; ARMED YOUTH LIKE RELATIVE FREEDOM THEY HAVE HAD TO POINT THEIR NEW WEAPONS AT PEOPLE. HE HAD PERSONALLY HAD TO SLAP DOWN A FEW OF HIS YOUNGER COLLEAGUES. CAMPAIGN TO DISARM IRREGULAR FORCES AND PLACE THEM UNDER POLICE OR ARMY DISCIPLINE IS NOT LIKELY TO GO DOWN WELL WITH THE REVOLUTION'S SHOCK TROOPS.

THOSE WHO HAVE A BENT FOR GOVERNMENT WILL UNDOUBTEDLY FIT INTO THE LOCAL ADMINISTRATIVE STRUCTURE; THE "BRIGANDS" MAY HAVE TO BE PHYSICALLY DISARMED. THIS WILL REQUIRE ALL THE CHARISMA AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI CAN MUSTER IF IT IS TO BE SUCCESSFULLY BROUGHT OFF.

DANGER FROM THE LEFT: SOURCE HOLDS VIEW THAT ISLAMIC MOVEMENT SHOULD MOVE TO REORGANIZE RIGHT NOW DESPITE ITS OWN WEAKNESS, WHILE LEFT IS STILL TOO DISORGANIZED TO SUCCESSFULLY MOUNT A CHALLENGE. BASED ON SOURCE'S EXPERIENCE IN NIAVARAN, LEFT WILL BE READY TO CAUSE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT SERIOUS TROUBLE BY JUNE OR EARLY JULY. SOURCE SAID HE FELT CONFIDENT THAT ISLAMIC MOVEMENT WOULD WIN ANY DIRECT CLASH, BUT THERE WAS ENOUGH DOUBT IN HIS VOICE AND DEMEANOR TO INDICATE IT WAS BY NO MEANS A FOREGONE CONCLUSION.

MARXIST FEDAYAN ARE MAKING HEADWAY WITH RADICAL UNIVERSITY STUDENTS, AND IF REGULARIZATION OF COMMITTEE STRUCTURE IS NOT CARRIED OUT PROPERLY, ATTEMPT COULD PRODUCE SUBSTANTIAL NUMBER OF RECRUITS FOR LEFTIST GROUPS. THIS IS MAIN REASON WHY LEFT IS TRYING TO FUZZ RELIGIOUS ISSUE. IT FEELS IF IT CAN BORROW EVEN A FIG LEAF OF ISLAMIC LEGITIMACY, IT CAN APPEAL TO THE SELFINTEREST OF THE YOUNG WHEN THE PGOI AND KHOMEINI TRY TO MAKE THEM BOW TO DISCIPLINE.

KHOMEINI HEALTH: SOURCE HAD NOT SEEN KHOMEINI FOR SOME TIME, BUT SAID CONCERN IS GROWING IN COMMITTEE CIRCLES ------------------067475 170919Z /13 FM AMEOBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1494 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 05128 THAT AYATOLLAH'S HEALTH WILL NOT PERMIT HIM TO GIVE DAILY DIRECTION TO MOVEMENT. HE SAID KHOMEINI SOMETIMES FADES OUT MENTALLY WHILE HE IS RECEIVING PEOPLE.

ONE SENIOR TEHRAN COMMITTEEMAN, ACKNOWLEDGING THIS AS WELL AS PROBLEM OF GOVERNING COUNTRY WHERE AUTHORITY HAS BEEN DESTROYED AND INDIVIDUALISM IS RAMPANT, MADE COMMENT WHICH IS QUIETLY AND QUICKLY GOING AROUND IN SENIOR COMMITTEE CIRCLES: "IT TOOK US 37 YEARS TO DRIVE THE LAST ONE CRAZY (SHAH), BUT ONLY FOUR MONTHS TO DRIVE THIS ONE OUT OF HIS MIND." SITUATION WOULD BE MORE MANAGEABLE IF THERE WAS TRUST IN KHOMEINI ENTOURAGE. ADMITTING THAT HE WAS MUCH MORE MODERNIZED THAN THE REST OF THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT, SOURCE SAID THERE IS MUCH CRITICISM WITHIN ISLAMIC MOVEMENT, EVEN BY LONG-TIME KHOMEINI SUPPORTERS, OF SOME OF THOSE AROUND HIM.

SOURCE WOULD NOT GO INTO NAMES, BUT SAID THERE WERE A NUMBER OF RADICAL MULLAHS, SOME OF THEM PRESSING VERY LEFT-WING IDEAS, WHO HAD ACCESS TO KHOMEINI "OUT OF PROPORTION TO THEIR SUPPORT AT LARGE OR THEIR INTELLIGENCE." HE CONCLUDEDTHAT FACTIONAL IN-FIGHTING WITHIN ISLAMIC MOVEMENT HAD JUST BEGUN, AND WOULD PROBABLY GET MORE VICIOUS, BECAUSE "EACH MULLAH THINKS HE HAS GOD AND THE AGHA (KHOMEINI) ON HIS SIDE."

COMMENT: SOURCE IS OBVIOUSLY VIEWING SITUATION FROM A PERSONAL PERSPECTIVE, AND HIS VIEWS ON MODERNIZATION ARE UNDOUBTEDLY NOT SHARED BY BULK OF KHOMEINI FOLLOWERS. EVERTHELESS, HE SEEMS WELL INFORMEON GENERAL OUTLINES OF ISLAMIC MOVEMENT'S INTERNAL STRUGGLES. THOUGH PERSONALLY PESSIMISTIC ABOUT CHANCES OF PEACE, HE REMAINS COMMITTED TO ISLAMIC MOVEMENT AS BEST WAY TO INSURE OUTCOME HE COULD LIVE WITH. HE IS PROBABLY TYPICAL OF SIGNIFICANT NUMBERS OF WORKING-LEVEL COMMITTEEMEN IN TEHRAN AND PERHAPS OTHER CITIES AND HIS ADMINISTRATIVE SKILLS WILL BE IMPORTANT FOR THE REVOLUTION'S SURVIVAL.

SCOTT MURBACH DEPARTED TEHRAN MAY 17 BUT WILL RETURN ON TDY O/A JUNE 7 FOR APPROXIMATELY 6-8 WEEKS. HE HOLDS OFFICIAL PASSPORT. IN LIGHT OF CONCERNS DESCRIBED REFTEL, BELIEVE IT HIGHLY DESIRABLE THAT HE BE ISSUED DIPLOMATIC PP PRIOR TO HIS RETURN HERE. NAAS

IRANIAN PRESS CARRIED STRAIGHTFORWARD WIRE SERVICE PIECES COVERING CONFIRMATION HEARINGS OF AMBASSADOR CUTLER. PARS NEWS AGENCY AND MAJOR PRESSES PUBLISHED BIO OF AMBASSADOR CUTLER SUPPLIED BY EMBASSY PRESS OFFICE.

1979TEHRAN05193.subject: ANTI-U.S. DEMONSTRATION AND OTHER HIJINKS IN - ISFAHAN

segments.text: ISFAHAN (C - ENTIRE TEXT.)

SUMMARY: MAY 19 A GROUP OF APPROXIMATELY 400 DEMONSTRATED IN FRONT OF (CLOSED) CONSULATE ISFAHAN, PROTESTING U.S. SENATE COMMENTS ON IRANIAN EXECUTIONS. SAME EVENING, FRONT OF CONSULATE PLASTERED WITH POSTERS. THAT EVENING, BOOKSTALLS THOUGHOUT TOWN ATTACKED. END SUMMARY.

ON SATURDAY, MAY 19, FOLLOWING TWO DAYS OF PROTEST MEETINGS IN MOSQUES, TWO DIFFERENT GROUPS MARCHED FROM MOSQUES TO TEMPORARILY CLOSED CONSULATE ISFAHAN BUILDING TO PROTEST "INTERFERENCE IN IRANIAN AFFAIRS BY U.S. AND ZIONISM." PURPOSE OF MARCH WAS ANNOUNCED ON ISFAHAN RADIO AT 3:30 P.M., RESULTING IN ADDITIONAL NUMBERS JOINING DEMO. DEMO, NUMBERING ABOUT 4-500 ACTIVISTS PLUS HANGERS-ON, MADE SPEECHES DENOUNCING REMARKS OF SENATOR JACOB JAVITS ON ISLAMIC COURT EXECUTION OF IRANIAN JEWISH INDUSTRIALIST ELGHANIAN. ACCORDING TO MEMBER OF CONSULATE STAFF, LOOKING ON FROM DISTANCE, THERE WAS SOME AGITATION TO BURN BUILDING, BUT CROWD DISPERSED PEACEFULLY AFTER POSTING "STATEMENT" ON FRONT DOOR.

BUILDING WAS EMPTY AT TIME, AS GUARD FORCE FLED ON SIGHTING MARCHERS. STATEMENT POSTED READ, IN ESSENCE, "THIS IS A RELIGIOUS COUNTRY. WE DON'T WANT ISRAEL. WE SUPPORT ARAFAT. WHY DOES U.S. ALLOW ZIONIST AGENTS (I.E., SENATOR JAVITS) TO INTERFERE IN OUR AFFAIRS?" STATEMENT WAS ROUGHLY HANDWRITTEN IN FARSI.

THAT EVENING, SMALL GROUP RETURNED, TOOK DOWN STATEMENT, AND PLASTERED ENTIRE FRONT WALL WITH PRINTED POSTERS, IN ENGLISH AND FARSI, STATING "DOWN WITH CARTER. DOWN WITH IMPERIALISM AND ZIONISM. WE WANT TO HANG THE SHAH-IN-SHAH. WHY DOES THE U.S. OBJECT?"

BETWEEN 6:30 AND 7:00 THAT EVENING, A BOOKSTORE AND TWO NEWS-STANDS IN CENTER OF CITY WERE ATTACKED, AND HAD ALL OF THEIR STOCK DESTROYED, ALLEGEDLY FOR SELLING "RUSSIAN" NEWSPAPERS--KARGAR (WORKER) AND AHANGAR (STEEL WORKER), BOTH LOCAL PUBLICATIONS. ABOUT ONE HOUR LATER, A BOOKSTORE IN THE CONSERVATIVE SOUTH OF THE CITY WAS ATTACKED AND ALL STOCK DESTROYED, FOR SELLING "RELIGIOUS" NEWSPAPERS.
COMMENT: IT APPEARS THAT STREET VIOLENCE IS NOT TOTALLY DEAD IN ISFAHAN. THESE INCIDENTS COULD PREVIEW REAL CLASHES BETWEEN OPPOSING GROUPS. NAAS
(C - ENTIRE TEXT.)
SUMMARY: SOURCE OUTLINED CLEARLY LOGIC BEHIND IRANIAN BELIEF IN CIA PLOT. HE STATES HIS VIEWS ARE WIDELY HELD. END SUMMARY.

POLOFF SPENT LONG EVENING WITH JAMSHID IRANPOUR, CLOSE CONTACT FROM ISFAHAN. IRANPOUR, IN PRE-REVOLUTIONARY DAYS, MAINTAINED GOOD CONTACTS WITH GOVERNMENT, SAVAK, RELIGIOUS PARTY, REVOLUTIONARIES, AND CONSULATE. A WEALTHY IMPORTEREXPORTER AND CONTRACTOR, WITH BUSINESS INTEREST IN U.S. AND EVENTUAL INTENTION TO EMIGRATE TO U.S., IRANPOUR IS A CLASSIC PERSIAN "FIXER," BASICALLY APOLITICAL, AND USING ALL CONTACTS TO FURTHER HIS OWN ENDS. SHORTLY BEFORE REVOLUTION, HE TRAVELLED TO U.S. AFTER REVOLUTION, HE WAS ACTIVELY SOUGHT BY ISLAMIC COURT IN ISFAHAN AS "CIA AGENT" AND "SAVAKI," BUT MANAGED TO OBTAIN LETTERS FROM AYATOLLAH KHADAMI IN ISFAHAN ATTESTING HIS REVOLUTIONARY CREDENTIALS.

HE HAS NOW RETURNED TO ISFAHAN, HAS MADE GIFTS OF OVER 100,000 TOMAN (APPROXIMATELY $15,000) TO VARIOUS REVOLUTIONARY AND RELIGIOUS FIGURES, AND IS NOW WORKING WITH ISFAHAN CENTRAL COMMITTEE. IRANPOUR WAS NOT SURE WHETHER POLOFF WAS DISSIMULATING OR WAS HOODWINKED BY USG, BUT DECIDED TO EXPLAIN WHY HE, AND "MOST THINKING IRANIANS" WERE CONVINCED THAT ISLAMIC REVOLUTION WAS A CIA PLOT, AND WHY HE WAS HAPPY WITH THAT IDEA.

IRANPOUR NOTED THAT I WAS AWARE THAT ALL SECTORS OF IRANIAN PEOPLE, RICH OR POOR, WERE DEEPLY DISSATISFIED WITH SHAH, AND THAT THERE WAS A GRAVE DANGER THAT "WHEN THE BUBBLE BURST," IRAN WOULD HAVE A LEFTIST OR COMMUNIST GOVERNMENT. HE CONCLUDES, THEREFORE, THAT THE U.S. DETERMINED TO PUT IN A RELIGIOUS GOVERNMENT AS THE BEST DEFENSE AGAINST COMMUNISM.

HE THEN NOTED THAT THE MAJOR REASON FOR THE DISCONTENT WAS THE INCREDIBLY POOR PLANNING AND ECONOMIC DISLOCATIONS IN IRAN, WITH (E.G.) PORT DEVELOPMENT COMMENCING AFTER PORTS WERE SO CONGESTED THAT DEVELOPMENT WAS IMPOSSIBLE, INDUSTRY STARTED IN ISFAHAN BEFORE A HIGHWAY WAS BUILT TO CONNECT ISFAHAN TO EITHER TEHRAN OR THE PORTS, POWER PLANTS COMPLETED YEARS BEFORE TRANSMISSION LINES WERE BUILT, ETC., ETC. SINCE, IRANPOUR STATED, EVERYONE KNOWS THAT THE AREA OF GREATEST U.S. INFLUENCE IN IRAN WAS IN ECONOMIC PLANNING, AND SUCH THINGS DON'T HAPPEN IN THE U.S., HE MUST CONCLUDE THAT THIS WAS DELIBERATE U.S. POLICY. THUS, THE U.S.
CREATED THE "BUBBLE" IN THE FIRST PLACE, TO PAVE THE WAY FOR THE REMOVAL OF THE SHAH.

HE NOTED THAT THERE WERE MANY REASONS WHY THE U.S. WANTED TO GET RID OF THE SHAH. PRINCIPAL AMONG THEM WERE: (A) THE INCREASING ECONOMIC INFLUENCE THE SHAH HAD IN THE U.S. AND EUROPE THROUGH HIS PURCHASES OF MAJOR BLOCS OF COMPANY STOCKS, (B) THE SHAH'S INCREASING THIRDWORLD STATURE AND INDICATIONS OF HIS THINKING OF TAKING A MORE INDEPENDENT POSTURE, (C) FEARS THAT HIS MEGALOMANIA AND WEAPONS POSSESSIONS WOULD LEAD HIM TO START A WAR WHICH COULD INVOLVE THE U.S., (D) THE LONG TERM CONFLICT BETWEEN THE SHAH AND THE DEMOCRATIC PARTY.
IRANPOUR NOTED THAT THE SHAH HAD SPENT VAST SUMS TRYING TO DEFEAT JIMMY CARTER, BUT THAT THIS CONFLICT GOES BACK TO WHEN THE SHAH WAS INVOLVED IN THE KILLING OF THE KENNEDYS.

IN ADDITION, IRANPOUR NOTED THE ECONOMIC BENEFITS ACCRUING TO THE U.S. THE DISRUPTION OF THE REVOLUTION HAS MADE MOST OF THE SHAH'S WEAPON PURCHASES "SO MUCH SCRAP METAL," AS WELL AS DESTROYING A LOT OF INDUSTRIAL EQUIPMENT. SINCE IRAN WOULD HAVE TO COME BACK TO THE U.S. TO REPURCHASE MOST OF THESE THINGS, TO AVOID COMMUNIST DOMINATION, THE U.S. RECREATED A TREMENDOUS MARKET FOR ITSELF, WHILE SIMULTANEOUSLY AVOIDING THE THREAT OF AN IRANIAN USE OF THE WEAPONS IN THE AREA.

HOW WAS IT DONE? IRANPOUR NOTED THAT EVERY ACTION OF THE SHAH AND THE GOI IN ITS LAST SIX MONTHS SEEMED ONLY TO INFLAME THE REVOLUTION, AS IF DELIBERATELY. HE POINTED TO THE VACILLATION BETWEEN BRUTALITY AND RESTRAINT("NEVER ENOUGH FORCE TO COW THEM, NEVER ENOUGH RESTRAINT TO APPEASE THEM"), THE ALWAYS ONE-STEP-TOO-LATE GOVERNMENT CHANGES, WHICH GAVE THE REVOLUTIONARIES A SENSE OF CREEPING VICTORY, ETC. HE IS NOT SURE WHETHER (A) THE U.S. CONSISTENTLY GAVE THE SHAH THE WRONG "INSTRUCTIONS" (MODIFIED TO "SUGGESTIONS" AT THE LOOK ON MY FACE) OR (B) THE SHAH WAS MENTALLY INCOMPETENT FROM A STROKE.

(HE NOTED THAT MANY ASSUME THE SHAH'S ILLNESS WAS CAUSED BY THE CIA.) HE ALSO NOTED THAT AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI WAS ------------------108484 201304Z /46 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1539 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 05206 "A NOBODY" UNTIL HE WAS (MYSTERIOUSLY) SHIFTED TO PARIS, (MYSTERIOUSLY) BECAME WELL FUNDED, AND WAS LIONIZED BY THE U.S. PRESS. HE CONCLUDES THAT, WITHOUT OUTSIDE (I.E., CIA) PRESSURE, THE MANTLE COULD NEVER HAVE FALLEN TO SUCH AN OBSCURE, POLITICALLY IGNORANT FIGURE. THUS, THE U.S., HAVING CREATED THE SETTING FOR REVOLUTION, NEUTRALIZED THE SHAH AND CREATED THE IMAM, AND LET NATURE TAKE ITS COURSE.

THE PROOF OF THE PUDDING? DR. IBRAHIM YAZDI, A U.S. CITIZEN, BECAME FIRST DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER (FOR REVOLUTIONARY AFFAIRS*) AND THENFOREIGN MINISTER, WHILE SADEQ GOTBZADEH, TOTALLY U.S. ORIENTED, IS IN CHARGE OF RADIOTELEVISION, THE "ONLY SOURCE OF INFORMATION FOR MOST IRANIANS" ABOUT THE PROGRESS OF THE REVOLUTION. THE GOVERNMENT IS CAREFUL TO HIDE ITS U.S. ORIGIN, FOR EXAMPLE, BY STAGING AN ATTACK ON THE EMBASSY (NOTE PHOTO OF AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN "GRINNING BETWEEN TWO GUARDS") AND MOUTHING ANTI-US GENERALITIES, BUT IS QUICK TO TAKE ACTION AGAINST ANY REALLY ANTI-US GROUPS (SUCH AS PEYGHAMI-EMRUZ AND AYANDAGAN NEWSPAPERS).
HE SAYS THAT IF USIRANIAN RELATIONS RETURN TO NORMAL WITHIN A YEAR OR SO, HE WILL HAVE FINAL PROOF.

HIS REACTION TO THIS, AND A REACTION HE STATES IS WIDELY HELD, IS VERY POSITIVE. HE FEELS, IF THE U.S. MAKES NO MISTAKES, THIS REVOLUTION WILL BE THE END OF COMMUNISTS IN THIS COUNTRY, AND NOT INCIDENTALLY, GET RID OF THE SHAH AND HIS CORRUPT FAMILY. HIS ONLY PUZZLE IS HOW THIS GOVERNMENT WILL RENEW TIES AND TRADE WITH ISRAEL, OBVIOUSLY A U.S. GOAL--HIS BEST GUESS IS "PROBABLY THROUGH EGYPT."

HE REFUSED TO HEAR ANY ARGUMENTATION, SAYING THAT OBVIOUSLY THIS COULD NEVER BE ADMITTED, BUT HE WANTED TO STATE THAT "THINKING IRANIANS" ARE NOW DEPENDING ON THE U.S. NOT TO MAKE ANY MISTAKES "AND LOSE EVERYTHING THAT HAS BEEN GAINED SO FAR." HE ADDED THAT, FROM MY REACTIONS, I WAS EITHER IGNORANT OR A VERY GOOD ACTOR.

COMMENT: IRANPOUR APPEARED CANDID AND SINCERE, AND HE SAID THAT HE HAD COME TO THESE CONCLUSIONS ONLY AFTER MANY CONVERSATIONS WITH OTHERS, IN AND OUT OF THE COMMITTEE STRUCTURE. IF SO, IT'S "PRAISED IF WE DID, AND PRAISED IF WE DIDN'T." WHILE WE WESTERNERS MAY BE UNWILLING TO ACCEPT THIS LOGIC, EMBOFFS NOTE SOME VARIANT OF THIS STORY IS WIDELY, REPEAT WIDELY, SHARED AMONG IRAN'S

SUMMARY: CHARGE DISCUSSED WITH MINISTER SAHABI U.S.IRAN RELATIONS. MINISTER EXPRESSED HOPE CURRENT MISUNDERSTANDINGS WOULD NOT IMPEDE GOOD TIES WHICH PGOI WANTS. SAHABI TALKED OF NEW GOVERNMENT STRUCTURE AND SHOWED ACTIVE INTEREST IN FEDERAL SYSTEM. BIO NOTE. END SUMMARY.

CHARGE AND ACTING POLCOUNS CALLED ON MINISTER OF STATE FOR REVOLUTIONARY AFFAIRS DR. YADOLLAH SAHABI MORNING MAY 20. SAHABI RECEIVED AMERICANS IN PLEASANT, GRACEFUL OLD-WORLD PERSIAN MANNER AND DISCUSSION WAS FRIENDLY THROUGHOUT. FOLLOWING ARE IMPORTANT POINTS

AFTER CHARGE EXPRESSED U.S. INTEREST IN GOOD TIES WITH NEW PGOI AND ASSURED MINISTER THAT USG WAS NOT RPT NOT INTERFERING IN IRAN AND WOULD NOT DO SO, SAHABI IMMEDIATELY AND IN AN UNDERSTANDING MANNER EXPRESSED REGRETS FOR MEDIA ATTACKS ON USG IN WAKE OF PUBLICITY GIVEN JAVITS RESOLUTION ON IRAN. SAHABI SAID IRAN IS IN REVOLUTIONARY PERIOD AND AFFIRMED TWICE THAT BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT WANTS GOOD RELATIONS WITH U.S. HE NOTED, HOWEVER, THAT THERE ARE MANY QUESTIONS WHICH MUST BE RESOLVED BETWEEN IRAN AND U.S. AND REGRETTED VERY MUCH THAT MISUNDERSTANDINGS UNQUOTE WERE MARRING PUBLIC SCENE.

FONMIN WOULD BE CALLING TO TALK TO CHARGE ABOUT PROBLEM (YAZDI DID CALL; SEE SEPTEL ON LATER MEETING). HE SAID THAT MUCH OF WHAT WAS IN RESOLUTION WAS TRUE; SOME OF WHAT PRESS IN IRAN WAS SAYING IS TRUE. IRAN IS IN A REVOLUTIONARY SITUATION--EVEN QUESTION AS SIMPLE AS THAT OF NEW PASSPORTS IS NOT RESOLVED YET. ROLE OF REVOLUTIONARY COURTS, MASS DEMONSTRATIONS AND VARIOUS MOVEMENTS ARE ALL CHANGING. IRAN'S PROBLEMS WILL BE WORKED OUT, BUT IT WILL TAKE TIME. CHARGE COMMENTED THAT EXECUTIONS AND TRIALS WITHOUT INTERNATIONALLY ACCEPTED STANDARDS CAUSED U.S. AND OTHERS TO THINK MORE BADLY OF THE REVOLUTION THAN THEY WOULD OTHERWISE.

WITH OBVIOUS PAIN IN HIS BROW, SAHABI SAID YOU ARE RIGHT; WE ARE NOT HAPPY WITH THESE EXECUTIONS OURSELVES. BUT WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT? IF THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT DOES NOT STAY IN OFFICE, THERE WILL BE NO HOPE FOR STABILITY. END . (COMMENT: WE THINK HE IS PROBABLY RIGHT.) SAHABI SAID COURTS WERE A SHORT TERM EXPEDIENT WHICH WOULD NOT LAST; PGOI WANTED TO WIND THEM UP AS SOON AS POSSIBLE, BUT IT WOULD TAKE A LITTLE TIME.

CHARGE ASKED ABOUT NEW GOVERNMENTAL STRUCTURE. SAHABI REPLIED THAT DRAFT CONSTITUTION WOULD BE RELEASED WITHIN TWO WEEKS. CONSTITUTIONAL ASSEMBLY WOULD BE CALLED WITHIN 30 TO 60 DAYS. PGOI EXPECTED ASSEMBLY TO LAST A MAXIMUM OF FOUR MONTHS, WITH ELECTIONS FOR PRESIDENT AND THE PARLIAMENT TO FOLLOW TOWARD THE END OF THIS YEAR. WITH RESPECT TO RELATIONSHIP OF REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS TO NEW GOVERNMENTAL STRUCTURE, SAHABI SAID THIS CONFUSES EVEN MEMBERS OF GOVERNMENT. FOR NOW, DR. MUSTAFA CHAMRAN IS THE HEAD OF THE GUARDS, BUT HE IS NOT RPT NOT A DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER. DEPUTY PM BANI-ASSADI HAS NO RPT NO CONNECTION WITH THE REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS.

SAHABI SAID HIS OWN OFFICE, THE BUREAU OF REVOLUTIONARY AFFAIRS, WILL BE IN CHARGE OF REVIEWING ALL LAWS AND HARMONIZING THEM WITH THE NEW GOVERNMENTAL SYSTEM. IN THIS CONNECTION, HE THANKED ACTING POLCOUNS FOR SENDING HIM A COPY OF THE U.S. FEDERAL CONSTITUTION. AFTER DISCUSSION OF FEDERAL SYSTEM, INCLUDING DUAL LINES OF GOVERNMENT AND STATE AND FEDERAL TAX STRUCTURES, SAHABI SAID THAT IF WE HAD ANY MORE MATERIAL ON U.S. FEDERAL STRUCTURE, HE WOULD LIKE TO HAVE IT. PGOI PLANNED TO REMAKE IRAN INTO FEDERATED SYSTEM OF GOVERNMENT TO HELP EASE TRIBAL AND OTHER PROBLEMS OF DECENTRALIZATION. CHARGE SAID USG WOULD BE HAPPY TO PROVIDE ADDITIONAL INFO (SEE SEPTEL).

BIO NOTE: SAHABI IS IN HIS 80'S AND A CLOSE, LONGTIME FRIEND OF PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN. OTHERS WHO HAVE SEEN HIM HAVE NOT BEEN IMPRESSED WITH HIS GRASP OF PROBLEMS AND COHERENCE, BUT DURING THIS MEETING HE EXHIBITED SOPHISTICATED VIEW OF IRAN'S PROBLEMS AND POTENTIAL AND REMAINED ALERT THROUGHOUT. HE HAS NO INDEPENDENT POWER BASE, HOWEVER, AND MUST BE COUNTED AMONG THE PGOI'S SECULARISTS. HIS REACTION TO QUESTIONS ABOUT THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS AND U.S.-IRAN RELATIONS MADE IT CRYSTAL CLEAR HE LACKS SYMPATHY FOR THE KHOMEINI ENTOURAGE.

HE IS OBVIOUSLY CONCERNED ABOUT THE PROBLEM OF INSTITUTIONALIZING THE GOVERNMENTAL STRUCTURE, AND SPOKE FORCEFULLY ON THE NEED TO GET A NEW GOVERNMENTAL STRUCTURE IN PLACE. HE IS ONE OF THE REVOLUTION'S ELDER STATESMEN. NAAS

SUMMARY. FOREIGN MINISTER YAZDI SUMMONED ME TO FONOFF MAY 20 TO LODGE FORMAL PROTEST CONCERNING SENATE RESOLUTION. HE ASKED THAT AMBASSADOR CUTLER DELAY HIS ARRIVAL IN TEHRAN UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE. END SUMMARY.

FOREIGN MINISTER YADZI ASKED ME TO CALL ON HIM MAY 20; POL COUNS TOMSETH ACCOMPANIED ME. THE FONMIN SAID THAT "THE SENATE RESOLUTION CONSTITUTES A DIRECT INTERVENTION IN IRAN'S INTERNAL AFFAIRS" AND FURTHER THAT "IT IS CONTRARY TO THE REASSURANCES EXPRESSED BY SECRETARY VANCE IN HIS LETTER TO ME." YAZDI SAID THAT THE RESOLUTION "DOES NOT SQUARE" WITH THE EXPRESSED DESIRE FOR IMPROVED RELATIONS BETWEEN IRAN AND THE UNITED STATES. AS A CONSEQUENCE, HIS GOVERNMENT HAD INSTRUCTED HIM TO PROTEST THE RESOLUTION.

HE SAID THAT HIS GOVERNMENT DID NOT UNDERSTAND WHY THE SENATE IS CONCERNED ABOUT A "BUNCH OF CRIMINALS AND MASS MURDERERS" AND ALSO "WHY THE SENATE WAS SILENT FOR SO MANY YEARS." YAZDI SAID THAT HE HAD BEEN INSTRUCTED TO SUBMIT A FORMAL NOTE TO THE EMBASSY AND THAT HE EXPECTED TO BE DOING SO THE SAME DAY. THE NOTE WOULD ASK AMBASSADOR CUTLER'S ARRIVAL BE DELAYED UNTIL "FURTHER NOTICE." YAZDI SAID THAT HIS ARRIVAL IN IRAN WOULD NOT BE PROPER "UNDER PRESENT CIRCUMSTANCES."

I REPLIED THAT THE REQUEST FOR DELAY OF AMBASSADOR CUTLER'S ARRIVAL WAS A SERIOUS ACTION AND POINTED OUT THAT THE SENATE WAS ONLY ONE PART OF OUR GOVERNMENT AND DID NOT SPEAK FOR THE EXECUTIVE BRANCH. SECRETARY VANCES' LETTER REFLECTS THE EXECUTIVE BRANCH'S POLICY WITH REGARD TO IRAN. HOWEVER, AS I HAD DISCUSSED WITH HIM A MONTH AGO WHEN HE WAS DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER, THERE IS GREAT CONCERN IN THE UNITED STATES OVER THE MANNER IN WHICH THE REVOLUTIONARY COURT CONDUCTED ITS BUSINESS. WE HAD TAKEN NO POSITION WITH RESPECT TO THE GUILT OR INNOCENCE OF THE INDIVIDUALS, I CONTINUED, BUT WERE DISTURBED BY THE PROCEDURES.

IN THAT RESPECT, I SAID, THE SENATE RESOLUTION REFLECTED WIDESPREAD AMERICAN FEELINGS. IN OUR PREVIOUS DISCUSSION HE HAD SPOKEN TO ME VERY FRANKLY ABOUT THE LAST 25 YEARS OF US-IRAN RELATIONS AND IMPACT THESE YEARS HAD ON THE IRANIAN PUBLIC'S VIEWS OF THE UNITED STATES. THAT WAS THE DOMESTIC REALITY HE HAD TO DEAL WITH, I SAID, AND THE UNITED STATES SIDE ALSO HAD THE DOMESTIC REALITY OF THE CONCERN OVER THE EXECUTIONS. I ADDED THAT THE STATEMENT BY AYATOLLAH KHALKHALI WAS INDEED EXTRAORDINARY.

YAZDI SAID THAT HE UNDERSTOOD THE SEPARATION OF POWERS IN THE UNITED STATES AND THE PROTEST WAS NOT ABOUT U.S. POLICY BUT IS DIRECTED SPECIFICALLY TO THE SENATE ACTION. YAZDI, SPEAKING QUIETLY AND IN AN ESSENTIALLY FRIENDLY WAY, SAID THAT HE AND THE MEMBERS OF THE GOVERNMENT RECOGNIZE MANY OF THE FAULTS OF THE REVOLUTIONARY TRIBUNALS AND WERE ATTEMPTING TO RESOLVE THEM. THE REVOLUTION IS NOT OVER, HE SAID, BUT STILL PROGRESSES. HE THEN TOLD ME THAT AYATOLLAH KHALKHALI NOT ONLY IS NOT THE HEAD OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COURT BUT HE IS NOT EVEN A MEMBER; HIS STATEMENT HAD NO AUTHORITY WHATSOEVER BEHIND IT.

IN A SPEECH AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI HAD INDICATED THAT KHALKHALI HAD NO STATUS AND TOLD MEMBERS OF THE CABINET THAT, IF KHALKHALI WENT NEAR GHASR PRISON AGAIN, HE SHOULD BE ARRESTED AND PUT INSIDE. I SAID THAT I HAD SEEN NO STATEMENT BY THE GOVERNMENT DENYING THE AUTHORITY OF KHALKHALI AND THAT I WAS PLEASED TO HEAR THAT HE DID NOT HAVE ANY RELATIONSHIP WITH THE REVOLUTIONARY COURT. IN ORDER TO CLARIFY, I ASKED HIM WHETHER HIS STATEMENT WAS THE OFFICIAL POSITION OF THE GOVERNMENT AND HE SAID THAT, OFFICIALLY, KHALKHALI'S STATEMENT WAS "WRONG, BASELESS AND FALSE."

IN CLOSING OUR DISCUSSION I AGAIN SAID THAT I REGRETTED THE GOVERNMENT'S ACTION WITH RESPECT TO AMBASSADOR CUTLER AND THAT I WOULD PAAHECIATE FURTHER CLARIFICATION ON WHAT THE GOVERNMENT HAD IN MIND, SINCE AMBASSADOR CUTLER HAD NOT PLANNED TO GET HERE UNTIL MID-JUNE.
SEPTEL REPORTS YAZDI'S COMMENTS ON JEWISH COMMUNITY.

SUMMARY: AFGHAN FUND RAISER NASSRY REPORTED SOME ASSISTANCE FROM IRANIANS, TALK OF "HUMANITARIAN ASSISTANCE." REPORTS 30-35,000 AFGHAN REFUGEES IN IRAN. END SUMMARY.

AMCIT AFGHAN ZIA NASSRY CALLED POLOFF MAY 21 TO REPORT RESULTS OF HIS TALKS WITH IRANIAN AUTHORITIES. HE STATES THAT HE DID TRAVEL TO QOM AND MET WITH AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI. HE SAID THEIR TALK WAS FRIENDLY, BUT NOT TOO PRODUCTIVE. HE WAS ASKING FOR ARMS ASSISTANCE, AND THE AYATOLLAH SPOKE INSTEAD OF "HUMANITARIAN ASSISTANCE." HE SPOKE AGAIN WITH AYATOLLAH KHALKHALI, WHO SAID THAT THIS "COULD BE A BEGINNING." HE DID NOT MEET WITH FONMIN YAZDI, BUT INSTEAD MET WITH MR.TAGHAVI, CHIEF OF THE MFA SECTION DEALING WITH AFGHANISTAN, AND HAS A SECOND MEETING SCHEDULED WITH HIM IN APPROXIMATELY TEN DAYS.

YESTERDAY, IN A PRESS CONFERENCE, AYATOLLAH ROHANI, A MAJOR RELIGIOUS FIGURE AND CLOSE RELATIVE OF KHOMEINI, CALLED ON "THE AFGHAN PEOPLE TO REVOLT AGAINST THEIR GOVERNMENT AS THE IRANIANS DID HERE." HE URGED THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT TO "INTERVENE IN AFGHANISTAN " TO ASSIST MUSLIMS. SUCH STATEMENTS BY UNOFFICIAL, SECONDLEVEL FIGURES, CARRY LITTLE WEIGHT UNTIL THEY ARE CONFIRMED EITHER BY KHOMEINI OR BY THE GOVERNMENT.

NASSRY STATES THAT THE PGOI DID ASSIST HIM IN CONTACTING AFGHAN REFUGEES IN IRAN. RAVELLED TO MASHAD, WHERE THE AFGHANS HAVE A SMALL OFFICE, AND WAS ESCORTED TO THE REFUGEE CAMPS. HE STATES THERE ARE APPROXIMATELY 30-35,000 AFGHANS LOCATED IN AN AREA STRETCHING TWENTY MILES ALONG THE BORDER FROM THE TOWN OF "TYBAD," SOUTH OF MASHAD. MOST ARE SHEPHERD FAMILIES, WITH THEIR FLOCKS, AND BECAUSE OF LACK OF FODDER, MANY HAVE ALREADY RETURNED TO AFGHANISTAN. INCLUDED IN THE NUMBER, HOWEVER, ARE OVER ONE HUNDRED AFGHAN MILITARY OFFICERS--GROUND FORCES, ARTILLERY, AND AIR FORCE.

THESE ARE ATTEMPTING TO TRAIN A GUERRILLA FORCE (MOST MALE REFUGEES HAVE PERSONALLYOWNED RIFLES) AND, NASSRY SAYS, ARE CONDUCTING SOME OPERATIONS INSIDE AFGHANISTAN. NASSRY HOPES THAT THE IRANIANS WILL AT LEAST TAKE THE BURDEN OF THE ACTUAL REFUGEES OFF THE HANDS OF THE OFFICERS, FREEING THEM FOR MORE TRAINING AND OPERATIONS.
NASSRY INTENDS TO TRAVEL TOMORROW TO PAKISTAN, AND WILL PLAN TO RETURN TO IRAN AFTER APPROXIMATELY ONE WEEK
(C) ENTIRE TEXT.

ON MAY 19, 1979, AT APPROX 0030 HOURS AND AGAIN AT APPROX 0230 HOURS, THE MUJEHEDDIN GUARD POSTS LOCATED ON THE COMPOUND AT THE CO-OP AND THE ROOSEVELT GATE CAME UNDER "HIT AND RUN" ATTACKS FROM PASSING AUTOS. IN EACH CASE, THE MUJEHEDDIN GUARDS RETURNED FIRE AND BRIEF "FIRE FIGHTS" ENSUED. THERE WAS NO PERSONAL OR PROPERTY DAMAGE. AS IN PREVIOUS ATTACKS OF LATE, IT IS ASSUMED THAT THE MUJEHEDDIN GUARD FORCE WAS THE TARGET, NOT THE EMBASSY.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT; THIS IS A REPORTING CABLE.)

SUMMARY: TWO MAJOR DEMONSTRATIONS AGAINST SENATE IN ISFAHAN. STREET CLASHES REPORTED. ARMS REPORTED STOCKPILED ON UNIVERSITY CAMPUS. LOW-LEVEL THREATS AGAINST CONSULATE. AYATOLLAH KHADAMI URGES CAUTION. NUMEROUS ARRESTS. END SUMMARY.

TWO MAJOR DEMONSTRATIONS, EACH WITH "THOUSANDS" OF PARTICIPANTS,OCCURRED THE EVENING OF MAY 20 ON THE TWO UNIVERSITY CAMPUSES IN ISFAHAN. SPEAKERS AT EACH SPOKE OF THE "TREACHERY" OF THE UNITED STATES. AT THE LARGER DEMONSTRATION, WITNESSES DIFFERED ABOUT NUMBERS--FROM"OVER A THOUSAND" TO "MORE THAN SEVEN THOUSAND," BUT AGREED THAT THE SPEAKERS MADE VIRULENT ATTACKS ON THE U.S., ESPECIALLY THE SENATE. THIS DEMONSTRATION, AT ISFAHAN UNIVERSITY, LASTED FROM 3:00 P.M. TO 7:00 P.M. THE SMALLER DEMONSTRATION, AT "SENATE SHARIF" (FORMERLY ARYA MEHR) UNIVERSITY, HAD SOME 1,500 PARTICIPANTS. EFFIGIES OF THE SHAH, CARTER, AND SENATOR JAVITS WERE BURNED, PLUS ANOTHER UNIDENTIFIED EFFIGY. PLEDGE WAS REPORTED CIRCULATED FOR SIGNATURES TO "BAR U.S.
EXPLOITERS FROM AGAIN PLUNDERING IRAN."

THERE ARE PERSISTENT RUMORS OF, BUT NO WITNESSES TO, STREET CLASHES BETWEEN "LEFTISTS" AND "MOSLEM STUDENTS," RESULTING IN CASUALTIES. HOWEVER, BOTH "MOSLEM STUDENT ORGANIZATION" AND THREE SEPARATE "LEFTIST" GROUPS COSPONSORED ISFAHAN U. DEMONSTRATION. FURTHER RUMORS, BELIEVED TO BE TRUE BY UNIVERSITY FACULTY CONTACT, STATE THAT THE LEFTIST STUDENTS ARE STOCKPILING ARMS ON THE TWO CAMPUSES, AND SWEAR THEY WILL NOT BE DISARMED BY THE REVOLUTIONARY GUARDIANS CORPS. SO FAR, NO SIGN OF THIS REVOLUTIONARY GUARDIANS CORPS HAS APPEARED IN ISFAHAN.

THE GOVERNOR-GENERAL IS REPORTED AS ASKING DURING GOVERNORGENERALS' CONFERENCE IN TEHRAN THAT THE POLICE BE ISSUED WEAPONS, BUT POLICE CONTACTS IN ISFAHAN TOLD CONSULATE EMPLOYEE THAT THEY WOULD NOT ACCEPT WEAPONS "UNTIL THEIR SECURITY COULD BE GUARANTEED."

FORMER CONSUL IN ISFAHAN, WHO HAD SCHEDULED TRIP TO CITY TO COMMENCE MAY 23, WAS CONTACTED BY SENIOR RELIGIOUS FIGURE IN CITY, AYATOLLAH KHADAMI, WHO REQUESTED TRIP BE POSTPONED BECAUSE OF KHOMEINI'S "BAN ON RELATIONS WITH THE U.S." UNDER THE CIRCUMSTANCES, KHADAMI SAID, "IT WOULD BE EMBARRASSING TO HAVE YOU IN MY HOME."

AFTER TWO POSTERS PASTED TO FRONT OF CONSULATE BLEW DOWN, CONSULATE EMPLOYEES WERE WARNED THAT ANY ATTEMPT TO REMOVE POSTERS WOULD BE DANGEROUS. SHIPPING COMPANY, CONTRACTED TO PACK AND SHIP CONSUL'S HHE, CALLED TO SAY THEY COULD NOT SEND TRUCK TO RESIDENCE, BECAUSE "COMPANY HAD BEEN WARNED."

IT WAS ALSO LEARNED THAT SOME 45 FORMER OFFICIALS IN ISFAHAN, INCLUDING THE THREE DEPUTIES OF THE EXECUTED CHIEF OF POLICE, HAD BEEN ARRESTED, AND THAT A LARGE NUMBER OF OTHERS WERE BEING SOUGHT. SUPPOSEDLY, MASS TRIALS ARE SCHEDULED FOR THIS WEEK. THERE HAD ALSO BEEN A RIOT LAST WEEK AT ISFAHAN PRISON, RESULTING IN SOME DEATHS. ISLAMIC GUARDS ARE NOW GUARDING THE PRISON AND ALL COURTS, SO SECURITY FORCES ARE THIN ON THE STREET.

1979TEHRAN05275.subject: TEXT OF LETTER TO SECRETARY VANCE FROM FOREIGN MINISTER YAZDI

segments.text: MINISTER YAZDI (C - ENTIRE TEXT; REPORTING CABLE)

FOLLOWING IS TEXT OF LETTER TO SECRETARY VANCE FROM FOREIGN MINISTER YAZDI IN RESPONSE TO THE SECRETARY'S MESSAGE OF MAY 13: "IN THE NAME OF THE ALMIGHTY OFFICE OF THE MINISTER OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS, MAY 20, 1979 "HONORABLE MR.

SECRETARY OF STATE: "YOUR EXCELLENCY'S LETTER DATED MAY 13, 1979, WAS RECEIVED WITH PLEASURE. "I APPRECIATE THE CONGRATULATIONS AND GOOD WISHES THAT YOU HAVE EXPRESSED ON THE OCCASION OF MY APPOINTMENT AS MINISTER OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS OF THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN, AND WISH TO ASSURE YOUR EXCELLENCY MUTUALLY THAT THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN IS ALSO READY TO COOPERATE IN THE JOINT ISSUES AND MATTERS OF COMMON INTEREST TO THE TWO COUNTRIES. "THANK YOU FOR INFORMING ME OF THE APPOINTMENT OF MR.

CUTLER AS THE AMBASSADOR OF THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA TO IRAN, AND I HOPE THAT AS SOON AS THE ATMOSPHERE OF DIPLOMATIC RELATIONS BETWEEN THE TWO COUNTRIES BECOMES FAVORABLE HE CAN PROCEED TO IRAN AND COMMENCE HIS DUTIES. "I WELCOME YOUR VIEWS ON THE NECESSITY OF FULL AND FRANK EXCHANGE OF VIEWS, WHETHER DIRECTLY OR THROUGH REPRESENTATIVES OF THE TWO COUNTRIES, AND IN PURSUIT OF THAT IDEA MAY I SET FORTH THE FOLLOWING POINT AND INVITE YOUR SPECIAL ATTENTION TO IT: "MR. SECRETARY OF STATE, "YOU STATE IN YOUR LETTER THAT YOUR GOVERNMENT HAS NO INTENTION TO INTERVENE IN ANY WAY IN IRAN'S INTERNAL AFFAIRS. I APPRECIATE THIS EXPLICITNESS.

HOWEVER, I HAVE TO STATE THAT IN THE VIEW OF THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN THE RESOLUTION DATED MAY 17, 1979 OF YOUR COUNTRY'S SENATE CONCERNING THE PENALIZATION OF THE FORMER REGIME'S CRIMINALS DOES NOT AT ALL COMPLY WITH THE ABOVE PRINCIPLE, BUT IS A CLEAR INSTANCE OF INTERVENTION IN OUR COUNTRY'S INTERNAL AFFAIRS AND, THEREBY COMPELLED, THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT STRONGLY PROTESTS AGAINST THAT LINE OF ACTION AND RESOLUTION OF THE UNITED STATES SENATE. "IT IS A SOURCE OF SURPRISE FOR THE IRANIAN PEOPLE WHO WONDER HOW IT WAS THAT WHEN THE PAST REGIME WAS RUTHLESSLY FELLING DOWN OUR YOUNG PEOPLE THE UNITED STATES SENATE REMAINED SILENT AND DID NOT SEEM TO FEEL THAT HUMAN RIGHTS WERE BEING VIOLATED IN IRAN, WHEREAS NOW THAT THE REVOLUTION HAS TRIUMPHED AND THE CRIMINALS--REGARDLESS OF THEIR RELIGIOUS AFFILIATIONS--ARE METED THE PENALTY OF THEIR DEEDS, IT HAS RAISED THE CRY OF HUMAN RIGHTS VIOLATION IN IRAN AND SUPPORTS THOSE WHO HAVE COMMITTED THE MOST SHAMEFUL CRIMES FOR MORE THAN HALF A CENTURY. "I AM CONFIDENT THAT YOUR EXCELLENCY IS QUITE FAMILIAR WITH THE FACT THAT ONE OF THE PRINCIPAL AND CONTINUOUS OBJECTIVES OF THE IRANIAN PEOPLE'S REVOLUTION IS TO BRING TO END ANY SORT OF INTERVENTION BY FOREIGNERS IN THE INTERNAL AFFAIRS OF THEIR COUNTRY.

UNDER THESE CONDITIONS I MUST STATE WITH CONCERN THAT NOT ONLY DOES THE ACTION TAKEN BY YOUR COUNTRY'S SENATE NOT HELP TO CREATE MUTUAL UNDERSTANDING AND A BASIS FOR FRUITFUL COOPERATION AS CITED IN YOUR LETTER, BUT IT COMPELS THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT, UNDER STRONG PRESSURE FROM THE NATION'S PUBLIC OPINION, TO MAKE REVISIONS IN ITS TIES WITH THE UNITED STATES GOVERNMENT IN THE DIRECTION OF LIMITING THEM. "I ASSURE YOUR EXCELLENCY THAT MY GOVERNMENT IS ALSO DESIROUS OF ESTABLISHING CLOSE TIES OF FRIENDSHIP AND COOPERATION WITH THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA ON THE BASIS OF PRESERVING THE COUNTRY'S INDEPENDENCE AND NATIONAL INTERESTS AND BASED ON MUTUAL RESPECT.
BUT THESE RELATIONS, AS ALSO POINTED OUT BY YOUR EXCELLENCY, MUST BE BASED ON A NEW FOUNDATION.

IN THE VIEW OF MY GOVERNMENT THIS FOUNDATION IS CONSIDERATION AND RESPECT FOR THE FEELINGS AND ASPIRATIONS OF THE IRANIAN PEOPLE AND ACCEPTANCE OF THE REALITIES DERIVED FROM THEIR HEROIC REVOLUTION. ------------------128096 220816Z /12 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1581 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 05275 "I ASSURE YOU THAT IN THE EVENT THE NEW RELATIONS BETWEEN OUR TWO COUNTRIES ARE FOUNDED ON THE ABOVE BASES, THEY WILL CONSTITUTE A FAVORABLE GROUND FOR THE KINDS OF COOPERATION MENTIONED IN YOUR EXCELLENCY'S LETTER. "I MUTUALLY WISH FOR AN OPPORTUNITY TO MEET YOU IN THE FUTURE. "WITH REGARDS, /S/ EBRAHIM YAZDI" NAAS

AS PER REFTEL (A) BE ADVISED THAT AS OF 1100 MAY 22 LOCAL TIME NO DEMONSTRATION OCCURRED HERE. ON FRIDAY, MAY 25, THERE IS TO BE A DEMONSTRATION IN SOUTH TEHRAN (ABOUT 8 MILES FROM THE CHANCERY). THE PURPOSE IS TO PROTEST THE U.S. SENATE RESOLUTION CONDEMNING EXECUTIONS IN IRAN. WHETHER THAT DEMONSTRATION OR ANOTHER DEMONSTRATION WILL COME TO THE CHANCERY IS UNKNOWN. ANTIAMERICAN SENTIMENT IS VERY HIGH HERE AT PRESENT.

ANTI-TERRORIST CONSTRUCTION AT THE CHANCERY WILL BE COMPLETED PRIOR TO MAY 25. OUTER STEEL DOORS ARE IN PLACE AND INNER BLAST DOORS ARE TO BE INSTALLED WITHIN TWO DAYS. BALLISTIC WINDOW BOXES ARE ALSO BEING INSTALLED THIS WEEK. ALL WINDOWS ON ALL FLOORS HAVE BEEN GRILLED.

CONSULTATION WITH FBO TEAM COMPLETED YESTERDAY ON NEW (TEMPORARY) CONSULAR SECTION IN CARAVANSARAI RESTAURANT. A/SY'S INTERESTS WERE FULLY MET. NEW INTERNAL DEFENSE PLANS (ANNEX K) TO E&E PLAN HAVE BEEN DRAFTED AND AFTER APPROVAL BY DCM ON MAY 22 OR MAY 23 WILL BE RELEASED TO AMERICAN STAFF. CHARGE WILL HOLD A MEETING WITH THE RSO TO DISCUSS OUR "MODUS OPERANDI" IN THE EVENT OF AN ATTACK A LA 2/14 OR A LARGE SCALE MOB ATTACK ON THE EMBASSY WHICH COULD OCCUR ON FRIDAY 5/25.

HE IS OBVIOUSLY IMPRESSED WITH THE NEW PHYSICAL SECURITY IMPROVEMENTS AND ALSO WILL PRESS THE GOI FOR PRIOR AND CONTINUING ARMED INTERVENTION TO PREVENT A REPEAT OF 2/14. HE WILL MEET WITH MFA OFFICIALS PRIOR TO 5/25 TO WORK OUT DETAILS WITH THEM. WE HAVE 900 TEAR GAS GRENADES AND AMPLE SHOTGUN AMMUNITION.

RSO JUDGES PERSONNEL IN THE CHANCERY WOULD BE SECURE FROM SMALL ARMS BUT NOT EXPLOSIVE CHARGES OR WIDE-SCALE USE OF INCENDIARY DEVICES. WE HAVE TRIPLED UP ON FIRE FIGHTING EQUIPMENT AND WILL HAVE ESCAPE WINDOWS AT KEY POINTS ON FIRST AND SECOND FLOORS AS WELL AS ROLL-UP LADDERS IN PLACE THIS WEEK. THE CHANCERY IS BEING CALLED "FORT APACHE" BY AMERICANS HERE.

ONE OMINOUS NOTE IS THAT THE GOI DID NOT REINFORCE OUR MUJEHEDDIN GUARD FORCE YESTERDAY AS THEY SAID THEY WOULD. THEIR LACK OF RESPONSE COULD BE THAT THEY BECAME AWARE AFTER THEY PROMISED SUPPORT THAT NO DEMONSTRATION WOULD ACTUALLY TAKE PLACE (OPTIMISTIC VIEW), OR THAT AN ADMINISTRATIVE FOUL-UP OCCURRED, OR THAT THEY COULD NOT OR WOULD NOT REINFORCE MUJEHEDDIN FORCES HERE (PESSIMISTIC VIEW).
WITHIN A FEW DAYS AND PRIOR TO 5/25 EVERYTHING EXCEPT T-GUARD SYSTEMS (TO BE INSTALLED BY RTC ATHENS IN 6/79) WILL BE AT THE READY.

ROWGHANI LEFT TEHRAN THIS MORNING FOR A FOUR TO SIX WEEK TRIP TO THE U.S. POLOFF GAVE HIM PRECHT'S NAME AND PHONE NUMBER AND STRONGLY SUGGESTED ROWGHANI GET IN TOUCH WITH PRECHT. ROWGHANI HAD ASKED POLOFFS IF THERE WAS ANY ONE HE SHOULD CALL ON.

ROWGHANI WILL BE WILLING TO TALK WITH PRECHT AND MAY BE WILLING TO HAVE PRIVATE DISCUSSIONS WITH OTHERS. BECAUSE OF HIS FAMILY RELATIONSHIP WITH KHOMEINI, HE IS AN INTERESTING SOURCE OF INFORMATION ON KHOMEINI ENTOURAGE.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT; REPORTING CABLE)

SOURCE CLOSE TO AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI WHO HAS BEEN CRITICAL OF SOME OF THOSE AROUND KHOMEINI IN PAST OBSERVED THAT BASIC GROUP OF 100 AROUND AYATOLLAH IN QOM ARE NOBODIES WHO HAVE EXTREMELY RADICAL AND CRAZY IDEAS. WHEN POLOFFS NOTED TENTATIVELY THAT THEY HAD HEARD THAT RADICALS DOMINATED KHOMEINI ENTOURAGE SOURCE LAUGHED WRYLY AND SAID "AS BAD AS YOU THINK IT IS, IT'S EVEN WORSE."
