THE AYATOLLAH REMEMBERED THIS, AND PUT HIM INTO KEY JOB DESPITE FACT THAT HE IS EXTREMELY DISORGANIZED INDIVIDUAL. SOURCE SAID HE HAD SPENT EIGHT HOURS WITH HIM ONE DAY AND SEEN MANY PROJECTS STARTED AND NONE FINISHED. DEPUTY REVOLUTIONARY PROSECUTORS (ONE IS NAMED PORVAND AND WAS INSURANCE BROKER IN PREVIOUS LIFE) DO ALL THE WORK AND ARE ONLY INDIVIDUALS WHO CAN BE RELIED ON TO MOVE CASES ALONG. NAAS

1979TEHRAN05420.subject: STATUS OF THE CONSTITUTION, U.S. TIES DISCUSSED

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT.)
MEDIA ANNOUNCED MAY 24 THAT PRIME MINISTER AND AYATOLLAH TALEQANI MET WITH KHOMEINI IN QOM MAY 22 AND DISCUSSED NEW CONSTITUTION. CONSTITUTION WOULD BE PRODUCED IN TWO STAGES.

SOURCE CLOSE TO KHOMEINI TOLD POLOFFS MAY 23 THAT MEETING WAS MUCH LARGER THAN PUBLICLY ADMITTED AND MOST KEY CABINET MINISTERS WERE THERE, ALONG WITH REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL. SOME KNOCK-DOWN, DRAG-OUT INFIGHTING OCCURRED, AND DRAFT CONSTITUTION WAS DISCUSSED AND PUSHED WELL ALONG WAY TO SEEING PUBLIC LIGHT. ACCORDING TO SOURCE, NEW CONSTITUTION WILL BE A REAL AMALGAM OF "LIBERAL DEMOCRATIC" DRAFT BY MINATCHI AND NATIONAL FRONTERS, AND "ISLAMIC" DOCUMENT PRODUCED BY COUNCIL OF RELIGIOUS LEADERS. SOURCE PROFESSED NOT TO KNOW CONTENTS, JUST THAT IT WAS A MIXED BAG (WE THINK HE KNOWS, BUT WON'T TALK). HE VENTURED PERSONAL OPINION THAT IT WOULD NOT MAKE MANY PEOPLE COMPLETELY HAPPY.

IT WOULD BE RELEASED WITHIN TWO WEEKS FOR PUBLIC CRITICISM (PRESUMABLY THE "FIRST STAGE" OF THE PGOI'S TWO-STAGE PROCESS), THEN TAKEN BEFORE CONSTITUTIONAL ASSEMBLY. COMMENT: THIS MORE OR LESS SQUARES WITH WHAT MINISTER OF STATE SAHABI TOLD CHARGE MAY 20 (REFTEL).

SOURCE ALSO SAID MAY 22 MEETING DISCUSSED U.S.-IRAN TIES EXTENSIVELY, BUT CAME TO NO FIRM CONCLUSIONS. FROM CHANCE COMMENT BY DEFENSE MINISTRY OFFICIAL, WE CONCLUDE THAT PART OF THIS DISCUSSION PROBABLY CONCERNED QUESTION OF CONTINUING MILITARY TIES WITH U.S. DEFENSE OFFICIAL TOLD VISITING U.S. COLONEL THAT DEFMINISTRY WAS ENGAGED IN MAJOR FIGHT WITH YAZDI ON THIS QUESTION. DEFMINISTRY FAVORS CONTINUING U.S. TIE, SO PRESUMABLY YAZDI OPPOSES
(C - ENTIRE TEXT; REPORTING MESSAGE)

SUMMARY: PHYSICS PROFESSOR AT SHIRAZ (FORMERLY PAHLAVI) UNIVERSITY IN SHIRAZ TOLD POL COUNSELOR MAY 23 THAT FOLLOWING A BRIEF PERIOD OF EUPHORIA THE AFTERMATH OF THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION HAS BEEN ACCOMPANIED BY GROWING DISENCHANTMENT AMONG HIS COLLEAGUES. END SUMMARY.

SHORTLY AFTER THE COLLAPSE OF THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT CERTAIN UNIDENTIFIED FACULTY MEMBERS PRODUCED A LIST OF TEN SENIOR SHIRAZ UNIVERSITY OFFICIALS ALONG WITH A DEMAND THAT THEY BE FIRED. SINCE MOST OF THESE INDIVIDUALS WERE ROUNDLY HATED BY MOST UNIVERSITY STAFF MEMBERS, THEIR DEPARTURE WAS GREETED AS A MAJOR VICTORY OF THE REVOLUTION.

THEREAFTER, HOWEVER, DEVELOPMENTS BEGAN TO TURN SOUR. ANOTHER LIST OF 30 FACULTY MEMBERS SOON APPEARED, BUT THIS TIME IT INCLUDED MANY INDIVIDUALS WHO REGARDED THEMSELVES AS IN THE VANGUARD OF THE UNIVERSITY'S PROGRESSIVE FORCES. STUDENTS HAVE PUSHED A VARIETY OF DEMANDS THAT MANY PROFESSORS FIND CONTRARY TO ACADEMIC FREEDOM. FOR EXAMPLE, IN THE PHYSICS DEPARTMENT STUDENTS HAVE INSISTED THAT THE STANDARD CURRICULUM BE DROPPED AND THAT ONLY "ISLAMIC" PHYSICS BE TAUGHT. NON-TEACHING STAFF MEMBERS, CLAIMING THAT THE TEACHING STAFF AVERAGES ONLY TEN CLASS HOURS PER WEEK, HAVE REFUSED TO WORK MORE THAN THAT.

EVEN WHEN THEY ARE SUPPOSEDLY ON THE JOB, THEY SELDOM DO MORE THAN DRINK TEA OR DISCUSS THE IMAN'S WORKS. FURTHER, THEY HAVE DEMANDED PREREQUISITES EQUIVALENT TO THE PERIODIC SABBATICAL LEAVE GRANTED FACULTY MEMBERS. FINALLY, THE MAN CHOSEN AS ACTING CHANCELLOR HAS TURNED OUT TO BE EVERY BIT AS UNSATISFACTORY AN ADMINISTRATOR AS ANY OF HIS PREDECESSORS. .
AS A CONSEQUENCE OF THESE DEVELOPMENTS, MORE AND MORE OF THE UNIVERSITY'S FACULTY MEMBERS ARE BEGINNING TO WONDER WHERE THE REVOLUTION WENT WRONG. NAAS

1979TEHRAN05434.subject: PGOI REQUESTS WITHDRAWAL OF AMBASSADOR CUTLER'S ASSIGNMENT

segments.text: ASSIGNMENT (S - ENTIRE TEXT.)

SUMMARY: DEPUTY PRIMIN ENTEZAM REQUESTS WITHDRAWAL OF NOMINATION OF AMBASSADOR CUTLER. HE PLEADED THAT THIS BE HANDLED IN AS INFORMAL AND UNDERSTANDING A MANNER AS POSSIBLE SO AS NOT TO CREATE FRICTION BETWEEN OUR TWO COUNTRIES. END SUMMARY.

I CALLED ON DEPUTY PRIMIN AMIR ENTEZAM AT HIS REQUEST MAY 24; POLCOUNS TOMSETH ACCOMPANIED ME. AFTER BRIEF CHAT ON INCONSEQUENTIAL MATTERS, I ASKED ENTEZAM TO CLARIFY FOR ME WHAT THE PGOI HAD IN MIND WITH RESPECT TO ITS REQUEST THAT AMBASSADOR CUTLER'S ARRIVAL BE DELAYED. ENTEZAM SAID THAT THIS WAS ONE OF THE SUBJECTS HE WISHED TO DISCUSS WITH ME IN A VERY INFORMAL WAY. HE THEN STATED THAT REQUEST FOR AGREMENT FOR AMBASSADOR CUTLER HAD BEEN APPROVED ONLY BY SALAMATIAN, THE FORMER ACTING DEPUTY FOREIGN MINISTER, AND HAD NOT BEEN REFERRED TO THE FOREIGN MINISTER NOR THE PRIME MINISTER.

THE FIRST THE CABINET MEMBERS KNEW OF THE APPOINTMENT OF AMBASSADOR CUTLER TO IRAN WAS WHEN THEY READ IT IN THE NEWSPAPERS. AMBASSADOR CUTLER'S PREVIOUS ASSIGNMENTS TO ZAIRE AND, FURTHER BACK, TO VIETNAM, CREATED PROBLEMS FOR THE GOVERNMENT. HE SAID THE U.S. SHOULD ASSIGN AN AMBASSADOR HERE WHO HAS NOT HAD "CONTROVERSIAL" ASSIGNMENTS, SUCH AS THE NORDIC COUNTRIES OR JAPAN. HE AGAIN PLEADED WITH ME FOR UNDERSTANDING AND ASKED THAT THE ARRANGEMENTS IN WASHINGTON FOR SENDING A NEW AMBASSADOR HERE BE ACCOMPLISHED IN SUCH A MANNER SO AS NOT TO CREATE FURTHER FRICTION.

ENTEZAM SAID, "WE WANT TO HAVE GOOD RELATIONS WITH YOU AND ALTHOUGH WE HAVE THE RIGHT TO REJECT A NOMINATION, WE DON'T WANT TO INSULT YOU AND WE DON'T WANT A REJECTION OF AMBASSADOR CUTLER TO PROVOKE A REACTION." THE FAULT IN THIS LIES WITH US, HE SAID, BECAUSE OF OUR DISORGANIZATION.

HE FURTHER ELABORATED BY SAYING THE PGOI IS IN A VERY DIFFICULT POSITION IN ITS RELATIONSHIP TO KHOMEINI AND OTHERS. HE INTIMATED THAT THE PREVIOUS REQUEST "FOR DELAY" WAS IN RESPONSE TO KHOMEINI'S VIOLENT REACTION TO THE SENATE RESOLUTION. "WE ARE TRYING TO MODIFY THIS REACTION AND GIVE IT DIRECTION." THE GOVERNMENT MUST AVOID ANY APPEARANCE THAT IT IS ACCEPTING AN AMBASSADOR WHO HAS HAD THE KIND OF EXPERIENCE AMBASSADOR CUTLER HAS HAD IN THE LAST THREE YEARS.

(COMMENT: ALTHOUGH HE DID NOT SPELL THIS OUT IN ANY FASHION, HE CLEARLY HAS IN MIND NOT HAVING SOMEONE HERE WHO HAS BEEN ASSOCIATED RECENTLY WITH WHAT THE IRANIANS WOULD CONSIDER A "CLIENT STATE." AS YOU KNOW, MUCH OF THE ATTACK ON THE SHAH HAS TO DO WITH CHARGES THAT HE WAS A TOOL OF THE U.S. END COMMENT.)

I TOLD HIM THAT I RECOGNIZED THAT EVERY STATE HAD THE RIGHT UNDER INTERNATIONAL PRACTICE TO REFUSE AN AGREMENT, BUT THAT IN FACT SUCH ACTIONS WERE VERY RARE. I STATED THAT I KNEW AMBASSADOR CUTLER WELL AND THAT HE HAD COMPLETE CONFIDENCE OF THE ADMINISTRATION TO CARRY OUT THE NEW BEGINNING WITH THE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN AND ASKED WHETHER THE PGOI MIGHT NOT WISH TO RECONSIDER ITS ACTION. I SAID THAT I WAS CONCERNED THAT THE PGOI'S ACTION WOULD BE MISUNDERSTOOD AND RESULT IN THE KIND OF REACTION IN THE U.S. THAT I THOUGHT BOTH GOVERNMENTS WOULD WISH TO AVOID.

I COMMENTED THAT IT WOULD BE DIFFICULT TO FIND A COMPETENT SENIOR OFFICER WHO HAD NOT HAD AT LEAST ONE "CONTROVERSIAL" ASSIGNMENT IN HIS PAST AND THAT DIPLOMATS WENT WHERE THEIR GOVERNMENTS ASSIGNED THEM.

ENTEZAM THEN ESSENTIALLY REPEATED AT LEAST TWICE MORE WHAT HE HAD SAID AT THE BEGINNING OF OUR DISCUSSION: ONLY SALAMATIAN KNEW ABOUT THE AGREMENT, PGOI CANNOT, BECAUSE OF ITS CURRENT WEAKNESS, BE ASSOCIATED WITH AN AMERICAN AMBASSADOR WITH MR. CUTLER'S BACKGROUND, AND A PLEA AGAIN THAT THE WHOLE MATTER BE HANDLED WITH GREAT DELICACY AND UNDERSTANDING. "WE NEED YOUR HELP ON THIS MATTER." NAAS
(C - ENTIRE TEXT; REPORTING CABLE)

EMBASSY GUARD HAS BEEN HEAVILY REINFORCED BY REVOLUTIONARY GUARDE (SEPAH-E-PAZDARAN-E-INGHIBAB) WHO HAVE APPARENTLY BEEN SENT BY A REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE. ALSO A GROUP OF REGULAR POLICE ARE NOW CURRENTLY STATIONED IN FRONT OF THE EMBASSY. OUR GUARDS ARE NOT ANTICIPATING SERIOUS TROUBLE THIS AFTERNOON BUT ARE STILL CONCERNED ABOUT POTENTIAL CLASHES TOMORROW. THEY HAVE ASSERTED THAT BY TOMORROW WE WILL HAVE FURTHER REINFORCEMENTS. WE, OF COURSE, HAVE NO IDEA HOW EFFECTIVE THIS FORCE WOULD BE IN AN EMERGENCY.

RE REFTEL, I ALREADY HAD HAD A MEETING SCHEDULED WITH DEPUTY PRIMIN AMIR ENTEZAM FOR TODAY. I DELIVERED A LETTER TO HIM FOR THE PRIME MINISTER WHICH DREW UPON YOUR MESSAGE (TEXT BELOW). ENTEZAM ASSURED ME THAT GOVERNMENT WOULD DO EVERYTHING POSSIBLE TO PROTECT AMERICAN LIVES AND PROPERTY. AFTER CONSIDERABLE DISCUSSION ON WHAT THE GOVERNMENT COULD DO IN LIGHT OF THE PRESENCE OF ISLAMIC GUARDS ON THE COMPOUND, HE AGREED TO SEND A MILITARY FORCE OF 100 PEOPLE TO BE STATIONED NEARBY THE EMBASSY TO PROVIDE ASSISTANCE SHOULD THAT BE NECESSARY.

IS SUGGESTED SUCH A FORCE COULD ALSO BE USED TO SET UP A ROADBLOCK A FEW BLOCKS FROM THE EMBASSY TO PREVENT DEMONSTRATORS APPROACHING OUR GROUNDS. HE SAID HE UNDERSTOOD THE CONCEPT BUT HE MADE NO COMMITMENT IN THIS REGARD.
DEMONSTRATIONS CONTINUE TO BE OF PRIME MEDIA INTEREST AND TV CAMERAS ARE SET UP ON TAKHTE JAMSHID TO FILM THE EVENT. IT IS NOW 1530 LOCAL AND WILL BE IN TOUCH WITH YOU LATER.

TEXT OF LETTER TO PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN: "DEAR MR. PRIME MINISTER: "AS YOU KNOW, A SERIES OF LARGE DEMONSTRATIONS TO PROTEST THE RECENT RESOLUTION BY THE UNITED STATES SENATE ARE PLANNED FOR THIS AFTERNOON AND TOMORROW. I AM DEEPLY DISTURBED THAT AT NO TIME SINCE THE PREPARATIONS OF THE DEMONSTRATIONS WERE ANNOUNCED HAVE I SEEN ANY ACTION OR APPEAL BY THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN TO ENSURE THAT THE PUBLIC ACTIONS WILL BE PEACEFUL. I URGE THAT THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN TAKE WHATEVER STEPS ARE NECESSARY TO CALL FOR CALM AND A PEACEFUL ATMOSPHERE. "YOUR GOVERNMENT IS AWARE THAT THE U.S.

ADMINISTRATION HAS BEEN MAKING A MAXIMUM EFFORT TO IMPROVE RELATIONS, RESTORE OUR TIES TO A NORMAL COURSE, AND LIMIT TO THE EXTENT POSSIBLE EMOTIONAL OR MISINFORMED RESPONSES. WE HAVE NO ABIILITY TO CONTROL STATEMENTS FROM THE AMERICAN PRESS OR THE U.S. CONGRESS. WE HAVE DONE OUR BEST, HOWEVER, TO PRESENT A FACTUAL PICTURE OF EVENTS IN IRAN AND TO DESCRIBE TO ALL INTERESTED AMERICAN PARTIES THE MUTUAL INTEREST AND CONCERNS WE SHARE WITH IRAN. "WE ARE CONCERNED BY THE PHENOMENON OF INCREASING ANTIAMERICANISM IN IRAN, MUCH OF WHICH SEEMS TO BE BASED ON A POPULAR MISUNDERSTANDING OF THE ATTITUDE OF THIS ADMINISTRATION.

I HAVE BEEN INSTRUCTED BY MY GOVERNMENT TO EXPRESS ITS CONCERN THAT THE DEMONSTRATIONS TODAY AND TOMORROW MAY THREATEN THE SAFETY OF AMERICAN EMBASSY PERSONNEL IN TEHRAN. WE WOULD LIKE THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN TO CONSIDER ADDITIONAL MEASURES TO PROVIDE PROTECTION IN THE EMOTIONALLY-CHARGED CIRCUMSTANCES. THE UNITED STATES GOVERNMENT EXPECTS THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN TO FULFILL ITS INTERNATIONALLY RECOGNIZED RESPONSIBILITIES TO PROTECT THE LIVES AND PROPERTY OF FOREIGN DIPLOMATIC PERSONNEL.

IN ORDER TO REDUCE THE POSSIBILITY OF VIOLENCE, I WOULD LIKE TO SUGGEST THAT THE DEMONSTRATIONS BE ROUTED AWAY FROM THE EMBASSY AND PREVENTED FROM APPRROACHING THE WALLS OF THE EMBASSY. MR. PRINE MINISTER, AS I HAD EXPRESSED TO YOU PERSONNALLY, OUR TWO COUNTRIES AND PEOPLES HAVE MUCH IN COMMON TO PROVIDE A FIRM FOUNDATION FOR A GOOD RELATIONSHIP IN THE FUTURE BASED ON MUTUAL RESPECT.

I SINCERELY HOPE THAT YOUR GOVERNMENT WILL TAKE WHATEVER STEPS ARE NECESSARY TO COOL THE PRESENT ATMOSPHERE SO THAT BOTH OF US CAN GO ABOUT OUR WORK IN IMPROVING OUR RELATIONS IN THE INTEREST OF BOTH OF OUR PEOPLES. "WITH HIGH ESTEEM, SINCERELY /S/ CHARLES W. NAAS. NAAS
(C - ENTIRE TEXT; REPORTING CABLE.)

IN PAST FEW DAYS, SMALLER FARSI PAPER CARRIED ANNOUNCEMENT THAT IRAN WOULD SEND TROOPS TO FIGHT ALONGSIDE PALESTINIAN BRETHREN IN LEBANON. REMARKS ORIGINALLY ATTRIBUTED TO AYATOLLAH ROUHANI BY ONE SOURCE, BUT ORIGIN OF STORY SOMEWHAT OBSCURE. TO OUR KNOWLEDGE, INTERNATIONAL WIRES AND MAJOR LOCAL PAPERS HAVE NOT CARRIED ITEM, AND IT DOES NOT APPEAR TO BE ANNOUNCED GOVERNMENT POLICY.

DEFENSE MINISTRY OFFICIAL MENTIONED IN PASSING TO VISITING U.S. COLONEL, HOWEVER, THAT THERE WERE IRANIAN "VOLUNTEERS" BEING TRAINED WHO MIGHT FIND THEIR WAY TO ARAB-ISRAELI CONFLICT. SOURCE HAD NO TIME TO ELABORATE.

COMMENT: WHILE PGOI HAS NOT ANNOUNCED ANY PARTICIPATION BY IRANIANS IN ARAB-ISRAELI STRUGGLE AND HAS DOWNPLAYED IDEA IN PAST, DEFENSE MINISTRY OFFICIAL'S COMMENT SUGGESTS SOME IRANIANS ARE PREPARING FOR SOME SORT OF PARTICIPATION IN PALESTINIAN STRUGGLE. THIS WOULD NOT BE INCONSISTENT WITH PGOI POLICY, BUT WOULD PROBABLY BE ONLY TOKEN PRESENCE FOR SYMBOLIC REASONS, SINCE IRANIAN ISLAMIC MOVEMENT NEEDS ALL THE TRAINED HANDS IT CAN
(S - ENTIRE TEXT; REPORTING MESSAGE)

SUMMARY: DURING MAY 24 DISCUSSIONS DEP PM AMIR ENTEZAM PROVIDED INSIGHTS INTO PGOI'S RELATIONSHIP WITH KHOMEINI AND THE IMAN'S INFORMAL STRUCTURE OF GOVERNMENT, AS WELL AS POSSIBLE MOTIVATION FOR PGOI'S ACTION RE MAY 17 SENATE RESOLUTION. END SUMMARY.

DURING DISCUSSION WITH CHARGE AND POL COUNS MAY 24 DEP PM AMIR ENTEZAM INDICATED HIS AND PGOI'S CONTINUING SEVERE FRUSTRATION IN DEALING WITH KHOMEINI AND ESTABLISHING FORMER'S AUTHORITY TO DEAL WITH ISSUES ORDINARILY WITHIN A NATIONAL GOVERNMENT'S DOMAIN. ECHOING REMARKS OF ANOTHER SOURCE (TEHRAN 1636), ENTEZAM INDICATED THAT PGOI HAD DIFFICULTY HAVING MEANINGFUL POLICY DISCUSSIONS WITH THE IMAN BECAUSE OF THE ENTOURAGE IN QOM THAT CONSTANTLY SURROUNDS HIM. WHILE ENTEZAM DID NOT PHRASE IT THUSLY, THE IMPRESSION HE GAVE WAS THAT THE PGOI IS TREATED IN THE SAME FASHION AS THE NUMEROUS OTHER SUPPLICANTS WHO REGULARLY SEEK KHOMEINI'S EAR.
HE APPARENTLY HEARS THE CABINET OUT, BUT THERE IS NO MEANINGFUL INTERCHANGE. ONLY LATER DOES KHOMEINI GIVE HIS VIEWS WHICH IMMEDIATELY BECOME ALMOST IMMUTABLE DOGMA.

ENTEZAM, SPEAKING WITH WHAT APPEARED TO BE TOTAL FRANKNESS, SAID THAT POLITICAL REALITY IN IRAN IS THAT KHOMEINI MAKES ALMOST ALL POLICY. THE PGOI DOES NOT ALWAYS AGREE WITH HIS VIEWS AND DECISIONS, BUT IT HAS NO CHOICE BUT TO GO ALONG WITH THEM, EVEN WHEN THEY ARE CONTRARY TO IRAN'S POLITICAL INTERESTS. AS AN EXAMPLE OF WHAT HE MEANT, ENTEZAM CITED THE DECISION TO ALLOW THE PLO TO SET UP AN OFFICE IN AHWAZ.

THE PGOI RECOGNIZED THAT THIS MOVE, WHICH ALLOWED THE PLO TO HAVE A BASE FOR SUBVERSIVE OPERATIONS AMONG IRAN'S ETHNIC ARAB MINORITY RIGHT IN THAT MINORITY'S BACK YARD, WAS INIMICAL TO IRAN'S INTERESTS, BUT IT COULD DO NOTHING ABOUT IT BECAUSE THE IMAM HAD AUTHORIZED THE ESTABLISHMENT OF THE OFFICE.

ENTEZAM SAID THAT THE PGOI ATTEMPTS TO SOFTEN THE AFFECTS OF KHOMEINI'S MOST RADICAL AND EXTREME DIRECTIVES, BUT THAT ITS MEANS FOR DOING THIS ARE LIMITED. HE SUGGESDED THAT THE PGOI'S DECISION TO ASK THAT AMBASSA DOR CUTLER DELAY HIS ARRIVAL WAS AN EXAMPLE OF THIS SORT OF ENDEAVOR. THE IMPLICATION OF HIS REMARKS WAS THAT THE CABINET, IN THE FACE OF KHOMEINI'S IMMEDIATE REACTION TO THE MAY 17 SENATE RESOLUTION,WHICH INDICATED HE FAVORED A TOTAL BREAK IN RELATIONS WITH THE U.S., WAS TO DEVISE A LESS PRECIPITOUS RESPONSE.

WE ALSO GATHERED FROM HIS REMARKS THAT THE DECISION TO ASK THAT AMBASSADOR CUTLER NOT BE SENT AT ALL FLOWED FROM THIS. IF WE ARE RIGHT IN THIS LINE OF SPECULATION, IT WOULD APPEAR THAT, WHILE THE PGOI INITIALLY MIGHT HAVE BEEN UPSET BY THE SEQUENCE OF EVENTS WHEREBY THE AGREMENT WAS GRANTED (REPORTED SEPTEL), IT WAS PREPARED TO LIVE WITH ITS CONSEQUENCES. HOWEVER, THE SENATE RESOLUTION AND THE DECISION TO ASK FOR AMBASSADOR CUTLER TO DELAY HIS ARRIVAL LED TO A REOPENING OF THE QUESTION OF HIS SUITABILITY IN THE PGOI'S EYES (AND MORE IMPORTANTLY, IN THE EYES OF KHOMEINI). NAAS

1979TEHRAN05446.subject: ANTI-U.S. DEMONSTRATION MAY 24: SITREP AS OF 1800 LOCAL TIME

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT; REPORTING CABLE)

SUMMARY: BETWEEN 8 AND 12 THOUSAND IRANIANS MARCHED PAST U.S. EMBASSY SHOUTING SLOGANS AND WAVING BANNERS IN PROTEST OF U.S. SENATE RESOLUTION AND ALLEGED U.S. INTERVENTION IN IRAN. EMBASSY WAS PROTECTED BY ITS OWN MUJAHIDDIN GUARD FORCE AUGMENTED BY REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS. T.V. CAMERAS WERE PLACED BEFORE MARCH BEGAN. REVOLUTIONARY GUARD GROUP GAVE U.S. FLAG TO FIRST WAVE OF DEMONSTRATORS. ONE COMMUNIST GROUP MARCHED, BUT WAS HEMMED IN BY ISLAMIC FORCES. AFTERNOON PERSIAN PAPER SAYS THAT IN ADDITION TO ALL-GROUP MARCH MAY 25, AIR FORCE HOMOFARS WILL HOLD SEPARATE MARCH MAY 26. END SUMMARY.
CROWDS FOR SCHEDULED MARCH BEGAN PASSING EMB ABOUT 3:30 LOCAL TIME. MARCHING GROUPS WERE IN GOOD ORDER, AND FIVE DIFFERENT AMCIT CROWD ESTIMATORS SET SIZE OF CROWD BETWEEN 8,000 AND 12,000.

MUJAHIDDIN GROUP WAS FIRST PAST AND STOPPED AT FRONT OF CHANCERY TO SHOUT SLOGANS SUCH AS "DEATH TO CARTER, AMERICAN SENATE IS DEFEATED." PROFESSIONALLY DONE BANNERS CARRIED BY ALL GROUPS, INCLUDING ONE IN ENGLISH SAYING "WE SUPPORT THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS AND ABSOLUTELY CONDEMN AMERICAN INTERFERENCE." ISLAMIC REPUBLICAN PARTY BANNERS CARRIED SAME THEMES, INCLUDING ONE SAYING "DEATH TO CARTER; DEATH TO RUSSIANS." GROUPS CAME IN FOUR OR FIVE WAVES, WELL-DISCIPLINED, AND STOPPED TO CHANT IN FRONT OF EMB GATES WHERE T.V. CAMERA SET UP 1 HR BEFORE. GROUPS LED BY ARMED MEN, MANY ON MOTORCYCLES, SOME IN JEEPS. PARADE MARSHALLS HAD WHITE CARNATION-LIKE BADGES.

ONLY TWO INCIDENTS MARRED FESTIVITIES. FIRST GROUP PAST EXHIBITED INTENSE HOSTILITY AT AMERICAN FLAG, AND REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS WHO HAD ARRIVED TO PROTECT EMB TOOK FLAG DOWN AND GAVE IT TO DEMONSTRATORS WHO TORE IT UP AND USED IT FOR STRIP BANNERS. EMB MUJAHIDDIN GUARDS TRIED TO STOP THIS, AND EMB GUARD LEADER KICKED REVOLUTIONARY GUARD WHO HAD LOWERED FLAG. GUARDS RAN POSTER UP FLAG POLE, SHOWING AMERICAN WITH DEVIL-LIKE EARS AND U.S. FLAG IN ONE EAR AND ISRAELI FLAG IN OTHER. EMB MUJAHIDDIN GUARD SHINNIED UP FLAG POLE AND TORE IT DOWN.

SECOND INCIDENT OCCURRED NEAR END OF MARCH ABOUT 1700 WHEN TUDEH (COMMUNIST)PARTY GROUP TRIED TO MARCH PAST AND WAS BLOCKED BY ISLAMIC MARCHERS. TUDEH MEN, ABOUT 150-200 SAT DOWN AND WERE SURROUNDED BY ISLAMIC FORCES. AFTER 15 MINUTES OF INTENSE PALAVER, GROUP GOT UP AND MOVED ON, TO ROUND OF HEARTY APPLAUSE.
STREET WAS FAIRLY QUIET FROM 1730 TO 1750, WHEN GROUP OF MOTORCYCLISTS ROARED BY AND GAVE A BIG SHOUT. THERE WAS NO FOLLOWUP, AND BY 1810 STREETS WERE RELATIVELY QUIET AGAIN.

UNLESS PEOPLE STREAMING BACK FROM RALLY AT 17 ESFAND SQUARE (REFTEL) WANT TO SHOUT A BIT MORE, THIS PROBABLY ENDS ACTIVITY FOR MAY 24. ------------------037640 241656Z /41 Z 241537Z MAY 79 ZFF-4 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC FLASH 1658 DIA WASH DC FLASH CIA WASH DCZFLASH USICA WASHDC FLASH INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY ANKARA IMMEDIATE 473#-$/USINT BAGHDAD IMMEDIATE CPOE AMEMBASSY BONN IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY CAIRO IMMEDIATE AMCONSUL DHAHRAN IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY DOHA IMMEDIATE AMCONSUL FRANKFURT IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY JIDDA IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY KABUL IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY KUWAIT IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY LONDON IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY MANAMA IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY MOSCOW IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY PARIS IMMEDGDYE AMEMBASXZ BEIJING IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY RABAT IMMEDIATE USLSXRIYADH IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY ROME IMMEDIATE AMEMBASSY TOKYO IMMEDIATE USCINCYAR VAIHINGEN GE IMMEDIATE CINCPAC HONOLULU HI IMMEDIATE USDOCOSOUTH NAPLES IT IMMEDIATE SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 05446

PGOI RESPONDED TO CALL FOR ADDITIONAL REINFORCEMENTS BY BEEFING UP EMB MUJAHIDDIN GUARD FORCE TO ABOUT 40 MEN, AND ADDING ANOTHER 40 REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS (SEPAHE-PASDARAN-E-ENGLELOB). EMB SECURITY MEN BELIEVE EMB MUJAHIDDIN WORKED WELL, AND THEIR LEADER, MASHALLAH KASHANI, WAS EFFECTIVE LEADER OF COMBINED FORCE. REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS, HOWEVER, WERE HOSTILE TO AMERICANS, DID LOWER U.S. FLAG AND GIVE IT TO DEMONSTRATORS, AND BEGAN CLAPPING, AND RAISING FISTS AND "V" SALUTE WITH HANDS IN SUPPORT OF EACH GROUP AS IT MARCHED PAST. BETWEEN 12 AND 24 NATIONAL POLICE SHOWED UP BEFORE MARCH PAST STARTED, BUT BY TIME FIRST GROUP WAS ABREAST EMB, THEY HAD DOFFED THEIR HATS AND DISAPPEARED INTO THE CROWD.
AFTERNOON MAY 24 PERSIAN PAPER ANNOUNCED THAT AIR FORCE HOMOFARS WOULD HOLD THEIR OWN ANTI-U.S. MARCH MAY

HOMOFARS WERE ANTI-U.S. GROUP OF TECHNICAL SPECIALISTS WHO TRIGGERED REVOLUTION FEB. 9. MAY 25 MARCH IS CONSIDERED BY LOCAL ISLAMIC GUARDS TO BE COMMUNIST MARCH, BUT MANY GROUPS, INCLUDING NATIONAL DEMOCRATIC FRONT AND NATIONAL FRONT WILL BE PARTICIPATING. EMB PLEASED TO HAVE GOTTEN BY FIRST DAY OF RAH-RAY, BUT IT LOOKS LIKE A VERY LONG WEEKEND.
CHARGE HAS BEEN UNABLE THUS FAR TO REACH DEPUTY PRIMIN ENTEZAM TO DISCUSS VERY UNFORTUNATE FLAG INCIDENT.
AS OF 1900 LOCAL MARCHERS ARE PASSING EMB RETURNING FROM RALLY IN PEACEFUL FASHION. NAAS

1979TEHRAN05447.subject: ANTI-U.S. DEMONSTRATION MAY 25: SITREP AS OF1130 LOCAL TIME

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY: AS OF 1130 LOCAL TIME LARGE CROWD OF DEMONSTRATORS WAS ENCAMPED IN STREETS ONTWO SIDE OF EMBASSY COMPOUND. SPEECHES, WHILE CONDEMNING PRESIDENT, USG AND SENATOR JAVITS, HAVE NOT BEEN PARTICULARLY INFLAMATORY. INDEED, SPEAKERS HAVE GENERALLY MADE CLEAR DISTINCTION BETWEEN THE OBJECT OF THEIR PROTEST (MAY 17 SENATE RESOLUTION) AND AMERICAN PEOPLE. MIXED SECURITY FORCES WHICH HAVE INCLUDED ISLAMICMOJAHEDIN IRREGULARS INSIDE THE EMBASSY COMPOUND AND NATIONAL POLICE ON THE OUTSIDE OF THEWALL HAVE SO FAR DONE A CREDITABLE JOB. END SUMMARY.

DEMONSTRATORS BEGAN FORMING UP IN FRONT OF THE EMBASSY COMPOUND AT ABOUT 0900 MAY 25. MOJAHEDIN IRREGULARS INSIDE COMPOUND WERE IN PLACE, AS WAS A SMALL CONTINGENT OF NATIONAL POLICE OUTSIDE THE WALL. WITHIN 45 MINUTES THE CROWD HAD SWELLED TO ABOUT 3,000. A PODIUM WAS SET UP NEAR THE ROOSEVELT AVENUE GATE AND SPEECHES BEGAN. APPEALS WERE MADE TO DEMONSTRATORS BY SPEAKERS NOT TO BURN ANYTHING AND POLICE ENDEAVORED TO GET THEM TO SIT DOWN IN STREET WHILETHEY LISTENED TO SPEECHES. THE CROWD WAS STEADILY AUGMENTED UNTIL BY 1030 BOTH ROOSEVELT AVENUE (EAST PERIMETER) AND TAKHTE JAMSHID AVENUE (SOUTH PERI METER) WERE COMPLETELY FILLED FOR SEVERAL BLOCKS.
EXACT ESTIMATE OF CROWD'S SIZE DIFFICULT FROM OUR VANTAGE POINT, BUT IT APPEARS TO BE CONSIDERABLY LARGER THAN YESTERDAY'S

MOOD OF THE CROWD HASNOT BEEN PARTICULARY HOSTILE. INDEED, A CONCERTEDEFFORT SEEMS TO BE BEING MADE TO AVOID AN INCIDENT. SPEAKERS HAVE URGED DEMONSTRATORS NOTTO DO ANYTHING PROVOCATIVE SINCE IRANIAN NATION HAS NOTHING AGAINST THE AMERICAN PEOPLE. CHANTS HAVE INCLUDED SUCH THINGS AS DEATH TO CARTER AND ISRAEL, VICTORY TO ISLAM AND PALESTINE, AND ISRAEL AND AMERICA ARE NOTHING. SEVERAL EFFIGIES OF CARTER AND BEGIN HAVE BEEN SPOTTED, AS WELL AS A PALESTINIAN FLAG AT ABOUT 1045 A MULLAH BEGAN TO READ FROM THE KORAN AND THE CROWD MAINTAINED A RESPECTFUL SILENCE. CHANTS HAVE SINCE RESUMMED.

OUR SECURITY FORCES, WHILE FRATERNIZING WITH THE CROWD ON THE OUTSIDE, HAVE DONE A CREDITABLE JOB SO FAR. COMMANDER-IN-CHIEF OF THE MOJAHEDIN IRREGULARS, MASHALLAH KASHANI, HAS WORKED HARD TO PREVENT RECURRANCE OF THE KIND OF INCIDENT WHICH TOOK PLACE YESTERDAY WHEREIN SEVERAL MOJAHEDIN (NONE OF WHOM WERE FROM THE GROUP WHICH NORMALLY PROVIDES EMBASSY SECURITY) LOWERED OUR FLAG AND PRESENTED TO THE DEMONSTRATORS. SEVERAL SEEMED TEMPTED TO REPEAT THEIR PERFORMANCE, BUT MASHALLAH MOVED QUICKLY TO PREVENT ANY ATTEMPT TO BRING THE FLAG DOWN.
OUR MARINES ALSO TOOK THE PRECAUTION TO PUT THE HALYARDS OUT OF REACH FROM THE GROUND AND TO GREASE THE POLE WITH PETROLEUM JELLY AND THIRTY WEIGHT OIL. NAAS

1979TEHRAN05448.subject: ANTI-U.S. DEMONSTRATION MAY 25: SITREP AS OF 1330 LOCAL TIME

segments.text: TIME (C - ENTIRE TEXT: REPORTING MESSAGE)

DEMONSTRATORS BEGAN TO DISPERSE FOLLOWING FINAL HALF HOUR OF HARANGUING AND SLOGANEERING DURING WHICH TENSIONS AMONG PARTICIPANTS APPEARED TO INCREASE MARKEDLY. AS DEMONSTRATORS BEGAN SLOWLY TO DRIFT AWAY, AT LEAST ONE GROUP, WHICH WAS DESCRIBED BY OUR MOJAHEDIN SECURITY FORCE AS "COMMUNIST" AND WHICH MAY HAVE BEEN MADE UP OF MARXIST FEDAYIN-E-KHALQ AND THEIR SUPPORTERS, ATTEMPTED TO MARCH EAST ALONG TAKHTE JAMSHID AVENUE AGAINST THE FLOW OF THE DISPERSING DEMONSTRATORS. BEGINNING ABOUT 1230 THIS GROUP AND PERHAPS OTHERS STARTED SCUFFLING WITH ONE ANOTHER.

AFTER SEVERAL MINUTES OF TOING AND FROING ALONG THE STREET AND CONSIDERABLE SHOUTING OUR MOJAHEDIN FORCE FIRED APPROXIMATELY SEVEN SHOTS IN THE AIR AND SOON THEREAFTER THE CROWD MELTED AWAY. FYI: WE HAD HEARD EARLIER IN THE MORNING THAT A GROUP OF LEFTISTS AT THE TEHRAN UNIVERSITY CAMPUS WAS BEING PREVENTED FROM MARCHING ON THE EMBASSY, BUT WE CANNOT CONFIRM THE ACCURACY OF THIS REPORT. END FYI. OUR UNOFFICIAL ESTIMATE OF THE CROWD SIZE IS WELL OVER 100,000. FINALLY, WE HAVE HEARD REPORTS THAT WE MAY HAVE YET ANOTHER DEMONSTRATION TOMORROW, THIS TIME BY THE AIR FORCE HOMOFARS.
AREA AROUND EMBASSY IS NOW QUIET. NAAS

1979TEHRAN05452.subject: ANTI-U..S. DEMONSTRATIONS MAY25 AND 26: SITREP AS OF 1100 LOCAL TIME MAY 26

segments.text: C - ENTIRE TEXT; REPORT MESSAGE.

FOLLOWING DISPERSAL OF LARGE GATHERING OUTSIDE EMBASSY COMPOUND EARLY AFTERNOON MAY 25 (REFTEL) SMALL GROUP OF DEMONSTRATORS (APPROXIMATELY 1,000 GATHERED OUTSIDE ROOSEVELT AVENUE GATE AT ABOUT 1700 LOCAL TIME. AFTER SHOUTING SLOGANS AND WAVING THEIR FISTS FOR ABOUT 45 MINUTES THEY DISPERSED. GROUP WAS A MIXTURE OF MEN, WOMEN AND YOUNG CHILDREN. SEVERAL CARRIED POSTERS OF KHOMEINI AND ARAFAT.

MARXIST FEDYIN-E-KHALQ, PERHAPS NUMBERING 15,000 STRONG, DID HOLD RALLY YESTERDAY AND ATTEMPTED TO MARCH ON EMBASSY WITH OTHER DEMONSTRATORS. ALL BUT A FEW WERE PREVENTED FROM REACHING THE COMPOUND BY ISLAMIC FORCES, HOWEVER.
DEMONSTRATION BY AIR FORCE HOMOFARS REPORTEDLY SCHEDULED FOR 1400 THIS AFTERNOON NOW LOOKS DOUBTFUL.
(S - ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY: I MET WITH ENTEZAM AFTERNOON MAY 26 AND, AFTER I COVERED POINTS REFTEL, HE REITERATED DESIRE FOR AMBASSADOR CUTLER WITHDRAWAL. IN RESPONSE MY QUESTION, HE AFFIRMED HE WAS SPEAKING FOR PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN. END SUMMARY.

I MET WITH DEP PRIMIN ENTEZAM AFTERNOON MAY 26 AND COVERED REFTEL FULLY. HE SAID HE UNDERSTOOD POINTS, BUT AT THE PRESENT TIME PGOI CONTINUED PREFER WITHDRAWAL OF AMBASSADOR CUTLER'S ASSIGNMENT AND ASSIGNMENT OF AN AMBASSADOR WITH DIFFERENT BACKGROUND, EVEN IF IT MEANT DELAY OF SEVERAL MONTHS IN THE NEW AMBASSADOR'S ARRIVAL. HE AGAIN URGED OUR UNDERSTANDING FOR PROBLEMS PGOI FACED WITH "THOSE OUTSIDE GOVERNMENT" WHO ARE EITHER UNAWARE OF IMPORTANCE OF RELATIONS WITH U.S. OR CONSCIOUSLY ATTEMPTING TO CAUSE PROBLEMS BETWEEN TWO GOVERNMENTS. IN RESPONSE TO MY DIRECT QUESTION HE AFFIRMED HE SPOKE FOR PRIME MINISTER.

I EXPLAINED THAT A NEW AMBASSADOR COULD PROBABLY NOT BE ON BOARD FOR AT LEAST THREE MONTHS AND THAT, THEREFORE, THE EMB WOULD BE HEADED BY A CHARGE. HE LOOKED DOLEFUL BUT SHRUGGED AND SAID THAT "WOULD BE BETTER" THAN CUTLER NOMINATION. THEN, RATHER SADLY, HE SAID HE AND UABINET MEMBERS SINCERELY WANT GOOD RELATIONS WITH U.S. AND HOPE THAT A SOLID RELATIONSHIP CAN BE DEVELOPED

1979TEHRAN05458.subject: ANTI-U.S. DEMONSTRATION MAY 26: SITREP AS OF 1700 LOCAL TIME

segments.text: LOCAL TIME (C - ENTIRE TEXT; REPORTING MESSAGE)

CROWD ESTIMATED AT APPROXIMATELY 1,000 STRONG, PROMINENT AMONG WHOM WERE AIR FORCEHOMOFARS INCLUDING A NUMBER WHO PREVIOUSLY HAD BEEN PART OF EMBASSY SECURITY FORCE, GATHERED AT ROOSEVELT AVENUE GATE OF EMBASSY COMPOUND. GROUP WAS DESCIPLINED AND SAT QUIETLY LISTENING TO ANTI-AMERICAN, ANTI-SENATE, AND ANTI-ZIONIST SPEECHES. AT APPROXIMATELY 1630 CROWD BEGAN TO BREAK UP WHEN A SINGL SHOT WAS HEARD. THEIS APPARENTLY WAS AN ACCIDENTAL DISCHARGE FROM A WEAPON OF A MEMBER OF OUR OWN SECURITY FORCE, BUT THINKING THAT IT MIGHT HAVE COME FROM OUTSIDE, SEVERAL OTHERS AMONG OUR PROTECTORS FIRED OFF ABOUT A DOZEN SHOTS TO DISPERSE THE REMAINING DEMONSTRATORS.. THEY ALSO TOOK SIX "COMMUNISTS" INTO CUSTODY FOR QUESTIONING.
PERIMETER AROUND COMPOUND NOW QUIET AND TRAFFICE IF FLOWING NORMALLY ALONG TAKHTE JAMSHID AND ROOSEVELT AVENUES. NAAS
RAFSANJANI (C - ENTIRE TEXT; REPORTING MESSAGE.)

SUMMARY: HOJATOLESLAM HASHEMI RAFSANJANI NARROWLY AVOIDED BECOMING THE LATEST ASSASSINATION VICTIM OF THE SHADOWY FORGHAN GROUP IN AN ATTACK MAY 25. WHILE FORGHAN APPEARS TO BE AN ENTIRELY INDIGENOUS RADICAL RELIGIOUS GROUP, MUCH OF IRAN'S ISLAMIC ESTABLISHMENT, INCLUDING KHOMEINI, IS BUSILY LOOKING FOR FOREIGN ENEMIES TO BLAME FOR RESPONSIBILITY. END SUMMARY.

THE FOLLOWING INFORMATION ON THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE ASSASSINATION ATTEMPT HAS BEEN GATHERED FROM MEDIA REPORTS AND CONFIRMED BY DEP PM AMIR ENTEZAM: ABOUT 2045 MAY 25 TWO MEN CAME TO RAFSANJANI'S HOUSE SAYING THEY WERE FROM AYATOLLAH NOURI WITH WHOM RAFSANJANI WAS TO HAVE A MEETING AT 2100 . RAFSANJANI WAS SAYING HIS EVENING PRAYERS AND THE TWO MEN WERE INVITED IN TO WAIT FOR HIM. ONE STOOD AT THE DOOR WHILE THE OTHER WENT INTO AN INNER ROOM AND SAT DOWN NEAR THE PHONE. WHEN RAFSANJANI CAME INTO THE ROOM, HE ASKED THE MAN TO MOVE SO THAT HE COULD SIT NEXT TO THE PHONE HIMSELF.

AS THE MAN MADE A MOTION TO RISE, RAFSANJANI SAW HIS GUN CONCEALED BENEATH HIS LEG. RAFSANJANI GRABBED THE MAN'S ARM AS HE RAISED HIS GUN TO FIRE. IN THE STRUGGLE WHICH ENSUED HE WAS SLIGHTLY WOUNDED IN THE ARM, BUT HE MANAGED TO WRESTLE HIS ATTACKER TO THE FLOOR. RAFSANJANI'S WIFE RUSHED INTO THE ROOM AND THREW HERSELF ON THE TWO MEN ON THE FLOOR JUST AS THE SECOND ASSASSIN ENTERED. HE FIRED ONE SHOT INTO RAFSANJANI' EXPOSED RIGHT SIDE, WHEREUPON HE AND HIS COMPATRIATE FLED, LEAVING BEHIND LEAFLETS IDENTIFYING THEM AS MEMBERS OF FORGHAN. RAFSANJANI WAS RUSHED TO THE HOSPITAL WHERE HIS LIVER WAS OPERATED ON.
HE PRESENTLY APPEARS TO BE OUT OF DANGER.

KHOMEINI AND SEVERAL SENIOR RELIGIOUS FIGURES IMMEDIATELY ISSUED STATEMENTS, ALL OF WHICH PLACE THE BLAME FOR THE ATTACK ON FOREIGN ENEMIES. KHOMEINI WARNED THE U.S. SPECIFICALLY AND "OTHER POWERS" IN GENERAL THAT RAFSANJANI AND THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT ARE STILL ALIVE AND THAT ALL PLOTS AND CONSPIRACIES WOULD BE SMASHED. AYATOLLAH MONAZERI WENT EVEN FURTHER THAN KHOMEINI: HE TOLD KAYHAN THAT, "MOST PROBABLY IT WAS THE U.S. THAT IS BEHIND THIS, AND EVEN IF IT IS THE LEFTISTS, IT MUST BE THE 'AMERICAN' LEFTISTS, LIKE IN MOSSADEGH'S TIME."

THE TIMING OF THE ATTEMPTED ASSASSINATION COULD NOT HAVE BEEN MUCH WORSE, COMING AS IT DID IN THE CONTEXT OF ANTI-AMERICAN DEMONSTRATIONS AND JUST HOURS AFTER RAFSANJANI HIMSELF HAD DELIVERED A FIERY ANTI-AMERICAN SPEECH TO DEMONSTRATORS PROTESTING THE MAY 17 SENATE RESOLUTION. THE TEMPTATION TO DRAW A CONNECTION BETWEEN THE ATTACK ON THE ONE HAND AND RAFSANJANI'S OUTSPOKEN CRITICISM OF THE U.S. ON THE OTHER WOULD BE DIFFICULT FOR EVEN THE MOST OPEN-MINDED TO RESIST AND VIRTUALLY IMPOSSIBLE FOR THE VAST MAJORITY OF IRANIANS WHO ARE ALL TOO READY TO SEE A CIA AGENT BEHIND EVERY BUSH.
IN FACT, HOWEVER, WHAT LITTLE INFORMATION IS AVAILABLE ON FORGHAN INDICATES THAT THE ORGANIZATION IS A WHOLLY ISLAMIC ONE, ALBEIT ONE THAT REJECTS THE ISLAMIC CLERGY.

RAFSANJANI HAS SOMETIMES BEEN IDENTIFIED AS A MEMBER OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL. OUR INFORMATION ON THE COUNCIL'S PERMANENT MEMBERSHIP INDICATES OTHERWISE, BUT HE IS UNQUESTIONABLY ONE OF KHOMEINI'S INNER CIRCLE

1979TEHRAN05488.subject: THE ISLAMIC GUARDIAN CORPS IN ACTION

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT; REPORTING CABLE.)
SUMMARY: THE ISLAMIC GUARDS EXIST AS A SEPARATE, UNIFORMED CORPS, BEING NEWLY TRAINED IN AT LEAST THREE SEPARATE CAMPS, UNDER FOREIGN (PROBABLY LEBANESE) EXPERTS. END SUMMARY.

IN RESPONSE TO THE EMBASSY'S REQUEST FOR ADDITIONAL SECURITY OVER THE DEMONSTRATION WEEKEND OF MAY 24-25, SOME 100 MEMBERS OF THE ISLAMIC GUARDIAN CORPS APPEARED, LAYING TO REST RUMORS THAT THE GUARDS DID NOT IN FACT EXIST AS A DISINCT UNIT. THESE GUARDS, ALL IN THEIR EARLY 20'S, ALL CARRIED IDENTICAL AUTOMATIC RIFLES AND WERE WEARING NEW UNIFORMS--KHAKI TANS, GREEN CAMOUFLAGE CLOTH, OR BROWN CAMOUFLAGE CLOTH. THEY WORE NON-STANDARD SHOES, BELTS AND HATS. FROM OVERHEARD CONVERSATIONS, IT WAS CLEAR THAT THE UNIFORMS INDICATED THREE SEPARATE GROUPS, WHO HAD NOT MET BEFORE THIS OCCASION, AND THAT THE UNIFORMS WERE NEWLY ISSUED FOR THIS DUTY.
THE GUARDS WERE COMPARING THEIR TRAINING CAMPS, PROGRAMS, AND RAINING EXPERTS, WITH POSITIVE COMMENTS ON EACH. NO LOCAIONS WERE MENTIONED.

THE GUARDS' ATTITUDE DURING THE DEMONSRATION WAS DECIDEDLY ANTI-AMERICAN; ON FRIDAY, MAY 25, GUARDS TORE DOWN THE AMERICAN FLAG, GAVE IT TO THE DEMONSTRATORS TO BURN, AND RAN A PROTEST BANNER UP THE FLAGPOLE. THEY WERE UNWILLING TO SPEAK TO AMERICANS EXCEPT FOR MINIMUM SECURITY ORDERS. HOWEVER, THEIR PRESENCE PROVIDED EFFECTIVE SECURITY AND NO DEMONSTRATORS ATTEMPTED TO ENTER THE GROUNDS.

MASHALLAH KASHANI, THE CHIEF OF THE EMBASSY'S MOJAHEDIN GUARDS, WAS VOCALLY UNIMPRESSED BY THE GUARDS' READINESS AND TRAINING. WHILE THEY HAD THEIR OWN LEADERS, HOWEVER, HEY ACCEPTED MASHALLAH'S AUTHORITY AND ORDERS.

FOLLOWING THE MAY 25 DEMONSTRATION, A NON-IRANIAN ACCORDING TO SEVERAL OF THE GUARDS, IN OD UNIFORM, ACCOMPANIED BY TWO BODYGUARDS, APPEARED TO INSPECT AND COMPLIMENT THE GUARDS. HE WAS OBVIOUSLY WELL KNOWN, AND RESPECTED, BY ALL THREE GROUPS. THEY ASKED HIM IF THEY WERE TO GO "ON DUTY" OR RETURN TO THE TRAINING CAMPS, AND HE ORDERED ALL BACK TO THE CAMPS. HE WAS NOT IDENTIFIED, BUT IT IS POSSIBLE THAT HE WAS ONE OF THE LEBANESE PREVIOUSLY REPORTED IN REFTEL, AS THAT HAS BEEN THE ONLY NATIONALITY MENTIONED IN CONNECTION WITH THE GUARDS.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT; REPORTING MESSAGE)

RE MRS. DELRAHIM, WE HAVE LEARNED THE FOLLOWING. MRS. DELRAHIM WAS AN ELDERLY LADY RELATED TO A PROMINENT SHIRAZI JEWISH FAMILY, THE COHANIMS, WHO LIVED ALONE IN A HOUSE IN AN AREA OF SHIRAZ WHERE A NUMBER OF JEWISH FAMILIES ALSO RESIDE. A WEEK AGO SATURDAY HER HOUSE WAS BROKEN INTO AND SHE WAS MURDERED. HER HEAD WAS CUT OFF BUT THAT WAS PROBABLY NOT THE CAUSE OF DEATH SINCE SHE WAS ALSO STABBED A NUMBER OF TIMES, APPARENTLY BEFORE HER BEHEADING. NEITHER WE NOR THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES CAN BE CERTAIN OF THE EXACT MOTIVE OF THE BREAK-IN, BUT ROBBERY IS POSSIBLE IF NOT ACTUALLY PROBABLE. MRS.
DELRAHIM'S JEWELRY WAS REMOVED AND A NUMBER OF ITEMS WERE TAKEN FROM THE HOUSE.

RE ALLEGED TEHRAN ARRESTS, RABBI SHOFAH, LEADER OF THE LOCAL JEWISH COMMUNITY,AS WELL AS ALL OTHERS WE HAVE BEEN ABLE TO CONTACT ARE UNAWARE OF ANY JEWS HAVING BEEN RECENTLY ARRESTED. RABBI SHOFAH WAS SPECIFICALLY ASKED ABOUT THE FOUR NAMES MENTIONED IN REF A, BUT COULD PROVIDE NO INFORMATION ON THEM.

ENGLISH-LANGUAGE TEHRAN TIMES MAY 27 QUOTES FORMIN YAZDI THAT HIS GOVERNMENT RESPECTS IRANIAN JEWS ALTHOUGH IT IS OPPOSED TO ISRAEL AND ZIONISM. WHILE CONCEDING THAT YAZDI REITERATED THE PGOI POSITION THAT ELGHANIAN WAS NOT EXECUTED BECAUSE OF HIS RELIGION, LEFTIST AYENDAGAN, QUOTING AFP, REUTERS AND PARS NEWS AGENCY REPORTS, CLAIMED IN MAY 26 EDITION THAT YAZDI TOLD A FRENCH HUMAN RIGHTS ACTIVIST (SERGE KLARSFELDT - PHONETIC) WHO CAME TO IRAN TO PROTEST THE ELGHANIAN EXECUTION THAT THE IRANIAN JEWISH COMMUNITY HAD "SYMPATHIZED AND COLLABORATED" WITH THE SHAH DESPITE WARNINGS BY THE "REVOLUTIONARY FORCES." ACCORDING TO THE SAME AYENDAGAN REPORT, 20,000 IRANIAN JEWS HAVE EMIGRATED TO ISRAEL SINCE LAST YEAR.

(COMMENT: THE DEPARTURE OF 20,000 JEWS IN RECENT MONTHS IS SOMEWHAT LOWER THAN OUR ESTIMATE OF TOTAL DEPARTURES;WHATEVER THE ACTUAL NUMBER, WE BELIEVE THAT MOST HAVE IN FACT CHOSEN TO GO ELSEWHERE THAN ISRAEL.)
INDIVIDUALS' RELIGION IS NOT INDICATED IN THEIR PASSPORTS ALTHOUGH THEIR NAMES ARE FREQUENTLY A GOOD INDICATOR OF THEIR RELIGIOUS AFFILIATION.

FINALLY, RE THE SHIRAZ BAHAIS, SENIOR NIOC EMPLOYEE AT THE SHIRAZ REFINERY WHO CLAIMS TO HAVE A NUMBER OF FRIENDS AMONG THE BAHAI COMMUNITY TOLD POL COUNS MAY 27 THAT THERE HAS BEEN NO TROUBLE IN SHIRAZ SINCE DECEMBER ALTHOUGH THE COMMUNITY MEMBERS HAVE MAINTAINED A DISCREETLY LOW PROFILE SINCE THAT TIME. NAAS

1979TEHRAN05491.subject: PGOI REQUEST FOR INFORMATION ON SUBVERSIVE ACTIVITIES

segments.text: ACTIVITIES (S - ENTIRE TEXT; ACTION REQUESTED)

DURING MEETING WITH CHARGE MAY 26 DEP PM AMIR ENTEZAM RAISED ONCE AGAIN HIS GOVERNMENT'S DESIRE TO SHARE INTELLIGENCE INFORMATION WITH USG. AS YOU WILL RECALL, WE HAD EARLIER PROVIDED HIM WITH A PAPER ON AFGHANISTAN. DURING MAY 24 MEETING ENTEZAM HAD SAID THAT THIS INFORMATION HAD BEEN USEFUL, BUT THAT PGOI WAS REALLY MORE INTERESTED IN POSSIBLE INTERNAL SECURITY THREATS. ON MAY 26 HE WENT FURTHER, SAYING THAT PGOI WAS CONCERNED ABOUT POSSIBLE MEDDLING BY IRAQIS IN KHUZESTAN PROVINCE AS WELL AS ACTIVITIES OF PLO AND LYBIANS.

ENTEZAM SAID THAT PGOI HAD INFORMATION THAT GEORGE HABASH HAD RECENTLY VISITED SEVERAL GULF COUNTRIES, PERHAPS MORE THAN ONCE, PRESUMABLY WITH A VIEW TO CAUSING TROUBLE FOR IRAN. HE ADDED THAT THE PLO OFFICE IN AHWAZ ALSO GIVES THE PGOI SOME CONCERN. THEN, SHAKING HIS HEAD, HE SAID THAT HIS GOVERNMENT COULD DO NOTHING ABOUT IT FOR THE MOMENT BECAUSE IT WAS KHOMEINI'S DESIRE THAT IT BE OPENED.

CHARGE TOLD ENTEZAM THAT, QUITE FRANKLY, SECURITY OF ANY INFORMATION WE MIGHT PROVIDE PGOI WAS OF GREAT CONCERN. ENTEZAM QUICKLY REJOINED THAT HE HAD SHARED THE INFORMATION ON AFGHANISTAN ONLY WITH PM BAZARGAN AND THAT THEREAFTER THE PAPER HAD BEEN DESTROYED. (COMMENT: WE THINK THAT IN FACT THE INFO GOT SOMEWHAT WIDER DISTRIBUTION SINCE FORMIN YAZDI AT LEAST KNEW THAT WE HAD PROVIDED IT WHEN CHARGED CALLED ON HIM MAY 20.) CHARGE TOLD ENTEZAM THAT HE WOULD LOOK INTO POSSIBILITY OF SHARING WHATEVER INFORMATION WE MIGHT HAVE ON THE KIND OF ACTIVITIES HE IS INTERESTED IN.

ACTION REQUESTED: IF THE DEPARTMENT AGREES THAT THE RISK OF SHARING INFORMATION ON PLO, IRAQI AND LIBYAN SUBVERSIVE ACTIVITIES IN IRAN IS OUT-WEIGHED BY POTENTIAL REWARDS OF CLOSER COOPERATION WITH PGOI, REQUEST THAT PAPER BE PREPARED WHICH WE CAN GIVE TO ENTEZAM. NAAS

1979TEHRAN05517.subject: LABOR UNREST AND LEFTISTS ACTIVITIES AT SHIRAZ

segments.text: REFINERY (C - ENTIRE TEXT; REPORTING CABLE)

DIRECTOR OF PUBLIC RELATIONS AT SHIRAZ REFINERY, MOHAMMAD SHIRAZI, TOLD POL COUNS MAY 27 THAT REFINERY IS OPERATING BUT CONTINUES TO SUFFER FROM LABOR UNREST. SHIRAZI SAID THAT FOLLOWING FEBRUARY REVOLUTION LARGE NUMBERS OF STAFF AT REFINERY WERE REPLACED BY PERSONNEL FROM ABADAN, KERMANSHAH AND TEHRAN. THOSE FROM ABADAN HAVE GENERALLY BEEN PROFESSIONAL AND INTERESTED IN GETTING THE REFINERY BACK INTO FULL PRODUCTION, BUT THOSE FROM TEHRAN AND KERMANSHAH HAVE PRIMARILY BEEN ENGAGED IN FOMENTING TROUBLE BETWEEN LABORERS AND HOLDOVER MANAGERS. SHIRAZI SAID THAT HE BELIEVES AGITATORS HAVE AFFILIATION WITH FEDAYIN-E-KHALQ. THE PRO-MOSCOW TUDEH PARTY APPARENTLY HAS LITTLE INFLUENCE AMONG SHIRAZ REFINERY WORKERS.

SHIRAZ REFINERY MANAGING DIRECTOR, ASGHAR SHAHRIAR, IN AN EARLIER CONVERSATION WITH POL COUNS, ALSO SAID MUCH THE SAME THING. HE WAS VERY DISCOURAGED WITH THE SITUATION AT THE REFINERY, SAYING THAT HARDLY A DAY GOES BY WITHOUT SOME KIND OF INCIDENT WITH THE WORKERS AND LOWER LEVEL WHITE COLLAR PERSONNEL.
ACCORDING TO SHIRAZI, THE ABORTIVE ATTACK ON THE SHIRAZ REFINERY BY AN UNIDENTIFIED GROUP OF ARMED MEN MAY 23 WAS UNRELATED TO LABOR DIFFICULTIES AT THE FACILITY.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT; REPORTING CABLE)

SUMMARY; MOFATEH INDICATES THERE WILL BE NO CONSTITUTIONAL CONVENTION, THEN MUDDLES REPORT. CONFUSION OVER PROCESS CREATES FEARS AND ANXIETIES AMONG MANY GROUPS, PARTICULARLY SECULARISTS AND LEFTISTS. PROMINENT PROVINCIAL GOVERNOR MOGHADDAM MARAGHEI RESIGNS. RUMORS OF CLASH/COUP GROWING. CONSTITUTIONAL ISSUE APPEARS LIKELY TO PROVOKE WIDER CONFLICT IN IRAN. END SUMMARY.

PRESS COMMENTS OF PAST FEW DAYS SINCE REF A DRAFTED HAVE PAINTED EXTREMELY CONFUSED SCENE WITH RESPECT TO CONSTITUTIONAL PROCESS. ON MAY 28, REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL MEMBER DR. MOHAMMAD MOFATEH AND MINISTER OF INTERIOR HAJ SEYED JAVADI EACH TOLD PRESS THERE WOULD BE NO CONSTITUTIONAL ASSEMBLY, AND POLITICAL GROUPS WOULD BE BANNED FROM RATIFICATION PROCESS. MOFATEH LATER DENIED HE HAD SAID THERE WOULD BE NO ASSEMBLY, AND SAID THERE WOULD BE A LIMITED ONE OF FORTY MEMBERS, CONFIRMING REF A COMMENT THAT MEMBERS WOULD BE APPOINTED.

NUMBER OF POLITICIANS ASSERTED, SOME FOR PUBLICATION, THAT KHOMEINI HAD DROPPED PLANS FOR CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY TO BE ELECTED FROM COUNTRY AT LARGE (AS VIRTUALLY ALL HAD THOUGHT WOULD BE CASE) BECAUSE ISLAMIC CONSTITUTION WOULD NOT GAIN A MAJORITY, OSTENSIBLY "FOR ETHNIC REASONS," (I.E., BECAUSE MINORITIES WOULD OBJECT). POLITICAL GROUPS' SUSPICIONS OF KHOMEINI INTENTIONS HAVE SHARPLY INCREASED IN PAST FEW DAYS. NATIONAL DEMOCRATIC FRONT'S MATIN-DAFTARI HAS CRITICIZED NARROWNESS OF CONSTITUTIONAL PROCESS.

DEMOCRATIC PARTY LEADER ABDOL HUSSEIN BAGHAI TOLD PRESS CONFERENCE THAT PLACING POWER IN THE HANDS OF THE CLERGY WOULD "CAUSE ARGUMENT." IN ANOTHER SERIOUS DEFECTION FROM GOVERNMENT, RADICAL MOVEMENT LEADER RAHMATOLLAH MOGHADDAM MARAGHEI RESIGNED AS PROVINCIAL GOVERNOR OF EAST AZARBAIJAN, CHARGING THAT DUAL STRUCTURE OF GOVERNMENT MADE IT IMPOSSIBLE TO FUNCTION. PARS PROVINCIAL GOVERNOR HAS REPORTEDLYRESIGNED FOR SIMILAR REASONS AS WELL.

EVEN WITHIN KHOMEINI CAMP, OPINION IS SHARPLY DIVIDED ON PROPER ARRANGEMENTS TO PRODUCE A CONSTITUTION. MEMBER OF KHOMEINI COMMITTEE FOR NIAVARAN TOLD POLOFF AT DINNER WHICH INCLUDED TWO OTHER SENIOR FIGURES IN NORTHERN COMMITTEE STRUCTURE THAT MOST MODERNISTS IN MOVEMENT FEARED "QOM GROUP" WAS GETTING READY TO IMPOSE A TRUE SEVENTH CENTURY CONSTITUTION WHICH MIGHT NOT EVEN INCLUDE BASIC MODERN PARLIAMENTARY STRUCTURE. IT WAS CLEAR THAT SUCH A DEVELOPMENT WOULD POSE SEVERE INTERNAL STRESS FOR THE KHOMEINI COMMITTEEMEN, AS WELL AS MANY OTHERS WHO HAVE SUPPORTED KHOMEINI UNTIL NOW.

EVEN PM BAZARGAN IN AN INTERVIEW CARRIED ON NIRT MAY 28, IN WHICH HE SET OUT HIS VIEWS ON THE FORM THE CONSTITUTION SHOULD TAKE SEEMED TO EXPRESS ------------------085063 291319Z /43 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1700 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY BONN AMEMBASSY CAIRO AMCONSUL DHAHRAN AMEMBASSY DOHA AMCONSUL FRANKFURT AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KHARTOUM AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY NEW DELHI AMEMBASSY PARIS AMEMBASSY BEIJING AMEMBASSY RABAT USLO RIYADH AMEMBASSY ROME AMEMBASSY TOKYO USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE CINCPAC HONOLULU HI USDOCOSOUTH NAPLES IT SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 05555 A SENSE OF FOREBODING THAT KHOMEINI IS TRYING TO RAM A DOCUMENT THROUGH THAT WILL NOT CONTAIN THE KINDS OF PROVISIONS BAZARGAN SEES AS ESSENTIAL BOTH FOR THE PROTECTION OF BASIC FREEDOMS AND WORKABILITY.

MOST VOCIFEROUS IN OPPOSING SUCH A DEVELOPMENT WOULD BE THE UNIVERSITY INTELLECTUALS, AND THE LEFTIST PARTIES, WITH THE SECULAR POLITICIANS OF THE NATIONAL FRONT, NATIONAL DEMOCRATIC FRONT AND THE SMALLER SOCIALIST-STYLE PARTIES NOT FAR BEHIND. WE SUSPECT PRO-MONARCHIST ELEMENTS HAVE BEEN STIMULATING TALK OF CONFLICT AND WOULD SHARPLY INCREASE THEIR ORGANIZATIONAL EFFORTS.

BY-PRODUCT OF THE ABOVE IS INCREASING TALK OF POSSIBLE SHAKE-UP IN PGOI OR, ALTERNATIVELY, A COUP FOR JUNE 5, SIXTEENTH ANNIVERSARY OF THE SUPPRESSION OF THE 1963 RELIGIOUS RIOTS BY MILITARY FORCE (EVENT WHICH LED TO KHOMEINI'S EXILE). SO FAR AS WE CAN TELL, THESE ARE JUST RUMORS, BUT THEY ARE SPREADING AS PEOPLE PERCEIVE A PATTERN OF CONFLICT DEVELOPING OVER QUESTION OF NEW CONSTITUTION.

EVEN SPEECH BY NIOC HEAD (AND PRESIDENT OF BAR ASSOCIATION) HASSAN NAZIH CHALLENGING PRIME MINISTER'S CLAIM THAT IRAN IS POOR AND CALLING FOR RULE OF LAW IS SEEN AS EVIDENCE OF CONFLICT WITHIN PGOI AND HAS LED TO RUMOR THAT NAZIH MAY BE ON THE WAY OUT. (EMBOFFS HAVE HEARD SAME THING FROM NIOC SOURCES FOR ABOUT TWO WEEKS.)

COMMENT: POT IS BEGINNING TO BOIL HERE. IT IS BECOMING INCREASINGLY CLEAR THAT DEBATE OVER CONSTITUTION ITSELF AND ON WAY IT WILL BE RATIFIED AND APPROVED IS LIKELY TO BRING TO THE SURFACE THE POLITICAL DIFFERENCES BETWEEN SUPPORTERS OF THE REVOLUTION WHICH HAVE THUS FAR REMAINED LATENT (REF B). IT IS UNLIKELY THAT THE U.S. WILL ESCAPE ATTENTION AS THIS PROCESS UNFOLDS, PARTICULARLY SINCE THE HARD-LINE ISLAMIC CAMP APPEARS BENT ON MAKING THE U.S. AT LEAST A SMALL PART OF THE ARGUMENT THROUGH CHARGES OF INTERVENTION IN THE IRANIAN POLITICAL PROCESS.

RECENT ANTI-AMERICAN DEMONSTRATIONS AND PRONOUNCEMENTS IN IRAN ALONG WITH INCIDENTS IN WHICH AMERICAN BUSINESSMEN HAVE BEEN SUBJECTED TO VARYING DEGREES OF HARASSMENT CALL FOR A RESTATEMENT OF THE EMBASSY'S GUIDANCE ON AMERICAN BUSINESS TRAVEL TO IRAN. THE FOLLOWING STATEMENT, UPDATING REFS A AND B, IS NOT MEANT TO INVALIDATE THE GENERAL ADVISORY AGAINST TRAVEL TO IRAN OR THE IMPLICATIONS OF THE EMBASSY'S E & E STATUS, I.E., PHASE THREE. IT RECOGNIZES THAT THE DECISION TO TRAVEL BELONGS TO THE FIRM OR INDIVIDUAL BUT SUGGESTS FACTORS WHICH WE BELIEVE SHOULD BE TAKEN INTO CONSIDERATION IN MAKING THAT DECISION.
THE DIFFICULTIES IN SUCH GUIDANCE ARE THE UNFORESEEN EVENTS IN THIS STILL-UNSTABLE, DYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT, AS WELL AS THE FACTORS UNIQUE TO ANY ONE FIRM.

MANY U.S. BUSINESSMEN HAVE RETURNED TO IRAN SINCE THE REVOLUTION; A NUMBER STAYED THROUGHOUT THE FEBRUARY DIFFICULTIES AND HAVE SINCE GONE OUT AND RETURNED. FEW, HOWEVER, ARE IN "PERMANENT" STATUS, AND DEPENDENTS ARE RARE. INCIDENTS OF DETENTION, PASSPORT CONFISCATION AND HARASSMENT ARE FEW BUT CANNOT BE IGNORED. IN THE LAST TWO WEEKS OF MAY THERE WERE AT LEAST SIX CASES OF AMERICAN BUSINESSMEN WHO EXPERIENCED EMPLOYEE THREATS FROM IRANIAN EMPLOYEES, CONFISCATION OF PASSPORT, TEMPORARY DETENTION OR PROHIBITION FROM LEAVING THE COUNTRY. ALL INCIDENTS RELATE TO THE BUSINESSMAN'S COMMERCIAL ACTIVITY AND NOT TO INTERNAL SECURITY.

APART FROM BUSINESS RELATIONS, WE HAVE HAD FEW CASES REPORTED OF EVEN ORAL HARASSMENT (E.G., ON THE STREETS) AND NONE OF A PHYSICAL NATURE. ANTI-FOREIGN AND SPECIFICALLY ANTI-AMERICAN SENTIMENT IS EVIDENT BUT IS SELDOM EXPRESSED IN PERSONAL, BUSINESS ENCOUNTERS. THERE HAVE BEEN SOME REPORTS, HOWEVER, BY BUSINESSMEN WHO PERCEIVE AS ANTI-AMERICAN ACT DIFFICULTIES IN OBTAINING APPOINTMENTS OR INORDINATE DELAYS IN ACCOMPLISHING ROUTINE ACTIONS.

ADVISORY ON IF ASKED BASIS: THE EMBASSY ADVISES AGAINST PROMOTIONAL BUSINESS TRAVEL AT THIS TIME UNLESS A DIRECT IRANIAN INVITATION HAS BEEN RECEIVED. TRAVEL IN CONNECTION WITH PENDING BUSINESS IN IRAN MAY BE NECESSARY FOR REASONS SUCH AS TO MEET LOCAL OBLIGATIONS, DETERMINE THE STATUS OF CONTRACTS AND CLARIFY FINANCES. BEFORE TRAVELING, ONE SHOULD ASCERTAIN TO THE EXTENT POSSIBLE WHETHER OR NOT THERE IS ACTIVE EMPLOYEE AGITATION WITHIN HIS IRANIAN OFFICE WHICH COULD RESULT IN A CONFRONTATION, WHETHER THERE ARE CHARGES OF ANY NATURE BY THE AUTHORITIES AGAINST HIS FIRM AND, IN GENERAL, THE SECURITY CLIMATE OF THE FIRM.

THE UNFORESEEN COMPLAINT BY A PRESENT OR EVEN FORMER IRANIAN EMPLOYEE OF THE FIRM IS A RISK THAT MUST BE TAKEN INTO ACCOUNT. FIRMS WHICH ARE IN JOINT VENTURES IN IRAN SHOULD TAKE MORE SERIOUSLY THE IMPLICATIONS OF CONTINUED ABSENCE FROM IRAN, PARTICULARLY IN LIGHT OF THE PGOI EDICT WHICH IN EFFECT MANDATES INTERVENTION OF FIRMS IN WHICH MANAGEMENT IS ABSENT. UNLESS THEY HAVE GOOD REASON TO EXPECT SERIOUS INCIDENTS UPON THEIR RETURN TO IRAN, THEY WOULD DO WELL TO MAKE AT LEAST AN EXPLORATORY VISIT. IN GENERAL, U.S.

BUSINESS TRAVEL, EXCEPT PERHAPS IN THE CASE OF A MANAGING DIRECTOR OF A FIRM IN IRAN, IS BEST FOR SHORT DURATIONS WITH LIMITED OBJECTIVES. TRAVELERS ARE URGED TO CONTACT THE EMBASSY UPON ARRIVAL AND MAINTAIN PERIODIC CONTACT THROUGHOUT THEIR VISIT. THE EMBASSY WILL PROVIDE ITS CURRENT SECURITY ASSESSMENT, INCLUDING TRAVEL OUTSIDE TEHRAN, AND TO THE EXTENT STAFF AND ACCESS PERMIT, ASSIST IN RESOLVING MISUNDERSTANDINGS AND INTERPRETING THE
(C - ENTIRE TEXT; REPORTING CABLE.)

PERSIAN PRESS MORNING MAY 30 REPORTED MEETING BETWEEN CHIEF REVOLUTIONARY PROSECUTOR MEHDI HADAVI AND VISITING FRENCH LAWYER SERGE KLARSFELD AT WHICH HADAVI SAID THERE WERE ONLY TWO JEWS AWAITING TRIAL--AZIZ (BELIEVED TO BE PARVIZ) HA'I AND ALBERT DANIELPOUR. ACCORDING TO PRESS, PAIR WERE ACCUSED OF AIDING ISRAEL.
PRESS PREVIOUS DAY INDICATED HADAVI HAD TOLD KLARSFELD THAT ANYONE WHO PUT INFORMATION OR MONEY AT THE DISPOSAL OF ISRAEL WOULD BE LIABLE FOR PROSECUTION.

COMMENT: WE WILL BE MAKING CONTACT EITHER LATER TODAY OR TOMORROW WITH FRENCH EMBOFFS. JUST PRIOR TO KLARSFELD VISIT, FRENCH POLOFF HAD EXHIBITED SOME MISGIVINGS ABOUT HIS COMING TO TEHRAN AT THIS TIME. ONE PERSIAN OBSERVER NOTED THAT TIMING OF VISIT WAS PARTICULARLY UNFORTUNATE SINCE "CLARIFICATIONS" ELICITED WERE LIKELY TO HARDEN REVOLUTIONARY COURT'S POSITION TOWARD IRANIAN JEWISH MINORITY RATHER THAN TO EASE IT IN WAKE OF REACTION TO U.S. SENATE RESOLUTION. WE CONTINUE TO BELIEVE BETWEEN EIGHT AND FIFTEEN IRANIAN JEWS REMAIN IN JAIL, BUT IT IS INTERESTING AND PERHAPS HOPEFUL THAT REVOLUTIONARY PROSECUTOR WOULD ONLY IDENTIFY TWO AS LIABLE TO TRIAL AT THIS POINT.
NATURE AND VAGUENESS OF CHARGES, HOWEVER, IS LIKELY TO SET OFF NEW ROUND OF FEAR AND UNCERTAINTY AMONG
GSUBJECT: DISTURBANCES IN KHUZESTAN (C - ENTIRE TEXT; REPORTING CABLE.)

TROUBLE HAS BEEN BREWING IN THE KHUZESTAN PROVINCE PORT CITY OF KHORRAMSHAHR FOR SOME TIME WITH ATTEMPTS BY GOVERNMENT FORCES TO DISARM THE MANY INDIVIDUALS WHO ACQUIRED WEAPONS IMMEDIATELY AFTER THE COLLAPSE OF THE PAHLAVI REGIME IN FEBRUARY, SIT-INS AND OTHER PROTEST ACTIONS CONDUCTED BY THE LOCAL ARAB POPULATION, AND THREATS BY THEIR LEADER, AYATOLLAH KHAGHANI, TO LEAVE THE COUNTRY IF ARAB DEMANDS WERE NOT MET. TODAY, MAY 30, THAT TROUBLE APPARENTLY HAS BURST INTO THE OPEN.

THE ITALIAN CONSULAR AGENT IN KHORRAMSHAHR REPORTED EARLIER THIS MORNING THAT KHORRAMSHAHR WAS A "RAGING INFERNO." TELEPHONE CONTACT WITH THE CITY HAS BEEN CUT BECAUSE, AS ONE TELEPHONE ORGANIZATION EMPLOYEE TOLD THE ITALIAN EMBASSY, "THERE IS A WAR GOING ON THERE." WE WILL REPORT MORE DETAILS AS THEY BECOME AVAILABLE.

1979TEHRAN05612.subject: KHORRAMSHAHR: ALL FALL DOWN GO BOOM*

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT; REPORTING CABLE.)

SUMMARY: INTENSE FIGHTING AND RIOTING CONTINUING IN KHORRAMSHAHR THROUGH EARLY AFTERNOON MAY 30. ARAB CITIZENS CHALLENGING LAW AND ORDER, BURNING TOWN, AND PLANNING TRUCK MARCH ON OIL FIELDS. SHOOTING TRIGGERED INCIDENT, CASUALTIES EXTENSIVE. SIGNS INDICATE RESTLESSNESS EXISTS IN OTHER AREAS AS WELL. END SUMMARY.
FROM SOURCES IN KHORRAMSHAHR WHO HAVE CALLED TEHRAN, WE HAVE PIECED TOGETHER PICTURE OF WHAT HAS HAPPENED IN KHORRAMSHAHR OVER PAST TWENTY-FOUR HOURS TO SUPPLEMENT INITIAL INFO IN REFTEL.

KHORRAMSHAHR SWEDISH CONSUL DESCRIBED EVENTS AT NOON MAY 30 TO HIS CHARGE IN TEHRAN AS FOLLOWS: ABOUT 1600 LOCAL MAY 29, TWO ARAB CITIZENS OF CITY WERE ARGUING WITH GATEKEEPER AT KHORRAMSHAHR PORT, WHERE PROTRACTED LABOR UNREST HAS WORKED GENERALLY TO EXACERBATE TENSIONS. REVOLUTIONARY GUARDSMAN ENTERED DISCUSSION AND ENDED IT BY KILLING BOTH MEN. WITNESSES MOBILIZED ARAB COMMUNITY, WHICH HAS BEEN RESTIVE OVER PAST TWO MONTHS IN ANY CASE, AND GROUP PROCEEDED TO ATTACK PORT AND PUBLIC BUILDINGS. ONE SOURCE TOLD SWEDISH CONSUL THAT PORT DIRECTOR HAD BEEN CAPTURED BY MOB AND WAS BEING HELD HOSTAGE. ABOUT 0400 MAY 30, ARAB MOB BEGAN ATTACKING POLICE STATION. GUN BATTLE HAS CONTINUED.

AT DAYLIGHT, MOB BEGAN BURNING BUILDINGS. GUNFIRE CONTINUED HEAVY UNTIL PAST NOON AND WAS STILL GOING ON AS OF MID-AFTERNOON. . KHORRAMSHAHR BUSINESS ASSOCIATE OF LOCAL EMPLOYEE'S COUSIN CALLED FROM HIS OFFICE TO INFORM COUSIN IN TEHRAN THAT BUILDING WAS BEING BURNED OUT FROM UNDER HIM AT NOON. KHORRAMSHAHR SOURCE SAID MOB APPEARED REASONABLY WELL ORGANIZED AND WAS BURNING MUCH OF TOWN. NEXT PLANNED STEP WAS TO COMMANDEER TRUCKS AND MOVE ON TO OIL FIELDS AND WREAK HAVOC THERE (NEAREST MAJOR OIL FIELDS ARE 75 MILES AWAY, HOWEVER, SO THREAT MAY NOT BE AS SERIOUS AS IT SOUNDS).

LOCAL RADIO REPORTS FOUR DEAD, 17 WOUNDED, BUT EYEWITNESSES SAID KNOWN DEAD THAT THEY COULD SEE WERE AROUND TWENTY, AND SWEDISH CONSUL REPORTS HOSPITALS ARE FILLING UP FAST; HE ESTIMATED SEVERAL HUNDRED WOUNDED.

THIS INCIDENT COMES AFTER SEVERAL WEEKS OF LABOR UNREST IN OIL FIELDS AND FRICTION BETWEEN ARAB AND PERSIAN RESIDENTS OF KHORRAMSHAHR. PERCEPTIONS OF FIGHT BREWING BETWEEN KHOMEINI'S ISLAMIC MOVEMENT AND OTHERS (MOST ARABS IN KHUZISTAN ARE DIFFERENT SECT OF SHIA FROM BULK OF PERSIANS), INCLUDING SECULAR FORCES.

RUMORS HAVE BEEN GROWING THAT SOME SORT OF ANTIGOVERNMENT ACTION WILL TAKE PLACE EITHER IN TEHRAN OR IN SEVERAL PARTS OF COUNTRY IN NEXT FEW DAYS TO A WEEK. ONE EMPLOYER IN TEHRAN WAS ASKED BY HIS KURDISH EMPLOYEES FOR THEIR SEVERANCE PAY.

1979TEHRAN05632.subject: GLIMPSES OF SOCIAL ATMOSPHERE AND REVOLUTIONARY - MORALITY

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT.)

DURING CONVERSATION WITH EMBASSY OFFICER MAY 29 PARVIZ DANIELPOUR, BROTHER OF DETAINEE ALBERT, DESCRIBED EFFORTS OF HIS AND HAI FAMILY TO OBTAIN RELEASE OF ALBERT AND HIS BROTHER-IN-LAW, PARVIZ HAI. IT WAS NOT A PORTRAYAL OF PEOPLE INTIMIDATED OR IMMOBILIZED BY FRIGHT. HE REPORTED THAT THEY "WERE OUT EVERY DAY FOR THE PAST THREE MONTHS" BUTTONHOLING NOTABLES AND OFFICIALS TRYING TO EFFECT RELEASE. HIS DESCRIPTION INDICATES THAT THE FAMILIES DID NOT FEEL CONSTRAINED BY RELIGION OR OTHER FACTORS FROM RESPONDING ENERGETICALLY TO THE SITUATION. THE FACT THAT THEY FEEL FREE TO ACT SAYS SOMETHING GOOD ABOUT THE SOCIAL AMBIANCE AND ALSO ABOUT THEIR MORALE.

RECENTLY, THE SON OF AN EXECUTED GENERAL, INDICATED TO AN EMBASSY OFFICER THAT HE FELT NO INHIBITION IN PURSUING HIS EFFORTS TO RECOVER FAMILY PROPERTY CONFISCATED BY REVOLUTIONARY AUTHORITIES. IT WAS CLEAR THAT HE DID NOT THINK THAT HE IS CONSIDERED IN ANY WAY TAINTED WITH THE SINS OF HIS FATHER. HE SAID THAT THE ONLY DIFFICULTY HE HAD ENCOUNTERED WAS AN INSUFFICIENCY OF MONEY TO PAY THE BRIBES DEMANDED FOR THE RESTORATION OF THE PROPERTY TO THE FAMILY.

DANIELPOUR REPORTED SIMILARLY THAT IN THE INITIAL RAID ON THE HAI FAMILY OFFICES BY A REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE, A LARGE QUANTITY OF BUSINESS DOCUMENTS WAS CONFISCATED, THE RETURN OF WHICH HAS BEEN PROMISED AGAINST PAYMENT OF A LARGE SUM OF MONEY. PLUS CA CHANGE, ... NAAS
(C - ENTIRE TEXT; REPORTING MESSAGE)
SUMMARY: THE NOMINATION OF AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI FOR PRESIDENT OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC IS GAINING SUPPORT. NOMINATION BEING USED ALSO AGAINST NIRT'S POLICIES. END SUMMARY.

SINCE THE NOMINATION OF AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI FOR PRESIDENT BY MASUD RAJAVI, SPOKESMAN OF THE MUJAHEDDIN KHALQ ON MAY 25, A LARGE NUMBER OF ORGANIZATIONS, PRIMARILY STUDENT AND LEFTIST, BUT INCLUDING SOME CENTER-OFTHE-ROAD GROUPS, HAVE CLIMBED ON THE BANDWAGON. THE ISLAMIC STUDENTS ORGANIZATION, THE MOSLEM STUDENTS OF THE POLYTECHNIC, INDUSTRIAL, AND SCIENCE AND INDUSTRY UNIVERSITIES IN TEHRAN HAVE ALL ENDORSED TALEGHANI. THE STUDENT WING OF THE MUJAHEDDIN KHALQ AT SEVEN OTHER UNIVERSITIES AROUND THE COUNTRY HAVE ENDORSED HIM. SIX COLLEGES OR FACULTIES OF TEHRAN UNIVERSITY HAVE ALSO CHIMED IN, AS WELL AS TWO "NEIGHBORHOOD ASSOCIATIONS" (APPARENTLY SPEAKING THROUGH THEIR DISTRICT COMMITTEES).

NOTABLY, ALMOST ALL OF THE ENDORSEMENTS HAVE INCLUDA DEMAND THAT RAJAVI'S NOMINATION SPEECH BE BROADCAST BY NATIONAT IRANIAN RADIO AND TELEVISION (NIRT). THIS TIES IN WITH WIDESPREAD ATTACKS ON NIRT CHIEF QOTBZADEH FOR ALLEGED CENSORSHIP. THE LAWYER'S ASSOCIATION, THE KURDISH DEMOCRATIC PARTY, ARAB REPRESENTATIVES, AND OTHER GROUPS HAVE CHIMED IN TO DEMAND THAT NIRT GIVE BROADCAST TIME TO ALL POLITICAL PARTIES, ESPECIALLY ON THE ISSUE OF THE PROPOSED CONSTITUTION AND ELECTIONS.

COMMENT: WHILE THE NOMINATION OF TALEGHANI IS SEEN EVERYWHERE AS A DIRECT RESPONSE TO THE NOMINATION BY RELIGIOUS LEADERS QOMI AND KHALKHALI OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI AS PRESIDENT, THE DECLARATIONS ARE CAREFUL TO POINT OUT THAT TALEGHANI HAS "THE FULL TRUST AND CONFIDENCE OF IMAN KHOMEINI." NO ONE IS YET PREPARED TO CHALLENGE KHOMEINI DIRECTLY, BUT EVIDENCE OF OPPOSITION
(C - ENTIRE TEXT; REPORTING CABLE.)

ETHNIC FRICTIONS SEEM TO BE BUILDING IN FARS PROVINCE AS WELL AS IN OTHER AREAS OF IRAN. DURING THE PAST WEEK THERE HAVE BEEN REPORTS OF DISTURBANCES IN MARV DASHT, AN AREA NORTHWEST OF ZARGHAN, NEIRIZ, FASA, DARAB, JAHROM AND DASHT-E-ARZHAN. TO THE EXTENT THAT THERE ARE DETAILS AVAILABLE, MOST OF THESE INCIDENTS APPEAR TO HAVE INVOLVED MEMBERS OF THE NOMADIC TRIBES WHICH INHABIT THE PROVINCE. MOST WERE BETWEEN TRIBES PEOPLE AND VILLAGERS, BUT IN AT LEAST ONE INSTANCE THERE WAS A CLASH BETWEEN TWO TRIBES. NAAS
(C - ENTIRE TEXT; REPORTING CABLE)

SUMMARY: THE EXPLOSION OF KHORRAMSHAHR'S ARAB COMMUNITY OVER THE PAST TWO DAYS WAS A LONG TIME IN THE MAKING. WHILE MANY NON-ARAB IRANIANS ARE QUICK KO BLAME "INTERNATIONAL IMPERIALISM" FOR THE TROUBLES IN KHUZESTAN, "IRANIAN IMPERIALISM" LIES MUCH CLOSER TO THE HEART OF THE MATTER. ARAB MILITANCY ALSO POSES A MAJOR FOREIGN POLICY DILEMMA FOR IRAN. END SUMMARY.

THE MAJORITY OF IRAN'S APPROXIMATELY 2,000,000 ETHNIC ARABS LIVE IN THE PROVINCE OF KHUZESTAN IN SOUTHWESTERN IRAN. THEY CONSTITUTE PERHAPS 60 PERCENT OR MORE OF THE PROVINCE'S TOTAL POPULATION. FOR YEARS THESE ARABS HAVE BEEN SECOND-CLASS CITIZENS IN THEIR OWN HOMELAND. THE PROVINCE'S ECONOMY IS DOMINATED BY OIL WHICH IN TURN IS DOMINATED BY NON-ARAB PERSIANS. WHILE THE PETROLEUM INDUSTRY EMPLOYS LARGE NUMBERS OF ARABS, FEW OCCUPY OTHER THAN THE MOST MENIAL POSITIONS. IN THE PROVINCE'S IMPORTANT COMMERCIAL AND TRANSPORTATION SECTORS, TOO, ARABS HAVE SELDOM BEEN ABLE TO COMPETE SUCCESSFULLY WITH THEIR PERSIAN COUNTRYMEN.

EVEN IN AGRICULTURE THE ARABS HAVE BEEN PUSHED OFF OF MOST OF THE BEST LANDS BY BOTH LARGE GOVERNMENT-BACKED AGROBUSINESSES AND MORE SOPHISTICATED AND AGGRESSIVE SMALL FARMERS FROM THE IRANIAN INTERIOR.

AS SHIAS (ALTHOUGH OF A DIFFERENT SUB-BRANCH OF THE SECT THAN THE MAJORITY OF ETHNIC PERSIANS) THE KHUZESTAN ARABS JOINED AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI'S REVOLUTION AGAINST THE PAHLAVI REGIME. WITH ITS SUCCESS, AND PERHAPS INSPIRED BY THE DEMANDS OF OTHER MINORITIES SUCH AS THE KURDS, THE ARABS HOPED FOR AN INCREASED SHARE OF THE IRANIAN ECONOMIC PIE THAN THEY HAD PREVIOUSLY BEEN ALLOTTED, AS WELL AS A GREATER ROLE IN ADMINISTERING THEIR OWN AFFAIRS THAN WAS PERMITTED UNDER THE PAHLAVIS.

WHILE THE PGOI GAVE HIGH PRIORITY TO RESUMING OIL PRODUCTION, WHICH HAD VIRTUALLY CEASED DURING THE FINAL WEEKS OF THE REVOLUTION, NUMEROUS SUBSIDIARY ACTIVITIES (OFTEN DEPENDENT UPON EXPATRIATE COMPANIES AND PERSONNEL WHO HAD DEPARTED THE COUNTRY) ARE STILL IN A STATE OF SUSPENDED ANIMATION. MASSIVE LAY-OFFS AND UNCERTAINTIES ABOUT THE FUTURE TENDED TO EXACERBATE THE SITUATION, PROVOKING STRIKES AND OTHER LABOR ACTIONS THAT HAMPERED EFFORTS TO RESTORE NORMAL ECONOMIC ACTIVITY.

THAT THE EFFECTS OF THIS PHENOMENON HAVE CUT ACROSS ETHNIC GROUPS HAS BEEN OF LITTLE CONSOLATION TO THE ARABS WHO EXPECTED MORE FROM THE REVOLUTION AND HAVE WOUND UP (AT LEAST IN THE SHORT TERM) WITH LESS THAN THEY HAD BEFORE.

THE ACTIVITIES OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES-THE UNOFFICIAL PARALLEL GOVERNMENT WHICH DOMINATES LOCAL AFFAIRS IN IRAN TODAY--HAVE ALSO BEEN A DISAPPOINTMENT TO THE ARAB COMMUNITY. EVEN IN A CITY LIKE KHORRAMSHAHR, WHICH IS OVERWHELMINGLY ARAB, THE COMMITTEE STRUCTURE HAS BEEN THE PRESERVE OF NON-ARABS. IN MANY INSTANCES THE BEHAVIOR OF COMMITTEE PERSONNEL AND THE IRREGULAR "GUARDIANS OF THE REVOLUTION," THE ARMED AUXILLIARY OF THE COMMITTEE STRUCTURE, HAS BEEN FAR MORE ARBITRARY AND ARROGANT THAN THAT OF THE SHAH'S CIVILIAN BUREAUCRACY AND SECURITY FORCES EVER WAS.

THUS, MAJOR DEMANDS OF THE ARAB COMMUNITY HAVE BEEN ABOLITION OF THE COMMITTEES, RESTORATION OF A REGULAR POLICE FORCE AND PROPORTIONAL REPRESENTATION FOR ARABS IN ANY POPULAR ORGANIZATIONS SUCH AS THE GUARDIANS OF THE REVOLUTION.

SERIOUS TROUBLE IN KHORRAMSHAHR DEVELOPED IN EARLY MAY ------------------117593 311345Z /42 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 1773 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY BEIRUT AMCONSUL DHAHRAN AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY PARIS SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 05674 AS IRAN TERMINAL SERVICES (A PRIVATE FIRM WHICH OPERATES THE PORT) INCREASINGLY WAS UNABLE TO MEET ITS LARGE PAYROLL. SLOWDOWNS BY IRAN TERMINAL EMPLOYEES PROVOKED WALK-OUTS BY THE PORTS AND SHIPPING ORGANIZATION STAFF AS WELL AS THE STAFF OF THE CUSTOMS DEPARTMENT.

BY MAY 13, IN AN ATMOSPHERE OF GROWING UNEMPLOYMENT AND ECONOMIC DISTRESS, AS WELL AS DEEPENING RESENTMENT AMONG LOCAL ARABS TOWARD WHAT THEY REGARDED AS THE SHORT SHRIFT THEY WERE RECEIVING, SERIOUS RIOTING BROKE OUT FOLLOWING A SPEECH BY ARAB RELIGIOUS LEADER SHEIKH MOHAMMAD TAHER AL SHOBEIR KHAGHANI.

IN THE WAKE OF THE DISTURBANCE THE PROVINCIAL GOVERNOR GENERAL, ADM. AHMAD MADANI, PROMISED THAT COMMITTEES WOULD BE DISSOLVED AND IRREGULARS WOULD BE DISARMED. THE PGOI, WHICH HAS LITTLE COERCIVE POWER AVAILABLE TO IT, ALMOST IMMEDIATELY BEGAN HEDGING ON BOTH PLEDGES. ON MAY 27 KHAGHANI TRAVELED TO QOM WHERE HE EXTRACTED SEVERAL PROMISES FROM KHOMEINI INCLUDING ONE THAT THE KHUZESTAN ARABS WOULD BE GIVEN A GREATER VOICE IN RUNNING THEIR OWN AFFAIRS. HE RETURNED TO KHORRAMSHAHR MAY 28 WHERE HE MET WITH MADANI WHO REITERATED HIS PLEDGE TO DISARM THE IRREGULARS.

IN WHAT WOULD APPEAR TO HAVE BEEN A TACTICAL ERROR, MADANI'S FIRST TARGET WAS AN ARAB ORGANIZATION WHOSE MEMBERS WERE HEAVILY ARMED AND BARRICADED IN A DOWNTOWN KHORAMSHAHR BUILDING. THEY HAD NO TROUBLE IN REPULSING THE UNDERMANNED GOVERNMENT FORCE SENT TO DISARM THEM.

THE INCIDENT WHICH ACTUALLY SET OFF RENEWED RIOTING ON MAY 29 WAS THE ONE WHICH OCCURRED AT THE PORT REPORTED IN REFTEL, BUT TENSIONS HAD BEEN SO HEIGHTENED BY THE EARLIER ABORTIVE ATTEMPT TO DISARM THE MILITANT ARABS THAT FIGHTING QUICKLY SPREAD THROUGHOUT THE CITY. (AN INCIDENT IN NEIGHBORING ABADAN IN WHICH AT LEAST THREE WERE REPORTEDLY KILLED ON MAY 30 MAY HAVE ALSO BEEN RELATED TO WHAT WAS THEN HAPPENING IN KHORRAMSHAHR.) GUN BATTLES AND ARSONIST ATTACKS CONTINUED MOST OF THE DAY MAY 30 IN KHORRAMSHAHR. MILITARY FORCES WERE BROUGHT IN AND MADANI DECLARED A STATE OF EMERGENCY AT MID-AFTERNOON.
BY EVENING A DEGREE OF CALM HAD BEEN RESTORED, BUT IT WAS YOUTHFUL IRREGULARS RATHER THAN PGOI FORCES WHO SEEMED TO BE IN CONTROL OF THE STREETS.

THE ARABS REPORTEDLY HAVE MADE TWO DEMANDS IN RESPONSE TO THE FIGHTING OF THE LAST TWO DAYS, I.E., THAT THE IRREGULARS BE DISARMED AND THAT MADANI BE REMOVED. THEY APPARENTLY HAVE THREATENED TO DISRUPT OIL PRODUCTION AND EXPORTS IF THE DEMANDS ARE NOT MET. IF THEY ARE SERIOUS IN THIS THREAT, AND WE HAVE NO REASON TO DOUBT THAT THEY ARE, THEY HAVE CONSIDERABLE CAPABILITY FOR CARRYING IT OUT. IN AN INTERVIEW BROADCAST MAY 30 BUT CONDUCTED THE EVENING BEFORE MADANI BLAMED "INTERNATIONAL IMPERIALISM" FOR THE TROUBLES IN KHORRAMSHAHR.
IN ACTUALITY, GIVEN THE LONG HISTORY OF ARAB OPPRESSION IN KHUZESTAN AT THE HANDS OF THE PERSIANS, HE AND THE PGOI MIGHT DO WELL TO LOOK A LITTLE CLOSER TO HOME FOR THE CAUSE.

THE GROWING MILITANCY AMONG THE KHUZESTAN ARABS AS WELL AS SUSPICIONS (AND EVEN SOME CONCRETE INDICATIONS) THAT INTERESTED ARAB PARTIES OUTSIDE IRAN MAY BE TEMPTED TO TAKE ADVANTAGE OF THE SITUATION POSES A MAJOR POLICY DILEMMA FOR IRAN. THE PGOI, OR AT LEAST CERTAIN SENIOR MEMBERS INCLUDING PM BAZARGAN, IS DEEPLY CONCERENED ABOUT THE POSSIBILITY OF IRAQI, LIBYAN OR PLO INTERFERENCE IN THE PROVINCE. KHOMEINI, ON THE OTHER HAND, HAS BEEN GENERALLY OBLIVIOUS TO THE POTENTIAL FOR RADICAL ARAB TROUBLE-MAKING.
IT WAS HIS DECISION TO ALLOW THE PLO TO SET UP AN OFFICE IN AHWAZ, A MOVE THAT HORRIFIED MANY IRANIANS MORE SENSITIVE TO THE ETHNIC RIVALRIES AND RESENTMENTS WHICH PERMEATE KHUZESTAN.

NOT KNOWING THE IDENTITY OF THE INTERMEDIARY OR NAMES OF PUTATIVE EMISSARIES FROM SHARIATMADARI AND TELEGHANI PUTS US AT A SEVERE DISADVANTAGE TO COMMENT. HOWEVER, WE RECOMMEND CAUTION AND GREAT CARE IN HANDLING APPROACH. AS YOU HAVE SEEN IN OUR REPORTING, THE RELIGIOUS FRONT AT THIS TIME IS SPLIT WITH SHARIATMADARI AND TELEGHANI OPENLY OPPOSING KHOMEINI'S PROCEDURES FOR APPROVAL OF CONSTITUTION. THE FRICTION BETWEEN THE VARIOUS AYATOLLAH CAMPS COULD BECOME QUITE SEVERE IN THE NEXT FEW WEEKS.

THE VISIT BY EMISSARIES IS NOT LIKELY TO REMAIN CONFIDENTIAL AND UNLESS THE IDEA INDEED HAD KHOMEINI'S BLESSING WE WOULD AGAIN BE CHARGED WITH GROSS INTERFERENCE IN INTERNAL AFFAIRS WITH THE POSSIBILITY OF A BREAK IN RELATIONS.

I AM ALSO CURIOUS WHY APPROACH WAS MADE IN WASHINGTON AND NOT HERE IF IT IS INDEED BONA FIDE. WE HAVE GOOD CHANNEL TO TELEGHANI FAMILY AND SHARIATMADARI KNOWS HOW TO GET IN TOUCH WITH US IF NECESSARY. IRANIANS HAVE A PENCHANT FOR SETTING THEMSELVES UP AS INTERMEDIARIES AND THEN, AFTER GETTING APPROVAL OF THEIR IDEA WITH ONE PARTY, WORKING BACKWARD TO THE ALLEGED ORIGINATOR OF THE APPROACH. THEY MAY ALSO THINK IT EASIER TO WORK ON US TO REMAIN PATIENT THAN TO ADDRESS THE CAUSE OF THE PROBLEM DIRECTLY IN THEIR OWN COUNTRY.
WE EXPERIENCE THIS SORT OF THING ALMOST DAILY BECAUSE IRANIANS STILL BELIEVE WE CARRY GREAT WEIGHT IN INTERNAL AFFAIRS.

AT SAME TIME WE SHOULD NOT CUT OFF POSSIBILITY OF USEFUL DIALOGUE AND THE OBJECTIVE IS CERTAINLY ADMIRABLE. WE SUGGEST THAT INTERMEDIARY BE ASKED TO GIVE CONVINCING EVIDENCE THAT HE IN FACT SPEAKS FOR THE TWO AYATOLLAHS, THAT HIS INITIATIVE IS AT THEIR BEHEST, AND THAT KHOMEINI IS IN FACT AWARE OF AND IS NOT OPPOSED TO HIS APPNOACH. ALSO, HE SHOULD BE PRESSED FOR IDENTITY OF EMISSARIES. AFTER YOU HAVE DONE ABOVE, I WILL BE IN BETTER POSITION TO COMMENT WHETHER PRIME MINISTER SHOULD BE MADE PRIVEY TO APPROACH. NAAS

1979TEHRAN05711.subject: POSSIBLE DEMONSTRATION AT AMERICAN EMBASSY - TEHRAN JUNE 5, 1979

segments.text: TEHRAN JUNE 5, 1979 (C - ENTIRE TEXT.)

SEVERAL SOURCES HAVE STATED THAT JUNE 5 COULD BE A DIFFICULT DAY AT AMERICAN EMBASSY TEHRAN BECAUSE MASS DEMONSTRATIONS HAVE BEEN CALLED BY VARIOUS GROUPS. THE PURPOSE OF THE DEMONSTRATIONS IS TO CELEBRATE THE ANNIVERSARY OF THE 15TH OF KHORAD (JUNE 1963). ON THIS DATE IN 1963 THERE WAS AN ABORTIVE UPRISING AGAINST THE FORMER SHAH LED BY KHOMEINI.
ONE LARGE GROUP OF DEMONSTRATORS WILL PASS IN FRONT OF THE CHANCERY (ON TUESDAY MORNING) ON THEIR WAY TO SEPAH SQUARE.

EMBASSY AGAIN PLANS TO ASK MFA OF PGOI TO REINFORCE OUR PRESENT MUJAHEDIN GROUP. MSG WILL BE IN PLACE ON DATE OF DEMONSTRATION AND IF THREAT APPEARS TO BE MATERIALIZING, EMERGENCY INTERNAL DEFENSE PLANS WILL
(C - ENTIRE TEXT; REPORTING CABLE.)

SUMMARY: VILLAGERS NEARBY TEHRAN ARE UNIMPRESSED WITH POLITICAL ACTIVITY IN CAPITAL. THEY BASICALLY WANT A LITTLE MORE RELIGION IN LIFE AND GOVERNMENT TO WORK FOR THEM. SOME UNAWARE SHAH GONE FOR GOOD, MOST SEE SOME SORT OF STRONG LEADER EMERGING, BUT DON'T SEE KHOMEINI IN THIS VEIN. REVOLUTIONARY PRESENCE MINIMAL, ECONOMIC CONCERN PARAMOUNT. END SUMMARY.

POLOFF TOOK ADVANTAGE OF WARMING JUNE WEATHER TO PAY RETURN VISIT TO SEVERAL VILLAGES TO EAST OF TEHRAN, WHERE HE HAD PICNICKED WITH FAMILY IN FALL OF 1978 (REFTELS/ AIRGRAMS DESTROYED). AT THAT TIME, VILLAGERS WERE RELATIVELY UNCONCERNED ABOUT REVOLUTIONARY UPHEAVAL IN CITIES AND THOUGHT COMPROMISE BETWEEN KHOMEINI AND SHAH WOULD BE WORKED OUT.

RETURN VISIT INDICATED VILLAGERS HAVE NOT RPT NOT BECOME MUCH MORE POLITICIZED, DESPITE CONSTANT HEAVY DOSES OF REVOLUTIONARY POLITICS OVER PAST EIGHT MONTHS. ONLY A FEW HAVE RADIOS, AND THEY ARE UNDERWHELMED BY POSTREVOLUTIONARY RADIO PROGRAMMING. IDEOLOGICAL INVECTIVE HAS MADE LITTLE DENT HERE, EVEN 10-15 MILES FROM TEHRAN, AND EVEN MORE LITERATE VILLAGE LEADERS ARE STILL MUCH MORE CONCERNED WITH VILLAGE AFFAIRS THAN WITH NATIONAL POLITICS. THEY ARE PLEASED THAT RELIGION IS BEING GIVEN NEW PROMINENCE, BUT STILL LOOK TO THE GOVERNMENT TO DO THINGS FOR THEM.

THOSE WITH WHOM POLOFF TALKED WERE MILDLY SURPRISED TO FIND AMERICANS STILL IN IRAN, BEING UNDER THE IMPRESSION THAT ALL HAD LEFT, AND BEING VAGUELY AWARE OF TALK IN RECENT DAYS ABOUT BREAK IN RELATIONS. ALL EXPRESSED DESIRE THAT AMERICANS REMAIN, AND TROTTED OUT THEIR FAVORITE "AMERICAN" STORIES FOR BENEFIT OF VISITORS. SEVERAL WERE UNAWARE THAT SHAH HAD "GONE FOR GOOD," AND SEVERAL EXPECTED HIM BACK AFTER DEAL HAD BEEN ARRANGED WITH KHOMEINI.

AWARE VILLAGERS WHO HAD COME TO CONCLUSION SHAH WOULD NOT BE COMING BACK DO NOT SEE KHOMEINI IN POLITICAL LEADER'S ROLE; "HE IS A MAN OF THE MOSYUE; THE GOVERNMENT NEEDS A MAN OF THE PALACE." MOST SEE A STRONG LEADER EMERGING, SEVERAL WERE PARTIAL TO CROWN PRINCE'S CHANCES OF ASCENDING THE PEACOCK THRONE. IT WAS CLEAR THAT IDEA OF ISLAMIC REPUBLIC WITHOUT SOME KIND OF KING HAD NOT MADE MUCH HEADWAY HERE YET, AT LEAST AS CONCEPT IS DISCUSSED IN TEHRAN AND OTHER CITIES.

POLOFF HAD FOUND TOKEN LIBERATION MOVEMENT PRESENCE IN VILLAGES LAST FALL, AND THIS HAD REMAINED. WHILE LOCAL MULLAH WAS OBVIOUSLY PLAYING AN IMPORTANT ROLE, HE HAD DONE SO PREVIOUSLY. SINGLE REVOLUTIONARY GUARD, WHO APPARENTLY ALTERNATES BETWEEN THREE VILLAGES, WAS NICELOOKING YOUNG KID WHO WAS TREATED WITH AFFECTIONATE AMUSEMENT BY VILLAGERS, MOST OF WHOM HAD KNOWN HIM ALL HIS LIFE. HE WAS HARDLY IDEOLOGICAL HEAVY SOMETIMES FOUND AMONG HIS COUNTERPARTS IN TEHRAN. VILLAGE GOVERNMENTAL STRUCTURE APPEARED TO HAVE REMAINED ABOUT THE SAME. IN THREE VILLAGES, PERHAPS TWO OFFICIALS HAD LEFT, BUT IT WAS DIFFICULT TO TELL IF THIS WAS BECAUSE OF REVOLUTION OR OTHER REASONS.

VILLAGERS WERE AWARE OF SOME CHANGES FURTHER UP THE GOVERNING SCALE (WHAT POLOFF TOOK TO BE ROUGHLY FARMANDAR LEVEL) AND WERE NOT MUCH IMPRESSED BY NEW GROUP. LOCAL MULLAH THOUGHT HE WAS BEING CROWDED A BIT BY GREATER ACTIVITY AMONG OTHER RELIGIOUS LEADERS, BUT SEEMED TO ACCEPT THIS AS CONCOMITANT FACT OF LIFE IN REVOLUTIONARY SITUATION.

WOMEN IN THIS AREA HAD BEEN CHADOUR WEARERS BEFORE REVOLUTION, AND THERE APPEARED LITTLE CHANGE IN THEIR STATUS, THOUGH OF COURSE SHORT VISIT GAVE LITTLE OPPORTUNITY FOR THOROUGH EXAMINATION. CHILDREN WERE ABOUT, AND ECONOMIC OUTLOOK FOR AREA WAS QUITE GOOD, SINCE RAINS HAD BEEN FAIRLY PLENTIFUL, WATER SUPPLIES SEEMED ADEQUATE FOR SUMMER, AND GRAZING GRASS FOR GOATS AND SHEEP LOOKED VERY HEALTHY. AT THIS LEVEL, THERE HAS BEEN NO REAL SHORTAGE OF GOODS TO DATE, THOUGH TWO INDIVIDUALS COMMENTED THAT SPARE PARTS FOR CARS, TRUCKS, ETC., WERE BECOMING HARD TO FIND OR EXPENSIVE OR BOTH.

COMMENT: GENERAL PICTURE OF LIFE WAS STATUS YUO. REVOLUTION HAD NOT RPT NOT AFFECTED THIS AREA MUCH, AND VILLAGERS APPEARED TO DISMISS REVOLUTIONARY RHETORIC WITH SAME FACILITY THEY DISMISSED IMPERIAL PRONOUNCEMENTS ON POLITICS. CONTRARY TO EXPECTATIONS OF POLOFF, KHOMEINI HAD NOT MADE MUCH OF AN IMPRESSION HERE--HE WAS RECOGNIZED ------------------023306 031459Z /44 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 1809 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 05728 AS NATIONAL LEADER, BUT NOT CANONIZED.

FINALITY OF SHAH'S DEPARTURE, ACCEPTED AS FACT IN MORE ACTIVE URBAN POLITICAL CIRCLES, HAD NOT YET BEEN FULLY ACCEPTED, AT LEAST PARTLY BECAUSE SHREWD OLD VILLAGERS KEEP EXPECTING SOME SORT OF A DEAL BETWEEN SHAH AND THE MOSYUE TO BE ARRANGED IN TIMEHONORED PERSIAN TRADITION. IT SEEMS FAIR TO SAY THAT THERE WILL BE NO GROUNDSWELL OF RURAL ACTIVISM ON BEHALF OF ANYONE BY THESE VILLAGERS. THEY WANT TO GET ON WITH THE BUSINESS OF LIVING WITH MINIMAL INTERFERENCE AND AS MUCH HELP AS POSSIBLE FROM GOVERNMENT.

AT VILLAGE LEVEL, HARVEST PROSPECTS AND HEALTH OF YOUNG GOATS ARE MORE IMPORTANT THAN "ALL THAT SHOLOOY (DISTURBANCE) IN THE CITIES." SHOULD BREAKDOWN IN ECONOMIC SUPPORT SYSTEM BEGIN TO SERIOUSLY AFFECT VILLAGES, THIS ATTITUDE MIGHT CHANGE. IF IT DOES, THERE WILL BE A SUBSTANTIAL JOB OF POLITICAL EDUCATION TO BE UNDERGONE; THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT WILL START ABOUT EVEN WITH OR ONLY SLIGHTLY AHEAD OF ANYONE ELSE WHO WANTS TO PLAY. NAAS

AMERICAN SERVICES IN EMBASSY TEHRAN HAS ONLY FIVE AMCITS REGISTERED IN SOUTH: TWO IN ABADAN; THREE IN AHWAZ.

REGISTRATIONS DO NOT REFLECT, HOWEVER, ACTUAL NUMBER OF AMCITS RESIDENT IN THE SOUTH. CONOFF FEELS THAT CONSERVATIVE ESTIMATE WOULD BE 100 FOR ABADAN, AHWAZ AND KHORRAMSHAHR. THIS FIGURE IS BASED ON TELEPHONE INQUIRIES SECTION HAS HAD FROM PERSONS CLAIMING TO BE AMCITS AND CONVERSATIONS WITH RECENT RESIDENTS OF THE AREA WHO VISITED EMB PRIOR TO DEPARTURE FROM IRAN. MOST AMCITS IN AREA ARE WIVES AND CHILDREN OF IRANIANS BUT WE ESTIMATE AS MANY AS 25 ARE EXPATRIATES WORKING IN REGION.
EMBASSY IS NOT AWARE OF ANY SECURITY INCIDENTS INVOLVING AMCITS IN THE AREA WITHIN LAST FEW WEEKS. NAAS

1979TEHRAN05760.subject: IRANIAN JEWS - MURDER OF MRS. DELRAHIM

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT; REPORTING CABLE.)

FOLLOWING ADDITIONAL INFORMATION, OBTAINED FROM SEVERAL SOURCES, IS PROVIDED: MRS. DELRAHIM HAD SOLD ALL HER PROPERTY SHORTLY BEFORE SHE WAS MURDERED. SHE WAS PREPARING TO LEAVE IRAN, PERHAPS FOR ISRAEL. SHE APPARENTLY HAD A SUBSTANTIAL AMOUNT OF CASH IN HER HOUSE AT THE TIME IT WAS BROKEN INTO. THUS, ROBBERY WOULD SEEM YUITE LIKELY A MAJOR MOTIVE IN THE CRIME.
