SUMMARY: TAVASSOLI SAID REVOLUTIONARY ADMINISTRATION SUFFERS FROM LACK OF MONEY AND INDISCIPLINE OF WORKERS. HE URGED US UNDERSTANDING OF REVOLUTIONARY IRAN. END SUMMARY.

TEHRAN MAYOR TAVASSOLI ASKED DEPARTING POLOFF STEMPEL TO CALL ON HIM AT HIS OFFICE. STEMPEL HAD NOT SEEN TAVASSOLI SINCE DECEMBER, AND MAYOR WELCOMED HIM WARMLY AS OLD FRIEND. AFTER BRIEF DISCUSSION ON SUCCESS OF ISLAMIC REVOLUTION, TAVASSOLI (DISPLAYING BETTER SENSE OF HUMOR THAN POLOFF HAS EVER SEEN) SAID RUNNING "REVOLUTIONARY TEHRAN" WASN'T THE KIND OF JOB HE HAD EXPECTED. SAME PROBLEMS EXISTED WITH MUNICIPALITY AS WITH NATIONAL GOVERNMENT--LACK OF MONEY AND INDISCIPLINE OF WORK FORCE. POLOFF COMMENTED THAT TEHRAN SERVICES HAD GOTTEN BACK TO NORMAL FAIRLY QUICKLY GIVEN REVOLUTIONARY SITUATION.

TAVASSOLI REPLIED, "YES, BUT YOU DON'T KNOW HOW OFTEN I HAVE TO TALK TO THE WORKERS TO MAKE THEM UNDERSTAND OUR PROBLEMS." HE SAID TEHRAN METRO WAS BEING REVIEWED, AND CONTRACTS APPEARED VERY ONE-SIDED; SUCH THINGS TOOK MUCH TIME. MAYOR ADMITTED HE WORKED "AT LEAST A 23-HOUR DAY;"CALLS EVEN REACHED HIM LATE AT NIGHT.

TAVASSOLI SAID HE WANTED TO MAKE PLEA FOR BETTER UNDERSTANDING OF ISLAMIC REVOLUTION IN AMERICA. HE SAID U.S. "SHOULD BEHAVE IN A WAY THAT WILL KEEP RELATIONS BETWEEN OUR COUNTRIES." POLOFF REPLIED IN SPIRIT OF FRANK FRIENDSHIP THAT SUGGESTION CUT BOTH WAYS. THERE FOLLOWED SHORT DISCUSSION OF PROBLEMS FORCED ON BOTH COUNTRIES BY RECENT EVOLUTION OF SITUATION. TAVASSOLI ASKED FOR UNDERSTANDING ON CASE OF CONTRACTS WITH UNFAIR CANCELLATION CLAUSES, ASSISTANCE WITH GRAIN SHIPMENTS, AND A "FORTHCOMING ATTITUDE" ON SPARE PARTS. POLOFF SAID U.S. ATTITUDES WOULD PROBABLY REFLECT PGOI AND KHOMEINI ATTITUDES AND SAID FRANKLY OUTPUT FROM SENIOR FIGURES WAS NOT VERY REASSURING OR HELP-INDUCING.

TAVASSOLI ADMITTED THAT SOME STATEMENTS WERE EXTREME, BUT NOTED USG SHOULD STOP ANTI-ISLAMIC CAMPAIGN IN AMERICAN PRESS. POLOFF SAID SHAH'S MEN HAD MADE EXACTLY SAME POINT A YEAR EARLIER. IT WOULD HELP IF MORE IRANIANS UNDERSTOOD NATURE OF U.S. FREE PRESS. POLOFF SAID THERE WERE SOME THINGS PGOI AND KHOMEINI WERE DOING THAT WENT AGAINST OUR VALUES, SUCH AS THE REVOLUTIONARY EXECUTIONS AND SUPPRESSION OF WOMEN. PGOI COULD EXPECT UNFAVORABLE PRESS COVERAGE OF THIS, AND THERE WAS LITTLE ANYONE COULD DO ABOUT IT. POLOFF SUGGESTED ISLAMIC MOVEMENT SHOULD DO BETTER JOB OF PUBLICIZING ITS POSITIVE ASPECTS, AND TAVASSOLI READILY AGREED.

AT END OF DISCUSSION, TAVASSOLI DEFENDED NEED FOR REVOLUTIONARY TRIALS, BUT SAID THEY HAD NOT BEEN CARRIED OUT WELL. HE ASCRIBED THIS TO SWIFTNESS OF REVOLUTIONARY VICTORY AND LACK OF JUDICIAL PREPARATION.

IN INTERESTING SIDE COMMENT, HE SAID IT WAS "IMPOSSIBLE" FOR ISLAMIC MOVEMENT TO TURN SUCH TRIALS OVER TO MINISTRY OF JUSTICE OFFICIALS, SINCE THESE WERE ALL "SLAVES OF THE SHAH." (COMMENT: TAVASSOLI IS A LEFTIST MEMBER OF THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT, BUT HIS STATEMENT REFLECTS "WE BROTHERS" SPIRIT OF MOST COMMITTED ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARIES, AND THEIR WILLINGNESS TO PLACE BEYOND THE PALE THOSE WHO WORKED IN ANY WAY FOR OLD REGIME.) POLOFF GAVE TAVASSOLI NAME OF HIS SUCCESSOR, AND MAYOR HAD NO TROUBLE WITH THE IDEA OF SEEING OFFICIAL U.S. REPRESENTATIVE FROM TIME TO TIME.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT; REPORTING CABLE.)

SUMMARY: THERE IS LITTLE CHANCE FOR A NEAR TERM IMPROVEMENT IN THE IRANIAN SITUATION. MOST LIKELY PROSPECT IS CONTINUED LACK OF GOVERNMENT WITH INCREASING VIOLENCE, FOLLOWED BY THEOCRATIC AUTOCRACY OVER A DIMINISHED IRAN OR A LEFTIST TAKE-OVER WITH RESISTANCE: ALL THREE INDICATE ECONOMIC COLLAPSE. VIOLENCE WILL BE INCREASINGLY ALONG CLASS LINES. U.S. HAS CHOICE OF RETREAT OR INTERVENTION. THIS CABLE REPRESENTS A PERSONAL ASSESSMENT BY FORMER ISFAHAN PO MCGAFFEY AT END OF THREE YEARS IN IRAN, MOSTLY IN THE PROVINCES. END SUMMARY.

THE OVERRIDING CHARACTERISTIC OF IRANIANS IN THE POLITICAL PROCESS IS SUBLIME SELF-INTEREST, ACCOMPANIED BY A REFUSAL TO ACCEPT RESPONSIBILITY. THE DISASTROUSLY SKEWED "DEVELOPMENT" OF IRAN IN THE LAST TEN YEARS WAS CAUSED TO A CONSIDERABLE EXTENT BY POOR CENTRAL PLANNING AND VENALITY AT THE TOP, BUT WAS PRIMARILY THE RESULT OF DELIBERATE CHOICES BY THE MASSES OF IRANIANS FOR PERSONAL AGGRANDIZEMENT OVER NATIONAL INTEREST.

CONVERSATIONS WITH INDUSTRIALISTS, LANDOWNERS, MERCHANTS, GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES, WORKERS, AND PROFESSIONS OVER THE YEARS ELICITED THE COMMON ADMISSION THAT THEY KNEW THEIR ACTIONS SPELLED FUTURE TROUBLE FOR IRAN, "BUT, AS LONG AS EVERYONE ELSE IS DOING IT,..." THIS CHARACTERISTIC CARRIED OVER INTO POLITICAL ACTION AND THE REVOLUTION. CYNICAL SUPPORT FOR CONTRADICTORY POLICIES (E.G., CONSTITUTIONALISTS SUPPORTING ANTICONSTITUTION KHOMEINI), IRRELIGIOUS WAVING OF THE BANNER OF RELIGION, ETC., WAS ACCOMPANIED BY THE STATEMENT, "WHEN I, THROUGH THIS PROCESS, OBTAIN POWER, I WILL CORRECT THESE INCONSISTENCIES." MOST IRANIANS KEPT THEIR EYE ON THE MAIN CHANCE, WITH ONE FOOT IN THE REVOLUTIONARY CAMP, ONE IN SAVAK, AND BOTH HANDS CLUTCHING A U.S.
VISA OR "GREEN CARD,""JUST IN CASE."

KHOMEINI, THE PGOI, AND THE PROTO-OPPOSITION FIGURES (SHARIAT-MADARI, TALEGHANI, NAZIH, MATINE-DAFTARY, ETC.) HAVE YET TO SHOW A WILLINGNESS TO STAND ON PRINCIPLE. WHETHER KHOMEINI EVER MEANT HIS STATEMENT THAT HE DID NOT INTEND TO RULE IS QUESTIONABLE; CERTAINLY HE IS EXERCISING ALL THE POWER HE CAN GET, WHILE COMPROMISING ON ANY PRINCIPLE WHICH ROUSES OPPOSITION (VEILS FOR WOMEN, FROZEN MEAT, EXECUTIONS, CONSTITUTION ELECTIONS) IN SPEECHES IF NOT IN FACT. THE PGOI'S ACCEPTANCE OF ITS EMASCULATION CAN BEST BE EXPLAINED BY THE DESIRE TO HANG ONTO PRESTIGIOUS POSITIONS AT ANY COST. TALEGHANI AND SHARIATMADARI BACK OFF FROM CONFRONTATION UNTIL THEY ARE SURE THEY CAN WIN.

GIVEN THIS SITUATION, PROSPECTS FOR IMPROVEMENT IN THE CURRENT SITUATION IN IRAN ARE DIM, AT BEST. KHOMEINI AND THE PGOI WILL CONTINUE TO REIGN FOR AS LONG AS THEY CAN, WHILE THE REST OF THE COUNTRY ACCEPTS OR REJECTS THEIR STATEMENTS AS IT SERVES THEM. OPPOSITION GROUPS WILL CONTINUE TO SEIZE OPPORTUNITIES AS THEY SEE PROSPECTS FOR INCREASED POWER. THERE IS LIKELY TO BE ONE OR MORE "COUP D'ETATS," CATAPULTING DIFFERENT GROUPS INTO POSITIONS OF PROMINENCE, BUT THEY, LIKE THE CURRENT LEADERS, WILL CONTINUE TO LACK EFFECTIVE POWER, AND WILL FACE THEIR OWN COUP WHEN ANOTHER GROUP SEIZES ON A REAL OR PERCEIVED MISTAKE.

REGIONAL, POSSIBLY ETHNIC, GROUPS WILL COME INCREASINGLY UNDER THE CONTROL OF REGIONAL POWER-SEEKERS, BUT THESE WILL FACE THE SAME SITUATION IN MICROCOSM (WHO SPEAKS FOR THE KURDS?). SUCH COUPS ARE LIKELY TO BE VIOLENT, AND SPORADIC VIOLENCE RANGING FROM RIOTS TO ASSASSINATION WILL MARK THE PERIODS BETWEEN COUPS.

THIS IS ONLY THE MOST LIKELY FUTURE. SECOND MOST LIKELY IS THE CONSOLIDATION OF A RELIGIOUS AUTOCRACY, WITH KHOMEINI AT THE APEX, BUT CHARACTERIZED BY SEMIINDEPENDENT "DEPUTY-IMAMS" AMONG THE RELIGIOUS, COOPERATING BUT JEALOUS OF PERSONAL FIEFDOMS.

AS SUCH A THEOCRACY WILL REJECT "SECULAR" ALLIANCES, IT WILL BE MARKEDLY SHORT OF ADMINISTRATIVE TALENT, FACING IRAN WITH A SLOW DESCENT ------------------083689 161916Z /50 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 2044 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMCONSUL DHAHRAN AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY PARIS SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 06234 INTO A FEUDAL ECONOMY.

TECHNOCRATS, PROFESSIONALS, AND THE MIDDLE CLASS WILL LEAVE IN DROVES, LEAVING IRAN TO THE MULLAHS AND THE "MOSTAZ'AF" (LITERALLY THE MEEK--DEFINED BY KHOMEINI AS IN "...SHALL INHERIT THE EARTH," BY THE OPPOSITION AS "POOR AND WEAK (MINDED)"). THE NEXT MOST LIKELY EVENT IS A MIDDLE-CLASS REJECTION OF THE RELIGIOUS RIGHT, LEADING TO A LEFTIST TAKE-OVER. AS THE LEFT DEMONSTRATE NO GREATER ADMINISTRATIVE ABILITY OR WILLINGNESS TO COOPERATE ON PRINCIPLES THAN ANY OTHER GROUP, SUCH A LEFTIST GOVERNMENT IS LIKELY TO COME UNDER THE "PROTECTION AND GUIDANCE" OF IRAN'S NORTHERN NEIGHBOR, LEADING TO AN AFGHANISTAN-LIKE SITUATION, WITH WIDESPREAD, DISORGANIZED OPPOSITION.

RUSSIA IS LIKELY TO INVEST MORE RESOURCES IN PROTECTING A CLIENT IRANIAN GOVERNMENT THAN AN AFGHAN GOVERNMENT, BUT THE VAST POTENTIAL FOR SABOTAGE OF IRAN'S PETROLEUM, POWER, AND INDUSTRIAL ASSETS MAY MAKE THE COUNTRY LESS THAN A GRAND PRIZE.

ANY OF THE ALTERNATIVES POINT TO A CONTINUATION AND ACCELERATION OF IRAN'S CURRENT ECONOMIC DISRUPTION. WE CAN EXPECT A GRADUAL OR SUDDEN DEGRADATION OF IRAN'S PETROLEUM PRODUCTION CAPACITY, INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT, AND PROBABLY AGRICULTURAL OUTPUT (WITH INCREASED OPIUM PRODUCTION AS A FAST CASH CROP). THIS ECONOMIC WEAKNESS WILL ENTAIL MILITARY WEAKNESS, WITH IRAN UNABLE TO DEFEND ITS BORDERS (WHICH COULD THEN MEAN SOMEONE ELSE IS PRODUCING THE OIL), AND A LOSS OF ANY REGIONAL POWER.

ANOTHER DISTURBING ELEMENT IS THE INCREASING CLASS ANTAGONISM WITHIN IRAN. THE MIDDLE CLASS DESPISE THE COMMITTEE STRUCTURE, PEASANTS ARE FIGHTING WITH LANDLORDS, EMPHASIS ON PERSONAL RANK AND PRESTIGE IS INCREASING, CAPITALISTS AND WORKERS ARE BECOMING IRRECONCILABLE. THE DRAFTING OFFICER SEES POLITICAL PARTIES INCREASINGLY BECOMING CLASS-ORIENTED, WHICH INCREASES THE CHANCES FOR VIOLENCE, AND DECREASES THE CHANCES FOR COOPERATION.

U.S. INTERESTS IN IRAN--A STRONG, INDEPENDENT, ECONOMICALLY DEVELOPING IRAN BEING A STABLE PRODUCER OF PETROLEUM, A MARKET FOR WESTERN GOODS IN BALANCE WITH ITS SALES, AND ABLE TO EXERCISE A MODERATING INFLUENCE IN REGIONAL AFFAIRS--ARE COMPATIBLE, AND IN SOME CASES IDENTICAL WITH IRANIAN INTERESTS. HOWEVER, GIVEN THE COSTS OF THE REVOLUTION, THEIR ATTAINMENT BY IRANIANS ACTING ALONE WILL REQUIRE MAJOR SACRIFICES BY THE MAJORITY OF IRANIANS. GIVEN THE IRANIAN CHARACTER AS I SEE IT, THIS IS TOO REMOTE A POSSIBILITY TO WAIT FOR. THE DEVOLUTION OF IRANIAN SOCIETY MAKES IT UNLIKELY THAT IRAN WILL BE ABLE TO ACT SIGNIFICANTLY AGAINST U.S.

INTERESTS, EXCEPT IN THE REDUCTION OF OIL PRODUCTION, SO IT IS LIKELY TO BECOME, NOT AN OPPONENT OF U.S. INTERESTS, BUT A NULLITY. THE U.S. MUST DETERMINE WHETHER IT IS ABLE TO ACCEPT THIS (AND IN SUCH CASE SHOULD CONTINUE TO REDUCE ITS EXPOSURE HERE) OR TAKE STEPS TO ASSIST THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A GOVERNMENT STRONG ENOUGH TO RULE IRAN. THIS WILL REQUIRE GUARANTEEING, TO A LARGE ENOUGH GROUP, PERSONAL BENEFITS SUFFICIENT TO GET THESE LARGE NUMBERS TO COOPERATE. THIS WILL ALSO BE COSTLY, BUT GIVEN THE DEEP BELIEF AMONG IRANIANS IN THE OVERWHELMING POWER OF THE U.S. OVER IRANIAN AFFAIRS, IT IS POSSIBLE.

WE WILL BE ASSUMED TO BE ACTING WHETHER WE DO OR NOT, AND IF THE COUNTRY CRUMBLES IT WILL BE BELIEVED THAT WE ARE EITHER CAUSING IT, OR ARE INCOMPETENT IN OUR ACTIONS. WE WILL NOT, HOWEVER, SAFEGUARD U.S. INTERESTS BY WAITING FOR IRANIANS TO SETTLE THEIR OWN AFFAIRS.

THIS CABLE IS ADMITTEDLY PESSIMISTIC, BUT THE DRAFTING OFFICER BELIEVES THAT IT ACCURATELY PRESENTS THE MOST LIKELY FUTURES. NONE OF THESE THINGS IS GOING TO HAPPEN OVERNIGHT. THE GASSES IN THE CORPSE OF DEVELOPING IRAN WILL GUARANTEE ENOUGH MOTION TO CARRY IRAN THROUGH MONTHS OR EVEN YEARS OF APPARENT LIFE. HOWEVER, THREE DAYS HAVE PASSED, AND WE SHOULD NOT EXPECT THIS CORPSE TO RISE FROM
(C - ENTIRE TEXT; ACTION CABLE)

ETTESAM (DIR GEN EUROPE AND AMERICAS) REQUESTED ME TO CALL ON HIM ON "URGENT" MATTER THIS MORNING. WHEN I ARRIVED HE TOLD ME THAT FONMIN YADZI HAD RECEIVED INFORMATION THAT "TWO SENATORS" BARNES AND HOLLENBECK WERE SPONSORING A RESOLUTION ON IRAN ALONG THE LINES OF THE PREVIOUS SENATE RESOLUTION (I CANNOT PUT MY HANDS ON CURRENT CONGRESSIONAL DIRECTORY BUT NEA/IRN OFFICER HAS INFORMED THAT A REPRESENTATIVE HOLLENBECK HAS BEEN WORKING ON SUCH A RESOLUTION).ETTESAM SAID THAT PGOI IS VERY CONCERNED THAT THE PASSAGE OF SUCH A RESOLUTION WILL CREATE A VERY STRONG RESURGENCE OF ANTI-AMERICAN FEELING IN THE COUNTRY.

GOVERNMENT BELIEVES THAT PASSING OF SUCH A RESOLUTION, IN FACT, WOULD CREATE EVEN STRONGER REACTION THEN EARLIER SENATE RESOLUTION. HE ASKED THAT WE DO WHATEVER COULD BE DONE TO PREVENT THIS HAPPENING.

AT THE INSTRUCTIONS OF THE FOREIGN MINISTER, ETTESAM REFERRED FAVORABLY TO THE SENTIMENTS OF SECRETARY VANCE'S LETTER TO THE FONMIN AND SAID THAT THE PGOI RECIPROCATES THESE FEELINGS AND WISHES TO SEE A GRADUAL IMPROVEMENT OF RELATIONS. HOWEVER, ANOTHER CONGRESSIONAL RESOLUTION WOULD MAKE THIS EXTREMELY DIFFICULT.

I WOULD APPRECIATE A CURRENT READING ON THIS MATTER SO THAT I MAY INFORM THE FOREIGN MINISTER. I REALIZE THAT THIS IS SATURDAY BUT IF YOU COULD HAVE EVEN A PRELIMINARY REPORT SENT TO ME TODAY, I COULD PASS THE INFORMATION TO FONMIN YAZDI TOMORROW MORNING AT OUR 10:30 MEETING.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT: REPORTING CABLE)

DURING JUNE 18 FAREWELL CALL DEPUTY PM AMIR ENTEZAM ASKED CHARGE WHAT INFORMATION WE MIGHT HAVE ON IRAQI INTENTIONS TOWARD IRAN. AFTER REMARKING THAT HE WAS NOT SURE WHO CAST THE FIRST STONE, CHARGE OUTLINED THE KINDS OF CONCERNS EITHER ENGENDERED OR EXACERBATED BY THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION ( REFTELS) AND SPECULATED ON THE POSSIBILITY OF THE IRAQIS ATTEMPTING TO CREATE A "PRICKLY HEDGE" ALONG IRAQ'S BORDER WITH IRAN A LA ONE-TIME BRITISH POLICY ON THE DURAND LINE. ENTEZAM HAD LITTLE TO SAY BUT DID INDICATE GENUINE SURPRISE WHEN THE CHARGE MENTIONED THE INFLAMATORY NATURE OF RECENT IRANIAN ARABIC LANGUAGE SERVICE BROADCASTS.

HE MADE A WRITTEN NOTE TO HIMSELF AND CONCEIVABLY WILL ATTEMPT TO INTERJECT SOME MODERATION. WE ARE NOT SANGUINE ABOUT HIS PROSPECTS FOR SUCCESS, BUT DRAW ATTENTION TO THE MATTER FOR THE LIGHT IT SHEDS ON THE LACK OF COORDINATION EVEN WITHIN THE RELATIVELY CONFINED CIRCLE OF THE PGOI. WE GOT THE DISTINCT IMPRESSION THAT SADEGH GHOTBZADEH, THE CONTROVERSIAL HEAD OF THE RADIO AND TELEVISION ORGANIZATION, MAY HAVE BEEN MAKING FOREIGN POLICY WITHOUT THE KNOWLEDGE OF THE DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER. NAAS
(C - ENTIRE TEXT; REPORTING CABLE)

SUMMARY: IN FAREWELL CALL ON DEPUTY PM ENTEZAM I REVIEWED WITH HIM THE CURRENT STATE OF U.S.-IRAN RELATIONS. HE EXPRESSED PGOI'S DESIRE FOR NORMALIZATION BUT APPEARED TO BE QUITE FRUSTRATED BY THE OBSTACLES POSED TO THIS BY THE PARALLEL SYSTEM OF GOVERNMENTS HERE. END SUMMARY.

ACCOMPANIED BY POLCOUNS I PAID A FAREWELL CALL ON DEPUTY PM AMIR ENTEZAM JUNE 18. I PROVIDED HIM WITH INFORMATION CONTAINED IN REFTEL (WHICH HE HAD EARLIER REQUESTED). HE TOOK CAREFUL NOTES AND SAID THAT THE DAA WOULD BE MOST USEFUL IN A PRESS CONFERENCE HE INTENDED TO HOLD WITHIN THE NEXT FEW DAYS. HE SAID THAT HE ALSO INTENDED TO REITERATE AT THAT TIME THE PGOI'S DESIRE FOR GOOD RELATIONS WITH THE U.S.

HE ADDED THAT HE AND THE REST OF HIS COLLEAGUES IN THE PGOI LOOK FORWARD TO IMPROVED RELATIONS BETWEEN THE TWO COUNTRIES ALTHOUGH THEY RECOGNIZE THAT IT WILL TAKE TIME. "IT MAY TAKE WEEKS OR EVEN MONTHS," HE SAID, "BUT WE KNOW THAT WE HAVE MANY INTERESTS IN COMMON." I REPLIED THAT WE WOULD CERTAINLY DO OUR BEST TO FURTHER THE NORMALIZATION PROCESS. NOTING THAT WE HAVE NO MAJOR POLICY DIFFERENCES, I POINTED OUT THAT THERE ARE CERTAIN LEGAL CONSIDERATIONS THAT LIMIT OUR FLEXIBILITY IN SUCH MATTERS AS CONTRACTS. NONETHELESS, I ASSURED HIM OF OUR BASIC GOODWILL.

A SHORT DISCUSSION OF A SCURRILOUS PRESS ARTICLE ENSUED WHICH ENTEZAM ENDED BY SAYING THAT HIS OVERRIDING CONCERN IS THE RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN THE PGOI AND THE USG, NOT WHAT THE PAPERS MAY SAY TO MAKE MONEY. IN THIS REGARD, HE ASKED IF I COULD TELL HIM ANYTHING ABOUT OUR PLANS FOR AN AMBASSADOR. I TOLD HIM QUITE FRANKLY THAT THE PGOI REJECTION OF AMBASSADOR CUTLER HAD CREATED PROBLEMS IN WASHINGTON THAT NOW HAVE TO BE WORKED OUT. THUS, IT IS UNLIKELY THAT THERE WOULD BE ANY IMMEDIATE MOVE TO REPLACE HIM.

IN ANY EVENT, I ADDED, THE NOMINATION AND CONFIRMATION PROCESS IS RELATIVELY LENGTHY AND THEREFORE THE PGOI SHOULD BE PATIENT. I SUGGESTED THAT HE SHOULD NOT EXPECT ANY MAJOR DEVELOPMENT ON THIS ISSUE UNTIL FALL. WHILE CLEARLY ANXIOUS TO HAVE US NAME A REPLACEMENT FOR AMBASSADOR CUTLER, ENEZAM SEEMED TO APPRECIATE THE OBSTACLES INVOLVED.

DURING THE COURSE OF OUR DISCUSSION (WHICH RANGED OVER A VARIETY OF TOPICS COVERED IN SEPTELS) ENTEZAM KEPT COMING BACK TO THE FRUSTRATIONS HE, AND PRESUMABLY OTHERS IN THE PGOI AS WELL, HAS EXPERIENCED IN DEALING WITH THE DUAL STRUCTURE OF GOVERNMENT IN IRAN. SEVERAL TIMES HE NOTED THE PROPENSITY OF PEOPLE NOT IN POSITIONS OF AUTHORITY BUT WITH CONSIDERABLE POLITICAL CLOUT TO MAKE OFF-THE-CUFF STATEMENTS THAT MAKE THE PGOI'S TASKS ALL THE MORE DIFFICULT. "AFTER MANY YEARS OF DICTATORSHIP," HE SAID, "THESE PEOPLE ARE FREE. THEY THINK THEY HAVE THE RIGHT TO SAY WHATEVER THEY WANT.

EVERYONE WANTS TO BE A LEADER." AT ANOTHER POINT I ASKED HIM ABOUT HIS APPOINTMENT TO SWEDEN AND HE REPLIED, "IT MAY BE EASIER FOR US TO TALK TO ONE ANOTHER IN STOCKHOLM. WE ORIGINALLY THOUGHT THAT IT WOULD TAKE NO MORE THAN A FEW MONTHS TO SOLVE OUR PROBLEMS. BUT THESE PEOPLE KEEP INTERFERING. WE HOPE THAT WE WILL HAVE AN OPPORTUNITY TO WORK OUT OUR PROBLEMS. WE NEED YOUR HELP IN THIS REGARD. WE MUST BE PATIENT, EVEN IT IT TAKES ONE OR TWO YEARS."

WHILE ENTEZAM APPEARS GENUINE IN HIS EXPRESSIONS OF GOODWILL TOWARD THE U.S. AND SEEMS TO COMPREHEND AS FEW IRANIANS IN POSITIONS OF INFLUENCE THESE DAYS DO THE IMPORTANCE OF IRAN'S RELATIONSHIP WITH US, HE HAS BEEN WORN DOWN BY HIS EXPERIENCE AS DEPUTY PM. HIS DESPAIR WITH THE LACK OF PROGRESS WAS ONLY MODERATELY LEAVENED BY REMINDERS (AS MUCH TO HIMSELF AS TO ME) THAT IRAN, AFTER ALL, HAS EXPERIENCED A VERY TRAUMATIC POLITICAL UPHEAVAL AND THAT IT WILL TAKE TIME AND PATIENCE TO SET THINGS BACK IN ORDER. NAAS
(C - ENTIRE TEXT.)

SUMMARY: ON JUNE 20, PAO MET WITH DR. BOZORGMEHR MEHR, LEADER OF ZOROASTRIAN COMMUNIY. DR. MEHR BELIEVES THAT WHILE ZOROASTRIANS ARE NOT BEING PERSECUTED AS A MINORITY RELIGIOUS SECT, BECAUSE OF THEIR PROFESSIONAL PURSUITS, THEY ARE, ALONG WITH OTHERS OF THEIR CLASS, FACING SEVERE ECONOMIC HARDSHIP. AS A FORMER MAJLIS DEPUTY, DR. MEHR FINDS HIMSELF ESPECIALLY VICTIMIZED AND VULNERABLE. END SUMMARY.

AT THE INVITATION OF DR. MEHR, A LONG-TIME ACQUAINTANCE, JOINED HIM FOR LUNCH AT THE MEHRS' COMFORTABLE TEHRAN RESIDENCE. IN DISCUSSING THE ZOROASTRIAN LO, HE MADE THE FOLLOWING POINTS: --THERE ARE ABOUT 15,000 IN THE TEHRAN COMMUNITY. PRACTICALLY ALL ARE ENGAGED IN COMMERCE, BUYING AND SELLING PROPERTY, PRIVATE ENTREPRENEURSHIP. THE ECONOMIC SLOWDOWN HAS, OF COURSE, SEVERELY AFFECTED THESE PEOPLE, MOST OF WHOM ARE SEEKING WAYS TO LEAVE THE COUNTRY. --THE THREE ZONE OASTRIAN TEMPLES IN TEHRAN HAVE NOT BEEN DISTURBED AND SERVICES ARE CONTINUING WITH NORMAL TURNOUTS. THE COMMUNITY OPERATES SIX PRIVATE SCHOOLS IN THE CITY FROM PRIMARY THROUGH SECONDARY.

OF THE APPROXIMATELY 3,000 STUDENT ENROLLMENT, 95 PERCENT ARE NON-ZOROASTRIANS, MAINLY ARMENIAN CHRISTIANS AND SOME MUSLIMS. THREE MONTHS AGO, THE MINISTRY OF EDUCATION THREATENED TO CLOSE THESE SCHOOLS ALONG WITH OTHER PRIVATE EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS. SINCE THAT TIME, NOTHING FURTHER HAS BEEN HEARD AND DR. MEHR BELIEVES OPERATIONS WILL CONTINUE. AT THE PRIMARY LEVEL, BOYS AND GIRLS ATTEND CLASSES TOGETHER, BUT NOT IN SECONDARY SCHOOL. --THE MOST TROUBLING INTRUSIONS IN THE LIFE OF THE COMMUNITY DO NOT COME FROM MUSLIMS, ACCORDING TO DR. MEHR, BUT FROM DISAFFECTED ZOROASTRIAN YOUTH WHO HAVE RETURNED FROM THE U.S.

AND EUROPE FILLED WITH LEFTIST VIEWS AND WHO SEEK TO MODIFY THEIR RELIGION IN SUCH A WAY AS TO MAKE IT CORRESPOND TO SOME FORM OF MARXISM, A VERY NEAT TRICK, GIVEN ITS EHEREALNESS, SAYS DR. MEHR. --COMMUNITY REPRESENTATIVES HAVE BEN RECEIVED BY AYATOLLAHS KHOMEINI AND TALEGHANI. BOTH SESSIONS WERE MARKED BY POLITENESS AND ASSURANCES AGAINST DISCRIMINATION. IT IS MEHR'S BELIEF, HOWEVER, THAT NEITHER AYATOLLAH HAS THE SLIGHTEST UNDERSTANDING OF THE RELIGION, WHICH MAY BE FOR THE BEST.

MEHR'S PERSONAL SITUATION IS GETTING DESPERATE, HE SAYS. AS A FORMER MAJLIS MEMBER, HE HAS LOST HIS RETIREMENT PAY FROM TEHRAN UNIVERSITY, WHERE HE TAUGHT MEDICINE FOR MANY YEARS. HIS BANK ACCOUNTS HAVE BEEN FROZEN. HE MAY NOT BUY OR SELL PROPERTY OR RECEIVE A BANK LOAN OR HOLD ANY GOVERNMENTAL POSITION. HE MUST REIMBURSE THE GOVERNMENT THE ENTIRE SALARY HE RECEIVED AS A MAJLIS DEPUTY FOR THREE AND A HALF YEARS. THE AMOUNT MUST BE PAID WITHIN FIVE YEARS. HE WILL TRY TO RESUME PRIVATE MEDICAL PRACTICE, ALTHOUGH THE SMALL CLINIC HE RECENTLY ESTABLISHED WAS BURGLARIZED (NOT BECAUSE OF HIS MAJLIS OR ZOROASTRIAN CONNECTIONS).

ALL IN ALL, THESE ARE DIFFICULT AND WORRISOME DAYS. HE NEVER KNOWS BUT THAT A KNOCK AT HIS DOOR WILL SIGNAL A PRISON TERM AS HAS BEFALLEN 35 OF HIS ERSTWHILE MAJLIS COLLEAGUES. HIS BROTHER, THE FORMER CHANCELLOR OF PAHLAVI UNIVERSITY, HAS NOT BEEN TROUBLED, BUT HAS NO FURTHER ASSOCIATION WITH THE UNIVERSITY. HE PLANS TO GO TO THE U.S. THIS SUMMER FOR MEDICAL TREATMENT.

1979TEHRAN06455.subject: (C) MINISTRY OF ECONOMIC AFFAIRS AND FINANCE: POLICIES, ORGANIZATION AND OFFICIALS

segments.text: (D) TEHRAN 6395, (E) TEHRAN 6415 (C) ENTIRE TEXT.

THE MINISTRY OF ECONOMIC AFFAIRS AND FINANCE INCLUDES THE FUNCTIONS OF TREASURY, CUSTOMS, TAX, ECONOMIC RESEARCH, INTERNATIONAL AFFAIRS, INTERNATIONAL INVESTMENT AND CREDITS AND ITS OWN ADMINISTRATION (SEE REF A FOR DETAIL). APART FROM THE ECONOMIC AND INTERNAL ACTIVITIES, IT WAS ONE OF THE MOST PARALIZED MINISTRIES IN THE PREREVOLUTION PERIOD AND IT IS THUS UNDERSTANDABLE THAT ITS RECOVERY HAS BEEN SLOW. BASED ON OUR LIMITED CONTACTS, MOSTLY WITH THE ECONOMIC AND INTERNATIONAL BUREAUS, IT APPEARS THAT THE MEAF'S WHEELS ARE TURNING ONLY SLIGHTLY BETTER THAN TWO MONTHS AGO (REF B).

THE REASONS ARE THE USUAL (PREOCCUPATION WITH POLITICS, RESENTMENT OF HOLDOVER SUPERVISORS, WELL-ESTABLISHED POOR WORK HABITS) PLUS SOME EXOGENOUS TO THE EMPLOYEES. THE ABSENCE OF A BUDGET AND VERY LOW LEVELS OF DISBURSEMEPT NO DOUBT HAVE REDUCED WORK AS WELL AS CHALLENGE IN THE TREASURY AND ACCOUNTING AREA. THE AMNESTY ON TAX FILING UNTIL JUNE 21 MAY HAVE REDUCED THE DEMANDS ON THAT BUREAU. THE ABSENCE OF BUDGETARY AUTHORITY FOR FOREIGN CREDITS HAS LEFT THE AID ADMINISTRATORS LESS OCCUPIED. ALL TOLD, THE CASE CAN BE MADE THAT BUREAUCRATIC RECOVERY AT MEAF WILL CORRELATE WITH A RESUMPTION OF WORK DEMANDS.

POLICIES: RECENT CALLS ON UNDERSECRETARY DR. IBRAHIMZADEH AND OIETA ACTING PRESIDENT DR. SALIMI PLUS OTHER CONTINUING CONTACTS REVEAL THE FOLLOWING POSITIONS OR TRENDS IN POLICY. IT SHOULD BE NOTED THAT IBRAHIMZADEH IS A MEMBER OF ANY INTER-MINISTERIAL ECONOMIC COMMITTEE AND ACTS AS THE MINISTER'S CHIEF RESOURCE FOR THE ECONOMIC COUNCIL, WHICH IS THE INTER-MINISTERIAL POLICY MAKING BODY. LABOR POLICY: IBRAHIMZADEH WAS SURPRISINGLY OUTSPOKEN - (MAY 30) WITH EMBOFF IN CRITICIZING THE POLICIES - OF MINLAB FOROUHAR.

HE BELIEVES THAT THE LABOR - MINISTRY IS CAUSING SERIOUS DAMAGE TO LONG-TERM - ECONOMIC RECOVERY, AND OVERALL INDUSTRIAL VIABILITY - AND PRODUCTIVITY BY FORCING EMPLOYERS TO REHIRE - (IN SOME CASES AT HIGHER LEVELS THAN PRE-REVOLUTION) - AND PAY EVEN THOUGH NO WORK IS BEING DONE. HE WANTS - THE GOVERNMENT'S ROLE IN LABOR MORE/LESS LIMITED TO - GENERAL LABOR PRACTICE GUIDELINES AND WAGE RESTRAINT, - IF NEEDED. PRICE POLICY: IBRAHIMZADEH ATTENDED THE FIRST MEETING - OF THE PRICE CONTROL COMMISSION (CHAIRED BY MINCOM - DR. REZA SADR) MAY 30.

HE WAS PREPARED TO ARGUE - FOR VIRTUAL DE-CONTROL AND ON JUNE 16 TOLD EMBOFF - THAT HE THOUGHT HE HAD BROUGHT MINISTER SADR AROUND - TO HIS POSITION AND THAT ONLY TEN OR SO BASIC FOOD - ITEMS WOULD BE PRICE CONTROLLED. HE DID NOT THINK - THAT EVEN VEHICLES WOULD BE CONTROLLED. THE FINAL - POLICY DECISION HAD NOT, HOWEVER, BEEN MADE. THE PGOI ANNOUNCED LATE JUNE 20 THAT MINISTER OF JUSTICE ASSADOLLAH MOBASHERI HAD SUBMITTED HIS RESIGNATION AND WOULD BE REPLACED BY MINISTER OF INTERIOR AHMAD SADR HAJ SEYED JAVADI. DEPUTY PM FOR TRANSITIONAL AFFAIRS HASHEM SABAGHIAN IS SLATED TO REPLACE JAVADI AT INTERIOR.

MOBASHERI WAS EMBARRASSED BY THE REACTIVATION OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS IN APRIL AND WANTED TO RESIGN AT THAT TIME. HE WAS TALKED OUT OF IT BUT REPUTEDLY CONTINUED TO BE UNHAPPY ABOUT THE MANNER IN WHICH JUSTICE WAS BEING CARRIED OUT AND THE LACK OF AUTHORITY HIS MINISTRY HAD IN ITS ADMINISTRATION. MORE RECENTLY, THERE HAD BEEN GROWING PRESSURE THROUGHOUT THE CIVIL BUREAUCRACY TO LIMIT THE ROLE OF WOMEN WHICH IN JUSTICE LED TO THE EXCLUSION OF FEMALE JUDGES FROM A SWEARING-IN CEREMONY AND A SUBSEQUENT PROTEST BY THEM AND THEIR SUPPORTERS.
WHILE NO PUBLIC REASONS HAVE BEEN MADE FOR MOBASHERI'S RESIGNATION IT SEEMS CLEAR THAT THE ABOVE-MENTIONED FACTORS FIGURED PROMINENTLY IN IT.

JAVADI HAS THE REPUTATION FOR BEING A STRONGER PERSONALITY THAT MOBASHERI, BUT WE DOUBT THAT HE WILL BE ABLE TO DO MUCH ABOUT THE EROSION OF THE MINISTRY OF JUSTICE'S FUNCTIONS. ON THE CONTRARY, THE REVOLUTIONARY COURT SYSTEM APPEARS TO BE COMING MORE ENTRENCHED EVERY DAY. FURTHER, WITH LAW ENFORCEMENT STILL VERY MUCH IN THE HANDS OF THE COMMITTEE STRUCTURE, THE MINISTRY OF JUSTICE CAN EXPECT LITTLE EFFECTIVE HELP FROM OTHER AGENCIES SUCH AS THE POLICE AND GENDARMERIE WHICH WOULD OTHERWISE BE INVOLVED IN JUDICIAL PROCEEDINGS.

SABAGHIAN, DESPITE HIS POSITION IN THE PRIME MINISTRY, HAS REMAINED SOMETHING OF A MYSTERY. REPUTE TO HAVE LEFTIST LEANINGS (SEVERAL SOURCES TOLD EMBOFFS THAT HE WAS APPOINTED TO DEPUTY PM AS A SOP TO THE LEFT), HE MAINTAINED THE LOWEST PROFILE OF THE THREE DEPUTY YM'S ORIGINALLY NAMED TO BAZARGAN'S CABINET (EBRAHIM YAZDI, ABBAS AMIR ENTEZAM AND SABAGHIAN HIMSELF). HIS SHIFT TO INTERIOR AND THE IMMINENT DEPARTURE OF ENTEZAM FOR SWEDEN AS AMBASSADOR WILL LEAVE ONLY BAZARGAN'S SON-INLAW, AHNAD BANI-ASSADI, AS AN ASSISTANT TO THE PRIME

EMBOFFS MET WITH PRYOR AGAIN JUNE 21 ON SUBJECT OF PERSECUTION OF BAHAI COMMUNITY. BECAUSE PRYOR IS HAVING FURTHER MEETINGS WITH BAHAI LEADERS JUNE 21 AND JUNE 25, THIS CABLE IS AN INTERIM REPLY TO STATE 158779.

PRYOR HAS PROMISED TO HOLD DOCUMENTS IN HIS POSSESSION CLOSELY AT LEAST UNTIL JUNE 25. HE IS STILL WORKING ON HIS REPORT, WHICH IS NOT COMPLETELY FINISHED OWING TO ADDITIONAL INFORMATION AND EVIDENCE THAT BAHAI LEADERS HAVE PROMISED HIM.

EMBASSY IS WORKING ON OBTAINING INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION OF THE PREVIOUSLY DESCRIBED ACTIONS AND THREATS. PRYOR SAID THAT ATTACKS ON 93 VILLAGES TOOK PLACE BOTH BEFORE AND AFTER FEBRUARY REVOLUTION. HIS INFORMATION IS FOR THE JANUARY 4 - MARCH 15 PERIOD. HE WILL BE PROVIDED WITH DETAILED SPECIFICS BY BAHAI LEADERS. MEANWHILE, HE BELIEVES MOST OF THE ATTACKS TOOK PLACE BEFORE THE REVOLUTION.

CONCERNING QUESTION OF WHETHER THERE IS A LEGAL BASIS FOR CONFISCATION OF BAHAI PROPERTY AND ASSETS, PRYOR SAID THAT HE HAS A COPY OF A DOCUMENT DEALING WITH THE CONFISCATIONS THAT WERE DESCRIBED IN TEHRAN 6421. IT IS A FORM WHICH HAS THE NAME AND SEAL OF THE "CONFISCATED GOODS COMMITTEE OF THE POOR PEOPLE'S ORGANIZATION" IN THE UPPER RIGHT-HAND CORNER, A FILE OR DOCKET NUMBER IN THE UPPER LEFT-HAND CORNER, AND A SEAL STAMP ON THE BOTTOM.

THE FORM IS SIGNED BY A MASSOUD SETOUDEH, WHOSE TITLE IS "SUPERVISOR OF THE CONFISCATED GOODS COMMITTEE." THERE IS A PLACE ON THE FORM WHERE THE NAME OF THE PERSON DESIGNATED TO DO THE CONFISCATING AND THE NAME OR NAMES OF THE ENTITIES TO BE CONFISCATED ARE ENTERED. THE TEXT OF THE FORM INCLUDES THE FORMULATION: "IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE ORDER OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COURT YOU ARE AUTHORIZED TO CONFISCATE ..." THE DOCUMENT THAT PRYOR HAS HAS THIS PHRASE AND SPECIFIES THAT THE THREE ENTITIES, THE SHERKAT OMANAH (REAL ESTATE COMPANY), THE NOW NAHALAM COMPANY (THE INVESTMENT CO.), AND THE MISAGHIE HOSPITAL ARE TO BE CONFISCATED.
AS MENTIONED, THE HOSPITAL HAS NOT YET BEEN ACTUALLY TAKEN OVER.

IT WOULD THEREFORE SEEM THAT, INSOFAR AS ANYTHING IS LEGAL IN TODAY'S IRAN, THE CONFISCATION ON THE ORDER OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COURT IS CONSIDERED TO HAVE A LEGAL BASIS. THE FORM LETTER NATURE OF THE DOCUMENT RAISES THE POSSIBILITY THAT CONFISCATIONS ARE FREQUENT OCCURRENCES.

RECENT CONVERSATIONS WITH SOURCES FROM TWO IRANIAN PROVINCIAL CITIES SUGGEST THAT THE ECONOMIC IMPACT OF IRAN'S REVOLUTION MAY BE MORE ADVANCED IN CERTAIN RESPECTS THAN IT IS IN TEHRAN. A SHIRAZ UNIVERSITY FACULTY MEMBER TOLD POLCOUNS JUNE 21 THAT THE ENTIRE LENGTH OF THE CITY'S MAIN STREET NOW LOOKS MORE LIKE A SCENE OUT OF CARAVANS THAN IT DOES A MODERN THOROUGHFARE. FARMERS DISPENSE FRESH PRODUCE FROM BAGS ON THE BACKS OF DONKEYS WHILE WHOLE FAMILIES HAWK A VARIETY OF MANUFACTURED WARES FROM THE SIDEWALKS. GROUPS OF UNEMPLOYED MALES STAND AROUND LOOKING FOR PICK-UP JOBS UNLOADING MERCHANDISE OR CARRYING PACKAGES.
WE HAVE NOTICED A SIMILAR PHENOMENON IN CERTAIN PARTS OF THE CAPITAL AS WELL, BUT IT DOES NOT SEEM TO BE NEARLY AS PERVASIVE AS IT APPARENTLY IS IN SHIRAZ.

ACCORDING TO A DOCTOR FROM HAMEDAN ALMOST ALL OF THE SMALL FACTORIES AND WORKSHOPS IN THAT CITY ARE IDLE. HE TOLD POLCOUNS THAT ON A NUMBER OF OCCASIONS THOSE LEFT IN CHARGE BY OWNERS WHO FLED THE COUNTRY HAVE BEEN THREATENED BY WORKERS DEMANDING SALARIES. PRESS REPORTED ON 13 JUNE THAT HOUSHANG ISSA BIGLOU, A TABRIZI LAWYER, WAS KIDNAPPED IN TEHRAN, BEATEN UNCONSCIOUS AND FINALLY DROPPED NEAR HIS HOME BY UNKNOWN ASSAILANTS. ISSA BIGLOU WAS PICKED UP BY HIS ATTACKERS NEAR HEDAYAT MATIN-DAFTARI'S OFFICE, WHERE HE HAD GONE AFTER RECEIVING A CALL THAT THE NATIONAL DEMOCRATIC FRONT LEADER HAD JUST BEEN ATTACKED. NO EXPLANATION HAS BEEN FORTHCOMING, BUT THERE MAY BE A TIE IN WITH OTHER STORIES REPORTED IN RECENT PRESS THAT MATIN-DAFTARI WAS DETAINED BY REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS ON HIS DEPARTURE FOR EUROPE. THE N.D.F. HAS LODGED A PROTEST OVER THE TREATMENT MATINDAFTARI RECEIVED AT PASDARAN HANDS AT MEHRABAD AIRPORT. MORE RECENTLY, A N.D.F.
RALLY AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY JUNE 22 WAS BROKEN UP BY ISLAMIC TOUGHS. THE RALLY HAD BEEN CALLED TO DEMAND A CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY WITH FULL POWERS TO AMEND IRAN'S DRAFT CONSTITUTION.

IN ANOTHER SUCH INCIDENT ON 16 JUNE FOUR GUNMEN RAIDED THE HOUSE OF GENERAL VALLIOLLAH QARANI, THE FIRST REVOLUTIONARY ARMED FORCES CHIEF OF STAFF WHO WAS KILLED ON 22 APRIL. THE RAID WAS DESCRIBED BY THE PRESS AS AN ABORTIVE ATTEMPT AGAINST THE LIFE OF QARANI'S WIDOW. ONE OF THE ATTACKERS WAS CAPTURED AND IS NOW UNDER DETENTION.

SINCE THE EARLY DAYS OF THE REVOLUTION THE PRESS HAS DEVOTED CONSIDERABLE SPACE TO ARRESTS, TRIALS, EXECUTIONS AND RELATED MATTERS. IN MORE RECENT TIMES, SEVERAL GROUPS HAVE BECOME VOCAL IN PROTESTING CERTAIN ARRESTS. ONE EXAMPLE THIS PAST WEEK WAS A STATEMENT ISSUED BY ALI ASGHAR HAJ SAYED JAVADI, LEADER OF THE JONBESH PARTY. THE STATEMENT PROTESTED THE ARREST AND DETENTION OF MEMBERS OF THE SOCIALIST WORKERS PARTY IN AHVAZ. ANOTHER EXAMPLE IS THE COVERAGE GIVEN TO A PROTEST BY THE PEOPLE'S MUJAHEDIN ORGANIZATION OVER THE ARRESTS OF HAMID SHEIBANI AND MOHAMMED-REZA SA'ADATI.

IN A LONG LETTER TO THE PRESS SA'ADATI'S WIFE CLAIMED THAT HE WAS "ARRESTED IN HIS OFFICE ON APRIL 26, 1979, BY THE ARMED MILITIA MEN STATIONED AT THE AMERICAN EMBASSY, WAS TAKEN TO A HOME BEHIND THE EMBASSY AND...WAS SEVERELY BEATEN WHILE BEING TAKEN BLIND FOLDED TO HIS CAPTORS' VEHICLE AND ALSO SUBJECTED TO 12 HOURS OF TORTURE AND BEATING AT THE ABOVE HOUSE." ON 22 JUNE THE HOUSE IN QUESTION, A BUILDING USED BY THE EMBASSY'S MUJAHEDIN GUARDS, WAS DAMAGED BY A BOMB AND STRAFED WITH GUNFIRE BY UNKNOWN ASSAILANTS.

THE COBRA-MONGOOSE GAME BEING PLAYED THROUGHOUT IRAN AS GROUPS WHOSE MEMBERS HAVE BEEN ARRESTED (OR WORSE) TAKE RETALIATORY ACTION WILL UNDOUBTEDLY CONTINUE, BUT WITH UNTRADITIONALLY PERSIAN OVERTONES. FAMILIES AND PROPERTY SEEM TO BE BECOMING FAIR GAME. DURING THE RECENT TABRIZ BAZAAR FIRE, DAMAGE WAS APPARENTLY CONCENTRATED ON AN ARCADE OWNED BY THE LEADING MULLAH AND COMMITTEE HEAD OF THE CITY. ONE TABRIZI SOURCE COMMENTED TO POLOFF THAT HE EXPECTED THE NEXT TARGET THERE TO BE THE MULLAH'S HOUSE.

IN CONTRAST TO PROTESTS OVER CERTAIN ARRESTS, DETAILED DESCRIPTIONS OF SOME TRIALS ALSO CONTINUE. MOST RECENT EXAMPLE HAS BEEN WEEK-LONG PLAY UP OF BAHMAN NADERIPOUR AKA "TEHRANI" AND FEREIDOUN TAVANGARI AKA "ARASH" TRIALS. IN MORE JAIL NEWS, THE TEHRAN COURTS CHIEF PROSECUTOR JAFFAR SHAHSHANI HAS ASKED ALL THOSE WHO FLED TEHRAN'S JAILS ON 11 AND 12 FEBRUARY TO SURRENDER VOLUNTARILY. A DEADLINE OF 21 JULY HAS BEEN GIVEN, AFTER WHICH THE FORMER PRISONERS WOULD BE TRIED FOR ILLEGAL ESCAPE AS WELL AS THEIR OTHER CHARGES.

ANOTHER REQUEST THAT MAY OR MAY NOT BE MET IS FOR ALL COMMITTEES IN ZANJAN TO TURN IN THEIR WEAPONS. THE RESPONSE HAS REPORTEDLY BEEN NEGLIGIBLE. IN ABADAN AND KHORRAMSHAHR ALL THOSE POSSESSING WEAPONS HAVE BEEN ORDERED TO APPLY FOR LICENSES BEFORE 26 JUNE. VARIOUS OTHER REQUESTS BY GOVERNORS-GENERAL FOR COMMITTEE MEMBERS TO SURRENDER THEIR WEAPONS HAVE APPARENTLY NOT RPT NOT MET WITH A GREAT DEAL OF SUCCESS. STORIES OF ARMS CACHES, RAMPANT SMUGGLING OVER THE BORDERS, AND EASY ARMS PURCHASES CONTINUE TO CIRCULATE. ONE CACHE, BELONGING TO THE MARXIST FEDAYAN-E-KHALQ, WAS CAPTURED BY A TEHRAN COMMITTEE LATE LAST WEEK.
GIVEN THE VAST NUMBERS OF WEAPONS WHICH HAVE FALLEN INTO UNKNOWN HANDS ALL OVER THE COUNTRY, IT SEEMS CERTAIN THAT EFFECTIVE WEAPONS CONTROL IN IRAN WILL BE A PIPEDREAM FOR THE FORESEEABLE FUTURE.

EDUCATION MINISTRY OFFICIALS CLAIM THAT APPLICANTS FOR THE COMING SCHOLASTIC YEAR IN IRANIAN UNIVERSITIES HAVE ALREADY REACHED UNMANAGEABLE PROPORTIONS. MORE THAN 600,000 HAVE REGISTERED FOR THE UNIVERSITY ENTRANCE EXAMINATIONS, BUT ONLY ABOUT 45,000 WILL BE ABLE TO ENROLL. WITH THE PRESENT UNEMPLOYMENT SITUATION, CONSEQUENCES OF REFUSAL TO THE REJECTED 555,000 CANDIDATES COULD EASILY BECOME SEVERE. AT VERY BEST INCREDIBLE PRESSURE WILL BE PLACED ON POST'S CONSULAR SECTION FOR U.S. STUDENT VISAS. AT WORST, THE WOULD-BE STUDENTS WILL SEE THEIR REJECTION AS A LAST STRAW AND SWELL THE RANKS OF ORGANIZATIONS OPPOSED TO THE PRESENT ORDER.

THE FLOW OF IRANIAN STUDENTS TO THE USA AND OTHER COUNTRIES WILL NECESSARILY CONTINUE AND PERHAPS EVEN SWELL, WITH ALL OF ITS ATTENDANT STUDENT ACTIVISM DIRECTED AGAINST THE VERY REGIME THE STUDENTS DID SO MUCH TO PUT IN POWER.

BOTH THE NATIONAL FRONT AND THE NATIONAL DEMOCRATIC FRONT HELD SPECIAL CEREMONIES TO MARK THE 26TH ANNIVERSARY OF MOSSADEGH'S NATIONALIZATION OF THE OIL INDUSTRY. TWO DAYS BEFORE THE NATIONAL FRONT'S PUBLIC COMMEMORATION, MINISTER OF LABOR DARIUSH FOROUHAR, ANNOUNCED HE WAS QUITTING THE PARTY AND REVIVING THE PEOPLE'S PARTY, ORIGINALLY ESTABLISHED SOME 30 YEARS AGO TO SUPPORT MOSSADEGH'S POLICIES. FOROUHAR CLAIMED HE WAS LEAVING THE NATIONAL FRONT BECAUSE THE PARTY WAS PLAGUED BY A POWER STRUGGLE AND HE COULD NO LONGER ENDORSE ITS POLICIES. COMMENTING ON FOROUHAR'S RESIGNATION, NF LEADER SANJABI CLAIMED THAT THE MINISTER OF LABOR WAS DEVIATING FROM HIS PRINCIPLES TO GAIN (PERSONAL) POWER.

IN OTHER NF NEWS, SANJABI SEEMS TO BE TRYING HARD TO GET THE ORGANIZATION'S ACT TOGETHER. THE NF HAD REJECTED AN ASSEMBLY OF EXPERTS AND CALLED FOR A FULL-FLEDGED AND PUBLICLY ELECTED CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY TO APPROVE THE NATION'S NEW CONSTITUTION. KHOMEINI REFERRED TO THOSE WHO REFUSED TO ACCEPT AN ASSEMBLY OF EXPERTS AS "PLOTTING AGAINST ISLAM AND THE COUNTRY." REPORTS OF SANJABI'S UNSUCCESSFUL ATTEMPTS TO GET VARIOUS WINGS TO AGREE ON BASIC PARTY POLICY CONTINUE. LAINGEN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT; REPORTING CABLE)

SUMMARY: THE POSITION OF WOMEN IN REVOLUTIONARY AND ISLAMIC IRAN CONTINUES TO ERODE. EFFORTS TO SQUEEZE WOMEN OUT OF GOVERNMENT AGENCIES PERSISTS. THE RECENTLY PUBLICIZED DRAFT CONSTITUTION CONTAINS SEVERAL PROVISIONS THAT IMPLY CONSIDERABLE CIRCUMSPECTION OF THE AREA OF ACTIVITY WHICH WILL BE LEGITIMATELY OPEN TO WOMEN. DESPITE THEIR RELATIVELY FEW NUMBERS, THE POLITICAL STRENGTH OF IRANIAN WOMEN WHO MAY BE PREPARED TO RESIST RESTRICTION OF THEIR RIGHTS SHOULD NOT BE UNDERESTIMATED. END SUMMARY.

THE POSITION OF WOMEN IN REVOLUTIONARY IRAN CONTINUES TO ERODE. RECENTLY, A GROUP OF FEMALE TRAINEES FOR THE JUDICIARY WAS BARRED FROM A SWEARING-IN CEREMONY AT THE MINISTRY OF JUSTICE. THE WOMEN, ALONG WITH A NUMBER OF SUPPORTERS, IMMEDIATELY LAUNCHED A SIT-IN, A DEVELOPMENT WHICH APPEARS TO HAVE FIGURED IN JUSTICE MINISTER ASSADOLLAH MOBASHERI'S RESIGNATION JUNE 20. BEFORE HE DEPARTED THE MINISTRY, HOWEVER, MOBASHERI "UNOFFICIALLY" INFORMED THE WOMEN THAT THEIR SIT-IN WOULD BE IN VAIN, SINCE THE CIVIL JUDICIARY ITSELF WOULD SOON BE OUT OF BUSINESS.

IN OTHER GOVERNMENT AGENCIES, TOO, THERE APPEARS TO BE A CONCERTED CAMPAIGN AT LEAST TO REDUCE THE PROFILE OF WOMEN EMPLOYEES IF NOT FORCE THEM OUT COMPLETELY. AS REPORTED IN REFTEL, A FAVORITE TECHNIQUE IS TO SHIFT WOMEN INTO LESS IMPORTANT JOBS, PRESUMABLY IN THE HOPE THAT MOST WILL ULTIMATELY RESIGN IN FRUSTRATION.

THE NEW CONSTITUTION HAS ALSO CAUSED CONSIDERABLE CONSTERNATION. SEVERAL PROVISIONS IMPLY A DRASTIC CIRCUMSPECTION OF THE AREA OF ACTIVITY WHICH WILL BE LEGITIMATELY OPEN TO WOMEN. ARTICLE 11 DEFINES THE FUNDAMENTAL UNIT OF IRAN'S REVOLUTIONARY ISLAMIC SOCIETY AS THE FAMILY AND STATES THAT THE RIGHTS OF THE FAMILY AS A UNIT WILL TAKE PRECEDENCE OVER THOSE OF INDIVIDUAL MEMBERS OF IT.

ARTICLE 12 GOES ON TO ENSHRINE THE PRIMACY OF THE MOTHER IN REARING CHILDREN AND ENJOINS THAT"FAMILY LAWS SHOULD PROVIDE MOTHERS WITH MATERIAL AND SPIRITUAL OPPORTUNITIES SO THAT THEY CAN CAN ATTEND...TO THE HIGHLY VALUED MATERNAL DUTIES THAT ARE ENTRUSTED TO THEM..." ARTICLE 28, WHICH STATES THAT "EVERY PERSON HAS THE RIGHT TO CHOOSE THE PROFESSION HE WISHES, PROVIDED IT IS NOT IN CONTRAVENTION OF ISLAM OR THE PUBLIC INTEREST," ALSO SEEMS AN OPEN-ENDED INVITATION TO LIMIT THE FREEDOM OF WOMEN TO CHOOSE CAREERS OTHER THAN THOSE OF MARRIAGE AND MOTHERHOOD.

THE PRACTICAL EFFECTS OF THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT'S DETERMINATION TO CONFINE IRANIAN WOMEN TO THE NURSERY AND THE KITCHEN WILL BE LIMITED IN SCOPE SINCE THE VAST MAJORITY OF IRANIAN WOMEN HAD NEVER LEFT THOSE PLACES. HOWEVER, A SIGNIFICANT MINORITY APPEARS DETERMINED TO RESIST THE IMPOSITION OF RESTRICTIONS ON ITS MEMBERS' FREEDOM. THEIR STRENGTH SHOULD NOT BE UNDERESTIMATED. IT WAS, AFTERALL, WOMEN WHO FORCED KHOMEINI TO MAKE HIS FIRST SIGNIFICANT POLITICAL CONCESSION BACK IN MARCH OVER THE ISSUE OF HEJAB OR THE WEARING OF THE VEIL. LAINGEN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)

WHILE DEFERRING TO BAGHDAD'S JUDGMENT ON WHAT MIGHT MOTIVATE THE IRAQIS TOWARD RESTRAINT OR ADVENTURISM IN THEIR RELATIONSHIP WITH IRAN, WE OFFER THE FOLLOWING OBSERVATIONS ON ASPECTS OF THE POLITICAL SITUATION HERE WHICH MAY HAVE A BEARING ON THE IRAQI POSTURE.

AS NOTED IN PARA 9 OF REFTEL, LOGIC WOULD STRONGLY RECOMMEND THE IRANIANS TO CONTENT THEMSELVES WITH TENDING TO THEIR MANIFOLD INTERNAL PROBLEMS. HOWEVER, PRECISELY BECAUSE THOSE PROBLEMS ARE SO GREAT IN SCOPE, LOGIC IS OFTEN THROWN TO THE WINDS BY IRANIAN POLITICAL LEADERS CONVINCED THAT THINGS COULD NOT BE AS BAD AS THEY ARE IN THE ABSENCE OF A MASSIVE CONSPIRACY. THIS SENSE OF PARANOIA RESULTS IN KNEE-JERK REACTIONS TO EACH INCIDENT THAT SEEMS TO THREATEN THE NEW ORDER IN IRAN.

IN THE CASE OF KHUZESTAN, WHICH IS BOTH THE SOURCE OF IRAN'S ECONOMIC LIFE BLOOD AND THE HOME OF AN ARAB MINORITY WITH PROFOUND GRIEVANCES AGAINST THE PERSIAN MAJORITY, THE TEMPTATION TO FIND FOREIGN INTRIGUE UNDERLYING ANY SIGN OF ETHNIC UNREST IS AND WILL REMAIN FOR THE FORESEEABLE FUTURE IRRESISTIBLE.

THE POLITICAL DOMINANCE OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI AND THE CLERICAL ENTOURAGE AROUND HIM HAS TWO IMPORTANT EFFECTS WHICH ARE NOT ENCOURAGING IN TERMS OF THE DISINCENTIVES THEY PROVIDE TO THE IRAQIS (AND PERHAPS OTHERS AS WELL) TO EXERCISE RESTRAINT. THE FIRST IS THE MESSIANIC QUALITY OF THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION (NOTED IN PARA 10 OF REFTEL) AND A CONCOMITANT LACK OF SOPHISTICATION AMONG THE ISLAMIC CROWD REGARDING INTERNATIONAL BEHAVIOR. THUS, KHOMEINI AND HIS CLERICAL FRIENDS CAN CALL FOR THE MUSLIM MASSES TO RISE UP AGAINST THEIR OPPRESSORS IN APPARENT OBLIVIOUSNESS TO THE INTERNATIONAL REPERCUSSIONS SUCH STATEMENTS MAY HAVE FOR IRAN.

AT THE SAME TIME, THE CONTINUING WEAKNESS OF THE PGOI RELATIVE TO THE REAL CENTER OF POLITICAL POWER IN QOM USUALLY MEANS THAT OUTRAGEOUS PRONOUNCEMENTS FROM THE LATTER ARE NOT CHALLENGED. ON THE CONTRARY, TO THE EXTENT THE PGOI HAS A FOREIGN POLICY AT ALL IT REFLECTS THE VIEWS OF THE ISLAMIC RADICALS FAR MORE OFTEN THAN IT DOES THOSE OF COOLER HEADS IN THE GOVERNMENT.

BAGHDAD HAS ENUMERATED IN DETAIL THE FACTORS WHICH MAY CONSTRAIN THE IRAQIS IN THEIR RELATIONS WITH IRAN. WE WOULD NOT LIST AMONG THESE, HOWEVER, THE PROSPECT OF MODERATE BEHAVIOR ON IRAN'S PART. INDEED, THE OPPOSITE WOULD SEEM FAR MORE LIKELY. WE SUSPECT THE IRAQIS ARE GOING TO HAVE TO CONTEND WITH WHAT MAY APPEAR TO THEM CONSIDERABLE IRANIAN PROVOCATION FOR SOME TIME TO COME.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT.)

THE IRANIAN PRESS HAS BEEN FEATURING ON AN ALMOST DAILY BASIS AYATOLLAH SADEGH KHALKHALI'S COMMENTS ON BRINGING THE SHAH TO JUSTICE. ACCORDING TO THE CONTROVERSIAL KHALKHALI, BOTH FARAH AND HER MOTHER, ALONG WITH THE SHAH HIMSELF, HAVE BEEN SENTENCED TO DEATH BY THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS IN ABSENTIA BECAUSE OF THE ACTIVE ROLE THEY PLAYED IN MAKING DECISIONS DURING THE LAST DAYS OF THE PAHLAVI REGIME.

REWARDS FOR KILLING THE SHAH HVE ALSO BEEN WELL PUBLICIZED. ALONG WITH THE ALL-EXPENSE PAID TRIP TO MECCA ANNOUNCED EARLIER, KHALKHALI HAS SET AN AWARD OF TEN MILLION RIALS TO ANYONE WHO CARRIES OUT THE ASSASSINATION. KHALKHALI HAS ALSO PROMISED THAT THE EMPRESS COULD RETURN TO IRAN IF SHE CARRIED OUT THE EXECUTION HERSELF OR AIDED IN THE ARREST OF HER HUSBAND. AT VARIOUS TIMES, THE PRESS HAS CLAIMED THAT A HIT SQUAD IS ALREADY IN MEXICO, AND ALSO THAT THE PLO HAS UNDERTAKEN TO CARRY OUT THE DEATH MISSION. THIS LATTER CLAIM HAS BEEN DENIED BY THE PLO. THE ROYAL CHILDREN ARE APPARENTLY EXEMPT FROM ANY PUNISHMENT.

A MORE RESPECTABLE DEATH-TO-THE-SHAH CAMPAIGN LEADER MIGHT HAVE BEEN FOUND THAN KHALKHALI. THE AYATOLLAH HAS ALSO FIGURED PROMINENTLY IN THE PRESS DURING RECENT MONTHS FOR HIS ATTACK ON THE WIDELY RESPECTED AYATOLLAH SHARIA MADAS WELL AS FOR HIS THREATS TAKEN AS DIRECTED AGAINST KHUZESTAN'S AYATOLLAH KHAGHANI. KHALKHALI'S TRIP TO THE PERSIAN GULF EMIRATES AND THE CONTROVERSIAL STATEMENTS HE IS SAID TO HAVE MADE THERE ABOUT CHANGING THE NAME TO THE "ISLAMIC GULF" RESULTED IN AN IMMEDIATE DENIAL BY PGOI SPOKESMEN THAT THE AYATOLLAH WAS IN ANY WAY CONNECTED TO THE GOVERNMENT.
DESPITE BEING WIDELY REGARDED AS A BUFFOON, KHALKHALI IS NONETHELESS FEARED BECAUSE OF THE SUPPORT HE APPARENTLY CONTINUES TO ENJOY AMONG THE MORE RADICAL CLERGY, INCLUDING KHOMEINI. LAINGEN

(U) IN TV INTERVIEW BROADCAST JUNE 23 AND REPORTED SEPARATELY IN LOCAL PRESS JUNE 24, FOREIGN MINISTER YAZDI WAS ASKED WHEN THE NEW AMERICAN AMBASSADOR WILL ARRIVE IN IRAN. IN REPLY, HE SAID, "I IS THE RIGHT OF EVERY INDEPENDENT COUNTRY TO MAKE HER OWN DECISIONS. AS WE DISCOVERED THAT MR.

CUTLER WAS COMING TO TEHRAN FROM A COUNTRY WHERE HE HAD BEEN CARRYING OUT IMPERIALISTIC OBJECTIVES, AND HIS PRESENCE HERE WOULD NOT CONTRIBUTE TO A BETTERMENT OF RELATIONS BETWEEN OUR TWO COUNTRIES, WE WITHDREW OUR ACCEPTANCE OF HIM...THE U.S.CHARGE D'AFFAIRES ONE DAY CAME TO THE MINISTRY AND SAID THAT OUR REJECTION HAD BEEN ACCEPTED BY HIS GOVERNMENT AND ADDED THAT THE NEW AMBASSADOR'S NAME WILL BE MADE KNOWN LATER....PROBABLY IN SEVERAL WEEKS."

(LOU) COMMENT: THE SUBJECT OF A NEW AMBASSADOR DID NOT COME UP AT ALL DURING FORMER CHARGE NAAS' MOST RECENT CONVERSATION WITH YAZDI (REF A) ALTHOUGH IT DID IN CONVERSATION WITH AMIR-ENTEZAM A DAY LATER (REF B).

1979TEHRAN06624.subject: IRANIAN REACTION TO FIGHTING IN KABUL

segments.text: (C - ENTIRETEXT; REPORTING CABLE)

TO DATE THERE HAS BEEN LITTLE REACTION IN IRAN TO THE FIGHTING IN KABUL OR KHALQI ACCUSATIONS THAT IRAN WAS INVOLVED. TWO MAJOR FARSI LANGUAGE PAPERS (KAYHAN AND ETTELAAT) CARRIED BRIEF ITEMS BASED ON WIRE SERVICES REPORTS JUNE 24 AS DID THE ENGLISH LANGUAGE TEHRAN TIMES JUNE 25. NEITHER FARSI LANGUAGE MORNING PAPER (AYENDAGAN AND BAMDAD) JUNE 25 BOTHERED TO MENTION AFGHANISTAN. ONLY THE TEHRAN TIMES CITED THE CHARGE THAT IRAN WAS SOMEHOW INVOLVED. SO FAR THERE HAS BEEN NO OFFICIAL REACTION TO THIS, EITHER FROM THE PGOI OR THE KHOMEINI ENTOURAGE, ALTHOUGH WE EXPECT SOMEONE TO GET AROUND TO IT SOONER OR LATER.

THE TEHRAN TIMES ALSO REPORTED THAT A 12-MAN DELEGATION OF AFGHAN SHIA CLERGYMEN ARRIVED IN QOM JUNE 23. A SPOKESMAN FOR THE GROUP, SHEIKH ABDOLLAH AHMADZADEH, SAID THAT HE AND THE OTHERS HAD FLED AFGHANISTAN "AMIDST A WAVE OF ARRESTS AND TORTURE OF THE CLERGYMEN BELIEVED TO BE INSTRUMENTAL IN THE CURRENT ARMED REVOLT AGAINST TARAKI'S REGIME." LAINGEN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)

WE SUSPECT THAT THE BROADCAST FROM BAGHDAD THAT AFGHAN AIRCRAFT VIOLATED IRANIAN AIRSPACE AND STRAFED SEVERAL AREAS (REF A) AND THE AFGHAN CLAIM THAT IRANIAN AIR AND LAND FORCES WERE BEING MOVED UP TO THE AFGHAN BORDER (REF B) ORIGNATE FROM THE SAME JUNE 23 BAMDAD (FARSI LANGUAGE) STORY WHICH QUOTED AN UNNAMED PGOI OFFICIAL AS SAYING THAT AFGHANISTAN INTENDED RPT INTENDED TO LAUNCH AIR ATTACKS AGAINST IRAN. ACCORDING TO BAMDAD, THIS SAME SOURCE SAID THAT IRANIAN AIR AND GROUND FORCES HAD TAKEN "THE REQUIRED STEPS" TO PROTECT IRANIAN AIRSPACE.

SINCE WE DO NOT MONITOR EVERY NEWS BROADCAST, WE CANNOT BE ABSOLUTELY SURE THAT THE REPORT WAS NOT CARRIED ON LOCAL RADIO, BUT IT DEFINITELY WAS NOT ON THE MAIN MORNING, AFTERNOON, AND EARLY EVENING BROADCASTS JUNE 25 WHICH USUALLY COVER MOST MAJOR NEWS ITEMS. NOR WAS AFGHANISTAN MENTIONED ON EITHER THE MORNING OR AFTERNOON BROADCASTS JUNE 26.

AS FOR IRAN'S ABILITY TO DO WHAT IT IS ACCUSED OF, PM BAZARGAN'S STATEMENT TO AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN LAST MARCH REGARDING AFGHAN ACCUSATIONS THAT IRAN HAD INFILTRATED SEVERAL THOUSAND TROOPS ACROSS THE BORDER (REFTEL NO LONGER AVAILABLE AT POST) IS STILL INDICATIVE OF THE STATE OF READINESS (OR LACK THEREOF) OF THE IRANIAN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)

ON JUNE 22 KHOMEINI RECEIVED A DELEGATION OF HOMOFARS WHO PRESENTED HIM WITH A STATEMENT CONTAINING SEVEN POINTS. AMONG THESE WAS A PROTEST AGAINST THE CONTINUED PRESENCE OF U.S. MILITARY ADVISORS IN IRAN.

THE HOMOFARS HAVE CONTINUED TO REGARD THEMSELVES IN THE VANGUARD OF THE REVOLUTION AND A MAJOR OPPONENT OF IMPERIALIST INTERESTS IN IRAN. UNDER THE CIRCUMSTANCES, THEIR PROTEST OF THE CONTINUED PRESENCE OF MILITARY ADVISORS HERE WAS ENTIRELY CONSISTENT WITH THEIR PAST ACTIONS SUCH AS THE DEMONSTRATION THEY ORGANIZED OUTSIDE THE EMBASSY ON MAY 26. LAINGEN

(U) JUNE 26, THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL RATIFIED A DECREE, SUPPOSEDLY PROPOSED BY THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT, PERMITTING THE TAKEOVER OF LARGE, UNDEVELOPED TRACTS OF URBAN LAND. ACCORDING TO THE NEW LAW, THE MINISTRY OF HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT (MHUD) WILL ESTABLISH A TIME LIMIT FOR LANDOWNERS TO BEGIN CONSTRUCTION ON LARGE PLOTS OF UNIMPROVED LAND. DETERMINATION OF THE MINIMUM SIZE OF LAND HOLDINGS SUBJECT TO THE LAW WILL PRESUMABLY ALSO BE DETERMINED BY MHUD. AFTER THE EXPIRATION OF THE GRACE PERIOD, THE MINISTRY WILL BE FREE TO EXERCISE THE RIGHT OF EMMINENT DOMAIN AND MAKE THE LAND AVAILABLE TO APPLICANTS FOR THE CONSTRUCTION OF HOUSES OR OTHER BUILDINGS.
SIGNIFICANTLY, THE DECREE MAKES NO MENTION OF COMPENSATION AND THE CLEAR IMPLICATION IS THAT NONE WILL BE PAID.

(LOU) SINCE MANY OF THE OWNERS OF LARGE UNDEVELOPED TRACTS OF LAND ARE ABSENTEE LANDLORDS WITH SCANT DESIRE TO RETURN TO IRAN, THE NEW LAW APPEARS TO BE PRIMARILY DESIGNED AS A METHOD OF REDISTRIBUTING WEALTH. GIVEN THE EXTREMELY BROAD AUTHORITY GIVEN TO MHUD TO DEFINE AND IMPLEMENT THE NEW LAW AS WELL AS THE PRESENT IMPOTENCE OF THE REGULAR JUDICIAL SYSTEM, ADMINISTRATION BY MHUD WILL BE MOST IMPORTANT. ADMINISTRATION COULD BE VERY ARBITRARY AND CAPRICOUS. PREVIOUS GOVERNMENTS HAD ALSO BEEN CONCERNED ABOUT THE FAILURE OF LARGE LANDOWNERS TO DEVELOP THEIR LAND, BUT THE RESPONSE HAD BEEN TO ENACT SUBSTANTIAL TAX DISINCENTIVES FOR LEAVING LAND IDLE.

(U) SUBSEQUENT TO TYPING PARAS ABOVE, WE HAVE READ REPORT, ATTRIBUTED TO MINISTER OF HUD, THAT LANDOWNERS WOULD HAVE ONE YEAR TO DEVELOP THEIR LANDS. MINISTER ALSO WAS REPORTED TO HAVE SAID THAT ALL LANDS CONFISCATED WOULD BE SOLD BUT THAT THE STATE WOULD NOT TRY TO MAKE A PROFIT THROUGH THE SALES--HOW THE STATE COULD SELL SOMETHING ACQUIRED AT NO COST AND AVOID MAKING A PROFIT WAS NOT EXPLAINED. HOWEVER, ONE ARTICLE ON THE SUBJECT SAID THAT THE POOR WOULD BE PROVIDED LAND FREE OF CHARGE ALONG WITH GOVERNMENT ASSISTANCE IN BUILDING HOUSES. LAINGEN
(S - ENTIRE TEXT.)

EMBOFFS HAVE OBTAINED INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION OF BASIC POINTS IN INFORMATION PREVIOUSLY PROVIDED BY REVEREND PRYOR AS REPORTED IN REFTELS. VERIFICATION COMES FROM FSN SOURCE WHO IS CONSIDERED KNOWLEDGEABLE AND RELIABLE. SOURCE IS WORKING ON SETTING UP MEETING BETWEEN EMBOFFS AND BAHAI LEADERS.

IN MOST RECENT DISCUSSION WITH PRYOR ON JUNE 28, HE SAID THAT CURRENT SITUATION OF BAHAI COMMUNITY SHOULD PERHAPS BE MORE APPROPRIATELY CHARACTERIZED AS ONE OF "HARASSMENT AND DISCRIMINATION" RATHER THAN "PERSECUTION." BE THIS AS IT MAY, IT IS ABUNDANTLY CLEAR THAT THE BAHAI LEADERS ARE EXTREMELY WORRIED AND SEE THEMSELVES FACING THE WORST CRISIS IN THE HISTORY OF BAHAISM. EVERY DAY BRINGS ADDITIONAL EXAMPLES OF HARASSMENT.

THE BAHAI LEADERS ARE STILL HOPING THAT VIOLENCE CAN BE AVOIDED IN SHIRAZ ON JULY 10. THEY HAVE ASKED TO SEE PM BAZARGAN REGARDING THIS. MEANWHILE THEY DO NOT WISH TO PUBLICLY EXACERBATE THE ALREADY TENSE SITUATION. THEY HAVE SPECIFICALLY REQUESTED THAT THE USG NOT TAKE ANY ACTION AT THIS TIME BECAUSE OF THE POLITICAL SITUATION IN IRAN.

THE BAHAI LEADERS DO WANT TO MAKE SURE THAT INFORMATION AND DOCUMENTATION IS SAFELY IN PLACE OUTSIDE IRAN SO THAT THEY CAN GO PUBLIC WITH THEIR STORY WHEN AND IF NEEDED. THEY HAVE ASKED PRYOR TO GO TO GENEVA AND ZURICH, AND HE WILL DO SO AROUND JULY 7. PRYOR WILL REPORT TO THE WORLD COUNCIL OF CHURCHES' HUMAN RIGHTS COMMISSION IN GENEVA AND LEAVE DOCUMENTATION IN SAFE HANDS IN SWITZERLAND. HE IS AFRAID, HOWEVER, THAT THE SITUATION COULD BECOME SUBSTANTIALLY WORSE BEFORE THEN.

PRYOR PROVIDED THE FOLLOWING INFORMATION (WHICH WE HAVE NOT YET HAD TIME TO VERIFY FROM OTHER SOURCES) ON JUNE 28: OF THE ROUGHLY 400,000 BAHAIS IN IRAN, ABOUT 75,000 ARE IN TEHRAN. THE MASTER MEMBERSHIP LIST FOR TEHRAN WAS STOLEN ABOUT SIX WEEKS AGO. THE BAHAIS BELIEVE IT IS IN ISLAMIC HANDS, BECAUSE A NUMBER OF BAHAIS HAVE BEEN RECEIVING LETTERS IN THEIR NAME AT THEIR HOME ADDRESS FROM THE ISLAMIC PROPAGANDA ORGANIZATION IN QOM STRONGLY URGING THEM TO CONVERT TO ISLAM. SPIRITUAL ASSEMBLY MEETINGS HAVE BEEN BROKEN UP, AND FILES HAVE BEEN DESTROYED.
WHEREAS RELIGIOUS MEETINGS NORMALLY WERE ATTENDED BY 200 MEMBERS, THEY ARE NOW LIMITED TO 10-15 PEOPLE SO AS TO AVOID HARASSMENT.

TO DATE, THE PERSONAL BANK ACCOUNTS OF THE TOP 27 BAHAI LEADERS WHO MAKE UP THE NATIONAL COUNCIL HAVE BEEN FROZEN (BUT NOT YET CONFISCATED). TWO OF THESE LEADERS HAVE BEEN DENIED EXIT PERMITS, OTHERS HAVE NOT ATTEMPTED TO OBTAIN ONE. IN ADDITION TO PREVIOUSLY REPORTED CONFISCATIONS OF BAHAI COMMUNITY ASSETS, FOUR OF THE MAIN FIVE ADMINISTRATIVE BUILDINGS OF THE COMMUNITY HAVE BEEN CONFISCATED. THESE BUILDINGS ARE VALUED AT BETWEEN $70-100 MILLION. THE NUMBER OF CIVIL SERVANTS DISMISSED FROM THEIR JOBS SINCE EARLY DECEMBER ON THE SPECIFIC GROUND THAT THEY WERE BAHAI IS ABOUT 90, ACCORDING TO INFORMATION (DOCUMENTED) PROVIDED TO PRYOR.

THE BAHAI LEADERS DO NOT HAVE ANY REAL IDEA OF HOW MANY BAHAIS HAVE LEFT IRAN, BUT ARE UNDER THE IMPRESSION THAT THE EXODUS HAS NOT SO FAR BEEN SIGNIFICANT. THE LEADERS ARE URGING THEIR MEMBERS TO STAY IN IRAN.

UP TO NOW THE ACTIONS HAVE BEEN DIRECTED PRIMARILY AGAINST THE COMMUNITY AS AN ENTITY, RATHER THAN AGAINST INDIVIDUAL BAHAIS--EXCEPT FOR THE FROZEN BANK ACCOUNTS OF THE LEADERS, DISMISSAL OF CIVIL SERVANTS, ATTEMPTS TO PRESSURE INDIVIDUAL MEMBERS TO CONVERT, AND THE HARASSMENT OF RELIGIOUS MEETINGS. THE BAHAI LEADERS ARE FEARFUL THAT THE SITUATION FOR INDIVIDUALS WILL CHANGE FOR THE WORSE SOON.

NO BAHAIS HAVE BEEN KILLED IN THE POST-REVOLUTION ERA, AND NONE OF THE MORE THAN THREE HUNDRED PEOPLE WHO HAVE BEEN EXECUTED WERE BAHAIS (IT IS AGAINST BAHAI RULES FOR MEMBERS TO BE ACTIVE IN POLITICS). HOPEFULLY THE SAME CAN STILL BE SAID AFTER JULY 10. AS FURTHER INFORMATION BECOMES AVAILABLE THROUGH OTHER SOURCES, WE WILL UP-DATE REPORTING ON THIS SUBJECT.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT; REPORTING CABLE.)

SUMMARY: WEAPONS CONTROL CONTINUES TO POSE MAJOR PROBLEM; TRIALS AND EXECUTIONS CONTINUE; REPORTS OF TERRORISM AGAINST PGOI OFFICIAL; KHOMEINI WARNS AGAINST DEFAMATION OF CLERGY AND DEVIATION FROM "ISLAMIC TENETS"; EX-MEMBERS OF PARLIAMENT BARRED FROM LEAVING IRAN UNTIL SALARIES ARE REFUNDED; UNUTILIZED URBAN LAND TO BE CONFISCATED. END SUMMARY.

THE REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS LOCATED A LARGE ARMS CACHE IN TEHRAN 21 JUNE WHICH, ACCORDING TO PRESS REPORTS, BELONGED TO THE MARXIST FEDAYIN-E-KHALQ ORGANIZATION. THE FEDAYIN HAVE EMPHATICALLY DENIED ANY CONNECTION TO THE ARMS CACHE. IN OTHER NEWS OF ILLEGAL WEAPONS, IT WAS ANNOUNCED THAT AUTHORITIES SEIZED 6,000 KLASHINKOV RIFLES FROM SMUGGLERS ON THE IRAQI BORDER. THE WEAPONS WERE APPARENTLY DESTINED FOR THE TROUBLED ETHNIC ARAB KHUZESTAN PROVINCE IN SOUTHWEST IRAN. CHARGES OF ILLEGAL ARMS DISTRIBUTION CONTINUE TO BE MADE. THE KURDISH DEMOCRATIC PARTY CLAIMS THAT IN KURDESTAN REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS DISTRIBUTED "HUNDREDS" OF GUNS AMONG FEUDAL LANDLORDS HOSTILE TO THE KURDISH AUTONOMY MOVEMENT.

ATTEMPTS ALSO CONTINUE TO COLLECT WEAPONS, MOST RECENTLY IN URUMIEH (FORMERLY REZAYEH) AND RASHT. IN THE LATTER CITY A DEADLINE OF 30 JUNE HAS BEEN ANNOUNCED. BOTH CITIES CLAIMED THAT THOSE POSSESSING ILLEGAL WEAPONS WOULD BE PROSECUTED IN ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COURTS.

TRIALS AND EXECUTIONS CONTINUE IN IRAN. AFTER VERY EXTENSIVE PRESS AND TELEVISION COVERAGE OF THEIR TRIALS, SAVAK MEMBERS BAHMAN NADERIPOUR (ALIAS "TEHRANI") AND FEREIDOUN TAVANGARI (ALIAS "ARASH") WERE EXECUTED ON 24 JUNE, BRINGING THE NUMBER OF OFFICIAL EXECUTIONS TO OVER 300 SINCE FEBRUARY. THE ARASH/TEHRANI TRIAL WAS ONE OF THE LONGEST HELD BY THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS, EXTENDING THROUGH NINE SESSIONS. ONE REASON FOR THE LENGTH WAS GIVEN AS THE GREAT EXTENT OF KNOWLEDGE HELD BY THE TWO RE SAVAK'S INNER WORKINGS. MANY SOURCES HAVE COMMENTED, HOWEVER, THAT THE PUBLICITY GIVEN BY THE ACCUSED RE THE FEDAYIN-E-KHALQ ORGANIZATION WAS A MORE IMPORTANT REASON FOR THE LENGTHY TELEVISION COVERAGE.

THEY CLAIM THAT THE EXTENSIVE PUBLICITY WAS TO LAY GROUNDWORK FOR AN EVENTUAL MOVE AGAINST THE FEDAYIN-E-KHALQ BY THE PGOI. IN ISFAHAN, BRIGADIER GENERAL MORTEZA SHIRANI, THE FORMER DEPUTY CHIEF OF POLICE, WAS EXECUTED BY ORDERS OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COURT. FIVE FORMER OFFICIALS HAVE ALSO BEEN EXECUTED IN THE CITIES OF NAJAFABAD, GACHSARAN, AND MASHAD DURING THE PAST WEEK.

ETTELA'AT CLAIMED THAT AN ATTEMPT WAS MADE TO BOMB THE HOUSE OF MINISTER FOR REVOLUTIONARY AFFAIRS YADOLLAH SAHABI, ON 23 JUNE. ACCORDING TO THE ACCOUNT, THE BOMB WAS FOUND BY THE MINISTER'S GRANDDAUGHTER WHO THOUGHT IT WAS A TOY AND BROUGHT IT INTO THE FAMILY HOUSE. A SECURITY GUARD STOPPED HER AND THE BOMB WAS SUCCESSFULLY DEFUSED. PGOI SPOKESMAN AMIR-ENTEZAM DENIED LATER THAT ANY SUCH ATTEMPT HAD BEEN MADE.

IN AT LEAST TWO SPEECHES THIS PAST WEEK, AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI HAS WARNED AGAINST DEVIATION FROM "ISLAMIC TEACHINGS," WITH SPECIAL EMPHASIS ON THE SELF-CONTROL THAT "AKHONDS" (MOSLEM CLERGY) MUST EXERCISE. ADDRESSING A GROUP OF VISITORS TO QOM, HE BROUGHT UP CHARGES THAT HAVE BEEN MADE THAT "THE PAHLAVI DICTATORSHIP WAS BEING REPLACED BY THE DICTATORSHIP OF AKHONDS." IN ANOTHER ADDRESS BEFORE A GROUP OF REVOLUTIONARY GUARDSMEN, HE SAID THAT THOSE WHO ATTACK RELIGION OR THE CLERGY ARE "SERVING THE ENEMIES OF IRAN." KHOMEINI'S HALF WARNING TO THE CLERGY, HALF ATTACK ON THEIR DEFAMERS SHOWS AN INCREASING AWARENESS ON HIS PART THAT THE LEVEL OF ANTI-CLERICAL RHETORIC IS ON THE RISE.

ON 27 JUNE THE PROSECUTOR GENERAL OF THE ISLAMIC COURTS BARRED 757 FORMER PARLIAMENTARIANS FROM LEAVING IRAN UNTIL THEY REFUND ALL THE MONEY THEY RECEIVED AS SALARIES DURING THEIR TERMS OF OFFICE. THE REFUND OF SALARIES ORDER COVERS ALL THOSE WHO HAVE SERVED AS DEPUTIES OR SENATORS SINCE 1963. A TIME LIMIT OF JULY 31 HAS BEEN SET BY WHEN THE MONEY MUST BE RETURNED. RUBBING SALT INTO STILL OPEN FAMILY WOUNDS, THE ORDER ALSO INCLUDES THE SALARIES OF EIGHT DEPUTIES WHO HAVE ALREADY BEEN EXECUTED BY ISLAMIC COURTS. NEEDLESS TO SAY, THE REFUND WILL BE A NEAR IMPOSSIBILITY FOR MANY OF THE DEPUTIES.

ON 26 JUNE THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL APPROVED A BILL TO CANCEL THE OWNERSHIP OF UNUTILIZED URBAN LAND. THE MINISTRY OF HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT WILL IMPLEMENT THE NATIONALIZATION. PRESS ACCOUNTS ARE CONFUSED AS TO WHICH AND WHETHER SUCH LANDS ARE TO BE NATIONALIZED IMMEDIATELY, OR AFTER ONE OR THREE MORE YEARS OF NONUTILIZATION BY OWNERS. LAND OWNERSHIP HAS BECOME A CONFUSING ISSUE SINCE THE FEBRUARY REVOLUTION. THE EXTENSIVE PAHLAVI FAMILY HOLDINGS HAVE BEEN CONFISCATED, OF COURSE, AS WELL AS ESTATES AND LANDS BELONGING TO MANY OF THE FORMER REGIME'S MEMBERS.

IN SOME RURAL AREAS, VILLAGERS HAVE SIMPLY TAKEN OVER HOLDINGS WHETHER OR NOT THE OWNERS ARE ACCUSED OF CRIMES, AND REGULARIZING THE CLAIMS SEEMS TO BE BEYOND LOCAL LAW ENFORCEMENT ABILITY. FACED WITH THE GOAL OF ENCOURAGING AGRICULTURE AND AGRICULTURAL INVESTMENT, THE PGOI WILL HAVE A DIFFICULT CHALLENGE IN RESOLVING THE PROBLEMS INHERENT IN PROVIDING PEASANTS SUFFICIENT HOLDINGS AS WELL AS TRYING TO RESTORE THE CONFIDENCE OF LARGE-SCALE FARM OWNERS WHO FEAR CONFISCATION. POLCOUNS MET JUNE 29 WITH Y.K. GHADIMI, ONE OF THE BAHAI "NINE WISE MEN." GHADIMI RECOUNTED THE TRIALS AND TRIBULATIONS OF THE BAHAIS IN RECENT WEEKS IN ALMOST EXACTLY THE SAME TERMS AS THOSE PROVIDED BY PRYOR. INDEED, FROM CERTAIN PHRASES GHADIMI USED TO DESCRIBE THE SITUATION WE TENTATIVELY CONCLUDE THAT HE MAY HAVE BEEN ONE OF PRYOR'S SOURCES OF INFORMATION.

SINCE WE HAD ALREADY CONFIRMED THE ESSENTIAL ACCURACY OF WHAT PRYOR HAD REPORTED, POLCOUN'S MAIN OBJECTIVE WAS TO ELICIT FROM GHADIMI VIEWS ON HOW THE U.S. MIGHT BE HELPFUL IN THIS SITUATION. GHADIMI SAID THAT AS A MATTER OF POLICY THE BAHAI COMMUNITY PREFERS TO RELY ON ITS OWN RESOURCES TO THE EXTENT POSSIBLE TO SOLVE ITS PROBLEMS IN IRAN. ONLY IN THE EVENT THAT THESE LOCAL EFFORTS PROVE UNSUCCESSFUL WOULD THE BAHAIS LOOK TO OUTSIDE SOURCES FOR ASSISTANCE.

GHADIMI SAID THAT THE COMMUNITY HAD WRITTEN LETTERS AND SENT TELEGRAMS TO LEADING GOVERNMENT AND RELIGIOUS FIGURES AND FOLLOWED THAT UP WITH DISPATCHES OF DELEGATIONS TO THOSE THE COMMUNITY BELIEVED MIGHT BE SYMPATHETIC TO THEIR PLIGHT. IN GENERAL, THE GOVERNMENT HAS EITHER IGNORED THESE APPROACHES OR HAS PLEADED THAT IT HAS NO POWER TO DO ANYTHING ABOUT THE ACTIVITIES OF THE COMMITTEE STRUCTURE WHICH HAS ACTUALLY BEEN RESPONSIBLE FOR THE CONFISCATIONS AND OTHER FORMS OF HARASSMENT THE BAHAIS HAVE ENDURED. GHADIMI SAID THAT A FEW RELIGIOUS FIGURES, INCLUDING THE HEAD OF THE TEHRAN CENTRAL COMMITTEE, MAHDAVI-KANI, HAVE BEEN SYMPATHETIC, BUT AGAIN HAVE NOT BEEN OF MUCH PRACTICAL HELP.

IN ONE INSTANCE, MAHDAVI-KANI WROTE LETTERS TO SEVERAL TEHRAN DISTRICT COMMITTEES POINTING OUT THAT CONFISCATIONS ARE FORBIDDEN IN ISLAM BUT ALL HAD BEEN REJECTED BY THE MULLAHS IN CHARGE OF THE COMMITTEES INVOLVED. "WHO," THEY HAD ASKED, "IS MAHDAVIKANI TO GIVE US INSTRUCTIONS?"

GHADIMI SAID THAT THE BAHAIS ARE PURSUING A STRATEGY BASED ON THE PRINCIPLE THAT CONFISCATIONS ARE NOT PERMITTED IN ISLAM. SHARIAT-MADARI, HE CLAIMED, ADHERES TO THIS LINE, AND THE BAHAIS HAD GOTTEN RECENT INDICATIONS THAT KHOMEINI HIMSELF MIGHT BE PREPARED TO GO ALONG WITH IT. AT THE SAME TIME, THE BAHAIS ARE ENDEAVORING TO HAVE THE CONSTITUTION ALTERED IN WAYS THAT WILL AFFORD THEIR COMMUNITY GREATER PROTECTION THAN THE PRESENT DRAFT IMPLIES. FOR EXAMPLE, THE OLD CONSTITUTION MADE NO MENTION OF MINORITY GROUPS AS SUCH, AND THE BAHAIS WOULD PREFER THIS APPROACH TO THE ONE IN THE PRESENT DRAFT WHICH ONLY RECOGNIZES CHRISTIANS, JEWS AND ZOROASTRIANS.

ALTERNATIVELY,THEY WOULD LIKE TO SEE A STATEMENT THAT ALL MINORITY GROUPS, WITHOUT SPECIFYING THEIR IDENTITIES, ARE GUARANTEED THEIR CIVIL RIGHTS UNDER THE CONSTITUTION. GHADIMI SAID THAT THE BAHAIS RECOGNIZE THAT, ALTHOUGH THEY ARE MORE NUMEROUS THAN ALL OF THE OTHER RELGIIOUS MINORITIES COMBINED, IT IS EXTREMELY UNLIKELY THAT THEY WILL BE GIVEN OFFICIAL RECOGNITION AS BAHAIS IN THE FORESEEABLE FUTURE. HOWEVER, THEY DO NOT BELIEVE THAT IT IS BEYOND THE REALM OF POSSIBILITY THAT THEY COULD BE ACCORDED NON-SPECIFIC CONSTITUTIONAL GUARANTEES THAT WOULD IN EFFECT PROVIDE THEM THE SAME DEGREE OF PROTECTION AS THE OTHER MINORITY GROUPS.

TURNING TO THE U.S., GHADIMI SAID THAT BAHAIS AS A GROUP ARE NOT CONSIDERING A MASS EVACUATION OF IRAN. "THIS IS OUR HOME," HE SAID, "AND MANY OF OUR HOLY PLACES ARE HERE." THE BAHAIS, HE CONTINUED, WOULD STAY AS LONG AS THEY SEE EVEN THE FAINTEST HOPE THAT THEY CAN SURVIVE IN IRAN. HE WENT ON TO SAY THAT, GIVEN GREAT IRANIAN SENSITIVITIES ABOUT EXTERNAL POWERS INTERFERING IN IRAN'S INTERNAL AFFAIRS, ANY ACTION TAKEN BY THE U.S. ON BEHALF OF THE BAHAI COMMUNITY, NO MATTER HOW WELLINTENTIONED, COULD EASILY BACKFIRE AND THEREBY MAKE MATTERS WORSE FOR THE COMMUNITY.

FURTHER, THE COMMUNITY IS NOT LOOKING FOR SUCH ASSISTANCE, AT LEAST FOR THE MOMENT, BECAUSE OF ITS PREFERENCE TO APPROACH LOCAL PROBLEMS AT THE LOCAL LEVEL IN THE FIRST INSTANCE. HE CONCLUDED BY SUGGESTING THAT WE MIGHT BE ABLE TO REINFORCE THE BAHAIS' OWN EFFORTS BY POINTING OUT IN PRIVATE MEETINGS WITH SENIOR IRANIAN OFFICIALS, WHETHER IN ------------------026912 011301Z /46 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 2371 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 06801 LIMDIS WASHINGTON OR IN TEHRAN, THAT PERSECUTION OF MINORITIES IN GENERAL GIVES ISLAM A BAD NAME.

GHADIMI HASTENED TO ADD THAT SUCH APPROACHES WOULD HAVE TO BE HANDLED VERY CAREFULLY IF THEY WERE TO HAVE THE DESIRED IMPACT, BUT, AS A FORMER DIPLOMAT HIMSELF, HE BELIEVED THAT THEY COULD HAVE A POSITIVE RESULT.

IN SUM, THE BAHAIS WOULD PREFER TO FIGHT THEIR OWN BATTLES AND SEE ONLY A MARGINAL ROLE FOR THE U.S. WE AGREE, AND BELIEVE THAT ALMOST ANY ACTION WE COULD CONCEIVABLY TAKE OUTSIDE THE KIND OF QUIET DIPLOMACY SUGGESTED BY GHADIMI WOULD PROBABLY MAKE MATTERS WORSE

SUMMARY: DURING MY INITIAL CALL ON FM YAZDI JULY 2 I REITERATED U.S. DESIRE TO NORMALIZE RELATIONS WITH IRAN. I EMPHASIZED THAT THE PROCESS OF REBUILDING OUR RELATIONSHIP MUST BE A MUTUAL ONE. YAZDI RESPONDED BY EXPRESSING HIS AND HIS GOVERNMENT'S APPRECIATION FOR OUR STATEMENTS RECOGNIZING THE CHANGED CIRCUMSTANCES IN IRAN BUT CAUTIONED THAT RECOGNIZING THE REVOLUTION AND ACCEPTING IT ARE TWO DIFFERENT MATTERS. I GAVE YAZDI THE TEXT OF THE DEPARTMENT SPOKESMAN'S JUNE 25 BACKGROUND STATEMENT CONCERNING THE ASSIGNMENT OF AN AMBASSADOR, WHICH PROMPTED YAZDI TO ASK JUST WHEN WE WOULD BE SENDING SOMEONE. HE ALSO WANTED TO KNOW WHAT WAS IMPLIED BY GEN.
ROGERS' STATEMENT RE "SPECIAL FORCES" IN THE GULF AREA. END SUMMARY.

I BEGAN MY REMARKS BY STATING FOR THE RECORD MY GOVERNMENT'S APPRECIATION FOR THE HELP YAZDI AND HIS COLLEAGUES AT THE MFA HAD PROVIDED. I TOLD HIM THAT WE WERE ESPECIALLY APPRECIATIVE FOR HIS PERSONAL INTERVENTION IN TIMES OF DANGER AND STRESS FOR THE PERSONNEL ASSIGNED TO OUR MISSION IN IRAN. I SAID THAT I HAD COME TO IRAN AS A FRIEND, BOTH IN PERSONAL TERMS AND AS AN OFFICIAL OF THE USG.

I TOLD HIM THAT I HAD BEEN INSTRUCTED TO SAY THAT MY GOVERNMENT IS PREPARED TO WORK IN JOINT EFFORT WITH THE PGOI TO REBUILD A MUTUALLY BENEFICIAL RELATIONSHIP, ONE THAT TAKES INTO FULL AND SYMPATHETIC ACCOUNT THE CHANGED SITUATION IN IRAN. IRAN'S INDEPENDENCE AND TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY, I SAID, ARE OF ABIDING INTEREST TO US. WE WANT A STRONG AND VIGOROUS IRAN. WE STAND READY TO COOPERATE IN ACHIEVING THAT END, INCLUDING A READINESS TO WORK TOGETHER IN SORTING OUT OLD PROBLEMS SUCH AS MILITARY SUPPLY AS WELL AS REACHING UNDERSTANDING ON AREAS OF COOPERATION IN THE FUTURE.

I SAID THAT WE WISH IRAN WELL IN ITS EFFORTS TO DRAFT A NEW CONSTITUTION AND TO BUILD NEW INSTITUTIONS OF GOVERNMENT ALTHOUGH WE HAD NEITHER THE INTENTION NOR DESIRE TO INVOLVE OURSELVES IN ANY WAY IN THAT PROCESS. I STRESSED THAT THE REBUILDING OF OUR RELATIONSHIP MUST BE A MUTUAL PROCESS IN WHICH RESTRAINT AND UNDERSTANDING ARE REQUIRED ON BOTH SIDES. I TOLD HIM THAT, IN THIS REGARD, I HAD BEEN INSTRUCTED TO EXPRESS OUR APPRECIATION FOR RECENT STATEMENTS BY PGOI SPOKESMEN, INCLUDING HIMSELF AND DEPUTY PM AMIR-ENTEZAM REGARDING U.S.-IRANIAN RELATIONS. I SPECIFICALLY MENTIONED YAZDI'S COMMENTS OF JUNE 27 REGARDING MILITARY-RELATED ISSUES.

I CONCLUDED BY STATING THAT MY GOVERNMENT WANTS A GOOD RELATIONSHIP WITH THE NEW IRAN AND THAT, FROM OUR POINT OF VIEW, MY ASSIGNMENT TO IRAN, ALBEIT AN INTERIM ONE, WAS A STEP IN THE REBUILDING PROCESS.

YAZDI THANKED ME FOR MY REMARKS AND SAID THAT, AS I KNEW, HIS GOVERNMENT, TOO, HAD OFTEN SAID THAT IT WANTS A MUTUALLY BENEFICIAL RELATIONSHIP. THERE ARE, HE CONTINUED, PROBLEMS IN REACHING THIS GOAL, PROBLEMS WHICH HE HAD DISCUSSED WITH FORMER CHARGE NAAS. HE HAD FOUND HIS RECOGNITION THAT THE HISTORY OF OUR RELATIONSHIP WITH THE PREVIOUS REGIME CONSTITUTED A MAJOR OBSTACLE TO THE NORMALIZATION PROCESS AN ENCOURAGING SIGN.

UNDERSTANDING THE REALITY OF THE NEW IRAN, HE SAID, WILL MAKE IT POSSIBLE FOR US TO DEVELOP A MEANINGFUL RELATIONSHIP. "ALL WE WANT IS AMERICANS TO KNOW AND ACCEPT THE NEW REALITY HERE." TO MY RESPONSE THAT, "YOU HAVE IT," YAZDI COUNTERED THAT THERE IS A DISTINCTION BETWEEN RECOGNIZING THE REALITY HERE AND ACCEPTING IT.

HIS GOVERNMENT AND THE IRANIAN PEOPLE, HE SAID, ARE STILL UNSURE ABOUT AMERICAN ACCEPTANCE OF THEIR REVOLUTION. YAZDI AGAIN REPLIED THAT THE PGOI WAS TRYING TO BE "COOL," THAT IT THOUGHT IT HAD BEEN GIVEN ASSURANCES WE WOULD QUICKLY NOMINATE SOMEONE TO REPLACE CUTLER, THAT IT WANTED US TO DO SO.

AS WE WERE WINDING UP THE MEETING YAZDI SAID THAT HE WOULD LIKE TO TALK AT A LATER SESSION ABOUT THE IMPLICATIONS OF GENERAL ROGERS' STATEMENT REGARDING "SPECIAL FORCES" IN THE PERSIAN GULF AREA. I REPLIED THAT I WOULD BE AVAILABLE AT ANY TIME, BUT THAT, IN BRIEF, ROGERS' STATEMENT REFLECTED OUR GLOBAL CONCERNS AND OUR PERCEPTION OF A NEED TO DEFEND OUR WORLDWIDE INTERESTS. I STRESSED THAT ROGERS WAS REFERRING ONLY TO CONTINGENCY PLANNING. I THEN NOTED RECENT PRESS REPORTS HERE THAT THE U.S. IS SOMEHOW INVOLVED IN TRYING TO SEPARATE KHUZISTAN FROM THE REST OF IRAN, SAYING THAT SUCH ACCUSATIONS ARE CONTRARY TO ALL LOGIC.

OUR OVERRIDING INTEREST IN THIS PART OF THE WORLD, I SAID, RELATED TO THE NEED FOR AN UNINTERRUPTED FLOW OF OIL FROM THE REGION. WE SEE STABILITY AND DETENTE AMONG THE COUNTRIES OF THE REGION AS THE BEST ASSURANCE OF THAT, A POINT INCIDENTALLY THAT OUR MISSION IN IRAQ HAD MADE THERE ON THE SUBJECT OF IRAN/IRAQ RELATIONS. YAZDI REPLIED THAT THE PRESS REPORTS ABOUT U.S. INVOLVEMENT IN KHUZISTAN MUST BE VIEWED IN THE CONTEXT OF THE ROGERS STATEMENT.

I REITERATED THAT HE WAS REFERRING TO CONTINGENCY PLANNING, THAT WE ARE NOT SEEKING IN ANY WAY TO DESTABILIZE THE SITUATION HERE. "YES," YAZDI SAID, "BUT HOW CAN SPECIAL FORCES HELP IN THAT REGARD?" (A QUESTION THAT WE HEAR A GOOD DEAL OF, ACCOMPANIED BY INCREDULITY THAT WE WOULD IN ANY EVENT GO PUBLIC WITH SUCH PLANNING.)

DURING JULY 2 CALL ON FM YAZDI, CHARGE EXPRESSED REGRET OVER THE EXPULSION OF L.A. TIMES CORRESPONDENT DAVID LAMB. WHILE CONCEDING THE PGOI'S RIGHT TO TAKE THIS ACTION, HE SAID THAT IT WAS CONTRARY TO THE PGOI'S OWN EXPRESSIONS OF SUPPORT FOR A FREE FLOW OF INFORMATION. HE SAID THAT WE WERE CONCERNED ABOUT THE IMPACT OF THIS ACTION IN THE U.S. WHERE WE SAW IT AS COUNTERPRODUCTIVE TO IRAN'S OWN INTERESTS AND HARMFUL TO THE ATMOSPHERE IN WHICH WE SEEK TO REBUILD OUR BILATERAL RELATIONSHIP. YAZDI RESPONDED THAT THE U.S. PRESS HAD BEEN BIASED REGARDING THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION.

HE ADDED THAT THE PGOI HAD WARNED PRESS REPRESENTATIVES ABOUT REPORTING MISINFORMATION. HE ALSO CLAIMED THAT THE PGOI IN GENERAL AND HE HIMSELF IN PARTICULAR HAD FREQUENTLY MADE SPECIAL EFFORTS TO FACILITATE PRESSMEN COMING TO IRAN. HE CITED A RECENT INSTANCE IN WHICH HE HAD PERSONALLY INTERVENED TO HAVE NYT CORRESPONDENT YOUSEF IBRAHIM ADMITTED TO IRAN EVEN THOUGH HE HAD ARRIVED AT THE TEHRAN AIRPORT WITHOUT A VISA.
