SUMMARY. DURING CALL ON FM YAZDI JULY 2 CHARGE RAISED ISSUE OF COMPOUND SECURITY IN THE CONTEXT OF OUR DESIRE TO GET ON WITH THE PROCESS OF NORMALIZATION OF OUR BILATERIAL RELATIONS. END SUMMARY.

REFERRING TO EARLIER CONVERSATIONS BETWEEN NAAS AND YAZDI AND THE CHIEF OF PROTOCOL AND HIMSELF, CHARGE EXPRESSED HIS THANKS FOR THE JOB WHICH THE SECURITY FORCE ASSIGNED TO THE EMB HAD DONE. HE ADDED, HOWEVER, THAT WE LOOK FORWARD TO A RETURN TO A MORE NORMAL SITUATION AS FAR AS EMB SECURITY IS CONCERNED IN THE CONTEXT OF THE NORMALIZATION OF OUR BILATERAL RELATIONSHIP WITH IRAN. YAZDI QUICKLY REPLIED THAT WE SHOULD TELL THE PGOI IF WE NO LONGER NEED A SECURITY FORCE. THE CHARGE COUNTERED THAT, SINCE THE PGOI IS RESPONSIBLE FOR PROVIDING PROTECTION FOR DIPLOMATIC MISSIONS, WE MUST LOOK TO IT FOR A DETERMINATION ON WHAT IS REQUIRED.

HE NOTED, THAT WHILE THE PRESENT ARRANGEMENT HAS WORKED, THERE HAVE BEEN PROBLEMS, INCLUDING SOME ADVERSE PUBLICITY, WHICH HAVE NOT BENEFITTED EITHER GOVERNMENT. HE THEREFORE HOPED THE PGOI WOULD LOOK INTO THE SITUATION WITH A VIEW TO RETURNING TO MORE USUAL SECURITY PRACTICES, PERHAPS WITH A CONTINGENT OF NATIONAL POLICE STATIONED OUTSIDE THE EMB WALLS AND AT ITS GATES.

YAZDI THEN REFERRED TO PRESS REPORTS (WE THINK HE HAD IN MIND SPECIFICALLY A RECENT L.A. TIMES REPORT WHICH APPEARED IN THE FARSI LANGUAGE PRESS IN TRANSLATION), ASKING IF IT WAS TRUE THAT OUR SECURITY FORCE HAD BEEN DEMANDING LIQUOR AND HARASSING WOMEN ON THE EMB COMPOUND. THE CHARGE REPLIED THAT WE HAVE ONLY CIRCUMSTANTIAL EVIDENCE, ADDING THAT, WHETHER OR NOT THE RUMORS ABOUT SUCH ACTIVITIES ARE TRUE, THESE RUMORS CREATE A BAD IMPRESSION WHICH ONLY COMPLICATES THE SITUATION. YAZDI SAID THAT WHAT WE DO ON THE INSIDE OF THE COMPOUND IS UP TO US.

THE PRESENT GROUP COULD BE REPLACED, HE SAID, BUT THEN ADDED THAT THERE MIGHT BE SOME PROBLEM IN DOING THIS SINCE IT HAD BEEN THERE SINCE THE REVOLUTION. CHARGE SAID THIS WAS PGOI'S PROBLEM, NOT OURS. YAZDI NOTED THAT THE PGOI HAS THE SAME KIND OF PROBLEM IN DEALING WITH THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES WHICH HAD ALSO CARVED OUT EMPIRES IN THE AFTERMATH OF THE REVOLUTION THAT THEY ARE NOW RELUCTANT TO ABANDON.

THE CHARGE THEN MENTIONED RIVALRIES BETWEEN THE GROUP AT THE EMB AND OTHER GROUPS WHICH HAD RESULTED IN A SHOOT-OUT IN THE EARLY HOURS OF JUNE 22 AT ONE OF THE GUARD POSTS ON THE COMPOUND--THE SORT OF THING THAT SIMPLY ADDS TO TENSIONS AND HARMS MORALE. HE STRESSED THAT IT IS OUR DESIRE TO RETURN TO NORMAL ACCROSS-THEBOARD. WE WANT TO BE ABLE TO DEMONSTRATE OUR CONFIDENCE IN THE THE PGOI.

YAZDI REPLIED THAT AS A MATTER OF GENERAL POLICY THE PGOI IS TRYING TO REMOVE GROUPS ASSIGNED TO SUCH TASKS AS THAT OF THE GROUP GUARDING THE EMB AND WHICH HAVE BEEN IN PLACE FOR AN EXTENDED PERIOD OF TIME WITH NEW GROUPS. BY THIS MEANS, HE SAID, THE PGOI HOPES TO BE ABLE TO EXERCISE GREATER DISCIPLINARY CONTROL OVER ALL GROUPS THAN HAS BEEN POSSIBLE HERETOFORE. WHEN ASKED BY THE CHARGE WHEN THIS MIGHT BE DONE WITH THE GROUP ASSIGNED TO THE EMB, YAZDI REPLIED WITHIN ONE OR TWO WEEKS.
CLOSING OUT THE DISCUSSION ON THIS SUBJECT, THE CHARGE EMPHASIZED OUR DESIRE TO HELP IN WHATEVER WAY WE COULD TO MAKE THE TRANSITION TO A MORE NORMAL SECURITY ARRANGEMENT AS SMOOTH AS POSSIBLE.

LATER IN THE DAY POLCOUNS FOLLOWED UP WITH FOURTH POLITICAL DEPARTMENT REP,PARSAKIA, WHO SAT IN ON MORNING SESSION. PARSAKIA AGAIN ASKED JUST WHAT IT IS THAT WE WANT WITH REGARD TO OUR SECURITY FORCE. POLCOUNS REFUSED TO BE DRAWN INTO A SPECIFIC STATEMENT, REITERATING INSTEAD OUR DESIRE TO MOVE AS EXPEDITIOUSLY AS POSSIBLE TO MORE NORMAL ARRANGEMENTS.

PARSAKIA SAID THAT IT MIGHT NOT BE POSSIBLE JUST YET TO REPLACE OUR CURRENT PROTECTORS WITH NATIONAL POLICE, BUT RESPONDED POSITIVELY TO THE SUGGESTION THAT THE PROCESS COULD BE CARRIED OUT IN SEVERAL STAGES WITH THE FIRST PERHAPS BEING REPLACEMENT OF THE GROUP HERE NOW BY ANOTHER IRREGULAR GROUP THAT WOULD BE ASSIGNED TO EMB PERIMETER. POLCOUNS STRESSED WE LOOK TO PGOI TO DETERMINE WHAT IS BOTH REQUIRED AND FEASIBLE, BUT THAT IT IS OUR DESIRE TO RESTORE OUR SECURITY ARRANGEMENTS TO THOSE MORE IN ACCORDANCE WITH REGULAR DIPLOMATIC PRACTICES AT THE
(C - ENTIRE TEXT.)

DURING CALL BY DEPOFF CLEMENT AND POLCOUNS ON MINISTER OF NATIONAL GUIDANCE (FORMERLY INFORMATION)(MINACHI JULY 4 THE SUBJECT OF THE EXPULSION OF L.A. TIMES CORRESPONDENT DAVID LAMB AND CHARGE'S EARLIER EXPRESSION OF REGRET TO FM YAZDI (REF B) CAME UP. MINACHI SAID THAT LAMB WAS ASKED TO LEAVE BECAUSE HE WAS NOT PROPERLY DOCUMENTED AS A FOREIGN CORRESPONDENT AND ASKED WHY WE HAD OBJECTED TO THIS ACTION. OFFS EXPLAINED THAT NEITHER CHARGE NOR USG QUESTIONED RIGHT OF PGOI TO EXERCISE ITS SOVEREIGN AUTHORITY, BUT THAT CHARGE HAD WANTED TO REGISTER U.S.
VIEW THAT EXPULSION OF LAMB WAS CONTRARY TO PGOI'S OWN EXPRESSION OF SUPPORT FOR FREE FLOW OF INFORMATION AND, ULTIMATELY, COUNTER-PRODUCTIVE TO IRAN'S OWN INTERESTS.

AT THAT POINT MINACHI CALLED IN ALI BEHZADNIA, DIRECTOR GENERAL OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS AT THE MINISTRY OF NATIONAL GUIDANCE, TO ELABORATE. AFTER PRESENTATION OF HIS VERSION OF THE EVENTS LEADING UP TO LAMB'S EXPULSION, WHICH WAS HEAVILY LARDED WITH COMPLAINTS AGAINST L.A. TIMES REPORTING OF THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION AND ITS AFTERMATH, OFFS ASKED BEHZADNIA WHETHER DECISION TO EXPELL LAMB HAD BEEN BASED ON LAMB'S LACK OF PROPER DOCUTION OR THE L.A. TIMES' COVERAGE OF IRAN.

BEHZADNIA QUICKLY REPLIED, "BOTH," THEREBY PROMPTING ONCE AGAIN A STATEMENT BY OFFS THAT, WHILE THE USG DID NOT QUESTION PGOI'S AUTHORITY TO ACT AS IT SAW FIT IN THIS MATTER, IT DID REGRET ANY APPEARANCE OF INTERFERENCE IN THE FREE FLOW OF INFORMATION AND BELIEVED THAT SUCH ACTIONS WOULD ULTIMATELY PROVE SELFDEFEATING.

FOLLOWING A LONG DISCUSSION OF THE FEASIBILITY OF CONTROLLING WHAT THE INTERNATIONAL PRESS WRITES ABOUT IRAN, IN WHICH BEHZADNIA SEVERAL TIMES INDICATED HIS CONVICTION THAT IT COULD BE DONE, OFFS ENDED THE MEETING BY ASKING IF LAMB'S EXPULSION MEANT THAT THE L.A. TIMES COULD NOT SEND ANOTHER CORRESPONDENT. BEHZADNIA IMMEDIATELY DEMURRED, SAYING THAT, IF THE INDIVIDUAL WAS PROPERLY DOCUMENTED AND ABIDED BY IRANIAN LAWS AND REGULATIONS, THERE WOULD BE NO PROBLEM. HE POINTED TO THE PRESENCE OF L.A. TIMES REPORTER KATHY HENDRIX, WHO WAS PROPERLY DOCUMENTED, AS PROOF OF THE PGOI'S FLEXIBILITY IN THIS REGARD.

(COMMENT: THERE WAS AN ELEMENT OF DISINGENUITY IN THIS LATTER STATEMENT SINCE HENDRIX IS HERE TO DO A SINGLE STORY, BUT WE THINK THE POINT WE WANTED TO MAKE, I.E., THAT IT WOULD BE FUTILE FOR THE PGOI TO ATTEMPT TO BAR THE INTERNATIONAL MEDIA FROM COVERING IRAN, GOT ACROSS. ACCORDINGLY, IF THE L.A. TIMES WISHES TO REPLACE LAMB, WE THINK IT CAN SAFELY DO SO, PROVIDED THAT WHOEVER COMES PAYS CLOSE ATTENTION TO THE REGULATORY REQUIREMENTS GOVERNING THE PRESENCE OF FOREIGN CORRESPONDENTS IN IRAN. END COMMENT.)

ONE OTHER POINT OF INTEREST CAME OUT OF THE MEETING: IT WAS CLEAR FROM WHAT BEHZADNIA SAID AND MINACHI'S LACK OF KNOWLEDGE OF MANY OF THE DETAILS OF THE LAMB CASE THAT THE FORMER HAS OPERATED WITH CONSIDERABLE FREEDOM IN HIS AREA OF RESPONSIBILITY, APPARENTLY ABLE TO SPEAK IN HIS MINISTER'S NAME WITH GREAT AUTHORITY. THIS SITUATION STANDS IN SHONTRAST TO TRADITIONAL PERSIAN BUREAUCRATIC PRACTICES WHERE THE TOP MAN WAS THE ONLY PERSON WHO COULD MAKE EVEN THE MOST ROUTINE DECISIONS. WE DO NOT KNOW IF THIS IS AN ISOLATED CASE OR REPRESENTS A NEW PHENOMENON PECULIAR TO THE PERIOD SINCE THE REVOLUTION. WE WILL CONTINUE TO WATCH IT. LAINGEN

1979TEHRAN06996.subject: U.S. DROPS IN POP ART CHARTS

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT)

A RECENT SURVEY OF TEHRAN WALLS AND A CHECK OF SIDEWALK VENDORS BY EMBOFF INDICATED THAT ANTI-AMERICAN POSTERS, WHICH ONCE CHALLENGED AYATOLLAH PORTRAITS FOR TOP-TEN SUPREMACY, ARE NO LONGER AMONG THE LEADERS IN THE POP ART HIT PARADE. THE FORMERLY POPULAR FULL-COLOR SLAPS AT UNCLE SAM HAVE GIVEN WAY TO A FEW BLACK-ANDWHITE PRINTS ON FLIMSY PAPER AND EVEN THESE ARE HARD TO FIND. WHILE KHOMEINI STILL TOPS THE ART CHARTS, HE IS PRESENTLY GETTING STIFF COMPETITION FROM CHE GUEVARA AND V.I. LENIN.

MAKING A SUPRISE COMEBACK IN THE POSTER WORLD IS SINGER GOOGOOSH, WHO, IN THE IMMEDIATE AFTERMATH OF THE REVOLUTION, WAS BANNED FROM IRAN'S AIRWAVES AS A DECADENT INFLUENCE BY BROADCASTING CZAR SADEGH "WOLFMAN" GHOTBZADEH. LAINGEN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)

DESPITE UNCERTAINTIES OF OUR SITUATION HERE AS A CONSEQUENCE OF IRAN'S REVOLUTION, MISSION DECIDED TO CONDUCT OBSERVANCES OF THE 4TH OF JULY IN AS NORMAL MANNER AS POSSIBLE. THIS INCLUDED AN OFFICIAL VIN D'HONNEUR TO WHICH THE DIPLOMATIC CORPS, BUSINESS AND PRESS REPRESENTATIVES, AND A NUMBER OF SENIOR PGOI OFFICIALS WERE INVITED. FEW AMONG THE LATTER GROUP BOTHERED TO R.S.V.P., AND THUS IT WAS SOMETHING OF A PLEASANT SURPRISE THAT A SUBSTANTIAL NUMBER DID IN FACT ATTEND. FM YAZDI LED A LARGE DELEGATION FROM THE FOREIGN MINISTRY. DEPUTY PM AMIR-ENTEZAM WAS ALSO THERE, AS WERE THE MINISTERS OF NATIONAL GUIDANCE (MINACHI) AND AGRICULTURE (IZADI).

CENTRAL BANK GOVERNOR MOULAVI CAME AND SO DID GEN. EFTEKHARI OF THE NATIONAL DEFENSE INDUSTRIES ORGANIZATION, COL. IRAN-NEJAD OF THE MINISTRY OF NATIONAL DEFENSE, AND VICE CHIEF OF STAFF OF THE ARMY GEN. MADANI. WE ARE INCLINED TO REGARD THIS TURNOUT AS A CONSCIOUS EFFORT ON THE PGOI'S PART TO TELL US THAT IT IS SERIOUS IN ITS DESIRE TO NORMALIZE RELATIONS WITH US. SEVERAL OF THE OFFICIAL IRANIANS ASKED MISSION OFFICERS ABOUT OUR PLANS FOR SENDING AN AMBASSADOR. LAINGEN

1979TEHRAN07009.subject: TABRIZ: CONTINUING ECONOMIC EFFECTS OF THE REVOLUTION

segments.text: TELEGRAM TEXT FOR THIS SEGMENT IS UNAVAILABLE
(LOU) ENTIRE TEXT.

DURING THE PAST WEEK, SOME DETAILS ON THE PGOI BUDGET FOR THE IRANIAN YEAR 1358 (ENDING MARCH 20, 1980) HAVE APPEARED IN THE PRESS ATTRIBUTED TO THE MINISTERS OF MINES AND INDUSTRY AND THE PLAN AND BUDGET ORGANIZATION. A CONTACT IN PBO HAS TOLD US THAT THE BUDGET IS STILL BEING PRINTED BUT SHOULD BE AVAILABLE NEXT WEEK. SOURCE ALSO CONFIRMED THAT THE BUDGET HAS NOT BEEN APPROVED BY THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL. HOWEVER, WE EXPECT THAT THE COUNCIL HAS HAD SUFFICIENT INPUT INTO THE FORMULATION OF THE BUDGET THAT APPROVAL WILL BE A QUICK FORMALITY.

ACCORDING TO CURRENT, PRESUMBABLY FINAL, PRONOUNCEMENTS, IRAN'S NATIONAL BUDGET FOR 1358 WILL BE 2,440 BILLION RIALS ($34.6 BILLION). PBO HEAD ALI AKBAR MOINFAR TOLD THE PRESS THAT THE BUDGET IS BASED ON ESTIMATED TOTAL REVENUES OF 2,107 BN RIALS ($29.9 BN), AND WILL, THEREFORE, CONTAIN A DEFICIT OF 333 BN RIALS ($4.7 BN). HOW THE DEFICIT IS TO BE FINANCED WAS NOT DISCUSSED. ON THE REVENUE SIDE, MOINFAR PREDICTED OIL/GAS REVENUES OF 1,472 BN RIALS ($20.9 BN), WHICH IS ABOUT FIVE PERCENT LESS THAN THE ESTIMATED OIL/GAS REVENUE IN THE 1357 BUDGET.

(COMMENT: ALTHOUGH OIL/GAS REVENUES, THANKS TO SUCCESSIVE PRICE INCREASES DURING THE PAST FEW MONTHS, ARE PRESENTLY RUNNING AT AN ANNUALIZED RATE OF OVER $25 BN, THE $20.9 BN REVENUE ESTIMATE IS REASONABLE SINCE THE PRICE INCREASES WERE NOT RETROACTIVE AND SINCE INCOME FROM RESUMED OIL EXPORTS DID NOT AMOUNT TO VERY MUCH UNTIL MAY. END COMMENT) TAX RECEIPTS DURING 1358 WERE PROJECTED TO BE 553 BN RIALS ($7.8 BN), AND "SPECIAL REVENUES" (INCOME FROM FOREIGN INVESTMENTS?) ACCOUNT FOR THE OTHER 82 BN RIALS ($1.16 BN). (COMMENT: THE ESTIMATE FOR TAX REVENUES, WHICH PRESUMABLY INCLUDES CUSTOMS CHARGES, COULD NOT BE MUCH MORE THAN A CRUDE ESTIMATE.

AT THIS POINT, IT WOULD ONLY SEEM SAFE TO SAY THAT TAX/CUSTOMS REVENUES WILL BE DOWN CONSIDERABLY BECAUSE OF THE CONTINUING ECONOMIC DISLOCATIONS, AMNESTIES ON TAXES AND VARIOUS CHARGES PAYABLE BY MERCHANDISE IMPORTERS, ETC. HOWEVER, IF THE ESTIMATE IS WRONG, WE WOULD EXPECT TAX/CUSTOMS REVENUES TO BE LESS THAN ANTICIPATED. END COMMENT).

ON THE EXPENDITURE SIDE, MOINFAR ESTIMATED THE CAPITAL BUDGET AT 880 BN RIALS ($12.5 BN) WHICH WOULD LEAVE 1,560 BN RIALS ($22.1 BN) FOR THE GENERAL EXPENDITURES (CURRENT) BUDGET. BOTH FIGURES ARE HIGHER THAN EARLIER ESTIMATED (REF B) AND REFLECT, IN LARGE PART, THE LEGACY INHERITED FROM THE SHAH'S GOVERNMENTS -- AN EXCESSIVELY LARGE AND OFTEN OVER PAID BUREAUCRACY, MAJOR PROJECTS WHICH ARE PARTIALLY COMPLETED AND WHICH CAN BE SCRAPPED ONLY AT GREAT COST, INEFFICIENT STATE INDUSTRIES, ETC.

RELATIVELY FEW DETAILS ARE AVAILABLE ON SPECIFIC EXPENDITURE PLANS, BUT THERE HAVE APPARENTLY BEEN NO CHANGES IN THE BASIC EMPHASIS ON AGRICULTURE, REGIONAL/RURAL DEVELOPMENT, HOUSING FOR THE LOWER CLASSES, SOCIAL SERVICES, AND DEVELOPMENT OF INDUSTRIES WHICH UTILIZE A HIGH PERCENTAGE OF IRANIAN ORIGIN COMPONENTS AND RAW MATERIALS. HOWEVER, ONE INTERESTING REVELATION BY MOINFAR WAS THAT DEFENSE SPENDING WILL BE CUT FROM 700 BN RIALS LAST YEAR TO ONLY 300 BN RIALS IN 1358.

THE DECISION TO ENACT AN EXPANSIONARY BUDGET WITH A SUBSTANTIAL DEFICIT REFLECTS THE CONTINUING, AND PERHAPS EVEN INCREASING, CONCERN WITHIN THE PGOI OVER THE NEED TO STIMULATE ECONOMIC RECOVERY AND EMPLOYMENT. WHETHER THERE WILL BE SUFFICIENT POLITICAL WILL AND ORGANIZATIONAL SKILLS TO ACTUALLY DISBURSE THE AMOUNTS AUTHORIZED REMAINS TO BE SEEN.
FURTHER DETAILS WILL BE REPORTED AS THEY BECOME

(U) THERE FOLLOWS THE TEXT OF DOCTOR SEYED MOHAMMAD BEHESHTI'S ANSWER TO A QUESTION ON IRAN'S CURRENT ANTIZIONIST POLICY AND HOW IT AFFECTS IRANIAN JEWS WHICH WAS ASKED DURING THE COURSE OF A RECENT INTERVIEW CONDUCTED BY THE WEEKLY NEWS MAGAZINE, THE IRANIAN.

(U) "FIRST OF ALL, SUCH A POSSIBILITY MUST DEFINITELY BE PREVENTED. SECONDLY, SO FAR, I HAVE NOT SEEN ANY SIGNS THAT ANTI-ZIONIST FEELINGS IN IRAN HAVE RESULTED OR LEAD TO ANTI-JEWISH FEELINGS. YOU MUST TAKE NOTE THAT ANTIZIONISM IS NOT SOMETHING NEW. ANTI-ZIONIST FEELINGS HAVE EXISTED FOR DECADES IN IRAN, WHEREAS PEOPLE'S ATTITUDES TOWARDS THE JEWS HAVE BEEN IMPROVING DAILY. IN FACT, AS FAR AS I CAN SEE, ONE OF THE EFFECTS OF THE INTELLECTUAL DEVELOPMENT AND SOCIAL MOVEMENT OF THE PEOPLE OVER THE LAST 30 YEARS HAS BEEN A MARKED IMPROVEMENT IN THEIR ATTITUDE TOWARDS THE MINORITIES.

AND WHEN I COMPARE THE CONDUCT TOWARDS THE JEWS TODAY WITH THAT OF 30 YEARS AGO, OR EVEN LAST YEAR, I FIND THIS IMPROVING ATTITUDE IS NOT NEW. IT HAS BEEN BETTER THAN THAT TOWARDS THE ZOROASTRIANS OR THE CHRISTIANS. IT IS NATURAL THAT IN THE PROCESS OF A REVOLUTION, PEOPLE BECOME MORE MATURE THROUGH INTELLECTUAL AND SOCIAL GROWTH. AND OF COURSE I WILL ALSO SAY THAT IF, GOD FORBID, THROUGH FOREIGN PROVOCATION, OR FOR ANY OTHER REASON, WE NOTICE THE SIGNS OF ANY ANTI-JEWISH DEVELOPMENT, WE WILL STOP IT WITH ALL OUR MIGHT."

(C) BEHESHTI'S CLEAR-CUT DISTINCTION BETWEEN ANTI-ZIONISM AND ANTI-SEMITISM NOTWITHSTANDING, A COMMON COMPLAINT WE HEAR FROM IRANIAN JEWS (AND OTHER MINORITIES AS WELL) IS THAT MANY OF THE IRANIANS-IN-THE-STREET DO NOT MAKE THE FINE DISTINCTIONS THEIR POLITICAL AND RELIGIOUS LEADERS DO. CONSEQUENTLY, TO STIR UP ANTI-ZIONIST SENTIMENT OR TO AROUSE RELIGIOUS FERVOR AMONG THE MUSLIM MAJORITY HAS THE PRACTICAL EFFECT OF EXACERBATING INTER-COMMUNAL FRICTIONS. THIS WAS A POINT MADE ONCE AGAIN BY RABBI SHOFAT IN A RECENT MEETING WITH DEPTOFF CLEMENT AND POLCOUNS (SEPTEL).
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)
TWO RECENT CONVERSATIONS WITH EMB DRIVERS MAY BE AS GOOD AS ANY INDICATION OF THE RANGE OF ATTITUDES AMONG THE IRANIAN COMMON PEOPLE TOWARD THE RESULTS OF IRAN'S REVOLUTION.

ONE, WHO IS SOON TO BE TERMINATED AS PART OF A MAJOR REDUCTION OF FORCE, HAD NOTHING GOOD TO SAY ABOUT THE REVOLUTION. IRANIANS' IDEA OF FREEDOM, HE SAID, IS THE RIGHT TO DRIVE THE WRONG WAY UP A ONE-WAY STREET. HE ALSO CRITICIZED THE INTOLERANCE OF THE REVOLUTION AND THE VENGEFULNESS IT HAD AROUSED IN PEOPLE. AND WHAT HAD THE LATTER ACHIEVED, HE ASKED RHETORICALLY. ANSWERING HIS OWN QUESTION, HE SAID THAT THE EXECUTION OF JEWISH ENTREPRENEUR HABIBOLLAH ELGHANIAN HAD ONLY SUCCEEDED IN PUTTING 3,000 MUSLIMS OUT OF WORK.

THE OTHER, WHILE RECOGNIZING THE SERIOUS PROBLEMS IRAN PRESENTLY CONFRONTS AS A CONSEQUENCE OF THE REVOLUTION, WAS SUPREMELY CONFIDENT THAT EVERYTHING WOULD EVENTUALLY TURN OUT ALL RIGHT. PASSING BY A BLOCK OF LUXURY APARTMENT BUILDINGS, HOWEVER, SET HIM OFF ON THE INEQUITIES OF PRE-REVOLUTIONARY IRAN. IT WAS CRIMINAL, HE SAID, THAT SOME IRANIANS COULD AFFORD TO PAY THE HUNDREDS OF THOUSANDS OF DOLLARS THE APARTMENTS COST WHILE THE VERY PEOPLE WHO LABORED ON THEIR CONSTRUCTION HAD HAD TO SLEEP IN THE STREETS. UNDER SUCH CONDITIONS AN EXPLOSION WAS INEVITABLE. WHILE THE INEQUITIES HAVE NOT YET BEEN ENTIRELY ELIMINATED, HE BELIEVED THAT PROGRESS IN THAT DIRECTION IS NOW POSSIBLE. LAINGEN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY: DEPOFF CLEMENT AND POLCOUNS TALKED THIS PAST WEEK WITH MINISTER OF STATE FOR REVOLUTIONARY PROJECTS SAHABI AND MINISTER OF NATIONAL GUIDANCE MINACHI ABOUT IRAN'S DRAFT CONSTITUTION AND PLANS FOR ITS PROMULGATION. END SUMMARY.

SAHABI SAID THAT IT HAD ORIGINALLY BEEN THE PGOI'S PLAN TO HAVE A FULL-FLEDGED CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY OF SEVERAL HUNDRED DELEGATES DEBATE THE CONSTITUTION, BUT THAT, AS WEEKS DRAGGED INTO MONTHS DURING THE DRAFTING PROCESS, IT CAME TO BE RECOGNIZED THAT TIME WAS OF INCREASING IMPORTANCE. THE SMALLER ASSEMBLY OF EXPERTS (SHORA-YE-KHEBREGAN) WAS CONSEQUENTLY HIT UPON AS THE BEST MEANS OF GETTING THE DRAFT QUICKLY REVIEWED AND TO THE PUBLIC FOR APPROVAL. MINACHI, WHO WAS A MEMBER OF THE COMMITTEE WHICH PREPARED THE INITIAL DRAFT, ESTIMATED THAT THE ASSEMBLY WOULD TAKE APPROXIMATELY A MONTH TO DO ITS WORK.

ELECTIONS ARE TENTATIVELY SCHEDULED FOR THE END OF JULY WHICH, IF MINACHI'S SCHEDULE HOLDS, WOULD MEAN THAT THE DRAFT WOULD BE READY TO BE PUT TO A REFERENDUM SOMETIME AROUND THE BEGINNING OF SEPTEMBER. THIS ACCORDS WITH MINACHI'S ESTIMATE OF EARLY AUTUM FOR COMPLETION OF THE ENTIRE PROCESS, I.E., APPROVAL AND PROMULGATION OF THE CONSTITUTION, MAJLES AND PRESIDENTIAL ELECTIONS AND INSTALLATION OF A NEW GOVERNMENT.

WHEN ASKED IF THE DRAFT RECENTLY PUBLISHED WAS CLOSE TO THE INITIAL DRAFT HIS COMMITTEE HAD PREPARED, MINACHI SAID THAT KHOMEINI HAD MADE ONLY "A FEW MINOR CHANGES." SAHABI STRESSED THAT THE DRAFT IS JUST THAT, I.E., A WORKING DOCUMENT WHICH MAY BE AMENDED BY THE ASSEMBLY WHEN IT TAKES IT UP FOR DEBATE. ALL IRANIANS THEORETICALLY HAVE A RIGHT TO COMMENT UPON THE DRAFT AND THE ASSEMBLY IS SUPPOSED TO TAKE THEIR VIEWS INTO CONSIDERATION. MINACHI SAID THAT SAHABI'S OFFICE IS RESPONSIBLE FOR COLLATING THESE VIEWS AND PRESENTING THEM TO THE ASSEMBLY IN SOME FORM THAT WILL ALLOW IT TO MAKE APPROPRIATE AMENDMENTS.

WE HAVE GOTTEN THE IMPRESSION IN RECENT DAYS THAT THE PGOI, IN THE FACE OF CONTINUING FRUSTRATIONS IN ITS ATTEMPT TO BRING THE INFORMAL GOVERNMENT UNDER SOME DEGREE OF CONTROL, HAS FIXED UPON PUTTING ITSELF OUT OF BUSINESS AS THE BEST MEANS OF DEALING WITH THE MANIFOLD PROBLEMS IRAN PRESENTLY CONFRONTS. IN OTHER WORDS, THE OVERRRIDING OBJECTIVE HAS BECOME GETTING A PROPERLY CONSTITUTED GOVERNMENT IN PLACE AND THE MINOR TECHNICALITIES OF DOING

1979TEHRAN07056.subject: THE SAADATI AFFAIR: CONSEQUENCES FOR THE USA

segments.text: TEHRAN 07055 KARACHI FOR RSS (C - ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY: PUBLICITY GIVEN THE SAADATI CASE WILL STRENGTHEN THE PERSIAN INCLINATION TO SEE MASSIVE "AMERICAN INTERFERENCE" IN IRAN'S INTERNAL AFFAIRS. THE CONNECTION BETWEEN THE EMBASSY AND THE ARREST IS LIKELY TO INCREASE THE SECURITY THREAT AGAINST THE POST. END SUMMARY.

THE PERSIAN PRESS HAS GIVEN WIDE COVERAGE TO CHARGES BY THE MJUAHEDEEN-E-KHALQ THAT MOHAMMED REZA SAADATI WAS ARRESTED AND TORTURED INTO A CONFESSION BY SECURITY GUARDS STATIONED AT THE U.S. EMBASSY. THERE HAVE BEEN FREQUENT REPETITIONS OF THE CHARGES FROM SUCH SOURCES AS SAADATI'S WIFE AS WELL AS PROMINENT SPEECHMAKER AND REVOLUTIONARY HEROINE SAKINEH REZAI. IN NUMEROUS DISCUSSIONS OF THE CASE WITH EMBOFFS, IRANIANS HAVE INQUIRED ABOUT THE ROLE OF THE EMB. IN THE POPULAR MIND, IT IS DIFFICULT TO ACCEPT THAT THE EMB DOES NOT CONTROL THE SECURITY UNIT ASSIGNED TO THE POST BY THE PGOI.

ONCE SAADATI GOES ON TRIAL AND HAS A CHANCE TO PUBLICLY DESCRIBE HIS ARREST AND DETENTION BY PEOPLE ASSOCIATED WITH THE SECURITY UNIT, ALLEGATIONS OF INTERFERENCE BY THE "CIA" AND THE EMB IN IRANIAN DOMESTIC AND REVOLUTIONARY AFFAIRS WILL CERTAINLY GAIN EVEN MORE POPULAR ATTENTION AND PERHAPS CREDENCE. RARELY WILLING TO ACCEPT OR EVEN UNDERSTAND THE CONCEPTS OF PERSONAL RESPONSBILITY OR CAUSALITY, THE IRANIAN-IN-THE-STREET WILL PERCEIVE THE AFFAIR AS ANOTHER AMERICAN ATTEMPT TO UNDERMINE THE REVOLUTION AND DESTROY ITS HEROES.

ON ANOTHER LEVEL, THE SAADATI AFFAIR HAS INCREASED THE SECURITY THREAT TO THE POST. THE MAJOR ROLE OF EMB SECURITY UNIT LEADER MASHALLA KASHANI IN SAADATI'S ARREST HAS PLACED KASHANI AND HIS GROUP IN A TARGET POSITION FOR RETALIATION BY SAADATI'S SUPPORTERS. HIS PRESENCE AT THE EMB HAS ALREADY DRAWN AT LEAST ONE SUCH ARMED ATTACK (REF C). WITH KASHANI CONTINUING TO USE HIS "FRIENDS" TO PUBLICLY HARASS PRO-SAADATI DEMONSTRATORS, THE THREAT POSED TO THE EMB ITSELF AS AN UNWILLING PARTNER IN THE WHOLE DEBACLE INCREASES CORRESPONDINGLY. LAINGEN
(D) BAGHDAD 1213 (S - ENTIRE TEXT.)

SUMMARY: DURING A MEETING WITH DEPUTY PM ENTEZAM JULY 7 I REITERATED OUR DESIRE TO GET ON WITH THE PROCESS OF NORMALIZING OUR RELATIONS WITH IRAN. I ALSO RAISED A NUMBER OF BUSINESS ITEMS, INCLUDING OUTSTANDING MILITARY ISSUES, THE GTE CASE, AND TREATMENT OF MINORITIES. ENTEZAM REVIEWED THE PROBLEMS THE PGOI HAS HAD IN ASSERTING ITS AUTHORITY OVER THE INFORMAL PARALLEL SYSTEM OF REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES. HE ASKED ONCE AGAIN THAT WE SHARE INFORMATION ON ACTIVITIES BOTH WITHIN IRAN AND IN NEIGHBORING COUNTRIES WHICH MIGHT BE OF IMPORTANCE TO IRANIAN SECURITY. END SUMMARY.

I BEGAN MY PRESENTATION USING THE SAME APPROACH ON U.S.IRANIAN RELATIONS THAT I HAD EARLIER WITH YAZDI (REF A). I THANKED ENTEZAM SPECIFICALLY FOR THE THINGS HE HAD DONE TO FACILITATE MOVING TOWARD A MORE NORMAL, MUTUALLY BENEFICIAL RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN OUR TWO COUNTRIES IN THE POSTREVOLUTIONARY PERIOD. I MENTIONED, IN THIS REGARD, HIS JUNE 21 PRESS CONFERENCE WHICH WE SAW AS HELPFUL IN PUTTING OUR RELATIONS INTO PERSPECTIVE.

ON THE SUBJECT OF AN AMBASSADOR, I SUGGESTED (AS I HAD WITH YAZDI) THAT FOR THE MOMENT "THE LESS SAID, THE BETTER;" THAT OUR POSITION REMAINED AS THE DEPT SPOKESMAN HAD EXPRESSED IT, BUT NOTED UNOFFICIALLY THAT WE OBVIOUSLY COULD NOT INSIST ON SENDING SOMEONE THE IRANIANS DID NOT WANT. I ADDED THAT IT WOULD TAKE AWHILE TO RESOLVE THIS ISSUE TO EVERYONE'S SATISFACTION. I WISHED HIM WELL IN STOCKHOLM.

TURNING TO BUSINESS MATTERS, I THANKED ENTEZAM FOR HIS EFFORTS TO HELP RESOLVE SUCH MATTERS AS THE DISPOSITION OF THE U.S. ARMY COMMISSARY STOCKS AND THE RETURN OF MILITARY COMMUNICATIONS EQUIPMENT, BUT NOTED THAT WE HAVE CONTINUED TO ENCOUNTER DIFFICULTIES OWING TO THE DIVIDED AUTHORITY IN ACTUAL CONTROL OF THE MATERIEL AND PROPERTY IN QUESTION. ENTEZAM SEEMED SURPRISED THAT THE MATTER OF COMMISSARY STOCKS HAD NOT BEEN RESOLVED. HE REITERATED THE PGOI'S DESIRE TO PURCHASE MOST OF THEM, AND SAID THAT HE WOULD SPEAK TO THE MINISTER OF COMMERCE ABOUT IT.

WHEN I NOTED THE DESIRABILITY OF AN ORDERLY DISPOSAL OF ALL ISSUES LEFT OVER FROM THE PREVIOUS ERA OF MILITARY COOPERATION BETWEEN IRAN AND THE U.S. SO THAT WE COULD GET ON IN DETERMINING THE NATURE AND SCOPE OF THE RELATIONSHIP IRAN NOW WANTS IN THIS AREA, ENTEZAM SAID THE PGOI HAS PROCEEDED CAUTIOUSLY BECAUSE OF THE SENSITIVE NATURE OF THE SUBJECT AND PRESSURES ON THE PGOI, PARTICULARLY FROM THE LEFT, TO ACT PRECIPITOUSLY.

I ALSO RAISED GTE WITH HIM, AGAIN POINTING OUT THE NEED TO COMPROMISE IN CASES WHERE THE COMPANIES ARE PREPARED TO NEGOTIATE IN GOOD FAITH. I NOTED THAT OTHER COMPANIES ARE WATCHING NEGOTIATIONS SUCH AS THOSE INVOLVING GTE AND WILL BE INFLUENCED IN A MAJOR WAY BY THEIR PERCEPTION OF IRAN'S WILLINGNESS TO BE FLEXIBLE. ENTEZAM SEEMED RELATIVELY UNFAMILIAR WITH THE CASE, BUT SAID THAT HE WOULD BE SEEING MINISTER OF PTT ESLAMI LATER THE SAME DAY, AND WOULD CONVEY MY VIEWS TO HIM.
I ALSO NOTED THE RETURN OF DUPONT EXECUTIVES, WHICH PROMPTED ENTEZAM TO ASSURE ME THAT FOREIGN SHAREHOLDERS IN IRANIAN ENTERPRISES THAT ARE NATIONALIZED WILL BE ADEQUATELY COMPENSATED.

FINALLY, IN THE ECONOMIC AREA, I NOTED THE RECENT BRIEFING PROVIDED TO THE IRANIAN ------------------103102 081543Z /43 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 2515 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMCONSUL DHAHRAN AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY PARIS JCS WASH DC USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE AMEMBASSY STOCKHOLM SECTION 02 OF 03 TEHRAN 07064 EXDIS EMBASSY IN WASHINGTON REGARDING THE TIGHTENING COMMODITIES MARKET AND THE NEED TO ACT PROMPTLY IF MAJOR PURCHASES WERE CONTEMPLATED.

MOVING ON TO THE ISSUE OF TREATMENT OF MINORITIES, I REMINDED ENTEZAM OF THE GREAT INTEREST IN THE U.S., PARTICULARLY IN THE CONGRESS, IN THIS SUBJECT. I THEN ASKED HIM ABOUT HAI AND DANIELPOUR (REF B), NOTING THAT WE HAD BEEN ASKED BY WASHINGTON TO CHECK THE ACCURACY OF REPORTS THAT THEY WERE CURRENTLY ON TRIAL. ENTEZAM WAS COMPLETELY IGNORANT OF THE FACT THAT THEY HAD EVEN BEEN ARRESTED, BUT PROMISED TO LOOK INTO THE MATTER AND LET US KNOW THE RESULTS OF HIS INQUIRY.

I THEN SOLICITED ENTEZAM'S VIEWS ON HOW THINGS WERE GOING DOMESTICALLY FOR THE PGOI WITH PARTICULAR REFERENCE TO THE SERIES OF MEETINGS THAT HAD BEEN HELD IN QOM LAST WEEK BETWEEN THE CABINET AND KHOMEINI AND KHOMEINI AND THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL. ENTEZAM SAID THAT THE PGOI CONTINUES TO HAVE MANY PROBLEMS, MOST OF WHICH WERE CAUSED BY "IDEALISTIC PEOPLE WHO WANT TO HELP." HE SAID THAT IT WOULD TAKE TIME TO RESOLVE THESE, AND THAT "WE--AND YOU--MUST BE PATIENT." THE PGOI, HE CONTINUED, HAS HAD DIFFICULTY ASSERTING ITS AUTHORITY BUT IS INEVITABLY HELD RESPONSIBLE FOR WHATEVER HAPPENS.

MANY PEOPLE OUTSIDE THE GOVERNMENT WOULD NOT LEAVE THE PGOI ALONE TO GET ON WITH THE JOB OF RUNNING THE NATION'S AFFAIRS EVEN THOUGH THESE SAME PEOPLE DID NOT HAVE THE KNOWLEDGE OR TECHNICAL EXPERTISE TO RUN THINGS THEMSELVES. ENTEZAM SAID THAT THE PGOI HAS TRIED TO CONVINCE THESE PEOPLE TO STOP INTERFERING, AN EFFORT, HE CLAIMED, WHICH HAD THE FULL SUPPORT OF KHOMEINI. HE THEN CHARGED THAT THE LEFT HAS PURPOSELY TRIED TO SABOTAGE THE REVOLUTION AND THAT IT HAD BEEN SUPPORTED IN THIS BY THE SOVIETS.
IN THIS REGARD, HE SAID THAT HE HOPED WE WOULD SHARE ANY INFORMATION WE MIGHT HAVE ON SUBVERSIVE ACTIVITIES IN IRAN WITH THE PGOI.

I COUNTERED BY NOTING THAT IRAN FREQUENTLY APPEARS TO BE LOOKING FOR TROUBLE IN THAT A NUMBER OF POLITICALLY PROMINENT INDIVIDUALS HAD MADE STATEMENTS WHICH OTHERS COULD ONLY REGARD AS PROVOCATIVE. ENTEZAM SIGHED AND SAID THAT ONE OF THE CONSEQUENCES OF THE REVOLUTION HAD BEEN TO LEAD EVERYONE TO THINK THAT HE COULD SPEAK ON BEHALF OF THE NATION. HE SAID THERE HAD EVEN BEEN DIFFICULTY IN THIS REGARD WITHIN THE GOVERNMENT.

IT WAS IRAN'S POLICY TO HAVE GOOD RELATIONS WITH ALL COUNTRIES, ESPECIALLY ITS NEIGHBORS, BUT THAT VERY DAY NEW PGOI SPOKESMAN SADEGH TABATABAIE, ENTEZAM SAID, HAD MADE A STATEMENT THAT WAS TOTALLY CONTRARY TO THE PGOI'S POLICY TOWARDS IRAQ. THE SAME PROBLEM EXISTED AT SADEGH GHOTBZADEH'S NATIONAL IRANIAN RADIO AND TELEVISION ORGANIZATION (NIRT). NIRT'S BUDGET IS PAID BY THE GOVERNMENT, BUT THE PGOI HAS NO CONTROL OVER PROGRAMING, HE SAID.

ENTEZAM SAID THAT VERY SHORTLY AFTER THE REVOLUTION IN FEBRUARY THE PGOI CONCLUDED THAT EVERYONE, WHETHER IT BE THE IMAM HIMSELF, THE COMMITTEES, THE GUARDIANS OF THE REVOLUTION OR THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS, WAS WORKING AGAINST THE PGOI. THE PM AND THE CABINET HAD APPROACHED KHOMEINI "HUNDREDS OF TIMES," HE SAID, BUT UNTIL TWO WEEKS EARLIER, WHEN THE PGOI HAD DECIDED TO TAKE A FIRM STAND, NOTHING HAD BEEN ACCOMPLISHED.

HE SAID THAT THE PGOI WANTS TO RETURN CONDITIONS TO NORMAL JUST AS QUICKLY AS POSSIBLE, AND PREDICTED THAT "WITHIN A WEEK OR TWO" THERE WOULD BE A PUBLIC ANNOUNCEMENT OF POLICY AND ORGANIZATIONAL MEASURES AGREED UPON IN RECENT MEETING WITH THE REVOLUTIONARY LEADERSHIP DESIGNED TO ACHIEVE THAT GOAL. ENTEZAM SAID, IN ANSWER TO MY QUESTION, THAT PM BAZARGAN IS DETERMINED TO SEE HIS JOB THROUGH TO A SUCCESSFUL CONCLUSION.

HE DESCRIBED HIM AS THE IDEAL MAN FOR THE JOB HE HAS, AN INDIVIDUAL WHO RECOGNIZES THE IMPRACTICALITY OF THE PROGRAM ADVOCATED BY THE RELIGIOUS REACTIONARIES WHO WOULD TURN THE ------------------102819 081324Z /43 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 2516 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMCONSUL DHAHRAN AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY PARIS JCS WASH DC USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE AMEMBASSY STOCKHOLM SECTION 03 OF 03 TEHRAN 07064 EXDIS CLOCK BACK 1,000 YEARS BUT WHO WOULD NOT YIELD TO THE LEFTISTS.

ENTEZAM INTIMATED THAT HIS DEPARTURE FOR SWEDEN DID NOT NECESSARILY MEAN AN END TO THE CHANNEL OF COMMUNICATION THROUGH HIMSELF BETWEEN THE PGOI AND THE USG. "IT MAY BE EASIER," HE SAID, "FOR US TO TALK FRANKLY THERE THAN IT IS HERE OR WOULD BE IN WASHINGTON." MOREOVER, HE WOULD RETURN AT REGULAR INTERVALS--EVERY TWO MONTHS OR SO--TO IRAN. WHEN I ASKED HIM ABOUT IRAN'S PLANS FOR AN AMBASSADOR TO WASHINGTON, HE SAID THAT IT WOULD TAKE A COUPLE OF MONTHS TO WORK OUT AND THEN INTIMATED THAT HE HIMSELF MIGHT BE THE NOMINEE. ENTEZAM ALSO PRESSED ME FOR INFORMATION ON WHAT WAS GOING ON IN NEIGHBORING COUNTRIES, ESPECIALLY IRAQ.
I GAVE HIM A VERY GENERAL OVERVIEW OF OUR ASSESSMENT OF HOW THE IRAQIS PERCEIVE THEIR RELATIONSHIP WITH IRAN BASED PRIMARILY ON REF D. LAINGEN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT.)

WE HAVE NOT BEEN ABLE TO PIN DOWN PRECISELY THE INFORMATION REQUESTED IN REFTEL, BUT IT DOES APPEAR THAT THE REVOLUTIONARY PROSECUTOR SOME TIME LAST WEEK DID REQUEST ALL THOSE WHO HAVE COMPLAINTS AGAINST A NUMBER OF INDIVIDUALS, AMONG WHOM WERE HAI AND DANIELPOUR, TO COME FORWARD WITH THEIR CHARGES. THIS IS A STANDARD PROCEDURE IN THE IRANIAN REVOLUTIONARY JUDICIAL PROCESS. IT DOES NOT NECESSARILY MEAN THAT A TRIAL IS IMMINENT NOR EVEN THAT THERE WILL BE A TRIAL (E.G., THERE HAVE BEEN INSTANCES WHERE NO PLAINTIFFS CAME FORWARD IN RESPONSE TO THE PROSECUTOR'S SUMMONS).

WHILE THE POSSIBILITY OF TRIAL ISCERTAINLY SOMETHING TO BE WATCHED CAREFULLY IN THIS INSTANCE, WE DO NOT THINK THERE IS REASON FOR UNDUE CONCERN ABOUT THE WELFARE OF HAI AND DANIELPOUR AT THIS PARTICULAR JUNCTURE. IN THIS REGARD, WE WOULD NOTE THAT SENTENCES HANDED DOWN IN RECENT DAYS HAVE TENDED TO BE LESS HARSH THAN WAS EARLIER THE CASE. FURTHER, AT LEAST ONE OF OUR JEWISH CONTACTS WAS CONFIDENT THAT IF HAI AND DANIELPOUR ARE BROUGHT TO TRIAL, THEY WILL AT MOST RECEIVE RELATIVELY LIGHT SENTENCES AND MAY EVEN BE ACQUITTED.
THE REASON GIVEN FOR THIS OPTIMISM WAS THE REACTION ELGHANIAN'S EXECUTION PROVOKED, A REACTION OUR CONTACT THOUGHT MOST IRANIANS WOULD PREFER TO AVOID REPEATING. LAINGEN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT)
CONSOFFS FARRELL AND SORENSON RECENTLY SPENT A WEEKEND IN ISFAHAN ON LEAVE. THERE FOLLOWS FARRELL'S REPORT ON WHAT THEY FOUND THERE.

THE CITY SEEMED RELATIVELY QUIET AND UNALTERED BY EVENTS OF LAST WINTER. THE ISFAHAN AIRPORT WAS STILL CROWDED WITH MILITARY HELICOPTERS. THERE WAS, HOWEVER, LITTLE EVIDENCE OF SPECIAL SECURITY PRECAUTIONS. WHEN CONSOFFS DEPARTED ISFAHAN THERE WAS ONE ARMED GUARD ON THE TARMAC (THE GUARD WAS DRESSED IN A POLICE UNIFORM, NOT IN THE USUAL REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE FATIGUES). ALL PASSENGERS WERE CHECKED THOROUGHLY FOR THE FLIGHT TO TEHRAN: TICKETS WERE COMPARED WITH PASSPORTS OR IRANIAN IDENTIFICATION DOCUMENTS. THE AIRPORT GROUNDS WERE STILL SURROUNDED BY BARBED WIRE.
THREE AND FOUR STAR HOTELS, AND LUXURY HOTELS, WERE VIRTUALLY DESERTED. THE SHAH ABBAS HOTEL HAD TAKEN THE EXPEDIENT OF REDUCING ITS RATES TO ATTRACT WHATEVER CUSTOMERS STILL COME TO THE CITY.

APART FROM THE USUAL RUDENESS ENGENDERED BY THE CURIOUS IN A PROVINCIAL PLACE, THERE WAS LITTLE ANTIAMERICAN FEELING DIRECTED AGAINST CONSOFFS. FARRELL WAS ACCOSTED BY THREE OR FOUR YOUNG MEN ON ONE OCCASION WHO SHOUTED, IN FARSI, "DEATH TO YOU (PEOPLE)," BUT EXPERIENCED NO OTHER INCIDENT OF THIS NATURE. THERE WERE A FEW OTHER TOURISTS--WORLD TRAVELER TYPES--IN TOWN: THEY DID NOT SEEM TO BE EXPERIENCING ANY PARTICULAR PROBLEMS.

FARRELL DID OVERHEAR PEOPLE TALKING IN THE STREET WHO WERE EXPLAINING TO THEIR AUDIENCE THE ROLE THE U.S. HAD PLAYED AS A SUPPORTER OF THE SHAH. THE GENERAL SENTIMENT SEEMED TO BE THAT THE U.S. TOOK IRAN'S WEALTH--OR MOST OF IT--AND THEN GAVE SANCTUARY TO THE SHAH (THESE REMARKS WERE USUALLY OVERHEARD NEAR STREETSIDE STALLS SELLING POSTERS WHICH DIPICTED THE SHAH BEING DRIVEN FROM IRAN BY KHOMEINI; THE SHAH'S BAGS WERE STUFFED WITH BANK NOTES AND THEY CARRED AMERICAN FLAG DECALS).

SOME MONUMENTS AND PLACES OF WORSHIP, MOST NOTABLY THE FRIDAY MOSQUE LOCATED TO THE NORTH OF THE OLD BAZAAR, WERE CLOSED TO NON-MUSLIMS. THE ATMOSPHERE IN THE BAZAAR ITSELF WAS COOL BUT NOT HOSTILE. THERE WAS PRACTICALLY NO EVIDENCE IN THE CITY OF COMMITTEE PARA-MILITARY ACITIVITY. NO ONE CARRYING ARMS, NO ONE DRESSED IN REVOLUTIONARY GUARDIAN UNIFORM, ETC. WAS TO BE SEEN. ISFAHAN RADIO, UNLIKE TEHRAN'S, PLAYED DECADENT WESTERN

1979TEHRAN07098.subject: AMIR ENTEZAM'S INTEREST IN SHARED INTELLIGENCE

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT.)

AS REF B INDICATED, FORMER DEPUTY PM AMIR ENTEZAM (NOW AMBASSADOR DESIGNATE TO FIVE SCANDINAVIAN COUNTRIES-COUNT THEM|) PRESSED ME RATHER STRONGLY WHEN I SAW HIM FOR ANY INTELLIGENCE WE MIGHT WISH TO SHARE ON BOTH IRANIAN DOMESTIC POLITICS AND ON IRAQI INTENTIONS TOWARD IRAN. WE INTEND TO STAY OUT OF THE BUSINESS OF TELLING THE IRANIANS HOW TO CONDUCT THEIR DOMESTIC POLITICS, BUT I WOULD APPRECIATE DEPT'S CONSIDERING WHETHER THERE IS NOT MERIT IN BEING RESPONSIVE ON THE IRAQ REQUEST.

ENTEZAM SAID HE HAD RAISED HIS CONCERN OVER IRAQI INTENTIONS PREVIOUSLY WITH NAAS (REF A) AND THAT BAZARGAN HAD DONE SO ON AT LEAST ONE OCCASION WITH SULLIVAN. IN HIS APPROACH TO ME, HE MADE IT VERY CLEAR THAT HIS CONCERN WAS BOTH WITH THE ATTITUDES OF THE BAGHDAD LEADERSHIP AND WITH THE SOVIETS, WHERE HE EMPHASIZED WHAT HE SAW AS A CLEARLY SHARED INTEREST BETWEEN THE PGOI AND THE U.S.

AS INDICATED REF B, I KEPT MY RESPONSE TO GENERAL OBSERVATIONS, BASED ON BAGHDAD REPORTING AVAILABLE HERE, ADDING THAT OUR U.S. INTEREST SECTION THERE ON SEVERAL OCCASIONS HAD INDICATED TO THE GOI OUR INTEREST IN IRAN/ IRAQ DETENTE AND OUR CONCERN OVER REPORTS OF ESCALATING TENSIONS BETWEEN THE TWO COUNTRIES. I ADDED THAT I WOULD LOOK INTO THE MATTER TO SEE WHETHER WE WERE IN A POSITION TO PROVIDE ANYTHING MORE FIC.

WHEN I MENTIONED HIS IMMINENT DEPARTURE FOR STOCKHOLM AND QUERIED WHERE OUR CONTACT POINT MIGHT BE, HE SUGGESTED HIS SUCCESSOR AS GOVERNMENT SPOKESMAN (TABATABAIE), BUT AGREED THAT DR. YAZDI COULD SERVE AS AN EQUALLY AVAILABLE CONTACT POINT.

I WILL WELCOME THE DEPT'S GUIDANCE ON THIS OVERTURE. FROM OUR VANTAGE POINT HERE, A POSITIVE RESPONSE WOULD SEEM TO HAVE SOME MERIT. SHARING OUR ASSESSMENT OF THE IRAQI SCENE WITH THE PGOI WOULD HELP DEMONSTRATE THAT WE MEAN WHAT WE SAY ABOUT OUR STRONG INTEREST IN STABILITY IN THE PERSIAN GULF AREA. ASSUMING THAT WHAT WE COULD PASS ALONG WOULD ON BALANCE SUGGEST THAT THE IRAQIS ARE NOT LOOKING FOR A FIGHT, IT MIGHT HELP MODERATE ATTITUDES HERE, INCLUDING THE TONE OF NIRT PROPAGANDA BROADCASTS WHICH, AS I REMINDED ENTEZAM, CONTINUE TO BE INFLAMMATORY.
IN TERMS OF OUR BILATERAL RELATIONS WITH THE PGOI, IT WOULD BE A CONCRETE WAY OF SIGNALING OUR CONFIDENCE IN THEM AND OUR DESIRE TO COOPERATE IN MUTUALLY BENEFICIAL WAYS.

THERE IS, OF COURSE, THE MATTER OF ENTEZAM'S IMMINENT DEPARTURE. WE WOULD NOT RECOMMEND TABATABAIE AS A CONTACT POINT, SINCE WE KNOW SO LITTLE ABOUT HIM. PREFERABLY, WE COULD TAKE HIS SUGGESTION OF TALKING WITH YAZDI, WHOM WE ASSUME IS EQUALLY CONCERNED AS FOREIGN MINISTER WITH IRAQ/ IRAN RELATIONS AND WITH WHOM IT IS IN OUR INTEREST TO LOOK FOR ADDED WAYS TO DEVELOP A RELATIONSHIP OF CONFIDENCE. IT MIGHT ALSO BE USEFUL TO KEEP IN TOUCH WITH ENTEZAM IN STOCKHOLM OCCASIONALLY ON THIS SUBJECT SINCE WE ASSUME HIS INTEREST, IF NOT HIS INVOLVEMENT, IN LOCAL AFFAIRS WILL CONTINUE STRONG.

HAVING SAID ALL THIS, I RECOGNIZE THAT THERE ARE BROADER INTERESTS INVOLVED, INCLUDING OUR INTERESTS IN IRAQ. IN THAT RESPECT, HOWEVER, AND AT RISK OF OVER-SIMPLIFICATION, IT SEEMS TO ME WE HAVE SOMETHING TO BE GAINED HERE AND NOT MUCH TO LOSE IN IRAQ ON THIS CULAR ISSUE.

AS TO THE TYPE OF INFORMATION WE MIGHT SHARE, ONE POSSIBILITY WOULD BE OCCASIONAL ASSESSMENTS OF THE KIND CONTAINED IN BAGHDAD'S 1362 OF JUNE 21, SANITIZED AS NECESSARY. INFORMATION ON ACTUAL IRAQI FORCE MOVEMENTS AND CAPABILITIES WOULD BE A MORE SENSITIVE MATTER, BUT THERE MAY BE POSSIBILITIES OCCASIONALLY WHERE OUR AREA INTERESTS COULD BE SERVED BY SOME CAREFUL SHARING.

FINALLY I MUST NOTE THAT THERE MAY BE PRECEDENTS IN TERMS OF THE INVOLVEMENT OF THIS MISSION IN THIS TYPE OF EXERCISE OF WHICH I AM NOT AWARE FROM THE COLLECTIVE MEMORY OF PERSONNEL NOW HERE, IN WHICH CASE I WOULD APPRECIATE

(LOU) EMBASSY IS UNABLE PROVIDE INDEPENDENT CONFIRMATION OF SUBJECT INCIDENT. HOWEVER, WE HAVE OBTAINED FROM JOSEPH REYNOLDS, PRESENTLY THE SENIOR PAN AM REPRESENTATIVE IN TEHRAN AND A PERSON WHOM THE EMBASSY TRUSTS, DETAILS ABOUT THE INCIDENT WHICH IN ONE INSTANCE DIFFER FROM REPORT CONTAINED REFTEL AND WHICH PROVIDE A FULLER PICTURE. PRESUMABLY, PAN AM-NYC ALREADY HAS ALL PERTINENT DETAILS FROM THEIR TEHRAN OFFICE AND OUR REPORT IS PRIMARILY FOR THE DEPARTMENT'S INFORMATION.

(LOU) THIRTY-EIGHT MORE PASSENGERS THAN COULD BE ACCOMMODATED ON THE AIRCRAFT (B-747) FLYING WESTBOUND FROM TEHRAN ON PAN AM'S FLIGHT 002 ON JULY 6 APPEARED AT MEHRABAD AIRPORT. ALL PROSPECTIVE PASSENGERS HAD TICKETS INDICATING THAT THEY HAD CONFIRMED RESERVATIONS, BUT MANY HAD BEEN BOOKED BY TRAVEL AGENTS AND MANY OF THE RESERVATIONS HAD NOT BEEN ENTERED ON PAN AM'S COMPUTER. (COMMENT: ALTHOUGH REYNOLDS DID NOT SAY SO, EMBOFF GATHERED THAT FLIGHT WAS PROBABLY OVER-BOOKED EVEN DISREGARDING THOSE PASSENGERS WHOSE RESERVATIONS HAD NOT BEEN ENTERED INTO THE COMPUTER. END COMMENT).

(LOU) THE 38 STUDENTS WHO WERE TOLD THEY COULD NOT BE ACCOMMODATED WERE UNDERSTANDABLY UPSET, AND THEY DECIDED TO DO SOMETHING. GIVEN THE CONTINUING REVOLUTIONARY CLIMATE, IT PROVED TO BE FAIRLY EASY TO OFFICE (PRESUMABLY A DUTY OFFICER SINCE IT WAS THEN ABOUT 4:00 AM) AND THE AIRPORT COMMITTEE. THEN THE AIRPORT AIR TRAFFIC CONTROLLER (ATC), APPARENTLY ON INSTRUCTIONS FROM THE AIRPORT COMMITTEE, REFUSED TAKEOFF CLEARANCE.

PAN AM OFFICIALS, WHEN TOLD THAT THEY WOULD HAVE TO PROVIDE FOR THE 38 OVERBOOKED PASSENGERS BEFORE THE FLIGHT COULD LEAVE, POINTED OUT THAT IT WAS IMPOSSIBLE TO MAKE CONFIRMED ARRANGEMENTS WITH OTHER AIRLINES SINCE IT WAS 0400 AND THAT CONTINUED DELAY OF PA 002 WAS IN NO ONES' INTEREST. FLIGHT WAS PERMITTED TO DEPART WITH UNDERSTANDING THAT PAN AM WOULD MAKE EVERY EFFORT TO ARRANGE TRANSPORTATION FOR THE 38. THEY WERE SUCCESSFUL AND ALL 38 DEPARTED TEHRAN ON OTHER FLIGHTS LATER IN THE MORNING OF JULY 6.

(C) SINCE THE INCIDENT, ENGINEER VALI, HEAD OF THE CIVIL AVIATION ORGANIZATION, HAS REPORTEDLY EXPRESSED HIS GREAT DISPLEASURE AT THE ACTIONS OF MEHRABAD ATC. MOREOVER, VALI HAS REPORTEDLY INSTRUCTED ATC THAT IT CANNOT AND WILL NOT DENY TAKEOFF CLEARANCE TO A SCHEDULED FLIGHT EXCEPT ON THE EXPRESS INSTRUCTIONS OF VALI HIMSELF, HIS DEPUTY, OR THE CAO DUTY OFFICER. (COMMENT: GIVEN THE DISPROPORTIONATE BALANCE IN WEAPONS BETWEEN CAO/ATC AND THE AIRPORT COMMITTEE, WE QUESTION WHETHER VALI'S INSTRUCTIONS WOULD BE FOLLOWED IF (WHEN) A SIMILAR SITUATION RE-OCCURS. END COMMENT).

(C) A MEETING HAS BEEN SCHEDULED FOR WEDNESAY, JULY 11, BETWEEN VALI AND REPRESENTATIVES OF THE AIRLINES SERVING TEHRAN. THE FOREIGN AIRLINES'REPRESENTATIVES INTEND TO RAISE AND TO MAKE PROTESTS ABOUT THE PAN AM JULY 6 INCIDENT AND THE EARLIER, POTENTIALLY MUCH MORE DANGEROUS, INCIDENT INVOLVING AYATOLLAH MOTAZERI'S SON. THE CAO AND INDEED THE PGOI ARE UNDOUBTEDLY CHAGRINED OVER SUCH INCIDENTS, AND VALI WILL PROBABLY TRY TO REASSURE THE AIRLINES THAT STEPS HAVE BEEN (ARE BEING) TAKEN TO PREVENT REOCCURRENCES. HOWEVER, IN LINE WITH OUR COMMENT OF THE PREVIOUS PARA, GUNS ARE CONSIDERABLY MORE IMPORTANT THAN GOOD INTENTIONS.

1979TEHRAN07156.subject: PGOI DENIES THAT MONTAZERI HEADS DELEGATION TO LIBYA

segments.text: ACCORDING TO IRAN RADIO ON JULY 7, DEPPRIMIN AND PGOI SPOKESMAN SADEGH TABATABAI DENIED THAT THE PGOI HAS SENT AN OFFICIAL DELEGATION TO LIBYA. THE DENIAL FOLLOWED PUBLICATION OF NEWS STORIES THAT MOHAMMAD MONTAZERI, SON OF AYATOLLAH MONTAZERI, WAS HEADING AN IRANIAN DELEGATION THERE. TABATABAI ONCE AGAIN CONDEMNED MONTAZERI'S ROLE AT MEHRABAD AIRPORT LAST WEEK, WHEN HIS ARMED GUARDS SEVERLY DISRUPTED AIRPORT SERVICES. THE PGOI SPOKESMAN ALSO SAID THAT HOJJATOLISLAM MAHDAVI KANI, CHIEF OF THE CENTRAL REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE, AND PRIMIN BAZARGAN HAVE ISSUED ORDERS FOR

SUMMARY: PRESS ATTACHE MET WITH NEW EDITOR AND - BAZAARI PUBLISHER OF KAYHAN. EDITOR - MOBASHERI HIGHLY CRITICAL OF NEW PRESS - BILL WHILE HAJI MAHDIAN SAYS HE IS RIDDING - HIS EDITORIAL BOARD OF THOSE NOT IN - CONSONANCE WITH ISLAMIC IDEALS. SOURCES - AT KAYHAN MAINTAIN MAHDIAN MAY BE FORCED TO - REHIRE A MAJORITY OF OLD EDITORIAL BOARD - WITHOUT LOSING ITS INDEPENDENCE. ZARNEGAR, - FORMER EDITOR OF KAYHAN, CONDUCTING SIT-IN - OVER SEVERANCE PAY.

ON WEDNESDAY MORNING, JULY 13, PRESS ATTACHE ROSEN MET WITH KAYHAN'S EDITOR, ASSADULLAH MOBASHERI, FORMER JUSTICE MINISTER, AND HAJI HUSSEIN MAHDIAN, THE BAZAARI PUBLISHER OF THE PAPER. UNLIKE TWO MONTHS AGO DURING HIS LAST VISIT TO KAYHAN ROSEN FOUND THE BUILDING ORDERLY AND BUSINESSLIKE, FREE OF ANY DEMONSTRATIONS OR ASSEMBLED GROUPS.

MOBASHERI WAS MORE THAN CORDIAL AND QUITE CANDID TO QUESTIONS POSED TO HIM. HE IS PRESENTLY INVOLVED IN HIRING NEW WRITERS, REPORTERS AND EDITORS, GIVEN MANAGEMENT'S INABILITY TO RECEIVE A PLEDGE OF FIDELITY TO THE REVOLUTION FROM A MAJORITY OF THE EDITORIAL BOARD. MOBASHERI IS A KINDLY, SCHOLARLY FIGURE WITH AN AIR OF OLD PERSIAN CORDIALITY, THUS HE WAS UNABLE TO REFUSE THE NUMEROUS SUPPLICANTS KNOCKING ON HIS DOOR DURING THE MEETING WITH ROSEN. WITH THE NEW PRESS BILL READY FOR FINAL APPROVAL OF THE COUNCIL OF MINISTERS AND THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL.

MOBASHERI SAID HE INTENDED TO PUBLISH CRITICISMS OF THE BILL AND WITH THAT PULLED OUT A CRUMPLED HANDWRITTEN LIST OF REMARKS. HE CHARACTERIZED THE BILL AS AN EXAMPLE OF EKHTENAQ OR STRANGUALTION NOT UNLIKE THE OLD REGIME'S 1947 LAW. FIRST, HE SAID, THERE IS NO NECESSITY TO HAVE A CODE TO GOVERN THE PRESS IF IRAN IS TO PROCEED ON DEMOCRATIC PRINCIPLES. HE THEN WENT ON TO EXPRESS HIS OPINION THAT THE BILL COULD NOT HAVE BEEN THE HANDIWORK OF MINACHI, THE MINISTER OF NATIONAL GUIDANCE, GIVEN HIS PAST RECORD AS A HUMAN RIGHTS ADVOCATE, BUT RATHER THE EFFORT OF SOMEONE LIKE BANI SADR.

HE FELT THAT THE REQUIREMENT TO OBTAIN AN EMTIYAZ OR LICENSE TO PUBLISH FROM THE MNG UNDER THE CRITERIA THAT THE PUBLISHER MUST NOT HAVE A POLICE RECORD AND BE MORALLY UPRIGHT PROVIDES THE GOVERNMENT WITH A POWERFUL WEAPON TO MUZZLE THE PRESS. POINTING TO ARTICLE 11 OF THE PRESS BILL WHICH CALLS ON PUBLISHERS TO EXPLICITY PRINT THE NAME OF THE LICENSEE AND MANAGEMENT ON THE FIRST PAGE AS WELL AS PROVIDE THE MNG WITH A DISTRIBUTION LIST, CIRCULATION AND CHANGE OF ADDRESS WHENEVER THIS OCCURS, SMACKS OF DICTATORSHIP. HE FIRMLY CRITICIZED ARTICLE 16 WHICH HOLDS A JOURNALIST RESPONSIBLE FOR HIS SOURCES.
MOBASHIRI DESCRIBED THE CAVEAT RESTRICTING PUBLICATION UNLESS THE MNG KNEW THE EXACT POLITICAL LEANINGS OF THE MANAGEMENT AS UNBELIEVEABLE AND NONE OF THE GOVERNMENT'S BUSINESS.

HAJI MAHDIAN, THE BAZAARI CALLED THE "IRON MERCHANT" WHO WAS ROUNDLY CRITICIZED IN A RECENT AYANDEGAN ARTICLE ACCUSING HIM OF A CLOSE FRIENDSHIP WITH DISCREDITED FORMER OWNER OF KAYHAN, DR. MESBAHZADEH, IS A SLIM, RATHER UNASSUMING MAN, SOFT SPOKEN IN HIS LATE 4O'S. HE IS REPUTED TO BE WELL CONNECTED WITH KHOMEINI AS EVIDENCED BY HIS FREQUENT VISITS TO THE AYATOLLAH'S RESIDENCE IN PARIS IN THE EARLY WINTER OF '79. SOURCES AT KAYHAN MAINTAIN THAT MAHDIAN DOES NOT CALL THE SHOTS AT KAYHAN DIRECTLY BUT RECEIVES ORDERS FROM CLERICAL ASSOCIATES OF KHOMEINI IN QUM.

MAHDIAN TALKED ABOUT THE IN-HOUSE SETTLEMENT WITH THE EDITORIAL BOARD OF APPROXIMATELY 110 WHEREIN THE ENTIRE GROUP WAS GIVEN SEVERANCE PAY WITH THE OPTION TO BE REHIRED AS LONG AS MANAGEMENT WAS SATISFIED THAT WITH A PLEDGE TO UPHOLD THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTION. ACCORDING TO MAHDIAN 45 MEMBERS OF THE OLD BOARD HAVE BEEN REHIRED WHILE NEGOTIATIONS ARE GOING ON WITH SOME OTHERS. MAHDIAN SAID THAT HE HAD COMPILED A FILE ON ALL THE BOARD AND KNEW EXACTLY WHICH INDIVIDUAL BETRAYED THE REVOLUTION. SOURCES AT THE KAYHAN SAY THAT MAHDIAN COULD'T BE THAT SOPHISTICATED SINCE SAVAK DIDN'T HAVE A COMPLETE DOSSIER ON REPORTERS.

SOURCES CLAIM THAT ------------------016669 121306Z /53 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO USICA WASHDC IMMEDIATE INFO SECSTATE WASHDC 2598 USICA MAHDIAN WENT AGAINST A MAJORITY OF THE EDITORIAL BOARD WHEN IT WANTED TO EXTRACT A PLEDGE OF INDEPENDENCE FROM HIM AND HE REFUSED. THIS GROUP BELIEVES THAT THE PAPER IS HAVING A DIFFICULT TIME GETTING THE DAILY EDITIONS OUT. SOURCES FELT THAT MAHDIAN MAY HAVE TO TURN TO THE OLD BOARD IN THE FUTURE AND AS LONG AS THEY HAVE THEIR SEVERANCE PAY THEY CAN HOLD OUT FOR A WHILE.

MAHDIAN WAS FORCED TO CLOSE HIS CONVERSATION WITH ROSEN WHEN A SUDANESE DELEGATION ARRIVED AT HIS OFFICE FOR NOON PRAYERS. WITHIN A MINUTE HE READIED HIMSELF FOR PRAYER WITH RITUAL ABLUTIONS, EXCUSED HIMSELF AND INVITED THE DELEGATION INTO HIS NEW NAMAZKHANEH, PRAYER SANCTUARY. HE ASKED ROSEN TO CALL ON HIM AGAIN SOON.

SOURCES AT KAYHAN TOLD ROSEN THAT DR. KAZEM ZARNEGAR, FORMER EDITOR OF KAYHAN IN DR. MESBAHZADEH'S ABSENCE, IS CONDUCTING A SIT-IN, HOLDING OUT IN HIS OFFICE. ZARNEGAR HAS BEEN RELEASED FROM THE PAPER BUT HE DOESN'T LIKE THE TERMS OF HIS OWN SEVERANCE PAY. KAYHAN WILL PAY HIM 2 MONTHS SALARY FOR EVERY YEAR OF EMPLOYMENT BUT HE IS HOLDING OUT FOR A THREE MONTH

SUMMARY: ON JULY 9, THE EVE OF THE BIRTHDAY OF THE 12TH IMAM OF THE SHIITE SECT, AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI ANNOUNCED WHAT WAS BILLED IN THE LOCAL PRESS AS A "GENERAL AMNESTY." LIKE MANY ASPECTS OF THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION, HOWEVER, THIS "AMNESTY" WILL PROBABLY TURN OUT TO BE CONSIDERABLY LESS THAN TOUTED. END SUMMARY.

THERE APPEAR TO BE TWO PRINCIPAL REASONS WHY THIS WILL BE THECASE. THE FIRST RELATES TO KHOMEINI'S OWN CONTINUING AMBIVALENCE TOWARDS THE EXERCISE OF POLITICAL AUTHORITY. IMMEDIATELY PRIOR TO THE ANNOUNCEMENT OF THE AMNESTY, HE HAD BEEN GIVING RELATIVELY GREATER LIP SERVICE TO THE PRINCIPLE OF A RATIONAL, UNITARY GOVERNMENT STRUCTURE THAN EARLIER. INDEED, THE AMNESTY ANNOUNCEMENT FOLLOWED LOGICALLY FROM THE STATEMENTS OF SUPPORT HE HAD GIVEN TO THE PGOI. BUT AT THE SAME TIME, KHOMEINI HAS SHOWN GREAT RELUCTANCE TO GIVE UP HIS OWN CONSIDERABLE POWERS, POWERS WHICH ARE USUALLY EXERCISED OUTSIDE THE FORMAL GOVERNMENTAL STRUCTURE.

THE MOST RECENT EXAMPLE OF THIS WAS KHOMEINI'S OVERTURNING OF THE ORDER OF MINISTER OF NATIONAL DEFENSE RIAHI DISMISSING B.G. SEIF AMIR-RAHIMI, THE OUTSPOKEN COMMANDER OF THE MILITARY POLICE, A MOVE WHICH WENT FAR TO NEGATE ALL THAT KHOMEINI HAD EARLIER SAID REGARDING THE NEED FOR THE PGOI'S AUTHORITY TO BE RESPECTED.

THE SECOND FACTOR IS THE ENTRENCHED POSITION OF IRAN'S INFORMAL SYSTEM OF PARALLEL GOVERNMENT, THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE STRUCTURE AND ITS ADJUNCTS. THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS, IN PARTICULAR, STAND TO LOSE POWER THROUGH EFFECTUAL IMPLEMENTATION OF A GENERAL AMNESTY, AND WERE QUICK TO DEMONSTRATE NOT ONLY THEIR INDEPENDENCE OF THE PGOI BUT OF KHOMEINI (AT LEAST AS HE IS ABLE TO AFFECT THE DAY-TO-DAY OPERATIONS OF THE COURTS) AS WELL. THE FIRST MOVE WAS THE ANNOUNCEMENT BY A SPOKESMAN FOR THE COURTS THAT THE PGOI DOES NOT HAVE THE AUTHORITY TO DISSOLVE THEM, AN ACTION, THE SPOKESMAN SAID, ONLY KHOMEINI CAN INITIATE.

THEN, AS IF TO PROVIDE CHILLING EVIDENCE THAT THE COURTS WILL NOT BE COWED BY PRONOUNCEMENTS ALONE, 14 PEOPLE WERE CONDEMNED TO DEATH IN THE FIRST 48 HOURS AFTER THE AMENSTY WAS TO TAKE EFFECT. TO EMPHASIZE THE COURT'S DISDAIN FOR THOSE WHO WOULD CURB THEIR POWERS, THE CONDEMNED INCLUDED NOT ONLY THE USUAL ASSORTMENT OF SAVAK COLLABORATORS BUT SEVERAL INDIVIDUALS (THREE PROSTITUTES AMONG THEM) CHARGED WITH WHAT CAN ONLY BE REGARDED AS COMMON CRIMES.

THE GENERAL AMNESTY ILLUSTRATES A PHENOMENON THAT HAS TURNED OUT TO BE AS TYPICAL OF POST-REVOLUTIONARY IRAN AS IT WAS OF IRAN UNDER THE SHAH--THE PERSIAN CONVICTION THAT SAYING SOMETHING IS THE SAME AS DOING IT. THUS, AN AMNESTY HAS BEEN EFFECTED BECAUSE KHOMEINI HAS SAID THERE IS TO BE ONE. REALITY, JUST AS WAS THE CASE UNDER THE SHAH, IS OFTEN ANOTHER MATTER, HOWEVER. IN THIS INSTANCE, THE REALITY IS THAT REVOLUTIONARY JUSTICE CONTINUES TO BE DISPENSED, A SITUATION THAT IS NOT LIKELY TO CHANGE UNTIL THERE IS A FUNDAMENTAL SHIFT IN THE EXERCISE POWER IN THIS COUNTRY.
(C) ENTIRE TEXT.
SUMMARY: GOVENORS-GENERAL MEET TO REVIEW ELECTION LAWS; SECURITY INCIDENTS CONTINUE THROUGHOUT IRAN; REVOLUTIONARY TRIALS GO ON; KURDISH AND ARAB PROVINCES REMAIN UNSETTLED. END SUMMARY.
GOVERNORS FROM THROUGHOUT IRAN WILL MEET IN TEHRAN TODAY TO DISCUSS ELECTION ARRANGEMENTS FOR THE ASSEMBLY OF EXPERTS. ELECTIONS ARE SCHEDULED TO BE HELD ON AUGUST 3.

SECURITY INCIDENTS HAVE CONTINUED TO PLAGUE IRAN DURING THE PAST WEEK, WITH WIDE PRESS COVERAGE BEING GIVEN TO ASSASSINATIONS, ACTS OF SABOTAGE AND TERRORISM. ON JULY 7, TAQI HAJ TARKHANI, FOUNDER OF TEHRAN'S GHOBA MOSQUE AND DESCRIBED AS "A STRONG OPPONENT OF THE PREVIOUS REGIME" WAS SHOT TO DEATH IN FRONT OF HIS TEHRAN HOME. ACCORDING TO SOME REPORTS, THE ASSASSINATION WAS A MISTAKE, SINCE THE ASSAILANTS WERE ALLEGEDLY LOOKING FOR TARKHANI'S BROTHER WHO IS DESCRIBED AS A CLOSE ADVISOR TO KHOMEINI. THE FORGHAN GROUP HAS BEEN BLAMED FOR THE ASSASSINATION. ON JULY 6 AN UNIDENTIFIED GROUP ATTACKED THE OFFICE OF AYATOLLAH RABBANI SHIRAZI IN SHIRAZ WITH MOLOTOV COCKTAILS.

NO INJURIES WERE REPORTED. IN ANOTHER PARTIALLY SUCCESSFUL ATTEMPT AGAINST A RELIGIOUS FIGURE, TWO UNIDENTIFIED MEN IN TEHRAN OPENED FIRE ON AYATOLLAH SEYED RAZI SHRAZI ON JULY 15. AYATOLLAH SHIRAZI IS THE FOUNDER OF TEHRAN'S SHAFA MOSQUE AND HEAD OF A REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE IN NORTH TEHRAN. HIT BY THREE BULLETS, SHIRAZI IS PRESENTLY DESCRIBED AS BEINN IN "SATISFACTORY" CONDITION. THE RESIDENCE OF AYATOLLAH AL SHUBAIR KHAGHANI, RELIGIOUS LEADER OF IRAN'S ETHNIC ARABS, WAS ALSO SUBJECT TO AN ATTACK THIS WEEK. FOUR PEOPLE ARE SAID TO HAVE BEEN KILLED IN THE FIGHTING AT THE RESIDENCE IN KHORRAMSHAHR, BUT THE AYATOLLAH HIMSELF WAS AWAY AT THE TIME.

ON JULY 10, A MEMBER OF MILITARY POLICE HEAD GENERAL RAHIMI'S SPECIAL "BLACK CLAD" FORCE WAS SHOT IN TEHRAN NOT FAR FROM THE GENERAL'S HEADQUARTERS AT KHOMEINI (FORMERLY JAMSHIDIQP) BARRACKS. A SECOND ATTEMPT ON THE SAME GUARD WAS SAID TO HAVEBEEN MADE ON JULY 13. GENERAL RAHIMI HIMSELFHAS BEEN THE SUBJECT OF WIDESPREAD PRESS COVERAGE BECAUSE OF HIS SELF-PROCLAIMED STANCE AS A STRICT DISCIPLINARIAN AND HIS FREQUENT COMMENTS TO REPORTERS ON CONDITIONS IN IRAN. SACKED BY DEFENSE MINISTER FARBOD ON JULY 9, RAHIMI REFUSED TO LEAVE HIS POST AND WAS REINSTATED BY KHOMEINI THE FOLLOWING DAY.

RAHIMI HAD COME INTO THE NEWS PREVIOUSLY FOR HIS OFFER TO ASSUME GUARD RESPONSIBILITY FOR IRAN'S LEADING RELIGIOUS FIGURES, BUT WAS REBUFFED AT THAT TIME BY COMMITTEE AND CLERGICAL FIGURES IN QOM. ON JULY 11 RAHIMI ANNOUNCED HIS READINESS TO SEND 3,000 SOLDIERS TO GUARD OIL PIPE LINES IN SABOTAGE-RIDDEN KHUZESTAN PROVINCE.

REVOLUTIONARY TRIALS CONTINUE THROUGHOUT IRAN, AND, IN WHAT IS SAID TO BE THE FIRST EXECUTION OF WOMEN SINCE THE FEBRUARY REVOLUTION, THREE PROSTITUTES FACED A FIRING SQUAD IN TEHRAN ON JULY 12. TWO OTHER PROSTITUTES WERE PUBLICLY FLOGGED IN AMOL DURING THE PAST WEEK, BUT IN VIEW OF THEIR PEERS' FATE PRESUMABLY CONSIDER THEMSELVES LUCKY. SINCE JULY 12, SOME FIFTEEN EXECUTIONS HAVE TAKEN PLACE THROUGHOUT IRAN FOR BOTH POLITICAL AND NONPOLITICAL REASONS. ACCORDING TO AYATOLLAH AZARI QOMI, THE CHIEF PROSECUTOR OF TEHRAN'S REVOLUTIONARY COURTS, THE STATUS OF ALL POLITICAL PRISONERS PRESENTLY BEING DETAINED WILL BE CLARIFIED WITHIN THE NEXT TEN TO FIFTEEN DAYS.

PRISONERS WILL BE RELEASED ON "PERSONAL SURETY", REQUIRING ANYONE WHO HAS POSTED SUCH A BOND ON BEHALF OF THE PRISONER TO BRING THE PRISONER TO TRIAL AT THE APPOINTED TIME, OR FACE IMPRISONMENT HIMSELF IF THE PRISONER CANNOT BE FOUND. ------------------092358 190617Z /16 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 2664 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMCONSUL DHAHRAN AMEMBASSY DOHA AMMBASSY JIDDA 0214 AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBAIY KHARTOUM AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEPYASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD SECTION 02 OF 03 TEHRAN 07424

CONDITIONS IN IRAN'S ETHNIC ARAB AND KURDISH AREAS REMAIN VERY UNSETTLED, WITH DAILY REPORTS OF CLASHES, SABOTAGE AND ACCUSATIONS AND COUNTER-ACCUSATIONS BY POLITICAL AND RELIGIOUS FIGURES. ON JULY 4 A MEETING WAS HELD IN MAHABAD (KORDESTAN PROVINCE) TO REVIEW PROVINCIAL PROBLEMS AND TO DISCUSS IRAN'S DRAFT CONSTITUTION. THE CONSTITUTION HAS COME UNDER ATTACK FROM VARIOUS KURDISH GROUPS FOR WHAT THEY CLAIM IS LACK OF REGARD FOR KURDISH NATIONAL RIGHTS AND FOR THE PROPOSAL TO HAVE JAFARI SHIISM LISTED AS THE OFFICIAL RELIGION OF IRAN.

IN THE JILDIAN AREA, SCENE OF CLASHES LAST WEEK, A GENDARMERIE FORCE CLOSED DOWN THE LOCAL OFFICE OF THE KORDESTAN DEMOCRACTIC PARTY (KDP) AFTER AN ARMED BATTLE INVOLVING MEMBERS OF BOTH GROUPS. KDP SECRETARY GENERAL ABDOR RAHMAN GHASSEMLOU HAS ACCUSED RADIO IRAN OF TRYING TO STIR UP ANTI-KURDISH SENTIMENT IN THE NATION. AMONG BROADCASTS CONSIDERED INFLAMATORY BY THE KDP WAS ONE CLAIMING THAT 6,000 TO 10,000 MEMBERS OF THE KDP HAD LAID SEIGE TO THE KURDISH ZARZAH TRIBE AND WAS HOLDING ITS CHIEF HOSTAGE. THE ACCOUNT HAS BEEN STRONGLY DENIED BY THE KDP HEAD.

ON JULY 8 A MEETING WAS HELD BY RELIGIOUS AND POLITICAL FIGURES TO SOLVE THE KURDISH-TURKISH PROBLEMS WHICH HAD CAUSED SO MUCH PREVIOUS CONFLICT IN THE CITY OF NAGHADEH. REFUGEES WHO FLED THE CITY ARE BEING ASKED TO RETURN. TWO RELIGIOUS LEADERS HAVE BEEN APPOINTED TO HELP ADMINISTER THE TROUBLED CITY, AND PAYMENT OF COMPENSATION TO THOSE WHO SUFFERED MONETARY LOSSES HAS BEEN APPROVED. ON JULY 11, PROTEST MARCHES AND DEMONSTRATIONS ORGANIZED BY THE KDP WERE HELD IN KORDESTAN PROVINCE. ACCORDING TO KDP SPOKESMAN GHANI BOLORIAN, THE DEMONSTRATIONS WERE HELD AS A WARNING TO THE GOVERNMENT TO FOCUS ATTENTION ON PROBLEMS IN THE AREA.

ON JULY 14, THE KURDISH BORDER TOWN OF MARRVAN WAS THE SCENE OF A BATTLE WHICH RESULTED IN 22 CASUALTIES AND ABOUT 40 WOUNDED. ONE PRESS SOURCE CLAIMED THE CONFLICT WAS AN INTERNAL AFFAIR, WITH REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS ATTACHED TO THE LOCAL COMMITTEE FIGHTING "LEFTIST" KURDISH GROUPS. A KDP SPOKESMAN GAVE A DIFFERENT VERSION, ALLEGING THE ISSUE WAS BETWEEN "FEUDAL AND COUNTERREVOLUTIONARY ELEMENTS ASSOCIATED WITH THE PAHLAVI REGIME WHO HAVE INFILTRATED THE COMMITTEE" AND "KURDISH FARMERS SEEKING THEIR RIGHTS".

THE KURDISH UNREST IS AFFECTED BY A COMPLICATED SERIES OF FACTORS IN SOME WAYS PECULIAR TO THE REGION, AND IN OTHERS REPRESENTATIVE OF WHAT HAS BEEN HAPPENING THROUGHOUT POST-REVOLUTIONARY IRAN. AS IN OTHER PARTS OF THE COUNTRY, SOME FARM LANDS HAVE APPARENTLY BEEN SEIZED SINCE FEBRUARY BY PEASANTS FROM THEIR ABSENTEE OR PRO-PAHLAVI LANDLORDS. APPARENTLY ALSO, SOME LANDLORDS WHO LOST LANDS TO THE SHAH'S WHITE REVOLUTION ARE ATTEMPTING TO REGAIN OLD ESTATES. SERIOUS RELIGIOUS DIFFERENCES EXIST BETWEEN GROUPS OF SUNNI KURDS AND A SHIITE-DOMINATED GOVERNMENT. THE GENERAL FRAGMENTATION OF THE IRANIAN BODY POLITIC INTO A MULTITUDE OF SPLINTER GROUPS HAS ALSO HAD ITS EFFECT ON THE KURDS.

LOCATED AS THEY ARE ALONG THE IRAQI BORDER, THE BREAKDOWN OF THE GENDARMERIE BORDER PATROL SYSTEM AND THE WAR OF WORDS BETWEEN THE PGOI AND THE IRAQI GOVERNMENT HAS ADDED DIVERSE FUEL TO THE KURDISH UNREST. CLAIMS OF IRAQI ATTACKS AGAINST KURDISH BORDER VILLAGES HAVE BEEN MADE, AND LONG-STANDING KURDISH-TURKISH RIVALRY RESULTING IN RECENT BLOODSHED, AND THE WIDESPREAD POSSESSION OF WEAPONS BY THE WHOLE SPECTRUM OF RIVAL GROUPS ALMOST GUARANTEES CONTINUING UNREST IN THE KURDISH AREA.

IN KHUZESTAN PROVINCE, DEMONSTRATIONS AND SABOTAGE SEEM TO BE AN EVER MORE IMPORTANT ASPECT OF THE ETHNIC ARAB UNREST. IN ADDITION TO THE EXPLOSION OF TWO PIPELINES CARRYING OIL AND NATURAL GAS LAST WEEK, OTHER ACTS OF VIOLENCE HAVE BEEN REPORTED. THE RAILWAY STATION IN THE CITY ITSELF WAS SUBJECT TO A GRENADE ATTACK APPARENTLY AIMED AGAINST THE PASDARAN GUARD FORCE THERE, AND THERE ARE OTHER PRESS REPORTS OF BOMBS THROWN AT PRIVATE HOMES AS WELL AS AT A PASDARAN JEEP IN THE CITY. RENEWED DEMONSTRATIONS BY IRANIAN ARABS IN KHORRAMSHAHR RESULTED IN A DECREE BY KHUZESTAN'S GOVERNOR GENERAL MADANI FOR THE ARMED FORCES TO OBSERVE AN AROUND THE CLOCK ALERT.

THE PRESS REPORTS THAT ON JULY 13, TWENTY-FIVE DEMONSTRATORS IN ABADAN WERE INJURED WHEN GUNMEN OPENED FIRE ON A "PEACEFUL MARCH". PARTICIPANTS IN THE MARCH WERE ALLEGEDLY DEMANDING "SELF RULE FOR KHUZESTAN, THE FREEING OF ALL POLITICAL PRISONERS, AND AN END TO INTERFERENCE FROM OFFICIALS OF THE CENTRAL GOVERNMENT." ON JULY 15 THE CITY OF KHORRAMSHAHR WITNESSED MORE VIOLENCE WHEN UNIDENTIFIED ASSAILANTS BOMBED A MOSQUE WHERE A MEMORIAL SERVICE WAS BEING HELD. FIVE WERE REPORTED KILLED AND AT LEAST THIRTY INJURED IN THE ATTACK. IN A RECENT PRESS INTERVIEW, MADANI CLAIMED THAT "PROFESSIONAL AGITATORS" WERE RESPONSIBLE FOR SECURITY INCIDENTS IN THE PROVINCE.

CALLING THE SITUATION "HIGHLY VOLATILE", MADANI SAID THAT "TIME, AS WELL AS A COMBINATION OF FIRMNESS AND DIPLOMACY WERE NEEDED TO SOLVE THE MANY SIDED PROBLEMS". IN A DIFFERENT INTERVIEW WITH THE PRESS, EISSA KHAGHANI, BROTHER AND CLOSE AIDE TO AYATOLLAH KHAGHANI, THREW A DIFFERENT LIGHT ON THE PROBLEMS OF KHUZESTAN. CLAIMING THAT THE 40,000 PEOPLE WHO DEMONSTRATED THERE RECENTLY WERE "ASKING FOR WATER," HE SAID THE AREA WAS "IN A STATE OF EXPLOSION, AND IF WE DON'T MOVE FAST WE ARE GOING TO FIND IN THE NEAR FUTURE THAT WE CAN DO NOTHING TO BRING IT UNDER CONTROL." LAINGEN

HARD DATA ON JEWISH EMIGRATION SIMPLY DO NOT EXIST. RABBI SHOFET SAYS THAT HE GETS REQUESTS FROM AS MANY AS 30 PEOPLE PER DAY FOR LETTERS OF INTRODUCTION WHICH THEY CAN USE IN SEEKING VISA ASSISTANCE OUTSIDE IRAN. THAT RATE ALONE COULD ACCOUNT FOR AS MANY AS 900 PEOPLE A MONTH LEAVING IRAN. SHOFET SAYS HE HAS LITTLE INFORMATION ABOUT JEWISH COMMUNITIES OUTSIDE TEHRAN, BUT OUR CONTACTS IN SUCH PLACES AS SHIRAZ AND ISFAHAN SUGGEST THAT JEWISH EMIGRATION, PARTICULARLY AMONG YOUNG PEOPLE, IS RUNNING AS HIGH IN THOSE PLACES AS IT IS IN TEHRAN.

WHEN WE ASKED SHOFET SEVERAL WEEKS AGO FOR A TOTAL FIGURE OF JEWS WHO HAVE DEPARTED IRAN HIS ESTIMATE WAS SOMEWHAT LOWER THAN OUR OWN (REF B), BUT WE BELIEVE THIS MAY HAVE BEEN MORE A FUNCTION OF HIS LACK OF INFORMATION ON JEWS OUTSIDE HIS OWN IMMEDIATE FLOCK THAN ANYTHING ELSE. WE HAVE TALKED TO NO RPT NO IRANIAN JEW IN RECENT DAYS WHO EITHER WAS NOT CONTEMPLATING LEAVING HIMSELF OR WHO DID NOT HAVE RELATIVES WHO HAD LEFT OR WANTED OUT.

WE ARE, THEREFORE, INCLINED TO CONCLUDE THAT AT LEAST 25 PERCENT OF A COMMUNITY WHICH ONCE NUMBERED APPROXIMATELY 60,000 HAS ALREADY LEFT WITH PERHAPS THAT MANY AGAIN WHO PLAN TO LEAVE AS SOON AS THEY CAN. BASED ON OUR ADMITTEDLY IMPERFECT PERCEPTION OF WHAT IS ACTUALLY HAPPENING, WE SUSPECT THAT THE NUMBER OF IRANIAN JEWS WHO LEFT IRAN IN THE IMMEDIATE AFTERMATH OF THE REVOLUTION BUT THEN RETURNED IS SO SMALL AS TO BE STATISTICALLY INSIGNIFICANT.

THERE IS NOTHING FURTHER ON HAI AND DANIELPOUR, I.E., THE REVOLUTIONARY PROSECUTOR'S CALL FOR INDIVIDUALS WITH CHARGES AGAINST THEM TO COME FORWARD STILL STANDS BUT THERE HAVE BEEN NO INDICATIONS THAT A TRIAL IS IMMINENT. ON THE OMINIOUS SIDE, EVENTS OF RECENT DAYS HAVE TENDED TO CREATE A SET OF CONDITIONS IN WHICH THE REVOLUTIONARY MOVEMENT AND ITS COURTS FEEL THREATENED. IN THE PAST THE REACTION OF THE SYSTEM IN SUCH CIRCUMSTANCES HAS BEEN A NEW WAVE OF JUDICIAL SAVAGERY. THAT PHENOMENON MAY BE OCCURING ONCE AGAIN, AND THE POSSIBILITY OF HAI AND DANIELPOUR BEING SWEPT UP BY IT CANNOT BE RULED OUT. LAINGEN

1979TEHRAN07514.subject: CHARGE'S CALL ON NIOC CHIEF NAZIH

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY: ON JULY 17, CHARGE, ACCOMPANIED BY PETOFF, CALLED ON NIOC MANAGING DIRECTOR HASSAN NAZIH. DISCUSSION CENTERED ON 1) THE NOW FAMILIAR (TO US AT LEAST) LITANY OF UNDERSTANDING AND ACCEPTANCE OF THE REVOLUTION AND OUR ABIDING SUPPORT FOR THE TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY OF AN INDEPENDENT AND STRONG IRAN, 2) THE POLITICAL ENVIRONMENT AND NAZIH'S POLITICAL ROLE AND BELIEFS, AND 3) PETROLEUM AND THE CURRENT SITUATION IN KHUZESTAN.

NAZIH DEMONSTRATED A FRIENDLY ATTITUDE TOWARDS THE U.S.; HE IS A SECULARIST WHO IS WILLING TO CHALLENGE SOME OF THE CONCEPTS OF AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC (AND THE PEOPLE WHO ADVOCATE A "PURE" VERSION OF SUCH A GOVERNMENT); AND, WHILE RECOGNIZING SOME PROBLEMS IN KHUZESTAN, HE TENDED TO MINIMIZE THEIR IMPORTANCE. LAST PARA INCLUDES NAZIH BIO. END SUMMARY.

IN RESPONSE TO CHARGE'S EXPRESSIONS OF USG ACCEPTANCE OF THE REVOLUTION AND OUR DESIRE TO ESTABLISH A GOOD AND BROADLY-BASED BILATERAL RELATIONSHIP, NAZIH COMMENTED AT CONSIDERABLE LENGTH ON OUR TWO COUNTRIES' MUTUAL INTERESTS, DESIRABILITY OF "REMAINING" GOOD FRIENDS, ETC. SIGNIFICANTLY, NAZIH PRAISED PRESIDENT CARTER'S INITIATIVES ON HUMAN RIGHTS AND SAID THAT THE PRESIDENT'S STRONG STAND ON HUMAN RIGHTS HAD "MADE THE SHAH'S POSITION HOPELESS." IN AN INTERESTING ALLUSION TO THE RUSSIANS, NAZIH SAID THAT IF WE (IRAN AND THE U.S.) HAVE SOME PROBLEMS WE (IRANIANS) SHOULD REMEMBER THAT THE U.S. IS "WITH US" AND THAT THE USG WOULD HELP IN RESOLVING PROBLEMS CAUSED BY OTHER FOREIGNERS.

NAZIH DID NOT SAY ANYTHING OF PARTICULAR NOTE ON THE POLITICAL SITUATION. HE SAID THAT HE MIGHT BE A CANDIDATE FOR THE CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY. HE ALSO SAID THAT THE TIME TABLE FOR THE PROCESS OF ELECTING AND INSTALLING A NEW GOVERNMENT WAS TOO SHORT AND THAT HE INTENDED TO "INSIST" ON AN EXTENSION. NAZIH, THE HEAD OF THE BAR ASSOCIATION, SAID THE ASSOCIATION IN A MEETING JULY 16 HAD DECIDED TO ASK THE GOVERNMENT AND KHOMEINI TO EXTEND THE DEADLINE.

CHARGE GAVE NAZIH A SUMMARY OF THE NEW ENERGY POLICIES AND GOALS ANNOUNCED BY THE PRESIDENT AS WELL AS A COPY OF THE FACT SHEET ON THE POLICY ANNOUNCEMENTS. NAZIH WELCOMED THE GENERAL THRUST OF THE PRESIDENT'S INITIATIVES, BUT HE APPEARED TO BE ILL-PREPARED TO DISCUSS THE INTERNATIONAL ENERGY PICTURE IN MORE THAN GENERALITIES. IN RESPONSE TO CHARGE'S REQUEST THAT IRAN MAINTAIN AN ADEQUATE SUPPLY OF OIL TO THE INTERNATIONAL MARKET AND THEREBY MAKE THE TRANSITION IN THE U.S.

AWAY FROM AN EXCESSIVE DEPENDENCE ON IMPORTED OIL POSSIBLE AND SMOOTH, NAZIH SAID THAT IT WAS THE GOVERNMENT RATHER THAN NIOC THAT SET THE LEVEL OF PRODUCTION AND EXPORTS BUT THAT THE PRODUCTION LEVEL FOR 1979 WAS 4.0 MMBD. HE ALSO SAID THAT THE FIGURE MIGHT BE CHANGED FOR 1980.

IN REGARD TO SITUATION IN KHUZESTAN AND ITS PRESENT AND POTENTIAL FUTURE IMPACT ON THE OIL SECTOR, NAZIH WAS UNWILLING OR UNABLE (PROBABLY THE FORMER) TO BE VERY SPECIFIC. HE ACKNOWLEDGED THAT PROBLEMS EXISTED, BUT HE MAINTAINED THAT ONLY A FEW PEOPLE WERE RESPONSIBLE AND THAT THE GOVERNMENT AND THE PASDARANS SHOULD BE ABLE TO RESOLVE THE PROBLEMS. NAZIH DENIED THAT THE ARAB DISTURBANCES OR THE SABOTAGE HAD HAD ANY IMPACT ON CRUDE PRODUCTION OR EXPORTS (SEPTEL).

NAZIH GRADUATED FROM TEHRAN UNIVERSITY (LAW) IN 1944, WORKED AS A LAWYER IN IRAN FOR A TIME, AND THEN CONTINUED HIS STUDIES IN SWITZERLAND FROM 1950 TO 1953. DURING PREMIERSHIP OF MOSSADEGH, NAZIH SERVED AS LEGAL ADVISOR TO NEWLY ESTABLISHED SOCIAL SECURITY ORGANIZATION. DURING MOSSADEGH PERIOD, NAZIH WAS ALSO ACTIVE IN SUPERVISION OF MILITARY JUSTICE SYSTEM. HE WAS A FOUNDER IN 1953 OF THE NATIONAL RESISTANCE MOVEMENT AND HAS BEEN AN ACTIVE PARTICIPANT IN THE NATIONAL FRONT SINCE 1963. ACCORDING TO THE NIOC-RELEASED BIOGRAPHY (FROM WHICH INFO ABOVE IS TAKEN), HE WAS ARRESTED AND IMPRISONED SEVERAL TIMES.

IN 1977, NAZIH HELPED FOUND THE SOCIETY FOR THE DEFENSE OF ------------------114867 211746Z /44 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 2693 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 07514 HUMAN RIGHTS AND THE SOCIETY OF IRANIAN LAWYERS. DURING JULY 17 MEETING WITH CHARGE, NAZIH WAS VERY FRIENDLY AND HOSPITABLE. HE WAS WILLING TO CONDUCT MEETING IN FRENCH BUT HE SAID THAT HE DOES NOT SPEAK ENGLISH AND HE APPEARED TO UNDERSTAND VERY LITTLE ENGLISH. (NIOC'S DIRECTOR FOR INTERNATIONAL AFFAIRS, REZA AZIMI, TRANSLATED.) NAZIH IS VERY SOFT AND SLOW-SPOKEN. DESPITE HIS APPOINTMENT AS HEAD OF NIOC, NAZIH OBVIOUSLY REMAINS FAR MORE INTERESTED IN LAW AND POLITICS.

1979TEHRAN07532.subject: IRANIAN PRESS COVERAGE OF NIXON VISIT TO SHAH AND REACTION TO EGYPTIAN OFFER OF AMNESTY

segments.text: AND REACTION TO EGYPTIAN OFFER OF AMNESTY

U) IRANIAN PRESS COVERAGE OF THE RECENT VISIT BY NIXON TO THE SHAH HAS BEEN LOW KEY AND RELATIVELY STRAIGHT FORWARD. ETELAAT CARRIED AN AP RELEASE FROM MOSCOW ON PAGE 12 OF ITS JULY 15 ISSUE. THE ARTICLE QUOTED A TASS STATEMENT ON THE LONGSTANDING NIXON-SHAH RELATIONSHIP. KEYHAN NEWSPAPER ALSO RAN A BRIEF ARTICLE ON A BACK PAGE OF ITS JULY 12 ISSUE, QUOTING BBC AS ITS SOURCE. ON JULY 18, BAMDAD CARRIED A VERY SMALL PICTURE OF THE SHAH AND NIXON ON ITS LAST PAGE. COMMENT ACCOMPANYING THE PICTURE WAS VERY BRIEF AND STRAIGHT FORWARD.

(LOU) RE THE EGYPTIAN OFFER OF ASYLUM TO THE SHAH, DESPITE A LOCAL PRESS REPORT JULY 15 QUOTING AN MFA "SPOKESMAN" TO THE EFFECT THAT THE PGOI HAD "WARNED" SADAT THAT ASYLUM WOULD BE IN "DIRECT OPPOSITION TO THE IRANIAN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC," THE MFA TELLS US THE FIRST IT KNEW ABOUT SUCH A WARNING WAS WHEN IT READ OF IT IN THE PAPER. TO THE BEST OF OUR KNOWLEDGE AND RECOLLECTION, THE PGOI HAS NEVER TAKEN AN OFFICIAL STANCE ON THE ISSUE OF THE EGYPTIAN OFFER OF ASLYUM.
THERE HAS BEEN SOME CRITICAL COMMENT IN THE PRESS, INCLUDING AN EDITORIAL IN THE ENGLISH LANGUAGE TEHRAN TIMES JULY 19 PREDICTED "DIRE CONSEQUENCES" IF AMNESTY IS GRANTED. LAINGEN

YOUSSEF IBRAHIM, RESIDENT NY TIMES CORRESPONDENT, WAS CALLED TO MINISTRY OF NATIONAL GUIDANCE MORNING JULY 22, HANDED A LETTER BY BEHZADNIA (DEPUTY MINISTER) WHICH, IN FARSI, INFORMED HIM THAT HIS PRESENCE IN IRAN AS THE NEW YORK TIMES CORRESPONDENT WAS NO LONGER POSSIBLE AND THAT HE SHOULD MAKE PLANS TO LEAVE AT HIS "EARLIEST CONVENIENCE."

IBRAHIM TRIED, UNSUCCESSFULLY, TO WRING MORE OUT OF BEHZADNIA BUT LEARNED ONLY THAT "THEY" WANTED IT AND "THEY" WOULD NOT BE MORE SPECIFIC AS TO WHAT ERRORS IBRAHIM HAD COMMITTED. BEHZADNIA ADDED, SOMEWHAT OMINOUSLY, THAT CLAIBOURNE OF THE WASHINGTON POST, HERE TEMPORARILY, AND THE REUTERS REPRESENTATIVE WOULD ALSO BE ASKED TO LEAVE. SOME FARSI LANGUAGE NEWSPAPERS MAY ALSO BE CLOSED, HE SAID.
CHARGE RAISED MATTER WITH TABATABAI, DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER AND GOVERNMENT SPOKESMAN, DURING POLISH NATIONAL DAY RECEPTION. TABATABAI SAID HE HAD NO KNOWLEDGE OF THE MATTER. CHARGE DEPLORED ACTION.

SUMMARY: THE FOLLOWING ANALYSIS ATTEMPTS TO MEASURE IN QUANTITATIVE TERMS, AT LEAST IN A CRUDE WAY, THE DEGREE OF PROGRESS MADE SINCE THE FEBRUARY REVOLUTION TOWARDS RESOLUTION OF THE ANOMALY OF A DUAL SYSTEM OF GOVERNMENT BROUGHT ABOUT BY THE REVOLUTION'S SUDDEN AND UNEXPECTED VICTORY. WE CONCLUDE THAT, DESPITE AN APPEARANCE OF A CONSIDERABLE DEGREE OF NORMAILITY, THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT OF IRAN (PGOI) HAS BEEN GENERALLY UNSUCCESSFUL IN ASSERTING ITS POLITICAL AUTHORITY. THE INFORMAL STRUCTURE--THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES AND THEIR ADJUNCTS--CONTINUES TO THRIVE, AND INDEED HAS STEADILY BECOME MORE ENTRENCHED AS A PARALLEL SOURCE OF AUTHORITY. A CONCOMITANT FEATURE OF THIS ABNORMAL STATE OF AFFAIRS HAS BEEN GROWING POLITICAL DISSIDENCE.

IN RECENT WEEKS, THE PGOI HAS FOCUSED ON THE CONSTITUTIONAL PROCESS AND THE PROSPECT OF A POPULARLY ELECTED GOVERNMENT BEING IN PLACE BY EARLY AUTUMN AS THE SOLUTION TO THE CONUNDRUM IT HAS NOT BEEN ABLE TO RESOLVE BY OTHER MEANS. END SUMMARY.

THIS REPORT ATTEMPTS TO ASSESS IRAN'S CURRENT POLITICAL SITUATION IN TERMS OF QUANTIFIABLE INDICATORS. TO DO THIS POSES SUBSTANTIAL PROBLEMS, NOT THE LEAST OF WHICH IS THE TOTAL ABSENCE OF OFFICIAL DATA WHICH MIGHT BE APPLIED TO A MODEL FOR MEASURING TRENDS. GIVEN THE GREAT SUSPICION IN PRESENT-DAY IRAN OF USG ACTIVITIES OF ALL KINDS, AS WELL AS THE GENERAL INSECURITY IN MANY AREAS OF THE COUNTRY, IT IS NEARLY IMPOSSIBLE FOR EMBOFFS TO GATHER THE NECESSARY DATA THEMSELVES EXCEPT ON AN EXTREMELY SELECTIVE BASIS.

NONETHELESS, THERE ARE PHENOMENA WHICH CAN BE QUANTIFIED AT LEAST IN A CRUDE WAY, AND WE HAVE ENDEAVORED TO APPLY THESE TO A MODEL WHICH HOPEFULLY CAN BE USED OVER TIME AS A MEASURE OF THE POLITICAL PROCESS.

THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION LEFT A LEGACY OF A DUAL SYSTEM OF GOVERNMENT, THE FORMAL STRUCTURE HEADED BY PM BAZARGAN AND THE INFORMAL ONE HEADED BY AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI. OUR MODEL ASSUMES THAT THIS IS AN ABNORMAL SITUATION, AND, THEREFORE, THAT POLITICAL DEVELOPMENT MUST BE DEFINED AS PROGRESS TOWARD A UNIFIED GOVERNMENT STRUCTURE CAPABLE OF ADMINISTERING THE NATION'S AFFAIRS. IT IS ALSO ASSUMED THAT THE LEVEL OF POLITICAL DISSIDENCE WILL BE INVERSELY PROPORTIONAL TO DEVELOPMENT TOWARD A UNIFORM STRUCTURE. AREAS EXAMINED INCLUDE THE FOLLOWING

THE GOVERNMEET

THE CABINET - --WHEN PM BAZARGAN AND HIS CABINET TOOK OFFICE THEY APPEARED TO SEE THEIR JOB AS ONE OF OVERSEEING THE NATION'S AFFAIRS WHILE CARRYING OUT A PROCESS OF FORMULATING A NEW CONSTITUTION UNDER WHICH A NFF GOVERNMENT WOULD ULTIMATELY BE ELECTED. TWO THINGS INTERFERED: FIRST, THE TASK OF CREATING A NEW GOVERNMENTAL FRAMEWORK IN THE MANNER IN WHICH THE PGOI INITIALLY ENVISIONED IT PROVED TO BE FAR MORE COMPLICATED THAN THE NEW AND INEXPERIENCED LEADERS HAD ANTICIPATED.

SECOND, AND MORE IMPORTANT, THE PGOI SOON FOUND ITSELF SPENDING AN INORDINATE AMOUNT OF TIME TRYING TO SORT OUT THE AN(MALIES AND CONFLICTING SOURCES OF AUTHORITY CAUSED BY A DUALISTIC SYSTEM OF ADMINISTRATION. THE CONSEQUENCE WAS TNIT PROGRESS TOWARD THE GOAL OF ELECTING A PERMANENT GOVERNMENT WAS SLOW AND HAPHAZARD (AS THE MAR(H REFERENDUM ON THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC BORE WITNESS). - --AS SPRING WORE INTO SUMMER BAZARGAN AND HIS COLLEAGUES FOUND THEMSELVES INCREASINGLY BOGGED DOWN IN INEFFECTUAL EFFORTS TO ASSERT THEIR PRIMACY IN MATTERS OF NATIONAL ADMINISTRATION AT ALL LEVELS. WHILE BAZARGAN HIMSELF MORALE WITHIN THE CABINET BEGAN TO FLAG.

JUSTICE MINISTER MOBASHERI WANTED OUT BECAUSE THE INDEPENDENT REVOLUTIONARY COURTS MADE HIS FUNCTION LARGELY SUPERFLUOUS. FOREIGN MINISTER SANJABI QUIT. DEFENSE MINISTER MADANI MOVED ON TO GREENER POLITICAL PASTURES IN THE NAVY AND KHUZESTAN PROVINCE. DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER AMIR-ENTEZAM LEFT FOR SCANDINAVIA. - --FOR THE RECORD, THE EFFORTS TO CURB THE POWERS OF THE INFORMAL SYSTEM OF GOVERNMENT CONTINUE. HOWEVER, IT SEEMS CLEAR THAT THIS HAS BECOME A HOLLOW EXERCISE. THE GOVERNMENT APPEARS TO HAVE REDIRECTED ITS FOCUS BACK TO THE CONSTITUTIONAL PROCESS, AND IS PRESENTLY CONCENTRATING ITS ENERGIES ON PUTTING ITSELF OUT OF BUSINESS AT AN EARLY DATE.
THE ATTITUDE INCREASINGLY SEEMS TO BE THAT ONLY A POPULARLY ELECTED GOVERNMENT WILL BE ABLE TO DEAL WITH IRAN'S MANIFOLD PROBLEMS, INCLUDING THE ONE OF ITS INFORMAL PARALLEL SYSTEM OF GOVERNMENT.

PROVINCIAL AND LOCAL ADMINISTRATION - --THE PGOI MOVED RELATIVELY RAPIDLY TO APPOINT GOVERNORS GENERAL TO MOST OF IRAN'S 22 PROVINCES. AS EARLY AS MARCH, HOWEVER, IT WAS APPARENT THAT THESE CHIEF EXECUTIVES AT THE PROVINCIAL LEVEL WERE HAVING CONSIDERABLE DIFFICULTY IN ASSERTING THEIR AUTHORITY. BY THE END OF JUNE EIGHT GOVERNORS GENERAL IN SEVEN PROVINCES HAD EITHER QUIT IN THE FACE OF THEIR INABILITY TO FUNCTION DUE TO THE INTERFERENCE OF LOCAL REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES OR HAD ACTUALLY BEEN DRIVEN OUT OF THE PROVINCES BY THESE SAME COMMITTEES. - --BELOW THE PROVINCIAL LEVEL THE BUREAUCRATIC STRUCTURE OF THE PREVIOUS REGIME WAS LEFT IN PLACE FOR THE MOST PART.

THIS INFRASTRUCTURE ACCOUNTS FOR THE ABILITY OF MOST LOCAL JURISDICTIONS TO RESUME QUICKLY SUCH BASIC SERVICES AS GARBAGE COLLECTION AND TO PROVIDE UTILITIES VIRTUALLY WITHOUT INTERRUPTION. URBAN LIFE, CONSEQUENTLY OFTEN APPEARS TO HAVE BEEN ONLY MARGINALLY AFFECTED BY THE REVOLUTION. AT THE SAME TIME, HOWEVER, REAL AUTHORITY IN MATTERS OF LOCAL ADMINISTRATION DOES NOT LIE WITH PGOI OFFICIALS.

LAW ENFORCEMENT AND JUSTICE - --THE TRAFFIC POLICE WERE THE FIRST ELEMENT OF IRAN'S FORMAL LAW ENFORCEMENT APPARATUS TO REAPPEAR FOLLOWING THE FEBRUARY REVOLUTION. MUCH MORE SLOWLY, REGULAR POLICE HAVE BEGUN TO REOCCUPY PRECINCT STATIONS. THEY OFTEN SHARE THESE FACILITIES WITH IRREGULAR MILITIAS, HOWEVER, AND ORDERS FROM COMMANDING OFFICERS FREQUENTLY ARE SUBJECT TO VETO BY STATIONHOUSE COMMITTEES WHOSE MEMBERSHIPS ARE NOT INFREQUENTLY DOMINATED BY NON-OFFICIAL PERSONNEL.

REGULAR POLICE, AND EVEN GENDARMERIE, HAVE BEEN ALLOWED TO CARRY ARMS ONLY ON A LIMITED BASIS AND USUALLY UNDER SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES (E.G., PERSONNEL ASSIGNED TO SECURITY DUTY AT SOME GOVERNMENT OFFICES). - --THE SITUATION MAY BE SLIGHTLY BETTER IN THE PROVINCES THAN IN TEHRAN, ALTHOUGH THERE APPEARS TO BE GREAT VARIATION FROM ONE PLACE TO ANOTHER.

IN THE CASPIAN SEA TOWN OF CHALUS, FOR EXAMPLE, EMBOFFS NOT LONG AGO OBSERVED THAT BOTH THE CITY'S POLICE FORCE AND THE LOCAL GENDARMERIE POST SEEMED 1O BE FUNCTIONING IN A NORMAL MANNER, WHEREAS THE INEFFECTIVENESS OF THE POLICE IN KHORRAMSHAHR IN CURBING THE POWER OF THE LOCAL MILITIAS HAS BEEN A MAJOR ELEMENT IN ETHNIC UNREST IN THAT CITY. - --THE MINISTRY OF JUSTICE IS ESSENTIALLY MORIBUND.

THE ADMINISTRATION OF JUSTICE IN CASES OF GREATEST IMPORTANCE TO THE PUBLIC IS THE EXCLUSIVE DOMAIN OF THE OFFICE OF THE REVOLUTIONARY PROSECUTOR AND THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS, BOTH OF WHICH ARE OUTSIDE THE FORMAL PGOI BLREAUCRATIC STRUCTURE AND ACT TOTALLY INDEPENDENT OF IT. OFFICIAL PRONOUNCEMENTS THAT THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS WILL BE REPLACED BY A SPECIAL SYSTEM OF FORMAL TRIBUNALS TO TRY COUNTER-REVOLUTIONARY OFFENSES AND THE DRAFT CONSTITUTION WHICH ENVISIONS A REVITALIZED CIVILIAN JUDICIARY NOTWITHSTANDING, THE PGOI HAS BEEN SINGULARLY UNSUCCESSFUL IN ASSERTING ITS AUTHORITY IN THE ADMINISTRATION OF JUSTICE.

NOR, DESPITE THE GRADUAL REAPPEARANCE OF THE POLICE AND GENDARMERIE, HAS THE PGOI BEEN ABLE IN ANY MEANINGFUL RESPECT TO REGAIN CONTROL OF THE POWER OF ARREST FROM THE COMMITTEES AND IRREGULAR MILITIAS. EVEN WHERE THE POLICE AND GENDARMERIE HAVE RETURNED TO THEIR POSTS, THEIR ROLE IS ESSENTIALLY AN AUXILLIARY ONE TO THE COMMITTEES AND MILITIAS.

EDUCATION - --PRIMARY AND SECONDARY SCHOOLS REOPENED SHORTLY AFTER THE FALL OF THE BAKHTIAN GOVERNEMNT IN FEBRUARY. DESPITE THE PROBLEMS IMPOSED BY AN ABBREVIATED SCHOOLTYEAR AND STUDENTS POLITICIZED BY THEIR EXPERIENCE OF THE PRECEDING MONTHS, THE PGOI CAN BE REASONABLY SATISFIED WITH ITS ABILITY TO REACTIVATE THE PUBLIC SCHOOL SYSTEM, A PROCESS WHICH HAS JUST CULMINATED IN THE ADMINSTRATION OF YEAREND EXAMINATIONS.

(IT SHOULD BE NOTED, HOWEVER, THAT THE EXAMINATIONS HAD TO BE POSTPONED IN CERTAIN INSTANCES BECAUSE OF ADMINISTRATIVE PROBLEMS.) THERE ARE MASSIVE PROBLEMS (SHORTAGES OF TEACHERS, INADQUATE FACILITIES, A MEDIOCRE CURRICULUM) TO BE FACED IN THE FUTURE, BUT THESE WOULD HAVE BEEN THERE IN ANY EVENT. - --AT THE UNIVERSITY LEVEL, HOWEVER, THE RECORD IS MUCH MORE MODEST. CAMPUSES IN THE CAPITAL, ESPECIALLY THE UNIVERSITY OF TEHRAN, REMAIN HOTBEDS OF POLITICAL ACTIVITY WHERE LITTLE CLASSROOM INSTRUCTION IS CARRIED OUT.

ECONOMIC POLICY AND PLANNING - --THE PGOI'S ABILITY TO GET THE OIL INDUSTRY OPERATIONAL AND TO RESUME PRODUCTION HAS TO BE REGARDED AS A MAJOR ACHIEVEMENT. ALTHOUGH THE PETROLEUM SECTOR IS FAR FROM TROUBLE-FREE AND THE PGOI HAS EXPERIENCED DIFFICULTY IN CONVERTING ITS SUBSTANTIAL OIL REVENUES INTO USUABLE ECONOMIC ASSETS, AN INABILITY TO REACTIVATE THE OIL INDUSTRY ALMOST CERTAINLY WOULD HAVE MEANT THE EARLY DEMISE OF THE PGOI. AS IT IS, THE PGOI HAS BEEN CUSHIONED TO A DEGREE FROM THE FULL FORCE OF THE REPERCUSSIONS OF RADICAL SOCIAL AND ECONOMIC UPHEAVEL. - --ELSEWHERE, HOWEVER, THE PGOI'S ECONOMIC RECORD IS GENERALLY POOR.

IT HAS BEEN SINGULARLY INEFFECTIVE IN PRODDING INDUSTRY BACK INTO PRODUCTION OR IN PROTECTING THE NATION'S OWN LONGER TERM INTERESTS BY MOVING EXPEDITIOUSLY TO RATIONALIZE AND REGULARIZE THE MYRIAD CONTRACTUAL RELATIONSHIPS ESTABLISHED BY THE PREVIOUS REGIME WITH FOREIGN GOVERNMENTS AND PRIVATE ENTITIES. INDEED, IN THE LATTER AREA THE PGOI HAS USUALLY PROVEN POWERLESS TO PREVENT THE INTRUSION OF PAROCHIAL INTERESTS INTO CONTRACT RELATIONSHIPS IN WAYS THAT ARE HIGHLY DETRIMENTAL TO THE COMMON WEAL. ON THE POSITIVE SIDE, IN RECENT DAYS THERE HAS BEEN SOME PROGRESS IN DEFINING PRIORITIES, AND A NUMBER OF FOREIGN FIRMS RETURNING TO IRAN HAVE BEEN PLEASED WITH THE RECEPTION THEY HAVE RECEIVED.

IN THIS REGARD THERE HAS BEEN A SLIGHT EASING IN THE POLICY OF GRANTING WORK PERMITS TO FOREIGN PERSONNEL. THE PGOI HAS FINALLY GIVEN BIRTH TO A BUDGET, BUT IT IS LESS THAN INSPIRED, AND IN SEVERAL IMPORTANT RESPECTS ACTUALLY CONTRADICTS STATED POLICIES (E.G., AGRICULTURE, EDUCATION, SOCIAL WELFARE AND ROADS). THE ASSUMPTION MUST BE THAT THE SLAP-DASH MANNER IN WHICH THE BUDGET WAS PUT TOGETHER REFLECTS THE STILL TENUOUS GRIP PGOI ECONOMIC PLANNERS AND MANAGERS HAVE ON THE AREAS THEY ARE RESPONSIBLE FOR.

FINALLY, DECISIONS TO NATIONALIZE BANKS, INSURANCE, AND CERTAIN INDUSTRIES, WHILE PERHAPS UNAVOIDABLE UNDER PREVAILING CONDITIONS, REPRESENT LESS A CLEARLY DEFINED ECONOMIC POLICY ON THE PGOI'S PART THAN THE ABSENCE OF ONE.

PUBLIC WELFARE. - --THE PGOI'S PUBLIC WELFARE PROGRAM HAS BEEN DOMINATED BY THE CONSEQUENCES OF THE ECONOMIC ACTIONS TAKEN IN OPPOSITION TO THE PREVIOUS REGIME AND A CONCOMITANT FLIGHT OF CAPITAL AND TECHNICAL, MANAGERIAL AND ENTERPRENEURIAL SKILLS. UNEMPLOYMENT, UNDEREMPLOYMENT AND UNPRODUCTIVE EMPLOYMENT ARE ENDEMIC, PERHAPS AFFECTING AN ABSOLUTE MAJORITY OF THE WORKFORCE, THE PGOI'S RESPONSE HAS BEEN PALLIATIVE RATHER THAN CURATIVE. FOR EXAMPLE, THE PGOI HAS NO PROGRAM TO SOLVE ITS MASSIVE LABOR PROBLEMS, PREFERING INSTEAD TO DEAL WITH THEM THROUGH DOLES TO THE UNEMPLOYED AND PRESSURES ON EMMLOYERS TO KEEP AS MANY PEOPLE AS POSSIBLE ON THE PAYROLLS WHETHER OR NOT THERE IS WORK FOR THEM TO DO.
AT BEST, THIS APPROACH MAY BUY TIME IN ANTICIPATION OF THE DEVELOPMENT OF AN EFFECTIVE POLICY; AT WCRST, IT SIMPLY POSTPONES THE ULTIMATE DAY OF RECKONING.
