NATIONAL DEFENSE - --THE MILITARY SERVICES HAVE BEEN AGONIZINGLY SLOW IN THEIR RECOVERY FROM THE TRAUMA OF THE REVOLUTION. THE NEW LEADERSHIP, BOTH WITHIN AND WITHOUT THE SERVICES, HAS TALKED OF AN OVERALL FORCE STRUCTURE GREATLY REDUCED IN SIZE FROM THAT UNDER THE SHAH. NONETHELESS, EVEN WITH THESE REDUCED MANNING LEVEL GOALS, THE SERVICES, PARTICULARLY THE GROUND FORCES, HAVE EXPERIENCED GREAT DIFFICULTY IN FILLING OUT THEIR UNITS. MANNING LEVELS IN THE GROUND FORCES, FOR EXAMPLE, MAY BE NO MORE THAN 50 PERCENT OF THE NEW, REDUCED STRENGTH REQUIREMENTS. THE RECORD IS BETTER IN THE AIR FORCE AND NAVY, BUT THERE ARE PROBLEMS THERE AS WELL.

FOR INSTANCE, THE APPROXIMATELY 14,000 AIR FORCE HOMOFARS HAVE BEEN HIGHLY POLITICIZED AND OFTEN CONSTITUTE AN OBSTACLE TO REBUILDING RATHER THAN A NUCLEUS AROUND WHICH IT CAN OCCUR. - --THE SENIOR OFFICER CORPS HAS BEEN DEVASTATED. (THE NAVY, FOR EXAMPLE, HAS ONLY THREE FLAG OFFICERS ON ACTIVE DUTY, WHILE THE AIR FORCE, WITH ELEVEN GENERAL OFFICERS, IS HARDLY BETTER OFF.) THE GENERALLY LESS EXPERIENCED OFFICERS WHO NOW MAN MANY KEY POSITIONS IN THE SERVICES HAVE OFTEN BEEN FRUSTRATED IN DEMONSTRATING LEADERSHIP ABILITIES BY THE ACTIONS OF THE SERVICE COMMITTEES.

THE LATTER, WHICH HAVE SHOWN SURPRISING RESILIENCY, ARE FREQUENTLY DOMINATED BY HOMOFARS, NCO'S AND LOWER RANKING ENLISTED MEN, AND INFLUENCE NEARLY ALL MAJOR MILITARY DECISIONS. - --THERE HAS BEEN SOME IMPROVEMENT IN THE PHYSICAL APPEARANCE OF SOME UNITS IN RECENT TEEKS AND THERE IS A CERTAIN AMOUNT OF ROUTINE ACTIVITY (INSPECTIONS, TRAINING SORTIES, ETC.), BUT FOR THE TIME BEING, IRAN'S MILITARY SERVICES REMAIN A CONCEPT MORE THAN A REALITY. AS A WHOLE, THEY ARE NOT CAPABLE CF EFFECTIVELY CONDUCTING A MAJOR JOINT OPERATION IN DEFENSE OF THEIR COUNTRY.
THE REVOLUTIONARY MOVEMENT

FURTHER, THE POWER OF THE SHADOWY REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL ACTUALLY APPEARS TO BE GROWING. WHEREAS IT INITIALLY SEEMED TO BE LIMITED TO A VAGUE AD HOC CONSULTATIVE ROLE, IT HAS TAKEN ON IN RECENT WEEKS A CLEAR QUASI-LEGISLATIVE FUNCTION.

WHILE MOST OF THOSE TRIED TO DATE WERE IN ONE WAY OR ANOTHER ASSOCIATED WITH THE PAHLAVI SYSTEM, THE DEFINITION OF COLLABORATION HAS TENDED TO BROADEN OVER TIME. FURTHER, THE COURTS HAVE FROM TIME TO TIME TRIED CASES THAT WERE PURELY CRIMINAL.

THE COURTS PALPABLY DEMONSTRATED THEIR INDEPENDENCE AND CONTEMPT FOR EFFORTS (FROM WHATEVER QUARTER) TO CURB THEIR POWERS BY CONDEMNING 14 INDIVIDUALS TO DEATH IN THE FIRST 48 HOURS FOLLOWING THE RECENT ANNOUNCEMENT OF A "GENERAL AMNESTY".

MODERATE CLERICS AND THEIR ALLIES IN THE BAZAARS, TOO, HAVE QUESTIONED THE PRACTICALITY OF A RIGIDLY THEOCRATIC STATE, AND WHILE EVEN MORE RELUCTANT TO CHALLENGE KHOMEINI DIRECTLY THAN THE SECULARISTS, MAY ULTIMATELY HAVE A FAR GREATER IMPACT ON THE SHAPE OF IRAN"S POLITICAL FUTURE THAN THE LESS NUMEROUS SECULARISTS.

RADICALS AND TERRORISTS - --THE WAVE OF TERRORIST ATTACKS SFT OFF BY THE ASSASSINATION OF FORMER ARMY CHIEF QARANI IN APRIL HAS NOT ABATED. THE PRESS HAS COVERED VARIOUS ATTEMPTS AGAINST PROMINENT INDIVIDUALS, MOST OF WHOM HAVE BEEN CLERICS ASSOCIATED WITH KHOMEINI AND THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT HE HEADS, BUT NO DATA ARE AVAILABLE ON THE NUMBER OF CASUALTIES WHICH HAVE RESULTED FROM ATTACKS--REPUTED TO OCCUR ALMOST NIGHTLY--ON A VARIETY OF LOW-LEVEL TARGETS. AGAIN, WHILE HARD DATA ARE SIMPLY NOT AVAILABLE, IT IS GENERALLY PERCEIVED THAT ZHE OVERALL LEVEL OF VIOLENCE HAS BEEN ON THE RISE IN RECENT WEEKS.

ETHNIC MINORITIES - --DISSIDENCE HAS INCREASED VIRTUALLY WITHOUT INTERRUPTION AMONG IRAN'S ETHNIC MINORITIES. KURDESTAN AND KHUZISTAN ARE POWDERKEGS WHICH COULD EXPLODE AT ANY MINUTE. THE TURKOMAN SAHRA AREA OF GORGAN IS ONLY MARGINALLY MORE TRANQUIL. OMINOUS RUMBLINGS AMONG THE NOMADIC TRIBES OF FARS HAVE BEEN GROWING LOUDER, AND THE -GOI IS CLEARLY WORRIED ABOUT BALUCHISTAN.

CONCLUSIONS - --MEASURED ON AN ABSOLUTE SCALE, THE CURRENT IRANIAN SCENE IS NOT ENTIRELY BLEAK. IN THE IMMEDIATE AFTERMATH OF THE REVOLUTION THE COUNTRY DID NOT DISINTEGRATE INTO COMPLETE ECONOMIC AND POLITICAL CHAOS. INDEED, THE PGOI AND THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES WERE ABLE TO FOSTER A SET OF CONDITIONS WHICH GIVE THE APPEARANCE OF A SURPRIZING DEGREE OF NORMALITY.

TELEPHONES WORK, WATER RUNS, LIGHTS TURN ON, OIL IS BEING PRODUCED, THE BAZAARS ARE OPEN, FARMERS ARE TENDING THEIR FIELDS, AND THE TRAFFIC IS AS BAD AS EVER. - --HOWEVER, AS THE ABOVE SECTORAL EXAMINATION SUGGESTS, THE PGOI HAS FAILED TO ASSERT ITS AUTHORITY IN A MEANINGFUL WAY IN MOST OF THE AREAS THAT ULTIMATELY COUNT IN POLITICAL TERMS. FIVE MONTHS AFTER THE REVOLUTION THE INFORMAL PARALLEL SYSTEM OF GOVERNMENT IS JUST AS VIGOROUS AS AND MORE ENTRENCHED THAN IT EVER WAS.

IN OTHER WORDS, THERE HAS BEEN NO SIGNIFICANT PROGRESS ------------------125306 230406Z /11 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 2747 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMCONSUL DHAHRAN AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE SECTION 08 OF 08 TEHRAN 07635 IN ELIMINATING THE ANOMALY OF GOVERNMENTAL DUALISM BROUGHT ABOUT BY THE REVOLUTION'S SUDDEN AND UNEXPECTED VICTORY IN FEBRUARY.

RATHER THAN CONTINUE TO ATTEMPT TO DISSOLVE OR ABSORB THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES AND OTHER ELEMENTS OF THE INFORMAL STRUCTURE, THE PGOI IS GENERALLY IGNORING THEIR EXISTENCE WHILE FOCUSING ITS ATTENTION ON THE CONSTITUTIONAL PROCESS THAT WILL BRING A NEW GOVERNMENT INTO BEING, PROBABLY SOMETIME IN THE EARLY AUTUMN. 1979TEHRAN07679.subject: CHARGE'S CALL ON AGRICULTURE MINISTER DR. MOHAMMAD IZADI

segments.text: DR. MOHAMMAD IZADI (C - ENTIRE TEXT)

MY COURTESY CALL, JULY 18, (ACCOMPANIED BY AGRICULTURAL ATTACHE PHILLIPS) ON MINISTER OF AGRICULTURE IZADI WAS ABOUT ONE PERCENT ON AGRICULTURAL MATTERS AND 99 PERCENT ON IZADI'S CONCERNS OVER THE MANNER IN WHICH AMERICAN "SPECIAL INTEREST GROUPS", PARTICULARLY "ZIONISM", WERE CONVEYING THE WRONG IMAGE OF THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION TO THE AMERICAN PEOPLE. IN THIS SENSE IT WAS A REPEAT OF IZADI'S PITCH TO CHARGE NAAS DURING THEIR CONVERSATION BEFORE HE LEFT HERE (TEHRAN 04625).

IZADI WENT ON AT GREAT LENGTH ABOUT HIS CONVICTION PREJUDICIAL TO BOTH OUR GOVERNMENTS IN THE SENSE THAT THEY WERE UNDERMINING AMERICAN ATTITUDES TOWARD IRAN. HE CONCEDED THAT THE USG COULD NOT CONTROL THE AMERICAN MEDIA BUT FELT THAT SOMETHING SHOULD BE DONE TO TRY TO GET THE SITUATION HERE ACROSS IN A MORE BALANCED AND FACTUAL WAY. THIS INCLUDED, HE SAID, THE MILIARY SUPPLY PICTURE WHERE HE DESCRIBED A STRONG FEELING ON THE PART OF THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT THAT THE USG WAS DELIBERATELY WITHHOLDING INFORMATION AND THAT WE HAD BEEN DOING THIS FOR SOME TIME.
HE SAID THERE WAS A GENERAL FEELING AMONG HIS MINISTERIAL COLLEAGUES THAT THE USG WAS WITHHOLDING LARGE AMOUNTS OF SPARE PARTS URGENTLY NEEDED HERE.

I MADE A CONSIDERABLE ATTEMPT TO TRY TO PUT SOME PERSPECTIVE INTO THE MATTER OF THE OPERATION OF THE AMERICAN MEDIA, EMPHASIZING ITS SIZE, ITS FREEDOM, AND ITS DIVERSITY. I SAID THAT ACCUSATIONS ABOUT ITS BEING CONTROLLED BY "SPECIAL INTERESTS", HOWEVER, PARTICULARLY ZIONISM, WERE UNJUSTIFIED AND UNWARRANTED EXAGGERATION THAT WAS IN THE INTEREST OF NEITHER OF OUR GOVERNMENTS. I REMINDED HIM THAT FOR MY PART I RECENTLY HAD BEEN VERY MUCH CONCERNED ABOUT THE MANNER IN WHICH WE WERE BEING PORTRAYED BY THE OFFICIAL MEDIA IN THIS COUNTRY AS SOMEHOW ACTING AGAINST THE REVOLUTION AND SEEKING TO FRUSTRATE ITS PURPOSE.

THIS WAS TOTALLY WRONG, AND I SAID I HAD NO SYMPATHY WITH THE RESPONSE MADE TO ME THAT ALTHOUGH THE RADIO AND TELEVISION HERE ARE STATE-OWNED THE GOVERNMENT DOES NOT CONTROL WHAT THEY SAY. I SAID I HAD SAID AS MUCH TO DR. YAZDI. (IZADI WAS FRANK TO CONCEDE THAT ULTIMATE CONTROL OVER THE MEDIA WAS IN QOM AND NOT IN THE FORMAL GOVERNMENT APPARATUS.)

I TOLD IZADI THAT I DID AGREE WITH HIM ON HIS UNDERLYING CONCERN; I.E., THAT IT WAS IMPORTANT THAT BOTH OUR GOVERNMENTS AND BOTH OUR PEOPLE HAVE BETTER CONCEPTIONS OF OUR RESPECTIVE PURPOSES AND THAT WE BOTH NEEDED TO WORK ON THIS. LAINGEN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

MONTAZERI RETURNED TO IRAN JULY 20 AND PROMPTLY GAVE A PRESS INTERVIEW IN WHICH HE MADE A NUMBER OF REMARKS SIMILAR IN TONE TO THOSE REPORTED IN REFTEL. AMONG HIS MORE INTERESTING ALLEGATIONS WAS ONE THAT FORMER DEPUTY PM AMIR-ENTEZAM HAD SOMEHOW DUPED FM YAZDI INTO DEMANDING THAT THE PLO OFFICE IN AHWAZ BE CLOSED. AS FAR AS WE KNOW THE OFFICE REMAINS OPEN, BUT MONTAZERI'S CHARGE WAS NOT ALL THAT FAR OFF THE MARK. BEFORE HIS DEPARTURE FOR SWEDEN AS AMBASSADOR AMIR-ENTEZAM WAS INDEED MOST CONCERNED ABOUT PLO ACTIVITIES IN KHUZESTAN PROVINCE AND WOULD HAVE BEEN QUITE HAPPY TO SEE ITS OFFICE IN AHWAZ CLOSED DOWN.

THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF MONTAZERI'S DEPARTUERE FROM IRAN JUNE 30 (TEHRAN 7096) PROVED A SCURCE OF EMBARRASS ENT FOR HIS FATHFAR (WHO REPUDIATED HIS SON'S BEHAVIOR) AND OUTRAGED FOR THOSE IRANIANS WITH EVEN A MODICUM OF CONCERN ABOUT LAW AND ORDER. :' A RESULTN THE PROSEQ AUX# GENERAL ( PGOI OFFICIAL) SUBSEQUENTLY ANNOUNCED THAT A WARRANT HAS BEEN ISSUED FOR YOUNG MONTAZARI'S ARREST AND THAT HE WOULD BE PICKEUPON HIS RETURN. THE "MEHRWLL D MADMANWCZ AS HE HAS COME TO BE KNOPDN AMONGTDMEDK# THUGS AS WELL AS AIRPORT OFFICIALS. THE PROSECUTOR GENERAL'S OFFICE HAS BEEN BUSY SINCE BACKTRACKING ON ITS BRAVE TALK ABOUT ARRESTING MONTAZERI, NOW SAYING INSTEAD THAT HE IS"UNDER INVESTIGATION."

THE LESSON IN THIS IS THAT EVEN FOOLS HAVE TO BE TAKEN SERIOUSLY IN REVOLUTIONARY IRAN IF THEY HAVE ACCESS TO THE REAL WELLSPRINGS OF AUTHORITY. 1979TEHRAN07852.subject: FOREIGN PRESS REGULATIONS USICA FOR NEA

segments.text: PRESS ATTACHE ROSEN CALLED ON MINISTRY OF NATIONAL GUIDANCE'S BEHZADNIA JULY 25, TO SEEK MORE DETAILS REGARDING GROUND RULES FOR FOREIGN PRESS. BEHZADNIA, RECEIVED ROSEN CORDIALLY, BUT SAID THAT SINCE THE REGULATIONS ARE ONLY NOW BEING SUBMITTED TO REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL, HE COULD NOT SUPPLY ANYTHING IN WRITING. HE DID SAY THAT ACCREDITATION AND MONITORING OF FOREIGN PRESS WILL BE THE RESPONSIBILITY OF IRAN EMBASSIES IN COUNTRIES TO WHOM THE CORRESPONDENT FILES. ACCREDITATION IN IRAN WILL BE SUBJECT TO RENEWAL EVERY THREE MONTHS DURING WHICH THE CORRESPONDENT'S DISPATCHES WILL BE REVIEWED. IF THERE IS EVIDENCE OF INACCURATE OR DISTORTED REPORTING, ACCREDITATION WILL BE WITHDRAWN.
FOREIGN CORRESPONDENTS, WHEN INTERVIEWING IRANIANS, MUST BE ACCOMPANIED BY A GUIDE/TRANSLATOR SELECTED BY THE MINISTRY.

BEHZADNIA SCOFFED AT THE PROTESTS OF THE FOREIGN PRESS ASSOCIATION AGAINST RESTRICTIONS. "I'LL THROW THEM ALL OUT," HE SAID. CLAIBOURNE, HE DECRIED IS AN EXAMPLE OF AN IRRESPONSIBLE JOURNALIST IN THAT HE "MIQUOTED" SHARIATMADARI, VISITED MINOO ISLAND "KNOWING NOTHING" OF THAT AREA, PICKS AND CHOOSES HIS OWN TIME WHEN "COMING TO ME". ON IBRAHIM, HE SAID THERE ARE "DEEP SECRETS" ABOUT HIM. HE SHOULD FEEL "LUCKY" TO LEAVE IRAN. HO CITED THE VIENNA CONVENTION AS PROVIDING SUFFICIENT LATITUDE FOR IRAN TO DETERMINE WHO WILL BE WELCOME OR UNWELCOME HERE.
AS FOR HIS OWN FUTURE, BEHZADNIA SAID HE IS ONLY TEMPORARILY IN THE JOB. AS AN ENDODRINOLOGIST, HE WANTS TO RETURN TO MEDICINE. LAINGEN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: THE ANNOUNCEMENT OF THE "GENERAL AMNESTY" BY AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI ON JULY 9 HAS RESULTED IN THE RELEASE OF MANY PRISONERS FROM REVOLUTIONARY JAILS, BUT AT THE SAME TIME HAS BEEN ACCOMPANIED BY A DRASTIC SURGE IN EXECUTIONS. SINCE JULY 10, SOME 67 PEOPLE HAVE BEEN EXECUTED IN VARIOUS IRANIAN CITIES. END SUMMARY.

OF THOSE IDENTIFIED BY OCCUPATION IN THE NEWSPAPERS, EX-POLICE, MILITARY, AND GENDARMERIE WERE AMONG THE HARDEST HIT GROUPS. TWENTY-THREE MEMBERS OF THESE PROFESSIONS HAVE BEEN EXECUTED SINCE JULY 11. AN UNSPECIFIED NUMBER HAVE ALSO BEEN RELEASED FROM PRISON. SOME, AT LEAST, APPARENTLY WILL BE EXPECTED TO CONTINUE IN THEIR FORMER PROFESSIONS. (POLOFF KNOWS OF ONE POLICE MAJOR WHO FORMERLY SERVED AS CHIEF OF TABRIZ' 5TH PRECINCT AND WAS RELEASED LAST WEEK AFTER SEVERAL MONTHS IN THE TABRIZ PRISON. THE RELEASE NOTICE WAS FOLLOWED BY THE MAJOR'S TRANSFER TO A DIFFERENT CITY, BUT HE REMAINS ON ACTIVE DUTY.)

IN A MOVE UNPRECEDENTED SINCE THE FEBRUARY REVOLUTION, EIGHT WOMEN HAVE ALSO BEEN EXECUTED BY REVOLUTIONARY COURTS. ALTHOUGH MOST WERE ACCUSED OF PROSTITUTION, ONE WOMAN WAS CONVICTED OF SMUGGLING WEAPONS AND HEROIN. A NUMBER OF MEN ACCUSED OF ADULTERY HAVE ALSO BEEN EXECUTED. THIS WAVE OF EXECUTIONS FOR NON-POLITICAL CRIMES HAS BEEN PUBLICLY QUESTIONED BY IRAN'S PROSECUTOR GENERAL FATHOLLAH BANISADR. IN A RECENT INTERVIEW HE CLAIMED THAT THE SENTENCES PASSED ON SUCH "MORAL OFFENDERS" WERE UNLAWFUL, SINCE THESE OFFENSES DID NOT COME WITHIN THE JURISDICTION OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS.

GIVEN THE IRANIAN FUNDAMENTALISTS' IDENTIFICATION OF ISLAM AND THE KORAN WITH THE REVOLUTION, HOWEVER, IT SEEMS UNLIKELY THAT CLERGYMEN HERE WILL VIEW BANISADR'S CLAIMS WITH ANY SYMPATHY. THE COMMON CAPITAL CHARGE OF "CORRUPTION ON EARTH" HAS BEEN USED TO ENCOMPASS A WIDE VARIETY OF CRIMES, RANGING FROM SODOMY TO ANTIREVOLUTIONARY ACTS.

THE LATEST DEATHS BRING THE NUMBER OF THOSE EXECUTED TO 387 PEOPLE. THE RASH OF EXECUTIONS SINCE THE AMNESTY IS ALMOST CERTAINLY RELATED AT LEAST IN PART TO ITS VERY ANNOUNCEMENT, AND REPRESENTS A REACTION BY THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS TO WHAT THEY PERCEIVE AS A THREAT TO THEIR EXISTENCE. THERE IS ALSO EVIDENCE THAT SOME GROUPS BENT ON REVENGE OR STILL BRIMMING WITH THE FERVOR OF RELIGIOUS RIGHTEOUSNESS ARE OPPOSED TO THE AMNESTY. IN THE CITY OF BEBAHAN, EX-SENATOR MUSSAVI WAS ASSASSINATED IN HIS JAIL CELL SHORTLY BEFORE HE WAS TO BE RELEASED ON BAIL UNDER THE NEW AMNESTY.

AN IRANIAN SOURCE TOLD POLOFF THAT HIS COUSIN, A POLICE OFFICER IN ARDEBIL, WAS OFFICIALLY RELEASED FROM PRISON IN THAT CITY BECAUSE OF THE AMNESTY A FEW DAYS AGO. LED OUT OF HIS CELL BY A LOCAL COMMITTEE GROUP, THE OFFICER WAS SHOT TO DEATH IN A FIELD OUTSIDE THE CITY. DESPITE PROCLAMATIONS, SPEECHES AND THE AMNESTY, IT SEEMS LIKELY THAT THE JUDICIAL PROCESS IN IRAN WILL REMAIN A BLOODY ONE FOR SOME TIME TO COME.

DURING JULY 25 CALL ON FM YAZDI CHARGE RAISED THE MATTER OF THE RECENT SPATE OF EXECUTIONS AS ONE OF SEVERAL ISSUES THAT CLOUD OUR BILATERAL RELATIONSHIP. HE SAID THAT WE DO NOT UNDERSTAND THIS IN THE IMMEDIATE WAKE OF AN ANNOUNCEMENT OF AN AMNESTY.

HE NOTED THAT GIVEN THE IMPORTANCE OF HUMAN RIGHTS IN THE AMERICAN DOMESTIC POLITICAL EQUATION,THE CONTINUING EXECUTIONS ------------------043806 290254Z /64 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 2889 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 07901 ADVERSELY AFFECT IRAN'S POLITICAL IMAGE IN THE U.S. AND MAKE IT DIFFICULT FOR US TO DEFEND OUR RELATIONSHIP WITH IRAN.
IN HIS RESPONSE YAZDI DID NOT ADDRESS THE MATTER OF THE EXECUTIONS, CONCENTRATING HIS ATTENTION INSTEAD ON WHAT HE VIEWS AS BIASED TREATMENT OF IRAN IN THE AMERICAN PRESS (SEPTEL). LAINGEN

1979TEHRAN07930.subject: SHAH'S DESIRE TO RESIE IN THE U.S.

segments.text: YOUR MESSAGE ASKS FOR MY PERSONAL AND PRIVATE EVALUATION OF THE EFFECT, ON THE SAFETY OF AMERICANS IN IRAN AND ON OUR RELATIONS WITH THE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN, OF THE SHAH BEING ALLOWED TO ESTABLISH RESIDENCE IN THE UNITED STATES.

A JUDGMENT ON THAT ISSUE MUST INEVITABLY BE (AND REMAIN) SPECULATIVE, CLOUDED BY THE ENORMOUS UNCERTAINTIES OF THE CURRENT IRANIAN SCENE--WHERE THERE HAS BEEN ALMOST NO PROGRESS TO (#) INCLUDE THAT FOR THE SHAH TO TAKE UP RESIDE IN THE U.S. IN THE IMMEDIATE FUTURE, BY WHICH I MEAN THE NEXT 2-3 MONTHS, WOULD CONTINUE AS BEFORE TO BE SERIOUSLY PREJUDICIAL TO OUR INTERESTS AND TO THE SECURITY OF AMERICANS IN IRAN. ON THE OTHER HAND, I BELIEVE THAT THIS SITUATION COULD BEGIN TO CHANGE WITHIN THAT TIME PERIOD TO MAKE THE RISKS MANAGEABLE BY LATE FALL.
EVEN THAT JUDGMENT, I MUST CONFESS, IS INEVITABLY SPECULATIVE AND PRESUPPOSES A GOOD DEAL OF GOOD FORTUNE FOR ALL CONCERNED. MY RATIONALE FOLLOWS.

I BELIEVE THE NEXT 2-3 MONTHS REPRESENT THE WRONG TIME PERIOD FOR TWO BASIC REASONS: FIRST, THE HIGH DEGREE OF FRUSTRATION (AND THUS THE POTENTIAL FOR A SEARCH FOR SCAPEGOATS) IN THE CURRENT IRANIAN POLITICAL SCENE AND, SECOND, THE STILL SENSITIVE NATURE OF OUR BILATERAL RELATIONSHIP.

IRAN TODAY REMAINS POLITICALLY ADRIFT, ITS "GOVERNMENT" UNDER BAZARGAN STILL SUBJECT TO THE WHIMS AND ULTIMATE CONTROL OF THE AYATOLLAH AND HIS ENTOURAGE AT QOM. DAY-TO-DAY DECISION MAKING IS DIFFUSED, EXERCISED MORE OFTEN THAN NOT BY REVOLUTIONARY GROUPS AND INDIVIDUALS SCATTERED IN AND OUT OF THE FORMAL ADMINISTRATIVE APPARATUS OF GOVERNMENT. THERE IS GROWING POPULAR FRUSTRATION OVER THE FACT THAT THE REVOLUTION HAS NOT CHANGED THINGS VERY MUCH IN IRAN; INDEED FOR MANY SEGMENTS OF THE POPULATION, CONDITIONS ARE WORSE THAN THEY WERE BEFORE.

IN THIS ATMOSPHERE, WE REMAIN THE CONVENIENT SCAPEGOAT,TO THE POINT WHERE KHOMEINI THIS PAST WEEK EVEN TARGETED US AS SOMEHOW BEHIND THE BURNING OF HARVESTS IN THE FIELDS IN CERTAIN PARTS OF IRAN. FOR US NOW TO GIVE REFUGE TO THE SHAH WOULD ALMOST CERTAINLY TRIGGER MASSIVE DEMONSTRATIONS AGAINST OUR EMBASSY. WITH LUCK, THEY MAY STOP AT THAT, WITHOUT A PHYSICAL ASSAULT OF THE KIND WE EXPERIENCED LAST FEBRUARY. BUT THERE COULD BE NO ASSURANCE OF THAT, SINCE IRAN'S REGULAR MILITARY AND POLICE FORCES REMAIN LARGELY DEMORALIZED AND CANNOT YET BE RELIED ON TO APPLY THE FORCE THAT MIGHT BE NEEDED TO PREVENT VIOLENCE AGAINST US.

INDEED THE GOVERNMENT HERE HAS YET TO FIND THE STRENGTH OR MEANS TO REPLACE WITH A UNIFORMED FORCE THE IRREGULAR GUERILLA FORCE ASSIGNED BY KHOMEINI TO "GUARD" OUR COMPOUND SINCE LAST FEBRUARY. THE POSSIBILITY OF INDIVIDUAL OR GROUP TERRORIST ACTION AGAINST OUR CHANCERY AND PERSONNEL WOULD OF COURSE ALSO BE GREATER WERE THE SHAH TO COME TO THE U.S. NOW, THOUGH THAT IS A POSSIBILITY THAT ALREADY EXISTS.

NOR IS OUR BILATERAL RELATIONSHIP YET OF THE MUTUAL CONFIDENCE AND SUBSTANCE EASILY TO WEATHER A GESTURE OF THIS KIND TOWARD THE SHAH. I THINK WE ARE MAKING PROGRESS IN REMOVING AT LEAST SOME OF WHAT HAS BEEN A DEEPLY FELT SUSPICION AMONG REVOLUTIONARY IRANIANS THAT WE HAVE NOT YET ACCEPTED THE NEW REALITIES IN IRAN AND THAT WE ARE CONNIVING WITH THE SHAH, ZIONISM, OR WITH SAVAKIS TO UNDERMINE THE REVOLUTION. BUT IT IS SLOW GOING, AND WE DOUBT VERY MUCH THAT OUR CREDENTIALS HAVE BEEN ENHANCED MUCH AT ALL AS YET WITH KHOMEINI.

GRANTING ASYLUM TO THE SHAH NOW WOULE NEGATE MUCH THAT WE HAVE ACHIEVED TO DATE, AND I WOULD NOT EXCLUDE A REPEAT IN SOME FASHION, DICTATED BY KHOMEINI, OF A KNEE-JERK TYYE OF POLICY ACTION AGAINST US AS DEMONSTRATED AT THE TIME OF THE JAVITS RESOLUTION.

WHAT I AM SAYING IS THAT WE NEED SOME ADDED CUSHION ON BOTH FRONTS--ON THE INTERNAL IRANIAN SCENE AND IN OUR BILATERAL RELATIONS--BEFORE WE ACCEPT WHATEVER RISKS NOTE BY OC/T: TEHRAN 7930/01 (#) OMISSION CORRECTION TO FOLLOW. ------------------039665 281055Z /10 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 2905 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 07930 NODIS CHEROKEE - FOR THE SECRETARY THERE MAY BE FOR OUR INTERESTS IN DOING WHAT I BELIEVE WE EVENTUALLY SHOULD DO-- ALLOW THE SHAH REFUGE IN THE U.S.

THE NEXT 2-3 MONTHS ARE CRUCIAL AND POSSIBLY HOPEFUL IN BOTH RESPECTS. INTERNALLY, BAZARGAN IS MAKING A NEW AND STRONGER EFFORT TO GET KHOMEINI TO TRANSFER TO HIS PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT SOME OF THE AUTHORITY NOW EXERCISED BY THE REVOLUTIONARY AND COURTS AND BY THE LOOSE HIERARCHY OF REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES THAT STRETCH TO THE STREET LEVEL. GROWING PROBLEMS WITH THE KURDS AND THE ARAB MINORITY IN KUZISTAN SEEM TO BE REMINDING AT LEAST SOME OF THE REVOLUTIONARY ELEMENTS THAT STEPS MUST BE TAKEN TO RESTORE THE STATUS OF THE MILITARY IN TERMS OF BOTH AUTHORITY AND MATERIAL.

BUT THE REAL KEY TO STRENGTHENED GOVERNMENTAL AUTHORITY AND CONTROL LIES IN THE SUCCESSFUL CARRYING OUT OF THE ELECTORAL PROCESS (A KIND OF CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY IS TO BE ELECTED AUGUST 3) WHICH IS SUPPOSED TO RESULT IN A CONSTITUTIONALLY ENDOWED GOVERNMENT IN POWER BY AUTUMN.

IT IS OF UTMOST IMPORTANCE, IN MY VIEW, THAT WE NOT INJECT OURSELVES IN THAT PROCESS BY ANY PREMATURE GESTURE TOWARD THE SHAH, WITH ALL THE SUSPICIONS ABOUT OUR ATTITUDES AND ABOUT USG INTERFERANCE THAT THIS COULD AROUSE AND THE THE OPPORTUNITY IT COULD PROVIDE FOR THOSE REVOLUTIONARY HOTHEADS WHO WOULD PROBABLY LIKE NOTHING BETTER THAN A CHANCE TO FRUSTRATE THE POLITICAL TIMETABLE AND TAKE A CRACK AT US AT THE SAME TIME.

SIMILARLY, I BELIEVE IT IMPORTANT THAT WE NOT BURDEN OUR STILL THIN BILATERAL RELATIONSHIP WITH THE REVOLUTIONARY LEADERSHIP HERE UNTIL IT HAS GAINED ADDED SUBSTANCE AND DEPTH. AGAIN THERE IS PROMISE. DESPITE CONTINUED PROBLEMS ON MANY ISSUES BETWEEN US, WE HAVE SENSED IN RECENT WEEKS A GROWING APPRECIATION, AT LEAST WITHIN THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT, OF THE IMPORTANCE OF A BETTER U.S. RELATIONSHIP. LAST WEEK'S CONGRESSIONAL APPROVAL (IN THE DOD SUPPLEMENTAL) OF FUNDS TO PURCHASE THE FOUR SPRUANCE DESTROYERS ORIGINALLY DESTINED FOR IRAN HAS GIVEN US AND THE IRANIANS THE FLEIXIBILITY TO BEGIN ALLOWING THE IRANIANS ACCESS TO MORE URGENTLY NEEDED SPARES FOR THEIR AIR FORCE AND OTHER MILITARY FORCES.
THIS WILL HELP REMOVE LINGERING SUSPICIONS IN THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT THAT WE HAVE HAD ULTERIOR POLITICAL MOTIVES IN HOLDING BACK ON SUCH SHIPMENTS.

ASSUMING THAT THIS MORE HOPEFUL TREND II OUR BILATERIAL RELATIONSHIP CONTINUES AND DEEPENS, AND ASSUMING ALSO THAT THE CONSTITUTIONAL TIMETABLE HERE RESULTS IN A SOMEWHAT STRONGER GOVERNMENT IN PLACE BY AUTUMN, WITH ENHANCED AUTHORITY OVER IRAN'S SECURITY FORCES, THE RISKS IN A GESTURE ON OUR PART TOWARD THE SHAH COULD BE MUCH MORE MANAGEABLE. I WOULD THEREFORE HOPE THAT WE COULD DELAY ANY FINAL DECISION UNTIL WE SEE HOW THINGS DEVELOP OVER THE NEXT 60-90 DAYS.
IT WOULD HELP MEASURABLY, IN MY VIEW, IF DURING THAT SAME TIME PERIOD WE WERE ABLE TO NAME AN AMBASSADOR, AN ACT THAT IN ITSELF WILL BE SEEN AS A VOTE OF CONFIDENCE IN THE NEW REALITIES IN IRAN.

THE JUDGMENT DESCRIBED ABOVE WOULD OF COURSE DIFFER IF THE SHAH WERE PUBLICLY TO RENOUNCE HIS CLAIM AND THAT OF HIS HEIRS TO THE THRONE BEFORE COMING TO THE U.S. SUCH ACTION ON HIS PART WOULD SUBSTANTIALLY LESSEN THE RISKS TO OUR INTERESTS.(I CONFESS, HOWEVER, TO FINDING IT HARD TO IMAGINE HIS TAKING SUCH ACTION IN THE SHORT TERM FUTURE). ON THE OTHER HAND, I DO NOT SEE THAT A PUBLIC STATEMENT BY THE SHAH SIMPLY FORESWEARING POLITICAL ACTIVITIES OF ANY SORT WOULD HAVE MUCH IMPACT. IT WOULD SCARCELY BE CREDIBLE HERE. LAINGEN

THE INCIDENT REFERRED TO IN REFTEL WAS REPORTED IN THE LOCAL PRESS IN AN INFLAMATORY MANNER. TO DATE THERE HAVE BEEN NO DEMONSTRATIONS OVER THE INCIDENT OF WHICH WE HAVE BECOME AWARE. HOWEVER, WE DO NOT RULE OUT THE POSSIBILITY OF TROUBLE, AND, THEREFORE, WOULD APPRECIATE BEING KEPT APPRISED OF DEVELOPMENTS.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

AT THE RISK OF SOUNDING CYNICAL, WE NOTE THAT ROWGHANI'S OPTIMISM HAS INCREASED PROPORTIONATELY TO THE DISTANCE HE HAS PUT BETWEEN HIMSELF AND IRAN. WHEN HE LEFT IN MAY (FOR "FOUR TO SIX WEEKS") HE WAS DISPAIRING ABOUT THE SITUATION IN QOM AND WONDERING WHERE THE REVOLUTION WENT WRONG. segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT)

PER INSTRUCTIONS IN REF A POLCOUNS CALLED ON HEAD OF INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS DEPARTMENT IN MFA, MEHDI EHSASI, JULY 30 AND MADE POINTS IN PARAS 3 THROUGH 8 OF REF A AND RAISED SPECIFIC POINTS OF CONCERN ENUMERATED IN PARA 3 OF REF B. EHSASI RESPONDED TO POLCOUNS' INVITATION TO COMMENT BY SAYING THAT IRAN, BECAUSE IT IS NOT YET A FULL-FLEDGED MEMBER OF THE NAM, HAD NOT BEEN INVITED TO COMMENT ON THE CUBAN DRAFT.

FURTHER, THE PGOI IS STILL IN THE PROCESS OF REVIEWING WHAT ITS POLICIES ON A RANGE OF ISSUES, INCLUDING SOME OF THOSE CITED BY POLCOUNS, SHOULD BE, AND THUS HE, EHSASI, WAS NOT IN A POSITION YET TO GIVE ANY OFFICIAL REACTION TO POLCOUNS' INVITATION.

HOWEVER, HE SAID THAT UNOFFICIALLY HE WAS CONFIDENT THAT IRAN WOULD FOLLOW AN INDEPENDENT POLICY WITHIN THE NAM, EXAMINING EACH ISSUE ON ITS MERITS. HE RECOGNIZED THAT THERE ARE VARIOUS BLOCS WITHIN THE NAM, SOME OF WHICH TEND TOWARD EXTREMIST POSITIONS. OCCASSIONALLY, IRAN MIGHT FIND ITSELF SIDING WITH ONE OF THESE BLOCS ON A PARTICULAR ISSUE, BUT IT WOULD NOT BE BECAUSE IRAN WAS ALIGNING ITSELF WITH THAT BLOC BUT RATHER BECAUSE INDEPENDENT EXAMINATION OF THE ISSUE HAD LED IRAN TO CONCLUDE THAT IT SHOULD TAKE THE POSITION IT DID.

COMMENT: IRAN IS STILL VERY MUCH PREOCCUPIED IN PUTTING ITS FOREIGN AFFAIRS HOUSE IN ORDER FOLLOWING THE FEBRUARY REVOLUTION. WE THINK THAT EHSASI WAS BEING PERFECTLY CANDID WHEN HE DECLINED TO COMMENT ON THE ISSUES RAISED BY POLCOUNS ON THE GROUNDS THAT THE PGOI DOES NOT YET HAVE AN OFFICIAL POSITION ON THEM. UNDER THE CIRCUMSTANCES, WE ARE INCLINED TO CONCLUDE THAT IRAN'S POSTURE AT THE NAM--AS WELL AS IN OTHER INTERNATIONAL FORA--WILL FOR THE FORESEEABLE FUTURE BE GOVERNED MORE BY THE PERSONALITY OF THE LEADING MEMBER OF THE DELEGATION.

IF FM YAZDI HIMSELF ATTENDS, WE CAN PROBABLY COUNT ON IRAN TAKING A RELATIVELY RESPONSIBLE APPROACH TO MOST ISSUES BASED UPON A REASONABLY PRAGMATIC ASSESSMENT OF WHAT IRAN'S OWN NATIONAL INTERESTS ARE. IF, HOWEVER, IRAN'S DELEGATION IS HEADED BY SOMEONE LACKING EXPERIENCE AND/OR SWEPT UP WITH THE MYSTIQUE OF THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTON, MODERATION AND PRAGMATISM MAY BE THE VICTIMS. LAINGEN

BALLOTING PROCEDURES PROMISE TO BE PONDEROUS. UNREST AT SEVERAL LOCATIONS IN THE ETHNIC KURDISH AREA OF WESTERN IRAN CONTINUES. THE PGOI IS TAKING THIS PHENOMENON SERIOUSLY, BUT AS YET HAS NOT FOUND A MEANS OF DEALING WITH IT. END SUMMARY. .

MATIN-DAFTARI'S NATIONAL DEMOCRATIC FRONT ANNOUNCED JULY 25 THAT IT WOULD NOT PARTICIPATE IN THE ASSEMBLY OF EXPERTS ELECTION ON AUGUST 3. THE NDF SAID ITS DECISION WAS TO PROTEST THE REGIME'S LACK OF ATTENTION TO BASIC HUMAN RIGHTS. THE ARAB PEOPLE'S POLITICAL ORGANIZATION, THE DEMOCRATIC PARTY, THE PAN IRAN PARTY AND THE PARTY OF THE FREE HAVE ALSO ANNOUNCED THAT THEY WILL NOT TAKE PART. WELL OVER ONE HUNDRED OTHER POLITICAL PARTIES AND ORGANIZATIONS, INCLUDING THE TUDEH, SOCIALIST WORKERS PARTY AND FEDAYAN-EKHALQ ON THE LEFT AND THE ISLAMIC REPUBLICAN PARTY ON THE RIGHT, HAVE PUT UP CANDIDATES HOWEVER.

THE ETHNIC KURDISH BORDER PROVINCES OF IRAN REMAIN VERY UNSETTLED, AND A NUMBER OF CLASHES HAVE BEEN REPORTED DURING THE PAST WEEK. KURDISTAN'S GOVERNOR . GENERAL CLAIMED JULY 22 THAT THE CITY OF MARIVAN WAS IN THE HANDS OF ARMED REBELS WHO WERE UNWILLING TO HOLD DISCUSSIONS WITH ANY ONE EXCEPT A DELEGATION FROM TEHRAN. HE REPORTED THAT TWO-THIRDS OF THE POPULATION HAD LEFT THE CITY, OFFICES WERE CLOSED AND TELEPHONE COMMUNICATIONS HAD BEEN CUT. A DELEGATION SENT TO MARIVAN ON JULY 24, HEADED BY HOJATOLESLAM LAHOUTI, RETURNED EMPTY-HANDED. THE DELEGATION LEADER CLAIMED THE KURDS HAD LAID DOWN UNACCEPTABLE CONDITIONS.

REVOLUTIONARY GUARDSMEN APPARENTLY CONTROL HIGHWAY ACCESS TO THE CITY, AND REPORTS CLAIM THEY ARE STOPPING FOOD SUPPLY TRUCKS FROM TRYING TO REACH THE RESIDENTS WHO ARE CAMPED OUTSIDE THE CITY.

OTHER PRESS REPORTS CLAIM THAT ARMY TANK REINFORCEMENTS BEING SENT FROM QAHRAMANSHAR (FORMERLY KERMANSHAH) TOWARDS SANANDAJ HAD BEEN STOPPED BY THE KURDISH RESIDENTS OF KAMYARAN, WHO SURROUNDED THE TANKS AND FORCED THEM TO HALT.

SUMMARY: ELECTIONS TO IRAN'S ASSEMBLY OF EXPERTS WHICH WILL DEBATE THE COUNTRY'S DRAFT CONSTITUTION TOOK PLACE IN THE MIDST OF CONFUSION AND CONTROVERSY AUGUST 3, BUT NONETHELESS APPEAR TO HAVE BEEN GENERALLY FREE FROM PREMEDITATED ABUSES. A NUMBER OF PARTIES BOYCOTTED THE ELECTIONS, AND THE TURNOUT WAS LIGHTER THAN FOR THE REFERENDUM ON THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC IN MARCH. THOSE WHO DID VOTE APPEAR TO HAVE BEEN OVERWHELMINGLY SUPPORTERS OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI AND HIS ISLAMIC MOVEMENT. END SUMMARY.

AS WAS TRUE FOR THE MARCH REFERENDUM, ELECTIONS FOR IRAN'S CONSTITUTIONAL ASSEMBLY OF EXPERTS AUGUST 3 WAS SURROUNDED BY CONFUSION AND CONTROVERSY. ARRANGEMENTS FOR THE BALLOTING WERE, IF ANYTHING, EVEN MORE HAPHAZARD THAN EARLIER, WITH RULES BEING PROMULGATED UP TO AND BEYOND THE ELEVENTH HOUR. THE CAMPAIGN WAS EFFECTIVELY LIMITED TO THE FIVE DAYS IMMEDIATELY PRIOR TO AUGUST 3, THEREBY PRECIPITATING COMPLAINTS THAT THE ELECTORATE HAD LITTLE OPPORTUNITY TO GET TO KNOW THE CANDIDATES AND THEIR QUALIFICATIONS FOR OFFICE. APPARENTLY, ALMOST NO ADVANCE THOUGHT WAS GIVEN TO THE SPECIAL PROBLEM OF ILLITERATE VOTERS.

THE ARRANGEMENT FINALLY HIT UPON--TO HAVE POLLING OFFICIALS WRITE IN THE NAMES OF ILLITERATE VOTERS' CHOICES FOR THEM--WAS SO OBVIOUSLY OPEN TO ABUSE THAT IT IMMEDIATELY PROVOKED WIDESPREAD CRITICISM.

THE MECHANICS OF THE ELECTIONS WERE AS FOLLOWS: EXCEPT FOR TEHRAN, WHICH WAS SEPARATED FROM THE REST OF THE CENTRAL PROVINCE AS A SINGLE ELECTORAL DISTRICT, EACH PROVINCE CONSTITUTED AN ELECTORAL DISTRICT. ONE MEMBER OF THE ASSEMBLY WAS ELECTED FOR EACH 500,000 PECFE IN THE TOTAL POPULATION. SIX PROVINCES HAVE FEWER THAN 500,000 PEOPLE BUT NONETHELESS ELECTED ONE REPRESENTATIVE EACH. THOSE PROVINCES WITH MULTIPLES OF 500,000 ELECTED MORE THAN ONE REPRESENTATIVE DEPENDING UPON THE TOTAL POPULATION (E.G., FARS, WITH APPROXIMATELY 2,000,000 TOTAL POPULATION, ELECTED FOUR).

EACH VOTER COULD SELECT UP TO THE MAXIMUM NUMBER OF CANDIDATES THE ELECTORAL DISTRICT HE WAS CASTING HIS BALLOT IN WAS AUTHORIZED TO SEND TO THE ASSEMBLY ON THE BASIS OF ITS POPULATION. THE BALLOT WAS IN TWO PARTS, ONE WHICH REQUESTED PERSONAL DATA ON THE VOTER AND THE OTHER SPACE TO WRITE IN HIS CHOICE OR CHOICES. THE VOTER WAS REQUIRED TO SHOW HIS IDENTITY CARD (SHENAS NAMEH) AND TO PUT HIS THUMB PRINT ON HIS BALLOT (THE INK USED FOR THIS PURPOSF WAS SUPPOSEDLY INDELIBLE SO THAT A VOTER COULD NOT GO TO ANOTHER POLLING STATION AND VOTE AGAIN).
AS NOTED ABOVE, POLLING OFFICIALS WERE PRESENT TO HELP ILLITERATE VOTERS WRITE IN THEIR CHOICE OR CHOICES.

AS OF LATE AUGUST 2 AT LEAST 15 PARTIES AND POLITICAL ORGANIZATIONS HAD ANNOUNCED THAT THEY WOULD BOYCOTT THE ELECTIONS BECAUSE OF THE "UNDEMOCRATIC" MANNER IN WHICH THEY WERE BEING HELD. MOST OF THESE WERE OBSCURE LEFTIST GROUPS WITH LITTLE CHANCE OF ELECTING ANY OF THEIR CANDIDATES IN ANY EVENT, BUT ALSO INCLUDED SEVERAL ETHNICALLY-BASED PARTIES AND MUCH OF THE NON-MARXIST SECULAR PORTION OF THE POLITICAL SPECTRUM, MOST NOTABLY THE NATIONAL FRONT AND THE NATIONAL DEMOCRATIC FRONT. THE FORMER HAD INITIALLY INDICATED IT WOULC PARTICIPATE AND HAD FIELDED A SMALL SLATE OF CANDIDATES.

AMONG INDIVIDUALS TAKING THEIR HATS OUT OF THE RING BECAUSE OF RESERVATIONS ABOUT THE MANNER IN WHICH THE ELECTIONS WERE ORGANIZED WAS HASSAN NAZIH, HEAD OF NIOC AND PRESIDENT OF THE LAWYERS' ASSOCIATION, WHO HAS EMERGED AS THE MOST ARTICULATE SPOKESMAN OF THOSE OPPOSED TO KHCMEINI'S RIGIDLY ISLAMIC REPUBLIC.

THE TUDEH HAS CONTINUED TO GIVE LIP SERVICE TO THE THEME OF UNITY WITH THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT, THEREBY MAKING IT DIFFICULT FOR THE PARTY NOT TO PARTICIPATE.

ON THE MORNING OF AUGUST 3 A SURVEY OF A NUMBER OF POLLING STATIONS AROUND TEHRAN REVEALED SEVERAL INTERESTING PHENOMENA: FIRST, THE TURNOUT APPEARED TO BE MUCH LIGHTER THAN IT WAS DURING THE MARCH REFERENDUM ON THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. THE LONGEST LINES WERE IN THE POORER SECTIONS OF THE CITY; IN "TAGHOUTI" NEIGHBORHOOS OF NORTH TEHRAN VOTERS WERE FEW AND FAR BETWEEN. SECOND, THOSE VOTING WERE PREDOMINANTLY THE SORTS OF PEOPLE WHO ALWAYS CONSTITUTED THE BACKBONE OF KHOMEINI'S STRENGTH AND WHO REMAIN LARGELY LOYAL TO HIM, I.E., THE IRANIAN MASSES.

MEN WERE IN A SUBSTANTIAL MAJORITY AT THE POLLING THOSE WOMEN GOING TO THE POLLS, WITH ONLY OCCASIONAL EXCEPTIONS, WORE CHADORS. THIRD, THE VOTING WAS ORDEFLY. WHERE THERE WERE LINES, PEOPLE WAITED PATIENTLY. BASED ON TELEVISION INTERVIEWS WITH A NUMBER OF VOTEPS IN TEHRAN, IT APPEAFED THAT PEOPLE WERE GENERALLY FREE TO VOTE THEIR CONSCIENCES. WHILE THERE WAS LITTLE PRIVACY, IT DID NOT APPEAR THAT POLLING OFFICIALS WERE PRESSURING VOTERS TO CHOOSE PARTICULAR INDIVIDUALS. THIS PRESUMABLY REFLECTED A GENERAL UNAAIMITY OF VIEWS BETWEEN MOST VOTERS AND OFFICIALS AS MUCH AS SCRUPULOUSNESS ON THE LATTER'S PART.

IT WILL BE SEVERAL DAYS BEFCRE THE RESULTS OF THE VOTING ARE KNOWN, BUT WE THINK IT SAFE TO PREDICT NOW THAT THE HEZBCLLAHIS--THE REPRESENTATIVES OF THE PARTY OF GOD (WHETHER THAT BE IRP CANDIDATES, MPRP CANDIDATES OR MEMBEFS OF SOME OTHER ISLAMIC ORGANIZATION)--WILL MAKE AN ALMOST CLEAN SWEEP OF THE 73 SEATS AT STAKE. APPROXIMATELY 80 PERCENT OF THE CANDIDATES WERE MULLAHS IN ANY EVENT. FURTHER, DESPITE THE AMATEURISH ORGANIZATION OF THE ELECTIONS, THEY WERE NOT RIGGED. FEOPLE WERE GENERALLY FREE TO VOTE AS THEY SAW FIT.

THAT MUCH OF THE NON-ISLAMIC PORTION OF THE ELECTORATE APPARENTLY CHOSE TO STAY AWAY FROM THE POLLS DOES NOT NEGATE THE FACT THAT THE RESULTS WILL REPRESENT THE WILL OF THE MAJORITY OF THE IRANIAN PEOPLE. 1979TEHRAN08779.subject: IRANIAN PARTICIPATION IN THE NAM CONFERENCE

segments.text: A CUBAN DELEGATION HAS BEEN VISITING TEHRAN FOR THE LAST FEW DAYS TO DISCUSS IRANIAN PARTICIPATION IN THE NAM CONFERENCE IN SEPTEMBER AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF DIPLOMATIC RELATIONS BETWEEN IRAN AND CUBA. ACCORDING TO THE ENGLISH-LANGUAGE TEHRAN TIMES AUGUST 6, PM MEHDI BAZARGAN HIMSELF MAY LEAD THE IRANIAN DELEGATION TO HAVANA. THE PAPER ALSO SAID THAT THE CUBANS CURRENTLY IN TEHRAN HAD PRESENTED THE PGOI WITH A COPY OF THE DRAFT NAM COMMUNIQUE. AN MFA SPOKESMAN SAID THAT IT WOULD BE STUDIED DURING THE NEXT TWO WEEKS.

IN ADDITION TO CALLS ON VARIOUS PGOI OFFICIALS, THE CUBAN DELEGATION, LED BY PEDRO ANTONIO ESQUIVAL (DESCRIBED AS THE CUBAN MINISTER FOR CHEMICAL INDUSTRIES), SAW LEADER OF THE REVOLUTION, AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, AND AYATOLLAH MAHMOUD TALEGHANI, THE SENIOR RELIGIOUS FIGURE IN TEHRAN. TALEGHANI'S REMARKS TO THE DELEGATION, AS REPORTED IN THE PRESS, WERE SOMEWHAT CRYPTIC. ON THE ONE HAND, HE SAID THAT THE ONLY DIFFERENCE BETWEEN COMMUNISM AND ISLAM WAS THE LATER'S BELIEF IN GOD, WHILE ON THE OTHER HE TOLD MEMBERS THAT IT WAS "RATHER AMBIGUOUS" FOR HIM THAT "CERTAIN NON-ALIGNED MEMBERS WERE NOT NON-ALIGNED IN THE REAL SENSE OF THE MOVEMENT." LAINGEN

A SOLID BODY OF LEFTIST OPINION, COMPOSED PRIMARILY OF VILLAGE YOUNG PEOPLE, HAS GROWN UP IN OPPOSITION TO THE KHOMEINI LOYALISTS. - --THE ULEMA HAVE ALIGNED THEMSELVES WITH A NEW PROVINCIAL "ESTABLISHMENT" IN DEFENSE OF THE STATUS QUO. THIS NEW ESTABLISHMENT IS DISTINCT FROM THE FORMER PROVINCIAL ELITE WHICH TENDED TO PROFESS SECULAR VALUES, BUT LIKE I,ALTH. THIS YEAR, THE GENDARMERIE WERE NOWHERE TO BE FOUND WHEN THE TRIBES BEGAN THEIR TREK, AND THE FLOCKS GRAZED ALMOST AT WILL ON THE WHEAT CROP. - --THERE IS CONSIDERABLE CONFLICT WITHIN THE TRIBES THEMSELVES, PARTICULARLY WITHIN THE GHASHGHAIE TRIBE, AS A RESULT OF THE KHANS, OFTEN WITH THE SUPPORT OF THE ULEMA, TRYING TO REASSERT THE AUTHORITY THEY HAD LOST UNDER THE SHAH. 1979TEHRAN08828.subject: POLADS DISCUSSION AND SOVIET RELATIONS WITH IRAN

segments.text: (C-ENTIRE TEXT.)

THE MESSAGE REFERRED TO BY THE BELGIAN REP PRESUMABLY WAS THE ONE CARRIED BY IRANIAN AMBASSADOR TO MOSCOW MOHAMMAD MOKRI WHEN HE RECENTLY RETURNED TO THE USSR. THE TEXT READS AS FOLLOWS: IN HIS EXALTED NAME, JUNE 23, 1979, YOUR EXCELLENCY LEONID BREZHNEV, CHAIRMAN OF THE USSR SUPREME SOVIET PRESIDIUM. I THANK YOU FOR YOUR KIND MESSAGE AND THE KIND INTEREST YOU HAVE EXPRESSED TOWARDS THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN.

I PRAY TO ALMIGHTY GOD FOR THE PROSPERITY AND DELIIERANCE OF THE PEOPLE OF THE USSR, AND I HOPE THAT OUR ISLAMIC REPUBLIC, WHICH IS BASED ON THE UNITY OF EXPRESSION AND ON THE BASIS OF THE WORTHY ISLAMIC REVOLUTION AND THE ABOLUTION OF THE SATANIC REGIME, WILL PLAY A WORTHWHILE ROLE IN THE UNITY AND ALLIANCE OF THE NATIONS OF THE WORLD WILL TRY TO ACHIEVE PEACE AND PROSPERITY, AS IT IS THE WISH OF OUR NATION AND ISLAM. ROUHOLLAH MOUSAVI KHOMEINI. END .

WE FOUND THE FRG PAPER PRESENTED AT THE JULY 26 MEETING QUITE GOOD. WE, TOO, TEND TO SEE THE SOVIETS CAUGHT ON THE HORNS OF A DILEMMA IN IRAN. WE THINK THERE WERE SEVERAL POSSIBLE FACTORS THAT LED THEM TO CUT THEIR TIES WITH THE SHAH AND SEEK AN EQUALLY UNHOLY ALLIANCE WITH KHOMEINI AND HIS ISLAMIC MOVEMENT. THESE INCLUDE: - --THE LACK OF ALTERNATIVES. LAST WINTER KHOMEINI SEEMED TO HOLD ALL THE CARDS. THE PRO-MOSCOW TUDEH (COMMUNIST) PARTY WAS WEAK AND HAD BEEN LARGELY DISCREDITED IN IRAN ITSELF.

THERE WERE NO OTHER "PROGRESSIVE" POLITICAL GROUPINGS EITHER STRONG ENOUGH TO CHALLENGE KHOMEINI OR PREPARED TO WORK WITH THE SOVIETS AGAINST HIM. - --THE HOPE OF PROFITTING AT OUR EXPENSE. WE WERE CLEARLY THE NUMBER ONE FOREIGN ENEMY FOR THE ANTI-SHAH FORCES BY VIRTUE OF OUR SUPPORT FOR AND LONG ASSOCIATION WITH HIM. THE SOVIETS WERE SOMEWHAT VULNERABLE ON THAT SCORE AS WELL, BUT RELATIVELY MUCH LESS THAN WE. THE PROSPECT OF CONSIDERABLE DIMINUTION OF OUR INFLUENCE IN IRAN COULD NOT BUT BE WELCOMED BY THE SOVIETS, EVEN IF THEIR OWN PROSPECTS FOR GAINING INFLUENCE WERE PROBLEMATIC. - --THE FEAR OF INSTABILITY ON THE USSR'S SOUTHERN FLANK.

FROM OUR PROSPECTIVE IT APPEARS THAT, WHILE ALWAYS ALERT TO TAKE ADVANTAGE OF TURMOIL, MOSCOW DOES NOT SEEK TURMOIL FOR TURMOIL'S SAKE. WITH THE DEPARTURE OF THE SHAH, KHOMEINI'S ISLAMIC MOVEMENT SEEMED TO OFFER THE ONLY POSSIBILITY OF A RAPID REIMPOSITION OF STRONG CENTRAL AUTHORITY. - --THE DESIRE TO PROTECT ITS ECONOMIC STAKE IN IRAN. WHILE NOT LARGE BY COMPARISON WITH SOME OF THE WESTERN INDUSTRIALIZED NATIONS, THE USSR HAD DONE A GROWING VOLUME OF BUSINESS WITH IRAN IN RECENT YEARS.

GAS PROVIDED THROUGH IGAT-I, THE SUBSTANTIAL SHARE OF CONSTRUCTION OF IGAT-II RESERVED FOR THE SOVIETS, AND THE PROFITS THEY STOOD TO MAKE FROM TRILATERAL TRADE IN GAS THROUGH IT WERE OF PARTICULAR IMPORTANCE TO MOSCOW.

THERE STILL IS NO IMMEDIATE ALTERNATIVE TO KHOMEINI, A FACT WE ARE INCLINED TO VIEW AS THE MAIN REASON THE SOVIETS HAVE NOT YET REJECTED HIM AND HIS MOVEMENT. THERE ARE, HOWEVER, AMPLE REASONS WHY THEY MIGHT AT LEAST CONSIDER TURNING AGAINST HIM. FOR EXAMPLE, WHILE THE NEW AUTHORITIES IN IRAN HAVE DEALT WITH US AND THE SOVIETS IN A MORE EVEN-HANDED MANNER THAN WAS TRUE UNDER THE SHAH, THE SOVIETS PROBABLY FIND RELATIVELY LITTLE CONSOLATION IN THAT SINCE BOTH PARTIES ARE FREQUENTLY SINGLED OUT FOR CRITICISM BY THE ISLAMIC CROWD.

MOREOVER, THE REALITIES OF IRAN'S SITUATION ARE BEGINNING TO HAVE AN EFFECT ON AT LEAST THE PGOI'S PERCEPTION OF WHERE ITS INTERESTS LIE AND THIS PERCEPTION DOES NOT GENERALLY FAVOR THE SOVIET POSITION IN IRAN. A CASE IN POINT IS THE CONTINUING UNREST IN KURDESTAN WHERE THE POSSIBILITY OF ETHNIC INSURGENCY HAS BROUGHT HOME THE NEED FOR A MILITARY CAPABILITY TO DEAL WITH IT. THIS IN TURN HAS SPARKED INTEREST IN RENEWING A MILITARY SUPPLY RELATION------------------117792 080426Z /15 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO USMISSION USNATO INFO SECSTATE WASHDC 3104 AMEMBASSY BRUSSELS AMEMBASSY BONN AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY PARIS SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 08828 SHIP WITH THE U.S.

FURTHER, SIX MONTHS AFTER THE REVOLUTION, THE POLITICAL SITUATION IN IRAN REMAINS IN A STATE OF FLUX. THE PGOI HAS NOT BEEN ABLE TO ASSERT ITS PRIMACY IN MATTERS OF GOVERNMENTAL ADMINISTRATION AND THE INFORMAL GOVERNMENT STRUCTURE, THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES AND THEIR ADJUNCTS, WHICH OFTEN EXERCISE REAL POLITICAL POWER, SEEMS INCAPABLE IN TECHNICAL TERMS OF ADMINISTERING IRAN'S AFFAIRS ON A NATIONAL BASIS. THE SOVIETS MUST VIEW THE UNCERTAIN PROSPECTS FOR STABILITY IN IRAN, PARTICULARLY WHEN INSTABILITY HERE THREATENS SOVIET INTERESTS IN SUCH PLACES AS AFGHANISTAN, WITH SOME CONCERN.

FINALLY, THE SOVIETS HAVE FARED NO BETTER THAN ANYONE ELSE IN DOING BUSINESS IN POST-REVOLUTIONARY IRAN. GAS SHIPMENTS THROUGH IGAT-I STILL HAVE NOT ATTAINED THE LEVEL OF VOLUME WHICH PERTAINED PRIOR TO THE REVOLUTION. MOREOVER, THE IRANIANS HAVE ASKED THAT THE PRICE THE SOVIETS SAY FOR THE GAS THEY ARE GETTING BE RENEGOTIATED UPWARDS, AND THEY APPARENTLY INTEND NOT TO BUILD IGAT-II AT ALL.

WE AGREE WITH THE FRG PAPER THAT "KHOMEINI WILL BE OFFICIALLY DROPPED BY THE SOVIET UNION WHEN THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTION BEGINS TO THREATEN VITAL SOVIET INTERESTS." HOWEVER, THAT DEMARCATION IS NOT A FINE LINE EASILY DISTINGUISHED. WE SENSE THAT THE SOVIETS MAY HAVE BEGUN THE PROCESS OF RE-EXAMINING THEIR POLICY TOWARDS KHOMEINI, BUT AS YET HAVE NOT BEEN ABLE TO DETERMINE THAT IT IS TIME TO CHANGE COURSE. THE RESULT IS A CERTAIN AMBIVALENCE TOWARD IRAN AND THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTION THAT MAY PERSIST SO LONG AS THE SITUATION HERE REMAINS AS MUDDLED AS IT HAS FOR THE LAST SEVERAL MONTHS. LAINGEN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

DURING THE PAST WEEK POLCOUNS HAS SPOKEN WITH THREE DIFFERENT PEOPLE, ALL OF WHOM WERE IN POSITIONS TO BE WELL-INFORMED ABOUT AGRICULTURAL PATTERNS, WHO TOLD HIM THAT OPIUM PRODUCTION IN KHORRASAN, FARS AND KURDESTAN PROVINCES WAS UP SUBSTANTIALLY THIS YEAR. THERE APPEAR TO BE TWO PRIMARY REASONS FOR THIS PHENOMENON: FIRST, THE BREAKDOWN IN SECURITY AND THE DISSINTEGRATION OF LAW ENFORCEMENT AGENICES PERMITTED FARMERS TO GROW WHATEVER THEY WANTED, INCLUDING OPIUM. AND SECOND, THE IMPOSITION OF BANS ON MOST FORMS OF DIVERSION, INCLUDING THE CONSUMPTION OF ALCOHOL, HAS LED TO A SHARP INCREASE IN DEMAND FOR OPIUM.

SMOKING HAS LONG BEEN A POPULAR PASSTIME AMONG IRANIANS ADVANCING IN YEARS AND THE LOCAL JET SET, BUT ADDICTION SEEMS TO BE SPREADING RAPIDLY IN OTHER CLASSES OF SOCIETY AS WELL. USE AMONG IRANIAN YOUTH, IN PARTICULAR, APPEARS TO BE ON THE RISE.

1979TEHRAN08832.subject: RELEASE FROM PRISON OF USICA EMPLOYEE REZA AMINI

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: USICA EMPLOYEE, FINALLY RELEASED AFTER FOUR MONTHS IN PRISON, GIVES INSIGHTS INTO WHY HE WAS IMPRISONED, THE WORKING OF THE POWER STRUCTURE, AND THE IRANIAN MENTALITY. ALSO SUGGESTS PROGRAM INITIATIVES AND CONFIRMS THE USEFULNESS OF THE IAS LIBRARY AND ENGLISH LANGUAGE COURSES. END SUMMARY.

DR. REZA AMINI WAS RELEASED FROM EVIN PRISON AUGUST 1, COMPLETELY FREE (MAN'E TA'GIB) WITHOUT POSTING THE THREATENED BAIL OF 5 MILLION RIALS. HE APPEARED WEAK AND DRAWN BUT NOT BITTER ABOUT HIS FOUR-MONTH DETENTION. HE IS ANXIOUS TO BE PRODUCTIVE AND WANTS TO RETURN TO WORK BUT IS CONCERNED ABOUT HIS ABILITY TO BE EFFECTIVE BECAUSE OF THE PRESENT PARALLEL POWER STRUCTURE IN IRAN. HE RECEIVED CONGRATULATORY CALLS FROM MINISTER OF NATIONAL GUIDANCE MINACHI AND MEMBERS OF IRAN'S DIPLOMATIC SERVICE. HE IS THEREFORE CONFIDENT THAT HE CAN AT LEAST WORK WITH GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS AGAIN.

BEFORE FEELING HIS WAY BACK INTO THE BUREAUCRACY, HOWEVER, HE WOULD LIKE TO TAKE A VACATION IN SPAIN WITH HIS WIFE AND THEN GO ON TO THE U.S. TO VISIT HIS DAUGHTER AND RENEW HIS GREEN CARD, PROVIDING AUTHORITIES RETURN HIS CONFISCATED PASSPORT AND CARD. AT THE OUTSET, HE DOES NOT WANT TO WORK OUT OF THE EMBASSY BECAUSE OF THE SECURITY GUARDS ON THE COMPOUND. HE WAS, HOWEVER, DELIGHTED WHEN IT WAS SUGGESTED THAT HE COULD USE AN OFFICE IN THE IAS LIBRARY.

THE IMMEDIATE CAUSE OF DR. AMINI'S ARREST, ACCORDING TO PRISON AUTHORITIES, WAS A NO-RUZ MEETING OF DR. AMINI AND SEVERAL CLOSE FRIENDS WITH AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN. (THE AMBASSADOR DID NOT IN FACT ATTEND THE GATHERING AT DR. AMINI'S HOUSE.) HE SPENT THE FIRST NIGHT ON THE FLOOR OF A CELL WITH 18 OTHER PRISONERS, INCLUDING FORMER UNDER SECRETARIES AND MILITARY OFFICERS. THE NEXT MORNING, DR. AMINI MET MUHAMMAD REZA AMELI TEHRANI, MINISTER OF INFORMATION UNDER BAKHTIAR (LATER EXECUTED) WHO WAS ASTOUNDED TO SEE AMINI BUT CONFIDENT ALL WOULD BE STRAIGHTENED OUT. AMINI, WHO WAS REFERRED TO AS "MR. SPY FROM THE U.S.

EMBASSY" THROUGHOUT HIS STAY IN PRISON, WAS INTERROGATED BY A MULLAH WHO ACCUSED HIM OF WORKING WITH THE CIA AND PRODUCED A PHOTO OF HELMS AS PROOF. DR. AMINI EXPLAINED HIS DUTIES AT ICA, DEBATED WITH HIS INTERROGATORS ON THE ROLE OF THE U.S. IN IRANIAN HISTORY, AND WAS FINALLY TOLD THAT HE WAS CHARGED WITH "ACTIVITIES RELATED TO YOUR WORK" AND THAT "IMPRISONMENT IS YOUR CONTRIBUTION TO HELPING THE REVOLUTION ESTABLISH ITS ROOTS" (BY REDUCING ICA EFFECTIVENESS). EVERY MONDAY, DR. AMINI SAW HIS WIFE WHO WAS BETTER ABLE TO HELP HIM ONCE SHE DONNED A CHADOR. HE WAS ABLE TO KEEP SOMEWHAT ABREAST OF EVENTS BY READING "KAYHAN."

DR. AMINI'S EXPERIENCES IN PRISON SUGGEST CONSIDERABLE INCOMPETENCE AMONG THOSE IN CONTROL WHO APPARENTLY DID NOT HAVE ENOUGH MANAGEMENT SKILL TO PROVIDE HABITABLE QUARTERS OR ADEQUATE SANITARY FACILITIES EVEN THOUGH THE FACILITY AT EVIN WAS BRAND NEW. THE PLUMBING, FOR EXAMPLE, WAS SO BAD THAT DR. AMINI DID NOT EAT FOR DAYS IN ORDER TO AVOID HAVING TO RELIEVE HIMSELF. HIS CELLMATE AT EVIN, A FILE CLERK FROM PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN'S OFFICE,SHOWED AMINI A COPY OF A THREE-MONTH OLD LETTER FROM BAZARGAN HIMSELF REQUESTING THE RELEASE OF HIS MUCH-NEEDED CLERK.

IT WAS, HOWEVER, ONLY AFTER BAZARGAN'S RECENT MEETING WITH KHOMEINI WHICH RESULTED IN SOME INTEGRATION OF THE GOVERNMENT AND THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL THAT THE FILE CLERK WAS IN FACT RELEASED. A SCHEME COOKED UP BY AMINI'S CELLMATES JUST BEFORE HIS RELEASE SUGGESTS THE PERSIAN PENCHANT FOR BYZANTINE PLOTS AND THE PERSIAN CONVICTION THAT OTHER COUNTRIES GREATLY INFLUENCE THE DOMESTIC AFFAIRS OF IRAN. A COPY OF "NEWSWEEK" FEATURING THE "JOYLESS REVOLUTION" (APPARENTLY SMUGGLED INTO THE PRISON) TRIGGERED THE SCHEME: AMINI'S CELLMATES INTERPRETED THE ARTICLE AS AN INDICATION THAT THE U.S. WOULD INTERVENE. THEY WANTED AMINI, ONCE HE WAS RELEASED, TO SEND THEM A CODE LETTER ESTIMATING THE PROSPECTS FOR A COUP.

THE LETTER WOULD COMMENT ON THE HEALTH OF A FRIEND (IRAN) AND WHETHER OR NOT HE WOULD UNDERGO AN OPERATION (COUP INSTIGATED BY THE U.S.). AMINI'S CELLMATES WOULD THEN BE IN A POSITION TO DECIDE WHETHER TO WAIT IN PRISON FOR THE COUP OR BRIBE OFFICIALS TO OBTAIN THEIR RELEASE.

I CALLED ON COMMERCE MINISTER REZA SADR ON AUGUST 6. MY PURPOSE WAS TO INTRODUCE MYSELF AND E/C COUNSELOR SENS AND MAKE SOME SPECIFIC POINTS REGARDING A BASIS FOR THE U.S.-IRANIAN ECONOMIC RELATIONSHIP IN THE FUTURE. I WANTED PARTICULARLY TO BRING TO REZA SADR'S ATTENTION SOME OF THE PLUSES AND MINUSES THE RELATIONSHIP NOW FACES.

TO THIS END, I EXPLAINED THAT THE U.S. WAS EAGER TO WORK WITH THE NEW GOVERNMENT--AS I HAD EMPHASIZED REPEATEDLY TO OTHERS IN THE CABINET--AND I SAID THAT IF OUR EFFORTS ARE TO PROSPER WE MUST ESTABLISH A FOUNDATION OF MUTUAL RESPECT AND WE MUST COMMUNICATE OUR PROBLEMS AND CONCERNS FRANKLY. I POINTED OUT THAT WE HAVE WORKED TO KEEP THE TRUST FUND SOLVENT, HAVE EXPRESSED A WILLINGNESS TO SUPPLY NEEDED SPARE PARTS, AND ARE TRYING TO PROVIDE ESSENTIAL VISA SERVICES. I STRESSED THAT THE USG WAS COMPLETELY SINCERE IN ITS DESIRE TO UNDERSTAND THE OBJECTIVES OF THE NEW REGIME. I ALSO STRESSED THAT WHILE U.S.
BUSINESSMEN WERE WILLING TO ADJUST TO THE RULES UNDER THE NEW REGIME, THEY COULD ONLY DO SO IF THE RULES ARE MADE CLEAR.

I THEN RAISED THE CASES OF SHERRY AND SHEIBANI AS EXAMPLES OF PROBLEMS THAT CAUSED DIFFICULTIES FOR BOTH COUNTRIES AND WHERE OPEN COMMUNICATION MIGHT HELP. I NOTED THAT WHILE WE WERE DELIGHTED THAT JAMES SHERRY WAS OUT OF JAIL, THE FACT THAT HE STILL COULD NOT LEAVE THE COUNTRY MADE PEOPLE IN AMERICA SKEPTICAL ABOUT THE EXTENT TO WHICH A U.S. CITIZEN COULD EXPECT TO RECEIVE "DUE PROCESS" IN IRAN. THE SHEIBANI CASE--ADMITTEDLY COMPLICATED BY HIS DUAL NATIONALITY--ALSO NOT CHARGED BUT YET IN PRISON, WAS ANOTHER IRRITANT THAT ADVERSELY AFFECTED THE ATMOSPHERE IN WHICH AMERICAN BUSINESS JUDGED THE OUTLOOK IN IRAN.

REZA SADR RESPONDED BY SAYING HE WAS QUITE FAMILIAR WITH THE U.S., HAVING BEEN MANAGING DIRECTOR OF AN EXPORT FIRM IN SCARSDALE FOR TWENTY YEARS BEFORE RETURNING TO IRAN AND HIS PRESENT JOB. HE COMMENTED THAT THE U.S., IN HIS OPINION, HAD TO BEAR THE BLAME FOR MUCH OF WHAT HAS HAPPENED IN IRAN IN THE LAST YEAR AND A HALF, NOTING THAT EACH TIME THERE HAD OCCURRED A MAJOR CONFRONTATION ONE OR ANOTHER U.S. POLICYMAKER WOULD ANNOUNCE AMERICA'S FIRM SUPPORT FOR THE SHAH.

HE THEN WENT ON THAT EVEN TODAY THE "ZIONIST-DOMINATED AMERICAN PRESS" PREJUDICES PUBLIC OPINION AGAINST THE REVOLUTION AND EXPRESSED CONSIDERABLE IRRITATION WITH THE RECENT NEWSWEEK ARTICLE ON IRAN. (THIS MAY HAVE PARTLY BEEN CAUSED BY THE FACT THAT AN INTERVIEW HE GAVE TIME DID NOT SURVIVE EDITING.) THERE ENSUED A CONSIDERABLE DISCUSSION OF THE ALLEGED ZIONIST INFLUENCE IN THE U.S., WHICH--AS IS THE CASE WITH MANY IRANIANS THESE DAYS--MADE NO PROGRESS IN CONVINCING THE MINISTER TO TLI CONTRARY.

SUMMARY: KHUZESTAN PROVINCE QUIET, BUT MARIVAN CONTINUES TO SIMMER. LOCAL KURDS THAT THE PGOI HAS RENEGED ON AN AGREEMENT TO LET THEM HANDLE SECURITY THEMSELVES, AND THE ARMY HAS MOVED IN. PGOI ANNOUNCES FORMATION OF A NEW INTELLIGENCE AGENCY (SAVAMA) TO REPLACE, BUT NOT RESEMBLE SAVAK, SINCE IT WILL NOT HAVE A "TORTURE" WING. GIVEN THE PERSIAN PREDILECTION TOWARDS PHYSICAL INTERROGATION METHODS, THE CHANCES ARE GOOD THAT SAVAMA WILL SOON BE SEEN AS A TRUE SON OF SAVAK. STRIKES AND DEMONSTRATIONS OCCUR IN VARIOUS CITIES; AND COMMITTEE/REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS ARE STILL HEAVILY INVOLVED IN HANDLING THESE INCIDENTS.
WITH POLICE AND MILITARY FORCES STILL WEAK, IT SEEMS PROBABLE THAT THE PARAMILITARY COMMITTEE AND REVOLUTIONARY GUARD UNITS WILL BE AROUND FOR THE FORESEEABLE FUTURE. END SUMMARY.

BOTH KHUZESTAN AND ETHNIC KURDISH AREAS OF KORDESTAN AND WEST AZARBAIJAN WERE QUIETER, OR AT LEAST LESS IN THE NEWS, DURING ELECTION WEEK. IN KHUZESTAN THE CALM MAY BE PARTIALLY A RESULT OF RECENT ARRESTS THERE. THIRTEEN SABOTEURS WERE ARRESTED IN KHORRAMSHAHR ON 31 JULY BECAUSE OF THEIR ALLEGED INVOLVEMENT WITH A FIRE THAT GUTTED A GENDARMERIE POST IN THE IRAN-IRAQ BORDER AREA. ATTEMPTS ARE BEING MADE TO COLLECT ILLEGAL WEAPONS IN THE AREA, AND THE PUBLIC HAS ONCE AGAIN BEEN ASKED TO SURRENDER SUCH ARMS TO LOCAL GENDARMERIE POSTS.

TALKS CONTINUED DURING THE WEEK IN AN ATTEMPT TO DEFUSE THE MARIVAN CRISIS, AND DR. MUSTAFA CHAMRAN FREQUENTLY REFERRED TO IN RECENT PRESS REPORTS AS DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER AND BRIGADIER GEN. IZADI VISITED THE AREA TO PARTICIPATE IN THE DISCUSSIONS. AN ACCORD WAS FINALLY SIGNED ON 1 AUGUST. ACCORDING TO THE AGREEMENT, THE REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS SENT TO THE CITY WERE TO GRADUALLY RETURN TO THEIR OWN HEADQUARTERS, AND A LOCAL COUNCIL WOULD BE RESPONSIBLE FOR PEACE AND ORDER IN THE CITY. DESPITE THE SIGNING, HOWEVER, CLASHES NEAR MARIVAN BETWEEN REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS AND LOCAL INHABITANTS WERE REPORTED ON 3 AUGUST.

THE PROVISIONAL REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL OF MARIVAN THEN ACCUSED THE PGOI OF BREAKING THE AGREEMENT BY RINGING THE CITY WITH ARTILLERY AND INSTALLING A MILITARY GOVERNMENT IN MARIVAN. A VIABLE MARIVAN-PGOI ACCORD STILL SEEMS TO BE SOME DISTANCE AWAY, AND CONTINUED CLASHES BETWEEN LOCAL KURDISH INHABITANTS AND TEHRAN/QOM SUPPORTED SECURITY FORCES ARE LIKELY.

PRESS REPORTS CLAIM THAT A NEWLY FORMED IRANIAN INTELLIGENCE GATHERING AGENCY HAS ALREADY STARTED FUNCTIONING BOTH INSIDE AND OUTSIDE THE COUNTRY. OFFICIALLY NAMED THE "IRANIAN NATIONAL INFORMATION AND SECURITY ORGANIZATION" OR SAVAMA (SAZEMAN-E-ETTELAAT VA AMNIYAT-E-MELLI-YE-IRAN) THE NEW ORGANIZATION WILL OPERATE THROUGH THE PRIME MINISTER'S OFFICE UNDER THE DIRECTION OF MUSTAFA CHAMRAN. ACCORDING TO GOVERNMENT SPOKESMAN SADEGH TABATABAIE, THE NEW AGENCY'S PURPOSE IS PURELY INVESTIGATION AND INTELLIGENCE GATHERING, AND IT WILL NOT RESEMBLE THE OLD SAVAK. IN POPULAR JOKES AT LEAST, THE CREATION OF THE NEW ORGANIZATION HAS LONG BEEN ANTICIPATED.

FOR SOME MONTHS NOW IRANIANS HAVE BEEN REFERRING TO SAVAKH, OR THE KHOMEINI INTELLIGENCE AND SECURITY ORGANIZATION (SAZEMAN-E-ETTELAAT VA AMNIYAT-EKHOMEINI) AS HAVING TAKEN SAVAK'S PLACE. WHILE THE PGOI SPOKESMAN HAS CLAIMED THAT SAVAMA WILL NOT HAVE A "TORTURE" BRANCH, IT SEEMS UNLIKELY THAT THE NEW ORGANIZATION WILL RETAIN ITS PROFESSED PURITY AND INNOCENCE FOR ANY LENGTH OF TIME. PERSIAN SECURITY OFFICIALS HAVE TOO LONG A HISTORY OF RELYING ON PHYSICAL METHODS TO EXTRACT INFORMATION, AND ALMOST IMMEDIATELY AFTER THE REVOLUTION, IT WAS OBVIOUS THAT BEATINGS WERE AS COMMON IN THE NEW SECURITY ORDER AS THEY HAD BEEN IN THE OLD.

WHILE LARGE SCALE CLASHS WERE DOWN SOMEWHAT DURING THE PAST WEEK, A NUMBER OF DEMONSTRATIONS, STRIKES AND SECURITY INCIDENTS CONTINUED TO OCCUR. IN QAHRAMANSHAHR (FORMERLY KERMANSHAH) THREE BOOKSTORES WERE BURNED RECENTLY. IN MAHRAN (ILAM PROVINCE) A GERNADE EXPLODED IN THE OFFICE OF THE LOCAL GOVERNOR. IN GANAVEH (NEAR BUSHEHR) CUSTOMS EMPLOYEES WENT ON A ONE-DAY STRIKE TO PROTEST THEIR LACK OF PERSONAL SECURITY AND THE PUBLIC INATTENTION TO CUSTOMS REGULATIONS. THE STRIKE OF THE CIVIL AVIATION DEPARTMENT'S TELECOMMUNICATIONS SECTION ENTERED IT'S SECOND WEEK, CAUSING SOME DISRUPTION AND DELAYS IN BOTH DOMESTIC AND INTERNATIONAL FLIGHTS.

ZANJAN SAW A GATHERING OF "THOUSANDS OF PEOPLE" WHO DEMANDED THE RELEASE OF PERSONS IMPRISONED ON THE ORDERS OF THE PROSECUTOR OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS. THE PROTESTORS ALSO ASKED FOR THE RESIGNATION OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COURT PROSECUTOR, THE DISSOLUTION OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COURT, AND THE SETTING UP OF A NEW COURT. OTHER DEMONSTRATIONS INCLUDED A STREET PROCESSION BY UNEMPLOYED HIGH SCHOOL GRADUATES, WHO GATHERED IN FRONT OF THE GOVERNOR-GENERAL'S OFFICE IN AHVAZ TO DEMAND JOBS.

IN GENERAL, BREACHES OF PUBLIC ORDER AND SECURITY INCIDENTS SUCH AS THESE CONTINUE TO BE HANDLED BY REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS. POLOFF WAS INFORMED BY A TEHRAN POLICE COLONEL THAT REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS WILL PLAY A VITAL ROLE FOR THE NEAR FUTURE IN NORMAL POLICE WORK, IF ONLY BECAUSE THERE ARE INSUFFICIENT POLICE IN TEHRAN TO HANDLE DAY-TO-DAY PROBLEMS. IN EARLY POST-REVOLUTION DAYS, 6,800 LOWER RANKING CITY POLICEMEN WERE TRANSFERRED TO PROVINCIAL CITIES AT THEIR OWN REQUEST, AND THEIR PLACES CANNOT BE FILLED BY OTHER POLICE. THE SOURCE CLAIMED THAT FOR THIS REASON THE COMMITTEES AND REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS DOING POLICE-TYPE WORK WOULD BE STAYING AT THE PRECINCT HOUSES FOR SOME TIME YET.

IN ANOTHER CONVERSATION AN ARMY OFFICER ASSIGNED TO TEHRAN SUPPORTED THE POLICE SOURCE'S CONCLUSION WHEN HE SAID THAT NEITHER HE NOR HIS MEN WOULD OPEN FIRE AT DEMONSTRATORS INVOLVED IN BREACHES OF PUBLIC ORDER UNLESS IT WERE A MATTER OF ABSOLUTE SELF DEFENSE. THE ONLY GROUP CAPABLE OR WILLING TO DO SO ARE THE REVOLUTIONARY GUARD AND COMMITTEE UNITS, WHO HAVE ALREADY DEMONSTRATED THEIR LACK OF QUALMS IN VARIOUS PARTS OF THE COUNTRY.

GIVEN A POLICE FORCE AND ARMY UNITS WHICH ARE STILL DISHEARTENED, AND WHOSE MEMBERS ARE STILL BEING PUNISHED FOR ATTEMPTS TO MAINTAIN ORDER IN PRE-REVOLUTIONARY DAYS, THE PGOI WILL PROBABLY BE FORCED FOR SOMETIME TO COME TO RELY ON THE PARA-MILITARY REVOLUTIONARY GUARD FORCES TO CARRY OUT DISCIPLINARY ORDERS. LAINGEN

SUMMARY: IRANIAN JEWS ARE NOT THE ONLY RELIGIOUS MINORITY WITH MISGIVINGS ABOUT THE IMPLICATIONS OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC FOR THEM. THE BAHAI COMMUNITY HAS SUFFERED CONFISCATIONS AND INDIVIDUAL MEMBERS HAVE EXPERIENCED FORMS OF DISCRIMINATION. THE BAHAI LEADERSHIP, HOWEVER, HAS NOT PANICKED, AND IS DIRECTING A CAREFULLY ORCHESTRATED CAMPAIGN TO AROUSE IRANIAN PUBLIC OPINION AND INTERNATIONAL PRESSURES ON BEHALF OF THE COMMUNITY. AT LEAST ONE PORTION OF THE CHRISTIAN COMMUNITY, TOO, HAS ENCOUNTERED DIFFICULTIES WITH THE ISLAMIC AUTHORITIES, BUT THE EPISCOPAL BISHOP, UNLIKE THE BAHAI LEADERSHIP, SEEMS PREPARED TO ENGAGE IN CONFRONTATION. END SUMMARY.

WE HAVE CONTINUED TO HEAR OF CASES OF DISCRIMINATION AGAINST INDIVIDUAL MEMBERS OF THE IRANIAN BAHAI COMMUNITY, INCLUDING FIRINGS FROM GOVERNMENT POSITIONS AND REFUSAL TO ENROLL BAHAI STUDENTS IN PUBLIC SCHOOL CLASSES. IN VIRTUALLY EVERY INSTANCE, THE REASON GIVEN FOR THE ACTION TAKEN IS NOT LINVD#TO THE INDIVIDUAL BEING BAHAI, BUT IT SEEMS CLEAR NONETHELESS THAT THAT IS THE UNDERLYING MOTIVATION. WE HAVE HEARD LITTLE RECENTLY OF CONFISCATION OF ADDITIONAL BAHAI PROPERTIES, BUT NEITHER DOES IT APPEAR THAT THOSE CONFISCATED EARLIER WILL BE RETURNED TO THE COMMUNITY, AT LEAST IN THE SHORT TERM.

REV. ROBERT PRYOR, WHO WAS DISPATCHED TO SWITZERLAND IN JULY BY THE BAHAI COMMUNITY TO PLEAD ITS CASE, RECENTLY TOLD POLCOUNS THAT HE HAD DISCOVERED WHILE HE WAS THERE THAT THE INTERNATIONAL BAHAI COMMUNITY HAD ALREADY MOUNTED AN EXTENSIVE LETTER-WRITING AND TELEGRAM CAMPAIGN ON BEHALF OF THEIR CO-RELIGIONISTS IN IRAN. HE SAID THAT BAHAI REPRESENTATIVES HE HAD MET WITH IN ZURICH HAD SHOWN HIM AN IMPRESSIVE FILE ON WHAT HAD BEEN DONE TO DATE. HE SUSPECTED THAT THIS MAY HAVE HAD SOME EFFECT, SINCE, UPON HIS RETURN TO IRAN, HIS BAHAI CONTACTS HAD SEEMED MUCH LESS ANXIOUS THAN THEY DID BEFORE HE LEFT.

WE HAD BEEN AWARE FROM OUR OWN CONTACTS IN THE BAHAI COMMUNITY THAT THE LOCAL LEADERSHIP WAS SENDING TELEGRAMS TO VARIOUS PGOI AND RELIGIOUS LEADERS TO ENLIST THEIR HELP IN PUTTING A STOP TO DISCRIMINATORY ACTS AGAINST BAHAIS. AFTER PRYOR'S DEPARTURE FOR SWITZERLAND IN JULY THE LEADERSHIP WENT ONE STEP FURTHER, ISSUING A COMMUNIQUE TO PUBLICIZE LOCALLY THE PLIGHT OF THE BAHAI COMMUNITY. IT IS DIFFICULT TO GAGE HOW MUCH (IF ANY) EFFECT THESE EFFORTS HAVE HAD TO DATE, BUT THE BAHAIS SEEM TO BE TAKING A LONG TERM VIEW OF THEIR SITUATION IN IRAN.

THE IRANIAN EPISCOPAL CHURCH, LED BY BISHOP DEHGHANTAFTI OF ISFAHAN, APPEARS TO BE INCLINED TO TAKE CONSIDERABLE RISKS IN ITS EFFORTS TO RESIST DISCRIMINATORY ACTIONS AGAINST IT. TROUBLE BEGAN ABOUT TWO MONTHS AGO IN ISFAHAN AT THE CHURCH HOSPITAL WHEN MUSLIM STAFF MEMBERS, AIDED AND ABETTED BY LOCAL REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE MEMBERS, THE GOVERNOR GENERAL'S OFFICE AND THE TGOI BUREAUCRACY, AND THE ISFAHAN MEDICAL COMMUNITY NOT AFFILIATED WITH THE CHRISTIAN HOSPITAL, CHARGED SEVERAL BRITISH STAFF MEMBERS WITH PROSELYTIZING. THE MUSLIMS FIRST TOOK OVER MANAGEMENT OF THE HOSPITAL, SUBSEQUENTLY SUCCEEDED IN FREEZING THE HOSPITAL'S BANK ACCOUNTS, AND MORE RECENTLY STILL ACTUALLY GOT CONTROL OVER AND BEGAN DISPERSING THE FUNDS IN THESE ACCOUNTS.
THE EIGHT BRITISH MISSIONARIES INVOLVED IN THE PROSELYTIZING CONTROVERSY HAVE DEPARTED IRAN.

HOSPITALS AFFILIATED WITH THE EPISCOPAL CHURCH IN SHIRAZ AND GORVEH (IN KURDESTAN) HAVE BEEN TAKEN OVER AS WELL, ALTHOUGH UNDER SOMEWHAT DIFFERENT CIRCUMSTANCES. WE REMAIN TO BE CONVINCED THAT THERE IS ANY COMMON POLICY UNDERLYING THESE TAKEOVERS. INDEED, IN ISFAHAN THE UNDERLYING MOTIVATION APPEARS TO BE AS MUCH ECONOMIC AS RELIGIOUS. THE CHRISTIAN HOSPITAL HAD A POLICY OF CHARGING ONLY WHAT THE PATIENT COULD AFFORD. NEEDLESS TO SAY, IT WAS POPULAR WITH RICH AND POOR ALIKE, AND MANY PRIVATE PRACTITIONERS RESENTED WHAT THEY REGARDED AS BUSINESS BEING TAKEN FROM THEM BY THE PRICING PRACTICES OF THE HOSPITAL.

DEHGHAN-TAFTI HAS FOUGHT BACK. HE HAS ALSO ATTEMPTED TO BRING PRESSURE TO BEAR ON SENIOR FIGURES IN THE PGOI AND THE RELIGIOUS MOVEMENT.

HE HAS SENT TELEGRAMS TO PM BAZARGAN, MINISTER OF JUSTICE JAVADI, MINISTER OF HEALTH SAMI, AND EVEN KHOMEINI COMPLAINING ABOUT THE "RANK INJUSTICE AND MERCILESS CONFISCATIONS." FINALLY, HE APPROACHED PRYOR TO GO TO SEVERAL EUROPEAN COUNTRIES, THE U.S., LEBANON AND ISRAEL TO ENLIST CHRISTIAN HELP IN MOUNTING A "MASSIVE" LETTER-WRITING AND TELEGRAM CAMPAIGN TO IRANIAN LEADERS ON BEHALF OF THE IRANIAN EPISCOPAL CHURCH.

PRYOR SAID THAT HE THINKS DEHGHAN-TAFTI MAY HAVE "MORE GUTS THAN HE HAS SENSE," AND THOUGHT THAT HE RUNS THE RISK OF RETALIATION FROM THE VARIOUS MUSLIM POWERBROKERS IN ISFAHAN HE HAS OFFENDED WITH HIS INTEMPERATE CHARGES. HOWEVER, PRYOR THOUGHT THAT HE MIGHT JUST BE ABLE TO GET AWAY WITH WHAT HE IS ATTEMPTING. BRITISH AMBASSADOR GRAHAM, WHO IS ALSO FAMILAR WITH THE CASE, AGREED WITH PRYOR'S ASSESSMENT OF THE BISHOP'S PROSPECTS.

PRYOR TOLD POLCOUNS THAT DURING HIS TALKS IN ZURICH AND GENEVA WITH SWISS AND WORLD COUNCIL OF CHURCHES HUMAN RIGHTS REPRESENTATIVES ON BEHALF OF THE BAHAIS HE WAS TOLD THAT PAST EXPERIENCE INDICATED THAT IN SITUATIONS OF PERSECUTION NOT INVOLVING PHYSICAL ABUSE QUICK LEGAL ACTION(EVEN IF THE JUDICIAL SYSTEM IS BIASED OR INEFFECTIVE) AND MOBILIZATION OF INTERNATIONAL PUBLIC OPINION OFFER THE BEST HOPE OF STOPPING SUCH PERSECUTION.

DEHGHAN-TAFTI'S OWN MOTIVATIONS IN ALL THIS ARE NOT ENTIRELY CLEAR. HE ESTIMATES THE VALUE OF CHURCH PROPERTIES AND MONIES CONFISCATED AT TWO BILLION RIALS. FURTHER, THERE IS REASON TO BELIEVE THAT THE CHURCH DOES NOT HAVE THE RESOURCES TO SUPPORT THE ISFAHAN HOSPITAL, WHICH WAS COMPLETED ABOUT A YEAR AGO, IF IT WERE ACTUALLY ABLE TO GET IT BACK. CONSEQUENTLY, DEHGHAN-TAFTI MIGHT WELL PREFER COMPENSATION TO RETURN OF WHAT HAS BEEN CONFISCATED WHICH IN TURN SUGGESTS THAT HE MAY BE PLAYING THE RELIGIOUS PERSECUTION ANGLE FOR ESSENTIALLY ECONOMIC
