INTRODUCTION: RECENT NEGOTIATIONS IN WHICH THE EMBASSY HAS BEEN INVOLVED HERE, RANGING FROM COMPOUND SECURITY TO VISA OPERATIONS TO GTE TO THE SHERRY CASE, HIGHLIGHT SEVERAL SPECIAL FEATURES OF CONDUCTING BUSINESS IN THE PERSIAN ENVIRONMENT. IN SOME INSTANCES THE DIFFICULTIES WE HAVE ENCOUNTERED ARE A PARTIAL REFLECTION ON THE EFFECTS OF THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION, BUT WE BELIEVE THE UNDERLYING CULTURAL AND PSYCHOLOGICAL QUALITIES THAT ACCOUNT FOR THE NATURE OF THESE DIFFICULTIES ARE AND WILL REMAIN RELATIVELY CONSTANT. THEREFORE, WE SUGGEST THAT THE FOLLOWING ANALYSIS BE USED TO BRIEF BOTH USG PERSONNEL AND PRIVATE SECTOR REPRESENTATIVES WHO ARE REQUIRED TO DO BUSINESS WITH AND IN THIS COUNTRY. END INTRODUCTION.

PERHAPS THE SINGLE DOMINANT ASPECT OF THE PERSIAN PSYCHE IS AN OVERRIDING EGOISM. ITS ANTECEDENTS LIE IN THE LONG IRANIAN HISTORY OF INSTABILITY AND INSECURITY WHICH PUT A PREMIUM ON SELF-PRESERVATION. THE PRACTICAL EFFECT OF IT IS AN ALMOST TOTAL PERSIAN PREOCCUPATION WITH SELF AND LEAVES LITTLE ROOM FOR UNDERSTANDING POINTS OF VIEW OTHER THAN ONE'S OWN. THUS, FOR EXAMPLE, IT IS INCOMPREHENSIBLE TO AN IRANIAN THAT U.S. IMMIGRATION LAW MAY PROHIBIT ISSUING HIM A TOURIST VISA WHEN HE HAS DETERMINED THAT HE WANTS TO LIVE IN CALIFORNIA.

SIMILARLY, THE IRANIAN CENTRAL BANK SEES NO INCONSISTENCY IN CLAIMING FORCE MAJEURE TO AVOID PENALTIES FOR LATE PAYMENT OF INTEREST DUE ON OUTSTANDING LOANS WHILE THE GOVERNMENT OF WHICH IT IS A PART IS DENYING THE VAILIDITY OF THE VERY GROUNDS UPON WHICH THE CLAIM IS MADE WHEN CONFRONTED BY SIMILAR CLAIMS FROM FOREIGN FIRMS FORCED TO CEASE OPERATIONS DURING THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION.

THE REVERSE OF THIS PARTICULAR PSYCHOLOGICAL COIN, AND HAVING THE SAME HISTORICAL ROOTS AS PERSIAN EGOISM, IS A PERVASIVE UNEASE ABOUT THE NATURE OF THE WORLD IN WHICH ONE LIVES. THE PERSIAN EXPERIENCE HAS BEEN THAT NOTHING IS PERMANENT AND IT IS COMMONLY PERCEIVED THAT HOSTILE FORCES ABOUND. IN SUCH AN ENVIRONMENT EACH INDIVIDUAL MUST BE CONSTANTLY ALERT FOR OPPORTUNITIES TO PROTECT HIMSELF AGAINST THE MALEVOLENT FORCES THAT WOULD OTHERWISE BE HIS UNDOING. HE IS OBVIOUSLY JUSTIFIED IN USING ALMOST ANY MEANS AVAILABLE TO EXPLOIT SUCH OPPORTUNITIES.

THIS APPROACH UNDERLIES THE SOCALLED "BAZAAR MENTALITY" SO COMMON AMONG PERSIANS, A MIND-SET THAT OFTEN IGNORES LONGER TERM INTERESTS IN FAVOR OF IMMEDIATELY OBTAINABLE ADVANTAGES AND COUNTENANCES PRACTICES THAT ARE REGARDED AS UNETHICAL BY OTHER NORMS. AN EXAMPLE IS THE SEEMINGLY SHORTSIGHTED AND HARASSING TACTICS EMPLOYED BY THE PGOI IN ITS NEGOTIATIONS WITH GTE.

COUPLED WITH THESE PSYCHOLOGICAL LIMITATIONS IS A GENERAL INCOMPREHENSION OF CASUALITY. ISLAM, WITH ITS EMPHASIS ON THE OMNIPOTENCE OF GOD, APPEARS TO ACCOUNT AT LEAST IN MAJOR PART FOR THIS PHENOMENON. SOMEWHAT SURPRISINGLY, EVEN THOSE IRANIANS EDUCATED IN THE WESTERN STYLE AND PERHAPS WITH LONG EXPERIENCE OUTSIDE IRAN ITSELF FREQUENTLY HAVE DIFFICULTY GRASPING THE INTER-RELATIONSHIP OF EVENTS. WITNESS A YAZDI RESISTING THE IDEA THAT IRANIAN BEHAVIOR HAS CONSEQUENCES ON THE PERCEPTION OF IRAN IN THE U.S. OR THAT THIS PERCEPTION IS SOMEHOW RELATED TO AMERICAN POLICIES REGARDING IRAN. THIS SAME QUALITY ALSO HELPS EXPLAIN PERSIAN AVERSION TO ACCEPTING RESPONSIBILITY FOR ONE'S OWN ACTIONS.
THE DEUS EX MACHINA IS ALWAYS AT WORK.

THE PERSIAN PROCLIVITY FOR ASSUMING THAT TO SAY SOMETHING IS TO DO IT FURTHER COMPLICATES MATTERS. AGAIN, YAZDI CAN EXPRESS SURPRISE WHEN INFORMED THAT THE IRREGULAR SECURITY FORCES ASSIGNED TO THE EMBASSY REMAIN IN PLACE. "BUT THE CENTRAL COMMITTEE TOLD ME THEY WOULD GO BY MONDAY," HE SAYS. AN MFA OFFICIAL REPORTS THAT THE SHERRY CASE IS "90 PERCENT SOLVED," BUT WHEN A CONSULAR OFFICER INVESTIGATES HE DISCOVERS THAT NOTHING HAS CHANGED. THERE IS NO RECOGNITION THAT INSTRUCTIONS MUST BE FOLLOWED UP, THAT COMMITMENTS MUST BE ACCOMPANIED BY ACTION AND RESULTS.

FINALLY, THERE ARE THE PERSIAN CONCEPTS OF INFLUENCE AND OBLIGATION. EVERYONE PAYS OBEISANCE TO THE FORMER AND THE LATTER IS USUALLY HONORED IN THE BREACH. PERSIANS ARE CONSUMED WITH DEVELOPING PARTI BAZI--THE INFLUENCE THAT WILL HELP GET THINGS DONE--WHILE FAVORS ARE ONLY GRUDGINGLY BESTOWED AND THEN JUST TO THE ------------------027075 140144Z /75 FM AMEXBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 3183 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 08980 EXTENT THAT A TANGIBLE QUID PRO QUO IS IMMEDIATELY PRECEPTIBLE. FORGET ABOUT ASSISTANCE PROFERRED LAST YEAR OR EVEN LAST WEEK; WHAT CAN BE OFFERED TODAY?

THERE ARE SEVERAL LESSONS FOR THOSE WHO WOULD NEGOTIATE WITH PERSIANS IN ALL THIS: - --FIRST, ONE SHOULD NEVER ASSUME THAT HIS SIDE OF THE ISSUE WILL BE RECOGNIZED, LET ALONE THAT IT WILL BE CONCEDED TO HAVE MERITS. PERSIAN PREOCCUPATION WITH SELF PRECLUDES THIS. A NEGOTIATOR MUST FORCE RECOGNITION OF HIS POSITION UPON HIS PERSIAN OPPOSITE NUMBER. - --SECOND, ONE SHOULD NOT EXPECT AN IRANIAN READILY TO PERCEIVE THE ADVANTAGES OF A LONG-TERM RELATIONSHIP ASED ON TRUST. HE WILL ASSUME THAT HIS OPPOSITE NUMBER IS ESSENTIALLY AN ADVERSARY. IN DEALING WITH HIM HE WILL ATTEMPT TO MAXIMIZE THE BENEFITS TO HIMSELF THAT ARE IMMEDIATELY OBTAINABLE.

HE WILL BE PREPARED TO GO TO GREAT LENGTHS TO ACHIEVE THIS GOAL, INCLUDING RUNNING THE RISK OF SO ALIENATING WHOEVER HE IS DEALING WITH THAT FUTURE BUSINESS WOULD BE UNTHINKABLE, AT LEAST TO THE LATTER. - --THIRD, INTERLOCKING RELATIONSHIPS OF ALL ASPECTS OF AN ISSUE MUST BE PAINSTAKINGLY, FORECEFULLY AND REPEATEDLY DEVELOPED. LINKAGES WILL BE NEITHER READILY COMPREHENDED NOR ACCEPTED BY PERSIAN NEGOTIATORS. - --FOURTH, ONE SHOULD INSIST ON PERFORMANCE AS THE SINE QUA NON AT ESH STAGE OF NEGOTIATIONS. STATEMENTS OF INTENTION COUNT FOR ALMOST NOTHING. - --FIFTH, CULTIVATION OF GOODWILL FOR GOODWILL'S SAKE IS A WASTE OF EFFORT.

THE OVERRIDING OBJECTIVE AT ALL TIMES SHOULD BE IMPRESSING UPON THE PERSIAN ACROSS THE TABLE THE MUTUALITY OF THE PROPOSED UNDERTAKINGS, HE MUST BE MADE TO KNOW THAT A QUID PRO QUO IS INVOLVED ON BOTH SIDES. - --FINALLY, ONE SHOULD BE PREPARED FOR THE THREAT OF BREAKDOWN IN NEGOTIATIONS AT ANY GIVEN MOMENT AND NOT BE COWED BY THE POSSIBLITY. GIVEN THE PERSIAN NEGOTIATOR'S CULTURAL AND PSYCHOLOGICAL LIMITATIONS, HE IS GOING TO RESIST THE VERY CONCEPT OF A RATIONAL (FROM THE WESTERN POINT OF VIEW) NEGOTIATING PROCESS.
(S - ENTIRE TEXT).

NAHAVANDI'S COMMENTS ABOUT THE SITUATION ALONG THE TURKISH AND IRAQI BORDERS WITH IRANIAN KURDESTAN ARE GENERALLY CONSONANT WITH OUR ADMITTEDLY LIMITED INFORMATION. MOST PEOPLE WE HAVE TALKED TO WHO HAVE VISITED THE REGION RECENTLY HAVE ALSO REPORTED THAT THE KURDS ARE IN DE FACTO CONTROL OF THE BORDER. WE ARE NOT SURE, HOWEVER, THAT THEY ARE AS WELL ORGANIZED AS NAHAVANDI SUGGESTS; THERE ARE A NUMBER OF KURDISH GROUPS OPERATING IN THE REGION, AND IT DOES NOT APPEAR THAT THEY USUALLY COORDINATE THEIR ACTIVITIES VERY EFFECTIVELY.

WE HAVE NO EVIDENCE TO SUPPORT NAHAVANDI'S PROGNOSTICATION THAT THERE WILL BE A COUP LED BY DISGRUNTLED GENERALS IN SIX TO EIGHT WEEKS. IT IS A SIMPLE FACT THAT THERE ARE FEW GENERALS LEFT ON ACTIVE DUTY TO LEAD IT. MOREOVER, THE ARMED FORCES REMAINS IN SUCH DISARRAY THAT IT IS DIFFICULT TO CONCEIVE OF EVEN A COLONELS' COUP HAVING MUCH CHANCE OF SUCCESS IN THE NEAR FUTURE.

HOWEVER, HIS REFERENCE TO POSSIBLE KURDISH INVOLVEMENT IN MILITARY ACTIVITIES HAS A FAMILIAR RING. THERE HAS LONG BEEN A SUBSTANTIAL KURDISH COMPONENT AMONG CAREER MEMBERS OF THE IRANIAN ARMED FORCES, AND RUMORS ABOUND THAT KURDISH AND NON-KURDISH MILITARY PERSONNEL ALIKE MIGHT DESERT TO JOIN A MILITARY FORCE OUTSIDE THE REGULAR ARMED SERVICES WHICH HAS SOME PROSPECT OF OVERTHROWING THE CENTRAL GOVERNMENT. SPECULATION IN THIS REGARD TENDS TO CENTER ON GEN. AZIZOLLAH PALIZBAN WHO IS FREQUENTLY SAID TO BE ORGANIZING A MILITARY FORCE IN KURDESTAN. (NOTE: WE HAVE NO CONCRETE EVIDENCE THAT SUCH A FORCE EXISTS OR THAT PALIZBAN IS EVEN IN KURDESTAN.)

RE NAHAVANDI, HOWEVER HE MIGHT BE DESCRIBING HIMSELF AT THE MOMENT, HE IS FOREMOST A POLITICAL OPPORTUNIST. HE WAS AMONG THE MOST SYCOPHANTIC OF THE SHAH'S CLOSE AIDES IN RECENT YEARS AND WIDELY HATED BY BOTH HIS COLLEAGUES IN GOVERNMENT AND IRANIANS AT LARGE. WE SEE LITTLE LIKELIHOOD OF HIS BECOMING THE NUCLEUS AROUND WHICH OPPONENTS OF THE PRESENT ORDER WILL RALLY. LAINGEN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: THE PGOI HAS ANNOUNCED A NEW PRESS LAW WHICH HAS BEEN ROUNDLY ATTACKED BY A VARIETY OF GROUPS AS AN INFRINGEMENT ON FREEDOM OF THE PRESS. ON AUGUST 12 A COALITION OF NON-ISLAMIC POLITICAL ORGANIZATIONS STAGED A MARCH TO PROTEST THE NEW LAW. THE MARCH DEGENERATED INTO VIOLENCE BETWEEN PROTESTOR AND ISLAMIC TOUGHS. IT IS NOT JUST THE SECULARISTS WHO HAVE SEIZED ON THE LAW AS A POLITICAL ISSUE, HOWEVER; AYATOLLAH SHARIAT-MADARI AND THE MUSLIM PEOPLE'S REPUBLICAN PARTY HAVE USED RESTRICTIONS ON THE PRESS AS MEANS OF ATTACKING THEIR RIVALS WITHIN THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT. END SUMMARY.

AS IS FREQUENTLY THE PRACTICE IN POST-REVOLUTIONARY IRAN, THE TEXT OF THE COUNTRY'S NEW PRESS LAW WAS MADE PUBLIC AUGUST 12 BY MINISTER OF NATIONAL GUIDANCE NASER MINACHI--SEVERAL DAYS SUBSEQUENT TO THE CLOSURE OF THE DAILY AYENDAGAN AND ITS PRESSES (WHICH EFFECTIVELY STOPPED THE PUBLICATION OF SEVERAL OTHER JOURNALS OFTEN CRITICAL OF THE ISLAMIC REGIME). MINACHI, IN A PRESS CONFERENCE HELD IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE TEXT'S RELEASE, JUSTIFIED THE RESTRICTIONS ON THE PRESS THE LAW IMPOSES BY DRAWING A PARALLEL WITH THE TIME OF MOSSADEGH WHEN, HE SAID, PRESS ATTACKS WERE RESPONSIBLE FOR MOSSADEGH'S DOWNFALL AND HAD "HANDED OVER THE COUNTRY TO (GEN.

HASSAN) ZAHEDI." NONETHELESS, MINACHI MAINTAINED, THE PGOI HAD NOT PUT "THE SLIGHTEST PRESSURE ON THE PRESS," AND SAID THAT HE WAS PREPARED TO GIVE A PRIZE TO ANY NEWSMAN WHO COULD SINCERELY SAY OTHERWISE.

MINACHI'S BRAVADO NOTWITHSTANDING, THE NEW PRESS LAW AND THE MANNER IN WHICH IT CAME INTO BEING DO NOT AUGUR WELL FOR FREEDOM OF THE PRESS IN IRAN. THE LAW WAS DRAWN UP BY BUREAUCRATS AND ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARIES WITH LITTLE REGARD FOR THE VIEWS OF PROFESSIONAL JOURNALISTS OR PUBLIC OPINION. THE LAW WAS THEN "PASSED" BY IRAN'S SHADOWY REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL, A BODY NO ONE ELECTED AND WHOSE MEMBERSHIP REMAINS AN OFFICIAL SECRET. OF THE LAW'S 41 ARTICLES, FULLY 23 ARE DEVOTED TO DELINIATING THE PUNISHMENTS FOR VIOLATIONS OF THE LAW OR THE MANNER IN WHICH THE PUNISHMENTS WILL BE DETERMINED.

FURTHER, LICENSING REQUIREMENTS ARE DESIGNED IN SUCH A WAY THAT THE REGIME WILL HAVE SWEEPING POWERS TO DETERMINE WHO MAY PUBLISH AND HENCE BE ABLE TO CONTROL WHAT IS PRINTED WITHOUT RESORTING TO DIRECT CENSORSHIP. INDEED TEN MORE PUBLICATIONS APPARENTLY WILL BE CLOSED DOWN IMMEDIATELY FOR NON-COMPLIANCE WITH THE NEW LAW.

THE LAW IS ALREADY MEETING VOCAL RESISTANCE FROM A COALITION OF DISPARATE GROUPS THAT HAVE LITTLE IN COMMON OTHER THAN THEIR FOREBODING ABOUT THE DICTATORIAL TENDENCIES OF THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT. HEDAYATOLLAH MATINDAFTARI, LEADER OF THE SECULARIST NATIONAL DEMOCRATIC FRONT, ORGANIZED A MARCH LATE AUGUST 12 TO PROTEST RESTRICTIONS ON FREEDOM OF THE PRESS. A NUMBER OF OTHER GROUPS JOINED WITH HIM. AS THE PARTICIPANTS FULLY ANTICIPATED (AND PERHAPS EVEN WELCOMED), THE MARCHERS WERE HARASSED BY ISLAMIC TOUGHS. FIGHTING BROKE OUT ALONG THE MARCH ROUTE AND A NUMBER OF PEOPLE (ONE PAPER SAID WERE INJURED SERIOUSLY ENOUGH TO REQUIRE HOSPITALIZATION.

DESPITE SUCH INTIMIDATION, IT SEEMS DOUBTFUL THAT RESISTENCE TO RESTRICTIONS ON PRESS FREEDOMS WILL QUPCKLY DISSIPATE. THE ISLAMIC FORCES, WHILE NUMERICALLY FAR SUPERIOR TO THE SECULARISTS WHO HAVE BEEN IN THE FOREFRONT OF THE CAMPAIGN TO DEFEND THE PRESS, HAVE SHOWN AN INABILITY TO ORGANIZE THAT SHOULD GIVE THE ADVOCATES OF ------------------021424 131227Z /41 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 3191 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 08995 A FREE PRESS CONSIDERABLE ROOM TO CONTINUE AGITATION.

FURTHER, THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT ITSELF IS SHOWING GROWING SIGNS OF DISUNITY, WITH THE MUSLIM PEOPLE'S REPUBLICAN PARTY (MPRP) LOYAL TO AYATOLLAH SHARIAT-MADARI INCREASINGLY PREPARED TO CHALLENGE THE DOMINANCE OF FORCES LOYAL TO KHOMEINI. THE MPRP HAS BEEN QUICK TO SEIZE THE FREEDOM OF THE PRESS ISSUE AS A POLITICAL BLUDGEON TO USE ON ITS ISLAMIC RIVALS. SHARIAT-MADARI HIMSELF SAID A FEW DAYS AGO THAT THE PGOI HAS NO LEGAL AUTHORITY TO PROMULGATE NEW LAWS, A COMMENT CLEARLY DIRECTED AGAINST THE THEN PENDING PRESS BILL. LAINGEN

1979TEHRAN09005.subject: KHUZESTAN DEVELOPMENTS AND OIL WORKER ATTITUDES

segments.text: (C) ENTIRE TEXT

SUMMARY: A RECENT VISITOR TO KHUZESTAN CONCLUDES AFTER MEETING WITH GOVERNMENT AND ARAB DISSIDENT LEADERS THAT ADMIRAL MADANI'S FIRM USE OF A STRONG REVOLUTIONARY GUARD FORCE IN KHUZESTAN, THE JAILING OF ACTIVISTS, AND THE DISPERSAL OF ARAB LEADERS HAS SUBSTANTIALLY DEMORALIZED THE ARAB POPULATION. ALTHOUGH ARAB TERRORIST GROUPS EXIST, FOR THE TIME BEING AT LEAST, THEY ARE NOT ACTIVELY SUPPORTED BY THEIR OWN PEOPLE AND ARE NOT ABLE TO MOUNT A CAMPAIGN THAT COULD SERIOUSLY DISRUPT OIL PRODUCTION IN KHUZESTAN. END SUMMARY.

WE HAVE BEEN BRIEFED BY A DIPLOMATIC COLLEAGUE WHO SPENT FIVE DAYS IN LATE JULY-EARLY AUGUST IN KHORRAMSHAHR AND ABADAN. OUR CONTACT IMPRESSES US AS A SEASONED POLITICAL/ ECONOMIC ANALYST AND WE WOULD GUESS HIS OBSERVATIONS ARE A FAIRLY RELIABLE DEPICTION OF THE SITUATION. WE NOTE OUR CONTACT DID NOT REQUEST MFA PERMISSION TO MAKE HIS TRIP. HE DID PRESENT HIMSELF TO THE MAYOR OF KHORRAMSHAHR WHO TRIED TO ATTACH A REVOLUTIONARY GUARD BY WAY OF ESCORT; THE ESCORT WAS DISLODGED BY A DRIVE OUT OF HIS JURISDICTION TO ABADAN.

ALTHOUGH THERE WERE ONLY A FEW EUROPEANS IN EVIDENCE, OUR CONTACT ENCOUNTERED NO PARTICULAR HOSTILITY OR DIFFICULTY IN MAKING HIS CALLS. THE FOLLOWING IS HIS ASSESSMENT OF ARAB ATTITUDES AS THEY MAY AFFECT OIL FIELD SECURITY BASED ON CONVERSATIONSWITHGOVERNMENT AND DISSIDENT SOURCES.

ALTHOUGH ADMIRAL MADANI, GOVERNOR OF KHUZESTAN, HAS PUBLICALLY CLAIMED THAT THE RECENT TERRORIST ACTIVITIES IN THE AREA -- THE RAILWAY LINK NEAR AHWAZ HAS BEEN BLOWN UP IN THREE PLACES; "SEVERAL" ATTACKS ON OIL AND GAS PIPELINES -- ARE THE WORK OF AGENTS OF THE FORMER REGIME BOUND ON OVERTHROWING THE REEOLUTION, FEW IN KHUZESTAN BELIEVE THIS. RATHER, THE DISPUTE IS BETWEEN THE PERSIAN MAJORITY IN THE REGION (MAINLY MIDDLE-CLASS TRADERS), AND THE MILLION OR SO ARABS (FROM WHOM THE OIL FIELDS DRAW THEIR BASIC WORK FORCE). BOTH GROUPS ARE SHIITE.

AT ISSUE IS THE PERSIANS' WISH TO MAINTAIN THE LOCAL CONTROL ESTABLISHED BY THE FORMER REGIME AND THE ARABS' WISH TO ASSERT THEIR OWN RIGHTS, FOR THE MOST PART WITHIN THE CONTEXT OF THE REVOLUTION. SECESSIONISTS FAVORING THE CREATION OF AN "ARABASTAN" SEEM FEW AND FAR BETWEEN.

FOR THE MOMENT AT LEAST, THE ISSUE IS MADE MOOT BY THE FACT THAT THE PGOI SEEMS TO HAVE WON IN KHUZESTAN. THE FORCES ARRAYED BY THE GOVERNMENT ARE CONSIDERABLE, AND SO FAR AS MAINTAINING AUTHORITY IS CONCERNED, RELATIVELY UNITED. CAREFUL PROBING REVEALED NONE OF THE DISUNITY THAT CHARACTERIZES DECISION MAKING IN TEHRAN. BENEATH HIS SOFT SPOKEN MANNER,MADANI IS SOMETHING OF A STRONG MAN.

HE APPARENTLY HAS THE FULL BACKING OF THE NAVY COMMANDOS (THIS WAS THE FORCE USED AGAINST THE ARABS UNTIL"BLACK WEDNESDAY" AT THE END OF MAY WHEN 25 ARABS WERE KILLED AND 70 WOUNDED IN A MAJOR ERUPTION OF VIOLENCE IN KHORRAMSHAHR.) HE HAS ALSO RECEIVED SOME ASSISTANCE FROM THE AMAL PEOPLE, WHO ACTED IN KHUZESTAN UNDER THE UMBRELLA OF THE "MILITARY CULTURAL ORGANIZATION." MOST IMPORTANT, HE HAS BEEN ASSIGNED A CONSIDERABLE NUMBER OF REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS (PASDARAN) FROM TEHRAN (BUT OUR CONTACT COULD NOT SAY HOW MANY) WHO HAVE TAKEN OVER THE MAIN ROLE OF MAINTAINING ORDER.

THERE ARE SOME SOLDIERS IN THE AREA AS WELL BUT THE ARMY IS STILL DISORGANIZED AND PRETTY MUCH DISREGARDED FOR THE MOMENT. SIMILARLY, THE GENDARMERIE HAVE HAD ONLY MINOR ROLES OF LATE. INTERESTINGLY, CONSIDERABLE QUANTITIES OF ARMS HAVE BEEN DISTRIBUTED TO THE PERSIAN POPULATION WITH NAVY CONNIVANCE IN ANTICIPATION OF A NEED TO RESIST ARAB PRESSURES. THE PERSIAN POPULATION DOMINATES ALL THE TOWNS IN KHUZESTAN EXCEPT KHORRAMSHAHR AND IS RECKONED TO SUPPORT KHOMEINI ALMOST COMPLETELY. WITH THESE FORCES, MADANI FELT ABLE TO AGREE TO DISSOLVING THE MILITARY CULTURAL ORGANIZATION IN RESPONSE TO ARAB DEMANDS.

MOST EVIDENCE SUGGESTS THE ARAB MINORITY ARE RECONCILED TO CONTINUING PERSIAN DOMINATION. ARAB DEMANDS WERE ORCHESTRATED BY THE ARAB CULTURAL ORGANIZATION (A MODERATE GROUP) AND A (MORE MILITANT) ARAB POLITICAL ORGANIZATION, AND BY THE ARABS' SPIRITUAL LEADER, SHEIKH KHAGHANI. HOWEVER, DURING BLACK WEDNESDAY BOTH ORGANIZATIONS WERE TAKEN OVER BY THE MILITARY CULTURAL ORGANIZATION AND THE KHORRAMSHAHR KOMITEH AND SINCE THEN NEITHER OF THE TWO ORGANIZATIONS HAS BEEN ACTIVE. MOST OF THEIR KEY ------------------021856 131314Z /41 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 3195 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 09005 MEMBERS HAVE BEEN ARRESTED BY THE PASDARAN ALONG WITH OTHER ACTIVISTS. ARAB SOURCES PUT THEIR NUMBERS JAILED AT 300 TO 500.

AS A RESULT, TWO (MINISCULE) TERRORIST GROUPS HAVE BEEN FORMED TO CARRY ON THE ARABS' CAUSE, "BLACK WEDNESDAY" AND "SAEGHRA" BOTH ARE REPORTEDLY INDIGENOUS TO KHUZESTAN AND ARE NOT LINKED TO TERRORIST ORGANIZATIONS ELSEWHERE IN THE MIDDLE EAST. (THE SAEGHRA IN KHUZESTAN ARE NOT RELATED TO THE SYRIAN GROUU OF THE SAME NAME: "SAEGHRA" MEANS "ACTION.")

MOST IMPORTANTLY, THE ARAB LEADERSHIP SEEMS TO HAVE BEEN BROKEN. SHEIKH KHAGANI'S FAMILY AND MANY FOLLOWERS HAVE BEEN ARRESTED FOR "THEIR OWN PROTECTION." KHAGHANI HAS BEEN TAKEN TO QOM FROM WHENCE STATEMENTS ATTRIBUTED TO HIM HAVE BEEN BROADCAST URGING THE ARABS TO ACT PEACEABLY. THESE STATEMENTS APPEAR TO HAVE MAINLY CAUSED DESPAIR IN KHUZESTAN AT THE LOSS OF THE ARABS' ONLY REMAINING LEADER. THE ONLY OTHER ARAB RELIGIOUS LEADER OF COMPARATIVE STATURE IS SHEIKH KAREMI IN AHWAZ WHO IS AN APPROVED KHOMEINI MEMBER OF THE CONSTITUTIONAL CONVENTION. OTHER SHEIKHS OR TRIBAL LEADERS HAVE EITHER LEFT FOR IRAQ (LIKE THE PROSHAH FAISALI) OR COME UNDER MADANI'S THUMB.

ACTIVISTS IN TWO GROUPS OF DISSIDENT LEFTISTS AMONG NIOC EMPLOYEES HAVE BEEN JAILED. BOTH THE AMOGHLY GROUP, WHO ARE UNARMED PROGRESSIVE LEFTISTS, AND THE TUDEHISTS MADE THREATS ABOUT INTERFERING WITH OIL PRODUCTION DURING THE REVOLUTION ITSELF. BOTH GROUPS ARE NOW UNDERGROUND OR SIMPLY NOT OPERATING.

AT THIS STAGE, THE ARABS APPEAR DEMORALIZED AND APATHETIC. THE EXPECTATION APPEARS TO BE THAT THERE WILL PERHAPS BE FURTHER INCIDENTS BUT NOTHING OF THE NATURE OF A MAJOR ARAB REVOLT. THE ARAB POPULATION GENERALLY SYMPATHIZES WITH THE TERRORISTS' AIMS, BUT IT WILL NOT SUPPORT THE GROUPS' ACTIVITIES GIVEN THE APPARENT IMPOSSIBILITY OF ACHIEVING ANYTHING USEFUL NOW.

KHUZESTAN PORT NOTES: THE SITUATION IN THE KHUZESTAN PORTS IS REPORTEDLY AS FOLLOWS. WORK AT BOTH KHORRAMSHAHR AND BANDAR SHAHPOUR HAS RESUMED THOUGH IT IS CURRENTLY CONSTRAINED TO 6 HOURS A DAY (8 AM - 2 PM) AS A RESULT OF THE GOVERNMENT'S REFUSAL TO PAY OVERTIME. BEST GUESSES OF THE BACKLOG OF CARGO AT BOTH PORTS PUT IT AT ABOUT 1.2 MILLION TONS IN TOTAL, MOSTLY GENERAL CARGO AT KHORRAMSHAHR AND CONTAINERS AT BANDAR SHAHPOUR.

KHORRAR- P ARE AVAILABLE AND THERE IS NO BERTHAGE PROBLEM. WORK RETURNED TO SOMETHING APPROACHING NORMAL IN JULY, THOUGH IT REMAINS SLOW. THE DISCHARGE RATE FOR GENERAL CARGO IS CURRENTLY 300 TONS PER DAY. THERE ALSO SEEMS TO BE A LACK OF TRANSPORT FACILITIES AVAILABLE TO CONVEY IT TO THE WAREHOUSES.

BANDAR SHAHPOUR: EIGHTEEN PIERS ARE IN OPERATION AND, AGAIN, THERE IS NO DIFFICULTY IN SECURING BERTHS. AT PRESENT THERE ARE NO LABOR PROBLEMS (BEYOND THE SHORT HOURS WORKED). THE PORT AUTHORITY IS PREPARED, MOREOVER, TO ALLOW SHIPS' CREWS TO USE THEIR OWN MACHINERY (E.G., FORKLIFT TRUCKS CARRIED ON BOARD) TO UNLOAD VESSELS. THERE ARE TWO CONTAINER GANTRY CRANES ERECTED AND READY AT THE CONTAINER JETTY AND AN UNCOMPLETED AND STRENGTHENED AREA FOR STACKING CONTINERS.

(THIS AREA IS NOT YET IN USE.) THERE APPEARS TO BE NO SUITABLE POWER GENERATOR UNIT OR POWER CONNECTORS AT THE PORT FOR FREEZER CONTAINERS WHICH WOULD ACCORDINGLY NEED TO COME WITH THEIR OWN SOURCE OF POWER. THE HANZA CONTAINER YARD IS FULL AT THE MOMENT, BUT WITH SEVERAL SHIPS CALLING THIS SHOULD IMPROVE. THE IRAN SCANDIA CONTAINER YARD IS ALSO OPERATIONAL. THERE DOES NOT APPEAR TO BE A SHORTAGE OF TRUCKS AT BANDAR SHAHPOUR FOR UNLOADING AND FOR TRANSPORT. CUSTOMS AT THE PORT IS GAINING WITH SHIPPERS AND FORWARDING AGENTS IN TEHRAN.

AT LEASTONEPROBLEM MAY ARISE IN THE WINTER; THE BRIDGE ON THE MAIN ROAD TO BANDAR SHAHPOUR HAS BEEN BLOWN UP BY TERRORISTS AND AT PRESENT TRUCKS AND TRAFFIC SIMPLY CAREER ACROSS THE DESERT AROUND IT. IN WINTER THE AREA IS APPARENTLY INUNDATED AND SO THE BRIDGE WILL NEED TO BE REPAIRED TO SOLVE THE DIFFICULTY. ESTIMATES ARE THAT THE BRIDGE WILL TAKE TWO MONTHS TO REPAIR BUT SO FAR NO WORK HAS BEEN DONE ON IT. LAINGEN##
(U) THE NIGHT OF AUGUST 12 PASSED WITHOUT FURTHER INCIDENT AND THE EMBASSY RESUMED NORMAL OPERATIONS THIS MORNING.

(C) COMPOUND SECURITY IS CURRENTLY PROVIDED BY ELEMENTS OF THE PASDARAN FORCE WHICH REMOVED MASHALLAH KASHANI AND COMPANY FROM THE COMPOUND YESTERDAY. THE GROUP, NUMBERING 12-20 MEN, IS COMPARATIVELY WELL DISCIPLINED, FRIENDLY AND HAS SHOWN NO INCLINATION TO INTERFERE WITH EMBASSY OPERATIONS. IT IS NOT CLEAR AT THIS TIME HOW LONG THE GROUP WILL REMAIN AT THE EMBASSY OR IF THEY ARE TO BE REPLACED BY MILITARY, POLICE OR NO SECURITY FORCE AT ALL. WE ARE SEEKING CLARIFICATION OF THESE POINTS THROUGH THE MFA. THE LEADER OF THE GROUP HAS INTIMATED THAT THEIR PRESENCE IS ONLY TEMPORARY AND IS SOLELY FOR THE PURPOSE OF PREVENTING KASHANI'S RETURN.

(C) THE GROUP PRESENTLY MANS POSITIONS AT THE MAIN GATES AND RUNS TWO VEHICULAR PATROLS OUTSIDE OF THE EMBASSY. THEY ARE ALSO MANNING A FOLLOW CAR FOR CHARGE'S MOVES OUTSIDE OF THE COMPOUND. RSOS INSPECTION OF POSTS AT 2300 LAST NIGHT FOUND PERSONNEL ALERT AND ON DUTY. POST WILL GRADUALLY ENCOURAGE THE PRESENT FORCE TO MAN ITS POSITIONS OUTSIDE OF THE COMPOUND. HOWEVER, UNTIL SUCH TIME AS KASHANI'S FATE AND/OR INTENTIONS ARE DETERMINED WE PLAN TO TAKE APPROPRIATE PRECAUTIONS, INCLUDING MAINTAINING THE PRESENCE OF A SECURITY FORCE.

(U) THE IMMEDIATE EFFECT OF KASHANI'S REMOVAL ARE APPARENT. PERSONNEL, AMERICAN AND FSN ALIKE, ARE VISIBLY MORE RELAXED. WE HAVE BEGUN REMOVING THE SANDBAGS AND OTHER FORTIFICATIONS CREATED BY KASHANI IN AN EFFORT TO RESTORE THE IMAGE OF THE AMERICAN EMBASSY. LAINGEN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT.)

REFTEL IS A REASONABLY ACCURATE ACCOUNT BY A JOURNALIST WITH CONSIDERABLE EXPERIENCE IN IRAN OF CLASHES BETWEEN SECULARIST POLITICAL GROUPS AND HEZBOLLAHIS (LITERALLY, ADHERENTS OF THE PARTY OF GOD) LOYAL TO AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI ON AUGUST 12 AND 13. ALLOWAY'S REPORT IS COLORED SOMEWHAT BY HIS SYMPATHY FOR THE SECULARISTS AND HIS OWN BRUSH WITH ISLAMIC FANATICISM, BUT THE GROWING POLITICAL AND SOCIAL DIVISIONS HE DESCRIBES WHICH UNDERLIE THESE CLASHES ARE VERY REAL.

HAVING SAID THAT, HOWEVER, WE ARE NOT INCLINED TO CONCLUDE THAT WHAT HAS HAPPENED THIS WEEK SIGNALS THE IMMINENT APPROACH OF ARMAGEDDON IN IRAN. WE THINK IT MORE LIKELY THAT THE CURRENT CONFRONTATION BETWEEN THE SECULAR LEFT AND THE ISLAMIC HARDLINERS WILL SUBSIDE (INDEED, THE LEVEL OF TENSION WAS NOTICEABLY LOWER YESTERDAY, AUGUST 14, AND TODAY, AUGUST 15, THE CITY IS VIRTUALLY CLOSED UP BECAUSE OF THE COMMEMORATION OF THE DEATH OF IMAM ALI). SUCH A PATTERN HAS BEEN TYPICAL OF OTHER POLITICAL CRISES SINCE THE FEBRUARY REVOLUTION, AND WE WOULD NOT EXPECT THIS ONE TO BE ANY DIFFERENT.

BUT A LEGACY OF BITTERNESS WILL REMAIN TO FESTER JUST BENEATH THE SURFACE OF THE BODY POLITIC. THIS, IT SEEMS TO US, IS THE REAL SIGNIFICANCE OF THE POLITICAL PROCESS IN IRAN. THE ISLAMIC FORCES REMAIN PREDOMINENT. NO OTHER POLITICAL GROUP HAS EMERGED THAT HAS A CAPABILITY OF SUCCESSFULLY CHALLENGING THEM. BUT THE ISLAMIC FUNDAMENTALISTS HAVE SHOWN A SINGULAR INABILITY TO COME TO GRIPS WITH IRAN'S PLURALISTIC SOCIETY WHICH CONTAINS A LARGE, MODERNIZED, SECULAR COMPONENT. DURING THEIR SIX MONTHS IN POWER THEY HAVE ALIENATED ONE GROUP AFTER ANOTHER. THIS PROCESS CANNOT GO ON INDEFINITELY.

IT MAY NEVER COME TO CIVIL WAR, AS ALLOWAY SUGGESTS, BUT NEITHER CAN THE ISLAMIC FORCES EXPECT TO BE ABLE CONTINUALLY TO RIDE ROUGHSHOD OVER ALL THOSE WHO DO NOT AGREE WITH THEM WITHOUT EVENTUALLY ENCOUNTERING A MORE SEVERE REACTION THAN THEY HAVE TO DATE. LAINEEN

1979TEHRAN09144.subject: MEETING WITH DEP PRIME MINISTER TABATABAI

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: I MET WITH PGOI SPOKESMAN DEP PRIM MIN TABATABAI TO DISCUSS RECENT ANTI-U.S. STATEMENTS MADE OVER NATIONAL IRANIAN RADIO AND TELEVISION (NIRT). IN A FRANK AND FRIENDLY CONVERSATION TABATABAI DISCUSSED THE PGOI'S OWN PROBLEMS WITH NIRT, AS WELL AS STILL STRONG ANTI-U.S. FEELING IN IRAN. DESCRIBING THE PGOI'S DIFFICULTIES VIS-A-VIS INTENSE POPULAR EMOTIONS, TABATABAI ASKED THAT OFFICIAL U.S. GOVERNMENT SPOKESMEN DO MORE TO HELP SOLVE THE PRESENT MISUNDERSTANDINGS BETWEEN THE U.S. AND IRAN, AND ASKED FOR MORE FREQUENT MEETINGS WITH THE EMBASSY IN ORDER TO PREVENT AND OVERCOME SUCH DIFFICULTIES. END SUMMARY

I MET WITH DEP PRIM MIN SADEQU TABATABAI ON 13 AUGUST TO DISCUSS ISSUES OF RECENT ANTI-AMERICAN STATEMENTS ON NIRT AND MINISTRY OF NATIONAL GUIDANCE UNDER SECRETARY MOMKEN'S ALLEGATIONS THAT AMERICAN REPORTERS OFTEN TENDED TO BE SPIES FIRST AND REPORTERS SECOND. TABATABAI RESPONDED BY CLAIMING THAT THE NIRT IS ONE OF THE LARGER PROBLEMS BEING FACED BY THE PGOI. WHILE EVERYONE ASSUMES THAT THE NIRT IS GOVERNMENT CONTROLLED, HE SAID, IN REALITY THERE HAS BEEN MUCH DIFFICULTY BETWEEN THE PGOI AND NIRT MANAGEMENT.
IN FACT, PM BAZARGAN WAS SCHEDULED TO ATTEND A MEETING AT NIRT THAT VERY AFTERNOON IN AN ATTEMPT TO SMOOTH OUT PROBLEMS THE PGOI HAS BEEN HAVING WITH THE ORGANIZATION.

TABATABAI WENT ON TO SAY THAT A VARIETY OF POLITICAL VIEWS HAVE BEEN EXPRESSED VIA THE NIRT FACILITIES, INCLUDING SOME THAT COULD BE CONSIDERED ATTACKS ON THE PGOI ITSELF. ELABORATING FURTHER ON ANTI-U.S. STATEMENTS BEING MADE BY NIRT AND THE PRESS, HE EXPLAINED THAT THE ANTI-AMERICAN SENTIMENT AMONG THE PEOPLE OF IRAN WAS STILL VERY STRONG, AND REPORTERS WERE OFTEN INFLUENCED BY SUCH FEELINGS. AS AN EXAMPLE, TABATABAI DESCRIBED HIS TRIP TO GERMANY SOME MONTHS EARLIER, WHEN IRANIAN STUDENTS THERE HAD DEMANDED NOT ONLY THAT IRANIANAMERICAN RELATIONS BE BROKEN, BUT THAT THE U.S. ALSO BE FORCED TO PAY REPARATIONS FOR ALL OF THE SHAH'S MISDEEDS IN IRAN.

IF THESE STUDENTS, WHO COULD BE CONSIDERED AMONG IRAN'S FUTURE INTELLECTUALS AND WHO ALL LIVE ABROAD FEEL THIS WAY, HE SAID, HOW CAN ONE EXPECT THE COMMON AND UNEDUCATED PEOPLE TO FEEL DIFFERENTLY? IN AN EFFORT TO EXPLAIN THE PRESSURES UNDER WHICH THE PGOI WAS OPERATING, TABATABAI DESCRIBED THE REACTION TO HIS RECENT PUBLIC STATEMENT ABOUT THE CANCELLATION OF THE AWACS AND F-16 CONTRACTS BETWEEN THE IRANIAN AND AMERICAN GOVERNMENTS. "ABOUT TWO HUNDRED PEOPLE CALLED AND WROTE MY OFFICE ASKING WHY I HAD NOT USED THE TERMINOLOGY 'CRIMINAL' TO REFER TO THE U.S. GOVERNMENT," HE SAID.

ACCORDING TO TABATABAI, POPULAR ANTIPATHY WAS NOT LIMITED TO THE USA, BUT INCLUDED THE WEST IN GENERAL, AND GERMANY IN PARTICULAR. THERE WAS, IN ADDITION, A DEEP HATRED FELT FOR THE SOVIET UNION. THIS ANTIUSSR FEELING SPRANG FROM THE VERY RELIGION OF THE IRANIANS, AND IN THE LONG RUN WOULD DO MUCH TO PUT THE USA IN A FAR BETTER LIGHT HERE.

ALONG PREVIOUSLY REPORTED LINES, I EXPRESSED THE U.S. GOVERNMENT'S DESIRE TO ESTABLISH AND ENCOURAGE GOOD BILATERAL RELATIONS, AND ASKED TABATABAI FOR ANY SUGGESTIONS HE MIGHT HAVE TO IMPROVE THE PUBLIC PERCEPTION OF THIS REPORT. TABATABAI CLAIMED THAT OFFICIAL U.S. GOVERNMENT SPOKESMEN, INCLUDING THOSE AT THE WHITE HOUSE, DEPT OF STATE, AND MYSELF, SHOULD DO MORE TO MAKE PUBLIC OUR PRIVATE EXPRESSIONS OF UNDERSTANDING ON IRAN. HE SAID THAT THE ONLY REASON HE KNEW THE U.S. WAS MAKING SUCH EFFORTS TO ESTABLISH GOOD BILATERAL RELATIONS WAS BECAUSE HE HAD BEEN TOLD SO IN CABINET MEETINGS.

PRIOR TO HIS APPOINTMENT AS DEP PRIM MIN, HE HAD SIMPLY NOT REALIZED IT, AND CERTAINLY THE ORDINARY PEOPLE OF IRAN SAW NO INDICATION OF SUCH EFFORTS SINCE AMERICAN PRESS COVERAGE APPEARED TO BE ANTI-REVOLUTION IN TONE. I RESPONDED BY SAYING I HAD SEEN VERY LITTLE IN PERSIAN PRESS COVERAGE TO INDICATE IRAN'S DESIRE TO ENCOURAGE A POSITIVE RELATIONSHIP, AND ASKED IF WHETHER SUCH A MUTUALLY DESCRIBED GOAL SHOULD NOT ALSO BE GIVEN OFFICIAL PUBLICITY IN IRAN. TABATABAI SAID THAT "IN A MONTH OR SO," WHEN POPULAR ANTI-U.S. FERVOR HAD SOMEWHAT DIED DOWN, THIS WOULD INDEED BE POSSIBLE.
IF FRIENDLIER PUBLICITY COULD COMMENCE IN THE U.S., HOWEVER, IT WOULD MAKE THE PGOI'S TASK MUCH EASIER.

TABATABAI ALSO ASKED FOR MORE MEETINGS WITH ME SINCE HE HAD FOUND THE FRANK TALK TO BE VERY USEFUL. HE INDICATED, PERHAPS CARRIED AWAY BY HIS OWN ------------------046544 161427Z /73 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 3269 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 09144 ENTHUSIASM, THAT HE WOULD EVEN COME TO THE EMBASSY IF IT WERE MORE CONVENIENT.

AS A LAST POINT, I THANKED TABATABAI FOR THE PGOI'S AID IN REPLACING THE (MASHALLAH KASHANI) EMBASSY SECURITY GUARD GROUP WITH A SECURITY UNIT MORE APPROPRIATE TO THE EMBASSY, AND STATED THAT THIS WOULD FACILITATE THE OPENING OF NORMAL CONSULAR ACTIVITIES WITHIN A SHORT TIME. TABATABAI'S RESPONSE WAS THAT HIS OFFICE HAD BEEN UNDER TREMENDOUS PRESSURE ON THIS SCORE,AND AS A PARTING GIFT HE PRESENTED ME WITH A YOUNG RELATIVE'S STUDENT VISA APPLICATION FOR PROCESSING OUTSIDE THE NORMAL CHANNELS. 1979TEHRAN09150.subject: FIGHTING IN KURDISH TOWN OF PAVEH

segments.text: FIGHTING IN KURDISH CITY OF PAVEH BETWEEN KURDISH REBELS AND GOVERNMENT TROOPS WHICH HAS BEEN GOING ON FOR THREE DAYS INTENSIFIED FRIDAY NIGHT. ACCORDING TO THE TEHRAN TIMES AUGUST 18, THREE GROUPS OF KURDISH REBELS UNDER LEADERSHIP OF THE DEMOCRATIC PARTY OF KORDESTAN AND HEADED BY JALAL TALEBANI, SALAR JAF AND PALIZBAN(SIC) SEIZED PARTS OF THE TOWN AND THE HOSPITAL, KILLING AT LEAST 40 REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS AND OTHERS AND BEHEADING SOME OF THE PEOPLE IN THE HOSPITAL. IN THE FIGHTING A F-4 PHANTOM AND A HELICOPTER CARRYING WOUNDED TROOPS HAVE REPORTEDLY CRASHED. THE TROOPS IN THE CITY ARE BEING REINFORCED BY AIR AND ARE NOW COUNTERATTACKING.
THE GOVERNMENT BACKED BY KHOMEINI HAS ANNOUNCED ON THE TEHRAN RADIO THIS MORNING THAT THEY INTEND TO ATTACK THE CITY FULL FORCE WITH PLANES AND THE ARMY BY 1300 TODAY UNLESS THE KURDS SURRENDER.
COMMENT: THE FIGHTING IN PAVEH IS INTENSE BUT WE HAVE NO WAY OF CHECKING HOW MUCH OF THE ABOVE TIMES STORY MAY BE TRUE. SALAR JAF WAS EXECUTED EARLIER THIS YEAR. LAINGEN

MOVING THEM. EVEN THAT HAD NOT BEEN EASY, SINCE MASHALLAH WAS WIDELY FEARED IN IRAN. HE INDICATED THAT FOR THE MOMENT THE PASDARAN MAY BE THE THE ONLY ORGANIZED FORCE CAPABLE OF PROVIDING THE SECURITY WE REQUIRED, BUT HELD OUT THE POSSIBILITY THAT, WITH MASHALLAH'S REMOVAL SUCCESSFULLY CARRIED OUT, IT MAY BE POSSIBLE TO READDRESS THE QUESTIONS OF A POLICE CONTINGENT FOR THE EMBASSY--IF NOT IMMEDIATELY, THAN IN THE RELATIVELY NEAR FUTURE.

VAFA, AND OUR OWN SECURITY PEOPLE, BUT PROMISED TO TALK TO VAFA ABOUT THE REQUIREMENT AND PUT HIM IN TOUCH WITH OUR SECURITY PEOPLE IMMEDIATELY. TOWARD THE END OF THE MEETING I WAS INFORMED THAT IT HAD BEEN DISCOVERED THAT A SECOND BLAST HAD BEEN CAUSED BY A CONCUSSION GRENADE THAT HAD BEEN SET OFF ON THIS COMPOUND ITSELF.

THIS FACTOR, WHICH SUGGESTED BOTH A COORDINATED EFFORT AND THE ACTUAL PENETRATION OF COMPOUND, I EMPHASIZED, MADE IT DOUBLY IMPORTANT THAT THERE BE A FORCE WITH ADEQUATE NUMBERS OF PEOPLE TO GUARD KEY POINTS AND PATROL THE COMPOUND PERIMETER.

COMMENT: WHILE THE AUGUSTVGQU INCIDENT SHOULD BE TAKEN WITH ALL DUE SERIOUSNESS, I DO NOT BELIEVE IT SHOULD DCAUSE US TO PANIC. BALANCED AGAINST THE NEGATIVE IMPLICATIONS OF THE BLASTS THEMSELVES ARE THE RAPIDITY OF THE PGOI'S RESPONSE AND THE DEGREE OF COOPERATION BOTH THE PGOI AND THE PZUDARAN SEEMED PREPARED TO EXTEND IN ASSURING THAT WE GET THE PROTECTION WE EQUIRE. FURTHER, IF THIS INCIDENT GALVANIZES THE PGOI TO TAKE THE STEPS NECESSARY TO PROVIDE US WITH A REGULAR UNIFORMED SECURITY FORCE, WE WILL HAVE ACTUALLY GAINED FROM IT.

ACCORDINGLY, I RECOMMEND THAT WE KEEP OUR OPTIONS OPEN REGARDING ONGOING CONSULAR OPERATIONS AND THE OPENING OF THE NEW VISA ISSUING UNIT. THERE IS TIME ENOUGHT YET TO MAKE DECISIONS ONE WAY OR THE OTHER ON THESE AND RELATED MATTERS SUCH AS THE RETURN OF DEPENDENTS. LET US SEE HOW THE SITUATION DEVELOPS FIRST.

1979TEHRAN09174.subject: BUILDING CONCEPTUAL BRIDGES TO SHI'A ISLAM

segments.text: AT PRESENT THERE IS A GREAT DEAL OF CONFUSION IN IRAN. POWER IS DIFFUSED AT BEST, AND EVEN RELATIVELY SIMPLE DECISIONS OFTEN GET POSTPONED FOR WANT OF CLEAR AUTHORITY. IT IS THEREFORE IMPRACTICAL TO TRY TO MAP OUT MORE THAN A TENTATIVE POWER STRUCTURE WHICH IDENTIFIES SOME INFLUENTIAL GROUPS AND INSTITUTIONS. AND OF COURSE IT IS EVEN MORE DIFFICULT TO FORESEE WHO THE PLAYERS WILL BE A YEAR OR, MORE IMPORTANTLY, TEN YEARS HENCE.

IT IS, NONETHELESS, VERY MUCH IN THE U.S. INTEREST TO BEGIN, INSOFAR AS PRACTICAL, DISCREETLY AND CAUTIOUSLY BUILDING BRIDGES TO GROUPS WHICH APPEAR CERTAIN TO PLAY MAJOR ROLES IN IRAN DURING THE NEXT TEN YEARS. IRANIAN HISTORY, THE EVENTS LEADING UP TO THE DEPARTURE OF THE SHAH, AND THE SITUATION AT PRESENT ALL INDICATE THAT SHI'A RELIGIOUS LEADERS WILL CERTAINLY BE ONE GROUP WHICH WILL PLAY A MAJOR ROLE IN IRAN REGARDLESS OF WHAT KIND OF GOVERNMENT, SOCIAL STRUCTURE, AND ECONOMY EMERGE FROM THE PRESENT FLUX.

WHILE IT IS EVIDENT THAT IRAN'S DEEP, GRASS-ROOTS ATTACHMENT TO SHI'A ISLAM MAKES IT CERTAIN THAT THE CLERGY WILL CONTINUE TO HAVE ENORMOUS INFLUENCE IN IRAN, IT IS EQUALLY EVIDENT THAT AMERICANS HAVE AT PRESENT LITTLE ABILITY TO RELATE TO THE CONCEPTUAL FRAMEWORK WHICH INFORMS THE ULAMA. WE DO NOT KNOW WHERE THEY ARE COMING FROM. CONVERSELY, THE ULAMA HAVE LITTLE UNDERSTANDING OF THE CONCEPTS WHICH UNDERLIE WESTERN THOUGHT. TO MAKE MATTERS WORSE, BOTH SIZS ARE BURDENED WITH A STOCK OF SUPERFICIAL INFORMATION AND MISLEADING GENERALIZATIONS.

UNFORTUNATELY, THERE IS NO QUICK WAY TO CLOSE THE COMMUNICATION GAP BETWEEN AMERICANS AND THE SHI'A CLERGY. IN THIS CASE, THE AMERICAN PENCHANT FOR CRASH PROGRAMS AND QUICK ACTION IS HOPELESSLY INAPPROPRIATE. RUSHING OUT TO TAKE A MULLAH TO LUNCH, SENDING THE CLERGY OUR PUBLICATIONS, OR EVEN DEVISING PROGRAMS WITH THEM IN MIND IS UNLIKELY TO DO MUCH BY WAY OF REDUCING THE COMMUNICATION PROBLEM.

CONVENTIONAL EXCHANGES WHICH INVOLVE MODERN IRANIAN INSTITUTIONS AND SCHOLARS DO LITTLE TO PROMOTE DIALOGUE BETWEEN AMERICANS AND THE ULAMA. THOUSANDS OF IRANIANS HAVE STUDIED IN THE U.S. OR WESTERN EUROPE. BUT WHEN THEY RETURN TO IRAN THEIR ASPIRATIONS AND LIFE STYLE TEND TO CONFIRM THE ULAMA'S RESERVATIONS WITH REGARD TO WESTERN VALUES AND CONCEPTS. IN THEIR EAGERNESS TO ASSIMILATE A SPECIFIC DISCIPLINE OR TECHNOLOGY, CONVENTIONAL IRANIAN STUDENTS PROVIDE AMERICANS WITH LITTLE INSIGHT INTO TRADITIONAL PERSIAN THOUGHT.

THEIR PREOCCUPATION WITH IMMEDIATE POLITICAL CONCERNS AND THEIR MEAGER KNOWLEDGE OF THE GREAT BODY OF ISLAMIC THOUGHT FURTHER REDUCE THEIR ABILLTY TO ENTER INTO MEANINGFUL DIALOGUE WITH THOSE FEW AMERICANS PREPARED TO EXPLORE A TOTALLY FOREIGN CONCEPTUAL FRAMEWORK.

THE POST THEREFORE SUGGESTS THE POSSIBILITY OF AN EXCHANGE, UNDER FULBRIGHT PROGRAM AUSPICES, WHICH WOULD BRING ONE OR TWO ADVANCED STUDENTS FROM THE FAYZIYEH SCHOOL IN QOM WHERE MANY OF THE MOST INFLUENTIAL IRANIAN RELIGIOUS LEADERS TRAINED AND TAUGHT (INCLUDING AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI) TO AN APPROPRIATE AMERICAN SCHOOL SUCH AS UNION THEOLOGICAL SEMINARY FOR TWO YEARS. THE FIRST YEAR WOULD BE DEVOTED TO ENGLISH LANGUAGE STUDY AND EXPLORATION OF WESTERN THOUGHT. THE SECOND YEAR WOULD PROVIDE OPPORTUNITY FOR DEEPENING DIALOGUE WITH APPROPRIATE AMERICANS AND MIGHT INCLUDE SOME FORMAL TEACHING.

AT THE SAME TIME, ONE OR TWO AMERICAN GRADUATE STUDENTS ORYOUNG PROFESSORS FROM UNION THEOLOGICAL OR SOME SIMILAR INSTITUTION WOULD COME TO STUDY AND EVENTUALLY ENGAGE IN CONCERTED DIALOGUE WITH COLLEAGUES AT QOM.

THE POST RECOGNIZES THAT ESTABLISHING MEANINGFUL CONTACT WITH THE FAYZIYEH SCHOOL WOULD, AT BEST, REQUIRE A GREAT DEAL OF TIME, EFFORT, PATIENCE, AND TACT. THE ODDS AGAINST SUCCESS ARE GREAT. BUT THE POST HAS FRIENDLY RELATIONS WITH PEOPLE WHO KNOW FAYZIYEH WELL AND MIGHT ACT AS DISCREET INTERMEDIARIES WHO COULD EXPLORE THE POSSIBILITIES WITHOUT IN ANY WAY ENGAGING THE MISSION. AS A FIRST STEP, THE POST THEREFORE SUGGESTS THAT, IF THE PROPOSAL APPEARS PROMISING TO THE AGENCY, THE AGENCY EXPLORE THE POSSIBILITY OF AN EXCHANGE WITH APPROPRIATE AMERICAN INSTITUTIONS. 1979TEHRAN09240.subject: PAVEH INCIDENT BRINGS TOUGH GOVERNMENT REACTION

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: IN THE PAST TWO DAYS, AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI BY A SERIES OF INFLAMATORY STATEMENTS FROM QOM HAS FORCED THE PGOI TO TAKE HARSH MEASURES TO SUPPRESS KURDISH REBELS IN PAVEH AND OTHER NEARBY AREAS. KOHMEINI'S DEMANDS HAVE RESULTED IN A GENERAL MOBILIZATION OF THE ARMED FORCES AND MAY HAVE PUSHED THE IRANIAN KURDS INTO MORE OPEN OPPOSITION TO THE IRANIAN ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT. END SUMMARY.

ACCORDING TO PRESS REPORTS BY EVENING AUGUST 19, PGOI FORCES HAD FULL CONTROL OVER KURDISH TOWN OF PAVEH AND WERE ATTEMPTING TO SEARCH OUT REBELS WHO EITHER FLED OR WITHDREW IN FACE OF PGOI TROOPS (ARMY, GENDARMARIE AND PASDARAN). KURDISH REBELS ALSO APPARENTLY ATTEMPTED TO TAKE OVER NOWSOOD, A SMALL TOWN ON THE ROAD TO THE IRAQ BORDER AND ANOTHER GROUP MAY HAVE ATTACKED A GOVERNMENT POST IN THE KURDISTAN PROVINCE CAPITOL OF SANANDAJ. GOVERNMENT FORCES REPORTEDLY HELD OFF THE ATTACK ON NOWSOOD AND HAVE SENT REINFORCEMENTS TO SANANDAJ.

EVENTS LEADING UP TO FIGHTING IN PAVEH ARE UNCLEAR BUT MAY HAVE BEEN CAUSED BY FRICTION BETWEEN LOCAL PEOPLE AND PASDARAN TROOPS. THE KERMANSHAH GENDAMERIE CHIEF TOLD REPORTERS AUGUST 18 THAT PAVEH REBELS WERE NOT COUNTER-REVOLUTIONARIES AND FIGHTING COULD HAVE BEEN AVOIDED IF PASDARAN COMMANDER IN PAVEH HAD BEEN REMOVED.

IN ANY CASE, KHOMEINI HAS USED THE PAVEH INCIDENT TO STIR UP FLAGGING REVOLUTIONARY SENTIMENT AND VENT HIS FRUSTRATIONS AGAINST "COUNTER-REVOLUTIONARY' FORCES IN THE COUNTRY, I.E., ANYONE WHO IS NOT 100 PERCENT BEHIND KHOMEINI'S ISLAMIC REVOLUTION. REACTION FROM TO THE PAVEH INCIDENT HAS BEEN EXCEPTIONALLY STRONG5 AND SEEMS TO BE AN OVERREACTION TO KURDISH UNREST.

IN STATEMENTS OVER THE PAST FEW DAYS, KHOMEINI HAS CALLED HIMSELF THE SUPREME COMMANDER OF THE IRANIAN ARMED FORCES, A TITLE PREVIOUSLY RESERVED FOR THE SHAH, HAS DEMANDED THE ARMED FORCES WHICH WERE APPARENTLY RELUCTANT TO USE FORCE AGAINST PAVEH TO ATTACK IMMEDIATELY AND HAS ACCUSED THE IRAN KURDISTAN DEMOCRATIC PARTY (IRDP) OF BEING AGAINST THE REVOLUTION.

THE RESULTS OF KHOMEINI'S BATTLE CALL WERE IMMEDIATE THE ARMY WENT ON THE ALERT, ALL LEAVES WERE CANCELLED AND AN ANNOUNCEMENT MADE THAT VOLUNTEERS WITH PREVIOUS MILITARY EXPERIENCE COULD BE REINSTATED. VARIOUS ARMED FORCES UNITS WERE DISPATCHED TO PAVEH AND A GROUP OF PASDARAN WERE AIRLIFTED FROM TEHRAN. THE FORCES ATTACKING PAVEH APPARENTLY USED BOTH F-4'S AND HELICOPTER GUNSHIPS IN THE ATTACK.

KHOMEINI'S CALLS TO BATTLE INCITED SUCH ENTHUSIASM THAT PASDARAN POSTS IN TEHRAN WERE SWAMPED WITH VOLUNTEERS AND THE GOVERNMENT HAS NOW HAD TO ISSUE CALLS TO THE "PEOPLE" FROM KERMANSHAH WHO SET OUT TO RESCUE SANANDAJ IN RESPONSE TO KHOMEINI'S CALLS TO LAY DOWN THEIR ARMS AND GO HOME.

IN THE AFTERMATH, THE IRANIAN KURDESTAN DEMOCRATIC PARTY HAS BEEN BANNED, ITS LEADER, ABDUL RAHMAN GHASEMLOU, AND KURDISH RELIGIOUS LEADER, SHEIKH EZZEDIN HOSSEINI, BRANDED "CORRUPT", ELEVEN OF THE KURDISH REBELS EXECUTED AND SADEGH KHALKHALI, WHO MAY OR MAY NOT STILL BE THE HEAD OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS, SENT TO KERMANSHAH TO INVESTIGATE THE PROBLEM.

THE EVENTS SURROUNDING PAVEH ARE STILL UNCLEAR, BUT THE PGOI'S HARSH REACTION MAY WELL DESTROY ANY ------------------074702 201359Z /43 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 3328 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 09240 BELIEF BY KURDISH LEADERS THAT THEY CAN WORK WITHIN KHOMEINI'S ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. THE IDKP HAS ALREADY BROADCAST AN APPEAL FOR HELP AGAINST THE "HOLY WAR" WHICH THEY SAY THE SHIITES ARE NOW WAGING AGAINST THE KURDS.

IN TEHRAN THERE ARE INDICATIONS THAT KHOMEINI'S INTERVENTION IN THE PAVEH INCIDENT AND HIS SUCCESSFUL DEMAND FOR HARSH ACTION HAVE SHAKEN THE BAZARGEN GOVERNMENT WHICH WOULD HAVE PREFERRED A MILDER APPROACH. THE EFFECT OF PAVEH ON THE ARMED FORCES IS STILL UNCLEAR. IN ONE SENSE KHOMEINI'S CALL FOR MOBILIZATION AND THE OBVIOUS NEED FOR A STRONGER ARMED FORCE TO DEAL WITH THE KURDS MAY STRENGTHEN THE ARMY'S EFFORTS TO REORGANIZE. ON THE OTHER HAND, WE ASSUME THAT COMMAND AND CONTROL WAS ALMOST NON-EXISTANT DURING THE PAVEH INCIDENT AND THIS MAY SIMPLY LEAD TO FURTHER TENSION IN THE ARMED FORCES.

THERE HAS BEEN GREAT RELUCTANCE IN THE ARMED FORCES AND EVEN AMONG THE LAW ENFORCEMENT AGENCIES TO GET INVOLVED IN PUTTING DOWN CIVIL UNREST. THIS RELUCTANCE WAS AGAIN EVIDENT AMONG THESE ORGANIZATIONS IN THE CASE OF THE FIGHTING AT PAVEH.

THE PGOI'S RESPONSE TO THE PAVEH INCIDENT MAY ALSO BE PART OF AN OVER ALL TOUGHENING OF CONTROL BY KHOMEINI AND HIS FORCE WHICH IN THE PAST WEEK MOVED TO CLOSE THE OPPOSITION PRESS IN TEHRAN AND HAVE BEEN TAKING A MORE CONFRONTATIONAL POSTURE AGAINST OPPOSITION GROUPS SUCH AS THE NATIONAL DEMOCRATIC FRONT, THE FEDAYAN-EKHALQ AND EVEN THE MOJAHEDIN-E-KHALQ. LAINGEN

PRESS ATTACHE ROSEN MET WITH FATHULLAH VALA, GENERAL DIRECTOR OF THE WEEKLY POLITICAL MAGAZINE, TEHRAN MOSSAVAR, ONE OF APPROXIMATELY TWENTY TWO PUBLICATIONS CLOSED BY ORDER OF AYATOLLAH QUMI, THE TEHRAN REVOLUTIONARY PROSECUTOR. ROSEN HAD AN APPOINTMENT WITH THE PUBLISHER, ABDULLAH VALA, BUT WAS TOLD BOTH HE AND THE EDITOR, MASSOUD BEHNOUD, WERE IN HIDING TO AVOID AN ARREST WARRANT. FATHULLAH VALA SAID THE PRETEXT FOR THE CLOSURE WAS ARTICLE TWO OF THE NEW PRESS LAW WHICH STATES THAT INDIVIDUALS AFFILIATED WITH THE FORMER REGIME ARE BARRED FROM PUBLISHING.

VALA NOTED THAT HIS BROTHER WAS IN FACT A FORMER MAJLIS MEMBER FROM KHALKHAL IN AZERBAIJAN, BUT THAT HE, ALONG WITH SEVERAL OTHER PUBLISHERS, LOST HIS LICENCE UNDER THE FORMER REGIME IN 1974. VALA ADDED THAT HE IS PROTESTING THE CLOSURE ON THE GROUNDS THAT THE PRESS LAW WAS PASSED BY AN EXECUTIVE BODY, THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL, RATHER THAN BY A LEGISLATIVE BODY AND ALSO BECAUSE A PUBLICATION HAS, ACCORDING TO THE CODE ITSELF, THREE MONTHS TO PETITION THE GOVERNMENT BEFORE IT IS ACTUALLY CLOSED.

VALA IS CERTAIN SADEQ QOTBZADEH IS BEHIND THE ENTIRE WAVE OF PRESS CENSORSHIP AND CHARACTRIZED THE NIRT CHIEF AS HITLER-LIKE, "KISSING KHOMEINI'S HAND AND GETTING WHATEVER HE WANTS." VALA SAID THE STAFF AT TEHRAN MOSSAVAR WAS OUT TO GET QOTBZADEH AND SEVERAL MONTHS AGO CAME UP WITH A PHOTO OF HIM WITH THE SHAH. MOREOVER, A RECENT ISSUE CARRIED AN EXPOSE OF QOTBZADEH AND HIS AFFILIATIONS WITH SOUTH TEHRAN THUGS USED BY THE NIRT DIRECTOR TO TERRORIZE OPPONENTS. VALA FEELS QOTBZADEH'S DIRECT LINKS WITH AND CONSTANT REPORTING ON PRESS ACTIVITIES TO THE AYATOLLAH LED TO KHOMEINI'S LATEST ASSAULT AGAINST THOSE WHO DO NOT FOLLOW THE HEZBULLAH LINE.

THE CONVERSATION ENDED WITH A TELEPHONE CALL FROM VALA'S DISTRIBUTOR WHO TOLD HIM THAT EIGHTY THOUSAND COPIES OF THE LAST ISSUE WERE BEING CONFISCATED BY LOCAL KOMITEHS. VALA ADDED "IT LOOKS LIKE THE STAFF WILL HAVE TO GO UNDERGROUND" AND BEMOANED HIS OWN UNMITIGATED AND IRRATIONAL SUPPORT OF KHOMEINI DURING THE HEADY DAYS OF THE REVOLUTION.

COMMENT: ALTHOUGH VALA WILL TRY TO APPROACH THE PRIME MINISTER'S OFFICE AND THE MINISTRY OF NATIONAL GUIDANCE WITH A PETITION TO PUT THE LICENSE UNDER A NEW NAME, THIS PLOY IS UNLIKELY TO WORK, GIVEN THE MAGAZINE'S HARD-HITTING INVESTIGATIVE REPORTING AND THE REGIME'S THIN SKIN. ALTHOUGH VALA IS PROBABLY OVERESTIMATING QOTBZADEH'S DIRECT INFLUENCE, IT IS NONETHELESS INTERESTING THAT KHOMEINI'S LATEST DIATRIBE AGAINST THE PRESS USED TERMINOLOGY SIMILAR TO THAT USED BY THE NIRT CHIEF LESS THAN TWO WEEKS AGO. IN ANY CASE, THE REGIME IS CLEARLY ATTEMPTING TO QUELL OPPOSITION BY

ACCORDING TO AN IRANIAN SOURCE WHO ARRIVED FROM KERMANSHAH AUGUST 20, THE LOCAL AIRPORT WAS "FILLED WITH HUNDREDS"OF INCOMING MILITARY PERSONNEL. THE SOURCE, WHO HAS JUST FINISHED HIS OWN MILITARY SERVICE, CLAIMS THAT ALL THOSE AT THE AIRPORT WERE REGULAR SOLDIERS (I.E., NOT REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS) AND THAT THEY WERE MOSTLY FROM THE KHORRASSAN AREA.

THE SOURCE, AN ETHNIC KURD FROM ILAM AND A MEMBER OF THE MALEK-SHAHI TRIBE, ALSO CLAIMED THAT THE CITIES OF ILAM AND IWAN WOULD WITNESS SERIOUS UNREST SHORTLY AFTER THE RAMEZAN FASTING PERIOD ENDS ON 24 AUGUST. HE HAS JUST RETURNED FROM A VISIT TO THOSE CITIES, AND SAYS THAT WOMEN AND CHILDREN ARE ALREADY BEING SENT AWAY IN PREPARATION FOR THE COMING ANTI-PGOI AND ANTI-REVOLUTIONARY GUARD CLASHES. LAINGEN

1979TEHRAN09306.subject: ; MEDIA REACT IN AN ARTICLE PUBLISHED IN THE AUGUST 21 EDITION OF PEYAM-E SHAHID, THE REGIME-ORIENTED DAILY OF

segments.text: IN AN ARTICLE PUBLISHED IN THE AUGUST 21 EDITION OF PEYAM-E SHAHID, THE REGIME-ORIENTED DAILY OF MUHAMMAD MONTAZERI, THE CIA IS ACCUSED OF PAYING THE IRANIAN PRESS MILLIONS OF DOLLARS. THE ARTICLE, "THE U.S. STRATEGY," MAINTAINS THAT THE PAYOFFS ARE THE ONLY WAY TO EXPLAIN THE "FICTITIOUS ARTICLES PUBLISHED BY THE PRESS." IT GOES ON TO SAY THAT, AS IN CHILE, THE CIA IS AFFILIATED WITH CERTAIN PUBLISHERS, I.E. AYANDEGAN AND PEYGAM-E EMRUZ, AND CONTROLS WHAT IS PUBLISHED.

THE FOREIGN PRESS IS ALSO ATTACKED BY PEYAM-E SHAHID AS BEING CONTROLLED BY "CIA AND ZIONIST ELEMENTS." THE PAPER STATES, "WE KNOW THAT SINCE THE BEGINNING OF THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION THE MAJORITY OF THE WORLD PRESS, WHICH IS CONNECTED WITH ZIONIST, HAS PAINTED AN UGLY IMAGE OF OUR REVOLUTION." THE ARTICLE CONCLUDES BY LAUDING THE MANAGEMENT OF THE IRANIAN RADIO AND TELEVISION NETWORK FOR ITS STRONG MEASURES AGAINST THE CIA'S ATTEMPTED INFILTRATION OF THE AIRWAVES.

1979TEHRAN09349.subject: REVOLUTIONARY AND ANTI-KURDISH DEMOCRATIC PARTY FERVOR

segments.text: PARTY FERVOR (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

NATIONAL IRANIAN RADIO AND TELEVISION (NIRT) GAVE EXTENSIVE TELEVISED NEWS COVERAGE ON 20 AUGUST TO THE TEHRAN MOURNING DEMONSTRATION SURROUNDING THE BURIAL OF SEVERAL REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS KILLED AT PAVEH. OBVIOUSLY WELL CHOREOGRAPHED, THE CROWD OF THOUSANDS CHANTED DEATH THREATS AGAINST KURDISH RELIGIOUS LEADER SHEIKH EZZEDIN HOSSEINI AND KURDISH DEMOCRAT PARTY (KDP) LEADER ABUL RAHMAN GHASEMLOU. CHANT LEADERS FROM WITHIN THE CROWD COULD BE HEARD PLAINLY, AND THE DEMONSTRATORS REPEATED THEIR CURSES IN TRUE PEP RALLY FASHION.

IN ANOTHER ATTACK ON THE KDP, WHICH IS BEING BLAMED FOR INSTIGATING THE TROUBLE IN PAVEH, KHOMEINI CALLED ON THE PEOPLE OF KURDESTAN TO ARREST ITS LEADERS AND HAND THEM OVER TO THE AUTHORITIES. KHOMEINI CLAIMED THE PARTY WAS UNOFFICIAL, ILLEGAL AND "A PARTY OF SATAN". THE AYATOLLAH HAS ALSO BITTERLY ATTACKED SHEIKH EZZEDIN HOSSEINI, RELIGIOUS LEADER OF THE SUNNI KURDS, IN COMMENTS BROADCAST OVER NIRT. KHOMEINI DESCRIBED HOSSEINI AS BEING "CORRUPT ON EARTH." POSTERS CLAIMING THAT HOSSEINI IS AN AGENT OF SAVAK HAVE ALSO BEEN SEEN IN TEHRAN.

AYATOLLAH KHALKHALI HAS BEEN SENT TO PAVEH AND KERMANSHAH AS "HAKIM-E-SHAHR" (RELIGIOUS JUDGE) WITH A MANDATE TO EXECUTE THOSE FOUND GUILTY IN THE PAVEH CLASHES, AND THUS FAR 27 PEOPLE HAVE BEEN SUMMARILY EXECUTED. IN ADDITION TO KHALKHALI'S POPULAR REPUTATION AS A "MADMAN," THE ASSIGNMENT OF A SHIITE AS "RELIGIOUS JUDGE" OVER A PREDOMINANTLY SUNNI POPULATION HAS ALREADY BEEN DESCRIBED BY VARIOUS SOURCES TO POLOFF AS A DIRECT RELIGIOUS INSULT TO THE KURDISH SUNNIS. LAINGEN
(S - ENTIRE TEXT).

FOURTH POLITICAL DEPARTMENT HEAD BAYANDOR ASKED ME TO DROP BY HIS OFFICE FOR A FEW MINUTES BEFORE MY SCHEDULED APPOINTMENT WITH FOREIGN MINISTER YAZDI, AUGUST 22. THE SUBJECT TURNED OUT TO BE MY CONVERSATION REFTEL CONCERNING THE SHAH'S FAMILY.

BAYANDOR SAID THAT HE HAD INFORMED YAZDI OF WHAT I HAD SAID IN REFTEL CONCERNING THE PRESENCE OF THE SHAH'S FAMILY IN THE U.S. YAZDI HAD INSTRUCTED HIM TO PROTEST, ORALLY, THE ISSUANCE OF A VISA TO REZA SO THAT HE COULD STUDY IN THE U.S. I RESPONDED BY REMINDING BAYANDOR THAT WE HAD PREVIOUSLY TOLD THE PRIME MINISTER THAT THE SHAH'S CHILDREN WOULD BE STUDYING IN THE UNITED STATES. I SAID WE MADE NO DISTINCTION AMONG THE FOUR CHILDREN.

BAYANDOR SAID HE PERSONALLY WAS NOT AWARE OF ANY PREVIOUS CONVERSATION WITH THE PRIME MINISTER CONCERNING THE SHAH'S CHILDREN AND SAID THAT IF I WANTED TO PURSUE THE MATTER FURTHER, INCLUDING ANY FURTHER ELABORATION CONCERNING THE PROTEST HE WAS REGISTERING, I SHOULD TAKE IT UP WITH YAZDI DIRECTLY.
I CHOSE NOT TO MAKE ANY FURTHER COMMENTS OR RESPONSE TO YAZDI. THE PROTEST APPEARS TO HAVE BEEN ONE LARGELY FOR THE RECORD AND I SAW NO MERIT IN GETTING INVOLVED IN FURTHER DISCUSSION. LAINGEN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

CHARGE RAISED CUBAN DRAFT COMMUNIQUE AND ITS REAFFIRMATION OF THE ZIONISM/RACISM EQUATION WITH FM MINISTER YAZDI DURING AUGUST 22 MEETING. YAZDI REACTED BY ASKING, "WHAT IS YOUR OBJECTION TO THE EQUATION?" AND THEN LAUNCHING INTO A LECTURE ON THE AMERICAN DOUBLE STANDARD IN KEEPING ITS COMMITMENTS TO ISRAEL AND TO LEBANON, SPECIFICALLY THE LEBANESE SHIA COMMUNITY WHICH HAS BORNE THE BRUNT OF ISRAELI ATTACKS ON SOUTHERN LEBANON. IRAN, HE SAID, COULD NOT BE INDIFFERENT TO SUCH A BLATANTLY RACIST POLICY WHICH IS INTENDED TO EXTERMINATE THE LEBANESE SHIA COMMUNITY.

HE SAID THAT ON THIS SCORE IRAN AGREES WITH THE CUBAN DRAFT, ALTHOUGH IT WILL TAKE AN INDEPENDENT STANCE ON OTHER ISSUES WHERE IT APPEARS TO IRAN THE PURPOSE OF GENUINE NON-ALIGNMENT ARE BEING SUBVERTED.

A LONG DISCUSSION ENSUED AS TO WHAT POSITION THE U.S. HAD TAKEN TOWARD ISRAELI RAIDS, WITH YAZDI REFUSING TO BACK AWAY FROM HIS INSISTENCE THAT THE U.S. HAS NOT DEALT WITH THE SITUATION IN AN EVEN-HANDED MANNER. ON THE SUBJECTS OF ISRAEL, ZIONISM AND RACISM YAZDI CLEARLY HAD VERY FIXED OPINIONS AND WAS NOT TO BE MOVED FROM THEM. WE CAN EXPECT NO HELP WHATSOEVER FROM IRAN AT THE NAM CONFERENCE ON THE ISSUE OF ZIONISM/RACISM. HOWEVER, WE ARE SOMEWHAT MORE OPTIMISTIC ABOUT THE POSITION IRAN WILL TAKE ON OTHER TOPICS IN THE CUBAN DRAFT. INDEED YAZDI STATED THAT HE DID NOT AGREE WITH EVERYTHING IN THE CUBAN DRAFT.
LAINGEN NOTE BY OC/T: NOT PASSED ABOVE ADDRESSEE.

1979TEHRAN09385.subject: COMMITTEE OF 24 VOTE ON PUERTO RICO

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

DURING AUGUST 22 MEETING WITH FM YAZDI CHARGE EXPRESSED OUR DISAPPOINTMENT IN IRAN'S VOTE IN FAVOR OF THE CUBAN-IRAQI RESOLUTION ON PUERTO RICO. YAZDI FIRST REACTED BY SAYING THAT IRAN HAD NOT VOTED FOR IT, BUT WHEN CHARGE ASSURED HIM THAT IT HAD, YAZDI BACKED OFF, CLAIMING THAT HE HAD NOT BEEN BRIEFED ON THE MATTER.

WE DO NOT DOUBT THAT YAZDI DID NOT HAVE ANY IDEA WHAT HIS REPRESENTATIVE IN NEW YORK WAS DOING. AS WE HAVE POINTED OUT IN PREVIOUS REPORTING, THE FOREIGN MINISTRY REMAINS IN CONSIDERABLE DISARRAY, TO THE EXTENT THAT THE POSITIONS IRAN TAKES IN SUCH MULTI-LATERAL FORA AS THE COMMITTEE OF 24 HAVE BEEN AND WILL CONTINUE TO BE DETERMINED MORE BY THE CHARACTER OF THE REPRESENTATION IN ATTENDANCE THAN BY WHATEVER VAGUE POLICY PRONOUNCEMENTS THE PGOI MAY HAVE MADE REGARDING THE ISSUES ADDRESSED.

ACCORDINGLY, WHEN A SENIOR REPRESENTATIVE, SUCH AS YAZDI HIMSELF, IS ON THE SPOT, DECISIONS WILL TEND TO BE BASED ON A PRAGMATIC ASSESSMENT OF IRAN'S NATIONAL INTEREST, WHEREAS WHEN THE REPRESENTATIVE IS A RELATIVELY JUNIOR PERSON (MORE THAN LIKELY WITHOUT INSTRUCTIONS FROM TEHRAN), THE PROBABILITY FOR IDEOLOGICAL EXTREMISM WILL RISE.

THE PRESS RELEASES CONTAINED IN REFTEL ARE BEING TRANSMITTED TO YAZDI UNDER COVER OF A LETTER FROM THE CHARGE. WE SEE NO POINT IN ASKING FOR IRAN'S RATIONALE IN VOTING FOR THE RESOLUTION. HAD THE MATTER BEEN APPROACHED RATIONALLY, IRAN MAY WELL HAVE ABSTAINED. LAINGEN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).
ROBERT PRYOR, TEHRAN COMMUNITY CHURCH CHAPLIN, WHO WAS IN ISFAHAN AT EPISCOPALIAN CHURCH AT TIME OF INCIDENT REFTEL GAVE FOLLOWING ACCOUNT TO CHARGE.

PRYOR SAID THAT SUNDAY AUGUST 19 A GROUP OF UNIDENTIFIED MEN SHOWED UP AT EPISCOPALIAN COMPOUND IN ISFAHAN. THEY ENTERED AND SEARCHED THE HOUSE OF BISHOP DEGHANI-TAFTI SEIZING ALL FILES INCLUDING PERSONAL FILES, PICTURES AND PHOTO ALBUMS. THEY NEXT ENTERED THE CHURCH OFFICE, SEIZED ALL THE FILES INCLUDING CHURCH RECORDS, CHECKBOOKS, LEDGERS AND PERSONNEL RECORDS AND BURNT THEM IN THE CHURCH YARD. (ONE PERSON PRESENT BELIEVED HE SAW SOME OF THE RECORDS BEING CARRIED OFF). CHURCH OFFICIALS DID IDENTIFY ONE OF THE GROUP OF 30 AS THE SON OF THE HEAD OF THE PUBLIC HEALTH DEPARTMENT OF ISFAHAN.
DURING THE INCIDENT NO ONE WAS HURT BUT THE GROUP WARNED THE BISHOP THEY WOULD BE BACK. TO DATE NOTHING NEW HAS HAPPENED.

IN A SEPARATE INCIDENT SATURDAY AUGUST 18, DEMONSTRATORS IN ISFAHAN ATTACKED BOOKSTORES, TAKING BOOKS OUT INTO THE STREET AND BURNING THEM. APPROXIMATELY 20 BOOKSTORES WERE HIT INCLUDING THE CHRISTIAN ONE. WE HAVE NO REASON TO BELIEVE THAT THE CHRISTIAN BOOKSTORE WAS INANY WAY SINGLED OUT DURING THIS INCIDENT.

INCIDENT IN ISFAHAN WAS VERY DISTURBING TO PRYOR WHO STATES HE IS DESTROYING SELECTED CHURCH RECORDS IN TEHRAN TO AVOID POSSIBILITY THEY TOO MIGHT BE SEIZED AT SOME POINT. PRYOR PERSONALLY BELIEVES THAT PGOI IS BEGINNING A POLICY OF "ADMINISTRATIVE AND FINANCIAL STRANGULATIONN AIMED AT THE REPRESSION OF CHRISTIANS AND CHRISTIAN ORGANIZATIONS IN IRAN. AS PROOF HE POINTS TO THE OCCUPATION OF THREE CHRISTIAN HOSPITALS IN ISFAHAN, SHIRAZ AND GOVEH; THE OCCUPATION OF THE LUTHERAN SCHOOL FOR THE BLIND AND THE COMMUNITY SCHOOL IN TEHRAN; AND THE CANCELLATION OF THE WORK PERMITS OF 22 FOREIGN MISSIONARY AND MEDICAL WORKERS IN ISFAHAN.
WE WILL CONTINUE TO KEEP CLOSE TRACK OF THIS SITUATION. CHARGE RAISED THE QUESTION OF HARASSMENT OF CHRISTIAN COMMUNITY WITH FOREIGN MINISTER YAZDI AUGUST 22 (SEE SEPTEL).
EMBASSY THINKS IT MIGHT BE HELPFUL IF DEPARTMENT WOULD ALSO RAISE THIS QUESTION WITH IRANIAN CHARGE IN

SUMMARY: CIVIL UNREST IS SPREADING. THE CITY OF TABRIZ HAS EXPERIENCED A NUMBER OF OMINOUS INCIDENTS. SOME OBSERVERS FEEL THAT TABRIZ COULD WITNESS SEVERE VIOLENCE IN THE NEAR FUTURE. RIVALRY AMONG VARIOUS COMMITTEES, POLITICAL AND RELIGIOUS GROUPS, AS WELL AS A DETERIORATING ECONOMIC SITUATION MAY SOON BRING THE CITY TO THE EXPLODING POINT. TEHRAN HAS WITNESSED ITS OWN INCREASE IN DEMONSTRATIONS AND PROTESTS, AND INJURIES AND ARRESTS OF PARTICIPANTS ARE BECOMING ALMOST A RULE OF THE DAY. THE PGOI IS EXPANDING ITS CAMPAIGN AGAINST THE FEDAYAN-E-KHALQ AND THE MUJAHEDEEN-E-KHALQ, AND VARIOUS OFFICES BELONGING TO THESE ORGANIZATIONS HAVE BEEN SEIZED BY GOVERNMENT FORCES. END SUMMARY.

COMMITTEE TENSIONS AND CIVIL UNREST SEEM TO BE INCREASING IN TABRIZ. THE PRESS REPORTS THAT ONE REVOLUTIONARY GUARD AND A PASSER-BY WERE KILLED AND TWO OTHER PEOPLE WERE INJURED IN A ONE HOUR SHOOT-OUT BETWEEN MEMBERS OF ISLAMIC COMMITTEES IN THE EAST AZARBAIJAN CAPITAL LAST WEEK. ON 12 AUGUST, SEVERAL FRUIT SHOPS AND ROAD SIDE STALLS WERE RANSACKED IN AN "ANTI-PROFITEERING" DEMONSTRATION WHICH BEGAN NEAR THE BAZAAR AND EXTENDED TO OTHER PARTS OF THE CITY. OTHER SHOPS IN THE CITY WERE ALSO DAMAGED. A TABRIZ JOURNALIST TOLD POLOFF THE DEMONSTRATION WAS THE RESULT OF INTENSE LOCAL DISSATISFACTION OVER ECONOMIC CONDITIONS IN THE CITY, WHERE UNEMPLOYMENT IS REPORTEDLY VERY HIGH.

FOODSTUFFS AND OTHER GOODS STRIPPED FROM LOCAL SHOPS WERE SOLD BY PROTEST LEADERS TO THE DEMONSTRATING CROWDS AT WHAT THE PROTESTORS FELT WERE FAIR PRICES. THE DEMONSTRATION LED AYATOLLAH MADANI, KHOMEINI'S REPRESENTATIVE AS LEADER OF THE TABRIZ COMMITTEE STRUCTURE, TO ISSUE A STATEMENT CLAIMING PROFITEERING WAS COUNTER REVOLUTIONARY, AND THAT OFFENDERS COULD FACE THE DEATH SENTENCE. MADANI ALSO CASTIGATED THE DEMONSTRATORS FOR BEING "REACTIONARIES AND COUNTER-REVOLUTIONARIES."

ON 18 AUGUST DEMONSTRATORS ATTACKED THE TUDEH PARTY OFFICE IN TABRIZ, AND TWO MEMBERS OF THE PARTY WERE ARRESTED BY REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS. ON 19 AUGUST, THE FEDAYAN-E-KHALQ HEADQUARTERS WAS ALSO ATTACKED AND OCCUPIED.

THE SITUATION IN TABRIZ IS NOT BEING FULLY REPORTED IN THE LOCAL PRESS, AND CERTAINLY THE INTRICACIES OF LOCAL POLITICS ARE PLAYING A SIGNIFICANT ROLE IN THE TEMPER OF THE CITY. COMMITTEE RIVALRY WITHIN TABRIZ HAS BEEN CARRIED TO EXTRAORDINARY LENGTHS, WITH AT LEAST THREE PARRALLEL AND OPPOSING COMMITTEE HIERARCHICAL STRUCTURES STRUGGLING FOR DOMINANCE. A POWER STRUGGLE BETWEEN THREE OF THE CITY'S LEADING MULLAHS HAS ALSO BEEN GOING ON FOR SOME MONTHS, ADDING TO THE POLITICAL CONFUSION CAUSED BY THE EXISTENCEOF A MYRIAD OF OTHER CONFLICTING GROUPS.

KHOMEINI HAS ORDERED AND AYATOLLAH SHARIAT-MADARI HAS ENDORSED THE SENDING OF AN INVESTIGATIVE MISSION TO THE EAST AND WEST AZARBAIJAN PROVINCES. THE PURPOSE OF THE MISSION, HEADED BY AYATOLLAH MAHDAVI-KANI, IS TO PURGE THE LOCAL COMMITTEES,REVOLUTIONARY COURTS, PRISONS AND THE REVOLUTIONARY GUARD CORPS. ACCORDING TO A NUMBER OF SOURCES FROM THE CITY, TABRIZ COULD "BLOW UP" AT ANY TIME, AND ONLY THE CONSTANT VIGILANCE OF AYATOLLAH SHARIAT-MADARI HAS PREVENTED IT. THE INVESTIGATIVE COMMITTEE MAY DEFUSE THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH VIOLENCE.

TEHRAN HAS SEEN A SPATE OF DEMONSTRATIONS AND MARCHES DURING THE PAST WEEKS. ONE SERIES OF PROTESTS WAS CAUSED BY THE GOVERMENT'S CLOSING OF AYANDEGAN NEWSPAPER, AND SEVERAL INJURIES WERE REPORTED IN CLASHES BETWEEN ANTIAND PRO- AYANDEGAN GROUPS. REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS ARRESTED ------------------113821 251057Z /21 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 3398 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE AMEMBASSY PARIS SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 09396 OVER 40 MEMBERS OF THE STAFF OF AYANDEGAN AND ITS ASSOCIATED PRINTING HOUSE.

ON 12 AUGUST THE NATIONAL DEMOCRATIC FRONT ORGANIZED A DEMONSTRATION TO SUPPORT PRESS FREEDOM, AND DURING THE COURSE OF THE MARCH GROUPS IDENTIFIED ONLY AS ISLAMIC MILITANTS HURLED STONES AT THE DEMONSTRATORS, INJURING SEVERAL. THE MARCH WAS FINALLY BROKEN UP BY REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS USING TEAR GAS AND FIRING INTO THE AIR. ONE RESULT OF THE DEMONSTRATIONS WAS THE ISSUANCE OF ARREST WARRANTS FOR HEDAYATOLLAH MATIN-DAFTARI, WHOSE NATIONAL DEMOCRATIC FRONT IS BEING BLAMED FOR ORGANIZING AT LEAST TWO PROTEST MARCHES, AND REZA MARZBAN, EDITOR OF PAYGHAM-E-EMRUZ, WHO IS BEING SOUGHT FOR "CREATING DIVISION AND ENTICING PEOPLE TO RIOT" AS WELL AS PUBLISHING "A DIRECT INSULT TO IMAM KHOMEINI."

MUJAHEDEEN-E-KHALQ MEMBERS AND SYMPATHIZERS HAVE BEEN STAGING SIT-INS IN FRONT OF THEIR HEADQUARTERS NEAR MEYDAN-E-VALI ASR (FORMERLY MEYDAN-E-VALIAT) IN TEHRAN TO WARD OFF A THREATENED ATTACK AGAINST THE BUILDING, AND TWO TRUCKLOADS OF REVOLUTIONARY GUARDSMEN REMAINED NEAR THE BUILDING AS A PRECAUTIONARY MEASURE. THE MUJAHEDEEN FEARED THAT THEIR HEADQUARETERS MIGHT SUFFER THE FATE OF THE FEDAYAN-E-KHALQ HEADQUARTERS, WHICH WAS SEIZED BY "MOSLEM MILITANTS" ON AUGUST 13. SEVERAL GROUPS OF DEMONSTRATORS WERE REPORTED TO HAVE PASSED BY THE MUJAHEDEEN HEADQUARTERS SHOUTING THREATS AT THE BUILDING'S OCCUPANTS.

ENLISTING AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI'S HELP, THE MUJAHEDEEN BEGAN NEGOTIATIONS WITH THE PGOI AND THEIR CASE WAS TURNED OVER TO THE MINISTRY OF JUSTICE. THE MUJAHEDEEN WERE AT FIRST GIVEN ONE WEEK'S TIME TO ARRIVE AT A SOLUTION WITH THE GOVERNMENT OVER OCCUPANCY OF THEIR TEHRAN HEADQUARTERS, BUT ON 22 AUGUST THE BUILDING WAS FINALLY TAKEN AWAY FROM THEM. THE SEIZURE OF THE TEHRAN HEADQUARTERS FOLLOWS ATTACKS ON MUJAHEDEEN-E-KHALQ OFFICES IN AHVAZ AND ISFAHAN, AND A COMMITTEE RAID ON THEIR TEHRAN ARSENAL A FEW DAYS AGO. THE ATTACKS AND ARSENAL RAID ARE CONSISTENT WITH PGOI POLICY.
ACCORDDNG TO TEHRAN'S REVOLUTIONARY PROSECUTOR-GENERAL AYATOLLAH AZARI-QOMI, ALL GROUPS AND POLITICAL PARTIES WILL BE DISARMED, EXCEPT FOR THE MILITARY, THE REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS AND THE COMMITTEES.

TEHRAN UNIVERSITY WAS THE SCENE OF CLASHES DURING THE LAST WEEK, AND SEVERAL STUDENTS WERE INJURED IN FIGHTS BETWEEN RIVAL GROUPS. A NUMBER OF BOOKSHOPS NEAR THE UNIVERSITY WERE ALSO ATTACKED, AND THEIR BOOKS THROWN INTO THE STREET AND BURNED. SIMILAR BOOK SHOP ATTACKS TOOK PLACE IN ISFAHAN ON 18 AUGUST, WHERE ONE SOURCE CLAIMS OVER 20 SHOPS WERE HIT. EARLIER, THE CITY OF KERMANSHAH WITNESSED A SIMILAR EPISODE, WHEN THREE BOOK STORES WERE BURNED OUT.

IN A DEMONSTRATION DESCRIBED AS COMPOSED OF.MILLIONS OF PARTICIPANTS", IRANIANS EXPRESSED SUPPORT IN TEHRAN AND OTHER CITIES ON 17 MARCH FOR THE PALESTINIAN CAUSE. THE PEACEFUL DEMONSTRATION WAS CALLED BY KHOMEINI, WHO TOOK THE OPPORTUNITY IN A NATIONALLY BROADCAST SPEECH TO BLAST BOTH ISRAEL AND THE UNITED STATES, WHICH HE CLAIMED WERE ENEMIES OF ISLAM. LAINGEN

segments.text: PAVEH (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

A PHYSICIAN WORKING AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY TOLD EMBASSY POLITICAL OFFICER THAT A NUMBER OF MEDICAL PERSONNEL, INCLUDING A SECOND YEAR SURGICAL RESIDENT FROM TEHRAN UNIVERSITY HOSPITAL AND SEVERAL NURSING STUDENTS HAD BEEN SUMMARILY EXECUTED BY THE REVOLUTIONARY AUTHORITIES IN PAVEH HOSPITAL WITHOUT EVEN THE BENEFIT OF A HEARING. THESE MEDICAL PERSONNEL HAD GONE TO PAVEH IN RESPONSE TO THE CALL FOR VOLUNTEERS TO TREAT VICTIMS OF RECENT FIGHTING THERE.
ACCORDING TO THIS SOURCE, THESE PERSONS WERE EXECUTED AT KHALKHALI'S ORDER IMMEDIATELY AFTER HE DISCOVERED THEM TREATING WOUNDED KURDS.

SOURCE WAS VERY CERTAIN OF HIS INFORMATION, WHICH HE SAID HAD BEEN TRANSMITTED THROUGH A FRIEND OF THE EXECUTED SURGERY RESIDENT AND THEN CONFIRMED (ALTHOUGH NOT IN DETAIL) BY THE MINISTRY OF HEALTH. LAINGEN

1979TEHRAN09418.subject: TRIALS AND EXECUTIONS IN FACE OF KURDISH PROBLEMS

segments.text: EMBASSY OVER PAST WEEK HAS NOTED AN INCREASE IN TRIALS AND EXECUTIONS, NOT ALL OF WHICH ARE CONNECTED DIRECTLY TO THE KURDISH DISTURBANCES. WE SPECULATE, HOWEVER, PGOI ANNOUNCEMENTS THAT A MAJOR GROUP OF POLITICAL TRIALS ARE TO START SOON MAY WELL BE PART OF AN EFFORT TO RELIEVE SOME OF THE TENSIONS GENERATED BY THE FIGHTING IN KURDESTAN.

SINCE AUGUST 18 EMBASSY ESTIMATES APPROXIMATELY 32 KURDISH REBELS HAVE BEEN BROUGHT BEFORE ISLAMIC COURTS, SOME UNDER THE JURISDICTION OF AYATOLLAH SADEGH KHALKHALI, AND EXECUTED IN PAVEH AND KERMANSHAH. OTHER TRIALS ARE STILL ONGOING AND WE EXPECT MORE EXECUTIONS TO BE ANNOUNCED OVER THE WEEKEND. EXTREMELY HARSH POLICY TOWARD REBELS AMOUNTING ALMOST TO "TAKE NO PRISONERS" WILL UNDOUBTEDLY BRING A STRONG KURDISH REACTION. EMBASSY HAS ALREADY HEARD RUMORS THAT KURDS ARE THREATENING TO EXECUTE THEIR PASDARAN PRISONERS IN RETALIATION.

EMBASSY HAS COUNTED 15 OTHER EXECUTIONS SINCE AUGUST 18 IN TEHRAN AND OTHER PARTS OF THE COUNTRY NOT DIRECTLY RELATED TO THE KURDISH SITUATION. MOST OF THESE INVOLVED MINOR POLICE OFFICIALS, HEROIN SMUGGLERS AND AN ADULTRESS, BUT THIS FIGURE ALSO INCLUDES THREE AFAB REBELS IN KHUZISTAN AND THREE HIGH RANKING FORMER ARMY AND POLICE OFFICERS IN TEHRAN.

THE REVOLUTIONARY PROSECUTOR HAS ALSO ANNOUNCED THE TRIALS OF MAJOR GENERAL FIROUZMAND AND TWO OTHERS WHICH ARE PRESENTLY BEING HEARD IN TEHRAN AND THE PROSECUTOR'S INTENSION TO BRING TO TRIAL SHORTLY 33 FORMER GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS, SAVAK MEMBERS, BUSINESSMEN, ETC. THREE OF THOSE MENTIONED WERE FORMER MINISTERS IN THE GOVERNMENT OF SHAPUR BAKHTIAR: ABBAS GHOLI BAKHTIAR (INDUSTRY), AHMAD MIR-FENDERSKI (FOREIGN AFFAIRS) AND SSFOUS AMOUZEGAR-YEGANEH (INFORMATION). TOMSETH

POLCOUNS ASKED BAYANDOR AUGUST 22 IF HE HAD FOLLOWED UP FBI REQUEST FOR DOCUMENTS. BAYANDOR SAID HE HAD SPOKEN WITH FM YAZDI WHO HAD SUGGESTED THAT WE PURSUE THE REQUEST THROUGH THE IRANIAN EMBASSY IN WASHINGTON.

SINCE THE EMBASSY IN WASHINGTON SAID SOME TIME AGO THE DOCUMENTS IN QUESTION HAD BEEN SENT TO TEHRAN, WE HAVE NOW GONE FULL CIRCLE. AS WE SUGGESTED EARLIER, WE SERIOUSLY DOUBT THERE ARE ANY DOCUMENTS, AND ACCORDINGLY RECOMMEND THIS MATTER BE CLOSED. TOMSETH

SUMMARY: POLOFF SPENT A RECENT EVENING WITH A PERSIAN PROFESSIONAL MILITARY AND POLICE FAMILY WHO SERVE AS AN EXCELLENT EXAMPLE OF IRANIAN ADJUSTMENT TO THE POSTREVOLUTIONARY ERA. THEIR PAHLAVI PAST HAS NOT BEEN FORGOTTEN BY THE FAMILY, NOR HAVE OLD FRIENDS WHO ARE PRESENTLY SUFFERING ILL EFFECTS FROM THE POLITICAL CHANGE, BUT THE FAMILY HAS ALREADY MOVED TO CONSOLIDATE IT'S POST-REVOLUTIONARY POSITION. THE FAMILY MAINTAINS EXTENSIVE RELATIONSHIPS WITH BOTH PAHLAVI AND KHOMEINI ERA OFFICIALS, BUT IT WAS CLEAR THAT THEIR FIRST LOYALTIES WERE TO RELATIVES, FRIENDS AND THEIR RESPECTIVE SERVICES RATHER THAN TO EITHER REGIME AS SUCH. END SUMMARY.

HOST FOR THE EVENING WAS A POLICE CAPTAIN PRESENTLY ATTACHED TO THE HELICOPTER CORPS OF THE NATIONAL POLICE. SINCE FEBRUARY, THE CAPTAIN HAS ACTED AS HELICOPTER PILOT FOR PRI MIN BAZARGAN AND OTHER CABINET MEMBERS. HIS DUTIES OFTEN CARRY HIM TO QOM ON MINISTERIAL VISITS THERE. RECENTLY THE CAPTAIN REQUESTED HE BE RELIEVED OF THIS PARTICLAR DUTY, CITING TO POLOFF HIS EXTREME DISTASTE FOR THE GOVT OFFICIALS HE CARRIED AS HIS REASON FOR BOWING OUT OF THE TASK. (HIS REQUEST WAS DENIED). STRONGLY ANTI-CLERICAL, THE CAPTAIN CONSIDERS THE "AKHOUNDS" (CLERGYMEN) AS THE RUINATION OF IRAN, AND THE PGOI CABINET MEMBERS AS CLERGICAL PAWNS.

AT THE SAME TIME, THE CAPTAIN AND HIS FAMILY ARE DEEPLY RELIGIOUS, BUT RESERVE THEIR HOMAGE FOR A SUFI MYSTIC IN TEHRAN WHO HAS CAUTIONED HIS FOLLOWERS NOT TO GET INVOLVED IN POLITICS. WHILE RETAINING HIS POSITION IN THE POLICE FORCE, THE CAPTAIN HAS ADOPTED A PERSONAL POLICY OF SITTING BACK AND WATCHING EVENTS UNFOLD. HE FEELS THAT THE PRESENT REGIME HAS NO FUTURE IN IRAN AND FOR THIS REASON WANTED QUIETLY TO DISASSOCIATE HIMSELF FROM PUBLIC CONTACT WITH HIGHER RANKING PGOI OFFICIALS.

THE ELDEST BROTHER OF THE MAJOR WHO IS A COLONEL AND DEPUTY DIRECTOR OF THE NATIONAL POLICE ACADMEY, WAS ALSO PRESENT. THE COLONEL HAS PROFITTED A GREAT DEAL FROM POST-REVOLUTIONARY CHANGES WITHIN THE POLICE, AND EXPECTS TO ATTAIN RANK OF GENERAL AND DIRECTORSHIP OF THE ACADEMY SOON. DESPITE HIS KHOMEINI ERA PROMOTION AND PROMISES OF AN EVEN BETTER ASSIGNMENT, THE COLONEL IS ALSO OPPOSED TO THE PRESENT ROLE OF THE "AKHOUNDS". HIS LOYALTIES REMAIN FIRST AND FOREMOST TO THE POLICE AND TO HIS PEERS WITHIN THE OTHER TRADITIONAL SECURITY FORCES.

DESPITE PRESSURE FROM HIS WIFE TO RESIGN AND IMMIGRATE TO THE USA (THE COLONEL'S SISTER IS AN AMCIT), HE HAS DECIDED TO REMAIN IN IRAN, EVEN THOUGH HE FACES CONSIDERABLE PROBLEMS IN HIS PROFESSION. THE COL CLAIMS THAT MORALE AND DISCIPLINE WITHIN THE OFFICER CORPS OF THE POLICE HAS GREATLY IMPROVED, BUT THAT THERE IS STILL CONFLICT BETWEEN OFFICERS AND LOWER RANKS. THIS HAS EVEN BEEN EVIDENT AT THE POLICE ACADEMY, WHERE "PASBAN" (LOWEST RANKING STREET COPS) STAGED A RECENT DEMONSTRATION TO DEMAND OFFICER STATUS.

THE ACADEMY'S ENTRANCE EXAMINATION FOR THE COMING FRESHMAN CLASS ALSO HAD TO BE CANCELLED, THE COLONEL CLAIMED, BECAUSE "THERE WAS NO WAY TO INVESTIGATE PERSONAL BACKGROUNDS." THE FACULTY WERE AFRAID THAT COMMUNIST AND OTHER UNDESIRABLE ELEMENTS MIGHT INFILTRATE THE ACADEMY THROUGH THE EXAM CHANNEL.

THE CAPTAIN'S FATHER-IN-LAW, A RETIRED ARMY GENERAL, WAS THE RANKING GUEST. AN ETHNIC KURD FROM KERMANSHAH, THE GENERAL EXPLAINED THAT HE HAD RETIRED FROM THE ARMY 12 YEARS AGO, BUT THIS HAD NOT PREVENTED HIS BEING IMPRISONED IN THE POST-REVOLUTIONARY ERA. THE GENERAL HAS SPENT 41 DAYS IN QASR PRISON, AND VARIOUS CELLMATES OF HIS HAD BEEN EXECUTED DURING HIS TIME THERE.

HIS IMPRISONMENT HAD COINCIDED WITH HIS SON-IN-LAW'S BEING PM BAZARGAN'S PILOT, AND WITH HIS OWN SON BEING NAMED CONSUL GENERAL TO BAKU AT AMB TO USSR MOKRI'S PERSONAL ------------------123293 270054Z /64 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 3435 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 09445 EQUEST. THE GENERAL CLAIMED HE HAD BEEN TREATED WELL AT QASR, AND AFTER FAMILY INFLUENCE HAD OBTAINED HIS RELEASE, OFFICIALS FROM THE REVOLUTIONARY PROSECUTOR GENERAL'S OFFICE HAD APOLOGIZED TO HIM FOR THE ARREST.

SEVERAL TIMES DURING THE EVENING THE GENERAL WAS CALLED TO THE TELEPHONE, AND HE RETURNED EACH TIME CLAIMING THAT "PAVEH WAS GETTING WORSE." THE GENERAL REMAINS IN CLOSE TOUCH WITH BOTH RETIRED AND ACTIVE MILITARY PERSONNEL, AND DESCRIVED HIMSELF AS A "VERY CLOSE FRIEND OF GEN PALIZABAN," WHO HE CLAIMED WAS STILL IN THE KURDISH AREA OF IRAN.

IT WAS CLEAR THAT THIS GROUP OF OFFICERS RETAINED CONTACT WITH SOME OFFICIALS WHO HAD FLED THE COUNTRY, AND IN SOME CASES THEY PROFESSED TO KNOW EXACTLY WHO HAD HELPED SUCH ESCAPEES. IN ONE EXAMPLE, THEY DESCRIBED GEN MOBASSER'S FLIGHT. HE HAD ESCAPED VIA THE TURKISH BORDER AND BEEN MET ON THE TURKISH SIDE BY A BLACK MERCEDES BENZ. PAYMENT FOR THE ESCAPE CAME TO 40,000 TOMEN BECAUSE OF THE GENERAL'S RANK AND HIS USE OF A DIPLOMATIC PASSPORT. ONCE IN EUROPE, CLAIMED THE DINNER GUESTS, GEN. MOBASSER CONTACTED EX-AMB HELMS, WHO PHONED THE LOCAL AMERICAN EMBASSY AND OBTAINED A VISA FOR HIM.
OTHER NAMES AND METHODS WERE MENTIONED, AND THE GROUP OBVIOUSLY VIEWED ALL SUCH SCARLET PIMPERNEL EFFORTS WITH THE GREATEST OF SYMPATHY.

THE DINNER GROUP WAS NOTEWORTHY BOTH BECAUSE OF THE WAY ITS SERVICE LOYALTY SEEMSEEMED TO OUTWEIGHT LOYALTY TO THE REGIME, AND ALSO BECAUSE IT CLEARLY SHOWED THAT CONTACTS ARE BEING MAINTAINED AMONG OFFICERS WHO ARE ON ACTIVE DUTY, ARE RETIRED, AND ARE EVEN IN FUGITIVE STATUS. AT ONE POINT THE RETIRED GENERAL STATED THAT HE WAS IN TOUCH WITH GENERAL PALIZBAN'S FAMILY, FOR EXAMPLE, AND NONE OF THE OTHER GUEST SEEMED TO THINK HIS ADMISSION WAS OUT OF PLACE. POLOFF HAS ATTENDED MANY OTHER SIMILAR PRIVATE FUNCTIONS, WHERE ARMY, POLICE AND NAVY OFFICERS OF DIFFERENT RANKS HAVE BEEN PRESENT.

THE INTER-SERVICE MIXTURE HAS AT TIMES BEEN DUE TO FAMILY RELATIONSHIPS, BUT MORE OFTEN HAS BEEN SIMPLY DUE TO MEMBERS OF THE VARIOUS GROUPS BEING CLOSE FRIENDS. SUCH GROUPS SEEM TO HAVE STRONGER LOYALTY TO EACH THAN TO THE PRESENT REGIME, AND THEIR LOYALTIES AND FRIENDSHIP TIES EXTEND BOTH VERTICALLY AND HORIZONTALLY WITHIN THE SERVICE STRUCTURES. DESPITE THE FACT THAT SUCH OFFICERS HAVE RETAINED OR EVEN ADVANCED IN THEIR POSITIONS SINCE THE REVOLUTION, MANY OF THEM HAVE EXPRESSED SENTIMENTS RANGING FROM DISSATISFACTION TO EXTREME DISLIKE OF THE KHOMEINI REGIME AND "AKHOUND" INFLUENCE WITHIN THE COUNTRY.

THE PGOI REALIZES THE DANGER OF RETAINING THE PAHLAVI ERA OFFICER CORPS WITHIN THE POLICE FORCE, AND BUREAUCRATIC STEPS HAVE ALREADY BEEN TAKEN TO EASE THE MASS OF SUCH HIGHER RANKING OFFICERS OUT OF THEIR POSITIONS. ACCORDING TO THE POLICE COLONEL, A PLAN HAS BEEN APPROVED (BUT NOT YET ANNOUNCED) TO GRANT ALL POLICE FIVE YEARS ADVANCE ON TIME IN SERVICE. SUCH A STEP WILL ALLOW MANY POLICEMEN A WELCOME OPPORTUNITY TO RETIRE EARLY,AND ALSO REMOVED A POTENTIAL THREAT TO THE PGOI.

1979TEHRAN09446.subject: RECENT MOVES AGAINST THE IRANIAN PRESS

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: IRANIAN AUTHORITIES HAVE TAKEN STEPS TO CLOSE DOWN A LARGE NUMBER OF NEWSPAPERS AND MAGAZINES IN TEHRAN AND THE PROVINCES. THE REVOLUTIONARY PROSECUTOR OF TEHRAN AND THE MINISTRY OF NATIONAL GUIDANCE HAVE ISSUED LISTS ANNOUNCING THE CLOSING. ALTHOUGH THERE ARE SOME DIFFERENCES BETWEEN THE LISTS AND THERE ARE VARYING JUSTIFICATIONS FOR THE CLOSINGS, THE MAJOR TARGETS ARE THE SAME. OTHER PUBLICATIONS ARE BEING REVIEWED FOR POSSIBLE CLOSING. IF CLOSINGS ARE CARRIED OUT, MEDIA CRITICISM OF PRESENT AUTHORITIES WILL HAVE BEEN EFFECTIVELY SILENCED. NN THIS CAMPAIGN, GOVERNMENT IS DOING NO MORE THAN OLLOWING INITIATIVE OF REVOLUTIONARY AUTHORITIES. END SUMMARY.

FOLLOWING THE PROMULGATION OF THE PRESS LAW ON AUGUST 11, THE AUTHORITIES ARE MOVING AGAINST MUCH OF THE IRANIAN PRESS, WHICH HAS BEEN OPERATING RELATIVELY WITHOUT RESTRICTION SINCE THE FEBRUARY REVOLUTION. ALTHOUGH ADMINISTRATIVE DISORGANIZATION HAS KEPT THESE ANTI-PRESS MOVES DISJOINTED, THE AUTHORITIES CLEARLY INTEND TO CLOSE PUBLICATIONS NOT TO THE LIKING OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI AND HIS ALLIES.

ON AUGUST 20, THE PUBLIC PROSECUTOR OF THE CENTRAL REVOLUTIONARY COURT OF TEHRAN, AHMAD AZARI-QOMI, ISSUED A STATEMENT THAT TWENTY-SIX NEWSPAPERS AND MAGAZINES HAD BEEN ORDERED CLOSED. IN AN INTERVIEW ON IRANIAN TELEVISION THAT EVENING AZARI-QOMI SAID THAT THESE PAPERS HAD BEEN BANNED BECAUSE OF CONSPIRACY AGAINST THE REVOLUTION AND FOR DISTORTION OF FACTS. HE NOTED THAT THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS WERE REVIEWING THE STATUS OF OTHER PAPERS AND THAT FURTHER CLOSINGS COULD BE EXPECTED.

THE NEXT DAY THE PERSIAN-LANGUAGE ETTALA'AT REPORTED THAT THE MINISTRY OF NATIONAL GUIDANCE HAD PREPARED TWO LISTS OF FORTY-ONE PUBLICATIONS IN TEHRAN AND THE PROVINCES TO BE CLOSED. THE FIRST LIST NAMED PAPERS TO BE CLOSED UNDER FOOTNOTE TO ARTICLE 2 OF THE NEW PRESS LAW WHICH FORBIDS OFFICIALS AND ASSOCIATES OF THE PREVIOUS REGIME FROM PUBLISHING. THE SECOND MINISTRY LIST NAMED PAPERS TO BE CLOSED UNDER FOOTNOTE 1 OF ARTICLE 2 OF THE SAME LAW--A FOOTNOTE WHICH DEALS WITH FINANCIAL COMPENSATION FOR PAPERS BANNED UNDER THE MONARCHY. SEVERAL IMPORTANT PUBLICATIONS, SUCH AS TEHRAN MOSSAVAR AND FERDOWSI, APPEARED ON BOTH LISTS. EIGHTEEN PROVINCIAL NEWSPAPERS WERE ALSO BANNED FOR UNSPECIFIED REASONS.

GUIDANCE MINISTER MINACHI TOLD A TELEVISION REPORTER THAT SINCE THE BANNED PUBLICATIONS HAD VIOLATED EXPLICIT PROVISIONS OF THE PRESS LAW, THERE EXISTED NO POSSIBILITY OF APPEAL OF THE MINISTRY'S DECISION.

THESE ACTIONS CAME SHORTLY AFTER THE CLOSING OF AYANDEGAN'S PRINTING PLANT. THIS CLOSING RESULTED IN FOUR OR FIVE OTHER PAPERS, INCLUDING THE POPULAR HUMOR MAGAZINE AHANGAR, LOSING THEIR PRINTING FACILITIES. ALTHOUGH THE CLOSING OF THESE OTHER PAPERS MAY HAVE BEEN A COINCIDENCE, SUCH A COINCIDENCE SILENCED SOME OUTSPOKEN CRITICS OF 1ANY OF THE POLICIES AND PERSONALITIES OF THE REGIME.

THE MAJOR TARGETS OF THE LATEST CLOSING INCLUDE THE MAGAZINES FERDOWSI, JAVANAN, SEPID-0-SIYAH, OMID-E-IRAN, AND TEHRAN MOSSAVAR. IN ADDITION TO AHANGAR, CLOSED EARLIER, THE HUMOR MAGAZINES BOHLUL AND HAJI BABA WERE ALSO CLOSED. MOST OF THESE PUBLICATIONS ADVOCATED NON-MARXIST, SECULAR POLICIES AND WERE VOCAL ADVOCATES ------------------123297 270057Z /64 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 3437 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 09446 OF PRESS FREEDOM.

IN GENERAL THEIR EDITORIAL POLICIES INCLUDED: - A) STRONG CRITICISM OF GOVERNMENT FIGURES SUCH AS QOTBZADEH, YAZDI, AND MINACHI. MILD CRITICISM OF BAZARGAN. - B) DETAILED REPORTING ON THE EVENTS OF THE PERIOD OF DR. MOSSADEGH AND ON THE ACTIVITIES OF THE NATIONAL FRONT DURING THE EARLY FIFTIES. - C) COMPLETE MISTRUST OF AMERICAN POLICY TOWARD IRAN, COUPLED WITH A VIEW OF YAZDI AS A U.S. AGENT. - D) CRITICISM OF THE SOVIET ROLE IN AFGHANISTAN TEMPERED BY THE BELIEF THAT THE INSURGENTS MAY BE FEUDAL REACTIONARIES. - D) CRITICISM OF AKHUNDBAZ, RELIGIOUS MEDDLING, IN SECULAR AFFAIRS.
THE SYMBOL OF SUCH MEDDLING HAS BEEN THE CLUBS (CHOMAQ) OF THE STREET GANGS AND THE WORRY BEADS (TASBIH) OF THOSE WHO CONTROL THE GANGS.
DESPITE THE ANNOUNCED CLOSINGS, SEPID-O-SIYAH AND JAVANAN APPEARED ON NEWSTANDS ON AUGUST 23. HOWEVER, IT IS BELIEVED THAT THESE MAY HAVE BEEN THE LAST ISSUE OF THESE MAGAZINES.

IF ALL OF THESE PUBLICATIONS DISAPPEAR, THE IRANIAN PRESS, WHICH HAS BEEN FLOURISHING SINCE THE REVOLUTION, MAY RETURN TO THE SAME DREARY ROLE IT PLAYED UNDER THE MONARCHY--REPORTING ONLY OFFICIAL STATEMENTS AND REFUSING TO COMMENT ON ANY ISSUE, NO MATTER HOW INNOCUOUS. THE PROSPECT FACING THE INTELLIGENT IRANIAN READER IS BLEAK. FOR NEWSPAPERS HE IS LEFT WITH THE FOLLOWING: - A) KEYHAN AND ETTALA'AT, THE MAJOR EVENING PAPERS UNDER THE PREVIOUS REGIME. THESE PAPERS HAVE RECENTLY PRINTED NOTHING EXCEPT GOVERNMENT ANNOUNCEMENTS, STATEMENTS OF VARIOUS OFFICIALS, AND WIRE SERVICE MATERIAL.

THEY HAVE ALSO CEASED PRINTING EDITORIAL OR COLUMNIST OPINION. - B) JUMHURI-YE-ISLAMI, THE HOUSE ORGAN OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLICAN PARTY, PUBLISHED BY DR. BEHESHTI, PARTY LEADER AND CLOSE KHOMEINI ASSCIATE. - C) ENQELAB-E-ISLAMI, PUBLISHED BY HASAN BANI SADR, KHOMEINI ASSOCATE AND THEORETICIAN OF ISLAMIC ECONOMICS. - D) BAMDAD, THE MOST MODERATE OF THE PRESENT PAPERS. HOWEVER, THIS PAPER HAS TWICE RECEIVED WARNINGS FROM THE REVOLUTIONARY PROSECUTOR'S OFFICE TO REFRAIN FROM PRINTING FALSE HEADLINES OR FACE CLOSING.

FREEDOM OF THE PRESS FACES AN UNCERTAIN FUTURE IN REVOLUTIONARY IRAN. ALTHOUGH CONFUSION AND LACK OF COORDINATION AMONG VARIOUS GROUPS IN POWER MAY ALLOW VARIOUS PUBLICATIONS TO EVADE OFFICIAL HARASSMENT, THE AUTHORITIES, SPECIFICALLY THOSE LEADERS CLOSELY ASSOCIATED WITH AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, APPEAR DETERMINED TO SILENCE ALL PUBLIC DISAGREEMENT WITH THEIR VIEWS.

IT IS INTERESTING TO NOTE THAT THE REVOLUTIONARY AUTHORITIES, SPECIFICALLY THE TEHRAN PUBLIC PROSECUTOR, TOOK THE INITIATIVE IN ACTING AGAINST THE PRESS. ON THIS ISSUE THE MINISTRY OF NATIONAL GUIDANCE WAS THE FOLLOWER, ALTHOUGH IT DID TAKE SOME TROUBLE TO SHOW IT WAS ALSO RESPONSIVE TO THE WISHES OF THE IMAM. ALTHOUGH FURTHER PROOF MAY HAVE BEEN UNNECESSARY, THE ANTI-PRESS CAMPAIGN HAS BEEN A DEMONSTRATION OF THE INABILITY OF THE GOVERNMENT MINISTRIES TO DO ANYTHING BEYOND SAYING "ME TOO" WHEN THE REAL POWERS AMONG THE RELIGIOUS AUTHORITIES HAVE ALREADY MADE THEIR DECISION. TOMSETH
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

PGOI'S GET TOUGH POLICY WITH KURDS APPEARS TO HAVE LED TO INCREASINGLY SERIOUS KURDISH ATTACKS. OVER THE PAST TWO DAYS, KURDISH REBELS APPEAR TO HAVE ATTACKED PGOI FORCES IN SEVERAL POINTS IN KURDISTAN AND WEST AZERBAJAN, SEIZING AND APPARENTLY HOLDING FOR AT LEAST TWO DAYS THE TOWN OF SAGHEZ LOCATED MIDWAY BETWEEN SANANDADJ AND THE TEMPORTY DEFACTO HEADQUARTERS OF THE KURDISH DEMOCRATIC PARTY IN MAHABAD. KDP LEADER GHASSEMLOU AND KURDISH RELIGIOUS LEADER HOUSSENI ARE STILL APPARENTLY IN OR NEAR MAHABAD AND WHILE IT IS UNCLEAR IF THE KDP CONTROLS THE CITY OF MAHABAD, KURDISH REBELS HAVE SEIZED THE TV MAHABAD RADIO STATION AND ARE PREPARING TO USE IT.

ACCORDING TO AF REPORTS THE KDP IS TRYING TO NEGOTIATE A CEASEFIRE IN THE AREA, BUT EMBASSY DOES NOT BELIEVE THAT EITHER SIDE IS PREPARED TO COME TO TERMS AT THE MOMENT. AT PRESENT KURDS APPEAR TO BE HOLDING THEIR OWN, ALTHOUGH PGOI IS CONTINUING TO SEND REINFORCEMENTS TO THE AREA.
ACCORDING TO REPORTS REACHING EMBASSY, TENSION IN BOTH TURKESTAN AND BALUCHI AREAS ARE INCREASING AND PEOPLE THERE ARE WATCHING EVENTS IN KURDISTAN CLOSELY.

EMBASSY SPECULATES THAT ATTEMPTED ASSASSINATION AUGUST 26 OF EDITOR OF GOVERNMENT PAPER KAYHAN ALTHOUGH SEEMINGLY UNRELATED TO KURDISTAN WILL SERVE TO FURTHER HEIGHTEN TENSIONS IN TEHRAN AND QOM AND MAKE PGOI MORE DETERMINED TO "WIN" AGAINST KURDS. TOMSETH

ROBERT PRYOR, TEHRAN COMMUNITY CHURCH CHAPLIN TOLD CHARGE AUGUST 25 THAT 15 UNIDENTIFIED PEOPLE APPEARED AT ST. PAUL'S CATHOLIC CHURCH TEHRAN AT 9:00 A.M. SATURDAY, AUGUST 25, BROKE OPEN THE DOORS OF THE RESIDENT PRIEST'S OFFICE AND SEARCHED THE OFFICE UNTIL 3:00 P.M. THE GROUP APPEARED TO KNOW WHAT THEY WERE DOING AND CARRIED OFF ALL CHURCH RECORDS. THEY APPEARED PARTICULARLY INTERESTED IN NON-IRANIAN NAMES IN THE FILES. ONE MEMBER OF THE GROUP TOLD AN ONLOOKER THAT THEY WERE AFTER COMMUNIST DOCUMENTS AND PORNOGRAPHIC MATERIAL.
