1979TEHRAN09470.subject: JEWISH BUSINESSMEN UNDER INVESTIGATION BY REVOLUTIONARY GUILD COURT

segments.text: REVOLUTIONARY GUILD COURT (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

BENJAMIN PARHAMI, AN IRANIAN JEWISH DOCTOR WHO OWNS A PHARMACEUTICAL COMPANY IN TEHRAN WAS ARRESTED WEDNESDAY AUGUST 22 ON CHARGES MADE BY WORKERS IN HIS COMPANY. PARHAMI WHO IS NOW OUT ON BAIL WAS HELD FOR TWO NIGHTS IN A LUXURY HOTEL (INSTEAD OF JAIL) AND QUESTIONED ABOUT THE PRICING PRACTICES OF HIS FIRM, HIS FAMILY MEMBERS AND HIS TRAVEL PLANS ABROAD. PARHAMI WAS APPARENTLY WELL TREATED. HIS CASE WILL EVENTUALLY BE HEARD BEFORE THE REVOLUTIONARY GUILD COURTS WHICH HANDLE COMMERCIAL ACTIVITY.

EMBASSY HAS NO INDICATION THAT PARHAMI'S ARREST WAS IN ANY WAS SPECIFICALLY RELATED TO HIS RELIGION. JEWISH COMMUNITY TEHRAN DOES NOT APPEAR VERY CONCERNED WITH THIS CASE AT THE MOMENT. COMMUNITY'S RELATIONS WITH PGOI APPEAR TO BE ON EVEN KEEL. TEHRAN RADIO GAVE FIVE MINUTE REPORT RECENTLY ON COMMUNITY'S EID-E-FETR MESSAGE OF CONGRATULATIONS TO KHOMENI AND ON CALL BY TWO LEADERS OF JEWISH COMMUNITY ON AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI. SUMMARY: IRAN'S OIL EXPORTS DROPPED SUBSTANTIALLY, TO BELOW ONE MILLION B/D ON SOME DAYS DURING THE LAST TWO WEEKS, AS A RESULT OF HIGH WAVES AND BAD WEATHER AT KHARG ISLAND ACCORDING TO NIOC INTERNATIONAL AFFAIRS DIRECTOR REZA AZIMI. END SUMMARY.

WE MET WITH AZIMI AUGUST 26 TO CONFIRM REPORTS OF REDUCED EXPORTS AND PRODUCTION. HE ADMITTED BOTH EXPORTS AND PRODUCTION HAVE BEEN CUT BACK RECENTLY, SAYING HIGH WAVES HAVE MADE THE SEA ISLAND JETTY AT KHARG UNUSABLE. AS A RESULT, TANKERS OF 200,000 TONS AND UP HAVE BEEN UNABLE TO LOAD CARGOS. STORAGE TANKS AT KHARG HAVE FILLED AS A CONSEQUENCE AND PRODUCTION HAS THEN BEEN CUT FOR LACK OF STORAGE CAPACITY.

AZIMI SAID "ON AVERAGE" OIL EXPORTS ARE DOWN OF LATE BY ABOUT 400,000 B/D, CONFIRMING THAT ON TWO DAYS EXPORTS DROPPED BELOW ONE MILLION B/D. WE HOPE TO HAVE MORE PRECISE FIGURES ON PRODUCTION AND EXPORTS DURING THIS PERIOD BY TOMORROW (AUGUST 28) AND WILL REPORT ACCORDINGLY.

COMMENT: THERE HAVE BEEN RUMORS OF FURTHER TROUBLE IN THE OIL FIELDS AND PRESS REPORTS THAT KHOMEINI HAS DISPATCHED A TEAM OF MULLAHS TO INVESTIGATE PROBLEMS AND HEAR OIL WORKERS' COMPLAINTS. WHEN WE ASKED ABOUT THE REPORTS, AZIMI SAID THEY WERE "EXAGGERATED." JUST HOW MUCH, IF AT ALL, WORKER UNREST IS A FACTOR IN THE RECENT PRODUCTION-EXPORT DROP, WE DO NOT KNOW. AZIMI STRESSED, HOWEVER, THAT THE PROBLEM WAS ENTIRELY WEATHER, UNSEASONABLY BAD WEATHER FOR THIS TIME OF YEAR, BUT NEVERTHELESS NOTHING MORE THAN

MEHDIAN PRESENTLY IN HOSPITAL WHERE HIS CONDITION IS DESCRIBED AS SATISFACTORY. ACCORDING TO LOCAL PRESS, FORGHAN HAS CLAIMED RESPONSIBILITY FOR KILLINGS.

IRANIAN FRIENDS OF EMBASSY POLITICAL OFFICER WHO VISITED HAJ SHEIKH OL-ISLAM KURDESTANI, SANANDAJ RELIGIOUS LEADER RESIDENT IN TEHRAN, TO OFFER GREETINGS ON EID-EFETR (AUG 24), TOLD REPORTING OFFICER THAT ALL THOSE PRESENT AT SHEIKH'S HOUSE WERE VERY UPSET AT SITUATION IN KURDESTAN, AND THAT ATMOSPHERE WAS MORE FUNEREAL THAN FESTIVE. DURING THEIR VISIT, A TELEPHONE CALL FROM SANANDAJ TO THE SHEIKH REPORTED THAT FOLLOWING EID PRAYERS STREET FIGHTING HAD BROKEN OUT THERE BETWEEN FOLLOWERS OF KHOMEINI SUPPORTER MOFTIZADEH AND PARTISANS OF THE KURDISH DEMOCRATIC PARTY (KDP).

DURING THEIR VISIT, OFFICER'S FRIENDS WERE TAKEN ASIDE BY THE SHEIKH'S SON (WHO CLEARLY WANTED HIS INFORMATION PASSED TO REPORTING OFFICER) AND TOLD THAT THE SITUATION IN KURDESTAN WAS BEING VERY CLOSELY WATCHED BY IRANIAN SUNNIS IN QUCHAN, TURKMAN-SAHRA, BALUCHESTAN, ANCAND THE PERSIAN GULF COAST. HAJ SHEIKH OL-ISLAM HAS TRADITIONALLY MAINTAINED VERY CLOSE CONTACTS WITH THESE OTHER SUNNI COMMUNITIES.

COMMENT: SANANDAJ HAS NEVER BEEN A STRONGHOLD OF KURDISH NATIONALISM. RATHER, IT HAS ALWAYS BEEN THE MOST PERSIANIZED OF THE CITIES OF KURDESTAN AND THE CENTER OF TEHRAN'S INFLUENCE IN THAT PROVINCE. SANANDAJ WAS NEVER INVOLVED, FOR EXAMPLE, IN THE KURDISH REPUBLIC MOVEMENT OF 1945-46, AND DURING THAT TIME REMAINED LOYAL TO THE CENTRAL GOVERNMENT. FROM THESE AND OTHER REPORTS IT WOULD APPEAR THAT THE POPULATION IS NOW DIVIDED IN ITS LOYALTIES AND THAT THE REVOLUTIONARY AUTHORITIES HAVE YET TO ESTABLISH THEIR AUTHORITY THERE.

BUT THE EXISTENCE OF PROBLEMS IN SANANDAJ, WHERE KURDISH AUTONOMY FEELINGS ARE RELATIVELY WEAK, IS AN INDICATION THAT THE CENTRAL GOVERNMENT MAY BE FACING MUCH MORE SEVERE PROBLEMS IN TRADITIONAL CENTERS OF KURDISH NATIONAL FEELING SUCH AS MAHABAD AND BANEH.

BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE: HAJ SHEIKH OL-ISLAM KURDESTANI HAS BEEN IN DISFAVOR SINCE THE REVOLUTION BECAUSE OF HIS TIES WITH THE MONARCHY. HIS BROTHER, MEHDI SHEIKH OL-ISLAM, FORMER PARLIAMENT DEPUTY AND DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER OF JUSTICE, WAS RECENTLY RELEASED FROM PRISON AND STILL FACES A HEAVY FINE. THE SHEIKH'S SON AS'AD, PROFESSOR OF THEOLOGY AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY, SPENT THE ACADEMIC YEAR 1972-73 AT THE HARVARD CENTER FOR WORLD RELIGION. FAMILY TRADITIONALLY SUPPORTED THE SHAH NOT BECAUSE OF PHILOSOPHICAL ATTACHMENT TO THE MONARCHY BUT BECAUSE OF FAVOR SHOWN BY MONARCH TO SUNNI MINORITY AT EXPENSE OF SHIA REILGIOUS ESTABLISHMENT. ADMIN COUNS, CONGEN AND RSO MET WITH TEHRAN CHIEF OF POLICE COL. NABIPOUR AUG. 28 TO DISCUSS SECURITY ARRANGEMENTS FOR EMBASSY COMPOUND AND CROWD CONTROL OUTSIDE NEW CONSULAR SECTION WHEN IT OPENS. NABIPOUR WAS FRANK IN STATING THE PROBLEMS HE CONFRONTS IN PROVIDING THE SECURITY ARRANGEMENTS WE NEED. HE HOPES TO BUILD UP THE DETAIL TO 14 MEN AT ANY GIVEN TIME WITHIN THE NEXT FEW DAYS. HALF WILL BE RECENT RECRUITS WHO WILL BE PAIRED WITH MORE SEASONED VETERANS. THEY WILL BE EQUIPPED WITH RADIOS AND BE CONTROLLED OUT OF THE 7TH POLICE PRECINCT STATION. NABIPOUR INTENDS TO ROTATE PERSONNEL AT FOUR HOUR INTERVALS.

HE ESTIMATED THAT IT WILL TAKE AT LEAST A MONTH TO DEVELOP AN ESTABLISHED ROUTINE. ON CROWD CONTROL, NABIPOUR PROMISED TO PROVIDE AS MANY MEN AS MAY BE REQUIRED TO MAINTAIN ORDER OUTSIDE THE NEW CONSULAR FACILITY.

CHARGE SPOKE TO MFA CHIEF OF PROTOCOL SHOKOUHIAN AUGUST 28 AND STRESSED TO HIM THE NEED FOR ADEQUATE SECURITY AND CROWD CONTROL ARRANGEMENTS PRIOR TO OPENING OF NEW CONSULAR FACILITY. HE NOTED THAT RSO HAD BEEN WORKING ACTIVELY WITH NABIPOUR ON THESE ARRANGEMENTS, BUT POINTED OUT THAT THEY HAD ENCOUNTERED PROBLEMS SUCH AS UNWILLINGNESS OF POLICEMEN SENT TO EMBASSY TO BE THERE AND A LACK OF DISCIPLINE DEMONSTRATED BY THE TENDENCY OF POLICEMEN ASSIGNED TO POSTS ON THE COMPOUND PERIMETER TO WANDER AWAY.

CHARGE SAID THAT IT WAS UP TO IRANIAN AUTHORITIES TO DETERMINE THE KIND AND SIZE OF SECURITY FORCE REQUIRED, BUT THAT IT WAS IMPORTANT THAT WE BE FULLY AWARE OF AND CONFIDENT IN THE MECHANICS OF ITS OPERATIONS. IN THIS REGARD, HE ASKED FOR SHOKOUHIAN'S HELP IN EXPEDITING THE PROCESS OF GETTING A FORCE IN PLACE AND A ROUTINE ESTABLISHED SINCE IT WAS ABSOLUTELY ESSENTIAL THAT WASHINGTON BE ASSURED OF THE ADEQUACY OF SECURITY ARRANGEMENTS BEFORE THE CONSULAR FACILITY OPENS.

SHOKOUHIAN, AS USUAL, DID NOT STINT HIS ASSURANCES THAT ADEQUATE SECURITY AND CROWD CONTROL ARRANGEMENTS WILL BE MADE. NABIPOUR HAS A MORE REALISTIC VIEW OF THE SITUATION. WHILE HIS ESTIMATE THAT IT WILL TAKE A MONTH TO WORK THE GREMLINS OUT OF THE SECURITY ARRANGEMENTS HE HAS IN MIND MAY PROVE OVERLY OPTIMISTIC (E.G., AS OF 1530 AUGUST 28 OUR SECURITY FORCE CONSISTED OF TWO ARMED POLICEMEN AT THE MOTOR POOL GATE), THE ASSETS ON HIS SIDE SHOULD NOT BE UNDERESTIMATED. NABIPOUR IS A PROFESSIONAL.

HE APPEARS TO WANT TO SUCCEED, AND REALIZES THAT, IF HE DOES,IT WILL BOTH BE A FEATHER IN HIS CAP PERSONALLY AND WILL PROVIDE AN IMPORTANT BOOST IN MORALE FOR THE POLICE AS AN ORGANIZATION. FURTHER, HE HAS A SUBSTANTIAL BODY OF RECRUITS COMING INTO THE FORCE AT REGULAR INTERVALS THAT HE CAN DRAW UPON TO FIND MEN WHO WILL WILLINGLY SERVE HERE. IT IS GOING TO TAKE TIME AND PATIENCE, BUT WE ARE CAUTIOUSLY HOPEFUL NABIPOUR WILL PERSEVERE.

FROM PRESS AND OTHER REPORTS THERE APPEARS AT THE MOMENT TO BE A SLIGHT LULL IN THE LEVEL OF FIGHTING IN THE KURDISH AREA, ALTHOUGH WE CONTINUE TO HAVE REPORTS OF SCATTERED ATTACKS BY KURDS ON PGOI FORCES. SOME EFFORTS AT NEGOTIATIONS DO APPEAR TO BE UNDERWAY.

AS OF MORNING AUGUST 28, PGOI FORCES APPEAR TO HAVE REESTABLISHED CONTROL OVER TOWNS IN KERMANSHAHAN (PAVEH AND NOWSOOD) AND SOME OF THOSE IN KURDESTAN PROVINCE (SANANDADJ, MARIVAN, AND SAGHEZ). SCATTERED REPORTS ARE BEING RECEIVED HOWEVER OF MINOR ATTACKS ON PGOI FORCES IN BOTH PROVINCES AND THE TOWNS OF MAHABAD AND SARDASHT IN W. AZARBAIJAN AND BANEH IN KURDESTAN ARE STILL UNDER KURDISH REBEL CONTROL.

THE MILITARY SITUATION IS HARD TO JUDGE AS MEDIA AND OTHER REPORTS REACHING EMBASSY ARE OFTEN EXAGGERATED. IRANIAN MILITARY SUPPORT FOR KURDISH OPERATIONS, TO THE BEST OF OUR KNOWLEDGE, HAS BEEN LIMITED. THE AIR FORCE HAS PROVIDED C-130 AND HELICOPTER PERSONNEL AND SUPPLY SUPPORT AND ONLY A FEW FIGHTERS, PRIMARILY FOR OBSERVATION. ARMY AVIATION HELICOPTERS HAVE PROBABLY PLAYED THE BIGGEST ROLE BUT SPECIFIC NUMBERS OF AIRCRAFT AND SORTIES ARE UNKNOWN. ALTHOUGH THE PRESS HAS HAILED THE ARMY'S (GROUND FORCES) EFFORTS, WE HAVE DOUBTS THAT MANY SOLDIERS HAVE ACTUALLY BEEN INVOLVED IN THE FIGHTING.

THE PASDARANS (REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS) ARE TAKING THE BRUNT OF THE CASULTIES AS THEY HAVE IN OTHER DISTURBANCES SINCE THE REVOLUTION. THE GENDARMARIE ALSO APPEARS TO BE INVOLVED BUT WE DO NOT KNOW TO WHAT EXTENT.

RELATIONS BETWEEN THE PASDARAN AND THE REGULAR ARMED FORCES IN THE KURDISH AREA ARE PROBABLY VERY CONFUSED AND TENSE. THERE HAVE BEEN NUMEROUS CALLS ON THE RADIO BOTH FROM KHOMEINI HIMSELF AND OTHERS FOR PASDARAN NOT OFFICIALLY ASSIGNED TO THE AREA TO RETURN TO THEIR HOME BASES AND FOR BOTH ARMY AND PASDARAN TO OBEY THEIR COMMANDERS. THE ACTIVE PASDARAN ROLE IN THE FIGHTING HAS EARNED THEM THE EMNITY OF THE KURDS WHO APPARENTLY HAVE EXECUTED SOME PASDARAN, BUT THUS FAR NO REGULAR SOLDIERS.
ACCORDING TO SOME EMBASSY SOURCES ONE OF THE DEMANDS OF THE KURDISH REBELS IS THAT ALL PASDARAN TROOPS (NOT ARMY OR GENDARMARIE) BE WITHDRAWN FROM THE AREA.

ACCORDING TO PRESS REPORTS, MEMBERS OF THE KURDISH REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL FROM MAHABAD ARE IN TEHRAN FOR TALKS WITH THE PGOI AIMED AT STOPPING THE FIGHTING. ACCORDING TO THE TEHRAN TIMES, REBELS WANT AN IMMEDIATE CEASEFIRE, THE RECALL OF AYATOLLAH KHALKHALI AND A CONFERENCE TO SOLVE THE KURDISH PROBLEM THROUGH PEACEFUL MEANS.

PGOI HAS PLAINLY GOTTEN ITSELF OUT ON A LIMB IN KURDISH AREAS BUT IT REMAINS TO BE SEEN IF IT WILL NOW BE WILLING TO BACK OFF. IT IS OUR FEELING THAT KHOMEINI AND THOSE CLOSE TO HIM SAW THEIR ORIGINAL TOUGH STANCE TOWARD THE KURDS AS A MEANS TO REESTABLISH FLAGGING REVOLUTIONARY FERVOR AMONG THEIR FOLLOWERS AT THE SAME TIME AS THEY TIGHTENED THEIR CONTROL OVER THE PRESS AND OPPOSITION FORCES. THIS TACTIC HAS PROVOKED DEMONSTRATIONS OF SUPPORT ESPECIALLY AT THE FUNERALS OF MILITARY MARTYRS OF THE FIGHTING.

WE CALLED ON SOHRABPOUR, CHIEF OF NUCLEAR RESEARCH AT THE AEOI, TO MAKE THE POINT THAT USG IS CONSIDERING HIS REQUEST FOR ADDITIONAL HEU FUEL SUPPLIES AND TO ASK QUESTIONS AS NOTED REFTEL. SOHRABPOUR WAS PLEASED TO LEARN THAT HIS REQUEST HAD NOT BEEN IGNORED AND HE ATTEMPTED WITH LIMITED SUCCESS TO ANSWER OUR QUESTIONS.

IN RESPONSE TO A QUESTION ABOUT THE NUMBER OF MEGAWATT DAYS HIS REACTOR CAN OPERATE WITH CURRENT FUEL INVENTORIES, HE NOTED THAT LOGGING PROCEDURES OVER LAST FEW YEARS HAVE BEEN "INEXACT" AND AS A RESULT HE CANNOT ESTIMATE HOW MUCH FUEL IS AVAILABLE IN TERMS OF MEGAWATT DAYS OF OPERATION. (HE DID SAY, INCIDENTALLY, THAT ALL FUEL ASSEMBLIES IN HIS INVENTORY HAVE BEEN IRRADIATED).

SOHRABPOUR THEN EXPALINED THAT HIS MAIN WORRY HAD TO DO WITH THE CLAD MATERIAL ON THE FUEL ASSEMBLIES. AS THE REACTOR HAS BEEN SHUT DOWN FOR ABOUT A YEAR AND IS ONLY NOW UNDERGOING START-UP TESTS, IT MUST BE TAKEN TO HIGH POWER BEFORE HE CAN TEST THE INTEGRITY OF THE CLAD MATERIAL. IF THE CLAD MATERIAL POSES NO PROBLEM, THEN THE REACTOR SHOULD BE ABLE TO RUN FOR ABOUT SIX MONTHS WITH PRESENT FUEL SUPPLIES, HE BELIEVES.

SOHRABPOUR ASKED TO BE INFORMED OF OUR DECISION ON ADDITIONAL HEU AS SOON AS POSSIBLE BECAUSE IF NEGATIVE HE WILL HAVE TO START PLANNING FOR A CORE CONVERSION WHICH WILL REQUIRE AT LEAST SIX MONTHS LEAD TIME. HE COMMENTED THAT GENERAL ATOMIC HAS ALWAYS TAKEN A RATHER CASUAL APPROACH TO THEIR CONTRACT WITH AEOI AND SAID HE WOULD NOT BE SURPRISED NOW IF HE HAD TO TURN ELSEWHERE FOR HIS FUEL SUPPLIES. WE SAID WE HOPED TO HAVE AN ANSWER FOR HIM FAIRLY SOON.

SOHRABPOUR TELLS US HIS CURRENT PROGRAM FOR THE REACTOR INCLUDES ISOTOPE PRODUCTION FOR MEDICAL RESEARCH, "BEAM WORK", AND ACTIVATION ANALYSIS. HE ALSO WILL USE THE REACTOR FOR TRAINING PURPOSES FOR PHYSICS SUTDENTS.

COMMENT: NUCLEAR RESEARCH IS BY NO MEANS A HIGH PRIORITY ITEM FOR THE PGOI AT THIS POINT. NEVERTHELESS, WE BELIEVE IT IMPORTANT THAT WE NOT GIVE THE IMPRESSION THAT THE USG IS TAKING LIGHTLY THEIR REQUEST FOR FURTHER FUEL SUPPLIES. A GESTURE TO UNDERSCORE THE SERIOUSNESS WITH WHICH WE HAVE REVIEWED THEIR REQUEST WOULD BE HELPFUL, PARTICULARLY IF OUR ANSWER IS TO BE NO. A POSSIBILITY THAT COMES TO MIND WOULD BE FOR AN OES/NET OFFICER OR INTERAGENCY TEAM TO MEET WITH SOHRABPOUR IN TEHRAN. PERHAPS WHEN NEXT IN THE AREA IN THE COURSE OF OTHER
