SUMMARY: LOCAL TABRIZ COMMITTEES GENERALLY HAVE NOT HARASSED THE ARMENIAN COMMUNITY OR CONFISCATED ITS PROPERTY ACCORDING TO AN ARMENIAN FSN AT THE TABRIZ CONSULATE. THE ARMENIAN COMMUNITY IS STILL PARTICIPATING IN THE CITY'S ECONOMIC LIFE. THE REVOLUTION, HOWEVER, HAS SPLIT THE COMMUNITY AS THE YOUNGER GENERATION HAS MADE A BID TO CONTROL THE LOCAL ARMENIAN GOVERNING COUNCIL.

MOST ARMENIANS WILL REMAIN IN TABRIZ SINCE THEY HAVE NOT SUFFERED FROM PROPERTY CONFISCATION AS HAVE OTHER RELIGIOUS MINORITY GROUPS ELSEWHERE IN IRAN. HOWEVER, 36 FAMILIES (APPROXIMATELY 175 PERSONS) ARE PLANNING TO MOVE TO TEHRAN BECAUSE THEY DO NOT FEEL SECURE IN THE TABRIZ ENVIRONMENT.

ECONOMICALLY SPEAKING, THE ARMENIAN COMMUNITY IS COMPOSED OF LABORERS (CONSTRUCTION AND FACTORY), SILVERSMITHS, AND A FEW WEALTHY PROFESSIONAL AND MERCHANT FAMILIES. A VISIT TO THE SHOP OF A LOCAL SILVERSMITH (KNOWN THROUGHOUT IRAN FOR HIS CRAFTSMANSHIP) REVEALED THAT HE HAS A STEADY BUSINESS WITH AT LEAST THREE EMPLOYEES ACTIVELY WORKING. TABRIZ'S BIGGEST CINEMA WHICH IS ARMENIAN OWNED WILL BE RENOVATED (IT WAS BURNED DURING THE REVOLUTION) WITH ARMENIAN MONEY.

THE REVOLUTION HAS PROVIDED THE OPPORTUNITY FOR THE YOUNGER GENERATION TO OUST THEIR ELDERS FROM THE LOCAL ARMENIAN GOVERNING COUNCIL. (AMONG OTHER THINGS, THE COUNCIL ADMINISTERS SEVERAL PIECES OF PROFITABLE COMMERCIAL PROPERTY). THE CONFLICT BEGAN IN MARCH AND HAS ONLY BEEN SETTLED IN FAVOR THE YOUNGER GENERATION IN THE PAST MONTH. WHILE THE FSN SOURCE CLAIMED THAT THIS YOUNGER GROUP WERE "70 PERCENT COMMUNIST," IT IS POSSIBLE THAT HIS RESERVATIONS AND PEJORATIVE DESCRIPTION MAY STEM FROM HIS OWN DISSATISFACTION AT HAVING BEEN OUSTED FROM COUNCIL WORK, AND HIS DISTRUST OF "YOUTH" IN GENERAL.
THE SOURCE WAS VERY MUCH A MEMBER OF THE OLDER GENERATION WITH EXCLUSIVE CONTACTS AMONG HIS OWN AGE GROUP, AND FEELS THREATENED BY THE INFLUX OF THE YOUNGER ARMENIANS INTO HIS GROUP'S DOMAIN.

COMMENT: THE POWER STRUGGLE WITHIN THE TABRIZ ARMENIAN COMMUNITY IS PROBABLY ILLUSTRATIVE OF A PROCESS THAT IS PRESENTLY OCCURRING IN LOCAL COMMUNITIES THROUGHOUT IRAN. THE REVOLUTION HAS EITHER CREATED A POLITICAL VACUUM OR PROVIDED INDIVIDUALS OR GROUPS WITH THE OPPORTUNITY OF CHALLENGING AN EXISTING POWER STRUCTURE. MANEUVERING HAS BEEN INTENSE AS VARIOUS FACTIONS IN A LOCAL JURISDICTION ATTEMPT TO SOLIDIFY THEIR POSITION BEFORE A MORE NORMAL STATE OF AFFAIRS RETURNS IN IRAN.
(S - ENTIRE TEXT).

IRANIAN GOVERNMENT IS EQUALLY SUSPICIOUS OF SOVIET UNION AND UNITED STATES AND DETERMINED TO PLAY AN INDEPENDENT ROLE AT THE NON-ALIGNED SUMMIT IN HAVANA. PGOI FOREIGN MINISTER YAZDI INFORMED CHARGE BEFORE LEAVING TEHRAN THAT IRAN HAS DIFFERENCES OF OPINION WITH CUBA (SEE TEHRAN 9384). IN YAZDI'S PUBLIC DEPARTURE STATEMENT, AUGUST 26, HE POINTED OUT THAT THERE ARE A NUMBER OF COUNTRIES IN THE NON-ALIGNED CONFERENCE WHO ARE NOT REALLY NON-ALIGNED AND SAID THAT IT IS THE DUTY OF THOSE COUNTRIES "INTERESTED IN THE ASPIRATIONS OF THE MOVEMENT TO PREVENT THEM FROM ANY INCLINATIONS TOWARDS LEFT OR RIGHT AND NOT LET THE SUPERPOWERS INFLUENCE THE MOVEMENT."

PGOI IS ALREADY STRONGLY ANTI-COMMUNIST AND SUSPICIOUS OF USSR, BUT ANY OPEN EFFORT BY US TO PUBLICIZE USSRCUBA LINKS WOULD BE VERY COUNTER PRODUCTIVE HERE AND MIGHT EVEN HELP RATHER THAN HURT CURBAN IMAGE IN IRAN. IRANIAN INTEREST IN CUBA AND CUBAN PRESENCE HERE IS MINIMAL. ANY OBVIOUS U.S. COMPAIGN AGAINST CUBA MIGHT BOTH STIR UP INTEREST AND BRING IRAN TO CUBAN'S DEFENSE AGAINST AMERICAN IMPERIALISM.

ON THE OTHER HAND, EMBASSY MIGHT BE ABLE DISCRETELY TO USE WITH SOME OF ITS CONTACTS HARD INFORMATION ON THE EXTENT OF CUBAN DEPENDANCE ON USSR ECONOMIC AND MILITARY ASSISTANCE. IT WOULD ALSO BE USEFUL TO HAVE DEPARTMENT'S VIEW ON EXTENT TO WHICH CUBAN INTERESTS RUN PARALLEL TO SOVIETS AND THOSE AREAS WHERE CUBANS ARE DEFINITELY ACTING AS SOVIET SURROGATES PERHAPS AGAINST OWN INTERESTS. IRANIANS WOULD PARTICULARLY BE INTERESTED IN CUBAN ACTIVITIES IN ARAB WORLD.
EMBASSY WAS ASKED FOR INFORMATION ON CUBA BY IRANIAN FOREIGN MINISTRY BEFORE HAVANA NON-ALLIGNED SUMMIT (REF B.). TOMSETH

IRANIAN DELEGATION OPENING DAY OF THE WORLD ADMINISTRATIVE RADIO CONFERENCE (WARC) 1979 WILL BE LED BY MOHAMMAD HASSAN ESLAMI, MINISTER OF POST TELEPHONE AND TELEGRAPH (PTT) AND BY FEREYDOUN ASGARIAN, GENERAL MANAGER FOR TELECOMMUNICATIONS IN PTT. ASGARIAN, AN ELECTRONICS ENGINEER, IS A CAREER OFFICIAL IN PTT AND WAS THE MINISTRY'S INSPECTOR SEVERAL YEARS AGO. BOTH ESLAMI AND ASGARIAN PLAN TO ATTEND ONLY THE OPENING CEREMONIES.

THE TECHNICAL DELEGATION WILL BE LED BY ASGARIAN'S DEPUTY, NOORELDIN MADANI, A CAREER OFFICIAL WHO HAS BEEN HEAD OF MANAGEMENT SYSTEMS IN PTT FOR SEVERAL YEARS. OTHER PARTICIPANTS FROM PTT ARE ENGINEER YAZDANI, ENGINEER ABDOLVAHAB, AND ENGINEER NASIBZADEH.

MEMBERS OF THE IRANIAN DELEGATION FROM NATIONAL IRANIAN RADIO AND TV WILL BE ENGINEER KAVOOS ARASTEH, DR. RADJI, ENGINEER TAHMASEB ZAMANI, AND SEVEN OTHERS. MEMBERS OF THE IRANIAN DELEGATION TO WARC FROM THE ARMED FORCES WILL BE COLONEL MOTAMED LARIE PLUS FOUR. TOMSETH

1979TEHRAN09627.subject: U.S. POLICY RE SITUATION IN SOUTHERN LEBANON

segments.text: IN LIGHT OF YOUR DISCUSSION WITH YAZDI AUGUST 22 ON OUR ATTITUDE TOWARD ISRAELI ARTILLERY SHELLING AND ATTACKS IN SOUTHERN LEBANON, I HAVE SENT BAYANDOR A COPY OF AMBASSADOR YOUNG'S AUGUST 29 STATEMENT DELIVERED TO THE SECURITY COUNCIL (REFTEL). TOMSETH
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: RELATIVE CALM CONTINUED TODAY IN KURDESTAN AS THE IRANIAN ARMED FORCES APPARENTLY REFRAINED FROM ADVANCING ON KURDISH STRONGHOLDS AND VARIOUS EFFORTS WERE MADE TO FIND A NEGOTIATED SETTLEMENT. EMBASSY IS NOT OPTIMISTIC THAT ANY LASTING SOLUTION WILL BE FOUND. END SUMMARY.

THE MILITARY SITUATION IN THE KURDISH AREAS SEEMS TO HAVE STABILIZED TEMPORARILY WITH KURDISH REBELS CONTINUING TO HOLD SOME IMPORTANT TOWNS (MAHABAD, BANEH, SARDASHT) AND THE IRANIAN ARMED FORCES, ALTHOUGH IN PLACE ON THE ROADS TO THESE AREAS,REFRAINING FROM FRONTAL ATTACKS. THERE WERE REPORTS OF MINOR ATTACKS ON GOVERNMENTAL FORCES BY KURDS AUGUST 28, THE MOST SERIOUS BEING AN ATTACK ON A MILITARY POST AT JALDIAN (3652N, 4508E) NEAR THE IRAQUI BOARDER.

ALTHOUGH KHOMEINI, FROM HIS STATEMENTS AND PRESS INTERPRETATIONS, APPEARS UNWILLING TO DEAL WITH KURDISH DEMOCRATIC PARTY LEADERS, SEVERAL EFFORTS SEEM TO BE UNDERWAY TO REACH A NEGOTIATED SETTLEMENT. KHOMEINI HIMSELF HAS OFFERED AMNESTY TO ALL LOWER RANKING KURDS WHO ARE WILLING TO TURN THEMSELVES IN. A FIVE-MAN DELEGATION FROM THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF MAHABAD HAS BEEN IN TEHRAN FOR SEVERAL DAYS MEETING WITH A WIDE RANGE OF PGOI LEADERS INCLUDING INTERIOR MINISTER SABBAGHIAN AND UNDERSECRETARY OF DEFENSE KHAMENE'I.

THE TEHRAN TIMES ANNOUNCED THIS MORNING THAT SABBAGHIAN HAD REACHED AN AGREEMENT WITH THE DELEGATION TO PERMIT THE ARMY TO ENTER MAHABAD PEACEFULLY, BUT IT IS UNCLEAR WHAT, IF ANY, AUTHORITY THE KURDISH GROUP HAS. INDEED, ACCORDING TO ONE AFP REPORT THE REBELS IN MAHABAD HAVE REJECTED ANY AGREEMENT TO ALLOW THE ARMY TO ENTER.

AT THE SAME TIME, SHARIATMADARI HAS ISSUED A CALL FOR PEACEFUL SETTLEMENT OF THE PROBLEM, THE NATIONAL FRONT HAS ANNOUNCED ITS INTENTION TO SEND A DELEGATION TO KURDISTAN, KHOMEINI'S OWN REPRESENTATIVE, HOJATOLESLAM SHEIKH HOSSEINI KERMANI, WENT TO THE AREA AUGUST 28 TO SEE WHAT COULD BE DONE AND THE PAPERS ARE EVEN CARRYING THE RUMOR THAT AYATOLLAH KHALKHALI HAS ASKED SHEIKH HOSSEINI TO COME WITH HIM TO QOM TO MEET KHOMEINI.

ARMED FORCES INACTIVITY AND ALL THE ABOVE INITIATIVES DO SEEM TO INDICATE THAT THE PGOI IS STARTING TO LOOK FOR A NEGOTIATED SETTLEMENT. ANY SUCH SETTLEMENT WOULD PROBABLY HAVE TO BE ON THE BASIS OF AN AMNESTY FOR THE LEADERSHIP OF THE KDP AND A PROMISE TO WITHDRAW THE DISLIKED PASDARAN FROM THE AREA. SHOULD SUCH A DEAL BE STRUCK BY LOWER RANKING PGOI OFFICIALS, IT IS NOT AT ALL CLEAR THAT KHOMEINI WOULD BE WILLING TO ACCEPT IT.

IN THE MEANWHILE, THE PGOI APPEARS TO BE STARTING TO LOOK FOR SCAPEGOATS TO BLAME FOR THE KURDISH UNREST AND APPEARS TO HAVE FALLEN ON AN OLD FAVORITE -- THE ISRAELIS. THE TEHRAN PRESS IS CARRYING VAGUE REPORTS OF THE CAPTURE OF FOUR ISRAELIS IN THE FIGHTING AND PRIME MINISTER BARZAGAN (ACCORDING TO THE PRESS REPORTS) INTIMATED TO THE AUSTRIAN AMBASSADOR THAT HE THOUGHT THE ISRAELIS BACKED BY EUROPEAN AND AMERICAN CAPITALISTS ARE SOMEHOW INVOLVED. THE PGOI IS ALSO APPARENTLY CONCERNED OVER LEFT WING (FEDAYAN-E-KHALQ) OR "COMMUNIST" INFLUENCE IN THE EVENTS.

ACCORDING TO THE PRESS, SOME FEDAYAN-E-KHALQ MEMBERS HAVE PARTICIPATED IN THE FIGHTING ON THE KURDISH SIDE AND AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI'S PEOPLE HAVE MENTIONED THEIR CONCERN OVER LEFT WING INVOLVEMENT IN KURDESTAN TO AN EMBASSY OFFICER.

THE PGOI APPEARS TO BE DEALING VERY CAREFULLY WITH BOTH IRAQ AND TURKEY DURING THIS CRISIS. PGOI ARMED FORCES HAVE CAPTURED TWO ALLEGED IRAQI OFFICERS IN THE ------------------017942 301428Z /41 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 3556 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE SECTION 02 OF 03 TEHRAN 09656 FIGHTING, BUT PGOI DOES NOT SEEM TO INTEND TO MAKE AN ISSUE OF THIS.

ACCORDING TO THE PRESS, THE IRAQI AMBASSADOR MET KHOMEINI IN QOM AUGUST 26 AND PROMISED THAT IRAQ WOULD NOT ALLOW KURDISH REBELS TO ENTER IRAQ. THERE HAVE BEEN NO REPORTS IN THE IRANIAN PRESS OF AID TO KURDISH REBELS FROM TURKEY. THE IRANIAN BORDER AREA WITH BOTH TURKEY AND IRAQ IN THE KURDISH AREAS APPEARS TO BE WIDE OPEN ON THE IRANIAN SIDE, AND EMBASSY HAD BEEN HEARING STORIES OF GUN RUNNING FROM TURKEY TO IRAN FOR SEVERAL MONTHS. ACCORDING TO EMBASSY OFFICER WHO VISITED TABRIZ AUGUST 27-28 TURKISH CONSULAR REPRESENTATIVES IN THE AREA ARE KEEPING CLOSE TRACK OF KURDISH ACTIVITIES.
TOMSETH MRN: 1979TEHRAN009656 SEGMENT NUMBER: 000003 ERROR READING TEXT INDEX FILE; TELEGRAM TEXT FOR THIS SEGMENT IS UNAVAILABLE
(C - ENTIRE TEXT.)
ACCORDING TO GOVERNMENT SPKESMAN'S OFFICE (TABATABAI), PM BAZARGAN HAS NOT RPT NOT RESIGNED. HE WAS AT WORK AS USUAL TODAY, SEPTEMBER 1.

TEXT OF BAZARGAN'S MIDNIGHT SPEECH NOT YET AVAILABLE HERE. UNTIL WE HAVE IT WE WANT TO RESERVE JUDGEMENT ON ITS SIGNIFICANCE. HOWEVER, BASED ON THE LACK OF ATTENTION IT HAS RECEIVED SO FAR IN IRAN, WE ARE INCLINED TO SPECULATE THAT IT IS JUST THE LATEST EXAMPLE OF HIS WELL-KNOWN FRUSTRATION WITH IRAN'S DUAL SYSTEM OF GOVERNMENT.
EMBASSY TEHRAN BIOGRAPHIC REPORTER WILL BE JOHN M. LIMBERT OF POLITICAL SECTION. TOMSETH
(C-ENTIRE TEXT.)

JAPANESE EMBASSY POLITICAL SECTION CHIEF AMAE TOLD CHARGE AUGUST 29 THAT HE HAD RECENTLY BEEN INFORMED BY A TURKOMAN FROM GONBAD-E-KAVOUS THAT POLITICAL ACTIVITY IN THE TURKOMAN SABRA AREA CONTINUES AT A HIGH LEVEL. ACCORDING TO AMAE'S SOURCE, THE TURKOMAN TRIBESMEN HAVE WORKED OUT A COOPERATIVE ARRANGEMENT WITH SOVIET AUTHORITIES WHICH WILL ALLOW THE TRIBESMEN TO USE SOVIET TERRITORY AS A SAFEHAVEN SHOULD IT BECOME POLITICALLY NECESSARY TO DO SO. (COMMENT: AT THE TIME OF THE FIGHTING IN GONBAD-E-KAVOUS LAST SPRING THERE WERE PERSISTENT REPORTS IN TEHRAN THAT SOVIET AUTHORITIES OPENED THEIR BORDER TO THE TURKOMAN TRIBESMEN.
END COMMENT.) HE ALSO CLAIMED THAT IRANIAN TRIBESMEN HAVE BEEN ABLE TO SECURE CONSIDERABLE FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE FROM TRIBESMEN ON THE SOVIET SIDE. FOR THE TURKOMAN, HE TOLD AMAE, THERE IS NO BORDER.

AMAE'S SOURCE ALSO CLAIMED THAT THE TURKOMAN TRIBESMEN HAD BEEN WORKING CLOSELY WITH MEMBERS OF THE MARXIST FEDAYAN-E-KHALQ WHICH, HE SAID, HAS A RELATIVELY STRONG BASE IN THE TOWNS OF BABOL AND SARI TO THE IMMEDIATE WEST OF THE TURKOMAN SAHRA REGION. (COMMENT: THE FEDAYAN FIRST BECAME INVOLVED WITH THE TURKOMAN DURING LAST SPRING'S FIGHTING. SEVERAL FEDAYAN MEMBERS WERE ARRESTED AT THAT TIME AND ACCUSED OF AIDING THE REBELLIOUS TRIBESMEN. END COMMENT.)

FINALLY, AMAE'S SOURCE TOLD HIM THAT THE TRIBESMEN ARE DTERMINED TO PUSH THEIR DEMANDS FOR AUTONOMY AND WERE PREPARED TO CHALLENGE GOVERNMENT FORCES FRONTALLY IMMEDIATELY FOLLOWING COMPLETION OF THE WHEAT HARVEST IN JULY. SINCE THAT PERIOD COINCIDED WITH THE ONSET OF RAMAZAN, HOWEVER, THE TRIBESMEN WERE PREVAILED UPON BY LEADING SUNNI CLERGYMEN NOT TO RESUME FIGHTING DURING THE HOLY MONTH.

WE HAVE HEARD FROM SEVERAL SOURCES THAT TENSIONS ARE HIGH IN THE TURKOMAN SAHRA AREA, AND AT THE PEAK OF RECENT FIGHTING IN KURDESTAN THERE WERE REPORTS IN THE LOCAL PRESS THAT THE TURKOMAN SAHRA, TOO, MIGHT EXPLODE. THAT MAY BE AN EXAGGERATION, BUT THE AREA CERTAINLY BEARS
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

BAZARGAN SPEECH AUGUST 31 WAS CLEARLY MORE A REACTION TO MOUNTING CRITICISM OVER THE PAST FEW WEEKS THAT HIS GOVERNMENT IS INEFFECTIVE THAN A SERIOUS ATTEMPT AT RESIGNATION. THE SPEECH ALSO GIVES AN INTERESTING VIEW OF HOW BAZARGAN VIEWS THE LACK OF POWER OF HIS GOVERNMENT AND HIS SUBSERVIENT RELATIONSHIP TO KHOMEINI.

IN THE SPEECH BAZARGAN DEFENDS HIS GOVERNMENT AGAINST CHARGES OF INDECISIVENESS, INACTION AND LACK OF REVOLUTIONARY ATTITUDE, AND CALLS ON HIS CRITICS TO ASK KHOMEINI TO DISMISS HIM IF THEY THINK HE SHOULD NOT BE PRIME MINISTER. AT THE END OF THE SPEECH, BAZARGAN POINTS OUT THAT HE TAKES NO PLEASURE FROM HIS POSITION AS PRIME MINNSTER AND THAT HE HAS SENT A LETTER TO KHOMINI OOOERING HIS RESIGNATION. IT IS NOT AT ALL CLEAR WHEN OVER THE PAST FEW WEEKS THIS LATEST BAZARGAN OFFER OF RESIGNATION WAS SENT, BUT IT DOES SEEM CLEAR THAT KHOMEINI HAS NO INTENTION OF TAKING BAZARGAN UP ON HIS OFFER.

BAZARGAN SPEECH IS A GOOD REFLECTION OF THE PROBLEMS INHERENT IN IRAN'S DUAL-SYSTEM OF GOVERNMENT AND OF THE GROWING POWER OF THE UNOFFICIAL SIDE OF THE GOVERNMENT WHICH WAS REPORTED IN REF B. BAZARGAN DESCRIBES HIS GOVERNMENT AS"A KNIFE WITHOUT A BLADE": MEANING IT APPEARS THAT HIS GOVERNMENT CAN MAKE LAWS BUT THE AUTHORITY TO CARRY THEM OUT RESTS IN THE HANDS OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES. THE POWER KHOMEINI HOLDS OVER BAZARGAN'S GOVERNMENT IS ALSO GRAPHICALLY DESCRIBED: "ALL OUR AFFAIRS ARE IN HIS HANDS, AT HIS OWN COMMAND, INCLUDING THE POWERS OF DISMISSAL, APPOINTMENT, DECISION-MAKING, ISSUING ORDERS, EVERYTHING."

1979TEHRAN09711.subject: ATTACK ON LOCKHEED OFFICES IN TEHRAN

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

LOCKHEED REPRESENTATIVE IN TEHRAN SCHRUGGS INFORMED EMBASSY SEPTEMBER 2 THAT HIS FORMER OFFICES WERE RANSACKED SEPTEMBER 1. SCHRUGGS TOLD EMBASSY THAT HIS LOCAL EMPLOYEES HAD BEEN RECEIVING CALLS THE PAST FEW DAYS WARNING THAT HIS OFFICE WOULD SOON BE ATTACKED. AS SCHRUGGS HAD PLANNED TO MOVE TO NEW OFFICES, HE SIMPLY SPEEDED UP THE PROCESS AND HAD COMPLETED THE MOVE BEFORE THE OFFICES WERE RANSACKED. NO ONE WAS INJURED IN THE INCIDENT.
EMBASSY DOES NOT HAVE FULL DETAILS OF THE INCIDENT OR WHO MIGHT HAVE BEEN BEHIND IT. WE ARE INVESTIGATING AND WILL REPORT AGAIN AS SOON AS FURTHER DETAILS BECOME
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

THE PGOI HAS CONTINUED TO HOLD BACK FROM A FRONTAL ATTACK ON KURDISH HELD TOWN. HOWEVER, REPORTS CONTINUE OF SCATTERED ATTACKS BY KURDISH REBELS ON GOVERNMENT FORCES. INTERIOR MINISTER SABBAGHIAN WARNED ON NATIONAL TV SEPTEMBER 1 THAT THE ARMY IS READY TO GO INTO MAHABAD AND KHOMEINI IS CONTINUING TO CALL FOR DESTRUCTION OF THE KURDISH DOMOCRATIC PARTY AND ITS LEADERS. ACCORDING TO FARSI PAPER KAYAN, KHOMEINI HAS THREATENED TO GO PERSONALLY TO KURDESTAN IF THE PROBLEM THERE IS NOT SOLVED SOON.

THERE IS AN OBVIOUS SPLIT AMONGST IRANIAN AUTHORITIES ON HOW TO HANDLE THE KURDISH PROBLEM. AYATOLLAH SHARIAT-MADARI HAS GIVEN PUBLIC SUPPORT TO ANY EFFORT TO NEGOTIATE A SETTLEMENT WITH THE KURDS AND BOTH PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN AND ARMED FORCES LEADERS PREFER THIS COURSE. EMBASSY CONTINUES TO RECEIVE STRONG INDICATIONS OF ARMY RELUCTANCE TO ATTACK REBEL HELD TOWNS. TALEGANI, ON THE OTHER HAND, WHILE NOT RULING OUT NEGOTIATIONS HAS CALLED FOR A MUCH TOUGHER LINE.

IF SOME SORT OF SOLUTION IS NOT REACHED SOON, EMBASSY DOUBTS, HOWEVER, THE MODERATES WILL BE ABLE TO HOLD OUT MUCH LONGER AGAINST KHOMEINI'S STRIDENT CALLS FOR ACTION. IRANIAN LEADERS APPEAR INCREASINGLY TO VIEW KURDISH PROBLEM AS COMMUNIST INFLUENCED, AND DENUNCIATIONS OF COMMUNIST PARTICPATION IN THE KURDISH REVOLT BY KHOMEINI AND TALEGANI OVER THE WEEKEND REFLECT A GROWING CONCERN.

ALTHOUGH MANY IN THE GOVERNMENT SEEM TO REALIZE THAT CURRENT PROBLEMS IN KURDISH AREAS ARE NOT ENTIRELY THE FAULT OF THE KURDS, MOST OF THE IRANIAN LEADERS INCLUDING BAZARGAN WOULD PROBABLY APPROVE THE USE OF FORCE IN THE AREA ONCE THEY SEE IT AS THE ONLY SOLUTION TO A THREAT TO THE TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY OF IRAN.

THE ONLY HOPEFUL SIGN IS SABBAGHIAN'S COMMENTS IN HIS TV INTERVIEW THAT THE REBEL HELD TOWNS ARE RUNNING SHORT OF FOOD AND FUEL. SHOULD THIS PROVE TRUE THERE IS ALWAYS THE POSSIBILITY THAT THE PGOI MIGHT BE ABLE TO FORCE REBEL EVACUATION OF THE TOWNS. WHILE THIS WOULD NOT RESOLVE THE REBELLION IT WOULD AT LEAST AVOID THE KILLING THAT WILL INEVITABLY OCCUR IF THE ARMY IS FORCED TO A FRONTAL ATTACK ON THE TOWNS. TOMSETH

AFTER A FIVE MONTH HIATUS, THE ENGLISH-LANGUAGE DAILY KAYHAN INTERNATIONAL, HAS REAPPEARED. THE FOUR-PAGE EDITION HIT THE STREETS ON SATURDAY, SEPTEMBER 1, ONCE AGAIN UNDER THE EDITORIAL CONTROL OF THE INDOMITABLE KAZEM ZARNEGAR.

IN HIS INAUGURAL EDITORIAL, ZARNEGAR SAYS "IT WAS NOT POLITICS THAT DROVE US OUT OF CIRCULATION AND IT IS NOT POLITICS THAT BRINGS US BACK." ECONOMIC PROBLEMS, ACCORDING TO ZARNEGAR, SUCH AS LOSS OF ADVERTISING REVENUE, THE DEPARTURE OF EXPATRIATE READERS AND THE HIGH COST OF AN INFLATED STAFF "CRIPPLED THE PAPER." HE ADDS, THE PAPER'S RETURN DOES NOT MEAN THAT THOSE PROBLEMS ARE RESOLVED, BUT WITH A REDUCTION IN STAFF AND THE HOPE OF AN UPTURN IN THE ECONOMY, IT MAY PULL THROUGH.

WELL AWARE OF HIS OPERATING LIMITS, INASMUCH AS THE PAPER IS IN ASSOCIATION WITH THE ULAMA THROUGH BAZAARI MAHDIAN AND FINANCED BY THE MOSTAZAFIN FOUNDATION, ZARNEGAR WRITES OF THE PRESS SCENE: "WE FELT THAT THERE WAS PERHAPS TOO MUCH COMMENT AND TOO LITTLE OBJECTIVE REPORTING...

THERE WAS AND IS A POWERFUL NEED FOR REPORTING AND NEWS ANALYSIS THAT IS INDEPENDENT, RELIABLE AND UNBLASED." ZARNEGAR DESCRIBES THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTION AS "BASED ON COMMITMENT TO SOCIAL AND ECONOMIC JUSTICE, POLITICAL DEMOCRACY AND A GUARANTEE OF BASIC FREEDOMS." HE IS EMPHATIC ABOUT IRAN NO LONGER BEING ECONOMICALLY DEPENDENT ON EXPATRIATES BUT NOTES "ITS ECONOMY AND MONEY MARKETS CANNOT BE ISOLATED FROM THE INTERNATIONAL ECONOMY."

COMMENT: ZARNEGAR IS A SURVIVOR MAKING THE BEST OF HARD TIMES. A CLOSE ASSOCIATE OF FORMER KAYHAN OWNER, MESBAZADEH, ZARNEGAR HAS BEEN TRYING TO DEAL HIMSELF OUT OF THE ORGANIZATION BY DEMANDING WHAT HE CONSIDERS FAIR SEVERANCE PAY. GENERAL MANAGER MAHDIAN HAS NOT ACCEPTED ZARNEGAR'S PROPOSAL AND RECENTLY PREVENTED HIM FROM GOING INDEPENDENT WITH ANOTHER ENGLISH DAILY BY RENTING KAYHAN PRESSES WHILE MORE THAN SIXTY PRINTERS AND FORMER MEMBERS OF THE OLD KAYHAN INTERNATIONAL ADVERTISING STAFF WERE STILL ON THE PAYROLL. MAHDIAN WAS UNABLE TO DISCHARGE THIS CREW, HALF OF THE ORIGINAL KAYHAN INTERNATIONAL STAFF, FOR FEAR OF THEIR ACTIVIST LINKS WITH FELLOW HEZBULLAHI PRINTERS AT THE KAYHAN FARSI EDITION.

ZARNEGAR IS ALSO A PAWN OF THESE VERY SAME WORKERS WHO SEE HIM AS THEIR TICKET TO FULL EMPLOYMENT. MOREOVER ZARNEGAR HAS BEEN ORDERED, BUT DOES NOT SAY BY WHOM, NOT TO LEAVE THE COUNTRY. THEREFORE, HE HAS FEW OPTIONS EXCEPT TO WILE HIS TIME AWAY WITH A PLAYTHING SUCH AS KAYHAN INTERNATIONAL, WHICH CANNOT REACH MORE THAN SIX THOUSAND READERS AT
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

ACCORDING TO PRESS AND RADIO REPORTS IRANIAN ARMY APPEARS TO HAVE TAKEN MAIN KURDISH TOWNS OF MAHABAD AND BANEH WITH A MINIMUM OF RESISTANCE FROM KURDISH REBELS. ACCORDING TO PGOI REPORTS, IRANIAN ARMY CASULTIES WERE LIGHT. WHILE MILITARY GARRISON AT MAHABAD WAS ATTACKED AND BURNED, LITTLE DAMAGE WAS REPORTEDLY DONE IN EITHER MAHABAD OR BANEH.

DAO CONVERSATIONS WITH AIR FORCE OFFICERS CONFIRM THAT F-4 JETS DID ATTACK AND STRAFE MAHABAD GARRISON WHICH HAD EARLIER BEEN TAKEN BY REBELS. IT IS UNCLEAR IF ANY REBELS WERE IN THE GARRISON AT THE TIME.
CHIEF OF THE GENERAL STAFF SHAKER HAS HOW ISSUED AN APPEAL TO HIS "VICTOROUS" TROOPS "TO GIVE PRIORITY TO HEALING THE WOUNDS OF THE OPPRESSED COMPATRIOTS".

EMBASSY SPECULATES THAT SOME DEAL MAY HAVE BEEN WORKED OUT BETWEEN ARMY COMMANDERS ON GROUND AND KURDISH REBELS TO PERMIT UNOPPOSED ARMY ENTRY TO TOWNS. KDP LEADER, QUASSEMLOU HAS THREATENED TO TAKE HIS FORCES INTO THE HILLS FOR A GUERILLA WAR. PGOI OCCUPATION OF TOWNS MAY ONLY REPRESENT THE BEGINNING OF A STAGE OF PROTRACTED GUERILLA WARFARE. TOMSETH
(C-ENTIRE TEXT.)

SUMMARY: PER REFTEL CHARGE SAW MINACHI SEPT 4 AND MADE A GENERAL PRESENTATION ON THE NEGATIVE PERCEPTION THE ACTIVITIES OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS ARE CREATING IN THE U.S. HE COVERED THE FALLAHI CASE, BUT ALSO MENTIONED THOSE OF SHERRY, SHEIBANI AND REZA AMINI AS EXAMPLES OF TREATMENT THAT IS DIFFICULT FOR AMERICANS TO UNDERSTAND. HE EXPRESSED CONCERN THAT THE PROCESS OF NORMALIZING RELATIONS BETWEEN IRAN AND THE U.S. WAS BEING MADE MORE DIFFICULT BY PERCEPTIONS OF JUSTICE IN IRAN. END SUMMARY.

CHARGE, ACCOMPANIED BY POLOFF SWIFT, SAW MINACHI SEPT 4. CHARGE SAID THAT HE WANTED TO SPEAK TO MINACHI INFORMALLY AS A FRIEND ABOUT CONCERNS GROWING OUT OF PERCEPTIONS OF CONDITIONS IN IRAN AMONG THE AMERICAN PEOPLE. HE SAID THAT THIS WAS A SUBJECT CHARRE LAINGEN AND FM YAZDI HAD DISCUSSED SEVERAL TIIES BEFORE.

YAZDI HAD MENTIONED THE PERCEPTION AMONG THE IRANIAN PEOPLE CREATED BY OUR LONG AND CLOSE ASSOCIATION WITH THE SHAH, A PERCEPTION WE RECOGNIZED AND HAD ATTEMPTED TO MODIFY BY PUBLIC STATEMENTS OF OUR ACCEPTANCE OF THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION AND ACTIONS, SUCH AS THOSE REGARDING THE IRANIAN TRUST FUND AND THE SALE OF REFINED FUEL PRODUCTS, SUPPORTIVE OF THE PGOI.

SIMILARLY, SUCH THINGS AS THE EXPULSION OF FOREIGN CORRESPONDENTS AND CLOSURE OF NEWSPAPERS HAVE CREATED A NEAGATIVE IMPRESSION IN THE U.S. THE ACTIVITIES OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS, TOO, ARE SOMETHING THAT THE AMERICAN PEOPLE FIND HARD TO COMPREHEND. CHARGE SAID THAT HE WAS SURE MINACHI, GIVEN HIS OWN INVOLVEMENT IN HUMAN RIGHTS AFFAIRS AND WITH HIS BACKGROUND IN THE LAW, COULD UNDERSTAND OUR CONCERN ABOUT THE IMPRESSION THAT WAS BEING CREATED. HE NOTED THE PICTURES OF SUMMARY EXECUTIONS WHICH HAD RECENTLY OCCURRED IN KURDESTAN. INCARCERATION WITHOUT CHARGES WAS ANOTHER ASPECT OF THE SAME PROBLEM.

HE MENTIONED THE SHERRY, SHEIBANI AND AMINI CASES AS EXAMPLES OF INDIVIDUALS BEING HELD WITHOUT, TO THE BEST OF OUR KNOWLEDGE, FORMAL CHARGES BEING BROUGHT AGAINST THEM. CHARGE SAID THAT WE DID NOT PRESUME TO INTERFERE IN IRAN'S INTERNAL AFFAIRS, BUT THAT WE HAD AN INTEREST IN SUCH MATTERS BOTH ON HUMAN RIGHTS GROUNDS AND BECAUSE THESE PEOPLE WERE EITHER CITIZENS OR OTHERWISE CONNECTED TO THE U.S.

THE CHARGE SAID THAT THE CASE OF SEVERAL MEMBERS OF THE SOCIALIST WORKERS PARTY HELD IN AHWAZ WAS ANOTHER SUCH INSTANCE. ONE MEMBER OF THIS GROUP, GHOLAM FALLAHI, WAS MARRIED TO A U.S. CITIZEN, WAS HIMSELF A PERMANENT RESIDENT AND HAD CLOSE FAMILY MEMBERS LIVING IN THE U.S. STORIES THAT THESE PEOPLE HAD BEEN EXECUTED HAD CAUSED GREAT ANXIETY IN THE U.S. (NOTE: THE MFA SEPT 3 RELEASED A STATEMENT DENYING THAT ANY OF THE GROUP'S MEMBERS HAD BEEN EXECUTED. WE ARE ATTEMPTING TO GET A COPY OF THE TEXT.

END NOTE.) THE CHARGE REPEATED THAT WE DID NOT PRESUME TO COMMENT ON THE GUILT OR INNOCENCE OF THOSE INVOLVED, BUT STRESSED THAT WE BELIEVE THAT EVEN MEMBERS OF A MARXIST PARTY DESERVE DUE PROCESS. THE IMPRESSION IN THE U.S. THAT THEY WERE BEING DENIED THIS CONSTITUTED AN IMPEDIMENT TO THE DESIRE OF BOTH COUNTIESS TO IMPROVE OUR BILATERAL RELATIONS.

MINACHI LISTENED ATTENTIVELY THROUGHOUT THE PRESENTATION. HE ASKED SEVERAL SPECIFIC QUESTIONS ABOUT SHEIBANI AND SEEMED WILLING AT LEAST TO TRY TO DO SOMETHING FOR HIM. HE ALSO ASKED IF THE EMBASSY WOULD WANT TO SEND SOMEONE TO AHWAZ TO CHECK ON THE CONDITIONS UNDER THE SOCIALIST WORKERS PARTY PEOPLE ARE BEING HELD IF ARRANGEMENTS COULD BE WORKED OUT. CHARGE RESPONDED AFFIRMATIVELY, INDICATING THAT SWIFT, AS EMBASSY'S OFFICER RESPONSIBLE FOR HUMAN RIGHTS MATTERS, WOULD BE PREPARED TO GO. MINACHI SAID THAT IT WOULD TAKE SEVERAL DAYS TO LOOK INTO THE FEASIBILITY OF THE VISIT, AND THAT HE WOULD BE IN TOUCH LATER.

COMMENT: MINACHI UNQUESTIONABLY UNDERSTANDS THE PROBLEM. ALSO, HE ALMOST CERTAINLY WOULD LIKE TO HELP. WE ARE SURE HE WILL DO WHAT HE CAN, BUT IT IS A SAD FACT THAT CONTROL OVER THE ADMINISTRATION OF JUSTICE IN POSTREVOLUTIONARY IRAN DOES NOT LIE IN THE HANDS OF PEOPLE
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: THE COMPLEX SYSTEM OF RIVAL COMMITTEES IN TABRIZ IS ATTRACTING INCREASING CIRITICISM FROM LOCAL CITIZENS. ACCUSATIONS RANGING FROM THEFT, CORRUPTION, ANTI-REVOLUTIONARY ACTIVITY, BEATINGS AND MURDER HAVE BEEN DIRECTED AT VARIOUS COMMITTEE GROUPS, AND SEEM TO HAVE SOME BASIS IN FACT. END SUMMARY.

BOTH DURING VISIT TO TABRIZ ON 27-28 AUGUST AND IN CONVERSATION WITH TABRIZ CONTACTS IN TEHRAN, POLOFF HAS HEARD INCREASING ACCUSATIONS AND CRITICISM AIMED AGAINST TABRIZ'S COMMITTEE STRUCTURE.DURING LAST WEEK OF AUGUST, ONE MAJOR COMMITTEE HEAD IN TABRIZ WAS ARRESTED WITH SEVERAL SUBORDINATES, AND LOCAL RUMOR CLAIMS THE GROUP WAS ACTIVELY INVOLVED IN SELLING ARMS TO KURDISH INSURGENTS.

PRIOR TO POLOFF'S VISIT TO TABRIZ CONSULATE THE COMMITTEE ASSIGNED TO ASSURE COMPOUND'S SECURITY HAD BEEN REPLACED BY CITY POLICEMEN FROM THE LOCAL PRECINCT. ON 28 AUGUST, THE FORMER HEAD OF THE CONSULATE'S COMMITTEE WAS ARRESTED, AND TABRIZ RADIO ASKED ANY ONE WITH A COMPLAINT AGAINST HIM TO PRESENT IT TO THE REVOLUTIONARY PROSECUTOR'S OFFICE. TO POLOFF'S KNOWLEDGE, AT LEAST ONE HOUSE OWNER WHO LIVES ACROSS FROM THE CONSULATE HAS SUBMITTED A FORMAL COMPLAINT, ACCUSING THE EX-CONSULATE COMMITTEE HEAD OF ASSAULTING HIM AND STEALING APPROXIMATELY $300 FRO HOME. A RASH OF THEFTS IN THE IMMEDIATE VICINITY OF THE CONSULATE IS POPULARLY ATTRIBUTED TO THIS COMMITTEE'S PRESENCE.

ON 27 AND 28 AUGUST, TABRIZ CITY PRISON EXPERIENCED SEVERE RIOTING WHICH RESULTED IN SEVERAL INJURIES. DEATHS AND SUBSEQUENT EXECUTIONS. THE PRESS CLAIMED 14 OF THE RIOTERS, INCLUDING TWO WOMEN, HAD BEEN EXECUTED. EVEN DURING COURSE OF RIOTING, HOWEVER, AND IN SUBSEQUENT CONVERSATIONS IN TEHRAN, POLOFF WAS TOLD BY TABRIZ SOURCES THAT THE INCIDENT HAD BEEN COMMITTEE INSPIRED. CITY POLICE HAD BEEN ASKED TO RESUME CONTROL OF THE PRISON, AND THE COMMITTEE GROUP IN SITU HAD ARRANGED RIOTS TO PROVE THAT POLICE WERE NOT CAPABLE OF SECURITY DUTIES.

THE PRISON COMMITTEE ALLEGEDLY SUPPLIED WEAPONS TO PRISONERS, AND ALSO STARTED A FIRE IN THE BUILDING, BUT THE PLANS BACK FIRED WHEN RIOTING GOT OUT OF CONTROL. ACCORDING TO A TABRIZ SOURCE WHO HAD BEEN INCARCERATED AT LOCAL PRISON FOR THREE MONTHS AND WAS RELEASED SHORTLY BEFORE THE RIOTING, THE PRISON COMMITTEE GROUP WAS DEEPLY INVOLVED IN TAKING BRIBES FROM PRISONERS TO ENSURE PREFERENTIAL TREATMENT. THIS SOURCE (AND OTHERS) CLAIMS THE COMMITTEE WAS UNWILLING TO DEPART THE PRISON BECAUSE OF THE LARGE PROFITS INVOLVED. HE SAYS HE WITNESSED COMMITTEE MEMBERS INVOLVEMENT IN INCITING THE PRISONERS TO RIOT.
ACCORDING TO THIS SOURCE, MORE THAN 30 PRISONERS WERE SUMMARILY EXECUTED AFTER THE RIOTING, MORE TO PREVENT THEM FROM REVEALING COMMITTEE INVOLVEMENT THAN FOR ANY ACTIVE ROLE IN THE INCIDENT. TOMSETH

1979TEHRAN09768.subject: CONDITIONS FOR POLITICAL PRISONERS IN IRAN

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: IN A RECENT DISCUSSION AN IRANIAN BUSINESSMAN DESCRIBED TO EMBASSY OFFICERS HIS EXPERIENCE DURING THREE MONTHS IN AN IRANIAN JAIL. HIS DESCRIPTION INCLUDED A PICTURE OF THE POOR CONDITIONS IN THE PRISON AND THE USE OF BEATINGS TO EXTRACT INFORMATION.

EMBOFFS HAD INTERESTING DISCUSSION RECENTLY WITH IRANIAN BUSINESSMAN WHO A WEEK AGO HAD BEEN RELEASED ON BAIL FROM A PROVINCIAL PRISON WHERE HE HAD BEEN HELD ON VAGUE POLITICAL AND CORRUPTION CHARGES FOR ABOUT THREE MONTHS. EMBOFFS SUSPECT CORRUPTION CHARGES MAY HAVE BEEN WELL FOUNDED. ALTHOUGH FREE NOW, HE MAY STILL FACE TRIAL BEFORE A REVOLUTIONARY COURT AND IS SUBJECT TO REARREST AT ANY TIME. IN THE PROCESS OF TRYING TO PROCURE HIS RELEASE, THE BUSINESSMAN HAD OBTAINED LETTERS OF RECOMMENDATION FROM SHARIAT-MADARI, KHOMEINI'S BROTHER, AND THE FORMER REVOLUTIONARY PROSECUTOR GENERAL MAHDAVKANI. NONE OF THESE APPEARS TO HAVE HAD MUCH EFFECT ON THE PRISON COMMITTEE.

THE BUSINESSMAN EXPLAINS THIS BY SAYING THAT THE COMMITTEE WAS COMMUNIST DOMINATED AND THEREFORE UNWILLING TO BEND TO THE WISHES OF THESE POWERFUL REVOLUTIONARY LEADERS THAT HE BE RELEASED. WE SUSPECT THE LETTERS HE RECEIVED MAY HAVE BEEN SIMPLY PRO-FORMA.
THE BUSINESSMAN APPEARED SHAKEN BUT FAIRLY DISPASSIONATE ABOUT HIS PRISONRIENCE. WE HAVE LITTLE WAY OF CHECKING HIS STORY BUT IT DOES NOT SEEM TOO EXAGGERATED.

THE BUSINESSMAN'S JAIL HELD SIX TO SEVEN HUNDRED PRISONERS, ABOUT 150 OF WHOM WERE BEING HELD FOR POLITICAL OFFENSES. THE BULK OF THESE WERE YOUNG (20-30 YEAR OLD) ARMED FORCES OFFICERS. THEY INCLUDED, HOWEVER, SOME HIGH RANKING FORMER GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS, SOME OF WHOM WERE EXECUTED DURING THE TIME THE BUSINESSMAN WAS IN PRISON. WHILE MANY OF THE PRISONERS LIKE HIMSELF WERE AWAITING TRIAL, OTHERS WERE SERVING THEIR SENTENCES.

THE BUSINESSMAN SEEMS TO HAVE FARED WELL HIMSELF IN PRISON AS HE HAD MONEY TO BRIBE THE GUARDS TO SEND LETTERS IN AND OUT AND TO ASSURE HE WAS NOT SUBJECT TO PHYSICAL ABUSE. PRISON FOOD WAS APPARENTLY QUITE BAD AND PRISONERS RELIED ON THEIR FAMILIES TO SEND FOOD ON VISITING DAYS. THOSE WHO WERE WITHOUT FAMILIES OR FINANCES WERE LOOKED AFTER BY THE OTHERS.

BUSINESSMAN DESCRIBED PHYSICAL ABUSE OF PRISONERS AS REGULAR OCCURENCE. GUARDS APPARENTLY USED BEATINGS AS THREAT TO PROCURE BRIBE MONEY FROM PRISONERS. BEATING WAS ALSO APPARENTLY USED FAIRLY SYSTEMATICALLY AS METHOD TO OBTAIN INFORMATION FROM PRISONERS. THE BUSINESSMAN APPEARS TO HAVE BEEN WITNESS TO AFTER EFFECTS OF SEVERAL SUCH INCIDENTS, TWO OF WHICH HE DESCRIBED TO EMOFFS: THE NEPHEW OF A LEADING KURDISH REBEL WHO HAD NO KNOWLEDGE OF THE WHEREABOUTS OF HIS UNCLE WAS ARRESTED AND SEVERLY BEATEN IN AN ATTEMPT TO EXTRACT INFORMATION.

IN ANOTHER INCIDENT, A GENDARMARIE OFFICER WAS BEATEN SEVERELY AND WHEN HE WAS UNABLE OR UNWILLING TO GIVE THE REQUIRED INFORMATION WAS TAKEN OUT AND PUT THROUGH A MOCK EXECUTION (THE EXECUTION SQUAD MISSED). THE BUSINESSMAN SAID THAT THE GENDARMARIE OFFICER WAS COMPLETELY BROKEN PHYSICALLY AND MENTALLY AT THE TIME HE WAS RETURNED TO HIS CELL.

OVERALL PICTURE WHICH BUSINESSMAN PAINTED OF THE PRWAS ONE OF REGULARIZED BRUTALITY,INEFFICIENTCY AND CORRUPTION BY COMMITTEE MEMBERS WHO WERE RUNNING THE PRISON. WHILE BUSINESSMAN NEVER USED THE WORD HIMSELF WHEN DESCRIBING INTERROGATION TECHNIQUES OF GUARDS, IT SEEMS QUITE PLAIN COMMITTEE GUARDS WERE USING TORTURE
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: DESPITE BASIC ETHNIC DIFFERENCES AND SOME TRADITION OF ANIMOSITY, AZARBAIJANI TURKISH COMMENTS ON KURDISH UNREST REVEAL A LARGE DEGREE OF SYMPATHY FOR KURDISH AIMS. KURDISH INSURGENTS ARE REPORTEDLY BEING VERY CAREFUL IN DEALING WITH THEIR ETHNIC TURKISH NEIGHBORS, AND POPULAR PERCEPTION OF THIS IS AFFECTING THE ATTITUDES OF TURKS IN IRAN TOWARDS THE KURDS. END SUMMARY.

DURING THE PAST TWO WEEKS, POLOFF HAS SPOKEN TO A NUMBER OF ETHNIC TURKS IN TABRIZ AND TEHRAN ABOUT THE KURDISH UNREST. THE BASIC TABRIZ ATTITUDE EXPRESSED TOWARDS THE KURDISH FIGHTING HAS BEEN ONE OF SYMPATHY FOR KURDISH DEMANDS, AND CONDEMNATION OF PGOI AND QOM ATTACKS ON KURDISH DEMOCRATIC PARTY LEADERS.

ON 28 AUGUST VISIT TO TABRIZ, POLOFF WITNESSED FUNERAL PROCESSION FOR TWO TABRIZ REVOLUTIONARY GUARD VOLUNTEERS WHO HAD BEEN KILLED IN KURDISH FIGHTING. THE PROCESSION WAS COMPOSED OF ONLY SLIGHTLY OVER 100 PEOPLE, AND DESPITE ITS ROUTE ALONG TABRIZ'S MAIN STREET, ATTRACO INTEREST FROM PASSERS BY. PEDESTRIANS CONTINUED TO WALK NORMALLY AS THE PROCESSION PASSED, AND THE SLOW-DOWN IN STREET TRAFFIC WAS GREETED WITH HORN BLOWING BY IRRITATED DRIVERS.

THE PROCESSION LED THE DRIVER OF POLOFF'S TAXI TO COMMENT CAUSTICALLY ON THE POLITICAL CHAOS RESULTING FROM THE REVOLUTION, AND HE CONTINUED WITH A LENGTHY DESCRIPTION OF UNEMPLOYMENT IN TABRIZ AND THE GENERAL STUPIDITY OF SENDING VOLUNTEERS FROM TABRIZ TO FIGHT THE KURDS. IN A SUBSEQUENT CONVERSATION WITH A LOCAL MERCHANT, POLOFF WAS TREATED TO ONE VERSION OF THE GUARDSMEN'S DEATH. THE MERCHANT CLAIMED THAT TWO HELICOPTERS OF VOLUNTEERS HAD BEEN SENT FROM TABRIZ TO THE SAQQEZ AREA, AND THE VOLUNTEERS HAD BEEN CAPTURED IMMEDIATELY AFTER LANDING. THE KURDISH CAPTORS ALLEGEDLY ASKED THE VOLUNTEERS IF THEY PROFESSED LOYALTY TO SHARIAT-MADARI OR KHOMEINI.

THOSE WHO CLAIMED THE FORMER WERE SET FREE AND TOLD NOT TO INTERFERE IN KURDISH AFFAIRS AGAIN. THOSE WHO CLAIMED THE LATTER WERE SHOT. IN A DIFFERENT INCIDENT REPORTED BY THE PRESS, A NUMBER OF TABRIZ VOLUNTEERS WERE STRIPPED OF THEIR WEAPONS BY KURDISH INSURGENTS AND ALLOWED TO RETURN HOME PEACEFULLY. SEVERAL TABRIZ SOURCES HAVE COMMENTED TO POLOFF THAT THE KURDS WERE TREATING ETHNIC TURKISH REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS FAR BETTER THAN THEY DESERVED, AND THAT THIS POLICY WAS AIMED AT KEEPING TURKISH/KURDISH RELATIONS AS AMICABLE AS POSSIBLE.

TABRIZ'S RELIGIOUS LEADER AYATOLLAH SHARIAT-MADARI HAS ALSO MADE PUBLIC COMMENTS WHICH MIGHT BE SEEN AS GUARDELY PRO-KURDISH. IN A PRESS INTERVIEW ON 29 AUGUST, SHARIAT-MADARI CLAIMED THAT THE OBJECTIVE OF THE FIGHTING IN KURDESTAN WAS TO SECURE THE RIGHTS OF THE KURDISH PEOPLE. AND SUCH RIGHTS COULD BE SAFEGUARDED AND GUARANTEED WITHOUT THE NEED TO RESORT TO WAR AND VIOLENCE. UNLIKE KHOMEINI, SHARIAT-MADARI HAS NOT ATTACKED KURDISH RELIGIOUS AND POAL LEADER SHEIKH IZZEDIN HOSSEINI, PERHAPS SEEING POTENTIAL PARALLELS IN HOSSEINI'S ROLE AND HIS OWN AS AN ETHNIC MINORITY

1979TEHRAN09786.subject: FREEDOM OF THE PRESS AND THE NATURE OF THE IRANIAN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC

segments.text: (C-ENTIRE TEXT.)

THE EXPULSION OF ALL AMERICAN STAFF MEMBERS OF THE ASSOCIATED PRESS BUREAU ON SEPT 4 (REFTEL) HIGHLIGHTS A CENTRAL ASPECT OF THE IRANIAN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC THAT WE SHOULD NOT LOSE SIGHT OF: ITS INEFFICIENCIES NOTWITHSTANDING, THE SYSTEM OF GOVERNMENT KHOMEINI IS CREATING IN IRAN PROMISES TO BE EVERY BIT AS DICTATORIAL AND REPRESSIVE AS THE SHAH'S. DESPITE THE RHETORICAL PREOCCUPATION WITH FREEDOM, IT HAS BECOME INCREASINGLY CLEAR THAT FOR KHOMEINI THE WORD HAS A MEANING QUITE DIFFERENT THAN THE WESTERN DEFINITION OF IT. IT DOES NOT, FOR EXAMPLE, ENCOMPASS THE FREEDOM TO REPORT THE NEWS ACCURATELY IF ACCURACY IS DEEMED CONTRARY TO THE INTERESTS OF ISLAM.

OUR INTERESTS IN IRAN TRANSCEND ANY PARTICULAR REGIME, A POINT WE HAVE TRIED TO MAKE WITH THE NEW RULERS HERE IN ORDER TO ALLAY THEIR SUSPICIONS THAT WE CONTINUE TO COLLUDE WITH THE FORMER SHAH. FOR THE MOMENT, IT APPEARS THAT OUR INTERESTS WILL BE BEST SERVED THROUGH WORKING WITH THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT OF MEHDI BARZRGAN TO RE-ESTABLISH COOPERATIVE BILATERAL RELATIONS BETWEEN IRAN AND THE U.S. WE ANTICIPATE THAT WE WILL WANT TO TAKE A SIMILAR STANCE WHEN AN ELECTED GOVERNMENT IS IN PLACE, PROBABLY LATER THIS YEAR. HOWEVER, IT WOULD BE DANGEROUS TO CONCLUDE THAT COOPERATION WITH EITHER THIS GOVERNMENT OR ITS SUCCESSOR IS OUR ONLY POLICY OPTION.
IF THE CURRENT TREND TOWARD HARSH DICTATORSHIP IS NOT CHECKED AND REVERSED, WE MAY WELL NOT WANT TO BE CLOSELY IDENTIFIED WITH THE REGIME

GOVERNMENT RUN RADIO-TV (NIRT) POSTPONED CARRYING A SPEECH BY PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN SEVERAL TIMES. UNDER PRESSURE, NIRT LAMELY EXPLAINED THE RECORDED SPEECH WAS EDITED AT BAZARGAN'S REQUEST AFTER A NIRT TECHNICAL MONITOR CALLED ATTENTION TO CERTAIN "PROBLEMS" WITH THE RECORDED SPEECH. THE EDITED VERSION WAS FINALLY BROADCAST IN THE LATE EVENING OF AUGUST 31 AND SHOWED A DISPIRITED BAZARGAN RESPONDING TO CRITICISMS OF HIS GOVERNMENT BY EXPLAINING THAT THE PGOI LACKED REAL POWER. BAZARGAN REVEALED HE HAD ONCE AGAIN REQUESTED THAT KHOMEINI RELIEVE HIM OF THE BURDEN OF OFFICE.

RUMOR HAS IT THAT NIRT STRONGMAN QOTBZADEH WAS DIRECTLY INVOLVED IN "EDITING" BAZARGAN'S SPEECH, REMOVING PASSAGES WHICH REVEALED BAZARGAN'S DISENCHANTMENT WITH KHOMEINI AND THE EXCESSES OF THE REVOLUTION, I.E. JUDGMENTS OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS, VIOLATION OF INTERNATIONAL CODES OF JUSTICE IN KURDESTAN. SOURCES REPORT FIVE POINTS IN BAZARGAN'S SPEECH WERE DELETED

A HARSH REPLY TO KHOMEINI'S CHARACTERIZATION OF THE PRIME MINISTER AS A "TURTLE."; B) AN OBSERVATION THAT "IF I WERE REVOLUTIONARY ENOUGH I'D NEVER LET QOTBZADEH CONTROL TELEVISION AND ATTACK ME"; C) A COMMENT ON THE PRIME MINISTER'S MEETING WITH AYATOLLAH SHARIAT MADARI DURING WHICH THE AYATOLLAH SUGGESTED THAT BAZARGAN SHOULD PRESERVE HIS INTEGRITY AS A MUSLIM AND RESIGN.
AN ALLUSION TO KHOMEINI'S INTENTION TO OFFICIALLY TAKE CONTROL OF THE GOVERNMENT; E) A CRITICAL RESPONSE TO KHOMEINI'S CHARGE OF NEPOTISM DIRECTED AT BAZARGAN.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

NEWSWEEK CORRESPONDENT TOLD POLITICAL OFFICER SEPTEMBER 5 THAT REMAINING SOCIALIST WORKERS PARTY MEMBERS MAY BE BROUGHT TO TRIAL IN AHWAZ AS EARLY AS SEPTEMBER 6. CORRESPONDENT SAID THAT HEAD OF SOCIALIST WORKERS PARTY IN TEHRAN, BABAK ZAHRAIE, HAS BEEN TRYING TO STIR UP INTEREST IN THE CASE.

EMBASSY HAS BEEN ATTEMPTING TO CONTACT ZAHRAIE BUT HE SEEMS VERY SUSPICIOUS OF OUR INTEREST AND RELUCTANT TO TALK WITH US. WE SPECULATE HE MAY FEEL THAT CONTACT WITH THE AMERICAN EMBASSY AT THIS POINT WILL NOT BE HELPFUL TO THE TRIAL IF IT BECOMES KNOWN. WE WILL KEEP TRYING.

EMBASSY HAS RECEIVED FOLLOWING MESSAGE FROM SENATOR WARREN G. MAGNUSON, FROM HIS HOME DISTRICT OFFICE (U.S. COURT HOUSE 1010 - 5TH AVENUE, ROOM 900, SEATTLE, WASHINGTON, 98104). : MY CONSTITUENT MRS. FALLAHI WIFE OF GHOLAM ABBAS FALLAHI PRESENTLY IMPRISONED IN AHWAZ. MR. FALLAHI PERMANENT RESIDENT OF WASHINGTON STATE. APPRECIATE EVERY POSSIBLE ASSISTANCE YOU CAN PROVIDE IN URGING HIS RELEASE. UNQUOTE

WOULD APPRECIATE DEPARTMENT CONTACTING SENATOR MAGNUSON AND BRIEFING THE SENATOR ON THE CASE. EMBASSY FEELS STRONGLY THAT DIRECT EMBASSY INTERVENTION IN THE CASE BEYOND WHAT WE HAVE ALREADY DONE WITH MINISTER MINACHI MIGHT WELL BE EXTREMELY HARMFUL TO FALLAHI'S CASE. EMBASSY COULD NOT IN ANY CASE TRY TO DO MORE THAN ATTEMPT TO ASSURE FALLAHI RECEIVED FAIR TRIAL UNDER

1979TEHRAN09821.subject: ATTACK ON LOCKHEED OFFICES IN TEHRAN

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).
EMBASSY OFFICER HAD FURTHER DISCUSSION WITH LOCKHEED REPRESENTATIVE RAY SCHRUGGS SEPTEMBER 5. SCHRUGGS GAVE FOLLOWING ACCOUNT OF RANSACKING OF LOCKHEED OFFICES.

ON EVENINGS OF AUGUST 30 AND 31 AND SEPTEMBER 1 A GROUP OF FIVE ARMED UNIDENTIFIED MEN ENTERED UNLOCKED BACK DOOR OF LOCKHEED OFFICES. ON EVENING OF AUGUST 30 GROUP, WHICH WAS COMPOSED OF YOUNG MEN 18-20 YEARS OLD, HELD LOCKHEED GUARD AT GUNPOINT AND METHODICALLY SEARCHED THE PREMISES AS THOUGH THEY WERE LOOKING FOR SOMETHING HIDDEN. ON NIGHT OF AUGUST 31, GROUP AGAIN ENTERED LOCKHEED OFFICES AND WHEN DISCOVERED BY GUARD AND FRIENDS, THREATENED TO SHOOT THEM. GUARD AND FRIENDS FLED DOWN STAIRCASE, ONE FALLING AND FRACTURING FOOT, BUT OTHERWISE ESCAPING UNHARMED.

LOCKHEED AMERICAN REPRESENTATIVE SCHURGGS WAS NOT INFORMED OF THE ABOVE UNTIL SEPTEMBER 1. AS LOCKHEED HAD INTENDED TO CHANGE OFFICES IN ANY CASE, HE ACCOMPLISHED THE MOVE THAT DAY. ON EVENING OF SEPTEMBER 1, GROUP AGAIN RETURNED AND ENTERED EMPTY OFFICES. GUARD WATCHING FROM ACROSS THE STREET SAW THEM ENTER. THEY BROKE OPEN SEVERAL LOCKED DOORS AND SHOT OUT SEVERAL OF THE OFFICE WINDOWS.

ON EACH OCCASION, LOCKHEED GUARD CALLED LOCAL COMMITTEE FOR HELP BUT NO ONE WAS SENT UNTIL FOLLOWING MORNING. ON EVENING OF SEPTEMBER 1, GUARD REPORTEDLY TOLD COMMITTEE THAT GROUP WAS IN THEIR OFFICES BUT EVEN THEN NO ONE CAME UNTIL FOLLOWING MORNING. COMMITTEE AND POLICE OCTOBER 2 REPORTEDLY INSPECTED DAMAGE AND TOOK FINGERPRINTS, BUT LOCKHEED STILL HAS NO WORD WHO MIGHT HAVE BEEN RESPONSIBLE.

SCHRUGGS FINDS WHOLE INCIDENT VERY PECULIAR AND SPECULATES IT MAY HAVE BEEN THE WORK OF LOCAL THUGS OR PERHAPS SOMEONE WITH COMMITTEE CONNECTIONS. GROUP DID NOT, TO SCHRUGGS' KNOWLEDGE, TAKE ANYTHING DURING ANY OF VISITS. ACCORDING TO LOCKHEED GUARD, GROUP SPOKE VERY LITTLE, MADE NO THREATS AGAINST LOCKHEED, AND IN NO WAY INDICATED ANY POLITICAL MOTIVES.
SCHRUGGS HAS INFORMED HIS US OFFICE OF ABOVE. HE DOES NOT REPEAT NOT EXPECT A REPEAT OF THE INCIDENT AT HIS NEW OFFICE. TOMSETH
REFS.: A) TEHRAN 9610; B) STATE AIRGRAM A-2382 (C - ENTIRE TEXT)

ON 2 SEP, EMBASSY OFFICER VISITED OFFICES OF MR. FEREYDOUN ASGARIAN, GENERAL MANAGER FOR TELECOMMUNICATIONS IN MINISTRY OF POST, TELEPHONE, AND TELEGRAPH (PTT), TO DISCUSS US POSITION ON REMOTE SENSING AT WARC CONFERENCE. ALSO TAKING PART IN THE DISCUSSION WAS MR. NOORELDIN MADANI, WHO WILL BE IRAN'S CHIEF TECHNICAL DELEGATE AT WARC.
WE REVIEWED SOME OF THE US PROPOSALS AS PRESENTED TO ITU IN DOCUMENT NUMBER 45E AND MADANI HAD FOLLOWING COMMENTS 6.425-7.125 MHZ BAND DSA/45/18 IRAN HAS NO OBJECTIONS TO THIS PROPOSAL AT THIS TIME.
8.175-8.215 MHZ BAND (USA/45/207). IRAN IS UNDECIDED ON THIS PROPOSAL.
8.175-8.400 MHZ BAND (USA/45/208). IRAN IS UNDECIDED ON THIS PROPOSAL.
15.2-15.35 MHZ BAND (USA/45/240). IRAN UNDERSTANDS THAT THERE ARE DIFFERENT PROPOSALS FROM THE UK AND JAPAN AND IS UNDECIDED.
18.6-18.8 MHZ BAND (USA/45/258). IRAN IS UNDECIDED. IRAN UNDERSTANDS THAT UK OR INDIA HAS PROPOSED BROADCAST SATELLITES IN THIS BAND.
23.6-24 MHZ BAND (USA/45/272). IRAN WILL PROBABLY AGREE TO THIS PROPOSAL.

BOTH MR. ASGARIAN AND MR. MADANI RECALL MEETING CHIEF US DELEGATE GLEN ROBINSON AT PREVIOUS CONFERENCES. EMB OFF GAVE THEM COPY OF MR. ROBINSON'S TESTIMONY ON US PROPOSALS, WHICH WAS FORWARDED WITH REF. WE ALSO GAVE THEM THE BACKGROUND DOCUMENTS ON REMOTE SENSING, STRESSING THE IMPORTANCE OF PRESERVING FREQUENCIES FOR THIS APPLICATION IN SPITE OF THE IMMEDIATE DESIRE OF BROADCASTERS AND COMMUNICATORS TO FILL UP THESE BANDS. EMB OFF ASKED WHETHER ANY SCIENTISTS FROM THE UNIVERSITIES WOULD BE IN THE DELEGATION AND MR. MADANI REPLIED, SOMEWHAT DEFENSIVELY, THAT THERE WOULD NOT BUT THAT PTT HAD SUFFICIENT TECHNICAL EXPERTS OF ITS OWN.

BOTH MADANI AND ASGARIAN HAVE EXPERIENCE IN THE UNITED STATES AND SEEM WELL-DISPOSED TOWARD THE US PROPOSALS, IN SPITE OF THEIR UNWILLINGNESS TO MAKE COMMITMENTS TO SUPPORT THEM IF MR. ROBINSON FINDS IT APPROPRIATE TO PAY EVEN SHORT SOCIAL CALL ON IRANIAN DELEGATION AND RECALL PREVIOUS MEETINGS WITH ASGARIAN AND YAZDANI, WE BELIEVE IT MIGHT ASSIST US DELEGATION IN DEVELOPMENT OF CORDIAL WORKING-LEVEL CONTACTS AT WARC CONFERENCE.

MR. ASGARIAN WILL ATTEND ONLY THE OPENING CEREMONIES AND WILL GO THEREAFTER TO THE UNITED STATES FOR A VISIT WITH HIS CHILDREN, WHO ARE STUDYING AT MONTGOMERY JUNIOR COLLEGE, ROCKVILLE, MARYLAND. HE WAS RECEPTIVE TO SUGGESTION THAT HE MIGHT BE ABLE TO VISIT OFFICES OF NASA'S GODDARD SPACE FLIGHT CENTER, GREENBELT, MARYLAND, DURING HIS STAY IN WASHINGTON AREA. EMBASSY OFFICER COULD ARRANGE THIS ON PRIVATE BASIS, BUT WE BELIEVE THAT NASA MAY WISH TO EXTEND OFFICIAL COURTESIES BECAUSE OF
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

IRANIAN FRIEND OF EMBASSY POLITICAL OFFICER REPORTED WITNESSING THE FOLLOWING SCENE AT HEADQUARTERS OF THE BONGAH-E-MOSTAZ'AFIN (INSTITUTE FOR THE OPPRESSED/ CENTRAL WELFARE ORGANIZATION) IN TEHRAN ON AUGUST 30. THIS FRIEND HAD GONE TO THE INSTITUTE TO GET A LETTER FROM THE OFFICIAL IN CHARGE OF THE PROPERTY OF THE FORMER MINISTRY OF COURT. THIS OFFICIAL TOLD HIS DEPUTY TO WRITE THE LETTER, BUT THE DEPUTY REFUSED. IN THE ENSUING ARGUMENT, THE CHIEF DREW A PISTOL AND FIRED AT THE DEPUTY, BREAKING ONE OF THE OFFICE WINDOWS. ALTHOUGH NO ONE WAS HURT IN THE SHOOTING, IT CAUSED A GENERAL PANIC AND RUSH FOR THE EXITS.

ALTHOUGH SHOOT-OUTS IN OFFICES ARE UNCOMMON, THE ABOVE EPISODE IS AN EXAMPLE OF PREVAILING ADMINISTRATIVE CHAOS. OFFICIALS ARE REFUSING TO SIGN PAPERS, DEPARTMENTS ARE IGNORING EACH OTHER, AND CHIEFS ARE UNABLE TO ISSUE THE SIMPLEST ORDERS TO SUBORDINATES. PERHAPS THIS INCIDENT IS A MEASURE OF ONE PERSON'S DESPERATION AT HIS INABILITY TO OPERATE AN OFFICE. TOMSETH
(C-ENTIRE TEXT.)

THE RESURFACING OF SHAPUR BAKHTIAR IN PARIS AND PERSISTENT RUMORS ABOUT VARIOUS IRANIAN EMIGRES BEING ACTIVELY INVOLVED IN PLOTS TO OVERTHROW THE ISLAMIC REGIME OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI POSES A TEMPTATION TO SEE IN THESE POLITICAL EXILES THE SOLUTION TO A SITUATION IN IRAN THE U.S. FINDS DISTASTEFUL. AFTER ALL, AMERICANS CAN IDENTIFY WITH BAKHTIAR WHEN HE SPEAKS (FLUENTLY IN A WESTERN LANGUAGE) OF INDIVIDUAL FREEDOM AND LIBERTY WHEREAS THEY ARE DISGUSTED AND INCOMPREHENDING WHEN AYATOLLAH KHALKHALI (IMMEDIATELY AFTER DISPATCHING ANOTHER GAGGLE OF KURDS TO THEIR FATE) PROUDLY DESCRIBES HIMSELF AS THE IRANIAN ADOLF EICHMANN.

MOREOVER, THE ARGUMENT THAT IRAN CANNOT FUNCTION AS A MODERN NATION WITHOUT THE TECHNICAL SKILLS MONOPOLIZED BY THE IRANIAN EDUCATED ELITE STRIKES THESE SAME AMERICANS AS EMINENTLY LOGICAL. SINCE MANY MEMBERS OF THIS ELITE HAVE FLED INTO EXILE RATHER THAN PUT UP WITH A GOVERNMENT INCREASINGLY DOMINATED BY NARROW-MINDED ISLAMIC FANATICS, IT IS A SIMPLE SYLOGISTIC STEP TO THE CONCLUSION THAT THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC IS BOUND TO FAIL THROUGH A SHORTAGE OF THE TECHNICAL SKILLS NECESSARY TO OPERATE THE NATIONAL BUREAUCRACY AND ECONOMY.

IT WOULD, IN OUR VIEW, BE A GRAVE ERROR TO SUBSCRIBE TO THE PROPOSITION PUT FORWARD BY VARIOUS EMIGRES THEMSELVES THAT THEY HOLD THE KEY TO SETTING THINGS RIGHT IN IRAN. OUTSIDE THEIR OWN RELATIVELY MINISCULE CLASS, THEY HAVE VIRTUALLY NO SUPPORT HERE. FURTHER, THEY HAVE NO COERCIVE MEANS OF OVERTHROWING THE CURRENT ORDER READILY AT THEIR DISPOSAL. THE EMERGENCE OF NOSTALGIA WITHIN THE ARMED FORCES FOR THE "GOOD OLD DAYS," WITH A CONCOMITANT RESTORATION OF THE MILITARY'S COERCIVE CAPABILITY, COULD ALTER THE SITUATION, BUT AS OF THIS MOMENT NEITHER OF THESE PRECONDITIONS EXISTS.

FINALLY, THERE IS NO REASON TO BELIEVE THAT THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC WILL NOT BE ABLE TO CONTINUE TO CO-OPT SUFFICIENT NUMBERS OF PEOPLE WITH THE KINDS OF TECHNICAL SKILLS REQUIRED TO OPERATE INDUSTRIES AND GOVERNMENT OFFICES ON AT LEAST A SCALE WHICH THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC ITSELF DEEMS ADEQUATE. THINGS MAY NOT WORK VERY EFFICIENTLY, BUT CATCHING UP WITH WEST GERMANY WAS THE SHAH'S DREAM, NOT KHOMEINI'S.

FOR THE MOMENT, KHOMEINI'S ISLAMIC FORCES REMAIN FIRMLY IN PLACE WITH NO EFFECTIVE OPPOSITION IN SIGHT. DISAFFECTION HAS BEEN GROWING, BUT FOR THE FORESEEABLE FUTURE THE RANKS OF THE DISGRUNTLED DO NOT SEEM LIKELY TO BE CAPABLE OF TRANSLATING THEIR DISSATISFACTION INTO THE KIND OF ACTION THAT WOULD CHALLENGE THE REGIME IN ANY SERIOUS MANNER. THAT IS ESPECIALLY TRUE OF EMIGRES WHO HAVE LITTLE SUPPORT WHERE IT REALLY COUNTS -- IN IRAN ITSELF.

THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT'S CONTINUING INABILITY TO COME TO GRIPS WITH THE REALITY OF IRANIAN PLURALISM MAY YET LEAD TO ITS ULTIMATE FAILURE, BUT IF IT DOES, WE ARE REASONABLY CONFIDENT THAT WHATEVER REPLACES IT WILL BE HOME GROWN RATHER THANNURTURED IN PARIS OR NEW YORK.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: MFA OFFICIAL SAYS THAT NUMEROUS STATEMENTS ON BAHRAIN IN PRESS AND BY REVOLUTIONARY LEADERS CARRY NO OFFICIAL ENDORSEMENT OF EITHER PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT ON REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL. THE AMBIGUITIES IN IRANIAN POLICY, WHICH MANAMA HAS POINTED OUT IN ITS MESSAGE (REF C), ARE AN INEVITABLE RESULT OF THE DISJOINTED NATURE OF FOREIGN POLICY IN REVOLUTIONARY IRAN, WHERE THE MESSIANIC CHARACTER OF THE REVOLUTION (AND OF IRANIAN SHIISM IN GENERAL) IS AT SOME VARIANCE WITH THE OFFICIAL IRANIAN ATTITUDE TOWARD BAHRAIN. END SUMMARY.

WE WERE MOST INTERESTED IN READING MANAMA'S EXCELLENT DISCUSSION OF AMBIGUITIES IN THE IRANIAN ATTITUDE TOWARD BAHRAIN (REF C). EMBASSY POLITICAL OFFICER DISCUSSED IRANIAN-BAHRAINI RELATIONS IN SEPTEMBER 5 MEETING WITH NASIR TIJANI, ACTING CHIEF OF ARAB AFFAIRS DEPARTMENT AT MFA. TIJANI SAID THAT BI-LATERAL RELATIONS CONTINUE TO BE FRIENDLY AND THAT IRANIAN AMBASSADOR RAFAHI WOULD BE DEPARTING FOR BAHRAIN VERY SOON.

CONCERNING HOJJAT AL-ISLAM MODARRESI, TIJANI SAID THAT BAHRAIN WAS A SOVEREIGN STATE AND HAD THE RIGHT TO EXCLUDE ANYONE IT WISHED FROM ITS TERRITORY. AS FAR AS THE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN IS CONCERNED, MODARESSI'S GOING TO SHARJAH (WHETHER VOLUNTARY OR OTHERWISE) IS A MATTER OF CONCERN ONLY TO BAHRAIN AND THE UAE. TIJANI ADDED THAT THE BAHRAIN EMBASSY IN TEHRAN HAS BEEN INFORMED OF IRAN'S ATTITUDE ON THIS QUESTION. MODARESSI'S POSITION AS AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI'S REPRESENTATIVE IN BAHRAIN IS A PURELY SPIRITUAL ONE. EMPHASIZING THIS POINT, TIJANI SAID THAT KHOMEINI COULD SEND REPRESENTATIVES ANYWHERE IN THE WORLD, BUT THAT THESE PERSONS WOULD REPRESENT ONLY THE SPIRITUAL (RUHANI) SIDE OF HIS LEADERSHIP.

TIJANI ALSO DISCUSSED THE RECENT TELEGRAM OF AYATOLLAH SADEQ ROWHANI AND THE LETTER FROM LEADING TEHRAN BAZAR MERCHANTS TO THE SHEIKH OF BAHRAIN IN WHICH THE WRITERS EXPRESSED THEIR SORROW AND REVULSION AT THE RULER'S RECENT ACTIONS AGAINST MODARESSI AND OTHER SHIA LEADERS. TIJANI SAID THAT ROWHANI'S TELEGRAM WAS A PURELY PERSONAL STATEMENT OF OPINION AND CARRIED NO ENDORSEMENT EITHER FROM THE COUNCIL OF MINISTERS OR THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL. ALTOHOUGH ROWHANI IS UNDOUBTEDLY AN INFLUENTIAL FIGURE IN THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL, HIS INFLUENCE THERE GIVES HIM NO OFFICIAL STANDING IN FOREIGN POLICY MATTERS.

ASKED ABOUT THE CRITICAL ARTICLES IN JUMHURI-YEISLAMI AND KAYHAN (PARA 7, REF. C), TIJANI OBSERVED THAT UNDER PRESENT CONDITIONS IN IRAN ALMOST ANYONE WOULD MAKE A NAME FOR HIMSELF BY WRITING A CRITICAL EDITORIAL. HE SAID THAT BOTH PAPERS WERE ABUSING THEIR REPUTATIONS AS KHOMEINI SPOKESMEN TO MISLEAD THE PUBLIC INTO THINKING ALL OF THEIR OPINIONS WERE ENDORSED BY THE IMAM. TIJANI NOTED THAT HIS MINISTRY HAD WORSE PROBLEMS WITH THE MAGAZINE SHAHID, PRINTED IN QOM, WHICH PASSED OFF OUTRAGEOUS DISTORTIONS AS OFFICIAL. THE BASIC PROBLEM, TIJANI SAID, WAS THAT MANY WRITERS DID NOT UNDERSTAND THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN FAZILAT (WISDOM) AND FOZULAT (MEDDLING).

TIJANI CONCLUDED THAT HE COULD UNDERSTAND BAHRAINI SENSITIVITIES ON SHIA-SUNNI MATTERS. HE SAID THAT CHRUCH-STATE RELATIONS IN SUNNI COUNTRIES WERE GENERALLY SMOOTHER THAN THEY WERE IN IRAN. THUS THE REVOLUTIONARY ------------------082989 082356Z /66 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 3665 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI USINT BAGHDAD AMCONSUL DHAHRAN AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MUSCAT USLO RIYAHD USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 09856 MESSAGE OF IRAN IS SEEN AS A THREAT TO THE ESTABLISHED ORDER IN BAHRAIN.

NOR, TIJANI ADMITTED, DID THE PREEMPTORY TONE OF ROWHANI'S MESSAGE HELP MATTERS VERY MUCH WHEN HE WROTE (ACCORDING TO PERSIAN TRANSLATION OF MESSAGE APPEARING IN LOCAL PRESS OF SEPT 3):"...WE ADVISE YOU THAT IT IS IN YOUR INTEREST TO IMMEDIATELY FREE ALL (SHIA DISSIDENT) PRISONERS AND TO SEND MODARESSI TO IRAN. OTHERWISE THE FLOOD CANNOT BE STOPPED AND THE ISLAMIC CALL WHICH HAS BEGUN IN BAHRAIN WILL SOON BE VICTORIOUS AS IT WAS IN IRAN. GOD HAVE MERCY ON THOSE WHO HAVE NOT LEARNED A LESSON FROM THE FATE OF THEIR COLLEAGUES."

WHATEVER HIS STATUS, AYATOLLAH ROWHANI APPEARS TO HAVE MADE HIMSELF CUSTODIAN OF THE BAHRAINI SHIA CAUSE. ACCORDING TO AN ARTICLE IN SEPT 5 ENGLISH-LANGUAGE TEHRAN TIMES, ROWHANI HAD RECENTLY HELD MEETINGS WITH A DELEGATION OF THE BAHRAIN PARTY OF THE OPPRESSED (MOSTAZ'AFIN), ONE OF WHOSE LEADERS, ABU MUSHIN, TOLD A PRESS CONFERENCE THAT HIS GROUP SOUGHT THE ESTABLISHMENT OF AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC IN BAHRAIN.

COMMENT: TIJANI IS A CAREER DIPLOMAT WITH LONG EXPERIENCE IN ARAB AFFAIRS. WE SEE LITTLE REASON TO QUESTION HIS JUDGEMENT THAT THE ACTIONS OF ROWHANI AND OTHERS ARE INDEPENDENT ACTS. WHATEVER KHOMEINI'S PERSONAL VIEWS ON BAHRAIN MAY BE, NEITHER HE NOR THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL HAVE EXPLICITLY ENDORSED ROWHANI'S ACTIONS. THE FACT REMAINS, HOWEVER, THAT IRAN IS NOT SPEAKING WITH ONE COHERENT VOICE IN FOREIGN POLICY. UNDER PRESENT CONDITIONS, FIGURES SUCH AS ROWHANI AND JOURNALISTS SYMPATHETIC TO HIS POINT OF VIEW ARE FREE TO EXPRESS THEIR OPINIONS AND LEAVE THE LISTENER WITH THE IMPRESSION THAT THEIR IDEAS CARRY OFFICIAL SANCTION.

MUCH OF THE CRITICISM OF THE RECENT ACTIONS OF THE BAHRAIN GOVERNMENT HAS BEEN MOTIVATED BY IRANIAN DOMESTIC POLITICAL CONSIDERATIONS. MANY SUPPORTERS OF THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTON CONSIDER THAT IRAN HAS A SACRED MISSION TO SUPPORT SHIA ISLAM AND PROTECT SHIA MUSLIMS EVERYWHERE. UNDER SUCH CONDITIONS, SPOKESMEN SUCH AS ROWHANI WILL BE EXPECTED BY THEIR FOLLOWERS TO TAKE UP THE CAUSE OF OPPRESSED SHIA MUSLIMS IN BAHRAIN OR ELSEWHERE WITHOUT REGARD FOR THE RESULTING DIFFICULTIES AND AMBIGUITIES IN IRANIAN FOREIGN POLICY. TOMSETH
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

THE KURDISH AREAS APPEAR FAIRLY QUIET WITH ONLY ISOLATED SNIPING AT PGOI FORCES BEING REPORTED BY TEHRAN PRESS. IT IS UNCLEAR IF THE ARMY HAS YET ENTERED SARDASHT BUT IN ANY CASE LITTLE RESISTANCE IS EXPECTED.

PGOI APPEARS TO BE GREETING THEIR "VICTORY" WITH RELIEF AND MAGNANIMITY. PRESS IS FULL OF STORIES OF HOW "OUR MISLED KURDISH BROTHERS" ARE TO BE FORGIVEN (EXCEPT THE LEADERS) AND OF PLANS FOR RECONSTRUCTION AND DEVELOPMENT AID WHICH IS TO BE FUNNELLED TO KURDESTAN. ACCORDING TO PRESS 22 COUNTER-REVOLUTIONARIES IN KURDESTAN WHO HAVE REPENTED THEIR ACTS HAVE BEEN ORDERED RELEASED BY THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COURT AND KHOMEINI HAS POINTED OUT THAT THE GOVERNMENT HAS BUDGETED 450 MILLION TOMANS FOR THE KURDISH AREA.

ON THE DARK SIDE OF THE PICTURE, HOWEVER, IS THE ANNOUNCEMENT THAT REVOLUTIONARY JUDGE KHALKHALI IS NOW IN MAHABAD, PRESUMABLY TO START TRIALS DESPITE APPEALS BY A GROUP OF MAHABAD CITIZENS THAT HE NOT COME. AFP SEPTEMBER 5 ALSO REPORTED THAT KURDS IN MAHABAD HAVE DEMONSTRATED FOR THE WITHDRAWAL OF CENTRAL GOVERNMENT FORCES (WE HAVE NO INDICATION OF THIS). WHILE THE GOVERNMENT APPEARS TO BE NEGOTIATING WITH SOME TRIBAL LEADERS AND HAS REPORTEDLY RECEIVED PLEDGES OF ALLEGIANCE FROM 22 SUCH LEADERS IN SALMAS, WEST AZERBAIJAN, THE MAIN GROUP OF KURDISH REBELS WHO WITHDREW IN GOOD ORDER TO THE HILLS FROM THE MAHABAD AREA HAVE STILL TO BE
(C-ENTIRE TEXT)

WHILE IN TABRIZ POLOFF METRINKO AND DEPTOFF GRUMMON PAID A COURTESY CALL ON THE NEW TURKISH CONSUL GENERAL. DURING THE COURSE OF THE CONVERSATION THE LATTER REVEALED THAT TURKISH OFFICIALS (PARTICULARLY AT THE TURKISH CONSULATE IN URUMIYEH, FORMERLY REZAIYEH) HAVE REGULAR CONTACT WITH IRANIAN KURDISH LEADERS. (HE DID NOT SAY WHETHER TURKEY WAS PROVIDING MATERIAL SUPPORT TO THE KURDS.)

APPROXIMATELY FIVE DAYS AFTER THIS CONVERSATION THE TURKISH GOVERNMENT, PERHAPS IN RESPONSE TO AN IRANIAN COMPLAINT THAT AN UNNAMED MOSLEM COUNTRY WAS SUPPORTING THE KURDS, ISSUED A FORMAL PUBLIC COMMUNIQUE EMPHATICALLY STATING THAT TURKEY WAS NOT INTERFERING IN IRAN'S INTERNAL AFFAIRS AND THAT IT WAS NEITHER GIVING SUPPORT TO THE GOVERNMENT NOR THE KURDS IN THE CURRENT ROUND OF FIGHTING. THE TURKISH CONSUL'S COMMENTS INDICATE, HOWEVER, THAT THE TURKS INTEND TO APPLY THEIR NEUTRALITY POLICY EVENLY BY KEEPING COMMUNICATIONS CHANNELS OPEN TO BOTH SIDES.

THE CONSUL ALSO REPORTED THAT THE IRANIAN GENDARMERIE BORDER POST AT SERO (RECENTLY THE SCENE OF FIERCE FIGHTING BETWEEN KURDS AND GOVERNMENT SECURITY FORCES) HAD BEEN ABANDONED. PEOPLE WERE FREELY CROSSING THE BORDER (THE CONSUL HAD DONE SO ON AUGUST 26) AND THE GENDARMERIE HEADQUARTERS WAS OCCUPIED BY A LONE KURDISH SHEPHERD.

1979TEHRAN09861.subject: A PERSIAN VILLAGE AND THE REVOLUTION: PART I

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: THE FOLLOWING IS A TRIP REPORT BY EMBASSY POLOFF WHO SPENT TWO DAYS IN A VILLAGE NEAR SHIRAZ HE LAST VISITED IN 1977. LIFE IN THE VILLAGE OF DARYOON HAS BEEN ONLY SLIGHTLY AFFECTED BY THE REVOLUTION, AND NEITHER REVOLUTIONARY NOR ANTI-REVOLUTIONARY FERVOR SEEM TO EXIST. DAILY LIFE DRAGS ON MONOTONOUSLY, AND THE MOST CONSPICUOUS SIGNS OF THE NEW ISLAMIC REPUBLIC ARE FLY SPECKED, DUSTY PICTURES OF KHOMEINI WHICH HAVE REPLACED THE FLY SPECKED DUSTY PICTURES OF THE SHAH. END SUMMARY.

THE VAST BULK OF PEASANTS IN CENTRAL IRAN PLAYED LITTLE PART IN THE REVOLUTIONARY EVENTS OF 1978-79, AND ARE UNLIKELY TO HAVE A POLITICALLY SIGNIFICANT ROLE IN THE NEAR FUTURE UNLESS THEIR WAY OF LIFE IS SERIOUSLY THREATENED. ATTACHED TO THEIR LANDS AND FLOCKS ,SUCH PEASANTS HAVE TRADITIONALLY EXPRESSED LITTLE INTEREST IN NATIONAL POLITICS AS SUCH, AND THE SLOW, PATIENT TEMOF THE AGRICULTURAL CYCLE IS NOT CONDUCIVE TO FRENZIED POLITICAL ACTIVITY. SUCH VILLAGERS ARE A DIFFERENT BREED FROM THEIR BROTHERS AND COUSINS WHO HAVE MIGRATED TO LARGER CITIES TO WORK IN FACTORIES OR CONSTRUCTION. AT THE SAME TIME, HOWEVER, THERE IS CONSIDERABLE COMMUNICATION BETWEEN THE VILLAGERS AND THE CITY DWELLERS.

ALMOST EVERY FAMILY FROM DARYOON HAS CLOSE RELATIVES ATTENDING SCHOOL OR WORKING IN SHIRAZ OR TEHRAN, AND VISITS BACK AND FORTH ARE COMMON. FOR THE PEASANTS OF THE CENTRAL PROVINCES, THE KURDISH, ARAB, BALUCHI AND TURKISH BORDER PROVINCES ARE FAR AWAY, AND IDENTITY WITH THESE MINORITIES IS NOT AN ISSUE YET. AS LONG AS THE PGOI AND THE AKHOUNDS OF QOM DO NOT SEEK TO ALIENATE THEM, IT SEEMS LIKELY THAT THE RURAL INHABITANTS OF THE INNER PROVINCES WILL IGNORE SUPERFICIAL POLITICAL CHANGES AND CONTINUE THEIR PASSIVE, MONOTONOUS AND PRODUCTIVE WAY OF LIFE.

THE VILLAGE OF DARYOON IS LOCATED 30 KILOMETERS EAST OF SHIRAZ ON THE RO TO KHARAMEH. BECAUSE OF THE POOR CONDITION OF THE GRAVEL AND DIRT ROAD, THE TRIP USUALLY TAKES ABOUT ONE HOUR, AND A NORMAL SEDAN WOULD HAVE TROUBLE TRAVERSING THE ROUTE. LEAVING SHIRAZ FROM THE SAADI SUBURB, THE ROAD IS UNMARKED, AND UNTIL ONE ARRIVZY AT DARYOON ITSELF, THERE ARE FEW SIGNS THAT THE AREA IS ANYTHING BUT A DESERT.

DARYOON HAS A POPULATION OF APPROXIMATELY 5,000 PEOPLE, AND WITH VERY FEW EXCEPTIONS ALL THE VILLAGE MEN ARE ENGAGED IN AGRICULTURAL WORK. THE VILLAGE IS A DUSTY, ALMOST TREELESS PLACE, WITH WHEAT FIELDS, A FEW VINEYARDS, AND LARGE VEGETABLE GARDENS SURROUNDING IT. WHEAT, CUCUMBERS, POTATOES AND CHICK PEAS ARE GROWN IN THE AREA. ACCORDING TO SEVERAL OF THE VILLAGE FARMERS, THE CROPS THIS YEAR HAVE BEEN EXCELLENT. DESPITE AN UNTIMELY FROST IN LATE SPRING THAT DESTROYED A LARGE PERCENTAGE OF THE PLANTING, PRICES HAVE BEEN FAVOR AND THE FARMERS WERE PLEASED WITH THEIR PROFITS.

ALL OF THE LOCAL FIELDS ARE IRRIGATED, USUALLY BY MOTOR POWERED DEEP WELLS WHICH HAVE REPLACED THE FORMER "QANAT" (UNDERGROUND CANAL) SYSTEM. WHILE INITIAL USE OF DIESEL MOTORS SEVERAL YEARS AGO TO DRAW WATER FROM THE WELLS HAD RESULTED IN A DRASTIC LOWERING OF THE WATER BED LEVEL, THIS PROBLEM MAY HAVE BEEN ALLEVIATED BY THE CONSTRUCTION OF A LARGE DAM IN THE AREA.

ACCORDING TO ------------------083147 090041Z /70 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 3669 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE AMEMBASSY MUSCAT SECTION 02 OF 04 TEHRAN 09861 ONE FARMER, THE WATER BED LEVEL HAS REMAINED STATIONARY (AT ABOUT 40 METERS) FOR THE PAST FOUR YEARS.

MANY OF THE VILLAGERS OWN FLOCKS OF SHEEP, AS DO THE BASSIRI NOMADS WHO SPEND LONG PERIODS CAMPED IN THE VICINITY. THE WOOL IS USED LOCALLY FOR CARPET WEAVING, AND DAIRY PRODUCTS ARE ALSO OBTAINED FROM THE FLOCKS. WITH A NORMAL DIET LIMITED TO BREAD, GREENS, YOGHURT, CHEESE AND OCCASIONAL MEAT, THE DARYOON VILLAGER CAN EXIST VERY COMFORTABLY AND CHEAPLY WITHOUT RELYING ON SHOPS FOR FOOD STUFFS OTHER THAN TEA OR SUGAR.

THE COTTAGE CARPET INDUSTRY IN DARYOON REMAINS SELFCONTAINED, AND THE VILLAGE WOMEN CAN FIND ALL NECESSARY MATERIALS EASILY AT HAND. WOOL FROM LOCAL FLOCKS, COLORED BY ONE OF THE TWO VILLAGE DYERS, IS WOVEN BY VILLAGE WOMEN INTO CARPETS WITH TRADITIONAL AREA DESIGNS. IN RECENT YEARS CARPET WEAVING HAS FALLEN OFF CONSIDERABLY, AND THERE SEEMS TO BE NO THOUGHT GIVEN TO DEVELOPING THE WOMEN'S SKILLS INTO ANY LARGE SCALE PRODUCTON.

ONE VERY TALENTED VILLAGE WEAVER TOLD POLOFF THAT SHE HAD NOT WOVEN ANY LARGER CARPETS IN SE YEARS, BECAUSE THE LARGER RUGS REQUIRED THREE WEAVERS, AND SHE COULD NOT FIND ANY OTHER WOMEN WHO WERE INTERESTED OR WHO NEEDED THE MONEY CARPET SALES BROUGHT. YOUNGER GIRLS IN THE VILLAGE RARELY BOTHERED TO LEARN WEAVING, AND THE MIDDLE AGED WOMEN WERE COMFORTABLE ENOUGH FROM THEIR HUSBANDS' AGRICULTURAL PROFITS NOT TO HAVE TO BOTHER. DARYOON HAS ONLY TWO CARPET MERCHANTS, AND BOTH CLAIMED THAT THE PRODUCTION OF BETTER QUALITY CARPETS CEASED ABOUT TEN YEARS AGO IN THE VILLAGE.

PRESENT DAY WEAVING IS USUALLY LIMITED TO SMALLER (ONE AND ONE-HALF METERS LONG) RUGS AND THESE ARE NORMALLY NOT MADE TO BE SOLD, BUT ARE FOR HOUSE USE. THE MERCHANTS' BUSINESS CONSISTED MAINLY OF BUYING AND SELLING OLDER CARPETS FROM SMALLER VILLAGES IN THE AREA.

THE INHABITANTS OF DARYOON ARE MEMBERS OF THE BASSIRI TRIBE, AND FAMILY CONNECTIONS WITH THE STILL NOMADIC SEGMENTS OF THE TRIBE REMAIN VERY STRONG. IN MANY CASES, VILLAGERS WHO HAVE SETTLED PERMANENTLY IN DARYOON HAVE MOTHERS, FATHERS OR SIBLINGS WHO CONTINUE TO MIGRATE ON THE BASSIRI TREK BETWEEN SHIRAZ AND JAHROM. VILLAGE MEN ROUTINELY SELECT BRIDES FROM AMONG THEIR NOMADIC COUSINS, ALTHOUGH IT IS LESS COMMON FOR VILLAGE GIRLS TO MARRY NOMADS AND LEAVE THE VILLAGE FOR THE MIGRANT LIFE.

DARYOON NOW HAS ONE HIGH SCHOOL WHERE STUDENTS MAY STUDY UP TO THE 12TH YEAR. UNTIL THE FEBRUARY REVOLUTION, BOYS AND GIRLS WERE MIXED AT ALL LEVELS. AFTER THE REVOLUTION HOWEVER, SEGREGATED CLASSES WERE PUT INTO EFFECT, AND BECAUSE THE NUMBER OF GIRLS STUDYING AT THE HIGH SCHOOL LEVEL WAS SO SMALL (ABOUT TEN STUDENTS) THE LOCAL DEPT OF EDUCATION SIMPLY TOLD THE GIRLS TO LEAVE THE SCHOOL WITHOUT OFFERING ANY ALTERNATE PLANS FOR THEIR EDUCATION.

SINCE IT HAS BEEN CUSTOMARY FOR THE BETTER STUDENTS TO ATTEND HIGH SCHOOL IN SHIRAZ, ANY GIRL WHO WISHES TO OBTAIN A DIPLOMA CASUMABLY MOVE IN WITH RELATIVES OR FRIENDS IN THE CITY AND CONTINUE HER EDUCATION.

THE REVOLUTION HAS AFFECTED DARYOON IN OTHER WAYS, TOO. PRIOR TO FEBRUARY, THE VILLAGE HAD A SMALL GOVERNMENT CLINIC PRESIDED OVER BY A PAKISTANI DOCTOR. AFTER THE GENERAL EXODUS OF FOREIGNERS FROM IRAN, THE PAKISTANI PHYSICIN WAS TRANSFERRED TO A LARGER VILLAGE AND THE CLINIC WAS CLOSED. THE VILLAGE'S ONLY DRUG STORE, OWNED AND OPERATED BY A NATIVE OF THE VILLAGE, HAS ALSO SHUT DOWN RECENTLY. THE OWNER CLAIMED THAT HE WAS UNABLE TO PURCHASE DRUG SUPPLIES BECAUSE OF THE GENERAL SHORTAGES.

ANYONE WHO NOW REQUIRES DRUGS OR MEDICAL TREATMENT MUST ------------------083171 090042Z /70 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 3670 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE AMEMBASSY MUSCAT SECTION 03 OF 04 TEHRAN 09861 GO TO SHIRAZ FOR SUCH SERVICES, OR RELY ON THE SKILLS AND TRADIONAL DRUG LORE OF HIS FELLOW VILLAGERS.

ORGANIZED RELIGION DOES NOT SEEM TO PLAY AN IMPORTANT ROLE IN VILLAGE LIFE. WHILE THERE IS A VILLAGE MOSQUE, THERE IS NO AKHOUND (CLERGYMAN) RESIDING IN DARYOON. ON MAJOR RELIGIOUS HOLIDAYS AN AKHOUND MAY OR MAY NOT COME FROM SHIRAZ TO HOLD PRAYER SERVICES IN THE VILLAGE. ACCORDING TO ONE SOURCE, THE RAMAZAN FASTING RULES ARE USUALLY NOT OBSERVED BY THE VILLAGERS, AND RAMAZAN THIS YEAR WAS NO DIFFERENT FROM PREVIOUSLY IGNORED FASTING PERIODS. FRIDAYS AND NATIONALLY PROCLAIMED HOLIDAYS, WHETHER RELIGIOUS OR POLITICAL, HAVE NO EFFECT ON VILLAGE LIFE, SINCE DAILY FARM WORK CANNOT BE POSTPONED OR REGULATED BY A CALENDAR.
ONE RESIDENT STATED THE MATTER SUCCINCTLY WHEN HE ASKED "WHAT COULD THE PEOPLE HERE DO IF THEY TOOK A HOLIDAY?"

ENTERTAINMENT AND RECREATION IN THE VILLAGE IS VERY LIMITED BY WESTERN STANDARDS. WHILE TELEVISION EXISTS AND WAS POPULAR IN DARYOON PRIOR TO THE REVOLUTION, THE INHABITANTS NOW SUFFER FROM THE SAME DEARTH TERTAINMENT PROGRAMMING THAT AFFECTS ALL OF IRAN. THERE ARE NO SPORTS FACILITIES AS SUCH, AND EVEN THE DUSTY PLAYGROUND AREA ADJACENT TO THE SCHOOL WAS CLOSED FOR THE SUMMER. VILLAGE GIRLS AND WOMEN REMAIN INSIDE THEIR OWN HOMES, OR VISIT RELATIVES AND FRIENDS FOR ENTERTAINMENT. THE VILLAGE MEN AND BOYS SIMPLY SQUAT OR STAND IN SMALL GROUPS ALONG THE DUSTY STREETS OR CONGREGATE AT VARIOUS SHOPS AND DRINK TEA.

THE OVERALL IMPRESSION OF A WALK THROUGH THE SLEEPY VILLAGE IS THAT THE LOCAL RESIDENTS ARE WAITING FOR SOMETHING TO HAPPEN TO BREAK THE MONOTONY, WHETHER IT BE THE EXCITEMENTOF A PASSING JEEP, OR ALMOST ANYTHING NOISY AND UNUSUAL ENOUGH TO GENERATE COMMENT AMONG THE STANDING/SQUATTING CITIZENS. PART OF THE LISTLESSNESS OF LIFE IN DARYOON IS UNDOUBTEDLY THE RESULT OF THE OPIUM ADDICTION IN THE AREA. MANY MEMBERS OF THE OLDER GENERATION USE OPIUM ON A DAILY BASIS, AND IT IS COMMON FOR YOUNGER MALES TO INDULGE ONCE OR TWICE A WEEK ON A SOCIAL BASIS.
OPIUM USAGE IS NOT FROWNED UPON ON EITHER ON A SOCIAL OR RELIGIOUS BASIS, AND THE SUPPLY SEEMS TO BE PLENTIFUL.

DARYOON PLAYED ALMOST NO ROLE IN IRAN'S REVOLUTION, AND IN GENERAL THE VILLAGERS WERE CONTENT TO SIT AND WATCH EVENTS FROM AFAR. THERE NAS NEVER BEEN A POLICE OR GENDARMERIE POST IN THE VILLAGE, AND SO THERE WAS NO PAHLAVI SYMBOL AGAINST WHICH ANY EMOTION COULD BE GENERATED. SOME OF THE YOUNGER VILLAGERS DID MAKE A HALFHEARTED ATTEMPT TO DISARM A REGIONAL GENDARMERIE POST AFTER THE REVOLUTION, BUT THEY WERE QUICKLY STOPPED BY WISER HEADS. THE VILLAGE HAD A FEW BAHAI FAMILIES, AND AN ALTERCATION DEVELOPED LATE IN THE WINTER, BUT THE NET RESULT WAS ONE BROKEN TELEVISION SET IN A BAHAI RESIDENCE.

ONE OLD BAHAI FARMER LEFT DARYOON TO STAY WITH RELATIVES IN SHIRAZ, BUT HE IS EXPECTED TO RETURN. THE OTHER BAHAI FAMILIES STAYED IN THE VILLAG THERE HAS BEEN NO RECURRENCE OF TROUBLE SINCE LAST WINTER. PICTURES OF KHOMEINI DECORATE THE INTERIOR WALLS OF VARIOUS SHOPS AND ALL THE HOUSES VISITED, BUT THEY SEEM TO OCCUPY THE SAME FRAMES ONCE USED FOR THE SHAH'S PORTRAIT, AND TO GENERATE JUST AS LITTLE COMMENT. ALREADY DUSTY AND FLY SPECKED, THE KHOMEINI PICTURES WERE FRAMED OR TACKED TO PLASTER WALLS NEXT TO POSTERS OF WEEPING KEENE CHILDREN OR SWISS MOUNTAIN SCENES, AND SERVED THE SAME PURELY DECORATIVE FUNCTION.

THE LISTLESS ATTITUDE OF DARYOON DURING THE HEAT OF IRAN'S REVOLUTION HAS BECOME EVEN MORE VAGUE AND LISTLESS SINCE FEBRUARY. THE MINOR CHANGES IN THE VILLAGE HAVE BEEN TAKEN IN STRIDE AND NOW GENERATE LITTLE OR NO ------------------083228 090043Z /70 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 3671 INFO AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE AMEMBASSY MUSCAT LAIECTION 04 OF 04 TEHRAN 09861 COMMENT.

FOR THE VILLAGERS OF DARYOON, THE POLITICIANS OF TEHRAN AND QOM ARE FAR AWAY, AND AS LONG AS THE WEATHER IS MILD AND THE GOVERNMENT DOES NOT TRY TO SERIOUSLY INTERFERE IN VILLAGE LIFE, IT HARDLY MATTERS WHO RULES

1979TEHRAN09862.subject: A PERSIAN VILLAGE AND THE REVOLUTION: PART II

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: OPINIONS HELD BY INDIVIDUAL IRANIANS VIS A VIS THEIR REVOLUTION DEPEND IN LARGE PART ON HOW BENEFICIAL THE POLITICAL CHANGES HAVE BEEN TO THEM PERSONALLY. FOR THOSE PEASANTS WHOSE LIVES HAVE NOT CHANGED WITH THE REVOLUTION, IT MAKES LITTLE DIFFERENCE WHICH REGIME IS IN POWER, OR WHETHER IRAN'S RULER WEARS A CROWN OR A TURBAN. VIEWS EXPRESSED BY PROVINCIAL MEMBERS OF THE PROFESSIONAL AND MIDDLE CLASS, HOWEVER, SEEM TO BE CONSISTENT WITH THEIR TEHRAN PEER GROUP'S ANTI-CLERGICAL ATTITUDES. END SUMMARY.

DURING A RECENT VISIT TO A SMALL VILLAGE IN FARS PROVINCE, POLOFF HAD OPPORTUNITY TO WITNESS BASIC LACK OF EFFECT OF THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION ON RURAL LIFE. EXCEPTIONS EXIST, HOWEVER, AND THE FOLLOWING IS A SAMPLING OF SOME INDIVIDUAL ATTITUDES TOWARDS THE REVOLUTION.

POLOFF'S HOST WAS A FRIEND OF NINE YEARS STANDING WHO RECEIVED HIS B.S. DEGREE INUSA. EMPLOYED AT THE IRANIAN ELECTRONICS INDUSTRY IN SHIRAZ AS A COMPUTER SPECIALIST, THE US GRADUATE SPENDS ALL OF HIS FREE TIME IN THE VILLAGE OF DARYOON WORKING ON THE SMALL FARM HIS FAMILY OWNS THERE. HE IS PRESENTLY INVESTING MUCH OF HIS CAPITAL IN THE CONSTRUCTION OF A HIGH STONE WALL AROUND A TWO ACRE GARDEN PLOT NEAR THE VILLAGE, AND PLANS TO BEGIN PLANTING AN ORCHARD WITHIN THE WALLS.

BASICALLY NON-POLITICAL, THE HOST TOOK NO PART IN REVOLUTIONARY ACTIVITY DURING THE PAST YEAR, BUT NOW EXPRESSES A GREAT DEAL OF ANTI-AKHOUND (CLERGY) AND ANTI-KHOMEINI SENTIMENT. HE CLAIMS KHOMEINI HAS NO KNOWLEDGE OF POLITICAL REALITY, AND THAT THE AYATOLLAH'S ACTIONS AND SPEECHES ARE MAKING IRAN A WORLD LAUGHING STOCK. THE REVOLUTION HAS NOT APPRECIABLY AFFECTED HIS OWN LIFE STYLE OR THAT OF THE VILLAGE,HOWEVER, AND ASIDE FROM THE ANTI-CLERICAL STANCE AFFECTED BY THE COMPUTER SPECIALIST, POLITICS IN GENERAL WAS OF NO INTEREST TO HIM.

THE HOST'S 60 YEAR OLD FATHER IS A FULL TIME RESIDENT OF THE VILLAGE WHO HAS NEVER BEEN EXPOSED TO ANY FRENZIED PACE OF LIFE. A LONG-TIME OPIUM ADDICT WITH MONEY FROM HIS FARM LANDS TO FULLY INDULGE HIS ADDICTION, HIS SOLE REACTION TO THE REVOLUTION WAS TO TAKE DOWN THE OLD PICTURE OF THE SHAH AND PUT ONE OF KHOMEINI IN THE SAME FRAME. PRIOR TO THE REVOLUTION HE HAD BEEN PROFITABLY ENGAGED IN MAKING SHORT TERM LOANS TO OTHER VILLAGERS AT HIGH INTEREST RATES.

WHEN PUBLIC CONDEMNATION OF USURY BEGAN, HOWEVER, MANY OF HIS DEBTORS REFUSED TO PAY EITHER THE INTEREST OR, IN SOME CASES, EVEN THE ORIGINAL MONIES ADVANCED. THE OLD ADDICT'S REACTION WAS A PHILOSPHICAL SHRUG OF THE SHOULDERS. HE HAS CUT HIS LOSSES AND NOW CONCENTRATES HIS CAPITAL ON MAKING PURCHASES OF WHEAT AND CHICK PEAS TO STORE IN HIS HOME AND HOPEFULLY SELL LATER AT A PROFIT. HIS CHIEF INTERESTS REMAIN OPIUM AND TING WITH HIS CRONIES IN THE DUSTY VILLAGE STREET, AND THE REVOLUTION HAS NOT AFFECTED THESE ALL IMPORTANT PAST TIMES.

ONE LUNCH HOST WAS TEIMUR, A MIDDLE AGED SEMI-NOMAD, SEMI-VILLAGER. WITH A WIFE AND SEVERAL CHILDREN IN THE VILLAGE, AND PARENTS WHO BELONG TO A NOMAD TRIBE, TEIMUR HAS ADJUSTED TO BOTH LIFE STYLES. TEIMUR HAS A SMALL POTATO PLOT ON THE FARTHEST EDGE OF THE CULTIVATED AREA, A LOCATION THAT ALLOWS HIM TO DRIFT INTO THE DESERT AND THE NOMADIC LIFE FOR DAYS AT A TIME.

A POLICE CAPTAIN WHO WAS VISITING HIS PARENTS IN DARYOON DISPLAYED INTENSE ANTI-REVOLUTIONARY AND ANTIKHOMEINI FEELINGS. DURING THE REVOLUTION THE CAPTAIN HAD BEEN PRISON DIRECTOR AND THEN A PRECINCT CHIEF IN MALAYER (NEAR ISFAHAN). HE CLAIMED THE POLICE THERE HAD HAD NO TROUBLE UNTIL AFTER KHOMEINI'S RETURN, WHEN A MOB OF TOWNSPEOPLE STORMED POLICE HEADQUARTERS. THE CAPTAIN HAD TO SHOOT HIS WAY OUT OF THE BUILDING AND ESCAPED THE CITY WITH HIS FAMILY. IN THE ENSUING WEEK, ALL POLICE OFFICER RESIDENCES IN THE TOWN EXCEPT HIS OWN WERE BURNED BY MOBSO OF HIS OWN ASSISTANTS HAVE BEEN EXECUTED BY REVOLUTIONARY COURTS, AS HAVE A NUMBER OF HIS FRIENDS.

THE CAPTAIN HAD SUFFERED NO PERSONAL LOSS OF PROPERTY, AND THE TOWNSPEOPLE HAD EVEN FORMALLY REQUESTED THAT HE BE NAMED CHIEF OF POLICE, BUT HE WAS INTENSELY BITTER OVER THE FATE OF HIS FELLOW OFFICERS. PRESENTLY ASSIGNED TO SHIRAZ, THE POLICE CAPTAIN SEEMS TO BLAME THE CLERGY AND KHOMEINI PERSONALLY FOR THE DEATHS OF HIS FRIENDS.

PERSIAN VIEWS TOWARDS THE REVOLUTION ARE BASED VERY MUCH ON ITS EFFECTS ON THEIR INDIVIDUAL LIVES. THE FARS PROVINCE POLICE OFFICER'S ATTITUDE HAS BEEN ECHOED REPEATEDLY BY OTHER SUCH PROFESSIONALS WHO HAVE LOST COLLEAGUES TO THE POST-REVOLUTIONARY PURGES, AND THIS IMPORTANT MINORITY GROUP MAY PLAY A ROLE IN AN ANTICLERGICAL, ANTI-REVOLUTIONARY MOVEMENT. IRANIAN JOURNALIST HAMID NAZARI, PUBLISHER OF THE WEEKLY ENGLISH-LANGUAGE "IRANIAN," TOLD CHARGE SEPT 7 THAT HE HAD RECENTLY ATTENDED SEVERAL SESSIONS OF THE ASSEMBLY OF EXPERTS. HE SAID THAT THE SITUATION THERE IS VERY CONFUSED, WITH THE HUSTLE AND BUSTLE RESEMBLING THE BAZAAR MORE THAN A LEGISLATIVE ASSEMBLY. ROBERT'S RULES OF ORDER HAVE NEVER BEEN HEARD OF, AND IT IS DIFFICULT TO TELL WHO IS IN CHARGE. FOR EXAMPLE, ON ONE RECENT DAY AYATOLLAH MOHAMMAD BEHESHTI, THE ASSEMBLY'S VICE PRESIDENT, WAS IN THE CHAIR ALTHOUGH PRESIDENT AYATOLLAH HOSSEIN ALI MONTAZERI WAS ALSO PRESENT.

BEHESHTI WAS TRYING RATHER VAINLY TO IMPOSE SOME ORDER, INSISTING THAT MEMBERS SPEAK ONLY WHEN RECOGNIZED BY THE CHAIR. AT ONE POINT MONTAZERI BROKE IN AND COMMENCED TO DELIVER WHAT PROMISED TO BE A LENGTHY LECTURE. BEGESHTI TRIED TO SILENCE HIM, POINTING OUT THAT HE HAD NOT SOUGHT RECOGNITION FROM THE CHAIR. "SHUT UP," MONTAZERI TOLD HIM, "I AM TALKING." THEREUPON, THE OTHER MEMBERS PROCEEDED TO DENOUNCE BEHESHTI FOR ALLOWING MONTAZERI TO SPEAK OUT OF TURN.

NAZARI SAID THAT THERE APPEARS TO BE LITTLE ORDER IN THE WAY THE INDIVIDUAL ARTICLES OF THE CONSTITUTION ARE TAKEN UP FOR CONSIDERATION. THE MEMBERSHIP HAS BEEN DIVIDED INTO A NUMBER OF COMMITTEES WHICH ARE SUPPOSED TO MAKE RECOMMENDATIONS. DURING ONE OF THE SESSIONS NAZARI ATTENDED MORE THAN 20 SEPARATE RECOMMENDATIONS, SOME PUT FORWARD BY THE COMMITTEES AND SOME BY INDIVIDUAL MEMBERS, WERE MADE REGARDING A SINGLE ARTICLE. THESE WERE ALL VOTED UPON, WITH NO RECOMMENDATION RECEIVING MORE THAN 30 VOTES AND SOME AS FEW AS THREE OR FOUR.

NAZARI THOUGHT IT EXTREMELY UNLIKELY THAT THE ASSEMBLY WOULD BE ABLE TO STICK TO ITS THIRTY-DAY SCHEDULE FOR COMPLETION OF THE CONSTITUTIONAL REVIEW. HE ESTIMATED THAT IT WOULD BE THE END OF THE YEAR BEFORE THE CONSTITUTION COULD BE PROMULGATED AND ELECTIONS HELD. DESPITE THE ASSEMBLY MEMBERSHIP'S LACK OF EXPERIENCE WITH PARLIAMENTARY PROCEDURE AND THE CONSEQUENT PROSPECT FOR DELAYED COMPLETION OF THE CONSTITUTIONAL REVIEW PROCESS, NAZARI BELIEVED THERE IS ONE POSITIVE ASPECT OF THE ASSEMBLY'S SESSIONS: HE ANTICIPATED THAT MANY MEMBERS WILL ALSO BE ELECTED TO THE MAJLES, AND HENCE THE LEGISLATIVE EXPERIENCE THEY ARE NOW GAINING WILL STAND THEM IN GOOD STEAD LATER.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

DURING LUNCHEON SEPTEMBER 6 WITH IRANIAN BUSINESSMAN FRIEND, POLOFF WAS ASKED IF USG WAS IN ANY WAY SUPPORTING FIROUZ SHARIFI IN HIS ATTEMPTS TO PUT TOGETHER A COALITION TO TAKE OVER THE PGOI. IRANIAN BUSINESSMAN SAID THAT HE HAD BEEN CALLED TO ONE OF HIS UNCLE'S HOUSES THE PREVIOUS NIGHT TO MEET "SOMEONE WHO MIGHT BE INTERESTING." THE INTERESTING FRIEND TURNED OUT TO BE FIROUZ SHARIFI WHO OVER THE COURSE OF AN INFORMAL EVENING APPARENTLY INFORMED THE GUESTS THAT HE HAD BEEN ASKED BY THE AMERICANS TO FORM A GROUP TO TAKE OVER THE GOVERNMENT.

SHARIFI WAS APPARENTLY LEAVING FOR PARIS IN THE NEXT COUPLE OF DAYS TO MEET WITH VARIOUS EXILE GROUPS THERE. BUSINESSMAN SAID THAT TWO OTHER BAKHTIAR CONNECTED INDIVIDUALS HAD JUST ARRIVED FROM PARIS AND ALSO ATTENDED THE GATHERING.

IN A CONVERSATION THE FOLLOWING DAY WITH BUSINESSMAN, POLOFF INFORMED BUSINESSMAN THAT POLITICAL COUNSELLOR TOMSETH HAD MET WITH SHARIFI, (REFTEL) THAT HE HAD ASKED FOR US ASSISTANCE AND THAT HIS REQUEST HAD BEEN REFUSED. POLOFF SAID WE FOUND SHARIFI'S ASSOCIATION OF US WITH HIS PLANS VERY DISTURBING. TOMSETH

PGOI ARMED FORCES APPEAR NOW TO BE IN CONTROL OF ALL MAJOR TOWNS IN THE KURDISH REGION. PGOI FORCES REPORTEDLY TOOK PIRANSHAHR SEPTEMBER 5 AND SARDASHT EVENING OF SEPTEMBER 6. REBEL KURDISH FORCES HAVE RETIRED TO THE HILLS BUT HAVE NOT YET BEGUN ANY ORGANIZED GUERILLA ATTACKS ON PGOI FORCES. ALTHOUGH GOVERNMENT FORCES ENTERED MAHABAD SEPTEMBER 3, TOWNS PEOPLE APPARENTLY STAGED FAIRLY LARGE PRO-KURDISH DEMONSTRATION (PRESS REPORTS 2,000 DEMONSTRATORS) SEPT 5 WHICH HAD TO BE BROKEN UP BY GOVERNMENT TROOPS FIRING SHOTS INTO AIR.

ON FRIDAY, SEPTEMBER 7 GROUP OF HIGH RANKING PGOI OFFICIALS LED BY PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN VISITED MAHABAD AND OTHER KURDISH TOWNS. (GROUP INCLUDED MINISTER OF THE INTERIOR SAHBAGHIAN, JOINT CHIEFS HEAD GENERAL SHAKER AND ARMY COMMANDER FALAHI). GROUP APPARENTLY DISCUSSED RELIEF ASSISTANCE AND DEVELOPMENT NEEDS OF THE KURDISH REGION. DURING THE VISIT, BAZARGAN PUBLICLY REAFFIRMED KHOMEINI'S STATEMENT THAT THE PGOI AMNESTY FOR THE REBELS DID NOT REPEAT NOT APPLY TO THE KDP LEADERSHIP. IN ADDITION, KHOMEINI AGAIN ON AUGUST 8 IN AN EMOTIONAL SPEECH COMMENORATING THE 17 OF SHAHRIVAR OFFERED A GENERAL AMNESTY TO ALL THOSE YOUNG KURKISH MEN WHO HAD BEEN "DECEIVED" BY THEIR LEADERS.

REVOLUTIONARY JUDGE KHALKHALI HAS CONTINUED TO MOVE ABOUT THE KURDISH AREAS HOLDING REVOLUTIONARY COURT TRIALS. HE HAS APPARENTLY SET UP TEMPORARY HEADQUARTERS IN MAHABAD. IN AN INTERVIEW WITH THE TEHRAN TIMES SEPTEMBER 8, KHALKHALI SAID THAT CONTRARY TO REPORTS IN THE INTERNAIONAL PRESS OF APPROXIMATELY 90 EXECUTIONS, "ONLY 53 PEOPLE HAVE BEEN EXECUTED THROUGHOUT KURDESTAN PROVINCE." KHALKHALI ADDED THAT HE HAD PARDONED MORE THAN 1,000 AND DID "NOT EXPECT MORE TO DRAW A SENTENCE (SIC)." COMMENT: EMBASSY HAS BEEN KEEPING TRACK OF EXECUTIONS WHICH HAVE BEEN PUBLISHED IN THE TEHRAN PRESS AND OUR FIGURES ON THOSE EXECUTED FOR DIRECT INVOLVEMENT IN THE KURDISH REBELLION IS 56.

NINE OF THESE WERE PGOI MILITARY OFFICERS AND MEN AND WE ASSUMED SOME OF THOSE EXECUTED WERE NOT ETHNIC KURDS. EMBASSY ASSUMES KHALKHALI'S FIGURE IS FAIRLY ACCURATE AS HE HAS NEVER BEEN RETICENT ABOUT HIS EXECUTIONS. KHALKHALI'S BRAND ISLAMIC JUSTICE CONTINUES TO BE THAT OF AN "EYE FOR AN EYE". IN THE INTERVIEW, KHALKHALI STATES THE HARDEST PUNISHMENT HE ISSUED WAS TO A MAN IN MAHABAD RESPONSIBLE FOR SMASHING THE TEETH OF A PRISONER AND BLINDING HIM. KHALKHALI STATED HE HAD ORDERED THE SAME PUNISHMENT FOR THE MAN BUT HAD REFRAINED FROM BLINDING HIM AFTER THE RELATIVES OF THE MAN'S VICTIM, ISLAMIC STYLE, GAVE THEIR PARDON.

BOTH FARSI LANGUAGE AND ENGLISH PRESS HAVE CARRIED VERY BRIEF MENTIONS OF UN HUMAN RIGHTS SUB-COMMISSION APPEAL TO PGOI FRIDAY THAT "THE REPORTED SUMMARY EXECUTIONS OF NUMEROUS KURDS IN IRAN" BE STOPPED. EMBASSY NOTES THAT WE HAVE HAD NO REPORTS OF EXECUTIONS SINCE SEPTEMBER 5 WHEN FOUR REBELS WERE EXECUTED IN SAQEZ. IN PARTICULAR, THERE APPEARS TO HAVE BEEN NO EXECUTIONS IN MAHABAD FOLLOWING ITS OCCUPATION ON SEPT 3.
