1979TEHRAN09948.subject: IRANIAN AMBASSADOR TO USSR: CLAIMS WESTERN PLOTS TO DISMEMBER IRAN

segments.text: PLOTS TO DISMEMBER IRAN

IN INTERVIEW APPEARING IN SEPTEMBER 9 ENGLISHLANGUAGE "TEHRAN TIMES," IRANIAN AMBASSADOR TO USSR MOHAMMAD MOKRI SPOKE OF A THREE-POWER INTERNATIONAL PLOT TO DISMEMBER IRAN. MOKRI ACCUSED ISRAEL, THE CIA , AND BRITISH INTELLIGENCE OF MASTERMINDING THE PLOT, WHICH WAS TO BEGIN WITH THE SEPARATION OF KURDESTAN FROM IRAN FOLLOWED BY THE SEPARATION OF AZARBAIJAN. MOKRI DID NOT SPECIFY THE SOURCES OF HIS INFORMATION ABOUT THIS PLOT. HE SAID ONLY THAT DURING HIS TWENTY FIVE YEARS OF ANTI-MONARCHY ACTIVITY HE "DEVELOPED REASONABLY RELIABLE SOURCES OF INFORMATION."

MOKRI CLAIMED THAT HE LEARNED OF THE PLOT IN MOSCOW AND IMMIEDIATELY ADVISED IMAM KHOMEINI AND THE GOVERNMENT TO ACT DECISIVELY. (ACCORDING TO AN EARLIER INTERVIEW WITH IRANIAN RADIO, MOKRI SAID THAT KURDESTAN WOULD HAVE BEEN LOST TO IRAN IF THE GOVERNMENT HAD ACTED THREE DAYS LATER.) .

ASKED ABOUT POSSIBLE SOVIET INVOLVEMENT IN THE EVENTS IN KURDESTAN, MOKRI SAID: "I DO NOT HAVE ANY INDICATION TO SHOW ANY RUSSIAN INVOLVEMENT IN THE PLOT. BESIDES, THE RUSSIANS ARE TOO WISE TO SHOOT IN THE DARK AND TAKE THE RISK OF SPOILING THEIR RELATIONS WITH US."

MOKRI (HIMSELF OF KURDISH EXTRACTION) SAID THAT THE GOVERNMENT SHOULD NOT BE VINDICTIVE TOWARD THE KURDS. RATHER THEY SHOULD BE TREATED AS THEY WERE BEING TREATED, WITH KINDNESS. HOWEVER, THEIR LEADERS WHO WERE INVOLVED WITH FOREIGN PLOTTERS SHOULD BE DEALT WITH HARSHLY.

REFERRING TO A CRITICAL ARTICLE BY COMMENTATOR ALEXANDER BOVIN APPEARING IN THE SOVIET NEWSPAPER "ISVESTIA,"MOKRI SAID THAT ONE ARTICLE IN ONE NEWSPAPER DOES NOT NECESSARILY REPRESENT OFFICIAL SOVIET POLICY. "TEHRAN TIMES" EDITORIAL OF SEPT 10, ANSWERING BOVIN'S ARTICLE, REFERS TO MOKRI'S STATEMENT WITH SKEPTICISM, SAYING "THE WRITER (BOVIN) IS SOMETIMES CREDITED TO REFLECT THE THINKING OF KREMLIN LEADERS."

COMMENT: MOKRI'S ACCUSATIONS DO NOT APPEAR TO HAVE MADE MUCH IMPACT IN THE IRANIAN MEDIA. THE LEFT WING PRESS, WHICH MIGHT HAVE GIVEN HIM WIDE PUBLICITY, HAS BEEN LARGELY SILENCED. THOSE DAILIES STILL PUBLISHING HAVE RELEGATED THE STORY TO THEIR BACK PAGES. WHILE THERE ARE CERTAINLY MANY IRANIANS WHO BELIEVE THAT FOREIGN POWERS ARE BEHIND THE KURDISH EVENTS, MOKRI'S STATEMENTS ARE GENERALLY CONSIDERED EXTREME AND WILL PROBABLY FIND A RECEPTIVE AUDIENCE ONLY AMONG HIS HARD CORE OF MARXIST
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

THE DEATH OF AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI CAUSED A GREAT OUTPOURING OF PUBLIC GRIEF IN TEHRAN AND THE PROVINCES. VAST CROWDS IN TEHRAN YESTERDAY PREVENTED THE FUNERAL FROM BEING HELD UNTIL 6:30 AM THIS MORNING (SEPT. 11). AN ESTIMATED ONE MILLION PEOPLE SPENT THE NIGHT IN BEHESHT-E-ZAHRA CEMETARY AWAITING TALEGHANI'S BURIAL. THE RADIO AND TELEVISION HAVE DISCONTINUED THEIR NORMAL PROGRAMMING FOR THREE DAYS OF NATIONAL MOURNING. CROWDS OF EMOTIONAL MOURNERS THROUGHTOUT THE COUNTRY SHOUTED SLOGANS SUCH AS "MOTAHARI: YOU HAVE A GUEST", AND "TALEGHANI: CONGRATULATIONS ON YOUR MARTYRDOM".

THE EXPRESSIONS OF GRIEF ARE A REFLECTION OF TALEGHANI'S POPULARITY AMONG ALMOST ALL CLASSES OF IRANIANS. BRIEFLY, THE REASONS FOR HIS POPULARITY INCLUDE: - (A) HE WAS NOT IDENTIFIED WITH ANY PARTICULAR CLASS OR REGION. RATHER HE WAS CONSIDERED AS A CONCILIATOR AND A HEALER OF DISPUTES AMONG SOCIAL CLASSES AND AMONG VARIOUS ETHNIC GROUPS. IN MARCH, HE HAD WORKED TO SETTLE THE DISPUTES IN SANANDAJ AND HE HAD BEEN INVOLVED IN HELPING TO SETTLE TURKISHKURDISH CLASHES IN NAQADEH. - (B) PERSONALLY, HE APPEARED MORE HUMANE THAN THE AUSTERE AND SOMETIMES REMOTE KHOMEINI.

MANY HAVE REMARKED HOW HE STOOD FOR HOURS IN THE SUN TO LEAD FRIDAY PRAYERS DESPITE HIS POOR HEALTH. IN HIS SPEECHES HE ADVOCATED A HUMANE VERSION OF ISLAM WHICH WAS AT SOME VARIANCE WITH KHOMEINI'S STRICTURES AGAINST WESTERN PRACTICES. - (C) MANY OF THE LIBERAL, WESTERNIZED GROUPS AND THE MARXIST LEFT LOOKED TO TALEGHANI AS PROTECTOR AND PATRON. TALEGHANI WAS SEEN AS A SHIELD AGAINST THE EXCESSES OF CLERICAL RULE. - (D) HIS LONG-TIME OPPOSITION TO THE SHAH'S REGIME WHICH BROUGHT HIM IMPRISONMENT, INTERNAL EXILE, AND TORTURE EARNED HIM THE TRUST OF MANY INDIVIDUALS WHO WERE ALSO PERSECUTED UNDER THE MONARCHY.
LIKE KHOMEINI, HE WAS KNOWN TO BE PERSONALLY HONEST AND NOT UNDER FOREIGN TUTELAGE.

TALEGHANI'S POPULARITY DURING HIS LIFETIME WAS MOST VIVIDLY DEMONSTRATED IN HIS PERFORMING THE DUTIES OF THE IMAM-E-JOM'EH (FRIDAY PREACHER) IN TEHRAN. HIS WEEKLY PRAYERS AT THE UNIVERSITY OF TEHRAN (AND HIS LAST AT BEHESHT-E-ZAHRA CEMETERY ON SEPT 7) WOULD ATTRACT AN ESTIMATED TWO MILLION WORSHIPPERS WHO SOUGHT TO PRAY BEHIND HIM. THE SELECTION OF TEHRAN UNIVERSITY AS THE SITE OF FRIDAY PRAYERS WAS HIGHLY SYMBOLIC OF TALEGHANI'S ROLE AS CONCILIATOR BETWEEN THE RELIGIOUS CLASSES AND THE SECULAR INTELLECTUALS. PRAYING BEHIND TALEGHANI WAS FOR THE IRANIAN MUSLIM, THE FREEST AND MOST DIRECT EXPRESSION OF CONFIDENCE HE COULD SHOW.
(UNDER THE MONARCHY, THE INSTITUTION OF FRIDAY PRAYERS FELL INTO DISUSE BECAUSE WORSHIPPERS WOULD NOT PRAY BEHIND AN IMAM APPOINTED BY THE SHAH.)

THE ANNOUNCEMENT OF TALEGHANI'S DEATH IN THE MORNING OF SEPTEMBER 10 REVEALED THAT HE HELD THE POST OF CHIEF OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL. THIS ANNOUNCEMENT WAS THE FIRST ACKNOWLEDGEMENT THAT TALEGHANI HELD SUCH A POST.

A STATEMENT ISSUED BY IMAM KHOMEINI'S OFFICE OF SEPT 10, APPOINTED AYATOLLAH HOSEIN ALI MONTAZERI AS THE NEW IMAM JOM'EH OF TEHRAN. IT WILL BE INTERESTING TO SEE WHETHER MONTAZERI, WHO IS CLOSELY IDENTIFIED WITH KHOMEINI, WILL ATTRACT THE SAME FOLLOWING AS TALEGHANI FOR HIS FRIDAY PRAYERS, AND WHETHER THE FRIDAY'S PRAYERS, WILL CONTINUE TO BE HELD AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY.

TALEGHANI HAD BEEN IDENTIFIED WITH THE LIBERAL AND RADICAL LEFTIST GROUPS WHICH HAVE RECENTLY COME UNDER ATTACK FROM KHOMEINI AND HIS ALLIES. THE MOHAHEDIN-EKHALQ, LOOKED TO HIM AS A LEADER AND PROTECTOR; HE WAS ALSO CLOSELY ASSOCIATED WITH PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN'S LIBERATION MOVEMENT OF IRAN. IN THE WEEKS BEFORE HIS DEATH, HOWEVER, TALEGHANI WAS SEEN AS TAKING A HARDER LINE AGAINST COMMUNISTS AND AGAINST THE KURDISH DEMOCRATIC PARTY, WHOM HE ACCUSED OF HAVING SOVIET SUPPORT. HIS FRIDAY SERMON OF AUGUST 24 CONTAINED STRONG LANGUAGE DIRECTED AGAINST THE COMMUNISTS AND THEIR ALLIES.

ALTHOUGH TALEGHANI DID NOT REPEAT KHOMEINI'S RECENT ATTACKS ON WESTERN INFLUENCES IN IRANIAN LIFE, TALEGHANI HAD APPARENTLY SETTLED WHATEVER DIFFERENCES HE HAD WITH THE IMAM. TALEGHANI MAY HAVE FELT THAT HE WAS BECOMING A FOCUS FOR OPPOSITION GROUPS WHOSE AIMS WERE BASICALLY HOSTILE TO THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTION. THIS FEAR, COMBINED WITH TALEGHANI'S STRONG BELIEF IN THE NECESSITY OF UNIFIED LEADERSHIP COULD HAVE LED HIM TO MUTE HIS PUBLIC DISAGREEMENTS WITH KHOMEINI'S LEADERSHIP. ALTHOUGH CYNICS MIGHT SAY THAT TALEGHANI WAS CO-OPTED BY HIS APPOINTMENT AS IMAM JOM'EH, IT IS MORE LIKELY THAT HE WAS GENUINELY CONCERNED THAT HIS DISAGREEMENTS COULD ENCOURAGE THOSE BASICALLY HOSTILE TO THE REVOLUTION.

TALEGHANI HAS LEFT NO POLITICAL ORGANIZATION OR POLITICAL HEIR. THE LOYALTY OF THE RELIGIOUS MASSES, THE LIBERALS, AND THE LEFTISTS TO HIM WAS INTENSELY PERSONAL. AYATOLLAH SHARI'AT-MADARI, FOR EXAMPLE, DOES NOT HAVE THE SAME PERSONAL CHARISMA OR INVITE THE SAME INTENSE LOYALTY FROM SUCH A VARIETY OF GROUPS. WE DO NOT KNOW WHAT WILL HAPPEN TO THOSE GROUPS WHO SAW TALEGHANI AS THEIR ULTIMATE PROTECTOR, BUT AT PRESENT THERE IS NO ONE TO REPLACE HIM AS MODERATOR AND CONCILIATOR. IT MAY BE SOME TIME BEFORE THESE GROUPS, WHO HAD LITTLE IN COMMON EXCEPT A REVERANCE FOR TALEGHANI, CAN FIND ANOTHER FIGURE UPON WHOM THEY CAN FOCUS THEIR LOYALTIES.

IN THE MEANTIME WE CAN EXPECT FURTHER DIFFUSION AND WEAKENING OF THE SECULAR MOVEMENT, WHICH IN TALEGHANI'S DEATH, HAS LOST A POWERFUL ALLY. AT THE SAME TIME, KHOMEINI WILL UNDOUBTEDLY SUFFER FROM THE LOSS OF A MEDIATOR WITH GROUPS WHO OPPOSE SOME OF HIS MORE EXTREME RELIGIOUS IDEALS. LAINGEN

THE PERSIAN PRESS CARRIED PORTIONS OF FONMIN YAZDI'S INTERVIEW WITH BARBARA WALTERS AND YAZDI WAS QUOTED IN BAMDAD OF SEPT 12 AS SAYING WASHINGTON HAS PROMISED TEHRAN THAT THE USA WOULD NEVER PROVIDE ASYLUM FOR THE FORMER SHAH. HE ADDED THAT IF THE SHAH RETURNS TO IRAN HE WOULD BE TRIED AND EXECUTED. YAZDI CLAIMED THAT THE SHAH'S CHILDREN WOULD BE PARDONED, BUT HE MADE NO STATEMENT ON THE FATE OF THE EMPRESS FARAH. ETELAAT OF SEPT 11 HAD A SLIGHTLY MORE EXPANDED VERSION OF YAZDI'S STATEMENT.

ACCORDING TO ETELAAT, WHEN YAZDI WAS ASKED WHICH US AUTHORITY HAD PROMISED IRAN NOT TO PERMIT THE SHAH TO ENTER THE USA, HE SAID THAT "US REPRESENTATIVES" HAD DONE SO. WHILE THE WORD CONGRESSIONAL WAS NOT MENTIONED, THE IMPLICATION IN THE ARTICLE WAS THAT THE REPRESENTATIVES WERE FROM CONGRESS.

SECRETARY'S MESSAGE OF CONDOLENCE TO PM BAZARGAN ON DEATH OF AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI WAS REPORTED IN FULL ON TEHRAN RADIO AND TELEVISION. PERSIAN LANGUAGE PAPERS ALSO GAVE FULL TEXT OF MESSAGE ON INSIDE PAGES. ENGLISH-LANGUAGE KAYHAN INTERNATIONAL OF SEPTEMBER 13 CARRIED FRONT PAGE HEADLINE "VANCE MOURNS DEATH OF AYATOLLAH" WITH FULL TEXT OF SECRETARY'S AND CHARGE'S
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

WOULD APPRECIATE ANY INFORMATION DEPARTMENT OR HAVANA CAN PROVIDE ON ACTIVITIES AND STATEMENTS OF IRANIAN FOREIGN MINISTER YAZDI AT NON-ALIGNED SUMMIT.MEETING WAS OF PARTICULAR IMPORTANCE FOR IRAN AS IT WAS THE NEW GOVERNMENT'S FIRST REAL FORAY INTO THE NON-ALIGNED WORLD.
AS CHARGE WILL MEET FON MINISTER YAZDI TUESDAY, SEPTEMBER 18 WOULD APPRECIATE IMMEDIATE REPLY BY COB WASHINGTON TIME AUGUST 17. LAINGEN

EMBASSY TRIPOLI IS CORRECT IN ITS IMPRESSION THAT MONTAZERI IS REGARDED AS A RENEGADE IN IRAN, WHERE HE IS KNOWN AS "SHEIKH RINGO". HIS MOST RECENT DEPARTURE FROM TEHRAN'S MEHRABAD AIRPORT IN LATE AUGUST, ALTHOUGH NOT AS DRAMATIC AS THE ARMED CONFRONTATION IN JULY, WAS ANOTHER DEMONSTRATION OF THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT'S INABILITY TO DEAL WITH MONTAZERI. MONTAZERI APPEARED AT THE AIRPORT WITH A BAHREINI PASSPORT AND WAS TOLD THAT HE HAD TO TRAVEL AS AN IRANIAN. THAT DIFFICULTY WAS SOLVED WHEN THE POLICE AT MEHRABAD AIRPORT WERE PERSUADED TO ISSUE A NEW PASSPORT WITH AN EXIT PERMIT IN ONE HOUR.

IF THE LIBYANS ARE INTERESTED IN NORMALIZING RELATIONS WITH IRAN, MOHAMMAD MONTAZERI WOULD APPEAR A POOR CHANNEL FOR SUCH A MOVE. ALTHOUGH MONTAZERI DOES HAVE SOME FOLLOWING IN IRAN AND BENEFITS FROM THE PRESTIGE OF HIS FATHER, THE NEWLY APPOINTED IMAM-JOM'EH (FRIDAY PRAYER LEADER) OF TEHRAN AND THE PRESIDENT OF THE COUNCIL OF EXPERTS, HIS RADICAL, PRO-LIBYAN VIEWS RUN CONTRARY TO THOSE OF THE POWERFUL IRANIAN RELIGIOUS LEADERS WHO SEE SHIA ISLAM AS THE BASIS OF IRANIAN NATIONAL IDENTITY.

ALTHOUGH THE PRECISE NATURE OF MONTAZERI'S CONTACTS WITH PALESTINIAN GROUPS AND WITH LIBYA ARE UNKNOWN IN TEHRAN, THE MOST FREQUENT RUMOR IS THAT HE HAS BEEN TRANSFERRING LARGE SUMS OF MONEY TO LIBYA. ACCORDING TO ONE RUMOR, IN JULY MONTAZERI ABSCONDED WITH THE IRANIAN CROWN JEWELS.

MONTAZERI ACCUSES ANYONE WHO DOES NOT AGREE WITH HIM OF BEING A ZIONIST AND CIA AGENT. SO FAR THE TARGETS OF HIS ACCUSATIONS HAVE INCLUDED AYATOLLAH SADEQ ROWHANI AND EVEN (REPORTEDLY) THE LATE AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI.
EMBASSY IS REPORTING ON MONTAZERI'S LATEST ESCAPADE

1979TEHRAN10135.subject: IRANIAN PRIME MINISTER'S VISIT TO BALUCHISTAN

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

ON SEPTEMBER 11, IRANIAN PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN, INTERIOR MINISTER SABBAGHIAN AND ARMY COMMANDER FALLAHI PAID A WHIRLWIND ONE-DAY VISIT TO BALUCHISTAN AND SISTAN. THE GROUP VISITED THE TOWNS OF ZAHEDAN AND ZABOL. FROM THE NUMEROUS REFERENCES DURING THE TRIP TO KURDESTAN, THE INSPECTION TOUR WAS OBVIOUSLY AIMED AT GIVING THESE TOP PGOI LEADERS A FIRSTHAND LOOK AT ANOTHER POTENTIAL TROUBLE SPOT IN THE ETHNIC AREAS.

DURING THE VISIT BAZARGAN ASSURED THE BALUCHIS AND SISTANIS OF PGOI'S INTEREST IN THEIR WELFARE AND INTENTION TO HELP IN THE ECONOMIC WELFARE OF THE AREA. FOLLOWING HIS RETURN TO TEHRAN, BAZARGAN NOTED THAT ONE OF THE MOST SERIOUS PROBLEMS IN BALUCHESTAN WAS THAT THE CENTRAL GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS WERE UNFAMILIAR WITH CONDITIONS IN THE PROVINCE.

ACCORDING TO PRESS REPORTS, BAZARGAN SAID THAT THE "AFGHAN BROTHERS PRESENT IN SISTAN" WERE THE BIGGEST PROBLEM THERE. HE SAID THEY SHOULD BE GIVEN A SPECIFIC AREA OF RESIDENCE TO COPE WITH THEIR FOOD AND HOUSING PROBLEMS (SIC) BUT THEY WERE NOT TO ENGAGE IN POLITICAL OR MILITARY ACTIVITIES OR ARMS TRAFFIC WITHIN IRANIAN TERRITORY. REGARDING AFGHANISTAN, BAZARGAN IS QUOTED AS SAYING "WE PRAY TO GOD THAT OUR MUSLIM (AFGHAN) BROTHERS WILL BE SUCCESSFUL IN THEIR STRUGGLE FOR INDEPENDENCE, JUSTICE AND SECURITY IN THEIR COUNTRY.
BUT THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT WILL IN NO WAY INTERFERE WITH THEIR INTERNAL AFFAIRS AS OTHERWISE WE WILL NOT BE ABLE TO ASK OTHERS TO REFRAIN FROM INTERFERING IN OUR AFFAIRS."

FOLLOWING THE TRIP, THE GOVERNOR GENERAL OF THE PROVINCE HABIB HARIRI IS QUOTED AS STATING THERE ARE BETWEEN 4,000-5,000 AFGHAN REFUGEES IN IRAN WHO WERE ALLOWED TO STAY BUT NOT UNDERTAKE ANY TYPE OF ACTIVITY AGAINST AFGHANISTAN FROM IRANIAN SOIL. COMMENT: LIGHTLY POPULATED AND VERY POOR, BALUCHISTAN APPEARS TO BE FAIRLY QUIET AT THE MOMENT. ACCORDING TO PRESS REPORTS, PGOI AUTHORITIES SEEM MAINLY CONCERNED WITH GUN RUNNING, DRUG SMUGGLING AND LOCAL FEUDS RATHER THAN WITH THE POSSIBILITY AT THE MOMENT OF ANY SERIOUS

1.(C) SUMMARY:DURING THE PAST FEW DAYS, PM MEHDI BAZARGAN HAS BEEN THE TARGET OF CRITICISMS FROM VARIOUS SIDES. HE HAS BEEN ACCUSED OF ANTI-CLERICALISM, OF INEFFECTIVENESS, AND OF GENERAL BUNGLING. BAZARGAN HAS ANSWERED THESE ATTACKS BY CLAIMING THAT THE SAME PERSONS WHO WERE CRITICIZING HIM ARE NOT ALLOWING HIS GOVERNMENT TO FUNCTION. DESPITE THESE ATTACKS, IT APPEARS THAT BAZARGAN STILL ENJOYS THE SUPPORT OF KHOMEINI AND WILL NOT BE REPLACED IN THE NEAR FUTURE. END SUMMARY.

(C) THE FIRST ATTACK ON BAZARGAN CAME FROM AYATOLLAH DR. MOHAMMAD BEHESHTI, VICE-CHAIRMAN OF THE COUNCIL OF EXPERTS, MEMBER OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL, AND CHAIRMAN OF THE CENTRAL COMMITTEE OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLICAN PARTY. IN AN INTERVIEW WITH PARS NEWS AGENCY IN QOM ON SEPTEMBER 14, DR. BEHESHTI BLAMED THE GOVERNMENT AND PM BAZARGAN FOR FAILING TO IMPLEMENT A BILL ON THE FORMATION OF LOCAL COUNCILS. ACCORDING TO BEHESHTI, THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL TWO MONTHS BEFORE HAD APPROVED A BILL CALLING FOR THE FORMATION OF COUNCILS AT PROVINCE, CITY, DISTRICT, AND VILLAGE LEVELS. BEHESHTI SAID DR.

BAZARGAN'S GOVERNMENT HAD FAILED TO IMPLEMENT THIS BILL, EITHER BECAUSE OF DELIBERATE PROCRASTINATION OR BECAUSE OF GENERAL ADMINISTRATIVE WEAKNESS. (DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER BANI-ASSADI TOLD CHARGE SEPT 17 THAT BAZARGAN'S OFFICE, IMMEDIATELY AFTER RECEIVING THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL'S BILL, HAD SENT A LETTER TO THE COUNCIL TELLING THEM THAT THE BILL AS DRAFTED WAS UNREALISTIC BUT THAT THE GOVERNMENT WOULD WORK OUT A FEASIBLE BILL ALONG THOSE LINES.)

(C) LATER THE SAME DAY, THE MONOTHEISM PARTY (HEZB-ETOWHIDI) ISSUED A SEVEN-POINT STATEMENT CRITICIZING THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT FOR NEGLECT AND INDIFFERENCE. LITTLE IS KNOWN ABOUT THE HEZB-E-TOWHIDI EXCEPT THAT IT IS AN ISLAMIC POLITICAL GROUPING WITH POSSIBLE TIES TO AYATOLLAH SADEQ ROWHANI.

THE CRITICISMS DIRECTED AT BAZARGAN INCLUDED: - (A) GOVERNMENT INDIFFERENCE TO CRITICISMS OF IRAN IN THE FOREIGN PRESS, BOTH WESTERN AND NON-ALIGNED. - (B) SEEKING POPULARITY BY PLAYING WITH WORDS AND BY OPPOSING THE ADVICE OF THE RELIGIOUS LEADERS. "PERHAPS YOU HAVE FORGOTTEN THAT THE IRANIAN ISLAMIC MOVEMENT IS LED BY THE CLERGY." - (C) DELAY IN IMPLEMENTING THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL'S BILL ON FORMATION OF LOCAL COUNCILS. - (D) NEGLECTING TO FOLLOW AYATOLLAH ROWHANI'S ADVICE ABOUT THE NECESSITY OF PURGING THE GOVERNMENT OF ANTI-REVOLUTIONARY ELEMENTS.

(U) THESE ATTACKS WERE ACCOMPANIED BY AN ATTACK ON SATURDAY, SEPTEMBER 15 BY REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL AND COUNCIL OF EXPERTS MEMBER ABU AL-HASAN BANI-SADR. SPEAKING TO AN AUDIENCE IN YAZD, BANI-SADR ATTACKED BAZARGAN'S ECONOMIC POLICIES AND ACCUSED HIM OF HINDERING THE WORK OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL.

BANI-SADR ALSO ACCUSED BAZARGAN OF: - (A) REFUSING TO ACCEPT CONSTRUCTIVE CRITICISM. - (B) BUNGLING IN KURDESTAN AND THAN TRYING TO CLAIM CREDIT FOR GOVERNMENT ACTION THERE. - (C) OPPOSING THE NATIONALIZATION OF THE BANKS, A FAVORITE PROGRAM OF BANI-SADR. ------------------014175 171412Z /43 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 0000 INFO SECDEF WASH DC JCS WASH DC AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 10138 - (D) BURYING HIMSELF IN TRIVIA AND NOT ORGANIZING HIS WORK PROGRAM.

(U) IN AN ATTACK APPEARING IN THE ENGLISH AND PERSIAN-LANGUAGE PRESS OF SEPTEMBER 16, TEHRAN REVOLUTIONARY PROSECUTOR AYATOLLAH AHMAD AZARI-QOMI CRITICIZED BAZARGAN FOR ALLEGEDLY ANTI-CLERICAL STATEMENTS IN THE PRIME MINISTER'S EULOGY FOR AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY ON SEPTEMBER 11. AZARI-QOMI (WHO ANNOUNCED HIS RESIGNATION FOR HEALTH REASONS) SAID THAT BAZARGAN HAD SAID THAT TALEGHANI, UNLIKE THE MAJORITY OF RELIGIOUS LEADERS, WAS NOT OPPOSED TO THE MANIFESTATIONS OF MODERN CIVILIZATION. ACCUSING BAZARGAN OF WEAKENING REVOLUTIONARY UNITY, AZARI QOMI SAID, "IT IS VERY STRANGE THAT A DISTINGUISHED FIGURE AS MR. BAZARGAN WOULD MAKE AN UNFAIR ACCUSATION AGAINST THE CLERGY.

WAS IT NOT TALEGHANI'S GOAL TO UNITE ALL GROUPS, THE FOREMOST OF WHICH WAS A COMMITTED AND ACTIVE CLERGY? HOW CAN HE (BAZARGAN) PRAISE TALEGHANI BY STIRRING UP THE PEOPLE AGAINST THE CLERGY AND BY CONDEMNING THIS PROGRESSIVE AND ACTIVE GROUP AS REACTIONARY?"

(C) LOCAL PRESS ACCOUNTS OF BAZARGAN'S SPEECH DID NOT INCLUDE THE STATEMENTS WHICH OFFENDED AZARI-QOMI. EMBASSY WILL CHECK FULL TEXT OF SPEECH (WHEN AVAILABLE) TO ESTABLISH EXACTLY WHAT PRIME MINISTER SAID.

(C) ALTHOUGH THE PRESS HAS BEEN GIVING WIDE PUBLICITY TO THESE ATTACKS, BAZARGAN'S REACTION HAS SO FAR BEEN LIMITED TO A STATEMNT AT AN ECONOMIC SEMINAR (REPORTED BY ETTELAAT OF SEPTEMBER 16) THAT THE SAME (UNNAMED PERSONS WHO WERE CRITICIZING HIS GOVERNMENT FOR ITS INEFFECTIVENESS WERE THE SAME ONES WHO WERE INTERFERING IN GOVERNMENT AFFAIRS AND PREVENTING HIS CABINET FROM OPERATING.)

(C) THIS IS NOT THE FIRST TIME (NOR WILL IT BE THE LAST TIME) THAT BAZARGAN HAS BEEN UNDER ATTACK FROM MEMBERS OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL RELIGIOUS LEADERS, AND THEIR SUPPORTERS. ALTHOUGH THE ATTACKS COMING FROM VARIOUS DIRECTIONS AND FROM VARIOUS PERSONALITIES, NOT NECESSARILY PART OF ANY CONCERTED ANTI-BAZARGAN CAMPAIGN, THERE ARE ENOUGH COMMON THEMES IN THE CRITICISMS TO INDICATE THE COMMON INTERESTS OF HIS OPPONENTS. THESE THEMES INCLUDE: - (A) IGNORING THE ADVICE OF THE RELIGIOUS LEADERS. - (B) IGNORING THE INSTRUCTIONS OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL. - (C) GENERAL INEFFECTIVENESS AND BUNGLING.

(C) IT IS WORTH NOTING, HOWEVER, THAT NONE OF THESE ATTACKS MENTION AYTATOLLAH KHOMEINI BY NAME AND THAT NONE OF THE ATTACKERS NOTE ANY CLAIM TO SPEAK FOR HIM. IN PREVIOUS DISAGREEMENTS OF THIS KIND, BAZARGAN HAS HAD ENOUGH SUPPORT FROM THE IMAM TO OVERCOME CALLS FOR HIS DISMISSAL. IT IS LIKELY THAT AS LONG AS BAZARGAN CONTINUES TO HAVE KHOMEINI'S SUPPORT (AND THERE IS NO SIGN OF HIS LOOSING IT) HE WILL BE ABLE TO SURVIVE SUCH ATTACKS. BAZARGAN'S SURVIVAL, HOWEVER, IS UNLIKELY TO MAKE HIS GOVERNMENT ANY MORE EFFECTIVE IN DEALING WITH THOSE WHO HAVE ALREADY TAKEN OVER MOST OF ITS FUNCTIONS. LAINGEN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

KURDISH AREAS HAVE REMAINED FAIRLY QUIET OVER THE PAST WEEK ALTHOUGH SCATTERED CLASHES BETWEEN PGOI FORCES AND KURDISH REBELS CONTINUE TO BE REPORTED. PGOI HAS REESTABLISHED CONTROL OVER ALL MAIN TOWNS IN THE AREA AND APPEARS TO BE LAUNCHED ON A CAMPAIGN OF ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT OF THE AREA. ALL RETURNS ARE NOT YET IN, AND EMBASSY IS UNWILLING TO SPECULATE IF THE APPARENT SUCCESS OF PGOI FORCES IN RECAPTURING KURDESTAN IS A LASTING ONE.

OVER THE PAST WEEK PGOI FORCES, AFTER REESTABLISHING CONTROL OVER ALL TOWNS IN THE KURDISH AREAS, HAVE BEEN ENGAGING IN "MOPPING UP" OPERATIONS. KAYHAN ON SEPTEMBER 15 REPORTED SEVERAL CLASHES NEAR THE TURKISH BOARDER IN WEST AZARBAIJAN AND IN THE AREA OF PIRANSHAHR, SARDASHT AND SALMAS. OTHER REPORTS MENTION GUNFIRE AT NIGHT IN THE MAHABAD AREA. ONE DRAMATIC REPORT FROM SARDASHT ALLEGES THAT THE MILITARY HAD SURROUNDED 400 MEMBERS OF THE KDP IN THE AREA AND WAS ATTACKING WITH JETS AND HELICOPTERS (WE HAVE NO CONFIRMATION OF THIS.)

IRAN DOES NOT SEEM TO BE HAVING ANY PROBLEMS WITH EITHER IRAQ OR TURKEY IN THE BORDER AREAS. ONE PRESS REPORT STATES THAT TURKEY HAS REFUSED PERMISSION FOR PEOPLE TO ESCAPE TO TURKEY VIA SERO. REVOLUTIONARY JUDGE KHALKHALI CLAIMED THAT LAST WEEK IRAQUI ARMED FORCES ATTACKED IRANIAN KURDISH GUERILLA POSITIONS 25 KILOMETRES SOUTHWEST OF BANEH AND FORCED THE KURDS TO MOVE BACK TOWARDS THE IRANIAN BORDER. KHALKHALI IS TREATING THE CASE OF SIX IRAQUI KURDS CAUGHT FIGHTING WITH THE KURDISH REBELS WITH UNCHARACTERISTIC CAUTION. ALTHOUGH HIS COURT HAS SENTENCED THEM TO DEATH, THEY HAVE BEEN BROUGHT TO TEHRAN FOR REVIEW OF THEIR CASE.

SINCE SEPTEMBER 8, ONLY TWO KURDS HAVE BEEN EXECUTED AND THESE EXECUTIONS WERE PROBABLY UNRELATED TO KURDISH REBEL ACTIVITIES. WITH KHALKHALI'S RETURN TO QOM IT APPEARS THE PACE OF EXECUTIONS HAS DEFINITELY SLOWED ALMOST TO A HALT. THIS MAY REFLECT A MORE GENEROUS PGOI ATTITUDE TO THE CONQUERED. HOWEVER, EMBASSY WONDERS IF PGOI CAUTION MAY NOT ALSO COME FROM FACT THAT KURDS APPEAR TO BE HOLDING FAIRLY LARGE NUMBERS OF PGOI HOSTAGES (FROM 80-150). WHATEVER THE CASE WE ASSUME THAT MAJOR DAMAGE HAS ALREADY BEEN CAUSED AMONG FIERCELY LOYAL TRIBAL KURDS BY PGOI POLICY OF EXECUTIONS.

THE TWO LATEST KURDISH EXECUTIONS WERE OF MEMBERS OF TOP SANANDAJ FAMILIES BAHRAMIKAMANGER CHARGED WITH REBEL ACTIVITIES AND FORCEABLY OCCUPING LAND NEAR THE CITY; AND ALI REZA SANANDAJI (KNOWN AS VALI KHAN) CHARGED WITH CLOSE TIES TO THE FORMER GOVERNMENT, KILLING A FARMER AND SEXUALLY ASSUALTING A VILLAGE WOMAN. REGARDLESS OF THE ACCURACY OF THESE CHARGES, THESE EXECUTIONS IN PARTICULAR ARE LIKELY TO FURTHER ALIENATE TWO VERY POWERFUL KURDISH CLANS.

AS PREVIOUSLY REPORTED, PGOI OFFICIALS HAVE CONTINUED TO STRESS THEIR INTENTION TO HELP THE KURDISH AREAS RECOVER FROM THE FIGHTING AND DEVELOP ECONOMICALLY. HOWEVER, THE GOVERNOR-GENERAL OF KURDESTAN SHAKIBA, HIMSELF A KURD, TOLD THE PRESS THAT ALTHOUGH HE HAD INITIALLY BEEN CONFIDENT CONDITIONS WOULD IMPROVE, HE WAS NO LONGER SURE.

HE IS QUOTED AS SAYING THE "SITUATION IS RAPIDLY DETERIORATING IN KURDESTAN." THIS SITUATION, HE CHARGES, IS DUE TO THE SENTENCES PASSED ON REBELS BY KHALKAHLI AND TO THE ACTIONS OF THE REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS AND THE RELIGIOUS COMMITTEES. ------------------013603 171244Z /50 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 3811 INFO SECDEF WASH DC JCS WASH DC AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 10139

COMMENT: THE HARSH PGOI RESPONSE TO THE KURDISH SITUATION HAS HAD TWO RESULTS: THE PGOI HAS REESTABLISHED UNQUESTIONED CONTROL OVER THE MAIN KURDISH TOWNS AND LINES OF COMMUNICATION TO THE BORDER. IT ALSO SEEMS, PERHAPS TEMPORARILY, TO HAVE QUIETED MUTTERINGS IN OTHER SUNNI AREAS ABOUT INCREASED AUTONOMY. ALL THE RETURNS ARE CERTAINLY NOT IN. WE DO NOT KNOW EITHER HOW STRONG OR HOW UNIFIED THE REBEL KURDS WILL BE. WE ASSUME THAT FOR THE FORESEEABLE FUTURE THERE WILL CONTINUE TO BE LOW LEVEL GUERILLA ATTACKS AGAINST THE PGOI FORCES BY VARIOUS GROUPS.

WHETHER THIS FIGHTING WILL TURN INTO A FULL SCALE GUERILLA WAR WITH ACTIVE SUPPORT OF THE TOWNS PEOPLE - FIGHTING WHICH COULD SERIOUSLY THREATEN THE PGOI'S CONTROL OF TOWNS AND COMMUNICATIONS-IS TOO EARLY TO SAY. LAINGEN

1979TEHRAN10140.subject: NATIONALIZATION OF PRIVATE SCHOOLS IN IRAN.

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

THE PGOI ANNOUNCED SEPTEMBER 16 THAT ALL PRIVATELY OWNED SCHOOLS IN IRAN WOULD BE NATIONALIZED. ACCORDING TO TEHRAN RADIO, THE NATIONALIZATION WILL BE A ONE-YEAR EXPERIMENTAL PROGRAM WHICH THE GOVERNMENT HOPES WILL BE SUCCESSFUL AND BECOME PERMANENT.

DURING COURTESY CALLS ON DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER BANI ASSADI SEPTEMBER 17, CHARGE HAD BRIEF DISCUSSION OF NATIONALIZATION OF SCHOOLS. ASSADI IS US EDUCATED SON-IN-LAW OF PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN AND DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER IN CHARGE OF "COOPERATION" (HAMKARI PERHAPS BETTER TRANSLATED IN THIS CASE AS SELF-HELP). ASSADI SAID THAT HE HAD PROPOSED NATIONALIZATION OF ALL THE SCHOOLS TO THE PREVIOUS GOVERNMENT BEFORE THE REVOLUTION BUT THAT NOTHING HAD HAPPENED. THE GOVERNMENT IS VERY SERIOUS THIS TIME IN ITS INTENTION. NATIONALIZATION WILL INCLUDE ALL THE FOREIGN SCHOOLS SUCH AS IRAN ZAMIN.

ASSADI SAID THAT THE NEWLY NATIONALIZED SCHOOLS WOULD BE RUN BY A SCHOOL COMMITTEE COMPOSED OF APPROXIMATELY TWO TEACHERS FROM THE SCHOOL, TWO PARENTS OF THE SCHOOL CHILDREN AND ONE OFFICIAL APPOINTED FROM THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION. THE GOVERNMENT WOULD FUND THE SCHOOLS AND NO TUITION WOULD BE PAID TO THE SCHOOLS FROM THE PARENTS. .. -"

COMMENT: THIS REGIME, LIKE THE PREVIOUS ONE, OBVIOUSLY FEELS THE NEED TO "DO SOMETHING" ABOUT THE IRANIAN SECONDARY AND ELEMENTARY SCHOOL SYSTEM. THIS GOVERNMENT IN PARTICULAR HAS BEEN INTERESTED IN FORMING A MORE EGALITARIAN SCHOOL SYSTEM. PAST ANNOUCEMENTS OF THIS KIND, IN WHICH THE GOVERNMENT DECLARES ALL SCHOOLING FREE AND ALL PRIVATE SCHOOLING ABOLISHED, HAVE USUALLY BEEN FOLLOWED BY A FEW WEEKS OF CONFUSION AND THE EMERGENCE OF A SYSTEM DIFFERING FROM THE OLD ONLY IN NAME.

AT THE ROOT OF THE GOVERNMENT'S CHRONIC INABILITY TO UNDERTAKE ANY REFORM OF THE SCHOOL SYSTEM HAS BEEN TWO BASIC FACTORS. - (A) THE SHEER COMPLEXITY OF THE PROBLEM IN TERMS OF NUMBERS, OF STUDENTS, SHORTAGES OF PERSONNEL, AND SIZE OF INVESTMENT REQUIRED. - (B) THE TENDENCY TO CONFUSE DECLARATIONS AND INTENTIONS WITH ACTION.

ALTHOUGH WE COULD BE UNDER-ESTIMATING THE ABILITIES OF THIS GOVERNMENT, WE SUSPECT THAT THIS STEP HAS BEEN UNDERTAKEN WITH A MINIMUM OF THOUGHT ABOUT FOLLOWUP AND IMPLEMENTATIONS. THE NATIONALIZATION WILL UNDOUBTEDLY MEAN CLOSER GOVERNMENT CONTROL OF THE SCHOOLS BUT HOW PRECISELY THIS WILL EFFECT WESTERN ORIENTED SCHOOLS SUCH AS IRAN ZAMIN IS UNCLEAR. WE WILL BE FOLLOWING THE SITUATION CLOSELY IN THE NEXT
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

WHILE MORE THAN 150 POLITICAL ORGANIZATIONS OF ONE SORT OR ANOTHER HAVE DECLARED THEMSELVES TO THE PUBLIC IN THE SIX MONTHS SINCE THE REVOLUTION, VERY FEW OF THESE CAN BE CONSIDERED POLITICAL PARTIES IN THE CLASSICAL SENSE OF THE WORD. MOST WOULD MORE ACCURATELY BE DESCRIBED IN PERSIAN TERMS AS DOREH, CIRCLES OF INDIVIDUALS COMING TOGETHER FOR A COMMON PURPOSE UNDER THE PERSONAL SPONSORSHIP OF A LEADING MEMBER. AS MUCH, THEY TEND TO BE SMALL AND SUBJECT TO GREAT VICISSITUDES. FURTHER, WHILE THESE POLITICAL ORGANIZATIONS ARE IN PRINCIPLE BASED UPON AN IDEOLOGY, THE EXIGENCIES OF THE MOMENT OFTEN MAKE FOR RATHER ODD ALLIANCES.

WITNESS THE TUDEH PARTY'S CURRENT UNEASY SUPPORT FOR THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. WHAT FOLLOWS, THEN, IS AT BEST A ROUGH OUTLINE OF THE MOST SIGNIFICANT OF IRAN'S POLITICAL ORGANIZATIONS. THESE HAVE BEEN DIVIDED INTO SEVERAL BROAD CATEGORIES ON THE BASIS OF IDEOLOGICAL ORIENTATION, BUT THESE CATEGORIES SUGGEST NOTHING AT ALL OF RELATIONSHIPS AMONG GROUPS WITHIN A PARTICULAR CATEGORY OR POSSIBLE RELATIONSHIPS FROM ONE CATEGORY TO ANOTHER. ISLAMIC ORGANIZATIONS: - THE ISLAMIC REPUBLICAN PARTY - HEADED BY KHOMEINI CONFIDANT AND REPUTED MEMBER OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL DR. MOHAMMAD BEHESTI, THE ISLAMIC REPUBLICAN PARTY CURRENTLY ENJOYS THE BROADEST POPULAR SUPPORT OF ANY POLITICAL ORGANIZATION OPERATING IN IRAN.

HOWEVER, IT IS NOT CLEAR THAT IT POSSESSES AN ORGANIZATIONAL STRUCTURE IN ANYTHING MORE THAN THEORY. ONLY TIME WILL TELL WHETHER IT IS A MERE REFLECTION OF KHOMEINI'S CURRENT POPULARITY OR AN INSTITUTION CAPABLE OF SURVIVING HIM. THE PARTY'S PLATFORM, TO THE EXTENT ONE EXISTS, FAVORS A RIGIDLY THEOCRATIC FORM OF GOVERNMENT. - THE MUSLIM PEOPLE'S REPUBLICAN PARTY - LITTLE IS KNOWN ABOUT THE PARTY'S SECRETARY GENERAL, A MAN NAMED ALIZADEH, BUT IT IS WIDELY PERCEIVED THAT THE PARTY ITSELF IS THE POLITICAL VEHICLE OF AYATOLLAH KAZEM SHARIAT-MADARI. WHILE FAVORING A STRONG ISLAMIC CONTENT IN GOVERNMENT, THE PARTY'S PLATFORM IS LESS RIGIDLY THEOCRATIC THAN THAT OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLICAN PARTY.

FURTHER, IT HAS AN IMPORTANT ETHNIC ORIENTATION, ENJOYING PARTICULAR SUPPORT AMONG AZARI TURKS. - THE MONOTHEISM PARTY (HEZB-E-TOWHIDI) - THE LEADERSHIP AND POLICIES OF THIS PARTY ARE OBSCURE, BUT IT HAS BEEN CRITICAL OF PM BAZARGAN AND HAS FOLLOWED A STRONGLY PRO-CLERICAL LINE. IT MAY BE ASSOCIATED WITH AYATOLLAH MOHAMMED SADEQ ROWHANI. - THE MOJAHEDIN-E-KHALQ - THE MOJAHEDIN BEGAN AS A PARA-MILITARY MOVEMENT IN OPPOSITION TO THE PAHLAVI REGIME, THEN BECAME AN UMBRRELLA ORGANIZATION FOR A WIDE VARIETY OF GROUPS VAGUELY IDENTIFIED WITH ISLAM, AND MORE RECENTLY STILL HAS BEGUN TO FRAGMENT INTO A NUMBER OF COMPONENT ELEMENTS WHICH ARE FREQUENTLY IN CONFLICT WITH ONE ANOTHER.

THE MOST OPENLY POLITICAL ELEMENT IS HEADED BY MASOUD RAJAVI, A YOUNG MAN WHO OFTEN IDENTIFIES MORE CLOSELY WITH RADICAL POLITICAL GROUPS OF THE LEFT THAN WITH CONSERVATIVE ISLAMIC ORGANIZATIONS. THE PATRON SAINT OF THIS MOVEMENT IS THE LATE DR. ALI SHARIATI, A LEADING ISLAMIC INTELLECTUAL AND TEACHER PERSECUTED UNDER THE SHAH. - FORGHAN - FORGHAN IS A SMALL GROUP DEDICATED TO ISLAM WITHOUT THE ULEMA. IT HAS CHOSEN TERRORISM AS ITS PREFERRED MEANS OF POLITICAL EXPRESSION. RIGHT WING AND NATIONAL PARTIES: - PAN IRANIST PARTY - HEADED BY FORMER MAJLES MEMBER MOHSEN PEZESHKPOUR, THE PAN IRANIST PARTY HAS BEEN AROUND SINCE THE 1950'S.

DEDICATED TO THE PRINCIPLE OF A GREATER IRAN (INCLUDING THE RECAPTURE OF BAHRAIN AND LANDS LOST TO CZARIST RUSSIA), THE PAN IRANISTS HAVE NOT BEEN ABOVE RESORTING TO POLITICAL EXPEDIENCY TO STAY IN BUSINESS. IN 1975 THE PAN IRANIST PARTY ACCEPTED BLOC STATUS IN THE RASTAKHIZ PARTY, IRAN'S SINGLE LEGAL PARTY BETWEEN THAT YEAR AND 1978. - THE IRANIAN PEOPLE'S PARTY - LED BY MINISTER OF LABOR DARIOUSH FOROUHAR, THE IRANIAN PEOPLE'S PARTY WAS UNTIL ABOUT THREE MONTHS AGO A COMPONENT OF THE ------------------026797 190019Z /64 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 3814 SECTION 02 OF 03 TEHRAN 10141 NATIONAL FRONT.

SECULAR, NON-MARXIST ORGANIZATIONS: - THE NATIONAL FRONT - THE NATIONAL FRONT IS NOT REALLY A PARTY BUT RATHER A COLLECTION OF PARTIES. WITH THE DEPARTURE OF FOROUHAR, THE DISEMBOWELMENT OF THE IRAN PARTY FOLLOWING SHAPUR BAKHTIAR'S ACCEPTANCE OF THE PREMIERSHIP IN JANUARY, AND GROWING INDEPENDENCE OF THE LIBERATION MOVEMENT OF IRAN SINCE MEHDI BAZARGAN HAS BEEN PRIME MINISTER, HOWEVER, THE COLLECTION IS AT PRESENT QUITE DIMINISHED. THE CREATION OF THE NATIONAL DEMOCRATIC FRONT UNDER HEDAYATOLLAH MATIN-DAFTARI ALSO HAD THE EFFECT OF DRAWING AWAY MUCH POTENTIAL SUPPORT FROM SECULAR ORIENTED IRANIANS UNDER FIFTY.

THE RESULT HAS BEEN TO LEAVE THE NATIONAL FRONT AS AN ORGANIZATION WITH A LOT OF AGING CHIEFS (E.G., KARIM SANJABI) BUT VERY FEW INDIANS OF ANY AGE. IT'S CHIEF CLAIM TO LEGITIMACY IS AS THE HEIR TO DR. MOSSADEGH'S COALITION OF THE EARLY 1950'S. - THE NATIONAL DEMOCRATIC FRONT - THE NATIONAL DEMOCRATIC FRONT IS LESS A FRONT THAN A PARTY ALTHOUGH BY ITS OWN ADMISSION LITTLE HAS BEEN DONE TO CREATE AN ORGANIZATIONAL STRUCTURE. THE FRONT IS CLEARLY SEARCHING FOR A NICHE.

IT OFTEN VACILLATES BETWEEN STAKING OUT A POSITION AS THE NON-MARXIST SECULAR OPPOSITION TO THE ISLAMIC CROWD AND JOINING MUSLIM KNOW-NOTHINGS IN ATTACKS ON IMPERIALISM OF EAST AND WEST. MATIN-DAFTARI, THE SRONT'S FOUNDER AND MEMBER OF ITS GOVERNING COUNCIL IS IRESENTLY "UNDERGROUND" AVOIDING ARREST BY THE PGOI ON CHARGES STEMMING FROM THE MARCH WHICH THE FRONT ORGANIZED TO PROTEST RESTRICTIONS ON PRESS FREEDOMS. - THE LIBERATION MOVEMENT OF IRAN - OSTENSIBLY LED BY PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN,THE LIBERATION MOVEMENT OF IRAN HAS OCCUPIED A RATHER ANAMOLOUS POSITION FOR THE LAST SIX MONTHS. ITS LEADING MEMBERS, AS PART OF THE PGOI, HAVE NOT PARTICIPATED, AT LEAST OPENLY, IN PARTY ACTIVITIES.

NONETHELESS, SOME OF THEIR PRESTIGE AS KEY MEMBERS OF THE PGOI HAS REDOUNDED TO THE PARTY'S ADVANTAGE. FOR EXAMPLE, IT FIELDED A SEPARATE SLATE OF CANDIDATES FOR THE ASSEMBLY OF EXPERTS ELECTIONS, A DEGREE OF INDEPENDENCE OTHER SO-CALLED COMPONENTS OF THE NATIONAL FRONT DID NOT HAVE. - THE RADICAL MOVEMENT - HEADED BY RAHMATOLLAH MOGHADAM-MARAGHEIE, THE RADICAL MOVEMENT IS ALSO A SOMETIMES ASSOICATE OF THE NATIONAL FRONT. IT DOES NOT HAVE A PARTICULARLY LARGE FOLLOWING, BUT IS IMPORTANT BECAUSE OF ITS LINKS TO SUCH ORGANIZATIONS AS THE LAWYERS ASSOCIATION AND ITS BASE AMONG THE AZARI TURKS. MOGHADAMMARAGHEIE HIMSELF WAS ELECTED TO THE ASSEMBLY OF EXPERTS FROM EAST AZARBAIJAN.

HE WAS SPONSORED BY BOTH HIS OWN PARTY AND THE MUSLIM PEOPLE'S REPUBLICAN PARTY. - JUMBESH - A SMALL PARTY HEADED BY JAVADI, THE BROTHER OF THE MINISTER OF JUSTICE. IT WAS, SURPRISINGLY, THE LEADING VOTEGETTER IN TEHRAN OF THE NON-RELIGIOUS PARTIES. MARXIST ORGANIZATIONS: - THE TUDEH PARTY - THE TUDEH, PRESENTLY LED BY NOUROLLAH KIANOURI, HAS BEEN AROUND AS LONG AS ALMOST ANY OTHER IRANIAN POLITICAL ORGANIZATION AND, WHILE HAVING A LIMITED FOLLOWING, IS STRUCTURED ALONG THE LINES OF A TRUE POLITICAL PARTY. FOR THE MOMENT, THE TUDEH IS PURSUING A POLICY OF A UNITED FRONT WITH THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT.

TUDEH OPPOSITION TO THE GOVERNMENT'S POLICY, THE GOVERNMENT'S STRONGLY ANTI-COMMUNIST LINE AND THE CLOSURE OF THE PARTY'S NEWSPAPER SIGNAL AND THE TUDEH'S INCREASING UNEASE IN ITS RELATIONSHIP WITH THE PGOI. - THE FEDAYAN-E-KHALQ-E-IRAN - THE FEDAYAN, LIKE THE MOJAHEDIN, BEGAN AS A PARA-MILTIARY ORGANIZATION IN OPPOSITION TO THE PAHLAVI REGIME. IT CONTINUES TO REGARD ITSELF PRIMARILY IN THOSE TERMS, ALTHOUGH IN RECENT MONTHS IT HAS BEHAVED MORE AND MORE LIKE A POLITICAL ORGANIZATION. THE FEDAYAN FIELDED A SMALL SLATE OF CANDIDATES FOR THE ASSEMBLY OF EXPERTS ELECTIONS AND CAMPAIGNED HARD DURING THE BRIEF PERIOD ALLOTTED FOR SUCH ACTIVITIES.

ITS NEWSPAPER, KAR, WHICH WAS HEAVILY POLITICAL IN CONTENT WAS CLOSED RECENTLY BY THE GOVERNEMNT. - SOCIALIST WORKERS PARTY - LED BY A YOUNG AMERICAN EDUCATED RADICAL, BABAK ZAHRAIE, THE SOCIALIST WORKERS ------------------026822 190021Z /64 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 3815 SECTION 03 OF 03 TEHRAN 10141 PARTY APPEARS TO HAVE A MINISCULE FOLLOWING. ITS PRIMARY SIGNIFICANCE IS THE ATTENTION IT HAS RECEIVED FROM THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE STRUCTURE. AN UNUSUALLY HIGH PROPORTION OF PARTY MEMBERS APPEAR TO HAVE BEEN SINGLED OUT BY THE ISLAMIC MOVEMENT FOR HARASSMENT.

AT PRESENT TWO PARTY MEMBERS IN AHWAZ HAVE RECEIVED TERMS OF LIFE IMPRISONMENT AND TEN OTHERS ARE UNDER INDICTMENT FOR "SUBVERSIVE" ACTIVITIES. - THE KURDISH DEMOCRATIC PARTY - LED BY ABDOL RAHIM GHASEMLOU, THE KURDISH DEMOCRATIC PARTY SEEMS TO HAVE A VAGUELY LEFTIST ORIENTATION BUT IN ACTUALITY IS BASED PRIMARILY ON ITS ETHNIC IDENTIFICATION. THE PARTY ITSELF WAS INITIALLY JUST ONE OF SEVERAL CONTENDERS FOR SUPPORT AMONG THE KURDISH POPULATION, BUT IT RECENTLY GAINED THE SUPPORT OF SHEIKH EZZEDIN HOSSEINI, THE SINGULAR MOST POPULAR RELIGIOUS FIGURE IN KURDESTAN.

GHASEMLOU WAS ELECTED TO THE ASSEMBLY OF EXPERTS FROM WEST AZARBAIJAN, BUT DID NOT TAKE HIS SEAT BECAUSE OF OF THE KURDISH REBELLION. THE KDP WAS BLAMED BY THE PGOI FOR THE KURDISH REVOLT. ITS LEADERS ARE CHARGED WITH SUBVERSION AND THE PARTY ITSELF BANNED. - THE MUSLIM ARABS POLITICAL ORGANIZATION - THIS ORGANIZATION SEEMS TO BE A QUITE RECENT POLITICAL PHENOMENON. LITTLE IS KNOWN ABOUT IT EXCEPT FOR ITS PLATFORM OF DEMANDING MORE RIGHTS FOR IRANIAN ARABS IN KHUZESTAN PROVINCE. IT BOYCOTTED THE ASSEMBLY OF EXPERTS ELECTIONS, A TELLING COMMENT ON ITS POLITICAL STRENGTH, EVEN AMONG ETHNIC ARABS. LAINGEN

AFGHANISTAN EMBASSY CALLED MORNING OF SEPTEMBER 18, SAYING THAT IT WAS OPENING CONDOLENCE BOOK TODAY ONLY FOR DA'UD TAROON, MEMBER OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL WHO DIED SEPTEMBER 16. ACCORDING TO LOCAL PRESS REPORTS, TAROON WAS TARAKI'S PERSONAL BODYGUARD AND FORMER POLICE CHIEF.
UNLESS WE RECEIVE INSTRUCTIONS TO THE CONTRARY, WE DO NOT INTEND TO SIGN CONDOLENCE BOOK. BRITISH EMBASSY INFORMS US THAT AMBASSADOR, AS OF 0930 THIS MORNING DID NOT INTEND TO SIGN BOOK. LAINGEN

1979TEHRAN10181.subject: COUNCIL OF EXPERTS APPROVES GOVERNMENT OF THEOLOGIANS

segments.text: OF THEOLOGIANS (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

THE COUNCIL OF EXPERTS FOR EXAMINING THE NEW IRANIAN CONSTITUTION APPROVED ARTICLE V OF THE NEW CONSTITUTION ON SEPTEMBER 21 BY A VOTE OF 53-8 WITH FOUR ABSTENTIONS. THIS ARTICLE, ESTABLISHES THE VILAYAT-E-FAQIH, OR GOVERNMENT OF THEOLOGIANS. THE ARTICLE STIPULATES THAT IN THE ABSENCE OF THE IMAM OF THE AGE (TO WHOM ALL SECULAR POWER RIGHTLY BELONGS), THE MANAGEMENT OF PUBLIC AFFAIRS AND THE LEADERSHIP OF THE COMMUNITY IN THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN IS VESTED IN A JUST, VIRTUOUS, KNOWLEDGEABLE, COURAGEOUS, AND SAGACIOUS SPECIALIST IN ISLAMIC JURISPRUDENCE (FAQIH).

THIS LEADER MUST BE ACCEPTED AND RECOGNIZED BY A MAJORITY OF THE PUBLIC. IF SUCH A PERSON CANNOT BE FOUND, A COUNCIL OF HIGHLY QUALIFIED RELIGIOUS LAW SCHOLARS WILL ASSUME THIS FUNCTION. THE LAW WILL SPECIFY THE FORMATION AND ORGANIZATION OF THIS COUNCIL.

VILAYAT-E-FAQIH IS IN FACT THE TITLE OF ONE OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI'S WORKS OF POLITICAL PHILOSOPHY. NO ONE IS CERTAIN OF THE EXACT MEANING OF THE TERM OR OF ITS LONG-TERM POLITICAL IMPLICATIONS. HOWEVER, ITS ADOPTION DOES REPRESENT A SIGNIFICANT ALTERATION OF THE ORIGINAL DRAFT CONSTITUTION, WHICH ENVISAGED A SECULAR PRESIDENCY AND A REVITALIZED COUNCIL OF RELIGIOUS EXPERTS TO ENSURE THAT ALL LAWS WERE IN CONFORMANCE WITH ISLAM. THIS ARRANGEMENT WAS CONTAINED IN THE ORIGINAL 1906 CONSTITUTION BUT HAD NEVER BEEN IMPLEMENTED.

IN THE SHORT TERM, THE ADOPTION OF THIS ARTICLE APPEARS TO CLEAR THE WAY FOR AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI TO TAKE CHARGE OPENLY OF ALL SECULAR AND RELIGIOUS AUTHORITY. AS LONG AS KHOMEINI IS ALIVE, THERE WILL BE FEW RIVAL CANDIDATES FOR THE OFFICE'S OF FAQIH.

THE APPROVED ARTICLE MAKES NO MENTION OF THE OFFICE OF PRESIDENCY. NOR HAVE ANY OF THE ARTICLES APPROVED SO FAR DEFINED THE PRESIDENCY OR DEFINED THE RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN THE PRESIDENCY AND THE THEOCRATIC LEADER. IT APPEARS, HOWEVER, THAT THE INTENTION OF THIS ARTICLE IS TO FORMALIZE A MERGING OF STATE AND RELIGION AND TO ENSURE THAT THE NEW CHIEF OF STATE, WHATEVER HIS FORMAL TITLE, WILL BE DRAWN FROM AMONG THE LEADERS OF THE SHIA CLERGY. COUNCIL PRESIDENT MONTAZERI SAID ARTICLE WAS FORMAL ACKNOWLEDGEMENT THAT IN ISLAM RELIGION AND POLITICS ARE INSEPARABLE.

PERSIAN-LANGUAGE PAPER BAMDAD OF SEPTEMBER 15 REFERRED TO THIS OPINION, WRITING, "FOR SOME, NOT WELL-VERSED IN ISLAMIC JURISPRUDENCE, THE QUESTION IS WHETHER THE GOVERNMENT OF THE THEOLOGIAN IS THE SAME AS THE PRESIDENCY. IF IT IS NOT, THEN WILL NOT THE EXISTENCE OF TWO AUTHORITIES CREATE CONFLICT AND CONTRADICTIONS?"

SINCE THE ENTIRE CONCEPT OF VILAYAT-E-FAQIH IS CLOSELY ASSOCIATED WITH KHOMEINI, PUBLIC COMMENT HAS BEEN CAUTIOUS. COUNCIL REPRESENTATIVE ABU AL-HASAN BANI SADR IS QOUTED BY BAMDAD AS ASKING RHETORICALLY WHETHER IT WILL BE POSSIBLE TO FIND A SCHOLAR OF RELIGIOUS LAW WHO MEETS ALL OF THE CONDITIONS DEFINED IN THE ARTICLE. ANOTHER REPRESENTATIVE, MOQADDAM-MARAGHE'I, EXPLAINED HIS VOTE AGAINST THE ARTICLE BY SAYING THAT THIS THEOCRACY'S FUNCTIONING WAS DEPENDENT ON THE PRESENCE OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI BUT WOULD PROBABLY NOT WORK IN HIS ABSENCE.

ACCORDING TO A REPORTER WRITING IN THE SEPT 11 ENGLISH-LANGUAGE TEHRAN TIMES, ONE OF AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI'S LAST ACTS IN THE ASSEMBLY WAS TO VOTE ------------------022085 181256Z /50 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 3833 INFO SECDEF WASH DC JCS WASH DC AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 10181 AGAINST THIS ARTICLE. THIS REPORT HAS RECEIVED WIDE ACCEPTANCE IN TEHRAN. IF THERE IS TO BE ANY SIGNIFICANT OPPOSITION TO THE ARTICLE, THEN TALEGHANI'S OPINION COULD BECOME THE FOCUS OF THAT OPPOSITION.

HOWEVER, APPROVAL OF THIS ARTICLE IS AN INDICATION THAT THE PROPONENTS OF CLERICAL GOVERNMENT ARE NOW IN THE ASCENDANT IN THE COUNCIL OF EXPERTS. AT THE SAME TIME, VILAYAT-E-FAQIH, LIKE THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC, IS STILL AN UNKOWN QUANTITY FOR MOST IRANIANS. IF A REFERENDUM WERE HELD ON THE SUBJECT TODAY, THIS POLITICAL CONCEPT WOULD UNDOUBTEDLY RECEIVE OVERWHELMING APPROVAL AND THE DETAILS OF THIS ARRANGEMENT WOULD BE LEFT FOR THE LEARNED THEOLOGIANS TO WORK OUT. LAINGEN

1979TEHRAN10183.subject: IRANIAN FOREIGN MINISTER YAZDI TRIP TO UNGA

segments.text: DURING MEETING WITH CHARGE SEPTEMBER 18, FOREIGN MINISTER YAZDI INFORMED US THAT IRAN'S DELEGATES TO THE U.N., SHEMRANI,IS HANDLING HIS SCHEDULE AND THAT DEPARTMENT SHOULD CHECK WITH SHEMRANI FOR YAZDI'S TRAVEL PLANS TO THE UNGA AND FOR SCHEDULING OF MEETING WITH SECRETARY VANCE. COMMENT: THIS IS SECOND TIME IN LAST FEW WEEKS THAT YAZDI HAS REFUSED TO GIVE INFORMATION ON HIS TRAVEL PLANS TO EMBASSY OR OTHERS HERE IN IRAN. THE SAME PROBLEM OCCURRED OVER HIS PLANS FOR HIS VISIT TO HAVANA. WE DO NOT KNOW BUT SUSPECT SECURITY CONCERNS LIE BEHIND THIS CAUTION.

DURING CONVERSATION, YAZDI MENTIONED HIS INTEREST IN DISCUSSING THE MILITARY SUPPLY QUESTION WHILE HE WAS IN NEW YORK AND SAID HE UNDERSTOOD FROM IRANIAN CHARGE AGAH THAT THE SECRETARY OF DEFENSE WISHED TO SEE HIM. YAZDI SAID HE INTENDED TO TAKE A MILITARY AIDE WITH HIM FOR THIS MEETING. CHARGE SAID THAT HIS UNDERSTANDING WAS THAT PRECHT IN CONVERSATION WITH AGAH HAD RAISED THE POSSIBILITY OF SOMEONE FROM DEFENSE COMING TO NEW YORK TO BRIEF YAZDI. CHARGE ASSUMED THAT THIS MIGHT BE DEPUTY ASSISTANT SECRETARY OF DEFENSE FOR INTERNATIONAL AFFAIRS MURRAY. WE HAD NOT HEARD THE SECRETARY OF DEFENSE HIMSELF WOULD BE IN NEW YORK.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).
DURING MEETING WITH FOREIGN MINISTER YAZDI SEPT 18, CHARGE ASKED FOR YAZDI'S COMMENTS ON RESULTS OF HAVANA NON-ALIGNED MEETING.

DURING THE DISCUSSION, YAZDI STRESSED IRAN'S INDEPENDENT ROLE AT THE NAM AND MADE IT CLEAR IRAN DID NOT FOLLOW CUBA'S LEAD DURING THE MEETING. YAZDI MENTIONED BRIEFLY SOME OF THE NAM ISSUES, TOUCHING IN PARTICULAR ON IRAN'S ATTEMPT TO SUSPEND THE MEMBERSHIP OF EGYPT. HE SAID THAT THE MEETING HAD CONDEMNED CAMP DAVID AND HAD AGREED TO A COMPROMISE ON EGYPT TO DELAY ANY DECISION UNTIL 1981. YAZDI SAID THAT CAMBODIA WAS A PARTICULARLY HOT ISSUE AND ONE WHICH WAS NOT YET SETTLED.
HE STATED THAT THE NAM CONDEMNED VIETNAMESE INTERVENTION IN THE NAM, AND OBSERVED THAT WHILE THE OUTCOME OF VIETNAMESE INTERVENTIONS WAS GOOD, VIETNAM'S ENDS DO NOT JUSTIFY THE MEANS.

YAZDI SAID THAT HE HAD BEEN HAPPY TO BE ABLE TO MAKE A CONTRIBUTION TOWARD KEEPING THE NAM NON-ALIGNED. HE SAID THAT ONE OF IRAN'S MAIN CONTRIBUTIONS HAD BEEN TO DEMAND THAT THE NAM BE "CULTURALLY" NON-ALIGNED. YAZDI SAID THAT MANY NATIONS AT THE NAM ARE ANTIIMPERIALIST BUT THINK WITH A WESTERN MIND, ARE ANTI-USSR BUT THINK WITH A RUSSIAN MIND OR ARE ANTI-RACIST BUT HAVE A RACIST MENTALITY. THE MENTALITY AND CULTURE OF THE NON-ALIGNED COUNTRIES MUST BECOME TRULY NON-ALIGNED.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

EMBASSY OFFICER CALLED ON MOSTOFA DABIRI, DEPUTY CHIEF OF THE INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS DEPARTMENT OF THE IRANIAN MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS AUGUST 18 TO DISCUSS ISSUES SET FORTH REFTEL. A NON-PAPER USING TALKING POINTS REFTEL WAS GIVEN DABIRI FOR FUTURE REFERENCE. DABIRI WILL BE ATTENDING UNGA AS PART OF IRANIAN DELEGATION SOME TIME AFTER OCTOBER 1. DABIRI STATED THAT MFA IS STILL WORKING OUT ITS OWN POSITIONS ON SOME OF THESE QUESTIONS.

(THIS POINT WAS ALSO MADE BY FOREIGN MINISTER YAZDI TO CHARGE AUGUST 18 WHEN TOLD THAT WE WOULD BE GIVING YAZDI'S INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS DIVISION THESE POSITION PAPERS,) IN GENERAL ON THESE ISSUES, DABIRI INDICATED THAT IRAN PLANNED TO FOLLOW THE LEAD OF THE GROUP OF 77 OR THE OPEC COUNTRIES. EMBOFF CAME AWAY WITH FEELING THAT IRAN WILL STRIVE AT THIS UNGA TO SOLIDIFY ITS IMAGE AS A MEMBER OF THE NON-ALIGNED AND DEVELOPING WORLD. THE FOLLOWING ARE COMMENTS MADE BY DABIRI ON IRAN'S POSITION ON EACH OF THE SPECIFIC POINTS RAISED GLOBAL NEGOTIATIONS: IRAN WILL FOLLOW THE LEAD OF THE GROUP OF 77.
1980 SPECIAL SESSION: DABIRI SAW NO PROBLEM WITH HOLDING THE SESSION IN NEW YORK THE FIRST TWO WEEKS OF SEPTEMBER 1980. HE STATED THAT SUCH SESSIONS WERE TRADITIONALLY HELD IN NEW YORK.
INTERNATIONAL DEVELOPMENT STRATEGY: IRAN WILL FOLLOW THE POLICIES SET BY OPEC.
ENERGY: IRAN WILL FOLLOW OPEC POLICY.
COMMON FUNDS: IRAN WILL FOLLOW THE LEAD OF THE G-77.

TREATY OF ILLICIT PAYMENTS: DABIRI SAID THAT IRAN HAS BEEN VERY ACTIVE ON THIS QUESTION AND IS VERY INTERESTED IN IT. HE HOPES THAT ALL THE DELEGATIONS WILL WORK CLOSELY TOGETHER TO FIND A COMPROMISE SOLUTION. FROM HIS COMMENTS IT APPEARS THAT IRAN WOULD SUPPORT THE G-77 ON THIS ISSUE WITH SOME FLEXIBILITY.
CAMBODIA: IRAN IS STILL STUDYING THE CAMBODIA SITUATION WHICH WAS THE SUBJECT OF INTENSE DEBATE AT THE HAVANA NAM.

MIDDLE EAST: EMBASSY OFFICER STRESSED OUR HOPE TO AVOID PROPAGANDISTIC ATTACKS AND RESOLUTONS AGAINST ISRAEL AND EGYPT AND OUR HOPE OF ADVANCING AND BROADENING THE PEACE PROCESS AND FINDING A SOLUTION TO THE MIDDLE EAST DISPUTE. DABIRI HEARD EMBOFF OUT POLITELY.
ZIONISM/RACISM: DABIRI NOTED THAT "EVEN UNDER THE OLD REGIME" IRAN SUPPORTED THE ZIONISM/RACISM ISSUE AND IT WOULD AGAIN IF A RESOLUTION WERE PUT FORTH.

RHODESIA/ZIMBABWE: IRAN FULLY SUPPORTS THE PATRIOTIC FRONT, IS FOLLOWING THE LONDON CONFERENCE WITH INTERSEST AND HOPES IT WILL BE SUCCESSFUL. IRAN, HOWEVER, DABIRI INTIMATED, WILL DO WHAT EVER THE PATRIOTIC FRONT ASKS.
NAMIBIA: IRAN HAS IN THE PAST AND WILL ESPECIALLY NOW SUPPORT ANY RESOLUTIONS WHICH CALL FOR NATIONAL LIBERATION AND AN END TO SOUTH AFRICAN "OCCUPATION" OF NAMIBIA.
PUERTO RICO: DABIRI SAID THAT THE GROUP OF 24 HAD VOTED ON THE PUERTO RICO ISSUE RECENTLY. HE COULD NOT REMEMBER IRAN'S EXACT POSITION BUT IT WOULD BE THE SAME AS THE VOTE IT TOOK IN THAT MEETING.

CYPRUS: IN THE PAST IRAN SUPPORTED TURKEY ON THE CYPRUS QUESTION. NOW, HOWEVER, ITS POSITION HAS SHIFTED TO THE NON-ALIGNED VIEW WHICH HAS USUALLY ENDORSED THE SECRETARY GENERALS'S EFFORTS ON CYPRUS. IRAN WILL FOLLOW THE NON-ALIGNED COUNTRIES LEAD ON THIS ISSUE THIS YEAR.
ARMS CONTROL: AS A MEMBER OF THE GENEVA COMMITTEE ON DISARMAMENT, IRAN PLANS TO FOLLOW THE POLICIES SET BY THE NON-ALIGNED GROUP WITHIN THE DISARMAMENT COMMITTEE.

HUMAN RIGHTS: IRAN SUPPORTS HUMAN RIGHTS. WHILE ------------------030615 191225Z /40 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 3848 INFO USMISSION USUN NEW YORK SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 10223 IRAN IN THE PAST GAVE LIP SERVICE SUPPORT TO THE UN HUMAN RIGHTS ORGANIZATION, THIS YEAR IT WILL GIVE TRUE SUPPORT TO EFFORTS TO GET CONCRETE PROTECTION FOR HUMAN RIGHTS. ASKED IF THE LETTER PUBLISHED FROM ONE OF THE HUMAN RIGHTS SUBCOMMITTEES CALLING FOR A HALT TO EXECUTIONS IN IRAN WOULD EFFECT IRAN'S SUPPORT FOR THE HUMAN RIGHTS ORGANIZATIONS, DABIRI SAID NO. HE DID SEEM A BIT NERVIOUS ABOUT THE QUESTION.

UN REFORM: DABIRI SAID THAT THE SECRETARY GENERAL WAS USUALLY EXCELLENT IN CONSULTING WITH UNDERDEVELOPED COUNTRIES ON HIS IDEAS FOR REFORM. IRAN WOULD PROBABLY FOLLOW THE SECRETARY GENERAL'S RECOMMENDATIONS.
UN BUDGET, MANAGEMENT AND SALARIES: SAME AS 18. DABIRI SAID HE WOULD GIVE OUR TALKING POINTS DIRECTLY TO THE OFFICIAL WHO WILL BE WORKING ON THESE QUESTIONS
(S - ENTIRE TEXT).

DURING MEETING WITH IRANIAN FOREIGN MINISTER YAZDI SEPTEMBER 18, CHARGE RAISED SUBJECT OF AFGHANISTAN AND TOLD YAZDI THAT WE WOULD BE INTERESTED IN A CONTINUING DISCUSSION AND EXCHANGE OF IDEAS ON THIS QUESTION. CHARGE POINTED TO SOVIET ROLE IN AFGHANISTAN AND SAID THAT WE WOULD REGARD ANY INTRODUCTION OF SOVIET COMBAT FORCES INTO AFGHANISTAN AS VERY DISTURBING FOR US AND FOR THE REGION AS A WHOLE.
FONMIN YAZDI ASKED IF THERE WAS ANY INFORMATION THAT CUBANS WERE WORKING IN AFGHANISTAN. CHARGE REPLIED THAT HE HAD SEEN NO REPORTS ON CUBAN INVOLVEMENT BUT THAT WE WOULD CHECK WITH WASHINGTON.

YAZDI SAID THAT TARAKI HAD COMPLAINED TO HIM AT NAM ABOUT AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI'S STATEMENT AGAINST AFGHANISTAN. YAZDI SAID HE REPLIED THAT TARAKI SHOULD NOT WORRY ABOUT THE AYATOLLAH'S STATEMENT AS LONG AS HE HAD THE SUPPORT OF AFGHANI PEOPLE. YAZDI SAID HE ESTIMATED THERE WERE ABOUT 4,000 SOVIET MILITARY ADVISORS IN AFGHANISTAN. HE GOT THIS FIGURE FROM PRESS STORIES.
YAZDI STATED THAT THE PGOI WAS WORRIED ABOUT THE "FEW THOUSAND" AFGHANI REFUGEES NOW IN IRAN. YAZDI ESTIMATED THEM AT MORE THAN 4,000.
COMMENT: EMBASSY PLANS TO START INFORMATION EXCHANGE WITH DEPARTMENT OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS FIFTH POLITICAL DIVISION IN THE NEXT FEW DAYS.

ACTION REQUESTED: DOES DEPARTMENT HAVE ANY INDICATION OF CUBAN INVOLVEMENT IN AFGHANISTAN AND IF SO COULD WE PASS THIS INFORMATION ON TO YAZDI. YAZDI ASKED SPECIFICALLY ABOUT THE POSSIBILITY OF CUBAN MEDICAL
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: AYATOLLAH MONTAZERI HAS BEEN NAMED IMAM JOMEH OF TEHRAN, BUT PUBLICITY GIVEN TO HIS SON'S ERRATIC ANTICS HAS ALREADY CAST A SHADOW ON THE AYATOLLAH'S NAME. BESIDES MONTAZERI JR.'S DRAMATICS AT TEHRAN'S AIRPORT, A NUMBER OF OTHER INCIDENTS ILLUSTRATE THE BASIC PROBLEMS WITH PUBLIC SAFETY AND SECURITY BEING FACED BY THE PGOI. THE GOVERNMENT IS ATTEMPTING TO FACE SUCH PROBLEMS, BUT DECISION MAKING BODIES SEEM TO DIFFER IN NATURE THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY. RECENT ANNOUNCEMENTS OF MORE ADMINISTRATIVE AND ORGANIZATIONAL PURGES MAY WELL ONLY REINFORCE SUCH PROBLEMS RATHER THAN ALLEVIATE THEM. END SUMMARY.

EVENTS IN IRAN DURING THE FIRST WEEKS OF SEPTEMBER WERE DOMINATED BY THE KURDISH TROUBLES AND THE DEATH OF AYATOLLAH MAHMOUD TALEGHANI (SEPTELS). THE THREE-DAY NATIONAL MOURNING PERIOD FOR TALEGHANI WAS OBSERVED BY MILLIONS OF PARTICIPANTS THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY, AND EVERY LEADING GOVERNMENT AND RELIGIOUS FIGURE WAS INVOLVED IN THE MEMORIAL PRAYER SERVICES. WHILE TALEGHANI'S ROLE AS A POPULAR AND DEEPLY RESPECTED REVOLUTIONARY FIGURE WILL PROBABLY NOT BE FILLED FOR A CONSIDERABLE LENGTH OF TIME (IF EVER), HIS POSITION AS "IMAM JOMEH" (FRIDAY PRAYER LEADER) OF TEHRAN WAS IMMEDIATELY ASSIGNED TO AYATOLLAH HOSSEIN ALI MONTAZERI.

THE LATTER HAS CONSIDERABLY LESS POPULAR APPEAL, AND THE PROBABILITY OF HIS ATTRACTING THE MASSIVE CROWDS WHO JOINED TALEGHANI IN PUBLIC AND TELEVISED PRAYER SESSIONS IS SLIGHT. (SEPTEL). 4.AYTOLLAH MONTAZERI'S CONTROVERSIAL SON, MOHAMMED, HAS CERTAINLY DONE LITTLE TO ENHANCE HIS FATHER'S PRESTIGE. HIS NOTERIETY HAS NOW LED HIS FATHER TO SAY PUBLICALLY HE IS MENTALLY ILL. POPULARLY (AND DEROGATORILY)KNOWN AS "RINGO", SHEIKH MOHAMMED MONTAZERI HAS CAPTURED A GREAT DEAL OF PUBLICITY FOR HIS INVOLVEMENT WITH SECURITY INCIDENTS AT TEHRAN'S MEHRABAD AIRPORT.

PRIOR TO HIS DEPARTURE FOR LIBYA BY SYRIAN AIRLINES ON SEPT 2, "RINGO" TOOK THE OPPORTUNITY TO CRITICIZE IRAN AIR, (WHICH WOULD NOT PROVIDE TICKETS TO HIM AND HIS 90 TRAVELING COMPANIONS), INTERIOR MINISTER SABBAGHIAN (WHOM RINGO ACCUSED OF HINDERING HIS TRAVEL) AND ZIONIST POWER IN GENERAL (WHICH HE CLAIMED HAD TRIED TO BAN HIS DEPARTURE FROM IRAN). YOUNG MONTAZERI'S RETURN TO TEHRAN ON SEPT 15 WAS MARKED BY NOW CUSTOMARY DRAMATICS. A NUMBER OF REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS AND POLICE ARRESTED MONTAZERI AS HE LEFT HIS PLANE, BUT SHORTLY THEREAFTER 15 ARMED MEN ATTACKED THE AIRPORT SECURITY OFFICE AND AFTER DISARMING THE GUARDS ESCAPED WITH "RINGO".

THE IRANIAN REACTION TO MONTAZERI'S ANTICS, TO HIS CASUAL ACCUSATIONS OF "COMMUNIST" AND "ZIONIST" AIMED AT PGOI FIGURES, AND TO HIS WELL PUBLICIZED ASSOCIATION WITH KHADAFFI AND YASSER ARAFAT, HAS BEEN ONE OF DISGUSTED FASCINATION. ON SEPTEMBER 17, THE PROSECUTOR GENERAL'S OFFICE MADE A STATEMENT DEMANDING THAT "RINGO" MONTAZERI TURN HIMSELF OVER TO THE AUTHORITIES, BUT IT SEEMS UNLIKELY HE WILL DO SO. RINGO'S NOSE-THUMBING AT THE PGOI AT THE VERY TIME THAT HIS FATHER IS PRESIDENT OF THE ASSEMBLY OF EXPERTS AND IMAM JOMEH OF TEHRAN IS A BLATANT EXAMPLE OF THE PGOI'S INABILITY TO CONTROL LAWLESSNESS WITHIN ITS OWN DOMAIN.

BESIDES THE WELL-PUBLICIZED ANTICS OF MONTAZERI, OTHER SECURITY INCIDENTS HAVE OCCURRED IN VARIOUS PARTS OF IRAN. ON SEPTEMBER 1 TERRORISTS DAMAGED A RAILROAD BRIDGE 50 MILES NORTHEAST OF KHORRAMSHAHR IN WHAT THE PRESS CLAIMED WAS THE FOURTH SUCH RAILROAD SABOTAGE IN KHUZESTAN PROVINCE SINCE JUNE.

DURING THE FIRST WEEK ------------------039316 201353Z /51 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 3875 INFO SECDEF WASH DC JCS WASH DC AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 10280 OF SEPTEMBER, A GRENADE WAS THROWN INTO A GAS CYLINDER WAREHOUSE IN KHORRAMSHAHR. ONE PRESS ACCOUNT OF THE INCIDENT CLAIMED THE GRENADE FAILED TO EXPLODE. A SECOND ACCOUNT QUOTED THE CITY'S REVOLUTIONARY GUARD COMMANDER AS SAYING THAT THE GRENADE HAD EXPLODED AND CAUSED THE DESTRUCTION OF A LIQUID GAS RESEVOIR.

USE OF GRENADES SEEMS TO BE BECOMING MORE POPULAR. ON SEPTEMBER 4 A HAND-GRENADE EXPLODED NEAR MELLAT PARK IN NORTH TEHRAN, BUT NO INJURIES WERE REPORTED. COMMITTEE GUARDSMEN WHO SEARCHED THE AREA FOUND A SECOND, UNEXPLODED GRENADE NEAR THE PARK. THE CITY OF TEHRAN HAS BEEN RELATIVELY QUIET AT NIGHT RECENTLY, ALTHOUGH THE SOUND OF SHOOTING HAS OCCASIONALLY BEEN HEARD. REVOLUTIONARY GUARDSMEN CONTINUE TO DO SPOT CHECKS OF VEHICLES DURING LATE NIGHT HOURS, AND ARE NOT LOATH TO FIRE WARNING SHOTS IF CARS FAIL TO STOP. HOUSE SEARCHES BY REVOLUTIONARY GUARDSMEN CONTINUE, AS DO ARRESTS.

DESPITE REPEATED ANNOUNCEMENTS BY THE AUTHORITIES THAT REVOLUTIONARY GUARDSMEN MUST HAVE WARRANTS, THERE ARE REPORTS THAT THE INSTRUCTIONS ARE NOT ALWAYS OBEYED (UNDOUBTEDLY PROMPTING THE REPEATED ANNOUNCEMENTS). A CLOSE RELATIVE OF EX-MINISTER OF ENERGY TAVAKOLI TOLD POLOFF THE LATTER WAS ARRESTED AND TAKEN TO PRISON TWO WEEKS AGO BY GUARDSMEN WHO HAD NO WARRANT TO SHOW.

ATTEMPTS TO COLLECT WEAPONS CONTINUE, AND THE SOURCES OF THE ANNOUNCEMENTS SEEM TO VARY FROM CITY TO CITY. AYATOLLAH KHALKHALI ISSUED A COMMUNIQUE EARLY IN SEPTEMBER SAYING THAT RESIDENTS OF KORDESTAN SHOULD TURN THEIR WEAPONS IN TO THE NEAREST MILITARY BASE. IN ISFAHAN THE CITY GOVERNOR HAS ORDERED REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE GUARDS TO SURRENDER THEIR WEAPONS. IN LANGEROUD, THE REVOLUTIONARY GUARD CORPS MADE A SIMILAR ANNOUNCEMENT, AND IN MALAYER IT WAS THE REVOLUTIONARY COURT WHICH ASKED FOR ILLEGAL ARMS TO BE SURRENDERED. IN KASHAN, THE CLERICS SOCIETY DEMANDED THAT WEAPONS BE SURRENDERED TO THE REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS CORPS.

THE FLURRY OF ANNOUNCEMENTS TO SURRENDER WEAPONS BY SUCH A VARIETY OF AUTHORITIES IS AN INDICATION OF THE CONTINUING SERIOUSNESS OF THE WEAPONS PROBLEM, AND ILLUSTRATES CLEARLY AS WELL THAT THE SEATS OF POWER IN VARIOUS IRANIAN CITIES ARE STILL NOT UNIFORM.

IN A RECENT CIRCULAR ISSUED BY THE PRIME MINISTER TO ALL MINISTRIES, GOVERNMENT AND SEMI-GOVERNMENT ORGANIZATIONS, IT WAS ANNOUNCED THAT ALL GOVERNMENT SERVANTS INVOLVED IN ANTI-REVOLUTIONARY CRITICISM FACED POSSIBLE DISMISSAL FROM THEIR JOBS. WHILE THE WARNING WAS AIMED AT BRINGING ABOUT GREATER COORDINATION AT THE GOVERNMENT LEVEL AND OSTENSIBLY PREVENTING GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES FROM TAKING PART IN ANTI-REVOLUTIONARY DISCUSSIONS, THE CURE MIGHT VERY WELL BE WORSE THAN THE DISEASE. ONE EXAMPLE IS THE CLOSING OF THE TABRIZ MUNICIPALITY OFFICES FOR A SO-CALLED PURGE OF ANTI-REVOLUTIONARIES.

THE SHUTDOWN OF THE BUILDING OCCURRED MORE THAN A MONTH AGO, AND HAS CONTRIBUTED TO AN INCREASE OF FRUSTRATION AMONG PEOPLE IN THE CITY WHO REQUIRE MUNICIPAL SERVICES. UNTIL THE OFFICE REOPENS, SUCH MUNDANE BUT IMPORTANT THINGS AS CONSTRUCTION PERMITS, LAND PURCHASES AND SALES PERMITS ETC., HAVE COME TO A HALT. LAINGEN

1979TEHRAN10281.subject: KHOMEINI MODERATES HIS ATTACKS ON INTELLECTUALS

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI'S SPEECHES FOLLOWING THE DEATH OF TALEGHANI CONTAINED A CHANGE IN EMPHASIS. HE SOFTENED HIS ATTACKS ON THE IRANIAN INTELLECTUALS WHOM HE PREVIOUSLY ANATHEMATIZED AS GHARBZADEH (INFATUATED WITH THE WEST). INSTEAD HIS SPEECHES CONTAINED CALLS FOR UNITY-UNITY WITHIN THE CLERGY, UNITY WITHIN THE UNIVERSITIES, AND UNITY BETWEEN CLERGY AND INTELLECTUALS. ALTHOUGH WE CANNOT BE CERTAIN OF KHOMEINI'S MOTIVES, HE HAS BEEN TRYING TO ENSURE THAT A LARGE PART OF FORMER TALEGHANI SUPPORTERS, INCLUDING THE MODERATE CLERGY AND THE SECULAR INTELLECTUALS, ARE NOT IRREPARABLY ALIENATED FROM THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION.
IT REMAINS TO BE SEEN IF THE SHIFT IN KHOMEINI'S PUBLIC STATEMENTS HAS ANY PRACTICAL EFFECTS ON THE REVOLUTIONARY AUTHORITIES OR ON THE WORK OF THE COUNCIL OF EXPERTS.

IN REFTEL A EMBASSY DISCUSSED SOME OF THE IMPLICATIONS OF TALEGHANI'S DEATH FOR THE IRANIAN POLITICAL LEADERSHIP. ONE PROBLEM CREATED BY HIS DEATH IS THAT ONE OF TALEGHANI'S MAJOR CONSTITUENCIES, THE UNIVERSITY-BASED INTELLECTUALS, HAS BEEN LEFT WITHOUT AN OBVIOUS LEADER AND PROTECTOR. TALEGHANI'S DEPARTURE HAS LEFT THIS GROUP WITHOUT A LEADER OF SUFFICIENT STATURE WHO CAN WORK TO PRESERVE UNITY BETWEEN MORE EXTREME CLERICAL SUPPORTERS OF THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION AND THE MODERATE AND SECULAR ELEMENTS WHO HAVE FELT THEMSELVES UNDER INCREASING PRESSURE FROM THE ADVOCATES OF A PURELY ISLAMIC STATE.

ALTHOUGH IT IS STILL TOO SOON TO MAKE A DEFINITE JUDGEMENT, IT APPEARS THAT AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI IS MAKING AN EFFORT TO ATTRACT THE MORE MODERATE CONSTITUENCY OF TALEGHANI AND TO ENSURE THEIR CONTINUING LOYALTY TO THE REVOLUTION.

AS EMBASSY NOTED REFTEL A, THE LOYALTY OF TALEGHANI'S FOLLOWING WAS INTENSELY PERSONAL AND BASED ON AN INSTINCTIVE TRUST AND RESPECT. IT WAS ALSO BASED ON A UNIQUE SET OF HUMAN FACTORS WHICH ARE NOT DUPLICATED IN ANY OTHER LEADER NOW ON THE IRANIAN POLITICAL SCENE. AYATOLLAH HOSSEIN ALI MONTAZERI, APPOINTED IMAM JOM'EH OF TEHRAN IN PLACE OF TELEGHANI, HAS NOT ATTRACTED THE SAME LOYALTY. MONTAZERI'S PERFORMANCE AT HIS FIRST FRIDAY PRAYERS ON SEPTEMBER 15 AT BEHESHT-E-ZAHRA WAS UNIMPRESSIVE. HE IS UNDISTINGUISHED IN APPEARANCE, AND AN INNFFECTIVE SPEAKER.

ALTHOUGH MANY ATTENDED FRIDAY PRAYERS OUT OF RESPECT FOR THE MEMORY OF TALEGHANI, MONTAZERI MAY FIND IT DIFFICULT TO ATTRACT TALEGHANI'S MASSIVE CONGREGATION AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY WHEN FRIDAY PRAYERS RESUME THERE ON SEPTEMBER 21.

SIGNS HAVE ALREADY APPEARED ON THE GATES OF TEHRAN UNIVERSITY PROCLAIMING IT TO BE "TALEGHANI UNIVERSITY", AND MONTAZERI MAY NOT BE ABLE TO MATCH THE PERFORMANCE OF HIS PREDECESSOR. IN THE ABSENCE OF ANY OBVIOUS REPLACEMENT FOR TALEGHANI AS LEADER OF THE EDUCATED, IT APPEARS THAT KHOMEINI HIMSELF IS MAKING CONCILIATORY MOVES TOWARD THIS GROUP.

THE EDUCATED HAD PREVIOUSLY BEEN A TARGET FOR KHOMEINI'S SCORN AND RIDICULE. JUST A FEW DAYS BEFORE TALEGHANI'S DEATH, KHOMEINI TOLD A GATHERING AT FEIZIEH SCHOOL IN QOM THAT THOSE EASTERNERS WHO HAD MADE THE WEST THEIR KA'ABA WERE THE FOLLOWERS OF TAGHUT (THE DEVIL) SPOKEN OF IN THE QORAN.

KHOMEINI SAID THAT BLIND IMITATION OF THE WEST HAS BROUGHT THE FREEDOM FOR OUR YOUNG PEOPLE TO WATCH P0RNOGRAPHY ON TELEVISION, TO ------------------062020 230549Z /12 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 3877 INFO SECDEF WASH DC JCS WASH DC AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE SECTION 02 OF 03 TEHRAN 10281 MOKE OPIUM, AND TO WASTE THEIR LIVES IN BROTHELS AND BARS. AFTER BELITTLING THE IMPORTANCE OF THE COUNTRY'S ECONOMIC INFRASTRUCTURE, KHOMEINI WITH GREAT EMOTION TOLD HIS LISTENERS, "ISLAM IS SERIOUS. ISLAM IS NOT FRIVOLOUS.

ISLAM DOES NOT MEAN YOUNG BOYS AND GIRLS TAKING OFF THEIR CLOTHES AND GETTING INTO THE WATER TOGETHER." KHOMEINI SAID THAT ISLAM ALLOWS ONLY TWO SPORTS, SHOOTING AND HORSE RACING, BOTH OF WHICH HAD OVERTONES OF MILITARY TRAINING. THE LATTER, HE SAID, IS SO IMPORTANT THAT ISLAM EVEN ALLOWS BETTING ON THE RESULTS.

KHOMEINI ALSO CONDEMNED THE USE OF WESTERN NAMES FOR SHOPS, ROADS, AND PARKS AND ASKED FOR THE BOYCOTT OF PRODUCTS AND SHOPS WHICH BEAR WESTERN NAMES SIMPLY FOR THE SAKE OF PUBLICITY AND SALES. ONLY IN THIS WAY, HE SAID, WOULD IRAN BE ABLE TO OVERCOME ITS FASCINATION FOR THE WEST AND TO BECOME SOMETHING OTHER THAN A PASSIVE ABSORBER OF EVERYTHING THE WEST DISHES OUT.

KHOMEINI, IN THIS AND OTHER SPEECHES, HAD ESPECIALLY HARSH WORDS FOR IRANIAN INTELLECTUALS. IN AN EARLIER SPEECH HE HAD SAID, "WE DO NOT WANT INTELLECTUALS" AND THEN RETRACTED SLIGHTLY BY SAYING THAT SOME FEW MIGHT BE WORTHWHILE. IN HIS SEPT 8 SPEECH IN QOM HE ACCUSED THE INTELLECTUALS OF BEING INFECTED WITH THE SAME INFATUATION WITH THE WEST (GHARBZADEGI) WHICH HAS CORRUPTED THE ENTIRE IRANIAN SOCIETY EXCEPT FOR THE MOSQUES AND THE CLERGY.

(FYI: IRONICALLY THE VERY TERM GHARBZADEGI WAS COINED BY THE LATE JALAL AL AHMAD, ONE OF THE INTELLECTUALS WHO KHOMEINI HARSHLY ATTACKS.) THE DUTY OF THE INTELLECTUALS, SAID KHOMEINI, WAS NOT TO ADVOCATE THE FALSE FREEDOM OF THE WEST, BUT TO EXPOSE ITS EVILS AND ITS ESSENTIAL WORTHLESSNESS.

IN ONE OF HIS FIRST PUBLIC ADDRESSES FOLLOWING TALEGHANI'S DEATH, KHOMEINI APPEARED TO CONSIDERABLY MODERATE HIS ANTI-INTELLECTUAL STANCE. ALTHOUGH STILL ATTACKING THOSE WHO WOULD CALL THE CLERGY REACTIONARY, KHOMEINI SAID THAT THE GREATEST NEED OF THE COUNTRY WAS NOW FOR UNITY, ESPECIALLY UNITY BETWEEN THE CLERGY AND THE INTELLECTUALS.

SPEAKING IN QOM ON SEPTEMBER 13, KHOMEINI URGED THE INTELLECTUALS TO BECOME PART OF THE SEA OF RELIGIOUS POWER SO THAT THE COMBINED STRENGTH OF THESE GROUPS COULD BETTER SERVE THE COUNTRY. "YOU ARE ALL OF THE SAME NATION, LIVE IN ONE COUNTRY AND ONE HOME. SO JOIN FORCES AND PROTECT YOUR HOUSE." ALTHOUGH STILL CRITICIZING THE INTELLECTUALS'INFATUATION WITH THE WEST, HE SPARED THEM THE HARSH, BLANKET CONDEMNATIONS HE HAD MADE ONLY FIVE DAYS BEFORE.

KHOMEINI ALSO APPEALED TO THE RELIGIOUS LEADERS NOT TO ABUSE THE POWER IN THEIR HANDS AND WARNED THEM AGAINST OPPOSING THE UNIVERSITY-EDUCATED YOUNG PEOPLE, WHO CONSTITUTE THE FUTURE LEADERSHIP OF THE NATION. THE OVER-RIDING CONCERN BOTH FOR THE UNIVERSITY AND FOR THE CLERGY, HE SAID SHOULD BE UNITY. HE ENTREATED BOTH THE CLERGY AND THE UNIVERSITIES NOT TO SPLIT INTO FEUDING FACTIONS AND TO PROTECT THEIR OWN INTERNAL UNITY OF PURPOSE.

THE IMAM TOOK A SIMILAR CONCILIATORY LINE IN A MEETING WITH THE CENTRAL COMMITTEE OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLICAN PARTY IN QOM ON SEPTEMBER 14. KHOMEINI TOLD THE COMMITTEE THAT HE OPPOSED THE IMMEDIATE REMOVAL OF ALL GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS WHO MIGHT OPPOSE ISLAM AND THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTION. SUCH A STEP WOULD SERIOUSLY WEAKEN THE GOVERNMENT. ADVOCATING PATIENCE, KHOMEINI SAID THAT SUCH DRASTIC MEASURES WERE ILL-ADVISED AND THAT SUCH REFORM SHOULD FOLLOW APPROVAL OF THE NEW CONSTITUTION AND FORMATION OF THE NEW LEGISLATIVE ASSEMBLY.

COMMENT: ALTHOUGH KHOMEINI HAS NOT RETREATED FROM ANY OF HIS FUNDAMENTAL IDEAS ON THE HARMFUL EFFECT OF FOREIGN INFLUENCES ON IRANIAN SOCIETY, HE APPEARS TO BE CONCERNED THAT HE NOT ALIENATE THE LATE AYATOLLAH ------------------062037 230549Z /12 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 3878 INFO SECDEF WASH DC JCS WASH DC AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE SECTION 03 OF 03 TEHRAN 10281 TALEGHANI'S SUPPORTERS AMONG MODERATES IN THE CLERGY AND THE UNIVERSITIES.

THE ABSENCE OF TALEGHANI HAS APPARENTLY FORCED THE IMAM TO TONE DOWN SOME OF HIS MORE EXTREME ATTACKS AGAINST THE SECULAR AND WESTERN-ORIENTED SECTIONS OF THE SOCIETY, WHOM HE HAD REGULARLY ANATHEMATIZED IN HIS EARLIER SPEECHES.

IN MODIFYING HIS PUBLIC STATEMENTS, THE IMAM MAY HAVE BEEN INFLUENCED BY THE IMMINENT OPENING OF THE SCHOOLS AND UNIVERSITIES, WHERE THERE ARE RUMORS OF SERIOUS DIVISIONS BETWEEN THE RELIGIOUS AND THE SECULAR STUDENT GROUPS. KHOMEINI MAY REALIZE THAT HE IS THE ONLY POSSIBLE REPLACEMENT FOR TALEGHANI AS A MEDIATOR BETWEEN DISPUTING FACTIONS. THERE IS NO ONE ELSE WITH ENOUGH STATURE AND PRESTIGE.

ALTHOUGH IT IS STILL TOO EARLY TO BE CERTAIN, IT APPEARS THAT KHOMEINI IS ATTEMPTING TO EXTEND THE HAND OF FRIENDSHIP TO A WIDER SECTOR OF IRANIAN SOCIETY WITHOUT CHANGING HIS UNDERLYING MESSAGE THAT IRAN'S SALVATION LIES NEITHER IN EAST NOR WEST, BUT IN THE STRAIGHT PATH (SIRAT AL-MUSTAQIM) OF ISLAM.

IT IS STILL UNCLEAR WHAT KHOMEINI'S MORE MODERATE LINE IN HIS RECENT SPEECHES WILL MEAN IN PRACTICAL TERMS OR WHETHER HE IS OFFERING THE MODERATES ANYTHING MORE THAN WORDS. ONE AREA TO WATCH WILL BE THE COUNCIL OF EXPERTS, WHICH HAS BEEN CONVERTING THE ORIGINAL DRAFT CONSTITUTION INTO THE FUNDAMENTAL LAW OF A THEOCRATIC STATE (REF B). IT REMAINS TO BE SEEN WHETHER THE DRIVE FOR THEOCRACY IN THE COUNCIL, LED BY AYATOLLAHS BEHESHTI AND MONTAZERI, IS AT ALL BLUNTED BY THE SHIFT IN TONE OF KHOMEINI'S PUBLIC STATEMENTS.
IF IT IS NOT, THEN KHOMEINI'S EFFORTS AT RECONCILIATION WILL BE DIFFICULT, ESPECIALLY AS MODERATES MAY SEE THEMSELVES BEING SYSTEMATICALLY EXCLUDED FROM ANY SHARE IN THE IRANIAN POLITICAL PROCESS.

WE NOTE THAT A KHOMEINI SPEECH AUGUST 19 TO AIR FORCE OFFICERS IN QOM MADE AFTER THIS CABLE WAS WRITTEN AGAIN CONTAINS AN ATTACK ON WESTERNIZED INTELLECTUALS. IT IS DIFFICULT TO SAY WHETHER THESE COMMENTS WILL MARK THE BEGINNING OF A NEW SPATE OF ANTIWESTERN SPEECHES, OR WHETHER THEY ARE AN EXCEPTION TO THE TREND WE HAVE BEEN OBSERVING SINCE TALEGHANI'S

BAYANDOR WILL BE IN US APPROXIMATELY ONE MONTH. EMBASSY HAS SUGGESTED HE MEET WITH PRECHT IN WASHINGTON IF HE COMES DOWN.
DEPARTMENT SHOULD CHECK WITH IRANIAN MISSION TO UNGA FOR ARRIVAL TIME OF DELEGATION IN NEW YORK AND FULL LIST OF DELEGATION.

RECOGNITION OF US INTERESTS IN IRAN AND A WILLINGNESS TO WORK WITH THE PGOI. THE USG WISHED TO GET ON WITH THE RELATIONSHIP BUT IT HAD TO BE A MUTUAL EFFORT IF IT WAS TO PROGRESS. THE CHARGE THEN ASKED YAZDI IF HE WISHED TO COMMENT ON ANY OF THESE POINTS.

YAZDI COMMENTED THAT THE PRESS HAD CERTAINLY NOT PICKED UP ANY FAVORABLE COMMENTS ON IRAN THAT CHARGE MAY HAVE MADE WHILE HE WAS IN THE US. YAZDI THEN LAUNCHED INTO A DISCUSSION OF HOW THE FOREIGN PRESS DISTORTS NEWS IN IRAN AND TREATS THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION VERY UNFAIRLY. YAZDI SAID THAT THE PGOI HAD BEEN WATCHING CLOSELY AND THE US PRESS NEVER CARRIES GOOD NEWS ABOUT IRAN. THE CHARGE REPLIED THAT IRAN WAS UNLIKELY TO GET GOOD PRESS COVERAGE IF IT KEPT ON KICKING OUT THE PRESS. HE POINTED OUT AGAIN THAT "IRAN CAN NOT SHED ALL RESPONSIBILITY" FOR ITS BAD PRESS.

IRAN BEARS RESPONSIBILITY FOR MANY OF THE THINGS THAT HAVE BEEN REPORTED SUCH AS THE LARGE NUMBER OF SUMMARY EXECUTIONS. EVEN SOME SUPPORTERS OF THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION IN THE US WERE QUESTIONING IF THESE ACTIONS BY THE PGOI WERE CONSISTENT WITH THE SPIRIT OF THE REVOLUTION. CHARGE POINTED TO SECURITY PROBLEMS ON THE EMBASSY COMPOUND, TO ILL TREATMENT OF BUSINESSMEN, AND ACTIONS THAT APPEARED DESIGNED TO REMOVE ALL US JOURNALISTS FROM IRAN. THIS SIMPLY MADE THE PUBLIC THINK IRAN HAD SOMETHING TO HIDE. YAZDI DENIED THIS HOTLY AND STATED THAT HE WOULD BE FULLY READY TO HANDLE ALL QUESTIONS FROM THE PRESS WHEN HE GOT TO WASHINGTON.

CHARGE POINTED OUT THAT HE THOUGHT SOME OF THE US PRESS HAD DONE A GOOD JOB OF REPORTING. THE TIME PEOPLE ON KHOMEINI HAD BEEN EXCELLENT FOR INSTANCE. (YAZDI CONCURRED). CHARGE OBSERVED THAT STATEMENTS WHICH WERE CONTINUOUSLY BEING CARRIED ON IRAN NATIONAL RADIO AND TELEVISION ACCUSING US, AMONG OTHER THINGS, OF BEING INVOLVED IN PLOTS WITH SAVAK, THE CIA AND ZIONISTS TO DESTROY THE REVOLUTION WERE BOTH INACCURATE AND UNHELPFUL TO OUR RELATIONSHIP. HE POINTED OUT TO YAZDI THAT PGOI COULD CONTROL THIS TYPE OF ANTI-US PROPAGANDA ON THE NIRT AND SHOULD. YAZDI MADE NO REPLY.

INSTEAD YAZDI ASKED IF USG WAS INVOLVED IN ANY WAY IN CIRCULATION IN TEHRAN OF ZEROXED SHEET CALLED THE "BERNARD LEWIS PLAN" SHOWING A PLOT TO DIVIDE UP THE COUNTRY INTO SMALL AREAS BASED ON ETHNIC GROUPS. YAZDI SEEMED TO TAKE THE SHEET SEMI-SERIOUSLY. CHARGE TOLD HIM THAT IT WAS NOT WORTH THE MINISTER'S TIME AS IT WAS NONSENSE NOT HELPFUL TO EITHER US OR IRAN, BUT PROMISED TO CHECK WITH WASHINGTON.
MEETING ENDED WITH CHARGE AGAIN REQUESTING ANY HELP YAZDI COULD OFFER ON SHERRY AND SHEBANI CASE AND GULF DISTRICT. HE ALSO QUERIED YAZDI ABOUT BAHA'I INCIDENT (SEPTEL).
ACTION REQUESTED: WOULD APPRECIATE ANY INFORMATION DEPARTMENT MAY HAVE ON "BERNARD LEWIS". LAINGEN

1979TEHRAN10288.subject: WORK OF COUNCIL OF EXPERTS PROCEEDS SLOWLY

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: THE COUNCIL OF EXPERTS FOR THE EXAMINATION OF THE IRANIAN CONSTITUTION, WHICH WAS SUPPOSED TO COMPLETE ITS WORK BY SEPTEMBER 23, HAS SO FAR APPROVED ONLY FIFTEEN ARTICLES OF THE NEW CONSTITUTION. THE ORIGINAL DRAFT SUBMITTED FOR CONSIDERATION CONTAINED 151 ARTICLES, SO THE COUNCIL WILL HAVE EITHER TO SPEED UP ITS PACE OR EXTEND ITS MANDATE. ACCORDING TO PRESS REPORTS ON SEPTEMBER 19, THE COUNCIL'S LIFE HAS BEEN EXTENDED FOR ANOTHER 15 DAYS. HOWEVER THIS NEW PERIOD MAY WELL NOT BE SUFFICIENT TO COMPLETE THE COUNCIL'S WORK. END SUMMARY.

THE WORK OF THE COUNCIL OF EXPERTS HAS BEEN PROCEEDING SMOOTHLY, IF SLOWLY. RADIO AND TELEVISION BROADCASTS OF THE SESSIONS HAVE SHOWN THE DEBATES TO BE LIVELY, ORDERLY, AND VERBOSE. THERE IS NO PROVISION FOR LIMITING THE LENGTH OF SPEECHES OR OF RESTRICTING THE SUBJECT MATTER. AS A RESULT, ALMOST THE ENTIRE FIRST MEETINGS WERE TAKEN UP BY GENERAL SPEECHES BY VARIOUS DELEGATES-SPEECHES WITH LITTLE RELEVANCE TO THE SPECIFIC MATTERS IN THE CONSTITUTION.

THE HIGH LIGHTS OF THE MAIN ARTICLES PASSED SO FAR INCLUDE: - (A) ARTICLE 5, THE GOVERNMENT OF THE THEOLOGIAN (VILAYAT-E-FAQIH). THIS ARTICLE WAS DISCUSSED IN DETAIL SEPTEL. ALTHOUGH THE EXACT MEANING OF THIS ARTICLE IS STILL UNCLEAR, MAJOR IMPLICATION IS TO ENSURE SHIA RELIGIOUS ESTABLISHMENT CONTROL OVER THE OFFICE OF CHIEF OF STATE. PASSAGE OF THIS ARTICLE HAS STIRRED OPEN CRITICISM. RELIGIOUS SCHOLAR EZZATOLAH SAHABI HAS SEVERELY CRITICIZED ARTICLE 5, SAYING THE NEW PROVISION WILL LEAD TO AN AUTHORITY RUNNING PARALLEL WITH THAT OF THE GOVERNMENT OR IN OPPOSITION TO THE GOVERNMENT.

IT IS DANGEROUS FOR ISLAM, HE SAID, BECAUSE IF A GOVERNMENT MADE MISTAKES IT COULD BE REMOVED, BUT IF A RELIGIOUS LEADER MADE A MISTAKE, PEOPLE WOULD LOSE FAITH IN THE CLERGY ITSELF AND THUS IN ISLAM. ASSEMBLY OF EXPERTS DELEGATE AND REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL MEMBER ABOLHASSAN BANISADR HAS ALSO CRITICIZED ARTICLE 5, SAYING THAT IF CLERGYMEN WERE TO BE ENTRUSTED WITH SPECIAL POWERS, THEN THE EXISTENCE OF INDEPENDENT PARTIES WAS MEANINGLESS. HOWEVER, IN REPLY TO THESE CRITICS, AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI TOLD GROUP OF AIR FORCE OFFICERS THAT "OUR GOVERNMENT IS ISLAMIC, AND THAT (THEY) MUST SUPPORT ARTICLE 5 SO THAT THE COUNTRY IS NOT HARMED.

THE NATION HAS CAST ITS VOTE FOR THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC; ALL OF YOU MUST COMPLY, OR YOU WILL BE OBLITERATED." - (B) ARTICLE 12, ESTABLISHING TWELVER JA'FARI SHI'ISM AS THE STATE RELIGION OF IRAN FOR ETERNITY. THIS ARTICLE WAS OPPOSED BY REPRESENTATIVES OF THE SUNNI AREAS, NOTABLY MOWLAVI ABDULAZIZ DELEGATE FOR BALUCHESTAN, WHO SAID THAT THE OFFICIAL RELIGION SHOULD BE ISLAM -NOT ONE SECT. THE ARTICLE ALSO NOTES THAT THE VARIOUS SUNNI LAW SCHOOLS ARE RESPECTED AND MAY BE FREELY APPLIED IN AREAS WHERE SUNNIS PREDOMINATE. - (C) ARTICLE 13, DEFINES THE RECOGNIZED NON-MUSLIM MINORITIES: CHRISTIANS, JEWS AND ZOROASTIANS.

THESE MINORITIES ARE GUARANTEED FREEDOM OF RELIGIOUS PRACTICE AND EDUCATION, AND ARE ALLOWED TO APPLY THEIR OWN LAWS OF DIVORCE, MARRIAGE AND INHERITANCE. THIS ARTICLE CREATED A BRIEF STIR OF INTEREST IN A SMALL ANCIENT SECT CALLED THE SABEANS, WHO CLAIM TO BE FOLLOWERS OF JOHN THE BAPTIST. AYATOLLAH MAHARRENI-SHIRAZI ENDED THAT CONTROVERSY WHEN HE SAID THAT THE SABEANS WERE INCLUDED UNDER THE PROTECTION AFFORDED TO JEWS AND CHRISTIANS.

THE THEOCRATIC LEADERSHIP IS GIVEN THE POWER TO SEE THAT THE PRINCIPLES AND ARTICLES OF THE CONSTITUTION ARE IMPLEMENTED, IN ADDITION TO BEING THE LIAISON BETWEEN THE OTHER FOUR ARMS OF THE STATE. - (E) ARTICLE 21, MAKES PERSIAN THE OFFICIAL LANGUAGE OF IRAN, BUT ALLOWS FOR THE USE OF OTHER "LOCAL AND TRIBAL" LANGUAGES ALONGSIDE OF PERSIAN IN PUBLICATIONS, THE MEDIA, AND THE TEACHING OF LITERATURE IN LOCAL SCHOOLS.

THE ASSEMBLY HAS BEGUN TO FACE THE FORMIDABLE TASK OF ANSWERING QUESTIONS OF THE LEGISLATURE, THE JUDICIARY, AND THE CABINET. UNLESS THE PACE OF WORK IS SPEEDED UP, THERE SEEMS LITTLE PROSPECT FOR THE COUNCIL TO FINISH ITS WORK BEFORE THE END OF 1979. ON 19 SEPT, HOWEVER, KHOMEINI AGAIN URGED THE ASSEMBLY TO EXPEDITE PASSAGE OF THE CONSTITUTION GIVING INDICATION THAT HE MAY BE BECOMING IMPATIENT WITH THE ASSEMBLY'S SNAIL LIKE PACE. SHOULD KHOMEINI STEP IN HE COULD UNDOUBTEDLY SPEED UP THE PROCESS.

THE COUNCIL HAS CHANGED ITS ROLE FROM THAT ORIGINALLY ENVISAGED. IT WAS FIRST THOUGHT THAT THE COUNCIL WOULD MAKE A QUICK REVIEW OF THE DRAFT CONSTITUTION, AND APPROVE IT WITH MINOR CHANGES. INSTEAD, THE COUNCIL HAS TURNED INTO A GENUINE CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY, REWRITING, ADDING AND OMITTING ARTICLES AT WILL.

NOT ALL ARE PLEASED WITH WHAT IS EMERGING FROM THE COUNCIL. THERE APPEARS TO BE A STABLE BLOC OF ABOUT FIFTY TO FIFTY-FIVE DELEGATES WHO SUPPORT MOVES TO INCREASE THE ROLE OF THE CLERGY IN THE NEW GOVERNMENT. ALTHOUGH THERE IS NO FORMAL FACTION OR PARTY STRUCTURE, AYATOLLAHS MONTAZERI AND BEHESHTI HAVE GENERALLY BEEN SPOKESMEN FOR THIS GROUP. THERE IS A SMALL MINORITY, INCLUDING SOME OF THE NON-MUSLIM DELEGATES AND MOQADDAM MARAGHE'I, DELEGATE FROM TABRIZ FROM THE MUSLIM PEOPLES REPUBLICAN PARTY (MRPP) WHO HAVE BEEN UNSUCCESFULLY RESISTING THE MOVES TO MERGE CLERICAL AND SECULAR AUTHORITY.

ALTHOUGH THE DRAFT CONSTITUTION SPECIFICALLY MENTIONED RIGHTS FOR THE NON-PERSIAN ETHNIC GROUPS IN IRAN, THE COUNCIL HAS SO FAR MADE NO MENTION OF THESE GROUPS IN THE ARTICLES APPROVED. THE ORIGINAL ARTICLE 5, WHICH GUARANTEED EQUAL RIGHTS FOR PERSIANS, KURDS, TURKS, ARABS, ETC., HAS SO FAR BEEN IGNORED BY THE ASSEMBLY. WRITER AND CRITIC DR. REZA BARAHENI TOLD AN MRPP MEETING THAT IN HIS OPINION IF THE CONSTITUTION IS RATIFIED WITHOUT GIVING AUTONOMY TO THE MINORITIES, IT WOULD NOT BE IN LINE WITH THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION. COMMENT: THE IRANIAN EXPERIENCE WITH CONSTITUTIONS AND PARLIAMENT, HAS NOT BEEN A HAPPY ONE.

THE 1906 CONSTITUTION WAS ONE OF THE MOST VENERABLE AND MOST IGNORED DOCUMENTS IN THE MIDDLE EAST. AN IRANIAN POET OF THE PRE-REZA SHAH ERA ONCE WROTE IN EXASPERATION, "ONE CAN ONLY DEFECATE ON SUCH A PARLIAMENT."

WITH THIS BACKGROUND, IT IS PERHAPS UNDERSTANDABLE THAT THE PROCEEDINGS OF THE COUNCIL OF EXPERTS HAVE NOT EXCITED GREAT INTEREST, DESPITE THE FACT THAT ITS DECISIONS WILL BE CRUCIAL IN DETERMINING THE SHAPE OF A NEW GOVERNMENT. SOME CONSIDER THE ENTIRE PROCEDURE A CHARADE WHICH WILL COMPLETE ITS WORK AND THEN BE IGNORED BY SOME NEW DICTATOR. OTHER MIDDLE-CLASS IRANIANS ARE WORRIED BY THE DOCUMENT EMERGING.
