1979TEHRAN10321.subject: CHARGE'S MEETING WITH DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER BANI ASSADI

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

CHARGE PAID COURTESY CALL ON DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER FOR COOPERATION (HAM KARI) BANI ASSADI SEPTEMBER 16. ASSADI, WHO IS SON-IN-LAW OF PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN, WAS RECOMMENDED TO CHARGE BY RAMSAY CLARK. ASSADI IS A U.S. EDUCATED (PURDUE, ILLINOIS INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY (MA) AND UNIVERSITY OF PENNSYLVANIA) SOCIAL SCIENTIST WHO SEES HIMSELF, AS HE SAID, AS BEING INVOLVED IN THE GOOD "FACE" OF THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION: THE PGOI'S EFFORTS TO REFORM AND RESTRUCTURE IRAN'S ECONOMY AND SOCIETY. AS ARE SO MANY OF IRAN'S TECHNOCRATS, ASSADI WAS PLAINLY DISTURBED BY THE DARK FACE OF IRAN'S REVOLUTION, THE JAILINGS AND EXECUTIONS, BUT SEEMS TO HAVE RATIONALIZED THEM AS NECESSARY.

AT ONE POINT DURING THE CONVERSATION, ASSADI CLAIMED THAT KHOMEINI HIMSELF WAS CHECKING THE DEMANDS OF EXTREMISTS THAT MORE BE KILLED. ASSADI SAID HE HAD BEEN PRESENT JUST BEFORE THE FIRST EXECUTIONS WHEN KHOMEINI HAD ORDERED THAT ONLY THOSE UNQUESTIONABLY GUILTY OF KILLING BE EXECUTED. KHOMEINI HAD ORDERED THIS EVEN THOUGH "THE PEOPLE" WERE DEMANDING REVENGE.

ASSADI PLAINLY PREFERRED TO DISCUSS THE SOMEWHAT AMORPHOUS TASKS OF HIS OFFICE WHICH IS IN CHARGE, APPARENTLY, OF RURAL DEVELOPMENT AND SELF HELP PROJECTS. AT THE TIME OF THE CHARGE'S VISIT HE HAD BEFORE HIM THE DRAFT PLANS FOR LOCAL AND MUNICIPAL ELECTIONS WHICH ARE SUPPOSED TO BE HELD THIS FALL. THE ORIGINAL PLAN, ASSADI SAID, HAD BEEN SENT TO THE PRIME MINISTER'S OFFICE THREE MONTHS BEFORE BY THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL. THIS PLAN HAD BEEN COMPLETELY IMPRACTIBLE AND THEY HAD SENT IT BACK TO THE COUNCIL UNDER A LETTER SAYING THAT THE PLAN WOULD NOT WORK BUT THAT THEY WERE WORKING ON A NEW PLAN.

(ASSADI PLAINLY HAD BEEN STUNG BY CRITICISM APPEARING IN THE PRESS THAT BAZARGAN HAD DONE NOTHING TO IMPLEMENT THE COUNCIL'S CALL FOR LOCAL ELECTIONS). ASSADI SAID THAT RESTRUCTURING AND DECENTRALIZATION OF LOCAL GOVERNMENT COULD NOT BE ACCOMPLISHED OVER NIGHT. GOVERNMENT IN IRAN HAD ALWAYS BEEN RUN FROM THE CENTER, AND IT WAS NOT EASY TO REVERSE THIS CENTURIES-OLD TRADITON AND GET LOCAL COMMUNITIES TO RUN THEIR OWN AFFAIRS. ASSADI SAID HE WOULD BE MEETING WITH THE MINISTERS THAT AFTERNOON TO DISCUSS A PLAN WHICH CALLED FOR MUNICIPAL ELECTIONS UNDER A SYSTEM OF FUNCTIONAL GROUPINGS (I.E. LABOR ETC).
HE DID NOT LIKE THIS IDEA AS HE FELT IT GAVE TOO MUCH POWER TO THE LEADERS OF THESE GROUPS AND THAT IT WOULD NOT MESH WITH THE NATIONAL SYSTEM OF ELECTIONS WHICH WOULD BE BASED ON PARTIES.

COMMENT: WE DO NOT YET KNOW WHAT THE OUTCOME OF THE MEETING WAS. INTERIOR MINISTER SABAGHIAN ANNOUNCED SEPTEMBER 10 THAT A NEW BILL ON URBAN AND RURAL COUNCILS HAD BEEN SENT TO THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL FOR ITS APPROVAL. WE HAVE NO WORD YET WHEN THESE LOCAL LEVEL ELECTIONS MIGHT BE HELD. DURING THE MEETING, ASSADI SAID THAT THE PGOI INTENDS TO GO AHEAD WITH THESE ELECTIONS EVEN IF THE CONSTITUTION IS NOT COMPLETED.

ASSADI SAID THE PGOI WAS LOOKING INTO WAYS TO RAISE THE STANDARDS OF LIVING IN THE VILLAGES AND REDUCE THE DISPARITY BETWEEN CITY AND RURAL LIFE. ONE IDEA WHICH THEY WERE CONSIDERING WOULD BE TO GIVE EACH VILLAGE A LARGE AMOUNT OF MONEY TO USE FOR THEIR OWN NEEDS.

ASSADI SPENT SOME TIME ENTHUSIASTICALLY DISCUSSING HIS "CRUSADE FOR RECONSTRUCTION", A PEACE CORPS LIKE ORGANIZATION WHICH SENDS STUDENTS OUT INTO THE COUNTRYSIDE TO WORK WITH LOCAL OFFICIALS TO SPEED UP DEVELOPMENT. ALTHOUGH CHARGE PRESSED ASSADI WITH QUESTIONS, HE DID NOT RECEIVE A VERY CLEAR PICTURE OF EXACTLY HOW THIS ORGANIZATION (IF IT CAN BE CALLED THAT) WORKS. EARLY IN THE REVOLUTION, ASSADI APPARENTLY PROPOSED THAT ALL UNIVERSITY STUDENTS BE SENT (A LA CHINA'S CULTURAL REVOLUTION) TO THE COUNTRYSIDE FOR A PERIOD OF TIME TO WORK IN RURAL COMMUNITIES.

AS ASSADI DID NOT WIN APPROVAL FOR THIS IDEA, HE HAD TO SETTLE FOR A GENERAL APPEAL THROUGH THE NATIONAL AND PROVINCIAL GOVERNMENTS FOR VOLUNTEERS TO WORK IN HIS CRUSADE. HE SAID THE CRUSADE WAS RUN BY A BOARD COMPOSED OF SIX MINISTERS, TEN MEMBERS OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL AND REPRESENTATIVES FROM THE CRUSADE. THE VOLUNTEERS ARE PAID AND ARE SOMEHOW MANAGED BY LOCAL BOARDS IN THE PROVINCIAL CITIES. THE CRUSADE ------------------073992 250304Z /66 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 3909 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 10321 APPEARED TO BE A STOPGAP MEASURE AND ASSADI DID NOT SEEM TO VISUALIZE ITS CONTUNUATION ONCE LOCAL AND MUNICIPAL GOVERNMENTS BEGAN TO FUNCTION.

COMMENT: SOME REPORTS REACHING EMBOFFS INDICATE THAT SOME OF THE PROFESSORS AND STUDENTS GOING OUT INTO THE COUNTRYSIDE WITH CRUSADE IN THE EARLY DAYS OF THE REVOLUTION WERE GREETED WITH SUSPICION (AS GOVERNMENT SPIES) AND DISTRUST. DURING TROUBLES IN TURKOMAN SARAI IN EARLY REVOLUTION TWO VOLUNTEERS WERE KILLED. WE NOTE FROM RECENT FBIS REPORT THAT THERE IS NOW SOMETHING CALLED THE "CRUSADE FOR RECONSTRUCTION" WHICH IS GOING TO BE USED IN RECONSTRUCTING KURDESTAN. WE DO NOT KNOW IF THIS IS THE SAME OUTFIT.

ASSADI SEEMED VERY INTERESTED IN US LOCAL AND STATE GOVERNMENT AND WE ARE ARRANGING TO MAKE SOME BOOKS ON THIS SUBJECT AVAILABLE TO HIM. COMMENT: ASSADI IS JUST THE SORT OF WESTERNIZED TECHNOCRAT THAT ONE WISHES WOULD HAVE SOME INFLUENCE IN THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. WE DOUBT, HOWEVER, THAT HE IS VERY EFFECTIVE. LAINGEN

1979TEHRAN10342.subject: SECRETARY'S MEETING WITH YAZDI: GULF DISTRICT; US PRESENCE IN PERSIAN GULF

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

DURING CONVERSATIONS WITH YAZDI OCTOBER 3, WE SUGGEST SECRETARY VANCE RAISE QUESTION OF OUR ACCESS TO COMMISSARY,GULF DISTRICT AND OTHER MILITARY PROPERTIES SUCH AS MOTOR POOL AND ARMY COMMUNICATION COMMMAND (ACOM) FACILITY.

FOLLOWING DEATH OF AYATOLLA TALEGHANI, THE TALEGHANI COMMITTEE WHICH FORMERLY CONTROLLED COMMISSARY IS TURNING OVER CONTROL OF COMMISSARY AND OTHER PROPERTIES (BOTH US AND IRANIAN) EITHER TO OFFICE OF THE PRIME MINISTER OR TO ARMY. WE ARE NOT CERTAIN WHO ACTUALLY CONTROLS ACCESS TO THE GULF DISTRICT. WE HOPE THAT COMMISSARY AND THE GULF DISTRICT MAY END UP IN HANDS OF PRIME MINISTER'S OFFICE. IF SO, YAZDI WOULD BE IN A POSITION TO CONTROL DISPOSITION OF COMMISSARY AND GULF DISTRICT. WHILE YAZDI HAS NOT BEEN RESPONSIVE TO OUR APPROACHES IN THE PAST, WE THINK IT NOW MIGHT BE WORTH ANOTHER TRY.

IN HIS DEPARTURE STATEMENT AUGUST 23, YAZDI REPORTEDLY TOLD PRESS THAT "BESIDES DISCUSSING RELATIONS BETWEEN THE TWO COUNTRIES WITH VANCE, YAZDI SAID HE WILL ALSO DISCUSS AN AMERICAN PLAN TO LAND COMBAT TROOPS IN THE PERSIAN GULF TO PROVIDE STABILITY IN THE REGION. SUCH A MOVE BY THE US, HE SAID, WILL NOT IN ANY WAY HELP DEFUSE ANY OF THE REGION'S CONFLICTS". 5, COMMENT: TEHRAN PRESS HAS BEEN FOLLOWING WITH INTEREST VARIOUS STATEMENTS BY USG OFFICIALS REGARDING FORMATION OF RAPID REACTION FORCES.

THERE HAS BEEN A GREAT DEAL OF SPECULATION HERE THAT USG INTENDS TO OR HAS INCREASED ITS COMBAT MARINE FORCES IN THE GULF AREA; THAT WE MAY INTEND TO SEND IN FORCES TO AFGHANISTAN; AND THAT US MIGHT BE CONSIDERING SOME ACTION AGAINST OIL FIELDS IN MIDDLE EAST. LATEST VERSION OF THIS IS KAYHAN STORY AUGUST 24 QUOTING KHOMEINI'S REPRESENTATIVE TO THE UAE MODARESSI THAT FIVE TO SIX THOUSAND US TROOPS ARE STATIONED IN JUFAIR BASE IN BAHRAIN.

IT WOULD BE VERY USEFUL IF SECRETARY COULD DISCUSS WITH YAZDI DISPOSITION OF OUR FORCES IN THE INDIAN OCEAN AND PERSIAN GULF SO HE WILL HAVE FULL UNDERSTANDING OF OUR INTENTION IN THE AREA. CHARGE TOOK OPPORTUNITY DURING CALL ON MINISTRY OF NATIONAL GUIDANCE MINISTER MINACHI TODAY TO DESCRIBE PRESS REPORT OF U.S. TROOPS IN BAHRAIN AS TOTALLY WITHOUT FOUNDATION AND UNHELPFUL TO ATMOSPHERE AFFECT ING US IRAN RELATIONSHIP. LAINGEN

1979TEHRAN10348.subject: OPENING OF THE SCHOOL YEAR IN IRAN

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

THE FIRST ACADEMIC YEAR FOLLOWING THE REVOLUTION HAS BEGUN AS SCHOOLS ACROSS IRAN OPENED ON SEPTEMBER 23 AND AN ESTIMATED 10 MILLION STUDENTS MARCHED OFF TO THEIR FIRST DAY OF CLASSES. THE PROBLEMS GREETING STUDENTS WERE NOT UNTYPICAL OF OTHER YEARS: A SHORTAGE OF BOOKS, SERIOUSLY AGGRAVATED THIS YEAR BY GENERAL CHANGES IN MANY OF THE TEXTS, AND TRAFFIC JAMS CAUSED BY THE HEAVY INFLUX OF PUPILS INTO THE STREETS.

AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI TOOK THE OPPORTUNITY OF THE SCHOLASTIC YEAR'S COMMENCEMENT TO WARN UNIVERSITY REPRESENTATIVES AGAINST THE "(FOREIGN) DEVILS WHO WANT TO TAKE AWAY EVERYTHING WE HAVE." CALLING THE UNIVERSITIES THE NERVE CENTER OF THE COUNTRY, KHOMEINI CLAIMED THAT "FOREIGNERS DO NOT WANT US TO HAVE THESE SEATS OF LEARNING, EVEN DIVINITY SCHOOLS." KHOMEINI'S SPEECH, HOWEVER, SEEMS TO BE MORE A CALL FOR RESTORATION OF TRADITIONAL ISLAMIC AND PERSIAN VALUES IN THE EDUCATION SYSTEM THAN AN ATTACK ON THE WEST AS SUCH. STRESSING THE NEED TO BREAK AWAY FROM DEPENDENCE ON THE WEST, HE SAID THAT CULTURAL DEPENDENCE ON THE SUPERPOWERS LED TO DEPENDENCE IN OTHER FIELDS OF ACTIVITY.
UNLESS CULTURAL AND INTELLECTUAL INDEPENDENCE WAS OBTAINED BY THE DEPRIVED NATIONS, THERE COULD BE NO INDEPENDENCE IN ANY OTHER FIELD.

ON SEPTEMBER 22 PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN POSTPONED AN ORDER BY THE MINISTRY OF EDUCATION TO NATIONALIZE PRIVATE SCHOOLS (REF A). PRIVATE SCHOOLS ARE, HOWEVER, TO BE MANAGED BY A BOARD OF TRUSTEES COMPRISED OF REPRESENTATIVES OF PARENTS, MINISTRY OF EDUCATION AND OWNERS OF THE SCHOOLS.

TEHRAN UNIVERSITY'S ACADEMIC YEAR WAS INAUGURATED ON SEPTEMBER 23, BUT AN ANNOUNCEMENT WAS MADE THAT REGISTRATION WOULD NOT BEGIN UNTIL SEPTEMBER 29. CLASSES ARE NOW SCHEDULED TO ACTUALLY BEGIN ON OCTOBER 7. PERHAPS ONE REASON FOR THE LATE START AT THE UNIVERSITY WAS THE DELAYED ANNOUNCEMENT OF WHICH PROSPECTIVE STUDENTS HAD BEEN ACCEPTED FOLLOWING THE UNIVERSITY ENTRANCE EXAMINATIONS. (THE NUMBER OF ACCEPTANCES EACH YEAR IS DETERMINED BY THE NUMBER OF AVAILABLE PLACES). THE EXAMS, ("KONKUR") WERE GIVEN IN JULY AND 546,491 APPLICANTS PARTICIPATED. LESS THAN 40,000 OF THOSE WHO TOOK THE EXAM WILL BE ADMITTED TO COLLEGES AND UNIVERSITIES THROUGHOUT IRAN.

WHILE THE PGOI HAS ANNOUNCED VAGUE PLANS OF ADMITTING APPROXIMATELY 200,000 OF THE DISAPPOINTED CANDIDATES INTO A RURAL RECONSTRUCTION PROGRAM, IT HARDLY SEEMS TO BE THE ANSWER OF WHICH THEY WERE HOPEFUL. WITHOUT DOUBT, MANY OF THOSE STUDENTS WHO ARE UNABLE TO ENTER IRANIAN UNIVERSITIES WILL BE ADDED TO THE THOUSANDS ALREADY WAITING AT THE POST'S CONSULAR SECTION FOR STUDENT VISAS TO THE USA. LAINGEN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SCATTERED INCIDENTS HAVE OCCURRED THROUGHOUT THE KURDISH AREAS OF IRAN OVER THE LAST WEEK AS KURDISH REBELS WITH NO APPARENT COORDINATION HAVE CARRIED OUT SMALL HIT AND RUN ATTACKS USUALLY ON THE PGOI'S REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS. APPROXIMATELY SIX SOLDIERS OR PASDAR HAVE BEEN KILLED AND SEVERAL WOUNDED. THE WORST INCIDENTS HAVE OCCURRED IN OR AROUND MAHABAD. ALL ROADS IN THE AREA APPEAR TO BE OPEN BUT THOSE IN THE MAHABAD AREA IN PARTICULAR ARE SUBJECT TO SPOT ATTACKS.
PGOI ITSELF APPARENTLY IS CONCERNED OVER CONTINUED REBEL ACTIVITY. ON SEPTEMBER 23, KHOMEINI'S ENVOY TO KURDESTAN KERMANI TOLD THE PRESS THAT THE REBELLION IN KURDESTAN IS NOT OVER YET.

IN AN INTERESTING COMMENT TO THE PRESS, SEPT 19, REVOLUTIONARY JUDGE KHALKHALI STATED THAT HIS INVESTIGATIONS IN KURDESTAN REVEALED THAT NEITHER THE SOVIET UNION NOR JALAL TALEBANI WERE INVOLVED IN THE KURDISH SITUATION. INSTEAD HE BLAMED MEMBERS OF THE KDP WHO WERE AFFILIATED WITH EITHER THE FADAYEEN KHALQ OR WITH THOSE CONNECTED WITH IMPERIALISM/ZIONISM WHO HAD DIRECT LINKS TO GENEVA AND TEL AVIV.

SIGNS OF UNREST WERE ALSO APPARENT THIS WEEK ON THE EASTERN SIDE OF IRAN, AS DEMONSTRATORS GATHERED IN ZAHEDAN TO PROTEST THE INSTALLATION OF SHIITE ISLAM AS THE OFFICIAL RELIGION OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. THE GOVERNOR OF BALUCHISTAN AND SISTAN HAS ADMITTED THAT REBELS RECENTLY MADE TWO ATTACKS ON GENDARMARIE POSTS AND CARRIED OFF GUNS. THE GOVERNOR IS APPARENTLY NEGOITIATING AN AMNESTY FOR SOME OF THE REBEL BALUCHI TRIBES IN RETURN FOR SURRENDER OF WEAPONS. LAINGEN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

ON SEPTEMBER 24, THE PGOI EXECUTED THREE MORE SUPPORTERS OF THE FORMER SHAH FOR BEING "CORRUPT ON EARTH AND WARRING AGAINST GOD." ONE, IRAJ MATBUI, WAS AN 81 YEAR OLD FORMER SENATOR AND GENERAL WHOSE MAIN CRIMES SEEM TO HAVE BEEN HELPING THE SHAH'S FATHER COME TO POWER IN 1920 AND SUPPRESSING A DEMONSTRATION IN 1935. THE OTHER TWO JAMSHID ALAM (74) AND MOHSEN KHAWJANURI
WERE CONVICTED MAINLY ON CORRUPTION CHARGES ALTHOUGH ALAM AS THE SHAH'S DOCTOR WAS ALSO CHARGED WITH URGING THE SHAH TO FIRE ON DEMONSTRATORS.

THESE EXECUTIONS SEEM PARTICULARLY IRONIC FOLLOWING AS THEY DO SO CLOSELY ON KHOMEINI'S SON'S STATEMENTS OF TWO DAYS AGO THAT EXECUTIONS SHOULD BE BANNED AND KHOMEINI'S OWN STATEMENTS IN THE PAST THAT ONLY THOSE INVOLVED IN KILLINGS SHOULD BE EXECUTED.

THE REGIME HAS LITTLE EXCUSE FOR EXECUTING THESE OLD MEN: THE PGOI IS NOT UNDER ANY PARTICULAR PRESSURE EVEN IN KURDESTAN; THERE IS NO PARTICULAR NEED AT THIS MOMENT TO GARNER MASS SUPPORT BY EXECUTIONS; THOSE EXECUTED, ESPECIALLY THE GENERAL WERE NOT PARTICULARLY DANGEROUS OR EXCEPT FOR ALAM, WELL KNOWN.

THE EXECUTION OF AN 81 YEAR OLD DOES NOT SIT WELL ON ANY ONES MIND. WE HAVE NOTED A SLIGHT BUT GROWING REVULSION EVEN AMONG RELIGIOUS MUSLEMS TO THE REGIMES EXCESSES AND CAN ONLY HOPE THAT ACTS LIKE THIS WILL BRING A BACKLASH AMONG THE IRANIANS THEMSELVES.

ON 23 SEP, EMB OFF CALLED ON MS. NAZANIN ALTUNTASH OF INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATION SECTION, MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS, FOR SHORT DISCUSSION OF IMCO MEETING AND ELECTIONS. MS. ALTUNTASH WAS JOINED BY MR. A.M. BIDARNAGHZ OF THE LEGAL SECTION. SHE TOLD EMB OFF THAT US NOTE SENT TO IRANIAN EMBASSY IN WASH HAD NOT YET BEEN RECEIVED IN TEHRAN, THEREFORE SHE COULD NOT COMMENT ON IT. BASED ON PREVIOUS US PARTICIPATION IN IMCO, SHE CONSIDERED IT FOREGONE CONCLUSION THAT US WOULD BE ELECTED.
SHE SAID THAT IRANIAN DELEGATION HAD NOT YET BEEN CHOSEN, BUT WOULD PROBABLY CONSIST OF ONE PERSON FROM IRANIAN EMBASSY LONDON AND ONE REPRESENTATIVE OF THE MINISTRY OF
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

POLOFF SEPTEMBER 25 INFORMED ALI-ASGHAR PARSAKIA, ACTING-CHIEF OF FOURTH POLITICAL DIVISION OF CONTENTS REFTEL. PARSAKIA APPEARED FASCINATED BY BERNARD LEWIS PLAN AND RELIEVED TO HEAR REPETITION OF IMPORTANCE TO US OF RESPECT FOR TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY OF IRAN.

WHILE WE REGRET SHOWING OUR IGNORANCE, EMBASSY WOULD APPRECIATE SHORT BIO FROM DEPARTMENT ON BERNARD LEWIS. WE HAVE GUESSES RANGING FROM A BRITISH SCHOLAR AND AUTHOR OF SEVERAL BOOKS ON THE MIDDLE EAST TO A ZIONIST REPORTER ON A NEW YORK PAPER.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).
INTERIOR MINISTER SABAGHIAN ANNOUNCED SEPTEMBER 23 THAT IRAN NOW PLANS TO HOLD MUNICIPAL ELECTIONS ON FRIDAY, OCTOBER 12,IN 156 MAJOR CITIES (OUT OF A TOTAL OF 470).

A FORTY-FIVE ARTICLE DECREE ON THE ELECTIONS HAS NOW BEEN PUBLISHED BUT THE GROUND RULES FOR THE ELECTIONS SEEM FAIRLY VAGUE: ANYONE OVER 16 WHO HAS LIVED IN THE TOWN FOR OVER SIX MONTHS CAN VOTE IN THE ELECTIONS. REGISTRATION WILL BE HELD OCTOBER 11. TO STAND FOR ELECTION A CANDIDATE MUST BE OVER TWENTY-FIVE, LITERATE IN PERSIAN, HAVE LIVED ONE YEAR IN THE DISTRICT, HAVE A GOOD REPUTATION AND BELIEVE IN THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTION.
THE ELECTIONS WILL CHOOSE CITY COUNCILS WHICH WILL BE COMPOSED OF A MINIMUM OF SEVEN AND A MAXIMUM OF TWENTY MEMBERS. THE COUNCIL WILL THEN ELECT ONE OF THE MEMBERS MAYOR.

WE WILL FOLLOW THESE LOCAL ELECTIONS CAREFULLY OVER THE NEXT FEW WEEKS TO SEE IF THEY WILL GIVE US SOME INDICATION HOW THE PGOI MAY INTEND TO HANDLE POLITICS ON THE NATIONAL LEVEL. THESE LOCAL ELECTIONS MAY BE QUITE IMPORTANT. THE GOVERNMENT IS APPARENTLY CONSIDERING MERGING THE AUTHORITIES OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES WITH THESE MUNICIPAL COUNCILS ONCE THE ELECTIONS ARE OVER. THIS WOULD MEAN IN TEHRAN FOR INSTANCE A SWITCH FROM A REVOLUTIONARY GOVERNMENT SYSTEM OF 14 REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES SO AN ELECTED SYSTEM OF EIGHT MUNICIPAL COUNCILS. LAINGEN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

ON SEPTEMBER 26, INTERIOR MINISTER SABBAGHIAN ANNOUNCED THAT CITY COUNCIL ELECTIONS IN TEHRAN, MASHHAD, TABRIZ, SHIRAZ, ESFAHAN AND AHWAZ WOULD BE POSTPONED. THE OFFICIAL REASON FOR THE POSTPONMENT IS THAT "SPECIAL REGULATIONS ARE BEING PREPARED FOR THESE CITIES WHICH HAVE SEVERAL MUNICIPAL DISTRICTS EACH." NO NEW DATE HAS BEEN SET.

WHILE WE ASSUME THIS POSTPONEMENT MAY WELL HAVE BEEN DUE PARTIALLY TO ADMINISTRATIVE PROBLEMS, WE SUSPECT THAT THERE WAS ALSO CONCERN IN PGOI THAT ELECTIONS AT THIS TIME IN THE MAJOR CITIES WITHOUT PROPER PREPARATION MIGHT BE DIFFICULT TO CONTROL. LAINGEN

ON SEPTEMBER 28, PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN ANNOUNCED A SERIES OF CABINET CHANGES IN EFFECT FIRING NIOC CHAIRMAN HASSAN NAZIH AND REPLACING HIM WITH STATE MINISTER FOR PLAN AND BUDGET ORGANIZATION ALI AKBAR MOINFAR WHO WILL HEAD A NEWLY-CREATED MINISTRY OF OIL. ACCORDING TO PRESS REPORTS, THE MINISTRY OF OIL WILL CONTROL NIOC, NIPC (NATIONAL IRANIAN PETROCHEMICAL COMPANY) AND NIGC (NATIONAL IRANIAN GAS COMPANY), PLUS THE OIL DEPARTMENT OF THE MINISTRY OF FINANCE AND ECONOMIC AFFAIRS.

NAZIH IS IN SERIOUS TROUBLE. UNDOUBTEDLY ON ORDERS FROM KHOMEINI, HE HAS BEEN REMOVED FROM THE CHAIRMANSHIP OF NIOC BY BAZARGAN AND HAS BEEN ORDERED BY REVOLUTIONARY PROSECUTOR GENERAL ALI GHODOUSI TO APPEAR BEFORE HIM TO ANSWER "NUMEROUS COMPLAINTS" AGAINST HIM. IN A STATEMENT THURSDAY NIGHT, KHOMEINI SAID "NAZIH IS AN ORDINARY PERSON AND IS NOT WORTH MENTIONING - IF HE HAS COMMITTED TREASON HE SHOULD BE TRIED AND PUNISHED; AND IF HE IS FOUND INNOCENT HE SHOULD BE RELEASED."

IN ANOTHER IMPORTANT MOVE, BAZARGAN NAMED MOSTAFA CHAMRAN, DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER OF REVOLUTIONARY AFFAIRS AND HEAD OF SAVAK'S REPLACEMENT ORGANIZATION SAVAMA, TO HEAD THE MINISTRY OF DEFENSE. CHAMRAN, 48 YEARS OLD, IS A U.S. EDUCATED ENGINEER AND LONGTIME REVOLUTIONARY. A CIVILIAN, HE MADE A NAME FOR HIMSELF RECENTLY FOR HIS ROLE AS COORDINATOR OF THE KURDISH CAMPAIGN. AS DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER, CHAMSAN IS BELIEVED TO HAVE HAD A MAJOR ROLE IN THE FORMATION AND OPERATIONS OF THE REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS (PASDARAN). WE ARE NOT CERTAIN, HOWEVER, HOW MANY OF HIS FORMER RESPONSIBILITIES HE WILL CARRY TO HIS NEW POSITION.

SHOULD HE CONTINUE TO HAVE INFLUENCE WITH THE PASDARAN, THIS WILL GIVE HIM CONTROL OF ALL IRAN'S ARMED FORCES BOTH REVOLUTIONARY AND REGULAR (E.G. THE PASDARAN, THE ARMY, NAVY, AIR RORCE AND GENDARMARIE.) CHAMRAN HAS BEEN SEEN AS A COMER RECENTLY WHO HAS THE TRUST OF KHOMEINI. HIS NEW POSITION SHOULD MAKE HIM ONE OF IRAN'S MOST POWERFUL LEADERS.

DURING CONVERSATIONS WITH YAZDI OCTOBER 3, WE SUGGEST SECRETARY VANCE RAISE QUESTION OF OUR ACCESS TO COMMISSARY,GULF DISTRICT AND OTHER MILITARY PROPERTIES SUCH AS MOTOR POOL AND ARMY COMMUNICATION COMMMAND (ACOM) FACILITY.

FOLLOWING DEATH OF AYATOLLA TALEGHANI, THE TALEGHANI COMMITTEE WHICH FORMERLY CONTROLLED COMMISSARY IS TURNING OVER CONTROL OF COMMISSARY AND OTHER PROPERTIES (BOTH US AND IRANIAN) EITHER TO OFFICE OF THE PRIME MINISTER OR TO ARMY. WE ARE NOT CERTAIN WHO ACTUALLY CONTROLS ACCESS TO THE GULF DISTRICT. WE HOPE THAT COMMISSARY AND THE GULF DISTRICT MAY END UP IN HANDS OF PRIME MINISTER'S OFFICE. IF SO, YAZDI WOULD BE IN A POSITION TO CONTROL DISPOSITION OF COMMISSARY AND GULF DISTRICT. WHILE YAZDI HAS NOT BEEN RESPONSIVE TO OUR APPROACHES IN THE PAST, WE THINK IT NOW MIGHT BE WORTH ANOTHER TRY.

IN HIS DEPARTURE STATEMENT AUGUST 23, YAZDI REPORTEDLY TOLD PRESS THAT "BESIDES DISCUSSING RELATIONS BETWEEN THE TWO COUNTRIES WITH VANCE, YAZDI SAID HE WILL ALSO DISCUSS AN AMERICAN PLAN TO LAND COMBAT TROOPS IN THE PERSIAN GULF TO PROVIDE STABILITY IN THE REGION. SUCH A MOVE BY THE US, HE SAID, WILL NOT IN ANY WAY HELP DEFUSE ANY OF THE REGION'S CONFLICTS". 5, COMMENT: TEHRAN PRESS HAS BEEN FOLLOWING WITH INTEREST VARIOUS STATEMENTS BY USG OFFICIALS REGARDING FORMATION OF RAPID REACTION FORCES.

THERE HAS BEEN A GREAT DEAL OF SPECULATION HERE THAT USG INTENDS TO OR HAS INCREASED ITS COMBAT MARINE FORCES IN THE GULF AREA; THAT WE MAY INTEND TO SEND IN FORCES TO AFGHANISTAN; AND THAT US MIGHT BE CONSIDERING SOME ACTION AGAINST OIL FIELDS IN MIDDLE EAST. LATEST VERSION OF THIS IS KAYHAN STORY AUGUST 24 QUOTING KHOMEINI'S REPRESENTATIVE TO THE UAE MODARESSI THAT FIVE TO SIX THOUSAND US TROOPS ARE STATIONED IN JUFAIR BASE IN BAHRAIN.

IT WOULD BE VERY USEFUL IF SECRETARY COULD DISCUSS WITH YAZDI DISPOSITION OF OUR FORCES IN THE INDIAN OCEAN AND PERSIAN GULF SO HE WILL HAVE FULL UNDERSTANDING OF OUR INTENTION IN THE AREA. CHARGE TOOK OPPORTUNITY DURING CALL ON MINISTRY OF NATIONAL GUIDANCE MINISTER MINACHI TODAY TO DESCRIBE PRESS REPORT OF U.S. TROOPS IN BAHRAIN AS TOTALLY WITHOUT FOUNDATION AND UNHELPFUL TO ATMOSPHERE AFFECT ING US RAN RELATIONSHIP. 1979TEHRAN10503.subject: BANKING: CONSOLIDATION OF THE PRIVATE BANKING SECTOR

segments.text: (C-ENTIRE TEXT)

ACCORDING TO KHOSROW NAYEBI, DIRECTOR GENERAL OF BANK SUPERVISION IN THE CENTRAL BANK OF IRAN (CBI), IRAN'S 36 NATIONALIZED PRIVATE BANKS WILL SOON BE MERGED INTO 10-12 MORE SOLID INSTITUTIONS. LEGISLATION TO THIS EFFECT IS NOW PENDING BEFORE THE CABINET, AND SEEMS CERTAIN TO BE APPROVED. NAYEBI OPINED THAT THE LEGISLATION MUST HAVE BEEN CHECKED OUT WITH THE RELIGIOUS AUTHORITIES IN QUM.

CONSOLIDATION. A FEW BANKS, SUCH AS THE BANK MELLI, THE BANK RAHNI IRAN (MORTGAGE BANK), AND THE BANK FARANGHIAN (EDUCATIONAL BANK), ALL LONG-STANDING GOI INSTITUTIONS, WILL BE EXEMPTED FROM THE CONSOLIDATION. FOR THE OTHERS, FOUR OR POSSIBLY FIVE MAJOR BANKS, INCLUDING THE BANK SADERAT IRAN, THE BANK OF TEHRAN, AND THE BANK TEJARAT KHAREGI IRAN, WILL SERVE AS THE NUCLEAR BANKS, INTO WHICH ALL THE OTHER PRIVATE BANKS WILL BE MELDED.

PRIVATE BANKS NOT NATIONALIZED. ACTING ECONCOUNS ASKED WHY THE BANK RUSS VA IRAN, 100 PERCENT OWNED BY THE SOVIET STATE, HAD BEEN EXEMPTED FROM NATIONALIZATION. IT HAD NOT BEEN EXEMPTED, REPLIED NAYEBI. THE NATIONALIZATION LAW WHICH COVERED IT HAD NOT YET BEEN APPLIED TO IT. THERE HAD, AFTER ALL, BEEN NO URGENCY IN THE MATTER. THE BANK RUSS VA IRAN HAD CONCENTRATED ON TRADE FACILITATION WITH THE USSR. NOT BEING INVOLVED WITH THE LOCAL MARKETPLACE, IT HAD NOT NEEDED, NOR SOUGHT, CENTRAL BANK ADVANCES DURING THE TROUBLES. IT WOULD BE NATIONALIZED NEVERTHELESS.
AS FOR THE "ISLAMIC BANK," ALSO NOT NATIONALIZED, IT HAD BEEN DECIDED NOT TO OPEN THIS PROJECT AS A BANK, BUT AS SOMETHING ELSE UNSPECIFIED.

PRO'S AND CON'S OF CONSOLIDATION. MORE THAN 5 DIFFERENT BANKS ' FOR EXAMPLE, ARE TODAY DOING BUSINESS IN THE SMALL CITY OF QAZIN, A REDUNDANCY TO BE DIMINISHED BY CONSOLIDATION. MANAGERIAL SKILLS ARE THIN. BY CONSOLIDATION THE FEW GOOD PEOPLE CAN BE MORE EFFECTIVELY UTILIZED, CAPITALIZATION AND DEPOSIT BASES WOULD BE STRONGER. AND NAYEBI'S OWN INSPECTION WOULD BE EASIER. AT THE SAME TIME, EACH OF THE BANKS HAS ITS OWN ACCOUNTING SYSTEM. SOME ARE COMPUTERIZED, SOME NOT. PERSONNEL PROBLEMS LOOMED LARGE.

THE OVERALL PICTURE. IN GENERAL, SAID NAYEBI, THE BANKING PICTURE LOOKS A LOT BETTER OVERALL, GIVEN VARIATIONS AMONG THE DIFFERENT BANKS, THAN IT DID SIX MONTHS AGO. FOR MOST, DEPOSIT LEVELS ARE UP AND LOANS EXTENDED ARE ALSO UP. COLLECTIONS ARE GOOD, WHILE THE PREFERENCE FOR CASH WAS STRONG, IT WAS A LOT STRONGER SIX MONTHS AGO. HE HAD OBSERVED NO PRESSURE ON BANK MANAGERS TO LEND OR WITHHOLD CREDIT ON RELIGIOUS OR OTHER NON-BANKING GROUNDS. EACH MANAGER ACTED EXACTLY AS HE HAD BEFORE.

NOR HAD NAYEBI NOTICED ANY DETERIORATION IN SERVICE AS SOMETIMES ALLEGED HERE. SOME SENIOR EXECUTIVES WERE DISCONTENTED WITH HAVING THEIR SALARIES REDUCED TO CIVIL SERVICE LEVELS BUT FOR THE RANK-AND-FILE, BEING PLACED IN CIVIL SERVICE STATUS WITH ALL ITS EMOLUMENTS WAS A BLESSING.

COMMENT. THE EARLIER NOTION THAT EACH OF THE CONSOLIDATED GROUPS MIGHT SPECIALIZE IN A SEPARATE ECONOMIC FIELD WAS NOT MENTIONED BY NAYEBI. AT THE VERY LEAST, IT WOULD NOT MEET THE NEEDS OF THE PROVINCES. LAINGEN
(S-ENTIRE TEXT.)

I CANNOT SUGGEST THAT THERE HAS BEEN ANY SIGNIFICANT CHANGE AS YET IN THE KIND OF OFFICIAL AND PUBLIC REACTION TO THE SHAH ENTERING THE UNITED STATES THAT WOULD DIFFER FROM THE ASSESSMENT I GAVE YOU IN LATE JULY (TEHRAN 7930). THE CONSTITUTIONAL TIMETABLE HAS SLIPPED AND A NEW GOVERNMENT IS NOW UNLIKELY TO BE INSTALLED BEFORE THE END OF THIS YEAR. OUR OWN RELATIONSHIP IS IMPROVING BUT ONLY SLOWLY, AND IT IS NOT YET OF THE SUBSTANCE THAT WOULD WEATHER VERY WELL THE IMPACT OF THE SHAH ENTERING THE UNITED STATES.

MEANWHILE THE CLERICS HERE ARE IN THE ASCENDANCY, AND THAT I FEAR WORSENS THE PUBLIC ATMOSPHERE AS REGARDS ANY GESTURE ON OUR PART TOWARD THE SHAH. THAT WAS ILLUSTRATED THIS PAST WEEK IN THE VERY TOUGH REMARKS BY KHOMEINI CONCERNING THE SHAH IN HIS REPORTED INTERVIEW WITH ORIANA FALLACI, IN WHICH HE DENOUNCED THE SHAH AS A TRAITOR WHO MUST BE RETURNED TO IRAN AND TRIED PUBLICLY FOR FIFTY YEARS OF CRIMES AGAINST THE IRANIAN PEOPLE.

GIVEN THAT KIND OF ATMOSPHERE AND THE KIND OF PUBLIC POSTURING ABOUT THE SHAH BY THOSE WHO CONTROL OR INFLUENCE PUBLIC OPINION HERE, I DOUBT THAT THE SHAH BEING ILL WOULD HAVE MUCH AMELIORATING EFFECT ON THE DEGREE OF REACTION HERE. IT WOULD PRESUMABLY MAKE OUR OWN POSITION MORE DEFENSIBLE IF WE WERE SEEN TO ADMIT HIM UNDER DEMONSTRABLY HUMANITARIAN CONSIDERATIONS.

THAT BEING SAID, IT IS AS YOU INDICATE OF UTMOST IMPORTANCE THAT WE TALK QUIETLY WITH THE GOVERNMENT OF IRAN IN ADVANCE IF WE INTEND TO ADMIT HIM, EVEN FOR A VERY SHORT PERIOD. IF WE DO INTEND TO TAKE SUCH ACTION AND IF THE MATTER IS URGENT, CLEARLY THE BEST MEANS OF SEEKING SOME COOPERATION FROM THE PGOI WOULD BE FOR THE SECRETARY TO RAISE IT WITH YAZDI WHEN HE SEES HIM ON OCTOBER 3. LAINGEN

BEGIN SUMMARY: RECENTLY POLOFF HAS HAD OPPORTUNITY TO DISCUSS REVOLUTIONARY JUSTICE WITH SEVERAL PEOPLE CLOSELY ASSOCIATED BY FAMILY AND WORK TIES TO AYATOLLAHS TALEGHANI AND KHOMEINI. WHILE THE DISCUSSIONS WERE HELD ON SEPARATE OCCASIONS, VIEWS EXPRESSED BY ALL SOURCES WERE SURPRISINGLY CONSISTENT. ACCORDING TO WHAT ALL "REVOLUTIONARIES" SAID, MERCY AND FORGIVENESS SEEM TO BE ALIEN CONCEPTS. FOR THESE SOURCES, ALLAH IS A MILITANT FIGURE, AND PUNISHMENT FOR THE "CORRUPT ON EARTH" SHOULSYPWY HIS MOTHER AND FATHER, AND THE FAMILY HAS MAINTAINED CLOSE TIES TO THE IMAM.

THE SOURCE CLAIMED HIS FATHER HAD SPENT LONG PERIODS OF TIME WITH THE IMAM DURING THE LATTER'S EXILE IN IRAQ, AND HAD JOINED KHOMEINI IN PARIS DURING HIS STAY THERE. THE SOURCE HIMSELF, A DOCTOR, HAS SEEN KHOMEINI IN PRIVATE GATHERINGS SEVERAL TIMES SINCE THE IMAM HAS BEEN IN QOM. DURING A LONG DISCUSSION ABOUT THE RECENT EXECUTIONS OF ALAM, KHAWJANURI AND MATBUI (REF A), THE DOCTOR WAS ADAMANT THAT ALL SUCH PEOPLE SHOULD BE EXECUTED. THE FACT THAT THEIR "CRIMES" MAY HAVE BEEN COMMITTED IN THE DISTANT PAST MADE NO DIFFERENCE.
THE AGE OF THE ACCUSED WAS ALSO OF NO IMPORTANCE, SINCE THEY HAD BEEN DECLARED ENEMIES OF GOD AND HAD TO BE DESTROYED.

POLOFF HAD HEARD RUMORS OF AT LEAST ONE DISTANT MEMBER OF KHOMEINI'S FAMILY BEING EXECUTED BY THE REVOLUTIONARY COURT, AND SOURCE CORROBORATED THE STORY. COL. ESHRAGHI, A POLICE/SAVAK OFFICER AND THE PATERNAL FIRST COUSIN OF KHOMEINI'S SON-IN-LAW, WAS EXECUTED DESPITE PERSONAL PLEAS FOR MERCY FROM THE IMAM'S SON-INLAW AND THE OFFICER'S WIFE. ACCORDING TO THE SOURCE, KHOMEINI HAS NEVER REGARDED HIS OWN RELATIVES WITH ANY SPECIAL FAVOR, BUT INSTEAD JUDGES THEM MORE HARSHLY THAN HE DOES OTHERS. HE HAS EVEN CUT HIMSELF OFF FROM MOST NORMAL FAMILY CONTACTS.

FOR EXAMPLE, THE IMAM HAS NOT SPOKEN TO ONE OF HIS OWN BROTHERS FOR MANY YEARS BECAUSE THE LATTER ACCEPTED A POSITION WITH THE MINISTRY OF JUSTICE DURING THIE PAHLAVI ERA. KHOMEINI HAS NEVER FORGIVEN HIS BROTHER FOR THIS.

THE SOURCE BECAME EMOTIONAL OVER OBJECTIONS TO THE SUMMARY JUSTICE TAKING PLACE IN IRAN, AND ESPECIALLY AT THE IDEA THAT THE USA WAS FINDING FAULT WITH IT. HE SAID THAT A NATION WHICH HAD SUPPORTED SAVAK ATROCITIES AND WHICH HAD MASSACRED SO MANY PEOPLE IN VIETNAM HAD NO RIGHT TO COMPLAIN ABOUT JUSTICE IN IRAN. ANY COMPLAINTS MADE BY US OFFICIALS WERE OBVIOUSLY ONLY ATTEMPTS TO SAVE AMERICAN HENCHMEN. THE DOCTOR ALSO SAID THAT MANY OF THE CRIMES COMMITTED BY THE ACCUSED WERE NOT BEING MADE PUBLIC, AND AS AN EXAMPLE MENTIONED THE KHALATBARI CASE.

THE EX-MFA HEAD HAD BEEN RESPONSIBLE, HE SAID, FOR INTRODUCING SAVAK AGENTS INTO THE RANKS OF THE IRANIAN DIPLOMATS, AND THIS IN ITSELF WAS A GOOD ENOUGH REASON TO EXECUTE HIM. ACCORDING TO THE SOURCE, MOREOVER, THERE WAS NO REASON TO MAKE COURT FINDINGS PUBLIC. THE DECISION OF "CORRUPTION" WAS QUITE ENOUGH IN ITSELF AND NO ONE HAD THE RIGHT TO QUESTION IT.

POLOFF HAS ALSO HAD SEVERAL LENGTHY DISCUSSIONS ABOUT REVOLUTIONARY JUSTICE WITH BOTH THE SON OF AND CLOSE ASSISTANT TO AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI. BOTH OF THESE SOURCES HAVE BEEN CONSISTENTLY ADAMANT IN THEIR SUPPORT OF THE EXECUTIONS THIS YEAR, THE LATTER TOOK SPECIAL PAINS NOT TO INTERFERE WHEN HIS OWN UNCLE WAS ARRESTED EARLY IN THE SPRING, AND CLAIMED TO POLOFF THAT IF HIS UNCLE WERE GUILTY, HE WOULD BE HAPPY OVER THE MAN'S EXECUTION.

(FORTUNATELY, THE UNCLE WAS FREED A SHORT TIME AGO.) IN ONE LONG DISCUSSION BETWEEN POLOFF AND FOUR OTHER MEMBERS OF THE TALEGHANI ENTOURAGE, TWO OF THE FEMALE PARTICIPANTS SHOWED A PARTICULARLY FERVENT BLOOD LUST AGAINST THE "CORRUPT ON EARTH", AS WELL AS AGAINST THE IMMEDIATE FAMILIES OF SUCH PEOPLE. IN A PARTICULARLY MEMORABLE DISCOURSE, THE TWO WOMEN CLAIMED THAT THE EXECUTIONS WERE NOT PROCEEDING FAST ENOUGH, AND WERE ALSO TOO LIMITED. THE WIVES AND CHILDREN OF THE ACCUSED SHOULD ALSO BE EXECUTED, THEY CLAIMED, SINCE FAMILY MEMBERS WERE WELL AWARE OF CRIMES AND ATROCITIES COMMITTED BY THEIR HUSBANDS/FATHERS.

BY REMAINING LOYAL TO SUCH PEOPLE, THE FAMILIES PROVED THAT THEY WERE "CORRUPT" AND AGAINST GOD; THEY SHOULD, THERE------------------121836 020700Z /10 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 4000 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 10510 FORE, BE EXECUTED. WHEN POLOFF ATTEMPTED TO DISCUSS THE KORAN'S VIEWS ON REPENTANCE AND MERCY, THE ANSWER WAS SIMPLE: BY REMAINING WITH THE SHAH'S GOVERNMENT ALL THE ACCUSED HAD SHOWN THAT THEY WERE UNREPENTANT. THEY HAD ALL BEEN GIVEN A CHOICE BY ALLAH AT THE BEGINNINGS OFQZJ THEIR CAREERS , AND HAD SHOWN THEMSELVES TO BE UNREPENTANT AND THUS FOREVER UNWORTHY.
SUCH PEOPLE COULD NOT BE ALLOWED TO LIVE, OR THEY WOULD REVERT TO CORRUPTION AT THE FIRST OPPORTUNITY.

WHILE A GREAT DEAL HAS BEEN SAID ABOUT GENERAL AMNESTIES IN IRAN, AND EVEN KHOMEINI'S SON HAS QUESTIONED REVOLUTIONARY JUSTICE, IT SEEMS THAT A SIGNIFICANT EXECUTION FERVOR STILL EXISTS AMONG PEOPLE CAPABLE OF CARRYING OUT THEIR BELIEFS. THE CONCEPT OF HUMAN RIGHTS, DEFENSE LAWYERS OR EVEN REPENTANCE ARE DISMISSED BY THIS GROUP AS SUMMARILY AS THEIR JUSTICE IS DISPENSED, AND NONE OF THE NORMAL WESTERN REASONINGS OR BELIEF IN JUDICIAL PROCESS SEEMS TO HAVE ANY EFFECT. THE ACCUSED ARE, IN THEIR EYES, ENEMIES OF ALLAH, AND ALL SUCH MUST BE DESTROYED WITHOUT COMPUNCTION.

FACED WITH THE EXECUTIONS SINCE FEBRUARY AND PERCEIVING THE DEPTH OF THIS FERVOR, OPPONENTS OF THE KHOMEINI REGIME WILL UNDOUBTEDLY REALIZE THEY MUST PLAY FOR KEEPS. IT IS POSSIBLE THAT THE CLASSIC PERSIAN POLITICAL COMPROMISE SYSTEM MAY SHATTER IN THE PROCESS. LAINGEN

1979TEHRAN10511.subject: REPRESENTATION ON EXECUTION OF THREE SENATORS

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

DURING SEPT 30 CALL ON MINISTER OF INTERIOR HASHEM SABAGHIAN, CHARGE REFERRED TO RECENT EXECUTIONS OF THE THREE AGED SENATORS. WITHOUT PRESUMING TO JUDGE INNOCENCE OR GUILT OF THESE MEN, CHARGE SAID THAT SUCH ACTIONS COULD ONLY COMPLICATE IRAN'S TASK OF STRENGTHENING THE POSITIVE ASPECTS OF ITS REVOLUTION. THE SUMMARY QUALITY OF THESE AND OTHER EXECUTIONS AND THE DEGREE OF VENGEANCE EVIDENT IN EXECUTING PERSONS WHO HAVE BEEN OUT OF ACTIVE POLITICAL LIFE FOR DECADES WILL DO LITTLE TO REASSURE THOSE WHO WISH TO SEE THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION SUCCEED IN ESTABLISHING FREEDOM AND STABILITY IN THE COUNTRY.

SABAGHIAN TOOK CAREFUL NOTES DURING CHARGE'S STATEMENT, AND IN REPLY ADMITTED THAT THE PROCESSES AND METHODS OF REVOLUTIONARY JUSTICE WERE NOT ALWAYS IN ACCORDANCE WITH ACCEPTED, INTERNATIONAL STANDARDS. HOWEVER, HE DEFENDED THOSE EXECUTIONS WHICH HAVE BEEN CARRIED OUT SO FAR AND SAID THAT ALL OF THOSE EXECUTED, INCLUDING THE THREE SENATORS, DESERVED EXECUTION. SENATOR MATBU'I, FOR EXAMPLE, HAD BEEN RESPONSIBLE FOR THE DEATH OF MANY PEOPLE IN MASHHAD. THE AUTHORITIES NOW FELT THEY HAD A RESPONSIBILITY TO THE DESCENDANTS OF THOSE KILLED BY MATBU'I'S ORDER.

IN REPLY TO THE QUESTION OF THE IMAM'S AMNESTY, SABAGHIAN SAID THAT ONE OF THE GROUPS EXCLUDED FROM THE AMNESTY WAS PERSONS WHO HAD ORDERED KILLINGS. SINCE MATBU'I WAS ONE OF THIS GROUP, THE IMAM'S AMNESTY DID NOT PREVENT HIS EXECUTION. SABAGHIAN NOTED THAT THE AMNESTY HAD BEEN APPLIED IN THE CASES OF DR. SHEIKHOLISLAMZADEH, FORMER MINISTER OF HEALTH, AND MR. KHOSHKISH, FORMER CHAIRMAN OF THE CENTRAL BANK. BOTH OF THESE PERSONS WERE SENTENCED TO PRISON TERMS INSTEAD OF EXECUTION BECAUSE THEIR CRIMES INVOLVED PROPERTY, NOT PERSONS.

SPEAKING ABOUT EXECUTIONS IN GENERAL, SABAGHIAN ADMITTED THAT THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS' EXECUTIONS HAVE CREATED A PROBLEM FOR IRAN IN WESTERN COUNTRIES. HE SAID, HOWEVER, THAT TWO IMPORTANT POINTS SHOULD BE KEPT IN MIND: - 1) THERE WERE EXTREMIST GROUPS AMONG THE SUPPORTERS OF THE REVOLUTION WHO WERE CRITICIZING THE AUTHORITIES FOR TOO GENEROUS APPLICATION OF MERCY. THESE GROUPS WERE DEMANDING MORE EXECUTIONS AND HARSHER SENTENCES FOR OFFENDERS. - 2) UNDER ISLAMIC LAW, CERTAIN CRIMES ARE EXPLICITLY PUNISHED BY DEATH. FOR EXAMPLE, RAPE OF A MARRIED WOMAN CARRIED AN AUTOMATIC DEATH PENALTY. THE WESTERN MEDIA WHICH CRITICIZE THE IRANIAN COURTS MAY FAIL TO UNDERSTAND THIS FEATURE OF ISLAMIC LAW.

COMMENT: ALTHOUGH SABAGHIAN ADMITTED DEFECTS IN THE PROCESS OF REVOLUTIONARY JUSTICE, HE WAS VEHEMENT IN HIS DEFENSENGF THE RESULTS. HE DID NOT BELIEVE THERE WAS ANYTHING WRONG IN THE GOVERNMENT'S EXECUTING WRONGDOERSIN REVENGE FOR CRIMES COMMITTED DECADES AGO. AT THE SAME TIME HE INDICATED THAT THERE IS PRESSURE ON THE AUTHORITIES TO DEAL EVEN MORE HARSHLY WITH OFFENDERS-PRESSURE THAT MAY BE DIFFICULT TO RESIST IN MANY CASES. IF HIS STATEMENTS ARE AN INDICATION, WE MAY EXPECT FURTHER TRIALS AND EXECUTIONS OF AGED SURVIVORS OF PREVIOUS
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

EMBASSY TEHRAN AGREES WITH DESCRIPTION BY OMANI MFA OFFICIAL REFTEL OF PLO/IRANIAN TIES. IRAN ENTHUSIASTICALLY AND UNRESERVEDLY SUPPORTS THE PALESTINIAN CAUSE.IRAN WILL NOT, HOWEVER, PERMIT ANY PLO INTERFERENCE IN INTERNAL IRANIAN POLITICS ESPECIALLY NOT IN KHUZESTAN.

WHILE PGOI OFFICIALS INCLUDING KHOMEINI CONTINUE TO DENOUNCE ISRAEL AND SUPPORT "PALESTINE", RELATIVELY LITTLE IS SAID ABOUT PLO ITSELF. EMBASSY HAS HEARD RUMORS, CHIEFLY FROM JEWISH COMMUNITY IN TEHRAN, OF UP TO 80 MILLION DOLLARS BEING TRANSFERRED THROUGH IRAN'S NATIONAL BANKING SYSTEM TO THE PLO. THE RUMORS ARE SO PERSISTENT THAT WE ASSUME SOME MONEY HAS BEEN SENT.

ACCORDING TO DIPLOMATIC SOURCES TEHRAN (JAPANESE AND AUSTRALIAN) PLO OFFICES IN AHWAZ AND KHORRAMSHAHR ARE NOT STAFFED ON PERMANENT BASIS AND MAY INDEED BE CLOSED. IN ADDITION, PLO HAS JUST MOVED OUT OF THE EXISRAELI EMBASSY IN TEHRAN TO OTHER QUARTERS AND JAPANESE SPECULATE THAT THEY MAY HAVE BEEN FORCED TO MOVE. AUSTRALIAN EMBASSY SOURCE DID NOT THINK MONEY WAS BEING TRANSFERRED BY IRAN TO PLO.
EMBASSY HAS NOT HEARD FROM SOURCES HERE OF RUMORED PLO REQUEST TO USE TUMBS AND ABU MUSA NOR DO WE HAVE ANY INDICATION THAT IRAN WOULD AGREE TO SUCH A REQUEST IF IT WERE MADE.
WE THINK IT WOULD BE MOST UNLIKELY PGOI WOULD PERMIT PLO TO USE THESE ISLANDS. LAINGEN

1979TEHRAN10528.subject: BILATERAL WITH IRANIAN FOREIGN MINISTER, OCTOBER 3

segments.text: OCTOBER 3 (CONFIDENTIAL-ENTIRE TEXT.)

YOU MEET WITH YAZDI AT A TIME THAT MAY MARK A SIGNIFICANT WATERSHED IN IRANIAN INTERNAL AFFAIRS. WHILE IT IS IMPORTANT FOR ANY OBSERVER TO AVOID HASTY JUDGMENTS ABOUT THIS PLACE, IT IS HARD TO AVOID THE CONCLUSION THAT THE CLERICS ARE NOW IN THE MOOD TO STEAMROLLER VIRTUALLY ANY AND ALL OPPOSITION TO THEIR DESIGNS FOR AN ESSENTIALLY THEOCRATIC STATE, WITH ISLAM AS THE IDEOLOGY AND THE ISLAMIC REPUBLICAN PARTY POSSIBLY PROVIDING CONTROLLING PARTY APPARATUS. ITEMS: - A. THE KURDISH "REBELLION" HAS BEEN PUT DOWN IN A - WAY INTENDED TO SERVE AN OBJECT LESSON FOR - OTHER MINORITIES. - B.

THE NATIONAL DEMOCRATIC FRONT AND ITS LEADERSHIP - HAVE BEEN BRANDED COUNTER-REVOLUTIONARIES AND - OTHER OPPOSITION ELEMENTS SIMILARLY WARNED. - C. A CLERIC-DOMINATED COUNCIL IS RAMRODDING THROUGH - A CONSTITUTIONAL REVIEW PROCESS THAT WOULD SEEM TO - INSTITUTIONALIZE AN IRON-CLAD SHIA ISLAMIC - CONTROL OF THE GOVERNMENTAL APPARATUS. - D. EXECUTIONS ARE CONTINUING, EVEN OF COMMON - CRIMINALS, DESPITE TALK OF AMNESTY. QUM SEEMS - DETERMINED TO AVOID ANY SHOW OF JUDICIAL MERCY - OR COMPASSION. - E. THE HEAD OF THE REVOLUTION-BORN PASDARANS - ("GUARDIANS OF THE REVOLUTION") HAS JUST TAKEN OVER - AS MINISTER OF DEFENSE. - F.

NAZEH'S OUSTER AT NIOC IS A FORCEFUL AND VERY - PUBLIC REMINDER TO THE SECULARISTS OF QUM'S - DETERMINATION TO PREVENT ANY LESSENING OF ITS - CONTROL OVER WHAT MATTERS, INCLUDING THE OIL - SECTOR. - G. A KIND OF PARANOIA PERSISTS OVER AN ALLEGED - CONSPIRACY BY THE WESTERN PRESS AGAINST THE - IRANIAN REVOLUTION. (THERE ARE NO AMERICAN - JOURNALISTS NOW RESIDENT HERE.) - H. THE U.S.

CONTINUES TO BE DENOUNCED BY KHOMEINI - AS MASSIVELY INVOLVED WITH INTERNATIONAL ZIONISM - IN FRUSTRATING THE HOPES OF THE PALESTINIANS; - INDEED KHOMEINI SEEMS TO SEE HIMSELF AND THE - REVOLUTION AS BECOMING THE REAL UNIFYING FORCE - THROUGHOUT THE AREA IN THE STRUGGLE FOR PALESTINIAN - RIGHTS.

THERE IS MORE, BUT THIS IS ENOUGH TO UNDERSCORE THE POINT THAT FOR THE MOMENT THE CLERICS ARE IN A FLOOD TIDE OF ASCENDANCY. THERE WOULD SEEM TO BE NOTHING THAT WILL PREVENT THEIR SOLIDIFYING THEIR POLITICAL CONTROL IN THE EVOLVING CONSTITUTIONAL STRUCTURE -- NOT THE MILITARY, NOT BAKHTIAR FROM PARIS, NOT POPULAR DISILLUSIONMENT OVER THE LACK OF MUCH BREAD AND BUTTER RETURNS FROM THE REVOLUTION, NOT BAZARGAN AND OTHER MODERATES IN THE PGOI. (BAZARGAN IS QUOTED IN AN INTERVIEW IN TODAY'S PRESS WITH ORIANA FALLACI AS SAYING "...
FROM AN OFFICIAL POINT OF VIEW THE GOVERNMENT RUNS THE COUNTRY BUT IN AN IDEOLOGICAL AND REVOLUTIONARY SENSE KHOMEINI AND HIS COUNCILS CONTROL." TRUE INDEED.)

WHAT COULD ARREST THE TREND PERHAPS, BUT ONLY WITH TIME, WOULD BE A GREATER APPRECIATION THAN NOW EXISTS OF THE PROBLEMS OF GOVERNING A PLURALISTIC BODY POLITIC AND A PARTIALLY MODERNIZED ECONOMY SUCH AS IRAN'S WITH RELIGIOUS PRECEPTS THAT SEEM TO PROVIDE SO LITTLE ROOM FOR PARTICIPATION BY THE SECULAR ELEMENTS OF THIS COUNTRY.

THE QUESTION IS WHETHER KHOMEINI APPRECIATES THIS AT ALL, AND THERE THE RETURNS ARE NOT ENCOURAGING. EVEN IF HE DOES THERE IS A REAL QUESTION WHETHER EVEN HE COULD PREVAIL AGAINST A SUBSTANTIAL TIDE NOW RUNNING AND AN ENTOURAGE IN QUM THAT BY ALL ACCOUNTS IS EVEN MORE OBDURATE THAN KHOMEINI. ------------------122793 010910Z /23 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 4014 USMISSION USUN NEW YORK IMMEDIATE SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 10528 EXDIS
THE EASY ANSWER IS THAT AN INEXORABLE PROCESS IS UNDERWAY THAT WILL SWEEP ASIDE THE MODERATE FORCES AND THAT WILL EVENTUALLY ALSO SEE BAZARGAN OUSTED, IN THE MANNER OF NAZEH AT NIOC.

I AM NOT SO SURE. I FIND MUCH LESS GROUND FOR OPTIMISM THAN A MONTH AGO, BUT KHOMEINI IS NO FOOL POLITICALLY AND MAY YET APPRECIATE THE NEED FOR SOME ACCOMMODATION TO THE MODERATES (WHICH BAZARGAN WEAKLY BUT STILL GAMELY REPRESENTS) TO ASSURE CONTINUED POLITICAL STABILITY AS HE SEEKS TO ASSURE WHAT MATTERS TO HIM, AND THAT IS PRIMACY OF ISLAM IN THE SOCIAL AND POLITICAL FABRIC OF FUTURE IRAN.

YOU MAY WISH TO PROBE WITH YAZDI HOW HE SEES FUTURE TRENDS IN THIS AREA. HE IS A DEEP BELIEVER, A REVOLUTIONARY WHO IS AS CLOSE AS ANY IN THE PGOI TO KHOMEINI BUT WHO MAY APPRECIATE THE NEED TO BALANCE HIS IDEALISM WITH REALISM. HE HAS SAID AS MUCH TO ME, AND I AM PREPARED TO BELIEVE HIM. YOUR CONVERSATION WITH HIM, THE FIRST HIGH LEVEL CONTACT WE HAVE HAD WITH THE REVOLUTIONARY LEADERSHIP, IS CRUCIAL TO OUR PURPOSES HERE.

IN AFFIRMING TO HIM THAT WE ACCEPT THE NEW REALITIES IN IRAN, AND INDEED THAT WE WISH IRAN WELL IN DEVELOPING ITS NEW INSTITUTIONS OF GOVERNMENT, YAZDI SHOULD ALSO KNOW THAT WE ARE TROUBLED BY A RIGIDITY AND AN ABSENCE OF A HUMAN FACE IN THE REVOLUTION THAT SEEMS TO LEAVE SO LITTLE SCOPE FOR THE RIGHTS OR INTERESTS OF MORE MODERATE ELEMENTS IN TODAY'S IRAN. KHOMEINI CARES LITTLE ABOUT IRAN'S IMAGE IN THE UNITED STATES BUT THERE ARE OTHERS, LIKE YAZDI, WHO DO.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

DURING SEPT 30 CALL BY CHARGE AND EMBASSY POLITICAL OFFICER, MINISTRY OF INTERIOR SABBAGHIAN DISCUSSED SCHEDULED LOCAL AND NATIONAL ELECTIONS. SABAGHIAN SAID THAT FIRST STEP WOULD BE ELECTIONS FOR COUNCILS IN 150 MUNICIPALITIES ON OCTOBER 12 AND 13. ELECTIONS IN TEHRAN AND THE MAJOR PROVINCIAL CITIES OF MASHHAD, TABRIZ, SHIRAZ, ESFAHAN, AND AHWAZ WOULD BE HELD LATER.

MUNICIPAL COUNCIL ELECTIONS WILL BE FOLLOWED BY A REFERENDUM ON THE NEW CONSTITUTION, BY PRESIDENTIAL ELECTIONS, AND THEN BY ELECTIONS FOR A NATIONAL ASSEMBLY. ALL OF THESE ELECTIONS SABAGHIAN HOPED WOULD BE COMPLETED BY THE END OF THE IRANIAN YEAR (MARCH, 1980). HE ADDED THAT THE VILLAGE AND DISTRICT (BAKHSH) ELECTIONS WOULD PROBABLY BE THE LAST TO BE HELD, SINCE THE MINISTRY OF INTERIOR'S APPARATUS WAS WEAKEST AT THOSE LEVELS. (FYI: IN A SEPARATE INTERVIEW PUBLISHED IN SEPT 30 TEHRAN TIMES, SABAGHIAN SAID THAT THE ASSEMBLY OF EXPERTS SHOULD COMPLETE THEIR WORK BY OCTOBER 23 AND THAT THE REFERENDUM COULD BE HELD AT THE END OF NOVEMBER. END FYI).

ASKED ABOUT THE DATE FOR MUNICIPAL COUNCIL ELECTIONS IN THE MAJOR CITIES SABAGHIAN ESTIMATED THAT THESE ELECTIONS WOULD BE HELD ABOUT TWO WEEKS AFTER THE OCTOBER 12/13 ELECTIONS AND BEFORE THE REFERENDUM ON THE NEW CONSTITUTION.

SABAGHIAN SAID THAT HE HOPED THESE ELECTIONS WOULD PROVIDE PRACTICAL DEMONSTRATION OF THE NEW IRANIAN REGIME'S DETERMINATION TO ESTABLISH ISLAMIC AND DEMOCRATIC PRINCIPLES IN THE COUNTRY. HE SAID THAT THESE ELECTIONS WOULD ESTABLISH A PERMANENT GOVERNMENT STRUCTURE WHICH SHOULD HELP TO ALLEVIATE SOME OF THE ABUSES CAUSED BY THE WEAKNESS OF THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT. COMMENT: WE WISH WE COULD BELIEVE THIS. LAINGEN

ALL PAPERS OF OCTOBER 1 GAVE PROMINENT COVERAGE TO CHARGE'S MEETING WITH MINISTER OF INTERIOR SABAGHIAN. UNDER HEADLINES SUCH AS "U.S. CHARGE CRITICIZES RECENT EXECUTIONS", PAPERS QUOTED SABAGHIAN AS FOLLOWS: "THE AMERICAN CHARGE SAID THAT THE U.S. HONORS IRAN'S INDEPENDENCE AND NATIONAL INTEGRITY. HE ALSO CRITICIZED RECENT EXECUTIONS AFTER THE IMAM'S AMNESTY ORDER, ESPECIALLY THOSE OF THE THREE SENATORS, ON GROUNDS OF THEIR AGE. I REPLIED THAT THE VERDICT OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS CONFORMED TO REALITY. FURTHERMORE, SINCE WE CONSIDER ISLAMIC LAWS MORE PROGRESSIVE THAN HUMAN RIGHTS LEGISLATION, IT IS OF NO CONSEQUENCE TO US WHAT HUMAN RIGHTS SAY ABOUT THIS."

PERSIAN-LANGUAGE JUMHURI-YE-ISLAMI OF OCTOBER 1 CARRIED INTERVIEW WITH DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER TABATABA'I, WHO WAS ASKED FOR HIS OPINION ABOUT CHARGE'S COMMENTS. TABATABA'I SAID, "WHILE EVEN OUR OWN GOVERNMENT HAS NO BUSINESS INTERFERING IN THE AFFAIRS OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS, I CONSIDER THE CHARGE'S COMMENTS ON THE COURT'S ACTIONS TO BE UNDUE MEDDLING IN OUR AFFAIRS. THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS HAVE THEIR OWN ORGANIZATION AND ACT ACCORDING TO THE LAWS OF ISLAM. NO AUTHORITY IS PERMITTED TO INTERFERE IN THEIR AFFAIRS."
SAME NEWSPAPER CARRIED VIOLENTLY ANTI-U.S. EDITORIAL ENTITLED "WHAT AMERICANS SHOULD KNOW." TEXT OF THIS EDITORIAL WILL BE TRANSMITTED SEPTEL.

PERSIAN-LANGUAGE RADIO NEWS OF 1400 LOCAL TIME CARRIED INTERVIEW WITH SABAGHIAN IN WHICH HE GAVE HIS VERSION OF HIS MEETING. IN HIS STATEMENT, SABAGHIAN EMPHASIZED TWO POINTS. - (A) HIS (SABAGHIAN'S)MEETING WITH THE CHARGE HAD BEEN ARRANGED WITH THECONCURRENCE OF THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS, WHICH AGREED THAT THE MINISTRY OF INTERIOR WAS THE APPROPRIATE PLACE TO DISCUSS INTERNAL AFFAIRS. - (B) THE MATTER OF THE EXECUTION WAS ONLY ONE OF MANY MATTERS DISCUSSED. THE CHARGE PREFACED HIS REMARKS ON THE EXECUTIONS BY THE ADMISSION "THIS IS NONE OF MY BUSINESS, BUT..." AND PHRASED THE ENTIRE ISSUE IN THE FORM OF A QUESTION. (SEE REFTEL FOR EMBASSY ACCOUNT OF CONVERSATION).

FOLLOWING SABAGHIAN INTERVIEW, RADIO IRAN BROADCAST CRITICAL COMMENT WHICH REPEATED MANY STATEMENTS OF JUMHURI-YE-ISLAMI EDITORIAL. RADIO COMMENTARY ALSO ASKS THE MINISTER OF INTERIOR WHY HE EVEN BOTHERED TO LISTEN TO SUCH NONSENSE AND WHY HE SHOULD REPEAT IT TO REPORTERS. IT ALSO ASKS SABAGHIAN WHY HE WOULD EVEN TRY TO JUSTIFY IRANIAN ACTIONS TO THE CHARGE.
COMMENT TO FOLLOW BY SEPTEL. LAINGEN

1979TEHRAN10566.subject: ALLEGED DESTRUCTION OF BAHA'I SHRINE IN SHIRAZ

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

PETROLEUM OFFICER, DURING TRIP TO SHIRAZ ON OTHER BUSINESS, VISITED SITE OF BAHA'I SHRINE (HOUSE OF BAB). HE WAS ACCOMPANIED BY MR. AZUDI, GUARD AT CONSULATE SHIRAZ PREMISES, WHO IS PERSONAL FRIEND OF MEMBER OF BAHA'I GROUP. FRIEND HAD KEYS TO HOUSE AND ESCORTED PETOFF DURING VISIT.
HOUSE IS GUARDED BY TWO ARMED MEMBERS OF REGULAR POLICE FORCE. THEY WERE FRIENDLY, DID NOT OBJECT TO PHOTOGRAPHY, AND DID NOT LEAVE THEIR STATIONS DURING VISIT.

EMBOFF NOTED THAT CONSIDERABLE DAMAGE HAD BEEN DONE TO HOUSE, WHICH HAD CONSISTED OF COURTYARD WITH GARDEN, SURROUNDED BY TWO-STORY HOUSE. STRUCTURAL WALLS ARE STILL STANDING, ALTHOUGH DECORATION AND PLASTERING HAS BEEN DESTROYED, APPARENTLY HAVING BEEN ATTACKED FOR SEVERAL HOURS BY A LARGE NUMBER OF PERSONS USING HAMMERS AND OTHER HAND TOOLS. THE CEILING AND MANY DIVIDING WALLS HAVE BEEN DESTROYED, FALLING IN A HEAP OF RUBBLE ONTO THE FLOOR. THE ENTIRE HOUSE IS STREWN WITH BROKEN BRICKS AND WOODWORK. STAIRWAY REMAINS STANDING, AND EMBOFF WAS ABLE TO CLIMB TO REMAINS OF ROOF AND TAKE EXTENSIVE PHOTOGRAPHS, WHICH EMBASSY IS NOW HAVING DEVELOPED.

COMMENT: THE HOUSE IS MADE TO LOOK LIKE A DISASTER AREA BY THE RUBBLE STREWN EVERYWHERE. HOUSE HAS NOT, HOWEVER, BEEN TOTALLY DESTROYED. ONCE RUBBLE IS CLEARED AWAY, THE WORK REQUIRED FOR RECONSTRUCTION (MASONRY, CARPENTRY, PLASTERING, ROOFING) WILL BE OBVIOUS AND FAR FROM OVERWHELMING. CONDITION OF HOUSE IS CONSISTENT WITH CLAIM OF BAHAI'S THAT LARGE NUMBER OF LOCAL PEOPLE WERE INCITED BY RELIGIOUS RHETORIC TO ADVANCE ON HOUSE AND ATTEMPT TO DEMOLISH IT. EASE WITH WHICH EMBOFF WAS ABLE TO GAIN ACCESS TO PREMISES AND APPARENT FREEDOM OF BAHA'I MEMBERS TO ATTEND TO SITE SUGGESTS THAT SECURITY SITUATION FOR BAHA'IS AROUND HOUSE HAS IMPROVED.

GOI HAS BEEN GIVING EXTENSIVE AND DETAILED PUBLICITY TO ITS RECONSTRUCTION CRUSADE, WHICH STARTED WITH A PUBLIC APPEAL BY KHOMEINY THREE MONTHS AGO. LAST YEAR, PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN IN A MESSAGE TO THE PARTICIPANTS, MADE THE FOLLOWING POINTS
ALL GOVERNMENT AGENCIES AND THE ARMED FORCES HAVE BEEN ASKED TO COOPERATE WITH THE CRUSADE, TO PROVIDE PERSONNEL AND EQUIPMENT, AND TO RELEASE VOLUNTEERS FOR THIS SERVICE.
FUNDING INCLUDES AN APPROPRIATION OF 4.8 BILLION RIALS (200 MILLION PER PROVINCE), AND A 5 BILLION RIAL CREDIT FOR EMERGENCY WORK IN RURAL AREAS, AND POPULAR CONTRIBUTIONS TOTALLING 30 MILLION RIALS.
AN ORGANIZATION HAS BEEN ESTABLISHED, WITH APPROPRIATE REGULATIONS, AND A MAGAZINE IS TO BE PUBLISHED.
"THOUSANDS" OF STUDENTS AND NON-STUDENTS HAVE ALREADY BEEN SENT TO RURAL AREAS.
ADDITIONALLY, NOTED BAZARGAN

"HUNDREDS" OF KILOMETERS OF RURAL ROADS, "NUMEROUS" BRIDGES, RESERVOIRS, PUBLIC BATHS, SCHOOLS, CLINICS AND MOSQUES HHVE BEEN CONSTRUCTED, WELLS DUG, DAMS ERECTED, WATER PIPELINES LAID, AND POWER STATIONS INSTALLED.
"HUNDREDS" OF IRRIGATION CANALS IN SISTAN, BALUCHISTAN, KERMAN AND ISFAHAN HAVE BEEN COMPLETED.
"HUNDREDS" OF TONS OF FOODSTUFFS HAVE BEEN SENT TO DEPRIVED OR WAR-TORN AREAS, ALONG WITH MEDICAL AND DENTAL TEAMS, SMALL LIBRARIES, FILMS, FERTILIZERS AND PESTICIDES.
ACCORDING TO RECENT PLANS, DRUG ADDICTION IS TO BE COMBATTED, VILLAGERS ARE TO BE VACCINATED AND THEIR WATER CHLORINATED.
CLASSES IN HYGIENE, ISLAM, GENERAL LITERACY AND VOCATIONAL TRAINING HAVE BEGUN.
RESEARCH IS UNDERWAY TO IDENTIFY RURAL NEEDS, AND PRIORITIES.

SUBSEQUENTLY, THE GOVERNOR-GENERAL OF TEHRAN PROVINCE ANNOUNCED THAT HIS PROVINCE'S SHARE OF THE 4.8 BILLION RIAL FUND, OR 200 MILLION RIALS, HAD ALREADY BEEN ALLOCATED TO VARIOUS PROJECTS. ADDITIONALLY, A FURTHER SUM OF 4 BILLION RIALS (PRESUMABLY OUT OF THE 5 BILLION RIAL CREDIT) HAD BEEN PLACED AT HIS DISPOSAL. 4-4.8 BILLION RIALS BEING ROUGHLY EQUIVALENT TO A DAY'S OIL REVENUE, BAZARGAN AND GOVERNOR-GENERAL SAMIIE EACH HAS IDENTIFIED HIS SLICE, THE 4.8 BILLION FUND TO BE SPEND NATIONALLY, INCLUDING TEHRAN PROVINCE, AND THE 4.0 BILLION CREDIT ALLOCATED ONLY TO TEHRAN, AS THE EQUIVALENT TO THAT ONE DAY'S REVENUE.

COMMENT. NO NEWSPAPER HAS PICKED UP THIS APPARENT DOUBLE COUNTING. NOR HAS IT BEEN EXPLAINED HOW, IF FUNDS HAVE ONLY JUST BEEN ALLOCATED TO THE CRUSADE, SO MUCH HAD ALREADY BEEN ACCOMPLISHED. TDY ECONOFF IS CALLING ON DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER BANI-ASSADI (REF A) LATER IN THE WEEK TO
(C-ENTIRE TEXT)

PAN AM MNAGER TEHRAN REPORTED TO EMBASSY THAT PAA AIRPORT RESERVATIONS CLERK RECEIVED TELEPHONE CALL THIS MORNING FROM APPARENT NATIVE FARSI SPEAKER WHO SAID THAT PAA PLANE WOULD BE HIJACKED THIS EVENING. PAA HAS NO FLIGHTS TODAY. NEXT FLIGHT INTO TEHRAN SCHEDULED FOR WEDNESDAY EVENING, OCTOBER 3.

PAA PASSED ON INFORMATION TO IRANIAN CIVIL AVIATION AUTHORITIES. CIVIL AVIATION HAS IN TURN INFORMED IRAN AIR AND IRAN AIR HAS INSTRUCTED ITS SECURITY SKY MARSHALLS AT MEHRABAD AIRPORT TO BE ESPECIALLY WATCHFUL FOR PAN AM FLIGHT TOMORROW. WALK-THRU METAL DETECTORS AT MEHRABAD ARE INOPERATIVE.

PAA MANAGER TEHRAN HAS ALSO SENT TELEX TO NEW YORK OFFICE. WE UNDERSTAND PAA STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURE WILL BE FOLLOWED AND PAA WILL BE ESPECIALLY VIGILANT ON FLIGHTS IN MIDDLE EAST/SOUTH ASIA AREA FOR NEXT FEW
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

INCIDENTS OF SHOOTING AND GRENADE THROWING BY KURDISH REBELS HAVE CONTINUED OVER LAST WEEK THROUGHOUT THE KURDISH AREAS. BY PRESS ACCOUNTS MOST TROUBLE HAS CENTERED IN THE MAHABAD AREA BUT ATTACKS ON POLICE, PASDARAN AND ARMY PERSONNEL HAVE TAKEN PLACE IN MARIVAN, SARDASHT, THE KERMANSHAH-PAVEH ROAD (4 KILLED) AND MAHABAD-MIANDOAB ROAD AMONG OTHERS.

ALTHOUGH EMBASSY DOUBTS THESE INCIDENTS ARE BEING COORDINATED IN ANY MEANINGFUL WAY BY KDP, THE COMMANDER OF THE KERMANSHAH GENDARMERIE IN AN INTERVIEW WITH TEHRAN TIMES SEPT 25 CHARGED THAT KDP TEAMS OF 2-3 MEMBERS WERE ATTACKING GOVERNMENT TROOPS AND INSTALLATIONS ALONG THE BORDER APPARENTLY FAIRLY REGULARLY DURING THE NIGHT HOURS. ON OCTOBER 1, REBELS APPARENTLY SET FIRE TO THE POWERSTATION AT KARAND NEAR KERMANSHAH KNOCKING OUT TELEPHONE LINES IN THE SURROUNDING AREAS OF KERMANSHAH, KARAND, SAR-E-POL-E-ZOHAB, AND GHASRESHIRIN. PASDARAN SPOKESMAN IN MAHABAD ALSO TOLD TEHRAN TIMES SEPTEMBER 29 THAT BEFORE THE START OF NIGHTLY CLASHES WITH THE KDP REBELS THE POWER SUPPLY TO THE CITY WAS CUT.

HOWEVER, THE NEXT DAY SEPTEMBER 30 BOTH THE ACTING GOVERNOR AT MAHABAD AND THE PASDARAN HEADQUARTERS SAID THERE HAD BEEN NO INCIDENTS FOR 48 HOURS AND SCHOOLS CLOSED THE PREVIOUS WEEK HAD BEEN REOPENED.

UNREST IN KURDISH AREAS LED ISLAMIC JUDGE KHALKHALI SEPT 26 TO BAN ALL DEMONSTRATIONS IN "SUPPORT OF KDP" IN MAHABAD, SAQQEZ, BUKAN, BANEH AND SARDASHT. (VARIOUS SMALL DEMONSTRATIONS, SOME AGAINST EXECUTIONS OR PASDARAN, HAD TAKEN PLACE.) A SIMILAR EDICT WAS ISSUED BY THE REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS IN SANANDAJ. IN ADDITION KHALKHALI ON SEPTEMBER 28 SENTENCED FOUR KURDS TO EXECUTION IN MAHABAD, THE FIRST SUCH EXECUTIONS IN MAHABAD SINCE ITS CAPTURE BY THE PGOI FORCES 4 WEEKS AGO.

IN AN INTERESTING INTERVIEW IN KAYHAN SEPTEMBER 30, REVOLUTIONARY JUDGE KHALKHALI DENIED THAT IRAQI KURDISH LEADER JALAL TALEBANI HAD ANYTHING TO DO WITH THE REVOLT SAYING THAT WHILE SOME KDP PRISONERS CLAIMED TO BE TALEBANI MEN, "THERE ARE MANY SUCH CONSPIRACIES WITH KDP OR FADAYAN MEMBERS OR ZIONIST AGENTS CLAIMING TO BE TALEBANI'S MEN IN ORDER TO SPOIL RELATIONS BETWEEN IRAN AND TALEBANI."IN THE SAME INTERVIEW, KHALKHALI ALSO DENIED RUMORS THAT EITHER ARDESHIR ZAHEDI OR AZZIZOLLAH PALIZBAN WERE IN KURDESTAN.

THE PGOI HAS BEEN DEALING VERY CAREFULLY WITH IRAQ AND ANNOUNCED SEPTEMBER 30 THAT A JOINT IRAQ-IRAN COMMISSION WILL BEGIN WORK SOON TO ASSESS DAMAGES CAUSED TO IRANIAN BORDER VILLAGES BY IRAQI PLANES ON JUNE 4. WEST AZERBAJAN GOVERNOR HAQQOU SAID HE HAD ARRANGED THESE TALKS WITH THE GOVERNOR GENERAL OF SULEIMANIEH, IRAQ WHO HAD STATED IRAQI WILLINGNESS TO COMPENSATE IRAN FOR THE DAMAGE. ACCORDING TO KAYHAN 80 IRAQI KURDS WHO TOOK REFUGE IN IRAN HAVE RETURNED TO IRAQ FOLLOWING THE IRAQI GENERAL AMNESTY.

COMMENT: THUS FAR THE PGOI SEEMS TO BE DEALING WITH THE CONTINUING KURDISH REBEL ATTACKS ON A CASE BY CASE BASIS WITHOUT CALLING FOR STRONGER MEASURES BY THE AIR FORCE OR ARMY. ACCORDING TO KERMANSHAH GOVERNOR GENERAL SEPEHRIPOUR, HOWEVER, THE REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS HAVE BEEN GIVEN A BUDGET BY THE PGOI TO ALLOW THEM TO STAY IN KURDESTAN AND BUILD UP THEIR FORCES. THERE IS OBVIOUSLY A GROWING IMPATIENCE AMONG THE GUARDS OF THE GOVERNMENT'S STATIC ROLE IN KURDESTAN.

1979TEHRAN10616.subject: CHARGE'S MEETING WITH DEP PRIM MIN TABATABAI

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: CHARGE HAD A MEETING WITH DEP PRIM MIN TABATABAI ON OCT 2 TO EXPRESS HIS CONCERN THAT PUBLIC MEDIA AND PGOI SPOKESMEN CONTINUED TO FEED NOTION THAT THE USA WAS HOSTILE TO THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION. TABATABAI ASSURED CHARGE THAT THE JUMHURI-YE-ISLAMI EDITORIAL ATTACKING THE USA FOR CHARGE'S ALLEDGED "MEDDLING" OVER EXECUTIONS REFLECTED NEITHER OFFICIAL PGOI NOR KHOMEINI'S VIEWS. END SUMMARY.

CHARGE MET WITH DEP PRIM MIN AND GOVERNMENT SPOKESMAN TABATABAI ON OCTOBER 2 TO DISCUSS INTER ALIA, THE JUMHURI-YE-ISLAMI EDITORIAL (REFTEL) WHICH HAD ACCUSED THE USA OF INTERFERING IN IRAN'S INTERNAL AFFAIRS. IN ANSWER TO CHARGE'S QUESTION AS TO WHETHER THE JUMHURI-YEISLAMI NEWSPAPER REFLECTED EITHER THE PGOI OR QOM'S VIEWS VIS-A-VIS THE USA, TABATABAI EMPHASIZED THAT THIS WAS DEFINITELY NOT RPT NOT SO. HE SAID THAT THE PAPER WAS NOT EXPRESSING THE VIEWS OF EITHER THE PGOI, THE REVOLUTION'S LEADER IMAM KHOMEINI, OR ALL THE PEOPLE OF IRAN.

THE PAPER DID, HOWEVER, REFLECT SENTIMENTS HELD BY "SOME RELIGIOUS LEADERS AND SOME OF THE PEOPLE." TABATABAI SAID THAT JUMHURI-YE-ISLAMI WAS ONE OF THE PGOI'S WORST CRITICS, AND HAD FREQUENTLY ACCUSED FONMIN YAZDI AND NIRT HEAD GHOBTZADEH OF BEING AMERICANS. THE PAPER HAD ALSO ACCUSED THE PGOI OF BEING TOO PRO-WEST. TABATABAI SAID THAT WHEN HE READ THE EDITORIAL, HE HIMSELF HAD BEEN UPSET AT THE ATTACK ON BOTH THE US GOVERNMENT AND ON CHARGE.

TABATABAI CLAIMED THAT A RECENT ENGLISH LANGUAGE PAPER VERSION OF REMARKS BY HIM SUGGESTING THAT THE USA IS IRAN'S NUMBER ONE ENEMY HAD NOT BEEN AT ALL ACCURATE. WHAT HE HAD ACTUALLY SAID WAS THAT "IT IS A MISTAKE TO THINK OF THE USA AS OUR NUMBER ONE ENEMY. OUR MAIN ENEMY IS ISRAEL (AND ZIONISM) WHICH SEES ITS EXISTENCE THREATENED BY THE ESTABLISHMENT OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN." WHEN CHARGE ASKED WRYLY WHETHER THIS MEANT THE PGOI NOW SAW THE USA AS ITS SECOND MAJOR ENEMY, TABATABAI SAID THIS WAS BY NO MEANS THE CASE.
THE NUMBER TWO SPOT, HE CLAIMED, WAS HELD BY THE SOVIET UNION AS FAR AS HE WAS CONCERNED. HE ADDED THAT THE SOVIET AMBASSADOR HAD EVEN PAID A VISIT TO PROTEST RECENT ANTI-SOVIET STATEMENTS.

COMMENTING FURTHER, TABATABAI SAID THAT HE HIMSELF SAW RELIGIOUS AND LEFTIST FANATICISM AS THE CHIEF DANGER TO THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION. HE CLAIMED THAT THE NEWSPAPER JUMHURI-YE-ISLAMI WAS AGOOD EXAMPLE OF THIS SORT OF FANATICISM.

COMMENT: IN GENERAL, THE TONE OF THE MEETING WAS WARM AND FRIENDLY, WITH TABATABAI DOING HIS BEST TO BE CONCILIATORY. CERTAINLY THERE IS NO ANTI-AMERICANISM EVIDENT IN HIS OWN OFFICE. TABATABAI'S STAFF-AIDE ESCORTED CHARGE DOWN TO THE LOBBY AND TOOK THE OPPORTUNITY TO ASK FOR HELP WITH A NEPHEW'S STUDENT VISA. FYI: PRESS ATTENTION TO CHARGE-SABAGHIAN EXCHANGE WAS VERY LIGHT OCTOBER 2. ENGLISH LANGUAGE TEHRAN TIMES AND KAYHAN INTERNATIONAL CARRIED TABATABAI'S STATEMENTS (REFTEL) TO PRESS AND ALSO QUOTED TEHRAN RADIO OCT 1 AS CRITICIZING SABAGHIAN FOR EVEN OFFERING AN EXPLANATION TO CHARGE'S COMMENTS. FARSI PRESS OCTOBER 2 DID NOT MENTION THE SABAGHIAN-CHARGE
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: A GROWING NUMBER OF DEMONSTRATIONS AND PROTESTS BY THE UNEMPLOYED HAS SWEPT IRAN IN THE LAST TWO WEEKS, AND THE SERIOUS NATURE OF THE PROTESTS MAY BE THE MAJOR REASON FOR A REPORTED BAN ON UNAUTHORIZED PROTESTS AND GATHERINGS. ACTS OF TERRORISM AND SABOTAGE ALSO CONTINUE, WITH KHUZESTAN AND THE KURDISH AREAS BEING THE MAIN AREAS OF UNREST. THE CITY OF MASHAD HAS WITNESSED TWO RECENT ASSASSINATIONS, BOTH VICTIMS BEING CLERGYMEN. IN SISTAN AND BALUCHISTAN, A SECURITY PROBLEM BETWEEN TRIBES PEOPLE AND GOVERNMENT FORCES SEEMS TO HAVE BEEN DEFUSED BY TRIBAL LEADERS AND THE LOCAL GOVERNOR GENERAL.
ACROSS THE COUNTRY THERE IS A GROWING EFFORT BY CITIES TO BRING UNRULY COMMITTEES UNDER CONTROL. END SUMMARY.

THE IRANIAN POLITICAL SCENCE HAS BEEN DOMINATED DURING THE PAST WEEK BY MAJOR CABINET RESHUFFLING, THE CONTINUATION OF THE ASSEMBLY OF EXPERTS WORK ON A NEW CONSTITUTION, AND THE APPARENTLY QOM INSPIRED CRITICISM OF NATIONAL IRANIAN OIL CO. HEAD HASSAN NAZIH WHICH RESULTED IN HIS DEPARTURE FROM THE NIOC AND DISAPPEARANCE, RUMORS SAY PERHAPS TO PARIS.

ACCORDING TO DEP PRIM MIN TABATABAI, THE GOVERNMENT HAS BANNED ALL UNAUTHORIZED RALLIES, DEMONSTRATIONS, GATHERINGS AND MARCHES WITH A WARNING THAT THOSE WHO PERSIST IN THESE PROTESTS WILL BE DEALT WITH HARSHLY. THE BAN IS PROBABLY A RESULT OF THE GROWING COMPLAINTS AND DEMONSTRATIONS FROM THE RANKS OF THE UNEMPLOYED BEING SEEN ACROSS IRAN. ONE OF THE MOST TELLING INDICATIONS OF THE SEVERITY OF THE PROBLEM WAS THE SIZE OF A CROWD WHICH JAMMED THE AREA NEAR TEHRAN'S IRAN AIR OFFICES ON SEPTEMBER 23. PARS NEWS SERVICE CLAIMED THAT "THOUSANDS" OF PEOPLE CAUSED A MAJOR TRAFFIC SNARL, NECESSITATING THE USE OF POLICE CARS AND HELICOPTERS TO DISPERSE THE CROWD.

THE THRONG HAD GATHERED AROUND THE IRAN AIR BUILDING TO APPLY FOR THE TWENTY AIR STEWARD JOBS ADVERTISED AS VACANT BY THE NATIONAL AIRLINES. IN THE CASPIAN COAST TOWN OF BABOL, THREE HUNDRED RECENTLY GRADUATED TEACHERS ENGAGED IN A SIT-IN AT THE CITY'S EDUCATION DEPARTMENT TO DEMAND JOBS, AND A SIMILAR INCIDENT OCCURRED IN THE NEARBY CITY OF SARI. AT NOWSHAHR AND LANGRUD, 1200 HIGH SCHOOL GRADUATES DEMONSTRATED TO ATTRACT ATTENTION TO THEIR LACK OF JOBS, AS DID 200 EX-STUDENTS AT BABAK (NEAR KERMAN).

ONE HUNDRED FIFTY HIGH SCHOOL GRADUATES AT SIYAHKAL GATHERED IN FRONT OF THE EDUCATION OFFICE, DISMISSED THE BUILDINGS STAFF, AND BEGAN A SIT-IN FOR THE SAME REASONS. ON SEPT 25 "HUNDREDS"OF UNEMPLOYED YOUTHS GATHERED IN FRONT OF THE PRIME MINISTRY TO DRAW ATTENTION TO THE PLIGHT OF JOBLESS RECENT GRADUATES, A GROUP THEY ESTIMATE AS 210,000 STRONG. ANOTHER CROWD OF 350 DEMONSTRATED AT THE MINISTRY OF LABOR ON SEPTEMBER 26. THE DEMONSTRATIONS AT THE PRIME MINISTRY CONTINUED DURING THE WEEK, GROWING TO A CROWD ESTIMATED AS 1200, AND RESULTING IN THE REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS DISPERSING THE CROWD WITH SHOTS IN THE AIR AND THE ARREST OF SIX DEMONSTRATORS ON OCTOBER 1.

DEMONSTRATIONS AT THE PRIME MINISTRY BECAME TENSE. REPORTEDLY SOME OF THE DEMONSTRATORS WERE SHOUTING "DOWN WITH KHOMEINI". WITH VACANCIES MINIMAL IN PRIVATE INDUSTRY, WITH THE IRANIAN UNIVERSITY SYSTEM ABLE TO ABSORB ONLY A SMALL PERCENTAGE OF APPLICANTS FOR HIGHER EDUCATION, AND WITH MILITARY SERVICE PROCEDURES STILL BEING SOMEWHAT CONFUSED, THERE SEEMS TO BE NO QUICK SOLUTION FOR THE UNEMPLOYMENT PROBLEM.

DURING THE MONTHS SINCE THE REVOLUTION, THE COMMITTEE SYSTEM HAS COME IN FOR A GREAT DEAL OF CRITICISM, WITH COMMITTEE BANDS BEING POPULARLY ACCUSED OF CRIMES RANGING FROM THEFT TO TORTURE TO ILLEGAL ARRESTS. ON SEPT 11, KHOMEINI ORDERED REVOLUTIONARY ORGANIZATIONS NOT TO ACT ON THEIR OWN IN GOVERNMENT AFFAIRS. SOME EXAMPLES HAVE APPEARED RECENTLY, ESPECIALLY IN TABRIZ OF COMMITTEE MEMBERS BEING ARRESTED AND TRIED FOR ANTI-REVOLUTIONARY ACTS. IN TEHRAN, AYATOLLAH MOHAMMED REZA MAHDAVI-KANI, NATIONAL DIRECTOR OF IRAN'S REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES, HAS ANNOUNCED THAT ALL OF TEHRAN'S REVOLUTIONARY SUBCOMMITTEES ARE DISSOLVED.

AT PRESENT, TEHRAN HAS A REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE FOR EACH OF ITS 14 DISTRICTS, AND ONE ESTIMATE OF THE SUB-COMMITTEES HAS BEEN GIVEN AS 1,200. ACCORDING TO MAHDAVI-KANI, THE MEMBERSHIP OF THE 14 DISTRICT COMMITTEES WILL BE STRICTLY CONTROLLED, AND ANYONE WITH A QUESTIONABLE RECORD WILL BE PURGED.

ACTS OF SABOTAGE AND TERRORISM CONTINUED THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY LATE SEPTEMBER AND EARLY OCTOBER. SEVERAL SHOPS WERE DAMAGED WHEN AN EXPLOSION SHOOK THE BAZAAR AT KHORRAMSHAHR, ALTHOUGH NO INJURIES HAVE BEEN REPORTED. A 70 METER COMMUNICATIONS TOWER ON THE KHORRAMSHAHR-AHWAZ ROAD WAS BLOWN UP ON SEPTEMBER 30, AND COMMUNICATIONS MINISTER HASSAN ESLAMI CLAIMED THE EXPLOSION WAS CAUSED BY A TIME BOMB. THE TOWER FELL ACROSS AN ADJACENT RELAY STATION, DAMAGING THAT BUILDING, AND CAUSING A CUT OFF IN COMMUNICATIONS BETWEEN THE MAIN CITIES OF THE OIL PROVINCE AND THE REST OF IRAN. ON SEPTEMBER 30 ANOTHER EXPLOSION OCCURRED NEAR THE KHORRAMSHAHR GOVERNOR'S OFFICE. NO CASUALTIES WERE REPORTED.

AT LEAST EIGHT PEOPLE WERE KILLED AND 17 INJURED ON OCTOBER 3 WHEN A BOMB EXPLODED ON THE TEHRAN-KHORRAMSHAHR TRAIN. THERE IS STILL NO INDICATION WHO SET OFF THE BOMB. IN TEHRAN A FIRE BROKE OUT AT THE AFGHAN EMBASSY ON SEPTEMBER 23. AN EMBASSY SPOKESMAN CLAIMED THE BLAZE WAS CAUSED BY ARSONISTS. DAMAGE WAS APPARENTLY LIMITED TO THE GUARDS CABIN AT THE EMBASSY. ANOTHER EXPLOSION, PERHAPS FROM A GRENADE, TOOK PLACE OUTSIDE THE SAUDI ARABIAN EMBASSY ON SEPTEMBER 24 DURING THE OFFICIAL CELEBRATION BEING HELD TO MARK SAUDI ARABIAN NATIONAL DAY. TWO ASSASSINATIONS HAVE TAKEN PLACE IN MASHAD, BOTH INVOLVING LOCAL CLERGYMEN.

HAJ MOSHALLAH HOMAI WAS GUNNED DOWN LATE IN THE EVENING ON SEPTEMBER 22. A NEWSPAPER REPORT CLAIMED THAT THE CLERGYMAN HAD BEEN A SUPPORTER OF THE SHAH. A SECOND CLERGYMAN WAS ASSASSINATED IN MASHAD ON OCTOBER 1. SEYYED ADMAD AHMADI WAS SHOT TO DEATH ON THE DOORSTEP OF HIS OWN HOUSE,AND RUMORS CIRCULATING IN MASHAD CLAIM THE DEATH WAS PART OF A PLOT TO LIQUIDATE 21 PROMINENT PERSONALITIES IN THE CITY.

THE ETHNIC KURDISH AREAS HAVE ALSO HAD A FAIR SHARE OF UNREST DURING THE PAST FEW DAYS. ON OCTOBER 3 EIGHT BUILDINGS IN NAQADEH, INCLUDING THE TOWNS WATER SUPPLY CENTER, THE GENDARMERIE HEADQUARTERS AND PRIVATE HOMES WERE DAMAGED IN A GRENADE ATTACK. SPORADIC VIOLENCE HAS HIT OTHER KURDISH TOWNS TOO, AND CLASHES AND INCIDENTS HAVE BEEN REPORTED IN SARDASHT, BANEH, SAQQEZ, MAHABAD, AND URUMIYEH (REZAIYEH). IN SANANDAJ THE HOUSE OF A REVOLUTIONARY GUARDSMAN WAS WRECKED BY AN EXPLOSION ON OCTOBER 1. ON OCTOBER 2 A GROUP OF 24 REVOLUTIONARY GUARDSMEN WERE AMBUSHED IN SARDASHT RESULTING IN FIVE OF THE GUARDS BEING KILLED, EIGHT WOUNDED AND THE REST BEING CAPTURED.

THE BALUCHISTAN REGION HAS ALSO SEEN RECENT UNREST. ON SEPT 20 HUNDREDS OF ZAHEDAN RESIDENTS SUPPORTED BY PEOPLE FROM KHASH AND IRAN SHAHR DEMONSTRATED AGAINST THE NEW IRANIAN CONSTITUTION ARTICLES WHICH STATE THAT THE OFFICIAL RELIGION OF IRAN IS THE JA'AFARI SECT OF SHIITE ISLAM. BALUCHISTAN IS A PREDOMINANTLY SUNNI AREA.

1979TEHRAN10701.subject: PAO'S MEETING WITH DR. BEHZADNIA, HEAD OF FOREIGN PRESS DEPARTMENT AT THE MINISTRY OF NATIONAL GUIDANCE

segments.text: PRESS DEPARTMENT AT THE MINISTRY OF NATIONAL GUIDANCE

DR. BEHZADNIA APPEARED HARRIED, TIRED, AND DISTRACTED BY SEVERAL INTERRUPTIONS AT THE OUTSET OF OUR MEETING IN HIS OFFICE. ONCE OUR DISCUSSION GOT FULLY UNDERWAY, HOWEVER, HE BECAME INCREASINGLY CORDIAL AND FORTHCOMING, ALLUDING TO HIS YEARS IN THE U.S. WHERE HE PRACTICED MEDICINE AND TO THE WARM RELATIONS HE HAD WITH PATIENTS, COLLEAGUES AND NEIGHBORS.

I BEGAN BY NOTING WRYLY THAT I HAD NOT COME TO LODGE A PROTEST OR INTERVENE IN THE AFFAIRS OF IRAN. HIS REACTION CLEARLY INDICATED HE UNDERSTOOD MY ALLUSION TO THE DISCUSSION OUR CHARGE HAD WITH INTERIOR MINISTER SABAGHIAN AND THE SUBSEQUENT PREPOSTEROUS ACCUSATIONS AGAINST THE CHARGE WHICH APPEARED IN THE IRANIAN PRESS.

I EXPRESSED CONCERN OVER THE EXPULSION OF AMERICAN JOURNALISTS, NOTING THAT NO AMERICANS WERE AT PRESENT ACCREDITED AS RESIDENT CORRESPONDENTS. I ASKED FOR CLARIFICATION OF HIS OFFICE'S POLICY, NOTING THAT THERE HAD BEEN REFERENCES RECENTLY IN THE PRESS TO "BANNED FOREIGN NEWS SERVICES." HE INSISTED THAT NO ORGANIZATIONS WERE BANNED AS SUCH, ONLY INDIVIDUALS GUILTY OF FALSE REPORTING. I THEN ASKED HIM IF HE THOUGHT EXPELLING CORRESPONDENTS WOULD RESULT IN IMPROVED REPORTING ON IRAN. HE SAID NO, BUT ADDED HE HAD NO CHOICE.

I THEN REMINDED HIM OF OUR STATE DEPARTMENT AND WHITE HOUSE BRIEFING SESSIONS FOR REPORTERS AND ALSO DESCRIBED THE SERVICES RENDERED TO FOREIGN CORRESPONDENTS BY USICA PRESS CENTERS. DR. BEHZADNIA AGREED THAT SUCH BRIEFINGS AND SERVICES WOULD BE MORE EFFECTIVE IN IMPROVING IRAN'S IMAGE ABROAD THAN EXPELLING JOURNALISTS BUT THEN SADLY ADDED, "PEOPLE WE WORK WITH DO NOT UNDERSTAND THIS WAY."

DR. BEHZANDIA THEN LAUNCHED INTO A LONG TIRADE AGAINST FALSE AND HOSTILE REPORTING, CITING FAIRLY COGENT EXAMPLES AND EXPRESSING THE CONVICTION THAT , BECAUSE THE AMERICANS AND GERMANS HAD SUFFERED BUSINESS LOSSES AND BECAUSE THEY HAD CLOSE RELATIONS WITH THE SHAH, THE GERMAN AND AMERICAN PRESS IS ILL-DISPOSED TOWARD THE REVOLUTION.

I TOOK THE OCCASION TO EXPRESS THE VIEW THAT THE IRANIAN PRESS PRESENTED A FALSE IMAGE OF THE U.S. AND ITS POLICIES AND THAT HE AND I HAD A SIMILAR PROBLEM ON OUR HANDS, CITING AS EXAMPLE THE DISTORTIONS OF OUR CHARGE'S TALK WITH MINISTER SABAGHIAN. HE AGREED AND MADE THE DISTINCTION AT LENGTH BETWEEN THE VIEWS OF INDIVIDUALS AND GOVERNMENTS, SAYING HOW MUCH HE LOVED AMERICA AND AMERICANS. HE WAS, HOWEVER, OUTRAGED BY THE FACT THAT THE U.S. GAVE REFUGE AND PROTECTION TO THE SHAH'S FAMILY AND COLLABORATORS.

I NOTED THAT HE HAD BENEFITED FROM THIS SAME AMERICAN HOSPITALITY AND REMINDED HIM THAT HE HAD EARLIER IN OUR DISCUSSION DESCRIBED HOW DURING HIS YEARS IN THE U.S. HE HAD WORKED PUBLICLY TO CALL ATTENTION TO THE MISDEEDS OF THE SHAH.
OUR HOUR-LONG DISCUSSION ENDED ON A NOTE OF CORDIALITY WITH DR. BEHZADNIA INVITING ME TO COME AND TALK WITH HIM AGAIN SOON ABOUT OUR MUTUAL CONCERN WITH BAD REPORTING.

COMMENT: I CAME AWAY FROM THE DISCUSSION WITH DR. BEHZADNIA WITH THE IMPRESSION THAT HE IS WELL-DISPOSED TO AMERICANS, KNOWS A GREAT DEAL ABOUT THE U.S. AND IS FRUSTRATED BY THE CONTEXT WITHIN WHICH HE MUST NOW WORK TO CONSOLIDATE THE REVOLUTION WHICH HE ENTHUSIASTICALLY PROMOTED DURING THE LAST YEARS OF THE SHAH'S REGIME. I ALSO GOT THE IMPRESSION THAT HE IS SINCERELY PUZZLED AND FRUSTRATED BY AMERICAN REPORTERS' PENCHANT TO REPORT THE SENSATIONAL AND THEIR BASIC LACK OF SYMPATHY FOR ISLAM

1979TEHRAN10733.subject: NIOC DIRECTOR REFUTES CHARGES MADE BEFORE ISLAMIC - COURT THERE FOLLOWS INFORMAL EMBASSY TRANSLATION OF THE

segments.text: COURT THERE FOLLOWS INFORMAL EMBASSY TRANSLATION OF THE REPLY OF HASSAN NAZIH, MANAGING DIRECTOR AND FORMER CHAIRMAN OF NIOC, TO THE 14 CHARGES LEVIED AGAINST HIM IN THE REVOLUTIONARY COURT
IT WAS CLAIMED THAT I INTENDED TO RUN AWAY WITH 60 OIL COMPANY WORKERS TO ROMANIA AND THEN PARIS TO PLOT THERE AGAINST THE REVOLUTION. IT WAS AN ABSOLUTE LIE AS CONFIRMED BY PM BAZARGAN AND THE IMAM.

IT WAS CLAIMED THAT I PAID 3,500,000 TOMANS TO THE LAW SOCIETY AND DR. MATIN DAFTARI. THIS IS NOT TRUE, I PAID THE SUM FOR THE HELP OF THE 2,000 DISABLED BY THE FORMER REGIME AND FOR THE REVOLUTIONARY PERIOD TO THE IRANIAN SOCIETY OF THE DEFENSE OF FREEDOM AND HUMAN RIGHTS.

IT WAS CLAIMED THAT ONE OF THE MEMBERS OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS WAS A BAHA'I AND A COMMUNIST. IT IS NOT TRUE AS HOJATOL ESLAM GHODOSI KNOWS THE INDIVIDUAL; MOREOVER THIS CASE HAS NOTHING TO DO WITH MY WORK AND MEMBERSHIP ON THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS.
IT WAS CLAIMED THAT ONE OF THE MEMBERS OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS WAS AN "OIL TUDEH" PARTY MEMBER, IF TRUE IT HAS NOTHING TO DO WITH ME.
IT WAS CLAIMED THAT THE OIL RESERVOIRS OF THE COUNTRY ARE EMPTY, IT IS NOT TRUE, AND HOJATOL ESLAM ESHRAGHI HAD COME TO THE SAME CONCLUSION.
IT WAS CLAIMED THAT I HAVE BEEN PROTECTING AGENTS OF THE FORMER REGIME. IT IS NOT TRUE, AS I COULD NOT SUPPORT THE AGENTS OF SHAH AGAINST WHOM I HAVE BEEN FIGHTING FOR 25 YEARS.
IT WAS CLAIMED THAT I PREVENTED THE PUBLISHING OF THE NAMES OF MEMBERS OF SAVAK. THE NAMES HAD ALREADY BEEN GIVEN TO THE BOARDS MAKING THE INVESTIGATION.
IT WAS CLAIMED THAT PURGING (OF COUNTER REVOLUTIONARIES) WAS NOT EXERCISED, THIS IS AN INJUSTICE, AS MANY MEMBERS OF THE STAFF WERE RETIRED BY DECISION OF THE BOARD OF INVESTIGATION.

IT WAS CLAIMED THAT THE SALARIES OF SOME WERE NOT JUSTIFIED. THE WAY THIS HAS BEEN PRESENTED IS NOT RIGHT. THEIR SALARIES WERE ADJUSTED BY TECHNICAL, FINANCIAL AND ADMIN SPECIALISTS AS DEMANDED BY THE REPRESENTATIVES OF LABOR.

IT WAS CLAIMED THAT 1,500,000 RIALS WAS PAID TO AYANDEGAN. THIS IS AN UNTENABLE ACCUSATION AS THE ANNOUNCEMENTS ARE PUT IN THE NEWSPAPERS BASED ON REGULATIONS PUBLISHED BY THE MINISTRY OF NATIONAL GUIDANCE. AYANDEGAN RECEIVED 500,000 RIALS FOR PUBLISHING ANNOUNCEMENTS, AS DID ETELAAT AND KAYHAN.
IT WAS CLAIMED THAT I USED TO GATHER FRIENDS AT MY HOME TO HELP KDP PLOT AGAINST THE IMAM. IT IS AS RIDICULOUS AS THE CLAIM OF MY ESCAPE WITH 60 SPECIALISTS TO PARIS.
IT WAS CLAIMED THAT I PROVIDED THE MEANS FOR ESCAPE OF MR. SEYED MOHAMAD TABATABAI DIBA. THIS IS NOT TRUE. HE RETIRED AND COLLECTED HIS PAY AND WENT TO EUROPE.
IT WAS CLAIMED THAT I WAS RESISTING ISLAMIC ACTIVITIES WITHIN THE OIL COMPANY. IT IS NOT TRUE AS I WAS ON THE CONTRARY ENCOURAGING IT.
IT WAS CLAIMED THAT RAISED DISCRIMINATIONS EXISTS. IT IS NOT TRUE AS WITNESSED BY MOST OIL COMPANY WORKERS.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

DURING RECENT VISIT TO MASHHAD, EMBASSY POLITICAL OFFICER CALLED ON 75-YEAR OLD RELIGIOUS LEADER AYATOLLAH HAJ HASAN TABATABA'I-QOMI ON EVENING OF OCTOBER 2, EVE OF THE BIRTHDAY OF THE EIGHTH IMAM OF SHIA ISLAM. THE AYATOLLAH'S SON, SEYYID MAHMUD, HAD PREVIOUSLY VISITED THE EMBASSY AND HAD SAID THAT HIS FATHER WOULD BE HAPPY TO RECEIVE EMBASSY REPRESENTATIVE IN MASHHAD.

VISIT WAS MADE AT AYATOLLAH'S HOUSE, WHICH HE ALSO USES AS OFFICES, LIBRARY, CLASSES, PRAYER HALL, AND PUBLIC RECEPTION AREA. HOUSE WAS GUARDED BY ARMED, PRIVATE BODYGUARDS. VISITORS WERE RECEIVED IN SMALL PUBLIC ROOM, AND THOSE WITH PRIVATE BUSINESS TO TRANSACT WOULD SIT NEXT TO THE AYATOLLAH, STATE THEIR BUSINESS IN A WHISPER, KISS HIS HAND, AND DEPART.

POLITICAL OFFICER EXPLAINED THAT ON BEHALF OF CHARGE HE WAS MAKING COURTESY CALL AND OFFERING CONGRATULATIONS ON OCCASION OF BIRTHDAY OF IMAM. AYATOLLAH QOMI EXPRESSED HIS THANKS FOR THE VISIT AND THE GOOD WISHES. HE THEN EXPRESSED THE HOPE THAT THOSE NATIONS TO WHOM GOD HAD GIVEN THE GIFT OF GREAT POWER WOULD USE THIS POWER WISELY. THIS GIFT, HE HOPED, WOULD BE USED FOR THE BENEFIT OF THE OPPRESSED AND NOT FOR THE OPPRESSOR.

THE AYATOLLAH CONTINUED SAYING THAT IT SADDENED HIM TO SEE A GREAT POWER LIKE THE UNITED STATES USING ITS POWER TO SUPPORT ISRAEL, THE OPPRESSOR OF MUSLIMS IN PALESTINE AND LEBANON. HE HOPED THAT THE US WAS REALIZING THAT BY SUPPORTING ISRAEL IN OPPRESSING MUSLIM PEOPLES, THE US WAS LOSING THE OPPORTUNITY TO USE ITS POWER TO SUPPORT JUSTICE AND BENEFIT THE OPPRESSED OF THE WORLD.

POLITICAL OFFICER SAID THAT THE AIM OF THE UNITED STATES' HUMAN RIGHTS POLICY WAS IMPROVEMENT OF CONDITIONS OF LIFE FOR ALL PEOPLES EVERYWHERE. SUCH A POLICY KNEW NO LINES OF NATIONALITY OR RELIGION AND CONSIDERED HUMAN RIGHTS TO BE THE SAME FOR ARAB, NON-ARAB, MUSLIM, AND NON-MUSLIM. POLOFF SAID THAT THE UNITED STATES WOULD CONTINUE TO PURSUE THIS HUMAN RIGHTS POLICY VIGOROUSLY IN THE FUTURE. HE SAID THAT HE WOULD CONVEY AYATOLLAH'S MESSAGE TO THE US GOVERNMENT.

COMMENT: AYATOLLAH QOMI IS ONE OF TWO RELIGIOUS LEADERS OF MASHHAD. ALTHOUGH HE HAS NEVER EXPRESSED ANY PUBLIC OPPOSITION TO KHOMEINI'S LEADERSHIP, AYATOLLAH QOMI HAS REPORTEDLY VOICED RESERVATIONS IN PRIVATE ABOUT CERTAIN ASPECTS OF IRANIAN REVOLUTIONARY JUSTICE AND THE DEVELOPMENT OF A PERSONALITY CULT AROUND KHOMEINI. PRESS ALSO MENTIONED QOMI AS A POSSIBLE MEDIATOR IN THE DISPUTE BETWEEN FORMER OIL COMPANY HEAD HASAN NAZIH AND SOME OF KHOMEINI'S CLOSE SUPPORTERS. IN SEPARATE CABLE, EMBASSY HAS DISCUSSED QOMI'S POLITICAL POSITION AND THE REASONS FOR HIS WEAKNESS RELATIVE TO KHOMEINI.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: POLITICAL OFFICER SPENT OCTOBER 2-3 IN MASHHAD, CAPITAL OF NORTHEASTERN PROVINCE OF KHORASAN. CITY WAS IN FESTIVE MOOD AND FILLED WITH VISITORS ON OCCASION OF BIRTHDAY OF EIGHTH IMAM. MASHHAD CONTINUES ITS TRADITION OF GOING ITS OWN WAY OUTSIDE OF THE MAINSTREAM OF IRANIAN POLITICAL LIFE. AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI HAS ESTABLISHED HIS AUTHORITY THOUGH A DELEGATE WHO OVERSHADOWS BOTH THE CIVIL GOVERNOR GENERAL AND THE TWO INFLUENTIAL LOCAL RELIGIOUS LEADERS WHO RAN THE CITY FOR THE MONTH BETWEEN THE EFFECTIVE COLLAPSE OF CENTRAL GOVERNMENT AUTHORITY IN JANUARY 1979 AND THE REVOLUTION OF FEBRUARY. EMBASSY WILL REPORT SEPARATELY ON CONDITIONS AT MASHHAD UNIVERSITY AND ON VISIT TO LEADING MASHHAD RELIGIOUS FIGURE.
END SUMMARY.

EMBASSY POLITICAL OFFICER SPENT OCTOBER 2-3 IN MASHHAD, THE CAPITAL OF KHORASAN PROVINCE AND THE SITE OF THE SHRINE OF IMAM REZA, EIGHTH IMAM OF THE SHI'A MUSLIMS. OFFICER HAD NOT VISITED MASHHAD IN EIGHT YEARS AND DURING HIS VISIT HE CALLED ON UNIVERSITY FACULTY AND ON AYATOLLAH HAJ HASAN TABATABA'I-QOMI, ONE OF SENIOR RELIGIOUS LEADERS OF THE PROVINCE. FOLLOWING ARE IMPRESSIONS GAINED FROM THE VISIT. - HISTORY AND BACKGROUND

MASHHAD HAS TRADITIONALLY FOLLOWED A PATH INDEPENDENT OF THE MAINSTREAM OF IRANIAN POLITICAL LIFE. THE REASONS FOR THIS INDEPENDENCE ARE OBSCURE, ALTHOUGH THEY MAY BE RELATED TOTHE CITY'S GEOGRAPHIC ISOLATION (TEHRAN IS 600 MILES WEST AND THE ROADS BEYOND MASHHAD GO NOWHERE, THEY SAY). HISTORICALLY THE CITY HAS ALWAYS BEEN MORE CLOSELY LINKED TO CENTRAL ASIA AND AFGHANISTAN THAN TO THE CENTRAL PERSIAN HEARTLAND. FOR WHATEVER REASONS, THE CITY'S ROLE IN THE MAJOR POLITICAL UPHEAVALS OF THE PAST DECADES--THE CONSTITUTIONAL MOVEMENT, THE SEPARATIST MOVEMENTS AFTER WORLD WAR II, THE MOSSADEGH PERIOD, AND THE RECENT ISLAMIC REVOLUTION--HAS BEEN PERIPHERAL.

THIS CHARACTER OF THE CITY EXISTS DESPITE THE FACT THAT MASHHAD IS A CENTER OF PILGRIMAGE FOR ALL SHIA MUSLIMS, IS ONE OF THE FIVE LARGEST CITIES IN IRAN, AND IS THE CENTER OF ONE OF THE COUNTRY'S MOST IMPORTANT AGRICULTURAL AREAS.

MASHHAD HAD REMAINED RELATIVELY FREE OF THE DISTURBANCES WHICH COVERED SO MUCH OF IRAN THROUGHOUT LATE 1978. THE INHABITANTS' HOPES FOR PEACE WERE SHATTERED IN EARLY JANUARY, 1979, HOWEVER, WHEN FOUR DAYS OF FIGHTING LEFT ABOUT 2,000 PERSONS DEAD. ACCORDING TO LOCAL SOURCES, AT THAT TIME THE ARMY WENT ON A RAMPAGE, ATTACKING A HOSPITAL AND SHOOTING INDISCRIMINATELY AT ANYONE IN THE STREETS. FOLLOWING THAT FIGHTING, MANY OF THE SOLDIERS FLED THEIR BARRACKS, AND THE MILITARY AUTHORITY MELTED AWAY. THE FARMANDAR (TOWN GOVERNOR) JOINED THE REVOLUTIONARIES AND THE OSTANDER AND OTHER CENTRAL GOVERNMENT REPRESENTATIVES LEFT THE CITY.

FROM EARLY JANUARY UNTIL THE FEBRUARY REVOLUTION, EFFECTIVE AUTHORITY WAS IN THE HANDS OF AYATOLLAH HAJ HASAN TABATABA'I-QOMI AND AYATOLLAH SAYYID ABDOLLAH SHIRAZI, WHO RAN THE AFFAIRS OF THE CITY FROM THEIR HOMES AND SCHOOLS. IT WAS AYATOLLAH SHIRAZI, FOR EXAMPLE, WHO FORBADE THE PEOPLE FROM ATTACKING FOREIGNERS. THE FOREIGN COMMUNITY LEFT MASHHAD AROUND JANUARY 7 AND TRAVELLED OVERLAND TO HERAT.

FOLLOWING THE VICTORY OF THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTION IN FEBRUARY 1979, THE TWO AYATOLLAHS OF MASHHAD LOST MUCH OF THEIR POLITICAL POWER TO SHEIKH TABASI, AYATOLLAH ------------------038299 071511Z /47 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 4123 INFO SECDEF WASH DC JCS WASH DC AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE SECTION 02 OF 03 TEHRAN 10752 KHOMEINI'S REPRESENTATIVE IN MASHHAD.

TABASI WAS AN OBSCURE CLERGYMAN BEFORE THE REVOLUTION, BUT ASSISTED BY KHOMEINI'S AUTHORITY AND BY A SMALL GROUP OF REOVLUTIONARY GUARDS, HE HAS BEEN ABLE TO ASSERT HIS CONTROL OF THE CITY TO THE POINT THAT HE NOW ORDERS ARRESTS, TRIALS, AND EXECUTIONS WITHOUT REFERENCE TO ANY OTHER AUTHORITY. THE GOVERNOR-GENERAL AND OTHER REPRESENTATIVES OF THE OFFICIAL GOVERNMENT HAVE ALSO BEEN OVERSHADOWED BY TABASI.

A MEMBER OF A PROMINENT, LIBERAL MASHHAD FAMILY EXPLAINED THE POLITICAL ECLIPSE OF THE TWO AYATOLLAHS AS FOLLOWS: - (A) DURING KHOMEINI'S 15-YEAR EXILE FROM IRAN, THE MASHHAD RELIGIOUS LEADERS HAD BEEN FORCED TO MAKE ACCOMMODATIONS WITH THE CIVIL AUTHORITIES. AZIZI, THE LAST GOVERNOR GENERAL OF KHORASAN UNDER THE MONARCHY, HAD ESTABLISHED EXCELLENT RELATIONS WITH THE MASHHAD RELIGIOUS LEADERS TO THE EXTENT THAT THE NEW REGIME HAS NOT MOLESTED HIM (AZIZI). HOWEVER, THE AYATOLLAHS HAD ALSO DEALT WITH EX-GOVERNOR GENERAL VALIAN, WHO IS ONE OF THE NEW REGIME'S NUMBER ONE TARGETS.

KHOMEINI'S THREATS TO REVEAL THESE ASSOCIATIONS HAS PREVENTED THE MASHHAD AYATOLLAHS FROM EFFECTIVELY OPPOSING HIS POLITICAL AUTHORITY. - (B) DURING THE FIRST WEEKS AFTER THE REVOLUTION, AYATOLLAH TABATABAI-QOMI DID VOICE SOME OPPOSITION TO THE PROCEDURES OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS. SPECIFICALLY, THE AYATOLLAH NOTED THAT UNDER ISLAMIC JURISPRUDENCE THE ASSERTIONS OF A PLAINTIFF HAD TO BE SUPPORTED BY THE TESTIMONY OF IMPARTIAL WITNESSES. HOWEVER, THE REVLUTIONARY COURTS WERE USING THE PLAINTIFFS AS WITNESSES AGAINST THE ACCUSED. ACCORDING TO EMBASSY SOURCE, KHOMEINI SIMPLY IGNORED THESE OBJECTIONS AND "BLACKMAILED" THE AYATOLLAH'S INTO SILENCE BY THREATENING TO MAKE AN ISSUE OF THEIR ASSOCIATIONS WITH MEMBERS OF THE PAST REGIME.

THE MASHHAD AYATOLLAHS HAVE REPORTEDLY ALSO BEEN UNHAPPY AT THE CULT OF PERSONALITY WHICH HAS BEEN BUILT UP AROUND KHOMEINI. THE RECENT ANNIVERSARY OF HIS TRAVELS FROM IRAQ TO PARIS (OCT 2) WAS DESCRIBED ON THE STATE RADIO AND TELEVISION AS THE SECOND GREATEST HEJRAT (MIGRATION) IN ISLAMIC HISTORY, SECOND ONLY TO THE TRAVEL OF THE PROPHET MOHAMMAD FROM MECCA TO MEDINA. SUCH LANGUAGE VERGES ON HERESY FOR STRICT MUSLIMS. KHOMEINI HAS ALSO ASSUMED THE AUTHORITY TO GRANT CLERICAL TITLES ON HIS OWN INITIATIVE.

TRADITIONALLY SUCH HONORIFICS AS AYATOLLAH AND HOJJAT AL-ISLAM WERE NOT BESTOWED BY ANY INDIVIDUAL BUT WERE GRANTED BY CONSENSUS OF THE SCHOLARLY COMMUNITY WHEN A PERSON HAD REACHED A CERTAIN DEGREE OF LEARNING AND PIETY. KHOMEINI'S UNILATERALLY BESTOWING THESE TITLES ON VARIOUS CLERGYMEN IS SEEN AS A THREAT TO THE COLLEGIAL SYSTEM WHICH HAS TRADITIONALLY PREVAILED AMONG THE SHIA LEADERSHIP.

EMBASSY SOURCE SAID HE HAD VISITED AYATOLLAH QOMI AS PART OF A DELEGATION. IN PRIVATE, THE AYATOLLAH TOLD ONE OF THE DELEGATION MEMBERS THAT KHOMEINI WAS ABLE TO "SIT UNDER AN APPLE TREE IN PARIS AND ISSUE EDICTS" WHILE THOSE LEADERS ON THE SCENE HAD TO TRY AND ALLEVIATE THE BLOODSHED AND SUFFERING OF THEIR FOLLOWERS. DURING THE WORST OF THE FIGHTING IN MASHHAD, BODIES OF THE VICTIMS WERE STORED IN AYATOLLAH QOMI'S HOUSE UNTIL THEY COULD BE WASHED AND BURIED SECRETLY.

QOMI SAID HE HAD TO CONSOLE THE SURVIVORS AND TO DEAL WITH THE AUTHORITIES TO TRY AND STOP FURTHER KILLING. "WHERE WAS KHOMEINI DURING ALL THIS?"
