IN HIS CALL ON DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER BANI-ASSADI (REF.A) TDY ECONOFFICER ASKED ABOUT PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN'S RECENT DETAILED INVENTORY (REF B) OF THE ACCOMPLISHMENTS OF THE CRUSADE. HE SUGGESTED THAT THE NUMBER AND SCOPE OF THE ACCOMPLISHMENTS SEEMED RATHER EXTRAORDINARY, CONSIDERING THAT THE CRUSADE HAD ONLY BEEN LAUNCHED THREE MONTHS BEFORE. SMILING DELIGHTEDLY, BANI-ASSADI ACKNOWLEDGED THAT HE HAD WRITTEN THE SPEECH. THE ACCOMPLISHMENTS WERE INDEED EXTRAORDINARY. LIKE THE REVOLUTION ITSELF, THEY CONSTITUTED A MIRACLE, A PROOF OF GOD'S CONCERN FOR ITS SUCCESS. AS FOR THE ACCURACY OF BAZARGAN'S CLAIMS, BANI-ASSADI HAD A FILE "THIS THICK" (INDICATING 1-1/2 INCHES BETWEEN THUMB AND FOREFINGER) WHICH SUBSTANTIATED EVERY ACCOMPLISHMENT.

AS ONE EXAMPLE, HE CITED THE RECENT REBUILDING OF 450 SCHOOLS IN TEHRAN PROVINCE. IT HAD BECOME CLEAR THAT MANY SCHOOL PLANTS WERE NOT READY FOR THE OPENING OF SCHOOL. THE CRUSADE SET UP TENTS THROUGHOUT TEHRAN TO WHICH THE CITIZENRY BROUGHT PAINT, CEMENT, BRICKS--ANYTHING THEY COULD CONTRIBUTE. AT THE SAME TIME, ARTISANS HAD OFFERED THEIR SERVICES GRATIS TO DO THE WORK. MOREOVER, CONTINUED BANI-ASSADI PROUDLY, THE CRUSADE HAD PULLED 10,000 TEETH. NOTING THE EXPRESSION ON TDY ECONOFF'S FACE, HE POINTED OUT THAT MOST IRANIAN VILLAGERS HAD NEVER EVEN SEEN A DENTIST.
THE VOLUNTEER DENTAL TEAMS THAT WENT OUT TO THE VILLAGERS HAD NEITHER THE TIME NOR THE RESOURCES TO DO FILLINGS AND CROWNS.

THE DEVELOPMENT OF THE CRUSADE OVER THE PAST FIVE MONTHS HAD NOT BEEN EASY. OPPOSITION FROM THE BUREAUCRACY, ON THE ONE HAND, AND FROM THOSE (UNSPECIFIED) WHO SOUGHT TO EXPLOIT IT FOR THEIR OWN POLITICAL ENDS, HAD ALMOST ABORTED IT. THREE MONTHS AGO, HE TALKED KHOMEINI INTO LAUNCHING HIS GENERAL APPEAL. EVEN PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN (BANIASSADI'S FATHER-IN-LAW) HAS BEEN SKEPTICAL ABOUT LAUNCHING THE SPECIAL APPEAL FOR REBUILDING THE SCHOOLS. "DON'T ASK ME TO MAKE A LOT OF EMPTY PROPAGANDA," HE APPARENTLY GRUMBLED TO BANI-ASSADI. BAZARGAN, EXPLAINED BANI-ASSADI, HAD AN ENGINEER'S MIND. HE HAD TO HAVE ALL THE ELEMENTS IN A SITUATION FIRMLY IN HAND BEFORE HE WOULD MAKE A MOVE.

THIS HOWEVER, WAS A TIME, BANI-ASSADI FELT, FOR ACTION, IN THE ABSENCE OF CERTAINTY. IN ANY EVENT, THE MINISTER OF EDUCATION HAD BEEN SO IMPRESSED WITH THE RESULTS OF THE SCHOOL CAMPAIGN THAT HE HAD ASKED THAT IT BE EXTENDED. THIS APPARANTLY BROUGHT BAZARGAN AROUND.

TDY ECONOFF EXPLAINED THAT HIS EFFORTS TO EXPLAIN THE CRUSADE AND ALL IT SYMBOLIZED TO WASHINGTON WOULD ENCOUNTER A SIMILAR SKEPTICISM. MUCH HAD BEEN CLAIMED FOR A VERY SHORT TIME WITHOUT MUCH SPECIFICITY AS TO MEANS. BANIASSADI SUGGESTED THAT IT MIGHT BE USEFUL IF TDY ECONOFF COULD VISIT SOME OF THE PROJECTS FOR HIMSELF. HE THEN BACKED OFF A LITTLE, SAYING THAT THE FEELING AGAINST THE UNITED STATES AMONG THOSE RESPONSIBLE FOR THE CRUSADE WAS PARTICULARLY VIRULENT. LATE THAT NIGHT, HOWEVER, HE CALLED TDY ECONOFF TO SAY THAT HE HAD ARRANGED FOR HIM TO VISIT PROJECTS IN SHIRAZ ON THE FOLLOWING TUESDAY, OCTOBER 9.

1979TEHRAN10754.subject: CONVERSATION WITH THE GOVERNOR OF KARAJ

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).
SUMMARY: DURING CONVERSATION WITH POLOFF, THE NEW DISTRICT GOVERNOR OF KARAJ DISCUSSED PROBLEMS HE FACED WITH LOCAL CLERGY AND THE BUREAUCRACY HE INHERITED FROM THE PAHLAVI REGIME. END SUMMARY.

ON OCTOBER 4 POLOFF METRINKO HAD DINNER WITH AMIR HUSSEIN POULADI, NEWLY APPOINTED DISTRICT GOVERNOR (FARMANDAR) OF KARAJ. POULADI DISCUSSED PROBLEMS HE FACES IN HIS DISTRICT, WITH ESPECIAL EMPHASIS ON ITS POPULATION (ABOUT ONE MILLION) AND THE DRASTIC CONTRASTS BETWEEN RICH AND POOR. KARAJ HAS BEEN A TRADITIONAL AREA FOR WEALTHY TEHRANI'S TO INVEST IN LAND, AND THE KARAJ AREA IS DOTTED WITH VILLAS AND LARGE ORCHARDS OWNED BY TEHRAN LANDLORDS JUXTAPOSED WITH SQUALID VILLAGE HOUSING WHICH HAS NO WATER OR ELECTRICITY. ACCORDING TO THE FARMANDAR, ANY DEVELOPMENT PROJECTS IN THE KARAJ AREA WILL BE SERIOUSLY CHALLENGED BY THESE WEALTHY LANDLORDS, SINCE THEY HAVE BEEN TRADITIONALLY JEALOUS OF THEIR PRIVILEGES.
THE REVOLUTION AND DEVELOPMENT PROGRAMS NOTWITHSTANDING, THESE LANDLORDS STILL HAVE STRONG INFLUENCE IN THE GOVERNMENT AND WILL TRY TO DETER ANY DEVELOPMENT PROGRAMS WHICH THREATEN THEIR HOLDINGS.

ONE MAJOR PROBLEM FACED BY THE NEW FARMANDAR IS INTERFERENCE IN HIS WORK BY VARIOUS COMMITTEES AND RELIGIOUS GROUPS. EVERY CLERGYMAN IN THE AREA SEEMS TO THINK THAT HIS WORD IS LAW, AND THE CLERGY ARE QUICK TO REPORT TO QOM WHENEVER A GOVERNMENT OFFICIAL OR THE FARMANDAR HAS DONE ANYTHING OF WHICH THEY DON'T APPROVE. ACCORDING TO THE FARMANDAR, MEDDLING BY THE CLERGY HAS BECOME ENDEMIC, AND CLERGYMEN SEE NO LIMITS ON THEIR RIGHTS TO COMPLAIN OR ACTIVELY INTERFERE IN ANY AND ALL MATTERS OF GOVERNMENT BUSINESS.

FYI: THE FARMANDAR'S WIFE AND DAUGHTER BEGAN A LONG DISCUSSION, VERY ANTI-CLERICAL IN TONE, AT THIS POINT. FOLLOWING LINES POLOFF HAS HEARD FROM A VARIETY OF OTHER SOURCES, THEIR COMPLAINTS RANGED FROM THE SEEMING VAST INCREASE IN THE CLERICAL PROFESSION ("WHERE WERE THEY ALL DURING THE FIGHTING LAST YEAR"?) TO THE SEEMING PROFIT ALL THE CLERGY HAD MADE BECAUSE OF THE REVOLUTION ("EVERY AKHOUND YOU SEE NOW IS SITTING IN A MERCEDES-BENZ").

THE FARMANDAR ECHOED A NUMBER OF OTHER POST-REVOLUTION OFFICIALS WITH WHOM POLOFF HAS SPOKEN WHEN HE BEGAN TO DESCRIBE HIS FEELINGS OF NON-SUPPORT FROM HIS OWN STAFF IN KARAJ. THE MAJORITY OF THE CIVIL SERVANTS UNDER HIS CONTROL SEEMED TO HAVE NO FEELINGS OF RESPONSIBILITY, AND SHOWED A DISTINCT LACK OF ENTHUSIASM FOR NEW PROJECTS OR EVEN BASIC OFFICE WORK. "I FEEL LIKE I'M ALONE," HE CLAIMED.

COMMENT: FEELINGS OF ANTIPATHY TOWARDS THE CLERGY REMAIN STRONG AMONG MANY MEMBERS OF THE BUREAUCRACY AND THE MIDDLE CLASS, WHO SEEM UNABLE TO COME TO TERMS WITH THE CLERGY'S NEW-FOUND POWER. WHILE COMPLAINTS AGAINST KHOMEINI HIMSELF ARE OFTEN AVOIDED, HIS IMMEDIATE ENTOURAGE AND "AKHOUNDS" IN GENERAL ARE CASTIGATED WITH A GREAT DEAL OF REGULARITY. THE FARMANDAR CERTAINLY MADE NO ATTEMPT TO CONTROL THE ANTI-CLERICAL OUTBURST ON THE PART OF HIS WIFE AND DAUGHTER, AND IT WAS OBVIOUS THAT HE HIMSELF WAS NOT READILY WILLINGTO ACCEPT THE CLERGY IN THEIR ROLE OF GOVERNMENT CRITICS.

PERHAPS MORE IMPORTANT, HOWEVER, WERE THE FARMANDAR'S STATEMENTS ON THE UNWILLINGNESS OF HIS OWN BUREAUCRACY TO RESPOND TO DEMANDS FOR THEIR SERVICES. TOP OFFICIALS HAVE BEEN CHANGED THROUGHOUT IRAN BY BRINGING OLD ONES OUT OF RETIREMENT, OR BY TRANSFERS AND PURGES, BUT THE MASSIVE LOWER BUREAUCRACY SEEMS TO HAVE REMAINED MUCH THE SAME. DESPITE ALL THE FERVOR AND ENTHUSIASM OF THE TOP RANKS, IT WILL TAKE CONSIDERABLE TIME TO MOLD THE PAHLAVI REGIME BUREAUCRACY INTO A REVOLUTIONARY ONE. LAINGEN

1979TEHRAN10755.subject: OIL WORKER ATTITUDES AND OIL FIELD SECURITY

segments.text: (C-ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY. IMPRESSIONS GAINED DURING A WEEK'S VISIT TO IRAN'S KHUZESTAN OIL PROVINCE SUGGEST THAT OIL FIELD WORKERS ARE TROUBLED. SOME FEAR THAT REVOLUTIONARY EXCESSES MAY FURTHER ERODE PRIVILEGES AND FREEDOMS AND OTHERS THAT THE REVOLUTION WILL FAIL TO RECTIFY PAST INJUSTICES. NEVERTHELESS, THERE SEEMS TO BE BASIC SUPPORT FOR KHOMEINI AND THE REVOLUTION AND THE WORKER DISCONTENT WE ENCOUNTERED SHOULD NOT LEAD TO CRITICAL MANPOWER SHORTAGES OR TO CONFRONTATIONS WITH MANAGEMENT THAT WILL SERIOUSLY HINDER PRODUCTION OR EXPORTS AT LEAST IN THE NEAR TERM.

(HOWEVER, THE REGIME MUST MEET NEEDS OF THE MAINLY ARAB CONTRACT WORKERS AND PASS UP A SUBSTANTIAL PURGE OF MANAGERS/TECHNICIANS ASSOCIATED WITH THE FORMER REGIME FOLLOWING DIRECTOR NAZIH'S DISMISSAL LAST WEEK.) GROUPS OF DISSIDENTS HAVE CLEARLY DEMONSTRATED THEY CAN SABOTAGE NIOC TARGETS OF OPPORTUNITY. BUT STRONG SECURITY MEASURES MAKE ATTACKS ON IMPORTANT OIL INSTALLATIONS DIFFICULT AND NIOC HAS THE CAPABILITY -- AND CLEAR ORDERS FROM THE NEW REGIME -- TO QUICKLY REPAIR RELATIVELY MINOR DAMAGE TO PRODUCTION AND EXPORT FAICLITIES. END SUMMARARY.

AS NOTED REF A, EMBASSY ECONOMIC OFFICERS TOURED IRAN'S KHUZESTAN OIL PROVINCE FROM SEPTEMBER 23-30, MEETING IN THE COURSE OF THE TRIP PROVINCIAL GOVERNOR GENERAL MADANI, THE GOVERNOR OF ABADAN, A VARIETY OF NIOC/OSCO SUPERVISORY PERSONNEL AND SEDIRAN'S MANAGER IN AHWAZ, THE MANAGING DIRECTORS OF THE ABADAN AND SHIRAZ REFINERIES, THE GENERAL MANAGER OF THE ABADAN AND BANDAR MASHAR PETROCHEMICAL COMPANIES, NIOC PERSONNEL ON KHARG ISLAND, IPAC'S KHARG ISLAND MANAGER, AND A VARIETY OF BUSINESSMEN, BANKING OFFICIALS, ENGINEERS AND TECHNICIANS, AS WELL AS SPOKESMEN FOR WORKERS GROUPS IN THE AREA. AT ALL LEVELS AND ON EVERY OCCASION WE WERE CORDIALLY RECEIVED.

GENERALLY, OUR CONTACTS WERE CANDID AND OPEN, BUT SOME SENIOR PEOPLE SEEMED TO CHOOSE THEIR WORDS CAREFULLY, PARTICULARLY WHEN DISCUSSING THE POLITICAL SITUATION. AMONG MANY QUESTIONS, WE ASKED ABOUT ISSUES BEARING ON SECURITY IN THE OIL FIELDS. THE ANSWERS WE GOT AND THE CONCLUSIONS WE DRAW AS A RESULT ARE SUMMARIZED IN THE FOLLOWING PARAGRAPHS.
OIL WORKER CONCERNS

THE NIOC MANAGER/TECHNICIANS WE MET SEEMED MOST CONCERNED ABOUT FAILING TO MEET THE NEW REGIME'S DEMANDS FOR A STEADY 4 MILLION B/D OF PRODUCTION WITHOUT EXPATRIATE HELP, OFTEN WITH KEY PERSONNEL RETIRED OR EMIGRATED, AND SOMETIMES IN THE FACE OF DIFFICULT LABOR PROBLEMS. YET MOST CLAIM THE MANPOWER SHORTAGES ARE NOT YET CRITICAL AND EXPATRIATES ARE NOT WANTED BACK EXCEPT IN LIMITED NUMBERS FOR TECHNICAL-NOT SUPERVISORY -- PURPOSES. THERE IS CONTINUING CONCERN ABOUT WHAT WORKERS (AT LEAST THE LOWEST PAID "CONTRACT WORKERS") WILL DO.

THE MANAGER/TECHNICIANS ALSO OFTEN HAVE DIFFICULTY, WE GATHER, IN RECONCILING BASIC CONFLICTS BETWEEN THE OFTEN HARSH STANDARDS OF THE NEW REGIME AND A LIBERAL OUTLOOK (OFTEN GAINED VIA A WESTERN EDUCATION). THESE WORKERS HAVE TENDED TO "THANK GOD FOR NAZIH" FOR RESISTING EFFORTS TO RADICALIZE THE NIOC. AT THE SAME TIME, THEY SEEM TO STRONGLY APPROVE THE REVOLUTION'S ATTACKS ON CORRUPTION, AND WE FOUND NO SYMPATHY FOR THE FORMER REGIME.

THE MAJORITY OF MANAGER/TECHNICIANS SEEM TO SEE WHAT AN NPC ENGINEER DESCRIBED AS "KHOMEINI'S REVEALED PREFERENCE FOR INCOME LEVELS REQUIRING CONTINUED OIL EXPORTS AT ABOUT THE CURRENT RATE" AS THEIR PROTECTION AGAINST AN ULTRACONSERVATIVE MAJORITY CAPABLE OF "RUINOUS EXCESSES." WE COULD FIND LITTLE INTEREST FOR THE LEFT AMONG THIS GROUP AS A POLITICAL ALTERNATIVE (THOUGH SOME COMMITTEE MEMBERS AT THE SHIRAZ REFINERY SAID THERE WERE LEFTISTS AMONG THE OIL WORKERS AND "THEY WERE NOT AMONG THE LOWEST PAID.") MORALE -- UNTIL RECENTLY AT LEAST -- AMONG THIS GROUP RANGED FROM "ACCEPTABLE TO BAD" WITH MANY CONCERNED FOR WHAT THE FUTURE WILL BRING BUT STILL INCLINED TO BELIEVE THAT MATTERS MIGHT IMPROVE SLOWLY.

THE NIOC "COMPANY WORKER" IS LARGELY BUT NOT ENTIRELY ETHNIC PERSIAN AND IS MUCH MORE CONSERVATIVE THAN THE MANAGER/TECHNICIAN. HE HAS A VESTED INTEREST IN THINGS ------------------038335 071550Z /40 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 4128 INFO AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY DAMASCUS AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY KUWAIT SECTION 02 OF 04 TEHRAN 10755 AS THEY ARE,DUE TO COMPANY PROVIDED HOUSING, FOOD, MEDICAL CARE AND OTHER SERVICES. THIS GROUP HAS ALSO SUPPORTED BOTH KHOMEINI'S AND NAZIH'S LEADERSHIP. MOST APPEAR CONCERNED BY THE MORE EXTREME ASPECTS OF THE REVOLUTION, AND WITH THE RECENT GENERAL WAGE INCREASES THESE WORKERS SEE THEMSELVES AS NO LONGER QUITE SO ELITE AS ONCE THEY WERE.

(ON THE OTHER HAND, FOR SOME -- YOUNGER ONES -THE EXCITEMENT OF POLITICAL ACTIVISM OUTWEIGHS OTHER CONSIDERATIONS.) FROM ALL WE HEARD, HOWEVER, IT APPEARS THE COMPANY WORKERS ARE BASICALLY QUITE CONTENT WITH THEIR LOT AND HOPE TO PRESERVE THEIR POSITION. WE WERE TOLD THAT THERE HAVE BEEN NO STRIKES OR WORK INTERRUPTIONS BY COMPANY WORKERS SINCE LAST FEBRUARY/MARCH.

CONTRACT LABORERS, PROBABLY ABOUT HALF OF ALL OIL FIELD WORKERS, AND USUALLY BUT NOT ALWAYS ETHNIC ARABS, HAVE BEEN THE LEAST ADVANTAGED ECONOMICALLY. THIS GROUP NOW SEEMS LITTLE INTERESTED IN NATIONALISM AS AN ISSUE BUT LOOKS TO THE REVOLUTION FOR HELP WITH HOUSING, MEDICAL CARE, JOB SECURITY AND IMPROVED PAY SIMILAR TO THAT ENJOYED BY NIOC COMPANY WORKERS. WHILE NAZIH DID RAISE THE PAY OF THIS GROUP SOMEWHAT AND PROMISED MORE SOCIAL SERVICES HE PREFERRED NOT TO TAKE THEM ON THE NIOC PAYROLL BECAUSE, OFTEN SEASONAL OR PART-TIME, THEY WOULD ADD COSTS AND MANAGEMENT HEADACHES NOT SUFFERED BY NIOC IN THE PAST.

IT IS THESE WORKERS WHO SEND DELEGATIONS TO PLANT MANAGEMENT AND TO THE COMMITTEES, AND TO WHOM KHOMEINI SENT HIS SON-INLAW, HOJTOLESLAM ESHRAGI, IN MID-SEPTEMBER TO INVESTIGATE WORKER COMPLAINTS IN THE OIL FIELDS. ESHRAGI REPORTED TO KHOMEINI THAT THE OIL WORKERS HAD VALID GROUNDS FOR DISCONTENT. NAZIH THEN WENT TO KHOMEINI HIMSELF TO SAY THAT REFORM COULD NOT BE INSTANTANEOUS AND ESHRAGI'S INTERFERENCE HAD NOT HELPED NIOC'S EFFORTS TO KEEP PRODUCTION UP. ESHRAGI DEFENDED HIMSELF BY SAYING NAZIH'S POLICY WITH REGARD TO THE CONTRACT WORKERS WAS CLEARLY NOT IN KEEPING WITH REVOLUTIONARY OBJECTIVES.

PRESUMABLY REFLECTING THE NAZIH-ESHRAGI DISPUTE, CONTRACT WORKERS HAVE MADE A SERIES OF DEMANDS TO MANAGEMENT IN A NUMBER OF NIOC PLANTS JUST RECENTLY; THE FIRST TIME IN SEVERAL WEEKS THAT THESE WORKERS HAVE BEEN SO ACTIVE. CONTRACT WORKERS HAVE REPORTEDLY STRUCK, STAGED SIT-INS AND OTHERWISE HINDERED OIL PRODUCTION/EXPORTS IN THE PERIOD LEADING UP TO ABOUT THE END OF JUNE WHEN REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS (PASDARAN) WERE CALLED INTO ABADAN REFINERY TO BREAK UP A SERIOUS CONFRONTATION BETWEEN THEM AND MANAGEMENT. THE CONTRACT WORKERS ARE INFLUENCED BY TRIBAL TIES, ARE INTENSELY RELIGIOUS, AND LACK LEADERSHIP.

SHEIKH KHAGANI'S CONTINUED RESIDENCE IN QOM DOES NOT APPEAR TO BE CAUSING NOTICEABLE TROUBLE (REF B.) WE ARE AWARE THAT TRADITIONALLY THE TUDEH (LEFT) PARTY HAS HAD A STRONG BASE AMONG THE POOR IN THE SOUTH; WE SAW NO SIGN, HOWEVER, OF TUDEH INFLUENCE NOW.
THE REGIME'S INFLUENCE ON THE OIL WORKERS

KHOEMINI APPEARS TO HAVE INFLUENCE OVER AT LEAST THE MAJORITY OF OIL WORKERS. NO ONE WE SPOKE TO QUESTIONED EITHER HIS CALL TO KEEP THE OIL FLOWING AT 4 MILLION B/D OR HIS CHARGE THAT SABOTEURS ARE COUNTER-REVOLUTIONARY AND SHOULD BE SHOT. MANAGERS AND EVEN COMMITTEE MEMBERS CLAIM TO BE OPPOSED TO STRIKES AND DEMONSTRATIONS THAT PLAY INTO THE HANDS OF THE "ENEMIES OF THE REVOLUTION." EVEN THE CONTRACT WORKERS ARE NOW CAREFUL TO COUCH THEIR PROTESTS IN TERMS OF "EXPRESSING JUST GRIEVANCES"; THEY SEND DELEGATIONS TO MANAGERS DURING NON-WORKING HOURS.

(AT THE SAME TIME, REVOLUTIONARY LEADERS OBVIOUSLY ARE AWARE OF LIMITS TO EVEN KHOMEINI'S IMPACT AND THEY SEEM PARTICULARLY CONCERNED ABOUT THE CONSEQUENCES OF THE NEW REGIME'S BEING SEEN AS INDIFFERENT TO THE CONTRACT WORKERS' PLIGHT.) IN EXPLAINING KHOMEINI'S ATTRACTIVENESS TO MOST IN THE OIL FIELDS, A U.S. TRAINED, RATHER INTENSE YOUNG NIOC SUPERVISOR NOTED THAT KHOMEINI IS INCORRUPTIBLE, CONCERNED, AND WHILE HIS BEHAVIOR MAY BE "FRIGHTENING" TO A LIBERALLY EDUCATED AMERICAN, IT IS "ENTIRELY IN ACCORD WITH TRADITIONAL IRANIAN CULTURE, AND EVEN WESTERN EDUCATED IRANIANS CANNOT HELP RESPONDING TO "THE BASIC TRUTHS OF HIS MESSAGE." A KHARG ISLAND SPOKESMAN FOR THE CONTRACT WORKER ECHOED THIS VIEW.

NAZIH'S EFFORTS HAVE BEEN USEFUL IN CHANNELING OIL WORKER CONCERNS CONSTRUCTIVELY. BY MAKING HIMSELF PERSONALLY AVAILABLE TO WORKERS AT ALL LEVELS OVER THE PAST MONTHS, HE HAS CONVINCED MOST, EXCEPT FORSOME CONTRACT WORKERS, THAT HE CARES. BY DEFENDING WORKERS SAID TO BE ASSOCIATED WITH THE PAST REGIME AND BY KEEPING ON MANY NIOC WORKERS WHEN THE PROJECTS FOR WHICH THEY WERE HIRED WERE DROPPED, ------------------038360 071551Z /40 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 4129 INFO AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY DAMASCUS AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY KUWAIT SECTION 03 OF 04 TEHRAN 10755 HE HAS BECOME A VALUED PROTECTOR.

NAZIH'S STRESSING TO THE CONTRACT WORKERS THAT A) THEY MUST BE REALISTIC IN THEIR DEMANDS AND B) THEYMUST PRESENT THEIR DEMANDS IN A RESPONSIBLE FASHION HAS NOT GONE UNAPPRECIATED, EVEN BY THE CONTRACT WORKERS THEMSELVES. ACCORDING TO THE PEOPLE IAL WE SPOKE WITH, WORK DISRUPTING CONFRONTATIONS FELL OFF SUBSTANTIALLY AT LEAST IN PART BECAUSE OF NAZIH'S EFFORTS. (OR DID UNTIL ESHRAGI CAME TO KHUSEZTAN TWO WEEKS AGO.)

THE NEW REGIME HAS SUBSTANTIAL SECURITY MEASURES IN PLACE. WE LEARNED THAT PASDARAN (PROTECTING KEY INSTALLATIONS), NAVY COMMANDOES (PROTECTING PIPELINES), AIR FORCE PERSONNEL (ON KHARG ISLAND) AND GENDARMES (ALSO PROTECTING PIPELINES) TOTAL "AS MANY AS 2000." THERE ARE IN ADDITION PLENTIFUL CIVIL POLICE THAT WE SAW IN THE TOWNS AND NIOC GUARDS AT THE MAIN PLANTS. ACCORDING TO THE ABADAN REFINERY MANAGER, THE SABOTAGE IN LATE JUNE OF THE CRUDE/PRODUCT PIPELINE BETWEEN THE REFINERY AND BANDAR KHOMEINI (FORMERLY BANDAR SHAPUR) WAS THE ONLY SERIOUS ATTACK ON OIL FIELD INSTALLATIONS SINCE THE REVOLUTION.

HE ADMITTED THAT THIS WAS DONE BY "PEOPLE WHO KNEW WHAT THEY WERE DOING" AS PLACEMENT OF THE EXPLOSIVES MAXIMIZED DAMAGE. HE ADDED THAT SINCE THAT INCIDENT THE ONLY SIGNIFICANT OCCURRENCE HAS BEEN THE ARREST AND SUBSEQUENT EXECUTION IN EARLY AUGUST OF TWO MEN APPREHENDED FLEEING A VAN DEEMED CURIOUS BY PASDARAN WHICH TURNED OUT TO BE FULL OF DYNAMITE (AND WHICH EXPLOED). THE TWO HAD NOT HAD TIME TO PLACE THE VAN SO AS TO DO ANY DAMAGE. WE COULD NOT DETERMINE WHAT IF ANYTHING THE AUTHORITIES FOUND OUT ABOUT THE MOTIVES OF THE TWO MEN BEFORE THEY WERE KILLED.

THE ABADAN REFINERY MANAGER STRESSED THAT THE PARTIAL SHUTDOWN OF THE ABADAN REFINERY SOME WEEKS BACK WAS DUE TO "ACCIDENTS AND HUMAN ERROR" IN RESPONDING TO A STEAM PIPE BREAK (AS NOTED REFTEL A) AND REPAIRS WERE MADE PROMPTLY AND PRODUCTION RETURNED TO NORMAL WITHIN THREE DAYS. DURING THE MARCH/JUNE PERIOD WHEN STRIKES BY THE CONTRACT WORKERS WERE DISRUPTING PRODUCTION AND REFINERY OPERATIONS, PASDAR AND COMMANDOES SENT TO THE ABADAN REFINERY "SWEPT EVERYTHING BEFORE THEM" AND RESTORED ORDER QUICKLY. THE PASDAR ARE NOT LOCAL BOYS AND OUR CONTACT SAID THAT ARAB WORKERS IN PARTICULAR SINCE THEN HAVE BEEN CAREFUL TO AVOID SITUATIONS THAT COULD ESCALATE INTO CONFRONTATIONS WITH THEM.

NEVERTHELESS, WHILE THE VAST MAJORITY OF OIL WORKERS IN THE SOUTH MAY BE BASICALLY IN SYMPATHY WITH THE NEW REGIME OR COWED BY ITS EFFECTIVE POLICE POWER (AND POSSIBLY ITS INTELLIGENCE APPARATUS IF MADANI'S COMMENT THAT "WE KNOW WHAT IS GOING ON" MEANS ANYTHING), THE AUTORITIES DO NOT DENY THAT EXTREMIST GROUPS EXIST. THE YOUNG, U.S. TRAINED GOVERNOROF ABADAN TOLD US THAT THERE ARE A SMALL NUMBER OF "YOUNG ARABS OF KHUZESTAN WHO WHILE NOT DISTRIBUTING LEAFLETS OF LATE ARE "PROBABLY JUST UNDERGROUND." HE ALSO ADMITTED KNOWLEDGE OF "A COMBINATION OF PRO-SHAH RIGHT AND EXTREME LEFT" THAT IS "WEAK, DISORGANIZED AND UNPOPULAR" BUT STILL CAPABLE OF TERRORIST ACTIVITY.
HE SAID THAT OTHERS UNHAPPY WITH THE NEW REGIME DRAWN FROM THE RANKS OF "FORMER SMUGGLERS, FORMER PROSTITUTES, LEFT WINGERS AND THOSE ADDICTED TO ALCOHOL" COULD POSSIBLY TURN TO TERRORISM.
OIL FIELD SECURITY -- SOME TENTATIVE CONCLUSIONS

FROM THE FOREGOING WE CONCLUDE THAT NIOC MANAGER/ TECHNICIANS AND OTHER STAFF: --SHARE A GENERAL SYMPATHY FOR THE REVOLUTION; --YET ARE TROUBLED IN MANY CASES BY (AND BY THE POSSIBILITIES FOR) REVOLUTIONARY EXCESSES; --ARE EQUALLY WORRIED ABOUT ECONOMIC ISSUES

WE CONCLUDE THAT CONTRACT WORKERS' DISSATISFACTIONS OFFER A POTENTIAL FOR ESCALATING LABOR/MANAGERS CONFRONTATIONS UNLESS: --THE NEW REGIME MOVES QUICKLY TO IMPROVE CONTRACT WORKER LIVING AND WORKING CONDITIONS; --AND IF ARAB NATIONALIST OR LEFTIST LEADERS DO NOT POLITICI AN APPARENTLY NOW REASONABLE APOLITICAL GROUP.

WE ALSO CONCLUDE THAT DISSIDENTS OF A VARIETY POLITICAL VIEWS WILL CONTINUE TO ATTEMMT SABOTAGE OF OIL FIEL INSTALLATIONS IN THE MONTHS AHEAD. HOWEVER, THE THREAT TO PRODUCTION AND EXPORTS SHOULD BE MODERATED BY: ------------------038310 071551Z /40 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 4130 INFO AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY DAMASCUS AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY KUWAIT SECTION 04 OF 04 TEHRAN 10755 --SECURITY MEASURES WHICH LIMIT THE OPPORTUNITIES FOR ATTACKS AGAINST MAJOR INSTALLATIONS; --NIOC'S CAPABILITY TO REPAIR FAIRLY ROUTINE DAMAGE TO ITS RELATIVELY PROMPTLY.

COMMENT: THE RECENT SPATE OF TERRORIST ATTACKS IN THE SOUTH AND NAZIH'S ABRUPT DEPARTURE CAME JUST AT THE END OF OUR VISIT. WE DO NOT KNOW WHO IS BEHIND THE LATEST BOMBINGS, BUT WE HAVE CONFIRMED THAT THEY HAVE HAD AS YET NO DIRECT IMPACT ON OIL OPERATIONS. THE LONGER TERM IMPLICATIONS ARE THAT SKILLED WORKERS WILL INCREASINGLY LEAVE AND EXPATRIATES INVITED BACK WILL NOT COME. THE CONSEQUENCES OF NAZIH'SDISMISSAL ARENOT YET ALL CLEAR.

IF MANAGER/TECHNICIANS ASSOCIATED WITH THE FORMER REGIME ARE TO BE HUNTED OUT OF THE COMPANY, THE LOSS OF THESE PEOPLE AND OTHERS WHO FLEE IN FRIGHT COULD ALSO MAKE A REALITY THE CRITICAL MANPOWER SHORTAGES THAT MANY FEAR BUT WHICH DO NOT SEEM TO EXIST AT PRESENT. IF, ON THE OTHER HAND, NAZIH'S REMOVAL HELPS TO DEFUSE THE POLITICALLY SENSITIVE ISSUE OF CONTRACT WORKERS RESENTMENT AT THEIR CONTINUED EXPLOITATION BY THE COMPANY, THEN OIL FIELD SECURITY MAY EVEN BE ENHANCED. THE CONCERN THAT NAZIH'S REPLACEMENT WILL, THROUGH MISMANAGEMENT OR DELIBERATE POLICY, CAUSE OIL PRODUCTION AND EXPORTS TO BE REDUCED SEEMS NOT TO BE JUSTIFIED.

THERE ARE CAPABLE MEN TO REPLACE NAZIH, AND AS FAR AS WE CAN TELL HE WAS FIRED FOR HIS CRITICISM OF THE CLERGY PLUS INSENSITIVITY TO THE CONTRACT WORKER ISSUE, NOT BECAUSE HE WORKED HARD TO MAINTAIN THE REVOLUTION'S 4 MILLION B/D PRODUCTION CEILING. WE WILL OF COURSE FOLLOW DEVELOPMENTS WITH CLOSE INTEREST.
REVOLUTION.

FISCAL AUTHORITY. TRADITIONALLY, PROCEEDS FROM TAXES COLLECTED THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY WERE SENT TO TEHRAN, WHERE THEY WERE CENTRALLY APPORTIONED BY MINISTRY AND PROVINCE. THF FIRST OF THE TWO NEW BILLS RECENTLY PASSED WOULD AUTHORIZE COLLECTION AND RETENTION EVEN AT THE VILLAGE LEVEL OF SOME TAXES ALONG WITH COMMUNITY DECISION AS TO HOW THESE REVENUES WOULD BE EXPENDED. THE SAME FISCAL AUTONOMY WOULD BE GRANTED TO CITIES AND PROVINCES.

NEITHER THE MANNER IN WHICH THESE COMMUNITIES TAX THEMSELVES (I.E., INCOME, REAL ESTATE, PERSONAL PROPERTY, SALES), NOR THE PURPOSES TO WHICH TAXES WILL BE APPLIED ARE SPELLED OUT IN THE AUTHORIZING LEGISLATION. BANIASSADI HAD THE IDEA THAT ONE TAX WOULD BE A SORT OF TRANSIT TAX ON NON-INHABITANTS, "RATHER LIKE THE AIRPORT TAX PAID BY INTERNATIONAL TRAVELLERS." (OR LIKE SPEED TRAPS?)

PRESENTLY, BANI-ASSADI WENT ON, LOCALITIES WILL STILL HAVE TO DEPEND ON TEHRAN (AND OIL REVENUES) FOR THE FINANCING OF SCHOOLS, LOCAL ROADS, HOSPITALS, ET AL. IN TIME, HOWEVER, "AS IRAN BECOMES SELF-SUFFICIENT CHIEFLY THROUGH GREATER RELIANCE ON AGRICULTURE," LOCALITIES WILL BE ABLE TO SELF-FINANCE ALL SUCH EXPENSES. AT THAT POINT, OIL REVENUES COULD BE DEDICATED EXCLUSIVELY TO MAJOR PROJECTS OF NATIONAL SIGNIFICANCE.

CRUSADE. WHAT WOULD MAKE THE SYSTEM WORK, BANI-ASSADI INSISTED,WAS THE ENTHUSIASM UNLEASHED BY THE REVOLUTION, AND A DESIRE FOR POPULAR PARTICIPATION IN GOVERNMENT HITHERTO UNKNOWN IN IRAN. THIS ENTHUSIASM WAS LIKE "MOLTEN METAL," WHICH HAD TO BE PROPERLY INSTITUTIONALIZED BEFORE IT COOLED, AFTER WHICH IT WOULD BE TOO LATE. THE CRUSADE FOR RECONSTRUCTION WAS A PRINCIPAL MEANS OF KEEPING THIS REVOLUTIONARY SPIRIT "MOLTEN" WHILE THESE NEW INSTITUTIONS WERE BEING SHAPED. NEVER BEFORE IN HISTORY, RHAPSODIZED BANI-ASSADI, HAD SUCH GENUINE ENTHUSIASM BEEN AROUSED.
THE CRUSADE IS DISCUSSED IN FOLLOWING MESSAGES. LAINGEN

INTRODUCTION: DURING HIS INITIAL CALLS, TDY ECONOFF HAS UNCOVERED SOME GENUINE CONCERNS ABOUT THE PACE OF ECONOMIC RECOVERY. ONE TYPICAL CONVERSATION IS REPORTED HERE. THOSE WHO HARBOR THESE MISGIVINGS NEVERTHELESS AGREE THAT THE SITUATION IS CONSIDERABLY BETTER THAN IT WAS SIX MONTHS AGO, AND ESPECIALLY CONSIDERING THAT THE COUNTRY HAS BEEN THROUGH A REVOLUTION. END INTRODUCTION.

ONE KEY INDICATOR OF THE PACE OF ECONOMIC RECOVERY WOULD BE THE EXTENT TO WHICH GOVERNMENT PUMP-PRIMING HAS BEEN ABSORBED WITHIN THE ECONOMY. FIVE MONTHS AGO, THE CENTRAL BANK (CBI) WAS INSTRUCTED TO PUMP EIGHTY BILLION RIALS INTO THE ECONOMY, BY THE FOLLOWING MEANS. SUPPOSE, FOR EXAMPLE, AN INDUSTRIALIST NEEDS TO IMPORT FOREIGN COMPONENTS FOR HIS PRODUCT. HE IS FACED AT THE THRESHHOLD WITH A DEMAND BY HIS SUPPLIER FOR A CONFIRMED LETTER OF CREDIT, WHICH, OFTEN AS NOT, MEANS THAT HE HAS TO PUT UP THE FULL PURCHASE PRICE IN CASH.

THROUGH THIS FACILITY, THE INDUSTRIALIST HAS ONLY TO GO TO THE MINISTRY RESPONSIBLE FOR HIS AREA OF ACTIVITY, AND PRESENT HIS CASE. THE MINISTRY THEN ISSUES A "PERMISSION" TO CBI. THE INDUSTRIALIST HAS THEN TO APPLY TO ANY ONE OF 10 COMMERCIAL BANKS, SELECTED BY CBI AS THE STRONGEST IN THE SYSTEM, WHICH WILL ADVANCE TO HIM FUNDS IN TURN ADVANCED TO THE BANK BY CBI OUT OF THE 80 BILLION RIALS. WE UNDERSTAND THAT THE FACILITY IS NOT LIMITED TO DOLLAR EXCHANGE PROBLEMS. ANY LEGITIMATE CASH SHORTAGE THAT IS HAMPERING A RETURN TO FULL ACTIVITY CAN BE MITIGATED BY THIS MEANS.

ACCORDING TO THE DIRECTOR GENERAL OF THE CREDIT DEPARTMENT OF THE CENTRAL BANK (MAHDAVI), IT HAD BEEN EXPECTED THAT THESE 10 COMMERCIAL BANKS WOULD ADVANCE ONE-HALF OF THE REQUESTED CREDIT FROM THEIR OWN FUNDS. (WITH SOLID DEPOSIT BASES AND A GOOD RATE OF COLLECTIONS, THESE BANKS ARE VERY LIQUID, AND WOULD HAVE EVERY REASON TO KEEP THEIR CASH WORKING.) AS IT TURNS OUT, THESE BANKS HAVE DRAWN DOWN ONLY VERY LITTLE OF THE EIGHTY BILLION RIAL FACILITY. MORE IMPORTANTLY, LENDING FROM THEIR OWN FUNDS HAS BEEN MINIMAL. "THE CASH," MURMURED MAHDAVI,"IS JUST NOT BEING ABSORBED."

EXPLANATIONS POINT TO SEVERAL FACTORS, OF WHICH THE COMMONEST IS THAT OF LACK OF BUSINESS CONFIDENCE. ACTING BOTH AS CAUSE AND EFFECT HAS BEEN THE FLIGHT OF SOME OF THE ABLEST BUSINESS EXECUTIVES IN THE COUNTRY, WITH THOSE FILLING IN BEHIND THEM (WITH EXCEPTIONS) NOT OF THE SAME CALIBER. PARTICULARLY IN THE IMPORTING FIELD, MANY OF THE OLD-LINE FIRMS WHOSE PRINCIPALS WERE CLOSELY ASSOCIATED WITH THE OLD REGIME ARE NOW DEFUNCT. BAZAAR MERCHANTS NOW TRYING TO TAKE THEIR PLACE HARDLY KNOW WHERE TO BEGIN, IN SOME CASES.

SOME OTHER BUSINESSMEN IN HIGHLY VISIBLE POSITIONS BUT NOT OF THE SAME IDEOLOGICAL BENT AS THE NEW REGIME, FEAR FOR THEIR JOBS. FOR EXAMPLE, ENGINEER BARADAR IS ACTING MANAGING DIRECTOR OF THE INDUSTRIAL AND MINING DEVELOPMENT BANK OF IRAN (IMDBI) DURING THE ABSENCE OF MANAGING DIRECTOR MOQADAM. IT IS WIDELY RUMORED THAT MOQADAM HAS ELECTED NOT TO RETURN. AND WESTERN-ORIENTED BARADAR, WITH 19 YEARS IN IMDBI WONDERS HOW LONG HE WILL BE ALLOWED TO REMAIN. "I CANNOT CHANNE MY PSYCHOLOGY," (IE. BECOME A 'BORN AGAIN' MUSLIM) AT THIS POINT IN MY LIFE," CONCEDES BARADAR.

SIMILARLY DISQUIETING IS THE LIKELY FUTURE EXTENT OF GOVERNMENT OWNERSHIP AND CONTROL, AS WELL AS THE EXTENT OF THE ROLE TO BE PLAYED BY LABOR COMMITTEES. WITH SO MANY UNCERTAINTIES, MANAGERS ARE NOT LIKELY TO BE RISK TAKERS, SUCH AS WOULD LEAD THEM INTO FRESH INVESTMENT THROUGH BORROWINGS AT THE BANKS. NOR, IN FACE OF THE SAME UNCERTAINTIES, ARE BANKERS LIKELY TO FOLLOW ANYTHING BUT HIGHLY CONSERVATIVE LENDING POLICIES. THEIR CAUTION, CONTINUED MAHDAVI, IS REINFORCED BY ------------------045991 090901Z /12 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 4141 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 10770 ATIONALIZATION.

AS CIVIL SERVANTS, RATHER THAN PRIVATE ENTREPENEURS INTERESTED IN PROFITS, IRAN'S COMMERCIAL BANKERS ARE LESS LIKELY TO BE RISK-TAKERS. ALL THESE IMPEDIMENTS TO INITIATIVE, HE WENT ON, ARE COMPOUNDED BY INEFFECTIVENESS AT THE GOVERNMENT LEVEL. THE RESULTS OF THE INTERACTION OF ALL THESE FACTORS, SAYS MAHDAVI, IS PLANTS OPERATING AT HALF-CAPACITY, AND THE ECONOMY AS WELL.

COMMENT. MANAGING DIRECTOR AFGHANI OF ONE OF THE 10 COMMERCIAL BANKS, BANK SADERAT IRAN, AGREED WITH MAHDAVI ONLY IN PART. IT WAS PERFECTLY TRUE THAT THE BANKS WERE NOT FINANCING ANY NEW INVESTMENT. THERE WAS A LOT OF SLACK IN THE COMMERCIAL SECTOR. BUT IN THE INDUSTRIAL SECTOR, AND PARTICULARLY IN THE MAJOR INDUSTRIES TAKEN OVER BY THE GOVERNMENT, GOVERNMENT-APPOINTED MANAGERS WERE COMING INTO THE BANKS TO BORROW TO COVER PURCHASES OF RAW MATERIALS, AND MEET OTHER DAY-TO-DAY OPERATING NEEDS.

THE DIFFERENCE OF OPINION MAY WELL BE ONE OF PERCEPTION. AFGHANI WAS CLEARLY FOR THE REVOLUTION AND ITS CHANGES, EVEN IF THIS CAUSES SOME DISLOCATIONS. NOTHING SO FAR INDICATES THAT THE SLOW IMPROVEMENT OBSERVED OVER THE PAST 6 MONTHS WILL NOT CONTINUE. HOWEVER, WE NEED TO KNOW A GREAT DEAL MORE ABOUT WHAT IS GOING ON IN THE INDUSTRIAL SECTOR BEFORE WE WILL BE IN A POSITION TO DRAW ANY FIRM

ZADEH STATED THAT PGOI HAD DECIDED THAT IRANIAN RECOGNITION OF FORMER GOVERNMENT SIMPLY CARRIED OVER TO NEW AMIN GOVERNMENT AND THAT PGOI HAD NO INTENTION OF BREAKING RELATIONS WITH AFGHANISTAN.

ZADEH HAD BEEN VERY INTERESTED TWO WEEKS AGO IN WHAT US, PAKISTAN AND INDIAN RELATIONS WITH AMIN GOVERNMENT WOULD BE. PGOI HAS OBVIOUSLY DECIDED TO GO EASY ROUTE OF DECLARING THAT NO DECISION ON RECOGNITION OR NON-RECOGNITION NEED BE MADE AS AMIN GOVERNMENT UNDER THEIR THEORY IS SIMPLY A DIFFERENT VERSION OF THE PREVIOUS

DURING THE LAST WEEK THERE HAS BEEN INCREASED VIOLENCE IN BOTH KURDESTAN AND KHUZESTAN PROVINCES. ON SUNDAY, OCTOBER 7, A DELEGATION OF SOME OF IRAN'S TOP MILITARY AND CIVILIAN LEADERS MET WITH KHOMEINI TO DISCUSS HOW TO MEET THIS INCREASED ACTIVITY. THE DELEGATION INCLUDED DEFENSE MINISTER CHAMRAN, UNDERSECRETARY OF DEFENSE KHAMNEYI, INTERIOR MINISTER SABAGHIAN, JCS CHIEF SHAKER, GROUND FORCES COMMANDER FALLAHI REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS COMMANDER AYATOLLAH LAHOUTI AND REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS OPERATIONS COMMANDER ABU SHARIF. WE DO NOT YET KNOW WHAT WAS DECIDED BUT THE MEETING ITSELF GIVES AN INDICATION OF THE SERIOUSNESS WITH WHICH THE PGOI REGARDS THE UPTURN IN VIOLENCE IN BOTH AREAS.

KHUZESTAN: OVER THE LAST WEEK IRAN'S OIL PRODUCING AREA HAS BEEN ROCKED BY A SERIES OF BOMBS AND SHOOTINGS LEAVING, AS OF OCTOBER 7, AT LEAST 12 DEAD AND 53 WOUNDED. WE DO NOT HAVE A CLEAR IDEA YET OF WHO IS BEHIND THESE ACTIVITIES. THE PGOI UNTIL RECENTLY HAS SEEMED TO ASSUME THAT GUERILLA ACTIVITY WOULD COME FROM ARABS. WE DO NOT KNOW IF OTHERS, THE TUDEH OR FEDAYEEN FOR EXAMPLE, MAY BE INVOLVED.

KHUZESTAN HAD BEEN RELATIVELY QUIET SINCE VIOLENT CLASHES BETWEEN ARAB NATIONALIST FORCES AND REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS LAST MAY BROUGHT A FIRM PGOI REACTION. ADMIRAL MADANI (COMMANDER OF THE NAVY AND GOVERNOR OF KHUZESTAN) AT THAT TIME SUPPRESSED THE DISTURBANCES, CLOSED ARAB CULTURAL CENTERS, SENT ARAB RELIGIOUS LEADER SHEIKH TAHER SHOBEIR KHAGHANI AS HOSTAGE TO QOM AND EXECUTED SEVERAL ARAB LEADERS. THE PGOI UNTIL LAST WEEK PLAINLY FELT THESE MEASURES HAD BEEN SUCCESSFUL. ACTIVITIES THE PAST WEEK HAVE BEEN AS FOLLOWS: - SEPTEMBER 30: - AN EXPLOSION AT A COMMUNICATIONS TOWER OF THE KHORRAMSHAR AHWAZ ROAD BLEW OUT COMMERCIAL COMMUNICATIONS BETWEEN KHORRAMSHAHR, ABADAN AND THE REST OF IRAN.

COMMUNICATIONS WITH THE AREA ARE NOW BEING CHANNELED THROUGH THE NIOC NETWORK. THE SAME DAY AN EXPLOSION OCCURRED ATTHE KHORRAMSHAR GOVERNOR'S OFFICE. - OCTOBER 3: - BOMB ON TEHRAN- KHORRAMSHAR TRAIN KILLED ABOUT EIGHT; A PIPE FACTORY AT NAVARD NEAR AHWAZ WAS BOMBED. FARSI LANGUAGE KAYHAN ALSO REPORTED ATTACKS ON "OIL STORAGE DEPOTS" BEING FENDED OFF BY GUARDS BUT DID NOT SAY WHERE. - OCTOBER 4: - EIGHT PERSONS WERE EXECUTED IN ABADAN ON CHARGES RANGING FROM SABOTAGE, SPYING TO BOMBING THE TRAIN.

(EVEN THOUGH TO OUR KNOWLEDGE THE PGOI DOES NOT YET KNOW WHO BOMBED THE TRAIN). - OCTOBER 5: - (1) BOMBS EXPLODED IN ABADAN AND KHORRAMSHAR (TWO KILLED) MARKETS AND AT THE UNIVERSITY OF AHWAZ. (2) AN UNUSED PIPELINE FROM CLOSED IN OIL WELL 120 TO THE AHWAZ INSTALLATION WAS EXPLODED SETTING ON FIRE RESIDUAL OIL IN THE LINE. (THIS DID NOT AFFECT OIL PRODUCTION). (3) TWO MICROWAVE CENTERS WERE ATTACKED BY GUERILLAS WITHOUT RESULT AT GHOUST ON THE AHWAZBEBBAHAN ROAD AND AT A STATION ON THE AHWAZ-ANDIMESHK ROAD. - OCTOBER 6: - (1) A MINE ON A ROAD NEAR AHWAZ DESTROYED A CAR (BLAZER).

(2) A FOUNDING MEMBER OF THE ARAB PEOPLE'S ORGANIZATION ABDASSAB MOUSAVI-ASI WAS ARRESTED IN TEHRAN SUPPOSEDLY ACCORDING TO TEHRAN PRESS IN CONNECTION WITH THE TRAIN BOMBING. ------------------048573 091729Z /47 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 4164 INFO SECDEF WASH DC JCS WASH DC AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE SECTION 02 OF 03 TEHRAN 10804

IT IS DIFFICULT TO TELL WHAT--OTHER THAN SIMMERING ARAB RESENTMENT OF PGOI REPRESSION--MIGHT BE TRIGGERING THESE ATTACKS. SOME OBSERVERS HAVE BEEN SPECULATING FOR WEEKS THAT THE TIME WAS COMING WHEN THE ARABS WOULD RISE IN KHUZESTAN TO SUPPORT KURDISH ACTIVITY IN THE NORTHWEST. WHILE THE ARABS MAY HAVE FELT THAT THE GOVERNMENT WAS TIED DOWN BY THE REBELLION IN KURDESTAN, THERE IS NO EVIDENCE OF A KURDISH-ARAB LINK, NOR HAS THERE HISTORICALLY BEEN ANY LOVE LOST BETWEEN THESE TWO MINORITIES. THERE IS ALSO A POSSIBILITY THAT THE CURRENT ROUND OF ATTACKS BEGAN IN RESPONSE TO THE EXECUTIONS IN KHORRAMSHAR SEPTEMBER 29 OF TWO ARABS.
WE HAVE NO INDICATION OF WHAT-IF ANY--CONNECTION THESE INCIDENTS HAVE TO NAZIH AFFAIR.

COMMENT: THESE ATTACKS, WHILE DOING DAMAGE TO COMMUNICATIONS NETWORKS WITH THE SOUTH, HAVE NOT THUS FAR DIRECTLY AFFECTED OIL PRODUCTION FACILITIES. EMBASSY DOES NOT FEEL THAT UNLESS CURRENT ROUND OF ATTACKS STIRS SUPPORT FROM ARABS OR LEFTISTS WITHIN THE REFINERIES, THAT OIL PRODUCTION FACILITIES WILL BE AFFECTED. GUERILLAS ARE PLAINLY TARGETTING SOME OIL INSTALLATIONS (PIPELINES, OIL STORAGE DEPOTS). HOWEVER, MAIN FACILITIES AT KHARG ISLAND DEPOT ARE ISOLATED AND WELL PROTECTED; ABADAN REFINERY IS WELL GUARDED AND MANY OF THE CRUDE PIPELINES LEADING TO ABADAN AND KHARG ARE BURIED ALTHOUGH AT SOME POINTS EVEN THESE LINES ARE EXPOSED.

IN ADDITION, EVEN DURING STRIKES LAST YEAR PRODUCTION FACILITIES WERE NOT SABOTAGED AS REVOLUTIONARIES HAD NO DESIRE TO DESTROY MAIN SOURCE OF WEALTH IN KHUZESTAN. WE HAVE YET TO SEE IF THIS WILL HOLD TRUE FOR THESE REBELS.

KURDESTAN: THE KURDISH AREAS CONTINUED TO HEAT UP THIS WEEK CULMINATING OCTOBER 8 WITH AN AMBUSH OF A RELIEF COLUMN OF 73 REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS IN WHICH MOST WERE KILLED OR CAPTURED. (SEE REFTEL FOR EVENTS THRU OCTOBER 2). ACCORDING TO PRESS REPORTS ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, OCTOBER 3, KURDISH REBELS ATTACKED THE MAHABAD RADIO/TELEVISION STATION TEMPORARILY CLOSING IT (TWO TANKS FROM THE MAHABAD GARRISON WERE INVOLVED IN THE FIGHT); ON OCTOBER 4, REBELS ATTACKED REVOLUTIONARY GUARD HEADQUARTERS AT MAHABAD AND A TRUCK HIT A LANDMINE NEAR BANEH; ON FRIDAY EVENING, OCTOBER 5, KURDISH GUERILLAS ATTACKED THE MAHABAD GARRISON REPORTEDLY USING 50 CALIBER MACHINE GUNS AND RPG 7 GRENADES.

THEY WERE DRIVEN BACK. THERE WERE ALSO SPOT ATTACKS NEAR NOWSUD AND KERMANSHAH. ON SATURDAY, OCTOBER 6, DEMONSTRATING YOUTHS IN MAHABAD REPORTEDLY TRIED TO ATTACK TURKISH SHOPS AND KURDISH REBELS ATTACKED REVOLUTIONARY GUARD HEADQUARTERS IN BANEH. DURING THESE SKIRMISHES NO ONE APPEARS TO HAVE BEEN KILLED. HOWEVER, ON OCTOBER 8, KURDS AMBUSHED A RELIEF COLUMN OF 73 REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS ENROUTE TO BANEH ON THE BANEH-SARDSHT ROAD, KILLING 22 AND TAKING MOST OTHERS HOSTAGE. ONLY SEVEN ESCAPED. THE AMBUSH FOLLOWED REBEL ATTACKS ON FOUR GENDARMARIE POSTS AT DOAB, NOWSUD, SHAIKHAN AND SHUSHMI ON THE IRAQI BORDER.

PGOI EXECUTIONS HAVE CONTINUED IN KURDESTAN WITH FOUR MORE IN KERMANSHAH ON CHARGES OF "SODOMY AND CONTRABAND" ON OCTOBER 6. THE EXECUTIONS ARE PLAINLY HAVING AN INFLAMATORY EFFECT, AND THE TEHRAN TIMES ITSELF COMMENTS THAT "EXECUTIONS OF KURDISH MILITANTS AT MAHABAD HAVE PROVOKED REPRISAL KILLINGS OF CAPTURED REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS." THE MAIN TARGETS OF THE KURDS APPEAR TO BE THE HATED REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS WHO ARE TAKING AN INCREASINGLY HARSH STAND.

ON OCTOBER 6 UNDER THIS PRESSURE THE LEADER OF THE REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS IN MAHABAD STATED THAT BECAUSE OF THESE ATTACKS THE GUARDS WOULD NO LONGER BE HELD RESPONSIBLE FOR THE LOSS OF LIVES AND PROPERTY AMONG THE PEOPLE WHEN THEY COUNTER ATTACK.

ACCORDING TO KORMANSHAH GOVERNOR GENERAL SEPEHRIPOUR, HE HAS RECEIVED A MESSAGE THAT KURDISH RELIGIOUS LEADER HOSSEINI HAS NOW ISSUED A GENERAL CALL FOR KURDS TO LAUNCH AN ALL OUT WAR ON THE CENTRAL GOVERNMENT. RECENT KURDISH ATTACKS DO SEEM TO HAVE BOTH INCREASED IN INTENSITY AND ORGANIZATION.

ON OCTOBER 9, AT 1728 HOURS, A GROUP OF DEMONSTRATORS NUMBERING 350-500 MARCHED DOWN TAKHTE JAMSHID AND STOPPED AT THE FRONT OF THE EMBASSY FOR 5-6 MINUTES CHANTING "DEATH TO AMERICA" AND "THE CONSPIRACY IN KURDESTAN IS DIRECTED BY AMERICA". THE CROWD THEN CONTINUED TO MARCH PEACEFULLY BUT VOCIFEROUSLY AWAY FROM THE EMBASSY.

THERE WERE NO ATTEMPTS TO ENTER THE EMBASSY COMPOUND NOR WERE THERE ANY DISPLAYS OF VIOLENCE. ORDER WAS MAINTAINED BY CROWD MARSHALLS. POLICE ASSIGNED TO THE EMBASSY STATED THAT THEY WOULD ONLY TAKE ACTION IF AN ATTEMPT WERE MADE BY THE DEMONSTRATORS TO ENTER THE COMPOUND.
DEMONSTRATION WOULD SEEM TO HAVE BEEN PROVOKED BY FULL PAGE ARTICLE IN "JUMHURI-YE-ISLAMI" THIS MORNING ACCUSING U.S. OF INVOLVEMENT IN KURDESTAN EVENTS AND OF

THE OCTOBER 10 JUMHURI ISLAMI REPORTED ON A SMALL DEMONSTRATION IN FRONT OF THE U.S. EMBASSY YESTERDAY BY THE ISLAMIC ASSOCIATION OF TEHRAN UNIVERSITY STUDENTS AND THE MUSLIM STUDENTS OF SHARIF UNIVERSITY (FORMER ARYAMEHR), IN PROTEST AGAINST U.S. INVOLVEMENT IN KURDESTAN. THE ARTICLE INCLUDED A PROVOCATIVE PHOTO OF THE BODY OF ONE OF THE 52 REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS BURNED DURING THE AMBUSH AT SARDASHT WITH THE CAPTION "HUMAN RIGHTS, AMERICAN STYLE* LOOK AT THIS PICTURE OF A YOUNG REVOLUTIONARY GUARD WHO WAS BURNED TO DEATH BY PAID U.S. AGENTS. THIS IS THE TRUE IMAGE OF U.S.

WORLD POLICY: KILLING, BURNING, AND DESTROYING FOR ONLY ONE AIM - PLUNDER." THE ARTICLE DESCRIBED THE THE DEMONSTRATORS AS ANGRILY LIFTING THEIR FISTS IN THE AIR, SCREAMING "DOWN WITH AMERICA." THEY CARRIED A RESOLUTION ACCUSING "IMPERIALISTS", "EXTREME LEFTISTS", INTERNATIONAL ZIONISTS IN THE GUISE OF THE KURDISH DEMOCRATIC PARTY (KDP), ASHRAF PAHLAVI AND PALIZBAN OF BEING ACTIVE PARTICIPANTS IN ANTI-REVOLUTIONARY ACTIVITIES. THE JUMHURI ISLAMI REPORTER ENDED HIS PIECE WITH THE ASSERTION THAT THE SARDASHT MASSACRE WAS THE ACT OF THE KDP, "THE PAID AGENTS OF THE U.S.".

COMMENT: GIVEN THE INFLUENCE OF JUMHURI ISLAMI AS THE AUTHORITATIVE SPOKESMAN FOR THE CLERICAL LEADERSHIP, PUBLIC OPINION WILL OBVIOUSLY BE MOLDED BY WHAT THE NEWSPAPER HAS BEEN PUBLISHING FOR THE LAST SEVERAL DAYS. THE ANTI-U.S. REPORTING AND ANALYSES IN THIS SPECIFIC PRESS HAS HEIGHTENED WITH OUTRIGHT ACCUSATIONS OF U.S. AGENTS INVOLVED IN INCIDENTS IN KURDESTAN AND KHUZESTAN AS WELL AS U.S. PLOTS TO UNDERMINE IRANIAN-ARAB RELATIONS. AS A RESULT OF THIS CONTINUING TREND I INTEND TO MEET WITH THE EDITOR OF JUMHURI ISLAMI, MIR HUSSEIN MOOSAVI, ASAP. ROSEN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

ACCORDING TO PRESS AND RADIO REPORTS,IN RESPONSE TO AMBUSH OF REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS (REFTEL) DEF MIN CHAMRAN HAS FLOWN TO KURDESTAN TO OVERSEE OPERATIONS AGAINST REBELS. AT THE SAME TIME JCS CHIEF SHAKER ANNOUNCED THAT THE ARMY HAD "EXTENSIVE PLANS TO COUNTER THE KURDISH REBELS" AND INTERIOR MINISTER SABAGHIAN TOLD THE PRESS THAT THE PGOI PLANNED TO TAKE THE WAR OUT OF THE TOWNS INTO THE MOUNTAINS "AFTER THE AREA IS STUDIED."

STORY OF AMBUSH SEEMS FAR FROM CLEAR: AMBUSH REPORTEDLY TOOK PLACE SUNDAY, OCTOBER 7; IT IS UNCLEAR WHETHER 22 OR 52 GUARDSMEN WERE KILLED IN AMBUSH WHICH SEEMS TO HAVE OCCURRED WHEN REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS WITHDREW FROM GENDARMARIE POST NEAR SARDASHT TO BANEH WITHOUT COORDINATING WITH LOCAL ARMY COMMANDER AND AGAINST HIS

CERIMONIES FOR THE SLAIN GUARDS WERE HELD OCTOBER 10 IN CITIES ACROSS IRAN. IN TEHRAN, THE BAZAAR CLOSED AND CERIMONIES WERE HELD AT THE UNIVERSITY OF TEHRAN BUT NO FURTHER DEMONSTRATIONS HAVE APPEARED AT EMBASSY. (OCT 9 DEMONSTRATIONS, ACCORDING TO JUMHURI-E-ISLAMI, WERE ORGANIZED BY TEHRAN UNIVERSITY ISLAMIC STUDENTS SOCIETY AND SHARIF INDUSTRIAL UNIVERSITY MOSLEM STUDENTS ORGANIZATION.)

RIGHT-WING ISLAMIC PAPER JUMHURI-E-ISLAMI CONTINUED ITS ATTACKS TODAY ON ALLEGED AMERICAN INVOLVEMENT IN KURDESTAN FRONT PAGING A GORY PICTURE OF A CHARRED REVOLUTIONARY GUARD ENTITLED "HUMAN RIGHTS AMERICAN STYLE". (SEE SEPTEL FOR DETAILS).

IN ADDITION PRESS CARRIED STORY BY REUTERS FROM BEIRUT THAT PGOI DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER TABATABAI CHARGED THAT THE SHAH HAD PAID TWO HUNDRED MILLION DOLLARS TWO WEEKS AGO THROUGH EX-AMBASSADOR ZAHEDI TO FINANCE THE KURDISH REBELLION. COMMENT: PGOI COMMENTS THUS FAR HAVE BEEN FAIRLY NON-SPECIFIC ON OUTSIDE INTERFERENCE BUT IT SEEMS PLAIN THEY SUSPECT IRAQI INTERFERENCE WITH THE KURDS AS WELL AS SOME VAGUE "ISRAELI" CONNECTION.

ON WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 10, IN COURSE OF ALREADY SCHEDULED MEETING WITH ACTING HEAD OF THE MFA 4TH DIVISION PARSA KIA, ACTING POL COUNCELLOR SHOWED PARSA KIA A COPY OF THE JUMHURI-E-ISLAMI ARTICLE AND EXPRESSED EMBASSY'S CONCERN OVER TONE OF THE REPORTS OF US ALLEGED INVOLVEMENT IN KURDESTAN. EMBOFF POINTED OUT THAT SUCH UNFOUNDED REPORTING MAY HAVE ENCOURAGED SMALL DEMONSTRATION AGAINST EMBASY OCTOBER 9. EMBOFF CONTINUED THAT JUMHURI-E-ISLAMI WAS AFTERALL PAPER OF AYATOLLAH BEHESHTI'S ISLAMIC REPUBLICAN PARTY. PARSA KIA ASSURED EMBOFF THAT PGOI WAS NOT INVOLVED IN SUCH STORIES OAD THAT NO PGOI OFFICIALS HAD EVER ACCUSED USG OF INVOLVEMENT IN KURDESTAN.

HE RECOGNIZED THAT SOME PRESS REPORTS HAD MENTIONED US, BUT STATED THAT ONLY ACCUSATIONS BY PGOI OFFICIALS OF INVOLVEMENT OF OUTSIDE POWERS HE HAD SEEN WERE DIRECTED AGAINST ISRAEL AND IRAQ. PARSA KIA STATED PGOI DID NOT CONTROL "FREE" PRESS SUCH AS JUMHURI-EISLAMI BUT THAT HE UNDERSTOOD OUR CONCERN OVER THESE STORIES. HE SAID HE WOULD CONVEY OUR CONCERN TO FOREIGN MINISTER YAZDI WO HAS JUST RETURNED TO IRAN. PARSA KIA REMARKED THAT YAZDI WOULD BE GIVING A PRESS CONFERENCE THAT AFTERNOON TO DISCUSS HIS TRIP. IN COURSE OF CONVERSATION, EMBOFF REPEATED ASSURANCE (STATE 247846) OF USG RESPECT FOR PGOI TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY. LAINGEN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: MASHHAD UNIVERSITY OPENED ON SCHEDULE THIS YEAR AND IS OPERATING PEACEFULLY. ALTHOUGH DIVISIONS EXSITAMOUNG GROUPS OF STUDENTS AND FACULTY, THESE DIVISIONS HAVE NOT LED TO OPEN CLASHES. PROGRESSIVE ISLAMIC GROUPS ARE MOST INFLUENTIAL AMONG THE STUDENTS, AND THE NON-ISLAMIC LEFT HAS LITTLE FOLLOWING. THE RIGHT-WING ISLAMIC GROUPS HAVE A MINORITY STUDENT FOLLOWING, (#) UNIVERSITY FACULTY AND ADMINISTRATION. A UNIVERSITY PURGE COMMITTEE HAS BEEN FORMED AND HAS SO FAR BEEN ABLE TO PRESERVE CONSENSUS AMONG ITS MEMBERS. END SUMMARY.

DURING RECENT VISIT TO MASHHAD, EMBASSY POLITICAL OFFICER SPOKE TO FACULTY MEMBERS AND OTHERS ABOUT CONDITIONS AT MASHHAD UNIVERSITY. THE UNIVERSITY HAD OPENED ON SCHEDULE (SEPTEMBER 23) AND CLASSES WERE PROCEEDING IN AN ORDERLY FASHION. BECAUSE OF THE LATE ANNOUNCEMENT OF ENTRANCE EXAMINATION RESULTS, FRESHMAN REGISTRATION WAS DELAYED ABOUT TWO WEEKS.

DURING LATE 1978 AND EARLY 1979, UNIVERSITY WAS RUN BY COORDINATING COMMITTEE DOMINATED BY LOCAL CHAPTER OF IRANIAN ASSOCIATION OF UNIVERSITY PROFESSORS (IAUP) AND ITS STUDENT ALLIES. ALL FORMER UNIVERSITY OFFICIALS, WITH THE EXCEPTION OF THE VICE-CHANCELLOR FOR FINANCIAL AFFAIRS, HAD LEFT MASHHAD BEFORE THE FEBRUARY REVOLUTION. AFTER THE REVOLUTION, DR. SAHAMI OF THE UNIVERSITY FACULTY WAS APPOINTED CHANCELLOR WITH THE UNANIMOUS CONSENT OF ALL GROUPS. .

WITHIN THE PAST SIX MONTHS, HOWEVER, GREATER AUTHORITY HAS BEEN TAKEN BY THE VICE-CHANCELLOR, DR. BARADARAN-RAFIHI OF THE SCHOOL OF EDUCATION. DR. RAFIHI APPARENTLY HAS IMPORTANT ALLIES AMONG THE RIGHT-WING RELIGIOUS GROUPS IN MASHHAD AND AMONG THEIR STUDENT SYMPATHIZERS. HIS AUTHORITY REPORTEDLY EXCEEDS THAT OF THE CHANCELLOR WHO HAS UNSUCCESSFULLY TRIED TO RESIGN SEVERAL TIMES. ACCORPU CHANCELLOR REFUSED TO ACCEPT IT."

STUDENT ELECTIONS HAVE BEEN DOMINATED BY THE PROGRESSIVE MUSLIM GROUPS KNOWN LOCALLY AS PISHGAM, JONBESH, AND MOJAHEDIN, THESE GROUPS CONSIDER THENSELVES FOLLOWERS OF THE FORMER MASHHAD PROFESSOR THE LATE DR. ALI SHARIATI A JJAN-E-KHALQ ARE MUCH WEAKER AMONG THE STUDENTS, BUT THEY SHARE MANY OF THE VIEWS OF THE PROGRESSIVE ISLAMIC GROUPS AND SHARE THEIR DISSATISFACTION ABOUT THE PRESENT REGIME'S FAILURE TO IMPLEMENT A REAL SOCIAL AND ECONOMIC REVOLUTION IN THE COUNTRY.

THE RIGHT-WING ISLAMIC STUDENTS ARE REPRESENTED BY THE SOCIETY FOR THE RESURRECTION OF SHIA IDEOLOGY, WHICH HAS LINKS TO THE VICE-CHANCELLOR, THE (#) OF MASHHAD. THERE HAS BEEN OCCASIONAL AGITATION FROM THIS SOCIETY FOR THE SEPARATION OF THE SEXES IN CLASSES AND FOR A GENERAL PURGE OF TEXTBOOKS-BUT THESE PRESSURES HAVE SO FAR BEEN RESISTED.

THERE HAVE BEEN DISAGREEMENTS OVER QUESTIONS OF ACADEMIC FREEDOM. IN JUNE 1979 THE MASHHAD IAUP CHAPTER ISSUED A STATEMENT CONDEMNING OUTSIDE INTERFERENCE IN ACADEMIC AFFAIRS. THIS STATEMENT WAS PROMPTLY CONDEMNED BY THE VARIOUS RIGHT-WING GROUPS WHO WENT AS FAR AS TO THREATEN TO INVADE THE UNIVERSITY. STATEMENTS WERE ISSUED SUCH AS "MERCHANTS OF THE REZA BAZAR CONDEMN THE STATEMENT OF THE MASHHAD PROFESSORS". THE MAIN OBJECTION TO THE STATEMENT WAS THAT IN THEIR HASTE THE PROFESSORS HAD FORGOTTEN TO PREFACE IT WITH "IN THE NAME OF GOD."

DESPITE THESE DISAGREEMENTS,THE UNIVERSITY HAS BEEN SPARED OPEN CONFRONTATION AMONG THESE GROUPS. ACCORDING TO ONE FACULTY MEMBER, AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI'S APPEAL FOR UNITY BETWEEN CLERGY AND UNIVERSITY--AN APPEAL WHICH WAS ISSUED SHORTLY BEFORE THE SCHEDULED UNIVERSITY OPENINGS--WAS MOST IMPORTANT FACTOR IN DEFUSING POSSIBLE VIOLENCE. (SEE TEHRAN 10281). SAME SOURCE ADDED THAT MOST OF THE STUDENTS AND FACULTY REMAINED FIERCELY LOYAL TO MEMORY OF LATE AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI AND THAT THERE WAS STILL NO CLEAR REPLACEMENT FOR HIM IN SIGHT.

A UNIVERSITY PURGE COMMITTEE HAS BEEN FORMED AND IS REVIEWING FILESSOF STUDENTS, FACULTY, AND ADMINISTRATION. EACH COLLEGE ELECTED THREE REPRESENTATIVES--ONE TEACHER, ONE STUDENT, ONE ADMINISTRATOR--TO FORM A FIFTEEN-MEMBER BODY. THIS BODY THEN SELECTED TWO STUDENTS, TWO PROFESSORS, AND TWO ADMINISTRATORS TO SERVE ON THE PURGE COMMITTEE. ACCORDING TO A MEMBER OF THE COMMITTEE, ABOUT 20 TEACHERS, 50 STUDENTS, AND 10 ADMINISTRATORS HAVE BEEN EXPELLED FOR SAVAK CONNECTIONS. THE COMMITTEE IS NOW REVIEWING FILES FOR EVIDENCE OF CORRUPTION OR ILLEGITIMATE TIES WITH THE OLD REGIME.

FACULTY COMMITTEE MEMBER TOLD POLITICAL OFFICER THAT THE STUDENT COMMITTEE MEMBERS WERE VERY STRICT IN THEIR STANDARDS OF PURITY AND WERE SEEKING A WIDERANGING PURGE. IN GENERAL, THE FACULTY AND ADMINISTRATION WERE MORE MODERATE AND WERE TRYING TO CONVINCE THE STUDENTS THAT A THOROUGH PURGE COULD PARALYZE THE UNIVERSITY. HE SAID THAT THE COMMITTEE HAD SO FAR TAKEN ITS DECISIONS UNANIMOUSLY. ALTHOUGH IN PRINCIPLE, DECISIONS COULD BE MADE BY A MAJORITY VOTE, THE COMMITTEE HAS AVOIDED TAKING SUCH DECISIONS IN THE BELIEF THAT ANY DIVISION WITHIN THE COMMITTEE WOULD WEAKEN AND THREATEN THE EXISTENCE OF THE ENTIRE

TEHRAN PRESS OCTOBER 10 BECAME COMPLETELY CONFUSED OVER FONMIN YAZDI'S ANSWER TO QUESTION ON WHETHER FOREIGN MINISTRY HAD REVOKED ALL AGREEMENTS WITH U.S. OR NOT.

ACCORDING TO RELIABLE PRESS CORRESPONDENT WHO WAS AT THE CONFERENCE, YAZDI TOLD PRESS THAT FOREIGN MINISTRY DID NOT HAVE THE AUTHORITY TO REVOKE AGREEMENTS. FOREIGN MINISTRY SOME TIME AGO HAD RECOMMENDED TO THE GOVERNMENT THAT BOTH THE 1921 AGREEMENT WITH THE RUSSIANS AND THE 1959 AGREEMENT WITH THE US BE REVOKED. HE HAD HEARD NO REPLY ON HIS RECOMMENDATION.

WHEN QUERIED MORNING OCTOBER 11, ON CONFUSED PRESS ACCOUNTS, MFA 4TH POLITICAL DIVISION ACTING CHIEF PARSA KIA WAS PLAINLY NON-PLUSSED. HE CHECKED INTO QUESTION AND CALLED EMBASSY BACK WITH REPLY THAT YAZDI HAD NOT SAID THAT AGREEMENTS WITH THE U.S. WERE CANCELLED. THAT "WHAT HE HAD MEANT TO SAY" WAS THAT THESE AGREEMENTS ARE STILL UNDER STUDY AND THAT THOSE THAT WERE NOT IN HER NATIONAL INTERESTS WOULD BE CANCELLED.

JUMHURI-YE-ISLAMI, EMBASSY'S OLD ENEMY, DID FULL REPORT ON YAZDI PRESS CONFERENCE PLAYING UP YAZDI'S ENNUMERATION OF PROBLEMS WITH U.S. (SEE SEPTEL USICA). JUMHURI-YE-ISLAMI, HOWEVER, ALSO CARRIED FOLLOWING VERY HELPFUL OPENING YAZDI STATEMENT: : DR. YAZDI IN CONNECTION WITH HIS MEETING WITH U.S. SECRETARY OF STATE STATED THIS WAS THE FIRST MEETING OF U.S. SECRETARY OF STATE AND MINISTER OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS OF IRANIAN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. WE MET IN UN AND THEY EXPRESSED THEIR WILL TO IMPROVE RELATIONS BETWEEN IRAN AND USA AND THEY ACCEPTED THE REALITY OF IRANIAN REVOLUTION, BECAUSE IT WAS REVOLUTION IN THE TRUE SENSE OF MEANING WHERE ALL THE MASSES HAVE TAKEN PART.

INTEREST WAS EXPRESSED FOR THE FRIENDSHIP OF IRAN. WE SAID WE ARE HAPPY WITH SUCH AN INTEREST, WE HOPE YOU MAY PROVE THE FRIENDSHIP BY ACTION NOT WORDS. BUT EXPRESSION OF INTEREST IS NOT ENOUGH, THERE ARE PROBLEMS ON THE WAY: ONE .... END

SUMMARY. YAZDI'S NEW YORK PERFORMANCE WAS AN ABRASIVE AND PUBLIC REMINDER THAT WE HAVE YET TO ACT IN WAYS THAT DEMONSTRATE CONVINCINGLY THAT WE HAVE ACCEPTED THE REVOLUTION. SOME OF THIS IS REVOLUTIONARY RHETORIC BUT MORE OF IT IS GENUINE, REFLECTING AMONG OTHER THINGS A CONCERN FOR CONSOLIDATION OF POWER BY AN INNER PGOI CIRCLE. WE RECOMMEND ACTION IN SEVERAL AREAS THAT WE CAN AND SHOULD TAKE TO STRENGTHEN OUR POLICY HAND IN THIS ATMOSPHERE. END SUMMARY.

EMBASSY APPRECIATES EXCELLENT ANALYSIS IN REFTEL OF NEW YORK PERFORMANCE BY DR. YAZDI, A MAN INCREASINGLY INFLUENTIAL AS MEMBER OF A GROUP WITHIN THE PGOI CLOSE TO KHOMEINI AND LIKELY TO PLAY A MAJOR ROLE IN THE EVOLUTION OF POST-REVOLUTIONARY IRAN. (WE INCLUDE IN THAT INNER GROUP, IN ADDITION TO YAZDI, NEW DEFENSE MINISTER CHAMRAN, QOTBZADAH AT NIRT, PGOI SPOKESMAN TABATABAI, AND MINISTER OF INTERIOR SABAGHIAN.)

WE SHARE DEPARTMENT'S ANALYSIS OF YAZDI'S PURPOSES -TO CREATE, FOR HIS OWN PSYCHIC AND PERSONAL POLITICAL PURPOSES THE IMPRESSION OF THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY AS A NEW BREED OF MAN DEMANDING TO BE HEARD ON THE WORLD STAGE. YAZDI HAD THAT OPPORTUNITY, BOTH AT HAVANA AND AT NEW YORK, AND HE CLEARLY WAS DETERMINED TO USE IT TO MAXIMUM EFFECTIVENESS.

MORE SPECIFICALLY, AS FAR AS THE USG IS CONCERNED, HIS PURPOSE WAS TO TELL US, BOTH PRIVATELY AND PUBLICLY, THAT REVOLUTION.# AND TO WARN US THAT UNTIL WE DO, THERE CAN BE NO PROGRESS IN BULDING A NEW RELATIONSHIP. THE THEME WAS SOUNDED AGAIN, WITH SPECIFICS, IN A PRESS CONFERENCE ON HIS RETURN HERE FROM NEW YORK (SEPTEL). THE ICE, SAYS YAZDI, HAS NOT YET BEEN BROKEN.

THAT MAY SOUND A BIT EXTREME IN LIGHT OF USG ACTIONS TO DATE DESIGNED TO DEMONSTRATE THAT WE HAVE INDEED ACCEPTED THE REVOLUTION. BUT IT IS PERHAPS NOT ALL THAT SURPRISING, FOR A VARIETY OF REASONS -- NOT ALL OF WHICH WE NEED ACCEPT BUT WHICH WE NEED TO TAKE INTO ACCOUNT IN FINDING WAYS TO DEAL WITH THIS DIFFICULT REGIME.

PARTLY, AS REFTEL POINTS OUT, IT IS THE REVOLUTIONARY POLITICIAN, THE AMBITIOUS POLITICAN THAT YAZDI IS. THAT COMPULSION REQUIRES HIM TO TALK AND LOOK LIKE A REVOLUTIONARY, ESPECIALLY IN THIS FIRST RETURN TO THE U.S. AFTER HIS 18 YEARS IN TEXAS AND OTHER WAYPOINTS -- A PART OF HIS PAST THAT HE NOW FINDS SOMEWHAT BURDENSOME POLITICALLY. CONSEQUENTLY IT WAS IMPORTANT FOR YAZDI THAT THE HEADLINES BACK HOME SHOW HIM IN TRUEREVOLUTIONARY COLORS, PREPARED TO STAND UP TO THE U.S.

AND NOT SOMEONE STRICKEN WITH THE "MENTAL SLAVERY" THAT HE DECRIED IN HIS HAVANA SPEECH AS "THE MOST DISTRINCT CONSEQUENCE OF IMPERIALISM IN THE CONTEMPORARY WORLD...A CHEAP AND EFFECTIVE TOOL OF PERPETUATING IMPERIALIST DOMINATION".

BUT THERE IS MORE THAN THAT IN HIS TOUGH STANCE WITH US, BOTH IN HIS BILATERAL WITH THE SECRETARY AND HIS PUBLIC SPEECHES. YAZDI IS POLITICALLY AMBITIOUS BUT HE IS ALSO A BELIEVING REVOLUTIONARY. IT IS THEREFORE MORE THAN THE REVOLUTIONARY REFURBISHING HIS CREDENTIALS. HIS APPROACH SAYS THINGS THAT ARE FUNDAMENTAL ABOUT THE ENTIRE REVOLUTIONARY APPARATUS HERE -- ONE THING THAT IS TACTICAL AND REASONABLY SHORT-RANGE; THE OTHER MORE FUNDAMENTAL AND LONG-RANGE.

IN THE SHORT-TERM YAZDI AND OTHERS OF HIS CLOSE ASSOCIATES IN THE PGOI REFLECT, WE THINK, AN INCREASING CONCERN FOR CONSOLIDATION OF THEIR POLITICAL POWER AT A TIME OF REAL OR IMAGINED THREAT TO IT. THUS THE SHARP REACTION TO THE NEW OUTBREAK OF DIFFICULTIES IN KURDESTAN AND KHUZESTAN, A REACTION MARKED BY A BARRAGE OF INTERNAL PROPAGANDA TO THE EFFECT THAT THE U.S., BEHIND THE FACADE INDEED THAT IRAQ IS ALSO INVOLVED IN SOME CONVOLUTED COLLUSION WITH AMERICAN AGENTS AND INFLUENCE.

WHATEVER ITS RELATIONSHIP TO THE REAL SITUATION ON THE GROUND IN THESE TWO TROUBLED PROVINCES, THE SPATE OF PROPAGANDA SEEMS DESIGNED FURTHER TO STRENGTHEN CLERICAL AND REVOLUTIONARY CONTROL OVER THE SECURITY FORCES AND THE EVOLVING GOVERNMENT APPARATUS THAT IS TO BE PUT IN PLACE WHEN THE CONSTITUTION IS COMPLETE. THE EFFORT AT CONSOLIDATION OF POWER IS ALSO SEEN IN THE INCREASING EMPHASIS ON THE NEED TO "PURGE" FROM THE STRUCTURE OF GOVERNMENT BOTH THE REMNANTS OF THE ANCIEN REGIME AND THEIR POLITICAL OPPONENTS. THUS YAZDI IS QUOTED FROM NEW YORK AS SAYING THAT THE NOTE BY OC/T: TEHRAN 10891/1. #PARA 5 SENTENCE AS RECEIVED.

CHAMRAN TALKS OF THE PURGE HE INTENDS TO PURSUE IN THE ARMED FORCES. THE NAZIH AFFAIR AT NIOC IS ACCOMPANIED BY TALK OF A NECESSARY PURGING PROCESS THAT NAZIH HAD IGNORED OR SET ASIDE. THAT CONCERN RELATES TO THE NEED TOELIMINATE FOREIGN AND PARTICULARLY WESTERN CULTURAL DOMINATION -- AN ALLEGED LEGACY OF THE PREVIOUS REGIM THAT THE REVOLUTIONARIES SEE AS CORROSIVE FOR THE EFFECTIVENESS OF ISLAM AS THE DRIVING FORCE AND MOTIVATION FOR IRAN'S ENTIRE POLITICAL, SOCIAL AND ECONOMIC MAKE-UP: INDEED THEY SEE THIS CORROSION AS THREATENING EVERYWHERE IN THE ISLAMIC WORLD, AN IDEOLOGICAL COMPULSION THAT COMBINES WITH LOOSE TALK OF IRRIDENTISM IN SHIA MESSIANIC TERMS TO MUDDY THE WATERS FOR THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC'S RELATIONS WITH MOST OF ITS MUSLIM NEIGHBORS.

YAZDI DEVOTED A GOOD PART OF THIS REVEALING SPEECH AT HAVANA TO THIS PARTICULAR CONCERN OF THE IRANIAN REVOLUTIONARIES. AS HE PUT IT, "THE STANDARDIZATION OF VALUES, GOALS AND ASPIRATIONS AMONG THE RULING ELITE OF THE WORLD HAS ADDED A NEW DIMENSION OF CULTURAL DOMINATION TO THE EVOLVING CHARACTER OF IMPERIALISM IN THE CONTEMPORARY WORLD." YAZDI CALLED FOR A RECOGNITION OF "THE ALIENATING AND HABITUAL CUTLURAL ALIGNMENTWITH THE SUPERPOWERS AND A SYSTEMATIC EFFORT TO FREE OURSELVES FROM THE MENTAL BONDAGE OF CULTURAL DOMINATION."

IT IS NOT AND IT WILL NOT BE EASY FOR US TO WORK WITH A LEADERSHIP THAT BELIEVES AND ACTS AS THIS ONE DOES; THAT KNOW THEY NEED US BUT YET FEAR FOR THEIR REVOLUTION IF THEY GET TOO CLOSE TO US. TIME AND THE COMPELLING CIRCUMSTANCES OF AN ALREADY BUILT-IN MOMENTUM IN THE SECULARIZATION AND MODERNIZATION OF IRAN'S ECONOMY AND ITS URBAN SOCIAL STRUCTURE WILL CHANGE SOME OF THIS. BUT THAT WILL BE A SLOW PROCESS, BARRING SOME DRAMATIC POLITICAL TURNAROUND THAT SEEMS UNLIKELY IN THE SHORT-TERM.
WE WILL NEED TO ACT WITH A MAXIMUM OF PATIENCE AND SENSITIVITY AS WE PURSUE OUR INTERESTS IN THE ATMOSPHERE OF SUSPICION MANIFESTED BY YAZDI IN NEW YORK.

WITH THIS AS BACKGROUND, WE COMMENT BELOW ON THREE SPECIFIC AREAS OF POLICY: FIRST, MILITARY SUPPLY: SECOND, OUR PUBLIC POSTURE ON THE REVOLUTION; AND THIRD, THE SPECIAL SYMBOLISM OF CALLING ON KHOMEINI AND NOMINATING AN AMBASSADOR.

YAZDI DID NOT FAIL IN NEW YORK TO MAKE CLEAR THAT OUR PERFORMANCE IN THE MILITARY SUPPLY FIELD WILL CONTINUE TO BE AN ACID TEST OF OURATTITUDES TOWARD THE REVOLUTION. THE COURSE WILL BE ROUGH, NOT SIMPLY BECAUSE OF WHAT SEEMS DDSTINED TO BE A PRICKLY RELATIONSHIP WITH CHAMRAN AS THE NEW HEAD OF THE DEFENSE ESTABLISHMENT, BUT MORE FUNDAMENTALLY BECAUSE OF THE FEAR OF AMERICAN INFLUENCE IN AND VIA THE MILITARY IN IRAN SOCIETY. (AS YAZDI NOTED IN HAVANA, MORE THAN 1200 IRANIAN MILITARY PERSONNEL WERE TRAINED IN THE UNITED STATES -- A CONSERVATIVE FIGUREBY OUR ESTIMATE).
THERE IS ALSO THE ABIDING SUSPICION ON THE PART OF YAZDI AND OTHERS THAT IRAN HAS BEEN FINANCIALLY HAD BY MEANS OF THE TRUST FUND.

WE THUS FACE THE CHALLENGE OF SATISFYING BOTH THE POLITICIANS SUCH AS YAZDI AND CHAMRAN BUT ALSO THE MILITARY PROFESSIONALS, WHO ARE BEGINNING TO REFLECT A CONCERN THAT THEY WILL BE DENIED THE LOGISTICAL AND TECHNICAL SUPPORT THEY FEEL THEY NEED FROM THE U.S.

NONETHELESS WE SEE OUR CURRENT POLICY STANCE ON MILITARY SUPPLY AS ESSENTIALLY SOUND -- AN OPEN AND STRAIGHTFORWARD POSTURE CONCERNING BILLINGS AND ACCOUNTS, FRANK AND FORCEFUL REMINDERS ABOUT OUR OWN LAWS AND REGULATIONS THAT APPLY, A DEMONSTRATED WILLINGNESS TO GO ALL OUT IN RESPONDING TO PGOI QUESTIONS ABOUT FINANCIAL DETAIL, ------------------072015 121111Z /12 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 4219 SECTION 03 OF 03 TEHRAN 10891 EXDIS AND MAKING SPARE PARTS AVAILABLE AS RAPIDLY AS THE PGOI CAN GET ITS OWN HOUSE IN ORDER.

WE BELIEVE WE SHOULD, HOWEVER, ALSO BE PREPARED TO TAKE SOME RISKS IN THE CASE BY CASE POLICY WE ENVISAGE AS AFFECTING CLASSIFIED AND SENSITIVE MATERIAL. AS A CASE IN POINT WE BELIEVE WE SHOULD MOVE AFFIRMATIVELY IN RESPONSE TO THE PGOI REQUEST CONCERNING THE RF4E'S. TO DELAY OR TO DENY THESE AIRCRAFT WILL AROUSE NEW SUSPICIONS OF AN INTENT TO PENALIZE THE PGOI ON BOTH FINANCIAL AND POLITICAL COUNTS; APPROVAL OF THIS SMALL NUMBER OF AIRCRAFT ALREADY LARGELY PAID FOR AND ADDITIONAL TO AN ALREADY EXISTING IIAF INVENTORY IS CERTAINLY DEFENSIBLE (IN WHAT WE ASSUME WILL BE REQUIRED CONGRESSIONAL CONSULTATIONS) IN TERMS OF OUR INTERESTS IN IRAN.

SECONDLY, AS THIS EMBASSY HAS RECOMMENDED EARLIER, WE BELIEVE WE CAN AND SHOULD FIND WAYS TO SPEAK PUBLICLY AND POSITIVELY MORE THAN WE HAVE TO DATE ABOUT HAVING ACCEPTED THE CHANGE IN IRAN. THERE ARE TWO REASONS FOR THIS; THE ONE OBVIOUSLY TO HELP REDUCE PGOI SUSPICIONS ABOUT OUR PURPOSES AND THE OTHER TO REMIND OUR OWN PUBLIC (ONLY SUPERFICIALLY INFORMED BY THE U.S. PRESS) ABOUT OUR LONGTERM INTERESTS IN IRAN. THIS IS NOT TO SAY THAT WE NEED PUBLICLY TO EMBRACE AND ENDORSE KHOMEINI, OR TO APPLAUD SUCH FIGURES AS YAZDI AND CHAMRAN AND ALL THAT THEY SAY AND DO, OR TO COMMEND PGOI POLICY IN KURDESTAN.
WHAT WE DO NEED TO SAY, IN WAYS THAT WE HAVE NOT YET DONE, IS THAT WE HAVE LONG-TERM INTERESTS IN IRAN THAT CONTINUE AND WHICH WE BELIEVE CAN BE PRESERVED IN AN ISLAMIC IRAN.

SPECIFICALLY, WE URGE THE DEPARTMENT TO FIND WAYS PUBLICLY TO SAY THAT WE WISH IRAN WELL IN PUTTING ITS REVOLUTIONARY OBJECTIVES INTO FORMS AND INSTITUTIONS THAT WILL COMMAND THE SUPPORT OF ALL ITS PEOPLE; THAT THE U.S. HAS NO INTEREST IN OR INTENTION OF IMPOSING ANY REGIME, MONARCHY OR OTHERWISE, ON IRAN; THAT WE HAVE AN ABIDING INTEREST IN IRAN'S INTEGRITY AND INDEPENDENCE; THAT AMERICAN INTERESTS IN ACCESS TO IRANIAN OIL ARE SYNONYMOUS WITH IRANIAN INTERESTS IN SUSTAINING AND FINANCING ITS FUTURE INDUSTRIAL AND AGRICULTURAL DEVELOPMENT.

WE SHOULD FIND OPPORTUNITIES AS WELL TO WELCOME REVOLUTIONARY IRAN'S EMPHASIS ON ISLAM AND ITS SPIRITUAL CONTRIBUTION TO SOCIETY AS SOMETHING THAT AMERICANS UNDERSTAND AND RESPECT, GIVEN THE WAY IN WHICH AMERICANS ALSO SEE THINGS OF THE SPIRIT AS IMPORTANT TO HUMAN ENDEAVOR.

ASSISTANT SECRETARY SAUNDERS' TESTIMONY OF SOME MONTHS BACK BEFORE THE HIRC ON THE MIDDLE EAST AS A WHOLE HAS THE ESSENCE OF MUCH OF THIS AND IS THE KIND OF THING WE SHOULD BE HEARD SAYING MORE FREQUENTLY ABOUT IRAN.

THIRDLY, AND BRIEFLY, THERE IS THE VERY LARGE IMPORTANCE OF THE SYMBOLIC ACTS OF SEEING KHOMEINI AND NAMING AN AMBASSADOR. THESE ACTIONS ARE LONG OVERDUE; THEY ARE CENTRAL TO THE WAY IN WHICH YAZDI AND INDEED MOST IRANIANS SEE OUR ATTITUDES TOWARD THE REVOLUTION. IF A NEW AMBASSADOR IS TO BE FURTHER DELAYED, WE RECOMMEND THAT WE SEEK A MEETING NOW WITH KHOMEINI AT THE CHARGE LEVEL. AS FOR DESIGNATING AN AMBASSADOR, THE TIMING WILL NEVER BE TOTALLY RIGHT; THE ACTION SHOULD NO LONGER BE DELAYED.

ON OCTOBER 10, ACTING POL COUNSELLOR CALLED INFORMALLY ON DIRECTOR OF MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS FIFTH DIVISION MOSHAVEQ-ZADEH TO CONTINUE DISCUSSION OF AFGHANISTAN AND PASS ON SOME OF INFORMATION CONTAINED REF B. IN COURSE OF DISCUSSION, ZADEH MADE FOLLOWING POINTS.

AFGHAN-USSR RELATIONS - USSR-AMIN RELATIONS ARE NOT YET CLEAR TO PGOI. PGOI DOES NOT THINK USSR WHICH SUPPORTED TARAKI WAS AWARE OF COUP PLANS. ZADEH WAS PLAINLY CAUTIOUSLY HOPEFUL THAT USSR-AMIN RELATIONS WOULD BE FAIRLY COOL. HE SAID PGOI HAD THIRD HAND INFORMATION FROM THE NEW AFGHAN FOREIGN MINISTER THAT WATANJAR, MAZDOORYAR AND GULABZOI WERE ALL IN THE SOVIET EMBASSY IN KABUL. ZADEH SAID THAT HE HAD BEEN CONTACTED BY THE INDIAN EMBASSY (PROBABLY THE AMBASSADOR). THE INDIAN ASSESSMENT WAS THAT THE AFGHANS WERE A VERY INDEPENDENT PEOPLE AND THAT AMIN GOVERNMENT WAS DEFINITELY DISTANCING ITSELF FROM THE RUSSIANS.

INDIA HAD APPEALED TO AFGHANISTAN'S NEIGHBORS, PARTICULARLY PGOI, TO DO WHATEVER POSSIBLE TO BETTER THEIR RELATIONS WITH THE AMIN GOVERNMENT OR AT LEAST PREVENT FRICTION SO THAT AMIN WOULD NOT BE PUSHED BACK TOWARD THE USSR. ZADEH SAID THAT PGOI DID NOT SHARE THIS OPTIMISTIC VIEW, BUT WAS WATCHING THE SITUATION CAREFULLY AND WOULD DO EVERYTHING POSSIBLE TO REDUCE TENSIONS WITH AFGHANISTAN. UNLIKE PREVIOUS DISCUSSION (REF A), ZADEH THIS TIME EXPRESSED HOPE THAT USG INFORMATION ON AFGHANISTAN WAS NOT REPEAT NOT COMING FROM REFUGEE GROUPS IN PAKISTAN.

ZADEH SAID PGOI DID NOT THINK THAT USSR INTENDED TO MOVE MILITARY UNITS ACROSS THE BORDER INTO AFGHANISTAN. ALTHOUGH AFGHANISTAN IS CONSIDERED TO BE IN USSR SPHERE OF INFLUENCE, USSR HAS NEVER, OUTSIDE OF EASTERN EUROPE, MOVED PHYSICALLY INTO ANOTHER COUNTRY (SIC). ZADEH SAID THAT HE HAD TALKED RECENTLY TO SOME OF THE MIDDLE RANKING USSR DIPLOMATS IN TEHRAN AND EXPRESSED HOPE THAT USSR WOULD TAKE ITS TROOPS OUT OF AFGHANISTAN AND PERMIT AFGHANISTAN TO FOLLOW AN INDEPENDENT COURSE. (ZADEH DID NOT VOLUNTEER THE ABOVE INFORMATION AND GAVE NO INDICATION HE HAD MADE THIS APPROACH ON PGOI INSTRUCTIONS.)

ZADEH MENTIONED CASUALLY THE "FLOOD" OF REFUGEES FLOWING ACROSS AFGHAN BORDER TO IRAN AND THE FACT THAT IRAN WAS NOW SETTING UP TWO REFUGEE CAMPS. HE, HOWEVER, BACKED QUICKLY OFF FROM TALK OF "FLOODS" WHEN QUESTIONED. HE SAID THAT IRAN PLANNED TO HANDLE THE PROBLEM ITSELF AND DID NOT HAVE OR NEED ANY INTERNATIONAL HELP. COMMENT: THE REFUGEE QUESTION IS PLAINLY A SENSITIVE ONE TO IRAN, AND ONE THAT THEY ARE PURPOSELY DOWN PLAYING. LAINGEN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

BECAUSE OF FUROR RAISED OVER CHARGE-SABAGHIAN TALK ON EXECUTION OF THREE SENATORS, EMBASSY HAS NOT RAISED CASE OF MOHSEN FOROUGHI WITH PGOI FOR FEAR OUR INTERVENTION AT THIS POINT MIGHT BE COUNTER PRODUCTIVE. WE HAVE NO INDICATION AT PRESENT THAT FOROUGHI'S CASE WILL BE TRIED IN IMMEDIATE FUTURE.

WE WILL DISCUSS FOROUGHI CASE WITH FRENCH EMBASSY HERE TO SEE WHAT ACTION THEY MIGHT TAKE. DEPARTMENT MIGHT CONSIDER REQUESTING PRIVATE AMERICANS OF GOOD STANDING WITH PGOI, SUCH AS RAMSEY CLARK TO TAKE ACTION IN THIS AND OTHER CASES. LAINGEN

FON MINISTER YAZDI IN A PRESS CONFERENCE OCTOBER 10 FORMALLY ACKNOWLEDGED PGOI'S REFUSAL TO PERMIT PLO TO OPERATE AN OFFICE IN AHWAZ, KHUZESTAN.

YAZDI SAID "WE FELT THE PLO OFFICE IN AHWAZ WOULD NOT BE IN OUR INTEREST OR IN THE INTEREST OF THE PLO, BECAUSE OF THE SITUATION IN THE COUNTRY. WE DISCUSSED IT TOGETHER AND THEY DECIDED TO CLOSE THEIR OFFICE THERE."

THE ARRIVAL OF A PLO DELEGATION IN TEHRAN OCT 12 HAS RECEIVED SOME ATTENTION IN THE PRESS AND MAY HAVE ENCOURAGED A SERIES OF STATEMENTS ON THE PLO. THE FOURMAN DELEGATION, LED BY KHALIL A. VASIR ("NICKNAMED ABU JEHAD"), CAME, ACCORDING TO PRESS REPORTS, TO TALK ABOUT BRINGING A CLOSER AND MORE FRUITFUL COOPERATION BETWEEN IRAN AND THE PLO. THE DELEGATION WAS MET BY FOREIGN MINISTER YAZDI AT THE AIRPORT AND IS REPORTEDLY TO SEE KHOMEINI, YAZDI AND DEFENSE MINISTER CHAMRAN WHILE THEYARE HERE.

ON THE SAME DAY, REVOLUTIONARY GUARD COMMANDER ABOU SHARIF WHO WAS TRAINED IN PALESTINE WITH AMAL EXPRESSED HIS DISSATISFACTION TO THE PRESS OVER IRAN'S FOREIGN POLICY TOWARD THE PLO. SHARIF REPORTEDLY SAID THAT "AS FAR AS THE PALESTINIAN REVOLUTION WAS CONCERNED THE FOREIGN POLICY OF IRAN HAD NOT BEEN EFFECTIVE AND REVOLUTIONARY FOR REASONS BEST KNOWN TO THOSE WHO WERE PURSUING THIS POLICY." THERE ARE CERTAIN POINTS WHICH CANNOT BE REVEALED FOR "TACTICAL REASONS," HE SAID.
IN A STATEMENT TO THE PRESS ALSO ON OCTOBER 10, THE MOJAHEDEEN SUPPORTED THE PLO AND CALLED ON KHOMEINI TO SUPPORT THE PALESTINIAN CAUSE FINANCIALLY.
COMMENT: EMBASSY DOES NOT FEEL THAT THIS RECENT PLO VISIT WILL CHANGE BASIC IRANIAN POLICY OUTLINED REFTEL BUT WE WILL FOLLOW SITUATION CLOSELY. LAINGEN

1979TEHRAN10947.subject: ASSASSINATION OF GERMAN BUSINESSMAN IN TEHRAN

segments.text: MR. HANS JOACHIM LEIB, GERMANY FINANCIAL DIRECTOR OF MERCK SHARP AND DOHME A.G.'S IRANIAN SUBSIDIARY WAS ASSASSINATED AT APPROXIMATELY 0700 HOURS, OCTOBER 14, 1979 OUTSIDE OF HIS RESIDENCE WHILE REPARING TO GO TO WORK.

RSO AND COMMERCIAL OFFICER MET WITH FIRST SECRETARY OF GERMAN EMBASSY, MR. SPAHN, AFTERNOON OF OCTOBER 14, IN ORDER TO DETERMINE FACTS OF CASE. SPAHN ADVISED THAT THE GERMAN EMBASSY WAS CALLED AT 0730 AND INFORMED THAT LEIB HAD BEEN ASSASSINATED. MR. SPAHN IMMEDIATELY WENT TO THE LEIB RESIDENCE, ARRIVING AT APPROXIMATELY 0830. SPAHN ADVISED THAT WHEN HE ARRIVED, HE BEGAN TO PIECE TOGETHER WHAT HAD TRANSPIRED. HE STATED THAT MR. LEIB DEPARTED HIS RESIDENCE, AS USUAL, AT APPROXIMATELY 0650.

AS HE WAS ENTERING HIS VEHICLE, TWO INDIVIDUALS ON A MOTORCYCLE, ONE WEARING A MASK, APPROACHED FROM BEHIND AND SHOT LEIB ONE TIME WITH A REVOLVER THROUGH HIS LEFT EAR, KILLING HIM INSTANTLY. THE ACT WAS WITNESSED BY A SCHOOLBOY ON HIS WAY TO SCHOOL. ALTHOUGH SPAHN WAS NOT ABLE TO READ THE NOTE THAT WAS LEFT AT THE SCENE BY THE MURDERS, HE WAS TOLD THAT IT WAS SIGNED BY FORGHAN (A TERRORIST GROUP DEDICATED TO ISLAM BUT OPPOSED TO THE ROLE OF THE CLERGY IN GOVERNMENT) AND THAT IT CONDEMNED "ZIONISM", "POLYTHEISM" AND WESTERN CAPITALISM".

SPAHN ADVISED THAT THE POLICE WOULD NOT GIVE HIM THE NOTE BUT PROMISED THAT A COPY OF IT WOULD BE MADE AVAILABLE TO HIM ON OCTOBER 15. (SHORT NEWS ITEM ON TEHRAN RADIO AT 1300 STATED "THE ASSASSINS LEFT SOME FORGHAN LEAFLETS AT THE SITE STATING THAT HE (LEIB) WAS THE PROTECTOR OF WESTERN INTERESTS").

SPAHN STATED THAT THERE WERE NO DISCERNIBLE MOTIVES FOR THE MURDER AND COULD ONLY DRAW THE CONCLUSION THAT IT WAS A "POLITICAL MURDER". HE ADDED THAT LEIB DID NOT HAVE ANY PERSONAL ENEMIES NOR HAD HE BEEN THE OBJECT OF ANY THREATS OR HARRASSMENT IN THE FIFTEEN MONTHS THAT HE HAD LIVED IN IRAN. FURTHERMORE, THE GERMAN DIRECTOR OF MERCK SHARP AND DOHME HAD STATED TO SPAHN THAT HIS COMPANY HAD EXPERIENCED NO SPECIAL LABOR PROBLEMS SINCE THE REVOLUTION.

SPAHN REPORTED THAT THE GERMAN COMMUNITY (NUMBERING APPROXIMATELY 1,000) HAD BEEN BADLY SHAKEN BY LEIB'S MURDER. HE ADDED THAT IT HAS CAUSED PARTICULAR CONCERN AMONGST THE GERMANS BECAUSE LEIB WAS A RELATIVELY MINOR EXECUTIVE IN A LESS WELL-KNOWN GERMANY COMPANY THAN, FOR EXAMPLE, SIEMENS.

ALTHOUGH PRESS REPORTS TODAY SAY BRITISH EMBASSY IS GOING TO PUT OUT A COMMUNIQUE WARNING BRITISH SUBJECTS HERE TO TAKE CARE WHEN TRAVELING IN THE CAPITAL, BRITISH EMBASSY OFFICIALS SAY THEY ARE SIMPLY CALLING BRITISH COMMUNITY THROUGH THEIR PYRAMID SYSTEM TO INFORM THEM OF THE INCIDENT AND ADVISE THEM TO TAKE CARE. LAINGEN

1979TEHRAN10961.subject: CALL ON COUNCIL OF EXPERTS DELEGATE GHAFFOURI

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

CHARGE AND EMBASSY POLITICAL OFFICER CALLED ON TEHRAN DELEGATE TO COUNCIL OF EXPERTS, HOJJAT AL-ISLAM DR. ALI GOLZADEH GHAFFOURI ON OCTOBER 14 AT COUNCIL BLDG. CALL HAD ORIGINALLY BEEN SUGGESTED BY MINISTER OF INTERIOR AND WAS PROCEEDED BY POLITICAL OFFICER'S VISIT ONE WEEK EARLIER. GHAFFOURI IS A CLERGYMAN, A TEACHER, A LEGAL SCHOLAR AND A MEMBER OF THE COORDINATING COMMITTEE OF THE COUNCIL OF EXPERTS. DR. GHAFFOURI'S SON, A GERMANTRAINED ENGINEER, ALSO ATTENDED THE MEETING. MEETING HAD BEEN ARRANGED FOR "A PERSONAL EXCHANGE OF VIEWS."

CHARGE BEGAN BY ASSURING DR. GHAFFOURI THAT WHATEVER ITS POSITION IN THE PAST, THE U.S. GOVERNMENT ACCEPTS AND RECOGNIZES THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION AND WISHES IT SUCCESS IN ESTABLISHING A FREE AND INDEPENDENT NATION BASED ON THE HIGH SPIRITUAL VALUES OF ISLAM. ALTHOUGH PROBLEMS BETWEEN THE TWO NATIONS EXIST, CHARGE SAID HE HOPED THAT A NEW, SOUND RELATIONSHIP COULD BE BUILT ON A BASIS OF MUTUAL RESPECT AND TRUE NATIONAL INTERESTS. CHARGE THEN ASKED DR. GHAFFOURI HOW HE SAW RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN THE TWO COUNTRIES AND WHAT STEPS COULD IMPROVE THESE RELATIONSHIPS AND ELIMINATE MISUNDERSTANDINGS.

DR. GHAFFOURI REPLIED THAT HE WELCOMED THE OPPORTUNITY TO MEET WITH THE CHARGE INFORMALLY. HE ASKED ABOUT THE STATUS OF POPULAR OPINION IN THE UNITED STATES AND ITS INFLUENCE ON GOVERNMENT POLICY. HE ASKED IF POPULAR OPINION COULD CHANGE AMERICAN POLICY TO BRING THAT POLICY INTO HARMONY WITH ASPIRATIONS OF PEOPLES OF THE THIRD WORLD COUNTRIES. HE SAID THAT IRAN HAD TRADITIONALLY SEEN THE U.S. AS THE MESSENGER OF FREEDOM, BUT THAT U.S. ACTIONS IN VIETNAM AND ELSEWHERE IN RECENT YEARS HAD RAISED IMAGE OF U.S. AS COLONIST AND EXPLOITING POWER.

CHARGE COMMENTED THAT IN MATTER OF IRAN, U.S. OFFICIAL POLICY WAS PROBABLY AHEAD OF PUBLIC OPINION SINCE LATTER GENERALLY HAD INADQUATE KNOWLEDGE OF EVENTS IN IRAN. ALTHOUGH AMERICAN PUBLIC OPINION UNDERSTOOD AND GENERALLY SYMPATHIZED WITH MOVEMENT THAT LED TO SHAH'S OVERTHROW, IT WAS DIFFICULT FOR IT TO UNDERSTAND PRESENT EVENTS IN IRAN. MUCH OF WHAT HAS BEEN SEEN SO FAR--EXECUTIONS, CLERICAL MONOPOLY OF POWER, AND EXPULSION OF WESTERN JOURNALISTS--HAS NOT HAD A POSITIVE EFFECT ON U.S. PUBLIC OPINION. FOR THIS REASON, LEADING IRANIANS SUCH AS DR. GHAFFOURI HAVE THE RESPONSIBILITY TO PRESENT THE POSITIVE ACHIEVEMENTS AND GOALS OF THE REVOLUTION. CHARGE EMPHASIZED THAT NEITHER HE NOR U.S.

GOVERNMENT HAD ANY INTENTION OF INTERFERING IN IRAN'S INTERNAL AFFAIRS. HE HAD NOT "PROTESPVD" EXECUTIONS TO SABAGHIAN AND WAS NOT PROTESTING THEM NOW. NEVERTHELESS, HE SAID THAT IF IRAN WANTED TO SEE U.S. PUBLIC OPINION INFLUENCE GOVERNMENT POLICY, THEN IRAN HAD A RESPONSIBLITY TO TRY AND SHOW THAT REVOLUTIONARY IRAN WAS WORKING FOR THE BENEFIT OF THE POOR, AND WORKING, THROUGH THE PROCESS OF CONSULTATION (SHURA), TO ENCOURAGE GREATER PARTICIPATION IN POLITICAL DECISON-MAKING.

DR. GHAFFOURI SAID THAT IRAN WAS NOW WORKING TO SHOW THE WORLD A NEW AND GENUINE FACE OF ISLAM--A FACE IN WHICH GOVERNMENT SHOULD BE THE SERVANT OF HUMANITY RATHER THAN ITS MASTER. HE SAID SUCH ISLAM WAS DIFFERENT FROM ISLAM AS IT IS NOW PRACTICED IN AFRICA, AMONG THE U.S. MUSLIMS, AND IN SAUDI ARABIA, WHICH CALLS ITSELF ISLAMIC.

HE SAID THAT HE, AS A MUSLIM, BELIEVED IN THE BROTHERHOOD OF BELIEVERS OF ALL RELIGIONS, AND BELIEVED THAT ISLAM SHOULD NOT BECOME THE REASON FOR DISAGREEMENT BETWEEN OUR TWO COUNTRIES. ------------------092158 151458Z /51 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 4249 INFO SECDEF WASH DC JCS WASH DC AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 10961 BETWEEN OUR TWO COUNTRIES.

DR. GHAFFOURI SAID THAT IRAN COULD OVERLOOK THE FACT THAT THE U.S. HAD SUPPORTED THE SHAH MILITARILY AND THAT THE TWO PILLARS OF THE SHAH'S STRENGTH WERE A U.S.-TRAINED AND SUPPLIED ARMY AT HOME AND AMERICAN DIPLOMATIC SUPPORT ABROAD. ALL OF THIS, HE SAID, COULD BE OVERLOOKED IF THE U.S. CHANGED ITS TRADITIONAL POLICY OF DEALING LIKE A MERCHANT WITH IRAN IN A WAY THAT KEPT THAT COUNTRY BACKWARD AND UNDER-DEVELOPED.

CHARGE ANSWERED THAT ALTHOUGH U.S. SOCIETY HAS A MATERIALISTIC SIDE, IT ALSO HAS HIGH SPIRITUAL VALUES. SUCH VALUES WERE BEHIND MUCH OF PRESIDENT'S HUMAN RIGHTS POLICY AND BEHIND POLICY OF OFFERING ALL POSSIBLE HELP TO REPUBLICAN IRAN IN BUILDING AN INDEPENDENT COUNTRY BASED ON THE ISLAMIC VALUES OF DEMOCRACY, HUMANITY, AND COMPASSION.

DR. GHAFFOURI EXCUSED HIMSELF AT THIS POINT, SAYING THAT HE HAD ANOTHER VISITOR. HE SAID THAT HE WAS VERY HAPPY TO HAVE THIS OPPORTUNITY TO SPEAK WITH THE CHARGE, NOT AS A POLITICIAN, BUT AS A FRIEND. HE HOPED THAT SUCH MEETINGS COULD CONTINUE AND THAT U.S.-IRANIAN RELATIONS COULD INDEED BE REBUILT ON A NEW FOUNDATION.

COMMENT: DR. GHAFFOURI IS DEEPLY COMMITTED TO THE CAUSE OF ISLAM AND THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION. HE AND HIS STUDENTS SUFFERED FOR THEIR IDEAS UNDER THE PREVIOUS REGIME. IN 1978 HE VISITED THE UNITED STATES, INCLUDING PRINCETON AND BERKELEY, TO MEET WITH IRANIAN STUDENTS ABOUT THE REVOLUTION. ALTHOUGH HE WAS CORDIAL AND FRIENDLY THROUGHOUT THIS MEETING, HIS WORDS REVEALED SOMETHING OF THE DEPTH OF SUSPICION AND MISTRUST IN WHICH THE U.S. IS HELD AMONGTHOSE IRANIANS WHO SEE AMERICA AS BEING RESPONSIBLE FOR MUCH OF THE MISERY OF THEIR COUNTRY DURING THE LAST TWENTY-FIVE YEARS.
SUCH MISTRUST WILL NOT BE OVERCOME IN ONE MEETING, BUT GHAFFOURI'S WILLINGNESS TO MEET AND TO LISTEN IS AT LEAST A SIGN THAT HE ATTACHES GREAT IMPORTANCE TO THE U.S. POSITION ON THE IRANIAN

1979TEHRAN10976.subject: COUNCIL OF EXPERTS: WAITING FOR FAQIH

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: COUNCIL OF EXPERTS HAS SPEEDED UP ITS WORK AND PLANS TO COMPLETE DRAFTING NEW CONSTITUTION WITHIN ONE MONTH. EMBASSY CONTINUES TO DOUBT THIS CAN BE DONE. DEBATES IN PUBLIC SESSIONS OF COUNCIL HAVE BEEN LIVELY, WITH SEVERAL ARTICLES PROVOKING SHARP CONTROVERSY AMONG MEMBERS AND OBSERVERS. ORIGINAL DRAFT CONSTITUTION HAS BEEN COMPLETELY RE-WRITTEN. MOST CONTROVERSIAL ARTICLES INCLUDE PROVISIONS FOR GOVERNMENT BY THEOLOGIANS, A COUNCIL OF GUARDIANS, ORGANIZATION OF COUNCILS, AND RECOGNITION OF JA'FARI SHI'ISM AS THE OFFICIAL RELIGION OF IRAN. COUNCIL WILL DELINEATE DUTIES OF PRESIDENT AND PRIME MINISTER FOLLOWING PASSAGE OF ARTICLES NOW UNDER DEBATE WHICH DEFINE THE INSTITUTION OF THEOLOGICAL LEADERSHIP. END SUMMARY.

AFTER STARTING AT LEISURELY PACE, COUNCIL OF EXPERTS FOR EXAMINING THE NEW IRANIAN CONSTITUTION HAS SPEEDED UP ITS WORK. ASSEMBLY VICE PRESIDENT, AYATOLLAH DR. MUHAMMAD BEHESHTI, HAS PRESIDED OVER MOST OF PLENARY SESSIONS IN PLACE OF ASSEMBLY PRESIDENT AYATOLLAH MONTAZERI. BEHESHTI, LOCALLY NICKNAMED "RASPUTIN", HAS SHOWN HIMSELF VERY SKILLED AT PARLIAMENTARY PROCEDURES, AND HAS SUCCESSFULLY KEPT THE PROCEDURES ORDERLY AND BUSINESSLIKE. HE HAS ALSO DISPLAYED CONSIDERABLE TACT AND HUMOR IN HANDLING SOME OF THE DIFFICULT PERSONALITIES IN THE ASSEMBLY.

ACCORDING TO ASSEMBLY RULES OF PROCEDURE, ARTICLES REQUIRE APPROVAL BY TWO-THIRDS OF THOSE PRESENT. ARTICLES NOT RECEIVING APPROVAL ARE SENT BACK TO THE SPECIALIZED COMMITTEE FOR FURTHER STUDY AND REVISION. IN THIS WAY ARTICLES ARE NOT PASSED IN ORDER, BUT ASSEMBLY CONTINUES TO VOTE ON ARTICLES WHILE TABLED ARTICLES ARE MODIFIED. FOR THIS REASON, ARTICLES 29 AND 31 ARE STILL NOT APPROVED WHILE ASSEMBLY IS VOTING ON ARTICLES IN THE EIGHTIES. AS TABLED ARTICLES ARE REVISED THEY ARE BROUGHT FORWARD FOR RECONSIDERATION BY THE FULL ASSEMBLY.

ACCORDING TO LOCAL JOURNALIST WHO HAS BEEN FOLLOWING ASSEMBLY SESSIONS, DURING LAST 10 DAYS ASSEMBLY HAS MADE SIGNIFICANT CHANGE IN ITS DRAFTING PROCEDURE. ARTICLES ARE NO LONGER WRITTEN BY FUNCTIONAL COMMITTEES, BUT ARE DRAFTED BY A COORDINATING COMMITTEE MADE UP OF SENIOR DELEGATES. THESE DRAFT ARTICLES ARE THEN SENT TO THE SPECIALIZED COMMITTEE BEFORE BEING SUBMITTED TO A VOTE OF THE ENTIRE ASSEMBLY. THIS SHIFT APPARENTLY CAME AS RECOGNITION OF THE IMPORTANCE OF THE FIRST DRAFT IN SHAPING THE ARTICLES OF THE CONSTITUTION. DRAFT ARTICLES EMERGING FROM THE FUNCTIONAL COMMITTEES, LACKED THE EXPLICIT APPROVAL OF MANY SENIOR DELEGATES AND WERE ENCOUNTERING DIFFICULTY ON THE FLOOR OF THE ASSEMBLY.

REFTELS HAVE ALREADY DISCUSSED SOME OF THE EARLIEST ARTICLES PASSED, INCLUDING THE CONTROVERSIAL VELAYAT-EFAQIH. OTHER IMPORTANT ARTICLES PASSED SO FAR INCLUDE: - A. ARTICLE 6. ESTABLISHES THE PRINCIPLE OF ELECTED COUNCILS AND INDIVIDUALS. THIS ARTICLE HAS LED TO A GREAT DEAL OF CONTROVERSY ABOUT THE ENTIRE QUESITON OF THE ROLE OF COUNCILS IN THE NEW GOVERNMENT. EMBASSY WILL BE DISCUSSING THIS CONTROVERSY IN SEPARATE MESSAGE. - B. ARTICLE 8 STIPULATES THAT IT IS THE DUTY OF ALL CITIZENS AND THE GOVERNMENT TO ADVISE EACH OTHER TO DO GOOD AND AVOID ALL EVIL.

ARTICLE 74 DEALS WITH MUNICIPAL COUNCILS AND STATES THAT ALL SOCIAL, ECONOMIC, DEVELOPMENTAL, CULTURAL, EDUCATIONAL, AND WELFARE MATTERS SHALL BE UNDERTAKEN BY THE PEOPLE UNDER THE SUPERVISION OF THE MUNICIPAL COUNCILS. - J. ARTICLE 78 ESTABLISHES A GUARDIAN COUNCIL OF THE CONSTITUTION WHICH IS TO EXAMINE ALL ENACTMENTS OF THE ASSEMBLY TO ENSURE THEIR CONFORMITY WITH ISLAMIC LAW. LAWS JUDGED TO BE IN CONFLICT WITH ISLAMIC TENETS CAN BE REJECTED BY A TWO-THIRDS VOTE OF THE COUNCIL OF GUARDIANS. EMBASSY IS PREPARING TRANSLATION OF OFFICIAL TEXT OF ALL ARTICLES APPROVED.

AS NOTED REF B, COUNCIL OF EXPERTS HAS DEVIATED FROM TEXT OO ORIGINAL DRAFT CONSTITUTION AND IN FACT HAS DRAFTED ALMOST ENTIRELY NEW DOCUMENT. ASKED ABOUT THE REASONS FOR THIS STEP, COUNCIL DELEGATE HOJJAT AL-ISLAM DR. ALI GOLZADEH GHAFFOURI TOLD EMBASSY POLITICAL OFFICER THAT ORIGINAL DRAFT WAS SIMPLY ONE SUGGESTION AND THAT COUNCIL HAD RECEIVED OVER 4,000 SUGGESTIONS FOR CHANGES IN THAT DOCUMENT. HE SAID, "SINCE WE WANTED TO ENSURE THE PEOPLE'S PARTICIPATION IN WRITING THE CONSTITUTION, EACH COMMITTEE OF THE COUNCIL HAD TO CAREFULLY EXAMINE THE SUGGESTIONS MADE AND TRY TO MODIFY THE DRAFT ACCORDING TO THE WISHES OF THE MAJORITY."

ALTHOUGH THE GREAT MAJORITY OF THE DELEGATES TO THE COUNCIL ARE PERSONS OF CLERICAL BACKGROUND, THE COUNCIL PROCEEDINGS HAVE OCCASIONALLYREVEALED SHARP DISAGREEMENTS AMONG THE MEMBERS. THE MATTER OF PARLIAMENTARY IMMUNITY WAS DEBATED AT GREAT LENGTH AND THE ARTICLE (NO. 71) PASSED ONLY WHEN THE WORD "IMMUNITY" WAS OMITTED AND THE WORDING CHANGED TO READ: "EACH MEMBER OF THE NATIONAL ASSEMBLY IS FREE TO EXPRESS HIS OPINIONS IN THE ASSEMBLY WITHOUT FEAR OF REPRISALS."

THE DEBATE ON ARTICLE 42 (BAN ON TORTURE) LED TO DELEGATE MESHKINI'S OBJECTING TO A TOTAL BAN. HE ARGUED THAT IN SOME CASES OF EXTREME GRAVITY "A FEW SLAPS ON THE FACE...MAY REVEAL A LOT." ASSEMBLY VICE-PRESIDENT BEHESHTI ANSWERED MESHKINI BY SAYING "IF ONE IS ALLOWED TO SLAP SOMEONE ACCORDING TO THIS ARTICLE, TOMORROW IT WILL LEAD TO BRANDING PEOPLE WITH IRON RODS."

DEBATES ON ARTICLE 48 REVEALED THAT THERE WAS A SMALL GROUP OF DELEGATES WHO SOUGHT THE CREATION OF A BI-CAMERAL ------------------092367 151411Z /44 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 4255 INFO SECDEF WASH DC JCS WASH DC AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE SECTION 03 OF 04 TEHRAN 10976 LEGISLATURE IN WHICH ONE HOUSE WOULD GIVE ALL PROVINCES EQUAL REPRESENTATION.
