EAST AZARBAIJAN DELEGATE MOGHADDAM-MARAGHEH'I AND BALUCHESTAN DELEGATE MIR MORAD ZEHI HAVE BOTH ADVOCATED THE DUAL PARLIAMENT SYSTEM. IT IS INTERESTING TO NOTE THAT TEHRAN DELEGATE DR. GHAFFOURI (CF. PARA 6 ABOVE) ALSO SUPPORTED THE DUAL PARLIAMENT SYSTEM AS A WAY OF STRENGTHENING THE PRINCIPLE OF REGIONAL AND PROVINCIAL COUNCILS. THE ASSEMBLY OVERRODE THESE OBJECTIONS AND PASSED THE ONEHOUSE ARTICLE 54-3 (FIVE ABSTENTIONS).

THE COUNCIL OF GUARDIANS LEGISLATION (ARTICLE 78 AND OTHERS) HAS LED TO SOME SPIRITED DEBATES ON CLERICAL VERSUS SECULAR AUTHORITY IN THE NEW GOVERNMENT. THE COMPOSITION OF THE COUNCIL OF GUARDIANS IS TO BE SIX ISLAMIC SCHOLARS AND SIX LAWYERS. HOWEVER, THERE HAS BEEN STRONG OPPOSITION FROM SOME OF THE CONSERVATIVE MEMBERS TO INCLUDING LAWYERS ON THE BODY.

(COMMENT: SINCE THE REVOLUTION, LAWYERS HAVE FALLEN ON EVIL DAYS IN IRAN, AND SUCH LEADING LAWYERS AS FORUHAR, MATINDAFTARI, MINACHI, AND NAZIH HAVE COME UNDER INCREASING PRESSURE FROM THE CONSERVATIVE RELIGIOUS FIGURES.) AT THE SAME TIME DELEGATE MOQQADAM-MARAGHEH'I, TOLD MEETING OF HIS MOSLEM REPUBLICAN PEOPLES' PARTY (MPRP) IN EARLY OCTOBER THAT HE WAS UNEASY ABOUT ENTRUSTING THE COUNCIL OF GUARDIANS WITH SUCH VAST POWER. ARTICLE 77 STIPULATES THAT THE SIX RELIGIOUS MEMBERS OF THE COUNCIL ARE TO BE APPOINTED BY THE LEADING THEOLOGIAN (FAQIH) OR A COUNCIL ACTING IN HIS PLACE. THE SIX OTHER MEMBERS ARE TO BE APPOINTED BY THE NATIONAL ASSEMBLY.

DEBATE ALSO CONTINUES ON ARTICLE 5 (VELAYAT-E-FAQIH) AND 12 (OFFICIAL RELIGION). SUNNI KURDISH LEADER ALAMEH AHMAD MOFTIZADEH, GENERALLY CONSIDERED LEADER OF PRO-KHOMEINI FORCES IN SANANDAJ, CRITICIZED ARTICLE 12 AND REMARKED SARCASTICALLY THAT PERHAPS THE ASSEMBLY THOUGHT THAT CHANGING ITS NUMBER FROM UNLUCKY 13 (IN THE ORIGINAL DRAFT) TO 12 (IN THE APPROVED DRAFT) WOULD BRING ABOUT AN IMPROVEMENT.

CONCERNING VELAYAT-E-FAQIH, BALUCHI DELEGATE ZEHI (SEE ABOVE PARA 10) TOLD A REPORTER FOR THE ENGLISH-LANGUAGE "THE IRANIAN" THAT THE PEOPLE OF BALUCHESTAN, SINCE THEY ARE SUNNIS, DO NOT BELIEVE IN THE PRINCIPLE OF VELAYAT AS THE SHIAS DO. "WE DO NOT BELIEVE THAT VELAYAT WAS BESTOWED BY GOD ON THE PROPHET MOHAMMAD, AND THEN PASSED ON TO THE EMAMS AND THE FOQAHA (ISLAMIC LEGAL SCHOLARS)." AS REPORTED REF A, THE IMPLICATIONS OF VELAYAT-E-FAQIH ARE STILL UNCLEAR, AND NO LESS AN AUTHORITY THAN AYATOLLAH KAZEM SHARI'AT-MADARI TOLD A KAYHAN INTERNATIONAL REPORTER (SEPT 25) THAT THE CONCEPT WAS VAGUE AND WITHOUT CLEAR LEGAL MEANING.
HE ADDED THAT HE BELIEVED ARTICLE 5 SHOULD BE EXPLAINED FURTHER AND THAT PRECISE LEGAL BOUNDARIES SHOULD BE DEFINED FOR THE FAQIH.

THE COUNCIL IS CURRENTLY DEBATING THE APPLICATION OF VELAYAT-E-FAQIH. 1979TEHRAN10980.subject: POSITION OF JEWISH COMMUNITY IN IRAN

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

OVER PAST MONTH POLITICAL AND CONSULAR OFFICERS HAVE HAD A SERIES OF TALKS WITH VARIOUS MEMBERS OF JEWISH COMMUNITY IN IRAN RANGING FROM FORMER POLITICAL PRISONERS, TO PROFESSIONALS TO BUSINESSMEN. (THESE TALKS HAVE NOT INCLUDED THE RABINICAL LEADERSHIP OR LEFTIST JEWISH ORGANIZATIONS. FROM THESE TALKS A CONSISTENT PICTURE HAS EMERGED OF THE COMMUNITY'S FEAR OF THE IRANIAN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC.

AS FAR AS EMBASSY CAN TELL, AT THE MOMENT THE JEWISH COMMUNITY IS NOT BEING SINGLED OUT FOR HARASSMENT BY THE PGOI.THE COMMUNITY SEEMS TO FEEL THAT THE POLICY OF THE PGOI IS SUBTLY TO MAKE LIFE VERY DIFFICULT FOR THE JEWS SO THEY WILL DEPART OF THEIR OWN ACCORD. THIS FEELING IS APPARENTLY SHARED BY THE ARMENIANS WHOSE REPRESENTATIVE MADE THIS CHARGE OPENLY IN THE COUNCIL OF EXPERTS OCTOBER 8. JEWISH COMMUNITY LIFE APPEARS NO MORE OR LESS UNPLEASANT THAN THE LIFE OF OTHER MINORITIES OR SECULAR MOSLEMS IN IRAN.

SOME JEWISH INDUSTRIES, SMALL AND LARGE, HAVE BEEN TAKEN OVER BY COMMITTEES; SOME MEMBERS OF THE JEWISH COMMUNITY ARE IN JAIL ON ILL-DEFINED ANTI-REVOLUTIONARY CHARGES (ONE SOURCE ESTIMATED THIS NUMBER AT FIVE IN THE TEHRAN AREA) AND JEWISH SCHOOLS ARE UNDER HEAVY PRESSURE (TO WHICH MANY HAVE BOWED) TO SEGREGATE CLASSES. ALTHOUGH JEWISH COMMUNITY HAS TRIED BY SUCH RUSES AS MARCHING IN PRO-ISLAMIC REPUBLIC RALLIES TO DIVORCE ITSELF FROM CHARGES OF SUPPORT OF ISRAEL OR ZIONISM, THERE ARE SOME INDICATIONS OF GROWING MUSLIM IRANIAN HOSTILITY TO THE JEWISH COMMUNITY.
REPORTEDLY, SOME CHILDREN AT NON-JEWISH SCHOOLS AND UNIVERSITIES ARE HARASSED BY FELLOW STUDENTS AND SOME MUSLIM BUSINESSMEN ARE STARTING TO BOYCOTT JEWISH SUPPLIERS.

JEWISH COMMUNITY DOES NOT APPEAR TO FEEL PHYSICALLY THREATENED AT THE MOMENT. HOWEVER, THE POSITION OF SOME JEWISH LEADERS WHO ARE SUSPECT OF EITHER CORRUPTION OR "ZIONIST CONNECTIONS" IS EXTREMELY HAZARDOUS. EMBASSY HAS HEARD OF AT LEAST ONE PERSON PRESENTLY UNDER DEATH SENTENCE IN ABSENTIA FOR ZIONIST CONNECTIONS WHOM MEMBERS OF THE JEWISH COMMUNITY ARE SMUGGLING OUT OF COUNTRY. JEWISH COMMUNITY IS WORKING HARD TO SPRING (LEGALLY OR BY BRIBES) MEMBERS OF COMMUNITY STILL IN REVOLUTIONARY COURT JAILS. EMBOFFS HAVE HAD DISCUSSIONS WITH TWO RECENTLY RELEASED PRISONERS BOTH OF WHOM ARE STILL "UNCLEARED" BY THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS. THEIR ANAMOLOUS POSITION MEANS THAT THEY ARE SUBJECT TO REARREST AT ANY TIME.

ALL OF THIS AND A CONVICTION IN THE JEWISH COMMUNITY THAT THINGS ARE GOING TO GET WORSE APPEARS TO HAVE CONVINCED MANY MEMBERS OF THE COMMUNITY THAT IRAN NO LONGER OFFERS THEM A SAFE LIVING. AS FAR AS EMBASSY CAN DETERMINE THOSE MEMBERS OF THE JEWISH COMMUNITY WHO CAN DO SO ARE MAKING A CONCERTED EFFORT TO LEAVE IRAN OR AT LEAST TO SEND THEIR CHILDREN AND WIVES OUT TO SAFETY. ONE EMBASSY SOURCE OF QUESTIONABLE RELIABILITY ESTIMATES THE JEWISH COMMUNITY IN IRAN IS NOW ABOUT 60,000 PEOPLE. (COMMENT: FIGURES MAY NOW BE SOMEWHAT LOWER).

OF THESE ABOUT, THE SOURCE ESTIMATES, 20-30,000 WOULD GO TO ISRAEL, 10,000 TO EUROPE AND 10,000-20,000 TO THE US IF THE OPPORTUNITY WAS EASILY AVAILABLE. PGOI IS NOT BLOCKING DEPARTURE OF ANY JEWS OTHER THAN THOSE ON THEIR OVERALL WATCH LIST OF SUSPECT IRANIANS. PASSPORTS, EXIT PERMITS, ETC., HOWEVER, ARE OFTEN OBTAINED THRU PAYOFFS.

IN THEIR EFFORTS TO RELOCATE TEMPORARILY OR PERMANENTLY THE JEWISH COMMUNITY IS FACED WITH TWO SERIOUS ECONOMIC PROBLEMS. FIRST, MANY JEWISH BUSINESSMEN ARE HEAVILY INTO REAL ESTATE INVESTMENT AND IN TODAY'S DEPRESSED MARKET THEY MAY STAND TO LOSE 50 PERCENT OR MORE OF THEIR INVESTMENT IF THEY SELL OUT. OTHERS ARE STILL NEGOTIATING FOR RETURN OF BUSINESSES OR TRYING TO GET OLD BUSINESSES BACK ON THEIR FEET. THE SECOND PROBLEM CONCERNS GETTING MONEY OUT ONCE A BUSINESS IS SOLD. MANY INVENTIVE SCHEMES (SOME OF WHICH INVOLVE OVER-INVOICING) ARE BEING USED FOR THIS BY BOTH MUSLIMS AND ON-MUSLIMS TO CIRCUMVENT PGOI CURRENCY REGULATIONS BUT IT IS A RISKY BUSINESS.

THOSE CAUGHT STAND TO LOSE AT LEAST THEIR MONEY IF NOT FAR MORE AT THE HANDS OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS. ------------------092853 151541Z /46 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 4262 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 10980

COMMENT: EMBASSY FEELS THAT PRIMARY MOTIVATION FOR JEWISH MIGRATION FROM IRAN IS SIMILAR TO MOTIVATION OF MANY WESTERN-EDUCATED MUSLIMS: ECONOMIC AND POLITICAL UNCERTAINTY AND ALIENATION FROM THE KIND OF THEOCRATIC STATE THAT IS EMERGING FROM THE CONSTITUTIONAL PROCESS. SIMPLY PUT JEWS AND ARMENIANS, AS WELL AS MANY MUSLINS, FEEL THEY WILL HAVE NO PLACE IN THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC AS ENVISIONED BY KHOMEINI, BEHESHTI, AND OTHERS. THIS ANXIETY EXISTS DESPITE OFFICIAL REASSURANCES THAT THE RIGHTS OF JEWS, AS PEOPLE OF THE BOOK, ARE PROTECTED AND RECOGNIZED IN AN ISLAMIC STATE.

THE PGOI HAS NOT OPENLY DISCRIMINATED AGAINST MINORITIES, AND CERTAINLY THE IRANIAN JEWS RECEIVE FAR BETTER TREATMENT THAN DOES AN ANATHEMATIZED COMMUNITY LIKE THE BAHA'IS. AN ANNOUNCEMENT FROM NATIONAL REVOLUTIONARY PROSECUTOR QODDUSI OCTOBER 12 SPECIFICALLY WARNED AGAINST HARASSMENT OF THE RELIGIOUS MINORITIES,SAYING THAT "CERTAIN FRAUDULENT PEOPLE" HAD MADE UNAUTHORIZED ARRESTS OF INNOCENT PEOPLE, SEARCHES OF HOUSES AND HAD DEMANDED BRIBES. QODDUSI'S STATEMENT SEEMED TO INDICATE REVOLUTIONARY PROSECUTOR'S OFFICE WOULD BE TIGHTENING UP ON PROCEDURES FOR ISSUANCE OF WARRENTS AGAINST MINORITIES.

ON THE OTHER HAND, SHI'A ISLAM HAS ALWAYS CONTAINED AN ANTI-SEMITIC TRADITION WHICH HAS OCCASIONALLY MANIFESTED IN OUTBREAKS OF POPULAR VIOLENCE AGAINST IRANIAN JEWS, ESPECIALLY DURING PERIODS OF POLITICAL STRESS. MANY STRICT SHI'ITES CONSIDER ALL NON-MUSLIMS TO BE NAJES, OR RITUALLY UNCLEAN, AND CONSIDER ANYTHING TOUCHED BY THEM TO BE CONTAMINATED. HOWEVER, IN ITS PUBLIC DEALINGS WITH THE JEWISH COMMUNITY, BOTH THE PGOI AND THE REVOLUTIONARY AUTHORITIES, PERHAPS IN DEFERENCE TO WORLD OPINION, HAVE BEEN CORRECT. EMBASSY SUSPECTS, HOWEVER, THAT MANY LEADERS OF THE NEW REGIME WOULD BE HAPPIER IF THE ENTIRE IRANIAN JEWISH COMMUNITY LEFT THE COUNTRY.
EMBASSY PLANS TO KEEP IN CLOSE CONTACT WITH JEWISH COMMUNITY TO MONITOR ANY CHANGE IN ABOVE ASSESSMENT AND TO FOLLOW CASES OF JEWS PRESENTLY IN REVOLUTIONARY COURT

OIL MINISTER ALI AKHBAR MOINFAR IS QUOTED IN THE IRANIAN PRESS TODAY AS SAYING: "INTENSE PROPAGANDA AGAINST IRAN HAS BEGUN THESE DAYS IN THE UNITED STATES. NEWS AGENCIES AND MASS MEDIA OF THAT COUNTRY HAVE SPREAD RUMORS ABOUT DECREASE IN IRAN'S OIL PRODUCTION AND INABILITY OF TANKERS TO LOAD CRUDE AT IRANIAN PORTS." "THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT DENIES THESE RUMORS AND HAS INSTRUCTED ITS EMBASSY IN WASHINGTON TO PURSUE THIS MATTER AND FILE COMPLAINTS AGAINST SUCH NEWS AGENCIES AND MASS MEDIA."

MOINFAR IS REFERRING, WE PRESUME, TO THE ARTICLE IN THE LONDON BASED IOP OF OCTOBER 15 ON IRANIAN PRODUCTION SHORTFALLS. WE PLAN TO POINT OUT TO NIOC OFFICIALS AS OCCASIONS COME UP IN THE NEXT FEW DAYS THAT RUMORS OF IRANIAN PRODUCTION CUTS ARE NOT HEARD ONLY
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

ENGLISH LANGUAGE WEEKLY RUMOR SHEET CALLED"EXCLUSIVE"ON OCTOBER 14 CARRIES STORY THAT PART OF DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER TABATABAI'S TRIP TO LEBANON RESULTED IN AGREEMENT WITH PALESTINIAN LEADERS TO HELP IRANIAN REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS ACQUIRE MORE TRAINING FROM PALESTINIANS IN GUERILLA WARFARE CONCERNING MOUNTAINOUS REGIONS. STORY SAYS TABATABAI EXTENDED INVITATION TO PALESTINIAN MILITARY ADVISORS TO VISIT IRAN AND SPECULATES CURRENT VISIT OF "PLO OPERATIONS COMMANDER ABU JAHAD" (REFTEL) MAY BE CONNECTED WITH TABATABAI'S INVITATION.

EXCLUSIVE ALSO SPECULATES TABATABAI IN SYRIA GOT ASSURANCES THAT RADICAL PALESTINIAN GROUP "SAEGHE" (SAIQA) WAS NOT INVOLVED IN KHUZESTAN TROUBLES AND THAT SYRIA PROMISED TO HOLD NEGOTIATIONS WITH GEORGE HABASH'S GROUP TO PREVENT THEM FROM INVOLVEMENT IN THE REGION.
EMBASSY WOULD APPRECIATE ANY LIGHT ADDRESSEES COULD SHED ON ANY OF ABOVE. LAINGEN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

DURING OCTOBER 10 DISCUSSION OF IRANIAN PRESS ATTACKS ON US OVER KURDESTAN,ACTING CHIEF OF MFA FOURTH POLITICAL DIVISION, PARSA KIA, ONCE AGAIN BROUGHT UP SUBJECT OF CHARGE'S TALK WITH INTERIOR MINISTER SABAGHIAN ON HUMAN RIGHTS. PARSA KIA IS INTELLIGENT, FRIENDLY TO US AND HIMSELF VERY WORRIED OVER THE "EXCESSES" OF THE REVOLUTIONARY GOVERNMENT. HE SEEMED MAINLY CONCERNED WE HAD RAISED THE QUESTION WITH SABAGHIAN RATHER THAN COMING THROUGH FONMIN YAZDI. THE FOREIGN OFFICE, HE SAID, COULD BE COUNTED ON TO KEEP SUCH DISCUSSIONS PRIVATE.

IN ADDITION, FOREIGN MINISTER YAZDI KNEW HOW TO TRANSLATE THE US'S REMARKS INTO LANGUAGE WHICH WOULD DO THE MOST GOOD IN QOM OR AT LEAST WOULD NOT RAISE SO MUCH TROUBLE. US VIEWS, HE ASSURED US, WOULD, HOWEVER, GET THROUGH.

PARSA KIA POINTED OUT STANDARD SECULAR INTELLECTUAL LINE THAT "REVOLUTION NOT YET FINISHED." AS YOU KNOW, HE SAID, THERE ARE TWO GOVERNMENTS AND WHILE WE WOULD LIKE TO SEE THESE THINGS CEASE WE CAN NOT YET CONTROL THE SITUATION.

COMMENT: WHILE EMBASSY SYMPATHIZES WITH ANGUISH OF PEOPLE LIKE PARSA KIA AND REGRETS THE STORM THAT SABAGHIAN'S COMMENTS CAUSED AT A VERY INOPPORTUNE MOMENT, PUBLIC KNOWLEDGE OF US PROTEST ON EXECUTIONS HAS RAISED EMBASSY'S CREDIT IN EYES OF MANY MODERATE IRANIANS. USG DISAPPROVAL PLAINLY TOUCHED VERY SENSITIVE NERVE ENDING IN IRAN, INDICATIVE PERHAPS OF THE GROWING UNEASE EVEN AMONG SUPPORTERS OF THE REVOLUTION AT THE OCCASIONAL EXCESSES OF THEIR NEW GOVERNMENT. WE NOTE, BY THE WAY, THAT SABAGHIAN WAS A FORMER MEMBER OF THE IRAN HUMAN RIGHTS COMMITTEE. LAINGEN

1979TEHRAN11005.subject: CRUSADE FOR RECONSTRUCTION - REPORT FROM FARS

segments.text: (C-ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY: THE CRUSADE FOR RECONSTRUCTION IS FOR REAL. AT THE BEHEST OF DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER BANI-ASSADI (REFS) TDY ECONOFF VISITED THE PROVINCIAL HEADQUARTERS OF THE CRUSADE (IN FARSI - JEHAD SAZANDEGI OR SIMPLY "JEHAD") IN SHIRAZ, AND TOURED A NUMBER OF PROJECTS IN THE AREA. THESE RANGE FROM HANDOUTS WARNING THE PEOPLE OF TRUCKERS WHO OVERCHARGE (WOE UNTO THEM*) AND THE DISTRIBUTION OF BOOKS AND MEDICINES TO THE PROVISION, WITH CONTRIBUTIONS IN CASH AND LABOR BY THE VILLAGES TO BE BENEFITTED, OF ROADS, POTABLE WATER, COMMUNAL SHOWERS (HAMMAMS), SCHOOLS, CLINICS AND MOSQUES. ONE HUNDRED VOLUNTEERS RUN 160 PROJECTS IN THE PROVINCE OF FARS.

THROUGH THE REQUIREMENT OF CONTRIBUTIONS, AND THROUGH DISCRETIONARY AUTHORITY INVESTED IN ITS LOCAL PROJECT MANAGERS, THE JEHAD STRENGTHENS THE CONCEPT OF A RETURN TO LOCAL AUTONOMY (REF A). VILLAGERS SEEM TO FIND THE JEHAD A FLEXIBLE ENTITY PROMPT TO RESPOND TO THEIR NEEDS, A FAR CRY, ARGUE THE VOLUNTEERS, FROM THE NEGLECT AND INEFFICIENCY CHARACTERISTIC OF THE OLD REGIME. BECAUSE SO MUCH IS CONTRIBUTED, PROJECTS ARGUABLY COST A FRACTION OF WHAT THE VILLAGERS WOULD HAVE TO PAY TO COMMERCIAL ENTERPRISES FOR THE SAME WORK. HOW MUCH IS REALLY SAVED DEPENDS ON THE EXTENT AND EFFECTIVENESS OF THE VOLUNTARY LABOR.

FOR THE VOLUNTEERS, THE JEHAD IS A VEHICLE FOR THEIR DESIRE TO DO SOMETHING FOR THE PEOPLE. THEIR ENTHUSIASM IS CONTAGIOUS. IF ITS FREE-FLOATING UNLAYERED ORGANIZATION CAN LEAVE GAPS, NOTABLY IN THE MOTOR POOL, IT, AT THE SAME TIME, PROVIDES SCOPE FOR MUCH GREATER INITIATIVE. CONSIDERING THAT THE CONCEPT WAS LAUNCHED ONLY FIVE MONTHS AGO, AND THAT THE ENTITY IS ONLY FOUR MONTHS OLD, THE JEHAD IS QUITE AN ACHIEVEMENT. END SUMMARY.

ORGANIZATIONAL STRUCTURE. THE CHIEF OF THE JEHAD FOR THE PROVINCE OF FARS, OF WHICH SHIRAZ IS THE CAPITAL, IS GHOLAM-HOSSEIN NEJABAT, A LOCALLY TRAINED ENGINEER. HIS HEADQUARTERS ARE IN A SEMI-FINISHED MANSION CONFISCATED FROM AN ADHERENT OF THE OLD REGIME NOW IN EXILE. (AS MAYOR OF SHIRAZ, HE HAD "STOLEN FROM THE PEOPLE"). IN EACH TOWN, THERE IS A LOCAL DIRECTOR, WITH MANAGERS FOR EACH PROJECT. LIKE NEJABAT, THOSE IN MARVDASHT AND JAHRUM, THE TWO SITES VISITED, WERE NATIVE TO THEIR AREAS. THEY WORK OUT OF BORROWED OFFICE SPACE IN MUNICIPAL BUILDINGS.

THE JEHAD HAS LITTLE EQUIPMENT OF ITS OWN. JEEPS, CARRYALLS, ETC. ARE BORROWED FROM OTHER GOVERNMENT AGENCIES. TRUCKS AND CONSTRUCTION EQUIPMENT ARE ALSO BORROWED, SOME AS A CONTRIBUTION FROM PRIVATE SECTOR INDUSTRIAL ENTERPRISES. ONE FACTORY HAD VOLUNTEERED TO MAINTAIN THE VEHICLES BORROWED BY THE JEHAD, A CONTRIBUTION OF SMALL COMFORT TO TDY ECONOFF AS HE SAT STRANDED MILES BEYOND JAHRUM, A DATE-GROWING OASIS IN THE DESERT SEVERAL HOURS SOUTH OF SHIRAZ. NO ONE HAD CHECKED THE OIL FILTER IN SOME TIME. SYSTEMATIC AND PREVENIENT ADMINISTRATION IS NOT ALWAYS COMPATIBLE WITH SPONTANEITY.

AS WITH CASH AND MANUAL LABOR, THOSE BEING BENEFITTED ARE EXPECTED TO CONTRIBUTE WHAT EQUIPMENT THEY CAN. JEHAD HEADQUARTERS, WITH THE HELP OF THE UNIVERSITY OF SHIRAZ COMPUTER, MAINTAINS A TALLY OF ALL VEHICLES AND EQUIPMENT IN THE PROVINCE POTENTIALLY AVAILABLE FOR PROJECTS.

COMPOSITION OF PERSONNEL. ALMOST ALL UNDER 30, WITH EDUCATED FACES AND POLITE MANNERS, THE VOLUNTEERS MIGHT HAVE FITTED EASILY INTO ANY AMERICAN GRADUATE SCHOOL SCENE. AND MANY HAD. ONE, FOR EXAMPLE, HAD JUST TAKEN ------------------101112 161727Z /51 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 4283 INFO AMEMBASSY CAIRO AMEMBASSY BEIRUT AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY TEL AVIV SECTION 02 OF 05 TEHRAN 11005 HIS MA AT THE UNIVERSITY OF FLORIDA IN NUCLEAR ENGINEERING. A PRINCIPAL DEPUTY OF NEJABAT HAD DONE ELECTRICAL AND ELECTRONIC ENGINEERING AT LOUISIANA STATE UNIVERSITY. PROJECT DIRECTOR OWRANGI IN MARVDASHT HAD TAKEN HIS MA IN CIVIL ENGINEERING FROM THE UNIVERSITY OF LOUISVILLE.

SOME VOLUNTEERS, APPARENTLY, HAD JOINED THE JEHAD BECAUSE THEY COULD NOT FIND JOBS TO THEIR LIKING. A LARGER NUMBER WERE CIVIL SERVANTS SENT ON DETAIL TO THE JEHAD WHEN CERTAIN PROGRAMS OF THE OLD REGIME HAD BEEN CURTAILED. THE LOCAL DIRECTOR IN JAHRUM WAS A TEACHER OF LITERATURE, STILL ON FULL SALARY FROM THE MINISTRY OF EDUCATION. SO WAS HIS DEPUTY. MOST, HOWEVER, APPEARED TO HAVE BEEN GENUINE UNPAID VOLUNTEERS OVER THE PAST FOUR MONTHS. OWRANGI FOR EXAMPLE, WAS BEING SUPPORTED BY HIS FATHER, WHO BELIEVED IN THE JEHAD, (JUDGING FROM OWRANGI'S PERSONALITY AND STYLE, HIS FATHER COULD AFFORD IT.)

TWO OF THESE VOLUNTEERS POINTED OUT, AND CONVINCINGLY, THAT THEY COULD GET GOOD ENGINEERING JOBS ANY TIME THEY WANTED. OTHERS, THEY SAID, WERE IN EXACTLY THE SAME SITUATION. THEY HAD CHOSEN INSTEAD TO JOIN THE JEHAD BECAUSE THEY WANTED A "CHANCE TO SERVE THE PEOPLE." THEIR ENTHUSIASM SEEMED UNBOUNDED. HOW LONG THEY COULD ALL GO ON WORKING WITHOUT PAY WAS SOMETHING WHICH DID NOT APPEAR TO BOTHER THEM UNDULY. CONSIDERATION WAS BEING GIVEN, ONE SAID, TO A LIVING ALLOWANCE FOR THOSE WITHOUT CIVIL SERVICE STIPENDS.

POLITICAL AND RELIGIOUS ORIENTATION. THE VOLUNTEERS WERE GOING THROUGH A REACTION TO THE MISALLOCATION OF NATIONAL RESOURCES BY THE FORMER SHAH, EGGED ON, IT WAS SAID, BY THE UNITED STATES. WHY, WITH MANY IRANIAN VILLAGES WITHOUT BASIC PUBLIC FACILITIES DID THE UNITED STATES HAVE TO SELL ALL THOSE EXPENSIVE ARMS TO IRAN? WHY DID IRAN NEED NUCLEAR REACTORS AT A TIME WHEN IT WAS FLARING SO MUCH NATURAL GAS? WHY IMPORT KOREAN WORKERS, WITH UNEMPLOYMENT ENDEMIC IN IRAN?

AT NO POINT WAS THEIR EXPRESSIONS OF EMNITY FOR THE TERMS. OCCASIONALLY THERE WAS A PIOUS REFERENCE TO GOD, IN WHOSE NAME EVERY JEHAD DOCUMENT BEGINS. BUT RELIGIOUS FANATICISM WAS NOT IN EVIDENCE. FOR EXAMPLE, ONE OF THE PROJECTS IN MARVDASHT WAS A TWIN HIGH SCHOOL, ONE FOR BOYS AND ONE FOR GIRLS, SIDE-BY-SIDE ON THE SITE OF A FORMER BAHAI TEMPLE DESTROYED DURING THE REVOLUTION. OWRANGI JUSTIFIED THE DESTRUCTION NOT ON THE GROUNDS THAT THE BAHA'IS WERE HERETICS, BUT BECAUSE THE SHAH HAD RELIED HEAVILY ON THE BAHA'IS AND MADE THEM PARTNERS IN MANY A COMMERCIAL DEAL, OBVIOUSLY AT THE EXPENSE OF THE PEOPLE.

BAHA'IS CONTINUED TO LIVE, SAID OWRANGI, IN MARVDASHT. (THE RANK ORDERING OF THE VALUE SYSTEM OF THE VOLUNTEERS, AND, THEREFORE, OF THE JEHAD, IS BEST SEEN IN THEIR RANK ORDERING OF PROJECTS, DISCUSSED BELOW.)

PROJECT MANAGEMENT. THE TWIN HIGH SCHOOLS WERE A DONATION OF ONE ADHERENT OF THE REVOLUTION IN MARVDASHT. A COMMERCIAL ENTERPRISE WOULD PERFORM THE WORK. THAT, HOWEVER, WAS ATYPICAL. IN GENERAL, THE VILLAGE TO BE BENEFITTED IS EXPECTED TO CONTRIBUTE ONE-THIRD OF THE COSTS OF ANY PROJECT, IF IT CAN, AS WELL AS ALL THE UNSKILLED LABOR AND EQUIPMENT IT CAN. AS NOTED ABOVE, THE GOVERNMENT AND SOME COMMERCIAL ENTERPRISES CONTRIBUTE VEHICLES, WHILE THE VOLUNTEERS' SERVICES (I.E.: PLANNING, ENGINEERING AND MANAGEMENT) ARE COST-FREE.

THE ONLY COSTS ASSOCIATED WITH A TYPICAL PROJECT, THEREFORE, ARE THE ------------------101380 161728Z /51 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 4284 INFO AMEMBASSY CAIRO AMEMBASSY BEIRUT AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY TEL AVIV SECTION 03 OF 05 TEHRAN 11005 MATERIALS AND THE SKILLED LABOR. A TYPICAL JEHAD PROJECT ARGUABLY COSTS ONLY A FRACTION OF WHAT IT WOULD COST IF THE GOVERNMENT, OR THE VILLAGE, HAD CONTRACTED THE WORK OUT TO A COMMERCIAL FIRM.

A PROJECT BEGINS WHEN VILLAGE SPOKESMEN APPROACH THE LOCAL OFFICE OF THE JEHAD. OFTEN THIS HAPPENS AFTER A PROJECT IS SEEN TO BE SATISFACTORILY UNDER WAY IN A NEIGHBORING VILLAGE, A SORT OF DEMONSTRATION EFFECT WHICH TENDS TO OVERCOME THE VILLAGERS' INNATE SUSPICION OF OUTSIDERS AND OF WHAT MIGHT HAPPEN TO THEIR MONEY. THE LOCAL JEHAD DIRECTOR ENCOURAGES THE VILLAGERS TO ELECT A REPRESENTATIVE COMMITTEE WITH WHICH HE CAN NEGOTIATE. HE ASCERTAINS HOW MUCH THE VILLAGERS ARE WILLING AND ABLE TO SPEND, AND ADVISES THEM OF WHAT MIGHT BE DONE WITHIN THOSE LIMITS.

BEING A NATIVE OF THE MARVDASHT AREA, OWRANGI SAID THAT HE KNEW EXACTLY WHAT EACH VILLAGE WAS REALLY CAPABLE OF CONTRIBUTING, USUALLY RATHER MORE THAN ITS SPOKESMEN WERE WILLING TO ADMIT. THE LOCAL DIRECTOR THEN MAKES HIS RECOMMENDATION TO SHIRAZ, AND OBTAINS APPROVAL. ONLY WHEN THE VILLAGERS HAVE PAID IN THEIR ONE-THIRD (OR OTHER) CONTRIBUTION IS THE FILE MOVED UP INTO THE "ACTIVE" DRAWER. THE VILLAGERS' MONEY IS SENT TO SHIRAZ, BANKED TOGETHER WITH FUNDS WHICH SHIRAZ HAS OBTAINED FROM TEHRAN, AND THE ACCOUNT TRANSFERRED BACK TO A LOCAL BRANCH BANK. THE LOCAL DIRECTOR (OR PROJECT MANAGER) CAN DRAW ON THIS AS HE LIKES.

FROM THT POINT ON, THE INITIATIVE AND RESPONSIBILITY IS PURELY LOCAL. AS A RESULT, JEHAD OFFICES ARE OFTEN BOMBARDED WITH FAR MORE REQUESTS THAN THEY CAN POSSIBLY MEET, SO UNEXPECTEDLY IMPRESSED ARE THE LOCALS WITH THE ABSENCE OF BUREAUCRATIC DELAY AND EVIDENCE OF LOCAL INITIATIVE. IN MARVDASHT, FOR EXAMPLE, THERE WERE MORE THAN TWICE AS MANY FILES IN THE "PENDING" AS THERE WERE IN THE "ACTIVE" DRAWER.

AMONG THE PROJECTS VISITED BY TDY ECONOFF WAS A AND 2 FOR TOILETS. THE MEN IN THE VILLAGE WOULD USE IT BETWEEN 5:00 A.M. AND 8:00 A.M., WHEN THEY WENT TO WORK, AFTER WHICH IT WOULD BE TURNED OVER TO THE WOMEN. AT THE OUTSIDE, THE COST WOULD BE 150,000 TOMANS (15,000 DOLS.) TOWARDS WHICH THE VILLAGERS HAD CONTRIBUTED 50,000 TOMANS. CONSTRUCTION WOULD BE COMPLETED IN 3 MONTHS, A FRACTION OF THE TIME THAT NORMAL CONTRACTING WOULD TAKE.

A WATER SUPPLY PROJECT WITH WELL, TOWER, AND PIPES TO EACH HOUSE, WAS UNDERWAY IN THE NEXT VILLAGE. AS WITH ALL SUCH PROJECTS, THE WATCHWORD WAS SIMPLICITY AND MANAGEABILITY. THUS, IN THE UNITED STATES, THE WATER TOWER WOULD (WE PRESUME) BE EQUIPPED WITH SOME SORT OF FLOAT VALVE, TO CUT OFF THE PUMP ONCE THE TANK HAD FILLED. "IF," SAID OWRANGI, "WE WERE TO INSTALL ANY SUCH AUTOMATIC DEVICE, THE VILLAGERS WOULD ONLY MESS IT UP, AND THERE WOULD BE NO ONE READILY AVAILABLE TO FIX IT. INSTEAD, THE VILLAGERS WILL HIRE A MAN PERIODICALLY TO TURN ON THE PUMP.

WHEN HE SEES WATER BEGINNING TO SPILL OUT FROM THE TOP OF THE TOWER, HE WILL TURN OFF THE PUMP." (PRACTICAL EXPERIENCE WITH VILLAGERS ASIDE, THIS REFLECTS A REACTION AGAINST UNNECESSARILY COMPLEX TECHNOLOGY, BEYOND THE CAPACITY OF THE COUNTRY TO ABSORB IT, WHICH IS A LEGACY OF THE SHAH. MOREOVER, SUCH SIMPLIFICATION TENDS TO CREATE, RATHER THAN DISPLACE, JOBS.)

PROJECT PRIORITIES. THE FIRST IMPROVEMENT USUALLY REQUESTED BY VILLAGERS IS THE LUXURY OF A HAMMAM (COMMUNAL SHOWER), NEXT IS LIKELY TO BE A SCHOOL, THEN A MOSQUE, THEN A WATER SUPPLY. WHILE THE VILLAGERS' PREFERENCES, AND ABILITY TO CONTRIBUTE, ARE OBVIOUSLY TAKEN INTO ACCOUNT, THE PRIORITIES OF THE JEHAD PREVAIL. OF THESE, THE FIRST IS: - ROADS. WITHOUT COMMUNICATION WITH THE REST OF THE WORLD A VILLAGE MUST REMAIN UNCIVILIZED.

TDY ECONOFF WAS SHOWN A ROAD, AND CULVERT OVER A STREAM, WHICH ULTIMATELY WOULD ------------------101209 161730Z /51 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 4285 INFO AMEMBASSY CAIRO AMEMBASSY BEIRUT AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY TEL AVIV SECTION 04 OF 05 TEHRAN 11005 EXTEND FOR 47 KILOMETERS OF WATER-BOUND MACADAM, EASY TO BUILD AND EASIER TO MAINTAIN. THERE WAS CONSIDERABLE VOLUNTARY LABOR FROM THE 7 - 8 VILLAGES MOST IMMEDIATELY TO BE REACHED, AND THIS, IT WAS REPEATEDLY SAID, HAD CUT THE COST DRAMATICALLY. ALREADY ITS SOCIAL IMPACT HAD BECOME APPARENT. PEOPLE WERE SAID TO BE MOVING BACK TO THESE VILLAGES.

THIS TREND AWAY FROM URBAN AGGLOMERATION IS MUCH DESIRED BY THE PRESENT REGIME. YET, WHILE ALL AGREED ON THE PRIORITY TO BE ACCORDED ROADS, ROADS ARE, RELATIVE TO OTHER PROJECTS, EXPENSIVE AND NOT OF SUCH IMMEDIATE IMPACT. ONE VOLUNTEER VOICED THE HOPE THAT THE GOI WOULD ABSORB THIS PART OF THE PROGRAM. THE NEXT IS: - POTABLE WATER. UPON THIS UNDISPUTABLY DEPENDED THE HEALTH OF THE VILLAGERS. AFTER THIS COMES A: - HAMMAM OR SCHOOL. THIS WAS A TOSS-UP. THE HAMMAM ENJOYS HIGH PRIORITY NOT BECAUSE IT MAKES LIFE MORE AGREEABLE FOR THE VILLAGERS, (WHICH IT DOES), BUT BECAUSE IT CONTRIBUTES TO THEIR HEALTH.
NEXT WOULD COME A: - CLINIC, FOR THE SAME REASON.

ACCORDING TO THE JEHAD'S OWN CRITERIA, A MOSQUE WOULD ENJOY LOWEST PRIORITY. TDY ECONOFF VISITED ONE MOSQUE UNDER CONSTRUCTION BY THE JEHAD, BUT THAT WAS IN A VILLAGE NEAR A MAIN PAVED ROAD, WHICH ALREADY HAD A SCHOOL AND A WATER SUPPLY, AND WHERE THE JEHAD WAS ALREADY BUILDING A HAMMAM. MANAGER OWRANGI SAID THAT HE HAD PREVAILED ON THE VILLAGE COMMITTEE TO ADD A KETAB-KHANEH, OR LIBRARY, TO THE MOSQUE, A SORT OF REC-ROOM "FOR THE YOUNG PEOPLE TO GATHER IN." ACCORDING TO OWRANGI, QUM WOULD PROVIDE AN IMAM. "THAT," HE SAID, WITH A TWINKLE IN HIS EYE, "IS SOMETHING THAT QUM CAN DO."

(NOTE: THE CONTRIBUTION OF DRINKING WATER, OR SANITARY OR MEDICAL FACILITIES SATISFIES AN IMPORTANT OBLIGATION ON BELIEVERS. THE CONSTRUCTION OF SUCH FACILITIES HAS LONG BEEN CONSIDERED SUPEREROGATORY ACTS OF GRACE ON THE PART OF THE BELIEVER.)

PROJECT ALLOCATION. SHIRAZ AWARDS FUNDS NOT MERELY ON THE DESIRABILITY OF THE PROJECT FOR THAT PARTICULAR VILLAGE, BUT ALSO ON THE BASIS OF HOW THAT PROJECT WILL RAISE THE GENERAL LEVEL OF "CIVILIZATION" THROUGHOUT THE PROVINCE, CIVILIZATION IS DEFINED AS THE STATE OF THE ROADS, AND HOW MANY SCHOOLS, CLINICS, HAMMAMS, POTABLE WATER SUPPLY, ETC. ARE FOUND IN EACH VILLAGE-CLUSTER. THE DATA IS FED INTO THE COMPUTER AT THE UNIVERSITY OF SHIRAZ, AND WINDS UP IN A VERTICAL BAR GRAPH, ONE BAR FOR EACH VILLAGE CLUSTER. ON A SCALE OF 100, THE HIGHEST LEVEL OF CIVILIZATION REACHED BY ANY VILLAGE CLUSTER WAS

LEVELS OF CIVILIZATION VARY WIDELY BELOW THAT TOP PERCENTAGE. PRIORITY IN THE ALLOCATION OF FUNDS IS GIVEN TO THE VILLAGE CLUSTER WITH THE LOWEST PERCENTAGE SCORE, IN ORDER TO EVEN OUT DISPARITIES THROUGHOUT THE PROVINCE, AND THUS GRADUALLY TO RAISE THE GENERAL LEVEL FOR ALL.

PROVINCE CHIEF NEJABAT WAS UNWILLING TO STATE WHETHER THE JEHAD IN HIS PROVINCE OF FARS WAS TYPICAL OF THE REST OF THE COUNTRY. FARS IS "BETTER," HE ALLOWED. THE VILLAGERS WERE MORE "HELPFUL" THAN ELSEWHERE. ONE OF HIS STAFFERS ACKNOWLEDGED THAT BAZARGAN'S PAEAN TO THE JEHAD (REF C) PERHAPS WENT A BIT FAR IN ITS RECITATION OF DETAIL. NEVERTHELESS THE MAIN THRUST, HE SAID, WAS CORRECT.

COMMENT: THE JEHAD MELDS A NUMBER OF MOTIVES, PERSONAL AND NATIONAL. .A VEHICLE ENABLING SOME OF THE REVOLUTION'S YOUNGER AND MORE IDEALISTIC SUPPORTERS TO DEMONSTRATE THEIR SUPPORT THROUGH PARTICIPATION IN THE REVOLUTION, IT ENABLES THE GOVERNMENT TO DEMONSTRATE TO IRAN'S VILLAGERS THAT IT CARES, AND THAT THE REVOLUTION IS FOR THEIR BENEFIT AS WELL. USEFUL WORK IS FOUND FOR ------------------105971 170538Z /10 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 4286 INFO AMEMBASSY CAIRO AMEMBASSY BEIRUT AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY TEL AVIV SECTION 05 OF 05 TEHRAN 11005 POSSIBLY REDUNDANT CIVIL SERVANTS AND TEACHERS, WHILE SOME INFRASTRUCTURAL AND PUBLIC HEALTH OBJECTIVES ARE MET.

TO WHATEVER EXTENT ALL THE YOUNGER VOLUNTEERS SHARE, OR DO NOT SHARE, THE MILITANT FAITH OF THE REAL RULERS OF PRESENT-DAY IRAN, THIS JEHAD, WHICH MEANS EFFORT OR STRUGGLE, PROCLAIMS AND EXEMPLIFIES ISLAMIC TEACHINGS.

ONE MAY ASK HOW LONG-LIVED THIS EFFORT WILL BE. THE ENTHUSIASM SEEN AFTER FOUR MONTHS MAY BEGIN TO TAPER AFTER A YEAR. AS THE REVOLUTION BECOMES STATIC, HOW MANY NEW VOLUNTEERS WILL THERE BE? OR WILL THE JEHAD CONTINUE, AS IS HOPED, TO INFUSE FRESH LIFE INTO THE REVOLUTIONARY PROCESS? IF IT SUCCEEDS IN THIS, THEN THE LIMITATIONS OF SCOPE, RESOURCES AND IMPACT, AND THE AT TIMES QUESTIONABLE SAVINGS (15,000 DOLS. COMMUNAL SHOWER?) WILL HARDLY
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: UNREST CONTINUES TO BE FELT ACROSS IRAN, AND SOME OF THE CLASHES DESCRIBED RECENTLY CAN BE ATTRIBUTED TO POPULAR DISLIKE FOR REVOLUTIONARY GUARD INTERFERENCE AND EXCESSES. FOUR ASSASSINATION ATTEMPTS HAVE BEEN REPORTED, AND A WEST GERMAN BUSINESSMAN WAS KILLED IN TEHRAN. UNEMPLOYMENT CONTINUES TO BE A MAJOR PROBLEM, AND DESPITE A GOVERNMENT EDICT, PROTESTS AND DEMONSTRATIONS BY THE UNEMPLOYED HAVE OCCURRED IN SEVERAL CITIES. THE MUNICIPAL ELECTIONS HELD ACROSS IRAN ON OCTOBER 12 PROVED TO BE FAR LESS A SUCCESS THAN THE PGOI HOPED, AND WERE MARKED BY VIOLENCE IN SOME AREAS AS WELL AS A GENERAL CHARGE OF RIGGING. END SUMMARY.

THE POLITICAL SCENE IN IRAN OVER THE PAST TWO WEEKS HAS CONTINUED TO BE DOMINATED BY CONTINUED VIOLENCE AND UNREST IN THE ETHNIC KURDISH AREAS (SEPTEL). FLARE-UPS HAVE BEEN REPORTED AT THE CASPIAN SEA COAST CITY OF BANDAR ANZELI (FORMERLY BANDAR PAHLAVI), IN SISTAN AND BALUCHESTAN, AND AT THE TURKISH-IRANIAN BORDER TOWN OF MAKU. MANY OF THESE INCIDENTS SEEM TO ORIGINATE FROM PROBLEMS WITH THE REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS.

IN MAKU, WEST AZERBAIJAN, A DEMONSTRATION WAS HELD ON OCTOBER 14 BY THOUSANDS OF AREA RESIDENTS TO PROTEST THE "IRRESPONSIBLE ACTIONS" OF THE LOCAL REVOLUTIONARY GUARD CONTINGENT. SCHOOLS AND SHOPS WERE SHUT, AND ACCESS TO THE NEARBY BAZARGHAN BORDER POST WAS HALTED. ACCORDING TO WEST AZARBAIJAN GOVERNOR-GENERAL HAQGOU, ONE INCIDENT WHICH LED TO THE PROTEST HAD OCCURRED TWO NIGHTS EARLIER, WHEN THE REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS OPENED FIRE ON A CAR WHOSE PASSENGERS WERE DRINKING ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES. ANOTHER INCIDENT HAD BEEN THE ARREST OF NINE LOCAL PEASANTS BY REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS FROM TABRIZ, WHO APPARENTLY CAME INTO THE WEST AZARBAIJAN AREA WITHOUT BOTHERING TO INFORM THAT PROVINCE'S GOVERNORGENERAL OF THEIR PLANS.

TROUBLE IN BANDAR ANZELI (BANDAR PAHLAVI) ALSO INVOLVED CLASHES BETWEEN THE REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS AND LOCAL CITIZENS. VIOLENCE IN THE CITY BEGAN ON OCTOBER 15 AND CONTINUED THE NEXT DAY, LEAVING A TOTAL OF TEN DEAD AND 34 INJURED. GENDARMERIE AND NAVY FORCES WERE EVENTUALLY CALLED IN TO RESTORE ORDER AND RESCUE THE REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS WHO HAD TAKEN REFUGE INSIDE A LOCAL POLICE STATION. APPARENTLY THE TROUBLE ORIGINATED IN DISPUTES OVER FISHING RIGHTS NEAR THE COASTAL TOWN, WHEN LOCAL FISHERMEN PROTESTED RESTRICTIONS IMPOSED BY THE GOVERNMENT'S NORTHERN FISHERIES COMPANY.

KHUZESTAN PROVINCE WAS RELATIVELY QUIET DURING THE PAST WEEK, ALTHOUGH TWO BOMBS EXPLODED IN A RESIDENTIAL QUARTER OF KHORRAMSHAHR ON OCTOBER 10. NO DAMAGE OR CASUALTIES WERE REPORTED. ANOTHER EXPLOSIVE DEVICE WAS DISCOVERED BUT WAS DEFUSED BEFORE IT COULD EXPLODE. IN AHWAZ A BOMB WAS FOUND AT THE SHARIF VAQEFI HIGH SCHOOL, BUT WAS ALSO DEFUSED.

ON OCTOBER 4, UNIDENTIFIED GUNMEN CAPTURED TAQI ROUHANI, A PAHLAVI-REGIME RADIO COMMENTATOR, AS HE WAS BEING ESCORTED TO TEHRAN'S MEHRABAD AIRPORT BY REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS TO BEGIN A SIX YEAR SENTENCE OF EXILE IMPOSED BY THE REVOLUTIONARY COURT. ROUHANI WAS LATER DISCOVERED WITH A BULLET WOUND IN THE HEAD, BUT HOSPITAL SOURCES CLAIM HE WILL PROBABLY LIVE.
