THE WOULD-BE ATTACKERS ESCAPED.

THE SAME DAY, HOJJATOLISLAM MOHAMMED BAQER DASHTYANI, HEAD OF TEHRAN'S DISTRICT 13 REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE, WAS ALSO THE TARGET OF AN ASSASSINATION ATTEMPT. IN WHAT IS BECOMING A FAMILIAR SCENARIO, TWO "UNIDENTIFIED" MEN ON A MOTORCYCLE WOUNDED DASHTYANI AS HE WAS WALKING HOME FROM COMMITTEE HEADQUARTERS. ON OCTOBER 14, HANS JOACHIM LEIB, THE WEST GERMAN CHIEF ACCOUNTANT FOR MERCK, INC., WAS AMBUSHED AND KILLED OUTSIDE HIS TEHRAN HOME. THE ASSAILANTS ESCAPED BY MOTORCYCLE, AND A LEAFLET FOUND NEAR LEIB'S BODY CLAIMED THAT THE MOSLEM EXTREMIST "FORGHAN" GROUP WAS RESPONSIBLE FOR THE DEATH.

DEMONSTRATIONS INVOLVING UNEMPLOYMENT CONTINUED IN VARIOUS CITIES DESPITE A GOVERNMENT BAN ON UNAUTHORIZED PROTEST GATHERINGS. ON OCTOBER 6 MORE THAN 4,000 UNEMPLOYED DEMONSTRATED IN FRONT OF TEHRAN'S LABOR MINISTRY BUILDING, AND A FEW DAYS LATER HUNDREDS OF PROTESTORS STAGED A MARCH IN TEHRAN TO ADVERTISE THEIR PLIGHT. REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS FIRED IN THE AIR TO DISPERSE THE MARCHERS.

ACCORDING TO ONE NEWSPAPER REPORT, A GROUP OF 600-700 UNEMPLOYED STAGED A DEMONSTRATION AT THE EDUCATION OFFICE IN SANANDAJ, AND JOBLESS HIGH SCHOOL GRADUATES HAVE ALSO DEMONSTRATED IN THE NORTHWESTERN CITY OF GHOOCHAN, IN MASHAD AND IN THE CASPIAN CITY OF BABOL. - ACCORDING TO LABOR MINISTER ABDUL ALI ESPAHBODI, THERE ARE PRESENTLY BETWEEN ONE AND ONE AND A HALF MILLION UNEMPLOYED IN IRAN. THE MINISTER ALSO CLAIMED THAT THE UNEMPLOYMENT RATE HAS DECLINED SINCE THE PERIOD FOLLOWING THE REVOLUTION, AND PRESENTLY EIGHT TO TEN MILLION PEOOLE HAD JOBS.

ELECTIONS TO MUNICIPAL COUNCILS WERE HELD IN 140 TOWNS ACROSS IRAN ON OCTOBER 12, AND VOTER TURNOUT SEEMS TO HAVE BEEN FAR LESS THAN EXPECTED. IN SOME TOWNS, MOST NOTABLY IN THE KURDISH AREA, ELECTIONS DID NOT TAKE PLACE BECAUSE OF THE SECURITY PROBLEMS INVOLVED. IN THE SOUTHEASTERN PROVINCE OF SISTAN AND BALUCHESTAN THERE WERE ALSO REPORTS OF VIOLENCE STEMMING FROM THE ELECTIONS. ON OCTOBER 12 A GROUP SHOUTING "LONG LIVE THE SHAH" ATTACKED SEVERAL POLLING STATIONS IN ZAHEDAN, WOUNDED SEVERAL PEOPLE AND KILLED ONE POLICEMAN.

TROUBLE IN ZAHEDAN APPARENTLY STARTED WHEN NINE OF THE CITY COUNCIL CANDIDATES RESIGNED AND THE BALUCHI MEMBERS OF THE ELECTION OVERSEERS' COMMITTEE WALKED OUT OF THEIR JOBS. TENSION REACHED A CLIMAX WHEN THE POPULAR BALUCHI PARTY ETEHAD-AL-MOSLEMIN BOYCOTTED THE ELECTIONS AND ASKED PEOPLE NOT TO PARTICIPATE. FOLLOWING THE ATTACKS ON POLLING STATIONS, THE ZAHEDAN ELECTION WAS CALLED OFF. UNCONFIRMED REPORTS INDICATE THAT THE TROUBLE IN SISTAN AND BALUCHESTAN MAY BE FAR MORE WIDESPREAD THAN PRESS ACCOUNTS INDICATE. SOURCES WHO HAVE TRAVELED TO THE BALUCHI AREA TOLD POLOFF THAT THE TRIBESPEOPLE THERE ARE BLATANTLY PRO-SHAH. EVEN GOVERNOR-GENERAL MOHAMMED JARIRI ADMITS THAT THE WEAPONS COLLECTION CAMPAIGN HAS BEEN A FAILURE.

WHILE CLAIMING THAT "THE GOVERNMENT WAS IN FULL CONTROL OF THE SITUATION" IN THE PROVINCE, JARIRI FELT IT NECESSARY TO ADD THAT IF THE TRIBESMEN CONTINUED TO REFUSE TO SURRENDER THEIR WEAPONS, THE AMNESTY EXTENDED TO THEM BY KHOMEINI WOULD BE CANCELLED AND THEY WOULD BE DEALT WITH AS REBELS. ------------------108823 171508Z /41 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 4314 INFO SECDEF WASH DC JCS WASH DC AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMCONSUL KARACHI AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE SECTION 03 OF 03 TEHRAN 11067

ELECTION DISRUPTIONS ALSO OCCURRED IN THE CASPIAN AREA. IN RASHT, THE CAPITAL OF GILAN PROVINCE, THE ELECTION OVERSEERS' COMMITTEE RESIGNED EN MASSE, CLAIMING THAT "IRRESPONSIBLE PEOPLE" WERE INTERFERING WITH ITS WORK. IN NEARBY LANGEROOD, 20 OF THE 29 CANDIDATES FOR CITY COUNCIL POSITIONS RESIGNED, BUT VOTING CONTINUED NONETHELESS. ATTACKS ON POLLING STATIONS OCCURRED IN HASHT PAR-E-TAVALESH (NEAR RASHT) AS WELL AS IN HAMEDAN. THE MINISTRY OF THE INTERIOR ANNOUNCED THE NAMES OF 17 CITIES ACROSS IRAN IN WHICH COUNCIL ELECTIONS WERE CANCELLED.

ON OCTOBER 16, THE ISLAMIC REPUBLICAN PARTY ISSUED A STATEMENT CLAIMING THAT THE NATIONWIDE MUNICIPAL ELECTIONS HAD BEEN RIGGED, AND ASKED FOR THE FORMATION OF A COMMISSION TO INVESTIGATE THE VIOLATIONS.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

TROUBLE CONTINUED THROUGHOUT KURDISH AREAS OVER THE WEEKEND WITH GUERRILLA ATTACKS ON BORDER POSTS AND TOWNS. THE MAIN ACTION OCCURRED IN MAHABAD WHERE ATTACKS HAVE OCCURRED NIGHTLY THROUGH OCTOBER 16. ON FRIDAY, OCTOBER 12 KURDISH FORCES ATTACKED MAHABAD KILLING THE MAHABAD POLICE CHIEF. ON OCTOBER 13 BAZARGAN'S REPRESENTATIVE SADEQ ZIBAKALAM, WHO WAS IN TOWN ON A GOOD WILL MISSION AND TO ATTEND THE FUNERAL OF THE POLICE CHIEF, WAS KIDNAPPED BY REBELS WHO STORMED THE GOVERNOR'S OFFICE AND CARRIED HIM OFF. HE WAS RELEASED UNHARMED OCTOBER 15 APPARENTLY AFTER HE HAD HELD LONG TALKS WITH KURDISH LEADERS. ALSO ON OCTOBER 13, A BOMB WRECKED THE GOVERNOR'S OFFICE IN SANANDAJ.

THERE ARE SOME SIGNS THAT THE PGOI MAY BE TRYING TO NEGOTIATE WITH THE REBELS. ACCORDING TO PRESS REPORTS (LATER DENIED BY INTERIOR MINISTER SABAGHIAN) MINISTER OF STATE FOROUHAR WAS PLANNING ON OCTOBER 14 TO GO TO THE KURDISH AREA TO NEGOTIATE WITH LEADERS OF THE OUTLAWED KURDISH DEMOCRATIC PARTY. THE MEETINGS WERE REPORTEDLY ARRANGED THROUGH JALAL TALEBANI WHEN FOROUHAR VISITED KURDESTAN LAST WEEK. THE PRESS ALSO REPORTS THAT FOROUHAR MAY ALREADY HAVE MET SHEIKH EZZADIN HOUSSEINI ONCE DURING HIS KURDESTAN VISIT LAST WEEK. IN ADDITION, IN A RADIO INTERVIEW OCTOBER 16 FOREIGN MINISTER YAZDI STATED THAT A SOCIAL PROBLEM CAN NOT BE SOLVED BY MILITARY MEANS ALONE.
THE GOVERNMENT, YAZDI SAID, HAS TAKEN ACTION TO FIND THE ROOTS OF THE PROBLEM IN THE REGION AND ALREADY TALKS WITH LOCAL LEADERS ARE UNDERWAY.

PGOI RESPONSE TO REBEL ATTACKS HAS BEEN MARKED AT BEST BY A LACK OF COORDINATION BETWEEN ARMY AND REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS AND IF RUMORS ARE TO BE BELIEVED, BY REAL TENSIONS. JCS CHIEF SHAKER HAS PUBLICLY NOTED THE LACK OF COORDINATION WHICH WAS CAUSED, HE SAID, BY AN EXCESS OF "REVOLUTIONARY ZEAL" ON THE PASDARAN'S SIDE. EMBASSY COMMENT: THE PASDARAN CONTINUE TO CARRY THE BULK OF THE FIGHTING AND TO RECEIVE THE BRUNT OF KURDISH ATTACKS.

PGOI OFFICIALS CONTINUE TO SPECULATE OVER WHICH FOREIGN POWERS ARE BEHIND THE EVENTS IN KURDESTAN. CONTRADICTORY ACCUSATORY STATEMENTS HAVE BEEN ISSUED OVER THE SOURCE OF THE DISTURBANCES. THE LEADER OF THE PASDARAN IN THE KURDISH AREA, ABU SHARIF, CLAIMS THAT MARXISTS AND ISRAELI AND AMERICAN SPIES ARE RESPONSIBLE. ON OCTOBER 15, NATIONAL IRANIAN RADIO BROADCAST A STATEMENT BY THE "STAFF FOR KURDESTAN PROBLEMS" THAT COMMUNIST GROUPS ARE BEHIND THE COUNTER-REVOLUTIONARY ACTIVITY. ON OCTOBER 12, FOROUHAR CHARGED THAT IRAQ WAS SENDING ARMS TO KURDISH REGIONS AND THAT IRAQ HAD CREATED "A BASE IN IRAN (SIC)" FROM WHICH THE KURDS COULD FIGHT THE REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS.

FOREIGN MINISTER YAZDI, HOWEVER, IN HIS OCTOBER 16 RADIO INTERVIEW TOOK AN EVEN-HANDED APPROACH NOT NAMING NAMES BUT SAYING THAT PGOI SHOULD FIRST FIND OUT WHO EXACTLY IS MEDDLING AND THEN STOP THE "INTERFERENCES" BOTH BY DIRECT TALKS WITH THAT COUNTRY AND BY INDIRECT PRESSURE. LAINGEN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: LOCAL PRESS OF OCTOBER 18 REPORTS A HALT IN EXECUTIONS AT KHOMEINI'S ORDER. THERE HAVE BEEN NO REPORTS OF EXECUTIONS SINCE OCTOBER 14. KHOMEINI URGES REVOLUTIONARY PROSECUTORS AND ISLAMIC JUDGES TO REFRAIN FROM RASH JUDGEMENTS AND TO APPLY STRICTLY ISLAMIC STANDARDS OF EVIDENCE. GOVERNMENT OFFICIAL LINKS KHOMEINI STATEMENT ON JUSTICE TO YAZDI-VANCE MEETINGS IN U.S. END SUMMARY.

PERSIAN-LANGUAGE BAMDAD OF OCTOBER 18 CARRIES INTERVIEW WITH REVOLUTIONARY PROSECUTOR GENERAL AYATOLLAH QODDUSI IN WHICH HE DISCUSSES (AMONG OTHER MATTERS) THE HALTING OF EXECUTIONS AT THE ORDERS OF IMAM KHOMEINI. INTERVIEW QUOTES QODDUSI AS FOLLOWS: "AT THE ORDER OF IMAM KHOMEINI...WE HAVE INSTRUCTED ALL OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS OF TEHRAN TO REFRAIN FROM CARRYING OUT ANY DEATH SENTENCE UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE. THESE INSTRUCTIONS HAVE NOT YET BEEN SENT TO ALL REVOLUTIONARY COURTS THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY, BUT THIS WILL BE DONE SOON."

ALTHOUGH WE HAVE NOT BEEN ABLE TO LOCATE ANY SPECIFIC ORDER FROM KHOMEINI, THE INSTRUCTIONS MAY HAVE COME FROM HIS OCTOBER 11 SPEECH TO SEMINAR OF ISLAMIC JUDGES AND REVOLUTIONARY PROSECUTORS IN QOM. IN THAT SPEECH KHOMEINI WARNED HIS AUDIENCE TO ADHERE STRICTLY TO THE RULES OF ISLAMIC JUSTICE AND NOT TO USE THE REVOLUTION AS AN EXCUSE FOR UNJUST SENTENCES. DOING SO, HE WARNED, WOULD EXPOSE THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC TO CHARGES OF REPEATING THE OPPRESSION OF THE MONARCHY.

FOLLOWING EXCERPTS ARE FROM HIS SPEECH: - A) "YOU ARE THE JUDGES IN AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC; THE VERDICTS YOU PASS MIGHT ADVERSELY AFFECT...NOT ONLY OUR COUNTRY, BUT ALSO THE ENTIRE REPUTATION OF ISLAM...IF YOU PASS A SENTENCE THAT CONTRADICTS THE TENETS OF ISLAM, THE ENEMIES OF OUR RELIGION WILL MANIPULATE YOUR MISTAKE TO SAY, 'IN THE PAST WE WERE IN THE HANDS OF THE SHAH; NOW WE ARE IN THE HANDS OF PEOPLE IN CLERICAL DRESS'." - B) "(CRIMES LIKE ADULTERY AND SODOMY) ARE VERY DIFFICULT TO PROVE IN AN ISLAMIC COURT IF PROPER ISLAMIC TENETS ARE ENFORCED.

IN THE CASE OF ADULTERY, ISLAM SAYS THAT AT LEAST FOUR JUST WITNESSES HAVE TO COME TO THE COURT AND TELL THE JUDGE THAT THEY WITNESSED THE CRIME. GOD DID NOT WANT THESE CASES TO BE MADE PUBLIC EASILY." - C) "I HAVE RECEIVED A LETTER FROM A RELIGIOUS SCHOLAR IN SHIRAZ COMPLAINING THAT IN CASES OF PROSTITUTION BROUGHT TO THE ISLAMIC COURTS, RASH DECISIONS HAVE BEEN MADE IN CONTRADICTION WITH RELIGIOUS TEACHINGS". (COMMENT: EMBASSY HAS HEARD REPORT THAT AYATOLLAH BAHA AL-DIN MAHALLATI OF SHIRAZ HAD CRITICIZED THE PROCEEDINGS OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS)." - D) "WE CANNOT PASS A SENTENCE JUST BECAUSE WE HAVE HAD A REVOLUTION IN THIS COUNTRY.
WE CANNOT FLOG, IMPRISON, OR EXECUTE PEOPLE JUST BECAUSE THERE HAS BEEN A REVOLUTION.

NO, THE QUESTION IS THE REPUTATION OF THE MOSLEM PEOPLE, AND THIS REPUTATION MUST BE PROTECTED." - E) "WE SHOULD NOT DO (IN OUR ISLAMIC COURTS) WHAT ------------------122391 190636Z /14 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 4335 INFO SECDEF WASH DC JCS WASH DC AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 11090 WOULD CAUSE PEOPLE TO SAY THAT SIMILAR DECISIONS WERE TAKEN AT THE TIME OF TAGHOUT (THE SHAH). ALL YOU GENTLEMEN SHOULD TAKE STEPS TOWARD CORRECTING THIS MISTAKE.
IF YOU ARE CAPABLE OF CORRECTING THIS MATTER, THEN DO SO. OTHERWISE, THERE IS NO NEED FOR YOU TO REMAIN A JUDGE."

THERE HAVE ALSO BEEN FREQUENT STORIES IN THE PRESS DURING THE PAST WEEK ABOUT CORRUPTION IN THE REVOLUTIONARY COURT SYSTEM. ONE PRESS REPORT TOLD OF AN ASSISTANT TO FORMER TEHRAN PROSECUTOR HADAVI WHO TOOK ABOUT $600,000 TO FIX A CASE. THERE IS ALSO A RUMOR (UNCONFIRMED) THAT THE FORMER REVOLUTIONARY PROSECUTOR OF TEHRAN, AYATOLLAH AZAR-QOMI, HAS GONE INTO HIDING.

EMBASSY POLITICAL ASSISTANT REPORTED THAT ALI BEHZADNIA, DIRECTOR GENERAL OF FOREIGN PRESS DEPARTMENT AT THE MINISTRY OF NATIONAL GUIDANCE, AND OTHER OFFICIALS OF THAT MINISTRY HAD TOLD HIM PRIVATELY THAT THEY BELIEVED KHOMEINI'S MODIFYING HIS STAND ON EXECUTIONS WAS A DIRECT RESULT OF THE YAZDI-VANCE MEETING IN NEW YORK. ACCORDING TO THIS VERSION OF EVENTS, YAZDI WAS READ THE RIOT ACT IN NEW YORK ON EXECUTIONS AND HE REPORTED U.S. VIEWS TO KHOMEINI DIRECTLY UPON HIS RETURN TO IRAN. BEHZADNIA REPORTEDLY ADDED THAT HE THOUGHT THE WORST DAYS OF EXECUTIONS IN IRAN WERE OVER AND THAT WASHINGTON HAD A MAJOR ROLE IN BRINGING ABOUT THIS CHANGE.

COMMENT: IT IS STILL TOO EARLY TO CELEBRATE THE END OF SUMMARY JUSTICE IN IRAN. THE LAST REPORTED EXECUTION BY THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS WAS OCTOBER 14, BUT A THREEDAY PAUSE DOES NOT MEAN THE DAWN OF A NEW ERA OF JUSTICE. ON THE OTHER HAND, IT IS INTERESTING TO NOTE THAT THE MOST RECENT REPORT OF AN EXECUTION, THAT OF MAJOR GENERAL ESPAHRAM (FORMER MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR OF SISTAN AND BALUCHESTAN) ON OCTOBER 16 WAS RETRACTED THE NEXT DAY IN THE PRESS.

IT WOULD BE SATISFYING IF THE U.S. COULD CLAIM CREDIT FOR A SHIFT. UNFORTUNATELY, WE DOUBT THIS WILL REPRESENT MUCH MORE THAN A PAUSE IN THE EXECUTIONS, WHICH MAY RESUME AT A SLOWER PACE. IF, INDEED, SOME SORT OF CHANGE IS IMMINENT (OR IF THIS PAUSE IS ONLY TEMPORARY), THERE ARE OTHER FACTORS PROBABLY WHICH HAVE BEEN MORE IMPORTANT THAN U.S. REPRESENTATIONS.

THESE FACTORS INCLUDE: - A) THE DESIRE TO CALM THE CONTINUING TENSION AND VIOLENCE IN KURDESTAN AND KHUZESTAN WHERE THE REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS AND COURTS HAVE BEEN IMPORTANT TARGETS OF ATTACKS. - B) DISTURBANCES IN OTHER PROVINCIAL TOWNS, NOTABLY ZAHEDAN, MAKU, AND ENZELI (BANDAR PAHLAVI) WHICH HAVE WITNESSED DEMONSTRATIONS AND VIOLENCE AGAINST THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS AND GUARDS. - C) THERE ARE REPORTS THAT THE KDP INSURGENTS HOLD LARGE NUMBER OF HOSTAGES WHOM THE KDP IS THREATENING TO KILL IN RETALIATION FOR EXECUTION OF ITS PARTISANS. THERE IS ALSO A REPORT THAT A KDP PAMPHLET HAS OFFERED THE RELEASE OF ALL HOSTAGES IN EXCHANGE FOR THE SURRENDERING

1979TEHRAN11105.subject: IRAN'S SUSPICION OF U.S. INTERFERENCE IN KURDESTAN

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

IRANIAN PARANOIA ABOUT US INTERFERENCE IN KURDESTAN IS A CONTINUING AND SERIOUS PROBLEM HERE. FOREIGN MINISTER YAZDI'S COMMENTS TO THE SECRETARY REGARDING ALLEGED CIA INVOLVEMENT HAVE BEEN REPEATED IN MEETINGS WE HAVE HAD WITH ENTEZAM AND YAZDI THIS PAST WEEK. WHILE WE MAY HAVE MADE SOME PROGRESS IN REDUCING THEIR SUSPICIONS, THIS REGIME SPEAKS WITH MANY VOICES AND THERE IS A VERY SUBSTANTIAL LEGACY OF SCEPTICISM TO OVERCOME ON THIS ISSUE.

MOREVER, THE PRESS, INCLUDING PAPERS IDENTIFIED IN THE PUBLIC MIND WITH KHOMEINI AND WHICH INDIVIDUALS LIKE ENTEZAM AND YAZDI PLAINLY DO NOT CONTROL, CONTINUE DAILY TO ATTACK US WITH CHARGES OF INVOLVEMENT IN KURDESTAN.

ENTEZAM HAS SUGGESTED TO US THAT HE AND OTHERS IN THE PGOI WHO RECOGNIZE THE DANGERS INVOLVED IN THIS KIND OF CONINUING CAMPAIGN WOULD BE BETTER EQUIPPED TO DEAL WITH THE PROBLEM IF THE US AT A SENIOR LEVEL WERE HEARD PUBLICLY TO DENY THESE REPORTS.

WE WOULD LIKE TO BE RESPONSIVE. WE DO NOT WISH TO GET INTO A SITUATION OF RENDERING CREDENCE TO RIDICULOUS CHARGES BY THE PRESS AND ELEMENTS IN THE PGOI BY DENYING THEM EACH AND EVERY TIME THEY ARISE. WE RECOGNIZE ALSO THAT SO LONG AS THE PGOI CONTINUES TO HAVE DIFFICULTY IN KURDESTAN, WE WILL BE SEEN BY THE PRESS AND MANY POLITICAL FIGURES AS A CONVENIENT SCRAPEGOAT.

NONETHELESS, WE THINK IT IS NOW TIME THAT WE APPEAR ON THE PUBLIC RECORD WITH A STRONG REAFFIRMATION OF OUR POSITION ON THIS SUBJECT. WE, THEREFORE, URGE THE DEPARTMENT TO FIND AN EARLY OPPORTUNITY FOR A SENIOR USG POLICY OFFICIAL TO REAFFIRM OUR SUPPORT FOR THE TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY AND INDEPENDENCE OF IRAN, EMPHASIZING IN THIS CONNECTION THAT ACCUSATIONS OF OUR INVOLVEMENT IN KURDESTAN ARE WHOLLY WITHOUT SUBSTANCE. WITH THAT KIND OF STATEMENT FROM A SENIOR LEVEL ON THE RECORD, OUR OWN POSITION IN TEHRAN WILL BE GREATLY STRENGTHENED IN DEALING WITH SUCH CHARGES AS THEY ARISE. LAINGEN
(SECRET-ENTIRE TEXT.)

I TOOK OPPORTUNITY OF SCHEDULED APPOINTMENT WITH AMBASSADOR ENTEZAM THIS MORNING AT 10:00 O'CLOCK (INTRODUCING HENRY PRECHT) TO ADVISE HIM OF MY INSTRUCTIONS AND TO ASK HIM TO ARRANGE IMMEDIATE APPOINTMENT WITH PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN (GEORGE CAVE LEFT TEHRAN OCTOBER 19). AFTER DISCUSSION WITH ENTEZAM, WE WALKED NEXT DOOR WITH HIM TO CALL ON BAZARGAN. FOREIGN MINISTER YAZDI JOINED US SHORTLY THEREAFTER.

IN CONVEYING TALKING POINTS CONCERNING OUR HAVING CONCURRED IN MEDICAL JUDGMENT THAT SHAH'S CONDITION REQUIRED ADMISSION SOONEST TO U.S. MEDICAL FACILITIES, I SAID THAT OUR DECISION WAS MADE ENTIRELY ON HUMANITARIAN GROUNDS. I EMPHASIZED THAT WE RECOGNIZED AND DEALT WITH THE PGOI AND THE PRIME MINISTER, THAT THIS REFLECTED OUR ACCEPTANCE OF THE CHANGE IN IRAN, AND THAT WE WERE ANXIOUS TO WORK TOGETHER IN EVERY WAY POSSIBLE TO BUILD A NEW RELATIONSHIP WITH IRAN.

I SAID THAT I HOPED THAT THE PGOI, WHICH WE ASSUMED ALSO GENUINELY SOUGHT TO BUILD A NEW RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN OUR TWO COUNTRIES, WOULD WORK WITH US TO ENSURE THAT THE POLITICAL FALLOUT FROM THE SHAH'S ENTRY INTO THE U.S. WOULD BE MANAGEABLE FORBOTH COUNTRIES. I ALSO STRESSED OUR HOPE AND CONFIDENCE THAT THE PGOI WOULD TAKE WHATEVER STEPS WERE NECESSARY TO ASSURE THE SECURITY OF OUR COMMUNITY IN IRAN, SHOULD ADVERSE PUBLIC DEMONSTRATIONS OCCUR.

THE REACTION FROM OUR THREE INTERLOCUTORS WAS MIXED BUT GENERALLY SUBDUED. REACTION VARIED FROM ENTEZAM'S IMMEDIATE EXPRESSION OF CONCERN OVER THIS NEW OBSTACLE TO EFFORTS THAT HE SAID HE AND OTHER FRIENDS OF THE U.S. IN IRAN WERE CARRYING OUT TO TRY TO IMPROVE OUR RELATIONSHIP, TO BAZARGAN'S QUIET BUT CONCERNED ACCEPTANCE OF REALITY, TO YAZDI'S (WHO DOMINATED THE DISCUSSION) EMPHASIS ON THE PROBLEMS THAT THIS WOULD CREATE FORTHE U.S. IN IRAN.

A FAIRLY EXTENDED DISCUSSION CULMINATED IN YAZDI'S SUMMING UP WITH THE FOLLOWING POINTS: - A. THE PGOI WOULD STRONGLY PREFER THAT THE SHAH, ASSUMING HIS CONDITION GENUINELY REQUIRED MEDICAL EXAMINATION OUTSIDE MEXICO, SEEK SUCH ASSISTANCE ELSEWHERE THAN IN THE U.S. YAZDI CONCEDED READILY THAT SUCH FACILITIES WERE NOT AVAILABLE IN MEXICO BUT HE SAID THE PGOI COULD NOT UNDERSTAND WHY THE REQUIRED ASSISTANCE COULD NOT BE FOUND IN WESTERN EUROPE. - B. SHOULD THE U.S. NONETHELESS PROCEED TO ADMIT THE SHAH, YAZDI FELT THAT TREATMENT OUTSIDE OF NEW YORK CITY WOULD BE "MARGINALLY BETTER" IN TERMS OF PUBLIC OPINION HERE.

AS HE DESCRIBED IT, NEW YORK CITY IS SEEN BY IRANIANS AS A CENTER OF ROCKEFELLER AND ZIONIST INFLUENCE, AND THIS WOULD COMPOUND THE PROBLEM. HE SUGGESTED THE M.D. ANDERSON INSTITUTE IN HOUSTON AS BEING FULLY CAPABLE OF PROVIDING THE KIND OF DIAGNOSIS THAT APPEARED TO BE NEEDED. (YAZDI SPEAKS FROM PERSONAL PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE WITH BOTH KETTERING AND ANDERSON INSTITUTES.) - C. TO HELP THE PGOI TO REASSURE THE IRANIAN PUBLIC AND KHOMEINI THAT THISWAS NOT SIMPLY A "RUSE" ON THE PART OF THE SHAH TO GAIN ADMISSION TO THE U.S., THE PGOI WOULD HOPE THAT AN IRANIAN DOCTOR WOULD BE ALLOWED TO CONFIRM THE VALIDITY OF THE MEDICAL FINDINGS.

(IT WAS UNCLEAR WHETHER HE WOULD BE EXPECTED TO EXAMINE THE SHAH.) IN RESPONSE TO OUR QUESTION, YAZDI SAID THERE WERE A NUMBER OF CAPABLE IRANIAN DOCTORS RESIDENT IN THE U.S. WHO COULD BE SO TASKED RATHER THAN SENDING SOME ONE FROM IRAN. YAZDI ALSO PRESSED US AS TO WHETHER SHAH WOULD REMAIN IN THE U.S. IF DIAGNOSIS SUGGESTED EXTENDED CHEMOTHERAPY OR OTHER TREATMENT. I ANSWERED THAT WE COULD NOT PROVIDE ANY ASSURANCES ON THAT SCORE AT THIS POINT. - D.

FINALLY THE PGOI WOULD EXPECT THE USG TO OBTAIN FROM THE SHAH A PRIOR ASSURANCE THAT HE WOULD NOT ------------------006302 211244Z /40 Z 211118Z OCT 79 ZFF-4 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC FLASH 4356 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 11133 NODIS CHEROKEE PARTICIPATE IN POLITICAL ACTIVITY WHILE IN THE U.S. NOR WOULD HE ENGAGE IN PRESS INTERVIEWS TO FURTHER HIS POLITICAL INTERESTS. WE SAID THAT HIS ADMISSION INTO THE U.S.

COULD NOT BE KEPT SECRET, THAT WE COULD NOT PROVIDE ANY ABSOLUTE GUARANTEES ABOUT CONTACT WITH THE PRESS, BUT THAT WE WOULD UNDOUBTEDLY EMPHASIZE TO THE SHAH OUR DESIRE THAT HE AVOID ANY POLITICAL ACTIVITY, EITHER WITH THE PRESS OR OTHERWISE.

THROUGHOUT THE DISCUSSION, PARTICULARLY FROM YAZDI, THERE PREVAILED A SUSPICION THAT THE SHAH'S CONDITION IS NOT REALLY SUCH AS TO REQUIRE THE MEDICAL FACILITIES NOW SOUGHT. I EMPHASIZED THAT I COULD NOT SPEAK TO HIS CONDITION BEYOND THE INSTRUCTIONS THAT I HAD BUT THAT I HAD NO REASON TO BELIEVE THAT HIS CONDITION WAS NOT OF IMMEDIATE CONCERN AND SERIOUS. I ASSURED THE PRIME MINISTER THAT WE WOULD KEEP THE PRIME MINISTER INFORMED ON A PRIVATE BASIS ON THE COURSE OF THIS MATTER. LAINGEN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

QUIETLY AND TOTALLY WITHOUT FANFARE OR OFFICIAL NOTICE TEHRAN UNIVERSITY HAS OPENED ITS GATES AND AT LEAST IN SOME COLLEGES, IS TEACHING ONCE MORE. ALTHOUGH WE WERE TOLD IT WOULD NOT OFFICIALLY OPEN UNTIL OCT 20, EMBASSY HAD BEEN HEARING FOR ABOUT A WEEK THAT CLASSES WERE BEING HELD. THE REPORT BELOW HAS BEEN DONE BY OUR NEW EMBASSY IRANIAN ASSISTANT IN THE POLITICAL SECTION AFTER A VISIT TO THE CAMPUS OCTOBER 16. THE NEXT DAY SHE VISITED THE NATIONAL UNIVERSITY WHICH SHE FOUND QUIET DESPITE RUMORS OF STRIKES.

PERHAPS FOR THE FIRST TIME SINCE THE REVOLUTION, THE UNIVERSITY HAS FINALLY MANAGED TO MUSTER UP AN EDUCATIONAL ATMOSPHERE. THE EVER-PRESENT SALESMEN WHO USED TO HAUNT THE UNIVERSITY GROUNDS ALL DAY, ARE NO LONGER THERE, AND THE ONLY FACTOR LEFT BEHIND FROM THE REVOLUTION IS THE COLORFUL WRITING ON THE WALLS CONDEMNING DICTATORSHIP, THE SHAH, THE UNITED STATES, ZIONISM, IMPERIALISM, AND COMMUNISM.

TEHRAN UNIVERSITY IS BACK TO NORMAL THESE DAYS WITH GROUPS OF STUDENTS THRONGING INTO ITS HIGH-CEILINGED HALLS AND TREE-LINED AVENUES. SMALL GROUPS OF STUDENTS WALK TOGETHER CARRYING BOOKS, TALK SOFTLY TO ONE ANOTHER, AND DISCUSS THE LATEST ISSUES, BUT THE EXPRESSIONS ON THEIR FACES HAVE CHANGED FROM ONE OF QUIET TENSION TO ONE OF RELATIVE CALM AND SERIOUSNESS. AFTER ALL, GRADES DON'T KID AROUND AND A REVOLUTION IS FINE FOR A WHILE, BUT AFTER THAT ONE HAS TO OBTAIN THOSE GRADES IN ORDER TO REMAIN IN THE UNIVERSITY.

THE MOST STRIKING FACT IN THE UNIVERSITY THESE DAYS IS THAT THERE ARE VERY, VERY FEW NON-STUDENTS MILLING AROUND THE CAMPUS. BEFORE THE STUDIES BEGAN, MOST OF THE PEOPLE WALKING AROUND THE UNIVERSITY GROUNDS WERE NON-STUDENTS WHO WERE THERE TO SEE WHAT IS HAPPENING, TO BUY BOOKS AND TAPES, OR JUST TO SPEND A CAREFREE DAY IN A CENTER THAT HAS BEEN THE NUCLEUS OF ACTIVITY FOR SOME TIME. TODAY THE MAJORITY OF THOSE WALKING AROUND THE GROUNDS CARRY BOOKS, HAVE BRIEF CASES, OR HAVE A PURPOSEFUL WALK...THEY ARE NOT LOITERING OR STROLLING THROUGH THE GROUNDS.

MANY OF THE STUDENTS FEEL THEIR SUBJECTS HAVE NOT REALLY CHANGED MUCH THIS YEAR DESPITE THE REVOLUTION. "WE ARE STILL STUDYING THE SAME THINGS, BUT OUR RELATIONSHIPS WITH OUR TEACHERS HAVE CHANGED FOR THE BETTER. THEY ARE MORE OUR FRIENDS NOW," SAID ONE YOUNG MALE STUDENT OF THE MEDICAL SCHOOL.

CLASSES ARE NOT AS REGULAR AS BEFORE, AND SUBJECTS OF STUDY ARE NOT AS NUMEROUS, FOR EXAMPLE,THE HISTORY COURSES HAVE BEEN MODIFIED CONSIDERABLY DUE TO THE RECENT CHANGES...BUT SOMEHOW NONE WOULD EXPLAIN THESE MODIFICATIONS OR EXPLAIN WHY THE COURSES WERE DIFFERENT NOW.

THE BUILDINGS ARE STILL COVERED WITH SLOGANS OF ALL KINDS, BUT INSIDE THERE IS SOME ORDER REPLACING THE POSTREVOLUTION CHAOS WHICH PREVAILED FOR MANY MONTHS AFTER FEBRUARY 11. THE SOLE CHIEFTAIN TANK THAT WAS THE MAIN ATTRACTION FOR WEEKS HAS GONE BACK TO ITS HOME, AND THE SANDBAGS WHICH WERE PLACED IN FRONT OF THE MAIN GATES HAVE BEEN REMOVED. THERE HAS CERTAINLY BEEN AN EFFORT TO MAINTAIN THE UNIVERSITY AIR.

THE STALLS WHICH WERE EVERYWHERE ON CAMPUS HAVE BEEN REMOVED, BUT MOST OF THEM HAVE RETURNED, ONLY THIS TIME JUST OUTSIDE THE GATES. HERE THEY ARE AGAIN SELLING ANYTHING AND EVERYTHING FROM BLANKETS TO FOOD, TO CUPS, TO BOOKS, TO TAPES AND POSTERS. FOOD STALLS HAVE BEEN SET UP TO CATER TO THE STUDENT BUDGET...AND LONG TABLES WITH TEA GLASSES AND CAKES STRETCH ALONG ENGHELAB AVENUE.

OUTSIDE THE MAIN GATES TO UNIVERSITY, AN ISLAMIC GROUP HAS SET UP A TENT WITH A PICTURE EXHIBITION SHOWING THE RECENT EVENTS IN KURDESTAN. BADLY TAKEN PICTURES OF DEAD BODIES AND CAPTIONS VERY MUCH TILTED TO ONE SIDE (POLITICALLY) HAVE BEEN CRUDELY PINNED ONTO NOTICE BOARDS FOR ALL TO SEE "THE CRIMES COMMITTED BY COUNTER REVOLUTIONARIES AND AMERICAN MERCENARIES." STUDENTS AND NON-STUDENTS WALK BY THE PICTURES SILENTLY CONTEMPLATING, SIGHING SOMETIMES, BUT GENERALLY PEACEFUL. ------------------006649 211351Z /43 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 4364 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 11145 SIGHING SOMETIMES, BUT GENERALLY PEACEFUL.

DIRECTLY OPPOSITE THE TENTS WITH THE PICTURES, THERE IS A HUGE MOBILE UNIT FROM THE BLOOD TRANSFUSION CENTER WITH A NOTICE STUCK TO ITS SIDE READING, "ALL TYPES OF BLOOD NEEDED FOR VICTIMS OF TROUBLES ACROSS THE COUNTRY."

PERHAPS THE ONE THING THAT SUMS UP THE UNIVERSITY ATMOSPHERE IS THE SINGLE OBSERVATION THAT THE GRASS IS GROWING BACK ON THE MAIN LAWN...SINCE THERE ARE NOT THAT MANY RALLIES AND MEETINGS HELD THERE ANYMORE...JUST FRIDAY PRAYERS WHICH ARE READ WITHOUT SHOES...BARE FEET AFTER ALL DO NOT DAMAGE THE GRASS.

COMPARED WITH THE BIGGER TEHRAN UNIVERSITY, THE NATIONAL (MELLI) UNIVERSITY HAS NOT BEEN TOUCHED SO MUCH BY THE REVOLUTION. THE SLOGANS ARE NOT SO NUMEROUS AND THE STUDENTS' MANNERS AND CLOTHING, PLUS THE CARS PARKED OUTSIDE THE UNIVERSITY INDICATE THAT MORE AFFLUENT CLASS OF STUDENTS ATTEND THE NATIONAL UNIVERSITY. SMALL GROUPS OF STUDENTS MILL AROUND THE CAMPUS AND DISCUSS THEIR LATEST AND FAVORITE SUBJECTS ON STAIRWAYS. THE MOOD IS RELAXED AND THE PEOPLE SMILING, UNLIKE TEHRAN UNIVERSITY WHERE THE ATMOSPHERE IS STILL RATHER ON THE TENSE AND CAUTIOUS SIDE.

THE MOST INTERESTING FEATURES AT THE MELLI UNVERSITY IS THAT THE SIGNS OF ISLAM ARE LESS OSTENTATIOUS THAN THEY ARE AT THE TEHRAN UNIVERSITY. THERE ARE FEWER ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY POSTERS OR PICTURES OF AYATOLLAH RUHOLLAH KHOMEINI...INSTEAD THERE ARE HUGE PLACARDS MADE UP BY THE TUDEH OR COMMUNIST PARTY COMDEMNING THE GOVERNMENT'S ACTIONS IN KURDESTAN AND ALSO COMMEMORATING VARIOUS DAYS,FOR EXAMPLE, THE "MASSACRES" OF THE 27TH MORDAD OF 1953. THERE ARE PICTURES OF THE DEAD TUDEH PARTY ARMY GENERALS WHO WERE EXECUTED AFTER THE 1953 COUP, AND ALSO LARGE POSTERS OF MARX AND LENIN IN THE COLEGES.

BOOK STALLS SET UP ON LONG TABLES INSIDE THE CAMPUS ALSO SELL MOST MARXIST AND COMMUNIST BOOKS, ALTHOUGH THERE ARE SEVERAL TABLES WHICH SELL ALI SHARIATI AND THE KORAN. CLOTH BANNERS STRETCHING FROM TREE TO TREE ALSO PICK AT DIFFERNET IDEOLOGIES AND THOUGHTS. SOME OF THEM MOURN THE DEATH OF AYATOLLAH MAHMOUD TALEGHANI; STILL OTHERS SIGNED BY TUDEH PARTY FOLLOWERS SAY, "THE BILATERAL MILITARY PACTS BETWEEN IRAN AND UNITED STATES MUST BE BROKEN." LAINGEN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

FIGHTING HAS CONTINUED IN KURDISH AREAS SINCE OCTOBER 16 WITH THE HEAVIEST IN MAHABAD. ACCORDING TO THE TEHRAN PRESS ON OCTOBER 20 THERE WAS PARTICULARY HEAVY FIGHTING AT MAHABAD IN WHICH AT LEAST ONE TANK WAS DESTROYED WITHIN THE CITY ITSELF, THERE WAS REPORTEDLY SOME HOUSE-TO-HOUSE FIGHTING AND PERHAPS AS MANY AS 77 PEOPLE WERE KILLED. SCATTERED CLASHES CONTINUE TO BE REPORTED THROUGHOUT THE KURDISH REGION IN BUKAN, MARIVAN, SAGHEZ AND BANEH. ON OCTOBER 20 THERE WERE BOMB INCIDENTS AND DEMONSTRATIONS IN SANANDADJ.

PGOI RESPONSE TO THE INCREASED FIGHTING HAS BEEN EXTREMELY DISORGANIZED. GOVERNOR-GENERAL OF KURDESTAN PROVINCE SHAKIBA ON OCTOBER 20 TOLD THE TEHRAN TIMES THAT THERE HAD BEEN A COMPLETE BREAKDOWN OF LAW AND ORDER IN HIS PROVINCE. IN SANANDADJ,HE SAID, THE REVOLUTIONARY GAURDS HAD RECEIVED AN ORDER FROM THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL NOT TO INTERFERE IN SANANDADJ'S ADMINISTRATION AND, THEREFORE, WITHDREW COMPLETELY. LOCAL POLICE AND GENDARMARIE REFUSED TO TAKE OVER BECAUSE IT WAS TOO DANGEROUS AND, ACCORDING TO THE GOVERNOR, THE TOWN WAS CLOSED BY A GENERAL STRIKE.

DEFENSE MINISTER CHAMRAN REPORTEDLY WENT TO KURDESTAN LAST WEEK TO TRY TO BRING THE SITUATION UNDER CONTROL. EMBASSY HAS HAD RUMORS THAT HE AND ARMY C/G FALLAHI WERE INJURED IN VARIOUS ATTACKS. ON OCTOBER 20, HOWEVER, BOTH ARMY CHIEF OF STAFF FALLAHI AND REVOLUTIONARY GUARD COMMANDER ABU SHARIF WERE AT MILITARY ACADEMY GRADUATION CEREMONIES IN TEHRAN ALTHOUGH WE STILL HAVE NOT SEEN CHAMRAN. REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS, WHO ARE STILL CARRYING BULK OF FIGHTING IN KURDESTAN, DO NOT APPEAR TO BE FARING VERY WELL AGAINST THE HIT-AND-RUN TACTICS OF THE KURDISH REBELS.

WHILE THERE ARE REPORTS THAT PGOI HELICOPTERS AND PLANES ARE TAKING PART IN THE DEFENSE OF MAHABAD, ARMY STILL IS NOT HEAVILY ENGAGED IN THE FIGHTING. THE MAHABAD ARMY COMMANDER TOLD TEHRAN TIMES THE ARMY HAS ONLY BEEN INVOLVED IN ONE CLASH THIS FAR IN THE MOUNTAINS BEHIND MAHABAD WHEN THEY WERE FIRED ON AND RETURNED THE FIRE. ACCORDING TO ONE RELIABLE REPORT, ONE TANK BATALLION REFUSED CHAMRAN'S ORDERS TO GO INTO BATTLE AND ITS OFFICERS ARE CURRENTLY ON TRIAL BEFORE A REVOLUTIONARY COURT (WE HAVE BEEN UNABLE TO CONFIRM THIS REPORT).

PGOI ATTEMPTS TO NEGOTIATE WITH THE REBELS DO NOT SEEM TO HAVE MADE MUCH HEADWAY AND THE PROLIFERATION OF "REPRESENTATIVES" SENT BY KHOMEINI, BAZARGAN AND OTHERS IS PRODUCING A RASH OF CONTRADICTORY REPORTS. STATE MINISTER FOROUHAR AND BAZARGAN'S REPRESENTATIVE ZIBA KALEM RETURNED TO TEHRAN OCTOBER 19 AND HAVE REPORTED TO THE CABINET. ACCORDING TO PRESS REPORTS, WHILE FOROUHAR SAW LOCAL KURDISH LEADERS HE DID NOT CONTACT EITHER HOUSSAINI OR QASSEMLOU.

ON THE OTHER HAND, ON THURSDAY, OCTOBER 18, TEHRAN TIMES CARRIED A STORY THAT KHOMEINI'S "PERSONAL REPRESENTATIVE" MEHDI BAHADORAN WHO HAD BEEN IN KURDESTAN A MONTH HAD REPORTED TO KHOMEINI THAT THE PROBELM IN KURDESTAN STEMMED FROM A VAGUELY WORDED PLOT BY ANTI-KURD SAVAK MULLAHS LOCAL MILITARY AND GENDARMARIE COMMANDERS AND DEFENSE MINISTER CHAMRAN TO ARM FEUDAL LANDLORDS AND SUBVERT THE REVOLUTION.

THIS STORY WAS LATER DENIED BY BAZARGAN'S OFFICE WHICH STATED THAT NOT ONLY WAS THE REPORT A LIE BUT BAHADORAN WAS NOT KHOMEINI'S REPRESENTATIVE. ------------------012419 221449Z /50 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 4391 INFO SECDEF WASH DC JCS WASH DC AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 11179

ON OCTOBER 21, BAZARGAN HELD TALKS WITH KHOMEINI AND TEHRAN TIMES SPECULATES THAT HE PROPOSED AN AMNESTY FOR HOSSAINI AND QASSEMLOU AS WELL AS OTHER KURDISH KDP LEADERS. EMBASSY DOUBTS, HOWEVER, THAT THIS WILL BE ACCEPTABLE TO KHOMEINI WHO HAS TO DATE REFUSED TO DEAL WITH THESE TWO LEADERS. IN A SPEECH TO NIRT WORKERS OCTOBER 21, KHOMEINI SAID THAT HE DID NOT WISH TO UNLEASH ALL OUT WAR ON KURDESTAN AS THE REBELS WERE MIXED IN WITH THE INNOCENT LOCAL POPULATION.

HE CALLED ON THE KURDS TO SEPARATE OUT THE COUNTER-REVOLUTIONARY REBELS AND WARNED THAT THERE WAS A PLOT AFOOT "BY PEOPLE WHOSE INTERESTS HAVE BEEN ENDANGERED BY THE REVOLUTION" TO CUT IRAN INTO BITS BY SEPARATING OUT KURDESTAN, BALUCHISTAN AND KHUZESTAN.

IN THE MIDST OF ALL THIS ANOTHER KHOMEINI ENVOY, SHEIKH HOSSEIN KERMANI, OCTOBER 21 FLEW TO THE IRAQI BORDER FOR TALKS WITH IRAQI OFFICIALS. (PRESS REPORTS HAVE ALLEGED THAT PLANES---PROBABLY IRAQI HAVE BEEN VIOLATING IRANIAN AIR SPACE IN KURDESTAN).

THE US CONTINUES TO BE ATTACKED IN RIGHT WING PAPER JUMHURI-YE-ISLAMI WHICH ON OCTOBER 21 CARRIED STORIES ON KURDESTAN ALLEGING THAT "MERCENARIES OF THE AMERICANS" ARE TAKING PART IN THE FIGHTING. LAINGEN
(S - ENTIRE TEXT).

IN COURSE OF DISCUSSION OF US-IRAN RELATIONS, CHARGE AND VISITING DEPTOFF REVIEWED THE MEASURES WE HAVE TAKEN RECENTLY AND ASKED FON MIN YAZDI FOR FURTHER CONCRETE SUGGESTIONS TO ASSIST PGOI IN BUILDING ITS EFFECTIVENESS AND TO STRENGTHEN BILATERAL TIES. YAZDI REPLIED THAT WE WERE AWARE OBVIOUSLY THAT IRANIAN SECURITY SERVICES NO LONGER EXISTED. CONSEQUENTLY, PGOI LACKED INTELLIGENCE ON ACTS OF SABOTAGE IN KHUZESTAN AND KURDESTAN. WHO WAS BEHIND THESE ATTACKS? THE IRANIANS SUSPECTED ISRAEL AND IRAQ, BUT NEEDED MORE INFORMATION. YAZDI KNEW THAT USG HAD MUCH INFORMATION--"KNEW EVERTHING"-ON DEVELOPMENTS IN THE REGION; PGOI HOPED WE WOULD SHARE IT.

WE REPLIED THAT IRAN CERTAINLY OVERRATED OUR INTELLIGENCE CAPABILITIES, BUT WE WOULD BE PLEASED TO EXCHANGE ASSESSMENTS WITH IRAN. IT WOULD BE HELPFUL IF PGOI WOULD SHARE WITH US INFORMATION IT HAS TO ASSIST OUR INQUIRIES. WE HAD NO INFORMATION SUGGESTING ISRAEL WAS INVOLVED WITH IRAN'S TROUBLES.

COMMENT: YAZDI CLEARLY ATTACHED IMPORTANCE TO INTELLIGENCE EXCHANGE, REFLECTING THE INSECURITY OF THIS REGIME. IT WAS THE ONLY INITIATIVE FOR ASSISTANCE HE MADE TO US, APART FROM "CLEARING UP THE PAST" I.E.

1979TEHRAN11203.subject: OIL MINISTER REPORTEDLY BEATEN AND HOSPITALIZED

segments.text: (U) ENGLISH LANGUAGE TEHRAN TIMES OF OCTOBER 23 CARRIED STORY THAT OIL MINISTER ALI AKBAR MOINFARR WAS HOSPITALIZED IN TEHRAN AFTER SUFFERING A HEART ATTACK OCTOBER 20. ACCORDING TO THE STORY,MONIFARR'S CONDITION WAS CRITICAL WHEN HE ARRIVED AT THE HOSPITAL. HE IS NOW RECOVERING AND IS EXPECTED TO BE OUT IN THREE DAYS.

(C) NEWSPAPER VERSION HAS BEEN CONTRADICTED BY REPORTS THAT MOINFARR WAS IN FACT BEATEN BY ANGRY OIL WORKERS IN KHUZESTAN. ACCORDING TO EYEWITNESS REPORT REACHING EMBASSY FROM KHUZESTAN-BASED JOURNALIST, MOINFARR WAS DRAGGED FROM HIS CAR IN ABADAN BY WORKERS ANGRY AT RECENT WAGE CUTS AND REFUSALS TO PAY BONUSES. HE WAS SEVERELY BEATEN BEFORE HE COULD BE RESCUED.

(C) THERE HAVE BEEN OTHER REPORTS THAT MOINFARR'' BRIEF TENURE AS OIL MINISTER HAS BEEN STORMY. ACCORDING TO ONE STORY EMPLOYEES WERE THREATENED INTO ATTENDING MEETINGS AND RALLIES IN SUPPORT OF THE NEW MINISTER AND AGAINST FORMER NIOC DIRECTOR NAZIH. LAINGEN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

EMBASSY POLITICAL OFFICER LIMBERT MET OCT 22 WITH SHEIKH MA'SUM NAQSHBANDI, ELDERLY KURDISH RELIGIOUS LEADER AND HIS SONS. SHEIKH MA'SUM, WHO IS ORIGINALLY FROM THE SULEIMANIYEH REGION OF IRAQ, MIGRATED WITH HIS FAMILY TO MAHABAD AFTER THE DOWNFALL OF THE IRAQI MONARCHY IN 1958. HE STILL MAINTAINS TIES WITH THE KURDISH COMMUNITIES IN TURKEY, IRAQ, AND SYRIA. HIS UNCLE SHEIKH OSMAN, PATRIARCH OF THE NAGSHBANDI CLAN, HAS RECENTLY RETURNED FROM IRAN TO IRAQ.

SHEIKH MA'SUM SAID THAT HE AND HIS FAMILY HAD ALWAYS OPPOSSED COMMUNISM BY WAY OF ISLAM. IN 1946 HE HAD REJECTED SOVIET APPEALS TO COOPERATE WITH THE KURDISH REPUBLIC OF MAHABAD BECAUSE OF THAT STATE'S COMMUNIST CONNECTIONS. HE WAS NOW WORRIED THAT THE PRESENT FIGHTING IN THE KURDISH REGIONS WOULD LEAD TO THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A COMMUNIST BASE, OR A BASE UNDER IRAQI CONTROL,ON IRANIAN SOIL.

ONE OF SHEIKH MA'SUM'S SONS, JA'FAR, NOTED THAT MARXIST INFLUENCE WAS VERY STRONG AMONG THE KURDISH FIGHTERS. ASHRAF DEHQAN, LEADER OF THE CHERIKHA-YE-FEDA' I-YE-KHALQ, WAS NOW IN KURDISTAN AND HIS GROUP WAS FIGHTING AGAINST GOVERNMENT FORCES THERE. ACCORDING TO JA'FAR, MUCH OF THE MEMBERSHIP OF THE IRANIAN LEFTIST GROUPS WAS KURDISH. AFTER THE CHERIKS LOST THEIR HEADQUARTERS IN TEHRAN, MANY OF THEM TOOK REFUGE IN KURDESTAN WHERE THEY JOINED FORCES WITH THE KURDS TO FIGHT THE CENTRAL GOVERNMENT.

SHEIKH MA'SUM SAID THAT THIS GROUP'S MARXIST PROPAGANDA HAD BEEN VERY SUCCESSFUL AMONG THE KURDS AND THAT SHEIKH EZZ AL-DIN HOSSEINI HAD FALLEN UNDER THE DOMINATION OF LEFTISTS. ON THE OTHER HAND, THE NAGSHBANDIS SAID THAT ABD AL-RAHMAN QASSEMLOU AND THE KURDISH DEMOCRATIC PARTY (KDP) REPRESENTED LEGITIMATE NATIONAL ASPIRATIONS OF THE KURDISH PEOPLE BASED ON THEIR CULTURAL IDENTITY AND THEIR ISLAMIC FAITH. ON A MILITARY LEVEL, HOWEVER, THE KDP AND THE MARXISTS WERE COOPERATING. (COMMENT: THERE HAVE BEEN PRESS REPORTS OF CHERIK ELEMENTS AMONG THE KURDISH INSURGENTS. ONE PASDAR REPORTED THAT THE ATTACKERS AT SARDASHT ON OCTOBER 7 WERE,IN FACT PERSIANS, SPEAKING IN SHRIRAZI AND ISFAHANI ACCENTS.
THERE HAVE ALSO BEEN FRAGMENTARY REPORTS OF SPLITS AND FIGHTING WITHIN THE KURDISH RANKS.)

SHEIKH MA'SUM SAID THERE WAS NO QUESTION THAT IRAQ WAS SUPPORTING THE KURDISH FIGHTERS, IF ONLY BY KEEPING ITS BORDER OPEN. IF THE BORDER WAS CLOSED, HE SAID, THE INSURGENCY WOULD QUICKLY COLLAPSE. AS FOR IRAQ'S MOTIVES, HE SAID THAT IT AIMED AT (1) WEAKENING THE CENTRAL GOVERNMENT OF IRAN; AND (2) ESTABLISHING A RADICAL, IRAQI-DOMINATED KURDISH ENTITY IN IRAN. SUCH A STATE, SHEIKH MA'SUM FELT, WOULD BE UNDER STRONG SOVIET INFLUENCE AND INCOMPATABLE WITH ISLAMIC IDEALS.

ASKED ABOUT A WAY OUT OF THE PRESENT DIFFICULTIIES, SHEIKH MA'SUM SAID THAT KHOMEINI AND HIS ALLIES IN TEHRAN HAD TO COME TO THEIR SENSES AND REALIZE THAT PRESENT CONDITIONS IN KURDESTAN WERE BENEFITTING ONLY THE ENEMIES OF IRAN AND ISLAM. THE SOLUTION, IN HIS OPINION LAY IN GRANTING THE KURDS GENUINE AUTONOMY WITHIN A FEDERAL IRAN. THE INSISTENCE ON SHI'ISM AS THE OFFICIAL RELIGION OF IRAN WAS ALSO CAUSING GREAT PROBLEMS FOR THE KURDS.

SHEIKH MA SUM SAID HE HAD PLEADED WITH AYATOLLAH NASER MAKAREM-SHIRAZI, ONE OF THE MOST LIBERAL OF THE SHI'ITE CLERICS, TO OMIT THE REFERENCE TO SHI'ITE ISLAM IN THE NEW CONSTITUTION "OR ELSE BLOOD WILL FLOW."

SHEIKH MA'SUM AND HIS SONS CONFIRMED REPORTS THAT THE IRANIAN ARMY, GENDARMERIE, AND POLICE ARE REFUSING TO GET INVOLVED IN THE KURDISTAN FIGHTING, WHICH IS BEING LEFT TO THE REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS (PASDARAN). THEY REPORTED THAT THE KILLING OF THE MAHABAD POLICE CHIEF, CAPT. MOHSEN YARJA'I ON OCTOBER 12 WAS DONE BY PASDARS ENRAGED THAT THE CHIEF HAD ORDERED HIS MEN NOT TO COOPERATE WITH LOCAL GUARDS.

(COMMENT: THIS SAME VERSION OF THE KILLING WAS TOLD TO ANOTHER EMBASSY OFFICER BY A POLICE OFFICER.) ------------------020994 231347Z /44 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC IMMEDIATE 4413 INFO USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY DAMASCUS AMEMBASSY MOSCOW SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 11213 IT WAS ALSO CLAIMED THAT THE PASDAR WERE RESPONSIBLE FOR THE KILLING OF THE HEAD OF THE GENDARMERIE AT SAQQEZ IN LATE AUGUST.

COMMENT: THE STATEMENTS OF SHEIKH MA'SUM AND HIS SONS CONFIRM EMBASSY'S IMPRESSION THAT CENTRAL GOVERNMENT HAS GOTTEN BOGGED DOWN IN SEEKING A MILITARY SOLUTION TO KURDESTAN QUESTION. SO FAR THE TO-INGS AND FRO-INGS OF THE VARIOUS REPRESENTATIVES FROM KHOMEINI AND BAZARGAN HAVE RESULTED ONLY IN CONFUSION AND THE TRADING OF ACCUSATIONS. ALTHOUGH THE NAQSHBANDIS SHARE THE LOCAL TENDENCY TO SEE THE KURDISH INSURGENCY AS PART OF A SUPER-POWER GAME, THEY ALSO ADMIT THE EXISTENCE OF ENDEMIC FACTORS, THE MOST IMPORTANT OF WHICH IS THE INCOMPETENCE AND INEXPERIENCE OF THE IRANIAN SHI'ITE RELIGIOUS LEADERS AND THEIR INABILITY TO EXECUTE A RATIONAL NATIONALITIES POLICY.
EMBASSY WOULD APPRECIATE ANY AVAILABLE BIOGRAPHIC INFORMATION ON MEMBERS OF NAQSHBANDI FAMILY. LAINGEN
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

DURING CALL OF CHARGE AND VISITING DEPTOFF ON FON MIN YAZDI, WE REFERRED BRIEFLY TO US EFFORTS TO STABILIZE SITUATION IN LEBANON. YAZDI SAID CONDITIONS IN NORTHERN LEBANON WERE BECOMING INTOLERABLE FOR SHIAS WHO WERE CONSIDERING JOINING FORCES WITH PALESTINIANS AGAINST ISRAELIS AND CHRISTIANS. US MUST USE PRESSURE TO STOP ISRAELI ATTACKS.

WE REPLIED THAT US WAS ATTEMPTING TO RESTRAIN ISRAEL BUT PALESTINIAN TERRORIST ATTACKS MUST ALSO BE ENDED IF ISRAEL WAS TO CHANGE ITS ATTITUDE. IT SEEMED TO US THAT IRANIAN REVOLUTION,WHICH MOBILIZED ENTIRE PEOPLE IN PEACEFUL DISPLAY OF POLITICAL WILL, WAS A BETTER MODEL FOR THE PALESTINIANS. YAZDI SAID IRANIANS HAD BEEN WORKING ON PLO TO THAT END. IRANIANS WANTED PLO TO INJECT GREATER USE OF ISLAMIC SOLIDARITY IN ITS APPEAL. IF PLO CONTINUED SECULAR APPROACH, VICTORY WAS NOT ASSURED. IF PLO DID CREATE A PALESTINIAN STATE ON PURELY SECULAR LINES, THE MARXISTS AND RADICAL PALESTINIANS WOULD MOVE QUICKLY TO TAKE OVER.

YAZDI SEEMED TO THINK THAT IRANIANS HAD MADE SOME IMPRESSION ON PALESTINIANS. HE ALSO MADE QUITE CLEAR IRAN'S COMMITMENT TO THE PALESTINIAN CAUSE: "WE HAVE HELPED THEM AND WE WILL HELP THEM IN THE FUTURE." LAINGEN

1979TEHRAN11219.subject: NEW HUMAN RIGHTS GROUP IN IRAN

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

ON OCTOBER 21, TEHRAN PRESS CARRIED STORY OF PRESS CONFERENCE GIVEN OCTOBER 20 BY SHOKROLLAH PAKNEJAD. PAKNEJAD IS CHAIRMAN OF AN ORGANIZATION CALLED THE ASSOCIATION OF POLITICAL PRISONERS (APP) WHICH APPEARS TO BE AN UMBRELLA GROUP OF PEOPLE "WHO SERVED TIME IN THE SHAH'S JAILS FOR REVOLUTIONARY ACTIVITIES." PAKNEJAD CHARGED THAT SEVERAL PRISONS IN THE COUNTRY ARE NOW FILLED WITH MEN AND WOMEN ACCUSED OF MEMBERSHIP IN POLITICAL PARTIES OR PARTICIPATION IN STUDENT AND LABOR ACTIVITIES. IN PARTICULAR, HE MENTIONED THE KURDISH AND ARAB MINORITIES. PAKNEJAD SAID THAT THERE WERE OVER 1,500 CURRENT POLITICAL PRISONERS FROM "AMONG THE PEOPLE WHO ACTIVELY OPPOSED THE PREVIOUS REGIME."
PRIME MINISTER'S OFFICE IMMEDIATELY DENIED ALL CHARGES OF IMPRISONMENT AND TORTURE OF POLITICAL DISSIDENTS AND SAID IT WAS INVESTIGATING CHARGES INVOLVING A STUDENT EXECUTED IN KURDESTAN.

EMBASSY DOES NOT KNOW THIS GROUP BUT WILL CHECK IT OUT. WE FIND IT VERY INTERESTING THAT THIS STORY WAS CARRIED IN BOTH ENGLISH AND FARSI LANGUAGE PRESS. THE PROSECUTOR GENERAL OF IRAN STATED ON OCTOBER 22 THAT THERE WERE 673 POLITICAL PRISONERS IN EVIN PRISON IN TEHRAN. EMBASSY DOES NOT PRESENTLY HAVE FIGURES ON PRISONERS IN OTHER PARTS OF THE COUNTRY BUT IS TRYING TO OBTAIN THEM. LAINGEN
(C-ENTIRE TEXT)

INTRODUCTION AND SUMMARY. WHILE IRAN EARNS TWO BILLION DOLLARS A MONTH IN OIL REVENUES, ABOUT 2.4 MILLION OF IRAN'S WORKFORCE (OR 20 PERCENT) ARE UNEMPLOYED. MANY PLANTS ARE IDLED. AVERAGES PRODUCTION IS ESTIMATED AT FIFTY PERCENT OF CAPACITY WITH THE REVOLUTION 8 MONTHS PAST, AND THE FIRST INITIAL STAGE, RECOVERY FROM CHAOS, ACHIEVED, MANY IRANIANS ARE BEGINNING TO ASK WHY THE RECOVERY CURVE IS NOT RISING FASTER.

THIS TELEGRAM EXPLORES A BASIC PROBLEM, THE FAILURE TO TRANSLATE EXCESS LIQUIDITY IN BANKS INTO BADLY NEEDED INVESTMENT OR CREDIT FOR A LIMPING INDUSTRIAL SECTOR. TIGHT CREDIT THWARTS THE DECLARED INTENTIONS OF GOVERNMENT, AND CONTRIBUTES TO THE INSTABILITY AND LACK OF CONFIDENCE WHICH ARE THEMSELVES FACTORS IN THE PROBLEM. OTHER CAUSES DISCUSSED BELOW ARE THE LACK OF INVESTORS AND INVESTMENT, CAPITAL FLIGHT, GOVERNMENT INCAPACITY AT ALL LEVELS, PERSONAL INSECURITY, FAILURE OF THE EMERGENCY CREDIT PROGRAM, AND THE INSOLVENCY OF INTENDING BORROWERS.UPON THE GOVERNMENT'S SUCCESS IN THE COMING MONTHS IN RESOLVING SUCH PROBLEMS AND IN LAUNCHING PROGRAMS WHICH INSPIRE CONFIDENCE, MAY DEPEND THE FUTURE OF THIS REGIME.
END INTRODUCTION AND SUMMARY.

LACK OF CONFIDENCE, ZERO INVESTMENT, LIQUIDITY PREFERENCE AND CAPITAL FLIGHT. EXCESS LIQUIDITY CAN BE MADE PRODUCTIVE THROUGH INVESTMENT, IN NEW OR EXISTING PLANT, OR THROUGH THE LOAN OF WORKING CAPITAL. INVESTMENT TODAY IS ALMOST NON-EXISTENT, IN PART BECAUSE THE OLD ENTREPRENEURIAL CLASS HAS FLED THE COUNTRY. SADEGH SAMII, DEPUTY MANAGING DIRECTOR OF THE IRAN-ARAB BANK, AND HIMSELF OF THAT KIND OF FAMILY, ESTIMATES THAT TODAY THERE REMAIN NOT MORE THAN FIFTEEN IRANIANS OF THE NECESSARY PERSONAL FINANCIAL STATURE. UNDER TODAY'S CONDITIONS, THEY WILL NOT MAKE A MOVE.

THE BAZARI (CONSERVATIVE MERCHANT) CLASS ARE TRADERS, NOT RISK-TAKING INVESTORS. ACCORDING TO DIRECTOR ABTAHI OF THE FOREIGN DEPARTMENT OF BANK MELLI, IRAN'S LARGEST COMMERCIAL BANK, THESE BAZARIS ARE EXTREMELY WELL HEELED. IN THE FACE OF THE SAME UNCERTAINTIES, HOWEVER, THEY PREFER TO PILE UP THEIR WEALTH IN BANKS, OR BETTER STILL, TO EXPORT IT. OVERINVOICING OF IMPORTS IS REPORTEDLY A COMMON DEVICE, EXPLAINING WHY THE VOLUME (I.E. TOTAL DOLLAR VALUE) OF LETTERS OF CREDIT HAVE SWOLLEN SO MUCH OVER THE PAST TWO MONTHS. "IT DOES NOT NECESSARILY MEAN INCREASED IMPORTS, ON INCREASED ECONOMIC ACTIVITY.
WHY, I KEEP ASKING PEOPLE, WILL THEY NOT FACE THE FACT THAT WE ARE IN A VERY BAD SITUATION?," ASKS ABTAHI.

ALTERNATIVELY, ABTAHI WENT ON, BAZARIS (AND OTHERS) ARE CONVERTING THEIR WEALTH INTO GOODS LIKELY TO FIND MARKETS ABROAD. BESIDES OBVIOUS ITEMS SUCH AS GOLD OR ORIENTAL CARPETS, SAFFRON NOW IS MUCH IN DEMAND. UNLIKE THE ENTREPRENEURIAL CLASS WHO HAD BEEN UNCOMFORTABLY CLOSE TO THE OLD REGIME, MUCH OF THE BAZARIS LASS ARE IDEOLOGICALLY CLOSE TO THIS ONE. GENERALLY, THEY ARE DOING WELL, AS ATTESTED BY LIVELY RETAIL ACTIVITY IN THE BAZARS, AND BY THEIR SWELLING BANK ACCOUNTS. EVIDENCE OF UNCERTAINTY ON THEIR PART, THEREFORE, SHOULD NOT BE DISMISSED LIGHTLY.

PART OF THIS MISTRUST IS OF THE POLICIES (OR THE LACK OF THEM) EMANATING FROM THE GOVERNMENT. INSTEAD OF FIRM POLICIES, BUSINESSMEN ENCOUNTER ESOTERIC THEORIES, SUCH AS ZERO INTEREST, (REF B), WITHOUT MUCH BEING OFFERED IN THE WAY OF SPECIFICS TO WHICH THEY CAN RELATE, AND ON THE BASIS OF WHICH THEY CAN MAKE PLANS. ABTAHI ONLY HALFFACETIOUSLY REMARKED THAT TALK OF ZERO INTEREST MIGHT HAVE BEEN A "FALSE SIGNAL," IN ORDER TO SCARE EXCESS LIQUIDITY OUT OF INTEREST-BEARING TIME DEPOSITS AND INTO THE STOCK MARKET OR MORE DIRECT FORMS OF INVESTMENT. BUT THIS, HE SAID SADLY, WAS JUST NOT HAPPENING.

EQUALLY DISTURBING FOR THE BAZARIS MUST BE THE PRICE MUCH DID THEY PAY FOR THIS OR THAT IMPORT? HOW MUCH ARE THEY CHARGING THE CONSUMERS? WHILE THIS HAS BEEN A ------------------021615 232019Z /64 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 4421 SECTION 02 OF 03 TEHRAN 11223 TRADITIONAL CLERICAL FUNCTION IN TRADITIONAL ISLAM, ITS SIMPLISTIC APPROACH, AND THE DISQUIET THAT THEIR BIAS AGAINST PROFIT MUST GENERATE, SHOULD BE AN ADDITIONAL DETERENT TO INVESTMENT OR LENDING.

CONFIDENCE MAYBE ERODED BY THE QUALITY OF MANAGERS APPOINTED TO RUN THE NATIONALIZED INDUSTRIES. EVEN THE WORKERS, APPARENTLY, MAY COMPLAIN. BANKERS TELL OF MANAGERS WHO HAVE TO BE INTRODUCED TO THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN THE DEBIT SIDE OF THE BALANCE SHEET, AND THE CREDIT. COMPOUNDING THE RELUCTANCE OF BANKERS TO LEND TO FIRMS WITH INEXPERIENCED MANAGEMENT IS UNCERTAINTY AS TO WHO OWNS AND CONTROLS THE FIRMS. IN SOME CASES WHERE ALL THE SHARES HAVE NOT BEEN TAKEN OVER, BUT WHERE THE GOVERNMENT OR A CHARITABLE FOUNDATION APPOINTS CERTAIN DIRECTORS TO THE BOARD, LINES OF AUTHORITY AND ULTIMATE FINANCIAL RESPONSIBILITY REMAIN UNCLEAR.

THE APPOINTMENT OF INEXPERIENCED ADMINISTRATORS REFLECTS THE FLIGHT OF THE EXPERIENCED. YET, A NUMBER OF THE LATTER REMAIN, AND ARE FUNCTIONING WITHIN THE SYSTEM. THEIR ABILITY, HOWEVER, TO BRIDGE THE EXPERIENCE GAP AND EFFECTIVENESS IN MAKING THE ECONOMY TICK, IS REDUCED BY PSYCHOLOGICAL DISCOMFORT IN THEIR ROLES. "DO YOU REALIZE" ASKED ABTAHI, "THAT MY TENURE HERE MAY DEPEND ON WHETHER OR NOT I PRAY?" OTHERS HAVE SAID THE SAME, WHO, LIKE ABTAHI ARE UNWILLING TO PLAY THE HYPOCRITE. ALL ARE VULNERABLE TO SOME EXTENT, A LESSON DRIVEN HOME BY THE FIRING OF THE NIOC CHIEF NAZIH.

THERE ARISES A TENDENCY TO AVOID DECISIONS LIKELY TO GIVE OFFENSE OR TO DRAW ATTENTION TO THEMSELVES. IT EVEN AFFECTS THEIR DESIRE TO WORK OVERTIME (ESPECIALLY AFTER THE RECENT MAJOR CUTS IN PAY IN NIOC AND THE BANKS.)

ANOTHER, AND RELATED PRESSURE, IS THE FEAR NOT THAT THIS REGIME, BUT THAT ITS SUCCESSOR MAY CALL MANAGERS TO ACCOUNT FOR HAVING CARRIED OUT THE INSTRUCTIONS OF THE PRESENT ONE. WHAT HAPPENED TO MANY WHO CARRIED OUT THE ORDERS OF THE SHAH, THE PATENT INSTABILITY OF THIS REGIME, AND THE FELT POSSIBILITY OF COUNTER-REVOLUTION, ALL COMBINE TO DISCOURAGE INITIATIVE.

ON THE POSITIVE SIDE, OF COURSE, THE EXAMPLE OF WHAT HAPPENED TO THOSE WHO BENT THE RULES TO TAKE CARE OF THE SHAH'S CRONIES HAS STRENGTHENED THE BACKS OF BANKERS TO RESIST CRUDE INTERFERENCES BY CLERGY AND KOMITEHS ANXIOUS TO HAVE THEIR PET PROJECTS FINANCED, HOWEVER UNECONOMIC. "NOBODY'S GOING TO STAND ME UP AGAINST THE WALL LIKE THEY DID TO SOME OF THOSE GUYS," SAYS MANAGING DIRECTOR AGHILI OF THE BANK OF IRAN AND THE MIDDLE EAST.

ON BALANCE, HOWEVER, THE EFFECT OF THESE PRESSURES, PARTICULARLY ON BANKERS WHO ARE NOW CIVIL SERVANTS, HAS BEEN TO DISCOURAGE INNOVATION, BOLDNESS AND FLEXIBILITY. THESE QUALITIES ARE PARTICULARLY NEEDED AS MANY INSOLVENT IRANIAN INDUSTRIES CALL OUT IN VAIN FOR CREDIT.

TO UNDERSTAND THE IMPORTANCE OF CREDIT FOR IRANIAN INDUSTRIES, ONE SHOULD RECALL THAT MUCH OF IT CONSISTS OF THE ASSEMBLY OF FOREIGN COMPONENTS, OR, AT LEAST, DEPENDS HEAVILY ON IMPORTED RAW MATERIALS. INDUSTRIALISTS WERE AT PAINS TO MAINTAIN THEIR CREDIT RATINGS.AS MANAGING DIRECTOR SAGHETTLIAN OF THE FOREIGN TRADE BANK OF IRAN (FTBI) COMMENTED, THEY TOOK CARE OF THEIR SUPPLIERS WELL BEFORE THEIR IRANIAN BANKERS. IN RETURN, MANY ENJOYED THE PRIVILEGE OF BUYING ON OPEN ACCOUNT. OTHERS TOOK OUT TERM LETTERS OF CREDIT OF 180 DAYS OR BETTER.

AT 180 DAY TERMS HAVING ALLOWED A MONTH FOR TRANSPORT OF THE IMPORTED INPUTS, A MONTH FOR PROCESSING AND A MONTHS GRACE TO THE PURCHASER OF THE FINISHED PRODUCT BEFORE HE HAD TO PAY, THE INDUSTRIALIST ENJOYED A 3-MONTH HOLIDAY BEFORE HE HAD TO REPAY HIS SUPPLIERS. THE FLOAT WAS AN IMPORTANT FACTOR IN HIS PROFIT MARGIN.

WITH THE REVOLUTION, FOREIGN SUPPLIERS BEGAN TO INSIST ON CONFIRMED LETTERS OF CREDIT, WHICH EFFECTIVELY MEANT CASH. FIRMS IN TURN BEGAN TO DEMAND CASH PAYMENT FROM THEIR CUSTOMERS. THE FLOAT WAS LOST, AND, IN MANY CASES, PRODUCTION IS DOWN (AND EARNINGS),WHILE. FULL PAYROLLS MUST STILL BE MAINTAINED WITH A 20 PERCENT PAY BOOST. CUSTOMERS HAVE WITHHELD PAYMENT. EFFECTIVELY INSOLVENT, WITH THEIR AVAILABLE COLLATERAL (LAND) RENDERED VALUELESS, MANY INDUSTRIES, ALREADY LENT UP, WERE TRYING TO BORROW EVEN TO MEET THEIR PAYROLLS, AND USUALLY WITHOUT SUCCESS.

THE CRY FOR EMERGENCY CREDIT, FIRST HEARD FIVE MONTHS AGO, WAS RESPONDED TO BY THE "BUSINESS COMMITTEE" OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE IN QUM. IN LEAGUE WITH RIGHTTHINKING BAZARIS, THEIR WELL-PUBLICIZED 80 BILLION RIAL EMERGENCY CREDIT (REF A) BUILT UP GREAT HOPES. AT SIX PERCENT INTEREST, AND WITH COLLATERAL REQUIREMENTS EFFECTIVELY WAIVED, THE CBI WAS TO CHANNEL 80 BILLION RIALS IN 10 TRANCHES THROUGH 10 BANKS (RECENTLY BECOME 11) OF THE STRONGER COMMERCIAL BANKS.

FIFTY PERCENT OF THE ------------------021380 232020Z /64 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 4422 SECTION 03 OF 03 TEHRAN 11223 APPLICANTS' REQUIREMENTS WERE TO BE DRAWN FROM THIS FACILITY, WHILE THE BALANCE WOULD COME FROM THE BANKS OWN FUNDS. HENCE 160 BILLION RIALS WOULD BE INJECTED INTO THE ECONOMY, WITH 1.6 BILLION RIALS EXPECTED FROM EACH DESIGNATED BANK IN THE FIRST TRANCHE. THE CREDITS COULD BE USED EITHER TO MEET PAYROLLS, OR TO PURCHASE RAW MATERIALS.

WITH ONE POSSIBLE EXCEPTION, ALL OUR BANKING CONTACTS AGREE THAT THE SCHEME HAS PROVEN TO BE A TOTAL FAILURE THE BANK SANAYE, THE ONLY ONE OF THE DESIGNATED BANKS TO GIVE US FIGURES, NOTED THAT OF ITS 1.6 BILLION, ONLY 309 MILLION, OR 20 PERCENT OF TARGET HAS BEEN ADVANCED. THE PRINCIPAL ROADBLOCK, ALL ADMIT, WAS THE HOPELESSLY COMPLEX REDTAPE ENCOUNTERED BY THE APPLICANT. SAGHETELIAN OF FTBI TELLS OF ONE APPLICANT WHO APPLIED FOR A CREDIT TO BUY RAW MATERIALS, ONLY TO BE REQUESTED BY THE LOAN COMMITTEE OF THE MINISTRY OF INDUSTRIES AND MINES TO SUPPLY THE NAMES OF ALL HIS EMPLOYEES.

INADVERTENTLY, HE HAD APPLIED FOR THE WRONG KIND OF CREDIT. (THE QUESTION REMAINS WHETHER IN ORDER TO MAKE AN EMERGENCY PAYROLL LOAN, ONE REALLY NEEDS ALL THOSE NAMES.) THE IRANIAN BUREAUCRACY IN THE MINISTRY HAD A FIELD DAY AS DID THE CLERICAL REPRESENTATIVES, IN SOLICITING NIGGLING AND IRRELEVANT DETAILS. MONTHS WOULD GO BY, WITHOUT ACTION ON THE PART OF THE MINISTRY OF CENTRAL BANK.

ALONE AMONG THE BANKERS, SAGHATELIAN APPEARED UNTROUBLED BY THESE DIFFICULTIES. WHEN THE CENTRAL BANK WAS SLOW IN COMING THROUGH, HE WOULD ADVANCE THE ENTIRE AMOUNT FROM FTBI'S OWN FUNDS, AND CORRECT THE ACCOUNT LATER. IN CONCEDING THAT THE DRAW-DOWN RATE IN OTHER BANKS WAS LOW, HE ALLOWED THAT HIS BANK HAD TRADITIONALLY ENJOYED THE CUSTOM OF THE "CREAM" OF IRANIAN INDUSTRY. IN OTHER WORDS, HE WAS LENDING TO THE FEW WHO DIDNT REALLY NEED EMERGENCY CREDITS. AS NOTED ABOVE, THE CONSENSUS WAS THAT THOSE WHO DID NEED THEM WEREN'T GETTING THEM.

THE OVERRIDING QUESTION, THEREFORE, REMAINS THE CREDITWORTHINESS OF THE INDIVIDUAL INDUSTRIALIST. BANK MELLI, SAID ABTAHI, HAD DONE ALL IT COULD TO MAKE CREDIT AVAILABLE. BUT WHEN A COMPANY IS PATENTLY INSOLVENT, WHEN IT HAS TO BORROW EVEN TO MEET ITS PAYROLL, THEN A LINE HAS TO BE DRAWN. ABTAHI MADE IT CLEAR THAT HE HAD NO MORE DESIRE THAN AGHILI SOMEDAY TO BE STOOD UP AGAINST A WALL.

CONCLUSIONS. FACED WITH THE INEPTITUDE OF THE RESPONSIBLE MINISTRY, NO COLLATERAL REQUIREMENTS, AND ASKED TO PUT THEIR OWN MONEY INTO INSOLVENT OPERATIONS, THE COMMERCIAL BAKS ARE UNDERSTANDABLY NOT RESPONDING TO THIS NATIONAL PRIORITY. THE CONSEQUENCES ARE FELT IN A NUMBER OF WAYS.

FOR EXAMPLE, THE TRUCKING INDUSTRY FACES A SERIOUS SHORTAGE OF SPARE PARTS. ONE OF THE LARGEST SPARE PARTS IMPORTERS CAN MEET ONLY 65 PERCENT OF ORDERS. ADDITIONAL STOCK IS AVAILABLE, BUT UNPAID FOR, IN CUSTOMS WAREHOUSES. THE FIRM IS INSOLVENT, AND NO BANK WILL LEND IT FUNDS TO PAY OFF THE LETTERS OF CREDIT AND CLEAR CUSTOMS. MEANWHILE, GOVERNMENT MINISTERS ARE JAWBONING MANUFACTURERS AND IMPORTERS TO "DO SOMETHING" ABOUT THE PROBLEM.

THIS MAY BE AN EXTREMS CASE. INDUSTRIES OWNED BY THE GOVERNMENT, AT LEAST ACCORDING TO PRO-GOVERNMENT MANAGING DIRECTOR AFGHANI OF THE BANK SADERAT IRAN, ARE ABLE TO FIND ENOUGH CREDIT TO IMPORT AND TO KEEP PRODUCTION GOING. A NUMBER OF PROBLEMS WERE INHERITED FROM THE DAYS OF THE SHAH. AGRICULTURAL MACHINERY, WE ARE TOLD, IS DOING BETTER.

THERE IS, NEVERTHELESS, CAUSE FOR CONCERN IN THE PRECEDING ANALYSIS. AS REVOLUTIONARY EVENTS RECEDE INTO THE PAST, PEOPLE WILL EXPECT MORE OF GOVERNMENT THAN GOVERNMENT IS PRESENTLY DELIVERING. THE NEXT FEW MONTHS SHOULD GIVE US A BETTER IDEA OF WHETHER THE STABILITY AND CONFIDENCE CURVE WILL GO UP, OR DOWN. LAINGEN

(U) SHAH'S ARRIVAL IN US HAD NOT FULLY REGISTERED ON IRANIAN PUBLIC, PRESS AND MEDIA BY 1600 OCTOBER 23. TEHRAN RADIO HAD NOT YET MENTIONED SHAH'S ARRIVAL IN US AND EVENING PAPERS, JUST OUT ARE SIMPLY CARRYING WIRE REPORTS WITHOUT COMMENTS. EVENING FARSI LANGUAGE KAYHAN, CARRIES AP REPORT UNDER HEADLINE "DEPOSED SHAH ARRIVES IN NEW YORK". KAYHAN STORY, HOWEVER, IS TUCKED AWAY ON PAGE TWO AS SMALLEST ITEM ON PAGE. FARSI LANGUAGE "ETALLAT", HOWEVER, DID CARRY FRONT PAGE HEADLINE "CARTER GIVES THE DEPOSED SHAH A RESIDENCE PERMIT - DEPOSED SHAH LEAVES FOR NEW YORK MEDICAL EXAMINATION", WITH BACK THREE PARA TEXT OF AFP STORY FROM MEXICO.

(U) EMBASSY HAS HAD NO WORD OF ANY DEMONSTRATIONS. TWO SMALL GROUPS OF DEMONSTRATORS DID WALK BY EMBASSY EARLY THIS MORNING BUT NEITHER HAD ANY CONNECTION AS FAR AS WE COULD TELL TO THE SHAH'S TRIP. FIRST GROUP OF ABOUT 200 STUDENTS CARRIED SIGNS AND SHOUTED "DEATH TO THE USA" AND THE US SHOULD BE DESTROYED". THE SECOND GROUP ABOUT A HALF AN HOUR LATER WAS ALSO COMPOSED OF ABOUT 3050 STUDENTS WHO WAVES NOTEBOOKS AND CALLED OUT SLOGANS ASKING THAT THEIR TEACHERS BE PURGED. SECOND DEMONSTRATION APPEARED TO HAVE NO CONNECTION WITH EMBASSY. BOTH DEMONSTRATIONS PASSED EMBASSY WITHOUT STOPPING.
A THIRD SMALL GROUP OF APPROXIMATELY 75 STUDENTS STAGED A "WALK-BY" IN FRONT OF THE EMBASSY AT 1600 HOURS CHANTING AMONG OTHER SLOGANS "DEATH TO CARTER".

(C) EMBASSY HAS TAKEN APPROPRIATE INTERNAL SECURITY MEASURES AND HAS DEVELOPED CONTINGENCY PLANS SIMILAR TO THOSE USED TO DEAL WITH THE DEMONSTRATIONS FOLLOWING THE ANNOUNCEMENT OF THE JAVITS' RESOLUTION THIS MAY. ALSO, CHARGE HAS SOUGHT AND RECEIVED ASSURANCES FROM FM YAZDI THAT NATIONAL POLICE AT EMBASSY WOULD BE AUGMENTED ALTHOUGH WE HAVE YET TO SEE ANY INDICATION OF THIS. (COMMENT: THERE WERE NO NATIONAL POLICE IN SIGHT DURING 1600 WALK BY). RSO MET WITH HEAD OF NATIONAL POLICE CONTINGENT AT EMBASSY, COL.
NEMATI, TODAY AND WAS ADVISED BY THE LATTER THAT HE HAD BEEN TOLD BY THE CHIEF OF POLICE THIS MORNING THAT HIS GROUP WOULD BE REINFORCED AT THE FIRST SIGN OF TROUBLE.
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

DEPTOFF PRECHT AND POLCOUNS MET WITH Y.K. GHADIMI, MEMBER OF THE IRANIAN BAHA'I NATIONAL COUNCIL, OCTOBER 22. DISCUSSION PRODUCED LITTLE SUBSTANCE NOT PREVIOUSLY REPORTED (REFTELS) ASIDE FROM GHADIMI'S STATEMENT THAT AT LEAST SOME MEMBERS OF THE PGOI AND SOME MEMBERS OF THE ASSEMBLY OF EXPERTS CURRENTLY DEBATING IRAN'S DRAFT CONSTITUTION HAD SHOWN SYMPATHY TO THE BAHA'I COMMUNITY'S SITUATION. HE INTIMATED THAT SUCH VIEWS WERE REFLECTED IN POLICE PROTECTION PROVIDED THE RUINS OF THE HOUSE OF THE BAB (TEHRAN 10229) FOLLOWING THE BUILDING'S DEMOLITION IN EARLY SEPTEMBER. THE PRIME MINISTER'S OFFICE HAD INSTRUCTED THE MAYOR OF SHIRAZ TO PREVENT INCIDENTS WHICH HAD "INTERNATIONAL IMPLICATIONS."

GHADIMI AGAIN STRESSED THAT THE FOCUS OF BAHA'I EFFORTS IN IRAN LIES IN SECURING TACIT IF NOT EXPLICIT LEGAL GUARANTEES FOR THE COMMUNITY'S CIVIL RIGHTS. HE CONCEDED THAT THE SYMPATHY HE REFERRED TO MIGHT,INDEED, PRESAGE AN ULTIMATE MODUS VIVENDI WITH IRAN'S CURRENT ISLAMIC LEADERSHIP. HE REMAINED CONVINCED, HOWEVER, THAT FOR THE MOMENT THE BAHA'I COMMUNITY IS THE TARGET OF A CAMPAIGN OF "ADMINISTRATIVE, FINANCIAL AND SOCIAL STRANGULATION." HE REITERATED THAT THE BAHA'I LEADERSHIP INTENDS TO RESIST AND IS NOT ENCOURAGING MEMBERS OF THE COMMUNITY TO LEAVE IRAN. HE WAS GRATEFUL FOR THE QUIET ASSISTANCE BEING PROVIDED BY THE USG. 1979TEHRAN11268.subject: POST-REVOLUTIONARY INDUSTRY IN TABRIZ: MERCEDES BENZ

segments.text: BENZ (C-ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY: DURING A RECENT VISIT TO TABRIZ, TDY COMMOFF VISITED MERCEDES-BENZ JOINT-VENTURE DIESEL ENGINE PLANT. COMMOFF FROM EARLIER TOUR IN TABRIZ (1972-74) WAS WELLACQUAINTED WITH PLANT, ITS PREVIOUS IRANIAN MANAGING DIRECTOR AND ITS NEW IRANIAN MANAGING DIRECTOR, CHRIST AGHABEGIAN WHO HAPPENS TO BE AN ARMENIAN. BY POSTREVOLUTIONARY IRANIAN INDUSTRIAL STANDARDS, PRODUCTION AT 50 PERCENT OF PAST PRODUCTION CAN BE COUNTED AS SUCCESS. STORY OF HOW PLANT IS WEATHERING CRISIS PROVIDES INTERESTING VIGNETTEE ON REVOLUTIONARY IRAN AS WELL AS EXAMPLE OF HOW TALENTED ARMENIAN MANAGER CAN JUGGLE OFTEN CONFLICTING INTERESTS OF GOVERNMENT, PRIVATE SHAREHOLDERS, BANKS, REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEES, MULLAHS AND WORKERS. END SUMMARY.

THE IRANIAN DIESEL ENGINE MANUFACTURING COMPANY (IDEM) WAS ESTABLISHED IN 1970 AS A MERCEDES-BENZ JOINT VENTURE TO MANUFACTURE TRUCK AND BUS DIESEL ENGINES. APPROXIMATELY EQUAL SHARES ARE HELD IN THIS PRIVATE JOINT-STOCK DEVELOPMENT BANK OF IRAN (IMDBI), KHAVAR COMPANY AND IRAN NATIONAL. KHAVAR AND IRAN NATIONAL ARE MERCEDES-BENZ MANUFACTURERS IN TEHRAN OF M-B TRUCKS AND BUSES RESPECTIVELY. IDEM HAS BEEN A SUCCESS STORY; BY 1977 PRODUCTION HAD RISEN TO 18,000 ENGINES A YEAR (APPROXIMATELY HALF EACH FOR KHAVAR AND IRAN NATIONAL) AND A VIGOROUS EXPANSION PROGRAM WAS ENSURING STEADY INCREASE IN IRANIAN VALUE ADDED.
PRODUCTION FOR THE CURRENT IRANIAN YEAR (MARCH TO SEPTEMBER) HAS DROPPED TO 750 ENGINES A MONTH OR ABOUT 9,000 PER YEAR.

IDEM HAS BEEN BOTH FORTUNATE AND UNFORTUNATE IN ITS CAPTIVE MARKET. KHAVAR COMPANY HAS HAD VERY SERIOUS CREDIT AND PRODUCTION PROBLEMS SINCE THE REVOLUTION. WHILE ITS CHIEF STOCKHOLDER (THE SOUDEVAR FAMILY) HAS REMAINED IN IRAN, THE GOVERNMENT HAS INSTALLED NEW MANAGEMENT AND A NEW BOARD OF DIRECTORS. KHAVAR WAS OVER-EXTENDED EVEN PRIOR TO THE REVOLUTION; TRUCKS WERE SOLD ON CREDIT IN IRAN AND KHAVAR ALWAYS HAD TO STRUGGLE FOR OPERATING CAPITAL. WITH THE REVOLUTION, THE SHUT-DOWN OF LARGE CONSTRUCTION PROJECTS, THE REFUSAL OR INABILITY OF ITS CUSTOMERS TO PAY THEIR DEBTS, COUPLED WITH CREDIT SHORTAGES AND THE INEXPERIENCE OF ITS NEW MANAGEMENT, THE COMPANY IS NEARLY BANKRUPT.

WORKERS WAGES HAVE BEEN RAISED WHILE PRODUCTION IS VIRTUALLY NIL. IRAN NATIONAL,ON THE OTHER HAND, WAS A MONEY MACHINE FOR ITS OWNERS, THE KHAYYAMIS, IN PRE-REVOLUTIONARY IRAN. PAYKAN AUTOMOBILES MADE BY THE FIRM WERE IN SUCH DEMAND THAT CUSTOMERS PAID CASH 6 MONTHS IN ADVANCE AND ITS M-B BUS MARKET WAS GROWING STEADILY. THE KHAYYAMIS HAVE FLED FROM IRAN, THEIR PROPERTY HAS BEEN NATIONALIZED, BUT EVEN THE PGOI HAS NOT BEEN ABLE YET TO RUIN IRAN NATIONAL. THE COMPANY HAD SURPLUS CASH OPERATING CAPITAL OF OVER 1 BILLION TOMAN (ABOUT 135 MILLION DOLLARS) ON THE EVE OF THE REVOLUTION.
THIS HAS PROVIDED A COMFORTABLE TEMPORARY CUSHION TO ABSORB INCREASED WORKER WAGES AND THE CONTINUING DEMAND FOR M-B BUSES HAS PROVIDED A MARKET FOR IDEM.

BY TABRIZ AND EVEN IRANIAN STANDARDS, IDEM HAS BEEN A PROFITABLE COMPANY FOR ITS SHAREHOLDERS. TURNOVER WAS OVER 600 MILLION TOMAN PER YEAR (NEARLY 100 MILLION DOL), IMPORTS OF COMPONENTS FROM DAIMLER-BENZ WERE OVER 100 M. DM PER YEAR, THE PLANT EARNED A PROFIT OF 80 MILLION TOMANS (OVER 10 MILLION DOLLARS) IN 1977 AND PROVIDED EMPLOYMENT FOR 1300 TABRIZIS. PLANT IS NOW AT HALF-PRODUCTION, IS PAYING ITS SAME WORKFORCE (WHICH CANNOT BE REDUCED) HIGHER WAGES AND IS LOSING ABOUT 5 MILLION TOMANS A MONTH (ABOUT 800,000 DOLLARS). LOSSES ARE TO A LARGE EXTENT BEING FINANCED THROUGH DIPPING INTO DEPRECIATION RESERVES AND SOME BANK CREDITS.

PRIOR TO THE REVOLUTION, D-M GERMANY SOLD COMPONENTS AT 50 PERCENT DOWN AND 50 PERCENT IN 9, 12, AND 15 MONTH TRANCHES. AFTER THE REVOLUTION, D-M EXTENDED TERMS TO A 20 PERCENT TO 80 PERCENT RATIO, BUT WHEN HERMES ELIMINATED ITS EXPORT INSURANCE, IDEM WAS FORCED TO PURCHASE ON A CONFIRMED LETTER OF CREDIT BASIS.

THE REVOLUTION HAS DRAMATICALLY CHANGED MANAGEMENTLABOR RELATIONS AT IDEM, AT LEAST IN THE SHORT-RUN. AGHABEGIAN BECAME ACTING MANAGING DIRECTOR IN EARLY 1978. AGHABEGIAN, A NATIVE TABRIZ ARMENIAN, HAD SPENT 13 YEARS IN GERMANY, BUT RETURNED TO TABRIZ IN 1970 AS AN ENGINEER AND HAS WORKED HIS WAY TO THE TOP OF THE COMPANY. AGHABEGIAN WAS APPOINTED MANAGING DIRECTOR BY THE BOARD OF ------------------052256 270122Z /65 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 4446 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 11268 DIRECTORS AFTER THE REVOLUTION AND RE-CONFIRMED IN THIS POSITION BY THE REVOLUTIONARY PLANT COMMITTEE IN A NOISY MEETING OF ALL 1300 EMPLOYEES.

THE EARLY PLANT COMMITTEE HAD 29 MEMBERS (SOME LEFTISTS), BUT THE WORKERS HAVE SINCE ELECTED A NEW 5-MAN COMMITTEE COMPRISED OF VERY RELIGIOUS WORKERS. AGHABEGIAN IS SOMEWHAT CONCERNED THAT THIS COMMITTEE IS INCREASINGLY BEING BY-PASSED BY WORKERS WHO WANT TO BRING THEIR PROBLEMS TO HIM DIRECTLY. WHILE THIS INDICATES TRUST IT PLACES AN IMPOSSIBLE DEMAND ON HIS TIME.

EVEN PRIOR TO THE REVOLUTION, AGHABEGIAN HAD VERY ASTUTELY REACTED TO WORKER FRUSTRATIONS AND JEALOUSIES. TO THE CHAGRIN OF STAFF, HE ALLOWED WORKERS TO USE THE IDEM CLUB, SWIMMING POOL AND TENNIS COURTS. HE STOPPED CONSTRUCTION ON A 250,000 DOL HOUSE HE HAD BEEN CONSTRUCTING AND HAS CONTINUED TO LIVE IN A SMALLER HOUSE IN TABRIZ. HE NOTED THAT RELIGIOUS WORKERS HAD NO WHERE TO PRAY AND BEGAN THE CONSTRUCTION OF A SMALL MOSQUE ON THE PLANT SITE. HE REFUSED A CHAFFEUR, SOLD THE NEW MERCEDES COMPANY CAR AND DRIVES A 5 YEAR OLD MERCEDES.

ALL OF THIS HAS PAID OFF IN BETTER WORKER RELATIONS, BUT PERHAPS EVEN MORE IMPORTANTLY HAS PROMOTED AGHABEGIAN'S RELATIONS WITH THE CITY'S NEW REVOLUTIONARY ESTABLISHMENT. THE SINGING OF HIS PRAISES BY HIS PIOUS WORKER COMMITTEE HAS BROUGHT VISITS AND COMMENDATIONS FROM THE CITY'S CHIEF AYATOLLAHS. HIS RELATIVELY SUCCESSFUL PLEAS FOR CREDIT FROM THE CAUTIOUS BANKERS IN TABRIZ HAVE BEEN BACKED BY REQUESTS FROM THE CHIEF REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE TO THE GOVERNOR GENERAL TO THE CITY'S CHIEF AYATOLLAHS.

AGHABEGIAN REALIZES THAT SUCCESS IN REVOLUTIONARY IRAN IS TEMPORARY. THE WORKERS WHO "ELECTED" HIM CAN TURN AGAINST HIM ENBLOC FOR LITTLE OR NO CAUSE. HIS BOARD OF DIRECTORS, MANY OF WHOM ARE NOW GOVERNMENT APPOINTEES, ARE AN ADDITIONAL TRIAL. HE HAS FOUGHT THEM, HOWEVER, REFUSING TO HAVE MINUTES OF BOARD MEETINGS CHANGED FROM ENGLISH TO FARSI AND HAS CHALLENGED THEIR BRAND OF "BANNER" REVOLUTION (ALL RHETORIC, NO WORK).

MOTIVES ARE NOTORIOUSLY DIFFICULT TO ANALYZE, BUT IT APPEARS THAT AGHABEGIAN, WHO HAS BEEN FRUSTRATED TO THE POINT OF RESIGNATION ON THREE SEPARATE OCCASIONS, BELIEVES THAT THE PLANT MIGHT WELL FAIL WITHOUT HIM' SINCE HIS OARD AND THE WORKER COMMITEE REFUSED TO ACCEPT HIS RESIGNATION THEY MAY AGREE. AGHABEGIAN IS A MANAGER WHO SEEKS TO CONQUER THE IMMENSE CHALLENGES FACING HIM. HIS LINES OF ESCAPE SHOULD THE CHALLENGE PROVE TOO LARGE ARE OPEN, HOWEVER; M-B HAS A JOB WAITING FOR HIM IN GERMANY AND HIS ARMENIAN RELATIVES IN LOS ANGELES WOULD MAKE HIM A BUSINESS PARTNER.

AGHABEGIAN IS AN EXAMPLE OF ONE OF ONLY A FEW HUNDRED MODERN MANAGERS THAT IRAN CANNOT AFFORD TO LOSE. FAR TOO MANY MANAGERS HAVE ALREADY LEFT THE COUNTRY. THE MAJORITY OF THOSE REMAINING HAVE FRUSTRATIONS SIMILAR TO AGHABEGIAN'S AND IN MOST CASES
(C - ENTIRE TEXT).

1979TEHRAN11274.subject: REVOLUTIONARY PROSECUTOR REVISES STATEMENT ON EXECUTIONS

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

ACCORDING TO FARSI LANGUAGE PAPER KAYHAN, A SPOKESMAN FOR REVOLUTIONARY CHIEF PROSECUTOR GHODUSI AFTERNOON OF OCTOBER 18 CLARIFIED HIS ANNOUNCEMENT OF THAT MORNING THAT EXECUTIONS WOULD BE STOPPED (REFTEL). CLARIFICATION STATED THAT EXECUTIONS HAVE NOT BEEN STOPPED AT THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS BUT THAT THE CHIEF PROSECUTOR MUST NOW APPROVE ALL EXECUTION VERDICTS IN IRAN BEFORE THEY ARE CARRIED OUT. THIS WAS BEING DONE TO ASSURE UNIFORMITY OF VERDICTS ISSUED BY JUDGES OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS ACROSS THE COUNTRY. COMMENT: THERE HAVE BEEN NO REPORTS OF EXECUTIONS IN THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS SINCE OCTOBER 14.

ON OCTOBER 22, HOWEVER, TEHRAN PRESS REPORTED AN EXECUTION BY HANGING AT QASR PRISON. THIS CASE, HOWEVER, HAD BEEN JUDGED IN THE CRIMINAL COURT SYSTEM AND THE VERDICT APPEALED TO AND CONFIRMED BY THE SUPREME COURT. THE 23 YEAR OLD MAN CONFESSED TO AND WAS CONVICTED OF THE RAPE AND STRANION DEATH OF A FIVE YEAR OLD BOY. THE CRIME WAS APPARENTLY COMMITTED UNDER THE INFLUENCE OF ALCOHOL.

RADIO TEHRAN ANNOUNCED TODAY THAT THE REVOLUTIONARY COURTS IN TEHRAN WOULD BEGIN TRIALS TODAY OF SIX MILITARY OFFICERS ON VARIOUS CHARGES RELATED TO SUPRESSING THE REVOLUTIONARY MOVEMENT. THE SIX ARE: - MG NOZARIBAGHA - LTG HUSHANG HATAM - LTG BAKHSHIAZAR - LTG RAFATJU - MG HASSAN BEHZADI - COL HUSHANG TAZYANI.

ON OCTOBER 18, FAT-HULLAH JOSEPH GEORGIS, ONE OF THE LEADERS OF THE IRAQI KURDISH COMMUNITY IN IRAN CALLED ON CONSUL GENERAL AND ACTING POLITICAL COUNSELOR TO RELATE THE PRESENT STATUS OF THE IRAQI KURDISH COMMUNITY IN IRAN, TO PRESENT A COPY OF LETTER SENT TO UNHCR AND TO REQUEST HELP GETTING THREE MEMBERS OF THE IRAQI KURDISH COMMUNITY OUT OF IRAN. GEORGIS SAID THAT IT WAS URGENT THAT THESE MEMBERS WHO WERE IN PHYSICAL DANGER BECAUSE OF INTER-GROUP RIVALRIES GET OUT OF IRAN IMMEDIATELY. IN ADDITION, HE STATED HE HAD PRESENTED THE NAMES OF 500 IRAQI KURDS TO THE UNHCR REPRESENTATIVE TO CERTIFY AS REFUGEES.
HE HAS, HOWEVER, HAD NO REPLY FROM THE UNHCR.

GEORGIS GAVE EMBOFF A LETTER WHICH HE HAD SENT TO THE UNHCR REGARDING THE PROBLEMS FACED BY KURDISH REFUGEES IN IRAN. (BEING POUCHED). THE LETTER STATES THAT SINCE REVOLUTION, THE IRAQI KURDS SITUATION HAS BECOME VERY PRECARIOUS: SUBSIDIES TO THE IRAQI KURDS HAVE STOPPED; MANY HAVE LOST THEIR JOBS DUE TO CLOSURE OF FOREIGN AND DOMESTIC FIRMS; PGOI HAS MADE NO STATEMENT ON FUTURE POLICIES OF GOVERNMENT TO KURDS; IRANIAN FOREIGN MINISTRY IS ISSUING KURDS LAISSER PASSER FOR STATELESS PERSONS WHICH IS GOOD ONLY FOR EXIT (NOT RETURN) FROM IRAN. IRAQI KURDISH COMMUNITY IS SUSPECT AS AGENTS US CIA AND SUBJECT TO MUCH HARRASSMENT.

RECENTLY LEADERSHIP OF IRAQI KURD COMMUNITY WHICH IS HEADQUARTERED IN KARAJ (NEAR TEHRAN) HAS BEEN SUBJECT OF ASSASSINATIONS BY "EXTREMIST KURDS AND LEFTIST GROUPS" (SIC) AND THREE LEADERS HAVE BEEN ASSASSINATED: AUGUST 29 - SHEIKHA HAJI RASUL; SEPTEMBER 9 - MAJOR GENERAL ABDUL FAHMAN AL-QAZI (FORMER IRAQ AMBASSADOR TO INDONESIA); SEPTEMBER 15-A. AQRAWI. ASSASSINATIONS HAVE RESULTED IN PANIC IN KURDISH COMMUNITY AND IRAQI KURDS ARE NOW FEARFUL OF STAYING IN OWN HOUSES AT NIGHT.

GEORGIS WENT ON TO ELABORATE FOR EMBOFFS WHY HE THOUGHT IT PARTICULARLY URGENT THAT SOMETHING BE DONE FOR IRAQI KURDS IN IRAN. GEORGIS EXPLAINED THAT AFTER THE SHAH STOPPED SUPPORTING THE BARZANI IRAQI KURDS AGAINST IRAQ IN 1975, 30,000 IRAQI KURDS FROM BARZANI"S GROUP CAME TO IRAN FOR REFUGE AND WERE SETTLED ALL OVER IRAN. THE SHAH USED 3,000 OF THESE ARMED IRAQI KURDS AS GUARDS ALONG THE BORDER WITH IRAQ CLOSE TO TURKEY. IN THE CHAOS FOLLOWING THE REVOLUTION, MANY OF THE KURDS WHO HAD BEEN RELOCATED TO DISTANT AREAS HAVE NOW MOVED BACK TO THE BORDER AREA.

(COMMENT: THIS IS AN INDICATION THAT ASSIMILATION INTO IRANIAN SOCIETY HAS NOT, AND PROBABLY WILL NOT, WORK.) IN ADDITON, ABOUT 7,000 WHO WERE FEARFUL FOR THEIR SAFETY IN IRAN HAVE TAKEN THE IRAQI AMNESTY OFFER (ALTHOUGH THEY WERE VERY MISTRUSTFUL OF IT) AND HAVE RETURNED TO IRAQ.

MR. GEORGIS SAID THAT THE TWO SONS OF MULLAH MUSTAFA BARZANI, IDRIS AND MASU BARZANI ARE IN IRAN AND ARE VERY ANTI-IRAQ. THEY HAVE BEEN WORKING WITH THE PGOI AND ARE TRYING TO BUILD THE 3,000 MAN IRAQI BORDER FORCE INTO A LARGER AND MORE POWERFUL UNIT. MR. GEORGIS WAS VERY RESPECTFUL TOWARD IDRIS BARZANI BUT SAID HE FEARED THAT THIS FORCE WOULD BE USED TO SUPPRESS THE IRANIAN KDP KURDS. ONE OR TWO INCIDENTS HAD ALREADY OCCURRED WHERE THE IRAQI KURD FORCE HAD BEEN FORCED TO KILL IRANIAN KURDISH REBELS WHO ATTACKED THEM. GEORGIS SAID THAT IDRIS WAS PRESENTLY PRESSURING YOUNG KURDS TO JOIN HIS FORCE.
IDRIS WAS PROBABLY RECEIVING MONEY FROM THE PGOI FOR THIS AS HE HAD JUST LEFT TEHRAN LAST WEEK FOR THE KURDISH AREAS CARRYING THE PAY ROLL FOR HIS TROOPS.

GEORGIS SAID THAT THE HEADQUARTERS OF THE IRAQI KURDISH FORCE WAS IN URUMEIH (REZAIYEH) BUT THAT THE TROOPS WERE STATIONED MAINLY ALONG THE BORDER AREA BETWEEN NAGHADEH AND KHANEH NORTH TOWARD OSHNAVIEH.

HE SAID THAT THE HOSTILITY BETWEEN THE KDP AND THE IRAQI KURDS WENT BACK TO THE DAYS WHEN BARZANI WAS WORKING WITH THE CIA. THE IRANIAN KURDS ARE LEFTIST AND ALLIED WITH THE FEDAYIN. WHEN THE PASDARAN ABOUT A MONTH AGO ATTACKED A KDP VILLAGE NEAR NAGHADEH, ------------------036883 250811Z /10 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC PRIORITY 4453 INFO AMEMBASSY ANKARA AMEMBASSY ATHENS USINT BAGHDAD USMISSION GENEVA SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 11277 THE KDP AND FEDAYIN RETALIATED BY ATTACKING THE IRAQI KURDS STATIONED AT OSHNAVIEH. THIS ATTACK WAS BEATEN OFF QUITE EASILY.
GEORGIS IS AFRAID THAT THIS IS JUST THE BEGINNING AND THAT THE PGOI WILL INCREASINGLY USE THE IRAQI KURDS AGAINST THE KURDISH REBELS.

IN AN ASIDE, GEORGIS SAID THAT JALAL TALEBANI IS NOT VERY STRONG ONLY HAS ABOUT 700 MEN AT HIS DISPOSAL. THAHE DID NOT FEEL THAT MINISTER OF STATE FOROUHAR (HIMSELF A KURD) HAD ACTUALLY BEEN IN TOUCH WITH KDP LEADERS TO NEGOTIATE A CEASEFIRE IN KURDESTAN.

GEORGIS SAID THAT ABOUT 500 NAMES HAVE BEEN SUBMITTED TO THE UNHCR REPRESENTATIVE FOR CERTIFICATION. DURING CONGENS COURTESY CALL AT UNHCR OFFICE IN EARLY SEPTEMBER HE WAS TOLD THERE WERE NO APPLICATIONS PENDING. GEORGIS WAS TOLD EMBASSY COULD NOT ASSIST IN VISA PROCESS UNTIL CERTIFICATION PROCESS WAS COMPLETED. GEORGIS SAID HE WOULD PUSH PROCEEDINGS. CONGEN ALSO SUGGESTED THAT, GIVEN THE DEMANDS AGAINST SEVENTH PREFERENCE ANY KURDS WITH IMMEDIATE RELATIVES IN THE U.S. SHOULD ATTEMPT TO ENTER THROUGH OTHER CATEGORIES. DISCUSSION OF VISAS FOR INDIVIDUALS IN "DANGER" BECAUSE OF INTERNAL KURDISH POLITICS WAS AVOIDED.

ACTION REQUESTED: - A) FOR DEPARTMENT: PRESUME THERE IS NO BASIS FOR VISAS FOR INDIVIDUALS CAUGHT IN INTRA-GROUP DIFFICULTIES. WOULD APPRECIATE GUIDANCE ON THIS POINT. - B) FOR BAGHDAD: WOULD FIND USEFUL ANY COMMENTS YOU COULD MAKE ON TREATMENT OF THOSE WHO HAVE ACCEPTED AMNESTY. - C) FOR GENEVA: CONGEN HAS CONTACTED UNHCR REP TEHRAN REGARDING IRAQI KURDS. REP SAYS UNHCR DOES HAVE NAMES OF 500 KURDISH APPLICANTS AND HE IS WORKING TO HAVE THEM CERTIFIED AS REFUGEES. USUAL UNHCR PROCEDURE, HOWEVER, IS ONLY TO ISSUE REFUGEE STATUS TO APPLICANTS WHO HAVE BEEN DENIED RESIDENT STATUS BY HOST GOVERNMENT (E.G. IRAN).

IRAN, HOWEVER, HAS GIVEN KURDS SEMIPERMANENT STATUS AND IS UNWILLING FOR POLITICAL REASONS TO WITHDRAW THIS. REP SAYS SECURITY SITUATION FOR IRAQI KURDS HAS DETERIORATED SERIOUSLY OVER LAST TWO MONTHS DUE TO SPLIT WITHIN IRAQI KURDISH COMMUNITY AND REP HAS RECOMMENDED TO GENEVA THAT REQUIREMENTS RE RESIDENCE STATUS BE WAIVED AND GROUP OF 500 BE GRANTED REFUGEE STATUS. EMBASSY WOULD APPRECIATE ANY INFORMATION GENEVA MAY HAVE ON ABOVE. LAINGEN
