1979TEHRAN11312.subject: TABRIZ AFTER FIVE YEARS: IMPRESSIONS OF REVOLUTIONARY IRAN

segments.text: REVOLUTIONARY IRAN (C-ENTIRE TEXT)

SUMMARY: IN VISIT TO TABRIZ, OCTOBER 17 TO 21, TDY COMMOFF HAD OPPORTUNITY TO RENEW OLD FRIENDSHIPS AND NOTE CONFLICTING EVEN CONTRADICTORY REACTIONS TO REVOLUTION. COMMOFF HAD SERVED IN TABRIZ FROM 1972-74 AND HAD KEPT IN TOUCH WITH TABRIZ THROUGH VISITS BY SELF OR WIFE IN 1975, 1976, AND 1977 WHILE STATIONED IN ANKARA. PHYSICALLY, TABRIZ HAS CHANGED A GREAT DEAL: IT USED TO BE THE LARGEST VILLAGE IN IRAN, NOW ITS A CITY. ECONOMICALLY, THE REVOLUTION HAS NOT FULFILLED THE EXPECTATIONS OF THE MASSES AND HAS CERTAINLY DASHED THE INITIALLY HIGH HOPES OF MANY IN THE MIDDLE CLASS.

WHILE THERE IS AN INCREASING SENSE OF PERSONAL SECURITY, THERE IS STILL FEAR OF UNBRIDLED ISLAMIC AND KOMITEH POWER. PSYCHOLOGICALLY, THE REMOVAL OF SAVAK HAS CREATED FREEDOM OF EXPRESSION AND DESIRE FOR MORE LIBERTIES THAT COULD PLACE A CHECK ON REVOLUTIONARY EXCESSES. END SUMMARY.

THE HIGHWAY THAT PASSES THROUGH TABRIZ FROM BAZARGAN TO TEHRAN IS ONE OF THE BUSIEST IN IRAN. IN 1977, 600 TO 800 TIR TRANSPORTS A DAY CROSSED THE TURKISH-IRANIAN BORDER WITH CARGO BOUND FOR TEHRAN. A PHYSICAL COUNT OF THE PRIMARILY BULGARIAN, TURKISH AND ROMANIAN TRANSPORTS MET ON THE HIGHWAY INDICATES THIS NUMBER HAS SHRUNK TO ABOUT 200 A DAY AT PRESENT. STILL, THE BUSY HIGHWAY HUMS WITH DOMESTIC TRUCKS CARRYING STEEL, COTTON, GRAIN, CEMENT, ETC. THE ABYEK 4,000 TON A DAY CEMENT PLANT NEAR QAZVIN WHERE UP TO 150 TRANSPORTS WOULD AWAIT CARGO AT ONE TIME IN 1974, WHILE STILL BUSY, NOW HAS LINES OF 50 TRUCKS OR LESS.

TABRIZ ITSELF HAS GROWN FROM A GIANT VILLAGE INTO A CITY. THERE WERE NO BUIIDINGS TALLER THAN 4 STORIES IN 1974, NOW THERE ARE SEVERAL 12 TO 16 STORY STRUCTURES. THE MAIN STREET OF THE CITY WHILE STILL TRAFFIC-CLOGGED NOW MUST COMPETE FOR TRAFFIC WITH THE RING ROADS AND SEVERAL OTHER MAJOR ARTERIES. WHILE LARGE CONSTRUCTION PROJECTS IN TABRIZ AS IN TEHRAN ARE STILL IDLE, TABRIZ IS BUSTLING WITH HUNDREDS OF SMALLER PROJECTS. PARTICULARLY ALONG THE NEW RING ROADS EVERYONE SEEMS TO HAVE HIRED 3 TO 5 LABORERS AND IS FINISHING OR BEGINNING CONSTRUCTION OF SMALLER HOUSES OR SHOPS.
WHILE PRODUCTION OF TRACTORS, DIESEL ENGINES, BALL-BEARINGS AND MACHINE TOOLS ARE DOWN TO 50 PERCENT OR LESS OF 1977 PRODUCTION, NO ONE HAS BEEN FIRED AND IN FACT WAGES HAVE BEEN RAISED.

ONE OF THE REASONS TABRIZ WAS OFTEN CONSIDERED A VILLAGE WERE THE AIMLESS WONDERINGS OF HUNDREDS OF YOUNG MEN IN THE STREETS OF DOWNTOWN TABRIZ. THIS HAS INCREASED GREATLY SINCE 1974, REPORTEDLY MOSTLY SINCE THE REVOLUTION. THERE ARE HUNDREDS OF UNEMPLOYED OR UNDER-EMPLOYED SELLING CIGARETTES, APPLES, KNICK-KNACKS, COMBS, ANYTHING THAT CAN BRING IN A FEW RIALS. AND THE AIMLESS WANDERERS HAVE GROWN TO THOUSANDS. A MERCHANT FRIEND WHO RECENTLY MOVED FROM THE BAZAAR TO A DOWNTOWN LOCATION STRESSED THAT THE ECONOMIC TRAGEDY OF THE PAHLAVI YEARS WAS THE DISLOCATION OF PEASANTS WHO WERE ATTRACTED TO THE CITY BY HIGH CONSTRUCTION WAGES.

WITH DRASTIC CUT-BACKS SINCE THE REVOLUTION, THIS DISPOSSESSED JOBLESS BADLY-EDUCATED PROLETARIAN COULD, HE FEARED, BE AS EASILY LED AFTER THE INEVITABLE DISILLUSIONMENT SETS IN BY COMMUNIST AGITATOOS AS IT HAS BEEN BY THE RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP.

DISCUSSIONS WITH MERCHANT FRIENDS INDICATED CONCERN WITH CHRONIC SLOWDOWN OF ECONOMY - IN THESE CASES CUTBACK IN CREDIT PURCHASES OF CONSUMER DURABLES. PRE-REVOLUTIONARY IRAN HAD THREE-PRONGED PROMOTION OF CONSUMER CREDIT: BANKS, BAZAARIS AND THE MERCHANTS THEMSELVES. CONSUMER CREDIT NOW HAS VIRTUALLY CEASED AND PURCHASES ARE FOR CASH. AS A LAWYER FRIEND PUT IT, "ALL CONTRACTS ARE UNENFORCEABLE,THERE ARE NO COURTS, NO JUDGES, NO LAWYERS, JUST QAZIS (RELIGIOUS JUDGES)." WHILE PEOPLE HAVE BY FORCE HAD TO TRUST THEIR LIVES OR PRISON SENTENCES TO QAZI JUSTICE, NO MERCHANT OR LAWYER DESIRES TO TRY TO ENFORCE CIVIL CONTRACTS IN A QAZI COURT.
SO EVERYONE SELLS FOR CASH AND PRAYS THAT HIS CREDITORS WILL PAY LATER. A LAWYER FRIEND SAID HE WAS OWED OVER 300,000 DOLLARS IN FEES. RATHER THAN CHANCE QAZI JUSTICE HE WILL WAIT THIS ONE OUT.

BULK OF EMBOFF FRIENDS DURING TOUR IN TABRIZ HAD BEEN MIDDLE CLASS: DOCTORS, LAWYERS, UNIVERSITY PROFESSORS, PLANT MANAGERS, BUSINESSMEN, ENGINEERS, SOME BUREAUCRATS. MOST WERE STILL IN TABRIZ, BUT QUICK SURVEY OF DOCTOR FRIENDS INDICATED THAT HIGHLY-PUBLICIZED PHYSICIAN BRAIN DRAIN (REPORTEDLY 4-5,000 OUT OF 13,000 PHYSICIANS HAVE LEFT IRAN SINCE LATE 1978) IS ACCURATE, AT LEAST IN PERCENTAGE TERMS FOR TABRIZ. MIDDLE CLASS FRIENDS SPENT LONG HOURS DISCUSSING PROBLEMS OF IRAN. TO A PERSON, THEY EXPRESSED EXTREME DISILLUSIONMENT WITH "REACTIONARY, FANATIC ------------------059320 280005Z /64 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 4472 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 11312 REPRESSIVE" ACTIONS OF KHOMEINI.

THEY SHARE TEHRAN MIDDLE CLASS HOPES THAT SOMEHOW, SOMEWAY SHARIAT-MADARI CAN MODERATE AND AMELORIATE FANATICISM THEY SEE AS EVIDENCE IN KHOMEINI, MONTAZERI, ET AL. AS INDICATION OF GROWING SHARIAT-MADARI POPULARITY THEY POINTED TO OBSERVABLE FACT THAT S-M'S PICTURES IN TABRIZ ARE OFTEN LARGER AND MORE PROMINENTLY DISPLAYED THAN KHOMEINI'SAND OUTNUMBER THE IMAM'S BY 10 TO 1.
OPENING CONVERSATIONS WITH MIDDLE CLASS FRIENDS USUALLY EVOLVED AROUND THREE QUESTIONS: 1. "WHAT IS GOING TO HAPPEN TO IRAN?", 2. "SHOULD WE LEAVE OR STAY?", AND

SOME VARIATION ON U.S. INVOLVEMENT IN BRINGING KHOMEINI TO POWER AND KEEPING HIM PROPPED UP NOW THAT HE IS BECOMING SO UNPOPULAR. THERE IS CONSIDERABLE CYNICAL DISCUSSION OF THE POWER OF THE "AMERICAN TRIUMVIRATE" (YAZDI, QOTBZADEH AND CHAMRAN) THAT SOME OF THEM VISUALIZE AS THE REAL RULERS OF IRAN. THE RELIGIOSITY OF THE THREE IS ACCEPTED AS GENUINE, BUT THE ANTI-AMERICANISM IS ONLY SEEN AS A NECESSARY TACTIC TO CONSOLIDATE POWER IN REVOLUTIONARY IRAN.

WHILE UNIVERSITY PROFESSORS IN PARTICULAR EXPRESSED SOME CONCERN ABOUT RUTHLESS CAPRICIOUSNESS OF ONGOING PURGE OF "TAGHOOTIS" AND "SAVAKIS" FROM FACULTY, FRIENDS SAY THEY ARE MORE RELAXED ABOUT PERSONAL SECURITY THAN THEY WERE AS RECENTLY AS TWO MONTHS AGO. WHILE MOST HAVE HAD FRIENDS OR RELATIVES IN PRISON, FEW HAD CLOSE ACQUAINTANCES WHO WERE EXECUTED. EVENTS HAVE RECEDED ENOUGH INTO THE PAST FOR FRIENDS TO JOKE OF FEARS OF THE "KOMITEH" KNOCK ON THE DOOR AT MIDNIGHT, THE "KOMITEH" RAIDS LOOKING FOR LIQUOR, THE SECRET BURNING OF PLAYBOY MAGAZINES.

TABRIZIS EVEN GRIN A LITTLE ABOUT HOW THEY WERE AFRAID OF RUSSIAN INTERFERENCE DURING THE REVOLUTION AND WERE READY TO FLEE TO TURKEY IF NECESSARY. PARTICULARLY AMONG PEOPLE OVER 40 THE MEMORY OF THE PISHEVARI DAYS IS STILL STRONG. AS SEVERAL FRIENDS PUT IT: "ALL IT TOOK TO DRIVE OUT 45,000 AMERICANS WAS AN INDICATION THAT THEY WEREN'T WANTED, THE RUSSIANS DON'T LEAVE AS EASILY."

TABRIZIS HAVE NOT YET SORTED OUT THE GAINS AND LOSSES OF THE SHAH'S OVERTHROW AND THE NEW GOVERNMENT'S PROGRAMS OR LACK THEREOF. EMBOFF HAS FOUND IT A TROUBLING EXPERIENCE TO BE ASKED FOR ADVICE BY FRIENDS ON QUESTIONS OF WHETHER THEY SHOULD LEAVE IRAN OR STAY, WHETHER THEY SHOULD JOIN THE GOVERNMENT OR STAND ASIDE. YET, FOR ALL OF THE REVOLUTION'S FAILURES, THERE IS ONE CLEAR GAIN. EXCEPT FOR THE FACT THAT NO ONE DARES TO PUBLICLY (OR EVEN TOO LOUDLY IN PRIVATE) SUPPORT THE SHAH'S OLD REGIME, THERE IS AN INCREDIBLE INCREASE IN FREEDOM OF EXPRESSION SINCE THE REVOLUTION.

FRIENDS DARE TO "G-D KHOMEINI" OVER THE TELEPHONE AND SPEAK FRANKLY OF POLITICS IN LARGE GATHERINGS. WHILE MUCH OF CRITICISM OF U.S. POLICY IN IRAN IS UNINFORMED, CYNICAL AND CONSPIRATORIAL IN NATURE, THE REMOVAL OF THE COMNIPRESENT SAVAK HAS CERTAINLY REVITALIZED A HEALTHY INTEREST IN BOTH INTERNAL AND EX

1979TEHRAN11319.subject: MODERATION: DOES IT HAVE A CHANCE?

segments.text: (C - ENTIRE TEXT).

SUMMARY: THE MODERATE IRANIAN POLITICAL PARTIES, WHICH WERE ACTIVE DURING THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION AND WHICH HAVE A LONG HISTORY OF OPPOSITION TO THE SHAH, HAVE BEEN PUSHED INTO THE BACKGROUND BY THOSE INDIVIDUAL AND GROUPS WHO FOLLOW A NARROW AND AUTHORITARIAN INTERPRETATION OF ISLAM. WITHIN THE PAST FEW WEEKS, MODERATE GROUPS WHO FAVOR A MORE BALANCED SOCIETY RESEMBLING A WESTERN SOCIAL-DEMOCRACY, HAVE BECOME MORE VOCAL. WHILE NOT DIRECTLY CRITICIZING AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, THEY HAVE FOCUSED THEIR CRITICISM ON SOME OF THE OBVIOUS FAILURES OF THE PRESENT REGIME. THE POLITICAL POSITION OF THESE GROUPSIS STILL PRECARIOUS. IT EXPRESSES ITSELF THROUGH A FEW SECULAR SPOKESMEN, SOME LIBERAL CLERICS, AND SOME SMALL NEWSPAPERS.
ALTHOUGH STILL NOT A MAJOR FORCE ON THE IRANIAN POLITICAL SCENE, THESE GROUPS HAVE BEEN ABLE TO ORGANIZE THEMSELVES ENOUGH TO EXPRESS IDEAS CONTRARY TO THOSE OF THE RULING ESTABLISHMENT. END SUMMARY.

THE ROLE OF SECULAR AND CLERICAL MODERATES--THE HEIRS IS STILL A MATTER OF DEBATE. SINCE THE REVOLUTION FIGURES SUCH AS MATIN-DAFTARI NAZIH, FORUHAR,SANJABI, AND BAZARGAN HIMSELF HAVE BEEN OVERSHADOWED BY KHOMEINI AND BY HIS ALLIES WHO SHARE HIS VISION OF A THEOCRATIC IRAN. NOT ALL OF THESE SUPPORTERS OF KHOMEINI ARE CLERICS; THEY INCLUDE THE "SECULAR MULLAHS" SUCH AS QOTBZADEH, YAZDI, CHAMRAN, TABATABA'I AND OTHERS. THIS GROUP HAS DOMINATED THE GOVERNMENT, THE PRESS, THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL, AND THE COUNCIL OF EXPERTS. IT HAS HARRASSED AND IGNORED ITS OPPONENTS.
BAZARGAN REMAINS POWERLESS; MATIN-DAFTARI AND NAZIH ARE IN HIDING; FORUHAR IS IGNORED; AND SANJABI QUIT HIS JOB IN DISGUST AND LEFT THE COUNTRY.

ALTHOUGH THE POSITION OF THE MODERATE PARTIES IS STILL VERY FRAGILE, IN RECENT WEEKS THEY HAVE SHOWN SOME SIGNS OF LIFE. ALTHOUGH THEIR MOST IMPORTANT ORGANS, INCLUDING THE NEWSPAPER AYANDEGAN AND THE POPULAR HUMOR MAGAZINE AHANGAR, WERE SUPPRESSED IN AUGUST, THEY HAVE BEGUN PUBLISHING SMALL PAPERS SUCH AS KHALQ-E-MOSALMAN (FROM THE MUSLIM REPUBLICAN PEOPLES' PARTY); JONBESH (PUBLISHED BY ALI ASGHAR HAJ SEYYID JAVADI), JEBHEH-YEAZADI FROM THE IRAN PARTY AND AZADI FROM THE NATIONAL DEMOCRATIC FRONT.

ALTHOUGH THE CIRCULATION OF THESE PAPERS IS LIMITED AND THEY CARRY MUCH LESS INFLUENCE THAN THE THREE MAJOR DAILIES (KAYHAN, ETTELAAT, AND BAMDAD) THEY DO OFFER SUBSTANTIAL AND CRITICAL COMMENTARY ON EVENTS -- A COMMENTARY OFTEN AT VARIANCE WITH THE OFFICIAL VERSION.

FOR THE PAST SIX WEEKS, THE MUSLIM REPUBLICAN PEOPLES PARTY (MPRP) HAS ORGANIZED FRIDAY AFTERNOON MEETINGS AT ITS TEHRAN HEADQUARTERS. ALTHOUGH THE FIRST MEETING ATTRACTED ONLY ABOUT 100 PEOPLE, EMBASSY POLITICAL OFFICER AND POLITICAL ASSISTANT ATTENDED OCTOBER 19 MEETING AND FOUND AN OVERFLOW OF OVER 1500. THE CROWD WAS LAAGELY MIDDLE-CLASS AND WELL-EDUCATED.

THERE WERE MANY WOMEN, SOME VEILED, A FEW CLERICS.THE SPEAKERS INCLUDED AHMAD ALIZADEH, THE SECRETARY-GENERAL OF THE MPRP,AND RAHMATULLAH MOQQADAM-MARAGHE'I, LEADER OF THE RADICAL MOVEMENT AND EAST AZARBAIJAN DELEGATE TO THE COUNCIL OF ------------------063349 281740Z /44 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 4479 INFO SECDEF WASH DC JCS WASH DC AMEMBASSY ABU DHABI AMEMBASSY ANKARA USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY DOHA AMEMBASSY ISLAMABAD AMEMBASSY JIDDA AMEMBASSY KABUL AMEMBASSY KUWAIT AMEMBASSY LONDON AMEMBASSY MANAMA AMEMBASSY MOSCOW AMEMBASSY MUSCAT AMEMBASSY PARIS USCINCEUR VAIHINGEN GE SECTION 02 OF 04 TEHRAN 11319 MOVEMENT AND EAST AZARBAIJAN DELEGATE TO THE COUNCIL OF EXPERTS.
ALTHOUGH THE AUDIENCE AND SPEAKERS HAD NO AFFECTION FOR THE OLD REGIME, THERE WERE FEW MENTIONS OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, AND NO ANTI-AMERICAN STATEMENTS.

THE SPEAKERS ELICITED THE GREATEST RESPONSE BY THEIR ATTACKS ON AKHUNDBAZI (CLERICAL MEDDLING), ON THE COUNCIL OF EXPERTS,AND ON ATTEMPTS TO ESTABLISH A THEOCRATIC DICTATORSHIP THROUGH THE VELAYAT-E-FAQIH. ONE OF THE SPEAKERS FOUND THE CROWD'SPULSE WHEN HE SAID, "WE WANT THE ISLAM OF DR. SHAR'IATI; WE DON'T WANT THE ISLAM OF.........)" AND LEFT THE END EMPTY FOR THE CROWD TO FILL IN. BOTH MOQQADAM-MARAGHE'I AND ALIZADEH WERE CRITICAL OF THE VELAYAT-E-FAQIH. THE LATTER SAID, "THIS CLAUSE IS AN ACT OF TREASON AGAINST FUTURE GENERATIONS OF IRANIAN PEOPLE.

WE HAD A REVOLUTION NOT TO PREPARE THE GROUND FOR A DIFFERENT KIND OF DESPOTISM." SPEAKING PRIVATELY AFTER THE MEETING, MOQQADAM-MARAGHE'I SAID THAT EVEN THE RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP HAS NOW REALIZED THAT IT WILL NOT BE ABLE TO SELL THE VELAYAT-E-FAQIH TO THE IRANIAN PEOPLE IN ITS PRESENT FORM. "THE COUNCIL OF EXPERTS HAS DECIDED TO REOPEN DEBATE ON THIS ISSUE. I HOPE THAT SOME KIND OF IMPROVEMENT WILL BE POSSIBLE."

THE MODERATES, IN CRITICISING VELAYAT-E-FAQIH, HAVE FOUND SOME ALLIES AMONG CLERICS SUCH AS AYATOLLAHS NURI AND SHARI'AT-MADARI WHO SHARE THE VIEW THAT SUCH AN INSTITUTION, IF NOT PROPERLY DEFINED, COULD LEAD TO A DICTATORSHIP. ONE OF THE MOST INTERESTING RECENT DEVELOPMENTS HAS BEEN THE ENTRANCE OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI'S SON, HOJJAT AL-ISLAM AHMAD KHOMEINI, INTO THE DEBATE ON THIS SUBJECT. IN THESE DEBATES, THE YOUNG KHOMEINI HAS TAKEN A POSITION WHICH HAS MUCH IN COMMON WITH THE MODERATE VIEW THAT VELAYAT-E-FAQIH, AS DEFINED BY THE CONSTITUTION, CONTAINS SOME DANGEROUS AMBIGUITIES. EMBASSY WILL DISCUSS THIS QUESTION IN MORE DETAIL IN SEPARATE MESSAGE.

IN PART, RECENT OUTSPOKENNESS OF THE MODERATES CAN BE ATTRIBUTED TO DISILLUSION WITH SOME ASPECTS OF THE REVOLUTION--ESPECIALLY TRENDS TOWARD AUTHORITARIAN, CLERICAL RULE. THE MODERATES HAVE ALSO TAKEN ADVANTAGE OF THE GOVERNMENT'S OBVIOUS MISHANDLING OF CERTAIN ISSUES TO ATTRACT ALLIES BEYOND THE NORMALLY MINISCULE CONSTITUENCY OF GROUPS SUCH AS THE RADICAL MOVEMENT, THE IRAN PARTY,AND THE NATIONAL FRONT. FOR EXAMPLE, THE OBVIOUS FAILURE OF A MILITARY POLICY IN KURDESTAN HAS BROUGHT CALLS FOR RECONCILIATION, EVEN BY FIGURES WITHIN THE REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS.

A COLUMNIST IN THE NORMALLY CONSERVATIVE ENGLISH-LANGUAGE TEHRAN TIMES HAS URGED THE WITHDRAWAL OF NON-KURDISH GUARDS FROM THE REGION; THE TUDEH PARTY PAPER MARDOM, STUNG BY ACCUSATIONS OF SOVIET INVOLVEMENT IN KURDESTAN, HAS CALLED FOR A NEGOTIATED SETTLEMENT. ONLY THE RIGHT-WING ISLAMIC REPUBLICAN PARTY, THROUGH ITS ORGAN JOMHURI-YE-ISLAMI, HAS CONTINUED TO REFER TO THE KURDISH INSURGENTS AS "AMERICAN MERCENARIES". HOWEVER, THE IRP HAS BECOME INCREASINGLY ISOLATED IN ITS POSITION.

THE GOVERNMENT'S FAILURE TO ENSURE PERSONAL SECURITY, ITS CRUDE ATTEMPTS AT CENSORSHIP, AND SCANDALS INVOLVING THE REVOLUTIONARY COURT SYSTEM--LARGE-SCALE BRIBERY AND THEFT INVOLVING NO LESS A FIGURE THAN FORMER TEHRAN PERSECUTOR AYATOLLAH AZARI-QOMI HIMSELF--HAS ALSO WIDENED THE APPEAL OF THE MODERATE MESSAGE. THE PAPER AZADI OF OCTOBER 18 PRINTED A BITTER ATTACK ON THE REVOLUTIONARY JUSTICE SYSTEM ACCUSING IT OF IGNORING THEFTS BY ILYAVI, FORMER ASSISTANT TO PROSECUTOR-GENERAL HADAVI, WHILE SENDING PROSTITUTES AND SMALL-TIME DRUG SMUGGLERS TO THE FIRING SQUAD.

EMBASSY POLOFF AND VISITING DEPARTMENT OFFICER MET FOR 45 MINUTES WITH AYATOLLAH HUSSEIN ALI MONTAZERI AT HIS COUNCIL OF EXPERTS OFFICE ON OCTOBER 25. AYATOLLAH MONTAZERI IS CHAIRMAN OF THE COUNCIL OF EXPERTS AND WAS APPOINTED IMAM JOM'EH (FRIDAY PRAYER LEADER) OF TEHRAN IN SEPTEMBER, 1979, AFTER THE DEATH OF AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI. MEETING HAD BEEN ARRANGED BY THE FOREIGN MINISTRY.

DEPOFF OPENED BY CONVEYING GREETINGS FROM THE AMERICAN GOVERNMENT AND AMERICAN PEOPLE. AMERICANS HAD FELT MUCH SYMPATHY FOR THE SUFFERING OF IRANIANS DURING THE PERIOD OF THE REVOLUTION. WE ALSO ADMIRED THE COURAGE OF UNARMED IRANIANS IN THEIR STRUGGLE AND THE IDEALS OF FREEDOM WHICH MOTIVATED THE REVOLUTION. WE SHARE THOSE IDEALS.

MONTAZERI WAS FRIENDLY AND WARM IN REPLY. HE SPOKE OF HIS GREAT ADMIRATION FOR PRESIDENT CARTER. HE RECALLED HOW HE LEARNED OF CARTER'S ELECTION WHILE HE WAS IN PRISON AND HOW PLEASED HE WAS TO HEAR THAT THE PRESIDENT WAS A PIOUS CHRISTIAN AND A BELIEVER IN HUMAN RIGHTS. HE KNEW AMERICANS, LIKE PEOPLE EVERYWHERE, SHARED THOSE IDEALS. MONTAZERI SAID HE CONSIDERED IT A PITY THAT THE PEOPLE OF THE UNITED STATES, FOR WHOM THE IRANIAN PEOPLE HAD GREAT FEELINGS OF FRIENDSHIP, SHOULD BE SO DOMINATED BY A MINORITY WHICH FORCES THE COUNTRY TO SUPPORT ISRAEL AGAINST THE ASPIRATION OF THE MOSLEM PEOPLES.

MONTAZERI SAID THAT HE COULD NOT UNDERSTAND WHY THE UNITED STATES HAD BEEN WILLING TO LOSE SO MUCH PRESTIGE AND ECONOMIC ADVANTAGE BECAUSE OF ITS RELATIONS WITH ISRAEL. HE CONSIDERED IT A SHAME THAT A LEADER SUCH AS PRESIDENT CARTER COULD SUFFER SO MUCH FOR THE SAKE OF A COUNTRY THAT BROUGHT THE U.S. NO BENEFIT. "WHAT IS THE BENEFIT IN ISRAEL? THE MUSLIM WORLD HAS MUCH MORE BENEFIT FOR THE U.S. WE HAVE OIL, AND WE NEED AMERICAN PRODUCTS AND TECHNOCSMG THE SEA, BUT SAID THAT HE FELT THERE SHOULD BE EQUALITY FOR ALL RELIGIONS IN PALESTINE AS HAD FORMERLY BEEN THE CASE IN LEBANON.

DEPARTMENT OFFICER SAID THAT U.S. SUPPORT FOR SECURITY OF ISRAEL DID NOT MEAN AUTOMATIC SUPPORT FOR ALL ISRAELI ACTIONS. FOR EXAMPLE, THE U.S. AND ISRAEL HAVE DINE DEED OVER THE LATTER'S ACTIONS IN SOUTH LEBANON AND THE U.S. WAS TRYING TO FIND A SOLUTION TO THAT PROBLEM. THE BASIC PROBLEM IS THAT THE U.S., IN TRYING TO BE FAIR TO BOTH THE ARABS AND ISRAELIS, IS RESENTED BY BOTH SIDES. BUT HE WANTED TO ASSURE AYATOLLAH MONTAZERI THAT THE PRESIDENT WAS EXERTING EVERY EFFORT TO FIND A FAIR AND MUTUALLY ACCEPTABLE SOLUTION TO THE ARAB-ISRAEL QUESTION. NO PRESIDENT HAD WORKED HARDER ON THE OBJECTIVE.

LEAVING THE SUBJECT OF ISRAEL, DEPOFF SAID WE DID NOT WISH TO DWELL ON THE PAST. WE HOPED THAT WITH PATIENCE A NEW PAGE COULD BE TURNED IN U.S.-IRANIAN RELATIONS AND THAT THESE RELATIONS COULD BE BUILT ON A NEW AND STRONG FOUNDATION. IRAN WAS LITTLE UNDERSTOOD IN THE U.S. ONE OF THE PROBLEMS THAT AMERICANS FACED WAS THE ABSENCE OF ACCURATE INFORMATION ABOUT THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION -- A PROBLEM COMPOUNDED BY THE ABSENCE OF AMERICAN REPORTERS, MANY OF WHOM HAD BEEN EXPELLED BY THE REVOLUTIONARY AUTHORITIES.

AYATOLLAH MONTAZERI WAS NOT WELL INFORMED ON THIS QUESTION, BUT HIS TRANSLATOR REPLIED FOR HIM. HE SAID THAT SOME, NOT ALL, REPORTERS HAD WRITTEN DISTORTED AND INACCURATE REPORTS ABOUT IRAN. MONTAZERI ADDED THAT SOME PAPERS HAD CLAIMED THAT IRAN HAD HOSTILE INTENTIONS IN THE PERSIAN GULF. "IN MY FRIDAY SERMON I SAID WE DID NOT COVET ONE INCH OF ANYONE ELSE'S TERRITORY." ONE OF THE PROBLEMS IN OUR RELATIONS, HE SAID, WAS THE ANTI-IRANIAN PROPAGANDA IN THE WESTERN ------------------063678 281835Z /44 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 4486 SECTION 02 OF 02 TEHRAN 11325 EXDIS PRESS.

MUCH OF THE ANTI-AMERICAN COMMENTS IN THE IRANIAN PRESS WAS PRINTED IN REACTION TO THE DISTORTED REPORTING ABOUT IRAN IN THE U.S. MONTAZERI ALSO NOTED THE PAST HISTORY OF INACCURATE REPORTING FROM DIPLOMATIC SOURCES, WHICH SEEMED TO RELY ON THE SHAH AND HIS ORGANIZATION FOR THEIR INFORMATION. FOR EXAMPLE, THE SHAH HAD ONCE CLAIMED THAT AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI HAD ONLY 3,000 SUPPORTERS IN IRAN, ALL OF WHOM WERE JAILED TERRORIST.

IN REPLY TO MONTAZERI'S COMMENT ABOUT A NEW AWARENESS IN THE THIRD WORLD, DEPOFF SAID THAT U.S. SAW THIS NEW AWAKENING AND POLITICAL CONSCIOUSNESS AS A VERY HEALTHY DEVELOPMENT. MONTAZERI SAID THAT HE HOPED THAT ALL COUNTRIES WOULD LEARN FROM HISTORY. THAT A REGIME THAT SURVIVES BY PRESSURE WILL BE OVERCOME BY COUNTER-PRESSURE. OBVIOUSLY, HE SAID, THE SAUDIS HAD NOT LEARNED FROM HISTORY.

IN CONCLUSION, DEPOFF ASKED THAT AYATOLLAH MONTAZERI CONVEY GREETINGS TO AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI, AND TO ASSURE HIM OF OUR DESIRE FOR FRIENDLY RELATIONS WITH IRAN BASED ON MUTUAL RESPECT AND THE ASPIRATIONS OF THE IRANIAN PEOPLE FOR A FREE SOCIETY. HE ADDED THAT HE APPRECIATED THE OPPORTUNITY TO SPEAK FRANKLY IN AN INFORMAL SITUATION AND HOPED THAT CONTACT BETWEEN THE EMBASSY AND THE RELIGIOUS LEADERS COULD BE EXPANDED AND CONTINUED. MONTAZERI RECIPROCATED THESE EXPRESSIONS.

BIOGRAPHIC INFORMATION: AYATOLLAH MONTAZERI WAS BORN IN 1922 IN NAJAFABAD, NEAR ESFAHAN. HIS EARLIEST EDUCATION WAS IN THE RELIGIOUS SCHOOL OF ESFAHAN, WHERE HE OBTAINED THE TITLE OF HOJJAT AL-ISLAM AT THE AGE OF THIRTY. HE WAS A PUPIL OF THE FAMOUS AYATOLLAHS BORUJERDI AND KHOMEINI. IN ADDITION TO HIS POSITION IN THE COUNCIL OF EXPERTS AND AS IMAM JOM'EH OF TEHRAN, HE IS ONE OF THE LEADING PROFESSORS IN THE QOM EDUCATIONAL CENTER (HOWZEH-YE-ELMIYEH-YE-QOM). HE BEGAN HIS POLITICAL ACTIVITIES IN 1963, LEADING A WEEK-LONG STRIKE IN NAJAFABAD TO PROTEST THE ARREST OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI AND OTHER CLERGYMEN.

HE WAS FIRST ARRESTED IN TEHRAN IN MARCH 1966 AND RELEASED AND REERRESTED SEVERAL TIMES. HE WAS REPORTEDLY TORTURED IN QASR PRISON. FOLLOWING A TRIP TO IRAQ AND EXILE WITHIN IRAN, HE WAS TRIED AND SENTENCED TO TEN YEARS INPRISON IN 1975. ON NOVEMBER 1, 1978, HE WAS RELEASED. HE SPEAKS PERSIAN, ARABIC, AND A VERY LITTLE ENGLISH.

ALTHOUGH AYATOLLAH MONTAZERI MAKES AN UNIMPOSING APPEARANCE IN FRONT OF LARGE GATHERINGS AND ON TELEVISION -HE IS VERY SHORT AND HAS A SQUEAKY VOICE -- HE IS VERY GENIAL AND WARM IN A SMALL GROUP. HE SPEAKS SOFTLY AND AT LENGTH, AND ALMOST ALWAYS SMILES. FROM THIS BRIEF MEETING, WE HAVE THE IMPRESSION THAT HE IS NOT A VERY PROFOUND POLITICAL THINKER AND THAT MUCH OF WHAT IS ATTRIBUTED TO HIM IS EITHER WRITTEN FOR HIM OR PUT INTO HIS MOUTH BY OTHERS. AT THIS MEETING, HIS INTERPRETER, A YOUNG RELIGIOUS FIGURE WITH VERY GOOD ENGLISH, SEVERAL TIMES GAVE HIM SUGGESTIONS ON POINTS TO MAKE.

MONTAZERI IS VERY CONCERNED WITH THE SUBJECT OF ZIONISM AND ISRAEL. ALTHOUGH THE ABOVE ACCOUNT MAY NOT REFLECT IT, THE AYATOLLAH WOULD, AT EVERY OPPORTUNITY, BRING THE SUBJECT OF THE MEETING AROUND TO ISRAEL. ON THAT SUBJECT HE NEEDED NO COACHING, EXCEPT WHERE HIS TRANSLATOR TOLD HIM TO TAKE EXCEPTION TO THE USE OF THE WORD "TERRORIST."

SUMMARY: UNREST IN THE KURDISH AREAS CONTINUES, AND THE CITY OF MAHABAD HAS BEEN THE CENTER OF GREATLY INCREASED VIOLENCE. THE LEVEL OF CONFLICT HAS LED TO FOUR CABINET MEMBERS BEING ORDERED TO FORM A SPECIAL PEACENEGOTIATIONS COMMISSION. SEVERAL BOMBING INCIDENTS HAVE BEEN REPORTED IN KHUZESTAN. LAST WEEK'S CONFLICT AT THE CASPIAN CITY OF BANDAR ANZELI SEEMS TO HAVE BEEN DEFUSED, AND AN INVESTIGATIVE COMMISSION HAS BEEN SENT TO REPORT ON THE SITUATION. ISFAHAN'S ANGLICAN BISHOP HAS BEEN ATTACKED BY UNKNOWN ASSAILANTS.

IN TEHRAN, THE CABINET IS SHOWING SIGNS OF INTERNAL STRAIN AS THE MINISTER OF COMMERCE ACCUSES TWO OF HIS PEERS OF INFLUENCING HIM TO APPOINT AN ALLEGED SAVAK MEMBER AS HIS DEPUTY. THE DEPUTY HAS APPARENTLY FLED WITH DOLS 4 MILLION OF THE MINISTRY'S FUNDS. END SUMMARY.

UNREST CONTINUED IN THE ETHNIC KURDISH AREA OF IRAN DURING THE PAST WEEK WITH THE MAIN FIGHTING CENTERED IN MAHABAD. ALTHOUGH REPORTS ARE VERY UNCLEAR, BY THE WEEKEND MAHABAD APPEARED TO BE MORE OR LESS INFORMALLY IN KURDISH REBEL HANDS WITH KDP REBELS MOVING FREELY ABOUT THE CITY. THE IRANIAN ARMY COMMANDER OF THE AREA TOLD THE PRESS THAT ARMY AND REVOLUTIONARY GUARD UNITS IN MAHABAD HAD BEEN CONFINED TO BARRACKS ON PGOI ORDERS TO AVOID KILLING OF CIVILIANS IN THE CITY. WHEN PGOI UNITS TRY TO MOVE ABOUT THE CITY THEY APPARENTLY COME UNDER FIRE.

SCATTERED INCIDENTS HAVE CONTINUED TO OCCUR THROUGHOUT THE KURDISH AREA WITH REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS BEING THE MAIN TARGET OF KURDISH ATTACKS. THE LATEST CLASHES HAVE BEEN REPORTED IN MARIVAN AND BANEH. SCHOOLS THROUGHOUT THE AREA ARE NOW CLOSED AND BUSINESSES APPEAR TO CLOSE WHENEVER AN INCIDENT OR DEMONSTRATION OCCURS (SUCH AS THAT HELD IN SAQHEZ OCTOBER 27).

PRIMIN BAZARGAN AND A DELEGATION OF FIVE MINISTERS VISITED KHOMEINI ON 21 OCTOBER TO DISCUSS KURDISH PEACE PROPOSALS, BUT NO RESULTS HAVE YET BEEN ANNOUNCED. THE ISSUE OF AMNESTY FOR KDP LEADER QASSEMLOU AND KURDSIH RELIGIOUS LEADER SHEIKH EZZEDIN HOSSEINI SEEMS TO BE PROVING A MAIN STUMBLING BLOCK IN NEGOTIATIONS. EVEN THE CONTROVERSIAL "HANGING JUDGE," AYATOLLAH KHALKHALI, SEEMS TO HAVE BECOME INVOLVED IN THE THUS FAR FUTILE ATTEMPTS TO RESTORE SOME PEACE TO THE AREA, OFFERING HIMSELF AS A HOSTAGE TO KDP FORCES IN RETURN FOR THE RELEASE OF REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS CAPTURED BY THE KURDISH INSURGENTS. FOUR MINISTERS HAVE BEEN APPOINTED TO TACKLE THE KURDISH PROBLEM.

INT MIN HASHEM SABAGHIAN, DEFENSE MIN MOSTAFA CHAMRAN AND PLAN, BUDGET ORG MIN EZZATOLLAH SAHABI AND MINISTER OF STATE FOROUHAR MET WITH KHOMEINI OCTOBER 27 TO DISCUSS THE PROBLEMS AND PLAN TO SET UP THEIR HEADQUARTERS IN SANANDAJ. AYATOLLAH SHARIAT MADARI'S NAME HAS ALSO COME UP AS A POSSIBLE MEDIATOR BETWEEN THE PGOI AND KURDISH INSURGENTS. COMMMENT: WE HOPE THE PGOI'S MODERATE STANCE THUS FAR IN MAHABAD INDICATES THAT THE PGOI DOES INTEND TO TRY FOR A NEGOTIATED SETTLEMENT TO THE KURDISH PROBLEM.

KHUZESTAN'S GOVERNOR GENERAL MADANI, WHO CLAIMS THAT THE UNREST IN HIS PROVINCE IS BEING GENERATED BY "A NEIGHBORING COUNTRY" (IRAQ) HAS A PERSONAL INTEREST IN RESTORING CALM TO THE AREA.
A POTENTIAL PRESIDENTIAL CANDIDATE IN THE COMING ELECTIONS, MADANI'S PRESTIGE WILL SUFFER IF HE SHOWS THAT HE CANNOT CONTROL THE SECURITY SITUATION IN KHUZESTAN.

MADANA HAS ALSO BEEN INVOLVED IN SETTLING THE UNREST AT BANDAR ANZELI (FORMERLY BANDAR PAHLAVI). HE VISITED THE CASPIAN CITY TO PARTICIPATE IN PEACE MAKING NEGOTIATIONS FOLLOWING LAST WEEK'S CONFLICT BETWEEN LOCAL FISHERMEN AND REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS. THE CONFLICT, WHICH LED TO 14 DEATHS AND 47 WOUNDED ACCORDING TO THE PRESS (AND 23 DEATHS ACCORDING TO A NAVAL SOURCE) SEEMS TO HAVE BEEN DEFUSED BY THE REMOVAL OF REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS FROM THE CITY AND GRANTING OF MORE RIGHTS TO THE FISHERMEN. AN INVESTIGATION INTO THE BANDAR ANZELI DISTURBANCE HAS BEEN ORDERED BY PRIMIN BAZARGAN.

ACCUSATIONS FOR CAUSING THE DISTURBANCE HAVE BEEN LEVELED BY THE CITY GOVERNOR AGAINST THE MINISTER OF AGRICULTURE AND THE CHIEF OF THE IRAN FISHERIES COMPANY. THE LATTER, AS CAN BE EXPECTED, PUTS ALL BLAME AT THE CITY GOVERNOR'S DOOR.

TEHRAN HAS WITNESSED AN INTERESTING VARIATION ON THE PROBLEM OF THE STUDENT HOUSING SHORTAGE. THE INTERNATIONAL HOTEL ON OLD SHEMIRAN ROAD, THE SINA, THE IMPERIAL, THE WALDORF, AND ROYAL GARDEN HOTELS ON TALEGHANI (TAKHT-E-JAMSHID) AVE., AND THE SEMIRAMIS NEAR THE EMBASSY HAVE BEEN SEIZED BY UNIVERSITY STUDENTS FOR USE AS DORMITORIES. ALTHOUGH TEHRAN'S PROSECUTOR GENERAL SHAHSHAHANI HAS PROTESTED THE SEIZURES, IT IS LIKELY THAT ANY ATTEMPT TO FORCIBLY EVICT THE STUDENTS WILL LEAD TO VIOLENCE.

OTHER SEIZURES OF PROPERTY BY VARIOUS SUCH INTEREST GROUPS HAVE BEEN REPORTED SINCE THE REVOLUTION, AND THE PGOI MUST WALK A FINE LINE BETWEEN THE CONFISCATION DEMANDS OF GROUPS CLAIMING TO BE "REVOLUTIONARY" AND THE WELL DESERVED FEARS OF PROPERTY OWNERS.

ANGLICAN BISHOP HASSAN DEHQANI-TAFTI WAS ATTACKED BY THREE UNIDENTIFIED ASSAILANTS IN HIS HOME IN ISFAHAN ON 26 OCTOBER. THE THREE GUNMEN FIRED FIVE SHOTS, ONE OF WHICH STRUCKTHE BISHOP'S WIFE IN THE HAND, BEFORE FLEEING THE SCENE. MOTIVES FOR THE ATTACK ON THE BISHOP, WHO WAS NOT INJURED,REMAIN UNKNOWN.

A MAJOR SCANDAL IS ROCKING THE MINISTRY OF COMMERCE. DEPUTY MINISTER EBRAHIM NIK KHALQ HAS APPARENTLY ESCAPED INTO HIDING AFTER BECOMING INVOLVED IN A DOLS 4 MILLION FRAUD TO PAY DEMEURRAGE CHARGES TO AN AMERICAN COMPANY. NIK KHALQ IS ALSO BEING ACCUSED OF HAVING HAD ASSOCIATIONS WITH SAVAK, AND OF TRYING TO SET UP A NETWORK OF SAVAK AGENTS WITHIN THE MINISTRY OF COMMERCE. COMMERCE MINISTER REZA SADR HAS BLAMED MIN OF AGRICULTURE ALI MOHAMMED IZADI AND HEALTH MINISTER KAZEM SAMI FOR HAVING INFLUENCED HIM TO APPOINT NIK KHALQ AS DEPUTY MINISTER IN THE FIRST PLACE. SUMMARY: HENRY PRECHT AND I,OCTOBER 27 CALLED ON DR. MOHAMMED BEHESHTI, VICE PRESIDENT OF THE COUNCIL OF EXPERTS AND SECRETARY GENERAL OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLICAN PARTY, THE POLITICAL GROUPING CLOSELY ASSOCIATED WITH KHOMEINI. BEHESHTI REMINDED US OF STRONG PUBLIC FEELING ABOUT ANY SUPPORT FOR EX-SHAH, ASKED ABOUT PROBLEMS IN MILITARY SPARE PARTS SHIPMENTS AND BUSINESS CONTRACTS, AND NOTED WIDESPREAD RUMORS OF CIA INVOLVEMENT IN KURDESTAN. EXPRESSIONS OF SUPPORT BY USG FOR REVOLUTION DID NOT SUFFICE; ACTION RATHER THAN WORDS WAS NEEDED. SAID THAT REVOLUTION HAS SUFFICIENT SUPPORT FROM MASS MAJORITY IN IRAN TO IGNORE MIDDLE CLASS AND PROFESSIONAL MINORITY IF NECESSARY.
BEHESHTI REFLECTS ENORMOUS SELF-CONFIDENCE AND NO APPARENT HOSTILITY, BUT PUTS ONUS HEAVILY ON U.S. SIDE IF U.S.-IRAN RELATIONS ARE TO IMPROVE. END SUMMARY.
BEHESHTI RECEIVED US IN ANTE-ROOM OF THE SENATE BUILDING. HE WAS ALONE, FRIENDLY IN MANNER AND RELAXED IN STYLE BUT COMPLAINING ABOUT OVERWORK.

WE CONVEYED THE GOOD WISHES OF THE AMERICAN GOVERNMENT AND PEOPLE, EMPHASIZING OUR VIEW THAT PROGRESS BY PGOI IN BUILDING NEW INSTITUTIONS OF GOVERNMENT SERVED AMERICAN INTERESTS AS WELL AS THOSE OF IRAN. PRECHT, SPEAKING FROM THE WASHINGTON PERSPECTIVE, NOTED THAT A MUTUAL PROBLEM FOR BOTH COUNTRIES WAS THE INADEQUATE AND TO SOME EXTENT INACCURATE UNDERSTANDING OF THE REVOLUTION AMONG THE AMERICAN AND IRANIAN PUBLIC. HE SAID HE WOULD WELCOME BEHESHTI'S VIEWS AS TO HOW HE SAW OUR RELATIONSHIP AND WHAT MIGHT BE DONE TO IMPROVE IT.

BEHESHTI RESPONDED BY FIRST EMPHASIZING THE NEED FOR THE USG TO DEMONSTRATE ITS GOODWILL BY ACTIONS AS WELL AS WORDS. EXPRESSIONS OF GOODWILL ALONE WOULD NOT SUFFICE. HE RAISED THREE SPECIFIC PROBLEM AREAS. THE FIRST DEALT WITH THE SHAH. THE LATTER HAD IMPOSED FIFTY YEARS OF DEGRADATION ON THE IRANIAN PEOPLE; POPULAR SENTIMENT AGAINST HIM WAS NOW VERY STRONG; THEREFORE IRAN COULD NOT TOLERATE ANY COUNTRY, THE U.S. OR OTHERWISE, PROVIDING HIM ANY SUPPORT. (BEHESHTI'S COMMENTS ON THIS SUBJECT, AS INDEED THROUGHOUT THE CONVERSATION, WERE STRAIGHTFORWARD AND RESTRAINED AND WITHOUT EMOTION.)

HIS SECOND CRITICISM RELATED TO BUSINESS CONTRACTS. HIS POINT WAS THAT IN THE CONTEXT OF A REVOLUTION, PROBLEMS RELATING TO COMMERCIAL ISSUES COULD NOT BE DEALT WITH ON THE BASIS OF NORMAL COMMERCIAL CONSIDERATIONS ALONE; THEY MUST BE APPROACHED FROM A POLITICAL STANDPOINT AS WELL. HE HAD HEARD THAT SUBSTANTIAL IRANIAN FUNDS IN THE U.S. WERE BEING BLOCKED BY JUDICIAL ACTIONS. IT WAS IMPORTANT THAT THE USG DEMONSTRATE ITS SUPPORT FOR IRAN BY HELPING RESOLVE THESE PROBLEMS.

HIS THIRD CONCERN RELATED TO MILITARY AND COMMERCIAL SPARE PARTS. IT WAS APPARENT THAT HE HAD LITTLE DETAILED INFORMATION ON THIS SUBJECT BUT SPOKE FROM SOME UNDERSTANDING THAT SPARE PARTS WERE NOT BEING MADE AVAILABLE BY THE U.S. IN BOTH THE AMOUNTS AND SPEED REQUIRED.

I SAID I WOULD RESPOND CONCERNING THE SHAH AND ASK PRECHT TO SPEAK FROM THE WASHINGTON VIEWPOINT ON THE OTHER ISSUES RAISED. I EMPHASIZED WHAT I HAD TOLD THE PM AND YAZDI ABOUT OUR POSTURE TOWARD THE SHAH WHEN I HAD SPOKEN TO THEM ABOUT HIS TRIP TO THE U.S. FOR MEDICAL TREATMENT. WE DID NOT RECOGNIZE THE SHAH'S AUTHORITY IN IRAN; WE SUPPORTED THE PGOI UNDER BAZARGAN; WE ATTACHED MAJOR IMPORTANCE TO IRAN'S INTEGRITY AND INDEPENDENCE; AND WE HAD EMPHASIZED TO THE SHAH THAT HE SHOULD NOT PARTICIPATE IN ANY POLITICAL ACTIVITY WHILE IN THE U.S.

BEHESHTI TOOK NO EXCEPTION TO THIS BUT THEN ASKED WHAT I HAD TO SAY ABOUT RUMORS REACHING HIM OF CIA ACTIVITY IN KURDESTAN AND ELSEWHERE IN IRAN. I SAID THERE WAS ABSOLUTELY NO BASIS FOR THESE RUMORS; NEITHER THE CIA NOR ANY OTHER ELEMENT OF THE USG WAS INVOLVED IN ANY WAY WHATSOEVER IN ANY ACTIVITY PREJUDICIAL TO IRAN'S INTEGRITY. I COULD GIVE HIM THIS ASSURANCE ON THE BASIS OF FULL AWARENESS OF USG ACTIVITIES IN IRAN.

PRECHT SAID WE RECOGNIZED THERE WERE MANY PROBLEMS IN THE BUSINESS FIELD, BUT THERE WERE TWO SIDES TO ALL THESE ISSUES. USG WAS ACTIVELY INVOLVED DOING WHAT IT COULD TO FACILITATE RESOLUTION OF THESE PROBLEMS; INDEED IN SOME CASES WE HAD FILED BRIEFS IN SUPPORT OF THE IRANIAN SIDE WITH U.S. COURTS. ON MILITARY SPARES, PRECHT REVIEWED STEPS WE HAD TAKEN TO ENSURE TRUST FUND SOLVENCY, NOTING THAT THIS HAD BEEN ASSURED SINCE JULY AND THAT THERE HAD BEEN NO OBSTACLES PLACED BY THE USG SINCE THAT TIME TO THE MOVEMENT OF SPARES. THERE WERE INDIVIDUAL INSTANCES WHERE WE WOULD HAVE SOME DIFFICULTIES, BUT THE USG INTEREST WAS TO FACILITATE THE MOVEMENT OF SPARES SO AS TO ENSURE A CONTINUED MILITARY SUPPLY RELATIONSHIP WITH IRAN. WE ALSO WANTED TO BE HELPFUL IN ASSURING SPARES AND EQUIPMENT FOR COMMERCIAL FIRMS. WE NEEDED INFO ON SPECIFIC CASES TO BE HELPFUL.

BEHESHTI SPENT SOME TIME EMPHASIZING TO US THE MASS SUPPORT FOR THE REVOLUTION IN IRAN. THE SUPPORT WAS NOT YET FULLY EVIDENT OR ORGANIZED IN TERMS OF ANY POLITICAL ORGANIZATION OR PARTY, BUT IT WAS LARGE AND ITS VERY MASS WAS SUFFICIENT TO DEMONSTRATE THE LEGITIMACY AND THE SUPPORT FOR THE REVOLUTION'S OBJECTIVES IN IRAN.THE REVOLUTION'S LEADE SHIP RESTEDIN THIS OVERWHELMING SUPPORT, AN ELEMENT OF THE REVOLUTION THAT ASSURED ITS STRENGTH AND SUCCESS DESPITE THE FACT THAT THERE WERE REPORTS AND RUMORS OF EXTENSIVE PLOTTING, INCLUDING THE POSSIBILITY BY SOME IN THE MILITARY AREA.

ATTEMPTS AT A COUP D'ETAT MIGHT WELL OCCUR, AND HE OBSERVED THAT IF THIS WERE TO HAPPEN, THE U.S. WOULD BE BLAMED BECAUSE OF ITS PREVIOUS EXTENSIVE ROLE IN THE MILITARY AREA. BEHESHTI SPOKE OF THIS NOT IN A MANNER TO SUGGEST HE THOUGHT SUCH ATTEMPTS AT A COUP WOULD SUCCEED BUT THAT INDEED THEY COULD NOT SUCCEED AND THAT ANY SUCH ATTEMPTS WOULD CREATE SERIOUS DIFFICULTIES FOR THE USG IN IRAN. THE REVOLUTIONARY LEADERSHIP HAD DECIDED TO APPROACH THE U.S. AND THE WEST IN A "FRIENDLY AND POSITIVE" FRAME OF MIND,BUT THEY REMAINED DEEPLY SUSPICIOUS.

IN RESPONSE I PICKED UP THE POINT MADE EARLIER BY PRECHT THAT POPULAR PERCEPTIONS OF THE REVOLUTION IN THE U.S. WERE INADEQUATE BUT THAT ON ONE ASPECT OF THE REVOLUTION THERE WAS NO QUESTION OF U.S. PUBLIC AWARENESS. THAT WAS THAT NO ONE IN THE U.S. DOUBTED THE EXTENT OF THE MASS SUPPORT FOR THE REVOLUTION. WITH RESPECT TO OUR RELATIONSHIP WITH THE MILITARY IN IRAN, I TOOK THE OPPORTUNITY TO BRIEF BEHESHTI ON THE SIZE OF OUR MILITARY LIAISON GROUP.

AN ARMISH/MAAG ADVISORY GROUP OF VERY SUBSTANTIAL NUMBERS HAD NOW BEEN REDUCED TO A SIX-MAN LIAISON TEAM WHOSE ONLY PURPOSE WAS TO MAINTAIN CONTACTS WITH IRANIAN COUNTERPARTS TO FACILITATE PGOI MILITARY PROCUREMENT FROM THE U.S.

PRECHT NOTED THAT IN WASHINGTON HIS OFFICE WAS OCCASIONALLY APPROACHED BY IRANIANS WHO REPRESENTED THE MIDDLE AND PROFESSIONAL CLASSES WHO HAD OPPOSED THE SHAH BUT WHO HAD NOW FLED IRAN, FEELING THAT THERE WAS NO LONGER ANY PLACE FOR THEM IN THE NEW POLITICAL ENVIRONMENT. HE ASKED BEHESHTI TO CHARACTERIZE THE ATTITUDE OF THE REVOLUTION'S LEADERSHIP TOWARD THESE AND OTHER IRANIANS WHO APPEAR INCREASINGLY DISILLUSIONED AND DISAPPOINTED WITH THE PROGRESS OF THE REVOLUTION.

BEHESHTI'S RESPONSE WAS TO CONCEDE THAT THE REVOLUTION HAD MADE MISTAKES; THAT WAS INEVITABLE IN A MOVEMENT AS EXTENSIVE AND FAST MOVING AS THAT IN IRAN. THE LEADERSHIP RECOGNIZED THAT IT COULD NOT PUT A WALL AROUND IRAN AND ISOLATE IT FROM OUTSIDE INFLUENCES OR THE TECHNOLOGICAL AND COMMERCIAL INTERESTS THAT SERVED IRAN AND THAT IRAN NEEDED. THE REVOLUTION'S LEADERSHIP WANTED "OPEN LIMITS," NOT "CLOSED LIMITS" WITH THE OUTSIDE WORLD.

BUT THIS MINORITY COULD NOT BE ALLOWED TO DICTATE TO THE MAJORITY OF 35 MILLION IRANIANS WHO SUPPORTED THE REVOLUTION AND THE OBJECTIVES IT WAS PURSUING.

IF NECESSARY, THIS MASS OF IRAN'S POPULATION WOULD GO IT ALONE, AND IN 20 YEARS OR SO IT WOULD BE POSSIBLE TO MAKE UP WHAT HAD BEEN LOST IN THE DEFECTION OF THOSE CLASSES AND INTERESTS REPRESENTED IN THE MINORITY OF ONE MILLION. IN RESPONSE TO OUR QUESTION WHETHER IT MIGHT NOT BE PREFERABLE TO TRY TO WIN OVER THE MINORITY, BEHESHTI EMPHASIZED THAT THAT WAS INDEED THE LEADERSHIP'S PURPOSE AND IT WAS MAKING EFFORTS TO ACCOMPLISH IT. COMMENT: BEHESHTI IS AN IMPRESSIVE FIGURE. CERTAINLY PHYSICALLY, AND IF THIS CONVERSATION IS ANY INDICATION, ALSO IN INTELLECTUAL TERMS. HE SPEAKS WITH ENORMOUS SELF-CONFIDENCE IN SLOW AND MEASURED BUT GOOD ENGLISH. HIS MANNER WAS CALM AND UNEMOTIONAL THROUGHOUT. HIS PURPOSE SEEMED TO BE TO REMIND US THAT IT WAS MORE IN THE U.S. INTEREST THAN IRAN' S TO TRY TO IMPROVE OUR RELATIONSHIP; REVOLUTIONARY IRAN WOULD WELCOME U.S. SUPPORT AND UNDERSTANDING BUT WAS NOT GOING TO BE DEPENDENT ON IT

1979TEHRAN11405.subject: MILLIONS MARCH FOR UNITY AND KHOMEINI

segments.text: (C-ENTIRE TEXT.)

MILLIONS OF IRANIANS PARTICIPATED IN OCTOBER 26 MARCH IN TEHRAN AND THE PROVINCES TO SHOW SUPPORT FOR THE LEADERSHIP OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI AND FOR UNITY OF IMAM (KHOMEINI) AND OMMAT (NATION). THE MARCH HAD BEEN CALLED BY THE ISLAMIC REPUBLICAN PARTY (IRP), LED BY AYATOLLAH BEHESHTI. IN TEHRAN A CROWD ESTIMATED AT OVER ONE MILLION PEOPLE CONVERGED BY VARIOUS ROUTES ON TEHRAN UNIVERSITY WHERE THEY LISTENED TO SPEECHES, CHANTED SLOGANS, AND HELD FRIDAY PRAYERS.

MARCH AND MEETINGS WERE ORDERLY. IN TEHRAN, CROWD INCLUDED MANY WOMEN AND CHILDREN AND UNIFORMED MILITARY PERSONNEL. THERE WAS A GENERAL HOLIDAY MOOD, AND HARASSED MARSHALLS DID AN EXCELLENT JOB OF KEEPING ORDER AND GOOD SPIRITS. CROWDS FILLED ALL STREETS SURROUNDING TEHRAN UNIVERSITY AS WELL AS UNIVERSITY GROUNDS, WHICH WERE TOO CROWDED FOR MANY PERSONS TO PRAY.

AT FOREIGN MINISTER'S SUGGESTION, VISITING DEPTOFF PRECHT, ACCOMPANIED BY EMBASSY POLOFF AND WORRIED-LOOKING OFFICIAL FROM MFA PROTOCOL ATTENDED PRAYERS AND RALLY. TO GET PAST GATE GUARDS, QUICK-THINKING MFA OFFICIAL INTRODUCED U.S. VISITORS AS "FROM THE SENEGAL EMBASSY." FORTUNATELY, NO ONE INVOLVED KNEW MUCH ABOUT SENEGAL. ONLY OTHER FOREIGNERS IN EVIDENCE WERE SENEGALESE AMBASSADOR (REAL) AND SEVERAL NEWSMEN. CROWD WAS MILDLY CURIOUS AND FRIENDLY TOWARD FOREIGN GUESTS. THERE WAS NO HOSTILITY WHATSOEVER.

CROWD WAS ADDRESSED BY AYATOLLAH BEHESHTI, SECRETARY GENERAL OF THE IRP, AND BY MOHAMMAD ALI RAJA'I, ACTING MINISTER OF EDUCATION. BEHESHTI CALLED FOR UNITY FOR ALL SUPORTERS OF THE REVOLUTION AND, REITERATED KHOMEINI'S EARLIER CALL FOR UNITY BETWEEN THE CLERGY AND THE UNIVERSITIES. THESE SPEECHES WERE FOLLOWED BY THE ADDRESS (KHOTBEH) OF AYATOLLAH MONTAZERI, IMAM JOM'EH OF TEHRAN. MONTAZERI APPEARS TO HAVE CONSIDERABLE POPULARITY AMONG THE ORDINARY IRANIAN,WHO APPRECIATES HIS LACK OF AFFECTATION AND HIS SIMPLICTY OF SPEECH. HIGHLIGHTS OF MONTAZERI'S ADDRESS INCLUDED: - A. PEOPLE SHOULD APPRECIATE VALUE OF FREEDOM AND NOT COMPLAIN AT SHORTAGES OF SOAP POWDER AND MEAT.

HE COMPARED THESE COMPLAINTS TO THE QORANIC STORY OF THE ISRAELITES' COMPLAINTS AGAINST MOSES AFTER HE HAD LED THEM TO FREEDOM. - B. PERSONS IN HIGH POSITIONS, INCLUDING CLERGYMEN, SHOULD FOLLOW THE EXAMPLE OF THE PROPHET, AND NOT SURROUND THEMSELVES WITH SERVANTS AND GUARDS TO DISTANCE THEMSELVES FROM THE PEOPLE. - C. ANTI-REVOLUTIONARY BUREAUCRATS SHOULD NOT BE JAILED, BUT SHOULD BE QUIETLY RETIRED AND REPLACED BY YOUNGER, COMMITTED PEOPLE. MONTAZERI COMPLAINED, "AT LEAST IN THE OLD DAYS FEAR OF THE SAVAK MADE SOME OFFICIALS DO SOMETHING FOR THE PEOPLE EVERY NOW AND THEN. NOW THE SAVAK IS GONE, AND THEY NEVER THINK OF THE PUBLIC WELFARE." - D.
FIVE MINUTE ARABIC SPEECH ADVISED ARABS TO LEAVE THE EAST AND WEST AND FOLLOW THE STRAIGHT PATH OF ISLAMIC

AFTER PRAYERS, CHEERLEADER LED ABOUT TWENTY MINUTES OF REVOLUTIONARY SLOGANS. THE ONLY ANTI-AMERICAN VERSE WAS, "DEATH TO THE CORRUPT TRIUMVIRATE: CARTER, SADAT, AND BEGIN." CROWD THEN DISPERSED IN ORDERLY FASHION.

IN ESFAHAN, SHEIKH KHALKHALI TOLD THE CROWD THAT GENERAL HUYSER, ACCOMPANIED BY TWO BURLY SERGEANTS, HAD FORCED THE SHAH OUT OF THE COUNTRY.

FRIDAY PRAYERS, WHICH HAD BEEN STOPPED IN THAT CITY FOR SOME WEEKS WERE RESUMED AT KHOMEINI'S DIRECT ORDER UNDER THE LEADERSHIP OF AYATOLLAH TAHERI. IRANIAN RADIO AND TELEVISION GAVE PROMINENT COVERAGE TO THE MARCH OF SUPPORT IN MECCA, CLAIMING THAT IT WAS JOINEDBY PAKISTANIS, KUWAITIS, AND CHADIANS.

SOME OBSERVERS WERE CONCERNED LEST KHOMEINI'S RECENT ATTACK ON THE OPPONENTS OF VELAYAT-E-FAQIH (SEE TEHRAN 11319) WOULD LEAD TO VIOLENCE AT THE MUSLIM PEOPLES REPUBLICAN PARTY (MPRP) MEETING SCHEDULED FOR LATER THAT DAY. TO PREVENT SUCH AN OCCURRENCE, ARMED REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS FROM TABRIZ AND QOM (PRESUMABLY SHARI'AT-MADARI PARTISANS) PROVIDED SECURITY AT THE MEETING TO PREVENT ATTACK FROM THE HEZBOLLAHIS (RIGHT-WING GOON SQUADS). HOWEVER, THE MEETING WAS HELD WITHOUT INCIDENT.

COMMENT: THE MARCHES AND RALLIES ON UNITY DAY WERE A VIVID DEMONSTRATION THAT AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI STILL COMMANDS GREAT SUPPORT AMONG ORDINARY IRANIAN CITIZENS. THERE WAS NO INDICATION OF ANY COMPULSION OR REGIMENTATION AMONG THE DEMONSTRATORS. MILLIONS OF PERSONS WILL TURN OUT VOLUNTARILY IN SUPPORT OF KHOMEINI. THIS SUPPORT IS INTENSELY PERSONAL, HOWEVER, AND DOES NOT EASILY TRANSLATE EITHER INTO SUPPORT FOR A PROGRAM OF POLITICAL ACTION OR INTO SUPPORT FOR OTHER PERSONALITIES ASSOCIATED WITH THE IMAM. ALTHOUGH THE PRESENT REGIME FACES SEVERE POLITICAL AND ECONOMIC PROBLEMS, IF THE RECENT DEMONSTRATIONS ARE ANY INDICATION, THESE PROBLEMS HAVE NOT LESSENED KHOMEINI'S CHARISMATIC APPEAL TO THE MAJORITY OF HIS COUNTRYMEN.

A REVIEW OF THE QUM BASED MONTHLY MAGAZINE, KUDAK-EMUSALMAN (THE MUSLIM CHILD), PURPORTEDLY THE "FIRST PUBLICATION OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC FOR CHILDREN," GIVES REVEALING INSIGHTS INTO THE PRECEPTS ISLAMIC IRAN INTENDS TO TEACH ITS YOUTH.

IN VOLUME 1, NUMBER 6, OF KUDAK-E-MUSALMAN, THE EDITORIAL BOARD ASKS THE READERSHIP "TO DEFINE FREEDOM" BY WRITING TO THE MAGAZINE AND PROMISES TO REWARD THOSE WHO SEND IN THE BEST THEMES WITH PRIZES. THE PUBLICATION, HOWEVER, DEFINES THE PARAMETERS OF FREEDOM BY LISTING THOSE NOT WORTHY OF FREEDOM: THE ENEMIES OF "RELIGION" (DIN), AGENTS OF FOREIGN COUNTRIES WORKING TO DESTROY THE REVOLUTION, THOSE WHO OPPOSE IMAM KHOMEINI, NEWSPAPERS AND MAGAZINES THAT BETRAY THE REVOLUTION, SMUGGLERS AND NARCOTICS DEALERS, THOSE WHO "CHEAT" WORKERS AND SUPPORTERS OF THE SOVIET UNION, THE U.S., AND ISRAEL.

THE FAIRY TALE, "THE MAGIC BOX", IN THE SAME EDITION, PROVIDES OPPORTUNITY FOR THE EDITORIAL BOARD TO HIGHLIGHT SOME BASIC TENETS OF THE REVOLUTION, I.E., OPPOSITION TO THE HIGH LIFE AND CORRUPTION AND SUPPORT FOR KHOMEINI'S "BAZGASHT BE RUSTA" OR RETURN TO THE VILLAGE. THE STORY RECOUNTS THE STORY OF HASSAN, THE PEASANT BOY WITH THE MAGIC BOX AND THE ONE-EYED DOG WHO RESCUES THE YOUNG DAUGHTER OF THE WEALTHY AND CRUEL HAKIM, OR LOCAL RULER.

WHEN HASSAN GAINS THE UPPER HAND, THE EDITORS HAVE HIM RECITE WHAT THE ULAMA MUST HAVE TOLD THEIR CONGREGATIONS IN SERMONS COMPARING THE SHAH WITH YAZID, THE UMAYYAD GOVERNOR RESPONSIBLE FOR THE DEATH OF HUSSEIN, THE THIRD IMAM. HASSAN SAYS "DO YOU THINK THAT THE POVERTY STRICKEN AREN'T HUMAN... I DON'T LIKE PEOPLE WHO RULE LIKE YOU." HASSAN ORDERS THE HAKIM REMOVED, ASKS THE PEOPLE TO ELECT A "PURE-HEARTED" LEADER AND PROMISES TO MARRY THE YOUNG GIRL ONLY IF SHE ACCEPTS THE BUCOLIC.

HE TELLS HER "YOU MUST KNOW THAT I'M A POOR BOY AND THAT I LIKE TO WORK IN THE GARDEN OR THE FIELDS." SHE AGREES WITHOUT HESITATION AND SAYS, "I TOO DESPISE PALACES AND THE ARISTOCRATIC LIFE. I LIKE THE SIMPLE LIFE AND I SEE HAPPINESS IN IT."

THE MAGAZINE ALSO CARRIES RATHER MUNDANE SECTIONS ON THE STORY OF THE PROPHET AND THE BENEFITS OF PRAYER, ENTITLED "THE WAY TO LOVE GOD," WITH NOTES TO MOTHERS INFORMING THEM OF FUTURE EDITIONS WHICH WILL CONTAIN DETAILED INSTRUCTIONS ON PRAYER. GRAVES

1979TEHRAN11460.subject: MEETING WITH RADICAL MOVEMENT LEADER MOGHADAM- MARAGHEIE

segments.text: MARAGHEIE 1.DGBB AND STRONGLY UP BJUTHAT CHARGE PAY CALL ON KHOMEINI TO COMMVMF A DISCUSSION ON A VARIETY OF SUBJECTS SEPTEMBER 29, RADICAL MOVEMENT LEADER RAHMATOLLAH MOGHADAM-MARAGHEIE, A MEMBER OF THE COUNCIL OF EXPERTS REVIEWING THE CONSTITUTION, REPLIED TO A QUESTION ON HOW THE U.S. COULD IMPROVE ITS RELATIONS WITH IRAN BY STRONGLY URGING THAT THE U.S. CHARGE CALL ON KHOMEINI AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. MOGHADAM APPEARED CONCERNED THAT THE U.S. HM DWPZS. SHOULD ASK IMMEDIATELY FOR AN APPOINTMENT. MOGHADAM POINTED OUT THAT THE TIME WILL NEVER BE RIGHT, THAT KHOMEINI IS NOW OLD AND QUITE INFLEXIBLE. HOWEVER, SHOULD KHOMEINI DIE SUDDENLY BEFORE THE U.S.

PAYS A CALL, EVEN MODERATES WHO DO NOT FULLY SUPPORT KHOMEINI WILL CRITICIZE THE U.S. AND SAY THAT THE LACK OF A MEETING WAS A SIGN OF THE U.S.' LACK OX NTHADAM WAS HOPEFUL, BUT NOT PARTICULARLY O PTIMISTIC, ABOUT THE POLITICAL SITUATION. HE FELT THAT KHOMEINI HELD THE ALLEGIANCE OF THE MASSES AT THE MOMENT AND THAT OVER THE PAST FEW WEEKS HE HAS TAKEN AN INCREASINGLY HARD STAND ON THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC. KHOMEINI IS ALIENATING THE INTELLECTUALS AND MOGHADAM FELT THAT AT SOME POINT SOON HE WILL REALIZE THIS AND RECTIFY THE SITUATION.

MOGHADAM SAID THAT HE SUPPORTS KHOMEINI AND THE IDEA OF THE VALIAT-E-FAQIH BUT THAT HE FEELS THE FAQIH SHOULD NOT HAVE POLITICAL POWER. MOGHADAM SAID HE THOUGHT THE CONSTITUTION WOULD BE FINISHED BY THE COUNCIL OF EXPERTS IN 3-4 WEEKS. IN RESPONSE TO PRECHT'S QUESTION, HE SAID HE HAD TALKED TO BEHESHTI ABOUT POSSIBLE CHANGES IN THE DRAFT AND BEHESHTI SAID HE WOULD BE WILLING TO REVIEW ALREADY PASSED ARTICLES IF THEY WERE INCONSISTENT. MOGHADAM NOTED THAT PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN HAD EARLIER ASKED HIM THE SAME QUESTION AS PRECHT. MOGHADAM DID NOT SEEM TO HOLD OUT MUCH HOPE THAT THE PRESENT FORM OF THE CONSTITUTION WOULD BE CHANGED.

HE DID NOT REPEAT NOT FEEL THAT A REFERENDUM ON THE CONSTITUTIONOR ELECTIONS COULD BE HELD ANYTIME SOON GIVEN THE PROBLEMS IN KURDESTAN. IF THE TEXT WERE NOT CHANGED, ESPECIALLY THE SUNNI-SHIA PROVISION, THE REFERENDUM MIGHT NOT GO WELL FOR THE REGIME.

MOGHADAM SAID THAT MANY PEOPLE WERE CRITICIZING SHARIAT-MADARI FOR LACK OF LEADERSHIP AT THIS POINT. THIS WAS UNJUST AS THIS WAS THE WRONG TIME AND KHOMEINI WAS TOO STRONG AT PRESENT FOR SHARIAT-MADARI TO OPPOSE. THE TIME WOULD COME, MOGHADAM INTIMATED, AND THE AZERBAJANI ARE JUST WAITING FOR A SIGNAL FROM HIM.

QUESTIONED ON THE PROSPECTS FOR PEACE IN KURDESTAN, MOGHADAM FLATLY STATED HE SAW NO POSSIBILITY THAT THE CURRENT PEACE EFFORTS BY THE GOVERNMENT WILL SUCCEED. HAD THE GOVERNMENT MADE THIS TYPE OF EFFORT 6 WEEKS AGO IT MIGHT HAVE WORKED BUT HE SAW NO POSSIBILITY NOW. HE COULD OFFER NO SOLUTIONS FOR SETTLEMENT.

AT THE END OF THE CONVERSATION, MOGHADAM URGED THAT MORE VISITORS BOTH OFFICIAL AND UNOFFICIAL SUCH AS RAMSAY CLARK AND RICHARD COTTAM BE SENT TO IRAN TO STAY IN TOUCH WITH IRANIANS OF ALL POLITICAL PERSUASIONS. LAINGEN NOTE BY OC/T: PARA'S 1 THRU 4 AS RECEIVED. CORRECTION TO FOLLOW.
(S-ENTIRE TEXT.)

IN ABSENCE OF UNDER SECRETARY KHARRAZI CHARGE CALLED ON DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR EUROPE AND AMERICAS ETESAM OCTOBER 31 TO DELIVER INFORMATION IN REF A. CHARGE STRESSED THAT WHILE WE REGRETTED THIS MOST RECENT DEVELOPMENT WE STILL STOOD READY IN THE PERSON OF THE DEPARTMENT'S DIRECTOR OF MEDICAL SERVICES TO ACT AS A POINT OF LIAISON BETWEEN THE DCOTORS DESIGNATED BY THE PGOI AND THOSE ATTENDING THE SHAH. HE REITERATED THAT THE USG NO LONGER VIEWS THESHAH AS HAVING AUTHORITY IN IRAN AND THAT HE IS IN THE U.S. AS A PRIVATE CITIZEN. HE HAD BEEN ADMITTED FOR HUMANITARIAN REASONS AND NO GOVERNMENT FACILITIES WERE BEING MADE AVAILABLE TO HIM.

ETESAM WHO APPEARED NOT TO HAVE BEEN PREVIOUSLY INVOLVED IN AN INTIMATE WAY IN THE MFA'S DELIBERATIONS ON THE SUBJECT OF THE SHAH'S PRESENCE IN THE U.S. ASKED SEVERAL QUESTIONS FOR CLARIFICATION. HE THEN SAID THAT HE COULD APPRECIATE THE CONSIDERATIONS THAT LED THE U.S. TO ADMIT THE SHAH BUT ADDED THAT GIVEN IRANIAN PUBLIC ATTITUDES IT WOULD INEVITABLY AFFECT RELATIONS BETWEEN THE U.S. AND IRAN. DURING THE COURSE OF THE CONVERSATION HE CAME BACK TO THIS POINT SEVERAL TIMES. CHARGE RESPONDED TO THIS BY NOTING THAT IN OUR VIEW THE SHAH IS NO LONGER OF ANY POLITICAL CONSEQUENCE IN THIS COUNTRY.

HE ADDED THAT GIVEN THE OVERWHELMING PUBLIC SUPPORT FOR THE CURRENT AUTHORITIES IN IRAN H WAS CONFIDENT THAT THE PGOI COULD MANAGE THUE OF THE SHAH'S PRESENCE IN THE U.S. SO THAT THIS ISSUE WOULD NOT DAMAGE OUR OVERRIDING MUTUAL INTEREST IN NORMALIZING OUR BILATERAL RELATIONSHIP. ETESAM EXPRESSED THE HOPE THAT THE U.S. WOULD DO EVERYTHING IT COULD TO PROVIDE THE INFORMATION THE PGOI WOULD NEED IN EXPLAINING WHY THE SHAH WAS IN THE U.S.

ETESAM CLOSED OUT THE MEETING BY GOING OVER THE POINTS FROM REF A MADE TO HIM BY CHARGE AT THE BEGINNING OF THE MEETING. SINCE ETESAM DID NOT RAISE THE MATTER OF EXTRADITION (REF B), THE CHARGE DID NOT GO INTO THAT SUBJECT.

CHARGE REMINDED ETESAM HE HAS BEEN IN TOUCH WITH CHIEF OF PROTOCOL SHOKOUHIAN REGARDING ENHANCED POLICE PROTECTION FOR TOMORROW'S PLANNED DEMONSTRATION (SEPTEL) AT EMBASSY AND EXPRESSED CONFIDENCE SUCH PROTECTION WOULD
(C-ENTIRE TEXT.)

AFTER ONLY ONE OR TWO DAYS, A CEASEFIRE REPORTEDLY ORDERED BY THE PGOI IN KURDISH AREAS EITHER OCTOBER 28 OR 29 SEEMS TO HAVE COLLAPSED OCTOBER 30. ACCORDING TO TEHRAN TIMES KURDISH RELIGIOUS LEADER HOSSEINI HAS REJECTED THE CEASEFIRE AND KDP FORCES ARE PRESSING THEIR ATTACKS AGAINST REVOLUTIONARY GUARD AND GENDARMERIE OUTPOSTS. ACCORDING TO TEHRAN TIMES, BOTH MAHABAD AND BOUKAN ARE NOW IN REBEL HANDS AND THE KDP HAS TAKEN OVER MANY OF THE GENDARMERIE OUTPOSTS ON THE IRAN-IRAQ BORDER. MAIN CLASHES AUGUST 30 REPORTEDLY CAME IN AZGELEH DISTRICT IN VICINITY OF QASR-E-SHIRIN ON THE IRAQI BORDER.

(FARSI LANGUAGE PRESS HAS NOT REPORTED THESE CLASHES AND MORNING PAPER BAMDAD IN CONTRADICTORY STATEMENT SAYS KDP HAS CALLED ON ITS MEMBERSHIP IN MAHABAD TO AVOID CLASHES BECAUSE OF NEGOTIATIONS BETWEEN KDP AND PGOI. BAMDAD ALSO SAYS MAHABAD OCTOBER 30 WAS QUIET AND SHOEN.) IN RESPONSE TO CONTINUED KDP ATTACKS JCS CHIEF SHAKER STATED THAT WHILE THE ARMY WOULD NOT START ANY ARMED OPERATION ITSELF, ARMED AGGRESSION AND PROVOCATION AIMED AT THE ARMED FORCES WILL BE CONFRONTED SEVERELY.
(THE ARMY THROUGHOUT THIS PERIOD HAS BEEN TRYING TO STAY OUT OF THE FIGHTING ALTHOUGH IT TOO HAS BEEN TAKING CASUALTIES, AND EMBASSY ASSUMES SHAKER'S MESSAGE MEANS THAT IT WILL CONTINUE THIS POLICY.)

THE KURDISH REGION IS NOW BRACING FOR DEMONSTRATIONS NOVEMBER 1. THE KDP HAS ANNOUNCED THAT THIS YEAR'S EIDE-QORBAN WILL BE CALLED MARTYRS EID, AND HANDBILLS CIRCULATED THROUGHOUT THE REGION ARE CALLING FOR THE KURDISH PEOPLE TO TURN OUT IN LARGE NUMBERS TO PROTEST THE "GOVERNMENT'S CONDUCT" IN HANDLING THE KURDISH PROBLEM.

LITTLE HAS BEEN HEARD FROM THE GOVERNMENT TEAM NAMED TO NEGOTIATE WITH THE REBELS AND SETTLE THE KURDISH PROBLEM. ACCORDING TO TEHRAN PRESS, HOSSEINI HAS NOT ONLY REJECTED THE CEASEFIRE, BUT HAS ALSO PRESENTED THE NEGOTIATORS WITH STIFF DEMANDS. AT LEAST ONE OF THESE DEMANDS APPARENTLY IS THAT THE REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS BE WITHDRAWN FROM THE AREA. LAINGEN
MADE AN EMOTIONAL, UNOFFICIAL, AND PERSONAL PLEA TO EMBOFF (FOR 45 MINUTES) TO EXPLAIN TO USG WHY SHAH MUST LEAVE U.S. PARSA KIA MADE FOLLOWING POINTS.

HE AND DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR EUROPE AND THE AMERICAS ETESAM WERE WORKING HARD TO TRY TO AVOID A CRISIS IN RELATIONS WITH THE U.S. BUT IT WAS ALMOST IMPOSSIBLE. THEY HAD NOT WANTED THE PGOI TO SEND AN OFFICIAL NOTE ON THE SHAH AND HAD WATERED IT DOWN AS FAR AS POSSIBLE, BUT OUTSIDE PRESSURES ON THE FOREIGN MINISTRY WERE TOO STRONG.

PGOI LEADERS (I.E., BAZARGAN AND YAZDI) WERE POWERLESS AND DECISIONS ON HOW TO ACT ON THE SHAH'S CONTINUED PRESENCE IN THE U.S. WOULD NOT BE MADE BY THEM. THE FOREIGN MINISTRY WOULD BE ABLE TO REPAIR THE DAMAGE DONE TO U.S.-IRANIAN RELATIONS IF THE SHAH LEFT IMMEDIATELY AFTER HE IS RELEASED FROM THE HOSPITAL; OTHERWISE THERE WILL BE A CRISIS. PARSA KIA POINTED TO HOW DECISIONS HAD BEEN MADE BY KHOMEINI ON OTHER FOREIGN AFFAIRS ISSUES SUCH AS RELATIONS WITH EGYPT, AND INTIMATED, BUT DID NOT DIRECTLY STATE, THAT THE SHAH'S CONTINUED PRESENCE IN THE U.S. MIGHT WELL RESULT IN A BREAKING OF RELATIONS BETWEEN IRAN AND THE U.S.

PARSA KIA SAID THAT PGOI LEADERS WERE WILLING TO HAVE THE SHAH IN MEXICO BUT THE U.S. WAS A DIFFERENT CASE. THE PGO CONVINCED THAT THE SHAH WOULD USE HIS RESIDENCE IN THE U.S. AS KHOMEINI HAD IN PARIS TO CONTINUE SUBVERSIVE EFFORTS AGAINST THE PGOI. PARSA KIA POINTED OUT THERE ARE 200,000 IRANIANS IN THE U.S. AND THAT THE SHAH HAS LIMITLESS FUNDS AT HIS COMMAND (HE USED THE FIGURE WHICH IS NOW BECOMING COMMON USAGE OF 20 BILLION). PARSA KIA POINTED OUT THAT IRAN WAS A POROUS RUMOR MILL BUT THAT THE PGOI LEADERS HAD NEVER HAD ANY RUMORS THAT THE SHAH HAD CANCER.
FOR THIS REASON THEY WERE VERY SUSPICIOUS OF THE SHAH'S ILLNESS. THEY ALSO DID NOT UNDERSTAND WHY THE SHAH HAD TO HAVE HIS MEDICAL CARE IN THE U.S.

PARSA KIA SAID THAT THE LEADERS OF THE PGOI, BY WHICH HE PLAINLY MEANT KHOMEINI AND HIS ENTOURAGE,WERE NOT POLITICIANS AND DID NOT UNDERSTAND THE DIPLOMATIC PROCESS. THEY DID NOT LOOK TO THE FUTURE RESULTS WHICH ANY DECISION MIGHT BRING. PARSA KIA SAID THAT THEY (THE LEADERS IN QOM) WERE WATCHING VERY CAREFULLY TO SEE WHETHER OR NOT THE SHAH WAS PERMITTED TO STAY IN THE U.S. IF HE WAS, THEY WOULD IMMEDIATELY MOVE. (HE DID NOT SAY HOW, BUT THE INFERENCE WAS TO BREAK RELATIONS.)

DURING CONVERSATION, PARSA KIA ALSO POINTED TO SENATOR JACKSON INTERVIEW ON MEET THE PRESS WHICH,HE SAID,HAD HIT THE UPPER LEVELS OF THE FOREIGN MINISTRY LIKE A BOMBSHELL. (STATE 11446) YAZDI HAD IMMEDIATELY SENT FOR THE FULL TRANSCRIPT WHICH THEY NOW HAD TO SEE THE CONTEXT OF JACKSON'S REMARKS. YAZDI REGARDS JACKSON AS A VERY POWERFUL U.S. LEADER AND WAS WONDERING IF JACKSON'S REMARKS COULD HAVE BEEN INTENDED AS SOME SORT OF MESSAGE FROM THE USG. EMBOFF ASSURED PARSA KIA IT WAS NOT.

1979TEHRAN11516.subject: SHAH'S MEDICAL TREATMENT: DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER BANI-ASSADI PROTESTS

segments.text: C-ENTIRE TEXT.

IN THE COURSE OF A CALL BY TDY ECONOFF TO DISCUSS THE CRUSADE FOR RECONSTRUCTION (REFS), BANI-ASSADI EXPRESSED DEEP BITTERNESS OVER U.S. ADMISSION OF SHAH FOR MEDICAL TREATMENT. WHY, HE ASKED, COULD NOT THE SHAH BE TREATED IN MEXICO? WHY WOULD NOT THE USG ALLOW TWO QUALIFIED IRANIAN PHYSICIANS TO EXAMINE HIM? EVEN ASSUMING THAT INFORMATION WAS PASSED TO THE IRANIAN PHYSICIANS, HOW COULD THE PGOI BE SURE THAT IT WAS CORRECT?

BANI-ASSADI DID NOT COMMENT ON TDY ECONOFF'S STOCK ANSWERS. CLEARLY HE DID NOT BELIEVE THAT THE SHAH WAS ENTITLED TO THE BENEFITS OF MEDICAL ETHICS. "THE MAN IS A CRIMINAL. HE SHOULD BE EXTRADITED," SAID BANI-ASSADI.

COMMENT: ONLY BY SWITCHING THE SUBJECT BACK TO THE CRUSADE(SEPTEL) AND HIS ADMIRATION OF IT WAS TDY ECONOFF ABLE TO RESTORE THE USUAL PLEASANT TONE OF HIS CONVERSATIONS WITH BANI-ASSADI. RELIGIOUS, A DEEP BELIEVER IN THE REVOLUTION, BUT ALSO AN ADMIRER OF THE U.S., BANIASSADI SEEMED MORE HURT THAN ANYTHING ELSE BY THE DECISION TO ADMIT THE SHAH. THERE WOULD, HE SAID, BE FIVE HU THOUSAND DEMONSTRATORS IN FRONTOF THE EMBASSY ON NOVEMBER 1. ALL THAT WAS PLANNED WAS THE PRESENTATION OF A REMONSTRANCE. LAINGEN

1979TEHRAN11520.subject: SITUATION AT EMBASSY AS OF 1100 LOCAL TIME

segments.text: (C-ENTIRE TEXT)

DESPITE ANNOUNCEMENT BY ISLAMIC REPUBLICAN PARTY ORGANIZERS LAST NIGHT THAT THERE WOULD BE NO MARCH ON OUR EMBASSY FOLLOWING PRAYERS NOV 1 AT THE BUS TERMINAL IN SOUTH TEHRAN, A CROWD BEGAN TO GATHER OUTSIDE EMBASSY WALLS ON ROOSEVELT AND TAKHTE JAMSHID AVENUES ABOUT 0900 LOCAL TIME. THIS GROUP PRESENTLY NUMBERS ABOUT 3500 AND IS BEING STEADILY AUGMENTED. IT HAS MARCHED BY FRONT GATES SEVERAL TIMES SHOUTING ANTI-AMERICAN SLOGANS, AND HAS HUNG SOME BANNERS AND POSTERS ON THE ROOSEVELT GATE.

AT THE BEGINNING OF ACTIVITIES AT THE BUS TERMINAL, WHICH WE ARE MONITORING BY RADIO, ANNOUNCEMENT WAS AGAIN MADE THAT FOLLOWING PRAYERS AND CHANTING OF SLOGANS, PARTICIPANTS SHOULD MARCH TO SHUSH SQUARE, ALSO IN SOUTH TEHRAN, INSTEAD OF THE AMERICAN EMBASSY. PROCLAMATION CONDEMNING U.S. IS TO BE READ THERE. SPOKESMAN FOR ORGANIZERS OF THE DEMONSTRATION SPECIFICALLY STATED THAT PROGRAM IS TO END FOLLOWING READING OF PROCLAMATION.
POLICE DETAIL AT EMBASSY WAS REINFORCED THIS MORNING AND NOW NUMBERS ABOUT 3HIS SHOULD BE ADEQUATE SO LONG AS DEMONSTRATORS MAINTAIN A DEGREE OF SELF DIS
EMBASSY COMPOUND PERIMETER IS QUIET AS OF NOON TODAY, FRIDAY, AND THERE IS NO INDICATION AS YET THAT WE WILL HAVE ANY REPEAT OF YESTERDAY'S DEMONSTRATIONS. POLICE ARE PRESENT IN NORMAL NUMBERS.
EVENING CROWDS YESTERDAY LEAVING SPORTS STADIUM ACROSS ROOSEVELT AVENUE FROM COMPOUND MOUNTED SOME NOISY ANTI-US SLOGANS BUT NOTHING UNTOWARD DEVELOPED.

OUTSIDE WALLS OF COMPOUND ARE RICHLY DECORATED WITH NEW GRAFFITTI FROM YESTERDAY'S DEMONSTRATION. THE BLESSINGS OF SPRAY PAINT CANS ARE OBVIOUS. SLOGANS ARE VARIATIONS ON A GENERAL THEME; E.G. - DEATH TO IMPERIALISM, THE US, AND ISRAEL. - THE US AND ISRAEL ARE OUR ENEMIES. - KHOMEINI IS OUR LEADER; THE US IS OUR ENEMY. - MILITARY AND COMMERCIAL AGREEMENT WITH US SHOULD BE ABROGATED. - THE US EMBASSY, A CAGE FOR SPIES, SHOULD BE CLOSED DOWN. - AMERICAN MILITARY REPRESENTATIVES MUST LEAVE IRAN. - DEATH TO AMERICAN, ENEMY OF THE WORLD'S POOR PEOPLE.

ROOSEVELT GATE IS FESTOONED WITH SEVERAL LARGE BANNERS PROCLAIMING THAT ALL THE WORLD'S PROBLEMS CAME FROM THE US, DOWN WITH CARTER AND DEATH TO ZIONISM, THE ILLEGITIMATE CHILD OF T. REMOVING THE BANNERS WILL REQUIRE SOME CAREFUL NEGOTIATION (AND POSSIBLY SOME STEALTH), SINCE ATTEMPTS TO REMOVE ONE OF THEM YESTERDAY RESULTED IN A RENEWED CLAQUE OF DEMONSTRATORS, PROMISING AN ASSAULT OVER THE WALLS IF THE BANNER WAS NOT RESTORED. WE HAVE SWALLOWED OUR PRIDE FOR THE MOMENT, BUT WE INTEND TO PERSEVERE.

NIRT CLAIMS THAT THREE MILLION PARTICIPATED IN THE RALLY SPONSORED BY THE ISLAMIC REPUBLICAN PARTY IN TEHRAN NOV 1, AND THAT "MILLIONS" MORE DEMONSTRATED IN THE PROVINCES. THESE FIGURES ARE UNDOUBTEDLY EXAGGERATED, BUT TELEVISION SHOTS OF THE CROWD IN TEHRAN CERTAINLY SUGGESTED A LARGE TORNOUT. AYATOLLAH MONTAZERI, WHO WAS THE FEATURED SPEAKER IN TEHRAN, WAS CLEARLY CAREFUL TO DRAW A DISTINCTION BETWEEN THE AMERICAN PEOPLE AND THE USG IN HIS CONDEMNATION OF THE LATTER. LAINGEN

1979TOKYO07080.subject: MOFA VIEWS ON CURRENT IRANIAN SITUATION

segments.text: (C) ENTIRE TEXT.
IN RECENT DISCUSSION OF CURRENT IRANIAN SITUATION WITH EMBOFF, SECOND MIDDLE EAST DIVISION DIRECTOR SUTO MADE FOLLOWING POINTS OF INTEREST

JAPANESE AMBASSADOR WADA, WHO WAS HOME FOR BRIEF CONSULTATIONS BEFORE RETURNING TO POST, HAD GIVEN MOFA RELATIVELY OPTIMISTIC REPORT ON BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT AND PROSPECTS FOR STABILITY IN NEAR FUTURE. AMBASSADOR REPORTEDLY SAID THAT PERIOD OF CRISIS AND CHAOS HAD PASSED AND THAT AUTHORITY OF GOVERNMENT WAS GROWING DAILY. DIFFERENCES BETWEEN KHOMEINI AND BAZARGAN WERE SAID TO BE MINOR, AKIN TO DISPUTES WITHIN FAMILY, AND AMBASSADOR JUDGED THERE WERE NO MAJOR DIVISIONS AMONG RULING GROUP. AMBASSADOR ALSO TOLD TOKYO OFFICIALS THAT BAZARGAN ADMINISTRATION SOUGHT CLOSER TIES WITH JAPAN AND DESIRED TO INCREASE JAPANESE PARTICIPATION IN IRANIAN ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT. AS ROLE OF U.S.
IN IRAN CONTINUED TO DIMINISH, AMBASSADOR PREDICTED THAT JAPANESE PRESENCE WOULD BECOME MORE PRONOUNCED, BUT BELIEVED THERE WAS LITTLE OPPORTUNITY FOR CORRESPONDING EXPANSION OF SOVIET INFLUENCE.

SUTO INDICATED, HOWEVER, THAT SOME MOFA MIDEAST EXPERTS, AND MOST JAPANESE JOURNALISTS WITH DIRECT EXPERIENCE OF CURRENT IRANIAN SITUATION, DISAGREED WITH WADA'S ASSESSMENT. THESE OBSERVERS WERE SAID TO BE PESSIMISTIC ABOUT FUTURE OF BAZARGAN REGIME, INASMUCH AS GOVERNMENT HAD BEEN INEFFECTIVE IN CONTROLLING UNEMPLOYMENT AND INFLATION, AND LEFTISTS HAD EXPLOITED PUBLIC FRUSTRATION ON THESE ISSUES TO ENHANCE THEIR OWN INFLUENCE. MANY OF THESE OBSERVERS SAW POSSIBILITY OF LEFTIST TAKEOVER IF PRESENT REGIME FALTERED.
SUTO SAID JAPANESE EMBASSY FAMILIES WERE RETURNING TO TEHRAN, WADA HAVING DETERMINED THAT NO FURTHER SECURITY PROBLEM EXISTED.

SUTO ALSO SAID THAT WORK ON PETROCHEMICAL PROJECT AT BANDARASHAHPUR, WHICH HAD BEEN SUSPENDED WITH WITHDRAWAL OF JAPANESE PERSONNEL IN MARCH, WOULD BE RESUMED NEXT MONTH. JAPANESE TECHNICIANS, HE EXPLAINED, WOULD BEGIN RETURNING TO PROJECT SITE BY END OF APRIL AND FULL PERSONNEL STRENGTH WOULD GRADUALLY BE BUILT UP TO PRECRISIS LEVELS OVER SIX WEEKS. HOWEVER, SUPPLY OF SOME VITAL PARTS WAS BADLY BEHIND SCHEDULE. HE SPECIFICALLY MENTIONED GAS-SUPPLY SYSTEM, WHICH U.S. ENGINEERS LEFT ABOUT 80 PERCENT COMPLETED AND WHICH IRANIANS MIGHT BE UNABLE TO FINISH. IF THIS SYSTEM WERE NOT FINISHED, MAIN PETROCHEMICAL WORKS WOULD BE UNABLE TO FUNCTION.
IN ANY CASE ALREADY UNAVOIDABLE DELAYS WOULD RAISE PROJECT COSTS MUCH BEYOND ORIGINAL PLAN.

1979TOKYO07586.subject: (C) REPLACEMENT OF IRANIAN AMBASSADOR TO JAPAN

segments.text: (C) ENTIRE TEXT

CHARGE INFORMED MAY 2 IN STRICT CONFIDENCE BY DIRGEN MIDDLE EAST AND AFRICAN AFFAIRS CHIBA THAT IRANIAN AMBASSADOR NASSER MAJD WAS BEING REPLACED AND WOULD SHORTLY BE RETURNING HOME. CHIBA REGRETTED DEPARTURE, INASMUCH AS HE HAD BEEN MOST HELPFUL IN WORKING OUT MATTERS OF CONCERN TO JAPAN. THERE HAD BEEN SOME SPECULATION HOW LONG MAJD, REGARDED AS SENSIBLE AND MODERATE, WOULD BE ABLE TO REMAIN, HIS STAYING POWER TO DATE BEING CREDITED IN LARGE PART TO HIS WIFE'S RELIGIOUS CONNECTIONS. SHERMAN

1979USUNN01216.subject: (U) RETURN OF IRANIAN BATTALION FROM UNDOF

segments.text: (C-ENTIRE TEXT)

DURING MARCH 19 MEETING WITH AMBASSADOR MCHENRY, UNDOF COMMANDER PHILIPP (AUSTRIA) PASSED ON INFORMATION REGARDING RECENT REPATRIATION OF IRANIAN BATTALION FROM UNDOF WHICH MAY HAVE SOME RELEVANCE TO CURRENT UNREST REPORTED IN KURDISH AREA OF IRAN.

PHILIPP REPORTED THAT THE IRANIAN BATTALION IN UNDOF WAS MORE THAN NINETY PERCENT KURDISH. THIS FACT, PLUS THE PRESENCE OF A KURDISH TRIBAL CHIEF AS BATTALION COMMANDER, KEPT THE BATTALION TOGETHER DESPITE TURMOIL IN IRAN AND COMPLETE LACK OF SUPPORT FROM HOME GOVERNMENT. PHILIPP SAID THAT WHEN UNIT DEPARTED DAMASCUS, IT WAS STILL A COHERENT MILITARY BODY AND HE SAID HE HAD THE IMPRESSION THAT ON ARRIVAL IN IRAN IT WOULD FIGHT FOR KURDISH INDEPENDENCE. HE SAID THAT THE BATTALION HAD SUFFICIENT ARMS AND AMMUNITION WITH IT WHEN IT LEFT DAMASCUS TO BE A FAIRLY POTENT FORCE IN CURRENT IRANIAN CONTEXT.
